title: Duel in the Sun
actors: Jennifer Jones, Gregory Peck, Joseph Cotten, Lionel Barrymore, Lillian Gish, Herbert Marshall, Walter Huston, Charles Bickford, Harry Carey, Joan Tetzel, Tilly Losch, Butterfly McQueen
description: Pearl is a passionate girl, the daughter of a dancer who was killed by her husband out of jealousy. Raised in a God-fearing family, she meets the violent and possessive Lew; she feels attracted to it in spite of herself and becomes its lover. He dominates her and ends up killing his own brother Jack, who tried to make her repent. Between Pearl and Lew it all ends in a tragic final confrontation. King Vidor (who signs the film, although Sternberg, Willem Dieterle and Otto Brewer took turns directing him) masterfully intertwines western and melodrama in this torrid and baroque film, marked by the intervention of David O'Selznick, screenwriter and producer . Excellent cast and great work on color, to underline the ferocity of passions. The final duel / embrace is famous. It was a scandal: the sexy Jones had just been Bernadette in a very pious film.

title: Gunfigth at Dodge City
actors: Joel McCrea, Julie Adams, John McIntire, Nancy Gates, Richard Anderson, James Westerfield, Walter Coy, Don Haggerty, Wright King, Harry Lauter
description: Having become co-owner of the Dodge City saloon, Barth Masterson finds himself having to face the men of Regan, a local boss who, in order to dominate better, wants to be nominated sheriff at all costs. Barth manages to prevent this by becoming a sheriff himself and thus putting a spoke in the wheel of Regan's men. The attempt to restore legality, however, ends up costing him very dearly, in emotional terms, but the showdown with Regan is only a matter of time.
notes: Joel McCrea, close to retirement (and Peckinpah's "Challenge in the High Sierra" testament), in a western that is sometimes ironic but not entirely convincing.

title: The Scarlet Coat
actors: Cornel Wilde, Michael Wilding, George Sanders, Anne Francis, Robert Douglas, John McIntire, Rhys Williams, John Dehner, James Westerfield, Ashley Cowan, Paul Cavanagh
description: The war of independence against the British is now in the decisive phase. The US military instructs an officer to find out who the general is who passed information to the enemy. The officer insinuates himself into the enemy ranks and here he meets the beautiful Sally, with whom an English officer is also in love. The American manages to find out who the traitor is, while Sally falls in love with him; for his part, the English officer accepts the shooting without batting an eye.
notes: The future director of the "Magnificent Seven" also proves skilled in this espionage story set two centuries ago. The color lives up to the Metro tradition.

title: Man Hunt
actors: Walter Pidgeon, Joan Bennett, George Sanders, John Carradine, Roddy McDowall, Ludwig Stössel, Heather Thatcher, Frederick Worlock, Roger Imhof
description: An Englishman, a world-famous hunter, usually goes in search of his prey in a land not far from the villa where Hitler is staying. One day he is surprised by the Gestapo agents with the sniper rifle aimed at the fuhrer's residence. Arrested and subjected to harsh interrogation, he is only offered freedom if he is ready to declare that he has received orders from his government to kill Hitler.
notes: Interesting and controversial film by Lang, a project originally rejected by John Ford. Under an ambiguous espionage vicissitude, Lang stages more moral than political dilemmas, always keeping the suspense very high.

title: Hell in the Pacific
actors: Lee Marvin, Toshiro Mifune
description: During the Second World War, a missing American pilot and a Japanese officer find themselves living together on a desert island. They start a personal war, but then work together to organize the escape. Almost friends now, they come to another island; in an abandoned warehouse they find Japanese and US material. Regaining consciousness of their respective nationality, they abruptly separate.
notes: Boorman throws himself into the enterprise of this curious anti-war apologue, relying on the extraordinary faces of Toshiro Mifune and Lee Marvin. Inspired by the direction of the visionary English director, even if the project (only two characters on a desert island, almost total lack of dialogue) may appear artificial. The director makes a reflection not only on man, but also on the nature of vision (the final close-up of the eye that preludes the explosion) and maintains a certain hidden sense of humor.

title: Second Chance
actors: Robert Mitchum, Linda Darnell, Jack Palance, Roy Roberts, Dan Seymour, Rodolfo Hoyos jr., Reginald Sheffield, Margaret Brewster, Judy Walsh, Fortunio Bonanova, Milburn Stone, Maurice Jara
description: A woman living in Mexico is sued by an American court: she is the main accusation against a gangster on trial in the United States. A killer, who has long been in love with her, is tasked with silencing her. The woman, in turn, is defended by an ex-boxer.
notes: Breathtaking story full of twists, halfway between the story of a gangster and the traditional adventure. Among the performers dominates Robert Mitchum, at ease in the role of tough with a soft heart. Mexico is hot and passionate, as is often the case in American cinema.

title: Duet for One
actors: Julie Andrews, Alan Bates, Max Von Sydow, Rupert Everett, Liam Neeson, Margaret Courtenay, Cathryn Harrison, Sigfrit Steiner, Macha Meril, Siobhan Redmond
description: On the eve of an important concert, the famous violinist Stephanie Anderson confides to her psychiatrist friend David Cornwallis that she is experiencing the first symptoms of multiple sclerosis. Over time, the woman will become increasingly unable to control the movements of others, compromising her career. Stephanie will struggle to accept her fate and to live with the misfortune ...
notes: Taken from a play by the British Tom Kempinski, it is entrusted to the skill of the performers, guided with sobriety and measure. Sometimes Konchalovskij borders on melodrama and the pathetic, but it is the theme of the relationship between doctor, disease and patient that dictates this.

title: Daffy Duck's Quackbusters
directors: Greg Ford, Friz Freleng, Chuck Jones, Terry Lennon, Robert McKimson, Maurice Noble
description: With the money of an inheritance, the duck Daffy opens with the rabbit Bugs Bunny, the pig Porky Pig, the cat Sylvester and the canary Tweety, a ghost catcher agency. It is almost inevitable that such a mismatched company will soon turn from hunters into ... game. The resources of the unleashed characters are however inexhaustible so that surprises are always lurking. Especially on the part of those who are given up for lost at the start.
notes: Tasty animated parody of "Ghostbusters", the great success of fictional cinema, of which the crazy pencils of Warner have skillfully exploited the topic.

title: Dumbo
description: Dumbo, son of the elephant Jumbo, has two huge protruding ears and for this he is teased by the other elephants of the circus. The poor guy is lonely and dejected, but he meets a true friend in a mouse with an unbridled fantasy. It will be he who will discover that, thanks to his huge ears, the little pachyderm will be able to fly. Dumbo thus becomes the real star of the circus.
notes: Very famous, a classic in children's cinematic imagery for several generations. Amazing design, engaging, supported by perfectly timed music (one for all: the blues in the choir of the crows watching the first flight of the elephant) that won the Oscar. The dream scene of the pink elephants is visionary.

title: Dune
actors: Kyle MacLachlan, Silvana Mangano, José Ferrer, Sting, Francesca Annis, Jürgen Prochnow, Brad Dourif, Linda Hunt, Freddie Jones, Richard Jordan, Virginia Madsen, Sean Young, Everett McGill, Leonardo Cimino
description: In the year 10.191, the powerful Space Guild entrusted the Atreides family with the government of the powerful planet Dune, a completely inhospitable but important reserve of the "melange", a drug that has the fabulous power to extend life in an extraordinary way. However, the Atreides are destroyed by the evil and ruthless Baron Arkonnen; survives, together with his mother, only the young Paul, who has inherited extraordinary powers from his father ...
notes: From the famous saga signed by Frank Herbert, here is a real cult destined for all fans of director David Lynch, who moves with ease between science fiction and mystical instances. Widely manipulated by the producer De Laurentiis, and therefore full of discontinuities (after all the events of the Herbert saga were exterminated), it nevertheless maintains happy moments.

title: Hard to Kill
actors: Steven Seagal, Kelly LeBrock, William Sadler, Frederick Coffin, Bonnie Burroughs, Andrew Bloch, Branscombe Richmond, Charles Boswell, Zachary Rosencrantz, Lou Beatty Jr., Geoffrey Bara
description: Mason (Seagal), an honest police officer, discovers that Senator Vernon Trent is covering a lot of underworld trafficking. The politician then sends a gang of brutal killers to Mason's house to attack her. Mason, seriously injured, remains in a coma for seven years, assisted only by a splendid nurse (Le Brock) who, in love with him, does not stop hoping for his recovery. He regains consciousness, but when Trent finds out, he sends his henchmen again to kill him. The nurse rescues him again and in a safe place helps him in rehabilitation therapy. Mason is soon able to take on the gang. The film is eventful but crude.

title: Walking Tall
actors: Joe Don Baker, Elizabeth Hartman, Gene Evans, Leif Garrett, Dawn Lyn, Noah Beery jr., Lurene Tuttle, Lynn Borden, Arch Johnson
description: Buford Pusser, ex-combatant in Vietnam and ex-wrestler, becomes sheriff to clean up his city of the rot that lurks there with the complicity of the powerful. He knows numerous defeats, even killing his wife but, in the end, honest citizens are all with him.
notes: It seems that the story and the protagonist are real, at least in substance. However, the film is told according to the most well-known stereotypes of a thousand similar stories, born from fantasy. Thus the picture of a society lying in illegality until the rescue of the spotless and fearless hero ends up appearing totally conventional.

title: Tough Enough
actors: Dennis Quaid, Warren Oates, Carlene Watkins, Stan Shaw, Pam Grier, Bruce McGill, Wilford Brimley, Fran Ryan, Christopher Norris
description: Art Long (Quaid) lives as best he can by singing country music, which he himself composes, in small provincial clubs. However, what he earns is not enough to support his wife Caroline and son, so much so that he is forced to change jobs. Embraced his career as a boxer he became famous under the name of Country Western Warrior. The film is not bad: Dennis Quaid was a rising star and the presence of Warren Oates, albeit in a minor role, is always good news. But the idea that an ephebic singer of ballads and lullabies can suddenly become a boxing champion is hard to swallow.

title: Dutch
actors: Ed O'Neill, Ethan Embry, JoBeth Williams, Christopher McDonald, Ari Meyers, Elizabeth Daily, L. Scott Caldwell, Kathleen Freeman
description: Natalie (Williams) has long been separated from her husband (McDonald) and lives in Chicago. His son Doyle (Randall) was sent to study at an exclusive boarding school in Atlanta. Since her ex-husband is leaving, she instructs her new partner Dutch (O'Neill) to pick up Doyle, so that he can spend Thanksgiving with the family. Dutch is as jovial and helpful as the boy proves petulant and convinced he belongs to some sort of social elite. After a series of travel adventures and misadventures, Dutch manages to win Doyle's affection. Doyle will emerge from the experience profoundly changed, and free from social prejudices.
notes: A moralistic and optimistic family comedy on the road, shot with professionalism. The screenplay is by John Hughes, that of "Mom I missed the plane".

title: Little Man, What Now?
actors: Margaret Sullavan, Douglas Montgomery, Alan Hale, Catherine Doucet, DeWitt Jennings, Bodil Rosing, Muriel Kirkland, Donald Haines, George Meeker, Paul Fix
description: In Germany, at the end of the First World War, the economic situation was disastrous and unemployment reached very high levels. Hans goes from job to job, with his pregnant wife he goes to Berlin and, on the day the baby is born, he manages to find accommodation.
notes: Great crying machine built by Borzage on the novel by Hans Fallada. A film that would be impossible to remake today without falling into rhetoric, but which, revised, still works today. Well done Margaret Sullavan.

title: E cominciò il viaggio nella vertigine
actors: Ingrid Thulin, Gastone Moschin, Sergio Fantoni, Giampiero Albertini, Franca Nuti, Anna Bonasso, Marzia Ubaldi, Jacques Sernas, Milena Vukotic, Renato Scarpa, Bruno Corazzari, Danika La Loggia
description: Deported to Siberia on suspicion of Trotskyite complicity, Tatiana Ivanova Zilienina remains devoted to Stalin and the party anyway: especially when the news of Hitler's attack on the USSR arrives ...
notes: The comparison with history is fine: but when De Gregorio tries to deepen the characters, the interest inexorably wanes.

title: ...e continuavano a fregarsi il milione di dollari
actors: Lee Van Cleef, Gina Lollobrigida, James Mason, Gianni Garko, Sergio Fantoni, Simon Andreu, Diana Lorys, Aldo Sambrell, Jess Hahn, Eduardo Fajardo
description: Bomba marries Alicia, the two begin to carry out robberies, but she disappears after having stolen the loot from him. The two meet by chance: she is now the wife of the revolutionary leader Monedero, who hired Bomba to blow up an arsenal of the regular army, setting the reward first at ten thousand, then at one million dollars.
notes: Western spaghetti of not low quality, also and above all thanks to a slap-up cast. Unfortunately, the script fails and the attempt to combine grotesque motifs with the western does not hold up.

title: ...And Justice for All
actors: Al Pacino, Jack Warden, John Forsythe, Craig T. Nelson, Lee Strasberg, Jeffrey Tambor, Christine Lahti, Sam Levene, Robert Christian, Thomas G. Waites
description: In constant struggle with the corrupt administration of justice, lawyer Arthur Kirkland clashes with grumpy judge Henry Fleming. When the latter has to answer for a rape charge, he appoints Kirkland as his defender. Despite being convinced of his guilt, the lawyer cannot refuse the assignment: a moral dilemma that can also cost him expulsion from the order ...
notes: Jewison fully exploits Pacino's histrionic qualities in this "legal thriller" with ethical-deontological implications. A big hand, however, also comes from the rest of the cast, in particular from Jack Warden in the part of Judge Rayford. Screenplay by Valerie Curtin and Barry Levinson.

title: Little Miss Marker
actors: Walter Matthau, Julie Andrews, Tony Curtis, Sara Stimson, Bob Newhart, Lee Grant, Brian Dennehy, Kenneth McMillan, Andrew Rubin, Nedra Volz
description: Tristezza, together with his partner Angustia, leads a "good" gambling den in the back of his shop. As a result, he doesn't earn much and is harassed by the violent Blakie Ryan. One day a gambler leaves his six-year-old girl as a pledge and, after leaving, he commits suicide. Sadness has to look after the little girl in spite of herself.
notes: Remake of an old film with Shirley Temple with the grumpy charity Walter Matthau always very good.

title: Johnny Got His Gun
actors: Timothy Bottoms, Kathy Fields, Jason Robards, Marsha Hunt, Donald Sutherland, Charles McGraw, Sandy Brown Wyeth, Don 'Red' Barry, Peter Brocco, Diane Varsi
description: The tragedy of a WWI veteran reduced to a human wreck in a military hospital, who manages to communicate by moving his head according to the Morse alphabet. Atrocious and beautiful, one of the most totally anti-militarist films in the history of cinema. The only direction (from his own novel) by screenwriter Trumbo, who had been one of the "Hollywood ten" imprisoned during McCarthyism.

title: Operation Daybreak
actors: Timothy Bottoms, Anthony Andrews, Marvin Shaw, Karel Curda, Joss Ackland, Nicola Pagett, Anton Diffring, Carl Duering, Cyril Shaps, Diana Coupland
description: Fictional reconstruction of the killing of Heildrich, Nazi "Reichprotektor" in Czechoslovakia, which took place in Prague in 1941. Honest but without flights; nothing to do with the film that Lang made, almost "live", on the same subject: "Executioners die too" (1943).

title: ...e lo chiamarono Spirito Santo
actors: Vassili Karis, Mimmo Palmara, Margaret Rose Keil, Jack Betts, José Torres, Vittorio Fanfoni, Lina Franchi, Aristide Caporale
description: A ranch owner commissions the Holy Spirit to rob a cargo of gold from a train carriage. The gunslinger hires accomplices and carries out the criminal action. Consuelo, the daughter of the owner of the ranch loved by the Holy Spirit, dies during the coup. The commissioner of the robbery, however, accuses him and the Holy Spirit kills him. At this point an Indian sheriff intervenes who is in charge of leading the Holy Spirit to testify in a trial convinced that the gunslinger is responsible for the death of his sister.
notes: Almost all the worst of western spaghetti in less than a hundred minutes.

title: A Star Is Born
actors: Barbra Streisand, Kris Kristofferson, Gary Busey, Oliver Clark, Venetta Fields, Clydie King, Marta Heflin, M.G. Kelly, Sally Kirkland, Joanne Linville, Paul Mazursky
description: John Howard is a singer now in decline, partly because of alcohol and drugs. He discovers that a young colleague, Esther (Streisand), has all the credentials to make it big: first marries her and then throws her into show business. Except then envy its success and try to hinder it. When he dies in a car accident, she will be left to remember him in her songs. Third film version on the subject, the film is rather rhetorical, banal and tear-jerking. The theme of show business and its background beyond sequins is told with superficiality. However, Streisand was good.

title: Starting Over
actors: Burt Reynolds, Jill Clayburgh, Candice Bergen, Charles Durning, Frances Sternhagen, Austin Pendleton, Mary Kay Place, MacIntyre Dixon, Jay O. Sanders, Charles Kimbrough
description: Phil (Reynolds), divorced from Jessica (Bergen), goes to live in Boston. Here he meets Marylin (Clayburgh). But the ex-wife returns to the office.
notes: From a story by Dan Wakefield, a comedy about who has to start a second life again. Perhaps not entirely homogeneous, but pleasant and intelligent, it updates the sentimental difficulties of Hollywood comedy to the atmosphere of the 70s.

title: And Now for Something Completely Different
actors: John Cleese, Graham Chapman, Eric Idle, Terry Jones, Michael Palin, Terry Gilliam, Carol Cleveland, Connie Booth
description: The film does not have a real plot but it is a collection of sketches among the most successful of the television series curated by Monty Python entitled Flying Circus. They range from the discovery of a dirty English-Hungarian vocabulary, to the family counselor who covets a wife under the eyes of her husband, to the so funny joke that is used by the allies as a weapon against the German army for its effects of devastating laughter. There is the naked organist, the gay interviewer, the contest for "the most imbecile bourgeois of the year" and a thousand other Python-branded devilry. Irreverent towards everything and everyone (including them), desecrators, brilliant "nonsensists", funanboli of the joke, but at the same time always endowed with the most perfect English aplomb: these are the Monty Phytons.

title: ...e per tetto un cielo di stelle
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Mario Adorf, Magda Konopka, Julie Menard, Federico Boido, Cris Huerta, Anthony Dawson, Sandro Dori, Franco Balducci
description: Roger Pratt is a bandit who, with all his people, looks for Tim, the man who killed his two sons, and exterminates all the passengers of a stagecoach, convinced that Tim is also among them. Harry, a poor miner, discovers the corpses and buries them, stealing all their money. And here is Tim, who befriends Harry and tells him the truth.
notes: Among the so-called "spaghetti western", a genre that has had a long period of citizenship in Italian cinema, this is not the worst, but, equally, due to its structural characteristics and poor narrative, it is dull and mediocre.

title: ...e poi lo chiamarono Il Magnifico
actors: Terence Hill, Gregory Walcott, Yanti Somer, Dominic Barto, Harry Carey jr., Enzo Fiermonte, Danika La Loggia, Riccardo Pizzuti, Jean Louis, Alessandro Sperli, Sal Borgese
description: Educated in England, Thomas Moore arrives in the Wild West following the death of his father, an English viscount who fled overseas years earlier. His problem is that he seems too respectable, he never turns armed and, to get around, he prefers the bicycle to the horse. Then he finds himself rivaling a foreman for the heart of the beautiful Candida Olsen and then he gives in and learns how to use the gun too.The title would suggest a sort of sequel to the Trinity series, but it is not so also because Bud is missing here. Spencer. Not that it makes a big difference: the films in that series were all mediocre, except for the slightly funny first ones.

title: E.T.: The Extra-Terrestrial
actors: Dee Wallace, Drew Barrymore, Henry Thomas, Peter Coyote, Robert MacNaughton, K.C. Martel, Sean Frye, C. Thomas Howell, Erika Eleniak, Richard Swingler
description: An extraterrestrial is abandoned on Earth by his companions, forced to leave in a hurry. Men hunt him down, but a group of children hides him. A friendship is born, but the alien (baptized E.T.) is homesick and tries in every way to get in touch with his parents. It will be thanks to the boys that he will be able to escape the ambushes of the military and scientists.
notes: Moving story of a "different" helped by the pure of heart (children) against the coldness of adults and institutions. Exciting even today. A Spielberg in a state of grace recovers the suggestions of the cinema of his childhood and of American popular culture in an apotheosis of sincere Hollywood passion. Oscar for music and visual and sound special effects.

title: E venne il giorno dei limoni neri
actors: Antonio Sabato, Florinda Bolkan, Peter Carsten, Silvano Tranquilli, Pier Paolo Capponi, Didi Perego, Guido Lollobrigida, Frank Latimore, Massimo Farinelli, Stefano Satta Flores
description: Back from America, an Italian mafia enters on a collision course with the Sicilian mafia. Silly action movie. Among the screenwriters Luciano Vincenzoni and Ugo Pirro.

title: Behold a Pale Horse
actors: Gregory Peck, Anthony Quinn, Omar Sharif, Raymond Pellegrin, Paolo Stoppa, Mildred Dunnock, Daniela Rocca, Christian Marquand, Marietto, Perrette Pradier
description: Manuel, after having fought against Francoism in Spain, takes refuge in France. A false news pushes him to cross the border again, luring him into a deadly trap.
notes: The political theme and the more adventurous elements are intertwined in a fragile balance.

title: Hurry Sundown
actors: Michael Caine, Jane Fonda, Rex Ingram, John Phillip Law, Diahann Carroll, Robert Hooks, Faye Dunaway, Burgess Meredith, Loring Smith, George Kennedy, Luke Askew
description: In Georgia, Henry Warren absolutely wants the lands of his cousin Rad and Negro Scott. He accuses Scott of illegal possession and makes sure that he is also blamed for a serious accident, instead caused by himself and of which his son Colie is the victim. The ideological assumption is noble, big are the names that we find among the interpreters, but the screenplay is heavily tied to banal commonplaces, to the point of involuntary grotesque. Not even Preminger, who is also a great director, manages to save the operation.

title: ...e venne un uomo
actors: Rod Steiger, Adolfo Celi, Giorgio Fortunato, Ottone Candiani, Alfonso Orlando, Alberto Rossi, Giovanni Rossi, Fabrizio Rossi, Pietro Germi, Rita Bertocchi
description: Angelo Roncalli is sent to follow the Latin courses held by Don Pietro. Here his religious vocation matures, which pushes him to move to Rome where he is ordained a priest. After the First World War he began his career as Apostolic Nuncio, first in Bulgaria, then in Turkey, and finally in Paris. In 1958 he became Pope with the name of John XXIII, without ever forgetting his humble origins.
notes: The most beloved Pope of the century told by Olmi also using archive clips and a professional actor like Rod Steiger. The director rejects hagiography and manages to move with a simple story.

title: Easy Rider
actors: Peter Fonda, Dennis Hopper, Jack Nicholson, Luana Anders, Antonio Mendoza, Phil Spector, Mac Mashourian, Warren Finnerty, Tita Colorado, Luke Askew, Sabrina Scharf
description: Billy and "Captain America" ??Wyatt want to drive to New Orleans for the carnival. The journey through the States turns into an odyssey into American intolerance. After a stopover in a hippy community, they meet George, who joins them but dies at the hands of strangers in a nocturnal assault. Even for Billy and Wyatt, on the way back, death is waiting.
notes: Mythical. Dennis Hopper reinvents the road movie, perhaps the last of the genres, but "Easy Rider" is also the portrait of a generation or, at least, of a generational spirit then widespread. What does it matter if the film cannot be said to be completely successful?

title: Ecce Bombo
actors: Nanni Moretti, Luisa Rossi, Glauco Mauri, Fabio Traversa, Lina Sastri, Piero Galletti, Susanna Javicoli, Cristina Manni, Lorenza Ralli, Maurizio Romoli
description: The life of Michele, a university student, drags on between many discussions and few facts: from the tables in the bar to the microphones of a private radio, from the sessions of "male self-awareness" to the difficult family coexistence. Michele spends the summer alone in the city; at the end of the holidays, one evening the group decides to visit Olga, a girl with mental problems: at first Michele refuses, but in the end he will be the only one to keep his commitment.
notes: An ironically desperate portrait of the post-1968 25-year-olds: masked behind a succession of surreal and hilarious situations is all the discomfort of a frustrated and disbanded generation.

title: La comédie du bonheur
actors: Michel Simon, Ramon Novarro, Micheline Presle, Jacqueline Delubac, Sylvie, Louis Jourdan, André Alerme, Ève Francis, Magdeleine Bérubet, Marcel Vallée
description: Worried about his philanthropy, which risks squandering his assets, the heirs of the banker Jourdain have him interned in an asylum. Jourdain escapes and decides to try other paths: hired three actors, leads them to a boarding house and directs them in a performance that has as many unhappy protagonists who live there, who will come out transformed. Then, caught back, he returns without regrets to the asylum. In this comedy, to whose vaguely surreal atmospheres Cocteau's dialogues contribute, one can read in transparency an indication of the transfiguring potential of cinema. The script is enhanced by a handful of great actors.

title: Ecco noi per esempio...
actors: Adriano Celentano, Renato Pozzetto, Barbara Bach, Felice Andreasi, Antonio Casagrande, Giuliana Calandra, Franca Marzi, Imma Piro, Capucine, Georges Wilson, Sal Borgese
description: Palmambrogio is a young poet who arrives in Milan in search of a publisher. Instead, he makes friends with Antonmatteo "Click" Colombo, a photographer in constant search for the winning scoop. The two go through some disappointments, until Antonmatteo manages to photograph a kidnapping; but the bandits shoot him and blind him. After entrusting the family to his friend, "Click" goes off alone on an adventure. Trying to exploit some clichés of the "social problem" of the time, the film would like to tell the story of two nutters with surreal tones of comedy. Two hours, however, are definitely too many, especially if there are no script ideas.

title: Echos aus einem düsteren Reich
actors: Michael Goldsmith, François Gibault, Augustine Assemat
description: Michael Goldsmith, sent to the Central African Republic, is suspected of spying. We pass from suspicion to imprisonment, then to mistreatment. Michael gets out of jail licking his wounds and thinking that this is the Bokassa regime. This film is the story of Jean Bedel Bokassa, delusional dictator and perhaps even cannibal, seen through the exemplary story of a journalist who left to do his job and ended up straight into a nightmare. Werner Herzog is always in search of the dark side of the world, the boiling points of the planet, the hearts of darkness of humanity. Now only he is able to make such films.

title: L'eclisse
actors: Monica Vitti, Alain Delon, Francisco Rabal, Lilla Brignone, Louis Seigner, Rossana Rory, Mirella Ricciardi
description: After a disappointment in love, Vittoria meets Piero, a cynical and easygoing stock broker. The two become lovers right after a stock market crash in which Vittoria's mother lost a lot of money in favor of Piero. This casts a shadow over their relationship which falls apart.
notes: #Continuing in his analysis of the disintegration of the Italian bourgeoisie, Antonioni composes the second chapter of his trilogy on incommunicability ("L'avventure", La notte "and" L'eclisse ") with the" muse "and then life partner Monica Vitti.

title: Edipo Re
actors: Silvana Mangano, Franco Citti, Carmelo Bene, Alida Valli, Julian Beck, Luciano Bartoli, Francesco Leonetti, Ahmed Belhachmi, Giovanni Ivan Scratuglia, Giandomenico Davoli
description: Laius and Jocasta feel threatened by the prophecy that their son Oedipus will kill his father and marry his mother. So they order a servant to kill the newborn, but he is picked up by a shepherd and raised by a king of Corinth. Oedipus, now a man, learns the prophecy and runs away, but fate guides him inexorably to the fulfillment of the atrocious prophecy. Desperate Oedipus goes blind. Faithful to the text of Sophocles' tragedies "Oedipus the King" and "Oedipus a Colonus", the film makes use of suggestive sets (modern in the introduction and in the epilogue) and images of plastic effectiveness. Pasolini shrewdly blends "barbarism" and refinement.

title: Edward, My Son
actors: Spencer Tracy, Deborah Kerr, Ian Hunter, James Donald, Mervyn Johns, Leueen MacGrath, Felix Aylmer, Walter Fitzgerald
description: An honest trader (Spencer Tracy) loves his only son madly. For him he would be willing to do anything, and so, when the little one falls ill, he does not hesitate to set fire to his shop to defraud the insurance and pay for the difficult intervention. Years pass, business thrives and the young man grows up without any control, guided by a paternal indulgence without limits. But one day, all the knots will come to a head ...
notes: Mediocre version of a Robert Morley and Noel Langley theatrical success scripted by Donald Ogden Stewart. Actors a little over the top, discreet reconstruction of the environment. A curiosity: Edoardo, the son, does not appear in any scene.

title: Edward Scissorhands
actors: Johnny Depp, Winona Ryder, Dianne Wiest, Kathy Baker, Vincent Price, Alan Arkin, Anthony Michael Hall, Robert Oliveri, Conchata Ferrell, Caroline Aaron, Dick Anthony Williams, O-Lan Jones
description: Peggy discovers in the castle on the hill a curious young man, Edward, "created" by a strange inventor who died before he could fix his upper limbs. His hands, incomplete, are in fact two long scissors. Peggy decides to take him home to her husband and two children, Kevin and Kim. Edward becomes the darling of his neighbors, until a series of daring amorous circumstances lead him to transform into a "monster", hated and chased away by everyone ...
notes: From the director of "Batman" a postmodern parable on the dangers of diversity, with beautiful directorial ideas and a subtle modern fairy tale atmosphere. Last role of the old glorious Price. Bravissimo Depp.

title: The Effect of Gamma Rays on Man-in-the-Moon Marigolds
actors: Joanne Woodward, Nell Potts, Roberta Wallach, Judith Lowry, David Spielberg, Richard Venture, Carolyn Coates, Will Hare, Estelle Omens, Jess Osuna
description: A widow lives modestly with her two daughters amidst continuous crises. Only the youngest manages to maintain the right balance.
notes: Family drama directed by Paul Newman based on a play by Paul Zindel, winner of the Pulitzer Prize. Joan Woodward awarded at Cannes 1973 as best leading actress.

title: La nuit américaine
actors: François Truffaut, Jacqueline Bisset, Valentina Cortese, Jean-Pierre Léaud, Jean-Pierre Aumont, Dani, Alexandra Stewart, Jean Champion, François Truffaut, Nike Arrighi, Nathalie Baye, Bernard Menez
description: Director Ferrand is shooting the film _This is Pamela_ in the studios of the Victorine in Nice. The subject is based on the story of a young Englishwoman just married to an equally young boy. The woman ends up falling in love with her father-in-law, who after running away with her is killed by her betrayed son. The private stories of the protagonists are intertwined with the making of the film.
notes: Only the cinephile, passionate, François Truffaut could carry out a survey of cinema as a profession so affectionately "truthful", so sweet, so perfect. Metacinematographic but free from icy intellectualisms, it is a real declaration of love for the seventh art.

title: Ehi amico... c'è Sabata. Hai chiuso!
actors: Lee Van Cleef, William Berger, Ignazio Spalla, Aldo Canti, Franco Ressel, Antonio Gradoli, Linda Veras, Robert Hundar, Gianni Rizzo
description: Stengel, Judge O'Hara and Ferguson commission a $ 100,000 robbery. Sabata (Van Cleef) recovers the loot, gets a reward and, having identified the trio of principals, squeezes them out by blackmailing them. Banjo, to whom Stengel and associates promise sixty thousand dollars to free them from Sabata, prefers to settle with him. Saturday liquidates Stengel and Ferguson, then pretends to be dead so that Banjo collects the agreed sum from O'Hara. Then, instead of splitting with the new partner, he tries to get away. An "average" product in the best artisan tradition of the Italian western. Great rhythm for a story that shuttles between serious and humorous tones, with an effective Lee Van Cleef.

title: El Alamein (Deserto di gloria)
actors: Fausto Tozzi, Rosanna Rory, Gabriele Tinti, Pierre Cressoy, Matteo Spinola, Marco Guglielmi, Walter Santesso, Livio Lorenzon
description: Sergio, a young son of a father, meets an English singer in a nightclub and falls in love with her. But just when he thinks of marrying her, World War II breaks out. Sergio will find himself in the hell of the African war: he will participate in the battle of El Alamein covering himself with glory.
notes: Negligible war drama.

title: Pampa salvaje
actors: Robert Taylor, Mario Lozano, Ron Randell, Marc Lawrence, Ty Hardin, Felicia Roc, Ángel del Pozo, Susana Mara
description: In Argentina, in a fort at the extreme edge of the pampas not yet fully colonized, numerous soldiers, recruited from the scum of society, desert and join other stragglers and tribes of rebel Indians, living off robberies against the settlers. The captain of the outpost convinces his superiors that women are needed, and prostitutes are sent to the place. It is not only a question of the easy spectacularization of a degraded environment, but also of a discreet analysis of the exasperation of individuals relegated to the margins of society, towards a tiring and at least partial redemption.

title: El cochecito
actors: José Isbert, José Luis López Vazquez, Pedro Porcel, Maria Luisa Ponte, Lepe, Angel Alvarez, Antonio Gavilán, María Isbert, Chus Lampreave
description: Envious of his friend Don Luca, an invalid and owner of a motorized wheelchair, Don Anselmo, whose legs work perfectly, decides to buy himself a "cochecito" too. Ferreri at his debut in Spain, young and bad with a José Isbert who is second to none in terms of obstinacy and malice.

title: El Condor
actors: Jim Brown, Lee Van Cleef, Marianna Hill, Patrick O'Neal, Iron Eyes Cody, Imogen Hassall, Elisha Cook jr., Gustavo Rojo, Florencio Amarilla, Julio Peña, Ángel del Pozo
description: Lute, a young black escaped from a US penitentiary takes refuge in Mexico, where the revolution is raging. Having met an adventurer who calls himself El Condor, Lute proposes to him the attack on a fortress where the treasure of Emperor Maximilian is kept. The fortress is conquered, but a nasty surprise awaits the winners of the battle.
notes: Nothing new under the (Mexican) sun; the film follows very exploited patterns even if it is quite compelling, especially for those who like strong scenes of violence.

title: El Dorado
actors: John Wayne, Robert Mitchum, James Caan, Charlene Holt, Paul Fix, Arthur Hunnicutt, Michele Carey, R.G. Armstrong, Edward Asner, Christopher George
description: Jason, a wealthy rancher, wants to take over a farmer's pastures by force; to this end he hires a gunslinger, Cole Thorton, but he instead allies himself with his old friend, Sheriff Jimmy Harrah, who has long been a slave to alcohol. Together with him he stands up to the arrogant breeder until victory, restoring peace and order to the country.
notes: Very similar in the plot to the previous "A dollar of honor", "El Dorado" traces some themes dear to Hawks: manly friendship, the reestablishment of the law, the sense of duty. Even if his heroes have grown older, and the look has become more ironic and melancholy.

title: El Paso
actors: John Payne, Gail Russell, Sterling Hayden, George 'Gabby' Hayes, Dick Foran, Eduardo Noriega, Henry Hull, Mary Beth Hughes, H.B. Warner, Robert Ellis
description: A lawyer turns into a bandit to bring to justice the corrupt authorities of El Paso, used to stealing veterans from the Secession war.

title: Electra Glide in Blue
actors: Billy Green Bush, Robert Blake, Mitchell Ryan, Jeannine Riley, Elisha Cook jr., Royal Dano, Hawk Wolinski, Peter Cetera, Terry Kath
description: John Wintergreen, street policeman, watches the streets in his "Electra Glide". His dream: to switch to the homicide squad. One day he discovers the corpse of a man and, thanks to his indications, puts the inspector conducting the investigation on the right track. John becomes the driver but, too "zealous", is sent back to the road. Get killed during a chase. The first and only work of the impresario composer James W. Guercio, the film is an excellent example of US cinema in the seventies: bitter and ruthless in photographing America, harsh and melancholy. Great soundtrack.

title: Shock Treatment
actors: Stuart Whitman, Lauren Bacall, Carol Lynley, Roddy McDowall, Olive Deering, Ossie Davis, Donald Buka, Paulene Myers
description: A popular actor pretends to be mad and gets locked up in an asylum to unmask a murderer, who ended up in the clinic with the same stratagem. The actor is in league with an unscrupulous lawyer who believes the criminal is hiding the swag of a big shot somewhere.
notes: Sanders' film would like to replicate the success of Fuller's "Corridor of Fear," released the year before. Of course, the comparison is impossible. Whitman holds up well in the role of the actor forced to play the role of the madman and who really ends up on the verge of madness. As usual, beautiful Lauren Bacall.

title: Pete's Dragon
actors: Sean Marshall, Helen Reddy, Jim Dale, Mickey Rooney, Shelley Winters, Red Buttons, Jane Kean, Jim Backus, Charles Tyner, Gary Morgan, Jeff Conaway
description: Peter is a poor orphan, ignobly exploited by the Gogan family, who bought him, just like any other object. Fortunately for him, the boy is protected by Elliott, a green dragon who sometimes manifests himself to other people as well. When Petere, supported by Elliott, manages to escape the Gogans, the two reach the seaside village of Passamaquody, and here the fun begins ...
notes: A Walt Disney production in which "live" shots are intertwined with animation shots. He is not one of the top management of the company, but he defends himself with honor. Nice drawn dragon.

title: L'emigrante
actors: Adriano Celentano, Claudia Mori, Lino Toffolo, Sybil Danning, José Calvo, Herbert Fux, Omero Capanna, Gigi Reder, Rosita Pisano, Giacomo Rizzo, Nino Vingelli
description: Peppino Cavallo leaves from Naples and embarks for the United States, in search of his father who has been missing for years. Robbed by false friends, he becomes the bodyguard of a mafia boss, until he discovers that it was this man who killed his father. He gives up revenge, but runs into other adventures, until he returns to Italy, accompanied by a beautiful singer.
notes: The direction of Pasquale Festa Campanile is not convincing: the film is ramshackle, now pathetic, now ironic. There is no shortage of some funny gags, but in general the work is lackluster. Celentano makes the histrionic and gives in, while Claudia Mori makes the Loren verse.

title: The Life of Emile Zola
actors: Paul Muni, Gloria Holden, Joseph Schildkraut, Gale Sondergaard, Donald Crisp, Erin O'Brien-Moore, John Litel, Henry O'Neill, Morris Carnovsky, Louis Calhern, Ralph Morgan
description: Emile Zola (1840-1902), the prolific author of the 20 volumes of the Human Comedy, was presented from the beginning of his career, when he lived in an attic with the painter Paul Cézanne, until his death from the fumes of a stove. A fundamental chapter is the passionate stance in favor of the accused in the "Dreyfus case", the Jewish officer unjustly convicted of espionage. A somewhat melodramatic biography (as often happens), but narrated with heart and enlivened by a great interpretation by Paul Muni.

title: Trop tôt, trop tard
description: In the first part on the current images of the Breton countryside, a voiceover reads some pages by Friedrich Engels dedicated to the miserable condition of the peasants of those places at the end of the eighteenth century. The second part includes images of modern-day Egypt with, in the soundtrack, a text by the historian Mahmoud Hussein on the class struggle from Napoleon to Sadat and on how all the liberation movements in that land have always been crushed by the British or recovered. by the local ruling castes.

title: Entr'acte/Voyage imaginaire/La Tour
actors: Jean Borlin, Man Ray, Francis Picabia, Marcel Duchamp, Eric Satie
description: René Clair holds a prominent place in the avant-garde cinema of the 1920s. Entr'acte (1924), his second film, constitutes one of the sacred texts of the surrealist movement: born from a subject by Francis Picabia, accompanied by the music of Satie, interpreted by these and other famous artists is a delightful and irreverent exploitation of the poetic techniques of the group led by Breton. Le voyage imaginaire (1925) is a love story suspended with childlike grace between dream and reality. La Tour (1928) documents the taut, metallic beauty of the Eiffel Tower in seventy-five shots closer to the Cubist vision.

title: Era lui... sì! sì!
actors: Walter Chiari, Silvana Pampanini, Carlo Campanini, Isa Barzizza, Enrico Viarisio, Nyta Dover, Fanfulla, Lilia Landi, Luigi Tosi
description: Commendatore Fernando is stressed by a nightmare in which a young man, always the same, blows beautiful women under his nose. One fine day Walter, a young man identical to the persecutor of his dreams, appears to ask him for work, and Fernando, in a mad anger, would like to drive him out. The man gives up on his purpose on the advice of the doctor and through the intercession of his daughter.
notes: The screenwriters Metz and Marchesi are not doing badly behind the camera. Typical medium product inspired by a hit song. Sophia Lazzaro, not yet Loren, appears in two small roles. The Pampanini instead plays itself.

title: Era notte a Roma
actors: Giovanna Ralli, Leo Genn, Sergey Bondarchuk, Peter Baldwin, Renato Salvatori, Enrico Maria Salerno, Paolo Stoppa, Laura Betti
description: As the battle rages around Monte Cassino, an American, a British and a Russian soldier manage to escape from a concentration camp. A woman, who lives off the black bag, hosts them in the attic of her house, but the three, unable to remain inactive, get in touch with the partisans. Their movements, however, do not go unnoticed and the woman, betrayed by a spy, will be arrested.
notes: Message of solidarity between East and West directed by a moving Rossellini who returns to the topics of his war trilogy, albeit with less incisiveness. Good screenplay signed by the director with Sergio Amidei, Diego Fabbri and Brunello Rondi.

title: Ils étaient neuf célibataires
actors: Sacha Guitry, Max Dearly, Elvire Popesco, Victor Boucher, André Lefaur, Saturnin Fabre, Raymond Aimos, Gaston Dubosc, Henri Cremieux, Betty Stockfeld
description: Nine handsome young ladies risk expulsion from France because their residence permit is about to expire. Knowing this, the founder of a hospice for celibate old people "offers" his nine boarders to the young ladies who, by marrying them, will be able to obtain French citizenship. Famous example of "cinéma de papa" in grand style, with a paused direction, a very bad script and irresistible actors.

title: Dear Brigitte
actors: James Stewart, Bill Mumy, Fabian, Glynis Johns, Ed Wynn, Brigitte Bardot, Cindy Carol, John Williams, Jack Kruschen, Charles Robinson, Howard Freeman
description: A poet retires from university teaching because he hates scientists who undermine the future of humanity with their discoveries. To his amazement, his son Erasmus reveals great mathematical skills: with his calculations he is also able to predict the victories to the horses. An individual comes forward who proposes to use the money from his winnings for cultural purposes: the man accepts, and when he discovers that he is actually a speculator he rebels and allocates the money to the conservation of the fine arts. For his part, Erasmus will fulfill the dream of meeting Brigitte Bardot.
notes: Funny comedy, excellent performance by James Stewart.

title: The Seven Little Boys
actors: Bob Hope, Milly Vitale, James Cagney, George Tobias, Angela Clarke, Herbert Heyes, Richard Shannon, Billy Gray, Lee Erickson, Paul De Rolf
description: The musical number between Eddie Foy and the Italian Maddalena Morando is a success on Broadway. But he is afraid that the girl falls in love with him, breaks the contract and goes away. She then returns to Italy and is about to get married were it not for Eddie, repentant, returns to the office and declares himself. The offspring will be numerous. The best moment of the film is when James Cagney enters the scene and starts a ballet together with Bob Hope. The rest is not that great.

title: The Grass is Greener
actors: Cary Grant, Deborah Kerr, Jean Simmons, Robert Mitchum, Moray Watson
description: An aristocratic British couple in financial difficulty opens the ancestral castle to paying guests, and a wealthy American visitor falls in love with their mistress, while her husband is not insensitive to the graces of a secretary. The lady tries to live with her new suitor. And the situation can only be resolved with a duel between the two men, destined however ...
notes: Sparkling dialogue, subtle humor to ironize on the blue-blooded "caste", splendid interpretations of the "returnee" Cary Grant and the "rustic" Robert Mitchum vying for the noble Deborah Kerr. Perky the secretary Jean Simmons.

title: Hercules in New York
actors: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Arnold Stang, Taina Elg, Deborah Loomis, James Karen, Ernest Graves, Tanny McDonald, Harold Burstein, Merwin Goldsmith
description: Thrown into the sea from Olympus, Hercules lands in New York, and not even Juno can prevent his muscular triumphs. A rambling and boring film, with Schwarzenegger still far from the stars.

title: Ercole alla conquista di Atlantide
actors: Reg Park, Enrico Maria Salerno, Gian Maria Volonté, Fay Spain, Ettore Manni, Luciano Marin, Laura Efrikian, Mario Valdemarin, Mimmo Palmara, Raf Baldassarre
description: Foretold by fatal signs from heaven, the mysterious people of Atlantis are about to conquer Greece. Of all the Hellenic rulers, it is only Androclus, king of Thebes, who has the courage to challenge the invaders, but his ship is captured and he is imprisoned. Hercules, however, is on his trail and, after having managed to penetrate the city of Atlantis, hidden in the bowels of a mountain-island, undoes the spell that makes its inhabitants invincible.
notes: Vittorio Cottafavi is the historical author of the "peplums". Here he ventures a modern and even "political" interpretation. As usual the "special effects" are imaginative.

title: Ercole contro i tiranni di Babilonia
actors: Peter Lupus, Mario Petri, Helga Liné, Anna Maria Polani, Livio Lorenzon, Tullio Altamura, Franco Balducci, Diego Pozzetto, Mirko Valentin, Diego Michelotti
description: The tyrants of Babylon, two brothers and a sister, took the queen of Hellas prisoner. Phaleg, king of Assyria, would like to marry her to take over the kingdom of the woman, but he gets a refusal from the Babylonians. Hercules intervenes and, among various betrayals, battles, destruction and other sensational events, we arrive at the triumph of the good and the punishment of the wicked.
notes: The strand of pseudo mythology on which a sector of Italian cinema has been living for a long time. This is a very modest example.

title: Ercole contro Roma
actors: Sergio Ciani, Wandisa Guida, Daniele Vargas, Andrea Aureli, Livio Lorenzon, Dina De Santis, Carlo Tamberlani, Tullio Altamura, Simonetta Simeoni
description: In 244 the prefect Philip Afro had the Jordan Emperor slain with all his faithful, then he took up the throne of Rome. Giordano's daughter, Ulpia, however, is rescued by Hercules who arrived just in time from Pannonia. Then, with the consul Quinto Traiano, he moves against Afro.
notes: One of the many Italian "peplums" that have been lost in the memory of the time. It is a certain tenderness to see them again today, in the era of special effects, but this episode of the vein definitely lacks in imagination and inventiveness. The story follows some Greek myths, making them very romantic (and making them, in fact, unrecognizable).

title: Ercole, Sansone, Maciste e Ursus gli invincibili
actors: Sergio Ciani, Howard Ross, Nadir Moretti, Yann Larvor, Moira Orfei, Luciano Marin, Hélène Chanel, Lia Zoppelli, Arnaldo Fabrizio, Livio Lorenzon
description: Ercole is in love with the beautiful Onfale and would like to marry her. To win his love he would have to fight with Samson, but Delilah knocks out. the biblical hero cutting his hair. Lydia's messengers, not understanding why Samson did not accept the challenge, have him kidnapped by Ursus: but the latter, in turn, is punished by Maciste.
notes: This Italo-Franco-Spanish co-production is located in the descending phase of the glorious mythological genre, of which it attempts to revive the glories. Then, inevitably, an attempt is made to scrape the bottom of the barrel, bringing together in a single adventure the flower of the strongmen of ancient times.

title: L'eredità dello zio buonanima
actors: Angelo Musco, Elsa De Giorgi, Adolfo Geri, Zoe Incrocci, Enrico Marroni, Rosina Anselmi, Sandro Del Signore, Lulu Marinelli
description: Two families are fighting over an inheritance. The one who believes himself chosen by the deceased spends and spreads for a mind-boggling funeral, but the will hides a trap that gets him into trouble. However, a second will is found, which seems to put everything in order, except the bank where the money of the deceased is kept ...
notes: There is a 1976 remake of the film starring Franco Franchi who, from the confrontation with fellow countryman Musco, however, comes out massacred.

title: Erik il vichingo
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Gordon Mitchell, Eleonora Bianchi, Carrol Brown, Elisa Montes, Eduardo Fajardo, Beni Deus, Lucio De Santis, Roberto Ceccacci
description: In the Middle Ages, Erik, to get away from his treacherous cousin who inherited the throne, sets out in search of new lands beyond the great sea. After a long and adventurous crossing and landing on an unknown continent: America. Here he will have to deal with indigenous tribes.
notes: Shallow adventure film.

title: I Was a Male War Bride
actors: Cary Grant, Ann Sheridan, Marion Marshall, Randy Stuart, Bill Neff
description: At the end of the war, the French captain Henri Rochard goes on a mission to Germany, with an American occupation contingent. Here he is joined by the American lieutenant Catherine Gates. Love is born between the two, soon crowned by marriage. When she has to return home, he demands that the law used for the "war brides" of American soldiers be applied to them too.
notes: Cary Grant, forced to be French, is a champion of sympathy and skill. Ann Sheridan has a hard time on him, but the whole Hawks movie is a masterpiece of rhythm, measure and fun.

title: Erode il Grande
actors: Edmund Purdom, Sylvia Lopez, Massimo Girotti, Sandra Milo, Elena Zareschi, Alberto Lupo, Corrado Pani, Renato Baldini, Camillo Pilotto, Carlo D'Angelo, Enrico Glori
description: Herod, king of Judea, rules with violence and terror. To avoid the invasion of his lands by the victorious Romans, he decides to parley with Octavian. On his departure for Rome, however, the intrigues of the palace are unleashed: the queen mother spreads the false news of his death preparing the accession to the throne of his brother-in-law, Aristobulus. While Herod's wife, Mariam, destined to be killed if her jealous consort was killed, is spared by the faithful Aron. Back home, Herod is so blinded by anger that his insane revenge will eventually overwhelm everything and everyone. Modest costume film made just before the Ercoli boom.

title: The 300 Spartans
actors: Richard Egan, Diane Baker, Ralph Richardson, Barry Coe, David Farrar, Donald Houston, Anna Synodinou, Kieron Moore, John Crawford, Robert Brown
description: Xerxes, king of the Persians, moves with a very powerful army against the free city-states of Greece. Leonidas, king of Sparta, faces the enemy at the Thermopylae pass with very few men. In an epic confrontation, the Asian cavalry is driven back. Xerxes is about to retire but a traitor leads his army behind the Greeks.
notes: Enjoyable American "peplum", faithful to the historical accounts of Herodotus and to the "epos" which is still handed down today and which has become the symbol of the battle of a few for freedom against the multitude who wanted to enslave them.

title: Rescue Me
actors: Stephen Dorff, Michael Dudikoff, Ami Dolenz, Peter DeLuise, William Lucking, Dee Wallace, Liz Torres, Danny Nucci, Ty Hardin, Kimberley Kates
description: Frances is a serious high school student with one weakness: he is madly in love with the most beautiful girl in college, Genny. One day Genny accidentally witnesses a shady traffic between criminals and for this she is kidnapped. Frances can not help but photograph the moment of the kidnapping and then go and ask Mac, a friend of hers, a Vietnam veteran, for help.

title: Killing Streets
actors: Michael Paré, Lorenzo Lamas, Jennifer Runyon, Alon Aboutboul, Ishai Wureit, Shaul Mizrahi, Uri Mauda, Rahely Chimeyan, Hashem Yassin
description: Chris Brandt (Paré) has a twin brother, captain of the Marines, given up for dead in Lebanon in 1983. The official version, however, does not convince him and so he leaves for Beirut where he is treated like a fish in the face by the American ambassador (Lamas) and is kidnapped by terrorists; however, he does not give up and eventually returns to Ohio with his twin safe and sound. Michael Paré was the good lead in Walter Hill's Streets of Fire, a film in which everyone cheered for villain Willem Dafoe. For this child with a lost and innocent air, the role of Rambo does not fit, so much so that he is not credible even for a second.

title: Gli eroi della domenica
actors: Raf Vallone, Marcello Mastroianni, Galeazzo Benti, Gianni Cavalieri, Cosetta Greco, Paolo Stoppa, Franco Interlenghi, Enrico Viarisio, Marisa Merlini
description: Although gifted with great talent, center forward Bardi plays for a mediocre team. Before the last, crucial league match, he receives a big offer to make his team lose. A boy casually attends the meeting: Bardi refuses, but his health conditions do not allow him to excel; the same doctor advised him not to play the second half. But the boy's gaze restores strength to the player, who ...
notes: The film features the historian c.t. of the Vittorio Pozzo national team and some Milan players. Before becoming an actor, Vallone had worn the glorious Torino jersey.

title: The Heroes of Telemark
actors: Kirk Douglas, Richard Harris, Michael Redgrave, Ulla Jacobsson, David Weston, Sebastian Breaks, John Golightly, Alan Howard, Patrick Jordan
description: Second World War: the Nazis install a heavy water factory in Norway, essential for the construction of the atomic bomb. A heroic partisan commando (after many unsuccessful attempts) puts the systems out of order. The Germans quickly restore them and ship the radioactive product to Germany, but the Norwegian patriots luckily manage to sink the boat on which the material travels.

title: Let's Get Harry
actors: Mark Harmon, Gary Busey, Robert Duvall, Michael Schoeffling, Tom Wilson, Glenn Frey, Rick Rossovich, Ben Johnson
description: Harry, a worker in a plumbing company, is kidnapped, along with the American ambassador, by a gang of South American drug traffickers. Faced with the indifference of the government, four of his work colleagues take it into his head to go and free him. They seek help from a disarmed old mercenary, Norman Shrike (Robert Duvall).
notes: If an American director wants to remove his name from the opening credits of a film, the pseudonym that is usually used is Alan Smithee. This time it was Stuart Rosenberg who resorted to makeup. Two great actors like Gary Busey and Robert Duvall, however, could not deny their participation in one of the worst films of the eighties.

title: The Paper Chase
actors: Timothy Bottoms, Lindsay Wagner, John Houseman, James Naughton, Graham Beckel, Edward Herrmann, Craig Richard Nelson, Robert Lydiard, Lenny Baker, David Clennon
description: Harvard law student James Hart is obsessed with the idea that a college degree is indispensable in life. He meets Susan and falls in love with her without knowing that the girl is the daughter of Professor Kingsfield, holder of the hardest course in the faculty. The commitment to studies leads Hart to neglect everything, including Susan, and to place exaggerated hopes in the interest that Kingsfield has in him. Eventually James, who graduated with honors, realizes he has too many illusions ...
notes: A good dramatic plot (scripted by Bridges himself), embellished with photography by Gordon Willis. Oscar to John Houseman for Best Supporting Actor.

title: Les seins de glace
actors: Alain Delon, Mireille Darc, Claude Brasseur, Nicoletta Macchiavelli, Fiore Altoviti, Emilio Messina, André Falcon, Michel Peyrelon, Philippe Castelli
description: François (Claude Brasseur), is a successful writer. One day he meets Peggy (Mireille Darc) and is immediately taken by her mysterious and somewhat ambiguous charm. Although Marc (Alain Delon), the woman's lawyer, warns him about disturbing suspicions regarding her past, François prefers not to care. By now the man is taken by a morbid passion, and in this way he gets entangled in a dramatic spider's web. Psychological mystery based on a short story by Richard Matheson, with an excellent Brasseur.

title: L'Esorciccio
actors: Ciccio Ingrassia, Lino Banfi, Didi Perego, Mimmo Baldi, Tano Cimarosa, Ubaldo Lay, Barbara Nascimben, Romano Sebenello, Luigi Bonos, Dante Cleri, Renato Malavasi, Franca Haas, Salvatore Baccaro, Ada Pometti
description: During archaeological excavations in Iran an amulet was found that ends up in the hands of the ten-year-old son of the mayor of a small town in Lazio. The boy becomes a fiery amateur, and then resorts to the sorcerer Exorcise. And like him all those who, in turn, possess the amulet are unleashed in unseemly oddities. Every so often even the Devil himself appears, until Exorcise swallows the diabolical object.
notes: Ciccio Ingrassia, on one of his subjects, directs himself in a parody, with a somewhat crude but not ignoble comedy, of William Friedkin's "Exorcist" (1973). On this occasion he renounces the company of the usual Franco Franchi shoulder.

title: The Exorcist
actors: Ellen Burstyn, Max Von Sydow, Linda Blair, Jason Miller, Lee J. Cobb, Kitty Winn, William O'Malley, Barton Heyman
description: Regan MacNeil, daughter of a well-known actress, begins to show unusual signs of imbalance. Violent noises come from her room, she becomes hysterical and fulfills monstrous dreams. Moreover, a director friend of the family is found dead after being alone with her. Little by little, however, the doctors who are treating her declare themselves helpless in the face of the very strange manifestations of the girl, even whispering that the poor woman is "possessed" by external forces. The mother is also convinced of this when she calls a priest. But he fails. Another exorcist, after an epic battle, manages to prevail, but at a very high price.

title: The Exorcist III
actors: George C. Scott, Ed Flanders, Brad Dourif, Jason Miller, Viveca Lindfors, Nicol Williamson, Scott Wilson, Nancy Fish, George DiCenzo, Don Gordon, Lee Richardson, Grand L. Bush, Mary Jackson
description: The policeman Kinderman, investigating a series of atrocious crimes that took place in the city, discovers that between them there could be a common religious bond. The case becomes complicated with the killing of some priests, but Kinderman thinks he identifies the perpetrator of the murders in a madman locked up in an asylum who would be the reincarnation of a maniac killed in the electric chair fifteen years earlier.
notes: William Peter Blatty, screenwriter of the first "Exorcist", goes behind the camera. We are far from the thickness of Friedkin's film, but this third part actually "grows inside" ...

title: To Be or Not to Be
actors: Mel Brooks, Anne Bancroft, Tim Matheson, Charles Durning, José Ferrer, George Gaynes, Christopher Lloyd, George Wyner, Lewis J. Stadlen, Jack Riley
description: Frederick Bronski, a theater actor, is a member of the Polish government in exile in London during the German occupation of his country. Back in Warsaw to eliminate a double agent, he then manages to expatriate with his entire theater company, helping himself with a sensational series of disguises. Although directed by Alan Johnson, Mel Brooks can in fact be considered the true author of this remake of Lubitch's 1942 masterpiece We Want to Live. The subject allows him to intelligently embed his farcical repertoire. Magnificent Anne Bancroft, Brooks' wife.

title: They Live
actors: Roddy Piper, Keith David, Meg Foster, George 'Buck' Flower, Peter Jason, Raymond St. Jacques, Jason Robards III, John Lawrence, Susan Barnes, Sy Richardson
description: John Nada, who has landed in Los Angeles in search of work, witnesses a bloody police raid on a chapel. When the waters have calmed down, he enters and finds a pair of dark glasses through which reality appears completely different to him: the world is all black and white, and many "normal" people are aliens who have occupied positions of power and they keep the population subliminal through subliminal messages broadcast on television ...
notes: The film hides under a patina of light-hearted horror staging: its true nature, however, is a harsh and ferocious condemnation of certain American society and its methods.

title: Another Time, Another Place
actors: Lana Turner, Sean Connery, Barry Sullivan, Glynis Johns, Terence Longdon, Sidney James, Martin Stephens, Doris Hare, Julian Somers
description: Sara Worth is the London correspondent for a major New York newspaper. We are in a time of war. One day he meets and falls in love with Mark Trevor a correspondent of the English radio. Despite Mark is married, a love story is born between the two. But Mark dies in an accident. Sara upset, after a long hospitalization in the clinic, leaves for Cornwall where she meets Mark's wife and son. Film with melodramatic tones, even if a little chilled by its British origin. Among the performers to note a young Sean Connery and an always good Lana Turner.

title: Spring Break
actors: David Knell, Perry Lang, Paul Land, Steve Bassett, Jayne Modean, Corinne Wahl, Richard B. Shull, Jessica James
description: With the intention of having a great time, Adam and Nelson head to the beach in Fort Lauderdale, Florida after a year of study. Together with two other smartest friends known on the spot, they learn to hunt down the beautiful girls who flock to the coast, with alternating luck. The only annoyances come from Nelson's stepfather, a senator devoted to shady trades, and his "gorillas". A silly comedy to add to the many others of the "beach teenagers" genre.

title: Haunted Summer
actors: Philip Anglim, Laura Dern, Alice Krige, Eric Stoltz, Alex Winter, Peter Berling, Donald Hodson, Giusto Lo Pipero, Antoinette McLain, Terry Richards
description: Atmospheric Italian encounter between Lord Byron and Percy and Mary Shelley, romantic and transgressive geniuses.
notes: At the same time Ken Russell was shooting on the same "Gothic" theme, but this is worse. Photograph of Rotunno, but it is of little use. Lost actors.

title: Estate violenta
actors: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Eleonora Rossi Drago, Lilla Brignone, Raf Mattioli, Federica Ranchi, Cathia Caro, Giampiero Littera, Bruno Carotenuto, Enrico Maria Salerno, Jacqueline Sassard
description: Riccione: Carlo, the son of a fascist hierarch, falls in love with Roberta, the widow of an officer. When Carlo risks arrest for his documents not in order, Roberta wants to hide him in Rovigo: but after an air attack, the young man decides otherwise ...
notes: The tension caused by the upheavals of the summer of 1943 frames the love story of the two protagonists and conditions their feelings. Zurlini (also screenwriter, together with Giorgio Prosperi and Suso Cecchi d'Amico) does not make a partisan film: with narrative elegance, he evokes a troubled period and proposes a discourse of a primarily existential character.

title: Forever Female
actors: Ginger Rogers, William Holden, Paul Douglas, James Gleason, Jesse White, Marjorie Rambeau, George Reeves, King Donovan, Vic Perrin, Marion Ross
description: A young playwright agrees to change the age of the protagonist of his new job to favor an actress who is no longer young. The result is a fiasco, but in the end, with another actress, the comedy triumphs. Taken from a work by J. M. Barrie, that of Peter Pan but we are far from Eve against Eve even if Rogers' interpretation is excellent and the description of the environment quite merciless.

title: Étoile
actors: Jennifer Connelly, Gary McCleery, Laurent Terzieff, Olimpia Carlisi, Mario Marozzi, Donald Hodson, Charles Durning
description: Claire leaves New York with the hope of being admitted to a dance school in Budapest, directed by an elderly and famous choreographer. The aspiring dancer is rejected at the selection and takes the opportunity to visit the city. In a park he discovers the abandoned villa of Nathalie Moruth, a dancer who died a hundred years earlier. And he identifies with her and with her world. Claire falls under the influence of Sandor, who claims sacrificial victims to the god of Evil for the dance to be perfect.
notes: Uneven black fairytale between the worst Silver and the worst Del Monte An interesting idea thrown away.

title: Un ettaro di cielo
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Rosanna Schiaffino, Carlo Pisacane, Silvio Bagolini, Salvatore Cafiero, Luigi De Martino, Polidor, Aristide Spelta
description: In a remote village at the mouth of the Po, a fair is held every year in which Severino, a friendly salesman, takes part. Retirees, living in poverty, believe in his proposal: to buy a hectare of sky to be able to live well after death. After investing their savings, the old men decide it is time to die and abandon themselves on a boat. They will be saved, the deception will be revealed, but a self-respecting fairy tale cannot end in bad way: Severino marries a local girl and ...
notes: A social story, made with sentiment but with a disastrous commercial outcome that cut short the director's career.

title: Ettore Fieramosca
actors: Gino Cervi, Mario Ferrari, Elisa Cegani, Osvaldo Valenti, Lamberto Picasso, Corrado Racca, Clara Calamai, Umberto Sacripante, Gianni Pons, Carlo Duse, Mario Mazza, Andrea Checchi
description: The castellana di Monreale is in love with the mercenary Fieramosca, but instead marries Graiano d'Asti, who turns out to be a bloodthirsty traitor sold to the French. Then the Spaniards beat the French and Fieramosca, offended by the insults of Captain De La Motte aimed at the Italians, challenged him.
notes: Shot with a wealth of means and with some intent of nationalist propaganda, the film makes use of first-rate sets and costumes; Blasetti gets a lot from his actors and builds an exciting staging.

title: Ettore lo fusto
actors: Vittorio Caprioli, Vittorio De Sica, Rosanna Schiaffino, Philippe Leroy, Giancarlo Giannini, Orchidea De Santis, Aldo Giuffré, Giancarlo Prete, Luciano Salce, Haydee Politoff, Gianrico Tedeschi
description: The keeper of a brothel, Ettore Lo Fusto, is in possession of compromising photos thanks to which he deludes himself that he is fighting a prelate, Cardinal Giove and his secretary Mercury who, dedicated to building speculation, have set their sights on the land the rendezvous house arises. The two prelates, to achieve their goal, pitted against each other Hector and his brothers, Menelaus and Agamemnon.The satirical intent was to remake, in a farcical key, the Trojan War but, the results were rather unfortunate. . The cast is highly respected. Girolami is also known under the pseudonym of Enzo G. Castellari.

title: Eugenia Grandet
actors: Alida Valli, Gualtiero Tumiati, Giorgio De Lullo, Giuditta Rissone, Maria Bodi, Giuseppe Varni, Pina Gallini, Lando Sguazzini, Mario Siletti
description: Daughter of a rich but morbidly miserly man, Eugenia Grandet is secretly engaged to her cousin Carlo, whom her father "exiles" to the Indies. When her father dies Eugenia finds herself rich, but she doesn't manage to be happy for this: after seven years Carlo can return, but now he doesn't love her anymore and wants to marry an aristocrat. Eugenia, dramatically, steps aside.
notes: Mario Soldati portrays the famous novel by Honoré de Balzac with calligraphic care, but without much flair and with ineffective narrative scans. Some intense expressions of Alida Valli redeem a rather dull level of acting.

title: Europa '51
actors: Ingrid Bergman, Alexander Knox, Ettore Giannini, Giulietta Masina, Teresa Pellati, Marcella Rovena, Tina Perna, Sandro Franchina, Maria Zanoli, Silvana Veronese
description: Irène Girard, wife of a diplomat, lives a comfortable life away from any worries. but when her son commits suicide because he feels neglected, something clicks in her: she begins to visit the sick, to console prostitutes and attend factories, etc. She will be branded as insane and locked up in an asylum.

title: Europa, Europa
actors: Marco Holschneider, Julie Delpy, Delphine Forest, René Hofschneider, Piotr Kozlowski, Ashley Wanninger, Halina Labonarska, Klaus Abramowsky, Marta Sandrowicz, Solomon Perel, Martin Maria Blau, Andrzej Mastalerz, Michèle Gleizer
description: To escape Nazi persecution, the Perel family left Germany for Poland. In the flight, the parents are separated from their children, and one of them, Solomon, ends up in a Russian boarding school. Captured by the Germans, he declares himself an Aryan and is enlisted, involuntarily becoming a war hero. Recaptured by the Russians, he is about to be shot but his brother, who escaped the concentration camp, recognizes him and saves him.
notes: The film is based on the diary of Solomon Perel who now lives in Israel. Alternating drama and comedy, Holland effectively reconstructs the chaotic climate of Europe of the time. Intense some sequences such as that of the crossing of the ghetto.

title: The Europeans
actors: Lee Remick, Robin Ellis, Wesley Addy, Tim Choate, Lisa Eichhorn, Kristin Griffith, Nancy New, Norman Snow, Helen Stenborg, Tim Woodward
description: Baroness Eugenia Münster arrives in Boston in 1850, in the company of her brother Felix, to meet the Wentworths, their wealthy American cousins. Ivory, on a screenplay by Prawer Jhabvala, based on a novel by Henry James, makes one of her best films, elegant and with a talented Lee Remick.

title: Eutanasia di un amore
actors: Ornella Muti, Tony Musante, Monica Guerritore, Mario Scaccia, Laura Trotter, Gerardo Amato, Umberto Benedetto, Enrico Bergier, Eduardo Salerno, Luciano Fineschi
description: After years of living together in Florence, professor Paolo Naviase is abandoned by his former student Sena, without explanation. They meet again in Versailles, but having seen the woman on another man's arm, Paolo falls ill and returns to Italy. Now it is Sena who gets back to him and explains the reason for the abandonment: having forced her to have an abortion.
notes: From the novel by Giorgio Saviane, the conflict between two opposing conceptions of love treated by Salerno as a luxury and whining photo novel. Very mediocre protagonists.

title: All About Eve
actors: Bette Davis, Anne Baxter, George Sanders, Gary Merrill, Marilyn Monroe, Celeste Holm, Hugh Marlowe, Gregory Ratoff, Barbara Bates, Thelma Ritter, Walter Hampden, Randy Stuart, Craig Hill
description: Eva Harrington wants to make a name for herself in the world of theater. She wins the trust of a great actress, Margo Channing, but she gets jealous when she gets word of her protégé's talent. One day, Eva replaces Margo in an evening and gets an extraordinary success: a new star is born, but there is already someone trying to do to her what she did to Margo
notes: A merciless description of the world of theater, a metaphor for social relations; a refined staging and a high-class interpretation: Mankiewicz at the highest level. Six Oscars (film, direction, screenplay, costumes, George Sanders supporting actor, sound), Special Jury Prize and Palme d'Or for Best Actress (Bette Davis) at Cannes. Honored by Almodòvar in "All about my mother".

title: House of Numbers
actors: Jack Palance, Barbara Lang, Harold J. Stone, Edward Platt
description: An inmate prisoner in the San Quentin prison constructs an ingenious escape plan involving his identical brother. Based on a novel by Jack Finney, Rouse's film is based on an idea that possesses a certain logical rigor, but suffers the inability of the great Jack Palance to give different substance to two identical bodies.

title: Evil Toons
actors: David Carradine, Monique Gabrielle, Dick Miller, Arte Johnson, Suzanne Ager, Madison, Barbara Dare, Don Dowe, Michelle Bauer
description: Four friends work on the renovation of a long-uninhabited house. By opening a book of black magic, they free an animated demon who tries by all means to take possession of souls in order to earn immortality. He finally manages to penetrate the body of one of them.
notes: The mix of cartoons / actors could have interesting developments in the horror genre, but for this time there is no need to get too excited. Fans will still find something for their teeth. A curiosity: Fred Olen Ray, Californian B-series author, is considered the most prolific director after Jesus Franco.

title: Excalibur
actors: Nigel Terry, Helen Mirren, Nicol Williamson, Nicholas Clay, Cherie Lunghi, Paul Geoffrey, Robert Addie, Gabriel Byrne, Keith Buckley, Liam Neeson, Patrick Stewart
description: Arthur is the king designated by the wizard Merlin for the Crown of England and his is Excalibur, the marvelous sword. The knights of the Round Table have gathered around him, but the union of vassals is shattered by the alleged betrayal of Queen Guinevere with Lancelot.
notes: "Excalibur" Boorman version. Kitsch and redundant (the soundtrack includes Wagner and "Carmina Burana") but also full of passion and with a bloodthirsty fury not seen since Kurosawa's time. Nice Williamson who plays Merlin, a sort of stunt double for the director. The same year George A. Romero shot, on the same subject (even if set today), "Knightriders", an even better film but never distributed in Italy.

title: Execution
actors: John Richardson, Mimmo Palmara, Piero Vida, Rita Klein, Franco Giornelli, Nestor Garay, Dali Bresciani, Romano Magnino, Lucio De Santis, Giovanni Ivan Scratuglia
description: John Cooler has been hiding a large amount of gold from a bank robbery for a long time. He must defend himself from a bounty hunter and a group of Mexican bandits intent on stealing the loot. John's young brother is captured and reveals his hiding place: then he is at his side in the firefight. Soon after he convinces John to turn himself in to prevent the slaughter from continuing.
notes: Author of popular cinema, Paolella is a cultured and prepared director, novelist and longtime director of the Incom Week. This western of his is tense and unusual.

title: Explorers
actors: River Phoenix, Ethan Hawke, Jason Presson, Bobby Fite, Amanda Peterson, Dick Miller, Robert Picardo, Dana Ivey, Taliesin Jaffe, James Cromwell
description: Ben, Wolfgang and Darren are three distracted kids with a passion for space adventures. For this mania they stay up at night planning intergalactic journeys. Using their computer knowledge, the three are able to identify and control a magnetic force which, harnessed with the help of scrap appliances, becomes a spaceship.
notes: Joe Dante's most personal film after "Matinée", unfortunately massacred by the production that sent him into trouble without even finishing postproduction. A shame, because some ideas are brilliant. River Phoenix, just a teenager, is the bespectacled genius.

title: Exposed
actors: Nastassja Kinski, Harvey Keitel, Rudolf Nureyev, Pierre Clementi, Ian McShane, Bibi Andersson, Ron Randell, Dov Gottesfeld, James Russo, Marion Varella
description: Elisabeth leaves Wisconsin, where she was born (and the professor she loved), for New York. She becomes a top model and bonds with Daniel, a famous Jewish violinist with whom she moves to Paris. Daniel is threatened by the threat of Rivas, a mercenary terrorist in the pay of the Arabs, and the woman becomes involved in his bloody plots ...
notes: The part of the film set in New York is acceptable and fresh, while the Parisian part is absurd. Director James Toback _ (For Love and Money, Black & White) _ appears as the seduced and abandoned professor. Nastassja Kinski is still worth the ticket price.

title: That Darn Cat!
actors: Hayley Mills, Dean Jones, Dorothy Provine, Roddy McDowall, Neville Brand, Elsa Lanchester, William Demarest, Frank Gorshin, Richard Eastham, Grayson Hall
description: Kidnapped by a gang of robbers, a woman who works at a bank cashier slips a message for help around the neck of Gigi, a beautiful Siamese cat who happened to be in the apartment where she is being held prisoner. Patty, the owner of the feline, warns the FBI, which makes her home the basis of the investigation.
