To find the kidnapped woman, it is thought to follow the cat's raids by inserting a transmitter into her collar.
notes: Directed with elegance by London-born director Robert Stevenson, a specialist in the genre under contract at Walt Disney since 1956, it is a classic family film appreciable for its good-paced cues and fascinating Siamese performer.

title: 'FF.SS.' cioè: '...che mi hai portato a fare sopra a Posillipo se non mi vuoi più bene?'
actors: Renzo Arbore, Pietra Montecorvino, Roberto Benigni, Luciano De Crescenzo, Isabella Biagini, Nino Frassica, Dino Cassio, Gerardo Gargiulo, Lory Del Santo, Gigi Proietti, Massimo Troisi, Sandra Milo, Maurizio Costanzo, Pippo Baudo, Luciana Turina, Andy Luotto, Lello Bersani, Gianni Boncompagni
description: Two aspiring directors randomly collect some sheets that have flown away from the window of Fellini's house containing the notes for his new film: "Federico Fellini Sud Story". The story is that of a Neapolitan girl, keeper of public toilets, who crowns the dream of becoming a music star thanks to her ignorant and clumsy manager. In the final apotheosis the girl is in Sanremo singing "Nuie simmo d'o Sud". Arbore is not and will never be a great director, but this epic of the ugly, really ugly, Pietra Montecorvino, he does well. Not to mention the appearance of Benigni in the role of sheikh Beige: absolutely hilarious.

title: F.I.S.T.
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Rod Steiger, Peter Boyle, Melinda Dillon, David Huffman, Kevin Conway, Tony Lo Bianco, Cassie Yates, Peter Donat, John Lehne, Henry Wilcoxon
description: Johnny Kovak (Stallone), a young activist from the truckers' union, manages to organize a tough strike against a large transport company. To win it, he asks the mafia for help. This becomes his trump card for an unstoppable career as a trade unionist but, in the end, it backfires on him.
notes: Stallone, a not very refined actor, is also co-writer of this good film dedicated to the environment and the struggles of the American haulers' union of the 30s and 40s. Tension and suspense make "F.i.s.t." a film of great involvement, without the show stealing too much from the complexity of the subject addressed.

title: Do the Right Thing
actors: Danny Aiello, Spike Lee, John Turturro, Rosie Perez, Ossie Davis, Ruby Dee, Richard Edson, Giancarlo Esposito, Bill Nunn, Paul Benjamin, Frankie Faison, Robin Harris, John Savage, Samuel L. Jackson, Martin Lawrence, Roger Guenveur Smith
description: Brooklyn, during a day of scorching heat: the situation seems calm in the Bedford-Stuyvesant neighborhood; and also in the Italian pizzeria - run by Sal and his two sons Vito and Pino and frequented mostly by blacks - everything proceeds as usual. The racial riots of fifteen years ago seem forgotten. But a trivial accident is enough to unleash the battle, unpredictable ...
notes: Avoiding easy Manichaeism and any sentimentality, Lee paints a bizarre and dramatic picture of the racial tensions that run through American society beneath its surface. A "hot" and full of energy film.

title: Faccia a faccia
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, Tomas Milian, William Berger, Carole André, Jolanda Modio, Lydia Alfonsi, Gianni Rizzo, Ángel del Pozo, Aldo Sambrell, Nello Pazzafini
description: A history teacher (Gian Maria Volonté), traveling the West, becomes a bandit; a bandit (Tomas Milian) repents and shows he has a heart. Sollima tries the path of the ethical-political western, but he lacks depth and epic breath.

title: Faccia da schiaffi
actors: Gianni Morandi, Laura Belli, Duilio Cruciani, Grit Freyberg, Enzo Cannavale, Agostina Belli, Marie Louise Sinclair
description: Escaped from an orphanage, little Mario is picked up and hosted by Nino, a Roman boy used to living by expedients. Having soon become friends, the two arrange themselves as best they can to make a living. Taking advantage of his fascination with foreigners, Nino manages to get one meal a day for himself and his protégé. It happens, however, that Nino falls in love with the daughter of a shopkeeper and that it does not go to genius Mario who does everything to make the two split up.
notes: An insipid, irrelevant and useless film, born only to exploit the popularity of Gianni Morandi who would work the following year with Pietro Germi.

title: Take Me Out to the Ball Game
actors: Gene Kelly, Frank Sinatra, Esther Williams, Betty Garrett, Edward Arnold, Jules Munshin, Richard Lane, Tom Dugan
description: Young Katherine Higghins inherits a baseball team and, to everyone's disbelief, proves she can do it. The star of the team is Eddie who, however, also has a passion for singing and dancing. A shady bookie tries to distract him by getting him a writing in a musical.
notes: Gene Kelly and Frank Sinatra rehearse for the next "A Day in New York". At least a couple of extraordinary numbers, and a very fast pace.

title: Let's Make Love
actors: Marilyn Monroe, Yves Montand, Tony Randall, Frankie Vaughan, Wilfrid Hyde-White, David Burns, Michael David, Mara Lynn, Dennis King Jr., Joe Besser
description: Knowing that a magazine intended to mock him is being staged on Broadway, billionaire Jean Marc Clement shows up incognito at the theater, to see to what extent this is true. Taken for an extra, he ends up being entrusted with the part ... of himself. Accept, to stay next to Amanda, a beautiful actress of the company with a charm as naive as it is irresistible.
notes: The film is certainly not among George Cukor's masterpieces but it contains very enjoyable moments. Memorable Marilyn in black sweater and tights, to the music of "My Heart Belongs to Daddy".

title: Faccione
actors: Nadia Rinaldi, Paco Reconti, Agnese Nano, Antonello Fassari, Achille Bonito Oliva, Roberto D'Agostino, Francesco Gabriele, Rosalina Neri, Lucia Poli, Dado Ruspoli, Massimo Bonetti
description: Daniela is a nice fat woman who works in an art gallery in Rome. The men in her life are as messed up as she is: Mubu, a Senegalese drummer (from whom Daniela is expecting a child), is perpetually on tour with a folkloristic group, while Michele, a freaked plumber who has taken under her protection, turns out to be a latent homosexual. Daniela never loses heart and in the end manages to get Michele to be cast in a film by the Taviani brothers, while Mubu finally returns to look after the beautiful black baby born in the meantime.
notes: De Sica seeks the way of comedy a la Frank Capra, but does not achieve any commercial success. The film is meant to be crafty, but it's just boring and vulgar.

title: Easy Prey
actors: Gerald McRaney, Sean McCann, Susan Hogan, Kate Lynch, Barry Flatman, Neil Clifford, Jessica Steen, Shawnee Smith
description: Spring 1984. In Torrence, California, young Tina Risico is kidnapped by Christopher Wilder (Gerald McRaney), a serial killer and rapist. The film, based on a true story episode, chronicles the girl's subsequent terrifying journey with the dangerous kidnapper. Actor Gerald McRaney is decidedly close to the role of a character opposite to the one who made him popular, that Rick Simon, positive hero not devoid of humor, protagonist of the TV series Simon & Simon. Sandor Stern as a director is not exceptional, but aficionados of the genre remember him as the writer of Amityville Horror.

title: Nighthawks
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Rutger Hauer, Billy Dee Williams, Lindsay Wagner, Persis Khambatta, Nigel Davenport, Hilarie Thompson, Joe Spinell, Walter Mathews
description: Wulfgar is a ruthless and infallible German terrorist. His current principals decide to hand him over to the police. But the man manages to escape, undergoes facial plastic and goes to New York to carry out a massacre at the United Nations. To counter him is the very special agent Deke Da Silva ...
notes: At the time, Bruce Malmuth was an overpaid commercial director (he directed over a thousand) who knew the sense of rhythm perfectly. Little exploited by the cinema, however, it sealed the success of this tense and tight “action movie”. One of the best roles of Sylvester Stallone, macho cop who likes to dress up as ... a woman.

title: Il falco d'oro
actors: Anna Maria Ferrero, Massimo Serato, Nadia Gray, Mariangela Giordano, Frank Latimore, Carlo Sposito, Charles Fawcett, Rose Alba, Arturo Bragaglia, Umberto Sacripante
description: Sienese countryside, 1600. The Montefalco and Della Torre families hate each other. To try to make peace, they decide to arrange a marriage between their firstborn. The only one who proves opposed to the wedding is Fiammetta, a girl, usually wearing men's clothes, in love with the groom.
notes: Inspired by a work by Tirso de Molina.

title: Christopher Strong
actors: Katharine Hepburn, Colin Clive, Billie Burke, Helen Chandler, Ralph Forbes, Irene Browne, Jack La Rue, Desmond Roberts
description: A woman who holds countless and prestigious flight records falls in love with a married man in return. It is an intense passion that erases all modesty in a woman and that leads her lover to destroy twenty years of marital fidelity. When she finds herself pregnant, the terror of the scandal, the awareness of her own equivocal position, lead her to the decision to let herself die.
notes: It is the second film by Katharine Hepburn, not without elements of interest and where the actress's temperament already emerges with considerable vigor. A solemn fiasco at the box office, unjustified compared to the undeniable merits.

title: I falsari
actors: Fosco Giachetti, Doris Duranti, Erno Crisa, Lianella Carell, Gabriele Ferzetti, Mario Angelotti, Leopoldo Trieste, Saro Urzì, Nerio Bernardi
description: To unmask a gang of forgers, Inspector Moroni (Giachetti) pretends to be a traveling salesman and thus comes into contact with Teresa (Duranti), a pious benefactress, apparently, who takes care of orphans but who also secretly keeps the ranks of an organization that "manufactures" banknote paper. Having passed unscathed through a thousand controversies, the former diva of the regime Doris Duranti appears in this first film, not very promising, by Franco Rossi, the future director of the television "Odyssey" (1968), who died in 2000.

title: La famiglia
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Stefania Sandrelli, Fanny Ardant, Ottavia Piccolo, Renzo Palmer, Athina Cenci, Carlo Dapporto, Philippe Noiret, Sergio Castellitto, Andrea Occhipinti, Jo Champa, Massimo Dapporto
description: Carlo, an elderly retired teacher, recalls the saga of the bourgeois family of which he is the last patriarch, from the early twentieth century to the present day. Through various small pictures, with History as the background to the personal events and feelings of a well-characterized gallery of characters.
notes: Scola has two aces up his sleeve for this film: a script (written by him together with Ruggero Maccari and Furio Scarpelli) actually well oiled, which works as a crutch for a fairly ordinary staging and manages to masterfully intertwine public and private, and a cast of exceptional performers. When we say "an actor's film".

title: La famiglia Brambilla in vacanza
actors: Cesco Baseggio, Massimo Girotti, Elena Lüber, Paolo Stoppa, Amelia Chellini, Giulio Stival, Vita Bandini, Umberto Cocchi, Jole Ferrari
description: Ms. Brambilla has great ideas for her daughter's future. A young man without means, what the girl dotes on, is not exactly what the lady has in mind. So she forces her husband to go into debt to spend the holidays on a luxury beach. However, the suitors she meets are not all reliable. Not too funny routine movie. The thing that saves him is the presence of actors like Girotti and Stoppa, not to mention Cavalier Baseggio.

title: La famiglia Buonanotte
actors: Lina Sastri, Kim Cattrall, Giancarlo Giannini, Tony Nardi, Kim Coates, Peter Boretski, Chris Britton, David Calderisi, Daniel DeSanto
description: Canada, 1957. Ten-year-old Michelangelo observes the community of emigrants in which he lives. Giulia, the mother, is a point of reference for everyone. Sister Eva cheats on her husband with a priest. Fiorello lives in a basement, he got a girl pregnant but he can't get married before his older brother. Upstairs we love and argue. The grandfather dies, the world changes too quickly and the boy wants to leave.
notes: A fresh film, scripted and directed, between neorealistic suggestions and Woody Allen-like tones, by the newcomer Carlo Liconti and well supported by interpreters such as Lina Sastri (Giulia) and Kim Cattrall.

title: La famiglia Passaguai fa fortuna
actors: Aldo Fabrizi, Ave Ninchi, Erminio Macario, Giovanna Ralli, Luigi Pavese, Virgilio Riento, Marisa Merlini, Carlo Delle Piane, Carlo Rizzo, Nino Pavese
description: The cav. Valenzi has lost his job and his family is having a bad time. One day, mistaken by a former fellow soldier for the owner of a luxury car not his own, he makes big plans with his friend. One thing leads to another and the knight gets to sign a bad check for a large sum, but this illegal move is the beginning of luck instead of ruin. Whether Aldo Fabrizi was an actor, comedian or dramatic, everyone knows. Here he tries again the direction of direction (after a first "chapter" of the previous year with the same characters) and it always turns out to be a bit tricky.

title: La famiglia Passaguai
actors: Aldo Fabrizi, Ave Ninchi, Peppino De Filippo, Tino Scotti, Giovanna Ralli, Carlo Delle Piane, Luigi Pavese, Nyta Dover, Enrico Luzi, Giovanni Grasso, Maria Donati
description: Beach portrait, with a few happy touches, of a small Italian bourgeoisie that has now overcome the trauma and difficulties of the war. Directed and performed by Aldo Fabrizi.

title: Adam Had Four Sons
actors: Ingrid Bergman, Warner Baxter, Susan Hayward, Fay Wray, Richard Denning, Johnny Downs, Robert Shaw, Charles Lind, Billy Ray, Steven Muller, June Lockhart
description: A young French woman hired as a housekeeper (Bergman) conquers an American family with her gifts of wisdom and sympathy, consisting of a widower father and four children. The father's esteem ends up turning into love, but the perfect romance is threatened by the intrusion of a daughter-in-law (Hayward) as seductive as she is corrupt, who tries to pit the brothers against each other.
notes: The cocktail of feelings, of tears and smiles, of seduction and betrayal is very well mixed and works. Excellent comparison of characters offered by the duo Bergman / Hayward.

title: I familiari delle vittime non saranno avvertiti
actors: Antonio Sabato, Telly Savalas, Paola Tedesco, Guido Lollobrigida, Giuliano Persico, Nino Dal Fabbro, Sergio Rossi, Sergio Tramonti, Piero Morgia, Carlo Gaddi
description: Antonio Mancuso, whose father was eliminated by Don Vincenzo's men, has decided to take revenge. He manages to win the trust of the boss, thus becoming his most reliable killer. When the disagreements with Don Vincenzo begin, Antonio reunites the leaders of the mafia and obtains from them the authorization to kill the boss. The mission succeeds but, at this point, it is he who is in the sights of the mafia. Conventional imitation of American crime films according to the patterns that were fashionable in the seventies.

title: Ziegfeld Girl
actors: Judy Garland, Hedy Lamarr, Lana Turner, James Stewart, Tony Martin, Jackie Cooper, Ian Hunter, Charles Winninger, Edward Everett Horton, Philip Dorn, Paul Kelly
description: Three girls are hired by the Ziegfeld Follies to participate in a famous Broadway magazine. The first is a fairly famous vaudeville singer with a great future waiting for her. The second is a girl in charge of the elevators of a grand hotel who has always dreamed of being part of the entertainment world, the third is a penniless violinist who seizes the opportunity.
notes: The film lives on the fantastic choreography of Busby Berkeley and the great interpretation of the trio Garland, Lamar and Turner. "You Stepped Out of a Dream" and "Minnie from Trinidad" are the most famous musical numbers.

title: Way Out West
actors: Stan Laurel, Oliver Hardy, Sharon Lynne, James Finlayson, Stanley Fields, Rosina Lawrence, Vivien Oakland
description: Laurel and Hardy must bring Marie's father's will which makes her the owner of a gold mine. Our two heroes have to deal with Mickey, a treacherous saloon owner, who passes off his wife as the girl.
notes: One of the couple's best movies with memorable gags (the finger that lights up).

title: Fandango
actors: Kevin Costner, Judd Nelson, Sam Robards, Chuck Bush, Suzy Amis, Brian Cesak, Marvin J. McIntyre, Glenne Headly, Pepe Serna, Elizabeth Daily
description: Austin, Texas, 1971. Ken Waggener celebrates his bachelor party, but his three friends, Gardner, Philip and Norman, decide that the wedding will not take place and drag the betrothed away to the Mexican desert where he awaits them, buried in the sand a few years earlier, a bottle of Dom Perignon. After the toast, Gardner decides that Ken must still get married.
notes: Beautiful debut film, melancholy and bold, by Kevin Reynolds, the future director of "Robin Hood" and the world flop "Waterworld". Production by Steven Spielberg and Costner's first major role.

title: Fanfan la Tulipe
actors: Gérard Philipe, Gina Lollobrigida, Marcel Herrand, Noël Roquevert, Olivier Hussenot, Henri Rollan, Nerio Bernardi, Jean-Marc Tennberg, Geneviève Page, Sylvie Pelayo
description: A young provincial Don Juan (Philipe) enlisted for not having to marry, frees Madame de Pompadour and the Dauphin of France from bandits, sneaks into the castle of King Louis XV and is sentenced to death. His beauty, Adelina (Lollobrigida), gets pardon for him, but the adventure is not over. Made to measure for Gérard Philipe, the film is conducted to the rhythm of a light-hearted, playful and paradoxical epic, where everything, from heroism to love, becomes an opportunity for a witty over-the-top story, to which the protagonist gives the mark of his class and its extraordinary communication.

title: Fango sulla metropoli - I criminali della metropoli
actors: Dorian Gray, Tony Kendall, Vassili Karis, Greta Polyn, Enzo Tarascio, Maddalena Gillia, Germano Longo, Giancarlo Giannini, Silla Bettini, Roger Beaumont
description: Between December 28 and New Year's Eve, in Paris, a gang of drug traffickers clashes with the police on several occasions. During a shooting, a bandit is killed and a policeman injured. The investigation then continues with great use of means and men, until the final dismantling of the gang. Other murders and plot twists conclude a rather predictable and predictable film.

title: Wild River
actors: Montgomery Clift, Lee Remick, Jo Van Fleet, Albert Salmi, Jay C. Flippen, James Westerfield, Barbara Loden, Frank Overton, Malcolm Atterbury
description: Chuck Glover must convince the Garthville landowners to cede the land located along the Tennessee River to allow the government to build a dam system. He clashes with the obstinacy of Ella, an elderly owner, and with the racial hatred that will also turn against him. Once his work is done he starts again: with him goes Carol, Ella's niece who in the meantime has died, an important film in Elia Kazan's career. The search for realism, the epic representation of the New Deal, the lyrical inspiration that makes its way even at the expense of action are intertwined.

title: The Green Slime
actors: Robert Horton, Luciana Paluzzi, Richard Jaeckel, Bud Widom, Ted Gunther, David Yorston, Robert Dunham, Gary Randolf
description: After destroying an asteroid that threatened to strike Earth, Colonel Jack Rankin's patrol stops at the Gamma-3 space station. Here a mysterious green substance, inadvertently brought into the base, begins to generate sprawling, red-colored monsters ...
notes: It is an ordinary science fiction story, enlivened by the comradely clash of two men fighting for the same woman, a space scientist. Too bad that former "Bond Girl" Luciana Paluzzi is very far from looking like an astronaut and that an interesting director like Fukasaku remains well below the standards of his later works.

title: Fanny och Alexander
actors: Pernilla Allwin, Bertil Guve, Börje Ahlstedt, Erland Josephson, Allan Edwall, Ewa Fröling, Kristina Adolphson, Kristian Almgren, Carl Billquist, Jan Malmsjö
description: The troubled saga of the Ekdhal family of Uppsala at the beginning of the century, seen through the eyes of the teenager Alexander and his little sister Fanny. Strongly autobiographical, it is Bergman's film-testament and a tribute to theater and cinema: two worlds in which "everything can happen, everything is possible and plausible".

title: The Big Bus
actors: Joseph Bologna, Stockard Channing, John Beck, Murphy Dunne, René Auberjonois, Ned Beatty, Bob Dishy, José Ferrer, Ruth Gordon, Harold Gould, Larry Hagman, Sally Kellerman
description: The revolutionary project of a nuclear-powered bus is opposed by the unfair Ironmaster. Pleasant comedy that pokes fun at the catastrophic blockbuster contemporaries (here too the cast is made up of old Hollywood glories) but doesn't try too hard to be original too.

title: Fantaghirò 2
actors: Alessandra Martines, Brigitte Nielsen, Kim Rossi Stuart, Mario Adorf, Stefano Davanzati, Tomás Valík, Lenka Kubálkova, Karel Roden, Katarína Kolajová, Anna Geislerová
description: Before marrying Prince Romualdo, Princess Fantaghirò solemnly promises never to use weapons again. But the Black Witch plots against their happiness and holds the father King of Fantaghirò prisoner. Separately, the two lovers set out on a journey to the Black Kingdom, facing dangers of all kinds. The Black Witch manages to make Romualdo lose his memory and push him against Fantaghirò: the two face each other in a duel, and Fantaghirò is acquitted of the vow made. The Black Queen is finally eradicated, but to get married the two engaged will still have to overcome many obstacles and many magic. Excellent special effects curated by Stivaletti and Valcauda, ??naive but not infamous all.

title: The Spirit Is Willing
actors: Vera Miles, Sid Caesar, Barry Gordon, John Astin, John McGiver, Cass Daley, Ricky Cordell, Mary Wickes, Jesse White, Robert Donner, Mickey Deems
description: Ben and Kate with their son Steve rent a vacation villa. The house soon reveals itself to be inhabited by three restless ghosts: two young and an older one, who even falls in love with one of Steve's uncle and does everything to take him to the afterlife. The ending implies that the troubles will not end simply by leaving the mansion. William Castle was a true king of B-grade horror: on one occasion he even thought of insuring his viewers against frightening death. A director for fans of the genre, he measures himself here on his favorite terrain, but exploiting the humorous side of it for a "witty" comedy.

title: Phantom of the Paradise
actors: Paul Williams, William Finley, Jessica Harper, Gerrit Graham, George Memmoli, Archie Hahn, Jeffrey Comanor, Peter Elbling, Colin Cameron
description: A powerful record industrialist commercially exploits the music of Winslow Leach, a shy and awkward composer who got Sing Sing locked up. Winslow escapes, tries to take revenge on the tycoon, but remains disfigured. With a strange bird mask and superhero costume he locks himself in a recording studio and seeks revenge.
notes: A horror musical that wisely mixes the myth of Faust with that of the "Phantom of the Opera". De Palma distorts the expressionist canons and plays the card of the Baroque accumulation, composing an impressive score. The melodic aspects and the critique of the cultural industry and its exploitation of artists are highly emphasized.

title: Blackbeard's Ghost
actors: Peter Ustinov, Dean Jones, Suzanne Pleshette, Elsa Lanchester, Joby Baker, Elliott Reid, Richard Deacon, Norman Grabowski, Kelly Thordsen, Michael Conrad, Herbie Faye
description: A young PE teacher moves to Godolphin to train the town's athletics team. He takes up residence in an inn located on an islet run by old maids descendants of the pirate Teach known as Blackbeard. He ends up involved in the handling of old women to preserve their ancestor's house from the aims of a dangerous gangster who wants to turn it into a gambling house. Even the young man manages to evoke the ghost of the old buccaneer who comes to the rescue of his descendants.
notes: Very classic Disney production with the famous stars of the House (Jones and Pleshette) joined by a sly Ustinov. Funny the sequence of the races with the intervention of the ghost, of slaptick derivation and copied on numerous occasions.

title: Phantom of the Opera
actors: Claude Rains, Nelson Eddy, Susanna Foster, Edgar Barrier, Leo Carrillo, Jane Farrar, J. Edward Bromberg, Fritz Feld, Frank Puglia, Steven Geray, Barbara Everest, Hume Cronyn
description: One of the musicians of the Paris Opera, after being robbed of one of his compositions, in the throes of fury was responsible for a murder. Horribly burned his face, he has since taken refuge in the basement of the theater. From there he reappears as a ghost from time to time, spreading death and ruin in his madness to favor the career of his daughter, chorister of the Opera. Remake of the version made in 1925 with Lon Chaney, it is rather traditional and not very personal. The use of color (quite unusual at the time, especially for a horror movie) allows for some suggestive solutions. Oscar in photography and scenography.

title: Phantom of Chinatown
actors: Keye Luke, Lotus Long, Grant Withers, Charles Miller, Huntley Gordon, Virginia Carpenter, John Dilson, Paul McVey, John Holland, Richard Terry
description: The mysterious death of an archaeologist proves to be linked to his discoveries ... not archaeological carried out during the excavations in the tomb of an emperor, in a Chinese location. When the detectives believe they have reached the culprit, this dies killed in turn and everything has to start again. A crime of routine, last of the Mr. Wong series. Moreover, there is not even Boris Karloff, replaced by Keye Luke who usually did the part of Charlie Chan's primacy.

title: Le fantôme de la liberté
actors: Jean-Claude Brialy, Julien Bertheau, Adriana Asti, Michael Lonsdale, Michel Piccoli, Monica Vitti, Jean Rochefort, Milena Vukotic, Bernard Verley, Claude Piéplu, Hélène Perdrière, Paul Frankeur, François Maistre
description: In the prologue, in the year 1808, we witness the shooting of patriots and a grave-profaner officer. Then we move on to the present, and here is a man who shows two little girls "obscene" photos of the monuments of Paris, a murderer set free, the repression of a demonstration that praises the chains ... The social conventions of the bourgeoisie, wickedly overturned , reveal all their absurdity. One of the clearest and most entertaining films of the late Buñuel, which recovers an irreconcilable bitterness together with an Olympic simplicity. The last image is a close-up of a surreal and distant ostrich.

title: The Ghost Goes West
actors: Robert Donat, Jean Parker, Eugene Pallette, Elsa Lanchester, Ralph Bunker, Patricia Hilliard, Everley Gregg, Morton Selten, Chili Bouchier
description: An American heiress convinces Dad to buy a Scottish castle. Disassembled piece by piece, the manor is rebuilt in Florida. Surprise: the building still houses the ghost who lived there.
notes: The film combines the structure of the comedy with the atmosphere of the fantastic, which has always been dear to René Clair. However, beneath the clear and brilliant surface of the repeated discoveries, there is no lack of a ferocious satire of the enriched and of the contrast between America and Europe.

title: Heart Condition
actors: Bob Hoskins, Denzel Washington, Chloe Webb, Roger E. Mosley, Ja'net DuBois, Alan Rachins, Ray Baker, Jeffrey Meek, Eva LaRue
description: Jack (Bob Hoskins) is a police sergeant in love with Crystal, a beautiful prostitute. After a heart attack, the heart of the hated Stone (Denzel Washington), a black lawyer who has just died in an accident, is transplanted. From that day on, Stone's ghost begins to live with him and, after a rather turbulent first period, helps him find Crystal, unmask a political scandal and destroy a drug trade.
notes: Of course, the populace Bob Hoskins would make a nice couple with the refined Denzel Washington, if the script were less cumbersome and the direction a little faster.

title: Fantasmi a Roma
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Vittorio Gassman, Eduardo De Filippo, Tino Buazzelli, Belinda Lee, Sandra Milo, Claudio Gora, Franca Marzi, Evelyn Stewart, Lilla Brignone
description: On the death of the elderly prince of Roviano, the ancient palace in which he lived risks being demolished to make way for building speculation. The ghosts of his ancestors, placid inhabitants of the palace, do everything to prevent its demolition and in the end they manage to save it thanks to a ghost painter friend who even weaves a short love story with a beautiful death.
notes: A pleasant comedy based on an excellent screenplay by Flaiano, Maccari and Scola. Fit actors.

title: Fantasmi del mare
actors: Raf Tindi, Michele Moradico, Gaby Silvia, Ugo Donarelli, Anna Arena, Carlo Giustini, Umberto Raho
description: An old sailor thinks back to a tragic episode of war, when his ship, after 8 September 1943, had to avoid falling into the hands of the Germans. There was a conflict situation between the commander and his son, who was also on board and it was up to those who now recall the story to make a decision so that at least part of the crew did not fall into enemy hands. In his films Francesco De Robertis has often talked about the sea and the men who have linked their destiny to the sea. With a semi-documentary style, without any popular actors, this film of yours is also effective in the presentation of the environment and the characters.

title: Dead Cert
actors: Scott Antony, Judi Dench, Michael Williams, Nina Thomas, Julian Glover, Mark Dignam, John Bindon, Joseph Blatchley, Ian Hogg
description: The young jockey Alan York begins to make private investigations into some mysterious fatal accidents that also involve his splendid horse and finds himself at the center of a corruption case in the world of horse racing.
notes: It will not be a very original thriller, but the awareness of the jockey, in fact, is quite interesting (the screenplay, as well as the director, is by John Oaksey, from a Dick Francis novel). The tense scenes are noteworthy, but we are still far from Free Cinema.

title: Fantômas
actors: Louis De Funès, Jean Marais, Mylène Demongeot, Jacques Dynam, Robert Dalban, Marie-Hélène Arnaud, Anne-Marie Peysson, Christian Toma, Michel Duplaix
description: In search of a scoop, the Parisian journalist Fandor publishes a fake interview with the famous thief Fantomas, who first kidnaps him in revenge, then carries out a robbery, putting the blame on him. Fandor is found innocent, but ...
notes: A comic version of Fantomas, with an irresistible de Funès in the role of Juve commissioner.

title: Fantômas se déchaîne
actors: Jean Marais, Louis De Funès, Mylène Demongeot, Jacques Dynam, Albert Dagnant, Robert Dalban, Christian Toma, Michel Duplaix, Olivier De Funès
description: Despite having received the Legion of Honor, the Juve commissioner continues to lose the duel with his deadly enemy Fantomas who, this time, has kidnapped a scientist named Marchand. To complicate matters, the journalist Fandor intervenes, attending a conference in the guise of Professor Marchand's assistant. New episode of the cinematographic Fantomas with Marais and De Funes. In the James Bond years, the French responded with these funny and surreal parodies of appendix sypereroi.

title: Fantozzi
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Anna Mazzamauro, Liù Bosisio, Plinio Fernando, Gigi Reder, Giuseppe Anatrelli, Umberto D'Orsi, Dino Emanuelli, Paolo Paoloni, Elena Tricoli, Pietro Zardini
description: After struggling with the perpetually packed public transport, the accountant Ugo Fantozzi finally arrives at the office. Here he finds piles of paperwork to be handled by his smart colleagues waiting for him. Forced to take part in company outings and football matches, Fantozzi is also obsessed with an ugly wife and horrifying daughter. Rebelling against company rules, he ends up in the director's human aquarium. From his book of the same name (more than a million copies), Villaggio brings to the screen the character, the gags and the linguistic inventions that made him so famous and that have now entered the collective imagination.

title: Fantozzi alla riscossa
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Milena Vukotic, Anna Mazzamauro, Gigi Reder, Plinio Fernando, Luigi Petrucci, Paul Muller, Silvia Annichiarico, Pierfrancesco Villaggio, Salvatore Billa
description: The pension is not enough to neutralize the accountant Fantozzi, who tries his hand as the manager of his graceless niece in search of movie fortune and as a popular judge in a Mafia trial. He earns a lot of trouble, ends up first in prison, then by the psychoanalyst, finally ridiculed by a book his wife wrote about him. But not even this avalanche of disasters is holding back his feverish activism.

title: Fantozzi contro tutti
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Milena Vukotic, Plinio Fernando, Gigi Reder, Paul Muller, Camillo Milli, Guerrino Crivello, Angelo Pellegrino, Giuseppe Anatrelli, Diego Abatantuono
description: The accountant Ugo Fantozzi is a born loser: for him the problems of the office and of everyday life are enormous tragedies. How to plow through city traffic, find a parking space, deal with colleagues, meet bosses, participate in demonstrations organized by the union.
notes: For the third episode of the adventures of his most famous character, Paolo Villaggio does everything by himself (including co-direction) and the results are a bit repetitive, even if there are some memorable moments (his wife Pina who falls in love with the grim baker Abatantuono , the cycling race with the restaurant "Al Curvone").

title: Fantozzi subisce ancora
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Milena Vukotic, Anna Mazzamauro, Plinio Fernando, Gigi Reder, Riccardo Garrone, Giulio Farnese, Carlo Colombo, Antonio Francioni, Ugo Bologna
description: The ordeal of the accountant Ugo Fantozzi, a frustrated and brutalized concept employee in a multinational company, continues. After a tiring day at the office, grappling with the usual problems and enslaved, as usual, by colleagues, poor accountant Fantozzi must also undergo a catastrophic condominium meeting. He then sets off for a family outing aboard an incredible camper. Upon returning, he discovers that his ugly daughter, seduced and abandoned, is pregnant.
notes: In the fourth episode, Fantozzi's lasaga begins to be in a crisis of ideas and rhythm.

title: Fantozzi va in pensione
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Milena Vukotic, Gigi Reder, Anna Mazzamauro, Plinio Fernando, Antonio Allocca, Ennio Antonelli, Stefano Antonucci, Albano Bufalini
description: A life as a travet, decades of mid-manics left behind because, God willing, the day arises when all this belongs to the past, in which the rosy prospects of a different existence, of a well-deserved and serene rest, open up. free time to fill as you see fit, in peace and quiet. Perhaps this happens to other retirees, but certainly not to rag. Ugo Fantozzi, whose life as a former worker is made up of stress and frustration perhaps more than in his office days.
notes: Village, in a story that also makes a serious speech and that knows how to be sometimes bad, as well as hilarious, wallows in it.

title: Far North
actors: Jessica Lange, Charles Durning, Tess Harper, Donald Moffat, Ann Wedgeworth, Patricia Arquette, Nina Draxten, Tim Hanrahan, Pearl Fuller, Melissa Sue Anderson, Paolo Rossi
description: Kate lived for many years in New York until her wounded father calls him back to his homeland, in the woods of the far north of the United States. Here the girl immerses herself in the country atmosphere but a little neurotic. With this film, not completely resolved but full of suggestive moments, Sam Shepard makes his debut as a director. The film is affected by many echoes (especially theatrical) but manages to convey a sense of the landscape and traditions.

title: A Distant Trumpet
actors: Troy Donahue, Suzanne Pleshette, James Gregory, Diane McBain, William Reynolds, Claude Akins, Kent Smith, Judson Pratt, Bartlett Robinson
description: The young Lieutenant Hazard is stationed at Fort Delivery, where General Quait arrives with a squadron to attack the Black Hawk tribe. After a first, bloody battle, Quait tries the path of negotiation and sends Hazard with an Indian guide on a mission to the rebels. Hazard succeeds in composing the parts, earning medal and promotion.
notes: Times change; The era of the "revisionist" western, intent on restoring dignity to the ancient enemy, is fast approaching. In the film, which closes his fifty-year career Walsh, this time turns a non-critical look at least perplexed on the history of the West.

title: Pharaoh
actors: Jerzy Selnik, Barbara Brylska, Wieslawa Mazurkiewicz, Krystyna Mikolajewska, Ewa Krzyzewska, Piotr Pawlowski, Leszek Herdegen, Stanislaw Milski, Kazimierz Opalinski
description: The heir to the throne of Egypt wants war with the Assyrians but the priests oppose him. A hard clash between idealism and opportunism.

title: Farfallon
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Mario Carotenuto, Fiorenzo Fiorentini, Gina Rovere, Micaela Pignatelli, Enzo Andronico, Salvatore Baccaro, Carla Mancini
description: Farfallon, a Sicilian pastry chef in prison for attempted uxoricide, regularly tries to escape to complete the work he left unfinished and is regularly caught back. During one of the many escapes he is even "captured" by the nuns of a convent who snatch all the secrets of Sicilian pastry from him. When he is filmed with his friend Vistacorta, he is thrown into a terrible penal colony isolated in the middle of the sea. But even from here he tries to escape, with Leonardo's wings. Once in his country, revenge is finally done and Farfallon can return placated in prison by his old friend. Tired parody of "Papillon", with some moments more melancholy than funny.

title: Le dossier noir
actors: Bernard Blier, Antoine Balpêtré, Danièle Delorme, Lea Padovani, Jean-Marc Bory, Daniel Cauchy, Nelly Borgeaud, Jacques Duby, Noël Roquevert
description: A young magistrate looks for a compromising file for many notables of the provincial town where he was assigned; the dossier had been compiled by his predecessor, who died under suspicious circumstances. Director André Cayatte came to film from the legal profession and has often dealt with issues related to justice and its administration in his films. Here the atmosphere is charged with suspicions and fears for an investigation that digs under the crust of official respectability. Excellent narrative rhythm, which creates a notable dramatic tension (with some twists), and the work of the interpreters.

title: Le charme discret de la bourgeoisie
actors: Jean-Pierre Cassel, Fernando Rey, Delphine Seyrig, Bulle Ogier, Stéphane Audran, Paul Frankeur, Julien Bertheau, Milena Vukotic, Maria Gabriella Maione, Claude Piéplu, Michel Piccoli
description: Two spouses, her sister, an ambassador and another couple: they are the main characters of this "fairy tale" with which Buñuel, now elderly but always with a poisoned tooth against the institutions and myths of the bourgeois world, satirizes the society of respectability official. The unifying element of the story is the attempt, always frustrated by the most unpredictable hitches, to have a lunch with friends. Around this idea, other significant figures and a series of collateral events give life to a painting that is as elegant as it is "ferocious". Ironic and hopeless, clear and complex in its narrative development, the film won the Oscar for best foreign film (obviously Buñuel did not go to collect it).

title: Fatal Beauty
actors: Whoopi Goldberg, Sam Elliott, Rubén Blades, Harris Yulin, John P. Ryan, Jennifer Warren, Brad Dourif, Mike Jolly, Charles Hallahan, David Harris, James Le Gros
description: Rita, a Los Angeles policewoman with a past as a drug addict, has long been keeping an eye on a gang of drug traffickers bent on vanquishing her. But despite countless ambushes, informants and dead bodies left on the ground by both sides, she still hasn't managed to get her hands on the head of the organization. Just when things seem hopelessly lost, Mike arrives, one of the boss's gorillas, who, falling in love with her, begins to give her a hand in the investigation.
notes: A valuable cross-section of the violent undergrowth of Los Angeles, populated by well-constructed and interpreted characters, the film instead falters on the sentimental side.

title: Fatal Temptation
actors: Loredana Romito, John Armstead, Carmen Marano, Ann Margaret Hughes, James Villemaire
description: A betrayed wife hatches a diabolical plan to eliminate her husband with the help of her lover. Despite the precautions, however, things do not go as expected: she discovers that her new man is also unfaithful, and again plots revenge ...
notes: The foray into the soft-core of the director of _La casa del buon viaggio_ and _Diceria dell'untore_ - which is signed here with a canonical Anglo-Saxon pseudonym - is certainly not what is said to be an overwhelming episode: indeed it comes close to ridicule, and as for the rate of tension it is good to overlook. Intertwining to the minimum terms of credibility and supermarket eroticism.

title: Fatalità
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, Maria Michi, Massimo Girotti, Tanino Chiurazzi, Anita Durante, Margherita Bossi
description: Vincenzo (Girotti) is a young entrepreneur who adores his wife Paola (Michi). However, she surrenders to the court of Renato Salesi (Nazzari), an employee of her husband. Nothing happens between them, but fate gets in the way and the conclusion is tragic. A failed adultery, a repentance in extremis, but an adverse fate. On this basis, the film builds a story that is more than discreetly structured and narrated. The model is clearly that of the pre-war French "noirs" of Renoir and Carné, but this homegrown application of intrigue and atmospheres, even without taking into account the classics that inspired it, has its own dignity.

title: Easy to Love
actors: Esther Williams, Tony Martin, Van Johnson, Carroll Baker, John Bromfield, Edna Skinner, King Donovan, Paul Bryar, Ed Oliver
description: Everyone loves Giulia (Williams), superdiva of aquatic musicals, except Rudy, the impresario who seems to consider her little more than a business. Only when her admirers get too close will he realize that he is in love with the "siren", who reciprocates him.
notes: The sentimental comedy is only the frame of the sumptuous aquatic choreographies custom built for Esther Williams by the great Busby Berkeley (the final one is particularly beautiful).

title: Faust
actors: Gösta Ekman, Emil Jannings, Camilla Horn, Frida Richard, William Dieterle, Yvette Guilbert, Eric Barclay, Hanna Ralph, Werner Fuetterer
description: Mephistopheles bets with the archangel Gabriel that he will be able to conquer the soul of Faust. First he allows him to heal a plague epidemic; then she gives him back his youth and seduces the Duchess of Parma; finally, after having been the lover of the beautiful Margherita, Faust redeems himself by agreeing to share the stake with her. Extraordinary work on space, multifaceted, reduced and enlarged to create a dimension of moral fairy tale. Unforgettable moments: the prologue with the challenge between Satan and the angel, the arrival of the plague with the shadow of Satan on the village, the scene on the flying carpet. To illustrate the Night on Bald Mountain, in Fantasia, Walt Disney drew inspiration from the initial appearance of the Satan by Emil Janniongs.

title: The Fabulous Baker Boys
actors: Jeff Bridges, Michelle Pfeiffer, Beau Bridges, Ellie Raab, Xander Berkeley, Dakin Matthews, Ken Lerner, Albert Hall, Terri Treas, Gregory Itzin, Bradford English
description: Jack and Frank Baker (Jeff and Beau Bridges) are two brothers pianists who play jazz, in duo, in a Seattle nightclub, but they are in crisis because their repertoire is now worn out. Their actions rise suddenly when they cast a girl (Pfeiffer) as a singer who impresses everyone with her charm. Even on the two brothers, divided by love. Beautiful and original film, even if directed by a stranger, punctual in portraying the world of American night music and in drawing the portrait of the psychologies and feelings of the two protagonists, played by the real Bridges brothers.

title: La favorita
actors: Sophia Loren, Franca Tamantini, Paolo Silveri, Gino Sinimberghi, Miriam Di Giove, Alfredo Colella, Giorgio Costantini, Palmira Vitali Marini, Piero Sardelli
description: Fernando falls in love with a beautiful unknown lady, glimpsed in the church where he is praying. The woman, who even demonstrates that she reciprocates Fernando's feelings, declares to him that any relationship between them is impossible. Covered with glory in war, Fernando gets the hand of Leonora from the king, the woman whose identity and, above all, the role he continues to ignore. It is, in fact, the favorite of the king himself.
notes: Film adaptation of Gaetano Donizetti's melodrama and lyrical voices "loaned" to non-singing actors, with far from brilliant results. The young Loren still appears here with the name of Sofia Lazzaro.

title: The Virgin Queen
actors: Bette Davis, Richard Todd, Joan Collins, Herbert Marshall, Jay Robinson, Dan O'Herlihy, Robert Douglas, Romney Brent, Leslie Parrish, Lisa Daniels
description: Walter Raleigh pleads with Elizabeth I to grant him three vessels, with which he proposes to reach the New World. Conquered by the young man, Elizabeth does not grant him the ships, but makes him Captain of the Bodyguard.
notes: The lack of historical accuracy is canceled out by the actor's performances.

title: Febbre da cavallo
actors: Gigi Proietti, Enrico Montesano, Catherine Spaak, Mario Carotenuto, Francesco De Rosa, Maria Teresa Albani, Gigi Ballista, Nikki Gentile, Adolfo Celi, Ennio Antonelli
description: Mandrake, Pomata and Felice, three friends with the common habit of clandestine bets on horses and at the same time desperate for money (for the debts contracted with bets), try to fix a race. One of them will have to take the place of the jockey of a horse that is assumed to be a winner, making sure that a crook wins instead and they will bet a lot of money.

title: Saturday Night Fever
actors: John Travolta, Karen Lynn Gorney, Barry Miller, Joseph Cali, Paul Pape, Donna Pescow, Bruce Ornstein, Julie Bovasso, Martin Shakar, Sam Coppola, Fran Drescher
description: Tony Manero (Travolta) is nineteen, with dark eyes and Latin charm. He works as a clerk in a paint shop, but as soon as he can he runs to dance in the disco. After all, the situation at home is not idyllic: the father is unemployed, the mother is a bigoted maniac and the priest brother is about to leave the cassock. The film was born under the pretext of a journalistic investigation entitled Tribal rites of the new Saturday night, but what matters is the disco, Travolta's white dress and the music of the Bee Gees.

title: Jazz Singer
actors: Neil Diamond, Laurence Olivier, Lucie Arnaz, Catlin Adams, Franklyn Ajaye, Paul Nicholas, Sully Boyar, Mike Kellin, James Booth, Luther Waters
description: Yussel, sings during the day in the synagogue in New York and in the evening in the clubs of Harlem, disguised as an African-American. The father does not approve, but reconciles when the son, now a celebrity, sings in the synagogue for Yom Kippur. Pale remake of The Jazz Singer, the first all-sound film of 1927. In the role of the protagonist we find Neil Diamond, famous and already decayed singer of the 70s.

title: The Gold Rush
actors: Charles Chaplin, Georgia Hale, Mack Swain, Tom Murray, Henry Bergman, Malcolm Waite
description: Charlot is in the Klondike on the trail of the precious metal, but the eyes of a dancer have more hold on him. After a snowstorm Charlot finds himself in a hut poised on the abyss, in the company of another prospector, the corpulent Giacomone who, hungry, mistakes him for a gigantic chicken and tries to devour him. Charlot then has to settle for a shoe and its laces like spaghetti.
notes: The memorable piece of the film, however, is the dance of the sandwiches made to brighten (in a dream) the evening for the girl and her friends. Happiness is only postponed: until the gold found with the friend makes the little man rich and admired.

title: Il federale
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Georges Wilson, Mireille Granelli, Stefania Sandrelli, Gianrico Tedeschi, Elsa Vazzoler, Renzo Palmer, Gianni Agus, Franco Giacobini, Ester Carloni
description: In 1944 a fascist fanatic who hopes to become a Federal must bring an opponent of the regime from Abruzzo to Rome. Along the journey (by sidecar) the two get to know each other better, against the backdrop of an Italy now in ruins and in disarray. Despite the clear evidence of the collapse of the regime, the comrade's faith does not falter, again due to the mirage of promotion.
notes: The best film by Luciano Salce, which puts the plebiscitary fascist Italy to the hatch and fully exploits the extraordinary skill of Ugo Tognazzi. A cult of our best comedy.

title: Fedora
actors: William Holden, Marthe Keller, José Ferrer, Hildegarde Knef, Frances Sternhagen, Mario Adorf, Stephen Collins, Henry Fonda, Michael York, Hans Jaray, Gottfried John, Arlene Francis
description: Barry Detweiler, a Hollywood producer, travels to Corfu in search of the elderly star Fedora, of whom he was an occasional lover. He wants to persuade her to participate in a film, after so many years. Among many difficulties, he meets a young woman who claims to be Fedora who has undergone cosmetic surgery. But a suicide reveals the pathetic truth to Barry. We are still around Sunset Boulevard: there is the cruelty of the world of cinema, there is William Holden ... The years have passed and Wilder's wickedness perhaps no longer strikes with the speed and ferocity of the past, but the story is still beautiful, melancholy and cruel.

title: Phaedra
actors: Melina Mercouri, Anthony Perkins, Raf Vallone, Elizabeth Ercy, Tzavalas Karousos, Zorz Sarri, Andreas Filippides, Olympia Papadouka, Stelios Vokovich
description: Phaedra, the wife of a wealthy Greek shipowner, falls in love with her stepson. The latter is eventually driven to suicide.
notes: A bold, well-acted drama inspired by Euripides' tragedy (and Racine's version)

title: La feldmarescialla. Rita fugge... Lui corre... Egli scappa
actors: Rita Pavone, Francis Blanche, Terence Hill, Aroldo Tieri, Jess Hahn, Michel Modo, Teddy Reno, Giampiero Littera, Claudio Trionfi
description: An American pilot who parachuted near Florence finds refuge in the restaurant run by Rita which also hosts Giuliano, a professor engaged in research on a newly conceived rocket. Explosive mixture, it must be said, since Rita by mistake causes an explosion that forces the three to flee with the Germans at the ribs. Double happy ending with the arrival of the American lines and the idyll between Rita and the professor.
notes: Curious musical-comedian with a Nazi setting. The atmosphere is that of vintage musicians, with Rita Pavone as the star, but the context is actually funny.

title: Let It Ride
actors: Richard Dreyfuss, Teri Garr, David Johansen, Jennifer Tilly, Allen Garfield, Edward Walsh, Richard Edson, David Schramm, John Roselius, Joseph Walsh
description: An unfortunate gambler learns of a rigged run in Florida. The opportunity he had been waiting for for years. Our hero decides to seize it on the fly to be able to take a big revenge on the cheating and cruel destiny. Although his friends try to distract him from his purpose, he puts all he has left on that race ... The attempt is to make a fast-paced comedy with bizarre tones. To get an idea of ??what is of the result, just think that the screenwriter preferred to appear in the credits under a pseudonym. Dreyfuss obviously disoriented.

title: Felicita Colombo
actors: Dina Galli, Armando Falconi, Giuseppe Porelli, Roberta Mari, Paolo Varna, Angelo Gandolfi, Giovanni Barrella, Nando Tamberlani
description: Felicita has a forever delicatessen in the center of Milan. Her daughter Rosetta is in love with the son of the penniless Conte Scotti. The latter has no intention of learning himself with a saluma, and to give the delivery to the wedding claims that the Supporation retires. But the woman resumes the reins of the shop at the birth of a grandchild and the count adapts, accepting a job in the company. The homonymous comedy of Giuseppe Adani had, at the time, an amazing success and the cinematographic transposition respects its panache, Strengthened by two splendid protagonists, Dina Galli and Armando Falconi, and a group of valid minor interpreters.

title: Beware of Pity
actors: Lilli Palmer, Albert Lieven, Cedric Hardwicke, Gladys Cooper, Linden Travers, Ernest Thesiger, Emrys Jones, Gerhard Kempinski, Ralph Truman
description: An Austrian officer realizes that he is in love with an invalid young woman, but it is too late to avoid the tragedy. Well done, the film is marked by sentimentality and romantic passion and is notable for the very accurate sets.

title: La femme en bleu
actors: Michel Piccoli, Lea Massari, Michel Aumont, Simone Simon, Marie Lasas, Amarande, Geneviève Fontanel, Sabine Glaser, Patricia Lesieur
description: The crisis of an affirmed and fascinating musicologist facing an evanescent and mysterious "woman in blue" who appears and disappears from his life. Solid film directed by Deville with gorgeous actors

title: Take the High Ground
actors: Richard Widmark, Karl Malden, Elaine Stewart, Carleton Carpenter, Russ Tamblyn, Jerome Courtland, Steve Forrest, Robert Arthur, Chris Warfield
description: Sergeant Ryan is the toughest and most inflexible instructor, which is why he is hated by recruits. He feels a strong responsibility on his shoulders: to educate the soldiers who are about to leave for the hot front in Korea to discipline. But one day he meets and falls in love with a woman who is being talked about, and is disputed by his best friend. Ryan reveals his humanity on this occasion.
notes: Despite the Italian title, Brooks has no desire to tell sentimental stories. His is instead an acute reflection on the militarism and the fragility of those who use it as a shield of their own insecurities.

title: Leave Her to Heaven
actors: Gene Tierney, Cornel Wilde, Jeanne Crain, Vincent Price, Mary Philips, Ray Collins, Gene Lockhart, Reed Hadley, Darryl Hickman
description: Elena and Harlan, a love at first sight and a quick wedding. But then her mind is overwhelmed by a devastating jealousy that leads her to suppress all those whom she pathologically identifies as "rivals" in her relationship with her husband, even the child she is expecting. Elena goes so far as to kill herself, but even on this occasion she plots a diabolical plot to strike yet another victim.
notes: Excellent drama in shades that cannot be stronger, that time has neither tarnished nor weakened. It seemed, then, a magnificent spectacle of violent impact and today its attractions are not weakened. Delusional photograph of Shamroy (awarded with an Oscar) and delusional Gene Tierney.

title: The Revolt of Mamie Stover
actors: Jane Russell, Richard Egan, Joan Leslie, Agnes Moorehead, Michael Pate, Jorja Curtright, Richard Coogan, Alan Reed, Eddie Firestone, Jean Willes, Leon Lontoc
description: Determined to earn a lot, enough to return rich to the country from which she left, Mamie Stover embarks for Honolulu. On the ship he meets a young writer, Jim Blair. Between the two it is sympathy at first sight and she confides in him her intentions, he urges her not to put money first. Arriving at their destination, Mamie finds a lucrative job as an entrîneuse and gets rich. Meanwhile, after some time, she finds Jim. And between the two it is really love. But Mamie doesn't quit her regular job, even when Jim volunteers to go to war.
notes: Good interpretation of Jane Russell, however, caged in a character a little too schematic.

title: Painting the Clouds With Sunshine
actors: Virginia Mayo, Lucille Norman, Virginia Gibson, Dennis Morgan, Gene Nelson, S.Z. Sakall, Tom Conway, Wallace Ford
description: Three magazine dancers Carol, Ebe and June perform in a club with two dancers: Ted and Vincent. Ebe loves Vincent, but he, seized by a fever for the game, neglects her. Disappointed by their career and life, the three girls leave for Las Vegas where they are joined by Ted and his cousin, who compete for the love of the girls: but in the end everything works out. Director David Butler does his utmost to update the themes and atmospheres of 1930s musicals after the war. But this muiscal is not the most sumptuous and imaginative.

title: Caged Heat
actors: Juanita Brown, Roberta Collins, Barbara Steele, Erica Gavin, Ella Reid, Cheryl Smith, Warren Miller, Crystin Sinclaire, Mickey Fox
description: In an isolated prison there are hardly any controls: in this way, the director can vent her sadism towards the prisoners, helped by a psychopathic doctor who was already torturing prisoners in Vietnam. Some inmates, including the beautiful black Maggie, organize a riot whose outcome is not at all obvious ...
notes: Jonathan Demme makes his debut in a small Roger Corman production. Despite the scarce means, you can see the makings of a thoroughbred director in the wild pace of the story. The director of the prison is the unforgettable Barbara Steele, who will soon retire from the screens for good.

title: Bus Stop
actors: Marilyn Monroe, Don Murray, Betty Field, Arthur O'Connell, Eileen Heckart, Robert Bray, Hope Lange, Hans Conried, Max Showalter
description: Young Bo and his manager Virgil, two cowboys from Montana, travel to Phoenix to participate in the annual rodeo. Here they meet Chérie, a singer who performs in a cowboy club where customers often disrespect her. For this she is favorably impressed by the kind ways of the shy Bo, who immediately falls in love with her and asks her to marry him.
notes: A healthy classic comedy, which is especially true for a splendid Marylin: beautiful as always, with a touch of sublime sensuality.

title: Cover-up
actors: Dolph Lundgren, Louis Gossett jr., Lisa Berkley, John Finn, Gil Kopel, Howard Rypp, Ofer Lehavi, Zadok Zarum
description: Prior to being a reporter, Mike (Lundgren) was a member of the Marine Corps. When eight American soldiers are killed in Israel and the responsibility is officially attributed to a terrorist group called Black October, Mike, not convinced, decides to investigate and discovers that in reality there is a plot behind the affair that wants to cause an international crisis. In a race against time, the journalist foils an attack by saving the situation. Lou Gosset jr. in this film it nullifies the credit earned with the Oscar ("Officer and a gentleman"). Dolph Lundgren gives all his energies to the end, but in the popular imagination he can't go beyond the famous "I split you in two" said to Stallone in "Rocky IV".

title: Fermo con le mani!
actors: Totò, Erzsi Paal, Tina Pica, Oreste Bilancia, Franco Coop, Miranda Bonansea, Luigi Erminio D'Olivo, Alfredo Martinelli, Alfredo De Antoni
description: Hired in a beauty salon, the vagabond Totò disguises himself as a woman to replace the temporarily absent masseuse. Thus he devotes himself to the care of a client who, however, unmasks him. The scandal that follows leads him to agree with the friend of the lady by whom Totò, for a fee, will be slapped in a public place. But the two end up in the police station where Totò discovers that he is being sought ... as heir to a large fortune.
notes: The Prince's first film pays the price for his verve as a theatrical comedian. Cinematographically it's not that great, but Totò's gags and his facial expressions are already those.

title: Il ferroviere
actors: Pietro Germi, Sylva Koscina, Luisa Della Noce, Saro Urzì, Carlo Giuffrè, Amedeo Trilli, Renato Speziali, Edoardo Nevola, Riccardo Garrone
description: Andrea Marcocci worked all his life in the railways, but he never made friends with his colleagues; in addition, the children prove to be a disappointment: the male in fact does not want to work, while the girl continues to have extramarital affairs. Andrea begins to drink more and more until he suffers a train accident: in that difficult situation, his workmates deny him solidarity because he had worked during a strike ...
notes: Affectionate and pathetic representation of a proletarian family. Presented in Cannes, the film later achieved good public success. The director-actor Germi dominates the scene.

title: The Birthday Party
actors: Robert Shaw, Patrick Magee, Sidney Tafter, Dandy Nichols, Moultrie Kelsall, Helen Fraser
description: A landlord in a seaside village receives the visit of two sinister characters and his life is inexorably marked. On the theme of the "stranger" who suddenly arrives to ruin the life of a defenseless character, Pinter would later build a fortune. This is his first theatrical work and probably, taking it to the cinema, he didn't have the courage to make some cuts. It's a bit long and obviously very theatrical, but the dialogue is superb and Patrick Magee is beyond compare.

title: Fever
actors: Sam Neill, Armand Assante, Marcia Gay Harden, Gregg Henry, Joe Spano, Steve Rankin, Mark Boone Junior, Jon Gries, Tim Ransom
description: A former convict who has recently returned to freedom just wants to find his girlfriend, to start over. You work with a lawyer, condominium administration sector. As is inevitable, competition arises between the two males, but it is brutally interrupted by the kidnapping of the woman: old prison rivalries come to the surface. Television film without too many nuances: the woman, prey or victim, still finds herself at the expense of the clash between the dominating males. Sam Neill (the lawyer) is an actor of a certain sensitivity.

title: I fichissimi
actors: Diego Abatantuono, Jerry Calà, Simona Mariani, Mauro Di Francesco, Simone Bongiovanni, Renato Cecchetto, Carmine Faraco, Fabio Grossi, Barbara Herrera
description: In the Milanese suburbs, Romeo, a thoroughbred northerner, and Felice, a perfectly integrated Apulian, command two rival gangs. Romeo falls in love with Juliet without knowing that this is Felice's sister. When the truth comes out, the hurricane breaks out. Following the failed robbery of a pawnshop, Romeo also ends up in jail, where he leaves just in time to take Juliet away from the altar, ready to marry another with Felice's consent. A pseudo-Milanese farce dominated by a first style Abatantuono, who shuffles the cards from Romeo and Juliet to West Side Story, passing through The Graduate. Too much grace, Saint Anthony.

title: Fico d'India
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Aldo Maccione, Gloria Guida, Daniele Formica, Diego Abatantuono, Gianfranco Barra, Roberto Della Casa, Nestor Garay, Dario Ghirardi, Licinia Lentini
description: In the village of Cavagnano, the city sport is gossip. One day, Ghigo Buccilli tries to corrupt the loyalty of Mayor Millozzi's wife, taking advantage of his absence. Ghigo, however, gets a heart attack and stays at the Millozzi house for a week: the mayor is in fact back, but in order not to cause the scandal to break out, he keeps Ghigo hidden from everyone's eyes. The two become friends ...
notes: According to a trend that was popular until the mid-1980s, this is one of those things that can alternatively be called "pochade" or "jokes". Here the lightness of the touch - as in all films of the genre - is extremely "heavy".

title: The Tender Trap
actors: Frank Sinatra, Debbie Reynolds, Celeste Holm, Carolyn Jones, David Wayne, Jarma Lewis, Lola Albright, Howard St. John
description: Charlie Reder, a theatrical agent, lives in New York and has no problems with women, courted as he is by beautiful girls. But one day he falls in love with Giulia. Faced with too heavy advances, this takes offense. Charlie, after drinking, decides to marry Silvia, one of the many who, moreover, has become the lover of a friend of Charlie's, Joe. But Giulia is not willing to give up so easily.
notes: Bubbly comedy with a Sinatra in great shape and young Debbie Reynolds at the height of her season of glory. Iron script, and song outline.

title: Figaro e la sua gran giornata
actors: Gianfranco Giachetti, Leda Gloria, Maurizio D'Ancora, Ugo Ceseri, Umberto Sacripante, Olga Capri, Gemma Schirato
description: Cavalier Basoto, a former baritone, is commissioned by the town council of his town to stage the "Barber of Seville". The preparation is studded with accidents, so much so that in the end it is he himself who impersonates Figaro, while the role of the prima donna will be played by a young and talented girl, but with a strict and meddlesome father.

title: At Sword's Point
actors: Cornel Wilde, Maureen O'Hara, Robert Douglas, Gladys Cooper, June Clayworth, Dan O'Herlihy, Alan Hale jr., Blanche Yurka, Nancy Gates
description: Although Louis XIII, dying, left a minor heir as heir to the throne, the Duke of Lavalle actually dominates the kingdom of France, with the intention of marrying the Queen's daughter and thus making his power legitimate. The children of the famous musketeers, three young men and a girl arrive to help the sovereign. Never four will have their problems returning the throne to the Dauphin.
notes: Some good duels, but there is little new compared to the other films in the series. Allen directs with impeccable rhythm, the actors are the right ones.

title: In Search of the Castaways
actors: Maurice Chevalier, George Sanders, Hayley Mills, Wilfrid Hyde-White, Michael Anderson jr., Antonio Cifariello, Keith Hamshere, Wilfrid Brambell, Jack Gwillim, Ronald Fraser
description: Captain Grant, commander of Britannia who mysteriously disappeared in 1883, left two sons who, determined to find him, persuade Lord Harry Glernavan to go in search of him. Adventures and troubles of all kinds accompany the group during the journey that first stops in Chile and then towards Australia where they are captured by the Maori.
notes: Colorful and naive Disney adaptation of the classic Jules Verne novel. The script is so-so, the cast is great. But the film was already old at the time.

title: Sons of the Desert
actors: Stan Laurel, Oliver Hardy, Charlie Chase, Mae Busch, Dorothy Christy, Lucien Littlefield
description: There is actually no desert in the film. The title takes its name from the club that Stanlio and Ollio are part of. The two, in order to attend the annual meeting, are forced to deceive their wives by making them believe they have left on a ship. When the newspaper announces that the ship has sunk, they naturally have to stage an alleged rescue from the shipwreck after a thousand adventures. The spouses are more attentive than ever to the miraculous ones, but then, by chance, they see a filmed chronicle of the meeting in which the two jokers frolic with friends and little women. Their wrath will be relentless.
notes: Tight, unstoppable, hilarious: an apocalyptic vision of male infantilism, marriage, and endless gags.

title: I figli del leopardo
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Evi Marandi, Alberto Bonucci, Anthony Steffen, Vittorio Congia, Mario Castellani, Elisa Mainardi, Silvio Bagolini, Enzo Andronico, Raimondo Vianello
description: The adventures, between farce and speck, of two wandering "tooth pickers", sons of a penniless baron. The protagonists have to deal first with the band of the Brigand Bagalone, then with the Bourbon soldiers, finally, even, with Giuseppe Garibaldi's "red shirts".
notes: The recognized profession of Sergio Corbucci this time fails to revive the fate of a comedy that too often borders on farce. Franchi and Ingrassia abandon themselves to the usual repertoire of jokes and jokes. At the time it was a great success and saved the Titanus from the flop of the real _Gattopardo_, but today this Visconti parody can only whet, at best, cinephile curiosity.

title: The Space Children
actors: Michael Ray, Jackie Coogan, Adam Williams, Peggy Webber, Johnny Washbrook, Richard Shannon, Raymond Bailey
description: Under the influence of an alien, some children attempt to sabotage the launch of a space missile.

title: I figli di nessuno
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, Yvonne Sanson, Françoise Rosay, Folco Lulli, Enrica Dyrell, Enrico Olivieri, Teresa Franchini, Gualtiero Tumiati, Alberto Farnese, Aristide Baghetti, Enrico Glori
description: Luisa loves Guido, but the latter's mother hinders them. He also makes her kidnap her son. Luisa, believing that the child is dead, locks herself up in the convent. Many years later the boy finds himself working in the mines of Guido, who has married another woman. When after an argument with Guido himself, the young man runs away and is seriously injured, his father learns the whole truth from his wife.
notes: One of the most famous films of the king of "made in Italy" melodrama, capable of translating the most incredible subjects into popular spectacle, including tears, music and strong emotions. As a "mettur en scène", Matarazzo is great.

title: Children of a Lesser God
actors: William Hurt, Marlee Matlin, Piper Laurie, Philip Bosco, Alison Gompf, John F. Cleary, Philip Holmes, Georgia Ann Cline
description: James Leeds, a young teacher specializing in the recovery of deaf and dumb kids, arrives at a traditionally run institution. At first his rather casual methods disconcert the headmaster, but they immediately win the sympathy of the boys. Sarah Norman also lives in the institute, who seems resistant to any learning discipline. Sarah and James fall in love, but their relationship isn't easy. The director avoids patheticism, even if she is unable to reproduce the wickedness of the theatrical text that inspires her. Marlee Matlin, on her debut, immediately wins the Oscar, the sympathy of the public and the love of William Hurt; however, their marriage did not last long. The film also won the Silver Bear in Berlin.

title: I figli di Zanna Bianca
actors: Sal Borgese, Ileana Rigano, Gualtiero Rispoli, Claudia Bianchi, Piero Fabiani, Danny Ribol, Antonio Maimone, Luciano Rossi
description: A little girl, granddaughter of a rich industrialist, was kidnapped in Sardinia just when her parents decided to separate. The police are groping in the dark and the intervention of an aspiring journalist assisted by the dog Buck, who is very fond of the child, is decisive. The unprecedented couple succeeds where the police have failed; the kidnappers are captured and the parents are reconciled.
notes: The famous dog in Jack London's novel has nothing to do with the story of the film, a children's detective of little interest. Leading role for the acrobat Sal Borgese, one of the most famous stunt performers of Italian cinema.

title: La figlia del capitano
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, Irasema Dilian, Cesare Danova, Vittorio Gassman, Aldo Silvani, Ave Ninchi, Ernesto Almirante, Olga Solbelli, Carlo Ninchi, Gualtiero Tumiati
description: The young and noble standard bearer Piotr has been assigned to a frontier department in a remote garrison in the heart of Siberia. During the voyage he saves a Cossack from death, then, having reached the fort, he falls in love with Mascia, the daughter of Captain Mironov, attracting the hatred of a rival who for years has been asking in vain for the girl's hand. Meanwhile, the rebel Cossacks are about to storm the fort ... The Lux production company had a long tradition of period films, which is filmed here at its highest level. Pushkin's novel is freely adapted, with a sense of action.

title: Daughter of Darkness
actors: Anthony Perkins, Mia Sara, Jack Coleman, Robert Reynolds, Dezsö Garas, Erika Bodnár, Kati Rák, Ági Margitai
description: A girl who has never met her father finally decides to go in search of him. Eventually she discovers that her father lives in Bucharest in a vampire colony and also discovers that if her father is a vampire, maybe she herself ... Poor Anthony Perkins, now at the end of his career, was willing to shoot anything with anyone. The whoever of this case is Stuart Gordon, author of some great horror as "Re-Animator", but here short of ideas.

title: Ryan's Daughter
actors: Sarah Miles, Robert Mitchum, John Mills, Trevor Howard, Christopher Jones, Leo McKern, Barry Foster, Marie Kean, Arthur O'Sullivan, Evin Crowley
description: In 1916, Rosy, the daughter of Tom Ryan, the richest man in Kirrary, a miserable Irish village, cheats on her husband with an English officer. One night in the village a German fishing boat disembarks carrying a load of weapons. Recipient of the weapons is Tom O'Leary, hero of the Irish revolution, but ...
notes: The film, which originally premiered in a 206-minute version, garnered two Academy Awards: John Mills for Supporting Actor and photography by Freddie Young.

title: Daughters of Joshua Cabe
actors: Buddy Ebsen, Lesley Ann Warren, Sandra Dee, Karen Valentine, Don Stroud, Henry Jones, Jack Elam, Leif Erickson, Michael Anderson jr., Paul Koslo
description: The new government law provides that border lands are assigned to settlers in proportion to the number of family members. Joshua Cabe is said to have three daughters, but none of them are planning to return to live with him. To remedy this, Joshua adopts three girls who certainly do not belong to good society.

title: Il figlio del Corsaro Rosso
actors: Lex Barker, Sylvia Lopez, Vira Silenti, Renato Bracale, Tiziano Cortini, Elio Pandolfi, Luciano Marin, Antonio Crast, Fanfulla, Vicky Lagos
description: Count Enrico di Ventimiglia, son of the famous Corsaro Rosso, searches all seas for the sinister Van Hais, whose betrayal cost his father his life. The filibuster is captured while boarding a Spanish galleon. On board the ship is the Marquise of Montellimar who is made a sign of the attentions of Enrico's men. To try to save himself, Van Hais promises to reveal the place where the count's sister has disappeared for years. The nobleman learns that his sister is in the service of a noblewoman in Maracaibo. Posing as a Spanish officer, Enrico tries to get in touch with her.
notes: Negligible adventure film.

title: Comme un boomerang
actors: Alain Delon, Carla Gravina, Dora Doll, Louis Julien, Christian de Tillière, Monique Chaumette, Louisa Colpeyn, Charles Vanel, Suzanne Flon, Reinhard Kolldehoff
description: A boy unintentionally kills a policeman and his father (Delon), who has a history as a major outlaw, tries to save him through legal means. But when things go wrong, man goes back to the old ways.
notes: Director José Giovanni had direct experience of the underworld environments, which he then put to good use as a novelist, screenwriter and director. The film, to the script of which Delon himself also contributed, outlines a situation with remarkable effectiveness and the characters have a dimension that is not at all trivial. Alongside Delon, the presence of Charles Vanel and Suzanne Flon are noteworthy.

title: The Son of Sheik
actors: Rodolfo Valentino, Vilma Banky, George Fawcett, Montagu Love, Karl Dane, Bull Montana, Bynunsky Hyman, Agnes Ayres
description: Love, exoticism, adventures in one of the great successes of Rudolph Valentino, in his latest film.

title: Il figlio di Aquila Nera
actors: Mimmo Palmara, Edwige Fenech, Ingrid Schoeller, Franco Ressel, Andrea Aureli, Ivy Holzer, Loris Gizzi, Massimo Carocci, Franco Pasquetto, Tullio Altamura
description: Alessio Andrejevic, son of the legendary hero Black Eagle, puts himself at the head of the Cossacks and fights against the ruthless Governor of the Caucasus. Falling into the hands of his enemy, he is freed by the intervention of Natasha (Fenech).
notes: Italian adventures with exotic appearances.

title: Il figlio di Django
actors: Guy Madison, Gabriele Tinti, Daniele Vargas, Andrea Scotti, Ingrid Schoeller, Ignazio Spalla, Andrea Scotti, Roberto Messina, Giovanni Ivan Scratuglia, Cristina Penz
description: As a child, Tracy witnessed the killing of her father Django. Having also become a gunslinger, he is tasked with killing a bandit who is extorting a small town in the West. He discovers that behind the outlaw is one of the most powerful men in the city and that he himself had caused the death of his father. He kills him and then, tired of the violence, he makes a decision.
notes: Osvaldo Civirani, one of the best known Italian stage photographers, devoted himself to directing in the 1960s. Here he reprises the most neurotic of the heroes created by the spaghetti western, but the adventure is dull and without suspense.

title: Son of Frankenstein
actors: Basil Rathbone, Boris Karloff, Bela Lugosi, Lionel Atwill, Josephine Hutchinson, Donnie Dunagan, Emma Dunn, Edgar Norton, Perry Ivins
description: Doctor Frankenstein's creature was rescued and hidden by the scientist's faithful servant. Frankenstein's son discovers her and secretly takes an interest in her, but the monster escapes his control. Enthusiastic settings and cast for lovers of the genre, with Boris Karloff for the last time in the role of the revived brute, and a great Bela Lugosi in the part of the sinister servant Igor.

title: The Son of Kong
actors: Helen Mack, Robert Armstrong, Frank Reicher, John Marston, Victor Wong, Ed Brady
description: On a distant island, the same man who discovered King Kong meets the monstrous ape's son, who saves his life. Modest and not very fortunate sequel to the 1933 masterpiece. Almost a banal adventure film.

title: Son of Lassie
actors: Peter Lawford, Donald Crisp, June Lockhart, Nigel Bruce, Leon Ames, William Severn, Donald Curtis, Nils Asther, Robert Lewis, Fay Helm
description: Lassie had a puppy: Laddi. Laddi is very fond of his owner Joe. But when Joe has to leave for the war (he has to reach the RAF camp), Laddi secretly follows him. Joe's plane is shot down over the skies of Norway, so Joe is interned in a prison camp but the good Laddi will always be able to track down his master, and save his life on more than one occasion.
notes: The war comedy is the backdrop to the adventures of the famous collie.

title: Figlio mio, infinitamente caro...
actors: Ben Gazzara, Mariangela Melato, Sergio Rubini, Valeria Golino, Fabrizio Temperini, Wanda Pasquini, Gesualdo Bagnoli, Federica Benedetti
description: Antonio Morelli, a Pisan lawyer, discovers that his son Marco is a drug addict. Arguments, slaps and coercions are useless. In the end, the father decides to participate in the self-destruction of Marco and his girlfriend Francesca, of whom he becomes the lover. The girl dies of an overdose, Marco drops the heroin: now it's up to him to devote himself to the recovery of the parent destroyed by drugs. With some rhetorical excess, the film creates disturbance for Valentino Orsini's ability to displace the eternal discourse on ambiguous father-son relationships in the most current nightmare of bourgeois families. In the cast Ben Gazzara surpasses everyone by a notch.

title: Film d'amore e d'anarchia
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Mariangela Melato, Lina Polito, Eros Pagni, Pina Cei, Elena Fiore, Giuliana Calandra, Isa Bellini, Isa Danieli, Enrica Bonaccorti
description: Film of love and anarchy, or rather this morning at 10 in via dei Fiori in the well-known brothel ... the full title of the film.
