The Lombard peasant Antonio Soffiantini, known as Tunin, is in charge of killing Mussolini and chooses a brothel as a basis for his action, helped by the prostitute Salome.
notes: There is to laugh and tremble, but you have to understand the meaning of an operation that may seem, at first sight, a sloppy comedy but which also contains a cry of tragic desperation. Actors of great gigioneria (Giannini awarded in Cannes).

title: Every Which Way But Loose
actors: Clint Eastwood, Sondra Locke, Geoffrey Lewis, Beverly D'Angelo, Walter Barnes, George Chandler, Roy Jenson, James McEachin, Bill McKinney
description: Philo Beddo is a champion trucker of "street" boxing; leaves with his trusty orangutan Clyde and his friend Orville in search of his beloved, Lynn, who has fled to Denver. The chase is lively, the meeting with Lynn is disappointing; after a last fight with a local champion, by which he lets himself be beaten, Philo goes home.
notes: Clint, after years of nameless gunfighters and Lieutenants Callaghan, gives his character a twist; here the irony makes its way through the punches, to match the melancholy. A bittersweet cinematic ballad for a tender and unusual Eastwood (who personally shot some sequences).

title: The Razor's Edge
actors: Tyrone Power, Gene Tierney, Anne Baxter, John Payne, Clifton Webb, Herbert Marshall, Lucile Watson, Frank Latimore, Elsa Lanchester, Fritz Kortner
description: Larry, a veteran prostrate from the war, breaks with the frivolous society of Chicago and with his girlfriend Isabel, then leaves for India. A holy man initiates him into mystical wisdom and teaches him that "the way of salvation is as narrow as a razor's edge". Upon returning to America, he would like to redeem, by marrying her, a friend who has taken a bad turn. But Isabel, jealous of him despite having in the meantime married, does everything to stop him.
notes: It is one of the last works of Edmund Goulding ("Grand Hotel"), whose touch seems to have been made on purpose to underline the psychological and cosmopolitan tones of the W. Somerset Maugham novel from which the film is based. Oscar for Baxter as a supporting character.

title: Finché c'è guerra c'è speranza
actors: Alberto Sordi, Silvia Monti, Alessandro Cutolo, Matilde Costa Giuffrida, Edoardo Faieta, Mauro Firmani, Eliana De Santis, Fernando Daviddi
description: Pietro Chiocca sold water pumps and made good money. Now it sells weapons to Third World countries, and earns even more, with increasingly shady deals. When he is publicly referred to as a "death merchant," he would be willing to return to an honest business, but the family disagrees.
notes: Sordi likes to be a "moralist" but, above all, he likes to juggle. When he does everything on his own, as in this case, it is difficult for him to know how to contain himself, and the intentions of whipping vices appear unrealistic.

title: Beta Som
actors: James Mason, Lilli Palmer, Gabriele Ferzetti, Alberto Lupo, Valeria Fabrizi, Renato De Carmine, Daniele Vargas, Andrew Keir, Gabriele Tinti, Jeremy Burnham, Paul Muller
description: During the Second World War, an Italian submarine attempts to force the Strait of Gibraltar. The commander, since his boat is being chased by an English destroyer and damaged by depth bombs, decides to take refuge in the neutral waters of Tangier. Here he will also find the English officer and the two end up knowing and appreciating each other.
notes: An Italian-English co-production that traces the clichés of British-style war movies. Good psychological game between the two soldiers, forced on adverse fronts but basically aware of the mutual value. The action scenes are a bit naïve.

title: La fine del gioco
actors: Gianni Amelio, Ugo Gregoretti, Luigi Valentino
description: Leonardo (Valentino) is a little boy locked up in a correctional house in the deep south. A television director (Gregoretti) decides to enter the correctional institution and chooses him, among all the others imprisoned, to submit him to an interview.
notes: Amelio's film debut highlights the qualities that the director will be able to demonstrate later. His desire to thoroughly investigate the soul of a child with problems, as well as being a civilly high attempt, also represents an idea for making films.

title: La fine del mondo nel nostro solito letto in una notte piena di pioggia
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Candice Bergen, Michael Tucker, Mario Scarpetta, Lucio Amelio, Massimo Wertmüller, Anny Papa, Anne Byrne Hoffman, Flora Carabella, Jill Eikenberry
description: In 1968 a communist journalist (Giannini) falls in love with an American feminist, chases her to the US and marries her. Ten years later, the two blame each other for the mutual disappointment of desires and ideals. Written and directed by a particularly verbose and melodramatic Wertmüller.

title: The End
actors: Burt Reynolds, Dom DeLuise, Sally Field, Myrna Loy, Joanne Woodward, Strother Martin, David Steinberg, Norman Fell
description: The doctor was very clear: for Sonny Lawson there is still at most one year to live. But no one seems to be interested in him: the separated wife avoids him, the new friend is distracted as well as the old parents, even the priest is not very sensitive. Sonny therefore instructs a psychopath to kill him, after unsuccessfully trying to commit suicide. Then he changes his mind, but it's too late to escape the killer attacks ...
notes: From a not very original plot, Reynolds (directorial debut) derives a bitter comedy with some interesting ideas. Funny dialogues and a presence - that of Dom De Luise - truly devastating: but the light touch of Blake Edwards is missing.

title: Konetz Sankt-Peterburga
actors: Aleksandr Chistyakov, Vera Baranovskaya, Ivan Chuvelyov, V. Obolensky, Sergey Komarov, Viktor Tsoppi
description: A young peasant becomes a worker in a factory in St. Petersburg in 1914. When his comrades go on strike, he reports them to the boss, but joins them in prison after, including his own mistake, he attacked the boss himself. When the war broke out, a strong political awareness matured at the front and at the time of the Revolution it was in the front row. In the background, the misery of the Russian people. At first received with perplexity at home, in films he was instead acclaimed abroad for his epic and lyric power and for the vigorous editing used in a shrewd narrative function. The choice of interpreters, of plastic effectiveness, is very careful.

title: Bedroom Window
actors: Steve Guttenberg, Elizabeth McGovern, Isabelle Huppert, Paul Shenar, Carl Lumbly, Wallace Shawn, Frederick Coffin, Brad Greenquist, Robert Schenkkan
description: Sylvie, a beautiful and married woman, finds herself one night with her young lover Terry when she sees through the window a girl attacked by a criminal. In order not to compromise himself, he doesn't want to call the police. Terry is told everything and then offers himself as an eyewitness, managing to have a certain Anderson arrested, but he comes out unscathed from the trial.
notes: The American away Huppert, directed by a specialist in thrillers ("Bad Companies"), puts all her charm and skill at the service of a complex and tragic character. Next to her, the daredevil Guttenberg in a dramatic part just can't make it.

title: The Other Side of the Mountain
actors: Marilyn Hassett, Beau Bridges, Belinda Montgomery, Nan Martin, William Bryant, Dabney Coleman, Bill Vint, Hampton Fancher, Griffin Dunne
description: In the winter of 1954-55, Jill Kinmont, a student in a small town in Colorado, aspires to qualify for the upcoming Snow Olympics. She trains intensely, wins many competitions, but during the qualifying race, she incurs a frightening fall that causes her to fracture a cervical vertebra with consequent perennial immobility of her legs. She will be able to recover a minimum of movements and will become a teacher for the handicapped.
notes: The director Larry Peerce has established himself with films of high caliber of drama, as he also demonstrates on this occasion. A little "easy" psychological approaches, events with a strong emotional impact are his favorite ingredients.

title: Rear Window
actors: James Stewart, Grace Kelly, Thelma Ritter, Raymond Burr, Wendell Corey, Judith Evelyn, Ross Bagdasarian, Georgine Darcy
description: Jeff (Stewart), a photojournalist immobilized at home by a broken leg, has to contend with the rude nurse Stella (Ritter) and his girlfriend Lisa (Kelly), eager to get him a promise of marriage. To pass the time, Jeff keeps an eye on the lives of his neighbors from the window and in doing so he realizes that a woman has disappeared in a mysterious way. He then turns into a detective. Suspicions gather about the woman's husband, a traveling salesman. Grace Kelly, radiant and sparkling, is here at the peak of her beauty. The story, which ends with a masterful crescendo, takes place in a building entirely rebuilt in the studio: a technical feat that allows the director to unleash all his skill in distributing the movements of the characters and the camera in a perfect narrative device. Led by the hand of Hitchcock's narrative genius, the viewer becomes a witness to the private life of the various tenants of the building, in complete identification with Jeff, and participates helplessly in the dramatic finale.

title: Cloak & Dagger
actors: Henry Thomas, Dabney Coleman, Michael Murphy, Christina Nigra, John McIntire, Jeanette Nolan, Eloy Casados, Tim Rossovich, William Forsythe
description: David Osborne is twelve years old and has a passion: computer simulation games. By chance he comes into possession of a disk with the adventures of his favorite hero in which a spy has copied information. The police do not believe him, only a couple of elderly friends give him credit.
notes: Franklin, also director of "Psycho 2", is a Hitchcock admirer. And the memory of the master of the thrill is present in various moments of the film, with sequences quoted faithfully. Fun, but in the end a bit obvious. From a short story by Cornell Woolrich.

title: La finestra sul luna park
actors: Giulia Rubini, Gastone Renzelli, Giancarlo Damiani, Pierre Trabaud, Calina Classy, Gisella Mancinotti, Luigi Russo, Remo Galli, Lina Galli
description: After the death of his wife, a man returns from Kenya where he had moved to work. He has to think about the future of his son, little Mario, whom he has practically never met. So he thinks of entrusting the child to an orphanage and leaving again, then he discovers that Mario does not attend school but lingers with Richetto, a second-hand dealer who is very fond of the little one. After a first fight, Richetto makes the parent aware of his duties as a father and the latter decides not to leave anymore and take care of the child in the first person.
notes: Comencini has always had a particular sensitivity in his gaze on the world of children and this remote film is proof of this.

title: Until September
actors: Karen Allen, Thierry Lhermitte, Christopher Cazenove, Hutton Cobb, Michael Mellinger, Nitza Shaul, Rachel Robertson, Raphaëlle Spencer, Joanna Pavlis
description: Xavier's wife went on vacation with her children. The man, who has stayed in Paris to work all summer, meets a beautiful American tourist and falls in love with her. The two live a few carefree days even though they know their story will have to end. When September arrives and Xavier's wife returns to Paris, the American sadly prepares to leave for the United States. But at the airport Xavier joins her: he has changed his mind, he wants to build a new life with her. In this dull and sleepy Franco-American melodrama, it is difficult to recognize the hand of the director of Return of the Jedi.

title: À bout de souffle
actors: Jean Seberg, Jean-Paul Belmondo, Henri Jacques Huet, Van Doude, Daniel Boulanger, Roger Hanin, Claude Mansard, Liliane Dreyfus, Michel Fabre, Jean-Pierre Melville, Jean-Luc Godard
description: Michel is a displaced young man: the modern heir to the cursed romantics is incapable of living according to the rules of bourgeois society. He steals a car, flees to Italy, but the police chase him. Two agents intercept him and Michel kills one. He returns to Paris where he finds refuge with Patricia, a young American with whom he has a complicated love affair. The termination of their relationship coincides with a new police report. For Michel, the reckoning is getting closer and closer.
notes: From a subject by François Truffaut, the first feature film by Jean-Luc Godard, one of the mythical titles of the Nouvelle Vague: he revolutionized the cinematographic language with his arrogance of canonical rules, proposed a new, aggressive and frenetic approach to "making cinema", cast Belmondo as a star.

title: Il fiore delle Mille e una notte
actors: Ninetto Davoli, Franco Citti, Tessa Bouché, Franco Merli, Ines Pellegrini, Margareth Clémenti, Claudia Rocchi, Alberto Argentino, Francesco Paolo Governale
description: The story of Nur-el-Din and the beautiful slave Zumurrud; the trap set by Tiffané and Zeudé to find out who is the best lover between a boy and a girl. And again: the different fates of Aziz and Tagi, the first punished with emasculation for a love betrayal, the second, instead much more fortunate. Finally, two princes, through different but equally adventurous paths, end up becoming bonzes. It is the last chapter of the famous Pasolini's "Trilogy of life". One wonders what is left of the film, certainly scissored for television programming.

title: Steel Magnolias
actors: Shirley MacLaine, Sally Field, Julia Roberts, Olympia Dukakis, Daryl Hannah, Dolly Parton, Sam Shepard, Tom Skerritt, Dylan McDermott
description: M'Lynn is anxious about her daughter Shelby, who is pregnant despite doctors' advice to the contrary. In fact, Shelby is diabetic. Her friends Ouiser console her, a quarrelsome lady with two husbands behind her, Clairee and Annelle, who is running away from an unhappy marriage. The baby is born healthy, but Shelby gets worse and, despite the kidney transplant provided by M'Lynn, dies after a few months. Grandma M'Lynn dedicates herself to her grandson. Based on a successful comedy by Robert Harling, who is therefore also responsible for the gruesome names of the characters, the film is affected by the theatrical structure. On the other hand, all the actresses work perfectly.

title: Kaagaz ke phool
actors: Guru Dutt, Waheeda Rehman, Kumari Naaz, Mahesh Kaul, Mehmood, Johnny Walker, Veena, Minoo Mumtaz
description: Suresh Sinha was a famous film director. For some time in professional crisis and with serious problems with his wife, he decides to go back to shooting a film and chooses for the female role a girl with whom he ends up falling madly in love. However, the relationship is broken and Suresh, fallen into a state of deep depression, is brutalized by alcohol. Cruel apologue, partly autobiographical, on life and art made by a great Indian director almost unknown outside the borders of his homeland, himself the victim of a tragic fate: Guru Dutt in fact will take his own life a few years after the realization of this film. The film is innovative and of extraordinary sincerity, one of the most bitter reflections on cinema.

title: Firefox
actors: Clint Eastwood, Freddie Jones, David Huffman, Warren Clarke, Ronald Lacey, Kenneth Colley, Klaus Löwitsch, Nigel Hawthorne, Stefan Schnabel
description: The latest in Soviet warfare is an aircraft that delivers astounding performance as long as the pilot thinks in Russian. The CIA hires Russian-speaking Colonel Gant (Eastwood), a Vietnam veteran, and sends him to Russia to steal the plane. Before reaching his goal, Gant must overcome the obstacles placed in the way of the Soviet intelligence network. From the moment Gant finally manages to get his hands on the plane and escape, the film acquires rhythm and tension.
notes: The aerial duel with the pursuers introduces a fantastic dimension, thanks also to the special effects of Dykstra ("Star Wars"). Eastwood's eighth direction.

title: Il fischio al naso
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Tina Louise, Olga Villi, Franca Bettoia, Riccardo Garrone, Alicia Brandet, Gildo Tognazzi, Gigi Ballista, Marco Ferreri, Alessandro Quasimodo
description: The industrialist Giuseppe Inzerna is afflicted with a hissing in the respiratory tract. Nothing pathological, just a trivial annoyance. Finding himself on business in a luxurious private clinic, he is persuaded to be admitted to eliminate the inconvenience. Following analyzes and examinations, however, other ailments are found, the treatments of which make his health worse and worse. Inzerna's conditions thus worsen more and more until the victim ends up in the terminally ill ward. Second direction by Tognazzi. Based on a famous story by Buzzati, it is a black satire of medical malpractice, sometimes sketchy, but pungent.

title: Fitzcarraldo
actors: Klaus Kinski, Claudia Cardinale, José Lewgoy, Miguel Angel Fuentes, Paul Hittscher, Huerequeque Enrique Bohorquez, Grande Otelo, Peter Berling, David Pérez Espinosa, Milton Nascimento
description: The passion of adventurer Brian Sweeny Fitzgerald (Kinski), known by the name of Fitzcarraldo, is opera. His fixed idea is to build an opera house in Iquitos, where he lives, in the heart of the Amazon rainforest. In order to succeed in his intent he agrees to lead an expedition aboard a boat to a very rich area of ??rubber trees that he intends to exploit, and tries desperate undertakings to transport a ship across the mountains. Three years of filming, billions invested personally by the director, accusations of exploitation of the Indians and risks experienced firsthand. Caruso's voice echoing in the Amazon jungle gives chills; Kinski's interpretation, masterful. Certainly one of the best things about Herzog.

title: Il fiume del grande caimano
actors: Barbara Bach, Claudio Cassinelli, Mel Ferrer, Richard Johnson, Romano Puppo, Fabrizia Castagnoli, Silvia Collatina, Enzo Fisichella, Lory Del Santo, Anny Papa, Bobby Rhodes, Clara Colosimo
description: The director of a holiday village in the tropics is organizing the inauguration of the hotel complex. But the natives are restless: they believe that the settlement of the whites could cause the awakening of an ancient curse. Some tourists disappear but, fearing negative publicity, the fact is hushed up. Together with a photographer, the director discovers that the area is haunted by a huge caiman, revered by the natives as a cruel deity. Together, the two will manage to defeat him. Adventure film focusing on the charm of Barbara Bach and on slightly grungy special effects.

title: The River
actors: Mel Gibson, Sissy Spacek, Scott Glenn, Shane Bailey, Becky Jo Lynch, Don Hood, Billy Green Bush, James Tolkan
description: Tom Garvey with his wife Mae loves the land that belonged to his fathers and works it despite all adversities. Neither the capitalist Wade, who is in love with Mae, with his purchase offers, nor disastrous weather calamities will make him give up.
notes: A rural epic in the small Reagan tradition of the 1980s ("The seasons of the heart"). Predictable and long, with a stunning photograph by Vilmos Zsigmond.

title: River of Death
country: United States, Great Britain, South Africa, Israel
actors: Michael Dudikoff, Robert Vaughn, Donald Pleasence, Herbert Lom, L.Q. Jones, Sarah Maur Thorp, Cynthia Erland, Foziah Davidson
description: An adventurer is on the trail of a girl ...

title: Red River
actors: James Arness, Bruce Boxleitner, Ty Hardin, Guy Madison, Ray Walston, Gregory Harrison, Stan Shaw, Robert Horton, John Lupton, Laura Johnson
description: A group of cowboys have to carry a large herd across the United States. Work puts a strain on men's nerves. The most dangerous friction is that between the herd leader and the younger cowboy. At first, the boy willingly accepts the protection of the most experienced colleague, but eventually he begins to argue more and more fiercely.
notes: The 1948 version, starring John Wayne and Montgomery Clift, was considered an "adult" western. In this remake for TV, psychology is the cornerstone around which the action revolves. But don't even think about making the comparison.

title: The Flamingo Kid
actors: Matt Dillon, Hector Elizondo, Molly McCarthy, Martha Gehman, Richard Crenna, Jessica Walter, Carole Davis, Janet Jones, Fisher Stevens, Joe Grifasi, Brian McNamara
description: While waiting to enroll in college, Joffrey finds a job as a valet parking at the Flamingo Club. The owner's vain chatter and the physique of his blonde niece seem to convince the boy that college isn't everything in life after all. But then Joffrey opens his eyes to reality and, after taking his revenge on the dishonest employer, returns to his family and school. The director of "Pretty Woman" proposes another simple simple tale. Same optimism and a greater dose of sound principles. Dillon does well as a good guy.

title: Flash Gordon
actors: Sam J. Jones, Max Von Sydow, Ornella Muti, Mariangela Melato, Melody Anderson, Topol, Timothy Dalton, Brian Blessed, Peter Wyngarde, John Osborne
description: Dr. Zarro, a NASA scientist, realizes that the moon is progressively moving from its axis of rotation. He suspects that the author of this disaster is the evil Ming, emperor of the planet Mongo. For this Zarro goes to Mongo being accompanied by Flash Gordon and his girlfriend Dale Arden.
notes: The figure of Flash Gordon, a comic book hero born in the 1930s from the pen of the designer Alex Raymond, has always inspired the world of cinema that brought him to the screen in some serials with Buster Crabbe. This is a pyrotechnic version, with rich special effects and an all-star cast, strongly desired by producer De Laurentiis, with moments of quite amusing voluntary kitsch and with the music of Queen.

title: Flashback
actors: Kiefer Sutherland, Dennis Hopper, Carol Kane, Paul Dooley, Cliff De Young, Richard Masur, Michael McKean, Kathleen York, Tom O'Brien
description: In today's United States, a young federal agent is tasked with arresting a mature man. The wanted man is on the list of dangerous elements only because in the sixties, during the golden age of the protest, he had made fun of a powerful politician; the FBI agent can't help but question his work.
notes: Franco Amurri conducts an operina oozing progressiveness and sentiments. It is his first American film after the success of "Da grande" (1987).

title: Flashdance
actors: Jennifer Beals, Michael Nouri, Belinda Bauer, Lilia Skala, Sunny Johnson, Kyle T. Heffner, Lee Ving, Ron Karabatsos, Malcolm Danare, Micole Mercurio, Cynthia Rhodes
description: Alex, a nineteen-year-old metal worker from Pittsburgh, cultivates an intense passion for dance. To supplement her salary, she performs flash dance numbers in a nightclub, but her dream is to be admitted to the local academy and become a professional dancer. He will succeed, thanks also to his young employer, despite his own insecurities and humble social condition.
notes: Jennifer Beals / Alex, fragile and determined, ambitious but sensitive, is an emblem of the optimism of the early 1980s. In the long run, however, the story is syrupy, without the slightest irony. Oscar to the title song sung by Irene Cara and written by Giorgio Moroder and Keith Forsey.

title: La flûte à six schtroumpfs
description: A bandit steals a magic flute from the Smurfs that has the ability to relentlessly push anyone who listens to it to dance. Cartoon version of the puppets created by the Dutch designer Peyo. Pleasant and well done, it was also broadcast as a pilot of a TV series.

title: Trollflöjten
actors: Ulrik Cold, Josef Köstlinger, Birgit Nordin, Håkan Hagegård, Irma Urrila, Ulf Johansson, Gösta Prüzelius
description: Prince Tamino must free Princess Pamina from the evil Queen of the Night. Papageno, the forest fairies and, above all, a magic flute help him. After all sorts of adventures and misadventures, the two lovers can crown their dream of love: light has triumphed over darkness.The magic flute is certainly one of the most loved works by Mozartians. Bergman was fascinated by him from the age of twelve: his is therefore a tribute to himself as well as to Mozart. Movie theater and melodrama, with portraits behind the scenes to act as ironic and alienating curtains to make the game of cinema astonishing. The edition is sung in the Swedish translation.

title: Flic story
actors: Alain Delon, Jean-Louis Trintignant, Renato Salvatori, Claudine Auger, Henri Guybert, Michael Lonsdale, André Pousse
description: In France in the late 1940s, Inspector Borniche (Delon) is famous for the obstinacy of a mastiff with which he faces his inquiries. So when the dangerous criminal Emile Buisson (Trintignant) escapes, he is entrusted with the task of tracking him down. At the end of a week Borniche discovers Buisson's refuge, but the latter has already committed three murders and has already disappeared. However, Borniche does not give up even when the case is taken away from him.
notes: With the long-distance confrontation between Alain Delon and Jean-Louis Trintignant and the skilful direction of Jacque Deray, the film stands on its own.

title: My Friend Flicka
actors: Roddy McDowall, Preston Foster, Rita Johnson, Diana Hale, James Bell, Jeff Corey
description: A horse breeder who lives on a farm on the edge of the forest near a large lake gives his teenage son a freaky filly in order to have her tamed. The boy will learn that it is necessary to sacrifice and commit oneself fully for the good of those entrusted to us. The plot is very tenuous, although the filly is now dispersed, now "mad" and now infirm. The risk, not always avoided, is therefore that of a certain monotony. The way in which the educational "message" inherent in the film is offered is quite naïve, but the shots of the natural environment are technically very valuable and very fascinating. Detail for the dog Lassie.

title: Get Crazy
actors: Malcolm McDowell, Allen Goorwitz, Lou Reed, Daniel Stern, Gail Edwards, Miles Chapin, Ed Begley jr., Bill Henderson, Stacey Nelkin, Lee Ving
description: A bizarre and crazy group of young people try, against everything and everyone, to organize a great rock concert for the night of the New Year. A criminal gang instead tries to boycott the event by putting their hands with deception and violence on the theater where the concert is to take place. Allan Arkush makes one of the most unique films in the history of cinema.

title: Flipper's New Adventure
actors: Luke Halpin, Pamela Franklin, Helen Cherry, Tom Helmore, Francesca Annis, Brian Kelly, Joe Higgins, Lloyd Battista, Robert Baldwin
description: The young Sandy Ricks has an inseparable friend: the Flipper Delfino. To prevent the intelligent animal from being locked up in an aquarium, Sandy escapes with him at sea and arrives on a desert island. Everything seems solved: nobody will look for them there. On the island they are not alone: ​​here in fact three ferocious pirates live here. By pretending to be shipwrecked, they combine a yacht, take the owner hostage and abandon his wife and two daughters on the island. Sandy and Flipper, however, do not intend to make him pass smoothly.
notes: Pure pretext in Disney -style (but the film is MGM) to show the aquatic acrobatics of the teaching dolphin. It is the sequel to "My Delfino friend".

title: Florida Straits
actors: Raul Julia, Fred Ward, Daniel Jenkins, Victor Argo, Jaime Sanchez, Ilka Tanya Payan, Antonio Fargas, Jesse Corti
description: A trio of adventurers face the dangers of the Cuban jungle, hurricanes, outlaws, ambushes and machine guns to get their hands on a gold fortune buried by one of them: a Cuban nationalist just released after more than twenty years of jail. Directed and performed by good professionals, the film remains a lively and enjoyable TV-movie.

title: The Fog
actors: Adrienne Barbeau, Jamie Lee Curtis, John Houseman, Hal Holbrook, Janet Leigh, Tom Atkins, James Canning, Charles Cyphers, Nancy Loomis, Ty Mitchell, Regina Waldon
description: Antonio Bay, on the Pacific. The city is celebrating, the anniversary of the foundation is approaching. The ancestors of the inhabitants of the town, however, were guilty of an impious crime: they let a sailing ship crash on the rocks to rob it of its treasures. The ghosts of those ancient sailors now return transported by the fog. It will be a massacre.
notes: Grande Carpenter: a horror made of ghostly atmospheres that reflects clearly on the loss of innocence of a community born on the ruins of sin. The Puritan pilgrim fathers of America do not sleep soundly but the cinema in these parts rejoices.

title: One Crazy Summer
actors: Demi Moore, John Cusack, Joel Murray, Curtis Armstrong, Bobcat Goldthwait, Tom Villard, John Matuszak, Jeremy Piven, Joe Flaherty, Billie Bird, Kimberly Foster
description: Hoops McCann (John Cusack) is an artist who, for his art school, is trying to put together a comic love story. The only particular is that he is still too young to know love. Then, during a vacation on the island of Nantucket, in New England, on the Atlantic coast of the United States, Hoops meets a certain Cassandra (Demi Moore). The girl is full of problems, but you can't really say ugly. A film that, despite the presence of the young Moore, is just as stupid as it seems: comic mechanisms closer to cartoon than sophisticated comedy and a very distracted script.

title: Riders of the Storm
actors: Dennis Hopper, Michael J. Pollard, Eugene Lipinski, James Aubrey, Al Matthews, William Armstrong, Michael Ho, Scott Hoxby, Nigel Pegram
description: Flying in an old B-29, a group of Vietnam veteran anarchists sabotages the "American way" culture by broadcasting pirate TV broadcasts. Cult film with Dennis Hopper.

title: The Nutty Professor
actors: Jerry Lewis, Stella Stevens, Kathleen Freeman, Del Moore, Med Flory, Norman Alden, Howard Morris, Elvia Allman, Milton Frome, Buddy Lester
description: Julius Kelp is a shy professor and scientist, unattractive and the subject of constant derision from his students. With a preparation of his own invention he turns into Buddy Love, a flashy play boy who attracts the attention of Stella, the prettiest of the university students, who also sympathizes with the professor ...
notes: Lewis isn't just a great comedian. Behind the camera he proves to be a shrewd director full of ideas. In this personal reinterpretation of "Doctor Jekyll and Mr. Hyde" he puts the American ideal of masculine beauty to shame as rarely seen on the big screen.

title: Rage in Heaven
actors: Robert Montgomery, Ingrid Bergman, George Sanders, Lucile Watson, Oskar Homolka, Philip Merivale, Matthew Boulton, Aubrey Mather, Frederick Worlock, Francis Compton
description: Unstable-minded millionaire escapes from the clinic where he is hospitalized, falls in love and gets married. But his illness manifests itself in morbid jealousy. Convinced that his wife is cheating on him, he kills himself in order to place a murderous responsibility on his rival. Usually concrete and active director, W.S. Van Dyke (The Shadow Man), here two years before the disappearance, does not appear at his best in a banal suspense drama that was also written by Christopher Isherwood.

title: Bluebeard
actors: John Carradine, Jean Parker, Nils Asther, Ludwig Stössel, George Pembroke, Teala Loring, Sonia Sorel, Henry Kolker, Emmett Lynn, Iris Adrian
description: Gaston Morel (Carradine) is now a puppeteer, but was once a successful painter. One evening he meets Lucille, a milliner, and falls in love with her, but it soon becomes clear that something is wrong with her head. And then the story of his first model comes out, when he was still a painter. And how she had let him down and he had killed her out of desperation. That had been Morel's first murder, but not the last. Ulmer, former assistant of Muranu, recovers expressionist and romantic atmospheres. What he manages to do in just six days of shooting, with a laughable budget and with a story he has already seen so many times, is miraculous.

title: Midnight Madness
actors: David Naughton, Debra Clinger, Michael J. Fox, Joel Kenney, David Damas, Stephen Furst, Patricia Alice Albrecht, Andy Tennant, Brian Frishman, Sal Lopez, Maggie Roswell
description: In an adventurous nocturnal treasure hunt the students of a Los Angeles college face off, divided into various teams that each represent a specific category: sportsmen, girls, "nerds", daddy's children ... the college psychologist, who also finds a way to take advantage of the circumstance to happily solve his love problems.
notes: Michael J. Fox's poor film debut in a coarse juvenile farce.

title: Swing Time
actors: Fred Astaire, Ginger Rogers, Victor Moore, Eric Blore, Helen Broderick, Betty Furness, Georges Metaxa
description: Lucky leaves for New York, promising his fiancée that he will return when she has collected twenty-five thousand dollars. The young man, good and lucky, soon becomes a Broadway star; there he falls in love with Penelope, his partner in dance, also betrothed (with an orchestra conductor).
notes: The little story, gracefully directed by Strevens, doesn't really matter; the extraordinary show of the couple Fred and Ginger counts: unforgettable duets and splendid songs by Jerome Kern and Dorothy Fields, including "A Fine Romance" and "The Way You Look Tonight", awarded with the Oscar.

title: Follie del secolo
actors: Armando Falconi, Paola Barbara, Sergio Tofano, Otello Toso, Olga Vittoria Gentilli, Dina Sassoli, Carlo Romano, Clelia Matania
description: A mature but irresistible Don Juan takes on the role of Casanova again, but not by choice. In fact, he must save the marriage of his son, who fell in love with a singer, Violette de Lys. Frivolous comedy by the prolific screenwriter Alessandro De Stefani, directed however with brio by one of our best professionals of the Fascist period.

title: There's no Business Like Show Business
actors: Marilyn Monroe, Ethel Merman, Donald O'Connor, Dan Dailey, Johnnie Ray, Mitzi Gaynor, Richard Eastham, Hugh O'Brian, Frank McHugh, Rhys Williams, Lee Patrick
description: Terence and Molly Donahues have always formed a well-matched couple, both on stage and in life. Their children, growing up, followed in his footsteps. But one day one of them, Steve, becomes a priest; and the other, Tim, in love with a beautiful dancer, Vicky, follows her together with his sister Katy to tread the scenes in a big magazine.
notes: A quality and luxury production that lacks nothing, even if some heaviness emerges. The original title is the same as a famous song by Irving Berlin, written for a musical of 46, transposed for the screen in _Anna take the rifle_ in 1950. Ethel Merman sings it in the film but the interpretation that Marilyn gives of it is also memorable. _Heat Wave_.

title: Second Chorus
actors: Fred Astaire, Burgess Meredith, Paulette Goddard, Artie Shaw, Charles Butterworth, Frank Melton, Jimmy Conlin, Don Brodie
description: Two students, aspiring trumpet players, find a girl as a manager and hit Broadway. Astaire was 42 and Meredith 32, apart from that the musical is enjoyable.

title: Follie per l'opera
actors: Aroldo Tieri, Gina Lollobrigida, Constance Dowling, Carlo Campanini, Gino Bechi, Maria Caniglia, Tito Gobbi, Aldo Silvani, Luigi Almirante
description: The pastor of a church destroyed by a bombing turns to Gino, a journalist with imagination and enthusiasm, for ideas on how to finance its reconstruction. Gino thinks of a concert in which the great names of opera music will participate. However, he does not reckon with Margaret, Covent Garden secretary who is in love with him, who first helps him with enthusiasm, then, when he discovers that he is engaged to Dora, puts a spoke in his wheel. But the concert will take place anyway and it will be a triumph.
notes: It is a film based on the formula of the American film-magazine, with the difference that the musical numbers are of lyric and ballet (there are the corps de ballet della Scala, Tito Gobbi, Beniamino Gigli, Gino Bechi etc.). Rather enjoyable.

title: The Fountainhead
actors: Gary Cooper, Patricia Neal, Raymond Massey, Kent Smith, Robert Douglas, Henry Hull, Ray Collins, Moroni Olsen, Jerome Cowan
description: Howard Roark is an architect with futuristic ideas but so alien to compromise that he is unable to obtain orders from clients who would like to entrust him with traditional works. To survive he must therefore adapt to manual labor. A figurehead allows him to return to architecture, but there is a new and more violent clash with entrepreneurs who have imposed changes that are not consistent with his ideas. Only in the end Roark manages to make his beliefs prevail by finding, moreover, a soul mate.
notes: An emblematic film of the "American dream" and its indefinite realization. It should be noted, in the stylistic choices, a certain reference to the great film schools: the Russian formalists and the German expressionists.

title: Sinful Davey
actors: John Hurt, Pamela Franklin, Nigel Davenport, Robert Morley, Fidelma Murphy, Maxine Audley, Fionnula Flanagan, Donal McCann, Allan Cuthbertson, Eddie Byrne
description: David Haggart's father had been one of Scotland's most famous bandits, who was hanged from the gallows. The son would like to follow in his father's footsteps, making a coup in the house of a rich nobleman; but the beautiful Annie, who has always been in love with him, wants to prevent it. Several times it is she who returns the loot to the robbed to avoid David being hanged; but when the bandit is caught the court shows itself inflexible. The day the sentence is to be carried out Annie ...
notes: John Huston's sure hand makes for a fun adventure full of twists, even if the film wasn't too successful.

title: The Emerald Forest
actors: Powers Boothe, Meg Foster, Charley Boorman, Dira Paes, Yara Vaneau, William Rodriguez, Estee Chandler, Eduardo Conde, Ariel Coelho
description: Bill Markham has been looking for his son Tommy for ten years, who was kidnapped by a tribe of Indians when he was the manager of a shipyard on the Amazon River. She finds him again but the latter, grown up in the tribe and now an adult, is about to get married and does not want to go home; on the contrary, it involves his father in a bloody war against the "Ferocious" people and in the clash with speculating adventurers.
notes: Always interested in the clash between modernity and archaic cultures, this time Boorman combines it with the ecological theme, also involving his son (he is the young white man adopted by the Indians). Remarkable direction, highly spectacular.

title: The Petrified Forest
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Leslie Howard, Bette Davis, Dirk Foran, Genevieve Tobin, Joe Sawyer, Porter Hall, Charley Grapewin, Paul Harvey, Eddie Acuff
description: Alan Squier, a passing writer, and Duke Mantee, a runaway gangster, meet at a gas station in the Arizona desert. Alan, disgusted by a world that has no room for art, asks Duke to kill him. Almost a work of charity, given that the writer has just signed an insurance policy in favor of the waitress, with whom he has fallen in love, who wants to go to study in Paris.

title: Il fornaretto di Venezia
actors: Jacques Perrin, Michèle Morgan, Enrico Maria Salerno, Sylva Koscina, Stefania Sandrelli, Gastone Moschin, Fred Williams, Ugo Attanasio, Rodolfo Lodi, Mario Brega
description: A Venetian nobleman, Count Alvise, was killed and the culprit is pointed to a young baker. The trial takes on more and more political character: as the hearing proceeds, in fact, the innocence of the young man appears evident, but the nobles who make up the court will condemn him for ruthless political calculation. Not even the confession of the real murderer, a noble, will help save the unfortunate young man.
notes: Political reworking of a costume drama by Francesco dall'Ongaro. Tessari's direction is agile but the film is a partly wasted opportunity.

title: La fornarina
actors: Lida Baarova, Walter Lazzaro, Anneliese Uhlig, Luigi Pavese, Loredana, Amilcare Pettinelli, Ugo Sasso, Giorgio Costantini, Vinicio Sofia, Cesare Fantoni
description: In Renaissance Rome a young commoner modeled the famous painter Raffaello Sanzio for several paintings with sacred subjects and ended up becoming his lover. A powerful noblewoman, jealous of their relationship, has the girl kidnapped, thus arousing the desperation of Raphael who does not rest until he can find her.
notes: On this simple track, the film embodies an artificially complicated intrigue along the lines of the French feuilleton. There is a certain care in the scenography, and a couple of (partial) female nudes that caused a scandal at the time.

title: Fort Massacre
actors: Joel McCrea, Forrest Tucker, Susan Cabot, John Russell, George N. Neise, Anthony Caruso, Robert Osterloh, Denver Pyle, Francis McDonald, Guy Prescott, Rayford Barnes
description: The few survivors of a battalion attacked by the Apaches take refuge in Fort Crain under the leadership of the only non-commissioned officer left alive, Sergeant Vinson (Joel McCrea). But there is a problem: Vinson's family has been exterminated by the Indians and this makes the sergeant unnecessarily angry and vengeful against the Apaches. Before he can do any more damage, one of his soldiers kills him. Western directed by one of the masters of the B-movie. Nothing special, but (unsurprisingly) some tight action sequences.

title: Opportunity Knocks
actors: Dana Carvey, Robert Loggia, Todd Graf, Julia Campbell, Milo O'Shea, James Tolkan, Doris Belack, Sally Gracie, Mike Bacarella, Del Close
description: A likeable professional swindler (Dana Carvey), on the run from an attacker who wants to kill him, changes his identity; a sanitation magnate (Robert Loggia) believes him to be a financial genius and pushes him to woo his daughter (Julia Campbell). For the scammer, what could be the blow that fixes him for life is thus looming. The matter, however, apparently very simple, is fraught with complications.
notes: Dana Carvey is one of the many comedians launched by the television show "Saturday Night Live" which had a big success in the cinema with "Fusi di testa" by Penelope Spheeris.

title: Outrageous Fortune
actors: Shelley Long, Bette Midler, Peter Coyote, Robert Prosky, John Schuck, George Carlin, Anthony Heald, Ji-Tu Cumbuka, Florence Stanley
description: Sandy Brozinsky is a nice and tongue-in-cheek starlet (she comes from the murky world of porn) who enrolls in an acting school run by an unlikely Russian master (actually a KGB spy). Lauren Ames attends the same school, all swooning and pallor: between the two women it is antipathy at first sight that turns into hatred when they discover they love the same man: they will become very friendly. Heir to the Jack Lemmon and Walter "buddy-buddy" genre Matthau, the film aligns a series of irresistible gags that gradually hit the world of espionage and entertainment with the overflowing vitality of Bette Midler.

title: La fortuna viene dal cielo
actors: Anna Magnani, Vera Carmi, Roberto Villa, Sandro Ruffini, Franco Coop, Guglielmo Sinaz, Romolo Costa, Giulio Battiferri, Claudio Ermelli
description: A thief steals a very precious jewel from the young and pretty Anna Illes, girlfriend of the lawyer Pap. Hunted by the police, he gets rid of the stolen goods, leaving the jewel on the table of a prostitute (Zizì) with financial problems. She thinks it's a gift from heaven and she doesn't take long to show it around. Zizì's behavior naturally creates a series of misunderstandings in which the lawyer and his girlfriend fall first, even reaching a sentimental crisis. However, new loves also arise until everything falls into the initial order.
notes: Typical example of the so-called "Hungarian comedies" of regime cinema, less aristocratic equivalents than those of "white telephones".

title: Invasion Force
actors: Renee Cline, Walter Cox, Richard Lynch, Douglas Harter, Charles Stedman, Graham Timbes, David Marriott, Steve Bullack
description: Actors and technicians of a war film shot in Richmond bravely transition from fiction to reality, confronting a small army of terrorists determined to blackmail the White House by taking the entire city hostage. David A. Prior has directed more than one extravagant B movie like this one, which is actually more original in subject than in staging. Released only on tape and on TV.

title: Stand and Deliver
actors: Edward James Olmos, Andy Garcia, Lou Diamond Philips, Richard Martinez, Rosanna DeSoto, Bodie Olmos, Carmen Argenziano, Will Gotay
description: Jaime Escalante teaches computer science at the Garfield Institute, the most infamous school in Los Angeles. Little by little he wins the trust of rebellious and distracted students and pushes them to face a very difficult test reserved for the best students in America. Willing, obvious, traditional.

title: Forza G
actors: Riccardo Salvino, Pino Colizzi, Dori Ghezzi, Magda Konopka, Mico Cundari, Giancarlo Prete, Ernesto Colli, Esmeralda Ruspoli, Anita Strindberg, Barbara Bouchet
description: Gianni Orlando had only one dream since he was a child: to become a pilot of the Italian aviation aerobatic team. He manages to enter the team as a reserve and his superiors, while appreciating his resourcefulness, do not consider him yet mature to participate in the main performances. During an important confrontation with the British air force, Gianni manages to convince his colleagues to execute the figures he has studied, leading them to victory. Tessari abandons adventure films for an American imitation military comedy. Not his kind: the story is stretched and the rhetoric is unbearable. Small role for Dori Ghezzi.

title: The Power
actors: George Hamilton, Suzanne Pleshette, Richard Carlson, Yvonne De Carlo, Earl Holliman, Gary Merrill, Ken Murray, Barbara Nichols, Arthur O'Connell, Nehemiah Persoff, Aldo Ray, Michael Rennie
description: In a space research center there is someone who cares more about the conquest of power than the fate of science. He thus begins to mysteriously decimate the team of scholars working at the center. Professor Jim Tanner must thus improvise detective to try to find the culprit also because he is himself the subject of numerous attacks. It's about finding out who is acting in the shadows before they complete the job.
notes: Discreet blend of mystery and science fiction, a little behind the times.

title: Forza Italia!
description: The story is well known to all Italians: it is the thirty years of Christian Democratic leadership, from the eve of the elections of '48 to '77, told through documentaries, interviews, testimonies. The protagonists are characters of the caliber of Moro, Leone, Andreotti, and their entire court. With an ironic montage, Faenza underlines the alternation in power of the same people, with the same modalities, purposes, fraud and various deceptions, and invites us to reflect on the misdeeds of the Christian Democrats in power. A document in which the seriousness of the topic is accompanied by a good dose of critical humor.

title: Force of Evil
actors: John Garfield, Beatrice Pearson, Thomas Gomez, Marie Windsor, Howland Chamberlain, Roy Roberts, Paul Fix, Stanley Prager, Barry Kelley, Paul McVey
description: A brilliant young lawyer gets hired by a shady financier who runs a clandestine lottery. He accepts the assignment solely to avenge the death of his older brother who ran one of these outlawed dealerships and banks. And he will avenge him, killing the two bandits, including the boss, in a duel. Then he will go to jail, but his sweetheart will wait for him to lead him on the right path.

title: Make Haste to Live
actors: Dorothy McGuire, Stephen McNally, Mary Murphy, Edgar Buchanan, John Howard, Ron Hagerthy, Pepe Hern, Eddy Waller, Carolyn Jones
description: A little good was convicted for the murder of his wife. In reality the woman is alive and has devised a staging to get rid of him. After 18 years in prison, the man finds his wife, settles in with her and begins to harass her, preparing a terrible revenge. Despite some narrative leaps, it is a well-paced, dark and effective thriller. Last film by William Seiter, already an excellent director of comedians such as Laurel and Hardy and the Marx Brothers.

title: Le foto di Gioia
actors: Serena Grandi, Capucine, Daria Nicolodi, Sabrina Salerno, Vanni Corbellini, David Brandon, George Eastman, Trine Michelsen, Karl Zinny, Lino Salemme
description: In the villa of Gioia, owner of a magazine for men only, a model is murdered, witness a paralyzed boy who lives in the adjacent house. The first murder is followed by others, accompanied by photographic messages and threats against Gioia. The police suspect Flora, the owner of a competing magazine, but the reality is quite different and it will be the paralytic neighbor who will resolve the situation at the last minute.
notes: One of the worst films by Lamberto Bava. The soft-porn (otherwise chaste) climate and bad acting contribute to the disaster.

title: Fotoromanzo
actors: Nino D'Angelo, Maria Chiara Sasso, Gabriele Villa, Cinzia De Ponti, Bruna Feirri, Pietro Tordi, Lucio Montanaro, Nuccia Fumo, Sofia Lombardo, Annamaria Petrini
description: Nino, the son of a Neapolitan concierge, also writes lyrics for songs. He is in love with the daughter of a carabinieri officer and follows her to Milan. Here, despite a modest job, he must ask for help from a girl who loves him. Then the "father-in-law" finds him in attitudes a little too tender with his daughter, and the daughter, in turn, discovers him in these similar circumstances with another. She will have an accident, and a blood donation from Nino will save her: reconsolidated love.
notes: Nino D'Angelo still not cleared through customs in one of his bad films which made him a "macro-regional" success in many regions of the South.

title: Fra' Diavolo
actors: Enzo Fiermonte, Laura Nucci, Elsa De Giorgi, Carlo Romano, Cesare Bettarini, Agostino Salvietti, Loris Gizzi, Marcello Giorda, Renato Chiantoni
description: A fictionalized version of the life and deeds of the bandit Michele Pezza, famous in the Kingdom of Naples as Fra 'Diavolo, who here becomes an adventurous patriot due to propaganda obligations.

title: Fracchia contro Dracula
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Edmund Purdom, Gigi Reder, Ania Pieroni, Giuseppe Cederna, Federica Brion, Susanna Martinkova, Andrea Gnecco, Filippo De Gara, Paul Muller, Isabella Ferrari
description: Threatened with dismissal from the real estate agent he works for, Fracchia has one last chance of redemption: to sell a castle in Transylvania. Find a buyer whom he makes believe that the manor rises near Rome. Arriving at their destination they find Dracula with his sister. She would like to marry Fracchia, who does not have the courage to oppose; the victim is saved by a girl who hates the vampire because he killed her boyfriend.
notes: Parody of Dracula movies with Village more measured than usual, unusual professionalism of the packaging (photography by Luciano Tovoli, music by Bruno Zambrini) and the old actor of "Sinuhe the Egyptian" in the part of the vampire. No great gimmicks, however.

title: Fracchia la belva umana
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Lino Banfi, Anna Mazzamauro, Francesco Salvi, Sandro Ghiani, Antonio Allocca, Jole Silvani, Massimo Boldi, Gigi Reder, Gianni Agus
description: Giandomenico Fracchia, surveyor, is the double of a very dangerous criminal called "The human beast". To circulate freely, Fracchia receives a pass, but the criminal attacks him and steals it from him. From this moment on, the misunderstandings and the most absurd situations follow one another, to arrive at a grotesque ending in the afterlife.
notes: Sloppy and shabby, the film, however, has some moments of great fun that make it one of the best of the period: Reder who is the Sicilian mother, the gang of losers with psychopathic Francesco Salvi. The plot, redone a hundred times, is that of the old "All the city speaks of it" by Ford with E. G. Robinson.

title: Dead Silence
actors: Renée Estevez, Lisanne Falk, Carrie Mitchum, Steven Brill, Claudette Nevins, Tim Russ, Beau Starr, Bryan Cranston, Steven M. Gagnon, Al Ruscio
description: Zanna, Joan and Sunnie are college friends. In the holiday period, which is between two course sessions, they go on a trip to the desert. However, the period of relaxation turns into a nightmare. In fact, Sunnie, drunk, overwhelms a stranger with the car and kills him. After abandoning the body, the three women leave, but the fact will not be without consequences.
notes: The idea is not brand new, but it would not be bad either for the potential it presents; the three protagonists also show some merit. On the other hand, very painful notes regarding the direction, which manages to trivialize the subject and contribution of the performers.

title: Frances
actors: Jessica Lange, Sam Shepard, Kim Stanley, Bart Burns, Anjelica Huston, Rod Colbin, Christopher Pennock, James Karen, Gerald S. O'Loughlin, Sarah Cunningham, Allan Rich
description: Frances Farmer is, in the Thirties, a nonconformist girl who reveals promising skills as a theatrical actress. Ambitious and intelligent, she leaves the middle-class province and makes a name for herself in Clifford Odets' Group Theater. Hollywood also notices her, especially her physical appearance. The film industry's attempt is to make Frances a sex symbol. But his unconventionality is a risk for the studios.
notes: Reconstruction of the existence of a victim of the cinema show business. A lot of commitment and a suspicion of hagiography, but above all a wonderful performance by Jessica Lange.

title: Francesco, giullare di Dio
actors: Aldo Fabrizi, Peparuolo, Severino Pisacane, Roberto Sorrentino
description: Before giving instructions to his disciples to bring the word of God into the world, Francis of Assisi lives with them in community. Various episodes, reported in the "Fioretti", illustrate the lifestyle of the saint and the order he founded: the praise of Frate Fuoco, the kiss to the leper, the charity of Friar Ginepro.
notes: Having abandoned the themes of neorealism that had made him famous, Rossellini devotes himself to his great passion for the marvelous: faith, filtered by his poetics, becomes man's tool to face the world with a pure gaze. After the years of Neoralism, Rossellini consistently pursues his path in a work of sublime narrative simplicity and great spiritual intensity.

title: Francis Goes to West Point
actors: Donald O'Connor, Lori Nelson, Alice Kelley, Gregg Palmer, William Reynolds, Les Tremayne, Otto Hulett, David Janssen, James Best
description: Third chapter of the exploits of the talking mule. First he saves an atomic plant from an attack, then, admitted as a mascot to the West Point Academy where his friend Peter Sterling joined, he helps him in his studies and, when Peter risks being hunted down to help a colleague, once again he settles things at their best. Unassuming comedy, harmless and naive, but, all in all, not evil. Donald O'Connor continues to have the right face for his candid role.

title: Francis Goes to the Races
actors: Donald O'Connor, Piper Laurie, Cecil Kellaway, Jesse White, Barry Kelley, Hayden Rorke, Vaughn Taylor, Larry Keating
description: Peter meets a retired colonel who owns a stable. He is in dire straits and Peter, who is also charmed by his daughter, wants to help him. Enter Francis, the talking mule who suggests to Peter the results of the races making him win a large sum.

title: Francis Covers the Big Town
actors: Donald O'Connor, Yvette Duguay, Nancy Guild, Gene Lockhart, William Harrigan, Silvio Minciotti, Lowell Gilmore, Larry Gates, Hanley Stafford
description: Francis' owner, the mule gifted with human intelligence and who can speak, has been hired as a delivery boy for a New York newspaper. But his ambition is to become a journalist: and he succeeds thanks to the precious services of Francis, who listens to confidential dialogues in the most disparate places and reports them to the boss. During an investigation into a mafia boss, he is mysteriously killed: it is once again Francis who brings the real culprit to justice. Fourth episode of the series, identical to the previous ones.

title: Francis
actors: Donald O'Connor, Patricia Medina, Zasu Pitts, Ray Collins, John McIntire, Eduard Franz, Howland Chamberlain, James Todd, Robert Warwick
description: During the war in the Far East, young Lieutenant Peter (O'Connor) meets a mule who talks and becomes friends with. Together, they have extraordinary adventures. The soldier-mule duo gave rise to a successful series, of which this is the first chapter.

title: Francisca
actors: Teresa Menezes, Diogo Dória, Mário Barroso, Glória De Matos, Isabel de Castro, Lia Gama, Laura Soveral, José Wallenstein
description: In the mid-nineteenth century, José Augusto, a young and rich Portuguese whom the family hinders in his love for Francisca, kidnaps his beloved. He respects her, but his passion fades as the wedding approaches and finally he marries her only in deference to convenience. The master of Portuguese cinema Manoel de Oliveira makes a splendid film about the madness of love, inspired by an epidose of the life of the writer Camilo Castelo Branco. Stylized and icy, with the actors talking at length in the car, a hypnotic film of restrained passion.

title: Franco, Ciccio e il pirata Barbanera
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Mimmo Palmara, Adriana Facchetti, Fernando Sancho, Pietro Tordi, Rosita Torosh, Umberto D'Orsi, Enzo Andronico, Andrea Scotti, Nino Terzo
description: The old corsair John recognizes Franco as the son he has lost track of. He entrusts him with the map of a hidden treasure that also tempts his enemy Blackbeard. Franco, together with the false captain Ciccio, organizes an expedition to find the treasure, but unknowingly hires Blackbeard himself.
notes: Troubles, various dangers, and a happy ending with the two "heroes" safe and rich. Parody of the "Treasure Island", poor in imagination and entrusted solely to some jokes of the two comedians.

title: Franco, Ciccio e le vedove allegre
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Raimondo Vianello, Adriana Facchetti, Rossella Como, Dominique Boschero, Nino Taranto, Enzo Andronico, Margaret Lee, Lucio Dalla
description: Film in three episodes: in "Our Lady" a sailor believed to be dead, returns and shares with his new partner his wife who, in the meantime, has married again. In "A Poor Widow" to get an inheritance a widow must have a child, and she seduces five young men by trying them in turns. In "Grandfather's Widow" her husband dies, a young grandmother meets her grandson and falls in love with him, but he prefers the great-grandmother.
notes: Less than mediocre episodic movie. Despite the title, Franco and Ciccio act only in the first episode. In the last one, Lucio Dalla also appears.

title: Franco e Ciccio sul sentiero di guerra
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Stelvio Rosi, Lino Banfi, Renato Baldini, Adler Gray, Turam Quibo, Alfredo Rizzo, Gianni Solaro, Renato Malavasi
description: Franco and Ciccio are two fearful and lazy soldiers of the Bourbon army. Unfortunately, however, we are in 1860 and Garibaldi with his Thousand lands in Sicily. When the Garibaldians arrive, Franco and Ciccio hide in a trunk that is sent to America, and the two find themselves in the Old West to fight against the Indians.
notes: A parody of the Risorgimento and the western could not be missing from the repertoire of the two Sicilian comedians. But the film is a clone and a blend of third-hand gimmicks, situations (and trovarobato).

title: Franco e Ciccio superstars
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Isabella Biagini, Ivano Staccioli, Enzo Andronico, Lino Banfi, Alfredo Adami, Ugo Fangareggi, Fiorenzo Fiorentini, Gabriella Giorgelli, Renato Malavasi
description: Franco Franchetti tries with his friend Ciccio to swindle the dictatorial head of state of a banana country, but then has to pay the stolen goods to the communist guerrillas. The two are then persecuted by an international terrorist. Finally they try to rob the Bank of Italy and the coup, despite the mistakes made, is only half successful.
notes: After raging on the screens in the 1960s, the Sicilian comedian duo experienced a heavy eclipse. Their producer Geo Agliani has revamped this anthology with episodes from various films, which confirm the mediocrity of the scripts that were offered to them.

title: Frankenstein
actors: Boris Karloff, Colin Clive, Mae Clarke, John Boles, Edward Van Sloan, Frederick Kerr, Dwight Frye, Lionel Belmore
description: The baron and scientist Dr. Frankenstein transplants a new brain onto a dead person and brings it back to life through the application of a magnetic fluid. But the grafted gray matter is that of a criminal madman: the creature, childish and bloodthirsty at the same time, gets rid of its guardians and begins to kill.
notes: English in Hollywood, James Whale made Mary Shelley's Frankenstein a true icon of the 20th century. It seems he was the one who invented the monster mask, even if the credit was attributed to the brilliant make-up technician Jack Pierce. Sublime Boris Karloff in the main role.

title: Frankenstein Meets the Wolf Man
actors: Lon Chaney jr., Bela Lugosi, Ilona Massey, Patric Knowles, Martha Vickers, Lionel Atwill, Maria Ouspenskaya, Dennis Hoey, Don Barclay, Rex Evans
description: To fight a werewolf, English villagers turn to Frankenstein. Horror also ambitious, but only succeeded in parts.

title: Young Frankenstein
actors: Gene Wilder, Peter Boyle, Marty Feldman, Teri Garr, Cloris Leachman, Madeline Kahn, Kenneth Mars, Richard Haydn, Liam Dunn, Danny Goldman
description: Frederick Frankenstein (Wilder), heir to the famous baron, is a brilliant scientist from an American university. The opening of his grandfather's will forces him to hastily reach Transylvania. The love for science, chance and some genetic inclination soon led him to repeat the baron's experiment. Everything works fine, except that the servant Igor, in charge of taking the brain of a genius, takes that of a madman.
notes: Mel Brooks, specialist in parodies, reaches his most successful result here, with moments of absolute mimicry of the vintage atmosphere and with a refinement of references. Some moments are absolutely hilarious, the rhythm is irresistible, the actors perfect (above all a Marty Feldman at his best in the role of the hunchbacked servant Igor).

title: Frankie and Johnny
actors: Elvis Presley, Donna Douglas, Sue Anne Langdon, Harry Morgan, Nancy Kovack, Audrey Christie, Robert Strauss, Anthony Eisley, Joyce Jameson
description: Frankie and Johnny, who perform together on a gambling den that crosses the Mississippi, would make a perfect match if only he got rid of the goddamn gambling habit. But Johnny does worse, starting to woo an old love of his master, influenced by the predictions of a gypsy. From the thrill of play and jealousy to an almost dramatic moment before the happy ending. The short film is above all a pretext for Presley's singing performances.

title: In God We Tru$t
actors: Marty Feldman, Peter Boyle, Louise Lasser, Richard Pryor, Andy Kaufman, Wilfrid Hyde-White, Severn Darden, Eddie Parks, Stephanie Ross
description: A Trappist friar in Los Angeles looking for money for his convent, meets fake holy men, scammers of all kinds and ends up falling in love with a prostitute.
notes: Despite the good cast and Marty Feldman (director, actor and screenwriter as well as famous Igor from "Frankenstein junior) and high ambitions, the film fails to be fun. Richard Pryor plays the role of God.

title: The Brotherhood
actors: Kirk Douglas, Alex Cord, Irene Papas, Luther Adler, Murray Hamilton, Susan Strasberg, Eduardo Ciannelli, Joe De Santis, Connie Scott, Val Avery
description: Frank Ginetta is a now completely Americanized Sicilian who has inherited the place his father won after a long struggle within the mafia. Frank is now on the organizing committee. But Frank has remained tied to his father's mentality and opposes all the new dangerous initiatives that the Committee proposes to him. The situation worsens when his brother Vince, who joined the organization as an administrator, does not have too many scruples.
notes: Traditional but solid story of a bloody confrontation between "styles" and generations of the American mafia. Great Douglas.

title: Fratelli d'Italia
actors: Christian De Sica, Jerry Calà, Massimo Boldi, Sabrina Salerno, Gloria Paul, Nathalie Caldonazzo, Fabrizio Bracconeri, Gian, Angelo Bernabucci, Maurizio Mattioli, Evelyn Stewart, Massimo Serato
description: Three episodes held together by a common element: a car subsequently rented by three different characters. A salesman ends up spending a fantastic weekend on a VIP boat by chance. An employee sees the longed-for night of passion with the boss's wife go up in smoke. A Milan fan forced by circumstances to pretend to be an exaggerated Roma player.
notes: The comedy of manners in its crafty episodic variant was already quite stale by the end of the 1960s. Here Neri Parenti, supported by the script of the ineffable Vanzina brothers, gives us three portraits of contemporary Italian that we did not miss. Only Boldi is saved in the part of Mr. Carlo Verdone, a Milan fan.

title: Ned Kelly
actors: Mick Jagger, Clarissa Kaye-Mason, Allen Bickford, Mark McManus, Ken Goodlet, Frank Thring, Bruce Barry, Tony Bazell, Diane Craig
description: The film tells the story of Ned Kelly, an Irishman who emigrated to Australia, and his brothers who became outlaws last century due to the oppression of the English rulers. In fact, Ned spent a few years in prison, although innocent. When he leaves, his mother suffers the same fate, again for an unjust accusation. Ned and his brothers take refuge in inaccessible areas from which they start a war to the death against the police. They will become heroes and martyrs of the anti-British rebellion.
notes: Gerry Fisher's photography and lighting, as well as the unusual presence of Mick Jagger as an actor, are the only attractions of the film.

title: The Naked Dawn
actors: Arthur Kennedy, Betta St. John, Eugene Iglesias, Roy Engel, Charlita, Tony Martinez, Francis McDonald
description: Santiago is a former Mexican revolutionary who has gone into hiding and is a bandit. During the robbery of a train he meets Manuel and Maria, peons and newlyweds. Maria, mistreated by her husband, asks Santiago to take her away; he also accepts because he discovered that the greedy Manuel was about to kill him. A woman next to an outlaw, however, can sometimes become a good ballast ...
notes: An unconventional western, internalized and modern, of extraordinary formal elegance. Absolute masterpiece of the brilliant Austrian-born director Edgar G. Ulmer, made with scarce means in about ten days.

title: Uncommon Valor
actors: Gene Hackman, Fred Ward, Patrick Swayze, Reb Brown, Robert Stack, Randall 'Tex' Cobb, Harold Sylvester, Tim Thomerson, Gail Strickland
description: Colonel Rodhes' son remained a prisoner in Vietnam. The colonel does not give up and, despite being opposed by the CIA and politicians, he organizes a plan to attack the camp where his son is being held. Putting together a team of veterans, financed by a billionaire whose son has suffered the same fate, Rodhes prepares for the attack. Two Americans are killed in the blitz, but the son of Rodhes and that of the billionaire are freed along with the other prisoners.
notes: In years of triumphant Reaganism, Hollywood hatches revenge intentions and mobilizes its best stars to make them, if not credible, at least engaging. Kotcheff, immediately after "Rambo", returns to Vietnam and confirms the ideological ambiguity and the skills of a brisk storyteller.

title: All the Brothers Were Valiant
actors: Robert Taylor, Stewart Granger, Ann Blyth, Betta St. John, Keenan Wynn, James Whitmore, Kurt Kasznar, Lewis Stone, Robert Burton, Peter Whitney
description: Joel Shore, captain of a whaler, leaves for the Gilbert Islands, where his brother Mark had been lost. He reappears one day, telling of having lived among the natives. A mutiny ensues and the two brothers unite to fight the danger.
notes: The film is unpretentious, but not trivial. The story is robust and the hunting sequences are beautiful. Thorpe was a MGM adventure film specialist.

title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes' Smarter Brother
actors: Gene Wilder, Madeline Kahn, Marty Feldman, Leo McKern, Dom DeLuise, Roy Kinnear, John Le Mesurier, Douglas Wilmer, Thorley Walters
description: In Sherlock's absence, his younger brother Sigerson Holmes is commissioned to retrieve an important document from Jenny Hill, a beautiful opera singer daughter of a minister. It is a compromising political agreement, stolen by an Italian baritone who blackmails the young woman with it. With incredible action, Sigerson will succeed where secret agents of half the world have failed ...
notes: Gene Wilder, in the wake of the success of _Frankenstein Junior_, makes his debut behind the camera with this nonsense inspired by the character of the most famous detective in the world. The gags are quite disconnected from each other, but the comic couple Wilder-Feldman is always close-knit and gives a decent parody.

title: Fratello Sole Sorella Luna
actors: Graham Faulkner, Judi Bowker, Valentina Cortese, Leigh Lawson, Alec Guinness, Kenneth Cranham, Lee Montague, Michael Feast, Nicholas Willatt, John Sharp, Adolfo Celi
description: Son of a rich dyer, Francesco lives his days joyfully. However, he left for the war and returned home exhausted in body and spirit. He then matures a radical conversion that leads him to strip himself of all his goods and to practice and preach poverty, with a group of faithful friends. Denigrated by the right-thinking, he goes to the pope and it will be the latter who kneels before him.
notes: Perhaps the worst cinematic version of the saint's life. Zeffirelli, as it is in his style, makes it a vaguely folk reading, more attentive to the staging, unbearably aesthetic, than to the history or even to the moral of the saint.

title: Fraülein Doktor
actors: Suzy Kendall, Kenneth More, Nigel Green, Giancarlo Giannini, Alexander Knox, Olivera Katarina, Capucine, James Booth, Andreina Paul, Silvia Monti
description: During the First World War, the Intelligence Service attempts to neutralize a German agent hiding under the name of Fraülein Doktor. The spy stole the formula of a terrible gas and caused the sinking of a ship. The British try to eliminate her through a colleague of the woman, but the plan fails and Fraülein Doktor is back at work, in Belgium. Madness awaits you. Film in which, more than the noble anti-militaristic intentions, what counts is the description of an anguished universe. The results are not exciting. The pace doesn't always hold, even if the sequences of the battle of Ypres are of considerable impact.

title: Rock Island Trail
actors: Forrest Tucker, Adele Mara, Lorna Gray, Bruce Cabot, Chill Wills, Barbra Fuller, Grant Withers, Jeff Corey, Roy Barcroft, Pierre Watkin
description: The interests of Reed, an engineer, are opposed to those of Morrow, the owner of a river shipping line. With dynamite and the Indians, the latter tries to prevent the success of the railway on which Reed works, which has also stolen his girlfriend. Acceptable product of Joseph Kane, director specializing in western series B.

title: La freccia nel fianco
actors: Mariella Lotti, Leonardo Cortese, Roldano Lupi, Alanova, Cesare Barbetti, Galeazzo Benti, Enzo Biliotti, Paola Borboni, Liliana Laine, Emilio Petacci, Sandro Ruffini
description: Nicoletta Dossena, happily married, abandons her husband to become the lover of a pianist, her distant childhood love, whom she has met again at a concert. When she discovers that she is a hindrance to the artist's career, the woman kills herself.
notes: The melodramatic theme of Zuccoli's novel is partially held back by the direction of the young Lattuada who begins his exploration of youthful sexuality with this film. Among the screenwriters, Flaiano, Moravia and Zavattini.

title: Arrow In the Dust
actors: Sterling Hayden, Coleen Gray, Keith Larsen, Tom Tully, Jimmy Wakely, Tudor Owen, Lee Van Cleef, John Pickard, Carleton Young
description: After deserting the United States cavalry, he returns to illegally dress the uniform to lead a caravan persecuted by Indians to safety to Fort Laramie. The heroic mission ends up rehabilitating him for all to see.
notes: A western by trade, starring Sterling Hayden, Hollywood tough, redeemed in the end.

title: Le Pacha
actors: Jean Gabin, Dany Carrel, Jean Gaven, André Pousse, Louis Arbessier, Gérard Buhr, Robert Dalban, Maurice Garrel
description: After forty years of service, Police Commissioner Joss is on the verge of retirement. In the course of a colossal jewelry theft, followed by a carnage, an elderly inspector, his great friend, is also killed. The commissioner then forgets the professional ethics and turns into a ruthless avenger.
notes: Lautner refers to the American police, but his story hinges above all on the presence of the now old Jean Gabin, a monument of himself.

title: Freeway
actors: Michael Callan, James Russo, Darlanne Fluegel, Billy Drago, Richard Belzer, Joe Palese, Steve Franken, Brian Kaiser, Kenneth Tobey
description: A killer randomly kills along a stretch of highway around Los Angeles. Lieutenant Boyle, in charge of the investigation, doesn't know which way to turn. Sunny, the widow of one of the victims, takes care of providing him with a good lead: the multiple murderer is one of the regular guests of a radio show reserved for sexual deviates and on one of these occasions the madman promises fire and flames ... first work that engages the traditional thriller mechanism on the fairly conventional criticism of persuasive power. The pace is sluggish, the direction has some authorial ambitions, the screenplay uses biblical references, the subject seems to be inspired by a chain of murders similar to Los Angeles.

title: Frenesia dell'estate
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Sandra Milo, Michèle Mercier, Lea Padovani, Philippe Leroy, Gabriella Giorgelli, Graziella Galvani, Vittorio Congia, Livio Lorenzon, Giampiero Littera, Umberto D'Orsi, Enzo Garinei
description: Episodes of seaside life in Versilia. An officer misunderstands the sex of his beloved. A mature man, but handsome enough to be able to extract money from some old lady, falls in love with a Lolita, which leads him to deal with the bitter reality of his existence and his years. A beautiful sells sweets and sweets. Two friends get busy with an advertising plane.
notes: Comedy sketches, a genre in vogue in those years, directed by Zampa with a grace which will increasingly be missed in the following years. The cast is also pleasant, while rather risqué situations are already appearing.

title: Biloxi Blues
actors: Matthew Broderick, Christopher Walken, Matt Mulhern, Penelope Ann Miller, Corey Parker, Markus Flanagan, Casey Siemaszko, Michael Dolan, Park Overall, Alan Pottinger
description: In Biloxi, Mississippi, during World War II, on a recruit training base. The film follows the events of a group of soldiers who become friends with each other during their stay, despite social, cultural and racial differences. The group clashes with the ruthless Sergeant Toomey, who will eventually settle the bill for his cynical toughness.
notes: Comedy with bitter implications: the screenplay is taken from an autobiographical play by the inexhaustible Neil Simon. Worn themes but sparkling style.

title: Frenzy
actors: Jon Finch, Alec McCowen, Barry Foster, Barbara Leigh-Hunt, Anna Massey, Vivien Merchant, Billie Whitelaw, Clive Swift, Bernard Cribbins, Michael Bates, Jean Marsh, Madge Ryan
description: Richard Barney is accused, based on clues, of killing his wife and former co-worker who resulted in his dismissal. In reality the killer is a friend of his who, after hosting him, reports him to the police. Convicted, Richard senses his friend's guilt. After escaping, he joins him with Captain Oxford, just as he is about to get rid of a third body.
notes: Penultimate film by Hitchcock, in which a female nude appears for the first time and her style is almost overturned with sadism and violence. The black humor of the great Alfred comes to make us side with the killer. Great sequence and extraordinary camera movement on the occasion of the second murder.

title: On the Waterfront
actors: Marlon Brando, Lee J. Cobb, Rod Steiger, Karl Malden, Eva Marie Saint, Pat Henning, Leif Erickson, James Westerfield
description: Terry Malloy is a former boxer who is part of a gang that controls the work of dockers. After having unintentionally caused the death of a worker who only wanted respect for his rights, he went over to the side of the workers. Even on this side of the fence, however, he retains his mentality and his methods and solves injustices with punches and then heads, staggering for the slaps, towards the "master of the ironworks" who is waiting for him on the dock, all dressed in white.
notes: In this ambiguous and fascinating film, the guilt of McCarthy's two "collaborators", Kazan and screenwriter Budd Schulberg, can be seen in filigree. But this is perhaps where much of his interest lies. And then, there is a gigantic Brando. Oscar for Kazan, Brando, Eva Marie Saint, Boris Kaufman (photography) and Schulberg (story and screenplay).

title: The Border
actors: Jack Nicholson, Harvey Keitel, Valerie Perrine, Warren Oates, Elpidia Carrillo, Shannon Wilcox, Manuel Viescas, Jeff Morris, Mike Gomez, Dirk Blocker, Lonny Chapman
description: Charlie Smith is a US-Mexico border surveillance policeman to prevent illegal entry into the United States. Its surveillance is in fact subordinated to the demands of the exploitation of illegal labor by local speculators. Smith goes into crisis after meeting a young Mexican girl, whose son is kidnapped to be sold. Tony Richardson, a former young English director of the "Free cinema" of many years ago, does not express himself here at his best. Despite the presence of Nicholson and the subject far from trivial, the film does not come out of the standard box. Nice Ry Cooder soundtrack.

title: North West Frontier
actors: Kenneth More, Lauren Bacall, Herbert Lom, Wilfred Hyde-White, I.S. Johar, Ursula Jeans, Eugene Deckers, Ian Hunter, Jack Gwillim
description: In India, at the turn of the century, the western borders of the British Empire were troubled by struggles over dynastic issues; and there is a little prince whose survival depends on the security of the region. An English captain who has to rescue the boy and his housekeeper has, as the only means, an old locomotive and a single carriage. But the dangers don't come only from the outside. Although the setting is almost always limited to the small train train, the film does not lose tension and some uses of classic British "humor" are providential to set the right tone for an adventure narrated with a sure pulse.

title: Copper Canyon
actors: Ray Milland, Hedy Lamarr, Macdonald Carey, Mona Freeman, Harry Carey jr., Frank Faylen, Hope Emerson, Taylor Holmes, Peggy Knudsen, James Burke
