description: A group of men who fought in the ranks of the Northerners undertake the exploitation of a copper mine, but the only foundry in the city is owned by a former southerner who refuses to collaborate with those who were his enemies in the war. Former Confederate Colonel Desmond comes to their rescue. He goes into trouble but, with the help of a girl, he defeats all the wicked. Even without elements of particular originality, the narration is fairly compelling and the show works.

title: Trail Street
actors: Randolph Scott, Robert Ryan, Anna Jeffreys, George 'Gabby' Hayes, Madge Meredith, Steve Brodie, Billy House, Virginia Sale, Harry Woods
description: In the town of Liberal, settlers and ranchers are fighting for the right to land. Sheriff Masterson intervenes to settle the dispute ...
notes: The narrative scheme is a classic of the western tradition: and in fact that of Enright is a vintage B movie. A treat for cinephiles and fans of the genre.

title: Il frullo del passero
actors: Ornella Muti, Philippe Noiret, Nicola Farron, Claudine Auger, Chiara Argelli, Sabrina Ferilli, Rosa Di Brigida, Beppe Chierici, Claudio Del Falco, Miriam Axa, Giuseppe Mauro Cruciano
description: Silvana left alone, the man who kept her died and she is about to abandon the village of Romagna in which she lives. At that point Gabriele, rich and widower, who proposes to go and live with him, as long as she is willing to listen to her past love adventures, is going on.
notes: Despite the actors, the subject of Tonino Guerra and the music of Lucio Dalla, the film cannot get up from a bland eroticism. Too bad because the script represents certain provincial atmospheres well.

title: Doctor Phibes Rises Again
actors: Vincent Price, Peter Cushing, Robert Quarry, Valli Kemp, Hugh Griffith, John Thaw, Keith Buckley, Lewis Fiander, Gerald Sim
description: Three years after the death of his beloved wife Victoria, Dr. Phibes awakens from catalepsy and prepares for an expedition in search of the river of life that would be found at the tomb of an Egyptian pharaoh. On the trail of the source is also Darius Baiderbeck: a bitter clash takes place between the two. The film is the sequel to The Abominable Dr. Phibes, made by the same crew; the narrative structure is also identical. Compared to the first episode, the murders of the doctor seem a bit gratuitous; intact, however, the vein of subtle humor impressed by the great Vincent Price on his evil character.

title: The Restless Years
actors: Sandra Dee, John Saxon, Teresa Wright, Luana Patten, Margaret Lindsay, James Whitmore, Virginia Grey, Jody McCrea, Alan Baxter
description: Marilyn Grent's mother is a single mother, but she told her daughter that her father died. But sooner or later the truth will come out. Mediocre melodrama of the 1950s, directed by a German emigrant.

title: The Major and the Minor
actors: Ginger Rogers, Ray Milland, Rita Johnson, Robert Benchley, Diana Lynn, Edward Fielding, Frankie Thomas, Raymond Roe
description: Disappointed by life in New York, Susan (Rogers) wants to return to her home country, but has a problem: she can't pay for a train ticket. To overcome this inconvenience, he disguises himself as a minor, in order to take advantage of the reduced rate. In a train compartment she finds the love of her life: Major Kirby, whom she will marry after a series of misunderstandings.
notes: Sapid and intelligent comedy that marked the debut of Billy Wilder as a director (before it had been only a screenwriter), in which the theme of the disguise - which will also resort in many subsequent films - and that of the taboo of the sexuality of minors are the pivot on which it rotates The story. In 1955 a remake will then be shot, the nephew Dicchiatello, with Jerry Lewis and Dean Martin.

title: Feu Mathias Pascal
actors: Ivan Mozzhukhin, Marcelle Pradot, Michel Simon, Lois Moran, Marthe Mellot, Pauline Carton, Irma Perrot, Mireille Barsac, Isaure Douvan
description: Mattia Pascal leads an anonymous life. He is obviously not satisfied, but he is also too weak to rebel against convention. Then one day, following a misunderstanding, Mattia is believed dead. After a first moment of confusion, the man decides to take advantage of the opportunity that is offered to him. He goes to great lengths to forget his former identity and starts a new life: he gets rich playing at the casino, frequents hotels and luxury women. But fate is lurking and when his family members learn the truth they continue to consider him dead.
notes: It is the first film version of Pirandello's novel, made when the Sicilian writer was still alive. The great playwright publicly appreciated L'Herbier's work, which is indeed exemplary in many ways, thanks also to an unforgettable characterization of the Russian actor Mosjoukine / Mozzuchin. Scenographies by Alberto Cavalvanti and Lazare Meerson, non immeomore direction of the contemporary French avant-gardes.

title: Fighting Caravans
actors: Gary Cooper, Lili Damita, Ernest Torrence, Tully Marshall, Fred Kohler, Eugene Pallette, Roy Stewart, May Boley, Eve Southern
description: Three fusiliers escort a caravan on its way to California. Weak western in which only the star of Gary Cooper shines.

title: The Fighting 69th
actors: James Cagney, Pat O'Brien, George Brent, Jeffrey Lynn, Alan Hale, Frank McHugh, Dennis Morgan, Dick Foran, William Lundigan, Guinn 'Big Boy' Williams
description: A young man volunteers at the recruiting center to go to war. Of Irish origin, he proclaims courage to spare, but, once at the front, with his cowardice he causes the death of numerous comrades. On trial, he is about to be shot when chance offers him the opportunity to redeem himself for his cowardice.
notes: William Keighley has been able to range from war films to gangster films to westerns with equal effectiveness. James Cagney was one of his recurring performers; here he is the protagonist of a war story cut specifically on his "character", violent and braggart, but capable of noble actions.

title: Escape from Alcatraz
actors: Clint Eastwood, Patrick McGoohan, Robert Blossom, Jack Thibeau, Fred Ward, Paul Benjamin, Larry Hankin, Bruce M. Fischer, Frank Ronzio
description: Frank Morris arrives in search of Alcatraz in January 1960. The prison enjoys a solid reputation for extreme security: no one has ever managed to escape. Despite this Morris has only one thought: to run away. And he also manages to find a way, taking three years.
notes: The man crushed by the Institution has only one way of salvation: pretend to accept the rules of the game and then claim his own individuality in the fight (or flight). The classic theme of Siegel's poetics returns in this extraordinary film, dry as a documentary, with a monumental Eastwood. Line to remember: "What kind of childhood did you have, Frank?" "Short".

title: Fuga dal paradiso
actors: Fabrice Josso, Ines Sastre, Aurore Clément, Horst Buchholz, Jacques Perrin, Van Johnson, Paolo Bonacelli, Giovanni Visentin, Lukas Ammann, Lou Castel, Barbara Cupisti
description: Following an ecological catastrophe, humanity is forced to live underground in small tunnels with the only comfort of suns, moons and various landscapes projected on fake windows. Teo (Josso) and Beatrice (Sastre) don't live in the same tunnel, but they talk to each other through a screen and, above all, they love each other.
notes: Even Ettore Pasculli's attempt to become a director was mercifully wrecked. Presented, for inscrutable reasons, at the Venice Film Festival of '90, this film then managed to go very little way.

title: Midnight Express
actors: Brad Davis, Irene Miracle, Bo Hopkins, Paolo Bonacelli, Paul L. Smith, Randy Quaid, Norbert Weisser, John Hurt, Mike Kellin, Franco Diogene, Michael Ensign, Gigi Ballista, Kevor Malikyan, Peter Jeffrey, Joe Zammit Cordina
description: On vacation in Istanbul, Billy Hayes is persuaded by a taxi driver to buy a couple of kilos of hashish and tries to cross the border. Naturally they stop him and a hallucinating odyssey begins for him inside Turkish prisons with physical and psychological violence. However, the killing of the prison director offers him an unexpected possibility of escape.
notes: For a while the Turks protested, accusing the film of racism. For a while, all the border guards began to check the heartbeats of possible suspects (this is how Billy gets caught) and for a while Alan Parker managed to make them believe he was a misunderstood genius. The director's hand is heavy and takes the throat.

title: Tarzan Escapes
actors: Johnny Weissmuller, Maureen O'Sullivan, Benita Hume, John Buckler, Herbert Mundin, William Henry, E.E. Clive, Darby Jones
description: Some of Jane's relatives join her and her man in the jungle to convince her to return to the civilized way in order to settle an inheritance issue. The expedition leader captures Tarzan and hands over his clients to a savage tribe. Fortunately, there are elephants who obey the Monkey Lord. The couple formed by Weissmuller and Maureen O'Sullivan is the most famous of all those who played the two heroes of the forest. The story is of course, totally naïve, but Thorpe draws from it what Tarzan fans expect.

title: The Defiant Ones
actors: Robert Urich, Carl Weathers, Barry Corbin, Ed Lauter, Laurie O'Brien, Thalmus Rasulala, William Sanderson, Ritch Brinkley, Ebbe Roe Smith
description: Johnny "Jocker" Johnson manages to escape from jail, but is tied to the same chain that also imprisons Cullen Monroe. The first is white and racist, the second is black and racist too. Now, however, given the situation, the two must try to put aside their prejudices and collaborate, if they want to survive and leave their pursuers behind. It will certainly not be an easy thing.
notes: The film is the "remake" of _Parete di mud_, directed in 1958 by Stanley Kramer, with Curtis and Poitier. Rather rare case, the remake is no less valid than the original; and the original was great. The ideological side also remains well taken care of.

title: Fuga in Francia
actors: Folco Lulli, Rosi Mirafiore, Mario Vercellone, Enrico Olivieri, Pietro Germi, Giovanni Dufour, Cesare Olivieri, Gino Apostolo, Gianni Luda, Mario Soldati
description: Riccardo Torre, a war criminal, tries to emigrate illegally after having escaped from prison. Difficulties do not scare him and, to achieve his goal, he does not hold back even in the face of the murder of a woman. At first his son Fabrizio joins him and is involuntarily injured by his father. At the end of the vicissitudes Riccardo falls into the hands of his pursuers. Among unforgettable faces, with a tension that owes a lot to American cinema and adapting one of his stories (and among the collaborators there are Cecchi, Flaiano, Bonfantini, Cesare Pavese), Soldati makes a personal use of neorealism, making the most of a cast of the highest level (unforgettable Germi and Lulli) and reaching one of his best directorial achievements.

title: Dreamscape
actors: Dennis Quaid, Max Von Sydow, Christopher Plummer, Kate Capshaw, Eddie Albert, David Patrick Kelly, George Wendt, Larry Gelman, Chris Mulkey, Peter Jason
description: Alex Gardner (Dennis Quaid) discovers that he has special powers, that is, being able to enter the dreams of others. In the laboratory of Doctor Novotny (Max Von Sydow) who studies these phenomena he also discovers that there is a plan to kill the President of the United States through sleep. Political intrigue is less interesting than paranormal, but the film works and Dennis Quaid does too.

title: Escape to Victory
actors: Michael Caine, Max Von Sydow, Sylvester Stallone, Pelé, Arthur Brauss, Amidou, Michael Wolf, Benoît Ferreux, Zoltán Gera, Carole Laure, Tim Pigott-Smith, Michael Cochrane
description: Major Von Steiner, a great football fan, arrives at the Gensdorff concentration camp. The presence among the inmates of some famous players pushes him to organize a match between them and the German national team. The game, played in Paris, is a good opportunity for propaganda for the Nazis, a chance for ours to escape. But at the end of the first half, ours are three goals down.
notes: A film that starts narrow and desolate in the field of Gensdorff, goes on on the double tension of the war and the match that will come and explodes in the stadium with a movement of people that would move the tears to the stones. Huston seems to be having a great time, football fans are in heaven.

title: La fuggitiva
actors: Jone Voleri, Anna Magnani, Renato Cialente, Clelia Matania, Anna Carena, Mariù Pascoli, Annibale Betrone, Nino Crisman, Stefano Sibaldi
description: Delfina, an orphan of both parents, brings a little girl who has run away from home to her father. Having failed her marriage due to a jealousy outbreak of her fiancé, she is hired as a housekeeper by the girl's family; later he falls in love with his father who everyone thinks is a widower. When happiness seems close at hand, his wife, a variety artist, who had moved away from home years earlier, unexpectedly reappears. Delfina therefore takes refuge with her grandfather in the mountains. The little girl tries to reach her and falls ill.
notes: The film is a melodrama based on the novel of the same name by Milly Dandolo, above the riche and with naturalistic thrusts that made one speak, in retrospect, of a precursor of neorealism.

title: The Lion and the Horse
actors: Steve Cochran, Ray Teal, Bob Steele, Sherry Jackson, Harry Antrim, George O'Hanlon, Sherry Jackson, William Fawcett
description: Ted, a passionate horse breeder, captures a splendid specimen during a hunt in Wyoming, but his companions sell it to Kirby, an avid rodeos organizer, who exploits it without regard and makes a lot of money. Ted manages to buy back Lightning (as he called it), to tune into him and train him. But the treacherous Kirby is still lurking. He will have bread for his teeth.
notes: Series B adventure film that manages to thrill a not too demanding audience. Good, for the time, the footage of the capture of the horses. Directed more than acceptable by Louis King, an expert of the genre.

title: Fumeria d'oppio - Ritorna Za-la-mort
actors: Emilio Ghione jr., Mariella Lotti, Paolo Stoppa, Emilio Cigoli, Enrico Glori, Umberto Spadaro, Adriana de Roberto, Fedele Gentile, Armando Francioli, Checco Durante, Arnoldo Foà
description: At the request of a girl, a convict turns into a detective to clarify an obscure murder. Interesting take of a silent hero, Za-la-mort, in a story full of suspense, directed with great skill. Ghione is precisely the son of Emilio, interpreter and director of the silent serial.

title: Fumo di Londra
actors: Alberto Sordi, Fiona Lewis, Amy Dalby, Alfredo Marchetti, Clara Bindi, Michael Trubshawe, Massimo Ungaretti, Romano Giomini, Pamela Hollyer
description: Dante Fontana, a modest antiquarian from Perugia, has the opportunity to go to London for an auction, and thus get to know England, for which he dotes on it. His first concern is to take on the appearance of a genuine Londoner, but even here it is not the dress that makes the monk. He has some exciting experiences, but the conclusion of his adventure in the land of Albion is at least embarrassing.
notes: Alberto Sordi's directorial debut has the character, like his other subsequent films, of a "guided humorous reportage" not without stereotypes. The real backbone of the building is still the "Albertone" actor.

title: Funeral in Berlin
actors: Michael Caine, Oskar Homolka, Eva Renzi, Paul Hubschmid, Guy Doleman, Hugh Burden, Heinz Schubert, Wolfgang Völz, Thomas Holtzmann
description: During the Cold War, a senior Soviet officer stationed in East Berlin let the secret services know that he wanted to move to the West. The English secret agent Harrry Palmer is in charge of the delicate matter and organizes the escape through a fake funeral. At the destination, however, in the coffin there is not the fake "corpse" of the officer, but the real one of another spy.
notes: Excellent film, from the novel by Len Deighton. Michael Caine wears, for the second time, the role of the secret agent and as usual interprets him with a good blend of self-control, irony and malice.

title: Nobi
actors: Eiji Funakoshi, Osamu Takizawa, Mickey Curtis, Hikaru Hoshi, Mantarô Ushio, Masaya Tsukida, Yasushi Sugita, Yoshihiro Hamaguchi
description: The defeat of the Japanese army, in the Philippines in 1945, through the eyes of soldier Tamura. Crude account of war, cannibalism and other horrors.

title: Out of the Dark
actors: Cameron Dye, Karen Black, Divine, Lynn Danielson-Rosenthal, Karen Lorre, Starr Andreeff, Karen Mayo-Chandler, Angela Robinson Witherspoon, Teresa Crespo, Geoffrey Lewis
description: Jo Ann is one of the voices that respond to a "sexy phone"; One night she is assassinated by a man disguised as clown. The suspicions fall on Kevin, a photographer sent to a colleague of the girl, Kristi, but he manages to divert the investigation towards an employee, who is killed in a scuffle with Kristi. Meanwhile, other girls are killed. Kristi, who fled Kevin, finds a strange mask in his suitcase. Sex, violence, telephones and misogyny in abundance: all things very dear to the Americans, according to Paul Bartel, a filmmaker of the Corman team and executive producer of the film. Heavy hand, therefore, in images as in the dialogues, but also macabre and sharp humor and a string of Cameos (Bartel, Bud Cort, Tab Hunter). Divine, famous Beso disguise of John Waters' films, lays female clothes and plays a policeman.

title: After Hours
actors: Griffin Dunne, Rosanna Arquette, Linda Fiorentino, Verna Bloom, Tommy Chong, Teri Garr, John Heard, Cheech Marin, Catherine O'Hara, Dick Miller, Will Patton
description: Paul Hackett is an anonymous New York employee, single, satisfied with his job and socially well connected. One day, in a bar, he meets a girl and decides to try. From then on, everything happens: the girl does not show up for the appointment, he finds himself on the street, far from home and without even the money for a taxi; plus all the inhabitants of the neighborhood seem to be angry with him.
notes: Grandiose metropolitan nightmare, one of Martin Scorsese's masterpieces. A descent into the underworld of suspended and abstract daily life, sublime in its inevitability. Kafkaesque, but with a superb lightness. Best Director Award at the Cannes Film Festival.

title: Fuori uno... sotto un altro, arriva il passatore
actors: George Hilton, Edwige Fenech, Manolo Zarzo, Sal Borgese, Chris Avram, Cris Huerta, Jack Logan, Helga Liné, Lucretia Love, Umberto D'Orsi, Fortunato Arena
description: While an incapable police officer chases him in vain, the bandit Stefano Pelloni, known as "Il Passatore" scores one hit after another. His boldness is such that he shows up in a theater and preys on the audience of all the money. With his proverbial cunning he manages to get Garibaldi to escape capture, hunted by Austrian forces. Meanwhile, the police chief Zambelli tries to set him a trap ...
notes: It is a grungy farce that was not successful with the public. Carnimeo directs the film as if it were a western.

title: This Gun for Hire
actors: Alan Ladd, Veronica Lake, Robert Preston, Laird Cregar, Tully Marshall, Marc Lawrence, Olin Howland, Roger Imhof, Pamela Blake, Frank Ferguson, Bernadene Hayes
description: A powerful US chemical company embroiled in shady dealings with Japan uses a former employee, Raven, a lonely and neurotic killer, to eliminate a man and his secretary, in possession of very co-controlling papers. Once the mission is complete and after they have paid for him with fake tickets, the principals decide to discard him and hand him over to the police.
notes: Compelling adaptation of a Graham Greene novel, the film has an excellent cast of actors and an effective screenplay by W. R. Burnett (author of the novel Jungle of Asphalt) and Albert Matz (who will be one of the "Ten of Hollywood"). It was the occasion for the launch of Alan Ladd.

title: Fury
actors: Spencer Tracy, Sylvia Sidney, Walter Abel, Walter Brennan, Bruce Cabot, Edward Ellis, Frank Albertson, George Walcott, Arthur Stone, Morgan Wallace
description: Joe Wilson visits his girlfriend who lives in a small town in the southern United States. Mistaken for a criminal, he risks being lynched and is saved only because everyone gives him up for dead in the fire in the prison where he was locked up. Calm returns, Joe denounces his assailants.
notes: It is the first American film by Fritz Lang, who fled from Germany at the advent of Nazism. Very high cinematic tension and representation of the typical Langhian theme: the innocent man hunted by a blind destiny and the fury of those who believe him guilty. Gorgeous Tracy in one of her best roles.

title: Blind Fury
actors: Rutger Hauer, Brandon Call, Terrance O'Quinn, Lisa Blount, Noble Willingham, Nick Cassavetes, Rick Overton, Randall 'Tex' Cobb, Charles Cooper, Meg Foster
description: Nick Parker was left blind during a war action in Vietnam. Back in the United States, he goes in search of Frank, a fellow soldier. The man is in trouble with the mafia who are trying to force him to work in a drug factory and has decided to kidnap his son Billy. Nick arrives at the right time, saves the boy and, with him, sets out in search of his father.
notes: The Australian Noyce "burns" himself with this silly action movie, evidently directed with his left hand. The hero looks like the Daredevil of comics but the script blows up all of its dramatic potential. Rutger Hauer collapses with the film.

title: La furia dei barbari
actors: Edmund Purdom, Rossana Podestà, Livio Lorenzon, Carla Calò, Daniele Vargas, Andrea Fantasia, Vittoria Febbi, Ljubica Jovic, Luciano Marin, Raffaella Carrà
description: In the 6th century AD, the Lombard raids on Italian soil were punctuated by oppression. The killing of a village chief's wife triggers a spiral of revenge.

title: Tarzan's Savage Fury
actors: Lex Barker, Dorothy Hart, Tommy Carlton, Patric Knowles, Charles Korvin
description: A caravan led by Rokov and Edwards reaches Tarzan in the jungle. Edwards pretends to be Tarzan's English cousin (whom he killed instead) and says he has an important mission to accomplish: recovering a lot of diamonds guarded by the Wasuri tribe. But their scam will be discovered and Tarzan, with the help of Jane and their adopted son Boy, will defeat the evil ones. Cyril Endfield, an American director of South African origin, after having directed a couple of good thrillers, was the victim of the so-called witch hunt. This Tarzan is certainly not one of his best things, it is still a good suspense and adventure film.

title: The Left-Handed Gun
actors: Paul Newman, Lita Milan, John Denher, Hurt Hatfield, James Congdon, James Best, Colin Keith-Johnston, John Dierkes, Robert Anderson, Wally Brown
description: William Bonney is a cowboy with no art or part. When his friend and protector Tunstall is killed by four men, including a sheriff, for venal reasons, he hunts down the killers with a couple of associates. He liquidates two, but is injured and must escape. He will be able to eliminate the others as well, but his mad thirst for revenge isolates him. Hunted, he is killed by an old friend who became a sheriff.
notes: Film written for TV by the corrosive Gore Vidal (and adapted for cinema by Leslie Stevens) with evident psychoanalytic references. Director Arthur Penn gives some healthy shakes to the myth of Billy the Kid, directing with a style that is more lyrical than epic The figure of the gunslinger is rendered by Paul Newman with an admirable interpretation over the top, according to the canons of the Actor's Studio.

title: White Heat
actors: James Cagney, Virginia Mayo, Edmond O'Brien, Margaret Wycherly, Steve Cochran, John Archer, Wally Cassell, Fred Clark
description: Cody organized a bloody robbery and to create an alibi he accused himself of a petty theft that occurred at the same time. But while he is in prison to serve his light sentence, he learns that his wife has fled with a friend of his.

title: The Grapes of Wrath
actors: Henry Fonda, Jane Darwell, John Carradine, Charley Grapewin, Dorris Bowdon, Russell Simpson, O.Z. Whitehead, John Qualen, Eddie Quillan, Zeffie Tilbury
description: From Oklahoma to California in an old truck. The farming family of Tom Joad (Fonda), overwhelmed like thousands of others by the Great Depression of 1929, faces an adventurous journey to the "promised land" where there will be work. But Tom, who just got out of prison and is wanted by the police, has to leave his loved ones so as not to get them into trouble.
notes: A masterpiece by John Ford that recreates, with exceptional intensity, the atmosphere of the John Steinbeck novel from which it is based. A masterful visual story in its impeccable, rigorous essentiality; great interpretations of protagonists and supporting actors.

title: De bruit et de fureur
actors: Vincent Gasperitsch, María Luisa García, François Négret, Bruno Cremer, Fabienne Babe, Thierry Hélaine, Sandrine Arnault, Victoire Buff
description: Bruno is a quiet boy abandoned to himself in the Parisian suburbs. She makes friends with a proud young hooligan, and then with a teacher, who abandons him when she is accused of having an affair with him. Definitely at the mercy of his friend and his own ghosts, Bruno runs towards self-destruction. According to a feature film by an interesting French author, the film can provoke different reactions, but it does not leave indifferent. Brisseau finds the right formal balance in the staging of two brutally opposed elements: daily violence and the dream world of a boy thirsty for love.

title: The Turning Point
actors: William Holden, Edmond O'Brien, Alexis Smith, Tom Tully, Ed Begley, Danny Dayton, Adele Longmire, Ray Teal, Ted De Corsia
description: A young and energetic magistrate is charged by the governor to defeat a criminal organization that has complicity even in the police. Despite the criminals killing his father, the magistrate does not give up. A good detective story by Dieterle, starring William Holden at the height of his career.

title: Furto di sera bel colpo si spera
actors: Pippo Franco, Giancarlo Prete, Piero Vida, Laura Troschel, Monica Monet, Thomas Rudy, Memmo Carotenuto, Aldo Giuffré, Umberto D'Orsi
description: His normal activity as a car thief has earned Quinto a stay in Regina Coeli, but he does not get discouraged and switches first to cured meats, then, with the help of a blacksmith, a mechanic and a call girl, to billionaire executives. . The outcome is always the same, with the difference that instead of going directly to jail, he goes to the hospital first. The slender script is based on variations of an identical situation that could be repeated indefinitely.

title: Il furto è l'anima del commercio?!...
actors: Alighiero Noschese, Enrico Montesano, Bernard Blier, Pia Giancaro, Ave Ninchi, Lino Banfi, Francis Blanche, Elio Crovetto, Enzo Cannavale, Ignazio Leone, Giacomo Furia
description: Libero Sbardellone and his wife's uncle, the noble Gaetano Gargiullo, are in and out of prison, in Naples, because of their fraudulent activities and prepare a sensational "coup": a theft from a lottery shop on a very special occasion . To begin with, it causes a false eruption of Vesuvius to raise the number of plays.
notes: The subject and the script are better than the direction and the clownish excesses of the performers.

title: The Fury
actors: Kirk Douglas, John Cassavetes, Amy Irving, Charles Durning, Carrie Snodgress, Fiona Lewis, Andrew Stevens, Carol Eve Rossen, Rutanya Alda, Joyce Easton, William Finley
description: Peter and Childress, longtime CIA agents, are friends. One day Childress has Robin, Peter's son, kidnapped; the kidnapping is organized as if it were the action of a group of Palestinian terrorists, but Peter understands that Childress wanted to take over the boy in order to use his paranormal powers. He launches in search of his son, with the help of Gillian, a girl under observation in an institute of parapsychological studies, with the same powers as Robin.
notes: Usually considered a "minor" De Palma, it deserves a closer look. In his filmography he represents a kind of foreign body: he starts from a completely delusional screenplay (written by John Farris and based on his book); but De Palma inserts such energy into the staging as to make the story fly high. Sequences of pure suspense embellished by two actors abandoned (rightly so) in furious recitations.

title: Futureworld
actors: Peter Fonda, Blythe Danner, Arthur Hill, Yul Brynner, John P. Ryan, Stuart Margolin, Allen Ludden, Robert Cornthwaite, Angela Greene
description: Two television reporters, Chuck and Tracy, discover that Delos, a robot-animated Disneyland, is the center of a conspiracy led by Dr. Schneider, who wants to kidnap the powerful of Earth and replace them with double automatons he controls ...
notes: Effective ecological-moralizing following of _The world of robots_ by Michael Crichton.

title: FX 2 - The Deadly Art of Illusion
actors: Bryan Brown, Brian Dennehy, Rachel Ticotin, Joanna Gleason, Philip Bosco, Kevin J. O'Connor, Tom Mason, Dominic Zamprogna, Jossie DeGuzman, John Walsh
description: Special effects expert Rollie Tyler has retired to private life; a policeman friend of his asks him for help with a risky investigation. The agent is killed, but the video tape recorded by Rollie unmasks the killer. Pursued by these and his accomplices, Rollie gets help from a detective friend. Behind the whole thing there are some gold medallions made by Michelangelo that are interested in the mafia.
notes: As in the first film in the series, special effects skills help Rollie get out of the way. Brian Dennehy is always nice and the role of the cop seems to be made for him.

title: FX - Murder by Illusion
actors: Bryan Brown, Brian Dennehy, Diane Venora, Cliff De Young, Mason Adams, Jerry Orbach, Joe Grifasi, Martha Gehman, Roscoe Orman
description: Rollie Tyler, who works as a special effectist in Hollywood, is contacted by the secret services: he must prepare a staging to simulate the murder of a repentant mobster who is about to testify at a trial. Rollie lends himself, but begins to be the subject of attacks that he discovers organized by a corrupt officer in league with the mafioso himself. Rollie manages to get by thanks to his skill with tricks, then he takes the place of the mobster and recovers the huge loot he has hidden in Switzerland.
notes: The starting plot seems a bit like a Hitchcock copy, but then the story works well and the emotions are not lacking. Bizarre surprise start.

title: Il gabbiano
actors: Laura Betti, Giulio Brogi, Pamela Villoresi, Remo Girone, Gisella Burinato, Antonio Piovanelli, Mattia Pinoli, Clara Colosimo, Remo Remotti, Gaetano Campisi
description: A councilor of state hosts his sister, a theatrical actress, with her son and lover on his estate. The young man suffers from the egocentrism of his mother who comes to mock a text written for her by her son. Out of disappointment, the young man tries to kill himself ...
notes: Faithful transposition of the Cecovian text in a Po Valley setting with the fetish actor of the Taviani Giulio Brogi and the Pasolinian Laura Betti. A meditation on rigor and success, in lacerating contradiction, and on the shipwreck of ambitions. From the "Helm of Athens" to the "Prince of Homburg", passing through "Henry IV", Bellocchio's theater is always a feast for the eyes and the heart.

title: Das kabinett des Doktor Caligari
actors: Werner Krauss, Conrad Veidt, Lil Dagover, Friedrich Feher, Hans Heinrich von Twardowski, Rudolf Lettinger
description: Two students discover the secret of Dr. Caligari and the sleepwalker Cesare that he exhibits at fairs: one of them dies. A masterpiece of German Expressionism (the sets were by Hermann Warm, Waltr Reimann and Walter Rohrig), it influenced all the fantastic and horror cinema. Going back to the great tradition of German fantastic romanticism (Hoffmann, Achim von Arnim), the screenwriters Carl Mayer and Hans Janowitz evoked historical ghosts which, according to the great sociologist Siegfried Kracauer, materialized in the Weimar crisis and in Nazism.

title: Gambe d'oro
actors: Paolo Ferrari, Scilla Gabel, Totò, Rossella Como, Mario Carotenuto, Elsa Merlini, Rosario Borelli, Dolores Palumbo, Giampiero Littera, Memmo Carotenuto, Luigi Pavese
description: The fate of a small provincial football team is in danger of collapse when it is learned that the two best elements, thanks to which the team is achieving remarkable successes, are about to be sold to an important Serie A team. the agreed sum is tempting both to the players and to the stingy president of the team. How to get out of the impasse?
notes: The "extraordinary participation" of Totò and other respectable actors is not enough, unfortunately, to save the film which turns out to be one of the least successful (and witty) Italian comedies of the time. Curious only for the football-provincial setting, now a relic.

title: Gandhi
actors: Ben Kingsley, Rohini Hattangadi, Roshan Seth, Candice Bergen, John Gielgud, Edward Fox, Trevor Howard, John Mills, Martin Sheen, Ian Charleson, Günther Maria Halmer, Geraldine James
description: Gandhi's political engagement begins in South Africa after he was kicked out of the first class of a train for being Indian. The refusal to obey English laws is combined with the choice of non-violence. He also ends up in prison. On his return to India he is welcomed triumphantly. Strengthened also by the love of his wife, he takes on the mission of snatching his compatriots from English domination and soon becomes the leader of a non-violent independence movement to which the British no longer know how to oppose. Having overcome even the conflicts between Hindus and Muslims, Gandhi leads his people to final victory before falling victim to the religious intolerance that divides his compatriots.
notes: It took about twenty years to create this blockbuster: no one was willing to finance it, considering it a not very commercial project. His extraordinary international success (and the conquest of nine Oscars, including film, direction and lead actor) proved the opposite. Attenborough meticulously reconstructs Gandhi's political story, attentive to the historical and psychological complexity of the character.

title: Thieves Like Us
actors: Keith Carradine, Shelley Duvall, Bert Remsen, John Schuck, Louise Fletcher, Ann Latham, Tom Skerritt, Al Scott, John Roper
description: In America, during the Great Depression, Bowie Bowers, in prison for murder, manages to escape together with two life prisoners: Ted and Chicamaw. In short, the three become companions in life and robbery. Then Bowie meets Keechie and starts thinking about quitting that kind of life. One more robbery is enough, the final one, the one that fixes for life, but the fateful "last robbery" ends badly.
notes: This is the Robert Altman of the good times, the fit one, the one capable of making an entire movie about three robbers without ever showing a robbery. The one capable of using sound like no one would ever be able to do again.

title: The Doberman Gang
actors: Byron Mabe, Julie Parrish, Simmy Bow, Hal Reed, JoJo D'Amore, John Tull, Jay Paxton, John Strong, Diane Prior
description: A criminal wants to make a perfect shot, so train six ferocious Dobermans. The subject is quite original, but the film is all there.

title: The Racket
actors: Robert Mitchum, Robert Ryan, Lizabeth Scott, William Talman, Ray Collins, Joyce Mackenzie, Robert Hutton, Virginia Huston, William Conrad
description: The bandit Nick Taylor proves to be cruel and aggressive like all the members of his gang. Captain Martin manages to have his accomplices arrested, but they are regularly acquitted by corrupt judges. When he finally catches them with his hands in the act, a cop paid by the bandit's accomplices is tasked with killing Taylor before he can make any admissions.
notes: Cromwell, specialist in melodramas. proposes a "noir" full of twists, with a very inspired Mitchum. The screenplay is inspired by a Bart Cormack play played on stage by Edward G. Robinson.

title: Gangster Story
actors: Walter Matthau, Carol Grace, Bruce McFarlane, Garry Walberg, Raikin Ben-Ari, David Leonard, John Albright, Clegg Hoyt
description: Just out of the jail, Jack Martin ends up in a small town where he lands an ingenious bank robbery. Hunted by the police, the FBI and the local crime boss, he also finds time to fall in love, but ...
notes: Unique, tasty and eccentric proof of the great Matthau behind the camera.

title: Un garibaldino al convento
actors: Carla Del Poggio, Maria Mercader, Leonardo Cortese, Fausto Guerzoni, Olga Vittoria Gentilli, Federico Collino, Clara Auteri Pepe, Elvira Betrone, Dina Romano
description: Mariella and Caterinetta attend the same college and enliven the days with their quarrels. In helping a wounded Garibaldian who sought refuge in the convent, the two girls discover friendship, and Mariella finds love again. A Vittorio De Sica already mature for results of a very different caliber.

title: The Trials of Oscar Wilde
actors: Peter Finch, Nigel Patrick, James Mason, Yvonne Mitchell, Lionel Jeffries, John Fraser, Sonia Dresdel, Maxine Audley, James Booth
description: The intimate and artistic life of the Irish writer Oscar Wilde from 1892 to 1897: from the triumph on stage of his "Lady Windermere's fan" to trials and incarceration for homosexuality. While in detention, Wilde knows the faith.
notes: A vibrant "biopic", much better than the recent "Wilde", which in unsuspecting times seeks a key to understanding between the life and art of the great writer. The "green carnation" of the title is what Oscar often wore in his buttonhole. Peter Finch's "mimetic" acting is truly admirable. On the same theme, in the same year, "One more question, Oscar Wilde!"

title: La chatte
actors: Françoise Arnoul, Bernard Blier, Bernhard Wicki, Kurt Meisel, André Versini, Roger Hanin, Louison Roblin, Harald Wolff, Michel Jourdan
description: Cora, known as "La Gatta", is part of a partisan group. Her lover pretends to be a Swiss journalist, but in reality he is a German officer whose job is to dismantle the resistance in that region. When Cora realizes how things stand, it's too late: her comrades are all arrested and she is killed for cheating.
notes: Decoin was a director with mixed results, best in the detective story. "La Gatta" would like to be an unconventional film about resistance, but in reality it is made up of clichés of adventure cinema that have ensured its commercial success and total improbability.

title: Cat on a Hot Tin Roof
actors: Elizabeth Taylor, Paul Newman, Burl Ives, Jack Carson, Judith Anderson, Madeleine Sherwood, Larry Gates, Vaughn Taylor
description: The Pollit family: dad (cancer patient) and mum; son Gooper, married to Mae; the other son Brick, married to the beautiful Maggie, the "cat" of the title. The father torments Brick who neglects his wife, because he is jealous of his alleged affair with a friend who later killed himself. Exasperated, Brick reveals the nature of his disease to his father. The tragedy breaks out.
notes: Taken from the Tennessee Williams drama, the film contains, although sweetening it in the passage to the screen, the whole repertoire: morbid dialogues, sexophobias, frustrations, effect acting. A drama of heated feelings, love and hate with an excellent direction. Extraordinary Newman and Taylor.

title: Gatti rossi in un labirinto di vetro
actors: Martine Brochard, John Richardson, Ines Pellegrini, Andres Mejuto, Mirta Miller, Daniele Vargas, George Rigaud, Silvia Solar, Raf Baldassarre
description: A group of Americans on a trip to Barcelona suddenly find themselves involved in a series of heinous crimes. An unknown murderer stabs young women from whom he tears out the right eye. The police suspect, after long groping in the dark, that the murderer is the publicist Marc Burton, a lover of Miss Paulette Stone. The man, for his part, believes that his wife Alma, who is sick with nerves, is responsible for the murders.
notes: Terrifying, but not because of the (non-existent) suspense. But where will the cats and the labyrinths ever be?

title: Il gatto
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Mariangela Melato, Michel Galabru, Jean Martin, Dalila Di Lazzaro, Aldo Reggiani, Adriana Innocenti, Philippe Leroy, Armando Brancia, Mario Brega
description: The brothers Amedeo (Tognazzi) and Ofelia (Melato) have received a very tempting offer for the old building they own, as long as they manage to free it from all those who live there. They try by all means, and even the feline can be useful. Two sordid protagonists in a chorus of minor characters sketched with incisive attention. On a screenplay full of humors, Comencini draws a story that unfolds masterfully in the tortuous interiors of the building, which punctually captures the significant aspects of the characters and which offers the actors, more or less famous, the opportunity for tasty interpretations.

title: Il gatto a nove code
actors: James Franciscus, Karl Malden, Catherine Spaak, Rada Rassimov, Pier Paolo Capponi, Horst Frank, Aldo Reggiani, Carlo Alighiero, Vittorio Congia, Ugo Fangareggi
description: Carlo Giordani, a journalist, finds himself on the trail of the murder of a scientist who has discovered the genetic code of the inclination to delinquency. Giordani is helped by Franco Arnò, a blind man with a passion for puzzles. The two manage to contact the dead man's girlfriend, but she too, shortly after, ends badly. The matter is becoming more and more risky and tangled.
notes: The story is rather labyrinthine and does not abound in twists, despite the ending. After the successful debut with "The bird with the crystal feathers", Dario Argento takes a small step back here. The music is by Ennio Morricone.

title: Puss in Booth
actors: Christopher Walken, Jason Connery, Carmela Marner, Yossi Graber, Elki Jacobs, Amnon Meskin, Ya'ackov Ben-Sira, Michael Schneider, Yehoyachin Friedlander
description: A miller's son inherits ... a cat, but the animal is a crafty three-crush and it will be his luck.

title: The Cat and the Canary
actors: Honor Blackman, Michael Callan, Edward Fox, Wendy Hiller, Olivia Hussey, Beatrix Lehmann, Carol Lynley, Daniel Massey, Peter McEnery, Wilfrid Hyde-White
description: In a villa in the English countryside, a group of people has gathered to learn the contents of the will of the very rich deceased, Cyrus West. The heir turns out to be the young fashion designer Annabelle, but her satisfaction and the tranquility of all present are disturbed by the news that a mad murderer has escaped from a nearby criminal asylum. And in fact, after a while, here is a first victim ...
notes: The opening part of the film, with a very accurate setting, conveys the gothic atmosphere of this story brought to the screen countless times (from Paul Leni in '27 to Jesus Franco). But little of this suggestion is then maintained.

title: Il gatto mammone
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Rossana Podestà, Gloria Guida, Grazia Di Marzà, Tiberio Murgia, Franco Lantieri, Sofia Lusy, Tiberio Murgia, Umberto Spadaro
description: Lollo Mascialucia is a small Sicilian industrialist who is convinced that his wife is sterile. To satisfy his desire for fatherhood, in agreement with the woman, he convinces a single mother to mate with him to finally have the heir, but it doesn't work. The wife then takes care of it, with a substitute for her husband who, now clearly, was sterile.
notes: Yet another variation on the theme of Mediterranean virility with the omnipresent Buzzanca, "Sicilian lover" par excellence in the seventies, and then, with the end of the pecoreccio genre, rightly disappeared from the scene.

title: Il gaucho
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Amedeo Nazzari, Silvana Pampanini, Nino Manfredi, Nelly Panizza, Maria Grazia Buccella, Annie Gorassini, Umberto D'Orsi, Guido Gorgatti, Norberto Sánchez Calleja, Maria Fiore, Francesco Mulè
description: Marco Ravicchio leads a miserable delegation of Italian filmmakers to a festival in Buenos Aires. Amidst trifles and provincialisms, there is the opportunity to exploit the nostalgia for Italy of an emigrant who made a fortune and to meet another who has remained a poor fellow.
notes: Risi and the screenwriters play at home with the undergrowth of our cinema and give it a portrait of smug malice. Gassman builds one of his best characters as an unpunished scoundrel and the other performers make him the crown for a vitriolic group picture.

title: Diabolo Menthe
actors: Eleonore Klarwein, Odile Michel, Anouk Ferjac, Michel Puterflam, Yves Rénier, Robert Rimbaud, Marie-Véronique Maurin, Corinne Dacla
description: Fréderique and Anne are two restless girls who attend the Ferry high school in Paris. The 60s are in the midst of their transgressions and yet the two girls are forced to submit to the strict rules of the institute, managed with an iron fist and managed with methods of the past. The adolescent disturbances will completely unleash the irreverence of the protagonists.
notes: A curious "teen-age movie" of French brand well directed and interpreted. It was a success at home, also for the sexual-sentimental winks of the story and for the all-Parisian verve of the setting.

title: Jealousy
actors: Angie Dickinson, David Carradine, Richard Mulligan, Paul Michael Glaser, Chuck Martinez, Jennifer Navarro, France Nuyen, Virginia Peters, Julie Philips, Ray Stricklyn, Bo Svenson
description: Georgia is a rich lady with a new husband and a previous daughter who is too sexy not to provoke dangerous rivalries. Lynn, on the other hand, is one who became rich by marrying a billionaire and who cannot remain indifferent to his cheating. Finally, Ginny is a folk singer who finds herself at a crossroads: on the one hand a possessive boyfriend, on the other her artistic career.Unequal triptych on the theme of jealousy that sees Angie Dickinson as the protagonist in all three episodes. The most convincing is the second, the third can be left out. Next to her, not to be missed, Robert Carradine, Richard Mulligan and Paul Michael Glaser.

title: Modern Problems
actors: Chevy Chase, Patti D'Arbanville, Dabney Coleman, Mary Kay Place, Nell Carter, Brian Doyle-Murray, Mitch Kreindel, Arthur Sellers
description: A sudden radioactive leak grants superpowers to Max, one who has a lot of problems with women. Chevy Chase which in Italy has never managed to break through, is good; but the film is sluggish.

title: Twin Sisters
actors: Stepfanie Kramer, Susan Almgren, Frederic Forrest, James Brolin, Richard Zeman, Robert Morelli, Vlasta Vrana, Lawrence Dane
description: To investigate the disappearance of Lynn, her twin, Carole replaces her. In short, she ends up entangled in a prostitution ring where murders are the order of the day: a world in which Carole sees the most ambiguous and hidden aspects of her personality mirrored for the first time.
notes: Weak and pretentious thriller starring the dull Stephanie Kramer, known to viewers as Hunter's partner in the eponymous TV series. In this desert, the participation of Frederic Forrest ("Hammett") shines.

title: Twins
actors: Danny DeVito, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Chloe Webb, Kelly Preston, Bonnie Bartlett, Marshall Bell, Trey Wilson, David Caruso, Hugh O'Brian, Tony Jay, Nehemiah Persoff
description: The result of an exceptional artificial fertilization experiment, Julius and Vincent are two men of 35, twins who have always lived without knowing each other's existence. Not only that: Julius is gigantic, intelligent, cultured and naive like a child; Vincent is small, round, crafty trickster who has always lived on the edge of legality.
notes: Reitman not at his best, despite the two wild performers. Funny the first meeting between the "twins", with DeVito who looking at Schwarzy exclaims "since you arrived I have had the impression of seeing myself in a mirror ...".

title: Buttiglione diventa capo del Servizio Segreto
actors: Jacques Dufilho, Gianni Cavina, Franco Diogene, Raf Luca, Gianni Agus, Mino Guerrini, Karin Field
description: Between Geneva, Hamburg and Rome, it is a question of unmasking the enemy agent "Dollar" through a spying operation, coded "Lynx Eye". In practice, apart from a sequence in which Buttiglione causes disasters by riding upside down, we have a series of slow and predictable "gags". The series built on this protagonist has expanded dramatically.

title: Il generale Della Rovere
actors: Vittorio De Sica, Hannes Messemer, Sandra Milo, Giovanna Ralli, Vittorio Caprioli, Nando Angelini, Anne Vernon, Linda Veras, Lucia Modugno, Luciano Pigozzi
description: Giovanni Bertone is a petty crook who, posing as an army general, swindles the family members of German prisoners. One day he is discovered by the Gestapo and arrested. In exchange for his freedom, the authorities ask him to collaborate by collecting information on the partisans in prison.
notes: Based on a short story by Indro Montanelli scripted by Diego Fabbri, Sergio Amidei and Rossellini himself, the film is one of Rossellini's most controversial works, which sparked heated controversy for its representation of the Resistance. In any case, the return to resistance issues (here and in the contemporary "It was night in Rome") obviously remains inferior to the masterpieces of the immediate post-war period. He won the Golden Lion at the twentieth ex aequo Film Festival with "La grande guerra" and the Nastro d'Argento for best direction.

title: Il generale dorme in piedi
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Mariangela Melato, Franco Fabrizi, Mario Scaccia, Daniele Vargas, Stefano Satta Flores, Checco Rissone, Edda Ferronao, Georges Wilson, Piero Nuti, Gianni Solaro, Enzo Robutti
description: Colonel Leone, a veterinarian "promoted" as a doctor out of necessity, becomes director of the Higher School of Health, but not a general, as he would like more than anything else. Forced to sleep standing up, because lying down he reveals dangerous truths about the army in his sleep, writes his memoirs, and they are not roses and flowers for the military hierarchy. As long as you don't publish them, you get the "Greek".
notes: It could have been a much more biting satire of the military if it hadn't been trivialized by resorting to farcical solutions of little incisiveness. The interpreters are good, but the screenplay is too messy and the direction appears to be on the loose.

title: Demon Seed
actors: Julie Christie, Fritz Weaver, Gerrit Graham, Berry Kroeger, Lisa Lu, Larry J. Blake, John O'Leary, Alfred Dennis, Davis Roberts, Patricia Wilson
description: After years of work in a secret laboratory, some scientists have developed Proteus IV, a very sophisticated computer, capable of self-programming and which highlights human behavior. Proteus soon shows that he is tormented by the idea of ??procreation and Susan, the wife of the computer programmer, pays the price. Not without difficulty Proteus is deactivated, but in the meantime Susan is expecting a baby.
notes: On a subject fascinated by the myth of Beauty and the Beast, based on a novel by Dean R. Koontz, Cammell constructs a film that oscillates between pure thriller and science fiction. Charming and mysterious Julie Christie.

actors: Warren Beatty, Goldie Hawn, Gert Fröbe, Robert Webber, Scott Brady, Arthur Brauss, Robert Stiles, Wolfgang Kieling, Bob Herron
description: Joe is an expert in anti-theft systems. Only he knows how to get into a bank in Hamburg, for which he designed the security apparatus, and "make" a million and a half dollars. But the customers of the bank robbed are shady characters who take the matter very badly, so Joe, along with the life girl who helped him, will have some problems before enjoying the swag. Light-hearted metaphor about immoral and criminal capitalism mocked by an enterprising thief. The meticulous sequence of the robbery is breathtaking, with Beatty locked inside the system he himself designed.

title: Le grand escogriffe
actors: Yves Montand, Agostina Belli, Claude Brasseur, Adolfo Celi, Aldo Maccione, Valentina Cortese, Guy Marchand, Ely Galleani, Gianni Cavina
description: Emilio, theatrical impresario several times imprisoned for fraud, this time aims high. With the complicity of a young partner and an actress, he kidnaps the son of an oilman, replacing him with a nice urchin: but this time too the plan goes up in smoke, because the oilman prefers to keep the new child much more sympathetic than the legitimate one, while accomplices understand that life is not for them. Comedy of good feelings and poor results directed by the future director of Il tempo delle mele.

title: Genitori in blue-jeans
actors: Peppino De Filippo, Ugo Tognazzi, Scilla Gabel, Sylva Koscina, Franco Fabrizi, Jacqueline Jones, Corrado Pani, Cathia Caro, Alberto Talegalli, Irene Tunc, Tiberio Murgia, Mario Carotenuto
description: In Rome, many people frequent the renowned Peppino tailor's shop, which refuses all marriage proposals. Mario lives on the money of his wife Lisa, who owns a ladies' linen shop; Renzino, despite his age not greener, continues to seek adventures with girls; Gianni sells cars and goes on to bills. Peppino and Mario have to go to Paris and here the tailor meets the beautiful Margaret: he decides to marry her, but only after the decision does he learn that the woman is a stripper.
notes: Comedy without too many pretensions and skits from the show. The cast partially redeems the weakness of the subject.

title: Ordinary People
actors: Timothy Hutton, Donald Sutherland, Mary Tyler Moore, Judd Hirsch, M. Emmet Walsh, Elizabeth McGovern, Dinah Manoff, Fredric Lehne, James Sikking, Basil Hoffman
description: The young Conrad belongs to a wealthy Illinois family and is burdened with distressing memories: long ago his older brother drowned and Conrad believes himself responsible for the misfortune. The feeling is also fueled by the mother's attitude. First direction for the "liberal" Robert Redford who proves to be very skilled even behind the camera, and able to evoke some themes that were in the air in the years of the ebb. Intimist, not too pimp and with good and well directed actors. Four Oscars: film, direction, non-original screenplay and supporting actor (Hutton).

title: Winter People
actors: Kurt Russell, Kelly McGillis, Lloyd Bridges, Mitchell Ryan, Jeffrey Meek, Don Michael Paul, Lanny Flaherty, Eileen Ryan, Amelia Burnette
description: Wayland Jackson has a watch shop in North Carolina during the Great Depression. Left a widower, he decides to move to Philadelphia with his daughter Paula. During the journey, the car crashes and the two find temporary hospitality in a cabin inhabited by Collie and his son. When Wayland decides to stay because he has been entrusted with building the town clock, Collie's husband reappears.
notes: The idea of ??Kurt Russell's carter's big hands, handling the delicate mechanisms of clocks, is no small feat. Fortunately, Kelly McGillis is there to lend some credibility to the story.

title: Gente dell'aria
actors: Gino Cervi, Antonio Centa, Antonio Gandusio, Paolo Stoppa, Adriana Benetti, Elisa Cegani, Aldo Silvani, Virgilio Riento, Guido Notari, Luigi Pavese
description: Two half-brothers united by the love of flying, but divided by that for a woman. Drama of veiled fascist aviation propaganda.

title: Night People
actors: Gregory Peck, Broderick Crawford, Anita Björk, Rita Gam, Walter Abel, Buddy Ebsen, Max Showalter, Jill Esmond, Peter Van Eyck, Marianne Koch
description: In the Berlin of the Cold War years, a young American soldier is kidnapped by the Russians. Negotiations for an exchange begin, but things get complicated because a Soviet spy mediates ...
notes: Directs with intensity and vigor the great screenwriter Nunnally Johnson (_Furore_, _Quella dirty dozen_).

title: La gentilezza del tocco
actors: Maurizio Puglisi, Antonio Alveario, Rosalba Scimone, Daniela Pacetto, Ninni Bruschetta
description: A scrupulous proofreader, reviewing the review that the newspaper's music critic dedicated to a young pianist's concert, is convinced that he has found a phrase that reveals a relationship between the two. He begins to investigate: at first he enters the critic's study in search of clues, then he pretends to be a journalist to interview the girl.
notes: The "yellow" plot is only a pretext. Calogero ("Metronotte") uses it for a very personal reconnaissance in the mental universe of its protagonist, between philosophy, literature and film references. Between Pessoa and Rohmer.

title: The Big Cube
actors: Lana Turner, George Chakiris, Richard Egan, Dan O'Herlihy, Karin Mossberg, Pamela Rodgers, Carlos East, Augusto Benedico, Victor Junco, Norma Herrera
description: Actress Adriana Roman retires from the stage to marry Charles Winthrop, a well-known businessman (and rumored fixer). Charles's daughter, however, is not thrilled with her stepmother and devises a plan to drive her insane. Through large doses of LSD administered in secret.
notes: Almost a television novel of less than two hours that exploits the popularity of a declining star. But the story seems curiously almost autobiographical: who does not remember the scandal of Lana Turner's daughter who (perhaps) killed her mother's mafia lover and gifted, Johnny Stompanato?

title: Gerarchi si muore
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Aldo Fabrizi, Luigi Pavese, Hélène Chanel, Vittorio Congia, Yvonne Monlaur, Vicky Ludovici, Carla Calò, Nino Fuscagni, Fanfulla, Raimondo Vianello, Ubaldo Lay
description: To save himself from bankruptcy, an industrialist enters into partnership with a former fascist hierarch, a maniac of castles. In the manor that the industrialist owns, his "partner" organizes a kind of camp for nostalgics. Neither, however, has come to terms with the ghost of the old owner, the baron of Roccanera, who lives in the ancient mansion and combines all the colors of it, destroying the marriage between the industrialist's son and the former's daughter hierarch.
notes: A modest film, which sinks into the most obvious banality, despite the presence of Fabrizi and the others. The setting in the twenty years is a mere pretext.

title: Germania anno zero
actors: Edmund Moeschke, Ernst Pittschau, Ingetraud Hinze, Franz-Otto Krüger, Erich Gühne
description: The story of little Edmund in Berlin devastated by the bombings: the invalid father, the wanted Nazi elder brother, the prostitute sister. The only person he can communicate with is a former Nazi professor, who pushes him to poison his father. Finally Edmund throws himself from a dilapidated building. A masterpiece of extreme pessimism that moves the investigation of the contemporary reality of "Rome open city" and "Paisà" to defeated Germany. Rossellini goes beyond neorealism, in a disenchanted look at history and human nature. Among the peaks of the history of cinema, the final, silent wandering of the child among the rubble of the city: immense and unsustainable.

title: Gervaise
actors: Maria Schell, François Périer, Suzy Delair, Armand Mestral, Jany Holt, Mathilde Casadesus, Florelle, Micheline Luccioni, Lucien Hubert
description: A country girl has long been the mistress of a hatter, and by the man she had two children. Hoping to rebuild a life, she goes to Paris where she meets a good-natured bricklayer who falls in love with her and marries her. After some time, due to an accident at work, the man turns to alcohol and all the few savings of the family go away in treatment. At this point the first lover who wants to exploit her reappears.
notes: The film is based on the famous novel "The Assommoir" by Zola, adapted by the most famous screenwriters of "Papa's cinema", Aurenche and Bost, and gives a good approximation of the social climate of the Paris of the Second Empire. The interpreters were measured but effective (Maria Schell was awarded in Venice).

title: The Getaway
actors: Steve McQueen, Ali MacGraw, Ben Johnson, Al Lettieri, Sally Struthers, Slim Pickens, Richard Bright, Jack Dodson, Dub Taylor
description: A politician manages to get Doc, a hardened criminal, out of prison before he has served his entire sentence; in exchange the latter has to rob a bank for him. The blow is scored with some accomplices who, however, compete for the booty. Doc escapes to Mexico with his money and his wife, chased by his accomplice, whom he had thought dead, and by the police. However, the road is very long and the dangers are always lurking. Will the skilled Doc succeed in his intent?
notes: From a Jim Thompson novel, adapted and scripted by Walter Hill, Peckinpah directs the only detective story of his career. The director of the "Wild Bunch" transforms the escape to freedom of the robber and his beautiful and courageous wife into a contemporary western. Deadly traps, a chase to the last breath and an unpredictable ending. An opaque remake of the film was shot in 1994.

title: Throw Momma From the Train
actors: Danny DeVito, Billy Crystal, Anne Ramsey, Kate Mulgrew, Bruce Kirby, Kim Greist, Branford Marsalis, Rob Reiner, Joey DePinto, Annie Ross, Oprah Winfrey
description: Donner is a professor at a small university. His wife took possession of one of his manuscripts and published it as his own, achieving great success. Owen Lift attends Donner's classes as an auditor and is obsessed with a tyrannical mother. Owen proposes an exchange to Donner: he will kill his wife, while the professor in exchange will free him from the maternal presence. It sounds easy, but wives and mothers are strong fiber and have luck on their side. The two would-be murders will console themselves with literature ...
notes: De Vito's wickedness here is inspired by the Hitchcockian "Crime by crime", exasperating his proverbial misogyny to the maximum.

title: Cold Heat
actors: Britt Ekland, John Phillip Law, Robert Sacchi, Roy Summerset, Chance Michael Corbitt, Joanne Watkins, Greg Rundo, Jerry Vogel
description: It is the story of the mistreatment and harassment that two parents inflict on their son. In this disastrous film, Lommel also involves Britt Ekland. A bad end also for her who had been one of Bond's girls in Agent 007. The man with the golden gun.

title: Green Ice
actors: Ryan O'Neal, Anne Archer, Omar Sharif, Domingo Ambriz, John Larroquette, Philip Stone, Michael Sheard, Enrique Lucero, Manuel Ojeda
description: John Wiley gives beautiful Lilian a lift on a Mexican street. Lilian learns that her sister has disappeared in Colombia. On their way to the scene, they discover that she was killed while smuggling emeralds for a group of guerrillas. It is only the beginning of a risky series of vicissitudes from which John and Lilian will come out safe and sound.
notes: Exoticism of an unlikely libertarian brand, at the service of a conventional adventure film. Names of recall those of the male protagonists, however at the time already sufficiently "cooked". The soundtrack is signed by Rolling Stones bassist Bill Wyman.

title: Ghost
actors: Patrick Swayze, Demi Moore, Whoopi Goldberg, Tony Goldwyn, Rick Aviles, Vincent Schiavelli, Bruce Jarchow, Gail Boggs, Armelia McQueen, Stephen Root
description: Between Sam and Molly is the great love, but he is killed in an ambush. His ghost stays close to the woman, but he cannot communicate with her. When the deceased Sam discovers that it was Carl, his best friend, who wanted her death, he has the problem of protecting the woman from the maneuvers of the sinister mandator (there is some dirty money involved to be laundered) and finds the collaboration of the seer Oda.
notes: Curious contamination between the otherworldly "fashion" and the thriller, the film by Zucker (known for its crazy parodies with the Abrahams brothers) discreetly holds the mixture between the motives of the heart and those of fear. Tasty the "sorceress" by Whoopi Goldberg.

title: Ghostbusters
actors: Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd, Sigourney Weaver, Harold Ramis, Rick Moranis, Annie Potts, William Atherton, Ernie Hudson, David Margulies, Steven Tash
description: Peter, Raymond and Egon have been kicked out of college, but their partnership against the ghosts that populate New York and cause serious ailments works wonders. It's a tough fight but our heroes fear nothing, not even the evil one.
notes: The terrifying trio of Canadians (Aykroyd and Harold Ramis as screenwriters, Ivan Reitman as director) make this wild and imaginative comedy that was an incredible commercial success. The best things are legacy of the "Saturday Night Show", with the addition of state-of-the-art special effects for the time. Priceless Bill Murray.

title: Ghostbusters II
actors: Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd, Sigourney Weaver, Harold Ramis, Rick Moranis, Ernie Hudson, Annie Potts, Peter MacNicol, Harris Yulin, David Margulies, Kurt Fuller, Janet Margolin
description: Four years have passed since the first adventures against the ghostly presences that loom over New York and Raymond, Egon and Peter (this time with the collaboration of Winston) must return to the field with their contraptions. In fact, our heroes discover, right in the bowels of the Big Apple, the origin of the mephitic gelatinous mass, a tangible sign of the terrible presences. But where does it come from so bad?
notes: Rather repetitive sequel to "Ghostbusters". The actors, Reitman's solid direction and superfine special effects, however, ensure some fun.

title: Giallo
actors: Assia Noris, Sandro Ruffini, Elio Steiner, Giuditta Rissone, Carlo Ranieri, Giulio Gemmò, Aronne Limardi, Carlo Lombardi, Vanda Barbini
description: Henriette has a passion for detective stories with which she tries to overcome boredom; her husband is in fact a landowner who is completely absorbed in his work. The woman finds compression in an engineer, who begins to court her, a brilliant and wild Camerini, inspired by a comedy by Edgar Wallace, adapting it with Mario Soldati, with Assia Noris in top form.

title: The Moonspinners
actors: Hayley Mills, Eli Wallach, Peter McEnery, Joan Greenwood, Irene Papas, John Le Mesurier, Paul Stassino, Sheila Hancock, Michael Davis, André Morell, Pola Negri, George Pastell, Tutte Lemkow, Harry Tardios, Steve Plytas, Pamela Barrie
description: The young Englishwoman Nikki has chosen Crete as her holiday destination. During his stay on the Greek island he meets Mark, a man on the trail of an elusive thief who has stolen a precious necklace. The girl thus becomes a pawn in the "game" between robbed and malefactor, which ends with the triumph of justice and love.
notes: The film is produced by Walt Disney, which obviously dampens the tones of yellow. Good interpreters, the setting in the calendar Mediterranean panorama is effective. It was the last interpretation, after a long absence from the sets, for Pula Negri, one of the great divers of the silent.

title: Men at Work
actors: Charlie Sheen, Emilio Estevez, Leslie Hope, Keith David, Dean Cameron, John Getz, Hawk Wolinski, John Lavachielli, Geoffrey Blake, Cameron Dye, Darrel Larson
description: Two close friends, Carl and James, dream of opening a surf shop in California. In the meantime they arrange themselves as garbage collectors. They accidentally discover that the biggest polluter in the area is a greedy and arrogant chemical industrialist. Thus the hunt for the yellow bin with the waste and the dead is unleashed.
notes: Funny comedy without many pretensions, with an ecological background. It could be the progenitor of a yellow-green-pink type of cinema: for the moment it remains a captivating fairy tale, to be watched while munching popcorn.

title: Giallo napoletano
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Ornella Muti, Renato Pozzetto, Zeudi Araya, Michel Piccoli, Capucine, Peppino De Filippo, Peppe Barra, Franco Javarone, Gennarino Palumbo, Carlo Taranto
description: Professor of classical mandolin who has fallen to the rank of busker, Raffaele finds himself in trouble because of his father, a player with holes in his hands. Serious troubles: a string of murders involving the most disparate characters, from a gambler to a nun. Confused and speckled, he lets himself be watched for the kilometric cast even if the plot leaks from all sides.

title: Gian Burrasca
actors: Alvaro Vitali, Mario Carotenuto, Marisa Merlini, Gigi Reder, Gisella Sofio, Enzo Robutti, Clara Colosimo, Tuccio Musumeci, Gianfranco Barra, Diana Dei, Toni Ucci
description: Giannino (Vitali) is a terrible child, the only son of the Stoppani family, made up of three sisters of marriageable age and a father, a rich merchant in Umbertine Rome. The whole family lives with the nightmare of pranks combined by Giannino, nicknamed, not surprisingly, Gian Burrasca.
notes: Pier Francesco Pingitore recovers Alvaro Vitali for a really ugly version of the famous book by Vamba (pseudonym of Luigi Bertelli), "Il Giornino di Gian Burrasca". The comedy is a little too heavy and even boring. Of course Rita Pavone was something else.

title: Giarabub
actors: Carlo Ninchi, Doris Duranti, Mario Ferrari, Carlo Romano, Alberto Sordi, Annibale Betrone, Elio Steiner, Erminio Spalla, Corrado De Cenzo
description: During the Second World War, in North Africa, a group of Italian soldiers remained isolated in the Giarabub fort. The last column carrying the supplies is destroyed by the enemy and the only possibility seems to be that of accepting an honorable surrender. But the Italian commander decides to resist indefinitely and rejects any hypothesis of compromise. A lot of rhetoric and some good sequences in a film about the war shot by Alessandrini during the war. In short, a kind of "instant movie" for propaganda purposes. Among the actors there is also the twenty-two year old Alberto Sordi, who, with the utmost originality, plays the part of Lieutenant Sordi.

title: Il giardino dei Finzi Contini
actors: Lino Capolicchio, Dominique Sanda, Fabio Testi, Helmut Berger, Romolo Valli, Camillo Cesarei, Inna Alexeievna, Katina Morisani, Barbara Pilavin
description: We are in Ferrara, in the years leading up to the Second World War; also in Italy anti-Semitic politics is about to take off. In the luxurious villa of the Finzi Contini, an ancient and aristocratic Jewish family, daily events, loves and sentimental misunderstandings follow one another among the youngest offspring. But these amorous dramas are soon overwhelmed by the cruel historical drama of war and deportations.
notes: From the novel by Giorgio Bassani (who withdrew the signature from the screenplay) one of the last films by De Sica, with a slightly lifeless historical reconstruction and with kitschy moments (the ending with the tennis match in soft focus). The Sanda is splendid. Awarded in 1971 with the Golden Bear at the Berlinale and the David di Donatello and in 1972 with the Oscar for best foreign film. Countless international awards also to performers.

title: The Blue Bird
actors: Elizabeth Taylor, Jane Fonda, Ava Gardner, Oleg Popov, Margarita Terekhova, Cicely Tyson, Todd Lookinland, Patsy Kensit, Will Geer, Mona Washbourne, Robert Morley
description: Tyltyl and Myltyl are the very young children of a lumberjack who on Christmas Eve dream of going, with the guidance of a sorceress, in search of the mythical blue bird that gives happiness. They stumble upon all sorts of portents and find that happiness is at hand; when they wake up, in fact, they see that the bird they keep in the house is blue like that of the dream.
notes: Based on the famous symbolist tale by Maurice Maeterlinck (already brought to the screen with Shirley Temple in 1940), a sumptuous fairy tale co-produced by the United States and Russia directed by veteran George Cukor. Colorful and slightly parchment allegory of music and ballets, with American stars and Russian virtuosos.

title: The Curse of the Cat People
actors: Simone Simon, Kent Smith, Jane Randolph, Ann Carter, Ann Carter, Eve March, Julia Dean, Elizabeth Russell
description: After the death of Irena, the first wife, Oliver married Alice and from the union was born little Amy. The girl, however, has problems and builds a fantasy world inhabited by an imaginary friend, who is always Irena. When Julia Farren, a half-mad neighbor who always tells her strange fairy tales, dies, Amy risks being strangled by her daughter, Barbara. Irena's spirit takes care of her. It's the sequel to the Panther's Kiss, but we're actually closer to Henry James' Turn of the Screw. Debut film for Robert Wise, the editor of Fourth Estate, who replaces Gunther Von Fritsch mid-production. Fairytale and feminine horror. A cult film.

title: The Garden of Allah
actors: Marlene Dietrich, Charles Boyer, Tilly Losch, Basil Rathbone, C. Aubrey Smith, Joseph Schildkraut, John Carradine, Alan Marshal, Lucile Watson, Henry Brandon
description: A wealthy widow traveling across the desert falls in love with an expelled priest. Oscar for photography.

title: The Assam Garden
actors: Deborah Kerr, Madhur Jaffrey, Alec McCowen, Zia Mohyeddin, Ronald Russell, Daisy Bell, Peggy Ann Wood, Iain Cuthbertson, Simon Hedger
description: Helen wants to restore the exotic garden that her late husband built years ago on their return from India. A neighbor, the Indian Ruxmani, offers her collaboration. Two different personalities thus find themselves side by side: for Helen, who accepts the offer of her neighbor almost as a due service, it will be an opportunity to get off the pedestal of privileges she was used to in the colony, for the other the possibility of remain linked to its homeland.
notes: A rookie director, a brilliant screenplay, two actresses in a prodigious competition for an intelligent, profound and at times ironic film.

title: The Wreck of Mary Deare
actors: Gary Cooper, Charlton Heston, Virginia McKenna, Michael Redgrave, Emlyn Williams, Cecil Parker, Alexander Knox, Richard Harris, Ben Wright
description: During a violent storm in the English Channel, a collision occurs between a lifeboat and a cargo ship. From the first, a man gets on board the second and remains practically a prisoner there, while the ship runs aground.
notes: There are two paths that the plot weaves in its development: the adventurous one of the accident on the sea and the ideological one of affirming the honesty of the commander of the rammed ship. The direction is strictly professional, the film is without surprises. Screenplay by the master of spy-stories Eric Ambler.

title: The Mountain Men
actors: Charlton Heston, Brian Keith, Stephen Nacht, Victoria Racimo, John Glover, Seymour Cassel, David Ackroyd, William Lucking
description: Bill (Heston) and Henry (Keith), two seasoned trappers, with the Ravens resist an attack by the Blackfoot led by Black Eagle, whose mistreated squaw, captured, falls in love with Bill. Black Eagle manages to take back the woman and destroy the Raven village, but the battle is not over. Nostalgic Western, beautifully set, where mature cowboys make Indian girls' hearts beat faster as "fire water" flows freely. With Heston we see Brian Keith, the excellent protagonist of Death rides a Rio Bravo (1961), the debut of Sam Peckinpah.

title: I giganti di Roma
actors: Richard Harrison, Wandisa Guida, Ettore Manni, Philippe Hersent, Ralph Hudson, Nicole Tessier, Goffredo Unger, Renato Baldini, Piero Lulli, Alessandro Sperli
description: Four valiant soldiers of Caesar commando neutralize a powerful war machine of Vercingetorix.

title: Bombers B-52
actors: Karl Malden, Marsha Hunt, Natalie Wood, Efrem Zimbalist jr., Don Kelly, Nelson Leigh, Robert Nichols, Ray Montgomery, Robert Hover
description: New B-52 bombers are about to arrive at a US military airbase. Sergeant Chas Brennan, one of the base's specialists, decides to postpone his leave so that he can train the crews. Brennan has a daughter with whom the young Colonel Herlihy, commander of the base, falls in love. The relationship is frowned upon by the old non-commissioned officer. An act of heroism by both will heal misunderstandings.
notes: It is a classic propaganda film of the American military armed forces, to which the romantic story is attached. During the years of the Cold War it was not uncommon for cinema to "flex its muscles".

title: Patterns
actors: Van Heflin, Everett Sloane, Ed Begley, Beatrice Straight, Elizabeth Wilson, Joanna Roos, Valerie Cossart, Eleni Kiamos, Ronnie Welsh
description: The director of a company takes on a young man and immediately competes with a wider colleague in which he should later take over. The tense climate that is created in the office brings the nerves to the old employee who, after a dramatic session of the Board of Directors, dies of a heart attack.
notes: Good melodramasocial in typical TV style engaged in those years (Screenplay by Rod Serling starting from one of his TV-drama) on a torn friendship from the tragic epilogue, which leaves its mark on all the protagonists of the dramatic story.

title: Giggi il bullo
actors: Alvaro Vitali, Adriana Russo, Susanna Fassetta, Marcello Furgiele, Cinzia De Carolis, Ennio Girolami, Gianfranco Barra, Diana Dei, Venantino Venantini
description: Giggi is a "lively" boy from the township convinced that "in life you always have to go first". And, for better or worse, he gains a certain popularity, between blows given and blows, left and right, in his days that can only end in the bars of the jail or on the litter of the emergency room.
notes: Talking about the subject, script or direction for this film would be completely inappropriate. We just have a series of gags glued to each other somehow, and nothing more. Too bad they don't even make you laugh.

title: Gigi
actors: Leslie Caron, Maurice Chevalier, Louis Jourdan, Hermione Gingold, Eva Gabor, Jacques Bergerac, Isabel Jeans, John Abbott
description: Gigi, a pretty little provincial girl, lives with her grandmother and an aunt in Paris. They hope that the little one will become a luxury socialite. They also set their sights on the possible "protector": the very wealthy Gaston Lachaille. Gaston, however, being truly in love with Gigi, disdainfully refuses. The same girl, revealing a strong character, opposes the drawings of the two relatives. In a delightful postcard Paris, with a delightful Leslie Caron, the songs of Lerner and Loewe and a sly Chevalier (Oscar for Lifetime Achievement), a sumptuous musical inspired by a Colette novel. Nine Oscars: Best Film, Direction, Screenplay, Photography, Costumes, Music, Song, Set Design, Editing.

title: Schöner Gigolo, armer Gigolo
actors: David Bowie, Sydne Rome, Kim Novak, Marlene Dietrich, David Hemmings, Maria Schell, Erika Pluhar, Hilde Weissner, Werner Pochath, Rudolf Schündler, Evelyn Künneke, Friedhelm Lehmann
description: Veteran of the First World War returns to Berlin and becomes the gigolo of Baroness Von Semering (Dietrich). Useless and long. Too bad old Marlene's last appearance was in such a mess.

title: Gilda
actors: Rita Hayworth, Glenn Ford, George Macready, Joseph Calleia, Steven Geray, Joe Sawyer, Gerald Mohr, Mark Roberts, Ludwig Donath, Donald Douglas
description: Gilda, a dancer, marries Ballin to spite Johnny, the ex-lover who left her. Later Ballin saves the life of Johnny who, out of gratitude, agrees to work in his gambling den, where he naturally finds Gilda whose marriage he was unaware of. The new meeting between the two triggers feelings that now seemed extinct.
