notes: Cult movie that consecrated Hayworth's wild beauty. Aside from the legendary iconography, Vidor's is a great film also for the construction, the script and the sense of inexorable fatality that is given to the passion. Very good Glenn Ford.

title: Gilda Live
actors: Gilda Radner, Don Novello, Paul Shaffer, Nils Nichols, Bob Christianson, Howard Shore, Diana Grasselli, Myriam Valle, María Vidal
description: Songs and characters of the famous showgirl Gilda Radner directly from the Broadway stage to the movie screen. There are also uncensored versions of his Saturday Night Live appearances, but who knows if Italian viewers will appreciate.

title: Ginger e Fred
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Giulietta Masina, Franco Fabrizi, Friedrich von Ledebur, Augusto Poderosi, Martin Maria Blau, Jacques Henri Lartigue, Totò Mignone, Ezio Marano, Antoine Saint-John, Friedrich von Thun
description: Amelia and Pippo, aka Ginger and Fred, had been successful on the provincial stages in the distant 1940s. They find themselves, after decades, to participate in a variety of old glories organized by a private television. A nightmare experience, but the two will have the pleasure of having met for a moment.
notes: Fellini takes a stand on TV and against the hedonism of the Eighties. Mastroianni and Masina illuminate the scene; the great from Rimini did better, but some moments (the arrival at the station) and the anguished atmosphere have the master's touch.

title: At Play in the Fields of the Lord
actors: Tom Berenger, John Lithgow, Daryl Hannah, Aidan Quinn, Tom Waits, Kathy Bates, Stênio Garcia, Nelson Xavier, José Dumont
description: Jealousy and rivalry between Catholic and Protestant missionaries operating in the Amazon rainforest among the indigenous people of the Niaruna tribe. An Indian mercenary aviator also contributes to add to the confusion, who, faced with the order to bomb an entire tribe, rebels and parachutes among the Indians to start a new life. Three hours of images, now violent, now glossy, in a film that chooses the compromise between aestheticism and realism. Based on the novel by Peter Matthiessen and directed by Hector Babenco, the film is finally boring despite the production effort.

title: Jinxed!
actors: Bette Midler, Ken Wahl, Rip Torn, Val Avery, Jack Elam, Benson Fong, Jacqueline Scott, F. William Parker, Ian Wolfe
description: Willie is an unfortunate dealer who is continually fired whenever he finds Harold, a semi-professional gambler in his way. In Reno he allies himself with Bonita, Harold's woman; the two try in every way to kill him, but Harold beats them on time by committing suicide. Getting their hands on insurance money is pretty tricky, but after a first breakup Willie and Bonita will find a win-win deal. The film that closed Don Siegel's long career is a cynical and immoral comedy which parodies the theme of Billy Wilder's "Flame of Sin". Underestimated at the time, in reality it does not deny the author's qualities of speed and malice. Repent of Hollywood Enriched (in the real sense) by the recent success of the "First Wives Club", Bette Midler has invested a large part of the nest egg in the purchase of a fabulous penthouse on Fifth Avenue, in the heart of Manhattan, a few steps from the house by another famous filmmaker: Woody Allen. Thus the ranks of the "repentants of Beverly Hills" swell, ie actors and directors who have left the West Coast, with its risk of earthquakes and its violent ghettos, for the more reassuring Big Apple. From Hollywood on the Tiber to Hollywood on the Hudson.

title: Il giocattolo
actors: Nino Manfredi, Marlène Jobert, Arnoldo Foà, Olga Karlatos, Pamela Villoresi, Daniele Formica, Vittorio Mezzogiorno, Carlo Bagno, Renato Scarpa, Luciano Catenacci, Mario Brega
description: Vittorio has long been the factotum of an unscrupulous industrialist. Wounded in a robbery attempt, he decides to buy a gun. Some time later he kills a criminal and becomes a kind of hero for a few days in the circles of the rich Milanese bourgeoisie. But soon after he was abandoned by everyone, including the industrialist for whom he had lent himself to all kinds of trafficking. He then decides to take revenge.
notes: Film too openly a thesis, but unusual in the Italian panorama of the time: a little muted tension, some too many didacticism, but Manfredi is sober and convincing.

title: Giochi d'estate
actors: Massimo Ciavarro, Natasha Hovey, Corinne Cléry, Mauro Di Francesco, Giorgio Vignali, Valeria Cavalli, Karina Huff, Fabio Testi, Elisabetta Bartolomei
description: A group of young people on vacation in Porto Rotondo experiences emotional disturbances and various sentimental events. There are those who flaunt improbable riches and those who are a true nabob arousing the envy of others. Anxiety and joy intertwine until the season, as it declines, brings everyone back to the daily routine of life away from the beach
notes: Inconsistent product and lacking in originality. The only noteworthy thing about the film, albeit with inventory benefit, is Natasha Hovey not yet a "traveler" for Raitre.

title: Drowning by Numbers
actors: Joan Plowright, Juliet Stevenson, Joely Richardson, Bernard Hill, Jason Edwards, Bryan Pringle, Trevor Cooper, David Morissey, John Rogan, Paul Mooney, Jane Gurnett, Kenny Ireland, Michael Percival
description: Three women, grandmother, mother and granddaughter, have in common the name, Cissie Colpitts, the murder of their respective husbands and the complicity of the coroner, who is in love with all three. To get rid of the latter, they drown it during the night ceremony during which the ashes of the three spouses are scattered in the river. Under the starry sky, a little girl jumps rope, counting the names of a hundred stars. Sort of definitive triumph of the eternal feminine, to the detriment of the poor male and his presumption of domination. But of course this is only the most rational of the elements that chase each other on the surface of this nocturnal, liquid, impregnable film. The others are the propensity for pictorial mimesis, the obsession with decay, the ironic manipulation of the detective genre. And finally, hidden in the shots, all the numbers from 1 to 100 appear progressively.

title: The Last Starfighter
actors: Lance Guest, Robert Preston, Dan O'Herlihy, Catherine Mary Stewart, Kay E. Kuter, Dan Mason, Barbara Bosson, Norman Snow, Chris Hebert
description: Alex is a very good guy in video games. For this reason the extraterrestrial Centauri (Preston) takes him to his planet and proposes him to fight on the spaceships of the Star League against the fleet of Xur, a treacherous rebel. Alex refuses to stay close to Earth's affections, but Xur is now hunting him. Thus accepts the proposal of Centauri and, trained by an old and bizarre pilot, he defeats the rebels.
notes: Pleasant variation on the classic themes of the "Star Wars" vein. Effective characters built by Bob Preston and Dan O'Herlihy (the old Grig), and a series of imaginative contraptions of futuristic technology.

title: Gioco al massacro
actors: Elliott Gould, Tomas Milian, Nathalie Baye, John Steiner, Eva Robin's, Jennifer Rubina Laser, Peter Gale, Galeazzo Benti, Michael Gothard
description: Clem has an inferiority complex towards fellow director Theo, who accuses him of stealing a woman and an Oscar from him. The two decide to transfer the competition directly to an artistic level, making a film about each other's life. Each one does his script to the sound of low blows. Neurotic duel with an edifying ending, written and directed by a Damiani (starting from a play by him and by Raffaele La Capria) with many ambitions but without much inspiration.

title: The Falcon and the Snowman
actors: Timothy Hutton, Sean Penn, Pat Hingle, David Suchet, Lori Singer, Joyce Van Patten, Art Camacho, Annie Kozuch, Richard Dysart, Priscilla Pointer, Chris Makepeace, Dorian Harewood
description: Young Christopher Boyce (Hutton), after leaving seminary, finds a job at a company that builds spy satellites. He discovers that the CIA is engaged in dirty games against the Labor government in Australia. Outraged, he decides to pass on top-secret documents to the USSR to which he can gain access, and involves his friend Dalton Lee (Penn), drug addict and drug dealer. Dangers in sight for both of us. The film, based on a true story (about which Robert Lindsey wrote a novel) is told by the English Schlesinger (A Man from the Sidewalk) with a distracted craft and little care in developing the various themes.

title: Power Play
actors: Peter O'Toole, David Hemmings, Donald Pleasence, Barry Morse, Jon Granik, Marcella Saint-Amant, George Touliatos, Chuck Shamata, Gary Reineke, Harvey Atkin
description: To fight corruption in his country, Professor Jean Rousseau organizes a coup d'état together with a group of soldiers. Colonel Zeller (O'Toole) joins them, but with other intentions. Set in a fictional but obviously European country, this British Canadian co-production is abstract, wordy and not very exciting. Recommended for Peter O'Toole fans only.

title: The Mating Game
actors: Debbie Reynolds, Tony Randall, Paul Douglas, Fred Clark, Una Merkel, Philip Ober, Philip Coolidge, Charles Lane, Trevor Bardette, William Smith
description: Pop Larkin is a quiet farmer, widower, with a daughter. A neighbor, envious of his farm, reports him to the Tax Office, confident that the investigation will ruin the neighbor. The official who arrives at the farm for inspection quickly discovers two things: that Pop has never paid in his life, but also that his daughter is quite pretty.
notes: Debbie Reynolds, she is absolutely delightful and the other performers are no less. The direction also plays its part and the film, in the end, is fun and snappy.

title: The Magus
actors: Anthony Quinn, Michael Caine, Candice Bergen, Anna Karina, Paul Stassino, Julian Glover, Takis Emmanuel, George Pastell, Danièle Noël, Jerome Willis
description: A young Londoner accepts a teaching position at a school in Phraxos, an island in the Aegean. Here there is an apparently abandoned villa, but the protagonist, who has entered it, finds a strange man who invites him to stay as a guest. It is said that the owner was a collaborator of the Germans, and should have died, but inexplicable phenomena follow one another in the villa.
notes: An elegant, at times refined, packaging for a story that is fascinating in its own way, despite the fact that the deciphering of meanings is anything but easy. Cast of excellent actors and careful direction. From a novel by John Fowles, adapted by the author.

title: The Jewel of the Nile
actors: Danny DeVito, Michael Douglas, Kathleen Turner, Spyros Fokas, Avner Eisenberg, Holland Taylor, Paul David Magid, Howard Jay Patterson, Randall Edwin Nelson
description: Joan, a writer of romance and adventure novels, is once again tired of the life she leads. After the wedding, in fact, Jack only thinks about going on vacation. However, their relationship survives. At least until, during a party, the writer is not approached by a mysterious sheikh who asks her to write her biography. Joan accepts, and from there a new exotic adventure begins.
notes: After the success of "In pursuit of the Green Stone", the production immediately set up this sequel which, despite some funny scenes, is weaker than the original, perhaps due to a completely second-hand script.

title: Giordano Bruno
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, Hans Christian Blech, Charlotte Rampling, Mathieu Carrière, Renato Scarpa, Giuseppe Maffioli, José Quaglio, Massimo Foschi, Mark Burns, Mario Bardella
description: The film tells the last years of the Nolan philosopher Giordano Brunofino at the mrtirio in 1600: from his capture in Venice to the burning of Campo dei Fiori in Rome. Giovanni Mocenigo who hosts it and reports it to the Inquisition. The interrogations in Rome, the meeting with Cardinal Bellarmino, the torture, the stake. Shot by Montaldo immediately after "Sacco e Vanzetti", the film tries to reconcile its ideological value with the needs of the spectacular, succeeding to a large extent. It is the full-fledged portrait of a victim of power, in a society that still considered the hypothesis of a distinction between faith and science to be heretical and blasphemous. An intense Gianmaria Volonté and a visual reconstruction of Venice traced on the chiaroscuro of the great painters of the sixteenth century. Photography by Storaro, music by Morricone.

title: Une journée bien remplie
actors: Jacques Dufilho, André Falcon, Denise Péron, Antoine Marin, Luce Marquand, Franco Pesce, Andrée Bernard, Louis Malignon, Vittorio Caprioli
description: While his old father takes his place in the work of baking bread and in the shop, Jean, a gentle baker in his fifties, kills one by one all the nine jurors who have unjustly sent his son Fernand to the gallows.
notes: Good black humor for a well-constructed film written and directed by Jean-Louis Trintignant.

title: I giorni contati
actors: Salvo Randone, Paolo Ferrari, Vittorio Caprioli, Franco Sportelli, Regina Bianchi, Marcella Valeri, Angela Minervini, Lando Buzzanca
description: Cesare is a fifty-five-year-old plumber, a widower. Seeing someone of his age die, Cesare becomes aware that death could strike him too. So he decides to quit his job and enjoy what he has left to live. But it is useless to chase after youth that is now past, to cultivate hopes that result in as many disappointments: to defeat desperation and loneliness, he just has to go back to work. Intense and bitter elegy on the fading of life, Elio Petri's film deals with an unusual subject with excellent sensitivity and measure. Salvo Randone is formidable and gives the figure of Caesar an exceptional "truth".

title: Giorni d'amore
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Marina Vlady, Gildo Bocci, Giulio Calì, Angelina Longobardi, Dora Scarpetta, Fernando Jacovolta, Renato Chiantoni, Lucien Gallas
description: Two young peasants, Angela and Pasquale, love each other and would like to marry, but cannot do so due to the lack of the money necessary for the traditional ceremony. With the complicity of both parents, they decide to stage a fake kidnapping. Everything seems to be going well, but at the best their relatives quarrel, thus risking to compromise the success of the enterprise. De Santis, on vacation from the cinema directly involved, shoots a peasant fairy tale in color, however, anything but evasive.

title: Days of Heaven
actors: Richard Gere, Brooke Adams, Sam Shepard, Linda Manz, Robert J. Wilke, Jackie Shultis, Stuart Margolin, Timothy Scott, Gene Bell
description: We are in the United States, at the beginning of the century. Bill, a good young man, emigrates from Chicago to the Midwest. His girlfriend Abby and her little sister travel with him. Finding a job with the wealthy Chuck, Bill convinces Abby to marry him to ensure a comfortable life for all three, but soon an ingenious jealousy ruins the relationship between the two spouses and married life becomes hell.
notes: Visionary melodrama, intense and hypnotic period reconstruction, delusional love story. With the voice off that marks all of his three directories ("The young rage", this one and "The thin red line"), Malick builds a boundless and very ambitious elegy, an intimist blockbuster that proved to be such a failure to banish his author from Hollywood for twenty years. Photograph by Nestor Almendros awarded with the Oscar, prize for best direction in Cannes, soundtrack by Ennio Morricone among the most beautiful and unusual composed by the musician.

title: I giorni del commissario Ambrosio
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Carlo Delle Piane, Carla Gravina, Athina Cenci, Claudio Amendola, Pupella Maggio, Rossella Falk, Cristina Marsillach, Amanda Sandrelli, Duilio Del Prete, Teo Teocoli
description: Commissioner Ambrosio investigates the death of a playboy convicted of drugs and prostitution. The testimony of a violinist is not convincing and he, cornered, confesses that he is the murderer. But it is only an attempt to cover up the real culprit, something that does not escape a man of great experience like Ambrosio.
notes: Cinematic adaptation of a novel by the mystery writer Renato Olivieri that was decidedly bad. But it is neither Corbucci's nor Tognazzi's fault, called at the last moment to replace Francesco Massaro (director) and Lino Ventura, respectively, who died prematurely after production has already begun.

title: I giorni dell'ira
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Lee Van Cleef, Walter Rilla, Christa Linder, Ennio Balbo, Lukas Ammann, Andrea Bosic, José Calvo, Giorgio Gargiullo, Anna Orso
description: Young Scott works as a street sweeper but waits for the opportunity to prove what he's really made of. A gunslinger arrives, Talby, who takes him under his protection and teaches him how to handle weapons. Scott proves to be very good at the subject and Talby puts him in his gang. Scott's fate seems sealed but the boy will know how to redeem himself.
notes: Valerii makes his debut with a discreet spaghetti-western, mindful of the lesson of the master Sergio Leone (of which the director was assistant and who will produce My name is nobody). At the time the film was a box-office success, thanks also to the presence of Gemma and Lee Van Cleef, the "villain" par excellence.

title: I giorni della violenza
actors: Peter Lee Lawrence, Beba Loncar, Luigi Vannucchi, Andrea Bosic, Nello Pazzafini, Lucio Rosato, Rosalba Neri, Gianni Solaro, Romano Puppo
description: His brother is killed by the Northerners and Josh joins the Southern guerrillas. After the war he meets Christine (Loncar), betrothed to the assassin officer, and kidnaps her in revenge by dragging her to the border. But the road is long. Few ideas for a botched serial western.

title: Days of Thunder
actors: Tom Cruise, Robert Duvall, Nicole Kidman, Randy Quaid, Cary Elwes, Michael Rooker, Fred Dalton Thompson, John C. Reilly, J.C. Quinn
description: Cole is a reckless young race car driver. He enters the stable of an elderly and wise mechanic who provides him with a prototype. After the first misunderstandings, the two find a great understanding. A serious accident, however, throws Cole and his rival into a coma: Cole recovers, also thanks to the love of a beautiful neurologist, and will win triumphantly. Few motor racing movies have worked - this isn't one of them. The film is based on the skirmishes between the two rival pilots first, and on the amorous ones with the Kidman, then.

title: Giorni felici
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, Valentina Cortese, Lilia Silvi, Paolo Stoppa, Leonardo Cortese, Vera Carmi, Silvio Bagolini
description: A handsome aviator forced to make a crash landing offers the opportunity that Marianna and Franca were waiting for to make their respective boyfriends jealous. In reality then the two end up really undergoing the charm of the aviator, but it is only a moment, the couples are strengthened and the aviator leaves alone. It is a comedy that betrays its theatrical origins, but played with exuberance by a good group of actors.

title: On the Town
actors: Gene Kelly, Frank Sinatra, Jules Munshin, Ann Miller, Betty Garrett, Vera-Ellen, Florence Bates, Alice Pearce, George Meader
description: Gabey, Chip and Ozzie, three cheerful sailors get a twenty-four-hour license to spend in New York City. Chip, who is in possession of an old guide, takes command of the operations and the three set off to discover the metropolis. While they are in the subway station, a poster catches their attention. In the photo there is the portrait of Ivy Smith, the girl who won the prestigious Miss Metropolitana contest and who, as the legend goes, has all the qualities and talents desirable to be the ideal woman.
notes: Delightful musical with two or three anthology numbers. Oscar for music.

title: Un giorno da leoni
actors: Renato Salvatori, Tomas Milian, Nino Castelnuovo, Anna Maria Ferrero, Carla Gravina, Saro Urzì, Romolo Valli, Corrado Pani, Leopoldo Trieste, Valeria Moriconi, Regina Bianchi
description: Danilo, Michele and Gino are three boys whose paths and destinies meet and intertwine in Italy divided by war, after September 8, 1943. Escaping a German roundup, the three join a partisan formation led by young Orlando; with him they perform an action of sabotage on a bridge during which Michele loses his life.
notes: The first important film by Nanni Loy is the reconstruction of a personal microcosm and a maturation of the protagonists who pass from disengagement to heroism, to self-sacrifice. Through these figures, Loy excellently paints the picture of the tragic era from which Italy was born contemponea.

title: The Day of the Dolphin
actors: George C. Scott, Trish Van Devere, Paul Sorvino, John Dehner, Severn Darden, Elizabeth Wilson, William Roerick, Phyllis Davis
description: Doctor Jack Terrel (Scott) works wonders with his experiments on dolphins, but sinister individuals take the opportunity to organize an attack on the President of the United States, carried out by unwitting animals.
notes: The plot is basically science fiction, but with a very specific moral: beware of the misuse of potentially positive studies and research (which, unfortunately, is anything but imaginary).

title: Point of View
actors: John Savage, Myryam Cyr, Fisher Stevens, Yossi Graber, Dan Muggia, Michael Lee Nichols, Mati Seri, Dan Turgeman
description: Palestinians living in areas occupied by Israel after the wars with the Arabs begin a new form of struggle, based on surprise strikes and demonstrations of hostility towards the Tel Aviv army. Often such manifestations are severely suppressed and there are deaths on both sides. These events are told by an American journalist who goes to Israel to carry out some inquiries.
notes: Based on a successful novel by the Israeli pacifist writer Ammon Yehoshua.

title: Il giorno della civetta
actors: Claudia Cardinale, Franco Nero, Lee J. Cobb, Serge Reggiani, Tano Cimarosa, Nehemiah Persoff, Ennio Balbo, Ugo D'Alessio, Fred Coplan
description: Mafia crime in Sicily: Captain Bellodi, commander of the local carabinieri, comes from northern Italy and stubbornly opposes the silence, openly facing the mafia leaders of the city. It will get some success, thanks also to the collaboration of the popular Rosa Nicolosi fair ...
notes: Based on a novel by Leonardo Sciascia (scripted by Ugo Pirro), the film is directed by Damiani with a keen heart and a great sense of action. Above all, it clearly illustrates the desperate but necessary fight against the mafia organization. Alongside Franco Nero stands out the Mediterranean beauty of the Cardinal.

title: The Day of the Jackal
actors: Edward Fox, Terence Alexander, Michael Lonsdale, Delphine Seyrig, Alan Badel, Jean Sorel, Cyril Cusack, Michel Auclair, Tony Britton, Maurice Denham, Vernon Dobtcheff, Derek Jacobi, Adrien Cayla-Legrand, Olga Georges-Picot
description: In 1963 the armed wing of the Algerian colonialists (O.A.S.) entrusted the task of assassinating General De Gaulle to a professional killer. The killer, known as "the jackal", is hunted down on a merciless "tour de France" by a Sureté inspector.
notes: The director of "High Noon" skillfully transcribes the famous novel by Frederick Forsyth. A lesson in classic cinema: dry and careful to enhance the suspense of the story and the crescendo of emotions. Edward Fox is an excellent "jackal". With two apocryphal remakes: "The assignment" and "The Jackal".

title: Lady in a Cage
actors: Olivia de Havilland, Ann Sothern, James Caan, Jennifer Billingsley, Rafael Campos, William Swan, Jeff Corey
description: Mrs Hilyard is left alone in her luxurious mansion. The son went on a vacation. One bad day, while she accidentally gets stuck in the elevator, the house becomes the scene of the raids of several bad guys. Three thugs, in particular, turn everything upside down and terrorize her with threats. Finally the woman manages to get out, but the nightmare is not over yet.The subject could be interesting, with its idea of ??contamination between thriller and horror. However, Walter Grauman's direction is static, especially in the first part and, despite the exasperation of tones, it ends up boring a bit.

title: Un giorno in pretura
actors: Peppino De Filippo, Alberto Sordi, Sophia Loren, Silvana Pampanini, Walter Chiari, Tania Weber, Leopoldo Trieste, Armenia Balducci, Virgilio Riento, Ubaldo Lay
description: A day of work of the praetor Salomone Lorusso (Peppino De Filippo). In front of him the defendants pass by in various trials. Nando Moriconi (Alberto Sordi), known as the American, was arrested because he was caught naked in the street. The poor fool had been robbed of his clothes, left at the edge of a river, while doing Tarzan imitation. Gloriana is a former soubrette accused of solicitation and Lorusso is all too indulgent with her. Fragmentary but funny film, based on an idea by Lucio Fulci and also written by Sandro Continenza, Alberto Sordi, Giancarlo Viganotti and by Steno himself.

title: Un giorno nella vita
actors: Elisa Cegani, Amedeo Nazzari, Mariella Lotti, Massimo Girotti, Arnoldo Foà, Dina Sassoli, Ave Ninchi, Ada Colangeli, Luciano Mondolfo
description: A group of partisans takes refuge in a convent of cloistered nuns, unaware of what is happening outside their walls and at first very suspicious. Then instead charity and understanding prevail. The partisans are thus saved, but the reprisals of the Germans do not take long to hit the convent.
notes: A "fictional" subject, but anchored to a theme (the Resistance) very current at the time. Blasetti conducts with the pulse and, at the same time, with appreciable measure. The actors are commendable and the overall result is very good. Italian cinema was reborn well from the disasters of the war, at least with its most significant authors.

title: Hennessy
actors: Rod Steiger, Lee Remick, Richard Johnson, Eric Porter, Trevor Howard, Peter Egan, Ian Hogg, Stanley Lebor, John Hallam, Patrick Stewart
description: Neal Hennessy is a Northern Irishman whose wife and child were killed by an English soldier. The spectacular revenge he wants to enact consists in the destruction of Westminster on the day the Queen attends the opening of the parliamentary session. Against him there is not only the English police: even the terrorists of the IRA want to prevent the crazy project. The story is rather unlikely, but well narrated and with interesting documentary passages.

title: The Longest Day
directors: Ken Annakin, Andrew Marton, Bernhard Wicki
actors: John Wayne, Henry Fonda, Robert Mitchum, Robert Ryan, Eddie Albert, Paul Anka, Arletty, Jean-Louis Barrault, Richard Beymer, Hans Christian Blech, Bourvil, Richard Burton, Sean Connery, Rod Steiger, Peter Van Eyck, Robert Wagner, Mel Ferrer
description: The film illustrates various phases of the Allied landing in Normandy, with particular reference to the occupation of S. Mère Eglise by a group of paratroopers, the difficult advance on the beach of Omaha and Utah, and the climbing of the Pointe du Roc cliff.
notes: Multi-handed film, with an episodic-chronicle structure: in a calibrated interlocking game, the events are narrated with sober realism and attention to the most curious or heroic details. Great productive effort orchestrated by Darryl Zanuck, starting from the novel by Cornelius Ryan. It lacks the epic tension that one would expect from the story of an event of this kind, but the mass movements in the reconstruction of the battles are nonetheless spectacular and organized with great skill. Oscar for photography and special effects.

title: Young and Innocent
actors: Derrick De Marney, Nova Pilbeam, Percy Marmont, Edward Rigby, Mary Clare, John Longden, George Curzon, Basil Radford, Pamela Carme, George Merritt
description: The sea returns the body of a woman and Robert is accused of murder. He escapes capture and travels to Cornwall in search of the real killer, helped by a girl. The killer has a tic in his eye, he is a drummer in an orchestra and is wearing black make-up. Robert tries to expose him.
notes: The theme is classic Hitchcock: the accused is innocent and to save himself he must find the real culprit. The theme of disguise is added here. The narrative mechanism is, as always in Hitchcock, excellent for the distribution of suspense, humor, action. Two scenes from the anthology: the children's party in which the protagonist plays blindfish, and the sequence shot that isolates the culprit in a jazz orchestra while, wearing a drummer's make-up, he loses strokes and shows the tic to the eye.

title: Mädchenjahre einer Königin
actors: Romy Schneider, Magda Schneider, Adrian Hoven, Karl Ludwig Diehl, Christl Mardayn, Paul Hörbiger, Rudolf Vogel, Fred Liewehr
description: Destined for the succession to the throne, the young Princess Victoria devotes herself to study and leisure, regardless of court intrigues. The sudden death of the king, her uncle, however, puts her before her responsibilities as a ruler. Impatient with court etiquette, he flees to Dover with the intention of embarking for France, but in a boarding house he meets a young student with whom he falls in love. In fact he is the prince of Saxony.
notes: Prototype of the series (the next will be "Princess Sissi"), it is the film that launched the amazing beauty of the then sixteen year old Schneider. But the film is a sugary postcard.

title: The Young Lions
actors: Marlon Brando, Montgomery Clift, Dean Martin, Hope Lange, Barbara Rush, Maximilian Schell, May Britt, Dora Doll, Lee Van Cleef, Liliane Montevecchi, Parley Baer
description: Christian Diestl (Brando) is a young German who after enthusiastically enlisted in the Nazi army, was traumatized by the horrors of war. During the final battle he is killed almost by chance by a young American, who ends up at the front after trying everything to avoid military service.
notes: The narrative structure is a bit artificial and the definition of the characters suffers from a certain schematism (there is also a third protagonist: an American Jew who manages to overcome his fear at the moment of the trial by fire), but it is a film of great breadth. Compared to the character in Irvin Shaw's book from which the film is based, the Nazi officer played by Brando has been made more human by the actor's will. Vigorous fresco inspired by a tragic feeling of history and human destiny. It remains the most famous of Dmytryk's films but, limited by the constraints of large production, he was never completely satisfied.

title: Giovani mariti
actors: Isabelle Corey, Antonio Cifariello, Franco Interlenghi, Raf Mattioli, Gérard Blain, Ennio Girolami, Antonella Lualdi, Anna Maria Guarnieri, Sylva Koscina
description: Wandering around the city at night, five friends go wild to celebrate the next wedding of one of them, Franco. After him, the others slowly give in to the idea of ??having to get married. Marcello falls in love with Lucia and marries her, despite the others trying to dissuade him. Ettore, on the other hand, gives in to a marriage of interest. The film ends with a new nocturnal raid, but the five friends no longer seem the same.
notes: Provincial life seen with good taste and refinement by Mauro Bolognini, in one of his best directorial tests. The screenplay, written by Pier Paolo Pasolini among others, has a vein of melancholy that upset the balance of the comedy.

title: Young Guns
actors: Emilio Estevez, Kiefer Sutherland, Charlie Sheen, Lou Diamond Phillips, Dermot Mulroney, Casey Siemaszko, Terence Stamp, Jack Palance, Terry O'Quinn, Brian Keith
description: Lincoln County. Two landowners are at war with each other, and one of the two hires six vigilantes, including a rather skilled young man with a gun who takes the lead. He is William Bonner, aka Billy (hereafter known as "the Kid"). When their boss is killed, the six will have to hurry up against coalitioned and far more armed opponents ...
notes: Christopher Cain at the time bet on the rebirth of the western, betting on the legend of Billy the Kid and on a handful of (then) young stars, mostly veterans of teen movies. Today those faces refer to very different scenarios (mostly televised) and the experiment, as we know, did not have the desired result. However, it remains a good entertainment film.

title: A Kiss Before Dying
actors: Jeffrey Hunter, Robert Wagner, Joanne Woodward, Mary Astor, Virginia Leith, George Macready, Robert Quarry, Howard Petrie, Bill Walker
description: Bud, a student, has only one ambition: to get out of mediocrity and get rich fast. To achieve his goal, he flirts with Dorothy, a pretty girl he doesn't love, but whose father is full of money. His goal is clear: to marry her and get his hands on the inheritance. The future father-in-law, however, realizes the boy's true intentions and vigorously opposes the wedding. Bud, showy unmasked ...
notes: Beautiful version of a novel by Ira Levin, brought back to the screen in 1991 by James Dearden with Matt Dillon and Sean Young with the title _A kiss before I die_.

title: Johnny Be Good
actors: Robert Downey jr., Anthony Michael Hall, Uma Thurman, Paul Gleason, Steve James, Seymour Cassel, Michael Greene, Marshall Bell, Deborah May, Michael Alldredge, Jennifer Tilly
description: Johnny, a promising football player at his university, receives tempting offers from three other colleges. His family is also involved in the affair, as is his girlfriend; the latter advises him to stay, but Johnny is undecided; in the end he opts to stay, but the intervention of a senior executive will be necessary to save him from the complications he has in the meantime got himself into. The scenario is usual: exasperated competitive spirit, incorrect and unscrupulous methods. But in the end, values ??prevail: were there any doubts? As a girlfriend, beautiful and honest, there is the rampant Uma Thurman, but the film is worth nothing.

title: Joan of Arc
actors: Ingrid Bergman, José Ferrer, Francis L. Sullivan, J. Carrol Naish, Ward Bond, Shepperd Strudwick, Gene Lockhart, John Emery, Leif Erickson, Cecil Kellaway, Selena Royle
description: The life of the "Maid of Orleans", divided between history and popular mythology, seen through the eyes of Hollywood. The spiritual dimension of Giovanna's story becomes secondary to the scenography, the beautiful action shots and Ingrid Bergman. The Swedish actress wanted very strongly to play this part that she considered, wrongly, the crowning of her career. Good Fleming, an excellent craftsman in his latest film, does what he can in this neat and heavy film, based on a play by Maxwell Anderson and photographed in color by Joseph Valentine (who won the Oscar).

title: Giovanna d'Arco al rogo
actors: Ingrid Bergman, Tullio Carminati, Giacinto Prandelli, Agnese Dubbini, Augusto Romani, Plinio Clabassi, Saturno Meletti, Pietro de Palma
description: In conversation with St. Dominic, Joan of Arc reviews her life before being accepted into heaven. Tailor-made for Bergman, who speaks in Italian, the film version of Arthur Honegger's oratorio (based on a text by Paul Claudel) already directed by Rossellii at the theater. Austere and almost experimental. Restored in 1987.

title: Giove in doppiopetto
actors: Carlo Dapporto, Delia Scala, Lucy D'Albert, Gianni Agus, Gino Ravazzini, Franca Gandolfi, Annabella Cerliani, Lilo Weibel, Françoise Rambert, Rina Mascetti
description: The father of the gods is in the mood for extra-marital escapades, but Juno is on the alert. Disguised as a common mortal Jupiter wanders the earth in search of skirts and lusts a beautiful woman. At the crucial moment, however, he realizes that his divine bride has also assumed mortal form ...

title: The Loneliness of the Long Distance Runner
actors: Tom Courtenay, Michael Redgrave, Avis Bunnage, Alec McCowen, James Bolam, Joe Robinson, Dervis Ward, Topsy Jane, Julia Foster
description: Colin Smith, in reform school for theft, is a very good runner. Winning the annual cross-country competition would mean making peace with the world, with the director of the reformatory and with himself. A few meters from the finish and with a great advantage over the second, Colin stops. Written (very well) by Alan Silitoe based on his own novel, a compelling and libertarian film that became the manifesto of Free Cinema and angry English young people. The attack on the institutions culminates in the final gesture of rebellion, with the unforgettable Courtenay who stops mockingly in front of the representatives of power and chooses not to win. From applause.

title: Rebel Without a Cause
actors: James Dean, Natalie Wood, Sal Mineo, Jim Backus, Ann Doran, Corey Allen, William Hopper, Rochelle Hudson, Dennis Hopper, Edward Platt
description: Young Jim, Judy and Plato are accused of assaulting a man. The next day, Buzz and his friends challenge Jim to a dangerous race called "the race of the rabbit": running a car to a precipice and jumping out of the car as late as possible. It's Buzz who dies, and Jim takes refuge in an isolated house where Plato is also ...
notes: The film, scripted by Irving Shulman starting from an original story by Ray himself, was the one that imposed James Dean as the myth of a restless and uprooted generation by definition. A real classic that still excites today. At least fifteen memorable scenes. The photograph of the master Ernest Haller is splendid.

title: I girasoli
actors: Sophia Loren, Marcello Mastroianni, Lyudmila Saveleva, Glauco Onorato, Galina Andreeva, Anna Carena, Nadya Serednichenko, Germano Longo, Silvano Tranquilli, Marisa Traversi
description: Giovanna sets out in search of her husband who has been reported missing in Russia during the war. She finds him again, but he is married. A De Sica in full decline, in a melodramatic film that serves above all to provide an opportunity for Loren's sanguine interpretation. Screenplay by Zavattini and Tonino Guerra, music by Henry Mancini.

title: Girolimoni, il mostro di Roma
actors: Nino Manfredi, Gabriele Lavia, Guido Leontini, Orso Maria Guerrini, Anna Maria Pescatori, Luciano Catenacci, Mario Carotenuto, Gianna Marelli, Claudio Nicastro, Umberto Raho
description: A series of atrocious crimes upsets Fascist Rome. The regime, which had promised order and discipline, finds itself in the absolute necessity of finding the culprit. The monster is found in the person of Gino Girolimoni (Manfredi). The fact that he is innocent does not matter.
notes: Damiani tells a case that actually happened with accuracy of reconstruction and based on a touching interpretation by Nino Manfredi.

title: White Water Summer
actors: Kevin Bacon, Sean Astin, Jonathan Ward, Matt Adler, K.C. Martel, Caroline McWilliams, Charles Siebert, Joseph Passerrelli
description: A guide specialized in trips to the limit of survival takes a group of children to heart: he is convinced that facing so many difficulties is the best push to move from adolescence to maturity. So with four of them he faces a difficult crossing and behaves very hard in particular with one, the most rebellious.
notes: Lazy children's film, with many beautiful images of wild nature and with Kevin Bacon, one of the four interpreters of "Fandango".

title: Giù la testa
actors: Rod Steiger, James Coburn, Romolo Valli, Maria Monti, Rik Battaglia, Franco Graziosi, Antoine Saint-John, Vivienne Chandler, David Warbeck
description: Miranda is a Mexican bandit who joins forces with the Irish Mallory (former IRA terrorist) to rob a bank. But he finds himself involved in the revolution. His family is massacred, he is saved in extremis by Mallory. In reality, Miranda is by no means converted to revolutionary ideals. Yet he still finds himself alongside the Irishman to face the regular troops.
notes: Leone's most "political" film, which begins with a quote from Mao and with a (moreover memorable) sequence on the close confrontation (close-ups, mouth details ...) between the anthropology of peons and that of the rich. It is also, however, the least homogeneous of his films, with some decidedly bad moments (the soft focus of Coburn's flashbacks) and a certain linguistic background of manner. Steiger's character is too over the top, Coburn's tormented Irishman much better. It was originally supposed to be called "Once upon a time there was a Revolution".

title: Giù la testa... hombre!
actors: Jack Betts, Gordon Mitchell, Klaus Kinski, Renzo Arbore, Benito Pacifico, Giancarlo Prete, Luciano Conti, Jeff Cameron, Amerigo Castrighella
description: Macho Callagan, lieutenant of the forest guards, assuming the task of routing the gang led by Butch Cassidy and Iron Head, manages to get in touch with the latter, passing himself off as a bandit. When the two, after a quarrel born for reasons of interest, decide to separate and give life to two autonomous gangs, Macho convinces Iron Head to attack his former accomplice.
notes: Low-profile western spaghetti directed by Miles Deem, born Demofilo Fidani, an expert on the genre, with a little part for Renzo Arbore.

title: She's Out of Control
actors: Tony Danza, Catherine Hicks, Wallace Shawn, Ami Dolenz, Dick O'Neill, Laura Mooney, Derek McGrath, Dana Ashbrook, Matthew Perry
description: Doug Simpson, a 37-year-old widower with two dependent daughters, suddenly discovers that Katie, his 15-year-old daughter, has now become a beautiful girl full of suitors. Worried about this sudden (and natural) evolution of the situation, Doug first turns to a psychoanalyst, then takes action personally, only to discover, however, that his fears towards his daughter are unfounded. Commediola bordering on farcical, which targets the fears of the parents. Among all stands out the interpretation of Wallace Shawn in the part of the psychoanalyst.

title: North West Mounted Police
actors: Gary Cooper, Paulette Goddard, Madeleine Carroll, Preston Foster, George Bancroft, Robert Preston, Lynne Overman, Akim Tamiroff, Walter Hampden, Lon Chaney jr.
description: The Redcoats are forced to accept the battle against an array of mestizos and allied Indians, stirred up by a criminal escaped from Texas. Lively and colorful adventure film, more than a real western. The interludes between Cooper and Goddard are delightful.

title: Giuditta e Oloferne
actors: Massimo Girotti, Isabelle Corey, Renato Baldini, Yvette Masson, Gianni Rizzo, Camillo Pilotto, Lucia Banti, Ricardo Valle, Leonardo Botta, Franco Balducci
description: The Babylonian general Holofernes conquers and oppresses the city of Betulia. Giuditta offers herself to him with the intention of killing him, but she falls in love with him. Eventually the girl will sacrifice her love for the good of her country and cut off the head of the proud leader. Modest Italian craftsmanship from one of the most famous biblical stories.

title: Julia
actors: Jane Fonda, Vanessa Redgrave, Jason Robards, Maximilian Schell, Hal Holbrook, Rosemary Murphy, Meryl Streep, Dora Doll, Elisabeth Mortensen, John Glover
description: Lillian Hellman, writer and playwright who was also the companion of the great writer Dashiell Hammett, had a friend, Giulia, the daughter of Jewish aristocrats. After discovering socialism, Giulia gave up all the privileges that her social position could guarantee and dedicated her life to the anti-Nazi cause, at the cost of her own life. The film tells the long and intense friendship between these two women.
notes: Solid film by Zinnemann, at times a bit mannered, but supported by strong moral tension and passionate sincerity, with Jane Fonda and Vanessa Redgrave (the latter Oscar winner for the supporting actress) matrixes and the incisive contribution of Robards (Academy Award winner) as Dashiel Hammett. Oscar also for the screenplay.

title: Giulietta degli spiriti
actors: Giulietta Masina, Sandra Milo, Mario Pisu, Sylva Koscina, Valentina Cortese, Valeska Gert, José Luis de Vilallonga, Friedrich von Ledebur, Caterina Boratto, Milena Vukotic
description: Juliet celebrated her wedding anniversary, but she is unhappy because she knows that Giorgio, her husband, is having an affair with another woman. At first she seeks spiritual comfort by questioning an Indian seer, then she tries to establish a dialogue with her husband and with the rival. However, marriage is now in an irreversible crisis and chooses loneliness. In the realization the ghosts will also vanish.
notes: Fellini proposes one of his most classic themes: the difficulty of adapting to reality and the search for visionary escapes, but this time with a female character at the center. Particularly impressive, almost horror, is the reconstruction of the nightmares instilled in Juliet by Catholic education.

title: Giulietta e Romeo
actors: Geronimo Meynier, Rosemarie Dexter, Tony Soler, Carlos Estrada, Andrea Bosic, Umberto Raho, Antonella Della Porta, José Marco, Elsa Vazzoler, Franco Balducci
description: Despite the hatred that has always divided their families, Romeo and Juliet, madly in love with each other, marry in secret with the help of Brother Lorenzo, their sincere friend. But one day, a bloody brawl, during which Romeo kills Juliet's cousin, forces the young man into exile. While Romeo is away from Verona, Juliet's father decides to marry her to Paris.
notes: Riccardo Freda, as known more interested in horses than actors, transforms William Shakespeare's tragedy into an enjoyable swashbuckle. In this case, among other things, he had seen it right: better the horses of the actors.

title: Julius Caesar
actors: Marlon Brando, James Mason, John Gielgud, Louis Calhern, Greer Garson, Edmond O'Brien, Deborah Kerr, George Macready, Michael Pate, Alan Napier, John Hoyt
description: In 44 a. C. Julius Caesar, who has centralized all military and civil powers in his hands, is named dictator. In this way he becomes too uncomfortable a figure and around him he finds only hostile people. Marco Giunio Bruto, who has always enjoyed the protection of Caesar, also participates in the conspiracy, led by Cassius. On the Ides of March, Cesare is attacked by the conspirators.
notes: Excellent reading of the homonymous Shakespearean text made with a modern but quite faithful cut. Famous performance by Marlon Brando, but also Sir John Gielgud and James Mason were masterful.

title: Giulio Cesare contro i pirati
actors: Gustavo Rojo, Abbe Lane, Gordon Mitchell, Piero Lulli, Franca Parisi, Silvana Jachino, Massimo Carocci, Ignazio Leone, Fedele Gentile, Pasquale Basile
description: Threatened with death by Sulla, Cesare leaves Rome for Bithynia. King Nicomedes, his new protector, in turn runs serious risks by holding Plautias hostage, wife of the terrible pirate Hamar. To save Nicomedes from possible reprisals, Caesar sets sail for Rhodes with Plautia, ending up straight into the clutches of the marauder. All that remains is to ask for freedom in exchange for a substantial ransom.

title: Colditz Story
actors: John Mills, Eric Portman, Lionel Jeffries, Bryan Forbes, Anton Diffring, Richard Wattis, Ian Carmichael, Theodore Bikel, Eugene Deckers, Christopher Rhodes
description: During the last world war, many prisoners held in concentration camps try to escape. To stem the phenomenon, the German command has all those who try to escape locked up in the castle of Colditz, transformed into a fortress. But these organize themselves by systematically implementing more or less successful attempts to escape Hamilton, specializing in action films and known for the James Bond and Agent Palmer series, maintains a balanced relationship between comedy and drama, and creates one of the most convincing British war films.

title: The Savage
actors: Charlton Heston, Susan Morrow, Peter Hansen, Joan Taylor, Richard Rober, Don Porter, Ted De Corsia, Ian MacDonald, Milburn Stone, Angela Clarke
description: Jim, who grew up with the Sioux tribe, who had kidnapped him as a child, is adopted by the Yellow Eagle chief, who already has a daughter, Luta. When he is sent to Fort Duane, to check the soldiers' intentions, he falls in love with Tally. War breaks out, but Jim, despite the pain of Luta's death killed by Captain Vargant, averted the conflict and then returns to the fort, where Tally awaits him. A young Charlton Heston in this rather predictable western. Solemnity sometimes borders on boredom.

title: El Zorro cabalga otra vez
actors: Tony Russell, Maria José Alfonso, Agustín González, Roberto Paoletti, Jesus Puente, Mirella Maravidi, Pepe Rubio, Angela Rhu, Sancho Gracia
description: In Spanish-dominated California, during the Mexican Revolution, an outlaw named Esteban Dominquez conquers the city of Santa Barbara and becomes its governor. His regime is tyrannical, but he has not reckoned with the elusive Zorro. Made in photocopy of the thousand other titles in the series.

title: Giuro che ti amo
actors: Nino D'Angelo, Roberta Olivieri, Gabriele Tinti, Bombolo, Tommaso Palladino, Gabriella Di Luzio, Vittorio La Rosa, Rik Battaglia, Marco Vivio
description: As soon as he comes out of prison, Nino Esposito returns to live in his old shack by the sea, near the boat given to him by Don Vito, boss of the Camorra. In the hut Nino lives with Masaniello, an orphan, dreaming of the love of Maruzzella, daughter of the fishermen's union leader. When Don Vito tries to involve him in shady trades, Nino rebels by making him jump the boat and thus gaining the love of Maruzzella and the custody of the child.
notes: Film much closer to the Neapolitan drama than to cinema. Nino D'Angelo, former golden helmet with an easy tear ko, directed, as well as scripted, performed and sang.

title: Giuseppe venduto dai fratelli
actors: Geoffrey Horne, Robert Morley, Belinda Lee, Terence Hill, Vira Silenti, Charles Borromel, Marietto, Finlay Currie, Nino Segurini, Charles Borromel, Carlo Giustini
description: Joseph, one of the twelve sons of the patriarch Jacob, is sold as a slave by his brothers who make his father think he is dead. Finished in Egypt, he is imprisoned on charges of having tried to abuse his master's wife while it was the woman who fell in love with him. In his cell, his ability to interpret dreams acquires the friendship of the pharaoh's cupbearer who, distressed by a dream, calls him to court for interpretation. In short, Joseph becomes viceroy of Egypt and can call his entire family to court. Discreet blockbuster made in Italy, directed at the end of his career by an old specialist in melodramas.

title: Giuseppe Verdi
actors: Pierre Cressoy, Anna Maria Ferrero, Gaby André, Sandro Ruffini, Camillo Pilotto, Laura Gore, Loris Gizzi, Emilio Cigoli, Irene Genna, Mario Del Monaco, Tito Gobbi
description: Near death, Giuseppe Verdi retraces the most important episodes of his life. Thus, from 1901 back to 1838 when the young composer arrived in Milan with his wife Margherita Barezzi and their two children. After being rejected in the admission exam to the conservatory he gets a first success with "Oberto, count of S. Bonifacio", but fate looms. The darkest period begins, both for life and for art. Some time later, however, the meeting with the soprano Giuseppina Strepponi opens the doors to success and fame.
notes: A biography where nineteenth-century populism and post-war populism meet in the passionate and dry direction of a master of cinematic melodrama.

title: No Escape, No Return
actors: Maxwell Caulfield, Dustin Nguyen, Denise Loveday, Michael Nouri, John Saxon, Pamela Dixon, Kevin Benton, Joey Travolta, Louis Perez
description: Tommy Cuff, Billy Sloan and Alison Weston are three young police officers. In reality they are a public danger: when they take out their weapons, everyone and everything is to be feared. During an operation they kill the brother of a drug trafficker, but also a good number of innocent civilians. At this point the three not only find themselves against the brother of the dead, but also end up under investigation. Charles T. Kanganis makes films with a stencil so you can't expect much. Maxwell Caulfield is the one who tried to covet Brenda in the Beverly Hills pilot, 90210 and that remains the highlight of her non-brilliant career.

title: Overruled
actors: Donna Mills, Adam Storke, John Getz, Lee Grant, John Rubinstein, Ron Frazier, Ari Meyers, Jan Lucas
description: Laura (Donna Mills) has a difficult relationship with the eldest of her two daughters Carly (Ari Meyers). After yet another quarrel in the family, Carly runs away from home and after wandering a bit, she gets loaded into her car by a young man, Peter (Adam Storke), who soon turns out to be a sex maniac. Carly is raped and killed. The police manage to track down and arrest the young man, but at the trial Peter, thanks to the skill of the lawyer and the prejudices of the court, gets a mild sentence, to be served in a nursing home. After a short time, Peter returns to freedom and begins to undermine Laura's other daughter as well. The woman then buys a gun and kills the maniac. At the trial she does not ask for any extenuating circumstances, but the court acknowledges the mistake she made in the first trial and tries to remedy it by inflicting the minimum penalty on her. The woman returns to freedom and resumes her family life, but she cannot forget what happened. In the America of the Eighties, crossed by a current of neo-puritanism, there were very frequent films in which the sexual freedom of young people and the excessive clemency of judges towards murderers were harshly attacked. This television film based on a novel by Sharon Michales and Phillys Vernick follows these models without particular inventiveness.

title: Instant Justice
actors: Michael Paré, Tawny Kitaen, Peter Crook, Charles Napier, Eddie Avoth, Scott Del Amo, Lynda Bridges, Lionel A. Ephraim, Maurice E. Aronow
description: A young marine is killed by his sister. The boy cannot bear without reacting. He then decides to leave the uniform to engage in the search for those responsible for the murder. A beautiful girl with a dubious reputation follows him in spite of himself.

title: Il giustiziere dei mari
actors: Richard Harrison, Michèle Mercier, Roldano Lupi, Walter Barnes, Marisa Belli, Paul Muller, Carlo Hintermann, Italo Sain, Romolo Giomini
description: At the end of the 1700s, David Robinson, a young scion of a noble English family and naval officer under the orders of the shady Captain Redway, appears totally unscrupulous, gets into trouble and is sentenced to death. He manages to escape in the company of a Dutch filibuster and becomes a pirate. By beating the coasts of Australia, he will have the opportunity to confront each other and therefore to defeat his former commander.
notes: An underrated author of musicals, peplums and other strands of popular cinema, Paolella has also dedicated herself to pirates.

title: Death Wish II
actors: Charles Bronson, Jill Ireland, Vincent Gardenia, Robin Sherwood, J.D. Cannon, Anthony Franciosa, Ben Frank, Silvana Gallardo, Robert F. Lyons, Laurence Fishburne
description: Architect Paul Kersey (Bronson) moved to Los Angeles with his daughter Carol (Sherwood). But it seems that everyone there is angry with him: he walks around the park and steals his money, then the same thieves go to his house, they rape the housekeeper, beat him up and kidnap his daughter. Paul decides to take revenge. This second part is more insipid than the previous one, above all due to its directorial and script sloppiness. The actors are dozing too.

title: Death Wish 4: The Crackdown
actors: Charles Bronson, Kay Lenz, John P. Ryan, Perry Lopez, George Dickerson, Soon-Tek Oh, Dana Barron, Jesse Dabson, Peter Sherayko, James Purcell
description: The daughter of Paul Kersery's current partner dies of an overdose. Paul investigates and kills the dealer who supplied her. Aided by a certain Nathan White, he then manages to defeat two gangs of drug traffickers before realizing that Nathan is the real boss and that he has used him to get rid of dangerous competitors. The vengeance of the "executioner" is unleashed at this point against the most important target. The fourth episode of the series adds nothing to the previous ones: the characters and situations are definitely exhausted, and almost pathetic.

title: Posse
actors: Kirk Douglas, Bruce Dern, Bo Hopkins, James Stacy, Luke Askew, David Canary, Alfonso Arau, Katherine Woodville, Mark Roberts, Beth Brickell
description: A politician (Douglas) hires adventurers to catch an outlaw (Dern). But it turns out he is almost a popular idol. Little violence and a lot of psychological tension: a surprising neo-western directed and starring Kirk Douglas.

title: Gladiator
actors: Ken Wahl, Nancy Allen, Robert Culp, Stan Shaw, Rosemary Forsyth, Bart Braverman, Brian Robbins, Rick Dees, Michael Young
description: Rick Benson now has only one thought: avenge his brother who was killed by a group of thugs. Thus, moving on a truck he personally equipped, he wanders around in ambiguous rooms along the highways. He will have his revenge, but he won't prove to be much different from the assassins he hunts. Revenge and its effects, understood as changes in men (up to the worst abjections), is one of the characteristic themes of Abel Ferrara. In this television movie, the violence is less than that of his most famous films, but the rendering is quite effective.

title: Il gladiatore di Roma
actors: Gordon Scott, Wandisa Guida, Roberto Risso, Ombretta Colli, Piero Lulli, Alberto Farnese, Gianni Solaro, Charles Borromel, Mirko Ellis, Pietro De Vico
description: The Valeri, a family of noble Roman patricians, disgraced by the emperor Caracalla, are killed, their goods confiscated and their slaves brought to Minturno and used for the construction of public works. The commissioner Annio notices, among these men, Marcus, an individual of exceptional strength and has him transferred to Rome in the gymnasium of his gladiators. Together with Marcus, Nisa, daughter of the king of Cilicia, is also sent to the capital of the empire. Help the two slaves, Valerio, who accidentally escaped the slaughter of his family.
notes: Peplum of little value with Gordon Scott, famous for having given his face and body to Tarzan.

title: The Gnome-Mobile
actors: Walter Brennan, Matthew Garber, Karen Dotrice, Richard Deacon, Tom Lowell, Sean McClory, Ed Wynn, Jerome Cowan, Charles Lane
description: A wealthy businessman, owner of a large paper mill, walking through a redwood forest with his two grandchildren, finds by chance a family of gnomes. The gnome grandfather has various problems: that of finding a wife for his grandson, that of saving himself from human attempts at deforestation and also from the possibility of ending up in a circus as an attraction. Our businessman has only apparently a hard heart and will help him. Disney production, a bit routine, with the old man of the Far West Walter Brennan.

title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
actors: Anthony Hopkins, Lesley-Anne Down, Derek Jacobi, David Suchet, John Gielgud, Robert Powell, Gerry Sundquist, Tim Pigott-Smith, Nigel Hawthorne, Roland Culver
description: In fifteenth-century Paris, the beautiful gypsy Esmeralda is threatened by the shady interests of three men. The sacrifice of Quasimodo, deformed bell-ringer of the church of Notre Dame, saves her.
notes: Fourteenth film version of Victor Hugo's novel. Anthony Hopkins ("The Silence of the Lambs") as Quasimodo looks good.

title: Golem, l'esprit de l'exil
actors: Hanna Schygulla, Vittorio Mezzogiorno, Ophrah Shemesh, Samuel Fuller, Mireille Perrier, Sotigui Kouyaté, Fabienne Babe, Antonio Carallo, Bernardo Bertolucci, Philippe Garrel
description: The Maharal, referring to ancient formulas of Kabbalah, creates a Golem from the clay that will have to help the exiles and the vagabonds. Naomi, led by the Golem, flees with her husband and children from her country due to famine. With her husband dead at work and her children killed in an accident resulting from a racist action, Naomi is thrown out of the house and takes refuge with a relative near a magical forest. an update inspired by the classic texts of Judaism where, in a symbolic key, it brings to life the eternal drama of the "chosen people" and the persecutions of its history.

title: Golia e il cavaliere mascherato
actors: Mimmo Palmara, Pilar Cansino, José Greci, Sergio Ciani, Arturo Dominici, Dina De Santis, Piero Leri, Renato Navarrini, Loris Gizzi, Ettore Manni, Tullio Altamura
description: Prince Don Francisco's beautiful daughter was promised to the hateful captain Don Ramiro, even if she loves cousin Juan. The villain kills his father and makes the girl prisoner; The good makes friends with the gypsies and, together with them, is preparing to save her. The rendering of the accounts between Juan and Ramiro is at this point inevitable.
notes: What does Goliath have to do with a Zorro context, without however nobody going around masked? Mysteries of the Italian 60s adventure production. There were, yes, of the masterpieces, but the trash taste has pervaded more than one title. Here is a classic example.

title: Goliath contro i giganti
actors: Brad Harris, Gloria Milland, Fernando Rey, Barbara Carroll, Carmen De Lirio, Pepe Rubio, Fernando Sancho, Lina Rosales, Arnaldo Martelli, Ignazio Dolce, Franco Gasparri
description: Taking over the kingdom of Beiran by force, the usurper Bocan orders a slave girl to kill the enemy Goliath. Faced with the disobedience of the woman, who has fallen in love with Goliath, Bocan condemns her to an atrocious death, from which Goliath will save her, who will also be able to restore the legitimate ruler to the throne. All the ingredients of the mythical-adventurous genre are present: a love story, a dynastic issue, intrigues, spectacular battles with vaguely monstrous beings and, of course, the triumph of the righteous. Redundant style that often borders on the grotesque.

title: Good Morning Babilonia
actors: Vincent Spano, Joaquim De Almeida, Greta Scacchi, Désirée Nosbusch, Omero Antonutti, Bérangère Bonvoisin, David Brandon, Margarita Lozano, Charles Dance
description: The brothers Nicola and Andrea Bonanno, two skilled artisans, emigrated from Tuscany to the United States at the dawn of the twentieth century. After the difficult beginnings they established themselves at the San Francisco International Exposition and, later, they worked on the sets of the film "Intolerance", the masterpiece of the great David W. Griffith. World War I interrupts their work.
notes: The Taviani brothers intertwine reality and myth to develop a film that would like to be the summa of their cinema, but is actually a mess. Family, past, present, all reduced to spooky, meaningless paintings.

title: Goodbye & Amen
actors: Tony Musante, Claudia Cardinale, John Forsythe, John Steiner, Renzo Palmer, Angela Goodwin, Anna Zinnemann, Fabrizio Jovine
description: John Dhannay, a CIA agent stationed in Rome, is organizing an attack in an African country, but has to face several unforeseen events: the betrayal of his colleague Lander and the kidnapping on the terrace of the Hilton of a couple of fellow citizens - including the ambassador in Italy - by a criminal madman who appears to be the Lander himself. It's not really about him, but Dhannay takes the opportunity to get rid of him ...
notes: Solid American-style detective centered on the character of a cynical bureaucrat of espionage, not without echoes of denunciation for the questionable activities carried out by the powerful US secret service in every part of the world.

title: The Goodbye Girl
actors: Richard Dreyfuss, Marsha Mason, Quinn Cummings, Paul Benedict, Barbara Rhoades, Theresa Merritt, Michael Shawn, Patricia Pearcy, Gene Castle
description: Paula, a dancer in a row, lives in New York with her daughter and a new partner, an actor, who, however, suddenly leaves her, stealing all her savings and sub-letting the apartment to a rather nutty colleague. Paula and the new "tenant" struggle to find an acceptable modus vivendi, but then they discover they love each other.
notes: From a comedy by Neil Simon, already brilliant in itself, a film directed on tiptoe by one of the most underestimated directors of American cinema of the 70s. The two protagonists particularly hit the spot. Dreyfuss won the Oscar.

title: Goodbye Mr. Chips
actors: Peter O'Toole, Petula Clark, Michael Redgrave, George Baker, Sian Phillips, Michael Bryant, Jack Hedley, Alison Leggatt, Jenny Runacre, Michael Culver
description: Professor Arthur Chipping, whom everyone familiarly refers to as mr. Chips teaches Greek and Latin at the Brookfield English boarding school. During a holiday in Pompeii and Paestum he meets Catherine, a beautiful and nice soubrette he had met in London. The girl falls in love with the teacher, overcomes his natural shyness and convinces him to marry her. In the closed and conservative environment of the college, the presence of Catherine - who has left the stage - is disturbing. A rich lord takes advantage of this to thwart Mr. Chips' career ...
notes: Remake of the film directed in 1939 by Sam Wood. Scripted by Terence Rattigan.

title: Gordon, il Pirata Nero
actors: Ricardo Montalban, Vincent Price, Giulia Rubini, Mario Brega, Liana Orfei, Mario Feliciani, Giustino Durano, Gisella Sofio, José Jaspe, Edoardo Toniolo
description: To unmask Tortuga, a ferocious slave trader, Captain Gordon goes to San Salvador under a false name, but is imprisoned. Manuela frees him with whom he will govern an island populated by former slaves now freed. Dull Italian swashbuckling film that makes use, without profit, of two international stars such as Ricardo Montalban and Vincent Price.

title: Gorillas in the Mist
actors: Sigourney Weaver, Bryan Brown, Julie Harris, Constantin Alexandrov, Iain Cuthbertson, John Omirah Miluwi, Waigwa Wachira, Iain Glen, David Lansbury
description: The strong-willed Diane Fossey, having abandoned her boyfriend, goes to Congo to research the behavior of gorillas. With great patience, he approaches and studies them, learning and imitating their language. With the help of her loyal Sembagare she is forced to fight both against the men of the Batwa tribe and against the cynical Van Vecten. Dian also fights against the hostility of local authorities. After a happy period of work and love with photographer Bob Campbell, Diane is mysteriously killed.
notes: Based on Fossey's autobiography, the film describes the life of the young scientist with intensity of feelings. The result is a scientifically more than reliable work, but perhaps precisely for this reason a bit obsessive, as obsessive as the protagonist's passion for the favorite apes appears.

title: Gorky Park
actors: William Hurt, Lee Marvin, Joanna Pacula, Brian Dennehy, Ian Bannen, Michael Elphick, Richard Griffiths, Rikki Fulton, Alexander Knox, Alexei Sayle
description: Three unrecognizable corpses are discovered in Gorky Park in Moscow. Criminal Police Inspector Arkadi Renko conducts the investigation and ends up convinced that the KGB is involved in the murder. He finds a pair of ice skates that lead him to Irina, a Siberian and former dissident. Renko suspects that the link between Irina and the three corpses is businessman Jack Osborne. Behind it all is an illicit trafficking in sables ...
notes: A thriller set in the Soviet Union, where police and espionage mix and where the villain is American while the hero is a Russian policeman. There is enough to contrast with the Hollywood trend of the 1980s. Apted nevertheless succeeds in supporting the intrigue with a tense and engaging staging, also capable of making us forget some improbability here and there. In addition to being well narrated, the film is excellently played by William Hurt, perfectly in part, and by the great old Lee Marvin, grim and cynical at the right point, here in one of his latest performances.

title: Gothic
actors: Gabriel Byrne, Julian Sands, Natasha Richardson, Miriam Cyr, Timothy Spall, Alec Mango, Andreas Wisniewski, Dexter Fletcher, Pascal King
description: June 1816: at Villa Donati, near Lake Geneva, Byron, the two Shelleys and doctor Polidori compete with invented stories with a horror theme. Precisely in this context, the cursed intellectuals manage to give birth to the characters of Frankenstein and Dracula. However, following a séance, pythons, a goat, severed heads and deformed creatures begin to appear in the house. It even seems that a ghost is wandering among the rooms and corridors ...
notes: Film that marks Natasha Richardson's big screen debut. Ken Russell unleashes his hallucinatory arts, but is often repetitive, deflated and devoid of ideas. Thomas Dolby's music is disappointing.

title: Gott mit uns (Dio è con noi)
actors: Franco Nero, Larry Aubrey, Richard Johnson, Helmut Schneider, Bud Spencer, Michael Goodliffe, Relja Basic, Emilio Delle Piane, Enrico Ostermann, Osvaldo Ruggieri
description: Holland, 1945. The war is over. Bruno Grauber managed, together with his fellow soldier Reyner Schultz, to save himself by throwing away the German uniform. However, he is captured and interned in a prison camp. A major brings him to trial for treason and sentences him to death. He then asks the camp commander for permission to have the traitor shot by his men. Linked to a militarist point of view, the commander accepts. According to the two graduates, in fact, disobedience is always to be punished. All humanitarian intercessions will prove useless. Strongly anti-Nazi and anti-militarist Italian-Yugoslav production, subject of great scandal at the time of its release.

title: La governante
actors: Turi Ferro, Martine Brochard, Vittorio Caprioli, Paola Quattrini, Pino Caruso, Agostina Belli, Christa Linder, Umberto Spadaro
description: The new housekeeper of the Platania family is French and her name is Caterina Leher. The girl's arrival upsets the balance of the family, made up of the elderly and widower Leopoldo, his son Casanova, the dumb daughter-in-law, the two grandchildren and the maid Jana. This is precisely the first victim of the situation because she is fired (because of the housekeeper) and, returning home, dies in a train accident.
notes: Remorse, tears, vulgar jokes, a bit of sex and a bit of morbid atmospheres. This adaptation of a 1950s comedy by Vitaliano Brancati is repetitive, and Grimaldi is not Samperi.

title: Sitting Pretty
actors: Clifton Webb, Robert Young, Maureen O'Hara, Richard Haydn, Louise Allbritton, Randy Stuart, Ed Begley, Larry Olsen, John Russell
description: A lawyer lives with his wife and three children in a town on the outskirts of a large city. The restlessness of the brats and the presence of a large dog do not allow any maid to resist for long. Desperate, the two put an ad in a newspaper to try to contact a new housekeeper. Elia Belvedere responds to the announcement and is mistaken for a woman. It is actually a man who in a short time proves to be so good that he conquers everyone, including the dog.
notes: A brilliant comedy about the vices and virtues of good neighborliness with a great Clifton Webb.

title: Father Goose
actors: Cary Grant, Leslie Caron, Trevor Howard, Jack Goode, Sharyl Locke, Pip Sparke, Verina Greenlaw, Stephanie Berrington
description: Walter Eckland is a former history professor who occupies an observer position on a small island in the Pacific. Its task is to report the passage of Japanese planes and convoys. During an enemy action, he saves seven girls with their French governess, but is then forced to keep them with him. His routine as a lonely bachelor is upset.
notes: Ralph Nelson is a director for all seasons and with mixed results; his, among others, "A face full of fists" and "Blue soldier". In this comedy based on a curious idea he gets along well, thanks also to a hilarious Cary Grant. Oscar for the screenplay.

title: National Velvet
actors: Mickey Rooney, Elizabeth Taylor, Donald Crisp, Anne Revere, Angela Lansbury, Jackie 'Butch' Jenkins, Juanita Quigley, Arthur Treacher, Reginald Owen, Norma Varden
description: Young Michael, who has lost both parents, searches for Mrs Brown and meets her daughter, Velvet. The two boys share a passion for horses and soon become friends. During a lottery, the girl manages to tame and win a horse and, together with Michael, trains it for the London Grand Prix. Unable to find a jockey, Velvet herself will mount the horse and win the race.
notes: The film is the classic "fairy tale" all about good feelings and sugar spread with both hands. But, in the specific case, there is something more important: it is the first test as a protagonist in the long career of Elizabeth Taylor.

title: Gran varietà
actors: Vittorio De Sica, Alberto Sordi, Renato Rascel, Maria Fiore, Nico Pepe, Renato Malavasi, Mario Siletti, Carlo Mazzarella, Giuseppe Porelli, Carlo Croccolo, Lea Padovani, Delia Scala
description: A peasant woman, who happened to be on stage by chance, becomes a star and gets married. A very skilled quick-change artist uses his art to seduce a beautiful woman. A comedian, who on the stage plays the laundering soldier, becomes instead an authentic hero in war. A fine speaker is reduced to third-rate theaters. A comedian always struggling with censorship, both during fascism and after.
notes: Barely discreet re-enactment of a form of entertainment that the changing tastes of the public have condemned to extinction. At the time, these theatrical "rides" with strings of actors through the century were in vogue. Here the funniest thing is De Sica singing "Toys and Perfumes". I>

title: Das kunstseidene Mädchen
actors: Giulietta Masina, Gert Fröbe, Hannes Messmer, Gustav Knuth, Agnes Fink, Alfred Balthoff, Axel Monjé, Ralf Wolter, Harry Meyen
description: In search of the ideal husband, Doris (Masina) naively passes from one man to another. In his research he encounters continuous disappointments, changes jobs many times, moves to the big city. In the end it seems that the soul mate is a draftsman abandoned by his wife, but she returns to the home. Doris is alone again, but not tamed. It is not one of the best films by the director of Pepé le moko, but the portrait of the romantic and dreamy clerk has an extraordinary importance thanks to Masina's interpretation. The impresario character rendered by Gert Froebe is also excellent.

title: Grand Hotel
actors: Greta Garbo, John Barrymore, Wallace Beery, Joan Crawford, Lionel Barrymore, Lewis Stone, Jean Hersholt, Robert McWade, Purnell Pratt
description: Champions of various humanity in a 1920s Berlin Grand Hotel: a Russian dancer in crisis because her career is in decline; a gentleman thief who intends to rob her, but then ends up falling in love with her; an elderly employee, condemned by an illness, who decides to happily spend his last days of life; a new rich dishonest grappling with his lively secretary ...
notes: With this enjoyable film, poised between comedy and drama, director Goulding signs his masterpiece, offering the talented actors (Garbo, the Barrymore brothers, Beery, Crawford) a golden opportunity for magnificent performances. Oscar for best film.

title: Grand Hotel Excelsior
actors: Adriano Celentano, Carlo Verdone, Enrico Montesano, Diego Abatantuono, Eleonora Giorgi, Gerry Bruno, Aldina Martano, Isabella Amadeo, Franco Diogene, Armando Brancia, Enzo Andronico
description: The professional cold wall of the hotel owner (Celentano) yields to Ilde's desperate assaults on love. A boxer client (Verdone) falls in love with a waitress and changes jobs. Then there is the Wizard of Segrate (Abatantuono), a waiter (Montesano) who has put his daughter in a Swiss boarding school and, as long as he can, pretends with her to be an important character.
notes: Counting on the call of the performers, Castellano & Pipolo can afford to script and direct a series of insipid sketches. The reference to "Grand Hotel" Goulding is almost offensive.

title: Brimstone
actors: Rod Cameron, Walter Brennan, Lorna Gray, Forrest Tucker, Jack Holt, Jim Davis, James Brown, Guinn 'Big Boy' Williams, Jack Lambert, Will Wright
description: A government inspector arrives in Oklahoma to bring a criminal to justice.

title: That Hamilton Woman
actors: Vivien Leigh, Laurence Olivier, Alan Mowbray, Sara Allgood, Gladys Cooper, Henry Wilcoxon, Heather Angel, Halliwell Hobbes, Gilbert Emery, Miles Mander
description: The young and pretty bride of the English ambassador to Naples, Lord Hamilton, meets the naval captain Orazio Nelson, who is passing through Italy. When he is appointed admiral, the two become lovers and flee together, from the scandal. But in the end Nelson will not escape the call of his homeland and will die facing the Napoleonic fleet; while the future of the beautiful Lady Hamilton, repudiated by her husband following his betrayal, will be miserable.
notes: Two stars of the first magnitude for this sumptuous historical-sentimental reconstruction signed by the brilliant specialist Alexander Korda. Also known as "Lady Hamilton."

title: The Adventures of the Wilderness Family
actors: Robert Logan, Susan Damante-Shaw, Hollye Holmes, Ham Larsen, George 'Buck' Flower, William Cornford, John F. Goff, Herbert F. Nelson
description: The Robinsons are advised by the doctor to take their daughter Jenny to the mountains for a long time. The smog of the metropolis is in fact very harmful for the girl. His parents accepting the doctor's invitation, buy a cottage immersed in the quiet of the Rocky Mountains and go to live there, encountering dangers and great emotions.

title: The Further Adventures of the Wilderness Family
actors: Robert Logan, Susan Damante-Shaw, Heather Rattray, Ham Larsen, George 'Buck' Flower, Brian Cutler, Kurt Grayson
description: The Robinson family wants to venture into the Rocky Mountains this time. To better face the freezing winter he decides to join an expert family of pioneers, who have lived in the mountains for years.
notes: Second part of a series that began with "The great adventure" and then continued with "The new adventures of the Robinsons". The bucolic spirit remains intact and the triumph of sentimentality that would like to exalt the average American family. Precisely for this reason the story of the Robinsons continues to be rhetorical and necessarily uplifting. The protagonists can also be a bit unpleasant.

title: Denver and Rio Grande
actors: Edmond O'Brien, Sterling Hayden, Zasu Pitts, Dean Jagger, Kasey Rogers, Lyle Bettger, J. Carrol Naish, Tom Powers, Robert Barrat
description: Two railway companies fight each other in the Wild West as General Palmer's train is attacked by bandits. Good ending with the frontal collision of two locomotives, modest overall.

title: The Big Heat
actors: Glenn Ford, Lee Marvin, Gloria Grahame, Jocelyn Brando, Howard Wendell, Alexander Scourby, Jeanette Nolan, Peter Whitney, Willis Bouchey
description: Sergeant Dave Bannion investigates the alleged suicide of a former colleague named Duncan. With the help of Lucy, a girl friend of the dead man, Bannion discovers that Duncan was on the payroll of boss Lagana. After the interview with Bannion, Lucy is murdered. For this reason, the investigation is stolen from him, but the detective decides to continue the investigation alone. In an attack planned against him, his wife is killed instead.
notes: A woman with a burned half face, a villain played by Lee Marvin, a violent and avenging "good guy", a sublime staging. Ultimately, one of the best noirs of all time. From a (cultured and complex) novel by William P. McGivern.

title: John Paul Jones
