actors: Robert Stack, Marisa Pavan, Charles Coburn, Bette Davis, Erin O'Brien, Macdonald Carey, Jean-Pierre Aumont, David Farrar, Peter Cushing, Susana Canales
description: Spectacular and fictional biography of the life of the Scottish sailor John Paul Jones, a mythical figure linked to the origins of the American navy in the 1700s. John leaves his native country for conflicts with the powerful, then, after beating the British, ends up in Paris, following Benjamin Franklin. Disgraced, he ends up in the Tsar's court. From battle to battle, not even a fleeting Parisian love can keep him away from the beloved sea.
notes: Spectacular and refined but superficial cartoon. Bette Davis makes a fleeting appearance in the role of the Russian empress.

title: Jubilee Trail
actors: Vera Ralston, Joan Leslie, Forrest Tucker, John Russell, Ray Middleton, Pat O'Brien, Buddy Baer, Jim Davis
description: Love, jealousy and murder in a caravan traveling from New Orleans to California. Western routine tending towards melodrama.

title: The Big Sky
actors: Kirk Douglas, Dewey Martin, Elizabeth Threatt, Arthur Hunnicutt, Steven Geray, Buddy Baer, Henri Letondal, Hank Worden, Jim Davis
description: A trapper who roams the Great North meets a young daredevil hunter and becomes his friend. The two decide to embark together with a group of French hunters who want to reach an unexplored region to be able to trade in skins without submitting to the wishes of large companies. Indians and business rivals will try to block them.
notes: Hawks' classic western with balanced action and sharp writing. The friendship between the two protagonists is so virile as to be ambiguous, even if in the end an Indian princess with cat eyes intervenes to put things back in order. Great landscapes and an epic and philological spirit at the same time. Wayne refused to play the lead role, and regretted it. A cult.

title: The Big City
actors: Spencer Tracy, Luise Rainer, Charley Grapewin, Janet Beecher, Eddie Quillan, Victor Varconi, Oscar O'Shea, Helen Troy, William Demarest
description: The hardships of a taxi driver (Tracy) whose Russian wife is threatened with repatriation for a murder she did not commit. Film poised between realism and melodrama.

title: Il grande colpo di Surcouf
actors: Gérard Barray, Antonella Lualdi, Alberto Cevenini, Terence Morgan, Genevieve Casile, Armand Mestral, Gérard Tichy, Alberto Cevenini, Fernando Sancho
description: Now a quiet family man, the former privateer Surcouf is commissioned by Napoleon to recover some precious documents fallen into the hands of the English together with the fortress of the island of Mahais. Sample of technical and narrative naivety.

title: Tycoon
actors: John Wayne, Laraine Day, Cedric Hardwicke, Anthony Quinn, Judith Anderson, James Gleason, Grant Withers, Paul Fix, Fernando Alvarado
description: A North American firm has been awarded the contract for the construction of a railway in South America. The chief engineer (Wayne) is forced to attempt to excavate a tunnel in a mountain with too brittle rock. Endless disasters arise. The troubles of his heart are added to his work problems when he falls in love with the daughter of a local squire who is not very favorable to marriage.
notes: Big waste of rhetoric, but good tension. A Wayne who graduated from polytechnic is only perplexing.

title: The Great Race
actors: Jack Lemmon, Tony Curtis, Natalie Wood, Peter Falk, Keenan Wynn, Arthur O'Connell, Vivian Vance, Dorothy Provine, Larry Storch, George Macready, Ross Martin
description: At the beginning of the 20th century, an American newspaper organized a car race from New York to Paris. The young and attractive Leslie and the sneaky Professor Fate respond to the challenge. The journalist Maggie DuBois joins them. Fate only thinks of inventing tricks to harm the rival. Leslie thinks of Maggie, so much so that to show her his love he stops a few meters from the finish line and kisses her.
notes: A thunderous, spectacular and almost as long as the distance between New York and Paris. It's kind of odd to see Jack Lemmon as the villain, but the vibe is so inspired it almost doesn't clash. Dedicated to Laurel and Hardy.

title: Clara's Heart
actors: Whoopi Goldberg, Michael Ontkean, Neil Patrick Harris, Kathleen Quinlan, Spalding Gray, Beverly Todd, Hattie Winston, Jason Downs, Caitlin Thompson, Maria Broom
description: David is a little boy tried by life. There were two events that marked him most cruelly: the death of the sister he was very fond of and the separation of his parents. Following these two blows, his will to live seems to have run out but David is desperate for someone who can give it back. He will find the right person in Clara, the Jamaican housekeeper.
notes: Robert Mulligan this time is measured on the treacherous terrain of adolescent psychology, relying on the good Whoopi Goldberg. But the results are not entirely convincing.

title: The Great Dictator
actors: Charles Chaplin, Paulette Goddard, Jack Oakie, Reginald Gardiner, Henry Daniell, Billy Gilbert, Grace Hayle, Carter DeHaven
description: In Tomania the dictator Adenoid Hynkel unleashes the repression against the Jews. The beautiful Hannah and her lover, a barber strikingly resembling Hynkel, flee. The barber, first captured, escapes from the concentration camp and accidentally runs into the real dictator who is arrested in his stead. From the führer's microphones, the barber delivers a long message of peace and hope to the world.
notes: The first film entirely talked about by Chaplin, it is a brilliant anti-Nazi satire made when the armies of the Third Reich had by now subjugated the whole of Europe. Among the anthology sequences, Hynkel's dance with the globe and the "duets" with Napoloni / Mussolini.

title: The Big Chill
actors: William Hurt, Glenn Close, Tom Berenger, Kevin Kline, Jeff Goldblum, Mary Kay Place, Meg Tilly, JoBeth Williams, Don Galloway, James Gillis, Ken Place
description: For the funeral of old friend Alex, old college friends gather ...
notes: A well-constructed, at times exciting film, played by a group of actors destined for a well-deserved celebrity. Memorable soundtrack: the funeral that fades into _You Can't Always Get What You Want_ is not forgotten.

title: The Great Escape
actors: Steve McQueen, James Coburn, James Garner, Charles Bronson, Donald Pleasence, Richard Attenborough, James Donald, Hannes Messemer, David McCallum
description: During the Second World War, some Allied prisoners who have tried several times to escape each on their own, are transferred to a German camp characterized by special surveillance. So the escape specialists get to know each other and organize a mass escape through some underground tunnels. Although several of them are caught or killed, there are also some who manage to make it and cross enemy lines. Three years later "The Magnificent Seven" Sturges takes up some formal structures and, using part of the same cast, signs another jewel. Clever mosaic of characters and memorable, in the finale, Steve McQueen's crazy motorcycle escape.

title: The Great Gatsby
actors: Alan Ladd, Betty Field, Macdonald Carey, Ruth Hussey, Barry Sullivan, Howard Da Silva, Shelley Winters, Henry Hull, Ed Begley, Elisha Cook jr.
description: Back from the war, Gatsby finds his fiancée Daisy married to the wealthy Buchanan. He goes into business and gets rich; having become a millionaire he manages to see the woman again and between the two everything starts again. One night, Daisy, in a car with Gatsby, runs over and kills a woman; it's about Buchanan's lover. Gatsby declares himself responsible for the accident, with tragic consequences. First film version of Scott Fitzgerald's novel. Hollywood tries to pay tribute to a writer whose greatness it had guilty mocked, but the results are ordinary.

title: The Great Gatsby
actors: Robert Redford, Mia Farrow, Karen Black, Bruce Dern, Scott Wilson, Sam Waterston, Lois Chiles, Howard Da Silva, Roberts Blossom, Edward Herrmann
description: Stockbroker Nick lives near Jay Gatsby's luxurious mansion, mysteriously enriched. Daisy, her cousin, was once a lover of Gatsby, but is now married to the rich and cynical Tom. Gatsby manages to meet her, thanks to Nick, and asks her to divorce. She refuses but Tom, convinced of his wife's infidelity, threatens his rival. Finally, it will be Daisy, investing a woman with Gatsby's car, to provoke the intervention of her husband, who will kill him believing him responsible.
notes: From Scott Fitzgerald's famous book, Clayton goes no further than a more cloying than nostalgic ambient illustration.

title: And the Band Played On
actors: Matthew Modine, Alan Alda, Patrick Bauchau, Nathalie Baye, Richard Gere, Phil Collins, Lily Tomlin, Anjelica Huston, Steve Martin, Richard Jenkins
description: In 1976 a doctor from the World Health Organization discovers that in an African village the population has been decimated by a particular type of fever. Only a few years later at the Pasteur Institute in Paris and, almost at the same time, the virus responsible for AIDS was isolated in America. Slowly the world begins to become aware of the most serious epidemic of our century.
notes: The film, shot for cable TV, is full of famous actors (Gere, Tomlin, Modine) who wanted to demonstrate their sensitivity on the subject. The problem is that they are all there without knowing what to do. The intentions are more than praiseworthy, but the result is not too convincing.

title: Il grande giuoco
actors: Gina Lollobrigida, Arletty, Raymond Pellegrin, Peter Van Eyck, Jean-Claude Pascal, Jean Témerson, Jean Hébey, Gérard Buhr, Lila Kedrova
description: When the Parisian lawyer Marc met Silvia he completely lost his mind: to be close to her he committed dishonest acts that ruined his career. So he joined the foreign legion, to forget and be forgotten. A fortune-teller predicts new misfortunes for him, but he tries to rebuild a life with Elena, a girl he met in a brothel. Just as he is about to redeem his mistakes, he meets Silvia again and abandons everything by returning to the legion.
notes: Melodrama performed by the best French actors. It did not achieve the success that producer Rizzoli expected.

title: Big Trouble
actors: Peter Falk, Alan Arkin, Beverly D'Angelo, Charles Dunning, Robert Stack, Paul Dooley, Valerie Curtin, Richard Libertini, Steve Alterman
description: An insurance employee, in order to pay for college to his three children, arranges with a couple to organize a scam. The trick succeeds, but the prize is not paid. The two scammers then try to take the money directly from the company's safe, but run into a group of terrorist bombers. Last film directed by Cassavetes, it is a commissioned comedy, funny but not very personal. A parenthesis in the director's work.

title: Big Jake
actors: John Wayne, Richard Boone, Maureen O'Hara, Patrick Wayne, Christopher Mitchum, Bobby Vinton, Bruce Cabot, Glenn Corbett, Harry Carey jr., John Doucette
description: Little Jacob McCandles is kidnapped by a gang of outlaws who have attacked his family's farm and demand a millionaire ransom. Marta, the grandmother, decides to turn to her husband Jake, from whom she has lived separated for 15 years; he is still a vigorous type, despite his age. Pretending to accept the bandits' requests, he arrives at their lair accompanied by two sons and an old Indian; in the trunk there is no money but waste paper. John Wayne is in this film (the last directed by specialist George Sherman) sick, started towards sunset and looks like a monument to himself.

title: La grande luce - Montevergine
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, Leda Gloria, Enzo Biliotti, Elsa De Giorgi, Carlo Duse, Lauro Gazzolo, Giovanni Grasso, Giulio Tempesti, Renato Chiantoni, Giovanni Dolfini, Andrea Checchi, Nando Bruno
description: Forced to flee to Argentina because accused of a murder he did not commit, a blacksmith from the village of Montevergine finally sees his innocence recognized. He is about to return to his homeland when he unjustly ends up in jail. After ten years the dream of repatriation comes true, but ...
notes: The misfortunes of Nazzari in this film are pathological.

title: The Bigamist
actors: Edmond O'Brien, Joan Fontaine, Ida Lupino, Edmund Gwenn, Kenneth Tobey, Jane Darwell, Peggy Maley, Lilian Fontaine
description: Failing to have children, Henry and Eva Graham decide to adopt a child. But during the investigation that is being carried out on the intended parents, it is discovered that years before Henry had married another woman, Phillys, with whom he had a son. The man is thus tried on charges of bigamy.
notes: It is the fifth of Ida Lupino's seven directories (one of the very rare women behind the camera in Hollywood; it is also the first film in which she directed herself): a refined and grandiose melodrama. Collier Young, producer and screenwriter, had just divorced Lupino to marry Joan Fontaine, the lead actor. The strange combination works perfectly.

title: Casanova's Big Night
actors: Bob Hope, Joan Fontaine, Basil Rathbone, Vincent Price, John Carradine, Raymond Burr, Audrey Dalton, Hugh Marlowe, Arnold Moss, John Hoyt, Hope Emerson
description: In Venice, a tailoring boy who likes women very much, to win their favors he passes himself off as the great seducer of his fellow citizen Giacomo Casanova. But the comedy of misunderstandings ends up involving him dangerously in a conspiracy against the Doge. Sumptuous staging, solid cast, Bob Hope in great shape, McLeod conducts with panache.

title: The Big Country
actors: Gregory Peck, Charlton Heston, Jean Simmons, Carroll Baker, Burl Ives, Charles Bickford, Alfonso Bedoya, Chuck Connors, Chuck Hayward
description: The rivalry for the possession of a spring separates Colonel Terrill and the Hannassey family. Jim, boyfriend of Terrill's daughter, tries in vain to resolve the conflict peacefully: plus he feels attracted to Julie, the teacher who owns the area. Eventually Jim buys the valley and convinces the two rivals to take out each other.
notes: Monumental Western (over two and a half hours) and pacifist by Wyler. Almost a mythical struggle between two giants so that the "big country" can pass from prehistory to history. At the time it was read as an anti-cold war film between the US and the USSR.

title: The Rains Came
actors: Myrna Loy, Tyrone Power, George Brent, Brenda Joyce, Nigel Bruce, Maria Ouspenskaya, Joseph Schildkraut, Mary Nash, Jane Darwell, Marjorie Rambeau, Henry Travers
description: In Ranchipur, social life is restricted to the small group of Europeans and the family of Pastor Simon. The English Ransome is coveted by Simon's daughter while the vanesia Edwina, his former lover, tries in vain to seduce the serious Doctor Safti. Then an earthquake ensues, followed by a flood and a plague. On this occasion Edwina understands the true values ??of life, does her utmost for the unfortunate and decides to change her life.
notes: Spectacular sequences (won the Oscar for special effects) and great acting (Mirna Loy was named after the rejection of the great Marlene Dietrich). Jean Negulesco made a remake of it in 1955 with the title "The rains of Ranchipur".

title: Robbery Under Arms
actors: Peter Finch, Ronald Lewis, Maureen Swanson, David McCallum, Jill Ireland, Ursula Finlay, Laurence Naismith, Jean Anderson, Edna Morris
description: In Australia, two brothers who live as herdsmen are contacted by their father who has been living in the bush for some time. The man forces them to help him in a stolen livestock trade, but things go wrong and the two boys are forced to go underground. They change zones and resume working honestly as miners; but the past haunts them and their father still tracks them down. During the shooting following a bank robbery, his father and elder brother die; the youngest will thus find the strength to change life together with the girl who loves him. English production set in Australia with all the schemes of the western.

title: Rampage
actors: Robert Mitchum, Elsa Martinelli, Jack Hawkins, Sabu, Cely Carillo, Emile Genest, Stefan Schnabel, David Cadiente, Sylva Koscina
description: On behalf of a German zoo, Harry captures the "Enchantress" in Malaysia, a strange and very rare hybrid between the tiger and the leopard. After taking her to Germany, Abbott, a rival hunter, frustrated by Harry's superiority even in sentimental matters, releases the beast out of jealousy. A new beat is therefore necessary, this time between the roofs and the houses. Abbott falls victim to his own machinations as Harry saves his homeland once again.
notes: Scarce emotions, a mixture of genres and settings, in a film directed by a prince of B series films, also very active on television.

title: The Great Scout & Cathouse Thursday
actors: Lee Marvin, Oliver Reed, Strother Martin, Robert Culp, Elizabeth Ashley, Sylvia Miles, Kay Lenz, Howard Platt
description: In Colorado at the turn of the century, everyone seems obsessed with making money. Among them is an old cowboy who worked on the railways and now cultivates some political ambition, but ends up falling in love with a prostitute. And there is also a half-breed who, apart from an inordinate passion for white women, continues to concoct money-making plans that never work. Film based on the model of Butch Cassidy, which however fails to be as funny. The cast is full of western fetish actors, from Strother Martin to Lee Marvin, but paradoxically the surprise is Oliver Reed in the role of the Indian.

title: Cheyenne Autumn
actors: Richard Widmark, Carroll Baker, Karl Malden, James Stewart, Sal Mineo, Dolores Del Rio, Ricardo Montalban, Gilbert Roland, Arthur Kennedy, Edward G. Robinson
description: The Cheyenne are no longer able to survive in the wastelands and unhealthy lands where they have been confined. They then begin a march of over two thousand kilometers to return to the land of the ancestors. Decimated by hunger and fatigue, they are joined by Captain Thomas Archer and his soldiers. A difficult negotiation begins ...
notes: The western testament of the great Ford is a much more sincere and innovative "political" film than others that in the following years they wanted to pass in favor of the Indians. After the claustrophobic interlude of "The Man Who Killed Liberty Valance", the latest concession of Ford's unmistakable gaze towards the great spaces of American nature.

title: Il grande silenzio
actors: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Klaus Kinski, Frank Wolff, Vonetta McGee, Marisa Merlini, Luigi Pistilli, Mario Brega, Carlo D'Angelo, Raf Baldassarre
description: From the hills of Utah, snow and misery drive desperate and outlawed outlaws into the bush, passing game for bounty hunters. Against Tigrero, the most ruthless of them, a mute gunslinger called Silenzio stands up. A sheriff gets in the way between the two, but the dramatic epilogue is only postponed.
notes: A nice Italian western, disconsolate and realistic like few others. Composite cast, evocative shifting and Morricone's music.

title: The Big Sleep
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Lauren Bacall, John Ridgely, Martha Vickers, Dorothy Malone, Peggy Knudsen, Regis Toomey, Charles Waldron, Charles D. Brown, Bob Steele, Elisha Cook jr.
description: Private investigator Philip Marlowe is hired by Elder General Sternwood to find out who blackmails his youngest daughter. Marlowe accepts the assignment, which turns out to be more complicated than expected. The girl, her older sister and brother-in-law are involved in an unclean round of gambling.
notes: The classic "cult movie" of entire generations of cinéphiles. The Bogart / Bacall couple is magnetic, Chandler's novel is adapted by William Faulkner and Leigh Brackett, the plot is enigmatic (even for the actors themselves, who claimed not to understand anything), some scenes (Bacall's father in the greenhouse) unforgettable. Music by max Steiner and photography by Sidney Hickox.

title: La grande strada azzurra
actors: Yves Montand, Alida Valli, Francisco Rabal, Umberto Spadaro, Peter Carsten, Federica Ranchi, Terence Hill, Ronaldo Bonacchi, Giancarlo Soblone
description: Squerciò uses explosives to fish. For a long time he manages to get away with it, then, preparing a bomb, he remains dry. Pontecorvo's debut was not very successful.

title: The Shepherd of the Hills
actors: John Wayne, Betty Field, Beluah Bondi, Harry Carey, James Barton, Samuel S. Hinds, Marjorie Main, Ward Bond, Marc Lawrence
description: Dr. Howitt stops at Sammy's home to treat her injured father. Sammy is engaged to Jack, a boy with a painful family background, having been abandoned by his father at a young age. Howitt decides to stop and his resemblance to Jack cannot fail to be noticed. The two will clash with gunfire. The story is as old as America, but Wayne, who was in his early thirties, works. Perfect direction.

title: The Big Red One
actors: Lee Marvin, Mark Hamill, Robert Carradine, Bobby Di Cicco, Kelly Ward, Stéphane Audran, Siegfried Rauch, Serge Marquand, Charles Macaulay, Alain Doutey
description: Second World War. The Sergeant and his four soldiers form an "invulnerable" patrol under the "Big Red One", the first American infantry regiment. The battles follow one another, front after front, from Tunisia to Sicily; from Normandy to Belgium; through Europe to Czechoslovakia, where the horrors of the Nazi concentration camps are discovered. At the end of the war, the Sergeant, as had already happened to him at the end of the First World War, stabbed a German by mistake, but this time he did everything to save him.
notes: The big red One does not make war a spectacle and at the same time does not go in search of the "museum of horrors". It is a controlled film, yet its dramatic impact is the same as a journalistic account showing what exactly war is: to kill or be killed. Fuller participated on the front line in the Second World War; his alter ego in this film, made up exclusively of soldiers, is Robert Carradine: an unnamed sergeant and untouched by emotions, "embodied symbol and admonisher of death".

title: Grandi magazzini
actors: Enrico Montesano, Nino Manfredi, Lino Banfi, Paolo Villaggio, Renato Pozzetto, Massimo Boldi, Christian De Sica, Laura Antonelli, Ornella Muti, Michele Placido, Alessandro Haber, Heather Parisi, Gigi Reder, Isabella Biagini, Leo Gullotta
description: Montesano, Villaggio and Pozzetto work in a large emporium populated by singular figures, both among customers and among the sales managers themselves. Rather than following a real plot, the film collects small burlesque episodes based on daily observations and on the propensities of the performers, on their tics and their idiosyncrasies. To those already mentioned are added, in other roles, Manfredi, Placido, Boldi, Banfi, De Sica (Christian) and others.
notes: The film is only the same name as that of Camerini. Despite the deployment of actors, you almost never laugh. Very old gags and less than televised rhythm.

title: I grandi magazzini
actors: Assia Noris, Vittorio De Sica, Luisella Beghi, Andrea Checchi, Enrico Glori, Virgilio Riento, Milena Penovich, Mattia Giancola
description: Suspected of theft, blackmailed by the chief of staff, abandoned by her boyfriend, a department store clerk no longer knows what to do. Then the truth comes out, the chief of staff is exposed and love triumphs. Camerini with Assia Noris and De Sica were the best that could be asked of the Italian cinema of the time. Once again, the director investigates the places of the nascent modernity and lovingly outlines the very small Italian bourgeoisie that faces them.

title: Les grandes manoeuvres
actors: Michèle Morgan, Gérard Philipe, Jean Desailly, Brigitte Bardot, Pierre Dux, Jacques Fabbri, Jacques François, Yves Robert, Lise Delamare
description: Armand, a young and brilliant lieutenant of the dragons and infallible conqueror of women, decides, as a wager, to entrust to chance who his next victim should be. The fate falls on the young divorced Marie Louise Riviére, a lady who has opened a fashion shop in the town. During the courtship, however, Armand really falls in love with the woman. Forced to leave the town for a short time, the lieutenant leaves the field open to the woman who learns of the bet. When Armand returns, determined to declare his love to the woman, he finds Marie Louise disillusioned and now completely detached from him. An excellent Gérard Philippe at the service of the late Clair's masterpiece, a melancholy comedy of yesteryear.

title: Big Brown Eyes
actors: Cary Grant, Joan Bennett, Walter Pidgeon, Lloyd Nolan, Alan Baxter, Marjorie Gateson, Isabel Jewell, Douglas Fowley, Henry Brandon
description: A gang of jewelry thieves is driving the police mad. To solve the case, even catching the criminals red handed, a detective takes care of it, aided by a pretty journalist who is in love with him.

title: Great Expectations
actors: John Mills, Valerie Hobson, Finlay Currie, Tony Wager, Jean Simmons, Bernard Miles, Francis L. Sullivan, Martita Hunt, Alec Guinness
description: Raised by the gloomy Miss Havisham, young Pip manages to enter the best society thanks to the bequest of an unknown benefactor. Here he finds Estella, known at the time of her unfortunate childhood, but above all she discovers who her guardian angel is: a convict he had helped years earlier. Once again he tries to rescue him, but the police, alerted by a complaint, kill the man. Before dying, he reveals to Pip that he is Estella's father. Admirable adaptation, for sensitivity and finesse, of the Dickensian universe, its themes and its atmospheres. Oscar in photography and scenography.

title: Children Of the Corn II: the Final Sacrifice
actors: Terence Knox, Paul Scherrer, Ryan Bollman, Christie Clark, Rosalind Allen, Ned Romero, Ed Grady, John Bennes, Wallace Merck
description: The city of Gatlin had been devastated in 1983 by a wave of mysterious murders, the victims of which were always adults. After a long investigation it was discovered that the killers were a group of children controlled by a sect who practiced grisly rituals. Now the murderous children are back and have started killing again: it will be up to a journalist, who has arrived in town because he hopes to write a memorable article, to face the threat.
notes: Based on a Stephen King novel, "Blood Wheat" was Linda Hamilton's first leading role. In the second episode, in addition to the suspense, she is also missing. Passed only on TV.

title: Grattacieli
actors: Luigi Pavese, Vanna Vanni, Renato Cialente, Elena Maltzeff, Paolo Stoppa, Guido Notari, Yvonne Giannini
description: During a party organized in an attic of a New York skyscraper, one of the guests, drunk, falls from the terrace and falls into the street. Inspector Stoll, however, is not convinced by the thesis of the accident and continues the investigation. Weak Italian production, shot at the time when the importation of American films was prohibited by the regime. Guglielmo Giannini takes up a comedy of his own, but the delirious New York setting, which perhaps did not clash in the theater, becomes almost ridiculous in the cinema.

title: Grazie... nonna
actors: Edwige Fenech, Valerio Fioravanti, Enrico Simonetti, Fabrizio Cardinali, Gianfranco D'Angelo, Valeria Fabrizi, Graziella Mossini, Antonio Canterini
description: Carletto, the youngest son of the engineer Pino Persichetti, is sent to receive Marijuana, the unknown Venezuelan widow of Pino's father. But instead of the nuisance badly expected by everyone, the boy finds a young and beautiful grandmother: from that moment, the attractive "grandmother" becomes the object of desire of the males of the Persichetti house, but without anything, or almost nothing happening. ...
notes: The real attraction of this film is not so much seeing the Fenech naked (this is trivial and often happened): rather it is that of seeing at least ten other films of the genre looted. Shortly thereafter, the beardless Giusva Fioravanti began a very different career.

title: Grazie zia
actors: Lou Castel, Lisa Gastoni, Gabriele Ferzetti, Nicoletta Rizzi, Luisa De Santis, Massimo Sarchielli, Anita Cacciolati
description: Alvise is a neuropathic boy who pretends to be paralyzed and is entrusted to the care of the young and wealthy Aunt Lea. Between the two he establishes a relationship with morbid implications, manipulated by the lucid madness of the patient, who induces his aunt to leave her lover and to implement her self-destruction project ...
notes: Despite his presumptions, in reality extremely conventional characters, situations and dialogues prevail in this film. But the film had a great success in Italy, becoming a "phenomenon of costume". Bravissimo Lou Castel, who three years earlier had interpreted _The fists in the pocket_ by Marco Bellocchio.

title: Grease
actors: John Travolta, Olivia Newton-John, Stockard Channing, Jeff Conaway, Barry Pearl, Michael Tucci, Kelly Ward, Didi Conn, Jamie Donnelly, Dinah Manoff, Eve Arden, Frankie Avalon, Joan Blondell
description: During the school holidays Danny befriends Sandy, an Australian girl. To his surprise he finds her in his own college, but feigns indifference because he's a real tough guy. After a dance contest that Danny wins paired with another girl, the two finally get together.
notes: Now a cult movie. That transcends the same aesthetic merits. Better "teenage" musicals have been seen, but the alchemy found by Kleiser on the set did indeed reward this fairy tale in time to the music. Some hits will become famous. Great Stockard Channing as the wild Rizzo.

title: Green Card
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Andie MacDowell, Bebe Neuwirth, Gregg Edelman, Robert Prosky, Jessie Keosian, Ethan Phillips, Mary Louise Wilson, Lois Smith, Conrad McLaren
description: Georges Faure is a French composer, portly and crude as well as genius and sensitive. To be able to settle in the United States, he needs a Green Card. The fastest way to get it is to marry an American. Bronte Barrish is an American girl, a refined botanist. Bronte has just found a delightful apartment, but the landlord has no intention of renting it except to a married couple.
notes: Weir returns to reflect on the relationship between nature and culture: McDowell's highly rational botany against the slouching ape Depardieu. A sophisticated comedy, such as not seen in years.

title: Gremlins
actors: Zach Galligan, Phoebe Cates, Hoyt Axton, Don Steele, Susan Burgess, Frances Lee McCain, Polly Holliday, Judge Reinhold, Scott Brady, Corey Feldman, Keye Luke
description: An original gift? Here is a Mogwai, a cute little animal that peeps out of a cage in the back room of a Chinese junk dealer. But be careful: he suffers from the light, he must not come into contact with water and, above all, he must not eat after midnight. The new owners, little boys, make everything wrong and from the wet down of the Mogwai splash fierce Gremlins, pestiferous creatures that quickly multiply excessively, put the city to fire and sword and terrorize all the inhabitants. A little boy, with the help of the "good" Mogway, tries to deal with the "enemies".
notes: The Amblin production, or the award-winning company Spielberg & C., has struck again. Joe Dante directs a hilarious bloodless horror, a ferocious Christmas fairy tale for naughty children, full of rhythm and cinephile winks.

title: Greystoke: the Legend of Tarzan, Lord of the Apes
actors: Christopher Lambert, Andie MacDowell, Ralph Richardson, Ian Holm, James Fox, Cheryl Campbell, Ian Charleson, Nigel Davenport, Nicholas Farrell, Paul Geoffrey
description: In 1886 the Scottish nobleman John Clayton and his wife were shipwrecked on the west coast of Africa. The two do not survive the hostile environment: Alice dies giving birth to little Jack, John is killed by an ape called Silverbeard, for the white fur on his face. The child, rescued and cared for by a female monkey, once grown up, fights with Silverbeard and snatches the command of the pack from him. But human nature continues to live in him as an instinct. Hudson's direction is effective in the scenes shot in Cameroon and the show is guaranteed, despite certain delays in the second part.

title: Il grido della Terra
actors: Andrea Checchi, Marina Berti, Carlo Ninchi, Luigi Tosi, Vivi Gioi, Filippo Scelzo, Peter Trent, Elena Zareschi, Alessandro Fersen, Nerio Bernardi
description: Freed from a concentration camp thanks to the allies, the surgeon Tannen reaches Palestine and discovers that his son David is engaged in the guerrilla war against the British. Following an attack, David is captured and taken to arms.
notes: An instant movie that was immediately overtaken by current events. Costumes by Luzzati, among the screenwriters also Carlo Levi.

title: Schrei aus Stein
actors: Vittorio Mezzogiorno, Mathilda May, Brad Dourif, Donald Sutherland, Stefan Glowacz, Al Waxman, Gunilla Karlzen, Chavela Vargas, Georg Marischka, Lautaro Murua
description: An expedition wants to climb the very difficult Cerro Torre, the high peak of Patagonia, to challenge a great mountaineer who has announced the same intention. During the ascent a climber dies and the survivor claims to have reached the summit. Are you sure there hasn't been someone else before?
notes: The German director Werner Herzog, from a (reneged) project by Messner, wants to celebrate an impossible feat by mixing it with the controversy against the mass media (television organizes the challenge) and against the sophisticated methods of modern mountaineering. But the message is confused and the outcome uncertain, even if the views take your breath away. Sorporesa cinephile in the final.

title: A Cry in the Dark
actors: Meryl Streep, Sam Neill, Dale Reeves, David Hoflin, Bruce Myles, Jason Reason, Michael Wetter, Kane Barton, Trent Roberts
description: The Chamberlain couple, accused of killing their newborn daughter, claim that the child was kidnapped at night by a wild dog, which entered the campsite where they were spending their holidays. The media go crazy, public opinion is hostile; while the mother, hard on the edge of antipathy, does not yield, the father instead collapses. Yet proof will eventually appear that husband and wife are innocent. Another difficult female portrait to hang in Meryl Streep's personal gallery. The film is a rigorous but somewhat anonymous denunciation of the consequences of intolerance that an information campaign that is too spectacular and arrogant can lead to.

title: El aventurero de Guaynas
actors: John Richardson, Gloria Milland, Evi Marandi, Fernando Sancho, Mia Genberg, Eduardo Fajardo, Luis Gaspar, José María Caffarel, Luis Induni
description: Irish adventurer on a treasure hunt makes the revolution in spite of himself. Latin Western between powerful shady, Mexican rebels and mysterious treasures, with somic and buffoonish touches.

title: True Grit
actors: John Wayne, Glen Campbell, Kim Darby, Dennis Hopper, Jeremy Slate, Robert Duvall, Alfred Ryder, Strother Martin, Jeff Corey, Ron Soble
description: Mattie Ross, a young ranch owner who was orphaned after her father's murder, teams up with an elderly sheriff, called "El Grinta", to avenge him. The two are joined by the young government agent La Boeuf. Reached the bandits, a firefight breaks out in which La Boeuf is killed, while the girl, bitten by a snake, is brought to safety by the "Grinta".
notes: The twilight of the western genre could only be represented by the "archaic" figure of Wayne. Eyepatch, whiskey and gun always ready, abrupt ways, but heart of gold to say goodbye to an epic genre. For this role alone, the Duke won the Oscar.

title: Touchez pas au grisbi
actors: Jean Gabin, Jeanne Moreau, René Dary, Dora Doll, Lino Ventura, Vittorio Sanipoli, Marilyn Buferd, Daniel Cauchy, Delia Scala, Paul Frankeur
description: A gang of gangsters land a big shot that yields fifty kilos of gold bars. Due to the imprudence of one of the group, rival bandits blackmail the perpetrators and to save a friend the old gang leader gives up the swag. The meeting with the rivals however ends in a carnage.
notes: Based on a novel in the "Série noire", the film is masterfully directed by Jacques Becker, with a dry and quick style, beautiful chiaroscuro and played by a great Gabin (awarded in Venice), unsurpassed in drawing portraits of old boys disenchanted by life. A novice Jeanne Moreau completes the cast.

title: The Grissom Gang
actors: Kim Darby, Scott Wilson, Irene Dailey, Tony Musante, Robert Lansing, Connie Stevens, Wesley Addy, Joey Faye, Michael Baseleon
description: A thief, Frankie Connor, kidnaps Barbara Blandish, the young daughter of a billionaire. After killing him, Ma'Grissom's gang, consisting of a mother and four children (Slim, Eddie, Woopy and Mace), takes over the affair. Having obtained the ransom of one million dollars, Ma decides to kill the girl, but Slim, who has fallen in love with her, takes her under his protection.
notes: Based on the novel "No Orchids for Miss Blandish" by James Hadley Chase, Aldrich's film goes beyond the genre by composing a ferocious cross-section of the America of the Great Depression. A great gangster movie that has long been underestimated.

title: Big Trouble in Little China
actors: Kurt Russell, Kim Cattrall, Dennis Dun, James Hong, Victor Wong, Kate Burton, Donald Li, Carter Wong, Peter Kwong, James Pax, Suzee Pai
description: Jack Burton, a truck driver, accompanies his friend Wang Chi to the airport to pick up his girlfriend Miao Yin, arriving from China. The woman is kidnapped by a sect of fanatics led by the diabolical Lo Pan. To save her, Jack and Wang Chi are even forced to fight against Chinese demons. Adrenaline-fueled action comedy, mocking kung fu movies and some Hong Kong fantasy. Without irreverence, indeed, with respect for the contamination that Carpenter has always shown. Russell demolishes the myth of Jena Plissken with an excellent interpretation.

title: Grosso guaio a Miami
actors: Bud Spencer, Michael Winslow
description: Arriving in Miami to give an energy lecture, Chinese scientist Tien, who is in possession of vital technological secrets for the planet, is kidnapped and replaced with a double. During a car trip the latter is blown up. The beautiful Lee, the scientist's niece, instructs Extralarge and her assistant Dumas to find her missing uncle. The girl is the victim of an attack, thwarted by detectives, by two Orientals. The mystery surrounding the whole affair thickens more and more until the unpredictable, unsuspected final. Bud Spencer once again plays the role of Extralarge, the detective made famous by the homonymous television series, who prefers to use slaps instead of weapons. fire.

title: First Family
actors: Bob Newhart, Gilda Radner, Madeline Kahn, Richard Benjamin, Bob Dishy, Harvey Korman, Austin Pendleton, Rip Torn, Fred Willard, John Hancock
description: A haughty and clumsy president of the United States (Newhart) seeks an alliance with his counterpart in a neighboring state for not too clear purposes. He is joined by a gassed First Lady, perpetually on the verge of a nervous breakdown, and a ridiculous daughter rather inclined to sexual adventure.
notes: The film stands out for some moments of healthy and demented fun. The original title "First Family" best stated the theme of this film: a satire of America's sacred presidential family institute. The title eagle is of course the one that stands out on the United States coat of arms.

title: The Group
actors: Candice Bergen, Joan Hackett, Elizabeth Hartman, Shirley Knight, Joanna Pettet, Mary-Robin Redd, Jessica Walter, Kathleen Widdoes, James Broderick, Larry Hagman, Hal Holbrook
description: A group of eight girls, ex-school friends, find themselves after years at the funeral of one of them who committed suicide. Well acted and beautifully photographed version of Mary McCarthy's novel by Boris Kaufman. It is the debut film for both Candice Bergen and Joan Hackett.

title: Guai ai vinti
actors: Lea Padovani, Anna Maria Ferrero, Pierre Cressoy, Clelia Matania, Camillo Pilotto, Gualtiero Tumiati, Paola Quattrini, Rolf Tasna, Emilio Cigoli, Marcella Rovena
description: During the First World War two Italian women, Luisa, married, and her young sister-in-law, unmarried, were subjected to violence by a group of Austrian soldiers. Both conceive a baby, one having an abortion while the other accepts motherhood. All around there is a husband, a traumatized daughter and many prejudices.
notes: Matarazzo was the undisputed master of made in Italy cinematic melodrama. The flaws of this film, inspired by a novel by Annie Vivanti, are the excessively literary structure and the interpreters who do not help to make a too overloaded story fluid.

title: I guappi non si toccano
actors: Gabriele Tinti, Paola Senatore, Richard Harrison, Pino Mauro, Marisa Laurito, Tommaso Palladino, Enrico Maisto, Enzo D'Ausilio, Emi Salvador, Gianni Diana
description: Tony, a former FBI agent, is called by the Naples police commissioner to investigate the trafficking of two gangs. He infiltrates the outlaws, pushes them to mortally clash with each other, but realizes that there is something stinking about the whole thing. Very "shouted" detective. Music by Tullio De Piscopo, secondary part for the late singer Pino Mauro, specialized in underworld songs.

title: Guardia, guardia scelta, brigadiere e maresciallo
actors: Alberto Sordi, Peppino De Filippo, Aldo Fabrizi, Gino Cervi, Valeria Moriconi, Tiberio Mitri, Nino Manfredi, Alessandra Panaro, Memmo Carotenuto, Riccardo Garrone, Mino Doro
description: Four comic episodes held together by the common denominator of the characters' belonging to the police force. The first is a particularly fussy policeman, the second of a chosen guard who has composed a new hymn for the band of the body, the third a good-natured brigadier father of a family and the fourth an understanding marshal.
notes: As many sacred monsters of Italian comedy were called to interpret the different roles, chosen for the different type of comedy: from the coarse one of Sordi to the "Neapolitan" one of Peppino; from Fabrizi's bonhomie to Cervi's understatement. The result, however, is not irresistible.

title: Guardia, ladro e cameriera
actors: Nino Manfredi, Mario Carotenuto, Luciano Salce, Gabriella Pallotta, Fausto Cigliano, Bice Valori, Marco Guglielmi, Gianni Minervini
description: Othello, an amateur thief, tries a shot on New Year's Eve but finds, in the house he thought empty, the maid Adalgisa. He is basically a good guy, much more honest than Amerigo, a night watchman who tries to take advantage of the situation. After a series of misunderstandings and exchanges of the parties, everything is resolved: the guard is promoted, while the thief and the waitress get together.
notes: The game is a bit weak, but Manfredi was still perky and Mario Carotenuto is a character actor like none exist anymore.

title: Guardie e ladri
actors: Totò, Aldo Fabrizi, Ave Ninchi, Rossana Podestà, William Tubbs, Ernesto Almirante, Pina Piovani, Pietro Carloni, Mario Castellani, Carlo Delle Piane, Aldo Giuffré
description: Thief out of necessity is recognized by one of his victims, but manages to escape capture. The carabiniere who let him escape is threatened with expulsion from the army if he does not arrest him within three months.
notes: One of the best films with Totò, which describes the Italy of reconstruction in a hilarious and pathetic way (screenplay by Flaiano, Steno, Monicelli, Farizi and Brancati awarded at Cannes). Famous moments: the pursuit of a fatigued guard and thief, Totò pretending to be tuberculous, the familiar skits with Ave Ninchi. Totò awarded as best actor at the Cannes Film Festival.

title: Guendalina
actors: Jacqueline Sassard, Raf Vallone, Sylva Koscina, Raf Mattioli, Leda Gloria, Lili Cerasoli, Fanny Landini, Loretta Capitoli, Leonardo Botta, Carla Gravina
description: The young Guendalina is spending the holidays with her parents in Viareggio. But these, rich and bored, continue to quarrel. So the girl, having to extend her holidays, left the usual friends, remains alone. He knows and slowly falls in love with an architecture student, thanks to whom he finally manages to see clearly inside himself. At this point, however, Guendalina must start again.
notes: A specialist in portraits of girls in bloom, Alberto Lattuada achieves here the delicate and difficult balance between sensual and psychological representation.

title: The Secret War of Harry Frigg
actors: Paul Newman, Sylva Koscina, Andrew Duggan, Tom Bosley, John Williams, Charles Gray, Vito Scotti, Jacques Roux, Werner Peters, James Gregory
description: Loves, pleasures and evasion attempts of five allied generals imprisoned in Italy during the Second World War. Rundown farce, Paul Newman saves what he can.

title: La guerre des boutons
actors: André Tréton, Michel Isella, Martin Lartigue, Jacques Dufilho, Michel Galabru, Yvette Etiévant, Michèle Meritz, Jean Richard, Pierre Tchernia
description: Boys from two rival French schools battle it out. Up for grabs: the buttons of the jackets. A childhood classic by Louis Pergaud successfully adapted by Robert.

title: The War of the Worlds
actors: Gene Barry, Ann Robinson, Les Tremayne, Robert Cornthwaite, Sandro Giglio, Lewis Martin, Houseley Stevenson Jr., Paul Frees
description: A meteorite falls to earth near a small town in the United States. In reality it is a device sent by the Martians to conquer the earth: some strange and terrifying beings in fact escape from the device pulverizing everything that enters their range. When the situation seems desperate, the Martians mysteriously begin to die: it is the terrestrial bacteria that kill them. Rat from the novel of the same name by the writer H. G. Wells, the film won the Oscar for special effects, for the time truly remarkable. A typical film from the Cold War era.

title: La guerre du feu
actors: Everett McGill, Ron Perlman, Nicholas Kadi, Rae Dawn Chong, Gary Schwartz, Naseer El-Kadi, Franck-Olivier Bonnet, Jean-Michel Kindt
description: In the Stone Age, the Ulam paleantropic tribe is attacked by a clan of Neanderthals. The fight causes the fire to go out, and three members of the Ulam move in search of the precious element: during the journey they help a woman, who teaches them the technique to light the flame ...
notes: Adventures characterized by panache and humor (scripted by Gérard Brach, from a novel by J.H. Rosny sr.), Excellently set and photographed by a director skilled in manipulating history in a fantastic way (one title above all, _The name of the rose_). The work of consultants Desmond Morris and Anthony Burgess, experts respectively in gestural and guttural languages, is important.

title: La guerra di Troia
actors: Steve Reeves, Edy Wessel, John Drew Barrymore, Juliette Mayniel, Lidia Alfonsi, Warner Bentivegna, Luciana Angiolillo, Arturo Dominici, Mimmo Palmara, Nerio Bernardi
description: At the death of Hector, the Trojan camp is divided by two factions: that of Paris and that of Aeneas. Paris treacherously kills Achilles and imprisons Aeneas, who thus witnesses the fall of the city without being able to do anything. His wife is killed during the fighting, but he manages to escape to Italy.
notes: Vulgarization of the background of the "Aeneid" and of some chapters of the "Iliad". Modest peplum from Cinecittà, supported only by the muscles of Steve "Mister Universo" Reeves.

title: Vojna i mir
actors: Lyudmila Saveleva, Sergey Bondarchuk, Vyacheslav Tikhonov, Boris Zakhava, Anatoli Ktorov, Anastasiya Vertinskaya, Antonina Shuranova, Oleg Tabakov
description: In 1805 Napoleon's troops invade Russia. Prince Andrei enlists, disappointed in his marriage, while his friend Pierre woos the gay Natasha; but marries another. Prince Andrei is wounded during the war against the Napoleonic invader. Back home, he falls in love with Natasha, then returns to the front and dies. His friend Pierre feels the war like a curse, then a new life begins alongside Natasha. Soviet Kolossal directed by the official director of the regime, in two parts (The Fire of Moscow "and" Natasha ") lasting respectively 135 and 128 minutes. The transcription of Tolstoy's novel is not unfaithful even if the direction is more insistent on spectacular scenes , such as warfare, dances, duels, troops retreating into the snow, etc.

title: Vojna i mir I
actors: Lyudmila Saveleva, Sergey Bondarchuk, Vyacheslav Tikhonov, Viktor Stanitsyn, Kira Golovko, Oleg Tabakov, Irina Gubanova, Anatoli Ktorov
description: In 1805 Napoleon's troops invade Russia. Prince Andrei enlists, disappointed in his marriage, while his friend Pierre woos the gay Natasha; but marries another.

title: Duck Soup
actors: Groucho Marx, Harpo Marx, Chico Marx, Zeppo Marx, Margaret Dumont, Raquel Torres, Louis Calhern, Edmund Breese
description: Rufus Firefly, a perfect incompetent, confused and ruffian, is appointed prime minister of Freedonia. The country is in the throes of an economic crisis and is also threatened by the neighboring state of Sylvania, which puts two spies, Pinky and Chicolini, on Firefly's ribs. By dint of seeing them around, Firefly makes them join his staff. Fifth film by the Marx gang, it is an overwhelming succession of gags in which Groucho involves friends and enemies in a ferocious parody of the games of high politics. Numerous hilarious jokes: "Are you following me?" (in the speech). "Yes, I follow her." "Stop following me or I'll call the police."

title: Conspiracy of Hearts
actors: Lilli Palmer, Sylvia Syms, Yvonne Mitchell, Albert Levien, Ronald Lewis, Peter Arne, Nora Swinburne, Michael Goodliffe, Megs Jenkins
description: Sister Katryn is the mother superior of a convent a short distance from a Nazi concentration camp for Jewish children. With the complicity of the Italian commander of the camp, the nun manages to save many prisoners, until the arrival of the new commander, the German Horsten. Three nuns are immediately sentenced by Horsten to be shot, but the Italian platoon refuses to carry out the order.
notes: The subject is one of those on which you do not mess around and the film has moments of intense drama. Which does not prevent Ralph Thomas, a solid director of consumer cinema, from making it more edible, leaving room for spectacularity.

title: La guerra segreta
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Henry Fonda, Annie Girardot, Robert Ryan, Bourvil, Georges Marchal, Peter Van Eyck, Mario Adorf, Maria Grazia Buccella, Jacques Sernas
description: A Russian officer flees East Berlin and seeks refuge with the American command in Germany. Before being killed by some hitmen, he uncovers a plot of some Soviet spies who want to destroy two American submarines and kidnap a nuclear scientist. A merciless clash opens between Paris, Djibouti and Rome.
notes: Spying mess starring famous actors from many countries ("the allies" of cinema) and directed by three directors. In Rome he directs Lizzani, in Djibouti Christian-Jacque and in Berlin Young, who mimics himself and his James Bond films. The film was an announced flop.

title: Star Wars
actors: Mark Hamill, Harrison Ford, Carrie Fisher, Peter Cushing, Alec Guinness, Anthony Daniels, Kenny Baker, Peter Mayhew, David Prowse, Phil Brown, Shelagh Fraser, Jack Purvis
description: The despotic Lord Darth Vader has waged war on a galactic empire. Princess Leia Organa, representative of the rebels, is his prisoner but she has managed to steal the plans of the Death Star, Lord Vader's space base that can disintegrate an entire planet. Elder General Obi-Wan Kenobi and young Luke Skywalker free Princess Leia and then lead the attack on the Death Star. An adventure that skillfully mixes the flavors of the western, myths of chivalry and horror. Large means, a lot of imagination and technological prodigies for a realization that has left a mark in American cinema, reworking myths and fantasies from the inside, and paving the way for the cinema of the following decades, Oscar for the soundtrack (very famous, by John Williams) , the scenography, the costumes, the editing, the sound and of course the special effects. A new restored edition with new sequences was released in 1997. Followed by "The Empire Strikes Back" (1980) and "Return of the Jedi" (1983), produced by Lucas and directed by Irvin Kershner and Richard Marquand respectively. In 1999 "Star Wars - The Phantom Menace" finally arrived, the first episode of a trilogy that tells the preamble to "Star Wars".

title: I guerrieri dell'anno 2072
actors: Jared Martin, Fred Williamson, Howard Ross, Eleonora Brigliadori, Renato Rossini, Cosimo Cinieri, Claudio Cassinelli, Valeria Cavalli, Donald O'Brien, Penny Brown, Al Cliver, Mario Novelli, Hal Yamanouchi
description: In 2072 the Earth is united under one power and the citizens live only according to the TV shows. A network organizes a deadly game in the Colosseum arena and to ensure the success of the initiative ensures that among the gladiators there is also a motorcycling champion unjustly condemned. With the help of a girl and another gladiator, the young man rebels and takes revenge by destroying the radio stations. Poor film but with many ideas and a good realization directed by veteran Lucio Fulci. Among the performers an unknown Eleonora Brigliadori and Renato Rossini, who played Ercole in the sixties.

title: Who'll Stop the Rain
actors: Nick Nolte, Tuesday Weld, Michael Moriarty, Anthony Zerbe, Richard Masur, Ray Sharkey, Gail Strickland, Charles Haid, David Opatoshu
description: Before returning from Vietnam, a journalist and a marine buy a batch of heroin to sell at home ...
notes: One of the first films to deal with the veterans of the dirty war and directed by the great Karel Reisz. The two drifters who return to their homeland find a very different society where hope is gone and utopias have failed.

title: The Warriors
actors: Michael Beck, James Remar, Thomas Waites, Deborah Van Valkenburgh, Dorsey Wright, Brian Tyler, David Harris, Tom McKitterick, Marcelino Sánchez, Roger Hill, David Patrick Kelly
description: During the meeting called to bring peace between the New York gangs, Cyrus, the organizer of the meeting, is killed. The Warriors are accused of the murder, and for them the return home will be bloody and full of ambushes. At dawn, having reached the beach of Coney Island, the Warriors will have to face the final challenge ...
notes: A sort of metropolitan western with exorbitant doses of music and violence. The opening sequence is extraordinary, the clash with the female gang is like an anthology, the one with the baseball bats is heart-stopping. Inspired by Xenophon's Anabasis, it has generated a real apocalyptic-metropolitan vein.

title: Kelly's Heroes
actors: Clint Eastwood, Telly Savalas, Don Rickles, Donald Sutherland, Carroll O'Connor, Gavin MacLeod, Hal Buckley, Stuart Margolin, Jeff Morris
description: After landing in France, the enterprising soldier Kelly learns that behind the German lines, in a bank, there is a pile of gold bars ready for transfer to Germany. Kelly convinces Sergeant Big Joe to attempt the coup: taking advantage of three days' leave, his whole platoon enters the enemy lines and, with some losses, seizes the treasure.
notes: Pleasant and with some humorous touches a bit forced, in the wake of the picaresque war films of those years. International cast.

title: American Ninja
actors: Michael Dudikoff, Steve James, Judie Aronson, Guich Koock, John Fujioka, Don Stewart, John LaMotta, Tadashi Yamashita, Phillip Brock
description: Joe, who learned Ninja techniques as a child in the Philippines, returns to the Asian archipelago as an American soldier. Discovered a plot between the local mafia and a US Army officer, he must confront the old martial arts master found and save his beloved Rose. The first of a serial that will arrive who knows how to five episodes, produced by Cannon by Menahem Golan and Goran Globus.

title: American Ninja 4: The Annihilation
actors: Michael Dudikoff, David Bradley, James Booth, Dwayne Alexandre, Ken Gampu, Robin Stille, Frantz Dobrowsky, Ron Smerczak
description: There is something rotten among the ninja warriors. Our heroes, martial arts experts, discover a faction of evil ninja who, in league with a terrorist group, trafficking with atomic material that could trigger a nuclear war. The laws of the market are truly mysterious as well as endless: now in its fourth installment, the "American Ninja" series has perhaps found its worthy conclusion. The protagonist, Michael Dudikoff appears only in the second part. The spectacular and athletic apparatus is perhaps the only reason for the film's interest.

title: Snake Eater 2: The Drug Buster
actors: Lorenzo Lamas, Michele Scarabelli, Larry B. Scott, Harvey Atkin, Jack Blum, Richard Jutras, Ron Palillo
description: The Warrior is no longer part of the police: he has set up his own business and watches over the city with his unorthodox but very effective methods. In this capacity he wages his personal war against drug traffickers who try by all means to eliminate him. The fight gets close and no holds barred until the final showdown The Warrior is a variant of the slightly mad but deadly cop brought to success by Mel Gibson in Lethal Weapon. What matters is not the story, of course, but the pace of the action: all standard, however, sparkling but without the slightest bit of fantasy. Lamas is comfortable with the character who also spares him the hassle of acting.

title: The Owl and the Pussycat
actors: Barbra Streisand, George Segal, Robert Klein, Allen Garfield, Roz Kelly, Jacques Sandulescu, Jack Manning, Grace Carney
description: From the homonymous, famous, theatrical text, the amusing tale with a happy ending, of the love between the girl of the world and the failed writer, against the backdrop of a scenic New York.

title: Yellowstone Kelly
actors: Clint Walker, Edd Byrnes, John Russell, Ray Danton, Andra Martin, Claude Akins, Rhodes Reason, Gary Vinson
description: Yellostowne Kelly, an Indian-friendly white hunter has fallen in love with a squaw whose life he saved. The girl is also courted by the chieftain and his nephew, but she does not reciprocate either of them. Furthermore, an official fanatic insists on trespassing into Indian territory: two different rivalries that lead the Indians to open confrontation. After ups and downs, the squaw wants to return to her village, but Kelly has promised her father, the chieftain, to protect her.
notes: "Progressive" Western with good and bad Indians. But the hero is still a white man. Not Gordon Douglas' best result in the western.

title: Gunga Din
actors: Cary Grant, Victor McLaglen, Douglas Fairbanks jr., Sam Jaffe, Joan Fontaine, Eduardo Ciannelli, Montagu Love, Robert Coote, Abner Biberman
description: In India, at the time of the Tughs uprising, three British officers are sent on a mission along with their water carrier named Gunga Din. During the mission all three are captured and tortured. Gunga Din saves the situation by warning the rest of the army with the trumpet.
notes: Loosely inspired by Kipling, the film mixes adventure, heroism and comedy well.

title: Heartbreak Ridge
actors: Clint Eastwood, Marsha Mason, Mario Van Peebles, Everett McGill, Bo Svenson, Boyd Gaines, Arlen Dean Snyder, Vincent Irizarry, Ramón Franco
description: Highway Sergeant "Gunny" is a veteran of the Marine Corps. He fought in Korea and Vietnam, and is now wearing a medal-laden uniform. Currently (we are in 1983) he is a trainer: he is assigned a platoon of recruits who is in charge of weaning and transforming them into war machines. He too has his troubles: above all he is still in love with his wife from whom he is divorced. At the end of the training, an order comes: invade Grenada.
notes: Great Clint Eastwood in a film that behind his warmongering appearance hides a notable sarcasm towards the Reagan militarism of the time.

title: Hair
actors: John Savage, Treat Williams, Beverly D'Angelo, Annie Golden, Dorsey Wright, Don Dacus, Cheryl Barnes, Richard Bright, Nicholas Ray, Charlotte Rae, Miles Chaplin
description: In New York to enlist, Claude meets a group of cheerful hippies and spends the hours before departure with them. Ten years after the very successful theatrical musical, Forman brings to the screen the musical by Gerome Ragni, James Rado and Galt NacDermot, a manifesto of youth rebellion. But the hippy vibe was already the past, and the film is commemorative and almost touching. The songs are very famous, including "Aquarius" and "Let the Sunshine", which comment on the tragic death of his friend who went to war by mistake, and the sad symbolic end of American youth in Vietnam.

title: Half Human: The Story of the Abominable Snowman
actors: John Carradine, Morris Ankrum, Russell Thorson, Robert Karnes, Akira Takarada, Akemi Negishi, Momoko Kochi
description: In Japan, a snow monster in the company of his son terrorizes the area of ??Mount Fuji. Two Americans are involved in the affair, including John Carradine who also acts as a narrator, with the task of psychoanalysis (!) The creature. One of the incredible films of the Japanese Inoshiro Honda, inventor of the mythical Godzilla and specialist in titanic battles between space and non-space monsters, in which incongruous sequences set in Americas and played by Carradine and Ankrum have been inserted (as in "Godzilla"). A delusion.

title: Halloween 4: The Return of Michael Myers
actors: Donald Pleasence, Ellie Cornell, Danielle Harris, Michael Pataki, George P. Wilbur, Beau Starr, Kathleen Kinmont, Sasha Jenson, Gene Ross
description: Psychopathic killer Michael Myers comes out of a coma caused by an accident, which blocked his career for ten years, and runs away. On his trail, psychiatrist Sam Loomis alerts the Sheriff of Haddonfield, where Jamie now lives, orphan of the latest victim of the insane. Which begins by causing a blackout in the town to make a massacre in the local police station.
notes: It is the fourth and definitely exhausted sequel to "Halloween". The plot leaks from all sides and takes up situations already seen in the second film of the series without adding suspense or any enjoyable effect.

title: Hamburger Hill
actors: Tim Quill, Courtney B. Vance, Michael Boatman, Don Cheadle, Michael Dolan, Don James, Dylan McDermott, Michael A. Nickles, Harry O'Reilly, Daniel O'Shea, Steven Weber
description: Vietnam, 1969. A group of recruits is trained by a gruff lieutenant to participate in the attack on Hill 937. The fighting begins and will last for ten days in a succession of assaults. Encouraged by superiors (who however do not offer adequate coverage) the assaults continue: only three will arrive at the summit. Shortly after the hill, having lost its strategic interest, it will be abandoned.
notes: Arrived in theaters on the long wave of films on the "dirty war", the film is a bit monotonous in its narrative structure and too demagogic in its anti-militarism.

title: Hammett
actors: Frederic Forrest, Peter Boyle, Lydia Lei, Sylvia Sydney, Marilu Henner, Roy Kinnear, Elisha Cook jr., R.G. Armstrong, Richard Bradford, David Patrick Kelly
description: In San Francisco, in 1928, Hammett, undermined by alcohol and tuberculosis, lived modestly writing detective stories. The writer is tasked with freeing a kidnapped Chinese girl. Crimes multiply around his investigation, while he ends up discovering a scandal involving big names. Unique among Wenders' films, to date, whose screenplay has not been signed by the director himself; behind it is the Hollywood car, in the person of Francis Ford Coppola as a producer. With Hammett, Wenders still manages, without losing his identity, to pay a fascinating homage to American film noir.

title: Hanky Panky
actors: Gene Wilder, Gilda Radner, Richard Widmark, Kathleen Quinlan, Robert Prosky, Josef Sommer, Johnny Sekka, Jay O. Sanders, Sam Gray, James Tolkan
description: Michael, a New York architect, accidentally comes into possession of a mysterious package whose contents he does not know. What he knows is that the charming woman who entrusted him to him is dead, that at least two organizations are chasing him with bad intentions, and that the journalist who accompanies him on his escape is perhaps not exactly a journalist.
notes: Sidney Poitier tries to repeat the lucky formula of "Nobody can stop us", but with poor results. Next to Gene Wilder we no longer find Richard Pryor, but Gilda Radner, known for her participation in "Saturday Night Live".

title: Hannah and Her Sisters
actors: Woody Allen, Mia Farrow, Dianne Wiest, Barbara Hershey, Michael Caine, Max Von Sydow, Lloyd Nolan, Maureen O'Sullivan, John Turturro, Carrie Fisher, Daniel Stern
description: Hannah, Holly and Lee are three sisters who live in New York. Hannah, after being married to Mickey, is Elliott's wife and mother of four children; on excellent terms with his ex, he would like to combine between him and Holly, a failed writer and dissatisfied woman. Lee lives with Frederick, an older painter than her; their story presents no problems, but then Lee falls in love with Elliott ...
notes: Family comedy with a complex but enjoyable intrigue with which Allen adds another piece to his New York mosaic. Beautiful photography (Carlo Di Palma) great cast.

title: Hansel and Gretel
actors: Cloris Leachman, Hugh Pollard, Nicola Stapleton, Emily Richard, David Warner, Susie Miller, Eugene Kline, Warren Feigin, Lutuf Nouasser
description: The famous tale of the Brothers Grimm in a version that adds a pinch of horror and suspense to the story.

title: Hardcore
actors: George C. Scott, Peter Boyle, Ilah Davis, Dick Sargent, Season Hubley, Leonard Gaines, Dave Nichols, Gary Graham, Larry Block, Marc Alaimo, Leslie Ackerman
description: Jake Van Dorn is a provincial industrialist, established and with a solid morality. Indeed, his Calvinism is so heavy that his wife has long since abandoned him. When his daughter Kristen also disappears, he hunts down a detective who finds her in the environment of prostitution and pornography. Van Dorn joins her and convinces her to follow him, but it's not over yet. Author of the screenplay for "Yakuza" and "Taxi Driver", after making his directorial debut with "Blue Collar", Schrader resumes in "Hardcore" environments that he had already partially described in Scorsese's film. Schrader does not cheat and the cruelty of the urban fresco that comes out amply testifies to this.

title: Harlequin
actors: Robert Powell, David Hemmings, Carmen Duncan, Broderick Crawford, Gus Mercurio, Alan Cassell, Mark Spain, Alyson Best
description: Gregory Wolfe, a mysterious healer, manages to save Senator Rast's little son from leukemia. Rast is a rich and powerful man, and Gregory's presence in his family circle becomes increasingly cumbersome and ambiguous. Rast and his wife are grateful for the recovery of their little son, but she soon falls in love with him. The situation becomes dangerous and a politician who is working to make Rast head of the government decides to run for cover. For this second film, Australian director Simon Wincer referred to the story of Rasputin, the monk who had so much influence in the Tsar's court.

title: Harley Davidson & Marlboro Man
actors: Mickey Rourke, Don Johnson, Chelsea Field, Tom Sizemore, Daniel Baldwin, Giancarlo Esposito, Vanessa Williams, Robert Ginty, Tia Carrere, Julius Harris
description: Harley Davidson and Marlboro are globetrotters always ready for anything. Together with Tom, who has money problems and has to run a club, they organize a robbery. On the armored van of the bank that is attacked, however, there is no money, but drugs, the traffic of which is controlled by great managers. The improvised robbers therefore have to contend with the fierce killers of the organization.
notes: The two sex symbols Mickey Rourke and Don Johnson ("Miami Vice") play tough in a film produced by MGM under the Parretti management. The economic result was bankruptcy. The equally disappointing artistic one.

title: Trouble Bound
actors: Patricia Arquette, Michael Madsen, Seymour Cassel, Billy Bob Thornton, Sal Jenco, Darren Epton, Gregory Sporleder, Paul Ben-Victor, Rustam Branaman
description: Harry thinks he has the wind behind him. After winning $ 5,000 at the game and a dream car, he sets off for Las Vegas so as not to miss the fleeting moment when luck seems to be on his side. He gives a ride to the beautiful Kit. What Harry doesn't know is that the girl has to do with the mafia and that in the hood of the car there is a burning corpse ...

title: Smile Jenny, You're Dead
actors: David Janssen, John Anderson, Jodie Foster, Andrea Marcovicci, Howard Da Silva, Tim McIntire, Zalman King, Clu Gulager, Martin Gabel
description: It is the pilot film of the famous television series in which David Janssen plays Harry Orwell, a former policeman turned private investigator. While grappling with the murder of a police officer, a friend of his son-in-law, his daughter becomes the main suspect in the crime.

title: Harry & Son
actors: Paul Newman, Robby Benson, Ellen Barkin, Joanne Woodward, Wilford Brimley, Judith Ivey, Ossie Davis, Morgan Freeman, Katherine Borowitz
description: Harry lost his job due to a slight visual impairment, years before he had lost a son and, for two years, also his wife. The eldest daughter got married some time ago and Harry lives only with his other son Howard. Both the father is grumpy, disillusioned and slothful, as the son is cheerful and constantly striving for dialogue and reconciliation with his old man.
notes: A film that, despite good intentions, did not work. Strongly desired by Paul Newman, who is also a director here, the film partly traces the painful relationships that Newman himself had with his son. But autobiography is not enough.

title: Harvey
actors: James Stewart, Josephine Hull, Charles Drake, Cecil Kellaway, Jesse White, Victoria Horne, Wallace Ford, Peggy Dow
description: Elwood P. Dowd, a likeable middle-aged madman, imagines a large white rabbit named Harvey accompanying him on his wanderings through the bars. But maybe the rabbit really exists.
notes: Stunning Pulitzer-winning comedy, translated almost verbatim to the screen. Oscar for Josephine Hull and a nomination for James Stewart.

title: Hatari!
actors: John Wayne, Elsa Martinelli, Gérard Blain, Hardy Krüger, Red Buttons, Bruce Cabot, Michèle Girardon, Valentin de Vargas, Eduard Franz
description: In Tanganyika, at Brenda's farm, a group of hunters embark on a safari. Together with them also a lovely Italian photojournalist, Anna. The capture of the animals will serve to supply the best zoos in the world. The two women become the protagonists of sentimental skirmishes. In the end, between one hunt and another, the respective loves will come to the right conclusion.
notes: The great Howard Hawks ("Susanna", "A Dollar of Honor") grappling with a wide-ranging adventure in which he can best combine dramatic tones and comedy. Hunting scenes almost all shot from life.

title: Havana
actors: Robert Redford, Lena Olin, Raul Julia, Tomas Milian, Alan Arkin, Daniel Davis, James Medina, Tony Plana, Richard Farnsworth, Mark Rydell
description: In 1958, on the ship traveling from Miami to Havana, player Jack Weil (Redford) falls in love with Roberta, wife of Arturo, a wealthy Cuban linked to Castro's rebels. On the island, when the press announces that she has been arrested and her husband is dead, Jack pretends to be a CIA agent to free her. But, learning that Arturo is actually alive, he manages to free him too and makes him the woman. Passionate love story that takes place on a historical-political scene in the manner of "Casablanca". Great atmospheres like Hemingway, but the intentions of the director Pollack were certainly better than the outcome of this blockbuster, a bit empty and caramel.

title: Heartbreak Hotel
actors: David Keith, Tuesday Weld, Charlie Schlatter, Angela Goethals, Jacque Lynn Colton, Chris Mulkey, Karen Landry, Tudor Sherrard, Paul J. Harkins
description: In a small town in Ohio lives a little boy who, in order to help his depressed mother, comes up with a diabolical plan: to kidnap Elvis Presley. His project goes daringly in port: the boy finds himself with the rock star and brings Elvis into the house of his divorced mother, who like all women of the time is a big fan of the singer. The life of the family is obviously upset by the event.
notes: A couple of years before the worldwide success of "Mom I Missed the Plane", director Chris Columbus tries his hand at an all-rock comedy.

title: Heartburn
actors: Meryl Streep, Jack Nicholson, Maureen Stapleton, Jeff Daniels, Stockard Channing, Richard Masur, Catherine O'Hara, Steven Hill, Milos Forman, Mamie Gummer, Kevin Spacey
description: Mark Forman (Nicholson) is a Washington-based reporter. Rachel Samstat (Streep) runs a cookery column in a New York magazine. The two meet at a wedding and end up returning home together. In a short time they get married, buy a house and have a child. She is over the moon and insists not to credit the rumors of friends whispering about a husband's affair with a politician's wife, but the story is true.

title: Hearts of the World
actors: Lillian Gish, Dorothy Gish, Erich Von Stroheim, Robert Harron, Adolph Lestina, Josephine Crowell, Jack Cosgrave, Kate Bruce
description: From one of the fathers of cinema, a patriotic propaganda film commissioned by the British government during the First World War.

title: Heidi
actors: Shirley Temple, Jean Hersholt, Arthur Treacher, Helen Westley, Thomas Beck, Mary Nash, Sidney Blackmer, Pauline Moore, Mady Christians, Marcia Mae Jones, Delmar Watson
description: The orphan Heidi is taken to her grumpy grandfather by a selfish aunt. The child's spontaneous graces win back the old man to socialize with his fellow villagers, but the aunt kidnaps the niece to exploit her qualities of humanity by placing her as the companion of a very rich little sick woman. Heidi heals the sick, but other hardships await her before she can be reunited with her grandfather. Shirley Temple, undisputed champion of "irresistible" moves, was a true diva of her time, idolized by an audience prey to the most caramelized sentimentality. It is a cinema that today requires immeasurable "complicity".

title: Heimat: Eine Chronik in elf Teilen - Heimatfront
actors: Marita Breuer, Sabine Wagner, Michael Kausch, Karin Rasenack, Rüdiger Weigang, Hans-Jürgen Schatz, Gertrud Bredel, Willi Burger, Jörg Hube
description: We are in 1943: in Schabbach, almost completely deprived of men, Maria welcomes Martha, the girl of her eldest son Anton, who is pregnant. Maria herself is the mother of a four-year-old boy, Hermann, son of Otto. The latter learns by chance, from Ernst, the other son of Maria, that a child has been born from his relationship with the woman: since he had to leave for the announcement of Paul's arrival, he and Maria had not more revised. Martha marries Anton by proxy: the boy is in fact at the front and can only speak to his wife by phone. Martha's wedding party continues at Lucie's mansion.

title: Heimat: Eine Chronik in elf Teilen - Die stolzen Jahre
actors: Mathias Kniesbeck, Michael Kausch, Jörg Richter, Marita Breuer, Peter Harting, Dieter Schaad, Kurt Wagner, Gabriele Blum, Sabine Wagner
description: We are in the sixties. Anton's factory is tempting to a Belgian consortium. Anton asks his father Paul for advice, who is at that time in Germany, and he tells him to sell. The workers are worried, but Anton decides to give up: the company will remain Simon's property. Hermann has meanwhile become an avant-garde musician; the radio broadcasts its first concert for electronic instruments. In the village restaurant, the listeners are shocked, except for the madman of the village, who recognizes the chirping of birds and the murmur of the waters. Listening, Mary measures the distance that now separates her from her son.

title: Heimat: Eine Chronik in elf Teilen - Hermännchen
actors: Peter Harting, Gudrun Landgrebe, Marita Breuer, Jörg Richter, Mathias Kniesbeck, Michael Kausch, Gabriele Blum, Hans-Jürgen Schatz, Johannes Lobewein
description: After the war, the two children of Maria and Paul are in business. Anton is the owner of a small company in the field of optics; Ernst married the daughter of a wealthy timber merchant. Maria then devotes herself body and soul to Hermann's future. He studies at the gymnasium of a nearby town. He soon realizes that he has a certain artistic talent, but he feels excluded above all from the affections of his classmates. Instead, she discovers love with Klarchen, a friend of her cousin; the girl becomes pregnant, and faced with the attempt of the family to resolve everything by legal means, Hermann decides to cut ties with his environment.

title: Heimat: Eine Chronik in elf Teilen - Die Mitte der Welt
actors: Marita Breuer, Rüdiger Weigang, Karin Rasenack, Karin Kienzler, Gertrud Bredel, Willi Burger, Johannes Lobewein, Kurt Wagner
description: After Paul's disappearance, Maria just wants to forget him. Eduard, Paul's older brother, has lung problems. He went to Berlin to be treated, he comes back healed and married to Lucie, the owner of a local misunderstanding. Hitler comes to power and people celebrate the event, believing that everything will be for the best from now on. But Paul and Eduard's mother, visiting her brother, witnesses the arrest of her unionist nephew. Scandalized and frightened, she returns to Schabbach taking with her the daughter of the arrested. The ambiguous signs of German history gather on the heads of the unsuspecting and simple inhabitants of Schabbach.

title: Heimat: Eine Chronik in elf Teilen - Der Amerikaner
actors: Dieter Schaad, Marita Breuer, Karin Rasenack, Rüdiger Weigang, Gertrud Bredel, Sabine Wagner, Gabriele Blum, Eva Maria Bayerwaltes
description: Germany soon got used to the presence of American soldiers. In the summer of 1946 a large limousine, driven by a black driver, arrives in Schabbach. An elderly man, elegantly dressed, wearing a camel coat and hat on his head, gets out. It's Paul. His arrival naturally puts the village in turmoil, and most of all Lucie, now devoted to the cause of wealth made in the USA. The only one to keep calm, even under the weight of an emotion that is anything but easy to bear, is Maria. And when Paul makes her understand that he wants to exercise her "conjugal right" as if nothing had happened, she rejects it courteously but firmly.

title: Heimat: Eine Chronik in elf Teilen - Die Liebe der Soldaten
actors: Marita Breuer, Jörg Hube, Karin Rasenack, Johannes Metzdorf, Gertrud Bredel, Willi Burger, Karin Rasenack, Rüdiger Weigang
description: In the winter of 1944, no one believes in victory anymore, despite the relentless propaganda. Otto, passing through Schabbach, meets Maria and can thus meet little Hermann. Otto and Maria spend the last night together, listening to the roar of the planes flying over the region. The next day, the man will die trying to defuse an unexploded bomb. Schabbach is bombed and old Mathias dies. Finally, the Americans arrive. Lucie's villa is requisitioned, but the woman does not lose heart and begins to imagine possible deals to be combined with the conquerors.

title: Heimat: Eine Chronik in elf Teilen - Das Fest der Lebenden und der Toten
actors: Peter Harting, Mathias Kniesbeck, Dieter Schaad, Marita Breuer, Michael Kausch, Peter Harting, Kurt Wagner, Sabine Wagner
