description: Maria dies, at the age of 81 one month and eleven days. The news reaches Hermann only the day before the funeral and he hurries to reach Schabbach. The whole family and the whole village gather around Mary's coffin; also Paul, who interrupted one of his travels around the world. The funeral procession is blocked by a very violent storm, just as Hermann arrives in Schabbach. Despite the general pain, the funeral feast leaves room for a more cheerful atmosphere which then turns into unbridled glee, even though Anton is worried about the future of his company. In the evening, the village celebrates the annual festival.

title: Heimat: Eine Chronik in elf Teilen - Weihnacht wie noch nie
actors: Rüdiger Weigang, Karin Rasenack, Marita Breuer, Gertrud Bredel, Willi Burger, Eva Maria Bayerwaltes, Johannes Lobewein, Hans-Jürgen Schatz, Kurt Wagner
description: Eduard, a veteran of the party, becomes Mayor of Schabbach and his wife Lucie is proud of it. Eduard, passionate about photography, dedicates more and more space to his passatampo. The couple also concludes the work on the sumptuous villa in which they will live: an event that the whole region talks about for an entire winter. Christmas 1935 is truly something extraordinary, rich and festive. Lucie is excited by the prospect of an imminent visit from some senior Nazi leaders. He then has a luxurious reception prepared, but the guests suddenly arrive and leave, leaving Eduard and Lucie alone in front of the table laden with delicacies.

title: Heimat: Eine Chronik in elf Teilen - Fernweh
actors: Michael Lesch, Marliese Assmann, Marita Breuer, Gertrude Bredel, Kurt Wagner, Willi Burger, Rüdiger Weigang, Karin Kienzler, Johannes Lobewein
description: In 1919 Paul Simon, released from prison, returns to Schabbach and marries Maria. From their marriage two children are born, Anton and Ernst. In 1928, Paul goes out to have a beer at the tavern and disappears into thin air. Heimat, whose first episode is broadcast today, was the event of the 1984 Venice Film Festival. The almost 16 hours of screening tell the story. choral of a family and a village and, through this, the history of the German nation from the end of the First World War to the 1980s. A river-movie that took Edgar Reitz and his collaborators more than 5 years, one and a half of which just for filming. Reitz has been able to distil emotions and sensations: a series of contrasts and nuances from whose skilful juxtaposition the image of Germany emerges, involving and complex.

title: Heimat: Eine Chronik in elf Teilen - Auf und davon und zurück
actors: Marita Breuer, Jörg Hube, Dieter Schaad, Karin Rasenack, Rüdiger Weigang, Johannes Metzdorf, Eva Maria Bayerwaltes, Joachim Bernhard
description: In the autumn of 1938, when everything seems to be going well and Maria too has begun to believe in life again, a letter arrives from America from Paul announcing that he has become a rich owner of an industry. The sky falls on poor Maria's head: for Otto there is no other solution than to leave. When Maria goes to Hamburg nine months later to meet Paul, Paul cannot even get off the ship, because he cannot prove his Aryan origin. Maria has the feeling that she has absolutely everything wrong. The next day Hitler declares war on Poland and the Second World War begins.

title: Heimat: Eine Chronik in elf Teilen - Reichshöhenstrasse
actors: Marita Breuer, Jörg Hube, Rüdiger Weigang, Eva Maria Bayerwaltes, Johannes Metzdorf, Hans-Jürgen Schatz, Karin Rasenack, Helga Bender
description: In 1938, work began on the construction of a military road that will cross the region. Among the workers there is an engineer, Otto Wohlleben, who is staying in the Simon house. Little by little a feeling arises between him and Maria that the two cannot help but declare, at a dance evening in the village hall. Eduard, for his part, is naively convinced that he has now achieved everything he could want from life. "This is the moment when time should stand still forever," he says, forgetting that the beautiful house is not yet paid for and that, as the old mother Katharina says, one does not live "only on credit".

title: Hello, Dolly!
actors: Barbra Streisand, Walter Matthau, Michael Crawford, Marianne McAndrew, Danny Lockin, E.J. Peaker, Joyce Ames, Tommy Tune, Judy Knaiz, Louis Armstrong
description: Dolly is a charming widow who works as a matchmaker. When he decides to remarry, he sets his sights on the merchant Horace Vandergelder. But he is in love with the beautiful Irene Mallow and moreover he is too busy destroying the engagement between his niece Ermengarda and the painter Ambrogio. Dolly will take care of it with her ability and her charm to put everything back in order.
notes: Arrived in the year of "Easy Rider" to renew the glories of the musical, the film was a resounding fiasco, which brought 20th Century Fox to ruin. Despite Matthau's presence, the comedy remains old-fashioned. Louis Armstrong sings "Hello, Dolly!" Oscar for music, scenography and sound.

title: Hellbound: Hellraiser II
actors: Clare Higgins, Ashley Laurence, Kenneth Cranham, Imogen Boorman, Sean Chapman, William Hope, Doug Bradley, Barbie Wilde, Simon Bamford
description: Two flashbacks summarize the first episode in which Julia tried to save her lover from death and collided with a devil. Kirsty, Julia's stepdaughter, is now in a psychiatric hospital run by Professor Channard, who has long been trying to cross the gates of the underworld. Channard has commissioned Tiffany to find the solution to a musical enigma that allows you to enter the world of the damned. At different times Channard, Kirsty and Tiffany find themselves in hell struggling with the great Leviathan. Hellraiser, directed by Clive Barker who is the producer here, had been one of the best horror films of the decade.

title: Hellraiser III - Hell on Earth
actors: Terry Farrell, Doug Bradley, Paula Marshall, Ashley Laurence, Kevin Bernhardt, David Young, Brent Bolthouse, Anthony Hickox, Aimée Leigh
description: Monroe, owner of a night club, bought a monstrous sculpture, where a head full of pins stands out. Reporter Joey Summerskill learns through an extrasensory experience that the sculpture is the refuge of a monster from a parallel world. It is only the first step of a terrifying adventure that through the search for the "entity" will lead her to the final confrontation with it. Third installment of the saga conceived and developed by the stories of Clive Barker. After directing the first Hellraiser, Barker delegated directing the next ones; thanks to the unbridled imagination of his inventions, charm and thrill are guaranteed.

title: Henry & June
actors: Fred Ward, Uma Thurman, Maria De Medeiros, Richard E. Grant, Kevin Spacey, Jean-Philippe Ecoffey, Bruce Myers, Juan Luis Buñuel, Feodor Atkine
description: In the Paris of the early 1930s, Henry Miller, struggling with "Tropic of Cancer", and Anaïs Nin, who works on his diaries, meet. Despite both being married, a furious passion (literary, sexual, sentimental) flares up between them, the plots of which will eventually involve their respective spouses.
notes: Director Philip Kaufman had directed "The Unbearable Lightness of Being" from Milan Kundera's novel with a happy "erotic" slant. However, the encore fails: the story of the two Parisian lovers, although more transgressive than the other, remains a cold cerebral operation.

title: Herbie Goes to Montecarlo
actors: Dean Jones, Don Knotts, Julie Sommars, Roy Kinnear, Jacques Marin, Bernard Fox, Eric Braeden, Xavier Saint-Macary, François Lalande, Alan Caillou
description: After a few years of inactivity, Jim Douglas (Jones) resumes racing with his "animated" Volkswagen and signs up for a race in France. Everything goes smoothly and Herbie is livelier than ever until the car falls in love with a competitor driven by a pretty girl and a duo of thieves hides a stolen diamond worth millions of dollars in her tank.
notes: Between twists and turns on the streets of the famous rally to the rhythm of pressing music, the diamond returns to its rightful owners, the criminals and their accomplices end up in prison, Jim wins the hearts of the beautiful opponents.

title: Herbie Goes Bananas
actors: Charles Martin Smith, Stephan W. Burns, Cloris Leachman, John Vernon, Elyssa Davalos, Joaquin Garay III, Harvey Korman, Richard Jaeckel, Alex Rocco, Fritz Feld, Vito Scotti
description: The famous Volkswagen "Beetle" travels by ship to Brazil but is thrown overboard as an unwanted stowaway. He lands in Mexico and meets a nice rascal, Paco, who puts in difficulty both the owners of Herbie himself and a gang of fences engaged in stealing some Incas treasures from the jungle.
notes: Walt Disney reuses the "character" from the internal combustion engine. It does so by remaining faithful to its own schemes, managing to hide the repetition of the events quite well.

title: Hercules
actors: Lou Ferrigno, Sybil Danning, Brad Harris, Rossana Podestà, Ingrid Anderson, Mirella D'Angelo, William Berger, Bobby Rhodes, Gianni Garko, Delia Boccardo
description: The myth of Hercules, from birth to the famous labors, revisited with some naive updates.

title: High Spirits
actors: Peter O'Toole, Daryl Hannah, Steve Guttenberg, Liam Neeson, Beverly D'Angelo, Jennifer Tilly, Peter Gallagher, Martin Ferrero, Connie Booth
description: An Irish nobleman (O'Toole), on the brink of ruin, transforms his castle into a tourist attraction. To the delight of the visitors, it also organizes a staging of fake ghosts. But real ghosts come into play. Two of them, married in life and tragically died, wreak havoc on a mismatched pair of guests. A very accurate blend from a technical point of view, but less captivating than one would like. There are very few pleasant moments, many boring ones. Liam Neeson, star of "Schindler's List", as a rude and attractive ghost.

title: Highlander II. The Quickening
actors: Christopher Lambert, Virginia Madsen, Sean Connery, Michael Ironside, Allan Rich, John C. McGinley, Phillip Brock, Rusty Schwimmer, Ed Trucco
description: Physicist Conner McLeod built a space shield to counteract the destruction of the ozone layer; old and tired, he remembers with nostalgia his planet Zeist, from which he was driven out. Now Katana, tyrant of Zeist, awaits for the final confrontation. Helped by the young Louise and her old partner Ramirez, McLeod, after having also foiled the shady plans of the multinational that installed his shield, he faces Katana. Russell Mulcahy could not avoid setting up a second episode after the success of the first "Highlander". Mulcahy focuses on rhythm and special effects, in which it is particularly effective, but does not care too much about the plot of the story. The emphasis that underlines the mythological aspect of the film is counterbalanced by the ironic presence of Ramirez, again personified, in a casual cameo, by the good Sean Connery.

title: Highlander
actors: Christopher Lambert, Roxanne Hart, Clancy Brown, Sean Connery, Beatie Edney, Alan North, Sheila Gish, Jon Polito, Hugh Quarshie
description: In the Highlands of Scotland, in the fifteenth century, a child of the McLeod clan was born. The little one is marked by a strange destiny: he belongs to a very particular lineage of immortal men whose task is to win in single combat their other fellow men doomed to evil. Once grown up, young McLeod is trained by Ramirez to fight Kurgan.
notes: The story is bizarre and evocative, well developed by director Russell Mulcahy in a continuous oscillation between past and present. Excellent sense of magic and drumming action. Famous Queen soundtrack.

title: The Hindenburg
actors: George C. Scott, Anne Bancroft, William Atherton, Roy Thinnes, Gig Young, Burgess Meredith, Charles Durning, Richard Dysart
description: In the spring of 1937, the Hinderburg, the pride of Hitler's Germany, exploded after its second ocean crossing. The film, inspired by a book by Michael M. Mooney, presents the hypothesis of an attack by a young anti-Nazi, an attack that a colonel, commissioned by Goebbels to investigate, is unable to prevent. Thirty-five people, of the ninety-seven who were on board, die in the stake. More spectacular than thrilling, the film lacks "suspense". The typing of the characters is modest and not very effective; on the other hand, the incursions of the camera into the structure of the airship are suggestive.

title: Yokai hanta - Hiruko
actors: Kenji Sawada, Naoto Takenaka, Masaki Kudou, Hideo Murota, Megumi Ueno, Kimiko Yo, Imari Tsuji, Ken Mitsuishi
description: An ancient pagan altar is found in the basement of a Japanese school. Arrived on the spot, the archaeologist Hieda, his pupil Masao and a group of young volunteers are involved in mysterious situations that become more and more frightening. First they are faced with the disturbing disappearance of a professor and a girl, then they are attacked in the basement by a terrifying hybrid (a spider with a woman's head) determined to free other monstrous brothers prisoners of the newly discovered altar. Good Tsukamoto horror, but not up to the previous Tetsuo.

title: The Hitcher
actors: Rutger Hauer, C. Thomas Howell, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Jeffrey DeMunn, John M. Jackson, Billy Green Bush, Jack Thibeau, Armin Shimerman, Gene Davis
description: Mom always tells me not to ride strangers Jim Halsey says when he takes John Ryder in the car. Jim is traveling from Chicago to San Diego and is afraid of falling asleep while driving. John is someone who just killed a man, he says, and he shows the bloody knife. What he asks is to be stopped so as not to kill again. Will he succeed?
notes: Rutger Hauer has never been so good.

title: Ho fatto splash!
actors: Maurizio Nichetti, Angela Finocchiaro, Luisa Morandini, Carlina Torta, Daniel Bongiovanni, Flavio Bonacci, Walter Valdi, Enzo Radicchio, Lyall Crawford
description: Maurizio, awakened from a lethargy that lasted twenty years (he had fallen asleep hearing Nilla Pizzi sing "Grazie dei fior"), is sent to live in the house of his cousin Carlina. She shares the apartment with two friends: an aspiring actress and an unemployed one. The arrival of Maurizio is the source of countless accidents that bring a breath of fresh air in the lives of the three girls.
notes: Second film for Maurizio Nichetti, after the brilliant debut of "Ratataplan". Less fresh than the previous one, but more narratively constructed "I made a splash!" he kindly makes fun of a certain youthful way of life typical of those years.

title: Starcrossed
actors: James Spader, Belinda Bauer, Peter Kowanko, Clark Johnson, Jacqueline Brookes, Ed Groenenberg, Roland Groenenberg, Chuck Shamata, James Kidnie
description: Joey suddenly sees an alien presence arriving: the appearance is human, moreover feminine and ironically she looks so much like her once wife. To the latter are soon added some dangerous killers from the other world who want to kill the woman, but ...
notes: The tone is a bit fairytale, hardened just by a slightly intrusive musical commentary and a video clip director style. James Spader, who became famous for the role of the frustrated blond in _Sex, lies and videotapes_, always looks a bit astonished, and is more comfortable with slightly perverse or over the top characters (like that of _Secretary_) .

title: Penny Serenade
actors: Irene Dunne, Cary Grant, Beulah Bondi, Edgar Buchanan, Ann Doran, Eva Lee Kuney, Leonard Willey, Wallis Clark, Walter Soderling, Jane Biffle
description: A young woman hearing an old record remembers her past: it was that song that made her meet Roger, her husband. The two left for Japan where, however, they remained victims of an earthquake, which renders the woman sterile. The couple adopts a child, but he dies shortly thereafter. The two are about to break up when the offer of a new adoption arrives.
notes: Stevens tackles this work with mastery: in fact, he never fails to fall into the pathetic, skilfully juggling between drama and comedy; served in this by an extraordinary pair of actors and an uncommon sense of humor.

title: My Stepmother is an Alien
actors: Dan Aykroyd, Kim Basinger, Jon Lovitz, Alyson Hannigan, Joseph Maher, Seth Green, Ann Prentiss, Wesley Mann, Tony Jay, Peter Bromilow
description: Young physicist Steve Mills hits a planet 92 light-years from Earth with a laser beam. From here they send an alien to punish the scientist, who has compromised their existence. Celeste, this is her name, hasn't come to terms with a couple of things that are unknown in her parts: food and sex. What's more, he is a widower and father of a teenage daughter, Jessie, who soon gets on well in love and well with Celeste.

title: All of Me
actors: Steve Martin, Lily Tomlin, Victoria Tennant, Madolyn Smith Osborne, Richard Libertini, Dana Elcar, Jason Bernard, Selma Diamond, Eric Christmas
description: An unpleasant and shabby rich woman, thanks to Tibetan magic, finds a way to preserve her life and heritage by passing through metempsychosis into the body of a young and beautiful English girl, nominated universal heir. Unfortunately, an accident causes the soul of the billionaire to slip into the body of her lawyer instead: complications follow in a chain. The finale, however, holds a happy surprise for him.
notes: More than ghosts, as the title suggests, it is a story of possession in which the spring of comedy is the forced coexistence of two antithetical personalities. Director Carl Reiner can't be considered a genius, but when Steve Martin is directed, the story always works.

title: Crime and Punishment
actors: Peter Lorre, Edward Arnold, Marian Marsh, Tala Birell, Elisabeth Risdon, Robert Allen, Douglass Dumbrille, Gene Lockhart, Charles Waldron
description: A dignified translation of a masterpiece by Dostoevsky, Crime and Punishment.

title: Ho vinto la lotteria di Capodanno
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Antonio Allocca, Camillo Milli, Giampaolo Saccarola, Margie Newton, Valerio Merola, Giancarlo Magalli, Stefano Antonucci, Ugo Bologna, Gianni Franco
description: Ciottoli is a chronicler of a Roman newspaper. But things are so bad that he even decides to commit suicide. He tries them all, but to no avail, until, having swallowed an unspeakable poisoned drink, he realizes that he is the owner of the winning ticket of the five billion new year lottery. After a terrifying gastric lavage he returns home, but the ticket is gone. Less foolish than the latest films, this Village film has the merit of pushing the comedy pedal so hard that it touches, in more than one point, the pure tragic. He laughs bitterly.

title: I Saw What You Did
actors: Shawnee Smith, Tammy Lauren, Candace Cameron Bure, Robert Carradine, David Carradine, Rosanna Huffman, Jo Anderson, Bo Brundin, Patrick O'Bryan
description: It all starts with a trio of frivolous girls who enjoy playing phone pranks; to the "victims" they say only one sentence: "I saw what you did and I know who you are". The trouble starts when, choosing at random from the list, they fall on a guy who has just killed his wife, who is convinced that he has dangerous witnesses on the other end of the line and works to discover their identity and eliminate them. . Television remake of a film directed by William Castle in 1965 (The eyes of others), much softer than the original.

title: Hold Back the Dawn
actors: Charles Boyer, Olivia de Havilland, Paulette Goddard, Victor Francen, Walter Abel, Curt Bois, Rosemary DeCamp, Eric Feldary, Nestor Paiva
description: A Mexican adventurer would do anything to become a US citizen. The simplest way is to marry an American girl. The choice falls on a naive spinster, a teacher by profession. The fact of falling in love with her is completely out of his intentions. Mitchell Leisen is not a master, but here he gives his best. Much of the credit for the film's success, however, goes to the scriptwriter duo Billy Wilder and Charles Brackett. Despite the six nominations (Best Picture, Leading Actress, Cinematography, Screenplay, Music and Production Design), the film didn't get an Oscar.

title: That's Entertainment, Part II
actors: Gene Kelly, Clark Gable, Fred Astaire, Frank Sinatra, Judy Garland, Mickey Rooney, Bing Crosby, Robert Taylor, Greer Garson, Kathryn Grayson, Leslie Caron, Doris Day
description: Gene Kelly and Fred Astaire are the masters of ceremonies for this parade of songs taken from some of the most famous comedies (musical and otherwise) produced by Metro Goldwyn Mayer: on the screen, among others, none other than Maurice Chevalier, Judy Garland, Marx Brothers, Laurel & Hardy, Tracy & Hepburn ...

title: Hollywood or Bust
actors: Jerry Lewis, Dean Martin, Anita Ekberg, Pat Crowley, Maxie Rosenbloom
description: Thanks to a machine won in a lottery, a movie-buff and a bit clumsy salesman and a little crook leave for Hollywood to meet Anita Ekberg. Last film by the Lewis-Martin couple, with some hilarious numbers.

title: The Party
actors: Peter Sellers, Claudine Longet, Steve Franken, Jean Carson, Natalia Borisova, Marge Champion, Al Checco, Corinne Cole, Dick Crockett
description: Indian actor Hrundi V. Baksh, hired as an extra in a film, proves to be so clumsy that he destroys the set. He is kicked out but, by mistake, the same evening he is invited to a party in the producer's villa. With its blundering gaffes, which cause disasters, which in turn cause other gaffes, it wreaks havoc everywhere.
notes: It is perhaps the highest point reached by the Edwards / Sellers pair. Each gag is superimposed on another in a crescendo of comedy, at a slow and inexorable pace. Extreme mockery towards the world of Hollywood and anarcho-pop manifesto without brakes.

title: Holocaust 2000
actors: Kirk Douglas, Simon Ward, Anthony Quayle, Agostina Belli, Alexander Knox, Virginia McKenna, Spyros Fokas, Ivo Garrani, Massimo Foschi, Romolo Valli, Adolfo Celi
description: An engineer (Douglas) wants to build a nuclear power plant of unprecedented power in a Third World country. All opponents of the project die in dark circumstances. The protagonist discovers that his son Angel is the incarnation of the Antichrist and attempts to kill him. When his father is locked up in an asylum, Angel thinks he has won, but he has broken his accounts. A hefty budget and a cast of big names don't automatically make for a good movie. The Apocalypse, the risks of the atomic bomb are covers for a truculent by-product of the "Exorcist" and "Omen". A pretentious cartoon.

title: Honkytonk Man
actors: Clint Eastwood, Kyle Eastwood, John McIntire, Verna Bloom, Alexa Kenin, Matt Clark, Barry Corbin, Jerry Hardin, Tim Thomerson
description: These are the years of the Great Depression. Red Stovall is a country singer, consumptive, globetrotter and aficionado of alcohol who wants to go to Nashville for a festival. His old grandfather and grandson Whit leave with him. The picaresque journey ends with the recording of Red's first album, but also with a tragedy.
notes: Clint Eastwood also enters the elite of American authors of depth. "Honkytonk Man" has some naivety but already gives a glimpse of the road that will lead to the director's masterpieces ("A perfect world" above all). If Eastwood were a musical genre, it would surely be roots rock.

title: The Hot Spot
actors: Don Johnson, Virginia Madsen, Jennifer Connelly, Charles Martin Smith, William Sadler, Jerry Hardin, Barry Corbin, Leon Rippy, Jack Nance
description: Harry Madox (Johnson) arrives one day in a small town in Texas. Nobody knows what they are looking for. But women are interested in him. Gloria is dark-haired, very young and with a naive face; Dolly, on the other hand, is tall, blonde and very sensual: they will compete for the handsome tramp, who in the meantime has started fiddling with used cars. Harry is actually preparing a big shot. But Dolly and Gloria also have their own strategy and the strange threesome will hold many surprises. Dennis Hopper, actor and director of the not forgotten "Easy Rider", proposes a distortion of the classic American black film by adapting a noir by Charles Williams. Evil is ultimately not overcome, perhaps because good is hard to find. And the actors do not spare to show their erotic preferences.

title: The Hotel New Hampshire
actors: Rob Lowe, Jodie Foster, Paul McCrane, Beau Bridges, Lisa Banes, Nastassja Kinski, Matthew Modine, Jennifer Dundas, Seth Green, Wallace Shawn, Joely Richardson
description: The maniacal dream of the schoolmaster Win Berry is to manage a hotel to live in with his elderly father, his wife and five children Frank, Franny, Lilly and Egg. He realizes his obsession first in the United States then, convinced by an old Austrian friend named Freud, in Vienna, finally still across the Atlantic, while his children grow up amidst dramatic and even bloody events. Commercial flop taken fairly faithfully from John Irving's bestseller.

title: Howard the Duck
actors: Lea Thompson, Jeffrey Jones, Tim Robbins, Paul Guilfoyle, Liz Sagal, Ed Gale, Jordan Prentice, Dominique Davalos
description: Howard is a duck who lives quietly in a Duckburg lost in the cosmos, until a mysterious force catapults him to Cleveland, Ohio. The welcome of humans leaves something to be desired, indeed there is even a group of young punks who torment him to the point of terrifying him. But luckily there's Beverly, a pretty rock singer, who gets him out of trouble and becomes his companion in an attempt to find his way home.
notes: Based on a cult comic of the undeground, with a much worse protagonist who is "disneyzzato" here. The film starts well, the protagonist is sympathetically insane, but the good potential does not materialize, due to a slow direction and a not clear script.

title: Hud
actors: Paul Newman, Melvyn Douglas, Patricia Neal, Brandon de Wilde, Whit Bissell, Crahan Denton, John Ashley, Val Avery, George Petrie
description: Homer's large ranch, a proud, traditionalist old cattle farmer, is home to his 30-year-old son Hud, a rebellious boy, and his sensitive and idealistic grandson Lon. But when a serious illness strikes the herds and Homer is forced to have the cattle culled, Hud takes command of the ranch and attempts to have his father interdicted. One evening, Hud and Lon see the body of a man on the ground, when they get close they discover that it is Homer.
notes: The film is only a correct vehicle that Ritt hands with the highest professionalism to an extraordinary Paul Newman. The film earned three Oscars: for Patricia Neal, as a leading actress, for Melvyn Douglas, a supporting actor, and for photography by James Wong Howe.

title: Rogue Male
actors: Peter O'Toole, John Standing, Alastair Sim, Harold Pinter, Michael Byrne, Mark McManus, Ray Smith, Hugh Manning, Robert Lang
description: An English aristocrat tries to kill Hitler, fails, but escapes the Gestapo. Remake of Duello mortale, by Fritz Lang. English television production of the highest professionalism.

title: The Wiz
actors: Diana Ross, Michael Jackson, Nipsey Russell, Ted Ross, Mabel King, Theresa Merritt, Thelma Carpenter, Lena Horne, Richard Pryor
description: Dorothy, a 24-year-old teacher from Harlem, is overwhelmed by a blizzard and thus finds herself in the mysterious world of Oz: a decadent and disturbing megalopolis that contains all the savvy characteristics of New York. Locals inform her that to get back to the real New York she will have to go to the Wizard of Oz ...
notes: Variation in a modern key and with black stars, including Michael Jackson, inspired by the fairy tale _The Wizard of Oz_. Despite the pharaonic budget, this Sidney Lumet musical was a commercial flop. Some musical numbers are beautiful, but the whole is cold and the ending as melancholy as the stage presence of Diana Ross. Music by Charles Smalls arranged by Quincy Jones.

title: Identificazione di una donna
actors: Tomas Milian, Daniela Silverio, Christine Boisson, Lara Wendel, Marcel Bozzuffi, Veronica Lazar, Enrica Antonioni, Sandra Monteleoni, Marcel Bozzuffi
description: Niccolò (Milian), is looking for the protagonist for one of his films, meets Mavi (Silverio) and falls in love with her. A kind of yellow begins. The director is threatened and stalked, Mavi disappears. Niccolò seeks her out, aided by Ida (Boisson), a woman devoid of Mavi's ambiguities. Ida, however, rejects the complicated relationship that is looming, especially since she is pregnant with someone else. Antonioni's introspective cinema struggles once again with existential anguish, but the director seems to have already given his best. In the end, only a great formal precision and the face of Christine Boisson remain in mind.

title: Three Strangers
actors: Sidney Greenstreet, Geraldine Fitzgerald, Peter Lorre, Robert Shayne, Joan Lorring, Marjorie Riordan, Arthur Shields, Rosalind Ivan, John Alvin
description: A young London lady has been predicted that if she finds herself at midnight with two strangers in front of her Chinese idol, her wish will come true. So here she is stopping two strangers on the street - who turn out to be a young libertine and an old cheating lawyer - and take them to her house. All the characters are burdened with dramatic problems, but they share, at least for a while, the thirst for money. Later the tensions will also poison their occasional relationship. Third direction by Negulesco at the service of the sacred monsters Peter Lorre and Sidney Greenstreet, for a noir that borders on the grotesque. The screenplay by John Huston and Howard Koch is unusual, twisted and full of interest.

title: The Ladies Man
actors: Jerry Lewis, Helen Traubel, Kathleen Freeman, George Raft, Pat Stanley, Harry James, Marty Ingels, Buddy Lester, Gloria Jean
description: Herbert (Jerry Lewis) is a young student who, due to a great sentimental disappointment, has decided not to deal with the fairer sex anymore. But he ends up working, the only male, in a female boarding school. Here he makes all sorts of troubles but, in the end, he becomes friends with the girls and boyfriend of the most beautiful. Crackling second direction by Jerry Lewis.

title: Little Miss Broadway
actors: Shirley Temple, George Murphy, Jimmy Durante, Phyllis Brooks, Edna May Oliver, George Barbier, Edward Ellis, Jane Darwell, El Brendel
description: A very enterprising girl tries to save a music hall show from the attacks of a surly creditor. The girl becomes the main attraction of the place and attracts around her a flood of spectators who help to pay off the debts of the company and to satisfy the main creditor.
notes: A film tailored to the little and talented Shirley Temple, a child prodigy who duets with the Italian-American singer Jimmy Durante. Among the songs "If All the World Were Paper", "Be Optimistic" and "Hop Skip and Jump". Good characterization of the surly debtor (Edna May Oliver). There is a colorized version.

title: Iguana
actors: Everett McGill, Manu Valdivielso, Michael Madsen, Joseph Culp, Fabio Testi, Jack Taylor, Fernando Cebrián
description: On an island in the Galapagos, at the beginning of the nineteenth century, lives Oberlus, a man with a face horribly disfigured by scales. On the island, which has become his undisputed kingdom, Carmen and Diego arrive. Oberlus kills Diego and makes Carmen his slave lover. The dangers then come from Gamboa, former helmsman of the ship on which Oberlus was boarded and now his mortal enemy. Oberlus is forced to flee, along with Carmen who is expecting a baby. During the subsequent manhunt, the woman gives birth to a monstrous child. The selection for Venice, in 1988, did not help guarantee the film a decent distribution in theaters. Yet it is a sincere and anguished film, full of humanity and with a ragged and fascinating period description. Hellmen has remained a director of the 70s throughout.

title: Intimní osvetlení
actors: Vera Kresadlova, Karel Blazek, Miroslav Cvrk, Jan Vostrcil, Zdenek Bezusek, Dagmar Redinová, Jaroslava Stedra
description: Gunto in a small town to give a concert, Peter, accompanied by his girlfriend Stepa, goes to visit an old fellow student, now director of the local Conservatory. The latter, to their busy life, preferred the family, and lives with his wife, children and grandparents. After having dinner, the two friends would like to rehearse the concert, but Stepa, bored, does everything to stop him. So the two get drunk and begin to dream of an escape into the night.
notes: Second feature film, with a cecovian tone, by Ivan Passer.

title: Images
actors: Susannah York, René Auberjonois, Marcel Bozzuffi, Hugh Millais, Cathryn Harrison, John Morley
description: Cathryn is a young woman obsessed with the idea of ??her husband's betrayal. He takes her to rest for a few days in a lonely house in the Irish countryside; here Cathryn is visited by the imaginary presence of two men from her life and the daughter of one of them. The progressive, inexorable loss of identity ends up leading her to a murder, perhaps imaginary. Here Altman tackles the burning and complex issue of the love relationship, making the female point of view his own, between liberating claims and ambiguous (self) destructive drives. Controversial meditation. Stunning photography. Remarkable interpretation.

title: L'imbranato
actors: Pippo Franco, Laura Troschel, Bombolo, Sergio Leonardi, Duilio Del Prete, Teo Teocoli, Luciana Turina, Oreste Lionello, Enzo Cannavale, Giancarlo Magalli, Paola Arduini
description: The industrialist Maranotti (Duilio Del Prete), to cover up an escapade, lends his identity to the employee Sperandio (Pippo Franco), who will have to replace him for a period at a tourist club in Sardinia. In Sperandio they happen to be of all kinds, until they are kidnapped in place of the principal. Having solved the misunderstanding, he agrees with the bandits to kidnap the real Maranotti, but things will turn badly boring farce, seasoned with profanity and populated by the inevitable specks of disheartening productions of this genre: Luciana Turina, Bombolo , Enzo Cannavale. At these levels, even the good Pippo Franco gasps.

title: Gli imbroglioni
actors: Walter Chiari, Raimondo Vianello, Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Antonella Lualdi, Dominique Boschero, José Luis López Vazquez, José Calvo, Aroldo Tieri, Fanfulla, Nino Terzo, Oreste Lionello
description: A day spent in the magistrate's court among petty swindlers, rogue industrialists, engaged couples who accuse each other, nuns and other examples of petty humanity. The film is made up entirely of scattered specks, linked only by a tenuous common thread of logic.

title: The Light Touch
actors: Stewart Granger, George Sanders, Anna Maria Pierangeli, Kurt Kasznar, Joseph Calleia, Larry Keating, Rhys Williams, Norman Lloyd, Mike Mazurki
description: A thief of works of art meets a young Italian painter and repents. The slow pace makes the film slide towards the sentimental vein and the tension of the story appears too centered on the dialogues.

title: L'immorale
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Stefania Sandrelli, Renée Longarini, Maria Grazia Garmassi, Gigi Ballista, Sergio Fincato, Marco Della Giovanna, Ildebrando Santafe, Riccardo Billi, Carlo Bagno
description: Sergio Masini is a married violinist, father of a family. His sixth son is about to be born; the mother is ... the second of his mistresses. In reality, Masini is in love with three women and for this reason he is unable to interrupt this complicated and extremely expensive ménage from the point of view of physical energy. A priest to whom he addresses in the confessional gives him advice, which the man does not accept. The sincere attachment to his three women can only lead to an inevitable fatal heart attack.

title: L'éternel retour
actors: Jean Marais, Madeleine Sologne, Jean Murat, Junie Astor, Roland Toutain, Jane Marken, Jean d'Yd, Piéral, Alexandre Rignault
description: In ancient times lived Natalia, a pretty girl forced to marry a rich and old man belonging to the aristocracy. The husband is undermined, like all the members of his family, by hereditary defects: to remedy the inconvenience, the couple have to drink a love potion, but by mistake the filter is given to a young admirer of Natalia; passion flares up between the two. Inspired by the legend of Tristan and Isolde, the film has the merit of having been written by Jean Cocteau and is imbued with a magical unreality. The interpreters, Madeleine Sologne and Jean Marais, are very romantic, guided with a sense of the ancient fairy tale by director Delannoy.

title: L'imperatore di Capri
actors: Totò, Yvonne Sanson, Marisa Merlini, Aldo Giuffré, Mario Castellani, Alda Mangini, Laura Gore, Nerio Bernardi, Enrico Glori
description: Everyone is struck by the resemblance of the waiter Totò to an Arab prince. The mistaken identity makes Totò very popular on the island of Capri, where his oddities appear snobbish in the eyes of wealthy vacationers. When Totò is about to be crowned emperor of the island, his wife and the real prince arrive. The misunderstanding will clear up, but ...
notes: Totò made the fortune of Lux and the producer Carlo Ponti with this low-cost film that made millions and equalized the shortages caused by other unsuccessful productions. A very promising young man to direct it: Luigi Comencini.

title: L'imperatore di Roma
actors: Gerardo Sperandini, Nadia Haggi, Giuseppe Amodio, Agnese De Donato, Fulvio Meloni
description: Gerry, drug addict with experience in a mental hospital, wanders under the bridges of Rome and among the lowest pensions, the squalid shores of his wandering. In the delirium of a sleepless night, he imagines himself to be a Roman emperor who has returned to bring life after the end of the world.
notes: Painstakingly shot over five years, it is Nico D'Alessandria's debut film. Presented in very few cinemas and fleetingly in some festivals, the film follows in the footsteps of one of the many young people that society has pushed to the margins. A very interesting first work, hard and unreconciled.

title: Empire Strikes Back
actors: Harrison Ford, Mark Hamill, Carrie Fisher, Billy Dee Williams, Anthony Daniels, David Prowse, Peter Mayhew, Kenny Baker, Frank Oz, Alec Guinness
description: Although the Death Star was destroyed, the imperial troops took over Yavin again. The rebels have taken refuge on the ice planet, but are still forced to flee. Han Solo leaves the pursuers, while Luke travels to the planet of Dogabah to find the "Force". In an attempt to free Leila and friends, she later meets Darth Vader, who turns out to be her father.
notes: Second episode (but in reality it is the fifth) of the saga of "Star Wars", with several allusions to the famous narrative cycle of the Breton knights: the parallel between Luke in search of "strength" and Parsifal is quite evident.

title: Hang 'em High
actors: Clint Eastwood, Inger Stevens, Ed Begley, Pat Hingle, Ben Johnson, Bruce Dern, Charles McGraw, Ruth White, Alan Hale jr., Arlene Golonka, Dennis Hopper
description: Jed Cooper accidentally bought stolen cattle. He is sentenced to hang, without the possibility of clearing himself. In extremis he is saved by Judge Fenton who offers him to return to his service. Cooper agrees for the sole purpose of revenge.
notes: After reaching stardom in Europe thanks to Sergio Leone, Eastwood returns to Hollywood, where he makes his star debut in this western by Ted Post. The avenger who "comes back from the dead" to do justice will remain one of his favorite characters.

title: L'impiegato
actors: Nino Manfredi, Eleonora Rossi Drago, Andrea Checchi, Gianrico Tedeschi, Gianni Bonagura, Cesare Polacco, Pietro De Vico, Franco Giacobini, Anna Campori, Ignazio Leone, Polidor
description: Nando, a modest employee of a real estate office, spends his monotonous existence between the office and the flat shared with a single sister. She makes up for this flatness with beautiful dreams until an energetic director swoops into the office and sets up new work systems. Nando is so upset that he dreams of killing her but, deep down, he is in love with her.
notes: An intelligent comedy born from a story by Elio Petri (credited as co-writer) and loosely inspired by Norman McLeod's "Forbidden Dreams" (1947). Among the other authors of the script Tommaso Chiaretti and Nino Manfredi himself.

title: The Running Man
actors: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Maria Conchita Alonso, Yaphet Kotto, Jim Brown, Jesse Ventura, Erland van Lidth, Marvin J. McIntyre, Gus Rethwisch
description: Los Angeles, 2019. The TV game of the year is called "The Running Man". The producer of the program, Killian, is willing to do any brutality in order to increase the audience. The rule of the game is simple: in a confined area a man must be able to survive the attacks of four deadly champions. Normally he fails, but this time the contestant is called Ben Richards (Arnold Schwarzenegger), one who is unwilling to be a sacrificial victim. Helped by two teammates and a fourth competitor, Amber (Maria Conchita Alonso), Ben manages to eliminate his fearsome opponents.

title: The Tall Men
actors: Clark Gable, Jane Russell, Robert Ryan, Cameron Mitchell, Juan García, Harry Shannon, Emile Meyer, Steve Darrell
description: After the end of the Civil War, two brothers are hired by an aggressive and ambitious landowner to bring his herd, four thousand head of cattle, from Texas to Montana, through Indian-infested territories. The road is long and there are many contrasts, sharpened by the fact that the older brother, Ben, badly tolerates the bullying of the breeder. Moreover, the three also compete for the love of a woman, who left with a group of pioneers hit by a terrible hurricane and rescued by the protagonists.
notes: A western with an epic breath, directed by a master of the genre, with a disenchanted Gable, a grinning and sneaky Ryan, a prosperous Russell object of desire.

title: L'important c'est d'aimer
actors: Romy Schneider, Fabio Testi, Klaus Kinski, Jacques Dutronc, Claude Dauphin, Nicoletta Machiavelli, Guy Mairesse, Katia Tchenko
description: Actress Nadine Chevalier was once very famous. Now everyone has forgotten her and she, in order to live, is forced to interpret pornographic films. So Mons, an attack photojournalist, when he accidentally meets her, he almost doesn't recognize her. But then he falls in love with her and gets into debt in order to provide her with adequate writing. Zulawski has a reputation as a visionary, but in reality he limits himself to being baroque to the point of boredom. Here he even manages to waste Romy Schneider.

title: L'importante è non farsi notare
actors: Neil Hansen, Mauro Bronchi, Tito Leduc, Maria Grazia Buccella, Laura Trotter, Gianni Musy, Marilda Donà, Roberto Della Casa, Gabriele Villa, Francesco De Rosa
description: The Russian scientist Penkosky, the custodian of terrible military secrets, settles in Rome. The secret services of half the world then send their best elements on his trail. Three agents arrive from America who, disguised as a woman, try to go unnoticed. But the three Russian spies, three beautiful girls, soon make Americans forget their duties.
notes: After the astonishing and ephemeral success obtained in Renzo Arbore's television show "L'altra Sunday", it was inevitable that the three Flag Sisters would land at the cinema. The result is a rather faded pink yellow, just barely spicy.

title: The Importance of Being Earnest
actors: Michael Redgrave, Richard Wattis, Michael Denison, Dorothy Tutin, Joan Greenwood, Walter Hudd, Edith Evans, Margaret Rutherford, Miles Malleson, Aubrey Mather
description: Jack is in love with Algernon's cousin and courts her using the pseudonym of Ernest. In the villa he has a goddaughter, whom he suggests that he often go to London to visit his brother Ernest. Algernon begins to woo the girl pretending to be Jack's elusive brother. The mother of the first girl appears on the scene: everything gets complicated, but then it is resolved unpredictably.
notes: Based on the play by Oscar Wilde. Asquith's direction is as refined as the setting, with a great sense of rhythm underlined by an almost perfect editing. The interpretation is also from an anthology. A very enjoyable and sophisticated comedy.

title: The Rape of Doctor Willis
actors: Jaclyn Smith, Robin Thomas, Holland Taylor, Dan Butler, Lisa Jakub, J.C. Quinn, Gregg Henry, Lonny Chapman
description: Doctor Willis, a surgeon dedicated to work with a rigor that borders on hardness, is hit by a terrifying series of misfortunes: first she loses her husband in an accident, then she is raped in the hospital parking lot, and finally she is accused of killing his rapist, who died under his scalpel in the operating room.Based on an improbable to ridiculous script, the film instead takes itself very seriously, managing to be fairly brutal and remarkably boring. Some secondary figures are saved, while the efforts of the main interpreters are in vain, trapped in characters of rare ignorance.

title: Mr. 880
actors: Burt Lancaster, Dorothy McGuire, Edmund Gwenn, Millard Mitchell, Minor Watson, Howard St. John, Hugh Sanders, James Millican
description: Who is the elusive who has been forging and peddling dollar bills for years? The agent (Burt Lancaster) who must discover the identity of the one who is conventionally called Mr. 880, first suspects a girl (Dorothy McGuire) who is then innocent and useful for the investigation and, above all, indispensable for the happy ending. Polite comedy, based on a screenplay with well-articulated situations and sparkling dialogues, the film also boasts excellent performers. And, as often happens with Hollywood films, the character actors are very effective in the roles

title: Choices of the Heart
actors: Melissa Gilbert, Peter Horton, Helen Hunt, Mary McCusker, Mari Gorman, Pamela Bellwood, Patrick Cassidy, René Enríquez
description: Jean Donovan, a missionary in solidarity with the oppressed people of El Salvador, was assassinated by the dictatorship in 1980.

title: Suddenly Last Summer
actors: Katharine Hepburn, Elizabeth Taylor, Montgomery Clift, Mercedes McCambridge, Albert Dekker, Gary Raymond, Mavis Villiers, Patricia Marmont, Joan Young, Maria Britneva
description: Shocked by the tragic end of her cousin Sebastian, Catherine is treated by a psychiatrist. There's something she can't remember, the same thing the doctor tries to remove, the same thing that Catherine's aunt, Sebastian's mother, doesn't want to know. A secret that eventually explodes in all its dramatic evidence, in contrast with the morality of the time.
notes: Tennessee Williams' one-act "stretched" for cinema by the same author and Gore Vidal. What was clearly said in the theater (the theme of homosexuality) is only hinted at here. Mankiewicz gradually builds a sunny nightmare atmosphere, with an antirealistic use of flashbacks and sets. Amazing Hepburn, which had an Oscar nomination.

title: Les galets d'Étretat
actors: Virna Lisi, Maurice Ronet, Annie Cordy, Juliette Mills, Christian Barbier, Gregoire Aslan, Philippe Baronnet, Michel Robbe, Amarande, Max Amyll
description: Left with the car broken down in the rain, the beautiful Annie, director of a beauty institute, is rescued by a stranger who takes her to his house and abuses her. Annie discovers that the man is the famous car driver Kelvo and decides to take revenge.
notes: Sentimental comedy seasoned with a little sex and lots of landscapes. Nothing exceptional.

title: Acting on Impulse
actors: Linda Fiorentino, C. Thomas Howell, Nancy Allen, Patrick Bauchau, Judith Hoag, Tom Wright, Adam Ant, Paul Bartel, Isaac Hayes, Miles O'Keeffe
description: Susan Gittes is a famous Z-movie actress, but by the day her producer is found dead she is miles away from the set. Particularly in a hotel where he finds Paul, a traveling salesman who desperately tries to remain faithful to his distant girlfriend, and Cathy, a business traveler too. And none of them know Susan is a murder suspect. This isn't a Z-series movie, just a B-series movie. The action, especially in the second part, works. Linda Fiorentino is okay in a rather unsympathetic role. C. Thomas Howell ("The Hitcher") perfect in the usual role of handsome a bit dumb.

title: Imputazione di omicidio per uno studente
actors: Massimo Ranieri, Martin Balsam, Valentina Cortese, Salvo Randone, Turi Ferro, Pino Colizzi, Luigi Diberti, Petra Pauly, Mariano Rigillo, Carlo Valli
description: An architecture student is accused of killing a policeman during a demonstration, but he is innocent.

title: The Man in the Net
actors: Alan Ladd, Carlyn Jones, Diane Brewster, Charles McGraw, John Lupton, Tom Helmore, Betty Lou Holland, John Alexander, Edward Binns
description: John Hamilton (Alan Ladd), an established painter, moves to a small town in Connecticut to better provide for the health of his alcoholic wife Linda. But when this mysteriously disappears, John is suspected of murder and must flee in order to investigate on his own, trying to find the real culprit.
notes: The mechanism of the story is traditional: the husband, the victim wife, the suspicions, the need to get out of trouble alone. Despite the old Curtiz (here at one of his latest productions) the result is a bit disappointing.

title: A Change of Seasons
actors: Shirley MacLaine, Anthony Hopkins, Bo Derek, Michael Brandon, Mary Beth Hurt, Edward Winter, Paul Regina, K Callan, Rod Colbin
description: University professor Adam Evans (Hopkins) tells his wife Karen (MacLaine) that he has fallen in love with one of his students. Karen exchanges her husband for the same coin with carpenter Pete. These are the first steps in an insistent game of unions and separations with an ever-increasing number of characters. The film discovers with a few decades of delay the subversive "combinations" of bourgeois respectability. He has little humor, tastes like heated soup and only Shirley McLaine is saved, unsinkable even in the banality of everything else.

title: In Search of America
actors: Jeff Bridges, Vera Miles, Carl Betz, Sal Mineo, Ruth McDevitt, Renne Jarrett, Howard Duff, Kim Hunter, Michael Anderson jr.
description: After dropping out of college for political reasons, Mike Olson (Bridges) takes it into his head to go on a cross-country trip. To this end, he embarks his mother, father, grandmother and other family members in a 1928 Greyhound bus and, together with them, he sets off for a verification of the fundamental values ??of the Great Country. Lewis John Carlino's script has aged somewhat.

title: Looking for Mr. Goodbar
actors: Diane Keaton, William Atherton, Richard Gere, Tuesday Weld, Richard Kiley, Alan Feinstein, Tom Berenger, Priscilla Pointer
description: Theresa Dunn (Keaton) is a tutor at a school for the deaf and dumb. Wounded by the failure of a romantic relationship and plagued by a slight physical deformation, he is looking for something that not even she knows. Attending nightclubs for singles, she meets James (Atherton), a young social worker, but ends up bonding with Tony (Gere), attracted by his aggressive manhood. Diane Keaton passes from Woody Allen to the melancholy and dark atmospheres of this film, in which the ghosts and insecurities of America of the 70s take shape. Gere is here in his first major role. Brooks conducts without patheticism or moralism, with the eye of a high-class urban narrator.

title: In due si soffre meglio
actors: Dedi Montano, Carlo Ninchi, Carlo Campanini, Giuditta Rissone, Carlo Micheluzzi, Marisa Vernati, Wanda Capodaglio, Tino Scotti, Tatiana Farnese
description: An industrialist fits a young girl. In truth, she would be engaged but there are many economic needs. In the meantime, her sister falls in love with the ex-manufactured. Thus develops a weird quartet. Malasomma, a prolific director of the 1930s and 1940s, was a specialist of light comedies. This comedy is outlined is supported Ninchi and Campanini, and also, in a side role, by the young Tino Scotti.

title: La última señora Anderson
actors: Carroll Baker, Michael Craig, Marina Malfatti, Enzo Garinei, Miranda Campa, José Luis López Vazquez, Phillip Ross, Alberto Fernández, Manuel Gallardo
description: Under a false identity, the sister of one of Arthur Anderson's three wives, who died under unclear circumstances, approaches the widower to find out the truth, while the police also investigate. International dtile thriller shot with discreet professionalism by the Spaniard Martin, horror specialist.

title: Fast Getaway
actors: Corey Haim, Leo Rossi, Cynthia Rothrock, Ken Lerner, Marcia Strassman, Shelli Lether, Tabitha Thompson, Jack North, Kim Peach, Jeff Olson, Richard Jewkes
description: Nelson, his father Sam, Lily and Tony form a band of itinerant robbers who split in two due to internal rivalries. Nelson and Sam end up in the hands of the police. At this point Nelson's real mother, Lorraine, appears and claims the protection of her son. He has never met her, and she passes herself off as an old friend of Sam's. Nelson then lets his father escape from prison and the two manage to reunite.
notes: The debutante Spiro Razatos entertains us with an unpretentious film, which brings together the two aspects of action and family comedy, flavoring everything with moments of violence-like and erotic allusions.

title: Three Fugitives
actors: Nick Nolte, Martin Short, Sarah Rowland Doroff, James Earl Jones, Alan Ruck, Kenneth MacMillan, David Arnott, Bruce McGill, Lee Garlington, Sy Richardson
description: The same day Daniel is released from prison for good behavior, he goes to a bank. He who has always visited banks with machine gun in hand, this time is only there to open an account. It just so happens that a robber arrives, Ned Perry. To make matters worse, Ned chooses Daniel as a hostage to secure his escape.
notes: Remake of "Two and a Half Fugitives", a French film directed by Francis Veber himself, with Depardieu in the role here entrusted to Nolte. At the center of the story is the oddity of this strange couple made up of the gigantic Nolte and the skinny Martin Short.

title: In ginocchio da te
actors: Gianni Morandi, Laura Efrikian, Margaret Lee, Nino Taranto, Raffaele Pisu, Enrico Viarisio, Dolores Palumbo, Carlo Taranto, Stelvio Rosi, Vittorio Congia, Enzo Tortora, Gino Bramieri, Ave Ninchi
description: Gianni, a young singer with his first musical experiences, is called up and sent to Naples where he falls in love with Carla, the marshal's daughter. The idyll, however, is disturbed by a girl from a noble family, with whom Gianni spends an award license granted for having won a radio competition for amateur singers. He would like to leave Carla, but he soon realizes that the world in which his new acquaintance lives is not made for him. He then returns to his girlfriend's arms.
notes: It was the time when half of Italy was anxious because Morandi was really in the period of military service. Fizzarotti cleverly exploits the situation and makes a good film today only for the nostalgic.

title: In Italia si chiama amore
description: Chronicles of the heart interpreted by the authentic protagonists of news events that really happened. In Calabria a young man married a 70-year-old old woman. In Siciclia a husband disfigures his wife who is wrongly convinced of the woman's infidelity. A rather old man is in love like a little boy with a woman much younger than him. A convict leaves prison just in time to catch his wife in flagrant adultery. Among the "waste of neorealism" we can also include the falsely chronicle that had some luck in the sixties. However, these faded specimens of the legendary "Incom Weeks" lack both the journalistic immediacy and the documentary approach. Joke and (for the time) itchy tones: almost a "Strangelove" of other times.

title: The Perfect Furlough
actors: Tony Curtis, Janet Leigh, Linda Cristal, Keenan Wynn, Elaine Stritch, Marcel Dalio, Les Tremayne, Jay Novello, King Donovan, Gordon Jones
description: Corporal Paul Hodges, after months on a base in the Polar Circle, can enjoy a license in the French capital. With him are an Argentine actress, Sandra Roca, Lieutenant Vickie Loren and a major. Paul does everything to win Sandra, but Vickie will marry him.
notes: The excellent Blake Edwards intertwines the parody of military life with an ironic representation of the relationship between the two sexes as always. Many funny gags and a very good rhythm. Tony Curtis is likeable, Janet Leigh is stiff and sexy, and overall the film has a light-hearted air.

title: In nome del Papa re
actors: Nino Manfredi, Carmen Scarpitta, Danilo Mattei, Salvo Randone, Ettore Manni, Rosalino Cellamare, Camillo Milli
description: Rome 1868. Countess Flaminia secretly had a natural son, Cesare (Mattei), from a fleeting relationship with Monsignor Colombo (Manfredi), a judge in crisis at the papal court. When Cesare is arrested for conspiracy (he is accused of killing twenty papal gendarmes with the complicity of two cronies), the noblewoman tries to save his life by telling everything to her ex-lover.
notes: Classic historical reconstruction in Roman dialect by Gigi Magni: But the script is too pedantic and the film is saved only for Manfredi. Among the actors Ron, with his real name Rosalino Cellamare.

title: In nome del popolo italiano
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Vittorio Gassman, Ely Galleani, Yvonne Furneaux, Michele Cimarosa, Renato Baldini, Pietro Tordi, Maria Teresa Albani, Checco Durante, Simonetta Stefanelli
description: The upright magistrate Bonifazi suspects the building speculator Santenocito of being guilty of the death of a student. A close duel ensues between the two, and when Bonifazi has proof of the innocence of his "enemy", he will destroy it. Santenocito, who had always gotten away with his misdeeds, will pay for once with interest.
notes: A healthy "bad" film, with digressions into the grotesque and a notable political courage. Tight script, wrist direction and two protagonists engaged in a memorable duel. Screenplay by Age and Scarpelli.

title: In nome del popolo sovrano
actors: Nino Manfredi, Alberto Sordi, Elena Sofia Ricci, Massimo Wertmüller, Luca Barbareschi, Jacques Perrin, Carlo Croccolo, Luigi De Filippo, Gianni Bonagura, Serena Grandi, Roberto Herlitzka, Gianni Garko
description: In 1849 in Rome the population rose up against Pius IX, forcing him into exile. French and Austrian troops are sent to suppress the revolt led by the populace Ciceruacchio. Cristina, wife of the noble Eufemio, falls in love with the revolutionary Livraghi. Having discovered the affair, Eufemio would like to kill Livraghi but ends up saving him while he is about to be killed by a French. The forces of restoration prevail and Livraghi is shot with Ciceruacchio.
notes: Luigi Magni returns to his favorite theme, papal Rome, using the most famous Italian actors, from Manfredi to Sordi. But by now themes and environments are known and bloodless.

title: Three for the Road
actors: Charlie Sheen, Kerri Green, Alan Ruck, Sally Kellerman, Blair Tefkin, Raymond J. Barry, Alexa Hamilton, Bert Remsen, James Avery
description: Paul is a bag holder for Senator Kitteredge; he entrusts him with his rebellious daughter Robin, to be taken to a reform school in the South because, free, she is a constant danger to his career. The journey turns into an odyssey, complicated by continuous misadventures. Comedy without great interest, despite the actors.

title: Lucky Lady
actors: Gene Hackman, Liza Minnelli, Burt Reynolds, Geoffrey Lewis, John Hillerman, Robby Benson, Michael Hordern, Anthony Holland, John McLiam, Val Avery
description: We are in Mexico, early thirties. Adventurers Claire, Walker and Kibby team up to smuggle five hundred cases of whiskey aboard the "Lucky Lady" to the US. The enterprise succeeds and the trio decides to persevere. But they soon find themselves annoying a real smuggling boss, who reacts brutally.
notes: Comedy and adventure intertwine in this film which, while not appearing among Stanley Donen's best performances, still offers two hours of entertainment and twists according to the classic Hollywood recipe. The three protagonists are really good.

title: In una notte di chiaro di luna
actors: Rutger Hauer, Nastassja Kinski, Faye Dunaway, Peter O'Toole, Lorraine Bracco, Massimo Wertmüller, George Eastman, Dominique Sanda, Lydia Lundry
description: A journalist engaged in an AIDS investigation suddenly discovers, on the eve of his marriage to a woman who is expecting a child from him, that he is HIV-positive. He runs away in a panic, devotes all his energies to the battle for prevention, until the woman manages to track him down: spared from the infection, she had a baby girl and is firmly determined to live with him anyway. Lina Wertmüller decides to tackle an important issue, with commendable intentions. But he is unable to give up a heavy baroqueism that frustrates good intentions. Dull and conceited; completely wasted the cast.

title: Alberto express
actors: Sergio Castellitto, Nino Manfredi, Marie Trintignant, Jeanne Moreau, Marco Messeri, Eugenia Marruzzo, Thomas Langmann, Dennis Goldson, Roland Amstutz, Michel Aumont
description: Alberto Capuana must return to his father, according to the family custom, the amount that cost him, the same day in which he too will become a father. Fifteen years later, when approaching the birth of his eldest son, Alberto is penniless, unemployed and indebted. He puts himself by train (from Paris to Rome) and here they begin to happen to him inexplicable and surreal facts.
notes: Conducted with loose and inspiration, strong of a brilliant and creative script, the film manages, despite the appearance of light -hearted "game", to arouse healthy reflections on life and its values.

title: In viaggio con papà
actors: Alberto Sordi, Carlo Verdone, Edy Angelillo, Tiziana Pini, Giuliana Calandra, Ugo Bologna, Angelo Infanti, Victoria Zinny, Margie Newton
description: His father is called Armando and he is an incurable Don Juan, as well as an unscrupulous businessman who tries to make money at any cost. Cristiano is the son, shy, burned by sentimental experiences that ended badly, an ecologist destined to bitterly disappoint himself. Traveling together, the two worlds collide at first, but then Cristiano proves that he has learned his dad's lessons too well. Alberto Sordi and Carlo Verdone give us this little comedy that is supposed to be cynical and is only banal. The confrontation-clash between two generations of Italian comedy ends up producing only a few smiles lost in a sea of ??boredom.

title: L'incendio di Roma
actors: Lang Jeffries, Cristina Gaioni, Mario Feliciani, Moira Orfei, Luciano Marin, Evi Maltagliati, Franco Fantasia, Massimo Carocci, Riccardo Pizzuti, Vladimir Medar
description: The mad and bloody emperor Nero has ordered the leader of the praetorians to exterminate the Christians. The consul Marco Valerio, a very popular military commander returning from so many victories, was commissioned to materially carry out the order, but he had serious doubts about the pretexts used for the persecution. The perplexities are transformed into certainties when, during the raid in a catacomb, he finds the woman he loves there. Will he be able to prevent the death of his beloved?
notes: Great use of means, but evident laziness of direction for this decidedly corrective example of the "peplum" genre shot by a specialist of the genre, author of numerous chapters of the "Maciste" saga.

title: The Story on Page One
actors: Rita Hayworth, Gig Young, Anthony Franciosa, Mildred Dunnock, Hugh Griffith, Sanford Meisner, Robert Burton, Alfred Ryder, Katherine Squire, Raymond Greenleaf, Myrna Fahey
description: Abused by a rude husband, Jo consoles herself with the friendship of Larry, a recently widowed accountant. What at first is just a friendship due to common unhappiness soon turns into love. Jo's husband, however, discovers them in flagrant adultery and, in the ensuing fight, is accidentally killed.
notes: It's a judicial film, set entirely in court, with all the strengths and weaknesses of the genre. On the one hand it is too predictable and long, but on the other hand it uses an excellent script (by Odets himself), impeccable interpreters and the music of Elmer Bernstein.

title: Against Her Will: An Incident in Baltimore
actors: Walter Matthau, Susan Blakely, Ariana Richards, Harry Morgan, Brian Kerwin, Barton Heyman, Norman Rose, Larry Keith
description: During the Second World War in the small center of Baltimore a concentration camp for German prisoners of war was set up. One of them is accused, without evidence, of being the author of a murder. His fate seems marked but the case seriously deals with a lawyer ready to challenge the public opinion for which there is no doubt about the responsibility of the German in the crime. Television films that marks the debut on the small screen of Walter Matthau, who until then had limited himself to cinema and theater. The specialist Delbert Mann directs it, and the result is without infamy and without honors.

title: Accident
actors: Dirk Bogarde, Stanley Baker, Jacqueline Sassard, Michael York, Vivien Merchant, Delphine Seyrig, Alexander Knox, Ann Firbank, Brian Phelan, Terence Rigby, Freddie Jones, Caroline Caplin
description: At Oxford University Charley and Stephen, two mature professors, fall in love with Anna, a newly arrived student. To complicate matters, the courtship of the young student William intervenes, who soon becomes the girl's boyfriend. When William dies in a frightening accident a few meters from Stephen's house, Stephen seduces Anna still in shock. Scripted by Harold Pinter from a Nicholas Mosley novel, the film is a cold and merciless portrait of the hypocrisies and perversions that lurk behind the traditionalist and elite structures of a structure like Oxford University. Wild impulses mixed with the blind rituals of conventions. Amazing actors and the couple Losey and Pinter at their maximum splendor.

title: Incompreso. Vita col figlio
actors: Anthony Quayle, Stefano Colagrande, Simone Giannozzi, John Sharp, Adriana Facchetti, Anna Maria Nardini, Silla Bettini, Rino Benini, Giorgia Moll
description: Duncombe, the British consul in Florence, remains a widower and is forced to take care of the education of his children: four-year-old Milo and eight-year-old Andrea. His decision is drastic: the eldest will be treated like an adult, the other will be fondled in every way. However, both will be looked after by an energetic housekeeper. Andrea, who has already suffered a lot from the death of his mother, suffers even more because of the incomprehensible attitude of his father.
notes: Comencini, refined childhood storyteller, reinterprets the tearful novel by Florence Montgomery almost contradicting it. Subtle and refined direction, an admirable interpretation by Anthony Quayle. We cry but we are not ashamed.

title: Close Encounters of the Third Kind
actors: Richard Dreyfuss, François Truffaut, Teri Garr, Melinda Dillon, Bob Balaban, Roberts Blossom, Cary Guffey, Lance Henriksen, Warren J. Kemmerling
description: A musical message from space, a series of mysterious apparitions in the skies of the United States, the recurrence of completely inexplicable facts, a subliminal message induced in many people. Portents of the coming of the aliens. Roy Neary, obsessed with a strange mountain, and a mother whose son has disappeared are among the chosen ones to welcome them, while a French scientist oversees the mysterious rendezvous.
notes: "I envy her," Truffaut tells Dreyfuss as the latter gets on the ship. Messianic, fairytale, literally wonderful science fiction. But also a film about cinema and its splendid illusions.

title: Meet Me in St. Louis
actors: Judy Garland, Margaret O'Brien, Tom Drake, Mary Astor, Lucille Bremer, Leon Ames, Marjorie Main, Harry Davenport
description: Mr. Smith announces to the family that he has been transferred from Saint Louis to New York. The news is badly received by everyone, partly because Esther has a boyfriend and partly because the following year there will be the great 1903 Fair. The film proceeds by telling how daughters manage to convince that their personal happiness is more important of dad's career. That waives the transfer.
notes: It is Minnelli's first color film and Garland's first film with her future husband. The pleasures of the family come out on the arrival: good feelings? ideology? yes, but it works. Oscar for little Margaret O'Brien ("Tootie" Smith). Pleasant singing performances by Garland.

title: Otley
actors: Tom Courtenay, Romy Schneider, Alan Badel, James Villiers, Leonard Rossiter, Freddie Jones, Fiona Lewis, James Bolam
description: Otley lives on Portobello Road with the other members of the hippie community. One evening he is invited by a mysterious woman to the luxurious villa of a certain Kopcenko. The next morning, the young man finds Kopcenko murdered. Many move on his trail: the police, who indicate him as a murderer and two spy organizations that believe him a killer. Although distracted, the boy manages to save his skin and unveil the plot in which he is involuntary participant. James Bond parody set in the age of flower children and with a Hitchcock-like plot. We laugh, but above all we see a London that no longer exists.

title: A Thousand Clowns
actors: Jason Robards, Barbara Harris, Martin Balsam, Gene Saks, William Daniels, Philip Bruns, John McMartin, Barry Gordon
description: Murray lost his job on a children's TV show. A sociologist and a psychologist arrive from the Children's Welfare Office to check the situation, because Nick, the 12-year-old nephew, lives with Murray. Murray ends up with the psychologist and who, albeit after some resistance, agrees to take on his responsibilities towards those who love him. Comedy in a "60s" climate, fake libertarian with its good protagonist a bit crazy but very recoverable, and all the others committed to making him come to his senses with a sense of humor and a lot of sentiment. Oscar 1966 for Balsam, Best Supporting Actor.

title: Escape to Witch Mountain
actors: Ray Milland, Donald Pleasence, Eddie Albert, Kim Richards, Ike Eisenmann, Walter Barnes, Reta Shaw, Denver Pyle, Alfred Ryder
description: Tommy and Tia are two kids from another planet. He manages to overcome gravity by playing the harmonica, she is able to see into the future. The evil Bolt tries to kidnap them and they manage to escape. Thus begins a long chase by the villains, but our heroes will escape to safety on a spaceship.
notes: Rudimentary science fiction film produced by Walt Disney, with a bunch of "moral of the story". Actually the craftsmanship of the special effects is fascinating, but similar things in the mid-70s are definitely out of time. With a sequel, "Back from the Unknown".

title: Love Sick
actors: Dudley Moore, Elizabeth McGovern, Alec Guinness, John Houston, Christine Baranski, Gene Saks, Renee Taylor, Kent Broadhurst
description: The life of the psychiatrist Bergerin is dominated by boredom: he gets bored with his wife (who for her part avoids the risk by distracting himself with a painter) and with his patients, until he falls in love with one of them. His attempt to escape from boredom, however, turns into a pathological obsession and causes him a lot of trouble: from the reproaches of Freud's shadow to the risk of being disbarred from the Order.
notes: Some good ideas developed with a discontinuous rhythm and some decidedly stagnant moments. But some characters are tasty, some jokes bad enough, and Dudley Moore is definitely good.

title: I, Desire
actors: David Naughton, Dorian Harewoond, Marilyn Jones, Barbara Stock, Arthur Rosenberg, James Victor, Brad Dourif, Anne Bloom, Marc Silver
description: A law student offers to help in the night shift at the Coroner. Suspicions were born when the body of the victim of a murder is found completely without blood. Thus began his personal investigation traced him back to a terrifying story of vampirism. To the young actor David Naughton, already the protagonist of an American werewolf in London by John Landis, are definitely the characters related to horror. First TV viewing.

title: The Charge at Feather River
actors: Guy Madison, Frank Lovejoy, Vera Miles, Helen Westcott, Dick Wesson, Onslow Stevens, Steve Brodie, Ron Hagerthy, Fay Roope, Neville Brand
description: For years, the Cheyenne have held two young white women prisoner; a patrol of cavalrymen in civilian clothes is formed to free them. Mission accomplished: but the girls are not at all happy to be back among their people. One, above all, who was about to marry the chief Thunder Falcon ...
notes: "The White Indian" is still part of that cinema in which the only good Indians are the dead Indians. More than the verisimilitude of the story narrated, the film is attentive to a certain spectacular effectiveness, particularly in the sequences of battles and massacres. The interpreters are also mediocre.

title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
actors: Harrison Ford, Kate Capshaw, Ke Huy Quan, Dan Aykroyd, Amrish Puri, Roshan Seth, Philip Stone, Roy Chiao, David Yip
description: Incredibly escaping death in the Himalayan mountains, Jones, the singer Willie and the little Chinese Short, end up in an Indian village from which the followers of the goddess Kali have taken away a miraculous stone along with all the children. Upon reaching the palace of Pencot, our heroes discover the existence of an underground temple, the site of horrific sacrifices and cover for the cruel exploitation of children, used as slaves.
notes: After the worldwide success of the "Raiders of the Lost Ark", Spielberg takes up the character of the adventurous archaeologist in 1984. He is always able to exploit the space at his disposal in a dynamic and breathtaking way (the sequence of the escape on the trolley through the mine tunnels is memorable). Here, however, the "insolent" lightness in its artificiality is lacking a little, which characterized the first episode and the game is a bit repetitive.

title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
actors: Harrison Ford, Sean Connery, Alison Doody, Denholm Elliott, John Rhys-Davies, Julian Glover, River Phoenix, Michael Byrne, Kevork Malikyan
description: Europe, 1938. During the search for the Holy Grail, the chalice that collected the blood of Christ on the Cross, the father of Indiana Jones, a renowned archaeologist, disappears. The son sets off on his search: with a German colleague he traces the tomb of a crusader in Venice who provides him with valuable information and finds his father prisoner of the Nazis (who want to get to the Grail first) in a castle in Germany. He frees his father and together they go to Berlin, sneaking into a gathering chaired by Hitler. Then the adventure continues in the Middle East.
notes: The allegorical values ??are hidden in the folds of an action with a frenzied rhythm and hilarious gags, with a great idea: to put Indy in front of the parent, the elderly Dr. Jones. The father-son duet, also thanks to the winking Sean Connery, is extraordinary. In short, this film is even better than the other two previous ones, especially for the declared desire not to take oneself seriously and to laugh at everything.

title: Winning
actors: Paul Newman, Joanne Woodward, Robert Wagner, Karen Arthur, Richard Thomas, David Sheiner, Clu Gulager, Barry Ford
description: A driver, who neglects his wife for racing, only repents when she cheats on him. The beauty is that Paul Newman and Joanne Woodward are actually married and that he is actually a racing fanatic.

title: Gli indifferenti
actors: Claudia Cardinale, Tomas Milian, Rod Steiger, Paulette Goddard, Shelley Winters, Consalvo Dell'Arti, Adriana Facchetti, Aurelio Marconi, Bruno Scipioni
description: Carla and Michele belong to the good Roman bourgeoisie. Despite their ambitions, they are unable to take back the disastrous family situation. Carla joins Merumeci, already her mother's lover; Michele, after having awkwardly attempted to kill the man, agrees to live in his shadow.
notes: Maselli's foray into the world of Alberto Moravia, supported by a respectable cast and beautiful photography by Gianni Di Venanzo. The performance of the actors, however, curiously disappointing, and the staging lacks an excessive moralistic characterization compared to the original.

title: Indio
actors: Francesco Quinn, Brian Dennehy, Marvelous Marvin Hagler
description: The neotenent half-caste Daniel Morrel returns to the Amazon and reports to the police the destruction committed by the mining company IMC against the natives and the rainforest. Thus he discovers the connivance of the authorities: he is about to be sent home, but manages to escape in time to witness the destruction of the village and the murder of his father. Discreet show, directed by the veteran Margheriti. Among the protagonists we find a good Brian Dennehy, while who just doesn't work is Francesco Quinn, the Indian of the title.

title: Indio 2 - La rivolta
actors: Marvelous Marvin Hagler, Frank Cuervo, Dirk Galuba, Maurizio Fardo, Jacqueline Carol, Charles Napier, Tetchie Agbayani
description: An Indian, a former lieutenant of the marines, is killed in the Amazon rainforest. Sergeant Iron (Hagler), the victim's widow and her brother discover that a multinational is destroying the forest and enslaving the natives. The three organize the rescue, punish the killer and drive out the devastators of the environment. Anthony Dawson (who would later be Antonio Margheriti) is not a very picky director: they pay him to make Marvin Hagler "act" and he performs. If the film is childish, that's okay too. Besides the powerful protagonist, there is even the ecological message, which is so fashionable.

title: Indio Black, sai che ti dico: sei un gran figlio di...
actors: Yul Brynner, Sal Borgese, Gianni Rizzo, Dean Reed, Ignazio Spalla, Gérard Herter, Sal Borgese, Franco Fantasia, Nieves Navarro
description: The gunslinger Indio Black with a group of desperados decides to seize a shipment of gold destined for the Mexican rebels fighting against Maximilian of Austria. The enterprise is not easy, also because a dishonest banker gets in the way who in turn wants to seize the booty; but the group, exploiting the abilities of each one, manages to win it. As in all his films (for example The Three Supermen), Gianfranco Parolini makes great use of stunt performers and stuntmen to give rhythm to the action. The western a la Leone was over, and from the title they try to parody it; Parolini is among those who do it best.

title: Guilty by Suspicion
actors: Robert De Niro, Annette Bening, George Wendt, Martin Scorsese, Patricia Wettig, Sam Wanamaker, Luke Edwards, Chris Cooper, Ben Piazza, Barry Primus, Gailard Sartain, Robin Gammell, Brad Sullivan, Tom Sizemore, Roxann Dawson
description: In the late 1940s, Hollywood was shocked by the commission promoted by Senator McCarthy to expel all Communist sympathizers from the world of cinema. Director David Merrill, who has never been a communist, is about to make a new film, but first he will have to testify before the commission, clear himself and, in addition, denounce his friends. David however does not give up: he loses his job, but does not accept blackmail.
notes: The theme is commendable, De Niro is obviously good and the dramatic tension is there: it is Irwin Winkler, a famous producer making his directorial debut here, who is not a personality monster. Appearance of Scorsese.

title: Indomable Angélique
