actors: Michèle Mercier, Robert Hossein, Roger Pigaut, Bruno Dietrich, Christian Rode, Ettore Manni, Pasquale Martino, Sieghardt Rupp
description: Now that she knows that her husband, the Count of Peyrac, is alive and in Sardinia, Angelica resumes the search for her husband. The ship she has embarked on is attacked by a pirate ship: to escape capture, Angelica throws herself into the sea and is fished out by other pirates, whose commander sells her to the slave market. A broker wins, for a fabulous sum, the auction for the possession of the young woman. Conducted in a palace, she is faced with a surprise ...
notes: Fourth (and penultimate) episode of the (mis) adventures of the heroine created by the Golon spouses. Everything as expected: a narration of professional ease with breadth of means.

title: The Rounders
actors: Henry Fonda, Glenn Ford, Sue Ann Langdon, Chill Wills, Hope Holiday, Edgar Buchanan, Kathleen Freeman, Joan Freeman, Denver Pyle
description: Two cowboys, specialized in capturing wild horses, come to grips with a roan that is absolutely rebellious to the saddle, but which nevertheless does not stop following them. The two decide to exploit the situation: they enroll the animal in a rodeo then bet on him and win a good sum. The horse, however, causes so much trouble that the money is barely enough to pay off the damage.
notes: Between western and comedy, a film directed without great panache but with a couple of splendid old actors.

title: A Life of Her Own
actors: Lana Turner, Ray Milland, Tom Ewell, Louis Calhern, Ann Dvorak, Barry Sullivan, Margaret Phillips, Jean Hagen, Phyllis Kirk
description: Lily is an aspiring model from Kansas. In New York he meets Mary, already an established model but slightly on the decline. Mary kills herself when her man shows an interest in Lily. The latter then decides to think only of work, but ends up falling in love with a married man. When he meets his wife, a brave woman paralyzed after a car accident, she decides to give up her love story.
notes: Feminine Mèlo embellished by Turner and masterfully directed by Cukor. Not one of his best films, perhaps for the tangled script.

title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner?
actors: Spencer Tracy, Sidney Poitier, Katharine Hepburn, Katharine Houghton, Cecil Kellaway, Beah Richards, Roy Glenn, Isabel Sanford, Virginia Christine, Alexandra Hay
description: Joey has decided to marry the black doctor John, certain she will not find difficulties in the family. Her father, in fact, is a journalist of liberal tendencies. But conventions still play a certain role: at first the man is decisively opposed. Only after a long conversation with his daughter, will he realize the racist meaning of his choice and consent to the union ...
notes: Famous film, spokesperson for "liberal" solidarity with the campaign for the civil rights of black Americans. For the occasion, the Hepburn-Tracy couple, luxury testimonials of the moderate anti-racist movement of the 1960s, also reunited on the screen. Kramer conducts with skill. Oscar to Hepburn and to the screenplay.

title: Indovina chi viene a merenda?
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Mimmo Palmara, Carlo Romano, Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Toni Ucci, Jon Chevron, Ignazio Leone, Lino Banfi
description: Sicily 1943: to avoid war, Franco and Ciccio hid in the mountains. Two American paratroopers steal their clothes and leave their uniforms, so our "heroes" are captured by the Germans and deported to Germany. They will escape, take refuge on a farm and be the protagonists of chain misadventures. After the war, believed to be dead, they are safe and sound up there in Germany.
notes: Rather rare case in the cinema of Ciccio and Franco, this film has a screenplay (by Marcello Ciorciolini and Amedeo Sollazzo), which is not only a botched pretext for their antics, but also feeds on some non-trivial ideas.

title: The Unforgiven
actors: Burt Lancaster, Audrey Hepburn, Lillian Gish, Audie Murphy, Doug McClure, John Saxon, Charles Bickford, Albert Salmi, Joseph Wiseman, June Walker
description: An old man, who has returned to the city after years, begins to spread the rumor that Rachel, daughter of Matelda Zachary, is, in fact, an Indian kidnapped while still a child from her tribe. Matelda denies it, but the city is in turmoil and so are the Indians, who attack the Zachary ranch to recover the girl.
notes: Racial hatred, family conflicts, virtual incest avoided at the last minute: a lot of meat in the fire in this dark western signed by Huston. The film is not one of the most loved by the director, who considered it a bit too conventional. In reality, although all the mechanisms of the western are respected, the film is one of the most anomalous and visionary of the time.

title: Support Your Local Gunfighter
actors: James Garner, Jack Elam, Suzanne Pleshette, Harry Morgan, Joan Blondell, Marie Windsor, John Dehner, Henry Jones, Dub Taylor, Kathleen Freeman
description: On his way to Denver, Latigo Smith stumbles upon the mining town of Purgatory. Here a struggle is taking place between two rival companies; he is mistaken for the famous gunslinger Swifty Morgan and is contacted by both contenders. When the real Morgan arrives, all sorts of things happen. Burt Kennedy, director of the film, was a brilliant screenwriter especially of westerns. Unfortunately, in passing behind the camera he is a bit out of tone, and has limited himself to parodying films of his favorite genre. This work is no exception where, however, the game of exchanging roles makes the plot very enjoyable.

title: Ivanovo devstvo
actors: Nikolay Burlyaev, Valentin Zubkov, Nikolay Grinko, Evgeniy Zharikov, Stepan Krylov, Dmitri Milyutenko, Valentina Malyavina, Irina Tarkovskaya, Andrey Konchalovskiy
description: We are in Russia, during the Second World War. Ivan is twelve years old and, despite the officers trying to dissuade him, he is not afraid to participate in war actions. At the end of the conflict, evidence of the boy's death in war will be found in the archives of a now liberated and semi-destroyed Berlin. A fascinating and morbid nightmare directed by the young Tarkovski in his first feature film. Apart from an unforgettable nightmare of Ivan, the whole style of the film, dry despite the tragic nature of the theme, hinted since 1962 that he was facing a future great director. The jurors of the Venice Exhibition of that year also understood this and awarded him the Golden Lion.

title: Infanzia, vocazione e prime esperienze di Giacomo Casanova, veneziano
actors: Leonard Whiting, Maria Grazia Buccella, Claudio De Kunert, Lionel Stander, Raoul Grassilli, Wilfrid Brambell, Tina Aumont, Mario Scaccia, Silvia Dionisio, Cristina Comencini
description: The son of actors, little Giacomo Casanova, lost his father, is entrusted by his mother, anxious to get rid of him, to the protection of a noble as stingy as he is full of himself. Sent to study in Padua, Giacomo soon fell to skin and bones. Luckily for him he is taken in favor by Don Gozzi who takes him into the house with him and who initiates him to ecclesiastical studies. Back in the city of Venice, he began preaching as an abbot. One day, in the midst of the begging money, he finds some love notes.
notes: Comencini chooses a singular angle to tell the story of Giacomo Casanova (the first five chapters of his "Memoirs"), and the results are excellent: his eighteenth century is among the most convincing that Italian cinema has narrated. The Italian version lasts 95 minutes.

title: Unfaithfully Yours
actors: Rex Harrison, Linda Darnell, Rudy Vallee, Barbara Lawrence, Lionel Stander, Kurt Kreuger, Edgar Kennedy, Al Bridge, Julius Tannen, Torben Meyer
description: The famous conductor Sir Alfred De Carter returns to New York after a long journey. His brother-in-law sends him a report showing that his wife Daphne has cheated on him with the young secretary. After reading this news, during the concert he is conducting he imagines the variants of the drama letting himself be carried away by the music: uxoricidio, perdono, duel? His passion turns the concert into a masterpiece: later, he will discover that ...
notes: Conducted as a refined parody of the mélo genre, a poison comedy, signed (also in the script) by that great American costume flogger who goes by the name of Preston Sturges. Simply perfect.

title: L'infermiera
actors: Ursula Andress, Mario Pisu, Daniele Vargas, Duilio Del Prete, Carla Romanelli, Marina Confalone, Stefano Sabelli, Luciana Paluzzi, Lino Toffolo, Jack Palance
description: An industrialist is dying from a heart attack. The heirs are negotiating the sale of the factory, but their relative does not decide to die. They then recruit a beautiful nurse with the aim of giving him the decisive heart attack. But the nurse really cares for him and seduces the other males of the family: thus the man heals and marries her. Immediately after the marriage, the woman is widowed and rich.
notes: Despite the passing of the years, the beauty of Ursula Andress remains statuesque as in the 007 film that introduced her to audiences all over the world. Plot and situations, including garters, are yet another derivative of the success of "Malizia".

title: L'infermiera di notte
actors: Gloria Guida, Lino Banfi, Francesca Romana Coluzzi, Alvaro Vitali, Leo Colonna, Mario Carotenuto, Annamaria Clementi, Lucio Montanaro, Jimmy il Fenomeno
description: Nicola Pischella, a dentist by profession, is an unrepentant attacker on the virtue of his patients. His attempts, however, are always frustrated by the watchful presence of his wife Lucia. One day Lucia's billionaire uncle arrives who, old and sick, is entrusted to the "care" of the young and beautiful nurse Angela. Nicola immediately tries to seduce Angela ...
notes: Fashions, even in the cinema, are fortunately transient. Thus also the epic of nurses, professors, substitutes and so on, has faded. Gloria Guida, not yet Signora Dorelli, was one of the flagships of this cinema.

title: L'infermiera nella corsia dei militari
actors: Nadia Cassini, Lino Banfi, Alvaro Vitali, Nieves Navarro, Paolo Giusti, Karin Schubert, Elio Zamuto, Carlo Sposito, Renato Cortesi, Enzo Andronico, Carmen Russo, Jimmy il Fenomeno
description: What is a singer disguised as a nurse doing in a psychiatric clinic populated by patients who think they are famous generals? She is looking for stolen pictures on behalf of her theatrical impresario who asked her for a similar "duty" to make her debut in his show. The patients, crippled in mind but not in their aggressive virility, put the singer to the test, but the worst comes from the director of the clinic, a professor equally thirsty for sex.
notes: Once again Lino Banfi finds himself in one of the scollacciate farces that made him popular in the seventies and that today regularly revisit on TV.

title: Inferno
actors: Leigh McCloskey, Gabriele Lavia, Daria Nicolodi, Eleonora Giorgi, Irene Miracle, Sacha Pitoeff, Alida Valli, Veronica Lazar, Feodor Chaliapin Jr., Leopoldo Mastelloni, Ania Pieroni
description: According to an old treatise on alchemy, in Freiburg, Rome and New York, there are three houses in which the "Three Mothers" of hell live. The young Rose, reading the book, is convinced that her house is built on the abyss: the discovery costs her life. However, he had had time to warn his brother, who will shed some light on the matter.
notes: Argento, in the construction of his horror films, definitely begins to waver. _Profondo rosso_ and _Suspiria_ are behind her, and chasms open up in her screenplays. _Inferno_ is saved for a certain macabre and visionary taste.

title: The Towering Inferno
actors: Steve McQueen, Paul Newman, Faye Dunaway, William Holden, Robert Vaughn, Fred Astaire, Susan Blakely, Richard Chamberlain, Jennifer Jones, O.J. Simpson, Robert Wagner, Susan Flannery
description: A skyscraper was built in San Francisco: a 138-story high crystal tower. The inauguration party takes place in the panoramic hall, on the top floor of the building, but a short circuit, which occurred due to the savings made by the manufacturer on the materials used, unleashes a real hell.
notes: The film was a milestone in the catastrophic genre, which has recently returned to fashion. Cast with all stars, very big productive commitment, effects, for the time, highly spectacular, breathtaking suspense are the ingredients of a show, perhaps taken for granted, but still compelling today.

title: Hell Is for Heroes
actors: Steve McQueen, James Coburn, Fess Parker, Bobby Darin, Harry Guardino, Bob Newhart, Nick Adams, Stephen Ferry, Mike Kellin, Don Haggerty
description: A six-man patrol in France in the autumn of '44, after the landing in Normandy, was forced to face a terrible attack by the Nazis. They will succeed in the enterprise thanks to a good dose of cunning. Don Siegel's great cast and confidence in directing an atypical and psychological war film, all centered on phobias caused by a practically invisible but oppressive opponent.

title: Torpedo Run
actors: Glenn Ford, Ernest Borgnine, Diane Brewster, Dean Jones, L.Q. Jones, Philip Ober, Richard Carlyle, Fredd Wayne, Don Keefer, Robert Hardy
description: In 1942 the American submarine "Greyfish" is hunting for the Japanese aircraft carrier "Shinaru": a clash in various stages, with the enemy ship that seems unreachable by the torpedoes of Captain Barney Doley (Ford). Intertwined with the main story, there is also that of the fate of Barney's wife and daughter, prisoners of the Japanese and embarked on one of the ships that are part of the "Shinaru" convoy.
notes: Decent war film, interpreted and narrated in a convincing way, both in the adventurous "suspense" and in the tension over the fate of the hostages.

title: Inganno
actors: Nadia Gray, Gabriele Ferzetti, Bice Valori, Tina Pica, Wilma Pagis, Bruna Corrà, Tina Lattanzi, Bianca Doria, Lia Orlandini, Giovanna Galletti
description: The marriage between Anna Comin and Andrea Vannini, a doctor with a bad past, ends in tragedy. Apart from the fact that the protagonist is a policewoman, there is not much original in this Brignone film.

title: An Englishman Abroad
actors: Alan Bates, Coral Browne, Charles Gray, Harold Innocent, Vernon Dobtcheff, Mark Wing-Davey, Douglas Reith, Peter Chelsom, Judy Gridley
description: The life in Russia of an English writer, exiled because he was accused of being a spy at home. The story is true and it is that of the writer Coral Browne. The character, then, is the same who inspired Marek Kaniewska for the film Another Country with Rupert Everett. Schlesinger directed this television film in the interregnum between Crazy Runners and The Game of the Hawk. But this is not a minor film, if only because there is Alan Bates.

title: Initiation
actors: Rodney Harvey, Bruno Lawrence, Arna-Maria Winchester, Miranda Otto, Bobby Smith, Tony Barry, Luciano Catenacci, Mladen Mladenov
description: Danny, following the death of his mother, leaves Brooklyn in search of his father. On the trail of his parent he arrives in Australia, where he finds him again. Here the man has rebuilt his life, he is married and has a daughter. Danny is not what you call welcome and on top of that he looks like he was born to get into trouble. He is taken into protection by an Aboriginal shaman who initiates him into the art of visions with dramatic consequences ...
notes: This Australian film tries to combine the adventurous ideas with the evocative magical rituals of a still mysterious culture. The result is not bad, but a little too full of "winks" at the US market.

title: Falling In Love
actors: Robert De Niro, Meryl Streep, Harvey Keitel, Dianne Wiest, Jane Kaczmarek, George Martin, David Clennon, Victor Argo, Jesse Bradford, Frances Conroy
description: He is an architect, she is a designer. They work in New York and one day they meet by chance (indeed, they collide) at the exit of a bookshop on Fifth Avenue. Then they meet again every day on the train going to work. Everyone has a family, but they fall in love with each other. Overwhelmed by the feeling, they yield to love with a thousand reserves.
notes: Crosses of glances, hesitations, whispers: a love story through the skill of De Niro and Streep. Grosbard and the writers have also gone too safe and forgotten that in addition to the actors, in the movies, there should be more.

title: Battle Hymn
actors: Rock Hudson, Martha Hyer, Dan Duryea, Don DeFore, Jock Mahoney, Anna Kashfi, Carl Benton Reid, Alan Hale jr., James Edwards
description: During the Second World War, Dean Hess accidentally bombed an orphanage, causing the deaths of numerous children. To atone for his guilt he became a priest; now he has resumed his service as a volunteer in Korea, where he works on behalf of war orphans.
notes: Even if he talks about war, Sirk does not give up his main inspiration. The film comes immediately after the masterpiece "Like the leaves in the wind". The mélo aspect is brought about above all by the irreparability of the frightening guilt that Hess carries inside.

title: L'innocente Casimiro
actors: Erminio Macario, Lea Padovani, Enzo Biliotti, Alberto Sordi, Ada Dondini, Lauro Gazzolo, Olinto Cristina, Baby Donall, Adriana Facchetti
description: In order to leave the college to which she just cannot adapt, a student makes the director believe that she is expecting a child and that the father of the unborn child is a professor of the college itself. To avoid the scandal, the girl is sent home, accompanied by the alleged seducer. Later the truth emerges and, of course, also the love between the two which is a prelude to orange blossom.
notes: From the musical comedy of Mario Amendola "Scandalo al collegio" a dull little film made to measure for Macario, star of the period "magazine". The Turin comedian with the curl on his forehead, however, gave his best in the theater and the film is a small thing.

title: L'innocente
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Laura Antonelli, Jennifer O'Neill, Rina Morelli, Massimo Girotti, Marc Porel, Didier Haudepin, Marie Dubois, Roberta Paladini, Claude Mann, Elvira Cortese
description: Rome, late nineteenth century: Tullio and Giuliana Hermil are a couple from the Roman upper class, together for years, but without love. He is an unrepentant Don Juan, but despite this she is faithful to him. At a certain point, however, the fascinating writer Filippo d’Arborio appears in the woman's life: Giuliana gives herself to him and conceives a child. On Christmas night, when the whole family is in church, Tullio exposes the "son of guilt" to freezing ...
notes: The latest film by the Milanese master displays sumptuous and formally flawless images, but fails to fully grasp the sense of irrevocable decadence that permeates D'Annunzio's pages.

title: Les innocents aux mains sales
actors: Romy Schneider, Rod Steiger, Paolo Giusti, Jean Rochefort, François Maistre, Pierre Santini, François Perrot, Hans-Christian Blech
description: Julie is bored in her beautiful villa in Saint-Tropez; her husband Louis is too old for her and he drinks. She soon becomes the lover of the young writer Jeff. In fact, we might as well send alcoholic Louis to the creator and enjoy his money. Except that things do not go exactly according to the plan of the two faithless ones.
notes: From a novel by Richard Neely, Claude Chabrol has made a film that is as elegant as it is cold. Not even the interpreters give the best of themselves. A few humorous subtleties and a discreet ambient painting are not enough to re-evaluate the work.

title: L'insegnante
actors: Edwige Fenech, Vittorio Caprioli, Mario Carotenuto, Carlo Delle Piane, Enzo Cannavale, Alfredo Pea, Stefano Amato, Alvaro Vitali, Gianfranco D'Angelo, Francesca Romana Coluzzi
description: In hot (in every sense) Sicily, the young Franco, the son of a feared local squire, proves to be very good in "sexology" but poor in all other subjects. To convince his parents to hire the beautiful repetition teacher (Edwige Fenech), the boy pretends to be effeminate, so that the teacher is forced to probe his sexual tastes.
notes: The progenitor of the "butt and sword" trend, so much in vogue in the 70s. The Fenech is truly splendid, but that's not a credit to the film. For lovers of trashy cinema, Cicero's film is a masterpiece. For everyone else it sucks.

title: L'insegnante al mare con tutta la classe
actors: Lino Banfi, Alvaro Vitali, Anna Maria Rizzoli, Marco Gelardini, Gisella Sofio, Franco Diogene, Gino Pagnani, Jimmy il Fenomeno, Francesca Romana Coluzzi
description: Mario Cubetti, the son of a building speculator, was postponed to September. The father decides to call a teacher: the official purpose is that of repetitions, the secret one is instead the desire to have an adventure with her. All together they go to the sea. The affairs do not, however, spin according to the wishes of the lewd parent. The Guardia di Finanza resolves the situation: the builder is arrested for tax fraud and Mario can replace the parent.
notes: There is nothing new in the plot, but the couple Lino Banfi-Alvaro Vitali manages to get some laughs and make the inexpressive Annamaria Rizzoli forget.

title: L'insegnante di violoncello
actors: Serena Grandi, Leo Gullotta, Michel Rocher, Antonio Caffari, Dodo Gagliarde, Miriam Baldi, Lorena Vottero, Danilo Verde
description: A group of friends goes to the sea with a clear goal in mind: to kill girls. The most coveted prey is the Junoesque Margherita, who teaches music and disturbs the sleeps of her adolescent pupils. But it will be the father of one of them who covets her, while the son ...
notes: Vanzina-style holiday comedy, boring and predictable.

title: L'insegnante viene a casa
actors: Edwige Fenech, Renzo Montagnani, Alvaro Vitali, Lino Banfi, Marco Gelardini, Carlo Sposito, Gisella Sofio, Clara Colosimo, Lucio Montanaro, Gianfranco Barra
description: Luisa, who moved from Milan to Lucca to stay close to the man she loves, the city councilor Ferdinando, realizes that she has not chosen the best time: the elections are approaching and the presence of her lover can be harmful to the political career of the candidate for mayor. So, while everyone is drooling for her, Luisa will choose who really loves her.
notes: There is no need to trust appearances: the possible political satire is just an alibi for yet another cheap film in which what really matters are Edwige Fenech's "graces", displayed with a side of assorted platitudes. And that's that.

title: Monsieur Hire
actors: Michel Blanc, Sandrine Bonnaire, André Wilms, Luc Thuillier, Eric Bérenger, Marielle Berthon, Philippe Dormoy, Marie Gaydu, Michel Morano, Nora Noël
description: The shy Monsieur Hire, a bachelor by profession tailor, frowned upon by all for his misanthropy, has a habit of spying on his neighbor, Alice, from the window, who is having an affair with a hooligan. Hire ends up falling madly in love with her. When a girl is murdered by the hooligan, for everyone Monsieur Hire will be the ideal suspect, and Alice's betrayal will do the rest. Great interpretation by Michel Blanc and Sandrine Bonnaire, in a context that the direction of Patrice Leconte recreates with dramatic gloom and with subtle attention to the nuances of intense meaning. From one of Simenon's "blackest" novels.

title: Sleuth
actors: Laurence Olivier, Michael Caine, Alec Cawthorne, John Matthews, Eve Channing, Teddy Martin
description: A mystery novelist lures his wife's young lover into a trap. First he offers him a reward, if he steps aside, but then he shoots him. After a few days a strange policeman arrives, who tells the writer that he killed his lover by disseminating evidence to attribute the crime to him. Both murders are actually bogus, but the ending will be tragically true.
notes: Adapting the play by Anthony Shaffer, Mankiewicz constructs a puzzle-script where each element fits perfectly into a game of Chinese boxes, equipped with corrosive dialogues and supported by a pair of protagonists in a state of grace.

title: The Unbearable Lightness of Being
actors: Daniel Day-Lewis, Juliette Binoche, Lena Olin, Derek de Lint, Erland Josephson, Pavel Landovský, Donald Moffat, Daniel Olbrychski, Stellan Skarsgård
description: Prague, 1968. Tomas, a brilliant surgeon, married Tereza. The two love each other even if the doctor acts like a cheerful Don Juan, passing from bed to bed, including Sabina's. Surprised by the Soviet invasion, the couple flee to Geneva where Sabina preceded them. The three, united by fate, establish an intense relationship until Tomas and Tereza decide to return home. Will a new happiness be possible?
notes: Based on the famous novel by Czech writer Milan Kundera, the film has its best moments in the mixture of documentary fiction and real footage of the Soviet invasion. Absent the philosophical speculations, the effective love story remains.

title: Mad Max
actors: Mel Gibson, Joanne Samuel, Roger Ward, Tim Burns, Hugh Keays-Byrne, Steve Bisley, Lisa Aldenhoven, David Bracks, Bertrand Cadart
description: Max Rockatansky is part of a special group of motorized policemen. We are in the near future, dominated by violence, drugs and gangs of thugs. When one of these groups appears on the horizon, Max becomes embroiled in a bloody struggle which his wife and son pay the price. All that remains is the path of revenge.
notes: Modern Western, science fiction film, road movie without consoling rhetoric. With this film, George Miller signed his debut film, caused a sensation at the 1979 Cannes Film Festival, started a successful series and launched Mel Gibson on the international stage.

title: Mad Max 2
actors: Mel Gibson, Bruce Spense, Michael Preston, Max Phipps, Vernon Wells, Kjell Nilsson, Emil Minty, Virginia Hey, William Zappa
description: Mad Max, the intrepid warrior from "Interceptor" is back on the road. In the harsh desert, made even more inhospitable by nature contaminated by the atomic disaster, the mortal game of life and death is played. The only currency is oil, now running out: Mad Max finds a deposit of the precious liquid besieged by the tribe of ferocious Umungus, and wages a very hard battle with them.
notes: A nice sequel that does not make you regret the first "Interceptor" but shifts the axis of drama and violence. If Mad Max's debut was dark and tragic, now it takes on an unprecedented adventure.

title: Interiors
actors: Geraldine Page, Diane Keaton, Mary Beth Hurt, Kristin Griffith, Richard Jordan, E.G. Marshall, Maureen Stapleton, Sam Waterston
description: Renata, Joey and Flyn are three sisters, whose life is turned upside down by their father's decision to leave the family. Eva, the mother, first tries to commit suicide with gas, then, when her husband, obtained a divorce, remarries, the woman drowns herself in the ocean. Joey tries in vain to save her, and is in turn barely saved by the other two.
notes: Having established himself as a great comedian, Woody Allen surprises everyone with this change of pace. The film testifies without how much its author feels indebted to Bergman's cinema and inaugurates a new phase in the career of the New York filmmaker.

title: Interlude
actors: June Allyson, Rossano Brazzi, Françoise Rosay, Marianne Koch, Keith Andes, Frances Bergen, Lisa Helwig, Jane Wyatt
description: Helen, a young American, works in Munich, where a compatriot of hers, Dr. Morley, pays her a discreet court. When Helen meets the famous conductor Tonio Fischer, it is love at first sight, but the man is married and his wife is sick with nerves. The young woman agrees to remain in the shadows, until Mrs. Fischer's suicide attempt convinces her to leave the camp.
notes: The film does not exploit the potential of the story despite two "ad hoc" protagonists: the tender June Allyson and the irresistible Latin lover Rossano Brazzi. Sirk, recognized master of the cinematic "mélo", here is grappling with a mediocre script (inspired by the distant "Serenata" by James M. Cain) and arranges himself as best he can. Previously done by John M. Stahl and, after Sirk, by Kevin Billington.

title: Intermezzo
actors: Ingrid Bergman, Leslie Howard, John Halliday, Edna Best, Ann Todd, Cecil Kellaway, Enid Bennett, Douglas Scott, Eleanor Wesselhoeft
description: A famous Swedish violinist returns home after a triumphal tour around the world. His wife, two children and the young piano teacher await him. The violinist falls madly in love with the latter, leaves his family and is already thinking about divorce, when the girl, seized by remorse, sacrifices herself and lets him return to her family. Ingrid Bergman was 24 at the time of her arrival in America, just to make this film. He was 21 at the time of Gustav Molander's original Swedish version of which this is the remake. Ingrid at 24 alone is enough to justify a film. But here are also Leslie Howard's flawless interpretation and essential music for the performance. If you enjoy crying, this is your movie.

title: Intervista
actors: Sergio Rubini, Antonella Ponziani, Maurizio Mein, Paola Liguori, Lara Wendel, Anita Ekberg, Marcello Mastroianni, Antonio Cantafora, Nadia Ottaviani
description: At the request of a Japanese television crew, Fellini agrees to be interviewed about his story as a director. Here he is on his arrival in Cinecittà, an inexperienced reporter from the province. Here are the images of the "Dolce Vita". Here, besieged by concrete and television aerials, is the Cinecittà of today, where we continue to work for the cinema with tenacity and joy.
notes: Self-celebration conducted with sly irony; narcissism suffused with nostalgia for an exciting and unrepeatable past; autobiography seasoned with all the marvelous and spectacular that the world of cinema is capable of when it "puts itself on stage".

title: The Untouchables
actors: Kevin Costner, Sean Connery, Robert De Niro, Andy Garcia, Charles Martin Smith, Richard Bradford, Jack Kehoe, Brad Sullivan, Patricia Clarkson, Billy Drago
description: During the years of Prohibition, an agent of the US Treasury, Elliot Ness, to fight crime and manage to "frame" Al Capone, forms an unofficial team of agents. It includes a young shooter, a wise and incorruptible retired policeman and an accountant. Two of them lose their skin, but the group of "untouchables" wins their battle.
notes: Based on the 1950s television series of the same name, the film tells the classic deeds of the group of professionals. De Palma mixes genres and quotes extensively from the history of cinema, amalgamating everything in an overwhelming way.

title: Intolerance
actors: Lillian Gish, Constance Talmadge, Elmer Clifton, Alfred Paget, Mae Marsh, Robert Harron, F.A. Turner, Sam De Grasse, Vera Lewis, Mary Alden
description: A striker sentenced to the gallows following a mass layoff; a Nazarene opposed by priests and powerful people crucified after the miracle of Cana; the love between a French Catholic and a Protestant truncated by the massacre of the Huguenots; Babylon conquered in blood by the Persian army of Cyrus. Four historical paintings, four moments of triumph of intolerance, linked together by the image of a woman cradling a child.
notes: Sumptuous sets, thousands of extras, the innovative use of alternate editing, make the film a monument of the seventh art. And after him, cinema was something else. The film (which originally ran three and a half hours) came out in the middle of World War I and was a colossal fiasco, with its creative ambition and pacifist message.

title: The Bachelor and the Bobby-Soxer
actors: Cary Grant, Myrna Loy, Shirley Temple, Rudy Vallee, Ray Collins, Harry Davenport, Johnny Sands, Don Beddoe, Lillian Randolph, Veda Ann Borg
description: A wild young painter makes a girl fall in love during a conference. The young girl's sister judge will force him to keep up with the girl to get her infatuation away. Result? Judge and painter marry, Oscar for screenplay.

title: Bâton Rouge
actors: Carmen Maura, Victoria Abril, Antonio Banderas, Angel de Andrés López, Laura Cepeda, Noel Molina, Rafael Díaz, Francisco Guijar
description: Isabel (Maura) is a very rich mature woman who suffers from nightmares; Antonio (Banderas) is young and willing to do anything to raise the money with which to take his dumb brother to Baton Rouge (the capital of Louisiana, the mythical place of a life all to the rhythm of jazz); Ana (Abril) is a psychologist who believes above good and evil. Antonio and Ana elaborate the plan of a perfect crime that will have to enrich them. The dream of an escape in an extremely complex story, very unscrupulous and "strong", not always adequately controlled according to the charge of challenge, biting and amused.

title: Sunset
actors: Bruce Willis, James Garner, Mariel Hemingway, Jennifer Edwards, Malcolm McDowell, Kathleen Quinlan, Patricia Hodge, Richard Bradford, M. Emmet Walsh, Joe Dallesandro
description: It is 1929, the Hollywood film industry is transforming due to the advent of sound. The producer Alperin, very rich but very shady, decides to join the star Tom Mix, the hero of many westerns, with Sheriff Wyatt Earp, a living legend of the Old West and now a quiet retired old man. The two quickly become friends and find themselves involved in a complex case of murders, blackmail and person replacements. Crackling Hollywood reinterpretation of the silent film by Blake Edwards (the one from the "Pink Panther" and "Hollywood Party" series). Willis and Garner are not perfectly comfortable, but overall the film works well.

title: Monsieur
actors: Jean Gabin, Mireille Darc, Liselotte Pulver, Marina Berti, Henri Cremieux, Berthe Granval, Jean-Paul Moulinot, Jean-Pierre Darras, Peter Vogel
description: René Duchêsne, a widowed and inconsolable banker, is saved as he is about to throw himself into the Seine by Suzanne, a former waitress who reveals unexpected details about the life of his deceased wife. A misunderstanding and a hangover allow the man to change his identity, to go to service as a butler to an industrialist who dangerously neglects his wife, and to be able to reconcile him with his marital duties.
notes: All too conventional and moralizing, but Gabin is as good with the powder puff as with a gun. At his side he does not disfigure Mireille Darc in the part of the young maid. Gavy Morlay's latest film, co-written by Claude Sautet.

title: The Prize
actors: Paul Newman, Elke Sommer, Edward G. Robinson, Sergio Fantoni, Diane Baker, Micheline Presle, Gérard Oury, Kevin McCarthy, Leo G. Carroll, Sacha Pitoeff, Jacqueline Beer, John Wengraf
description: Andrew Craig, an American writer with excessive liking for alcohol, is in Stockholm for the Nobel Prize. The Swedish authorities have chased a charming official. Craig notices that around the person of Dr. Stratman, also waiting to receive the award, something shady is moving. Thanks to the help of his nice overseer he will be able to solve the mystery.
notes: The spy story develops like a Hitchcockian pastiche, moving easily between comedy and thrilling (after all, the screenwriter Ernest Lehman is the same as "Intrigo Internazionale"). Newman is at the height of his vitality, Elke Sommer acts as a sexy counterpoint and softens the excesses of a showman.

title: North by Northwest
actors: Cary Grant, Eva Marie Saint, James Mason, Leo G. Carroll, Jessie Royce Landis, Josephine Hutchinson, Philip Ober, Martin Landau, Adam Williams
description: An advertiser, Roger Thornhill, is mistaken for an agent named Kaplan and kidnapped by a spy organization that attempts to kill him. He manages to escape, but no one wants to believe his story: indeed, due to another misunderstanding, he is accused of the murder of a diplomat. A mysterious blonde, Eva, seems to help him, but turns out to be the villain's lover. Or not?
notes: A perfect mechanism for a film based on the continuous exchange of identities, on the very thin line that separates the true from the false, on the rules of chance, on the figure of the double. In addition to being "intriguing" from the point of view of the story, the film is exemplary in construction.

title: Hider in the House
actors: Gary Busey, Mimi Rogers, Michael McKean, Candace Hutson, Elizabeth Ruscio, Chuck Lafont, Bruce Glover, Leonard Termo, Carole King, Jake Busey
description: Tom Skyes is released from the prison where he was locked up for killing his parents while still a boy, who had violently abused him. Obsessed with the pursuit of a normal family life, Tom decides to move to a suburban attic, where he builds a secret room for himself. The house is then bought by Phil and Julie Dreyer, who move in with their children, Neil and Holly, and the dog Rudolf. The chain of crimes is inevitable, in which Tom's intrusion into the romantic affairs of the couple finds space.
notes: Good actors for a film that manages to keep even the most distracted spectator on the edge of emotions.

title: Invaders From Mars
actors: Karen Black, Hunter Carson, Timothy Bottoms, Laraine Newman, James Karen, Bud Cort, Louise Fletcher, Eric Pierpoint, Christopher Allport
description: An eight-year-old boy, David, is the first to notice that a Martian spaceship has landed near his home. Extraterrestrials begin to take over the minds of everyone they meet, including David's parents and his teacher. The intervention of the army will be decisive. But then David wakes up: it was all a dream. Reworking of a classic 1950s science fiction ("The Space Invaders" by William Cameron Menzies, 1953), when space invaders were seen as villains as opposed to peaceful terrestrials. In this version there are many special effects, and the sure hand of Tobe Hooper considered one of the most important directors of the new horror.

title: Invasion U.S.A.
actors: Chuck Norris, Richard Linch, Melissa Prophet, Alexander Zale, Alex Colon, Eddie Jones, Jon DeVries, James O'Sullivan, Billy Drago
description: Secret agents of the KGB and Cuba and petty criminal laborers, hired by the Communist powers, are devastating Florida with the intent to put the rest of the United States on fire. They haven't reckoned with Special Agent Matt who the FBI is calling back while he's fishing for alligators. He'll take care of fixing things. The heroes played by Chuck Norris are even cruder than Rambo and "Invasion U. S. A" is among the most classic examples.

title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
actors: Kevin McCarthy, Dana Wynter, Sam Peckinpah, Larry Gates, King Donovan, Carolyn Jones, Jean Willes, Ralph Dumke, Virginia Christine, Tom Fadden
description: Dr. Miles Bennell discovers that his hometown, a thriving California center, has been invaded by pods of extraterrestrial origin that creep into the human body during sleep. Gradually the aliens are taking over the Earth, but who is contaminated and who is not?
notes: From a mediocre novel, a film that is a jewel. Without special effects, Don Siegel manages to create a very oppressive atmosphere and authentic suspense, based above all on the contrast between the doctor, who is gradually becoming more and more paranoid, and the indifference that prevails in his city. The director managed to neutralize the interference of the production, which tried to make the film more reassuring.

title: Forty-Ninth Parallel
actors: Eric Portman, Laurence Olivier, Anton Walbrook, Leslie Howard, Raymond Massey, Glynis Johns, Niall MacGinnis, Finlay Currie, Raymond Lovell
description: A German submarine is sunk near the Canadian coast. Only one officer and a few sailors are saved from the crew. Under the leadership of the officer, a fanatic Nazi, the group decides to cross the country from Canada to the United States, which is still neutral. To achieve their purpose, the military do not hesitate to use the most ferocious means: with threats and violence they appropriate what is necessary to survive and move and do not hesitate in the face of murder, managing to seize even a small plane that was on their traces. With the aircraft they believe they finally have safety at hand, but a mistake makes them fall into a lake where some die. After other troubles the handpiece gets thinner and thinner. War propaganda film conceived on commission from the Ministry of Information to persuade the United States to go to war, "49th parallel" however immediately turns into a great adventure film, capable even of triggering identification between the viewer and the "bad guys" who are its protagonists. Oscar 1942 for the best subject to Emeric Pressburger.

title: Inventiamo l'amore
actors: Evi Maltagliati, Gino Cervi, Sergio Tofano, Eugenio Cappabianca, Clelia Matania, Ivana Claar, Amelia Chellini, Guglielmo Sinaz
description: A provincial and his partner arrive in Rome with the hope of making a fortune in the world of cinema. But they are too naive and let themselves be entangled by disreputable people. In the end, disappointed and without money, the two decide to get married anyway.
notes: In the star-studded panorama of Italy of consensus, Gino Cervi was the good-natured counterpart of the handsome Amedeo Nazzari and this film does nothing but confirm it.

title: L'invenzione di Morel
actors: Giulio Brogi, Anna Karina, John Steiner, Anna Maria Gherardi, Ezio Marano, Margareth Clémenti, Roberto Herlitzka, Claudio Trionfi, Laura De Marchi
description: Shipwrecked on a desert island, a man finds himself in contact with some strange and cyclical presences. Later he discovers that it is all the result of the diabolical invention of Doctor Morel, creator of a machine that guarantees immortality. Good film, full of tension, based on a classic of Argentine literature by Adolfo Bioy-Casares, perhaps a little too cold and cerebral.

title: Une aussi longue absence
actors: Alida Valli, Georges Wilson, Jacques Harden, Diane Lepvrier, Catherine Fonteney, Charles Blavette, Amédée, Paul Faivre, Pierre Parel
description: Thérèse Langlois has been alone since 1944, after the Germans unjustly arrested her husband. Sixteen years later, man reappears profoundly changed both in the physical and in the psyche: now he is nothing more than a vagabond without memory who barely survives. With infinite love and a unique spirit of sacrifice, Thérèse tries to win him back and heal him, enduring enormous efforts and bitter disappointments ...
notes: A poignant story of pure love, centered on the themes of memory and female loneliness, taken from a news story and co-scripted by Marguerite Duras. Deserved Palme d'Or at the 1961 Cannes Film Festival, ex aequo with a masterpiece such as Luis Buñuel's _Viridiana_.

title: Marlowe
actors: James Garner, Gayle Hunnicutt, Carroll O'Connor, Rita Moreno, Sharon Farrell, William Daniels, H.M. Wynant, Jackie Coogan, Kenneth Tobey, Bruce Lee
description: Marlowe, in search of a missing young man, stumbles upon the relationship between a movie star and a gangster. On the trail of the blackmailer, Marlowe arrives at a clinic for subnormals, where he finds the young man's body. Later he also discovers the actress in the house of the gangster, who was also murdered. But Marlowe is convinced of the woman's innocence ...
notes: A good adaptation from Raymond Chandler, with James Garner replacing the legendary Bogey as Philip Marlowe. Bogart on the other hand is the director: Paul Bogart, usually active on television, here at his film debut, very respectable.

title: The Whistle Blower
actors: Michael Caine, James Fox, Nigel Havers, John Gielgud, Felicity Dean, Barry Foster, Gordon Jackson, Kenneth Colley, David Langton
description: British intelligence chief Adrian Chapple (John Gielgud) is suspected of being a double agent in favor of the Soviet Union. To neutralize him, counterintelligence eliminates all the men in his circle. Among them Bob, an expert on Russian language and literature. His father Frank, investigating privately, unmasks Chapple who, however, dies in a fight. It is a good thriller, tense and dramatic, full of twists and action and, above all, intense in telling the pain of a father, masterfully played by Michael Caine, who from the loss of his son finds the strength to fight in the treacherous. world of espionage.

title: Unconquered
actors: Gary Cooper, Paulette Goddard, Boris Karloff, Howard Da Silva, Cecil Kellaway, Ward Bond, Virginia Campbell, Katherine DeMille, Henry Wilcoxon, C. Aubrey Smith
description: The quarrel between two officers in America in 1764: Holden is the good, while Gart is a traitor. Among them Aby, an English girl sentenced to death for helping her rebellious brother, who agrees to be sold to the New World as a slave. She regains and loses her freedom several times before being captured by the Indians: Holden frees her definitively, but then she has to face the attack of the Indians at Fort Pitt ...
notes: De Mille's adventure movie, almost funny in its naivety. All reconstructed in the studio, all over the top, often beyond the threshold of kitsch but with an undeniable sense of entertainment.

title: L'invitation
actors: Jean-Luc Bideau, Jean Champion, Michel Robin, François Simon, Cécile Vassort, Corinne Coderey, Pierre Collet, Neige Dolsky, Jacques Rispal, Rosine Rochette
description: Rémy obtained a two-month leave following the death of his mother. After selling the house in the city, he buys a beautiful country villa with a park and invites his colleagues and superiors to a party. In the course of the party the formalities and inhibitions are dissolved little by little; a slight madness circulates in the air, until the young Aline performs an improvised striptease ... Goretta gives us a ferocious portrait of Swiss conformity; an irreverent representation of the mediocrity that the director sees in the behavior of his compatriots. The film was one of the first successes of the Swiss school of the 1970s.

title: Murder by Death
actors: Peter Sellers, Truman Capote, Alec Guinness, Peter Falk, James Coco, David Niven, Peter Sellers, Maggie Smith, Eileen Brennan, Elsa Lanchester, Nancy Walker
description: The billionaire Twain (Capote) summons the five greatest detectives in the world to a castle, announces that a crime will be committed at midnight and promises a colossal reward to those who will solve the case. In addition to the bizarre landlord, the investigators have to deal with a blind butler and a deaf-mute cook, escape some attacks thanks to their sagacity, and find themselves in front of three corpses. Parody Divertissement written by Neil Simon. With Falk playing Sam Spade, Sellers being a Charlie Chan-like, Guinness blind butler, plus the parodies of Miss Marple and Poirot, the film has no respite. The seven different endings, which contradict each other, are a bit cumbersome, but still fun.

title: Io bacio... tu baci
actors: Mina, Adriano Celentano, Mario Carotenuto, Umberto Orsini, Carlo Pisacane, Gianni Meccia, Jimmy Fontana, Tony Renis, Jimmy il Fenomeno
description: To carry out a real estate speculation, a wealthy businessman clashes with the elderly owner of a tavern. The place has become the favorite haunt of a large group of young people fond of pop music. The entrepreneur's daughter tries to help her father, but is conquered by the young people of the place where she joins. But even "young" music can be a business. It is one of the first film appearances of Celentano, who sings "24000 kisses" here. Mina instead (who sings "The sky in a room" and "The thousand blue bubbles") already had a fair experience of this type of film based on the popularity of the singers. Among others, appearances by Peppino Di Capri, Tony Dallara, Jimmy Fontana, Gianni Meccia.

title: I Confess
actors: Montgomery Clift, Anne Baxter, Karl Malden, Brian Aherne, O.E. Hasse, Roger Dann, Dolly Haas, Charles Andre
description: Father Logan had been caught in the company of a married woman, before priestly ordination, by the lawyer Villette. Now he has been robbed by the sexton Keller who acted disguised as a priest. Suspicion falls on Logan, of course, but he knows the truth: Keller revealed it to him, but in confession. Logan is therefore tried ... Hitchcock was not very satisfied with the film: he reproached him for lack of irony and a too close intertwining between the religious element and the rough element. Clift, however, is perfect in the role of the innocent and guilty priest at the same time, and very beautiful is the flashback that reveals his past.

title: Io e Caterina
actors: Alberto Sordi, Edwige Fenech, Catherine Spaak, Valeria Valeri, Rossano Brazzi, Ugo Bologna, Danuta Chawalek, Andy Miller, Laura Franci, Elisa Mainardi, Victoria Zinny
description: Enrico Menotti was annoyed with both his wife and his lover. When, in America, a friend tells him the possibility of having a robot-female all do, Enrico immediately buys one and gets rid of his wife, lover and even the maid. He will discover that even the robot Caterina causes him trouble.
notes: Deaf, as an actor, is only great when he finds a director who keeps him in check. When self-steering, he leaves the reins too loose, both behind and in front of the camera. And "ideologically" the film is not at all feminist, as Sordi claimed: it is just vulgar.

title: The Bears and I
actors: Patrick Wayne, Chief Dan George, Andrew Duggan, Michael Ansara, Robert Pine, Valentin de Vargas, Hal Baylor
description: A veteran from Vietnam (Wayne) returns home and decides to go to live in the middle of nature. So he goes to live near an Indian reserve, in an area populated by bears. Outdoor life is splendid and the three bear puppies that has adopted are even more. The troubles arise between the Indian reserve and the nearby, small community of "pale faces" that are not particularly distinguished by tolerance and width of views. A discreet Disney based, as always, on the beauty of natural scenarios.

title: Uncle Buck
actors: John Candy, Jean Louisa Kelly, Macaulay Culkin, Amy Madigan, Gaby Hoffmann, Elaine Bromka, Garrett M. Brown, Laurie Metcalf, Jay Underwood
description: Whom to entrust the children to when you are suddenly forced to leave home? Mr and Mrs Cindy and Bob Russell enlist the help of Uncle Buck, Bob's brother. Maizy, Miles and Tia put a strain on the proverbial laziness of their uncle who, after an initial moment of bewilderment, manages to win the sympathy of the three terrible children.
notes: The Italian distribution has fished out this film, after the resounding success obtained by the little Macaulay Culkin, star of "Mum I lost the plane". For the rest, the film is all about the shoulders of the good uncle, the portly and bungling actor John Candy.

title: Eagle's Wing
actors: Martin Sheen, Sam Waterston, Harvey Keitel, Stéphane Audran, Caroline Langrishe, John Castle, Jorge Russek, Manuel Ojeda, Jorge Luke
description: White Bull of the Kiowa tribe is roaming the plains and raiding everything he finds. He comes across a group of Comanches carrying a load of pelts to two white hunters. White Bull's attention is drawn to the horse ridden by one of the Comanches: "Eagle wing", a splendid white stallion. A frenzied pursuit of the horse begins by both White Bull and hunter Pike.
notes: Metaphysical Western, in which the elements of the story take on transcendent values ??in the myth. The protagonist is in fact the horse (symbolically white) to which the pursuers sacrifice all their possessions.

title: Io, mammeta e tu
actors: Marisa Merlini, Renato Salvatori, Rossella Como, Domenico Modugno, Dolores Palumbo, Alida Cappellini, Franca Gandolfi, Fernando Sancho, Tina Pica, Memmo Carotenuto
description: In a small village in southern Italy, a despotic mother constantly watches over her daughter, who is in love with a young man who wants to marry her. The two devise every stratagem to beat the woman's resistance: first they simulate a kidnapping for love; then they bring up a sailor, a friend of the woman's long-dead husband, with whom she falls in love, thus consenting to marriage. But the story immediately resumes, even if the protagonists are other young people from the country. It is one of the many "juvenile" films produced by Titanus after the extraordinary success of Poveri ma belli; however, he was not very lucky, despite the famous song by Riccardo Pazzaglia and Modugno that can be heard on the opening credits.

title: Io non protesto, io amo
actors: Caterina Caselli, Livio Lorenzon, Terence Hill, Enrico Montesano, Nina Larker, Tiberio Murgia, Pinuccio Ardia, Rosita Pisano, Luisa De Santis
description: Caterina, a teacher in a small town, has great singing skills with which she entertains her pupils. Baron Calò, conservative and respectable, wants to get her kicked out but later changes his mind: a cousin of his explained to him that with records for young people you can make a lot of money. He then organized a beat ensemble for Caterina, who won a competition and became famous. However, having to choose between her boyfriend and career, she prefers love.
notes: Caselli sings some famous songs. The boyfriend from him is Mario Girotti, soon famous as Terence Hill.

title: Io non spezzo... rompo
actors: Alighiero Noschese, Enrico Montesano, Janet Agren, Claudio Gora, Lino Banfi, Gino Pernice, Anna Campori, Giacomo Furia, Gordon Mitchell, Ignazio Leone
description: Endless troubles for two clumsy Mobile agents (Noschese and Montesano) who investigate a colossal drug trafficking. At the time Montesano was first and foremost Noschese's sidekick, but this is one of the duo's weakest films.

title: Io, Semiramide
actors: Yvonne Furneaux, John Ericson, Renzo Ricci, Calisto Calisti, Gianni Rizzo, Germano Longo, John Bartha, Nino Di Napoli, Valérie Camille
description: Semiramis, a powerful and beautiful Assyrian queen, is overseeing the construction of Babylon. He loves the slave, Kir, who is a fallen prince and the man returns his love. But a conspiracy separates the two lovers and sets them against each other: they will be reconciled only with death, obtained by drinking the same cup of poison after having revealed the intrigue.
notes: Historical film made in economy ("Totò contro Cleopatra" was also made with the same scenarios). It was the period in which all Italian cinema was working on the American blockbuster "Cleopatra", and Yvonne Fourneaux's clear eyes had to compete with those of Liz Taylor.

title: Io so che tu sai che io so
actors: Alberto Sordi, Monica Vitti, Isabella De Bernardi, Ivana Monti, Micaela Pignatelli, Salvatore Jacono, Giuseppe Mannajuolo, Claudio Gora, Cesare Cadeo, Sandro Paternostro, Gianni Letta
description: Fabrizio Bonetti, a mature bank employee, comes into possession of the videos of a private detective who, believing he was following another woman, followed his wife instead. The man thus discovers that his sixteen-year-old daughter has been taking drugs for three years, that his wife has been unfaithful to him and that he himself is suffering from an incurable disease in the terminal stage.
notes: Since Sordi has chosen do-it-yourself for directing, he has rarely got it right. Here, too, we have the usual moralistic manner, approximate characters and an awkward narrative conduct.

title: Lawman
actors: Burt Lancaster, Robert Ryan, Lee J. Cobb, Robert Duvall, Sheree North, Albert Salmi, Richard Jordan, John McGiver, Ralph Waite
description: In the town of Bannoch, a group of drunken herdsmen go wild and, in the chaos, the dead man escapes. Sheriff Jarold Maddox, however, is one who does not compromise: he intends to identify and punish the culprit, at any cost. His obstinacy clashes with the attempts at accommodation proposed by the landowner for whom the cowboys work.
notes: Michael Winner shouldn't be asked for great directorial subtleties. Here too he points to the point: the spectacular use of violence is effective (the lesson of the spaghetti western is not far off). In addition, he has a very respectable cast at his disposal.

title: Io sono un autarchico
actors: Nanni Moretti, Simona Frosi, Beniamino Placido, Luciano Agati, Andrea Pozzi, Fabio Traversa, Giorgio Viterbo, Paolo Zaccagnini
description: Abandoned by his wife, who left him their son, Michele, a former sixty-eight, he begins to take care of the child with affection. Unfortunately, he cannot be a good father for him. After trying in vain to persuade the woman to return home, he leaves her son. In the meantime he is convinced by Fabio to participate in an avant-garde theatrical performance. But even there it is failing.
notes: Nanni Moretti's debut feature was a revelation for young people who immediately identified with the Roman director. The cast includes Beniamino Placido, Moretti's father, Luigi, Paolo Flores D'Arcais and Alberto Abruzzese.

title: This Sporting Life
actors: Richard Harris, Rachel Roberts, Colin Blakely, Alan Badel, William Hartnell, Vanda Godsell, Anne Cunningham, Jack Watson, Arthur Lowe
description: Frank Machin, a former Yorkshire miner, becomes a successful rugby player. Had he the same talent for dealing with the world and with women, his problems would be solved. But no, his only relationship is that with his icy landlady, a relationship that comes to take on the contours of crazy love. It ends badly, both love and his playing career. Lindsay Anderson's first work, and one of the masterpieces of English "free cinema", stylistically daring and crudely realistic. Extraordinary Richard Harris, who was awarded at Cannes.

title: Valdez Is Coming
actors: Burt Lancaster, Frank Silvera, Susan Clark, Richard Jordan, Jon Cypher, Barton Heyman, Hector Elizondo, Phil Brown, Ralph Brown
description: Deputy Valdez kills Johnson, a black man hunted by breeder Frank Tenner's men, in self-defense. He then goes to the latter to ask him for a hundred dollars to pay to the widow of the dead man. In response, he is attacked and tortured. Leaving, however, he kidnaps Tenner's lover and hides in the mountains. Tenner unleashes his gang behind him, but Valdez, with cunning and courage, annihilates it. Direct confrontation is inevitable at this point.
notes: Unusually violent and stylistically over the top Western. A variation that perhaps wanted to be modern and that instead makes us regret the classics.

title: Io sto con gli indiani
actors: Bud Spencer, Michael Winslow
description: Cosa Nostra wants to expand the gambling business in Florida. As state laws prohibit it, he wants to develop it on Indian reservations, exempt from normal legislation. Indian chief Thomas opposes the project but is killed. At this point, Extralarge enters the field, a detective who is an old friend of the Indians who, among a thousand dangers, will manage to spoil the party for the criminals. Television production on the American exploits of Extralarge. A nice little tale but absolutely unlikely.

title: Io sto con gli ippopotami
actors: Terence Hill, Bud Spencer, Joe Bugner, May Dlamini, Dawn Jürgens, Malcolm Kirk, Ben Masinga, Les Marcowitz, Johan Naude
description: Tom, a giant big man with a heart of gold, has lived for a long time in Africa where he earns his living by organizing small scams against tourists in search of exoticism. At his side is his cousin Slim, who has joined forces with him. But a white adventurer has settled in the same area and starts raiding animals to send to wealthy collectors. Tom and Slim are unjustly accused of theft and imprisoned, but they break free and punch the poachers' plans.
notes: Adventures with an ecological background for the Spencer / Hill couple. The formula is always the same.

title: Spellbound
actors: Ingrid Bergman, Gregory Peck, Michael Chekhov, Leo G. Carroll, Rhonda Fleming, John Emery, Norman Lloyd, Bill Goodwin, Steven Geray, Donald Curtis
description: A young psychologist realizes that the new young director of the nursing home where she works, with whom she slowly falls in love, is suffering from a guilt complex that has roots in childhood. With the help of her elderly professor, the woman manages to discover the origin of the disturbances; in this way a murder case is also solved. The film marks the meeting between Hitchcock and Ingrid Bergman, who will then also play The Sin of Lady Considine and Notorius. Written by Ben Hecht, the film is somewhat burdened by the naive psychoanalytic subtext, and is among the author's most serious. The story unfolds as a search for truth in a labyrinth scattered with symbols. For the sequence of the dream Hitchcock availed himself of the collaboration of Salvador Dalì; for the soundtrack Miklos Rozsa was awarded an Oscar.

title: Io tigro, tu tigri, egli tigra
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Paolo Villaggio, Enrico Montesano, Cochi Ponzoni, Angela Luce, Nadia Cassini, Erika Blanc, Felice Andreasi, Massimo Boldi, Ugo Bologna, Paola Arduini
description: Elijah, a manure trader, is hired as a waiter by a couple where the husband plans to kill his wife and the new servant gives him a hand. A science fiction writer in a crisis of erotic efficiency risks a bad adventure with the repulsive queen of a fictional planet. A Bersagliere on the hunt for cigarettes risks causing a war between Italy and Switzerland. The first episode, with Pozzetto who directs himself, is all in all the best. Then Capitani directs Villaggio, in a variant of the everlasting Fantozzi, while the good Montesano gets lost in a script lacking in ideas.

title: Willie and Phil
actors: Michael Onktean, Margot Kidder, Ray Sharkey, Jan Miner, Tom Brennan, Julie Bovasso, Louis Guss, Kathleen Maguire, Kaki Hunter
description: Two friends fall in love with Jeannette and take turns at her side for years. When the three try to formalize their menage, the spell of love and complicity dissolves. Not bad, but the perfection of "Jules et Jim" is far off.

title: The Ipcress File
actors: Michael Caine, Nigel Green, Guy Doleman, Sue Lloyd, Gordon Jackson, Aubrey Richards, Frank Gatliff, Thomas Baptiste, Oliver MacGreevy
description: Having become a secret agent in spite of himself (to escape severe punishment), Harry must find out if two scientists, mysteriously disappeared, have been kidnapped by a foreign power or if they are traitors. Captured by his enemies, he is subjected to torture, but manages to resist. In the finale, he discovers that in his own service there is someone who is playing a double game. The psychedelic sequence of torture may seem a little aged today, but it still works. Caine, with the dazed face, with the clerk's goggles, never stopped playing that role.

title: L'ira di Achille
actors: Gordon Mitchell, Jacques Bergerac, Cristina Gaioni, Ennio Girolami, Gloria Milland, Eleonora Bianchi, Edith Peters, Tina Gloriani, Piero Lulli, Erminio Spalla, Nando Tamberlani
description: Under the walls of Troy, only the intervention of Achilles and Patroclus saves the Greeks from the attack of the besieged enemies. But Achilles was offended by Agamemnon and retreats indignantly to his tent. Patroclus, putting on the weapons of Achilles, is recognized and killed by the Trojan hero Hector. Only then, Achilles, furious, throws himself into the fray and avenges his friend by killing Hector.
notes: Poor Homer, what can be done in your name! The means employed are not few, but the results (environmental reconstruction, articulation of the story, acting and direction) are attested on a very modest level. Thirty years ago the film was considered poor.

title: Irene Irene
actors: Alain Cuny, Olimpia Carlisi, Sibilla Sedat, Carlo Hintermann, Vania Vilers, Francesco Carnelutti, Laura De Marchi, Riccardo Mangano, Antonio Francioni
description: Guido Boeri is an elderly magistrate who lives a normal, respectable and monotonous life together with his wife Irene. One day he comes home and his wife is gone. Deeply shocked, the judge takes refuge in a clinic on Lake Maggiore where the news of Irene's death reaches him.
notes: Delicate debut film for Monte who later would not keep all his promises. The first part of the film is the best. Magnificent Alain Cuny.

title: The Dawning
actors: Anthony Hopkins, Rebecca Pidgeon, Jean Simmons, Trevor Howard, Hugh Grant, Tara MacGowran, Ronnie Masterson, John Rogan, Joan O'Hara
description: Ireland, 1920. Growing up with her aunt and grandfather, Nancy meets Cassius (Anthony Hopkins), an elderly Republican rebel wanted by the British on her 18th birthday. In a flurry of feelings, he hides him and agrees to be his messenger, until his refuge is identified. From a novel by Jennifer Johnston, the film describes in an engaging and accurate way the initiation of a soul raised in the sentimental contact with nature, to the harshness and ruthless reasons of History.

title: My Friend Irma Goes West
actors: Marie Wilson, John Lund, Diana Lynn, Dean Martin, Jerry Lewis, Corinne Calvet, Lloyd Corrigan, Don Porter, Harold Huber, Joseph Vitale
description: Irma is engaged to Al, a frustrated impresario, while her friend Jane is with an aspiring bartender named Steve. A Hollywood producer offers Steve a contract and the quartet of friends triumphantly moves towards glory. Too bad that the self-styled producer is just a madman who escaped a madhouse. Quite weak sequel to "My friend Irma", despite the presence of the duo Martin / Lewis.

title: Ironweed
actors: Jack Nicholson, Meryl Streep, Carroll Baker, Diane Venora, Tom Waits, Michael O'Keefe, Fred Gwynne, Margaret Whitton, Nathan Lane, James Gammon
description: Francis, after the accidental death of a little son of which he feels responsible, has given himself to wandering. Other incredible deaths have marked his life, including that of a tram driver due to an innocent stone throw. Twenty years after the accident, in 1938, he returns to his hometown together with Helen, his affectionate companion in misery, and sees his former family again. Luxurious melodrama from a Pulitzer Prize-winning novel by William Kennedy with the "strange couple" Nicholson-Streep as the two bums.

title: Miles from Home
actors: Richard Gere, Kevin Anderson, Penelope Ann Miller, Helen Hunt, Brian Dennehy, Terry Kinney, Francis Guinan, Judith Ivey, Laurie Metcalf
description: Two brothers, Frank and Terry Roberts, inherited the land from their father. After the fat years, however (even Khrushchev, on a visit to the United States, had visited their farm), things are no longer going well: debts with banks are growing and a consortium would like to take over their lands. The two brothers then set fire to the ranch and run away: they will have to split up fighting hard for survival.
notes: A sort of agricultural road movie: the charge of denunciation it contains is sacrosanct, but the staging is conventional.

title: Isadora
actors: Vanessa Redgrave, Jason Robards, James Fox, John Fraser, Zvonimir Crnko, Lado Leskovar, Cynthia Harris, Bessie Love, Tony Vogel
description: At the age of fifty, the famous American dancer Isadora Duncan, in vogue between the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries, dictates her memoirs to a young secretary. We thus follow his artistic successes, the intimate tragedies, such as the death of his son, but also his intense desire to live and his overwhelming loves.
notes: Three different screenwriters took turns writing this story and perhaps that's why the result is all in all impersonal, very far from the Reisz of "Saturday night, Sunday morning". Luckily there is Vanessa Redgrave who, alone, raises the fate of the film.

title: Ischia operazione amore
actors: Walter Chiari, Peppino De Filippo, Vittorio Caprioli, Anna Campori, Tony Renis, Ric, Gian, Didi Perego, Ingrid Schoeller, Evi Marandi, Graziella Granata
description: Gennaro Capatosta manages a pension frequented by rich women in search of special attention, he has a cook wife and three children. Of the three, only one, Peppiniello, should be interested in the customers, but, deaf to his father's exhortations, he prefers to devote himself to his young wife. Then there is Enrico Tremalaterra, a footballer now out of shape, who manages to sign a contract with Flavia Petrazzi, a wealthy business woman. When the woman realizes that she has been exploited, she forces the man to honor his contract, elsewhere.
notes: Mediocre episodic comedy that wastes Peppino De Filippo. Tony Renis sings, and Ric and Gian make their debut in the role of two unemployed painters.

title: Ishtar
actors: Dustin Hoffman, Warren Beatty, Isabelle Adjani, Charles Grodin, Jack Weston, Tess Harper, Carol Kane, Aharon Ipalé, Fijad Hageb, David Margulies
description: Chuck and Lyle (Hoffman and Beatty) are two shabby American songwriters and stand-up comedians. Hired for a tour in Morocco, during the journey they end up being enchanted by a beautiful terrorist, Shira. Arrived almost by chance in the tyrannical emirate of Ishtar, they find themselves involved in a series of troubles and, among other things, are mistaken for the liberators announced by an ancient prophecy and for this acclaimed by the rebel gangs. Disguised as Bedouins and lost in the desert with a blind dromedary, they manage to save their skin and career at the expense of the CIA that wanted them dead.
notes: Melancholy performance by the two protagonists; Vittorio Storaro's photography is also wasted in this farce of little fun. Elaine May directed better ("She's Rich, I'll Groom Her and I'll Kill Her").

title: It's Alive III: Island of the Alive
actors: Michael Moriarty, Karen Black, Laurene Landon, Neal Israel, James Dixon, Gerrit Graham, Macdonald Carey, Art Lund, Ann Dane
description: A drug released by a pharmaceutical company produced five mutant children. The father of one of them, Stephen Jarvis, goes to court to prevent the children from being killed and manages to have them relegated to an island where nuclear tests were carried out years earlier. A few years later Stephen visits the island on a scientific expedition and discovers that the children have grown up and two of them now have a child. It is the third part of a series that began in 1975 with "Baby Killer". It is not a film for the refined, at times Cohen is also a bit clumsy, but there is some stuff, blood and great horror.

title: Bear Island
actors: Vanessa Redgrave, Donald Sutherland, Christopher Lee, Barbara Parkins, Richard Widmark, Lloyd Bridges, Lawrence Dane, Patricia Collins, Michael J. Reynolds, Nicholas Cortland
description: A group of researchers arrives on a small Arctic island that was occupied by the Nazis during World War II. A great deal of gold is hidden under the ice. Greed drives the participants in the scientific expedition to kill themselves inexorably ... Based on the novel by Alistair MacLean, it is a rather cumbersome thriller but still interesting in some particularly heinous situations.

title: L'isola di Arturo
actors: Vanni De Maigret, Reginald Kernan, Key Meersman, Luigi Giuliani, Gabriella Giorgelli, Elvira Tonelli, Luigi Zerbinati, Michele Barone, Aldo Vinci, Ireneo Petrucci, Ornella Vanoni
description: Fifteen-year-old Arturo, orphan of his mother, lives on the island of Procida where he awaits his father's return with trepidation. When he finally shows up together with his new wife, the very young Nunziata, he causes a dry disillusionment in the boy who, moreover, falls in love with his stepmother. At a certain point, Tonino also enters the game, a bad guy who has just come out of the island's prison.
notes: At the beginning of his career, Damiano Damiani tackles the adaptation of the famous novel by Elsa Morante with a light and sober touch and the result is happier than the subsequent adaptations from mafia stories.

title: Mysterious Island
actors: Michael Craig, Joan Greenwood, Michael Callan, Gary Merrill, Herbert Lom, Beth Rogan, Percy Herbert, Dan Jackson
description: A group of Southern soldiers, imprisoned after the end of the conflict, manages to escape. In their escape they end up on an islet not marked on the maps, where they are attacked by strange animals. Two women live on the island and the fugitives sympathize with them by agreeing to take them away from that inhospitable place. While they are fleeing they are attacked by pirates, but a mysterious explosion destroys the attackers' ship. Now safe, the group will know that the decisive intervention was the work of Captain Nemo's submarine. Jules Verne adapted at low cost by a director known for his committed films is always fascinating. Delightful Effects by Ray Harryhausen. Old-time fantasy.

title: La isla misteriosa y el capitán Nemo
actors: Omar Sharif, Jess Hahn, Philippe Nicaud, Gabriele Tinti, Ambroise Bia, Gérard Tichy, Rafael Bardem Jr., Mariano Vidal Molina, Rik Battaglia, Luis Induni
description: In the midst of the Civil War, five prisoners manage to escape from prison. Castaways, they end up landing on an island that appears to be deserted. This is actually Captain Nemo's refuge. Small budget for a small transposition from the novel "The mysterious island" by Jules Verne.

title: Island in the Sun
actors: James Mason, Joan Fontaine, Harry Belafonte, Joan Collins, Dorothy Dandridge, Michael Rennie, Diana Wynyard, John Williams, Stephen Boyd, Patricia Owens
description: Templeton, the English governor of the island of Santa Marta, in the Antilles, is caught between the conservative Maxwell Fleury, candidate in the elections, and David Boyeur who instead defends the claims of the indigenous who aspire to greater freedom and democracy. When it is learned that Maxwell's grandmother was a native, and therefore that the strict conservative is a half-breed, the drama breaks out.
notes: The cast is princely and the story, based on an Alec Vaugh novel, works well. As was often the case in Hollywood these days, it was enough to put together the right ingredients and the result was guaranteed.

title: Dirty Harry
actors: Clint Eastwood, Harry Guardino, Andrew Robinson, Reni Santoni, John Vernon, John Larch, John Mitchum, Mae Mercer, Lyn Edgington, Ruth Kobart
description: Harry Callaghan, of the San Francisco PD, is tough. In charge of the investigation of a madman who has already killed and blackmails the city by threatening chain murders, for a while he manages to neutralize him. At the end there is another murder. At this point Callaghan goes into action and, despite the spanners put in the wheel by superiors and procedures, he will be able to stop the unleashed killer. Directed by the very skilled Don Siegel, the first episode of the Callaghan series. First of all, there is action, but in the film there are also anxieties and deep impulses, which Eastwood will then be able to develop, returning to the character in four subsequent episodes, up to "Bet with death" in 1988.

title: The Inspector General
actors: Danny Kaye, Barbara Bates, Walter Slezak, Elsa Lanchester, Gene Lockhart, Alan Hale, Walter Catlett, Rhys Williams
description: Georgj, a gypsy who specializes in the sale of elixir of life, arrives torn and hungry in a small village and ends up in jail. The local authorities, however, are waiting for an Inspector General, one who uses to disguise himself as a vagabond in order to investigate without being recognized. Mistaken for the Inspector, Georgj is freed and filled with courtesies.
notes: The original is that of Gogol but here every satirical intent is sacrificed in the name of the omnipresence of the star. Danny Kaye gives his best and his performance ensures the fun. Good pace and setting.

title: L'istruttoria è chiusa: dimentichi
actors: Franco Nero, Riccardo Cucciolla, Georges Wilson, John Steiner, Ferruccio De Ceresa, Antonio Casale, Daniele Dublino, Piero Nuti, Luigi Zerbinati, Turi Ferro
description: Involved in a car accident, a young architect ends up in jail for manslaughter. But thanks to money and knowledge, release from prison doesn't seem far away ...
notes: We are from the parts of the best Italian social cinema of the 70s. A little didactic, but made with great participation. Soundtrack by Ennio Morricone.

title: Italia a mano armata
actors: Maurizio Merli, Raymond Pellegrin, John Saxon, Mirella D'Angelo, Toni Ucci, Daniele Dublino, Sergio Fiorentini, Franco Borelli, Massimo Vanni, Enzo Andronico
description: To obtain the release of some children taken as hostages, Commissioner Betti is forced to let the perpetrators of the kidnapping escape, intending to capture them later. He stops two, one dies in a chase, another is found charred. The instigator of the kidnapping remains in the shadows. Betti suspects a powerful underworld boss, but has no evidence.
notes: Pretty convincing Merli in the part of the cop all in one piece. But Girolami (who signs under the pseudonym Franco Martinelli) is neither Umberto Lenzi nor Sergio Martino. Weak result, despite the excellent characterization of John Saxon.

title: L'Italia s'è rotta
actors: Dalila Di Lazzaro, Teo Teocoli, Mario Scarpetta, Mario Carotenuto, Duilio Del Prete, Alberto Lionello, Enrico Montesano, Orazio Orlando, Franca Valeri, Marisa Laurito, Clelia Matania, Sergio Di Pinto, Loris Bazzocchi
description: After several job disappointments and a fair number of failures, Peppe, a Sicilian mechanic fired from the factory where he worked and his fellow countryman Nino and a Venetian girl picked up on the street leave Turin to return to the South. Along the way they try in every way to raise some money, but every initiative fails miserably. Once there they decide to go back.
notes: Rhapsody of clichés and jokes that concerned and closely concern the Italian reality (unemployment, crime and strikes). The soundtrack is signed by Enzo Jannacci.

title: Italian Boys - Liberate la scimmia
actors: Umberto Smaila, Franco Oppini, Rosa Fumetto, Ivan Graziani, Patrizia Pellegrino, Andrea Mingardi, Mauro Micheloni, Max Venegoni
description: Trip Radio and Radio Metropolis, two broadcasters separated by a heated rivalry, are engaged in a musical competition: the winner will be whoever is able to conquer the female audience. The results are uncertain, but Trip Radio will prevail after securing the support of well-known singers such as Ivan Graziani and Andrea Mingardi.
notes: After the dissolution of the Gatti di Vicolo Miracoli, Smaila and Oppini tried their luck with this unpretentious little film. Shortly after, Smaila will find her dimension as the conductor of Colpo grosso: the presence in the film of the stripper Rosa Comic, albeit in a chaste role, is a premonitory sign.

title: Italian Fast Food
actors: Enzo Braschi, Gino Coliandro, Edoardo Romano, Mirko Setaro, Sergio Vastano, Carlo Pistarino, Susanna Messaggio, Anna Galiena, Antonello Fassari, Clara Colosimo, Riccardo Rossi
description: A gang of paninari, led by Enzo, systematically clashes with a group of punks in a Milanese fast food restaurant. The cook of the restaurant is a lazy person who would like to have a career as a painter, while the waitress, who would do anything to become a movie star, manages at best to snatch a script for a commercial.
notes: Very sad "instant movie" made after the success of some comedians of the "Drive in", in particular of Enzo Braschi and his "paninaro".

title: Italian Secret Service
actors: Nino Manfredi, Françoise Prevost, Clive Revill, Giorgia Moll, Gastone Moschin, Jean Sobieski, Giampiero Albertini, Alvaro Piccardi, Enzo Andronico, Loris Bazzocchi
description: Natalino was a partisan and deputy; now he is hired by the American secret services to eliminate a dangerous neo-Nazi spy passing through Rome; compensation: ten thousand dollars. Natalino doesn't feel like it and so he passes the job on to Otto, who is satisfied with half. Ottone, however, has the same problem and passes and the assignment to a shady lawyer.
