Sort of hybrid between the Italian comedy and the spy story. What comes out in the end is quite funny, thanks above all to the interpretation of Manfredi and the skilful direction of Comencini.

title: Italiani a Rio
actors: Mauro Di Francesco, Silvio Spaccesi, Leo Gullotta, Gianni Ciardo, Clelia Rondinella, Consuelo Almeida, Orietta Graziano, Milton Gonçalves, Gisella Sofio
description: Three Italian bankers win an award trip to Rio. The eldest of the three immediately seeks love affairs which will all prove to be a failure. Another will overcome his sexual inhibitions and the third will sign a basketball player who turns out to be ... a surprise. Tragicomic adventures between exoticism and eroticism. Terrible.

title: Italiani, brava gente
actors: Tatyana Samoylova, Raffaele Pisu, Arthur Kennedy, Zhanna Prokhorenko, Peter Falk, Andrea Checchi, Riccardo Cucciolla, Valeri Somov, Nino Vingelli, Lev Prygunov
description: Two Italian soldiers in Ukraine save a Russian partisan twice: first from the Germans and then from the firing squad. Later the story of an Italian military doctor, who goes among the Russians to treat a wounded man, ends tragically. The war continues: winter arrives and the advance turns into defeat. Even for our heroes there is no escape.
notes: The Russian Campaign revisited by a great neorealist, between tragedy and poetry.

title: Un italiano in America
actors: Alberto Sordi, Vittorio De Sica, Franco Valobra, Alice Condon, Gray Frederickson, Alice Condon, Bettina Brenna, Bill Dana, Lou Perry
description: Giuseppe is a gas station attendant. For thirty years he has not seen his father who emigrated to the United States. Suddenly the man calls him and, during a television broadcast, the two meet again. The father, who pretends to be a businessman, is actually in debt: the money from the show will be used to pay off creditors.
notes: Writer and director, as well as of course interpreter of this film, Sordi is not completely convincing. His direction is ready for the criticism of manners (consumerism), but at the same time it fails to rise from a superficially satirical representation of American society.

title: Ivan Groznyy
actors: Nikolay Cherkasov, Lyudmila Tselikovskaya, Serafima Birman, Mikhail Nazvanov, Mikhail Zharov, Amvrosi Buchma, Mikhail Kuznetsov, Pavel Kadochnikov
description: Crowned Tsar of all the Russias, Ivan IV centralized power in his hands and waged victorious wars against the Tartars. But the Boyars, wanting to keep their privileges, plot against Ivan, support their suitor and poison the Tsarina, who, however, has time to secure an heir to Ivan. But the latter retreats sadly to a convent, while the people of Moscow ask for his return ...
notes: First part (the second is _La conspiracy of the Boyars_) of the great historical fresco by Ejzenstejn; but more than the hagiographic intention, the values ??of the staging are valid, above all for the plastic use of light, places and faces, inspired by great painting.

title: Ivanhoe
actors: Robert Taylor, Elizabeth Taylor, Joan Fontaine, George Sanders, Emlyn Williams, Robert Douglas, Finlay Currie, Felix Aylmer, Francis De Wolff, Norman Wooland, Basil Sydney
description: The Saxon knight Ivanhoe wants to free the King of England Richard the Lionheart, a prisoner in Austria, whose throne was usurped by Prince John. At the Ashbi tournament the knight wins against four Normans, but is wounded and goes to be treated by Rebecca, the daughter of the rich Isaac. Giovanni does not take it well and at that point he decides to make a scorched earth around the knight by imprisoning Ivanhoe's father, girlfriend Rowena, Rebecca and Rebecca's father.
notes: Spectacular cocktail of sieges, chivalrous clashes, intrigues and amorous passions drawn with a casual hand from the classic novel by Walter Scott.

title: Klondike Fever
actors: Jeff East, Rod Steiger, Angie Dickinson, Lorne Greene, Barry Morse, Lisa Langlois, Gordon Pinsent, Robin Gammell, Michael Hogan
description: Infected by gold fever, twenty-year-old Jack London, a boy who had hitherto been attracted to socialist books and doctrines, reaches Skagway from San Francisco, with the intention of organizing an expedition to the mythical Klondike. He finds a companion in the mature and extravagant Merrit Sloper, who helps him face the villain of the moment, a certain Soapy, from whom he takes the dog Buck. Just that dog that will become his faithful companion and protagonist of some of his most beautiful pages.
notes: A film with few merits that not even Rod Steiger can keep up.

title: The Mighty Quinn
actors: Denzel Washington, James Fox, Mimi Rogers, M. Emmet Walsh, Sheryl Lee Ralph, Art Evans, Esther Rolle, Norman Beaton, Robert Townsend
description: On an island in the Caribbean, a murder takes place in a luxury hotel: the investigation is conducted by the chief of police himself, Xavier Quinn, an open-minded and independent man. The main suspect is his childhood friend Maubee, now a prominent figure on the island: but between the investigator and the discovery of the real murderer there are obscure political interests ...
notes: A skilful use of Caribbean settings, the presence of a protagonist of the caliber of Denzel Washington and the support of a valid accompanying cast make all in all a pleasant story (scripted by Hampton Fancher, from a novel by A.H.Z. Carr) otherwise already seen.

title: For Your Eyes Only
actors: Roger Moore, Carole Bouquet, Topol, Lynn-Holly Johnson, Julian Glover, Cassandra Harris, Jill Bennett, Michael Gothard, John Wyman, Jack Hedley, Lois Maxwell, Desmond Llewelyn
description: An ultra-secret Atac-type device sinks the British spy ship St. Georges off the coast of Greece. A British archaeologist manages to locate him, but is assassinated. His young daughter Melina, eager for revenge, joins James Bond, in charge of the recovery operation. A risky job, as always, in the name of the unexpected, breathtaking pursuits, deadly ambushes, intercontinental travel: from the Bahamas to Cortina to the sunny Greek beaches. At the center of the intrigue is a Greek billionaire, a certain Kristatos, of whom Bond, with the beautiful Melina and a smuggler named Columbo, must storm the villa bunker. Of course there is no lack of Russians who, in turn, are on the trail of the device and certainly do not intend to back down.
notes: Directing, after having edited and directed the second unit in three other 007s, John Glen knows how to cook the good recipe of the series with full-bodied irony and long breathtaking sequences. For once, the scene is removed from the technological devilry that raged in the immediately preceding chapters, to give it back to agent James Bond, to his personal charm, to his humor. For Roger Moore, in his fifth 007, it's a wedding invitation. In the end, Bond's twelfth adventure (from Fleming's two books "Murder in Jamaica" and "Dangerous Affair") turns out to be one of the best-crafted.

title: Casino Royale
directors: Val Guest, Ken Hughes, John Huston, Joseph McGrath, Robert Parrish, Richard Talmadge
actors: David Niven, Peter Sellers, Woody Allen, Ursula Andress, Orson Welles, Deborah Kerr, William Holden, Charles Boyer, Peter O'Toole, John Huston, Jean-Paul Belmondo
description: Sir James Bond leads a withdrawn life after years of activity spent in Her Majesty's Secret Service. However, he must get back into action to face a mysterious international gang. which is eliminating the agents of the major powers. But the leader of the gang is… the most unsuspected.
notes: Ten movie stars to package this film, in which David Niven's aplomb clashes with the vitriolic humor of Peter Sellers and the demented humor of a Woody Allen at the beginning of his career. Five directors: Ken Hughes (scenes in Berlin), Robert Parrish, (with Sellers and Welles) John Huston (Bond's house and Scottish castle), Joseph McGrath (Sellers, Andress and Welles) and Val Guest (Allen and Niven) .

title: James Tont Operazione D.U.E.
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Antonella Lualdi, Antonella Murgia, Jacques Dufilho, France Anglade, Loris Gizzi, Claudie Lange, Geoffrey Copleston, Furio Meniconi
description: The clumsy agent James Tont this time is grappling with a criminal gang that wants to plunder the Vatican and destroy Rome.
notes: As in the illustrious model (the 007 series), given the success, even the all-Italian parody secret agent gives an encore. A satire, however, was already enough and in the second episode the character of Buzzanca shows the rope.

title: James Tont Operazione U.N.O.
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Evi Marandi, Gina Rovere, Loris Gizzi, Evi Rigano, George Wang, Licia Lombardi, Susanna Clemm, Lilia Neyung
description: Accompanied by the record magnate Goldsinger, China, excluded from the UN, is preparing a diabolical plot to blow up the Glass Palace. During an assembly attended by all the heads of the states that are part of it, a hymn will be played engraved on a disco-bomb. The agent of Sicilian origins Tont, inept but lucky, discovers the plan and, after having "brilliantly" overcome all sorts of obstacles, will manage to capture Goldsinger and his accomplices.
notes: In the wake of the success of the 007 series, here's a humorous farce like few of the countless starring Buzzanca.

title: Jean de Florette
actors: Daniel Auteuil, Gérard Depardieu, Yves Montand, Elisabeth Depardieu, Margarita Lozano, Ernestine Mazurowna, Armand Meffre, André Dupon
description: Jean de Florette (Depardieu) comes from the city, has a small physical impairment (a hump) and intends to cultivate a piece of land inherited from his mother. But the neighbors, led by the farmer Papet (Montand), boycotted him in every way to buy his land cheaply. Country saga based on a novel by Marcel Pagnol, the film constitutes the first part of a diptych which also includes the sequel to Manon delle sources. Director Berri evidently fell in love with the story and translated it warmly on the screen, making use of excellent actors. It should be noted that Pagnol himself filmed the story in 1952.

title: So Fine
actors: Ryan O'Neal, Mariangela Melato, Jack Warden, Richard Kiel, Fred Gwynne, Mike Kellin, David Rounds, Joel Stedman, Angela Pietropinto
description: Bobby Fine leaves the university career to help the father who has been indebted to his neck with his clothing company. Bob resolves brilliantly (and casually) the situation, but gets in trouble with a married woman. American experience not very happy for pomelate.

title: Un jeans e una maglietta
actors: Nino D'Angelo, Roberta Olivieri, Bombolo, Enzo Cannavale, Gabriele Villa, Benito Artesi, Sebastiano Somma, Laura Barbonetti
description: In a luxurious club on the island of Capri, everyone plays the thread to the beautiful Annamaria, and she doesn't seem to be sorry at all. Among these is Tony who would like to marry her and has also obtained the consent of her father. But Tony didn't deal with Nino, the bartender, the one with the angel's voice and a big heart. Thanks also to a boat that runs out of petrol, Nino will have the better of his rival.
notes: Nino D'Angelo has indeed shown, in recent times, a real talent, especially in the musical-melodic genre. His films from the 1980s, shot in a very short time and with very few means, remain indefensible.

title: Beware, My Lovely
actors: Ida Lupino, Robert Ryan, Taylor Holmes, Barbara Whiting, James Willmas, O.Z. Whitehead
description: For some housework Elena hires a man of fatigue but he is psychologically ill who, in the throes of a fit of madness, kidnaps her, threatens to rape and kill her. Any attempt to break free seems impossible. Robert Ryan looms large over Ida Lupino, the suspense takes your breath away from start to finish.

title: The Body Snatcher
actors: Boris Karloff, Bela Lugosi, Henry Daniell, Russell Wade, Rita Corday, Edith Atwater, Sharyn Moffett, Donna Lee
description: MacFarlane, a scientist, conducts studies in the field of pathological anatomy and is always in need of fresh cadavers. A grim driver finds them for him, who first goes to take them directly from the tomb, then decides to find them even fresher by killing people, and finally blackmails the professor, with tragic consequences.
notes: From an episode that really happened in Victorian England, told by Robert Louis Stevenson in one of his stories, Wise draws inspiration for one of his most beautiful films, which has become a horror classic over the years. Produced and written by Val Lewton.

title: The Narrow Margin
actors: Charles McGraw, Marie Windsor, Jacqueline White, Queenie Leonard, David Clarke, Peter Virgo, Don Beddoe, Paul Maxey, Harry Harvey, Gordon Gebert
description: The widow of a gangster, killed in a firefight, is willing to collaborate with the police and to mention the names of her husband's accomplices. She is escorted to testify in court, but on the train ride from Chicago to Los Angeles, despite all precautions, some killers try to kill her. A hard time for the policeman Walter Brown, responsible for his safety.
notes: Low-cost Noir that, using a very simple plot, manages to keep the tension high. The film's takings enriched Rko. In 1990, Peter Hyams made a remake (_Total Risk_) with Gene Hackman and Anne Archer.

title: The Flesh and the Fields
actors: Peter Cushing, June Laverick, Donald Pleasence, George Rose, Renee Houston, Dermot Walsh, Billie Whitelaw, John Cairney, Melvyn Hayes
description: "The story takes place in the nineteenth century. Doctor Knox is a surgeon who illegally procures corpses for his studies; for this he resorts to two shady individuals who lure old and vagabonds into their ambushes, to then kill them and bring their bodies to the Doctor. But one day the two kill a woman with whom a pupil of Knox is in love. English school horror, signed by one of the princes of the low-budget Anglo-Saxon film, The Hyenas of Edinburgh is a jewel of cruelty and sadism. "

title: Jesse James
actors: Tyrone Power, Henry Fonda, Randolph Scott, John Carradine, Nancy Kelly, Henry Hull, Slim Summerville, J. Edward Bromberg, Brian Donlevy
description: In the West, railroad agents often use violence to expropriate the land over which the railway will pass. The brothers Jesse and Frank James avenge their mother killed in one of these raids and, as farmers, they become outlaws. To survive they are therefore forced to commit other crimes, but, although they are now hunted by sheriffs and bounty killers, they are supported by the sympathy of the population who see them almost as Robin Hoods.
notes: George Barnes' stunning photography, some unforgettable spectacular scenes, and the effectiveness of the performers launched a cinematic legend, a monument to King's Hollywood classicism.

title: Jesuit Joe
actors: Peter Tarter, John Walsh, Laurence Treil, Geoffrey Carey, Chantal DesRoches, Valerio Popesco
description: Canada, 1911. Some bandits kill a corporal of the Red Coats in the hut of young half-blood Joe's grandfather, before being liquidated by him. While looking for his sister Duchess, Joe has time to do some good deeds and mistreat some traditional and self-righteous representatives of authority, including his father.
notes: From a book by Hugo Pratt, the creator of Corto Maltese who is also the co-screenwriter of this film, the static epos of the drawn "strip" is repeated in a slavish way. And the bewildered magic of certain situations and dialogues "a la Pratt", on the screen is reduced to emphasis.

title: Jesus Christ Superstar
actors: Ted Neeley, Carl Anderson, Yvonne Elliman, Barry Dennen, Josh Mostel, Bob Bingham, Larry Marshall, Kurt Yaghjian, Paul Thomas
description: A group of young people in jeans and T-shirts get off a bus in the desert of Palestine and begin to stage a musical about the last days of Jesus' life. We retrace all the episodes of the Gospel, from the triumphal entry into Jerusalem to the crucifixion.
notes: The music became a mass hit, but was already famous thanks to the previous theatrical version (by Andrew Lloyd Webber and Tim Rice). Upon release, the film aroused controversy from the Catholic press, which did not appreciate the director's "alternative" touch.

title: Jésus de Montréal
actors: Lothaire Bluteau, Catherine Wilkening, Johanne-Marie Tremblay, Rémy Girard, Robert Lepage, Gilles Pelletier, Yves Jacques, Cédric Noël, Pauline Martin
description: A young actor, director and interpreter of a representation of the Passion ends up identifying himself with Jesus.

title: JFK
actors: Kevin Costner, Donald Sutherland, Sissy Spacek, Jack Lemmon, Michael Rooker, Gary Oldman, Tommy Lee Jones, Joe Pesci, Walter Matthau, Jay O. Sanders
description: In November 1963, the President of the United States John Kennedy was killed by a sniper while driving along a street in Dallas in an open car. Lee Harvey Oswald is accused of the murder and is then killed almost immediately by a thug named Jack Ruby. The impression that the attack leaves in the country is enormous, but as far as the investigation is concerned, the case seems closed. Not so for Jim Garrison, the New Orleans District Attorney, who is stubborn to seek the truth, continues his research and ultimately comes to a surprising conclusion. A CIA plot, in agreement with the bosses of the war industry, would have been at the origin of the attack.
notes: Stone may be a little paranoid, but he's still a sincere Democrat. Here he signs a strong, aggressive and courageous product, not for nothing fiercely opposed by American politicians, mixing a scrupulous reconstruction of the facts with fiction. The accuser, upright and fascinating, is Costner; the villain (and this is not the first time this has happened to him) is Tommy Lee Jones. But the whole film is filled with perfect little roles for perfect great actors: from Gary Oldman, who plays Oswald, to Lemmon, Joe Pesci, Walter Matthau and Sissy Spacek.

title: A Lovely Way to Die
actors: Kirk Douglas, Sylva Koscina, Eli Wallach, Kenneth Haigh, Martyn Green, Sharon Farrell, Ruth White, Philip Bosco, Ralph Waite, Meg Myles
description: Leaving the police after a confrontation with superiors, Jim (Kirk Douglas) starts a new business as a private cop. In such guise he must escort Rina, a beautiful girl accused of killing her rich husband. Jim investigates and discovers that the girl is innocent: the real culprits are the inhabitants of a villa near the crime scene, who wanted to cover up their shady dealings. Love inevitably arises between Jim and Rina.
notes: After being on the cover of Playboy, Sylva Koscina had an American career as the new Italian sex symbol. But she didn't have much luck and returned to Italy to interpret erotic farces.

title: Jo
actors: Louis De Funès, Bernard Blier, Claude Gensac, Michel Galabru, Guy Tréjan, Ferdy Mayne, Yvonne Clech, Florence Blot, Micheline Luccioni
description: A writer of mystery dramas, Antonio Brisbard, tired of being blackmailed by a certain Jo, decides to kill him. Then he thinks about it, but a dead man escapes anyway. At this point, the problem becomes another: getting rid of the body, always having a police inspector at your feet. The "catchphrase" of the cumbersome deceased is a situation that has given rise to at least one cinema masterpiece: Hitchcock's The Conspiracy of the Innocents. Here we are not at those levels, but there is no shortage of funny situations. De Funès, when he has to hold up an agitated character, bordering on neurosis, plays at home.

title: Joan Lui - Ma un giorno nel paese arrivo io di lunedì
actors: Adriano Celentano, Claudia Mori, Federica Moro, Gian, Marthe Keller, Sherri Anderson, Federico Boido, Gino Cogliandro
description: Nobody knows where Joan Lui has come from, but everyone notices her arrival, even if the city is subjected to violence of all kinds. The Evil One, a powerful businessman, wants to silence the unconventional voice of the strange character and seems to succeed, but the force of His ideas is too strong.
notes: Musical film that Celentano signs as director, scriptwriter, author of music and editing, protagonist. It is certainly grungy and rhetorical (as well as its subsequent television appearances) but so strange and visionary that it is interesting.

title: Joe Versus the Volcano
actors: Tom Hanks, Meg Ryan, Lloyd Bridges, Robert Stack, Abe Vigoda, Dan Hedaya, Barry McGovern, Amanda Plummer, Ossie Davis, Jayne Haynes
description: Joe's life changes when he discovers he is only six months old. For this he accepts the offer of a billionaire: he must throw himself into the volcano of the island inhabited by the Waponi Woo to appease their god. In return Joe will spend the last days of his life as a nabob and his patron will receive from the natives a rare precious mineral for his industry. Joe leaves for the island and with him also the daughter of the industrialist, with whom he naturally falls in love.
notes: The story is very superficial, but Tom Hanks and Meg Ryan work together in anticipation of "Sleepless in love" and "There is mail for you".

title: Joe Hill
actors: Thommy Berggren, Anja Schmidt, Kelvin Malave, Evert Anderson, Cathy Smith, Hasse Persson, David Moritz, Richard Weber
description: In 1902 the Swedish Joel Hillström lands in New York and soon has to deal with the hostile reality that awaits workers like him. Thanks to his "political" songs he will become a character loved by the workers, but a tendentious accusation and a manipulated trial will lead to capital punishment. The character really existed and director Bo Widerberg tells his life (and death) in a film structured like a popular ballad, between the picaresque tale and the romantic-social drama. The judgment on the situation highlighted is without appeal. Excellent fusion between elegiac narrative elements and those of harsh social denunciation. Soundtrack by Stephen Grossmann and Joan Baez; special jury prize in Cannes.

title: Joe il rosso
actors: Armando Falconi, Ada Dondini, Barbara Monis, Luisa Garella, Aristide Baghetti, Maria Denis, Luigi Pavese, Angelo Bizzari
description: From the villa of the Sandelle Lafitte, a very precious painting by Murillo has disappeared. To lend a hand to the investigation comes from America Uncle Joe, known as "the red", who introduces himself as an investigator but is actually a gangster. Despite the doubts and perplexities of relatives, it is he who brilliantly solves the intricate case. Matarazzo brings to the screen the comedy of the same name, written by Dino Falconi for his father Armando. Falconi himself plays the role of Joe, giving space to all his qualities of sympathy. The result is a parody of crime films, full of twists, escapes and chases.

title: Joe Kidd
actors: Clint Eastwood, Robert Duvall, John Saxon, Don Stroud, Stella Garcia, James Wainwright, Paul Koslo, Gregory Walcott, Dick Van Patten
description: Joe Kidd is one of the many rancheros who live in an area of ??New Mexico where the natives were expropriated by a group of whites who, to achieve this, destroyed the archive where all the documents relating to the properties were kept with a fire. . The clash between the two communities comes to a head: on the one hand, the Mexicans are led by Luis Chama, on the other, the gringos have their leader in Mr. Harlan.
notes: Eastwood has been back in the US for four years, after finding stardom with Leone's westerns. He has already made his debut as a director, played the first film in the Callaghan series and founded his own production company, the Malpaso Company: "Joe Kidd" is precisely a Malpaso production.

title: Johnny Guitar
actors: Joan Crawford, Sterling Hayden, Mercedes McCambridge, Scott Brady, Ward Bond, Ben Cooper, Ernest Borgnine, John Carradine
description: Johnny, a cowboy guitar player, arrives at the club run by his former lover Vienna, now accused by the villagers of harboring a gang of robbers. The accusers are led by Emma, ??furious above all by the fact that the leader of the gang, with whom she is in love, prefers Vienna. Johnny defends the latter, but a showdown is looming between the two women ...
notes: A visually aggressive baroque western that hypnotizes by alternating moments of languor and sudden outbursts of fury. Ray uses the Trucolor (by Harry Stradling) and the sets (the saloon in the cave) as an avant-garde artist would; Crawford and McCambridge are a couple of antagonists like few in the history of cinema, and between them Hayden in one of the most "cult" roles of his career. Victor Young's leitmotif is famous.

title: Johnny Handsome
actors: Mickey Rourke, Ellen Barkin, Elizabeth McGovern, Morgan Freeman, Forest Whitaker, Lance Henriksen, Scott Wilson, David Schramm, Yvonne Bryceland
description: Arrested after a robbery that ended with the death of his best friend, killed by his accomplices, Johnny finds a protector in Doctor Resher. The doctor undergoes a facial plastic operation that brings his face, disfigured by a terrible congenital deformation, back to normal. When he is released from prison, now unrecognizable, Johnny enters a rehabilitation program for ex-convicts and finds work in a shipyard. In the meantime, he organizes a new robbery with the former accomplices who had betrayed him and his friend, for the sole purpose of cheating them.
notes: A tense and concentrated film, full of noir stereotypes but also illuminated by an unprecedented rawness. The interpreters are memorable: Forest Withaker caring doctor, Lance Enriksen slaying villain, Ellen Barkin hateful killer, the cop played by Morgan Freeman. For once, even Rourke seems better than usual. In the first 20 minutes there is a robbery sequence that should be studied by heart.

title: The Light in the Forest
actors: Fess Parker, Wendell Corey, Joanne Dru, James McArthur, Jessica Tandy, Carol Lynley, John McIntire, Joseph Calleia, Rafael Campos, Frank Ferguson
description: Inserted in a group of whites "returned" by the Indians who had kidnapped them (we are in 1764), 19-year-old Johnny, who was raised as a son by the chief Cujloga, would prefer to remain in the tribe in which he grew up. The boy finds his real father, his home, but many difficulties and fierce conflicts arise around him, fueled by evil people who hate Indians. Disney media production.

title: Johnny Stecchino
actors: Roberto Benigni, Nicoletta Braschi, Paolo Bonacelli, Franco Volpi, Ivano Marescotti, Turi Scalia, Loredana Romito, Alessandro De Santis, Sal Borgese, Giulio Donnini
description: Dante is a particularly naive, spontaneous type, and has as a friend Lillo, a handicapped boy. He knows Maria and immediately falls in love with her. But unfortunately Dante does not even remotely imagine what this love story will lead him to. In fact, the woman invites him to Palermo and hosts him in a very luxurious villa, where she introduces him to an alleged "uncle", a somewhat ambiguous character: he is in fact the lawyer of the very dangerous Johnny Stecchino, feared mafia boss who, just happened, is also Maria's husband. Dante is the perfect double of the terrible Johnny, so equal that he can serve the latter as a double.
notes: A series of paradoxical situations at a fast pace. As a director Benigni is a bit rough, but he redeems himself when he lets his overflowing comedy run free (and that is almost always). Moreover, here he has been able to surround himself with perfect "shoulders" (Bonacelli, Volpi).

title: Johnny West il mancino
actors: Mimmo Palmara, Adriano Micantoni, Roger Delaporte, André Bollet, Mara Cruz, Dada Gallotti, Barta Barri, Roberto Camardiel, Roberto Robles
description: Johnny West is an infallible gunslinger dealing with two bullies who have taken possession of a gold mine with the strength. Totally ordinary Western spaghetti.

title: Joko invoca Dio... e muori
actors: Richard Harrison, Claudio Camaso, Spela Rozin, Werner Pochath, Lucio De Santis, Paolo Gozlino, Mariangela Giordano, Goffredo Unger, Luciano Pigozzi
description: Together with Domingo, Rikie and Mendoza, Joko attempts to steal the cargo of gold they have stolen from a group of bandits. The operation fails and his accomplices are killed by thugs or turn out to be traitors. Joko decides to take revenge and comes to a showdown with the leader of the rival gang, whose identity will reserve him a surprise. Terrible. The title is completely incomprehensible because Joko is the only one not to die.

title: Juggernaut
actors: Richard Harris, David Hemmings, Omar Sharif, Anthony Hopkins, Shirley Knight, Ian Holm, Clifton James, Roy Kinnear, Caroline Mortimer, Mark Burns
description: A madman planted seven time bombs on an ocean liner for blackmail purposes. While on shore the police chase the criminal, a navy blaster reaches the ship and gets to work.

title: Jumpin' Jack Flash
actors: Whoopi Goldberg, Stephen Collins, John Wood, Carol Kane, Annie Potts, Peter Michael Goetz, Roscoe Lee Browne, Sara Botsford, Jeroen Krabbe, Jonathan Pryce, James Belushi
description: Terry Doolittle works in a New York bank following the currency movements of various countries. Because he gets bored, he sometimes enjoys sending witty messages to his correspondents. But one day an S.O.S appears on his computer: a certain Jumpin 'Jack Flash asks for help to escape from a country in the East. In a short time, the girl finds herself in an intrigue of spies, pursued by agents from all over the world.
notes: The film, built on Goldberg's overwhelming sympathy, is light but funny in its mixture of yellow and pink.

title: Kakkientruppen
actors: Gianfranco D'Angelo, Lino Banfi, Oreste Lionello, Mario Carotenuto, Donald O'Brien, Francesco De Rosa, Ric, Gian, Ugo Fangareggi, Francesco Mulè, Daniele Dublino, Enzo Andronico, Luciana Turina
description: Gallery of specks designed along the lines of the "Sturmtruppen", Bonvi's comic strips, otherwise humorous and which had already been brought to the screen by Salvatore Samperi. The protagonists are some military fools of the Wermacht during the Second World War, but also Sandokan appears, who intends to enlist in the Axis troops to fight, of course, against the British.
notes: Recycling of barracks jokes, in the wake of Samperi's "Sturmtrppen" taken from Bonvi's strips.

title: Kamikazen. Ultima notte a Milano
actors: Paolo Rossi, Gigio Alberti, Silvio Orlando, Claudio Bisio, David Riondino, Flavio Bonacci, Antonio Catania, Laura Ferrari, Gianni Palladino, Maria Luisa Santella, Bebo Storti, Mara Venier, Giovanni Storti
description: A theatrical agent passionate about horse racing loses a large sum on bets. To make up for it, he organizes an evening in a nightclub and convinces the six young artists (or self-styled ones) he represents to pay him a fee. The agent says he invited the manager of a popular TV show to the evening.
notes: In this comedy that targets the undergrowth of the show, Salvatores recruits all the friends of the Milanese cabaret: Paolo Rossi, Bisio, Bebo Storti, Antonio Catania and others. Their portraits of amateur comedians are merciless, and the overall result is pleasant and bitter.

title: Kangaroo
actors: Peter Lawford, Maureen O'Hara, Finlay Currie, Richard Boone, Chips Rafferty, Letty Craydon, Charles 'Bud' Tingwell
description: Richard Connor is an adventurer who works in tandem with an accomplice. The two become friends with an elderly landowner, tormented by the remorse of having abandoned his son years ago. Richard makes him believe that he is indeed the lost son, but then falls in love with the old man's (real) daughter. The intervention of a policeman who recognizes the two outlaws causes the clash from which Richard comes out alive and redeemed in order to love the girl.
notes: A sort of western filmed by Milestone in Australia, a circumstance that allows the eclectic director to suggest evocative exteriors and the staging of a nice duel with the whip.

title: Kaos
actors: Margarita Lozano, Claudio Bigagli, Massimo Bonetti, Enrica Maria Modugno, Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Omero Antonutti, Regina Bianchi
description: Four short stories from Pirandello opened and closed with a prologue and an epilogue in the form of _Colloquio con la madre_. In the first _The other son_: a poor widow lives in the illusion of keeping in touch with her children who emigrated to America who have never given news of themselves. Instead, the woman deliberately ignores the presence of a third child who remained in the village because he is the result of violence suffered many years earlier. In the second _Male di luna_: a young bride discovers with dismay that her husband, in the lots of full moon, falls prey to nervous breakdowns. In the third _La giara_: the tanner Zì Dima remains a prisoner of the enormous container on whose repair the rich and miserly Don Lollò wanted to interfere. In the fourth _Requiem_: a community of peasants obtains, in a daring way, a land on which to build the cemetery from the landowner.
notes: All situations are resolved with refined sensitivity and with a sober but effective cinematographic language. The Taviani brothers narrate the world of the writer with masterful effectiveness and obtain interpretations of great importance from the actors.

title: Kapò
actors: Susan Strasberg, Laurent Terzieff, Emmanuelle Riva, Didi Perego, Gianni Garko, Annabella Besi, Graziella Galvani, Paola Pitagora, Eleonora Bellinzaghi, Bruno Scipioni
description: During the last war Edith, a Jewish teenager, is interned in a Nazi concentration camp where she sees her parents die. Hatred and desperation push her to coldly prostitute herself to her torturers. She therefore comes to betray her companions and to become a "kapo", that is, an overseer.
notes: Certainly not Pontecorvo's most persuasive film, in which the denunciation of the tragedy of the extermination camps gradually slips into tones of easy sentimentality. A sensationalistic trolley that spectacularizes the death of a character caused some French critics to scream scandal, including director Jacques Rivette.

title: The Brothers Karamazov
actors: Yul Brynner, Maria Schell, Claire Bloom, Lee J. Cobb, Richard Basehart, William Shatner, Albert Salmi, Judith Evelyn, Edgar Stehli, Harry Townes
description: Three brothers live in a small town in Tsarist Russia: Ivan is a cynic, Alexei a true saint, Dimitri a pleasure-seeker who hates his father. When he is found killed it is Dimitri who is unjustly accused, but he, aware of his sins as a son, accepts the sentence. Catapulted into the poetic universe of the great Russian writer, Brooks still manages to get by. Merit of the actors (notable the interpretation of Yul Brynner in the role of Dimitri), but also of the general atmosphere that the director manages to give to the staging: feverish and painful, phantasmagoric and at the same time full of symbolic allusions.

title: The Karate Kid Part II
actors: Pat Morita, Ralph Macchio, Danny Kamekona, Pat E. Johnson, Nobu McCarthy, Danny Kamekona, Yuji Okumoto, Tamlyn Tomita, Martin Kove
description: Miyagi, young Daniel's life and karate teacher, returns after forty years of absence to his village in Japan, to the bedside of his dying father. The pupil decides to accompany him. Miyagi reunites with an old love and an ancient rival who has developed a mortal hatred for him and who, therefore, challenges him. Daniel flirts with the young Kumiko, but the evil Chozen becomes an enemy. Miyagi saves the life of Sato, buried in the rubble after a typhoon and the two elders reconcile, but Daniel will not be able to avoid fighting with Chozen.
notes: Second episode of a series aimed at teenagers, which started well and continued in decline, with lots of action and good feelings.

title: The Karate Kid III
actors: Pat Morita, Ralph Macchio, Thomas Ian Griffith, Robyn Lively, Martin Kove, Jonathan Avildsen, Sean Kanan, William Christopher Ford, Pat E. Johnson
description: Champion Daniel LaRusso is challenged by Mike Barnes. He was hired by the billionaire Silver to avenge Kreese's defeat by Daniel himself. Master Miyagi does not want to train Daniel, because the match, despite all rules, will be "full contact". Of course Miyagi will change his mind and Daniel will arrive perfectly prepared for the appointment.
notes: Some new characters are introduced and the driving force of the bloody battle is added, but everything is then cooked according to the usual recipe. Each step is predictable, the acting banal, the "morality" taken for granted.

title: Utvandrarna
actors: Max Von Sydow, Liv Ullmann, Eddie Axberg, Sven-Olof Bern, Aina Alfredsson, Allan Edwall, Monica Zetterlund, Pierre Lindstedt, Hans Alfredson
description: Epic of a peasant family that in the 19th century left the ungrateful, feudal Swedish countryside attracted by the American dream.

title: Ved vejen
actors: Tammi Øst, Ole Ernst, Kurt Ravn, Erik Paaske, Anne Grete Hilding, Tine Miehe-Renard, Ghita Nørby, Birthe Backhausen, Bodil Lassen
description: In a village in Denmark, the shy and pretty Katinka is the wife of the stationmaster, a gross man. One day a young agronomist, Huss, arrives and falls in love with her, reciprocated. Their understanding never goes beyond the looks. When Huss leaves, Katinka saddens to death. Fairy-tale atmospheres of the North for the directorial debut of the Bergmanian actor Max Von Sydow.

title: Kean
actors: Rossano Brazzi, Germana Paolieri, Mariella Lotti, Filippo Scelzo, Sandro Salvini, Dino Di Luca, Nicola Maldacea, Oreste Fares, Dina Sassoli, Paolo Ferrari
description: The great English actor Edmund Kean (Brazzi), friend but rival in love of the Prince of Wales (Scelzo), pays with exile the fact that the object of their passion is a married lady (Paolieri), and that the scandal must be suffocated at any cost. The subject is taken from the homonymous play by Alessando Dumas father. A careful but wristless direction, a protagonist who does not always manage to withstand the histrionic greatness of the character. Just discreet.

title: Kean. Genio e sregolatezza
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Anna Maria Ferrero, Eleonora Rossi Drago, Gérard Landry, Cesco Baseggio, Mario Carotenuto, Helmut Dantine, Nerio Bernardi, Massimo Burrelli
description: Edmund Kean, a histrionic English actor, enjoys a reputation as a Don Juan. Falling in love with the young Anna, he makes her debut as the first actress but it will be a disaster. To save the comedy (and the face of his beloved) he launches himself in a passionate monologue that involves all the spectators.
notes: Rumors would credit the real direction of this film to Francesco Rosi. But "Kean", undoubtedly, remains a project "of" Gassman, both for the theatrical layout and for the definition of the character. The story is taken from a tale by Dumas adapted for the stage by Sartre.

title: Khartoum
actors: Charlton Heston, Laurence Olivier, Ralph Richardson, Richard Johnson, Alexander Knox, Johnny Sekka, Michael Hordern, Zia Mohyeddin, Marne Maitland
description: Ten thousand Egyptian soldiers are annihilated by the Sudanese rebels who are headed by Mandhi and the latter, proclaimed a prophet, unleashes the holy war. In London, Prime Minister Gladstone sends Colonel Stewart and General Charles Gordon to Khartoum. Useless attempts at negotiations and alliances are started, and a heroic defense of the city, but reinforcements arrive when it has already fallen into the hands of the rebels. The film is worth more for its spectacularity than as a psychological portrait of its protagonist and minor figures. The interpreters are a bit sacrificed.

title: Kickboxer 2. The Road Home
actors: Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa, Sasha Mitchell, Peter Boyle, Dennis Chan, John Diehl, Michel Qissi, Heather McComb, Vince Murdocco, Humberto Ortiz, Matthias Hues, Brian Austin Green
description: Two of his brothers are dead, and David, who teaches martial arts in Los Angeles, reluctantly faces the champion of a new kickboxing association to fund his gym. David wins, but abandons the belt of champion denouncing the environment dominated by corruption and drugs and for this he suffers harsh reprisals. Wounded, he receives a visit from Xian, the master who led his brother Kurt to conquer the crown of champion in Thailand. After a passable start, the film becomes heavier and unexpectedly reconnects, in the second part, to the story of the previous Kickboxer (1989). Melancholy is the presence of an eclectic, good actor like Boyle (Frankenstein Junior, Taxi Driver), in the role of the villain on duty.

title: Kid Rodelo
actors: Don Murray, Janet Leigh, Broderick Crawford, Richard Carlson, José Nieto, Miguel Del Castillo, José Villasante, Julio Peña, Mike Brendel
description: Kid Rodelo, released from prison, goes to the abandoned town of Sheridan to search for $ 50,000 in gold that has been hidden there. But three fugitives and two adventurers accompanied by a woman also want the treasure. Prestigious interpreters in a film with an unlikely story, but narrated with discreet strength.

title: Killer, adios
actors: Peter Lee Lawrence, Marisa Solinas, Armando Calvo, José Jaspe, Víctor Israel, Paola Barbara, Nello Pazzafini, Rosalba Neri, Luis Induni, Miguel Del Castillo
description: Jess Vrain returned to his hometown, from which he had had to leave for killing the dangerous bandit Gaspar, saves the life of Jack Bradshaw, right-hand man of the very wealthy Sam Ringgold. Two attacks and the violent death of his friend Bob lead Jess to be appointed deputy sheriff. In the new role, Jess investigates a series of crimes of which it seems that the person responsible is attributable to Bradshaw. The truth, however, is another and Jess will be able to discover it by paying the price of other human lives.
notes: Dull blend of western and detective.

title: Killer Calibro 32
actors: Peter Lee Lawrence, Agnès Spaak, Lucy Scay, Massimo Righi, Alberto Dell'Acqua, Andrea Bosic, Nello Pazzafini, Valentino Macchi, Mirko Ellis, Hélène Chanel
description: Silver, an infallible and cunning killer, is tasked with identifying the members of a gang that has been systematically and for some time assaulting the same diligence. Silver, who is not a fool, spreads the news that he knows the identity of the bandits and starts waiting for them to show up to take him out. The result is of course the opposite. Those of the Explorer film '58, the producers of this film, must have had a hard time putting together such a complete and crystalline group of incapable ones. Almost everyone hides behind pseudonyms and they do not do it out of a desire for Americanization, but only for self-defense.

title: Killer Crocodile
actors: Anthony Crenna, Van Johnson, Pietro Genuardi, John Harper, Sherrie Rose, Ann Douglas, Ennio Girolami, Bill Wohrman, Gray Jordan
description: On a small island in the Caribbean, six young ecologists find a crocodile of immeasurable size and ferocity, perhaps born of radioactive contamination due to human neglect. Ecological catastrophic horror of Italian production (the director is Fabrizio De Angelis under a pseudonym), with the old Hollywood star Van Johnson.

title: Killer Crocodile II
actors: Anthony Crenna, Debra Karr, Ennio Girolami, Franco Fantasia, Terry Baer, Héctor Álvarez, Alan Bult, Paul Summers, Tony de Noia, Peter Schreiber
description: A young ecologist and an old hunter, who killed a monstrous crocodile generated by nuclear contamination in the first part of this sequel, face the equally terrible son of that reptile. It seems impossible, yet it is even weaker than the previous one.

title: Dead Center
actors: Justin Lazard, Rachel York, Eb Lottimer, Krista Shook, David Carradine, R.G. Armstrong, Francis X. McCarthy, Wynn Armstrong, Anthony Valero
description: Joe, a little street thug, is introduced to an organization that specializes in training killers. These are then used to eliminate the great leaders of world crime. After completing his first mission, Joe discovers that the head of the organization, Sanders, is a double agent and, aided by Mary, who had been his "teacher", sets out on his trail. The film is directed by a director who gained experience in the school of Roger Corman, from whom he learned speed and conciseness, qualities he has well assimilated, together with a wise use of the ambiguity of his characters. After making his debut as a director in 1973 he measured himself with different genres, from the gangster film (That dirty last night) to the full-length costume film, always flavoring everything with violence and eroticism.

title: Killer Party
actors: Martin Hewitt, Elaine Wilkes, Ralph Seymour, Paul Bartel, Sherry Willis-Burch, Alicia Fleer, Woody Brown, Joanna Johnson, Terri Hawkes
description: A student party in an abandoned house has macabre results because atrocious crimes have been committed within its walls.

title: Walk a Tightrope
actors: Dan Duryea, Patricia Owens, Terence Cooper, Richard Leech, Neil McCallum, Trevor Reid, A.J. Brown, Shirley Cameron, David Bauer
description: A professional killer kills Ellen's husband, then demands payment from the woman for the work done. She falls from the clouds, but maybe she pretends. The most remarkable thing about the film is its brevity.

title: Killing Birds - Uccelli assassini
actors: Lara Wendel, Robert Vaughn, Timothy W. Watts, Leslie Cumming, James Villemaire, Sal Maggiore, James Sutterfield, Lin Gathright
description: Ornithologist returning from Vietnam kills family members who, transformed into zombies, take revenge on anyone who approaches.

title: Kim
actors: Errol Flynn, Dean Stockwell, Paul Lukas, Robert Douglas, Thomas Gomez, Cecil Kellaway, Arnold Moss, Reginald Owen, Laurette Luez, Richard Hale
description: Abandoned by his English parents and raised as a Hindu by an old Lama, young Kim unconvinced enters the military college reserved for orphans and then becomes a British counterintelligence agent. Replaced by another agent who died on a mission, Kim successfully opposes the attempt by some Russian spies to stir up riots in the Himalayan region.
notes: From the famous novel by Kipling, the English Victor Saville has drawn a film in all respects Hollywood, in terms of production, cast and respect for the rules of the great show. Perfect Errol Flynn.

title: Kim
actors: Peter O'Toole, Bryan Brown, Ravi Sheth, John Rhys-Davies, John Glover, Lee Montague, Alfred Burke, Mick Ford, Bill Leadbitter
description: An English boy, raised on the streets of Bombay, is recruited by the British secret service. Beautiful version of Kipling's novel already brought to the screen by Saville in 1951. Don't miss Peter O'Toole as the bald monk.

title: King David
actors: Richard Gere, Edward Woodward, Alice Krige, Denise Quilley, Niall Buggy, Cherie Lunghi, Hurd Hatfield, Jack Klaff, John Castle, Tim Woodward
description: Based on the Old Testament, the film tells the story of David, the shepherd anointed by the prophet Samuel as the future ruler of the people of Israel. The young man first becomes a cantor and musician at the court of King Saul, the first ruler of Abraham's descendants, then, after the victory over the giant Goliath, his favorite warrior and strategist. David's rise culminates when he marries Saul's daughter, but an irremediable conflict soon breaks out between the two men. Having ascended the throne, David finds himself facing the rivalry of his own children.
notes: The biblical episodes are reconstructed with documentary fidelity. The text, however, becomes only a pre-established repertoire of facts and situations. The result is an implacable coldness, which the spectacular grandeur, due to the professionally impeccable packaging is not enough to redeem. Most of the film was shot in the Sassi di Matera, as Pasolini had already done for "The Gospel according to Matthew".

title: King Kong
directors: Merian C. Cooper, Ernest B. Schoedsack
actors: Fay Wray, Robert Armstrong, Bruce Cabot, Frank Reicher, Sam Hardy, Noble Johnson, Steve Clemente, James Flavin
description: A film producer reaches an unknown island where the natives worship a giant ape. With him there is also a girl who the natives kidnap and offer to the animal. Contrary to usual, he does not kill the woman, but takes her to his hiding place and defends her from other giant animals. The white men, however, imprison the ape and transport him to New Yor to exhibit him for a fee, but here, when King Kong sees the girl again ...
notes: Lightning and ephemeral glory for the female protagonist Fay Wray and shocking special effects for the time. It is always a film to be reviewed.

title: King Kong
actors: Jeff Bridges, Jessica Lange, Charles Grodin, John Randolph, Julius Harris, René Auberjonois, Jack O'Halloran, Dennis Fimple, Ed Lauter, Jorge Moreno
description: An expedition goes to an unknown island to look for oil. The explorers are joined by a young paleontologist and Dwan, an actress rescued from a shipwreck. The island is inhabited. The natives kidnap Dwan and offer her to their deity: a huge gorilla. The men from the expedition free Dwan and capture Kong. Back in New York, they exhibit the ape but he escapes with the girl looking for an unlikely safety on the World Trade Center towers.
notes: Useless as expensive remake of the 1933 film of the same name.

title: King Kong Lives
actors: Brian Kerwin, Linda Hamilton, John Ashton, Peter Michael Goetz, Frank Maraden, Jimmie Ray Weeks, Debbie McLeod
description: Shot down by the American Air Force in the previous 1976 film, King Kong is saved by a group of scientists who graft him a huge plastic heart. The operation is also successful thanks to the blood donated by a female of her own species. Having fled to the mountains for fear of being divided, the two animals are hunted down: the army kills Kong, but the female and the baby born of their union are saved. The poetry and the mythical atmosphere of the first 1933 film have completely disappeared, only the plastic of the special effects of Carlo Rambaldi remains.

title: King of New York
actors: Christopher Walken, Wesley Snipes, David Caruso, Steve Buscemi, Laurence Fishburne, Victor Argo, Wesley Snipes, Janet Julian, Giancarlo Esposito, Paul Calderon
description: A limo and two female bodyguards await drug kingpin Frank White as he leaves prison. Apart from a few disagreements with the Italian mafia, Frank's mind is occupied with only one thought: raising funds for a hospital in the Bronx. Relations with the Chinese mafia are also not good, but the crucial confrontation takes place with two policemen (one Irish, the other black) who have decided that legal methods are no longer enough.
notes: Great ending, banal and moral, disillusioned and bleak: perhaps the best scene of the film. The rest has the clarity of a nightmare, all resting on Christopher Walken's strong shoulders and Nosferatu face.

title: Kramer vs. Kramer
actors: Dustin Hoffman, Meryl Streep, Justin Henry, Jane Alexander, Howard Duff, George Coe, JoBeth Williams, Bill Moor, Howland Chamberlain
description: Ted Kramer, an advertising agent, returns home happy for a promotion and can no longer find his wife. Find little Billy, but not Joanna who has decided to divorce. From that moment everything goes wrong for him: he can't prevent Billy from suffering an accident in which he risks an eye and neglects work until he loses his job. The professional debacle, also derived from Ted's desire to stay closer to Billy, is even considered by the judges as a reason for demerit in the case that soon opposes the two spouses in the dispute over the child. The court in fact ends up entrusting custody of Billy to his mother. However, the story is not over and the woman, after the resentment that had led her to abandon her husband, understands that for the sake of the child it is preferable to find a "modus vivendi" that takes into account above all the needs of Billy .
notes: Oscar for Best Picture, Direction, Screenplay, Actor (Hoffman) and Supporting Actress (Streep) for Benton's third film that with "The Private Eye" had made us believe he was a completely different director.

title: Kriminal
actors: Glenn Saxson, Helga Liné, Andrea Bosic, Ivano Staccioli, Esmeralda Ruspoli, Dante Posani, Franco Fantasia, Maria Luisa Rispoli, Armando Calvo, Mary Arden
description: Recently escaped, Kriminal wants to get his hands on a diamond bag that Lady Gold is moving to Turkey. But the loot had been entrusted to twins and the bandit, of course, robs the wrong one ...
notes: The inspiring cartoon was bordering on the illegible; the film manages to do a little better.

title: Krull
actors: Ken Marshall, Lysette Anthony, Freddie Jones, Liam Neeson, Francesca Annis, Alun Armstrong, David Battley, Bernard Bresslaw, John Welsh
description: On the planet Krull, a king's daughter must marry another king's son. The day of the wedding the Massacres swoop into the castle, ferocious envoys of the Monster, who has decided to kidnap the beauty to make her his ...
notes: Fairytale for adults and children, endowed with irony, with adequate medieval-futuristic scenography.

title: È l'amor che mi rovina
actors: Walter Chiari, Lucia Bosé, Aroldo Tieri, Eduardo Ciannelli, Jackie Frost, Virgilio Riento, Amedeo Dejana, Eugenio Cancelli, Enrico Leurini
description: A ring containing a few drops of a dangerous atomic liquid is carried by the innocent Walter, a quiet shop assistant, to Sestrière to be delivered to a countess. Walter naturally manages to get himself, a friend of his and also Carla, a ski instructor with whom he is madly in love, into trouble. Then, fortunately, everything ends in the best way.
notes: Skillfully scripted by Mario Monicelli and Steno, an interesting comedy with a Walter Chiari in top form. Not the best Soldiers movie but certainly one of his funniest.

title: The Year of the Dragon
actors: Mickey Rourke, John Lone, Ariane, Leonard Termo, Raymond J. Barry, Caroline Kava, Eddie Jones, Joey Chin, Victor Wong
description: There is a non-aggression pact between the police and the "elders" of the Chinese community in Chinatown. But when policeman Stanley White arrives, things change. On the other side is the young and ambitious Joey Tai, who is attempting the rise to power of the Triad, the ruthless Chinese mafia. White tries to persuade TV reporter Tracy Tzu to help him in his war.
notes: Hyper-realistic violence, furious sequences, off-screen scandals for the merciless image of the melting pot, tension to the stars, protagonists involved in murky passions, duels to the death. In short, a film by Michael Cimino.

title: La casa 5
actors: David Brandon, Gene LeBrock, Barbara Bingham, Stephen Brown, Michael Paul Stephenson, Theresa Walker, Mary Coulson
description: Protestant pastor Peter settles with his family in a long-abandoned house. Strange phenomena and macabre visions make him understand that the house is frequented by demonic presences. Investigating, he discovers that in the past some women who worshiped the demon Amet had lived there. The priest decides to perform an exorcism. No connection with the series made in the United States by Sam Raimi: Clyde Anderson is the very Italian Claudio Fragasso, who copies with a certain talent the clichés of the most recent horror.

title: Laberinto de pasiones
actors: Imanol Arias, Cecilia Roth, Antonio Banderas, Helga Liné, Marta Fernández Muro, Fernando Vivanco, Ofelia Angélica, Ángel Alcázar, Concha Grégori, Cristina Sanchez Pascual
description: Sexilia, the daughter of a gynecologist who specializes in artificial insemination, goes to the analyst because she is a bit of a nymphomaniac. Riza Niro, son of the former emperor of Tiran, pursued by the empress Toraya, has a gay history with Sadec. The laundry girl, systematically raped by her father, swaps places with Sexilia to everyone's satisfaction. Eventually Riza and Sexilia flee to Contadora. If you think the plot is vulgar, then you haven't heard the song, sung by the director himself, "Suck It to Me". It is Almodóvar's second film and belongs to the happy period when he didn't know how to make movies, but he was absolutely crazy.

title: The House on Carroll Street
actors: Jeff Daniels, Kelly McGillis, Mandy Patinkin, Jessica Tandy, Jonathan Hogan, Remak Ramsay, Kenneth Welsh, Christopher Buchholz, Brian Davies
description: Emily accidentally discovers a shady turn by which some neo-Nazis are introduced to the United States with fake names. A corrupt senator wants to profit from this maneuver. The girl finds herself in a very dangerous situation, but receives help from an FBI agent who has been chased after her. After chases, twists and turns and deadly dangers, all the knots come to a head ...
notes: Yates ("The Stage Servant", "An Inconvenient Witness") is grappling with a political thriller. The eye is always turned to the Grand Master Hitchcock. The imitation is of a high standard, and screenwriter Walter Bernstein was indeed a victim of McCarthyism

title: Writer's Block
actors: Morgan Fairchild, Joe Regalbuto, Michael Praed, Mary Ann Pascal, Cheryl Anderson, Douglas Rowe, Ned Bellamy, David Grant Wright
description: Magenta Hart is a writer of detective novels. His celebrity is linked to the invention of a terrifying character: a serial killer who reaps his victims by strangling them with a red string. His editor decides that something new must be invented: the adventures of the strangler must end. And it is precisely then that the crimes imagined by Magenta really begin to happen. The protagonist of this television thriller is Morgan Fairchild, known for her presence in the serial Dinasty. The subject does not shine for originality and the direction is limited to applying the fundamental rules of the genre, aiming at pure entertainment.

title: Una lacrima sul viso
actors: Bobby Solo, Laura Efrikian, Nino Taranto, Lena von Martens, Dolores Palumbo, Lucy D'Albert, Dante Maggio, Pina Ceparano, Piero Jossa, Agostino Salvietti, Carlo Taranto
description: Bobby Tonner (Bobby Solo), the famous American singer, has arrived in Naples to visit the conservatory professor Giovanni Todini, an old friend of his father. The professor's daughter is called Lucia (Laura Efrikian), she is attractive and even the American seems to be fascinated by her.
notes: The relationship is opposed by numerous events that painfully lengthen the plot of a mediocre film necessary exclusively for a performance by the singer, then debut, Bobby Solo. Nino Taranto, in the old glory of variety theater, is the matusa who acts as a shoulder to various situations and offers that extra touch of comedy.

title: I ladri
actors: Totò, Giovanna Ralli, Armando Calvo, Giacomo Furia, Enzo Turco, Renato De Simone, Juanjo Menendez, Rafael Luis Calvo, Maria Luisa Rolando, Félix Fernández, Fred Buscaglione
description: Sent back as undesirable by the United States to Naples, the mobster Joe Castagnato carries with him, hidden in jars of jam, the rich loot of a robbery. But someone discovers the trick, and uses the worst methods to get hold of the loot ...
notes: In this film there is a faint echo of "I soliti ignoti", released a year earlier, but Fulci is not Monicelli, and the presence of Totò does not redeem the confused and biting script. In the cast, 24-year-old Giovanna Ralli and Fred Buscaglione.

title: Ladri di biciclette
actors: Lamberto Maggiorani, Enzo Staiola, Lianella Carell, Elena Altieri, Gino Saltamerenda, Giulio Chiari, Vittorio Antonucci, Michele Sakara, Fausto Guerzoni, Emma Druetti
description: At the end of the Second World War, the unemployed Antonio finally finds a job as an attacker, but his bicycle is stolen. After a hopeless report to the police, the man begins a frustrating search for all of Rome with his son Bruno, then, desperately, decides to steal one. But Antonio is caught red-handed, and ...
notes: Key film of Italian neorealism, played by non-professional actors and entirely shot on location based on a screenplay written by Cesare Zavattini and by De Sica himself. Awarded in 1949 with the Oscar for best foreign film. Small appearance for a young Sergio Leone.

title: The Thief of Baghdad
actors: Roddy McDowall, Kabir Bedi, Marina Vlady, Frank Finlay, Pavla Ustinov, Daniel Emilfork, Ian Holm, Peter Ustinov, Terence Stamp
description: A thief helps a prince to defeat the evil caliph and win the love of the beautiful princess.

title: The Thief of Bagdad
actors: Douglas Fairbanks, Julanne Johnston, Snitz Edwards, Anna May Wong, Charles Belcher, Sôjin Kamiyama, Brandon Hurst, Tote Du Crow, Noble Johnson
description: The thief Ahmed (Fairbanks) searches for a gold chest to steal, but he just has to glimpse the Princess to fall madly in love with her and think of nothing else. He manages to be received at court, his love is reciprocated, but here come the Mongols, who establish a ferocious dictatorship. The thief-patriot will resist the lure of a stupendous "enemy" slave and free Baghdad. The happy meeting between Walsh and the star Fairbanks (who wrote the film under a pseudonym) generated a resounding success. Amazing, for the time, the special effects and the accuracy of the sets. Mine of find and prototype of all oriental adventure films to come. Set design by William Cameron Menzies and costumes by Mitchell Leisen.

title: The Thief of Bagdad
directors: Michael Powell, Ludwig Berger, Tim Whelan
actors: Conrad Veidt, Sabu, Rex Ingram, June Duprez, John Justin, Miles Malleson, Morton Selten, Mary Morris, Bruce Winston
description: The evil vizier Jaffar has the young king of Baghdad, Ahmad, arrested. In prison Ahmad meets the nice thief Abu with whom he manages to escape. Meanwhile, the princess (with whom Ahmad has fallen in love) has fled not to marry Jaffar. The vizier, however, manages to have Ahmad captured and blinds him while transforming Abu into a dog.
notes: One of the most beautiful and fascinating versions of the famous tale of the "Thousand and One Nights". Magical and glowing, full of inventions (the genius, the flying carpet) and colors, the film won three Oscars (photography, scenography, special effects). The Korda brothers produce, with the help of William Cameron Menzies.

title: Il ladro di Bagdad
actors: Steve Reeves, Giorgia Moll, Arturo Dominici, Edy Vessel, Daniele Vargas, Antonio Battistella, Fanfulla, Giancarlo Zarfati, Gina Mascetti, Ignazio Dolce
description: The fairy-tale character is looking for the magical blue rose that will allow him to heal the sultan's daughter, struck by a mysterious disease that no doctor has managed to eradicate. The feat will not be easy, but in the end, the hand of the girl will also be there for the hero.
notes: Nothing to do with Walsh and Powell's bright precedents. The film is rather poor productively, without even the charm of the B series.

title: Il ladro di bambini
actors: Enrico Lo Verso, Valentina Scalici, Giuseppe Ieracitano, Florence Darel, Marina Golovine, Renato Carpentieri, Vitalba Andrea, Fabio Alessandrini, Vincenzo Peluso
description: Rosetta, (Scalici), a ten-year-old girl of Sicilian origin living in Milan, must be escorted with her little brother Luciano (Ieracitano) to an institution for minors at risk, in Civitavecchia, because their mother was arrested. Reason: instigation and exploitation of prostitution. The accompaniment is entrusted to a couple of young carabinieri. Given the ease of the task, one disappears with the complicity of the other, Antonio (Lo Verso), who sets out on a journey. In Civitavecchia, however, the director of the institute refuses to welcome the children, appealing to a series of bureaucratic quibbles and the journey must thus extend to Sicily, where the relatives of the children live. During this second journey the soldier decides to make some digressions, including a visit to his relatives in Calabria and a short stop at the sea.
notes: The film, acclaimed by audiences and critics, is all centered on the delicate balance of the relationships between the children and the carabiniere who accompanies them (Enrico Lo Verso really good) and on the psychology of the little "pretty baby". Winner of the Grand Jury Prize at Cannes, the film is an example of sincere, serious, moving, civilized Italian cinema. The narration is fluid, the interpretation exciting, the photography evocative.

title: Thief of Hearts
actors: Steven Bauer, Barbara Williams, John Getz, David Caruso, Christine Ebersole, George Wendt, Alan North, Romy Windsor, Joe Nesnow
description: Moving on the house, a thief also takes away the diaries of Mrs. Davis, reads them, falls in love and "hooks" the woman by breaking as a manager. Something arises between the two, but the intervention of Mr. Davis restores the order.

title: Breaking In
actors: Burt Reynolds, Casey Siemaszko, Sheila Kelly, Lorraine Toussaint, Albert Salmi, Harry Carey jr., Maury Chaykin, Stephen Tobolowsky
description: Ernie, a professional thief, takes a liking to the young Mike who is a novice in the same career and with him makes a whole series of thefts. At the same time, Ernie also tries to teach his pupil prudence and how to behave in life (always according to his own philosophy).
notes: A film that, in light and at times almost grotesque tones, celebrates a fruitful "education" on the road to illegality. The narrative has little bite and allows itself too many repetitions. Screenplay by John Sayles.

title: The Wrong Man
actors: Henry Fonda, Vera Miles, Anthony Quayle, Harold J. Stone, Charles Cooper, John Heldabrand, Esther Minciotti, Doreen Lang, Laurinda Barrett, Norma Connolly, Nehemiah Persoff
description: Manny, a double bass player with poor financial means, is recognized by the employees as the thief who robbed an insurance company. A nightmare period begins for Manny, which sees him busy trying to prove his innocence in every way. Only when the real robber is arrested, who resembles him in an extraordinary way, does everything work out for the best. An intense Henry Fonda in this film based on a situation typical of Alfred Hitchcock's cinema: the innocent being wrongly accused and forced to fight to defend his freedom. Inspired by a fact that really happened.

title: Lady Dragon
actors: Cynthia Rothrock, Richard Norton, Advent Bangun, Bella Esperance, Robert Ginty, Hengky Tornando, Thomas Forcher, Pitradjaya Burnama
description: "Kathy wants to avenge the death of her husband, killed on his wedding day by the mobster Ludwig. The woman is a martial arts expert. She manages to locate Ludwig in Bangkok, but the criminal has her beaten up by some of his henchmen. Kathy, rescued by an old man and his nephew, she recovers and prepares for the decisive battle. Kickboxing is rampant in the cinema in all sorts of ways. Here it is a woman who practices it with determination; for the rest, characters and environments do not present anything new ; the motive for the pain of love is little more than a pretext for the predictable succession of pursuits, clashes and warrior prowess. "

title: Lady for a Day
actors: May Robson, Warren William, Guy Kibbee, Walter Connolly, Glenda Farrell, Ned Sparks, Jean Parker, Nat Pendleton, Barry Norton, Halliwell Hobbes
description: Apple Annie, a peddler on Broadway, manages to support her daughter in a Spanish boarding school with great sacrifices, making her believe she is a great lady. One day, however, the girl announces that she will soon visit her together with her boyfriend, a count. Dave, a gangster from the neighborhood, helps Annie by preparing a staging so as not to let the miserable truth emerge. Even the police cooperate in the deception ...
notes: Tender, bizarre, moving: the irony with which Capra looks at the somewhat pathetic achievement of his commoner mother does not prevent him from taking a decisive stand on the side of the poor people, mocking the pomp of the aristocrats. With an "autoremake": _Angeli con la pistol_ (1961).

title: Lady Godiva of Coventry
actors: Maureen O'Hara, George Nader, Victor McLaglen, Rex Reason, Torin Thatcher, Eduard Franz, Leslie Bradley, Henry Brandon, Arthur Shields, Robert Warwick
description: England, middle ages. Lord Lefric is forced to participate in the war between the Saxons and the Normans, and manages to defend his village well from the attacks of the enemies. An envious noble, he accuses Lefric's beautiful wife, Lady Godiva, a kind of combative English Joan of Arc, of adultery. According to Saxon customs, the woman is forced to cross the country naked as a sign of humiliation. But the admiration of fellow citizens is such that no one will turn to look at it.
notes: Irish O'Hara, John Wayne's feisty consort, in one of his most famous roles. Modest, in her nakedness, but equally beautiful.

title: Lady Killer
actors: James Cagney, Mae Clarke, Leslie Fenton, Margaret Lindsay, Douglass Dumbrille, Russell Hopton, Raymond Hatton, Henry O'Neill, Robert Elliott, Marjorie Gateson
description: Fed up with living as a mask in a cinema, a young man starts to hang out with the underworld and becomes a gangster. But his star does not shine for long: hunted by other criminals and the police, he takes refuge in Hollywood, where he is hired to play criminal roles in crime films. Become a star, and with the notoriety comes the trouble: his past jumps out, but his fame resists even when his true identity becomes known. It begins as a detective story, ends in comedy: it is one of Cagney's best films, also famous for his clash with the female lead Mae Clarke.

title: Lady L.
actors: Sophia Loren, Paul Newman, David Niven, Cecil Parker, Marcel Dalio, Philippe Noiret, Jacques Dufilho, Eugene Deckers
description: Armand has a heart of gold, but he is an unrepentant thief and does not give up his reckless life even in view of his imminent fatherhood. For this he is abandoned by Louise, who marries the very rich Duke of Lendale, while keeping all her love for Armand. Moreover, once his bill is paid with justice, Armand is magnanimously tolerated by his legitimate wife.
notes: Set in a sumptuous context, the comedy remains undecided between a farcical attitude and a more sentimental and romantic tone, without being able to find a true balance. The actors obviously have a certain glamor.

title: Ladyhawke
actors: Matthew Broderick, Michelle Pfeiffer, Rutger Hauer, Leo McKern, Ken Hutchison, Alfred Molina, John Wood, Giancarlo Prete, Loris Loddi, Alessandro Serra, Charles Borromel, Massimo Sarchielli, Nicolina Papetti
description: In France, in the 13th century, an evil feudal bishop fell in love with Isabella of Anjou. But the beauty's heart belongs to the head of the guard Etienne. The bishop casts a curse on the two poor people: he is condemned to wander at night in the form of a wolf, she to transform into a hawk during the day. The two lovers are therefore destined not to meet again in human guise. Then Etienne meets the petty thief Philippe who, with the help of the monk-magician Imperius, first saves the life of the hawk, then the wolf.
notes: A discreet product of its kind, thanks to the careful reconstruction of the historical environment and the common thread of the love story. The pop soundtrack is a bit silly, Storaro's photography is splendid (the film is shot in the Abruzzo National Park).

title: The Blue Lagoon
actors: Brooke Shields, Christopher Atkins, Leo McKern, William Daniels, Elva Josephson, Glenn Kohan, Alan Hopgood, Gus Mercurio, Jeffrey Kleiser
description: The Northumberland sailing ship is shipwrecked in the open ocean. Three are saved: the ship's cook, Paddy Burton, and two teenagers: Emmeline and Richard. Paddy acts as a father to them, teaching them to survive, and then he dies. Meanwhile, the two boys have grown up, discovered love and discovered how children are born. Sooner or later help arrives.
notes: An archaic-idyllic tale that has touched the hearts of many spectators, slipping into a very cloying form of soft eroticism. Shields was already famous at the time for playing an underage prostitute in Malle's "Pretty Baby". Enchanting landscapes, photograph by Nestor Almendros.

title: Still of the Night
actors: Roy Scheider, Meryl Streep, Jessica Tandy, Joe Grifasi, Sara Botsford, Josef Sommer, Frederikke Borge, Irving Metzman, Larry Joshua
description: A psychiatrist's patient is murdered and the doctor acts as an investigator to find the culprit. At first he goes after the victim's woman, falls in love with her and helps her escape the police, convinced of her innocence. The case is resolved in an isolated villa on Long Island, thanks to the reconstruction of fragments of dreams narrated by the patient to the psychiatrist.
notes: Freud-Hitchcockian cocktail, without particular originality flashes but written, staged and interpreted with sure professionalism. Not surprisingly, Robert Benton had already been director-screenwriter of "Private Eye" and "Kramer vs. Kramer".

title: The Lives of a Bengal Lancer
actors: Gary Cooper, Franchot Tone, Richard Cromwell, Guy Standing, C. Aubrey Smith, Kathleen Burke, Douglass Dumbrille, Monte Blue, Colin Tapley, Akim Tamiroff
description: In an English camp in India, Captain McGregor cannot hide his rebellious attitude to discipline and for this reason he acquires the esteem and friendship of another officer and the colonel's son. When he is taken prisoner by rioting Indians, the two friends disguise themselves as natives and set out to free him. Film that enhances adventure: based on manly friendship, on individual courage, on personal initiative, it casts sarcasm against certain rules of military life, but celebrates heroism to the highest degree. The duo Gary Cooper-Franchot Tone (plus the young Richard Cromwell) is brilliant.

title: Oh, Susanna!
actors: Rod Cameron, Lorna Gray, Forrest Tucker, Chill Wills, William Ching, Jim Davis, Wally Cassell, Jimmy Lydon, Douglas Kennedy
description: "Hawks" and "doves" compared in the handful of soldiers guarding a fort bordering Sioux territories. There is also a strong love rivalry between an officer and his subordinate.

title: Da hong deng long gao gao gua
actors: Gong Li, Ma Jingwu, He Saifei, Cao Cuifen, Zhao Qi, Kong Lin, Jin Shuyuan, Ding Weimin
description: Beautiful young Song Liang leaves home and college to become Mr. Chen's fourth wife. Her dream is to become her favorite, even through deception (she pretends to be pregnant), but soon discovers the hostility, envy and perfidy of other wives. This murky climate entangles Song Liang in a spiral of violence that drives her to madness.
notes: Very cold and ritual female melodrama, based on a novel by Su Tong. The staging, of great psychological sophistication, underlines the minimal nuances of the power relations between the characters. Silver Lion in Venice.

title: Let's Scare Jessica to Death
actors: Zohra Lampert, Barton Heyman, Kevin O'Connor, Mariclare Costello, Alan Manson, Gretchen Corbett
description: Jessica has just returned to her home from a clinic, where she was hospitalized with a severe nervous breakdown. Apparently, however, his troubles are not over yet: the rooms are crossed by rumors and mysterious visions, not to mention the existence of a walking corpse and a couple of vampires lurking. Will our Jessica be able to escape? And by whom? The film is the first work of a director from the world of music and theater. It is a discreet horror. Zohra Lampert is the good protagonist: her best-known films are Splendor in the grass of Kazan and Cassavetes' La sera della prima.

title: The Gods Must Be Crazy II
actors: N!xau, Lena Farugia, Hans Strydom, Erick Bowen, Treasure Tshabalala, Eiros, Nadies, Pierre van Pletzen, Lourens Swanepoel, Richard Loring
description: Three parallel stories in the lush African savannah. A Bushman chases the kidnappers' truck of two of his children on foot. The beautiful lawyer Ann Taylor, on an aerial trip with a clumsy ecologist, crashes. Mateo, a Cuban soldier, and Timi, a Unita guerrilla, take turns capturing each other. At some point all the characters meet before continuing.
notes: Sequel to "Are we all crazy?"; witty and at times very pleasant, with beautiful natural backgrounds.

title: Somebody Up There Likes Me
actors: Paul Newman, Anna Maria Pierangeli, Everett Sloane, Eileen Eckart, Sal Mineo, Harold J. Stone, Joseph Buloff, Sammy White, Arch Johnson, Robert P. Lieb
description: The schools of the young Rocco Barbella (Paul) were the street and the reformatory when, in the military prison where he is locked up for desertion, he discovers that he has a talent for boxing. With the name of Rocky Graziano, comforted by Norma's love, he begins a brilliant sports career. The trouble begins when a bad guy reveals all the details of his unedifying past, but nothing can knock out. the super champion, in and out of the ring.
notes: Robert Wise's staging is effective, nervous and fast. Newman does not have the "physique du rôle" of the Italian-American, but he knows how to remedy very well with an angry and convincing interpretation.

title: Kiss Daddy Goodnight
actors: Uma Thurman, Paul Richards, Steve Buscemi, Paul Dillon, Annabelle Gurwitch, David Brisbin, Constance Burg, Lee Coleman
description: Laura (Thurman), a beautiful and very young blonde, is hunting every night in the slums of New York: she captures her prey giving them the illusion of fiery nights of mercenary sex and, instead, drugs them and rob their apartments. A man who lives in his own building, William (Richard), obsessed with the girl who reminds him of his daughter, would like to reshape her personality. A very low-cost, technically exemplary film, the debut of its director and protagonist, Uma Thurman.

title: Laura... a 16 anni mi dicesti sì
actors: Carmelo Zappulla, Maria Romano, Biagio Pelligra, Francesca Rimbaldi, Michele Esposito, Benedetto Casillo, Gianni Ciardo, Luigi Uzzo, Salvatore Puccinelli
description: Gino, a young fisherman from Pozzuoli, is in love with Laura, but her family uses hard ways to put an end to the idyll. The two lovebirds flee to Venice, but are immediately taken back. Laura marries Tito (to save Gino from prison). A decade later, at a new meeting, Gino and Laura discover that their love is far from dormant.
notes: There are all the ingredients of the classic "drama", but the film is really poor.

title: Laura nuda
actors: Giorgia Moll, Tomas Milian, Nino Castelnuovo, Antonio Centa, Anne Vernon, Milly, Nerio Bernardi, Riccardo Garrone, Giancarlo Sbragia
description: Laura's (Moll) marriage is unhappy and loveless. Dissatisfied, the woman begins a network of relationships with various men, including an esteemed professor: but none of them turns out to be true love. So Laura is convinced that she is living a life that makes no sense whatsoever.
notes: It is one of the best beginnings of the early 1960s, when the influences of the Nouvelle Vague were also felt in Italy. Giorgia Moll and Tomas Milian are very good, the female portrait is delicate and intense.

title: Lawrence of Arabia
actors: Peter O'Toole, Alec Guinness, Anthony Quinn, Omar Sharif, Jack Hawkins, José Ferrer, Anthony Quayle, Claude Rains, Arthur Kennedy, Donald Wolfit
description: Lieutenant T.E. Lawrence, from the British Headquarters in Cairo, is sent to the Arab tribes in revolt against the Turkish government with the task of rekindling the revolt. After a very audacious action and the taking of the stronghold of Aqaba, the officer, who has assumed the local customs and mentality, becomes the charismatic guide of the Arabs who now wants to emancipate against the same interests of the English government. His exploits have created around him an aura of invincibility that conditions him psychologically, pushing him to self-harm. Having become too bulky, Lawrence is pushed aside. The Arabs, however, are now aware of their national belonging and can create a unitary state.
