notes: Life and adventures in the Middle East are framed in flashbacks starting from the motorcycle accident that cost the heroic soldier's life. Kolossal of a disputed historical character, made with breadth of means and an adventurous spirit, capable of restoring the breath and charm of the desert through extremely suggestive outdoor shots. Seven Oscars (direction, film, photography, music, set design, editing, sound). The soundtrack was a famous hit. In 1989 the complete copy (three hours and forty) was released in 70mm.

title: Lazzarella
actors: Alessandra Panaro, Terence Hill, Domenico Modugno, Rossella Como, Luigi De Filippo, Irene Tunc, Dolores Palumbo, Aurelio Fierro, Riccardo Garrone, Tina Pica
description: Luciano, a university student, falls in love with Sandra, a high school student who reciprocates his sentiment. The girl belongs to a very rich family, while Luciano's has modest means. It happens that while Sandra is on vacation in the mountains, her father is forced to go abroad following a sudden financial crisis. In desperation, Sandra accepts the marriage proposal of a rich childhood friend to come to the aid of her family.
notes: Taken from the homonymous song by Modugno and scripted by Riccardo Pazzaglia (also author of the song), a feeble compendium of sentimental clichés.

title: ¡Átame!
actors: Victoria Abril, Antonio Banderas, Francisco Rabal, Loles Leon, Maria Barranco, Rossy De Palma, Julieta Serrano, Lola Cardona
description: "Released from the asylum and alone in the world, Ricky is in love with a horror film actress, Marina. He follows her home and kidnaps her to convince her to live with him and have children together. The woman, little by little, begins to to feel attraction for that man; in the end, when they come to free her, a great love is born between the two.
notes: Two sex symbols of Spanish cinema (and not only) enter a collision course, led with winking complicity by Almodóvar. A torrid (and somewhat smug) melodrama that teaches us how even sadomasochistic can, at times, lead to a happy ending.

title: Immediate Family
actors: Glenn Close, James Woods, Mary Stuart Masterson, Kevin Dillon, Linda Darlow, Mimi Kennedy, Charles Levin, Alma Beltran, Jessica James
description: Linda and Michael Spector are an established childless professional couple. After trying them all, they turn to the punkish Lucy, a seventeen-year-old hairdresser from Seattle, who legally gives them the child she carries in her womb. The girl and Sam, her boyfriend, spend a few days in the company of the Spectors, fascinated by the jet set, and the "deal" is concluded, but after giving birth Lucy has second thoughts.
notes: Sentimentality is only the thin facade of this film, in reality merciless in the excavation of the neurosis from social status symbol that more than anything else pushes the bourgeois couple to live anxiously as missing parents.

title: Legend
actors: Tom Cruise, Mia Sara, Tim Curry, Alice Playten, David Bennent, Billy Barty, Cork Hubbert, Peter O'Farrell, Kiran Shah
description: The powerful and evil lord of Darkness to take over the Earth has decided to plunge it into the darkness of the night, erasing all traces of Good. Guarantors of Light and Good are two beautiful white unicorns who live in a clearing. Here Jack leads Princess Lili when the villains emerge who kidnap the girl and kill a unicorn. Only after a thousand ups and downs will good and light triumph. The metaphorical praise of light, in a fable that blends Shakespearean elements with Peter Pan. Extremely elaborate images and sumptuous sets make the film a luxuriant comparative study of magic, but not very exciting.

title: Criminal Law
actors: Gary Oldman, Kevin Bacon, Karen Young, Tess Harper, Joe Don Baker, Sean McCann, Ron Lea, Michael Sinelnikoff, Karen Woolridge, Ali Giron
description: Ben Chase is a brilliant lawyer who manages to get his client, the charming and astute Martin Thiel, accused of having committed some rapes and a murder, acquitted in court. Chase's plea is so convincing that the jury has no doubts. But soon the lawyer realizes that his client was really guilty and that, thanks to the acquittal, he is once again free to kill and rape.
notes: Good Canadian production thriller directed by the director of "Goldeneye", with a brilliant "judicial" start. Bacon and Oldman are engaged in a duel of prowess.

title: The Sheepman
actors: Glenn Ford, Shirley MacLaine, Leslie Nielsen, Mickey Shaughnessy, Edgar Buchanan, Willis Bouchey, Pernell Roberts, Slim Pickens, Robert 'Buzz' Henry
description: In a small village in the Far West, the big owners of cattle dominate, with Colonel Bedford as their leader. Jason arrives, a stubborn sheep farmer with an infallible gun. The man first refuses the offers that are made to him to leave the region; then he responds to threats and ambushes by putting his hand to his gun.
notes: Marshall renews the western from the inside, opening up spaces for humor and comedy. MacLaine is very young and already very good.

title: Murphy's Law
actors: Charles Bronson, Kathleen Wilhoite, Carrie Snodgress, Robert F. Lyons, Richard Romanus, Angel Tompkins, Bill Henderson, James Luisi
description: Cop Jack Murphy has no qualms when it comes to shooting, thus attracting the hatred of criminals and the antipathy of his colleagues. His wife, who left him, is murdered along with his partner and Murphy is arrested. Escaped with a thief, Arabella, he takes refuge with a former colleague who is himself killed.
notes: Film tailored for Bronson, who retrieves all the numbers of his repertoire. The film, tough and violent, can boast a decent workmanship and a good hold on suspense. Lee Thompson ("Promontory of Fear") has long been the actor's trusted director.

title: La loi c'est la loi
actors: Totò, Fernandel, Nino Besozzi, Leda Gloria, Noël Roquevert, Nathalie Nerval, Luciano Marin, Albert Dinan, Anna Maria Luciani, Henri Cremieux
description: In a border village, divided by the war between France and Italy, the Italian smuggler Giuseppe La Quaglia finds himself in constant battle with the French gendarme Fernand Pastorelli. Then one day it is discovered that Fernand was also born in Italy and then the troubles begin for him: disbarred from the weapon, investigated because bigamous and other similar things due to the legislative differences existing between the two countries.
notes: Mild and gentle satire of bureaucratic paradoxes. Something better could have come out of the meeting between the two comedians, but in some moments we laugh. The music is by Nino Rota.

title: The Legend of the Seven Golden Vampires
actors: Peter Cushing, David Chiang, Julie Ege, Robin Stewart, Shih Szu, Han Chen Wang, John Forbes-Robertson, Robert Hanna, Shen Chan
description: Van Helsing returns to the field against Dracula, reincarnated in the body of a monk, and against the seven golden vampires. The vampire-kung fu combination has not always been successful.

title: La leggenda del santo bevitore
actors: Rutger Hauer, Anthony Quayle, Sandrine Dumas, Dominique Pinon, Sophie Segalen, Jean-Maurice Chanet, Cecile Paoli, Francesco Aldighieri, Joseph De Medina
description: Andreas Kartak, a former Silesian miner expelled from his country for an involuntary murder, now lives an alcoholic under the bridges of Paris. One day a distinguished gentleman who says he is indebted to Saint Therese of Lisieux offers him two hundred francs which Andreas will have to return to the statue of the saint in the church of Batignolles. From that moment on, in Andreas's alcoholic floating world, which has begun to end, it is a succession of encounters and small miracles that prevent him from paying off his debt.
notes: Leone d'Oro in Venice in 1988, from the novel by Joseph Roth.

title: The Flame and the Arrow
actors: Burt Lancaster, Virginia Mayo, Robert Douglas, Aline MacMahon, Frank Allenby, Nick Cravat, Lynn Baggett, Gordon Gebert, Norman Lloyd
description: Ulrich Count of Hess, Barbarossa's lieutenant, rules the Lombard territory with an iron fist. Dardo, a brave hunter, whose wife betrayed him with the count, leads the revolt of the peasants against the Germanic oppressor.
notes: Good adventure movie related to the exploits of Robin Hood. Lancaster unleashed as Dardo.

title: X-15
actors: David McLean, Charles Bronson, James Gregory, Ralph Taeger, Brad Dexter, Kenneth Tobey, Mary Tyler Moore, Patricia Owens, Lisabeth Hush, Stanley Livingston
description: Matt, Lee and Ernie are three expert drivers who have a good flight experience. Their goal is to pilot on the borders of space the X-15 a device that flies to four thousand miles per hour. The aviation psychologist Tony Rinaldi tries to resolve their personal conflicts so that they can face their task in the best way. Matt's wife is embittered by the importance that her husband gives to the success of the company and fears to become a widow. Lee and hernie companions look quiet enough. One day, however, Lee dies in an accident ...
notes: Good suspense film, even if a little rhetorical in its propaganda plant for NASA. James Stewart is the narrator.

title: La legione dei dannati
actors: Jack Palance, Tom Hunter, Robert Hundar, Wolfang Preiss, Curd Jürgens, Helmuth Schneider, Guido Lollobrigida, Aldo Sambrell, Diana Lorys, Franco Fantasia
description: In 1944, to prepare for the Normandy landings, an allied commando was tasked with blowing up a powerful cannon placed on the French coast. But the raiders are easily defeated by the enemies and Colonel Anderson, who initially only had to clear a stretch of sea with some divers, decides to complete the mission with his men.
notes: Effective war film directed by a B-series director who knows his stuff but who too often exceeds in effects. The thing that convinces the most is the screenplay by Dario Argento, at the time film critic ready to take flight in the cinema.

title: Légitime Violence
actors: Claude Brasseur, Thierry Lhermitte, Véronique Genest, Roger Planchon, Michel Aumont, Plastic Bertrand, Pierre Michael, Francis Lemarque, Christian Bouillette, Christopher Lambert
description: A robbery at a station degenerates into a massacre that decimates Martin's family. The latter, intolerant of the slowness of the investigation, decides to proceed alone. Cold and complicated, the film smuggles a critical reflection on private justice that doesn't really find space.

title: Quai des Orfèvres
actors: Louis Jouvet, Bernard Blier, Suzy Delair, Simone Renant, Pierre Larquey, Jeanne Fusier-Gir, Claudine Dupuis, Charles Dullin, Henri Arius
description: Jenny, singer of the variety, loves her husband Maurizio dearly, but when he discovers that she has accepted an invitation to an old libertine's house, she goes there with determination. However, he finds the elderly pleasure-seeker dead. Now begins the investigation conducted by Inspector Antoine, who will be able to solve the very intricate and complex case, also having to change his mind about Maurizio's guilt.
notes: More than the intrigue, which is anything but trivial, what counts is the atmosphere, which Clouzot's direction masterfully renders, and the great interpretations of the actors. Not for nothing, the film is considered a classic of French thriller.

title: Me and Him
actors: Griffin Dunne, Ellen Greene, Craig T. Nelson, Kelly Bishop, Carey Lowell, Kim Flowers, Bill Raymond, David Alan Grier, Kara Glover, Rocco Sisto
description: A young New York architect is going through a professional and marital crisis. One day, he hears a voice and realizes that it is his sex that speaks to him. "He" advises him to give himself mad joy, but the cure will prove worse than the disease. It is not the first time that Alberto Moravia's novel "Me and He" has been brought to the screen, but also the German Doris Dörrie ("Men") fails like her predecessors Salce and Buzzanca. Satire doesn't work; Griffin Dunne is wasted.

title: Leningrad Cowboys Go America
actors: Matti Pellonpää, Nicky Tesco, Jim Jarmusch, Sakke Jarvenpää, Kari Väänänen, Heikki Keskinen, Pimme Korhonen, Sakari Kuosmanen, Puka Oinonen
description: A rockabilly group called the Leningrad Cowboys decides to try their luck in America. In the hands of an unreliable agent, the boys travel to Mexico and succeed. A film built with ineffable humor in the manner of comic strips.

title: Léon Morin, prêtre
actors: Emmanuelle Riva, Jean-Paul Belmondo, Irene Tunc, Nicole Mirel, Gisèle Grimm, Marco Behar, Monique Bertho, Marc Eyraud
description: In Besançon, during the German occupation, Barny, a young Jewish widow of the Marxist faith, enters a church to confess. The intent is to provoke the priest, but he, young and intelligent, establishes a frank and open dialogue with her. The woman falls in love with the priest, regains her faith and resumes her life.
notes: Melville is particularly involved in the subject: he, of Jewish origin but educated in Catholicism, questions the relationship between secularism and faith with a rare participation in such films. In the end it reaches heights of unprecedented sensitivity. Belmondo's role is unusual.

title: Leonard Part 6
actors: Bill Cosby, Tom Courtenay, Joe Don Baker, Moses Gunn, Pat Colbert, Gloria Foster, Victoria Rowell, Anna Thomson, Grace Zabriskie
description: Leonard Parker, a former FBI agent, is hastily called back to service to face a frightening invasion of murderous animals. Who unleashed them? How to deal with and eradicate them? In short, Leonard identifies a gang that, through futuristic equipment, trains and conditions animals in order to conquer the world. The fight is uneven, but in the end Leonard wins in a daring way.
notes: Miserable parody of the 007 saga, as inconsistent as its title is bombastic. Cosby is better on TV ("The Robinsons").

title: The Lion in Winter
actors: Peter O'Toole, Katharine Hepburn, Jane Merrow, Anthony Hopkins, John Castle, Nigel Terry, Timothy Dalton, Nigel Stock, O.Z. Whitehead
description: Towards the end of the year 1183, Henry II, king of England, is concerned about the succession to the throne. He summons his wife, Eleonora of Aquitaine, his three children, his favorite and Philip King of France. The ensuing clash is violent, intrigues are unleashed. Finally, the (partial) winner will be Eleonora.
notes: The historic fresco is well defined, with attention to detail and an atmosphere saturated with violence. For her Eleanor of Aquitaine, Katharine Hepburn won the Oscar (two more went to the screenplay and soundtrack).

title: Il leone di Tebe
actors: Mark Forest, Yvonne Furneaux, Massimo Serato, Rosalba Neri, Pierre Cressoy, Enzo Fiermonte, Alberto Lupo, Nerio Bernardi, Carlo Tamberlani, Nello Pazzafini, Alberto Lupo
description: Ramses wants to give the throne of Egypt to Helen, whom he welcomed to Thebes with Menelaus and the faithful Spartan Arion, fleeing from Troy. Tutmes kills the pharaoh and blames the Spartans, but Arion manages to escape him and restore peace and justice. Incredible historical-mythological fantasies of Ferroni, a talented documentary maker who has also written several honest genre films (A punctured dollar, 1965).

title: Les Girls
actors: Gene Kelly, Mitzi Gaynor, Kay Kendall, Taina Elg, Jacques Bergerac, Leslie Phillips, Henry Daniell, Patrick Macnee, Stephen Vercoe
description: Joy, Angela, Sibilla and Barry, interpreters of "Les Girls", a musical comedy that has been around Europe, find themselves reunited in London, after many years, in a courtroom. A legal proceeding is underway following a libel suit that the French Angela filed against Sibilla. The latter has published a book of memories in which she mentioned the relations of the manager with each of the three actresses who were part of the company.
notes: Hate and rancor in a sort of "Rashomon" musical that delves into the world of entertainment. Songs by Cole Porter and great direction by Cukor, refined and visionary. Oscar for costumes by Olly-Kelly.

title: Una lettera all'alba
actors: Fosco Giachetti, Olga Villi, Lea Padovani, Jacques Sernas, Tatyana Pavlova, Margherita Bagni, Franca Marzi, Vittorio Sanipoli, Salvo Randone, Ernesto Calindri, Nerio Bernardi
description: In one go, Carlo discovers not only that he has a son, the result of an ancient relationship, but also that the boy is a cocaine dealer. Desperate, he tries to help him especially when he is accused of the murder of a countess. Once his son is proven innocent, Carlo has him board a ship so that he can rebuild a life elsewhere. All this without ever revealing that he is his father. The reference to drugs is not deceiving: this is not a thriller, but a melodrama. It is also the film that reveals Olga Villi to the cinema who, although young, already had a decent theatrical career behind her. Every two hours until 11pm

title: Letter from an Unknown Woman
actors: Joan Fontaine, Louis Jourdan, Mady Christians, Marcel Journet, Art Smith, Carol Yorke, Howard Freeman, John Good
description: A woman falls in love with a pianist, her neighbor. The man, however, ignores her. Years later the musician meets the girl without recognizing her. This time things are better and love finally breaks out between the two. Despite the birth of a child, the woman ends up marrying a wealthy aristocrat. But one day his old love comes back.
notes: Great Ophuls film, more than a director an evocator of visual symphonies. It has a US license plate but there is an air of Central Europe, dropped into a fictitious Vienna, rebuilt in the studio but equally extraordinary. When the "beauty" is truer than the truth. Breathtaking Joan Fontaine.

title: Stanley & Iris
actors: Robert De Niro, Jane Fonda, Martha Plimpton, Fëdor Chaliapin jr., Swoosie Kurtz, Harley Cross, Jamey Sheridan, Zohra Lampert, Loretta Devine
description: Iris works as a worker in a candy factory. She is left a widow with two children to support, and has other relatives weighing on her budget. He meets Stanley, a shy cook, unable to even spell his name because, the son of a peddler, he has never been able to attend school. Precisely because he is illiterate, Stanley is fired. Love is born between the two, reinforced (but at times also endangered) by the further relationship that is created between them, that of teacher and disciple: in fact, Iris is the teacher of Stanley who learns hard to read and write. After much humiliation, the man secures a prestigious job and offers his hand to Iris, after having written her passionate love letters.
notes: Two giants of American cinema demonstrate how an obvious relationship can be reinvented also because Ritt, who has linked his name to numerous social films, favors the factor of the "halved" personality due to lack of education.

title: Letti sbagliati
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Ingeborg Schöner, Aldo Giuffré, Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Carlo Giuffrè, Raimondo Vianello, Beba Loncar
description: In a dining car, three occasional traveling companions are betting that they will be able to conquer women. One of them, who proves reluctant, will end up being winked at by a beautiful traveler. An engineer attracted by the graces of a roommate, devises a complicated plan to be with the woman alone in the elevator. A provincial is sued for his clumsy approaches to a traveling companion. Ciccio lives with the nagging memory of his wife's devoted fidelity.
notes: Episode movies. The comedy, seasoned with beauties of the moment, remains low-level.

title: Letto a tre piazze
actors: Totò, Peppino De Filippo, Nadia Gray, Cristina Gaioni, Aroldo Tieri, Gabriele Tinti, Angela Luce, Cesare Fantoni, Paolo Ferrara, Mario Castellani
description: Amelia celebrates the tenth anniversary of her marriage (the second for her) with Peppino, when Antonio reappears, her first spouse believed to have died in Russia during the war. Therefore the union with Peppino is not valid, but perhaps not even that with Antonio. Endless fights and the woman's third marriage after her two previous husbands perish in a plane crash. Then, the last surprise.
notes: One of the most classic farces, adapted by Steno without much imagination. There are still Totò and Peppino.

title: Pillow Talk
actors: Rock Hudson, Doris Day, Tony Randall, Thelma Ritter, Nick Adams, Julia Meade, Allen Jenkins, Marcel Dalio, Lee Patrick, Mary McCarty
description: Jean is an interior designer, Brad is a musician. They have never seen each other but they struggle to use the duplex telephone they have in common. A man, in love with the girl, reveals to the two the mutual identity to drive them away: in fact the two met by chance and liked each other. But love is stronger than hate.
notes: Because of her simple and discreet charm, Doris Day was called in America "the girl next door". Everyone liked it. For Rock Hudson, women from all over the world went crazy. In this comedy of misunderstandings, both of them can be really funny.

title: Leviathan
actors: Peter Weller, Richard Crenna, Amanda Pays, Meg Foster, Daniel Stern, Ernie Hudson, Michael Carmine, Lisa Eilbacher, Hector Elizondo, Eugene Lipinski
description: Six men and two women work quietly on the ocean floor, are employed by a multinational and extract minerals aboard a sophisticated submarine. While working they come across the wreck of a Russian ship and immediately unexplained and terrible mutations occur. The secret is in a bottle of vodka: toxic substances have been injected into it.
notes: An Italian-American production film that uses an avalanche of special effects by proposing a variation of monster films in a new physical space: the underwater world. But Cosmatos is a director with no imagination and the product is banal and old.

title: Hide in Plain Sight
actors: James Caan, Kenneth McMillan, Joseph Sommer, Danny Aiello, Jill Eikenberry, Robert Viharo, Joe Grifasi, Barbra Rae, Thomas Hill, Chuck Hicks
description: Thomas Hacklin is divorced from his wife Ruthie and only sees his two children on weekends. Ruthie has remarried to a half-delinquent, one who gets caught during a robbery and then agrees to testify against the Mafia. As a result, the family is placed under protection and Thomas will never be able to see his children again. It is useless to resort to legal means because the interests of the authorities are above the affections: between the reticence of the policemen, bureaucratic and legal delays, obstacles of all kinds, the years pass.
notes: James Caan's interesting directorial debut, based on an episode that actually happened.

title: The Legend of Nigger Charley
actors: Fred Williamson, D'Urville Martin, Don Pedro Colley, Thomas Anderson, Jerry Gatlin, Alan Gifford, Will Hussung, Gertrude Jeannette
description: Charley is a slave for Mr. Carter who, on his deathbed, grants him his freedom. Of the opposite opinion is Huston, an employee of Carter, who in any case ends up killed by Charley himself, albeit in self-defense. At that point Charley escapes, but is chased by Nyls Fuller, a bounty hunter. Racial Western of pure profession, and with almost televised flatness.

title: S.E.R. - Svoboda eto rai
actors: Volodya Koryzev, Alexander Bureyev, Svetlana Gaytan, Vitautas Tokus, Sergei Bodrov, Vladimir Kosyrev, Luiza Mosendz, Kseniya Nazarova
description: Sacha, 13 years old, lives in an institute for misfitty children. He is an orphan of his mother and he father of him is held in a penitentiary. The boy, who has already fled several times by the institute, knows where his father is imprisoned, in the distant region of Archangel, in the extreme northern of Russia. Sacha manages to reach him and live a few hours with him. The future, perhaps, will be better for both. Bodrov's film won the "Grand-Prix of America" ​​at the Montreal Festival. The boy, Volodya Kozyrev, was truly a guest of a reformed and "lived" his role with a particular participation, which benefits the sincerity of the story.

title: The Jungle Book
actors: Sabu, Joseph Calleia, John Qualen, Rosemary DeCamp, Frank Puglia, Patricia O'Rourke, Ralph Byrd, John Mather, Faith Brook
description: Mowgli, in the course of the Shere Kan tiger hunt, finds a lost temple in the jungle and a fabulous treasure. Buldeo, a village chief, steals one of the precious stones, but is forced to abandon it to avoid the curse.
notes: Fascinating film, loosely based on Kipling's book; phantasmagoric colors, grandiose scenographies and a famous score by Miklos Rozsa contribute to an enchanting illustration, signed by a great specialist in exotic cinema. The protagonist is the young Sabu, discovered by Robert Flaherty in the "Dance of the elephants" (1937).

title: La liceale, il diavolo e l'acquasanta
actors: Gloria Guida, Lino Banfi, Alvaro Vitali, Tiberio Murgia, Pippo Santonastaso, Ernst Thole, Rosanna Salviati, Claudio Saint-Just
description: A guardian angel falls in love with a beautiful dancer, who, however, prefers an earthly love to him. A policeman sees his wife threatened by a transvestite who has converted to heterosexuality. A dental technician sells his soul to the devil, but he is not satisfied: he also wants his body. Three episodes for three regular performers of the scollacciata comedy: the blonde Gloria Guida and the wild Banfi and Vitali. None of the three, however, is in great shape and the jokes full of double meanings and vulgarity hardly ever make you laugh.

title: La liceale nella classe dei ripetenti
actors: Gloria Guida, Alvaro Vitali, Lino Banfi, Gianfranco D'Angelo, Rodolfo Bigotti, Sylvain Chamarande, Carlo Sposito, Nello Pazzafini, Jimmy il Fenomeno
description: Angela (Guida) studies in the same high school where her father (Banfi) teaches. She is a beautiful girl and although her boyfriend Tonino (Vitali) is not exactly an Adonis, she insists on being faithful to him. But when she discovers that she has been betrayed repeatedly, she decides to take revenge by giving herself to Carlo, who has been in love with her for a lifetime.
notes: It is traditional to mistreat directors like Mariano Laurenti for films like these. Even if or from the day we read that a film like "That big piece of Ubalda all naked and all hot" is considered a cult by many, perhaps we should be more cautious.

title: Liebestraum
actors: Kevin Anderson, Pamela Gidley, Kim Novak, Bill Pullman, Graham Beckel, Zach Grenier, Thomas Kopache, Jack Wallace, Taina Elg
description: A critic who works in an architecture magazine, Nick Kaminsky, returns to his hometown to meet his dying mother, whom he has not seen since he was a child. Meet an old college friend of his, Paul and his wife Jane. Nick and Jane become lovers and discover that behind the story of a building that is about to be demolished, there is a plot of crime that involves them. It is a film about the inevitability of fate and the persistence of memory directed with a happy hand by Mike Figgis (Family Affairs).

title: The Happy Ending
actors: Jean Simmons, John Forsythe, Lloyd Bridges, Teresa Wright, Shirley Jones, Dick Shawn, Nanette Fabray, Bobby Darin, Tina Louise
description: Mary Wilson is a quiet lady, happy bride and mother, with a beautiful house, a lovely daughter, a beautiful car. But one day something inside her breaks: she takes a plane and leaves for the Bahamas. Here she tries to reflect on her life that seems to her to have been useless, in the meantime experiencing some futile and unsatisfactory adventure. Disappointed, she returns to Denver where she tries to resume a normal life.
notes: The story of this woman, of a harsh and rough, almost unbearable realism, anticipated some feminist themes but had no commercial success. The interpretation of Jean Simmons is splendid.

title: Lili
actors: Leslie Caron, Mel Ferrer, Jean-Pierre Aumont, Zsa Zsa Gabor, Kurt Kasznar, Amanda Blake, Alex Gerry, Ralph Dumke, Wilton Graff, George Baxter
description: Lili, orphaned, leaves her hometown and moves to the city, where she hopes to find work with a friend of her deceased father. When she learns that he too is dead, the girl finds herself in serious trouble, but one day, she meets Marco, a magician who gets her a job as a waitress. Poor Lili, however, is too careless and ends up being fired. Desperate attempts to commit suicide, but a man distracts her from her intent.
notes: Leslie Caron's ballet, fresh from her successful debut in "An American in Paris" with puppets is a little classic. The film won the Oscar for Kaper's music.

title: Blood Warriors
actors: David Bradley, Frank Zagarino, Jennifer Campbell, Frans Tumbuan, Dicky Zulkarnaen, Pitradjaya Burnama, Diaz Tangkilisan, Joe Simpson
description: Former Marine Wes visits his old friend Keith. He finds Karen, his sister, who informs him of his death and leads him to the funeral. Here is a certain Jurgen who spits on Keith's grave, accusing him of stealing millions of dollars from him. What is more, Karen falls in love with the former marine, who then promises to take her away with him. But first come Jurgen's men. Wes, of course, is not idle, but in an attempt to free her he nibbles in a group of "commandos" who again precede him; even more surprising it will be to find out who their boss is ...
notes: Not enough for you? Then check out the rest as well. And best wishes.

title: Staroye i novoye
actors: Marfa Lapkina, Vasja Buzenkov, Kostja Vasil'ev, Michail Ivanin, Nejnikov, Chukamaryev, Ivan Yudin
description: 1920s, in a village of the USSR: a peasant woman does not have a horse to plow; a party member unsuccessfully proposes a cooperative, which buys a tractor and a bull. The peasants are now joining. The harvest begins ...
notes: Pedagogical work that exalts rural collectivization and the vitality of the revolution.

title: Link
actors: Elisabeth Shue, Terence Stamp, Steven Finch, Richard Garnett, David O'Hara, Kevin Lloyd, Joe Belcher
description: In a mansion live an anthropologist, Steven, his assistant Jane and three monkeys, on which the doctor is conducting research. Two of them begin to show signs of imbalance, and the professor keeps them locked in the laboratory. One night the girl discovers that Steven has disappeared.
notes: Franklin is obsessed with Hitchcock. He directed "Psycho II", and cast Ray Berwick (who was behind the birds in Hitchcock's film of the same name). Other than that, he's not a bad director.

title: Lionheart
actors: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Deborah Rennard, Harrison Page, Lisa Pelikan, Brian Thompson, Ashley Johnson, Voyo Goric
description: Enlisted in the Foreign Legion, Lyon defects and flies to Los Angeles to rescue his brother in trouble with some drug traffickers, but finds him dead. While his sister-in-law and granddaughter hold him responsible for what happened, the defector fights against a cheat in the world of kickboxing and against two bad guys from the Legion who want to bring him back at any cost.
notes: The lack of originality of the story is redeemed by the fast pace of the action and by the use of some beautiful fight scenes. Belgian Van Damme (now adopted by Hollywood) will again be a legionnaire in Peter MacDonald's "The Legionary".

title: Lisa dagli occhi blu
actors: Mario Tessuto, Silvia Dionisio, Vittorio Congia, Piero Mazzarella, Mario Carotenuto, Bice Valori, Peppino De Filippo, Nino Taranto, Erminio Macario, Carlo Dapporto, Ric, Gian, Carlo Taranto, Marisa Merlini, Gordon Mitchell, Pietro De Vico, Walter Brugiolo
description: To pay for his university studies, Mario (Mario Tessuto) teaches, is a tour guide, sells encyclopedias and sings in a nightclub. His most whimsical pupil is Lisa, who does not fail to target the shy teacher with jokes of all kinds. When, due to a joke, Lisa, who is the daughter of an industrialist, causes some economic damage to Mario, she realizes that she was foolish and she also understands that she loves him. A sudden financial collapse of her father causes Lisa to agree to marry the wealthy Luca, but the happiness of the two lovers is only postponed.
notes: Silly comedy hastily set up as the frame of the songs by Mario Tessuto, at the time at the top of the hit parade.

title: Little Rita nel West
actors: Rita Pavone, Terence Hill, Teddy Reno, Gordon Mitchell, Lucio Dalla, Nina Larker, Pinuccio Ardia, Kirk Morris, Fernando Sancho
description: Having identified the root of the world's evils in gold, Little Rita expends her skills as a gunslinger in robbing bandits. Then she hides the swag in a mine to blow it up, with the complicity of a young cowboy who has fallen in love with her.
notes: One of the bad films packaged in a hurry to exploit the musical success of Rita Pavone. Among the secondary performers: Terence Hill, Teddy Reno and Lucio Dalla. Years later it is not even valid as a document of customs.

title: Local Hero
actors: Burt Lancaster, Peter Riegert, Fulton MacKay, Peter Capaldi, Denis Lawson, Norman Chancer, Rikki Fulton, Alex Norton, Jenny Seagrove
description: Felix Happer, a powerful Houston oilman, plans to build a colossal refinery on a stretch of the Scottish coast. He sends one of his young officials to take care of the purchase of the land for the operation. But he stops in front of the last owner who doesn't want to know about selling.
notes: An ecological fable, whose satirical tone and happy final utopia refer to the cinema of Frank Capra. After a brisk start, the pace relaxes a bit, but overall, however, the film is humorous and captivating. Beautiful (and famous) music by Mark Knopfler.

title: The Inn of the Sixth Happiness
actors: Ingrid Bergman, Curd Jürgens, Robert Donat, Michael David, Athene Seyler, Ronald Squire, Moultrie Kelsall, Richard Wattis, Peter Chong
description: A young Protestant missionary, Gladys, reaches her mission in the country of When Chen in China. Here, to encourage contacts with the population, the missionaries have opened a place called "The Inn of the Sixth Happiness". Gladys wins the Mandarin's trust with her social activities. When the Japanese troops arrive, while everyone is fleeing, Gladys collects her orphans and with a long march on the mountains, saves them.
notes: A tear-jerking movie where, together with the portrait of the missionary, an accurate description of the Chinese environment and life prevail. Excellent interpretation of Ingrid Bergman.

title: La locandiera
actors: Claudia Mori, Adriano Celentano, Paolo Villaggio, Gianni Cavina, Marco Messeri, Lorenza Guerrieri, Milena Vukotic, Camillo Milli, Paolo Baroni, Lucio Montanaro, Roberto Della Casa
description: Mirandolina runs an inn in the Veneto region in the eighteenth century. Among the patrons there is the rough knight of Ripafratta, declared an enemy of women; but Mirandolina's charms make him change his mind. However, it is a deception, as the woman is promised to another lover.
notes: Based on the comedy of the same name by Goldoni, the film is a strange opportunity for the Celentano-Mori couple and the result is moderately funny, even for some musical numbers and the presence of good supporting actors, from Gianni Cavina to a notable Paolo Villaggio, penniless and fearful marquis of Roccaverdina.

title: Lolita
actors: James Mason, Peter Sellers, Sue Lyon, Shelley Winters, Gary Cockrell, Jerry Stovin, Diana Decker, Lois Maxwell, Cec Linder, Bill Greene
description: "Teacher Humbert, staying with widow Haze, marries her to be close to his teenage daughter, with whom he is in love. When Haze dies, Humbert finally gets together with the girl and travels with her across the United States. Lolita disappears; reappears three years later, married and pregnant.
notes: A masterpiece by Kubrick from 1962, one of his most lucid (in the narrative construction) and cynical (in the representation of bourgeois America and the moral misery of the characters) films. The character of Quilty in the interpretation of Peter Sellers is brilliant.

title: Londra chiama Polo Nord
actors: Curd Jürgens, Dawn Addams, Folco Lulli, René Deltgen, Philippe Hersent, Dario Michaelis, Albert Lieven, Lauro Gazzolo, Matteo Spinola, Giacomo Rossi Stuart
description: In 1943, Colonel Bernes of the German counter-intelligence manages to locate the underground North Pole station in Amsterdam, which transmits information to London. Meanwhile, the English agent Landers is arrested, and in exchange for his life, he allows himself to continue the broadcasts, convinced that, in any case, London will learn of his capture.
notes: Film by our Duilio Coletti who, despite the scarcity of economic means, tries to rival international "war movies". On his side a respectable cast with a regular like that: Curd Jürgens, obviously in the part of the Nazi.

title: Looker
actors: Albert Finney, James Coburn, Susan Dey, Leigh Taylor-Young, Dorian Harewood, Tim Rossovich, Darryl Hickman, Kathryn Witt, Terri Welles
description: A plastic surgeon (Albert Finney) uncovers a diabolical plot to clone models for TV commercials. Fantastic thriller without quality, directed by the novelist of "Jurassic Park" and "Congo".

title: Looney, Looney, Looney Bugs Bunny Movie
description: The film collects an anthology of the most beautiful adventures played by the most famous characters of the Warner Cartoon. The crazy rabbit Bugs Bunni is entrusted with the various curtains that intersperse the real stories that have as protagonists, among others, Porky Pig, the stammering pig, Sylvester Cat always struggling with the canary Tweety and the same Bugs Bunny, timeless troublemaker .

title: Lord Jim
actors: Peter O'Toole, James Mason, Curd Jürgens, Eli Wallach, Jack Hawkins, Paul Lukas, Daliah Lavi, Akim Tamiroff
description: Jim finds work on a ship that transports pilgrims to Mecca. During a shipwreck, he abandons the ship to his fate and is radiated; later, while looking for a new job, he receives a difficult assignment: helping an Indian tribe harassed by outlaws. In their village, the natives adore him and with him they perform many feats: he will be able to repel the onslaught of bandits, but ...
notes: Joseph Conrad's novel finds an excellent cinematic reduction, full of charm and respectful of the complex philosophy that underlies the literary work. The cast is nothing short of luxurious, with the British O'Toole and Mason above all.

title: The Blue Knight
actors: William Holden, Lee Remik, Joe Santos, Eileen Brennan, Emile Meyer, Sam Elliott, Vic Tayback, Anne Archer, Lucille Benson
description: Bill Bumper Morgan (Holden) is a veteran of the LAPD now close to retirement. The murder of a prostitute, his confidant, puts him back on track. His best friend also dies in the course of the investigation. Originally made in four parts of one hour each, then reissued in a single two-hour film, it is the adaptation of a best-seller written by former policeman Joseph Wanbaugh. First television production for William Holden, perfect interpreter of the mature policeman and winner of an Emmy.

title: Fight for Life
actors: Jerry Lewis, Morgan Freeman, Patty Duke, Barry Morse, Jaclyn Bernstein, Gerard Parkes, James Bearden, Robert Benson, Eve Crawford
description: A dentist leads a quiet life with his wife and daughter. One day their peace is disturbed by a bolt from the blue: the girl has a severe form of epilepsy for which she risks dying. From that moment on, the man and the woman devote all their efforts to snatch their daughter from death. TV melodrama without surprises, in which Jerry Lewis plays a decidedly dramatic part, as already in Scorsese's "King for a Night". The director is Elliot Silverstein, best known for "A man called a horse", but later passed almost exclusively to TV.

title: Hibernatus
actors: Louis De Funès, Michael Lonsdale, Claude Gensac, Olivier De Funès, Bernard Alane, Annick Alane, Eliette Demay, Martine Kelly, Jacques Legras, Pascal Mazzotti
description: Shipwrecked in 1905, Paul Fournier is found hibernating in the Arctic ice and brought back to life. For very venal reasons, the industrialist Hubert de Tartas, husband of one of Paul's nieces, decides to host him. In order not to make him suffer a fatal shock, however, he is forced to surround his grandfather, biologically 25, of the Belle Epoque environment from which he comes.
notes: The very unequal Molinaro finds perhaps the best measure in farcical comedies like this one. De Funès father (Louis) and son (Olivier) replicate the kinship on set, as Hubert and Didier de Tartas.

title: Love Story
actors: Ali MacGraw, Ryan O'Neal, Ray Milland, John Marley, Russell Nype, Katharine Balfour, Sydney Walker, Robert Modica, Walker Daniels, Tommy Lee Jones
description: Oliver, the son of a very wealthy financier, and Jenny, the daughter of a pastry chef of Italian origin, meet in the university library. They hang out, they fall in love. Despite his father's ban, Oliver marries Jenny. The two work hard and achieve moderate well-being, but shortly thereafter, Jenny is diagnosed with leukemia which soon leads to her death.
notes: "Love Story" represented, according to criticism, one of the most conventional and retrospective moments of cinematographic sentimentalism. However, to the spectators the film liked: perhaps precisely because of the river of tears that made them pour. Oscar to the famous music by Francis Lai. It should be noted that the novel of the same name of Eric Segal was written starting from his script and therefore is following the film.

title: I Love You
actors: Christopher Lambert, Eddy Mitchell, Anémone, Flora Barillaro, Agnès Soral, Marc Berman, Patrice Bertrand, Paula Dehelly, Maurizio Donadoni
description: The obsessive relationship between Michel and his keychain, one of those gadgets that respond to the whistle with the phrase "I Love You". An out of shape Ferreri.

title: Luca il contrabbandiere
actors: Fabio Testi, Marcel Bozzuffi, Ivana Monti, Saverio Marconi, Enrico Maisto, Ferdinando Murolo, Fabrizio Jovine, Daniele Dublino, Guido Alberti, Venantino Venantini
description: In Naples, the brothers Luca and Michele are owners of boats and motorboats with which they do smuggling. United by kinship, they find themselves embroiled on opposite sides in a war between bosses. Western tones, scripted setting, horror effects.

title: Lucas
actors: Corey Haim, Kerri Green, Charlie Sheen, Winona Ryder, Courtney Thorne-Smith, Tom Hodges, Ciro Poppiti, Guy Boyd, Jeremy Piven
description: It is the delicate story of a teenage love affair of a fourteen-year-old prodigy for a schoolmate, two years older. Lucas, sensitive and delicate, does not find anything better than to devote himself body and soul to the beautiful Maggie, in turn a victim of the charm of the captain of the football team. But for the girl Lucas is willing to risk his life.
notes: Not bad, even for the presence, in a minor role, of Winona Ryder. Of course: the game of the love chase is not exactly very original (he loves her, who loves another), but the film also redeems itself for the delicacy of the tones with which the emergence of the loving identity is represented.

title: Light of Day
actors: Michael J. Fox, Gena Rowlands, Joan Jett, Michael McKean, Thomas G. Waites, Cherry Jones, Michael Dolan, Paul J. Harkins, Billy L. Sullivan, Jason Miller
description: Brother and sister workers by day, they play in a rock band in the evening. Relations with the parents and with each other are strained: only the death of the mother from cancer will bring them together. A flop in the beautiful Schraderian filmography, perhaps because it is too tinged with melancholy. It's not bad though, and Fox is credible.

title: Nobody Lives Forever
actors: John Garfield, Geraldine Fitzgerald, Walter Brennan, Faye Emerson, George Coulouris, George Tobias, Robert Shayne, Richard Gaines, Richard Erdman
description: Nick, a veteran, is involved by some friends of the past in a big blow against a young and rich widow. Without too much enthusiasm the man accepts, but fate wants him to fall in love, reciprocated, precisely with his victim. The angry cronies kidnap the woman, carrying out their vile blackmail. Garfield, the "Jean Gabin of the Bronx" as he liked to call himself, plays one of his favorite roles here. Negulesco was almost a rookie director at the time, but destined for a fast career in comedy and melò, but he didn't have a great hand in noir.

title: City Lights
actors: Charles Chaplin, Virginia Cherrill, Florence Lee, Harry Myers, Al Ernest Garcia, Hank Mann
description: Charlot buys a rose from a young blind florist who, due to a misunderstanding, mistakes it for a millionaire. Wandering around the city, Charlot arrives on the pier where he saves the real millionaire from suicide. Determined to help the flower girl, in need of an expensive surgery that would restore her sight, Charlot does a thousand jobs, including a boxer.
notes: One of Chaplin's masterpieces, who shot something like a hundred thousand meters of film, repeating entire sequences until he reached perfection. Apparently fragmented into sketches, the film instead maintains its own intimate unity thanks to the painfully romantic tone that pervades it.

title: Luci lontane
actors: Tomas Milian, Laura Morante, William Berger, Giacomo Piperno, Susanna Martinkova, Mirella Falco, David Flosi, Alberto Capone, Isabella Illiers
description: A widower recently, Bernardo lives in a Romagna spa town with his mother-in-law and son Giuliano. One evening the latter tells of having met his mother, and the man - influenced by a series of curious circumstances - almost ends up believing him. But Renata, Giuliano's teacher, worried about the child's strange behavior, decides to lend a hand to Bernardo ...
notes: From a novel by Giuseppe Pederiali, Chiesa co-plays and directs an unusual plot with paranormal resonances, vaguely indebted to the first Avati and completely unnoticed: although a little unsolved, it might have deserved a better fate.

title: Lucia di Lammermoor
actors: Nelly Corradi, Afro Poli, Mario Filippeschi, Aldo Ferracuti, Loretta Di Lelio, Italo Tajo, Adelio Zagonara
description: In 17th-century England, Lucia is in love with Edgardo, but their respective families have been fighting for years. Lucia's brother, by deception, then makes Lucia believe that Edgardo is cheating on her and forces her to marry another. Edgardo, informed of the marriage, arrives at the castle on his wedding day and curses Lucia who, maddened by grief, kills her husband and dies. Edgardo at the news of the death of his beloved Lucia kills himself in turn.
notes: Mediocre reduction of Donizetti's work, marked by a bad sound. In the forties the films taken from famous operas had a moderate success, as, twenty years later, on the TV of the Rai monopoly, the "dramas" from equally famous novels.

title: Luciano Serra pilota
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, Germana Paolieri, Roberto Villa, Mario Ferrari, Guglielmo Sinaz, Egisto Olivieri, Andrea Checchi
description: The First World War is over and the army pilot Luciano Serra moves to South America as he no longer has faith in the redemption capabilities of his homeland. When he learns that Italy has invaded Abyssinia, Serra enlists under a false name and manages to save, with a reckless mission, the life of his son, also a volunteer.
notes: Awarded as the best Italian film in Venice in 1938, it is one of the most famous examples of fascist propaganda. In fact he is very successful in the spectacular parts and the script is positively affected by the collaboration of the very young Roberto Rossellini.

title: Lucrezia Borgia
actors: Martine Carol, Pedro Armendariz, Massimo Serato, Valentine Tessier, Arnoldo Foà, Piéral, Christian Marquand, Tania Fédor, Jean d'Yd, Maurice Ronet
description: In spite of her turbulent past, in which she has put the weapons of seduction at the service of her brother Cesare's intrigues, Lucrezia Borgia sincerely falls in love with Alfonso of Aragon, whom her brother assigns as her husband for reasons of political alliance. But his feelings will not prevent the unscrupulous Caesar from disposing of his ally, once he has become useless and dangerous. The film achieves its best results in terms of spectacularity, with generous use of sumptuous sets and sumptuous costumes, without neglecting the rhythm of the action and seasoning everything with some erotic suggestion.

title: Pat and Mike
actors: Spencer Tracy, Katharine Hepburn, Aldo Ray, William Ching, Sammy White, George Mathews, Charles Bronson, Jim Backus
description: Katharine Hepburn, a gym teacher, could be a golf champion if her fiancé, a snooty professor of literature, didn't do everything to send her into a crisis by constantly blaming her for her intellectual inferiority. The solution is found, unpredictable, when the teacher finds a handsome and understanding coach (Spencer Tracy). Jealousies, anger, quarrels and so on, but true feelings, in the end ...
notes: A pleasant comedy with the couple Tracy / Hepburn, it is not one of the director's masterpieces. Also in the cast is a young Charles Bronson.

title: Partners
actors: Ryan O'Neal, John Hurt, Kenneth McMillan, Robyn Douglass, Jay Robinson, Denise Galik, Joseph R. Sicari, Michael McGuire, Rick Jason, James Remar
description: After a murdered homosexual is found, two policemen, Benson and Kerwin, are tasked with infiltrating a gay ring. Their relations with the environment, but also with each other, are complicated by Kerwin's (repressed and unhappy) homosexuality.
notes: Starsky and Hutch in gay sauce. A rather ambiguous film, which between claims of film-truth and easy voyeurism does not scratch stereotypes but corroborates them.

title: Lui è peggio di me
actors: Adriano Celentano, Renato Pozzetto, Kelly Van der Velden, Sergio Renda, Daniel Stephen, Lamotte Eugene Atkins, Liliana Bocchi, Rita Catania
description: Leonardo and Luciano are two forty-year-old bachelors, lifelong friends. Owners of a company that rents classic cars, they do well and easily indulge in all the girls they want. The solid friendship breaks down when Leonardo falls in love with Giovanna and marries her. Luciano is thus forced to pack his bags ...
notes: The best film of the Pozzetto-Celentano duo, in fact well assorted. The baggage of gags and numbers is as always known but this time Oldoini hits a cult scene when the two play (so to speak) the musical theme of "That train to Yuma". Hilarious.

title: Tenue de Soirée
actors: Miou-Miou, Gérard Depardieu, Michel Blanc, Michel Creton, Jean-François Stévenin, Mylène Demongeot, Caroline Silhol, Jean-Yves Berteloot, Bruno Cremer
description: Monique prostitutes herself and supports Antoine. In the dull and miserable life of the couple one day the gigantic Bob falls, a thief who associates them with his profitable business and who, as a homosexual, manages to conquer Antoine. Comic-melò with some heaviness, dominated by an irresistible gay heartthrob Depardieu.

title: Luisa, Carla, Lorenza e... le affettuose lontananze
actors: Lina Sastri, Angela Finocchiaro, Fiorenza Marchegiani, Giampiero Bianchi, Massimo De Rossi, Paco Reconti, Gisella Burinato, Carla Cassola
description: "Luisa teaches, is separated and falls in love with a political cartoonist who neglects her; Carla runs a library, has a daughter and is about to remarry with Massimo; Lorenza is a gynecologist and is still waiting for true love. All three are forty years old. and they prepare to face the holidays. Amid gossip and illusions, they discover that for one reason or another they have not found the ideal companion and decide to be alone. Bolsa is an all-female comedy of which it is hard to believe that Age, screenwriter prince of the Italian comedy, has signed the dialogues. Even Finocchiaro can't provide fun. "

title: Luisa - Quattro storie di donne
actors: Senta Berger, Cristina Marsillach, Gianni Garko, Memé Perlini, Luciana Luciani, Paolo Pietrangeli, Fernando Cerulli, Giorgio Conti, Carlo Demi
description: During the years of the dispute, Luisa, about to divorce, discovers that her daughter has ended up in prison in Rebibbia for having occupied some houses. Television film that uses the screenplay by Ennio De Concini (The octopus) and the beauty of Cristina Marsillach (Marrakesh Express).

title: Il lumacone
actors: Turi Ferro, Ninetto Davoli, Agostina Belli, Francesco Mulè, Gabriella Giorgelli, Isa Danieli, Fioretta Mari, Liù Bosisio, Gianfranco Barra
description: Gianni Rodinò (Ferro), a middle-aged cook, drowns the pain of abandoning his wife in wine. His only friend is Ginetto (Davoli), a thief who lives with him and who, after some disagreements, helps him realize his life's dream: to buy a disused railway carriage and turn it into a restaurant. Turi Ferro is an excellent, measured protagonist, Ninetto Davoli and Agostina Belli shine with friendly ease. Based on a screenplay by Ruggero Maccari, director Paolo Cavara has made a film that combines comic and dramatic elements.

title: Luna di miele in tre
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Stefania Casini, Vincent Gardenia, Felice Andreasi, Harry Reems, Massimo Boldi, Cochi Ponzoni, Kirsten Gille, Silvia Annichiarico
description: Hotel waiter in Stresa, Alfredo, on the eve of his honeymoon with Graziella (destination Sanremo), learns that he has won a competition organized by the magazine "Playmen". Prize: dream vacation in Jamaica, five days, with model Christine. Alfredo also hijacks Graziella to the Caribbean. It will be five days of hell: our hero will have to try to exploit the once-in-a-lifetime opportunity without making the bride suspicious and fighting the insistence of the "Playmen" agent, who is busy handling the advertising aspects of the matter. Debut of Vanzina jr. with a pseudo-erotic farce that one would like to be comedy of manners.

title: Haunted Honeymoon
actors: Gene Wilder, Gilda Radner, Dom DeLuise, Jonathan Pryce, Bryan Pringle, Peter Vaughan, Eve Ferret, Paul L. Smith, Julann Griffin
description: Larry and his fiancée Vicky are two well-known radio broadcasters who specialize in horror dramas. For some time, however, Larry has been obsessed with visions and nightmares and he himself emits werewolf howls. Having gone to the castle of his old aunt who designated him heir to his conspicuous assets, Larry also finds all his (envious) relatives there: strange deaths begin to happen.
notes: Don't worry, everything works out for the best. Gene Wilder bursts into the world of horror with this film, mixing typical elements of the genre, bordering on stereotypes, with those of parody.

title: Thrill of a Romance
actors: Esther Williams, Van Johnson, Frances Gifford, Lauritz Melchior, Henry Travers, Spring Byington, Carleton G. Young, Ethel Griffies, Donald Curtis
description: A wealthy businessman marries a swimming champion a month after meeting her. On the very day of the wedding, however, due to urgent commitments, the man leaves his wife. The absence lasts a week during which she meets a kind and nice flyer. They do nothing wrong, but the affection between the two increases. When her husband decides to divorce, she and the other take the opportunity.

title: Hosszú vágta
actors: John Savage, Kelly Reno, Ildikó Bánsági, László Mensáros, Ferenc Bács, Djoko Rosic, László Horváth, Mátyás Usztics, Zoltán Sárközy
description: In the autumn of 1944 Hungary is occupied by the Nazis. Two aviators from an American B-17 bomber are forced to land. One of them, the driver Oscar Brady, hides from a horse breeder, demonstrating among other things excellent skills as a rider. This will allow the pilot to escape the encirclement of the Nazis and, with a frenzied ride through the endless Hungarian puzsta, to get to safety. Here, the Hungarian director Pal Gabor engages in a co-production with the United States: he makes use of it from a technical point of view (the splendid photography of the natural scenery) but the story is somewhat of a manner.

title: The Long Gray Line
actors: Tyrone Power, Maureen O'Hara, Robert Francis, Ward Bond, Donald Crisp, Betsy Palmer, Philip Carey, William Leslie, Harry Carey jr., Patrick Wayne
description: A US Army sergeant close to retirement has spent his entire career at West Point Academy. For decades he has dedicated himself to the training of cadets and for this reason he has refused all opportunities to stand out with more prestigious positions. Among his former students there was also the president Eisenhower himself, from whom he obtains to remain at the Academy even beyond the age limits. Through the affectionate and humorous portrayal of this old army lion, Ford offers a compendium of the themes that are dear to him: moral code, family, tradition. But a melancholy and twilight tone is inevitable.

title: La lunga notte dei disertori
actors: Ivan Rassimov, Monica Strebel, Kirk Morris, Marcella Michelangeli, Aldo Bufi Landi, Giuseppe Castellano, Jessy Maxwell, Joanna Sanders, Youssef Chaban, Paola Natale
description: During the war in Africa, four British soldiers try to return to their lines; to these are added three auxiliaries and a German prisoner. The group is intercepted by a tribe of nomads, who force them to follow them: the chief's son needs urgent care. During the crossing, the group is trapped in a fort and besieged by the Germans. After a very hard night, the decisive attack is triggered, with the British also helped by the nomads. War movie without too many frills, respectful of the rules: no show of ingenuity but good rhythm and authentic setting.

title: La lunga notte del '43
actors: Belinda Lee, Gabriele Ferzetti, Enrico Maria Salerno, Gino Cervi, Andrea Checchi, Nerio Bernardi, Isa Querio, Raffaella Carrà, Loris Bazzocchi
description: We are in the autumn of 1943, in Ferrara. The fascist Aretusi has the moderate consul Bolognesi assassinated, accuses the anti-fascists and then leads the reprisal: eleven shot in the house of the pharmacist Barillari, including the father of Anna's lover, Barillari's wife. After the massacre, Anna leaves Ferrara and her lover goes to Switzerland. In the summer of 1960 the latter returns to the city and meets Aretusi, who compliments him; the two shake hands.
notes: Fifteen years after the end of hostilities, Vancini faces the Resistance and Fascism with a story inspired by a story by Giorgio Bassani.

title: Die Blutigen Geier von Alaska
actors: Doug McClure, Harald Leipnitz, Angelica Ott, Roberto Blanco, Kristina Nel, Klaus Löwitsch, Kurt Bülau, Ivan Stimac, Miha Baloh
description: Jack Harper, a bear hunter, while rushing to the aid of a dying friend, picks up Billy, an orphaned boy and then entrusts him to a family of gold diggers who, with other groups of people, are marching in a caravan towards the fertile lands of the North. The convoy is attacked by bandits aided by the vile deputy Buffin, who kills the sheriff who escorts them and takes possession of the gold.
notes: The film is loosely inspired by the adventurous tales of Jack London and follows the traditional system of the so-called western sauerkraut. The result is really poor, both in terms of acting and directing.

title: I lunghi giorni della vendetta
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Francisco Rabal, Gabriella Giorgelli, Nieves Navarro, Conrado San Martín, Franco Cobianchi, Manuel Muñiz, Teodoro Corrà, Milo Quesada, Giovanni Ivan Scratuglia
description: Ted is out of luck: his father has been murdered and he ends up in jail on charges of a murder he didn't commit. Fortunately for him, he manages to escape and therefore tries to discover his father's killer and the perpetrator of the crime for which he ended up in jail. Naturally, the two leads lead to a single gang of criminals, arms smugglers, in the pay of the local boss who also has a corrupt deputy on the payroll. Ted's revenge can now be accomplished, relentless.
notes: Unfortunately Vancini, after giving good evidence of himself, got lost in the shackles of "food" films, nor is the pseudonym enough to justify it.

title: Battle of Britain
actors: Harry Andrews, Michael Caine, Trevor Howard, Curd Jürgens, Laurence Olivier, Robert Shaw, Ian McShane, Kenneth More, Nigel Patrick, Christopher Plummer, Michael Redgrave, Ralph Richardson, Susannah York
description: In the summer of 1940, the Germans prepare for the invasion of Great Britain. Marshal Goering, commander of the Lutwaffe, has about two thousand five hundred aircraft at his disposal, whose destructive action will have to act as a forerunner for the subsequent invasion. On the other hand, Hugh C. T. Dowling, commander of the British air force, had already foreseen everything, but despite this he is in a desperate situation.
notes: Big budget English film with a star cast, directed by a director known for some James Bond films. The action scenes do not differ too much from those typical of the genre.

title: The Long Goodbye
actors: Elliott Gould, Nina van Pallandt, Sterling Hayden, Mark Rydell, Henry Gibson, David Arkin, Jim Bouton, Warren Berlinger, Jo Ann Brody, Arnold Schwarzenegger
description: Private investigator Marlowe (Gould) does not believe that his friend Lennox, accused of murder, has committed suicide in Mexico and therefore begins a personal investigation that soon turns out to be torturous and dangerous. A dangerous bandit also hunts him, convinced that Lennox has entrusted him with a large sum. There is no shortage of disturbing discoveries including the existence of a love triangle in which Lennox's wife was involved. Final with a double twist. Successful "betrayal" of Chandler's work, where Altman succeeds in the miracle of updating the stereotype of an all too abused character such as Philip Marlowe. Elliott Gould is in great shape. Film adaptation by Leigh Brackett, former screenwriter for Howard Hawks of a classic among the films based on Chandler: The Big Sleep (1946), with the couple Bogart-Bacall.

title: The Long Duel
actors: Yul Brynner, Trevor Howard, Harry Andrews, Andrew Keir, Charlotte Rampling, Virginia North, Laurence Naismith, Maurice Denham, Imogen Hassall, Paul Hardwick
description: The scene of the story is the mysterious India of the early twentieth century, where the British government struggles to keep the turbulent tribes of mountain nomads at bay. As if that weren't enough, a dull police captain pretends to strictly enforce English law in these remote lands. The conflict is bloody, despite the good will of the brave Indian Sultan and the English captain Young.
notes: The story is in a manner; the most interesting element is the rivalry between the two English captains of different mentality. In the good part is Elder Trevor Howard, who stands out for dignity and consistency.

title: Il lungo giorno del massacro
actors: Peter Martell, Manuel Serrano, Luisa Baratto, Daniela Giordano, Glenn Saxon, Franco Fantasia, Ralph Yebb, Andrea Fantasia, Gaetano Imbrò, Ugo Adinolfi
description: Joe Williams, sheriff of a country on the old frontier, is exonerated from his post for the unorthodox methods with which he enforces the law. As if that were not enough, Joe is also unjustly accused of a double murder. He then sets off on the trail of the real culprit, the Mexican outlaw La Muerte, and routs him with all his gang.
notes: A flat and soporific spaghetti western.

title: Il lungo, il corto, il gatto
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Giusi Raspani Dandolo, Ivy Holzer, Ivano Staccioli, Daniele Vargas, Julie Menard, Elsa Vazzoler, Gianni Agus, Enzo La Torre, Andrea Scotti, Mirella Pamphili, Enzo Andronico, Ugo Fangareggi, Ignazio Leone
description: Franco and Ciccio are the waiters of an eccentric noblewoman (Raspani Dandolo). She believes that the house cat is a reincarnation of her late husband. The two, constantly struggling with the animal, must obviously treat the cat as the deceased master ...
notes: The film, directed by Lucio Fulci, is certainly not among the worst of the Sicilian couple. The scene in which the two are alternately elegant diners and modest servants is amusing.

title: Lupi nell'abisso
actors: Massimo Girotti, Folco Lulli, Alberto Lupo, Jean-Marc Bory, Horst Frank, Piero Lulli, Giancarlo Sbragia, Nino Dal Fabbro, Giorgio Cerioni, Enrico Salvatore
description: Only ten men survive from the crew of a submarine badly hit by a bomb. Only one of them can be saved. It's a sort of Ten Little Indians upside down and without suspense.

title: Il lupo della Sila
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, Silvana Mangano, Jacques Sernas, Vittorio Gassman, Luisa Rossi, Olga Solbelli, Dante Maggio, Michele Capezzuoli, Laura Cortese
description: Pietro and Orsola are in love, but due to the opposition of Rocco, the girl's brother, they must see each other in secret. After one of their "convict" appointments, Pietro is arrested on a murder charge. And he cannot excuse himself so as not to compromise Orsola. Jailed, he escapes from prison and is killed by the carabinieri. Years later, Rocco, Orsola's brother, welcomes young Rosalia (Pietro's sister) into his home and falls in love with her.
notes: Dense narration, all facts and no distracting ruminations, with performers who were at the top of the favor of the general public. Popular quality cinema.

title: Il lupo di mare
actors: Andrea Roncato, Gigi Sammarchi, Kara Donati, Kerry Hubbard, Milly D'Abbraccio, Hege Stuen, Dodo Gagliarde, Serena Bennato, Margie Newton
description: Sylvester is employed as a waiter on the Orient Express cruise ship. The maître of the same ship is Marco. The steamer is chartered by a cosmetics company for a cruise to Greece and Turkey in which all sales representatives will take part. What better occasion for the two Latin lovers to show off all their charm? And not only that.
notes: We do not know how much of Enrico Montesano's subject has remained in the film, perhaps not much. For the rest, the comedy slips on the waves of comedy with a television brand sketch: including beauties in the bathroom.

title: Lydia
actors: Merle Oberon, Joseph Cotten, Alan Marshal, Edna May Oliver, Hans Jaray, George Reeves, John Halliday, Sara Allgood, Billy Ray
description: With her three old suitors, Lidya McMillan, now elderly, remembers the past. She remembers her comfortable, trouble-free youth, her first dance and, in the end, she also confesses to the three men that none of them were the true love of her life. Her great love was another, a man who later abandoned her and of which she, today, barely remembers.
notes: Not unpleasant remake of "Carnet de bal" that Julien Duvivier himself had made in France four years earlier.

title: M - Eine Stadt sucht einen Mörder
actors: Peter Lorre, Ellen Widmann, Inge Landgut, Otto Wernicke, Theodor Loos, Gustaf Gründgens, Friedrich Gnaß, Fritz Odemar, Paul Kemp, Theo Lingen
description: An infanticide maniac (Lorre) wanders impregnable around Düsseldorf. The general alarm and the mobilization of the police disturb the activities of the thieves and tramps of the city who decide to do justice in their own way. Masterpiece where everything contributes to an intense dramatic progression, up to the vibrant, almost unsustainable finale. Lorre is extraordinary, the experimentation with sound (then a novelty) already very daring, with the killer who whistles "Peer Gynt".

title: 10.000 dollari per un massacro
actors: Gianni Garko, Loredana Nusciak, Claudio Camaso, Fernando Sancho, Adriana Ambesi, Pinuccio Ardia, Fidel Gonzáles, Franco Lantieri, Massimo Sarchielli
description: Manuel and Cisco to take revenge on Mendoza, the landowner who denounced them, kidnap his daughter Dolores. The girl's father offers Django, a feared bounty hunter, a large sum of money for the killing of the bandits and the release of the girl. Django initially refused the job because the money offered to him is lower than the rate he usually receives. But the "exploits" of the two outlaws who come to threaten his woman make him change his mind ...
notes: Originality is not a point in favor of the film, but some curious elements (the ambiguity between Django and Manuel) and good direction make it an enjoyable western. The soundtrack is mundane, but it is covered with gunfights.

title: The First Great Train Robbery
actors: Sean Connery, Donald Sutherland, Lesley-Anne Down, Alan Webb, Malcolm Terris, Robert Lang, Michael Elphick, Wayne Sleep, Pamela Salem
description: A "corpse" (with some accomplices) robs a convoy loaded with gold.
notes: Poised between comedy, suspense and historical fresco, Crichton takes many risks but he is saved by the ingenuity of the plot (taken from one of his books) and the unmistakable style of Sean Connery.

title: Ma che musica maestro
actors: Gianni Nazzaro, Agostina Belli, Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Didi Perego, Gaby Verusky, Franco Scandurra, Gigi Reder, Elio Crovetto, Leonardo Severini, Umberto D'Orsi, Tiberio Murgia, Enzo Andronico, Ignazio Leone
description: Between the inhabitants of Santa Veronica Alta and those of Santa Veronica Bassa, who have always been rivals, a fight is ignited to avoid the love between Gianni and Juliet. The despotic Ermenegilda, Juliet's aunt and widow of a missing explorer, is particularly determined in her intent. He will reappear at the end and will do his best, unlike his wife, to eliminate the obstacles that stand in the way of the wedding.

title: The Main Event
actors: Barbra Streisand, Ryan O'Neal, Patti D'Arbanville, Paul Sand, Whitman Mayo, Chu Chu Malave, Richard Lawson, James Gregory
description: Business woman proud of the achievements (and earnings) achieved, Hillary Kramer is preparing to launch a new product of her perfume line on the market, when she learns that the CEO has run away with "the cash" of the company . To recover, he tries to bring a boxer back to the ring, but falls in love with him.
notes: It is one of those works tailor-made for its interpreter, in this case the good Barbra Streisand. Even if the film ends up getting lost in the shallows of a shaky screenplay, to which the interpreters have to put more than one piece.

title: The Gods Must Be Crazy
actors: Marius Weyers, Sandra Prinsloo, N!xau, Louw Verwey, Michael Thys, Nic de Jager, Fanyana H. Sidumo, Joe Seakatsie, Brian O'Shaughnessy, Ken Gampu
description: A bottle of Coca Cola thrown from an airplane falls on a group of indigenous people of equatorial Africa: they wonder about its origin. Meanwhile, a group of terrorists has kidnapped the young teacher of a tribe along with her pupils, while the blond and clumsy leader of an ecological-scientific expedition, collaborating with the leader of the indigenous people, tries to free her.
notes: Remember _Someone's gone crazy up there_, a delightful little film set in turn in the Dark Continent? Well, that was the sequel to this one that in its time did not have the success it deserved. All this to say that it is a very pleasant exotic adventure comedy.

title: Ma chi t'ha dato la patente?
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Angela Luce, Willy Van Der Valke, Raika Juri, Renato Baldini, Aldo Bufi Landi, Gino Pagnani, Nino Terzo, Eugene Walter
description: Owners of a driving school so little frequented as to force them to sleep in a boat on the Tiber, Franco and Ciccio suffer the theft of their car. Having bought another one, with the money received from a client to bribe an examiner, they dedicate themselves to the road education of two young Americans. The girls, Deborah and Jane, have two objectives: to obtain a driving license and to avoid having to leave the Bel Paese after the residence permit has expired ...
notes: Film with few pretensions, where some found are also good but - as usual - penalized by a decidedly limited script.

title: But Not For Me
actors: Clark Gable, Carroll Baker, Lilli Palmer, Lee J. Cobb, Barry Coe, Thomas Gomez, Charles Lane, Wendell Holmes, Tom Duggan
description: Russ Ward, Broadway's theatrical impresario, is in full professional and marriage crisis. The sighed staged of a comedy of him sees the decisive contribution of his secretary and ex -wife. An excellent cast partially wasted, for a remake of "Accident on Youth" (1935).

title: What's Up, Doc?
actors: Barbra Streisand, Ryan O'Neal, Madeline Kahn, Kenneth Mars, Austin Pendleton, Michael Murphy, Philip Roth, Sorrell Booke, Stefan Gierasch
description: A serious musicologist, with an insignificant girlfriend, and a crazy girl are involved in a series of accidents and adventures on the trail of four suitcases full of highly confidential documents. With a side dish of thieves, cops, sneers and qui pro quo, a very cinephile and very funny reinterpretation of the Hawks-style screwball comedy ("Susanna"). The title is the interlayer of Bugs Bunny.

title: Macabro
actors: Bernice Stegers, Stanko Molnar, Veronica Zinny, Roberto Posse, Ferdinando Orlandi, Fernando Pannullo, Elisa Kadigia Bove
description: June, a young lady from New Orleans married to Leslie and a mother of two children, has a lover whom she secretly meets in Robert's house, a young blind man. One day the daughter, who sensed her mother's infidelity, drowns her little brother in the tub to take revenge. While running home Jane has a car accident, in which her lover dies beheaded. A year later Jane, who lives in the same apartment where she met with her lover, must suffer the attention of Robert, secretly in love with her and intrigued by the strange moans that come out of her room. Directorial debut of Mario Bava's son, based on a screenplay by Pupi Avati and Maurizio Costanzo. Filmed in America, with a good eye for suspense.

title: Macbeth
actors: Jon Finch, Francesca Annis, Martin Shaw, Terence Bayler, John Stride, Nicholas Selby, Stephan Chase, Paul Shelley, Maisie MacFarquhar, Elsie Taylor, Noelle Rimmington, Noel Davis
description: While riding in a forest, Macbeth and his companion in arms Banquo encounter three witches who reveal a prophecy to them: Macbeth will become king while Banquo will be the father of kings. In fact, Macbeth will gird the crown after killing his sovereign, thanks to his wife. So that the other prophecy doesn't come true, Macbeth pays two hit men to kill Banquo and his son. The friend is killed, the young man takes revenge and becomes the new ruler. In his first film after the murder of his wife Sharon Tate (1969), Polanski emphasizes the "splatter", ie darker and more violent, features of William Shakespeare's tragedy. Screenplay by critic Kenneth Tynan.

title: La macchina ammazzacattivi
actors: Gennaro Pisano, Marilyn Buferd, William Tubbs, Helen Tubbs, Giovanni Amato, Clara Bindi, Giacomo Furia, Joseph Falletta, Aldo Giuffré, Carlo Giuffrè
description: Celestino, a modest village photographer, was given, by S. Andrea to whom he is very devoted, the possibility of exterminating the wicked simply by re-photographing a photographic portrait of them. He tries, at the expense of some greedy people who want to deprive three poor people of the country of a legitimate inheritance. A curious aesthetic-political apologue, made practically without a script, by dint of improvisations, and ended three years after the start of filming. The result, although not without its moments, is excessively fragmentary. Subject by Eduardo De Filippo and Giuseppe Marotta.

title: Maciste all'inferno
actors: Kirk Morris, Hélène Chanel, Vira Silenti, Angelo Zanolli, Andrea Bosic, Donatella Mauro, Gina Mascetti, Antonella Della Porta, John Karlsen
description: In the 17th century, in a small Scottish village, Martha Gutt was tried for witchcraft and sentenced to be burned at the stake. She is innocent, but if it were not for Maciste ... The hero in fact descends into the underworld to destroy the forces of evil and save the unfortunate woman.
notes: The castle is actually that of Bolsena and the sequence of hell is shot in the caves of Castellana. The story is by Ennio De Concini, the future screenwriter of the "Piovra". The film is compelling and imaginative. Bizarre is the part of the metacinema in which pieces of Maciste's past are shown (actually they are the previous episodes of the series).

title: Maciste alla corte dello Zar
actors: Kirk Morris, Massimo Serato, Ombretta Colli, Gloria Milland, Tom Felleghy, Giulio Donnini, Dada Gallotti, Ugo Sasso, Arnaldo Arnaldi
description: At the extreme edge of Central Asia, an expedition of scientists discovers the intact body of a young and gigantic man in a cave who is given the name of Maciste. Brought outside, with the light and heat of the sun, the body is revived. The cruel Tsar Nikolaev, ruler of the province where the precious "relic" was found, immediately thinks of exploiting the giant for his own evil interests. But he does not reckon with the fact that Maciste, endowed with his own autonomy of judgment, does not allow himself to be trapped in the shady intentions of the monarch at all.
notes: A routine film, which transports an old and glorious character into an unlikely situation.

title: Maciste contro i cacciatori di teste
actors: Kirk Morris, Laura Brown, Alfredo Zammi, Demeter Bitenc, Frank Leroy, Corinne Capri, Luigi Esposito, Nello Pazzafini, Alessio Pregara
description: After a terrible volcanic eruption that devastated his island, Maciste leads the few survivors to other shores. Thus he lands in the country of the Urias, a people oppressed by headhunters. Falling in love with their queen, he defeats the villains after an epic duel with the usurper. In the 1960s, there were at least eighteen films in the series, starring the legendary strongman. This is one of many. Maciste is played by Kirk Morris, pseudonym of Adriano Bellini. Director Malatesta is not one of the most imaginative specialists.

title: Maciste contro lo sceicco
actors: Ed Fury, Erno Crisa, Gisella Arden, Massimo Carocci, Piero Lulli, Mara Berni, Anna Ranalli, Giuseppe Addobbati, Carlo Pisacane, Adriano Micantoni
description: Responding to the appeal of a Spanish officer, who asks for his help in freeing his girlfriend who is a prisoner of a sheikh, Maciste arrives in Africa, where however the alleged kidnapped, Isabella, says she intends to marry her alleged tormentor, the sheikh. . In reality, the girl is willing to marry only to save her father, who is segregated in the basement of the palace. After spectacular adventures, Isabella gets married with her officer.
notes: The film follows without any creativity the proven fantastic-muscular recipe of the series dedicated to the superhero which also has much better achievements.

title: Maciste e la regina di Samar
actors: Sergio Ciani, Jany Clair, Anna Maria Polani, Nando Tamberlani, Delia D'Alberti, Goffredo Unger, Anna Maria Dionisio, Paola Pitti, Giuliano Raffaelli
description: Maciste is called to Samar by the population, tired of the harassment to which the queen is subjected. She, using an army made up of stone men from the Moon, imposes human sacrifices on her subjects. The queen falls in love with Maciste, who does not give in to flattery. A group of rebels gather around Maciste: it is with their support that the very strong hero confronts the stone warriors and defeats them.
notes: Mythological story contaminated with elements of science fiction. Maciste is Alan Steel, pseudonym of Sergio Ciani, a bodybuilder who later dedicated himself to the theater (he also acted with Strehler).

title: Maciste l'eroe più grande del mondo
actors: Mark Forest, Giuliano Gemma, José Greci, Erno Crista, Livio Lorenzon, Mimmo Palmara, Piero Lulli, Paul Muller, Eleonora Bianchi, Jacques Herlin
description: The defeated Udor of Udor every year must immolate 24 virgins to the deities of Cafaus, the barbaric rival city. Maciste arrives in the city while the girls are dragged to the sacrifice by order of the tyrant of Cafaus, parchment. Not being able to bear to passively assist the cowardly operation, it intervenes; It is the beginning of a series of vicissitudes that will end with the return to justice.
