notes: Naive mythology but in the captivating whole. In the cast there is still little known Giuliano Gemma, who would shortly become an Italian star of the Western Spaghetti, while Michele Lupo would have shot some Bud Spencer films.

title: Maciste l'uomo più forte del mondo
actors: Mark Forest, Moira Orfei, Gianni Garko, Raffaella Carrà, Paul Wynter, Enrico Glori, Roberto Miali, Nando Tamberlani, Carla Foscari, Rosalia Gavo
description: Maciste and the faithful servant Bango are prisoners of the underground city of the warlike mole men, who have kidnapped the son of Loth, rightful ruler, forcing him with others to work in the mine. After many difficulties, the two manage to turn the situation in their favor. But the cruel queen of mole men, the charming Moira Orfei, is determined to give the invincible hero a hard time.
notes: One of the best films dedicated to Maciste. Visionary and avant-garde scenography and a pinch of creeping eroticism that doesn't hurt. Carramba, what a surprise: Raffaella is there too!

title: Maciste nelle miniere di Re Salomone
actors: Reg Park, Wandisa Guida, Bruno Piergentili, Eleonora Bianchi, Elio Jotta, Carlo Tamberlani, Giuseppe Addobbati, Nino Persello, Bruno Scipioni, Loris Loddi
description: In Africa, in the kingdom of Namar, there are the mythical mines of King Solomon. Riyadh and Fazira, at the head of a band of marauders, kill the sovereign and enslave his people to extract gold. Maciste intervenes and saves the legitimate heir to the throne: a boy.
notes: Directed and written by Piero Regnoli under the pseudonym of Martin Andrews, the film is not among the best in the Maciste series.

title: The Mad Bomber
actors: Chuck Connors, Vince Edwards, Neville Brand, Hank Brandt, Christina Hart, Faith Quabius, Ilona Wilson, Nancy Honnold, Ted Gehring
description: A man who saw his daughter dying of drugs decides to take revenge by exploding one bomb after another in different points of the city. A detective on the trail of a guardian maniac ends up putting the dynamitarian from the tight, forcing him to self -heel without damage for other people. Bert Gordon's film is certainly not for refined palates: rough and a little coarse, however it also shows a certain profession in the excited action scenes. The description of the violence, however insisted and at times performance, is not entirely free.

title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome
actors: Mel Gibson, Tina Turner, Frank Thring, Angelo Rossitto, Paul Larsson, Bruce Spence, Adam Cockburn, Angry Anderson, Robert Grupp
description: In the future, the source of energy is pig dung. Crossing the desert, Mad Max must clash with Baser Town, Queen Auntie's ferocious champion. After beating him, he is driven back into the dunes where he is rescued by a community of children who survived a plane crash. Max decides to lead them against Baser Town and its society based on the cruelest exploitation.
notes: Third and final episode of the Mad Max saga, less "ruthless" than the previous ones but equally spectacular and adventurous, perhaps even more comic. Miller's moral apologue is sharp and some moments are genuinely visionary (the duel with MasterBlaster, the queen played by Tina Turner).

title: Madame Bovary
actors: Isabelle Huppert, Jean-François Balmer, Christophe Malavoy, Jean Yanne, Lucas Belvaux, Christiane Minazzoli, Jean-Louis Maury, Florent Gibassier, Jean-Claude Bouillaud
description: Emma Bovary, married too soon to a provincial doctor, dreams of other horizons. After being seduced and abandoned by the libertine Rodolphe, she finds another lover in Léon. When, ruined by debts, she seeks Rodolphe's financial help, without finding him, she decides to commit suicide with arsenic.
notes: The aspect of Flaubert's novel that interested Chabrol is undoubtedly that given by the subtitle "Costumes of the province". The approach is as literary as you want, but Chabrol's nastiness about the suffocating life and environment of the province is explicit.

title: Madame Bovary
actors: Jennifer Jones, James Mason, Van Heflin, Louis Jourdan, Alf Kjellin, Gene Lockhart, Frank Allenby, Gladys Cooper, John Abbott, Harry Morgan, George Zucco, Ellen Corby
description: Emma Ronault, a young provincial with a romantic spirit, meets Carlo Bovary on her father's farm, a doctor who falls in love with her and marries her. Emma, ??however, soon realizes that her husband is not what is called a "prince charming" and the woman enters into a relationship with a young scribe who works for a notary. Invited to a party in an aristocratic house, she meets a country gentleman, Rodolfo, and soon becomes his lover. Minnelli shoots this (very free) Flaubertian adaptation in the same spirit as his famous musicals (see the dance scene in society). Very Minnellian and very little Flaubertian, the film is preceded by the staging of the famous trial for immorality suffered by the book, with James Mason playing Flaubert.

title: Madame DuBarry
actors: Pola Negri, Emil Jannings, Harry Liedtke, Eduard von Winterstein, Reinhold Schünzel, Else Berna, Fred Immler, Gustav Czimeg
description: Madame Dubarry, a favorite of Louis XV, falls in love with a young man of the court, but is forced to abandon him due to her social position. He will find it in the ranks of the sans-culottes, at the outbreak of the Revolution, and will end up with a guillotine. Here we are still far from the famous "Lubitsch touch", but there is no lack of ironic moments that herald it.

title: Madame Sousatzka
actors: Shirley MacLaine, Peggy Ashcroft, Twiggy, Shabana Azmi, Leigh Lawson, Geoffrey Bayldon, Lee Montague, Robert Rietty, Navin Chowdhry, Greg Ellis, Sam Howard, Jeremy Sinden
description: Madame Sousatzka is a Russian-born piano teacher who demands body and soul from her students. Her protege is Manek, a young Indian of proven talents, to whom the pianist is a teacher and mother. She comes into conflict with the boy's real mother, who feels excluded and pushes her son to perform in public. Manek, despite Madame's discontent, will perform the concert and rely on a more condescending teacher.
notes: An uncoordinated and too clever film. Too bad for Schlesinger, who was a great director, and for Shirley MacLaine, in the role of the teacher she is perfect, and characterizes her character at best.

title: Madame X
actors: Lana Turner, John Forsythe, Ricardo Montalban, Constance Bennett, Keir Dullea, Burgess Meredith, John Van Dreelen, Virginia Grey, Warren Stevens, Carl Benton Reid, Teddy Quinn
description: Holly marries a prominent politician, but during one of his too many absences she yields to the court of one of her suitors. When she wants to break off the relationship, the young man accidentally dies. Her husband's family pushes her away. Mélo shot with the sole purpose of re-proposing, with a new tragic mask after the dazzling appearances of twenty years earlier, the former pin up Lana Turner, a fatal blonde.

title: Maddalena zero in condotta
actors: Carla Del Poggio, Vittorio De Sica, Vera Bergman, Arturo Bragaglia, Irasema Dilian, Amelia Chellini, Pina Renzi, Paola Veneroni, Dora Bini
description: In a school for business secretaries, the German teacher offers the pupils an exercise: writing a business letter addressed to a certain Mr. Hartman, a Viennese captain of industry. Unlike the other companions, a student decides to really send the letter hoping for the prince charming from the fairy tale. The imaginary recipient, however, really exists and soon after, at the school, Mr. Hartman himself appears, interested in the sender of the writing.
notes: Inspired comedy by De Sica still not neorealist. He and Del Poggio make sparks, but watch out for all the good characters in the cast.

title: Made in Italy
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Nino Castelnuovo, Walter Chiari, Peppino De Filippo, Aldo Fabrizi, Sylva Koscina, Virna Lisi, Anna Magnani, Nino Manfredi, Lea Massari, Alberto Sordi, Jean Sorel, Catherine Spaak
description: A series of scketch on five different themes: among others, the young widow of an old rich man meets the old love, but used to bond for interest, she does not marry him even this time. A beautiful woman flattered by the attentions of a charming bachelor then discovers that the man is only interested in his car. A businessman goes to the Town Hall for a certificate and comes out without having obtained the document, but with several fines.
notes: At times savory and funny, at times predictable, with a system and a cast that already know of a celebration of Italian comedy.

title: Il maestro di Vigevano
actors: Alberto Sordi, Claire Bloom, Vito De Taranto, Guido Spadea, Ya Doucheskaya, Guido Spadea, Eva Magni, Piero Mazzarella, Lilla Ferrante, Ezio Sancrotti
description: Mombelli is an elementary school teacher who lives satisfied with his modest but decent condition. However, he ends up being conditioned and overwhelmed by the ambition of his wife Ada who, pushed by the idea of ??conquering easy riches, convinces him to abandon his career. The master invests his liquidation in a small artisan business and, at first, seems to accept his new condition.
notes: Petri attempts a bitter description of the environment, providing Sordi with a multifaceted character, but then the film settles on a tone of bland comedy. From the novel by Lucio Mastronardi written by Petri himself with the collaboration of Age and Scarpelli. A little confused Alberto Sordi, who tries to get out of clichés.

title: Maggio musicale
actors: Malcolm McDowell, Pierandrea Baglioni, Elisabetta Pozzi, Shirley Verrett, Benedetta Buccellato, Chris Merritt, Orsetta Gregoretti, Will Humburg, Guido Pasella
description: The Maggio Musicale is the opera season held every year in Florence. A boy sees La Bohème in 1946, but mysteriously we see him again as he is today, over forty years later, attending the theater and in particular a director, assisting him in his innovative staging of the same work. On the evening of the premiere, the boy disappears and only a diary remains: it is that of the director, in 1946 ... Wandering, ironic, intelligent but a little bloodless, this oneiric and autobiographical and oneiric fantasy of Gregoretti went very badly in the cinema.

title: The Raven
actors: Vincent Price, Peter Lorre, Boris Karloff, Hazel Court, Jack Nicholson, Olive Sturgess, Connie Wallace, Wiliam Baskin, Aaron Saxon
description: In sixteenth-century England, a learned wizard lives in his castle and is visited by another wizard who seeks his alliance to fight an evil wielder of magical powers. The good castellan accepts when he realizes that his rival has stolen his wife, who he believed dead, and defeats him in a deadly duel of magical arts. Roger Corman, after having made so many thrill films, here dismantles their mechanisms, making fun of them with hilarious results. Also thanks to the formidable performers (Price, Lorre and Karloff), who compete in making fun of their characters.

title: Summer Magic
actors: Hayley Mills, Burl Ives, Dorothy McGuire, Deborah Walley, Una Merkel, Eddie Hodges, Michael J. Pollard, Peter Brown, James Stacy, O.Z. Whitehead
description: Margaret Carey remains a widow and has to leave the overpriced house in Boston. Nancy, his daughter, finds a beautiful country house at a very low rent, thanks to the post officer who is the caretaker; the only counterpart, in the living room there must be a portrait of the owner's mother. Nancy, with the help of the caretaker's children, refurbishes the house. On the very day of the opening, the owner returns from China; much to the girl's surprise, it is a handsome young man. From the award-winning Disney company a sixties rural comedy, which develops like a modern fairy tale: filled with good feelings, boundless optimism and an indefinite defense of the "proverbial" pioneering altruism made in the USA.

title: Magic Moments
actors: Stefania Sandrelli, Sergio Castellitto, Fabio Traversa, Rodolfo Laganà, Paola Tiziana Cruciani, Shereen Sabet, Clara Colosimo, Lilli Carati, Nando Paone
description: Three provincial boys go to Rome with the illusion of working on television. One ends up selling fake movie memorabilia, another happily marries a stall owner, and the third gets into trouble with a journalist. After his debut with "Sciopén", Luciano Odorisio went precipitously in decline: fellinisms from the second film, narcissisms from the second film. And then he never recovered. The music is by Matia Bazar.

title: Il magnate
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Rosanna Schiaffino, Jean-Pierre Cassel, Pier Paola Bucchi, Empedocle Buzzanca, Guido Cerniglia, Michele Cimarosa, Antonio La Raina, Renato Malavasi
description: Clara, the wife of Furio Cicerone, engineer and president of Finsied, does not yield to the amorous proposals of Count Arienti. Cicero contracts a large debt with the count by signing an erotic mortgage on Clara as a guarantee, but he is certain to honor the financial commitment at maturity thanks to the coverage obtained by Bigerotti, the director of a bank. But the very powerful Arienti induces Bigerotti not to agree with Cicero. A thin farce but not all to be thrown away signed by Gianni Grimaldi, veteran screenwriter, rather than director, of comic and light films. It is one of the last appearances in the cinema of Rosanna Schiaffino.

title: The Greek Tycoon
actors: Anthony Quinn, Jacqueline Bisset, Raf Vallone, Marilù Tolo, Edward Albert, James Franciscus, Camilla Sparv, Charles Durning, Luciana Paluzzi, Robin Clarke, Kathryn Leigh Scott
description: The Greek Theo Thomasis became, out of thin air, one of the world's greatest capitalists, owner of fleets and airlines. It all began with an oath made when his father was hanged by the Turks. His loves were also adventurous and exceptional. Finally, Theo marries the widow of an American president who has fallen under the fire of an attacker. Their marriage is stormy, but supported by true love. It will be only the pain for the untimely death of his son Niko to be right of the indomitable tycoon.
notes: Long-winded meatloaf about the Onassis family, with actors who almost seem to make fun of themselves.

title: Magnificent Doll
actors: Ginger Rogers, David Niven, Burgess Meredith, Harlan Briggs, Peggy Wood, Stephen McNally, Robert Barrat, Grandon Rhodes, Frances E. Williams, Henri Letondal
description: A young widow is fought over by two politicians. The first, Aaron, is ambitious and a lover of power, the second, James, is instead an idealist advocating the abolition of slavery. She chooses James and the choice is happy as Aaron soon proves to be a cynical adventurer. In a dramatic finale, however, the woman manages to save him from a lynching. It is not one of Borzage's best films, but it remains the work of a master of cinema. Her psychological digging of the characters together with her great passion for freedom (see Dolly's final speech) remain admirable.

title: River of No Return
actors: Robert Mitchum, Marilyn Monroe, Rory Calhoun, Tommy Rettig, Murvyn Vye, Douglas Spencer
description: Matt Carter, a farmer who lives alone with his son Mark, saves a man and a woman from the river. The first takes his horse and gun, to go to the city to register the ownership of a mine won at the game. The woman, May, (Monroe) stays with Matt instead. Escaped from an Indian attack, the three manage to reach the city, where they find the adventurer. The showdown is resolved by Mark. May will stay with Matt and the baby forever.
notes: Marilyn finds here one of the most complex and suffered characters of her career. Adventurous Western, the film communicates an ideal push to the "resurrection", also symbolized by the memorable journey on the river.

title: The Magnificent Seven Ride!
actors: Lee Van Cleef, Stefanie Powers, Michael Callan, Pedro Armendariz jr., Mariette Hartley, Luke Askew, Ralph Waite, Melissa Murphy, William Lucking, James Sikking, Ed Lauter, Gary Busey
description: Chris, Sheriff of Sheridan, to avenge his wife raped and killed by three outlaws, recruits five inmates, promised an amnesty, and a journalist. The seven challenge the Detoro gang, responsible for the incident, to clash with them in the village of Magdalena. Only three will survive the clash, but Detoro's gang will finally be destroyed and peace restored to the region.
notes: The story and characterization of the characters are affected by the influence of the western-spaghetti, at the time also in vogue in the US and to which Van Cleef owed much of its relaunch. Nothing to do, however, with John Sturges' film.

title: Along Came Jones
actors: Gary Cooper, Loretta Young, William Demarest, Dan Duryea, Frank Sully, Don Costello, Walter Sande, Russell Simpson, Arthur Loft, Willard Robertson, Ray Teal
description: Melody travels to Texas with a friend, looking for work. Arriving in a small town he is mistaken for the bandit Mount Jarrad, whom he looks a lot like. To escape the hunt of the many citizens who would like to kill him, he accepts the hospitality of Cherry who hides him in her house. The girl is hosting the real Jarrad with whom she is madly in love. A violent fight breaks out between the two men, during which Cherry saves Melody's life by beating Jarrad to death.
notes: A mediocre production for a "star" at the height of his parable: the film is of little strength, despite the ironic touches of the screenplay by Nunnally Johnson. Gary Cooper has fun.

title: The Bobo
actors: Peter Sellers, Britt Ekland, Rossano Brazzi, Adolfo Celi, Don Lurio, Hattie Jacques, Ferdy Mayne, Kenneth Griffith, Al Lettieri, Marne Maitland
description: Jean Bautista (Sellers) is a matador, but he aspires to be a singer and, to get a writing, he must seduce Olympia, a high-class courtesan. Passing off as rich and powerful, Bautista achieves his goal, but, discovering his game, Olympya throws him out the door after painting him blue. The writing vanishes and our hero returns to the arenas where onlookers flock to see the colored-skinned toreador. Poor quality comedy, with some gems due to the always extraordinary Peter Sellers.

title: Scalawag
actors: Kirk Douglas, Mark Lester, Neville Brand, George Eastman, Don Stroud, Lesley-Anne Down, Danny DeVito, Mel Blanc, Phil Brown
description: Peg, once his companion in misdeeds, also joins an expedition in search of the treasure of the pirate Murdock. But little Jemy unmasks him and Peg ends up condemned to the gallows. He will be able to escape thanks to the help of the boy. A "eurowestern" version (shot in Yugoslavia) of the "Treasure Island". Douglas directs himself but does not have the vocation of a director. Instead, little Lester will actually end up behind the camera ("Commando").

title: Il magnifico cornuto
actors: Claudia Cardinale, Ugo Tognazzi, Gian Maria Volonté, Salvo Randone, Bernard Blier, Michèle Girardon, Paul Guers, Philippe Nicaud, Susy Andersen
description: Andrea Artusi (Tognazzi) is obsessed with his wife having a lover. The woman is actually faithful to him, but Andrea insists on spying on her and develops the belief that a friend is having an affair with her. Soon after, the jealous husband is injured in an accident; during his convalescence he is persuaded of his wife's fidelity, but she begins to meet the doctor.
notes: The subject is taken from a well-known comedy by Crommelynck, adapted with taste and refinement of style by Pietrangeli and well interpreted by Tognazzi who had brought it to the stage a short time before.

title: Young Cassidy
actors: Rod Taylor, Maggie Smith, Julie Christie, Flora Robson, Michael Redgrave, Edith Evans, Jack MacGowran, Sian Phillips, T.P. McKenna, Julie Ross, Robin Sumner
description: Rather faithful biography of the Irish worker Sean O'Casey, active in the anti-British resistance and later a famous playwright. Among the salient episodes that are narrated in the film is a curious attempted theft committed by O'Casey against a library: young, thirsty for knowledge, he was so poor that he could not even buy a book.
notes: The filming of the film was started by John Ford, who however fell ill a short time later. The direction was thus entrusted to director of photography Jack Cardiff who ended it in the best possible way.

title: Lone Wolf McQuade
actors: Chuck Norris, David Carradine, Barbara Carrera, Leon Isaac Kennedy, Robert Beltran, L.Q. Jones, Dana Kimmell, R.G. Armstrong, Jorge Cervera Jr., Sharon Farrell
description: Wilkes traffics in arms without the knowledge of his boss, Falco. McQuade is a Texas ranger, embroiled in this traffic, blackmailed and guarded by Wilkes through the beautiful Lola. The ranger, however, finds the strength to react and, with the help of an FBI agent and a friend of his, engages in a fight to the death with Wilkes, during which Lola also dies, in the meantime falling in love with him for real.
notes: Paroxysmal violence in the great spaces of Texas. Steve Carver comes out of Roger Corman's award-winning school, where he cut his teeth with gangster-movies and pseudo-mythological films, and the film has the pace and unpretentiousness of a healthy action-movie.

title: The Magician of Lublin
actors: Alan Arkin, Louise Fletcher, Shelley Winters, Valerie Perrine, Lou Jacobi, Warren Berlinger, Shaike Ophir, Lisa Whelchel, Maia Danziger
description: In the Poland of the early twentieth century, the life, adventures and mysterious disappearance of Yoshua Mazur, a thief and a great Jewish illusionist. Man's forbidden dream, the one for which he sacrifices everything, is the desire to fly. Mediocre Isaac B. Singer costume film, slow and expensive, directed by the producer who founded Cannon.

title: The Wizard of Oz
actors: Judy Garland, Frank Morgan, Ray Bolger, Bert Lahr, Jack Haley, Billie Burke, Margaret Hamilton, Charley Grapewin, Pat Walshe
description: From the famous story by Frank Baum, the prodigious adventure of the young Dorothy who ends up in the world of Oz to save her dog Totò. In the search for the Magician who reigns over the country, the child finds the company of the Scarecrow, the Tin Man and the scary Lion.
notes: Delightful adaptation, in black and white in the "realistic" part and in color in the "fairytale" part, with a rare inspiration and care. Fleming, who signed "Gone with the Wind" in the same year, also took over here after Richard Thorpe, King Vidor and George Cukor had alternated in the preparation. The film was a resounding box-office hit and launched Oscar-winning Judy Garland with the song "Over the Rainbow" among the stars. Salman Rushdie recently titled an autobiographical book after the film.

title: Never Say Never Again
actors: Sean Connery, Klaus Maria Brandauer, Max Von Sydow, Barbara Carrera, Kim Basinger, Bernie Casey, Alec McCowen, Edward Fox, Pamela Salem, Rowan Atkinson, Valerie Leon
description: Thanks to a very sophisticated plan, the Specter has managed to take possession of two nuclear warhead missiles and threatens to blow up half the world. The US and Great Britain can only solve the crisis by paying. British secret agent James Bond is given the task of tracking down the hiding place of the criminal organization ...
notes: Towards the end of the Roger Moore era, a parenthesis with the return of the "original" 007, a little aged but basically ageless. Ironically, Connery plays and guesses the comparison with the bad Nicaragueña Barbara Carrera. A film "out of series" for contractual reasons, without the customary logo and music, but with the unmistakable trademark of the Scottish actor.

title: Not Without My Daughter
actors: Sally Field, Alfred Molina, Sheila Rosenthal, Roshan Seter, Sarah Badel, Mony Rey, Georges Corraface, Mary Nell Santacroce, Ed Grady, Marc Gowan
description: Betty is an American who married an Iranian who has long since immigrated to the United States. Their life goes on happy, at least in the beginning: they have a daughter and lead a quiet life. When the husband wants to revisit Iran he convinces his wife and daughter to follow him. Here everything changes because the Iranian practically holds his wife prisoner, for this reason she is forced to flee.
notes: Based on a true story, the film is told with the tones of reckless melodrama and rages against Khomeinist intolerance; implicitly it also shows the American one towards everything that is not American. Sally Field is good, but the whole is heavy.

title: Maigret a Pigalle
actors: Gino Cervi, Lila Kedrova, Raymond Pellegrin, Alfred Adam, Daniel Ollier, José Greci, Enzo Cerusico, Armando Bandini, Christian Barbier, Mario Feliciani, Riccardo Garrone, Antonella Della Porta
description: A stripper tells police she overheard two clients plan a murder, but she is drunk and no one believes her. That night a countess is strangled and the girl also ends up in the same way. Maigret investigates the story, in which stories of jewels and drugs are intertwined. The highlight of the film is the description of environments and figures of a small purgatory of marginal people observed by a placid Gino Cervi. The popular actor, star of a hugely popular television series, plays Commissioner Maigret here for the first and only time in a film for the big screen.

title: Major League
actors: Tom Berenger, Charlie Sheen, Margaret Whitton, Wesley Snipes, Corbin Bernsen, James Gammon, Rene Russo, Charles Cyphers, Chelcie Ross, Dennis Haysbert, Andy Romano
description: The widow of the owner of a baseball team, the Cleveland Indians, organizes the new lineup with the intention of making it last in the league. Under the terms of the regulations, he will be able to transfer it to Miami, where he intends to go and settle. But Lou, the new coach, completely unaware of his plans, also manages to draw blood from the turnips. And the Indians even manage to win the championship.
notes: Comedy of environment and sports jargon, in which we find, close-knit teammates, Tom Berenger and Charlie Sheen, who had left enemies to the death in "Platoon".

title: Mak pigreco 100
actors: Rosita Celentano, Christophe Bouquin, Ray Lovelock, Erika Blanc, Jonathan Horn, Luca Lionello, Victoria Zinny, Beatrice Macola, Ricky Palazzolo, Antonio Nonpenso
description: Roberto enters the Naval Academy of Livorno and intertwines a tender flirtation with Claudia who has been engaged for four years with ensign Paolo Paolo. He puts the aut-aut to Roberto: either forget about Claudia or he won't participate in the great regatta of the "Mediterranean Cup", that is to say the sailing competition that crowns the dreams of every cadet.
notes: This film represented one of the most catastrophic flops of Italian cinema. Despite this, however, the experience was not able to sufficiently downsize the artistic ambitions of Molleilato's daughter. Aside from Lovelock, the cast is all laughter.

title: Maladie d'amour
actors: Nastassja Kinski, Michel Piccoli, Jean-Hugues Anglade, Jean-Claude Brialy, Souad Amidou, Jean-Paul Roussillon, Jean-Luc Porraz, Sophie d'Aulan, Catherine Jacob
description: Raul Bergeron, famous chief oncologist at the Bordeaux hospital, falls in love with a young manicurist. A brilliant assistant, Clément, also falls in love with the same woman, whose career Bergeron ruins out of spite. Juliette, realizing that she has harmed Clément, leaves him. Years later, seriously ill with cancer, Juliette finds her smile again by embracing for a moment Clément, whom she has never stopped loving. The film is a bit excessive: too much love, too many tears, too many hospitals, too many courses and appeals. The subject was by Zuòawski, here Deary does not even have his afollia. But there is Nastassja Kinski who gives the eye its part.

title: Malcolm
actors: Colin Friels, John Hargreaves, Lindy Davies, Chris Haywood, Charles 'Bud' Tingwell, Beverley Phillips, Judith Stratford, Heather Mitchell, Tony Mahood
description: Fired from the tram company, Malcom, a fragile young genius, makes friends with a nice couple of thieves. Thanks to his invention, the three land a robbery and flee to Europe. Delightful first feature by Australian director Nadia Tass.

title: The Mean Season
actors: Kurt Russell, Mariel Hemingway, Richard Jordan, Andy Garcia, Richard Masur, Richard Bradford, Joe Pantoliano, Rose Portillo, William Smith, John Palmer, Lee Sandman
description: Malcolm Anderson is a crime reporter who conducted an investigation into the murder of a girl. One day he receives a phone call: it is the killer, who compliments him and announces four more of his upcoming exploits, giving him information that allows Anderson to become a renowned reporter. Trouble begins when he tries to get rid of his uncomfortable "ally". The journalist's wife will also get involved, before the two men reach the final battle.
notes: Portrait of a psychopathic killer thirsty for publicity, and the ambiguous relationship that binds him to the reporter on whom his celebrity depends. The good cast is wasted by an effect direction.

title: Un maledetto imbroglio
actors: Claudia Cardinale, Pietro Germi, Claudio Gora, Eleonora Rossi Drago, Franco Fabrizi, Cristina Gaioni, Saro Urzì, Nino Castelnuovo, Ildebrando Santafe, Peppino De Martino, Silla Bettini
description: Commissioner Ingravallo investigates a theft, but soon finds himself in the throes of a murder. The two crimes are connected and, gifted with humanity as well as acumen, he solves the case in his own way. Not easy and therefore even more appreciable, robust transposition of one of the greatest Italian novels of the twentieth century, Quer pasticciaccio brutto de Via Merulana, by Gadda. Germi replaces the non-ending of the book with a plausible solution, transforming the metaphysical delirium into a simple thriller. Excellent places and surrounding figures. In the cast, the not yet twenty-year-old Claudia Cardinale. Rustichelli's final song, "Sinnò me moro", sung by Alida Chelli (daughter of the musician) is a must.

title: Damien: Omen II
actors: William Holden, Lee Grant, Jonathan Scott-Taylor, Robert Foxworth, Nicholas Pryor, Lew Ayres, Sylvia Sidney, Lance Henriksen, Elizabeth Shepherd, Lucas Donat
description: Damien, a seven-year-old boy, is growing up in Uncle Richard's home after his parents die. With his cousin Mark he is sent to attend a military college, where he does honor. But, anyone who realizes his true identity as a son of Satan faces a bad end. Back home, he grants his support to the family food company which is preparing to ride the wave of a sudden universal shortage.
notes: Taylor goes to great lengths to give us an acceptable product. The rest are banalities. The idea that ended the first episode, "The Omen", got lost along the way.

title: Malinconico autunno
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, Yvonne Sanson, Miguelito Gil, Mercedes Monterrey, José Guardiola, Manuel Guitian, Vicente Soler, Miguel Ángel Rodríguez, Javier Dasti, Ángel Calero
description: In Barcelona the little Luca, orphaned of his father, meets the captain Andrea who gets him out of the trouble into which a false accusation has driven him. Then, unbeknownst to everyone, Luca remains aboard Andrea's ship when it sails. Upon returning to port, Andrea meets Luca's mother, falls in love with her and, after settling some sentimental and professional issues, marries her. With great joy also of the child. Years go by and the love stories that have linked the Nazzari-Sanson couple so many times are no longer so whirlwind and passionate.
notes: The director Matarazzo, who knows his stuff, tells with greater sobriety but with an unchanged grip on his audience.

title: Malombra
actors: Isa Miranda, Andrea Checchi, Irasema Dilian, Gualtiero Tumiati, Nino Crisman, Enzo Biliotti, Ada Dondini, Giacinto Molteni, Corrado Racca, Luigi Pavese, Nando Tamberlani
description: Marina di Malombra, forced by her uncle to live practically a prisoner in a gloomy villa on Lake Como, is believed to be the reincarnation of a suicidal aunt. It will result in the death of his uncle and a writer, a victim of his ambiguous charm. And she will die as her aunt.
notes: After the excellent performance of "Piccolo mondo antico" of the previous year, Mario Soldati brings this other novel by Antonio Fogazzaro to the screen, and still gives a convincing proof of his qualities as a shrewd evocator of atmospheres and an elegant, refined narrator for images, assisted by a group of very effective interpreters.

title: Mambo
actors: Silvana Mangano, Vittorio Gassman, Michael Rennie, Shelley Winters, Katherine Dunham, Mary Clare, Eduardo Ciannelli, Julie Robinson, Walter Zappolini, Xiomara Alfaro
description: Giovanna is engaged to Mario, a little good, and when she is seduced by a Venetian count friend of Mario leaves everyone and becomes a dancer in an exotic ensemble. When Giovanna returns home after a tour, Mario convinces the girl to marry the Venetian count, who has little to live: but Giovanna really falls in love with the count and separates definitively from Mario. The incredible mélo was made on the personality of Silvana Mangano, fresh from Anna's exotic dances, and made for the American public: the result is quite banal, with Gassman in the role of the grinning villain. The winter Venice of backgrounds is saved.

title: The Mambo Kings
actors: Armand Assante, Antonio Banderas, Cathy Moriarty, Maruschka Detmers, Desi Arnaz jr., Pablo Calogero, Scott Cohen, Tito Puente, Celia Cruz, Roscoe Lee Browne
description: Cesar and Nestor are two Cuban brothers who, in 1952, went to New York to gain fame and success on the notes of mambo. During the day they work in a slaughterhouse, at night they play and sing in the clubs. Nestor, the youngest, suffers from nostalgia for his fiancée who, in Havana, has married another. When he falls in love with Dolores everything seems to settle down, but then the story falls and turns into drama. Hollywood debut for the handsome Antonio Banderas. A film (based on a novel by Oscar Hijuelos) opulent and flawless in terms of form, but insignificant in terms of content, all too déja vu. Among the actors Tito Puente and Celia Cruz, two glories of mambo. Good soundtrack, for fans.

title: White Mama
actors: Bette Davis, Ernest Harden jr., Eileen Heckart, Virginia Capers, Anne Ramsey, Lurene Tuttle, Tony Burton, Peg Shirley, Ernie Hudson
description: Estelle Malone (Bette Davis) is a widow without a lira, who lives in a building intended for demolition. To solve her problems she should leave and be witnessed by public organizations, but she does not want to exterior. He meets B. T. Williamson, a black boy, and welcomes him into the house. Touching story, tailor -made for Bette Davis.

title: Home Alone
actors: Macaulay Culkin, Joe Pesci, Daniel Stern, John Heard, Roberts Blossom, Catherine O'Hara, Angela Goethals, Devin Ratray, Gerry Bamman, Hillary Wolf, John Candy
description: Two families of relatives with numerous children are leaving for Paris where they will spend the Christmas holidays. In the frenzy and confusion of the last few minutes little Kevin is "forgotten" at home, considered the most daring of all children. The mother tries in vain to get in touch with him or to go back, but the boy has to fend for himself. He does it very well: with firecrackers, pitch and other devilry he makes two thieves who have broken into the house flee.
notes: The film was one of Hollywood's biggest hits in recent years: children are obviously all the rage, but Joe Pesci and Daniel Stern have contributed ...

title: The Maid
actors: Jacqueline Bisset, Martin Sheen, Jean-Pierre Cassel, Victoria Shalet, James Faulkner, Isabelle Guiard, Dominic Gould, Catherine Lachens, Joe Cosgrove, Carina Barone
description: Jacqueline Bisset is a charming Parisian "career woman", without a husband but with a six-year-old daughter. Martin Sheen is an unattached American, enterprising both at work and privately, on a business trip to the Ville Lumière. For the Yankee it is love at first sight and, to be close to the beautiful lady, she offers herself as a babysitter for the frugoletta. Everything is fine, but he has to find a way to confess something he hasn't told her yet. Fairly brilliant film, even if, all in all, quite predictable. Jacqueline Bisset is always beautiful, Martin Sheen always has class and Paris is always Paris.

title: Mamma Roma
actors: Anna Magnani, Ettore Garofolo, Franco Citti, Silvana Corsini, Luisa Loiano, Paolo Volponi, Luciano Gonini, Vittorio La Paglia, Piero Morgia
description: Mamma Roma is a prostitute who decides to change her life. He takes back his son, entrusted to a family that lives in the province, and goes to live with him in a village in the capital. But the boy gets into trouble and ends up in jail.
notes: The film could be defined with one word: masterpiece. Parable about the humble crushed by the weight of petty bourgeois dreams (well-being ...), proletarian sacredness reflected in the iconographic reference (Masaccio, Mantegna ...), urban architecture raped by the suburbs (barracks, Roman archeology). Anna Magnani's final glance from the window is eternal, her scream is opposite and twin to that of "Rome, open city".

title: Trouble in Paradise
actors: Herbert Marshall, Miriam Hopkins, Kay Francis, Charles Ruggles, Edward Everett Horton, C. Aubrey Smith, Robert Greig
description: Lily and Gaston, a couple of nice and skilled jewelry thieves, sneak into the house of Marianne, a wealthy lady of good Parisian society. The man passes himself off as a secretary while the woman passes herself off as his typist. In love with each other, the two decided to make a steady couple even at work. When Marianne sets her eyes on Gaston she provokes Lily's jealousy and she is forced to bite the brake.
notes: Very refined, hilarious masterpiece of sophisticated comedy, the work of the undisputed master of this genre: Ernst Lubitsch. Based on the comedy "The Honest Finder" by Laszlo Aladar, he made school with his couple of gentlemen thieves, the intertwining of deceptions and misunderstandings.

title: La mandragola
actors: Rosanna Schiaffino, Philippe Leroy, Romolo Valli, Nilla Pizzi, Totò, Jean-Claude Brialy, Armando Bandini, Pia Fioretti, Jacques Herlin, Donato Castellaneta, Ugo Attanasio
description: The pleasure-seeker Callimaco wants at all costs to make his very honest wife of Messer Nicia, a credulous notary. With the help of the parasite Ligurio and the corrupt friar Timoteo, a plot will be hatched that will lead Callimaco to become the lover of Lucrezia, who will throw away the honesty for which she was famous.
notes: From the homonymous comedy by Niccolò Machiavelli, the best known of the Italian sixteenth century, the film partially disperses the ferocious satire, the moral, political and social implications. But it remains an example of Lattuada's black and sensual art, with a superb Schiaffino, an atrocious cynicism and a great Totò.

title: Alraune
actors: Brigitte Helm, Paul Wegener, Ivan Petrovic, Mia Pankau, Wolfgang Zilzer, Louis Ralph, Hans Trautner, John Loder, Valeska Gert, Georg John
description: Alraune is born from the seed of a hanged man who fertilizes a prostitute. The girl has a perverse soul and occult powers: she escapes from the boarding school, runs away with occasional lovers, plays sadistically with the one who caused her birth, making him fall in love with himself and rejecting him, causing his madness. He will wander around the world, damning men. The story is taken from an ancient legend, and is interpreted according to the canons of German silent cinema (contrasted use of lights and shadows, mysterious atmospheres, etc.) and with the contribution of a darkly morbid interpreter, Brigitte Helm.

title: Eath the Rich
actors: Ronald Allen, Sandra Dorne, Jimmy Fagg, Lemmy, Lanah Pellay, Nosher Powell, Fiona Richmond, Ron Tarr, Robbie Coltrane
description: Alex is a black waiter and works in a luxury restaurant in London. For a trifle he is thrown out and thus finds himself penniless and jobless. Alex ponders revenge while the powerful defense minister, an ambiguous and violent character, wins growing popular favor. The political situation precipitates and Alex then decides to make the revolution with some friends. First he takes over his old restaurant by massacring the owners, then he begins to manage it in a rather particular way. Absurd, sarcastic film, with deliberately unnatural situations and characters.

title: Manhattan
actors: Woody Allen, Mariel Hemingway, Diane Keaton, Meryl Streep, Michael Murphy, Anne Byrne Hoffman, Karen Ludwig, Michael O'Donoghue, Victor Truro, Tisa Farrow, Helen Hanft
description: Isaac Davis has stopped writing for TV and is designing a book entitled "The Castrating Zionist"; he has two failed marriages behind him, lives with 17-year-old Tracy (Mariel Hemingway), but is afraid of the ridicule of this relationship. He also fears that his second wife has exposed his flaws in a book that is about to come out. Isaac tries to get his most devoted lover away from himself, he has a brief history with that of a friend of his, but then tries to retrieve Tracy, who in the meantime has decided to leave for Europe.
notes: "Manhattan" is a milestone in Woody Allen's filmography who has now left behind the films of pure comedy and has ventured into the difficult terrain of serious cinema. His digging into the depths, nevertheless, is always flavored with funny jokes, very often with a corrosive humor, and with situations bordering on the grotesque. Celebrate the "10 things worth living for", and then Gordon Willis' Manhattan in black and white ...

title: Manhunter
actors: William Petersen, Tom Noonan, Brian Cox, Kim Greist, Dennis Farina, Joan Allen, Stephen Lang, David Seaman, Benjamin Hendrickson, Michael Talbott
description: Will Graham, a former FBI agent, has retired to private life due to the mental obsessions that have caused him to hunt down cannibal maniac Hannibal Lecter. At the invitation of a colleague, however, he decides to return to work. A new maniac acts in the city, and to catch him Will does not hesitate to turn to the same Dr. Lecter, locked up in prison.
notes: A superb thriller directed by the director of "Insider", superior to the novel from which it is based, "Red Dragon" by Thomas Harris, even in its most exquisitely "literary" aspect. Brian Cox, the big screen's first Hannibal Lecter, is already convincing and diabolical.

title: Mani di velluto
actors: Adriano Celentano, Eleonora Giorgi, Olga Karlatos, John Sharp, Gino Santercole, Memo Dittongo, Ania Pieroni, Giancarlo Tondinelli, Pippo Santonastaso
description: Guido Quiller is a Milanese engineer who owes his immense wealth above all to the invention of a burglar-proof glass that transforms him into an idol of jewelers and enemy number one for thieves. Abandoned by his greedy wife and falling in love with a pickpocket, he manages to conquer her only by giving up his wealth.
notes: The very successful film, which made amazing box office receipts at its Christmas release, focuses on a less boorish comedy than the standard of the Castellano & Pipolo couple and can count on some good ideas. Which does not redeem it from the substantial discountedness of the matter and from the frequent falls in rhythm.

title: Gun Belt
actors: George Montgomery, Tab Hunter, Helen Westcott, John Delmer, William Bishop, Jack Elam, Douglas Kennedy, James Millican, Hugh Sanders
description: Billy Ringo, the bravest of Tombstone's riflemen, decides to hang up his rifle and lead a normal life. The cowboy has met a young milliner and is looking forward to starting a new life. To his misfortune, his brother Matt is not of the same idea as he organizes a bank heist and tries to involve Billy as well. Matt ends up killed and the blame seems to fall on his brother who can barely escape the lynching of the crowd.
notes: A beautiful photograph and a decent script put this western a step above the routine. Chases and shootings are wasted.

title: Maniac Cop 2
actors: Robert Davi, Claudia Christian, Michael Lerner, Bruce Campbell, Laurene Landon, Robert Z'Dar, Clarence Williams III, Leo Rossi, Lou Bonacki, Paula Trickey, Charles Napier
description: Matt Cordell, a murdered police officer in Sing Sing where he was locked up after a rigged trial by the police chief himself, has risen and sows death in the city. Susan Riley, a cop-psychologist, doesn't believe it: worse for her. Teaming up with Turkey, a serial killer, Matt takes her hostage. But as he pursues his revenge plan, Matt ends up colliding with Turkey ... From a bold B movie specialist, a curious detective horror. Screenplay and direction are not looking for psychological subtleties, but aim directly at the pressing action and the most blatant spectacular effects.

title: Maniac Cop
actors: Robert Z'Dar, Tom Atkins, Bruce Campbell, Laurene Landon, Richard Roundtree, William Smith, Sheree North, Nina Arvesen, Nick Barbaro, Lou Bonacki
description: Protected by a police uniform, a strongman kills the unfortunates he meets on his way. Circumstances lead to the accusation of a department agent, hastily jailed to appease public anger. The man is slaughtered by the inmates and returns from the afterlife as a zombie to bring death and destruction.
notes: Lustig, author of the beautiful "Maniac", gives us a concentrate of blood emotions by mixing the "slasher" with the parody of the super cops of the 80s. Produced by Larry Cohen ("Baby Killer", "Final Challenge"), another important name in genre cinema. But it is not the sequel to "Maniac Cop": on the contrary, it is the exact opposite. >

title: Mannaja
actors: Maurizio Merli, Philippe Leroy, Martine Brochard, John Steiner, Sonja Jeannine, Donald O'Brien, Salvatore Puntillo, Antonio Casale, Enzo Fiermonte, Rik Battaglia, Aldo Rendine
description: They call him Mannaja because he uses the ax with the skill of a juggler.
notes: Sergio Martino - with a few years of delay compared to the flowering of the trend - injects some horror mood into the western spaghetti thus favoring the fashion of contaminating the different genres. The result is passable.

title: Mannequin
actors: Andrew McCarthy, Kim Cattrall, Estelle Getty, James Spader, G.W. Bailey, Carole Davis, Steve Vinovich, Christopher Maher, Meshach Taylor, Phyllis Newman
description: After doing a thousand jobs, losing them all due to an excess of ideas, Jonathan manages to get hired at a department store. Here he comes into contact with a strange mannequin who, when they are alone, comes to life and reveals to be the reincarnation of an Egyptian princess of the pharaonic era. Jonathan, thanks to the charm of the mannequin, leads the warehouse to success and arouses the jealousy of the competitors. These first try to make him look crazy and then to destroy the mannequin: but it's all in vain. The story develops hackneyed ideas; in turn, the jokes, which could give a little salt to the farce, are not even funny: to be forgotten.

title: Puzzle of a Downfall Child
actors: Faye Dunaway, Viveca Lindfors, Roy Scheider, Barry Primus, Barry Morse, Ruth Jackson, John Heffernan, Sydney Walker, Clark Burckhalter
description: Rapid rise and equally sudden fall of a supermodel. Success comes very soon, but brings with it the seeds of madness when it upsets private life. The setting in the world of fashion is interesting, the story itself less convincing.

title: La mano della morta
actors: María Martín, Carlo Ninchi, Adriano Rimoldi, Renato De Carmine, Germana Paolieri, Saro Urzì, Marisa Mari, Ernesto Sabbatini, Raffaele Pindinelli
description: A little girl was picked up by a gypsy from the corpse of her mother, whose hand had been cut off. The culprit is a nobleman, Count Altieri, and his name is revealed to the girl who was raised by the gypsies under the name of Satanella. The girl makes Altieri's son fall in love with himself and reduces him to poverty; in this way he also ruins the daughter of the enemy, who must marry a usurer. Effective version of a well-known popular novel by Carolina Invernizio. Drama of undeniable grip.

title: La mano dello straniero
actors: Trevor Howard, Alida Valli, Richard Basehart, Eduardo Ciannelli, Richard O'Sullivan, Stephen Murray, Arnoldo Foà, Guido Celano, Giorgio Costantini
description: Roger, the son of a British major, has an appointment with his father in a hotel in Venice. At the appointed time, however, the father does not show up and a long adventure begins for the child. Graham Greene wrote and co-produced this film shot in Italy, which re-proposes the themes and atmospheres of "Broken Idol" (the child) and "The Third Man" (the international conspiracy). It falls short of the two, although the odd hybrid is not without its charm.

title: Black Hand
actors: Gene Kelly, J. Carrol Naish, Teresa Celli, Mark Lawrence, Frank Puglia, Barry Kelley, Mario Siletti, Carl Milletaire, Peter Brocco, Eleonora von Mendelssohn
description: The lawyer Colombo was killed by the criminals of an organization called the Black Hand that dominates the Italian neighborhood of New York. The son Johnny would like to have his father's killers arrested but hit a wall of silence; only the policeman Lorelli, also of Italian origin, is close to him. The two carry out investigations together between the United States and Naples; here Lorelli comes into possession of important documents but is killed. Johnny also falls into the hands of criminals, but frees himself and manages to send the evidence to the judiciary. Kelly does not dance this time but lends herself to a detective story full of twists and adventures. Also known as "The law of silence", vaguely inspired by the Italian-American policeman Joe Petrosino.

title: Manon des sources
actors: Yves Montand, Daniel Auteuil, Emmanuelle Béart, Hippolyte Girardot, Margarita Lozano, Yvonne Gamy, Ticky Holgado, Jean Bouchaud, Elisabeth Depardieu
description: Ten years have passed since the death of Jean de Florette. Ugolin enriched himself with the carnation trade and declares his love to Manon, who rejects him. To avenge her father, the girl stops the spring that feeds the village and publicly accuses Papet and Ugolin of Jean's murder. Desperate, Ugolin hangs himself. When Papet learns that in reality Jean de Florette was his son, the blow will be very hard for him: he will let himself die, leaving all his assets to Manon, his niece and only heir. From the dramatic realism that characterized the first part (Jean de Florette), Berry moves to a different, almost fabulous register, losing much of the emotional charge along the way. To underline however the excellent performance of the good actor Daniel Auteuil (Ugolin).

title: Le Mans - Scorciatoia per l'inferno
actors: Lang Jeffries, Erna Schurer, Maurizio Bonuglia, Edwige Fenech, Franco Borelli, Roberto Messina, Franco Pesce, Paola Iacopucci, Marcello Di Paolo
description: The car champion John Scott after an accident with many victims at Le Mans no longer races but raises other drivers and becomes a manufacturer. His protégé, Dustin Rich, looks promising, but also tries to replace him in his wife's heart. When Dustin wins a car built by John, everything will work out for the best. Trivial copying of films that are "American" by definition (in the sense that they know how to make them and the others don't): weak in suspense, modestly spectacular, almost childish in the definition of the characters. More than a sprint film, a film that runs on charcoal.

title: The Deadly Mantis
actors: Craig Stevens, Alix Talton, William Hopper, Donald Randolph, Pat Conway, Florenz Ames, Paul Smith, Phil Harvey, Floyd Simmons
description: After a series of mysterious disasters and destruction at an Arctic military base, it is discovered that a giant and ravenous mantis is haunting the region. The monstrous insect, against which Colonel Parkman hires a deadly hunt, heads for New York. Discreet, though not exciting. Old science fiction that fans always like.

title: Marakatumba... ma non è una rumba!
actors: Renato Rascel, Marylin Buferd, Paolo Stoppa, Mario Carotenuto, Aristide Baghetti, Felice Chiusano, Tata Giacobetti, Lucia Mannucci, Virgilio Savona, Fiorenzo Fiorentini
description: The accountant Filippo De Bellis is mysteriously appointed universal heir to the fortunes of an uncle who lives in the countryside. In reality it is a plot by the farmer's daughter to get hold of the sum by marrying Philip. But he loves Ester, a variety dancer who, after a duel with the farmer's daughter, will marry her Filippo.
notes: Light film shot on the aria of the hit songs of the Quartetto Cetra, and on the popularity of Renato Rascel. There is a little yellow about the direction: it is usually attributed to Enzo Trapani (who confirmed), but in the titles there is instead the name of Edmondo Lozzi.

title: Run for Your Life
actors: David Carradine, Lauren Hutton, George Segal, Franco Nero, Sabine Sun, Anthony Dawson, Jill Pearson, Gregg Stewart
description: The American major Forsyth, an iron officer serving in Rome with the NATO forces, is a passionate lover of the marathon. Bossy and rigid to the point of excess, Forsyth sees his marriage go into crisis when his wife becomes interested in another marathon runner. Curious but not exciting film by the English Terence Young known for the first three films of the 007 series. Convincing interpretation of David Carradine in the role of the disturbing major married to the always charming Lauren Hutton, former lover of Richard Gere in American Gigolo.

title: Marcelino pan y vino
actors: Pablito Calvo, Rafael Rivelles, Antonio Vico, Juan Calvo, Rafael Calvo, José Marco Davó, Juanjo Menendez, Adriano Domínguez, Mariano Azaña, Joaquín Roa
description: The friars of a Spanish convent find an abandoned baby under the cabbages of their garden. They raise him in the convent: Marcellin grows up, good and God-fearing. In moments of solitude he feels a great nostalgia for his mother he has never known and therefore comes to speak with a large wooden crucifix and offers him bread and wine. The Lord answers him and is animated for him. The friars witness the miracle in disbelief just before seeing Marcellin "fall asleep" forever.
notes: The story (also taken up by the Italian director Luigi Comencini) caused a sensation at the time; he moved half the world and made his little interpreter, Pablito Calvo, a real star.

title: Marcellino pane e vino
actors: Nicolò Paolucci, Fernando Fernán Gómez, Alberto Cracco, Ida Di Benedetto, Roberto Herlitzka, Didier Bénureau, Sergio Bini Bustric, Ernesto Lama, Thierry Nenez, Francesco Scali, Francesco Siciliano
description: It is the remake of the Spanish film, directed in 1955 by the Hungarian Ladislao Vajda and based on the novel by J.M. Sanchez Silva. We are in 1600, and an orphan is raised by the friars of a convent. An offspring count tries to pass him off as his son, but Marcellin escapes from the castle and returns to the convent. Here he has as a friend a crucifix with whom he talks and to whom he brings wine and bread. By him he will be taken to heaven, where he will find his much desired mother. Despite the addition of all the part concerning the count, the film, flat and running, is worth much less than the previous one. Comencini was a specialist for films with children. Once.

title: Il Marchese del Grillo
actors: Alberto Sordi, Paolo Stoppa, Flavio Bucci, Riccardo Billi, Caroline Berg, Camillo Milli, Cochi Ponzoni, Marc Porel, Pietro Tordi, Leopoldo Trieste
description: The Marquis Onofrio del Grillo, Duke of Bracciano, is the typical representative of the Roman papal nobility of the nineteenth century. Joyful and lover of jokes, devoted but sarcastic even with the Pope, he discovers a double of his in a tavern who risks (but as a joke) to end up beheaded in his place ...
notes: A Monicelli in a minor tone, which faces a context and a story more in the strings of Luigi Zampa but all oriented towards the comic and enjoyment aspects. The Tuscan director proves to rely almost entirely on the verve of the performers. Sordi is good, but who stands out the most is Paolo Stoppa in the role of the Pope.

title: Scars of Dracula
actors: Christopher Lee, Dennis Waterman, Jenny Hanley, Patrick Troughton, Christopher Matthews, Michael Gwynn, Michael Ripper, Wendy Hamilton, Anouska Hempel
description: In vain the villagers tried to burn Count Dracula, responsible for the death of a girl, alive. Dracula survived, took up residence in a castle and claimed victims among visitors. The young Simon, learning that the count is responsible for the death of his brother, confronts him and is about to have the worst: but a bolt of lightning strikes the monster which, engulfed in flames, falls from the battlements of the castle. One of the last films with the famous vampire produced by Hammer, the English house that has specialized in horror cinema with excellent results. Dracula is still Christopher Lee, his best performer.

title: Il marchio di Kriminal
actors: Glenn Saxon, Helga Liné, Andrea Bosic, Armando Francioli, Tomás Picó, Evi Rigano, Anna Zinnemann, Franca Dominici, Ugo Sasso
description: Of the map with the indications to recover two precious paintings, the bandit Kriminal owns only a part; the other is in the hands of Mara and Robson, two adventurers. The three reach an ephemeral agreement that as soon as the loot is recovered leads to a bloody showdown. At times the film tries to laugh at an irremediably conventional story.

title: Branded
actors: Alan Ladd, Mona Freeman, Charles Bickford, Robert Keith, Joseph Calleia, Peter Hansen, Selena Royle, Tom Tully, John Berkes
description: Choya, a young man wanted by the law, passes himself off as the son of an owner named Lavery, who was kidnapped as a child. He agrees with the kidnapper, who the boy was stolen by another bandit. The two want to get their hands on Lavery's wealth in this way. But at the most beautiful, love redeems Choya, despite the risks she will face for this reason.
notes: More psychological than action western, which provides Alan Ladd with one of his best rehearsals.

title: La marcia su Roma
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Ugo Tognazzi, Roger Hanin, Mario Brega, Angela Luce, Gérard Landry, Alberto Vecchietti, Claudio Perone
description: In the first post-war period Domenico Rocchetti, a veteran who lives by expedients, decides to join the fascist movement after meeting one of his old unemployed captain. Both participate in numerous punitive actions and prepare for the march on Rome. They requisition a car to reach the comrades. Once in the capital they run away and everyone believes they have fallen heroically. They reappear when fascism is in power and is giving itself a legality; they are still tied to the squad spirit and for this reason they are confined to a desert island.
notes: Risi tells, between satire and caricature, a fragment of the history of Italy. A little superficial but funny, especially for the characterization of the two protagonists.

title: East Side, West Side
actors: James Mason, Barbara Stanwyck, Ava Gardner, Van Heflin, Cyd Charisse, Nancy Davis, Gale Sondergaard, William Conrad, Raymond Greenleaf, Douglas Kennedy
description: Brandon Bourne (Mason) is a businessman, married to Jessie (Stanwyck), who cannot forget his past relationship with Isabel (Gardner). When he finds her in a nightclub, dressed in silk, languidly leaning against a piano, the troubles start again. One evening the two women have a crucial explanation and shortly thereafter Isabel is found dead; Brandon is charged with murder. How not to side with James Mason against the insignificant Van Heflin? Yet it is he, in the guise of the policeman, to score the winning blow. Morbid and sensual Noir, with an epic Ava-Barbara clash.

title: The Sea of Grass
actors: Katharine Hepburn, Spencer Tracy, Melvyn Douglas, Robert Walker, Phyllis Thaxter, Edgar Buchanan, Harry Carey, Ruth Nelson
description: The owner of immense prairies, opposed to progress, marries Lucia, a girl raised in the city. The husband has a deep love for his lands, but is convinced that subjecting them to intense exploitation is a mistake and is doomed to failure. Lucia has a completely different opinion and this helps to alienate the two. The woman, threatened by a judge, an opponent of her husband, has a moment of weakness and gives in. Based on the novel by Conrad Richter and written by Marguerite Roberts and Vincent Lawrence, the film has the ideal interpreter in Spencer Tracy. Elia Kazan, here in his second direction, already hits the mark.

title: Comment draguer toutes les filles
actors: Emmanuel Karsen, Yves Thuiller, Marco Perrin, Charlotte Walior, Jean-Luc Azra, Claudine Delvaux, Bernard Dumaine, Liliane Ponzio
description: In Deauville, on the French coast, three friends meet to spend a weekend there: Alain, Olivier and Erik. The three challenge each other to a particular type of hunt: that of girls. Between theory (a lot) and practice (little) the three some time later find themselves in a Parisian park with three ... baby carriages. Is there any moralism in this film? Maybe. The three, however, somewhat deserve this retaliation.

title: Mare matto
actors: Gina Lollobrigida, Jean-Paul Belmondo, Tomas Milian, Odoardo Spadaro, Noël Roquevert, Piero Morgia, Vincenzo Musolino, Anita Durante, Rossana Di Rocco
description: In Genoa, in the streets of the port, a group of sailors of all ages meet at Margherita's pension. They all have to board a ship that has to transport a consignment of wine to Sicily. During the voyage, all kinds of things happen: the captain is arrested, the sailors decide to continue the voyage alone and, caught in a storm, they have to throw the load into the sea.
notes: Renato Castellani does not find the vein of his best films and the story appears a bit stretched despite the commitment of the actors.

title: Camille
actors: Greta Garbo, Robert Taylor, Lionel Barrymore, Elizabeth Allan, Jessie Ralph, Henry Daniell, Lenore Ulric, Laura Hope Crews, Rex O'Malley
description: Margherita Gauthier leads a social life in nineteenth-century Paris. Falling in love with the young provincial Armando, she is convinced by his father to end a relationship that compromises the good name of the family. Margherita makes Armando jealous who leaves her. He will find out the truth too late.
notes: The Hollywood brand in the season of the greatest splendor of its stars. The real inspirer of the work was the producer Irving Thalberg, who died at 37 without having time to enjoy the finished work. Dumas's novel inspired a dozen films including Carmine Gallone's "Traviata". Do we want to say something about Greta Garbo?

title: Mary of Scotland
actors: Katharine Hepburn, Fredric March, John Carradine, Florence Eldridge, Douglas Walton, Robert Barrat, Gavin Muir, Ian Keith, Moroni Olsen
description: Mary Queen of Scots (Katharine Hepburn) returns to Scotland to ascend the throne. Opposed by the nobility, she marries Lord Darnley for convenience, but soon discovers that he is a tool of her adversaries, and leaves him. When her second husband is the victim of a conspiracy, Mary takes refuge with Elizabeth of England, but her suspicious cousin has her executed. Intense historical drama played on the psychological and moral confrontation between Mary, the Lords led by James, and Elizabeth. In a talented cast, Hepburn, recently in her career, is already a master of measurement. The excellent photograph is by the great Joseph H. August. Finale from anthology with Maria in front of her accusers.

title: Marinai, donne e guai
actors: Maurizio Arena, Abbe Lane, Ugo Tognazzi, Lauretta Masiero, Raimondo Vianello, Rossella Como, Riccardo Billi, Giampiero Littera, Julio Riscal
description: Maurizio, Raffaele, Pietro and Domenico are part of the crew of an Italian destroyer calling at Barcelona. Distrusted by the foreman to stay away from local women, the four are however entangled by Manuela, who is part of a gang of smugglers, in an intrigue hatched to favor the girl's accomplices in their shady trades.
notes: On the horizon there is an idea as ambitious as it is completely disproportionate to the actual capacity of the filmmakers: to copy the "musical" made in the USA. In practice, the result is only childishly pathetic.

title: Marinai in coperta
actors: Little Tony, Spela Rozin, Ferruccio Amendola, Lucio Flauto, Ignazio Leone, Liliana Chiari, Léa Nanni, Nino Scardina, Enrico Ciacci
description: Antonio is trying to become a successful singer when suddenly he has to leave for military service in the navy. He makes friends with Lucio, the son of an industrialist, and with Ferruccio, who hopes to win the case concerning an inheritance. The three are engaged to as many girls: Ferruccio will console himself for the lack of wealth with love; Lucio will end up buying a bar; Antonio will be able to fulfill his dreams by signing an advantageous contract with a record company.
notes: Singing film, whose slender story has only a supporting role: the important thing was to have Little Tony perform his hits of the moment, between one gag and another.

title: Marisa la civetta
actors: Marisa Allasio, Renato Salvatori, Francisco Rabal, Angel Aranda, Ettore Manniu, Luz Márquez, Maria Cuadra, Giancarlo Zarfati, Ennio Girolami, Polidor
description: Marisa is an open and casual girl who sells ice cream at the station. Almost all the local boys flirt with her, but Marisa makes fun of them. One day he meets a sailor and a certain sympathy is immediately established between the two. Due to a series of misunderstandings, the two end up separating, but only to understand that they can no longer do without each other.
notes: Bolognini made a name for himself on the Italian cinema scene with a group of light comedies, but already in these works one can glimpse, in the cleanness of the touch and in the care of the dialogues, the formal quality that distinguishes his most committed cinema and theatrical direction. Not surprisingly, Pier Paolo Pasolini is among the screenwriters.

title: I mariti
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, Mariella Lotti, Irma Gramatica, Clara Calamai, Giulio Stival, Roberto Villa, Rubi D'Alma, Sandro Ruffini
description: Countess Emma, ??secretly in love with the Count of Riverbella, is forced by her family to marry the lawyer Fabio Regoli who will not be noble, but is honest. Riverbella in fact gets framed for fraud, but Fabio assumes his defense and gets him acquitted. So Emma's sister gets into trouble with a Don Juan, who is also a count, and once again Fabio resolves the situation by challenging him to a duel.
notes: Comedy in costume written by the prolific Alessandro De Stefani, playwright who eventually joined Salò. Typical of many regime films the exaltation of bourgeois virtues against aristocratic decadence. The direction of Mastrocinque is correct and supports the actors with grace.

title: Mariti in città
actors: Nino Taranto, Renato Salvatori, Memmo Carotenuto, Giorgia Moll, Franca Valeri, Marisa Merlini, Irene Cefaro, Hélène Remy, Dolores Palumbo, Franca Gandolfi
description: "Seasonal" film, in the sense that it narrates the attempted extramarital adventures of boys wishing to make the most of the absence of their respective spouses, far from the home due to holidays. For one who does something, the others go systematically blank. And we end up discovering that the best is still the quiet and codified "routine" of the family.
notes: The film is nice and light. A thin texture and, on this, a dull colored embroidery. The cast is a guarantee.

title: Mariti in pericolo
actors: Sylva Koscina, Mario Carotenuto, Memmo Carotenuto, Franca Valeri, Pupella Maggio, Nietta Zocchi, Dolores Palumbo, Franco Sportelli, Carlo Pisacane
description: Two business partners lose their minds over the same girl, causing the inevitable ire of their wives. The strange thing is that while one of the spouses goes on a rampage, the other takes it with a lot of philosophy. Could it also have something to hide? At this point the husband, eaten up by the worm of jealousy, begins to spy on the woman's movements and discovers ... of everything.
notes: Despite the commendable efforts of comedy professionals such as Franca Valeri and the Carotenuto brothers, the story fails to take off. The fault of a well-known script and a completely anonymous direction.

title: The Model and the Marriage Broker
actors: Thelma Ritter, Jeanne Crain, Zero Mostel, Scott Brady, Michael O'Shea, Helen Ford, Frank Fontaine, Dennie Moore, John Alexander
description: Mae Swasey runs a marriage agency and takes her job as a mission. When arranging the meeting between Kitty, a charming model, and Matt, a young radiologist, he avoids telling the girl that this is her job. Kitty finds out, feels teased and cuts off relations with Mae.
notes: It is not the best of George Cukor, but it is still a skillfully articulated and brilliantly conducted film, in which the interpretation of a superlative Thelma Ritter in the role of Mae stands out in an already very pleasant ensemble.

title: Il marito
actors: Alberto Sordi, Aurora Bautista, Carlo Ninchi, Marcello Giorda, Luigi Tosi, Alberto De Amicis, Delia Luna, Laly Blanch
description: Alberto is a young building contractor fresh from marriage. The wife is not only jealous but also extraordinarily attached to her family of origin: in fact she forces Alberto to live with her mother-in-law and sister-in-law. Business is not going well and for Alberto salvation would be represented by a beautiful widow: but his wife, jealous, makes everything upset. Alberto changes jobs, he will become a confectionery salesman: so he can woo all the girls he wants, making his wife and mother-in-law happy at the same time.
notes: Modest comedy of manners in which Sordi fails to give the best of himself, and Loy and Puccini neither.

title: Le mari de la coiffeuse
actors: Anna Galiena, Jean Rochefort, Roland Bertin, Maurice Chevit, Philippe Clévenot, Jacques Mathou, Claude Aufaure, Albert Delpy, Henry Hocking
description: As a kid, Antoine was secretly in love with a busty hairdresser and never missed an opportunity to spend a few hours in his shop spying on her. As an adult he remained with an erotic obsession with that woman, perhaps also because she had died suddenly in the prime of her age. Now Antoine has married a busty hairdresser and spends most of the day in the shop in erect skirmishes with his wife between a shampoo and a haircut for customers. Here, too, fate lurks. Well acted and excellently directed, it is the film that confirmed Rochefort's international stature and revealed Anna Galiena's talent. Very pleasant.

title: Marito e moglie
actors: Eduardo De Filippo, Tina Pica, Titina De Filippo, Riccardo Frera, Amedeo Girardi, Ellida Lorini, Luciana Vedovelli, Giuseppe Pica
description: Don Matteo, nailed to the bed by paralysis, is forced by his wife, Donna Rosalia, to hatch the eggs of the chicken coop, devastated by a death. Gennarino, tired of the monotonous family environment, hopes for a less demeaning life.
notes: They are two sketches, without any particular commitment, but not without meaning. Desolate the first, with Eduardo the hen-man and Tina Pica greedy wife; the second is more serene, where Eduardo still tries to escape from a disheartening reality. In this second episode, there is the great Titina as the protagonist's wife. Minor film by De Filippo, however rich in humanity and splendidly acted.

title: An Ideal Husband
actors: Paulette Goddard, Michael Wilding, Hugh Williams, Diana Wynyard, C. Aubrey Smith, Glynis Johns, Constance Collier, Christine Norden, Harriette Johns
description: It is the film adaptation of one of the most famous plays by Oscar Wilde (1854-1900), which tells of an important politician who, in his youth, committed serious professional misconduct. Now he enjoys a reputation for uncompromising honesty, but when an adventurer blackmails him for his distant guilt, he finds himself in a difficult situation ...
notes: Some refinement of the original version for the theater has been lost, but the realization is more than decent.

title: Lost and Found
actors: George Segal, Glenda Jackson, Maureen Stapleton, Hollis McLaren, John Cunningham, Paul Sorvino, Ken Pogue, Janie Sell, Diana Barrington, Leslie Carlson, John Candy
description: Him, Adam Watson, American professor who has been widowed for six months. She, Patricia Brittenhame English, recently divorced: "thanks" to two accidents, one car, one skiing, they know each other, then they quarrel, make peace, fall in love, get married. However, the marriage menage does not work and she leaves him, but, thanks to a fake suicide, which risks becoming real, the two reconcile. Although the director of the film Melvin Frank said he couldn't stand the sequels, it was irresistible to bring the Segal / Jackson duo back to the screen, after the Oscar earned with A Touch of Class. The result is a pleasantly gigione film.

title: Houseboat
actors: Cary Grant, Sophia Loren, Edoardo Ciannelli, Martha Hyer, Harry Guardino, Murray Hamilton, Mimi Gibson, Paul Petersen, Charles Herbert
description: Tom Winston is an American lawyer who, after being widowed, takes his three children with him, reluctant to live with him. One evening he takes them to a concert by maestro Zaccardi, the tyrant father of a rebellious daughter: Cinzia. That same evening both Cinzia and Robert (son of the lawyer) flee from their respective parents; they meet and the girl takes Robert home. From here begins a relationship of sympathy between Cinzia and Tom's children, so much so that he hires the girl as a housekeeper. After various misadventures, Tom falls in love with Cinzia ...
notes: Comedy for families with a happy ending in perfect 1950s American style, with a nice and unlikely Loren.

title: Un marito per il mese di aprile
actors: Vanna Vanni, Carlo Romano, Vera Carmi, Pina Renzi, Guglielmo Sinaz, Romolo Costa, Fausto Guerzoni, Guido Morisi, Renato Malavasi
description: Reduced on the pavement from the passion of the game, a young man accepts a strange engagement by a girl haunted by a suitor: for a month she must pretend to be her husband and discourage the suitor. Consciously concluded the task, he will discover that he is at ease in the part of her.
notes: A frail and sometimes dangerous story, saved by the good test of the actors.

title: The Big Sleep
actors: Robert Mitchum, Sarah Miles, Richard Boone, Candy Clark, Joan Collins, Edward Fox, John Mills, James Stewart, Oliver Reed, Harry Andrews, Colin Blakely
description: General Sternwood asks for the intervention of Philip Marlowe, private detective, to put an end to the blackmail of his daughter Camilla. The investigation leads Marlowe to deal with the disappearance, which occurred some time ago, of Rusty, husband of Charlotte, Camilla's sister. At the cost of numerous victims, the truth eventually comes out.
notes: Based on the novel of the same name by Raymond Chandler, already masterfully brought to the screen by Howard Hawks in 1946, the film follows the same lines. Robert Mitchum, in his second interpretation of Marlowe after the best "Marlowe, the Private Cop," is austere and thoughtful.

title: The Sad Sack
actors: Jerry Lewis, David Wayne, Phyllis Kirk, Peter Lorre, Joe Mantell, Gene Evans, George Dolenz, Liliane Montevecchi, Shepperd Strudwick
description: Bisby is not a soldier, he is a landslide. To prevent him from making further trouble, he is first entrusted to the care of a psychologist, then to the custody of two corporals. But all of this doesn't stop Bisby from being duped by a group of thugs who are trying to sell a new type of machine gun to a warring sultan. The two corporals, with the addition of a dancer, will save him just in time. Loosely inspired by the military comics of "Sad Sack", it is not an irresistible film, despite Jerry Lewis.

title: Marnie
actors: Tippi Hedren, Sean Connery, Diane Baker, Martin Gabel, Louise Latham, Alan Napier, Bob Sweeney, Milton Selzer, Henry Beckman, Edith Evanson
description: Marnie is a thief who changes her identity after every theft. She is recognized by Mark, who falls in love with her, and confronts her with the alternative of prison or marriage. She agrees to marry him, but she is neurotic, frigid, and subject to terrible nightmares. Mark is determined to find out what this series of neuroses caused Marnie.
notes: One of Hitchcock's most extreme films, albeit outside of its heyday. Sean Connery, in the year of "Goldfinger", is forced to use force with a woman - a scandal for many fans - but then devotes himself to understanding the psychological dynamics that are stirring in his partner's unconscious. The story is morbid and terrible. Some scenes are masterful (all the initial part), the final revelation questionable.

title: Morocco
actors: Marlene Dietrich, Gary Cooper, Adolphe Menjou, Francis McDonald, Ullrich Haupt, Eve Southern, Paul Porcasi
description: Amy Jolly (Marlene Dietrich), a cabaret singer in Spanish Morocco, is torn between a wealthy amateur painter (Adolphe Menjou) and a glamorous French legionnaire (Gary Cooper). The dialogues and the actors are splendid. It is the first film made by Marlene in Hollywood, immediately after "The Blue Angel", also directed by Von Sternberg. The over-the-top baroque style and exotic setting create the film's distinctive charm.

title: Marrakech Express
actors: Diego Abatantuono, Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Giuseppe Cederna, Gigio Alberti, Cristina Marsillach, Massimo Venturiello, Corinna Agustoni, Antonio Carlucci, Ugo Conti, Hassan Koubba
description: Four thirty-year-olds, former sixties, meet again after ten years when a Spanish girl announces that Rudy, the fifth of the group, is in prison in Marrakech because he was found in possession of a kilo of hashish. Not too enthusiastic, the four raise thirty million to pay the bail, and set off for Morocco. Between different, fun adventures, the four rediscover their relationships of the past, and go on a journey in search of themselves. Abatantuono, Bentivoglio, Cederna and Alberti interpret these characters with a participatory acting, directed with cunning by Salvatores.

title: Martha et moi
actors: Marianne Sägebrecht, Michel Piccoli, Václav Chalupa, Klaus Grünberg, Michael Kausch, Jana Altmanová, Vladimír Brabec
description: Back in the Czechoslovakian village where he lived as a child with his uncle, Emil remembers those years. Uncle Ernst, a pleasure-seeking gynecologist of Jewish origin, married, amid the general scandal, his maid, a fat German woman, shy and with a heart of gold, of very humble origins. With the advent of Nazism, however, the family falls apart. Marta's brothers, pro-Nazi fanatics, forcibly separate her from Ernst even though she would have preferred to share his fate rather than abandon him.
notes: Excellent example of memory cinema. Between idyll and drama, it is a bittersweet elegy of old Europe. In the great tradition of Czechoslovakian cinema.

title: Marty
actors: Ernest Borgnine, Betsy Blair, Esther Minciotti, Karen Steele, Augusta Ciolli, Joe Mantell, Jerry Paris
description: Marty Piletti is thirty-five years old, he is Italian American, he works as a butcher and lives with his old mother. His sisters and brothers got married and left home a long time ago. Big and shy, he fears he will not find any girl to marry him and because of this he is harassed by his mother. Then, one day, he meets a young woman with many affinities and becomes another. Mom and friends, however, preferred it as it was before.
notes: Excellent interpreters, firm direction and, above all, popular freshness in the dialogues. for a film whose realism made school.
