Based on a telepley by Paddy Chayefsky, who wrote it, the film won the Palme d'Or at Cannes and four Oscars: film, direction, screenplay and interpretation (the extraordinary Ernest Borgnine).

title: Maruzzella
actors: Marisa Allasio, Massimo Serato, Yvette Lebon, Renato Carosone, Gegé Di Giacomo
description: Secretly in love with Salvatore, who still considers her a child, Maruzzella is shocked when she discovers that Salvatore is the lover of her stepmother and runs away to Rome to two musicians. The stepmother, who also has an affair with a shady accountant, dies with him in an accident. Salvatore finally opens his eyes and runs to marry Maruzzella.
notes: Renato Carosone's song which gives the title to the film is famous. The screenplay is signed by Capuano himself in collaboration with Alfredo Giannetti. Carosone himself and Gegé Di Giacomo are the two musicians who are friends of Maruzzella (the beautiful Marisa Allasio).

title: Mary Poppins
actors: Julie Andrews, Dick Van Dyke, David Tomlinson, Glynis Johns, Hermione Baddeley, Reta Shaw, Karen Dotrice, Matthew Garber, Elsa Lanchester, Arthur Treacher, Reginald Owen, Ed Wynn, Jane Darwell
description: The housekeeper of the two brothers Banks has resigned and confusion reigns supreme in the house. The father has little faith in the abilities of his young and naive wife, a suffragette who has only female claims in mind. Invoked by the two children, Mary Poppins, a strange lady with a hat and umbrella who combines all colors, descends from heaven. Magically....
notes: One of Disney's greatest hits, a film that time does not seem to have worn out. Live characters, animated drawings, songs and music form an excellent "mix", kept in perfect balance by the director. Sparkling Julie Andrews, at her debut, awarded with the Oscar (the film won 5: in addition to Andrews: editing, special effects, song column and the famous song "Chim Chim Chee Ree", aka "Cam Caminì").

title: Visit to a Small Planet
actors: Jerry Lewis, Joan Blackman, Earl Holliman, Fred Clark, John Williams, Jerome Cowan, Gale Gordon, Lee Patrick, Milton Frome, Ellen Corby
description: A Martian arrives on earth to study its uses and customs. Hosted by a TV host, he falls in love with his daughter and convinces his father of the existence of extraterrestrials, but the reaction of the girl's boyfriend convinces him to return to Mars. Enjoyable satire, in a sort of reverse science fiction, of the great Jerry Lewis.

title: Tha Masks of Death
actors: Peter Cushing, John Mills, Anne Baxter, Ray Milland, Anton Diffring, Gordon Jackson, Susan Penhaligon, Marcus Gilbert, Jenny Laird
description: In 1913 Sherlock Holmes has now retired to private life. However, he is persuaded to take an interest again in a case: the mysterious death of some harmless leftovers from society. With the faithful Doctor Watson, Holmes discovers that the matter is very complex and infinitely dangerous. Indeed, the very survival of London is in danger.
notes: Classic thriller of television production with a deliberate - and anything but banal - sense of senescence, which is well suited to the period in which it is set. Cushing is one of the best Holmes on the screen.

title: The Masque of the Red Death
actors: Vincent Price, Hazel Court, Jane Asher, David Weston, Nigel Green, Patrick Magee, Paul Whitsun-Jones, Robert Brown, Julian Burton
description: Prince Prospero reigns as tyrant over the population. He lives in a castle in southern Italy in whose rooms, each of a different color, entertains relations with Satan himself, dedicating himself to the demonic cult. Two commoners rebel against his tyranny, but are captured and sentenced to death. Francesca, respectively daughter and girlfriend of the two, asks for their pardon. The despot cruelly grants it to him for only one: which of the two affections to choose? Stylistically and figuratively precious reduction (Nicholas Roeg's photography is based entirely on shades ranging from pink to violet) of two of Poe's stories ("The Mask of the Red Death" and "Hop-frog").

title: House of Wax
actors: Vincent Price, Phillys Kirk, Frank Lovejoy, Carolyn Jones, Paul Picerni, Roy Roberts, Angela Clarke, Paul Cavanagh, Dabbs Greer, Charles Bronson
description: Professor Jarrow (Price), owner of the wax museum, was horribly disfigured in the fire of the museum itself, which was started by one of his partners to collect the insurance. The museum reopens and the statues are more beautiful: in fact they are obtained this time by pouring hot wax on human bodies captured by Jarrow, who in turn wears a wax mask to mask the scars. A girl discovers the truth. The subject had already been used for a film in the 1930s: the new version is in color and was originally made in three dimensions. Price begins a long career in horror cinema, and in one particle is Charles Bronson (still with the surname Buchinsky).

title: The Mask of Dimitrios
actors: Peter Lorre, Sidney Greenstreet, Zachary Scott, Faye Emerson, Victor Francen, Steven Geray, Florence Bates, Eduardo Ciannelli, Kurt Katch
description: We are in Istanbul, a city of a thousand trades, a crossroads for bandits of all kinds and from all backgrounds. The body of a criminal, a certain Dimitrios Makropoulos, is found in the Bosphorus. A writer takes an interest in the case and gets into trouble.
notes: The film is based on the novel of the same name by Eric Ambler, one of the greatest writers of the genre. Director Negulesco isn't great, but the mysterious and intertwined film works.

title: Springfield Rifle
actors: Gary Cooper, Phyllis Thaxter, David Brian, Lon Chaney jr., Paul Kelly, Philip Carey, James Millican, Guinn 'Big Boy' Williams, Alan Hale jr.
description: Major Lex Kearny is disbarred for having abandoned to the raiders, without a fight, a convoy of horses destined for Union troops, which he had orders to escort. This allows him to infiltrate a gang of horse thieves and to discover that his own colonel is a traitor acting, in league with the raiders, in favor of the Southern enemy.
notes: A traditional western that scrupulously respects the rules of the genre, conducted by a hard-working director on an elaborate script. Extraordinary Gary Cooper.

title: The Mask of Fu Manchu
actors: Boris Karloff, Myrna Loy, Lewis Stone, Charles Starrett, Karen Morley, Jean Hersholt, Lawrence Grant, David Torrence
description: Investigator Nayland Smith, who has always been on the trail of a criminal organization made up of Chinese and directed by the diabolical Fu Manchu, is captured and tortured, but manages to escape death and smash his rival's plans. Alongside Nayland Smith are his beautiful girlfriend and an assistant.
notes: Low-cost film version of Sax Rohmer's ancestral novels, shot at low cost by MGM, considered classics of their genre despite their veiled racism. Great interpretation of Boris Karloff in the role of the villain.

title: Star of Midnight
actors: William Powell, Ginger Rogers, Paul Kelly, Ralph Morgan, Gene Lockhart, Leslie Fenton, J. Farrell MacDonald, Russell Hopton, Vivien Oakland
description: Lawyer Dalzell suddenly finds himself in the sights of the police and a mysterious killer. A journalist who had offered to testify on the case of an actress who disappeared during a performance was killed at his home. Dalzell begins investigating on her behalf and quickly discovers that the girl is not dead, but has been kidnapped. It was one of the greatest successes for the RKO, mainly due to the presence of Powell and Rogers.

title: The Purple Mask
actors: Tony Curtis, Colleen Miller, Dan O'Herlihy, Gene Barry, Angela Lansbury, George Dolenz, John Hoyt, Donald Randolph, Robert Cornthwaite, Stephen Bekassy, Paul Cavanagh
description: Count René de Trevières, hiding his face under a mysterious purple mask, went to Paris in 1803 to free a gentleman whom Napoleon, First Republican Consul, had arrested and sentenced to the guillotine. René manages to capture the minister of police and to have a ransom delivered in exchange for his release. Napoleon, exasperated, entrusts his trusted man, Brisquet, with the task of tracking down and arresting the Purple Mask.
notes: Modest swashbuckling film.

title: Cloak and Dagger
actors: Gary Cooper, Lilli Palmer, Robert Alda, Vladimir Sokoloff, J. Edward Bromberg, Marjorie Hoshelle, Ludwig Stössel, Helene Thimig, Dan Seymour, Marc Lawrence
description: A physics professor is parachuted to Germany by the secret services to find out where the Germans are in preparing the atomic bomb.
notes: Atomic espionage with very strong ethical implications alongside the clear anti-Nazi spirit. He is not the best Lang, but the pace is effective and the anxieties are there.

title: Il maschio ruspante
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Barbara Bach, Ninetto Davoli, Marisa Merlini, Enrica Bonaccorti, Jacques Herlin, Didi Perego, Romano Malaspina, Alessandro Iacarella, Fausta Avelli, Francesca Romana Coluzzi, Nello Pazzafini
description: Romulus finds Rema, with whom he has been in love since kindergarten, at a village party. She invites him to follow her into her house, but only to take him as a waiter. Hybrid comedy melò with good character actors and, in a small part, Enrica Bonaccorti.

title: Masquerade
actors: Rob Lowe, Meg Tilly, Kim Cattrall, Doug Savant, John Glover, Dana Delany, Erik Holland, Brian Davies, Barton Heyman
description: Whalan is an unscrupulous young man. He skippers for Granger Morrison and sleeps with his wife. He meets Olivia Lawrence, beautiful, rich and orphan, and devises a plan to seduce her and enjoy her riches after killing her. The enterprise produces two deaths among Tim's accomplices. On the other hand, after marrying Olivia, he repents and lets himself be conquered by love to the point of extreme sacrifice.
notes: Grim melodrama set more on Rob Lowe's ambiguous charm than on the solidity of the story. Complicated plot, arbitrary revelations, implausible twists. To you the "pleasure" of meeting them, always if someone manages to get to the end of the film.

title: Slaughter in San Francisco
actors: Don Wong, Chuck Norris, Sylvia Channing, Robert Jones, Chuck Boyd, James Econmonides, Robert J. Hercuth, Dan Ivan, Ching-Ying Lam, Wen-Chun Ma
description: Former policeman makes havoc to avenge a friend and colleague killed by the underworld. Shot in 1973, modestly kept in the drawer for eight years and finally distributed in the wake of the popularity achieved by Chuck Norris (the killer), the film is a compendium of the clichés of the genre.

title: Dragon Wells Massacre
actors: Barry Sullivan, Dennis O'Keefe, Mona Freeman, Katy Jurado, Sebastian Cabot, Max Showalter, Jack Elam, Trevor Bardette, Jon Shepodd
description: Sheriff Hanley, escorting Linck and Tioca, two outlaws, joins a caravan where a trafficker who conspires with the Indians travels. The caravan is saved thanks to Linck's courage. Western series B, without interest.

title: Massacro al Grande Canyon
actors: James Mitchum, Milla Sannoner, Georges Ardisson, Burt Nelson, Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Eduardo Ciannelli, Andrea Giordana, Ferdinando Poggi, Benito Stefanelli, Renato Terra
description: Wess wants to avenge the murder of his father and is involved in the bitter feuds of the country unleashed for the possession of some land. While his gun solves all the problems, his heart beats fast for Nancy. Italian-style Western of the very first hour, but without interest.

title: Fort Apache
actors: Henry Fonda, John Wayne, Shirley Temple, John Agar, Ward Bond, Pedro Armendariz, George O'Brien, Victor McLaglen, Anna Lee, Irene Rich, Dick Foran
description: Colonel Thursday is transferred to Fort Apache. Against the advice of his officers, who know better the mentality of the Indians, the military provokes the chief of the Apache tribe, Cochise. In the battle that follows, the entire regiment is surrounded and few manage to escape the massacre.
notes: John Ford and the soldiers, symbol of a community that despite its mistakes manages to find within itself the values ??of loyalty and solidarity. And between the harsh reality and the myth, the myth will win. At the time it was mistaken for rhetoric what is, more simply, epic.

title: Mata Hari
actors: Greta Garbo, Ramon Novarro, Lionel Barrymore, Lewis Stone, C. Henry Gordon, Karen Morley, Alec B. Francis, Blanche Friderici, Edmund Breese
description: During the First World War, the German spy Mata Hari must seduce a French officer, but she falls in love with him. The woman's superior is jealous, and the mission goes down the drain; but the woman will have a heroin death.
notes: The film that launched the femme fatale model of grace is directed without flights from Fitzmaurice, but it is the Divine who makes sense of the operation. In exotic dance or in front of the firing squad.

title: Mata Hari, agent H21
actors: Jeanne Moreau, Jean-Louis Trintignant, Claude Rich, Frank Villard, Albert Rémy, Henry Garcin, Hella Petri, Marie Dubois, Nicole Desailly
description: The story of the famous and fascinating spy in the service of the Germans and his tragic end rewritten by Richard together with Truffaut. Starring an extraordinary Jeanne Moreau in a film of great charm, characterized by an accurate period reconstruction, an impressionist staging and a splendid photography.

title: Fiesta
actors: Esther Williams, Akim Tamiroff, Ricardo Montalban, Cyd Charisse, John Carroll, Mary Astor, Fortunio Bonanova, Hugo Haas, Jean Van
description: Antonio Mendoza, once a famous bullfighter, is the father of two twins, José and Maria, and would like the male to follow in his professional footsteps. But the young man doesn't want to know: he loves music, and he wants to be a singer. Maria, who wants to save peace and family honor, then appears in the arenas with the identity of her brother, obtaining excellent results. Meanwhile, José is also successful.
notes: This "Mexican" story with the hallmark of the most bizarre and cloying Hollywood exoticism, is an authentic bullfight with boredom. Esther Williams is definitely better in the water.

title: ¡Mátalo!
actors: Lou Castel, Corrado Pani, Antonio Salines, Luis Davila, Claudia Gravy, Anna Maria Noè, Miguel Del Castillo, Ana María Mendoza, Bruno Boschetti, Mirella Pamphili
description: Escaped from the gallows and left for dead by his partners after the assault on a stagecoach, a bandit arrives in an abandoned village, where his accomplices have found refuge, for the showdown. Here he meets a young Aussie who looks meek and helpless but is a real boomerang ace.
notes: Spaghetti-western completely unconventional, the one created by Canevari, with a nod to the youthful rebelliousness of the time. But it is not the political metaphor, however thin, that is of interest, as much as the staging, which maximizes the relationship between bodies and spaces and is incredibly inspired. Strangling music and a kitsch touch that doesn't hurt.

title: Matango
actors: Akira Kubo, Hiroshi Koizumi, Kumi Mizuno, Kenji Sahara, Hiroshi Tachikawa, Yoshio Tsuchiya, Miki Yashiro, Hideyo Amamoto
description: A boat, which left Tokyo for Europe with five men and two women on board, is shipwrecked. The crew finds refuge on a desert island, where, however, they have to deal with the apparitions of a monster: only later will it be discovered that it is a man transformed into a mushroom and that all the survivors will face the same fate. All except one, who - miraculously escaped - will end up in a psychiatric hospital.
notes: From the director of the first _Godzilla_, a variation on the theme of the monster with a human heart, or rather on the "diversity" that is hidden in human nature. Special effects of all respect for the time, even if today they can make you smile.

title: Matewan
actors: Chris Cooper, Mary McDonnell, Will Oldham, David Strathairn, Jace Alexander, Ken Jenkins, Kevin Tighe, Gordon Clapp, Bob Gunton, James Earl Jones, John Sayles
description: The film traces the chronicle of a dramatic episode that occurred in 1920 in Matewan, a small town in Virginia: the birth, development, internal conflicts and finally the bloody repression of the protest movement of miners. An intense and choral film, in a fruitful balance between the tradition of militant cinema and that of the American Serie B.

title: Matilda
actors: Carla Benedetti, Silvio Orlando, Luigi Petrucci, Gianni Agus, Milena Vukotic, Tino Schirinzi, Vanna Polverosi, Mario Santella, Carmen Scivittaro
description: Matilda is a beautiful and rich Neapolitan bourgeois, a lover of adventure and danger. Desperately on the hunt for a man, after his tragic previous relationships, he sets his sights on Torquato, a quiet, shy and ugly archivist, who doesn't want to know about getting married and is very happy with his routine. Despite himself, however, he is overwhelmed by the "cyclone" Matilda, which upsets his life.
notes: Directed by two young Neapolitan directors, Antonietta De Lillo and Giorgio Magliulo, the film, of good ironic-sentimental stuff, marks the first appearance of Orlando as the protagonist and shoots sarcasm on the bourgeoisie.

title: Medicine Man
actors: Sean Connery, Lorraine Bracco, José Wilker, Rodolfo De Alexandre, Francisco Tsiren Tsere Rereme, Elias Monteiro Da Silva, Edinei Maria Serrio Dos Santos, Bec-Kana-Re Dos Santos Kaiapo, Angelo Barra Moreira, José Lavat
description: Robert Campbell (Sean Connery) is a scientist who has lived for years in the Amazon rainforest, in search of a remedy for cancer starting from some drugs of the tribal medicine of the Indians. Since the results do not seem satisfactory, he is joined by the pharmaceutical multinational, who finances him a young researcher (Lorraine Bracco) who, after the first squabbles, proves his worth, conquering even the heart of the gruff scientist. Meanwhile, some unscrupulous businessmen are destroying the forest (and consequently the populations that inhabit it). To save their proteges and their studies, the two go even further into the region ... The screenwriter is that of "Fleeting Moment", McTiernan is not Boorman ("The Emerald Forest") and completely relies on the pair of actors capable of holding up the film.

title: We're Not Married
actors: Ginger Rogers, Fred Allen, Victor Moore, Marilyn Monroe, David Wayne, Eve Arden, Paul Douglas, Eddie Bracken, Mitzi Gaynor, Zsa Zsa Gabor, Louis Calhern, James Gleason
description: The district attorney discovers that seven marriages celebrated by a certain justice of the peace are to be canceled. The communication reaches the interested parties unexpected, but welcome, for various reasons, except for a single couple consisting of a soldier leaving for the front and his pregnant wife. Then, despite the crisis in their relationships, all couples will end up reconfirming the marriage.
notes: A "choral" comedy about the goodness of the marriage institution. There is Marilyn, who returns to the light genre after the dramatic experience of Fritz Lang's "The Confession of Mrs. Doyle". There is also Ginger Rogers, but the film is nothing exceptional.

title: Matrimonio all'italiana
actors: Sophia Loren, Marcello Mastroianni, Aldo Puglisi, Marilù Tolo, Tecla Scarano, Gianni Ridolfi, Generoso Cortini, Vito Moricone, Rita Piccione, Lino Mattera, Alfio Vita
description: Filumena Marturano, a former prostitute, was Domenico's servant-lover for years. Tired of this condition, she decides to get married. To do this, he pretends to be on the verge of death. The stratagem succeeds in half because, realizing the deception, Domenico has the wedding canceled. The woman then reveals that she has three children, one of them from her lover-master.
notes: The comedy by Eduardo De Filippo, already brought to the screen by its author over ten years earlier, is here the pretext to create, starting from the Pirandellian tones of the writing, a sweetened comedy tailored to the two interpreters. Loren was nominated for an Oscar.

title: Betsy's Wedding
actors: Alan Alda, Madeline Kahn, Joe Pesci, Molly Ringwald, Burt Young, Joey Bishop, Anthony LaPaglia, Catherine O'Hara, Ally Sheedy, Julie Bovasso, Dylan Walsh
description: Eddie, whose daughter Betsy is about to get married to Jake, launches into overdone preparations, despite his poor financial situation. He asks for help from his brother-in-law Oscar, a not very honest businessman, linked to a mafia boss. The matter takes on such proportions that the two betrothed are increasingly disgusted by it. But the boss has a nephew, an aspiring policeman, who falls in love with Betsy's older sister.
notes: Alan Alda is here actor and director. Good cast, in which the presence of Joe Pesci (Oscar for "Goodfellas") in the role of brother-in-law stands out, for a comedy of family troubles with a discontinuous trend.

title: A Handful of Dust
actors: James Wilby, Kristin Scott Thomas, Rupert Graves, Anjelica Huston, Judi Dench, Richard Beale, Pip Torrens, Beatie Edney, Richard Leech
description: Brenda and Tony Last live in a villa in the English countryside with their little son. Brenda, bored and dissatisfied, enters into a relationship with a cynical acquaintance. On the accidental death of their son, the couple separates: Tony leaves for the Amazon, where he gets lost and ends up "prisoner" of a strange character. A non-luminous fate also touches the wife, promptly abandoned by her lover. Based on a biting novel by Evelyn Waugh ("A handful of dust"), the film discards its fiercely satirical side, embroidering beautiful landscapes, a refined reconstruction of the period and well-drawn figures and a little sad on the remaining romantic material. and sentimental.

title: Die Ehe der Maria Braun
actors: Hanna Schygulla, Klaus Löwitsch, Gunther Lamprecht, Gisela Uhlen, Elisabeth Trissenaar, Gottfried John, Hark Bohm, George Eagles, Claus Holm
description: Maria married in 1943 and her husband immediately left for the front, where he was reported missing. To survive in defeated Germany, Maria begins a relationship with an American, who is killed under unclear circumstances when her husband returns. He gets arrested to save Maria, who seduces the industrialist Oswald becoming rich and powerful. According to an agreement between the two men, after Oswald's death the woman will return with her husband ...
notes: With the scheme of Douglas Sirk's melodramas, Fassbinder represents a passionate allegory of Germany and, above all, a poignant love story. Very good Hanna Schygulla.

title: Murderers' Row
actors: Dean Martin, Ann-Margret, Karl Malden, Camilla Sparv, James Gregory, Beverly Adams, Richard Eastham, Tom Reese, Duke Howard
description: Secret agent Matt Helm infiltrates the gang of a mad criminal who has kidnapped the scientist Solaris to wrest a secret with tremendous destructive power. Good pace and you find spectacular, but Dean Martin is not suited to the role of superagent.

title: The Morning After
actors: Jane Fonda, Jeff Bridges, Raul Julia, Diane Salinger, Richard Foronjy, Geoffrey Scott, James 'Gypsy' Haake, Kathleen Wilhoite, Don Hood, Fran Bennett
description: Alex is a failed, semi-alcoholic actress who has long been unhappily married to Raul, a successful hairdresser. After one of his good nights, one morning he wakes up in a bed that is not his own with the corpse of the stranger with whom he spent the night. Alex, who absolutely cannot remember anything of what happened in the previous hours, runs away after trying to erase the traces of his presence from the room.
notes: Unsuccessful thriller, directed by tired Sidney Lumet and dominated by a Jane Fonda, unfortunately always a little over the top. Better than her are the supporting men (Jeff Bridges and Raul Julia).

title: Maurice
actors: James Wilby, Hugh Grant, Rupert Graves, Denholm Elliott, Simon Callow, Billie Whitelaw, Barry Foster, Judy Parfitt, Phoebe Nicholls, Patrick Godfrey, Ben Kingsley
description: We are in Cambridge in 1910; the relationship between Clive and Maurice on the emotional level is more than just friendship, but Clive refuses to go beyond the platonic sentiment for fear of a scandal. He will marry and go into politics; Maurice, on the other hand, after a thousand indecisions decides to accept his homosexuality. Film transcription from the novel by E. M. Forster, it intends to reconstruct the climate of rigid control of feelings and sexual morality in England at the beginning of the century. Velvety but oppressive atmospheres, gestures and looks more eloquent than words; Ivory is definitely at ease, but the result is close to academia.

title: Maya
actors: Clint Walker, Jay North, I.S. Johar, Sajid Kahn, Sonia Sahni, Paidi Jairaj, Ulhas, Nana Palsikar
description: Hugh is a famous hunter who after being wounded by a tiger no longer has the courage to look in the mirror. His son Terry, who has joined him in India in the meantime, is shocked when his father kills a leopard cub that has become his favorite playmate. After running away from home, the little boy starts wandering through the jungle. He would surely be killed if he didn't meet an Indian peer, an elephant and her albino baby ...
notes: A simple film directed by a simple director and played by simple actors. Despite this, however, the honesty of intent (and form) saves the shack

title: Mayerling
actors: Danielle Darrieux, Charles Boyer, Marthe Regnier, Yolande Laffon, Suzy Prim, Gina Manès, Odette Talazac, Nane Germon, Assia Granatouroff
description: After marrying, for reasons of state, Princess Stefania, Rodolfo d'Asburg, falls in love with a young man from noble family. The scandal will push the two lovers to give death in Mayerling Castle. Good French version of a famous historical episode, directed by Anatole Litvak, director of Russian origin, at his latest European film before leaving for Hollywood. The couple Danielle Darrieux-Jean Boyer is superlative.

title: Mayflower Madam
actors: Candice Bergen, Chris Sarandon, Caitlin Clarke, Jim Antonio, Debra Rogers, Leslie Hardy, Victoria Loving, Robert Silver, Chita Rivera
description: Sydney Biddle Barrows carries an important name in American high society. His family is descended from one of the Pilgrim Fathers, English Protestants brought to the New Continent by the Mayflower vessel. Such prestigious Christmases do not prevent Sidney from carrying out an at least controversial job: in fact, he is the head of an agency that supplies wealthy New Yorkers with the most exclusive high-class call girls. The story is true, and the real Sydney Barrows (who is played by Candice Bergen in the film) also appears in a small role.

title: McBain
actors: Christopher Walken, Maria Conchita Alonso, Michael Ironside, Chick Vennera, Steve James, Victor Argo, Jay Patterson, Protacio Dee
description: McBain is a prisoner of war who is saved, on the last day of the Vietnamese conflict, by a group of soldiers including Santos. Eighteen years later, Santos is killed in a coup attempt in Colombia. McBain agrees to help Santos' sister Christina. With his intervention, the drug cartel that controls power is defeated and the return of democracy is favored. Glickenhaus is a director of B movie; this is revealed also on this occasion, despite the cast of recall. On other occasions, his "recycling of second-hand films" came out better.

title: Meatballs III
actors: Sally Kellerman, Shannon Tweed, Patrick Dempsey, Al Waxman, Isabelle Mejias, Peter Snider, Jan Taylor Hendricks, Hudson Bishop
description: Shy Rudy is hired as a river bath worker. His employer is the fearsome Mean, very jealous of a woman he keeps locked up at home. It goes without saying that the young holidaymakers organize expeditions to conquer the mysterious "goddess of love". It will be Rudy, helped by a bizarre guardian angel, to reveal the secret. But love is elsewhere. Third chapter of the Meatballs series, which had its golden moment during the 80s. With the excuse of operations-nostalgia, we can recover everything, but we are only saddened to see Sally Kellerman involved in such transactions.

title: Medea
actors: Maria Callas, Massimo Girotti, Giuseppe Gentile, Laurent Terzieff, Margareth Clémenti, Paul Jabara, Gerard Weiss, Sergio Tramonti
description: Jason lands in Colchis with the Argonauts in search of the Golden Fleece; he is helped by the sorceress Medea, who, falling in love with him, follows him on his return. Jason marries her and has two sons by her. When, however, blinded by ambition, he abandons her to marry the daughter of the king of Corinth, Medea's revenge falls relentlessly.
notes: Reinterpretation of the Greek myth staged by Pasolini with results of great lyricism. The Renaissance geometries of the Piazza dei Miracoli, the rocky towers of Cappadocia, the extravagance of the costumes, the beauty of the landscapes: extraordinary figurative richness at the service of a rare narrative sobriety.

title: The Nickel Ride
actors: Jason Miller, Linda Haynes, Victor French, John Hillerman, Bo Hopkins, Richard Evans, Bart Barnes, Lou Frizzell, Mark Gordon
description: The "broker" is a certain Cooper, a key man in a gang of thugs. His avenue of sunset is also that of a crime that had principles, while the emerging one is only merciless. The film is narrated with extended times and following a single character. One of the best gangster movies of the 70s.

title: Il medico dei pazzi
actors: Totò, Aldo Giuffré, Franca Marzi, Nerio Bernardi, Tecla Scarano, Maria Pia Casilio, Vittoria Crispo, Carlo Ninchi, Giacomo Furia, Nora Ricci
description: Ciccillo, nephew of Felice Sciosciammocca, is supported by his uncle, making him believe he is studying as a doctor. When his uncle arrives in town he invents a ruse: he makes him believe that the customers of the pension where he lives are mad and furious entrusted to him. All in all, the attitude of the customers helps him: an intrusive widow, a man jealous of his cheerful wife, an irascible colonel, an actor who tries "Othello" all the time. The misunderstandings will then be clarified by Ciccillo's confession and by Felice's return to the countryside.
notes: Staging of a play by Scarpetta by Mattoli, following the success of "Miseria e nobiltà". Classy comedians, and hilarious moments.

title: Il medico della mutua
actors: Alberto Sordi, Ida Galli, Bice Valori, Nanda Primavera, Franco Scandurra, Leopoldo Trieste, Sara Franchetti, Evelyn Stewart, Claudio Gora, Pupella Maggio
description: The promising and recent medical graduate Guido Tersilli discovers that he can earn much more by dealing with loans. At the beginning, business is not going well, but the death of the elderly Dr. Bui who "owns" two thousand three hundred loans, benefits his career: with the promise to take her to the altar, he seduces the widow and manages to pass under her care the patients of the late Dr. Bui. Now Tersilli works day and night, he is very rich and can abandon his widow to marry a young and rich girl, the daughter of a builder. In the meantime, his clients are growing out of all proportion, so much so that Tersilli can only dedicate them a few minutes per visit. Overwhelmed by a collapse, he ends up in the same hospital1 that had seen him as a volunteer assistant at the beginning of his career. Feeling threatened by his old colleagues who would like to take away his clients, he will make an advantageous decision.
notes: Bittersweet satire of the world of medicine, with an Alberto Sordi in great shape (he obtained the David di Donatello in 1969 as best leading actor) and with two excellent supporting actors Bice Valori, in the role of Dr. Bui's wife and Nanda Primavera, in those of the mother by Guido Tersilli. The film, based on a novel by Giuseppe D'Agata, achieved such success (more than three billion at the time), that the following year a second part was shot directed by Luciano Salce (Prof. Dr. Guido Tersilli, head of the Villa Celeste clinic with an agreement with mutuals.

title: Il medico e lo stregone
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Vittorio De Sica, Marisa Merlini, Lorella De Luca, Gabriella Pallotta, Alberto Sordi, Virgilio Riento, Carlo Taranto, Ilaria Occhini, Riccardo Garrone
description: The young doctor Marchetti (Mastroianni) arrives to practice in a village perched on the mountains. Where "civilization" has not yet arrived. So much so that before his arrival, medicine was practiced by an elderly "healer" (De Sica). It will be the doctor who prevails, managing to persuade the inhabitants of the effectiveness of his medicines.
notes: Monicelli plays on the contrast between peasant Italy and modernization, with the complicity of two true screenwriters: Age and Scarpelli.

title: Mediterraneo
actors: Diego Abatantuono, Claudio Bigagli, Gigio Alberti, Vanna Barba, Giuseppe Cederna, Claudio Bisio, Memo Dini, Vasco Mirandola, Antonio Catania, Irene Grazioli, Ugo Conti, Luigi Montini
description: In the spring of 1941, a patrol of Italian soldiers received the order to garrison a small island in the Aegean Sea, outside the commercial routes. The eight soldiers, a composite jumble of men belonging to different bodies and coming from the most diverse Italian regions, carry out the order and occupy the apparently deserted island. In a few months the war will forget about them and they will forget about the war.
notes: Awarded with the Oscar, dedicated, as the caption that opens the film warns, to all those who are on the run, played by a new group of actors including Diego Abatantuono, it was a success also abroad.

title: Melodie eterne
actors: Gino Cervi, Conchita Montenegro, Luisella Beghi, Maria Jacobini, Jone Salinas, Luigi Pavese, Paolo Stoppa, Lauro Gazzolo, Claudio Gora, Cesare Polacco
description: Little Mozart amazes the entire imperial court with some spinet compositions. It is the beginning of a dazzling career, full of professional successes, but also of love disappointments: left by the great love Aloisia, he will console himself in the arms of his sister Costanza.
notes: Scripted by playwright Guido Cantini and Ernesto Marischka, the film is a rather fictionalized biography, a typical work of Gallone, a specialist in opera and musical portraits. In fact, the director believed that the lives of famous composers could encompass spectacularity and praise of popular culture. Margherita Carosio puts in the voice that the actresses in the film did not have.

title: Melodrammore. E vissero felici e contenti
actors: Enrico Montesano, Fran Fullenwider, Amedeo Nazzari, Jenny Tamburi, Mino Bellei, Liana Trouché, Vincenzo Crocitti, Nilla Pizzi, Claudio Villa
description: Having to interpret a fifties-style melodrama, the actor Enrico Montesano asks Amedeo Nazzari for advice, who gives it to him while he reviews clips of "Appassionamente" by Giacomo Gentilomo and other tear-jerking films. Reinvigorated by these tips Montesano is ready to give his face to Raffaele, a seller of statues and sacred objects in love with Ada.
notes: Maurizio Costanzo, the one of talk shows, tries to set up an intellectual operation around the Matarazzo model melody. With this film he demonstrates two things: 1) he did not understand anything about Matarazzo 2) cinema was not really his job.

title: Love Nest
actors: William Lundigan, June Haver, Marilyn Monroe, Frank Fay, Jack Paar, Leatrice Joy, Henry Kulky
description: Jim Scott returns from the war and discovers that with the money he had regularly sent home, his wife Connie bought a building by renting out the various apartments. But Jim realizes that the little money he earns from rents will barely be enough for the renovations. Among the tenants is Mr. Patterson, a self-styled antiquarian, actually a hunter of widowers to whom he broke money by promising to marry them. Convicted for this, Patterson dictates his memoirs to Jim who achieves great success with the book. It is a funny comedy written by the great I. A. L. Diamond who is a regular collaborator of Billy Wilder. Also in the cast is Marilyn Monroe.

title: Memphis Belle
actors: Matthew Modine, Eric Stoltz, Tate Donovan, D.B. Sweeney, Billy Zane, Sean Astin, Harry Connick jr., Reed Diamond, Courtney Gains, Neil Giuntoli, David Strathairn, John Lithgow, Jane Horrocks
description: In May 1943, a B-17 bomber, baptized with the name of "Memphis Belle", took off from an air base in England for its twenty-fifth mission. The flying fortress is led by a crew of nine members: nine aviators whose personalities and ideals are not exactly homogeneous. The mission is very hard, both due to bad weather conditions, both for the German air attacks and for the action of the anti-aircraft. The idea is certainly not new, particularly for a war film: an inhomogeneous group forced to live together in prohibitive conditions. The show is there, and there is also a discreet psychological study and a genuine admiration for bombers.

title: Menage all'italiana
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Maria Grazia Buccella, Dalida, Romina Power, Anna Moffo, Tatyana Pavlova, Monica Siwers, Dino, Paola Barbara, Gisa Geert, Paola Borboni
description: Taking a cue from a news story, here is the paradoxical story of Carlo Valdesi who marries eight women one way after another, with a circle of lies, cheats, forged documents and appropriate disappearances. Some of them would like him dead, someone else forgives him and there are those who betray him.
notes: Before selecting his own repertoire in high-profile cinema, Tognazzi lived for a long time on cheap films, more at the level of farce than anything else. Here we are on the border between the first and second phase. Hyperqualunquista screenplay. The sixteen year old Romina Power, on her debut, shows herself in a bra and panties.

title: The Killing Mind
actors: Stephanie Zimbalist, Tony Bill, Daniel Roebuck, K. Todd Freeman, Lee Tergesen, Candy Ann Brown, Stan Ivar, John Durbin, Keith MacKechnie
description: Isobel Neiman, a psychologist serving at the FBI, is transferred to the state police. Here she is entrusted with unsolved cases. Isobel is dedicated in particular to a murder committed twenty years earlier, in which she had witnessed the discovery of the victim: a girl dressed as a dancer. He goes to see the journalist who covered the story and ...
notes: The idea behind the story is not brand new, but the atmosphere is discreetly constructed.

title: Meo Patacca
actors: Gigi Proietti, Marilù Tolo, Mario Scaccia, Enzo Cerusico, Nanda Primavera, Francesco Mulè, Marco Tulli, Adriano Micantoni, Fortunato Cecilia, Umberto Di Grazia
description: Year 1695. The Roman horse Meo Patacca, a consecrated crusader, trains a group of beggars in defense of Christianity. Amidst amorous spies with his wife, Meo leads his shabby army to fight against a brigand in defense of a group of prostitutes and to attack, for a misunderstanding, the peaceful population of a country. "Glory" is not for him; better escape.
notes: Partially distorting the poem "Meo Patacca", by Giuseppe Berneri, from which it takes its moves, the film neglects the serious ideas existing under the laughing skin and transforms the whole into a superficial farce.

title: Mephisto
actors: Klaus Maria Brandauer, Krystyna Janda, Ildikó Bánsági, Rolf Hoppe, György Cserhalmi, Péter Andorai, Karin Boyd, Christine Harbort, Tamás Major
description: German actor Henrik Höfgen, the star performer on stage and in life, enters a deep crisis when Hitler takes power in Germany. But his thirst for success makes him overcome all his problems. Indeed, Henrik finds justification for coming to terms with the Nazi power. He soon became one of Göring's favorites and a leading exponent of the theater of the time.
notes: It is the film that has consecrated the fame of the Austrian actor Klaus Maria Brandauer. The Hungarian Szabo draws the story of Höfgen from a novel by Klaus Mann, son of Thomas, who committed suicide in 1949. It is a baroque and symbolist drama, to be exported (and in fact it won the Oscar for best foreign film), but it is the best film by Szabò.

title: La fabuleuse aventure de Marco Polo
actors: Horst Buchholz, Elsa Martinelli, Gregoire Aslan, Robert Hossein, Akim Tamiroff, Omar Sharif, Anthony Quinn, Orson Welles, Massimo Girotti, Folco Lulli, Bruno Cremer
description: The young Marco Polo, heir to a dynasty of Venetian merchants on the brink of ruin, participates with his father and uncle in a mission to the East. The mission was entrusted to them by Pope Gregory X who intends to enter into negotiations with the spiritual leader of the East: Kubilai Khan. The journey turns out to be for Marco the source of wonderful and dangerous adventures that he overcomes thanks to his courage. Made with extensive use of means, the film, however, turns out to be weak on a historical and narrative level, ending up being simply a walk through folklore.

title: Some Kind of Wonderful
actors: Eric Stoltz, Lea Thompson, Mary Stuart Masterson, Craig Sheffer, John Ashton, Elias Koteas, Molly Hagan, Maddie Corman, Jane Elliot, Candace Cameron Bure
description: Beautiful, enterprising and sexy, she conquers a young man who is already lukewarmly engaged.
notes: Howard Deutc packs a sort of remake of "Bella in rosa" the film that the same director had directed a year earlier. The result is a flimsy, but well-crafted comedy with two female performers giving good results.

title: The Amazing Mr. Blunden
actors: Laurence Naismith, Diana Dors, James Villiers, Rosalyn Landor, Marc Granger, Diana Dors, Dorothy Alison, Graham Crowden
description: Mister Blunden, an elderly and mysterious lawyer, visits Mrs. Allen in the squalid house where she lives with her two small children, proposing that she move as a housekeeper to an abandoned country villa. Here, however, the two children come into contact with the spirits of two other children, who died in the palace a hundred years earlier. After brewing a potion that allows them to travel through time, they will find themselves busy trying to help their two new friends, putting themselves in danger as well.

title: The Wonderful Country
actors: Robert Mitchum, Julie London, Pedro Armendariz, Gary Merrill, Albert Dekker, Jack Oakie, Charles McGraw, Leroy 'Satchel' Paige, Anthony Caruso
description: Martin is a gunslinger in the service of the grim governor of Mexico who intends to use him to smuggle weapons from the United States. To follow the order, Martin goes to Puerto, a border village, where he has an accident that temporarily puts him out of action.
notes: A late and mature western that comes to terms with the stereotypes of the genre by staging a disillusioned and melancholy anti-hero. Parrish cloaks the story based on a novel by Tom Lea in lyricism. Mitchum, also a producer, is engaged in one of his best tests, in a complex and dubious character. I>

title: Gunslinger
actors: John Ireland, Beverly Garland, Allison Hayes, Martin Kingsley, Margaret Campbell, Bruno VeSota, Chris Alcaide, Dick Miller, George Offerman Jr.
description: Rose is suddenly widowed by Sheriff Scott. Which means for a couple of weeks before your replacement arrives, the sheriff will have to do it. The woman uses the opportunity to find her husband's killers. An original idea for a film opposed, during the seven days of production, by bad weather and other misadventures.

title: Il merlo maschio
actors: Laura Antonelli, Lando Buzzanca, Ferruccio De Ceresa, Elsa Vazzoler, Gino Cavalieri, Luciano Bianciardi, Adolfo Belletti, Franco Bisazza, Gigi Bonfanti, Lino Toffolo
description: Niccolò Vivaldi is a cello that suffers from a strong inferiority complex, both for the scarce professional success, and for the very little consideration in which it is held by those with whom it comes into contact. When he discovers that his wife likes other men very much, he starts making her pose naked.
notes: Festa Campanile makes a story of some claims, with almost cultured calls, but the best of the film are inevitably the graces of a vintage Antonelli. From a story by Luciano Bianciardi, who also makes a appearance.

title: Mery per sempre
actors: Michele Placido, Claudio Amendola, Francesco Benigno, Alessandra Di Sanzo, Tony Sperandeo, Roberto Mariano, Maurizio Prollo, Filippo Genzardi, Giovanni Alamia, Alfredo Li Bassi, Salvatore Termini
description: A literature professor awaiting definitive accommodation accepts an annual assignment in the juvenile prison of Palermo. The film tells about daily life, lessons, relationships that are anything but serene with the authority of the prison of the teacher who still manages to build a positive relationship with his students. However, there is no lack of disappointments, misunderstandings and defeats. After Soldati, with whom he had imposed a turn on his career, Marco Risi reaped critical and public success with this film capable of combining civil commitment with effective staging and collective interpretation. From an investigation book by Aurelio Grimaldi.

title: La messa è finita
actors: Nanni Moretti, Ferruccio De Ceresa, Marco Messeri, Enrica Maria Modugno, Margarita Lozano, Eugenio Masciari, Luisa De Santis, Pietro De Vico, Vincenzo Salemme, Dario Cantarelli, Mauro Fabretti, Giovanni Buttafava
description: For Don Giulio, returning to Rome after having been parish priest on an island in the Tyrrhenian Sea is full of bitter surprises. Friends have changed: one is under investigation for terrorism, another has exhaustion, yet another is living squalid homosexual adventures. And even in the family there is no good news: the father has run away, the mother kills herself, the sister wants to have an abortion. In addition, the parish is deserted by the faithful. Don Giulio puts all his effort into it ...
notes: Another moral story by Moretti, a mirror of the anxieties of a generation; the director leaves the role of Michele Apicella and makes an adult and bitter film. Scenes to remember: the arrival at the beach, Lauzi's "Ritornerai", the death of his mother. Silver bear in Berlin.

title: The Redhead and the Cowboy
actors: Glenn Ford, Rhonda Fleming, Edmond O'Brien, Alan Reed, Morris Ankrum, Edith Evanson, Perry Ivins, Janine Perreau
description: During the civil war, a dancer who sided with the Confederates (Fleming) meets a cynical cowboy and convinces him of the justice of the cause. The western isn't very lively, but it is saved for the couple of actors.

title: Messalina
actors: Maria Felix, Georges Marchal, Delia Scala, Carlo Ninchi, Camillo Pilotto, Memo Benassi, Erno Crisa, Jean Tissier, Jean Chevrier
description: After marrying Emperor Claudius, Messalina sits on the throne of Rome. But she is not satisfied with the result: in fact, at night she seeks emotions by prostituting herself in disguise, while with the faithful Gaius Sillio she plots to seize the throne alone. Claudio doesn't suspect anything; on the contrary, instigated by his wife, he kills the brave Valerio Asiaico who had denounced the intrigues of Messalina. But a courtier, who learned of the conspiracy, works with cunning to the point of nullifying the plots of the corrupt empress.
notes: It was a great success of the time. Now we appreciate more than anything else the bizarre cast, from the feline Maria Felix (Mexican divissima) to the super-gigione Memo Benassi, a blast.

title: Il Messia
actors: Pier Maria Rossi, Mita Ungaro, Carlos de Carvalho, Fausto Di Bella, Vernon Dobtcheff, Antonella Fasano, Jean Martin, Toni Ucci, Vittorio Caprioli, Tina Aumont
description: The history of the Jewish people and the arrival of the Messiah told by one of the greatest Italian directors. Rossellini's last film in his didactic period, when he thought that cinema served to educate the world. Contradictory and uncertain like all the films of that period, it represents a very lively aesthetic "hypothesis", even when the results are uncertain or annoying.

title: Savage Messiah
actors: Dorothy Tutin, Scott Anthony, Helen Mirren, Lindsay Kemp, Michael Gough, John Justin, Aubrey Richards, Peter Vaughan, Ben Aris
description: In Paris, Henri Gaudier, a very young painter and sculptor of the Vorticism movement, meets and falls in love with the Polish writer Sophie Brzeska, twenty years older than him. The two move to London where Henri lives his most prolific artistic period.
notes: Vorticism was a current comparable to what Futurism was in Italy. Ken Russell traces, with his usual impetuosity, the portrait of a life and a talent burned in the sacred fire of art and love. Notable is the interpretation of Dorothy Tutin in the role of Sophie, a part that should have been entrusted to Jeanne Moreau.

title: Metello
actors: Massimo Ranieri, Ottavia Piccolo, Tina Aumont, Lucia Bosé, Frank Wolff, Pino Colizzi, Mariano Rigillo, Luigi Diberti, Manuela Andrei
description: Orphaned, Metello finds work as a bricklayer in the construction site of a former worker who became an engineer who, forgetting his origins, has become an unscrupulous exploiter. Arrested for having clashed with the public force, sent to prohibit a demonstration following the death of an anarchist bricklayer, when he comes out of prison he finds Ersilia, the engineer's daughter, waiting for him. In the meantime, the socialist ideal has made its way to Florence and Metello, having abandoned the anarchists, takes part in a demonstration to obtain more decent wages.
notes: From a book by Vasco Pratolini which in the mid-1950s was a literary case, a classic literary film "alla Bolognini", precious and a little bloodless. Stunning photograph by Ennio Guarnieri, gritty Ranieri and the Piccolo.

title: Meteor
actors: Sean Connery, Natalie Wood, Karl Malden, Brian Keith, Martin Landau, Trevor Howard, Henry Fonda, Richard Dysart, Joseph Campanella, Bo Brundin
description: American space controllers have located a comet on its way to an asteroid beam. A spaceship is sent to the area, but it is run over and destroyed. A piece of the planet Orpheus, accompanied by a group of meteorites, is heading straight for the earth. Help is sought from the Russians. General Adlon, who aimed missiles at the USSR, opposes the operation. The Soviets, for their part, have no problem cooperating and send Dr. Dubov with his assistant Tatiana. Adlon resists, the tension rises.
notes: Catastrophic and science fiction go hand in hand. The cast is little less than pharaonic; the script a bit cumbersome and the suspense holds up to a certain point. But overall, the fun is guaranteed.

title: The Man Behind the Gun
actors: Randolph Scott, Patrice Wymore, Dick Wesson, Philip Carey, Lina Romay, Roy Roberts, Morris Ankrum, Katherine Warren, Alan Hale jr., Douglas Fowley, Anthony Caruso
description: Secret Service Major Callicut arrives in California to investigate a group of secessionists. It turns out that their base is a saloon. In the meantime he has fallen in love with a teacher, Lorna, who is taken hostage by the rebels, having discovered that the alleged killing of one of the leaders of the revolt was a fiction to act undisturbed.
notes: Lively movie, full of twists, fights and endless shootings.

title: Metti, una sera a cena
actors: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Florinda Bolkan, Tony Musante, Annie Girardot, Lino Capolicchio, Silvia Monti, Milly, Adriana Asti, Helmut Berger
description: Michele is a writer married to Nina. The couple's guests are often Giovanna, who is in love with him, and Max, Nina's lover. In search of more exciting transgressions, Max procures a paid lover for the woman, but an exclusive love seems to be born between the latter and Nina. It is only a brief parenthesis, bourgeois boredom then has the upper hand again.
notes: Giuseppe Patroni Griffi brings one of his greatest theatrical successes to the screen, but the ambiguous family portrait of the original fades into the film's end-in-itself aestheticism. Beautiful, but from the Pirelli calendar, the erotic images photographed by Tonino Delli Colli.

title: Mezzanotte d'amore
actors: Romina Power, Al Bano, Dolores Palumbo, Nino Taranto, Stelvio Rosi, Nino Terzo, Enzo Cannavale, Carlo Taranto, Lino Banfi, Paolo Panelli, Bice Valori
description: Donna Rosa, widow, marries Prince Antonio, and his daughter, Rosetta, with the sailor Andrea. Except that, Donna Rosa's first husband is back, alive, well and determined to be supported. And here is also that Andrea has suspicions about his wife's fidelity, and returns to his mother ...
notes: A whole circle of old and new family ties built for a modest and obvious sentimental comedy. Among the performers there is a bit of the whole Italian comic cinema of the time, crowning the couple Romina Power-Al Bano, married even in life, to the delight of their fans.

title: Mezzo destro, mezzo sinistro: 2 calciatori senza pallone
actors: Gigi Sammarchi, Andrea Roncato, Milena Vukotic, Leo Gullotta, Silvio Spaccesi, Sandro Ghiani, Pino Insegno, Loredana Romito, Gianni Ciardo, Isabel Russinova
description: The poor performance of the two players Gigi and Andrea is bringing the Marchigiana team to the bottom of the standings. The two are put on the bench and Andrea also loses his place in the heart of the widow Mirtila, sponsor of the team, who was conquered by the very young Vacca. But the athletic Vacca gets injured before a Cup match and it will be Gigi and Andrea who "drag" the team to victory.
notes: Comedy without ideas all aimed at exploiting the television success of Gigi and Andrea. Football and affairs are just a pretext to sew a small story on the two.

title: Blazing Saddles
actors: Cleavon Little, Gene Wilder, Slim Pickens, Harvey Korman, Madeline Kahn, Mel Brooks, Burton Gilliam, Alex Karras, David Huddleston, Liam Dunn, Robyn Hilton
description: The inhabitants of Rock Ridges are harassed by a pair of arrogant administrators: Judge Hedley Lamarr and the inept and corrupt Governor William De Petomane. The judge, to speculate on some land, does not hesitate to change the route of the railway. But the black Bart, the new sheriff, opposes the abuses, who with his incurable and contagious optimism saves the country.
notes: Mel Brooks plays here one of his trump cards: that of the parody. Its target is western cinema. The result is a wild saraband of gimmicks that ends in the film studios where the film is being shot. Particular for the band of Count Basie and memorable eaten of beans with final farts.

title: Surrender
actors: Michael Caine, Sally Field, Steve Guttenberg, Peter Boyle, Jackie Cooper, Julie Kavner, Louise Lasser, Iman
description: Sean is a successful writer, divorced and very wary of women, although he likes them a lot. He meets Daisy, a painter, in a rather embarrassing situation; between the two is created tender, but he hides his true identity from her. She is linked to another, but in the end the situation clears up and the two decide to get married; moreover, luck lends a hand with a final twist. Pleasant comedy. The script is well refined in the succession of squabbles and unexpected events; the cast is very respectable. Obviously, the two protagonists, the sly Caine and the sparkling Sally Field, take the lead.

title: Mi faccia causa
actors: Stefania Sandrelli, Christian De Sica, Gigi Proietti, Enrico Montesano, Franco Fabrizi, Giorgio Bracardi, Gigi Reder, Luca Sportelli, Franco Javarone, Marisa Laurito, Angelo Maggi
description: In front of the praetor Giovanni Pennisi a sample of various humanity passes every day, beset by flaws of all kinds. Sometimes real criminals also appear, but usually they are ordinary people trying to get by as best they can to survive.
notes: In this sort of updated remake of his "Un giorno in magistrale", Steno gathers a lot of names from Italian cinema. But the formula no longer holds up as it once did and it all boils down to a farce. National-popular screenplay that does not honor the director.

title: Mi faccio la barca
actors: Johnny Dorelli, Laura Antonelli, Christian De Sica, Daniela Poggi, Daniele Formica, Cariddi McKinnon Nardulli, Itaco Nardulli, Sal Borgese, Mario Donatone
description: A divorced dentist accompanies his two children on a cruise, whom he can see only fifteen days a year, on the "boat" he has just bought with great sacrifice. In the first part of the journey his ex-wife accompanies him. For a series of misadventures, including a "passage" to some convicts who escaped from Asinara, the two discover that they still love each other despite the sinking of the sweaty yacht. In parallel we also witness the performance of some rich people on another yacht.
notes: Laura Antonelli, still in shape, and the generous Daniela Poggi, are the only reasons for interest in a substantially insipid film.

title: Mi manda Picone
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Lina Sastri, Clelia Rondinella, Carlo Croccolo, Aldo Giuffré, Gerardo Scala, Marzio Honorato, Leo Gullotta, Nicola Di Pinto, Carlo Taranto
description: An Italsider worker sets himself on fire, in the hall of the municipal council of Naples, considering himself threatened with dismissal by the company. After being rescued by an ambulance, there is no trace of him and the searches for his wife Luciella Picone are in vain. Loy's tragicomic apologue, in a lively Naples of swindlers and specters.

title: Mi permette babbo!
actors: Alberto Sordi, Aldo Fabrizi, Marisa De Leza, Franco Silva, Rita Giannuzzi, Sergio Raimondi, Turi Pandolfini, Achille Majeroni, Pina Bottin, Riccardo Billi, Paola Borboni
description: Rodolfo, who married into a family of hard-working traders, has artistic aspirations and devotes all his time to singing lessons. With his back to the wall, thanks to his teacher, fearful of seeing his salary drop, he finds an expedient to credit his talent in front of the family. The director is on the safe side in identifying the types and situations, somewhat tested (not to say taken for granted), and in choosing the farcical tone. Sordi and Fabrizi are not at their best but act with ease, giving us some moments of genuine comedy.

title: Mi vedrai tornare
actors: Gianni Morandi, Elisabetta Wu, Nino Taranto, Vincenzo Caruso, Enrico Viarisio, Raimondo Vianello, Sandra Mondaini, Lelio Luttazzi, Pietro De Vico, Xenia Valderi, Loretta Goggi
description: Navy cadet Gianni Aleardi returns home for a license. At a dance party he meets the daughter of the Japanese prince Hirotoyo and falls in love with her. The girl feels attracted to the young man and accepts his courtship; everything is complicated by the fact that she has been promised to another man, a noble of the imperial court of the Rising Sun. Gianni sings his despair, but he doesn't give up. However, it is the determination of the girl who has the better of the rigid Japanese discipline.
notes: The Fizzarotti-Morandi couple, although an orphan of the Efrikian, is still a bomb set off against good cinema and common sense.

title: Out of Africa
actors: Meryl Streep, Robert Redford, Klaus Maria Brandauer, Michael Kitchen, Malick Bowens, Joseph Thiaka, Stephen Kinyanjui, Michael Gough, Suzanna Hamilton
description: Karen Dinesen arrives in Kenya in 1914 to find Baron von Blixen, whom she married without love. During her husband's long absences, Karen befriends Hatton, an elephant hunter. When the Baron gives her syphilis, Karen returns to Europe for treatment. But it will return to the black continent.
notes: The adventurous existence of writer Karen Blixen is the subject of this film that Pollack films with an eye to the exotic films of old Hollywood. Great interpretation by Meryl Streep. Seven Oscars: Best Film, Direction, Screenplay, Set Design, Sound, Photography and Music.

title: My Friend Irma
actors: John Lund, Diana Lynn, Don DeFore, Marie Wilson, Jerry Lewis, Dean Martin, Hans Conried, Kathryn Givney, Percy Helton
description: Irma is an office secretary, her friend Jane becomes the secretary of a young millionaire, who falls in love with her. Irma is promised to a likeable slacker who has discovered two gifted aspiring singers, (Martin and Lewis); Jane falls in love with the former so the young millionaire will have to give up on her. Based on a hit radio show, the film was originally supposed to launch blonde Marie Wilson, but actually dictated the Martin-Lewis duo, who debuted right here. Jerry is still Martin's sidekick, but he has a way to throw in some pretty notable comic gags.

title: My Little Chickadee
actors: Mae West, W.C. Fields, Joseph Calleia, Dick Foran, Ruth Donnelly, Margaret Hamilton, Donald Meek, Fuzzy Knight
description: The prosperous Flower Belle is married to Cuthbert J. Tillie who trades snake oil. The relationship between the two is on the verge of survival, because Flower does not allow her husband to consume the marriage. The woman, among other things, has already been expelled from the country where she was born because she suspects she is the lover of a masked bandit who terrorizes the community. Fortunately, there is an honest journalist who, in love with her, would like to restore her dignity.
notes: The encounter between Mae West's politically incorrect talent and W. C. Fields' ineffable genius should have produced other results. The movie isn't bad, but more was to be expected. In Italy it only arrived on TV.

title: My Favorite Brunette
actors: Bob Hope, Dorothy Lamour, Peter Lorre, Lon Chaney jr., John Hoyt, Charles Dingle, Reginald Denny, Frank Puglia, Ann Doran, Willard Robertson
description: By profession, a children's photographer, Ronnie Jackson has the ambition and mania to be an investigator. One day a fascinating and mysterious woman instructs him to find his uncle (very rich and disabled) who has disappeared. Ronnie does not let himself be begged, but with his inexperience he ends up falling into the hands of a gang of kidnappers first, and then into the hands of the police. Only the intervention of the woman will save him from jail. Bob Hope has been at the pinnacle of a certain type of gigionaire and couch potato comedy for years. In this film he attempts, partially succeeding, a parody of the detective genre. Two self-deprecating cameos by Lorre and Chaney jr.

title: My Cousin Rachel
actors: Olivia de Havilland, Richard Burton, Audrey Dalton, Ronald Squire, George Dolenz, John Sutton, Tudor Owen, J.M. Kerrigan
description: Philip, an orphan at an early age, was raised by his cousin Ambrose, but the news that he has married Rachel, a mysterious woman, throws him into despair. After receiving some letters in which his cousin mentions certain suspicions regarding his wife, Philip decides to leave for Florence. Arriving at his destination, he learns that Ambrose is dead and that Rachel has left for an unknown destination. Although Rachel's lawyer proves that her cousin died of cancer, Philip cannot overcome his doubts.
notes: A tense and highly ambiguous version of a Daphne Du Maurier novel, the film was Richard Burton's American debut.

title: Mortelle randonnée
actors: Isabelle Adjani, Michel Serrault, Guy Marchand, Stéphane Audran, Macha Meril, Geneviève Page, Sami Frey, Dominique Frot, Patrick Bouchitey
description: An investigator, in charge of supervising a girl, believes he recognizes her as his own daughter and even covers up the various crimes that the girl commits. Claude Miller is the one in Guardato a vista, and this too is a metaphysical "thriller" with a superb and ambiguous Michel Serrault.

title: La sirène du Mississippi
actors: Catherine Deneuve, Jean-Paul Belmondo, Nelly Borgeaud, Martine Ferrière, Marcel Berbert, Yves Drouhet, Michel Bouquet, Roland Thénot
description: Louis Mahé (Jean-Paul Belmondo) lives on the island of Réunion and married Julie (Catherine Deneuve) after meeting her by correspondence. She is much more beautiful than in the photographs and justifies herself by saying that she sent him those of a neighbor, to test him. In reality, she is a scammer and murderer named Marion who, after breaking up Louis' bank account, escapes. But the man is now in love with her. The escape of Louis and Julie / Marion is also an uncompromising escape from civilization and its rules and rightly does not end on the last frame: the viewer's imagination is left with the task of imagining a conclusion. Film idolized by cinéphiles, it mixes melodrama and detective genre and makes use of the presence of a dazzling Deneuve and a fascinating Belmondo. Based on a novel by Cornell Woolrich.

title: My Geisha
actors: Shirley MacLaine, Yves Montand, Edward G. Robinson, Robert Cummings, Yoko Tani, Tatsuo Saito, Tamae Kiyokawa, Ichirô Hayakawa, Alex Gerry
description: Lucy Dell is a famous actress, the wife of a director dissatisfied with living in her shadow. When he manages to get the direction of Madame Butterfly, to be shot in Japan with a local actress, his wife follows him without his knowledge and manages to get the part by pretending to be Japanese. The film will be a great success and the director will discover only at the end the true identity of the protagonist. And here is the moral note: with the art of geisha, Lucy has learned that her husband must be first and will overshadow herself for her sake. No comment. For the rest, it is a fairly funny and well-performed comedy.

title: Critic's Choice
actors: Bob Hope, Lucille Ball, Marie Windsor, Marilyn Maxwell, Rip Torn, Jessie Royce Landis, John Dehner, Jim Backus, Rickey Kelman, Dorothy Green
description: Parker has made every effort to dissuade his wife Angela from writing a comedy centered on the family's antics. In addition to pride, Parker also thinks about the complications that can arise for his job: he is in fact a theatrical critic of an important newspaper. But the wife stages the play, the critics crush her and the tension between her and her husband becomes unbearable.
notes: Even if already advanced in years, Bob Hope always manages to give the best of himself; alongside him Lucille Ball, television star repeatedly under investigation because considered pro-Communist (and despite this among John Wayne's best friends).

title: Let's Make It Legal
actors: Claudette Colbert, Macdonald Carey, Zachary Scott, Barbara Bates, Robert Wagner, Marilyn Monroe, Frank Cady, Harry Harvey
description: Miriam is already a grandmother, but she is still young. She feels neglected by her husband and decides to separate. The man continues to attend his daughter, but does not try to win back his wife: so Miriam anxiously awaits the day when the divorce will be done. Meanwhile, an old suitor, Victor, who has become a billionaire, shows up. Between him and Miriam it seems to be done but, shortly before the divorce, the woman discovers that Victor had not married her when she was young because he had lost her in a dice bet. So the granny decides to return to her family.
notes: Claudette Colbert knows how to age well and she proves it by making fun of old age. Screenplay by Wilderian I. A. L. Diamond, part for a young Marylin Monroe.

title: Mia nonna poliziotto
actors: Tina Pica, Mario Riva, Riccardo Billi, Ugo Tognazzi, Lyla Rocco, Alberto Lionello, Diana Dei, Bice Valori, Raimondo Vianello, Paolo Panelli
description: Grandma Tina (Tina Pica) returns to town for the wedding of her grandson Alberto. As soon as she arrived she was robbed of a precious medallion of immense emotional value. The police, in charge of the investigation, slack off. This is how grandma Tina sets out on the trail of thieves and manages to defeat a dangerous organization.
notes: It is a light comedy, where the hand of a specialist of the genre like Steno, prevents the film from losing its tone. All built on a handful of actors, among which Billi and Riva stand out, the film revolves around the figure of Tina Pica.

title: Billy Two Hats
actors: Gregory Peck, Desi Arnaz jr., Jack Warden, Sian Barbara Allen, David Huddleston, John Pearce, Dawn Little Sky, Vincent St. Cyr, Henry Medicine Hat
description: Henry is a bandit who is paired with Billy, a young half-caste. When Billy, captured by Sheriff Arch, is about to be hanged, Henry promptly arrives to rescue him. At that point, the only hope for the two is to arrive in Mexico. Henry is injured; a certain Spencer offers himself as a guide, but, in addition to the sheriff, the Indians also get involved.
notes: Western with a beautiful setting (Kotcheff was also the director of the first "Rambo", remarkable in this respect). Written by Alan Sharp, also screenwriter of "Night Target" (Penn) and "No Mercy for Ulzana" (Aldrich).

title: La mia signora
directors: Tinto Brass, Luigi Comencini, Mauro Bolognini
actors: Alberto Sordi, Silvana Mangano, Claudio Gora, Elena Nicolai, Laura Durell, Marisa Fiorio, Mario Conocchia, Elena Fabrizi, Mino Doro, Lamberto Antinori
description: An exasperated husband kills the canary to which his wife is very attached, then proceeds to do the same thing with the woman. A builder ingratiates himself with a minister with the favors of a prostitute. A man who has been sick for a long time is reprimanded by his "loved ones". A man and a woman waiting at the airport are hoping that their spouses will crash on the plane. A man worries about the car, but not about his wife's betrayal.
notes: Show in five episodes of the Deaf-Mangano couple (actually hilarious). But the sketching of almost all the episodes is excessive.

title: The Glass Bottom Boat
actors: Doris Day, Rod Taylor, Arthur Godfrey, Dom DeLuise, John McGiver, Paul Lynde, Edward Andrews, Eric Fleming, Dick Martin, Elisabeth Fraser, George Tobias
description: A somewhat crazy but harmless girl works in a missile factory, and all the most innocent gestures she makes are interpreted, by a dumb policeman and hysterical generals, as spy signals. We are at the time of the cold war and every citizen is haunted by the mania for the international communist conspiracy. When she notices it, she leads everyone by the nose whispering fake messages into her compact or making imaginary night appointments to non-existent Russian secret agents.
notes: Doris Day wisely quotes herself (from _The Man Who Knew Too Much About Hitchcock_) when she sings _Que sera, sera_.

title: This Earth Is Mine
actors: Rock Hudson, Jean Simmons, Dorothy McGuire, Claude Rains, Kent Smith, Anna Lee, Augusta Merighi, Francis Bethencourt, Stacy Graham, Alberto Morin
description: In times of prohibition, business is bad for wine producers. But the old Californian Philip Rambeau does not give up, and indeed plans to extend his domains with the marriage between his niece Elisabeth and the son of the neighboring owner. But Elisabeth starts a stormy friendship with John (Hudson), the illegitimate son of Philip's son-in-law and the family's black sheep. Disagreements, misunderstandings, head shots, stifled scandals and a stake prelude to the happy ending. Familiar saga of choral breath, the film feels some slowness but is supported by good acting and directed with sure craft.

title: Mitt liv som hund
actors: Anton Glanzelius, Tomas von Brömssen, Anki Liden, Melinda Kinnaman, Kicki Rundgren, Lennart Hjulström, Ing-Marie Carlsson, Leif Ericson, Christina Carlwind, Ralph Carlsson
description: Sweden in the 1950s. Having moved to the countryside with his uncles due to his mother's illness, also separated from his dog Sikkar, who is placed in a kennel, the young Ingemar reacts by fighting nostalgia with curiosity, typical of all children. The death of the mother and the animal lead him to despair, but thanks to these painful trials the boy will conquer a new maturity.
notes: Portrait of an adolescence tempered by modesty and irony taken from a very famous bestseller, in Sweden, by Reidar Jönson. Hallström then emigrated to America.

title: Miami Blues
actors: Alec Baldwin, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Fred Ward, José Pérez, Charles Napier, Obba Babatundé, Nora Dunn, José Pérez, Paul Gleason
description: Landing at Miami airport, fresh out of a prison where he served a sentence for scam and theft, the grim Frederick J. Frenge Junior breaks the finger of a harmless orange who, following the shock, dies of a stroke. Arriving at the hotel he calls the "ring", Susie, who falls prey to his ambiguous charm and becomes his lover and accomplice. But the dead man at the airport unleashed Hoke Moseley, a policeman determined to shed some light on the whole affair. On the trail of the killer, Hoke will open the eyes of the very naive Susie.
notes: The film is produced by that Jonathan Demme who revolutionized the canons of the comedy with "Something overwhelming" and of the thriller with "The silence of the lambs". Here his accomplice Armitage plays on the displacement and shuffling of the cards of the detective genre.

title: Miami Supercops
actors: Terence Hill, Bud Spencer, Jackie Castellano, C.B. Seay, Rhonda Lundstead, William 'Bo' Jim, Richard Liberty, C.V. Wood Jr., Rhonda S. Lundstead, Buffy Dee
description: Doug (Terence Hill) and Steve (Bud Spencer) have been friends for a long time. The former works for the FBI, the latter quit the police because he doesn't trust superiors. One day a criminal, a former policeman, is released after a robbery whose booty had not been found. Doug, who with Steve, had arrested the man is in charge of the investigation. At first Steve refuses to cooperate in the investigation, but changes his mind after the body of the former policeman is found. With a bit of cunning and many sganassons, the two discover what has happened.
notes: American production but all-Italian troupe directed, with the left hand, by Bruno Corbucci. Spencer and Hill's success was already on the wane.

title: Blue, White and Perfect
actors: Lloyd Nolan, Mary Beeth Hughes, George Reeves, Helene Reynolds, Steven Geray, Henry Victor, Curt Bois, Marie Blake, Emmett Vogan
description: During the war, a group of traffickers tried to smuggle diamonds, disguising them as buttons, in favor of the enemy. But the incorruptible Shayne watches over. Patriotic Michael Shayne is not very different from normal Michael Shayne.

title: Micki + Maude
actors: Dudley Moore, Amy Irving, Ann Reinking, Richard Mulligan, George Gaynes, Wallace Shawn, John Pleshette, H.B. Haggerty, Lu Leonard, Priscilla Pointer
description: Rob is a successful commentator and is married to a female lawyer, Micki. But she works too much and neglects her husband, who fatally falls in love with another woman, Maude, a beautiful cellist. When the latter announces that she is expecting a child with him, Rob decides to divorce. But his wife is also expecting a baby from him: so, how to do it?
notes: The comedy is told with amiable cynicism by a veteran of bizarre situations (Blake Edwards), who under the smiling surface hides the "poisons" of American institutions. In this case, the family, work and the habit of extramarital escape.

title: Il microfono è vostro
actors: Gisella Sofio, Enrico Luzi, Aroldo Tieri, Ada Dondini, Enrico Viarisio, Guglielmo Inglese, Mario Siletti, Rino Salviati, Franco Parenti, Nilla Pizzi
description: Maria Vanieri, daughter of a scientist, is engaged to Filippo an engineer, but her passion is music. The meeting with Bruno, composer of pop music, changes her life. The boy has put on a jazz band and learned that Maria can sing well asks her to join the group. During a radio show for amateurs, entitled "The microphone is yours", Maria proves to have a beautiful voice, but in order not to compromise her friends she decides to take on a stage name.
notes: A light comedy full of musical numbers performed, among others, by the Quartetto Cetra, Gorni Kramer and Nilla Pizzi.

title: My Favorite Wife
actors: Irene Dunne, Cary Grant, Randolph Scott, Gail Patrick, Ann Shoemaker, Scotty Beckett, Mary Lou Harrington, Donald MacBride, Hugh O'Connell
description: Seven years after his wife's disappearance in a shipwreck, Nick decides to remarry, but the woman, who was actually saved and lived on a desert island, reappears on her wedding day. The poor thing chases her husband on their honeymoon until he confronts him with the new and unexpected situation.
notes: Grant in great shape redeems some naivety of the script. Instead of Garson Kanin, Leo McCarey, who was the victim of an accident, was supposed to be at the helm. However Kanin added a bit of mischief to the plot which makes the film very enjoyable and entertaining.

title: I miei primi 40 anni
actors: Carol Alt, Elliott Gould, Jean Rochefort, Paola Quattrini, Pierre Cosso, Massimo Venturiello, Capucine, Riccardo Garrone, Carlo Monni, Teo Teocoli, Claudio Insegno, Riccardo Serventi Longhi
description: The irresistible rise of Marina's jet set into Olympus takes forty years, from the end of the war to the present day. The chosen path is that of erotic encounters and seductions that aim higher and higher, passing from boys met in Piazza Navona to dukes, princes and businessmen. In the alcove, however, some more or less, they all make a meager figure. The glossy photography, the performers little more than decorative, the dull screenplay make one think of a rotogravure; in fact the film is inspired by the autobiographical novel by Marina Ripa di Meana. Overwork for makeup artists and costume designers.

title: The Man Who Loved Women
actors: Burt Reynolds, Julie Andrews, Kim Basinger, Marilu Henner
description: An avid Don Juan, David Flower turned to a beautiful psychoanalyst to recover from his anxieties, obviously due to childhood problems. The sessions start the amorous complicity between doctor and patient until the first advises the second to look for another psychoanalyst (male). But the vision of a beautiful pair of female legs, distracting him from the arrival of a speeding car, will soon lead Flower to the terminus. Heavy and not very happy remake by Blake Edwards of Truffaut's beautiful film "The Man Who Loved Women": the melancholy of the original ends up drowned in a general tone a little too farcical. Certainly not Edwards' best film.

title: Best Defense
actors: Dudley Moore, Eddie Murphy, Helen Shaver, Kate Capshaw
description: He is a white man, he is an engineer and he is the author of a war project very welcome to the generals of the US army but which bothers enemy forces. Around him are unleashed CIA agents and terrorists while a black friend of his, in command of a sophisticated tank to which the engineer's innovations have been applied, finds himself in the middle of a conflict in the Middle East.
notes: Farce not very brilliant, in which the satire of military obtuseness dominates, but in addition to the Pentagon half the world is involved. The little guy Dudley Moore is the engineer, while the giggle Eddie Murphy is the black partner.

title: The Natural
actors: Robert Redford, Robert Duvall, Glenn Close, Kim Basinger
description: On the death of his father, who had pushed him to devote himself to baseball, Roy Hobbes (Redford) builds a bat from a tree trunk hit by lightning, and leaves for Chicago. Here he will meet an old flame, who in the meantime has become the mother of a child. Despite his natural talent, success as a professional player only comes very painfully.
notes: Reversing the moral of the Bernard Malamud novel from which it is based, Levinson directs a typical sports film that differs from the cliché for the mythological charge it contains: the lightning that breaks the bat, the typical figures of the assistant and the tempting woman. of fairy tales, and a timelessness that gives the whole a patina of nostalgia. Redford looks all his age.

title: Best of the Best
actors: Eric Roberts, James Earl Jones, Sally Kirkland, Chris Penn
description: On the eve of an important international karate match, the American team leader faces a serious problem. At his disposal there are in fact five champions who do not have good relations with each other.
