notes: The film alternates the performances of the champions with an attempt at psychological introspection. But the spectacular moments are definitely the most successful part of the film. Among the performers stand out the black James Earl Jones and the brother of Julia Roberts.

title: Milarepa
actors: Lajos Balázsovits, Paolo Bonacelli, Marisa Fabbri, Marcella Michelangeli
description: Leo (Lajos Balazsovits), a working class student who translated the story of the great Tibetan yogi Milarepa at the invitation of Professor Bennet (Paolo Bonacelli), is the victim of an accident while accompanying the professor and his wife to the airport. While waiting for help, Leo traces the story of the magician, poet and hermit of the 11th century. A story that concerns him closely. Filmed for Rai at the time of "experimentation", this is one of the least presumptuous, most successful and most chaste films of the Emilian director. Finding the East in the mountains of the L'Aquila Apennines was not easy, but Liliana Cavani succeeded.

title: Miliardi
actors: Carol Alt, Lauren Hutton, Billy Zane, Jean Sorel, Alexandra Paul
description: Leo Ferretti, with a financial empire behind him, is in a coma after an accident. While his wife, from whom he is separated, who still loves him, rushes to his bedside, the other relatives fight to divide up his wealth. A new family solidarity will eventually arise from the tangle of vipers, but for how long? Sentimental drama and comic-book social criticism in this umpteenth product by the Vanzina company, which would like to give us the disturbing insight into a certain social segment where only money and sex count, with the necessary exceptions. It is the usual glossy and monochord cinema that the Vanzina company has been offering for 15 years. What tiredness!

title: Le milieu du monde
actors: Philippe Léotard, Olimpia Carlisi, Juliet Berto, Denise Péron
description: Paul (Léotard) managed to make a career, now he is a manager of a small company and is a candidate in the municipal elections. During a meeting he meets Adriana (Carlisi), an Italian emigrant who works in a bistro: alone and independent. Paul falls in love with her and makes her his mistress, with the result that he ultimately loses the election. When Paul then asks Adriana to marry him, she refuses and goes to work in the factory: freedom, first of all. Social difference and feelings at the crossroads in a film "as beautiful as a winter landscape", set in Switzerland, in Eligoz, a natural watershed between the Mediterranean basin and that of the North Sea. As always, Alain Tanner prefers that no man's land where different cultures meet and often end up colliding.

title: Le million
actors: René Lefèvre, Annabella, Paul Olivier
description: A penniless Parisian painter has forgotten a lottery ticket in his vest sold to a second-hand dealer. Now that ticket is worth a million: thus begins a frantic ticket hunt that will end happily. A sort of light and fun Parisian musical, shot in the early years of sound making the most of the potential of the new technique.

title: One Million Years B. C.
actors: Raquel Welch, John Richardson, Robert Brown, Percy Herbert
description: At the dawn of humanity Tumack, son of the ferocious chieftain Aknoma, tries to rebel against his father's authority, but he goes wrong and is forced to flee. On the seashore he meets Loana who saves him from the attack of a sea turtle. In the meantime Aknoma has been dismissed by Sekoma, brother of our hero, even if the return home will not be easy for him. It would be easy to be ironic that a caveman just out of the house meets a cave woman who has the body of Raquel Welch. Actually the film is a bit naive, but it's not badly done. The special effects were good for the period.

title: Hands Across the Table
actors: Carole Lombard, Fred MacMurray, Ralph Bellamy
description: A manicurist (Lombard), looking for a wealthy young man to be stuffed for money, discovers that her betrothed is actually poor. True love, however, is stronger than interests and the two will marry equally. One of Leisen's best films: acute social notations and above all a refined erotic game between the protagonists, who are the extraordinary MacMurray and Lombard.

title: 1000 dollari sul nero
actors: Anthony Steffen, Gianni Garko, Erika Blanc
description: Undeservedly in jail, Johnny returns home and discovers the culprits of his suffering. One of them is his brother Sartana. Western spaghetti which stands out only for a curious note: it is the first in which a Sartana appears.

title: Les 1001 nuits
actors: Thierry Lhermitte, Gérard Jugnot, Catherine Zeta-Jones
description: The Baghdad caliph has a brutal habit, every night he marries a different woman and kills her after possessing her. But one day on his way the caliph meets a girl who will have the courage to rebel. It is the beautiful Shéhérazade who escapes the fate of the other concubines by telling the king about an enchanted lamp. The Genius who lends a hand to the brave girl lives in London in the nineties and gets in touch with her using his television.
notes: Modest TV movie, with good special effects, international cast. Catherine Zeta-Jones was entrusted with the role of the legendary Shéhérazade.

title: Arabian Nights
actors: Jon Hall, Maria Montez, Sabu
description: In a sumptuous technicolor the adventures of the beautiful (and, for the times, disgraced) Princess Sheherezade, who a prince saves from the clutches of the evil caliph. Hollywood exoticism, now deliciously kitsch.

title: Mille lire al mese
actors: Alida Valli, Umberto Melnati, Osvaldo Valente, Renato Cialente
description: Engineer Corodi is in Budapest to work on the nascent local television. Due to a misunderstanding he has a quarrel with a stranger, a quarrel that ends in the hands. The next day he discovers that the grumpy stranger just sent to that country is his future director. Of course it will be big trouble.
notes: Funny vintage comedy clearly inspired by the record success of the homonymous song "If I could have a thousand lire a month". A nostalgic dip into a type of cinema close to that of the "White Phones", even if less refined. For connoisseurs, a splendid Alida Valli not yet eighteen but already bewitching.

title: Mimì metallurgico ferito nell'onore
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Mariangela Melato, Turi Ferro, Elena Fiore
description: Mimì Mardocheo, emigrates to Turin from Catania. Here he has to undergo the "arm racket" in order to work. Thus he realizes that the mafia families control every level of production even in the North. Sent back to Sicily, he remains involved in an honor killing.
notes: According to the director, this is an Italian "parable of false progress", but it is essentially a grotesque comedy held by the histrionic couple Giannini / Melato.

title: Seven Days to Noon
actors: Frank Harvey, Roy Boulting, Paul Dehen, James Bernard
description: The British Prime Minister is threatened by prof. Willington, director of the Center for Atomic Studies. A nuclear explosion will occur in central London if the British government does not stop producing explosives. A bomb is in fact gone, and the professor's searches do not get results. All that remains is to evacuate the metropolis. The tension lasts until the last second. One of the first atomic science fiction films, not too naive and with some moments of great tension.

title: King Solomon's Mines
actors: Paul Robeson, Cedric Hardwicke, Ronald Young, John Loder
description: An expedition to Africa sets out in search of fabulous treasures hidden inside a mine. The wilderness, the ferocious animals and the warlike warriors of the primitive tribes constitute almost insurmountable obstacles. Before the numerous film versions of the novel by H. Rider Haggard. Great cast.

title: King Solomon's Mines
actors: Stewart Granger, Deborah Kerr, Richard Carlson, Hugo Haas
description: In search of an explorer who disappeared two years earlier and King Solomon's fabulous diamond mines, an expedition to the Zambari River region of Africa sets out ...
notes: Locations in true Africa, Oscar to cinematographer Robert Surtees and editor. Remake of a 1937 film, which was in turn remade in 1985.

title: Woman of the North Country
actors: Gale Storm, Ruth Hussey
description: A greedy and proud woman tempts them all - from the deadly ambush, to the weapons of seduction, to marriage - to ruin a possible business competitor who is also in love with her.

title: Mio
actors: Mio Hani, Rafael Cassuto, Brigitte Fossey
description: The Japanese girl Mio is six years old, she is an orphan, and from Paris, where she was abandoned, she is taken to a nursery school in a village in Sardinia. A new language, new friends in an unknown society form the universe of the little girl, who becomes attached to a French institution (Fossey). Director Susumu Hani is a globetrotter, attracted to exotic events with respect to his mother culture. In Sardinia, however, with the ambition of looking at reality through the eyes of a child, he made a presumptuous mess.

title: Il mio amico Benito
actors: Peppino De Filippo, Mario Carotenuto, Didi Perego, Riccardo Billi
description: Peppino Di Gennaro is an anonymous employee who aspires to the post of office manager. When a friend gives him a photograph in which he is portrayed in the trenches with Mussolini, he decides to use this medium as well to get what he wants. The misunderstandings follow one another; on the day of the declaration of war Peppino resigns. Comedy with flattened and fragmented satirical intentions. The film doesn't have enough nastiness, but Peppino De Filippo is a lot of fun. Particular also for Franchi and Ingrassia.

title: Flipper
actors: Chuck Connors, Luke Halpin, Kathleen Maguire, Jane Rose
description: A child, son of fishermen, saves a dolphin injured by a diver. The two become inseparable friends. The dolphin, however, despite the friendship, prefers to live free on the high seas. Reluctantly, the boy agrees to free him. However, the two are destined to meet again: in fact, the dolphin has not forgotten the "human cub" and when he is in great danger in the water ...

title: Bedazzled
actors: Peter Cook, Dudley Moore, Eleanor Brown, Raquel Welch
description: A young man, a cook in a diner, is in love with the beautiful waitress Margaret, but is unable to declare himself. The Devil himself intervenes to help him, allowing him seven opportunities for success in exchange for his soul. Of course the mocking Lord of Darkness wrecks all seven attempts. But then, for distraction, he returns the soul to the now desperate young man. Brilliant variation by Stanley Donen on a Faustian theme: iconoclastic, satirical, full of humor.

title: Il mio amico Jekyll
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Raimondo Vianello, Carlo Croccolo, Abbe Lane
description: Giacinto Flora, tutor in a girls' boarding school, is kidnapped every night by Doctor Jekyll, who manages to transform him into a sadistic and vicious individual. Strange and inexplicable facts take place inside the college, until the intervention of a detective tries to put things right by solving the riddle.
notes: The steel duo Tognazzi / Vianello, tested on television and in many other more successful films, misses several hits. The role of the detective is entrusted to Carlo Croccolo.

title: Kelly and Me
actors: Van Johnson, Piper Laurie, Martha Hyer
description: Len Carmory is a mediocre variety singer whose prices soar thanks to the sympathy of his new partner, Kelly, a little dog who has grown fond of him. Nina, the daughter of a producer, opens the doors to the cinema for the couple, but the presumption prevents Len from recognizing that the credit belongs to the dog. Then Kelly's real owner shows up, and Carmory opens her eyes to her situation. Decent sentimental comedy starring Van Johnson, eternal Hollywood baby-face, and Piper Laurie, just a few years before the good performance in The Big Swagger. Director's last film.

title: Mac and Me
actors: Jade Calegory, Jonathan Ward, Lauren Stanley
description: Mac, his parents and a little sister are dumped in the United States by a space probe that accidentally took them from their planet. Mac happens to be in the family of Eric, a handicapped child, with whom he becomes a great friend. The attempt to exploit the success of "E.T." with one story it is quite evident, the result is poor in ideas and modest spectacular attractions.

title: A New Kind of Love
actors: Paul Newman, Joanne Woodward, Thelma Ritter, George Tobias
description: Exiled to Paris as punishment, an American journalist is dazzled by a woman of the world about whom he writes articles that consecrate him to success. She conquers him by transforming herself into a different type of woman each time. More complex than confusing, more mellow than scratchy, a comedy with the Newman / Woodward couple and an appearance by Maurice Chevalier.

title: Fanny by Gaslight
actors: James Mason, Phyllis Calvert, Stewart Granger, Wilfrid Lawson
description: The illegitimate daughter of a politician, Fanny was raised by her adoptive parents. The putative father dies, killed by the evil Lord Manderstoke and so Fanny goes to be a maid in a noble house, which is that of her natural father. He then falls in love with his father's secretary, Harry, and discovers that Lord Manderstoke is the mistress of his father's wife who threatens to reveal Fanny's true origin. The latter's father kills himself. Fanny and Harry leave for Paris.
notes: Victorian melodrama born in the wake of the success of "The Man in Gray", but shot with great means and great wisdom. Disturbing and "perverse" the acting of James Mason.

title: Mio caro dottor Gräsler
actors: Keith Carradine, Miranda Richardson, Kristin Scott Thomas, Sarah Jane Fenton, Max Von Sydow
description: On the eve of the First World War, after the suicide of his protective sister, Dr. Grasler returns to Hungary from the Canary Islands. After an attempted marriage and a passionate adventure with a girl who later dies of scarlet fever, the doctor discovers his sister's unsuspected past. Finally, he marries an attractive and cunning widow. Film transcription of Arthur Schnitzler's short story. At the center of the film is the accurate and realistic reconstruction of the period, as well as the solid level of the cast, but overall the operation is rather aseptic and "plastered".

title: Mio Dio, come sono caduta in basso!
actors: Laura Antonelli, Alberto Lionello, Michele Placido, Jean Rochefort
description: The marquis Eugenia, on the point of consummating her marriage with Raimondo, receives a letter from her father. He reveals that the new husband is actually her stepbrother. The two decide to live as brother and sister: she dedicates herself to pious works, he to the reading of the texts of Gabriele D'Annunzio. Enlisted in the army, Raimondo dies in Libya, while Eugenia consoles herself too soon in the arms of the driver Silvano ...
notes: Comencini tries to make fun of the secondary novel and the popular culture of Italetta. Scattered D'Annunzio decadences, plus a Laura Antonelli still in splendid shape. The result, however, leaves a lot to be desired.

title: Mio figlio professore
actors: Aldo Fabrizi, Giorgio De Lullo, Mario Pisu, Diana Nava, Lisetta Nava, Pinuccia Nava
description: Left a widower at the birth of his son, Orazio Belli (Aldo Fabrizi) has only one ambition: to make the boy a teacher, to see him teach in the high school where he, his father, is a janitor. But gratitude is a rare virtue and is not part of the school curriculum and the boy, once he has grown up and graduated, ends up putting his ambitions before gratitude towards the sacrifices of the parent. Renato Castellani tells with elegance and measure a story in which feelings have a decisive weight. The interpretation of Fabrizi is sober and effective. Note the presence of many Italian writers: Emilio Cecchi and Fausto Tozzi (as screenwriters), Flaiano, Monelli, Gabriele Baldini, Patti and Jovine (as actors in secondary roles).

title: Enemy Mine
actors: Dennis Quaid, Louis Gossett jr., Brion James, Richard Marcus
description: Let's take a big step forward in time, up to the middle of the 21st century. The terrestrial Davidge (Quaid) goes to the assault of the alien Jeriba (Gossett jr.), A "Dracon" who has entered with his own space shuttle into orbit that was not his responsibility. Both fall on the planet Fyrine IV, a ghostly environment with two suns and six moons inhabited by human carnivores. At this point, it is necessary to put aside the old grudges and move on to mutual collaboration, but even so the dangers are far from over.
notes: The story is curious, but the film lacks the magic of the author's previous film, "The Neverending Story", and did not replicate its success.

title: Il mio nome è Mallory 'M' come morte
actors: Robert Wood, Gabriella Giorgelli, Teodoro Corrà
description: The famous gunslinger Mallory and the retired Northern Colonel Hasper buy a farm in which to spend their last years. A certain Jefferson who sold it is robbed and killed by two bandits. Hasper and Mallory confront them. Italian-style Western of series C and already a little out of time, but shot with some care.

title: Il mio nome è Nessuno
actors: Terence Hill, Henry Fonda, Jean Martin, Piero Lulli, Mario Brega
description: Nobody is a young and skilled gunslinger, but more ready for mockery than the use of weapons. His idol is the legendary Jack Beauregard. When Nobody finally meets him he does everything to involve him in an exaggerated enterprise: to destroy the "Wild Bunch", a band of 150 gunmen who terrorize the Far West.
notes: Spaghetti-Western far from negligible directed in some parts by Sergio Leone (uncredited). The reflection on Peckinpah (whose name appears on a tomb) is evident, the crepuscular atmosphere that accompanies the death of the western myth as well. The parts to the "Trinity" today are a little out of tune.

title: Il mio nome è Scopone e faccio sempre cappotto
actors: Anthony Steffen, Fernando Sancho, Gillian Hills, Ricardo Hundar
description: Gunman Dallas plays a rich poker legacy with beautiful Glenda. Comic Western that does not excite and does not entertain. Steffen is actually Antonio De Teffé.

title: Mon père, ce héros.
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Marie Gillain, Patrick Mile
description: André (Gérard Depardieu) portly forty, divorced, father of a beautiful fifteen-year-old girl and Isabelle's lover, leaves with his daughter Veronique for a holiday in Mauritius. Veronique, already very developed for her age, pretends to be eighteen and to be André's lover. Friends get jealous, right-thinking people murmur. A well-known cartoonist, Lauzier creates a pleasant and funny opera, mixing misunderstandings and a hint of transgression. Depardieu has the opportunity to show talent and ... belly.

title: My Left Foot
actors: Daniel Day-Lewis, Brenda Fricker, Fiona Shaw, Hugh O'Connor, Ruth McCabe
description: Christy Brown (Day-Lewis) is struck by a paralysis that precludes movement and speech. Despite this terrible disability, his family, very numerous and of modest economic conditions, welcomed him with great love. Christy is able to communicate through the movements of her left foot.
notes: First film by Irish director Jim Sheridan. Great is the seriousness with which the story is faced, without concessions to easy sentimentality and even with irony. Academy Awards to Daniel Day-Lewis and Brenda Fricker.

title: My Man and I
actors: Ricardo Montalban, Shelley Winters, Claire Trevor
description: José Ramirez, a Mexican laborer, recently became an American citizen, discovers that the masters are hateful, the wives of the lewd masters and the redeemed lost women. Watering social realism, comedy's bland tone. The script is by the writer John Fante who managed to ruin his reputation in Hollywood.

title: Az en XX Szazadom
actors: Dorotha Segda, Oleg Jankowski, Péter Andorai
description: In the night in which Edison invents the light bulb, two stars descend from the sky of Budapest and become women: the twins Dora and Lili. On Christmas night the two little sisters try to sell matches, two gentlemen pass that light their cigars and take them with them. Ten years later they meet on the Orient Express, Dora who became luxury ring, a clandestine anarchist lili that has to blow up the train. It is a strange and intriguing film this work before of the Hungarian director (he won the Chamber of OR in Cannes). Good photography and vintage reconstruction, perhaps a little frayed the story that lives of one of his retro poetics.

title: Mon oncle Benjamin
actors: Jacques Brel, Claude Jade, Rosy Varte, Bernard Alane, Paul Frankeur
description: Beniamino (Jacques Brel) is a young village doctor who enjoys his life amidst gallant adventures and mockery against the bourgeois. Jailed for debts, he gets pardon and returns to old habits. It almost seems like a Jacques Brel song, a talent that cinema has almost never been able to exploit.

title: The Miracle Of the Bells
actors: Alida Valli, Frank Sinatra, Fred MacMurray
description: Now seriously ill, an actress who has never managed to emerge sees herself entrusted, thanks to the commitment of her agent, to the part of Joan of Arc. The girl is committed despite the illness and ends the film by dying immediately after: she did it to leave a message of faith for her fellow citizens. But the producer has no faith in the film; the agent then convinces the actress's fellow villagers to project it by making him accompany the flocking bells for three days. So everyone talks about it and the manufacturer reviews their decision.
notes: Arriving in America with great expectations, Valli failed to break through even with this modest melodrama.

title: *batteries not included
actors: Hume Cronyn, Jessica Tandy, Elizabeth Peña, Frank McRae
description: To carry out a large housing speculation, the people of a working-class neighborhood in New York are made to evacuate with dollars or bars (these for the recalcitrant). The perpetrator of the misdeeds is the gang of Carlos Chavez. The only ones to resist it are five tenants, two of which are very elderly. Two alien spaceships come to their aid from space to restore peace to the neighborhood.
notes: After the times of terrifying science fiction and the fear of "aliens", here come the good extraterrestrials and executioners. Not surprisingly, there is Spielberg's hand.

title: Mirage
actors: Gregory Peck, Diane Baker, Walter Matthau, Leif Erickson
description: David, a chemical scientist, discovers the formula to neutralize the radioactivity, but destroys it to prevent its commercial exploitation by Calvin, the owner of the laboratories where he operates. The latter, in an attempt to get hold of it, dies, and David's mind is shocked. Now, however, it is Calvin's partner who plots against David, but, in the end, everything works out for the best. An excellent show, full of tension and with actors in the mood.

title: The Hunger
actors: Catherine Deneuve, Susan Sarandon, David Bowie, Ann Magnuson, Willem Dafoe
description: Miriam is the latest descendant of a 4,000-year-old generation of vampires. John has been her lover for three centuries and promised him eternal youth. But suddenly John begins to grow old without hope. He turns to Sarah, a famous doctor, but she can't do anything for him.
notes: Film debut of Tony Scott, Ridley's younger brother. Visually overwhelming, where the director's advertising provenance is evident, the film makes use of a pressing musical column. The wonderful Deneuve and Sarandon are accompanied by a disturbing and tragic David Bowie. The first part of the film has a dizzying charm. In the second part, the script becomes a bit rough.

title: Miseria e nobiltà
actors: Totò, Dolores Palumbo, Sophia Loren, Enzo Turco, Valeria Moriconi
description: Don Felice and Don Pasquale, public scribe and itinerant photographer, pretend to be relatives of the marquis Eugenio so that he can get the hand of the daughter of an enriched former cook. The phony aristocrats play their roles well, but the intrusion of Don Felice's woman risks ruining the purpose for which the fiction was concocted.
notes: From the most famous comedy by Eduardo Scarpetta, written in 1887, one of the best films played by Totò in his long career as a comedian. Beside him a very respectable cast: the young Sophia Loren and Franca Faldini in the role of the Piedmontese milliner. Screenplay by Ruggero Maccari. Totò is Felice Sciosciammocca, one of his most successful figures. Memorable the orgy of pasta, Totò photographer, and all the long final fiction (with the catchphrase "Vincenzo m'è father to me"). From commoners to (fake) aristocrats to foster a marriage of love.

title: Le miserie del signor Travet
actors: Carlo Campanini, Vera Carmi, Gino Cervi, Luigi Pavese, Alberto Sordi
description: Royal clerk Ignazio Travet has never had a promotion in the office because his section head dislikes him. A widower, he remarried a still young woman who makes him weigh his condition as a bankrupt, and also flirts with another superior. The day Ignazio finally rebels, he is immediately fired and ends up as an accountant in a bakery.
notes: Brilliant cinematographic reduction of a text written by Vittorio Bersezio in 1863, scripted among others by Tullio Pinelli. Carlo Campanini, for the first time in a dramatic role, albeit softened by comedy tones, makes sparks fly. The superior is Gino Cervi.

title: Misery
actors: James Caan, Kathy Bates, Lauren Bacall, Frances Sternhagen
description: Paul Sheldon (James Caan), author of a series of successful books, is returning to New York from the cabin where he retired to write the latest book, in which he has decided to have his ubiquitous heroine, Misery, die. Because of the snow he gets off the road with his car and is rescued by Annie Wilkes (Kathy Bates) who "shelters" him in her isolated house. Sheldon then falls, but falls to his feet as the woman is a registered nurse. Even if he will not be able to use them much, his feet, since Annie is also a regular reader of his books, passionately passionate about the character of Misery. At that point, for Sheldon there is no alternative or he leaves his heroine alive or Annie breaks his legs (which is what happens). Sheldon agrees, but does not give up hopes of escape. The starting point, as already in Stand by Me directed by Rob Reiner, is a story by Stephen King. But here, unlike in the previous one, the tone is all thrown on the thriller side with, in addition, some trespassing into horror. Chubby Kathy Bates is so loving and caring in looking after her favorite writer that one hardly believes it when she then gets angry and grabs him in the ankles. Maternal Kathy Bates is so subtle and perverse that no one was surprised the night she was awarded the Oscar for Best Actress for this film.

title: White Mischief
actors: Greta Scacchi, Charles Dance, John Hurt, Joss Ackland
description: We are in Kenya in 1940: the last glimpses of colonialism on the eve of the Second War; a lord is tried and acquitted of killing his wife's young lover. The woman, however, continues to suspect him until, after a scene, the lord kills himself. The widow soon remarried.
notes: Michael Radford ("Another Time Another Place") reconstructs a news story that really happened, which thrilled British public opinion at the time. Presumptuous and distracted film. Only Greta Scacchi, in the role of the icy and seductive protagonist, and the villain Joss Ackland work.

title: Mishima
actors: Ken Ogata, Kenji Sawada, Yasosuke Bando
description: The account of the last acts of the Japanese writer's existence is intertwined with the free adaptation of four of his novels. Paul Schrader, who has always been strongly attracted to Japanese culture and rituals, confronts head-on with one of the strongest and most ambiguous personalities of contemporary Japanese literature. A not entirely successful but interesting film, which investigates the biography and work of a controversial character, confronting a difficult culture. Rigorous (Schrader studied Ozu) and fascinating staging (splendid photography by John Bailey, music by Philip Glass).

title: Miss Arizona
actors: Hanna Schygulla, Marcello Mastroianni, Luigi Lucci
description: Mitzi, a former prostitute, is left alone with her son Andras, after her husband was killed by the soldiers. She is protected by Sandor, a poet-clown, with whom she goes to Italy: the three perform under the name of "Trio Arizona". Hidden in an old toy they discover the diamonds for which Mitzi's husband was killed, with which they open a nightclub in Budapest, the "Arizona", which becomes a luxurious meeting place.
notes: Pal Sandor's image of Hungary is always somewhat conventional. However, with this Italian-Hungarian co-production Sandor makes a false step, due to a weak screenplay.

title: Miss Italia
actors: Gina Lollobrigida, Constance Dowling, Carlo Campanini, Richard Ney, Luisa Rossi
description: A journalist's investigation into the finalists for the Miss Italy contest brings to light ambitions, naivety, frustrations and even a shady character involved in a theft. But everything ends well and a modest dressmaker wins the competition.
notes: A film that was born well and ended badly. The original project was by Alberto Lattuada and Elsa Morante collaborated on the first screenplay. Then everything passed into the hands of Coletti who wanted to "lighten" the tones of the story by renouncing realism in outlining the ruthless world of aspiring queens. The result is thus completely negligible, were it not for some "yesteryear" beauty.

title: Agatha Christie's "A Caribbean Mystery"
actors: Helen Hayes, Barnard Hughes, Jameson Parker
description: Miss Marple goes to spend the winter in the Tropics to escape the harsh English winter, but in the hotel where she is staying some people are murdered, including a retired British soldier. The ineffable detective thus begins to ask questions to all customers ...
notes: The weaving is good, the realization a bit too conventional.

title: Freeze Frame
actors: Shannen Doherty, Charles Haid, Robyn Douglass, Ryan Lambert
description: Lindsay is a 17-year-old who her father, a respected surgeon, sees well in her career at the local hospital. But she dreams of establishing herself as an assault journalist and works to do so for the school's television station. His tabloid reports shake the school and city environment, much to Dad's chagrin. However, the girl has the merit of uncovering a scandal linked to a businessman running for the office of governor. Shannon "Brenda" Doherty plays away from home, looking for credibility beyond the borders of Beverly Hills, denouncing poor athletic training even in less demanding matches. First TV viewing

title: Rally 'Round the Flag, Boys!
actors: Paul Newman, Joanne Woodward, Joan Collins, Jack Carson
description: Harry and Grace Bannermann already see each other little because she is always busy organizing committees and meetings. When it is learned that a missile base will be installed in the city, Harry goes to the Pentagon to change their minds to the military, but without obtaining any results. Indeed, his marriage enters into crisis and is called to arms.
notes: Paul Newman and Joanne Woodward, also spouses in life, master this witty mockery of military power intertwined with misadventures and misunderstandings within a couple.

title: Missing in Action 2: The Beginning
actors: Chuck Norris, Soon-Tek Oh, Steven Williams, Bennett Ohta, Cosie Costa
description: Ten years after the end of the conflict, Colonel Braddock is still a prisoner of the Vietnamese along with other American soldiers. The shady and sadistic commander of the camp tries, with every torture, to get him to sign a "confession" in which Braddock would declare himself a war criminal. The colonel, however, is a tough nut to crack: he resists his tormentor, manages to escape and, instead of saving himself, returns to free his companions, sowing death and destruction ...
notes: The film, actually a prequel to _Rombo di thunder_, is a Reagan-era cinematic fossil record for viewers in search of rather elementary thrills.

title: Braddock: Missing in Action III
actors: Chuck Norris, Aki Aleong, Roland Harrah III
description: Colonel James Braddock has lived for twelve years thinking that he had lost his pregnant Vietnamese wife in the house destroyed by a mortar shell during the fall of Saigon. He is baffled when a missionary reveals to him that mother and son are still alive. However, he manages to reach them and organize his escape from Vietnam, when he is captured by the perfidious general Quoc, sadist and torturer. Yet another performance by Chuck "steamroller" Norris, a warrior for pretense and for money (a lot), between amusement park and cartoon.

title: The Mission
actors: Jeremy Irons, Robert De Niro, Ray McAnally, Aidan Quinn
description: In 1767, in the South American region of Paranà governed by Spanish and Portuguese, Father Gabriel, a Jesuit missionary, decided to go up the Iguazu River Falls to make contact with a tribe of Indians living in the forest. He is joined by Mendoza, a slave hunter who killed his brother out of jealousy and is now seeking redemption. Their goal, shared by their superiors, is to try to create a community system where it is possible for the indigenous to live without being exploited.
notes: Adventure and epic, in this film that surprisingly won at Cannes in 1986. A lot of rhetoric but also undeniable emotion. All in all, the most exciting and most impressive thing about the film remains the confrontation between two sacred monsters of the caliber of Robert De Niro and Jeremy Irons. Morricone's famous soundtrack. Oscar for the wonderful photography of Chris Menges.

title: The Missionary
actors: Michael Palin, Maggie Smith, Denholm Elliott, Trevor Howard
description: Returning from ten years of missions in Africa, the Reverend Charles Fortescue is commissioned by the Bishop to open a new mission for misguided women in London. The task is challenging and the reverend discovers that to get the women in question off the sidewalk, the only way is to pay them. The relationship with the girls thus becomes more and more pleasant and intimate. Michael Palin tries to break out of the legacy of Monthy Pyton, the British comedy group he was a part of. The film isn't irresistible, but it still contains little gems (Denholm Elliot as the Bishop and Maggie Smith as Lady Ames) and pretty funny moments, and it's pretty curated.

title: Mission of Justice
actors: Brigitte Nielsen, Jeff Wincott, Lucas Bercovici, Matthias Hues
description: Los Angeles at night is not a children's show. Organized crime, drug dealing, the arms trade are normal. But there are those who do not give up: small groups, organized by the police and called "armies of peace", made up of private citizens skilled in martial arts. At the head of these is a woman, Rachel (Nielsen). That Brigitte Nielsen can scare any average criminal is beyond question. Whether he is also capable of acting is however questionable.

title: Seven Women
actors: Anne Bancroft, Sue Lyon, Margaret Leighton, Woody Strode, Mike Mazurki
description: Miss Cartwright left the United States (and an impossible love affair) and moved to a Chinese mission to work as a doctor. We are in 1935 and the area where the mission is located is infested with brigands that make life difficult for the population and for foreigners.
notes: It is the last film made by John Ford, sad and hopeless like many of his twilight period. Curiously for such a virile director, the protagonists are all women. The story even remembers, from a distance, a piece of "Red Shadows".

title: The Ugly American
actors: Marlon Brando, Eiji Okada, Sandra Church, Pat Hingle
description: In Sarkan, an imaginary state in Southeast Asia, the northern part is in the hands of the Communists; an unpopular US-backed government operates in the south. Ambassador McWithe seeks the support of Deong, a popular nationalist leader. These allies with the Communists who use it and then eliminate it. McWithe declares that the US must accept the democratic aspirations of the new states. Based on a novel that at the time had considerable success in America. Despite the advance on the times and the ecumenical conclusion, the war in Vietnam would have broken out anyway.

title: Delta Force 3
actors: Nick Cassavetes, Eric Douglas, Mike Norris, Matthew Penn
description: They call them Delta Force, they face desperate missions against terrorists, especially those operating in airports. Previously, the Delta Forces have confronted Islamic hardliners in Israel and drug wholesalers in Colombia; this time their task is to resolve a difficult situation that has arisen in an Arab sheikhdom.
notes: Third mediocre episode in a series that has never managed to make itself interesting. There is also Mike Norris, son of Chuck, who had played the first two episodes; with him another illustrious son, Nick Cassavetes.

title: Thirty Seconds Over Tokyo
actors: Van Johnson, Spencer Tracy, Robert Mitchum
description: The first American air mission over Tokyo, in 1942, lasted only thirty seconds and resulted in numerous casualties among the pilots. The film tells the story of an American aviator who leaves for the mission leaving his pregnant wife at home, is shot down by anti-aircraft and falls into Chinese territory. Here he loses the use of a leg, but is saved thanks to the loving care received in a village.
notes: Solid war propaganda film that achieved great success at home. Naturally, he came out of us only in 1947, after the war was over.

title: Crossroads
actors: Ralph Macchio, Joe Seneca, Jami Gertz, Steve Vai
description: An old harmonica player is persuaded by a boy, a blues fanatic, to leave the hospice to go to the Mississippi delta. Purpose of the trip: to find a lost recording of an old bluesman ...
notes: Even when he is not in shape, as in this case, Walter Hill is always worth the vision: here, with the complicity of Ry Cooder, he returns to the "demonic" origins of the blues. The original title, _Crossroads_, is the same as a song by Robert Johnson, which legend has it that he sold his soul to the devil near a crossroads. In the part of the devil, a must for the virtuoso guitarist Steve Vai.

title: Mississippi Burning
actors: Gene Hackman, Willem Dafoe, Frances McDormand
description: Summer of 1964 in a small town in the state of Mississippi. Two FBI agents investigate the mysterious disappearance of three civil rights activists: two white Jews and one black. Detective Anderson is a tough ex-sheriff of those parts who knows all too well the vices and prejudices of the Deep South. Instead, Alan Ward would like to follow the Bureau's rules to the letter.
notes: The staging often becomes oleographic. But the Southern drama of the three murdered activists (true story) cannot leave us indifferent, as well as the usual memorable ordeal of Gene Hackman. The clash between his brutal methods and Willem Dafoe's "disciplined" but ineffective ones seems to resemble a western.

title: Mississippi Masala
actors: Denzel Washington, Sharmila Tagore, Roshan Seth, Sarita Choudhury
description: Jay, his wife Kinnu and daughter Mina have lived in the state of Mississippi since 1972, when they had to flee Uganda on the orders of dictator Amin, along with many other families of Indian origin like them. Mina is now a beautiful girl, who falls in love with a good young black man; when the relationship between the two is discovered, scandal is created in their respective communities, but they will not give in.
notes: After her debut with "Salaam Bombay", Nair moved to the US to tell us about this unusual variant on the theme of racial contrast. The future lawyer Miller of Philadelphia is here the male protagonist in another story of diversity and courage.

title: The Missouri Breaks
actors: Marlon Brando, Jack Nicholson, Kathleen Lloyd, Randy Quaid, Harry Dean Stanton, John P. Ryan, John McLiam, Frederic Forrest
description: A landowner hires a famous bounty hunter, Lee Clayton, to vanquish a gang of horse-raiders. He kills all the bandits, except their leader, Tom Logan, who also has an affair with the owner's daughter. In the final battle, uncertain to the last, it is the bounty hunter who gets the worst of it, the landowner dies and his daughter and Tom each go their own way.
notes: Great cast and excellent interpretations for a story that has its roots in the epic of the American frontier, created in an unconventional and crepuscular way by Arthur Penn. The Nicholson-Brando comparison was enormous.

title: Mr. Mom
actors: Michael Keaton, Teri Garr, Martin Mull, Ann Jillian
description: An engineer on layoffs, he has to dedicate himself to the house and to his three children.
notes: The idea and the gags have nothing original. The theme of the reversal of roles is trite and withdrawn and the ending, with its ordinary morality, is predictable at best. Out of shape actors in an irritating comedy.

title: Mr. Billion
actors: Terence Hill, Valerie Perrine, Jackie Gleason, William Redfield
description: Dying old uncle Anthony leaves a billion dollars to his nephew Guido (Hill), an Italian mechanic. An avid administrator of the company who wants the colossal inheritance for himself sends the beautiful Rosy to the young man, who has arrived in the US, to seduce him and snatch a power of attorney from him. Jonathan Kaplan, a young director with a taste for rhythm ("Young warriors"), takes up the schemes of Frank Capra's comedy and fills them with fist fights, chases and hyperbolic humor, reinforcing everything with virtuosic aerial shots. For Terence Hill, in his first film as an absolute protagonist after a long association with Bud Spencer, it seemed the beginning of a career in the United States, but it was not. At his side, the beautiful and prosperous Valérie Perrine. and the excellent Jackie Gleason ("The Bully").

title: The Draughtsman's Contract
actors: Anthony Higgins, Janet Suzman, Anne-Louise Lambert, Hugh Fraser, Neil Cunningham, Dave Hill, David Gant, David Meyer, Tony Meyer, Nicholas Amer, Suzan Crowley, Lynda La Plante, Michael Feast, Alastair Cumming, Steve Ubels
description: We are in 1694, in England. Neville, an ambitious painter, accepts a curious contract: Mrs. Herbert commissions twelve drawings of his garden from him, granting him herself in exchange. At the end of the work, Neville realizes that the drawings contain the clues of a probable murder and here Mister Herbert is in fact found dead.
notes: It is the film that gave Greenaway international fame. A kind of charade designed with great formal refinement. It is legitimate to formulate any hypothesis about the meaning of the enigmatic ending: it is part of the intellectual game in which the English painter-director loves to involve his audience. Michael Nyman's minimal-baroque music is famous.

title: I misteri della giungla nera
actors: Stacy Keach, Virna Lisi, Kabir Bedi, John Rhys-Davies, Ennio Fantastichini
description: In India, the Tughs sect kidnaps little Ada, daughter of the commander of an English garrison, to make her a priestess. Having become a beautiful girl, Ada will have to serve the bloodthirsty goddess Kali, but the Bengali hunter Tremal Naik, who has fallen in love with her, will be able to save her. Almost twenty years after the successes of the Sandokan series, Kabir Bedi returns to play the role of an exotic hero in a TV movie based on Salgari. In the script by Rulli and Petraglia, the adventurous and imaginative atmosphere of the original story is moderated by a strong emphasis on the "pink" implications.

title: The Lady Vanished
actors: Elliott Gould, Cybill Shepherd, Angela Lansbury, Herbert Lom, Arthur Lowe
description: On a train traveling between Bavaria and Switzerland there are some foreigners who, fearing the outbreak of the Second World War, have decided to leave Germany to take refuge in a neutral country. Among them is also the elderly Mrs. Froy. Shortly after leaving, however, the woman vanishes into thin air.
notes: The Lady in Yellow is this time the victim of a scheme invented by Hitchcock ("The Lady Disappears", 1938) and now remade in less style by Page. The confrontation, of course, is merciless.

title: Il mistero di Bellavista
actors: Benedetto Casillo, Marina Confalone, Luciano De Crescenzo
description: A porter and a street cleaner, intrigued by the passage of Halley's comet, ask Professor Bellavista to be able to observe the sky through his telescope. The two, instead of observing the comet, end up framing a window of the apartment opposite and believe they have discovered a crime. They set off in search of the body.
notes: De Crescenzo spreads some dialogues of his book (platonically titled "Oi dialoguei") on a yellow plot that does not win even a little. Stereotypes, good character actors and Arbore's music.

title: Flight of Black Angel
actors: Peter Strauss, William O'Leary, James O'Sullivan, Michele Pawk
description: An American Air Force pilot is leading a group of recruits to simulate a missile attack. What the kids don't know is that their boss has convinced himself that he is an Angel of the Lord charged with a supreme mission: bombing Las Vegas. Well-made television film with a screenplay by Henry Dominic, capable of keeping the viewer in tension. In the role of the good captain, former instructor of the insane pilot, we find Peter Strauss, that of Blue Soldier.

title: Half Moon Street
actors: Sigourney Weaver, Michael Caine, Keith Buckley, Maria Aitken
description: Lauren Slaughter works at the British Middle East Institute in London. The job is good, the pay less so Lauren also ends up working for a service that provides escorts to businessmen passing through. In this way the girl meets Lord Bulbeck and falls in love with him.
notes: Since "Ipcress" Michael Caine has done nothing but play the same role, but he is not the problem with the film. The problem is that Swaim is a cheap director and that the story is not exciting even for a moment.

title: Mo' Better Blues
actors: Denzel Washington, Spike Lee, Joie Lee, Cynda Williams
description: Bleek became an acclaimed jazz trumpeter. His manager is friend Giant, a little too addicted to betting. Bleek, for its part, is disputed between two women: the teacher Indigo and the singer Clarke. What's more, Shadow, the group's saxophonist, is strongly enticed by the idea of ??outclassing him.
notes: Black music as magic and as a curse, white exploiters, a tribute to the greats of Jazz. Signed Spike Lee. In the soundtrack, among other things, Branford Marsalis. Very good Denzel Washington.

title: Moana, l'île du rêve
description: Four fellow adventures of French nationality decide to try their hand at a very risky but equally exciting undertaking: to go around the world on a small boat. During the long journey there is no shortage of dangers, counterbalanced by moments of serenity and joy such as underwater fishing trips and pleasant stops in the enchanting islands of the South Seas: here the camera stops to document dances and rituals of the local populations .
notes: Shot with fairness, but lacking the liveliness necessary to keep interest alive for the entire duration of the film. When TV had not yet tamed exoticism.

title: Mogli pericolose
actors: Sylva Koscina, Renato Salvatori, Dorian Gray, Giorgia Moll, Nino Taranto, Franco Fabrizi, Yvette Masson
description: Four wives discuss the fidelity of their respective spouses. The delicacy of the subject unleashes a whirlwind of suspicions, small passions and discontent that spare no one: as a wager the sexiest of the group undertakes to tempt the most faithful, in whose virtue only his wife believes; an employee fears that the manager's interest in his wife is behind his promotion; a father discovers that his son's disinterest in girls is only apparent.
notes: Comedy with the ambition of the portrait of costume, sometimes indifferent but still well directed. Koscina made people discuss for a hint of belly dancing.

title: Una moglie americana
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Rhonda Fleming, Graziella Granata
description: Unhappy with his job at a Magenta shoe factory, Riccardo hopes for the classic "rush of life". The opportunity presents itself to him when the boss sends him to the United States for work. Once in America he decides to settle there, but in order to do so he has to find a woman willing to marry him to get him to take American citizenship. However, the enterprise turns out to be more difficult than expected despite the fact that the myth of the Latin lover still enjoys good fame. Much of the story unfolds showing Riccardo's clumsy attempts to approach the most diverse women, from the Brooklyn negro to the sophisticated uptown lady. A little repetitive.

title: True Confession
actors: Carole Lombard, Fred MacMurray, John Barrymore
description: A young couple: he is a lawyer without a client, she is a pathological liar. The girl, with the intent of procuring clients for her husband's office, accuses herself of a crime and is thus brilliantly defended by her husband, who acquires fame and money. It is the film that is somewhat considered as the archetype of the crazy comedy: the one that opens the way to the figure of the crazy (but nice) wife, typical of the genre. At the time Graham Greene called it "the best comedy of the year"; probably because of the freshness of the situations and dialogues. There is no lack of moralizing elements: but they do not spoil.

title: In Love With an Older Woman
actors: John Ritter, Karen Carlson, Jamie Rosie, Jeff Altman, Clark Brandon
description: Robert Christenberry is a young lawyer who, one day, falls in love with the new employee who arrived in his office and plans to go live with her. The only problem is that the woman is fifteen years older and she has a daughter who is more or less the same age as the young man. It is a pleasant TV movie built on John Ritter's sympathy qualities (and everyone laughed).

title: Mi mujer me gusta más
actors: Walter Chiari, Yvonne Bastien, Akim Tamiroff, Fred Clark, Marisa De Leza
description: Giulio's escapades end up when his wife shows up with a fake husband in the villa of his main one. Adulterine comedian fairly trail.

title: Moglie e buoi...
actors: Gino Cervi, Walter Chiari, Nino Taranto, Enrico Viarisio, Sandra Milo
description: The Italian John Cattabriga, who made his fortune in America, returns with his son Frank to his hometown, with the intention of finding him a wife. A ball is organized to which the girls of the district flock attracted by such a good match, but Cattabriga junior falls in love with a girl who lives with her fascist uncle, John's sworn enemy, who has always been a socialist.
notes: Solid cast led by Gino Cervi (always a bit Peppone ...) and Walter Chiari and completed by the presence of an exuberant Sandra Milo just of age. The script also works, too bad the direction doesn't have rhythm.

title: La moglie giapponese
actors: Gastone Moschin, Paul Esser, Michiko Iwasaki
description: The accountant Taddei, called to replace his colleague Ferrante who fell ill suddenly, is forced to undertake a business trip to the Far East. Retracing the route that Ferrante used to follow, Taddei passes from Tokyo to Hong Kong, from Saigon to Calcutta. The journey gradually turns into a nightmare: thrown into a world different from his own, the accountant comes into contact with a depressing reality that will make him reflect on the meaning of his life.
notes: Polidoro stages a painful attempt to combine the speck of Italian abroad with easy social morality.

title: La moglie in bianco... l'amante al pepe
actors: Lino Banfi, Pamela Prati, Marisa Porcel, Susan Scott, Mario Carotenuto, Vittorio Caprioli
description: Gianluca, son of the dentist baron Patané, exhibits unmanly attitudes. The old grandfather, shortly before dying, places as a condition for the collection of the inheritance that Gianluca marries and, above all, that he has a child in a very short time. After a series of mouthful ups and downs, Gianluca marries a former stripper and becomes a father.
notes: Discounted canvas, all on the shoulders of Banfi and in the forms of Pamela Prati, for an Italian-Spanish production that will not remain in the annals.

title: La moglie in vacanza... l'amante in città
actors: Edwige Fenech, Lino Banfi, Renzo Montagnani, Barbara Bouchet
description: An industrialist from Parma has a relationship with the beautiful Giulia, who would like to have him all to herself. Wanting to avoid the costs of divorce, the industrialist favors his wife's relationship with a self-styled count. The four are found by chance in Courmayeur, where the knots finally come to a head.
notes: One of the many erotic comedies performed by the trio Banfi / Montagnani / Fenech, flanked in this case by Barbara Bouchet. But the trend is at an end: shortly thereafter we will find them, cleaned and dressed, on television.

title: La moglie più bella
actors: Ornella Muti, Alessio Orano, Tano Cimarosa, Joe Sentieri
description: Francesca Cimarosa is the beautiful sixteen year old daughter of a poor farmer. Vito, a small Mafia boss, falls in love with her, and in the face of her refusal, he does not hesitate to kidnap and rape her. The girl, however, takes revenge.
notes: The only thrill of this film, vaguely inspired by the story of Franca Viola a few years earlier, is the presence of a minor Ornella Muti and her then boyfriend, Alessio Orano. If that's enough, take a seat.

title: The More the Merrier
actors: Jean Arthur, Joel McCrea, Charles Coburn, Richard Gaines
description: It is not easy to find a home in Washington during the war. A girl (Arthur), who lives in an apartment of four, rents two rooms to a wealthy middle-aged gentleman (Coburn) who in turn sublet one to an aviation sergeant (McCrea). With the complicity of the mature tenant, the two young people end up falling in love.
notes: Here the real star is Charles Coburn who, in fact, for this film won the Oscar as a supporting actor. In the script, lightly light, but hilarious and without a moment's respite, we glimpse the hand (uncredited) of Garson Kanin.

title: Molti sogni per le strade
actors: Anna Magnani, Massimo Girotti, Checco Durante, Dante Maggio, Luigi Pavese
description: To solve his financial situation, Paolo steals his boss's car. Then he repents and is about to give it up, but discovers that he has already been reported to the police. It was his wife who did it, albeit for a good purpose, for fear that Paul would commit other nonsense. Of course it all ends well.
notes: The film seen today even has some neorealist echoes, but the tone is still a graceful populist comedy, with an energetic Magnani.

title: H. M. Pulham Esquire
actors: Robert Young, Hedy Lamarr, Charles Coburn, Ruth Hussey
description: Back from the war Harry Pulham finds a job in an advertising agency. There he meets Marvin and falls in love with her. But the sudden death of his father forces him to return to his hometown where he sees and marries Kay, a childhood friend. Today Mr. Pulham is an established and honorable business executive and if he thinks back on these things it is only because a former college friend of his called him. And after him also Marvin, but it is no longer possible to go back. At first glance it's not as overwhelming as other Vidor films, but the thrills of desire that upset this methodical and up-and-coming Mr. Pulham are indeed touching.

title: Chariots of Fire
actors: Ben Cross, Ian Charleson, Nicholas Farrell, Lindsay Anderson, Ian Holm
description: Two athletes, in the early 1920s, are preparing for the Paris Olympics. The first, Harold Abrahams, is Jewish and studies at Cambridge. The other, Eric Liddell, is the son of a missionary and comes from Oxford. For both, the highlight is that of the hundred meters but Liddell refuses to run the preliminary heats on Sunday, the day dedicated to the Lord, and gives Abrahams the green light. On the other hand, out of the 400, he will give England the second gold medal.
notes: It's all a bit unnecessarily rhetorical and Vangelis' pompous music helps to complete the impression. But the dramatic structure holds. In addition to Vangelis, the film received Oscars for Best Picture, Screenplay, Costume Design.

title: Il momento di uccidere
actors: George Hilton, Walter Barnes, Loni von Friedl, Renato Romano
description: Two gunslingers, Lord and Bull, are tasked with finding 500,000 dollars in gold belonging to the Southern Confederation, hidden by a colonel who died defending them from the Northerners. Lord and Bull have the mighty Forrester family and the band of outlaws they hired against them.
notes: The period of the "Italian western" saw the birth of important works (not many) and fourth-rate films (most of them). Including this debut by Anthony Ascott (born Giuliano Carnimeo).

title: Il monaco di Monza
actors: Totò, Nino Taranto, Lisa Gastoni, Erminio Macario, Mario Castellani
description: In a small village, in the 17th century, Pasquale the cobbler (Totò), is unemployed and homeless, he can no longer feed his twelve children. Disguised as a friar, he finds lodging in a castle, which however is governed by a perfidious marquis who keeps his sister-in-law segregated. The attempts made by Pasquale to free her cause numerous accidents. As always, Totò's cinema starts from the parody, even if in this case the Manzonian story foreshadowed in the title has nothing to do with it. On the other hand, the whole Boccaccio côté that the "friar" Totò provokes by chasing the beautiful Fiorenza becomes fun. Celentano and Don Backy are two (fake) friars who begging to rock time.

title: Il mondo dei miracoli
actors: Jacques Sernas, Virna Lisi, Vittorio De Sica, Amedeo Nazzari
description: Marco, a young theater actor, leaves his girlfriend Laura and leaves for Rome to attempt a film career. He meets Sara who falls in love with him and offers him a film next to an American diva (she too falls in love with him). Shortly after, Laura also arrives in Rome who is still attracted to Marco. Among the three women he will choose ...
notes: The real miracle is that good actors got involved in this film. On the other hand, Capuano was the author of films like this, which were all about sentimentality.

title: Westworld
actors: Yul Brynner, Richard Benjamin, James Brolin, Victoria Shaw
description: We are in Delos, a vacation spot for the earthlings of the near future. Divided by historical epochs and populated by suitably clad robots, it allows tourists to "live" adventures of all kinds without danger. But for Peter and John something goes wrong: the robots start to rebel and the plunge into the Old West turns into a tragic nightmare, from which it seems impossible to find a way out.
notes: Crichton is a novelist and director who awakens the most disturbing hallucinations linked to scientific progress (see "Jurassic Park"). Here he creates a western fantasy full of suspense and gimmicks, with a hypnotic Brinner.

title: The World of Suzie Wong
actors: William Holden, Nancy Kwan, Sylvia Syms, Michael Wilding
description: Robert Loma, an American painter who landed in Hong Kong in search of inspiration, falls in love with Suzie Wong. The fact that she is a prostitute and that she has a son does not seem to pose a problem for Robert, who naturally sets out to redeem her. She refuses and disappears. He loses his head and starts looking desperately for her. He finds her again and manages to convince her to leave with him for America. The film is based on a Richard Mason novel and Paul Osborn's subsequent play, but that doesn't help. The success of the film, however, served to launch the young Kwan as an international star. Even if his career didn't last long.

title: Il mondo di Yor
actors: Red Brown, Corinne Cléry, Alan Collins, John Steiner
description: It seems to be in the stone age, instead it is the one following a terrifying atomic catastrophe. In this context, Yor, a herculean protagonist with blond hair, fights against assorted enemies for the victory of Good against the Evil that rages. He will make it, along with his woman Ka-laa. Let us not be misled by appearances: behind the Anglophile pseudonym hides the very Italian Antonio Margheriti, who tells, in a film based on an Argentine comic and shot in economy, a naive story for a very "green" public (aged or tastes). And everything, from the dialogues to the costumes to the rest, is in tune.

title: Woman's World
actors: Clifton Webb, Lauren Bacall, Van Heflin, June Allison, Fred MacMurray
description: After the death of the general manager of Gifford Motors, the president of the large automobile factory summons the three most highly rated agency directors to New York. These are invited to bring their respective spouses with them: in fact it will be through the concept that the boss will become ladies (if they are a spur or an obstacle to the husbands' career) that the delicate choice of the successor will take place.
notes: A cast of all stars (and all committed to the right point) for a brilliant but not at all trivial story. A comedy in the wake of the best of the Hollywood tradition, capable of dealing with serious topics with elegant and captivating ease.

title: Il mondo le condanna
actors: Alida Valli, Amedeo Nazzari, Serge Reggiani, Franco Interlenghi
description: Renata is from Florence and works as a prostitute in Paris. After a raid by the French police she is repatriated with the obligatory travel document. Taken by despair, she tries to throw herself off the train, but, at the last moment, is held back by the industrialist Martelli. With the support of his wife, Renata finds work as a model in a large atelier. Destiny wants his past to return: his former protector, André, in fact, tries to exploit the situation with blackmail. To defend the girl there is Franco.
notes: Alida Valli is splendid as always, it is a pity that the film is in the balance between photo novel and poetic realism.

title: World in his Arms
actors: Gregory Peck, Ann Blyth, Anthony Quinn
description: In 1850, Captain Jonathan Clark fell in love with the Russian Duchess Marina. The noblewoman, however, has numerous suitors including Prince Simeon, to whom his uncle has promised the hand of the young woman. And who is the uncle to be able to make such a promise? None other than the Tsar himself! Will Jonathan and Marina therefore have to give up their love? It is not certain, if the usual palace conspiracy sees Simeone in the front row ...
notes: Raoul Walsh shows off his craft to tell a "sentimental" adventure story. Technicolor triumphs in pure Hollywood style. Also known as "The Bostonian".

title: La nuit de Varennes
actors: Michel Piccoli, Jean-Louis Barrault, Marcello Mastroianni, Hanna Schygulla
description: It is June 21, 1791 and a group of nobles find themselves traveling in diligence the stretch of road between Paris and Verdun where, just a few hours earlier, Louis XVI and Marie Antoinette were captured by the Jacobins. The stagecoach is in fact stopped in Varennes, where the royal family is kept under arrest. None of the passengers understand that they are witnessing a fact that marks the end of an era. Two years later some wanderers show the images of that day with a "world niovo", that is one of the many ancestors of the cinema.
notes: Scola talks about the French Revolution alluding to the Europe of the Eighties, but does not disdain to play with masks and historical (fanta) crosses: Tom Paine and Restif de La Bretonne, the king and queen and Casanova. Prologue and epilogue with Jannacci storyteller.

title: The Lost World
actors: Claude Rains, Michael Rennie, Jill St. John, David Hedison, Fernando Lamas
description: An expedition led by Professor George Edward Challenger travels to the Amazon to recover prehistoric fossils. Soon, however, the scientists and adventurers that compose it find themselves dealing with a very different discovery: a remote plateau populated by terrifying Jurassic monsters ...
notes: The novel _The Lost World_, written in 1912 by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle (the inventor of Sherlock Holmes, so to speak) and the first of a series dedicated to the character of Professor Challenger, has given rise to a considerable number of film and television versions. Unfortunately, this one by Allen certainly does not figure among the best.

title: The World According Garp
actors: Robin Williams, Mary Beth Hurt, Glenn Close, John Lithgow
description: Amid many reveries and pursuing the dream of becoming an established writer, young Garp gazes at the world around him. The boy is convinced that he can shape the world in his image and likeness, but, having reached adulthood, he is forced to come to terms with reality. On the path to finding himself there is also a bulky and unorthodox mother. One of his sons dies and literary success is also slow in coming.
notes: Kaleidoscopic film based on a novel by John Irving (who appears as a wrestling referee), starring newcomer Glenn Close.

title: The Kid
actors: Charles Chaplin, Jackie Coogan, Edna Purviance, Baby Hathaway, Lita Grey
description: A woman wants to become a great actress and abandons her newborn baby, so that he doesn't get in the way. The tramp Charlot picks it up and raises it. A few years later, the little man is like a father to the little one, but there are those who want to separate them.
notes: Melodrama, comedy, comedy and tenderness come together in this extraordinary work, in which Chaplin and little Jackie Coogan (later Uncle Fester in the Addams show) compete to steal the sympathy of the viewer. The film includes anthology sequences, such as that of the "heavenly" dream or the one in which the little man saves the brat "kidnapped" by the men of the orphanage.

title: Il monello della strada
actors: Erminio Macario, Luisa Rossi, Giulio Stival, Saro Urzì
description: The emigrant Carletto Po (Erminio Macario) gets married by proxy, from Argentina, to an Italian. After a few years he returns to his homeland and does not find his wife, who has died in the meantime, but her son, Paolo, who is also her son by law. Carletto is not enthusiastic and tries to get rid of the boy, but a woman (who looks extraordinarily like Anna) intervenes to make him change his mind. Weak film, even in its fantastic ending. The comparison with Chaplin's "Brat" is unthinkable.

title: The Brasher Doubloon
actors: George Montgomery, Nancy Guild, Conrad Janis
description: A private investigator is tasked with investigating the disappearance of a doubloon owned by a very well-to-do widow. During the investigation several people who had had to do in various ways with the precious coin are killed. The detective's suspicions focus on the widow's son and the woman's secretary.
notes: Faint adaptation from Raymond Chandler's "Window to the void" by Brahm, author of some masterpieces of film noir ("The boarder" of 1944 and "The monster of the mists", 1954). Montgomery is too dapper a Marlowe.

title: I mongoli
actors: Jack Palance, Anita Ekberg, Antonella Lualdi, Franco Silva, Roldano Lupi
description: Son of the Great Khan, Ogotai is at odds with his father over the peace proposal that comes from the European sovereigns. Stephen of Krakow leads the difficult negotiations, but when he arrives at the Ogotai camp he barely escapes an attack to which the perfidious Huluna, wife of the prince, is no stranger. Stefano then tries to reach the camp of Genghis Khan, more prone to peace, but Ogotai has his father killed and takes his place. It is war. De Toth seems to have directed almost nothing in this boring blockbuster shot in Italy. The battles, the essential part of the film, were shot by Riccardo Freda, other parts of the film by Leopoldo Savona.

title: Monkey Business
actors: Cary Grant, Ginger Rogers, Marilyn Monroe
description: While in a scientific laboratory they are trying to develop an elixir of life, the solution is found by a monkey who adds, at random, just the missing element. Except that the potion is poured into the water dispenser and everyone who drinks it benefits. The first is Dr. Barnabas Fulton, who, together with his wife, regresses to an infantile stage. Good things happen.
notes: Hawks makes fun of everything from science to love, and manages to lead the game with rhythm and find hilarious. The film starts early on the tangent of the surreal, with a healthy streak of wickedness. The craziest and most extreme of Hawks' comedies.

title: Monkey Shines
actors: Jason Beghe, John Pankow, Kate McNeil, Joyce Van Patten
description: Allan, athletic and sporty, is paralyzed following an accident. A friend of his has the idea of ??putting a monkey next to him undergoing genetic experiments and then trained by a specialist, Melanie Parker. The monkey becomes Allan's inseparable companion, but his morbid attachment results in a form of jealousy ... murderous.
notes: The horror dose is strong. But in reality "Monkey Shines" is a melodrama: the story of love and blood between a man and a little monkey. A passion literally lived in the flames. The original ending designed by the director (with hundreds of monkeys ready to invade the world) has been cut from the production.

title: Monolith
actors: Bill Paxton, Lindsay Frost, John Hurt, Louis Gossett jr.
description: Tucker and Flinn, two Los Angeles police officers, accidentally discover that Villano, head of a seemingly harmless Department of Historical Research, has spotted a shapeless alien force and secretly attempts to exploit it. The operation, however, gets out of hand to the sorcerer's apprentice. Successful product in terms of story and visual effects, but poorly served by the dialogues. The star couple, played by Bill Paxton ("Tombstone") and his energetic partner Lindsay Frost, are close-knit.

title: Traffic
actors: Jacques Tati, Marcel Fraval, Honoré Rostel, Maria Kimberly
description: With the executives of a car company, Hulot leaves for the Amsterdam show, driving a prototype he designed. Numerous setbacks, and the exhibition is reached when it has already closed. Tati in a refined satire of the myth of the four wheels. Some slowness is amply rewarded by many brilliant ideas.

title: Monsieur Verdoux
actors: Charles Chaplin, Martha Raye, Isobel Elson, Marilyn Nash, Irving Bacon
description: Fired from the bank he worked for, in order to support his wife and child, Monsieur Verdoux invents a new occupation: he seduces wealthy women, robs them and kills them. With the last victim designated, however, not everything goes smoothly and the doors of the "santé" open wide on the little bluebeard out of necessity.
notes: Leaving behind the tragicomic mélange of the little man with a cane, Chaplin here focuses on the dramatic creating one of his best works. The criticism of bourgeois society was clear in the final speech that caused a scandal. The film was originally intended to be made by Orson Welles, who appears in the opening credits as a "script writer".

title: La montagna di luce
actors: Richard Harrison, Luciana Gilli, Wilbert Bradly, Daniele Vargas
description: The rajah of Punjab, determined to get hold of the fabulous diamond called "the mountain of light" that shines on the forehead of a statue, instructs the adventurer Allan Foster to carry out the theft. Together with Sitama, Allan succeeds thanks to an ingenious plan to take possession of the precious stone. However, he does not intend to share the spoils with others and seeks refuge in the English protectorate.
notes: Italian product endowed with naive spectacular appeal. Based on the novel of the same name by Emilio Salgari.

title: Mountains of the Moon
actors: Patrick Bergin, Iain Glen, Richard E. Grant, Fiona Shaw
description: It is 1854. An English aristocrat with a desire for adventure and a professional explorer set out on a journey to discover the sources of the Nile. After many misadventures, the two reach Lake Victoria. Then other interests come into play and friendship turns into rivalry.
notes: It is not a trivial adventure film and it is not just a collage of suggestive landscapes. Rafelson in the 1970s had already said something about the search for utopia. But it is also a very conventional film. One of those films for which we say: "good actors, beautiful photography".

title: Kissin' Cousins
actors: Elvis Presley, Glenda Farrell, Arthur O'Connell, Jack Albertson
description: The United States Air Force has decided to build a base on top of Big Smokey, a mountain located in the state of Tennessee. Every time that the emissaries of the army go to the place to negotiate the purchase, they are welcomed by the owners. The armed forces, exasperated, send Lieutenant Josh Morgan, a native of the place, to the scene, following a very particular tactic.
notes: The plot is rather thin, Elvis sings. The film shot in two weeks was a great success with the public.

title: Montecassino
actors: Alberto Carlo Lolli, Ubaldo Lay
description: Re-enactment, based on the testimony of the survivors, of the destruction of the famous Abbey of San Benedetto during the Second World War, bombed by the allies because it was considered a strategic place for the Germans. The victims were many, also because many civilians had sought refuge in the abbey, considered a neutral and inviolable area. The narration alternates the documentary cut to the dramatized reconstruction and ends with the beginning of the reconstruction work. Accurately made, the film knows how to avoid rhetoric without denying itself a heartfelt appeal for peace.

title: Moonlighting
actors: Jeremy Irons, Eugene Lipinski, Jiri Stanislav, Eugeniusz Haczkiewicz
description: In December 1981, four Polish workers are sent to London to renovate an apartment bought by a Warsaw bureaucrat. They work hard, never leaving the apartment. Only Novak goes out every now and then and thus learns about the coup made by Jaruszelskj. He decides not to let his comrades know anything, to avoid their disturbances from jeopardizing the work. Only when he returns will he inform them and put up with their insults. It is the best film by Skolimovski, a Polish exile in the West for some time: it talks about politics but in a surreal way, and is played by an excellent Jeremy Irons (that of Inseparables).

title: Moonraker
actors: Roger Moore, Lois Chiles, Michael Lonsdale, Richard Kiel
description: A "space shuttle" is "kidnapped" by a mysterious organization headed by Hugo Drax, also owner of the company that builds the space shuttles. To solve the riddle, James Bond is sent on a mission, who finds himself having to collaborate with a CIA spy, obviously beautiful and fascinating. 007's investigations even lead him to fly into space.
notes: A minor 007, almost echoed from the previous "The spy who loved me". It was a success and, first among Western films, it also made a huge splash in Asia. But the story is stale. In an era of special effects, producers turn Bond into a kind of Flash Gordon. Certainly the first part, less glittering than the journey into the cosmos, reserves funny moments.

title: Moonwalker
actors: Michael Jackson, Joe Pesci, Sean Lennon, brandon quintin adams, kellie parker
description: Sean, Katie and Michael are three of Michael Jackson's millions of "fans". For them, the singer-dancer-actor fights against the perfidious Mister Big who wants to spread drugs among the very young, and defeats him. The film is a kaleidoscopic "monument" to Michael Jackson (on the subject of the same), built with a lot of special effects and with equal boldness and based on the songs from the album "Bad".

title: Entre las redas
actors: Lang Jeffries, Sabine Sun, Silvia Solar, Luciana Gilli, Lee Burton
description: The secret agent Coplan is on the trail of a criminal organization that, under the pretext of selling auteur paintings stolen by the Nazis in wartime, is trying to replace the American president with a double affiliated with them.
notes: Directed by Riccardo Freda on a screenplay by Bertrand Tavernier.

title: Desperate
actors: Raymond Burr, Steve Brodie, Audrey Long
description: Steve is a truck driver who gets involved in a robbery that ends up killing a policeman. One of the bandits is captured and sentenced to death; he is the brother of the gang leader. The latter decides to take revenge on Steve and to kill him the same night in which the sentence will be carried out. Our hero, after rescuing the family, confronts the criminal. Mann considers this film his "real" directorial debut. In the part of the gangster is Raymond Burr. A real treat for fans.

title: Morirai a mezzanotte
actors: Valeria D'Obici, Leonardo Treviglio, Lara Wendel, Lea Martino
description: A psychopath is terrorizing the city with a long series of murders. The first of the victims, all women, is the wife of a police officer who is therefore suspected of being guilty. Sara, a criminologist who is investigating the case of a sex maniac who died years ago, is not of that opinion. Although Sara is convinced that the man is still alive. Lamberto Bava followed in the footsteps of his father Mario in the thriller genre. But here the highlights are few, and the actors are not up to par.

title: Fatal Love
actors: Molly Ringwald, Lee Grant, Martin Landau, Roxana Zal
description: The charming young Allison Gertz, heterosexual, white and from a good family, after a long period of hospitalization and after exhausting analyzes, discovers that she has contracted AIDS, despite having had only one risky experience. Her relationships with family and boyfriend are upset, but over time Allison regains awareness of her own situation.
notes: Well-acted television film by an excellent cast.

title: Morire gratis
actors: Franco Angeli, Mario Pisu, Isabel Ruth
description: A painter leaves Rome for Paris with a statue full of drugs. The film is unreleased for Italy despite having won the Max Ophüls award in France and was screened at the Pesaro, Hyères and San Francisco festivals.
notes: Document of a troubled and restless generation, the film is unreleased for Italy despite having won the Max Ophüls award in France and was screened at the Pesaro, Hyères and San Francisco festivals. Despite having a lot of the undergroound air of the periosal, it has aged quite well.

title: Morituri
actors: Marlon Brando, Yul Brynner, Trevor Howard, Janet Margolin
description: In July 1942, the Axis forces appear to be heading towards a brilliant victory. The British secret services persuade the young Robert, who fled from Germany because he was anti-Nazi, to embark - pretending to be an SS officer - on a German merchant ship carrying weapons. Robert begins to build a certain consensus, including that of the captain who is however ousted by a mutiny led by extremist officers ...
notes: The cast is high-sounding, first and foremost the Brando-Brynner duo. But if the first part is smooth and well written, the second unfortunately tends to trivialize, and the overall outcome suffers. Too bad also for the direction of Wicki, who cleverly exploits the setting of the ship.

title: Mortacci
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Malcolm McDowell, Sergio Rubini, Carol Alt
description: Some deceased find themselves in a suspended life, in a sort of purgatory-parking lot, and then each one tells his or her own story.
