There are the recent dead and those of a few centuries ago, there are poetins and madmen, swindlers and powerful, actors and beautiful women, each with so many things to say.
notes: Oddity between the macabre, the poetic and the humorous signed by a director outside the box, a true borgataro, Pasolini's spiritual son. Cast from delirium, clear philosophical rhythm.

title: Morte a Venezia
actors: Dirk Bogarde, Silvana Mangano, Björn Andresen, Romolo Valli, Marisa Berenson, Carole André
description: The musician Gustav von Aschenbach, close to old age, takes up residence in the luxurious "Hotel des bains" on the Lido of Venice. Indifferent to everything, he is struck by the beauty of a teenager, Tadzio, a guest with his family in the same hotel. After a failed escape attempt, he can't help but stalk him. Venice is in the throes of a cholera epidemic and Gustav falls ill. Visconti re-reading by Thomas Mann; Proustian period re-enactment with roots in the director's own childhood memories and sumptuous melodrama supported by Mahler's music.

title: The Caller
actors: Madolyn Smith Osborne, Malcolm McDowell
description: A young widow who lives alone in a house in the middle of the woods receives a visit from a stranger who has been the victim of a serious car accident. A subtle psychological game develops between the two which, over time, becomes more and more dangerous for the woman, subjected by the visitor to a merciless interrogation about her past life. In the end, the man turns out to be an android with tasks that are anything but reassuring.
notes: Thriller shot in Italy based on the good performance of McDowell and Madolyn Smith-Osborne. Naturally Pavese has nothing to do with it.

title: The Night of the Hunter
actors: Robert Mitchum, Shelley Winters, Lillian Gish
description: Henry Powell, a preacher too interested in wealthy ladies, gets married by the young widow of a murderer who has hidden the spoils within the walls of his house. The woman, however, knows nothing about money. It is her two children who keep the secret. Killed their mother, Powell chases them along the river to which the two children have trusted and which will lead them to find an unexpected ally.
notes: Actor Charles Laughton's only directorial performance. Cult film par excellence. The Good, the Evil, the horror, the dream, the childhood, the death, in a Southern fairy tale that represents an absolute unicum, outside the genres, in the history of American cinema. Mitchum and Lilian Gish are two extraordinary biblical presences. Magical photograph by Stanley Cortez.

title: Death of a Salesman
actors: Dustin Hoffman, Kate Reid, Stephen Lang, John Malkovich, Charles Durning
description: After a life of sacrifice Willy Loman, a traveling salesman, is fired on the spot. By now he is too old to start over and the only solution seems to be to commit suicide thus offering the family the amount of his life insurance. The original text is the famous one by Arthur Miller. This television version (the second after Benedek's in '51) is based on the theatrical staging staged on Broadway by Dustin Hoffman himself. Schlondorff's direction is predictably flawless, but what's most exciting are the actors. Special mention for John Malkovich, Charles Durning and Jon Polito.

title: Morte di un matematico napoletano
actors: Carlo Cecchi, Anna Bonaiuto, Renato Carpentieri, Antonio Neiwiller, Toni Servillo
description: The last eight days of the life of Renato Caccioppoli, illustrious and eccentric mathematician, who committed suicide on 8 May 1959. Before the fatal gesture, the protagonist is found in a station like any other vagabond. Brought home, there are those who try in vain to save him from his bitterness and his total existential and political disappointment. At his funeral, discomfort hides behind the rhetoric.
notes: Beautiful film debut by the theater director Martone: a raid in the alleys of a sick Naples (the dominant color is yellowish) but still paradoxically proud of its nobility. Splendid Carlo Cecchi. Jury Prize in Venice.

title: Mort d'un pourri
actors: Alain Delon, Ornella Muti, Stéphane Audran, Mireille Darc, Maurice Ronet
description: Xavier is an honest man, despite his ties to Deputy Dubaye, a corrupt politician with an even more ambiguous clientele. Out of friendship, he is preparing to provide the Honorable Member with an alibi so as not to accuse him of the murder of a colleague. The motive for the crime is the theft of a notebook in which the astute and also corrupt Serrano, the victim, noted all the high-level offenses in which he was involved.
notes: Modest French thriller with claims of political denunciation.

title: La mort en direct
actors: Romy Schneider, Harvey Keitel, Harry Dean Stanton, Max Von Sydow, William Russell, Vadim Glowna, Bernhard Wicki, Eva Maria Meineke, Thérèse Liotard
description: Katherine is diagnosed with late stage cancer; a television producer offers her a contract to exclusively film her death. She first accepts, but then runs away. Tavernier's philosophical science fiction; it is actually a meditation on audiovisual civilization and sensational information. An alarmed warning, but also a drama of great lyrical strength.

title: Bitter Harvest
actors: Ron Howard, Art Carney, Richard Dysart, Tara Nutter
description: Farm animals mysteriously die. The owner, whose daughter is also ill, discovers that the cause is chemical contamination. Tight direction and good cast, for an exciting TV film based on a news story.

title: Mr. Wong Detective
actors: Boris Karloff, Grant Withers
description: Investigator Wong investigates a series of murders in a chemical industry. First and best film in the short series about Mr. Wong, starring Karloff.

title: Black Death
actors: Kate Jackson, Al Waxman, Jerry Orbach
description: A girl is admitted to a New York hospital with a lung infection. At his death, however, the verdict of the autopsy is rather disturbing: the girl died of the plague. The mayor of the city does not want to publicize the case, because he fears that panic could spread. Dr. Nora Hart finds herself alone fighting the epidemic. American television films have now examined all the most exotic, rare and unimaginable diseases. In this case, however, we are dealing with a classic, one could say, Manzoni. The intrepid doctor is played by Kate Jackson who has been one of Charlie's Angels for years.

title: A Judgment in Stone
actors: Rita Tushingham, Jackie Burroughs, Jonathan Crombie
description: An illiterate and psychotic spinster housekeeper gets hired into the home of wealthy Coverdales with tragic results. Based on a novel by Ruth Rendell, which will also inspire "The darkness in the mind" by Chabrol, it is a rather ordinary thriller in which you are pleased to see an icon of free cinema.

title: La morte risale a ieri sera
actors: Raf Vallone, Frank Wolff, Gigi Rizzi, Beryl Cunningham
description: Donatella is a young and beautiful girl, but mentally handicapped. Precisely because of her attractiveness she is kidnapped and sent into prostitution. The father then turns to a good commissioner, but the kidnappers, feeling hunted, kill the girl. The cops still manage to find the culprits, but Donatella's father has already done justice. Based on a thriller by Giorgio Scerbanenco, the film is set in a Milan of drifters and, although it favors the melodramatic aspect, it has a modern and lively edge. The actors are confidently directed.

title: Countess Dracula
actors: Ingrid Pitt, Nigel Green, Maurice Denham, Peter Jeffrey, Lesley-Anne Down
description: Countess Nagy refuses to grow old and renews a terrible spell each time: she kills a virgin and then bathes in her blood, thus transforming herself for some time into a beautiful girl. In this capacity she manages to seduce a young officer who believes her to be his daughter Ilona, ??not knowing that the countess is holding Ilona prisoner so that her rites are not discovered. It will be the daughter, who managed to free herself, to stop the horrendous crimes of the countess. One of Hammer's latest films, with many erotic sequences based on Ingrid Pitt's charm. The subject is inspired by the story of Countess Erzbeth von Bathory.

title: The Verdict
actors: Sidney Greenstreet, Peter Lorre, Joan Lorring, George Coulouris, Rosalind Ivan, Paul Cavanagh, Arthur Shields, Morton Lowry, Holmes Herbert
description: Inspector Borgman, now retired, is unable to rest his heart for a mistake made in the past. Siegel's ingenious debut feature, with already excellent suspense control and a certain amount of humor. Greenstreet and Lorre are two familiar faces of Casablanca.

title: I morti non pagano tasse
actors: Tino Scotti, Titina De Filippo, Carlo Campanini
description: The accountant Marco Vecchietti, a modest civil servant, is in trouble. They are about to evict him and he, in applying for a new home, discovers that he has died for the registry office, for seven years already. His new condition as a dead man certainly has positive sides, but new troubles seem to be approaching. Tino Scotti will be remembered more for Falqui advertising than for films like this one.

title: Un papillon sur l'épaule
actors: Lino Ventura, Claudine Auger, Paul Crauchet, Jean Bouise
description: Roland (Lino Ventura), a French seafarer stopped for a few days in Barcelona, ??is involved in an inexplicable case at the center of which is a mysterious briefcase. The story unfolds without an apparent logic, strewn with corpses. The protagonist finds himself living a distressing nightmare, with no elements to be able to grasp, without holds to get out of the condition of predestined victim.
notes: A story between Kafka and Borges, whose "illogic" would like to reflect the illogic of existence itself, where each individual is just an insignificant little wheel of a mechanism that crushes him inexorably. Unusual, intelligent and intriguing.

title: Moscow on the Hudson
actors: Robin Williams, Maria Conchita Alonso, Cleavant Derricks
description: Young Vladimir lives in Moscow where he works as a saxophonist in a circus. He lives in an apartment crammed with other members of his family, queues all day, is stopped by the KGB. Thanks to a tour in the USA, Vladimir defected. He will soon realize that American life may be even worse than the one he left behind in Russia. The film is intended to be a hymn to Western freedom compared to the oppressive climate of Eastern countries. In reality, between melodrama and small squares of life, Mazursky ends up presenting us with two mirror-like faces of the same coin, but ends up drowning in a sea of ??banality.

title: Moskva slezam nye verit
actors: Vera Alentova, Irina Nuraveva, Raisa Rjazanova
description: Tonia, Katia, Ludmilla: three women, at the end of the fifties, try to settle in Moscow. While Tonia marries a quiet and simple man, the other two are animated by very different ambitions ... Twenty years later, only Tonia will be able to say that she has obtained the life she had wanted for herself. Events not of three heroines of the people but of three simple women, grappling with everyday problems. Fake critical realism and curious example of a Soviet film that won the Oscar for best foreign film.

title: I moschettieri del mare
actors: Anna Maria Pierangeli, Robert Alda, Aldo Ray, Channing Pollock
description: A stampede from France leads the three friends Pierre, Moreau and Gosselin to join the filibusta. The ship they are on board, however, is shipwrecked, but the three friends manage to get on a galleon and, having captured the crew, set sail for Maracaibo. The Brothers of the Coast await them there. Although served by a banal story, Steno manages to build a funny story, mixing the comic genre with the picaresque one, also aided by the skill of the actors.

title: Moses und Aron
actors: Günther Reich, Louis Devos, Werner Mann, Eva Csapo
description: Charged by God to free his people, Moses chooses Aaron as an intermediary: he is old and above all he struggles to communicate with the people. Aronne speaks a different language, which proceeds in images, less rigorous but more captivating. The dialogue between Aaron and the Israelites goes hand in hand with the confrontation between the two men, amidst misunderstandings, flattery and riots.
notes: Straub and Huillet take up the score composed by Schönberg and make a film of rare intensity, in which the philosophical confrontation between the two protagonists is reflected in the dialectic between images, music and dialogue.

title: The Mosquito Coast
actors: Harrison Ford, Helen Mirren, River Phoenix, Martha Plimpton, Conrad Roberts, Andre Gregory, Dick O'Neill, Jadrien Steele, Michael Rogers, Hilary Gordon, Rebecca Gordon, Jason Alexander, Alice Heffernan-Sneed, Tiger Haynes, William Newman
description: Allie Fox (Ford) is a skilled worker who decides to leave the United States, whose degradation he can no longer bear. He moves with his family to the Costa delle Zanzare, Guatemala, to an abandoned village. He then throws himself into the enterprise of building an enormous and useless ice machine, which he must then destroy to kill three terrorists, but causing serious pollution. Weir's film is the reconstruction of a dream of escape that turns into utopia, to the point of degenerating under the weight of its greatness. Allie Fox is an ambiguous, at times hateful character: one of the most difficult roles in Harrison Ford's career, who gets along with honor. Weir does not deny his pessimism about the impossibility of the cultural encounter between the modern and the ancient.

title: La diagonale du fou
actors: Michel Piccoli, Alexandre Arbatt, Leslie Caron, Liv Ullmann
description: Challenge between two Russian chess geniuses, the old sick champion and the challenger, a young escaped man, who is also a mortal clash of opposing ideologies and worlds. Really exciting, with a great Michel Piccoli. 1984 Oscar for best foreign film.

title: I mostri
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Ugo Tognazzi, Michèle Mercier, Lando Buzzanca, Daniele Vargas
description: Sometimes there is a little story, sometimes a simple flash is enough to describe the new selfishness of Italians in a society that has left behind the miseries of the post-war period and knows well-being. The unemployed man who lives in the shacks of the Roman suburbs seems tormented by doubts, but then at the stadium he screams like crazy. The old boxer now played is pushed by the businessman on the pavement to return to the ring, but the meeting will be fatal. The deputy, the playboy and the dirty old man, for their part, do not miss an opportunity to prove themselves as real monsters.
notes: Risi conducts Tognazzi and Gassman unleashed with rhythm. Twenty episodes of various lengths united by malice; sometimes critical, sometimes cynical and (underneath) accomplices.

title: Il mostro
actors: Mark Harmon, Frederick Forrest, Glynnis O'Connor
description: Theodore Bundy has always been considered an example of sympathy, availability and education and no one would suspect that behind this apparent respectability lies a dangerous killer. Doubts to the police, who are unsuccessfully investigating the disappearance of seven women, begin to come after the testimony of a girl who claims to have been approached by a mysterious individual named Ted. Thus began a real manhunt. Based on a news story, the film entrusts the role of the psychopath to Mark Harmon, known to the television audience for his appearances in numerous serials.

title: Il mostro
actors: Johnny Dorelli, Sydne Rome, Renzo Palmer, Yves Beneyton
description: Valerio, a journalist in crisis, receives an anonymous note that heralds the murder of a TV star. At first he does not give importance to what, but when the character is promptly killed Valerio realizes he has a scoop in hand. The thing (letter and murder) repeats itself once again and Valerio marches on it and even seems to take pleasure in the coup when the murders become three and then four. At this point, however, the police begin to suspect him ...
notes: The idea is not very original (see the bestseller "In the Heat of the Summer" by John Katzenbach) the execution is cheesy.

title: Big Man on Campus
actors: Allan Katz, Corey Parker, Tom Skerritt
description: Quasimodo, the monstrous bell of Notre Dame, kidnaps the beautiful Esmeralda by order of the Archduonian Frollo. She freed from Captain De Chateaupers, she is falsely accused of a murder and hanged by Frollo ...
notes: The director Kagan starts from here to transport everything to a university campus and go from the melodramatic horror to the comedy, light -hearted and sexy, for adolescent use. The game succeeds discreetly.

title: The Abominable Snowman
actors: Peter Cushing, Forrest Tucker
description: A scientific expedition led by Dr. Rollanson, sets out (literally) on the trail of the abominable snowman. The scientist's wife and Dr. Foxi are also part of the group. Once they arrive at the Ranchour monastery in Tibet, the Dalai Lama hosts them even though he is aware that their purpose is to go in search of the yeti., An initiative that the holy man does not share. Meanwhile, a second expedition led by a certain Friend is underway.
notes: Good script, even if the appearance of the Snowman is disappointing.

title: Motorama
actors: Jordan Christopher Michael, John Diehl, Mary Woronov
description: Gus is a boy of about ten, obsessed with only one goal: to complete a collection of stickers by finding the ones with the letters that allow you to compose the word M-O-T-O-R-A-M-A and thus win 500 million dollars. Since these figurines can only be collected in gas stations, his search leads him to wander around America making encounters of all kinds.The picaresque wandering of the young protagonist allows us to get to know a variegated humanity by making us cross the suggestive and surreal lands of the South-West. All enlivened by rock music and moments of comic frenzy in the After Hours style.

title: Crocodile Dundee
actors: Paul Hogan, Linda Kozlowski, John Meillon
description: Sue, a young journalist, comes from New York to report on an Australian crocodile hunter who now owns an adventure holiday agency. The woman, after having faced the risks of Australian nature with the hunter, convinces him to follow her to New York. Here our hero ends up becoming everyone's darling. Amazing box office success. Hogan became for a time a sort of free-range Indiana Jones who based his charm on the myth of the good savage.

title: Crocodile Dundee II
actors: Paul Hogan, Linda Kozlowski, John Meillon
description: At the end of the first film we left the nice "ex-savage" Crocodile Dundee struggling with the chaotic life of the metropolis. In this second episode we find him almost perfectly integrated into his new life and with his partner, the journalist Sue Charlton. However, she is kidnapped by a gang of drug traffickers because of some compromising photos in her possession. Strangely, a sequel that does not lose its bite compared to the prototype. It is a funny film that is almost entirely based on Dundee's "character", full of gimmicks and self-irony.

title: Mr. & Mrs. Bridge
actors: Paul Newman, Joanne Woodward, Robert Sean Leonard, Margaret Welsh
description: We are in the 40s. Walter Bridge is an established Kansas City attorney. His wife India apparently leads a quiet and contented life, but in reality hides unexpected anxieties. Walter is a conservative and treats his wife as if she were his property. The children do not seem very different from their father and begin to rebel against family authority.
notes: Based on two novels by Evan S. Connell, defined as "the greatest of little writers", this film is academically directed by Ivory, always attentive to literary atmospheres and psychological penetration. Excellent Paul Newman and Joanne Woodward.

title: Mr. North
actors: Anthony Edwards, Robert Mitchum, Lauren Bacall, Virginia Madsen
description: The amiable 30-year-old Theophilus North, a graduate of Yale University, is hired as a "reader" by James Mac Henry Bosworth, a 70-year-old tycoon suffering from incontinence, during his forced stay in Newport. With peppermint tablets and with the only psychological effect of the suggestion she manages to cure him.
notes: The directorial debut of John Huston's son is a pleasant tale, based on "Mr. Theophilus North", the latest novel by Thorton Wilder. The great director had collaborated on the script, but death prevented him from playing the role that was then entrusted to Mitchum.

title: Mr. Smith Goes to Washington
actors: James Stewart, Claude Rains, Jean Arthur, Edward Arnold, Thomas Mitchell
description: Jefferson Smith is the young replacement for a recently deceased old senator. Alone, Smith opposes the construction of a dam to support the construction, on the same territory, of a national boy scout camp. He defeats the project and the economic interests of his opponents with a 26 hour long speech. At the end he falls unconscious from fatigue and disgust, but the head of the lobbyists, repentant, accuses himself of unworthiness and retires.
notes: A Frank Capra classic starring James Stewart as the fearless, honest "average man" American. Perfect pace and script, as well as naive big boy Stewart.

title: The Wild Bunch
actors: William Holden, Ernest Borgnine, Ben Johnson, Jamie Sanchez
description: Pike Bishop and his gang, pursued by Dick Thornton and his cutthroats after a robbery-trap, arrive in Aguaverde in Mexico and make an agreement with Mapachi, a former criminal who commands the counter-revolutionary troops, to attack a train loaded with weapons. The blow succeeds, but then Angelo, a Mexican from Pike's gang, holds back a crate of weapons to deliver it to the revolting Indians ...
notes: Sam Peckinpah celebrates the death of the classic western. Between dust and rivers of blood (the famous and unsurpassed final massacre), slow motion and frenetic editing, on the notes of the "Golondrina", with four pistoleros led by William Holden. A masterpiece that was restored to its integrity in 1997, according to the editing and duration desired by the director (about 7 minutes more), before the cuts imposed by the production.

title: Il mulino del Po
actors: Carla Del Poggio, Jacques Sernas, Leda Gloria
description: Berta Scarceni is betrothed to Orbino Verginesi and the engagement is celebrated on the floating mill of the Scarceni. Princivalle, Berta's brother, for fear of financial controls, sets fire to the mill. Thus began a period of misery and hatred for the two families, which resulted in tragedy and crime.
notes: Based on the great novel by Riccardo Bacchelli, who collaborated on the screenplay with Fellini, Comencini, Pinelli, Mario Bonafntini and others, the film is a realistic portrait of the era of the first peasant struggles. Lattuada moves very well between social passions masterfully intertwining them with individual ones. Music by Ildebrando Pizzetti.

title: The Mummy
actors: Boris Karloff, Zita Johann, David Manners, Arthur Byron
description: Accidentally resurrected, the Egyptian priest Imothep leads an archaeological expedition with the intent of reviving the princess he is still in love with, despite several centuries having passed.
notes: Horror classic directed by Karl Freund, extraordinary director of photography for Lang, Dreyer and Murnau. The mummy character played by Karloff still retains an unsurpassed charm. Jack Pierce's make-up, who had already developed the Frankenstein mask, was extraordinary and frightening.

title: The Walls of Jericho
actors: Linda Darnell, Cornel Wilde, Anne Baxter, Kirk Douglas, Anne Dvorak
description: A lawyer married to an alcoholic rejects the offers of love that a friend's wife makes to him with some insistence. She then carries out a smear campaign that overwhelms the lawyer and also instigates his wife, who, in a fit of anger, ends up seriously injuring him with a gunshot.
notes: Good sentimental drama with a very respectable cast.

title: Au-delà des grilles
actors: Jean Gabin, Isa Miranda, Vera Talchi, Andrea Checchi, Ave Ninchi
description: Pierre, on the run from France where he killed his lover, meets Maria, a mistreated janitor in a tavern in Genoa and the mother of a child. The passion ignites and the two decide to run away together, but the Italian police are looming. When the two lovers return home, Pierre falls into a trap.
notes: Manneristic but effective contamination between the transalpine detective story (of which René Clément was a specialist) and Italian neorealism. Co-written by Cesare Zavattini and Suso Cecchi D'Amico, the film won the Oscar for best foreign film. Curious about the use of the set.

title: Il muro di gomma
actors: Corso Salani, Angela Finocchiaro, Ivo Garrani, Laura Rossi, Antonello Fassari, Ivano Marescotti, Eliana Miglio, Mario De Candia, Sergio Fiorentini, Johnny Dorelli, Tony Sperandeo
description: On the evening of June 27, 1980 a civil aircraft from Itavia, flying from Bologna to Palermo, disappeared in flight. His remains are found near Ustica: eighty-one victims. The causes are mysterious, the news is contradictory. Some coincidences are suspicious: in Calabria, a few days later, a Libyan Mig is found, fallen or shot down. The highest authorities of the state deny everything. Marco Risi, son of Dino, has signed an unusual film-denunciation in the panorama of Italian cinema. No demagogic yielding, American-style rhythm, some good screenplay ideas (by Rulli, Petraglia and Andrea Purgatori). Music by Francesco De Gregori.

title: Music Box
actors: Jessica Lange, Armin Mueller-Stahl, Frederic Forrest, Lukas Haas
description: Mike Laszlo, a retired worker, of Hungarian origin but naturalized American for forty years, is defended by his daughter Ann, a lawyer, in a trial for an extradition request. Laszlo is accused of complicity in Nazi crimes and of having himself committed heinous crimes in the concentration camps. Ann manages to clear him. It will be only after the conclusion of the trial that he will discover the evidence of his actual guilt. Film of painful testimony under the guise of a psychological thriller. But probably the subject is not the best suited to the strings of screenwriter Joe Eszterhas ("Basic Instinct", etc.), which accentuates its didacticism. Convincing the cast.

title: Strike Up the Band
actors: Mickey Rooney, Judy Garland, Paul Whiteman
description: Jimmy and Maria bring their school orchestra to success. One of the great Berkeley musicals full of scenographic and choreographic virtuosity.

title: Musik i Mörker
actors: Mai Zetterling, Birger Malmsten, Bengt Eklund
description: Bengt Vyldeke was blinded by an accident during a military shooting exercise. Back home, he struggles to reintegrate into normal life. The love of music and the affection of Ingrid, a young waitress, help him. His application to enter the Music Academy is rejected and Bengt is adapted to play in a tavern. The relationship with Ingrid is also not always happy. Almost at the beginning, Bergman borders on melodrama. Not bad, but nothing to do with his later films.

title: Musica per vecchi animali
actors: Dario Fo, Paolo Rossi, Viola Simoncioni, Francesco Guccini
description: A professor, a mechanic and a nasty little girl meet on an August day. The city is hostile and in decay: checkpoints on every block, nothing that works, people closed in on themselves. In the evening the group breaks up. Unsuccessful debut as director of the humorist Benni, from his book "Comedians frightened warriors"; the actors are subdued. A wasted opportunity.

title: Mutande pazze
actors: Monica Guerritore, Eva Grimaldi, Barbara Kero, Debora Calì, Irma Capece Minutolo, Marisa Merlini
description: Alessia, a TV showwoman, tries to win the favor of an official. Amalia, host of a morning show, satisfies the masochistic director to be able to go in prime time. Stefania is "committed" a lot to act in the risque film of a well-known director, but the part is blown to her by her friend Beatrice, apparently dedicated only to studies.
notes: The deadly farce, written and directed by the television "expert" Roberto D'Agostino, would like to whip the vulgarity of the TV established in the Eighties, but it does so by placing itself on the same painful cultural level and without the vaguest idea of ??cinema.

title: My Beautiful Laundrette
actors: Gordon Warnecke, Daniel Day-Lewis, Saeed Jaffrey
description: Omar is a young Pakistani to whom his uncle entrusts the management of an abandoned laundry in the London suburbs. Omar gets her back on track with the help of Johnny (Daniel Day Lewis), a young drifter to whom a homosexual relationship binds him. Racial integration, homosexuality, drug trafficking: burning topics that Frears tackles with a realistic, almost documentary approach, but also with a sense of humor capable of softening the truly desolate picture of English society that emerges. Made in 16 mm for TV, it is one of the best results of the 1980s British cinema.

title: Mystère
actors: Carole Bouquet, Duilio Del Prete, John Steiner, Gabriele Tinti
description: Mystere is a luxury prostitute involved in a couple of murders. Inspector Colt investigates the case, but the girl is not inclined to cooperate, at least until the mysterious killer tries to kill her too. Underlying it all is a spy network and microfilm traffic. The inspector tries to take advantage of it, sells the microfilms, leaves the police and flees. Mystère, however, pursues him.
notes: The Vanzinas try with yellow. This was to be their finest film, the turning point in their career. The audience showed that they understood on the fly and deserted the halls. Only Carole Bouquet is saved, but a photo was enough.

title: Mystic Pizza
actors: Annabeth Gish, Julia Roberts, Lily Taylor, Adam Storke, Vincent D'Onofrio
description: Three nice girls, immigrants of Portuguese origin, lend a hand in the pizzeria of Leona, which considers them as daughters, in the American town of Mystic, Connecticut. This is where loves and disappointments, enthusiasm and despair intertwine, in the infinite game of life.
notes: Probably when you complain that Italian cinema has lost its typical "average product", you think of a film like this one: well shot, well-finished, with careful staging and dialogue, intelligent without being pedantic, sentimental without being tearful, dignified in short. even in its ending perhaps too happy. Among the interpreters Julia Roberts.

title: Nadine
actors: Kim Basinger, Jeff Bridges, Rip Torn, Gwen Verdon, Glenne Headly
description: In Austin, Texas, beautiful beautician Nadine Hightower posed for "risque" photos to scrape together a few dollars. But now he would like to get hold of the negatives again. He goes to the photographer just in time to see him murdered. He escapes with an envelope of negatives which, however, are not his own, but those of a speculative project.
notes: Beautiful and talented: Kim Basinger reconfirms a comic talent that enhances her natural gifts even more. Benton diligently directs this comedy turned yellow, perhaps obvious, but funny.

title: The Nanny
actors: Bette Davis, Wendy Craig, Jill Bennett, James Villiers
description: In the house of the Fane spouses, where Nanny has been serving for a long time, little Joey returns after two years in a psychiatric hospital, following the trauma of the dark death of her little sister Susan. There is hostility between Nanny and the baby and when his mother is hit by severe pain, Joey is suspected of trying to poison her, but little by little the unsuspected madness of the housekeeper comes to light.
notes: A film built on the masterful presence of Bette Davis, who cleverly exploits the sense of claustrophobia of the environment. A lot of skillful tension, without resorting to forcing.

title: The World's Greatest Athlete
actors: Jan-Michael Vincent, Tim Conway, John Amos, Roscoe Lee Browne
description: The coach Ancher and his assistant discover a prodigious sporting talent in Zambia: it is Nanù (Vincent), the son of white missionaries, who is brought to the United States to make him a champion. Entrusted to the care of the beautiful Jane, whom he falls in love with, reciprocated, Nanù fights jealousies and even magic, but in the end he wins over everything. Directed with lightness of touch and with the use of good tricks, the film is enjoyed like any pleasant Disney infusion, a mixture of humor and good feelings and faces with the brand of the House, like the actor Tim Conway.

title: Napoléon vu par Abel Gance
actors: Albert Dieudonné, Annabella, Antonin Artaud, Abel Gance
description: In Crécy's typography some characters who witnessed or protagonists (Stendhal, Béranger and others) recall the career of Napoleon, from the time of the military academy to the beginning of the Italian campaign. The military school of Brienne, the arrival in Paris of the Army of the Rhine, the birth of the Marseillaise, the march of the people on the Tuileries, the Republic, the siege of Toulon, etc. Two years of shooting for a much reduced production compared to the original project (6 lunar films); great innovations in shooting and editing. A delirium, the French equivalent of Griffith's bombast. The use of multiple superimpositions to simultaneously narrate distant events in space is famous. Original music by Arthur Honneger. Antonin Artaud plays Marat. The edition considered complete today (4 hours) was prepared in the 1970s.

title: Napoletani a Milano
actors: Eduardo De Filippo, Anna Maria Ferrero, Frank Latimore, Vittorio Sanipoli
description: Don Salvatore Aianello and a large group of his countrymen have always lived in huts built on an abandoned area on the outskirts of Naples. But the company that owns the land, operated by Milanese capitalists, drives them out because it wants to build modern buildings. So Don Salvatore leads a march of the dispossessed on Milan ...
notes: Based on a story by Eduardo De Filippo, scripted by himself (with Age and Scarpelli), directed and performed, the film rests on the shoulders of the great author-actor. Although it is affected here and there by the theatrical system (especially in the abundant dialogues), the outcome is often pleasant.

title: Many Rivers to Cross
actors: Robert Taylor, Eleanor Parker, Victor McLaglen
description: Bushrod Gentry (Robert Taylor) is a hunter from Kentucky, used to living in contact with nature and without too many ties. One day he meets Placida, a rather wild girl. He is a bit reluctant, but she has no doubts and, thanks to a subterfuge, manages to get married. For Bushrod married life is almost impossible, so much so that immediately after the marriage he runs away, but Placida does not give up and pursues him. A simple but enjoyable film, especially thanks to the Taylor / Parker couple. It goes without saying that in the original version of Neapolitans there is no shadow of it.

title: Napoli, Palermo, New York - Il triangolo della camorra
actors: Mario Merola, Howard Ross, Massimo Mollica
description: Gennaro, after having been a Camorrista, is now a quiet businessman from Naples. But when his wife is killed in a shooting, he regains his old grit and flies in search of the killers in Sicily and the United States. With Mario Merola, king of the "drama", in a film less heartbreaking than usual. But crude and patchy.

title: Napoli piange e ride
actors: Luciano Tajoli, Jula De Palma, Vincenzo Musolino
description: Luciano is a watchmaker with a hobby of song. Paralyzed following an accident, he had to abandon dreams of glory. His impresario realizes that his wife Marisa also has a beautiful voice and convinces her to debut. Once the contract is signed, the impresario tries to rape Marisa who kills him to defend herself. In a new accident Luciano then risks losing his sight.
notes: Melodramatic forerunner of the "musicarelli" of the sixties. The protagonist is a famous couple of the Neapolitan song.

title: Napoli si ribella
actors: Luc Merenda, Enzo Cannavale, Adolfo Lastretti, Claudio Gora, Marianne Comtel
description: The fearsome Commissioner Mauri, fresh off the move to Naples, investigates a theft from a bank safe deposit box. Initially it seems to be a trivial matter of jewelry; in reality the commissioner is faced with a powerful boss, drug trafficker and murderer, in a fight studded with massacres. The film recycles a conventional repertoire of policeman figures and situations, with some hints of local color.

title: Helsinki Napoli - All Night Long
actors: Kari Vaananen, Nino Manfredi, Roberta Manfredi, Jean-Pierre Castaldi, Margi Clarke, Sam Fuller, Eddie Constantine, Wim Wenders, Jim Jarmusch
description: Alex is the only Finnish taxi driver in Berlin, married to a Neapolitan girl. One evening he finds two corpses and a briefcase full of money in his taxi: he thinks of getting rid of the former and seizing the latter, but the matter becomes complicated when two gangsters appear intending to stop him. Mika is the brother of the more famous and noble Aki and has a penchant for stories that are all action and irony; the cast is an international puzzle and also features Wim Wenders and Jim Jarmusch.

title: Black Narcissus
actors: Deborah Kerr, David Farrar, Flora Robson, Jean Simmons
description: With the help of the small English community living there, five sisters have opened a school and a hospital in a center in the Himalayas. But difficulties of all kinds are emerging. A nun plants flowers instead of vegetables, another treats a child who dies, and suspicion spreads among the natives, yet another goes mad and tries to seduce a man.
notes: Entirely shot in the studio, morbid and flamboyant, it is the highest point reached by Powell's pictorial genius: the colors underline all the psychological differences of the characters. Oscar for scenography and photography.

title: The Birth of a Nation
actors: Lillian Gish, Henry B.Walthall, Mae Marsh, Miriam Cooper, Mary Alden
description: The southerner Ben Cameron, after the victory of the North, founded the Ku Klux Klan as a self-defense of the whites in the face of the arrogance of the blacks. He is struck by the tragedy of his sister's suicide, raped by a black man. Thanks to him, the whites regain control of the situation, after which Ben will be able to marry his beloved Elsie, who belongs to a family that had sided with the Northerners. Outdated and reactionary in its contents, but a fundamental work in the history of cinema: the cinematographic language demonstrates here that it has reached full expressive maturity and Griffith by right conquers the primacy among the fathers of the new art.

title: Nata di marzo
actors: Jacqueline Sassard, Gabriele Ferzetti, Mario Valdemarin, Tina De Mola
description: She is Francesca (Sassard), a modern and casual girl; he is Sandro (Ferzetti), a very posed architect and no longer very young. They get married, but reasons for friction soon arise. The two then decide to separate. However, they regret both the good times of their happy union and that is the one they will eventually return to.
notes: Comedy with a predictable happy ending, but not without its original structure and sagacity. Pietrangeli tells with ease and with polite irony. Good characterization of the performers.

title: Born Free
actors: Virginia McKenna, Bill Travers, Geoffrey Keen, Omar Chambati
description: George lives in Kenya with his wife Joy. One day the man has to kill a lioness who has torn a native to pieces; he returns home with the three puppies of the beast, which he raises with his wife. They send two to a zoo, keeping the third, a female they call Elsa. The lioness grows up in captivity, but once she's an adult the need arises to let her go.
notes: Between fiction and documentary, the ultra-famous late colonialist parable about good whites who know how to love Africa and its inhabitants (on all fours).

title: A Star Is Born
actors: James Mason, Judy Garland, Jack Carson, Charles Bickford
description: An alcoholic actor discovers a young singer full of talent and manages to launch her into show business. But the more she asserts herself, the more he experiences a painful decline. Until he decides to get out of the way voluntarily: one star dies, another is born: "the show must go on".
notes: Director George Cukor has signed one of his best films, showing the less flattering aspects of Hollywood, showing us what's behind the façade of "premieres" and ceremonies, letting himself go to his visionary flair without overdoing it, using the Garland superbly (for the first time in a dramatic role after musical comedies). She sings here too, the Garland, but with what vigor!

title: Nathalie
actors: Martine Carol, Mischa Auer, Michel Piccoli, Louis Seigner, Lise Delamare
description: A very valuable brooch is stolen during a fashion show. A young model, Nathalie, is wrongly accused. The girl will manage to find the brooch, escape the thieves who try to kidnap it and kill the gang leader. Martine Carol stars in this film, directed with a quick hand by Christian-Jacque.

title: National Lampoon's Vacation
actors: Chevy Chase, Beverly D'Angelo, Randy Quaid, John Candy
description: The Griswold family decides to go on vacation to the far-away Valley World amusement park. During the journey, all sorts of hitches disturb the serenity of the holidays. When they arrive at the park, they discover that it is closed for construction. The head of the family, arms in hand, lets himself be opened by the dazed guardians and then manages to avoid the rigors of the law thanks to his oratory skills.
notes: Inspired by a very successful humorous series in the United States, it is considered one of the best products of the maddened vein at home. Here it has not been very successful, also because the humor of Chevy Chase is not easily translated.

title: Born on the Fourth of July
actors: Tom Cruise, Caroline Kava, Willem Dafoe, Tom Berenger, Raymond J. Barry, Kyra Sedgwick, Tom Sizemore
description: Ron was born on July 4th, the anniversary of American independence. Volunteer in Vietnam, in the Asian country he knows hell: he sees women and children being killed and in turn causes the death of a friend. Badly wounded in the spine, Ron returns to his homeland paralyzed. He is forced to a long period of hospitalization in a military hospital during which he profoundly changes his opinion on the war and its motivations. He falls prey to a strong depression from which he emerges to devote himself soul to body to the cause of pacifism and to the politics of the Democratic Party.
notes: Taken from the autobiography of Ron Kovic (who appears, in a wheelchair, in the opening parade), a vigorous and (almost inevitable with Stone) pamphlet at times rhetorical. But the many moving moments cancel the slowness.

title: The Lightship
actors: Klaus Maria Brandauer, Robert Duvall, Tim Phillips, Arliss Howard, William Forsythe, Tom Bower, Robert Costanzo
description: A lighthouse collects three men from a failing speedboat: Caspary and brothers Gene and Eddie. The captain of the ship is called Miller and his son Alex is also on board, a refugee there to avoid trouble with the police. But the three castaways also have big problems with the police, who are actually ferocious gangsters; in short they take command of the ship. Captain Miller only tries not to precipitate the situation, which confirms Alex's suspicion that his father is a coward.
notes: Special jury prize in Venice '85, Skolimowski's film has a great atmosphere and at least one superlative actor, even if it doesn't shine too much for originality. The actor in question is not Brandauer.

title: The Wackiest Ship in the Army
actors: Jack Lemmon, Ricky Nelson, John Lund
description: In charge of a very delicate mission aimed at controlling the Japanese navy, Lieutenant Crandall is entrusted with the command of a shabby fishing boat. Not everything goes as planned, but the crew manages to get out of the most critical situations and carry out their task successfully. Sparkling comedy with an impeccable rhythm, directed by a Jack Lemmon of the golden times.

title: Down to the Sea in Ships
actors: Lionel Barrymore, Richard Widmark, Dean Stockwell, Cecil Kellaway
description: Captain Bering, commander of the whaling vessel "Bedford Pride" is old and ill and the owners are planning to retire him. But the old sea dog has a grandson, Jed, whom he cares a lot about and on whom he has made many plans. Meanwhile, the owners join the man, Dan, with a young captain. A solid seafaring drama, not too spectacular but with excellent actors.

title: Flight of the Navigator
actors: Joey Cramer, Veronica Cartwright, Cliff De Young, Sarah Jessica Parker
description: On Independence Day, while out and about in the woods, young David Freeman slips and hits his head. He wakes up eight years later: in the meantime he has been reported missing and - as he soon discovers - his brain has taken on strange characteristics. Under observation by NASA scientists, David escapes aboard a spacecraft along with an alien who is trying to find his way back, but then wakes up to find that the world is back to normal again ...
notes: The usual variation on the “baby with robot” trend, directed without too much imagination by the mediocre Kleiser (which, for the uninitiated, is that of _Grease_ and _Laguna blu_).

title: The Navigator: A Medieval Odyssey
actors: Hamish McFarlane, Bruce Lyons, Chris Haywood, Marshall Napier
description: In 1348, in the Cumbria region, Griffin, a nine-year-old boy, had a premonition: to overcome the Black Plague which claimed victims by the thousands, a copper cross had to be erected on top of the "Great Church". A somewhat naive story, but not without merits, especially in photography.

title: Navy Seals
actors: Charlie Sheen, Michael Biehn, Joanne Whalley
description: In the army of the United States of America, a special group called "Seals" is trained according to the harshest laws of selection. The men who are part of it must always be ready for anything. The group is sent to the Middle East on the trail of terrorist Ben Shaheed, and the missiles he possesses. Some vicissitudes lead them to Lebanon where a bloody clash will take place with the killing of the terrorists.
notes: In the beginning it was "That dirty dozen" then the various "Top Guns". However, the direction of Lewis Teague, better known as a horror director, is interesting.

title: Alla controra
actors: Andrea Roncato, Elena Sofia Ricci, Sebastiano Nardone, Francesco Scali
description: Nico and Alba run a motel where nobody stops. They then hire Marcello, the woman's lover, who, through a local radio, suggests that UFOs have landed near the hotel. Meanwhile Nico is believed dead by some killers who have mistaken him for another. Ménage a trois in the manner of the French pochade, but with less irony and a modest cast.

title: Fog over Frisco
actors: Bette Davis, Donald Woods, Margaret Lindsay, Lyle Talbot
description: In San Francisco, a young heiress enters a circle of criminals, between spicy and disturbing parties. But the round proves too big for her and she is eliminated. It is one of Bette Davis' first great performances, but at the time not yet at the peak of success, she was eliminated after twenty minutes of film.

title: Dangerous When Wet
actors: Esther Williams, Fernando Lamas, Jack Carson
description: The Higgins family lives on their ranch which needs a lot of jobs that are always postponed for lack of money. But one day the company that produces Liquepap liqueur offers them a lot of money if, using their well-known swimming skills, they cross the English Channel for advertising purposes. The Higgins accept and move to England.
notes: Beautiful colors and beautiful music, as always in MGM musicals; plus, an Esther Williams at the peak of her career.

title: Nefertite regina del Nilo
actors: Jeanne Crain, Edmund Purdom, Amedeo Nazzari, Liana Orfei
description: Tanith, daughter of the High Priest, must marry the heir to the throne although she loves the sculptor Tumos. He tries to forget her with the gypsy Merith, in vain. When he has to go to court to sculpt the portrait of the new queen, passion flares up again between the two ex-lovers. But the woman knows how to return to her duties as sovereign in the face of the threat of a revolt. Destiny is fulfilled in the last battle. Cast of appeal for a cumbersome and heavy film, in which ancient Egypt has to do with pure chance.

title: Switch
actors: Ellen Barkin, Jimmy Smits, JoBeth Williams, Lorraine Bracco
description: Steve Brooks, unrepentant womanizer, is killed by his three lovers. Once in the afterlife, he sees himself proposing a pact: he will go to heaven only if he finds on earth a person who truly loves him. He is then sent back to earth but ... as a blonde: Amanda.
notes: Crackling comedy by veteran Edwards, which reflects on the classic mechanisms of the genre (game of the sexes, equivocation elevated to a system) in a "metaphysical" way. God made us in his likeness and in fact speaks with the voice of a man and a woman.

title: Edge of the City
actors: John Cassavetes, Sidney Poitier, Jack Warden, Kathleen Maguire
description: With a painful past behind him, Alex is now wanted for not showing up for the draft call. He finds work in the harsh environment of the dockers and befriends Tommy, a black colleague, but he is killed by a racist foreman and Alex, despite how much he has to lose, is the only one who wants to report the killer.
notes: Vigorous and well-performed melodrama, made with a "Harbor Front" eye.

title: Return to Oz
actors: Fairuza Balk, Nicol Williamson, Jean Marsh, Piper Laurie
description: Dorothy Gale has returned home from the fantastic world of Oz and has not yet recovered. The worried parents take her to Dr. Worley who gives her an electric shock. As a result, the clinic is on fire and Dorothy finds herself back in the world of Oz, but this time everything has changed. It's not exactly a children's movie or if it is, it's pretty scary. Without the musical numbers it doesn't even seem a distant relative of Victor Fleming's old film of 1939. Here the best things, in fact, are the bad guys.

title: Nel giorno del Signore
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Igli Villani, Fred Robsam, Erminio Macario, Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Gino Bramieri
description: All the Italian comic cinema of the time (with some additions from beyond the border) to represent in a laughing key the story of Raffaello Sanzio and his beloved Fornarina struggling with the conspiracy hatched by the noble Beatrice del Giovenale to get rid of the woman and have everything for himself the famous painter that Pope Julius II called to work in the Vatican.
notes: If it were enough to accumulate names of funny actors to get a funny product, here we would have a hilarious result. Instead, this imitation of Luigi Magni's Roman style is created and interpreted with listlessness.

title: Nel gorgo del peccato
actors: Elisa Cegani, Fausto Tozzi, Margot Hielschera, Franco Fabrizi
description: Margherita, widowed at a young age with two children, was abandoned by her eldest son Alberto, a young man with a restless temperament. For years Alberto has not given news of himself, but one day, suddenly, he reappears together with Germaine, a beautiful woman who lives with him abroad. For the first time Alberto found a job at a gas station, but his modest earnings did not allow him to meet Germaine's needs.
notes: Cottafavi, an excellent artisan of cinema, attempts the path of Matarazzo-style melodrama and with his usual stylistic grace, confesses an excellent example of a popular novel and paints a delicate and profound portrait of female piscologies, despite the limping flaws of the screenplay.

title: Prime Evil
actors: William Beckwith, Christine Moore
description: In New York, members of the "demon monks" sect have signed a pact with the Devil. It states that every thirteen years the congregation will offer human sacrifices to the Evil One, receiving immortality for the adepts in exchange. Passable B-movie directed by a specialist of the genre.

title: Le pays des sourds
actors: Attori non professionisti
description: Led by Professor Jean Claude Poulain, expert in sign communication, the film takes us into the universe of the deaf, on a journey through some strong moments of their relationship with the "outside" world: school, work, socialization of the handicap. Successfully presented at the Locarno Film Festival, Nel Paese dei Sordi is a film that reconciles with documentarism and captivates like a novel. While poisoning itself with non-professional actors, authentic interpreters of themselves, the film avoids both the glossy pity of Hollywood and the shallows of the uplifting "holy card".

title: Nel segno di Roma
actors: Anita Ekberg, Georges Marchal, Folco Lulli, Chelo Alonso
description: Marco Valerio, Roman consul defeated by the troops of Queen Zenobia, with the help of one of his officers in love with a Palmyrene priestess, pretends to pass over to the enemy. Throw away the plots of Zenobia's bloodthirsty prime minister, capture the woman and take her to Rome. But when he discovers that the queen has fallen in love with him, he arranges for her to be released. The throne of Palmyra, however, passes to the priestess and the Roman officer.
notes: Signed by Brignone, the film was actually shot by Antonioni (for the interiors) and Freda (for the exteriors).

title: The Nativity
actors: Madeline Stowe, John Shea, Jane Wyatt, Paul Stewart, Audrey Totter
description: Television version of the nativity of Jesus, which traces the birth of the relationship between Joseph and Mary and the events that led to the first Christmas in history.
notes: Madeline Stowe, who starred in The Last of the Mohicans (1992), is the film's only real attraction.

title: Nel sole
actors: Al Bano, Romina Power, Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia
description: Charles and Lorraine, both students, love each other: but he has a straw tail, in the sense that he made the girl believe that she comes from a wealthy family while, to support her studies, she works as a waiter. The catch is discovered: but as we know, love is stronger than everything ...
notes: How many times have we seen a similar situation represented? Countless, and in fact there is very little original here. But what mattered was just to put together any little story to make Albano Carrisi sing: even the title, to be on the safe side, takes up that of one of his successes. The Albano-Romina couple was formed right on the set (convict) of this film: the rest is known.

title: Nella città l'inferno
actors: Anna Magnani, Giulietta Masina, Myriam Bru, Renato Salvatori, Alberto Sordi
description: Wrongly accused of theft, the naive Lina ends up in the Mantellate women's prison. Egle, a repeat offender with a troubled past, immediately takes a liking to her and starts teaching her something about life. They will both change: one in one direction, the other in the opposite, but prison is still hell ...
notes: Generally, critics attribute much of the film's failure to poor relations between the two stars. In any case, despite the sure hand of Castellani, the screenplay by Suso Cecchi d'Amico and the live sound, the film did not have much luck with the public of the time.

title: Caught!
actors: Barbara Bel Geddes, Robert Ryan, James Mason
description: The young and ambitious Martha (Bel Geddes) becomes a model in hopes of marrying a handsome and rich man. She becomes the wife of billionaire Smith Ohlrig (Ryan), but married life is hell, so much so that she escapes and is employed at the modest clinic of Dr. Larry Quinada (Mason).
notes: It is Ophüls' best American film, but it is virtually unknown in Europe. Made amidst a thousand hardships, it constitutes a close analysis of the ambitions, illusions and thirst for wealth that are shattered on cruel reality.

title: Intruder in the Dust
actors: Juan Hernandez, Elizabeth Patterson, Claude Jarman, David Brian, Porter Hall, Charles Kemper, Will Geer, Elzie Emanuel
description: A white man was killed in a small town in the southern United States. Lucas Beechman is accused only because he is black. Proud to the point of insolence, Lucas refuses to defend himself, but also to denounce the real killer whom he also knows.
notes: A notable anti-racist film, based on a novel by William Faulkner, who is also a co-writer, albeit uncredited.

title: Nella stretta morsa del ragno
actors: Anthony Franciosa, Klaus Kinski, Michèle Mercier, Raf Baldassarre
description: A cheeky reporter accepts a bet with Edgar Allan Poe and spends the night of November 2nd in a vampire-infested castle. The transformist Margheriti proposes an unlikely London Poe: the important thing is to tremble. Remake of "Danza macabra", by Margheriti himself (1964).

title: Chains of Gold
actors: John Travolta, Marilu Henner, Hector Elizondo, Joey Lawrence
description: There is a lot of drugs on the streets of Miami and the best couriers are kids. Tommy (Joey Lawrence) is thirteen and eager to earn easy money. He makes contact with Carlos, the boss who controls drug trafficking, and ends up in the ring of the underworld. His only possible way to salvation is represented by Scott (John Travolta).
notes: The protagonist at the time had entered into a contract with the production company of this film, with which he had already shot "Look who's talking", which had been a success. His participation in the film, directed by Rod Holcomb, did not meet with such satisfactory results.

title: Enemies, a Love Story
actors: Ron Silver, Anjelica Huston, Lena Olin, Margaret Sophie Stein
description: The story of the Polish Jewish intellectual Herman Broder who escaped the Nazis and lives in New York with his wife Yadwiga, the farmer who saved him. Between this, his lover Masha and his first wife Tamara, believed dead, a situation arises that the man will solve only by running away ...
notes: From the novel of the same name by a Nobel laureate (Isaac Bashevits Singer), a pretentious film adaptation by Mazursky (also a Jew), which turns it into a totally unresolved dramatic-grotesque key. A good protagonist and three good actresses do not save from the annoyance of a clever and unoriginal operation.

title: Il marito bello
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Giovanna Ralli, Giacomo Furia, Andrea Checchi
description: Luciana would like her husband Marco to devote himself to more serious things than refereeing football matches on Sundays and so she gets him hired by an aeronautical company. However, Marco gets fired and, after yet another quarrel, separates from his wife. When he meets Giulia he believes he can rebuild a life, but the girl accepts his court only to favor her favorite team.
notes: Gianni Puccini's film is also known by the title "The beautiful husband", it is a delicate but not too funny comedy, with a still immature Mastroianni.

title: Nerone
actors: Pippo Franco, Maria Grazia Buccella, Enrico Montesano, Bombolo
description: Surrounded by mendacious and unrealistic Christians who plot the revolution, by vengeful senators, by a satanic and distorted mother who conspires against him, locked up in an asylum, grappling with a fanatic barricadier named Seneca, Nero, one of the most discredited emperors in history , he almost looks like a saint: so much so that he manages to fool even that simpleton of St. Peter and thus settles himself in heaven.
notes: The film unleashes a harvest of irreverent but bland, trivial and banal comic.

title: No Mercy
actors: Richard Gere, Kim Basinger, Jeroen Krabbe
description: Losado, a drug kingpin from New Orleans, must be eliminated. However, Eddie, a policeman, goes to the appointment with the principal. Meanwhile, Eddie's friend is killed. Eddie then leaves for Baton Rouge to avenge him. Here he is hunted by the men of Losado, but manages to escape with the boss's beautiful mistress handcuffed to him. The two flee through the swamps.
notes: A confused and twisted detective story, written by Jim Carabatsos. Gere and Basinger try the mélo card, but they fall into ridicule.

title: Ulzana's Raid
actors: Burt Lancaster, Bruce Davison, Jorge Luke, Richard Jaeckel
description: Ulzana, the famous Apache leader, rebelled against white power and fled the reservation with a handful of loyal warriors. The young Lieutenant De Buine, who hates violence, is sent in pursuit with a group of soldiers and an Indian guide. It is the latter who explains that the tortures imposed by the Indians on their victims are a sacred rite: through them, the strength of the vanquished is transmitted to the victor. But Ulzana is more and more alone, abandoned even by his men ...
notes: Aldrich directs a vigorous western (written by Alan Sharp), in line with the pro-Indian revisionism of the time. Passionate and with an energetic Lancaster.

title: Stir Crazy
actors: Gene Wilder, Richard Pryor, Georg Stanford Brown
description: Skip and Harry decide to leave the cold and sad New York to go to the South, in search of sun, humanity and love. Needless to say, they are immediately mistaken for two robbers and thrown in jail. Here, of course, they see all sorts of things, until participation in a rodeo authorized by the management offers the right for the longed-for escape. Meanwhile, the two real robbers are arrested. Wilder and Pryor had already been partners in Hiller's "Wagon-Lits with murders", but it is only with this "Nobody can stop us" that the real fortune of this "strange couple" begins, destined to continue with two others. movie. The two do everything they can to make you forget Sidney Poitier's rather heavy direction.

title: Nessuno mi può giudicare
actors: Laura Efrikian, Fabrizio Moroni, Caterina Caselli, Alberto Terrani
description: The honesty of Federico, a young provincial who has just arrived in Rome, earned him the hiring in a department store, where Laura also works, with whom, loved back, he falls in love. But in the shadows the treacherous Alberto plots, who had already set his sights on the girl. True feelings eventually find a way to assert themselves.
notes: Commediola, with singers (Caterina Caselli) and comedians (Taranto, Bramieri) in the cast, undoubtedly modest, but not despicable. Good feelings in rivers and songs. It has done worse (before, then and even after) in Italian Serie B cinema.

title: Carson City
actors: Randolph Scott, Lucille Norman, Raymond Massey, Richard Webb
description: In 1870 the state of Nevada still does not have its own railway network, and stagecoaches are often prey to bandit attacks. Jeff Kincaid (Scott), engineer and resolute man, is commissioned to build a railway through the mountains. The work will be hindered in every way by the criminals.
notes: The conflict between the railway (symbol of progress) and farmers has been told countless times. Here, on the other hand, robbers and murderers oppose who see the profit of their criminal actions fading. A decent western.

title: On Dangerous Ground
actors: Robert Ryan, Ida Lupino, Charles Kemple, Ed Begley, Cleo Moore
description: Jim Wilson (Robert Ryan) of the NYPD is too violent. The superiors then transfer him to a mountainous region, where he meets a blind girl, the sister of a runaway murderer. The ending is tragic. At the time, the film, produced by John Houseman, was a commercial fiasco, perhaps because it exalted atmospheres and psychologies. Good reasons to see him again today. The beautiful soundtrack is signed by Bernard Herrmann.

title: The Snows of Kilimanjaro
actors: Gregory Peck, Susan Hayward, Ava Gardner, Hildegarde Neff
description: "The novelist Harry Strett, hunting in Africa, falls seriously ill following an infection. In the delirium of fever he reviews his past: Paris, at the beginning of his career, when he marries the model Cynthia; in Africa, where he neglects her wife who, by an accident, is forced to have an abortion; in Europe, where he falls in love with another woman, and finally again in Africa where he remarries with Helen.
notes: The film is based on a short story by Hemingway, stretching the broth without mercy. Beautiful landscapes, heavy character, even if well interpreted by Gregory Peck.

title: New York, New York
actors: Robert De Niro, Liza Minnelli, Lionel Stander, Georgie Auld
description: Immediately after the war, the very evening the nation celebrates its victory, Jimmy, a saxophonist, meets a singer, Francine. They marry and work together, but when one is more successful than the other, it is family trouble. She becomes a Hollywood star and the two leave, tempted, at times and without too much conviction, by the possibility of still loving each other.
notes: Film that takes up the atmosphere of the classic musical, but with a certain underlying bitterness. Liza Minnelli is not forgotten by the way she interprets the title song. Robert De Niro delivers the opening sequence of the courtship to all future anthologies of cinema.

title: New York Stories
directors: Martin Scorsese, Francis Ford Coppola, Woody Allen
actors: Nick Nolte, Rosanna Arquette, Giancarlo Giannini, Woody Allen
description: In the first episode ("Lezioni di vero", by Scorsese) an avant-garde painter (Nolte) struggles in a creative and sentimental crisis with his pupil-lover (Arquette). The second episode ("Life without Zoe", by Coppola) is centered on a very rich but unhappy girl (McComb) because her parents, famous concert performers (Giannini and Shire), are always around the world. In the third episode ("Oedipus wreck", by Allen) the protagonist (Allen himself) dreams of making the petulant mother disappear forever without succeeding. Not exactly homogeneous results: Coppola's evasive and modest, Allen's repetitive and joke, Scorsese's a masterpiece, a reflection on life and art inspired by Dostoevsky's diaries, dominated by a self-destructive Nick Nolte and counterpointed by "A Whiter Shade of Pale "by Procol Harum.

title: And You Thought Your Parents Were Weird
actors: Edan Gross, Joshua John Miller, Marcia Strassman, Eric Walker
description: Sarah Carson is recently widowed with two children, Max and Josh. The two kids are not just any schoolchildren, they don't spend their time in front of the TV or dreaming of baseball games. True computer geniuses, in fact, are deeply committed to electronics. At a competition for young inventors, the boys win a prize that they use to create their secret project, pursued for a very long time: the construction of a small robot, called Newman. Everything goes on almost for fun except that Albert Einstein with the complicity of Napoleon manages to inoculate the spirit of his deceased father in the robot. Jaeger, president of an electronics company interested in the discovery, hires another child to get hold of it. The fight between the two good kids and the bad one will be fierce, but this incredible "spirited" robot won't stand in the corner to watch.
notes: Movies for children and families with a typical Christmas atmosphere. The idea of ??Einstein (and Napoleon!), However, is not bad.

title: Niagara
actors: Marilyn Monroe, Joseph Cotten, Jean Peters, Don Wilson
description: Like so many newlyweds, Ray and Polly Cutter also go on their honeymoon to the famous falls. There they meet a couple in crisis: her husband, George, has lost all his money for a bankruptcy and returned sick from the Korean War. His wife Rose never ceases to mock him and betray him. It is Rose who pushes the last lover to kill George; but in hand-to-hand combat it is the latter that prevails. In order to take revenge, he then contemplates killing his wife.
notes: Marilyn in all her glory proves she also has what it takes to be an actress. One of Hathaway's best films, a dramatic drama as impetuous as the falls.

title: Final Impact
actors: Lorenzo Lamas, Kathleen Kinmont, Michael Worth
description: Young Danny asks Nick Taylor (Lorenzo Lamas), a cynical ex-kickfighting champion who has gone through training, to take care of his sporting career. Nick willingly agrees, but his secret purpose is to use the boy to take revenge on Jake, the reigning champion of the specialty. Numerous fights but without too many emotions in this film that echoes Rocky suggestions and is still a little less ramshackle than many others of the genre. Lorenzo Lamas, a well-known face to fans of the Beautiful television series, is here quite lively interpreter, well supported by the beautiful Kathleen Kinmont (Maggie). First TV viewing

title: Rhinestone
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Dolly Parton, Richard Farnsworth, Tim Thomerson
description: Blonde Jake is very successful in a New York country club. Jake has a contract that he would like to dissolve: the boss, however, loves bets and agrees to free her from obligations only if she manages to transform a stranger into a successful singer. Jake sets his sights on the taxi driver Nick: convinces him to play along, but then repents because he sees the frenzy of fame growing in the young man.
notes: Stallone tries the comedy card to give new life to his career, but he fails. Besides, Dolly Parton was the least suitable partner he could find.

title: Nico
actors: Steven Seagal, Sharon Stone, Daniel Faraldo, Henry Silva
description: Nico is a Chicago policeman of Italian origin. Paired with a colleague on the ground against organized crime, especially when he is involved in a secret operation with an international dimension against a group of drug traffickers protected by the CIA. His experience in Vietnam makes him understand many things, but his superiors are about to take the investigation away from him.
notes: It's an action movie with no interest. The superman on duty is the stony Steven Seagal; his partner is a not yet famous Sharon Stone in a sexy version.

title: A Breed Apart
actors: Rutger Hauer, Powers Boothe, Kathleen Turner
description: Walker, a famous mountaineer, is hired to steal some eggs of a very rare species of eagle from his nest, which is located on top of a mountain. The only problem is the guardian of the area (Hauer), a former Vietnam veteran with an ecological streak. Initially the two will almost make friends, but when the ranger discovers his true intentions, he will begin to hunt him down.
notes: The setting is naturally suggestive, but the story, with its elementary environmentalist spirit, proceeds with difficulty and leaves you cold.

title: L'évenement le plus important depuis que l'homme a marché sur la lune
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Catherine Deneuve, Mireille Mathieu
description: Marco lives with Irene in Paris. She is a hairdresser, he runs a driving school. Everything is fine as long as he feels strange disturbances. After various medical consultations an incredible diagnosis emerges: the man is in the fourth month of pregnancy. The news goes around the world and, with the notoriety, the quiet menage of the couple vanishes.
notes: Grotesque comedy based on one of the myths of the time: extremist feminism that is here overturned. The consumer society and the commercial exploitation of "human cases" are also targeted. The rest is due to the two protagonists.

title: Nothing in Common
actors: Tom Hanks, Jackie Gleason, Eva Marie Saint, Besse Armstrong
description: David Basner (Hanks) is the director of an advertising agency. Just as he is about to close a contract he learns that his father and mother have separated. David especially takes care of the situation of his father, who is sick and must end up in hospital: in doing so, he will understand that success is not the only value for which one must live. His girlfriend helps him.
notes: Mild and moralizing satire of the hectic life in the world of advertising, which has nothing in common with the affective one. The happy ending indicates that the two worlds can coexist.

title: Night Club
actors: Christian De Sica, Mara Venier, Sergio Vastano, Roberto Ciufoli, Sabrina Ferilli
description: On the night of February 2, 1960, in Rome there was the "premiere" of Fellini's "Dolce vita". Fred Buscaglione died in a car accident. This is the "historical" frame chosen to place a story that describes the misadventures of Piero and Ottavio, modest bank employees who have made it possible to organize a big party for Commendator Balestrelli, an industrialist from the North who they hope will become the financier of their projects. . The only advantage of "Night Club" consists precisely in a certain scruple in the period reconstruction. For the rest, we have specks rather than characters, situations more vulgar than spicy, superficiality in the portrait of the environment.

title: A Nightmare on Helm Street 2: Freddy's Revenge
actors: Mark Patton, Robert Englund
description: The terrifying Freddy Krueger takes over Jesse's mind and body, driving him into criminal insanity. Nice idea and effects, ingenuity is necessary for fear. A classic horror movie for teenagers, unmatched by the original.

title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 5: The Dream Child
actors: Robert Englund, Lisa Wilcox, Erika Anderson, Michael Ashton
description: The presence of Freddy Krueger occupies young Alice's dreams. Friends don't believe her and only her boyfriend Dan offers her some understanding. However, when Freddy eliminates Dan and two of his friends, it becomes clear that the girl is not a mythomaniac. Meanwhile Alice discovers she is pregnant and fears that Freddy may use the baby to carry out his atrocities.
notes: The best "Nightmare" of the series after the first directed by Wes Craven. The authors are not concerned at all with the story, more or less always the same, but only with the visual aspects. Baroque, expressionist, overflowing: an almost experimental horror.

title: Little Nikita
actors: River Phoenix, Sidney Poitier, Richard Bradford, Richard Lynch
description: FBI agent Roy Parmenter is on the trail of the Russian spy Scuba who, years earlier, killed his best friend. He goes to San Diego, where the spouses Richard and Elisabeth Grant live, whom Parmenter suspects are "hibernating" spies, but always ready to get back in the loop. Parmenter approaches the Grant's son, Jeff, but he turns out to be in the dark.
notes: More than the spies, the situations and the actors of this film are faceless. Patinated but soulless, he is saved only thanks to the good performance of the late River Phoenix.

title: Million Dollar Mermaid
actors: Esther Williams, Victor Mature, Walter Pidgeon, Jesse White
description: Annette Kellerman, Australian, is a polio girl: one day she leaves the house and throws herself in the water. This is how he learns to swim and begins to become passionate about what will later be his profession. She wins the first swimming competitions, becomes a prosperous girl, leaves Australia for England: here a show organizer convinces her to take a very long swim in the Thames. The path to success begins for her. The protagonist of the film is the actress-swimmer Esther Williams, star of the first magnitude of the Metro, established for her aquatic choreography (here are a couple of the great Busby Berkeley). It is one of his most solid and least specious films.

title: Ninì Tirabusciò, la donna che inventò la mossa
actors: Monica Vitti, Gastone Moschin, Pierre Clementi, Peppino De Filippo, Carlo Giuffrè
description: Maria Sarti at the beginning of the century tries them all to become a prose actress, until hunger drives her to sing in a Neapolitan cabaret. It was there that he invented the famous hip shot which was then passed down in history as "the move". It follows a trial for obscenities and the transfer to Turin, where Maria knows the loves and subtleties of intellectuals, but then returns to perform with the "move".
notes: Behind the protagonist's personal stories we can see the events of an era, but it is a purely decorative background and the homage to the "popular" show has melancholy results. Monica Vitti star among many famous names of our theater.

title: Revenge of the Ninja
actors: Sho Kosugi, Keith Vitali, Virgil Frye, Arthur Roberts
description: Cho Osaki fled Japan when a furious group of ninjas exterminated his family, except for a grandmother and son. Today he lives in America and makes a living from his Japanese imported doll shop. What he doesn't know is that dolls are the medium for a drug trade organized by his friend Braden. It is the second film in the Ninja series and is played roughly. The only one who is saved is Sho Kosugi, but only in the sequences in which he has to move his hands.

title: La nipote Sabella
actors: Tina Pica, Renato Salvatori, Sylva Koscina, Peppino De Filippo
description: For a strange testamentary question, a land under which an oil field is hidden, will be entitled by right to those who, between two married couples, will first have a daughter who must be given the name of her grandmother. Between the two couples rivalries, deceptions and endless spite break out.
notes: Insipid sequel to "La Nonna Sabella" less sparkling than the progenitor, but still enjoyable in some specks. The script trudges and smiles less.

title: I nipoti di Zorro
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Dean Reed, Agata Flory
description: Ciccio and Franco clandestinely board a ship to reach California and venture out in search of gold. Once they land in Las Palmas, they go to their uncle Diego De La Vega for financial help. Then they are duped by two astute scammers and, in the meantime, create problems for Diego De La Vega's son, the famous Zorro.
notes: Franco and Ciccio insinuate themselves into Zorro's adventures, coloring them with their jokes and specks. Serial product, indistinguishable from others of the couple

title: No grazie, il caffè mi rende nervoso
actors: Lello Arena, Maddalena Crippa, Massimo Troisi, Anna Campori
description: Funicolì Funicolà, a homicidal maniac, threatens to blow up the organization of the First New Naples Festival. A man backed by the police sets his trail on his trail.
notes: For the directorial debut of Lello Arena, Massimo Troisi offers his subject that does not have much to do with his films. Music by James Senese.

title: Rope
actors: James Stewart, Farley Granger, John Dall, Constance Collier, Cedric Hardwicke, Joan Chandler, Douglas Dick, Dick Hogan, Edith Evanson
description: To prove the "perfect murder" theory, Philip and Brandon kill their friend David and hide his body in a chest to get rid of later. In fact, people are about to arrive in the elegant apartment, including relatives and the girlfriend of David himself. The visit takes place in an atmosphere of tension. Brandon makes strange speeches, justifies murder when it comes to eliminating "inferior" people. One of the guests, Rupert Cadell, becomes suspicious ... Hitchcock's masterful directorial performance: very long sequence shots and accurate connections give us the idea of ??a film shot without interruption.

title: Noi donne siamo fatte così
actors: Monica Vitti, Carlo Giuffrè, Enrico Maria Salerno, Ettore Manni
description: A tympanist overestimates herself. A beautician confides in her own pains of love. On her 23rd birth, a woman is interviewed about birth control. A lame violinist cannot break away from her rough companion. A trade unionist "frigated" by the principal. A modern nun plays beat music to the bishop indignant. A war reporter attacks anyone who asks about her health. An acrobat on a motorcycle yields to the offers of an old gentleman. A stewardess terrified of the plane must cheer up the passengers. A blind woman attracts the patrons of a restaurant with her eyes. A mythomaniac on the radio.
