notes: Risi, a director who has had his weight in the Italian comedy. La Vitti, a "diva" of Italian cinema of over twenty years ago. The result, however, more often than not has the consistency of a joke.

title: Le train
actors: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Romy Schneider, Nike Arrighi, Regine, Franco Mazzieri, Maurice Biraud
description: May 1940, the Nazis advance and Julien (Trintignant) flees in front of them, with his family, along with many other Frenchmen. On the train heading south, constantly threatened by air raids that force him to stop for a long time, he meets Anna (Schneider) a German Jew. The two love each other briefly, then he returns to his wife. Three years later, the Gestapo reunites the two former lovers.
notes: From a non-cheesy director like Granier-Deferre it would have been reasonable to expect a deeper look at the characters and the period. The construction is brief and the story superficial.

title: Noi due soli
directors: M. Girolami, V. Metz, M. Marchesi
actors: Walter Chiari, Carlo Campanini, Hélène Remy, Raimondo Vianello
description: Walter (Chiari) and Carlo (Campanini) are close friends. Walter has the problem of finding a home if he wants to marry his Gina (Hélène Remy). He will dream of the destruction of the world, but he will understand that that is not the best solution when his wishes are fulfilled.
notes: They went out of their way to direct "Noi due soli", all specialists in the genre of comedy. Because the movie is just barely cute, but also fragile. Rather slow in the first part, it has a curious "fantastic" development in the second.

title: Noi peccatori
actors: Yvonne Sanson, Steve Barclay, Tamara Lees
description: Back from the war, Stefano meets Lucia and would like to marry her. Stefano finds work, but in a serious accident he loses his sight. Lucia, to help her partner, performs as a singer in a place of dubious fame.
notes: Melodrama with an alleged uplifting purpose in Matarazzo style with really unlikely developments.

title: Noi siamo 2 evasi
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Raimondo Vianello, Magali Noël, Maurizio Arena, Sandra Mondaini
description: Camillo, after breaking off his engagement with his boss's daughter, goes in the company of his friend Bernardo to an ambiguous nightclub. Only that the two are involved in a shady intrigue hatched by the ballerina Odette. After taking the place of two bosses of the mala, Bernardo and Camillo even end up in prison in their stead.
notes: A comedy without consistency, which exploits the success of a comic duo then famous on TV. Naive and at times funny.

title: A Chump at Oxford
actors: Stan Laurel, Oliver Hardy, Wilfred Lucas, Forbes Murray, Frank Baker
description: Laurel and Hardy are sent to study at Oxford. Unaccustomed to academic life, they soon become the target of goliardic jokes.
notes: Late outcome of the couple of comedians, who here find the verve of the best times. The transformation of Laurel into an English aristocrat is hilarious.

title: Noi uomini duri
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Enrico Montesano, Isabel Russinova, Mariangela Melato
description: Mario, a Roman tram driver (Enrico Montesano), and Silvio, a Milanese banker (Renato Pozzetto), make friends in the group of participants in a survival training course. Amidst tests of daring, unusual tricks to learn and scarce food, it's a bad life. But at least there is, for Silvio, the pang for Cora, the wife of a sort of Rambo who wins over the various tests of the course.
notes: Comedy without ideas, with the two actors quite blown out.

title: Noi vivi - Addio Kira!
actors: Alida Valli, Fosco Giachetti, Rossano Brazzi, Annibale Betrone, Elvira Betrone, Emilio Cigoli
description: In post-revolutionary Russia, Kira and her family cannot stand the new Bolshevik regime. What is more, the girl loves an aristocrat who works in hiding and is therefore targeted by the secret police. Kira is arrested then released, meanwhile her lover falls ill with tuberculosis and she accepts the police chief's court to treat him and becomes his lover. Drama with strong colors, in which the propaganda intentions are tempered by a robust staging and by a screenplay (also written by Corrado Alvaro) in which some even wanted to see allusions to fascism.

title: The Sundowners
actors: Deborah Kerr, Robert Mitchum, Peter Ustinov, Glynis Johns
description: Paddy Carmody lives in Australia but is of Irish descent. He carries flocks around the country, along with his wife Ida and son Sean. When the family stops next to a farm for sale, the woman convinces her husband to buy it. At first things go well, but then fate, in the form of the game's demon, pushes them back to choose the wandering life.
notes: Great natural scenery and great actors. A little honeyed, he still had five Oscar nominations.

title: Cia Codename: Alexa
actors: Lorenzo Lamas, Kathlen Kinmont, O. J. Simpson
description: Guest of the United States, diplomat Victor Mahler has taken possession of a super microchip which, once decoded, would allow him to hold the world in his hand. The CIA, to force Mahler's young lover, Alex, to collaborate on the plan to recover the precious object, kidnaps her daughter. Once the mission is complete, the girl must fight to save the child from Mahler's hands, but this time she will have at her side Graver, a counterintelligence agent to whom in the meantime she has linked herself. Cartoon plate hastily packaged for TV. The male protagonist is Lorenzo Lamas, son of Esther Williams and Fernando Lamas.

title: C.I.A. II : Target Alexa
actors: Lorenzo Lamas, Kathleen Kinmont, John Savage
description: A top secret nuclear system owned by the US government has been stolen. CIA agent Mark Graver and former terrorist Alexa, now retired for private life, team up together to track him down. The terrorist Franz Klug, already Alexa's lover, is also contacted for the research. The ranks of the whole matter are in the hands of Straker, a former CIA agent, who would like to sell the nuclear system on the international arms market. The world is in danger, but our heroes are ready to fight for international security. Catatonic entertainment television production; John Savage was also unexpectedly involved in the cast.

title: Non c'è due senza quattro
actors: Bud Spencer, Terence Hill, April Clough, Harold Bergman
description: A former convict on probation, who plays the sax in a jazz band, and a windsurfing stuntman, are both hired to replace two Brazilian cousins ??who have been repeatedly threatened. Punches, blows, exaggerated feats and tumbles as much as I can.
notes: The tried and tested Hill-Spencer couple gives it their all, even if the matter is somewhat obvious. And since we're in Brazil, we get a riotous football stadium scene and some samba, with wild white and chocolate girls.

title: Non c'è pace tra gli ulivi
actors: Raf Vallone, Lucia Bosé, Folco Lulli, Maria Grazia Francia
description: Francesco, a pastor who has just returned from the front, is looking in vain for work. To take revenge for a theft suffered by the local squire, Antonio, enriched during the war with unclean speculations, steals some sheep from him. Arrested and sentenced to four years he manages to escape. Antonio then fled, taking with him Francesco's sister, Maria Grazia, who he forced to become his mistress. But Francesco and the police chase them ....
notes: Social drama directed by Giuseppe De Santis, which mixes social commitment with an "American" taste for action. Music by Goffredo Petrassi.

title: Non chiamarmi Omar
actors: Ornella Muti, Stefania Sandrelli, Gastone Moschin, Gianni Cavina, Barbara D'Urso, Elena Sofia Ricci
description: Based on the tale Nudi e crudi by Carlo Tullio Altan, the film, set in a foggy metropolis, tells the intertwining of various "human cases" around a radio show and the possession of a mysterious briefcase. Chases, murders, surgeries, feminism regurgitation, are the ingredients of the film. Sergio Staino, the father of "Bobo", brought together a cast of "All Star" (so to speak) of Italian cinema for this film. The result is what it is, stretched gags, stale jokes, all seasoned with a feminist intent, where Thelma and Louise should be successful: boredom wins instead.

title: Krotki film o milosci
actors: Grazyna Szapolowska, Olaf Lubaszenko, Stefania Iwinska
description: Young Tomek has taken a tremendous crush on Magda, a more mature neighbor than him. The spy, suffering seeing her meet men, calls her on the phone without having the courage to say a word to her. When he manages to confess his feelings to her, Magda laughs at him and humiliates him. Only after Tomek attempts suicide does Magda take him seriously. The film is the expanded version of the sixth chapter of the Decalogue (which actually refers to the commandment "Do not commit impure acts"), a masterpiece of investigation on bodies and feelings, I look at it and loneliness.

title: Don't Tell Her It's Me
actors: Steve Guttenberg, Shelley Long, Jami Gertz, Mädchen Amick
description: Gus has just recovered from cancer and the treatments have left him bald and disfigured. His sister Lizzie introduces him to a pretty reporter, who politely refuses his advances. Under Lizzie's guidance, Gus tackles diet and sports. He is another person when he returns to the office and this time the beautiful girl is there. But Gus doesn't want to be loved just for his image.
notes: Mowbray had given us a caustic and biting "Royal Lunch" in 1985. With this Hollywood film we are on the side of sentimental comedy, where some touches of black humor are lost in the molasses.

title: Do Not Disturb
actors: Doris Day, Rod Taylor, Hermione Baddeley, Sergio Fantoni
description: American Mike Harper is sent to England in order to increase the sales of the company he works for. Mike learns the unscrupulous business methods in force in Europe; his behavior, however, raises suspicions of infidelity in his wife Janet, who tries to repay her husband with the same coin.
notes: A more than discreet series of brilliant ideas and satirical inventions enlivens a story that, for the rest, is not particularly original. The plot, taken in itself, is thin, and there is no lack of pauses in the narrative rhythm; on the other hand the interpreters, both the principal and the secondary ones, travel at full capacity.

title: Non è mai troppo tardi
actors: Paolo Stoppa, Isa Barzizza, Giorgio De Lullo, Marcello Mastroianni
description: Antonio Trabbi is a selfish and miserly man, whom everyone hates and who is hated by everyone. On Christmas day, after having performed his daily evil deed, he begins to have terrible visions. Among these, himself in sad solitude in the near future. Anguished and determined not to make the premonition a reality, Antonio thinks of changing his life ...
notes: Modest free transposition of "A Christmas Tale" by Charles Dickens, Paolo Stoppa is very good, but who does not hold up the whole film alone. Mastroianni cuts his teeth ...

title: The Great Outdoors
actors: Dan Aykroyd, John Candy, Stephanie Faracy, Annette Bening
description: Chet went on vacation with his wife and the already grown children, but is joined by his brother-in-law Roman, a pain in the ass and a lover of jokes. So the tranquility takes its toll and Chet lives all sorts of adventures in spite of himself, from go-kart racing to racing with wild horses.
notes: Despite the presence of Aykroyd and Candy, little laughs. Blame the gags already seen and magazines and actors who do not seem to believe too much in the story.

title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
actors: Gene Wilder, Richard Pryor, Joan Severance, Anthony Zerbe
description: Dave is a quiet, kind little man, apart from the fact that he's white and deaf. Wally is a short-tempered and outgoing satan, aside from the fact that he's black and blind. The two get along very well, complementing each other. Trouble comes when they accidentally witness a crime and are persecuted by the police who believe them guilty.
notes: The film oscillates between utter banality and zany fun, especially thanks to the witty Wilder and Pryor.

title: Send Me No Flowers
actors: Rock Hudson, Doris Day, Tony Randall, Paul Lynde, Hal March
description: Convinced that he has an incurable disease, George sets out on a search for a man who can then marry his wife Judy. She becomes suspicious and imagines a scenario of betrayal by him. George then tells her everything; despair of Judy, who however later discovers that her husband is an imaginary patient.
notes: Usual comedy, fast and unambitious, by the well-established Day / Hudson duo.

title: Non mi muovo!
actors: Eduardo De Filippo, Peppino De Filippo, Titina De Filippo, Vanna Vanni
description: An evicted auctioneer occupies an empty apartment with his family and two friends, despite the protests of the neighbors and the owner of the house: the latter will get back on it only by marrying the daughter of the abusive tenant. Lively, all played on the performers, film based on the comedy "O quattro 'e maggio" by Diego Petriccione.

title: Say Anything...
actors: John Cusack, Ione Skye, John Mahoney, Lili Taylor, Amy Taylor
description: Diane, daughter of divorced parents, lives with the father she adores. The father also dotes on his daughter. This is why he does not look favorably on his relationship with young Lloyd, a willing boy with little future. Diane decides to leave for London with Lloyd only after a big disappointment.
notes: The film remains on the track of mediocrity. If anything, the novelty lies in the unprecedented father-daughter-boyfriend triangle, photographed (by the great Lazlo Kovacs) and captured by the director through a series of small costume notations. Cusack asserts himself.

title: Non più di uno
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Maddalena Crippa, Giulia Fossà, Giorgio Del Bene
description: Piero, 45, separated and father of two grown children, lives with Roberta, younger than him. The girl unexpectedly becomes pregnant; Piero's first negative reaction provokes a chain of others with a corollary of troubles and sentimental bickering. When Roberta, after losing her baby, asks him to get back together, she places a condition.
notes: Pozzetto tries to renew its image, this time facing a character of greater dramatic depth. The effort is courageous, however, what is wavering is the film's system, unnecessarily cumbersome.

title: Buck and the Preacher
actors: Sidney Poitier, Harry Belafonte, Cameron Mitchell, Denny Miller
description: Two blacks, a preacher and a former Northern soldier, fight a gang of racists nostalgic for slavery. Rather lively, it is Péoitier's debut as a director. Both he and Belafonte are likeable, the film is more comedy than western.

title: You Were Never Lovelier
actors: Fred Astaire, Rita Hayworth, Adolphe Menjou, Xavier Cugat
description: Edoardo Acuna (Menjou), owner of theaters and ballrooms in Buenos Aires, opposes the engagement of his second daughter (Hayworth) to a dancer (Astaire), who, however, cannot get out of the way. A shining Rita Hayworth is paired with that "monster" of skill of Astaire and that fox Adolphe Menjou takes a hit.

title: Non si deve profanare il sonno dei morti
actors: Ray Lovelock, Cristina Galbó, Arthur Kennedy, Aldo Massasso, Giorgio Triestini
description: Two young friends, George and Edna, stop for a few days in Southgate, England, to visit the girl's sister. A series of experiments are being carried out in the area for the elimination of parasites through powerful ultrasound bursts. The results are very satisfying, but the side effects do not betray to be felt: children who turn into ferocious killers, crazed animals, resurrected corpses ... The only one who connects the two events is Steven, but no one wants to believe him ...
notes: Don't disturb nature or the consequences will be disastrous. The message is good, the rest is not.

title: We're No Angels
actors: Robert De Niro, Sean Penn, Demi Moore, James Russo, Wallace Shawn
description: United States, 1935. Ned and Jim escape and attempt to cross over to Canada. In a village near the border they disguise themselves as priests, but are mistaken for two ecclesiastical scholars by the prior of a convent. The two are forced by circumstances to play along and continue in the fiction in cassock. They manage so well to spread good words and exemplary deeds that, in the finale, something like a miracle happens.
notes: Remake of the film of the same name shot in 1955 by Michael Curtiz, the film is far from its original, despite the combination of De Niro and Sean Penn.

title: Non son degno di te
actors: Gianni Morandi, Laura Efrikian, Nino Taranto, Enrico Viarisio
description: Gianni, a singing soldier, is engaged to Carla, daughter of his marshal. The two organize a party inviting all their friends including the rich fellow soldier Giorgio, who soon falls in love with the girl. While Gianni has a first contract with a record company, Giorgio declares himself to Carla and, against her will, manages to snatch a kiss from her. But it so happens that Gianni also attended the meeting from afar.
notes: Plot built with the mimeograph for the most famous couple (at the time) in Italy. On the story of Morandi, who was really doing military service, Fizzarotti ate for several years. For the singer's fans, a nostalgic dip: everyone else refrains.

title: Non stuzzicate la zanzara
actors: Rita Pavone, Giancarlo Giannini, Giulietta Masina, Romolo Valli
description: Rita runs away from home to participate in a song contest. She is opposed by her father, the tyrant of the Colleoni Fortress, the house in which they live. Paolo, the composer who fell in love with her, helps her. When a new escape is in sight (a television broadcast from Sestrière) the situation worsens.
notes: Try to think of young Giancarlo Giannini kissing Rita Pavone under the direction of Lina Wertmüller: a film that borders on the absurd. Among the performers there is also Teddy Reno who plays himself and Gianni Brezza, famous Rai dancer, companion of Loretta Goggi.

title: Non ti conosco più amore
actors: Monica Vitti, Johnny Dorelli, Gigi Proietti
description: Seized by a fit of madness, a lawyer's wife tries to have her husband interned in a psychiatric hospital. Here he mistakes the attending physician for his spouse. The latter is in the game and convinces the lawyer to do the same, for the sake of the madwoman, but, in the end, it turns out that it was only a hoax due to the woman's jealousy towards the secretary of the law firm.
notes: Late epigone of a very large array of films on Italic defects in sentimental matters.

title: Non ti pago!
actors: Eduardo De Filippo, Peppino De Filippo, Titina De Filippo, Paolo Stoppa
description: Don Ferdinando, owner of a lottery bank, has an employee named Procopio Bertolini, who continues to play and win brazenly. When Bertolini gathers a quatern, Don Ferdinando refuses to pay: in fact it was his father in a dream who passed the numbers to Procopio, the wrong recipient! Eduardo, Peppino and Titina De Filippo together in this comedy based on a play by Eduardo and returned to the screen with very effective vitality. However, the staging is a bit subdued.

title: Joy of Sex
actors: Michelle Meyrink, Cameron Dye, Lisa Langlois, Christopher Lloyd
description: What would you do if you found that you only have a few weeks to live by now? Who knows. A girl, the student protagonist of this film, made the tragic discovery, decides to live as intensely as possible, savoring every moment that remains. Where to start if not by discovering the joys of sex? Fun, even if a little macabre, is guaranteed.

title: I Want to Live
actors: Susan Hayward, Simon Oackland, Virginia Vincent
description: Barbara Graham (Susan Hayward) is a young woman whose conduct is anything but exemplary. When she is indicted for a crime she has not committed, public opinion is fiercely hostile to her. And she, in an attempt to save herself, aggravates her position, already very compromised.
notes: Directed by a solidly crafted director and played by a strong-willed actress, the film is a robust indictment.

title: The Ninth Configuration
actors: Stacy Keach, Scott Wilson, Jason Miller, Neville Brand
description: In a castle, used by the army for the mental recovery of veterans from Vietnam, the new doctor Kane arrives. Kane loves Jung, theater and uses psychodramas to heal his patients. Only later is it revealed that, in reality, Kane is also a soldier distraught by the horrors of war, a soldier so ferocious that he deserves the name of "Killer Kane". Blatty, Oscar for the screenplay of The Exorcist, makes his directorial debut with a pretentious film, full of religious symbols, theological arguments and generic banalities. Keach has a decent maniac face and the bar sequence isn't bad, but that's not enough.

title: La nonna Sabella
actors: Tina Pica, Sylva Koscina, Peppino De Filippo, Paolo Stoppa, Dolores Palumbo, Renato Salvatori
description: Raffaele, a Neapolitan student, is suddenly recalled to his native village by the news of a serious illness that has struck his grandmother Sabella. Since Raffaele has been missing for years, it is difficult to recognize people and places, but there is also another reason: the terrible old woman has subjugated the town and everyone does what she wants.
notes: Tailored for Tina Pica, in a rare starring role and flanked by excellent actors.

title: Norma Rae
actors: Sally Field, Ron Leibman, Beau Bridges, Pat Hingle
description: In a spinning mill which is the only source of life in an Alabama village, in the absence of a union the workers are completely at the mercy of their employers. Norma Rae, with an independent character, will manage to create a class consciousness among her work colleagues, but after having had to suffer from all kinds of oppression. A true episode that Ritt recounts with robust effectiveness, obtaining from the performers an acting of exceptional credibility, first of all a sensational Sally Field, who won both the Palme d'Or at Cannes and the Oscar for best actress.

title: Fall for Grace
actors: James Fox, Michael York, Patsy Kensit, Tara Fitzgerald, Richard Anconina, Gary Cole
description: In 1943, the British Intelligence Service set up a plan to mislead Hitler on the location chosen for "D-Day", the Allied landing in France. Sir Henry Ridley, the young American Tom O'Neil and two secret agents, the Anglo-French Catherine Pradier and the French Paul Lemaire are at the center of a story with disturbing moral implications. Is it true that the end justifies the means?
notes: Inspired by the American bestseller Larry Collins, the film has a considerable basis of historical truth, fictionalized but not distorted in the transposition into images. The Indian director (English by adoption) guides the actors to effective acting.

title: Nosferatu, eine Symphonie des Grauens
actors: Max Schreck, Gustav von Vangenheim, Greta Schroeder
description: Hulter, a clerk in a real estate agency, is sent to Count Orlock, also known as Nosferatu, in Transylvania. He leaves his castle in a coffin, aboard a ship loaded with plague-carrying mice, and arrives in the city where Hulter's girlfriend lives, whom he intends to seduce.
notes: The atmosphere of horror is built through the slowness of the gestures and with the continuous variation of the light on the objects. Extraordinary the black presence of the protagonist, Max Schreck, from this film consigned forever to the legend.

title: Nostos - Il ritorno
actors: Luigi Mezzanotte, Franca De Camargo, Alex Carozzo
description: At the end of the war, the wandering hero Nostos begins the journey back home with his companions. Countless events delay the end of the adventure. Eventually, fortunately, Nostos manages to rejoin the family.
notes: An anomalous and unlabable film (like the previous one "The blue planet") by independent filmmaker Franco Piavoli. The mythological references to the figure of Ulysses are evident, but the absolute protagonist is Nature.

title: Notorious
actors: Ingrid Bergman, Cary Grant, Claude Rains, Louis Calhern
description: The daughter of a German spy sentenced to the end of the war, Elena agrees to work with Devlin, an American agent who must investigate the Brazilian activities of a group of escaped Nazis. Elena falls in love with Devlin and is shocked when the man accepts that she marries Sebastian, the leader of the Nazis. A man "sells" his woman for the good of the country; she sacrifices herself to atone for her father's sins. Espionage, psychological drama, love story: a great Hitch, with some masterful scenes and "the longest kiss in the history of cinema."

title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
actors: Charles Laughton, Maureen O'Hara, Edmond O'Brien
description: Esmeralda, a beautiful gypsy persecuted by justice, is saved by appealing to the right of asylum and taking refuge in the cathedral of Notre Dame. Very different men have fallen in love with her: an army captain, a poet and the president of the court. But Esmeralda has only one sincere friend: Quasimodo, the bell ringer of the cathedral, a repulsive but good and faithful man.
notes: For the transposition of the famous novel by Victor Hugo, Dieterle relies on the visionary power of the sets by Van Nest Polglase and the extraordinary talent of Charles Laughton.

title: La notte
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Jeanne Moreau, Monica Vitti, Bernhard Wicki, Rosy Mazzacurati, Maria Pia Luzi
description: The union of the writer Giovanni and his wife Lidia has now come to a standstill. Between boredom, sketchy flirtations and aimless wanderings, the two, sometimes together, sometimes separated, spend a gray day, gripped by their inner malaise. The dawn of the next day, however, surprises them in a fleeting moment of happiness.
notes: Second chapter of the so-called existential trilogy ("L'avventura", 1960 and "L'eclisse", 1962). Dated in themes and humus, the film is saved in the masterly direction of Antonioni, and Jeanne Moreau is in a state of grace. In the sequences of the party we recognize Salvatore Quasimodo, Valentino Bompiani and a very young Umberto Eco.

title: A Night at the Opera
actors: Groucho Marx, Harpo Marx, Chico Marx, Allan Jones, Margaret Dumont
description: Otis B. Driftwood, an eccentric New York theatrical impresario, convinces Madame Claypool to invest a large sum of money in favor of the New York Opera. Sum that will be used to hire the famous tenor Lasspari: in reality it is a machination to exhibit the less famous Baroni.
notes: Among the lines to remember: Groucho explains a long and complicated thing to Claypool (Margaret Dumont, his wife in reality), stops and says "is he following me?" "Sure" "Then stop it or I'll call a guard." And so on. We would all join the club that accepted a Marx as a member!

title: La notte brava
actors: Jean-Claude Brialy, Rosanna Schiaffino, Elsa Martinelli, Laurent Terzieff, Franco Interlenghi, Anna Maria Ferrero, Tomas Milian, Mylène Demongeot, Antonella Lualdi, Maurizio Conti
description: It all happens overnight. Two burgatari, Scintillone and Ruggeretto make a theft and soon after they get their money stolen by two prostitutes. After trying in vain to track down the occasional companions they try to make up for another theft: they try to steal a camera from a car, but the owner intervenes with two friends and ends up in a fight. All together, at the end of the quarrel, they go to celebrate in the villa of the rich man victim of the theft. The two scoundrels still steal: they appropriate two hundred thousand lire.
notes: It is probably Bolognini's best film, with a splendid screenplay by Pasolini playing at home in the Roman villages.

title: First Monday in October
actors: Jill Clayburgh, Walter Matthau, Barnard Hughes, Jan Sterling
description: Ruth Loomis (Clayburgh) is the first female member of the US Supreme Court of Justice. The reception is not the best, in particular from the sarcastic judge Snow (Matthau) who, however, later helps her in the investigation of the multinational Omnitech. In this circumstance Ruth also discovers the guilt of her ex-husband. Based on a hit comedy, the film limps here and there and struggles to get into the right rhythm. A Matthau in his classic role is not enough to save him.

title: Notte d'estate con profilo greco, occhi a mandorla e odore di basilico
actors: Mariangela Melato, Michele Placido, Roberto Herlitzka
description: A Lombard woman-manager has a Sicilian kidnapper kidnapped and held prisoner demanding a dizzying ransom. The man is kept in a very luxurious villa, controlled by a camera. His sexual provocations trigger the woman's cravings, which are satisfied during a good night. After the liberation the parties are reversed. Erotic-grotesque variation on the theme of the victim-executioner relationship, in a top-of-the-range tourist scenographic setting. Of the comedies of Lina Wertmüller it certainly cannot be said that they have ever shone for lightness.

title: Gloria
actors: Gena Rowlands, John Adames, Buck Henry, Julie Carmen
description: Jack Dawn is a mobster who hasn't been able to keep quiet. Before the killers reach his house, he delivers little Phil and a memorial notebook to his neighbor, Gloria. The relationship between the no longer young Gloria and the very young Phil, now left without a family, is rather difficult. Not to mention that the mafia would like to get their hands on the notebook left by Jack. To defend the boy, Gloria becomes a skilled gunslinger and, in the end, she manages to take refuge in the home of Tony, a boss she had been a lover of. But right there the staff of the mafia clan is waiting for her.
notes: With that loser face Buck Henry is a "natural" Jack Dawn. With that tormented villain face, Gena Rowlands has no trouble transforming herself into "ice-eyed woman". After all, the Rowlands / Cassavetes combination has always been a certainty.

title: The Night of the Generals
actors: Peter O'Toole, Omar Sharif, Tom Courtenay, Donald Pleasence
description: During the Nazi occupation of Warsaw, a woman is killed and Major Grau suspects a German general. Rather complicated in its premises and twisted in its psychological definitions, the film does not lack formal merits.

title: Hanussen
actors: Klaus Maria Brandauer, Erland Josephson, Karoly Eperyes
description: Under the pseudonym of Erik Jan Hanussen (Brandauer), a former sergeant in the Austrian army became famous throughout Germany for his clairvoyance skills. Then his career intersects with politics: Hanussen foresees Hitler's next victory in the elections and, despite his resistance, history ends up overwhelming him. It is the third time that we find Brandauer and Szabo together, after Mephisto and Colonel Redl. Too bad the stories are always the same and creative solutions become more and more obvious.

title: The Night of the Following Day
actors: Marlon Brando, Richard Boone, Rita Moreno, Pamela Franklin
description: At the Parisian airport of Orly, a gang of gangsters kidnaps a girl (Franklin), the daughter of a wealthy businessman. Buddy (Brando), his woman Lynn (Moreno), her brother, Wally (Hahn), have to contend with their partner Leer (Boone), a sex maniac ready to cheat on them. A compelling tale, a fast pace and a remarkable Richard Boone.

title: Night of the Big Heat
actors: Christopher Lee, Peter Cushing, Patrick Allen, Jane Merrow
description: Extraterrestrial invaders descend on a British islet causing a heat wave unusual for the area's harsh winter climate, but necessary for them to survive. The film gets lost a bit, after the promising start: too bad because Fisher was the father of the most exquisite brand of British horror, from Frankenstein to Dracula.

title: Moon of the Wolf
actors: David Janssen, Barbara Rush, Bradford Dillman
description: Aaron Whitaker (David Janssen), a marshland sheriff in Louisiana, investigates a series of savage assassins. The policeman begins the search believing he is dealing with a ruthless serial killer, but soon unequivocal clues convince him that he is on the trail of a werewolf. Could it be true, or is it a ruse to mislead the investigation? This TV product lacks action and suspense. The subject is based on a novel by Leslie Whitten.

title: The Eagle Has Landed
actors: Michael Caine, Donald Sutherland, Robert Duvall, Jenny Agutter, Donald Pleasence
description: Having freed Mussolini from the Gran Sasso, Hitler sets out an even more ambitious project: to kill British Prime Minister Winston Churchill. Some men are selected for the feat and parachuted to England. Discovered, they are decimated and the survivors disperse, but one of them still tries to find the politician.
notes: Inspired by a Jack Higgins bestseller, the film holds up thanks to a tight narrative, and well-drawn characters.

title: The Night of the Iguana
actors: Richard Burton, Deborah Kerr, Ava Gardner, Sue Lyon
description: Forced to leave the parish for unworthy behavior, a priest starts working as a tour guide. While driving through Mexico a group of teachers is coveted by Carlotta a very young girl who is part of the group. Miss Fellowes, one of the teachers, watches over her and shows an ambiguous attachment to her protégé.
notes: Tennessee Williams in the cinema is heavy as a truck, but Huston manages to ease the pressure. Gabriel Figueroa's stunning photography and Gardner's skill do the rest. Oscar for costumes.

title: La noche de los lapiles
actors: Alejo Garcia Pintos, Vita Escardo, Pablo Novarro, Pablo Machado
description: In Argentina, in 1975, some students from La Plata who had participated in a protest disappeared in military prisons, where they were tortured for months. A bit rough from a cinematographic point of view, the film evokes in a realistic, but at times insistent, way, with the tragedy of the disappeared and the techniques of repression and extermination.

title: La notte di San Lorenzo
actors: Omero Antonutti, Margarita Lozano, Claudio Bigagli, Dario Cantarelli, Massimo Bonetti, Norma Martelli, Enrica Maria Modugno, Sabina Vannucchi, Dario Cantarelli, Paolo Hendel, Antonio Prester, Laura Mannucchi, Rinaldo Mirannalti
description: The night of San Lorenzo is that of August 10, when the stars fall and wishes are expressed. The story unfolds around this day and the facts narrated really happened: the authors themselves were protagonists in childhood. We are in 1944, and the Tuscan town of San Miniato is occupied by the Germans in the mood for reprisals; a group of peasants sets out to escape the encirclement. Despite the atrocity of the war, the story is seen with the dreamy eyes of children, while the landscapes of the Tuscan countryside are of fundamental importance in the articulation of the story. The film won many awards, including the Grand Jury Prize at Cannes.

title: Night Shadow
actors: Brenda Vance, Dane Chan, Tom Boylan
description: Alex returns to Danford after years of absence and immediately a series of assassinations shock the town. As the terror grows uncontrollable, the girl becomes convinced that an evil power has thrown her a personal challenge; he will face her together with his friends until he defeats her. Improbable and amateurish.

title: Pursued
actors: Robert Mitchum, Teresa Wright, Judith Anderson, Dean Jagger, Alan Hale, John Rodney
description: In the feud with the Callums, only little Jed of the Rand family remains alive. Having become a man, he suffers from inexplicable nightmares and an obsession that devours him: knowing once and for all the truth about his origins. To free himself from his ghosts, he will have to go through revenge ...
notes: Western with noir atmospheres - indeed, almost "gothic" - and a marked psychoanalytic background. The hand of the great Walsh builds a little jewel of suspense, with the contribution (as well as the perfect performance by Mitchum) of the tight script by Niven Busch, the music of Max Steiner and the splendid black and white of the great James Wong Howe.

title: Love Happy
actors: I Fratelli Marx, Marilyn Monroe, Raymond Burr
description: Detective Lince must retrieve a precious necklace that belonged to the Tsars, but Madame Prudovich uses all her arts, financial and seductive, to get hold of it before him. Artistically already separated, Chico, Harpo and Groucho Marx find themselves for the last time in the same film which is also notable for an appearance by Marilyn Monroe, very young and breathtaking.

title: Un flic
actors: Alain Delon, Richard Crenna, Catherine Deneuve, Riccardo Cucciolla, Simone Valère, Paul Crauchet, Michael Conrad
description: Commissioner Coleman investigates a bank robbery. From an informant, he learns that the theft is actually for a bigger blow: robbing a drug dealer. Besieged the gang, Coleman kills Simon, the leader, under the eyes of Cathy, the woman to whom they were both related.
notes: Melville's latest film, one more "recherche" through the investigation of a disillusioned cop. The films of the master of noir do not tell situations but psychologies, and this is no exception. Extraordinary moments, respectful looks between cops and thieves, the tragic impending fate of destiny. Riccardo Cucciolla's great performance is worth noting.

title: Le notti di Cabiria
actors: Giulietta Masina, Franca Marzi, François Périer, Amedeo Nazzari
description: Cabiria (Masina) is a prostitute who has achieved a certain well-being and who, despite the life she leads, retains a fund of goodness and candor, so much so that she is still in search of true love. But hers is a ruthless world: a man seems sincerely in love with her and intending to marry her, but, during a trip to Lake Bracciano, he manifests his true intentions. Cabiria, however, is in the end still available to reconcile with life.
notes: The final film of an ideal "Catholic" trilogy together with "La strada" and "Il bidone". Cabiria's character is treated with compassion but with a very cruel gaze (even on the world of cinema). Pier Paolo Pasolini also collaborated on the film. Oscar for best foreign film.

title: Le notti di Lucrezia Borgia
actors: Belinda Lee, Jacques Sernas
description: In the service of Cesare Borgia and coveted by Lucrezia, the brave Federico degli Alberici falls in love with Diana D'Alba and joins her in the rebellion against tyrants. Pseudo-historic mess directed by a prolific craftsman.

title: Nine And Half Weeks
actors: Mickey Rourke, Kim Basinger, Christine Baranski
description: John (Mickey Rourke) is a young and rampant financial trader. Elizabeth (Basinger) is a blonde and perturbing gallery owner. The fatal encounter takes place in any room, on any day. After nine and a half weeks, Elizabeth ends the relationship just as John is about to fall in love with her. Lyne, skilfully making use of his experience as an advertising director, realizes a luxurious two-hour spot, caresses the persuasive impulses and fantasies of the spectators, exhibits a subtle play of references with the exhibition of glossy corporeality and signals of wealth . Curviline and vitaminic Kim Basinger, famous the striptease on "You Can Leave your Hat On".

title: Nozze di sangue
actors: Luisa Ferida, Fosco Giachetti, Nino Pavese, Umberto Spadaro
description: The young Immaculate Conception embarks on a steamship to reach her husband Gidda she had married by prosecutor. Once at the destination she is welcomed by Pietro Acerroimo enemy of Gidda who, pretending to be her husband, abuses her. Gidda no longer wants to know about his wife until, after his sacrifice that saves his life, he understands how unjust he was. Quite strong -colored drama, this of Alexandrini, where passion and hatred duel to the last blood. Precipitated in the dark and heavy atmosphere of an imaginary country with vaguely Latin American traits that gives the affair a touch of morbid exoticism.

title: Nothing Sacred
actors: Carole Lombard, Fredric March, Charles Winninger, Walter Connolly
description: Young Hazell Flagg was mistakenly diagnosed with an incurable disease. A reporter has her transported to New York at the newspaper's expense to pass her last days of carefree life. The girl accepts the tempting offer. But when the truth is about to come out, the mechanism put in place can no longer be stopped: public opinion, moved by the case, will attend a fake funeral: the girl is on her honeymoon with the journalist. , directed by the solid Wellman, and played by Carol Lombard, is a film with a perfect and fast pace, dominated by a sometimes ferocious comedy.

title: Mountain Family Robinson
actors: Robert Logan, Susan Damante-Shaw, Heather Rattray, Ham Larsen
description: The Robinson family, husband, wife and two children, have left Los Angeles. The stress and pollution of the big city, added to their daughter's breathing difficulties, cause the Robinsons to decide to move to a cottage in Oregon. But now that the girl is healed, the regret of the comfort of city life almost returns.
notes: Third and feeble episode of the Robinson saga which began in 1976 with "The Great Adventure" by Stewart Raffill. The starting point is always the same and even the characters do not change that much.

title: I nuovi barbari
actors: Giancarlo Prete, Luigi Montefiori, Fred Williamson, Anna Kanakis
description: In the year 2019 the great nuclear war is over and the survivors are fighting each other on a polluted and doomed planet. Powerful is the band of Templars led by leader One against which Skorpion fights, helped by other strange characters. The model is Mad Max, the completely self-sufficient realization. And it shows.

title: Nuovo Cinema Paradiso
actors: Philippe Noiret, Salvatore Cascio, Jacques Perrin, Leopoldo Trieste, Marco Leonardi, Agnese Nano
description: We are in the immediate postwar period in Giancaldo, a town in Sicily. Little Salvatore is introduced to the mysteries of cinema by the projectionist Alfredo and replaces him after Alfredo is blinded in a fire. To the passion for cinema is added the thwarted love for Elena. After his military service, Salvatore stops in Rome, where he manages to enter the world of cinema. He will return to the town for Alfredo's funeral; he will find everything different and a gift from his old friend.
notes: The story of the film was contrasted, from its first release in a longer version, which had not worked either with the public or with critics, to the second revised and corrected version, awarded first in Cannes (Jury Prize) and then with Oscar for best foreign film. It is actually an effective interweaving of cinematic subtleties and good feelings, with some frankly compelling scenes.

title: 'O Re
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Ornella Muti, Carlo Croccolo, Corrado Pani
description: With the conquest by Garibaldi of the Kingdom of the two Sicilies, Francesco II was expelled from Naples. After sheltering in exile in Rome with his wife Maria Sofia, he falls into a dark apathy from which nothing seems to move him: neither her insistence on having a child, nor General Coviello's plans for the reconquest of the throne. Financial difficulties also arise and in the end a daughter arrives, but she dies immediately. Meanwhile, Coviello dreams of returning to Naples, but ...
notes: Small screen breath and beat for a historical fresco that was wanted to be ironic but ends up being dusty. Giannini gets along in the role of Franceschiello.

title: Brass Target
actors: John Cassavetes, Sophia Loren, George Kennedy, Max Von Sydow, Robert Vaughn
description: At the end of the Second World War a train is robbed which is carrying, by order of General Patton, a large quantity of gold bars. Colonel Rogers is given the assignment to investigate. In reality, he is the brain of the coup and De Lucca, an officer secretly assigned by Patton to conduct a parallel investigation into the incident, has his work cut out to unmask him.
notes: Cast of strong appeal, fast pace, directing by profession, for a thriller that, apart from the unusual post-war setting, does not go an inch off the rails of the genre.

title: Objective Burma
actors: Errol Flynn, John Brown, George Tobias, John Alvin
description: Captain Nelson's paratrooper company destroys a Japanese radar station in Burma, but huge problems arise when US soldiers are supposed to be recovered. Several times the Japanese operate in a way that makes action impossible, the company's radio is destroyed and the Americans are completely isolated. All hope seems lost ...
notes: A typical film of exaltation of a "war to be won", it is made with an effective backbone and with adequate spectacle. Errol Flynn, as a shining hero, is compelling and the whole narrative finds accents of epic robustness.

title: Neskol' ko dnej iz zizni I.I. Oblomova
actors: Oleg Tabakov, Elena Solovej, Andrei Popov, Yury Bogatyrev
description: Oblomov is an aristocratic landowner who is bored with the world and prefers to sleep and take refuge in his dreams. He gave up his career, to clash with the narrow-mindedness of social life, and not even the love for the beautiful Olga will be able to tear him away from his choice. Beautiful film by Michalkov, from the novel by Goncarov: vast landscapes, accurate reconstruction of the environment, inspired adhesion to the character.

title: The Sea Wolves: The Last Charge of the Calcutta Light Horse
actors: Gregory Peck, Roger Moore, David Niven, Trevor Howard
description: In 1944 a mysterious German submarine sinks, one after the other and without fail, all the merchant ships that pass through the Indian Ocean. The allied commando discovers that the submarine is warned of the presence of its "prey" by some spies based on a disarmed merchant ship anchored in the neutral port of Goa. The British counter-intelligence thus organizes a team of volunteers to destroy the ship.
notes: The mere presence of Roger Moore and director Andrew V. McLaglen justify the title stuck by the Italian distribution. But "the wild goose" was something else and has nothing to do with this film.

title: Fugitive Among Us
actors: Peter Strauss, Eric Roberts, Elizabeth Peña, Lauren Holly, Salvator Xuereb
description: Officer Cole was abandoned by his wife and put on trial for beating up a criminal in questioning. The man, convicted of violence and murder, has in the meantime escaped and wants to track down the agent. Cole returns to his trail, and this time the case becomes an opportunity for personal redemption for him. American television production; the subject is taken from a book by Mike Cochran. Harper the criminal is Eric Roberts, brother of the famous Julia and a good actor, who has never found a role that can really cast him.

title: Carrie
actors: Laurence Olivier, Jennifer Jones, Eddie Albert, Miriam Hopkins
description: Carrie, a poor provincial girl (Jones), and George, a restaurant manager (Olivier), run away with the boss's money. But the police are on their trail. Wyler explores the souls of the two lovers with intelligence and pathos, transforming Dreiser's crude novel "Our Sister Carrie" into a melodrama, a vehicle for two high-class actors.

title: Occhi dalle stelle
actors: Nathalie Delon, Robert Hoffman, Martin Balsam, Sherry Buchanan
description: A photographer and his model are sucked into a flying saucer. A journalist who is in possession of the photographs becomes suspicious and begins to investigate, but runs into an organization called the "Silence Group" and ends badly.
notes: The fact that the model is Sherry Buchanan is the only interesting note in the film, directed under a pseudonym by Mario Gariazzo.

title: Wait Until Dark
actors: Audrey Hepburn, Alan Arkin, Richard Crenna
description: Susy is blind. She finds herself at the mercy of three criminals who are looking for a drug-stuffed doll, which she and her husband have accidentally come into possession of. The most ruthless of the three, after killing his accomplices, remains face to face with the woman, who however, cunningly, eliminates all sources of light in the house. A hunt in the dark begins ...
notes: Terence Young is the cinematic "father" of Agent 007, whose first three films he directed. Here we are in the realm of pure thriller, with frail Hepburn as a more tough-than-expected victim. Suspense is skillfully maneuvered.

title: Eyes of a Stranger
actors: Lauren Tewes, Jennifer Jason Leigh, John DiSanti
description: A psychopath is roaming around Miami. A journalist senses that the maniac could be her neighbor: sneaks into her home and into her life. Thus enters a dangerous game for both her and her handicapped sister threatened by the madman.

title: Gli occhi, la bocca
actors: Lou Castel, Angela Molina, Emmanuelle Riva, Michel Piccoli
description: Having fled from the oppressive bourgeois family when he was twenty, Giovanni comes back to deal with it for real, fifteen years later, on the occasion of the funeral of his brother Giuseppe, who committed suicide. Giovanni's efforts to adapt to the bourgeois reality of his family are inexorably frustrated by Wanda, the indirect girl guilty of Giuseppe's death, who is rejected in love.
notes: In his typical anti-naturalistic cinematographic language, Bellocchio once again investigates the unconscious and the bourgeoisie. The character of Wanda, refractory to all rules, is the classic "uncanny" destined to blow the lid of repression.

title: Gli occhiali d'oro
actors: Philippe Noiret, Rupert Everett, Valeria Golino, Stefania Sandrelli
description: In Ferrara, in 1938, Davide Lattes (Everett) is a Jewish university student in love with Nora (Golino). But she, sensing the wind of mounting racism, decides to get safe and marries a powerful hierarch. At the same time, Davide witnesses another story of marginalization, because the protagonist he becomes friends with, the mature doctor Athos Fadigati (Noiret), is homosexual.
notes: Bassani's novel from which the film is based is a masterpiece of refinement. Giuliano Montaldo, although showing good will, fits in a shy and flat way. Excellent cast, especially Noiret.

title: Occhio alla penna
actors: Bud Spencer, Amidou, Joe Bugner, Piero Trombetta, Renato Scarpa
description: We only know about him that he has an insatiable hunger and that he arrived in Yucca City with the Indian Girolamo whom he rescued from prison after a horse theft. Mistaken for a doctor, the stranger, whom everyone now calls Doc, decides to stop, as here he finally manages to quench his hunger. But such willingness of citizens has a downside: the country is under the threat of a gang of criminals led by Colorado Slim. And the sheriff is, at the very least, an inept.
notes: Western comedy is not without a certain verve. Almost a Spencer's response to Hill's solo in "A genius, two buddies and a chicken".

title: Occhio alla perestrojka
actors: Ezio Greggio, Jerry Calà, Rodolfo Laganà, Marina Kalinina
description: Three employees of a company in Crema are sent to Bulgaria for a commercial mission. The three take advantage of the trip to form a relationship with three beautiful local girls. Shortly after, the fall of the Berlin wall and the consequent liberalization of the former communist bloc pushed the three girls to come to Italy to ask for an account of the promises received.
notes: Comic instant-movie and the first Italian film in which we talk about the new European political situation. Discounted jokes of television matrix.

title: The Last Sunset
actors: Kirk Douglas, Rock Hudson, Dorothy Malone, Joseph Cotten
description: Mexico: Stribling, a Texas county sheriff, is on the trail of the bandit O'Malley. Both captain on the Beckinridge farm, whose wife Mary had been O'Malley's own fiancée as a young girl. The woman has a sixteen-year-old daughter, Melissa. The two men accept the host's offer to help bring a herd of cattle from Mexico to Texas.
notes: Dalton Trumbo's screenplay slips too often into literary existentialism, yet Aldrich's iron class is there, and it shows. Highlight when Joseph Cotten dies. Produced by Kirk Douglas.

title: Peeping Tom
actors: Karlheinz Böhm, Anna Massey, Moira Shearer, Esmond Knight, Maxine Audley, Brenda Bruce, Miles Malleson, Michael Goodliffe, Martin Miller, Jack Watson, Shirley Ann Field, Pamela Green
description: Cameraman Mark Lewis kills a series of girls with a strange camera-mounted weapon. The ritual requires that the victims see themselves in the mirror the moment they die. The reasons for his perversion can be traced back to his childhood, upset by the sadistic habits of his father who used him as a guinea pig for psychological experiments. This by Powell is an infinite masterpiece that focuses on the mechanics of vision, cinematic voyeurism, common morality, the art (between death and absolute) of looking. To see and marvel at.

title: Occhio malocchio prezzemolo e finocchio
actors: Johnny Dorelli, Lino Banfi, Janet Agren, Mario Scaccia, Paola Borboni, Adriana Russo
description: The hair of disgrace is the title of the first episode in which it tells of a jinx who will lose his powers if a certain hair is uprooted. In the second episode "The Wizard", a charlatan acquires true magical powers from an old witch, but on the day of the challenge with Silvan, the witch dies.
notes: The Italian comedy tries to do it in two to recover some credibility but, apart from a few flashes of clarity, a couple of jokes and a few actor cameos (Mario Scaccia, Paola Borboni) we are always on the side of farce.

title: Blood Alley
actors: John Wayne, Lauren Bacall, Anita Ekberg, Paul Fix, Joy Kim
description: The population of a Chinese village, tired of the tyrannical regime of the Communist government, decides to emigrate en masse to Hong Kong. In the risky undertaking, the exodus population is helped by an American captain, a former prisoner, who guides the ferry overloaded with people between the dangers of the sea and ... of the coast guard.
notes: Typical cold war movie. But even in 1955 it was known that the British mandate over the Asian colony was "over".

title: Oci Ciornie
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Silvana Mangano, Marthe Keller, Elena Sofonova
description: We are at the beginning of the century. Romano meets at the spa of Montecatini a young Russian lady whom he falls in love with. He is married to Elisa, a rich and energetic woman who allows him to live in comfort. The meeting with the Russian lady seems to change the life of Romano who follows her to Russia and promises her eternal love, reserving the right to return for her.
notes: From a short story by Chekhov, the film takes on an autonomous narrative development at the hands of Michalkov and Mastroianni. The result is loose, lively, full of a healthy pleasure of the story and the show.

title: Odette
actors: Anna Neagle, Trevor Howard, Peter Ustinov, Marius Goring
description: Odette is a quiet town of His British Majesty who during the last conflict agrees to infiltrate France as a spy of the Allied Command. Her husband accompanies her to her dangerous mission: together they fight in clandestinity against the Germans, they end up in two different concentration camps but at the end of the war they manage to reunite. The structure is typical of the espionage films, with the exhibited contrast between the very feminine personality of the actress Anna Neagle and the war tasks to which it is called.

title: Crossfire
actors: Robert Young, Robert Ryan, Robert Mitchum, Gloria Graham
description: A group of veterans, including an authoritarian sergeant and a Jewish soldier, are in the latter's apartment. Under unclear circumstances, the landlord is killed and the crime is attributed to a soldier who had in the meantime gone away. Then another witness dies and at that point the captain in charge of the investigation realizes that racism is the motive for the crime.
notes: From a novel by future director Richard Brooks. The pace is that of black films, but Dmytryk takes the opportunity to point the finger at anti-Semitism, thus building his fame as a left-wing director. Then, during the witch hunt, he will abjure before the commission of Senator McCarthy.

title: Odio mortale
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, Danielle De Metz, Renato Baldini, Ignazio Balsamo
description: With a handful of brave, the French captain Lebouff gives no respite to his compatriot Dominique who has sold himself to the Spaniards to become governor of Fort Carolina, Florida. Bolso exotic adventurous show sewn on the mature and "cast" Amedeo Nazzari.

title: The Search
actors: Montgomery Clift, Aline MacMahon, Ivan Jandl, Wendell Corey
description: Carel was freed, along with other survivors, from the Auschwitz concentration camp. Terrified and dazed, the child can no longer speak. He escapes with a small French companion, but the latter drowns. The child is then taken back, entrusted to the care of an officer and then taken to a refugee camp, where the miracle occurs. Film of great civil commitment, moving condemnation of the war and its most atrocious crimes, focusing above all on the consequences paid by the little ones. Zinnemann returns, after The Seventh Cross, to tell us about the concentration camps and the devastation they produced. Intense interpretation of Montgomery Clift.

title: Oggi a me... domani a te!
actors: Montgomery Ford, Bud Spencer, Wayde Preston, Jeff Cameron, Victoriano Gazzara, Tatsuya Nakadai, William Berger
description: Finished in prison unjustly, Bill Kowa, upon leaving, brutally takes revenge on James Elfego, the man who had framed him and killed his wife. The man hires four gunslingers to take out James who, in the meantime, has become the leader of a band of ferocious outlaws. Instead of facing his rival in his lair, Bill forces James to follow him to lure him into a trap.
notes: Sort of remake of "The Magnificent Seven". The screenplay is also signed by Dario Argento. With this film Tonino Cervi passes from production to directing.

title: Oggi domani dopodomani
directors: Marco Ferreri, Eduardo De Filippo, Luciano Salce
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Virna Lisi, Catherine Spaak, Luciano Salce, Pamela Tiffin, Marco Ferreri, Lelio Luttazzi, Ugo Tognazzi, Raimondo Vianello, Enzo La Torre
description: The young industrialist has everything a man can have, but he gets lost through an obsession: to what extent is it possible to inflate a balloon? In an apartment building, it is the firearms that solve the difficult relationships between the various couples. Finally, a clerk tries to sell his spendthrift wife to a sheikh, but the Emir's tastes aren't exactly traditional.
notes: Three grotesque episodes that photograph crises and situations on the eve of 1968. The best story is that of Ferreri with Mastroianni, that is, the first episode ("The man with 5 balloons"); it was supposed to be a feature film, but was massacred by the producer who had it reduced to just over half an hour. Decades later, it came out with the title "Break Up".

title: The War Between Men and Women
actors: Jack Lemmon, Barbara Harris, Jason Robards
description: Peter Wilson is a cartoonist who has made misogyny his second profession. But one day he meets (or rather collides) with Mrs. Terry Kozlenko: courtship and marriage follow suit. Peter thus becomes the father of three children that Terry had from a previous marriage.
notes: Light comedy but which, at a certain point, does not hesitate to field even more dramatic problems such as the Vietnam War or birth control.

title: Ogni giorno è domenica
actors: Giuliana Pinelli, Renato Bossi, Roberto Bruni, Erminio Spalla
description: During the war, a girl falls in love with a soldier who, after being wounded, undergoes the amputation of a leg. Having no more news from him, she has meanwhile accepted the court of a mature colleague, but then she finds the man she loves and accepts him as he is. Rare example of "cinema of Salò". The bitter atmosphere and the rough portrait of Venice are striking.

title: Ognuno per sé
actors: Van Heflin, Gilbert Roland, Klaus Kinski, George Hilton, Sarah Ross
description: Sam Cooper, a gold digger, manages to discover a gold-bearing vein. Unable to take all the gold with him, he sends for his godson for help. But he joins him along with a strange individual who seems to dominate his will and Cooper, while not trusting the newcomer, is forced to accept him in the expedition. The trio is soon joined by another man, an old friend of Sam's. The four reach the mine and after a hard work to recover the gold, they return to the village. But on the return trip, the group has to deal with several issues of conflict.
notes: Giorgio Capitani throws himself into a dignified but pure imitation American-style action.

title: Ogro
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, José Sacristan, Eusebio Poncela, Angela Molina
description: In 1973 a group of Basque terrorists decide to kidnap the vice president of the council ...
notes: The film is inspired by a historical episode and is shot with a flashback structure that enhances suspense. The allusions to Italian political life, while evident, remain relegated to the background.

title: Oh Serafina!
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Dalila Di Lazzaro, Lilla Brignone, Angelica Ippolito
description: Augusto Valle is a tender, vanished and somewhat ecologist industrialist. Out of love he marries one of his workers who accepted the proposal out of interest and who soon has him interned in a mental hospital. To this end, he also seduces the mayor who endorses the operation. In the asylum, however, Augusto is not at all bad, quite the contrary! Right here he finally finds his soul mate.
notes: Drawn, very loosely, from the novel of the same name by Giuseppe Berto, the film, scripted by Lattuada, Berto and Enrico Vanzina, slips into a kind of grotesque mess. Pozzetto, however, is well placed in the role.

title: Old Gringo
actors: Gregory Peck, Jane Fonda, Jimmy Smits, Patricio Contreras
description: Harriet Winslow, a spinster teacher, leaves for Mexico and finds herself involved in the Pancho Villa revolution. At first intimidated, then excited by the events, she meets an old American whom everyone calls Old Gringo (Gregory Peck). Arroyo, one of the revolutionaries, falls in love with her and kills the old man who is actually the writer Ambrose Bierce. Harriet returns to America with the novelist's body.
notes: After the excellent performance of "The official story", the Argentine Puenzo tries the path of the historical-epic fresco, but with poor results. The film remains flat in its staging, unrealistic in its intentions and literary in its characters.

title: Le olimpiadi dei mariti
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Raimondo Vianello, Delia Scala, Sandra Mondaini
description: Two journalists left alone in the city attempt a gallant adventure with some German girls, in Rome for the Olympics. At the best, however, the wives return home and from there a geometric series of lies is triggered with a final bang.
notes: Glorious 60s, when the Tognazzi-Vianello couple still raged on the small and big screen. The comic duo made sparks. For the rest, the film by the specialist Bianchi is a decent, unpretentious comedy, well supported by the whole cast.

title: Oliver Twist
actors: Richard Charles, George C. Scott, Tim Curry, Michael Horden
description: Modest TV adaptation of Dickens' masterpiece, by a vintage 1960s director ("Hello Pussycat").

title: The Outrage
actors: Paul Newman, Laurence Harvey, Claire Bloom, Edward G. Robinson
description: Accused of killing a man and raping his wife, Juan Carrasco is sentenced to death. He says it was a regular duel. Some support the suicide thesis, others blame (at least morally) the wickedness of the wife and the wife finally contradicts everyone by accusing herself of the murder. Too many versions for a single crime cause despair over the possibility of finding the truth. Martin Ritt puts the subject of "Rashomon", a famous film by Akira Kurosawa, into a western. The transposition fails completely and smells a little academy. However, the actors are splendid: from Paul Newman to Edward G. Robinson.

title: Interrupted Melody
actors: Glenn Ford, Eleanor Parker, Roger Moore
description: Biography of an Australian opera singer who was blocked her way to artistic consecration by polio. Thanks to her husband's loving care, and his patience, the singer was able to recover from the disease, overcame the trauma and returned to the scene.
notes: The writers of "Beyond Destiny", Sonya Levien and William Ludwing, won the Oscar. But the film is overly sentimental and predictable, and despite the good cast it never really gets off the ground.

title: Being There
actors: Peter Sellers, Shirley MacLaine, Melvin Douglas, Jack Warden
description: Chance has always lived with the man who welcomed him as a child: he is good, he only knows about gardening and he knows the rest only through TV. When his benefactor dies and the heirs throw him on the street, he is welcomed into the house. of a very rich financier, advisor to the President. His phrases about gardening are believed to be profound metaphors, and here he is at the center of economic-political attention.
notes: Sellers' penultimate film is a fable of subtle ambiguity, centered around a pure hearted in a hostile world. An angel who does not know evil and who walks on water. From a novel by Jerzy Kozinski.

title: Oltre la porta
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Eleonora Giorgi, Tom Berenger
description: Nina (Giorgi), Italian, lives in Morocco; his stepfather Enrico (Matroianni) is in prison accused of killing his wife; Matthew (Berenger) will marry Nina, but will be planted by his wife for the now old and lifeless Enrico. They are the characters of an intricate story which, despite the ambition to present a dramatic picture of moral degradation, has the scarce and fragile actual consistency of a cartoon. It happens when Cavani embarks on undertakings beyond her means, as if to claim a misunderstood superiority of being a female director. If you then rely on Eleonora Giorgi ...

title: Powwow Highway
actors: Gary Farmer, A Martinez, Amanda Wyss
description: A stately and gentle Cheyenne, who travels in his battered Buick to New Mexico for health reasons, gives an old friend a lift. He is an activist of the Indian Movement. The trip will be the right opportunity to cement that friendship, finding the roots of the culture that unites them even in the small things, even in the different life choices.
notes: The film talks about the miserable situation of the Indian community in the reservations, from poor working conditions, to the breakdown of traditional culture in the face of the pressure of contemporary American "values". A good film, serious but with a light and engaging touch.

title: Cat Chaser
actors: Peter Weller, Kelly McGillis, Charles Durning, Tomas Milian, Frederic Forrest
description: George, a Miami hotelier, goes to Santo Domingo to track down a young guerrilla who saved his life; instead he finds himself in the midst of the shady dealings of General De Boya, whose wife Mary was a flame of George himself. There is a lot of money involved that everyone would like for themselves. It doesn't take long between Mary and George for the understanding to be reborn. Old and new names in and around Hollywood for this action adventure signed by a still little known Ferrara.

title: A Breath of Scandal
actors: Sophia Loren, Maurice Chevalier, John Gavin, Tullio Carminati
description: Princess Olympia is young, widowed and above all of an independent character: too much for the rigid court costumes of early 19th century Vienna. Temporarily removed from the emperor as punishment, she obtains forgiveness on the condition of marrying Prince Ruprecht, ruler of a neighboring state. But Olympia, in her golden "exile", met a young American chemist and has completely different projects. Princess Lina, secretly in love with Ruprecht himself, helps her make them. Taken from a play by Ferenc Molnar, the film focuses on the opulence of costumes and sets.

title: Murder, My Sweet!
actors: Dick Powell, Claire Trevor, Anne Shirley, Otto Kruger, Mike Mazurki
description: Hired by Malloy, a giant ex-con who is looking for his girlfriend Velma, Marlowe ends up in a real nest of vipers. Velma has changed her name and married an important man, but is blackmailed by a certain Marriott, who in turn turns to Marlowe to track down a missing necklace.
notes: A classic noir, cleaned of all frills, which does not miss a beat in the complex comings and goings of the intrigue. Much admired by Chandler himself, author of the novel from which it is based, he brought the character of Marlowe to the screen for the first time.

title: The Shadow Riders
actors: Tom Selleck, Sam Elliott, Ben Johnson, Geoffrey Lewis, Jeff Osterhage
description: Returning from the Secession war, fought on opposite sides, two brothers discover that their family has been kidnapped; thus they set out on the trail of relatives. TV meatloaf based on a novel by Louis L'Amour. The director, son of actor Victor McLagen, a favorite of John Ford, makes use of two other "Fordians" such as Harry Carey jr. and Ben Johnson.

title: The Letter
actors: Bette Davis, Herbert Marshall, James Stephenson, Frieda Inescort
description: Robert and Leslie live on a large rubber plantation near Singapore. Robert is often absent and the union between the two is not exactly happy. Then, one day, the woman kills Hammond, a young Englishman who lives in the area. When questioned by the police, Leslie claims she acted in self-defense while trying to protect herself from sexual assault. But the man's widow is in possession of a letter which proves with full evidence that the two had been lovers for some time.
notes: From a story by Somerset Maugha, perhaps the masterpiece of the Wyler / Davis duo: a morbid and passionate melodrama, of great psychological finesse and with a tropical nightmare atmosphere.

title: Stagecoach
actors: John Wayne, Claire Trevor, John Carradine, Thomas Mitchell
description: A stagecoach leaves from Tonto to Lordsburg. On board are a prostitute, the pregnant wife of a military man, a cheater, a swindler and an alcoholic doctor. The gunfighter Ringo joins the street. But along the way, under the attacks of the Indians, this humanity of sinners will find redemption. The officer's wife gives birth thanks to the doctor, and Ringo faces a decisive shooting with the Plummer brothers. The founding film of the modern western, and one of the classics in the history of cinema. An action film with characters that have the mythical, and a film already full of Ford's religious symbolism. Dudley Nichols' screenplay is vaguely inspired by Maupassant's "Boule de suif" (in the character of the prostitute). It was the film that John Wayne launched: his entry on the scene, with the saddle over the shoulder, is royal.

title: L'ombrellone
actors: Enrico Maria Salerno, Sandra Milo, Daniela Bianchi, Jean Sorel
description: Like every summer weekend, the mature engineer Enrico joins his wife Giuliana by the sea. At first he is distracted by new and somewhat goliardic friendships, but then he discovers that his wife, which he believes to be more than faithful, neglected for too long, makes sweet eyes to one of the many young hunks who haunt the coast.
notes: Undecided between the seaside trend and the satire of customs, Dino Risi moves uncertainly between the traps of an uninspired screenplay by Ennio De Concini. Salerno is better as a dramatic actor, Sandra Milo is not exactly essential, Daniela Bianchi without 007 does not say much.

title: Body Double
actors: Craig Wasson, Melanie Griffith, Gregg Henry, Deborah Shelton, Dennis Franz
description: Jake is an actor who suffers when he is indoors; fired, he leaves the set. He returns home and finds his wife in the company of another man. Try to rebuild a life. A colleague, met by chance (at least so it seems), lends him a magnificent villa from which, every evening, a splendid naked girl is seen in a house opposite. Jake, of course, falls in love with her and desperately tries to meet her.
notes: The film is the synthesis of Hitchcock's rhetoric, between eroticism and irony. Melanie Griffith manages to impose her presence and books herself for future successes. Brian De Palma is in top form.

title: Murder Times Seven
actors: Richard Crenna, Cliff Gorman, Susan Blakely, Moses Gunn
description: For the third time, Lieutenant Janek is forced to face a difficult case based on some heinous murders that see some large pieces of the underworld implicated. The case is complicated by the fact that one of the victims is his friend of him Ray Kiley. During the investigation Janek comes to discover that Kiley worked for counterintelligence. Richard Crenna (the "Rambo" officer) does not help much, with his unexpressive face, unsuitable for a character who would like complex and troubled.

title: On the Edge - The Hitman
actors: Chuck Norris, Michael Parks, Al Waxman, Alberta Watson
description: After nearly losing his skin in a police action, the protagonist (Chuck Norris) infiltrates a gang of Seattle drug traffickers, with implications in Canada and Iran. It will be hard to deal with it and make the law triumph, but nothing scares our hero and, above all, nothing is impossible for him. Of course, not counting the corpses.
notes: For the second time Chuck Norris is directed by his brother Aaron, without any waste of originality. The story, the definition of the characters and the context are similar to those seen and reviewed dozens of times. We report Bill Ferguson. Who is it? The leader of the daring "stunt men".

title: Omicron
actors: Renato Salvatori, Rosemarie Dexter, Gaetano Quartararo, Mara Carisi
description: The Trabucco worker is found dead on the banks of the Po. An extraterrestrial has settled in his body, preparing the invasion of the Earth. Omicron (this is the name of the alien) at first denounces the trade unionists, but for the sake of a woman he then begins to take the side of the workers. He will be killed while organizing a strike. Science fiction used as a metaphor to talk about political and social problems. Sharp and ahead of its time, even if Gregoretti's caustic vein still has the flavor of archeology today (unfortunately).

title: Encore - Once More
actors: Jean-Louis Rolland, Florence Giorgetti, Pascale Rocard
description: Louis, married and father of a daughter who has a morbid love for him, separates from his family and discovers homosexual love. He is fascinated by the figure of Frantz, for whom he has a real passion. But Frantz can't stand ties of any kind and Louis goes to live with Michel who loves him sincerely. He will be the only one to remain beside him on his deathbed, also invoking that end for himself, while Louis dies invoking the name of Frantz. "I wanted to make a film about love and the fear of loving" declared Vecchiali, condensing fear and illness, love and neurosis into ten "sequence shots".

title: Ondata di calore
actors: Jean Seberg, Luigi Pistilli, P. Modugno
description: Lonely weekend in Africa for an engineer wife. It's hot, the atmosphere is oppressive; the woman attempts to commit suicide. The truth makes its way: the woman killed her husband, guilty of having preferred a young African to her. The director eliminates the "facts" to subtly tell impressions, mental restlessness, claustrophobic atmospheres.

title: L'onorata società
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Domenico Modugno
description: Saruzzo Messina and Rosolino Trapani (Franco Franchi and Ciccio Ingrassia) are in the sights of the honored company for having seduced the two daughters of a powerful mafia boss. The assassins charged with killing them find them in Rome, where our heroes have in the meantime become engaged to two other girls, also daughters of a Sicilian; he would be happy to see them settled with the marriage, given their not very commendable past.
notes: With Riccardo Pazzaglia's directorial debut, Franco and Ciccio are also beginners in terms of cinema. They then did better (but even worse) in terms of comedy.

title: Prizzi's Honor
actors: Jack Nicholson, Kathleen Turner, Anjelica Huston
description: Growing up in the shadow of the powerful Prizzi mafia family of which he is the top killer, Charles Partanna betrays his expectations by marrying an apparently "different" woman. Irene, however, is not so different: widow of a Charles victim, and killer in turn, it is she who is entrusted with the task of killing Charles. But Charles was also given a task: to eliminate Irene.
notes: The protagonist oscillates between cynicism and sentimental abandonment through all the intermediate gradations and the film oscillates between comedy and tragedy, with a constant background of sly irony that imposes itself in a final of masterly malice.

title: L'onorevole Angelina
actors: Anna Magnani, Ave Ninchi, Nando Bruno, Ernesto Almirante
description: Angelina Bianchi (Anna Magnani) is a leader. When something is wrong with her neighborhood, she is always in the front row. In the end they also convince her to throw herself into politics, but it ends badly. A part built to measure for Magnani, in a small comedy with an inconsistent polemical vein.

title: L'onorevole con l'amante sotto il letto
actors: Lino Banfi, Janet Agren, Alvaro Vitali, Marisa Merlini, Lory Del Santo
description: The teacher of a provincial private school, who has lost her job for having abruptly taken back the mayor's children, goes to Rome to ask the honorable boyfriend for help, and discovers that he is actually already married.
notes: What to say? A classic of the Italian "butt and sword", a little bit pimp, a little cheeky, erotic just enough to not scandalize to the end. The film is what it is, but viewers of the time greatly appreciated ...

title: Coupé de ville
actors: Patrick Dempsey, Arye Gross, Daniel Stern
description: Marvin, Bobby and Buddy Libner are ordered by their father Fred to bring a cadillac model "coupé de ville" from Michigan to Florida, a birthday gift for his mother. The three, with a character that cannot be more different, during the journey give free rein to their grudges and their quarrels, with the result of smashing the car. They will put it back together and strengthen their friendship, in the variegated vein of On the Road, a variant that veers towards an edifying finale.

title: Five Fingers
actors: James Mason, Danielle Darrieux, Michael Rennie
description: The waiter (James Mason) of the British ambassador in Ankara offers the Nazis, for a large fee, information so valuable that in Berlin it is believed to be false. Even the British are aware of what has happened and are trying in every way to send an agent. The waiter, frightened, tries the last shot and sells the plans for the landing in Normandy. The Germans buy, convinced however that it is a can, and pay with fake pounds; but man realizes it too late.
notes: Based on an episode that really happened during the Second World War, one of the classic films of mankiewicz, all intrigue and falsehood, suspended between theatricality and semi-documentary moments, with a superb James Mason. A film that Graham Greene would not mind.

title: Flying Firestone
actors: Tony Curtis, Roger Moore, Penelope Horner
description: This is a collage of two TV films from the series Beware of those two. The lead couple (Curtis and Moore) vanquish a gang dedicated to car racing makeup, then neutralize a group of Basque separatists. Ninety minutes of passable relaxation.

title: Darling Lili
actors: Julie Andrews, Rock Hudson, Jeremy Kemp, Lance Percival
description: Young Lili Smith (Julie Andrews), a famous London soubrette, actually works for German espionage.
