We are at the time of the First World War and her friendship with American Lieutenant Bill Larrabee (Rock Hudson) constitutes a precious source of information for her. Too bad that the girl falls madly in love with the officer and even comes to self-report in order to save him.
notes: Halfway between espionage and comedy, the film still enjoys the lightness of Blake Edwards' touch. Lots of aerial acrobatics beautifully photographed in Technicolor and lots of music (Oscar nomination for Henry Mancini, that of the Pink Panther).

title: Operation Crossbow
actors: George Peppard, Tom Courtenay, John Mills, Sophia Loren, Jeremy Kemp, John Willis
description: John, Robert and Phil are chosen by the Allies for an action of espionage in a secret and super-protected base where the Germans, according to the Intelligence Service, are preparing missiles and special bombs. The three take the identity of as many missing technicians and thus try to be hired by the enemy. Only two will succeed, but they too will have to sacrifice their lives for the success of the mission.
notes: Despite a prominent cast, the level is only decent entertainment. However, the second part is better than the first, as far as dramatic intensity and emotional grip are concerned.

title: D-Day the Sixth of June
actors: Robert Taylor, Dana Wynter, Richard Todd, Edmond O'Brien
description: In June 1944, while the Normandy landings were being prepared, an American officer, Captain Parker, had the opportunity to meet Valerie, a beautiful auxiliary of the English army. The two begin to confide in his wife and John, the boy the auxiliary loves and who is fighting on the African front. But little by little the friendship between the two turns into passionate love. Before leaving for the dangerous mission, Parker promises Valerie that, if he gets out alive, he will ask for a divorce.
notes: Conventional film not redeemed enough by a good script or good actors.

title: Inside Out
actors: Telly Savalas, Robert Culp, James Mason, Aldo Ray
description: In August 1941, a shipment of gold bars destined for the coffers of the Third Reich disappeared. After the war, a commando made up of people of various nationalities and different specializations attempts to recover the precious metal. The matter is very complex (it is even necessary to "resurrect" Hitler!), But the operation, thanks to the accuracy with which it was organized, has the desired outcome. A narrative that does not sufficiently tread its hand into the "game" of the paradoxical aspects of the story, poised between grotesque humor and imaginative adventurosity. Too bad, because that would have been the only condition to save the shack and puppets.

title: One Hour with You
actors: Maurice Chevalier, Jeannette MacDonald, Genevieve Tobin
description: André Bertier (Chevalier) is a Parisian-born doctor happily married to Colette (MacDonald). Colette's best friend is called Mitzi and, in spite of her friendship, she doesn't mind undermining the handsome doctor, as well as family peace. André is tempted and he could not be, but in the end he stoically resists. The only problem is that his wife insists not to believe him. Screenplay by Samuel Raphaelson, some scenes directed by Cukor, for this Cukor version of "Marriage for four", a silent film by Lubitsch himself. Virtually perfect.

title: Firecreek
actors: James Stewart, Henry Fonda, Gary Lockwood
description: A band of adventurers, made up of ex-military demobilized after the civil war, arrives in a remote village. Since the sheriff is temporarily away, the thugs rule by committing all kinds of abuses and persecuting a young Indian girl. But, when the sheriff returns, the country rebels.
notes: A modest twilight western that tries to combine the classic soul of the American genre with certain excesses of the spaghetti vein. Fonda in the role of the villain recovers the Frank of "Once upon a time in the West", but in this case we miss Sergio Leone a lot behind the camera.

title: The Clock
actors: Judy Garland, Robert Walker, James Gleason, Keenan Wynn
description: A soldier is in New York City to spend his well-deserved days off. Walking through the streets of the Big Apple he meets a secretary who is also on leave, but from work. An intense friendship immediately arises between the two, leading them to wander around the city and fall in love.
notes: A vintage Minnelli directs his fresh consort Judy Garland, crackling as usual. The film was underestimated by the public and was dubbed in Italian only recently.

title: The Fatal Hour
actors: Boris Karloff, Grant Withers, Marjorie Reynolds, Charles Trowbridge
description: A policeman investigating a gang of fences is killed. A colleague of his wants to avenge his death by solving the case, but is groping in the dark. However, the help of the famous Chinese investigator Mr. Wong will be decisive in bringing the wicked to justice. Decent yellow with the great Boris Karloff. The character of Mr. Wong was the protagonist of a series that was intended to oppose that of Charlie Chan.

title: The Scarlet Hour
actors: Carol Ohmart, Tom Tryon, Jody Lawrence
description: Rich Ralph Nevius's wife, Paula, is having an affair with Marshall. The two learn of a jewelry theft plan and Paula convinces Marshall to rob the thieves and then escape with the loot. The blow succeeds, but the husband is killed. The police torment the two lovers, whose relations deteriorate. Meanwhile Marshall discovers Katy's affection. Paula attempts to blame her rival for the murder, but is exposed and ends up in jail. Directed without infamy and without glory by Curtiz, the show is based on the discreet psychological design of the character of Paula.

title: Orazi e Curiazi 3-2
actors: Gianni Agus, Lino Banfi, Enzo Cannavale, Gloria Guida, Francesco Mulè, Elio Pandolfi
description: Predictable parody of the legendary chapter of ancient Roman history. The Horatii champions of the indolent Center-South clash with the Curiazi of Alba Longobarda, a hard-working city in the North.

title: Orca-Killer Whale
actors: Richard Harris, Charlotte Rampling, Bo Derek
description: Nolan, an Irish captain, wants to capture an orca to redeem his fishing boat with the proceeds from the sale of the cetacean. He manages to capture a female specimen that he kills, but the male, furious, begins a real persecution against Nolan, destroying his boat and house. She then challenges him to a deadly duel in the ice, where he will consume his revenge under the terrified eyes of the ethologist Rachel. Born on the wave of the commercial success of the "Shark", it is a highly spectacular film but completely failed on the narrative level. Sometimes it even borders on the ridiculous, like when the orca devours Bo Derek's leg.

title: The Black Orchid
actors: Sophia Loren, Anthony Quinn, Ina Balin, Jimmy Baird
description: Rosa Blanco is a young Italian American widow. She has a 10-year-old son named Ralphie, locked up in a reform school, and a scruple: if she hadn't pushed her husband into the world of the Mafia, he wouldn't have gotten himself killed. During a visit to her son, her friend Frank Valente asks her as a wife. Ralphie is thrilled to be able to get out of the reform school; much less so is Frank's daughter who doesn't want to know that she has a mafia-smelling stepmother. Carlo Ponti production for an American director. Sophia Loren won the Best Actress award at the Venice Film Festival. Three years later the Oscar would arrive.

title: Wild Orchid
actors: Mickey Rourke, Carré Otis, Jacqueline Bisset, Assumpta Serna
description: Claudia Liones, manager of a financial company, is on business trip to Brazil together with his secretary Emily Reed. In Rio they meet James Wheeler, Claudia's old friend, who begins to woo Emily. James manages to bring her to bed and tells her about her unhappy childhood. The next day the two leave by motorbike for an unknown destination.
notes: Direction debut for Zalman King, the screenwriter of "9 weeks and 1/2". The world premiere took place in Italy for fear, an unfounded result of American censorship. The television version has some cuts that makes the story even more inconsistent.

title: Gli ordini sono ordini
actors: Monica Vitti, Claudine Auger, Orazio Orlando
description: Giorgia, happily married to a bank manager, begins to hear an inner voice that pushes her to do strange things, so strange that they end up endangering her husband's life. Tired of the situation, the man chasing the house. After an unsuccessful visit to her mother, Giorgia meets Nancy, a foreign friend, who explains the reason for these "oddities": it is the subconscious that pushes Giorgia to emancipate herself from the role of woman-object.
notes: Story of a woman's rebellion made in an extremely banal way. Screenplay by Tonino Guerra, who wrote several memorable but also rubbish things like this.

title: Dead Calm
actors: Nicole Kidman, Sam Neill, Billy Zane, Rod Mulliner, Joshua Tilden
description: After the death of their son in a car accident, Rae and John Ingram try to regain the will to live by going on a cruise on the Pacific aboard their yacht "Saracen". Life is calm and the winds are even more so. One day they spot the "Orpheus" on their route, a schooner that does not respond to radio calls and from which a lifeboat departs with a terrified and exhausted man. The man is called Hughie and is promptly hoisted aboard, but he can hardly speak, so much so that John decides to go and see for himself. The interior of the "Orpheus" is full of horrors: dismembered bodies and even a videotape with the dynamics of the facts. At this point it is John who runs terrified towards the "Saracen", but it's too late. Hughie woke up, took Rae hostage and drove off in John's boat. Hughie is obviously a maniac and for John, abandoned in the middle of the Pacific with a schooner that is struggling to function, the chase is long.
notes: Great tension, great photography by Dean Semler and great outdoors. The story, of a classic and crystalline simplicity, is taken from a novel by Charles Williams that Orson Welles had already tried to bring to the screen in '67, but without success. Australian Philip Noyce manages to build a completely terrifying film with very few elements: two men, a woman and a boat in the middle of huge spaces. Well done Billy Zane, veteran Sam Neill and young Nicole Kidman who at the time was not yet Mrs. Cruise.

title: Certain Fury
actors: Tatum O'Neal, Irene Cara, Nicholas Campbell, Peter Fonda
description: After the roundup there is a hearing. The girls taken by the police are in front of the judge when two of them turn against the policemen and, in the ensuing confusion, two others manage to escape into the basement. I'm Scarlet, a brusque prostitute, and Tracy, a decent girl arrested by accident. At that point the hunt begins.
notes: Gyllenhaal is the director of good intentions: even the recent "The Black Heart of Paris Trout" was on the best card of the result. With "Ore 13" you don't get bored, and that's already something. Irene Cara is the lead singer of "Fame" and "What a Feelin '".

title: Ore 9: lezione di chimica
actors: Alida Valli, Irasema Dilian, Andrea Checchi
description: A student is caught hugging a man and reported to the headmistress by a jealous schoolmate who has identified the man as a teacher she is in love with. It is a misunderstanding, but in the meantime there is an escape, an accident, then the final repentance.
notes: Excellent actors and a director with a solid sense of comedy, who can afford to touch the pathetic without falling for it. The film, at the time of its release, caused some scandal for the argument considered too bold. It was however a success with the public, so much so that Mattoli shot a remake in 1955 entitled "The 18-year-olds".

title: Back Track
actors: Dennis Hopper, Jodie Foster, Vincent Price, John Turturro, Bob Dylan, Charlie Sheen, Joe Pesci
description: Anne Benton (Foster) witnesses a murder committed on behalf of the boss Carelli (Stockwell). Forced to flee from the killers who kill her boyfriend (Sheen), she takes refuge in New Mexico where another and more refined killer sent on her trail is discovered by Milo (Hopper). Milo loves the sax, Botticelli and Bosch and soon falls in love with Anne too and gives up killing her.
notes: Hopper's troubled film that in the United States, due to editing controversies, came out under the fictitious name of Alan Smithee. However, it remains a cursed film with a stratospheric cast: among others we find Vincent Price, Joe Pesci, John Turturro and Bob Dylan. In any case, the result remains difficult to judge.

title: Le ore dell'amore
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Emmanuelle Riva, Barbara Steele, Brunello Rondi
description: After three years of living together, Gianni and Maretta decide it's time to get married. But the marriage turns their life into an oppressive routine that soon puts a strain on Gianni's endurance and thwarts Maretta's efforts to save the day. The solution? Go back to making lovers.
notes: We can consider the film as the final act of a trilogy (_Il federal_, _La desire matta_ always with Tognazzi as the protagonist) that portrays the bourgeois man struggling with history and with the freedom of customs of the Sixties. The subject is signed not only by Luciano Salce but also by Castellano & Pipolo.

title: Uchu
actors: Radoslav Brzobohaty, Jirina Bohdalová
description: In Prague, in the 1950s, a ministry official and his wife come home a little tipsy after a dinner and realize they don't have the keys to their house. However, when they manage to get back into the house, they find that the electricity has been cut. It is a night of fears, memories and paranoia. Czechoslovakian tragicomedy distributed abroad twenty years late.

title: Scandal at Scourie
actors: Greer Garson, Walter Pidgeon, Agnes Moorehead, Donna Corcoran
description: The McChesneys, a Protestant couple living in Canada, meet a Catholic orphan by chance and decide to adopt her. The man's political opponents are eager to take advantage of the situation to create a scandal. The community of the country is also hostile to adoption. Everything seems to turn decisively towards tragedy when the little girl is unjustly accused of being an arsonist. The girl frightened by all that commotion runs away. Thus began the frantic searches.
notes: Predictable drama, but well directed by Jean Negulesco. Good performance of the actors.

title: Orfeu negro
actors: Breno Mello, Marpessa Dawn, Lourdes de Oliveira, Lea Garcia
description: In Rio de Janeiro a tram driver falls in love with a girl threatened with death. Their destinies will unite. Oscar for best foreign film and Palme d'Or at Cannes, the film is colorful and folkloric but the transposition of the myth of Orpheus in the favelas during the Rio carnival has its own bizarre charm. Almost all thanks to the famous, wonderful music by Vinicius de Moraes, Luis Bonfa and Antonio Carlos Jobim.

title: The Organization
actors: Sidney Poitier, Barbara McNair, Fred Beir, Raul Julia, Gerald S. O'Loughlin
description: Tibbs investigates the shady dealings of a large drug company. His research provokes the bloody reaction of the gang and the suspension of Tibbs himself from the service. Stubborn, the policeman will continue the investigation alone, but in the end the organization will prove to be stronger than him.
notes: The character created by John Ball and brought to the screen effectively by Poitier in an action film with veins of pessimism and declared sympathy for the losers.

title: The Pride and the Passion
actors: Cary Grant, Sophia Loren, Frank Sinatra, Theodore Bikel
description: In 1810 Spain, the troops are en route pursued by the French invaders. The retreat is delayed by a massive seven-ton cannon which the Spaniards are reluctantly forced to abandon. The cannon is tempting to the French who are busy to take possession of it; but it is also tempting for the British who send their agent to Spain who makes contact with the Spanish guerrillas.
notes: It is a highly spectacular film, where the Napoleonic battles are reconstructed very loosely. The contest of the cannon, the amorous passion and the war passion hold the ground.

title: Pride and Prejudice
actors: Maureen O'Sullivan, Laurence Olivier, Edmund Gwenn, Greer Garson
description: The arrival of Charles Bingley in an English town makes marriageable girls agitated. Contrary to his parents' expectations, however, he falls in love with Jane, a girl of modest conditions, and for this he is hindered.
notes: Based on the novel of the same name by Jane Austen, the film boasts an excellent staging and uses an actor like Laurence Olivier, perfect for this romantic part. The setting and the historical reconstruction are accurate, as well as the representation of the plot.

title: Fort Yuma
actors: Peter Graves, Joan Vohs, John Hudson, Joan Taylor
description: Apache Indians are besieging Fort Yuma. A caravan of unsuspecting settlers is heading towards the fort led by a white scout, Keegan, and an Indian. The contrasts between the white and the Indian are very strong, also due to Keegan's harshly racist attitude. The death of the girl, with whom the white is in love, and the approaching of the decisive confrontation with the Apaches brings together the two men who face the decisive confrontation together.
notes: Low-cost Western by Lesley Selander, one of the most prolific directors of the American B series. The pace is pressing and makes you forget the modesty of the actors.

title: Lost Horizon
actors: Ronald Colman, Jane Wyatt, Edward Everett Horton, Thomas Mitchell
description: The English consul in China tries to escape together with some compatriots, including his brother, to avoid the conflict between China and Japan. Their plane is hijacked and crashes into the mountains of Tibet: there the group accidentally discovers the mythical city of Shangri La, where people live happily. The old Lama who governs the city is dying and would like to entrust the command to the consul: but the man, pushed by his companions, tries to escape. In the end, only he survives and decides to go back. A goat's tale that is a kind of escape from history, a search for happiness and peace outside of everyday life. Based on a James Hillton novel, the film won Academy Awards for Production Design and Editing. A bad musical remake was made in 1972.

title: When Time Ran Out
actors: Paul Newman, Jacqueline Bisset, William Holden
description: An island in Hawaii is in danger of exploding due to an erupting volcano, which was also thrown into turmoil due to the drilling of the subsoil carried out by a company looking for "black gold". The first building to suffer the destructive consequences of the lava is a luxury hotel where American tourists and businessmen stay.
notes: Very modest disaster film directed by Goldstone, who did better with "Rollercoaster" (1977). Known situations, stars who do the bare minimum, cheesy special effects. As often in these cases, above all the script is missing.

title: Mackenna's Gold
actors: Gregory Peck, Omar Sharif, Telly Savalas
description: Sheriff Mackenna has found the map to reach a fabulous treasure hidden in a canyon. The Colorado gang forces him to take them to the field. A bit cumbersome Western, despite its spectacularity.

title: Gold of Seven Saints
actors: Clint Walker, Roger Moore, Chill Wills
description: Two Colorado hunters, Rainbolt and Garrett, accidentally discover a rich deposit of gold nuggets. This is the beginning of their troubles, between a bandit who assaults them with his men (and are saved by the providential intervention of a doctor), a second band of outlaws led by an old friend of Rainbolt, the murder of the doctor, the torture of Garrett to reveal the hiding of the gold, and other vicissitudes. And when everything seems to have ended for the best ... Despite some length and some excessive descriptive complacency, the film presents itself as a decent entertainment product, flavored with an ironic ending.

title: L'oro del mondo
actors: Al Bano, Romina Power, Carlo Giordana, Linda Christian, Nino Taranto
description: Carlo, a modest university student, is engaged to the beautiful Lorena, the daughter of a small industrialist, but Giorgio, the son of a rich entrepreneur, has plans for the girl and forces her to become engaged to him, threatening to cause his father to fail. Carlo learns of the trick and confronts his rival, inflicting a sound lesson on him.
notes: The couple Al Bano-Romina Power liked the teenagers and their parents didn't mind: their films always contained allusions to their meeting, as had been told by the magazines.

title: L'oro di Roma
actors: Anna Maria Ferrero, Jean Sorel, Gérard Blain, Paola Borboni
description: Fifty kilos of gold to be collected in 24 hours to avoid deportation to Germany. The Roman Jewish community manages to put together the quantity imposed by the SS major Kappler, but is still sent to the extermination camps.
notes: From the background of this atrocious historical fact, the film isolates a mosaic of individual events, with the result of sweetening the drama of the tragedy and without completely avoiding the trap of rhetoric. Film, however, of considerable interest for its civil commitment, for the contribution of the interpreters and for the valuable environmental reconstruction.

title: Georg Elser
actors: Klaus Maria Brandauer, Brian Dennehy, Rebecca Miller, Elisabeth Orth, Vadim Glowna, Ralf Richter
description: On the eve of a speech that Hitler is to give in a Munich brewery in 1938, the watchmaker Georg Elser works in the shadows to prepare an attack, with the help of a waitress from the restaurant from whom he is expecting a child. However, his precautions fail to prevent the suspicions of an SS officer. Brandauer the director is pompous and academic, and as an actor he is an unbridled gigione.

title: L'orribile segreto del Dr. Hichcock
actors: Robert Flemyng, Barbara Steele, Maria Teresa Vianello, Silvano Tranquilli
description: In an English villa, in 1885, Dr. Hichcock kills his wife Margareta with an overdose of anesthetic. Years later he returns home with a new wife, Cynthia, and discovers that Margareta is not dead. Dr. Hichcock lets himself be entangled by her again to the point of trying to restore her old youth using Cynthia's blood. The intervention of a friend and the burning of the villa will prove to be providential. The reference to Hitchcock is not accidental: there are echoes of "Rebecca, the first wife" and even the glass of milk from "The suspect". Freda insists more on sexual perversions and makes one of the best films of her career.

actors: John Hurt, Richard Burton, Suzanna Hamilton, Cyril Cusack
description: In London, the capital of Oceania dominated by a single party, the existence of every individual is spied on and directed by Big Brother. Clerk Winston Smith falls in love and tries to resist totalitarian power and personal degradation.
notes: Transposition of Orwell's masterpiece written in 1949, made in the very year in which the writer placed the events. The version is appreciated above all for the effective setting, which however cannot restore the original atmospheres. Richard Burton's last appearance.

title: Theatre of Blood
actors: Vincent Price, Diana Rigg, Robert Morley, Ian Hendry, Harry Andrews
description: Edward Lionheart, an actor devoted to Shakespeare, but regularly crushed by critics for his gigioneria, is replaced, in the awarding of a prestigious award, by a young novice. The actor fakes suicide, is believed dead by everyone, and instead contemplates revenge. He will kill the critics, killing them one after the other inspired by well-known Shakespearean tragedies.
notes: A horror classic directed by a "father" of art (his son Anthony is the director of "Hellraiser 3") and played by a Vincent Price increasingly undisputed lord of the genre. Between blood and atrocious crimes, you can glimpse some of the typical British black humor.

title: Oscar
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Ornella Muti, Joey Travolta, Chazz Palminteri, Marisa Tomei
description: We are in 1931, the gangster Angelo "Snaps" Provolone, married to Sofia and Lisa's father, head of a gang, must swear to his dying father to be honest. Abandoned his lucrative activities, Provolone tries to get together with a group of bankers. But it is precisely at the signing of the contract that an interminable series of misunderstandings takes place, exchanges of people and briefcases, of girlfriends and daughters.
notes: It is a metaphor full of symbols and paradoxes. The film, however, does not do justice to Landis' talent, resulting in the end without bite and a bit confusing.

title: Young Doctors in Love
actors: Sean Young, Michael McKean, Harry Dean Stanton, Dabney Coleman
description: A group of newly graduated doctors wreaks havoc in a hospital. It is Marshall's first film, and it shows. There is also Harry Dean Stanton, but it is not enough.

title: Banco à Bangkok pour Oss 117
actors: Kerwin Matthews, Anna Maria Pierangeli
description: A mysterious disease threatens Asia, and Agent OSS 117 is sent to Thailand to replace a murdered colleague. Among a thousand adventures, even gallant ones, he thus discovers the bacteriological plot of the "Chosen People", a fanatical political-criminal sect. Investigations and humor with more than a wink at James Bond.

title: Sangre y arena
actors: Sharon Stone, Christopher Rydell, Ana Torrent, Simon Andreu
description: Juan Gallardo, aspiring tortor, accidentally knows the beautiful sol. Subsequently he marries Carmen, debuts in the arena and gets the favors of the public. But in his life he reappears Sol: between the two an erotic passion arises that for her is only a whim, while Juan really falls in love, and then starts drinking and brutaling. Back in the arena, he is hit to death by the Bull. Ridiculous renovation of the classic film with Tyrone Power. He would have gone unnoticed if Sharon Stone had not become a sex symbol.

title: Obsessed
actors: William Devane, Shannen Doherty, Clare Carey, James Handy
description: Ed (Devane) is a divorced 50-year-old who falls in love with a 20-year-old girl. The girl, named Lori (Doherty) falls in love with him and the crazy love goes on for a while. But Ed, as much in love as he is, has no intention of marrying the girl. And at that point she gets furious and the situation worsens. The film plays on the reversal of roles: it is the 20-year-old who falls for the mature gentleman. However, if you consider that the role of the girl is played by the pestiferous, irascible and angry Shannen Doherty, everything becomes more believable.

title: Woman Obsessed
actors: Susan Hayward, Stephen Boyd, Barbara Nichols, Dennis Holmes
description: Mary, widowed with her son Robbie and a farm to run, decides to remarry with Fred, her helper who is also a widower. But the relationship between Robbie and his stepfather is immediately very difficult, so much so that the child makes life impossible for the couple. Following a fight, the man ends up in jail. On his return he will have to prove that he is really the head of the family.
notes: A melodrama with strong colors, where the natural grandeur of the environment is the background to the elementary nature of the passions that are unleashed. Hathaway shows his great craft in spectacular scenes, maximized by the cinemascope.

title: Naked Obsession
actors: William Kurt, Maria Ford
description: Franklyn, city councilor, fights against building speculations. This is why he clashes with the ambitions of the beautiful wife, who would like him more "sensitive" to the attempts of corruption made by Mitch, representative of a powerful lobby of manufacturers. Strange characters begin to circulate around him and his path dotted with corpses ...
notes: Between shady characters and ambiguous holders are also seen at work torrid and unscrupulous females, accustomed to playing dangerously with power. "Political" thriller with erotic implications that is based on a non -new idea, adapted with a certain cunning to the tastes of the public.

title: Orphans
actors: Albert Finney, Matthew Modine, Kevin Anderson, John Kellogg
description: Two young orphans live poor in an isolated and dilapidated house. Treat, the eldest, earns his living from thefts and robberies and shares the swag with his introverted brother Philip. One day he drags home a drunkard, Harold, whom he plans to hold back to demand his ransom. He is actually a gangster, cultured and tired of the underworld, whom many are hunting down.
notes: After a brilliant debut, the film becomes burdened by following too closely the structure of Lyle Kessler's theatrical drama, from which it is based. The direction of Alan J. Pakula is all at the service of the actors, dominated by the well-controlled Albert Finney ("The Servant").

title: Northern Pursuit
actors: Errol Flynn, Julie Bishop, Helmut Dantine
description: In an inaccessible mountainous area of ??Canada, two police officers capture a German colonel, the only survivor of a group of spies hit by an avalanche. Wagner, one of the two agents, of German origin, seems to be fraternizing with the colonel, and for this he is tried and disbarred by the police. He thus enters into the good graces of the head of the spy network who hires him: but he, remaining loyal to his followers, thwarts the German attack. It is one of the so-called minor films of the successful series shot by director Raoul Walsh with Errol Flynn after the latter's break with director Michael Curtiz.

title: The Osterman Weekend
actors: Burt Lancaster, Rutger Hauer, John Hurt, Meg Foster, Dennis Hopper, Helen Shaver, Craig T. Nelson
description: John Tanner, a famous television journalist, is recruited by CIA agent Fassett to unmask a Russian spy organization called Omega, of which some of his friends also seem to belong. Tanner must create the conditions for one of his three friends to be pushed to change sides, in exchange for an exclusive on the scoop.
notes: Last film made by Sam Peckinpah between misunderstandings and difficulties with the production. Despite the cuts and tampering, the director's acid and disillusioned vision of the modern world manipulated by the media and occult powers emerges as powerful. Masterful action scenes.

title: Othello
actors: Micheal MacLiammóir, Orson Welles, Suzanne Cloutier, Robert Coote, Hilton Edwards, Nicholas Bruce, Michael Laurence, Fay Compton, Doris Dowling
description: The dark-haired Otello, general of the Serenissima, marries Desdemona despite the opposition of her father. After defeating the Turks, he returns to Cyprus where Iago, his aide, makes him believe that his wife Desdemona is the lover of the young captain Cassio. Othello has Cassio killed and suffocates Desdemona but, having proof of their innocence, he kills himself. Iago will pay for his betrayal with his life.
notes: Extraordinary film adaptation from Shakespeare, by the great Welles, despite the incredible production ups and downs that made the production last three years. Palme d'Or in Cannes (highly contested) ex-aequo with Castellani's "Two soldi of hope".

actors: Claudia Cardinale, Marcello Mastroianni, Anouk Aimée, Sandra Milo, Rossella Falk, Barbara Steele, Madeleine Lebeau, Caterina Boratto, Eddra Gale, Guido Alberti, Mario Conocchia, Mario Pisu, Tito Masini, Marco Gemini, Nadia Sanders
description: Marcello Mastroianni, in a role that is openly the projection of the director, at the center of an adventure of the spirit and the psyche: dreams, memories, reality intertwine and overlap to configure a crisis that is human, artistic and ethical.
notes: A complex self-analysis of the depths, an ironic and desperate discourse on the artist's crisis and on the Italy of the boom, which manages to assume the suggestive spectacularity of an apparently fantastic tale. A film that has collected awards all over the world (including the Oscar for the best foreign film and the one for the costumes of Piero Gherardi), one of the most famous of the director and in the entire history of cinema. The screenplay is written with Tullio Pinelli, Ennio Flaiano, Brunello Rondi. Unforgettable scenes: the initial dream of flight, the Saraghina, "Asa nisi masa", and of course the final catwalk).

title: Eight Million Ways to Die
actors: Jeff Bridges, Rosanna Arquette, Alexandra Paul, Andy Garcia
description: Matt Scudder was a Los Angeles Narcotics cop; when he killed a young drug dealer he resigned. He was also an alcoholic, then he underwent a treatment and today he goes on non-alcoholic. Now he is a private detective without enthusiasm. But when a friend of hers is killed by a drug trafficker, Matt comes out of his apathy and goes into battle. Final in a shed full of drugs.
notes: Lawrence Block has been living for years writing the saga of tough Matt Scudder. The books aren't bad, but Oliver Stone's script isn't great. Rosanna Arquette is always a feast for the eyes.

title: Eight Iron Men
actors: Richard Kiley, Lee Marvin, Bonar Colleano
description: Six American soldiers bravely try to rescue a comrade under German fire. Rather conventional war film, but directed with great tension and with a certain psychological finesse by a director who had shot "The Young Lions" a year earlier. Produced by Stanley Kramer.

title: Overboard
actors: Goldie Hawn, Kurt Russell, Edward Hermann, Katherine Helmond
description: Rich Joanna doesn't like the work Dean Profitt, a rude carpenter, did for her and dismisses it badly. Later, on a cruise, the unpleasant billionaire has an accident, ends up in the sea and is found on the beach with no memory. Profitt, widower and penniless father of a gang of rowdy children, then finds a way to settle the score by passing himself off as her husband.
notes: Director Marshall carves out a fleeting appearance as a drummer. There is the atmosphere of certain comedies of yesteryear, but the potential for irony is canceled out by a script that pays too much attention to good feelings and the duet of protagonists lacks rhythm and measure.

title: El Pico
actors: Jose Luis Manzano, Jose Manuel Cervino
description: In the Basque Country, the scene of very strong national and political tensions, two fathers from different parts of Spain and of different ideological orientation, are united by the same problem: their two sons are heroin addicts. Pedantic and messed up lecture on drugs and relationships between generations.

title: Somewhere in Time
actors: Christopher Reeve, Jane Seymour, Christopher Plummer, Teresa Wright, Bill Erwin, George Voskovec, Susan French, John Alvin, William H. Macy, Sean Hayden
description: Richard, a famous playwright, discovers that he had a burning and unfortunate passion in a previous existence, and is able to relive it by taking a leap seventy years back in time. Cracked mess written by a great science fiction writer like Richard Matheson, who here launches himself into new age stunts. Very confused Reeve.

title: Oxford University
actors: Rob Lowe, Ally Sheedy, Amanda Pays, Julian Sands
description: A young American who fell in love with a beautiful English lady went to study in Oxford and won everyone's distrust thanks to his talent in rowing. Disguised and poorly done remake of An American in Oxford from 1938.

title: Father of the Bride
actors: Spencer Tracy, Elizabeth Taylor, Joan Bennett, Billie Burke
description: Moments of panic for Stanley Banks, a quiet middle-class lawyer who has to deal with his daughter's sudden marriage. While the girl plans a fantastic ceremony, the parent is torn between the joy of the event and the realization of the unstoppable passage of time.
notes: Perhaps the funniest comedy by Minnelli, which makes use of the screenplay by Albert Hackett and Frances Goodrich, sharp in social and psychological notations. The result is hilarious and tight, with an extraordinary Spencer Tracy. A sequel to the film was made the following year (Dad becomes a grandfather), and in more recent years a remake with the same title, in turn followed by a number 2.

title: The Godfather
actors: Marlon Brando, Robert Duvall, Al Pacino, James Caan, Sterling Hayden, Richard Castellano, Richard Conte, John Marley, Al Lettieri, Diane Keaton, Abe Vigoda, Talia Shire, Gianni Russo, John Cazale, Rudy Bond
description: On the wedding day of his daughter Connie Don Vito Corleone receives in audience all those who have complaints or requests to make: requests that the godfather is accustomed to satisfy with intimidation and violence. But the real problem for Don Vito is the disagreement with the Tartaglia family on drug issues. It will be his son Michael, first to save him from an attack, then to take revenge.
notes: From a novel by Mario Puzo, the story of a mafia epic that goes hand in hand with the cinematic one. An imposing cast and a director in a state of grace. An Elizabethan tragedy, a metaphor of America, one of the best portraits of the mafia (from within). 3 Oscars: best film, screenplay and Marlon Brando leading actor (who did not collect the award and controversially sent a Native American). No nominations for the wonderful photography by Gordon Willis, for the sets by Dean Tavoularis and for the music by Nino Rota (who actually recycled the famous leitmotif from De Filippo's "Fortunella"). The film was a global success, relaunched Hollywood megaproductions and had two sequels (and a third in preparation).

title: The Godfather Part II
actors: Robert De Niro, Diane Keaton, Al Pacino, Gastone Moschin, Robert Duvall, John Cazale, Talia Shire, Lee Strasberg, Michael V. Gazzo, G.D. Spradlin, Richard Bright, Tom Rosqui, Bruno Kirby, Frank Sivero, Francesca De Sapio
description: It is 1901 when Vito Corleone reaches the United States; growing up he founded an empire based on gambling houses and prostitution. In 1958 the Corleone family is disintegrating, while the situation becomes more and more difficult for "business". Vito's son Michael becomes the new Godfather, but power makes him a lonely man.
notes: The saga of the Corleone family continues in two directions: digging into the past of Don Vito, who emigrated to New York from Sicily, and clearly tracing the dynamics of economic power, according to a parallel mafia-capitalism already mentioned in the first episode. Coppola has the breath of a nineteenth-century novelist. Great critical success and seven Oscars: film, direction, screenplay, De Niro supporting actor, soundtrack, sets.

title: The Godfather - Part III
actors: Al Pacino, Diane Keaton, Talia Shire, Andy Garcia, Eli Wallach, Sofia Coppola, Robert Duvall, John Cazale, Talia Shire, Lee Strasberg, Michael V. Gazzo, G.D. Spradlin, Richard Bright, Gastone Moschin, Tom Rosqui, Bruno Kirby, Frank Sivero, Francesca De Sapio
description: We are in 1979 and Michael Corleone, now seventy years old, has managed to give himself an image of respectability to the point of obtaining, through a complacent archbishop, even an honor from the Holy See. Now he engages in big lawful financial transactions, but the other "families" try to get in the way. Private and public intertwine dramatically, with the grand finale in Italy after a Cavalleria rusticana in Palermo. Dark melodrama narrative tone for the last chapter of the triptych, reckless references to the most sensational news (Calvi, Papa Luciani), a sure directional pulse with some moments of great spectacular effectiveness. Masterful editing in the finale.

title: Master of the World
actors: Vincent Price, Charles Bronson, Mary Webster, Henry Hull
description: In the middle of the last century an inaccessible Pennsylvania mountain has sudden eruptions and mysterious manifestations that terrify the population. A search party enters the crater and finds a tyrant who dominates the mountain with a warship sailing in the inland sea and a spaceship. Based on two novels by Giulio Verne (The master of the world and Robur the conqueror) written by Richard Matheson, the film has a taste of naive fantasy, with period scent, and amusing cinematic solutions in the use of tricks. The dark Vincent Price is the tyrannical captain, Charles Bronson the young hero.

title: The Super
actors: Joe Pesci, Vincent Gardenia, Rubén Blades, Madolyn Smith Osborne, Kenny Blank
description: Louie Kritski is completely dominated by the greedy father Lou, who keeps the houses he owns in absolute decay, making those poor tenants live like animals. Sentenced by a female judge to forced home in one of his hovels, Louie gradually loses his claws and becomes the benefactor of his former victims.
notes: An uplifting tale (but often with a very ... colorful language), whose greatest value, if not the only one, consists in the duets between Joe Pesci and Vincent Gardenia. The rest is just ordinary business, with a duller direction than anything else.

title: Wild in the Country
actors: Elvis Presley, Hope Lange, Millie Perkins, Tuesday Weld
description: Gleen Tyler, motherless, lives with his selfish father and abusive brother. Following a violent quarrel, he is placed in the care of an uncle and the care of a doctor, Irene Sperry. The new acquaintances, especially female ones, and his introspective ability give him the vocation of the writer. More dramatic setbacks will occur, but better days will finally come.
notes: Sentimental and existential education of a sensitive young man in the obtuse American province. Elvis Presley is struggling, for once, with a subject not singing, but dramatic. However, the results are not memorable.

title: Paganini Horror
actors: Daria Nicolodi, Jasmine Main, Donald Pleasence
description: The story of the film begins in the Venetian villa where it is said that the great violinist Nicolò Paganini made a pact with the devil who gave him the prodigious musical technique in exchange for the soul. The Mephistophelic presence makes its evil influence felt even after the death of the violinist and composer, through the following generations of the unfortunate inhabitants the now cursed abode. Self-sufficient by-product like Dario Argento with the presence of the Hollywood "old caryatid" on duty (Pleasance) and the inevitable corollary of poorly dressed girls.

title: I pagliacci
actors: Tito Gobbi, Gina Lollobrigida, Afro Poli, Filippo Morucci
description: From Ruggero Leoncavallo's best-known work: Canio, a clown in a company of wandering actors, is jealous of his wife Nedda, who actually has a lover, Silvio, a young landowner in the area. When the truth comes out, Canio acts with death in his heart but then loses the sense of fiction and confronts his wife with a dagger.

title: Pal Joey
actors: Rita Hayworth, Frank Sinatra, Kim Novak, Barbara Nichols, Bobby Sherwood
description: Joey Evans (Sinatra) is a singer and would like to open his own club. There is a dancer, Linda (Novak), who is in love with him, but he doesn't seem to care. One evening he happens to be at the home of Vera (Hayworth), a former dancer, now very rich widow. Vera is the woman who can help him open the place: in fact the two agree and the deal takes shape. But she realizes that Joey is attracted to Linda and forces him to fire her ... It is certainly not one of the most memorable Hollywood musicals, but the trio of performers plus Sinatra's songs (including the famous "The Lady Is a Tramp ") guarantee a pleasant show.

title: Head Office
actors: Danny DeVito, Goerge Coe, Lori-Nan Engler, Eddie Albert, Rick Moranis
description: It is Jack Issel's first day of work in the multinational Inc. His first assignment is to face the protest of a small town (led by the beautiful Rachel) against the closure of a factory. Jack is a little foiled, but it doesn't take long to seduce the girl, win public opinion and gain control of the multinational.
notes: Yuppism satire mediocrely directed by the director of "The craziest plane in the world 2". But the real problem is that De Vito and Moranis leave the scene too soon.

title: The Naked Gun: from the Files of Police Squad!
actors: Leslie Nielsen, Priscilla Presley, Ricardo Montalban
description: Lieutenant Frank Drebin (Nielsen) of the LAPD must foil a plot hatched by some powerful politicians against Her Majesty and which must take place while Elizabeth II is visiting the Californian metropolis. Drebin has already dealt with his opponents in Beirut. Our hero hunts himself in the most absurd situations; however, it does its job successfully. A laughing version of catastrophic cinema, the film is made by three specialists in the genre: director David Zucker and screenwriters Jerry Zucker, his brother, and Jim Abrahams, authors of "The Craziest Plane in the World" and "Top Secret". To remember: the sequence of the golden pen ending in the aquarium, the one in which Drebin destroys the villain's luxurious house and his dialogue with the informant on the dock of the harbor.

title: Palombella rossa
actors: Nanni Moretti, Silvio Orlando, Mariella Valentini, Alfonso Santagata, Claudio Morganti, Asia Argento, Eugenio Masciari, Mario Patané, Antonio Petrocelli, Remo Remotti, Fabio Traversa, Giovanni Buttafava, Gabriele Ceracchini
description: Michele Apicella, Communist MP and water polo player, lost his memory in a car accident. Friends, journalists and comrades press him to remember: above all the sensational gesture he made. But Michele only manages to scrape up shreds of his memory: a child in early training, a strange political platform. Meanwhile, the game goes on but it will be he who misses the decisive penalty. In the year of the collapse of the Berlin Wall, Moretti treats the crisis of the left with oneiric and ironic tones, also using the inserts of his debut short film ("Defeat") and "Doctor Zhivago".

title: Panama Sugar
actors: Scott Plank, Oliver Reed, Lucrezia Lante Della Rovere, Duilio Del Prete, Memé Perlini
description: An American boss intends to exploit a pristine island by building tourist resorts for mass tourism. It goes without saying that in this way that pristine paradise risks being overturned by concrete pours and sports equipment. To oppose the project there is only Panama Sugar, but that is enough for the boss to make him desist from his perverse will.
notes: Naturalistic ecological pretext for a tourist postcard film of the tropics. It makes Spencer and Hill regret it.

title: Pane, amore e...
actors: Vittorio De Sica, Sophia Loren, Lea Padovani, Tina Pica, Antonio Cifariello, Mario Carotenuto
description: Former Marshal Carotenuto (De Sica) returns to his native Sorrento, but his house is occupied by a young widow, the fishwife Sofia (Loren), of whom the mature bachelor falls in love. Once again, however, a younger man blows it under his nose; all that remains for the former soldier is the "consolation" of a more mature lady: Donna Violante (Padovani), less beautiful than Sofia, but more wealthy.
notes: The film exhausts the sentimental events of De Sica-Carotenuto, the direction passes from Comencini to the professional Risi, Lollobrigida disappears and Loren comes into play, more genuine but unable to overcome her "predecessor".

title: Pane, amore e fantasia
actors: Vittorio De Sica, Gina Lollobrigida, Tina Pica, Roberto Risso, Marisa Merlini
description: Antonio Carotenuto (De Sica) marshal of the carabinieri, was sent from his native Sorrento to Sagliena, a small town in Abruzzo. Sensitive to feminine charm, the marshal is attracted both by the beautiful and provocative "bersagliera" and by the reserved Anna, the town's midwife.
notes: The film was one of the greatest commercial successes of Italian cinema. Comencini directs with a certain grace, but the strength of the film obviously lies in the duets between Lollobrigida and a very nice De Sica, and obviously in the overwhelming sorties of Tina Pica.

title: Pane, amore e gelosia
actors: Vittorio De Sica, Gina Lollobrigida, Roberto Risso, Maria Pia Casilio
description: Seconded to another command, the carabiniere Piero Stelluti entrusts his fiancée Maria, known as the Bersagliera, to the care of his superior, Marshal Antonio Carotenuto. But a convict dance between Maria and Carotenuto makes Piero jealous who breaks the engagement. It will be the marshal himself who will put things right.
notes: Comencini did not want to shoot a sequel to "Bread, love and fantasy", but the huge public success (the film grossed about a billion and a half) forced him to think again. Comencini's innovation was to introduce a vein of popular comedy into the vaguely neorealist framework of the two films.

title: Pane, burro e marmellata
actors: Enrico Montesano, Rossana Podestà, Claudine Auger, Rita Tushingham
description: Bruno De Santis, successful TV presenter, was left by his wife Sofia. One day he decides to call her to convince her to come back but her device is broken. By a strange twist of fate, it happens in the house of three women, Vera, Simona and Betty, who, tired of their respective husbands and boyfriends, live together and manage a boutique. By them he is pitied, pampered and even hosted in their apartment. And so Bruno, little by little, becomes the sultan of the little harem.
notes: Funny costume comedy. Very wild Montesano, but the surprises come above all from the female "counterparts" ....

title: Panic Button
actors: Maurice Chevalier, Carlo Croccolo, Vincent Barbi, Jayne Mansfield
description: To cover a tax evasion, two brothers decide to simulate a deficit. They hire a star released and invest money in a film from which a total failure is expected, but it is rewarded in Venice. Insapido, with George Sherman accredited as a direction supervisor.

title: Two Minute Warning
actors: Charlton Heston, John Cassavetes, Martin Balsam, Beau Bridges, Gena Rowlands
description: At the Memorial Coliseum in Los Angeles, a highly anticipated final of rugby is about to be played in a grandiose setting of crowds. The police, however, identifies a man armed with a rifle on the highest tower of the stadium. At the last moment, the expected arrival of the president of the United States was avoided, but the intervention of the special team to disarm the stranger triggers an immediate reaction. At the first shots, panic takes hold of the crowd. The film had a good success at the time, but today it looks almost like a show without much rhythm, despite the stellar cast.

title: The Pink Panther
actors: David Niven, Peter Sellers, Capucine, Claudia Cardinale
description: The Pink Panther is a fabulous brilliant in the possession of Princess Dala. On her trail the thief-gentleman Sir Lytton who follows her to Cortina D'Ampezzo, in turn followed by Inspector Clouseau, whose wife is Sir Lytton's lover. After an incredible series of tragicomic adventures, the inspector will be accused of the theft.
notes: The film is literally hilarious, and explodes especially in the second part. Blend of imperturbability and catastrophic comedy, it will kick off one of the most loved series by the public and an irresistible character like Inspector Clouseau from Surété. The musical motif of Henry Mancini is mythical.

title: Curse of the Pink Panther
actors: Ted Wass, David Niven, Robert Wagner, Herbert Lom, Capucine, Burt Kwouk
description: Inspector Dreyfus is in charge of the search for the hated colleague Clouseau, who mysteriously disappeared after the theft of a fabulous diamond. The searches, entrusted to an inept policeman from New York, take him around Europe but remain fruitless and Clouseau is pronounced dead. This attempt to continue the Pink Panther series is also unsuccessful without the brilliant Sellers (who really died), vainly ape by the new protagonist, the incapable American investigator (Wass). The film boils down to a series of obvious quotes of themselves by the surviving characters.

title: The Pink Panther Strikes Again
actors: Peter Sellers, Herbert Lom, Lesley-Anne Down
description: Dreyfuss, Clouseau's irascible superior, is now locked up in an asylum. But he manages to escape and sets up a powerful organization that blackmails the world. Once again it is Clouseau who unwittingly puts a spanner in the works: he enters his refuge under the guise of a dentist, naturally takes out his healthy tooth, escapes Dreyfuss's new outburst and finally destroys it with a powerful laser beam.
notes: The fourth episode of Clouseau is one of the most successful: abandoned all likelihood, it is full of crackling ideas (there is also for Kissinger, presented as a stunned football fan). Almost a cartoon.

title: Paolo Barca, maestro elementare, praticamente nudista
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Magali Noël, Janet Agren
description: Paolo Barca, a young Milanese dedicated, in his spare time, to nudism, wins a competition for elementary school teacher. He was assigned a professorship in Catania, where he moved. Her arrival and her unconventional ways of doing things immediately made her the object of criticism from the director and desire from her colleagues. The serious troubles begin when Paolo teaches some sort of sex education course in class.
notes: The film, behind its apparent critique of social and racial prejudices between Northern and Southern Italy, is actually a light and vaguely itchy comedy.

title: Paolo il caldo
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Gastone Moschin, Ornella Muti, Rossana Podestà
description: Worthy scion of a noble Catania family, whose male representatives have always distinguished themselves for their assiduity in female conquests, even Paolo Castorini barely resists the call of the senses and, after his father's death by suicide (an exception in the family panorama ), he becomes completely a slave to it. Even marriage with a girl of very honest morals does not change it. Based on the unfinished novel by Vitaliano Brancati, the film gives little space to the existential conflict of the protagonist, focusing only on the grotesque and voyeuristic side. Vicario usually had the lightest hand.

title: Father's Little Dividend
actors: Spencer Tracy, Elizabeth Taylor, Joan Bennett, Don Taylor
description: The film is the sequel to "Father of the Bride", with his wife Carla (Taylor) announcing her upcoming motherhood and her father (Tracy) not at all thrilled to enter the grandparents category at such a young age. A little more trouble and, when the baby is born, things with the maternal grandfather do not go well at all: for him the baby is horrible and the baby, for its part, screams every time he sees him. It will take a big scare for everything to get better.
notes: The film is worth a little less than the previous one from which it starts. Although the script is a little fragile, it defends itself well thanks to the excellent cast.

title: Otac na sluzbenom putu
actors: Miki Manojlovic, Mirjana Karanovic, Moreno D'e Bartolli, Mira Furlan
description: Little Malik lives with his family in Sarajevo. Her dad, Mesa, never sees you at home and everyone says he's on a business trip. Mesa, on the other hand, is in prison because he is not in line with the Stalinist Yugoslavia of the time. Then 1948 passes, Tito's tear arrives and Mesa can finally get out of prison. The return to the family takes place on the occasion of a party and just as the Yugoslav national football team beats the Soviet one. Kusturica makes you cry, laugh, think about times gone by and ours. He also has time to win the well deserved Palme d'Or at Cannes.

title: Daddy Long Legs
actors: Fred Astaire, Leslie Caron, Terry Moore, Thelma Ritter, Fred Clark
description: The very rich Jervis Pendleton spends his time between travels, pleasant adventures and the direction of his jazz orchestra. Sent to France for an economic mission by the government, he has the opportunity to admire the young Julie who takes care of the orphans of a welfare institution and, without revealing herself, makes her study in a boarding school in Massachussets. Thus is born the love that flows into an inevitable marriage. Nice variant of the Cinderella story with musical ingredients, gently told by actors of great skill, especially the protagonist Fred Astaire, in an age no longer green. Choreography by Roland Petit, music by Johnny Mercer.

title: Million Dollar Mystery
actors: Eddie Deezen, Wendy Sherman, Tom Bosley, Kevin Pollak
description: Sydney Preston, a fugitive wanted by the police, consumes a bowl of spoiled chili in an Arizona restaurant. Before dying, he reveals to the diner patrons that he has hidden four million dollars in four different places. The only clue he reveals is that "we must start from the City of the Bridge".
notes: The treasure hunt as a pretext to put together unrelated gags has already been used, with very different results, in "This mad, mad, mad, mad world". Some spectacular scenes do not save the film, directed by an old and very good director, from anonymity.

title: What Did You Do in the War, Daddy?
actors: James Coburn, Dick Shawn, Giovanna Ralli, Sergio Fantoni
description: The company commanded by Captain Cash must take the village of Valerno, in Sicily. It is the day of the wine festival; the Italian captain Oppo offers surrender as long as the party can be celebrated in peace. After a night of partying, Americans and Italians fraternize, despite Oppo having discovered Cash in the bed of his girlfriend, Gina. The Germans intervene, who lock everyone up in the village stadium, but the prisoners manage to free themselves and organize another big party.
notes: Laughs, but nevertheless Edwards leads a fierce criticism of the war, through the unreserved praise of the ambushers.

title: Author Author
actors: Al Pacino, Dyan Cannon, Tuesday Weld, Bob Dishy
description: Playwright Ivan Travalian (Pacino) is abandoned by his second wife, Gloria (Weld), with five young children, four of whom are Gloria's and her former husbands. There is a comedy at stake that Ivan is unable to finish, an attempted relationship with the lead actress (Cannon) and, above all, the future of the whole lively tribe.
notes: The bright aspects of the comedy do not hide a certain underlying bitterness. Sparkling dialogue, fast pace and an Al Pacino in great shape.

title: The Poppy Is Also a Flower
actors: Trevor Howard, Angie Dickinson, Rita Hayworth, Marcello Mastroianni
description: The UN, worried about the spread of drug use, decides to intervene, unleashing secret agents. The first, however, is immediately eliminated. After radioactively "marking" a batch of opium, two other agents manage to follow its path until it reaches Europe on various markets. Given the extension, it will not be easy to dismantle the entire drug trafficking organization.
notes: The basic idea is rather rudimentary and the end result is not very exciting. Fleming made up the story and Young directed it, but nothing came out of it that looked like a "007". Don't be a super-luxurious cast.

title: Million Dollar Duck
actors: Dean Jones, Sandy Duncan, Joe Flynn, Tony Roberts
description: Professor Dooley, in the course of his research on animal intelligence, makes a sensational discovery: a duck who is accidentally subjected to a burst of X-rays and the barking of dogs, deposits solid gold eggs. At this point the dilemma arises: to accumulate the precious eggs until you have a fortune or sell them immediately.
notes: Typical Disney production for the use and consumption of children and their parents.

title: Papillon
actors: Steve McQueen, Dustin Hoffman, Don Gordon, Victor Jory
description: Papillon is convicted of murder and imprisoned in the Devil's Island prison in Guiana. Befriend Dega, a forger relegated with him to a swampy jungle. Here the living conditions are so unsustainable that Papillon tries to escape, but is caught back. He manages to stay alive only thanks to Dega, and tries to escape again, along with his friend and another companion. Papillon is captured again, in Venezuela. Brought back to the Devil's Island, which has become a human wreck, he finds Dega in the grip of madness. But the anxiety for freedom is stronger.
notes: From the novel by Henri Charrière, based on his true personal story, a spectacular film of great success directed with fairness but above all interpreted virtuosity by two great actors.

title: I pappagalli
actors: Aldo Fabrizi, Alberto Sordi, Peppino De Filippo, Titina De Filippo, Elsa Merlini
description: The Sunday of the maids of a Roman building under the watchful and good-natured eye of a janitor. Some "curtains" among the many: Angela tries to kill herself with gas after learning that her boyfriend has left her to marry another. A shy sailor would like to "board" a servant girl. He will succeed only with the good-natured complicity of the porter. Doctor Tanzi seduces Juliet as soon as his wife leaves him alone. A little later, in agreement with his wife, he fires her.
notes: Streams of pathetic skits, with fleeting appearances of the usual suspects of the Italian comedy: from the national Albertone to Fabrizi, to the De Filippo.

title: Il paramedico
actors: Enrico Montesano, Edwige Fenech, Leo Gullotta, Enzo Cannavale, Marco Messeri
description: Mario Miglio, a nurse at a large hospital, unexpectedly wins a luxury car in a lottery. He uses it to go out at night and go to the most chic clubs in the city. Unfortunately, the terrorists steal the car and use it for an action. Mile is arrested and jailed. He is saved with a fake confession, while his wife becomes rich by selling a fake memorial. After directing some erotic films in previous years, Nasca devotes himself with little success to comedy with ambitions of political satire. Montesano is wasted.

title: Parenthood
actors: Steve Martin, Mary Steenburgen, Dianne Wiest, Jason Robards, Rick Moranis, Martha Plimpton, Joaquin Phoenix
description: Sixteen characters from a family spanning three generations: those who grew up well and those less, those who raise their children with criteria and those who don't, those who have substantial problems and those who manage to take life with serenity, those who get into trouble and those who the troubles must be solved.
notes: A cast full of high-profile actors and a director specializing in comedies for a story that is a little too uplifting. The narrative rhythm is discreet; good dialogues.

title: Pari e dispari
actors: Terence Hill, Bud Spencer, Marisa Laurito, Salvatore Borgese, Luciano Catenacci
description: In Florida, a midshipman is tasked with putting an end to the business of a gambling gang. Johnny Firpo, head of the mission, however, knows nothing of the tricks of the trade; The friendship with the strong truck driver Charly who participates in the enterprise is decisive because he has discovered that Johnny is his brother.
notes: Leaving the western setting, the adventures of Spencer and Hill continue successfully, always the same. In the cast also a very young Marisa Laurito.

title: Paris brule-t-il?
actors: Gert Fröbe, Jean-Paul Belmondo, Orson Welles, Charles Boyer, Anthony Perkins, Leslie Caron, Alain Delon, Kirk Douglas
description: In 1944 Hitler orders the destruction of bridges and buildings in Paris. The Allies are approaching, the Resistance, without waiting for the arrival of the allied troops, organizes itself and takes the first victories over the Germans. In the meantime, thanks to the intervention of the Swedish consul, it is a truce. This allows Major Galois to join General Léclerc and prepare with him and the Americans the liberation of the capital.
notes: Good direction for a very solid screenplay (by Gore Vidal and a very young Francis Ford Coppola). Stellar cast. Not a masterpiece, but a show that stands up well.

title: Paris Holiday
actors: Bob Hope, Fernandel
description: An American actor, in Paris to obtain permission to interpret a lucky comedy from his author, is involved in an unclear and somewhat dangerous affair. Bizarre and semi -unknown farce that compares two international comedians, is directed by the son of Richard Oswald and boasts a partic of Preston Sturges as an actor!

title: Listen to Me
actors: Kirk Cameron, Jami Gertz, Roy Scheider, Amanda Peterson
description: Monica is the daughter of a bartender. Tucker, who has been in reformed, is the son of a breeder of chickens. Garson's father is senator and pushes because his son embraces his political career. All three study at Kenmont College and all three are part of the "debates group", the one that will challenge Harvard. But to win the final, Monica will be forced to reveal its dramatic secret. The fact that American colleges organize rhetoric tournaments with each other is already quite stupid. But what does not pass is Roy Scheider in the role of the professor.

title: La parmigiana
actors: Catherine Spaak, Nino Manfredi, Didi Perego, Salvo Randone, Lando Buzzanca
description: Dora lives with an uncle who is a priest. He seduces a seminarian on vacation and then goes with him to Riccione. Thus begins a sentimental pilgrimage that leads her into the arms of several men. When he decides to return with the one he really feels a little love for, he discovers that it is being maintained by an older woman. Dora then chooses the path of prostitution.
notes: During the boom years, Dora's story is a bitter and biting metaphor of Italy poised between petty bourgeois morality and a new unscrupulousness. A great little film signed by an author who is still underestimated.

title: 12 Angry Men
actors: Henry Fonda, Lee J. Cobb, Ed Begley, E. G. Marshall, Jack Warden
description: Twelve jurors met in council to decide the fate of an 18-year-old accused of murder. Eleven found him guilty. Only one, Davis, considers him innocent; since it is a possible death sentence, unanimity is required. With passionate eloquence and the rigor of his reasoning, Davis convinces the others one by one that the accusation does not hold up.
notes: Sidney Lumet's directorial debut, from a teleplay by Reginald Rose, is one of his best films. Everything takes place in a single environment, the characters are never schematic and the tension is very strong thanks to the perfect work of the performers, led by the antagonists Fonda and Lee Cobb.

title: Parola di ladro
actors: Gabriele Ferzetti, Abbe Lane, Andrea Checchi, Nando Bruno
description: Desiderio (Ferzetti) together with the beautiful accomplice Lalla (Lane) decides to steal a precious jewel by replacing it with an imitation. To succeed in the enterprise Lalla must seduce the owner of the jewel. But the girl really falls in love with the man and reveals the plan.
notes: Yellow-pink debut for Loy and Puccini, future directors of committed films. The story is funny, the setting in Umbertine Rome is beautiful, which gives the story a fairytale tone.

title: Take a Hard Ride
actors: Lee Van Cleef, Catherine Spaak, Fred Williamson
description: A large sum of money that must be brought from the United States to Mexico triggers the most varied appetites. Italian film shot in the Canary Islands. The old Dana Andrews is also seen in a small part, together with the "Fordian" Harry Carey jr.

title: Words and Music
actors: Mickey Rooney, Tom Drake, Janet Leigh, Gene Kelly, Cyd Charisse, June Allyson
description: The difficulties, the successes, the happy and even unfortunate loves of Larry Hart and Dick Rogers, two of the most famous songwriters in the history of the musical.
notes: It is a fictionalized biography with all the rigidity of the "genre", but it does not matter because the best of the film are the musical numbers. Don't miss an eight-minute long ballet with Gene Kelly and Vera Ellen.

title: La partita
actors: Matthew Modine, Jennifer Beals, Faye Dunaway, Corinne Cléry
description: We are in 1700 in Venice. After a long exile, the noble Francesco Sacredo returns to the city. Thus he learns that all the huge family fortune has been lost in the game by his father in grueling games with the Countess Matilde Von Wallenstein. The countess, who fell in love with the young Francesco, offers him a pact: to gamble all the assets, in exchange for the total availability of his life in case of loss. The Vanzinas try to get out of the realm of comedy, and adapt an adventure novel by Alberto Ongaro. The result is pure kitsch, which burns a luxury cast.

title: Neokonchennaya pyesa dlya mekhanicheskogo pianino
actors: Alexandr Kaljagin, Elena Solovej, Evgenja Glusenko, Nikita Mikhalkov
description: Platonov is a village teacher who, invited to the country house of a general's widow, meets the great love of his youth there. But she is married, and Platonov is also married to someone else. The attempt to revive the past is doomed to wreck miserably. Taken from a youthful work by Chekhov, the beautiful film made by the Russian actor-director Michalkov intertwines the sentimental aspect, told with delicacy of tones but also with irony theme of the clash between the lazy habits of the bourgeois environment and the anxiety for renewal, but always unrealistic.

title: Pasqualino Cammarata... capitano di fregata
actors: Aldo Giuffré, Ninetto Davoli, Sal Borgese, Agata Flori
description: Pasqualino Cammarata is the son of an admiral and grandson of a senator for life. This is why he has a career despite continuing to make trouble. In order not to harm he is placed in the Admiralty, but here too he proves to be a volcano of ideas. Extremely banal exotic-military comedy entrusted to the usual coarse-grained comedy.

title: Pasqualino Settebellezze
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Fernando Rey, Elena Fiore, Shirley Stoler
description: Pasqualino is a poor fellow who commits an honor killing. For this reason he is locked up in a criminal asylum, but leaves because of the war. He is captured and ends up in a German concentration camp where he commits another murder. At the end of the hostilities he returns to a tragically euphoric Naples that celebrates the arrival of the allies.
notes: The director likes "strong" situations and sometimes wallows in them without restraint. Here it is instead (almost) controlled and its protagonist has a dimension of desperate grandeur, in a grim, indifferent fresco. Four Oscar nominations, music by Enzo Jannacci.

title: Night Passage
actors: James Stewart, Audie Murphy, Elaine Stewart, Dan Duryea, Dianne Foster
description: Grant McLaine, justice of the peace, is tasked with confronting a gang of outlaws that rage across the territory by repeatedly assaulting trains. The Band also includes Grant's brother, Utica Kid. During the umpteenth robbery, the judge is wounded, but still chases the bandits, who have taken the wife of the railway director hostage. Grant joins the gang and, before the final confrontation, tries to convince his brother to change his life. Discreet "psychological" western. Initially Anthony Mann should have directed it, but he found the script too weak.

title: A Passage to India
actors: Judy Davis, Peggy Ashcroft, James Fox, Alec Guinness, Victor Banerjee, Nigel Havers, Richard Wilson, Antonia Pemberton, Art Malik, Saeed Jaffrey
description: Two women of good Victorian society left for India, the pearl of the British Empire. One is young and it is the first time she visits the country, the other is elderly and goes to visit her military son. In the land of dangerous suggestions for the icy English colonists, the young lady visits ancient caves, has a hysterical fit and accuses her Indian companion of sexual abuse. Majestic and crepuscular, it has the epos of the great 1940s productions with that much of modernity in the psychological delineation of the characters that enriches the plot. Oscar to supporting Peggy Ashcroft and music by Maurice Jarre.

title: The Heavenly Kid
actors: Lewis Smith, Jason Gedrick
description: Young Bobby accepts the same automotive challenge in which his father died. Father, in the form of an angel, assists him. Honey and predictable, a Christmas movie like a hundred others.

title: Passaporto rosso
actors: Isa Miranda, Filippo Scelzo, Ugo Ceseri, Tina Lattanzi
description: Maria is a woman who emigrated from Italy to Argentina. Here she meets a doctor, also Italian, and marries him. Their child was born in a foreign land and, once he grew up, refused to leave for Italy and join the army. At the outbreak of the First World War, his father will take on the role of the soldier, setting a good example for the boy.
notes: The film exudes fascist rhetoric from first to last image, and yet has moments of great interest. Because in those years the cinema was thought of with a capital "C" and the sense of melodrama was not lacking. Great Tina Lattanzi.

title: La passeggiata
actors: Renato Rascel, Valentina Cortese, Giuseppe De Martino, Enzo Maggio
description: Paolo Barbato is a young provincial who moves to Rome to teach the National College. On the Janiculum he accidentally meets a young girl of life with whom he falls madly in love. Despite learning of the young woman's not blameless conduct, Paolo clumsily tries to redeem her, ending up making a fool of himself with his work colleagues and arousing the anger of his direct superior, who decides to fire him. For his directorial debut Rascel chooses a short story by Gogol, but it is a task beyond his strength.

title: Passion
actors: Isabelle Huppert, Michel Piccoli, Hanna Schygulla
description: A stammering worker, a despotic factory owner, a Polish director who tries to recreate in the film he is making exact reproductions of famous paintings. The film fails to make itself, the worker is fired and the director drives back to Poland. It is a film of overwhelming beauty and not only for the paintings it recreates with loving precision: it is an essay, an erotic film and a feast for the eyes.

title: Passione d'amore
actors: Valeria D'Obici, Bernard Giraudeau, Laura Antonelli, Massimo Girotti
description: The fascinating cavalry captain Giorgio Bacchetti is the lover of a beautiful woman, Clara. Fosca also lives in the garrison, a girl with a horrible appearance and a tormented and sick soul who makes the captain fall in love with herself. On the death of Fosca the man falls prey to a deep depression.
notes: Based on a novel by Igino Ugo Tarchetti, it is an uncompromising study on passion, on the different and on their perverse intertwining. In the ungrateful role of the protagonist, Valeria D'Obici manages very well almost without makeup.

title: La passion de Jeanne d'Arc
actors: Renée Falconetti, Eugène Sylvain, Antonin Artaud, Michel Simon
description: Accused of heresy, Joan of Arc appears before the ecclesiastical tribunal. At the end of interrogations and torture, Giovanna gives in and signs the abjuration: but then withdrawn and therefore sentenced to death. Her hair is cut, the stake awaits her. But when the flames rise, the crowd rises ...
notes: The film profoundly innovated the cinematographic language, in particular thanks to the use of close-ups and the use of details. Although "old" by over eight decades, it still retains an extraordinary modernity. Even if he had only made this film, Dreyer would have deserved a very high place in the history of cinema.

title: Spanish Affair
actors: Richard Kiley, Carmen Sevilla, José Guardiola, Jesus Tordesillas
description: An American architect active in Spain takes a local girl to accompany him to complete a deal and falls in love with her. But she has to deal with the girl's suitor, to whom she was promised since childhood according to the gypsy custom. It is a commercial film shot by Siegel (used in much more realistic atmospheres) in a Spain whose landscape and monumental beauties are highlighted, complete with a flamenco singer and Goya's paintings. Spanish actress Carmen Sevilla warmly plays the lead role.

title: The Fallen Sparrow
actors: John Garfield, Maureen O'Hara, Walter Slezak, Patricia Morison
description: Dick (Garfield), who fought in Spain against Franco, returns to America and becomes embroiled in a group of Nazis posing as political refugees. The death of a friend, passed off as a suicide, puts him in alarm, and he must defend precious documents he is in possession of. Even at the risk of his life. Anti-Nazi propaganda thriller, shot in the middle of the war. The plot is a bit unlikely, but the suspense builds as you go and John Garfield is perfect.

title: Oregon Passage
actors: John Ericson, Lola Albright, Edward Platt, Jon Shepodd
description: Ever since Lieutenant Niles Ord kidnapped a girl from his tribe, Little Elk, for the purpose of marrying her, the relentless Black Eagle Indian chief has no rest. The opportunity presents itself with the arrival at the fort of Major Dane, accompanied by his wife Sylvia, who ends up in the hands of the Indians.
notes: Good and bad, losers and winners, everything is very clear from the beginning to the end, in homage to the most rigid and simplified stereotypes of the genre.

title: Le repas des fauves
actors: Francis Blanche, Antonella Lualdi
description: In a French town occupied by the Nazis, some friends meet for dinner. The commander of the SS introduces himself and demands, in retaliation, the delivery of two among those present, chosen at random. Everyone thus begins to accuse each other.
notes: The conflict is a pretext for a theatrical game of slaughter between bourgeois and cowardly diners.

title: Irvine, 14 luglio 1926 – West Hollywood, 15 settembre 2017)
actors: James Coburn, Kris Kristofferson, Bob Dylan, Richard Jaeckel, Katy Jurado, Chill Wills, Jason Robards, R. G. Armstrong, Luke Askew, John Beck, Richard Bright, Matt Clark, Rita Coolidge, Jack Dodson, Emilio Fernández, Harry Dean Stanton
description: Pat Garrett and Billy Kid have long been raiding companions. At one point, however, Garrett chose to cross over to the other side of the fence ("The country gets old and I want to grow old with it," he says), and accepts the sheriff's mandate offered to him by the settlers harassed by Billy's raids. In order not to clash with his friend, Pat offers Billy the chance to save himself by going to Mexico, but the invitation falls on deaf ears.
notes: Sam Peckinpah's masterpiece: a poignant elegy about the end of the Far West, more quiet and melancholy than previous masterpieces, but no less heartbreaking. John Coquillon's photography and Bob Dylan's famous music ("Knockin 'on Heaven's Door") are sublime. The version released in Italy at the time was a quarter of an hour less.

title: La patata bollente
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Edwige Fenech, Massimo Ranieri
description: Worker and trade unionist in the Enicem factory, Bernardo Mambelli is the spokesperson for his colleagues at the superiors, by whom he is particularly esteemed. One day he saves a certain Claudio from a beating by neo-fascists and takes him to his house. Claudio, however, is a homosexual and this wreaks havoc in Bernardo's life: the neighbors suspect him, his colleagues mock him. His fiancée marries him to silence the gossips.
notes: After "Il vizietto", several gay comedies followed. This is one of the nicest, most pleasant and well told, which almost never expires in vulgarity.

title: Stepfather II
actors: Terry O'Quinn, Meg Foster, Jonathan Brandis, Caroline Williams
description: A dangerous psychopath obsessed with finding the perfect family, responsible (in the previous film) for multiple murders, moves to a suburb and starts a smoky "marriage counselor" business. He therefore finds himself in a privileged position to meet (and eventually court) widowed or divorced women who are still attractive, his traditional goal. His choice falls precisely on one of his clients; history seems to have to repeat itself over and over again.
