Faint sequel to a 1987 film, he just repeats the situations without variations, treading his hand on the gruesome details.

title: Storm in a Teacup
actors: Vivien Leigh, Rex Harrison, Cecil Parker
description: The tyrannical mayor of an English village mistreats a poor peddler whose dog Patrizia has been kidnapped because she has not paid a tax. A journalist who is present at the scene makes a case in his newspaper. The mayor then sues the journalist. But at the trial he makes believe that he is married to the daughter of the mayor.
notes: Saville was one of the most respected British directors and producers of the 1930s. He mainly directed musicals, but even in this foray into the comic he demonstrates all his craft.

title: Patrocloo!... e il soldato Camillone grande grosso e frescone
actors: Pippo Franco, Piero Vida, Luciana Turina
description: Bruno Camillone, hired for a dirty business, leaves for abroad with a passport in the name of a certain Bruschetta who, at police checks, is called to arms. Thus ends up in the barracks ...
notes: The characters come from Arbore and Boncompagni's _Alto gradimento_, but the thickness is that of a joke.

title: Patton
actors: George C. Scott, Karl Malden, Michael Bates, Stephen Young
description: General Patton is a celebrated American World War II strategist. Among his most famous (and victorious) campaigns the battle of Tunisia at the command of the 7th army and the landing in Sicily. On each of these occasions, Patton proves military to the core, as passionate about war as he is horrified by the idea of ??peace.
notes: Schaffner (certainly helped by the screenplay by Edmund North and Francis Ford Coppola) avoids taking a stand, drawing an "ahistorical" figure that somehow anticipates Colonel Kurtz of "Apocalypse Now". The direction is balanced, perhaps a bit static in the action scenes but convincing when it tails off the character without emphasis. But "Patton" would not have been so successful without George C. Scott, who has an impressive adherence to the steel general. Seven Oscars: film, direction, screenplay, set design, editing, I am and of course lead actor.

title: "G" Men
actors: James Cagney, Ann Dvorak, Robert Armstrong, Margaret Lindsay, Lloyd Nolan
description: A young lawyer becomes a federal agent to avenge a friend. Great Cagney in a film that made history, marking the transition from the epic of the fascinating "public enemies" to G-men movies, centered on law enforcement. But the urban spaces, the violence, the pace and Cagney's snout are the same.

title: The Long and the Short and the Tall
actors: Richard Todd, Laurence Harvey, Richard Harris
description: A British patrol on a mission in the jungle captures a Japanese soldier. Only one of the seven members of the group opposes his execution. A war film based on a theatrical work, therefore not exactly full of action and twists.

title: Fort Vengeance
actors: James Craig, Rita Moreno Keith Larsen, Reginald Denny
description: Brothers Dick and Andy Ross take refuge in Canada, after the latter kills a man in a fight, and join the Redcoats police force. But Andy is a bad guy who takes advantage of his position to commit, unpunished, many serious crimes. His brother Dick, on the other hand, scrupulously fulfills his duty as a representative of the law. On the traditional lineage of many western films, both as regards the relationship between whites and aborigines and the progression of events, the film plays a lot on the Canadian setting. Pure B.

title: Back to Bataan
actors: John Wayne, Anthony Quinn, Beulah Bondi, Feli Franquelli
description: World War II: Colonel Madden is sent by the General Staff to the Philippines to organize the anti-Japanese resistance and prepare the American counter-offensive.
notes: War propaganda film made with a great sense of rhythm. Anthony Quinn is here at the first appearance of some importance.

title: La pattuglia sperduta
actors: Sandro Isola, Giuseppe Aprà, Giorgio Luzzatti, Annibale Biglioni
description: We are in March 1849, when Carlo Alberto is about to resume the war against the Austrians. Volunteers from all over Italy arrive in Piedmont determined to fight for independence from Austria. On the morning of March 20, a patrol is cut off in enemy territory, while the battle of Novara is about to begin: a dangerous adventure that will last three days and will end on the field where it was bitterly fought.
notes: A laudable and somewhat naive attempt to re-read the events of the Risorgimento starting from popular participation, according to the teaching of neorealism and against the most forbidden rhetoric of official history.

title: Paulo Roberto Cotechiño centravanti di sfondamento
actors: Alvaro Vitali, Carmen Russo, Mario Carotenuto, Franca Valeri
description: The Napoli team buys the Brazilian bomber Cotechiño. Jealous of his bursting girlfriend Lucelia, the center forward entrusts her to the surveillance of a plumber, his double. After many adventures, Cotechiño is even kidnapped: guess who will replace him in the match against Inter?
notes: Let's face it: Nando Cicero, director of "Ultimo tango a Zagarolo", was not too bad in his genre. But this "pierinoccesque" foray of his is just beyond good and evil. Alvaro Vitali recycles himself in barracks jokes and jokes, Franca Valeri is so wasted as to make crimes scream.

title: Fear
actors: Cliff De Young, Kay Lenz, Zoe Trilling, Scott Schwartz, Robert Factor
description: Four escapees wreak havoc with murders and kidnappings. A couple taken hostage also pays the price. Strong color film that uses excellent performers.

title: Hilda Crane
actors: Jean Simmons, Guy Madison, Jean-Pierre Aumont, Judith Evelyn
description: Russell has built up a social position and, also, quite a fortune, as a building contractor. Russell loves Hilda, a girl who poses as original, but who is actually fragile and romantic, like most of her peers. Russell's mother opposes their marriage, but the young man, to confront her with a fait accompli, marries in secret. At the news, the mother dies of a heart attack; this tragic event undermines the relationship between the two spouses and only a desperate gesture by Hilda, which has no tragic consequences, makes Russell return to his choices. Is happiness now really within reach?
notes: The film manages to keep itself away from any excess.

title: Fürchten und Lieben
actors: Fanny Ardant, Valeria Golino, Greta Scacchi, Paolo Hendel, Sergio Castellitto
description: Three sisters live in Pavia. The eldest married a married man, the second loves a young professor who dies in an accident, the last is unhappily married to a television comedian.
notes: Successful updating of _Tre sorelle_ by Anton Cechov: with some heaviness, but also with the tension and genuine civil sensitivity of the best von Trotta (also scriptwriter and scriptwriter, with Dacia Maraini).

title: Stage Fright
actors: Marlene Dietrich, Jane Wyman, Richard Todd, Michael Wilding
description: Johnny is suspected of killing the husband of his mistress Charlotte, a well-known variety star. She asks her friend Vera for help, telling her that Carlotta is actually the culprit. Vera tries to make her confess, in vain. But the killer is Johnny himself, instigated and "used" by Carlotta who actually has another lover: the case is dramatically resolved in a theater.
notes: Not much loved even by its author, it is considered a minor work in Hitchcock's filmography; but it is not without interest. To remember the deception of the initial flash back, filmed as if it corresponded to reality while it is a lie.

title: Fear in the Night
actors: Ralph Bates, Judy Geeson, Joan Collins, Peter Cushing
description: On the way to join her husband, Peggy is attacked by a stranger with an artificial arm. She is upset, but her husband doesn't believe her very much. Good thriller produced by Hammer Film, the English house specializing in horror. Sangster was Terence Fisher's screenwriter.

title: Nuts
actors: Barbra Streisand, Richard Dreyfuss, Eli Wallach, Karl Malden
description: Luxury caller Claudia Draper killed a mature customer who insisted on an extra performance when she could have simply raised the rate. His prestigious lawyer plays the card of insanity; she makes a fool of herself to show that she is not mad; but it will be the lawyer, acute and patient, who will save her from the accusation and from her much more fearful ghosts. Barbra Streisand is the superstar of the situation, surrounded by a bombproof cast (Dreyfuss, Wallach, Malden). Ritt is on the safe side: the screenplay is flawless and the direction of the actors is iron (but Streisand, to be honest, is a bit hysterical).

title: The Madwoman of Chaillot
actors: Katharine Hepburn, Yul Brynner, Danny Kaye, Giulietta Masina, Donald Pleasence
description: A group of men gathers in a bar in the district of Chaillot, in Paris, to discuss the founding of a new institution that offers them the opportunity to increase their power. The group is joined by a researcher who, having discovered oil underground in the city, convinces his nephew to plant a bomb in the municipality, guilty of denying him permission to drill. The young man does not feel up to it, throws the briefcase containing the bomb into the river and attempts suicide. He is picked up by Amelia, an extravagant woman everyone calls a countess.
notes: Based on a play by Giraudoux, the film fails to entertain. The cast of stars is wasted.

title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
actors: Matthew Broderick, Mia Sara, Alan Ruck, Jeffrey Jones, Jennifer Grey, Cindy Pickett, Lyman Ward, Edie McClurg, Charlie Sheen, Ben Stein
description: Ferris goes to high school rather reluctantly: to overcome boredom, he decides to skip the hated school lessons and go to Chicago. He is accompanied by his girlfriend Sloane and his friend Cameron in the Ferrari of the latter's father; and for even more fun, organize the affair by putting out the most unlikely motives. Despite the principal's investigations, everything will go smoothly.
notes: Hughes writes and directs a funny and fast-paced film, without however neglecting a series of sharp and disillusioned "side notes" on the end of adolescence. The photograph is by Tak Fujimoto, Jonathan Demme's usual collaborator.

title: History of the World - Part 1
actors: Mel Brooks, Dom DeLuise, Madeline Kahn, Harvey Korman, Cloris Leachman, Gregory Hines
description: The history of the world revisited in a demented key by Mel Brooks. The film features two long episodes (the adventures of the philosopher Comicus in Nero's court and those of a commoner during the French Revolution) and some interludes, including a judgment of the Holy Inquisition made as if it were a musical. In conclusion, a grotesque "coming soon" of a second part that has never been realized.
notes: World history from prehistoric times to the French Revolution, in episodes that are sometimes a little drawn out, but sometimes frankly amusing, directed and interpreted by Brooks. Around him the usual group of excellent character actors. Unforgettable the catchphrase: "it's nice to be the king".

title: L.A. Story
actors: Steve Martin, Victoria Tennant, Richard E. Grant, Marilu Henner, Sarah Jessica Parker
description: Harris K. Telemacher (Steve Martin) is the host of the weather forecast program for a Los Angeles television. In just one weekend, Harris learns that his girlfriend has been cheating on him for at least three years, then loses her job due to a wrong prediction and, soon after, finds love again in the guise of an English journalist who arrived there for. get an interview.
notes: The great comic talent of Steve Martin (here also a screenwriter) alone supports the whole film. But the contribution of director Mick Jackson, the lucky director of "Bodyguard", should not be underestimated.

title: Armed and Dangerous
actors: John Candy, Eugene Levy, Robert Loggia, Meg Ryan
description: Frank Dooley is such a clumsy cop that he gets kicked out by the police for unworthiness. Norman is such a cowardly lawyer that he gets thrown out of the register. Taken together, they can only face disasters even when they have to guard a mephitic landfill; the hour of the rescue is in any case near.
notes: The screenplay is by Harold Ramis (the director of "Ricomincio da capo"), but Lester's direction doesn't have the right pace and Loggia is totally wasted.

title: Fresh Horses
actors: Molly Ringwald, Andrew McCarthy, Patty D'Arbanville, Ben Stiller
description: Matt Larkin is a nice guy with a college degree on the way and a surgeon's daughter girlfriend. In short, she has no reason to run after Jewel who is twenty, or maybe sixteen, is innocent, but maybe she has a husband in the Navy who may have committed a murder or who may have raped Jewel herself. Eventually Matt and Jewel break up, but he still seems in love. With all the "maybe" of this story, three more films could be made. The subject comes from an off-broadway play, and it shows. The Ringwald-McCarthy duo is the same as Howard Deutch's Bella in Pink, but far less convincing.

title: Mad About You
actors: Claudia Christian, Joseph Gian, Adam West
description: A wealthy heiress meets a rock musician who works as a waiter in a restaurant during his free time. The two sympathize and the girl begins to frequent the club where he plays with his group. It is love, but her father does not want to know, forcing her to associate with other young people of the same social background. An adolescent fairy tale, even didactic in its structure and in the combination of elements.

title: Girls Happy
actors: Elvis Presley, Harold J. Stone, Shelley Fabares, Mary Ann Mobley
description: Rusty Wells is the leader of a musical group who is commissioned by the owner of the club where the group plays to move to a well-known seaside resort to ensure the safety of his daughter Valeria who spends her holidays there. Naturally by dint of guarding her, Rusty falls in love with her. Routine musical comedy.

title: Vision Quest
actors: Matthew Modine, Linda Fiorentino, Ronny Cox, Daphne Zuniga
description: Carla (Fiorentino) leaves from New Jersey and, thanks to a car that no longer works, moves to the Loudens' house in Spokane, Washington state. The young Louden (Modine) is engaged in winning a scholarship, but above all in achieving victory in the wrestling championship. The arrival of the beautiful Carla is not the best to be able to maintain concentration ...
notes: Not particularly inspired comedy directed with little enthusiasm by the director of "Malice", evidently more at ease with the thriller; Linda Fiorentino is still worth the ticket price. Madonna sings the title song.

title: Beyond the Forest
actors: Bette Davis, Joseph Cotten, David Brian, Ruth Roman
description: Rosa, a housewife married to a doctor in an American town, dreams of a better life in a big city. She becomes the lover of a Chicago industrialist, but when she decides to abandon her husband for her lover, he leaves her to get engaged to another woman. Rosa is now expecting a baby and when her lover reappears to take her back with him, she does not hesitate to kill a man aware of her secret and determined to blackmail her. Excessive and passionate melodrama as the sanguine Vidor liked, with a very intense interpretation by Bette Davis.

title: Peccato che sia una canaglia
actors: Sophia Loren, Marcello Mastroianni, Vittorio De Sica
description: The life of Paolo (Mastroianni), a quiet and indolent taxi driver, is turned upside down by the meeting with Lina (Loren), a beautiful commoner, skilled in pickpockets and petty scams. Lina and her family, disjointed like her, fascinate Paolo who does all he can to redeem the girl.
notes: Based on a short story by Moravia, the film is a witty comedy of costume, expertly narrated and rich in gimmicks. Loren wallows in the role, Mastroianni very bitter and sympathetic acts as a shoulder.

title: Lady Caroline Lamb
actors: Sarah Miles, Jon Finch, Richard Chamberlain, John Mills, Margaret Leighton
description: Sir William Lamb, a member of the English Parliament, marries Caroline Ponsonby despite her mother's ban. After casually meeting Lord John Byron, a poet in misery, the woman becomes his lover. Having achieved success Byron abandons the woman. Meanwhile, her husband has been appointed Governor of Ireland.
notes: It is a melodrama suffocated by the setting and the narrative system and not redeemed by the interpretation of Sarah Miles. The director was David Lean's screenwriter for his most spectacular films.

title: Original Sin
actors: Ann Jillian, Charlton Heston
description: After her son is kidnapped, a mother discovers that her father-in-law is a mala boss and possibly also responsible for the kidnapping.

title: Peccatori di provincia
actors: Renzo Montagnani, Macha Meril, Femi Benussi, Lauretta Masiero
description: Upon his death, the wealthy Emanuele Lo Cascio leaves all his possessions to his natural daughter Domitilla. The other relatives, greedy and indebted, try everything to rob her of the acquired wealth, but Domitilla, who is a nun, cares nothing about money. The setting is that of a small town in the South, where the film concentrates the worst national defects, making it the target of a satire full of heavy vulgarity. Excessive also to speak of Serie B.

title: Les tricheurs
actors: Pascale Petit, Jacques Charrier, Laurent Terzieff, Andréa Parisy
description: Bob, the young son of an industrialist, makes new friends, but lets himself be seduced by their cynicism and their amorality to the point of getting involved in organizing a blackmail. Marcel Carné tries to modernize his style, but the result is discontinuous. Soundtrack with songs by jazz masters. But in the same year Truffaut was already doing "The 400 hits" ...

title: La peccatrice
actors: Vittorio De Sica, Paola Barbara, Gino Cervi, Fosco Giachetti
description: Seduced and abandoned, she gives birth to a child who dies almost immediately. A young man is interested in her, but having known her past, she hunts. For her the world of vice opens up; only the death of an unfortunate companion will make her return home to her mother.
notes: The film crowns the directorial career of one of the most famous and appreciated authors of melodramas of the period. Solid and well directed, with tones of a certain realism, based on a screenplay by Barbaro-Chiarini-Pasinetti.

title: Susan and God
actors: Joan Crawford, Fredric March, Rita Hayworth, Ruth Hussey
description: After leaving her alcoholic husband, Susan participates in a kind of crusade of a pseudo-religious movement to redeem the world. Meanwhile, the husband stops drinking and thinks of marrying another woman and then Susan returns to the family. The story, scripted by Anita Loos, and the magnificent cast, make up a ferocious portrait managed with admirable elegance by the great Cukor.

title: Pecos è qui: prega e muori
actors: Robert Woods, Erno Crisa, Luciana Gilli, Pedro Sanchez
description: Pinto, Paco and Pepe, three buskers, arrive in a Mexican village after the men of El Supremo, an exalted man who believes himself the heir of Montezuma, have sowed death and destruction. The only survivor of the massacre gives them the map of the treasure of Montezuma, hidden in the ruins of the temple of Teacoco where the band of El Supremo has its headquarters. The three players ask for the help of Pecos, a gunfighter.

title: Peggio per me... meglio per te
actors: Little Tony, Katia Kristina, Gianni Agus, Aldo Puglisi, Maria Pia Conte, Antonella Steni
description: Tony, a young and exuberant airline pilot, is engaged to Marisa. Despite this, he never misses an opportunity to (successfully) woo all the skirts, and there are many, that he meets in his numerous movements. This behavior, however, earned him the reproaches of his superiors but, one day, the commander of the plane is taken ill and only Tony's ability saves the plane.
notes: It is one of the typical films in vogue in the sixties, built around the figure of a singer. In this case it's Little Tony.

title: Peggy Sue Got Married
actors: Kathleen Turner, Nicolas Cage, Barry Miller, Catherine Hicks, Joan Allen, Kevin J. O'Connor, Jim Carrey, Lisa Jane Persky, Lucinda Jenney, Wil Shriner, Barbara Harris, Don Murray, Sofia Coppola, John Carradine, Maureen O'Sullivan, Leon Ames, Helen Hunt, Glenn Withrow, Marshall Crenshaw
description: We are in 1985, at the party of the former graduates in 1960. Peggy Sue, elected queen of the evening, passes out when she sees Charlie, the husband with whom she is filing a divorce. When he awakens, he finds himself in 1960! With the awareness of maturity he relives his adolescence, friendships, life with his parents, his love affair with Charlie.
notes: A commissioned film, in which Coppola, despite the light atmosphere and the abused pretext of the leap in time, enriches the show with brilliant and profound ideas of cinema: Turner remains bewildered, with a forty-year-old body, wandering among the ghosts of his past.

title: La pelle
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Burt Lancaster, Claudia Cardinale, Ken Marshall, Alexandra King, Carlo Giuffrè
description: Based on one of Curzio Malaparte's most famous novels, it is the story of a descent into the hellish circles of Naples in '44. General Cork, commander of the American Fifth Army, is completely involved in negotiations with the Camorra Marzullo who demands a payment per kilo to deliver 112 Germans. The intermediary to conduct the negotiations is Curzio Malaparte who, to please the aviator wife of a senator, has to organize a sumptuous Renaissance-style dinner. Meanwhile, in the lowlands, mothers sell their children to Moroccans.
notes: A fake-transgressive Cavani between bad taste and boredom.

title: Pelle erobreren
actors: Max Von Sydow, Pelle Hvenegaard, Björn Granath
description: In the nineteenth century, many left Sweden, a poor and desolate land, to go to work in prosperous Denmark. Eleven-year-old Pelle (Hvenegaard) arrives here with Lasse (Von Sydow) his father with the intention of securing a somewhat more satisfying future. Hired on a farm, the two "strangers" are sent to the stables.
notes: The film, based on the novel of the same name by Martin Andersen Naxo, is of a pompous and licked academicism, with naturalistic pretensions and poetic moments. Surprisingly he won the Palme d'Or at Cannes in 1988 and the Oscar for best foreign film.

title: The Fugitive Kind
actors: Marlon Brando, Anna Magnani, Joanne Woodward, Victor Jory, Maureen Stapleton, Victor Jory, R. G. Armstrong, Emory Richardson
description: In a small town in the "Deep South" comes Val, a young man with a turbulent past. The mature Lady Torrence falls in love with him, unmarried to an elderly, wicked and sick man. Lady hires Val in his emporium and becomes his lover, although the young and alcoholic Carol has her eyes on him. Lady's husband, however, discovers his wife's betrayal and ponders revenge on the lovers.
notes: From the play "Orpheus Descending" by Tennessee Williams, Lumet exacerbates the murky atmospheres of the text and the strong conflicts of characters steeped in hatred or doomed to defeat. Anna Magnani in the American version is a bit bewildered.

title: Pendulum
actors: George Peppard, Jean Seberg, Richard Kiley, Charles McGraw
description: A police officer (Peppard) is accused of killing his wife (Seberg) and her lover. The man, on the other hand, suspects that the crimes were committed by a murderous maniac (Lyons) whom he himself had had arrested and who had been released following a legal quibble.
notes: Melodramatic detective that starts very well but ultimately disappoints. Good soundtrack by Walter Scharf. Well done Peppard and Jean Seberg.

title: Penelope
actors: Natalie Wood, Ian Bannen, Peter Falk, Dick Shawn, Lila Kedrova
description: Penelope is the bored wife of a wealthy and busy bank president. Feeling neglected, the woman decides to dress up as an old woman, takes a gun and goes to rob her husband's bank. Paradoxically, the blow succeeds and of course no one suspects that it is her. When she confesses no one believes her.
notes: Pleasant comedy, although with the cast names perhaps it was fair to expect something more from a skilled theater director like Arthur Hiller.

title: Penne nere
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Marina Vlady, Camillo Pilotto, Enzo Staiola
description: In the village of Stella, close to a large dam on the Carnic border, the love between Pieri and Gemma is born. The outbreak of the Second World War deprives Stella of all men, called to arms. Pieri also follows the fate of his fellow villagers. During his absence, the village is heavily bombed and Gemma's father dies.
notes: A war film dripping with rhetoric out of time with respect to the Fascist era. Very young, but already good, the famous protagonists.

title: Pensando a te
actors: Al Bano, Romina Power, Francesco Mulè, Nino Taranto, Riccardo Garrone, Yvonne Sanson, Paolo Villaggio, Isabella Biagini
description: Husband, father and engineer, Carlo Albani (Al Bano) has become a song star and is preparing for a tour in the United States with Filippo Puglisi, his advisor and impresario. On the eve of their departure, the two yield to the more or less disinterested graces of two women, but are discovered by their wives.
notes: Second film for the couple Al Bano-Romina, with the participation of an unknown Paolo Villaggio. You pass for Albano in the role of the singer and in those of dad, but as an engineer we are not really there!

title: Pensavo fosse amore invece era un calesse
actors: Massimo Troisi, Francesca Neri, Angelo Orlando, Marco Messeri
description: Cecilia and Tommaso are about to get married, but she pulls back at the last moment. Tomaso is too lazy, she says that in the meantime she begins a relationship with another, a certain Aeneas (Messeri). Poor Tomaso manages to win it. Preparations begin again, but this time it is he who is seized by doubts.
notes: More than a comic film, this is a small "conte erotic". There are characters who come and go commenting on some aspects of love. There are moments of comedy and moments of narrative fatigue. Excellent Neri, usual Troisi star.

title: Pensiero d'amore
actors: Mal, Silvia Dionisio, Angela Luce, Pietro De Vico, Pippo Franco
description: Reg, an English boy, hitchhiking to Rome in the car of a noblewoman, Adriana, who invites him to dinner. Meanwhile, he meets Leone, a young man who offers him hospitality in exchange for English lessons. Called to the bedside of a dying uncle, Leone instructs Reg to warn his girlfriend Paola of his absence. The two spend the evening in a club, but when it comes to paying, Reg, who has no money, offers to sing.
notes: Mal dei Primitives sings some of his most famous songs in his characteristic Italian with an English cadence.

title: Pokayaniye
actors: Avtandil Makharadze, Iya Ninidze, Ketevan Abuladze, Zeinab Botsvadze, Edisher Giorgobiani, Kakhi Kavsadze, Merab Ninidze, Nino Zaqariadze, Nano Ochigava, Boris Tsipuria
description: Varlam is a tyrant who sums up the dictators of history (Hitler mustache, Mussolini's black shirt, a bit of Stalin), who rules in Georgia with cruelty and ignorance. Pursued a Christian artist, eliminates a Jewish couple, humiliates an old man from the party. All told through a long flash back reported by Kete, a woman who takes revenge on the tyrant's misdeeds by unearthing his corpse several times. With a positive but extremely bitter conclusion, this film uses the grotesque and parody to unmask the horror of the Soviet system, playing the game with intelligence and clarity.

title: Il pentito
actors: Franco Nero, Tony Musante, Max Von Sydow, Eric Estrada
description: The mafioso Vanni Ragusa, belonging to one of the losing clans, having seen his son and brother killed, decides to collaborate with a magistrate. Even among the robes, however, there is no shortage of corrupt and colluding with the winning clans so that the danger looms more than before. This story is intertwined with that of the crack of the financier Spinola, in turn linked to the mafia whose capital he "cleans up".
notes: The film would like to reconstruct some of the darkest Italian events of the seventies: the character of Spinola overshadows that of the financier Sindona and Ragusa refers to Buscetta, and guess who should be the bearded judge named Falco. Unfortunately, the basic thesis is absurd and Squitieri's direction is very vulgar. Small part for Rita Rusic.

title: Pepi, Luci, Bon y otras chicas del montón
actors: Carmen Maura, Olvido Gara, Eva Siva, Felix Rotaeta, Cecilia Roth
description: A girl raped by a policeman becomes friends with a punk who has a love affair with the wife of the same policeman. Debut for Almodóvar who has never been so vulgar and unstoppable. Nightlife air.

title: Peppino, le modelle e... chella llà!
actors: Peppino De Filippo, Teddy Reno, Giulia Rubini, Gino Bramieri, Massimo Serato
description: The painter Teddy, a well-known cascamorto, causes the dismissal of a young maid, Elisabetta. To repair, he welcomes her into his home, arousing the envy of Peppino, a down-and-out colleague always on the hunt for sentimental adventures. The girl's father and brother mistake Peppino for Teddy and teach him a sound lesson.
notes: A thin comedy of misunderstandings that offers Teddy Reno the opportunity to perform in some ditty. Respectable cast (which also includes Gino Bramieri in a tasty part); but the real engine of the action remains the irrepressible Peppino De Filippo.

title: Per amore
actors: Michael Craig, Capucine, Janet Agren, Lilla Brignone, Tino Carraro
description: The wife of a great pianist finds herself suffering from a mysterious disease. Then she discovers that her husband, unaware of her tragedy, is having a good time with another and, still without telling him anything about the illness, he ruins the party.
notes: Pretentious meatloaf co-served by the writer Giuseppe Berto.

title: For Whom the Bell Tolls
actors: Gary Cooper, Ingrid Bergman, Akim Tamiroff, Katina Paxinou
description: We are in the middle of the Spanish civil war. Robert is an American anti-Franco volunteer; leaning on a group of local republicans he must blow up a bridge to prevent the intervention of enemy troops. He will also be helped in his mission by the young and beautiful Mary with whom he falls in love.
notes: Hemingway, author of the book of the same name, did not like the film's insistence on romantic implications. However, "For Whom the Bell Tolls" remains fascinating for its themes (the Ideal, Death, Impossible Love), and for the cast. Screenplay by the great Dudley Nichols ("Red Shadows").

title: Ruthless People
directors: Jim Abrahams, David Zucker, Jerry Zucker
actors: Danny DeVito, Bette Midler, Helen Slater, Judge Reinhold, Bill Pullman
description: A wealthy industrialist, Sam Stone, hates his wife and plans to kill her. The woman, however, is kidnapped by a couple of fools as inexperienced spouses. Sam can't believe he got rid of it and, of course, refuses to pay the ransom. The woman, a real crone, proves unbearable for the kidnappers themselves.
notes: The trio Zucker, Abrahams, Zucker, abandon the wild comedy tones of the "Craziest Plane in the World". The style remains zany and ensures fun. Excellent graphics of the opening titles.

title: For Keeps
actors: Molly Ringwald, Randall Batinkoff, Kenneth Mars
description: A student couple with big plans for the future has to deal with an unexpected baby. Pink comedy directed by an eclectic veteran, but with script and actors not fully up to par

title: Per il gusto di uccidere
actors: Craig Hill, George Martin, Peter Carter, Diana Martin, Franco Ressel
description: Lanky Fellow is a bounty killer who lives by keeping an eye on the transports of valuables that travel from one Western bank to another. In Omaha, the mining tycoon Collins offers him to invest the ten thousand dollars he has just earned to secure his gold deposit in the local bank.
notes: In his debut film, Valerii, former assistant director of Sergio Leone, shows temperament; if the show is mediocre the fault is not his, but the ramshackle script.

title: Thunder Over the Plains
actors: Randolph Scott, Lex Barker
description: Immediately after the end of the Civil War, Captain David Porter is destined to garrison a remote garrison in Texas and decides to take his young wife with him. Porter must beware of the dirty maneuvers of Belfour, who exploits the cotton farmers. When the revolt breaks out, the captain is forced to intervene.
notes: Western series B directed with solid craft by a professional like the Hungarian De Toth. Nothing new, but the clichés are all respected.

title: Per le antiche scale
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Françoise Fabian, Marthe Keller, Barbara Bouchet
description: In the Thirties a psychiatrist convinced that the drift towards madness has begun for him, decides to run for cover in a rather anomalous way. It tries to isolate the bacillus of the disease.
notes: The best thing about the film is the cast: heterogeneous, well directed, excellent in individual rehearsals. Mastroianni loved the part very much because it is based on a novel dear to him, "Per le antica stairs" by Mario Tobino. Bolognini's direction is sometimes a little affected. Soundtrack by Ennio Morricone.

title: Per pochi dollari ancora
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Dan Vadis, José Calvo, Jacques Herlin, Jacques Sernas
description: A Southern major does not lay down his arms and goes to great lengths to assault and rob Fort Yuma. Giuliano Gemma, alias Montgomery Wood, who passed himself off as an American, stops him.
notes: Those were the golden years of spaghetti westerns, and the excellent craftsman Ferroni got by with little money and some ideas.

title: Per qualche dollaro in più
actors: Clint Eastwood, Lee Van Cleef, Gian Maria Volonté, Klaus Kinski, Mario Brega, Luigi Pistilli, Aldo Sambrell, Benito Stefanelli, Luis Rodriguez, Panos Papadopulos, Mara Krupp, Joseph Egger, Roberto Camardiel, Lorenzo Robledo
description: A bounty hunter, poncho on his shoulders and an eternal cigar in his mouth, associates with a much more distinguished but equally ruthless colleague to hunt down the Indian. He is a ferocious outlaw who, escaped with the help of his cronies, organizes a robbery at the El Paso bank. But it won't get very far.
notes: After the amazing success of for a handful of dollars Leone proposes his characters. Excessive and baroque, master of a style immediately recognizable among the many imitators already at work, Leone consolidates his fame. To remember Volonté in the role of the biased and the appearance of Klaus Kinski, Gobbo and neurotic.

title: For Love or Money
actors: Kirk Douglas, Thelma Ritter, Mitzi Gaynor, Gig Young
description: Ms. Cloe, an eccentric billionaire, entrusts her lawyer, Deke Gentry, with the marriage destiny of her three daughters, whom she intends to marry according to her tastes. The lawyer happily manages to settle the first two, with a tax expert and a lawyer. The third is supposed to marry an industrialist, but it is Deke who falls in love with her.
notes: Comedy that takes place according to situations and characters thoroughly tested by the Hollywood tradition. The cast is brilliant, the script works just enough: everything goes as it should and the viewer has fun, but in moderation.

title: Per un pugno nell'occhio
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Lina Rosales, Francisco Moran
description: Franks and Ingrassia are two representatives of guns in the Far West. Franco's sudden passion for a maid reveals the adulterous relationship between the mistress and a cavalry captain. This caused pandemonium in the country which, until then, was famous for its tranquility. Thus a fierce battle is unleashed which the two friends manage to escape thanks to a stratagem. One of the many western parodies of Franco and Ciccio, and not the best.

title: Per una bara piena di dollari
actors: Hunt Powers, Gordon Mitchell, Ray Saunders, Klaus Kinski
description: Returning from the Civil War, John Hamilton finds his house destroyed and his family massacred. A carillon is the clue that leads him on the trail of the gang of the evil Hagen, a violent man who built his fortune thanks to robberies and murders. With the help of a bounty hunter, John eliminates Hagen and his entire gang and frees the beautiful Monica, who has been kidnapped by Hagen for ransom. Mediocre Western directed by Fidani who, before this, had already worked on the Sartana series. In the cast, the "muscle man" Mitchell and the ubiquitous Kinski.

title: Per vivere meglio, divertitevi con noi
actors: Monica Vitti, Johnny Dorelli, Renato Pozzetto
description: Film in three episodes. In the first, a woman, after suffering violence from seven Himalayan Sherpas, develops an incurable aversion to sex. An alleged "extraterrestrial", who is actually a Swedish young man hired by her husband, manages to heal her. In the second, a man, convinced by a colleague, decides to test his wife's fidelity and risks getting shot. In the third, the owner of a racehorse manages to make him win a race and thus solves all his economic problems.
notes: Tired epigone of the films shot by several hands very popular in the sixties. Contrary to what the title promises, nobody is having fun.

title: Proc?
actors: Jiri Langmajer, Jan Potmesil, Pavlina Pourkova
description: On the way between Slovakia and Bohemia, a train is ransacked by Sparta fans. Effective Czechoslovakian film about the violence of football supporters.

title: Why Me?
actors: Christopher Lambert, Christopher Lloyd, Kim Greist
description: A skilled thief finds himself on his heels from cops (and criminals) from all over the world.
notes: Lambert frolics among high-end physical numbers with no stunt double. But the detective comedy does not adequately mix its souls, although you find it non-trivial.

title: Perché si uccide un magistrato
actors: Franco Nero, Françoise Fabian, Pier Luigi Aprà, Giancarlo Badessi, Eva Czemerys
description: After gathering precise information from a friend of police commissioner, from a tabloid newspaper and from a mafia builder, the young director Giacomo Solaris shoots _Investigation on the Palace of Justice_ and presents it in Palermo, causing a stir. The film in fact clearly portrays the figure and the misdeeds of Alberto Traini, a high magistrate who is killed shortly after. Overwhelmed by guilt, Solaris investigates ...
notes: One of the many products in vogue in the early seventies that mess with the political denunciation and the themes of costume, despite the undoubted solidity of Damiani's direction.

title: Perché uccidi ancora
directors: José Antonio de la Loma, Edoardo Mulargi
actors: Antonio De Teffé, Ida Galli, Pepe Calvo
description: In an attempt to avenge his father killed by the Lopezes, Steven McDougall kills an unknown number of people. Old Lopez hires a killer named El Gringo who, en passant, kills a soldier. Steven is charged with the murder. Western spaghetti of Italian production, shot in Spain by a Spanish director (de La Loma) together with another Italian (Mulargia). Although in truth neither country should have any interest in claiming paternity.

title: The Parallax View
actors: Kenneth Mars, Warren Beatty, Hume Cronyn, William Daniels
description: Journalist Joe Frady investigates the murder of a senator, a case that has been archived for years on which no full light has ever been brought to light. The investigation leads him to the Parallax Corporation, behind whose facade hides a killer agency. Frady gets hired, gets involved in the murder of another politician, and is himself killed by a Parallax hitman. The commission of inquiry determines that the culprit of both killings is ...
notes: With some intricacy in the plot, but with a high rate of suspense, the film explicitly refers to the murders of John and Bob Kennedy. The concluding sequence is memorable, while the photograph by Gordon Willis is remarkable.

title: The Biscuit Eater
actors: Earl Holliman, Lew Ayres, Godfrey Cambridge, Pat Crowley
description: A hunting dog breeder has a very nice and enterprising son who dedicates himself body and soul to a dog he cared for and baptized Perdipiù. The dog is very good but he has a vice: he loves looking for nests and eating eggs. Nonetheless, the boy enrolls him in a competition where he could win, only to withdraw him from the final fearing that he will damage his father's work.
notes: Lazy comedy by Walt Disney and directed by veteran McEveety.

title: Mahler
actors: Robert Powell, Giorgiana Hale, Lee Montague, Miriam Karlin, Rosalie Crutchley, Gary Rich, Richard Morant, Angela Down, Antonia Ellis, Ronald Pickup, Peter Eyre, Dana Gillespie, George Coulouris, David Collings
description: Gustav Mahler's last train journey, ill with septicemia, is an opportunity to recall some episodes of his life. Russel exaggerates as usual in tones, but composes moments of great charm.

title: Something to Live for
actors: Ray Milland, Joan Fontaine, Teresa Wright, Richard Derr
description: Alan Miller (Milland) works in an advertising agency. In the past he had problems with alcohol, but today he is clean and tries to help others stop drinking. This is how he meets Jenny (Fontaine), an alcoholic actress due to a love disappointment. Alan helps Jenny, Jenny gets help, the two look each other in the eye, but they don't go any further because Alan is married. It looks a bit like the sequel to Days Lost, Wilder's film in which Ray Milland had a lot of problems with alcohol. With the difference that Wilder never cared too much for his family.

title: Perdono
actors: Caterina Caselli, Fabrizio Moroni, Laura Efrikian, Nino Taranto
description: Federico, his girlfriend Laura and her cousin Caterina work in a department store. The three get along in love and well together until Caterina discovers her uncommon vocal skills and decides, with success, to attempt an artistic career. When Federico, some time later, meets Caterina in a language course, he feels a dangerous sympathy for her for his relationship with Laura.
notes: It is a sort of film-song, which seems to be in fashion, with the omnipresent Fabrizio Moroni who for years has been seen as strenuously engaged by Fizzarotti. Luckily there are the songs of Caselli.

title: Perfect
actors: Jamie Lee Curtis, John Travolta, Anne De Salvo, Marilu Henner
description: Adam, a "Rolling Stone" reporter, is preparing an important interview when he is sent to California for an article on aerobics. He discovers an environment that is anything but clean, also thanks to the revelations of an instructor he falls in love with. He promises not to involve her, but then finds himself caught between certain FBI investigations and the scoop needs of his newspaper.
notes: Bridges ("The Chinese Syndrome") takes it out here with the mass media, the police apparatus, the speculations in the world of gyms. Travolta tries hard, but the real "presence" of the film remains Jamie Lee Curtis.

title: Treacherous
actors: C. Thomas Howell, Adam Baldwin, Tia Carrere
description: Tommy and Micky, two young friends, work in the world of motors. One bad day Tommy finds himself confined to a wheelchair due to a serious accident. Covering themselves with debts, the two friends open a hotel in Mexico, but things get terribly complicated here.
notes: Television yellow without polish. The story, however, holds up fairly well. Without infamy and without praise.

title: Legal Eagles
actors: Robert Redford, Debra Winger, Daryl Hannah, Brian Dennehy
description: A girl, Chelsea Deardon, is accused of theft of paintings: it is those of her father, a very famous painter who died eighteen years earlier in the fire of his house. The girl is defended by the enterprising Laura Kelly, who is joined by the old fox of the forum Tom Logan. The two between disagreements and misunderstandings, ambushes and explosions, will end up falling in love.
notes: Smoothly transitioned from the demented science fiction of the "Ghostbusters" to the yellow-pink comedy, Reitman packs a decent film, if a bit cumbersome in plot. The professional duets and the squabbles between the two performers are the real spice of the story.

title: Les perles de la couronne
actors: Jaqueline Delubac, Sacha Guitry, Lynn Arding
description: It is the story through the centuries of seven pearls originally donated by Pope Clement VII to his niece, Queen Catherine de 'Medici for her marriage to the Dauphin of France. Pseudo-historical fantasy written, directed and performed by an inspired Giutry, who creates hilarious moments and plays with historical and verbal paradoxes.

title: Pearl of the South Pacific
actors: Virginia Mayo, Dennis Morgan, David Farrar
description: Three friends, two men and a woman, leave for a remote Pacific island where some precious black pearls should find themselves. The island is governed by a white one, which is now part of the tribe of the natives, whose son falls in love with the woman. Minor adventure movie for the Dwan veteran.

title: Permette? Rocco Papaleo
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Lauren Hutton, Tom Reed, Margot Novak
description: Rocco Papaleo, who emigrated to America to make his fortune as a boxer, finds himself after 20 years as an elevator operator in a mine. He goes to Chicago to attend a match and meets a model, who takes him home on a whim; but Rocco is deluded and decides to stay in the city for a few days. Because of his naivety and his good heart, all sorts of things happen to him; will be the insults of the girl, in the end, to open his eyes. The grotesque tone of the story does not mask the desperation. US satire is provincial, but Mastroianni is good.

title: Permettete signora che ami vostra figlia?
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Bernadette Lafont
description: Gino Pistone, manager of a provincial company, makes ends meet as best he can. The company is dissolved by the lead actress and he, to reunite it, has a stroke of genius: to stage the story of Mussolini and his latest lover, Claretta Petacci. The idea works, and Pistone identifies himself too much in the role of the Duce.
notes: Polidoro's satirical intentions, while evident, often fail. Tognazzi making Pistone making Mussolini is the only thing that can be saved.

title: Perseo l'invincibile
actors: Richard Harrison, Anna Ranalli, Arturo Dominici, Elisa Cegani
description: The kingdom of Cepheus is extorted by Acrisius, the usurper who reigns over Argos. Proud shepherd, Perseus is the heir to the rightful throne, but he doesn't know it. Falling in love with Andromeda, daughter of Cepheus, he rushes to Argos to save her from the hands of the son of Acrisius who has kidnapped her, and is recognized by his mother who reveals her birthplace to him. He will become king and happy bridegroom after killing the Medusa. From a (too) eclectic director of our B series, a fantasy film with all the coarseness of the genre, and without its quirks.

title: Personal Services
actors: Julie Walters, Alec McCowen, Shirley Stelfox, Dave Atkins
description: Christine Painter, a restaurant waitress, opts for a "working" quality leap to support her son at his studies. After hitting the sidewalks for a while, he sets up a luxury brothel. High-ranking clientele in search of perverse pleasures. When she is discovered, she faces the trial with Olympic serenity as the frequenters of her "maison" include, among others, several judges of the High Court.
notes: Former Monthy Python Terry Jones goes wild giving us the picture of good England as an acolyte of elderly perverts that our heroine is right to exploit. Caustic even if not as disruptive as the films of the group, with amused actors.

title: The Toast of New Orleans
actors: Mario Lanza, Kathryn Grayson, David Niven, Rita Moreno
description: A young man from the last century is a fisherman in the Mississippi delta area and dotes on music. When a famous singer arrives in New Orleans she succeeds in following in her footsteps and becomes a professional singer, renouncing - pushed by her - crude habits and popular behavior. But then she realizes she preferred him as he was before. Comedy made to measure for Mario Lanza, a successful Italian-American tenor, flanked by the capricious beauty of Kathryn Grayson, accompanied by a funny and vainly in love caretaker (Niven). Of course, songs, opera arias and love duets abound.

title: A Fish Called Wanda
actors: Jamie Lee Curtis, Kevin Kline, John Cleese, Michael Palin, Maria Aitken
description: Ken's apartment, an animal-friendly stutterer, is the base for a colossal diamond robbery. The gang is made up of George, boss and mastermind of the coup, his lover Wanda, and a thug named Otto. After the hit, Wanda together with Otto causes George to be arrested, but the safe where the diamonds should be is empty. Archie, George's lawyer, enters the field at this point. British film veteran Charles Crichton meets two ex-Monty Pythons, a sexy bombshell Jamie Lee Curtis and a talented Kevin Kline: the comedic result is memorable.

title: Gunn
actors: Craig Stevens, Laura Devon, Edward Asner, Albert Paulsen, Sherry Jackson
description: After The Pink Panther and A Shot in the Dark, Blake Edwards tries to direct a "serious" detective, in which a "serious" detective, former hero of a television series, investigates the murder of a mafia boss. Witty, easy-going and with a very pleasant 60's air, he is not, however, one of the best things of the director. Better the coeval TV series (from which the film is based).

title: Pia de' Tolomei
actors: Germana Paolieri, Carlo Tamberlani
description: Pia de 'Tolomei secretly hosts her brother, banned from Siena. Meanwhile, a treacherous friend convinces her husband - who has just returned from the war - that the woman is unfaithful to him: in reality, she pushes him to abandon her in order to seduce her ...
notes: A drama in strong colors, which holds up thanks to the unusually measured acting. The dialogues (little measured, however) are by the playwright Pier Maria Rosso di San Secondo.

title: Goodbye Again
actors: Ingrid Bergman, Yves Montand, Anthony Perkins, Jessie Royce Landis, Lee Patrick
description: Paula Tessier, a 38-year-old interior designer, is engaged to Renzo De Marco two years her junior, a selfish man who constantly cheats on her. One day she meets a boy she feels irresistibly attracted to and so she ends up accepting his court. Renzo, annoyed by Paula's abandonment, tries in every way to win her back and scores to such an extent that the woman agrees to marry him.
notes: Based on the novel of the same name by Françoise Sagan and scripted by Samuel Taylor, the film is a superficial comedy that is saved only thanks to the actors and beautiful costumes.

title: Skin Deep
actors: John Ritter, Vincent Gardenia, Alyson Reed, Joel Brooks, Julianne Phillips
description: Zach, a successful writer, has two passions in life: alcohol and women. He is flirting with a girl, but is discovered by his furious lover, Angie, just before all three are discovered by Alex, his wife. This is followed by the obvious divorce, visits to the psychoanalyst, more women, more alcohol ...
notes: It's not the best thing about Blake Edwards even if the times are not always the right ones and his typical bad things always hit the mark. But there are at least two sequences to remember. The one in which Zach is abused by his ex-lover and the one in the dark with fluorescent condoms.

title: I piaceri dello scapolo
actors: Mario Carotenuto, Memmo Carotenuto, Sylva Koscina
description: Two middle-aged bachelors decide to hire a garçonniere for their love affairs. Until then, in fact, the lack of a job was the justification for their frequent failures. But every time the two brothers try to use the apartment with the conquest of the moment, a new impediment arises. The protagonists of the film are the Carotenuto brothers, who generally play minor roles. The comedy is pulled away with various stunts.

title: Planet of the Apes
actors: Charlton Heston, Linda Harrison, Roddy McDowall
description: In 3972, some astronauts who have traveled at extraordinary speed arrive on an unknown planet. Here they must work hard not to become subjects of experiments and vivisection by evolved monkeys who have replaced humans (still existing, but considered as beasts) as the dominant species of the planet ...
notes: Based on the novel by the French writer Pierre Boulle (the author of _Bridge over the river Kwai) _, the film is pervaded by a subtle sense of anguish for the future, beyond the curiosity for the singular setting. Remade in 2001 by Tim Burton.

title: Piange... il telefono
actors: Domenico Modugno, Francesca Guadagno, Yvonne Danaud
description: An aviator always traveling around the world tries to reconcile with his wife so that he can be close to his daughter, practically never known. But an atrocious fate awaits him at the gate.
notes: A film built on nothing of direction and screenplay. Almost a photo novel in motion based on the famous song by Modugno. On the acting qualities of the national Mimmo better not to rage.

title: I'll Cry Tomorrow
actors: Susan Hayward, Richard Conte, Eddie Albert, Jo Van Fleet
description: After the death of her boyfriend Lilian Roth, a star of cinema and theater, she turns to alcohol. He reaches the point of delirium tremens, attempts suicide and then goes to the clinic to detoxify. Based on Roth's autobiographical novel, Daniel Mann's film is quite convincing thanks to the interpretations of Susan Hayward (who won the Palme d'Or at Cannes) and r Jo Van Fleet.

title: Don't Make Waves
actors: Tony Curtis, Sharon Tate, Robert Webber, Claudia Cardinale
description: Victim of an accident due to a beautiful stranger, Charles Cofield (Tony Curtis) loses all his possessions and is forced to look for work. The girl herself, Laura, who was the cause of his downfall, helps him by introducing a friend of his, Prescott Brandon, a wealthy businessman, who hires him in his company specializing in the construction of swimming pools. Charles quickly becomes his best seller, destined for great success.
notes: It doesn't measure up to Mackendrick's greatest black comedies ("The Murder Lady") or the cruelty of "Hot Lead", but the American West Coast satire is spot on and caustic as ever.

title: Il piatto piange
actors: Aldo Maccione, Agostina Belli, Andréa Ferréol, Erminio Macario
description: In Luino, in the Fascist period, the town is dozing and neither the squadriste bravado nor the desire to have fun of a small group of bulls can create the slightest confusion. On the other hand, the main personalities of the city find themselves in the clandestine gambling den managed by Berzi. The gambling den becomes the context in which the pettiness of individuals emerge.
notes: Bitter portrait of the Italian province based on the novel of the same name by Piero Chiara. The direction of Nuzzi is quite anonymous, but the story has such strength to support itself. Great Maccione.

title: La Pica sul Pacifico
actors: Tina Pica, Memmo Carotenuto, Ugo Tognazzi, Elke Sommer
description: Adelaide, who has a craze for scientific experiments, discovers that she has inherited from her husband, who has abandoned her for years, an island in the South Seas. She moves there with the intention of continuing her studies. But when she arrives there with the firm intention of taking possession of what is due to her, she has to contend with a castaway who pretends to be the son of her deceased husband and with a fugitive convict, who have already made arrangements with the chief of the tribe that inhabits the island. to keep it away.
notes: Easy farce and without ideas, in which the great Tina Pica is wasted despite being the protagonist. In a minor role, however, the very young Tognazzi.

title: I picari
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Enrico Montesano, Vittorio Gassman, Nino Manfredi, Giuliana De Sio
description: Two vagabonds, Guzman (Giannini) and Lazzarillo (Montesano), try to make do in sixteenth-century Spain. They improvise servants, pretend to be blind, act as actors and try to prostitute a beautiful girl. But it is all useless: they will have to continue to be pìcari, or vagabonds who have to take care above all to survive.
notes: Monicelli re-proposes a historical tragicomedy. Like the Middle Ages of the "Brancaleone Army", the first period of the modern age is also seen as an anti-heroic period. But the vein of that film seems rather distant, both for the writers and director and for the actors.

title: The Zany Adventures of Robin Hood
actors: George Segal, Morgan Fairchild, Roddy McDowall, Janet Suzman
description: Robin Hood is not all that brave and capable, but he proves to be very clumsy on more than one occasion. Marion is not a helpless girl, but an unbearable gossip. For his part, King Richard is a pompous idiot.
notes: It is a parody, shot for the American television, of the myth of the hero of Sherwood Forest. Everything is resolved in the deformation of the characters of the legend, and there is little to laugh about and above all there is very little spicy. Although the cast is of a good standard.

title: The Little Shop of Horrors
actors: Rick Moranis, Steve Martin, John Candy, Bill Murray, James Belushi, Ellen Greene, Vincent Gardenia
description: Seymour, shy and clumsy, works in a florist's shop and is smitten by his colleague Audrey, who is engaged to a sadistic dentist. A carnivorous plant bought by a Chinese offers him a pact: he will get her blood as food and she will give him the powers of the seducer. It's a trick; the plant is actually the vanguard of an extraterrestrial invasion. Musical remake of the homonymous film made by Corman in 1960, directed by one of the two creators of the "Muppet Show" (and you can hear it, in the delightful animation of the plant). Effective Rick Moranis in the role of Seymour who duets with the plant, but above all brilliant Steve Martin in the role of the dentist.

title: Piccola posta
actors: Franca Valeri, Alberto Sordi, Peppino De Filippo, Memmo Carotenuto
description: Around the very popular column published by the newspaper "Adamo ed Eva" and edited by the self-styled Lady Eva (Franca Valeri), an incredible series of misunderstandings are unleashed. Starting from the identity of the witch writer, countess on paper, borgatara in life. Fake barons, fallen millionaires and aspiring actresses will buzz around her.
notes: Amazing proof of Valeri. Perhaps one of the most successful films of the director, who also includes Sordi, Peppino De Filippo and Arnoldo Foà as a narrator.

title: The Little Princess
actors: Shirley Temple, Richard Greene, Anita Louise, Ian Hunter, Cesar Romero
description: We are at the end of the last century. A career English officer, who has recently returned to his family, must soon leave for South Africa where the Anglo-Boer war is underway. The officer has a daughter, little more than a little girl, entrusted to an aristocratic boarding school. When he is given up for dead, the little girl does not resign and does not even stop in front of the most difficult trials in order to find her parent. Shirley Temple in her usual part in a film whose only novelty is being in color.

title: The Littlest Rebel
actors: Shirley Temple, Jack Holt, John Boles, Karen Morley, Bill Robinson
description: A Southern officer tries to reach his wife and child who remained in territory occupied by the Nordists. The woman dies and the man is captured, but the little girl moves the enemy colonel who helps them escape. Then, when the two men are both sentenced to death, it is even the President who surrenders to the irresistible insistence of the child and signs the pardon. The series of uplifting "fairy tales" built on the character of the little star continues. Here, after the death of the mother, the tragedy is touched twice more and the interventions of the diva-babina are real miracles. To edify his fans.

title: Little Withe Lies
actors: Ann Jillian, Tim Matheson
description: Liz and Harry are two Americans on vacation in Rome alone. He is a cardiologist and she is a policewoman. When they meet, they immediately like each other and the charm of the Eternal City, its monuments and its atmosphere do the rest; the two lovers, however, hide their respective professions from each other. The mutual lie and the consequent misunderstanding continue even after returning to America, until a heart-sick jewel thief puts everything back in place: the two lovers find themselves face to face at the crucial moment when a life is at stake. The mechanism of misunderstandings that holds up the wait for complete resolution and the usual happy ending is traditional. Normal entertainment, therefore, with nothing memorable to underline. Tim Matheson was part of the cast of John Landis' legendary Animal House, with John Belushi. Other times and other genres of films! First TV viewing

title: Little Women
actors: Katharine Hepburn, Frances Dee, Douglas Montgomery
description: The "little women" are the four March sisters living in Concord, Massachusetts at the time of the Civil War. Jo boasts literary ambitions; Meg and Amy prefer social life, living rooms and admirers; Beth, the youngest, loves music. The four girls huddle around the mother when the father is drafted.
notes: Refined version of Cukor from the novel of the same name Louisa May Alcott. Although old it is still among the most successful. Hepburn like Jo is still unsurpassed.

title: Babes in Arms
actors: Judy Garland, Mickey Rooney, Charles Winninger
description: To fight the competition from the cinema, a group of musical artists decides to stage a great show, but the tour is a disaster. At that point their young people try to put together a show, but a storm destroys the scenes on the eve of the premiere. A Broadway impresario, however, has followed their rehearsals and decides to take them with him, making them all debut in a real theater.
notes: The theatrical original is by Rodgers and Hart, directed by the great choreographer Busby Berkeley and Judy Garland is just over sixteen: what more do you want?

title: Rouge Venise
actors: Vincent Spano, Wojtek Pszoniak, Massimo Dapporto, Andréa Ferréol
description: In the eighteenth century, in the middle of the carnival, all the patrons of the young Carlo Goldoni were killed in Venice. Together with his friends Vivaldi and Tiepolo and with a final twist, the playwright manages to unmask the murderer. The starting idea is bizarre, good cast, but the film is a co-production of those unfortunate ones.

title: Piccoli equivoci
actors: Sergio Castellitto, Lina Sastri, Nancy Brilli, Roberto Citran
description: The whole story takes place in an apartment. The protagonists are six young prose actors: Paolo, who loves Francesca; Piero, Francesca's new flame; Enrico, where Paolo is to be transferred; Sophie and her boyfriend Giuliano. All are linked by a multiple tangle of jealousies, rivalries, suspicions; the accommodating ending is just an interlude of respite. A decent Italian film directed by Ricky Tognazzi, based on the play of the same name by Claudio Bigagli. The anxieties and uncertainties of a generation staged with some affectation, and with the usual dining room breath. The least worst of director Tognazzi's films, however.

title: Bugsy Malone
actors: Jodie Foster, Scott Baio, John Cassisi, Florrie Dugger, Martin Lev
description: In New York, around 1920, Lardo Sam reigns over the club "Il grande Schlem", whose star is Tallulah. But Sam has to contend with a rival gang armed with cupcake machine guns; the gang attacks the club, but Sam can count on Bugsy Malone's alliance. The "war" ends with a gigantic battle with pies in the face and cream pastries. Parker makes his cinema debut with this parody of the gangster movie, played by kids aged 8 to 13, and curated in the setting like a miniature. Radical choice, which can amuse or leave you stunned by its premeditated "monstrosity".

title: Little Monsters
actors: Fred Savage, Howie Mandel, Ben Savage, Daniel Stern
description: A little boy discovers that under his bed there is a lively and mischievous monster. The two quickly become friends, but relations with the rest of the world are difficult. A bit similar to Beetlejuice, it ends up around Freddie Kruger.

title: Piccolo alpino
actors: Elio Sannangelo, Mario Ferrari, Filippo Scelzo, Ernesto Almirante, Cesco Baseggio
description: It is April 1915. A boy goes to the mountains with his father, but a storm separates him from him. Left alone, he joins a regiment that is leaving for the front after the declaration of war on Austria and in a short time becomes the mascot of the soldiers. Fallen into the hands of his enemies, he is locked up in an orphanage. Here he makes friends with a peer with whom he escapes. Cross the lines again and bring valuable information to the Italians. In the final offensive the boy will also find his father believed dead. From the novel by Salvator Gotta. Tears and action for an all-Italian epic, now largely ridiculous.

title: Il piccolo Archimede
actors: John Steiner, Aldo Salvi, Shirley Carrigan, Laura Betti
description: An English scholar, an admirer of Dante, Leonardo and Giotto, in the Florence of the 1930s believes he has discovered a genius in a seven-year-old boy. Between cowardice, craving for possession and frustrations, little Archimedes will choose death. Based on a short story by Aldous Huxley, a film that explores the margin between culture and life, in a painful investigation of childhood that confirmed Amelio's extraordinary directorial awareness.

title: Little Caesar
actors: Edward G. Robinson, Douglas Fairbanks jr.
description: Cesare Rico Bandello and Joe Massara are two small-time offenders. While Bandello, known as "Piccolo Cesare" for his ways, wants to climb to the top of the world of crime, Massara instead dreams of a future as a dancer. The brutality of Rico's deeds soon lead him to the head of a gang but, put on his trail by the woman from Massara, the police, in a firefight, kill him. It is perhaps the most famous film by the director, who was able to graft the gangster story on a social background of raw realism, inspired by a novel by W. R. Burnett. Unforgettable the interpretation of Edward G. Robinson.

title: The Little Fugitive
directors: Ray Ashley, Morris Engel, Ruth Orkin
actors: Richie Andrusco, Ricky Brewster
description: To play a joke on Joey, 7, he is led to believe that he has killed his older brother in whose care he was temporarily placed. Joey runs away from home and goes to Coney Island, where he spends a dream day and night among the crowds, the amusement parks, the beach. With a rare sensitivity of observation, the three authors have created a great little film that has the truth of the documentary and, at the same time, the compactness of a fairy tale about childhood.

title: Video Kid
actors: Fred Savage, Christian Slater, Beau Bridges, Jenny Lewis, Luke Edwards
description: Jimmy and Corey are two brothers aged nine and thirteen. After the separation of his parents, Jimmy runs away from home. Corey sets out on his research, remembering that his brother always pronounced the word California. On the way he meets Haley, a boy who helps him overcome some difficulties. When they find Jimmy, they discover that he is a video game ace. Together they leave for Los Angeles where the national championship is held. More playful than educational, but (at least for adults) it's not much fun.

title: Little Big Man
actors: Dustin Hoffman, Faye Dunaway, Martin Balsam, Chief Dan George
description: Jack Crabb grew up raised by a Cheyenne chief after a Red Indian rescued him following a raiding attack. As an adult, he tries to live in white society and ends up enlisted among Custer's soldiers; escaped after an absurd and useless massacre of Indian women and children, he takes back his uniform only to be able to kill the general, but in Little Big Horn the Sioux warriors precede him: he will be the only survivor of the battle.
notes: Great performance by Hoffman in this famous western "against", which restored to the native Indians all their dignity as a people first offended and then denigrated, but it was above all a reflection on the crisis of a nation and its founding stories. Desecrating, picaresque, but also poignant.

title: One Little Indian
actors: James Garner, Vera Miles, Jodie Foster, Clay O'Brien
description: An Indian boy who escaped the extermination of his tribe, a camel and an army corporal, who escaped a period of jail, cross the desert.
notes: Pick any animal at random, you'll find that Disney has already made a movie about it. Garner and Foster will reunite in "Maverick". She grew up and he aged a lot.

title: Little Lord Fauntleroy
actors: Freddy Bartholomew, Dolores Costello, C. Aubrey Smith
description: Educated by his severe and noble grandfather, little Cedric wins his affection and reconciles him with his daughter-in-law. From the famous novel by Francis Hodgson Burnett, a very honeyed and slightly dated film, but made with professionalism.

title: Piccolo mondo antico
actors: Alida Valli, Massimo Serato, Ada Dondini, Annibale Betrone
description: In Italy there is a general ferment against Austrian domination. The young scion of a noble family adheres to the ideas of progress and comes into conflict with his aunt, his guardian, especially when he marries a girl of the people. In retaliation, the aunt makes the girl's father lose his job. Later the girl of the two young people drowns. Soldati, in collaboration with Lattuada, signs a film considered among the most important of the "calligraphic" school, based on the classic by Fogazzaro. Charismatic actors, exquisite period re-enactment, and an intense and participatory direction.

title: Primrose Path
actors: Ginger Rogers, Joel McCrea, Henry Travers
description: The family of the young and candid Ellay May is a concentration of poverty and depravity. The girl is therefore easily won over by the kind ways of the elderly restaurant owner and her son (McCrea), with whom she marries. Bitter comedy with unusual setting and characters, and a good Ginger Rogers.

title: Pickpocket
actors: Martin Lassalle, Marika Green, Pierre Leymarie, Jean Pélegri, Dolly Scal, Pierre Etaix
description: Surprised in an attempted robbery, after a long "career" of thefts experienced as transgression, Michel ends up in prison. When he goes out he becomes a professional thief. A new arrest and the relationship with a single mother will be the vehicle for a newfound peace with himself. At the center of Dostoevsky's parable, dry and anti-narrative, a character trapped between the opposite automatisms of social integration and revolt. Bresson directs a "short novel" without music, playing with details of the hands and on Emrican planes of non-actors, building a realism of the soul, absolutely earthly, showing the invisible in the visible.

title: Picnic at Hanging Rock
actors: Rachel Roberts, Vivian Gray, Helen Morse, Jacki Weaver, Anne Lambert, Dominic Guard, Kirsty Child, Karen Robson, Jane Vallis
description: On the first Valentine's Day of this century, a group of girls from the aristocratic college of Appleyard are taken on a trip to the mountain called Hanging Rock. Some of them will disappear without explanation. The film that made Peter Weir famous. A sort of all-female thriller, allusive, exciting and impalpable, which preserves the mystery to the last, suspending the places between reality and dream and transforming itself into a reflection (dear to the author) between civilization and nature.

title: Un piede in Paradiso
actors: Bud Spencer, Carol Alt, Thierry Lhermitte, Jean Sorel, Ian Bannen, Sharon Madden
description: Taxi driver Bull (Spencer) risks losing his job. But luck comes to his aid by winning the richest lottery of all time: $ 150 million. At this point, one begins to be interested in him both in heaven and in hell: an angel (Lhermitte) and a she-devil (Alt) contend for him. Spencer returns to the cinema in a film written by his son (Giuseppe Pedersoli) and by the son of director Enzo Barboni, Marco. There are all the ingredients that fueled his long filmography and Carol Alt's side dish, but the result is really dull.

title: Piedipiatti
actors: Enrico Montesano, Renato Pozzetto, Victor Cavallo, Anne Benny
description: Silvio and Vasco, two policemen, are on the trail of a gang of drug traffickers and their investigations, which take them from Rome to Milan and then to Venice, end with the discovery that the gang leader is an unsuspected benefactor. They unmask him and chase him through the Venetian canals, but he takes a child hostage. Parody of the many stories of cops and thieves treated by American cinema, but the vein is rather weak and the two protagonists repeat their typical clichés.

title: Piedone a Hong Kong
actors: Bud Spencer, Al Lettieri, Enzo Cannavale, Renato Scarpa, Francesco De Rosa
description: Commissioner Rizzo (Spencer) of the narcotics section of Naples is suspected of collusion with drug traffickers. He will have to go to Bangkok, then to Macao, to Hong Kong, fight half the world, be arrested and sent back to Naples before unmasking the culprits. The scheme of the film is the coded one, with the addition of only the "local color" of exotic locations.

title: Piedone l'africano
actors: Bud Spencer, Enzo Cannavale, Baldwyn Dakile, Dagmar Lassander, Werner Pochath, Joe Stewardson, Rita Ehlers
description: Commissioner Rizzo (Spencer) takes care of the son of an African colleague killed in an ambush in Naples. Last episode of the adventures of the policeman who has been very successful especially with children.

title: Pierino colpisce ancora
actors: Alvaro Vitali, Michela Miti, Enzo Liberti, Riccardo Billi
description: Pierino, dean of Italian schoolchildren, is again rejected in the exams. This is why his desperate parents send him to boarding school. But Pierino escapes and returns home and his father makes him work in his restaurant. But not even this works and he is then employed as a clerk in various shops in the city, but always with catastrophic results.
notes: Tired episode of Pierino's series, struggling with the usual jokes, with the usual jokes and with the usual jokes towards the belloccia of the moment.

title: Pierino contro tutti
actors: Alvaro Vitali, Riccardo Billi, Enzo Liberti, Marisa Merlini, Michele Gammino
description: In a school where the most complete collection of foolish teachers and stupid professors seems to be gathered, there is the class of Pierino, repeating for life, who acts as the "grandfather" of the much younger companions in matters of jokes and vulgarity. Even outside the school walls, in the family or on the streets of the village where he lives, Pierino is no exception and his jokes continue to freewheel.
notes: The first film in the Pierino series, it had an incredible success. Some old glories like Riccardo Billi and Elsa Merlini in the role of fortune teller are complicit in the operation.

title: Pierino il fichissimo
actors: Maurizio Esposito, Adriana Russo, Tuccio Musumeci
description: The innkeeper Carmelo smells a good deal in the sale of his tavern to two Arabs. The day in which buyers have to view the place, Carmelo, to deceive them about the size of the turnover, fills it by inviting friends and relatives to lunch, including the deadly Pierino.
notes: You don't go beyond the jumble of jokes, mostly squalid.

title: Pierino medico della Saub
actors: Alvaro Vitali, Mario Carotenuto, Serena Bennato, Mario Feliciani, Giuseppe Ferrara
description: Pierino graduated in medicine, in Addis Ababa and certainly not at the university. Then he gets recommended by a big poppy from the P2 Masonic lodge and is hired in the hospital. Since the post of vice-primary belongs to the doctor who has the greatest number of patients, he convinces friends and relatives to be hospitalized, but, when the thing seems done, the trick is discovered.
notes: "The health care doctor" in Pierino version, with a collection of jokes about health care and surroundings, and a shocking appearance by Jimmy the Phenomenon.

title: Detective Story
actors: Kirk Douglas, Eleanor Parker, William Bendix, George Macready, Horace McMahon
description: McLeod, an intransigent inspector, ends up under investigation for mistreatment of Dr. Schneider, in prison for procuring abortions. It turns out that McLeod's own wife, unbeknownst to him, had resorted to Schneider's services. McLeod breaks up with his wife, but begins to have some doubts about his own ruthless rigor. Wyler conducts this adaptation of a theatrical text with great spatial-temporal concentration, of which he respects the three units. Backed up by brilliant performances by the actors right down to the most marginal roles, the film tackles a burning issue without hesitation in years of Hays code.

title: The Hot Rock
actors: Robert Redford, George Segal, Zero Mostel, Ron Leibman
description: The ambassador of an African state that has just gained independence makes contact with a group of friendly burglars. The task is to steal a precious stone, a symbol of the ancient civilization of the nation, which has been preserved for many years in an American museum. The criminals plunge into the daring enterprise with a lot of good will and, despite many messes, they manage to get hold of the precious jewel. But one of the burglars, captured by the police, has to swallow it to make the evidence of the theft disappear. Adventures full of suspense and twists are inserted in a tasty comic atmosphere. From a Donald Westlake novel, adapted by William Goldman.

title: Le pillole di Ercole
actors: Nino Manfredi, Sylva Koscina, Vittorio De Sica
description: Driven into adultery with an American client by a drug served to him by his colleagues in the mood for jokes, a young doctor gets into trouble. The husband of the seduced patient in fact confronts him energetically demanding satisfaction: the doctor will have to induce his wife, with whom he is very much in love, to spend a night of love with the American.
notes: Predictable situations and few laughs, despite the class of actors. For the time, quite licentious.

title: Un pilota ritorna
actors: Massimo Girotti, Michela Belmonte, Gaetano Masier, Elvira Betrone
description: Prisoner of the English in Greece, Lieutenant Gino Rossati falls in love with a girl who is also a prisoner. The idyll ends when Gino manages to escape and returns to Italy. Rossellini alternates documentary and fictional pages in a fascist propaganda film with pages of strong humanity, even if the humble tone and the daily heroism of the character were quite in line with the ideology of the regime. Vittorio Mussolini, the son of the Duce, signs the screenplay for the film with the anagram Tito Silvio Mursino.

title: Hell Drivers
actors: Stanley Baker, Herbert Lom, Peggy Cummins, Patrick McGoohan, William Hartnell, Wilfrid Lawson, Sean Connery, Sidney James
description: Hard work of a truck driver with a bad boss and treacherous bosses. Life is a constant mortal risk. Medium English production from the 1950s.

title: Pink Floyd. The Wall
actors: Bob Geldof, Christine Hargreaves, James Laurenson
description: While waiting to perform in the umpteenth concert, Pink, rock singer, thinks back to the salient episodes of his life. A war film broadcast on TV is the opportunity for this journey in memory between memories and hallucinations.
