notes: Perhaps Alan Parker wanted to repeat his previous success "They will be famous", this time showing the negative aspects of success. His predilection for banality, seasoned with bombast, however, makes the film heavy and rhetorical. Gerald Scarfe's animated drawings do not save the sinking ship. All that remains is to sit quietly and listen to Pink Floyd.

title: Pinky
actors: Jeanne Crain, Ethel Barrymore, Ethel Waters, William Lundigan
description: Pinky Johnson (Crain), a girl, daughter of blacks but fair-skinned, leaves the city of Boston, where she graduated from nursing, to return to her home country in the southern United States. Pinky, now accustomed to city life where people no longer give weight to race differences, finds the prejudices that are still well rooted in her hometown intolerable.
notes: Beautiful "head" melò from Kazan, whose direction was initially entrusted to John Ford. The film has all the flaws and simplism of Hollywood social dramas, but the director's staging, in his fifth direction, is already certain.

title: The Rains of Ranchipur
actors: Lana Turner, Richard Burton, Fred MacMurray, Michael Rennie, Joan Caulfield
description: Edwina (Turner), a wealthy American with a stormy past, arrives with her baronet husband in a Pakistani state and falls in love with a young Indian doctor (Burton), Maharani's godson. But an adverse fate, in the form of heavy rains, then an earthquake and then a flood, ends up fatally separating the two lovers. The doctor becomes involved in the survival problems of the people of her country and Edwina eventually gives up on love and reconciles with her husband. Remake of The Great Rain by Clarence Brown built on the presence of a very fatal actress like Turner and Burton disguised as an Indian. The disasters are spectacular, but Negulesco is directed by pure profession and the film looks like a photo novel.

title: Miss Sadie Thompson
actors: Rita Hayworth, José Ferrer, Aldo Ray, Russell Collins
description: Dancer and singer Sadie Thompson travels aboard a ship that is forced to stop on a Pacific island. Here Sadie finds the love of the rude but confident O'Hara, naval sergeant, but also the ambiguous attentions of the rich Davidson, the son of a Protestant pastor. The latter, conspicuously rejected, takes revenge by revealing the woman's unedifying past to O'Hara. But the loser will still be him. From the novel by W. Somerset Maugham, duly "purged" after the scandals of the 1932 version directed by Lewis Milestone. An exotic drama with strong colors, thanks to the good performance of the performers (and for the "frivolous" Hayworth one can speak of surprise), but also of little else. Originally in 3D.

title: The Tall Stranger
actors: Joel McCrea, Virginia Mayo, Barry Kelly
description: A Northern veteran defends a caravan which he joined by chance. Played by Joel McCrea, a specialist in the genre and based on a novel by Louis L'Amour.

title: Young Sherlock Holmes
actors: Nicholas Rowe, Alan Cox, Sophie Ward, Anthony Higgins
description: Still in college, Holmes, already lanky and in a checkered cape and hat, and Watson, chubby and peaceful, meet, united by an apparently inextricable mystery that threatens their school. Together they solve this first, intricate case, exposing a hellish sect that even makes human sacrifices.
notes: Scripted by Chris Columbus ("Mom I Missed the Plane") and, more importantly, produced by Steven Spielberg, is yet another, but very lively apocryphal fantasy about Sherlock Holmes. Traits a la Indiana Jones, subtleties of script and a very solid direction by Levinson make it a good example of cinema for children.

title: Piraña
actors: Bradford Dillman, Heather Menzies, Kevin McCarthy
description: The dr. Hoak has developed an unusual weapon: it is a new species of carnivorous fish that can live in both fresh and salt water. Paul and Maggie inadvertently spill them into a river; for the bloodthirsty fish the party begins, but the two responsible for the trouble are busy to make up for it.
notes: Scripted by director John Sayles, it is the second feature by the author of "Gremlins". Inspired by the "Shark", this is a catastrophic film, low budget, well written and made. Nervous style and excellent special effects strike rightly low, while a satirical subtext on the idiocy of the poeter flows.

title: Blackbeard the Pirate
actors: Robert Newton, Linda Darnell, Keith Andes, William Bendix
description: In the Antilles, in the 17th century: the young doctor Robert Maynard is charged with uncovering the secret agreements between Sir Henry Morgan and the pirates. Embarked on a ship whose captain Blackbeard has hanged, Robert courts the deceased's fiancée, Edwina, while the pirate seizes the woman's treasure. Then Morgan will beat Blackbeard, who, believed dead, is instead more alive than ever.
notes: A story of the best in the pirate vein. Walsh is having fun, and with him Robert Newton who unleashes a savory portrait of the marauder of the seas. No downtime, no pauses in this wacky pirate story.

title: The Pirate
actors: Gene Kelly, Judy Garland, Walter Slezak, Gladys Cooper
description: On a Caribbean island of the last century, a girl cultivates a romantic admiration for a mythical pirate of the An tille. The leader of a ramshackle company of acrobats, on tour in those places, pretends to be the pirate to take possession of the heart of the beauty who will become an actress by his side. Great result of the director Vincente Minnelli who entrusts to his wife Judy Garland the role of the girl in love with a ghost and to Gene Kelly that of the fake pirate: the film presents beautiful choreographic and musical numbers (songs by Cole Porter), presents a dazzling Kelly / Garland couple and ironically exalts faith in the imaginary. In Italy it was only released on TV, in 1980.

title: Il pirata sono io!
actors: Erminio Macario, Dora Bini, Juan De Landa
description: In Santa Cruz, an island in the Caribbean, the Viceroy organizes a fake pirate raid just before the real ones arrive. A shy schoolmaster solves the situation. Erminio Macario in a production that was made problematic by the French bombing. Italy had just entered the war. The parody is light, with some flavor of the vintage variety.

title: Raiders of the Seven Seas
actors: Lon Chaney jr., John Payne, Donna Reed
description: After being driven out by the Sultan of Morocco, the pirate Barbarossa lands in Havana, where he hopes to make a large booty. In fact, he manages to capture Alida, the Governor's beautiful daughter. The commander Salcedo, her fiancé, is shaken by Barbarossa who keeps the woman and the ransom money: Alida leaves with him having understood that she loves him. Director Salkow has truly sailed the seven seas of film genres: from Broadway shows to B-westerns. This film is a classic example of his eclecticism.

title: Los corsarios
actors: Dean Reed, Annabella Incontrera, Sal Borgese, Albert Mendoza, Paolo Gozlino
description: A shipwreck in the Caribbean takes Captain Drake and his crew to the court of the beautiful Princess Isabella. However, the princess's throne is threatened by the treacherous Duke of Burt, and Isabella asks Drake for help in defeating the evil one. Drake and his family, as well as Isabella disguised as a dancer, leave for the island of Saõ Tomé where, helped by the dwarf brothers Hercules and Samson, they will defeat the evil ones. Spectacular film closer to comics than to adventure novels. An unpretentious product by Ferdinando Baldi, suitable for young and old.

title: I pirati della costa
actors: Lex Barker, Gérard Blain, Liana Orfei, Livio Lorenzon
description: The precious silver cargo transported on the Spanish ship captained by Luis de Monterey is raided by pirates. Luis, held responsible for the incident, is then tried and sentenced to forced labor for life. On the ship that transports him to the penal colony, he leads a mutiny, takes command of the ship and heads for the pirate base on the island of Tortuga. He soon becomes a pirate leader. The short film is shot without means and without pretensions.

title: Hurricane Smith
actors: Yvonne De Carlo, John Ireland, James Craig, Forrest Tucker
description: Having been shipwrecked, Hurricane Smith can reach an island in the South Seas with his friends, O'Hara and Brundage. The sailor who knows the hiding place of a marvelous treasure needs a ship to go and unearth it. Through a ruse he seizes the ship of Captain Raikes, a fearsome slave trader and sets sail for Australia. The three who need money to be able to hire a crew come across Gorvahlsen also in search of the treasure.
notes: Directed without jolts by Jerry Hopper with a cast below expectations in which, however, Yvonne De Carlo stands out.

title: I pirati della Malesia
actors: Massimo Girotti, Clara Calamai, Camillo Pilotto
description: A young Hindu falls in love with a beautiful white girl held captive by a ferocious sect of Thugs. In an attempt to free her, he is taken prisoner and at that point he is forced to submit to blackmail: he can only be saved if he kills the English governor. It is a Salgari badly brought to the screen by the veteran Guazzoni, attempting an autarchic path to exoticism which proved to be unsuccessful.

title: The Pirates of Penzance
actors: Kevin Kline, Angela Lansbury, Linda Ronstadt, George Rose
description: These pirates are all to laugh about. Led by a curly-headed and impetuous young man and an aggressive blonde, even if no longer young, the pirate ship faces that of the English Navy and defeats it to the sound of songs. The occasion is a pretext to make fun of the haughtiness of the British military institutions, and, above all, to ridicule the excesses of discipline and respectable education. The film derives from an operetta by William Gilbert and Arthur Sullivan (those to whom "Topsy-Turvy" by Leigh is dedicated) already brought to the stage with a similar cast 8 except Lansbury). Beautiful sets.

title: La piscine
actors: Alain Delon, Romy Schneider, Jane Birkin, Maurice Ronet, Paul Crauchet
description: Jean Paul, a failed writer, spends a few days of vacation in a luxurious villa with his partner Marianne, a journalist. Harry, an old friend of Jean Paul's, arrives with his 18-year-old daughter, Penelope. Thanks to a party, a couple game begins in which the mature Harry woos Marianne with some chance and Jean Paul, perhaps out of spite, becomes interested in Penelope. However, it is the latter who soon leads the dance until Jean Paul and Harry collide to death. In the end, only three leave the villa as the police investigate an accident that could be a crime. The film has some limitations. Eighteen-year-old Jane Birkin, no.

title: Elephant Walk
actors: Elizabeth Taylor, Peter Finch, Dana Andrews, Abraham Sofaer
description: Rosy (Taylor) marries John, owner of a huge tea plantation, and from England, follows him to Ceylon. But life is not as rosy as the woman expected and she feels attracted to the young administrator, who reciprocates her sentiment. There is an epidemic, and Rosy is doing her best for the sick. But it is not the only disaster: a terrible charge of elephants arrives. John's heroism stands out in solving these dramas and love wins too. Started with Vivien Leigh, then replaced for a depression by Taylor (on "loan" from M.G.M.), the film is rather boring, except for the spectacular charge of the pachyderms.

title: Snowball Express
actors: Dean Jones, Nancy Olson, Harry Morgan, Keenan Wynn
description: A modest New York employee inherits a mountain hotel. He leaves his occupation and moves with the whole family, but the hotel is run down and in an isolated area. Not bad: the need sharpens the wits and, after a series of misadventures, luck arrives. Quite enjoyable Disney comedy.

title: Una pistola per cento bare
actors: Peter Lee Lawrence, John Ireland, Piero Lulli, Gloria Osuna, Julio Peña
description: Jim Slade, a pacifist soldier already sentenced to two years in prison for refusing to fight, turns into a bloodthirsty avenger when he discovers that his family has been exterminated. He will track the killers to hell and discover that their leader is a preacher.
notes: One of the less convincing films of Lenzi, a director more at ease with the war and detective genres. The starting point, with the troubled and politically correct soldier, is interesting, but everything is resolved in the usual manhunt, without great definitions of characters and actions. Among the protagonists, Piero Lulli.

title: Una pistola per Ringo
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Fernando Sancho, Lorella De Luca, Nieves Navarro
description: In a small town in Texas, on the border with Mexico, some outlaws robbed a bank and took refuge on a ranch and took farmers hostage. The gunslinger Ringo manages to enter the ranch claiming to be a wanted one; but in reality he agrees with the sheriff and acts in view of the size. Giuliano Gemma, until then, had been an obscure character actor in adventure films. In the wake of Leone, but with a more ironic and light-hearted taste. The results of the experiment were not bad, Gemma was launched, the film had a sequel the following year.

title: The Fastest Gun Alive
actors: Glenn Ford, Jeanne Crain, Broderick Crawford, Russ Tamblyn
description: George and his wife Dora run a convenience store in Cross Creek. He is very skilled with the gun, but nobody knows. One day he happens to prove it and Dora is alarmed, because in a nearby town lives Winnie Harold, who considers himself the best gunslinger in the world. When George decides to hang up his gun, Winnie comes to challenge him. Overcoming his fear of duels, George kills him. To prevent further challenges, his fellow citizens then devise a "trick". Good western, on a singular subject and served by an excellent script. Glenn Ford gives life to a character who lives on what he hides and who is forced, time after time, to reveal himself. Rouse, the son of a film pioneer, confirms his predisposition for intelligent and unpredictable cinema.

title: Belle Star's Daughter
actors: Ruth Roman, George Montgomery, Rod Cameron
description: Rose tries to kill the sheriff to avenge the death of her mother, the legendary Belle Starr. But the sheriff is innocent and wins her over. An outlaw as the protagonist is not usual for the western, but the film is weak.

title: Gun Point
actors: Audie Murphy, Joan Staley, Warren Stevens, Edgard Buchanan
description: Sheriff Chad is treacherously hit by his deputy, former Captain Holt who manages to go unnoticed, while trying to block a train awaited at the gate by a band of bandits. The robbery is successful, Holt and Chad himself return to town. Here they find a desperate situation, because the non-arrival of the gold transported on the train has sent all the banks into crisis.
notes: A rather conventional western, with some good ideas and with Audie Murphy on the boulevard of the melancholy sunset.

title: Les pétroleuses
actors: Claudia Cardinale, Brigitte Bardot, Michael J. Pollard
description: Maria, along with her four brothers, wants to buy a ranch but has to come up against the gunslingers of Louise's gang, who live in the area. The story is complicated by the presence of oil, but the well is unintentionally destroyed by the girls. The sheriff has the four brothers and the four gunslingers arrested: four marriages will take place in prison.
notes: The old Christian-Jaque, what is known as a skilled craftsman (his _La Certosa di Parma_, _Fanfan la Tulipe_, etc.), dedicates himself this time to the western, but the film is all based on the seductive graces of Bardot and Cardinale (here truly irresistible).

title: Gunfighters of Casa Grande
actors: Alex Nicol, Jorge Mistral, Dick Bentley
description: Joe Daylight, with money from the many robberies he has organized, has bought a ranch at Casa Grande in Mexico and wants to retire there with his accomplices. But the ranch is attacked by Rojo desperados, an unscrupulous Mexican bandit. To defend themselves, Daylight and his people stop at nothing: they shoot the bandits who have surrendered, litter the ground with explosive traps, kill helpless farmers. Eventually they get the better of the Mexicans, but Daylight will be killed by his own accomplices. An anomalous Western, in which there are no positive heroes. The director has made countless low-cost serials and films.

title: Arizona Raiders
actors: Audie Murphy, Michael Dante, Ben Cooper, Buster Crabbe
description: Of an Arizona band of outlaws, two are captured, while the others manage to escape. Captain Andrews has recourse to the collaboration of the imprisoned bandits and in the meantime sentenced to forced labor to solve the problem definitively. But even so it will be a far from simple undertaking. Heroisms, betrayals and many shootings: a western like many others.

title: Il pistolero dell'Ave Maria
actors: Leonard Mann, Luciana Paluzzi, Silvana Bacci, Enzo Fiermonte
description: General Carrasco, returned home after fighting in the war, is killed by Thomas, a gunfighter who, taking advantage of his absence, took his wife Anna away from him. The murder was witnessed by Sebastian and Isabelle, the two sons of the general. The two, aided by the faithful nurse, managed to escape the murder. Years pass and brother and sister, now adults, decide that the time has come to take revenge.
notes: Spaghetti western scripted by Piero Anchisi and Vincenzo Cerami, is confused among the many of the period.

title: Heaven with a Gun
actors: Glenn Ford, Carolyn Jones, Barbara Hershey, David Carradine
description: Jim Killian (Ford), a mature cowboy, gets into a fight with Asa Beck, a large cattle farmer who opposes sheep farmers for grazing reasons and who has a son, Cokes, bully and rogue. Killian adapts a former stable to a church and becomes a shepherd of souls preaching reconciliation and coexistence, finding many difficulties. A film with some traits of originality in the story, but of extreme simplism.

title: The Shootist
actors: John Wayne, Lauren Bacall, Bill McKinney, James Stewart, Sheree North
description: John Bernard Brooks, a famous gunfighter by now old and seriously ill, decides to face three of his bitter enemies one last time before dying. He then returns to Carson City to implement his plan, but has to deal with the local sheriff who is openly hostile to him. John will have his last duel: killed his rivals, but wounded in turn by betrayal, he dies perpetuating his own legend. Wayne resigned and also debilitated by the disease as the tired gunslinger nearing the end to celebrate the myth of the West - and the western film - and its decline. It is the last film played by the actor.

title: Il pistolero segnato da Dio
actors: Anthony Steffen, Richard Wyler, Ken Wood, Liz Barrett, Marco Stefanelli
description: Gary is a skilled circus gunslinger who, however, a childhood trauma made him unable to cope with any violent situation. Fate puts him on the path of a boy who is the victim of the oppression of some ruthless outlaws. It won't be easy, but the sight of the boy being beaten will finally shake Gary's numbness. Mediocre film that wearily traces the canons of the spaghetti-western genre.

title: The Magic of Lassie
actors: James Stewart, Mickey Rooney, Stephanie Zimbalist, Michael Sharrett
description: Ten-year-old Chris and his sister Kelly live with their grandfather and dog Lassie. A landowner wants to buy his grandfather's vineyard and, faced with his refusal, blackmails the family by taking the dog away on the basis of a forged ownership document. The recipe has the usual ingredients, taken from the decades-old Lassian saga; the vibe is Disney-for-families. The only curiosity is the presence of two old stars like Rooney and especially Stewart (one of his latest appearances).

title: Più bello di così si muore
actors: Enrico Montesano, Vittorio Caprioli, Monica Guerritore
description: Spartaco Meniconi is a super-marginal Roman who out of desperation disguises himself to prostitute himself. The chaste and very rich Count Nereo falls in love with "her". Spartacus and his family no longer go hungry, but the borgataro's heart of gold pushes him to confess the truth to his "fiancé".
notes: From a novel by Amurri, a film that (as often Festa Campanile) does not push the pedal of vulgarity all the way, but on the other hand fails to be really funny.

title: Il più comico spettacolo del mondo
actors: Totò, May Britt, Franca Faldini, Marc Lawrence, Tania Weber
description: Tottons is a clown who works in a big circus. A terrible secret forces him to always keep his makeup on and makes him a slave to his impresario. His life is also complicated by the amorazzi he has in progress with the elephant tamer, with the trapeze artist, with the playmaker. Moreover, he must beware of the lion tamer and the acrobat, his partners in the show. Forced to dial the wild beasts, he is also seen chased by a real policeman. Parody of De Mille's "Greatest Show in the World", it is not one of Totò's best films but has at least a couple of classic numbers taken from his magazines (the mannequin, the masseur, the tamer). The serious "prayer" that shows the sadness of being a clown is a little out of place. Among the audience we can see Aldo Fabrizi, Peppino De Filippo, Silvana Mangano, Anthony Qiunn and others. Shot in 3D and in color with the photography of Karl Struss, Chaplin's operator.

title: È più facile che un cammello...
actors: Jean Gabin, Mariella Lotti, Elli Parvo, Antonella Lualdi, Paola Borboni
description: Commendator Bacchi, a rich industrialist, dies and is condemned to hell for having brought a poor usher to the brink of suicide that Bacchi does not even remember. By dint of begging he gets twelve hours of new life to try to make up for it. He thus returns to Earth, but the enterprise turns out to be more difficult than expected because, finally satisfied in his desires, the usher becomes more and more greedy ...
notes: The subject is by Zavattini, and you understand immediately. Zampa is not a director, and it shows. Some nastiness in the script is perhaps due to the co-writer Vitaliano Brancati.

title: ...Più forte ragazzi!
actors: Terence Hill, Bud Spencer, René Kolldehoff, Ferdinando Murolo, Cyril Cusack, Michel Antoine, Alexander Allerson
description: Plata and Salud, are two pilot friends who work for private lines. They make ends meet by bringing airplanes destined for demolition and thus trying to collect the insurance money. With an old and shabby airplane they begin to trade with the emerald hunters and thus set themselves against a speculator who monopolizes the sector. The latter puts them against the local authorities, but the two get rid of them with sganassoni.
notes: After having achieved success with the parodies of Trinity, here are the two friends Bud Spencer and Terence Hill transferred by weight in the wild and remote forests of the Amazon. The film, although a little dated, still works today.

title: Drums Along the Mohawk
actors: Henry Fonda, Claudette Colbert, Ward Bond
description: The independence of the United States of America has just been declared, but the war of liberation is still raging. Gil Martin and Lana Bast, who have just got married, live in frontier land. Here they are subjected to attacks by Indians, allied with the English, and to the horrors of war. Gil enlists and, when he returns, is wounded, but the loving care of his wife, the birth of a son and the victory of the settlers revive hope. It is the first film shot in color by Ford: in it the entire epic of the director unfolds, the history of the United States is intertwined with that of individuals. A hymn to human strength and freedom.

title: Le soleil des voyoux
actors: Jean Gabin, Robert Stack, Suzanne Flon, Margaret Lee
description: Denis is a former robber torn from a quiet middle-class life by Jim, a friend in trouble with drug traffickers. The two rob a bank, Jim's enemies kidnap Denis' wife for the loot. Relentless thriller supported by a very solid cast, with a Margaret Lee (Betty) cat interpreter and worthy of the best tradition of film noir.

title: The Greatest Show on Earth
actors: Betty Hutton, Charlton Heston, James Stewart, Cornel Wilde
description: Famous acrobat Sebastian is hired by Circus Bradley, much to the chagrin of show star Olly. A strong rivalry is created between the two. Offended by the insinuations of his rival, Sebastian decides to make the number without a net, but falls and is left with a paralyzed arm. Olly, repentant, tries to be forgiven with her love. Rutilating circus fresco signed Cecil B. De Mille, full of scnea shots and yet rather static. Oscar for the best film and for the subject.

title: The Greatest Story Ever Told
actors: Max Von Sydow, Dorothy McGuire, Charlton Heston, Sal Mineo, John Wayne
description: The life of Christ is retraced entirely and with a spectacular cut: the arrival of the Magi in Bethlehem, the flight to Egypt, the preaching, the miracles, the crucifixion, the resurrection and the apparition to the apostles witnessing the crucifixion is almost ridiculous.

title: After Dark, My Sweet
actors: Jason Patric, Rachel Ward, Bruce Dern, George Dickerson
description: Kid Collins was a boxer, then he killed someone in the ring and now he walks the streets of America with no money and with the face of a beaten dog. This is why Fay Anderson calls him "Collie" when she meets him. And that is why, along with Doc Goldman, he involves him in a plan to kidnap the son of a billionaire. A plan in which Collie should end up playing the role of the scapegoat.
notes: It is one of the best adaptations of a Jim Thompson novel (that of "Getaway"). It is a world of fools and losers, lost in the midst of a blinding desert, in which there is no other end than the tragic one.

title: Pizza Connection
actors: Michele Placido, Mark Chase, Simona Cavallari, Ida Di Benedetto
description: Mario has a pizzeria in New York and is a killer for the mafia. He returns to Sicily with the task of eliminating a high magistrate and finds his brother Michele, whom he loves very much. The latter is a good boy: left out of work for his honesty and in love with a fifteen-year-old forced into prostitution, he asks Mario for money to "redeem her". In return, however, Mario wants to be helped to carry out the execution. Farraginous and melodramatic: not a denouncing film, but a succession of clichés.

title: Knock on Wood
actors: Danny Kaye, Mai Zetterling, David Burns, Torin Thatcher, Leon Askin
description: A ventriloquist discovers that he has mental disorders, but the persecution by agents who believe that the man has precious documents is more serious. Discreet film built around Danny Kaye.

title: Lucky Me
actors: Doris Day, Robert Cummings, Phil Silvers, Martha Hyer, Eddie Foy, Angie Dickinson
description: Between strokes of genius (with a catastrophic outcome) and strokes of luck, a ramshackle group of magazine artists goes from hunger to the golden triumph of Broadway theaters.

title: Platoon
actors: Charlie Sheen, Tom Berenger, Willem Dafoe, Forest Whitaker
description: Chris Taylor, a young man from a good family, volunteers for Vietnam and finds out what war is. The scarred-faced Sergeant Barnes has become a death and torture machine; Sergeant Elias instead tries to fulfill his duty in the most human way possible. After destroying a village suspected of hosting Vietcong, Barnes lures Elias into a trap and eliminates him, fearing that Elias will denounce him.
notes: Stone was a veteran and the war is considered from the point of view of the most anonymous of ordinary soldiers, with an energy that the director will never find again. Charlie Sheen is the son of Martin, the protagonist of "Apocalypse Now": to each generation its Vietnam. The film won four Oscars: Best Picture, Direction, Editing and Sound.

title: Can't Buy Me Love
actors: Patrick Dempsey, Amanda Peterson, Courtney Gains, Tina Caspary
description: Ronald Miller is a seventeen-year-old boy who, among others, has the problem of being constantly made fun of by his classmates at the institute he attends, due to his ineptitude with girls. Fed up with this bad habit, Ronald resorts to a ruse: he offers all his savings, a thousand dollars earned from small jobs, to the prettiest girl in school, to pretend to be his girlfriend. It really will become. Silly college-movies with the title inspired by a Beatles song.

title: Point Break
actors: Patrick Swayze, Keanu Reeves, John McGinley, Gary Busey, Lori Petty, James LeGros, Julian Reyes, Daniel Beer, Lee Tergesen, Tom Sizemore
description: Covered in the masks of the last American presidents, four robbers terrorize the banks of Los Angeles. An elderly FBI agent senses that the gangsters come from the surfer world. A colleague of his, the rookie but daring Johnny Utah, infiltrates and tests the accuracy of the hypothesis. At this point, however, the work is only just beginning. The hunt takes place between endless twists to end in a dramatic and spectacular way. Between Don Siegel and Peckinpah, Bigelow creates a fascinating male duet: elective affinities between the good and the bad with a breathtaking "final declaration of love" and a bitter counter-ending.

title: The Alphabet Murder
actors: Tony Randall, Anita Ekberg, Robert Morley, Maurice Denham, Margaret Rutherford
description: In London, a mysterious killer strikes his victims for no apparent reason, but following the alphabetical order of their names. The Belgian investigator Hercule Poirot is approached by the beautiful Amanda who confesses to being the author of the first crime and announces the next ones. Poirot discovers that Amanda is the victim of obsessive delusions but, unlike the police, she is not fooled by appearances.
notes: Already brilliant collaborator of Hal Roach, Tashlin contaminates the classic intrigue of Agatha Christie, just tinged with irony, with grotesque suggestions from a comic ending. Which will make the purists of the genre stand on end, but which makes the film enjoyable.

title: Polar
actors: Jean-François Balmer, Sandra Montaigu, Pierre Santini
description: Eugène Tarpon is a private detective with no clients. A mysterious woman, Charlotte, asks him to investigate the death of her friend. An alcoholic reporter directs the detective to a pornographic filmmaker and the victim's lover. Some gangsters want an object from him that Tarpon knows nothing about ... A French detective that finds its place among atmospheric films rather than short stories; Bral's sensitivity and irony know how to give life to the most unusual characters lost in the night.

title: Police Story: The Freeway Killings
actors: Angie Dickinson, Richard Crenna, Ben Gazzara, Tony Lo Bianco, Don Meredith
description: With dramatic recurrence a group of maniacs commits heinous crimes, always on the same motorway section. The commissioner in charge of the investigation decides to use the investigation to favor his election as police chief. But his ambition creates big problems for him with his collaborators, also because they suffer from the relationship he has with a beautiful policewoman. It will take cunning and coldness to resolve the situation ...
notes: Action detective with many old glories, from Richard Crenna to Ben Gazzara, to the ever beautiful Angie Dickinson. Based on the contrast between the humanity of the elderly policemen and the ruthless ferocity of the young criminals.

title: La polizia è al servizio del cittadino?
actors: Enrico Maria Salerno, Enrico Maria Salerno, Daniel Gélin, Daniel Gélin, Giuseppe Pambieri, Giuseppe Pambieri, John Steiner, John Steiner, Venantino Venantini, Venantino Venantini, Daniel Gélin, Daniel Gélin, Claudio Nicastro, Claudio Nicastro, Enzo Liberti, Enzo Liberti, Alessandro Momo, Alessandro Momo, Marie-Sophie Persson, Marie-Sophie Persson
description: In Genoa, Commissioner Sironi identified the head of the ferocious racketeering that controls port activities. But the law restrains his action, and he transforms himself into an executioner. Even in times of revaluation of the Italian black, Guerrieri's film is not among the best.

title: La poliziotta della squadra del Buon Costume
actors: Edwige Fenech, Alvaro Vitali, Lino Banfi, Sal Borgese, Gianfranco Barra
description: A policewoman, in order to solve a case of white trafficking, gets hired as a stripper in a nightclub. An ordinary film like its performers.

title: La poliziotta
actors: Mariangela Melato, Mario Carotenuto, Orazio Orlando, Renato Pozzetto
description: Gianna Abbastanzi is fed up with everyday life, suffocated by a loafer boyfriend and an employer who exploits her. She wins a competition as a policeman in a small town in Lombardy and proves to be severe and inflexible. A corrupt local industrialist who has strong political support enters its sights. Soon the scandal became national. Removed from office, Gianna leaves for Sicily in the company of the praetor who has been close to her in her inquiries.
notes: Social comedy skillfully directed by Steno. Too bad for the following episodes, in which the Fenech is instead of Melato and the story slips on the erotic side.

title: Loose Cannons
actors: Dan Aykroyd, Gene Hackman, Dom DeLuise, Ronny Cox, Nancy Travis, Robert Prosky
description: In a little film from 1945, alongside Hitler, the current candidate for the chancellorship of Germany appears as a young officer. Among secret agents and nostalgic for the Führer, two New York cops are also looking for the document, the mature Mac (Hackman) and the young nutty Ellis (Aykroyd), recently discharged from a psychiatric hospital. He joins the two, more by force than by love and, Guitterman, a Jewish trafficker in pornography. Bob Clark, coming from horror, tries to emulate John Landis with very modest results. Gene Hackman is here in the midst of a long eclipse, from which he will only come out with his formidable performance (Oscar 1993) in "Unforgiven".

title: Miami Cops
actors: Richard Roundtree, Michael J. Aronin, Harrison Muller, Dawn Baker
description: A mature black policeman sets off, along with his young partner, on the trail of the killer of a friend of the rookie's father. The investigation becomes complicated when it is discovered that the man is dealing with a gang of drug traffickers. Rountree (Shaft) is no longer old enough to do these things and in fact is reduced to working for Alfonso Brescia too.

title: Plain Clothes
actors: Arliss Howard, Suzy Amis, Diane Ladd, Seymour Cassel, George Wendt
description: A twenty-four-year-old policeman enrolls undercover at the college attended until recently by his brother; the latter is now accused of the murder of a professor. Convinced of his innocence, the false student investigates, between unexpected events and twists, to collect the evidence and discover the real killer. The starting idea has nothing original, but the script and the staging manage to make it a good suspense film, coloring the strand of the "adolescent-student" comedy black.

title: Kindergarten Cop
actors: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Penelope Ann Miller, Linda Hunt
description: John Kimble is a muscular cop tasked with tracking down the wife and baby son of a dangerous drug dealer. After the divorce, the woman took refuge in the town of Astor; the police have no photographs of him and Kimble has to pretend to be a teacher at the local elementary school to track down the child.

title: Peur sur la ville
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Adalberto Maria Merli, Lea Massari
description: The long struggle between Letellier, head of the criminal brigade, and the bandit Marcucci. The latter adopts an unusual delinquent tactic: first terrorizes potential victims over the phone, then kills them. He is driven by a distorted moralizing vision of his "mission". His weak point in the ... look.
notes: A memorable French noir, little known but classy. Adalberto Maria Merli, a refined serial killer, is a villain to remember. Halfway through the film there is a very long chase between rooftops and the subway that seems to have been shot by William Friedkin (and Belmondo is without a stunt double). This is the great European cinema!

title: Rent-a-Cop
actors: Burt Reynolds, Liza Minnelli, Dionne Warwick, James Remar
description: In a Chicago hotel room is Della Roberts, a call girl at work. In the next room, a group of drug traffickers is about to be framed by the police. It all ends in a massacre that also involves Linda, saved at the last moment by policeman Frank Church. But she saw that killer and now she's afraid. Meanwhile, Church has been expelled by the police and works as an overseer in a department store. Della meets him and hires him as a bodyguard. With a hint of nationalism it can be said that the best thing about the film is Giuseppe Rotunno's photography. The rest is very small.

title: Shakedown
actors: Peter Weller, Sam Elliott, Patricia Charbonneau, Blanche Baker
description: Roland Dalton, a successful lawyer and betrothed to the rich and charming Gail, decides to help his ex-girlfriend Susan who has embarked on the defense of a drug dealer accused of the murder of a policeman. In reality, Roland should definitely not get involved in what is likely to become an uncomfortable and negative case for his brilliant career. But Susan is definitely pretty while Gail, despite her charm and money, is one who believes Jimy Hendrix was a heavy-metal singer.
notes: This is undoubtedly the best film made by James Glickenhaus mainly thanks to Peter Weller and Sam Elliot.

title: Poliziotto sprint
actors: Maurizio Merli, Angelo Infanti, Lilli Carati, Orazio Orlando, Giancarlo Sbragia
description: Marco Palma is known among his colleagues in the Roman police for the skill with which he drives cars during the pursuits of robbers. His superiors ask him to infiltrate the gang of Nizzardo, a French robber who has the hobby of driving racing cars and predicting escapes in a car for his daring shots. After some time, the Nizzardo realizes that Marco is a policeman and throws him the last challenge. The film arouses some interest in beautiful action scenes.

title: Supersnooper
actors: Terence Hill, Ernest Borgnine, Sal Borgese, Joanne Dru, Herb Goldstein
description: While patrolling an uninhabited area, Officer Dave Speed ??(Hill) is accidentally hit by an atomic explosion. Despite this he survives and indeed realizes that he has come into possession of superhuman faculties.
notes: In an attempt to recycle his most famous characters, director Sergio Corbucci lands in the United States, puts Borgnine in the place of Bud Spencer and gives Hill some powers taken directly from Superman: the result is very modest, however.

title: The Brink's Job
actors: Peter Falk, Peter Boyle, Allen Goorwitz, Warren Oates
description: Tony Pinto, an Italian-American from Boston, was released from jail in 1944. He has always alternated his job as a cook with that of a safe-burglar. It is January 17, 1950 when he and seven others attempt a new billionaire heist. The theft succeeds and the loot is never found again.
notes: Friedkin did better in his life. And so is Peter Falk.

title: Poltergeist
actors: Craig T. Nelson, JoBeth Williams, Heather O'Rourke, Dominique Dunne
description: Her parents, Steve and Diane Freeling, can't help but worry when they find Carol Anne talking to herself with the device. Then she disappears, swallowed by the same TV and, from that moment, strange presences from the underworld begin to manifest themselves in the house.
notes: Monsters come out of the TV and the effect is chilling. The presence of Spielberg, screenwriter and producer, is felt, but the visionary touch, even if tamed, is of Hooper, one of the greats of '70s horror.

title: Trading Places
actors: Eddie Murphy, Dan Aykroyd, Jamie Lee Curtis, Don Ameche, Ralph Bellamy
description: Randolph and Mortimer Duke are two financiers from Philadelphia. Louis Winthorpe III (Aykroyd) is their dauphin, and their granddaughter's betrothed. Billy Ray Valentine (Murphy) is a poor fellow who pretends to be blind to pocket some alms. For a bet between the two Duke Valentine enters the control room, Louis ends up among the tramps. Winthorpe risks suicide, but Ophelia (Curtis), a charitable prostitute, saves him. Valentine, meanwhile, is very successful in the world of high finance.
notes: Among the best of Landis, a jewel of rhythm written by Timothy Harris and Hershel Weingrod with an eye to the "social" comedies of Capra and Sturges. Extraordinary the couple of protagonists, but also the two old men (Ralph Bellamy and Don Ameche). The insane, restrained and refined, becomes a weapon of ferocious mockery.

title: Poussière d'ange
actors: Fanny Bastien
description: Left by his wife, the policeman investigates the world of prostitution on the assassination of a protector. First TV viewing

title: A Force of One
actors: Chuck Norris, Jennifer O'Neill, Clu Gulager, Ron O'Neal
description: A deadly new drug is spreading on the California coast. But the traffickers are defeated by a martial arts cop who has the expressionless face of Chuck Norris early in his career. The director is Paul Aaron, but, to tell the truth, nothing changes and the story has nothing original. Follow-up to "Commando Black Tigers" by Ted Post, director and producer of some successful TV series.

title: Polyester
actors: Divine, Tab Hunter
description: The heart of an ill-married housewife starts beating again for a nice heartthrob. Fun in the name of satire and excess. The film was "the first product in odorama": by scratching and smelling a special card, you could experience the smells of the story passing on the screen in the room. Seen today, it remains quite irreverent, despite being less "cursed" than the previous ones.

title: Bedknobs and Broomsticks
actors: Angela Lansbury, David Tomlinson, Roddy McDowall, Sam Jaffe, John Ericson, Bruce Forsyth, Cindy O'Callaghan, Roy Snart, Ian Weighill, Tessie O'Shea, Arthur Gould-Porter
description: We are in an English town during the last World War. A lady who takes correspondence magic courses welcomes three displaced children from London. Together, they first help the magic teacher find the book he needs for the course and then they even manage to repel an attempted landing by the Germans. From the director of Mary Poppins, a film to have fun in the name of common sense, as it is no longer used. Musical numbers (including submarines, someone has remembered for The Little Mermaid), real characters and cartoons: the result is to be counted among the best of the Disney "family" genre.

title: I pompieri
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Lino Banfi, Ricky Tognazzi, Gigi Sammarchi, Andrea Roncato
description: The fire brigade of Rome is enriched with a new team: number 17. This is made up of young people in civil service or recalled elderly. It goes without saying that the team is known for its ineptitude until, when called by a former colleague to put out a fire in a restaurant, they behave in an excellent way.
notes: Perhaps the Italian response to the various police schools could have been better. The film is mainly based on the usual panting of Villaggio, the Apulian speech of Banfi and other various regionalisms. Lame comedy rather than comedy, with an appearance by Moana Pozzi.

title: Missione eroica. I pompieri 2
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Lino Banfi, Teo Teocoli, Massimo Boldi, Christian De Sica
description: Italy's most down-to-earth fire brigade is entrusted to the care of an American expert. But the man is completely insane so he agrees to carry a cargo of nitroglycerin to put out an oil well fire. The five follow him thinking it is an exercise. At the right moment, however, luck helps; as if by a miracle the mission succeeds and the five firefighters are rehabilitated. Villaggio, Banfi, Boldi, De Sica and Teocoli represent perhaps the best of popular comedy of these times. If they didn't always get involved in rubbish like this, with no idea and no comic invention.

title: I pompieri di Viggiù
actors: Carlo Campanini, Silvana Pampanini, Carlo Croccolo, Totò
description: Today the song that gives the title to the film is perhaps an archaeological find, but in its time it was at least as famous as the Hymn of Mameli. In order to exploit this "boom", the little film was made which, in some way linking magazine pictures, carries on a plot thread: the firefighters who do not want to be mocked by the song and their commander who wants to marry his daughter to a fireman, but discovers that he is far too stupid. The actors are the ones who raged in the magazine and Mario Mattoli directs for pure routine, but some numbers are truly incomparable documents (Totò who is the mannequin and the conductor, Dapporto Petronio and Monsieur Verdoux etc.). Almost a documentary, and see the beautiful article that Ennio Flaiano wrote about it at the time.

title: Cariboo Trail
actors: Randolph Scott, Gabby Hayes, Bill Williams, Karin Booth
description: Jim and Mike are carrying a herd to English Columbia. The former hopes to find green pastures, the latter is more attracted to the gold found in the region. At a bridge they are forced to confront the men of Walsh's gang. They both get out alive, but they lose the cattle and Mike also loses his arm, which Jim secretly blames. A completely negligible second-rate western.

title: Volunteers
actors: Tom Hanks, John Candy, Rita Wilson, Tim Thomerson
description: Lawrence Bourne III (Tom Hanks) is an arrogant and snobbish young man with huge gambling debts. Sneaking into a Peace Corps only to escape threats from his creditors, he is sent to a remote Thai village where he finds himself building a bridge together with the ultra-optimist Tom (John Candy) and a beautiful volunteer, Beth. But the Communists kidnap Tom to brainwash him. A flat comedy, with rare moments of effective entertainment. Too bad, because only the year before the Hanks-Candy couple had shown themselves capable of excellent performances, thanks to a very robust script, in "Splash", by Ron Howard.

title: The Bridge on the River Kwai
actors: Alec Guinness, William Holden, Jack Hawkins, Sessue Hayakawa
description: In the Burmese jungle, some British officers and soldiers are prisoners of the Japanese. The latter require the British to build a bridge, essential for their war transports. The prisoners refuse to do this. But later, the colonel commander of the British Nicholson, to demonstrate his superiority, devotes himself with his own to the construction of an imposing bridge, putting himself as it were in competition with his opponents in a kind of paradoxical patriotic fanaticism.
notes: Huge success with the public, this blockbuster manages to combine the needs of the big show (wide screen, great actors, extras, wealth of means) with an acute analysis of the reasons for militarism and the absurdities of war mechanisms. Seven Oscars: Best Film, Direction, Alec Guinness (extraordinary) supporting character, photography, editing, music (the arrangement of the "Colonel Bogey" march became famous) and screenplay (signed by Pierre Boulle, author of the novel, but written by two " blacklisted ", Carl Foreman and Michael Wilson).

title: Pop corn e patatine
actors: Nino D'Angelo, Roberta Olivieri, Lucio Montanaro, Pippo Cairelli
description: The penniless Nino loves Anna, whom he believes rich, and joins her in Taormina, where he manages to make people believe he is a customer of a luxury hotel. But another suitor of the girl discovers the trick and reveals it to Anna, who cuts off all relations with Nino, who, in turn, discovers that even she has no money. A subspecies of light comedy, sewn with two lire on the then golden helmet.

title: Porgi l'altra guancia
actors: Bud Spencer, Terence Hill, Jean-Pierre Aumont, Robert Loggia, Mario Pilar, Maria Cumano Quasimodo
description: We are at the end of the nineteenth century, in a Caribbean village. Father Pedro de Leon is a missionary who practices the Gospel by teaching the natives how to defend themselves from the surprises of the local squire. Father G. helps him who is actually a former convict devoted to the cause of the weak. The two proceed with punches for a while, but then Don Pedro learns of his partner's true identity. Very angry, he breaks the partnership, but the separation will be short-lived: the world is too much in need of their unique teaching. The Spencer / Hill couple takes it out on the waiting hierarchy. Good setting and, as usual, fast pace.

title: Porky's II - The Next Day
actors: Dan Monahan, Wyatt Knight, Mark Herrier
description: The cheerful gang of hypervitamin boys of the 1950s led by the horny Pippin returns to strike in Angel Beach, Florida. This time they have to contend with a bigoted pastor and with the city authorities who want to prevent the recitation of a play by Shakespeare, a spectacle deemed obscene ...
notes: Packed with massive doses of jokes, sex and jokes, the first _Porky's_ was very lucky at the box office. In this second chapter the tones are slightly more serious, even if the goliardic and light-hearted charge typical of the series remains intact. The final judgment, however, remains negative.

title: Porky's Revenge
actors: Dan Monahan, Wyatt Knight, Tony Ganios, Mark Herrier
description: The Angel College team should lose the decisive match of the basketball tournament due to a blackmail carried out by the shady Porky towards the coach. And the best player couldn't play under a teacher's veto. Then the teacher gets in trouble, the decisive match is won and, for good measure, the boat on which Porky conducts his trades is also smashed. In the third episode of this series of goliardic exuberance, even "heavy", scraped the bottom of the barrel. Very little imagination, worn-out situations, with no trace of subversive charge.

title: The Shuttered Room
actors: Gig Young, Carol Lynley, Oliver Reed
description: Susanna and her husband travel to an island near New York to spend a vacation in the mill where she spent her childhood. The islanders and an aunt want to dissuade them by telling them that a mysterious murderous monster lives here. The couple do not believe it, and they hurt. A very respectable cast for a barely passable product.

title: Porta un bacione a Firenze
actors: Milly Vitale, Alberto Farnese, Nino Besozzi, Marisa Merlini
description: After a difficult eye operation, Simonetta, an Italian-American girl, returns for a vacation to Florence, her family's hometown. Here she meets Alberto, a sculptor, with whom Maria is in love and sees her as a possible rival. In fact, in acting as Simonetta's guide, Alberto falls in love with her, but Maria is lurking and makes Simonetta believe that she is on the verge of marrying Alberto. While the latter tries to reach the man, she suffers an accident that causes her to lose her sight.
notes: In sentimental affairs Mastrocinque finds himself a little uncomfortable with respect to the comic and the Gothic incursions.

title: Il portaborse
actors: Nanni Moretti, Silvio Orlando, Angela Finocchiaro, Giulio Brogi
description: Luciano Sandulli, professor of literature, rounds off by writing books and articles for an author in crisis. One day he is summoned to Rome by Minister Botero, who hires him to write speeches and interventions. Sandulli hesitates, advised against by his girlfriend, but then accepts. After the first moment of infatuation with the environment and the boss, however, he realizes that Botero is a vulgar and unscrupulous politician, dedicated only to the cult of power. He will know how to abandon it and find his dignity again. A "premonitory" film, which gives Luchetti, Rulli and Petraglia (screenwriters) and Moretti the opportunity to brilliantly show us the hidden face of politics. Although a bit simple in its solutions and with an uncertain direction, it is a courageous and at times acute film.

title: Porte aperte
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, Ennio Fantastichini, Renato Carpentieri, Renzo Giovampietro, Tony Palazzo, Tuccio Musumeci, Silverio Blasi, Francesco Sineri, Vittorio Zarfati
description: In Parlermo, in l936, the employee Tommaso Scalia killed his wife, a superior and a colleague. At the trial, the death sentence awaits him, but the adjudicator Vito Di Francesco manages, against the opposition of all and with the understanding of a single juror, to prevent a sentence that he considers as barbaric as murder. He will inevitably have his career cut short.From the novel by Leonardo Sciascia, Gianni Amelio draws a film with a high civil commitment and a strong impact despite the refusal of the easy showmanship. A masterpiece of sobriety and moral tension. A story of yesterday, for our today.

title: The Paper Boy
actors: Alexandra Paul, William Katt, Marc Marut
description: Johnny is twelve years old and an orphan. The home delivery of newspapers offers him a minimum guarantee of survival, but it is within himself that he feels an anguished emptiness. A young woman, Melissa, has just moved with her daughter to the small Vermont town where Johnny lives, and it is she that the boy wants as his second mother. So much the worse for those who get in the way between him and Melissa. First viewing on TV On a dramatically reliable hypothesis of affective deficiency, the film builds a more effective than convincing development and the thriller aspect ends up predominating on a motivated and lucid analysis of feelings and behaviors. First TV viewing

title: Le porte dell'inferno
actors: Pietro Genuardi, Barbara Cupisti, Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Mario Luzzi
description: During an expedition some speleologists discover a terrifying reality hidden in the bowels of the earth. Attempt to revive the great tradition of Italian horror, out of time.

title: Il portiere di notte
actors: Charlotte Rampling, Dirk Bogarde, Philippe Leroy, Gabriele Ferzetti
description: Vienna, 1957: a former SS officer is now a night porter in a hotel; unlike many veterans, he has a strong guilt complex for his past actions. One day he meets Lucia, a Jew who was imprisoned in her concentration camp and is now persecuted as an uncomfortable witness: a perverse erotic relationship arises between the two that culminates in tragedy ...
notes: Cavani does not renounce any effect, from the most exhausting formalism to psychoanalytic symbols, to narrate the complexity of the relationship that binds victim and torturer. Looking at Luchino Visconti and making use of a Rampling at its peak.

title: The Postman Always Rings Twice
actors: Lana Turner, John Garfield, Cecil Kellaway, Hume Cronyn
description: Frank, a homeless young man, is hired as a boy in Nick's bar and soon ends up falling in love with Cora, the owner's wife. The two become lovers and Cora convinces Frank to kill Nick. After the crime, however, the two no longer trust each other. Arrested, they are both released. For them everything finally seems to be able to start from scratch, but Cora dies in a car accident.
notes: Third film version, full of atmosphere, of James Cain's novel of the same name (after "Le dernier tournant" by Chenal and "Ossessione" by Visconti), has a couple of extraordinary actors, the stoic Garfield and the disturbing Turner, who have made a cult movie.

title: The Postman Always Rings Twice
actors: Jack Nicholson, Jessica Lange, John Colicos, Michael Lerner
description: During the 1930s, Frank, a vagabond, appears in a truck stop run by Mich and his wife Cora. Before long Frank and Cora become lovers and, driven by passion, they decide to implement a criminal idea: to kill her husband in order to enjoy the insurance. Fourth version of Cain's novel, written by David Mamet and directed by Rafelson that adds an extra touch of realism. A wild Nicholson and a convincing Lange help him. The love scene on the kitchen table is memorable.

title: A Place in the Sun
actors: Montgomery Clift, Elizabeth Taylor, Shelley Winters
description: George Eastman, a young destitute, tries to make his way in life. If he did not have an ex-girlfriend, worker and pregnant, he would immediately get involved in a rich marriage with a beautiful heiress. He then plans to get rid of her on a boat trip, but regrets it. However, the girl slips into the water and dies. George is found guilty at trial.
notes: Second version of the novel An American Tragedy by Theodore Dreiser. It was more solid than Sternberg's '31, but this too has its strengths especially in the cast (Shelley Winters is superlative in the role of the victim). Nine nominations and six Oscars: film, direction, screenplay, music, editing and costumes.

title: Un posto all'inferno
actors: Monty Greenwood, Guy Madison, Hélène Chanel, Sandro Korso
description: In 1942 an American journalist, surprised in the Philippines by the Japanese invasion, covers himself with glory. Italian war film shot with little money and without great inventiveness.

title: The Kissing Place
actors: Meredith Baxter, David Odgen Stiers, Victoria Snow, Nathaniel Moreau
description: With the help of the insipid husband Charles, the psychopathic Florence Tulane kidnaps little Billy to satisfy an impossible and desperate desire for motherhood. But over time, Billy begins to have nightmares that lead him to question both his own identity and that of his alleged parents ...

title: Poor Little Rich Girl
actors: Shirley Temple, Michael Whalen, Jack Haley, Alice Faye, Gloria Stuart
description: Two industrialists, competing in the production of soap, are of opposite temperaments: one is young, widower, with modern views, the other is an old misogynist unable to adapt to the new demands of the market. The daughter of the first lost her way to the college, she was picked up by a couple of variety artists and performed with them singing and dancing. The trio is successfully recruited by the elder and the father reunites with his daughter.
notes: Shirley Temple who recites, sings and dances: the maximum of fascination for an audience that doted on her and had placed her at the top of the Olympus of the imagination.

title: The Poor Little Rich Girl
actors: Mary Pickford
description: The little girl in question is the daughter of an old-fashioned industrialist who does not like new advertising techniques. Business is going badly, while its more innovative competitor is doing very well. But destiny will be put into it, making him lose the little girl and then having her found again in singular circumstances to convince him otherwise. Mary Pickford was 24 when she played this little girl of eight; the physical traits, the conventions and the trick that silent cinema imposed make it credible. But, as has been said, the real protagonist of the film is the camera.

title: Poveri ma belli
actors: Marisa Allasio, Maurizio Arena, Renato Salvatori, Lorella De Luca
description: Two Roman young men are in love with the same girl and, in an attempt to conquer her, they do nothing but quarrel with each other. Not only neither of them succeeds, but they are also forced to acknowledge that the girl prefers a third. Then they discover that it is possible and pleasant to lose their heads even for their respective sisters.
notes: After the third episode of "Pane, amore e ...", Risi hits the mark in a sensational way with this film that brings its protagonists to popularity: a pleasant comedy, not without a neorealistic influence, but softened and with folk masks which will become classics.

title: Poveri milionari
actors: Maurizio Arena, Renato Salvatori, Lorella De Luca, Alessandra Panaro
description: Finally married to their respective sisters, the two friends Romolo and Salvatore leave for their honeymoon in Florence. Due to a series of setbacks, however, the two couples have to give up the trip and return to Rome. Here Salvatore argues with his wife and, after leaving the house, is run over by a car. In the collision he loses his memory and ends up falling in love with his investor; another bump will bring him to his senses. Risi continues to linger around the couple of friends with a sincere Roman spirit who had earned him his first success with Poveri, ma belli. The third episode, however, misses a few hits.

title: Un povero ricco
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Ornella Muti, Nanni Svampa, Piero Mazzarella
description: Forty years, a lot of money but the terror of a possible financial ruin, Eugenio practices living without a penny. He gets hired as a cleaner and goes to live in a council house. Here he meets Marta, a woman overwhelmed by economic problems, but serious and honest. With her he rebuilds a life, naturally as a rich man, after having thrown out his unfaithful wife.
notes: The idea is neither new nor original. The film that is based almost exclusively on the mimicry of the protagonist, who is not very fit.

title: Power
actors: Richard Gere, Julie Christie, Gene Hackman, Denzel Washington
description: Pete St. John (Gere) is an "image creator" who writes speeches to politicians, takes care of their clothing and gestures, manages their television appearances. Pete is the most unscrupulous and the highest paid, until, driven by a leap of conscience, he chooses the less powerful, but more honest, between two contenders. Made with great professionalism, the film convinces from a spectacular point of view, while its denunciation leaves us cold, emptied by the sudden final conversion.

title: The Pit and the Pendulum
actors: Vincent Price, John Kerr, Barbara Steele, Luana Anders, Anthony Carbone
description: Horrors, torture, madness and death in the castle of Nicholas Medina (son of a ruthless Inquisitor), whose wife Elizabeth suddenly perishes. Francis, the woman's brother, arrives to discover the causes of the tragic event. Meanwhile, Nicholas is obsessed with the idea that Elizabeth has been buried alive, and that her ghost is now roaming the manor. When he discovers the truth, he goes mad and starts a ruthless plan of revenge ...
notes: Corman signs a full-blown horror, without sparing blood and cruelty. At the exit he caused a sensation, also for the suggestive special effects called "Subliminal Flash Suggestion". Revolved by Stuart Gordon in 1991.

title: Babettes gæstebud
actors: Stéphane Audran, Jean-Philippe Lafont, Hanne Stensgaard, Birgitte Federspiel
description: Babette is a refined French cook, much appreciated by gourmets, who in 1871 for political reasons must leave Paris and find refuge in a desolate town on the Danish coast. After years of modest service with two elderly sisters, Babette organizes a sumptuous lunch with which she ends up winning a lottery, sensationally affirming her exquisite art. Based on the homonymous story by Karen Blixen, the film is a pleasant comedy for gluttons and not only, which speaks of contrasting religious conceptions, of the clash of two civilizations, of the value of food as a work of art, of the artist's creativity. Oscar for best foreign film.

title: Tha Catered Affair
actors: Bette Davis, Ernest Borgnine, Debbie Reynolds, Barry Fitzgerald
description: Young Jane Harley (Reynolds), daughter of a taxi driver (Borgnine), announces that she wants to get married in a very simple marriage, but her mother disagrees and wants, instead, all the expensive traditional corollary. Endless problems arise and the situation becomes more and more tense, until, finally, common sense is imposed.
notes: Born from a television work by Paddy Cahyefsky (adapted for the screen by Gore Vidal), it is a gem of sharpness and subtlety. The interpreters are engaged in a real skill contest. Bette Davis, in a hideous wig, plays the role of a fighting mother.

title: Un dólar de recompensa
actors: Peter Lee Lawrence, Orchidea De Santis, Carlos Romero Marchent
description: In the Far West a painter turns into a gunslinger to avenge his father murdered under his eyes by a group of masked bandits. Italian-Hispanic Westernaccio also a bit late.

title: The Naked Prey
actors: Cornel Wilde, Gert van den Bergh, Ken Gampu, Morrison Gampu
description: Retaliation for a bloodthirsty white hunter, turned into defenseless game by African natives. The acte Wilde here directs an exotic film of unusual tension and cruelty, which slowly moves on a distressing terrain, with a great use of the landscape.

title: Run for the Sun
actors: Richard Widmark, Jane Greer, Trevor Howard
description: Due to a plane crash, a writer living in Mexico and a journalist end up in the hands of a trio of former Nazi criminals hiding in the jungle.Third version, but this time in technicolor and with the screenplay by Dudley Nichols, of The Most Dangerous Game. Nothing to do with Schoesdack's original, but the story remains compelling.

title: Predator
actors: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Carl Weathers, Elpidia Carrillo, Bill Duke, Jesse Ventura, Sonny Landham, Richard Chaves, R.G. Armstrong, Shane Black, Kevin Peter Hall
description: Dutch is a former CIA agent hired for a special mission: he must free a politician kidnapped by guerrillas in the Central American jungle. The mission is accomplished, but on the way back Dutch and his men make the acquaintance of a mysterious and ferocious entity. One by one, everyone on the team falls, except Dutch.
notes: Narrative pretense for the exhibition of (good) special effects. Schwarzenegger moves at ease in this comic-book dimension, even unleashing some glimmers of irony.

title: I predatori dell'anno Omega
actors: Robert Ginty, Persis Khambatta, Fred Williamson
description: Nuclear wars have devastated and transformed the world. In command of his Omega forces, now the sinister Prossor maintains the dictatorship over the Illuminati with an iron fist. Directed by David Worth, in 1989 co-director of Kickboxer.

title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
actors: Harrison Ford, Karen Allen, Paul Freeman, Denholm Elliott, Ronald Lacey, John Rhys-Davies, Denholm Elliott, Alfred Molina, Wolf Kahler, Anthony Higgins
description: Having escaped an adventure in the Amazon rainforest, Indiana Jones, archaeologist and adventurer, sets out to search for the Ark of the Covenant of Moses, on whose trail Hitler's emissaries are also found (we are in 1936). Arriving in Egypt he finds the lost Ark in a well populated by snakes, but is discovered by the Germans who take possession of the Ark and kill Jones inside the well. Indiana escapes, sets off in pursuit of the Germans and, after various adventures, reaches them on the secret island where the mythical container is about to be opened. The film is an uninterrupted series of deadly dangers, chases and twists. It is as if Spielberg, inspired by the old adventure serials of the 1930s, had compressed fifty different episodes into a single film. Harrison Ford finds the role of his life and Spielberg collects an unimaginable amount of money. Oscar for scenography, editing, sound and special effects. Two sequels, also shot by Spielberg, and a TV series about the young Indiana.

title: Mother Lode
actors: Charlton Heston, Kim Basinger, Nick Mancuso
description: George Patterson went missing looking for gold in a remote region of Canada. In search of him, Jean Dupré (Mancuso) and Andrea Spalding (Basinger) come across the two old and sounded McGee twins (both played by Charlton Heston) who exploit a gold mine, the craziest of which is Silas. He does all he can to eliminate the intruders, as he has already done with Patterson. Pleasant revival of the glorious western genre. Charlton Heston is on his second and most successful directing experience, ten years after In the shadow of the pyramids, and he also enjoys playing two strongly characterized roles.

title: I predatori di Atlantide
actors: Christopher Connelly, Gioia Maria Scola, Tony King, George Hilton, Ivan Rassimov
description: A Russian submarine sinks off Florida. Recovery is attempted from a US platform. During the operations, a tablet with pre-Columbian inscriptions emerges from the ocean floor. A terrifying wave sweeps across the platform. The few survivors and two adventurers who sailed in the area end up on a mysterious island, not marked on the maps, dominated by a masked tyrant. Series C adventures, with little money and more than a debt to Indiana Jones

title: Abilene Town
actors: Randolph Scott, Ann Dvorak, Edgar Buchanan, Rhonda Fleming
description: New settlers against old cowboys during the Civil War. Western series for Scott in his period of maximum fortune.

title: The Kid from Brooklyn
actors: Danny Kaye, Virginia Mayo, Vera Allen, Steve Cochran
description: The young man is a milkman but has great ambitions. For example, that of becoming a great boxer, since he has sustained some matches and won them thanks to his speed of legs. But that's not always good for him, since he has muscles as big as bread sticks, and in fact, in the ring he gets beaten up and often takes a rich dose of punches. But luck helps him: the boss of his company admires the qualities and decides to support him. In the footsteps of an old Harold Lloyd movie, Kaye is athletic and lively enough.

title: Il prefetto di ferro
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Stefano Satta Flores, Francisco Rabal
description: Prefect Cesare Mori arrived in Palermo towards the end of the 1920s, with a reputation for inflexibility. During his mandate he proved his qualities, putting the local mafia organization on the ropes. However, when he discovers the decisive evidence that leads straight to Rome, to the federal fascist Galli, he is exonerated, elected senator and replaced by the very person he was about to indict.
notes: The mafia also existed under fascism, Squitieri tells us (who, inspired by the book by Arrigo Petacco, reconstructs a real story), and its defense and reproduction mechanisms were not so different from those of the following decades. Dry directing style, characters that are never forgotten.

title: Take the Money and Run
actors: Woody Allen, Janet Margolin, Marcel Hillaire, Jacquelyn Hyde
description: Virgil is a complex boy turned robber. Arrested and locked up in prison, he tries to escape with a gun made of soap and colored with shoe polish, but the night of the escape it rains. Other evasion attempts follow, rare periods of freedom, new robberies and new imprisonments. It is Allen's first direction and is a series of fulkminei sketches. For those who have already seen it, it will be enough to remember the interviews with parents made up by Marx brothers to avoid being recognized. Gag in bursts: the first Allen, the most frankly comic, almost insane.

title: Take Her, She's Mine
actors: James Stewart, Sandra Dee, Audrey Meadows, Robert Morley
description: Attorney Michelson's daughter is a lively girl. To avoid trouble her father does not hesitate to follow her to Paris. Pleasant comedy written by Dudley Nichols, with a couple of first-rate protagonists but without great directing shots.

title: Prénom Carmen
actors: Jean-Luc Godard, Maruschka Detmers, Myriam Roussel
description: A girl named Carmen (Detmers), embroiled in a terrorist group, is organizing a kidnapping. He asks for help from a bewildered uncle (Godard), a film director, to create a diversion with the crew. However, the plan does not work and, in the firefight, a policeman, in love with Carmen, kills her. The struggle of the sexes, the pulverized and possessed lives of the media, in a visual-sound mix of great charm (the scene with the detachment from one of the last Beetthoven quartets to Tom Waits' Ruby's Arms is splendid). At the 1983 Venice exhibition he obtained the Golden Lion. Maruschka Detmers, in her first major film, established herself as an actress with a disruptive erotic charge.

title: The Omen
actors: Gregory Peck, Lee Remick, David Warner, Billie Whitelaw, Harry Stevens
description: He discovers that his adopted son is the antichrist, and tries to suppress him. There is show, but little originality. A truly remarkable suspense, excellent actors and a dull and suggestive photography. The film had three sequels, the first of which was The Curse of Damien.

title: La presidentessa
actors: Silvana Pampanini, Carlo Dapporto, Ave Ninchi, Luigi Pavese, Franco Coop, Aroldo Tieri, Ernesto Calindri
description: The modest president of the court of a provincial town closes the place where the casual Gobette performs. Seeking revenge, the latter enters the house of the magistrate, who is forced to present her as his wife to the unexpected minister of justice. Of course there is an authentic spouse and the matter is gradually getting complicated ...
notes: Germi made the first attempt in the territories of satirical comedy (the times of _Signore & signori_ are still far away) starting from a play by Charles-Maurice Hennequin and Pierre Veber. For the moment, he is only half successful; then it will do much better.

title: The Presidio
actors: Sean Connery, Meg Ryan, Mark Harmon, Jack Warden, Dana Gladstone, Patrick Kilpatrick
description: A guardian is killed by two thieves during his patrol inside a military base. The investigation is conducted in parallel by Jay Austin (Harmon), police inspector, and Colonel Caldwell (Connery), of the military police. The two have a conflicted relationship due to an old rust. Making the situation even more complicated is Caldwell's daughter, who falls in love with the policeman.
notes: Hyams previously directed Connery in 1981 in "Atmosphere Zero"; but over the years, his verve has faded a little. The action is quite tense and the chase between the stalls of Chinatown is spectacular. But on the whole the film does not rise from a somewhat familiar average professionalism.

title: Presumed Innocent
actors: Harrison Ford, Greta Scacchi, Brian Dennehy, Raul Julia, Bonnie Bedelia
description: Rusty (Ford), deputy chief prosecutor, is in charge of investigating the murder of the charming Caroline (Chess). The case is delicate and not only because the deceased was a colleague, but because, some time before, there had been a love affair. Rusty slowly slips from the role of investigator to that of suspect, until his fingerprints are found on a glass found at the crime scene.
notes: The best thing is that atmosphere of petty corruption professionally rendered by Pakula. The late Raul Julia, in the role of defense attorney, gets along with a hint of lucid cynicism. Ford always has the air of a beaten dog, but his duets with Greta Scacchi are like fireworks.

title: Présumé dangereux
actors: Michael Brandon, Sophie Duez, Robert Mitchum
description: It is Robert Mitchum, in his first French film as Professor Forrester, inventor of a system for the interception and destruction of artificial satellites, who sends his unfaithful wife to the creator. And it is Michael Brandon, in the role of secret agent Tom Lepski, who must safeguard the scientist from the maneuvers of the many interested in his discovery. All this in a complicated and unlikely story that no one seems to take seriously, starting with the director. Unfortunately, however, no one takes even the self-mockery necessary to make a witty take on the collar of 007 & C.

title: Il prete bello
actors: Roberto Citran, Adriana Asti, Massimo Santella, David Torsello
description: It is the story of two friends, Sergio and Cena, who live in a popular neighborhood in Vicenza, and enter life with all their cheerful bravado, but through the wrong door. Don Gastone is the priest of the title, too much loved by the parish spinsters and the subject of scandal when he loses his head for the beautiful "professional" Fedora.
notes: Mazzacurati's second film, inspired by the novel by Goffredo Parise, was a certain disappointment in the face of the expectations that its debut ("Italian Night") had aroused. The fresco of the Venetian province is at times seductive but somewhat fragmentary.

title: Pretty Baby
actors: Susan Sarandon, Keith Carradine, Brooke Shields, Barbara Steele, Frances Faye, Antonio Fargas, Matthew Anton, Diana Scarwid, Seret Scott, Cheryl Markowitz, Susan Manske
description: Violet (Shields) is the daughter of a prostitute who works in a New Orleans brothel. Accustomed to the environment, she auctioned off her virginity. Grown up, she in turn becomes a prostitute and is linked, in a bizarre relationship, to the photographer (Carradine) who a few years earlier frequented the brothel to film the women. Malle, on her American debut, launched Brooke Shields with this hugely successful film. Spectacle and social fresco, glossy "Lolithism" and high-level cultural references (Toulouse-Lautrec but also Degas, Maupassant): it is an ambiguous film, constantly on the razor's edge between market and auteur cinema. Malle, however, comes out of it by imposing the firmness and sensitivity of his gaze to such an elusive and dangerous matter.

title: Pretty Woman
actors: Richard Gere, Julia Roberts, Hector Elizondo, Philip Stuckley, Ralph Bellamy, Laura San Giacomo, Alex Hyde-White, Amy Yasbeck, Elinor Donahue, Jason Alexander
description: Under the charming looks and heartthrob nature of Edward Lewis (Gere) lurks a financial shark. His specialty is to buy bad companies, restore them and sell them at a high price. One night in Hollywood, he casually meets Vivian Ward (Roberts), a prostitute. She needs money and he needs a woman to accompany him on his business lunches. It's a purely commercial relationship, but Edward's heart of stone slowly begins to melt.
notes: A little Cinderella and a little "My Fair Lady", it's the film that Julia Roberts launched. Boarding sample against every prediction, very clever but with a rhythm that today can keep in a few: one perfect romantic comedy that has left its mark on the 90s and on many titles to come that have tried to fade their success.

title: The Cheat
actors: Fannie Ward, Jack Dean, Sessue Hayakawa, Utake Abe, James Neill
description: Edith Hardy (Ward) plays on the stock market with the money of the Opera Pia whose funds she administers. A mistaken speculation causes her a loss that she is unable to repay and the woman, unbeknownst to her husband, resorts to the help of a rich man (Japanese in the first edition of the film, then of a nationality changed, for political reasons, in that of 1918) and gets into even worse trouble. The film that launched De Mille, an exotic melodrama that together with Griffith's films is one of the cornerstones in the invention of American cinema. Sessue Hayakawa later distinguished himself in the Bridge over the River Kway.

title: Above and Beyond
actors: Robert Taylor, Eleanor Parker, James Whitmore, Jim Backus
description: The anguish and problems, even family ones, of the pilot colonel Paul Tibbets who, at the end of the Second World War, was charged with the material execution of the secret project that led to the launch of the first atomic bomb on the Japanese city of Hiroshima. The bombing caused a real massacre and forced the Japanese to surrender, but in the foreground in the film is the conscience drama of Tibbets.
notes: Trivial drama in which it seems that the only victim of the Hiroshima tragedy is the American officer protagonist of the film. In the immediate postwar period, moreover, a different sensibility could not be expected from the winners.

title: Woman with a Past
actors: Pamela Reed, Dwight Schultz, Paul Le Mat, Carrie Snodgrass
description: The protagonist of the story is a woman who, after escaping from prison and having rebuilt a life of irreproachable wife and exemplary mother, is discovered. Will the husband be able to accept this hidden past of hers for so long? The man escapes with the two children and she, with no more hope, commits an armed robbery in order to finance the search for her missing spouse and children. Television production film.
