The story is clarified in the course of the narration through a series of flashbacks that enlighten us on the reasons for the woman's behavior. The script is discreet, also supported by realistic and non-trivial dialogues.

title: Career
actors: Anthony Franciosa, Dean Martin, Shirley MacLaine
description: Sam Lawson is a young man who dreams of a great future as a theatrical actor. After two failed marriages and a career that still does not take off, he is called to arms and leaves for Korea. On his return he is accused of anti-American activities (he had collaborated with a director in the odor of communism) and ends up working as a waiter. But he will be able to find the strength to rise again in the hottest humiliation. Dramatic film but with an optimistic ending, to be counted in the number of those announcing the passage from the dark period of the black lists to the new one of the thaw, not only internationally. Luxury cast: good protagonist Anthony Franciosa.

title: Sparks: The Price of Passion
actors: Victoria Principal, Ted Wass, Hector Elizondo, William Lucking
description: The favorite candidate in the Albuquerque mayoral election sees her political career threatened by the aftermath of a somewhat reckless evening and the threats of a killer. Boring movie for TV, signed by a director known in the cinema for a 1978 flop: "Battles in the galaxy". However, Victoria Principal manages to be convincing as the woman whose private life takes on public significance when a political candidacy is involved.

title: Prick Up Your Ears
actors: Gary Oldman, Alfred Molina, Vanessa Redgrave, Frances Barber
description: In 1960s London Joe Orton (Oldman) is a successful playwright, but his private life is a disaster. For years he has lived with Kenneth Halliwell, a frustrated writer who is actually an unacknowledged co-author of all his works. Their love continues amidst quarrels, recriminations and betrayals until one day Kenneth smashes Joe's head with a hammer and commits suicide. Alan Bennett (the author of Royal Lunch) gives Frears a script largely based on the diary kept by Orton himself, broken up into short episodes and chronologically fluctuating. Frears makes a dreary, amoral and not at all alluring film. With his interpretation Oldman demonstrates that, after Olivier and Gielgud, the genius of the great English actors has not been exhausted.

title: La prisonnière
actors: Elisabeth Wiener, Laurent Terzieff, Bernard Fresson, Dany Carrel
description: The young Josée, wife of the sculptor Gilbert, meets the gallery owner Stanislas Hassler, who loves to photograph women in humiliating or sapphic poses. Josée, at first troubled, ends up under the spell of Stanislas and takes part in a photo session. The woman, who in the meantime has fallen in love with Stanislas, attempts suicide out of desperation when she discovers she has been left. Upon hearing the truth, Gilbert tries to kill the gallery owner. At the last moment, however ...
notes: The latest film by Henri-Georges Clouzot, which mercilessly analyzes the greatest pain: the sense of despair and the lack of love.

title: Timbuktu
actors: Victor Mature, Yvonne De Carlo, John Dehner
description: During the Second World War, in French Sudan, a European officer appointed commander of the Timbuctou outpost is involved in the Arab nationalist rebellion. At stake are the commander of the French garrison Colonel Dufort, his wife and Conway, an American adventurer. The commander exploits his rival's passion for his wife in order to sow discord among the Arab leaders and prevent the revolt.
notes: Mediocre both the cast and the production. The film never came out in France, so as not to offend the sensitivity of the French engaged in the Algerian war.

title: Garden of Evil
actors: Gary Cooper, Richard Widmark, Susan Hayward, Cameron Mitchell
description: Fuller gets stuck at the bottom of a mine: the vault collapsed on him as he searched for gold. The wife goes to town to find help. He comes back with four animated adventurers of the most diverse purposes, but the woman uses her charm to keep the tension between them high so that no one prevails.
notes: A surprising western, directed by an "underground" master of American cinema. In this ballet of different male personalities, the one that stands out most is the woman, Susan Hayward, perhaps the only one able to counteract the wild destiny. A few hints of mèlo do not upset the dryness of the whole. Excellent protagonists Widmark and Cooper. But beware of Victor Emanuel Mendoza, who when he dies screaming his anger at the sky writes a great acting page in the cinema.

title: Prisoner of Second Avenue
actors: Jack Lemmon, Anne Bancroft, Gene Saks, Elizabeth Wilson
description: At nearly fifty, Mel loses his job, suffers a theft that puts him permanently on the pavement and falls into a state of anxious depression. His wife, who in turn is not without problems, tries hard, but it is difficult to help him.
notes: Neil Simon's Effective Psychological Drama; you laugh out loud with a great Jack Lemmon. Particle for a young Syvester Stallone, in the role of a hooligan.

title: Prima comunione
actors: Aldo Fabrizi, Gaby Morlay, Enrico Viarisio, Lucien baroux
description: Commendator Carloni (Aldo Fabrizi) desperately hunts for the white dress that his daughter Anna must wear on the day of her first communion.
notes: Between unforeseen events and setbacks a journey through a collection of various humanity: a great Fabrizi in an "Easter" comedy with a frank Zvattinian imprint, in which the accents of cruelty are soon diluted.

title: Battle Cry
actors: Van Heflin, Aldo Ray, James Whitmore, Raymond Massey, Mona Freeman, Tab Hunter
description: The events of four American marines from the training camp to the armed clash with the Japanese in the Pacific, until the return home. The dramas of the Second World War with an eye to the Cold War, where women also find a role. Not one of Walsh's best films, it's based on a Leon Uris novel.

title: Midnight Run
actors: Robert De Niro, Charles Grodin, Yaphet Kotto, John Ashton
description: Former policeman Jack Walsh, kicked out by the police for "stepping on" too many feet, accepts the task of capturing the accountant Jonathan Mardukas, who escaped with $ 15 million belonging to a drug kingpin. Time available: 5 days. Jack finds the accountant and prepares to go home, but at this point the trouble begins ...
notes: How many times has the story of the couple guard and thief in solidarity been told even if theoretically enemies? This is undoubtedly one of the brightest and wittiest, full of clever ideas, brio, and with a surprise ending.

title: Rachel, Rachel
actors: Joanne Woodward, Estelle Parsons, James Olson, Kate Harrington
description: Jennifer Cameron, thirty-five, has a tyrannical mother and leads a bleak life in a provincial town. She falls in love with Nick, a childhood friend, lost from sight for years, and in her presumed motherhood she sees hope for a radical change in her life. But for Nick it's just an adventure. The disappointment is strong, but Jennifer will find the strength to rebel and flee.
notes: Newman tries his hand at directing, and he does everything well. Thanks also to a script that holds up (based on a novel by Margaret Laurence) and to the excellent performance of Joanne Woodward, in the actor's wife life.

title: È primavera!
actors: Mario Angelotti, Elena Varzi, Donato Donati, Irene Genna, Ettore Jannetti
description: The Florentine Beppe, in Catania for his military service, marries Maria Antonia. Transferred to Milan, he consoles himself in the loneliness in Lucia's arms and marries her too. But Maria Antonia, suspicious, joins him from Sicily. The crime of passion is touched upon, but Beppe manages to juggle the very delicate situation. Pleasant and sparkling portrait of the environment, in which the neorealism is already dissolved in the vernacular comedy. The Sicilian part is particularly successful, vital but not stereotyped.

title: Primo applauso
actors: Claudio Villa, Carlo Dapporto, Riccardo Billi, Mario Riva
description: A young bartender with singing ambitions manages to make himself known thanks to a radio program called "Primo applauso". Once he gets to success, however, he gets wild and abandons his old friends. Villa unfolds his vocal cords convinced that this is enough to make us forget the inconsistency of the story.

title: Allegheny Uprising
actors: John Wayne, Claire Trevor, George Sanders, Brian Donlevy
description: A colony of pioneers fights the smugglers who supply the Indians with weapons. Wayne's "serial" period Western, who is here in the company of his female "shoulder" in "Red Shadows", Claire Trevor.

title: The scarlet Pimpernel
actors: Anthony Andrews, Jane Seymour, Ian McKellen, James Villiers
description: Seventh reduction in images (first for TV) of the famous novel of the same name by Baroness Orczy, at least two of which are memorable: that of 1935 directed by Harold Young with Leslie Howard and that of 1950 signed by Michael Powell and Emeric Pressburger. These are the adventures of Sir Percy, believed by all to be a cowardly dandy, who with reckless deeds saves French aristocrats from the terror of the Revolution, and wins the heart of the beautiful Marguerite. The breathtaking rhythm, the sense of humor and the ease of the performers give a pleasant imprint to the work.

title: The Principal
actors: James Belushi, Louis Gossett jr., Rae Dawn Chong
description: Professor Latimer is sent as principal of a school known throughout the district for the violence of its students. The masters of the situation are two rival groups: one led by the black Duncan, the other by the white Zac. Despite the intimidation, Latimer does not give up. With the help of Jake, overseer of the institute, and a student who sides with him, the principal faces the battle in the open field ... A ban on sociological subtleties and good feelings: a school western where Belushi is the principal -sheriff with the heart of a lion, (almost) alone against everyone.

title: The Drum
actors: Sabu, Raymond Massey, Roger Livesey, Valerie Hobson, Desmond Tester
description: The Indian prince of the Tokoti kingdom is killed by his brother who takes the throne. He is opposed to any kind of agreement with the British to which the deceased sovereign had guaranteed free access to his state. British troops arrive anyway, but the usurper is busy setting up snares. Prince Azim, son of the deceased king, intervenes and thwarts the plot.
notes: Good commercial production and beautiful technicolor for an adventure between exotic fairytale and nostalgia for the British empire.

title: Coming to America
actors: Eddie Murphy, Shari Headley, Arsenio Hall, James Earl Jones
description: Akeem (Murphy) is the heir to the throne of an imaginary and very wealthy African state and his father has already arranged his marriage with a submissive local girl. But Akeem, educated in the Western world, has made up his mind that he wants a woman who loves him for himself and not for his social position. For this he goes to America where he pretends to be a poor student and, working as a janitor in a fast food restaurant, he wins the daughter of the rich owner, despite the girl is already engaged to an arrogant "father's son".
notes: A little tarnished pace, but Landis' direction works and Eddie Murphy is much more measured than usual, indeed elegant and sober. The tics of black men and the habits of the Yankees were hilarious.

title: Prince Valiant
actors: Robert Wagner, Janet Leigh, James Mason, Debra Paget
description: The young Viking prince Valiant, son of the Christian Aguar, king of Scandia, ousted by Slaigon, is sent to the court of King Arthur to become a knight. Arriving at his destination, he has to deal with duels, deceptions and evil knights and also finds time to fall in love with a princess.
notes: Very grandiloquent, and quite successful, attempt to bring to the screen the exploits of Prince Valiant, a comic drawn in 1937 by Hal Foster. Screenplay by Dudley Nischols and music by Franz Waxman.

title: Principe coronato cercasi per ricca ereditiera
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia
description: A rich American with the desire to become a noble offers a billion to Don Mimì, a Sicilian prince, so that he can marry his daughter Grace. The contract, however, provides that the marriage is not consummated. Franchi and Ingrassia grappling with "buzzanchiane" atmospheres, throw it more on the infantile. Not their best.

title: Prince of the City
actors: Treat Williams, Richard Foronjy, Don Billet, Kenny Marino
description: Real-life story of a New York City narcotics investigator who, in the early 1970s, decided to collaborate with a police corruption inquiry commission. A powerful portrait of an ambiguous hero (with a great Treat Williams protagonist) and an essay on the sense of legality by American director Sidney Lumet. It is one of his most ambitious, long and imperfect films; a large urban portrait with high-end cinema pieces.

title: The Prince and the Pauper
actors: Claude Rains, Errol Flynn, Billy Mauch, Bobby Mauch, Alan Hale
description: In the mid-sixteenth century London presents two opposite faces: that of wealth in the Tudor court and that, miserable, of the slums. For a game of luck Edward the Prince of Wales swaps clothes (and the part) with the beggar Tom Canty. The film is based on the novel of the same name by Mark Twain, and is the classic good family film, well played by the two cute twins Mauch and the sanguine Flynn who assists the real prince. Music by Erich Wolfgang Korngold.

title: The Prince and the Showgirl
actors: Laurence Olivier, Marilyn Monroe, Sybil Thorndike, Richard Wattis
description: In 1911 the cream of the European nobility met in London for the coronation of King George V. Among the guests there was also a grand duke, regent of Carpathia, and some members of his court. At a variety show, the noble falls in love with a dancer who, however, seems to reject him. Knowing each other better, the two will end up falling in love, also because in the meantime the girl has foiled dangerous affairs against the Grand Duke. Once the things of the kingdom have been sorted out, the two will finally be able to fulfill their dream. From a play by Terence Rattigan, a delightful and graceful comedy, which borders on a fairy tale. Just as Marilyn Monroe is fabulous.

title: The War Lord
actors: Charlton Heston, Richard Boone, Rosemary Forsyth, Guy Stockwell
description: In the eleventh century, the men of the Norman and Christian Chrisagon repel an invasion of the Celtic village by the Frisians. Chrisagon falls in love with the daughter of the Phrygian king Odins, already promised to another, kidnaps her and, loved by her, refuses to give her back to her rightful husband. Celts and Frisians, united by faith in the same pagan traditions, unite against the despotic Norman.
notes: With rhetorical excesses, Schaffer (Patton, general of steel) develops some themes in the Middle Ages that are dear to him, that of the hero in contrast with the times in which he lives and the ambiguous dialectic between civilization and barbarism.

title: Princess of the Nile
actors: Debra Paget, Jeffrey Hunter, Michael Rennie, Dona Drake, Michael Ansara
description: We are in the thirteenth century, in Egypt. The son of the Caliph of Baghdad is forced to avenge the death of his faithful friend Hussein, killed by the henchmen of Rama Khan, head of a Bedouin tribe. He has taken over the government of the thriving city of Halwan. The Caliph's son joins the beautiful Taura, a legitimate princess, and with her frees the city from the usurper, avenging Hussein.
notes: Typical Hollywood costume product: extreme historical approximation and free rein to the imagination to give the "flavor" and "color" to an era that must seem fairytale. Cast of character actors without infamy and without praise.

title: Road to Bali
actors: Bob Hope, Bing Crosby, Dorothy Lamour, Murvyn Vye, Carolyn Jones
description: George and Harold, two varieties artists, in trouble with two girls, are forced to leave Sidney and flee to Bali. Injugated like palombari by Prince Klen Arok to recover a treasure sunk in the sea, they face a terrible piovra and complete the feat. Except for discovering in the meantime that the beautiful master of the treasure is the beautiful princess. They therefore find themselves fleeing with her to the avid and evil Prince Arok. One of the seven pleasant comedies of the Road to ... (1940-1962) series with the trio crosby- Hope- lamour and unique color.

title: Mohawk
actors: Scott Brady, Rita Gam, Lori Nelson
description: In the mid-18th century, the painter Johnathan Adams rescues the daughter of the Indian chief Elk Rosso and becomes friends with the Mohawk tribe. But there is a shady figure plotting for the Indians to take over Fort Aldel's weapons, so that Adams is forced to put his brushes aside and take action.
notes: Classic B-series western, however, quite interesting in the setting and not without some effective sequence.

title: Sissi
actors: Romy Schneider, Karlheinz Böhm, Magda Schneider, Josef Meinrad, Gustav Knuth, Uta Franz
description: Elizabeth, known as Sissi, and her elder sister Elena are daughters of the Grand Duke of Bavaria. The eldest has been designated to marry the young emperor of Austria Franz Joseph, but the sovereign is fascinated by the graces of Sissi and, when announcing the choice of his bride and future empress, he proclaims the name of his younger sister. Even for Elena, at first disappointed and saddened, however, there is a handsome prince on the way. It is a real story, but presented in a fairytale atmosphere, with great scenographic splendor and a naive but narrative simplicity. Mother and daughter in reality and on stage, with striking similarity, Magda and Romy Schneider.

title: Eve of Destruction
actors: Gregory Hines, Renée Soutendijk, Michael Greene, Kurt Fuller
description: Like a fledgling Doctor Frankenstein, scientist Eve Simmons built Eve 8, an android identical to her, which she endowed with her own memories. So when Eve 8 escapes her control and begins to sow corpses, the task of stopping her becomes difficult, especially as the android is capable of causing a nuclear disaster. Together with the inventor, Colonel Jim McQuade, an expert in counter-terrorism, deals with it.
notes: A mix of science fiction and psychological problems, which starts well but ends up keeping less than it seemed to promise. Technically fine, it suffers from some screenplay weaknesses.

title: Falsely Accused
actors: Lisa Hartman, Christopher Meloni, Peter Jurasik, Cloris Leachman
description: Laurie, married to Ray, is rather strained by household chores and motherhood: the newborn Corey is in fact not what is called a quiet child. When he is hospitalized with symptoms of poisoning and dies, Laurie is accused of murder and arrested, given her background is not exactly clear. But in prison she discovers she is still pregnant. When the baby is born, it reveals the same ailments as the previous one: it is genetic disorders, but it will not be easy for Laurie to clear herself. Family drama, judicial errors, existential problems: a television film decidedly on the side of commitment.

title: Fear on Trial
actors: George C. Scott, William Devane
description: Suspected of Communist sympathies, John Henry Faulk, a radio and television star of the early 1950s, is fired and his career cut short. To make up for it, Faulk hires the lawyer Nizer, who proves his innocence and gets compensation of three and a half million dollars. The place, however, is lost forever. At the time, the film earned an Emmy, the Oscar of American TV.

title: The Trial of the Incredible Hulk
actors: Bill Bixby, Lou Ferrigno, Rex Smith, John Rhys-Davies
description: The Incredible Hulk finds himself bonding with another superhero, Daredevil. Both will have to contend with the very dangerous leader of the underworld. Second film in the series, no better than the previous one.

title: Processo e morte di Socrate
actors: Ermete Zacconi, Rossano Brazzi, Alfredo De Sanctis, Ermete Tamberlani, Filippo Scelzo
description: Before the court of Athens, Socrates is tried on charges of blasphemous and corrupting theories of youth, and sentenced to death, despite his self-defense being a model of logical rigor and civil passion. underground to models incompatible with the fascist regime. But the staging is verbose and theatrical.

title: Il prode Anselmo e il suo scudiero
actors: Alighiero Noschese, Enrico Montesano, Tamara Baroni, Renzo Montagnani
description: A nobleman invents a fake relic and receives from his father the command over a group of volunteers about to leave for the crusade. Thanks to this expedient, he will be able to get everything he wants, especially from the young and beautiful wives of the Crusaders. The trick is discovered, but the noble manages to get away with blaming the dull squire.
notes: Rather rich picaresque adventures but closer to the decamerotic vein than to the Brancaleone Army. For the comedy everything revolves around the couple Noschese - Montesano, while the erotic part is entrusted to some actresses including Tamara Baroni, at the time also the protagonist of crime news.

title: Il Prof. Dott. Guido Tersilli primario della Clinica Villa Celeste convenzionata con le mutue
actors: Alberto Sordi, Evelyn Stewart, Pupella Maggio, Claudio Gora, Ira Fürstenberg, Ida Galli, Giovanni Nuvoletti, Nanda Primavera, Alessandro Cutolo, Marisa Fabbri
description: The doctor of the kilometric title (Sordi) runs the clinic owned by his father-in-law with the sole purpose of getting rich. The rules are clear: unnecessarily prolonged hospital stays for wealthy clients, dog treatment for borrowers without resources, so much so that even his collaborators end up rebelling. But it takes more to put the primary on the ropes. Follow-up to Zampa's "Healthcare Doctor", but the vein is tarnished. The script, which Sordi has also put his hand to, keeps everything over the top.

title: The Mechanic
actors: Charles Bronson, Jan-Michael Vincent, Keenan Wynn, Jill Ireland
description: Arthur Bishop (Bronson), professional killer, takes out his father's old friend Harry McKenna on commission. Having discovered that McKenna's son, Steve (Vincent), has all the "skills" necessary for the job, he decides, on his own initiative, to teach him and take him as a partner in the subsequent missions that are assigned to him. The film, which has some moments of marked spectacularity, also nourishes the ambition to establish a parallel between petty and institutionalized delinquency. See the marked similarities between the boss's residence and ... the White House. Winner conducts with confidence, without missing a beat.

title: Out for Blood
actors: Don 'The Dragon' Wilson, Shari Shattuck
description: Attorney John Decker sees his wife and son killed before his eyes by a group of criminals. A martial arts expert and bent on uncovering the killers, Decker transforms into a ferocious executioner. An analyst, to whom the lawyer turns, shocked by the terrible trauma of the double murder, does not know that the man who asked for her assistance hides a double personality. his actions as a martial arts champion.

title: The Evil That Men Do
actors: Charles Bronson, Theresa Saldana, Joseph Maher
description: Holland (Bronson), a retired killer, accepts the task of killing a certain Dr. Moloch who, in the service of a corrupt South American regime, commits atrocities of all kinds. Holland leaves for Guatemala, manages to get rid of Moloch's collaborators and lure him to a mine where, however, the miners themselves, victims of Moloch themselves, will carry out their revenge. Bronson was already sixty-three at the time and had already played the part of the executioner ad nauseam. Only for the most fanatical Bronson-addicted.

title: Harry in Your Pocket
actors: James Coburn, Michael Sarrazin, Walter Pidgeon, Trish Van Devere
description: A pair of novice pickpockets are hired by two specialists in this particular theft. There is no lack of contrasts within the group, also because the two professionals seem cynical and profiteers. In the end, however, when one of the two old men is arrested for the recklessness of the young, the other will know how to sacrifice himself to avoid their arrest. Bittersweet comedy centered on Coburn's ironic skills.

title: Svengali
actors: Peter O'Toole, Jodie Foster, Elizabeth Ashley, Larry Joshua, Pamela Blair
description: Peter O'Toole tyrant-Pigmalion of the young rocker Jodie Foster. Excellent cast, but this new version of the history of Svengali is too little visionary.

title: The Absent-Minded Professor
actors: Fred MacMurray, Keenan Wynn, Nancy Olson, Tommy Kirk
description: Professor Brynard is so distracted that he forgets to go to church on his wedding day. On the other hand, he manages to discover a chemical formula that attracts the attention of the military. A pleasant comedy with good special effects and a few laughs, it was a great success for Disney, which made two sequels.

title: Il profeta
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Ann-Margret, Oreste Lionello, Liana Orfei, Yvonne Sanson
description: Pietro has lived for some time on Mount Soratte far from everyone, rejecting consumerism. One day he is tracked down by television and taken back to town. Here he becomes a public figure: his speeches, amplified by the mass media, are devoured by the spectators. Then luck is about to turn its back: then the ex-protester opens a luxury restaurant.
notes: Harsh and indifferent satire of false rebels. Gassman plays in style as always.

title: Les Magiciens
actors: Jean Rochefort, Franco Nero, Stefania Sandrelli, Gert Fröbe
description: Sadry and Sylvia, spouses in crisis, decide to spend a holiday in Tunisia, on the island of Djerba, where he devotes himself to the assistance of his elderly sick mother. In the same hotel, the young and idle Edouard meets Vestar, a German seer, from whom he learns the imminence of a heinous crime. A little for fun, a little for a malign vocation, the boy decides to go towards the prophecy, choosing as his target the couple in disarray ...
notes: From a novel by Frédéric Dard, an exotic-seaside Chabrol that waters its traditional themes a bit (crisis of conventional values, ridicule of false bourgeois security) in the blue Mediterranean.

title: Profondo rosso
actors: David Hemmings, Daria Nicolodi, Gabriele Lavia, Macha Meril, Clara Calamai, Giuliana Calandra
description: Marc Daly, a young pianist, witnesses the murder of a parapsychologist, but cannot identify the killer. He begins to investigate on his own, helped by his friend Gianna, but soon the situation becomes very intricate: all the people who could help him in solving the mystery remain victims of the heinous killer ...
notes: A cursed city rebuilt using Roman and Turin exteriors. A deliberate sadism seasoned with perfidious irony and counterpointed by the obsessive and famous music performed by the Goblins (to a score by Giorgio Gaslini). Special effects by Carlo Rambaldi. Even today the best Dario Argento.

title: Profumo
actors: Florence Guérin, Luciano Bartoli, Robert Egon Spechtenhauser
description: The relationship between the engineer Corbi and his wife Lorenza is not very morbid. After trying all kinds of sexual excess, Lorenza can no longer and run away. In Fregene begins a relationship with the young Edward, but the memory of her husband obsesses her and progressively also her new relationship takes over the old transgressions. The only solution for Lorenza will be to kill her husband. This was to be the female response to the male -giving erotic cinema. Unfortunately, however, the ugly cinema is neither male, nor female: it is only ugly.

title: Profumo di donna
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Agostina Belli, Alessandro Momo, Moira Orfei
description: Captain Consolo lost his sight following an accident. While hiding his despair under a cynical mask of a man of the world, he decides to commit suicide. Accompanied by a white soldier, he sets off for Naples, where he wants to implement his extreme gesture ...
notes: Dino Risi manages to make pathetic and sentimental motifs coexist in this story with accents of black humor, touching upon very challenging themes without burdening them with useless rhetoric. Adapted from the novel _The dark and the honey_ by Giovanni Arpino, remade in Hollywood in 1993 (_Scent of a Woman_ by Martin Brest, with Al Pacino and Chris O'Donnell).

title: Shadowchaser
actors: Meg Foster, Frank Zagarino, Paul Koslo, Joss Ackland, Ricco Ross
description: The story is set in the United States, in the not too distant future. The President's daughter is kidnapped by some terrorists under the orders of an android who escaped from the laboratory where it was designed and built to order by the government. The ruthless criminals demand a ransom of fifty million dollars for the release of the hostage. The group is barricaded in a hospital; the federal agents laying siege to them believe that the best person to flush them out of their shelter may be the architect who designed the building. Sci-fi pretext for a normal action detective story with no particular signs.

title: Critical Condition
actors: Richard Pryor, Rachel Ticotin, Rubén Blades, Joe Mantegna
description: Lenyan (Richard Pryor), involved with a powerful criminal that the police are in a hurry to frame, is arrested for use as decoy. The boss's henchmen await him in prison, ready to prevent him from harming him by all means. Lenyan pretends to be mad and is hospitalized in the psychiatric hospital, despite some reservations from the experts. In a blackout night, in general panic, Lenyan is mistaken for a doctor and forced to serve with the foreseeable tragicomic consequences. The film is a clumsy cocktail of elements of tension, comic and sentimental. Only Richard Pryor is in great shape, but that's not always enough.

title: Marked for Death
actors: Steven Seagal, Joanna Pacula, Keith David, Basil Wallace
description: John Hatcher (Steven Seagal) of the narcotics team retires to private life. When he learns alarming news about the spread of a new drug (crack) in the city by the Jamaican trafficker Screwface, and when his granddaughter is injured in an attack on his home, Hatcher plunges back into the action. He will vanquish the wicked, after having had disconcerting surprises.
notes: Violence a go-go for the amazing exploits of that sort of white samurai that is Steven Seagal, here in the third film. It is true that he is on the side of the law, but it is an alibi for assorted justified brutalities. Rhythm does not save the film.

title: Proibito
actors: Mel Ferrer, Amedeo Nazzari, Henri Vilbert, Eduardo Ciannelli, Lea Massari
description: Assigned to a small and ruined Sardinian parish, Don Paolo Salinas arrives in the village while the rivalry between the Barras and Corrain families flares up. A relative of the Corrains is killed and, seeing that the police do not seem to be able to do anything, Don Paolo becomes a mediator between the two families to unmask the murderer and restore peace to the village. A dark and dramatic film, based on the novel "La madre" by Grazia Deledda and much reworked by Suso Cecchi D'Amico, Giuseppe Mangione and by Monicelli himself, made pretty well by a director specialized in comedies.

title: Proibito rubare
actors: Adolfo Celi, Tina Pica, Mario Russo, Luigi Dermasti
description: Don Pietro wants to go to Africa as a missionary. But the theft of the suitcase introduces him to the misery of the Neapolitan alleys where the boys live by stealing, abandoned by their families. He decides to stay and found a city of boys. The beginnings are difficult, but an anonymous aid of 60,000 lire proves to be decisive. On the day of the inauguration, however, the police arrested Don Pietro: the money was in fact the stolen goods accumulated by a Camorrista. Realizing the situation, the robbed withdraws the report and Don Pietro can continue the mission. Curious little film between neorealism and comedy, gracefully directed by a newcomer Comencini, already awaiting his childhood period.

title: Hello Mary Lou: Prom Night II
actors: Lisa Schrage, Michael Ironside, Wendy Lyon, Justin Louis
description: He surprises Mary Lou, prom queen, kissing another, and annoyed he throws a stinking bowler hat into the middle of the party. But the joke becomes drama, because the sparks from the contraption ignite the girl's dress, who dies in the flames. Thirty years later, the involuntary culprit of the tragedy is the principal of the same school. Her son participates in the election of the queen with Vicky, and she is "possessed" by the vengeful spirit of Mary Lou. A discreet Canadian production that has nothing to do with the previous Prom Night. With Michael Ironside (Total Recall) and a seductive Wendy Lyon (Vicky).

title: Evilspeak
actors: R. G. Armstrong, Clint Howard, Joseph Cortese, Haywood Nelson
description: Persecuted by his comrades from the military academy, a boy takes his revenge by evoking the damned soul of a Spanish priest from the Middle Ages.

title: After the Promise
actors: Mark Harmon, Diana Scarwid, Donnelly Rhodes
description: A modest worker (Mark Harmon) is deprived of the protection of his children from the court after the death of his wife after a long illness. He tries in every way to get them back, first by convincing the judges and then trying to break into the institutions where they have been placed. But it's all in vain: a fate of loneliness and regret awaits him. Weeping drama in which no easy effects are spared, with almost grotesque results. Long unreleased outside the United States, it was rescued thanks to the television fame of the main interpreter, Mark Harmon, star of many successful television series.

title: I promessi sposi
actors: Gino Cervi, Dina Sassoli, Ruggero Ruggeri, Gilda Marchiò
description: The film faithfully traces the pages of the great novel by Alessandro Manzoni, beginning with the warning of the bravo to Don Abbondio not to celebrate the fateful marriage. Then continuing with the escape from the country, the conversion of the Unnamed, the revolt, the plague and, therefore, the wedding. Film substantially faithful to the novel, also from an iconographic point of view (often referring to the illustrations of the 1827 edition), a little cold but highly professional: produced with a great deal of means by Lux, it was written by Gabriele Baldoini and Ivo Perilli with the collaboration of Emilio Cecchi and Riccardo Bacchelli and set to music by Ildebrando Pizzetti.

title: Downtown
actors: Forest Whitaker, Anthony Edwards, Penelope Ann Miller
description: Alex (Edwards), a fussy young agent, wants to punish the wealthy Jerome Sweet for speeding and for this he finds himself working in the most infamous neighborhoods. Here he meets Dennis (Withaker), a black policeman scarred by the death of a friend and colleague. The two end up, despite Dennis' resistance, working together to frame Sweet, the boss responsible for a drug trafficking and the death of a policeman. Benjamin is just an honest successful craftsman, but he manages to impress the film with captivating humor and alacrity from time to time. This time, however, the packaging, which mixes comedy and action, does not work too well: the pace is far from overwhelming and the story is at the elementary levels of a bad television series. Too bad, because the two-tone tandem made up of Edwards and Withaker had all the credentials.

title: Pronto... c'è una certa Giuliana per te
actors: Mita Medici, Gianni Dei, Marina Malfatti, Silvia Dionisio, Caterina Boratto
description: She is an orphan, the son of an industrialist, he, Giuliana and Paolo, high school friends, fall in love. The high school exams are close. The parents promise a spider to Paolo, if he is promoted, and he devotes himself entirely to his studies, while the aunt with whom Giuliana lives suddenly dies. Relations between the two young people loosen, but only momentarily. It is a film "of young people" that winks, even in the French songs of the soundtrack, at A man, a woman. In the cast, some iconic actresses of an era: the Piper girl Mita Medici and Silvia Dionisio.

title: Pronto... Lucia
actors: Carmelo Zappulla, Annie Belle, Clelia Rondinella, Jeff Blynn, Marisa Laurito, Raf Luca, Tommaso Bianco, Benito Artesi
description: Tonino (Carmelo Zappulla), a young car mechanic, for a trouble combined with a Rolls loses his job and the dream of getting married soon with Lucia. After a tragic-comic experience of precarious work, he finds a job as a miner in Austria, where he has an affair with Helga. Following an accident, Tonino loses his memory and Helga makes him believe he has married her. Tears and Neapolitan songs by Ciro Ippolito, a drama specialist.

title: The Next Man
actors: Sean Connery, Cornelia Sharpe, Albert Paulsen, Adolfo Celi, Marco St. John, Ted Beniades, Charles Cioffi, Salem Ludwig, Holland Taylor
description: The OPEC front risks being shattered by the initiative of some pro-Western Arab countries led by Saudi Arabia. Ryad's Foreign Minister Khalil Abdul (Connery) launches a proposal for an alliance between the Arab countries and the state of Israel at the UN. Khalil, however, has only the weapons of reason and the enlightened protection of the CIA on his side, insufficient to save him from the clutches of the "hawks", who also bring a woman of a thousand charms (Sharpe). The historical-political framework in which the love story between the protagonists takes place is of a sickly naivety. Connery, in the role of a pacifist messiah, is here reduced to the role of the "white negro" and somehow forced to renounce the disturbing interpretation of the Arab leader of The Wind and the Lion. Sarafian showed no signs of recovery after this injury.

title: I protagonisti
actors: Jean Sorel, Sylva Koscina, Lou Castel
description: The Sardinian bandit Taddeu agrees to meet, for a fee, tourists looking for excitement. A group of five people join him, but while they are intent on interviewing him, the police forces arrive and have discovered the outlaw's lair. The behavior of the tourists is ambiguous, one even fires a few shots at the agents. In the years of the "contestation", the debut of a director who would specialize in comedies. Here, on a subject by Flaiano, he tackles issues of social criticism without great inventiveness against the backdrop of Sardinian landscapes. The rich cast is a little confused.

title: Protocol
actors: Goldie Hawn, Chris Sarandon, Richard Romanus, Andre Gregory
description: Sunny Davis by trade waitress in Washington accidentally saves an Emir from an assassination attempt. Diplomacy, having learned that the Arab has fallen in love with her, wants to involve her in an attempt to circumvent him and convince him to have an American base installed on his territory. Sunny, however, does not accept the rules and the scandal becomes public with the name Sunnygate. The base will never be placed and Sunny will become famous enough to be elected as a congresswoman.
notes: Comedy along the lines of those of Frank Capra, full of references to the presidencies of Richard Nixon and Jimmy Carter. Goldie Hawn is good, but the script leaves something to be desired.

title: Somebody Has to Shoot the Picture
actors: Roy Scheider, Arliss Howard, Bonnie Bedelia, Robert Carradine
description: A photographer with a history of success and prestigious awards, now in a professional crisis, is contacted by a small Florida drug trafficker, accused of the murder of a policeman and sentenced to death. The prisoner offers him to lend himself to fulfill his last wish: to see his execution documented. The photographer accepts the assignment: the absurd and cruel procedures that precede the execution, the waits, the rehearsals, the push and pull, the fatal conclusion are captured by the shots of the camera and the film, a harsh indictment against the death penalty, interpreted with great intensity.

title: Ordeal by Innocence
actors: Donald Sutherland, Christopher Plummer, Sarah Miles, Faye Dunaway
description: Back in England after a long mission in Antarctica, Dr. Calgary discovers that his testimony could have exonerated a young man who had been executed in the meantime for murder. The scientist does not rest, he also takes serious personal risks, but he fights until the truth comes out. From one of the best novels by Agatha Christie (in Italian "The two truths"), a film directed without much backbone but with a remarkable duel of actors.

title: Prova d'orchestra
actors: Balduin Baas, Clara Colosimo, Elizabeth Labi, Ronaldo Baracchi
description: The orchestras have arrived in the 13th century chapel where they must rehearse a concert. There will also be television and everyone is scrambling to ask for explanations from the director and the trade unionist, who calls for a strike against the authoritarianism of the teacher. The action is interrupted by the demolition of a wall: as soon as the cloud of dust has dissolved the rehearsals resume, but the director begins to give a speech in Italian and in German. Less visionary than other Fellini films, more inclined to the political metaphor (we are in the middle of the lead years, shortly after the Moro kidnapping), the film confirms the director's great ability to propose large collective frescoes.

title: Shattered
actors: Tom Berenger, Greta Scacchi, Bob Hoskins, Joanne Whalley, Joan Severance
description: Dan Merrick, a successful young architect, has just returned from a frightening car accident. Plastic surgery has passably reconstructed his face, but as for his memory there is nothing to be done: Dan remembers almost nothing. His wife Jenny goes out of her way to help him, but there is nothing he can do when Dan discovers photos of her with her lover. To get to the end, there is still a detective played by Bob Hoskins, a couple of person changes and a few implausible passages. The fact is that a book would not be enough to list all the recent films that, like this one, have tried to copy Hitchcock.

title: Play It Again, Sam
actors: Woody Allen, Diane Keaton, Tony Roberts, Susan Anspach, Jerry Lacy
description: Sam, a clumsy and clumsy fan of the legendary Bogart, was abandoned by his wife Nancy. His friends, Dick and Linda, try to help him out. Dick is an indefatigable real estate manager who can't live away from the phone. Despite the efforts of the two, Sam cannot find company. She eventually ends up in Linda's bed, neglected by the very busy Dick, but they both realize it won't last. Woody Allen directed by Herbert Ross in a theatrical comedy that is part of the historical memory of an entire generation. Brilliant satire of contemporary myths: stardom, psychoanalysis, clichés ...

title: Provare per credere
actors: Gianni Ciardo, Patrizia Pellegrino, Guido Angeli
description: Accountant, shopkeeper and philatelist is left by his wife. Desperate, he takes advice from a neighbor and his life is filled with eventful adventures with beautiful women. Too good to be true. Pecoreccio, with the king of the 80s barkers Guido Angeli.

title: Providence
actors: John Gielgud, Dirk Bogarde, Ellen Burstyn
description: In the old castle where he lives, the old writer Clive Langham, now an alcoholic and ailing, lives a night of memories. In his hallucinated mind the faces of his suicidal wife and those of his children crowd, one is a successful lawyer, and his daughter-in-law who become the protagonists of an imaginary novel. In the morning the characters come together, gathered to celebrate the writer's 78th birthday. A little Robbe-Grillet and a little Bergman, Resnais makes a film between nightmare and memory. A merciless but humorous investigation into a man's mind. Wonderful the soundtrack of the old Miklos Rosza, great Gielgud.

title: La provinciale
actors: Gina Lollobrigida, Gabriele Ferzetti, Alda Mangini, Franco Interlenghi
description: Gemma falls in love with Paolo, but discovers that he is her mother's adulterous son. She then marries Franco, a professor, but is ensnared by Countess Elvira, a procuress who convinces her to become the lover of a certain Tittoni. After this relationship, the procuress tries to blackmail Gemma, who has a physical confrontation with her. Explanation with her husband, expulsion of the countess and triumph of conjugal love. From Moravia's novel, Soldati draws a film that is psychologically incomplete (as the book is) but very well-finished, often elegant. Silver ribbon to Ferzetti; Lollobrigida, as a dramatic actress, does what little she can.

title: Prudence and the Pill
actors: Deborah Kerr, David Niven, Robert Coote
description: A lukewarm marital relationship with the inevitable two side lovers and the elementary background on which the gimmick of the exchange of a contraceptive pill with one of aspirin is grafted. Twists commensurate with the premises, in a comedy that sees two mature extraordinary British actors having fun with the sexual revolution. But apart from the two, the film is worth little.

title: Psycho
actors: Anthony Perkins, Janet Leigh, Vera Miles, John Gavin, Martin Balsam
description: Dissatisfied Phoenix employee Marion Crane cuts ties with her past: steals forty thousand dollars from her office and escapes by car. He stops at the motel run by Norman Bates, a shy and awkward young man who lives with his mother in a sinister house next to the motel and who has a collection of stuffed animals himself. While Marion takes a shower, someone kills her. The next day, her boyfriend and her sister go in search of him, joined, at one point, by detective Arbogaste. One of Hitchcock's most famous films: an experimental film that ends in the middle (with the murder in the shower) and starts again, chilling and at times sarcastic. An experiment in sadism, shot in black and white and with a score of only strings composed by Baernard Herrmann. Perkins had a career marked for life by the role.

title: Psycosissimo
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Raimondo Vianello, Monique Just, Edy Vessel
description: Two actors (Tognazzi and Vianello) mistaken for killers risk being literally crushed by events. The parody of the thriller is truly without ideas, even if the Vianello-Tognazzi duo is a classic.

title: PT 109
actors: Cliff Robertson, Ty Hardin, James Gregory, Robert Blake
description: A certain John Fitzgerald Kennedy, midshipman of high hopes, is embarked among others on the PT 109, a fragile torpedo in action in the Pacific during the 1940-45 war. Launched against the mighty floating fortresses of the Japanese navy, the torpedo after some victorious actions has the worst: the young Kennedy, heroically, rescues the survivors by taking them to shelter on an island. It would be a normal war movie if it weren't for the name of the protagonist, who is destined to become one of the most famous presidents of the United States. When the film was shot, Kennedy was still of this world: therefore a living monument.

title: Puccini
actors: Gabriele Ferzetti, Marta Toren, Nadia Gray, Paolo Stoppa
description: The biography of the great composer is seen above all through the numerous love experiences attributed to him. Puccini (Ferzetti) leaves Cristina and flees to Milan with Elvira with whom he has a son. The years of triumphs follow, but also of bitterness: a maid kills herself because she is in love with him. Her married life also experiences ups and downs; ends in divorce, but then reconciliation takes place, shortly before the tragic death from illness.
notes: Not very reliable biographically, the film is appreciated above all from the musical point of view and for the presence of Marta Toren, actress with beautiful green eyes.

title: I pugni in tasca
actors: Lou Castel, Paola Pitagora, Marino Masé, Pier Luigi Troglio, Liliana Gerace
description: A blind mother and her four children live in a country villa. Theirs is a very particular family, also because many of the boys have serious mental problems. Among these only Augustus seems to aspire to a condition of bourgeois normality. Leone is subnormal and ends up drowned in the tub by Sandro. He is epileptic and Giulia is also not entirely "okay", at least judging by the way she watches her brother die during an epilepsy crisis.
notes: The dazzling and irreverent first work of the twenty-four-year-old Bellocchio, who signs the subject and the screenplay (the editing instead is by Silvano Agosti), with a portrait of the bourgeoisie in black on the verge of madness. A film that made history.

title: Pugni, pupe e marinai
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Raimondo Vianello, Maurizio Arena, Gloria Paul
description: Three of the four sailors sent to do some work on an island decide instead to take a ride on an apparently abandoned motorboat. The craft is actually a target for shooting practice. Sunk, they are collected by a fishing boat. Once landed, the three men must return to the island in order not to be delivered: it will not be easy.
notes: The film is a sort of ideal sequel to "Sailors, women and troubles" of which it keeps roughly the same cast and above all the same situations. The song from the film is sung by Little Tony.

title: Ten North Frederick
actors: Gary Cooper, Diane Varsi, Geraldine Fitzgerald, Suzy Parker
description: A rich and famous lawyer decides to throw himself into politics, also prodded by the unbridled ambition of his wife, a sour and petulant woman. However, his daughter's bond with a shady individual compromises his career. Years later, the mature lawyer falls in love with a friend of his daughter's but gives up on her, starts drinking and dies shortly thereafter. His daughter, reconciled with him at the last minute, tells the story. Socio-family drama with an intense Cooper already ill.

title: Blue Heat
actors: Brian Dennehy, Joe Pantoliano, Jeff Fahey, Bill Payton
description: Police Lieutenant Frank Daly is on the trail of a drug dealer. Daly is helped by a staff of young agents. Enraged because something always goes wrong in the investigation, he searches without a warrant a meat warehouse that serves as a cover for criminals. Suspended from service, after the death of one of his aides he resigns, followed by the others. Together they will continue the investigation outside the officialdom and will conclude it with a final battle where everything will be clarified: the good ones on one side, the bad ones on the other. Predictable action detective. Brian Dennehy is likeable, but everything in this movie has been really too much seen already.

title: Vanishing Point
actors: Barry Newman, Cleavon Little, Victoria Medlin, Timothy Scott
description: The young Kowalski unleashes pain and frustration in a car race; escapes the police, but not to a tragic end. Freedom, speed and death are intertwined in this small but significant film, which at the time managed to express the mood of many young people. A sort of little "Easy Rider", today almost a historical document.

title: Puro cashmere
actors: Mauro Di Francesco, Paola Onofri, Anna Galiena, Antonio Cantafora
description: At Manrica's birthday party, Giuliano's pure cashmere sweater, kindergarten teacher and former lover of the girl, is inadvertently stained by Liliana (formerly in love with Manrica's current lover). Various stories depart from this incident: of love (Giuliano for Liliana), of the underworld, of rigged football matches, and so on.
notes: A film that, as very often happens, starts off pretty well, in its tone between yellow and pink, only to get lost in the street, becoming repetitive and boring, despite the heterogeneous ingredients of which the recipe is composed. Because the cook's hand is weak.

title: Puro siccome un angelo papà mi fece monaco... di Monza
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Igli Villani, Paolo Carlini, Didi Perego, Paul Müller
description: In the seventeenth century, sent to the convent by his noble father, the libertine Alfonso entered into a contract with the friars, who walled him alive. The dreadful prison keeps him fresh as a rose. Gianni Grimaldi is a director, subject writer and screenwriter, but he has nothing to boast about.

title: Le quattro giornate di Napoli
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, Lea Massari, Georges Wilson, Aldo Giuffré
description: The film tells the humble and heroic epic of the Neapolitan citizenship who, without bosses and without pre-ordered tactics, finds themselves united in September 1943 to fight an improvised battle. Despite a "ridiculous" and rudimentary weaponry, thanks to the courage of the children of the reformatory and the elderly and the involvement of women, the insurgents manage to free the city from the Nazis, before the arrival of the allied troops.
notes: Loy, blending fiction and documentary passages, recreates both the events of September 1943 and the spirit with which those dramatic days were lived. Among the screenwriters, Vasco Pratolini and Carlo Bernari.

title: Magnum Force
actors: Clint Eastwood, Hal Holbrook, David Soul, Tim Matheson, Robert Urich
description: A trade unionist, acquitted for lack of evidence of the murder charge, is killed along with his men. Callaghan, marginalized to urban services for his notorious indiscipline, is back on track. His suspicions end up turning to some young police officers. After his fellow investigator is also killed, Callaghan goes wild and liquidates the "death squad". The regis is no longer of the great Siegel but of the more anonymous Post, but the tight script of this Callaghan n.2 are John Milius and Michael Cimino.

title: 47 morto che parla
actors: Totò, Silvana Pampanini, Adriana Benetti, Carlo Croccolo
description: Baron Antonio Peletti, very miserly, inherited a fortune in gold and jewels from his father. He keeps it hidden under the floor, denying the existence of the will: in fact a clause says that he should donate half of it to the town hall for the construction of the school, while the other half is reserved for his son Gastone. From here, jokes and twists follow one another until everything settles down.
notes: The original subject is by Petrolini, the screenplay by Age and Scarpelli, the (generous) forms of Pampanini. Totò rich and miserly is one of his classic "types". Here some duets with Croccolo servant remain memorable.

title: 48hrs.
actors: Eddie Murphy, Nick Nolte, Annette O'Toole, James Remar, David Patrick Kelly
description: Cates is a rude cop with a disastrous family situation behind him. Higher orders force him to join Reggie, an extroverted and very dynamic black prisoner, to try to track down some accomplices of the same, escaped from a penitentiary. Not even Reggie is enthusiastic about the idea: the apparent incompatibility of character little by little, however, falls apart ...
notes: "48 hours" is an important film for at least three reasons: first of all it is one of the best results achieved by director Walter Hill, a very successful mixture of crime film clichés, pure action and comedy. Secondly, it is Eddie Murphy's dazzling debut. Finally, it is also the film that relaunches Nick Nolte's career. Dizzying pace of both action and dialogue. Memorable the sequence with Reggie, a fake black policeman, struggling with an entire bar populated by racist and abusive whites.

title: Susan Slade
actors: Troy Donahue, Connie Stevens, Dorothy McGuire
description: After ten years abroad, the Daves family returns to the United States. Susan, the daughter, falls in love with a climber who dies leaving her waiting for a baby. To keep up appearances, the family goes abroad pretending that the baby is the girl's little brother. Susan, however, does not resist the fiction and reveals the mystery to her suitors: one retires, but the other is willing to marry her. The film constantly fluctuates between the light tones of comedy and the harsh tones of drama (which, however, borders on melodrama). Sentimental events and moralism are intertwined with tearful mother scenes. Good photography by Lucien Ballard.

title: Qualcosa di biondo
actors: Sophia Loren, Edoardo Ponti, Philippe Noiret, Daniel J. Travanti, Ricky Tognazzi
description: Aurora is a taxi driver in Sorrento, but in the past she was a waitress at the local Grand Hotel. The woman has an 11-year-old son who became blind following an accident. The costly operation that could restore his sight leads the woman in search of the boy's fathers. Is there any doubt about the happy ending? Sophia Loren, inactive since the days of A particular day, returns to the cinema with a story that fits perfectly to its fifty springs celebrated precisely in conjunction with the launch of the film which, for the rest, navigates in a sea of ​​tears and good feelings. Just the little Edoardo son, in life and in art, of Loren is saved.

title: Something Evil
actors: Sandy Dennis, Darren McGavin, Ralph Bellamy
description: A little family buys a farm in Pennsylvania. Having taken possession of the house, however, its occupants notice the existence of strange phenomena: the house is infested with otherworldly presences who try to possess the woman and upset the life of the family.
notes: Before making his big screen debut, Spielberg worked extensively for television. Witnesses of those years remain some films including this Something Evil, a horror in which some of the fantastic elements typical of much of his subsequent cinema are already present: from Close Encounters of the III type to Poltergeist produced by him. But in the draft state.

title: Something Wild
actors: Melanie Griffith, Jeff Daniels, Ray Liotta, Margaret Colin, Tracey Walter
description: Charles is a stockbroker. Divorced and (apparently) well integrated, he allows himself small transgressions, such as getting away without paying the bill. But one day he runs into Lulu, a sexy mine wandering around the metropolis. It seems like a simple adventure, but soon everything takes an unpredictable direction: passion crosses violence and love will then be like a hard conquest.
notes: A flagship film in Jonathan Demme's production and in the American one of the 1980s. Melanie Griffith is a force of nature who transforms Jeff Daniels from a fearful broker into a lover ready for anything. The excellent music column is edited by David Byrne.

title: Someone to Love
actors: Henry Jaglom, Orson Welles, Sally Kellerman, Andrea Marcovicci
description: In a historic cinema intended for demolition, the owner, a director, organizes a party with various "colleagues" of the show and films its interviews. The result is a varied mosaic of solitudes. Experiment at times interesting but with some length; Orson Welles pulls the ranks, between jokes and penetrating observations, in his last appearance on the screen.

title: King Rat
actors: George Segal, Tom Courtenay, James Fox, Denholm Elliott
description: We are in a Japanese concentration camp. Lieutenant Gray, the English manager of the camp, is relentless against the American smuggler Corporal King; he has as valid another Englishman, Marlowe. The discovery of a clandestine radio precipitates the situation, but the news arrives that the war is over. King is preparing to return after having severed all relations with Marlowe as well. War is a reserve of humanity in disarray: men sometimes forced to make friendships as strong as they have no future. Hatred, on the other hand, overcomes all unforeseen events. Introspective and harsh film with a good cocktail of actors from Hollywood to Free Cinema.

title: Qualcuno in ascolto
actors: Vincent Spano, Oliver Benny, Isabelle Pasco, Anne Canovas
description: Peter is a quiet young man who agrees to spend the winter in an isolated station in the high mountains with the task of checking the stability of the signals emitted by the satellites. He is alone, but through the ether he is in contact with the whole world. One day he hears something that seems to him to be a crime: together with a wavemate he stubbornly tries to solve the mystery. Italian production with American actors, a muddled film that does not create tension. The super-technological setting of the station is interesting in which the protagonist can dominate the telecommunications of an entire continent.

title: Qualcuno pagherà
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Daniel Greene, Ernest Borgnine, Mary Stavin, Keely Shaye Smith
description: A boxer decides to rebel against the racketeering that dominates the boxing world and therefore refuses to collaborate in the clandestine rigged betting round by refusing to participate in a combined match. But his honest determination does him nothing but trouble.
notes: Martino directs this action film in the parenthesis between "Mixed Doubles" and "A bear called Arturo". One cannot expect a good level of work from him, but only as a profession. A dull Giuliano Gemma is involved in the enterprise.

title: One False Move
actors: Bill Paxton, Cynda Williams, Billy Bob Thornton, Michael Beach
description: A ruthless gang, made up of a trio of criminals led by a beautiful girl who calls herself Fantasia, takes possession of a large batch of drugs. The three set off sowing blood and horror along the journey. Two policemen guess that their destination may be Star City in Arkansas. Here they alert the sheriff who discovers that Fantasia is none other than Lila, an old flame of his. A tense and politically incorrect detective (the director is an old black trader) in tracing the portraits of both Lila and the policemen, shot on the streets of a bloody America.

title: Quando Alice ruppe lo specchio
actors: Brett Halsey, Sacha Darwin, Pier Luigi Conti, Zora Ulla Keslerova, Ria De Simone
description: The repeated intrusions of his mysterious, yet unpredictable, "double" end up irreparably compromising the brilliant career of a serial killer with the ambitions of an unrepentant seducer. Late horror fulciano, now fully self-aware (and rather funny in the accumulation of quotes), with a television destination.

title: Cuando calienta el sol...
actors: Claudia Vegliante, Alex Freyberger, Orsetta Gregoretti, Carmen Russo
description: Stefano, an amateur boxer, falls in love with Giulia. For her love he follows her to Fregene, where Giulia is on vacation in a beautiful villa. Summer passes between baths, jokes and songs; only at the end Stefano confesses his love to Giulia. However, the girl has to leave for England and Stefano, desperate, wants to give up his boxing career.
notes: After "Sapore di mare" here is a holiday film that if it were not for the clothes it could be set in the Sixties, including the myth of England for young people: what reminds us of reality is the age of Little Tony, Peppino Di Capri and Edoardo Vianello.

title: Quando dico che ti amo
actors: Tony Renis, Lola Falana, Alida Chelli, Annarita Spinaci, Enzo Jannacci, Lucio Dalla, Caterina Caselli
description: There are six girls with whom the singer Tony has a relationship, each of which without the knowledge of the others. The situation worsens when Tony falls seriously in love with Sandra, a beat singer. The rivals discover their relationship, set up an ambush for Tony and beat him up. Sandra breaks off her relationship with the young man, but the happy ending is lurking.
notes: Musical film with many vintage singers; a small part also for Enzo Jannacci, Lucio Dalla and the inevitable Caterina Caselli.

title: When Worlds Collide
actors: Richard Derr
description: Two planets that have entered the orbit of the Earth, condemn the planet to imminent destruction. Naive science fiction produced by George Pal. Oscar for special effects, some of which still maintain a certain effectiveness today.

title: As Summers Die
actors: Scott Glenn, Jamie Lee Curtis, Bette Davis
description: A lawyer from a Louisiana town agrees to defend a black woman in a lawsuit against a wealthy local family.The cast is very rich: in addition to Scott Glenn (Silence of the Lambs) and Jamie Lee Curtis (Blue Steel) there are even eyes by Bette Davis.

title: Quando la coppia scoppia
actors: Enrico Montesano, Claude Brasseur, Dalila Di Lazzaro, Daniela Poggi
description: The caricaturist Enrico Granata (Montesano) is thirty years old, married and a father. One day his wife announces that everything is over between them. He tries to take her as a civilized person, but jealousy torments him because he learns that another man has entered her life. Enrico tries in vain to win back his wife, then meets another woman with whom he starts a new life.
notes: The subject is due to Montesano himself who had just experienced a similar moment in his private life. Without verve.

title: The Seven Year Itch
actors: Marilyn Monroe, Tom Ewell, Evelyn Keyes, Oskar Homolka
description: In the heat of Manhattan, while his wife and son are on vacation, Richard Sherman meets the upstairs neighbor. Richard is not insensitive to the girl's charm, but he is also an average American, moreover jealous of his wife who has found an old suitor in the resort. Between very healthy temptations and insane jealousies, Richard finally decides to leave to join his family.
notes: ONE of Wilder's masterpieces, an ingenious investigation into the psychology of the Western male and the desires induced by the mass media. Rhythm among the most perfect to have inhabited the screen. Marilyn with the skirt that rises above the subway grate has become part of the symbolic images of this century.

title: Quando le donne avevano la coda
actors: Senta Berger, Giuliano Gemma, Renzo Montagnani, Lino Toffolo
description: Some cavemen, who grew up in a semi-desert area, one day find a strange animal in a trap. It is a woman, but they don't know what it is. Accustomed, as they are, to feeding on all kinds of living beings, including their fellows, they prepare to kill and eat it. Equipped with a tail, but much more intelligent than them, the woman manages to convince her executioner to spare her.
notes: The film, directed by Festa Campanile and scripted, among others, by Lina Wertmüller, does not go beyond pecoreccio humor.

title: When the Clouds Roll By
actors: Douglas Fairbanks, Herbert Grimwood, Kathleen Clifford
description: We are at the beginning of the century and Doctor Metz is obsessed with the idea of ​​being able to explain human life with the methods of the exact sciences. His guinea pig is Daniel Boone Brown (Fairbanks), a superstitious young man to the point of neurosis who, because of Metz, comes to risk suicide. First film by Fleming, the future director of Gone with the Wind and second production by Douglas Fairbanks for the newborn United Artist. The film begins with Fairbanks being chased by the (enlarged) food he has just eaten. The classic story of the mad scientist is seasoned, that is, with surreal glimpses, but the ending is still reassuring.

title: Right to Die
actors: Raquel Welch, Michael Gross, Bonnie Bartlett
description: Emily Bauer (Raquel Welch), a happily married psychologist, discovers she has a deadly disease.

title: The Burning Bed
actors: Farrah Fawcett, Paul Le Mat, Richard Masur
description: After getting married at a very young age, she had to suffer such beatings and humiliations from her husband that led to divorce. An accident has temporarily recomposed the couple but the woman, in order to save her life and that of three children, eventually makes a drastic and tragic decision. frivolous cliché of blonde beauty a bit dizzy.

title: Fatal Judgment
actors: Patty Duke, Joe Regalbuto, Tom Conti, Philip Sterling
description: A nurse caring for a terminally ill patient runs into serious trouble with the law when the man dies. Did he exaggerate with the doses? Was it a carelessness? Or maybe he just wanted to get it over with? These questions will have to be answered by the brilliant lawyer who defends her before a court in Massachusetts. The film is based on a book by Gary Provost, which is inspired by a real fact. For someone like Patty Duke who became famous at a very young age in the theater with Anna dei miracoli and who also took the Oscar for the same role in the film version, this tvmovie is not exactly the best of aspirations.

title: Quanto costa morire
actors: Andrea Giordana, John Ireland
description: Snowbound in a mountain village, a group of cattle thieves kill the sheriff and terrorize the citizens. The sheriff's son goes into hiding and ponders revenge. First (and only) film by Sergio Merolle, a production manager; the only peculiarity is that it is filmed in the mountains of Abruzzo.

title: Forty Guns
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, Barry Sullivan, Dean Jagger, John Ericson, Gene Barry
description: A strong-willed landowner (Barbara Stanwyck) has bribed an assistant sheriff and rules Tombstone with her forty bravadoes. A federal agent (Barry Sullivan) goes to the scene to restore law and order. Samuel Fuller confirms himself as a robust innovator by breaking up many stereotypes of cinematic storytelling, not just westerns. The formal combination of daring sequence-shots and lightning-fast dramatic solutions is remarkable, while the screenplay (signed by the director himself) overturns the canonical balance of power between the sexes. The happy ending, as happened on other occasions, however, was imposed on Fuller by the production.

title: Forty-Second Street
actors: Warner Baxter, Ruby Keeler, Bebe Daniels, Ginger Rogers
description: A Broadway impresario is preparing a new musical, but finds it hard to bear the whims of the prima donna, who among other things is the lover of the show's financier. Then the diva breaks her leg and a girl from the choir is called to replace her ...
notes: Lloyd Bacon replaced at the last moment Mervyn LeRoy (who directed the great musical of the period "The Dance of Lights"). The dance numbers move further and further away from the tables of the stage to arrive at the real cinema thanks above all to the choreography of Busby Berkeley. The film, a "social" musical in full Warner style (almost an allegory of the Great Depression) represented a decisive step in the career of Dick Powell and in that of the newcomer Ruby Keeler.

title: The Fourth War
actors: Roy Scheider, Jürgen Prochnow, Tim Reid, Lara Harris
description: Czechoslovakia, December 1988: on the border with Germany, Soviet troops are entrusted to the leadership of Vachalev, a veteran of the war in Afghanistan. It so happens that another veteran - Major Knowles, who fought in Vietnam - gains command of the American troops in Germany. The two face each other and try to cause an accident with catastrophic consequences. Defeated by their superiors, they face off with their bare hands in one last battle ...
notes: The idea of ??the two soldiers frustrated by a lost war looking for revenge was not bad, but Frankenheimer no longer has the incisiveness he had shown in _Seven days in May_.

title: Quartiere
actors: Victoria Zinny, Sergio Bini, Dario Ghirardi, Valeria Sabel, Alessandra Corsale
description: Four true stories set in the Roman district of Prati. First episode: two sisters accept a ride; one is raped but then forgives her attackers and marries one. Second: two friends meet again after many years; a relationship is born between them but one of the two is about to get married. Third: abandoned by his wife, he finds consolation in the contemplation of a tiger. Fourth: An old homeless man spends an unexpected night of love with a concierge. Agosti recovers the episodic structure typical of Italian comedy, but the (real) stories he tells are examples of how the most radical starting realism can acquire an almost surreal aura thanks to the staging. Excellent photography, which is by Agosti himself, a singular character in the Italian panorama.

title: Porte des Lilas
actors: Pierre Brasseur, Georges Brassens, Henri Vidal, Dany Carrel
description: A runaway bandit is hosted by two friends, but a girl is also involved and it will end badly. Clair investigates with an eye now sentimental now more melancholy, in the proletarian environment of the Parisian suburbs (rebuilt in the studio by the great set designer Lèon Barsacq): superb soundtrack by Georges Brassens.

title: Quartieri alti
actors: Adriana Benetti, Vittorio Sanipoli, Massimo Serato, Nerio Bernardi
description: A young man, lover of a mature upper-class lady, falls in love in return for a girl from whom he keeps that relationship hidden. The boy's friends, who benefit a lot from his relationship, oppose his engagement but the young man chooses love and marries his girlfriend. The film, based on the stories of Ercole Patti, is perhaps too affected by the war climate in which it was shot: in fact, the film, which began in 1943, will only be concluded after the liberation of Rome in June 1944. A certain fragmentation of the story, however, does not remove the charge of denunciation of a certain bourgeoisie under fascism and hits the mark.

title: Citizen Kane
actors: Orson Welles, Joseph Cotten, Dorothy Comingore, Agnes Moorehead, Ruth Warrick, Ray Collins, Erskine Sanford, Everett Sloane, William Alland, Paul Stewart, George Coulouris, Fortunio Bonanova, Gus Schilling, Philip Van Zandt
description: On the death of tycoon Kane (Welles), a journalist (Cotten) investigates his life: from his childhood to his rise in the world of press and finance, to his love affair with an opera singer who missed the lonely end in the luxurious and boundless estate of Xanadu (or Kandalù).
notes: Dazzling debut film by 25-year-old Orson Welles, a milestone in the history of cinema for stylistic innovations (the massive use of depth of field) and narrative (the cross and fragmented stories that try to arrive at an impossible truth about Kane ). A film unsurpassed in the story of the relationship between the individual and the capitalist system, in the baroque recapitulation of artistic and spectacular genres (the film begins with a fake newsreel). The screenplay is by Herman J. Mankiewicz (who won the Oscar), and closely retraces the career of tycoon William Randolph Hearst, who effectively boycotted the film by his means.

title: Fourth Protocol
actors: Michael Caine, Pierce Brosnan, Ned Beatty, Joanna Cassidy, Julian Glover, Michael Gough, Ray McAnally, Ian Richardson, Anton Rodgers, Caroline Blakiston, Joseph Brady, Betsy Brantley, Sean Chapman
description: A KGB general plots to violate the nuclear non-proliferation treaty between the US, the USSR and Great Britain. One of his trusty agents settles near an American base on English soil and works on the construction of an atomic device, of limited power but sufficient to unleash an unprecedented international accident. But the diligent British counterintelligence runs for cover.
notes: Michael Caine's sly mask is made for stories of this kind. He is the quintessential English agent, reckless and not too loyal to orders. A decent, meticulous, though not unforgettable, spy film.

title: De Vierde man
actors: Jeroen Krabbe, Renée Soutendijk, Thom Hoffman, Dolf de Vries, Geert de Jong, Hans Veerman, Hero Muller, Caroline de Beus, Reinout Bussemaker, Erik J. Meijer, Ursul de Geer, Filip Bolluyt, Hedda Lornie, Paul Nygaard
description: Gerard, successful writer and homosexual accepts the tight court of the charming Christine. In reality he is attracted to a young man who he has guessed is his lover; manages to seduce him, but discovers that the woman is already the widow of three husbands, all of whom have died in road accidents. He warns the young man, who, however, does not listen to him; when he dies the same way, Gerard is upset to the point of having to be hospitalized.
notes: Erotic-intellectual digressions of the future director of "Robocop" and "Act of force", before his definitive move from Holland to Hollywood. Very hard and a little smug, but more rigorous than the following films.

title: Quatermass II
actors: Brian Donlevy, John Longden, Sidney James, Bryan Forbes
description: Quatermass and a collaborator investigate the fall of strange meteorites. They discover a large secret research center and also find one of the mysterious space bodies from which a gas escapes that burns Quatermass's collaborator. Behind all this there are aliens and a horrible bioweapon, which Quatermass will be able to neutralize, first addressing a deputy and then the police. Low-cost but very effective films, between science fiction and horror, and with an eye to L ' Invasion of the Body Snatchers: Earth is saved by the versatility of the scientific spirit against the ignorant immobility of politicians and military personnel.

title: Fourteen Hours
actors: Richard Basehart, Paul Douglas, Barbara Bel Geddes
description: Traffic Officer Dunnigan notices a man balancing on the fifteenth-floor ledge of a building, about to throw himself into the void. When the alarm is given, Dunnigan reaches the room closest to the suicide wannabe and begins a dialogue with him from the window. Meanwhile, the police have identified the young man: he has just left his girlfriend so as not to make her unhappy and has decided to end it.
notes: Beautiful drama, almost documentary, based on a real episode, which quickly captivates the viewer with relentless pace.

title: Shark!
actors: Burt Reynolds, Arthur Kennedy, Barry Sullivan, Silvia Pinal
description: Caine, an American adventurer in Africa, embarks as a machinist on the boat of a self-styled scientist who is looking for a cargo of gold in a wreck. A woman, beautiful and dangerous, and a brutal and corrupt policeman also buzz around so much wealth.
notes: Adventure film taken away from Fuller, who denied the authorship. But it's still hard to think it would have been one of his best films.

title: I quattro bersaglieri
actors: Alberto Sordi, Lyla Rocco, Mirka Ellis, Maurizio Arena
description: Mario (Sordi) is in the military in Rome. He gets engaged to Maria and, when he is transferred to Libya, she follows him as a Red Cross nurse. Failed attempt at comedy that renders the atmosphere of the Italian belle qpoque. We do not laugh enough, nor do we cry enough when, in the end, we touch the tragedy.

title: Benji the Hunted
actors: Red Steagall, Frank Inn, Nancy Francis, Mike Francis
description: Benji, a cute little dog, swims away from a violent storm at sea and witnesses the killing of a female puma leaving four cubs. He takes charge of them and carries them safely through various dangers and from ferocious predators (a bear, a wolf, a fox), until he finds a new adoptive mother of their own kind.
notes: Fascinating landscapes of Oregon, a story that tends to move and, at the same time, to create a dramatic tension, perfectly trained animals: a well-told tale for a young audience but which also captures those far from the green age.

title: Until They Sail
actors: Jean Simmons, Joan Fontaine, Paul Newman, Piper Laurie, Sandra Dee
description: In a small town in New Zealand, the four Leslie sisters are left alone when the Second World War breaks out. Of their men, recalled to the front, only one will return: drama in black and white and in cinemascope, based on a novel by James Michener. Excellent actresses. But while they struggle against misfortune, we struggle with Morpheus.

title: Bonne à tuer
actors: Danielle Darrieux, Michel Auclair, Corinne Calvet, Myriam Petacci
description: The first wife, the second and current one, who betrays him, the one who should become the third in the programs, that is a very young heiress and the unscrupulous secretary-lover: these are the four women that Larry Roques (Michel Auclair) has gathered in his new home.
