Reason? Larry wants to eliminate the current spouse who, in order to grant the divorce, asks for too high compensation, but ...
notes: Acting, set design and photography are the best things in the film.

title: Doctor in the House
actors: Dirk Bogarde, Kenneth More, Muriel Pavlow, Donald Houston
description: Comic-sentimental misadventures in a hospital of a group of medical students. It is the first film in a series of great success in both cinema and television, which launched Dirk Bogarde as a brilliant actor, but which arrived in Italy occasionally.

title: I 4 inesorabili
actors: Adam West, Robert Hundar, Howard Ross, Robert Camardiel, Raf Baldassarre, John Bartha, José Jaspe, Dina Loy, Cris Huerta, Elisa Mainardi
description: Adventures of an upright ranger to whom a quartet of bounty killers try to party. Zeglio, a busy man, tries to move this routine western filmed in economics as best he can, and puts a certain modesty in the spectacle of violence.

title: I 4 moschettieri
actors: Peppino De Filippo, Aldo Fabrizi, Erminio Macario, Nino Taranto
description: Passing off as musketeers, four nice rogues sneak into the court where they take possession of the jewels that the queen has destined for an English lord. Faced with the desperation of the sovereign they are moved and decide to rob another: Richelieu.
notes: Bragaglia is a good craftsman, capable of making the comic roles of this excellent cast stand out even from a cheap script. The film is a cheap doublet, but Peppino De Filippo plays Cardinal Richelieu with great class and malice.

title: Loving Couples
actors: Shirley MacLaine, James Coburn, Susan Sarandon, Stephen Collins
description: Walter is a famous career doctor who neglects his wife Evelyn, who is also a doctor. This, tired of her husband's constant betrayals, decides to take revenge by letting herself be seduced by the suffocating court of Gregg, a handsome young man. His girlfriend, however, discovers their relationship and warns her betrayed husband. So the starting couples separate to cross partners, but in the end everyone realizes that they were better off before.
notes: A very interesting cast wasted by a subject among the most trite and a trivial and absolutely devoid of ideas realization.

title: The Dream Team
actors: Michael Keaton, Christopher Lloyd, Peter Boyle, Stephen Furst
description: While accompanying Billy, Henry, Jack and Albert, four hospitalized for mental illness, Dr. Weitzman witnesses the murder committed by two corrupt policemen and is reduced to death by them. Nobody takes seriously the testimony of the four, now forced to rely only on their own strength.
notes: Humor and thrilling to say that mental suffering is healed with freedom. Too bad this thesis is not supported by a more breezy script and a more brilliant direction.

title: The Four Feathers
actors: John Clements, Ralph Richardson, C. Aubrey Smith, Jack Allen
description: We are in Sudan, during the colonial war between the British and the dervishes. The young officer protagonist wants to redeem himself from the accusation of cowardice that earned him the symbolic gift of four feathers from his friends. The opportunity comes from a risky but necessary undertaking for the final victory. The young man brilliantly surpasses it, confirming himself as the legitimate heir to British military honor.
notes: Second son of the three director brothers, of which the most famous was Alexander, Zoltan Korda always underwent the charm of distant lands, of exotic landscapes. His films still know how to communicate this to us, thanks also to the splendid photography of Jack Cardiff and Georges Périnal.

title: Two Tickets to Broadway
actors: Janet Leigh, Eddie Bracken, Gloria DeHaven
description: Dan is about to leave New York, disappointed, where for two years he has been waiting, in vain, for the big opportunity, which was to pave the way for success. Following an exchange of suitcases, Dan meets Nancy, who, having arrived at that moment from the province full of enthusiasm, is also looking for a writing. One day Nancy meets three girls, makes friends and decides to share an apartment with them.
notes: The structure is one of the most common and exploited in the revised films: the precarious initial situation, a hypothesis of success, the temptation to give up everything. While not one of the most famous, it is a musical of solid Hollywood professionalism.

title: Quattro ragazze sognano
actors: Valentina Cortese, Vanna Vanni, Paolo Stoppa
description: An American girl inherits a house from her uncle in which she goes to live with three of her friends. There is also a package of shares that the curator of the succession, a notary with few scruples, tries to steal them. But unexpectedly, a young man arrives to help the girls who, more through pose than conviction, poses as a gangster.
notes: Typical "war" comedy (in the sense that it was meant to distract people from the evils of war) directed by the future leader of the "Everyman" political movement.

title: Road House
actors: Ida Lupino, Richard Widmark, Cornel Wilde, Celeste Holm
description: Jefty, the owner of some nightclubs on the border with Canada, is known by all as a low-grade Don Juan. Jefty loves to woo the artists who perform as dancers in her nightclubs. One day he returns from the city with Lily, a beautiful girl who has convinced him of his many artistic skills. Pete Morgan, the manager of the club, tries to warn the girl and tries in every way to get her to break the contract. The girl refuses.
notes: A small but well-functioning film noir, with an almost new Richard Widmark and a delightful Ida Lupino (who sings).

title: Québec
actors: Corinne Calvet, John Barrymore jr., Barbara Rush, Patric Knowles
description: In Canada of the last century the revolt against the English domination mounts. A woman, betrothed to the rebel leader and with whom she also had a son, is coveted by an English officer who makes her believe that her man has been killed. She marries the officer, then discovers the truth and takes revenge. Little drama and little conviction in this feeble historical re-enactment.

title: Those Magnificent Men in Their Flying Machines
actors: Sarah Miles, Stuart Whitman, James Fox, Alberto Sordi, Robert Morley
description: The prize for those who win the flight from London to Paris, at a time when it took more recklessness than courage to face the sky, is 50,000 dollars. The competitors are numerous, coming from all over the world, and it even happens that someone makes it and takes home what, at the time, was a colossal figure.
notes: A curious comedy that begins by retracing the history of aviation and enters the story by celebrating the "magic" of man who manages to fly, despite the law of gravity. A cast of stars (including Benny Hill!) For a large international production that hasn't skimped on the budget but unfortunately lacks pace. We have fun, but in flashes.

title: Queimada
actors: Marlon Brando, Evaristo Marquez, Renato Salvatori, Dana Ghia
description: An English agent organizes the revolt against the Portuguese on a Caribbean island and ten years later returns to kill José Dolores, the man he himself had chosen as the leader of the revolution. A little confusing, but visually fascinating. Brando is perfect in the role. Gillo Pontecorvo wastes a good subject to make his political metaphor immediately evident (in the middle of the Vietnam War).

title: Quel bandito sono io
actors: Jean Kent, Robert Beatty, Gordon Harker, Margaret Rutherford
description: From the comedy of the same name by Peppino De Filippo: a Neapolitan bandit goes to the bank to sell a fake banknote and realizes, with great surprise, that the cashier is his double. His accomplices then think of exploiting the resemblance to carry out a millionaire heist by sending a blackmail letter to the meek banker. Salvation will have the face of a maid.
notes: Rather ramshackle film although Steno and Monicelli collaborated on the screenplay, Mario Bava for photography, Nino Rota for music, Piero Gherardi for scenography. From a comedy by Peppino De Filippo, one of Soldati's "food" films.

title: Quel caldo maledetto giorno di fuoco
actors: Robert Woods, John Ireland, Claudie Lange, Evelyn Stewart
description: Spying in the West around Mr. Gatlin, inventor of the machine gun. The skein is unraveled by Nat Pinkerton himself. A western film with intertwining pretensions, but really too poor.

title: That Certain Feeling
actors: Bob Hope, George Sanders, Eva Marie Saint, Pearl Bailey, Al Capp
description: Ambitious comic book author in crisis of inspiration exploits the ex-husband of his secretary-girlfriend, now his collaborator. He will be punished. Slow and without polish, a vehicle for Bob Hope.

title: The Great Bank Robbery
actors: Zero Mostel, Kim Novak, Claude Akins, Akim Tamiroff
description: Mexican Pedro's desperados are preparing the assault on Friendly's bank. They do not know what similar intention Slade's men and the very skilled burglars led by Harry have, for the occasion disguised as a preacher. Even the bank manager has his own plan to escape with the loot, and for this very reason the bank management has him stalked by a young agent. Harry will manage to get hold of the loot but has a hard time escaping. He will only succeed because one of his accomplice seduces the agent and convinces him to let him escape. Tired Western remake of Rififi, with many actors all from the background.

title: I Ought to be in Pictures
actors: Walter Matthau, Ann-Margret, Dinah Manoff, Lance Guest
description: Libby, an ambitious girl, wants to enter the world of cinema and goes to Hollywood hoping for the support of her father, who fifteen years earlier went to be a screenwriter in the capital of cinema. But the man is a failure: it is indeed the daughter who helps the parent and not vice versa, after the mutual incomprehension of the beginning. The girl's artistic hopes slowly fade, but on the other hand she gives back her father's confidence.
notes: The film, based on a Neil Simon comedy, is entertaining for the brilliant dialogue and interpretation of Matthau as the wacky parent and Ann Margret as the make-up artist.

title: Quel gran pezzo dell'Ubalda tutta nuda e tutta calda
actors: Edwige Fenech, Pippo Franco, Karin Schubert, Umberto D'Orsi
description: Olimpo, husband of Fiamma, aims for the bed of Ubalda, Oderisi's wife, but his attempts fail, certainly not because of the woman's virtue. Oderisi's initiatives for revenge have no better fate towards Olimpo's wife. At which, the two men sign an apparent armistice, but the consequences will be very heavy for both. Good ladies, on the other hand, enjoy themselves with lovers.
notes: A legendary title of Italian comedy. A vulgar Ciociaro "decamerotic" and, if you like, almost funny in its nothingness. Farts, coitus, double meanings.

title: The Long Good Friday
actors: Bob Hoskins, Helen Mirren, Eddie Constantine, Derek Thompson, Paul Freeman
description: Harold Sand is a leader of the London underworld who sees his trafficking hampered by a series of attacks against the men of his gang. At first, Sand believes that rival gangsters stand in his way, but that's not the case. He soon discovers that the IRA is lined up against him. Political issues take a back seat in this film which aims above all at a strong suspicion and makes use of the excellent evidence of Hoskins.

title: The Train Robbers
actors: John Wayne, Ann-Margret, Ben Johnson, Christopher George
description: Belinda Lowe (Ann-Margret), a young widow, has two problems: rehabilitating her late husband's name and returning the half million dollars in gold he had stolen and hidden in the desert. So he hires Lane (Wayne), a former captain of the Northern Army, with the promise to leave him and his gang the reward promised to those who recover the loot. Once the mission is complete, with Belinda already gone with the gold, an insurance agent explains to Lane that the girl is a skilled con artist.
notes: Wayne is overweight and has watery eyes. His comradely and obvious duets with Ben Jonhson are pure nostalgia. After all, the whole film fails to take off.

title: Quel maledetto giorno d'inverno... Django e Sartana...
actors: Hunt Powers, Simone Blondell, Stet Carson, Dean Stratford, Dennys Colt
description: Black City has long been subjected to raids by a gang of gringos. Just when the new sheriff arrives, the bounty hunter Django shows up and clashes with the bandits. He is about to get the worst of it, but is saved by the decisive intervention of the young guardian of the law, up to that moment anxious to avoid any confrontation. At the time of collecting the bounty it turns out that the sheriff is actually Sartana, a well-known gunslinger and also a bounty hunter. Continuous carnage, costs reduced to a minimum and plot inconsistencies for one of the last serious spaghetti westerns, while the parodies of Trinity were already taking hold.

title: That Wonderful Urge
actors: Tyrone Power, Gene Tierney, Reginald Gardiner, Arleen Whelan
description: Tom is an impertinent journalist who does not look anyone in the face and who, using a pseudonym, has written a series of articles full of malice about Sara, the very rich heiress. Luckily the woman has a very strong sense of humor, but despite this she takes a lot of anger because of those irreverent articles. When the two meet, sparks occur as she puts him to the sedan and he responds in kind.
notes: Pleasant remake of "Love is new", a 1937 film directed by Tay Garnett with the same Power and Loretta Young.

title: Dog Day Afternoon
actors: Al Pacino, John Cazale, Charles Durning, Chris Sarandon, Sully Boyar, Beulah Garrick
description: On August 22, 1972, three thugs storm a Brooklyn bank. One of the three immediately pulls back and runs away; Sal and Sonny are trapped on the bank premises after the accidental police intervention. A hallucinating and in some ways grotesque tug-of-war begins between the two robbers and the police: in the middle is the bank staff. Sonny manages to parley and negotiate the conditions for the escape; then, however, the FBI takes over the operations.
notes: Sidney Lumet reconstructs the story in a nervous and well-written film (Oscar to the screenplay), which gives no respite, excellently served by a very charged Al Pacino supported by a good John Cazale. A noir that becomes a black comedy, then a tragedy and a metaphor.

title: Quel ragazzo della curva B
actors: Nino D'Angelo, Laurentina Guidotti, Benito Artesi, Aldo Tarantino
description: The mechanic Nino is a Napoli fan and loves clean sport, without pollution of any kind. He founds a club for whose members these values ??are basic and is successful with the young people, the parish priest and even the women of the neighborhood. The Camorra tries to get their hands on it but deludes itself: it takes more, with all these honest people. And Napoli, joyfully, wins the Scudetto.
notes: The blond Nino D'Angelo, prince of the Neapolitan melody, in a very cloying comedy full of good feelings and without any depth. The only positive note is the football side: those were the good times of the great Diego Armando ...

title: Quel tesoro di papà
actors: Aurelio Fierro, Yvonne Monlaur, Raffaele Pisu, Ennio Girolami
description: Daughter of a fallen noble, Marina falls in love with a driver. The father encourages love, the aunt opposes it. Misunderstandings and songs by Aurelio Fierro up to the rosy final.

title: That Kind of Woman
actors: Sophia Loren, Tab Hunter, George Sanders
description: On the Miami-New York train, Kay (Sophia Loren) falls in love with Red, a young military man on leave but, already mistress of a mature millionaire, resists his feelings. Red, although brutally rejected, does not give up and returns to the charge. When the rich man senses the danger, he proposes to Kay to marry him and she seems inclined to accept.The story tastes stale and Sidney Lumet, in her third film after the splendid debut of The Word to the Jurors, tries to infuse her with new freshness by injecting her with rhythm. . Loren serves the director very well in this effort, and in the end the film can be saved thanks to the beautiful photography of Boris Kaufman.

title: 3:10 to Yuma
actors: Glenn Ford, Van Heflin, Felicia Farr, Leora Dana
description: Poor and honest farmer but very skilled marksman Dan Evans has to escort the bandit Ben Waden to Yuma. But the bandits barricade him in the town, and he must be able to jump out at the last minute with the prisoner and jump into the train. Excellent western with psychological veins, built on a very tight unity of time, place and action. In the tension between the individual and the community it can remember "High Noon". Breathtaking suspence in the finale, a famous song by Frankie Lane as a leitmotif.

title: Cet obscur objet du désir
actors: Fernando Rey, Angela Molina, Carole Bouquet, Julien Bertheau
description: Seville. Mathieu is leaving on the train for Paris. Concha begs him not to leave her, but he spills a bucket of water on her head. Then he tells his story to his astonished traveling companions. Since he met Concha, desire devours him, but the girl disconcerts him: now it seems easy and now inaccessible. The game continues, more and more cruel, grotesque and obsessive. In the epilogue, a woman stitches up a bloodstained sheet. An explosion destroys everything. Yet another, last magic of one who knew about the strategies of desire. And the idea of ??having two different actresses play the same part is as simple as it is brilliant.

title: There's Always Tomorrow
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, Fred MacMurray, Joan Bennett, Pat Crowley
description: Clifford, a wealthy industrialist, apparently leads a normal life with his wife and two grown children. But in reality he is dissatisfied with the monotony of the family routine and the indifference that his children show for him. Little by little he binds himself with a woman he has known for many years: their relationship is innocent, but the children (who have noticed it) suspect that the woman is their father's lover. The family situation worsens, Clifford really falls in love and wants to run away with her. Flamboyant melodrama like all those directed by Sirk, master of the genre, which re-proposes the couple of protagonists of The flame of sin.

title: Spencer's Mountain
actors: Henry Fonda, Maureen O'Hara, Donald Crisp
description: The Spencers live in the rugged mountainous region of Wyoming. They have nine children, to whom their father Clay, who works in a marble quarry, tries to give a decent future. The biggest problem arises when Clayboy, the eldest son, passes his high school exams with flying colors and asks to go to college. That means two arms less to keep the shack running and a big expense for college maintenance. The family, along with the whole country, join forces to allow the boy to improve his social position.
notes: Film full of good feelings equally dosed between the dramatic and the sentimental with a pragmatic "happy ending".

title: The Dirty Dozen
actors: Lee Marvin, Ernest Borgnine, Charles Bronson, Telly Savalas, Jim Brown, John Cassavetes, Richard Jaeckel, George Kennedy, Trini Lopez, Ralph Meeker, Robert Ryan
description: The landing in Normandy is now imminent. The Allied General Staff entrusts Major John Reisman, aided by Sergeant Ballon, with the task of blowing up a castle in France, where the highest officers of the German command usually meet. The locality is a nerve center and a pleasure house to pass the moments free from the fatigue of war. However, the mission presents very high risks that cannot be entrusted to ordinary soldiers, however skilled and courageous.
notes: War is a game of fools, Aldrich seems to say, but a game from which the best can emerge from even the worst scum. Ambiguous, dirty, politically very incorrect and warmongering, but with an unsurpassed rhythm and cynicism. Energy to spare and a great cast held together by Lee Marvin.

title: The Dirty Dozen: The Deadly Mission
actors: Telly Savalas, Ernest Borgnine, Randall Cobb, Vince Edwards, Gary Graham, James Van Patten, Vincent Van Patten, Bo Svensson
description: The Germans are about to produce a terrible new chemical weapon. Twelve soldiers, former inmates led by Telly Savalas, must stop him. Twenty years later TV sequel to Aldrich's classic. Comparison unthinkable.

title: Go Trabi Go
actors: Wolfgang Stumpf, Claudia Schmützler, Marie Gruber
description: An "average" family from former East Germany (husband, wife and peperina daughter) sets off on board the proverbial Trabant car for an adventurous, full of unexpected but nevertheless exciting holiday in Italy. A comedy so-so, a little simple but without vulgarity.

title: Quella villa in fondo al parco
actors: David Warbeck, Janet Agren, Eva Grimaldi
description: A humanoid monster breaks free from a laboratory in the Caribbean and kills people, starting with the usual supermodel. The police groped for a while in the dark, then a girl and a mystery writer find the right lead. Horror without fantasy by the pseudo-Ascot Giuliano Carnimeo.

title: Quelle sporche anime dannate
actors: Jeff Cameron, Donald O'Brien, Alfredo Rizzo
description: In the town of Greenwood, the wealthy Shannon is trying, by hook or by crook, to force all the farmers in the area to give him their land. In defense of the settlers, Tom Kanter intervenes, a man who is looking for a certain Ringo who, years earlier, during a robbery, had killed his brother Jerry. Shortly before the final confrontation, Tom also discovers that Shannon was the instigator of Jerry's murder. Badly done, badly directed and badly acted late Italian western.

title: Quelle strane occasioni
directors: Luigi Magni, Luigi Comencini, Nanni Loy
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Nino Manfredi, Alberto Sordi, Stefania Sandrelli, Flavio Bucci
description: Giobatta, a super-gifted erotic performer in a nightclub, succumbs to his wife's jealousy, involves her in the show and fails: the natural consequence is that he is downgraded. Antonio Pecoraro, on the other hand, is an architect who, in bed with a friend's daughter, discovers many things about his wife and daughter. In the final episode, the Jesuit Monsignor Ascanio La Costa is stuck in the elevator with the provocative Donatella ...
notes: Yet another and tired attempt to resurrect the Italian comedy by flavoring it with spicy condiments. The stories are inconsistent and the film is saved only for the professionalism of the performers.

title: Quelli belli... siamo noi
actors: Maurizio, Orchidea De Santis, Lino Banfi, Carlo Dapporto, Loredana Berté, Isabella Biagini
description: Amateur singer-songwriter falls in love with a Sicilian woman, but her father has already promised her. He consoles himself with another, she doesn't forgive him, but in the end two friends fix everything. Songs with outline of well-known comedians.

title: Quelli della montagna
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, Mariella Lotti, Mario Ferrari, Cesco Baseggio
description: Lawyer in civilian life and lieutenant of the Alpini in the army, the protagonist gets to take his wife with him to his destination in the mountains. The protagonist is in stark contrast to his captain and, moreover, his wife leaves him. There is no sparing of rhetoric in this film which is clearly "son of his time", more for bad than for good. but there is an energetic Nazzari and a certain narrative taste.

title: He Who Gets Slapped
actors: Marc MacDermott, Lon Chaney, Norma Shearer, John Gilbert, Tully Marshall
description: Having lost his wife and the "top secret" documents of his work, a scientist becomes a clown in a circus. A film that marries poetry and tragedy; it was the first major production of Metro Goldwin Meyer with a great Lon Chaney.

title: The Shaggy D. A.
actors: Dean Jones, Tim Conway, Suzanne Pleshette, Jo Anne Worley
description: Attorney Wilby Daniels, a candidate for the position of District Attorney, occasionally turns into a dog due to a magic ring ...
notes: It is the sequel to "Jeremiah, dog and spy", or the usual simple and pleasant Disney product, with the usual cast.

title: That Funny Feeling
actors: Sandra Dee, Bobby Darin, Donald O'Connor, Nita Talbot
description: Joan Howell is an aspiring actress, but to get by she works as a cleaner in an apartment she never knew the owner of. One day she meets a certain Tom, and a feeling arises between the two that soon turns into a love relationship. Taking advantage of the fact that the landlord is traveling, Joan invites Tom into the apartment pretending to be the owner. Of course the accommodation is Tom's ...
notes: The whole film is obvious and obvious. The comic element typical of misunderstanding is thus lost in boredom. Back then Sandra Dee and singer Bobby Darin were husband and wife off the set.

title: Vivre sa vie
actors: Anna Karina, Sady Rebbot, André S. Labarthe, Guylaine Schlumberger
description: Nana, a Parisian saleswoman who, not knowing how to pay the rent, decides to become a prostitute. The desire to return to a normal life is great, but Nana is forced to deal with her protector who doesn't want to let her go. Indeed, the shady individual tries to sell it to another "colleague" of his.
notes: The film was born from a journalistic investigation "Where is prostitution going?" signed by Marcel Sacotte. Godard divides the story of Nana into twelve paintings introduced by a quotation from Edgar Allan Poe's "Oval Portrait". Special Jury Prize at the Venice Film Festival, it is one of the masterpieces of Godard first style, one of the points of greatest balance between the explosion of traditional language and the critical confrontation with contemporary reality.

title: This Could Be The Night
actors: Jean Simmons, Anthony Franciosa, Paul Douglas, Joan Blondell
description: Anna is a candid teacher, who comes from the province and, after teaching during the day, to supplement her income she works in the evening as a secretary in a nightclub, whose owners are two unscrupulous guys with a turbulent past. His grace will be able to appease the two "tough" ones. The comedy is thin, but very pleasant, thanks also to the presence of a fresh and crafty Jean Simmons, able to navigate the equivocal jungle of nightclubs.

title: Questi fantasmi
actors: Sophia Loren, Vittorio Gassman, Mario Adorf, Aldo Giuffré
description: He believes in ghosts, but his wife's lover is made of flesh and blood. With a gimmick he saves face and love.
notes: Polite adaptation of a comedy by Eduardo De Filippo (already brought to the screen by the same writer in '54), with two sacred monsters, already too "international" inversion.

title: Tiger Bay
actors: John Mills, Horst Buchholz, Hayley Mills, Megs Jenkins
description: A sailor out of jealousy kills his girlfriend with a pistol shot. A little girl saw it all; the man takes her away with him and becomes her friend. Once the sailor has left, the police track down the girl, who, however, accuses the new boyfriend of the murdered girl. At this point the agents organize a confrontation between the girl and the sailor on board the ship. Lee Thompson is a filmmaker who knows how to juggle the rules of genres, usually managing to get good results, especially in detective stories, as in this case.

title: Una questione privata
actors: Rupert Graves, Céline Beauvallet, Alessandro Stefanelli, Rodolfo Corsato
description: Partisan Milton wants to find out if Giorgio, his best friend, was Fulvia's lover, with whom Milton is in love. He goes in search of him and comes to discover that Giorgio has been captured by the fascists, and is about to be shot. To ask for an exchange of prisoners, Milton manages to capture a black shirt sergeant but, following his escape attempt, is forced to kill him. From the raw novel of one of the greatest Italian writers of the twentieth century, Beppe Fenoglio, here is the third edition for the screen (the first was by Giorgio Trentin, with Valeria Ciangottini). A decidedly unconventional depiction of partisan warfare, wasted by the very mediocre director of "Io e il duce".

title: The Family Way
actors: John Mills, Hayley Mills, John Comer, Hywel Bennett, Marjorie Rhodes
description: Arthur and Jenny, fresh in marriage, are forced to give up the honeymoon and spend the honeymoon with the groom's family members. They are indiscreet, gossips and intrusive. Even the neighbors are placed, making insinuations on the conduct of the bride seen too often in the company of his brother -in -law. A light and ironic comedy, who manages not to get his hand taken too much by his ambitions of psychological study.

title: Questo e quello
actors: Nino Manfredi, Renato Pozzetto, Sylva Koscina, Janet Agren
description: Two-episode film. "This ... impossible love": Giulio (Pozzetto) is a comic artist who has not yet decided whether to be punk or hippie and is also in a professional crisis. Then, one evening, he meets a beautiful Swede whom he immediately falls in love with. In an attempt to show her all his love in comic strips, Giulio finds his lost creative vein. But disappointment is inevitable when he finds out that the big girl has been hired by her editor. "The one with the golden beret": Sandro (Manfredi), a distinguished 60-year-old intellectual, awakens the senses of a frustrated girl, the daughter of a woman with whom he had a relationship in the past.
notes: Corbucci leans towards the elementary level farce, loading everything on the shoulders of the actors, with a tinged script and directing as well.

title: It's a Wonderful World
actors: James Stewart, Claudette Colbert, Guy Kibbee, Nat Pendleton
description: Private detective Johnson arrives before the police at the place where a woman was murdered and finds a half coin, which he seizes. A client of the detective is accused of the crime and Johnson himself is arrested. Having fled, he meets Edwine and with her, through a thousand ups and downs, he arrives at the solution of the "case". With inevitable wedding march accompaniment for Johson and Edwine. Here is a film that, although not a masterpiece, has lost nothing, over time, of the merits of its decent production. The narrative mechanism devised by the great screenwriter Ben Hecht still works, with actors of the caliber of Stewart and Claudette Colbert.

title: It's a Mad, Mad, Mad, Mad World
actors: Spencer Tracy, Milton Berle, Sid Caesar, Mickey Rooney, Peter Falk
description: A gangster dies in a car accident. Before expiring he reveals to the rescuers that he has buried a huge sum. Thus begins a frantic treasure race. To beat the others on time, everyone uses the most disparate means, between thunderous brawl and extravagant situations. At the most beautiful, however, a police captain (Spencer Tracy) also enters, who unleashes the latest and delusional chase.
notes: The film grinds gags and spectacular twists, expanding and updating with a wealth of means the classic comic endings of silent cinema. It is no coincidence that in the role of Jimmy the Crook, the great Buster Keaton appears, the comedian who never laughed.

title: Quick
actors: Teri Polo, Martin Donovan, Jeff Fahey, Tia Carrere, Robert Davi
description: A mysterious brunette kills a gangster and his bodyguard in a Los Angeles boutique. The brunette, who is actually blonde, is called Quick (Teri Polo) and is a killer on behalf of a drug agent. Quick, however, also accepts other assignments, such as that of a mobster who wants to get rid of Herschel, a witness kept under surveillance by the FBI. But there is something that stinks and Quick instead of killing Herschel kidnaps him and takes him away.A good action movie that maybe a little bit like Nikita, but it works well on his legs, thanks also to the interpretation of Teri Polo , an almost revelation.

title: Quien sabe?
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, Klaus Kinski, Lou Castel, Martine Beswick, Andrea Checchi
description: Bill Tates (Castel) is commissioned by the Mexican government to liquidate Elias, leader of the revolutionaries. To reach his goal, he joins the gang of the opportunist El Chuncho (Volontè), who raids convoys and government barracks to resell weapons and ammunition to Elias. At the revolutionary headquarters El Chuncho, however, is accused of a horrendous crime and is about to be executed, but Bill saves him, and Elias is killed. With the reward in his pocket, the American would like to take his friend to the United States, but the latter has a jolt of pride. Damiani's skilful amalgamation of action and political message inaugurates a rich vein of western spaghetti. Unforgettable is the immense interpretation of Volontè, a disturbing "ugly dirty and bad" revolutionary anti-hero.

title: Quintet
actors: Paul Newman, Vittorio Gassman, Fernando Rey, Bibi Andersson
description: The earth is in the midst of a new glaciation; humanity is exhausted. Among those who still have energy at their disposal, a game called Quintet, which has the life of the losers at stake, is very fashionable. Essex is a hunter who agrees to play to understand what the meaning of this experience is. Cinematic meditation by Robert Altman, full of symbols and based on the very rules of the game that gives it its title. Cold film (and certainly not for its setting), which stages a sort of last act of degraded humanity, openly aiming at an involvement that is more intellectual than emotional.

title: Network
actors: Faye Dunaway, William Holden, Peter Finch, Robert Duvall
description: Commentator for a national TV network, Beale is in an audience crisis and is about to be fired. Embittered and depressed, he announces in front of the cameras that he will commit suicide, and the listening rises. Diana Christensen and other cynical TV managers sniff out the deal. They transform Beale into a TV preacher idolized by the crowd, then, when the phenomenon deflates, they have him murdered live. Pamphlet on television written by Paddy Chayefsky, who knew it from the inside: aggressive and effective, and above all supported by an extraordinary Peter Finch at his last performance (he won the Oscar for best actor, posthumously: and also the Dunaway won him as protagonist , Straight as a supporting character, and Chayefsky)

title: Quo vadis?
actors: Robert Taylor, Deborah Kerr, Peter Ustinov, Marina Berti
description: Under the dictatorship of the emperor Nero, the valiant Roman officer Marco Vinicius met the Christian Licia and fell in love with her. Following this meeting, Mark begins to have doubts about the faith and also to oppose the tyrannical madness of Nero who, in the meantime, sets fire to Rome, placing the blame on Christians ...
notes: Of the many "Quo vadis?" of cinema, again based on Sienkiewicz's novel, this is undoubtedly the best known. Six months of filming and a year of post-production for one of the most expensive blockbusters in the history of cinema. Among the many stars, Ustinov amusing gigione in the role of Nero is to be enjoyed better than the heroes Taylor and Kerr.

title: Up Periscope
actors: James Garner, Edmond O'Brien, Andra Martin, Alan Hale jr.
description: During the Second World War, an American submarine lands Second Lieutenant Ken Braden on an island occupied by the Japanese, where the officer will have to get hold of the secret cipher of the enemy fleet. During the voyage Braden and the commander of the submarine have an altercation that threatens to jeopardize the already difficult balance between the crew and the cockpit.
notes: A war film directed by an action movie specialist this time more interested in the psychologies of the protagonists than in situations. A few moments of tired, but overall enjoyable.

title: A Rage in Harlem
actors: Forest Whitaker, Gregory Hines, Robin Givens, Danny Glover
description: In Harlem in the 1950s violence dominates, but Jackson (Whitaker) still has a child's heart when the beautiful Imabelle bursts into his life, initiates him into sex and settles down with him, his life changes. In reality, she is hiding with the fruit of a robbery stolen from her accomplices. Whitaker's interpretation is splendid.

title: Rage and Honor
actors: Cynthia Rothrock, Richard Norton, Terri Treas, Brian Thompson
description: Kris Fairchild (Rothroch) is a high school teacher, but her real specialty is hand-to-hand combat. Preston Michaels (Norton) is a taciturn police officer who came undercover from Australia. The two embark on a mission together and, using kicks, punches and various forbidden blows, they manage to defeat a drug kingpin and with him also the corrupt cops. The film is not much more than a series of fights, one after the other, almost at random. To be recommended only to martial arts fanatics and especially those of Rothrock who, of her genre, is a little star.

title: Tales of Terror
actors: Vincent Price, Peter Lorre, Basil Rathbone, Debra Paget
description: Three episodes from E.A. Poe and adapted by Richard Matheson. The first (Morella) tells of a daughter who takes the place of the mummified body of her dead mother; the second (The Black Cat) of a betrayed husband who walls his wife and lover alive; the third (The case of Mr. Waldemar) of a hypnotist who postpones the death of a friend with grisly results. Roger Corman, producer and director, uses his tried and tested actors in the horror genre (Vincent Price above all, present in all three episodes) for a black fun with hallucinatory and grotesque tones, sometimes (as in the case of the cat that reveals a crime) not without a subtle hint of humor.

title: I racconti di Canterbury
actors: Hugh Griffith, Laura Betti, Ninetto Davoli, Franco Citti, Josephine Chaplin
description: Pellegrini traveling for Canterbury tells about short stories: a student seduces the wife of a superstitious woodsmith; Two friends take revenge on a dishonest miller; The misadventures of Candido and Gaio Perkin; An insatiable woman "consumes" five husbands; A mature bachelor marries a too young wife; the descent to the underworld of a friar; The failures of another friar to whom nobody wants to buy the relics. Second film of the "Trilogy of life", in which Pasolini marries the popular narrative vein of Geoffrey Chaucer with sensitivity of filmmaker and virulent choice of intellectual provocation. But the film is the least vital and interesting of the trilogy. Golden bear in Berlin.

title: Racconti romani
actors: Franco Fabrizi, Maurizio Arena, Antonio Cifariello, Giancarlo Costa, Vittorio De Sica, Totò, Giovanna Ralli, Silvana Pampanini
description: Released from the Regina Coeli prison, Alvaro Latini resumes his role as "leader" of the neighborhood, even if his mother and his wife welcome him with coolness and fear. The fishmonger Otello, the waiter Mario and Spartaco, a barber's boy, follow him in some small scams that will end up bringing the quartet back to prison.
notes: The film is a bitter portrait of marginal characters, taken from some of Alberto Moravia's "Roman tales". The screenplay is written by Amidei, Age, Scarpelli and Rosi. More "poor but beautiful" than "boys of life". Detail for Totò.

title: Radio Days
actors: Mia Farrow, Julie Kavner, Dianne Wiest, Seth Green, Josh Mostel, Andrew Clark
description: Joe's memories - his childhood, his family of Jewish origin - are linked to the years when there was no television and radio was the only source of entertainment and information. In the 1930s, between Glenn Miller's songs and the attack on Pearl Harbor, around Joe were his father, always ready for crazy adventures, his uncle, a very skilled fisherman, his gruff and affectionate mother, a everyone was in love with, an aunt, a spinster and a dreamer. Continuing his roundup of European-style films, Allen offers his personal Amarcord with his usual intelligence and melancholy finely combined with irony.

title: Rag. Arturo De Fanti, bancario precario
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Catherine Spaak, Anna Mazzamauro, Enrica Bonaccorti, Carlo Giuffrè, Anna Maria Rizzoli
description: The accountant De Fanti and his wife Elena are in financial difficulty. Their maid, waiting for the arrears of monthly payments, takes up residence with them as a guest. The two bring their respective lovers into the house, in exchange for a share in their income. The trouble is that the lovers' spouses will also arrive and that the complicated situation will be sensed by poor Arturo's director ...
notes: The film is one of Luciano Salce's last rehearsals. Some gags are spot on, but there are moments of tiredness.

title: La ragazza con la valigia
actors: Claudia Cardinale, Jacques Perrin, Romolo Valli, Corrado Pani, Gian Maria Volonté
description: Aida is a dancer with a stormy past. Lorenzo is a serious student from a good family. Despite everything conspiring against the possibility of their union, Lorenzo decides to invite Aida to join him in Parma, where he also pays his support. At a certain point Lorenzo's mathematics professor intervenes and convinces Aida of the ruin to which this union will inevitably lead the boy. Aida in spite of herself realizes that the professor (as well as a priest) is right and decides to leave. Good screenplay for a film in which Zurlini investigates the provincial environment and gives us a sharp and not superficial cross-section of Italian moralism. A small masterpiece.

title: A Very Special Favor
actors: Rock Hudson, Leslie Caron, Charles Boyer, Walter Slezak
description: Defeated in court by the American Paul Chadwick, the incredulous lawyer Michel Boullard manages to make him confess to having seduced the judge and to be promised a future and not better identified "compensation". It is Paul who turns to Michel to save his daughter, an established psychoanalyst, from the dryness of solitude: the charming American will have to break through the girl's heart. Comedy a little dated, but with some lively situation.

title: La ragazza del metrò
actors: Nino D'Angelo, Roberta Olivieri, Ninetto Davoli, Bruno Stori
description: Nino (D'Angelo) is a piano bar pianist; he meets a beautiful girl, Val, whom he falls in love with, loved back. But she is rich and doesn't want to let him know. Andrea, Val's ex-boyfriend, does everything to divide them and, in league with the underworld, even has the girl kidnapped, after humiliating Nino to get him out of the way. After several vicissitudes, however, the happy end inevitably arrives. D'Angelo, blond reuccio of the Neapolitan drama, goes through the most incredible situations unscathed.

title: La ragazza del Palio
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Diana Dors, Franca Valeri, Tina Lattanzi, Bruce Cabot
description: An American tourist, winner of a television quiz, and a penniless Sienese prince meet and fall in love. Deceived by appearances, they believe each other very rich, but the reality is quite different. After a long series of misunderstandings, they discover the truth, but they accept each other anyway. Zampa did better.

title: En cas de malheur
actors: Brigitte Bardot, Jean Gabin, Franco Interlenghi, Edwige Feuillère
description: Yvette is a girl adrift, accused of theft, who hires a renowned lawyer in her defense. He falls in love with her and abandons his bourgeois environment to follow the grateful girl, who however continues to associate with her young lover. When she finally decides to be alone with the lawyer, her ex kills her. She is Brigitte Bardot, he is Gabin, the other Interlenghi. A dramatic, morbid film, intended to challenge - says the director - retrograde and petty morals. However, it is not possible to go much beyond the anecdotal and the news, despite Gabin's determination.

title: Two for the Seesaw
actors: Shirley MacLaine, Robert Mitchum, Edmon Ryan, Elisabeth Fraser
description: A lawyer (Mitchum) who is about to divorce his wife decides to move to New York. Here he meets a dance teacher (MacLaine). The woman understands that the man is not entirely convinced of the separation and pushes him to reconcile with his wife. Based on a play by William Gibson, the film fully shows its weaknesses, even for Mitchum's less than excellent performance.

title: It Should Happen to You
actors: Judy Holliday, Jack Lemmon, Peter Lawford, Michael O'Shea
description: Gladys Glover comes from the provinces with only one idea in mind: to become famous. One day he decides to invest all his savings to put his name on a billboard in a very busy place in New York. Interviews, advertising contracts: this is how a star is born. All that's missing is love, and when Gladys arrives she'll be willing to throw her celebrity away. One of Cukor's masterpieces, one of the most intelligent comedies of the 1950s, satire of advertising and mass media and a tasty female portrait that matches that of "Born yesterday" (also played by Holliday). Screenplay by Garson Kanin.

title: The Bohemian Girl
actors: Stan Laurel, Oliver Hardy, Thelma Todd, Mae Busch, William P. Carleton
description: The gypsies Laurel and Hardy accused of having kidnapped the child they had lovingly adopted: one is "stretched" and the other "restricted" as punishment.

title: La ragazza di Bube
actors: Claudia Cardinale, Georges Chakiris, Marc Michel, Emilio Esposito
description: Immediately after the war, in Tuscany, Mara (Cardinal) falls in love with Bube, a young ex partisan forced into hiding because he is implicated in a political murder. Long separated from the man she loves, while her companions try to organize her escape abroad, Mara finds work in the city and meets Stefano, a good boy who proposes to marry him. She is about to accept when she receives the news that Bube has been arrested. Comencini tells the dramas of the post-war period without rhetoric, the bitterness of the former partisans disappointed in their political-social hopes. It is one of the best interpretations of the Cardinal.

title: The Country Girl
actors: Grace Kelly, Bing Crosby, William Holden
description: An alcoholic actor, his wife and the director of the new play. Bing Crosby, Grace Kelly and William Holden: a formidable trio of actors, but only Grace wins the Oscar.

title: Coal Miner's Daughter
actors: Sissy Spacek, Tommy Lee Jones, Levon Helm, Phyllis Boyens
description: The true story of Loretta Lynn, daughter of a Kentucky miner who became one of the most famous country singers in America: the marriage with a boy opposed by the family, the difficult maturation of the young couple, the birth of children. And one day the turning point, the first songs in the clubs, the recordings, the success. A parable perhaps too clear of the American dream; Sissy Spacek takes home an Oscar.

title: La ragazza di Trieste
actors: Ornella Muti, Ben Gazzara, Mimsy Farmer, Andréa Ferréol
description: Complicated love story between Dino, a comic artist, and a mysterious girl named Nicole. The mystery lies in the fact that the girl is a guest of a psychiatric institution from which she goes out from time to time for short periods. The relationship ends dramatically. Pasquale Festa Campanile transcribes his book for cinema with disappointing results.

title: La ragazza e il generale
actors: Virna Lisi, Rod Steiger, Umberto Orsini, Valentino Macchi
description: World War I, after the Italian defeat in Caporetto: the soldier Tarasconi (Orsini) captures an Austrian general (Steiger) and tries to bring him to his command; he would get the gold medal, a prize of one thousand lire and a license. Ada (Lisi), a smart and enterprising peasant woman, also intervenes, but the conclusion holds neither glory nor gratification. A "war tale", with a rather weak screenplay in its conspicuous inconsistencies and which is based more on the profession of interpreters.

title: La ragazza in vetrina
actors: Lino Ventura, Marina Vlady, Magali Noël, Bernard Fresson
description: Together with a group of Italians Vincenzo emigrated to Holland to work in a coal mine. His first experience in the bowels of the earth is traumatic. In fact, he remains imprisoned underground by a sudden collapse and, with difficulty, is freed by the rescue teams. Determined to return home, he is instead persuaded to stay by his friend Federico. The boy accompanies him to the famous street where prostitutes offer themselves from the windows of the houses. Here Vincenzo meets and falls in love with Els.
notes: Master of pink neorealism, Emmer gives the "French" Lino Ventura a very intense role in a courageous film, different from his previous production. Extremely bitter and raw, the film had serious problems with censorship (only recently some deleted scenes have been reinstated) and the director left the cinema to become a specialist in "carousels".

title: Made in Paris
actors: Ann-Margret, Louis Jourdan, Richard Crenna, Edie Adams, Chad Everett
description: Having become the director of the clothing store where she works from a saleswoman, the young American Maggie Scott, on a business trip to Paris, finds herself catapulted into the universe of haute couture ateliers in the French capital.

title: Billy Rose's Jumbo
actors: Doris Day, Jimmy Durante, Stephen Boyd, Martha Raye
description: A small circus, which has an elephant named Jumbo as its main attraction, risks bankruptcy also because the owner has an unbridled passion for the game of dice. But the biggest risk, in reality, is that a big player in the sector will buy it to attach it to its mega-circuit. The latter, however, has a son who has fallen in love with the daughter of the owner of the small circus and then things will no longer be so simple. A little tired but almost touching musical with the contribution of some absolute masters: songs by Rodgers and Hart, choreography by Busby Berkeley (at his latest work).

title: Das Mädchen Rosemarie
actors: Nadja Tiller, Peter Van Eyck, Carl Raddatz, Gert Fröbe, Hanne Wieder
description: Rosemarie is a beautiful blonde girl in post-WWII Germany, poor and hungry. He accompanies two courtyard musicians and dances to the notes of their music; then he puts his attractiveness to good use and learns that by accompanying rich gentlemen he earns more. And even more by stealing their secrets and then blackmailing them. Inspired by real situations in rubble Berlin, the story is told like a ballad, in a style reminiscent of the most classic Berlin cabaret, with mocking songs. In its time the film made an era, also for the presence of the explosive protagonist.

title: La ragazza sotto il lenzuolo
actors: Chelo Alonso, Walter Chiari, Carlo Delle Piane, Raimondo Vianello
description: In the crypt of an ancient castle transformed into a hotel, a thief, who pretends to be an archaeologist, discovers the ghost of Princess Maria Celeste d'Aragona Cortez. In an attempt to escape the intruder, the princess loses the sheet that made her invisible to human eyes. The complicity between the beautiful ectoplasm and the thief turns into love and for the woman he gets back on the right path. Except for the always glamorous Chelo Alonso, in the role of the princess, the film goes unnoticed. The cast is completed by the Cetra Quartet performing "Con il sob".

title: Candleshoe
actors: David Niven, Jodie Foster, Helen Hayes, Leo McKern, Veronica Quilligan
description: An orphan girl, with a rather difficult character, is welcomed in the shelter for abandoned boys founded and directed by an old English lady. Relations between the two women are not easy, so much so that the young woman tries to escape several times. One day a gang of thugs break into the hostel to try to steal a treasure hidden there by an old pirate. All the young guests then go into action to defend the loot and on this occasion the orphan and the lady discover they have much more in common than they previously seemed. Could the girl's origins hide a secret?

title: Belles on their Toes
actors: Myrna Loy, Debra Paget, Jeffrey Hunter
description: Widowed with twelve dependent children, Mirna Loy does not lose heart and sets up a school for managers. Enjoyable, but not exciting comedy, it is the sequel to "Twelve call him dad".

title: Ragazze d'oggi
actors: Marisa Allasio, Paolo Stoppa, Mike Bongiorno, Edoardo Bergamo, Camillo Milli, Lili Cerasoli
description: After the death of his wife, Peppino was left alone with his three daughters of marriageable age. Anna is engaged to the steward Sandro. Tilde discovers that her beloved is a swindler and abandons him. Sofia is with a married man who, despite his promises, does not intend to divorce his wife so as not to lose his father's money. The negative influence of Aunt Matilde also hangs over the three girls.
notes: In this case, Zampa lacks the corrosive spark. In the cast also an awkward, but already famous Mike Bongiorno.

title: Earth Girls Are Easy
actors: Geena Davis, Julie Brown, Jeff Goldblum, Damon Wayans, Jim Carrey
description: Three colorful and very hairy extraterrestrials land in the pool of Valerie, a Los Angeles manicurist in crisis with her partner, a surgeon. Valerie is at first frightened but then, after having humanized them in appearance with the help of her friend Candy, a beautician, she introduces them to worldly entertainment. Moreover, the girl does not remain insensitive to the charms of one of the three. After making a lot of trouble, the aliens leave for space and Valerie decides to follow them. A broken lance to intergalactic loves in this sly and slightly demented fairy tale, well served by a perky Geena Davis in the role of the nice manicurist.

title: The Harvey Girls
actors: Judy Garland, John Hodiak, Angela Lansbury
description: A stupid cowboy, a handsome one, and an all-girls restaurant. A good western musical. The future "lady in yellow" sings and dances pretty good, the choreography is by director Charles Walters.

title: Book of Love
actors: Chris Young, Keith Coogan, Aeryk Egan, Tricia Leigh Fisher
description: Jack, a moderately successful American writer, finds a message from a former schoolmate on his answering machine. Memories of adolescence come to mind in a succession of flashbacks: the heavy family atmosphere, the limping school career, the first troubles of the heart and sexuality, the marriage, up to his present life. It is difficult to understand the meaning of a well-packaged operation but already carried out many times: the past, even the most mediocre, is all wrapped up in stereotypes and in an aura of indulgent melancholy not too far from the (self) celebration.

title: I ragazzi dei Parioli
actors: Raf Mattioli, Alessandra Panaro, Ennio Girolami, Scilla Gabel, Nino Manfredi
description: Pretending to be film producers, two young men from Roma hope to attract young girls. The first meeting seems to turn into tragedy, then everything is resolved with laughter. At the beginning of his career Corbucci had some claim to social analysis, which was immediately abandoned. This is a portrait of a post-neorealist environment, uncertain but with some acute moments.

title: I ragazzi del 42º plotone
actors: Victor Rivers, Christopher Alan
description: Vietnam. A showgirl hired to raise the troop's low morale arrives in an American gathering camp. During his performance, the Vietcong launch a deadly attack. Two marines manage to save the girl and escape into the jungle.
notes: An all-Italian branded "survival" film. Too many things cloned from US war movies.

title: The Rat Race
actors: Tony Curtis, Debbie Reynolds, Jack Oakie, Joe Bushkin, Don Rickles
description: A young jazzman goes to New York in search of his fortune. He shares a hotel room with a broke girl who gets into further trouble for his sake. Delicate story of ordinary people, lonely people in the metropolis. From a play by Garson Kanin, classy screenwriter, with his wife Ruth, by George Cukor ("Girl of the Century").

title: The Boy Who Could Fly
actors: Lucy Deakins, Jay Underwood, Bonnie Bedelia, Fred Gwynne
description: An autistic boy thinks he can fly; he binds into a silent friendship with a sensitive schoolmate. The pathetic, lurking, spoils the ending.

title: Il ragazzo che sorride
actors: Al Bano, Rocky Roberts, Susanna Martinkova, Riccardo Garrone
description: Livia does not want to follow her husband Giorgio, a freshly graduated engineer called to manage a mine in Kenya. The young man, suspicious, instructs a friend to find out if his wife is cheating on him. Indeed, Livia frequents a hotel in Rome, but it is only to be visited by a foreign luminary who takes care of her sterility. Meanwhile, Giorgio is fighting to improve the lives of black miners. Livia, now healed, joins her husband and reveals her secret to him.
notes: 1968, year of engagement: Al Bano sings to music by Theodorakis and adds a caramelized anti-racism to the usual homemade sentimentality. Hypocritical.

title: Tex
actors: Matt Dillon, Meg Tilly, Emilio Estevez
description: The hard and tenacious struggle for the conquest of the serenity of Tex, a fifteen-year-old motherless and neglected by his father, more concerned about his "rodeo", of which he is the undisputed champion, than his son. Tex would like to be calm, but the conditions to which he is subject are too burdensome for him and moreover the gap between dreams and reality is still too wide to bridge. Attempt of psychological grafting on the themes of the Old Frontier.

title: Just One of the Guys
actors: Joyce Hyser, Clayton Rohner, Billy Jayne, Sherilyn Fenn
description: Terry is a student, she's cute, and she thinks she's cut out for journalism. The problem is that no one helps or takes her seriously. Maybe because she is a girl and maybe because she is pretty. Then he disguises himself as a man, starts over in a new school and eventually manages to win his journalism award. The writers of this film certainly didn't steal sleep time to come up with the story: they took Tootsie and turned him upside down. The result, however, is quite lively, fun and not unpleasant.

title: The Boy with Green Hair
actors: Pat O'Brien, Robert Ryan, Dean Stockwell, Barbara Hale
description: Little Peter, an orphan of war, lives with his grandfather. One morning he wakes up with green hair. Suddenly this strangeness makes him aware of his condition as a different (orphan) and desperation leads him to flee. Collected by the police, he finds comfort and hope for a better world in an interview with a sympathetic psychologist. Shot in '48 on the ruins of the Second World War, the film is an apologue told from the point of view of the child who becomes an indictment of racism and an invitation to freedom and tolerance because the first victims of errors (and horrors) adults are always children.

title: Il ragazzo dal kimono d'oro 3 - Il texano
actors: Christopher Alan, Ron Williams, Dorian D. Field
description: Larry Jones, a boy living in Ohio, moves to a new school. Here dominates the gang of thugs headed by Joe Carson, a karate expert. Carson and his team's target is Gregg, a boy who has become friends with Larry. After yet another provocation, Larry challenges Joe to a karate match, from which, although technically inferior, he will emerge victorious. Self-sufficient version (and third in the series) of the boy's adventures inspired by the Karate Kid series. The ingredients of the story are always the same.

title: Il ragazzo dal kimono d'oro 4
actors: Christopher Alan, David Warbeck, Dorian D. Field, Ron Williams
description: Larry, the "boy in the golden kimono", is celebrating the start of the school year in the restaurant of his friend and teacher Masura. Suddenly Bruce Lee Wang a charming and famous karate fighter enters the club: Larry's sister, Julie, is fascinated and begins to hang out with him. Of course this is a move by Wang determined to irritate Larry in order to challenge him. When the first episode came out it was rated as a lackluster Karate Kid parody. Despite this we have reached the fourth episode, a sign that the series has worked anyway.

title: Un ragazzo di Calabria
actors: Santo Polimeno, Diego Abatantuono, Gian Maria Volonté, Thérèse Liotard
description: A fan of the Olympic Games (we are in 1960), in a small town in Calabria, a boy challenges his father's anger by running day and night, passionate about foot races. The "grown-ups" would like him to continue the family's pastoral activities, but the boy will win: his passion makes him win a local competition and so he can go to Rome, in a real team of athletes. Loosely inspired by the biography of the champion Francesco Panetta. Comencini stages the hard battle of the dreams of a little boy from one of the most depressed areas of Italy against the conditioning of the family and the environment: good narrative qualities, a bit of a television cut, the thirteen-year-old protagonist is excellent.

title: Il ragazzo di campagna
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Massimo Serato, Massimo Boldi, Donna Osterbuhr
description: Artemio lives in the town: four houses lost in the countryside where nothing ever happens and the only spectacle is the passage of the train. Artemio wants to leave and takes the plunge when he is offered the prospect of marriage with the distressing Maria Rosa. But in the sprawling metropolis all sorts of things happen to our hero, both as regards the search for a job and in terms of sentimental experiences. The narrative pretext is undoubtedly reminiscent of Pozzetto's ancient cabaret fortunes, but the cinematic result is, once more, poor and sloppy.

title: Un ragazzo e una ragazza
actors: Jerry Calà, Marina Suma, Sandro Ghiani, Monica Scattini, Nino Prester, Francesca Ventura, Serena Grandi
description: At the center of this comedy is the relationship between the Milanese Calogero (Jerry Calà) and the Neapolitan Anna (Marina Suma), who continue to get together, and leave each other. In this frantic coming and going, she gives birth to a couple of children and establishes herself as a model, while he falls into depression.
notes: The title is inspired by the famous "A man and a woman" by Claude Lelouche, but does not stand up to comparison. Marco Risi's second slightly insipid film made before the committed and denouncing ones.

title: Eye Witness
actors: Mark Lester, Lionel Jeffries, Susan George, Peter Vaughan
description: There are two killers, the victim is an important African character on an official visit, the witness is Ziggy, a child with a fertile imagination who lives with his grandfather, a lighthouse keeper, with his sister and a housekeeper. Nobody believes his story or the dangerous situation he finds himself in. To save himself, Ziggy runs away from home and tries, with a friend, to get in touch with the police. The finale takes place around and inside the grandfather's lighthouse where all the protagonists converge. The director knows the job and knows how to create suspense: it's a pity that the game is too transparent.

title: L'enfant sauvage
actors: Jean-Pierre Cargol, Françoise Seigner, François Truffaut
description: In 1798 some French peasants captured an 11-year-old boy in the woods. He grew up in solitude and left to himself. A Parisian doctor who takes care of deaf and dumb children is interested in his animalistic state. Despite the prejudices that surround him, it will be he who will awaken the spark of intelligence in the boy.
notes: The interest that Truffaut's cinema has always shown for children is measured here with a limit-story; a rigorous and delicate film, in which Truffaut himself plays the role of the protagonist doctor. Photograph by Nestor Almendros, music by Vivaldi.

title: Boy on a Dolphin
actors: Sophia Loren, Alan Ladd, Clifton Webb, Laurence Naismith
description: Phaedra (Sophia Loren) is a sponge fisherman in the warm seas of Greece. One day, during a dive, he finds an archaeological find that depicts a boy riding a dolphin. Phaedra then decides to go to Athens to get explanations on the object found. Here he finds Jim Calder, a young American archaeologist who is concerned with arranging the precious relic. But everything does not go smoothly, Parmalee enters the scene, a rich gentleman, who tries, promising to Phaedra lavish rewards, to take possession of the statuette. Eventually Calder manages to stop Parmalee and marries the beautiful fisherwoman.

title: Ragtime
actors: James Cagney, Mary Steenburgen, Pat O'Brien, Howard Rollins, Elizabeth McGovern, Moses Gunn, Jeffrey DeMunn, Norman Mailer, Robert Joy, Jeff Daniels, Brad Dourif, Kenneth McMillan, Mandy Patinkin
description: A billionaire can't rest because his newlywed posed naked for a statue that now stands in Madison Square Garden. To remedy it, he kills the architect of the building and ends up in an asylum. This story is intertwined with that of a black child abandoned in a garden and his father who comes back to life after years, but immediately gets into trouble due to a stupid and fortuitous accident. he would have drawn a more choral story. Forman takes care of the historical reconstruction well, but does not make a masterpiece. However, James Cagney's latest interpretation as the chief of police is memorable.

title: Rain Man
actors: Dustin Hoffman, Tom Cruise, Valeria Golino, Gerald R. Molen, Bonnie Hunt, Jack Murdock, Michael D. Roberts, Ralph Seymour, Lucinda Jenney, Kim Robillard, Beth Grant
description: Charlie, a luxury car dealer but up to his neck in debt, discovers that the paternal inheritance has been assigned to a brother he has never heard of: he is twenty years older than him and lives in a clinic, suffering from autism. Charlie takes him away to become his guardian, actually to spend his money, but Charlie goes with him to Las Vegas and breaks the casino, but is soon kicked out. The relationship between the two that soon turns into solidarity. From this experience Charlie remains profoundly changed. Autism allows Hoffman to show off a great performance, but Cruise also manages to lend credibility to the character. The only drawback is the Italian Valeria Golino on an American trip. The story, although somewhat predictable, hits the right chords. The film earned four Oscars: Best Picture, Direction, Screenplay, and Lead Actor (Hoffman, of course).

title: Rambo III
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Richard Crenna, Marc De Jonge, Spiros Focas
description: Rambo returns to action, after Vietnam, by going to Afghanistan to free an officer who is a prisoner of the Russians occupying the country. He succeeds in his intent and takes sides with the Afghan partisans who cannot bear the domination of Soviet tanks, led by more ferocious invaders than the Nazis.
notes: Stallone repeats for the third time his character of the avenger of few words who lets firearms do the talking. And the barrels are authentically pyrotechnic in a film where international political news is a pure pretext.

title: Ramon il messicano
actors: Robert Hundar, Vilma Lindamar, Jean Louis, José Torres, Luciano Rossi, Omero Gargano, Mario Dardanelli, Giovanna Lenzi, Nino Musco
description: To defend the honor of Esmeralda, his girlfriend, Slim Baxter kills Ruan Morales while he tries to rape the girl after being surprised while she bathes in a river. Slim then suffers the revenge of Morales' relatives. After they have exterminated his entire family, he enters the village disguised as a priest and leaves none of his rivals alive. Unforgettable spaghetti-western that uses the name of a famous score of "For a fistful of dollars".

title: Ran
actors: Tatsuya Nakadai, Akira Terao, Jinpachi Nezu, Daisuke Ryu
description: In sixteenth-century Japan the power of the great feudal lords is immense. Prince Hidetora, feeling old and tired by now, decides to divide his possessions between his sons Taro, Jiro and Saburo. The latter refuses because he is convinced that nothing good can come from this. And his prophecies come true: Jiro kills Taro, marries his father's second wife and begins to persecute him. The old ruler dies, Jiro and Saburo go to war and perish, the once powerful fiefdom is in ruins. Only a blind man survives. Hallucinated reflection on history and violence, where armies of different colors (Oscar for costumes) clash in wonderful battle scenes, where Kurosawa gives the best of himself. The story is inspired by Shakespeare's King Lear.

title: The Rare Breed
actors: James Stewart, Maureen O'Hara, Brian Keith, Juliet Mills
description: Martha (O'Hara), an Irish widow, travels to Texas with her daughter determined to mate a strange Hereford bull to an American cow, convinced that she can produce a more resilient breed of cattle. In the adventures towards the realization of her project, the woman is helped by the rude cowboy Sam Burnett (Stewart).
notes: Far from the usual schemes, but narratively fatuous and slow, it is an almost pathetic twilight western.

title: Rancho Notorius
actors: Marlene Dietrich, Mel Ferrer, Arthur Kennedy, Gloria Henry, William Frawley, Lisa Ferraday, John Raven, Jack Elam, George Reeves, Frank Ferguson, Francis McDonald
description: Vern is in pursuit of the man who raped and killed his fiancée. Upon learning of the criminal and outlaw refuge where he has gone to hide, Vern joins him, helped by a friend. Here reigns a woman, Amber, who falls in love with Vern, who, however, will not give up on revenge. In the final showdown, Amber too will lose her life. Melodramatic and flamboyant, it takes place between baroque sets, to the sound of a song of great emotional intensity; a decidedly unusual western, which in its genre has some affinity with Johnny Guitar alone. Famous are the clashes on the set between Lang and Dietrich.

title: Reflection of Fear
actors: Sally Kellerman, Robert Shaw
description: When a stranger kills her mother and grandmother, the young Marguerite is left alone in the world with her obsessions. Second, an unfortunate film by the great operator William Fraker who then returned to his previous job. It is a thriller that loses a few strokes despite the good starting idea.

title: The Killing
actors: Sterling Hayden, Coleen Gray, Vince Edwards, Elisha Cook jr.
description: John Clay, a leftover but with style, is planning a coup at a racecourse. The gang includes a policeman harassed by creditors, a bartender with a sick wife, an alcoholic bookie and a cashier from the racecourse itself. The robbery, carried out with meticulous precision, succeeds, but in the end at the airport because of a hateful lady and a cursed dog .... Told in this way it seems an almost normal film. In reality, Kubrick artfully messes up the chronology, Lucien Ballard makes all the lights rain from above and the actors (extraordinary Elisha Cook jr.) Do the rest. A parable about defeat, destiny, cold and geometric like no noir. The first of Kubrick's many masterpieces.

title: Cairo
actors: George Sanders, Faten Hamama, Richard Johnson, John Meillon
description: Major Pickering has put together the best specialists from all over the world to create a very ambitious plan: to steal the jewels of the Tutankamen treasure from the Cairo Museum. The plan includes an explosion to sidetrack the police, a quick action inside the museum and a reckless escape by car until customs, where a corrupt official should allow the group to escape. However, someone betrays and everyone is likely to be killed or captured, including the eldest that lingers in a night club. Directed by a horror film specialist, he is one of the many imitations of refresh and asphalt jungle that makes the originals regret.

title: The Taking of Beverly Hills
actors: Ken Wahl, Matt Frewer, Harley Jane Kozak
description: A criminal who has grown enormously in wealth devises a plan to clean up the entire Beverly Hills. After having evacuated the inhabitants with a false chemical alarm, thanks to the complicity of the corrupt policemen who are supposed to protect the neighborhood, the gigantic robbery begins. But someone, sensing the deception, engages the criminals in a bitter battle. Chases, shootings, "technological" duels without fear of hyperbole (and ridicule). The golden citadel of the rich in Los Angeles is a theater like any other in which to unleash the Rambos on duty, with robust contribution of special effects.

title: Klassenverhältnisse
actors: Christian Heinisch, Reinald Schnell, Hanna Schnell
description: Chased away by his parents for having a maid pregnant, Karl Rossman arrives in the United States where he is welcomed by an uncle who has made a fortune in the New World. After a while things go wrong with his uncle too and Karl finds himself playing the elevator boy in a hotel. Here, too, he is fired, but immediately finds a job in the Oklahoma Natural Theater and leaves on a train that skirts Missouri ...
notes: Respectful, but imaginative version of _Amerika_ by Frank Kafka, or rather the misadventures of the young Karl looking for work in the USA and thrown out of every place because he is too scrupulous and always in good faith. A story, and a film, which speaks above all of exile, both physical and mental.

title: Rapsody
actors: Elizabeth Taylor, Vittorio Gassman, John Ericson
description: The daughter of a wealthy American industrialist (Liz Taylor) goes to Zurich to be close to the violinist (Vittorio Gassman) who is studying in Switzerland and with whom she is in love. But love and career don't mix; he goes on a tour and she, out of spite, marries a pianist (John Ericson). Years later, the conflict between life and feelings reappears.
notes: The film, in essence, looks a lot like a nice cartoon in strong colors, but it is full, fortunately, of great music masterfully performed (Claudio Arrau at the piano). With this interpretation, Gassman's Hollywood contract expired: he too "plays the game" and gives it his all.

title: Il ras del quartiere
actors: Diego Abatantuono, Lino Troisi, Isabella Ferrari, Lara Naszinski
description: Domingo, leader of a gang of boys who are half harmless and half guardians of the tranquility of the neighborhood, intervenes in defense of a man who has been harassed by a rival gang and helps him find his daughter who has run away from home. His companions unload him, his rivals give him a hard time, but in the end the fugitive returns to the fold ...
notes: The story frays and the "vis comica" is modest; a first-style Abatantuono, left alone like his character, gets busy as he can, but in the general emptiness his characteristic slang risks becoming an indigestible catchphrase.

title: Rascel Fifì
actors: Renato Rascel, Dario Fo, Franca Rame
description: In the Italian neighborhood of New York, a gang tries to impose closure on two friends who have opened a nightclub. The gang leader studies them all: he sends his friend to do a striptease in the club to provoke police intervention, then kidnaps the son of one of the two managers. Bizarre coupled between Rascel and the Fo / Rame couple in the pre-political phase. But the film remains such a thing.

title: Rascel marine
actors: Renato Rascel, Mario Carotenuto, Ernesto Calindri, Paolo Ferrari
description: During the Second World War, a patrol of marines landed on a small island in the Pacific to face the Japanese. The military purpose takes a back seat when the military arrives at old Taikiki's hut. Taikiki's two daughters attract the attention of men. In a fit of pacifism, Marines and Japanese lay down their arms and try to win the hearts of the two girls.
notes: The story should be funny, but this happens only rarely, despite Rascel and Carotenuto. It all boils down to an obvious comedy with musical brackets.

title: Ratataplan
actors: Maurizio Nichetti, Angela Finocchiaro, Edy Angelillo, Lidia Biondi, Roland Topor
description: A recent engineering graduate, during a competition he draws up the only valid test and is therefore not hired. Other surrealistic and poetic adventures involve the young man when he is busy as a bartender. Then he fails in the show and clumsily woo a couple of young ladies ...
notes: Nichetti's first work, coming from the great Milanese cabaret school and from Bruno Bozzetto's factory. Made with little money and a lot of imagination, it was one of the most interesting beginnings of the seventies. Not all of his subsequent films have had the same freshness.

title: Il ratto delle sabine
actors: Roger Moore, Mylène Demongeot, Scilla Gabel, Folco Lulli
description: The first inhabitants of Rome tried in vain to bond with neighboring peoples. Romulus and his family then decide to resort to a stratagem: they offer a sumptuous banquet to the Sabine king Tito Tazio and then, at the end of the dinner, neutralize the men and kidnap the women, including the king's daughter. War is looming, but the birth of an heir will bring harmony back.
notes: The most comical thing in the film (scripted with the left hand by Edoardo Anton and Carlo Infascelli) is Roger Moore in the part of Romulus, but she is not the only one. The director of photography is Adalberto "Bitto" Albertini, future director of _Emanuelle nera_ numbers 1 and 2.

title: Il ratto delle sabine
actors: Totò, Carlo Campanini, Olga Solbelli, Aldo Silvani, Clelia Matania
description: Professor Trombone, a provincial teacher full of presumption and arrogance, has the secret dream of becoming a playwright. He convinces a small company, frustrated by the chronic absence of an audience at the performances, to stage a comedy he wrote, "The Rape of the Sabine Women". The author should remain unknown, but the word spreads in the village and fellow citizens punish the professor's artistic ambitions by whistling the actors from the very first minute.
notes: Totò's surreal flair is a little out of place compared to the whole film, also known as "Professor Trombone".

title: The Lemon Drop Kid
actors: Bob Hope, Marilyn Maxwell, Lloyd Nolan, Jane Darwell
description: Lemon loaf is one that gives tips on safe horses. One day, however, a gangster loses a large sum due to him and demands that Pasticca make him that money. From a story by Damon Runyon, a film built around Bob Hope who returns courtesy with a funny interpretation.

title: King of the Grizzlies
actors: John Yesno, Chris Wiggins, Hugh Webster, Jack Van Evera
description: A bear cub and a young Indian spend their childhood together. Now the Indian has grown up and the bear cub has become a ferocious grizzly. When the two meet again, the situation can become extremely dangerous for the boy. Usual Disney production film in which, more than the plot or the interpreters, often almost unknown, the natural sceneries are appreciated.

title: The King of Kings
actors: Jeffrey Hunter, Robert Ryan, Siobhan McKenna, Viveca Lindfors, Rip Torn, Rita Gam
description: The film begins with the birth of Jesus, in the context of a particularly troubled situation due to the merciless Roman domination over the territory of Judea. The life of Christ is then narrated according to the usual stages from the massacre of the innocents by Herod, to the work of Jesus as a carpenter, from temptations, to preaching to the crucifixion and resurrection. A religious blockbuster, between a Hollywood show and an imaginative historical reconstruction. Ray accentuates the "political" reading of the story above all in the figures of Barabbas and Judas, seen as rebels to the power of the domination of Rome.

title: The Kings of the Sun
actors: Yul Brynner, George Chakiris, Shirley Ann Field, Richard Basehart
description: Overwhelmed by barbarians armed with bronze swords, the Mayan people retreat to Texas, where they clash with the Indians of North America. The leader of these, Black Hawk, is captured and risks being sacrificed to the gods, but a young Mayan prince saves him.
