notes: Brynner protagonist of a truly curious film, the only one perhaps, before the recent "Rapa Nui", which deals with the Amerindian peoples before the arrival of the Europeans. Among the curiosities: the jump of the stuntman from the burning lookout pole remained for a long time among the records of cinematographic acrobatics.

title: Mighty Joe Young
actors: Terry Moore, Ben Johnson, Robert Armstrong, Frank McHugh
description: When her father dies, young Jane is left alone on her farm in Congo with a domestic gorilla. An impresario proposes to take the animal to a US circus. The gorilla is successful, but suffers from nostalgia. Director and author of the special effects are the same as King Kong, with less impressive results. Enjoyable special effects by Willis O'Brien and his pupil Ray Harryhausen.

title: Master of the Islands
actors: Charlton Heston, Geraldine Chaplin, John Phillip Law, Mako
description: After a long career in command of slave ships, Navy Captain Hoxworth receives some land as a legacy in Honululu. Thus he abandons the life of the sea and tries to become a farmer. The working of the land, however, does not give him great results, but in the subsoil of his property he finds oil. In short, he becomes very rich and can thus buy other land until he becomes the owner of almost the whole island. In his position he favors the passage of Hawaii to the United States. Revolutionary events, corruption, plagues and moral examples superficially season this family romance that does not lack spectacularity. Music by Henry Mancini.

title: Il re di Poggioreale
actors: Ernest Borgnine, Keenan Wynn, David Opatoshu, Yvonne Sanson
description: A bold and generous man, Giuseppe Navarra, during the Second World War, worked hard to help the Neapolitan population, starving and impoverished. His exploits, often fictional, soon became legendary. Driven by a brigand and charitable instinct at the same time, Navarre devises the most original systems for stealing provisions from the allies. Giuseppe Navarra, awarded the title of king of Poggioreale, devises a plan: to steal the treasure of San Gennaro from the Vatican and bring it to Naples.
notes: The American writer John Fante collaborated on the screenplay, inspired by a real character. Borgnine looms large, but the direction is correct and that's it.

title: King Lear
actors: Peter Sellars, Burgess Meredith, Molly Ringwald, Jean-Luc Godard, Woody Allen, Norman Mailer
description: A descendant of Shakespeare attempts to reconstruct his ancestor's masterpieces destroyed by a nuclear catastrophe. Meet an old mafia boss, Don Learo, with his daughter Cordelia and a bizarre guru-professor. Godardian pyrotechnic manipulation of Shakespeare's tragedy, impossible to summarize. Made with the money of Golan and Globus (who knows what they thought), it is one of the less exciting digressions of the great director.

title: The King of Comedy
actors: Robert De Niro, Jerry Lewis, Diahnne Abbott, Tony Randall
description: Rupert Pupkin is a misunderstood comic genius. After long obsessing showman Jerry Langford to get a ride on his TV show, she comes to kidnap him. After all, Langford never used the velvet glove with Pupkin, even though he recognized his talent. Langford will be released only after Pupkin has taken his place in the broadcast obtaining a great success.
notes: One of Scorsese's most acidic and cruel films, it plays on the reach and ferocity that regulate relations in the world of television entertainment. Robert De Niro is an extraordinary Rupert Pupkin and ends up eclipsing even Jerry Lewis' sombre and arrogant Langford. Mutilated by the producers, it was a colossal flop and Scorsese could only resume with "Out of hours", shot at very low cost.

title: Crime of Innocence
actors: Andy Griffith, Diane Ladd, Ralph Waite
description: Based on a true story, the film tells the dramatic events of two young people who, due to an altogether banal crime and the relative sentence of a sadistic judge eager to teach a lesson, end up in prison living a dramatic story. At that point, the parents will try to do justice.

title: Rebecca
actors: Laurence Olivier, Joan Fontaine, George Sanders
description: The rich Maxim De Winter meets a beautiful and naive girl on the Côte d'Azur, and in a little while he marries her. She is delighted, but when she arrives at her husband's mansion she realizes that everyone is still obsessed with his first wife, Rebecca. In particular, the housekeeper feeds the memory of the lady, who one day reappears among the waves of the sea. Dead. De Winter is accused of murder.
notes: Hitchcock's first Hollywood film, a concentration of suspense still with many echoes of old Europe, translated for the screen from a gothic short story by Daphne du Maurier. Best Picture Oscar, the only one won by Hitch.

title: La bande des quatre
actors: Bulle Ogier, Laurence Cote, Ines De Medeiros, Irène Jacob
description: Claude, Anna, Joyce and Lucia live together in a house in the north of Paris and all study drama. One evening Anna is saved from an attack by the intervention of a stranger who from that moment on begins to go around the house. There is a secret hidden in that house and there is a risk that the friendship between the girls will be shattered. The film is long, wordy and full of theatrical pieces (especially Racine) played by the girls, but it is also absolutely fascinating: Rivette, one of the boys of the nouvelle vague, has this great gift. If you accept his pace (which isn't overwhelming), you won't be able to do without him anymore.

title: Reclusa: la rabbia di una madre
actors: Cheryl Ladd, Angela Basset, Diana Muldaur
description: Annie, despite her innocence, is sentenced to fifteen years for complicity with her boyfriend in a drug deal. The eldest of her children one day learns the truth and attempts suicide. Annie then begins a battle for the rights of detained mothers to see their children and, with the help of a social worker, she wins. Then she gets the grace and, finally, she can be free again.
notes: Drama with tired direction and not very credible performers. Protagonist Cheryl Ladd, previously seen alongside Kriss Kristofferson in the depressing and depressing sci-fi "Millennium" (1989) and in the recent television series "Hawaii, special mission".

title: The Rookie
actors: Clint Eastwood, Charlie Sheen, Raul Julia, Sonia Braga
description: In Los Angeles, the ruthless Strom gang, specializing in the recycling of stolen high-powered cars, dominates. Nick Pulovski sets out on his trail, flanked by the young recruit Eugene Ackerman. The latter's inexperience causes an important stakeout to fail: Pulovski is taken hostage and the young man will have to sweat seven shirts to free him. Eastwood, here actor and director, enjoyed varying on the abused theme of the police couple and their vicissitudes. The result is a tough, spectacular and violent film (the chase on the highway), but also amused and disenchanted.

title: Red Flag: The Ultimate Game
actors: Barry Bostwick, Joan Van Ark, Fred McCarren, George Coe
description: Red Flag is the name of a war simulation program that the American aviation uses during its training courses. It is only a simulation, but this does not mean that the pilots end up identifying themselves totally in the situation, behaving as if they were real war actions. Until one day one of them causes the death, true and not simulated, of a companion. The film has the merit of going out five years before Top Gun and the demerit of being much less exciting. The subject is not evil, but Don Taylor (escape from the planet of the monkeys) does not hold the confrontation with Tony Scott, who is also not a genius.

title: Red River
actors: John Wayne, Montgomery Clift, Joanne Dru, Walter Brennan
description: Texas, end of the Civil War. Cattle breeder Thomas Dunson has managed, at the cost of many sacrifices, to raise a huge herd. Helped by his adopted son Garth he decides to lead her beyond the Red River, where he can sell her at an affordable price. But on the way, things get complicated: Dunson is an overly tyrannical boss and Garth is unwilling to shut up. Hawsks dazzling debut in the western, with an epic film focused on the clash (mythical but also psychologically complex) between the old Wayne and the young Clift, with all the nervous sensitivity of post-war actors. The scene of the herd crossing the river is very famous.

title: Red Scorpion
actors: Dolph Lundgren, M. Emmet Walsh, Al White, Carmen Argenziano
description: Nikolaj, a brave Red Army soldier, is commissioned to eliminate the rebel leader of an African nation, but the mission fails. Taken prisoner by the natives, he was able to witness the inhumane persecutions of the Russian army against local populations. The political background of the story is the least vulgar thing about this film. Joseph Zito's direction and Lundgren's performance are even worse.

title: The Frozen Dead
actors: Dana Andrews, Anna Palk, Philip Gilbert, Karel Stepanek
description: Dr. Norberg (Andrews) keeps the hibernating bodies of some Third Reich hierarchs in his laboratory near London. When he is ordered to "thaw" them in view of a future Nazi rescue, a series of terrifying events begins that will end only thanks to the force of the thought of a girl whose head is detached from her body. Shot in England, the film is definitely on the heavy side in terms of gruesome visions, but the clumsy script by Herbert J. Leder, also producer and director, does not know how to put such a heap of horrors to good use. Too bad, because the idea was really bizarre.

title: Reds
actors: Warren Beatty, Diane Keaton, Jack Nicholson, Maureen Stapleton
description: Returning from Mexico in which he had followed with his brilliant reportages, the revolution of Pancho Villa, John Reed falls in love with Louise, and flees with her to New York. When the First World War broke out, the two find themselves in Petersburg, where they become witnesses of the October revolution. Returning home Louise feels neglected by John's political commitment who, returning to Russia, will die there, not before being able to embrace Louise who joined him there. Kolossal produced, directed and starring Warren Beatty, the film manages to merge Doctor Zhivago with Gone with the Wind. Some argue by taking the worst of the two, but in any case the film worked and won three Oscars: directing, best supporting actress (Stapleton), photography (superlative, by Vittorio Storaro). To love or hate, but at times irresistible, as in the love scenes on the notes of the Internazionale.

title: Queen Christina
actors: Greta Garbo, John Gilbert, Ian Keith
description: Induced to a political marriage to favor the alliance with Spain, Queen Christina of Sweden sets out to wander the streets of her country dressed as a man. In an inn he meets the Spanish ambassador - who has gone to ask for her hand on behalf of another - and falls in love with him. When she finally reveals herself, for a brief moment the two hope that the passion may be stronger than the raison d'état ...
notes: The film is entirely built on Greta Garbo, the Swedish from Hollywood, at the time of her heyday. The Divine is painful, ambiguous, passionate and regal, as the representation of the mysterious sovereign requires.

title: La regina dei Tartari
actors: Jacques Sernas, Folco Lulli, Chelo Alonso, Mario Petri
description: With Igor dead, his pupil Tania takes his place as head. Malok, pretender to the throne, does not use force to seize it because he is in love with her. Pseudo-historical paper mache of the lowest quality.

title: La regina delle amazzoni
actors: Rod Taylor, Dorian Gray, Gianna Maria Canale, Ed Fury, Alberto Farnese, Ignazio Leone, Daniela Rocca, Alfredo Varelli
description: The muscular Glaucus, the cunning Pyrrhus and some soldiers are lured by deception to the Amazon Island, who are used to using men to perpetuate the species and then kill them. But the dictatorship of women is short-lived. The strength of one and the cunning of the other pierce the hearts of the two women destined to become queens and save the unfortunate company. The film is dull and badly shot. The actors are also subdued.

title: Land of the Pharaohs
actors: Jack Hawkins, Joan Collins, Alexis Minotis, Dewey Martin
description: Cheops, a powerful Egyptian pharaoh, is having a mighty pyramid built. While receiving the kings of neighboring countries, he falls in love with the beautiful Nellifer (Joan Collins) who becomes his bride. But the woman begins to plot against him and comes to organize his murder. Her thirst for power is thwarted by the priests who, with a stratagem, get rid of her immediately after the sovereign's funeral. Kolossal in costume directed by one of the masters of American cinema. It is not among his best achievements, but it is made with a singular care for the genre, and with an eye to the madness of the story that some have called Brechtian (the comments of the supporting actors). William Faulkner is among the screenwriters, but he limited himself to supervising the dialogues. Production design by Alexandre Trauner.

title: La regina di Saba
actors: Gino Cervi, Leonora Ruffo, Gino Leurini
description: Fearing an attack from the kingdom of Sheba, King Solomon sends his son Roboam to Sheba, in disguise. He saves the life of the king's daughter and immediately falls in love with her. When the king dies, the girl ascends the throne, but with a clause: she must remain a virgin until the god Atar Samani has decided who she will marry for. Quite boring and ragged historian.

title: Queen Kelly
actors: Gloria Swanson, Walter Byron, Seena Owen, Sidney Bracey
description: In an imaginary realm of Central Europe, the queen, maddened by her passion for Prince Wolfram, wanders around the palace rooms naked. But Wolfram has fallen in love with a college girl and kidnaps her, setting fire to the convent that houses her. Expelled from the palace, Patricia takes refuge in Africa as a maid of a brothel, then marries an old man who dies shortly afterwards. The queen dies and Wolfram can return with Patricia.
notes: Made at the turn of the advent of sound, the film, financed by Joseph F. Kennedy (father of the future President) was discontinued. In 1932 a sonorized version of the film was released (for the European and South American market only), which producer Gloria Swanson further massacred by eliminating the entire African part and having Gregg Toland spin the sequences of a new ending. The original version was only restored and put together in a recent age. It remains a work that well exemplifies the delusional talent of its author: a cruel and sadomasochistic love story, a true cursed film.

title: Dimples
actors: Shirley Temple, Frank Morgan, Helen Westley, Robert Kent
description: A declining former actor lives with his granddaughter. They are poor, but the child makes friends with a rich lonely lady who comes to offer her grandfather a large sum to be able to keep her with him. For them the glories of Broadway are now close.
notes: Temple's usual cut-to-size film: songs, good feelings

title: La Région Centrale
description: In an absolutely wild place, in the mountains of Québec, the camera moves on itself, in a continuous 360-degree panorama, with variations on the vertical axis and in the focal distance of the lens, controlled from a distance. An "extreme" film conceived as an eye without a body, which floats in space in a seamless environmental research.

title: Dangerous Liaisons
actors: Glenn Close, John Malkovich, Michelle Pfeiffer, Uma Thurman
description: The link between the Marquise of Merteuil and the Viscount of Valmont is very particular. Wounded by being abandoned, the marquise insists on challenging him on his skills as a conqueror. After happily undermining a fifteen-year-old, Valmont - again on the advice of the Marquise - also seduces Madame de Tourvel, wife of an austere magistrate. But it is precisely the reactions of the noblewoman, seduced and abandoned, that induce the libertine to reflect on her existence ...
notes: After Vadim and before Forman, Frears adapted (based on a script by Christopher Hampton) the masterpiece of Pierre Choderlos de Laclos. All the interpreters are good.

title: Remo e Romolo - Storia di due figli di una Lupa
actors: Enrico Montesano, Pippo Franco, Gabriella Ferri, Maurizio Arena, Bombolo
description: The foundation of Rome revisited in a postribular key: the She-wolf is not the noble quadruped handed down from sculptures and history, but rather a prostitute; the rape of the Sabine women is dictated exclusively by sexual needs advocated in the first person by Remo, who reappeared for the occasion from the afterlife in pontifical guise. In the rest it goes to preserve.
notes: Peti, rudeness and surface pseud-satire. Bagaglino archeology, only for the strong stomachs.

title: Renegade. Un osso troppo duro
actors: Terence Hill, Robert Vaughn, Ross Hill, Norman Bowler
description: Renegade Luke is a quiet globetrotter who wanders around the States. A friend who ended up in jail entrusts him with his son Matt, fourteen; Luke must bring the boy to take possession of a land property in his name. The two become friends, facing a series of obstacles and unexpected events along the journey. In the end it is Matt himself who gets the good Luke out of trouble: the two can thus rest, putting an end to the wandering. Terence Hill aged and without Bud Spencer makes a contemporary western looking for an audience that no longer exists.

title: The Wraith
actors: Charlie Sheen, Nick Cassavetes, Sherilyn Fenn, Griffin O'Neal, Clint Howard
description: Packard Walsh has a garage in an Arizona town, but he enjoys smashing cars in reckless races by trade. Packard also has another craze: he is convinced that Keri is his girlfriend, even if the girl denies it. Then one day a black Turbo Interceptor arrives from the sky (literally materializes among the cacti). It takes a while for the final showdown, but the avenger ultimately wins. It's the film with the world record for daddy children: Nick Cassavetes is John's son, Charlie Sheen is Martin's son, Griffin O'Neal is Ryan's son and Clint Howard is Ron's brother. But in this case the good blood lies, because the film is void.

title: La resa dei conti
actors: Lee Van Cleef, Tomas Milian, Walter Barnes, Nieves Navarro, Luisa Rivelli, Fernando Sancho, Roberto Camardiel, Tom Felleghy, Gérard Herter, Pietro Ceccarelli, Maria Granada
description: After clearing the whole of Texas of thugs, Jonathan Corbett (Van Cleef) is offered a candidacy for the Senate by a big capitalist. First, however, he must capture Cuchillo (Milian), a Mexican bum accused of rape and murder. It will not be an easy task, nor will there be no surprises. Justice will be done, to the detriment of the real culprits.
notes: In the vein of Italian westerns, which at the time was very well received, there were works worthy of attention along with films of very little relevance. This belongs to the first group, for compactness of the story, well served by interpreters in a state of grace.

title: Resurrectio
actors: Lya Franca, Daniele Crespi, Venera Alexandrescu, Olga Capri
description: A child to be saved makes a man on the verge of suicide "rise" from depression. Trivial story, but skilful technique and experimental narration, as René Clair attempted in the same years, for the first Italian sound film (but "The song of love" by Righelli was released in theaters first).

title: Auferstehung
actors: Horst Buchholz, Myriam Bru, Edith Mill, Lea Massari, Til Kiwe, Marisa Merlini, Günther Lüders
description: Prince Dimitri, who acts as a juror in a trial for the murder of a merchant, recognizes Katiusha among the accused that, although innocent, she is sentenced to twelve years of forced labor. As a young man, the noble had seduced her and left her pregnant, pushing her towards the abyss of abjection: the child died, she became a prostitute. Unable to change the fate of the process, to redeem himself he leaves his life of luxuries and follows the deportees to Siberia.
notes: From the famous novel by Tolstoy, the tragic and dramatic love story of two souls on the edge of misery and grace: the sacrifice of their love (perhaps) will save them. Melodramatic.

title: Dragnet
actors: Dan Aykroyd, Tom Hanks, Dabney Coleman, Christopher Plummer
description: Joe Friday (Aykroyd) is a staid L.A. cop who is joined by his boss with the lively and unscrupulous young Pep (Hanks). Investigating Jerry Caesar, a trafficker of pornographic magazines, the two end up having to face Reverend Whirley as well. He is a heated moralist on the surface, but in reality he hopes to extort a million dollars from Caesar and flee abroad after exterminating the city council. Joe and Pep will manage to foil the plan. A pair of cops from an old hit TV series in the US, Dragnet. We are in the same genre as Beverly Hills Cop with a more pronounced propensity for parody and zany. Tom Mankiewicz is the son of the great Joseph, and is here on his debut as a director.

title: Revenge
actors: Kevin Costner, Anthony Quinn, Madeleine Stowe, Tomas Milian, Joaquín Martínez, James Gammon, Jesse Corti, Sally Kirkland, Miguel Ferrer
description: Cochran is a fighter pilot who, following a nervous breakdown, returns to civilian life. He goes to Mexico to visit his friend Tiburon, who has become a powerful mobster who tyrannizes a beautiful wife. Cochran falls in love with the reciprocated woman. But her husband takes revenge in a terrible way: he reduces Cochran to death and punishes the woman by disfiguring her and forcing her to prostitute herself in a brothel. Cochran does not give up and goes on the counterattack. Wanted by Costner, a story drumming in the actions, which does not come to the rhythm of "Top gun". Hot in love scenes, but it seems to end and start over halfway through.

title: Revolution
actors: Al Pacino, Nastassja Kinski, Donald Sutherland, Sid Owen
description: Even the struggle for independence can be experienced as a "dirty war": this is what happens, during the American Revolution, to Tom Dobb, a fisherman who finds himself fighting - like his son Ned - for a cause that is not it's his.
notes: Small individual stories within history with a capital S, in short. Out of place the enthusiastic and fanatic Nastassja Kinski, the field nurse who falls in love with the anti-hero Al Pacino. Filmed mostly in England, Hudson's (which had achieved fame with _Momenti di gloria_) is a confused and unsolved film, a luxurious blockbuster that lacks passion as much as the ability to thrill, and which achieved a resounding failure.

title: Yankee Doodle Dandy
actors: James Cagney, Joan Leslie, Walter Huston, Richard Whorf
description: Born on the stage, George Cohan (Cagney) spends his life there forming an acclaimed quartet with his parents and sister. Having moved from the provinces to Broadway, he achieved immense fame by composing, in 1917, the song "Over There", which became the official anthem of the troops and made him almost a national hero. With demobilization, success does not decline and Cohan sets up ever richer and more elegant shows. Even if in a musical key, we are still and always in the vicinity of the Great American Dream, with obvious propaganda intentions (we are during World War II). Oscar to Cagney, to the soundtrack and to the soundtrack.

title: All the Right Moves
actors: Tom Cruise, Craig T. Nelson, Lea Thompson, Chris Penn
description: In a gray Pennsylvania town, Stef, the son of an immigrant worker, wants to become someone with football. Determined but impetuous, he clashes with Nickerson, a high school coach. Then the boy matures. Bland socio-psychological cross-section. Tom Cruise's first starring role.

title: Belle Starr
actors: Randolph Scott, Dana Andrews, Gene Tierney
description: After the American Secession War, Belle, intrepid young girl from the South, after refusing the tight court of a northern captain, falls in love with Starr, a Confederate who continues the struggle as a bandit, and marries him. But her beloved and her brother are captured by a jealous Union captain, once rejected by the beautiful girl and who has now followed in her husband's footsteps. A little fictionalized life of the most famous outlaw in the West, with a splendid Tierney.

title: Appointment in Honduras
actors: Glenn Ford, Ann Sheridan, Zachary Scott
description: Steve Corbett (Ford) was tasked with bringing money to Prieto; he commands a group of rebels against the dictatorship of General Hidalgo, which dominates Honduras. To succeed, Steve joins a group of bandits who have fled Nicaragua and enters the virgin forest. He will have to endure all kinds of illnesses and ambushes, as well as the rebellion of his men, before arriving at Prieto. However, his help will be decisive for the struggle of the insurgents. Tourneur directs this little adventure film quickly and with great intelligence.

title: Ric e Gian alla conquista del West
actors: Ric e Gian, Craig Hill, Francesco Mulè, Barbara Carrol, Tiberio Murgia
description: During the Civil War, the northern command decides to buy a large number of horses, which are essential for the army. To secure the enormous amount of money needed, it was decided to build two gold wheels and replace them with those of Captain Stuart's caravan in charge of purchasing the horses. Unfortunately, the diligence is led by Ric and Gian.
notes: Cabaret dated (already at the time) with Riccardo Miniggio and Gianfabio Bosco, star of the television variety of the sixties. A film with the two comedians protagonists was a crazy idea from the start. With the West, then ...

title: Overexposed
actors: Marcy Walker, Dan Laurie, Terence Knox
description: Convinced of being betrayed by her husband, she has an affair, but the charming partner, who records every moment of their intimacy on video, is a psychopath. She understands the mistake and ends the relationship. The ex-lover then takes revenge and upsets the woman's life by circulating copies of the tapes documenting her extramarital affair. A passable product of the Fatal Attraction strand. While the cast isn't satisfying, Markowitz doesn't lack a certain sense of rhythm.

title: Ransom
actors: Glenn Ford, Donna Reed, Leslie Nielsen
description: Industrialist David Stannard leads a comfortable life with his wife and little son. One bad day, however, the latter is kidnapped by a gang of criminals who, in exchange for his release, demand a ransom of half a million dollars. The father collects the sum but, fearing that despite the payment the bandits will not release his son, he launches a dramatic appeal to them through a television network. It is a good job, tense and built with a fast pace, avoiding the risk of patheticism also thanks to a very good Glenn Ford. Decades later, a remake was made, "Ransom", starring Mel Gibson.

title: A New Leaf
actors: Walter Matthau, Elaine May, George Rose, Jack Weston
description: Playboy, man of the world and plunderer of other people's fortunes, Henry Graham (Matthau) can well boast that he never worked a day in his life. His latest victim is Henriette (May), an ugly, clumsy, botanist by hobby and billionaire by birth. During the honeymoon, however, Henriette discovers a new species of fern and gives it the name of Graham. Henry's hard heart slowly softens. Elaine May made her debut with this film and immediately disavowed it due to the cuts required by the production. Apart from the productive travails, the film works thanks above all to Walter Matthau's perfidious and imperturbable expression.

title: Ricchi, ricchissimi... praticamente in mutande
actors: Pippo Franco, Lino Banfi, Renato Pozzetto, Edwige Fenech, Janet Agren, Daniele Formica
description: During a trial, three people tell their troubles. Pippo Franco is a poor fellow who lives in a shack on a beach which is assaulted by a group of nudists. The second is Banfi, cheated by a fake German tourist who leaves him ... in his underwear. The third is Pozzetto, an industrialist in crisis, who becomes "the obscure object of desire" of an Arab emir. Joke movie not that funny.

title: Curly Tops
actors: Shirley Temple, John Boles, Rochelle Hudson, Jane Darwell
description: Two sisters, orphaned, are housed in an institute: the eldest collaborates in the running of the house, the youngest is among the young assisted. One of them, during a visit by the Guardianship Council, makes a mess that should be expelled but a rich and young member of the Council takes it at home, along with his older sister.
notes: A colossal hit by the "adorable" Shirley Temple, a charismatic character from 1930s Hollywood.

title: The Tracker
actors: Kris Kristofferson, Scott Wilson, Mark Moses, David Huddleston
description: Noble Adams (Kristofferson) is a retired old bounty killer who gets back into business to track down a religious fanatic (Wilson) who has become an outlaw and has been mass murdering and raping minors. In the research Noble is accompanied by his son, one who has received an education, has been in college and is not very familiar with either his father or the world. Guillermin, more famous in the war genre and in detective stories, is making his television debut here with a western that is a bit too verbose, but not despicable.

title: Call of the Wild
actors: Ricky Schroder, Duncan Fraser, Gordon Tootoosis, Mia Sara
description: Buck, a beautiful German Shepherd, is stolen from his family and sold to Alaska as a sled dog in the mythical days of the gold rush. His fate inevitably crosses over with that of John Thorton, the young heir to a rich timber company who, eager to build a future without the help of his family, is attracted by the charm of the gold rush. Arriving in Alaska, John meets the irascible Charlie, an Indian with whom he befriends.
notes: One of the worst film versions of the London novel. Alan Smithee is the conventional name that is used when a director decides not to sign a film.

title: Ricomincio da tre
actors: Massimo Troisi, Lello Arena, Fiorenza Marchegiani, Lino Troisi
description: Gaetano (Massimo Troisi), a shy and awkward young Neapolitan decides to escape from the inertia of Naples and from his family and goes in search of more lively stimuli elsewhere. He arrives in Florence where he finds support with an aunt, but as soon as he learns that the woman is living with a professor he accepts the hospitality of an Italian-American boy who wants to initiate him to preach the "word" within a Protestant sect. Meanwhile, Gaetano meets a girl ...
notes: Massimo Troisi's debut as a film director who uses his original comedy for an unusual approach. With his typical calm style of storytelling and acting, Troisi knows how to build an atmosphere of subtle malaise and indefinable dissatisfaction.

title: Recordações da casa amarela
actors: João César Monteiro, Manuela de Freitas, Sabina Sacchi
description: Filled with fuss, unemployed and a Benfica fan, João de Deus lives in a seedy pension run by Violeta and her daughter Julieta. One day he tries to rape the girl and is chased away. Having recovered a uniform who knows where, João begins to lead the life of a bum and live for the day. Until the moment when, completely adrift and reduced to a human larva, he ends up in an asylum.
notes: Great story, dry and violent, of a displaced person. Presented in Venice in 1989. Hilarious and desperate, the film that revealed Monteiro's talent. The character of Joao de Deus will return in "The Comedy of God" and "The Marriage of God".

title: Ride bene chi ride ultimo
directors: Gino Bramieri, Walter Chiari, Pino Caruso, Marco Aleandri
actors: Walter Chiari, Pino Caruso, Gino Bramieri, Luciano Salce
description: Seduced and abandoned (directed by Pino Caruso). Three young foreign tourists force a sacristan, devoted to Maria Goretti, to satisfy their cravings. "The Sheik arrives" (directed by Gino Bramieri). A Milanese commander submits to all the wishes of a sheikh in order to get him an advantageous contract. "The check-up visit" (by Marco Aleandri). A worker, a lover of hunting, pretends to be ill at work in order to satisfy his passion. To avoid tax control, his wife asks a representative to take her place. "A priest of necessity" (by Walter Chiari). Mistaken for a real priest, an extra receives confessions from a vicious patrician family in confession.
notes: The only curiosity (but today everyone does it) is that the actors also got behind the camera. Comedy at the lowest terms for a negligible film.

title: Riderà! (Cuore matto)
actors: Little Tony, Marisa Solinas, Ferruccio Amendola, Oreste Lionello, Anita Sanders
description: Tony Martelli has a beautiful voice and so he earns a few bucks singing in nightclubs. He also has a passion for sports cars and occasionally works as a mechanic-driver in a racing team. Sometimes he even makes do as an extra in western movies.
notes: In the sixties the musical genre had a certain fortune at the box office and the producers took advantage of this by placing the "star" of the moment in front of the camera. Before climbing the hit parades, the "Piccolo Antonio" of Rome, who really had a passion for engines, had made small appearances in spaghetti-westerns.

title: Riff-Raff
actors: Robert Carlyle, Emer McCourt, Jimmy Coleman, Ricky Tomlinson
description: Stevie arrives in London from Glasgow after an "interlude" in jail. In London he finds work on a construction site. Find some solidarity, squatter housing to live in and even a half-girlfriend, aspiring singer and drug addict. Then, the day when a companion falls from the scaffolding due to insufficient safety measures, he also finds the courage to set fire to the construction site.
notes: Only Ken Loach is able to tell depressing stories in a light tone, but almost without having the air.

title: Du rififi à Paname
actors: Jean Gabin, Mireille Darc, Nadja Tiller, Gert Fröbe, Georges Raft, Claude Brasseur
description: Elder Paul, known to the underworld by the nickname "Paul le Diams", instead of enjoying in peace the fruit of a life of illicit trafficking paired with Walter, organizes a gold trade. Paul is unaware of the fact that Walter is involved, for sentimental reasons, in arms trafficking in Cuba and that the US underworld is unleashed against him. The police, suspicious of Paul's movements, put Inspector Coppolano at his ribs, who infiltrates the organization.
notes: The soft and overloaded intrigue cancels even the charisma of Jean Gabin who fails to give the best of himself.

title: Reflections in a Golden Eye
actors: Elizabeth Taylor, Marlon Brando, Brian Keith, Julie Harris, Robert Forster
description: Elizabeth Taylor cheats on her husband Marlon Brando and covers him with contempt because he is homosexual. All this happens in a military base in the South of the United States which, under disciplined appearances, hides solitudes and complexes.
notes: Corrosive drama directed by John Huston at its best, with actors in a state of grace. An exasperated and baroque Southern drama, from a novel by Carson McCullers. Shot in technicolor it was rigged (by cinematographers Aldo Tonti and Oswald Morris) into a black and white color film.

title: The Reflecting Skin
actors: Jeremy Cooper, Viggo Mortensen, Lindsay Duncan
description: Seth is a nine-year-old boy who lives with his parents in a small house lost in the immensity of the Canadian plain. Dramatic and tragic events happen around him that the little protagonist understands according to his own sensibility, influenced and restless. His farewell passage to childhood is made up of deeply unsettling emotions. On a superficial level of reading the film may appear to be a simple horror, instead it is a disturbing interpretation of the abandonment of childhood, of an anguished gaze. thrown on the adult world. A first work of robust visionary and unusual hardness.

title: Rigoletto
actors: Tito Gobbi, Mario Filippeschi, Marcella Govoni, Giulio Neri
description: The duke of Mantua, unrepentant longing, seduces the young Gilda, daughter of his court jester, the hunchback Rigoletto, mocked by everyone. Rigoletto rebels furiously, but believing he is killing the dissolute duke, he actually stabs his own daughter.
notes: The version of Carmine Gallone (a specialist in film-opera) is dignified, making use of the orchestra and choir of the Teatro dell 'Opera in Rome and of easy-going actors-singers, such as Tito Gobbi in the title role; in other cases it uses photogenic faces and other people's voices (as for Gilda). All in all, passable.

title: Rimini Rimini
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Laura Antonelli, Jerry Calà, Serena Grandi
description: The most disparate beach types parade on the stage of the Romagna summer, animating the grossest vicissitudes. There is the unscrupulous Jerry Calà, who passes off a prostitute as a wife to the rich man on a yacht. There is the charming divorcee Brigliadori who, despite her availability, is unable to "conclude". There is Laura Antonelli, a sulky butcher surrounded by terrible brothers, and there is Maurizio Micheli who, despite his best efforts, is unable to wrest a smile from her. The latter is the best episode, with Micheli singing "Champagne" and doing the "wheelbarrow".

title: Rimini Rimini. Un anno dopo
actors: Gianfranco D'Angelo, Renzo Montagnani, Maurizio Micheli, Maria Rosaria Omaggio
description: Opera in five episodes. _The bishop's nephew_: the devout Paul knows the joys of sex and throws moralistic qualms to the winds. _The law of retaliation_: story of horns, protagonist of an Apulian provincial. _The Choice_: A mature playboy is grappling with a manly problem. _Do you want 'cumpra'? _: A fake Moroccan peddler makes fun of his miserly tormentor. Last episode without title: a girl, accomplices three young men, wins the understanding of the housekeeper by instilling new desires in her.
notes: Unfortunate attempt to link up with the commercial success of _Rimini Rimini_, but the outcome was much worse, in every sense.

title: La rimpatriata
actors: Walter Chiari, Francisco Rabal, Leticia Roman
description: A group of friends in their 35s find themselves, after having lost sight of each other for some time, for a "good night" of freedom and revelry. They are all married, with dependent families and professionally settled. Gradually, the initial euphoria gives way to the knowledge that a certain time of their existence has irremediably passed and that this was probably their last meeting. The evident intentions of costume criticism are partly thwarted by the structural weakness of the film, which concedes too much to the tones of the play.

title: Ring of Fire II
actors: Don 'The Dragon' Wilson, Maria Ford
description: Johnny (Don "the Dragon" Wilson) is an unlucky guy: he loves Julie, he gets engaged to her, accompanies her to buy the engagement ring and, just at that moment, robbers arrive in the shop. The girl is injured, Johnny sets off in pursuit of the criminals and manages to kill one. The matter seems over and the couple resume a normal life, but someone, in the gang, meditates revenge and meditates tremendously; In fact, Johnny does not end up in the crosshairs of the criminals, but his girlfriend. We see that the first Ring of Fire must have been liked by someone if Richard W. Munchkin found the money and the courage to make another one. In this second part, however, neither the kickboxing fights nor the stubbornly astonished expression of Don Wilson vainly balanced by the "pink" touch of his partner.

title: Ring of Fire - The Only Place for a Real Showdown
actors: Don 'The Dragon' Wilson, Maria Ford, Vince Murdocco, Dale Jacobyt, Michael Delano
description: In Chinatown, two different kickboxing groups face off. The risk is that a real war will emerge from their conflict, capable of involving the entire neighborhood. In one of the two groups is Johhny (Wilson) who fights above all to avenge the honor of his family. Yet another Kickboxing film that, mercifully, does not arrive on cinema screens, but unfortunately arrives on television. Wilson is not even the worst of the heroes of the genre: he has only the face of Lorenzo Lamas when Lorenzo Lamas tries to express something: that is, nothing.

title: Rio Bravo
actors: John Wayne, Dean Martin, Angie Dickinson, Ricky Nelson, Walter Brennan
description: The sheriff arrests a member of the ranching family who dominates the city for murder. It is open warfare. The man with the star has an elderly aide who is joined by the former deputy, Dude, recovered from alcoholism, and the young gunslinger Colorado. Dude thus regains his dignity and the sheriff agrees to have fallen in love with the beautiful Feathers. However, the fight against the other family members and their henchmen is still long and bitter.
notes: An apparently traditional and stylized western, in which however great ideas of cinema find space: one of Hawks' masterpieces. The film dictated Angie "Miss Legs" Dickinson; rock star Ricky Nelson was Colorado.

title: Rio Conchos
actors: Richard Boone, Anthony Franciosa, Stuart Whitman, Jim Brown
description: A former Southern officer is arrested by Captain Haven for a shooting with some Indians. It turns out, however, that the gun is part of a shipment of weapons stolen from the army in a rather mysterious way. Following this lead, Captain Haven discovers that a crazed ex-Southerner officer, believing that the Secession War is not over yet, wants to sell those weapons to the Indians for them to rise up.
notes: It's an unusual western, full of weird situations and weird characters. Perhaps the best work of its director. It's a violent film, but also a sentimental one, full of chases and shootings. The psychologies of the characters are well defined.

title: Rio Lobo
actors: John Wayne, Jorge Rivero, Jennifer O'Neill, Chris Mitchum
description: During the Secession War, the Northern Colonel McNally witnesses helplessly a clever blow by the Southern troops who, commanded by Captain Cordona, steal a load of gold destined for the Northern troops. After the war is over, McNally tracks down Cordona and gets her help in identifying the traitors who allowed that strike. One is dead, the other, still alive, tyrannizes the population of Rio Lobo, allied with the brutal local sheriff.
notes: The last film made by Howard Hawks, it concludes a western triptych that began ten years earlier with "A dollar of honor" and continued in 1966 with "El Dorado". Not his best film, senile and tired, but how can you not be moved?

title: Repossessed
actors: Linda Blair, Leslie Nielsen, Ned Beatty, Anthony Starke
description: Seventeen years after being freed from the devil, Nancy is a normal family mother. Father Mayii, who exorcised her, is now an accomplished lecturer. One evening, the Evil One takes her back while she is in front of the TV, resulting in splashes of vomit and other such pleasures. The young exorcist Father Luke in turn asks for the intervention of Father Mayii. A television channel also gets in the way: the show is guaranteed and Beelzebub is not spared. Then, finally, Father Luke has the winning idea. Sequel to William Friedkin's film, in a farcical key. Linda Blair plays the game, backed up by Leslie Nielsen (famous for the "Blunt Bullet" series).

title: La risaia
actors: Elsa Martinelli, Folco Lulli, Michel Auclair, Rick Battaglia
description: Pietro (Lulli) recognizes among the mondine hired to work in his rice fields, his natural daughter, Elena (Martinelli), born from the relationship with a woman he has abandoned. Elena is in love with Gianni (Battaglia) and is threatened by Mario (Auclair), Pietro's nephew. The father has the opportunity to sacrifice himself for the girl, after having revealed the truth to her. Matarazzo, author of major cinematographic melodramas, proposes the same setting as De Santis's "Riso amaro", but with less successful results. The story does not always convince and the interpretation is at times lacking, but Matarazzo takes his idea of ??melodrama to the extreme technicolor consequences: in fact the "matarazziani" doc have made it a cult.

title: Risate di gioia
actors: Anna Magnani, Totò, Ben Gazzara, Fred Clark, Toni Ucci
description: Tortorella (Anna Magnani), who lives with very small roles in the cinema, wants to spend New Year's Eve with his friend Umberto, an actor of the lowest order and thief (Totò). But he has another project: to collaborate with Lello (Ben Gazzara) in a theft. The woman is thus implicated, albeit innocent.
notes: At the origin of the film is the fusion of two Moravian tales. From the initial comedy tone it gradually passes to a more bitter atmosphere, almost to the unexpressed tragedy. The central trio of actors is extraordinary, with Totò and Magnani singing "Geppina Geppì" and a very young Gazzara. One of Monicelli's most underrated films in its heyday.

title: Bloodfist 4
actors: Don 'The Dragon' Wilson, Cat Sasson
description: A debt collector becomes involved in an international trafficking in atomic detonators. Not only that: his daughter is kidnapped by unscrupulous secret agents, but he himself is suspected by the police for the deaths that the war of spies is causing a continuous jet. In the midst of all this there is naturally also the CIA in action, which has its own interests to look after. Before our hero manages to get out of it, endless adventures follow. In the big entertainment supermarket everything is fair, it seems, but such a story would be better as a subject for a Bugs Bunny cartoon: maybe something better would come out of it. First TV viewing

title: Narrow Margin
actors: Gene Hackman, Anne Archer, James B. Sikking, J.T. Walsh
description: Blind date at a Los Angeles hotel for Carol, a young divorcee who works at a publishing house. He is a lawyer with some problems with the mafia who, the same evening, is killed. Terrified, Carol takes refuge in a cottage in the mountains of Canada, but District Attorney Robert Caufield arrives to bring her back to testify. On their trail, however, there are also the killers of the mafia.
notes: Written and directed by Peter Hyams ("Capricorn One" and "Atmosphere Zero") the film is the remake of Richard Fleischer's "The Hyenas of Chicago". A first part of a race through the mountains of Canada corresponds to a second part inside the train, claustrophobic, but no less exciting.

title: The Grifters
actors: Anjelica Huston, John Cusack, Annette Bening, Henry Jones, Eddie Jones, Pat Hingle, Michael Laskin, Gailard Sartain, Noelle Harling, Stephen Tobolowsky, Jimmy Noonan, Jan Munroe
description: Lilly (Anjelica Huston) is no longer a maiden, but she is still attractive and by trade makes bets for a powerful boss. Roy is his son (John Cusak), a petty crook who lives for the day. Myra (Annette Bening) is young, sexy and she knows what she wants from life. The fate of the three is intertwined and there is no more hope for them. Stephen Frears takes a novel by a cursed writer like Jim Thompson ("Getaway" and more) and makes one of the most poisonous and melancholy films of recent years. Memorable the final sequence with a corpse, a pile of blood stained money and Anjelica Huston who collects them, almost in a trance.

title: Awakenings
actors: Robert De Niro, Robin Williams, John Heard, Julie Kavner, Penelope Ann Miller
description: From the book of Dr. Oliver Sacks, the story of a doctor (Robin Williams) who tests a revolutionary therapy on patients with lethargic encephalitis. It will obtain prodigious results, but of limited duration in time; then his clients will fall back into the darkness of the disease. The film highlights a "case" among the 20 presented in the book, that of Leonard Lowe (Robert De Niro), but it "tames" it a lot. Great interpreters for a story that shamelessly focuses on emotion but which debases reality by drowning everything in a sweetish pathetism. The "love-story" between the doctor and his assistant is an almost laughable sop to the public.

title: Rita, la figlia americana
actors: Totò, Rita Pavone, Fabrizio Capucci, Lina Volonghi, The Rokes
description: Serafino, enriched by an inheritance, fulfills his dream as a lover of classical music by "hiring" an orchestra to conduct. Serafino has a Chilean adopted daughter whom he has never seen and who is now on his way to Italy. Since he hates songs, he wants to make her a concert performer, but trouble starts for him when the girl shows a strong propensity for modern music.
notes: Great poverty of ideas around Rita Pavone's ye-ye in a typical by-product of the time. For the prince of laughter Totò one of the "food" films to forget.

title: Rita la zanzara
actors: Rita Pavone, Giancarlo Giannini, Bice Valori, Turi Ferro
description: Rita is in love with her music teacher who performs secretly every night with a yè-yè complex. The director of the college where Rita is studying wants to punish the girl as the author of the "Zanzara", a satirical magazine against the professors. But the girl manages to avoid the suspension and wins over the professor by interpreting a song he composed in a competition for amateurs.
notes: Wertmüller signs this short film with a pseudonym, shot in a hurry to exploit the television fame of the Pavone and the scandal of a Milanese high school newspaper. But Peacock's songs are beautiful and she is nice.

title: Rita, Sue and Bob Too
actors: Siobhan Finneran, Michelle Holmes, George Costigan
description: Rita and Sue are two energetic, plump and not at all sexy teenagers who live with their families on the outskirts of an English town. While babysitting, they let themselves be seduced by Bob, the father of the family who hired them. Having discovered the affair, his wife leaves him and leaves with the children, but the trio, after a period of readjustment, resumes spinning with love and agreement. Proletarian British comedy that has no fear of vulgarity. Indeed, this becomes synonymous with salvation from the hypocrisy of those who believe they still have a dignity to defend. A mockery with high political content.

title: Return to Peyton Place
actors: Eleanor Parker, Carol Lynley, Jeff Chandler, Mary Astor, Tuesday Weld
description: The publication of a successful novel shocks the town of Peyton. The author, Allison, who was born and raised there, has exposed the variously painful and unmentionable past of its inhabitants, causing lacerations, indignation, revenge. Allison decides to return to help resolve some critical situations. Bringing the murky backstory of the quiet (and suffocating) life of a provincial town to the screen, the film uses an accurate setting but is slow, gray and even a little pleased with the heaviness of the material.

title: Back to the Future
actors: Michael J. Fox, Christopher Lloyd, Lea Thompson, Crispin Glover
description: Marty meets Dr. Brown, a spirited guy who invented a fully functional time machine. As soon as Brown finishes explaining to the boy how to use the vehicle, the Libyan terrorists arrive who he has stolen the plutonium for food and kill him. Pursued in turn Marty activates the mechanism and ends straight in 1955, where he meets his parents when they are still children. A classic, now, a film that gives all the weight of Reaganian nostalgia for the 50s. Ingenious script, lively and energetic direction by Zemeckis, Spielberg production. A cult "futuristic" execution by Johnny B. Goode.

title: Back to the Future Part II
actors: Michael J. Fox, Christopher Lloyd, Lea Thompson, Thomas F. Wilson
description: Emmett "Doc" Brown warns Marty McFly that, for the sake of his future family, he must travel to 2015 to "correct" events. Hill Valley is in fact terrified of Biff, enriched thanks to the possession of a sports yearbook that allows him to know in advance the results of the matches. In an attempt to bring everything back to normal, Marty must return to 1955.
notes: Second, spectacular (even if more tangled) episode of the “Back to the future” saga. Interesting in this film is the interaction with the first: past and future in fact mix and the characters become double of themselves.

title: Back to the Future Part III
actors: Michael J. Fox, Christopher Lloyd, Mary Steenburgen, Thomas F. Wilson
description: 955: While they are trying to recover the time machine, the young Marty McFly discovers the tomb on which the tombstone commemorates the date of Doc's death, which took place on 7 September 1885. To avoid the disastrous event, Marty decides to go back to the 'Nineteenth century, where Doc has settled and lives more or less happy, in love with the beautiful Clara.?Doc, however, has antagonized the outlaw Mad Dog, so Marty decides to pass himself off as a gunslinger and face the bandits ...
notes: Third episode of the saga invented by Zemeckis (with the help of Bob Gale) and sponsored by Spielberg: the idea of ??a fantastic western is funny (especially when McFly says his name is Clint Eastwood) but this segment is a bit tired compared to the rest of the series.

title: Return from the River Kwai
actors: Edward Fox, Denholm Elliott, Chris Penn, Timothy Bottoms
description: The horrors of a Japanese concentration camp in Thailand. Some Japanese officers are genuine beasts, others a little more human. The Americans bomb the bridge, a pilot falls into the jungle, but is saved by indigenous people trained in guerrilla warfare. The pilot tries to attack a Japanese military train carrying British prisoners. Nothing to do with David Lean's famous film. Too bad that excellent actors, like Fox and Elliott, turn out to be wasted. Tatsuya Nakadai was the old protagonist of Kurosawa's "Ran".

title: Return from Witch Mountain
actors: Bette Davis, Christopher Lee, Kim Richards, Ike Eisenman
description: A kid from another planet is being haunted by a pair of villains who want to use his powers for their own shady ends. Disney production, it is the sequel to Incredible Journey into the Unknown and the plot is identical, but here at least there is Bette Davis.

title: Ewoks: The Battle for Endor
actors: Wilford Brimley, Warwick Davis, Aubree Miller
description: A little girl falls with the spaceship in the forest of Endor and finds herself fighting a witch, a cave monster and an evil king. After "The adventure of the Ewoks", a second episode as protagonists for the puppets of the "Return of the Jedi". Television film only for children

title: The Return of the Living Dead
actors: Clu Gulager, James Karen, Don Calfa, Thom Mathews
description: In Louisville, a small town in the American province, some strange bins are kept in a warehouse. They contain what remains of the zombies that twenty years earlier had caused so many victims and which were kept there to be studied. Two guys inadvertently destroy the bins and free the monsters that start taking victims, including a bunch of punks and later the guys themselves. The army drops an atomic bomb in the area to limit the phenomenon, but perhaps it will not be enough. Dan O'Bannon, former writer of Alien, resumes the series created by Romero with particularly violent scenes and a subtle, almost demented parodic vein.

title: Return of the Living Dead Part II
actors: James Karen, Thom Mathews, Michael Kenworth, Marsha Dietlein
description: A metal drum accidentally falls from a truck. Three guys find it and open it. Inhuman screams and a strange mist are released from the container and spread everywhere. That's enough for the town of the three kids to be invaded by zombies that eat human brains. Even the intervention of the army is not enough to stem the infernal tide.
notes: Clearly inferior to the first episode, where the parody vein is excessively accentuated.

title: Return of the Gunfighter
actors: Robert Taylor, Ana Martin, Chad Everett, Mort Mills
description: Ben Wyatt, an elderly outlaw hunter, finds the two Mexican Domingo spouses murdered by bandits and sets out on the hunt for them. She meets the young Slim, who is being haunted by three brothers and helps him get rid of them. When the two reach Anita, the Domingo's daughter, Wyatt discovers that the criminals he is looking for are men of an unsuspecting brother of Slim, while the latter has fallen in love with the girl and is reciprocated. It is difficult to make justice triumph.
notes: A discreet western not without interest, both for the smoothness of the narration and for the underlying reasons that enliven it.

title: The Holcroft Covenant
actors: Michael Caine, Anthony Andrews, Victoria Tennant, Mario Adorf
description: Michael Caine inherits from his father, an SS general, a fortune illegally stolen from the Führer. The inheritance, however, is accompanied by the clause to allocate it, in part, to the numerous victims of Nazism. But the swag is also tempting to a group of nostalgics and some spies. Caine is thus involved in a terrible and bloody intrigue. Traditional spy film from a novel by Robert Ludlum.

title: Return of the Jedi
actors: Harrison Ford, Mark Hamill, Carrie Fisher, Billy Dee Williams
description: Luke Skywalker (Hamill) has long been battling the evil empire with his friends, including adventurer Han Solo (Ford). They are preparing for the final confrontation and Luke learns that the terrible Dart Vader, the greatest enemy of the rioters, is in fact his father. The insurrection is unsuccessful and Luke is captured by the emperor's troops who try to bring the young man to his side. But Luke does not give up, he wants to kill the tyrant and to do so he fights with his father and seriously injures him. Third and final episode of the "Star Wars" trilogy created by George Lucas: meticulously curated special effects and a story that incorporates all the traditional passages of adventure cinema.

title: Arsène Lupin et le Toison d'Or
actors: Robert Lamoureux, Alida Valli, Yves Robert, Roger Dumas
description: Arsenio Lupine tries to steal the treasure of the Order of the Golden Fleece, in competition with a fascinating colleague: after several adventures between France and Italy, he will succeed in the enterprise.
notes: It is the second of two pleasant films about the famous gentleman thief created by Maurice Leblanc, directed and starring Yves Robert.

title: The Black Stallion Returns
actors: Kelly Reno, Vincent Spano, Teri Garr, Allen Goorwitz, Woody Strode
description: We left little Alec Ramsey grappling with victory in an important horse race. We find him now, a few years older, but always very fond of his Black horse. Now he has to go on a world tour in his desperate search: Black was in fact kidnapped by an Arab chieftain. He will find it again after many adventures. Follow-up to "Black stallion", professionally done but rather silly.

title: El retorno de Clint el solitario
actors: George Martin, Marina Malfatti, Klaus Kinski, Fernando Sancho
description: After five years on the run, Clint, on whose head hangs a bounty of five thousand dollars, returns home, greeted with cold detachment by his wife and son Jimmy, who accuse him of having abandoned them. Thanks to little Betty, also his daughter, Clint is hired by his wife as a worker, on condition, however, that he renounces to use weapons. Scattered here and there, a very late spaghetti western.

title: Il ritorno di Don Camillo
actors: Gino Cervi, Fernandel, Leda Gloria, Paolo Stoppa, Saro Urzì
description: Don Camillo, parish priest of Brescello, was sent into exile in a mountain village. That removal should have been convenient for the Communist Mayor Peppone, his archenemy, and instead it is he who brings him back: he needs it to fight together with him against a landowner. Of course, the two do not spare the low blows, but when the Po overflows, they are side by side doing their utmost to help the local people: heart and concrete facts count more than divisions for ideas.
notes: It is the second episode of the series dedicated to the lucky characters created by the pen of the Emilian writer Giovannino Guareschi, less effective and more mellow than the first.

title: Challenge to Lassie
actors: Edmund Gwenn, Donald Crisp, Geraldine Brooks, Reginald Owen
description: Lassie is far away, but her instincts bring her home in time to say goodbye to the master who has died and is about to be buried. Third film dedicated to the dog with the heart of gold; here a true story is told, brought back from the Scottish chronicles of the last century. In return, Liz Taylor is missing in the part of the owner. Only for dog-loving children.

title: Il ritorno di Ringo
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Fernando Sancho, Hally Hammond
description: Two Mexicans have subjugated a small country with terror. Returning from the Civil War, Montgomery Brown discovers that all his possessions have been confiscated from him by criminals and, moreover, his wife, despite having remained faithful to him, has had to promise to become the bride of one of the two. During a fake funeral, however, Brown and his trusts defeat their enemies. An ironic and well-made Western that faithfully traces some passages of the "Odyssey" (the hero's homecoming) transporting it to the Far West.

title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
actors: Hurt Hatfield, Angela Lansbury, George Sanders, Donna Reed
description: Dorian Gray, young and handsome, lives an unruly existence. He loves to contemplate a portrait of him and realizes that, with the passage of time, the expression of the face in the picture becomes harder and then more and more horrible. When he falls in love with the beautiful Gladys and knows he is unworthy of her, in a fit of rage he stabs the painting: he dies, while the portrait returns to its initial features. The esthete Lewin directs a refined illustration of Wilde's novel, with more than an experimental trait. Excellent cast, Oscar for photography by Harry Stradling.

title: Portrait of Jennie
actors: Jennifer Jones, Joseph Cotten, Ethel Barrymore, Lillian Gish
description: A painter, irresistibly attracted to a mysterious girl, discovers that she actually died years ago. One of Hollywod's cursed masterpieces, a story of amour fou loved by the surrealists and the nouvelle vague, with a hypnotic Jennifer Jones and a dizzying use of temporal ellipses. The melodrama veers openly to the fantastic, with romance and a thrill of restlessness.

title: National Lampoon's Class Reunion
actors: Gerrit Graham, Michael Lerner, Misty Rowe, Blackie Dammett
description: The usual crazy students in the usual American college hold the usual crazy meeting, this time "flavored" by the intrusion of a murderous psychopath in search of prey. It is one of the many, and certainly the most insipid, films produced in the wake of John Landis' smash four years earlier with Animal House, which revealed John Belushi's extraordinary talent.

title: Riuscirà l'avvocato Franco Benenato a sconfiggere il suo acerrimo nemico il pretore Ciccio De Ingras?
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Lino Banfi, Gilian Bray, Memmo Carotenuto
description: The magistrate Ciccio De Ingras suffers from a liver pain from colliding with the unorthodox lawyer Franco Benenato. In fact, as the latter disappears, the praetor feels healed. But when he is transferred from the court of Rome to that of Milan, there is a surprise in store for him.
notes: The title of the film is: Will the lawyer Franco Benenato be able to defeat his archenemy, the praetor Ciccio De Ingras ?. It is not among the worst of the comic duo, indeed the series of gags that follow one another in court gives some good times.

title: Geneviève
actors: Dinah Sheridan, John Gregson, Kay Kendall, Kenneth More, Geoffrey Keen, Reginald Beckwith, Arthur Wontner
description: Alan has a classic car named Geneviève which he cares much more than his wife Wendy. During the London-Brighton race, Wendy will be able to take revenge. Great fun with great actors and a catchy soundtrack (by Larry Adler) for harmonica. A jewel of the English comedy.

title: La rivincita di Ivanhoe
actors: Clyde Rogers, Gilda Lousek, Andrea Aureli, Duilio Marzio
description: While the King of England Richard the Lionheart is engaged in the Crusades, his opponents Hastings plot intrigues to seize power. In favor of the king and therefore against them the noble Ivanhoe is fighting. When Rowena, his betrothed, is forced into marriage to one of the Hastings, Ivanhoe storms the castle and frees her. The occasion is opportune because other feudal lords and the people, tired of the Hastings' antics, also rise up.
notes: A poor and boring historical-adventure film.

title: Variety Girl
actors: Mary Hatcher, Olga San Juan
description: A Trovatella becomes a Hollywood star. The plot is a pure pretext to go around the Paramount studios and peek at a large number of famous actors, from Gary Cooper to Bing Crosby and Bob Hope.

title: Revolt at Fort Laramie
actors: John Dehner, Frances Helm, Gregg Palmer
description: The outbreak of the Civil War sows discord among the soldiers of the Fort Laramie garrison, from both warring factions. All the southerners are demobilized by order of Washington, including the commander of the fort. But it will be the former northern comrades to help them in the occasion of an attack by the Sioux. A discreet western, with military virtues a little over the top.

title: The Park Is Mine
actors: Tommy Lee Jones, Helen Shaver, Yaphet Kotto
description: A veteran of the Vietnam War, very linked to one of his former comrades, goes crazy when he receives the news of the suicide of his friend. Before killing himself, the latter had left a letter in which he accused the government of doing nothing for veterans. Impact in front of his anger, Harris kidnaps and holds a passer -by in Central Park hostage. The films that tell us about the "dirty war" are now sufficient. Born on July four for example, he addressed the themes of the inhuman living conditions of hospitals for veterans. All those films that continue to denounce the madness of the war are welcome.

title: The Evil of Frankenstein
actors: Peter Cushing, Peter Woodthorpe, Sandor Eles
description: Taking refuge in the mountains to escape arrest, Frankestein finds his old creation preserved in a glacier. To put it back into operation, the brain resorts to a hypnotist, but is unable to restore full control over the Creature. Although not among the best films on the famous baron, nor among the best directed by Francis, specialist in psychological horror and excellent director of photography (Elephant Man), it can boast the presence of an excellent Cushing.

title: Hadley's Rebellion
actors: Griffin O'Neal, Charles Durning, Adam Baldwin
description: A boy's passion for wrestling turns into a real obsession. Sports film without interest, but with good supporting good ones.

title: Madhouse
actors: John Larroquette, Kirstie Alley, Alison La Placa, John Diehl
description: Mark Bannister and his wife Jessica live happily ever after in their new house in Santa Monica, until they suffer a progressive invasion of relatives and relatives of relatives who not only take away their peace, but also prove to be a calamity for the neighborhood. More than a comedy, the film is a real farce, tangled and of very little substance for which the director is fully responsible, since he also signs the subject and script. In spite of everything that happens, the fun is very scarce, both for the bland rhythm and for the inconsistency of the performers.

title: Roba da ricchi
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Paolo Villaggio, Lino Banfi, Serena Grandi, Francesca Dellera, Laura Antonelli
description: Three episodes against the backdrop of Monte Carlo and the French Riviera. In the first, Princess Topazia falls in love with Don Vittorino, who is returning from Lourdes, recognizing him as the man who rapes her in a dream on full moon nights. In the second episode, the busty Dora deceives her husband and lover with a billionaire scam. In the third, a rich industrialist from Bari, used to having a good time with many women on his business trips, acts as a joker "chaperon" to his wife and to a singer-songwriter whom he believes to be gay and who rejects her.
notes: In the wake of "Rimini rimini", a filmaccio in episodes that is not really funny, with not so sexy bellone.

title: Robin and Marian
actors: Sean Connery, Audrey Hepburn, Robert Shaw, Nicol Williamson, Richard Harris
description: Robin returns from a crusade and discovers that Marian has become a nun in the meantime. The problem is resolved quickly and the two get back together. What is not resolved immediately is the disagreement with the Sheriff of Nottingham. In the final duel Robin is victorious, even if Marian, for the future, has some particular ideas. The Robin myth is back on earth and it doesn't have Douglas Fairbanks' agility, but Sean Connery's wise adult irony. Audrey Hepburn herself, for that matter, is no longer a child. The whole second part of the film is masterful with the final battle, the massacre of the commoners and the duel between Robin and the sheriff. The funny and sad film also saw the debut, in a three-second role, of Victoria Abril, the Spanish actress who received great acclaim with "Légami" and "Stiletto heels". Excellent script by James Goldman who manages to highlight the sense of adventure with a tender love story.

title: The Story of Robin Hood and His Merrie Men
actors: Richard Todd, Joan Rice, Peter Finch, James Hayter, James Robertson Justice
description: Richard the Lionheart has left for the crusade and John Senzaterra has usurped the throne of England with the help of the evil Sheriff of Nottingham. Only Robin Hood and his friends from Sherwood are in favor of Riccardo. A children's version of the well-known story, produced with the usual care by Walt Disney.

title: Robin Hood e i pirati
actors: Lex Barker, Jackie Lane, Rossana Rory, Mario Scaccia, Gino Buzzanca
description: Having escaped a kidnapping and a storm, Robin Hood avenges his father's murder. Outside Sherwood Forest, the unblemished and fearless hero is no longer the same. The title, moreover, only served as a spechio for larks in relation to the fame of the character. A fair amount of boredom.

title: Robin Hood
country: Canada, Germany, Great Britain, United States
actors: Patrick Bergin, Uma Thurman, Jürgen Prochnow, Jeroen Krabbe
description: In England, the orphan of Richard the Lionheart, the Saxon Count Robert Hode (Bergin) collides with the Norman Sir Miles Folcanet (Prochnow). What's worse is that Sir Miles is betrothed to young Marian (Thurman) and even Robert is not insensitive to the girl's charms. Thrown into prison, Robert manages to escape and take refuge in Sherwood Forest where, assuming the name of Robin Hood, he puts together a small army. Paremnte poor of the superproduction played by Kevin Costner. The problem is that he would like to make people laugh (with a comedy that at times is inspired by that of the Bond films) and he can't. The second problem is that Bergin is the office and looks a lot more dumb than Costner. The third that Thurman, generally measured, here exaggerates not a little. Apart from these minor details, and apart from Irvin's anonymous direction, the film lets itself be seen.

title: Robin Hood: Prince Of Thieves
actors: Kevin Costner, Morgan Freeman, Sean Connery, Alan Rickman
description: Robin de Lockley has returned to England after a crusade and realizes that the country is in the hands of the tyranny of John Senzaterra, ill advised by the Sheriff of Nottingham and the sorceress Mortianna. At his side are a group of rebels and the Saracen Azeem, who followed him from the Holy Land. After several fights, Robin Hood (this is the name he assumed) will be able to defeat the sheriff and marry Marian, while Azeem finally neutralizes Mortianna. The new Hollywood revisits a classic of the past with the direction of Kevin Reynolds (that of "Fandango"). The result is a Robin Hood from the third world and guerrilla, in a smashing and cunning film.

title: Swiss Family Robinson
actors: John Mills, Dorothy McGuire, James McArthur, Tommy Kirk
description: Mr. Robinson decides to emigrate and embarks, together with his family, on a freighter. A sudden storm and the sinking of the ship force the Robinsons to find refuge on a desert island in the Pacific with wild animals and dangerous pirates. But nothing will be able to undermine the optimism and organization of the family. It's a good old family adventure movie, made in true Disney style. Ken Annakin is a not inconsiderable English director, specializing in films of the genre. This is where the trade takes place, but the strongest imprint remains that of production. Still enjoyable, despite the years and two hours of duration.

title: Robocop
actors: Peter Weller, Nancy Allen, Dan O'Herlihy, Ronny Cox
description: Junkies, rapists and murderers are rampant in a Detroit next venture. An automaton built to be an invincible guardian of order fails the test. Using the mutilated body of Agent Murphy, killed by the deadliest gang in town, another robot is built. But the machine in addition to having some physiognomic traits of the previous human nature, retains some traces of memory and therefore also the capacity for emotions.
notes: Verhoeven makes his Hollywood debut with a fairly ambitious film. If the skin of the story is that of a technological and spectacular, its core is that of a resurrection. With evident influences from comics, but also from the most advanced science fiction literature (Philip K. Dick), Verhoeven directs a hard, dizzying and, all in all, not very consoling film. Peter Weller will then star in Cronenberg's "Naked Lunch".

title: Robocop 2
actors: Peter Weller, Nancy Allen, Galyn Görg, Gabriel Damon
description: The drug Nuke circulates in Detroit, created to subject the population to the will of powerful gangsters. Robocop, the robot cop with Agent Murphy's brains, takes out all the thugs he finds in his path. But the big crime bosses (among them there is also a twelve year old, Hob, sadistic and precocious), build another mechanical monster. In the final battle between the two androids, the good one wins, but the Great Old Man, supreme leader of all crime, survives.
notes: The director is no longer Paul Verhoeven, replaced by Irvin Kershner, and the charge of brutal ferocity has increased. On the other hand, all the irony has been lost.

title: Robowar
actors: Red Brown, Catherine Hickland, Max Laurel, Elex McBride, Puppo Romano
description: Six elite soldiers are sent to Southeast Asia with a technician to recover a deadly war machine that has gone mad. But the technician also has some psychic problems. Italian action movie made hilarious by homemade cyber pretensions. Vincent Dawn is actually Buno Mattei.

title: Davy Crockett, Indian Scout
actors: George Montgomery, Ellen Drew, Philip Reed
description: A caravan traveling to California under the leadership of Davy Crockett is forced to cross Indian territory. The travelers hope that the Indians do not notice their passage in order to be able to escape. The hero of the film has nothing to do with Davy Crockett's character, but that doesn't stop the film from being enjoyable.

title: Rocco e i suoi fratelli
actors: Alain Delon, Renato Salvatori, Annie Girardot, Roger Hanin, Katina Paxinou, Nino Castelnuovo, Corrado Pani, Claudia Cardinale, Spiros Focas, Rocco Vidolazzi, Max Cartier
description: The Parondi family came from the South to Milan, where they live in poor conditions. Of the four brothers, Rocco seeks fortune in boxing, but his desire is to return to the country. Simone, overwhelmed by the passion for a young prostitute, Nadia, who later prefers Rocco himself, kills her. He will end up in jail despite the attempt by family members (excluding Ciro, another brother) to protect him.
notes: Visconti's favorite film, it reflects the drama of southern emigration; the extraordinary ability to see Milan through the eyes of these "damned of the earth" forced to be uprooted in order to survive. A Greek tragedy in modern dress.

title: Voyage of the Rock Aliens
actors: Pia Zadora, Tom Nolan, Craig Sheffer, Ruth Gordon, Michael Berryman, Alison La Placa, Gregory Bond, Craig Quiter
description: Frankie is the leader of the rock group of the local high school. Dee Dee is in love with him and, moreover, dreams of a career as a singer. Things are unpredictable when a new band appears on the scene, the Aliens, from the origin ... unusual. James Fargo had made a couple of Picarschi films with Clint Eastwood, and here he pulls to live.

title: Rocky
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Talia Shire, Burt Young, Carl Weathers, Burgess Meredith
description: Rocky Balboa is a middle-class boxer who makes a living in the slums of Philadelphia, amidst minor matches and his job as a debt collector for a loan shark. Rocky loves, loved back, the young Adriana and this, at the moment, is the biggest stroke of luck of his life. The second comes when the famous champion Apollo Creed, left without a challenger, decides to give Rocky a chance. It is the first episode of the successful series, winner of three Oscars: film, direction, editing. In fact, it is a very pleasant film, where you shamelessly cheer for a Stallone who is still young and thin, full of will and good feelings. The best part of the film, rather than the almost obvious final fight, is where our hero prepares for combat. It is here, among other things, that the steadycam was used for the first time (to follow Stallone jogging on the stairs).

title: Rocky II
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Talia Shire, Burt Young, Burgess Meredith
description: Rocky retired after a meeting with Apollo Creed that many believed was rigged. But the latter would like to see his title legitimized with a new match ...
notes: The sentimental and sporting epic of the boxer reaches its second episode and Stallone's discreet direction cannot avoid repetition.

title: Rocky III
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Talia Shire, Burgess Meredith, Mr. T
description: Rocky Balboa, after becoming heavyweight champion by beating Apollo Creed, softens, attending show business more than gyms. Thus, he is "played" by a rampant boxer, and the death of the faithful manager ends up destroying him psychologically. To return to the ring with his head held high he will have to learn to suffer again and his coach will be Apollo, who has become his best friend.
notes: After the rehearsal of "Rocky II" (1979) Stallone insists on directing and (unfortunately) in the script, which looks like a carbon copy of the previous film. The song from the soundtrack "Eye of the Tiger" is very famous.

title: Rocky IV
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Dolph Lundgren, Brigitte Nielsen
description: A friend of Rocky Balboa dies in the ring challenging the Soviet super champion Drago on an American tour; our hero agrees to return to the ring and go to Moscow to fight against the latter. The difference between the two challengers is profound and does not concern only the ideological matrix of the two countries. The training of the Russian is so super-technological and planned, so naive and free-range is that of the American. At the end of a terrible match, Rocky will prevail, but his words after the victory will be only of peace.
notes: The structure of the story is elementary, the passions at stake primary, Balboa is a champion all home, ring and good feelings, a messenger of the "pax americana" on Russian soil. Stallone's Reagan period film, makes good Rocky the necessary counterpart to the grim Rambo. The boxer is now a real myth of Western propaganda.
