Stallone's direction aims to dramatically emphasize this clash. But now, in the fourth episode, the soup is overcooked. Emphasis is not enough to replace the rhythm of Avildsen's direction. And today the film above all remembers the line "Io ti spiezzo in due".

title: Rocky V
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Tommy Morrison, Talia Shire, Burt Young, Sage Stallone
description: After abandoning boxing due to injuries sustained in the fight with Drago and left to stone by an accountant who has squandered all his possessions, Rocky is forced to return to the seedy neighborhood he started from. Impressed by the young and ambitious Tommy, he puts his gloves back on to train him. Having achieved success and instigated by the evil Duke, he comes to challenge the master himself.
notes: Directed by John G. Avildsen, director of the first "Rocky" and screenwriter of the entire series, the film emphasizes more than the heroic character of the feats of the boxer that of a challenge with himself.

title: Ro.Go.Pa.G. - Laviamoci il cervello
directors: Roberto Rossellini, Jean-Luc Godard, Pier Paolo Pasolini, Ugo Gregoretti
actors: Rosanna Schiaffino, Jean-Marc Bory, Orson Welles, Ugo Tognazzi, Mario Cipriani, Laura Betti, Alexandra Stewart, Edmonda Aldini, Ettore Garofolo, Maria Pia Schiaffino, Bruce Balaban
description: "Il pollo ruspante" (Gregoretti): a typical petty-bourgeois consumerist and obedient to fashions tries to buy land but dies in an accident. "Illibosità" (Rossellini): a hostess to dissuade a suitor fascinated by her maternal ways shows herself unscrupulous. "The new world" (Godard): the atomic bomb falls on a city and a few radiations radically change the inhabitants. "La ricotta" (Pasolini): an extra dies of ricotta indigestion, after giving up lunch for the benefit of family members. Roberto Rossellini, Pier Paolo Pasolini and Jean-Luc Godard united for the only time are at the height of their fame; the fourth director is Gregoretti, the final g of the title constructed with the initials of the surnames. Experimental and curious are the episodes of Rossellini and Godard, caustic that of Gregoretti, an absolute masterpiece that of Pasolini, which reflects on cinema (that of neorealism, that of Hollywood and his own), Italy, the boom. The episode suffered a conviction for vilpending of the Catholic religion.

title: Rollerball
actors: James Caan, John Houseman, Maud Adams, John Beck
description: In the world of the future, the most popular sport is the very violent rollerball. In reality it is much more than a sport, it is a form of consensus, a way to control the population. Champion for a decade was Jonathan, but the bosses have decided that he must lose by now. He, of course, is not there.
notes: One of the first sci-fi films with socio-political backgrounds to reach the general public. The "rollerball" is invented to harness the aggression of the people, and in this the future looks like ancient Rome (panem et circenses). In hindsight, many considered the film overrated: in fact, a thousand copied it.

title: Rollercoaster
actors: George Segal, Richard Widmark, Timothy Bottoms, Henry Fonda
description: A fatal accident occurred at an American amusement park. Henry Calder, head of plant inspections, discovers it was not a fatality. The special effects aren't bad, but the problem is, there's no suspense.

title: Roma città aperta
actors: Anna Magnani, Aldo Fabrizi, Vito Annichiarico, Maria Michi, Marcello Pagliero, Harry Feist, Nando Bruno
description: During the German occupation of Rome, the Communist engineer Manfredi (Pagliero) who militated in the Resistance made contact with a fellow printer. The Gestapo is on his trail, but the man finds refuge in the home of a priest (Fabrizi) while the worker is arrested and his woman (Magnani) is killed by a barrage of machine guns. The denunciation of Marina (Michi), a cocaine addict starlet who had a relationship with Manfredi in the past and who is now among the German officers, allows them to capture the engineer and the priest. The first, although tortured to death, does not reveal the names of his companions; the priest is shot while receiving the last farewell from some children of his parish. It is the most famous film of Neorealism, made by Rossellini in conditions of incredible poverty of means and of fictional precariousness. Immortal is the sequence of Magnani being mowed down by machine guns while chasing the truck with her man. At the basis of the story is a real person, Don Morosini, whom the Germans shot in Rome for his participation in the partisan struggle.

title: Roma violenta
actors: Maurizio Merli, Richard Conte, Silvano Tranquilli, Ray Lovelock
description: Commissioner Betti, from the Roman Police Headquarters, had a younger brother killed by robbers. Then he is unleashed when a similar episode occurs, with methods such that he is removed from office. Betti then becomes the head of a group of vigilantes who, also, do summary justice. A friend of his, the victim of an attack that renders him invalid, admonishes him to get back on track.
notes: Signing himself as elsewhere with a curious pseudonym, Marino Girolami shoots a sinister and effective detective story, which Maurizio Merli launched.

title: La romana
actors: Gina Lollobrigida, Daniel Gélin, Franco Fabrizi
description: Beautiful but poor, Adriana finds work as a model for a painter. She becomes the lover of a chauffeur who promises to marry her, but then turns out to be already married. She improvises as a prostitute, falls in love with Gino, a good guy who ends up in jail for anti-fascist activities. Released after confessing the names of his companions, Gino kills himself, and Adriana finds herself alone again and expecting a child.
notes: Four screenwriters: the director, Moravia (author of the novel), Flaiano and Bassani. The result is a bit heavy, but the Lollobrigida is in all its glory. In recent years there has been a remake with the Dellera; who has not noticed it, raise your hand.

title: The Romantic Englishwoman
actors: Glenda Jackson, Michael Caine, Helmut Berger, Kate Nelligan
description: The lady is tired of her husband and, on vacation abroad, she meets a gigolo whose traffic is not exactly clean and falls in love with him; she even managed, when she returned home, to get him hired as her husband's secretary. Then the lover gets tired of her and begs her husband to take her back: a tragic surprise solution.With this story of a marital escape, the great director Joseph Losey did not make his best film, but he still managed to assert his class and to insinuate some reason for reflection, especially on the role of the intellectual who loses the boundaries of reality. Glenda Jackson is perfect as a restless wife.

title: Romanzo popolare
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Ornella Muti, Michele Placido, Vincenzo Crocitti
description: Giulio Basletti, a Milanese worker now quite advanced in age, marries his goddaughter, Vincenzina, with whom he has a son. With a thousand sacrifices, Giulio tries to ensure all possible comforts for his family. Having become his friend despite the different political-social alignment, a policeman, Giovanni, begins to frequent Giovanni's house and soon seduces his wife.
notes: One of the best performances of Monicelli, who manages to blend melodrama with social problems (North / South, man / woman). Excellent soundtrack by Enzo Jannacci and the dialogues of the same and Beppe Viola. Even Muti, in a different role than usual, plays with dignity.

title: Missing in Action
actors: Chuck Norris, M. Emmet Walsh, Lenore Kasdorf, James Hong
description: As an American mission to Vietnam seeks the truth about "missing in action", Colonel Braddock gets the confession of a Vietnamese general on a secret prison camp. Forced to hide temporarily in Saigon, Braddock will then be able, with a very daring action, to rescue some prisoners and to mislead the statements of the Vietnamese who denied their existence.
notes: Tailored to Chuck Norris' inexpressive virulence and in the footsteps of "Rambo", the film relies on frantic pace, action sequences. But it's Z-series action.

title: Romeo e Giulietta
actors: Leonard Whiting, Olivia Hussey, Michael York, John McEnery, Milo O'Shea, Pat Heywood, Natasha Parry, Bruce Robinson, Roberto Bisacco
description: In Renaissance Verona, Romeo Montecchi and Giulietta Capuleti fall in love, despite the hatred that divides their families. They marry in secret, but then Romeo is banished from the city for killing a cousin of Juliet in a duel. Furthermore, the Capulets decide to give a husband to their beloved daughter. It will end in tgragedia.
notes: With an almost entirely Anglo-Saxon cast, very young and unknown, Zeffirelli tackles this Shakespearean adaptation with the idea of ??bringing the beat spirit of Swinging London to 16th century Verona. Beautiful photography and beautiful costumes (both awarded with the Oscar), the famous soundtrack by Nino Rota and some suggestive moments.

title: Romero
actors: Raul Julia, Richard Jordan, Lucy Rejna, Eddie Velez, Tony Plana
description: Monsignor Oscar Romero, after being appointed bishop of El Salvador, comes into contact with a ferocious reality, made up of political oppression and continuous physical violence against opponents. After a first moment of prudence, Romero chooses to oppose the dictatorship, at the cost of his life. Hollywood realism: the testimony on the story of the bishop and the barbarism of the Salvadoran dictatorship is conducted through the traditional modules of a story that focuses on tension and strong moments. When the discussion would like to become more thoughtful, the film runs into moments of tiredness, but overall the result is dignified.

title: Rommel ruft Kairo
actors: Adrian Hoven, Elisabeth Müller, Peter Van Eyck, Paul Klinger
description: Captain Almassy of German espionage organizes a network of informants in Cairo to get in touch with Rommel's headquarters by passing valuable information. The British, however, manage to change their plans in time. When Rommel attacks he is thus faced with a number of enemies greater than his strength. Modest film from a cinematic point of view but skilled in some battle scenes.

title: The Desert Fox
actors: James Mason, Cedric Hardwicke, Jessica Tandy
description: Marshal Edwin Rommel commands the German Africakorps and is admired, for his strategic skill, even by the enemy. He was defeated in El Alamein by overwhelming forces and was appointed deputy commander of the troops of the Atlantic Wall. He joins the conspirators who attempted Hitler's life on July 20, 1944, but the dictator survives and Rommel is forced to commit suicide to avoid reprisals against his family. Compelling in its cleverly articulated narrative structure, the film gives credit to the figure of the protagonist (albeit an enemy), both as a soldier and as a man. Excellent interpretation of Mason, sober and intense in the role of Rommel.

title: L'emmerdeur
actors: Lino Ventura, Jacques Brel, Caroline Cellier, Nino Castelnuovo
description: A killer is stationed in a hotel in Montpellier, in front of the court: he must eliminate a dangerous witness, but has the misfortune of finding himself as a neighbor a representative afflicted by marital troubles and with suicidal manias. Brilliant both in the detective genre and in the comedy, Molinaro intertwines them in a paradoxical, funny and excellently interpreted story by Lino Ventura and the singer-actor Jacques Brel. An American version of the film was made in 1982, (Buddy Buddy) by Billy Wilder, with Matthau and Lemmon.

title: Fantasia chez les ploucs
actors: Lino Ventura, Jean Yanne, Mireille Darc, Nanni Loy, Jacques Dufilho
description: During Prohibition, an Italian immigrant in the US has to contend with clandestine distillers (and a woman). Apocryphal sequel to "Rompiballe", made so by Italian distributors. Enjoyable the intertwining of polar comedy and American setting, and of course Lino Ventura

title: Midnight Patrol
actors: Stan Laurel, Oliver Hardy
description: Laurel and Hardy are two agents who arrest the ... chief of police. They go fishing but destroy their boat. Reply at 00.55.

title: Rebecca of the Sunnybrook Farm
actors: Shirley Temple, Randolph Scott, Jack Haley
description: Poor orphan becomes a radio star thanks to a pygmalion and despite her stepfather.
notes: A modern version of a famous novel brought to the screen several times. In the first version the interpreter was Mary Pickford. There is also Gloria Stuart, who will play Kate Winselt as an old woman in "Titanic".

title: So Red the Rose
actors: Margaret Sullavan, Randolph Scott, Walter Connolly, Robert Cumming
description: The misfortunes of a wealthy southern U.S. planter family during the Civil War. The young Valette sees her brother Edward die and, after the defeat of the Confederates, she also loses contact with her cousin Duncan, with whom she is in love. However, the defeat did not destroy everything and the two young men manage to marry and return to their land to try to rebuild, at least in part, the ancient plantation. The idea was good and came four years earlier than Gone with the Wind. The result is pleasant, but economically it was a disaster.

title: Black Rose
actors: Tyrone Power, Orson Welles, Cécile Aubry
description: Two horsemen leave England and set out for China. Along the way they put themselves at the service of an adventurer who wants to take the power of the Great Khan: great battles and adventures await them. One will die, the other will find the love of the beautiful Miriam called "Black Rose".
notes: Great technicolor and great adventures, a sumptuous and good school Hollywood film.

title: The Rose Tattoo
actors: Anna Magnani, Burt Lancaster, Marisa Pavan, Jo Van Fleet
description: Serafina lives with her husband Rosario and daughter Rosa in a small village in Florida, where she emigrated from Italy, and works as a seamstress. Her husband suddenly dies and Serafina mourns for a long time, involving beyond measure even the daughter who would like to get married. However, she discovers that Rosario had been cheating on her for a long time. Bloody and slightly exalted melodrama taken from a text by Tennesse Williams, is especially true for the virtuosic performance of Anna Magnani, who won an Oscar, as well as the photography by James Wong Howe.

title: Rosalie Goes Shopping
actors: Marianne Sägebrecht, Brad Davis, Judge Reinhold, Willy Harlander
description: Of Bavarian origin, Rosalie married an American aviator. The two live with their seven children in Stuttgart in ... Arkansas. He takes care of the spraying of the fields, she of the house. Rosalie has a natural talent for scams: she uses, falsifying them, about thirty credit cards with which she buys every good thing. With a computer she accesses a bank code and soon becomes a spirited entrepreneur. The nice Sägebrecht became famous with Bagdad café not only for her skill, but also for her Teutonic bulk. In this comedy he makes fun of the consumerism of the eighties. Some drop in pace, but the starting point is very nice.

title: La rossa
actors: Giorgio Albertazzi, Ruth Leuwerick, Rossano Brazzi, Gert Fröbe
description: Francisca abandons her lover and husband and goes to Venice where she meets Patrick, a very rich Englishman who had played a double game during the Second World War between the British and the Germans. Today Patrick wants to take revenge on the German officer who reported him to his bosses and uses the girl as bait. The director is German, the actors and settings are Italian, the result is a disaster.

title: Il rossetto
actors: Pierre Brice, Pietro Germi, Laura Vivaldi, Giorgia Moll
description: Twelve-year-old Silvana De Carli (Vivaldi) falls in love, obviously not reciprocated, with thirty-year-old Gino (Brice), engaged to Lorella (Moll). While on the trail of her man, the girl sees him one day leave the house where a murder was committed. Gino confides to Commissioner Fioresi (Germi), who is dealing with the case, the annoying attention he has to undergo from Silvana. It is Damiani's first work, a yellow plot written with the collaboration of Zavattini. A good debut both for the psychological definition of the characters and for the portrait of the environment.

title: Blood Relatives/ Les liens de sang
actors: Donald Sutherland, Stéphane Audran, Aude Landry
description: Returning from an evening, while returning home, two cousins ??are attacked by a man: one is killed, the other, although wounded, manages to notify the police. The investigations are oriented in the world of sexual maniacs, but they do not give any results. At this point, however, Patricia, the survivor, denounces her brother as the perpetrator of the murder: but Inspector Carella, having found Patricia's diary, discovers the disconcerting truth. Chabrol engages in this film with the atmospheres and themes of the American thriller, with rather modest results: everything remains a bit too fashionable, a simple assembly of what has already been seen.

title: Scherben
actors: Werner Krauss, Hermine Strassmann-Wit
description: A railway inspector seduces the daughter of an old toll booth. The mother, out of pain, goes out to pray and freezes to death. Before the inspector leaves, the father strangles him and the daughter goes mad. Chamber drama with a fatally tragic ending. Scenes and lighting, as well as the stylized acting, are of pure expressionist style.

title: Rotaie
actors: Käthe Von Nagy, Maurizio D'Ancora, Daniele Crespi, Aldo Moschino
description: Abandoned by chance the idea of ??suicide, two young people come into possession, just as casually, of a wallet. They return it to the owner and, with the reward money, leave for Sanremo. Between the silent and the sonorous, Camerini seems to remember Expressionism, but he is not afraid to shoot outdoors.

title: Chinesisches Roulette
actors: Margit Carstensen, Alexander Allerson, Anna Karina, Ulli Lommel
description: Fierce truth game for eight people in a country house. Mannerist Fassbinder, beyond good and evil. Dry and theatrical anti-bourgeois theorem, apparently cold and even intellectualistic, but basically desperate and with a lucid and merciless direction.

title: Roxanne
actors: Steve Martin, Rick Rossovich, Daryl Hannah, Shelley Duvall, Michael J. Pollard
description: C. D. Bales, chief firefighter in the town of Nelson, falls in love with the beautiful astronomer Roxanne. Bales is refined and sensitive, but he has a huge nose. Roxanne falls in love with Chris, a fireman under Bales' orders, and to the latter she confesses her feelings. A romantic comedy directed by the Australian Schepisi, it is a modern adaptation of "Cyrano de Bergerac", which stands out for its almost old-time rhythm and for its lack of vulgarity. Obviously almost everything is on Steve Martin's shoulders.

title: Welcome Home Roxy Carmichael
actors: Winona Ryder, Jeff Daniels, Laila Robins, Frances Fisher, Thomas W. Brown
description: In Clyde, Ohio, the celebrations are preparing for Roxy Carmichael, who left 15 years earlier and became a small celebrity. The ex-boyfriend Denton and, trembling, his current wife are waiting for her, but above all Dinky (the splendid Winona Ryder), a girl who badly bears the life of the provinces and the adoptive parents, and thinks she is the natural daughter of Roxy and Denton.
notes: A rare film about the search for a female identity, the screenplay unfortunately disperses in a thousand rivulets.

title: The Roaring Twenties
actors: James Cagney, Humphrey Bogart, Priscilla Lane, Jeffrey Lynn
description: At the end of the First World War, three friends, former demobilized comrades, split up and take different paths. Eddie and George buy a bar and get involved in the illegal alcohol trade (we are in the era of prohibition), while Lloyd begins to work for justice. After prohibition, Eddie goes back to being a taxi driver, while George, who does not intend to cut ties with the underworld, finds himself fighting against his old friend Lloyd who, although reluctantly, certainly cannot make exceptions for him.
notes: Classic "G-man" film, among many shot in America a few years after Prohibition. Today, more than the ambitions of historical synthesis, he allows himself to be seen for the extraordinary skill of Walsh as an action and actor director. Among the writers, the future director Robert Rossen.

title: The Mouse That Roared
actors: Peter Sellers, Jean Seberg, David Kossoff
description: The troops (twenty men) of the Grand Fenwick Operetta Duchy land in the United States to declare war, lose it, and then be subsidized by the winning country. Except that a daredevil, as much as a paradoxical officer, risks leading the down-and-out troops to victory.
notes: Technical rehearsals of "Doctor Strangelove": mind you, Jack Arnold has nothing to do with Kubrick's film, but Sellers is unleashed in three different roles, including the hilarious one of the Grand Duchess. Funny comedy, directed by surprise by a director who only knew himself for dark science fiction and horror films.

title: Runaway
actors: Tom Selleck, Cynthia Rhodes, Gene Simmons, Kirstie Alley
description: Sergeant Ramsay is a widower and lives with his baby. He is the leader of a team whose job it is to neutralize robots when they "go mad". In the course of his work he finds himself having to face a criminal who uses robots, specially diverted, for his crimes. He kidnaps Ramsay's son to blackmail the agent. Directed and scneeggiatura by Chricton, but the tension has some major subsidence. Gene Simmons, former Kiss singer, also appears.

title: S.O.B.
actors: William Holden, Julie Andrews, Richard Mulligan, Marisa Berenson
description: Felix is ​​a successful film producer, but when his latest film turns out to be a fiasco, everyone leaves him. After a few failed suicide attempts, he has an idea to save the film, but the film company executives are plotting to get it. In an attempt to steal the negative, Felix is ​​killed by the vigilantes. Three friends steal his body, replacing it with another to pay him a worthy funeral, while Hollywood gathers to "pity" him hypocritically. Poisonous look by Blake Edwards on the cinema environment and its fauna of careerists and exploiters who frequent Hollywood studios.

title: Scrooged
actors: Bill Murray, Karen Allen, John Forsythe, Robert Mitchum
description: Frank Cross is the cynical owner of a television network. On the occasion of the end-of-year celebrations, he sets up a program based on Dickens' Christmas Tale. During the making, Frank is visited by ghosts from his past of poverty and his near future of death. Distraught, Frank comes to his senses and sends a message of peace and hope from the cameras. Very loosely based on the novel by the English writer, the film well describes the Dickensian Scrooge, played by Frank Cross. Great Murray.

title: Le gendarme en balade
actors: Louis De Funès, Jean Lefebvre, Guy Grosso, Michel Modo
description: Marshal Cruchot and five colleagues discharged from the gendarmerie of Saint Tropez cannot bear the new life of retirees. When one of the group loses his memory, with the excuse of making him return as before, the others decide to wear the uniform again (and illegally). It is inevitable that these attempts are also accompanied by some "environmental" disasters.
notes: De Funès brought the character of Cruchot to the screen for the first time in 1964, since then numerous "episodes" of the gendarmes saga have passed and here, more than ever, the fun is all entrusted to his mask of a hysterical and bungling policeman.

title: Trois milliards sans ascenseur
actors: Michel Bouquet, Marcel Bozzuffi, Dany Carrel, Bernard Fresson
description: Two thieves, together with their friends and two girls, attempt a sensational coup: the theft of the emeralds on the top floor of a skyscraper. But something is wrong.
notes: Discounted short film, with excellent actors and an Italian title that looks at _Sette uomo d'oro_.

title: 7 chili in 7 giorni
actors: Carlo Verdone, Renato Pozzetto, Tiziana Pini, Silvia Annichiarico, Salvatore Porcaro
description: Two young medical graduates are struggling to find a job in public health. They then decide to take advantage of the health-promoting vein that spreads among the people and open a clinic for the obese. The result is so disastrous that the two have to close the business, but fall on their feet: the clinic is transformed into the restaurant "Ai due porconi". Tired gags supported by two comedians not too in the mood.

title: Rocky Mountain
actors: Errol Flynn, Patrice Wymore, Scott Forbes
description: At the beginning of 1865 the American Civil War seems marked for the southerners. General Lee entrusts Captain Lafe Barstow with the task of recruiting new soldiers even among the outlaws. On the way to the Rocky Mountains, however, he will also have to guard against the threatening presence of the Indians.
notes: A routine film that has the only characteristic of being the last western starring Erroll Flynn.

title: Sabato domenica e venerdì
directors: Sergio Martino, Pasquale Festa Campanile, Castellano & Pipolo
actors: Lino Banfi, Michele Placido, Adriano Celentano, Edwige Fenech, Barbara Bouchet
description: In the first episode Lino Banfi is an employee who has to guide a Japanese engineer. To his surprise, however, the engineer is a beautiful woman. In the second, a truck driver pretends to be the husband of a girl: he will end up having to marry her for real. In the third, Adriano Celentano is a ballet impresario committed to not letting his prima ballerina escape. The film is all here, in the thinness of its plots.

title: Along the Great Divide
actors: Kirk Douglas, Walter Brennan, Virginia Mayo, John Agar, Ray Teal
description: A sheriff rescues a man accused of murder from summary justice and manages to bring him to justice after a long and painful journey. Spectacular settings and excellent performers, in a western where Walsh's direction never misses a beat.

title: Sabotage
actors: Oskar Homolka, Sylvia Sidney, John Loder, Desmond Tester
description: A series of attacks shocks London. The person in charge is a certain Verloc, director of a cinema. His wife, who works as a cashier in the same place, begins to have suspicions. And suspicions come true when her little brother dies from a Verloc bomb. At that point the woman kills Verloc, thus risking to be indicted, but her crime goes unpunished due to the explosion of the cinema that erases all traces. Hitchcock, not yet forty, was already "very bad". The deadly procedures to produce the suspece are all there and also some suggestions of German silent cinema. The sequence of the boy who goes around London with the bomb is from the anthology.

title: Sabrina
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Audrey Hepburn, William Holden, Martha Hyer
description: Sabrina, daughter of the driver of a billionaire family, falls in love with the youngest scion, David. He does not notice her until the girl returns, after two years of stay in Paris, completely transformed. David falls in love with her and messes up his marriage. His brother Larry intervenes to save the wedding, but he too falls in love with Sabrina and the two flee to Paris to get married. Romantic fable, but not without Wilder's critical (indeed sarcastic) moods: "No poor woman has ever been called 'democratic' for marrying a rich man". Unusual for Bogart to star in a comedy, while Hepburn is perfect as the tender girl.

title: The Sure Thing
actors: John Cusack, Daphne Zuniga, Viveca Lindfors, Anthony Edwards, Nicolette Sheridan
description: Walter aka Gib (Cusak) is a university student with a reputation as a great suitor. Alison (Zuniga) is instead a romantic girl with a "good head". Walter has to go to California where a wonderful "very helpful" girl is waiting for him. Alison, on the other hand, has to go there to join her boyfriend. The two decide to make the journey together, but along the way they fall in love. Reiner at Harry's dress rehearsal meet Sally starring fifteen years younger, in a film whose structure is still fragile. But the pace is brisk and in the college-comedies genre the film made itself known even then.

title: Un sacco bello
actors: Carlo Verdone, Mario Brega, Renato Scarpa, Veronica Miriel
description: Three episodes. Enzo, a Roman bully, sets out on a trip to Poland with a friend. Purpose: to make a massacre of hearts. Ruggero, who has founded a hippy community, finds his father after years and returns, for a short time, to the family. Leo, dominated by a castrating mother, meets a girl in crisis. When the spark could go off, her boyfriend reappears.
notes: It was the directorial debut of Verdone, previously known above all as a television personality. The screenplay, by Benvenuti, De Bernardi and Verdone himself, gives some characters a certain charge of humanity; the others are pure specks. But the talent of Verdone as an actor is undeniable, and the film returns a certain lost atmosphere of those years.

title: They Were Expendable
actors: John Wayne, Robert Montgomery, Donna Reed
description: Actions by two American officers aboard their torpedo boats just past Pearl Harbor. The original title says they "were expendable," and the whole film is a moving homage to the heroism of the little front-line soldiers. Almost devoid of rhetoric, even "uncomfortable" (we are at the end of the conflict, and the theme is not exactly triumphalistic), with almost documentary moments and others of strong tension.

title: Small Sacrifices
actors: Farrah Fawcett, John Shea, Ryan O'Neal
description: Diana is a woman with severe socialization problems. Mother of three, she decides to kill them after being abandoned by her man just because they didn't like the children. Two of them survived. Fortunately for them, the district attorney takes them under his protection as he searches for evidence to frame the degenerate mother. Farrah Fawcett plays the tormented woman in yet another tedious drama for TV.

title: Safari Express
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Ursula Andress, Jack Palance, Enzo Bottesini
description: A tour operator (Gemma) accidentally meets a beautiful woman (Andress) who has lost her memory. Suddenly the man finds himself involved in a series of attacks, carried out to eliminate the woman. It is a group of speculators who want to drive out a tribe to exploit a uranium deposit. Gemma returns with Tessari, who directed him in the character of Ringo making him famous, for an adventure film with an ecological background. Picaresque and a bit childish.

title: That Forsyte Woman
actors: Errol Flynn, Greer Garson, Walter Pidgeon, Robert Young, Janet Leigh
description: The Forsyte family, which has amassed great wealth over the years, is made up of five brothers with wives and children in tow. The black sheep of the family is the son of one of the brothers who chose to be a painter and who, after the death of his wife, fled to Paris with his housekeeper. But the scandal erupts when the matriarch falls in love with her niece's boyfriend.
notes: From the novel by John Galsworthy, a tear-jerking meatloaf.

title: Wise Blood
actors: Brad Dourif, Ned Beatty, Harry Dean Stanton
description: Hazel, after the four-year draft, decides to give herself crazy, but meets a street preacher, Asa, who convinces him to embrace this life. In this way he ends up in a completely new world for him, where swindlers, "lolitas" and the poor in spirit are moving in search of affection. Finally, he will pay the price, the only one among many who is, in his own way, sincere. From Flannery O'Connor's first novel, Huston drew this bitter, bloodthirsty film in 1979. The dubbing deprives him in part of the original Southern moods. Great Brad Dourif; Asa is Harry Dean Stanton, star of Paris, Texas.

title: Lo sai che i papaveri...
actors: Walter Chiari, Anna Maria Ferrero, Carlo Campanini, Luisa Rossi, Lauro Gazzolo
description: The double life of a young high school teacher: during the day he is a correct and irreproachable teacher, at night he is an unrepentant womanizer. The problem is, he doesn't know he has two personalities. Film built on the song "Papaveri e papere" saved by Walter Chiari and Ferrero.

title: Off Limits
actors: Willem Dafoe, Gregory Hines, Fred Ward, Amanda Pays, Scott Glenn
description: We are in Saigon, during the Vietnam War. The city is an anthill of sordidness where two US Army sergeants are tasked with investigating the murder of seven prostitutes. They are just good guys sent into trouble. Apparently the killer is a US officer. The main suspect commits suicide, but the murders continue. The investigation must start over. Dafoe returns to Vietnam after "Platoon" for this warlike detective film. Discreet reconstruction of places and atmospheres; but nothing new.

title: Saint Tropez Saint Tropez
actors: Alba Parietti, Debora Caprioglio, Jerry Calà, Maurizio Micheli
description: Four episodes on the French Riviera. A shy young man wants to take his busty cousin to bed. The bizarre celebration of a decade of marriage by a couple in search of new stimuli. Love at first sight unites a rather flashy mafia killer with a would-be suicide for love. Finally, a conjugal reconciliation by an intriguing little son. Episode movie in the wake of "Rimini Rimini": even worse than the models (!).

title: Salaam Bombay!
actors: Shafiq Syed, Raghubir Yadan, Aneeta Kanvar
description: After being abandoned by the circus where he worked, little Krishna arrives in Bombay. Here he joins the army of dispossessed like him: flocks of children fighting for survival. In the neighborhood people sleep on the ground, drugs circulate, prostitution is practiced. Krishna helps the weakest as he can, becomes a tea bearer but ends up in prison. He escapes but a dramatic epilogue awaits him. At her directorial debut the young Indian Mira Nair chooses to tell an extreme story poised between documentary drama and narrative pathos. The film is moving, even if the pace is uneven and there is more than a suspicion of mischief.

title: Salt and Pepper
actors: Sammy Davis jr., Peter Lawford, Michael Bates, Ilona Rodgers
description: Charlie and Chris run a nightclub in London's Soho neighborhood. Chris finds in his house a stabbed girl and a notebook with the names of some generals and a professor. The victim worked for the secret services and the two risk their lives to investigate the relationship between her and the characters in the diary. Thus they discover that the professor is the leader of a political conspiracy. Started off in a sparkling way, the film then piles up the events in an episodic way and proves to be a pretext for star performances in the slums of "swinging London".

title: Salomè
actors: Carmelo Bene, Donyale Luna, Lydia Mancinelli, Veruschka, Alfiero Vincenti
description: Herod married her sister-in-law Herodias. During a banquet he cannot take his eyes off his beautiful stepdaughter Salomé. He asks her to dance for him, promising in return what she will want to ask him. Salomé first niche, but then agrees, asking for the head of John the Baptist as a reward. The tetrarch pleases her, but she ends up no better than her victim.
notes: Bene (who plays Herod) provocative and ingenious operation on the text by Oscar Wilde. Salomé is the futuristic model Donyale Luna. Colors, voices and music form a glowing, indescribable and desecrating mixture: undoubtedly irritating for those who do not like strong artistic emotions.

title: Parlor, Bedroom and Bath
actors: Buster Keaton, Charlotte Greenwood, Reginald Denny
description: Jeffrey is engaged to Virginia, but he cannot marry her until her older sister, Angelica, is also married. One day he runs over a certain Reginald Irving (Keaton) with the car and the solution seems at hand: Reginald will marry Angelica, but the girl has decided that she will only marry an ardent Don Juan. With the sound begins Keaton's decline, yet to see him in this 1931 film the brilliant comedian is still in top form.

title: Man on a Tightrope
actors: Fredric March, Cameron Mitchell, Adolphe Menjou, Gloria Grahame
description: The director of a small Czechoslovakian circus opposes the nationalization of his enterprise decided by the communist regime after the seizure of power. The thing he can't stand is, in particular, the obligation to include some numbers of a political nature in the program. The impresario therefore thinks of taking refuge across the border asking for asylum in the German area occupied by the Americans.
notes: It is certainly not the best of Kazan's films, in its forced Cold War anti-communism (Kazan had recently "repented" before the Commission). but it has moments of good rhythm.

title: Innerspace
actors: Dennis Quaid, Martin Short, Meg Ryan, Kevin McCarthy
description: Pilot Tuck Pendelton agrees to undergo a miniaturization experiment to be injected, locked in a capsule, into the body of a rabbit. Instead, he will end up in that of a hypochondriac supermarket clerk. A group of thugs hunt down the latter to get hold of the invention in order to sell it to the highest bidder. In 1966 Viaggio hallucinante proposed a man "inside" another, but here much of the story is seen from the outside. Spielberg produces a film skillfully directed by the whimsical Joe Dante, starring the good Quaid, the no less good Short and (at the time) nice Meg Ryan.

title: Saludos amigos
description: The Disney team flies over Lake Titicaca where she is joined by Donald Duck on a tourist trip. Then it is the turn of the adventures of the airplane Pedro: employed for the first time in postal transport, he has to contend with the terrible Aconcagua, the highest mountain in the Andes. Third episode with Goofy, funny and wacky gaucho, who behaves like a real cowboy and teaches the secrets of the trade. Finally, in Rio, here is the meeting between Donald Duck and the parrot José Carioca for a Brazilian saraband. Disney propaganda medium film to foster relations with South American states. Some visionary moments (at the arrival of José Carioca) and others of ordinary administration (the airplane in the Andes).

title: Julie
actors: Doris Day, Louis Jourdan, Barry Sullivan
description: Julie is a stewardess and would be happy if she weren't haunted by jealous husband Bob. A suspicion arises in the woman: Julie's first husband has died tragically, and the woman is convinced that Henry is the killer. In front of her Bob confesses, but when questioned by the police he denies everything and accuses the woman of being crazy. Julie tries to escape but Bob chases her onto a plane, where he engages in a deadly fight with his wife. Little suspense despite the twists and turns for one of the many thrillers played by Doris Day.

title: The Rescue
actors: Kevin Dillon, Marc Price, Ned Vaughn, Christine Harmos
description: After the end of the Korean conflict, an American submarine with important military secrets is damaged in North Korean waters. The four officers in charge of rescuing the commander and destroying the submarine are captured by Communist troops and the American government, to avoid diplomatic incidents, washes its hands. But there are their daring children and an inevitable victory in sight. In a film like this, you don't go too far, but here we are beyond all limits of decency in terms of rhetorical emphasis, disconcerting naivety and conventionality of the dialogues. Too below the guard level.> I>

title: Save the Tiger
actors: Jack Lemmon, Jack Gilford, Laurie Heineman, Patricia Smith
description: In the seventies, faced with the Babelic and unscrupulous contemporary world, a mature entrepreneur in the textile sector (Lemmon) is torn between regret of the good old time, where individual honesty triumphed, and the desire to participate in the general trend, dealing unscrupulous only of their own personal gain. The ideals will fall when the industrialist, in an economic crisis, will have to adapt to the current "practice" and go even further. Delicious screenplay by Steve Shagan, tailored for the great Jack Lemmon, rightly awarded the Oscar for Best Actor.

title: Salvatore Giuliano
actors: Frank Wolff, Salvo Randone, Federico Zardi, Pietro Cammarata
description: Salvatore Giuliano after World War II forms a separatist army that wants to detach Sicily from the rest of Italy. He keeps the carabinieri in check for a long time, sows terror on the island and becomes the protagonist of many bloody events such as the Portella della Ginestra massacre, when he shoots at the workers' demonstration for the anniversary of May 1st. In 1950 he was killed. Gaspare Pisciotta, Giuliano's ex-lieutenant, who denounced him, is murdered in prison.
notes: A classic of political cinema, and the best Italian film about the mafia: Rosi chooses to fragment the narration back and forth, following not the chronology but the complex interweaving of cause and effect between the events. Giuliano is never seen: he is not the protagonist of the film, but the intertwining of interests between politics and crime after the war. Very tight, with moments of chronicle cinema that becomes epic (the shooting of the massacre).

title: A Son's Promise
actors: Ricky Schroder, David Andrews, Peirce Baehr, Stephen Dorff
description: A boy promises to the dying mother who will take care of his brothers. Ricky Schroeder, after "the champion", insists on tearing roles, but that's not enough.

title: Salvo D'Acquisto
actors: Massimo Ranieri, Lina Polito, Isa Danieli, Enrico Maria Salerno
description: Deputy Brigadier Salvo D'Acquisto offers himself voluntarily and heroically to the German firing squad to prevent a massacre of civilians. A film based on a famous real episode, which exalts courage against Nazi brutality. Written by Giuseppe Berto and directed without too much emphasis by Guerrieri. Ranieri also measured.

title: Savage Sam
actors: Brian Keith, Tommy Kirk, Kevin Corcoran, Dewey Martin
description: During a raid for the purpose of stealing horses, a group of Comanches Indians find themselves near a remote farm where, at that moment, there are only three children, two brothers and a friend of theirs, with a dog, named Sam. . The parents have in fact moved away and will not return before evening. Usual Disney production that replaces the adult protagonists with the trio of minors.

title: Sam Whiskey
actors: Burt Reynolds, Clint Walker, Ossie Davis, William Schallert, Woodrow Parfrey, Angie Dickinson
description: Sam Whiskey is a young cowboy looking for adventure. On his wanderings he meets a widow still in her prime who entrusts him with the task of recovering a fortune in gold bars from a river bed. Sam will then have to deliver the treasure to the state mint. To accomplish the feat, he hires a black farrier and an old inventor. Having recovered the load, between policemen and criminals, they will encounter many difficulties in concluding the mission.
notes: Paradoxical enough, the story, initially well thought out, becomes rather cumbersome in the final part. Perfectly at ease, in the role of the likeable rogue, the priceless Burt Reynolds.

title: Sammy and Rosie Get Laid
actors: Shashi Kapoor, Frances Barber, Ayub Khan Din, Roland Gift, Claire Bloom
description: Sammy, of Indian origin, lives in London with Rosie. Their home, a seaport open to all, is located in a neighborhood where immigrants' discontent often manifests itself. The couple's situation is disastrous. The arrival of Sammy's father, a former politician pursued by some exiles with vengeful intentions, only complicates events, until a conclusion in which drama and hope seem to intertwine. Frears and writer-screenwriter Hanif Kureishi give (after "My beautiful laundrette") another marginal and colorful portrait of thathcherian sombre London. Funny and naughty.

title: Sammy Going South
actors: Fergus McClelland, Edward G. Robinson, Constance Cummings
description: During the Second World War, a bombing strikes Porto Said, in Egypt, and kills the parents of little Sammy. Although he remained without anyone who takes care of him, the boy does not despair and starts in search of his aunt who lives in Durban in South Africa, that is, at the other head of the continent. Sammy knows that he must always go south and knows that along the way he will always trace English soil because then the British empire still ruled half world.
notes: Pleasant adventure film and training novel, directed by the director of the unforgettable "Murder Murder". One of the latest interpretations of Veteran Edward G. Robinson.

title: Return to Paradise
actors: Gary Cooper, Barry Jones, Roberta Haynes, Moira MacDonald
description: Arrived on an island in the Pacific, Mr. Morgan immediately clashes with the Puritan pastor Cobet who governs the community. Things get worse when Morgan begins a relationship with a native. Based on a James A. Michener novel, the film is naturally in technicolor. Cooper goes to great lengths to make the story believable and the result isn't unpleasant.

title: San Giovanni decollato
actors: Totò, Titina De Filippo, Silvana Jachino, Osvaldo Genazzani
description: The cobbler Agostino Miciacio (Totò) has a fanatic devotion to an image of St. John the Baptist which is found on a wall in the street, so much so as to create contrasts between the tenants for the "rites" he organizes. You also quarrel with his wife and daughter in love. Totò's first major achievement in the cinema after his triumphs in variety theater, is a sober adaptation of a comedy by Nino Martoglio, written by Zavattini and Aldo Vergano and directed by an underrated realist artisan. Totò is still forced by the script, but the film is still quite enjoyable today.

title: Sandokan alla riscossa
actors: Ray Danton, Guy Madison
description: The throne of Sandokan's father is usurped and the regent brutally murdered. Together with the faithful Yanez, the Tiger of Mompracem is looking for revenge ...
notes: Far inferior to the already modest (but cult) TV drama of Sollima with Kabir Bedi. Not satisfied, the producers will churn out a worthy sequel very soon.

title: Sandokan contro il leopardo di Sarawak
actors: Ray Danton, Guy Madison, Franca Bettoja
description: Sandokan's wife is kidnapped and hypnotized. The recovery in the Sandokan finale is obvious. Like the film, which is also the sequel to "Sandokan to the rescue".

title: Blood on the Moon
actors: Robert Mitchum, Robert Preston, Barbara Bel Geddes, Walter Brennan
description: To force John Lufton to sell him the cattle for little money, Tate Rilling hires the gunslinger Jim Garry, but he, realizing that the matter is shady, fights for Lufton. Wise constructs an original western about the ranchers-farmers conflict with many erotic and ambiguous solicitations, from noir (Mitchum, photography by Micholas Musuraca).

title: Deadly Is the Female
actors: Peggy Cummins, John Dall, Berry Kroeger
description: As soon as he comes out of a reform school, where he had been locked up for theft of weapons, a boy joins a circus where he performs as a shooter. He falls in love with a girl and marries her, but she proves to be greedy and bloodthirsty. Together they start carrying out robberies and kill two people. The police are on their trail. The two may escape, but the woman tries to eliminate two of the boy's childhood friends.
notes: American noir masterpiece directed by an American Serie B specialist. The neuroses and the violence of the characters inspired many films in the 1960s and 1970s. Screenplay by Dalton Trumbo.

title: Sansone contro il Corsaro Nero
actors: Alan Steel, Andrea Aureli, Rosalba Neri, Piero Lulli, Elisa Mainardi
description: The tireless Samson must defend his ruler from pirate raids and hold off a treacherous advisor who plots against his love for the beautiful little princess. Delirious peplum with corsairs, only for vintage trash lovers.

title: Samson and Delilah
actors: Victor Mature, Hedy Lamarr, Angela Lansbury, George Sanders
description: During the wedding between Samson and Sadanar a riot breaks out and the girl dies. Tradition has it that Samson marries his sister Delilah, but he refuses and she threatens retaliation. Having become the favorite of the leader of the Philistines, Delilah manages to imprison Samson who is also blinded. He then repents and agrees to lead him to the columns of the temple where Samson takes his revenge. Solito De Mille: a cheerful historical reconstruction, a little bare skin (audacity of the times!) And thousands of extras. The result was a huge success despite the paucity of the two protagonists, outclassed by George Sanders in a minor role. Oscar for costumes and scenography.

title: Sant'Elena piccola isola
actors: Ruggero Ruggeri, Mercedes Brignone, Carla Candiani
description: The film recounts the last years of Napoleon's imprisonment on the island of Sant'Alena. Academic film ennobled by the excellent interpretation of Ruggeri, one of the sacred monsters of Italian theater. Photo by Mario Bava.

title: Santiago
actors: Alan Ladd, Rossana Podestà, Lloyd Nolan
description: An adventurer hired for an arms transport to Cuba in 1898 confronts bandits, Spanish artillery and an old enemy. Eventually, with a beautiful rebel, he embraces the cause of the Caribbean revolutionaries.
notes: Naive story, but at a good pace and with some emotion.

title: The Amazing Dr. Clitterhouse
actors: Edward G. Robinson, Humphrey Bogart
description: A criminologist turns into a criminal to complete his studies. Captured and tried, he is acquitted because he is mad. Litvak's beautiful direction on a screenplay by John Huston, a disturbing noir with Bogart playing an ambiguous villain.

title: Tam-Lin
actors: Ava Gardner, Ian McShane, Richard Wattis, Cyril Cusack
description: Mikie (Gardner) has had a lot of men in her life, many of whom died in strange accidents. Milkie, however, is getting old and does not resign herself to the idea. Her latest lover, Tom, makes the mistake of falling in love with Susan, a younger girl. Forced to choose between the two women, Tom abandons Mikie, but she does not abandon him. The revenge of the no longer young lady will be terrible, even if in the end, thanks to the help of Susan, Tom manages to save himself. First film as director for actor Roddy McDowall and 50th, approximately, by Ava Gardner. Almost any film with Gardner is worth watching. Not this.

title: Sapore di mare
actors: Jerry Calà, Marina Suma, Christian De Sica, Isabella Ferrari, Karina Huff, Virna Lisi
description: During the summer of 1964 events involving a group of young vacationers intertwine on the beaches of Versilia. The protagonists are Paolo and Marina, two Neapolitan brothers, and Luca and Felicino, rich and spoiled Milanese. Between tales of amazing love adventures and gossip of all kinds, there are also (few) true feelings. Marina falls in love with Luca while Paolo gets mad at the beautiful Susan, a foreigner who, however, prefers the vacuous Felicino. Other vacationers who are no longer very young are also looking for adventures and the most frantic are some unattractive "mature" ones. Then the summer ends. The boys, now grown up and integrated into society, find themselves casually twenty years later in the same place: it is an opportunity to come to terms with what is left of the now distant promises; only one has been kept, for all other things only the bitter memory remains.
notes: Re-enactment of the "fabulous sixties", this film opens the holiday trend of the eighties. Intriguing the soundtrack entirely reworked on the great hits of the time, suitable for the rampant and hedonistic climate of the past decade. It is the best film by the Vanzina, the only one of the brothers' directors that has aimed at something more than just box office.

title: Sapore di mare 2. Un anno dopo
actors: Eleonora Giorgi, Mauro Di Francesco, Isabella Ferrari, Gianni Ansaldi, Massimo Ciavarro
description: We are still on the "mythical" sands of Versilia. We are still struggling with the "fabulous" Sixties and, of course, we are still faced with the inexhaustible renewal of the summer plot: amoretti and amorazzi, gossip and lies, some sincere sympathy, and a lot of "desire to have fun".
notes: Incredible, but true, this sequel also closes on the protagonists who find themselves, after twenty years, sadly pondering how life has forced them to judge. Heavier and more patchy than the first episode.

title: The Incredible Sarah
actors: Glenda Jackson, Daniel Massey, Yvonne Mitchell
description: In 1863 Sarah Bernhardt obtained the first small roles of a career that will then bring it to the top of the celebrities, adored by the public and critics. But they will not only be roses and flowers: there will be difficult moments, both in professional and emotional life.
notes: It took an actress of great temperament to face a "colossal" figure like that of Bernhardt and Jackson proves up to par. But the film Hatutti The defects of Biographic cinema embalmed.

title: Fame
actors: Irene Cara, Lee Curreri, Eddie Barth, Laura Dean, Paul McCrane, Gene Anthony Ray, Antonia Franceschi, Barry Miller, Maureen Teefy
description: In New York, some students of the High School of Performing Art are followed during a year of intense study: auditions and lessons (school and life) are intertwined with the loves, disappointments and hopes of those who dream of a front row seat in the entertainment world. The film, a sort of musical comedy, follows an almost documentary trend in the first part, to become more spectacular in the second. The story is largely taken for granted, however, the film follows the various protagonists well, in their personal and scholastic affairs. Some excellent choreographies (by Louis Falco) and some songs ("Fame" won the Oscar, as well as the soundtrack by Michael Gore). The film kicked off the homonymous television series.

title: Saratoga Trunk
actors: Gary Cooper, Ingrid Bergman, Flora Robson
description: Intriguing Bella lands in New Orleans to hook a wealthy husband. Clint, a cowboy with whom he is born tender, informs her that there are more millionaires in Saratoga: she goes there, but true feelings triumph over venal projects. A half western with the extraordinary Cooper-Bergman tandem, still directed by Sam Wood after the success in For Whom the Bell Tolls. But this film is much heavier. From a novel by Edna Ferber.

title: Saremo felici
actors: Franco Carpellino, Maurizio Ferrini, Jo Champa, Amanda Sandrelli, Alessandra Martines
description: A bar of a provincial town with four thirty -year -olds divided between impossible hopes, frustrations and foreign to seduce. Lorenz would like to become a songwriter, Caronte drinks his brain with the videotapes, Checcone (because of the girlfriend) he dreams of going to the United States and Mirko betrays his girlfriend with the tourists. In short, it is a calf set in Cesenatico, made with the feet and recited even worse. Ferrini is much more good to dressed as a woman. Amanda Sandrelli has also been more convincing elsewhere. Martines instead always reads like this.

title: Satiricosissimo
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Edwige Fenech
description: Franco and Ciccio took part, as waiters, in a costume party for ancient Romans. Suddenly the two really find themselves in ancient Rome. For a series of coincidences they manage to foil a plot by Britannicus, aimed at killing Nero: they are thus hired by the secret service and placed directly under Tigellinus, but, in their gullibility, they end up in the circus fighting against the gladiators.
notes: It is one of the classic farces of the Sicilian duo. It is inspired by Fellini's "Satyricon", with grimaces and references to current events. Some gags are undoubtedly funny, and Laurenti's direction is less sloppy than elsewhere.

title: Saxofone
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Cochi Ponzoni, Mariangela Melato, Teo Teocoli
description: A lady of the Milanese bourgeoisie falls in love with a vagabond, a sax player, who dispenses pills of wisdom, but who shows himself insensitive to his charm. This goes on until the woman understands that there is no need to insist. Ironic apologue due to the pen of Jannacci, Pozzetto, Ponzoni and Beppe Viola. Less successful than in intentions, but with a surreal and not vulgar streak. It is the first film directed by Pozzetto.

title: È sbarcato un marinaio
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, Doris Duranti, Germana Paolieri
description: Gianni (Nazzari) is a sailor who, for the love of a girl, gives up boarding. Between the two, however, things do not go smoothly: he gets into trouble, she has to deal with a little good.
notes: Discreet comedy that mixes feeling and action. Small role for Polidor, one of the comic actors who made the history of silent cinema.

title: Sbatti il mostro in prima pagina
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, Fabio Garriba, Carla Tatò, Laura Betti
description: Seventies. In a field on the outskirts of Milan, the mangled corpse of Maria Grazia, the fifteen-year-old daughter of a well-known professor, is found. The editor-in-chief of a well-known Milanese newspaper gives Roveda the task of following the case, a novice journalist, flanked by the seasoned Lauri. Then he starts investigating on his own. Thus approaches Professor Zigai, lover of an exponent of the extra-parliamentary left, in possession of the diary of Maria Grazia.
notes: Attempt at a political "genre film" (the model was Lang) on ??a filthy character of a journalist. Initially written by Bellocchio and Goffredo Fofi, and then by Sergio Donati. The direction of Bellocchio fits well, extraordinary Gian Maria Volontè in the role of director.

title: Dead Heat
actors: Treat Williams, Joe Piscopo, Vincent Price, Lindsay Frost
description: In the hell of the metropolis, here are two agents capable of risking the unspeakable to carry out their duty. We will see them grappling with robbers capable of resurrecting from the underworld and with cars that are hardly called demonic. If this were not enough, the two will also find themselves in the process (again for their commendable sense of duty) of being transformed into zombies. Detective in horror sauce that focuses on special effects (discreet), but is not saved from the banality of situations and dialogues. Detail for the great Price.

title: The Salzburg Connection
actors: Barry Newman, Anna Karina, Karen Jensen
description: The great powers want the lists of the Führer's spies during the war, found by a photographer who managed to hide them before being liquidated by the neo-Nazis. An unsuspected lawyer hired by the CIA has to compete with a shrewd Soviet agent.
notes: Spying and without ideas, with the former Mrs. Godard.

title: The Spiral Staircase
actors: Dorothy McGuire, George Brent, Ethel Barrymore, Kent Smith
description: Some women were killed in the city: all of them had a physical defect. In the sights of the killer a mute girl, serving in the house of a professor who lives with her stepmother and younger brother. During a night of tragedy, the killer returns to strike, this time risking to betray himself.
notes: Between the Gothic and the typical atmospheres of Expressionism, a masterpiece of cinema noir full of suspense, psychological subtleties and disturbing symbolism. Based on the novel _Some Must Watch_ by Ethel Lina White, the film has a great visual impact thanks to the extraordinary work of Nicholas Musuraca, one of the most respected cinematographers ever. Even today, a little suspenseful gem.

title: A Matter of Life and Death
actors: David Niven, Kim Hunter, Marius Goring, Roger Livesey
description: RAF pilot is shot down and barely saves himself. Delirious, he dreams that an angel will take him to heaven, where great characters of history plead his cause. Imaginary masterpiece of extraordinary technical skill directed by the brilliant couple Powell-Pressburger. Reality is in color, the afterlife in black and white. A simple propaganda film for US-UK relations becomes one of the craziest and most fantastic love stories in the history of cinema. Spielberg looted it in "Always" (remake of "Joe the Pilot") and made copies in circulation disappear for years.

title: Scandali al mare
actors: Carlo Dapporto, Raimondo Vianello, Gino Bramieri, Mario Carotenuto, Bice Valori, Gloria Milland, Valeria Fabrizi
description: Under the eyes of Riccardo, staid hotel concierge who tries in vain to preserve his professional imperturbability to the last, assorted characters parade that combine and mess up in a tangle of intertwined, consolidated or broken relationships. Each of the characters has their own story, their own problems and some more or less sensational and more or less confessable secret.
notes: Comedy of the highly exploited balnear-holiday trend which, in reality, limits itself to putting together well-known jokes and gags. The interpreters are listless and are saved only by the profession.

title: The Philadelphia Story
actors: Katharine Hepburn, Cary Grant, James Stewart, John Howard
description: Thirties. In the rich and sophisticated world of Philadelphia, heiress Tracy is about to marry a politician for the second time. Just on the eve of the wedding, however, an enterprising journalist insinuates himself into Tracy's life and refines the harshness of her character.
notes: From a play by Philip Barry, a dreamy masterpiece by the great Cukor. A sort of disguised romance, almost "A midsummer note's dream" in a refined game of misunderstandings, betrayals, subtle conflicts of class and style. Stewart won the Oscar. Grant offered his cachet to the war cause, Hepburn gave a memorable interpretation. Oscar also for the screenplay.

title: A Summer Place
actors: Dorothy McGuire, Richard Egan, Sandra Dee, Troy Donahue, Arthur Kennedy
description: Bart Hunter lives with his wife Sylvia and son Johnny on Pine Island, managing a hotel where one day billionaire Ken Jorgenson arrives to spend his holidays. He is with his wife and daughter Molly. While a love story is immediately born between Johnny and Molly, Ken and Sylvia find themselves after 20 years re-establishing a romantic relationship that life seemed to have interrupted. Swollen and baroque melodrama, it was a success among the young people of the time. Daves gets it on with his lavish style, Donahue and the Dee aren't great but it doesn't matter. A stunning soundtrack by Max Steiner.

title: Blaze
actors: Paul Newman, Lolita Davidovich, Jerry Hardin, Gailard Sartain
description: New Orleans, 1959. Governor Earl Long, 65, is an unscrupulous demagogue, an admirer of beautiful women, but also an advocate of an anti-segregationist policy that makes him enemies. These, taking advantage of his scandalous relationship with the stripper Blaze, send him to an asylum. He comes out more combative than ever, thanks also to the support of Blaze, but he can't stand up to the new battles. The period reconstruction is meticulous, Paul Newman admirable in the role of the contradictory protagonist (who really existed: the story is narrated in a book written by Blaze Starr, who inspired the film), but the whole is cold and unconvincing.

title: Scandalo segreto
actors: Monica Vitti, Elliott Gould, Catherine Spaak, Gino Pernice, Pietro De Vico
description: Having received a camera as a gift, Margherita, who is often alone at home, uses the device as a confessor. One day, however, the target records a phone call from her husband: the man called one of his mistresses. Between the two is the crisis, made worse by the fact that the camera had been a gift from the director friend who wanted to capture images of domestic dramas. Ambitious and unsolved, the film, presented at Cannes in 1990, unfortunately often falls into the grotesque. First and only direction by Monica Vitti: former muse of the incommunicability of Antonioni, a brilliant former actress of the Italian comedy, not yet a former writer of autobiographies. Pretentious and boring, even if the idea precedes that of a subsequent meta-cinema.

title: Scanzonatissimo
actors: Alighiero Noschese, Antonella Steni, Elio Pandolfi, Rossella Como
description: An uninterrupted series of imitations performed by Alighiero Noschese that targets the most famous personalities in politics, entertainment and television of the time.It is simply a film adaptation of the homonymous theatrical magazine by Dino Verde himself. Nothing remarkable apart from Noschese's skill.

title: Lo scapolo
actors: Alberto Sordi, Nino Manfredi, Rossana Podestà, Virna Lisi, Lilli Greco
description: Accountant Anselmi is very proud of the unrepentant bachelor life he leads. Over time, however, he realizes that he is alone. Little by little, Anselmi's passion for Carla grows, but she can't stand his playboy attitudes. Anselmi understands that he has to change and convinces Carla to marry him.
notes: A very funny film, especially in the first part. Pietrangeli proves not to be anyone: nothing special, but Sordi gives one of his best proofs of the 1950s.

title: Sibling Rivalry
actors: Kirstie Alley, Bill Pullman, Carrie Fisher, Jami Gertz, Scott Bakula, Sam Elliott
description: Marjorie, a restless wife and disappointed writer, is urged by her sister to betray her husband, a career doctor who considers his wife only as a pleasant presence for social occasions. Marjorie is persuaded and has an affair with a stranger, who however dies of a heart attack; she later discovers that the man is her brother-in-law. To manage the new situation she ends up leaving her husband. The brilliant tone of the beginning is not always maintained, but the director's skill and the sympathy of the actors still make the film enjoyable.

title: Private Resort
actors: Johnny Depp, Rob Morrow, Hector Elizondo, Karyn O'Brian
description: Ben and Jack are two guys with only one idea in mind: to slip into the sheets of all the girls who populate a trendy Miami haunt. The only result is to get involved in a ring of jewelry thieves with the aristocrat Amanda Rawlings who is on the trail of a diamond necklace, which was stolen from her by a great thief called "the Master". It is the third film in a series that includes Naughty Lessons and American College, based on a simple recipe: showing lots of girls in bikinis. In addition, there is also a very young Johnny Depp here.

title: Loophole
actors: Albert Finney, Martin Sheen, Susannah York
description: An unemployed architect (Finney) is the author of an ambitious plan that will allow him to break into a superpowered London bank and therefore considered robbery-proof. It is not to be thrown away, starting with the cast, but the story advances towards the end in inexorable decline.

title: Quick Change
actors: Bill Murray, Geena Davis, Randy Quaid, Jason Robards
description: Grimm, the beautiful Phyllis and Loomis rob a bank and sneak under the nose of police chief Rotzinger. On their way to the airport, the three are also robbed, but manage to save the loot. Then they run into a foreign taxi driver, with new complications due to his imperfect English and, always chased by the police, they chase a plane among a thousand other hilarious setbacks. The film is remembered for a guessed opening and for the good cast, dominated by the effective Bill Murray (Grimm). For the rest, the story is quite messed up and the lack of comic streak is also diverted by a decidedly incongruous romantic aspect.

title: City Slickers
actors: Billy Crystal, Daniel Stern, Bruno Kirby, Patricia Wettig, Jack Palance
description: An "intelligent vacation", and above all unusual, for three forty-year-olds from the city, dissatisfied and confused: two weeks as real cowboys to escort a herd. Heterogeneous (and not entirely reliable) company, assorted accidents, re-enactment of the past and, even, something that looks a lot like heroism. enjoyable and, at the same time, anything but frivolous. Excellent performance of the performers, and in particular of the "old" Jack Palance, in the part of Curly, for which he won an Oscar.

title: Scaramouche
actors: Stewart Granger, Janet Leigh, Mel Ferrer, Eleanor Parker
description: André Moreau, to avenge the death of a friend of his, hides in a company of comedians under the mask of Scaramouche. The Revolution rages and Scaramouche injures numerous representatives of the nobility in a duel, before finally managing to clash with the fearsome Marquis De Mayne. The most beautiful duel in the history of cinema is the culminating moment of this sumptuous and magical film, a remake of the first "Scaramouche" directed in 1923 by Rex Ingram. A classic of swashbuckling, which makes fun of itself with great panache.

title: Scarface
actors: Paul Muni, George Raft, Ann Dvorak, Boris Karloff, Karen Morley
description: A young killer, Tony Camonte, becomes the bodyguard of a gang leader. Helped by a friend, Rinaldo, he seizes power. Morbidly in love with his sister, Tony makes the mistake of killing Rinaldo, when he learns that he has married the girl. The police go after him for the murder. Anthology film. The figure of the young gangster, violent, cynical, amoral, ambitious is inspired by the youthful image of Al Capone. But characterized by a tragic dimension, which makes the character a sort of negative hero: ambiguity that forced the producers to release the film with a moralistic prologue. The film is one of Hawks' and 1930s cinema masterpieces. Masterful screenplay by Ben Hecht, perfect rhythm, famous the initial sequence shot.

title: Scarface
actors: Al Pacino, Steven Bauer, Michelle Pfeiffer, Robert Loggia, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Robert Loggia, Miriam Colon, F. Murray Abraham, Paul Shenar, Harris Yulin
description: Tony Montana, a Cuban refugee in the United States, climbs the heights of the underworld with cruelty and determination. Become the king of drug trafficking, backed by his friend Manny. After killing his boss, Lopez, he marries his woman, Elvira. Having reached the apex, however, trouble begins for Tony: unstable personality, the new boss offends his important Bolivian ally, Sosa. The relationship with Elvira fails and moreover his sister Gina, with whom he is morbidly in love, goes to marry Manny himself.
notes: De Palma reinterprets Hawks' masterpiece in his own way. One of the most baroque and bombastic films, from the duration to the over-the-top performance of a great Pacino. Screenplay by Oliver Stone. Michelle Pfeiffer in one of her first major roles.

title: Scarpe grosse
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, Lilia Silvi, Elena Altieri
description: A handsome young peasant (Nazzari) inherits an extensive landed estate from a nobleman, his natural father. The brother of the deceased and the other relatives join forces to make life difficult for the protagonist. But it takes more, he goes undaunted on his own path, especially since the pretty daughter of his arch enemy (Silvi) is on his side. And the court as well. Based on a play by the Hungarian Sandor Hunyday, it is strongly influenced by its theatrical origins. Typical "educational" product of a cinema with little blood in its veins.

title: The Red Shoes
actors: Moira Shearer, Anton Walbrook, Marius Goring
description: Vicky Page is a young dancer, to whom the famous impresario Lermontov predicts a radiant career. In love with the young composer Julian Craster, she lets himself be persuaded by him to abandon Lermontov, who also led her to success in the ballet "Red Shoes" inspired by Andersen's fairy tale. Repentant, she will go back and, identifying herself with the character of "Red Shoes", she will dance until death. On the basic melodramatic material, Powell and Pressburger have built a flamboyant work of inventiveness and visionary. The extraordinary colors and the enchanting camera movements make it an essential cult movie, a symbol of the dream in the cinema. Oscar for music, costumes and sets.

title: Le casse
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Omar Sharif, Robert Hossein, Dyan Cannon, Renato Salvatori
description: With a very audacious shot and scored with extremely sophisticated systems, two thieves steal a huge amount of diamonds. At the moment of escaping, however, a mishap blocks them in the port of Athens. A greedy Greek policeman hunts them down, but only to get his hands on the loot.
notes: Waste of stars in the cast (more likeable and scoundrel Belmondo) for a banal and disappointing detective story, based on a novel by David Goodis and with allusions to the regime of the Greek colonels.

title: Lo scatenato
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Claudio Gora, Massimo Serato, Carmelo Bene
description: Bob (Gassman) is very successful as an advertising actor. One day a little dog dirties him during a shoot and from that moment everything goes wrong: on several occasions he is attacked by a bull, a swarm of bees, a swarm of ants. Bob loses his job but the persecution continues: a fly annoys him day and night. It will end up in the zoo, in the gorilla's cage, feeding on peanuts.
notes: Cruel satire of the world of advertising and the rampant male characters played by Gassman in the sixties: now the boom times are over, it's time for crisis and second thoughts. There is also Carmelo Bene in a small part.

title: Lo sceicco bianco
actors: Alberto Sordi, Brunella Bovo, Leopoldo Trieste, Giulietta Masina, Lilia Landi, Ernesto Almirante, Fanny Marchiò, Gina Mascetti, Jole Silvani, Enzo Maggio, Ugo Attanasio, Mimo Billi
description: Wanda (Bovo) and Ivan (Trieste) are on their wedding voyage in Rome. For her it is an opportunity to get acquainted with the character of the photo novels for which she dotes: the White Sheikh (Deaf). With a pretext she leaves the hotel and her husband and joins the crew who are shooting a new episode. He soon discovers that dreams are one thing and reality quite another. After Lights of the Variety shot with Alberto Lattuada, Fellini makes his first film entirely "his", a bittersweet comedy that ironizes, without overloading the colors, both on popular culture and on the Italian province.

title: Lo sceicco rosso
actors: Channing Pollock, Luciana Gilli, Rosalba Neri, Ettore Manni, Mel Welles
description: Towards the middle of the last century, in Morocco, as the struggle for power between the usurper Hassan and the legitimate throne holder Ajabar rages, a young Spanish architect named Ruiz enters the court of Hassan. When the usurper's guards arrest Ajabar and his daughter Amina, with whom he is in love, Ruiz intervenes in the guise of the mysterious and legendary Red Sheikh, saves Amina from certain death and kills the evil Hassan. An adventure film like so many of the sixties, which also claims to be spectacular. In a minor role also Pietro De Vico, the unforgettable Nicolino of the television series "The grandmother of the Black Corsair".

title: Dying Young
actors: Julia Roberts, Campbell Scott, Vincent D'Onofrio
description: Hilary, a simple girl disappointed by a love story that ended badly, agrees to nurse Victor, a leukemic, the 28-year-old son of a billionaire. The boy is the victim of terrible crises caused by chemotherapy; all this does not prevent the two from falling in love and running away together. Once the therapy is suspended, Victor becomes prey to pain to overcome which he begins to use morphine; the drug, taken in ever more massive doses, makes him addictive and makes things worse. Only with her love can Hilary hope to help him. Schumacher measures himself with melodrama, relying on the graces of Roberts. The idea is to overturn the dynamic of "Love Story" and this time to condemn the rich scion to death; interesting, but maybe it took more nastiness, or less molasses.

title: Scemo di guerra
actors: Beppe Grillo, Coluche, Bernard Blier, Fabio Testi, Claudio Bisio, Gianni Franco
description: The story of Oscar Pilli, hallucinated and psychopathic Italian commander in the Libyan war. One of the very rare cinematic experiences for Beppe Grillo: not very happy. Risi tries the tragicomic by adapting Mario Tobino's "The Libyan Desert", but he doesn't keep up the pace.

title: Scenes from the Class Struggle in Beverly Hills
actors: Jacqueline Bisset, Ed Begley jr., Paul Bartel, Paul Mazursky, Mary Woronov
description: Clare, a famous soap opera actress, organizes a wake for her deceased husband. Her best friend's waiter, Lisabeth, bets with Clare's on which of them will be able to win the other's mistress first. So in the course of the night, the affairs between the various participants secretly follow one another. Paul Bartel does not like half measures, his humor is very poisonous, situations lead to the most insulting conclusions. Including the "pink" final which is a parody of himself. Jacqueline Bisset juggles the bedlam with great talent, like all the other performers, who know how to give the film that touch of madness that makes it irresistible.

title: Oklahoma Annie
actors: Judy Canova, John Russell, Grant Withers, Roy Barcroft, Emmett Lynn
description: The proprietary dynamic of an emporium aspires to collaborate with the young sheriff to free the city from the bandits. After alternating events he succeeds in the intent, also helping the sheriff who fell in the hands of the robbers. In the long series of western, this does nothing to be remembered.

title: Uno sceriffo extraterrestre... poco extra e molto terrestre
actors: Bud Spencer, Cary Guffey, Raimund Harmstorf, Joe Bugner, Renato Scarpa, Carlo Reali, Gigi Bonos, Giulio Maculani
description: A sheriff of an American citizen runs into a little boy who claims to come from the constellation of Vega. At first incredulous, the guardian of order must then defend the little friend from the military, who hunt him down to get hold of a particular super-technological object. Adventure with Bud Spencer, cult actor for boys, with a child who had appeared the year before in "Close Encounters of the Third Kind". More parochial than usual, with a sequel ("Who knows why captain all to me").

title: The Second Time Around
actors: Debbie Reynolds, Andy Griffith, Steve Forrest, Juliet Prowse
description: Lou Rogers, a young widow, moves to Charleyville, a small town in Arizona, in search of work. She is hired as a worker by a woman who owns a farm, who soon becomes as fond of her as a mother. Lou is courted by Dan, a gambler and, at the same time, by a wealthy farmer. One day the village bank is attacked and Lou kills one of the thieves, since then the woman has taken on the post of sheriff. Harmless and a bit late, a family comic western.

title: Heathers
actors: Winona Ryder, Christian Slater, Shannen Doherty, Lisanne Falk, Kim Walker
description: Veronica is a fragile teenager, the victim of her more savvy and dishonest companions; of the three Heather, in particular. Veronica falls in love with a newcomer, Jason. Together with him he begins to take revenge for past harassment, and the first to tragically pay the price is Heather. Strange "suicides" then follow one another in college, until Veronica finds the courage to rebel before it's too late.
notes: A dramatic variant of the school-adolescent trend, with an uncommon ferocity and rhythm. Excellent couple of protagonists.

title: Scherzi da prete
actors: Pippo Franco, Lino Toffolo, Cochi Ponzoni, Oreste Vianello, Bombolo
description: Don Tarquinio Buttafava is the shepherd of the simple souls of a parish in a small town in Ciociaria: Cioci. Don Tarquinio, for a privilege granted by the pope around the year 1000 to the diocese, is allowed to celebrate mass in the local dialect. A Roman princess, exponent of the "black" aristocracy, uses the Ciociara priest to carry out building speculation operations.
