But things get complicated when the little priest decides to found a party destined to supplant the DC.
notes: With clear reference to the "Lefebvre case", the film is more than a satire, a review of goliardic and farcical ideas. Unwatchable.

title: Lo scherzo
actors: Josef Somr, Jana Ditetova
description: Ludvik's life, with youth enthusiasm for socialism, to the prison in which he ends up for a postcard jokingly triggered in Trozkij, up to the darkness present. Taken from a novel by Milan Kundera who is also a conscnector, a film dated but with a verve at times exciting.

title: Scherzo del destino in agguato dietro l'angolo come un brigante da strada
actors: Gastone Moschin, Ugo Tognazzi, Piera Degli Esposti, Renzo Montagnani, Enzo Jannacci
description: The interior minister remains imprisoned in his armored car. In vain, Fiat technicians, Digos agents, party allies and political opponents attempt to free the minister. While an honorable man tries to ingratiate himself with the prisoner, his wife flirts with a terrorist hiding in the cellar: everyone will end up crammed inside the car. A satire against Italian politicians that would like to be ferocious, but only ends up being yet another display of Wertmüller's heavy taste. Too bad, because the starting idea was not bad and the actors all in all work. But the director avoids the pure register of comedy to push on that of the very insistent apologue.

title: La gifle
actors: Isabelle Adjani, Lino Ventura, Annie Girardot, George Wilson
description: Isabella (Adjani) is twenty years old, she studies medicine and has problems in her family. The parents are divorced, the mother (Girardot) lives with someone else, and the father (Ventura) is not an affable character. Great success in France, Pinoteau's film rests on Ventura's imperturbable face and Adjani's youthful freshness.

title: Red Dust
actors: Clark Gable, Jean Harlow, Gene Raymond, Mary Astor
description: The owner of a rubber plantation in Southeast Asia finds himself being courted by the wife of one of his collaborators. But he ends up falling in love with a troubled prostitute.
notes: Turbid passions and high-class interpretations, with Jean Harlow and Clark Gable sex symbols of the past. The censor cut a scene in which Harlow briefly appeared without a bra. Remade in 1953 by John Ford, with Gable himself, with the title of "Mogambo".

title: Raba lyubvi
actors: Elena Solovej, Rodion Nakhapetov, Nikita Mikhalkov
description: While the revolutionaries conquered Moscow, in 1917, a melodrama, "Slave of Love", was filmed in the Crimea. The protagonist is Olga, a diva of the moment, in love with the operator Viktor, who is actually a Bolshevik activist in possession of clandestine footage that he gives to Olga before being captured. Mikalkhov's debut, who uses the device of "cinema within cinema" as an ironic filter for an affectionate re-enactment of Russia on the threshold of revolution.

title: The President's Lady
actors: Charlton Heston, Susan Hayward, John McIntire
description: Rachel married a wicked and unscrupulous man. When she meets Andrew Jackson, a young and esteemed prosecutor, she falls in love with him. Going to live away from her husband Rachel finds Jackson and marries him convinced that her husband has asked for and obtained a divorce. Meanwhile, the prosecutor has made a career and is now running for the office of president of the United States. The divorce, however, had never been sanctioned and the couple risks scandal. The story is true, but more than a historical film it is a melodrama. Based on an Irving Stone novel.

title: Lady in the Dark
actors: Ginger Rogers, Ray Milland, Warner Baxter
description: Anne Elliot (Rogers) runs a fashion magazine. She is all dedicated to work and in her life there is very little room for affection. When she begins to suffer from nervous disorders, Anne turns to a psychoanalyst, who, by inducing her to delve into the subconscious, will lead her to free herself from her inferiority complex and the balance of an emotionally serene existence. Based on a "musical" by Ira Gershwin and Kurt Weill, the film is a successful attempt to blend musical, choreographic and traditional acting elements. Fun, spectacular and engaging, with a weird use of psychoanalysis and an eccentric opulence.

title: Slaves of New York
actors: Bernadette Peters, Chris Sarandon, Adam Coleman Howard
description: We are in New York in 2000; the city is dilapidated and run down. Eleanor, a proofreader and creator of fancy hats, lives with Stash, a neurotic painter. Their entourage is made up of artists and intellectuals. In this environment the passions seem banished and the bond between Eleanor and Stash seems the strongest. Under this aseptic appearance, however, passions harbor and betrayals and abandonments are lurking. Ivory does science fiction in her own way, proposing a future not too different from the present and very plausible. The film is a sort of apologue that warns about the upcoming ethical unease: laudable intention, but the cinematic result is certainly not up to the best Ivory.

title: Of Human Bondage
actors: Kim Novak, Laurence Harvey, Nanette Newman
description: Philip Carey, a failed painter who became a doctor, falls madly in love with Mildred who seems to reciprocate him despite continuing to flirt with other men too. Mildred, however, decides to marry another but the man, discovered that the woman is pregnant with her, abandons her. Philip takes her back with him but she leaves him again. After a life unruly Mildred dies in the hospital in Philip's arms. This Mildred is decidedly fifty. The film is the third version of Somerset Maugham's novel. Not the best, and not because of the two protagonists

title: Raw Deal
actors: Dennis O'Keefe, Claire Trevor, John Ireland
description: Rick Coyle is the leader of a ruthless San Francisco gang. To avoid arrest, he has Joe Sullivan sentenced in his place. He escapes from prison and, hosted by Ann, tries to escape to South America. Rick tries to have him killed by one of his hit men but Ann kills the latter but is captured by Rick: Joe frees her by killing Rick but is shot down. He is a great little noir, ruthless in describing a world made of monsters and angels: Anthony Mann investigates here, as in the handful of his noirs, before the great season of his westerns, the sick universe of gangsterism, with robustness of story and an eye to social problems: from an anthology.

title: Charade
actors: Audrey Hepburn, Cary Grant, Walter Matthau, James Coburn
description: Returning from vacation, Reggie discovers that her husband has been murdered. A charming man she met on vacation, Peter, offers her help. Friends of the deceased begin to anguish her with unorthodox requests for money and even Peter now seems less friendly than he had shown. In the intertwining of thriller and sparkling comedy, the master Donen refers to is obviously Hitchcock. The result on both sides was successful and very pleasant, also supported by an excellent cast, in which Cary Grant and Audrey Hepburn join forces with Matthau, Coburn and George Kennedy. Famous score by Henry Mancini.

title: Avec la peau des autres
actors: Lino Ventura, Jean Bouise, Marilù Tolo, Jean Servais
description: In Vienna, the secret agent Maurice tries to recover his colleague Paul who has fallen into the hands of the enemy. To help him are many: the owner of the brewery where Paul was captured, the administrator of the Vienna Philharmonic, a lawyer, protector of a young artist, in turn involved in the spy network. At the end of the adventurous mission, the budget will also have negative items. From the novel "Au pied du mur" by Gilles Perrault, a film with a solid and tight script, with a well-balanced narrative progression and convincing interpreters.

title: Scipione detto anche l'Africano
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Ruggero Mastroianni, Vittorio Gassman, Silvana Mangano, Turi Ferro, Woody Strode
description: Cato sees the popularity of Scipio the African and his brother the Asian as a danger to the Republic, and accuses them of stealing public money. The African, whose wife has filed for divorce, unable to bear the rigid moral integrity, discovers that the appropriation is the work of his brother. Realizing that these are not times for men of his stature, he takes responsibility for himself and goes into exile. Magni tells an episode of antiquity with the tones of popular comedy, supported by a very solid cast. But the historical fable has a somewhat woody assumption. Exceptionally, the editor Mastroianni, brother of Marcello, also plays. The soundtrack is by the flutist Severino Gazzelloni.

title: Scipione l'Africano
actors: Annibale Ninchi, Camillo Pilotto, Isa Miranda, Fosco Giachetti
description: Scipio must face the Carthaginians to reassert Roman dominion over the Mediterranean. To this end, he conceives an ambitious but very risky plan: to land on African soil and bring the war into the enemy's home. To implement it he must face the resistance of the senate, the love pitfalls of Queen Sofonisba and the plots of Massinissa. Kolossal of fascist cinema aimed at glorifying the regime through the exaltation of the glories of ancient Rome. However, Mussolini was disappointed by the excessive Hamletic weaknesses conferred on the character. Ninchi was also inadequate to the part. There remains the commitment of some mass scenes, clearly of "Soviet" derivation. Music by Ildebrando Pizzetti and prize for the best Italian film in Venice.

title: Scissors
actors: Sharon Stone, Steve Railsback, Michelle Phillips, Ronny Cox
description: Angie (Stone) has experienced sexual trauma in the past and still bears the marks. Strange things happen in her apartment: objects move by themselves and she thinks she's gone mad. Or maybe there is someone who is organizing all this just to drive her to madness? De Felitta is better known as a screenwriter and novelist (he is the author of the book from which Audrey Rose was based), than as a director. Sharon Stone had not yet done Basic Instinct at the time and therefore was just a beautiful girl. The film went unnoticed in theaters and there is no need to be too sorry about it.

title: The Dead Pool
actors: Clint Eastwood, Liam Neeson, Patricia Clarkson, Evan C. Kim
description: Inspector Callaghan is back in action. A homicidal maniac is killing everyone in the crew of a horror film directed by celebrated director Peter Swan. There is a list with the names of his next victims and inside there is also that of "Dirty Harry".
notes: On his fifth appearance as Inspector Callaghan, Eastwood is tired and even a little aged. He accuses the mass media of propagating violence as if he were making films as a schoolgirl. As director he takes on Buddy Van Horn, for years his hard man (he shot action scenes). And in fact the only sequence to remember is that of the remote controlled car, stuffed with explosives.

title: Deadly Bet
actors: Jeff Wincott, Stephen Vincent Leigh, Charlene Tilton
description: Angelo does the nonsense of loving kickboxing and betting on matches. As if that weren't enough, once his fiancée Isabella bets with Rico and inevitably loses. For the rest of the film we witness the repentance of Angelo who stops drinking, stops gambling and eventually gets the girl back. As for his love ... Angelo has to sweat another seven shirts to get him back. The plot is the same as I play his wife ... in Las Vegas, but at least there were James Caan and Nicholas Cage. Instead here we are grappling with Jeff Wincott and Stephen Vincent Leigh. In a minor role is former boxing champion Ray "Boom Boom" Mancini.

title: Eyewitness
actors: William Hurt, Sigourney Weaver, Christopher Plummer, James Woods
description: Darryl, a night watchman, in love with a beautiful television reporter, takes advantage of the opportunity offered him by the murder of a Vietnamese trafficker to finally meet the object of his desire: therefore he passes himself off as a witness. The knowledge between the two actually results in love. What Darryl does not know is that he himself, unintentionally, will eventually discover the identity of the killer. Good school thriller, with excellent protagonists and the direction of a specialist.

title: The Disappearance of Aimee
actors: Faye Dunaway, Bette Davis, James Woods, James Sloyan
description: In 1926, the preacher Aimée Semple McPhearson (Dunaway) disappeared for six weeks. The case affects public opinion and even when she reappears, the controversy does not go away. She claims she was kidnapped and taken to Mexico, the police, and even her mother (Davis), think more maliciously that Aimée took a convict vacation with a married man. The case ends up in a courtroom. Television debut for Dunaway, in a role originally conceived for Ann-Margret. Davis and Woods are at least as good as she is.

title: Attention, les enfants regardent
actors: Alain Delon, Sophie Renoir, Richard Constantini, Thierry Turchet, Tiphaine Leroux
description: The parents are far away and four brothers, two boys and two females from five to thirteen years old, are entrusted to a Spanish housekeeper in a splendid villa on the French Riviera. For hours and hours in front of the TV, influenced by the violence that passes on the commentary, the children come into conflict with the woman and, everyone in agreement, cause drowning. A vagabondo, however (Delon) has seen everything, introduces himself to the villa and claims to be the master. A film inspired by a work by American psychoanalysts Koenig and Dixon, who creates disturbance, causing infantile innocence influenced by TV. With all the vulgarisations of the case, and without suspense. Not even Delon is saved.

title: Pacific Heights
actors: Melanie Griffith, Michael Keaton, Matthew Modine, Mako, Nobu McCarthy
description: Patty and Drake, young and in love, restore a Victorian house in San Francisco, in which they create three apartments. One rents him a mysterious and disturbing character. He is a psychopath who lives with the causes won against the people he provokes to the point of forcing them into violent reactions. Patty will act, with the strength of desperation, and stop the diabolical scammer in a tragic final crescendo.
notes: Psychological thriller by John Schlesinger, which makes use of a remarkable work of actors. The villain is Michael "Batman" Keaton. The Hitchockian Tippy Hedren ("The Birds") appears in a "cameo".

title: Stranger on the Third Floor
actors: Peter Lorre, John McGuire, Margaret Tallichet, Charles Waldron
description: A journalist finds himself witnessing two different situations in the first person: in the first case he gets to convict a defendant with his testimony. In the second he is forced to prove his strangeness regarding a terrible murder committed in the building where he lives, and of which the journalist is unjustly accused. Only his fiancée seems to believe him. Final full of suspense, and obvious dreamlike references, in a nice low-cost gothic thriller, with an unmissable Lorre.

title: Clash of the Titans
actors: Laurence Olivier, Claire Bloom, Maggie Smith, Ursula Andress, Harry Hamlin
description: Perseus was born from one of the many terrestrial loves of the god Jupiter. He is destined to become a hero. With the help of Medusa's head and thanks to Jupiter's paternal surveillance, Perseus defeats a sea monster and gets Andromeda's hand.
notes: Confusing and full of delays, he ends up losing even what little good there is from time to time (like Laurence Olivier who enjoys playing Zeus). Ray Harryhausen's princely cast and well-crafted, albeit pre-electronic, special effects are not enough to avoid the landslide.

title: Scorpio
actors: Burt Lancaster, Alain Delon, Paul Scofield, Gayle Hunnicut, John Colicos, J.D. Cannon, Shmuel Rodensky, William Smithers
description: CIA agent Cross (Lancaster) is suspected of being in league with his Soviet emulator Zharkov (Scofield). Therefore the Frenchman Jean Laurier, known as Scorpio (Delon), has the task of eliminating him.
notes: A very intricate mechanism, with many victims, in the contrast between old-fashioned secret agents, capable of loyalty even among enemies, and young people who cynically obey any order. Direction by profession, good performers.

title: The Shop Around the Corner
actors: James Stewart, Margaret Sullavan, Frank Morgan, Felix Bressart
description: Alfred Kralik and Klara Novak both work as clerks in the leather goods shop owned by Mr. Matuschek. Both secretly cultivate a love letter with an anonymous correspondent. Neither of them dares to reveal themselves first, fearing disillusionment. In reality they write to each other, without realizing it. Indeed, the more they fall in love with each other by letter, the more they find themselves unbearable in life. Superb direction by the great Lubitsch based on a screenplay by Samson Raphaelson, a lesson in perfection, lightness and melancholy with perfect interpreters.

title: The Black Shield of Falworth
actors: Tony Curtis, Janet Leigh
description: Having escaped the extermination of the noble Falworth family, Myles grows up in poverty, however he manages to obtain the investiture of a knight in order to honor his name and take revenge on his enemies. He also has to deal with Walter Blunt, brother of his father's killer, who contends with Lady Anne Mackworth. Curtis-Leigh, who were married at the time, together in a movie made just for them, but with no major surprises.

title: Scugnizzi
actors: Leo Gullotta, Sara Basile, Giuseppe Merolla, Cristian Capone, Gigi Savoia
description: Fortunato Assante, a shabby show organizer, wants to set up a recital with the youth of the reformatory to raise a certain amount of money due to a creditor. During rehearsals, Fortunato is fascinated and shocked by the dramatic world of these guys. The show is staged at the "San Carlo", but the epilogue will be tragic.
notes: Loy returns to the city of Campania after the film on the war of Liberation _ (The four days of Naples) _ and plunges into everyday violence. The result, however, is less than mediocre: good in intentions but dull and irritating, a Neapolitan musical full of stereotypes and not redeemed by the performers.

title: Scuola di ladri
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Lino Banfi, Massimo Boldi, Enrico Maria Salerno, Barbara Scoppa
description: Three poor people from Campania making do. A certain Aliprando, who passes himself off as their uncle, hires the three to set up a criminal society: they must learn to rob jewelers under his guidance. The comedy is unpretentious and features well-known masks, the trio Villaggio-Banfi-Boldi struggling with three figures of thugs, and Salerno in the unexpected role of the perfidious uncle who moves in a wheelchair. The founds, however, are old and the comedy is made of sketches rather unrelated to each other.

title: Stitches
actors: Parker Stevenson, Geoffrey Lewis, Robin Dearden, Lloyd Bridges
description: The medical school students have some fixed ideas in their heads: disturbing the reception at the rector's home, pretending to be a corpse during an educational autopsy and above all watching the female students undress. Tremendous epigone of the "Police School" series; the director did not sign and the film appears to be directed by Allen Smithhe (trade union pseudonym).

title: The Monster Squad
actors: André Cower, Robby Kicer, Stephen Macht
description: To get hold of an ancient, precious amulet, all possible monsters meet in a small town in the United States: Dracula, Frankenstein, the Mummy, the Wolf Man and the Monster of the Black Lagoon. As the authorities groped in the dark, a team of enterprising kids defeat the monsters. Horror comedy for kids, with all the characters of classic horror, polite and stupid. The Italian title looked like "Police School".

title: Screwballs
actors: Peter Keleghan, Linda Speciale, Alan Daveau
description: In a prestigious college for well-to-do boys, students play in purely intellectual pastimes, such as going to great lengths to surprise the bra-less school stick.

title: Police Academy
actors: Steve Guttenberg, Kim Cattrall, Bubba Smith, Michael Winslow
description: Young Mahoney (Guttenberg) is in trouble with the law, but the mayor of the city wants to give everyone access to the police profession, so he can choose between jail and police school. In the company of other messed up like him, under the orders of a blonde and strong-willed instructor, he does an insane training and manages to neutralize a dangerous criminal.
notes: Parent film of a long series, it served to launch Guttenberg. Very vulgar and messed up, it is a jumble of one-dimensional specks that at times undeniably amuse.

title: Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment
actors: Steve Guttenberg, Bubba Smith, David Graf, Michael Winslow
description: Fresh from the police school graduation, a group of students is sent to the first mission. We find the good Mahoney, the gigantic Hightower, the "noisy" Jones and the gun maniac Tackleberry. They have to contend with both a gang of criminals and their older and sedentary colleagues. After a thousand vicissitudes, however, ours will be able to overcome the criminals. Insane comedy, surreal situations and monotonous characters are the winning ingredients of the series.

title: Police Academy 3: Back in Training
actors: Steve Guttenberg, Bubba Smith, David Graf, Michael Winslow, Marion Ramsey
description: 1980s. Reagan's economic rigorism hits hard: one of two police schools will have to close. The struggle is unleashed among the institutes to win the right to survival: the bad subjects of Commander Mauser seem to prevail over the clumsy pupils of Lassard. It will be up to the usual Mahoney & C. to put things back in place. Already perfectly serialized, with the third episode (of us a half flop) the series is now over, although four more episodes will arrive.

title: Police Academy 4 - Citizens On Patrol
actors: Steve Guttenberg, Bubba Smith, Michael Winsolw, Sharon Stone
description: The last frontier of the fight against crime is to entrust their defense to the citizens themselves. This is the program that Commander Lassard and his team of men headed by Sergeant Mahoney have set themselves. It goes without saying that the citizens, including a wild old woman, do nothing but make trouble, but redeem themselves in the end. The series was now boiling to the second episode. Note the journalist played by Sharon Stone.

title: Police Academy 5: Assignment Miami Beach
actors: Bubba Smith, George Gaynes, Michael Winslow, David Graf
description: Captain Harris tries in every way to ruin Commander Lassard's reputation by stealing his place. The latter offers him the opportunity on a silver platter by exchanging his suitcase at the airport for another one containing stolen diamonds, and finding himself chased by thieves who want the stolen goods back. But the young policemen under Lassard's command keep watch. The farce is not particularly crackling: at the fifth episode you no longer know what to invent. And Guttenberg is no longer there either.

title: Police Academy 6: City Under Siege
actors: G.W. Bailey, George Gaynes, Kenneth Mars, Bubba Smith, Michael Winslow
description: The demented Commander Lassard and his "cops", given the failure of Captain Harris in the same mission, must defeat the gang of a mysterious "Master Mind", whose criminal action aims to carry out a gigantic urban speculation. The penultimate film in the "Police Academy" series is as silly as the previous ones, but each time the penalty for the aggravating circumstance of the continuation grows. Guttenberg does not appear here, who threw in the towel after the fourth take in 1987. Of the old "heap" is the gigantic black actor Bubba Smith, champion of endurance.

title: Moving Violations
actors: John Murray, Jennifer Tilly, James Keach
description: A group of drivers whose driving license has been withdrawn is entrusted to the ambitious agent Halik for a re-education course. Israel and Proft, the same scriptwriter duo from Police School, miss the shot this time. We laugh half a time, and focus too much on smashing chases.

title: Scusate il ritardo
actors: Massimo Troisi, Giuliana De Sio, Lello Arena, Lina Polito, Franco Acampora
description: Vincenzo, a young Neapolitan, lives supported by his mother, sister and brother. His friend Tonino haunts him with his depression for a love that has gone wrong. Anna also had a disappointment and is convinced she will find her consolation in Vincenzo, and he accepts, since he is in love with her.
notes: Second film by Troisi director: a counter-current portrait of young Neapolitans. No sun and sea music, no great passions. In their place there is only everyday normality, told with irony and melancholy. Particularly appreciable are some surreal dialogues and some dramaturgical situations in which the unexpressed prevails, even if the film repeats a bit the director-actor's debut.

title: Crash Course
actors: Jackée Harry, Brian Bloom, Harvey Corman, Alyssa Milano, Charles Robinson
description: In a college, at the end of the school year, a group of reckless young people and pranksters have to take another test, in addition to the one they have to face to graduate.

title: The Frisco Kid
actors: Gene Wilder, Harrison Ford, Ramon Bieri, Val Bisoglio, George Ralph Di Cenzo
description: The bearded Avram is a very observant Polish rabbi, who marks the rhythms of his day and his life on the teachings of the Torah. In the mid-nineteenth century, when civilization was by now consolidated, he left for the United States and exactly for San Francisco, to carry out his functions in the local Jewish community. To implement his project, however, he must cross the Wild West, where the precepts of the Law are often in contrast with the most elementary needs: for example, that of escaping an outlaw who hunts him ...
notes: The couple Gene Wilder-Harrison Ford surprises for their harmony and comic effectiveness.

title: Scusi, lei è favorevole o contrario?
actors: Alberto Sordi, Anita Ekberg, Tina Aumont, Paola Pitagora, Mario Pisu, Laura Antonelli
description: A journalist is carrying out an investigation (we are in 1967) on the possible introduction of divorce in Italy. Despite being separated from his wife and allowing himself plenty of lovers, the industrialist Tullio Conforti is decidedly opposed because it is in contrast with his religious principles. Moreover, he dedicates a different day of the week to each of the numerous lovers, also providing them with something to live on. The Deaf futigatore of costumes is tremendous, the Deaf director as well; Luckily, memories of the Deaf comic actor occasionally awaken.

title: Scusi, ma lei paga le tasse?
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Umberto D'Orsi, Karin Schubert
description: Ciccio Cavaterra (Ingrassia), official of the Tax Office of Rome, aspires, zealous as he is, to make a career. Unfortunately for him, his nephew Franco (Franchi) is hired in the same office, and there is no end of trouble. He will in fact be demoted to usher. Fortunately, the grandson manages to find and tax the winner of a lottery.
notes: The iron couple, made up of two good actors, is quite worn out. Here we are now at the end of their lucky period.

title: If It's Tuesday, This Must Be Belgium
actors: Suzanne Pleshette, Ian McShane, Mildred Natwick, Murray Hamilton
description: A group of American tourists is seduced by one of those travel companies that offer half of the world around the world in three weeks, all inclusive. Departure from London and arrival in Rome by bus with a group leader Dongovanni who has a woman in every capital, but who does not stop taking the court at one of the tourists. The cutest thing is the title, but also the speed with which the film develops is not bad.

title: Se lo scopre Gargiulo
actors: Giuliana De Sio, Richard Anconina, Nicola D. Pinto, Enzo Cannavale, Marzio C. Honorato
description: Teresa is an unfortunate Neapolitan nurse with big problems in the family: her husband doesn't even look at her, her cousin Ernestina does everything to show herself superior and her father conspicuously gets into debt. Just to cover a debt of her father Teresa signs a bad check for a million and then spends a whole night of adventures trying to cover it. De Sio is unpleasant but good. Anconina has hollow features, a long nose and an experience with Lelouch. Porta, already a screenwriter, as a regitsa is not much.

title: Honky Tonk
actors: Clark Gable, Lana Turner, Claire Trevor, Frank Morgan
description: Candy Johnson is an unscrupulous scammer. His nomadic life satisfies him until one day he gets screwed by a girl. While he is drunk, she manages to marry him. From that moment Johnson seems to want to change his life, but it's only a moment. Every now and then we laugh out loud, and the cast is excellent. The direction, however, is not up to par.

title: Everybody Does It
actors: Paul Douglas, Celeste Holm, Linda Darnell
description: Doris would like to become a famous singer, but her husband is a placid businessman. Things in the family deteriorate when it is discovered that she will never be able to realize her dream because she is not sufficiently gifted while he has a beautiful baritone voice that soon catches the attention of the experts.
notes: Remake of Ratoff's "We Are Made Like This". The script is one of Nunnally Johson's best, focusing on satire and almost slapstick. Very good Paul Douglas, a comedian unknown to us.

title: Se non avessi più te
actors: Gianni Morandi, Laura Efrikian, Nino Taranto, Enrico Viarisio, Dolores Palumbo
description: Gianni, a successful singer, has finished the military and can marry his girlfriend Carla. However, he must do it secretly: his record company fears that the marriage will take away the sympathy of the girls. The two have a son but are not officially married; the situation is complicated when, for advertising reasons, Gianni's agent invents a flirtation with an heiress. Third episode of the series that had a huge success in the Sixties, dedicated to the bangs and uvula of the singer from Monghidoro. Few pretensions, but Morandi is nice and the songs have made an era after all.

title: Government Girl
actors: Olivia de Havilland, Ann Shirley, Sonny Tofts
description: The war is in full swing and Brown, provincial industrialist, is sent to deal with supplies for US aviation. Honesty of him ruins the plans of some speculators, who defame him and drag him into court. Brown is about to succumb also because the lawyer of the adverse part is engaged to his secretary and knows all indiscretion, however innocent, on his life. Sophisticated comedy based on the verve of De Havilland, in one of its not numerous brilliant roles.

title: When He's Not a Stranger
actors: Annabeth Gish, Kevin Dillon, John Terlesky
description: On a college campus in the United States today, a young student is having an affair with a peer. Their relationship looks like a normal teen flirtation but suddenly the boyfriend turns out to be a rapist. TV movie well received in the United States, but unreleased in Italy. Among the performers Kevin Dillon, brother of the more famous Matt.

title: Se non son matti non li vogliamo
actors: Ruggero Ruggeri, Armando Falconi, Paolo Stoppa, Germana Paolieri
description: The president of a goliardic company bequeaths all his assets to a pious work and the usufruct to the only three survivors of the company itself. Despite their age, they are forced, in order to keep their status, to persist with the students of their youth. of great actors.

title: Se permettete parliamo di donne
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Sylva Koscina, Giovanna Ralli, Antonella Lualdi
description: Vittorio Gassman, in his usual role as showman, faces various adventures in which women are the protagonists. They range from the prostitute with her complacent husband, to the girl who cannot find a place to seclude herself with her boyfriend, from the superstitious Sicilian, to the lady well in search of forbidden emotions, from the uncertain woman between two lovers, to the wife of an inmate who must justify a son had in the absence of her husband.
notes: It is the debut in the direction of Scola, until then a screenwriter. The film does not differ from the many episodic works typical of the period, but it was very successful especially for the attractive performers.

title: Try This One for Size/Sauf votre respect
actors: Michael Brandon, David Carradine, Arielle Dombasle, Guy Marchand
description: Lepski is a former policeman sent to Nice by an insurance company to keep an eye on a precious statuette that is in the sights of a gang of thieves. When the artifact is stolen, Lepski takes action to recover it. The epilogue takes place in the mountains of Switzerland. From a novel by James Hadley Chase, a detective story that wants to be witty but lacks rhythm.

title: Se tutto va bene siamo rovinati
actors: Gigi Sammarchi, Andrea Roncato, Patrizia Pellegrino, Gegia
description: As soon as he is discharged from a psychiatric hospital, Gigi joins Andrea in Rome, another former patient who is hosting him with his old aunt. The two meet Celeste, a girl in difficulty that they invite to live with them. But her brother, a very wanted man called "The Red" swoops threateningly into the trio's house. The affair gets tangled up with the appearance of a corpse. A single, bumpy joke, with rare ideas for fun.

title: Se vuoi vivere... spara!
actors: Sean Todd, Ken Wood, Isabella Savona, Peter White, Renato Mambor
description: Wounded by a bandit, Johnny is cared for in a farming family by young Sally. Healed, he leaves so as not to attract trouble to his benefactors, but they are all butchered except the girl. Johnny then prepares revenge, which will be terrible. When the mission is complete, love awaits him. Negligible western spaghetti.

title: Sea Wolf
actors: Edward G. Robinson, John Garfield, Ida Lupino
description: A girl escaped from prison and clandestinely boarded a steamer, throws herself into the sea to avoid capture, saves a young man from drowning. Both are taken aboard a privateer ship. The ship is led by Captain Larsen who keeps the sailors subjugated with terror. Larsen is subject to morbid crises during which he is taken by blindness. Attacked by the enemy, the captain will sink with his ship. It is considered the best film adaptation of Jack London's novel. Adventure and horror are cleverly mixed in the terrifying portrait of the captain and his crew of desperate corsairs.

title: The Executioner's Song
actors: Tommy Lee Jones, Rosanna Arquette, Christine Lahti, Eli Wallach
description: Gary Gilmore (Tommy Lee Jones) gets out of jail after twelve years and struggles to adjust to civilian life again. Find help, a job, a Ford Mustang and a woman. Things work out for a while, then the girl leaves him, he swaps the Ford for a truck, does a few robberies and commits a couple of murders. Captured and sentenced to death, Gary accepts the sentence, indeed demands a firing squad. Scripted by Norman Mailer from his famous book, this television film won an Emmy for Tommy Lee Jones (Oscar for The Fugitive). Note the interpretation of Rosanna Arquette.

title: Rendez-vous de juillet
actors: Daniel Gélin, Maurice Ronet, Brigitte Auber
description: Loves, hopes and ambitions of Lucien Bonnard about to leave for Africa. A light Becker full of vitality, a dreamy Paris. Ancient and modern, half period document and half precursor of the fluency of the nouvelles vagues.

title: Sedici anni
actors: Eva Czemerys, Ely Galleani, Georges Ardisson, Antonio De Teffé
description: Francesca, sixteen years old, took badly the divorce of her parents and especially her mother's new partner, Sergio. In the new situation then Francesca has a great desire to have her first sexual experience. The most willing partner for the operation will be Sergio. Terrible. Usual sexy comedy disguised as a psychological drama. The actors are inept.

title: Sedotti e bidonati
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Mia Genberg, Pia Genberg
description: Two Sicilian cousins, rich farmers, but lacking in education and intelligence, casually meet two beautiful Siamese twins. The girls get all their belongings from them under the pretext of a very expensive surgery that will finally have to separate them.
notes: Poor parody of "Seduced and abandoned". But the duo's films were still done with some professional writing and making, and some numbers are fun.

title: Loverboy
actors: Patrick Dempsey, Kate Jackson, Kirstie Alley, Carrie Fisher
description: In trouble with the girl because he doesn't introduce her to her parents, in trouble with her parents because she is bad at school, Randy Bodek decides to find a summer job to pay for his college tuition. At first he delivers pizzas at home, then he does not find it unbecoming to be paid by the lonely ladies to whom he does not deliver only pizzas. However, trouble arises when he discovers that the next customer is his mother. Excellent actresses reduced to terrible roles. Silver, despite the good rhythm of the finale, completely misses the film.

title: The Seduction of Joe Tynan
actors: Meryl Streep, Alan Alda, Barbara Harris, Melvyn Douglas
description: The private is political for Senator Tynan, who in the rise to power sacrifices a love story to exhibit the hypocritical image of a quiet husband and father. Schatzberg, a robust and successful craftsman in the 1970s, attempts the moralistic denunciation of power, but he comes up with a high-class cartoon with excellent wasted actors.

title: Sea of Love
actors: Al Pacino, Ellen Barkin, John Goodman, Michael Rooker
description: Three men die in similar circumstances. All three had placed an ad in a newspaper for lonely hearts. All three are found in bed, naked, murdered by a gunshot to the head. Frank Keller, a divorced, retired police captain, is handling the case. By placing advertisements in the same newspaper, he comes into contact with various women. Among these the most suspected is Helen and, involuntarily, a dangerous attraction arises between the two. Despite Ellen Barkin's insane charm ("The Big Easy"), the film is devoured by the presence of Al Pacino. An unusually robust genre film, well written by Richard Price.

title: Segni particolari: bellissimo
actors: Adriano Celentano, Federica Moro, Gianni Bonagura, Simona Mariani, Tiberio Murgia
description: Mattia (Celentano) is an established writer. After a wild life he decides to change direction; he therefore turns to a priest friend of his to whom he confesses all his amorous adventures. To start with his new intentions he would like to marry one of his latest conquests, but the woman is only aiming for money. Eventually Michaela, a neighbor, who everyone believes to be the writer's illegitimate daughter, wins. The film unfolds on the thread of this confession that runs through the entire arc of the story. Celentano gives up all his gigioneria.

title: The Tin Star
actors: Henry Fonda, Anthony Perkins
description: A bounty hunter and a rookie sheriff against bandits. Mann is a guarantee, the two protagonists offer a remarkable duel of interpretations. Although the film is one of Mann's less personal, and Dudley Nichols' script less "mythological" than the usual scripts written by Borden Chase for the director.

title: Il segno di Venere
actors: Sophia Loren, Franca Valeri, Vittorio De Sica, Alberto Sordi, Raf Vallone, Peppino De Filippo, Tina Pica
description: Cesira and Agnese are two cousins ??who live together in the same house: the first is rather ugly, while the beautiful Agnese draws upon herself all the admiring glances of men. Cesira however continues to hope with conviction in the "charming prince". The reason for so much hope is that a fortune teller, consulted by her, told her that she was born "in the sign of Venus".
notes: Very funny costume comedy, superficial but with a nice rhythm and very good actors (above all Valeri).

title: The Mark of Zorro
actors: Tyrone Power, Basil Rathbone, J. Edward Bromberg, Linda Darnell
description: Diego de Vega (Power), son of the Spanish governor of California, returns from Madrid and discovers that during his absence a dishonest schemer has ousted his father and oppresses the population. Diego, while everyone believes him to be a spineless pleasure-seeker, hidden under the mysterious identity of the fearless Zorro, infallible swordsman, punishes the wicked and restores legality.
notes: The adventures of one of the most well-known characters in cinematic mythology are narrated by Mamoulian with great panache, and Power rages in the hero's dual personality, not making Douglas Fairbanks regret the silent version.

title: Desk Set
actors: Spencer Tracy, Katharine Hepburn, Joan Blondell, Gig Young
description: An information office employee with a sensational memory risks her job because the company has decided to equip itself with the latest technological advance: an electronic brain. But the woman does not give up and ...
notes: Pleasant satire of automation, professionally directed by Lang and interpreted by the two stars with brio and ease.

title: The Young Philadelphians
actors: Paul Newman, Barbara Rush, Alexis Smith, Brian Keith, Robert Vaughn
description: Anthony Lawrence (Newman) is a promising young Philadelphia attorney. Falling in love with the daughter of a lawyer from one of the wealthiest families in the city, he is rejected. The disappointment of love makes him cynical and ruthless in the profession, in which he excels after having abandoned all his moral principles. Only the tormented defense of an alcoholic friend will make him rediscover his ideals. Typical late 1950s meatloaf, with Newman in a complex role and Sherman directing with no surprises.

title: Les secrets professionnels du docteur Apfelglück
directors: Alessandro Capone, Stéphane Clavier, Mathias Ledoux, Thierry Lhermitte, Hervé Palud
actors: Thierry Lhermitte, Alessandro Haber, Jacques Villeret, Micha Bayard
description: Five unequal episodes, starring the doctor of the title (Lhermitte) and some bizarre patients. The funniest and most ferocious is the one about the vulgarity of certain television games.

title: Segreti segreti
actors: Lina Sastri, Alida Valli, Giulia Boschi, Lea Massari, Stefania Sandrelli, Mariangela Melato, Rossana Podestà, Nicoletta Braschi, Sandra Ceccarelli, Lorella Morlotti, Massimo Ghini, Francesca Archibugi, Antonio Petrocelli
description: Laura, of bourgeois extraction, went underground with the Red Brigades. Together with some companions he plans and carries out the attack against a magistrate of Venice. Since a comrade is injured in the action, Laura cold kills him then takes refuge in the family villa, near Bologna. On a train that takes her to Rome, Laura accidentally meets and gets acquainted with Rosa, the half-sister of the murdered terrorist.
notes: Bernardo's lesser-known brother is sometimes the best director of the Bertolucci family. The film's completely feminine gaze (even the judge that Laura will face after her arrest is a woman) gives it a somewhat forced but unusual perspective.

title: Segretissimo
actors: Gordon Scott, Magda Konopka
description: An American secret agent, in search of some precious documents, lets himself be seduced by a beautiful adventurer. Italian Para-Bond so battered as to be almost sympathetic.

title: Il segreto
actors: Nastassja Kinski, Stefano Dionisi, Franco Citti, Chiara Caselli
description: History of sentimental neuroses between people of the popular class against the backdrop of a peripheral Rome. Lucia, a waitress in a fast food restaurant and back from a suicide attempt, starts with a delivery boy who is in love with her. The girl seems to have been reborn through love: in reality the relationship is just a screen covering another relationship that Lucia has had for some time with a man much older than her. Maselli has signed an ambitious but unresolved film whose greatest merits are the photographic suggestions. Kinski is good but unlikely as a borgatara.

title: The Locket
actors: Laraine Day, Brian Aherne, Robert Mitchum, Gene Raymond
description: A little girl is unjustly accused of the theft of a medallion and her psyche is irremediably scarred. His life will be sadly marked by neurotic delusions, then a case suddenly brings to the surface all the repressed. Psychoanalysis and prodigies of life mix somewhat confusedly in this drama which is otherwise decently constructed, almost like a Freudian analysis, on the axis of an uninterrupted flash-back. The German origin of Brahm, who emigrated to Hollywood in the mid-1940s, can be read in the overall inspiration and atmosphere of the film. In the cast, a twenty-nine-year-old Mitchum.

title: The Secret of My Success
actors: Michael J. Fox, Helen Slater, Richard Jordan, Margaret Whitton, John Pankow, Fred Gwynne
description: Brantley is young, smart and poor. He goes to New York to see his uncle Howard, a distant and wealthy relative. The latter hires him as a delivery boy. Brantley, however, manages to "split" and pass himself off as an executive, gaining the trust of all the staff. What's more, his aunt falls in love with him without knowing who he is, while he is in love with the beautiful Christy, Howard's lover.
notes: Sweet and sour yuppism: the road to success is not always paved with good intentions and generosity. Brantley makes his dream come true, Herbert Ross seeks serious morals, but basically he prefers to have fun with the game of misunderstandings.

title: Il segreto del Sahara
actors: Miguel Bosé, Diego Abatantuono, Daniel Olbrychski, Delia Boccardo
description: In 1925, the American archaeologist Desmond Jordan searches for the Talking Mountain in the Sahara. He will have to overcome terrible obstacles, pursued by Lieutenant Ryker of the Foreign Legion and the leader of the raiders of the desert. Massacre of the men of the Mountain, from which only Anthea, the queen, is saved, who with Jordan and the deserter Bear will finally reach the goal. The film is the reduction of a television original of pure and simple entertainment in an adventurous key, with a slightly dated exoticism.

title: The Scorpio Letters
actors: Alex Cord, Shirley Eaton, Laurence Naismith
description: A British intelligence agent named Chaffey is found murdered. Joe Christopher, a former lieutenant of American counter-intelligence, takes care of the case. The investigations lead him to infiltrate an underground association whose leader calls himself the "Scorpio". Mediocre film, directed by the versatile Thorpe.

title: Il segreto dello Sparviero Nero
actors: Lex Barker, Livio Lorenzon, Nadia Marlowa, Walter Barnes
description: As often happens in the 18th century, the European colonial powers wage war on the seas through pirate ships. A noble Spanish hidalgo, known as "the Black Sparrowhawk", is in fact engaged in the "racing war" on the seas in the service of the very Catholic king and goes from one adventure to another to recover precious state documents.
notes: Paolella was an action film specialist. Barker, one of the many muscle coaches loaned to the cinema. The film is without infamy and without praise.

title: Pollyanna
actors: Hayley Mills, Jane Wyman, Richard Egan, Karl Malden, Nancy Olson
description: Twelve-year-old Pollyanna, orphaned, goes to live with her aunt Polly, a spinster and strict. The girl spends all day with a smile on her face, appreciating the good things life offers her. And his example ends up infecting the whole country, whose inhabitants forget the ancient grudges and persevering spite. When the girl is seriously injured by falling from a tree, the villagers will show their gratitude to Pollyanna. A honeyed, clean Disney story with a luxurious cast around it.

title: The Secret of Santa Vittoria
actors: Anthony Quinn, Virna Lisi, Hardy Krüger, Anna Magnani
description: In the Piedmontese village of Santa Vittoria an excellent wine is produced. In order not to let it be stolen by the retreating Germans, the inhabitants hide a million bottles of it in a natural cave and, despite all the attempts of the occupants, manage to save what is their only source of subsistence.
notes: "Oenological" version of the Resistance, in comedy cadences and with massive use of macchiettismo in the definition of the characters. From the novel of the same name by Robert Crichton, an American production that engages many Italian actors, including big names, such as Anna Magnani. Not irresistible, but fun.

title: Follow the Fleet
actors: Fred Astaire, Ginger Rogers, Randolph Scott
description: Two girls, orphans of a navy captain, seek funds to restore their father's ship. Between falls in love and broken promises, everything works out for the best during a great music and dance show organized on the ship itself. Insipid story but who cares. Top class numbers with songs by Irving Berlin (including "Let's Face the Music and Dance").

title: Sei già cadavere amigo ti cerca Garringo!
actors: Richard Harrison, Fernando Sancho, Alejandro Ulloa, Raf Baldassarre
description: Miller, a wealthy landowner, enriches himself by forcing the settlers of the area to give him their land at a low price by means of blackmail and murder. After killing Govan, who tried to hinder him he must clash with his son Steve seeking revenge. Spaghetti-western really unknown and of the lowest order.

title: Le sei mogli di Barbablù
actors: Totò, Isa Barzizza, Carlo Ninchi, Mario Castellani, Tino Buazzelli, Luigi Pavese
description: Antonio Esposito (Totò) is forced to marry a hag, but after the ceremony he escapes abroad. Back undercover, he is mistaken for famous detective Nick Parker who is investigating a dangerous killer who has already killed five men and kidnapped their wives. Unmasked, Totò is forced to continue in the fiction to allow the real Parker to remain in the shadows and to allow an American journalist who pretends to be his wife to lure Bluebeard.
notes: A bit dated gothic paody, with some funny gags and a nice Buazzelli as a villain.

title: The Private Life of Henry VIII
actors: Charles Laughton, Merle Oberon, Wendy Barrie, Elsa Lanchester
description: The private life of one of the best-known English monarchs, a king who changed history precisely as a result of his private wishes. Henry VIII, to marry the women he gradually fell in love with (perhaps physically eliminating those he got tired of) caused the religious schism of England.
notes: Directed and produced by Alexander Korda, the film received enthusiastic reception above all for the refinement of its settings and for Laughton's interpretation of the exuberant monarch.

title: Sei simpatiche carogne - Uno scacco tutto matto
actors: Edward G. Robinson, Adolfo Celi, Maria Grazia Buccella
description: Sir George Mc Dowell attempts a blow against a bank by replacing its employees with some doubles. The real employees, however, manage to break free and notify the police. At that point Sir George decides to make the stolen goods and instructs the doubles to do it so that when the police arrive they find everything in order. The only reason for interest at the time was Maria Grazia Buccella naked for a couple of seconds. It shouldn't have the same effect today.

title: L.A. Takedown
actors: Scott Plank, Michael Rooker, Ely Pouget, Vincent Guastaferro
description: Her name is Hanna, her first name is Vincent, she is thirty years old. Former narcotics sergeant with a bunch of undisclosed arrests, he's transferred to the homicide squad, theft and robbery branch. This big hound runs his section like clockwork, but on a bad day he finds bread for his teeth: a gang of robbers led by a boss as tough and stubborn as he is. Between the two begins a relentless duel: firefights, chases, murders, until one has to surrender to the intelligence of the other.
notes: Police for TV directed by one of the few contemporary masters of the genre, which also here proves, as far as possible, a notch above the average.

title: Sella d'argento
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Ettore Manni, Sven Valsecchi, Cinzia Monreale
description: Roy, when he was ten, killed his father's killer, a bravado in the pay of wealthy Thomas Barrett. Now that he has become an infallible gunslinger called the Silver Saddle, he would like to take revenge on the family he believes to have instigated the murder, but chance has it that he saves the life of little Thomas Barrett jr. and who, tenderly reciprocated, become attached to him. Fulci tries to revive the spaghetti-western and to be more credible chooses Giuliano Gemma as the protagonist. While not entirely failed, the film suffers from too much rhetoric and poor narrative concentration.

title: The Wild Angels
actors: Peter Fonda, Nancy Sinatra, Bruce Dern, Diane Ladd
description: Heavenly Blues (Fonda) is the leader of a gang of Wild Angels, who clash with a rival group to recover a motorcycle. The owner of the motorbike, Loser, dies and his companions, challenging the agents, decide to organize his funeral, complete with the homily of the pastor. After exhausting his forays into the universe of Allan Poe, Corman immediately puts this film in the pipeline in which the anxieties and intolerances of a group of marginalized people in perennial war with the American society of well-being and order are reflected. In the character of Peter Fonda we can already see the future "Captain America" ​​of Easy Rider.

title: Wild Is the Wind
actors: Anthony Quinn, Anna Magnani, Anthony Franciosa, Dolores Hart, Joseph Calleia
description: His wife Rossana has long since died and Gino, a rich Italian breeder, lives in Nevada with the family which also includes the young Pietro, whom he raised as a son. Determined to remarry, he takes Gioia, his sister-in-law, to the altar. But the memory of Rossana torments him, Gioia does not accept being the shadow of her sister, and gives herself to Pietro. With this remake, Cukor has transformed the modest Furia, shot in 1946 by our Alessandrini, into a broad and romantic melodrama, which is well suited to the charged interpretation of Anna Magnani and the splendid black and white by Charles Lang Jr.

title: The Wild One
actors: Marlon Brando, Mary Murphy, Lee Marvin, Robert Keith, Jay C. Flippen
description: In a quiet California town, a gang of youngsters who are addicted to drunkenness, motorcycle gymkhana and hooliganism dominate. The band is headed by Johnny (Brando) a tough (apparently) but tender heart. One day he will be unjustly accused of murder, and will be exonerated by the testimony of the local policeman. It is a film that made history, both in terms of costume (Brando's leather jacket and motorbike) and in the collective imagination. It is a film that has acted more over time than immediately, becoming the progenitor of the denunciation of a certain youthful malaise.

title: The Blackboard Jungle
actors: Glenn Ford, Anne Francis, Louis Calhern, Sidney Poitier
description: Richard Dadier is a young professor on his first assignment. The environment is hostile to him, the students insolent, violence reigns in the school and in the neighborhood. Dadier is also forced to use his fists to defend himself. Not only that: an anonymous letter arrives to his wife accusing him of having an affair with a colleague.
notes: The metropolis, youth violence in school, rock'n'roll that asserts itself as a mass phenomenon: a courageous and sincere film, which directly addresses topics usually snubbed by Hollywood cinema.

title: Sensi
actors: Monica Guerritore, Gabriele Lavia, Mimsy Farmer, Lewis Ciannelli, Gioia Scola
description: A killer, hunted down by the organization he worked for, seeks refuge with an old flame, who now runs a luxury home where even unsuspecting beautiful women prostitute themselves. Here the fugitive weaves a warm and murky relationship with one of them and little by little he begins to sense that she is the person who was in charge of killing him.
notes: Weak suspense and cheap eroticism are mixed in this "noir" of Roman setting, decadent and murky.

title: Senso
actors: Alida Valli, Farley Granger, Massimo Girotti, Heinz Moog
description: Venice, 1866. The noblewoman Livia Serpieri falls in love with the Austrian lieutenant Franz Mahler and becomes his lover. Livia's cousin, a patriot, gives the woman the funds necessary for the insurrection, but she gives them to Franz to bribe a doctor. But when she reaches her lover in Verona, he rejects her. Livia then denounces him as a deserter.
notes: Visconti reinterprets a moment in national history with a cosmopolitan eye, using the stylistic features of melodrama to describe the society that was its protagonist and spectator, with an eye to music (Verdi, Bruckner) and painting (Hayez, Fattori). Spelndide battle scenes and refined use of color (at the beginning in Italy). The film was ideally juxtaposed by critics to Fellini's "Strada", and together the two films were the definitive tombstone on Neoralism.

title: Look Who's Talking
actors: Kirstie Alley, John Travolta, George Segal, Olympia Dukakis
description: Mollie was the mistress of a married man who ditched her leaving her pregnant. She is in pain on the street and is taken to the hospital by a caring taxi driver. After the girl gives birth, the taxi driver, James, comes back to see her and helps her raise the baby. In short, she grows fond of him and the child finds a dad. The whole story is commented on by the child's voice, starting from when he was not yet born. The gimmick is funny, also because the Italian edition entrusts the voice of Paolo Villaggio to the unborn child (and then to the newborn) (in the original it is that of Bruce Willis). The director has a fairly light hand in holding the game. The protagonist is good, but Travolta is better in the role of the meddling and kind-hearted taxi driver.

title: The Searchers
actors: John Wayne, Jeffrey Hunter, Vera Miles, Natalie Wood, Dorothy Jordan
description: After the Secession War is over, Ethan returns home. He reunites with his brother, sister-in-law, their two daughters Debbie and Lucy and their adopted son Martin, of Indian descent. One day Reverend Clayton arrives at the farm with a group of settlers and convinces Ethan and Martin to join them to hunt down the cattle-raiding Indians. But while the men are away, the Comanches attack the farm, massacre the parents and kidnap the two girls. Lucy is found dead; Ethan searches for Debbie, along with Martin.
notes: Ideologically much more nuanced than the subject says (it testifies to the complexity of the character played by John Wayne), the film is fascinating both on the narrative and on the visual level, one of the most beautiful of Ford. A melancholy, cruel ballad about the passage of time and the crisis of the American myth.

title: Back Street
actors: Susan Hayward, John Gavin, Vera Miles, Virginia Grey, Charles Drake
description: Paul Saxon (Gavin), married to Lise (Miles) and father of two children, lives the great love for the fashion designer Rita (Hayward), but is unable to obtain a divorce from his wife, a corrupt woman and addicted to alcohol. When Lise finds out about the relationship she takes on Rita hard at a fashion show and causes a scandal. The subsequent discussion in the car between husband and wife has dramatic results. It is the third film version of a Fanny Hurst novel, the ugliest. Susan Hayward and the other performers are unable to revive the fortunes of the film.

title: Gentleman Jim
actors: Errol Flynn, Alan Hale, Alexis Smith, Ward Bond
description: The story of James Corbett, a late-century boxer, who reached the crown of the greatest and also the heart of a senator's daughter. The screenplay, also signed by the writer Horace McCoy, moves between comedy and pure biography. Errol Flynn skips with agility between feelings and the ring and Walsh directs with a very happy hand.

title: Without Love
actors: Spencer Tracy, Katharine Hepburn, Lucille Ball, Keenan Wynn
description: To perform some scientific experiments, Pat settles in the house of a beautiful widow, who shows interest in her studies. The two marry, but only to silence the gossips: so, at least, they believe. The actors are good and the film is fun. From a play by Philip Barry, that of "Scandal in Philadelphia".

title: Bloodsport
actors: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Donald Gibb, Leah Ayres, Norman Burton
description: Warlike spirit, Frank is a military pilot and in his spare time he cultivates martial arts under the guidance of a Japanese great master. Attracted by the annual Kumi-te challenge, a ferocious and semi-illegal specialty, he travels to Hong Kong where he defeats all opponents and wins the title.
notes: Inspired by a real character, the film keeps what it promises in terms of competitive emotions, taking advantage of the presence of the protagonist. Around us it combines a love story, a conflict with the authorities and a contour of muscle sports, violence and more.

title: Senza famiglia nullatenenti cercano affetto
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Paolo Villaggio, Agostina Belli, Rossana Di Lorenzo
description: A trip to Italy for Armando, who once worked in a circus, and for Agostino, who at thirty tries to find his mother. The comic-grotesque alchemy between Gassman and Villaggio doesn't always work.

title: Without a Clue
actors: Michael Caine, Ben Kingsley, Lysette Anthony, Nigel Davenport
description: There is a bad deal of fake pounds to be solved and Lord Smithwich brings Sherlock Holmes (Caine) into question. Except that Watson can't take it anymore and finally reveals to the press that he is the true genius of the couple. The other is actually nothing more than a mediocre actor named Reginald Kincaid. In any case, the villain of the story is always the old Moriarty who, as always, ends up defeated.
notes: Halfway between thriller and comedy, this "Without a Clue" is an enjoyable film, with a desecrating assumption and a well-orchestrated script, with a pair of unrivaled sacred monsters in contending for the scene.

title: Les fantasmes de Miss Jones
actors: Martine Goberne, Carole Levi, Victor Bevine, Shannah Hall, Chris Beach, Noel Cohen, Christina Swing, Scott Plank, Steve Gadler, Rodelle Valadi, Dan Shott
description: To hide her profession from her boyfriend, a young ring asks a friend who looks a lot like her to replace her for an appointment with certain important customers.

title: Sans mobile apparent
actors: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Dominique Sanda, Laura Antonelli, Sacha Distel
description: In Nice, a commissioner investigates three murders, apparently without motive, carried out with a sniper rifle. A friend of the policeman who knew the victims, but who revealed nothing useful, is murdered in the same way. The thread that binds the killed and that leads far away, to a troubled story of youth, is still found. The truth is not nice to know: the commissioner solves the case but, disgusted, leaves the police. From a novel by Ed McBain, the intrigue does not take your breath away but is directed with panache by Philippe Labro. Excellent interpretation of Trintignant, stubborn, introverted and lonely cop.

title: Senza pietà
actors: Carla Del Poggio, John Kitzmiller, Giulietta Masina
description: Forced to leave home for a maternity leave, which has ended badly, Angela leaves for Livorno in search of her brother. On the train she is discovered without a ticket and ends up in jail. So instead of her brother (who has since died), she meets Jerry, a black American sergeant who falls in love with her. He also knows Pier Luigi, the leader of the local underworld and because of him she becomes a prostitute. It is the first of three films that Lattuada shot with his then wife Del Poggio. Raw and desperate film, little appreciated at the time by Italian critics. Lattuada brings together neorealism, the calligraphy of certain moments and a decidedly American cut in the rhythm.

title: Midnight Ride
actors: Michael Dudikoff, Mark Hamill, Savina Gersak, Robert Mitchum
description: Kelly Markam (Savina Gersak) has a lovely husband (Michael Dudikoff), but too attached to his job as a cop. One day he takes courage in four hands, decides to leave him, takes the car and goes away. On the way he has the unfortunate idea of ??giving a lift to a guy named Justin. Justin has just come out of an asylum and is headed to another institution where Dr. Hardy resides, the only one in which he trusts. Justin is a psychopath, a serial killer, and so when our cop goes looking for them, he doesn't just do it to save his marriage, but above all to save Kelly's life. Michael Dudikoff, the star of this film, is one of the many muscle men who has just become a little known for the American Ninja series. Even looking at him closely, it is impossible to distinguish him from any Van Damme or Dolph Lundgren. Mark Hamill, on the other hand, had a minimum of notoriety if he had built it at the time of Star Wars with the role of Luke Skywalker, but after the big occasion he did not make himself noticed in other productions, so much so that he was also reduced to participate in films like this one. .

title: Rogue Cop
actors: Robert Taylor, Janet Leigh, George Raft
description: Christopher and Eddy are Irish, they are brothers and they are both policemen. The only difference is that Chris, who is older and a sergeant, is corrupt, while Eddy is honest and has no problem arresting a man from the gang Chris protected. Tense detective with a more than respectable cast (it's one of Taylor's best roles), with a more sober than expressionist cut.

title: Point Blank
actors: Lee Marvin, Angie Dickinson, Keenan Wynn
description: Reese and Walker are two former prison mates. Together again they decide to carry out a robbery against a group of gangsters. Reese, however, also plays the part of Walker who then sets out on Reese's trail with the help of a mysterious character who calls himself Yost.
notes: A dramatic, tense and cruel noir, with a great Lee Marvin in the role of the negative hero, disillusioned with life. It was the film that launched Boorman, who here adopts a fragmented style and an almost Resnais-like editing. From a novel by Richard Stark.

title: No Way Out
actors: Kevin Costner, Gene Hackman, Sean Young, Will Patton
description: There is tension in Washington between the CIA and the Secretary of Defense, David Brice (Hackman). To act as "buffer" is called Tom Farrel (Costner), a young and charming naval officer with many decorations. At a party Tom meets Susan Atwell, Brice's lover, and a relationship is born between them. During a scene of jealousy, Brice unintentionally kills the woman and then tries to put the blame on an elusive Soviet spy.
notes: Especially in the second part the action unfolds with a pounding rhythm. Based on the novel "The Big Clock" by Kenneth Fearing, the film respects the canonical rules of thrilling, conducted with a sure hand by Donaldson. The final hypothesis is not the most reassuring.

title: Separati in casa
actors: Riccardo Pazzaglia, Simona Marchini, Marina Confalone
description: For Riccardo and Carolina, who have been married for twenty years, things are no longer going as well as in the early days. Quarrels and disagreements follow one another without respite. She is petulantly always lost behind her son, while he is, over time he has become too demanding in terms of gastronomic issues and in terms of daily coexistence. The two decide to separate, but due to the housing crisis, neither of them will leave home.
notes: Insipid film built on the television fame of Pazzaglia and Marchini.

title: Separate Vacations
actors: David Naughton, Jennifer Dale, Mark Keyloun
description: Richard is a successful architect, married and father of three. Sarah, his wife, was the first woman in his life and the only one who trusted him at the time. Now the success, which Richard has achieved in a short time, makes him a "particular" target for unscrupulous women and an easy prey for forbidden fantasies. Sarah is left more and more often alone for "business" trips to Mexico, until she makes him the pair ... Apparently unscrupulous comedy, in reality obsequious to the most solid conventions. Naughton starred in John Landis' An American Werewolf in London.

title: La sepolta viva
actors: Milly Vitale, Paul Müller, Evi Maltagliati
description: In a villa in the surroundings of Naples, still Bourbon, but for a short time, the greedy count Federico kills his mother and holds the stepsister Eva imprisoned, guilty of being a fervent watter of the hero of the two worlds, as well as having fallen in love with one of the his officers. The Garibaldini, however, conquered Sicily, are preparing to land on the peninsula. They will be their victory to save the situation. In the tradition of Feuilleton, the film shows off a cumbersome intertwining, a decisive simplification of the characters in favor of the succession of the events and strong melodramatic colors, accentuated by acting. It was a success.

title: The Premature Burial
actors: Ray Milland, Hazel Court, Richard Ney, Heather Angel, Alan Napier
description: Guy Garrel (Ray Milland) is terrified of being buried alive. He marries Emily, daughter of his master, Dr. Gault, and has a coffin built for a possible spill. When Garrel finds out that his father has been buried while still alive, he suffers a seemingly deadly shock. Inspired only vaguely by Edgar Allan Poe, Corman creates a film that is typically his own: without great means, hypnotic rhythm, visionary surges accentuated by bright colors. Instead of the usual Vincent Price here is MIlland, who is doing very well.

title: Buried Alive
actors: Tim Matheson, Jennifer Jason Leigh, William Atherton
description: Clinton Goodman works and got married in New York. He returns to live with his wife Joanna in his hometown. The wife cannot stand the rural environment and becomes the doctor's lover. He ensnares her and proposes to eliminate her husband. Joanna gives her husband a poison, but the dose is not lethal ....

title: Sequestro di persona
actors: Franco Nero, Charlotte Rampling, Frank Wolff, Ennio Balbo
description: Cristina, a Roman student on vacation in Sardinia, witnesses the kidnapping of her boyfriend, Francesco, and runs to warn the police. The investigations, however, lead to nothing and so Gavino, a friend of Francesco, surrenders himself to the bandits to find out the name of their leader. A "noble" attempt to attack the problem of banditry, but the result is more about the thriller. Mingozzi, in his second film, was a promise.

title: Una sera c'incontrammo
actors: Johnny Dorelli, Fran Fullenwider, Lia Tanzi, Gabriella Giacobbe
description: Unlikely love between a commuter laborer and the fat daughter of an industrialist. She woos him with overwhelming intrusiveness, he, who works as a bricklayer, does not want to look like a social climber and shields himself as best he can. Things improve when he manages to become rich and famous as the author of a song brought to success by his obese suitor.
notes: Based on a novel by the two humorists Terzoli and Vaime, the film is meant to be a parody of "Love Story", but it fails. Actors and direction not up to par.

title: Dance 'Til Down
actors: Alyssa Milano, Tempestt Bledsoe, Brian Bloom, Tracey Gold
description: The prom of an American high school: anxieties, disappointments, parents arguing with their children and their children among themselves. But also loves, joys and other delights. And on top of it all, the election of the queen of the party. Light, almost inconsistent. In the cast we note the presence of Alyssa Milano known for having taken part with Schwarzenegger in "Commando" (she was the kidnapped girl).

title: Serenade
actors: Mario Lanza, Joan Fontaine, Vincent Price, Sarita Montiel
description: Promising tenor Damon Vincenti (Lanza) achieves success with the help of the beautiful and rich Kendall (Fontaine), with whom he falls in love. But the woman betrays him and the young man leaves San Francisco and an important opera staging in which he was about to debut. He settles in Messcio, where he finds, with true love, self-confidence. Adapted from the novel of the same name by James M. Cain, where instead the protagonist discovered his homosexuality. Lanza then sang everything, classic and light. The film, made with skill by one of the masismo directors of westerns, however, discounts the extreme conventionality of the story.

title: Serenata amara
actors: Claudio Villa, Walter Santesso, Liliana Bonfatti, Ave Ninchi
description: Mario (Villa) and Fabrizio (Santesso) are two friends, both boxers, and, just as well, they are both in love with Maria (Bonfatti). This situation makes their relations less friendly; after a long hostility, however, friendship returns to prevail.
notes: Custom built for the Reuccio of the Italian song, the film is mercilessly ugly and poorly acted. Villa succeeds better as a boxer than as an actor and that is saying something.

title: Death Before Dishonor
actors: Fred Dryer, Brian Keith, Joanna Pacula
description: A dangerous group of Islamic terrorists acts in the imaginary capital of an Arab state. When an American colonel is kidnapped, his colleagues understand that they will get nothing through official ways and decide to act alone. Crucial help comes from the beautiful Elli (Joanna Pacula), a photojournalist who turns out to be a special agent of Israeli counterintelligence. The decisive confrontation between the Americans and the Arabs takes place in the desert, with many dead on both sides. Mediocre action movie that wasn't very successful. Not even Joanna Pacula, who we remember as a replicant in Blade Runner, can't lift it.

title: Christmas in Connecticut
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, Dennis Morgan, Sidney Greenstreet
description: Elisabeth Lane, editor of "Your Home" magazine, has always praised her home and family in her articles. What his editor-in-chief doesn't know is that both are completely made up. Problems arise when her publisher begs her to host a war veteran for Christmas. Comedy of perfect professionalism but not brilliant. Remade by Schwarzenegger as a director in 1992 ("Hero for families").

title: The Last Warrior
actors: Anthony Quinn, Claude Akins, Shelley Winters, Tony Bill, Don Collier, Victor French, Susana Miranda, Victor Jory
description: Flep Eagle is a Red Indian who served in the army. Back home, he wants to do something for his people. Organize a peaceful protest to draw the government's attention to some rights provided in the old treaties, never observed. During a demonstration, Flep is killed by a mestizo policeman, but his companions will be able to continue even without him. The awakening of Indian conscience as seen by Carol Reed (Broken Idol, The Third Man): colorful description of environments and characters in a film that develops in the tones of picaresque comedy but ends in a dramatic and participatory way.

title: Il sergente Rompiglioni
actors: Franco Franchi, Francesca Romana Coluzzi, Mario Carotenuto
description: Rompiglioni instructs the recruits by mixing, with curious effects, his two great passions: discipline and classical music. When he is entrusted with the components of the "Gli Alisei" complex, the sergeant uses an iron fist. The musicians, by means of a false letter, send Rompiglioni to the Castrocaro festival. As a punishment, here is the preparation of a "Nabucco" Verdi "without instruments". Franchi sezna Ingrassia in the footsteps of Colonel Buttiglione: at its worst.

title: Sergeant York
actors: Gary Cooper, Walter Brennan, Joan Leslie, George Tobias
description: Alvin York (Cooper), a young farmer from Minnesota, fails to buy a piece of land and, disheartened, turns to alcohol, resulting in reprehensible actions. His pastor brings him back to the right path, full of mystical fervor. War propaganda film with a protagonist who is the maximum of sympathy and a director who creates a narration of calculated balance between irony and Gascon heroism.

title: The Trip
actors: Peter Fonda, Susan Strasberg, Bruce Dern, Dennis Hopper
description: Work and marriage do not work and Paul Groves (Fonda), TV director, turns to "travel" with lysergic acid. The wonderful initial visions are soon overwhelmed by nightmares, but when Paul wakes up he feels like a lion. His mistress tries to cool his enthusiasm by warning him. Vivid picture, albeit very dated, of a generational attempt to liberate consciences by chemical means, a true psychedelic cult film for the contents, for the special effects, for the screenplay by Jack Nicholson, and for a cast that supports Peter Fonda in Dennis Hopper: not surprisingly, two years later, the three key figures of Easy Rider.

title: The Serpent and the Rainbow
actors: Bill Pullman, Cathy Tyson, Zakes Mokae, Paul Winfield, Brent Jennings
description: A Harvard anthropologist goes to Haiti to study the zombie phenomenon. But he is targeted by Duvalier's sorcerer-cops: the infamous and terrible Ton Ton Macoute. Craven manages to mix horror and political nightmares: zombies are a tool of dictatorial power. The horror part is flawless, but also the metaphor on power is not trivial. The dream scenes and the "anthropological" exploration of voodoo are beautiful.

title: Le serpent
actors: Yul Brynner, Henry Fonda, Dirk Bogarde, Philippe Noiret, Michel Bouquet, Virna Lisi
description: An adviser from the Russian embassy in Paris asks for political asylum and begins to make revelations, involving unsuspected characters, about the Soviet spy network in the West. The counsel's testimonies provoke a chain of suicides, resignations and "torpedoes". An extraordinary cast for a good product that, fed with documented facts, takes you back to the incredible but true intrigues of the cold war.

title: Serpico
actors: Al Pacino, John Randolph, Jack Kemoe, Barbara Eda-Young
description: Frank Serpico is a young New York police officer. He is genuinely enthusiastic about his work, but not long in realizing the corruption that reigns among his older colleagues. Thinking it is a circumscribed phenomenon, he reports it to his superiors, collecting promises and transfers in return. Over time, Serpico realizes that he is in serious danger: death threats follow one another.
notes: Lumet, as always, narrates the American city with great wisdom. One of the films that made Al Pacino famous, who plays a long-haired and foul-mouthed "executioner" but basically pure as a Hollywood hero.

title: Sex, Lies and Videotapes
actors: James Spader, Andie MacDowell, Laura San Giacomo, Peter Gallagher
description: Graham loves to collect video interviews of women talking about their sex life. When he returns to his hometown he accepts the hospitality of a former schoolmate: a lawyer married to the beautiful Ann. Graham discovers that the friend is also the lover of Ann's uninhibited sister, Cynthia. Ann, on the other hand, soon feels drawn to the strange guest. An interesting film for the analysis of a current phenomenon: the replacement of reality with its representation, that is, the superiority of the mass media over everyday existence. Soderbergh, on his directorial debut, received favorable reviews and won the Palme d'Or at Cannes in 1989 (although not everyone agreed on the verdict). Still convincing the actors.

title: The Opposite Sex
actors: June Allyson, Dolores Gray, Joan Collins, Ann Sheridan
description: Kay, a singer, leaves the scene despite the rosy prospects for her professional future to marry Steve, a famous theater producer.
