Out of jealousy, Sylvia spreads the word that Steve has fallen in love with the ballerina Crystal. The marriage, despite Steve's attempts, falls apart. Kay then goes to Reno to get a divorce, but is disgusted by the environment in which she finds herself immersed. However, she divorces, but the story doesn't end there.
notes: With the addition of music and male characters, it is the remake of "Women", shot by Cukor in 1939 with a very different class. The fault is not even in the choice of actresses. The flaw lies precisely in the handle: script and direction.

title: Sessomatto
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Laura Antonelli, Paola Borboni, Alberto Lionello, Duilio Del Prete
description: Nine episodes inspired by sex. A waiter finds a singular way to wake his mistress. Two poor people, heedless of misery, do not stop at the fifteenth child. A street vendor can only make love in the elevator. An emigrant falls in love with a transvestite only to discover that it is his brother. A Sicilian widow marries the man who had her husband killed in revenge. Risi insists with the episodic film in the vein of the Italian comedy, but comes out of time. There are, of course, some enjoyable moments, thanks also to the performers, but the whole opera doesn't have the wit or wickedness of good times.

title: Sesto continente
description: An Italian scientific expedition goes to a mission in the Red Sea. With appropriate cutting -edge technical precautions for the time, Folco Quilici troupe documents the charm of life in the abysses of the Indian Ocean. In the reconstruction the most spectacular aspects are privileged: the risks that the divers, the unusual animals, the picturesque flora that characterizes the bottom of the sea, run.
notes: Folco Quilici was one of the inventors of a way of conceiving the documentary intended as a show. This is why he is commercial success, but critics don't like it. But the beauty of the images, undeniable, is the master.

title: Executive Suite
actors: William Holden, June Allyson, Barbara Stanwyck, Fredric March, Walter Pidgeon, Shelley Winters, Paul Douglas
description: The president of a large company suddenly dies. His five deputies struggle to take his place and forbidden blows are wasted.
notes: It is not one of the best works of Robert Wise who, despite an extraordinary cast, does not know how to make the story of a sordid competition for power in the business world exciting.

title: La setta
actors: Kelly Curtis, Herbert Lom, Mariangela Giordano, Tomas Arana
description: Myriam teaches in a Frankfurt school. One day he meets a strange old man who was injured in a car accident. The man, who behaves in an unusual way, reveals to her that he is the priest of a sect that awaits the birth of the Antichrist. Myriam is the one predestined to give birth to him. Raped by a strange animal, Myriam wakes up at midnight ... pregnant.
notes: A work of cerebral horror that is not very emotional and too self-satisfied, although it has a suggestive visual impact thanks to lights and scenographies with effect and symbolism that is only apparently banal. After _Deliria_ a step back for Soavi, but still one of the top titles of the sterile Italian horror of the 90s.

title: The Cavern
actors: Rosanna Schiaffino, Nino Castelnuovo, Larry Hagman, Peter Marshall, Brian Aherne, Hans von Borsody, Joachim Hansen, Alfredo Varelli, Renato Terra
description: World War II: Six men and a woman, enemies of each other, are trapped in a cave after a bombing. Common danger brings them together. A botched and boring war movie like few others.

title: I sette del gruppo selvaggio
actors: Femi Benussi, Gordon Mitchell, Mario Brega, Dean Strattford
description: Cooper's gang rages around the village of Stanton, and his latest brutality is the robbery of a young widow, who was then raped and killed. Sheriff Perry is upright and brave, but his action is too slow and legal for Jeff, the gunfighter's brother. The differences between the two cause the death of a friend of the sheriff and of Liz, a girl dear to Jeff. Then, the gunslinger and the lawman join forces, find the support of other men and liquidate Cooper's gang. Indigestible sequence of stereotyped scenes and situations, exploited a thousand times by a genre that in 1975, when the film (shot three years earlier) comes out, is already dead and buried.

title: Sette donne per i MacGregor
actors: David Bailey, Agatha Flory, Leo Anchoriz, George Rigaud, Anne Marie Noé
description: Gregor Mac Gregor is getting engaged to Rosita; during the party the bandit Maldonado robs Gregor and his six brothers of the gold accumulated in years of work. Without thinking for a moment, the robbed go in pursuit. Rosita, jealous, ends up as a prisoner of Maldonado who then kidnaps her betrothed. But the brothers come to the rescue, aided by the six intrepid daughters of the Irish Donovan. The Maldonado gang is exterminated.
notes: Spaghetti-western that doesn't take itself too seriously. The pace is not pressing, despite the subject; on the other hand, Franco Giraldi enriches him with a pleasant humorous vein.

title: Frauen, die durch die Hõlle gehen
directors: Sidney W. Pink, Rudolf Zehetgruber, Gianfranco Parolini
actors: Anne Baxter, Adriana Ambesi, Rossella Como, Perla Cristal, Christa Linder
description: Some ladies who escaped the massacre of a caravan try to escape through Apache territory. Poor Anne Baxter at the end of her career finds herself in a very ugly western by the fearsome Parolini.

title: I 7 fratelli Cervi
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, Lisa Gastoni, Carla Gravina, Don Backy, Renzo Montagnani
description: Approaching communist ideas in prison, Aldo Cervi convinces his numerous brothers to the anti-fascist cause. While they are busy hosting former prisoners in the house, Aldo goes to the mountains with the partisans, also bonding romantically to Lucia, an actress, a member of the underground movement. Back home, Aldo is captured with his brothers by the fascists: they will be shot.The sacrifice of the seven Cervi brothers represents one of the most dramatic episodes of the Resistance. The film traces, in long flash backs, the history of this peasant family. A film perhaps a bit didactic today but useful for not forgetting.

title: Seven Days in May
actors: Burt Lancaster, Kirk Douglas, Ava Gardner, Fredric March
description: In 1980 the US and the USSR end the Cold War. The result is a crisis in the arms industry, resulting in unemployment and social malaise. In the United States, General Scott plans a coup. Colonel Casey, for his part, warns the President of the grave danger. A quick and risky investigation into the ongoing conspiracy begins. After seven days, the secret plots are revealed and the general forced to resign. An exciting political fantasy film, which interpreted the tensions and fears that characterized the early 1960s, in full atomic fear. The film was released shortly after Kennedy's death, and this circumstance further increased its credibility.

title: The Family Jewels
actors: Jerry Lewis, Neil Hamilton, Sebastian Cabot, Donna Butterworth
description: Six crazy uncles contend for an inheritance that has as a clause the adoption of the niece. The driver will win, as the actor is always him: Jerry Lewis. Obviously, as the seven characters Lewis goes wild. The "feel-good" parts are less convincing, the maximum is, as always, in the catastrophic, demented and transforming side.

title: 7 monaci d'oro
actors: Raimondo Vianello, Magda Konopka, Aldo Fabrizi, Riccardo Billi
description: Count Raimondo hides a load of contraband cigarettes in a convent: but the bandit Lucky Marciano has the same idea with a pile of gold bars ...
notes: Comedy of misunderstandings, obvious but still fun. A beautiful part for Fabrizi, whose spirit populates well duet with the "noble" aplomb of Count Vianello.

title: Sette ore di guai
actors: Totò, Clelia Matania, Isa Barzizza, Carlo Campanini, Mario Castellani
description: Totò De Pasquale, a mediocre Roman tailor, anticipates the donations promised by his mother-in-law for the baptism of his son, but on the fateful day the baby disappears. When Totò learns of the tragic event to avoid a shock to the new mother, he borrows a newborn from his neighbor and presents it to his wife as his own. Later accompanied by two friends, he sets out in search of the missing child.
notes: Comedy of misunderstandings, based on the farce "'Na Lost Creature" by Eduardo Scarpetta, tinged with the grotesque and surreal humor of its incomparable protagonist. In the control room the couple of humorists Vittorio Metz and Marcello Marchesi.

title: Sette pistole per i Mac Gregor
actors: Robert Woods, Fernando Sancho, Agatha Flory, Manny Zarzo
description: The Mac Gregor family of Scottish origin (father, mother and seven children) lives on a farm on the border with Mexico. One day the farm is attacked by a gang of raiders. At a horse fair, the Mac Gregors come across the gang of Santillanas, perpetrators of the assault, but the corrupt sheriff arrests them. The seven manage to escape and organize a plan to take justice for themselves. The eldest of the brothers, whom the bandits have never seen, thus infiltrates the gang and manages to defeat it. Discreet spaghetti-western, fairly conventional in the packaging but easy-going and with successful touches of irony, (see the sequence of the arrival of the brothers to the sound of the bagpipes). The director Franco Giraldi is hiding under the pseudonym.

title: Sette pistole per un massacro
actors: Craig Hill, Giulia Rubini, Piero Lulli, Eduardo Fajardo, Roberto Camardiel
description: After serving a lengthy prison sentence for a murder he didn't actually commit, gunslinger Willi finds himself facing those responsible for his unfair sentence who are now plotting a robbery. Once the bandits' plans have been broken, he also regained the confidence of his fellow citizens. A product-photocopy of the inexhaustible series of inconsistent "made in Italy" westerns.

title: Seven Chances
actors: Buster Keaton, T. Roy Barnes, Ruth Dwyen
description: A dude learns that he is forced to marry within hours so as not to miss out on a large inheritance. After being rejected by seven girls, he begins to propose marriage to anyone wearing a skirt, including a mannequin and a Scottish kilt. Everything will be resolved in extremis, of course. With the speed of editing, Keaton exasperates the "chase" structure and unleashes more and more apocalyptic gags. One of his craziest films, with a chase by a wild crowd of marriageable women.

title: Sette scialli di seta gialla
actors: Anthony Steffen, Sylva Koscina, Jeannette Len, Giacomo Rossi Stuart
description: The Danish inspector Iansen is in charge of investigating the death of the wearer Paula, found dead by her colleague Elga in the changing rooms of Françoise's atelier. The people on whom the suspicions focus are Professor Peter Oliver, blind pianist abandoned by the victim, and Victor, husband of the owner of the fashion house. Victor's position is aggravated when photographs taken by Henry, an alleged cousin of Paula's, appear, portraying him in intimacy with the deceased. Things get really bad for him when Henry is found dead.
notes: Tangle with a few thrills, in the wake of the successes of the first Silver.

title: Play Dirty
actors: Michael Caine, Nigel Davenport, Nigel Green, Harry Andrews
description: A British commando in Africa made up of former criminals tries to destroy a German fuel depot. The operation succeeds, but none of the seven men get out alive. Subject remembers The Dirty Dozen, but the similarities stop there. Away from England, the old Magyar master of noir and western makes a raw, modern, no-frills film.

title: Seven Brides for Seven Brothers
actors: Jane Powell, Howard Keel, Russ Tamblyn, Jeff Richards, Tommy Rall, Ruta Kilmonis, Matt Mattox, Julie Newmeyer, Marc Platt, Nancy Kilgas, Betty Carr, Virginia Gibson
description: There are six single girls in a small town in the West. Six local woodcutters move to their "assault", but they have to deal with the young men of the city who in turn court the girls. The lumberjacks do not give up and decide to kidnap the girls, inspired by the story of the rape of the Sabines that the only woman in their house, the wife of the eldest of the brothers, told them. A sudden snowfall cuts off kidnappers and kidnappers from the world: and the girls, while teaching good manners to the lumberjacks, also begin to appreciate them. Donen has signed a cheerful, dynamic, colorful film, where the choreographic numbers (by Michael Kidd) reject the constraints of the stage to shine in the open air: for example, the sequences of the agility competition and construction in record time are very remarkable. of a house made of tree trunks. Apotheosis of movement and inventiveness.

title: The Seventh Cross
actors: Spencer Tracy, Signe Hasso, Agnes Moorehead, Hume Cronyn, Jessica Tandy
description: Seven opponents of the Nazi regime flee a concentration camp. Only one reaches his city and seeks help from an ancient flame, which, however, hunts him. He will be helped by some citizens who restore their trust in man.
notes: A Spencer Tracy at the height of fame is the protagonist of Zinnemann's third film, inspired by a novel by Anna Seghers. The film has strong suspense, good performances and Karl Freund's great photography to its credit.

title: The Seventh Sign
actors: Demi Moore, Michael Biehn, Jürgen Prochnow, John Heard
description: The signs appear one after the other and herald death and destruction: the sea is boiling around the island of Haiti, an Israeli village suffers an ice age, the rivers of Nicaragua fill with blood. In Los Angeles, the inhabitants are terrified and turn to religious and exorcists. Is it divine will or are they just the nightmares of a young pregnant woman terrified of the future? Thriller full of biblical and psychoanalytic references. Demi Moore not yet kissed by the success of "Ghost", is doing well, but the suspense is flat.

title: La settimana della sfinge
actors: Margherita Buy, Paolo Hendel, Silvio Orlando, Delia Boccardo
description: A beautiful waitress, expert in puzzles, falls in love with a playboy antenna player and follows him everywhere. However, he considers it a passing conquest and snubs it. Eventually he gives in, but then she dumps him. Pleasant and minimal, one of Luchetti's best films, around an unprecedented Adriatic Italy. Very good Margherita Buy.

title: Une semaine de vacances
actors: Nathalie Baye, Gérard Lanvin
description: The week is the one prescribed to Laurence, apparently in an inexplicable crisis with respect to her teaching job. Intimate and subdued chronicle of a reflection on the meaning of one's own existence, with a realist and poetic cinema tone of the Popular Front. The actors are very talented and well directed.

title: The Seventh Veil
actors: James Mason, Ann Todd, Herbert Lom, Hugh McDermott, Albert Lieven
description: Francesca Cunnighem (Todd), orphaned at 14, is entrusted to a tutor (Mason) who, by dominating her will, leads her to be a world-famous pianist. Twice the woman tries to free herself from this psychological yoke through love, but she fails. Healed through narcosis and hypnosis from a shock after a serious car accident, she discovers who the man she truly loves is. A classic of English cinema, which treats the abysses of the psyche with ambiguity and subtlety, with references ranging from psychoanalysis to Svengali to Pygmalion.

title: The Seventh Voyage of Sinbad
actors: Kerwin Mathews, Kathryn Grant
description: Because of a spell, Princess Parisa has become very small. Simbad tries to save her. A film of almost poetic ingenuity, full of inventions, with wonderful special effects by Ray Harryhausen.

title: La sfida
actors: Rosanna Schiaffino, José Suarez, Nino Vingelli, Decimo Cristiani, José Jaspe, Tina Castigliano, Elsa Valentino Ascoli, Pasquale Cennamo, Nello Ascoli, Salvatore Cafiero
description: Vito manages, with violence, to place his products on the fruit and vegetable market, where a powerful Camorra player is the undisputed master. To avoid harmful consequences, the two come to terms. Some time later, Vito is now rich and, trusting too much in his new condition, he makes the mistake of challenging his opponent once again.
notes: Rosi, with an American air, but still with a neo-realist sensitivity, confronts the theme of organized crime. The accurate setting and the combination of news and entertainment are already in the style of the mature Rosi.

title: La sfida dei giganti
actors: Reg Park, Luigi Barbini, Gia Sandri, Giovanni Cianfriglia
description: Ercole ran to save Xanto who is held prisoner from Gea, goddess of the earth. Taking advantage of the absence of him Anteo, son of Gea, dominates the city of Syracuse. But Hercules won't waste time. Once freed, Xanto runs to Syracuse, destroys the city and also kills Anteo. Pelplum particularly poor and without ideas. Lucidi signs Maurice Bright.

title: My Darling Clementine
actors: Henry Fonda, Victor Mature, Linda Darnell, Walter Brennan
description: Wyatt Earp (Fonda) accepts the post of Tomstone sheriff after one of his three brothers is killed. Doc Holliday (Mature), a powerful man in town, is arrested by Wyatt for the murder of James Earp, but the two become friends after Doc's (Darnell) Indian girlfriend is killed by a member of the Clanton family. In the final fight at the OK Corral, Doc Holliday is sided with Wyatt Earp and the only survivor of his brothers, against the Clantons.
notes: Milestone of cinema of all time. Ford tells a historical episode (taken from many other films), but manages to give it the epic dimension of a myth. It is already an adult western, with complex characters, an underlying sad melancholy, and a unique figurative refinement. Highlight: the piece from Shakespeare played by Mature.

title: Submarine X 1
actors: James Caan, David Sumner, Norman Bowler, Paul Young
description: For Commander Botton of the English navy, the German battleship Luthendorf has become a beast: every time his men collided with that ship they had to resign themselves to defeat. This time Botton is determined to do things right: he trains a group of specialists and only at the end of the exercises does he explain to them what the goal is. Of the three minisubmarines that leave on a mission, two will be destroyed but one, the one commanded by Botton himself, manages to hit and sink the enemy target.
notes: Mediocre warlike film that, compared to American models, favors indoor scenes to save money.

title: Ride the High Country
actors: Randolph Scott, Joel McCrea, Mariette Hartley, Ron Starr
description: Steve Judd is a former adventurer and senior sheriff charged with escorting a shipment of gold. Before leaving he meets an old friend of his, Gil Westrum, to whom he asks for help; the young Heck Longthree joins them soon after. The latter accept the assignment with the secret intention of seizing the loot on the way. Along the way, the three must defend a girl who marries a brutal man who runs away from her husband.
notes: One of Peckinpah's first masterpieces, crepuscular and tragic. Two old western stars confronted and struggling with moral dilemmas and pettiness. The wedding scene is fierce, the death of the old gunslinger who does not want to be seen by his friend is moving.

title: The Law and Jake Wade
actors: Robert Taylor, Richard Widmark, Patricia Owens, Robert Middleton
description: Jake Wade abandons Clint Hollister's gang and takes away the spoils of a bank heist. Moving to a town in New Mexico, Jake becomes its sheriff and becomes engaged to Peggy Carter, a local girl. Having learned that Clint is being held in a town close to his and that he is waiting to be hanged, he goes to him to pay off. Escaped from prison, Clint kidnaps Peggy and forces Wade to take him to the abandoned city, where he buried the treasure.
notes: From such a specialist a product of sturdy workmanship, but without particular flashes. The cast is great.

title: The Pistolero of Red River
actors: Glenn Ford, Angie Dickinson, Chad Everett, Gary Merrill, Jack Elam
description: A young man named Lot (Chad Everett) wants to prove how good he is with the pistol by taking on Sheriff Dan Blaine (Glenn Ford), a redeemed gunslinger but still an infallible marksman. Lisa (Angie Dickinson), Dan's woman, tries to prevent the fight in every way, even the dirtiest. Dan himself, who is certain of his superiority and sympathizes with the boy, cannot avoid the duel.
notes: Discreet western supported by effective interpreters starting with Glenn Ford. Direction diligent and attentive.

title: La sfinge d'oro
actors: Robert Taylor, Anita Ekberg, Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Remo De Angelis
description: An archaeologist organized an expedition to Upper Egypt to track down the tomb of Pharaoh Aposis. However, he has to deal with two adventurers who join the expedition to seize the treasure. The two manage to secure the complicity of a collaborator of the archaeologist, but in the end they will not be able to enjoy the fruit of their misdeeds.
notes: An actor on the road to sunset (Taylor), a sex symbol of the period (Ekberg) and Kim's father, Giacomo Rossi Stuart, fail to infuse life into a foregone adventure. The settings also seem fake.

title: Vu du pont
actors: Raf Vallone, Maureen Stapleton, Jean Sorel, Carol Lawrence
description: A New Yorker of Italian origin decides to denounce the lover of his niece, of whom he is very jealous, because he immigrated to the United States illegally. Unfortunately it will end in tragedy.
notes: From a famous play by Arthur Miller, an "away" film for Lumet, which is doing well despite its rigid theatrical setting. The three protagonists are excellent: the kiss given by Raf Vallone (the docker) to Jean Sorel (the nephew's boyfriend), as a sign of challenge, was the first among men to be so insisted on the screen. Naturally he did talk about himself.

title: Shaft in Africa
actors: Richard Roundtree, Vonetta McGee, Frank Finley, Neda Arneric
description: The son of an emir investigates a slave trade that takes place between Africa and France. The young man just got his hands on important clues when he is killed. His father entrusts the research and revenge to the African American detective John Shaft. He manages to board the ship that transports the poor wretches. Thanks to the help of the beautiful Jazar, Shaft arrives, among many dangers, at the heart of the organization ...
notes: Hero of blaxploitation, Shaft rises here almost to a mythical figure, making an impossible historical redemption of black people. Good idea, but management is a mediocre adventure. Last cinematic chapter before the Singleton remake.

title: Shaft
actors: Richard Roundtree, Moses Gunn, Charles Cioffi, Gwenn Mitchell
description: In Harlem, black private detective John Shaft (Roundtree) is tasked by a black crime boss, Bumpy Jonas, to find his kidnapped daughter. Shaft suspects "Lumumba", the leader of the revolutionary movement of the Black Panthers. The latter, revealed to be a stranger to the kidnapping, helps him to defeat the real perpetrators: a mafia gang.
notes: Action at a sustained and constant pace, an unusual "hero" and setting, but which never go beyond a superficial transgression, are the right formula that has made this film the success, the first of the three dedicated to investigator invented by novelist Ernest Tidyman.

title: Withnail and I
actors: Paul McGann, Richard E. Grant, Richard Griffiths
description: In London, among the many aspiring actors who are looking for a job without finding it, there are also the two friends Withnail and I (the one who tells the story). Left penniless, they move to Withnail's uncle, rich and homosexual, in the countryside. The latter undermines them, but gives up because he is convinced that the two have a bond in their turn. Back in London, they discover that a drug dealer has settled in their home. When they have decided to change their lives, one of them finally gets a part. Entertaining first work that bases its humor on a refined mockery of the myth of Shakespeare, to narrate the results of a generation. Cult film in England, less so here.

title: Shakma
actors: Christopher Atkins, Amanda Wyss, Roddy McDowall
description: Professor Sorensen has a research center and a dangerous passion for games. One evening he locks up his young researchers in the institute together with the baboon Shakma. It is a simulation game in which the boys, with Sorensen guiding them with a walkie talkie, will have to save the "princess" Kim. But it doesn't take long to realize that it's not just a game and that Shakma is serious about it.Built on a miserable budget, the Hugh Parks and Tom Logan film is a pretty amazing horror, full of action and also nastiness. The actors are all respectable, including Baboon Typhoon, in the lead role.

title: Shanghai Surprise
actors: Madonna, Sean Penn, Paul Freeman, Richard Griffiths
description: In 1937, the Japanese invade China: the lay missionary Gloria arrives in Shanghai with her colleague Faraday to recover a stolen shipment of opium and precious stones destined for noble causes; a penniless salesman hired by Gloria helps them. After an adventurous journey, the treasure is finally found and Faraday unmasked as a double agent.
notes: Without Madonna, a modest interpreter who still conveys a bit of her brash charisma, the mess would be indigestible. Penn, the pop star's husband at the time, here gives the worst proof of his career. Previously, Goddard had made a name for himself for some films shot for British TV.

title: Shanghai Express
actors: Marlene Dietrich, Clive Brook, Warner Oland, Anna May Wong
description: Shanghai Lily, a high-class prostitute, and an English officer, her former lover, travel on a train that crosses revolutionary China. Among the passengers there is also, incognito, the leader of the rebels. The convoy runs into military formations of the opposing factions; Lily and the officer end up in the hands of the rioters. The woman offers herself to the boss to save the Englishman, who finally recognizes her love.
notes: The cinema with the powerful iconography of Sternberg once again "inhabited" by the divine Marlene, who for the name alone - Shanghai Lily - should be tattooed on the heart. A dizzying cult, with an exoticism that says camp is little, and jokes to be memorized ("It took more than one man to change my name to Shanghai Lily").

title: Shango, la pistola infallibile
actors: Anthony Steffen, Eduardo Fajardo, Giusva Fioravanti
description: The infallible Shango takes the side of the peasants and immediately comes into conflict with the major southerner Droster and the bandit Martinez who govern the small village with terror. In the end he wins. Western that is remembered more than anything else for the presence of Giusva Fioravanti, one of the protagonists of the black subversion.

title: Shark - Rosso nell'oceano
actors: Michael Sopkiw, Valentine Monnier, William Berger, Dagmar Lassander
description: A giant sea monster, half octopus and half shark, wreaks havoc. An ichthyologist left to explore is killed, while the woman who accompanies him is saved by taking away a piece of the tentacle. The analysis of the monster's cells leads to a disturbing discovery: the monster is able to reproduce itself. It is in fact the result of a dangerous scientific experiment ...
notes: It's a film that clearly mimics American horror classics, but neither the special effects nor the suspense hold a candle.

title: I Don't Want to Be Born
actors: Joan Collins, Donald Pleasence, Eileen Atkins
description: Newborn Nicholas has a larger than normal build and exceptional aggression. Doctors look for the explanation in the genetic heritage of the parents, but the reason lies in the dark past of the mother and in some of her even more obscure acquaintances. Disturbing atmospheres and a bit of grand guignol in the exploits of the diabolical infant, a by-product directed by a non-brilliant specialist. The Italian title is particularly atrocious.

title: She
actors: Sandahl Bergman, Quin Kessler, David Goss, Harrison Muller jr.
description: A planetary nuclear disaster brings back the law of the strongest and upsets the usual social rules. Male superiority is overturned, figures of female leaders emerge like She, the beautiful and daring protagonist.

title: She Devil
actors: Meryl Streep, Roseanne Barr, Ed Begley jr., Linda Hunt, A Martinez
description: Bob, husband and father with an established accountant firm, falls in love with Mary, a vain and very rich writer of romance novels. The woman lives in a very luxurious fake colonial villa in which Bob settles down, ditching Ruth, his wife, and their children. Ruth, however, takes action discovering incredible (or diabolical?) Abilities restore order to everyone's life. Female comedy, self-deprecating but not too bad, with a couple of top-class actresses.

title: Sheena
actors: Tanya Roberts, Ted Wass, Donovan Scott, Trevor Thomas
description: In the heart of the African jungle, at the foot of Mount Gudi Hara in the village of Zukuru, lives the peaceful Zambuli tribe; their leader is Sheena, a mysterious white girl who has the power to make herself understood by animals. A furious tribal struggle for the throne ensues, and even the peaceful Zambuli must take up arms to save Sheena ...
notes: Guillermin must definitely be a fan of exotic atmospheres if, ten years after directing two films about King Kong, he returns to Africa to shoot this _Sheena_. This time, however, he is not doing too well, always undecided between adventurous comics and eroticism.

title: Shenandoah
actors: James Stewart, Rosemary Forsyth, Doug McClure, Katharine Ross
description: Charlie Anderson lives happily in Virginia on his ranch with his seven children. The Secession war that troubles the United States does not shake its pacifism. The war will cause deaths among the Andersons, but eventually the survivors will find each other.
notes: Despite the presence in the cast of excellent actors and the beautiful battle shots, the action directed by Victor McLaglen's son is plagued by too many slownesses, which together with an excess of rhetoric prevent the success of this classic western.

title: Sherlock Holmes in Washington
actors: Basil Rathbone, Nigel Bruce, Marjorie Lord, Henry Daniell
description: Microfilms containing valuable state documents have disappeared. We are in a time of war, and if the Nazis got hold of it, the results could be disastrous. It is called Sherlock Holmes ...
notes: The film was produced for war propaganda, so much so that it closes with a caption that invites you to buy War Coupons.

title: The scarlet Claw
actors: Basil Rathbone, Nigel Bruce, Paul Cavanagh
description: The infallible detective Sherlock Holmes (Rathbone), obviously accompanied by the loyal Dr. Watson (Bruce), finds himself having to solve the riddle of mysterious crimes that take place in a Canadian Quebec village that has the dismal name of La Morte Rouge. An elusive killer cuts the throats of anyone who ventures out of the house on foggy nights and the population lives in terror. Probably the best film in the series starring Basil Rathbone, with no major ties to Conan Doyle's stories.

title: The Seven Per Cent Solution
actors: Vanessa Redgrave, Nicol Williamson, Robert Duvall
description: Dr. Watson manages to lead Holmes to Sigmund Freud to undergo psychoanalytic therapy that will cure him of his cocaine addiction. Together with his assistant and the famous doctor, Holmes is involved in the case of an ex-dancer kidnapped and about to be given to a wealthy Oriental, as a "payment" for a debt. Ironic approach to the figure of the legendary detective. Good script, meticulous setting work, excellent interpretation. A successful film thanks to the beautiful screenplay by Nicholas Meyer.

title: The Shining
actors: Jack Nicholson, Shelley Duvall, Danny Lloyd, Scatman Crothers
description: Jack Torrance (Nicholson), to find the right isolation that will allow him to write his novel, accepts the position of winter keeper of a huge hotel in the mountains. His wife and little son Danny follow him. The latter possesses paranormal powers that allow him to see into the past and into the future.
notes: In this gloomy, claustrophobic film, Kubrick takes the horror genre head on (The Shining is based on a Stephen King novel), to bend it to his genius. Film made of ambiguous signals, where the horror is the deeper the less it can be interpreted (reality, hallucination?), The Shining moves between fairy tale and gothic tale, with memorable moments: the chats between Torrance and the ghost of the bartender, Danny who wandering around the corridors on his little bike and the final chase in the snowy labyrinth.

title: Shogun
actors: Richard Chamberlain, Toshiro Mifune, Yoko Shimada
description: Blackthorne, a talented captain of the English navy, is shipwrecked in Japan. We are in the seventeenth century and the country is divided between two contenders, each of which also represents conflicting Western interests. Toronaga, who uses the support of Blackthorne, manages, after many adventures, to get the better of him and to be named Shogun, that is the warlord. Blackthorne also makes a career, but at his side there is no longer his beloved wife, who died in combat. An unsuccessful attempt of a western version of martial arts films, in which the talent of Toshiro Mifune, interpreter of the best films, is also wasted by Kurosawa.

title: Show Boat
actors: Ava Gardner, Kathryn Grayson, Howard Keel, Joe E. Brown
description: Magnolia is the daughter of a show boat captain, one of those cruise boats on the Mississippi. The girl falls in love with Gaylord, an unrepentant gamer. They get married, but Gaylord gives his wife a lot of sorrow for her gambling addiction. But after a period of separation and the birth of a girl, the two reconcile.
notes: George Sidney is a director famous for his musical comedies and for two swashbuckling films (_The Three Musketeers_ and the splendid _Scaramouche_). In this flamboyant and transgressive musical, we find Ava Gardner, a charming Creole, who sings (but the voice is not hers) and dances with never enough talent.

title: Show Boat
actors: Irene Dunne, Allan Jones, Paul Robeson
description: A singer and the daughter of an impresario get married; he loses all his gambling money and goes off in search of work, without giving any news of himself. His wife made a career in concert café and years later her daughter also made her debut in a theater as a singer. Destiny has it that the keeper of that theater is precisely her missing husband. Whale abandons horror to devote himself, with equal talent, to the staging of a successful musical comedy (by Hammerstein and Rodgers). Phantasmagoria of musical numbers and feelings, with a teardrop ending. Remake in 1950 with Ava Gardner.

title: For Heaven's Sake
actors: Clifton Webb, Joan Bennett, Robert Cummings, Edmund Gwenn
description: Jeff Bolton, theater director, and his wife Lydia, actress, still have no children after eight years of marriage; so Item, pure spirit, is waiting to incarnate in their designated daughter. Two angels, Carlo and Arturo, are sent to earth to make the Boltons decide. Carlo gets into trouble, but Item intercedes for him and so things get better.
notes: Specialist Setaon, with a good storyline, a brilliant script and suitable actors, made a very enjoyable fantastic comedy.

title: Si può fare... amigo
actors: Bud Spencer, Jack Palance, Francisco Rabal, Renato Cestié, Dany Saval
description: Coburn (Spencer), a giant with a heart of gold, is entrusted with the care of a child and his inheritance, the Casa del Pozzo. Coburn has seduced Sonny's sister Mary, the Sonny's Girls manager who plans to kill him after a shotgun wedding. The two and the awake Girls find themselves defending the House of the Well from the bandits until the final battle, during the wedding of Mary and Coburn. Bud Spencer, two years after the second "Trinity", is already a star who can excel among actors like Jack Palance and Francisco Rabal. But the level is parochial.

title: Le petit baigneur
actors: Louis De Funès, Robert Dhéry, Colette Brosset, Franco Fabrizi
description: While "Il Merluzzetto", a boat designed by Castagnier, wins an international regatta, a similar vessel, also designed by him, collapses during launch under the weight of the champagne bottle. When a sumptuous offer arrives at the yard to build many more "Merluzzetti", the owner of the yard, who has to win the competition from the Italian Cacciapuoti, makes a false attempt to have Castagnier with him again.
notes: Some good gags alternate with moments of fatigue.

title: Siamo donne
directors: Alfredo Guarini, Gianni Franciolini, Roberto Rossellini, Luchino Visconti, Luigi Zampa
actors: Anna Amendola, Alida Valli, Ingrid Bergman, Isa Miranda, Anna Magnani
description: Prologue (by Gianni Franciolini): Alida Valli and the boyfriend of another; Alfredo Guarini: a competition for aspiring actresses; Roberto Rossellini: Ingrid Bergman and the Loiacono chicken; Luigi Zampa: Isa Miranda and motherhood sacrificed to career; Luchino Visconti: Anna Magnani is a demanding taxi driver. Zavattini's idea was to "follow" the actresses, who play themselves. The project is curious but inevitably the results are unequal, and with the value of curiosity only. The episode to remember is that of Visconti, because it records a moving performance of "How beautiful it is to make love when it is evening" by Magnani.

title: Siamo ricchi e poveri
actors: Hélène Remy, Gaby André, Giacomo Rondinella, Dante e Beniamino Maggio
description: Rino and Lucia are two lovers who live in Naples in the Piedigrotta district. Rino occasionally acts as a tour guide for numerous foreign tourists. Lucia, on the other hand, works in an ironing room. However, he received a beautiful voice as a dowry and a famous French singer, who fell in love with him, gave him great career opportunities.
notes: Film-song with some of the best Neapolitan singers of the time and accompaniment of good character actors. Among the screenwriters Domenico Rea.

title: Siamo tutti inquilini
actors: Aldo Fabrizi, Anna Maria Ferrero, Peppino De Filippo, Nino Pavese
description: Anna (Ferrero) inherited the apartment in which she served as a maid for many years. However, she does not have sufficient economic resources to maintain it so that the administrator of the condominium (Pavese) would like to take advantage of it to steal it from her: the boyfriend and the concierge of the building (Fabrizi), with a heart of gold, will help her to resolve the situation by leading the revolt of the other condominiums against the hated administrator.
notes: A vehicle for the immense deu Fabrizi and De Filippo, with the grace of Mattoli and a crowd of character actors.

title: Siamo uomini o caporali?
actors: Totò, Paolo Stoppa, Sylva Koscina, Fiorella Mari, Mara Werlen, Franca Faldini
description: In the asylum where he was locked up for observation for threatening to kill a bully, Totò Esposito exposes his theory according to which the world is divided into "men" - who work, sweat, suffer - and "corporals", who exploit work , the sweat and suffering of the former. As has always happened to him, a poor man harassed by various corporals (all played by Paolo Stoppa).
notes: Indifferent but irresistible historical ride, with Stoppa very bad antagonist and some anthology numbers.

title: The Sicilian
actors: Christopher Lambert, John Turturro, Barbara Sukowa, Giulia Boschi
description: Discovered together with Aspanu Pisciotta (Turturro) carrying stolen wheat in a coffin, Salvatore Giuliano (Lambert) shoots, kills a carabiniere and runs away. It is the beginning of a legend: in Sicily in the 1940s, Giuliano becomes the symbol of the popular revolt. A disturbing American countess (Sukowa), a Communist girlfriend (Boschi) and a mafia boss (Ackland) move around him. Giuliano would like to liberate Sicily and annex it to the United States. The boss instead wants to use it in his anti-communist propaganda and artfully provokes the massacre of Portella delle Ginestre. This is not the true story of Salvatore Giuliano, and it is true that Lambert looks more like a ski instructor than an outlaw. It is also true that telephone booths were not found on Sicilian docks in the 1940s. But there are few directors capable of building a sumptuous and persuasive show as Cimino does. Maybe this film is not at its best, but it remains very good. And then the Italian version is repudiated by the director, having cuts of half an hour.

title: Sid and Nancy
actors: Gary Oldman, Chloe Webb, David Hayman, Debby Bishop
description: On October 12, 1978, Nancy Spungen's body was found in a room of the Chelsea Hotel next to Sid Vicious, drugged and in a catatonic state. The two had met at a party a year earlier, when he was still the bassist of the Sex Pistols. The film traces the history of the musician, from his attempts to make it as a soloist after the dissolution of the punk group (failed due to drugs), to the double suicide planned with Nancy. The rhythm and the adhesion of the director are undeniable, and the performances of the high-level protagonists.

title: Siesta
actors: Ellen Barkin, Gabriel Byrne, Jodie Foster, Martin Sheen
description: In the Southern United States and under the guidance of Del, her husband and, in effect, her manager, Claire parachutes herself from the most unexpected places. One day Claire receives a letter from Augustine, her former lover, who tells her that he is married to Marie. The woman immediately leaves for Madrid to see him again, promising her husband to return after a few days. Intricate and murky atmospheres, bewildered and wasted performers, directed by video clips, ridiculous final result.

title: Il signor Max
actors: Vittorio De Sica, Assia Noris, Rubi Dalma, Umberto Melnati, Adonella
description: The double life of the newsagent Gianni, aka Max, a self-styled aristocrat. Thanks to a free ticket, Max embarks on a cruise; he is mistaken for a noble and he naturally plays along. On the ship there is also the gallant affair with a noblewoman. Quintessence of the comedies of "white phones", directed by a Camerini of unrivaled class.

title: Forty Carats
actors: Liv Ullmann, Edward Albert, Gene Kelly, Nancy Walker
description: 40-year-old beautiful, divorced and mother of a teenage girl, Ann Stanley (Ullmann) has an affair with Peter, almost twenty years younger, during a trip to Greece. But soon the two discover that there is something more. The fun of this smooth comedy is all in the reactions of Ann's young daughter and ex-husband, played by the ever-brilliant Gene Kelly. Ullmann, Bergman's muse and companion, moves quite at ease.

title: The Subject was Roses
actors: Patricia Neal, Jack Albertson, Martin Sheen, Don Saxon, Elaine Williams
description: The menage of John and Nelly, a middle-aged couple, is poisoned by misunderstandings and a barrier of pride that, over time, the two have raised against each other. The return from the war of his son Timmy only stirs up the conflict. In the struggle to win their affection, the wickedness and the scenes between the spouses multiply.
notes: Static Psychological Drama, is the debut feature by Belgian-born director Ulu Grosbard, from a Pulitzer Prize-winning play by Frank D. Gilroy adapted by himself. Excellent actors (Albertson won the Oscar as a supporting character).

title: Lady Sings the Blues
actors: Diana Ross, Billy Dee Williams, Richard Pryor, James T. Callahan, Paul Hampton, Sid Melton, Virginia Capers, Yvonne Fair, Isabel Sandford, Tracee Lyles, Ned Glass
description: Coming from a poor black family, Billie Holiday goes through a dramatic and troubled existence before becoming one of the greatest singers of jazz and blues: from Harlem's brothels and low-key nightclubs to the success of Carnegie Hall. But all too late: Billie will soon die undermined by alcohol and drugs.
notes: Accurate reconstruction of the environments and great interpretation by Diana Ross.

title: His Girl Friday
actors: Rosalind Russell, Cary Grant, Ralph Bellamy, Gene Lockhart
description: Walter Burns, a young and likeable editor of a major newspaper, divorces his wife Hilde who keeps a prestigious column in the newspaper. The woman decides to marry an insurer and for this reason she is forced to abandon her collaboration. Since Walter cares a lot about his intervention, he tries in every way to ruin the wedding.
notes: Second film version of the comedy "First Page" by Ben Hecht and Charles MacArthur, after that of Lewis Milestone of '31. Hawks turns it into a cynical comedy of the sexes by making the protagonist a woman. One of the most beautiful comedies of the period and one of the most talked about (and at the craziest speed) films in the history of cinema. Superb Russell. There will be a further Billy Wilder remake in '74.

title: La dame dans l'auto avec les lunettes et un fusil
actors: Samantha Eggar, Oliver Reed
description: Danny discovers a dead body in the car left by his boss. The clues against her accumulate alarmingly and she begins to doubt her own mental faculties, then discovers the plot. The robust thrilling unfortunately declines in the second half of the film. It's Litvak's latest film.

title: La signora della notte
actors: Serena Grandi, Fabio Sartor, Francesca Topi, Stanko Molnar
description: Simona, a young aerobic teacher, discovers the pleasures of extramarital sex, but in the end she returns to her husband. The only intent of the film is to show the abundant Serena Grandi struggling with various and fiery lovers. There is a masturbation with the barrel of a rifle.

title: La femme d'à côté
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Fanny Ardant, Henri Garcin
description: Bernard (Depardieu) and Mathilde (Ardant), both married, find themselves neighbors after having once been lovers. The two are again overwhelmed by passion and Mathilde will end up on the verge of depression. The woman then decides to kill Bernard and commit suicide. A film about love fou, but without bombast. It is a passion of everyday dimensions, yet no less terrible for this. The sentiment erupts, bringing devastation to two quiet suburban families. Ardant, who makes her debut here in Truffaut's cinema, is perhaps the first woman in her films to possess a "hot" body and bring it to the stage. Faced with a subject of burning banality, Truffaut devises a form of estrangement: it is Odile, the tennis club keeper, who makes us retrace the tragic story in flashbacks. Under simple appearances, a film of great dramatic power.

title: Midnight
actors: Claudette Colbert, Don Ameche, John Barrymore, Mary Astor
description: A penniless American dancer (Colbert) arrives in Paris and is noticed by a rich nobleman (Barrymore) who courts her in order to make his wife jealous, who betrays him. The protagonist will then settle down with the taxi driver (Ameche), who turns out to be a noble in disguise. A typical comedy of the Thirties, directed with an easy rhythm by Leisen and interpreted by a crowd of actors tested in this kind of events. Also thanks to the ferocious and overwhelming screenplay by Billy Wilder and cahrles Brackett.

title: La signora di tutti
actors: Isa Miranda, Memo Benassi, Tatjana Pavlova, Federico Benfer, Nelly Corradi
description: Gaby Doriot is a saleswoman who kills hearts and once a professor, even married, has taken his own life for her sake. Now Gaby attends the home of an industrialist, when he declares his love to her, his wife, pinned to a wheelchair, falls down the stairs and dies. The man then marries Gaby and for her he goes into debt until bankruptcy and prison. In the meantime, she becomes a movie diva. Flamboyant and intellectual melodrama by Max Ophuls who on this occasion finds himself, for the first and only time, at work in Italy. From a novel by Salvator Gotta, Ophuls makes refined and all over the top variations, forcing tones and events up to the pure visionary.

title: What A Way To Go
actors: Shirley MacLaine, Robert Mitchum, Paul Newman, Gene Kelly, Dean Martin
description: A rich lady goes to the analyst to tell him about her many failed marriages: she would have wanted a pure and poor love and instead she has always run into rich men or about to become such. Stellar cast for a not always sparkling comedy, despite the screenplay by two musical magicians like Betty Comden and Adolph Green.

title: La signora è stata violentata!
actors: Pamela Tiffin, Carlo Giuffrè, Enrico Montesano
description: Good bourgeois unwittingly start a drug party, during which the landlady is raped without recognizing the aggressor. Both she and her husband go into crisis and try to figure out who it might have been. The truth comes out slowly, and it is unexpected.
notes: Vittorio Sindoni certainly had a certain taste for excess in choosing titles. Another of his films is in fact "Italians! It is strictly forbidden to use the toilets during stops". The titles are trash, he would like to be busy but the result does not live up to his expectations.

title: La signora in nero
actors: Carlo Ninchi, Laura Redi
description: A mysterious woman dressed in black appears on the threshold of a church on a wedding day and disrupts the party. From a French comedy, an escape short film with a good Carlo Ninchi and Gandusio on his shoulder.

title: Auntie Mame
actors: Rosalind Russell, Forrest Tucker, Roger Smith, Jan Handzlik
description: On the eve of the 1929 crisis, an orphaned ten-year-old boy is entrusted to a dynamic and nonconformist aunt. A brilliant comedy, with Russell at her best and the screenplay by masters Adolph Green and Betty Comden.

title: Lady in Cement
actors: Frank Sinatra, Raquel Welch, Dan Blocker, Richard Conte
description: Private investigator Tony Rome (Sinatra), who has a great passion for scuba diving, happens to come across the corpse of a young woman evidently murdered and sunk with her feet during an excursion on a shallow seabed near the coast. imprisoned in a concrete block. A rough and rough detective story, in which Sinatra and Douglas move for the third time to the terrain of very traditional noir. Ideal sequel to "The Investigator", released the year before.

title: Mrs. Parkington
actors: Greer Garson, Walter Pidgeon, Agnes Moorehead, Gladys Cooper
description: Young Susie is not rich, but she has a big heart capable of softening even the selfishness of her husband, the wealthy Major Parkington. After the death of her first child and that of her eldest, her life becomes more difficult because of her grandchildren. Three generations long family saga with Greer Garson who knows how to impose himself in the family.

title: La signora senza camelie
actors: Lucia Bosé, Gino Cervi, Andrea Checchi, Ivan Desny, Alain Cuny
description: Clara Manni, ex-saleswoman, makes her fortune in the world of cinema. A producer falls in love with Clara: he marries her and sets up a "Joan of Arc" for her, which is a fiasco and leads him to economic ruin. After helping him by playing a commercial film, Clara runs away with a diplomat, but even this love story ends badly and the woman, to re-enter the world of cinema, has to adapt to the silly parts that they offer her. Antonioni implements a healthy lesson in cynicism by turning his careful and cruel eye on the world of cinema: his studies. A young and beautiful Lucia Bosé and a series of other extraordinarily characterized figures are lost in this mechanism.

title: Home at Seven
actors: Ralph Richardson, Margaret Leighton, Jack Hawkins
description: An employee, treasurer of a club, leads a regulated and irreproachable life. Yet for a strange amnesia he cannot remember anything of a whole day. Unfortunately, just that day a theft and murder were committed. Attached by a theatrical work (and feels), shot in fifteen days (and feels even more), the film directed by one of the major English theatrical actors of its generation It is not really an overwhelming thriller.

title: Mr. and Mrs. Smith
actors: Carole Lombard, Robert Montgomery, Gene Raymond
description: Mr and Mrs Smith, newly wed, often quarrel, but they still love each other very much. After some time they discover that, due to a bureaucratic mistake, their marriage is invalid. The husband then skillfully exploits the situation and feigns an afterthought. The bride must therefore win back the man who raises the stakes every time. A light and sophisticated Hitchcock after Rebecca's dark atmosphere. The only pure comedy directed by the director in America, with good rhythm and classy comedians.

title: Signore e signori, buona notte
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Monica Guerritore, Nino Manfredi, Mario Scaccia, Ugo Tognazzi, Paolo Villaggio
description: Mastroianni is the host of a series of television services: Gianni Agnelli, kidnapped: pay the workers; an English lesson of secret agents; a fake bomb that comes true; the suicide of a Neapolitan child who supports eight siblings; a sociologist proposes to eat poor children; four Neapolitan politicians "devour" the city; a general shoots himself in the bathroom; the exploitation of child labor, an "educational" program for children; the "character of the day" is a starving retiree; an episode of the "Disgraziometer" game (just the word). Between the tragic, the grotesque and the comic (and a little 'also the vulgar) a "complaint" that convinces or irritates. Overall, despite enjoyable and ferocious moments, a missed opportunity.

title: Clue
actors: Eileen Brennan, Tim Curry, Madeline Kahn, Christopher Lloyd, Michael McKean, Martin Mull, Lesley Ann Warren, Colleen Camp
description: Following an unusual invitation, some of the guests are gathered in a luxurious American-Gothic castle. They are all strangers to each other, but they have something in common: they are all blackmailed by the host, Mr. Boddy, who at one point shows up with bizarre gifts for each of his guests. Things go wrong when Mr. Boddy is murdered. From that moment on, the murders begin to flock. Who will be the killer? The film proposes three possible solutions ... In the subject there is the hand of John Landis and the attraction lies in the graft between cinematographic language and the procedures of the famous detective-game Cluedo. Nice Tim Curry as butler deus ex-machina, but the gimmick doesn't hold up a whole movie.

title: Signori si nasce
actors: Totò, Peppino De Filippo, Carlo Croccolo, Liana Orfei
description: The two brothers Spinelli Degli Ulivi are very different: Ottone (Totò) is a pleasure-seeker who has eaten up his estate, Pio (De Filippo) runs an ecclesiastical tailor's shop. Ottone, who needs money and asks his brother for it, passes off a variety starlet he is in love with as his daughter.
notes: The best of the film is the reconstruction of a turn-of-the-century environment. The two comedians are at the peak of their skills, supported by a Mattoli at the end of his career.

title: Le signorine dello 04
actors: Franca Valeri, Antonella Lualdi, Giovanna Ralli, Marisa Merlini, Peppino De Filippo, Tina Pica
description: "Five stories of five women who work at a state telephone switchboard. Of different ages and social status, each has desires, aspirations or secrets that move life. One, the daughter of a worker, is waiting for Prince Charming; one gets engaged with a student who had come to the brink of suicide, another runs after a rich widower trying to catch him by the ... throat, another, finally, has to endure the constant betrayals of her husband. a little sad, a little funny and a little colorless.

title: Signorinella
actors: Gino Bechi, Aroldo Tieri, Ughetto Bertucci, Antonella Lualdi, Enzo Garinei, Ave Ninchi
description: Two cronies go to a small town in Abruzzo with a stolen American car. One of them pretends to be American and is mistaken by the inhabitants for a rich fellow countryman who has made a fortune in America. Gino Bechi sings very well, Ughetto Bertucci and Aroldo Tieri give their best with Mattoli as director.

title: The Silence of the Lambs
actors: Jodie Foster, Anthony Hopkins, Scott Glenn, Anthony Heald, Kasi Lemmons, Frankie Faison, Maria Skorobogatov, Jeffrie Lane, Lawrence T. Wrentz, Lawrence A. Bonney, Roger Corman, Charles Napier, Chris Isaak, Harry Northup, Cynthia Ettinger
description: Dr. Hannibal Lecter, locked up in a criminal asylum for cannibalism, was a brilliant psychoanalyst. A young FBI recruit, Clarice Starling, on the trail of a serial killer who kills his victims to skin them, is sent to him for advice.
notes: "So, Clarice, have the lambs stopped screaming?" Now a cult: Demme teaches what it means to be seduced by absolute evil and distances itself from the literary matrix of the story by focusing on the cinematic mechanisms of suspense. Splendid interpreters. Camei by Roger Corman and George Romero.

title: Silenzio, si gira!
actors: Beniamino Gigli, Rossano Brazzi, Carlo Campanini, Mariella Lotti
description: The famous tenor Massimo Giuliani would like to win the love of Eva, a young aspiring actress. To bring her closer to him and make her fall in love, he hires her for his next film, but he soon realizes that the girl prefers another actor, younger than him. Then he goes away, hoping to mess up the production. Curious metacinematographic musical, full of hilarious numbers and populated by leading actors. A film of considerable documentary value, and almost unique in the production of the time.

title: Silhouette
actors: Faye Dunaway, David Rasche, John Terry
description: Architect Samantha Kimball lands in a remote town, one where the favorite pastime is fighting in the saloon, and takes up residence in a sinister motel. After having made a visit to the bar, where she is not well received, she returns to her apartment: from the window she sees the young waitress of the room being stabbed to death by an individual, whose silhouette she can only see. Who is the killer?
notes: A billion films have been made in this way. This, strictly speaking, could also be passable: the problem is that the director (the craftsman Schenkel of _Jamaica Cop_ and _Scacco mortale_) doesn't know how to do it and it shows.

title: Silkwood
actors: Meryl Streep, Cher, Kurt Russell, Craig T. Nelson, Fred Ward
description: Karen Silkwood works in an atomic material factory. After noting the contamination of a colleague, she is transferred to another position. Karen joins the union and begins to report irregularities occurring in the company. At work she is soon isolated and, moreover, remains contaminated. Things will get even more complicated when Karen is about to give an interview to the New York Times.
notes: Nichols refers to a news story that took place in 1974, for this denunciation of the risks associated with atomic energy and the speculations that revolve around us. But the film is remembered above all for the superlative performance of Meryl Streep.

title: Silverado
actors: Kevin Costner, Kevin Kline, Scott Glenn, Danny Glover, Marvin J. McIntyre, Jeff Goldblum, Linda Hunt, Lynn Whitfield, Rosanna Arquette, Rusty Meyers, Brian Dennehy
description: Four fellow adventurers, former prisoners but nice and generous, are headed to Silverado, in the Far West: Emmett and his brother Jake, Paden and Mal, a black man. Arriving at their destination, they find that Mal's father has been killed and his land occupied by a landowner, backed by the sheriff. In addition, Emmett's brother-in-law is also killed: there is enough to trigger the reaction of our heroes. Kasdan tries to resurrect the western in the middle of the eighties, aiming to involve the younger audience. But his film, although at times compelling, has an inevitable archaeological and melancholy background.

title: Simba
actors: Dirk Bogarde, Joseph Tomelty, Virginia McKenna, Basil Sydney, Marie Ney
description: Allan travels to Kenya to join his brother, who owns a farm. He finds him killed by the Mau-Mau rebels. In search of the culprits, between suspicions and more blood, the young Englishman plunges into the terrible reality of hatred and colonial conflict.
notes: A film of strong emotions, taken from a true story, with a capital Dirk Bogarde who is not too uncomfortable in the African trip.

title: Simon Bolivar
actors: Maximilian Schell, Rosanna Schiaffino, Francisco Rabal
description: The revolt against the rulers in Venezuela in the early nineteenth century finds its leader in Simon Bolivar. However, his dream of uniting all of Latin America into an independent state is met with much opposition. Blasetti's latest film, it's a boring big movie that looks more like a breathless TV drama.

title: César et Rosalie
actors: Romy Schneider, Yves Montand, Sami Frey, Isabelle Huppert, Umberto Orsini, Eva Maria Meineke, Hervé Sand, Bernard Le Coq
description: Divorced, Rosalie lives with César, rich and overconfident. When David reappears, the serene love of youth, she realizes she still loves him. In order not to lose her, César asks his rival to live with them. Between the two men a friendship is born from which Rosalie feels excluded, and abandons them.
notes: An original film about love, precise and tender as Claude Sautet knows how to be ("A heart in winter"), and a precise and pitiful analysis of the French petty bourgeoisie in the 1970s.

title: Sinbad and the Eye of the Tiger
actors: Patrick Wayne, Taryn Power, Jane Seymour, Caterine Munro
description: To save the heir to the throne of the caliph, transformed into a baboon by the evil sorceress Zenobia, Sinbad goes to the land of Hyperborea where, among the ice, there is the valley of the four elements that will provide the necessary energy for the enterprise. Classic so-called "family" product, now out of time when it came out (it was the year of "Star Wars"!); but perhaps for this reason it is almost tender.

title: Il sindacalista
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Isabella Biagini, Dominique Boschero, Renzo Montagnani
description: A Sicilian emigrant rebels against his boss and becomes a union leader. He thus obtains notable improvements in working conditions, but it is all in vain: the boss, in the meantime, has sold the factory.
notes: Comedy written by Castellano and Pipolo, but more serious and "political" than it might seem.

title: Sindbad the Sailor
actors: Douglas Fairbanks jr., Maureen O'Hara, Anthony Quinn
description: In search of a fabulous treasure, Sinbad competes with an emir, a wizard and a beautiful. Exotic adventures of great charm, with a good cast and beautiful photography by George Barnes.

title: The China Syndrome
actors: Jane Fonda, Michael Douglas, Jack Lemmon, James Hampton
description: Kimberly Wells (Fonda), a television reporter, and her operator Richards Adams (Douglas) are carrying out a report on the nuclear power plant in Ventana, California. It was during their visit that an accident occurred. Richards, in contravention of the provisions, films the whole event. The director of the television network, however, refuses to broadcast the film. Kimberly then contacts Jack Godell (Lemmon), the technician who conducted the operations during the accident, while Richard steals the footage. Godell, realizing the actual danger of the plant, barricades himself in the operations center by being interviewed by television.
notes: "Chinese Syndrome" is the slang for the maximum radioactive risk. Only ten days after its release, the accident occurred at the Three Miles Island power plant. Skillfully conducted by director James Bridges, it has an excellent cast of actors, including Lemmon in a dramatic role that earned him the Palme d'Or at Cannes.

title: Sing Sing
actors: Enrico Montesano, Adriano Celentano, Marina Suma, Vanessa Redgrave
description: Episode movies. Edoardo (Montesano) works as a garage owner; due to a series of misunderstandings, he takes it into his head that he is the natural son of the Queen of England and thus tries to meet the alleged parent. Second episode. Inspector Boghi (Celentano) is tasked with protecting a porn actress from the threats of a bigoted maniac intent on killing her. The two episodes are linked by a prologue: Montesano and Celentano, in striped tunic, escape from Sing Sing prison, but are killed. It is a film whose producer starts shouting at the director for killing the main actors. The two episodes are proof of how a good cinematic story is not shot. However, it is difficult to say which is the least worst. Perhaps that of Montesano, but finding Redgrave (in the role of the Queen) involved in this junk tightens the heart.

title: Buy and Cell
actors: Robert Carradine, Malcolm McDowell, Lise Cutter, Michael Winslow
description: Herbie Altman (Robert Carradine) is a petty financial genius who has been jailed on embezzlement charges. Crime he has ever committed with. From his cell in Sing Sing and with the collaboration of fellow prisoners he creates a company called Det. Corporation and starts playing on the stock market.
notes: The fact that stock market speculators are actually criminals (or vice versa) is a non-trivial starting point, but the film is all there. The fact that everything was filmed in Italy is little more than a curiosity that in any case does not change anything.

title: World for Ransom
actors: Dan Duryea, Gene Lockhart, Patric Knowles, Reginald Denny, Nigel Bruce
description: Mike, a detective living in Singapore, is in love with his friend Julien's wife, an English officer. Pushed by her to investigate her husband's mysterious commitments, she discovers that he has put himself in the service of a spy organization. Low-cost, yet well-sharpened, adventurous thriller by Aldrich's direction and hard-nosed Dan Duryea.

title: Torn Curtain
actors: Paul Newman, Julie Andrews, Lila Kedrova, David Opatoshu
description: In Cold War Europe, American physicist Armstrong goes to Copenhagen for an international congress. Here, between everyone's disbelief and the consternation of his girlfriend, he announces that he wants to go to work with scientists from beyond the curtain. The incredible turnaround, however, hides something else: Armstrong in fact wants to sneak into the nuclear sanctuaries of the East to steal their secrets for the benefit of the United States. It's not Hitchcock's best film, which by the way didn't get along very well with Paul Newman. There is suspense, especially in the hectic final sequence, but the tale is somewhat botched.

title: Mermaids
actors: Cher, Winona Ryder, Bob Hoskins, Michael Schoeffling, Christina Ricci
description: Mrs. Flax is restless and independent; in her life she accumulated 18 transfers to as many US states, two husbands disappeared into thin air and two daughters who still live with her. Charlotte, the eldest, is a teenager full of disturbances and fears; in love with Joe, the caretaker of the nearby convent, she thinks she is pregnant after a simple kiss. Things get complicated when a suitor appears for her mother and Charlotte misrepresents a kiss she gives to Joe.
notes: An all-female family comedy set in the turbulent early 1960s. The cast was good, but it would have deserved a more inspired direction.

title: Die schöne Lügnerin
actors: Romy Schneider, Jean-Claude Pascal, Charles Regnier, Helmut Lohner, Paul Guers, Hans Moser
description: During the Congress of Vienna in 1815, Sissi, the grandson of an orchestral, fell in love with Ferdinand, the secretary of the Comte de Metternich. Seen by the Tsar wearing a splendid dress, she is introduced by him to a party. Suspected of being a spy, Sissi invents extravagant stories that, unexpectedly, have a confirmation in reality and in this way she saves Austria after Napoleon's escape from the island of Elba.
notes: Sissi is Romy Schneider, but the film has nothing to do with the famous series, played by the same actress, about the historical Sissi: Elisabetta di Baviera, the beautiful and unfortunate wife of Franz Joseph.

title: Sissi, die Junge Kaiserin
actors: Romy Schneider, Karlheinz Böhm, Magda Schneider, Gustav Knuth, Josef Meinrad, Walther Reyer, Vilma Degischer
description: After the marriage with Francesco Giuseppe, Sissi is in trouble because of her behavior, not suited to the strict rules of the court. She clashes with the austere mother-in-law and decides to return to her parents in Bavaria. But her husband follows her to make peace.
notes: One of the four films on the figure of Sissi shot in Austria between 1954 and 1957.

title: Sissignore
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Maria Grazia Buccella, Gastone Moschin
description: The driver of an industrialist takes the blame for a car accident caused by the boss and agrees to go to jail in his place. Once out, he agrees to marry the boss's mistress to cover him, and returns to prison again as a figurehead for shady deals, including a phantom project for a "revolutionary" ship.
notes: The film proposes a series of situations that are more farcical than satirical interpreted by Tognazzi in a disturbing and controversial anticipation of Fantozzi's anthropology.

title: Bachelor Mother
actors: Ginger Rogers, David Niven, Charles Coburn, Elbert Coplen jr.
description: Polly Parrish, employed in the Merlin warehouses in the odor of dismissal, is given a foundling by the town's orphanage. Young Merlin also believes that Polly is a single mother. His father suspects that Merlin jr is responsible. Only Polly knows that it is not true, but in the meantime she has fallen in love with the alleged father and the final solution does not mind anyone. An immoral, funny, irresistible and full of grace film. Between Ginger Rogers who at first did not even want to participate in the film and Niven who was not yet a star, the best is undoubtedly the irascible, fat and good-natured Charles Coburn.

title: The Slams
actors: Jim Brown, Judy Pace, Roland 'Bob' Harris, Ted Cassidy
description: In a modern Los Angeles prison built for 1,200 "guests", 5,000 prisoners are crowded together. Among them is Hook, a black inmate who, before being arrested for drug trafficking, managed to secure a million and a half dollars. Helped by Iris and his friend Jackson, Hook organizes an amazing escape which, after complicated settling of scores, he manages to put in place. Unpretentious action movie, but with a good pace and even comedy touches.

title: Lo smemorato di Collegno
actors: Totò, Erminio Macario, Nino Taranto, Gisella Sofio, Yvonne Sanson
description: A veteran from the war, poor in the barrel and with a strong amnesia, barricades himself in a Vespasian thus attracting the attention of public opinion to himself. One woman thinks she recognizes in him the missing husband, another the consort who abandoned him, a thief his accomplice One by one, however, the testimonies turn out to be unfounded and so the poor man finds himself alone as a dog, indeed: only with a dog...
notes: Tattered canvas and a clear allusion to the Bruneri-Canella case. In short: one of the classic films "saved" by Totò who plays freely.

title: Lo smemorato
actors: Paola Borboni, Angelo Musco
description: Angario by his wife, the mother -in -law and his brother -in -law Boxeur, he meets an eccentric rich who mistakes him for his disappeared husband. He participates in the comedy pretending a love, and draws its maximum advantage. With the great Angelo Musco, a comedy of clear theatrical driver (a comedy by Emilio Caglieri) directed without flights from Vecchio Righelli. Cinematographic debut by Paola Borboni.

title: Whispering Smith
actors: Alan Ladd, Brenda Marshall
description: Smith returns from the West and finds that his fiancée Mary has married Sinclair, an old friend who like him works for the railways. Smith, who is tasked with defending the line from Indians and outlaws, discovers that Sinclair is the brain of a gang of raiders and tries to convince him to get back on track. The speeches are useless, the last word will be for the guns. Shot with a steady hand by Leslie Fenton, director and actor of British origin, it is a successful grafting of elements of the detective story on the western, the genres most congenial to the excellent dark handsome Alan Ladd.

title: Snack Bar Budapest
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, François Négret, Raffaella Baracchi, Philippe Léotard, Carlo Monni, Sylvie Orcier
description: An ex-lawyer disbarred from the register (Giannini), his partner Milena (Baracchi) and Molecola (Negret), a seventeen-year-old who heads a gang of thugs, are the main characters of a very intricate affair that gushes with complacency and violence. more smug displays of eroticism often hovering over actual pornography. Brass tries the grotesque-surreal, softening the erotic side; but the film (based on a novel by Marco Lodoli and Silvia Bre) is even among his worst. On the other hand, the use of color in Alessio Gelsini's photography is suggestive. Music by Zucchero.

title: Società a responsabilità molto limitata
actors: Gianni Morandi
description: An ex-boxer played and a thug meet after five years (the previous time they had seen each other in jail) and try a shot together. They steal cocaine and sell it to a nurse, but not everything goes smoothly. Gianni Morandi is a disaster as an actor, the film is terrible.

title: Society
actors: Billy Warlock, Connie Danese, Ben Slack, Evan Rickards
description: Scion of rich bourgeois, pupil of an exclusive school, Bill is haunted by horrible nightmares. They forcibly cure him with massive doses of psychotropic drugs, but the boy is not paranoid; suffers from severe distress towards his family. Fearful of being the victim of a perverse game, Bill is afraid of everyone and distrusts the people around him. In an attempt to find an explanation for his problems, he is helped by Milo and David, two of his very dear friends. Originality is not lacking in this psycho-thriller-horror that targets the golden world of Beverly Hills and translates a ruthless political metaphor into images. Certain hesitations in the direction, especially in the first part, are compensated for in the progression of the story. It all culminates in a memorable erotic cannibal orgy.

title: A Nightingale Sang in Barkley Square
actors: Richard Jordan, David Niven, Oliver Tobias, Elke Sommer
description: A convict has just come out of prison and is immediately blackmailed by people "from the environment". In this way he is forced to re-enter the circle and participate in a robbery, organized by one of the top "brains" of the mala. As is easy to predict, the company will have several drawbacks and dramatic surprises in store for him. The corrivo Thomas was an English director who ended his thirty-year career without flights with this film. In the role of the boss is Niven, flanked by the blonde Sommer, rescued from her 60s successes.

title: Soft Beds Hard Battles
actors: Peter Sellers, Lila Kedrova, Curt Jürgens, Béatrice Romand
description: In Paris, during the German occupation, a famous brothel is reopened thanks to the old friendship that binds the maîtresse Madame Grenier to a high officer of the Wermacht, and transformed by the English major Robinson into an active center of the Resistance. Thanks to the help of Madame Grenier, promoted to the rank of colonel, and her girls, Robinson eliminates dozens of German soldiers and even manages to save the city from the destruction ordered by Hitler.
notes: Farsetta is well known, but Sellers plays six characters with exceptional virtuosity, including the Führer. The scene in which the girls dress up as nuns is hilarious.

title: Kinjite: Forbidden Subjects
actors: Charles Bronson, Juan Fernandez, James Pax, Peggy Lipton
description: Lt. Crowe of Los Angeles morality deals with the kidnapping of a Japanese businessman's daughter. The main suspect is a maniac who spies on little girls on the street trying to get them into prostitution. Crowe manages to frame him, but in the meantime the young Japanese, unable to bear the humiliation, kills herself. Bronson has an enemy: age. Even now that he is no longer a kid he continues to play the usual parts of a violent cop, with less and less credibility.

title: The Dreamer of Oz
actors: John Ritter, Annette O'Toole
description: It is the evening of the "first" of the extraordinary musical film of the MGM The Wizard of Oz, who fruned the Oscar to the seventeen year old Judy Garland: a journalist interviews the widow of Frank Baum, the imaginative writer of the novel that provided the subject, and reconstructs it A portrait full of biographical notations and curiosities. Different moments of fun. A television biography of the American writer, with inserts on his fantastic world. Screenplay by Richard Matheson, but the direction does no sparks. Discreet.

title: Yume
actors: Akira Terao, Mitsuko Baisho, Martin Scorsese
description: Eight dreams of the director put into images. A curious child spies a procession of foxes in the woods. Still the same child, later, discovers that the big doll party can no longer take place because the adults have cut down all the trees in the peach orchard. Four men struggle to find their way back during a storm. A soldier in a tunnel has his way blocked by a dog. The atomic bomb has turned men into mutants. An amateur painter fascinated by Van Gogh's paintings imagines himself interviewing the artist. Finally, an old man in a village ushers in a serene funeral.
notes: Eight dreams, more allegorical than Freudian. With the simplicity and serenity of the old master (but also with the effects of INdustrial Light & Magic), Kurosawa offers a quiet testament, with moments of absolute poetry (the peach episode) and hallucinations about the future of humanity.

title: The Story of the Beach Boys: Summer Dream
actors: Bruce Greenwood, Greg Kean, Arlen Dean Snyder, Casey Sander
description: Portrait without depth of the successes and private battles of the American Pop group author-interpreter of music that has been able to merge the rock that is easy to impact with melody. Adaptation for TV based on the unauthorized biography of Steven Gaines. The screenplay, direction and cast without quality boring.

title: Sogni mostruosamente proibiti
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Janet Agren, Alessandro Haber, Paul Müller, Alida Valli
description: Paolo Coniglio, little considered by everyone for his shyness, has created a female cartoon character who represents his ideal of a woman: beautiful, adventurous, enterprising. Quite the opposite of the girlfriend, ugly and pain in the ass that he is about to marry. One day at the supermarket a girl similar to his character appears to him, who entrusts him with a microfilm before disappearing: from that moment Paolo has to face ambushes and dangers. A kind of pseudo-remake of "Forbidden Dreams" with Danny Kaye; actually Villaggio does its usual numbers in the Fracchia.

title: I sogni muoiono all'alba
directors: Indro Montanelli, Enrico Gras, Mario Craveri
actors: Lea Massari, Aroldo Tieri, Mario Feliciani, Ivo Garrani, Gianni Santuccio
description: November 1956. Budapest, Hotel Duna. Locked in a room, five Italian journalists of different political tendencies live together the last hours of the Hungarian revolution. Among them are the young Communist who goes into crisis and goes down to fight with the Hungarian revolutionaries against the Soviet invasion, the old trombone and ignorant journalist, and the elderly, detached and cultured journalist.
