notes: Montanelli behind the camera for the first and only time. The film is based on one of his texts for the theater and the result of his experience in Hungary, but curiously tends towards comics.

title: I sogni nel cassetto
actors: Lea Massari, Enrico Pagani, Lilla Brignone, Sergio Tofano
description: Lucia, chemistry student in Pavia and Mario, a young graduate in medicine, fall in love. Their problem is that her parents are against it. But Lucia and Paolo do not want to know and go to a priest to be united in marriage. Once this is done, the parents are forced to accept their union which is cheered by the birth of a beautiful baby. But Lucia dies in giving birth to the child and Paolo decides to go and live with the child with Lucia's parents.
notes: The film, which Castellani draws from his brother's affairs, ends dramatically, but the tone is nevertheless intimate-sentimental. Castellani's touch in the description of the characters and the milieu is very delicate and the film is not too dated.

title: Il sogno di Zorro
actors: Walter Chiari, Delia Scala, Vittorio Gassman, Carlo Ninchi, Umberto Aquilino
description: The young Raimundo, Zorro's nephew, is so childish, shy and fearful that, after having screwed up the possible marriage, he decides to enter the convent. On the way, however, he is involved in a fight, and thanks to a providential blow to the head, he regains all his vigor and, with this, love.
notes: Even the myth of Zorro had to pass through the caudine gallows of parody. Mario Soldati takes care of it in one of his films defined by critics as "food", from the years between the 40s and the 50s. There is no shortage of intelligent ideas, such as the desire to dismantle the mechanism of the Hollywood star Zorro.

title: One from the Heart
actors: Frederic Forrest, Teri Garr, Raul Julia, Nastassja Kinski, Lainie Kazan
description: July 4th, Independence Day, is the longest day for Hank and Franny. He knows an acrobat from a circus, she has an affair with a singer of Latin origins. Eventually they get back together. The story is a bit obvious, but Coppola's homage to classic cinema was sincere and the techniques with which he shot the film were revolutionary. It was a colossal fiasco, which sent Zoetrope, Coppola's production house, into bankruptcy. Superb photography by Storaro and great soundtrack by Toma Waits.

title: Solaris
actors: Donatas Banionis, Natalya Bondarchuk, Jüri Järvet, Anatolij Solonicyn
description: In the space station orbiting around Solaris, a mysterious planet, strange accidents happen. A famous psychologist who has come on patrol discovers that Solaris materializes all the images buried in the memory of the astronauts. Once the "evil" has been identified, the psychologist finds himself enmeshed by the alien entity so much that he finds himself (in fantasy or in reality?) Next to his wife who had been dead for years, in their very green isba immersed in the Russian countryside. From a novel by the Polish science fiction writer Stanislaw Lem a film to be read in various ways, not least the metaphor of Brezhnev's Russia. It was launched as the Soviet answer to "2001", but it is a hypnotic and mental journey (literally!), Unfortunately inexcusable in the atrocious Italian version, shortened by 50 'and with the dialogues rewritten by Dacia Maraini.

title: La soldatessa alla visita militare
actors: Edwige Fenech, Renzo Montagnani, Alvaro Vitali, Michele Gammino
description: In the military, a surprise disturbs the quiet routine of everyday life. The new doctor has arrived, and it is a beautiful woman. Everyone flirts with her or, more prosaically, spies on her while she's taking a shower. But only a handsome, slightly rebellious soldier will be able to have a relationship with her: the others have to console themselves with a group of auxiliaries who replace the doctor when she gets married. One of the many films with a fixed cast (Montagnani in the role of the dirty graduate, Vitali who takes the slaps, Gammino who plays the beautiful tenebrous) that revolve around the generous shapes of the Fenech.

title: La soldatessa alle grandi manovre
actors: Edwige Fenech, Alvaro Vitali, Renzo Montagnani, Michele Gammino
description: Eva Marini, a graduate in medicine, has the task of drawing up a secret report on the sexual behavior of the soldiers of the barracks commanded by Colonel Fiaschetta. Here, apart from the embarrassments, the jokes and the vulgarities she encounters, the valiant doctor also finds a way to help Don Pagnotta in his work in favor of a group of orphans ...
notes: Sequel (?!) Of _The soldier on the military visit_, from which she recycles ideas (?!) And situations: so much no one notices it more or less ... Cicero, acclaimed specialist in the genre, directs listlessly, and it shows. Alvaro Vitali, for his part, reconfirms himself as a "scatological poet" of the highest order.

title: Le soldatesse
actors: Mario Adorf, Anna Karina, Lea Massari, Marie Laforêt, Valeria Morriconi
description: Albania, World War II. A soldier is assigned to escort some prostitutes who have sold themselves to the Italian occupation army. During the journey some will die, others will be killed, one will become aware and join the partisans in the mountains. The military thus knows the most squalid and inhuman aspects of war.
notes: Based on the autobiographical novel of the same name by Ugo Pirro, the film casts a not so consoling and anti-rhetorical gaze on a small group of people in the drama of war. However, there are some lapses in sentimentality. He had problems with censorship.

title: Soldati 365 all'alba
actors: Claudio Amendola, Massimo Dapporto, Claudio Botosso, Alessandro Benvenuti
description: Seven boys, coming from different cities and with different cultural roots, find themselves sharing a year of naja in a barracks in Venezia Giulia. Everyone faces military life in their own way. In particular, the recruit Scanna, of decisive and rebellious temperament, clashes daily with Lieutenant Fili who wants to break the strong personality of the boy but without succeeding.
notes: Specialized at the time in comedies with Jerry Calà, Risi imposed himself on critics with this dramatic comedy starring a young cast. At times over the top and uncertain in the description of the mechanisms of the barracks, but with some nice ideas (including the silent ending on the plane).

title: Soldier Blue
actors: Candice Bergen, Peter Strauss, Donald Pleasence, John Anderson
description: Kathy, "freed" by soldiers after two years spent in a Cheyennes tribe who had kidnapped her, has learned to understand the Indians' reasons. An expedition is organized to permanently destroy the village; the mission is carried out with ferocity, despite the attempts at dialogue by the leader Lupo Piebald. A young soldier in love with Kathy refuses to follow orders and ends up in chains. Film that had a notable impact at the time, due to its openly pro-Indian position; also readable as a figurative denunciation of the war in Vietnam. But it is not among the best westerns of the period, even if the final massacre still has its impact today.

title: Soldaat van Oranje
actors: Rutger Hauer, Jeroen Krabbe, Peter Faber, Susan Penhaligon
description: It is the story of the Dutch aristocrat Erik Hazelhoff Roelfzema (Hauer), university student and aide-de-camp to the queen, who in 1940, after the German invasion, fled to England, joined the Dutch secret services and performed prodigies of heroism in the service of anti-Hitler struggle.
notes: A blockbuster in the Netherlands, the film is built with Verhoeven's distinctive sense of spectacular action, who later entered the firmament of Hollywood cinema. Everything is made more interesting by the director's sharp, disenchanted notations on five terrible years of homeland history.

title: Private Benjamin
actors: Goldie Hawn, Eileen Brennan, Armand Assante, Harry Dean Stanton
description: Rich and rather light-headed, Giulia Benjamin (Hawn), already divorced, becomes a widow shortly after her second marriage. Prostrate, she decides she no longer wants to have other sentimental experiences and for this she enlists. All sorts of things happen to her in the army, but the real test comes when Giulia meets Henri, a charming French doctor, with whom she naturally falls in love. The third marriage is looming, but on the day of the wedding some strange behaviors of the "hubby" induce Giulia to give up and return to arms. Goldie Hawn has specialized in bright roles a la Doris Day, and in this case she hits it right.

title: Soldier in the Rain
actors: Steve McQueen, Jackie Gleason, Tuesday Weld
description: On a military base, two friendly sergeants trade under the table, looking forward to a comfortable future in civilian clothes. But one of the two dies of a heart attack and the other, who seemed the most allergic to military life, extends his stop to take the place of his friend, who instead really believed in the institution ...
notes: From a novel by William Goldman, a comedy with a military setting that slips into drama: we smile and cry in a balance of tones that is not always successful. Blake Edwards produces and co-writes, but the director's hand (the same as _Blue Soldier_) is decidedly anonymous and the film can't lift.

title: The Apprenticeship of Duddy Kravitz
actors: Richard Dreyfuss, Micheline Lanctot, Randy Quaid, Denholm Elliott
description: Duddy Kravitz (Dreyfuss) wants at all costs to leave behind his modest status as a Jew in the Montreal ghetto. He begins his social ascent starting from the job of a simple waiter and joins the Catholic Ivette (Lanctot) who cannot stop him when the desire for wealth leads him to commit dishonest actions. A film by no means trivial: Oscar nomination for the subject of Mordecai Richler, intense interpretations even in the supporting roles and the triumph of a negative protagonist. Golden Bear in Berlin.

title: Easy Money
actors: Rodney Dangerfield, Joe Pesci, Geraldine Fitzgerald
description: A poor fellow belonging to the working class has a year to finally abandon all his bad habits: that of being a loser, of drinking and eating too much, of smoking. Such an undertaking is the indispensable condition for winning an extraordinary inheritance, with which he will be able to solve his problems. Discreet comedy with a slightly intrusive moral. For American couch potatoes only.

title: White Nights
actors: Mikhail Baryshnikov, Isabella Rossellini, Gregory Hines, Jerzy Skolimowski
description: The plane traveling from London to Tokyo on which a Soviet refugee dancer travels in the US is forced, from a technical problem to a forced landing in Russian territory. The dancer is thus forced to remain at home and is entrusted to an American colleague who lives in the USSR, married to a Russian. However, he will be the first to convince the couple to try to escape with him to finally reach the USA. The famous dancer Baryshnikov plays the dissident dancer; Rossellini is the wife of the American. Hackford grapples with a subject in which political discourse and personal drama, ideology and adventure intertwine. The story is conducted with a sure hand, albeit here and there with some emphasis. Director Jerzy Skolimowski plays the KGB agent.

title: Il sole anche di notte
actors: Julian Sands, Nastassja Kinski, Charlotte Gainsbourg, Patricia Millardet, Margarita Lozano, Lorenzo Perpignani
description: A young noble arrives at the court of Naples in the eighteenth century, determined to excel. When he discovers that his betrothed was the sovereign's mistress, he is shocked and becomes a monk. But even in the convent he does not give up the desire to excel: he becomes a hermit and acquires the reputation of a saint. The hermitage becomes a place of pilgrimage until, seduced by a young woman who came to ask for a miracle.
notes: The Taviani brothers reflect on mysticism, salvation and faith, adapting a sublime story by Lev Tolstoy, "Father Sergio". The film is figuratively splendid, it has some truly poetic moments, even if in general it suffers from an excess of manner.

title: Sole nudo
actors: David Brandon, Tânia Alves, Paolo Bonacelli, Girolamo Marzano, Antonio Maimone
description: Luca, a fixer in trouble, flies to Brazil to ask for help from a colleague more experienced than him. When the latter refuses, he decides to commit suicide, but an attractive girl distracts him from the idea. The rest is tourism and postcard pseudo-eroticism, animated (so to speak) by the couple's quarrels.

title: The Hight Bright Sun
actors: Dirk Bogarde, Susan Strasberg, George Chakiris
description: In Cyprus, in 1957, an American girl was a guest on the island of Cyprus for study reasons. One day she witnesses a terrorist act, but when questioned by an English officer who investigates the incident, she refuses to cooperate ...
notes: Good action movie in pure English style: elegant and effective.

title: Those She Left Behind
actors: Gary Cole, Joanna Kerns
description: A businessman's wife dies in childbirth. He will be alone with the newborn baby. Tear-wrenching, but not ignoble.

title: Good Cop, Bad Cop
actors: David Keith, Robert Hays, Stacy Keach, Pamela Anderson
description: Donna, the daughter of the mayor of Los Angeles, is found murdered. The police investigate, but the mayor does not give up and also instructs a former policeman named Mace to investigate. To help him in the search for the truth, Mace finds allies a prostitute and Donna's ex-boyfriend but finds himself against the police themselves who not only hinder his attempts, but in the end even tries to frame him. A routine detective story populated with predictable characters and twists already seen. Directing Prior, then, doesn't help distinguish this from other films. To report only the presence of Stacy Keach now fifty, but always in shape.

title: I soliti ignoti vent'anni dopo
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Vittorio Gassman, Tiberio Murgia, Clelia Rondinella
description: Tiberio (Mastroianni), Peppe (Gassman) and Ferribotte (Murgia), three of Monicelli's Soliti ignoti, throw themselves back into an illegal enterprise, with other occasional partners. It will end badly this time too and, for one of them, very badly. The film aims to be fun and at the same time bring out the regret for the good time it was. The results, however, are rather modest and do not hold up to the comparison with the 1958 film. Modest pace, not exactly irresistible gags, but a poignant beginning and a dry drama finish. Recycled music by Nino Rota.

title: Dead Reckoning
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Lizabeth Scott, Morris Carnovsky, Charles Cane
description: Rip Murdock (Bogart) investigates the death of a former fellow soldier. Thus he discovers that his friend had been convicted of the murder of the beautiful Coral's husband, who had escaped and had lost track of him by enlisting under a false name. Rip also falls in love with Coral but does not drink the lies she tells him and dramatically discovers the whole truth. An excellent noir with the most classic ingredients: a murky story of love and death, the detective sensitive to the charm of a fatal woman and Bogart in the role of the protagonist. Coral's death is sealed in the disconsolate finale with a masterful metaphorical evocation.

title: Jeanne Eagles
actors: Kim Novak, Jeff Chandler, Agnes Moorehead, Gene Lockhart
description: After her debut in the amusement park run by Sal, to whom she is romantically linked, Jeanne, a girl with a beautiful appearance and great ambitions, abandons her lover and her engagement to go first to the theater and then to the cinema. She does not hesitate, in order to break through, to steal an important role from an actress undermined by alcohol, who commits suicide. But his parable will also close in a no different way. The excellent environmental reconstruction, the convincing interpretation by Kim Novak and a valuable photograph are the strengths of this reinterpretation of the life of a famous actress of the 1920s, which presents some forcing in the development of the story.

title: Only When I Larf
actors: David Hemmings, Richard Attenborough, Alexandra Stewart, Nicholas Pennell
description: Three crooks organize a scam against an African diplomat. Then, as always, the tripping between them begins. Harmless suspense comedy.

title: The Guru
actors: Michael York, Saeed Jaffrey, Rita Tushingham, Utpal Dutt
description: An English pop star, in India to learn to play the sitar, discovers a different world. The fact that the film was shot at the time of the Beatles' "Indian crush" is just a coincidence: we are around the bitter but interesting "Indian" Ivory, well before "Heat and Dust".

title: Sombrero
actors: Ricardo Montalban, Vittorio Gassman, Cyd Charisse, Anna Maria Pierangeli
description: In Mexico, three different love stories intertwine between two neighboring and rival countries. Alessandro, a wealthy young man, falls in love with a foundling and for this he meets the hostility of his family. Then he marries a woman he doesn't love, just to have an heir, but the wedding is sterile. At the home of Alessandro's parents Lola goes to live, persecuted by a curse in which her brother, a bullfighter, dies in the arena. A night dance frees her from the spell and she can thus crown her dream of love. Extravagant Hollywood film on Mexican folklore, incredibly based on a story by Josefina Niggli, with Gassman and "Pier Angeli" on an American trip. Best of all, however, is Cyd Charisse's dance number.

title: Il sommergibile più pazzo del mondo
actors: Anna Maria Rizzoli, Bombolo, Enzo Cannavale, Saverio Vallone, Roberto Caporali, Gianni Ciardo, Giorgio Ariani
description: In a challenge between the American and Italian Navy, a fierce handful of soldiers capable of supporting the weight of the mission is chosen by a computer. By a mistake, however, at the crucial moment the most stupid, clumsy and deranged group of sailors possible is "caught". When Italian cinema wants to compete with Hollywood (The craziest plane in the world) in a humorous key, the pains begin. Especially if there are Anna Maria Rizzoli (who is a transsexual), Bombolo and Cannavale involved.

title: La sonnambula
actors: Gino Sinimberghi, Paola Bertini, Alfredo Colella, Franca Tamantini
description: Lisa is jealous of sweet Amina, in love with and betrothed to Alvino. When he realizes that his rival is sleepwalking and discovers her in the room of a foreign count who has just arrived in the village, he tries to discredit her in the eyes of his beloved. At first Amina is estranged from everyone, but then, thanks to the count, she manages to prove her innocence.
notes: Like almost all the cinematographic versions of operas of the 1950s, this one too suffers from excessive static, but it must be recognized a certain sobriety. The main interest is in Bellini's music (Rai orchestra and choir); the performers are well directed and well dubbed in singing.

title: Family Business
actors: Sean Connery, Dustin Hoffman, Matthew Broderick
description: Vito (Dustin Hoffman) lives with his father Jessie (Sean Connery) and son Adam (Matthew Broderick). Together they run a wholesale meat business. Jessie, who once had problems with the law, is persuaded by Adam to attempt a robbery in a laboratory and urges the reluctant Vito to cooperate. The theft succeeds but Adam, who got emotional, is arrested. To get him out of trouble, Vito decides to accuse himself and involve Jessie as well; at the trial the judge is particularly severe with the elderly offender. That's why Vito and Adam hate each other until Jessie dies. Only then do father and son find the ability to dialogue.
notes: Excellent acting of the three protagonists, but many clichés and slownesses in the script and in the direction.

title: Sono fotogenico
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Edwige Fenech, Massimo Boldi, Ugo Tognazzi, Vittorio Gassman
description: Antonio (Pozzetto), scion of a good Lombard middle-class family, has a dream: to become a film actor. In order to achieve his goal, he is willing to do anything and spares no expense, even risking squandering dad's wealth. He moves to Rome and begins to hang out in Cinecittà, but he soon falls prey to characters from the undergrowth who try to take advantage of his naivety to steal money from him with sailor's promises.
notes: Self-portrait of the world of cinema (Tognazzi, Gassman and Monicelli make an appearance) a little pleased. But some moments are funny and biting.

title: You Only Live Once
actors: Henry Fonda, Sylvia Sidney
description: Jailed for a crime he didn't commit, Eddie Taylor escapes and attempts to flee to Mexico with his wife.
notes: The second American film by Fritz Lang, it is one of the few love stories he has shot, but above all a desperate noir a la Bonnie and Clyde and one of the most bitter frescoes of the years of the Great Depression. Masterful the staging, unforgettable the couple of protagonists. A cornerstone.

title: Umarete wa mita keredo
actors: Tomio Aoki, Hideo Sugawara, Tatsuo Saito, Mitsuko Yoshikawa, Takeshi Sakamoto
description: Two stubborn teens organize a hunger strike against their overly subservient father with his boss in the workplace. The film that affirmed Ozu, one of the greatest directors in the history of cinema. Tragic and grotesque tones in a merciless analysis of the class structure and the bourgeoisie of Japan, with an already purified and dry style.

title: Above Us the Waves
actors: John Mills, John Gregson, Donald Sinden
description: During the Second World War, three British submarines manage to undermine the German battleship "Tirpitz", at anchor in a Norwegian fjord. The way back, however, is blocked and two of the three submarines are stopped. The crews, forced to return to the surface, are taken prisoner. All this while the mines are about to explode. Good war movie a little out of fashion with decent action sequences.

title: I sopravvissuti della città morta
actors: David Warbeck, John Steiner, Susie Sudlow, Alan Collins, Ricardo Palacios
description: Dean, an English lord passionate about archeology, goes to Turkey in search of the temple of the god Gilgamesh and the golden scepter, which according to a legend would give those who possess it the power to intervene on the fate of the world. But the evil Emir Abdullah is also interested in the precious artifact.
notes: Concentration of conventional situations of the adventurous genre, recycled (especially from the Indiana Jones saga) with skill and irony by Antonio Margheriti, alias Anthony M. Dawson. Everything is second-rate: the plot, the narrow but ingenious special effects and even the protagonist, a sort of Nicholson of the poor.

title: Les soeurs Brontë
actors: Isabelle Adjani, Marie-France Pisier, Isabelle Huppert, Pascal Greggory, Patrick Magee, Hélène Surgere, Roland Bertin, Alice Sapritch, Xavier Depraz, Adrian Brine, Julian Curry, Renee Goddard, Jean Sorel
description: In Victorian England live Emily, Charlotte and Anne Brontë, daughters of a widowed Anglican pastor. All three show a marked vocation for literature from an early age. Although little inclined to worldly life, they show themselves attentive to the literary novelties of the European continent, especially to Romanticism. Téchiné has not yet found his way as a director, but he directs a team of thrilling actresses.

title: Le sorelle Materassi
actors: Irma Gramatica, Emma Gramatica, Massimo Serato, Paola Borboni, Olga Solbelli
description: Two elderly sisters live in Florence. But an exuberant and casual grandson bursts into their house. The two women are squeezed and humiliated. Based on a novel by Palazzeschi, the film is based on the interpretation of two well-known theater actresses, sisters also in life: Emma and Irma Gramatica. The acting of the two is very dated, but the staging is of supreme elegance.

title: Schwestern oder die Balance des Glücks
actors: Jutta Lampe, Gudrun Gabriel, Jessica Früh, Konstantin Wecker
description: Maria works as a secretary for a large company, she is satisfied with her job and has no financial problems. Anna, his sister, seems to have not yet found her place in life; Maria pays her to attend a biology course to make her independent, but things get complicated when Maurice, the son of Maria's boss, enters the scene and courts his older sister. Driven by jealousy, Anna kills herself. Non-trivial psychological drama, from the period in which Von Trotta was an exponent of a rigid and leaden female cinema. The themes of this film were taken up by the director in 1988 with Fear and love.

title: Frogs
actors: Ray Milland, Joan Van Ark, Sam Elliott, Adam Roarke, Judy Pace
description: A guest in the villa of the Crockett, powerful farmers in the South, Pickett, a young environmental journalist, discovers that the fortunes built by the tyrannical patriarch Jason rest on the insane spread of poisonous substances in the environment. It's too late to avoid disaster: nature rebels with a monstrous invasion of frogs ...
notes: "So bad that for many it is already a cult" says the Mereghetti dictionary. Amateur direction, absurd dialogues, characters thrown into disarray and all kinds of animals in the foreground to increase their threat. A real fun for lovers of the _eco vengeance_ trend (nature that rebels), but a real cinematic environmental disaster.

title: Stakeout
actors: Richard Dreyfuss, Emilio Estevez, Madeleine Stowe, Aidan Quinn
description: Seattle police inspectors Chris Lecce (Dreyfuss) and Bill Reimers (Estevez) must guard the home of Mary McGuire (Stowe), a waitress who guards the stolen stick of the escaped Stick. But Chris falls in love with the beautiful Mary. Badham (Wargames, Blue Thunder) skillfully maneuvers his pawns on the three contemporary tables of the frenetic action detective, comedy, sentimental story, with the valid help of actors who are at the game.

title: Black Belt
actors: Don 'The Dragon' Wilson, Deirdre Imershein, Matthias Hues
description: Jack Dillon is a policeman who went on his own. Rock star Shanna contacts him to act as her bodyguard; Jack quickly discovers that the task is rather complicated: there is Shanna's former agent who has decided to take revenge by taking her out and there is a serial killer by the angelic name of John Sweet who continues to send her death messages. Sweet, by the way, is the son of a former rock star traumatized in his youth by his mother's uninhibited sexual mores. Jack Dillon, a kickboxing expert, kills rivals and makes the singer fall in love with himself. Ugly In America, they call things like exploitation and they work like this: you take the subject of a probably successful film in the works and hastily assemble a similar story so that it comes out before the most important film. This is the "poor" version of Bodyguard.

title: Lock Up
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Donald Sutherland, Darlanne Fluegel, Sonny Landham, Tom Sizemore, John Amos, Frank McRae, William Allen Young, Larry Romano, Jordan Lund
description: Drumgoole is the director of the prison where Frank Leone is being held, who has almost reached the end of his sentence. Drumgoole has a terrible hatred for Leone that has ruined his career for a previous escape. The official pits against Leone the worst subjects in the penitentiary and uses the most barbaric methods to induce him to try to escape again and thus have the right to kill him.
notes: The context changes, the frame changes, but the essence of Stallone's "heroic" films remains substantially unchanged. Only for prison-movie fans.

title: Sotto a chi tocca!
actors: Dean Reed, Pedro Sanchez
description: Young acrobat overthrows a tyrant and hopes for the people's ovation, but is bitterly disappointed. Semi-serious parable, but not funny. Adventures and slaps in the Italian style, in a very low film directed under a pseudonym by Gianfranco Parolini.

title: Talons of the Eagle
actors: Jalal Merhi, Billy Blanks, James Hong, Priscilla Barnes
description: Two agents of the Goddess have been killed and two of their colleagues are in charge of the investigation. La Dea is the official agency of the United States set up specifically to counter the increasingly rampant drug trafficking and it is precisely against a drug kingpin that the two find themselves fighting. With muscle and karate, our two heroes manage to sneak into the criminal organization. But they will find that, in order to overcome their true enemy, they will have to go as far as Hong Kong. One of the two protagonists, Jalal Merhi, a true specialist in films of this genre, is also the producer. And this is the only way for him to be able to approach a set and participate in the making of a film. Michael Kennedy, on the other hand, was chosen directly from the telephone directory.

title: Back in Action
actors: Roddy Piper, Billy Blanks
description: Two Los Angeles agents are involved in the fight against drug trafficking. One falls under the blows of criminals; the other, intent on avenging him, meets on his way a martial arts expert who is part of the Special Force. He is on the trail of his sister, perhaps involved in traffic. The policeman also has a sister, an enterprising journalist. The gangsters kidnap the two women ... Usual clichés as a pretext for exhibiting pirouettes and more or less forbidden shots. The protagonists of these entertainment products are programmed to churn out two facial expressions and four gestures, four, possibly aggressive.

title: Sotto il segno dello scorpione
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, Lucia Bosé, Giulio Brogi, Piera Degli Esposti, Alessandro Haber
description: In an unspecified period of antiquity, a group of men escaped the volcanic eruption that destroyed their island and landed on a nearby island. At first accepted by the inhabitants, they are then imprisoned. With a stratagem they free and kidnap the women of their jailers, with whom they will found a new civilization on the continent. A mythological reconstruction of the birth of a society, the film claims the merit of the great changes in the history of mankind to the revolutionary determination. But the film is today almost unwatchable in its metaphorical anxiety and in its cumbersome experimentalism.

title: The Lawless Breed
actors: Rock Hudson, Julie Adams
description: Rock Hudson is a gunslinger accused of murder; however, he acted in self-defense and is about to turn himself in when he is involved in another shooting in which he kills a sheriff. He escapes with a woman, makes him lose track and becomes a farmer, but the past chases him and he is soon tracked down. He ends up in prison. After several years he leaves and returns home where his wife and grown-up son are waiting for him.
notes: Despite the complicated story, the film stands out for a robust narrative vein.

title: Sotto il vestito niente
actors: Renée Simonsen, Nicole Perrin, Donald Pleasence, Tom Schanley
description: Brother and sister, twins, have some kind of telepathic communication. When she is murdered in Milan, he warns him in the distant United States. So he comes to Italy to find the culprit. She was a supermodel and the crime took place in the beautiful world of fashion shows and designers. The hunt for (or the) culprit becomes in turn a struggle to survive.
notes: The subject is vaguely taken up by the news (the D'Amelio and Terry Broome crime), the staging little more than a pretext to enter with a voyeuristic eye behind the scenes of the ateliers. It was quite successful, but the Argentinian storyline and video clip style are laughable.

title: Sotto il vestito niente II
actors: François Eric Gendron, Florence Guérin, Randi Ingerman, Helena Jesus
description: A model, Sylvia, is raped by a powerful businessman with the complicity of some colleagues and their manager and then killed. After her, the other people present in the rape mysteriously lose their lives; the suspicions fall on Melanie, who replaces Sylvia and also seems to inherit the attentions from the director David. In an environment whose rendering is entrusted solely to the scenography and to a purely advertising style, boredom is not avoided even by the parade of glossy beauties.

title: Under The Volcano
actors: Albert Finney, Jacqueline Bisset, Anthony Andrews, Katy Jurado, Ignacio Lòpez Tarso
description: Former British consul in Cuernavaca in Mexico, Geoffrey Firmin scandalizes good society by drowning in alcohol the memory of Yvonne, the wife who left him. Injured, when she tries to reconcile he rejects her and blames her for the relationship with her stepbrother Hugh. Then he locks himself up, drunk, in a brothel. Here he is mocked, robbed and slaughtered, and even Yvonne, who has caught up with him, dies from a horse's kick. Buñuel and Losey had already thought of adapting Lowry's magmatic novel of the same name: Huston overcomes the difficulties by focusing on the plot and the unsuccessful drift of the characters, cornerstones of his vigorous style. Grande Finney, photograph by the Bunuelian Figueroa.

title: Under the Yum Yum Tree
actors: Jack Lemmon, Carol Lynley, Dean Jones, Imogene Coca, Edie Adams
description: A cute and romantic girl convinces her boyfriend Dave to move in with her by the sea. The two, however, make an agreement: their coexistence will only be platonic. The landlord tries to seduce Robin after making her fight with her boyfriend. In the end, Aunt Irene intervenes.
notes: An enjoyable comedy with a satyr Lemmon in better shape than ever. Swift had directed a couple of plays for Dieney, and in the cast of the film is a Disney icon like Dean Jones.

title: Deadlock
actors: Rutger Hauer, Mimi Rogers, Joan Chen, Stephen Tobolowsky, James Remar
description: A violent and indomitable criminal is locked up in a futuristic prison (sarcastically called Holiday Village), who constantly thinks about escaping. Which will be difficult, as each prisoner has a well-welded explosive around his neck that blows his head off if he tries to get away beyond a certain distance. Of course he manages to escape, but that damn collar continues to haunt him. Combining prison and science fiction, Teague tells a story full of deaths, escapes, explosions, with sadistic warders and corrupt directors that Rutger Hauer proudly stands up to. Watchable.

title: Shocker
actors: Mitch Pileggi, Michael Murphy, Peter Berg, Jessica Craven, Camille Cooper
description: In a small town in the American province, a serial killer is arrested and sentenced. But the discharges of the electric chair, instead of killing him, download the ferocious killer in the television frequencies. From the inventor of the "mythical" Freddy Krueger another step forward in the escalation of horror. Less compact and brilliant than "Nightmare", but with an equally acute and "sociological" basic idea.

title: Moving Target
actors: Jason Bateman, John Glover, Tom Skerritt, Jack Wagner
description: Toby Kellog is seventeen when he leaves for a summer camp. On his return he has only a few more weeks, but he no longer has a family. The problem is that his father became an important witness in the trial of a Mafia boss and so the whole family was put into a protection program by the FBI. The only one they haven't been able to track down in time is poor Toby.
notes: The Italian title is misleading because Toby, unlike his family, has no protection, indeed he is a moving target (this is the original title). Jason Bateman is a small TV star.

title: Sottozero
actors: Jerry Calà, Angelo Infanti, Antonella Interlenghi, Annie Papa
description: A mechanic from Veneto would like to buy the bar in front of his house and, to earn the necessary money, he goes to work in Norway, on the oil rigs of the North Sea. The pay is more than good, but the nostalgia is great. He will make friends with the man who put the horns on him in Italy.
notes: The unusual setting is the most interesting feature of the film. Apart from this, the story holds up, but without departing from the modules of our local comedy of limited incisiveness.

title: La spacconata
actors: Robert Wood, Franca Gonella
description: A gold digger with a dependent child fights and wins against the boss of a small town on the Canadian border. Unwatchable.

title: The Hustler
actors: Paul Newman, Piper Laurie, Jackie Gleason, George C. Scott
description: Eddie is a young and ambitious pool player. He manages to challenge the great Minnesota Fats, but loses. A long and not very honorable training in the betting business is required before the challenge can be renewed. This choice, however, leads him to neglect Sara's feelings. After finally beating "the best", Eddie realizes how low he has fallen to achieve his goal.
notes: Rossen puts all his skill into describing the smoky and tense environment of the pool halls, with the complicity of Eugen Schüfftan's photography: an extraordinary black and white cinemascope, awarded with an Oscar.

title: Lifeforce
actors: Steve Railsback, Peter Firth, Frank Finlay, Mathilda May
description: In deep space a terrestrial spaceship found three humanoids perfectly preserved in crystal coffins; among them a beautiful girl. They bring them back to earth and awaken them from hibernation, but these turn out to be invincible monsters, absorbing the life energy of their victims. Scientist Carlsen is tasked by the government to end the massacre; the man bravely faces the enterprise, but a relationship is established between him and the beautiful alien, which could be of love. The sexy alien is perhaps the most interesting thing in a film without great original gimmicks, directed by a director who is brilliant elsewhere.

title: The Golden Blade
actors: Rock Hudson, Piper Laurie, George Macready
description: Arun, a young man from Basra, goes to Baghdad to find out who killed his father. The only clue in his possession is a medallion taken from the killers. In the fabulous city he meets Kailusa, the caliph's daughter, who falls in love with him. In Baghdad, Arun then comes into possession of a fairy sword that gives great powers to its owner. Kailusa then announces a tournament, with her hand up for grabs, confident that Arun will win, but the evil son of a minister steals his sword just before the tournament begins ...
notes: Conventional adventure film made in a papier-mâché setting. Kitsch is fun.

title: La spada e la croce
actors: Yvonne De Carlo, Jorge Mistral, Massimo Serato, Rossana Podestà
description: In Pontius Pilate's Palestine, Maria di Magdala (De Carlo) is disputed between the Roman Caio Marcello (Mistral) and the indigenous Anan (Serato). Struck by the preaching of Christ, the Magdalene repents and tries in vain to save him. He will be present at the Crucifixion. Characters and situations from the Gospels as a pretext for a rather heavy peplum.

title: The Magic Sword
actors: Basil Rathbone, Anne Helm, Gary Lockwood
description: The evil wizard Lodak (Rathbone) has kidnapped Princess Elena and plans to feed her to a hideous two-headed dragon. To save the girl, Giorgio rushes, helped by six knights and a magical armor that his mother, the witch Sibilia, has given him. After seven dangerous tests, Giorgio frees the princess and marries her: special low-cost effects for a film that is not perfectly successful.

title: Sword in the Stone
description: Walt Disney interprets the Celtic saga of Arthur and tells us about the relationship between the Wizard Merlin and the little Arthur, called Semola, a scullery boy at the castle of an English Lord, but of royal blood and destined to reign over all of England. To learn the virtues necessary for his future mission, Arthur is transformed by Merlin first into a fish, then into a squirrel and finally into a sparrow. But the evil Maga Magò gets in the way. The cunning and knowledge of good Merlin will take care of defeating the perfidious Magò: Arthur will be able to extract the magical sword from the stone, thus becoming King of England.
notes: All about Arthur's apprenticeship to become king and his relationship with the good Merlin, the film avoids any roughness he might encounter when talking about knights, duels and struggles for power. Great moment is the magic duel between Merlin and Magò.

title: La spada normanna
actors: Mark Damon, Luis Davila, Krista Nell, Manolo Zarzo, Linda Sini
description: In the year 1000, on the death of King Henry, Stephen Cunningam took the crown of England and Scotland by force. Ten years later, the young Norman Ivanhoe, returning from the Holy Land, is imprisoned for his opposition to the usurper. An absolutely mediocre film in terms of reconstruction, script and interpretation.

title: Spaghetti a mezzanotte
actors: Lino Banfi, Barbara Bouchet, Teo Teocoli, Alida Chelli, Pippo Santonastaso
description: Savino Lagrasta is a lawyer obsessed with two things: the diets that his wife imposes on him and the menage with his lover. His wife Celeste also has a lover. To celebrate her husband's birthday, Celeste throws a party in their mansion, during which a mysterious individual is killed. Savino thinks he killed him but then the riddle is solved and we celebrate with a spaghetti meal.
notes: Banfi has always been an advocate of the "pochade" of French origin, but he almost never had the opportunity to play a role that went further than the cuckold husband or the ravaged lover. Not even here, but the film is not to be thrown away.

title: Strapless
actors: Blair Brown, Bridget Fonda, Bruno Ganz, Alan Howard
description: Dr. Lilian Hempell (Brown), all work and seriousness, terribly complicates her life when she surrenders to the court of the charming Raymond Forben (Ganz) and marries him. Amy (Fonda), her younger sister, leads a much more unruly life, but she will teach her the acceptance of her own destiny.
notes: Third film by David Hare, also playwright and theater director, who wrote and directed a highly dramatic story (entrusting its interpretation to excellent actors): amid remorse, regret and errors, it presents an "indelicate" truth, without consoling concessions, of robust impact and highly effective.

title: Shoot the Moon
actors: Diane Keaton, Albert Finney, Karen Allen, Peter Weller
description: Story of George and Faith Dunlop's Marital Crisis. He has a lover and she knows it. Complicating matters are four daughters, the eldest of whom unsuccessfully tries to reconcile their parents. Thrown out of his house, George tries to make peace with his wife, but in the meantime she has found another man ...
notes: In family dramas, Parker is definitely not at ease, and he exaggerates with tones. Good actors.

title: Spara forte, più forte... non capisco!
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Eduardo De Filippo, Raquel Welch
description: A Neapolitan sculptor, his vanished uncle who expresses himself only by means of fireworks and a beautiful prostitute are the protagonists of this surreal story set in Naples with the disappearance of people (never disappeared), reappearances and other similar things.
notes: Eduardo directs and interprets, but, like other times, cinema is ungrateful to him. Funny only at times, the film is based on the Edwardian comedy "Voices from the inside".

title: Spara, Gringo, spara
actors: Brian Kelly, Fabrizio Moroni, Keenan Wynn, Erika Blanc, Rik Battaglia
description: In order to escape conviction for murder, Stark succumbs to the blackmail of a landowner and sets out in search of his son, David.
notes: Bruno Corbucci in the western is not up to his brother Sergio, also because the budget is really from the C series.

title: A Shot in the Dark
actors: Peter Sellers, Elke Sommer, Herbert Lom, George Sanders
description: A murder has been committed in the villa of the wealthy Monsieur Ballon: Inspector Clouseau is in charge of the investigation. All suspicions spill over to the beautiful waitress, but Clouseau, falling in love with her, refuses to consider her guilty: the story (of the film) will prove him right. "Maria is beautiful, and therefore innocent", on these criminological bases the most hilarious inspector of all screens builds his acquittal system. But the only one to be continuously arrested will be him. Parody (naughty) of the yellow Agatha Christie, the film contains numerous anthology sequences, to remember the "historical" one of the nudist camp.

title: Spartacus
actors: Kirk Douglas, Laurence Olivier, Jean Simmons, Charles Laughton
description: The gladiator Spartacus leads a slave revolt which Rome faces by sending a military contingent. The rebels, however, defeat the legionaries and then head south. Having failed to obtain the necessary ships to escape from some Arab pirates, Spartacus decides to besiege Rome. But the war against Crassus will be a defeat. Spartacus, after having to kill his friend Antoninus in combat, is crucified with thousands of other slaves.
notes: Kubrick replaced Anthony Mann at the behest of lead producer Kirk Douglas. Screenplay by Dalton Trumbo. One of the highest achievements of the historical film of a Roman environment, although one of Kubrick's least personal. 4 Oscars: to Ustinov supporting actor, photography, set design and costumes. A restored version has recently come out with some missing scenes.

title: Lured
actors: George Sanders, Lucille Ball, Charles Coburn, Boris Karloff
description: Seven girls, lured into a trap by fake classifieds, have mysteriously disappeared; each time the disappearance was announced to the police by an anonymous poem. Investigators use the friend of one of the alleged victims as bait; she falls in love with the suspect number one, a young night club owner, in whose house she finds the photograph of her friend of whom there is no trace. As Sirk is named, one immediately thinks of mélo (Like the leaves in the wind), but this great director has also signed notable thrillers. Among these, Lo sparrowhawk of London occupies a front row seat. The cast is remarkable, the atmosphere enveloping.

title: Little Fauss and Big Halsey
actors: Michael J. Pollard, Robert Redford, Lauren Hutton
description: Little Fauss wants to be a car racer. Subjugated by the overwhelming personality of the biker Big Halsey, he agrees to follow him as a mechanic. He soon realizes that he is a presumptuous cynic, moreover incorrect in racing. He finally leaves him, to become a runner himself; he is the true champion and is on his way to a great career, while a premature sunset arrives for Big. In the restless and rough spirit of the American cinema of those years, an intelligent film about the world of motorcycling. Its protagonists express opposing aspects of the same dissatisfaction. Redford is young, Pollard is good, Hutton is beautiful.

title: La lune dans le caniveau
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Nastassja Kinski, Victoria Abril
description: In the slums of the port of Marseille, Gerard is in a perennial and desperate search for the man who raped and killed his sister. Loretta, beautiful and rich, wanders around with her Ferrari, in love with the rough Gerard. He is attracted by the idea of ​​marrying her, but Bella, his woman, mad with jealousy, hires a cheap killer to kill him. The murder fails but Gerard forgives and stays with Belle. After the first, refined Diva, Beneix deepens all his idea of ​​cinema in this second film of his. Vanity: the car runs idle, weighed down by ambitions. Detail for Rosa Comic, Crazy Horse diva.

title: Imitation of Life
actors: Lana Turner, John Gavin, Juanita Moore, Sandra Dee, Robert Alda, Susan Kohner, Dan O'Herlihy, Karin Dicker, John Vivyan, Terry Burnham
description: Lora, a young widow with a daughter, Susy, prefers a theatrical career to the love of photographer Steve. She looks after Emy, a black woman who also has a daughter, Sarah Jane. As she grows up, she tries to hide her black origin, thanks to her almost white skin, but she can't. He runs away from home cursing his mother. Lora, now famous, accepts Steve, who in the meantime has made a career, clashing with Susy, who is in turn in love with him. And that's not all ...
notes: Mélo which rightfully belongs to the number of great films in the history of cinema: sumptuous and flamboyant. Conflicts of class, age, and above all racial, in a staging that restrains, discards, finally expands in the masterful final scene of the funeral to the tune of "Trouble of the World" sung by Mahalia Jackson. Remake of John M. Stahl's 1934 film of the same name.

title: Break Trough
actors: Richard Burton, Rod Steiger
description: German generals plot against Hitler and a sergeant is charged with contacting the Allies. But the project is very old and even the actors have seen better times.

title: Dark Mirror
actors: Olivia de Havilland, Lew Ayres, Thomas Mitchell, Richard Long
description: A doctor was stabbed to death in his office and many witnesses are quick to identify the woman who killed him. The suspect, however, has a twin; it will be up to a psychiatrist to identify in one of the two sisters the mental illness that led to the murder.
notes: Directed by a master of noir like Siodmak, the film is strengthened above all by the extraordinary performance of Olivia De Havilland in the double role and the photography of Milton R. Krasner. Compelling and refined, a jewel of ambiguity and suspense.

title: Saddle the Wind
actors: Robert Taylor, John Cassavetes, Julie London, Donald Crisp
description: Tony returns to the farm that his brother Steve has been running in his absence. The two brothers love each other but have a very different character: Tony is bossy at least as much as Steve is reasonable. So the reactions of the two towards the claims of the cowboys are different: Steve is willing to negotiate while Tony confronts them with the gun in his hand. Found guilty of murder, Tony runs away hunted by the sheriff: once joined by a group of men including Steve, he will prefer suicide to capture. It is the character of John Cassavetes (future director and here an excellent actor), to make the difference between this western and the others of the period. Screenplay by Rod Serling, smart and modern.

title: The Naked Spur
actors: James Stewart, Janet Leigh, Robert Ryan, Ralph Meeker
description: Betrayed and ruined by a woman while at war, Robert is looking for a quick way to make money and rebuild his life. With lucky companions, he pursues a killer, Ben, to earn the $ 5,000 bounty hanging over his head. But Ben sells his life dearly and involves an elderly gold digger and his girlfriend Stella in the escape. Until the end the bandit sells his skin dearly, but ...
notes: Fast pace for a rigorous, exciting and spectacular western that concedes little to the canons of the genre to play all its cards on the fight to the death, but also on the psychological contrast, between two irreducible opponents. Epic and tragic, with a great Stewart, one of Anthony Mann's classics of the golden age.

title: The Band Wagon
actors: Fred Astaire, Cyd Charisse, Jack Buchanan, Oscar Levant, Lew Ayres
description: Tony Hunter, once a successful and now forgotten dancer, gets a role in a musical comedy. He tries to give his advice, but nobody listens to him. The audience, however, whistles the very parts that Tony had contested so that he is entrusted with the direction of the show.
notes: One of the top of the American musical; an ingenious theoretical summa written by Betty Comden and Adolph Green, which makes a mockery of intellectualisms and proposes a refined and conscious form of popular entertainment. The Astaire / Charysse duo is a concentrate of incorporeal lightness and colorful sensuality: unforgettable in a long number "Girl Hunt", a Spillane-style noir parody with Charysse wrapped in red.

title: The Spy with a Cold Nose
actors: Laurence Harvey, Daliah Lavi, Denholm Elliott, Lionel Jeffries, Eric Portman
description: British counterintelligence agents give a Russian minister a bulldog in which a miniature transmitter has been inserted. The Soviets give the same treatment to the British agent Farquar, who had the good idea. The film upsets the canons of the genre with good doses of humor, even if the result is dated.

title: One Spy Too Many
actors: Robert Vaughn, David McCallum, Leo G. Carroll, Dorothy Provine
description: Once again, the two best men of the U.N.C.L.E., Napoleon Solo and Illya Kuryakin are grappling with a criminal who wants to enslave the whole world by means of a deadly gas.
notes: Film version of the television series which, despite Sargent's best efforts, ends up being a very cheap James Bond.

title: The Spy in Black
actors: Conrad Veidt, Valerie Hobson, Sebastian Shaw
description: We are in 1917, a captain of the German navy is landed in the Orkney Islands to check the movements of British ships. With a skilful move, the English counter-espionage puts an agent of its own behind him, in the role of a pretty teacher. The German manages to escape, but is killed at sea, on a ship torpedoed by a German submarine.
notes: It is the film that inaugurates the collaboration of the legendary Powell / Pressburger duo: a war thriller with strong atmospheres and ambiguous meanings. Powell avoids any Manichaeism, emphasizing the charm of the German spy as well as the danger.

title: Spia spione
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Teresa Gimpera, Cristina Gajoni, Mario Pisu
description: A gang of burglars penetrates into the apartment of Carlo, a clumsy waiter, to rob the bank vault below, where in addition to the money, a very precious ring is kept due to the special metal alloy of which it is made. Untimely back home, Carlo undergoes various hardships, but then helps the thieves, in turn robbed by an international spy organization, in an attempt to recover the ring. Comedy film that simply unravels, aside from a few funny lines, into an obvious parody of spy movies a la 007.

title: Where the Boys Are
actors: Dolores Hart, George Hamilton, Paula Prentiss
description: Four friends on vacation in Florida in the late 1950s. Angie and Anna think only of having fun, Mary thinks of finding a good match and only Melania takes her too much to heart and is upset. Musical comedy by the specialist Levin, even a little too moralistic.

title: Spiando Marina
actors: Debora Caprioglio, Steve Bond, Sharon Twomey, Leonardo Treviglio
description: Mark Derrick, a former Miami narcotics agent, must kill a man in Buenos Aires who he believes to be the son of the mafia boss who exterminated his family. In the apartment next to her there is a young woman, Marina, who claims to be the slave of a lover-master who tortures her in perverse amorous performances. Marina and Mark become lovers, but it is a trap, which will end up costing everyone their lives.Tremendous boiata made (very badly) with the sole purpose of exhibiting the best of the artistic virtues of Debora Caprioglio, that is the naked body engaged in various labors of the art of love. The rest, all the rest, is to be forgotten. Immediately.

title: Company Business
actors: Gene Hackman, Mikhail Baryshnikov, Kurtwood Smith, Oleg Rudnik
description: The cold war is over and Sam Boyd (Hackman), a former CIA agent, is dedicated to industrial espionage. However, his old company calls him back temporarily to bring a Russian spy (Mikhail Baryshnikov) who had been a mole for the Soviets back to the USSR. Of course, it is not easy and the two find themselves traveling all over Europe, chased by the secret services of half the world. At first it looks like a spy movie, then it gets lost becoming a comedy and not even the funniest. Baryshnikov, as an actor, is negligible, while Hackman, superlative, manages to save himself even in the less successful films.

title: Le spie uccidono a Beirut
actors: Richard Harrison, Dominique Boschero
description: Soviet and American secret services compete for precious microfilms with no holds barred. Apotheosis of the Cold War, with a hint of humor.

title: Le spie vengono dal semifreddo
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Vincent Price, Laura Antonelli, Francesco Mulè
description: Two Sicilian hotel porters are mistakenly commissioned by a CIA agent to unmask the plans of Dr. Goldfoot, who wants to conquer the world by causing a conflict between Americans and Russians. For his plan he uses beautiful girls who eliminate the generals of both sides one by one. Then it should launch a bomb on Moscow causing a chain reaction. But the two awkwardly manage to derail the plan, even if they end up prisoners in Siberia. Two cult names of fantastic cinema, Mario Bava and Vincent Price, go along with Franchi and Ingrassia in a childish and funny farce.

title: The Deserter
actors: Bekim Fehmiu, Richard Crenna, Chuck Connors
description: His wife massacred by the Indians, forced to desert after a fight with a superior, Captain Carter is still the only one able to defeat a warlike Apache rebel. To this end, he is entrusted with the command of a group put together with the scum of the army. Shot in Yugoslavia, produced by DeLaurentiis, a foolish and soporific western.

title: Una spina nel cuore
actors: Anthony Delon, Sophie Duez, Leonardo Treviglio
description: Guido is a young player who gets lucky in a small town on the lake. One day at the station he meets Caterina and falls in love with her; she accepts his court, but it is evident that there is something murky in her past. Things take an increasingly dramatic turn when another lover appears. The son of Alain Delon is the fascinating and unfortunate protagonist of this adaptation of Lattuada from the novel by Piero Chiara; the silent province and its secret, dark passions are at the center of the story, which provides the director with yet another great opportunity to investigate the ambiguities and reticence of the female soul.

title: Gibraltar
actors: Gérard Barray, Elisa Montes, Hildegarde Neff, Fausto Tozzi
description: A British army officer, Frank Jackson, is commissioned by the commander of the British military base in Gibraltar to carry out a counter-intelligence mission. He pretends to be a deserter, escaped from the fortress, so that he can join the organization of enemy spies based in Tangier. To his surprise, he discovers that an unscrupulous woman is at the head of the terrorists ...
notes: International co-production of a certain depth, but the level, despite the intentions, is poor. The fake 007s made by Italians in Italy reached higher peaks in some cases.

title: A Bullet for Joey
actors: Edward G. Robinson, George Raft, Audrey Totter
description: An enemy secret agent is tasked with kidnapping a scientist involved in nuclear experiments in Canada. To this end, he recruits a violent individual who goes after the professor's secretary and a girl who is entrusted with the task of seducing the austere scholar.
notes: B movie that echoes "Coral Island" with Bogart, has its strength in Edward G. Robinson, unusually used as a policeman rather than a gangster.

title: Foreign Intrigue
actors: Robert Mitchum, Geneviève Page, Ingrid Thulin, Eugene Deckers
description: Victor Danemore, a wealthy and esteemed art dealer, suddenly died on the Cote d'Azur, his usual residence, following a heart attack. Danemore was considered by all to be a very respectable person, even though his way of life had always seemed rather strange to his agent Dave Bishop. Suspicious of the questions that some strangers ask him about the last hours of his boss's life, he decides to start the research. The young Mitchum moves a little bewildered in this enjoyable spy.

title: Witchboard
actors: Todd Allen, Tawny Kitaen, Stephen Nichols, Cathleen Wilhoite
description: During a party with friends, Brandon exhibits a tablet full of strange inscriptions, the "ouija", a kind of tool for summoning spirits. An experiment is then attempted by evoking the spirit of David. Handcrafted horror as it is not done anymore.

title: Spirito Santo e le 5 magnifiche canaglie
actors: Vassilli Karis, Ray O'Connor, Daria Norman, Ken Wood
description: On behalf of the owner of the real estate agency Powels, the bounty hunter Holy Spirit sets out in search of a bandit called the Lonely. He is accompanied by five magnificent scoundrels who respond to the names of Diego D'Asburgo, Morgan the Pirate, the Father, Caccola and Garibaldi. Meanwhile, two cousins ??of Garibaldi arrive from Sicily, engaged in a personal revenge. Italian cinema has come to this too. Not content with exploiting the mythology of the western for low purposes, he also managed to put in a film a man named Garibaldi and another named Caccola. It is a film that leaves you speechless.

title: Splendor in the Grass
actors: Natalie Wood, Warren Beatty, Pat Hingle, Barbara Loden
description: In a small town in Kansas, Bud and Deanie love each other, but their families' prejudices prevent them from getting married. She rebels, he resigns himself and tries to become a good father's son, but misfortune haunts him: his sister dies in an accident and his father, ruined by the crisis of '29, commits suicide. Then the young man marries an Italian, while Deanie experiences the purgatory of a clinic for nervous diseases. Wonderful film about the crisis of a country and the cruelty of youth, a complex fabric of impulses and feelings. 1961 Oscar to William Inge for the original story and screenplay.

title: Spogliamoci così senza pudor...
actors: Ursula Andress, Barbara Bouchet, Enrico Montesano, Johnny Dorelli, Gianrico Tedeschi, Alberto Lionello
description: Film in four episodes. A private detective is duped by the client he wanted to cheat. A former footballer returns to the pitch disguised as a woman, but betrays himself when he takes his place at the barrier. A man locks his lover in the closet when his wife arrives, but there is already someone in the cabinet ... A couple of not very superstitious adulterers occupy a hotel bed where a man has just passed away.
notes: Sergio Martino has put together the stories without too much grace, trusting in half-naked actresses. Raimondo Vianello appears among the creators of the film as a screenwriter.

title: Spogliando Valeria
actors: Dalila Di Lazzaro, Gérard Manzetti
description: The murder of a painter unleashes a reaction of crimes and passions at the center of which is the diabolical Valeria: a minimal attempt to exploit the beauty of Di Lazzaro, which has failed.

title: Man's Favorite Sport
actors: Rock Hudson, Paula Prentiss, Maria Perschy
description: Forced by his boss to participate in a fishing tournament, Roger Willonghby, an inexperienced sports shop clerk but author of a comprehensive fishing manual, seeks help from competition organizer Abigail Page. Roger, who has never picked up a line in his life and who doesn't even know how to swim, thanks to his help manages to win the race, even if in a completely random way. Soon an affectionate bond arises between the two that will lead them to marriage.
notes: A lively comedy, with cartoonish moments and refined solutions, played by a hilarious Rock Hudson. A perfect fable on the "war of the sexes".

title: The Bride Came C.O.D.
actors: Bette Davis, James Cagney, Stuart Erwin, Jack Carson, Eugene Pallette
description: Rich and spoiled, Joan is about to run away with an orchestra conductor. Her father convinces the pilot of the plane that he must take her to California to "kidnap" the girl and bring her back, but an accident forces the plane to make a crash landing which soon turns out to be a convict. Thanks to the two protagonists and the rhythm set by the director, the film is basically quite funny and turned out to be one of the great Warner hits of the season.

title: La sposa era bellissima
actors: Angela Molina, Massimo Ghini, Stefania Sandrelli, Marco Leonardi
description: From the village of Cammarata many heads of families have embarked on the road to Germany which has offered them a job. Among these the husbands of Carmela and Maria. Maria is courted by the dentist of which she is assistant. This triggers the jealousies of the child of the woman who would like to know his real father. When the sick woman dies, the son goes to Germany to kill his father. It is unfortunate that Pal Gabor, one of the great Hungarian directors ("Angi Vera"), has let himself be entangled in this melodrama which often borders on ridicule.

title: La mariée était en noir
actors: Jeanne Moreau, Michel Bouquet, Jean-Claude Brialy, Michael Lonsdale
description: Five time wasters accidentally cause the death of a poor fellow who just got married. Within a few years, however, they were all killed one by one. Responsible is the widow who, after attempting suicide, decided to pursue her personal revenge.
notes: From a novel by William Irish alias Cornell Woolrich, Truffaut paints a female portrait that is both painful and icy. Julia, the desperate protagonist, seeks and kills her victims with the cruelty of those who have nothing more to lose: only with their death will the circle of her impossible love be closed. La Moreau is gorgeous in her eerie coldness. Music by Bernard Herrmann.

title: If a Man Answers
actors: Sandra Dee, Bobby Darin, Micheline Presle, Cesar Romero
description: The young Chantal, exuberant eighteen-year-old daughter of the Parisian Germaine and the Bostonian John, is convinced by her father to marry. Chantal follows her father's advice and, enthralling a young photographer, steals him. However, married life reserves bitter surprises for the couple. Chantal then invents a mistress to make her husband jealous.
notes: It is a classic comedy of misunderstandings, lively and cheerful. The interpreters are Sandra Dee and Bobby Darin, wife and husband also in private life.

title: The Perfect Bride
actors: Sammi Davis, Kelly Preston, Linden Ashby
description: The psychologically distraught protagonist has no qualms about killing anyone who gets in the way of her happiness, including the men who from time to time are about to marry her ... But in the end she has to deal with the sister of her most recent betrothed. . Suspicious, she doesn't seem at all willing to believe her. It is a traditional psychological thriller, specially made for television, on a subject that allows the use of numerous clichés typical of the genre. Cocktail of misogyny and paranoia (sure ingredients for sometimes tasty thrills), which can still arouse the interest of enthusiasts. The protagonist, Sammi Davis, has an illustrious precedent in her career, among the interpreters of the beautiful film by John Boorman 1940s: it was Dawn, the girl who fell in love with the Canadian soldier and became pregnant.

title: Dream Wife
actors: Cary Grant, Deborah Kerr, Walter Pidgeon, Betta St. John
description: Clem (Grant) is about to get married to Priscilla (Kerr), but the marriage goes up in smoke. Priscilla is too busy with her career while Clem dreams of a wife devoted to her family. Clem even goes so far as to arrange the wedding with an Indian princess, but at the last moment he returns to Priscilla, the only one who truly loves him. One of the many comedies focused on the "war of the sexes", not particularly brilliant.

title: Sposerò Simon Le Bon
actors: Barbara Blanc, Federica Izzo, Luca Lionello
description: Clizia is a sixteen year old student from Milan, enrolled at Berchet; she is also a wild fan of Duran Duran and of course she is crazy about their leader, Simon Le Bon. When she learns that the beloved will sing at the Sanremo Festival, she doesn't think twice and leaves with the hope of meeting him, accompanied by her suitor Alex. But things will turn out differently than Clizia hoped.
notes: A film destined for oblivion with the end of the 80s. It was a small phenomenon of custom, but ephemeral. Dead end for all the protagonists, except for Gianmarco Tognazzi, a son of art not without quality.

title: Les mariés de l'an II
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Marlène Jobert, Laura Antonelli, Michel Auclair
description: In 1787 the young Nicolas Filibert was forced to flee France, abandoning his wife Charlotte, and to take refuge in the United States. Seven years later, when he returns to France to get a divorce, he is involved in the turbulent events that pit the revolutionaries against the nobles and, of course, finds Charlotte again. Tailor-made film for Jean-Paul Belmondo, unleashed protagonist all fire and action.

title: The Misfits
actors: Marilyn Monroe, Clark Gable, Montgomery Clift, Eli Wallach, Thelma Ritter, James Barton, Kevin McCarthy, Estelle Winwood, Peggy Barton, Rex Bell
description: Roslyn (Monroe) is in Reno to get a divorce. Perce (Clift), Guido (Wallach) and Gay (Gable) instead live there in Reno, capturing wild horses and participating in rodeos. All three are attracted to the beautiful Roslyn. During a mustang hunt, Perce gets hurt and Roslyn is shocked: that hard and violent world makes her see a different Gay side. So when Guido and Gay take part in a new hunt for a herd of wild horses, helped by Perce, the woman frees the animal that the two have so hardly captured. Gay then recaptures him, to free him in turn, in homage to Roslyn. A "cursed" film: all the main characters of its protagonists died in a short time. And the presentiment of death and dissolution almost weighs on the whole film, even if the film is valid for the great comparisons between the actors and for the Hustonian sense of space rather than for Arthur Miller's rather heavy script.

title: Now You See Him, Now You Don't
actors: Kurt Russell, Cesar Romero, Joe Flynn, Jim Backus, William Windom
description: Finding himself in a crisis of funds, the principal of Medfield College is forced to cut the funding of the internal science laboratory and to accept the "protection" of the gangster Arno. However, the students manage to complete the discovery of a serum that makes them invisible. Arno, however, takes possession of the preparation and robs a bank. The boys then join forces with the police. Disney movies, not the worst, with a pre-Carpenter Russell.

title: Squadra antifurto
actors: Tomas Milian, Robert Webber, Lilli Carati, Giuseppe Pambieri, Tony Ucci, Bombolo
description: Former mugger, turned police marshal in charge of petty crime, Nico Giraldi is definitely an unconventional agent. Skilled motorcyclist, in a hippie-like look, he juggles skillfully and without excessive risks among "his" thieves. A bad day, however, ends up on the trail of a ruthless American blackmailer looking for a precious notebook: when the going gets tough ...
notes: Follow-up to _Squadra antiscippo_, with Milian in the role of the policeman who seems to take nothing seriously but then turns out to be a real mastiff: a burgher version of Lieutenant Callaghan. We smile: but the story, the direction and the dialogues are coarse.

title: Squadra antigangsters
actors: Tomas Milian, Enzo Cannavale, Asha Puthli, Margherita Fumero
description: Nico Giraldi, a former Italian police officer, goes to the United States to visit his old friend Salvatore Esposito: who, after taking over an Italian restaurant in Little Italy, is in trouble for lack of a license and because he has contracted debts. with some unscrupulous usurers. In reality, Nico is an Interpol agent on a special mission, sent to get his hands on the gang that extorted Esposito ...
notes: The Milian-Cannavale couple rages between Little Italy and Miami but is mismatched, between useless gigionerie and Neapolitan comedy out of place. Even the properly detective aspect of the story is watering on all sides.

title: Squadra antiscippo
actors: Tomas Milian, Jack Palance, Maria Rosaria Omaggio
description: Marshal Giraldi (Milian) is an avid opponent of the muggers, but he is convinced that the real criminals are the fences. There is one, the "Baronet" (Palance), who never manages to fit, until he finds himself in his hands a swag that is too hot. The boss then makes a kind of alliance with Giraldi to make a common front against a very dangerous big underworld. Final surprise.
notes: It is a kind of city western, with the protagonist's bike replacing the horse, with a modest plot resolved mostly with recklessness on two wheels, with massive doses of blows and bad words.

title: Squadra antitruffa
actors: Tomas Milian, David Hemmings, Bombolo, Anna Cardini, Leo Gullotta, Alberto Farnese
description: Commissioner Nico Giraldi (Milian), universally known as "Trash", investigates an organized scam against Lloyd's of London. With the help of a distinguished inspector, who has come from England to help him, "Monnezza" follows his trail and reaches San Francisco to solve the case. This character brought a lot of luck to Tomas Milian, who plays here with a wig of black curls and with the voice of Ferruccio Amendola.

title: Vigilante Force
actors: Kris Kristofferson, Jan-Michael Vincent, Brad Dexter
description: In the city of Elk Hills, oil has rapidly increased wealth and crime. According to the notables, the police are not enough and therefore they decide to hire Aaron Arnold, a Vietnam veteran, to defend law and order with a team of tough guys. But the smell of money is irresistible, and Arnold ends up pursuing the crime on his own. It will be his brother, with some fellow citizens, to stop him. The theme of Vietnam's maladjusted veterans, an original trait mixed with classic western ingredients, remains in the background. Kristofferson, bulky and expressionless, is a minor Rambo, six years ahead of Stallone's film.

title: Vice Squad
actors: Edward G. Robinson, Paulette Goddard, K.T. Stevens, Porter Hall
description: A police officer is killed in a gunfight with two thugs and Captain Barnaby discovers that the fact is linked to a plan to rob a bank. With the help of the landlady of an appointment house, the police intensify their surveillance and when the bandits attempt the shot, two of them are killed, while the third escapes taking a hostage.
notes: The detective device works well, supported by the interpretation of the fascinating Goddard and above all by Edward G. Robinson, the mythical gangster face ("Little Caesar") capable of interpreting with credibility even the reassuring role of the cop.

title: 633 Squadron
actors: Cliff Robertson, George Chakiris, Maria Perschy
description: World War II: Anglo-Americans have a plan to target the Germans in Northern Europe. Parachuting to Norway to prepare for an air raid, Erik Bergman is captured. His prison is bombed by the allies to prevent him from speaking under torture, then the 633 squadron still implements the established plans, reaching the goal at a very high price.
notes: It's a conventional war movie, with stereotypical and confusingly scripted characters. Cliff Robertson, here Canadian bomber, is often the interpreter of warrior heroes. On the other hand, the Scandinavian partisan played by George Chakiris, an actor of Greek origin, is incredible.

title: Mosquito Squadron
actors: David McCallum, Suzanne Neve, Charles Gray, David Buck
description: How can the British bomb a German arsenal where their captive compatriots have been concentrated? And how can a pilot, in love with a colleague's wife, conquer a position in the woman's heart by revealing the tragedy in which her husband was the protagonist? Traditional war story, intricately intertwined, even if told decorously.

title: Lo squadrone bianco
actors: Fosco Giachetti, Fulvia Lanzi, Antonio Centa, Doris Duranti
description: The young officer assigned to a unit in Tripolitania enlisted due to a disappointment in love. Fighting in the desert against the tribes that rebel against the Italian colonizers, he discovers the meaning of concepts such as valor and pride, hitherto unknown. He may return to his homeland, but he decides to stay: old friendships no longer interest him.
notes: Melodrama directed by the specialist Genina and performed by one of the most famous actors of the period, Fosco Giachetti, is a fascist propaganda film; but revised today it is above all a masterful adventure film.

title: Jaws 3
actors: Dennis Quaid, Bess Armstrong, Louis Gossett jr., Simon MacCorkindale
description: The "Undersea Kingdom" is an underwater park. Visitors walk through transparent tunnels below sea level, in an enclosed space called the lagoon, to be in contact with marine flora and fauna as much as possible. On the day of the inauguration, however, a large female shark, whose cub had been captured, penetrates the aquarium, sowing destruction and panic (as if the fish were taking care of their offspring!).
notes: Third episode of the death-bearing shark that seems to be reborn every time from its ashes. Flat, yet another repeat of Spielberg's film. And the 3-D effect is also lost on television.

title: Jaws the Revenge
actors: Lorraine Gary, Lance Guest, Karen Young, Mario Van Peebles, Michael Caine
description: Ellen Brody is left the widow of her sheriff husband, who was killed while fighting a giant shark. Thirteen years have passed since then when the shark shows up on Christmas Eve killing Ellen's son, Sean. Convinced that the beast attacks her family, the woman moves to the Bahamas, but here too the shark arrives who, in an epic battle, will be faced by the woman.
notes: The saga of the sea monster started by Steven Spielberg continues. The nightmare atmospheres, the foaming of the waves and the reddening of the waters remain the indispensable ingredients. But this is the worst of the series.

title: Jaws
actors: Robert Shaw, Roy Scheider, Richard Dreyfuss, Lorraine Gary
description: The town of Amity, located on a small island in the Atlantic Ocean, owes its prosperity to tourism. One evening, a girl is torn apart by a huge shark. Faced with the complaint of the fact, Sheriff Martin would like to have the bathing suspended, but is faced with the opposition of the mayor, worried about the economic inconveniences of such a decision. The monster, however, strikes again. Martin sets up a team with elderly fisherman Quint and oceanologist Matt Hooper.
notes: It is the film that transformed an excellent filmmaker into one of the most relentless dollar machines in the history of cinema. Spielberg combines adventure with horror, with the best special effects available at the time and ushering in the road along which Hollywood would launch for the next decade. At the origin of the film there is a mediocre novel by Peter Benchley on which Spielberg constructs a narrative mechanism with an irresistible crescendo.

title: Bugles in the Afternoon
actors: Ray Milland, Hugh Marlowe, Helena Carter, Forrest Tucker
description: Cavalry captain Kern Shafter is unfairly disbarred from the army for an argument with a rival in love. Enlisted as a volunteer as a simple soldier, he is under the orders of a captain who, again for that reason, persecutes him fiercely. In the classic setting of the western, the story revolves around battles and rivalries for a woman.

title: Murder by Phone
actors: Richard Chamberlain, John Houseman, Sara Botsford
description: An ecology professor becomes a detective to find out who is the crazy murderer who killed one of his students. Thus he discovers a series of assassinations by the same person. The murderer has in fact a very particular technique: he kills his victims through the telephone handset. What is supposed to be an anti-technological metaphor is instead an assembly of badly recycled ideas. Not even Chamberlain offers a great performance.

title: Stars and Stripes Forever
actors: Clifton Webb, Debra Paget, Ruth Hussey, Robert Wagner
description: Willie Little, one of the master's most appreciated collaborators, works in the band of the famous composer John Philip Sousa. Willie meets and marries Lily Becher, a dancer and singer, and obtains a writing for her in the Sousa band.
