However, the marriage must be kept secret because, by virtue of internal regulations, musicians cannot be accompanied by their wives. But when Willie volunteers to go to war, the "secret" is discovered.
notes: Taken from the autobiography of Sousa himself, a composer who really lived at the turn of the century, the film is not overwhelming, but offers various and noisy musical pieces that are quite well known.

title: Stone Cold Dead
actors: Richard Crenna, Paul Williams, Linda Sorenson
description: A psychopath is disrupting city life. He kills prostitutes and photographs them at the moment of death. Sergeant Boyd sets out on his trail. Modern Canadian version of Jack the Ripper, played by Richard Crenna, Rambo's colonel.

title: Steelyard Blues
actors: Jane Fonda, Donald Sutherland, Peter Boyle, Garry Goodrow
description: Jess is unruly, passionate about motorsport, tied to other harmless and marginal optimists like himself, including the beautiful prostitute Iris. Together they plan an unlikely escape on a refurbished old seaplane. His brother Frank is a prominent man who for the sake of respectability tries to get him to settle down. At the cost of playing hard and putting the police on his heels. Captivating cast for this counter-current comedy in pure "New Hollywood" style. The establishment and conventional values ??of society are targeted. The heroes are all losers, from first to last, but for this very reason they are nice. And they will be fine.

title: St.Elmo's Fire
actors: Emilio Estevez, Rob Lowe, Demi Moore, Judd Nelson, Ally Sheedy, Andrew McCarthy, Mare Winningham, Joyce Van Patten, Martin Balsam, Andie MacDowell
description: It is the story of a group of young friends who have just graduated, four boys and three girls. Each of them feeds its illusions and dreams for the future; naturally, in the company, sentimental ties are intertwined which counterbalance their difficulties and their first existential disappointments. Enthusiasm soon gives way to realism. Schumacher chooses the student environment for a disenchanted, at times merciless description. The film does not escape moments of abulia, but it makes use of a good group of performers.

title: Places in the Heart
actors: Sally Field, Lindsay Crouse, Ed Harris, Amy Madigan, John Malkovich, Danny Glover
description: In 1935, when Sheriff Royce Spalding is killed on duty, his young wife, Edna (Field), suddenly finds herself in need to provide for herself and a large property that is still in debt. From a former super-protected housewife, Edna transforms herself into a mature and strong-willed woman through work, struggles against adversity and the construction of intense human relationships. Benton ("Kramer vs. Kramer") writes and directs another good-feeling film, a rhetorical idyll about the good old days of rural America. Excellent photography by Nestor Almenderos, but only the director and the protagonist received the 1984 Oscar.

title: Le stagioni del nostro amore
actors: Enrico Maria Salerno, Anouk Aimée, Jacqueline Sassard, Gian Maria Volonté, Gastone Moschin
description: The forty-year-old journalist Vittorio Borghi is experiencing a phase of rethinking caused by the crisis in his relationship with Elena, a much younger woman than him. Plus there's his failed marriage to Milena. In search of himself he returns to the Mantuan countryside, where he finds faces and places of his youth.
notes: Enrico Maria Salerno in his best season is the protagonist of this portrait of an intellectual in crisis. Vancini wants to counter the grain of the Italian comedy, but the result is a bit wordy.

title: Stalag 17
actors: William Holden, Don Taylor, Otto Preminger, Robert Strauss
description: The events of a group of Americans locked up in a Nazi concentration camp. Oscar for William Holden and only nomination for Billy Wilder, who uses the field only as a backdrop for a terrifying portrait of cynical and immoral Americans, very much against the tide.

title: Stalker
actors: Aleksandr Kajdanovskij, Anatolij Solonicyn, Nikolaj Grinko
description: A metorite that fell to earth produced strange phenomena in an area, promptly protected and fenced off by the army. To enter, however, there are clandestine guides, called "Stalker", able to lead anyone who requests it to the "room of wishes". A writer, a scientist and a stalker set out for the mysterious area. They will return profoundly changed.
notes: In reality it is not just a science fiction film, it is one of Tarkovsky's masterpieces. The opening sequence with the stalker, wife and handicapped daughter is thrilling. Unforgettable the rain that drips throughout the film.

title: Stand by Me
actors: Wil Wheaton, River Phoenix, Kiefer Sutherland, Richard Dreyfuss, Corey Feldman, Jerry O'Connell, Casey Siemaszko, Gary Riley, Bradley Gregg, Jason Oliver, Marshall Bell, Frances Lee McCain, John Cusack, Bruce Kirby
description: Reached by the news of the death of a friend, a writer remembers an episode of his years between childhood and adolescence: together with some peers he went into the Oregon woods, following the railway, to find the body of a missing boy. A somewhat crazy adventure, which for all of them turned into a real initiatory journey towards still distant maturity.
notes: Rob Reiner's singular adaptation of a Stephen King short story: the young protagonists grappling with their childhood fears are described in a tone that skilfully shifts from nostalgic to bizarre. In the cast a couple of illustrious "will be famous".

title: Stanno tutti bene
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Michèle Morgan, Marino Cenna, Norma Martelli
description: Matteo is retired after a life of hard work and sacrifices. A widower, he is proud of the successes of his children, scattered throughout Italy, who write to him from time to time boasting successful marriages and fabulous occupations. Now that Matteo has time he decides to visit them: from Sicily he goes back to Naples, then to Rome, then to Florence, then to Milan and Turin: but the children have deceived him, they are all ill. Tornatore tells, with this bitter apologue, an Italy in collapse, traveled far and wide by an old-fashioned Italian. Mastroianni, duly aged and with thick glasses, is very good in the role of the melancholy protagonist, but the film is often on the edge of ridicule, full of heavy metaphors, bulky fellinisms (the screenplay is also by Tonino Guerra) and with soporific tensions. Too bad for Morricone's beautiful music.

title: Stanza 1717, palazzo delle tasse, ufficio imposte
actors: Gastone Moschin, Philippe Leroy, Franco Fabrizi, Raymond Bussières, Ugo Tognazzi, Lionel Stander
description: Fiscal officer passes million-dollar fines to four rich people on paper only. They decide to make up for it by robbing the safe of the Tax Office. Their plan is elaborate and perfect, but they don't know they are working for the "enemy." A tasteless farce.

title: La stanza del vescovo
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Ornella Muti, Lia Tanzi, Patrick Dewaere, Gabriella Giacobbe, Piero Mazzarella
description: A young heartthrob meets Mr. Temistocle Mario Orimbelli, his shrewish wife Cleofe and his beautiful sister-in-law in a villa on Lake Maggiore. He falls in love with the latter, but retires when Themistocles, a widower, wants to marry her. It turns out then that Themistocles' widowhood is not accidental but deliberate: it is he who got rid of his wife, drowning her. Based on the homonymous story by Pietro Chiara, the film delves into the hidden aspects of the respectable bourgeoisie. One hundred and twenty film by Tognazzi, accompanied by a rising Muti and by Patrick Dewaere, a French actor who died prematurely.

title: Star 80
actors: Mariel Hemingway, Eric Roberts, Cliff Robertson, Carroll Baker
description: Dorothy is a blonde who works as a waitress in a diner. Paul is a trickster with a hobby of risque photos: he convinces Dorothy to pose for him. Thanks to the photos, Dorothy wins the selection for "Playboy". Then the doors of the cinema open to her, but her relationship with a director drives Paul crazy with jealousy, in the meantime become her husband, who kills her before taking his own life. The film is the true story of Dorothy Stratten, a former model and actress in And Everyone Laughed at which Mariel Hemingway effectively lends her body. Fosse makes a film imbued with the idea of ​​death and caustic towards American society.

title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
actors: William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan, George Takei, Majel Barrett, Nichelle Nichols, Stephen Collins, Persis Khambatta, Walter Koenig
description: We are in the 23rd century and Captain James T. Kirk, in command of the spaceship "Uss Enterprise", is called to fight an alien presence that threatens the Earth. The hours are numbered: the mysterious attacker, who comes in the form of unknown waves of energy, is about to attack our planet. The Enterprise reaches the center of this intergalactic force and discovers its astounding secret ... In 1979, after years of success in the television series of the same name, "Star Trek" lands on the big screen under the direction of an expressive Hollywood craftsman and is the beginning of a new, very long saga.

title: Star Trek. The Wrath of Khan
actors: William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, James Doohan, Ricardo Montalban, Kirstie Alley
description: The Enterprise abandons its normal mission to prevent the fearsome Khan from taking over the important Genesis project. In the dramatic confrontation Kirk finds the love of his ex-wife again. Second cinematic episode of the famous cosmic saga. Robert Wise has given up his place in the control room to the more cheap Nicholas Meyer and the story sometimes has some jokes.

title: Star Trek III. The Search for Spock
actors: William Shatner, Robert Hooks, Christopher Lloyd
description: Dr. Spock is not dead. Or at least that's what Admiral Kirk thinks when he recovers the Enterprise, already destined for demolition, and sets off to Genesis in search of his missing friend. Third film episode that is not even worth the ones in the television series. Recommended for Star Trek fans only.

title: Star Trek IV. The Voyage Home
actors: William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley
description: To save the Earth from ecological disaster, two whales are needed, but in the 23rd century they are extinct. The Enterprise then sets off on a journey through time that will take her to Los Angeles in 1986. The target is the local aquarium, which houses a pair of cetaceans; at first the combative director opposes the "transfer", then she convinces herself and joins the expedition. Written (four hands with Nicholas Meyer, director of The Day After), directed and starring Leonard Nimoy (Dr. Spock) , is probably the most successful film in the series.

title: Starflight One
actors: Lauren Hutton, Lee Majors, Hal Linden, Ray Milland
description: The hypersonic plane Starflight One is to leave for its maiden flight: California-Australia in just over two hours. In flight he is hit by the fragments of a telecommunications missile launched illegally and destroyed in flight. The plane ends up in the subgravitational zone, making it impossible to return. NASA must take care of it, among inevitable sentimental dramas, innocent victims and punished villains.
notes: Catastrophic film of the "Airport & co" trend, which seeks innovation at all costs in technological updating. His memory was lost without remission, despite Lauren Hutton in the cast and special effects of John Dykstra (Star Wars).

title: Starman
actors: Jeff Bridges, Karen Allen, Charles Martin Smith, Richard Jaeckel
description: Jenny is a widow. One night, an alien "appears" in her house who acquires the features of her deceased husband and convinces her to accompany him to a place in Arizona, where he will meet his companions. His future depends on that appointment. But the alien is chased by the army and the secret services, determined to block his escape route. For Jenny, that adventure will lead to a new life ...
notes: Carpenter tells a story with Spielbergian resonances very different from those he had accustomed us to, still managing to make it his own. Unforgettable Jeff Bridges in this role of man from the stars, modern messiah for a better future.

title: Stasera a casa di Alice
actors: Carlo Verdone, Ornella Muti, Sergio Castellitto, Yvonne Sciò
description: Filippo and Saverio are married with two sisters, Gigliola and Caterina. Gigliola discovers that Saverio is having an affair with a certain Alice, and Filippo, having learned of the fact, tries to dissuade his brother-in-law from this adventure. But when he meets Alice, he too falls in love with her and starts dating her secretly. It will be the girl who gets tired of the jealousies of the two brothers-in-law.
notes: The male actors, Castellitto and Verdone, are good but the film as a whole is banal and rather weak. Nothing new, then, although some episodes are funny and Ornella Muti (Alice) does everything in this role of seductive charmer.

title: Trouble in Mind
actors: Kris Kristofferson, Keith Carradine, Lori Singer, Divine
description: A young criminal is about to get involved in the most dangerous circles of the underworld. He is saved thanks to the help of a former prisoner. A film played entirely on the alternation of strident tones: from the grotesque to the surreal, from noir to comedy.

title: State of Grace
actors: Ed Harris, Sean Penn, Gary Oldman, Robin Wright, Ed Harris
description: Terry returns, after years, to his childhood neighborhood, the infamous Hell's Kitchen. This time, however, Terry is a police officer, infiltrated into the environment to combat local crime. He is hired by the gang of Frankie Flannery, whose sister, Kathleen, had once been in love with him. The game is risky and is even more complicated by the rivalry between the Irish component (of which the agent is a part) and the mafia "families" of Italian extraction. Phil Joanou ("Final Analysis") effectively revisits the New York crime scene of the 1970s. Dark tones, existential desperation, a male cast that couldn't be harder.

title: Stato interessante
actors: Janet Agren, Adriana Asti, Enrico Montesano, Monica Guerritore, Magali Noël, Turi Ferro
description: Three women are together in an abortion clinic; who does it reluctantly, who with determination. They are Carla, wife of an industrialist, Annabella, daughter of a Christian Democrat politician, and Patrizia, wife of a ragman. The latter, poor, will encounter the greatest difficulties.
notes: A thesis film shot in the hot years of the abortion debate. The rich and powerful, even if they preach their aversion to medical practice, resort to private clinics and the poor people crash. Nasca tackles the problem from his point of view but falls into the traps of didactic cinema.

title: Stavisky
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Anny Duperey, Charles Boyer, Michael Lonsdale
description: Stavisky is a nice high-class scammer, tied to the centers of political power; despite the advice of his secretary, he issues false cash vouchers of the Municipal Credit. The scandal broke out and was immediately exploited by the right; Stavisky is found dead: state suicide?
notes: Alain Resnais reconstructs a historical episode giving ample space to his refined poetics of memory; the result is a precious, complex film of subtle melancholy and refined historical reconstruction, in which Stavisky is placed in parallel with the exile of Lev Trotsky.

title: Staying Alive
actors: John Travolta, Cynthia Rhodes, Finola Hughes, Steve Inwood
description: Tony Manero (John Travolta), a boy from the suburbs, moves to Manhattan dreaming of making dance his profession. Jackie, his girlfriend, introduces him to Broadway, where the boy has an affair with Laura, a capricious prima ballerina. Tony's artistic skills are noticed and he is hired as principal dancer. It is the beginning of a triumph. Continuation of the events and the vaulting of the little king of Manero / Travolta discos, six years after Saturday night fever. The good film by John Badham, Sylvester Stallone, here as a director, is followed by an obvious film that looks only at the superficial and commercial aspects.

title: Stazione Termini
actors: Jennifer Jones, Montgomery Clift, Gino Cervi, Richard Beymer
description: Maria, a married American and mother, met a professor in Rome with whom she lived an intense "love story", but the call of the family convinces her to end the relationship. De Sica and Zavattini try to build a work worthy of their neorealist past, but the result is not exceptional.

title: Flaming Star
actors: Elvis Presley, Barbara Eden, Steve Forrest, Dolores Del Rio
description: Sam Burton, who has married an Indian in his second marriage, does not participate in a punitive expedition against the Red Indians who have attacked a farm and the other settlers disperse his cattle. While he is retrieving him with his eldest son Clint, his wife and other son go to the Indian village to make peace. But Clint alone will survive the terrible chain of cross-vendettas. Presley is engaged in a film that offers no playful loopholes and, on the contrary, is loaded with drama. He is doing quite well, under the guidance of a specialist like Siegel.

title: Cahill U. S. Marshal
actors: John Wayne, Gary Grimes, Neville Brand, George Kennedy
description: A gruff, trigger-happy lawmaker neglects his family and teenage children, too engrossed in his duty. The boys thus become involuntary accomplices of a gang of outlaws who attack the country's bank. Innocent, they soon end up in prison and risk the gallows, but the sheriff identifies the real culprits. Before arresting them, however, he waits for his boys to understand the mistake made.
notes: Tailor-made for a stunned Wayne, the film offers a heavy moral at the expense of action.

title: La steppa
actors: Daniele Spallone, Marina Vlady, Charles Vanel
description: The discovery of the world and the spiritual initiation of a Russian child coincides with a long journey undertaken together with his uncle. Measured and evocative transposition from a story by Checov, with a great international cast. Lattuada engages with the great European production but does not lose the touch and signs an excellent product.

title: They Died with their Boots on
actors: Errol Flynn, Olivia de Havilland, Arthur Kennedy
description: George Armstrong Custer's fictional story, from his arrival at West Point Academy (1857) to his death in battle, at the Little Big Horn, against Sitting Bull's Indians (1876). We witness the exploits of the young officer during the Civil War, his advancements, marriage, up to the fatal clash.
notes: In this beautiful film by Raoul Walsh, singer of the virile virtues, the protagonist is always seen under a double aspect, independent and heroic, but also vain and irresponsible. The real villains of the story, however, are the speculators and professional politicians who plot in the shadows while the pure expose themselves.

title: The First Texan
actors: Joel McCrea, Felicia Farr, Vic Morrow, Wallace Ford
description: Sam Houston (McCrea) divorces his wife, resigns as governor of Tennessee and moves to San Antonio, Texas. The area, under Mexican rule, is agitated by a desire for independence, but Sam has sworn to keep out of political contention. He also made this promise to his girlfriend (Farr) who in turn will only be a lawyer and will not even deal with politics. Of course he succeeds only as long as the President of the United States personally assigns him the task of leading the insurrection and of bringing Texas to annexation with the United States. Halfway between the western and the historical reconstruction, it lets itself be seen despite the forty and years since its release.

title: The Glenn Miller Story
actors: James Stewart, June Allyson, Charles Drake, Henry Morgan
description: The life and works of the great trombonist, composer and conductor, of his love for the woman who will become his wife, of his tragic end in a transatlantic flight accidentally shot down during World War II.
notes: Mann conducts with super professionalism; splendid performances of some jazz aces (from Armstrong to Gene Krupa).

title: The Story of Ruth
actors: Elana Eden, Stuart Whitman, Tom Tryon, Peggy Wood, Viveca Lindfors
description: Ruth, priestess of the Chemosh cult, goes into crisis after meeting a Jewish family and refuses to make human sacrifices. The High Priest's anger strikes her and the group of Jews. With the only survivor Naomi, Ruth takes refuge in Bethlehem, converting to Judaism. Here, after demonstrating the sincerity of her conversion, she marries Boaz: David will be part of their lineage. Biblical colossal that tries in vain to present itself as a great spectacle: the result of its efforts is only boredom.

title: The Nun's Story
actors: Audrey Hepburn, Peter Finch, Edith Evans, Colleen Dewhurst
description: Audrey Hepburn, a missionary in Congo, abandons her dress and rigid religious rules to be closer to the poor and the suffering. Challenging themes treated by Zinnemann's direction without simplifications, but with some excess of coldness. Hepburn did well

title: Things to Come
actors: Raymond Massey, Cedric Hardwicke, Ralph Richardson
description: Between science fiction and political fiction, the history of the Earth and how war cannot change things.
notes: Scripted by H. G. Welles, it is loosely inspired by the German Expressionist masterpiece "Metropolis" directed by Fritz Lang. Scenically fascinating, but the script is dated and a little emphatic.

title: Die Unendliche Geschichte
actors: Noah Hathaway, Barret Oliver, Tami Stronach, Tilo Prückner
description: The mother is dead and the father is rather distracted, so Bastian takes refuge in the books not to stop dreaming. One of these, "The story that never ends", read alone in the attic during a stormy day and night, offers him the chance to live in the kingdom of Fantàsia which is dying because people have stopped dreaming. And it will be Bastian himself to save the child Empress and to fly away on a winged dragon. Suggestive German superproduction, however shot in English, which at the time achieved great success thanks to the fairy tale story of Michael Ende's novel (duly simplified) and the soundtrack by Giorgio Moroder. Passionate and not cloying.

title: Die Unendliche Geschichte II
actors: Jonathan Brandis, Kenny Morrison, Clarissa Burt
description: The kingdom of Fantasia is about to be destroyed by the power of Nothingness, between the pages of the book "The Neverending Story", which little Sebastian, orphaned of his mother and misunderstood by his father, begins to read in the attic of his house to escape the reality that it makes him miserable. While he is intent on reading, he is sucked into the events he is imagining. Together with faithful Atreyu and the flying dragon Falkor, Sebastian defeats the beautiful but evil Queen Xayide. A somewhat tepid and obvious follow-up to the previous "The Neverending Story", it follows the same mechanisms.

title: La storia vera della signora delle camelie
actors: Isabelle Huppert, Gian Maria Volonté, Fernado Rey, Bruno Ganz
description: Immortalized in the novel and theatrical text by Dumas son as Margherita Gauthier and in Verdi's melodrama as Violetta Valéry, "La traviata", Alphonsine Plessis (Huppert) is prematurely initiated by her father into prostitution and, still a teenager, arrives in Paris from the province determined to win a place in the beautiful world of the capital. Worker for a short period, she begins her climb by passing from one "gentleman" to another, but is undermined by the consumption that will crush her at the age of 23. Bolognini lets himself be carried away by the taste for reconstruction of the environment. A cast of international celebrities, but the best is our Volonté. Detail for Carla Fracci.

title: Conte de la folie ordinaire
actors: Ben Gazzara, Ornella Muti, Tanya Lopert, Susan Tyrrell, Judith Drake, Katia Berger, Lewis Ciannelli
description: Charles Serking is a writer dedicated to a disordered life, who seeks in the abuse of alcohol and in poetry the remedies to his congenital despair. He seems to find momentary consolation in his relationship with Cass, a drifting prostitute like him, but it's only an illusion destined to tragically end. Serking remains alone, everything has to start over ... Marco Ferreri adapts five of Bukowski's stories. Self-marginalization, violence, refusal of any accommodation, aspiration to an impossible inner peace: this is the universe that Ferreri faces by imposing his personality as always, even if not always exhibiting the genius of the best years.

title: Stormy Monday
actors: Sting, Tommy Lee Jones, Melanie Griffith, Sean Bean, James Cosmo
description: A rich American, for his shady speculation (money laundering), wants to buy an entire neighborhood of Newcastle, England. But Sting, the owner of a jazz club, does not give in to the underworld pressures and the revenge of the American, managing to stand up to him.
notes: The story takes place during an "Anglo-American Friendship Week", but the director, Mike Figgis, shows very little sympathy for his cousins ??from across the Atlantic. Instead, he gives the green light to his sympathy for jazz and rock (he himself comes from rock): the narration is punctuated by this type of music. But apart from that, a smoky and mediocre film.

title: Stormy Weather
actors: Lena Horne, Bill Robinson, Cab Calloway and His Band, Fats Waller
description: A former black dancer reenacts his life story for neighborhood children. Between sequins and sequins, the charm of the stage exerts a great attraction on the little listeners, some of whom would like to tread in the footsteps of the narrator.
notes: The plot is a pretext: enjoy the dance numbers, the Cab Calloway jazz orchestra and the wonderful songs of Lena Horne.

title: La strada
actors: Giulietta Masina, Anthony Quinn, Richard Basehart
description: Gelsomina is a candid girl who has a strange relationship, made of love and awe, with Zampanò, a rough wanderer who earns his living with circus acts. One day he kills the "Fool", another globetrotter to whom Gelsomina has become friends. The girl, upset, goes mad. Zampanò abandons her but, later, on hearing of his death, he bursts into tears.
notes: Mythical film in the history of Italian cinema and the first Oscar for Fellini, of which it has established international fame. The character of Gelsomina has forever marked Giulietta Masina's career; Anthony Quinn wisely put his rough charm at Zampanò's service. Moving, Catholic, fabulous overcoming of neorealism.

title: Bloodbrothers
actors: Richard Gere, Paul Sorvino, Tony Lo Bianco, Lelia Goldoni
description: Emigrated to New York from Sicily, the De Coco made a small fortune by working hard in construction. Father Tommy can't wait to bring his son Stony to the construction site as well. However, the latter, undecided and more inclined to an educational work with the boys of the institute attended by his little brother, after many clashes with his father and uncle, will find his way also thanks to the love of a sensitive girl. , like many films of the time, the film, however, paints a stereotypical and somewhat over the top portrait of him. Mulligan is instead skilled in creating the atmosphere of the tender relationship between the two brothers.

title: Mystery Street
actors: Ricardo Montalban, Sally Forest, Bruce Bennett, Elsa Lanchester
description: In a clump of trees overlooking the beach, the body of Vivian Heldon, a dancer in a nightclub, is discovered. Police Inspector Morales is assigned to follow up the investigation. Suspicions first fall on the man who last accompanied the woman. But the victim's former landlord has another version of the facts and tries to blackmail a shipowner. A dark and realistic noir, written by Sidney Boehm and Richard Brooks.

title: On Our Merry Way
actors: Burgess Meredith, James Stewart, Henry Fonda, Dorothy Lamour, Victor Moore
description: The wife suggests to Oliver, a penniless editor, a round of interviews on the topic "What decisive influence has a child had on your life?". He snatches the job from a newspaper and collects several stories, but he'll hear the most beautiful when he gets home. A classy cast for a lovable eight-handed direct comedy (but Huston and Stevens, who directed the first episode, do not appear in the titles). An episode with Chrles Laughton was cut.

title: They Drive By Night
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Ida Lupino, George Raft, Gale Page
description: Joe accepts a good job from a friend and rejects the advances of his wife. The woman kills her husband and blames Joe for the murder. Acre and realistic, a social drama with noir streaks excellently performed and directed by a great Walsh.

title: Scarlet Street
actors: Edward G. Robinson, Joan Bennett, Dan Duryea, Margaret Lindsay
description: An upstanding bank employee who has already spent twenty-five years behind the counter falls madly in love with a prostitute. The girl exploits the situation and induces her lover to commit actions that otherwise she would never have done. For her, the man messes up a previous relationship and offers to marry her, but when he refuses, he kills her. In staging his typical themes (the fate that overwhelms man, "unjust justice", the devouring passion) Lang finds an excellent company of actors and signs a dreamlike and implacable film, the twin of the contemporary "La donna del portrait".

title: Les routes du sud
actors: Yves Montand, Miou-Miou, Laurent Malet
description: Juan (Montand) fled Spain and now lives in Paris, continuing to maintain contact with the Spanish resistance. His wife dies in an accident and he begins a relationship with a friend of his son. Just when the dictator Franco dies, Juan discovers that his wife was cheating on him and that his son despises him. He will decide to continue his political commitment. Shot entirely in France, it is one of Losey's less personal films that seems wearily to repeat the clichés of traditional political cinema. Montand is a prisoner of many similar roles already covered in his long career and Miou-Miou is also less interesting than usual.

title: Streets of Fire
actors: Michael Paré, Diane Lane, Willem Dafoe, Rick Moranis
description: Ellen Aim, a glamorous rock star, is singing sheathed in a spotlight in her fiery red dress. The music and the rhythm become overwhelming when, suddenly, a band of wild black-clad bikers bursts into the room and kidnaps her. To free her come Tom Cody, her ex-boyfriend, and a small band of desperate people. Not one of Hill's biggest hits, it was however an important film in investigating the image-music relationship. its charm is given by the timeless atmosphere of the story, by the epic clashes between rival gangs, by the grainy photography that translucent the neon signs on the wet asphalt. Plus, there's the perverse charm of Dafoe and Diane Lane. Ry Cooder's guitar does the rest.

title: Vampyr, l'etrange aventure de David Gray
actors: Julian West, Henriette Gérard, Jan Hieronimko, Maurice Schutz
description: Through a book on vampirism David Gray defeats a sect of the undead. A masterpiece of horror between expressionism and oneirism, a great experimental film in which Dreyer works on sound and blinding white colors. Famous is the sequence of the subjective burial, cited a thousand other times. The film is inspired by Sheridan Le Fanu's "Carmilla".

title: Strange Invaders
actors: Paul Le Mat
description: Good parody of 1950s science fiction. A professor from New York arrives in a small town that has been secretly in the hands of aliens for years.

title: The Case of the Hillside Stranglers
actors: Richard Crenna, Dennis Farina, Billy Zane, Karen Austin
description: Los Angeles, in the late 1970s. Policeman Bob Grogan is on the hunt for those responsible for a series of murders. Some women were brutally tortured before being raped and then strangled. The two guilty of these brutalities keep the city tightly in the circle of fear: on their trail, Bob will have to prove all his consummate skill.
notes: A television production thriller, inspired by a real story that took place in California. Richard Crenna is _Rambo_'s colonel and here, finally, he has the story all to himself. Dennis Farina was one of the performers of Michael Mann's _Manhunter - Fragments of a murder_.

title: Strange Bedfellows
actors: Rock Hudson, Gina Lollobrigida, Gig Young, Terry-Thomas
description: Carter's wife is a rather original woman, free in morals and beliefs. The two have been separated for years, but today Carter needs to reconcile with her in order to get a promotion. The result is a scandal which, while on the one hand seems to compromise Carter's career, on the other ends up by reconsolidating the marriage relationship. The Hudson-Lollobrigida couple drags on this conventional and not-so-funny marriage comedy quite wearily. The film was shot entirely in London.

title: Uno straniero a Paso Bravo
actors: Anthony Steffen, Giulia Rubini, Eduardo Fajardo, José Jaspe
description: After seven years in prison, Gary Hamilton returns to Paso Bravo and goes to war against the tyrannical Acombar. Shameless Italian western.

title: Straniero... fatti il segno della croce!
actors: Charles Southwood, Jeff Cameron, Cristina Penz, Max Dean
description: Two brothers leading a group of outlaws wreak havoc in a small western town. The inhabitants decide to rely on a bounty hunter who immediately sets to work. One of the many westerns made with a thousand pseudonyms and at very low cost by Demofilo Fidani, a set designer who has been active in Cinecittà for some time. To save money he did everything in the family: the producer is his wife Mila Vitelli, who also takes care of the costumes, while the female interpreter, also under a pseudonym, is their daughter.

title: High Plains Drifter
actors: Clint Eastwood, Verna Bloom, Marianna Hill, Mitch Ryan, Jack Ging
description: A mysterious stranger arrives in Lago, California; after seeing him in action with a gun, the inhabitants of the town ask him to defend them against a gang of criminals who are about to return to take revenge on those who had reported them. Alone against a multitude, the stranger must resort to all his cunning and skill. It is the first western starring and directed by Eastwood who immediately shows his particular vision: stories of ghosts, of survivors who materialize for one last adventure.

title: Kismet
actors: Howard Keel, Ann Blyth, Dolores Gray, Vic Damone, Monty Woolley
description: Out of interest, the Vizier wants the caliph to marry a princess. But the caliph has fallen in love with another who, however, believes him to be a simple gardener. A very kitschy and sumptuous oriental musical. The famous song "Stranger in Paradise" is actually one of Alexandr Borodin's "Polovesian Dances", arranged.

title: Chances Are
actors: Cybill Shepherd, Robert Downey jr., Ryan O'Neal, Mary Stuart Masterson
description: Killed in a car accident, the young lawyer Louie Jeffries, who has arrived in heaven, asks to be able to reincarnate. So he returns in the shoes of a certain Alex Finch but, due to a mistake, his memories have not been erased. When, as a guest of his wife Corinne and their daughter, who falls in love with him, he begins to remember, the matter gets mixed up.
notes: It is certainly not the first time that cinema has dealt with reincarnations: from "Heaven can wait" to "There is a ghost between us" the ... spectrum is very broad. Here a note of sentimentality is forcefully added, which however does not hurt.

title: Drôle de drame
actors: Michel Simon, Jean-Louis Barrault, Louis Jouvet
description: Irwin Molineux, a botanist, and Félix Chapel, a famous mystery writer, are the same person. When Molineux is accused of killing his wife, Chapel will conduct the investigation. Exchanges of people, misunderstandings, theatrical hits, all at a frenetic pace, with the screenplay by Prévert and the sets by Trauner.

title: Uno strano tipo
actors: Adriano Celentano, Claudia Mori, Erminio Macario
description: A double of Adriano Celentano arrives in Amalfi and makes a series of troubles just before the famous singer arrives on tour. When the latter arrives in the town he finds himself having to face a certain hostility and it is not exactly easy for him to get away with it. The only reason to see this film is that Celentano sings with the Rebels, the mythical group of Demetrio Stratos.

title: Lo strano vizio della signora Wardh
actors: Edwige Fenech, George Hilton, Cristina Airoldi, Manuel Gill
description: Julie Wardh, a woman with sadomasochistic tendencies, after breaking up her perverse relationship with Jean, tries to lead a peaceful life alongside her husband Neil. Neglected by the latter and blackmailed by Jean, the woman accepts George's court. But Jean harasses her to the point of trying to kill her. To unmask him, the police make believe that the crime was successful.
notes: Remarkable thriller by Sergio Martino, with some very beautiful death sequences visually and a flashback between Fenech, Rassimov and the glasses of a bottle to remember. The plot is cumbersome and the ending does not hold much, but it is secondary to the tension and the excellent work on the colors of the cinematographer Emilio Foriscot.

title: Hannibal Brooks
actors: Oliver Reed, Michael J. Pollard, Wolfgang Preiss, John Alderton, Helmut Lohner, Peter Garsten, Karin Baal, Ralf Wolter, Til Kiwe
description: A prisoner of war, in the Munich zoo Stephen Brooks has to take care of Lucy, an elephantess, and is so fond of her that, given the opportunity, he gives up running away. Having to move Lucy to Innsbruck, Stephen travels with two soldiers and a young cook. Along the way, Brooks kills a soldier from the escort who threatened to kill Lucy, then decides to reach Switzerland by crossing the mountains with the animal. The originality of the subject overflows into excess, and the film becomes cloying. One of the classic semi-serious and bizarre giants that were produced in the period.

title: Neobychajnye priklucenija Mistera Vesta v strane bol'sevikov
actors: Porfirij Podobed, Boris Barnet, Alessandra Kochlova, Vsevolod Pudovkin
description: A rich and simpleton Yankee, although not recommended by everyone, visits the USSR with cowboy Jeddy as his bodyguard. With the latter gone, Mr. West suffers the theft of his purse and is trapped by an adventurer who wants to plunder him with the help of a false countess. Jeddy and an American girl save him by turning to the police, thus discovering the true face of the USSR. Adventurous and brilliant first work, in which the director absorbs the motifs of American cinema and filters them into a satirical humor of very enjoyable effect. Visual and editing experiments, acting that breaks with theatrical schemes.

title: Straziami ma di baci saziami
actors: Nino Manfredi, Pamela Tiffin, Ugo Tognazzi, Moira Orfei, Livio Lorenzon
description: The long love story between Marino, a barber from Alatri, and Marisa, a beautiful girl from Sacrofanto Marche. First the two attempt suicide because her father opposes her, then she, unjustly accused of treason, abandons him and goes to Rome where she marries a deaf-mute tailor. He too goes to Rome, to find her or die. He finds her again and the two realize they still love each other, but her husband is involved. Funny parody of the world of romance novels written by Age and Scarpelli in the mood, with two or three hilarious moments and a splendid "whistling" Tognazzi.

title: Elvira, Mistress of the Dark
actors: Cassandra Peterson, William Morgan Sheppard, Daniel Greene, Edie McClurg
description: On the death of her aunt Morgana, Elvira inherits an old house in the province in which there is a recipe book with magical powers. She doesn't know anything about it, she doesn't even know that she is the daughter of a witch, but Uncle Vincent is aware of everything and tries in every way to get hold of the book. Comic variation on the theme of the paranormal. Hollywood is no stranger to such operations, but this time the cocktail doesn't work.

title: Moonstruck
actors: Cher, Nicolas Cage, Danny Aiello, Olympia Dukakis, Vincent Gardenia
description: Loretta Castorini, an attractive Italian-American widow, accepts Johnny Cammareri's marriage offer. Before the wedding, however, he has to go to Sicily to his old mother who seems to be on the verge of death and wants to see him for the last time; Loretta undertakes to contact the young Ronny, brother of the betrothed, to invite him to the wedding. In fact, there are disagreements between Johnny and Ronny that have separated them from each other. Needless to say, great love breaks out between Loretta and Ronny, thanks to the "Bohème" at the Metropolitan and the night of a full moon. Things get worse when ...
notes: Norman Jewison is not a genius, but he is nonetheless a skilled, experienced director, capable of adapting to different genres. In this case he starts from elements and characters characteristic of the great Hollywood tradition of brilliant comedy. The pace is not always up to the intentions but the cast is remarkable and Jewison directs her performers to the best of their ability. Two Oscars for actresses (Cher, Olympia Dukakis) and one for screenwriter John Patrick Shanley.

title: The Witches of Eastwick
actors: Jack Nicholson, Michelle Pfeiffer, Cher, Susan Sarandon, Richard Jenkins, Veronica Cartwright, Carel Struycken
description: Three free and independent women live in the quiet village of Eastwick, Alexandra, Jane and Sukie, who dream of their Prince Charming. The latter presents itself under the clothes of an eccentric and somewhat disturbing billionaire, Daryl Van Horne. It is actually a devil that seduces all three in the course of pleasant sabbat. However, its presence also causes several inconveniences. When the three friends manage to finally get rid of him are all pregnant.
notes: Miller was back from the "Mad Max" saga. John Updike offers him a subject for a well -polite and billionaire horror comedy, which Miller directs with a happy hand. Nicholson was born for this role. The trio is composed of the splendid Susan Sarandon, Michelle Pfeiffer and Cher, a true cocktail of sensuality, beauty and cunning.

title: Häxan
actors: Benjamin Christensen, Karen Winther, Emmy Schonfeldt
description: A 15th century witch, a devil welcomed in bed by a young bride, a hungry beggar who is accused of witchcraft, here are some of the protagonists of this singular film. Halfway between documentary and fiction, the film caused a lot of scandal when it appeared for the famous images of the Sabbath, inspired by medieval Flemish painting.

title: Vampire's Kiss
actors: Nicolas Cage, Jennifer Beals, Maria Conchita Alonso
description: A New York yuppie is dissatisfied with his job and feels a slave to the busy life he is forced into. After an affair with a beautiful woman, however, he is convinced that he has become a vampire. The symptoms are all there, in reality it is just an obsession. The tragedy breaks out anyway, but for much more "earthly" reasons. Cage and Beals in a film, halfway between horror and psychological thriller, which makes the excited New York of the Eighties the scene on which a drama with a gothic flavor is consumed.

title: Strike Commando
actors: Christopher Connelly, Reb Brown, Alan Collins
description: The only survivor of a commando action in Vietnam, he discovers that his commander is playing a double game.

title: Bite the Bullett
actors: Gene Hackman, Candice Bergen, James Coburn, Ben Johnson, Jan-Michael Vincent
description: In the Far West at the beginning of the century, a newspaper launched a unique competition: it will give two thousand dollars as a prize to whoever wins an endurance race on horseback for seven hundred miles. The race is joined by an unemployed cowboy, a bankrupt, a violent, a former prostitute and other singular characters. Brooks has signed one of his most convincing films: action dominates sovereign, sports adventure has a great pace and the company serves to learn more about the different souls of America. Very good, in this rather atypical western, Hackman, Ben Johnson and Candice Bergen.

title: Force of Arms
actors: William Holden, Nancy Olson, Frank Lovejoy
description: Returning from the war in Italy, Pete marries Eleanor, but does not rest for having unintentionally caused the death of a major friend of his. A variation on the theme of A Farewell to Arms updated to the Second World War. The result is not particularly interesting.

title: Stripes
actors: Bill Murray, Harold Ramis, Warren Oates, P.J. Soles, Sean Young
description: Enlisting in the army seems to be John Winger's last lifeline, after losing his job, home, car and girlfriend in a single day. So, with his friend Russell, he sets off on this adventure which, after a thousand delirious adventures, will even reward them with a medal of valor. Antimilitarist satire of director and actors of the "Ghostbusters" gang. The result is discontinuous, despite the presence of Bill Murray, and the film is not very comical.

title: The Couch Trip
actors: Dan Aykroyd, Walter Matthau, Charles Grodin, David Clennon, Donna Dixon
description: John Burns (Aykroyd) is locked up in an asylum in Illinois. By an almost unbelievable coincidence he manages to escape and go to Los Angeles to replace a psychiatrist on vacation. Burns as a psychiatrist is a success and only a priest known by chance (Matthau) seems capable of unmasking him. The old idea that it is difficult to distinguish the doctor from the patient works once again. The sequence with the crackpots at the stadium and the one at the top of the hill with the sign "Hollywood" are the most successful. Even if something more was expected from the Aykroyd-Matthau duets.

title: Strogoff
actors: John Phillip Law, Mimsy Farmer, Hiram Keller, Delia Boccardo, Claudio Gora, Kurt Meisel, Elisabeth Bergner, Donato Castellaneta, Jacques Maury, Christian Marin
description: The young Count Michael Strogoff, an officer of the Tsarist army, is sent to Siberia to warn the Grand Duke, brother of the Tsar and commander of the local garrison of the imminent onslaught of the Tartars. Disguised as a horse merchant, Michele begins the long journey in the company of Nadia, a young lady on her way to Siberia to join her husband, exiled for political reasons. The film, based on Verne's novel and shot in Bulgaria, lacks rhythm and has no storytelling force.

title: Stromboli terra di Dio
actors: Ingrid Bergman, Mario Vitale, Renzo Cesana, Mario Sponza
description: In order to leave the refugee camp, the young Karin is willing to marry Antonio, a fisherman from Stromboli. Even if life on the island is not quite what she expected. Then she becomes pregnant and the volcano threatens to go into business. On a trip to the Aeolian Islands with Bergman, Rossellini gives a change to his cinema, creating a powerful and innovative documentary of the soul, intensely played on the relationship between cultures, and between nature and culture.

title: The Stuff
actors: Michael Moriarty, Garrett Morris, Paul Sorvino, Andrea Marcovicci
description: The film has an absolutely unusual "protagonist" of which, to be as benevolent as possible, we can say that he is rather inexpressive and also rather cold. It is in fact a ... deadly alien dessert sold, who knows how, in fast food ...
notes: Singular horror film overwhelmingly turned into comedy. Shot with tones from the 1950s (cold war), it is imbued with satire from the 1980s.

title: Lipstick
actors: Margaux Hemingway, Mariel Hemingway, Chris Sarandon, Perry King
description: Chris McCormick, a model by profession, is raped by Gordon, his sister Kathie's music teacher. At the trial Gordon gets away with it, then he has the idea of ??raping Kathie too and at that point Chris shoots him. Ugly It looks like a show and it's not. It seems to have seen it twenty times and unfortunately it is. Margaux Hemingway, who is not a great actress, makes her sister Mariel's debut here.

title: Down and Out in Beverly Hills
actors: Nick Nolte, Richard Dreyfuss, Bette Midler, Little Richard, Tracy Nelson
description: Jerry is a Los Angeles bum who attempts suicide one bad day, desperate for losing his little dog. Unfortunately he tries to drown himself in the pool of a billionaire mansion; help from the owners is "adopted" by them. At first his presence takes on liberating functions, but then his position becomes more and more precarious, until the open confrontation during the end-of-year party ... Hollywood remake of Jean Renoir Boudu's film saved from the waters. As often happens in these cases, the result is not memorable. Good performance by Nick Nolte.

title: Up the Down Staircase
actors: Sandy Dennis, Patrick Bedford, Eileen Heckart, Ruth White
description: The difficulties, disappointments and betrayals of a young American high school teacher in contact with difficult children. Sandy Dennis, so young, alone saves the film, which is an honest social drama from specialist Mulligan.

title: Una su tredici
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Sharon Tate, Orson Welles, Vittorio De Sica, Ottavia Piccolo
description: Mario is a barber who emigrated to New York. His life is enlivened by the announcement that he is the sole heir of an old English aunt. Mario then rushes to England, but receives only thirteen vintage chairs. But when he has already sold them to an antique dealer, he discovers that a fortune is hidden in one of them. He then frantically tries to recover the chairs, which in the meantime have been scattered among various buyers.
notes: A fragmentary comedy, based on the famous Russian novel "The Twelve Chairs", which wastes the exceptional cast.

title: Royal Wedding
actors: Fred Astaire, Jane Powell, Peter Lawford
description: The dancers Tom and Ellen Bowen, brother and sister, are one of the most talented and close-knit couples in the American ballet corps. At the wedding of the Queen of England, they will both find love. Minor musical by the great Donen; but Astaire is still Astaire.

title: Sua Eccellenza si fermò a mangiare
actors: Totò, Ugo Tognazzi, Lia Zoppelli, Virna Lisi, Lauretta Masiero, Raimondo Vianello
description: Totò gets invited to a banquet under the false name of Doctor Tanzanella: the landlord accepts as long as the stranger pretends to be a comrade in arms and reassures his jealous wife because of her husband's absences. But Totò is a thief and his goal is a cutlery set: he steals it, and the blame seems to fall on a minister, forcing the landlord to accuse himself of the theft. Totò's latest film directed by Mario Mattoli, perhaps his best director; the luxury shoulder is this time a wild Tognazzi.

title: Il successo
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Anouk Aimée, Jean-Louis Trintignant
description: Determined to break through, a real estate official embarks on unclean speculation and compromise. He gets rich, but before he got into the "spin" he had a devoted wife and a very dear friend. Now he is left alone like a dog.
notes: Along the lines of the "Overtaking", but more schematic and heavy. The film is co-directed by Risi, uncredited.

title: The Mummy's Shroud
actors: André Morell, John Philips, David Buck, Michael Ripper, Elizabeth Sellars
description: An archaeological expedition travels to Egypt and discovers a sarcophagus containing the body of a pharaoh which has remained intact over the centuries. However, the mummy is stolen by an Egyptian who, after reciting a magic formula, gives life to the pharaoh who begins to kill all the members of the expedition one after another. A late Hammer directed by a second row director. Just sufficient.

title: Zuckerbaby
actors: Marianne Sägebrecht, Eisi Gulp, Toni Berger, Manuela Denz
description: The anomalous love of a fat office worker and a handsome subway driver. A film that starts as a comedy and immediately becomes bitter, despite the title. Sagebrecht is a revelation, Adlon conducts with grace.

title: Sugarland Express
actors: Goldie Hawn, Ben Johnson, Michael Sacks, Willliam Atherton
description: Clevis Poplin would still have to serve four months in prison: he has no reason to escape, because he was assigned to a model prison. His wife, Lou Jean Poplin, who wants to take back the little son entrusted to an elderly married couple from Sugarland, decides to let him escape. The escape succeeds, and for the couple begins a long journey across the United States to Sugarland ...
notes: Spielberg makes his real debut in the cinema with a lot of known actors, succeeding in his intent. The river of police cars marching behind the Poplin car is among the images that remain etched. Ben Johnson, as the captain, is fantastic.

title: Where the Sidewalk Ends
actors: Dana Andrews, Gene Tierney, Gary Merrill, Karl Malden
description: Policeman Dixon, while trying to arrest a man involved in a murder, hits and kills him. Dixon hides the body, falls in love with the widow and catches the killers of the first killed, then confesses his involuntary crime. Noir written by Ben Hecht under a pseudonym (it was a time of McCarthyism) and directed with the usual great skill by Preminger.

title: Silver River
actors: Errol Flynn, Ann Sheridan, Thomas Mitchell
description: Former army captain, professional gamer, he becomes a boss in Silver City, but ends up succumbing to the big monopoly trusts. Nice start during the war, more predictable the rest.

title: On Golden Pond
actors: Henry Fonda, Katharine Hepburn, Jane Fonda, Doug McKeon
description: 80-year-old Norman Thayer (Fonda) has retired with his wife (Hepburn) to a lakeside cottage. Their daughter Chelsea (Fonda) leaves them in their custody Billy (McKeon), the young son of her future second husband. Relations are already strained between Norman and Chelsea, and with the young Billy things are certainly not better. A film that is above all a happy meeting of great actors, with the Fondas, father and daughter, to recreate a situation not far from reality. It is the triumph of good feelings that erases the disagreements of the past and moves the viewer, overwhelmed by such astute sentimentality. Oscar for Fonda and for Hepoburn (not protagonist).

title: Edge of Eternity
actors: Cornel Wilde, Victoria Shaw, Mickey Shaughnessy, Jack Elam
description: Guardian and assistant manager of an abandoned mine in Arizona are killed. Agent Martin's investigation leads to Janice and her brother, the owner's children. The greedy young man has in fact secretly reactivated his father's gold mine and his accomplice, discovered, has committed murders. The killer kills again, escapes with Janice as a hostage, and succumbs fighting with Martin suspended over the void of the Grand Canyon. Violent and spectacular thriller with western accents directed by a master of the high-voltage B-movie.

title: Finian's Rainbow
actors: Fred Astaire, Petula Clark, Don Franks, Barbara Hancock, Tommy Steele
description: An elderly Irishman emigrates to the USA with his daughter and a magical vase that can satisfy three wishes. The girl, ignoring his powers, wishes a racist senator to become a black man, which comes true. The senator begins to understand her mistakes, but the young woman is accused of witchcraft. A musical tale to which neither the presence of Fred Astaire nor the direction of Coppola give the brio that one would expect.

title: Sunburn
actors: Farrah Fawcett, Charles Grodin, Art Carney
description: Investigator Jake Dekker (Grodin) works for a large insurance company and must find out how things really stand behind Mr. Thoren's death in a car accident. Dekker, with the collaboration of Ellie Morgan (Fawcett), ends up coming to terms with everything. A pure professional direction by an author who, at the beginning, promised better. Among the performers, the best is Art Carney, as Jake and Ellie's elderly colleague. The "television" Farrah Fawcett is beautiful and knows how to smile, but not much else.

title: Il suo nome è Donna Rosa
actors: Al Bano, Romina Power, Dolores Palumbo, Enzo Cannavale, Bice Valori, Pippo Baudo, Walter Brugiolo, Enzo Cannavale, Nicoletta Elmi, Anna Campori, Luciano Fineschi, Enzo Guarini, Lisa Halvorsen, Dolores Palumbo, Stelvio Rosi, Carlo Taranto
description: The boatman Andrea has fallen in love with the beautiful Rosetta, daughter of a rich notable from Capri: but their love is thwarted because Don Antonio, Rosetta's father, would like to marry her to Giorgio, the dissipated son of Donna Rosa, of whom Don Antonio he is in love...
notes: In this umpteenth musicarello, Al Bano and Romina Power once again propose the film version of their wedding, which at the time filled the pages of the magazines. Small parts for television stars such as Pippo Baudo (the title of the film is inspired by one of his songs, which was a successful television theme at the time) and Luciano Fineschi.

title: The Last Rebel
actors: Joe Namath, Jack Elam, Woody Strode, Ty Hardin, Victoria George, Renato Romano, Marina Coffa, Annamaria Chio
description: Hollis and Graves are disbanded Southern soldiers who try to rebuild their lives after the war. When Hollis gets a reward for saving a girl, Graves steals his money and manages to turn the sheriff on Hollis as well. Will Hollis get the better of it? Remained for a long time without distribution in Italy, it then came out with a scam title that imitates a famous film with Terence Hill, even the old character actors Woody Stroode and Jack Elam, veterans of many westerns, do not save it.

title: Suor Letizia - Il più grande amore
actors: Anna Magnani, Eleonora Rossi Drago, Antonio Cifariello
description: Sister Letizia (Anna Magnani), a nun who spent twenty years in the missions in Africa, as soon as she returned to Italy was sent to an island in the Gulf of Naples. He will have to revive a disarmed convent by welcoming some orphans. One in particular awakens his lay maternal instinct, but he will then have to give it back to the real mother.
notes: A beautiful film in balance between Camerini's directorial touch and Magnani's passion. The fact that the subject of Cesare Zavattini and the director himself was dealt with in the script by twelve hands is harmful to the film. All this was born in an attempt to create a female counterpart to the Don Camillo series.

title: Nuns on the Run
actors: Eric Idle, Robbie Coltrane, Janet Suzman
description: Brian and Charlie carry out a major robbery and plan to break away from the rest of the gang and fly to Rio de Janeiro. But they are forced to take refuge in a convent of nuns. Here they disguise themselves as religious. The film comes from Great Britain and grafted some typical elements of English comedy into the comic mechanisms of American cinema, with openly goliardic situations. Direction is, in this sense, quite heavy. Fortunately, the two performers are up to par: Eric Idle, who comes from Monty Python, and Robbie Coltrane (among the performers of "Mona Lisa").

title: Super-rapina a Milano
actors: Adriano Celentano, Claudia Mori, Vittorio Salvetti, Don Backy
description: A group of bandits carry out a spectacular heist by escaping from the roof of the bank in a helicopter. Then the bandits disguise themselves as friars and take refuge in an abandoned convent. Everything works until real friars arrive at the convent. For his debut as a director, he recruits all the elements of the Clan, including his wife and Vittorio Salvetti who was a show organizer by profession. The result is however quite modest.

title: The Foxes of Harrow
actors: Victor McLaglen, Rex Harrison, Maureen O'Hara, Richard Haydn
description: Set in 1820 in the southern United States, the film tells the story of a couple, he a former professional player who has made a position through hard work, she is the daughter of a wealthy landowner. They get married but the married life is not the best: their son dies and the couple splits. They will reconcile. Corruscious and sanguine southern melodrama, with a cast to match.

title: Superfantagenio
actors: Bud Spencer, Luca Venantini, Janet Agren, Venantino Venantini, Julian Voloshin, Lou Marsh, Diamy Spencer
description: Al lives in Miami a little boy who, to earn some money, works at a junk shop. One day, cleaning an old lamp that had been fished out of the sea, a gigantic man materializes in front of him who presents himself as the genie of the lamp, ready to satisfy his every desire.
notes: Despite the charm of Aladdin's fable and the peaceful face and the disruptive strength of the good Bud Spencer, the film has a disheartening technical and narrative level.

title: Superfantozzi
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Liù Bosisio, Gigi Reder, Luc Merenda
description: The history of the West crossed by Fantozzi, from the Earthly Paradise (a second category Adam) to the Crusades (in search of the key to his lady's chastity belt); from Sherwood Forest to the Second World War (a kamikaze, of course), with a series of intermediate stages, a sporting challenge of today and a projection into the future.
notes: There is no lack of tasty episodes, such as winks at cinephiles, but the game doesn't really work: what we see is always "our" accountant, but without a script and without any depth.

title: Supergirl
actors: Helen Slater, Faye Dunaway, Peter O'Toole, Mia Farrow
description: Zaltar, leader of the planet Argo, has lost his blue and gold magic sphere: the Omegaedron. This fell to Earth and ended up in the clutches of the witch Selena. Kara, Superman's cousin, sets out on her frantic search disguised as a high school student. After numerous adventures Kara is about to succumb to Selena's power, but regenerated by Zaltar's energy, she fights hard to recover the Omegaedron.
notes: Director Jeannot Szwarc tells us nothing new about Superman's close relative, already dull as a comic book character. And poor Helen Slater is a very unsteel actress. For enthusiasts only.

title: Superman III
actors: Christopher Reeve, Richard Pryor, Jackie Cooper, Marc McClure
description: The usual villain (Richard Pryor, nenache so bad, who wants to get hold of all the oil in the world) engages our hero in an epic fight. After three episodes, even Superman is pretty tired of saving lives all the time. Here then is that the (brilliant?) Gimmick of the film is to split its personality: at a certain point Superman becomes evil and spiteful, then he heals and the film slips one comic stunt after another to the delight of young and old.

title: Superman II
actors: Christopher Reeve, Margot Kidder, Gene Hackman, Terence Stamp
description: On the Eiffel Tower, Superman saves hostages threatened by terrorists with an atomic bomb. Among others there is also the journalist Lois Lane, of which she is a colleague under the false identity of Clark Kent. Sent into space, the bomb frees three extraterrestrial criminals who swoop down to Earth, come into contact with Superman's arch enemy, Lex Luthor, and together they hunt down the super hero. Made using several shots taken for the first Superman, the film is enjoyable and original. Bravo director Lester, who focuses more on the potential for irony and action than on special effects.

title: Superman IV
actors: Christopher Reeve, Mariel Hemingway, Gene Hackman, Margot Kidder, Mark Pillow
description: After saving the lives of some Soviet astronauts, Superman returns to Earth and decides to destroy all nuclear weapons existing on the planet. But Lex Luthor is lurking: he takes a Superman hair and, starting from that, he manages to reproduce another superhero, the Nuclear Man, with the same characteristics as the original, but totally devoted to Evil. For the fourth (and final) installment of the series, Furie still uses Reeve, but the gimmicks are old and the whole thing tastes like heated soup. Too bad for Hackman, always good, but wasted.

title: Superplatoon
actors: Alberto Wilton, David Arch, William Quaid, Joe Fields
description: A special unit of the US Army is tasked with freeing two counterintelligence agents held hostage in Vietnam by a gang of rebels led by Rolly Budd. The veteran, Major Gordon Smith, at the beginning of the operation must submit to a freshly studied officer, whose ineptitude almost leads to the destruction of the team. Then Gordon takes the lead and things improve. Oliver Stone's film Platoon has nothing to do with it. Released just a year later, this one by Christ Hannah tried to play on the misunderstanding of the word.

title: La supplente
actors: Carmen Villani, Dayle Haddon, Eligio Zamara, Gisela Hahn
description: Called to replace a recently deceased teacher, a young and uninhibited substitute teacher wreaks havoc among the students, but initially prefers that of a colleague to their attention. However, disrespected by the competition of her younger sister, she thinks about it. Exhaustive and sloppy sample of an itchy repertoire then in vogue. He gave the opening to a very rich (?) Final.

title: La supplente va in città
actors: Carmen Villani, Francesco Mulè, Vincenzo Crocitti, Josele Roman, Maria Luisa Ponte
description: Rubina, a village teacher, was "seduced and abandoned" by his boyfriend Carlo. In Rome Rubina traces Carlo and sends him to jail on charges of violence then he gets hired as a maid by a family of merchants where, in skillfully exploiting the art of sex and weaknesses of each of his masters, he takes control of the house and the shop.
notes: Goldoni's pecoreccia and pornosoft variant and pornosoft is among the latest films played by Carmen Villani, a busty stars of Osé films after a discreet singer career.

title: Surcouf l'eroe dei sette mari
actors: Gérard Barray, Antonella Lualdi, Terence Morgan, Genevieve Casile
description: In the Napoleonic era, disillusioned because he was denied the hand of his beloved Maria Cristina Blaise by his father, the French lieutenant Robert left for Port Louis where the governor instructed the young officer to break the naval blockade imposed by the British. With the fast pirate ship "Confiance", Robert, named captain by the governor and nicknamed Surcouf, defeats the British fleet after a long battle.
notes: Adventure film where, in addition to the superficiality of the story and the narrative inconsistencies, there is an amateurish realization

title: Bringing Up Baby
actors: Cary Grant, Katharine Hepburn, Charles Ruggles, May Robson
description: Paleontologist David Huxley, about to get married and about to complete the reconstruction of a dinosaur skeleton, is looking for funding. He meets Susanna, a stubborn but lovable heiress, and from that moment it is a succession of troubles for him. The girl, in fact, even if David does not understand him immediately, decides to marry him ...
notes: One of the masterpieces of American comedy (scripted by Dudley Nichols and Hagar Wilde), a classic of seduction. There are all the mechanisms of laughter: visual gags, misunderstandings, crackling dialogues and above all rhythm. Cary Grant and Katharine Hepburn are in an absolute state of grace. An inimitable film.

title: Bells Are Ringing
actors: Judy Holliday, Dean Martin, Fred Clark, Jean Stapleton
description: An underground betting organizer, an actor, a musician and a girl who runs an answering phone service come up with a story with a happy ending. Judy Holliday's latest film, it is a musical comedy (by Betty Comden, Adolph Green and Julie Style) and directed by the great Minnelli and you can hear it, even if it is not among the director's masterpieces.

title: Susanna tutta panna
actors: Marisa Allasio, Ettore Manni, Sandra Mondaini, Nino Manfredi, Mario Carotenuto
description: The recipe for the all cream Susanna cake is a secret that is handed down from generation to generation by a family of pastry chefs. The latest custodian is the beautiful Susanna (Marisa Allasio), coveted by a jealous boyfriend and by the agent of an industry that wants to exploit the formula.
notes: Marisa Allasio, made famous by "Poveri ma belli", here is more sex symbol than ever. The play is harmless, surreal and almost tender.

title: Suspect
actors: Cher, Dennis Quaid, John Mahoney, Liam Neeson
description: Carl Anderson, a Vietnam veteran who has lived on the road for many years and is deaf and dumb, is accused of the murder of a young secretary, assistant to a magistrate who recently committed suicide. All the clues are against him. Kathleen Riley (Cher), a young and beautiful female lawyer, is put in charge of the case as a lawyer, but little by little she realizes that the story hides something unclear.
notes: Specialist Peter Yates, already the author of successful thrillers such as "Bullitt", juggles with professionalism in building a thriller full of twists and turns.

title: Suspiria
actors: Jessica Harper, Stefania Casini, Alida Valli, Flavio Bucci, Miguel Bosé
description: Susy goes to Freiburg to enroll in a dance academy, but a couple of her classmates are slaughtered in a horrifying way. On the building that houses the school, an old building isolated and immersed in a wood, an ancient curse hangs and the director seems to be in communication with the afterlife. Or rather, with a witch hard to die ...
notes: Dario Argento plays with the roots of horror, the fairy-tale ones. And in the middle of a "Snow White" -type forest, among visionary scenographies, his typical Grand Guignolesco touch is taken to extremes. Twists, unsustainable suspense and music that is really scary.

title: Whispers
actors: Victoria Tennant, Chris Sarandon, Jean LeClerc, Peter MacNeill
description: A woman (Victoria Tennant) comes to kill the maniac who assaulted her. It is self-defense and the case is closed for the police as well. However, it is not closed for her who, understandably, remains quite upset. Things get worse when his attacker comes out, more alive than ever. A Canadian thriller based on a bestseller by Dean R. Koontz. The story is actually a bit far-fetched, but Jean LeClerc is not bad in the crazy part.

title: Un sussurro nel buio
actors: Joseph Cotten, Lucretia Love, Olga Bisera, Alessandro Poggi
description: Little Martino lives in a beautiful country house with his parents and little sisters. Martino, like many children, has an imaginary friend of his, who, however, does not seem so imaginary in the long run. A psychiatrist is summoned to the villa, but after a few days he has a bad end. The glorious Cotten is also involved in this attempt at synthesis between thrilling and psychological horror. The film went to the archives without leaving any traces.

title: Suzanne Simonin, la religieuse
actors: Anna Karina, Liselotte Pulver, Francisco Rabal
description: Forced by her family to become a nun, Suzanne goes through all sorts of troubles. First he finds a despotic superior, then one too complacent, then runs away with a friar and eventually runs away from the friar himself. A masterpiece based on DIderot, Rivette's film had a very troubled fate. Censored and reviled at the time of its theatrical release, it has only recently been possible to see it in its full version.

title: Sweet Charity
actors: Shirley MacLaine, Ricardo Montalban, Barbara Bouchet, John McMartin, Sammy Davis jr., Chita Rivera, Paula Kelly, Stubby Kaye, Suzanne Charny, Alan Hewitt
description: Charity is a girl of life. Abandoned by her boyfriend, she runs into Vittorio Vitale, the famous Italian actor, and spends the night with him. The next day she meets the very complex Oscar who falls in love with her and asks her to marry him, but then thinks about it. For his directorial debut the choreographer Bob Fosse (Cabaret) chooses a musical version, written by Neil Simon, of the Notti di Cabiria. The result is remarkable, but still not up to par with the other films of the director.

title: Sweet Dreams
actors: Jessica Lange, Ed Harris, Ann Wedgeworth, David Clennon
description: Patsy Cline, a young provincial girl, lives in Virginia with her mother, brother and younger sister. Her father left home after he attempted to rape her. To support the family to which her mother's new partner has been added, the girl sings in suburban folk clubs. Patsy soon becomes a celebrity in the world of country music, even as she has to deal with a frustrated husband upset by his father's suicide. Patsy will die in a plane crash.
notes: Karel Reisz conducts without overdoing it, mostly putting himself at the service of the beautiful interpretation of Jessica Lange.

title: Sweet Liberty
actors: Alan Alda, Michael Caine, Michelle Pfeiffer, Bob Hoskins
description: The historian of a provincial town (Alda) wins an award by writing a saga novel set in the period of the War of Independence. The rights to the book are bought by Hollywood producers, convinced they can make a successful film, and a film crew with lead actor (Caine) and illiterate screenwriter (Hoskins) descends into the town with tragicomic effects. Alda also proposes herself as the author in this funny comedy. Great cast.

title: T'amerò sempre
actors: Alida Valli, Gino Cervi, Jules Berry
description: The young Adriana was impregnated and then abandoned by Count Diego. The single mother works in a beauty salon to support herself and her daughter, when a shy accountant, Mario Fabbrini, falls madly in love with her. One day Adriana sees her old seducer who would like to resume the relationship with her, but the employee finds the courage to put him at the door to marry the girl, thus saving her from a life of hardship.
notes: Remake of the homonymous film made by Camerini in 1933, with Elsa De Giorgi and Nino Besozzi in place of Alida Valli and Gino Cervi. Struggling with a typical subject of popular literature, Camerini creates a sober and composed film.

title: Tabù
actors: Matahi, Reri, Hitu, Jean (II), Jules, Kong Ah
description: In Bora Bora, the love between Matahi and Reri becomes impossible when Reri is consecrated to the divinity: the girl is taboo, anyone who approaches her risks death. The two seek shelter on an island ruled by whites, but after some time the priest Hitu joins them and agrees to trade Matahi's freedom for Reri's submission. Murnau's latest film, directed with Flaherty, Tabù combines the nocturnal sensuality of the former with the deep sense of nature of the latter.

title: Le boucher
actors: Jean Yanne, Stéphane Audran, Antonio Passalia, Roger Rudel
description: The butcher Popaul, severely marked by the experience of the war, believes he will find a partner in the village teacher Hélène, but she refuses to commit to a relationship that goes beyond simple friendship. When the bodies of some young women are found, Hélène realizes that the killer is Popaul. The story of the protagonists, entrusted to excellent interpreters, emerges against the background of a valid portrait of daily life in the province. Chabrol stages the eternal story of Beauty and the Beast in a distressing and moving film.

title: Rough Cut
actors: Burt Reynolds, Lesley-Anne Down, David Niven
description: Inspector Willis wants to catch Jack Rhodes, the famous diamond thief. The idea of ??putting a beautiful kleptomaniac after him does not turn out to be very happy, since she falls in love with him immediately. With the help of the Rhodes woman he prepares a grand theft, but Willis awaits him right here. Siegel tries his hand at the end of his career with a yellow-pink. The result is certainly not up to par with his best films. However, the dialogues are brilliant, the ensemble is not without humor and the editing is respectable. The manufacturing was troubled by the contrasts between Siegel and the production.

title: Like Father, Like Son
actors: Dudley Moore, Kirk Cameron, Margaret Colin, Sean Astin
description: The chief of staff of a large American hospital has a daredevil son and aspiring athletics champion. By mistake, a miraculous potion ends up in their food and causes the austere father to squirm at the club and train on the playgrounds, while the son surprises everyone with his scientific preparation. A very obvious comedy with a declining Dudley Moore.

title: Talk Radio
actors: Eric Bogosian, Leslie Hope, Ellen Greene, Alec Baldwin, John C. McGinley
description: Barry hosts the Voices of the Night show for a local radio. He is in telephone contact every time with desperate people of all backgrounds, tormented by the most diverse problems. Helped in his work by his partner, Laura, he fights against all forms of abuse through microphones. Soon Barry becomes a beloved-hated character by listeners, until a tragic conclusion. Bogosian is also the author of the original play. Inspired by the murder of radio host Alan Berg, the film is a denunciation of the aberrations to which the media conduct their characters. Dark and nocturnal, it is one of Stone's least known and best-known films.

title: Days of Glory
actors: Gregory Peck, Tamara Toumanova, Alan Reed, Hugo Haas
description: A group of Russian partisans finds, lost in the middle of the forest, a woman fleeing the Germans: her name is Tamara and she was a famous dancer. In the new situation she will be able to demonstrate all her courage as a partisan.
notes: It is a certain effect to see an American film that glorifies the Russian resistance (it was the time of the anti-Nazi alliance), but the whole film is full of singularities: the actors were all rookies, including Gregory Peck and including Tamara Toumanova, former ballet star Russo, wife of the film's producer who invested a million dollars to launch it but grossed much less.

title: War Drums
actors: Lex Barker, Joan Taylor, Ben Johnson
description: A group of Apaches Indians led by Mangas attack a farm in Mexico where the thieves of their horses had taken refuge. The bandits are killed and the Indians return to their lands after capturing a beautiful girl, Rita, whom Mangas falls in love with and whom he marries, rescuing her from Luke Fargo's aims. Some time later it was Fargo himself, who had become a major in the army, who forced Mangas to sign a peace treaty with the whites. A western without infamy and without praise (from the author of the Joe Palooka series) that someone wanted to read as a forerunner of the issues on tolerance between races.

title: Distant Drums
actors: Gary Cooper, Mari Aldon, Richard Webb, Arthur Hunnicutt
description: Captain Wyatt, whose wife, a beautiful Indian princess, has been killed, contemplates revenge against the rebellious Seminole Indians. After destroying a fort where Indians and smugglers kept weapons and hostages, he tries to escape the pursuers and to bring his men to safety with a forced march through the swamps.
notes: It's kind of a Burma Goal! veered western, one of Walsh's most exciting and epic films and one of Cooper's classic interpretations. The final duel underwater is beautiful.

title: Death Drums Along the River
actors: Richard Todd, Marianne Koch, Albert Lieven, Vivi Bach
description: By secretly using the proceeds of a diamond mine, a doctor manages to keep a hospital in the heart of Africa. Trouble begins when his assistant and a British reporter find out and try to use it to their advantage. A rather modest adaptation of a series of exotic short stories by Edgar Wallace.

title: Tango & Cash
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Kurt Russell, Teri Hatcher, Jack Palance
