description: Two narcotics cops with opposite characters: Ray Tango (Stallone) wears a flawless double-breasted, he is bespectacled and distinguished like a yuppie; Gabe Cash (Russell) is a long-haired man in jeans and with rather hasty methods. They must work together to dismantle a drug trade, but the boss they investigate has them jailed. The two friends manage to escape from the penitentiary through the sewers. The film, directed by Russian immigrant Michalkov Konchalovskij, is pure entertainment and features two colorful characters. A lively variation on the theme of the strange pair of cops.

title: So Dear To My Heart
actors: Bobby Driscoll, Beulah Bondi, Luana Patten, Harry Carey
description: A little boy from the countryside is fighting his evil grandmother.
notes: Walt Disney's first film shot almost exclusively with real actors even if the scenes are frequently mixed with animated drawings.

title: Taps
actors: Timothy Hutton, George C. Scott, Sean Penn, Tom Cruise, Ronnie Cox
description: In the sole interest of real estate speculation, the Bankerhill Military Academy will have to be razed to the ground. Under the leadership of the young Moreland (Hutton), the cadets, all boys from eleven to seventeen, occupy the building ready to resist even with weapons. The narration is not the most accurate, but the film regains interest in the description of the boys who dream of West Point. Next to Hutton, fresh from Oscar after his debut in Common People, two future stars play: Tom Cruise and Sean Penn, the latter making his debut.

title: Turtle Diary
actors: Glenda Jackson, Ben Kingsley, Richard Johnson
description: A bookshop clerk and a childrens writer casually know each other for their common interest in turtles; so they get together for an "ecological" enterprise: to steal three turtles from the London Zoo to set them free in the ocean. An original and ironic ecological film, backed by the brilliant script by Harold Pinter and directed by John Irvin.

title: I tartassati
actors: Totò, Aldo Fabrizi, Louis De Funès, Cathia Caro, Cesare Fantoni
description: Cavalier Pezzella, who owns a large fabric shop, fears an inspection by the Tributary. When this happens, Pezzella tries every expedient to bribe the honest Marshal Topponi. His attempts are in vain, although the shopkeeper also tries to exploit the relationship between his son and Topponi's daughter. Fortunately, social satire is not even mentioned. The film is a collection of duets by Totò and Fabrizi, in which the first is almost always the winner.

title: Tartuff
actors: Emil Jannings, Lil Dagover, Werner Krauss
description: Tartufo is a profiteer who, by cheating Orgone, seduces his wife Elmira and disappears with the family jewels. He will then be unmasked. Adaptation of Molière's text by turned in the triumph of the expressionist style. Splendid use of the camera, which highlights the mischievous game of seduction and the ambiguity that reigns supreme. Jannings in the title role is a disturbing duplicity.

title: Tarzan in Manhattan
actors: Joe Lara, Tony Curtis, Jan-Michael Vincent, Kim Crosby
description: The little monkey Cheetah has been kidnapped by some bad guys hunting for tropical animals to sell to American laboratories where vivisection experiments are carried out. Tarzan rushes to New York to save the faithful chimpanzee: he succeeds, of course, and in addition to this he allows himself to give a good lesson to the cynical scientists who do not respect nature and animals. Star in disarmament, even Tony Curtis is involved in this anonymous short film made with very few ideas (bringing Tarzan to New York had already been done by Richard Thorpe in 1942). Yet Michael Schultz had made a promising start in the 1970s. Sin.

title: Tarzan's Hidden Jungle
actors: Gordon Scott, Vera Miles, Peter Van Eyck
description: Three hunters penetrate the African territory where Tarzan lives. The hunt is forbidden, but they don't give it to intended, not even when one of them puts our lives back. Indeed, deceiving a United Nations doctor, they take a massacre of animals. The natives take it with the doctor, but intervenes Tarzan and puts things right. The story is Banalissim, to the realization of the standard. Vera Miles and Peter Van Eyck in their career can boast much more.

title: Tarzan's Fight for Life
actors: Gordon Scott, Eve Brent, Rickie Sorensen, Carl Benton Reid
description: King of the jungle Tarzan takes the side of white Doctor Sturdy against the sorcerer of an indigenous tribe. The doctor is animated by humanitarian intentions, the shaman instead covers shady trades ...
notes: Tarzan of results, with the muscular Scott.

title: Tarzan Goes to India
actors: Jock Mahoney, Mark Dana, Simi, Leo Gordon, Feroz Khan
description: Kamara, an Indian princess, calls Tarzan: thousands of elephants risk death due to the erection of a dam, and Tarzan leaves her Africa and runs. He runs into a wild pachyderm who, guided by the boy Jai, terrorizes the area, but makes an agreement with the young man and, together, they carry out the rescue operation of the mammoth animals. Tarzan can now return to his original vines. Some new ideas and a different setting than usual are the distinctive features of an adventure that, for the rest, does not differ from the well-known.

title: Tarzan - The Ape Man
actors: Bo Derek, Richard Harris, Miles O'Keefe, John Phillip Law
description: West Africa, 1912. The rich and handsome Jane Parker is in search of her father, an explorer who hasn't given news of himself for some time. After tracking him down, Jane joins him on an expedition to the mountain where the elephant cemetery is located. They soon meet the mythical Tarzan, who kidnaps the woman.
notes: The film was made almost in the seventies of the birth of the character created by Edgar Rice Burroughs (1912); here the director makes his wife Bo the protagonist. Rich, glossy and spectacularly compelling show.

title: Tarzan, the Ape Man
actors: Denny Miller, Joanna Barnes, Robert Douglas, Cesare Danova
description: With the help of a professional hunter, an explorer and his daughter Jane organize an expedition to find the elephant cemetery. On the street they meet Tarzan, king of the forest, friend of animals and future boyfriend of Jane. Pale color remake of the original of '32. Instead of the former Weismüller swimmer there is Denny Miller, a former basketball champion. And in the change we lose.

title: Tarzan and the Valley of Gold
actors: Manuel Padilla jr., Mike Henry, David Opatoshu
description: A tribe of descendants of the Incas managed to steal a large amount of gold from the attention of various invaders. An unscrupulous adventurer discovers that this treasure would be found in a remote location in Central America and immediately organizes an expedition to seize it. But he hasn't reckoned with Tarzan. The Tarzan of the 1960s is Mike Henry, a former American football player. He is no worse than others, even if, as often happens, the best figure is the Mexican landscapes in which the film was shot.

title: Un tassinaro a New York
actors: Alberto Sordi, Anna Longhi, Dom DeLuise, George Gaynes
description: Pietro is a Roman tax collector who involuntarily witnesses a murder. When he goes to the United States to find his son, he is detained by the police for security reasons and, to support himself, he begins to practice his profession as a taxi driver here as well.
notes: Even for Deaf lovers, this film is a real disaster: banal, cloying, bankruptcy even where it would like to be comical. Deaf is little more than a speck, and the script offers no more than sketchy, stumbling skits.

title: La tavola dei poveri
actors: Raffaele Viviani, Leda Gloria, Salvatore Costa, Camillo Pilotto, Memo Benassi
description: The time comes for the annual banquet offered to the poor and there is a large sum of money that everyone thinks comes from the Marquis Isidoro. Which is only partially true: the sum was only entrusted to him and he will have a hard time repaying it. Single act by Raffaele Viviani, written by Viviani himself together with Mario Soldati. The theatrical structure is therefore evident, but the direction of Blasetti feels the same. In any case, an extraordinary filmed document of Viviani's art.

title: Battle Taxi
actors: Sterling Hayden, Arthur Franz, Marshall Thompson, Leo Needham
description: During the Korean War, Captain Edward commands a patrol of helicopters tasked with bringing relief to pilots in distress. His biggest problem, however, is the behavior of one of his lieutenants, a former Topgun who did not swallow the fact that he was assigned to a non-combat unit. Pleasant even if not too original.

title: Taxi Driver
actors: Robert De Niro, Cybill Shepherd, Harvey Keitel, Jodie Foster, Peter Boyle, Albert Brooks, Leonard Harris, Steven Prince, Diahnne Abbott, Victor Argo
description: Travis is a Vietnam veteran marked by the war experience. He suffers from insomnia and therefore gets hired as a taxi driver for the night shifts. In daily contact with the worst of New York, his situation worsens. Rejected by a respectable girl he has tried to court, Travis falls back on violence: armed to the teeth, he organizes a punitive expedition to a sordid brothel, after which he returns to cultivate his solitude.
notes: Palme d'Or in Cannes is the film that Scorsese revealed. De Niro is an "avenging angel" generated by the bad conscience of the United States at the time in full identity crisis. In the role of the girl prostitute a very young Jodie Foster.

title: Tea and Sympaty
actors: Deborah Kerr, John Kerr, Leif Ericson, Edward Andrew, Darryl Hickman, Norma Crane, Dean Jones, Jacqueline de Wit, Tom Laughlin, Ralph Votrian, Steven Terrell, Kip King, Jimmy Hayes
description: From the play of the same name by Robert Anderson, the troubles of the young Tom Lee (Kerr), sentimental and sensitive to culture, viewed with suspicion because for everyone, starting with his father, it corresponds too little to the stereotype of the "macho". Only the wife of the director of the college, Laura Kerr) understands and appreciates the subtlety of soul; it will be she, to help him overcome the anguish of a suspicion of homosexuality, to initiate him into love.
notes: The psychological "game" that constitutes the core of the story is exposed in a narrative anchored to the theatrical schemes, with some excessive length, but supported by a valuable interpretation.

title: The Sheltering Sky
actors: Debra Winger, John Malkovich, Campbell Scott, Jill Bennett
description: We are in 1947. Port is an uninspired musician, Kit is his wife, a writer herself in crisis; together with his friend George (who will later abandon them) they arrive from the USA to Tangier. They try to solve their creative and marital problems through the exceptional nature of the African experience. Port, however, falls ill with typhus and dies. Kit goes on alone: ??picked up by a Tuareg caravan, she has a dramatic love affair with their leader. From the book by Paul Bowles: evocative landscapes and vintage existential anxieties. But Bertolucci was able to do better.

title: Tea for Two
actors: Gordon MacRae, Doris Day, Eve Arden, Gene Nelson
description: United States: 1929. A girl from a good family (Day) promises her ex-boyfriend to finance him a musical, but has the unwelcome surprise of finding herself ruined by her uncle's reckless financial speculations. The money to carry out the business is still found by a secretary who marries a wealthy man. Excellent Doris Day in a musical to remember.

title: Teachers
actors: Nick Nolte, JoBeth Williams, Ralf Macchio, Allen Garfield
description: A young lawyer goes to her former high school to investigate the case of a diploma given to a student who, in reality, cannot read or write. The situation she faces is disastrous and only Alex Jurel, a teacher she was in love with as a pupil, helps her, even at the risk of being fired.
notes: The American school situation described in the film is probably forced; in any case, the story quickly turns into an obvious and rhetorical sentimental drama. Negligible, except for Nick Nolte.

title: The Cobweb
actors: Richard Widmark, Lauren Bacall, Charles Boyer, Lillian Gish, Susan Strasberg
description: The wife of the director of a psychiatric institution wants to have the wallpaper changed in the library room. The administrator is against it, as does Meg who would like to entrust the task to a patient painter. Between intrigues, jealousies and various psychodramas, the director will resolve the situation. A film with an impressive cast, from a novel by William Gibson. Visionary film about madness and creativity, very close to the director's strings.

title: Telefon
actors: Charles Bronson, Lee Remick, Patrick Magee, Donald Pleasence
description: In jargon they are called "sleeper". They are Russian agents sent to the US with the aim of mixing with the population and conditioned so as not to even remember that they are spies. They live in about fifty American cities; they are in the throes of a "mental sleep", but ready to awaken as soon as they hear some sort of password. And upon awakening they have been predisposed to aim at the destruction of important strategic objectives and therefore to commit suicide.
notes: The subject comes from a great book by Walter Wager and Don Siegel makes an almost metaphysical spy-movie, all suspended in an autumnal melancholy and punctuated by a ballad by Robert Frost.

title: Phone Call from a Stranger
actors: Bette Davis, Shelley Winters, Gary Merrill
description: The lawyer Trask leaves by plane to get away from his wife who betrayed him after twelve years of marriage. During the journey he makes friends with three passengers who tell him their tormented sentimental stories.
notes: Celebrating marital love beyond the inevitable storms in this no-holds-barred melodrama scripted by the skilled Nunnally Johnson, with a beautiful sequence tailored to Bette Davis that tops the rest of the cast.

title: Telefoni bianchi
actors: Agostina Belli, Ugo Tognazzi, Vittorio Gassman, Cochi Ponzoni, Renato Pozzetto, Maurizio Arena
description: Marcella comes from Conegliano and goes to Rome to make films. The first approach is traumatic and she ends up working in a brothel. So, thanks to the fact of having met the Duce, he finally becomes a star, but his glory is short and, once fascism has fallen, Marcella will be forced to retrace his steps. Risi's satire is easy-going and the film has lapses of pace alongside funny moments. Even Belli seemed destined to become a star at the time.

title: The Gypsy Moths
actors: Burt Lancaster, Deborah Kerr, Gene Hackman
description: Three acrobatic skydivers: Mike, Brady and young Malcolm, put on a show with their reckless jumps. Malcom hosts friends in his hometown with his uncles and Mike impresses the hostess, so much so that he ends up in bed. Mike performs in a very daring number and decides not to open the parachute; the exercise will be repeated by the rookie, before he and Brady separate.
notes: Slow, melancholy and all on the side of the losers, one of Frankenheimer's best films, with atmospheres reminiscent of the Faulkner of "Oggi si volo". Great interpretations of Lancaster and Kerr. Hackman pre- "French connection" is no exception.

title: The Raiders
actors: Robert Culp, Judi Meredith, James McMullan, Brian Keith
description: Seven Texan breeders see their herds perpetually intercepted by the Indians on the trails heading north. After unsuccessfully asking the Kansas-Pacific Railway Company to extend the line to Texas, the seven start a private war against the Company and end up facing Wild Bill Hickock, Buffalo Bill and Calamity Jane. The matter is about to take a bad turn ... They will be the very first two to make sure that everything ends up for the best. Despite the caliber of the characters, a western of little substance. It was actually a pilot film for a television series, and it shows.

title: The Great Waldo Pepper
actors: Robert Redford, Bo Svenson, Susan Sarandon
description: After the end of the First World War, numerous aviation aces, in order to keep flying, performed acrobatic numbers for crowds looking for strong emotions. Waldo Pepper (Redford) is one of them. Forced to retire, he is recruited to participate in a film about the exploits of pilots in war, in which he will face his former German enemy: it will be their last duel.
notes: The duo Roy Hill / Redford ("The Sting") strikes again with a nostalgic, albeit adventurous, evocation of the heroic times of aviation. Redford's role was right.

title: The Lusty Men
actors: Robert Mitchum, Susan Hayward, Arthur Kennedy
description: Jeff, a former rodeo champion, has to leave the business following yet another accident. He finds work on a ranch, where he meets a couple who are saving up to buy a farm. She convinces her husband Wes to become a rodeo cowboy, offering himself as his manager. Wes is good and quickly earns a lot of money but no longer thinks about the ranch to buy.
notes: A bitter and melancholy contemporary Western, on the ashes of frontier idealism as opposed to the squalor of reality. One of the best interpretations of Mitchum.

title: Tempi duri per i vampiri
actors: Renato Rascel, Christopher Lee, Sylva Koscina, Lia Zoppelli
description: In an ancient castle converted into a hotel, Count Osvaldo Lambertenghi (Rascel) is bitten by a vampire (Lee), and his canines grow too. The film, based on a subject by Edoardo Anton and Mario Cecchi Gori, would like to be the parody of classic vampire films (and at times it succeeds well), embodied here by the presence of the vampire par excellence Christopher Lee who, with Rascel, creates a couple of sure comic effect.

title: The Best of Times
actors: Robin Williams, Kurt Russell, Pamela Reed
description: Jack is a bank official but the memory of a legendary football game that ended in a scorching defeat of the city team is still alive in him. To get the excitement back to town, Jack decides to put the same team together and repeat the game. Little by little he convinces the old players, now all retired, to resume training. An optimistic tale (it could not be otherwise given that the interpreter is Robin Williams) whose moral is: never give up.

title: Modern Times
actors: Charles Chaplin, Paulette Goddard, Henry Bergman
description: A flock of sheep goes to pasture, a crowd of workers goes to the factory. Thus begins the story of Charlot worker, in charge of screwing the bolts. After being used as a guinea pig to demonstrate a mechanism to use to avoid workers' lunch breaks, he returns to the assembly line. There he loses his time and finds himself swallowed up by machines. Fired, he starts a series of occasional jobs, then meets a girl and ...
notes: A great Chaplin against the civilization of consumption, half a century ahead of reality. An almost silent film in the height of sound, but where noises add meaning to images and voices come only from cars and speakers.

title: Firewalker
actors: Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett jr., Melody Anderson, Will Sampson
description: Max Donigan and Leo Porter are two adventurers. They learn of a fabulous treasure hidden in the basement of an Aztec temple. The two, flanked by a girl, Melody, in possession of a magical dagger, set off in search. They are opposed by the natives but, after a thousand adventures, they manage to take possession of the treasure.
notes: Fourth hand history and predictable smashing developments.

title: Summertime
actors: Katharine Hepburn, Rossano Brazzi, Isa Miranda, Gaetano Audiero
description: No longer very young, slightly soured by the zitellaggio, the American Jane Hudson arrives in Venice to spend a period of vacation there. Fascinated by the beauty of the city, Jane also ends up yielding to the ruthless court of Renato, a gallant antiquarian. Jane, however, has the disappointment of accidentally discovering that the man is married.
notes: The protagonist of the film is Venice, photographed and "felt" by Lean without banality. Great Hepburn, bitter and autumnal.

title: Truck Turner
actors: Isaac Hayes, Yaphet Kotto, Alan Weeks, Annazette Chase
description: Trek, a "colored" private cop from Chicago, with brisk manners and an imposing physique, kills on commission Gator, a man of many criminal enterprises. But this fact triggers the reaction of a woman who heads a colossal turnover of spochi business. She hires a whole gang of killers to take out Trek. Reached inside a hospital, the detective transforms it first into a slaughterhouse and then into the graveyard of his opponents. A smug display of the defects of society (sex, prostitution and drugs) and of ferocious violence as a backdrop for the exploits of a brutal "hero" without a shred of humanity.

title: Tempo di villeggiatura
actors: Vittorio De Sica, Giovanna Ralli, Abbe Lane, Marisa Merlini, Nino Manfredi
description: Sentimental events in a hotel a few kilometers from Rome. Dolores, a former dancer married to a businessman, seeks distraction in the arms of a driver. Luciano, a student who prefers to hide that he is the son of the head waiter, falls in love in return with Silvana, a young bourgeois promised to the mature Fabrizio. An elderly bachelor sympathizes with a nubile and undergoes surgery on adenoids to get her hand, who has disdained him since he discovered that, while sleeping, he snores. Screenplay by Age and Scarpelli for a comedy with some good performer, sometimes even pretty, but which mixes exploited ingredients.

title: Tempo massimo
actors: Vittorio De Sica, Milly, Anna Magnani, Camillo Pilotto
description: A well-to-do and brilliant young man welcomes a pretty paratrooper to his villa and ends up falling in love with her. Mattoli of the beginnings, graceful and fast.

title: The Big Clock
actors: Ray Milland, Charles Laughton, Maureen O'Sullivan, George Macready, Rita Johnson, Elsa Lanchester, Harold Vermilyea, Dan Tobin, Harry Morgan
description: Journalist-detective goes on vacation. In a bar he meets his publisher's lover. Shortly thereafter, the woman is found dead; in the house she has an object that the reporter had just bought and then forgotten by her. In reality the killer is the publisher; a dramatic confrontation begins between the two. An excellent noir, one of the most successful of those years, turbid and tense. In the role of the murderous publisher a great Charles Laughton.

title: Il tempo si è fermato
actors: Natale Rossi, Roberto Seveso, Paolo Quadrubbi
description: A student went up to the great dam to replace one of the two guardians, who had to go down to the valley following the birth of his son. Between the boy and the other guardian at first there is embarrassment and coldness, but during a night of storm between the two a sincere friendship is born.
notes: Olmi made his feature film debut with this fake documentary, shot in solitude on the Adamello. The majestic landscape, the silences alternating with the short phrases of the protagonists and the whistling of the wind, the careful study of the two men and then the discovery of dialogue: simple elements for an authentic lesson in great cinema.

title: Rosy la bourrasque
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Faith Minton, Roland Bock, Gianrico Tedeschi
description: Raoul Spaccaporte (Gérard Depardieu), a former boxer, meets "Temporale Rosy", a massive wrestler, and follows her on her tour. The relationship isn't easy, plus there's Mike, the loving coach Rosy owes everything to. The couple argues, the proud Raoul tries disastrously to return to the ring, but even Rosy suffers a humiliation. The environment and the characters of the "muscular circus" are masterfully painted by Monicelli, who keeps the comedy in a skilful balance between pathetic and comic. Guess the protagonists, the very fine interpretation of Gianrico Tedeschi, character and narrator of the story.

title: Krasnaya palatka
actors: Claudia Cardinale, Sean Connery, Hardy Krüger, Peter Finch
description: On 25 May 1928 the "Italia" dirigible, commanded by General Umberto Nobile, flies over the North Pole. As it was impossible to land due to bad weather conditions, the return journey began, but the vehicle crashed to the ground. The problem is saving the survivors. Italian-Soviet co-production with all the defects of the case, starting from the stoned cast and the soporific rhythm.

title: Il tenente dei carabinieri
actors: Enrico Montesano, Nino Manfredi, Massimo Boldi, Marisa Laurito, Claudio Botosso
description: Carabinieri lieutenant Duilio Cordelli (Montesano) is investigating a traffic of one hundred thousand counterfeit banknotes (they have also given him one). The investigation is intertwined with that of a billionaire theft. The lieutenant suspects (rightly) that the two cases are connected.
notes: In the wake of the success of "I due carabinieri", Ponzi has created a discreet detective comedy, keeping the comedy of the two protagonists in check. The cast of character actors is also excellent.

title: Una tenera storia
actors: Annie Papa, Richard Sauer
description: Mature lover of a primary hospital meets a determined young man, who in turn has another story. Sentimental swing with black ending. Already king of "quality" porn, Joe D'Amato (aka Aristide Massaccesi) has given himself from the 1980s to horror and softcore, where the lack of "topics" is discounted.

title: The Tender
actors: John Travolta, Ellie Raab, Tino Larriva, Richard Edson
description: With no job and no money, Bobby has to raise his little girl. Seek help from brother-in-law Cissy who is a little good. He lures Bobby into dog fights, practically trying to eliminate him in order to get hold of his granddaughter. This, for its part, secretly cures a Doberman, given up for dead after a fight: the dog becomes his best friend. Harmon had debuted with The Hitcher, but this second test was not as successful. The main idea of ​​the film is none other than that of friendship between two innocent men under threat: the dog and the girl.

title: Le solitaire
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Michel Creton, Michel Beaune, François Dunoyer
description: Police Commissioner Stan (Belmondo) and his friend Inspector Simon, during a normal patrol tour, come across Schneider, a dangerous wanted man. The unsuccessful attempt to arrest the delinquent causes a gunfight in which Simon is killed. It takes two years for Stan to track down Schneider and bring him to justice. The film is tailor-made for Belmondo who, once again, plays the role of the lonely policeman who fights against bureaucracy but who, at the same time, practices a kind of private violence.

title: Le tentazioni del dottor Antonio
actors: Peppino De Filippo, Anita Ekberg
description: What happens to the old sexophobe who tears off the "risque" covers of newspapers from newsstands if a billboard with the busty Anita Ekberg in full carnal splendor suddenly stands right in front of his house? In the course of his battle against the cartel's "immorality", the professor even receives (in a dream) a visit from the woman.

title: Teodora imperatrice di Bisanzio
actors: Gianna Maria Canale, Georges Marchal, Irene Papas, Renato Baldini
description: The Emperor Justinian (Marchal) is under the control of the patricians; while he wanders incognito among the crowds of a poor neighborhood of Byzantium he meets Teodora (Canale), a prostitute, with whom he falls in love. Once on the throne, the woman displays extraordinary political qualities: she saves the throne of her husband and deeply reforms the state.
notes: The memorable scene: Theodora in the racecourse driving a chariot. Gianna Maria Canale had the most beautiful eyes of Italian cinema and the magnetism of a Hollywood star. Freda conducts (in color) with supreme mastery.

title: Tepepa
actors: Tomas Milian, Orson Welles, John Steiner, Luciano Casamonica, José Torres, Anna M. Lanciaprima, Paloma Cela
description: Dissatisfied with the Madero government, the peon Tepepa continues to fight against the regular troops together with a group of loyalists. He clashes several times with the cruel general Cascorro, but is also persecuted by the English doctor Price eager to avenge a girl whose death was caused by Tepepa himself. Cascorro manages to injure Tepepa, but in the decisive battle he is killed by the revolutionary. The doctor will have his revenge, but others will continue the revolution. Orson Welles makes his debut in the Italian western, in a film written by Franco Solinas and Ivan Della Mea who were inspired by the typical themes of '68.

title: Tequila Sunrise
actors: Mel Gibson, Kurt Russell, Michelle Pfeiffer, Raul Julia
description: Nick is a lieutenant in the narcotics section on the trail of Dale, his high school friend. Dale, known as Mac, is a drug trafficker who wants to get out of the "loop". Nick believes him, but a colleague of his, ambiguous and corrupt, seems to be mad at Mac. Following the movements of his friend, Nick begins to frequent Jo Ann's restaurant, which he falls in love with and which he would like to steal information about Mac. Thriller with a disjointed plot, often incomprehensible. Even the cast, on paper made up of excellent actors Gibson, Russell and Julia's sardonic Carlos, with the bewildered Pfeiffer is completely wasted. Great competition of teeth and wide blue eyes between the two alleged friends. And nothing more.

title: Letting Go
actors: John Ritter, Sharon Gless
description: Two New Yorkers, whose sentimental lives have been put to the test, learn to get to know each other better during a collective psychotherapy session. Will a new love story be born?

title: Beyond Therapy
actors: Jeff Goldblum, Christopher Guest, Glenda Jackson, Julie Hagerty
description: Bob is a homosexual who lives with Bruce, of whom he is very jealous. However, he intends to share his life with a woman as well. Bob, in full crisis, is entrusted to a psychoanalyst, who treats him with bizarre but effective methods. Bruce will be able to bond with one woman, Bob will be with another. Sarcastic comedy directed by Altman, which dismantles the all-American myth of psychoanalytic sessions. Amazing the interpretation of Goldblum in the role of Bruce and that of Glenda Jackson as a psychoanalyst.

title: Teresa
actors: Serena Grandi, Luca Barbareschi, Eros Pagni, Flora Carosello
description: Teresa, suddenly widowed, discovers that her husband owed a large sum of money to a certain Nabucco, a businessman of few scruples. Nabucco, falling in love with the busty Teresa, proposes to marry him as a "balance" of the debt. But the indomitable woman does not accept and, with the help of Gino, an expert truck driver, she drives a truck.
notes: Risi has certainly made better films. This is without rhyme or reason, populated by the usual specks, proceeds by clichés and banalities. Barbareschi aside, Serena Grandi always oversized.

title: Teresa la ladra
actors: Monica Vitti, Stefano Satta Flores, Michele Placido, Carlo Delle Piane
description: During the Fascist period Teresa Numa leaves her father's house crowded with too many children. In a whirlwind of events, she changes her job several times, becomes a mother, wife and, due to the war, a widow. Teresa, however, continues her wandering life even after the conflict, between different men, stays in prison, where she ends up when she binds herself to bad people, and even in a mental hospital.
notes: Melancholic comedy by one of the best Italian cinematographers. From a novel by dacia Maraini.

title: Teresa Venerdì
actors: Adriana Benetti, Vittorio De Sica, Anna Magnani, Irasema Dilian
description: A young doctor, a health inspector in a women's orphanage, arouses deep sympathy in the heart of one of the guests, Teresa Friday, a poor foundling of fervent talent and an excellent heart. The doctor is not a bad boy, but a bit on strike; he is in debt, entangled in a relationship with a songwriter, engaged to a presumptuous girl. At the start it was a classic "Hungarian" comedy, but the young De Sica gives it an uncommon grace.

title: The Terminator
actors: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Linda Hamilton, Michael Biehn, Paul Winfield, Brian Thompson, Lance Henriksen, Bess Motta, Bill Paxton
description: A terminator, a deadly human-like machine, is sent from the future to kill Sarah. The woman's only fault: her son will become the leader of the resistance led by mankind against the machines that remained masters of the world after the nuclear catastrophe. Cameron's film draws attention to the truly breathtaking rhythm and the particular effectiveness of the special effects, spectacular but also functional to the narration. Born as a small science fiction film, the film became a cult movie and launched Schwarzenegger.

title: Terminator 2 - Judgement Day
actors: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Linda Hamilton, Edward Furlong, Robert Patrick, Joe Morton
description: At the center of the sights of a cyborg killer, the terrifying T-100, is Sarah Connor's son. Sarah attempts to carry out her plan to eliminate the "Skynet" plans, the program from which the future, evil cyborgs will emerge. The Terminator and T-100 finally arrive at the decisive duel.
notes: Cameron puts all his directorial virtuosity into it; Winston & Muren's special effects are mind-blowing; Schwarzy is cleverly recycled by becoming the hero of the situation; the submerged meaning of the saga is enriched again. Great show, even if the old "Terminator" wins in charm.

title: The Land That Time Forgot
actors: John McEnery, Doug McClure, Susan Penhaligon
description: We are in 1916. A German submarine running out of fuel crosses a channel, penetrates Antarctica to an unknown land, populated by primitive people and antediluvian animals. On board, with the soldiers, there are some travelers who were on the last sunken ship. Between them and the Germans there seems to be a certain harmony motivated by necessity, but not everyone agrees. From a novel by E. R. Burroughs, the inventor of Tarzan, an adventurous-fantastic of normal workmanship and vintage special effects.

title: Far Country
actors: James Stewart, Ruth Roman, Corinne Calvet, John McIntire
description: Jeff (Stewart), with Rhonda's help, brought a herd into Canada; However, he clashes with the merchant Gannon who has him arrested on a false accusation. Rhonda, who owns a nightclub, manages to get him out of jail; the population, tired of Gannon's abuses, asks Jeff to become sheriff. The man refuses, but a girl in love with him pushes him to change his mind. Mann, a director specializing in the western landscape, gives his best in this story set in the snows of the Great North. More melancholy than adventurous, with an anti-hero Stewart at the center, such a jewel.

title: Billy the Kid
actors: Robert Taylor, Brian Donlevy, Ian Hunter, Mary Howard
description: Giving up to the life of the outlaw after avenging the killing of his father, the young Billy called the Kid, is led back to the right path by his friend, Jim. But when Keating, the farmer he works for, who is also the sheriff, is killed, Billy wants to avenge him, but Jim has him locked up in prison. Remake of King Vidor's 1930 film of the same name, it is a good western, which effectively outlines the Kid's biography. In the main and tragic role, Taylor is very good, albeit a bit old for that part.

title: Il terribile ispettore
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Francesco Mulè, Didi Perego, Agostina Belli
description: Paolo De Angelis, a simple hospital porter, gets kicked out because he behaves like a doctor. His ambition that pushes him to become a real doctor, despite having no diplomas and a degree, pushes him to enter that environment that he likes so much. With his chutzpah and inventing all sorts of lies, he manages to get into the mutual fund management after having a friend's graduation certificate photocopied.
notes: Unsuccessful attempt at social satire, with well-known gags and non-existent comedy.

title: Murders in the Rue Morgue
actors: Jason Robards, Herbert Lom
description: An actor who plays in the theaters of Grand Guignol (dark dramas with staging of bloodshed and other horrors) is found killed, his face disfigured by vitriol. This murder was followed by others, all scored in the same way. The impresario improvises himself as a detective and discovers that at the origin of all this lies a remote episode of jealousy and blood in which the victims were involved together with the company's lead actress. From one twist to the next, we arrive at the tortured conclusion that overturns everything. Based on a short story by Poe, but the story is more like that of the Phantom of the Opera.

title: Terror on Track Nine
actors: Richard Crenna, Swoosie Kurtz, Joan Van Ark
description: All unsolved murder cases in New York City happen to Lieutenant Frank Janek. The new challenge is presented at the Central Station. There is a man who enjoys killing girls with a singular method: a drug overdose. Janek also investigates with a bit of nervousness because there is a television reporter who does everything to criticize the work of the police. The case then breaks out in his hands when one of the girls who is found dead is the daughter of the homicide chief.
notes: Once again Richard Crenna plays the role of Lieutenant Janek, the character invented by William Bayer. Robert Iscove, the director of the "Flash" series is a certainty.

title: Blind Terror
actors: Mia Farrow, Dorothy Alison, Robin Bailey, Diane Grayson
description: Sarah, left blind after an accident, lives with her uncles. While out on horseback with her boyfriend, the relatives are exterminated by a criminal who loses his bracelet; the mortally wounded gardener reveals the detail to Sarah. Finding the bracelet, Sarah takes refuge with a tribe of gypsies to whom she tells the story. The leader of the nomads thinks he identifies the murderer in one of his own and locks Sarah in a hut; but she escapes, and so she ends up right in the hands of the real murderer. Thrilling not particularly original, which however plays skilfully on the protagonist's handicap

title: Sorry, Wrong Number
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, Burt Lancaster, Wendell Corey, Ed Begley Sr.
description: A rich invalid intercepts a phone call revealing her husband's murderous plans. On the phone, she looks for someone to help her, but nobody believes her. Growing anguish and excellent interpretation by Barbara Stanwyck.

title: Tarzan's Greatest Adventure
actors: Gordon Scott, Anthony Quayle, Sara Shane, Sean Connery
description: Crates of dynamite are stolen, a Kenyan village doctor and radio operator are killed in the raid by a group of adventurers led by Slade (aiming for a diamond mine). Tarzan saves the beautiful Augie, who has crashed with her plane and together with her chases the bandits.
notes: Partially successful attempt to modernize the ape-man film series. Weissmuller, Cita and Jane are missing, but the action is well crafted.

title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
actors: Donald Sutherland, Brooke Adams, Jeff Goldblum, Leonard Nimoy, Veronica Cartwright
description: Extraterrestrials are invading the earth silently replacing humans. The conquest plan is already advanced when Dr. Bennel tries to raise the alarm. It is the first remake of "The invasion of the body snatchers" by Don Siegel (the second is the most recent by Abel Ferrara). Kaufman manages to keep the original from regretting too much.

title: Il terrore dei mari
actors: Don Megowan, Emma Danieli, Silvana Pampanini, Livio Lorenzon
description: Escaped the massacre of the bucanieri operated by the astute and cruel Guzman, a corsair right arm of the governor of Maracaibo, Jacques, swears to take revenge. Collected by Rock, a valiant pirate known by everyone with the nickname "Il Braziliano", Jacques in turn becomes one of the most feared opponents of the Spanish Navy.
notes: Banal Italian -speaking co -production that does not stand out from the other adventure films of the time.

title: The Big Shot
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Irene Manning, Richard Travis, Donald Crisp
description: Bink Berne has spent twenty years in prison for three different sentences and, when he gets out, he can't find a job. There are those who try to suck him into the crime scene, but his ex-lover, Lola, who despite having married a criminal lawyer still loves Bink, dissuades him. Despite this, the man will find himself embroiled in an increasingly dramatic situation that will lead to tragedy for all the protagonists. A "noir" of dark denial of all hope, but with a very complicated and improbable plot. Neither the director nor the performers are able to save the film.

title: Trog
actors: Joan Crawford, Michael Gough, Thorley Walters
description: A scientist takes care of a troglodyte who would be the link between ape and man. But rock music infuriates the strange being who runs away and sows fear in London. Joan Crawford's latest film.

title: Silent Rage
actors: Chuck Norris, Ron Silver, Steven Keats, Toni Kalem
description: The multiple murderer John Kirby is wounded by the police and transported dying to hospital. Two doctors decide to test a new drug on him that acts on the genetic structure. The experiment succeeds and the brute is not only saved, but even becomes indestructible. It will take a Texan sheriff to neutralize him, but perhaps not permanently. Another absurd story, one of the most unhappy of his career, for B-series action movie star Chuck Norris.

title: Wheels of Terror
actors: Joanna Cassidy, Marcie Leeds, Dean Snyder, Carlos Cervantes
description: It is the story of a chase between a school bus and a black sedan around the mountains of Arizona. At the helm of the school bus there is a single mother who twenty years earlier had been kidnapped by a maniac. In the sedan is his daughter together with a man accused of child molestation.
notes: The story seems distantly related to that of Steven Spielberg's "Duel", except this time we know very well why the car is being chased and we are also inclined to think it is right. Beautiful television debut by Christopher Cain who had already made himself known at the cinema with "The Principal" and "Young Guns". Great suspense until the end and good action sequences.

title: Time Bomb
actors: Glenn Ford, Anne Vernon, Maurice Denham
description: A saboteur puts a bomb on the train going to Portsmouth. The train is diverted to a secondary station and the thug is arrested, but it will take a long time to get him to talk. Discreet suspense movie.

title: Whatever Happened to Aunt Alice
actors: Geraldine Page, Ruth Gordon, Rosemary Forsyth
description: Widowed, Claire Marable discovers that following the wrong speculations of her late husband, what must have been a large inheritance, is reduced to a collection of stamps and some odds and ends. Unable to give up her luxurious life, she kills the maid by stealing her savings. He performs the same operation with the second, and intends to continue. A thriller based on a novel by Ursula Curtiss, it builds a story full of suspense, photographed by the great Joe Biroc and supported by excellent actors.

title: Terzo canale - Avventura a Montecarlo
actors: Gabriella Giorgelli, Mal, New Trolls, I Ricchi e Poveri
description: Billy, Joe, Wegg and Pino are the four members of the musical group "The Trip" and leave Rome aboard a pickup truck for Monte Carlo, with the intention of participating in a singing festival. Although the famous singer Mal comes to their aid repeatedly, the four don't make it very far. After various misadventures they find themselves back at the starting point, in Rome, where they try to participate in a "pop" concert organized by an important radio station.
notes: The fragmentary tale is a pure excuse to celebrate the heyday of Italian pop rock, with Mal from the Primitives and the New Trolls all at the height of success.

title: Q & A
actors: Nick Nolte, Timothy Hutton, Armand Assante, Patrick O'Neal
description: Mike Brennan is the toughest lieutenant in the NYPD. One capable of shooting point blank at a Puerto Rican thug if he thinks it's right. The investigation that follows, entrusted to the young Al Reilly, should be a mere formality, at least so the chief of police himself suggests. But Al doesn't let himself be intimidated and, at the end of his investigation, he discovers that the world is far more corrupt than he thought. The plot of this film is quite complicated, which is a sort of ideal sequel to Lumet's own Prince of the City. Only here, after a promising start, the film gets lost.

title: The Third Man
actors: Orson Welles, Joseph Cotten, Alida Valli, Trevor Howard, Paul Hörbiger, Ernst Deutsch, Erich Ponto, Siegfried Breuer
description: The war has just ended and Canadian writer Holly Martins travels to Vienna to meet his old friend Harry Lime, only to learn that the man is dead. Not trusting the official investigation, Holly begins her research and discovers that there was a third person at the time Harry died. Then he seems to meet his friend, but he is only a shadow and runs away immediately. Gradually the truth comes out. Classic thriller written by Graham Greene, with Welles appearing only halfway through the film and doing a sublime monologue in defense of evil. Unforgettable the post-war Vienna divided into three, the famous tune by Anton Karas, played by the zither, the final glances between Cotten and the Valli. Reed's style seemed suspiciously influenced by director Welles's style.

title: The Skull
actors: Peter Cushing, Christopher Lee, Patrick Wymark
description: Professor Maitland, collector and lover of black magic and demonology, obtains a book on the life of the Marquis De Sade bound in human skin. Then the skull of the divine marquis stolen from his tomb by a phrenologist who later died under mysterious circumstances. Maitland will also die under the evil influence of the cursed skull. Operator for Powell and Pressburger ("The Fox") Francis signs a baroque and sadistic horror with great camp taste, in which two sacred monsters of British horror are confronted.

title: The Treasure of the Golden Condor
actors: Cornel Wilde, Constance Smith, Finlay Currie
description: In the 18th century, the illegitimate son of a noble, Jean Paul, is persecuted by his uncle, Marquis of Saint Malot, who treats him as his servant. Now an adult and in love with the marquis Maria, Jean Paul rebels and embarks for South America, where he finds wealth and true love. Swashbuckling swashbuckling but too naive, directed by a master of the western.

title: The Big Trees
actors: Kirk Douglas, Eve Miller, Patrice Wymore, Edgard Buchanan
description: Fallon, an unscrupulous California lumberjack trader, is trying to seize all of the woodland exploitation concessions that a recent federal law has expired. To counter his shady plans, however, there are Alicia, daughter of the old woodcutter Bixby, and Yukon, an elderly and expert trapper. The death of Bixby, of which he is unjustly accused, opens the eyes of Fallon, who later works to get the lumberjacks back in possession of their properties.
notes: Highly dramatic film supported by a cast to the height, with a Kirk Douglas in a role very suited to his characteristics.

title: The Treasure of the Sierra Madre
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Walter Huston, Tim Holt, Barton McLane, Harry Vejar
description: Fred Dobbs is a jobless tramp. He meets an old gold digger and begins to work hard following, with him and another man, a new trend. In a short time they collect a good fortune, but Dobbs wants to keep everything to himself: he hits his partner and runs away. However, he is attacked by Mexican bandits who kill him to rob him, but, ignoring the value of that yellow powder, they throw it away to keep his tools and mounts.
notes: From the novel by the mysterious B. Traven, one of John Huston's masterpieces, well supported by Bogart who is also very good as a negative hero. Greed is the worst of evils and blind fate does the rest. The just man has nothing left but death.

title: Treasure of Matecumbe
actors: Johnny Doran, Billy Attmore, Vic Morrow, Robert Foxworth, Peter Ustinov, Joan Hackett
description: The family estate where young Davie lives is burdened with mortgages. His only hope lies in a treasure hidden by his father in Florida. Among brigands, Ku Klux Klan and Seminole Indians, the boy reaches the swamp of Matecumbe and finds the treasure. Discreet Disney adventure film with some reference to Treasure Island. The best thing, however, is the peaceful Ustinov in the role of the charlatan, seller of miracle potions.

title: The Big Steal
actors: Robert Mitchum, Jane Greer, William Bendix, Ramon Novarro
description: Lieutenant Durke is accused by Captain Blake of stealing the regimental chest, even though he proclaims himself innocent. He manages to escape to prove the truth, but must escape the pursuit of Blake on the one hand and the real perpetrator of the theft on the other. The escape continues until the final twist. But Durke, also thanks to the help of a beautiful girl, will be able to unmask his persecutors. One of Don Siegel's classic films, with fast paced, breathtaking scenes and a great Mitchum. Jim McBride recently directed a remake starring Rosanna Arquette.

title: She's Having a Baby
actors: Kevin Bacon, Elizabeth McGovern, Alec Baldwin
description: Jefferson Bridges, a dissatisfied advertiser and aspiring novelist, is recently married. After the euphoria of the honeymoon he finds himself facing the everyday life of a couple in the suburbs of Chicago. When a future fatherhood arrives, he realizes he is not ready for the role of husband and father. Hughes, director and screenwriter, chooses here a medium tone, tinged with a bit dull humor. However, the interpretation of the actors is valuable.

title: Honey, I Shrunk the Kids
actors: Rick Moranis, Matt Frewer, Marcia Strassman, Kristine Sutherland
description: In the attic of the house, the eccentric Wayne Szalinski (Moranis) has developed a beam that makes objects smaller. Due to a trivial accident, his children Amy and Nick are miniaturized together with the two children of the neighbors and must face the thousand dangers of the backyard: from the attacks of gigantic insects to the action of deadly motor mowers. Disney production in which the newcomer Joe Johnston takes up with fun and beautiful special effects the idea that already belonged to Dr. Cyclops, a 1940 horror.

title: Tesoromio
actors: Johnny Dorelli, Sandra Milo, Zeudi Araya, Renato Pozzetto
description: Enrico is a playwright afflicted by many calamities: his arid inspirational streak, his vocation for failure, an entrepreneur who uses his failures to defraud the taxman and who imposes his lover as an actress (bad), the debt collectors always lurking. Salvation comes in the shoes of a fake black maid, beautiful and very rich, who also manages to perform the miracle of making him write a successful comedy.
notes: On the other hand, the director does not succeed in the miracle of saving his comedy from a final bath of molasses, but the film must be recognized as having moments of witty comedy, thanks also to the good form of Dorelli and Pozzetto.

title: Testa o croce
actors: John Ericson
description: Accused of murder, Shanda is raped and abandoned in the desert by two assistant sheriffs. An outlaw saves her who will make Shanda a free and rich woman. Overloaded and grungy western-spaghetti written and directed by the mediocre Pierotti.

title: Teste di quoio
actors: Philippe Leroy, Christian De Sica, Daniela Poggi, Leo Gullotta, Bombolo
description: Four terrorists are in Rome to carry out an attack on an embassy. The plan is triggered, but the goal is blatantly wrong: the embassy has moved elsewhere. In the meantime, the alarm has been raised and the house is surrounded by anti-terrorist troops. Dialogue is attempted, but the alleged interpreter who is supposed to establish contact does not actually understand anything of the language spoken by the four. Despite a few more claims, we are in full movie joke.

title: Perfect Witness
actors: Brian Dennehy, Aidan Quinn, Laura Harrington
description: A man casually witnesses a settling of scores between criminal gangs. Immediately inform the police of the incident. From that moment, however, a real nightmare begins for him because he is heavily threatened. The threats have their effect and the man withdraws his statements: the prosecutor, however, at this point, throws him in jail for perjury. The film was warmly received by American critics who especially praised the interpretation of the actors. It is also positive to tackle the problem of individual responsibility towards society in no uncertain terms, and the weight that this can have in a man's life.

title: Witness for the Prosecution
actors: Ralph Richardson, Deborah Kerr, Beau Bridges, Diana Rigg
description: An elderly lawyer agrees to defend a man accused of murder. At first glance, it appears that the most dangerous witness for the accused is his own wife. The lawyer, however, manages with skill and thanks to the intervention of a mysterious woman to dismantle the castle of the prosecution and to have his client acquitted. Television production, based on the script that Billy Wilder and Harry Kurnitz wrote for Billy Wilder's film of the same name from a play by Agatha Christie. Good cast.

title: Witness for the Prosecution
actors: Marlene Dietrich, Charles Laughton, Tyrone Power, Elsa Lanchester
description: Sir Wilfrid Roberts should stop being a lawyer, he is no longer old enough to be in court and he no longer has the physique even to drink as claimed by the nurse who lovingly takes care of him. But there is one case that irresistibly attracts him: there is a woman who with her testimony could have her husband convicted of murder. From a play by Agatha Christie. Plot full of twists like few others in the history of cinema. Marlene is wicked, perfect and adorable. Laughton has a monocle capable of piercing.

title: Le témoin
actors: Alberto Sordi, Philippe Noiret, Roland Dubillard
description: The Roman painter Antonio Berti goes to Reims for a restoration. Casually witnesses the murder committed by a friend of his, Robert, but does not report him to the police. Robert is killed for other reasons but police suspicions fall on the Italian painter who is sentenced to death. No one believes his attempts to have the trial reviewed, also because Robert's relatives manipulated the evidence to save the family's reputation.
notes: Mocky proves once again biting in describing the secret vices that hide behind the respectability of the French bourgeoisie, even if the film has somewhat easy narrative junctions. Sordi strives to go against his own image, in part succeeding.

title: Il testimone
actors: Roldano Lupi, Marina Berti, Ernesto Almirante
description: A man, presumed murderer, is about to be sentenced to death. The sentence came thanks to the testimony of a witness. But the latter, no longer sure of the infallibility of his testimony, retracted. Author of both the subject and the direction, Pietro Germi, in his first work, turns to noir atmospheres rather than neorealistic ones.

title: Blind Witness
actors: Victoria Principal, Paul Le Mat, Stephen Macht, Matt Clark, Tim Choate
description: A man who was supposed to testify before the Commission of Inquiry, which is investigating certain union activities, is found dead. Kathy Allen, a singer who works in nightclubs witnesses the crime by chance, is attacked by the killer who, after trying to kill her, escapes. The girl takes refuge in Hollywood, where she is forced to sing under an assumed name. A private detective, Stuart Bailey, tracks her down.
notes: Professional film, which apart from Efrem Zimbalist jr, does not even have a cast of good actors on its side.

title: Il tetto
actors: Gabriella Pallotta, Giorgio Listuzzi, Gastone Renzelli, Angelo Bigioni
description: Luisa is a waitress and Natale is a bricklayer. They love and marry, but living in his relatives' house is a hell in which it is never possible to find a moment of intimacy. Luisa learns that in certain areas of the city it is possible to build an illegal house as long as it is built in one night and has a roof.
notes: The screenplay is by Zavattini and the film has a vague neorealist flavor, but with less impact.

title: Tex e il Signore degli Abissi
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Carlo Mucari, William Berger, Flavio Bucci
description: Tex and his inseparable friends Tiger and Carson have to face, on the prairie, a mysterious enemy equipped with a deadly weapon that causes instant death, mummifying the victims. He is the Lord of the Abyss, the evil leader of the Yaquis Indians who are preparing a revolt against pale faces. Tessari, specialist in adventure films, takes on the difficult task of enlivening the character of Gianluigi Bonelli's famous comic on the screen. The enterprise was only partially successful, and too much respect for the original produces boredom.

title: The Outlaw Josey Wales
actors: Clint Eastwood, Chief Dan George, Sondra Locke
description: Josey Wales, a former Texan farmer and soldier of the Southern army, does not give up to the Yankee victors: especially if they are represented by Terrill and his gang, already massacres of his wife and son. He goes into hiding in the company of Jamie, a boy friend of his in the war, escapes various types of bad guys and leads a small group of outsiders to a new life.
notes: Clint Eastwood directs a well-paced film that combines Sergio Leone's lesson in deconstructing the western with an original vein of lyricism, linked to the Fordian tradition. Inspired by a true story.

title: Texas addio
actors: Franco Nero, Alberto Dell'Acqua, Elisa Montes, José Suarez
description: Sheriff Burt leaves with his brother Jim in search of his father's killer, a certain Delgado, who in the meantime has grown rich and transformed into a "respectable" person. Once reached, Delgado unexpectedly reveals to the two that he is Jim's real father and offers some money to buy his freedom. We are in the middle of the western-spaghetti season. Baldi, between a cloak and a sword and a Son of Cleopatra, immediately throws himself into it.

title: Texasville
actors: Jeff Bridges, Cybill Shepherd, Timothy Bottoms, Cloris Leachman, Randy Quaid, Annie Potts
description: We are in Anarene, the Texan town of The Last Show, history of hopes and frustrations of young clubs in the year 1951. Now, thirty years later, some have gone, others have messed up, others arranged more or less wellBut the frustrations are greater than the hopes.
notes: Taken from the novel of the same name by Larry Mcmurtry, winner of the Pulitzer prize and already the author of the novel from which Bogdanovich had taken the last show (1971). Bogdanovich signs this following, in which some characters are found (matured, but not really happy)) Of that collective story, and other new ones: but the microcosm is always that and the weather seems to have not spent in this corner of America. However, the result of that time was better.

title: The Black Cobra
actors: Fred Williamson, Eva Grimaldi, Karl Landgren, Maurice Poli
description: A particularly violent New York policeman must protect a young photographer witness of a crime. The killer is the head of the Black Cobra, the most feared gang of motorcyclists in circulation. To defeat him and save the woman, the detective will put the city on fire.
notes: Italian clone of "Cobra" with Sylvester Stallone and Brigitte Nielsen. Bacero and violent but with some effective action scenes. Stelvio Massi is a director specialized in "policemen", Fred Williamson a Blaxploitation star. There is also a sequel, "The Black Cobra 2", directed by Antonio Margheriti.

title: The Dead
actors: Anjelica Huston, Donald McCann, Helena Carroll, Cathleen Delany
description: Every year, on the evening of Epiphany, two elderly Dublin sisters celebrate a party they invite family and friends to, with repetitive rituals, set menus, music and occasional speeches. An Irish musical tune brings up painful memories in the wife of the two sisters' favorite nephew, which continue even after, when the couple retired to their hotel room ...
notes: Taken from Joyce's work, the film is the spiritual testament of John Huston who, already ill and helped by his family (the screenplay is by his son Tony, the lady oppressed by memories is his daughter Anjelica), elevates a lyrical song of the highest emotion at the drama of life.

title: Triple Cross
actors: Christopher Plummer, Romy Schneider, Yul Brynner, Trevor Howard, Gert Fröbe, Claudine Auger, Harry Meyen, Jess Hahn, Bernard Fresson
description: Arrested at home, but soon released from jail taking advantage of the outbreak of war, London burglar Eddie Chapman offers his services first to German, then to British espionage. This is how he gets around the whole conflict; then, in the imminence of victory, he makes a decisive contribution to the English successes, earning a rehabilitation granted with ill-concealed embarrassment. The intriguing ambiguity of the protagonist is barely hinted at; for the rest, the film conscientiously follows the rules of the genre, focusing everything on an enthralling plot and high rhythms, limiting the definition of the characters to the bone.

title: The Elephant Man
actors: Anthony Hopkins, John Hurt, Wendy Hiller, Freddie Jones, Anne Bancroft, John Gielgud
description: John Merrick, who a rare disease has made monstrous, is mistreated and exhibited in a London booth. Collected by a doctor, it intrigues aristocrats and artists, soon conquered by his intelligence and sensitivity. But the unfortunate "elephant man" is not yet safe from the wicked. Lynch's thrilling masterpiece based on a true chronicle and photographed in brilliant black and white by Freddie Francis.

title: The Great Lie
actors: Bette Davis, George Brent, Mary Astor
description: A wealthy woman (Davis), believing her much-loved husband died in a plane crash, offers her rival (Astor), a famous pianist, a large sum of money in exchange for the baby she is carrying. The man (Brent), who has survived, forgives her the lie of having made him believe that she is the real mother. Between two actresses of great temperament, the Oscar went to the one that the story wanted to be "loser", Mary Astor, in a film that had a resounding success with the public. An excellent mélo with a robust structure and, of course, excellent interpretations. Oscar also to the music of Max Steiner.

title: The Last Command
actors: Emil Jannings, William Powell, Evelyn Brent, Jack Raymond
description: In Russia in 1917, Natasha, an actress of the Kiev Theater, manages to make General Alexander (Emil Jannings), whom she is in love with, escape at the cost of her own life. The general witnesses her death and is deeply shaken. A few years later Andreiev, former director of the Theater, is in Hollywood to shoot a film about the end of Tsarist Russia. Among the extras Andreiev recognizes the old general, now a bum, and hires him to play the role of himself. Despite the riot sequence, it's not the best of Von Sternberg's silent period. Based on a subject by Lubitsch. Oscar for Emil Jannings.

title: The Love Parade
actors: Maurice Chevalier, Jeannette MacDonald, Lupino Lane
description: The Queen of Sylvania learns of her ambassador's amorous prowess in Paris, and has him recalled to his homeland to prove for himself if the legends are true. They correspond, and how, and then she marries him. But the prince consort does not intend to bear the authoritarian character of his illustrious consort. The queen will soon have to learn to be primarily a wife. Lubitsch's first sound film. Action and music are wisely intertwined, at the director's famous "touch", in a subtly erotic love story.

title: The Maltese Falcon
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Mary Astor, Peter Lorre, Sidney Greenstreet
description: A beautiful girl goes to private investigator Sam Spade to assign him to carry out an investigation. The policeman accepts and finds himself involved in an affair in which a group of adventurers is engaged in a relentless struggle to take possession of an ancient "prey" of inestimable value.
notes: Adapted from a famous novel by DSashiell Hammett, it is the directorial debut of the screenwriter Huston, an ambiguous and romantic noir, with a perfect cast (Lorre, Greenstreet, Astor). After a long career as a character actor, Bogart was suddenly promoted to lead actor and became a Hollywood legend. In a small part (Captain Jacobi) appears Walter Huston, John's father.

title: The Rocky Horror Picture Show
actors: Tim Curry, Susan Sarandon, Barry Bostwick, Richard O'Brien, Patricia Quinn, Nell Campbell, Jonathan Adams, Peter Hinwood, Meat Loaf, Charles Gray
description: Two boyfriends, Janet and Brad, due to a car breakdown, end up in a sinister castle inhabited by Dr. Furter, a crazy transsexual, who is about to give life to the perfect man: Rocky, blond and tanned. After crazy erotic adventures, the two sweethearts find themselves alone in the night.
notes: Cult film par excellence; delusional, aggressive, almost impossible to tell. Littered with cinematic quotes, it's not a horror nor a musical nor a parody, but all of these things together. For years, night after night, it has been the unmissable appointment, in a hall in Milan, for devoted fans. Like in New York.

title: The Rose
actors: Bette Midler, Alan Bates, Frederic Forrest, Harry Dean Stanton
description: Rose Foster is a vulgar, coarse rock singer. She is also tired, but the tour cannot be interrupted, as the manager explains, because there is three million dollars at stake and a concert in Florida that cannot be canceled. Rose still decides to run away with a former soldier named Huston, her latest adventure. Then Huston leaves her too and Rose meets an old drug dealer friend, so she shows up on stage, but she doesn't go beyond the first piece and dies on stage. The story recalls that of Janis Joplin, the singer who died of an overdose in 1970, and in such a role only an actress like Bette Midler could be convincing. Photography, curated by Vilmos Zsigmond, should not be underestimated.

title: Thema
actors: Mikhail Uljanov, Inna Churikova, Evgenij Vesnik
description: Successful playwright and well regarded by power, Kim Iesienin has long been in crisis: both in his private life (he is separated from his family) and in his intellectual life (too many compromises with the regime). He fled to the province to seek inspiration and peace, but found only bitterness and disappointment there. Produced in 1979, but "thawed" by the Soviet authorities only thanks to the new Gorbachevian course, Thema retraces the stages of an intellectual "via crucis" that is both personal and collective, through the lies of art, the illusions of life and the impossible ransom. The film won the Golden Bear at the 1987 Berlin Film Festival.

title: Thérèse
actors: Catherine Mouchet, Helene Alexandridis, Aurore Prieto
description: A fifteen-year-old Frenchwoman manages, despite her young age, to be accepted as a novice in the Convent of Liseux where she will die still very young. Great ascetic and austere film, made up of blinds, silences and ecstasy. Intended only for true movie lovers. Jury Prize at Cannes and six Césars (French Oscars)

title: This Is Elvis
actors: Elvis Presley, Andrea Cyrill, Debbie Edge, Dolores Hart, Lawrence Koller
description: Reconstruction of the life of singer Elvis Presley with several documentary tracks and with some sequences shot in the studio with actors. The dough doesn't turn out very well.

title: This Is Korea!
actors: Voci di John Ireland, Irving Pichel, George O'Brien
description: It is Christmas 1950, American soldiers are giving chewing gum to Korean children and meanwhile they look around, look inside Ford's camera and ask each other silent questions. It is a documentary about the Korean War in which you never see the enemy, only the cemeteries that the Marines leave behind as they advance. Instead of the triumphant shots of the Quinto Cavalleggeri (from bottom to top) who has always managed to save the day, Ford changes direction and crushes his soldiers against the ground. The off-cold war commentary is almost unbearable, but Ford's gaze is decidedly melancholy.

title: The Incredible Hulk Returns
actors: Bill Bixby, Lou Ferrigno, Eric Allan Kramer
description: David, a young researcher, is accidentally hit in the laboratory by gamma rays and undergoes monstrous variations, becoming the Hulk. Then comes Thor, an ancient Norse god, awakened by an archaeologist who profanes his sarcophagus. The two superheroes combine their powers and place them at the service of justice. These are two characters from the comics produced by the American house Marvel. Recommended for enthusiasts only.

title: Thunder
actors: Mark Gregory, Bo Svenson, Raymund Harmstorf, Valeria Ross
description: A young Native American, called Thunder, by virtue of an ancient treaty defends the cemetery of the ancestors from the bulldozers of the whites. He begins confident of the law, but is soon forced to respond with violence. Ludman, alias Fabrizio De Angelis, smoothly conducts an Italian-style "Rambo".

title: Thunder II
actors: Mark Gregory, Raimund Harmstorf, Bo Svenson, Karen Reel
description: Thunder is an American Indian who works as a policeman. A corrupt colleague frames him for the murder of a drug trafficker and sends him to a hellish prison camp. He breaks free and seeks revenge in the manner of the Indians. Sequel to an Italian copy of Rambo. What to add?

title: Thunder III
actors: Mark Gregory, John Phillip Law, Horst Schön, Werner Pochath
description: Already a defender of tribal rights and a policeman persecuted by racist and corrupt colleagues, this time the Red Indian Thunder neutralizes a gang of whites determined to rob his people. De Angelis conducts his third and last Italian "Rambo".

title: I Love You to Death
actors: Kevin Kline, Tracey Ullman, Joan Plowright, William Hurt, Keanu Reeves, Margaret Margolyes
description: Aside from numerous and systematic escapades, Joey Boca loves his wife Rosalie. Unaware of everything, the woman always thinks that he is at work in the pizzeria. Then one day he discovers his flirtation and decides to have him murdered. Hire two killers as fearsome as ... bunglers.
notes: The tone is grotesque, the contents acidic, the rhythm of the gags remarkable. Lawrence Kasdan - the inventor of Indiana Jones and the director of _The big cold_, _Brivido Caldo_, _Turista per chance_, _Silverado_ and _The Dreamcatcher_ - loves genres and in this case gives his best in comedy. Spectacular as usual William Hurt, effective Ullman.

title: Ti aspetterò all'inferno
actors: Eva Bartok, Massimo Serato, John Drew Barrymore
description: After a robbery, Walter, Sam and Al escape with a large booty. During the journey, a fight breaks out and Walter kills Sam by pushing him into a swamp. Arriving at the hiding place, the two survivors are tormented by the spirit of the deceased who announces his arrival.
notes: Poor work with a dramatic structure grafted onto a story with a vaguely spiritualistic flavor, but which cannot get out of the rails of a calm mediocrity.

title: Ti ho sempre amato
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, Myriam Bru, Tamara Lees, Jacques Sernas, Marisa Merlini
description: Maria lived for years in an orphanage institution; when he leaves, after various vicissitudes, he finds work in the department stores. Here he meets Massimo, a landowner, with whom he has a relationship. Massimo would like to marry her but there is an obstacle between the two: Clara, who is coveted by Massimo's wealth. The scheme is that of the melodramas of Matarazzo (there is also Nazzari), but Mario Costa confirms himself as an excellent popular director and interprets the story in a personal way.

title: Ti ho sposato per allegria
actors: Monica Vitti, Giorgio Albertazzi, Maria Grazia Buccella
description: Pietro is a young bourgeois lawyer who married Giuliana, a pretty nutty girl, met at an artists' party. Despite the premises, everything between the two seems to work best. Even when his mother comes to visit and Giuliana makes up one trouble after another. From the successful comedy of the same name by Natalia Ginzburg, one of the best interpretations of Vitti and one of the best direction by Salce.

title: Ti-Koyo e il suo pescecane
actors: Denis Puhira, Al Kaura, Diana You
description: On an island in the Pacific, a child, named Ti-Koyo, spends his hours in the company of a small shark, renamed Manidù. After a few years, both grown up, they meet again and dedicate themselves to a fruitful activity: fishing for pearl oysters in a secret lagoon, their refuge since childhood.
notes: Based on the novel of the same name by Clement Richter, the film Quilici tells the beautiful tale of friendship between a child and a small shark in the heavenly atolls of the Pacific.

title: Tick... tick... tick...
actors: Jim Brown, George Kennedy, Fredric March, Lynn Carlin
description: The black sheriff has a tough job in the small Deep South town he's been assigned to. Due to his belonging to the black race, he is opposed by the white conservatives of the area; if he is harsh with his people, blacks are the ones who turn against him, despite his repeated assurances that he intends to be absolutely impartial. And he demonstrates this by arresting the son of a white notable who, driving drunk, killed a little girl and a black man accused of rape. The black sheriff character is reminiscent of Inspector Tibbs from the series of the same name, although the actor and filmmaker are different here. But the film has its own pace and vigorous conduct. And the protagonist's persistence in ensuring justice affirms positive civil values.

title: Il tifoso, l'arbitro e il calciatore
actors: Alvaro Vitali, Carmen Russo, Pippo Franco, Mario Carotenuto
description: Two-episode film. In the first, a referee believes that his wife is cheating on him with a footballer, but then discovers that he is homosexual. In the second, a Roma fan pretends to be from Lazio to please his father-in-law; ends up being beaten by the ultras of both teams. The birth of twins will make things right in the family. Two strange stories, without rhythm and with good characters. The Romanist bar in Testaccio run by Carotenuto is quite cult.

title: Harry Black and the Tiger
actors: Stewart Granger, Anthony Steel, Barbara Rush, I.S. Johar, Martin Stephens
description: Taken prisoner during the war, Harry Black lost a leg in a concentration camp to a cowardly comrade. After the conflict, Harry resumes the profession of professional hunter to hunt down the tigers that threaten the villages of India. In the course of a joke and, again due to a companion, he gets clawed by a tiger. At that point, destroyed in morale as well as in physical, he starts drinking. A curious story, in the typical American tradition of wilderness allegory. But the best thing about this adventure melodrama is the Indian landscapes.

title: La tigre dei sette mari
actors: Anthony Steel, Gianna Maria Canale, Ernesto Calindri
description: A pirate known by all as "La Tigre", who flies the seas with the "Santa Maria", decides to leave the command of the ship. It will be a duel between a man of the crew and William to decide the successor. The latter wins, but at the same time is left by his girlfriend, who, among other things, is the daughter of the Tiger. It turns out that the loser is none other than a traitor in the service of a Spanish governor. Depressing adventure movie despite the six hands script. In the cast there is also Ernesto Calindri, out of part.

title: La tigre è ancora viva: Sandokan alla riscossa!
actors: Kabir Bedi, Philippe Leroy, Massimo Foschi, Adolfo Celi
description: The beloved Marianna is dead, the island of Mompracem is lost, handed over by the British to their evil puppet, Sultan Abdullah. Sandokan is in India, in the wild. Encouraged by his followers, aided by the jungle head cutters, flanked by the faithful Yanez, Kammamuri and Tremal Naik, the pirate decides to take Mompracem back. Meanwhile, on the island, the surviving tigers do their part.
notes: A television product (also released in theaters) packaged to exploit the public fortune of the drama "Sandokan" (1976), and in the wake of the short popularity of Kabir Bedi.

title: A Tiger Walks
actors: Brian Keith, Vera Miles, Pamela Franklin, Sabu
description: A tiger has escaped from the circus cage in an American town. The sheriff's daughter tries to convince her father, engaged in hunting the beast, not to kill her. After unsuccessful attempts, the girl opens a subscription to buy the whole tiger family and transfer them from the circus to a zoo. The sheriff first reacts badly to the little daughter's initiative; then, convinced, it will be he who will face the runaway tiger and risk his life just to be able to capture it without killing it. The setting is well cared for, as well as the psychological deepening: a children's film built with good skill.

title: Tigre reale
actors: Pina Menichelli, Alberto Nepoti, Febo Mari
description: Countess Natka (Menichelli), married in Russia to Count De Rancy, responsible for the suicide of a gamekeeper with whom she had an affair, goes to Paris and falls ill with tuberculosis. The love of the ambassador to Paris Giorgio De Ferlita saves her. With the eyes of now, the subject taken from Giovanni Verga can make you smile. But it would be a useless snobbery, also because the beauty of Pina Menichelli is still quite modern.

title: Tiger Shark
actors: Edward G. Robinson, Richard Arlen, Zita Johann
description: Mike and Pipes are two friends who make a living from the hard trade of fishermen, Mike lost a hand during a shark hunt. Mike marries a fisherman's young daughter but she falls in love with Pipes. When Mike realizes this, he devises a plan to eliminate his rival during a fishing trip, but the diabolical plan will have an unexpected end. Under Mike's curly wig and mustache hides Edward G. Robinson "in a state of grace". For its part, the film in a dramatic crescendo stages a classic Hawksian theme: the manly friendship "ruined" by a woman.

title: La discrète
actors: Fabrice Luchini, Judith Henry, Maurice Garrel, Marie Bunel
description: Antoine, a young writer, goes into crisis when he is abandoned by his woman. To take revenge, and find a new starting point, he accepts the proposal of his editor friend: he will have to seduce the first girl he meets, and then abandon her, in the meantime writing the chronicle of this adventure. The victim is an ugly typist, Catherine, who, however, manages to win over Antoine and turn the situation around.
notes: The presumptuous libertine is excellently interpreted by the Rohmerian Fabrice Luchini. The typist is Judith Henry, tender and determined. The film is light without being affected, witty but also cruel. The "shy" indicates a type of woman to be distinguished by the presence of a mole on the chin.

title: Tin Men
actors: Danny DeVito, Richard Dreyfuss, Barbara Hershey, John Mahoney
description: Bill and Ernest do the same job (they sell aluminum cladding for homes) and have the same passion, Cadillacs. But a road accident in which their respective cars are ruined arms them against each other: to take revenge they start a series of mutual teasing. But the clash must end: in fact the town hall has revoked their license due to the too unscrupulous means of sale and the two find themselves out of work.
