Levinson tells with sincerity a world of losers and marginals, with hilarious moments entrusted to the two excellent protagonists.

title: Tipi da spiaggia
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Johnny Dorelli, Christiane Martel, Lauretta Masiero
description: Pasubio Giovinezza, mask of the "Aurora" film theater, is persuaded by some friends to use the money entrusted to him by his boss to go to Taormina, where they will do everything so that one of them manages to marry an American billionaire who owns a chain of beauty. The enterprise fails and to avoid the prison Pasubio and his friends participate, winning it, in the car cup in Taormina. Holiday comedy sponsored by the city of Taormina, supported by the light-hearted direction of Mattoli and a cast of thoroughbred comedians.

title: Il tiranno di Padova
actors: Elsa De Giorgi, Alfredo Varelli, Clara Calamai, Carlo Lombardi
description: Caterina Bragadin is in love with Rodolfo, but the mayor of Padua wants to marry her at all costs. To get rid of his rival he has him condemned by the Council of Ten, the supreme organ of the republic of Venice. Rodolfo is imprisoned but manages to escape in a daring way; he thus collects the proofs of his innocence, unmasks his persecutor and finally marries Catherine. Based on a play by Victor Hugo, the film was made in the studios of Venice (used until recently by the Salò regime) immediately after the Liberation. It hit the screens a few years later, was unsuccessful and almost immediately disappeared from circulation.

title: Tiro al piccione
actors: Jacques Charrier, Eleonora Rossi Drago, Francisco Rabal
description: The young Marco Laudato (Jacques Charrier) enlisted, after the armistice of 8 September 1943, in the armed forces of the Republic of Salò. He will experience firsthand the last shocks of a regime in decay, of a world that history condemns to the disappearance, of an ideology that now generates only ferocity aimed at an impossible survival. Montaldo's debut is articulated on two main bases, the psychological and the social one; the first is supported by somewhat didactic expedients; the second is more convincing, in its historical setting.

title: A Night To Remember
actors: Kenneth More, Ronald Allen, Robert Ayres, David McCallum
description: In 1912 the ship, full of beautiful world but also of poor immigrants, is sailing towards America when it hits an iceberg; the security systems prove inadequate. Women and children are rescued, the orchestra continues to play, but the ship sinks rapidly. Taken from a radio drama, directed by future horror director Roy Ward Baker, with great economy of means creates a remarkable suspense. Many visual solutions will be featured in James Cameron's blockbuster.

title: Tobruk
actors: Rock Hudson, George Peppard, Nigel Green
description: In Tobruk, in the middle of the Libyan desert, there is the fortified depot of the fuel essential to the Germans for their advance. British Major Donald Craig is assigned to lead an expedition to destroy the warehouses. The battle will be very bloody. It's a classic, spectacular war movie, with a solid cast and directing by profession.

title: Toby Tyler or Ten Weeks with a Circus
actors: Kevin Corcoran, Henry Calvin, Gene Sheldon
description: Toby Tyler just can't stand life in the home of grim foster uncles and joins a circus as a helper to a soda vendor. Having entered into the good graces of Ben, "the strongest man in the world", and, having become inseparable companion of Mr. Stubbs, a nice chimpanzee, the boy will have the opportunity to make his debut as a horseman. Classic Disney production, family packaging, good feelings, a trickle of humor, professionalism. Unpretentious but pleasant show.

title: Touch and Go
actors: Michael Keaton, Maria Conchita Alonso, Ajay Naidu, Maria Tucci
description: Bobby Barbato is a wealthy ice hockey player. One evening he suffers an attempted robbery by a man who uses a boy as a bait. The baby is so nice that Bobby takes him back to his mother Denise instead of the police. Love is born between Bobby and the woman. Michael Keaton is the usual "boiled", and the story is obvious.

title: Tolgo il disturbo
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Dominique Sanda, Elliott Gould, Eva Grimaldi
description: Augusto Scribani returned home after a long period in a psychiatric hospital. To welcome him there are the daughter-in-law with the granddaughter and the new partner. The son has separated and is far away. Relations between father-in-law and daughter-in-law are not easy, but the granddaughter Rosa has a great affection for her grandfather and runs away with him. The police find them and the little girl is sent to boarding school while Augusto ...
notes: Author of bad and biting comedies in the sixties, Risi has lately given his best things in these stories with the third age as the protagonist. Bravo Vittorio Gassman.

title: Tom, Dick and Harry
actors: Ginger Rogers, George Murphy, Alan Marshal
description: An office worker, engaged to a worker, dreams of marrying a millionaire who has shown her some attention. To complicate the choice is added a third suitor, a wise philosopher, but it will be he who will induce the girl to make the most reasonable choice, that is to marry the worker. A sparkling comedy entrusted to solid performers.

title: The Tomb
actors: Cameron Mitchell, John Carradine, Michelle Bauer
description: A terrible Egyptian demon returns to activity to punish the profanators of a treasure sacred to the ancients, hidden among the pyramids in the African desert. Pleasant low -cost horror, direct without energy, with a very prolific Fred Olen Ray and played by some of the best stars of B Movie.

title: La casa de las muertas vivientes
actors: José Antonio Amor, Daniela Giordano, Nuria Torray, Gioia Desideri
description: Oliver is convinced that he killed his wife Helen in that house in the park near the cemetery. He tried to escape as much as possible from the place of horrors and death, but he is as if fatally attracted to the house. After his escape, the house was rented by new people, who behave somewhat ambiguously with Oliver. The restlessness turns to terror when the first corpses begin to be found.
notes: Unknown terror film of Spanish origin but flying the Italian flag. It also circulated under another title: "Helen's corpse gave me no peace."

title: The Tomb of Ligeia
actors: Vincent Price, Elizabeth Shepherd, John Westbrook, Richard Vernon
description: Ligeia died promising her husband not to abandon him. When he remarries, his new partner, Lady Rowena, falls victim to a series of terrible events, which seem to have been caused by the deceased. Furthermore, Rowena discovers that Ligeia's body is kept in the basement of the castle. With this film shot in England, Corman closes in style the series of titles inspired by the stories of Egar A. Poe, which began in the 1960s with The Living and the Dead. The absolute master of the scene is Vincent Price, a true tutelary deity of the Cormanian raid among the obsessions of the famous writer. Distressing, baroque and ferocious.

title: Die Gruft mit dem Rätselschloss
actors: Harald Leipnitz, Klaus Kinski, Eddi Arent, Werner Peters, Judith Dornys
description: A girl risks her life to get back a large sum. From an Edgar Wallace novel, the film was part of a series of adaptations shot in Germany.

title: Tombolo, paradiso nero
actors: Aldo Fabrizi, John Kitzmiller, Nada Fiorelli, Dante Maggio, Elio Steiner
description: The starting point of the film is given by an investigation by Indro Montanelli. The war is over and Italy is a heap of ruins. In Tombolo, an area of ??pine forests near Livorno, some American soldiers, deserters, criminals and prostitutes have established their headquarters. A trafficking organization introduces girls to prostitution, unaware of the fate that awaits them; someone opposes, but pays with their life. Bitter portrait of a dramatic situation, carried out according to neorealist criteria. The background exudes a rare sense of truth and the actors act with conviction, both professionals and those taken from the street.

title: Tootsie
actors: Dustin Hoffman, Jessica Lange, Teri Garr, Charles Durning
description: Michael (Dustin Hoffman) is a good actor, but he finds no scriptures. Depressed, he survives as best he can until, for various circumstances, he finds himself doing an audition disguised as a woman, with the name of Dorothy. In these roles she is "chosen" as the protagonist of a television serial. Determined not to miss the opportunity, he begins a double life with obvious complications when he falls in love with a workmate.
notes: This entertaining and sobering comedy is one of the most successful by Hoffman, who produced it, and Pollack, who directed it. Excellent proof of the double-sided protagonist, well flanked by a delicious Jessica Lange, who won the Oscar.

title: Top Gun
actors: Tom Cruise, Kelly McGillis, Anthony Edwards, Val Kilmer, Tom Skerritt, John Stockwell, Barry Tubb, Rick Rossovich, Tim Robbins, Clarence Gilyard, Whip Hubley, James Tolkan, Meg Ryan, Adrian Pasdar
description: Mitchell is a hunting pilot; He follows the training courses to enter the number of "top guns" with the stubborn determination to be worthy of his father's memory, who fell in Vietnam. In spite of the regulation, he falls in love with Charlie, an instructor blonde and his superior; Moreover, he believes himself responsible for the death of his co -pilot.
notes: Great international success for this Reagan clip that made Tom Cruise the rampant different of the forgetable 80s. Spectacular aerial sequences, of course. "Take My Breath Away" by Giorgio Moroder had the Oscar for best song. The film met a sequel released in 2022 always with Tom Cruise: Top Gun: Maverick.

title: Topaz
actors: Frederick Stafford, Dany Robin, Michel Piccoli, Philippe Noiret, Karin Dor
description: In 1962, on behalf of the CIA, the French agent André Devereaux (Stafford) flew to Cuba to gather information on the installation of Soviet missiles on the island. Juanita, the anti-Castro widow of a hero of the Revolution who gives him decisive news, is discovered and killed, but Devereux's mission is nevertheless accomplished. Now, in his country, another task awaits him: to infiltrate and dismantle a spy organization in the service of Moscow, called "Topaz", which includes unsuspected French officials. Shot widely in Paris, New York and Copenhagen, Hitchcock's 51st film mixes cold warfare, thrilling and sentimental intrigue, but lacks the tense pace and suspense of his masterpieces.

title: Topkapi
actors: Melina Mercouri, Peter Ustinov, Maximilian Schell
description: A charming adventurer, Mrs. Lipp, and her partner, organize the theft of a priceless dagger kept with exceptional security measures in the Museum of Constantinople. The band is selected and trained. Despite some hitches, the blow, which requires a meticulous and daring execution, is successfully completed. But a couple of unpredictable events end up ruining everything.
notes: From a great novel by Eric Ambler, Jules Dassin draws an amusing and splendidly interpreted detective story, with paws reminiscent of the splendid "Rififi", of a decade earlier. Great photography by Henri Alekan, Oscar for Peter Ustinov.

title: Topo Galileo
actors: Beppe Grillo, Jerry Hall, Renato Cecchetto, Athina Cenci
description: Giuseppe Maria Galileo (Grillo), a rodent specialist, has to hunt down Siegfried, a radioactive mouse who has escaped from a laboratory. Galileo, to capture him, procures him a companion and a small house. The trick is about to work when Galileo falls into a vat of plutonium; become in turn radioactive, is retained as a guinea pig. A beautiful doctor (Hall) frees him and runs away with him. Anti-nuclear apologue written in collaboration with Stefano Benni in which Grillo takes the whole scene. Inevitable consequence is a certain lack of interest in film writing, but the sympathy of the protagonist is undoubted.

title: Torino nera
actors: Andrea Balestri, Françoise Fabian, Marcel Bozzuffi, Bud Spencer, Domenico Santoro, Elio Zamuto, Mario Pilar, Guido Leontini
description: A lawyer follows in the footsteps of a photograph that can nail the construction builder Tommaso Fridda to murder. More than a denunciation film, an absolute cult for the improbability of events is cast (from Bud Spencer to Nicola di Bari).

title: Tormento
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, Yvonne Sanson, Ernesto Murolo, Tina Lattanzi, Giuditta Rissone
description: Anna (Sanson) loves, loved in return, the young Carlo (Nazzari), but this relationship is frowned upon by the girl's stepmother. Unjustly accused of murder, Carlo is jailed and Anna gives birth to a girl. The two marry, but Anna's father dies and the stepmother forces the young woman to separate from the child and live in a house of correction.
notes: Second episode of a trilogy that had great success in the 1950s. Matarazzo confirms himself as an attentive and capable director. The melodrama made you cry and fascinated.

title: Torna!
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, Yvonne Sanson, Franco Fabrizi, Aldo Silvani
description: Roberto Varesi (Nazzari) loves his cousin Susanna (Sanson). The two have to share an uncle's inheritance with Giacomo, who usually goes to gambling houses and is in turn in love with Susanna. But she marries Roberto, with whom she has a daughter; then Giacomo, to take revenge, makes Roberto believe that he is Susanna's lover as well as the real father of the little girl.
notes: The success of "Catene" had pushed Matarazzo to revive the Nazzari-Sanson couple in other excellent melodramas. The novelty in this case is the color.

title: Lassie, Come Home!
actors: Roddy McDowall, Donald Crisp, Nigel Bruce, Elsa Lanchester, Elizabeth Taylor
description: Left without money and work, a worker is forced to sell his purebred dog to the Duke of Rudling. Her son Joe is devastated at the idea of ??separation, but the bitch also doesn't take it well. In fact, twice he escapes from his new master to return to Joe. The duke, annoyed, decides to take her to Scotland, but for Lassie even the distance from Scotland to Yorkshire is nothing compared to his desire to return home. Apart from the very young Elizabeth Taylor, many other things have made this children's film famous, which has managed to make several generations of adults cry.

title: Come September
actors: Rock Hudson, Gina Lollobrigida, Bobby Darin
description: The American billionaire Robert Talbot (Hudson) usually spends the month of September in his luxurious villa near Florence in the company of Lisa (Lollobrigida), a Roman girl. But a year arrives earlier than usual and he learns that Lisa is about to get married. On his way to the villa, he also discovers that the butler has turned it into a hotel. Tourist comedy with a couple of poorly matched actors, directed by a novice Mulligan.

title: Rooster Cogburn
actors: John Wayne, Katharine Hepburn, Richard Jordan, John McIntire
description: El Grinta is a senior district commissioner that Judge Parker would like to retire for his hasty methods. The last mission is to recover a wagon loaded with explosives stolen by a gang of criminals. With El Grinta are Eula, daughter of a preacher, and a young Indian, Billy. Once again, not even a bandit arrives alive at the court, but Parker decides to reconfirm El Grinta in his role.
notes: Anonymous Western was the penultimate film made by a now sick old John Wayne.

title: Partir, revenir
actors: Annie Girardot, Jean-Louis Trintignant, Evelyne Bouix, Françoise Fabian, Richard Anconina, Michel Piccoli
description: The family of a French Jewish writer, who took refuge in the 1940s with friends in Burgundy, was then denounced and deported by the Gestapo. Only she has returned from concentration camps, determined to discover the perpetrators of the spy ...
notes: After _Bolero_, Lelouch makes another ambitiously "symphonic" film, but exaggerates with sentimentality.

title: The Stranger Within
actors: Ricky Schroder, Kate Jackson, Chris Sarandon, Clark Sandford, Peter Breitmayer, Pamela Danser
description: A widow (Jackson) whose son was kidnapped when he was a child, years later, cannot give herself peace and continues to mull over her mistakes as a mother before and after the dramatic event. On Halloween, young man Luke (Schroder) knocks on her door introducing himself as the son, and telling her how the kidnappers raised him. Could it be true? What is certain is that Luke soon turns out to be a dangerous madman. A thriller that proceeds alternating phases of authentic tension with amateur style falls. Effective characterization of the psychopath made by Schroder, Kate Jackson is definitely over the top.

title: La tour de Nesle
actors: Pierre Brasseur, Silvana Pampanini, Paul Guers, Michel Bouquet
description: Margaret of Burgundy, who received the powers of the regency during an absence of Louis X, uses them in the worst possible way. In fact, he indulges in the most incredible debauchery and spares no lover after lover. Only like a mantis, after love he makes them kill. Enter a vicious circle of death and tragedy, from which it is difficult to escape. Subjugated by the power of murder, she has two young men sentenced to death, only to discover later that they were her children.
notes: Gangbang, death and a pinch of humor in a food film by the great Abel Gance. Also known under the title of "The Tower of Nesle".

title: Tower of London
actors: Vincent Price, Michael Pate, Joan Freeman, Robert Brown, Bruce Gordon
description: Richard of Glouchester, taking advantage of the illness of his brother Edward IV of England, attempts to climb the throne by physically eliminating all his opponents. But the queen gathers her loyal troops and in Bosworth, in a bloody battle, she defeats Richard.
notes: Reworking of the 1939 film of the same name starring Basil Rathbone, it is a gothic in costume shot with the usual hand by Corman. Price wallows in the role.

title: La torta in cielo
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Didi Perego, Umberto D'Orsi, Daniela Minniti
description: A giant cake falls from the sky. The army, arms manufacturers and even a chocolate company try to turn the episode in their favor, but the children rebel. Film for children, is a heavily didactic allegory based on a novel by Gianni Rodari.

title: La Tosca
actors: Monica Vitti, Gigi Proietti, Umberto Orsini, Aldo Fabrizi
description: Rome, 1800. Mario Cavaradossi, Tosca's lover, hides Angelotti, an escaped patriot. Scarpia, head of the papal police, through the woman discovers the refuge of the fugitive, who kills himself. Tosca and her lover are locked up in Castel Sant'Angelo and the policeman has the opportunity to end all his perfidy in view of the tragic epilogue.
notes: Magni replaces the melodramatic aspect of Victorien Sardou's drama (and Puccini's opera) with the tones of grotesque comedy. The operation, however, only partially succeeds, and the film is deranged.

title: Totò a colori
actors: Totò, Luigi Pavese, Isa Barzizza, Mario Castellani, Virgilio Riento
description: Maestro Scannagatti, a misunderstood musical genius, lives in the town of Caianello. To convince him to direct a musical band, they promise him a meeting with the publisher Tiscordi. Scannagatti goes to Milan to bring his compositions to the publisher. He is believed to be mad and hunted. The first Italian color feature film is basically a collection of sketches from Totò's repertoire, from the sleeping car to the conductor's number to that of the puppet. Sublime moments, to be memorized.

title: Totò a Parigi
actors: Totò, Sylva Koscina, Lauretta Masiero, Fernand Gravey, Tiberio Mitri
description: The perfidious baron of Chemantel discovers that his perfect double, Totò, lives in Rome, who lives in a shelter in a tree. He manages to take him to Paris and organizes a scam against the insurance: Totò must die and be mistaken for the baron, in order to collect the life insurance policy. Totò sings one of his songs (Miss, my dear Miss) and proposes his usual repertoire. We laugh less than usual due to an annoying romantic subplot. Sylva Koscina is an excellent female presence.

title: Totò al Giro d'Italia
actors: Totò, Isa Barzizza, Walter Chiari, Fulvia Franco, Giuditta Rissone
description: To marry the woman he is in love with, Totò must win the Giro d'Italia. The devil presents himself to the desperate Totò to offer him victory in exchange for the soul. The race begins and, contrary to all expectations, the strange cyclist begins to beat Coppi, Bartali and other super champions. In an original look, with a mustache and goatee, Totò is unleashed. True pedal professionals crown him, including the two great champions mentioned.

title: Totò all'inferno
actors: Totò, Franca Faldini, Maria Frau, Dante Maggio, Ubaldo Lay
description: After several suicide attempts, Antonio accidentally drowns in a river. He ends up in Hell, where he meets Cleopatra; the great love that breaks out between the two makes Satan jealous and Antonio then runs away. While having fun in an existentialist haunt, he is recaptured by devils and taken back to the afterlife. Totò unleashed in a saraband of gimmicks, for a bizarre and fantastic subject (signed by himself) functional to his irrepressible comedy. The musical gag with the existentialists is hilarious.

title: Totò cerca casa
actors: Totò, Ada Mangini, Aroldo Tieri, Luigi Pavese, Cesare Polacco
description: The war is over and the civil servant Beniamino is one of the displaced people looking for a house. He wins a competition as a guardian with his family, but not reading the destination well, he later discovers that it is the cemetery. The family tries to adapt but a ghost, actually their daughter's jealous boyfriend, puts them on the run. Then they win the lottery and rent a house, but are duped.
notes: Inspired by "The Sfollatin family", a famous comic at the time, the young Steno and Monicelli invented a story with a social background for Totò and achieved a great success on the box. A well-established neorealist base derails in the absurdity of the great comedian.

title: Totò cerca moglie
actors: Totò, Mario Castellani, Aroldo Tieri, Marisa Merlini, Ave Ninchi, Elvy Lissiak
description: Totò, a penniless painter, anxiously awaits the return from Australia of a rich aunt. The relative informs him that he will bring with him a girl that his nephew will have to marry. By mistake, Totò gets a photo of a very ugly woman. He then decides to quickly find a wife and confront his aunt with a fait accompli. A series of hilarious Gags, a dizzying pace: one of the jewels with Totò. Among the screenwriters of the film appear Age and Scarpelli still beginners.

title: Totò cerca pace
actors: Totò, Ave Ninchi, Isa Barzizza, Enzo Turco, Paolo Ferrari
description: The marriage between Gennaro Piselli, widower and childless, and Gemma Torresi, widow and childless too, is frowned upon by their respective grandchildren. The only way to cause discord among the no longer young spouses is to instill the worm of jealousy in both of them. The trick works, but only for a short time: Gennaro and Gemma will have a clarifying explanation and will live happily ever after. The film is based on a comedy by Emilio Caglieri and suffers a little too much. Totò, here paired with Ave Ninchi, naturally works even if this is not his funniest film. In a short role also Paolo Ferrari, here on his debut.

title: Totò contro il Pirata Nero
actors: Totò, Mario Petri, Grazia Maria Spina, Aldo Giuffré, Franco Ressel
description: In the Caribbean there is also room for the thief Totò who, to escape the guards, hides in a barrel that is hoisted onto a pirate ship. Here Totò is about to be hanged, but he is saved because with a sword-shaped magnet he helps the pirates against a Spanish ship. Then the Black Pirate storms the governor's palace and captures his daughter, but Totò saves her.
notes: Film shot using sets, costumes and entire sequences of the "Queen of the pirates", made the year before by the same production house. Totò does what he can. The Black Pirate is Mario Petri, a lyric tenor who has always been a corpulent villain in the cinema.

title: Totò contro Maciste
actors: Totò, Nino Taranto, Gabriella Andreini, Nerio Bernardi, Samson Burke
description: Totocamen is a charlatan who performs in Thebes, where the Pharaoh of Egypt reigns, pretending to be very strong. Meanwhile Maciste, who is in love with the Pharaoh's daughter, is bewitched with a magical potion that makes him side with the Assyrians, enemies of Egypt. Totocamen is entrusted with the task of defeating them, and in vain ours tries to give up the impossible task.
notes: Although the plot is really obvious, Totò manages to put in a couple of numbers and hilarious jokes. Maciste is Samson Burke, an American bodybuilder with some "serious" mythology to his credit. Scenarios and costumes are by "Nefertiti queen of the Nile", directed by the same Circle.

title: Totò di notte n.1
actors: Totò, Erminio Macario, Rose Margaret Keil, Mac Ronay, Don Lurio
description: Ninì Cantachiaro (Totò) has received a sudden inheritance and decides to leave with his assistant Mimì (Macario). The two are amateur musicians and would like to play in the most prestigious clubs. They go to Madrid, London, Paris, New York and Hong Kong, but fail in their intent and decide to return to Rome. Parody of the numerous films that imitated the success of Europe by night by proposing sexy attractions taken from foreign night clubs, forbidden dreams of an Italy still bigot and moralistic. Not at all intimidated by Don Lurio or the Blue Bells, Totò manages to get some laughs, with Macario now resigned to the role of shoulder.

title: Totò Diabolicus
actors: Totò, Raimondo Vianello, Nadine Sanders, Beatrice Altariba
description: The Marquis Galeazzo di Torrealta is found killed and the murderer signed Diabolicus. Three of the four sons heirs of the conspicuous substances end up in the same way and only one survives, Monsignor Antonino. The suspicions fall on a certain Pasquale, illegitimate son of the Marquis, but, after a series of vicissitudes, it is discovered who had really engineered and carried out the massacre of the noble family. Totò plays all the Torrealta and the "bastard" Pasquale, in a hilarious black comedy that contains some of his most compelling solos.

title: Totò e Carolina
actors: Totò, Anna Maria Ferrero, Arnoldo Foà, Maurizio Arena, Tina Pica
description: In a raid carried out by morality at Villa Borghese, a girl who has just arrived from a nearby town, Carolina, is involved. To stop her was the agent Antonio Caccavallo who is instructed to take her home and supervise her having already attempted suicide.
notes: From a story by Ennio Flaiano, the writers Age, Scarpelli, and Monicelli make an unusual film, especially for the new role attributed to Totò. A Totò freanto in a gracious neorealist film that hit the censors for the character of the carabiniere. The film was released in 1955, with many sequences removed or "rigged" (of the political demonstrators, reduplicated, of the trippers). The complete edition was rebuilt in 1998.

title: Totò e Cleopatra
actors: Totò, Magali Noël, Mario Castellani, Gianni Agus, Moira Orfei
description: Marco Antonio loves Cleopatra but is persecuted by his jealous wife. Having found a poor man very similar to her husband, she sends him to the court of the queen of Egypt with the aim of putting an end to the relationship between the two. Cleopatra, for the pains of love, would like to kill herself but the poisonous asp, once bitten by the queen, falls to the ground poisoned. For its part, the unfortunate double gets to safety. All Cinecittà in 1963 was committed to the blockbuster Cleopatra, and imitations and parodies flocked. Totò could not be missing, at ease even in the midst of recycled sets and costumes, with the inevitable shoulders Mario Castellani and Gianni Agus.

title: Totò e i re di Roma
actors: Totò, Anna Carena, Giovanna Pala, Alberto Sordi, Aroldo Tieri
description: Ercole Pappalardo, head of the archives of a Ministry, gets into collision (due to a sneeze) with its Director General. Fired on the pretext of not having an elementary school certificate, he decides to die in order to appear in a dream to the family with five good numbers to play the lotto. The trick succeeds, but it does not escape the General Managers of the afterlife who put him under investigation again.
notes: Underneath, well hidden, there are a couple of stories by Chekhov, immediately distorted by the art of Totò, rather than by the work of the screenwriters. The scene of the exam in front of a very cruel Alberto Sordi is memorable, and the final part set in the afterlife is truly bizarre.

title: Totò e le donne
actors: Totò, Peppino De Filippo, Lea Padovani, Franca Faldini
description: Totò is a clerk in a fabric shop and is harassed by a shrewish and intrusive wife. Totò matures for this a misogynistic vision of the world and tries to prove his thesis in a series of comic curtains. Imagine, for example, that you have married an old girlfriend and you figure some situations with her, but the result is not striking. He then separates from his wife, but soon changes his mind. Collection of misogynistic sketches, almost all of a good standard. The most beautiful is that of the prostitute oppressed by family and economic ailments and misfortunes. "And then they call them cheerful little women ...", is Totò's final comment.

title: Totò e Peppino divisi a Berlino
actors: Totò, Peppino De Filippo, Nadine Sanders, Luigi Pavese
description: Totò's resemblance to the war criminal Canarinis is striking. Some friends of the Nazi hierarch try to take advantage of it and push the Italian to replace Canarinis in the trial that sees him accused. Totò, late realizing the situation, manages to explain the misunderstanding to the Americans, but the Russian agents kidnap him because he reveals some military secrets he is aware of. Totò's misadventures begin, with his friend Peppino Paglialunga at his side.
notes: A foolish abbatsanza film that however offers some hilarious duets between the two comedians (the moment in which they have to reconstruct a formula controlled by the communists is unforgettable). A re-release of the film was successfully presented at the Berlin Film Festival a few years ago.

title: Totò, Eva e il pennello proibito
actors: Totò, Abbe Lane, Mario Carotenuto, Louis De Funès, Giacomo Furia, Francesco Mulè
description: In Madrid, Eva and her accomplice Raoul convince the critic Francisco Montiel that they have discovered a "Maja in a shirt", to be added to Goya's "desnuda" and "vestida". In reality, the work is the birth of Totò, who painted the fake tempted by the promise of Eve's favors. Once the painting has been obtained, the latter does everything to eliminate the suitor. Steno's direction and Metz's screenplay are, as usual, overshadowed by the stage presence of Totò, capable of embroidering skits and nonsense baroque on the tenuous starting idea.

title: Totò, Fabrizi e i giovani d'oggi
actors: Totò, Aldo Fabrizi, Christine Kaufmann, Geronimo Meynier
description: The cavalier Cocozza (Totò) and the accountant D'Amore (Aldo Fabrizi) have in common only an unstoppable gab and a powerful polemical vocation. Forced to confront the prospect of becoming in-laws, they spark. With so much torque in action it is inevitable that the space that remains for the other characters is almost nil: Totò and Fabrizi, in excellent shape, steal the film, deepening their repertoire in a series of bickering at high speed, high volume and high potential. exhilarating. The story is tenuous, but the stage presence of the two comedians is enough and advances.

title: Fifa e arena
actors: Totò, Mario Castellani, Isa Barzizza, Luigi Pavese, Galeazzo Benti
description: Totò is a clerk in the pharmacy of his despotic aunt. Due to a mistake by the printer, his advertising photo of a purgative produced by the house is mistaken for that of a dangerous murderer. Totò is thus in trouble up to his neck, tailed by the police and other ferocious bandits. He ends up in Spain, disguised as a hostess and here he has to face the most unpredictable situations, including a challenge in the "plaza de toros".
notes: Even if the script doesn't help him that much, the prince of laughter is here at the height of the verve. Memorable as always the "duets" with the faithful sidekick Mario Castellani who here plays the role of a fierce gangster.

title: Totò lascia o raddoppia?
actors: Totò, Mike Bongiorno, Valeria Moriconi, Dorian Gray, Bruce Cabot, Elio Pandolfi
description: Duke Gagliardo della Forcoletta, thanks to his immense culture, becomes a champion in Leave or double, the quiz presented by Mike Bongiorno. Meanwhile, two gangsters, lovers of betting, have staked a lot of money on him: one stating that he will surely leave, the other certain that he will choose the double. When things seem to go wrong, Totò manages to get the bandits arrested and to enjoy the nest egg. For the first time, Totò "confronts" himself with TV and is irresistible, as always, especially in his proverbial puns. Among the actresses there is a very young Valeria Moriconi.

title: Toto le Héros
actors: Michel Bouquet, Mireille Perrier, Thomas Godet, Sandrine Blancke, Pascal Duquenne
description: At the beginning of everything a possible error: what if Thomas, known as Toto, had been exchanged, as soon as he was born, with another child? This is what Thomas is convinced of, as an old man, who traces his entire life, which would have been "stolen" from him by his neighbor. His childhood and real family, the woman he wanted to love, success, would be enjoyed in his place by the hateful Alfred. In the re-enactment of these episodes, the old Thomas finally decides to act, and will ultimately have his moment of glory. Here is a new, original film, with hilarious gimmicks and several ingenious solutions. It is like a puzzle whose various pieces are recomposed only at the end and reveal a practically perfect mechanism.

title: Totò nella luna
actors: Totò, Sylva Koscina, Ugo Tognazzi, Sandra Milo, Luciano Salce
description: Totò, editor of a magazine, is perpetually at loggerheads with the messenger Achille, in love with his daughter. For the not vile sum of thirty million dollars, and also due to a series of misunderstandings, Totò and Achille end up on the moon where they find two copies of themselves. Certainly not one of the best things about the prince of laughter. The young and talented Tognazzi launches into an imitation of Totò.

title: Totò, Peppino e i fuorilegge
actors: Totò, Peppino De Filippo, Dorian Gray, Titina De Filippo, Franco Interlenghi
description: Totò's rich wife keeps her husband on the spot. Then he, with the help of his trusted friend Peppino, pretends to be kidnapped by bandits and gets his wife to pay a ransom of five million. Together with his accomplice he squanders the money in a nightclub in Rome, but the television takes over and his wife discovers everything. Later, however, Totò is really kidnapped, but his wife ...
notes: One of the best films of the Totò / Peppino De Filippo duo with unforgettable scenes such as the threesome with the stingy Titina, the kidnapping sequence, and the final scene of the two at the night. It was actually filmed as a sequel to _Totò leaves or doubles ?, _ but it far surpassed the original, even in takings.

title: Totò, Peppino e la... malafemmina
actors: Totò, Peppino De Filippo, Teddy Reno, Dorian Gray
description: Totò and Peppino learn that their nephew Gianni, instead of studying at the university, has joined a theater company to follow the beautiful Marisa with whom he has fallen in love. The two uncles try everything to remove the nephew from what they believe is a woman of easy virtue and for this purpose they leave the village for the first time for Milan.
notes: A real cult movie at times even surreal and full of gags that made history: the writing of the letter, the arrival in Milan dressed as Cossacks, the interview with the policeman. Inspired by the Prince's song "Malafemmina", the film was designed as a vehicle for Teddy Reno, but the part of Totò and De Filppo was gradually inflated.

title: Totò, Peppino e le fanatiche
actors: Totò, Peppino De Filippo, Aroldo Tieri, Alessandra Panaro, Mario Riva, Virna Lisi, Johnny Dorelli, Elena Borgo, Diana Dei, Enzo Garinei, Giacomo Furia, Fanfulla, Renato Carosone
description: Cavalier Antonio Vignarello and accountant Peppino Caprioli tell the director of the asylum in which they are hospitalized that they are there because not of their obsessions but of those of their respective family members. And it is such a convincing story that the director decides to free them; at the earliest opportunity he will intern the joint pestilers.
notes: The film is not considered very good among those of the famous comedy duo. But the surreal moments (like the "comic" dialogues) are still fun, as is the satire of incipient consumerism (appliances). In a small role also Johnny Dorelli. Music provided by Renato Carosone and his band.

title: Totò sceicco
actors: Totò, Tamara Lees, Aroldo Tieri, Riccardo Billi, Laura Gore, Cesare Polacco
description: Desperate for a pain of love, the Marquis Gastone enlisted in the Foreign Legion. To "look after him", the butler Antonio Sapore (Totò) is put in tow. Due to a misunderstanding, Antonio is mistaken for the sheikh's son and ends up in the mysterious continent of Atlantis, where Queen Antinea falls in love with him.
notes: "See how beautiful Omàr is ...": Totò is unleashed by exploding in word games and gags that have made history. The iron script written by Age, Scarpelli, Marchesi and Metz sparkles but it is very little if deprived of the comic genius of the prince. It was a great success with the public.

title: Totò sexy
actors: Totò, Erminio Macario, Mario Castellani, Toni Ucci, Mario Pisu, Franca Polesello
description: Ninì and Mimì, modest double bass players persecuted by the blackest bad luck, end up in prison. Here to pass the time they tell their dreams: both would like to visit the most famous night clubs in Europe, attend striptease, see and meet beautiful and fascinating women. We see them like this in the best clubs in Paris, London, Berlin, Madrid.
notes: It's just an excuse to join the comic interludes of a very tired Totò. Dodò D'Ambourg, starlets of the time, plays its part among the nightlife attractions.

title: Totò Story
actors: Totò, Aldo Fabrizi, Peppino De Filippo, Giacomo Furia
description: In the year of his death, Totò was finally starting to be re-evaluated by the critics who had ignored him just as the audience crowded the screenings. We thought of compiling an anthology of his films: we can thus review some memorable scenes such as the dictation of a letter in Totò, Peppino e la malafemmina, the change of clothes in the car by Totò, Fabrizi and the young people of today, the printing of fake banknotes in The Band of the Honest, the design of a strange family tomb in Signori is born. It is not the best of the many anthologies then made by television, but it had at least one merit: it was the first.

title: Totò terzo uomo
actors: Totò, Franca Marzi, Elli Parvo, Carlo Campanini, Aroldo Tieri
description: The town is run by Piero, an austere and rigid man, quite the opposite of his twin Paolo, who instead enjoys life. The two brothers are fighting over the construction of a penitentiary on land owned by Paolo. Piero, in fact, finds every quibble in order not to shell out the expropriation money. Suddenly a third twin arrives in the village, of which everyone was unaware of the existence, which still complicates things.
notes: Under the guidance of Mario Mattoli, Totò gives his best in the triple effort of giving face and credibility to antithetical characters. The funniest character is obviously the mayor; Totò sings "Miss, my dear miss". Carol Reed's "Third Man" obviously has nothing to do with it.

title: Totò, Vittorio e la dottoressa
actors: Totò, Vittorio De Sica, Abbe Lane, Titina De Filippo, Agostino Salvietti
description: Young Othello fell in love with the beautiful Brigitte, an American practicing as a doctor. Othello's two aunts suspect his nephew's beautiful girlfriend and hire two detectives to follow her. But the two are just braggart: in fact they are shoe shine and have been hired for the investigation thanks to a misunderstanding. They combine all kinds of troubles before the affair ends with the marriage of the two young men. Under the guidance of Mastrocinque, Totò and De Sica play the part of two friendly scoundrels. The film is alternate but has hilarious moments (Totò welcoming a lady from San Vincenzo with "Dear Admiral"). The beautiful American is Abbe Lane, then very famous.

title: Totòtarzan
actors: Totò, Marylin Buferd, Bianca Frisori, Mario Castellani, Tino Buazzelli, Galeazzo Benti
description: Totò is the grown-up and semi-savage son of a very rich explorer. Abandoned at an early age in the jungle and becoming an adult there, he is brought home by three adventurers and then also approached by a relative, the father of three beautiful daughters of marriageable age. The reason for the many attentions to which Totò Tarzan is subjected is the inheritance he must take possession of, the parent having died.
notes: This time, the victim of the parodic desecration carried out by the prince of laughter is the character of the legendary "ape man". It was inevitable: Totò makes litter. Succulent curiosity: among the "tarzanids" appears this Sofia Lazzaro, who later became Sophia Loren.

title: Totòtruffa '62
actors: Totò, Nino Taranto, Lia Zoppelli, Ernesto Calindri, Mario Castellani
description: Antonio Peluffo with his accomplice Felice Campano scoring small scams against simpleton and gullible. Antonio must support his daughter in a luxurious Swiss boarding school where they believe him to be a career diplomat. However, the girl falls in love with the son of the commissioner who persecutes Antonio who, unbeknownst to his father, has obtained a job thanks to the two swindlers. The whole film is based solely on the comedy of the great Totò well supported by Nino Taranto. Some of the thousands of disguises and expedients of the two comedians belong by right to the anthology of laughter: Totò wife cheating ("She undresses me with her eyes ... dressing room!") And Taranto jealous husband, the sale of the Trevi Fountain etc.

title: Trader Horn
actors: Rod Taylor, Anne Heywood, Jean Sorel
description: Trader Horn, an English hunter, is invited by Colonel Sinclair to lead an organized expedition against the Germans who are taking over British military and commercial bases in Africa. Ugly remake of an American movie from the thirties.

title: The Informer
actors: Victor McLaglen, Heather Angel, Preston Foster, Margot Grahame
description: Gypo is part of a group of Irish rebels. However, he is thrown out for disobedience. In revenge, he tips the British police who arrest Franckie. Repentant of his gesture, Gypo squanders the bounty money he has earned by offering drinks to everyone. Suspected by his followers of being, the traitor is chased and shot to death.
notes: A drama with biblical tones, shot following the stylistic features of expressionist cinema, which Ford will not use later on. 4 Oscars: direction, screenplay, music (by Max Steiner), screenplay (by Dudley Nichols, from a novel by Liam O'Flaherty).

title: The Man from the Alamo
actors: Glenn Ford, Julie Adams, Chill Wills, Hugh O'Brian, Victor Jory
description: Accused of desertion, a soldier who escaped the siege of Fort Alamo manages to prove his innocence. Tight western film by one of the greatest specialists of the genre.

title: Der Transport
actors: Hannes Messemer, Armin Dahlen, Peter Herzog
description: In charge of the transfer to the front of a group of prisoners, in the last days of the war, a German lieutenant instead tries to save them, at the risk of his own life. Convincing characters, but the staging is a bit flat.

title: Sunset Grill
actors: Peter Weller, Lori Singer, Stacy Keach, Alexandra Paul, John Rhys-Davies
description: Already somewhat depressed about his problems, ungrateful work and existence in general, an American private investigator (Peter Weller) suffers two terrible shocks in rapid succession: the murder of a brother and that of his first wife. The investigations that, shocked, he decides to undertake personally then lead him to discover an unexpected and absolutely chilling truth. Hardly passable thriller, which, however, can count on a respectable cast. Alongside Weller, former protagonist of Robocop and The Naked Meal, are the young Singer (Footlose) and the veteran Keach.

title: Mutiny on the Bounty
actors: Clark Gable, Charles Laughton, Franchot Tone, Herbert Mundin
description: At the end of the 18th century, the crew of the Bounty, stirred up by the second officer Fletcher Christian (Gable), rebelled against the ferocity of Captain Bligh (Laughton), who was abandoned at sea on a lifeboat. But the captain, having reached England, sets out in search of the rebels, captures some of them and has them tried.
notes: This is a historical fact, and this is the first of three versions that have been made for the cinema (the last, in 1984, with Mel Gibson and Anthony Hopkins). In its own way it is also historical, with excellent actors and with an admirable spectacular performance. Huge success and Oscar for best film: a typical blockbuster from the past.

title: Scott of the Antartic
actors: John Mills, Drek Bond, Harold Warrender
description: In 1912, Captain Scott's second Antarctic expedition left London. Having reached Cape Evans, the journey to the South Pole begins in spring, where Amundsen had planted the Norwegian flag a few days earlier. The return to base camp is marked by terrible accidents, so much so that no one will survive. Eight months later, the bodies buried in the ice and the expedition journals will be found. Very accurate reconstruction (with an excellent photograph) of a company marked by adverse fate. The notoriety of the outcome of the enterprise eases the tension a little, but this does not detract from the dignity of the staging. Music by Ralph Vaughan Williams.

title: Dirnentragoedie
actors: Asta Nielsen, Hilde Jennings, Werner Pittschau, Oskar Homolka
description: Berlin 1920s. Auguste, a no longer young prostitute, falls in love with a student and wants to give up his job for him, buying a shop. But a more attractive companion, meanwhile, seduces the student, for which Auguste instructs his protector to suppress him. In vain he repents, then finding peace in a desperate gesture. Dark story in the degraded environment of a defeated and destitute Germany, where any attempt to rise is in vain. Danish actress Asta Nielsen excels in the role of Auguste, making the bleak mello an existential tragedy, while the director adopts a style tributary of expressionism.

title: La tragedia di un uomo ridicolo
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Anouk Aimée, Laura Morante, Ricky Tognazzi
description: An agricultural industrialist, proud of his success, suffers a psychological meltdown when his son is kidnapped for the purpose of extortion. It is in fact torn between the affection for the young and the attachment to well-being accumulated in a life of hard work. Then the son, believed to have been killed, suddenly comes out in strange circumstances.
notes: Bertolucci has signed a twisted and deliberately obscure film that intends to mix the life of feelings with the passion for accumulating money, so much so that, at a certain moment, one no longer knows how to distinguish between being and having. A film about Italy, about the Po valley, about terrorism. Grande Tognazzi, music by Morricone.

title: Tragica notte
actors: Doris Duranti, Carlo Ninchi, Andrea Checchi, Adriano Rimoldi
description: In a village in the Maremma Nanni is arrested and imprisoned because he is caught hunting in the estate of a count. Released from prison he decides to take revenge on the gamekeeper who denounced him. So he ambushes him and beats him to death. At this point it is the gamekeeper who wants to take revenge, but in a more subtle way. He makes Nanni believe that the count is having a secret relationship with his wife.
notes: An unusually dark film in full swing was "white phones". Soldati proves to be able to manage spaces well, especially the smoky and claustrophobic interiors, ideal projections of the protagonists' psychological torments.

title: Beyond the Stars
actors: Martin Sheen, Christian Slater, Sharon Stone, Olivia D'Abo
description: A boy dreams of becoming an astronaut and trying to carry out his project, he ends up meeting a real "man of space". This will be for him something more than a simple tool to realize his aspirations: he will teach him something about dreams and disappointments and will set him apart from a secret discovery made during his trip to the moon.
notes: Modest TV movie, curious only because it unites a reborn actor like Connery with two then unknown Slater and Connery.

title: Die Hard
actors: Bruce Willis, Bonnie Bedelia, Alan Rickman, Alexander Godunov
description: Policeman John McClane lives apart from his wife, he in New York, she in Los Angeles. At Christmas he accepts her invitation to spend the holidays together. On Christmas Eve, he joins her at the party at the company headquarters, a very modern skyscraper in Los Angeles that is now empty after the employees leave. But some German terrorists burst into the palace and take those present hostage with the declared aim of obtaining the release of some political prisoners and that, undeclared but more real, of emptying the very rich vault of the multinational. Only John, finding himself by chance in a toilet, escapes their attention and it's up to him, without any outside help, to vanquish the dangerous terrorists one by one. McTiernan's film is a big toy, but also one of the most significant action-movies of the decade, an irresistible concentration of suspense. Great Willis.

title: Die Venusfalle
actors: Horst-Günther Marx, Myriem Roussel, Sonja Kirchberger
description: Max has a mistress named Coco and a fantasy named Marie. The two actresses are beautiful, but the film is too affected to be caustic. A little eroticism does not save the whole.

title: The Money Trap
actors: Glenn Ford, Rita Hayworth, Joseph Cotten
description: Joe Baron, a police officer, is married to an ambitious woman and is tormented by the need to continually raise money. To do this, he steals money and drugs from the safe of a doctor linked to the underworld. In the escape, however, his accomplice is killed and Joe, barricaded in the house, can only wait for the arrival of the police.
notes: Bitter and violent tale of a life wasted in the service of money. Glenn Ford effectively tracks the character of the corrupt cop, well supported by a cast of old stars. The director was an excellent western film writer.

title: Parent Trap II
actors: Hayley Mills, Tom Skerritt, Carrie Kei Heim, Bridgette Andersen
description: Sharon Ferris and Susan Corey are two turbulent twin sisters who only discovered they were fourteen at the age of fourteen. Now they are grown up and Sharon has a daughter who has made up her mind to remarry her with Bill, the father of one of her classmates. The situation is not easy, but luckily Susan arrives who, exploiting the similarity with Sharon, will solve things. About twenty years later Hayley Mills reconstitutes the couple that made her famous in the first film of the series: "The cowboy with the bridal veil". This television shoot, shot for Walt Disney, was so successful that it deserved two more episodes.

title: Roger-La-Honte
actors: Georges Géret, Irene Papas, Jean-Pierre Marielle, Marie-France Boyer
description: An industrialist who saved the company thanks to a loan from his lover is accused of her murder. He escapes after fifteen years and discovers the real culprit. Based on the classic popular novel by Jules Mary (already brought to the screen several times), the film is not Freda's best but with its dry style and retro atmosphere it remains an enjoyable arthouse film.

title: The Gunrunner
actors: Kevin Costner, Sara Botsford, Paul Soles, Ron Lea, Aline Van Dine
description: Ted Beaubien (Costner) is a young Canadian who, to honor the memory of his girlfriend who died in China at the hands of a warring faction, decides to continue his political commitment by organizing an arms shipment between America and the Asian country. The recipient is the revolutionary army led by Mao Tse-Tung (we are in 1926). Despite a young Costner, the result does not arouse enthusiasm, although it reveals some interest in the Chinese sequences).

title: I Can Make You Love Me
actors: Brooke Shields, Richard Thomas, Viveka Davis, William Allen Young
description: Newly hired by a large electronics company, young engineering graduate Laura Black (Brooke Shields) arouses an irresistible attraction in her colleague Richard Farley (Richard Thomas). The man intensifies his advances to invade Laura's privacy, with constant stalking, nighttime phone calls and an uninterrupted series of love letters. Desperate, the girl first turns to her superiors and then to the police authorities, who manage to remove her persecutor from his workplace. And that's when Richard's vengeful madness is unleashed. It is an absolutely banal film, which has only the appearance of a thriller.

title: La trasgressione
actors: Milly D'Abbraccio, Rosanna Banfi, Pierfrancesco Campanella
description: The erotic hallucinations of a university student, complex and dedicated to drugs, which has been rejected the degree thesis. Insiend film with Milly D'Abbraccio not yet "silicone" nor become one of the most famous Italian pornstars. Rosanna Banfi, Lino's daughter of Lino.

title: Vincent, François, Paul et les autres
actors: Yves Montand, Michel Piccoli, Serge Reggiani, Gérard Depardieu
description: Established bourgeois meet, every weekend, in a country house. They seem happy but the wife of one of them, separated, wants a divorce. It is the beginning of a general crisis, even if apparently everything continues as always.
notes: A bitter comedy, this one by Claude Sautet, with subdued sentimental dramas but no less pungent. Skilled in describing the psychologies and relationships between bourgeois characters starting from nuances, the director is fortunate to use extraordinary actors such as Montand, Piccoli, Reggiani and Depardieu.

title: Three Amigos
actors: Chevy Chase, Steve Martin, Martin Short, Patrice Martinez
description: Dusty, Lucky and Ned are hugely popular as silent film actors. When the beautiful Carmen invites them to a Mexican village, they think they have to perform in the repertoire numbers and instead a real bandit awaits them, the ferocious El Guapo. After the first slip, the three organize themselves and prevail precisely by creating the typical situations of their films.
notes: John Landis is inspired by the comedy films that played Bob Hope, filling them with idiotic and absurd situations (for example, a singing bush). The results are hilarious, even if many lines are lost in the dubbing.

title: I tre aquilotti
actors: Michela Belmonte, Leonardo Cortese, Alberto Sordi, Carlo Minello, Piero Carnabuci
description: Marco, Mario and Filippo, students of the Aeronautical Academy of Caserta, enthusiastically follow the courses for obtaining the pilot's license. The arrival of the young sister of one of the three immediately becomes a matter of contention and their lasting friendship risks breaking abruptly ...
notes: Presented in Venice, the film sees Alberto Sordi among the co-stars for the first time. The subject signed by Tito Silvio Mursino (pseudonym of Vittorio Mussolini, son of the Duce) has similarities with the contemporary "A pilot returns" by Rossellini, who also collaborated, without signing, on the screenplay.

title: The Tall T
actors: Randolph Scott, Richard Boone, Maureen O'Sullivan, Arthur Hunnicut
description: A farmer, on foot due to a lost bet, finds a ride on a bus where a young lady also travels. An ambush puts the travelers at the mercy of three ruthless bandits, but the protagonist manages to save himself and the woman, after eliminating the outlaws. From a story by Elmore Leonard, Burt Kennedy writes one of the late masterpieces of Boetticher and Scott. The dialogues are very fine, but the film also applies to the old actor's sore step and the director's masterful style.

title: Thre Three Caballeros
actors: Carmen Molina, Aurora Miranda
description: Journey through South America in the company of some Disney characters. First we follow a cold penguin's journey to the equator. Then, the adventures of the flying donkey captured by a very young gaucho in the peaks of the Andes. Finally, pyrotechnics galloped between Brazil and Mexico in the company of Donald Duck, José Carioca and Panchito. Music, dances, colors, you find amusing, at times a bit postcards, but always enjoyable. Also enjoyable are the sequences in which the animated characters interact with real dancers (including Carmen Molina and Aurora Miranda).

title: I tre che sconvolsero il West (Vado, vedo e sparo)
actors: Antonio Sabato, John Saxon, Frank Wolff, Agata Flory, Leo Anchoriz
description: King wants to get hold of a large hidden sum on a stagecoach. A lone bandit spoils the blow by accident; to be forgiven he offers to find the money. He succeeds, but there is also the cheater Clay on the trail of the loot. The three chase each other through the West. At one point the bag falls into the river; it is recovered by a fisherman who dictates its conditions to return it.
notes: Spaghetti-western ironic and with ballad tones (music by Rustichelli) directed by an Italian action specialist and interpreted by a trio of faces known to fans. Fans will not be disappointed.

title: Donovan's Reef
actors: John Wayne, Lee Marvin, Jack Warden, Elizabeth Allen, Cesar Romero
description: Amelia, a severe girl from Bostonian society, has to join her father in Polynesia, but it is hidden from her that he, a widower, has remarried to a native woman and has three other children. So a friend of the parent pretends that the three children are his, but Amelia falls in love with him. In the meantime, she gets to know her father better and will be understanding when she finds out the truth.
notes: An unusual Ford, on the comedy side, who enjoys directing an eventful affair. Moments from a Christmas-tropical fairy tale, such as the beginning and above all the sacred representation with the Magi of all races.

title: Three Women
actors: Sissy Spacek, Shelley Duvall, Janice Rule, Robert Fortier
description: Millie (Duvall) and Pinky (Spacek) work as nurses at a senior center in California. Willie (Rule) is the wife of Edgar, the owner of the saloon, and has nothing to do but dabble in interior decoration and pool bottoms. Pinky loves Millie, but when she finds out she is having an affair with Edgar, the spell ends. After upsets, quarrels and, above all, after Edgar's mysterious death, the three women move in together. It is a film from Altman's golden age with a superlative use of sound (actually mortified by the Italian version) and with an amazing Duvall (awarded at Cannes).

title: Casanova Brown
actors: Gary Cooper, Teresa Wright, Frank Morgan, Anita Louise
description: Love at first sight between a university professor and a young graduate, but the girl's mother is against it: she cannot prevent the sudden marriage, but manages to wreck it after only one day. The professor is about to remarry, but has a jolt of paternal love when he learns that his ex-wife has given birth to a baby girl.
notes: The comedy is polite and alluring; Cooper gets away with it, in a brilliant role quite off his strings. Based on a play by Nunnally Johnson, already adapted two more times.

title: Tre fratelli
actors: Philippe Noiret, Vittorio Mezzogiorno, Michele Placido, Charles Vanel
description: Three brothers meet in the village on the occasion of the death of their mother. One is a judge who fights terrorism, the second is an assistant in a juvenile prison, the third is a worker. The night of the wake is an opportunity for confrontation, discussion, clash between the three, whose lives seem to have brought them insuperable distances from each other. They will leave again after the funeral, while the old father will be alone with his memories. Film of the crisis of an era, political metaphor and family elegy (taken from a story by Platonov), it is one of Rosi's most suffered films, and despite its untidiness it still has a certain value of testimony today.

title: Easy Come, Easy Go
actors: Elvis Presley, Dodie Marshall, Pat Priest, Pat Harrington jr.
description: A naval officer identifies an ancient sailing ship on the seabed and, once on leave, returns to the place hoping to find the classic chest. All this is only a weak pretext to make an Elvis Presley sing in sight of the avenue of the sunset.

title: Three Days of the Condor
actors: Robert Redford, Faye Dunaway, Cliff Robertson, Max Von Sydow, Addison Powell, Walter McGinn, Tina Chen, Michael Kane, Don McHenry
description: All the members of a CIA department are mysteriously eliminated, except one whose code name is "Condor". With a personal and very risky investigation, in which he is helped by a woman, the agent discovers the shady secrets behind the slaughter.
notes: One of the great masterpieces of Sydney Pollack with Faye Dunaway and Robert Redford, here in one of the roles that have imposed the myth. Pollack starts from a particularly spectacular genre (the spy film) to sketch a far-reaching political discourse (the individual crushed by Power). Dramatic tension, effective character complexity and a great sense of action make the film a classic of the seventies.

title: Uncertain Glory
actors: Errol Flynn, Paul Lukas, Jean Sullivan, Lucile Watson
description: In the France of the Second World War, Jean Picard, a murderer already condemned to the death penalty, finds a way to redeem himself by offering himself in exchange for one hundred innocent people taken hostage by the Germans. A little too static for Errol Flynn, but also for the great Walsh.

title: I tre ladri
actors: Totò, Simone Simon, Jean-Claude Pascal, Gino Bramieri, Giovanna Ralli
description: Two thieves, Tapioca and his "pupil" Gastone, who has far surpassed the teacher, find themselves in the same apartment when, suddenly, the owners return. One ends up in prison but in the end, after complicated rounds of compromising letters (one of the two is the mistress of the landlord's wife), having discovered that after all the industrialist is one of them, a company is born.
notes: Commediola Leggina, who would also like to have a moralistic intent: that is that, after all, thieves and industrialists belong to the same race. Enjoyable just for a few issues of Totò.

title: Turn Back the Clock
actors: Connie Sellecca, Wendy Kilbourne, Jere Burns, Joan Leslie
description: On New Year's Eve 1990, Sheila Powers, a film actress, kills her husband Barney, once a famous director. In desperation, she takes refuge from a screenwriter friend to whom she tells of having killed in self-defense. Then say the fateful sentence: "If I could go back". The wish is granted and Sheila relives for the second time the year just ended, trying in vain to change the events. A year, however, passes quickly and a new New Year, always the same, is approaching. A discreet remake of Tell me goodbye, a 1947 film, starring Joan Leslie who appears here in a very short role.

title: The Three Musketeers
actors: Gene Kelly, Lana Turner, June Allyson, Van Heflin, Vincent Price
description: The young Gascon gentleman D'Artagnan, just arrived in Paris, finds a way to fight with the king's three musketeers: Athos, Porthos and Aramis. While they are fighting a duel, Cardinal Richelieu's guards arrive and the four, having to join forces, become friends. Together they carry out exciting feats against the cardinal and thwart the plots of the perfidious Milady.
notes: One of the best cinematographic transpositions of the novel by Dumas the father, faithful to the narrative, sumptuous in the scenography, very well rhythmic in the mass scenes and in the clashes. Good proof of the whole cast. Kelly duels with dancer grace, and director Sidney choreographs the action with the confidence of a musical specialist.

title: The Three Musketeers
actors: Michael York, Oliver Reed, Raquel Welch, Richard Chamberlain, Frank Finlay
description: D'Artagnan has just arrived in Paris to enlist in the musketeers and immediately gets into trouble with the cardinal's guards, animated by historical rivalry; he is saved by three colleagues, Athos, Porthos and Aramis, with whom he becomes close friends. The intrigues of Richelieu and Milady are about to ruin the queen's reputation, but the musketeers risk their lives to recover the jewels the queen had given to her lover in England.
notes: The plot and the situations are well known, but the direction has the light touch of Richard Lester, the author of the Beatles films. So everything becomes fun, unreal, light-hearted.

title: Three Hours to Kill
actors: Dana Andrews, Donna Reed
description: A stagecoach driver accused of a crime has three hours to prove his innocence. An hour and a quarter of tight, thrilling action: the best of Serie B.

title: Le mataf
actors: Michel Constantin, Adolfo Celi, Georges Géret, Annie Cordy
description: Three crime professionals Frank, Bernard and Basilio are mocked by a mysterious gang as they try to secure the loot deposited on the Trans Europa Express. A few months pass and the three realize that they have been filmed while they were scoring the blow. The soul of the blackmail is the lawyer De Borde, who wants to force them to attempt the theft of a precious microfilm containing the secrets of a shipyard. The three are forced to accept.
notes: Serge Leroy proves to have a sense of the show and professionally directs this decidedly enjoyable noir.

title: Three Little Words
actors: Fred Astaire, Red Shelton, Arlene Dahl, Debbie Reynolds
description: Bert Kalmar, a well-known songwriter and vaudeville actor, meets Harry Ruby, a talented composer. The two find themselves working together and their creations are a resounding success. When a famous star of the magazine decides to launch one of their songs, the doors of the musical theater open for the two.
notes: Astaire is furious in what he himself has always considered his favorite of all the musicals he has filmed. In reality, the story narrated is a bit too schematic, almost a pretext for the choreographic numbers which are obviously overwhelming.

title: Three Men and a Baby
actors: Tom Selleck, Steve Guttenberg, Ted Danson, Nancy Travis
description: An architect, an actor and a draftsman find themselves forced to look after the newborn daughter of one of them. All habits, work commitments, love relationships are turned upside down by the little girl. Hence a series of hilarious gags, including a drug story in which they are involved in spite of themselves. And from the initial distrust, the three turn into adorable dads.
notes: The film does not have the lightness and charm of the original French "Three men and a cradle" directed by Coline Serreau, but it lets itself be seen, thanks also to a good performance by the three protagonists.

title: Three Men and a Little Lady
actors: Tom Selleck, Steve Guttenberg, Ted Danson, Nancy Travis, Robin Weisman
description: Mary, the little girl entrusted in swaddling clothes to the three bachelors Peter, Michael and Jack in "Three Bachelors and a Baby", is now six years old. Things don't seem to have changed in the strange menage and the three men are happy to be the child's adoptive fathers. But the little girl's mother, Sylvia, decides to accept the offer of Edward, a director who proposes to go and act in London and marry her. Taking the baby with him.
notes: Simple and necessarily uplifting, the film shows, like all continuations, a certain predictability. In many ways it is reminiscent of 1940s Hollywood comedies, but with less pace and fewer ideas.

title: Three Secrets
actors: Patricia Neal, Eleanor Parker, Ruth Roman
description: A child is saved from a plane crash where his adoptive parents die. He could be the son of one of the three women who, on the same day five years earlier, in a difficult moment in their lives, entrusted an unwanted infant to the orphanage. The meticulous direction of Wise harnesses the excesses of melò.

title: Tarzan's Three Challenges
actors: Jock Mahoney, Woody Strode, Tsu Kobayashi, Ricky Der
description: Little Kashi, who lives in a distant monastery, is named successor to the deceased spiritual leader of an ancient eastern city. Tarzan, his bodyguard, during the journey repels the deadly attacks ordered by Khan, an evil uncle who wants the power all to himself. Arriving safely at his destination, Kashi proves he is worthy of the place he is called to occupy by passing three tests of wisdom, but Khan wants to subject him to a fourth, deadly, trial.
notes: Predictable adventures that lose momentum as the film progresses. The deadpan and massive Jock Mahoney starred in three other Tarzan films.

title: Le tre spade di Zorro
actors: Guy Stockwell, Michela Wood, Gloria Milland, Franco Fantasia
description: The masked defender of the oppressed ends up in the evil governor's prisons. His son Diego, having become an adult, collects the inheritance, but is in turn captured. C2 series adventure movie.

title: Tre straniere a Roma
actors: Claudia Cardinale, Yvonne Monlaur, Roy Ciccolini, Françoise Danell
description: Three Milanese girls realize their great dream: to spend a couple of days in Rome. They pretend to be Danes (and moneyed) and have a good time at the expense of three Roman friends. When the truth comes out, the boys take it badly and ponder revenge, only to tame themselves when everyone recognizes their own wrongs and forgives those of others. General sympathy prevails and a promise to keep in touch.
notes: Postcard-size images, some sentimental ideas, some humorous skits, dialectal differences and that's it. Easy and harmless formula for an unpretentious but, all in all, pleasant film.

title: La grande vadrouille
actors: Louis De Funès, Bourvil, Terry-Thomas
description: An English plane is shot down over Paris by the Nazi anti-aircraft. The three crew members jump with parachutes landing more or less luckily in the French capital. Here, aided by an orchestra conductor and a house painter, they begin an escape through occupied France. After a thousand ups and downs and a good dose of luck, they manage to save themselves. Huge success for a play with a perfect rhythm, remade by the French a hundred more times. The trio of comedians works great.

title: The Three Lives of Thomasina
actors: Susan Hampshire, Patrick McGoohan, Karen Dotrice, Jean Anderson
description: A widowed vet has become grumpy and irritable. When his little daughter's kitten falls ill, the man advises the girl to kill her. The girl, upset, goes to the woods where a girl who is considered by everyone to be a witch lives and asks her to cure the animal. On the way back, she is surprised by the storm, gets wet and falls ill with pneumonia.
notes: Narrated in ... first person by the cat, the film is a syrupy Disney production, definitely not memorable.

title: I tre volti della paura
actors: Boris Karloff, Michèle Mercier, Jacqueline Pierreux, Lydia Alfonsi
description: Film in three episodes: In the "Telephone" (taken from F.G. Snyder, although he claims to be taken from Maupassant) a woman threatens a friend with anonymous phone calls. The friend asks her for help. In "I Wurdalak" (taken from Aleksej Tolstoy) it tells of a family that falls prey to a form of vampirism: they kill those they have loved the most. In "Drop of water" (which is taken from Chekhov) a nurse steals the ring from a dead woman, ignoring that the deceased was a medium: the theft will be fatal.
notes: Actually almost apocryphal episodes. Bava makes a disturbing and surprising film also for the final unveiling of the cinema as a "trick". The episode of the phone is a concentrate of suspense. The most beautiful episode is the one with Karloff, who also acts as an ironic narrator. In America "Black Sabbath" was initiated, and hence the famous musical group took its name.

title: Tremors
actors: Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter, Michael Gross, Reba McEntire
description: In Perfection, the ironic name of a microscopic and far from perfect inhabited center between the desert and the mountains of Nevada, some very rapid and voracious underground snakes make their terrible appearance. Blind, but sensitive to the slightest noise, the worms strike with no escape, destroying and swallowing anything. The small community is forced into an all-out battle.
notes: A beautiful horror shot all in the light of the sun with some comic vein and many references to old films of the fifties. Good cast with Kevin Bacon in the lead. Excellent special effects made by the same technicians of "Terminator".

title: The Train
actors: Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield, Jeanne Moreau, Michel Simon
description: The film tells a rather singular episode of the French Resistance. As the Allies approach Paris, a German officer loads a train with stolen works of art that he intends to take to Germany. A French railway worker, a member of the Resistance, does all he can to prevent the substantial assets from ending up in the enemy country. Even when the officer puts him at the helm of the convoy under the threat of weapons. With the help of other partisans, our hero accomplishes his mission.
notes: Great tension and rhythm for performers who do not disappoint their fame and a direction that does not miss a beat. The film, based on a Rose Valland novel, was started by Arthur Penn.

title: Treno di panna
actors: Sergio Rubini, Carol Alt, Cristina Marsillach, Irene Grazioli, Maurizio Faulisi
description: Giovanni Maimeri, a young musician to whom Italy is close, goes to America in search of success. Here he finds only hard work and endless disappointments. Not even his two love stories manage to reconcile him with himself: disconsolate he leaves for Patagonia. De Carlo was one of the most promising young Italian novelists. His transition to cinema was not as happy as his debut as a writer. Train of cream maintains a certain lightness of the novel of the same name, but no longer goes beyond the simple sketching in outlining its protagonists.

title: Un treno per Durango
actors: Anthony Steffen, Dominique Boschero, Mark Damon, Enrico Maria Salerno
description: Two adventurers, one American and one Mexican, cross Mexico to retrieve a load of gold stolen by bandits during an assault on the train. Every so often a gunslinger appears who solves their difficulties and then disappears. When the two have taken possession of the gold, the man throws off the mask: he is wanted for fraud and, with the complicity of an attractive girl, he manages to deceive them too.
notes: Western that anticipates some comic themes to Terence Hill and Bud Spencer. Dominique Boschero, the beautiful protagonist, is currently the leader of an Occitan independence movement, while Mark Damon is a producer in the United States.

title: Finders Keepers
actors: Michael O'Keefe, Beverly D'Angelo, Louis Gossett jr.
description: A bizarre trio travels on the train from Oakland to New York, consisting of a good-natured young man, a rather nervous starlet and a professional cheat. On that train there is also a coffin loaded with dollars (five million) taken from the coffers of a billionaire. The cash falls into the hands of the trio: who will be able to take advantage of it, pocketing the disproportionate swag? The subject has nothing particularly exciting, but Lester manages to make it into a crackling action comedy. As always at ease in this genre, the English director knows how to make people laugh without seeking refinement and aiming to the point.

title: Treno popolare
actors: Marcello Spada, Lina Gennari, Carlo Petrangeli, Maria Denis
description: A trip to the river with some happy ending incidents. One girl disdains a mild boy for a smokier one, and another is terrified that her lover's wife joined them on the train. A film with a delicate touch, shot all outdoors and on a real train by a rookie Matarazzo, a very enjoyable populist fresco that was not successful at the time but is now considered an important and innovative film.

title: Trenta secondi d'amore
actors: Elsa Merlini, Nino Besozzi
description: A woman, driving her own car, hits a pedestrian. After leaving the clinic after a long hospital stay, the investor asks for 15,000 lire as compensation or, alternatively, a kiss that lasts exactly thirty seconds. The lady at first refuses, but then convinced by the family who does not look favorably on the disbursement of the sum, she ends up accepting. Mild light comedy directed by Mario Bonnard, specialist in "white telephones".

title: Eye for an Eye
actors: Chuck Norris, Christopher Lee
description: After the murder of his partner, Sean Kane resigns from the San Francisco police and investigates a drug trade on his own. The film is worth nothing; but that Christopher Lee playing the bad guy.

title: Un grain de sable
actors: Lilli Palmer, Pierre Brasseur, Laurent Terzieff, Sylva Koscina
description: The death of a businessman in an accident sets off a bloody struggle for his succession. Wearable, despite the silly Italian title. Kast was one of the leading names of nouvelle vague critics.

title: Il triangolo della paura
actors: Lewis Collins, Lee Van Cleef, Donald Pleasence, Manfred Lehmann
description: There is a mole in the Narcotics Squad. To unmask her, a policeman is in turn infiltrated into a band of mercenaries who contend for the primacy of drug trafficking. American the model, American the setting; as expected (already seen and reviewed), the corpses flock.

title: Affair in Trinidad
actors: Rita Hayworth, Glenn Ford
description: Alarmed by a letter from his brother, Steve Emery, a former American air force pilot, leaves for the island of Trinidad. Here he discovers that his brother has killed himself. He then begins to investigate helped by Chris, the attractive singer of the local Night Club, widow of his brother. He soon discovers shady arms trafficking and spy intrigues, from which he will come out with great difficulty, even winning Chris's love. French critics have defined Sherman, the director of this film, a chameleon, for his great ability to adapt to the most diverse genres. We have a proof with this beautiful noir, vaguely inspired by Gilda.

title: Return of the Scarlet Pimpernel
actors: Barry K. Barnes, Sophie Stewart, Margaretta Scott, James Mason
description: During the period of the Terror, the English nobleman Sir Percy Blakeney, better known by all as Red Primrose, saved the French nobles from the guillotine, bringing them to safety in England. To capture the unstoppable champion of the ancien régime, republican agents kidnap his wife, holding her prisoner in Paris as bait. When Sir Percy is about to capitulate, Robespierre is dismissed by the assembly.
notes: Sword and swashbuckling according to the canons of the genre for this English production that is sumptuous in the scenography but a bit sloppy in the staging.
