title: Le triomphe de Michel Strogoff
actors: Curd Jürgens, Capucine, Pierre Massimi, Valéry Inkijinoff
description: Assigned to protect Prince Sergius during an expedition against a rebel tribe, Strogoff succeeds in the enterprise. Negligible adventure film.

title: The Jigsaw Man
actors: Michael Caine, Laurence Olivier, Susan George, Robert Powell
description: Having worked extensively for the Russians, former British intelligence chief Sir Philip Kimberly now lives in Moscow. The KGB decides to entrust him with a new mission in England. To this end, he is pronounced dead and, under a false name and with a new face, Kimberly returns home; in London he gets in touch with his old enemy, Admiral Scaith, proposing him the double game. It is probably the only spy film with Michael Caine that did not go well, despite the elite of the British scene in the cast.

title: Tristi amori
actors: Gino Cervi, Luisa Ferida, Andrea Checchi
description: A lawyer from Ivrea learns that his youngest aide is in trouble because he doesn't have the money to pay off his father's debts. He then immediately offers to lend them to him, but then discovers that the young man has been in a relationship with his wife for some time and things get complicated there. Solito drama, based on the work of Giuseppe Giacosa with a cast of stars of the time and a not very fresh direction by Gallone.

title: I tromboni di Fra' Diavolo
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Raimondo Vianello, Moira Orfei, Francisco Rabal
description: The French who occupy the Kingdom of Naples hunt down the elusive brigand and patriot Fra 'Diavolo; he regularly manages to trap them with cunning and unexpected moves, until he ends up trapped in a mountain monastery where he must marry his beloved Cristina. The French manage to replace the friars, who lock them up in the basement of the monastery.
notes: Farce with a historical background written by Castellano & Pipolo and starring the couple Tognazzi and Vianello who makes the unsuccessful verse at Stanlio and Ollio's "Fra Diavolo".

title: Tropic of Cancer
actors: Rip Torn, James Callahan, Ellen Burstyn, David Bauer
description: Inspired by his novel of the same name, it is the portrait of a young Henry Miller amid the excesses and follies of 1920s Paris. Ellen Burtsyn is beautiful and very young in the role of the wife. Today, however, it is almost more of a document on the 1970s than on the 1930s.

title: Trop belle pour toi!
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Josiane Balasko, Carole Bouquet
description: Bernard, who married the beautiful Florence, is envied by everyone for this reason. But Bernard at a certain point falls in love with his new secretary, Colette, rather ugly and sloppy, as well as married. After a bit of back and forth, Bernard decides to move in with Colette, but ...
notes: Comic film that would like to be transgressive but basically revisits the old pochades. Balasko is good.

title: Murder Is Easy
actors: Bill Bixby, Lesley-Anne Down, Olivia de Havilland, Helen Hayes
description: On a train to London, the American tourist Luke Williams meets the elderly Lavinia Fullerton, who intends to report the identity of the perpetrator of three recent murders in her village to Scotland Yard. As soon as she gets off at the station, however, the old woman is killed herself, and Luke begins to investigate ...

title: Troppo forte
actors: Carlo Verdone, Stella Hall, Alberto Sordi, Mario Brega, Sal Da Vinci
description: Oscar is a burgher who dreams of a future as a film actor, or at least as a stuntman. To contact a producer he stages an accident, in which however a young actress is really injured, who therefore loses the part. The girl settles in Oscar's house waiting for her husband to return to America with.
notes: Bittersweet comedy in which Verdone pursues the satire of certain rambling illusions of the periphery, without however putting in the necessary malice. The film does not scratch as much as it would like, and even Alberto Sordi's participation in the role of the lawyer is reduced to the revival of old clichés.

title: Troppo per vivere... poco per morire
actors: Claudio Brook, Daniela Bianchi, Sidney Chaplin, Jess Hahn, Paolo Gozlino
description: A reporter investigates a jewelry theft that took place in London during a fashion show. The Scotland Yard inspector is also investigating, but with other purposes. Italian-style yellow without verve, with an appearance by Lara Saint Paul.

title: Troppo rischio per un uomo solo
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Susan Scott, Venantino Venantini
description: Rudy Patti is a Formula One champion of Argentine origin. He is arrested by Scotland Yard for the murder of his mistress Nina. Rudy cannot provide an alibi for the night of the murder and is therefore jailed. Rudy does not know that Nina was involved in a large drug trade and that her accomplice Browner killed her for this. Escaped from prison with the help of Pietro, his mechanic, tries to prove his innocence.
notes: It is a detective story that casually reviews all the clichés of this genre, without involving too much.

title: La trovatella di Pompei
actors: Alessandra Panaro, Antonio De Teffé, Massimo Girotti, Carlo Giustini
description: Indicted for a crime she did not commit, Maria discovers she is the illegitimate daughter of the Public Prosecutor who supports the prosecution at the trial. A melodrama directed at the least worst and interpreted in a more than mediocre way.

title: Il trovatore
actors: Gianna Pederzini, Gino Sinimberghi, Cesare Polacco
description: Azucena, daughter of a gypsy burned alive at the stake, kidnaps one of the sons of the count of Luna and raises him. When he becomes an adult, the young Manrico falls in love with Eleonora, betrothed to the surviving Count of Luna, that is, to her unsuspecting brother. The two collide and Manrico manages to escape, but gets captured again to save the woman he believes to be his mother from the stake. He is sentenced to death and executed, while Eleonora poisons herself; at that point, Azucena reveals the truth to the count of Luna. Cinematic version of Verdi's opera by the specialist Gallone. Known singers (Sinimberghi, la Pederzini), beautiful sets, immortal melodies.

title: High-Ballin'
actors: Peter Fonda, Jerry Reed, Helen Shaver, Chris Wiggins, David Ferry, Christopher Langevin, Harvey Atkin, Leslie Carlson, Myrna Lorrie
description: A big hauler tries to eliminate independent competition with the assaults of the ferocious Harvey's gang. To face the raids are the truck driver Duke (Reed) and Rane (Fonda), a friend of his a bit 'hippie who is a stuntman. To get rid of Harvey, however, the intervention of Pickup (Shaver), a truck driver as beautiful as she is energetic, will be decisive. Not bad, even if the adventures of the two mature boys make one think with nostalgia of Easy Rider and Convoy. Always disturbing the presence on the screen of the Shaver (The color of money).

title: Trys dienos
actors: Katerina Golubëva, Rima Latupova, Arunas Sakalaukas
description: Two friends travel from their Lithuanian village to the city of Kaliningrad, formerly Koenigsberg. Along the way they have the adventure of meeting two Russian girls, with whom they continue their journey. Together they seek refuge in a station hotel, in a partially destroyed house; they sleep in cellars and in strange apartments. Soon the relations between the four, who at first spun of love and agreement, end up degenerating. A "border" film, which takes us on a journey through a geographical, social and historical reality made up of loneliness and repressed dissatisfaction. Interesting testimony from a young cinema.

title: Holiday Affair
actors: Janet Leigh, Robert Mitchum, Wendell Corey, Griff Barnett
description: The young widow Cinthya Ennis (Leigh) does a somewhat special job: she buys objects that she submits to her firm's technicians for comparison purposes, then returns them the next day. A salesman, Steve Mason (Robert Mitchum) is fired for selling her an electric train despite realizing she was a "sui generis" buyer. The two make friends and it is the first step towards marriage. Quite pleasant, but with interpreters who do their best.

title: Young at Heart
actors: Frank Sinatra, Doris Day, Gig Young
description: The Tutle family lives in the town of Strafford in Connecticut: their father Gregory and his sister, Aunt Jenny, and their three daughters, Fran, Amy and Laurie. The arrival of Alex, a very talented and equally charming composer, wreaks havoc in the house: all three girls fall in love with him. Laurie, the chosen one, on her wedding day, however, abandons Alex for Barney whom she had met in the meantime. Barney, jealous of Alex, attempts suicide but is saved in time.
notes: The film is a remake of the one shot by Michael Curtiz with Claude Rains and John Garfield. With Sinatra the musical aspect is accentuated.

title: Hot Spell
actors: Anthony Quinn, Shirley Booth
description: Father and husband tear the family apart, flee with his lover, then die in an accident. Dated but robust drama.

title: Tucker - The Man and His Dream
actors: Jeff Bridges, Joan Allen, Martin Landau, Frederic Forrest, Dean Stockwell
description: In the aftermath of the Second World War, Preston Tucker, a brilliant inventor, works around a revolutionary car model destined to leave behind everything that the big manufacturers have made up to then. With the help of a few friends, he lays the financial foundations for the factory that will have to produce it. But he hasn't reckoned with the excessive power of Detroit's big industries ... Identifying himself with the brilliant builder forced to abandon his project but not his dreams, Coppola makes a film full of energy: a sort of enthusiastic homage to the great losers.

title: The Robe
actors: Richard Burton, Jean Simmons, Victor Mature, Michael Rennie
description: The tribune Marcello is sent to Palestine. Thus he witnesses the entry of Jesus into Jerusalem, then his crucifixion at the end of which, by playing dice, he wins the tunic of the Redeemer. From that moment his life changed, also thanks to the servant Demetrius, a convinced Christian.
notes: Meatloaf of enormous commitment and enormous success. First example of Cinemascope, a system of shooting (and projection) obtained using anamorphic lenses, introduced in an attempt to counter the excessive power of TV. For a sort of historical nemesis, today, the shots of the films in Cinemascope that pass on TV are "foreshortened" at the ends to adapt them to the television format.

title: The Tunnel of Love
actors: Doris Day, Richard Widmark, Gig Young
description: Johnny and his wife Elisa want to adopt a child. The inspector who has to check their reliability receives a negative feeling from the meeting with the two. After a fight with Elisa, Johnny goes out with the inspector. He wakes up the next morning, alone in a hotel room. Gene Kelly only directs. You don't sing or dance, the plot is rather complicated, but Kelly comes out with enough lightness.

title: Blue Thunder
actors: Roy Scheider, Warren Oates, Malcolm McDowell
description: The name "Blue Thunder" is that of a helicopter intended for metropolitan surveillance, equipped with an ultra-sophisticated control and attack technology: electronic sensors to "see" and "hear" in the most difficult conditions. However, the pilot must beware of Colonel Cochrane, his ancient adversary, who once again proves that he deserves all the contempt our hero gratifies him. From the final mega-clash the "good" naturally emerges as the winner, then choosing to sacrifice the helicopter to save the citizens' tranquility.
notes: The fnatapolitico idea is curious, but the action part lacks backbone. Screenplay by Dan O'Bannon.

title: Un turco napoletano
actors: Totò, Isa Barzizza, Carlo Campanini, Mario Castellani, Franca Faldini
description: The wealthy Don Pasquale would like to hire a handyman but is terrified of the idea that he could undermine his wife and daughter. An honorable friend has the solution in his pocket: he will send him a Turkish eunuch. It happens, however, that Totò, just escaped from prison with a friend, manages to take the place of the Oriental and enter the house of her suspicious husband and father in disguise.
notes: The comedy by Edoardo Scarpetta, which is the subject of the film, is a small encyclopedia of the classic elements that allow Totò to deepen his hilarious repertoire. The cast is well oiled, Mattoli's direction is exact.

title: The Accidental Tourist
actors: William Hurt, Kathleen Turner, Geena Davis, Amy Wright
description: The relationship between Macom and Sarah is in crisis after the tragic death of their little son. The woman starts the divorce proceedings. Macom, who by profession writes tourist guides for hasty travelers, takes refuge in his father's house. Having to go on a trip, he entrusts the dog to an agency run by Muriel, exuberant and divorced. Between the two born a consolidated affection also from the presence of Muriel's son; when Sarah tries to get back in the game, it's too late. Adapting Ann Tyler's novel, Kasdan plays on the tones of melancholic comedy by finding a good blend of light humor and subtly dramatic implications. Good proof of the trio of protagonists.

title: Turné
actors: Diego Abatantuono, Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Laura Morante, Barbara Scoppa
description: Two men, friends since school, are actors: Dario is extroverted and jovial and has a moderate success, Federico is going through a moment of crisis mainly due to problems with Vittoria, his girlfriend. Dario drags Federico with him on a tour in which he will have to confess that Vittoria has joined him. Typical generational road movie a la Salvatores, not excellent but dignified from the narrative point of view, the direction of the actors and the listenability of the dialogues.

title: Il turno
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Laura Antonelli, Paolo Villaggio, Bernard Blier
description: The penniless Baron Pepé loves Stellina. However, she marries Don Diego out of interest and in the hope of becoming a widow soon. So she marries the lawyer who gets her to get the marriage annulled. Meanwhile, Pepé continues to wait for his turn. Based on the novel of the same name by Luigi Pirandello with some vulgar trivialization.

title: Tutta colpa del Paradiso
actors: Francesco Nuti, Ornella Muti, Roberto Alpi, Novello Novelli, Laura Betti
description: Romeo comes out of jail. There is no one waiting for him: his wife has abandoned him, his son is adopted by a new family. Romeo discovers where his son's new parents live: in a cabin in Gressoney, in Val d'Aosta. Without letting anyone know who he is, he starts dating them: he is a researcher who studies the behavior of the white ibex, she is beautiful and helpful, the child is affectionate. But a social worker reveals Romeo's true identity who decides to leave alone so as not to upset that family balance.
notes: Nuti, still in copy with the Muti, achieved a success at the time with this tedious alpine comedy.

title: Tutta colpa della Sip
actors: Gianfranco Bullo, Ana Obregon, Vittorio Caprioli, Toni Bertorelli
description: Luca, a newsagent in his spare time, accidentally finds himself answering a phone call from a man who thinks he's talking to the Babington detective agency. Luca does not miss the opportunity, he passes himself off as agent Buldok and gets into trouble. An attempt at a comic thriller directed and starring Gianfranco Bullo. Ana Obregon is a little Spanish star, but at least she's pretty.

title: Tutta da scoprire
actors: Nadia Cassini, Yorgo Voyagis, Renzo Montagnani, Bombolo, Enzo Cannavale
description: A rambling bundle of blackmail and double cross games between two couples plus one (of men, the latter). The highlight of the film should be Nadia Cassini, "to be discovered" in fact. Let alone the side dish.

title: Toute une vie
actors: Marthe Keller, Gilbert Bécaud, André Dussollier, Charles Denner
description: Sarah, daughter of a Jewish-born shoe manufacturer, is in love with Gilbert Bécaud. Disappointed by her infidelity, she consoles herself by traveling around the world. On the death of his father, he took over the reins of the company with renewed non-conformist ideas. He will find true love in an advertising director of humble origins. Marthe Keller is the mother (who dies in childbirth) and the restless daughter; Gilbert Bécaud plays himself with happy malice. Lelouch, as usual, gives life to a story of monstrous historical and geographical vastness. For him, cinema and life coincide. But it's not always about an exciting coexistence.

title: Ask Any Girl
actors: Shirley MacLaine, David Niven, Gig Young, Rod Taylor
description: Meg Wheeler comes to town from the provinces and immediately thinks about getting married. The problem is that all the men she meets have not exactly serious intentions, with the result that she manages to lose first a boyfriend and then her job. At that point she gets smart and tries to get an explanation of what men are looking for in women. The result is a new Meg, more worldly, but also less sincere than in the past. Pleasant comedy, well interpreted (the very young MacLaine is irresistible) and with tasty satirical ideas.

title: Our Mother's House
actors: Dirk Bogarde, John Gugolka, Margareth Brooks
description: The Hooks are seven siblings who live with their seriously ill mother in an old house on the outskirts of London. When the woman dies, the children, for fear of ending up in an orphanage, bury her in the garden. One day the father who had abandoned them years before shows up and remains insensitive to the stories of the boys, and above all manages to create a subtly ambiguous atmosphere.
notes: Work of a good genre director, it is a family psychological film that becomes more and more gothic. Very good Bogarde.

title: Little Sister
actors: Jonathan Silverman, Alyssa Milano, George Newbern
description: When one loses his heart for a girl studying in a female-only college there is nothing to be done. Our student tries them all to be next to his beloved, but in the end the only solution will be the radical one: change clothes and attitudes and pass for a girl. Ours succeeds in its intent, but it faces rather embarrassing situations. From the comics of the silent down this idea has been taken up countless times and by better actors. Despite this, Zeilinger's film is not entirely indecent. Keep an eye on Alyssa Milano, maybe she will replace Shannen Doherty in Beverly Hills.

title: Tutti defunti... tranne i morti
actors: Gianni Cavina, Francesca Marciano, Carlo Delle Piane
description: In the castle of the Zanetti marquises a man arrives with a book on which a prophecy is written: the death of 9 family members will give indications for finding a hidden treasure. In a short time the expected number passes to a better life: the marquisina Ilaria, the seller of the book and an investigator who does not understand anything remain. Furthermore, one of the deceased reappears alive and well.
notes: Pupi Avati jokes with yellow and reconstructs the atmosphere of the early 1950s in grotesque tones, in ways that often return to his cinema even if they refer to different environments and eras.

title: Tutti dentro
actors: Alberto Sordi, Joe Pesci, Dalila Di Lazzaro, Giorgia Moll
description: Judge Salvemini, a very scrupulous official, is conducting a very delicate investigation into alleged bribes on some oil supplies, which would involve ministers and senior state officials, as well as wealthy people from the entertainment world. To ingratiate him, they invite him to spend the weekend on the Côte d'Azur, but the inflexible judge has them arrested. So inflexible, but also so naïve, Salvemini will get stuck, ending up in jail too. Sordi tries to represent the reality of our country: however, more involuntarily grotesque works have come out of it.

title: Tutti fratelli nel West... per parte di padre
actors: Antonio Sabato, Peter Garsten, Fernando Sancho, Giacomo Furia
description: Gipo, a young adventurer, receives as a gift a fragment of a nugget on which the map of a legendary mine is engraved. He sets out in search of the other pieces in possession of a varied collection of humanity. When his mission is complete, he discovers that the mine belongs to the state, but does not despair: in the meantime he has found love. The veteran Grieco puts on the best of an epigonal western and slob.

title: All the President's Men
actors: Robert Redford, Dustin Hoffman, Martin Balsam
description: Bob Woodward and Carl Bernstein, two Washington Post reporters, hopelessly investigate five men arrested as they try to steal Democratic Party documents. Gradually they discover that all of President Nixon's aides are involved in the scandal. The two are subjected to all kinds of pressure not to make the results of the investigation public, but they do not stop. Thus was born the Watergate scandal that forces Nixon to resign. It is also a film of political and social commitment, starring two actors who have never hidden sympathies for the Democrats. But Pakula transforms it, with a stylized and hypnotic direction, into an apologue on power of great subtlety.

title: All the King's Men
actors: Broderick Crawford, Joanne Dru, John Ireland
description: Willie Stark is a young man who manages, thanks to his honesty, to be elected governor of the state. Politics transforms him into a corrupt and arrogant holder of power. Adapting a novel by Robert Penn Warren, Rossen takes the world of politics head on in his third film, presenting us with the metamorphosis of an ordinary citizen whose political career turns into a monster. Oscar for Best Picture, Best Actor (Crawford, Gigantic) and Supporting Actress (Mercedes McCambridge)

title: Tutti i colori del buio
actors: Edwige Fenech, George Hilton, Ivan Rassimov, Marina Malfatti, Nieves Navarro, Julián Ugarte, Maria Cumani Quasimodo, George Rigaud, Luciano Pigozzi
description: Due to childhood trauma, Jane suffers from recurring nightmares. Her sister recommends a psychiatrist, while a neighbor tries to cure her with black magic. But it's all a plot to steal her inheritance. After "The strange vice of Mrs. Wardh", Martino tries again with the thriller, leaning on the graces of the beautiful Fenech. But its suspense is taken for granted and second-hand.

title: The Sound of Music
actors: Julie Andrews, Christopher Plummer, Eleanor Parker, Richard Haydn, Peggy Wood, Charmian Carr, Heather Menzies, Nicholas Hammond, Duane Chase
description: Maria, to verify her vocation as a novice, is sent as a governess to the family of Mr. von Trapp, an attractive widower with an endless number of children. The two fall in love and get married until the onslaught of war forces them to fortunately expatriate to Switzerland.
notes: Undoubtedly effective film and at times even touching, although very rhetorical, but Rodgers' music remains in the head without remedy. 5 Oscars: best film, best direction, musical arrangement, editing and sound.

title: Tutti possono arricchire tranne i poveri
actors: Enrico Montesano, Barbara Bouchet, Anna Mazzamauro
description: Giovanni works as a switchboard operator, his wife Viviana instead teaches in an evening school. But suddenly, here is a nice thirteen at the Totocalcio. Giovanni and Viviana leave their jobs, decide to move to Montecarlo, live like the rich, travel aboard a luxurious car complete with a driver, hang out with the local nabobs. But then the wife of Giovanni's former boss, dissatisfied with her husband, convinces him to invest over seven hundred million in the purchase of an islet for which a brilliant tourist future is expected. Despite Montesano and the subject based on a novel by Terzoli and Vaime, it is a stretched film, suspended between vulgar comedy and satirical intentions.

title: Tutto a posto e niente in ordine
actors: Luigi Diberti, Lina Polito, Claudio Volonté, Nino Bignamini, Eros Pagni, Giuliana Calandra, Sara Rapisarda, Aldo Puglisi
description: Stories of a group of immigrants who arrived in Milan to make their fortune and were forced to live together in the same accommodation. Gino, after several attempts, gives himself up to the underworld. Carletto becomes a cook, Biky and Adelina work as waitresses, Isotta ends up on a sidewalk instead. Sante, a Sicilian, soon becomes the father of seven children and ends up in prison, involved in an attack to which he is, moreover, a stranger.
notes: At the height of her success, Wertmüller tries the path of the fresco-film; its choral history, however, is not very successful.

title: Freaky Friday
actors: Barbara Harris, Jodie Foster, John Astin, Ruth Buzzi
description: In a common American family, while the father only thinks about working, the one who has to solve the problems of the house, especially in the relationship with the children, is mother Ellen. One day, after yet another confrontation with 13-year-old Annabel (Jodie Foster), mother and daughter wish each other to be in the shoes of the other: which, who knows how, happens. The intersection of personalities creates confusion and hilarious situations. One of the funniest Disney comedies of the seventies, adapted for the screen by Mary Rogers, author of the book behind the subject. Fifteen, Jodie Foster is already in her tenth film, after "Alice Doesn't Live Here Anymore" and "Taxi Driver".

title: Sans lendemain
actors: Edwige Feuillère, Georges Rigaud, Paul Azais
description: When her husband dies, Evelyn is left alone with a son and engages in prostitution. Then she sees a young man, who has always been in love with her, who offers her to flee to Canada. Upon leaving, however, Evelyn decides to commit suicide. Who knows what this film was like in Ophüls' intentions. Now, which can only be seen by countless censorial cuts made at the time, it is inexcusable.

title: Into the Night
actors: Jeff Goldblum, Michelle Pfeiffer, Irene Papas, Dan Aykroyd
description: At the Los Angeles airport, Diana, pursued by Iranian killers, seeks escape in the car of Okin, an engineer betrayed by his wife and suffering from insomnia. Diana has smuggled some emeralds, she does not intend to give them up and drags the astonished night owl with her in search of various friends to ask for help. At the end of a night without a moment's respite, Okin and Diana find themselves in a motel, in love and with a suitcase full of dollars. John Landis' frantic night-time raid through Los Angeles, with nonstop gags and full-on fun, in the style already proven in "The Blues Brothers". Cameos by famous directors, from Don Siegel to Jonathan Demme to David Cronenberg.

title: Career Opportunities
actors: Frank Whaley, Jennifer Connelly, Barry Corbin, John Candy
description: Jim Dodge is a contented heart. His parents kick him out of the house and he is forced to find a job. But it's a minor problem because he quickly finds a job as a night watchman in a supermarket. Jim is also lucky because his first night of work is spent with a girl who hid there, but she is not a thief, on the contrary she is the richest girl in town. Then two thieves arrive ...
notes: That's just enough of an idea to make a ten-minute film. Bryan Gordon manages to cover eighty-four, but fails to prevent the viewer from yawning. To be noted only the fleeting appearance, however uncredited, of John Candy.

title: A Night on the Town
actors: Elisabeth Shue, Maia Brewton, Keith Coogan, Anthony Rapp
description: Hired for one evening as a babysitter by the Andersons, the young Chris finds herself nursing three young boys: Sara, Brad and Daryl. A friend's call, however, forces Chris to leave the house, taking his ... offspring with him. A good night awaits them in terrible Chicago, amidst car thieves, shady traffickers and dangers of all kinds. A not terrific little play and tailor-made for an audience of teenagers.

title: Twinky
actors: Charles Bronson, Susan George, Honor Blackman, Orson Bean
description: A 16-year-old English student marries a 40-year-old American writer. The couple goes to live in New York, but it doesn't last long. The last flashes of the legendary sixties in London flash in the film, but the result is less exciting than expected, and today the sobbing post-nouvelle vague style is a bit soporific. If anything, the role of Bronson is curious.

title: Assault on a Queen
actors: Frank Sinatra, Virna Lisi, Anthony Franciosa, Richard Conte
description: To recover an ancient treasure submerged in Florida waters, Rosa, Erik and Vic hire Mark, an experienced diver, and his collaborator Linch. Instead of the treasure, a German submarine scuttled during World War II is discovered. Also hired an excellent mechanic, Tony, the group decides to recover the U-boat to rob the Queen Mary ocean liner on the high seas, but in the middle of boarding a Coast Guard corvette intervenes. After the incredible premise, the film proceeds unsurprisingly to the end, always undecided between drama and thriller. Enjoy the Duke Ellington soundtrack.

title: Uccellacci e uccellini
actors: Totò, Ninetto Davoli, Femi Benussi, Umberto Bevilacqua, Renato Capogna, Alfredo Leggi, Renato Montalbano, Flaminia Siciliano, Giovanni Tarallo, Vittorio Vittori
description: Totò and Ninetto go to evict poor people from a farmhouse on the Roman outskirts. Along the way, they are joined by a crow, a veter-Marxist intellectual, who tells of how Brother Ciccillo and Brother Ninetto tried in vain to convince sparrows and hawks to make friends. After having, among other things, crossed the funeral of Togliatti and made love with a prostitute, the two are hungry. The crow talks and talks: it ends up devoured. Philosophical fable in which Pasolini talks about his time from the point of view of an intellectual in crisis. Light, deep and innovative in its intertwining of apologue and essay. Totò was awarded in Cannes.

title: Beaks-Birds of Prey
actors: Christopher Atkins
description: From various parts of the world there are reports of human beings being attacked by birds. A skeptical pair of television reporters leave for a report and have to change their minds. A bit of horror and a lot of naive ecological rhetoric in a pseudo-remake of Hitchcock's masterpiece.

title: The Birds
actors: Tippi Hedren, Rod Taylor, Jessica Tandy, Veronica Cartwright, Suzanne Pleshette
description: Melania arrives in Bodega Bay with a pair of budgies called "inseparable" to give to Mitch, a young lawyer who lives with his mother and little sister Cathy. While crossing the bay she is injured by a seagull. It looks like an accident, but the reality turns out to be quite different: birds of all kinds join forces in an inexplicable threat. A nightmare, which ends with the assault of the birds on Mitch's house. From a short story by Daphne du Maurier, scripted by Evan Hunter alias Ed McBain, one of Hitchcock's masterpieces; through a series of seemingly banal scenes, an apocalyptic portrait of the stupid human species and a depiction of his deepest fears. At the time, it was one of the most frenzied editing films ever seen: over 3,000 shots. Debut by Tippi Hedren, the director's "impossible" flame and Melanie Griffith's mother.

title: L'uccello dalle piume di cristallo
actors: Tony Musante, Suzy Kendall, Enrico Maria Salerno, Eva Renzi, Mario Adorf
description: In Rome, a young American writer, Sam Dalmas, witnesses the stabbing of a woman. Knowing that perhaps it is a serial killer who already has three murders behind him, Sam begins personal investigations. The killer targets him: in extremis the police save Giulia, Sam's girlfriend; then when the writer-detective seems to have solved the case, there is a breathtaking final surprise.
notes: Debut of the recognized master of contemporary Italian horror. In reality this is a thriller, in which however there is no lack of significant gothic accents and a certain personal imprint. The photography is by a young talent named Vittorio Storaro.

title: L'uccello migratore
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Rossana Podestà, Gianrico Tedeschi, Dominique Torrent, Paolo Carlini
description: Andrea Pomeraro, a history teacher, has an affair with a student who then blackmails him. Recovered the photos that accused him, ours becomes the leader of the student revolt and ends up in jail. Satirical film without art or part.

title: Tell Them Willie Boy Is Here
actors: Robert Redford, Katharine Ross, Robert Blake, Susan Clark
description: The Red Indian Willie Kid, confined to the Morongo reserve, is forced to kill Lola's father, his girlfriend, in self-defense. After the murder he is forced to flee to the mountains taking his girlfriend with him. Listlessly led by Sheriff Cooper, who is tolerant by nature, some bounty hunters, including old Calvert, chase him without being able to catch him. Called to Riverside to escort President Taft, Cooper entrusts Calvert with the task of continuing the hunt.
notes: Polonsky's first film after twenty-one years of Hollywood ostracism, it is a masterpiece of the adult western, consciously rooted in the archetypes of American culture, its literary tradition and its repressed.

title: The Package
actors: Gene Hackman, Joanna Cassidy, Tommy Lee Jones
description: In Berlin, while a diplomatic meeting is underway in preparation for the US-USSR super-summit in Chicago, two officers die in a terrorist attack. Sergeant Gallagher, accused of negligence, uncovers a plot that unites the militarists of the two superpowers to prevent nuclear disarmament. Assisted by his wife, he manages to thwart the plans of the conspirators. Hitchcockian story taken from a very successful novel, well directed and correctly acted, full of twists. Among the performers, Joanna Cassidy plays a prominent role, appearing in some of the best action films of the 1980s.

title: Uccidete Rommel!
actors: Anton Diffring, Carl Parker, Pamela Tudor, Ugo Adinolfi, Rudi Roman
description: World War II, North Africa. To stop the advance of the German army commanded by Rommel, a commando under the command of Captain Richard Hull has the enemies take possession of a false map of the mines scattered in the desert. The next order is to liquidate Rommel, but this time the company fails miserably. Thus begins a march back into the desert for the men of Hull ...
notes: Usual silly Italian war film, badly directed by Alfonso Brescia who this time signs himself with the xenophile pseudonym Al Bradley. Inconsistencies and banalities abound, even the dialogues are obvious and rhetorical.

title: My Lover, My Son
actors: Romy Schneider, Donald Houston, Dennis Waterman, Patricia Brake, Peter Sallis
description: Mrs Anderson has long had no relationship with her husband Robert, a rough London industrialist. Instead, she has a morbid passion for her son James. Robert realizes this and confronts the woman: during the fight he hits her, but is killed by James' intervention who mortally wounds him. The reconstruction of the facts at the trial proves that the woman had also hit her husband. Despite Romy Schneider, the passionate drama does not take off and the yellow story is stuck.

title: How Sweet It Is!
actors: James Garner, Debbie Reynolds, Maurice Ronet, Terry-Thomas
description: Young Chris goes on vacation to France, partly to follow his girlfriend, partly to stay away from Jenny, a one-time apprehensive mother. But she doesn't let herself be enchanted and follows him, only to discover that the man who rented her house is a charming playboy. And there Jenny just risks being enchanted. It is actually the mother who breaks up, but this is only the Italian title. Comedy winking to the air of the time and therefore much more dated today. Writes and produces Garry Marshall, who a quarter century later will sign "Pretty Woman".

title: An Officer and a Gentleman
actors: Richard Gere, Debra Winger, Louis Gossett jr.
description: Zack Mayo (Gere) is a young man of Italian American origins who grew up with a sailor, womanizer and drunkard father, in ports around the world. To change his life he enrolled in the course for military jet pilots. Here, thanks also to the wickedness of his instructor (Gossett jr.) And the rigidity of military discipline, he will be able to demonstrate all his character, even if the suicide of Sid, his best friend of course, will upset him. For Zack, love will come, Paula (Winger), a poor but affectionate girl. Education in authority (I don't deceive Gere's fake rebellion) and a pretty strong love story: the very cunning cocktail worked by launching actors and director, but also the excellent character actor Gosset jr. (which won the Oscar). Oscar also for the song "Up Where We Belong".

title: Un ufficiale non si arrende mai, nemmeno di fronte all'evidenza. Firmato Colonnello Buttiglione
actors: Aldo Maccione, Jacques Dufilho, Michele Gammino, Christa Linder
description: In the Zanzibar barracks, commanded by Colonel Buttiglione, a group of recruits arrives for the planned training period. A lover of discipline and authoritarian (he can't stand long hair and out-of-order uniforms), Buttiglione is, in reality, a clumsy and noisy officer who throws the barracks into confusion.
notes: ONE of the several terrible Buttiglione-movies of the early 70's.

title: Gli ultimi 10 giorni di Hitler
actors: Alec Guinness, Simon Ward, Adolfo Celi, Diane Cilento
description: On April 20, 1945 Adolf Hitler (Alec Guinness) closes himself in the underground bunker of the Chancellery, while the Red Army besieges Berlin, with his mistress Eva Braun (whom he will marry in extremis) and some high Nazi leaders. The Führer and his wife commit suicide on the 29th, while the others deny the oath made to follow the same fate. The enterprise of showing Hitler in the cinema was only partially successful, with some ingenuity; but Alec Guinness is great in his hallucinating fixity Hitler. To be compared with the next, much more ambitious and delusional, "Moloch" by Sokurov.

title: Ulisse contro Ercole
actors: Georges Marchal, Alessandra Panaro, Dominique Boschero, Mike Lane, Gabriele Tinti, Raffaella Carrà, Eleonora Bianchi, Raf Baldassarre, Yvette Lebon
description: While sailing to Ithaca, Ulysses is captured by Hercules by order of Jupiter, who intends to deliver him to Polyphemus. The two are taken prisoner by terrible beings half men and half birds, but they manage to escape. However, Ulysses is again captured by the troglodytes, while Hercules manages to reach the city ruled by the father of Elena, his fiancée. The strongman, having gathered the armed forces, commands a punitive expedition against the troglodytes.
notes: Incoherent and rather weak Caiano's first work. Numerous naiveties at the narrative level.

title: Tonka
actors: Sal Mineo, Philip Carey, Jerome Courtland, Rafael Campos
description: History of the Tonka horse, first disputed between the Toro Bianco and Toro Giallo Indians and then sold to the 7th Cavalry and, finally, returned to Toro Bianco after Little Big Horn. The film is a Walt Disney production and, despite its historical background, certainly not one of the memorable ones.

title: Punchline
actors: Sally Field, Tom Hanks, John Goodman, Mark Rydell, Kim Griest
description: Lilah, a dissatisfied housewife from New Jersey, seeks compensation for family mediocrity by reciting comic monologues in a New York club. He is not very successful, to be honest, with the public, unlike the young "colleague" Steven, a former university student and now a full-time comedian. A warm friendship is born between the two. Finally Lilah proves herself to be a good comedian, winning a contest for TV; only then does he choose to return to his family and leave the prize to Steven. Comedy without particular flashes; from the world of entertainment many good feelings behind the unscrupulous appearance of dialogues and situations.

title: The Last Wagon
actors: Richard Widmark, Felicia Farr, Tommy Rettig, Susan Kohner
description: A half-caste rescues a caravan attacked by Indians and drives it across the desert. A western with an evocative force that also brings up racial prejudices against mixed blood; excellent landscape photography.

title: L'ultima carrozzella
actors: Aldo Fabrizi, Anna Magnani, Lauro Gazzolo, Tino Scotti, Olga Solbelli
description: A Roman coachman is accused by a famous variety artist of having exchanged the ring she had forgotten in the wheelchair for a fake one. The coachman, however, is innocent. The Fabrizi-Magnani couple repeats the success of the previous "Campo de 'Fiori". The screenplay is by Federico Fellini and Fabrizi himself.

title: The Last Detail
actors: Jack Nicholson, Randy Quaid, Otis Young
description: Two naval sergeants cross half of America to escort a sailor sentenced to eight years for a theft of forty dollars to prison. The trip serves the three to forge a singular friendship, not devoid of roughness, but also deep and sincere. The sailor is more of a misfit than a delinquent and his "jailers" realize that he is about to pay off sins that are not his. The last hours of freedom thus become a hide and seek game between possibility and necessity.
notes: Director Ashby is the same as "Coming Home". Nicholson is huge and Randy Quaid stands up to him, and that's no small feat. From the film comes the portrait of a ruthless, cruel and moralistic America that time has not scratched.

title: Go Toward the Light
actors: Linda Hamilton, Piper Laurie, Joshua Harris, Ned Beatty
description: Ben's family can't be said to be lucky. Ben and his two siblings are all hemophiliacs; to this disease is added for him the tragedy of having contracted AIDS in the course of medical treatment.
notes: The film tells the story of Ben's last year of life and the terrible fate of a family facing death. Behind the film there is a true story; the drama is therefore doubled by this reference to reality. Good intentions are evident; the direction is not aimed at the show. Among the protagonists is Linda Hamilton, warrior mother in the two "Terminators".

title: The Last Movie
actors: Dennis Hopper, Stella Garcia, Tomas Milian
description: Kansas is part of an American crew that has finished shooting a western in Peru. As everyone returns home, he decides to stay, in love with a local girl. In the meantime, the villagers organize the staging of the cinematographic "rite", which will eventually intertwine with the annual procession destined to turn into a religious drama. After the success of Easy Rider, which had made him a sort of star of the new American cinema, Hopper makes this acid and "cursed" film, where he represents in total and masochistic freedom of expression his own sacrifice on the altar of Hollywood cinema.

title: Silent Movie
actors: Mel Brooks, Marty Feldman, Dom DeLuise, Bernadette Peters
description: An alcoholic director, along with his two bizarre assistants, tries to save an independent production company by making a silent film and focusing on the participation of big names in cinema: Paul Newman, Liza Minnelli, James Caan, Anne Bancroft and the French mime Marcel Marceau speaking the only word in the film. Unequal and unbalanced film like the imagination of its author; burst of silent gags, double meanings and ante litteram madness. Some moments, however, are unforgettable.

title: Full Moon in Blue Water
actors: Gene Hackman, Teri Garr, Burgess Meredith
description: Floyd runs a bar near a lake. The customers are few, but the bar is tempting to many because they are about to build a bridge nearby. Louise, who is a driver and is in love with Floyd, would like to help him pay off the debt with the bank, but the man refuses: he is haunted by the memory of his wife who disappeared a few years earlier and spends his time reviewing films that film them while they lived happily. But the woman's body is found, and Floyd realizes he has to move on: he accepts Louise's love and tidies up the bar. A little static theatrical story that crushes the usual good interpretation of Gene Hackman.

title: Ultima meta
actors: Oliver Tobias, Ernest Borgnine, Charles Napier, Martin Balsam
description: On a Caribbean island, a naive tourist falls into the hands of a group of drug dealers, who imprison her. His request for help reaches his father, a coach of an American football team. The indomitable parent, just to make things right, goes to get his daughter back and takes the whole team with him.
notes: Initially released as "The Last Game" (also because the "goal" with football has to do with the "ring" with football), the film is actually very Italian, directed by the producer-director of "The boy from the kimono d ' gold". The film is definitely ugly, but Borgnine and Balsam are still them.

title: Deadline USA
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Ethel Barrymore, Kim Hunter
description: The heirs of the recently deceased old owner have decided to stop publishing the newspaper "The Day". This decision is strenuously opposed by the director Ed Hutcheson, who is carrying out an investigation into the murder of a girl who seems to be hiding a case of sensational corruption. To avoid closure, Ed decides to take the case to court: thus gaining precious time to discover the truth and write it in the newspaper. It is one of the most passionate films dedicated to American journalism, directed by a director at ease with civil issues and fast rhythms.

title: The Last Wave
actors: Richard Chamberlain, Olivia Hamnett, Frederick Parslow, Vivean Gray, Nandjiwarra Amagula, Walter Amagula, David Gulpilil, Roy Bara
description: In Sydney, a lawyer has to defend a group of Aborigines from the accusation of having murdered one of their comrades; the crime has a magical tribal implication and the lawyer himself becomes prey to catastrophic visions that make him intuit an apocalyptic truth.
notes: After the excellent "Picnic at Hanging Rock", Australian director Peter Weir abandons the allusive style, but equally offers moments of intense emotion in a gothic that analyzes the relationship between modern, technological and urban Australia, and the aboriginal myths of apocalypse.

title: Union Station
actors: William Holden, Barry Fitzgerald, Nancy Olson
description: A gang of criminals kidnaps a blind girl, the daughter of a financier. A Los Angeles station is chosen as the place for the ransom payment. A good thriller shot on real locations.

title: Game of Death II/Si wang ta
actors: Bruce Lee, Tong Lung, Huong-Cheng-Li, Roy Horan, Roy Chiao, Lee Hoi-San, Miranda Austin
description: Billy Lo (Bruce Lee) is killed while investigating the death of a friend, and the film follows the adventures of younger brother Bobby (Tong Lung), who finds the perpetrators in the US.
notes: It is one of the many films that have exploited the scraps of films shot by the martial arts master Bruce Lee, who died in 1973. In spite of everything, the product reserves moments of great spectacular emotion, especially in the final duel.

title: The Last Time I Saw Paris
actors: Elizabeth Taylor, Van Johnson, Walter Pidgeon, Donna Reed, Roger Moore
description: In the festive atmosphere of Paris just liberated from the German occupation, the American lieutenant Charles Willis meets and marries Elena, from a very wealthy family. A daughter, Vicki, is born, whom the parents adore, but the marriage goes into crisis for several reasons: he does not earn enough and both seek consolation elsewhere. The drama explodes very hard.
notes: The narration is held on strongly melodramatic tones that tend to wrest the emotion of the audience with all too open artifices. Even the actors adapt to a manner acting. A film that was enormously successful, but which today appears very dated.

title: The Day the Earth Stood Still
actors: Michael Rennie, Patricia Neal, Hugh Marlowe, Sam Jaffe
description: The alien Klaatu, who landed in the United States with a flying saucer, asks to see the leaders of humanity to convince the world powers to eliminate nuclear weapons. Welcomed with hostile obtuseness, he will try to live incognito and get to know humans: guarding the disk remains Gort, a silent but very powerful robot ...
notes: A classic - directed by the great Wise - of science fiction cinema of the 1950s, pacifist and almost mystical long before Spielberg. Famous is the command given to the robot to stop its destructive intentions: "Klaatu barada nikto" (mentioned, as a magic formula, in Sam Raimi's Army of Darkness).

title: The Private Life of Don Juan
actors: Douglas Fairbanks, Merle Oberon, Binnie Barnes, Joan Gardner
description: Don Giovanni has arrived in Seville, now old and incognito. When the news leaks out, a local womanizer pretends to be him convinced in this way to increase his own haul of conquests; however, he is killed in a duel and the women of the city rush to what they believe is the funeral of the great seducer.
notes: Korda, a great English producer and director, seems to be sinning a little too much desire to make an artistic film, but the results are still interesting.

title: The Last Tycoon
actors: Robert De Niro, Jeanne Moreau, Robert Mitchum, Ingrid Boulting, Jack Nicholson
description: The lucid cynicism, the naive romanticism, the rise and the end of Monroe Stahr, film producer in Hollywood in the thirties. From Francis Scott Fitzgerald a film full of exemplary sequences, with a stratospheric cast and the screenplay by Harold Pinter. It was Kazan's last direction. A film of monumental decadence, with a masterful direction of actors and a famous sequence: the one in which the producer explains the secret of cinema with a coin.

title: L'ultimo amante
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, May Britt, Nino Besozzi, Frank Latimore
description: Cesare Monti, who works in a newspaper, leads a disordered life. One evening, while at the police station looking for news, he finds Maria, a girl he had met in a gambling house in Tunis, during the war. The woman had taken care of him after a bombing. Caesar has her released and with the help of a friend has her welcomed into a House of Redemption. Reunited with an old lover, however, Maria would like to escape, but a serious heart disease does not allow her to do so. Only feeling close to death, the woman asks Cesare to marry her ...
notes: Weeping drama, but Mattoli (who is remaking his old film "Tonight Nothing New") seems to direct without interest.

title: Apache
actors: Burt Lancaster, Jean Peters, Charles Buchinsky, Ian McDonald
description: In 1886, Colonel Beck's American troops finally defeated the Indians of Geronimo, who were deported to a reservation. One of them, Massai, decides to continue the fight. Captured, he escapes and finds refuge on the farm of a Cherokee Indian who urges him to desist. Denounced by the renegade Hondo, Massai is revived but escapes again and with his partner Nanline takes refuge in the mountains, where the woman will give birth to a son.Aldrich would have wanted a less consoling ending: Hondo had to shoot Massai in the back at the moment. which he turned around hearing the cry of his son, but production requirements made things go differently. In any case, with this film, the typical Aldrich hero and a genre of cinema more favorable to Indian themes are born.

title: The Flight of the Intruder
actors: Danny Glover, Willem Dafoe, Brad Johnson, Rosanna Arquette, Tom Sizemore
description: In the skies of Vietnam two battles are fought: one against the enemy and one against the orders of superiors. Two American aviation pilots decide that this is not how wars are won and, disobeying the orders received, they go to bomb some areas of Hanoi declared off-limits by the American command itself.
notes: Milius is a very good action movie director and the aerial sequences are well shot. It is the story that becomes obvious too quickly. "We wouldn't have lost that war if they'd left us free," says Stallone at the end of "Rambo". Stallone takes thirty seconds to say it, Milius takes one hundred and twenty minutes.

title: The Adventurers
actors: Bekim Fehmiu, Charles Aznavour, Candice Bergen, Ernest Borgnine
description: In the imaginary South American state of Corteguay, three revolutionaries seize power by overthrowing a cruel dictator. One of the three is sent, together with his son, as ambassador to Rome, but, in the meantime, the situation deteriorates in the Corteguay. The ambassador returns and is killed. The same fate will also befall the son. It is a classic cartoon where the most heterogeneous elements are mixed together without restraint: an international cast, a little sex, the charm of exoticism and even a little solidarity with the revolutionary movements. Which is not surprising when you consider that the film is based on a novel by Harold Robbins.

title: L'ultimo ballo
actors: Elsa Merlini, Amedeo Nazzari, Renato Cialente
description: A good lady, taken by the fear of getting old, gives herself to the frivolities of worldly life. She has an affair and is about to commit nonsense with her lover. A daughter intervenes who convinces her of the squalor of her belated ambitions and directs her back to the right path. Taken from a play by the Hungarian Ferenc Herczeg, the subject is so forbidden that not even a capable director like Camillo Mastrocinque, here in the early years of a very long activity, is able to enliven it. The cast lines up numerous beautiful names in Italian cinema and theater. Note Elsa Merlini in the double role of Baroness Marcus and her daughter.

title: Day of the Evil Gun
actors: Glenn Ford, Arthur Kennedy, Harry Dean Stanton, Dean Jagger
description: Wakenfield discovers that during his absence from home his wife was kidnapped with her daughters by the Indians; moreover, Forbes, already long in love with the woman, had almost convinced her to marry him. But only Forbes joins him to look for the kidnapped women; the two will also have to face a group of renegades. Then they free them and face off in one final deadly duel.
notes: By 1968 the classic western was dead, but there were still those who ignored it. So here is a late western, at a time when Leone's spaghetti-westerns or Peckinpah's anti-westerns were popular. Too bad for Glenn Ford, completely wasted.

title: Dernier domicile connu
actors: Lino Ventura, Marlène Jobert, Michel Constantin
description: Commissioner Leonetti, now close to retirement, is entrusted with a strange task: to track down an individual of whom there has been no trace for five years, who must testify in a trial against members of the underworld. With the help of the young assistant Jeanne, the inspector manages to find the missing person. But the mala does not forgive, and the poor man is murdered under the eyes of his little girl. With sober and precise effectiveness, Giovanni criticizes the police system and its principle that the end justifies the means. Successful criticism also thanks to the impeccable interpretation of Lino Ventura which gives his character strength and depth.

title: The Last Dragon
actors: Taimak, Vanity, Julius J. Carry III
description: Passionate martial arts lover falls in love with a beautiful video D.J. and finds himself having to fight a violent gang of gangsters. Fast consumer cinema, recommended for teenagers. Brief appearance of Chazz Palminteri.

title: The Last Gangster
actors: Edward G. Robinson, James Stewart, Rose Stradner, Lionel Stander
description: Joe Krozac is a gangster who went to jail for tax evasion. Meanwhile his wife, who in all good faith believed him innocent, falls in love with a journalist who reveals the truth about her husband. After serving his sentence, Joe gets out of jail with proud intentions of revenge against his wife. Robinson's role as a gangster stuck to his hands like fly paper. "Piccolo Cesare" was from '31 and already in '37 no one could take it anymore. In Italy, then, the film was released in 1953, with the result of appearing even more dated. But as obvious as the story is, the film works perfectly thanks to a very young Stewart.

title: Ultimo incontro
actors: Jean-Pierre Aumont, Alida Valli, Amedeo Nazzari
description: Lina cheats on her husband with Michele, a racing driver. The two plan to escape, but at the last moment Lina pulls back and Michele, upset, loses control of the car during a race and dies. At that point, however, Lina, to pay the silence of a mechanic of the pilot, ready to reveal the whole story, is forced to prostitute herself. It is the usual tear-jerking film in which misfortunes never come alone. Franciolini, however, is not Maratazzo and even Nazzari, left to fend for himself, does not express himself at his best. Fortunately, there is Alida Valli.

title: L'ultimo killer
actors: George Eastman, Anthony Ghidra, Daniele Vargas, Dana Ghia
description: The wealthy Barret owns a mortgage on Ramon's lands and, just as Ramon prepares to pay it, orders his men to rob him. From this begins a long series of vendettas involving Ramon's father, a business partner of Barrett himself, and Raza, a professional killer. You won't believe it, but Ramon is the only one in the end to stay alive.
notes: In reality, this is how all spaghetti westerns were made in those years. And this is not even the best.

title: Fukkatsu no hi
actors: Sonny Chiba, Chuck Connors, Stephane Faulkner, Glenn Ford
description: The US military has developed a virus of terrifyingly lethal power, MM 88, for use in a betteriological weapon. Following a plane crash, a dose stolen from East Germany spreads into the atmosphere and mankind runs the risk of total annihilation. An earthquake hits Washington, resulting in chain nuclear explosions. The few survivors flee to Antarctica. The anti-militarist message is subordinate to the appeal of the spectacle constituted by the enormous disasters narrated. But the film is really patchy.

title: The Last Safari
actors: Stewart Granger, Kaz Garas, Gabriella Licudi, Johnny Sekka
description: A hunter with intentions of vengeance is on the trail of the elephant who killed his friend. He refuses a rich contract with a millionaire who, however, fascinated by the man, follows him tirelessly until the safari of the truth that will prove to be the most important moment in the life of both. Original and captivating film by Henry Hathaway, which focuses on the existential value of the man-nature relationship and on the eccentricity of narrative developments.

title: L'ultimo squalo
actors: James Franciscus, Vic Morrow, Micaela Pignatelli
description: A shark terrorizes a Californian town. The special effects are laughable. Does the plot remind you of anything?

title: The Last Waltz
actors: Bob Dylan, Van Morrison, Eric Clapton, Neil Young, Paul Butterield, Joni Mitchell
description: For sixteen years they have trod the most important scenes in the world. Then, in 1976, the final decision to break up after a great farewell concert. This is how the group "The Band" entered the legend of rock, famous among other things for having accompanied Bob Dylan in his most famous concerts. The final evening takes place at San Francisco's Wintherland; among the guests besides Dylan also Van Morrison, Eric Clapton, Neil Young, Paul Butterield, Joni Mitchell, that is, the best known names of West Coast music that had made the kids of the Sixties dream.
notes: Martin Scorsese resumes the concert by building on the youthful experience of "Woodstock", the legendary concert film that summed up that season. After a year-long editing, he proposes a memorable film.

title: Howling II: Your Sister Is a Werewolf
actors: Christopher Lee, Sybil Danning, Annie McEnroe, Reb Brown
description: A quiet village in the American province is the protagonist of a strange curse: many inhabitants, and among them all the notables, are werewolves. In the past (with reference to the first film of the series) something had been discovered, but then everything was silenced again. By chance a girl learns of the secret and the werewolf community works hard to silence the inconvenient witness. Contemporary horror with critical ambitions against social conventions: mayor and sheriff are on the side of evil, against them the young people of the country are lined up. Reference, only in the title, to the film directed in 1981 by Joe Dante. Direction and desolating performers.

title: The Howling
actors: Patrick Macnee, Dee Wallace, Belinda Balaski, John Carradine
description: Karen is a reporter on a television network. A bad day is traumatized by a frightening vision that causes her to lose her memory and mental balance. Her husband has her hospitalized in a specialized clinic, but here things are even worse because outside, in the night, mournful howls echo and inside the walls of the hospital mysterious things happen: here and there the corpses of people horribly tortured by monstrous are found. wolfweres that proliferate exponentially and threaten the whole of humanity. Series A horror created by the specialist Joe Dante, who, while operating within a strongly codified cinema and giving the right space to tricks, introduces non-trivial elements of reflection into its history. Between the lines we can read the critique of the power and fascination of the mass media, of the mania of mysticism; without ever too much rhetoric.

title: Umberto D.
actors: Carlo Battisti, Maria Pia Casilio, Memmo Carotenuto
description: A retired senior ministerial official is not doing particularly well from an economic and affection point of view. In fact, he lives alone, with a dog and a maid. The scarce economic resources no longer allow him a lifestyle in keeping with his culture and decorum and he is constantly late with the payment of the rent, as the grim landlady often points out. In a leap of dignity he decides to take his own life so as not to be a burden to others: however, it will be his dog who will involuntarily reconcile him with the world.
notes: Masterpiece of neorealism thanks to the couple De Sica (director) and Zavattini (screenwriter), who however veered towards a radical pessismism. In fact, the film aroused the ire of the then undersecretary Giulio Andreotti precisely because of his desolate vision of society.

title: Silver Bullet
actors: Gary Busey, Everett McGill, Corey Haim, Megan Follows, Robin Groves
description: In the small provincial town, corpses are wasted. Who is the killer? A handicapped boy notices that the crimes always take place during the full moon and from this goes back to the culprit: a werewolf, that is a wolf-man sensitive to the influence of the satellite. The child in the wheelchair will also play a major role in the capture of the mysterious multi-killer. The film is quite repetitive and shows all the canonical situations of the genre; more than to its director, Daniel Attias, the film is due to the scriptwriter, the producer (Dino De Laurentiis) and the author of the special effects Carlo Rambaldi.

title: One, Two, Three
actors: James Cagney, Horst Buchholz, Pamela Tiffin, Liselotte Pulver
description: During a vacation in Berlin, Scarlett (Rossella in the Italian version) - daughter of the great head of Coca Cola - falls in love with Otto, a young man from East Germany. MacNamara, the local executive of the multinational, first tries to dissuade the girl, then to convert him - orthodox communist - to the "joys" of capitalism ...
notes: In the year in which the wound of the Wall opened in the heart of the former capital of the Reich, Wilder shoots a masterpiece of speed, wickedness and humor that spares no one. James Cagney has never been so cynical and he doesn't miss a beat. The film is based on a one-act by Ferenc Molnár.

title: Count a Lonely Cadence
actors: Charlie Sheen, Martin Sheen, F. Murray Abraham, Laurence Fishburne
description: Franklin Bean jr. is an American soldier stationed in Germany in 1965. Returning from a leave from his father's funeral, Franklyn gets into a bar fight and is sent to jail at Camp Berenfeld which is run by the tyrannical Sergeant McKinney. The relationship between the two is explosive, up to the risk of a duel. Only at the end, when Franklyn is leaving for Vietnam, does a kind of understanding be established between the two. The two protagonists are father and son (Martin and Charlie Sheen) and this adds interest to the story. Too bad that the rest is so predictable that it never leaves the classic canons of the prison film.

title: Gli uomini, che mascalzoni...
actors: Vittorio De Sica, Lya Franca, Cesare Zoppetti, Aldo Moschino
description: Bruno, a young Milanese driver, pretends to be the owner of the luxurious car entrusted to him in order to impress Mariuccia, a perfumery shop assistant. Lost his job due to an undue trip to the lake, he also loses his girlfriend when he tries to make her jealous. Then everything is arranged in the best way, so much so that even her father, a taxi driver by profession, accepts the future son-in-law.
notes: Camerini, an authentic master of Italian cinematographic comedy, reaches here one of his peaks of humor and narrative freshness in narrating the voicende of the very small Italian bourgeoisie of the period. De Sica, star of the time, sings, and makes famous, "Talk to me of love, Mariù". Screenplay by Mario Soldati and Aldo De Benedetti.

title: Silver Bears
actors: Michael Caine, Cybill Shepherd, Stéphane Audran, David Warner, Joss Ackland, Charles Gray, Jay Leno, Martin Balsam, Louis Jourdan
description: In order to launder dirty money, an American boss opens a bank in Lugano, but finds himself dealing with a London billionaire, a Californian banker and the owner of a silver mine in Iran. second-hand sting, with much less class.

title: Uomini duri
actors: Lino Ventura, Isaac Hayes, Fred Williamson, Vittorio Sanipoli, Paula Kelly, William Berger, Lorella De Luca, Luciano Salce
description: An insurance investigator is murdered during a bank robbery investigation. Father Charlie, urged by the widow, decides to see clearly and risks big. Fortunately, Lee Travels, a former police captain disbarred from the ranks, gives him a hand. The two work on the case together, thwarted by Captain Ryan and mobster Mike Petralia.
notes: Tessari casually mixes excesses of Italian "action" with moods of the French and American police tradition, trusting above all the "estate" and credibility in the character of an actor like Lino Ventura. On balance it must be admitted that he was right.

title: Uomini e lupi
actors: Silvana Mangano, Yves Montand, Pedro Armendariz, Guido Celano, Giulio Calì, Maria Zanoli, Irene Cefaro
description: Giovanni, an expert wolf hunter, and Ricuccio his immature helper are in action in a small town in Abruzzo. The boy becomes an adult only when his teacher dies, but the love of Teresa, Giovanni's beautiful wife, also contributes to his growth.
notes: A frontier story, geographical and psychological, in the vigorous style of De Santis who had many problems with the Titanus. The director tried in vain to have his name removed from the titles.

title: Uomini ombra
actors: Mara Lane, Giorgio Albertazzi, Eduardo Cianelli
description: During the Second World War, a group of men from the Italian naval counterintelligence waged a long-distance fight with colleagues in the British Intelligence. The British try to make our "shadow men" fall into a trap but are mocked; In turn, the spies who escaped the trap dismantle the information network of the enemies and their base.
notes: Curious Italian spy film that, although made in years of peace, does not design the men of the English army as "immaculate liberators". Unfortunately, the lack of rhetoric is counterpointed by a modest direction. In a small role Paolo Stoppa.

title: Wild Rovers
actors: William Holden, Ryan O'Neal, Karl Malden, Lynn Carlin
description: Elder Ross Bodine and young Frank Post, both cowboys on Walter Buckman's farm, fed up with their modest living, decide to rob a bank. The hit earns them thirty-six thousand dollars. With the booty they go to Mexico where they intend to start a new existence. A large group of men, including Buckman's two sons, launches on their trail.
notes: The master of comedy Edwards engages in a twilight western typical of those years. But the film was tampered with by MGM, which cut nearly half an hour of film.

title: Uomo avvisato mezzo ammazzato... parola di Spirito Santo
actors: Gianni Garko, Pilar Velasquez, Paolo Gozlino
description: The infallible gunslinger Holy Spirit tries to take over a gold mine. To succeed, he must ally himself with a group of revolutionaries who try to overthrow a cruel dictator: only their leader, in fact, knows the exact location of the mine. Among all kinds of pitfalls he will succeed in his intent thanks also to the strong friend with the indicative nickname Carezza. Comic Western that takes advantage of the success of Trinity and makes fun of the political westerns that were fashionable a few years earlier. Among the performers also Paolo Gozlino, one of the most famous Italian dancers and set designers, masked with the Anglicizing pseudonym Paul Stevens.

title: No Way Out
actors: Richard Widmark, Linda Darnell, Sidney Poitier, Stephen McNally
description: Two criminals, Ray and John, are hospitalized, injured during a robbery; John dies and Ray accuses the black doctor who treated them for murder. He asks in vain for an autopsy and in the end sets up himself in order to obtain it. Only at this point is his innocence recognized. Ray, however, escapes from prison with the intention of killing him ... Anti-racist film not very close to Mankiewicz, which however manages to be much ahead of the others, and to still be exciting today.

title: L'homme qui aimait les femmes
actors: Charles Denner, Brigitte Fossey, Leslie Caron
description: Bertrand Morane, an impeccable engineer from Montpellier, spends his free time admiring, looking for, chasing women. He is not a Don Juan, he is not a viveur or a psychopath. He does it simply because he feels comfortable with women and, above all, he feels alive. One day, on Christmas Eve 1976, to follow a woman, he crosses the street and dies. The long theory of his "widows" parades over his grave.
notes: Despite the lightness of the touch, it is a film full of a sense of death: more than Lubitsch, it reminds one of Truffaut's next film, "The Green Room". Quote to remember: "Women's legs are the compasses that measure the world".

title: The Man Who Fell to Earth
actors: David Bowie, Candy Clark, Rip Torn, Buck Henry, Bernie Casey
description: Tom Newton, human in appearance, is actually an alien fallen to earth who becomes an industrial tycoon. At the height of his wealth he is betrayed by his most faithful collaborator who hands him over to the government. Beautiful directed by Roeg and great Bowie when he takes off his contact lenses and reveals his alien eyes. From a novel by Walter Tevis, an existential science fiction film very 70s in style and sociological pessimism, with a great and bewildered Bowie.

title: L'uomo che ride
actors: Jean Sorel, Lisa Gastoni, Ilaria Occhini, Edmund Purdom, Linda Sini, Gianni Musy
description: Cesare Borgia, the evil Duke Valentino, has a disfigured acrobat subjected to facial plastic and for this he performs with his face covered by a mask. The acrobat thus becomes the perfect double of Prince Astorre Manfredi, bitter rival of the Borgia. The purpose of the plot is of course the elimination of Manfredi, but the acrobat, having discovered the deception, goes to the side of the prince and foils the plots of the evil one. From the novel by Victor Hugo, an attempt at Corbucci's costume drama off the ropes.

title: The Man Who Knew Too Much
actors: James Stewart, Doris Day, Daniel Gélin, Brenda De Banzie
description: Doctor Ben McKenna, on vacation in Marrakech with his family, casually collects information from a dying spy on the attack that will be carried out in London against a foreign politician. The attackers, who have earned his trust by passing themselves off as tourists, kidnap his little son to blackmail him into silence ...
notes: Remake of a film also shot by Hitchcock in 1934. The suspense mechanism develops in a masterly way: naturally the sequence, all set on the musical score, of the attack on the Albert Hall in London is extraordinary. The tune _Que será será_ will become an international success.

title: L'uomo che sorride
actors: Vittorio De Sica, Assia Noris, Umberto Melnati, Enrico Viarisio
description: A rich widower would more than willingly get rid of his grumpy daughter (Noris), but it seems she does it on purpose to screw up every possible opportunity. Until, one day, Pio Fardella (De Sica) enters the scene, accepting the "risk" of the wedding and appeasing his wife. The text was not excelled in the theater, and the film version leaves it more or less the same.

title: A Covenant with Death
actors: George Maharis, Laura Devon, Katy Jurado, Gene Hackman
description: Brian Talbot was found drunk next to his wife's dead body. He is accused of murder and sentenced to death despite proclaiming himself innocent. Then he tries to escape by killing the executioner and the trial is entrusted to a new judge. The latter has doubts about the first murder and discovers that the culprit is another: however, the problem remains of how to evaluate the second killing. Despite the attitude of the accused, who comes to attack him, the judge acts according to his conscience and acquits Talbot. An effective director especially of westerns, Lamont Johnson faces this time a judicial thriller doing very well.

title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
actors: John Wayne, James Stewart, Lee Marvin, Vera Miles, Edmond O'Brien
description: Senator Stoddard at the funeral of old Tom, in a remote western town, tells a journalist about their friendship, cemented in his youth by the fight against the fearsome outlaw Liberty Valance. Stoddard was then a novice lawyer, who found in Tom a precious ally; unintentionally he stole his girl too, after killing (so he believed) Valance in a duel. Now he is finally back with his wife to live forever in the region. Ford shows us for his part the transition from the justice of the colt to that of the law in a Far West that starts on the road of civilization, but making us cry about the end of the legend for the benefit of the more prosaic history.

title: Vengeance
actors: Peter Van Eyck, Bernard Lee, Anne Heywood, Cecil Parker, Maxine Audley
description: Peter Corrie, a scientist at the forefront of biological research, picks up a victim of a plane crash. Despite the rescue, the man, the financier Max Holt, does not survive, but the scientist manages to keep his brain alive. From that moment on Corrie begins to be influenced by the being who lives in his laboratory, so much so that he begins to investigate and discover that the plane crash was malicious. Yet another version, and not even the best, of Curt Siodmak's novel, "Donovan's Brain". Freddie Francis, here on the second film as director, would do better later.

title: I've Lived Before
actors: Jock Mahoney, Leigh Snowden, Ann Harding, John McIntire
description: John Bolan, a civil aviation pilot, while driving an airliner, suddenly loses control of himself and launches into frightening evolution. The situation is resolved by the second pilot who puts him out of action and thus manages to land the plane. John is hospitalized and explains that his reaction was caused by a strange psychic phenomenon. The man relives the memories belonging to the life of another aviator, who fell in the war. A really curious story for a small psychological thriller directed by a western craftsman.

title: The Time Machine
actors: Rod Taylor, Alan Young, Yvette Mimieux, Whit Bissell
description: George has always been fascinated by the "time" factor and after many attempts, he managed to develop a sophisticated device capable of making him travel into the future. On the evening of December 31, 1899, he stands at the controls of the car and in a moment he finds himself in 1917. But his fantastic journey does not end with this stage. George visits 1940, 1959 and 1966. Then, with a prodigious leap into the future, he even finds himself in 802.701 ...
notes: The novel by Herbert G. Wells from which the film was based comes out a bit battered, but the special effects (Oscar in 1960) are still enjoyable.

title: The Man Who Would Be King
actors: Sean Connery, Michael Caine, Christopher Plummer, Saeed Larbi
description: Dravot and Peachy are two former British Army officers. Together they organize an expedition to conquer a fabulous and unknown kingdom in the mountains of Kafiristan. And they succeed. What's more, Dravot is also worshiped as a god, but when a bite from the princess reveals her human condition on her wedding day, everything falls apart.
notes: Huston makes an excellent adventure film, based on a youthful tale by Kipling, on the theme of the cruel fate that mocked and defrauded the heroes of the fruit of their labors. But it does so without rhetoric, with a healthy irony. Masterful staging, beautiful photography, top-of-the-range interpretation.

title: A Man Called Intrepid
actors: David Niven, Barbara Hershey, Michael York
description: The true story of William Stevenson, a Canadian spy during World War II. Television debut for David Niven.

title: Celovek s kinoapparatom
description: A cameraman wanders around a Russian city, filming its life, from the first light of dawn to sunset: the city wakes up, the people, the streets, the markets, while the man with the camera goes right into the houses . In the evening, after the beach has also been displaced, the camera escapes the operator's hands and improvises an ironic ballet in a cinema: at an accelerated pace, all the material filmed is reviewed. Eventually the Bol'soj is shattered.
notes: Shot in Odessa, Kiev and Moscow (as if they were one place), Vertov's film is a masterpiece of the history of cinema that explains how the seventh art can also be a "place of utopia". Utopia (or illusion) of absolute cinema, projected in front of the viewer with the only intermediation of an operator. Vertov throws himself headlong into the suggestions of the artistic avant-gardes of the beginning of the century: futurist in the aesthetics of speed, constructivist in the decomposition of reality, naturalist in documentary impulses.

title: Midnight Cowboy
actors: Dustin Hoffman, Jon Voight, Brenda Vaccaro, John McGiver
description: Joe Bucker arrives in New York, from Texas, convinced that he can make a lot of money thanks to his exuberant virility to be made available to single women. The reality of the "job" will turn out to be very different and much more bitter. In the metropolitan jungle, Joe finds a true friend in the consumptive Rico. In the vain hope of being able to heal him, Joe will accompany Rico on his last trip to Florida.
notes: It was a cult film of the 70s, it remains one of the most lucid and ruthless portraits of New York, and at the same time the analysis of a friendship that tries to redeem man from the slums of his passions. Famous JOhn Barry score. Oscar for Best Picture, Best Direction and Best Screenplay.

title: The Man with X-Ray Eyes
actors: Ray Milland, Diana Van Der Vlis, Harold Stone, John Hoyt, Don Rickles
description: Doctor Xavier injects himself with a serum which allows him to obtain an X-ray vision. Accidentally procuring the death of a colleague, he begins to wander from town to town. After being exploited even in an amusement park he comes to the decision to blind himself, also to escape the painful side effects of the serum: terrible migraines and the need to wear leaded glasses.
