At the height of his Poe period, Corman tries this sci-fi-horror, from a short story by Ray Russell. With little means, a lot of ingenuity and a relentless and well-crafted story.

title: The Man with Two Brains
actors: Steve Martin, Kathleen Turner, David Warner, Paul Benedict
description: The famous surgeon dr. Hfuhruhurr (Steve Martin) specializes in brain surgery. Thanks to his skill, our doctor was able to keep alive the brain of his dead wife, with whom he continues to communicate. His advice will come in handy when he starts a relationship with a mean and calculating woman. Fantademenziale with an excellent cast, directed by veteran Reiner.

title: The Man with the Golden Arm
actors: Frank Sinatra, Kim Novak, Eleanor Parker, Arnold Stang
description: Frank, a morphine addict croupier, feels the guilt of having caused the paralysis of his wife Anna. After yet another detox treatment, he would like to become a drummer in an orchestra, but rebuilding a life is not easy. He is accused of murdering a trafficker, but the killer is actually Anna, who pretended to be paralyzed just to keep Frank tied to her; seeing herself uncovered, the woman kills herself. Now Frank will be able to live his love for neighbor Molly without remorse.
notes: A film that bravely tackled the burning issue of drugs for the time, relying on the film noir atmosphere and the charisma of the excellent protagonists, in particular Sinatra.

title: Coogan's Bluff
actors: Clint Eastwood, Susan Clark, Tisha Sterling, Don Stroude
description: Deputy Sheriff Coogan is sent from an Arizona town to New York to pick up a criminal in custody, Jameson Ringerman. Coogan is a tough and intolerant type of bureaucracy. He picks up Ringerman from the infirmary without permission and, when the gangster manages to escape, he sets out to find him alone. In this detective story, the character played by Eastwood is the prototype from which the famous Lieutenant Callaghan will derive shortly after.

title: The Man in the Iron Mask
actors: Richard Chamberlain, Patrick McGoohan, Louis Jourdan, Jenny Agutter
description: Louis XIV, king of France, has a twin brother named Philip, who grew up incognito and away from court. When Luigi learns of his existence he decides to have him locked up in the Bastille and, moreover, to cover his face that is identical to his with an iron mask. But D'Artagnan rushes to his aid and sets things right, brings Philip back to the throne and Louis to the Bastille.
notes: Yet another version, but certainly not the worst, of Dumas' novel. Richard Chamberlain plays the role of both brothers and seems to be enjoying himself. Patrick MacGoohan, the director of the prison in Escape from Alcatraz, is the evil Fouquet.

title: De la part des copains
actors: Charles Bronson, Liv Ullmann, James Mason, Jill Ireland
description: John Martin escapes from military prison with other inmates, but, when they kill a policeman, he leaves them. Years later, being tracked down by former escape companions, Martin is forced to collaborate in a drug trafficking. He will know how to fix the whole gang and will be able to resume a peaceful existence with his wife and daughter.
notes: On a scheme that is anything but original, the film is constructed in such a way that the dramatic tension does not undergo fraying, but with the use of some obvious narrative forcing. The director, the protagonist and the other performers get by, each for their own skills, thanks to a super-tested profession.

title: The Man Who Could Work Miracles
actors: Roland Young, Joan Gardner, Ralph Richardson
description: The young man, who works as a clerk in a shop, is continually humiliated by the arrogance and ignorance of his neighbor. By a strange magic, one day he is given the extraordinary power to work miracles. Our hero feels himself master of the world, he can change the phenomena of nature and influence events. Soon he will have to realize that once again his fellow men take advantage of him because, instead of using his powers for a good purpose, they exploit him for their own interests.
notes: The film, with a bitter finish, is a polite fable, exquisitely British, based on a fantastic novel by H.G. Wells.

title: Borderline
actors: Charles Bronson, Bruno Kirby, Bert Remsen, Ed Harris
description: The man in the title is the rocky "customs officer" Jeb Maynard (Charles Bronson) in whose jurisdiction there is a substantial trafficking of drugs and illegal immigrants from Mexico to the states. Jeb has a great friend, fellow Scooter Jackson, who is now close to retirement. The latter, one night, discovers a shipment of drugs and is wiped out by traffickers who also kill a boy who was trying to emigrate illegally. Bronson-movie equal to a hundred others.

title: The Southerner
actors: Zachary Scott, Betty Field, Beulah Bondi, J. Carrol Naish
description: The harsh life of a young farmer and his family, determined to conquer a free and dignified life on their land, despite adversity and natural disasters. Superb blend of mystical and realistic visionary of the great Jean Renoir in his American period.

title: L'uomo dalla croce
actors: Alberto Tavazzi, Roswita Schmidt, Attilio Dottesio
description: In the summer of 1942, a chaplain following the Italian army in Russia decides to stay next to an intractable wounded man even when the rest of the unit is ordered to move. The two are taken prisoner. Roberto Rossellini shoots the film in Ladispoli with non-professional actors. The question is still open: propaganda film or impressive prelude to neorealism? Probably both.

title: Man from God's Country
actors: George Montgomery, Randy Stuart, Kim Charney, Gregg Barton
description: Dan is a sheriff who gave up the star after killing a man in self-defense. He joins his former comrade in arms Jack to give himself to the breeding, but here he is mistaken for a railroad official. The owner of the local transport company pays Jack to take him out; he begs his friend to leave, but Dan refuses and decides to face the sender to free the city from its yoke. He succeeds, in a direct confrontation where even Jack finally takes his side. An adventurer in all genres of B-movie, Paul Landres here gives us a routine western in both subject matter and direction.

title: Les tribulations d'un Chinois en Chine
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Ursula Andress, Valerie Lagrange, Jess Hahn
description: Belmondo, heir to a colossal heritage, is bored. He tries all ways to commit suicide, but in vain, and then hires a hitman to kill him. But when he meets a beautiful girl who works as a stripper in Hong Kong, he changes his mind and begins the search for the hit man who should kill him to cancel the order. However, the thing is more difficult than expected. Sequel of the "UOmo di Rio", not too lively despite the nice Belmondo.

title: Tha Man from Laramie
actors: James Stewart, Arthur Kennedy, Donald Crisp, Cathy O'Donnell
description: Captain Lockhart must stop an arms trade that someone sells to the Apaches. Dave, the son of a wealthy landowner, is involved, and when the young man is killed his father puts the blame on Lockhart and tries to avenge him. But the black soul of the whole operation is Vic, Dave's lieutenant, who also tries to kill the old man, saved instead by Lockhart. A classic of the genre, almost a classic tragedy, directed by a director who is one of the greatest storytellers of the western epic and with performers who work at their best. From a novel by Louis L'Amour.

title: Czlowiek z marmuru
actors: Jerzy Radziwilowicz, Krystyna Janda, Ewa Zietek
description: Agnieszka, a young Polish graduate student in cinema, decides to shoot a documentary about Birkut, a hero of work in Stalin's time and of whom nothing was known after the memorable feat he had accomplished: with his team he had placed 30,509 bricks while they were building a palace. Gradually Agnieszka discovers that the case was blown up for propaganda purposes, that Birkut was subsequently marginalized and died as an opponent of the regime. Wajda investigates Poland's past. Between historical reconstruction, personal events, documentary and reflection on cinema, he invents a way of political cinema that will continue with the subsequent, less successful "Iron Man".

title: The Midnight Man
actors: Burt Lancaster, Susan Clark, Cameron Mitchell, Morgan Woodward
description: After a murder conviction, former agent Jim Slade is granted bail and a night watchman position at a local college. On the trail of some confidential tapes stolen from a professor, Slade finds himself working with the police on the case of a murdered student, daughter of a senator. But Slade will soon have to realize the hard way that not everyone who offers him a hand is actually on his side. Yellow without great merits, written co-directed and interpreted by Lancaster.

title: L'uomo di paglia
actors: Pietro Germi, Luisa Della Noce, Franca Bettoja, Edoardo Evola
description: Andrea Zaccardi is forty years old, a job as a skilled worker, a wife named Luisa and an eight-year-old son who has recovered from a bad illness. Precisely for this reason Luisa takes her son to the sea in convalescence. Andrea remains alone in Rome and meets Rita.
notes: Vaguely reactionary late-realist drama, less effective and moving than the "Railwayman".

title: L'homme de Rio
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Françoise Dorléac, Jean Servais, Simone Renant
description: Adriano returns home on leave and discovers that his girlfriend Agnese has just been kidnapped. After a chase, he joins the kidnappers at the airport and takes their own plane, bound for Rio de Janeiro. Here, after amazing adventures, he frees Agnes and reveals the criminal machinations behind the affair, linked to the discovery of an ancient civilization and its precious finds. Very lively yellow-pink directed by De Broca; for Belmondo it will be increasingly difficult to break away from the role of which the character of Adriano is the prototype. At his side the beautiful and unfortunate elder sister of Catherine Deneuve, Françoise Dorléac.

title: Fools' Parade
actors: James Stewart, George Kennedy, Kurt Russell
description: Matt, after serving forty years of forced labor, finds himself free and with a fair amount of money. In the company of friends, also former prisoners, he would like to undertake a commercial activity to redeem his previous life. His treasure is tempting to a dishonest banker who, with the complicity of a corrupt policeman, will try to get hold of it. The man, after trying in every possible way to escape, kills the agent by blowing him up with a load of dynamite. So he will end up in court again ...
notes: Andrew McLaglen, son of Victor, cult actor for John Ford, directs a comedy with dramatic implications. Old Stewart is always a security.

title: Un uomo in ginocchio
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Eleonora Giorgi, Michele Placido, Ettore Manni
description: Nino Peralta runs a kiosk next to Palermo's cathedral, but it hasn't been quiet for a few days. There is a guy who follows him and he doesn't know why. It is his partner Colicchia who explains to him that the man is a hitman of a mafia boss, who has decided to eliminate him because he suspects him as a friend of a rival boss. Nino then sells the bar and, in order to save himself, tries to get in touch with the killer. It is the usual film of denunciation against the mafia that does not denounce anything except the obviousness of its plot. Not among the best in Damiani.

title: An Innocent Man
actors: Tom Selleck, F. Murray Abraham, Laila Robins, David Rasche
description: Peaceful airport technician Jimmie Rainwood (Tom Selleck) ends up in jail "framed" by the false evidence of two corrupt narcotics agents. The ferocious life of the maximum security prison in which he is locked up transforms Rainwood into an unscrupulous tough guy, also capable of killing to defend himself. Having obtained the protection of a mob boss, he ends up getting respected by the other inmates. Released after three years, his only desire is to be able to take revenge. Will he succeed?
notes: Dramatic theme is the metamorphosis of a quiet man who must adapt to the law of the jungle to survive. Peter Yates is a fairly good director, but here he doesn't go beyond the limits of the anonymous action film; good photography by William Fraker.

title: Invisible Man
actors: Claude Rains, Gloria Stuart, Henry Travers, William Harrigan, Una O'Connor, Forrester Harvey, Holmes Herbert, E.E. Clive, Dudley Digges
description: A scientist discovers the secret of invisibility. The potion he has injected (and which has no antidotes) also transforms him into a kind of Mr. Hyde determined to challenge the world. Unmasked by the footprints he leaves in the snow, he is hunted down by the police after a series of tragic events.
notes: Taken from the famous story by H.G. Wells and packaged with the usual skill by Whale, which does not fail to emphasize his taste for irony and lightness of writing. The director wanted Karloff in the lead role, but Universal forced him to Rains. Sequel and remake (also apocryphal) as if it were raining ...

title: L'uomo, l'orgoglio e la vendetta
actors: Franco Nero, Tina Aumont, Klaus Kinski, Lee Burton, Franco Ressel
description: The non-commissioned officer José is demoted for having let a prisoner escape on the way to the prison. The girl named Carmen already has a husband, the bandit Garcia, has relations with other officers and eventually runs off with a bullfighter. Suso Cecchi from a friend re-lives a western "Carmen". but the direction of Bazzoni and the interpretation of Nero are not great.

title: L'uomo, la bestia e la virtù
actors: Totò, Orson Welles, Viviane Romance, Clelia Matania, Franca Faldini
description: The relations between Assunta Perrella and her husband, a long-time captain, are practically non-existent. He comes home twice a year and she consoles herself, in the interval, with Professor Paolino. Then she gets pregnant and, to save things, she tries to seduce her husband so as to reassure him about the paternity of the unborn child. The fact that this comedy is badly taken from a Pirandello novel is the less scandalous thing after all. Disappointing adaptation of Pirandello's classic, despite Totò, Welles and the screenwriter Vitaliano Brancati.

title: The Gauntlet
actors: Clint Eastwood, Sondra Locke, Pat Hingle, William Prince, Bill McKinney
description: Ben Shockley is a LAPD detective on the run with too much bureaucracy imposed from above. He is entrusted with custody of a witness from Las Vegas: a prostitute named Gus Mally. A small assignment that will prove to be explosive: a trap hatched by his own bosses, to kill two birds with one stone. But Ben and Gus together will know how to turn the omelette. One of Clint Eastwood's best detective stories, all action and fury. But watch out: there is a female gaze in the middle and the image of the tough policeman does not come out exactly intact. Nice little guy Sondra Locke: she will then become Clint's partner in life.

title: A Man for All Seasons
actors: Paul Scofield, Wendy Hiller, Leo McKern, Robert Shaw, Orson Welles
description: The capricious and dissolute Henry VIII wants to divorce Catherine of Aragon, who bore him no children, to marry Anna Bolena, with whom he is in love. To get the pope's assent, he asked for the help of a very religious gentleman, also esteemed in Rome: Sir Thomas More. But neither honors nor threats lead Moore (who will pay with his life) to yield to the precept of the indissolubility of marriage.
notes: Realization of austere but elegant dignity on the conflict of which Thomas Moore, later sanctified by the Church, was the heroic victim. 1966 Oscar for film, direction, screenplay, costumes, photography and starring Paul Scofield.

title: A Man for All Seasons
actors: Charlton Heston, Vanessa Redgrave, John Gielgud, Richard Johnson
description: Henry VIII is determined to divorce Catherine of Aragon, who bore him no children, in order to marry Anna Bolena. Enrico is well aware that this will put him in conflict with the pope, who has no intention of allowing him the annulment of the marriage. To this end he also knows how important it is to have the support of Sir Thomas More, a deeply religious man known for his philosophical studies. But he doesn't fold, even at the cost of his life. An irremediable conflict arises between Sir Thomas More and Henry VIII when the king decides to divorce, break with the Pope's authority and create the Church of England.
notes: Charlton Heston would have wanted the part of Moore in the '66 version of this Robert Bolt drama in which he was preferred Paul Scofield instead. For the revenge he had to wait 22 years and had to direct himself. Decent version.

title: Strongest Man in the World
actors: Kurt Russell, Joe Flynn, Eve Arden, Cesar Romero
description: For a laboratory accident, a student accidentally discovers a prodigious formula that allows you to increase your strength tenfold. He doesn't have time to recover from the sensational discovery that together with his friends he has to defend it from the usual bad guys who would like to make an unclean use of it. Disney production for grown-up children, accuses some slowness but recovers in the end.

title: Man Without a Star
actors: Kirk Douglas, Jeanne Crain, Claire Trevor, Richard Boone
description: Dempsey (Kirk Douglas) fled Texas because ranchers began surrounding pastures with barbed wire. He then goes to Wyoming and along the way he meets Jeff; the two put themselves at the service of the beautiful ranchera Reed which is trying to expropriate the small landowners in the area. Dempsey at first takes sides against them, because they have surrounded their pastures with barbed wire; but then it is decisive in the clash with Reed's men. A beautiful decadent western, in which Douglas embodies the cowboy who is intolerant of the limitations brought by cowardice and symbolized by barbed wire.

title: The Quiet Man
actors: John Wayne, Maureen O'Hara, Victor McLaglen, Barry Fitzgerald
description: Sean Thorton, former American boxer, decides to return to his homeland: Ireland. He buys a house and immediately gets into trouble with the bully Will Danaher. Trouble becomes complicated when Sean arrives to ask for the hand of Mary Kate, Will's sister. Irish Ford, that is braggart, moved and moved. The final fight sequence is now a movie classic. Not to mention that seeing the rude John Wayne fighting for a young lady's hat is not an everyday thing. Oscar for John Ford and for the two cinematographers.

title: Un homme et une femme vingt ans déjà
actors: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Anouk Aimée, Richard Berry
description: The romantic couple from Lelouch's 1966 film meet again twenty years later to never leave. Sequel without the impact of the antecedent.

title: The Shoes of the Fisherman
actors: Anthony Quinn, Laurence Olivier, Oskar Werner, Vittorio De Sica, David Janssen
description: To demonstrate that it has overcome Stalinism, the Soviet government frees a Russian Catholic prelate from the twenty-year imprisonment of the gulags, who is expelled, however, and thus moves to the papal curia in Rome. Appointed cardinal, on the sudden death of the reigning pope he was in turn elected pope. In homage to his origins he calls himself Kiril I, from the name of one of the two saints (Cyril and Methodius) evangelizers of Russia.
notes: An "all star" cast for a film that anticipated the thaw and the advent to the papal throne of the Slav John Paul II.

title: Le passager de la pluie
actors: Charles Bronson, Marlène Jobert, Gabriele Tinti, Jill Ireland
description: A stranger arrives in a small town on the French coast on a rainy day. The young Mélie suddenly finds herself in front of him; he stuns and rapes her, but the woman manages to kill him. He gets rid of the body by throwing it into the sea. Some time later a mysterious American, on the trail of the man, provides Mélie with the evidence of his murder. Once the body is recovered, however, the terrible past of the woman also comes to light. A film full of twists and turns, of raw realism in the first part, more atmospheric in the second, it combines the classic yellow story with a certain study of the French province.

title: Uova di garofano
actors: Federico Zanola, Elisa Murolo, Lou Castel, Alain Cuny
description: Silvano goes with his little son to the old abandoned country cottage, where he spent his childhood and begins to remember the joys and pains of family life, in the background the last years of fascism, the Second World War and the partisan struggles. He remembers his visits to old Crimen, a strange character who insisted on living in isolation and whose wife he was said to have killed and eaten. He remembers the episode of his death and his escape to the mountains.
notes: An anti-rhetorical tale of a childhood, of a historical and moral context where the narrative fragmentation goes hand in hand with the emotional crescendo.

title: The Serpent's Egg
actors: Liv Ullmann, David Carradine, Heinz Bennent
description: Berlin, 1923. Two American acrobats are ensnared by a mad scientist who anticipates the terrible medical experiments of the Nazis. Bergman in the already insane pre-Hitler Germani. Expressionist atmospheres (photograph by the always valid Sven Nykvist) for an unsolved film even if perfect in the rendering of the oppressive cloak of terror.

title: Hurricane
actors: Jason Robards, Mia Farrow, Max Von Sydow, Trevor Howard
description: On an island in the South Seas, a young chieftain, ambitious and enterprising, clashes with the white governor. The governor's daughter, however, is in love with the young boss and, when he ends up in prison, favors his escape. The two run away, hunted by the soldiers of the garrison. They would be recaptured if mother nature did not get involved with a terrible storm that devastates the island and annihilates all the inhabitants.
notes: Remake of John Ford's 1937 film, which becomes a massive exotic-catastrophic blockbuster.

title: Urban Warriors
actors: Karl Landgren, Alex Vitale
description: After a nuclear attack, technicians from an underground defense center return to the surface, where bands of survivors hunt down uncontaminated men to extract their bone marrow. A fantastic catastrophic of Italian production difficult to digest.

title: Urga
actors: Bayaertu, Badema, Vladimir Gosthukin, Larissa Kuznetsova
description: Gombo lives in the Mongolian steppe with his family (wife, three children, the old mother) according to the archaic rhythms and goes hunting with the "urga", a sort of lasso fixed on the tip of a pole. One day, his wife asks him to comply with the birth limitation law. Gombo goes to town, with a worker he saved after an accident, to buy condoms.
notes: Tedious and very licking fairy tale, which marks the drift of a good Russian director. The film won the Golden Lion in Venice in 1991.

title: The Killing Fields
actors: Sam Waterston, Haing S. Ngor, John Malkovich, Julian Sands
description: In March 1975 the Khmer Rouge occupied the capital of Cambodia, Phnom Penh. Dr. Dith Pran (Ngor) is the interpreter of New York Times reporter Sydney Schanberg (Waterston). After rescuing his family, the doctor decides to stay with the reporter. It will end up in the terrible labor camps of the Khmer. Joffe's debut film was an international case, for its choice to tell one of the most shocking collective dramas of this second half of the twentieth century: the extermination of the Cambodian people at the hands of the Khmer Rouge. With this film, which intelligently combines entertainment and commitment, Joffe immediately established himself on the international scene. The film won the Oscar for Best Supporting Actor (NGOR), for Chris Menges' photography and for editing.

title: Heart of Midnight
actors: Jennifer Jason Leigh, Peter Coyote, Brenda Vaccaro
description: A repressed childhood trauma makes Carol grieve. Heir to an uncle's dilapidated nightclub, she decides to restore it to go and live there, but, wandering around the labyrinthine local, she slowly remembers having been involved as a child in certain red-light parties. What's more, someone wants her dead ...

title: Urlatori alla sbarra
actors: Joe Sentieri, Mina, Adriano Celentano, Elke Sommer
description: The songs of the screamers excite young people but do not find favor with concert organizers. Some young singers try to ask on television. The austere professor Gammarelli, director general of Rai, is against it: but on the side of the young there is his daughter Giulia, who has her grandfather, senator, intervene. After some bickering, the concert will be broadcast with great success. After the success of the "Juke Box Boys", Fulci conducts with a certain panache and plenty of musical numbers.

title: Fort Dobbs
actors: Clint Walker, Virginia Mayo, Brian Keith
description: Wanted for murder, Davis manages to escape by taking refuge in the territory of the Comanches. Here he collects a woman with her child on an isolated farm and arrives at Fort Dobbs after various adventures. But the fort is half-destroyed and the arrival of the soldiers is immediately followed by that of the Indians who begin the siege. A decent western starring Brian Keith more famous on television than in cinema.

title: Cry of the City
actors: Victor Mature, Richard Conte, Shelley Winters
description: Martino Roma, after a shooting during which he killed a policeman, is approached in the hospital by a lawyer who would like to make him confess to a theft he did not commit. Martino escapes, kills the lawyer and tries to reunite with his girlfriend but Lieutenant Candella, his childhood friend, finds him and is forced to kill him. It is an excellent example of film noir, due to the specialist Siodmak. In this case the mixture of realism and elements that refer to psychoanalysis gives the work an uncommon depth.

title: Try and Get Me/The Sound of Fury
actors: Frank Lovejoy, Kathleen Ryan, Richrad Carlson, Lloyd Bridges
description: A hardened and unscrupulous criminal involves an unemployed and desperate family man (Frank Lovejoy) in the kidnapping of a child. But things go wrong, the little one dies and the two suffer the lynching of the crowd. Film of denunciation made darker and more powerful by the fact that the lynched are not innocent.

title: Ambush at Cimarron Pass
actors: Scott Brady, Clint Eastwood, Margia Dean, Irving Bacon, Frank Gerstle
description: Sergeant Matt Blake and an arms dealer his prisoner travel with Prescott's cowboys. Threatened by the Indians, there is not the slightest agreement on what to do.

title: 20, 000 Leagues Under the Sea
actors: Kirk Douglas, James Mason, Paul Lukas, Peter Lorre, Robert J. Wilke
description: A mysterious "sea monster" sinks ships that come within range and seems invulnerable to their blows: the US government assigns three men - Conseil, Ned Land and Professor Arronax - to hunt him down. After three months of frantic searches, the men on board the "Abraham Lincoln" finally spot him: but their surprise is great when they discover that it is a submarine, the "Nautilus" commanded by Captain Nemo ...
notes: The wonderful and terrible adventure of the novel by Jules Verne told with great breadth of means and spectacularity by Disney.

title: Vingt-quatre heures de la vie d'une femme
actors: Danielle Darrieux, Robert Hoffman, Romina Power
description: Switzerland, First World War. Alice (Darrieux) meets Thomas (Hoffman), a German who has managed to avoid war by taking refuge in Switzerland. Thomas has lost everything in the game and Alice, who immediately falls in love with him, gives him the money for the train ticket to Zurich. Alice returns home dreamily but meets Thomas again who is gambling the money that Alice has loaned him.
notes: The film is a non-dazzling adaptation of a short story by the Austrian writer Stefan Zweig.

title: The Manchurian Candidate
actors: Frank Sinatra, Laurence Harvey, Janet Leigh, Angela Lansbury
description: The Korean War left indelible traces in the mind of a soldier, who had already shown signs of disturbance on the front. His life seems normal, but his former commander, who has gone to visit him, realizes that the young man is somehow connected to a series of mysterious murders that the police are investigating. A congressional senator appears to be the next victim. From a novel by Richard Condon, an anguished and dreamlike political fiction film, one of the most imaginative of the cinema of those years.

title: Una vacanza bestiale
actors: Jerry Calà, Franco Oppini, Umberto Smaila, Nini Salerno, Diego Abatantuono, Teo Teocoli
description: A group of tourists is captured by the lure of "Via Col Vento Tours", an agency that ends up throwing its customers into a sea of ??trouble. After many adventures, our heroes return home with an idea: to open an agency that will be called "Libidine Tours" ... The tourist-exotic idea seems promising well but everything soon frays in a total lack of rhythm and in a disheartening void of effective ideas. The use of obvious parodies of famous cinematic situations does not allow the situation to be saved.

title: Vacanze a Ischia
actors: Vittorio De Sica, Isabelle Corey, Antonio Cifariello, Myriam Bru
description: In Ischia there are those who recover from the fatigue of work and those from the weariness of a couple relationship. A group of local boys liven up the well-deserved holidays, organizing scams and mockery at the expense of vacationers, falling in love with the tourists and making them fall in love. Sentimental trepidation alternates with judicial events of various kinds, from a complaint for fraud to a trial for outrage of modesty.
notes: The film looks like a typical example of the comic-erotic-seaside genre, but the outcome is more decent than one might expect. Thanks to the solid craft of Mario Camerini and a lively screenplay.

title: Vacanze d'estate
actors: Bombolo, Enzo Cannavale, Patrizia Pellegrino, Saverio Vallone, Yari Porzio
description: Adelmo Turati, a rich industrialist, arrives in Palinuro with two hitchhikers: "Cardinal", penniless and clingy, and Olga, a beautiful au pair headed to the villa of Judge Antonelli. The summer continues between affairs and sentimental spite, which sees Olga as the protagonist, while destiny has unpredictable developments in store for the Turati / Cardinale duo.
notes: Gags discounted and redone with fatigue, barracks comedy.

title: Vacanze d'inverno
actors: Alberto Sordi, Vittorio De Sica, Michèle Morgan
description: The film consists of several episodes: there is the employee who falls in love with the countess, the actress who seeks publicity, the don giovanni who deceives unlikely girls ... Gags, successful and unsuccessful, are intertwined with romance and amorazzi vacationers: someone wrote that this would be the prototype for the Vanzina films, but that compared to them it is a masterpiece.

title: Le vacanze del signor Rossi
description: Compilation of short films made by Bruno Bozzetto and starring the now very famous character of Mr. Rossi, that is the typical average Italian, dreamer, couch potato, likeable, a little bungler, entered the national and international imagination. Invented in the early 1960s, Mr. Rossi became in Bozzetto's imagination the preferred tool for a biting and apparently good-natured satire aimed at all the clichés of the time: economic boom, mass tourism, the myth of the automobile, etc. Mr. Rossi is the first real "character" to appear in the history of Italian animation cinema.

title: Summer Rental
actors: John Candy, Rip Torn, Richard Crenna, Karen Austin, Kerri Green
description: A flight controller who has been an exemplary employee up to that point is experiencing a severe nervous breakdown. He is then granted a vacation to Florida. Small and not unpleasant comedy with the late John Candy surrounded by good character actors and the expert direction of Reiner sr.

title: Roman Holiday
actors: Audrey Hepburn, Gregory Peck, Eddie Albert, Tullio Carminati
description: The young Princess Anna (Hepburn) is spending a vacation with her parents and entourage in Rome. One fine day, tired of ceremonies and protocol, she slips away and tries to mingle with mere mortals. She falls in love with an American journalist, Bradley (Peck), who finds her asleep on a low wall and takes her to his home, unaware of the girl's true identity. He finds out the next day from the newspaper and, pondering a big scoop, makes an agreement with a photographer friend to do a report on the matter.
notes: In this tender sentimental comedy the very young Hepburn was launched and immediately won an Oscar. The director elegantly directs the cast and paints a Rome populated by curious characters and punctuated by tasty brushstrokes of costume. Flawless and velvety photography. A second Oscar was awarded to the film for the subject.

title: Vacanze sulla Costa Smeralda
actors: Little Tony, Silvia Dionisio, Ferruccio Amendola, Francesco Mulè, Tamara Baroni
description: To beat the competition from the nearby Club Hotel, Commendator Grassu, owner of the Hotel Ringo, hires the famous singer Tony Martin. In a minor role there is Tamara Baroni, famous not only for cinematographic reasons, a major role for Little Tony who did not deserve it.

title: Vado a riprendermi il gatto
actors: Barbara De Rossi, Mario Adorf, Enzo Fabbri
description: Alceo, a mature peasant from Romagna, lives only with a cat, except for one month a year during which he allows himself the luxury of the company of a prostitute. Once, however, he brings home Ester, a girl different from the others, a pretty country girl who has remained basically healthy despite her "job". A discreet starting point, a photograph that adequately enhances the Romagna countryside, actors of good effectiveness. But also a too simplistic narrative management, with a very predictable development.

title: Vado a vivere da solo
actors: Jerry Calà, Elvire Audray, Lando Buzzanca
description: The twenty-six year old university Giacomino (Calà) gets from his parents to be able to take a house on his own. Settled in the new attic, he talks about exciting and endless erotic adventures, but things turn out very differently. And even when he has married the beautiful Françoise (Elvire Audray), the situation of Jack and his wife will remain extremely precarious.
notes: It is the directorial debut of Marco Risi. Very light Robetta, scripted by Enrico Vanzina and Jerry Calà as well as by Risi himself.

title: Vado... l'ammazzo e torno
actors: George Hilton, Gilbert Roland, Pedro Sanchez, Kareen O'Hara
description: A gang of outlaws led by bandit Monetero attacks a train train on which Southern Bank gold is transported. The action is observed by a bounty hunter called "The Stranger" who notices that the loot is being taken by Pajondo, one of Monetero's men. But Pajondo is killed and the only trace to go back to the gold is a half medallion. The film, while not emerging from the classic stereotypes of the Italian western, however, revitalizes its structure thanks to the irony that the director has lavished on it.

title: Il vagabondo
actors: Erminio Macario, Memo Benassi
description: Pippo the tramp doesn't have a penny in his pocket, but he doesn't have a worry on his mind either. He is there courting the maid of a noble house when he accidentally discovers that the betrothed of the owners' daughter is aiming exclusively for money. He reveals the news to his family and, instead of exploiting their gratitude, he leaves as always free and happy. Films tailored for Macario, but today it doesn't make anyone laugh anymore.

title: Vai alla grande
actors: Lara Wendel, Massimo Ciavarro, Danilo Mattei, Diego Cappuccio, Pippo Santonastaso
description: Four bored friends in a town on the Adriatic coast. Finally here is the big chance: they challenge Fernando, father's son, to a regatta. They get hold of a boat and even manage to win. In the meantime, Karin, a German girl initiated into prostitution, appeared; one of the four, Giorgio, falls in love with her and this time too, he will overpower the competition from Fernando, who in turn is fascinated by the girl. Clumsy attempt to outline a picture of the Italian province with the nice (?) Time wasters who populate it.

title: Vai avanti tu che mi vien da ridere
actors: Lino Banfi, Agostina Belli, Nando Paone, Aldo Massasso
description: Pasquale Bellachioma is a clumsy and unfortunate commissioner who is looking for an operation capable of shedding light on him. As a last resort, he kidnaps a transvestite, witness of some attacks on a head of state, to use him as bait for the killer. Unpredictable situations arise, pursuits, misunderstandings, up to the successful solution of the case. Meanwhile, Fairhair has fallen in love with the transvestite, who however claims to be a woman. Capitani's film does not rise from the level of Italian comedy of the Eighties, if not for a particularly in the mood for Banfi.

title: Avalanche
actors: Rock Hudson, Mia Farrow, Robert Forster, Jeanette Nolan
description: A tourist complex is built, with contempt for the warnings of ecologists and experts, in an area at risk of avalanches. After the pompous inauguration, the announced disaster occurs which overwhelms, among many innocent people, even the family members of the unscrupulous builder.
notes: Rather conventional disaster film. But the thrills don't abound, as do the spectacular effectiveness and credibility of the characters.

title: Peeper
actors: Michael Caine, Natalie Wood, Kitty Winn, Jerry Lacy
description: On the trail of a missing young woman, an investigator is embroiled in a grim family intrigue. Faint cast, with some parodic points, of the film noir of the 1940s.

title: Ride the Man Down
actors: Brian Donlevy, Rod Cameron, Ella Raines
description: Silvia inherits a large estate and with Will, already her father's right hand man, defends it from the bandits with whom Sam, her unworthy and greedy boyfriend, has joined. Western series C, for enthusiasts only.

title: Three Faces West
actors: John Wayne, Sigrid Gurie, Charles Coburn
description: A Czechoslovakian doctor who emigrated to the United States with his daughter gets a contract in an ungrateful agricultural region. A strange B-series film, with an almost western plot.

title: Valley of the Kings
actors: Robert Taylor, Eleanor Parker, Kurt Kasznar, Carlos Thompson, Victor Jory
description: After the death of her father, the daughter of a well-known archaeologist continues her search for evidence of the historical truth of the biblical story in the Valley of the Kings. She has to contend with sandstorms, desert raiders, and even her greedy husband. Exotic adventurous unpretentious, but lively enough.

title: The Valley of Decision
actors: Greer Garson, Gregory Peck, Lionel Barrymore
description: Pittsburgh, 1870: the difficult love story unfolds between a young waitress, the daughter of an invalid worker, and the son of the mine owner.
notes: Epic novel in pure American style from a short story by Marcia Davemport.

title: The Night of the Grizzly
actors: Clint Walker, Martha Hyer, Keenan Wynn, Leo Gardon, Candie Moore, Kevin Brodie, Jack Elam, Nancy Kulp, Don Haggerty, Victoria Paige Meyerink
description: Former Sheriff Big Jim Cole settles down with his family on an inherited farm. To ruin the plans of rest we think Jed Curry who does everything to take away the earth, the gigantic and terrible grizzly Satan and Dowdy, a hunter with whom there is some old rust. Determined to take the bounty that hangs on Satan, Big Jim will do anything to capture the ferocious animal. Very linear plot, contrasts between man and nature or between man and man didactically schematized, edifying morality (the united family that faces adversity). Correct implementation, in line with a story with no surprises.

title: Death Valley
actors: Stephen McHattie, Peter Billingsley
description: On vacation in Arizona with his mother, young Billy encounters a homicidal maniac. Unsuccessful despite Richards being one of the most prominent directors of the 1970s.

title: Valmont
actors: Colin Firth, Annette Bening, Fairuza Balk, Meg Tilly
description: The Marquise de Merteuil discovers that her former lover, Gercourt, will marry a fifteen-year-old from a good family who had lived up to that moment in a convent. He decides to take revenge with the complicity of the dissolute viscount of Valmont: he procures the girl many suitors, one of which gets her pregnant. But the two conspirators will not have the expected benefits as the young woman marries regularly, starting a life of hypocrisy.
notes: Loosely based on Chordelos De Laclos 'epistolary novel "Dangerous Liaisons", which also inspired Frears' film of the same name, "Valmont" did not have a commercial success despite the elegance of Forman's direction. Perhaps also the fault of a wrong cast.

title: Men of the Fighting Lady
actors: Van Johnson, Walter Pidgeon, Louis Calhern
description: Adventures of a group of pilots on an American aircraft carrier during the Korean War. An uninspiring war film. However, some semi-documentary flight sequences are good.

title: Vamos a matar compañeros
actors: Franco Nero, Tomas Milian, Fernando Rey, Jack Palance, Gino Pernice, Francisco Bodalgo, Iris Berben, Gérard Tichy
description: In Mexico troubled by infighting, Yod, a Swedish arms dealer, comes into contact with Mongo Alvarez, a revolutionary general who cares more about money than revolution. Since it seems, precisely, that some money is kept in a safe, the combination of which is known only to Professor Vitaliano Xantos (a non-violent idealist, leader of a group of young and authentic rioters), who, however, found in Fort Yuma, a prisoner of the Americans, Yod takes it upon himself to free him.
notes: Together with _Django_ (with which he has the protagonist, Franco Nero in common) this film is among the most famous "spaghetti" made by Sergio Corbucci: brilliant rhythm, unlikely and unreal truculence, casual narration and an irony that does not exclude the final moral .

title: Vampire Story
actors: Robert Quarry, Mariette Hartley, Roger Perry
description: The vampire Yorga resurrects from the grave near San Francisco with his court of hideous vampireesses and settles in the luxurious manson of the Mansons. Here Yorga and her group exterminate a less Cinzia family, with whom Yorga falls in love, and little Tommy himself the protagonist of gruesome adventures. Concentrated effects, supported by a soundtrack of organ music and stridi stridi.

title: Il Vangelo secondo Matteo
actors: Enrique Irazoqui, Susanna Pasolini, Settimio Di Porto
description: The film retraces the salient moments of the Gospel: the Annunciation, the Magi, the flight into Egypt, the massacre of the Innocents, Jesus in the desert, the healing of the leper, the Sermon on the Mount, the death of the Baptist, the multiplication of the loaves and of fishes, the entry into Jerusalem, the passion, the resurrection.
notes: In years dominated by Hollywood cinematic iconography and its spectacular biblical reconstructions, Pasolini imposed this extraordinary film for literal fidelity to the Gospel, interpreted by non-professional actors, shot in Matera and elsewhere, with a very refined soundtrack elaborated together with Morricone and a use of the room suspended between documentary speed and monumental distance. Grand jury prize in Venice.

title: Variété
actors: Emil Jannings, Lya De Putti
description: The owner of a fair booth leaves his wife for a foreign girl. She becomes the lover of a trapeze artist and at that point her old partner surprises her and kills her rival. The story is a bit obvious, but the film constitutes a classic of German cinema of the period, with a series of stunning technical innovations. Extraordinary the couple of protagonists.

title: Sealed Cargo
actors: Dana Andrews, Claude Rains, Carla Balenda, Philip Dorn, Onslow Stevens
description: An American fishing vessel runs into a broken-down freighter flying the Swedish flag during the night. The captain expresses doubts about the real nature of the ship and investigates on his behalf. He discovers that the freighter is a disguised German warship loaded with anti-submarine missiles. With a ruse and with the help of the inhabitants of a fishing village, he destroys the enemy ship. War film with many moments of suspense but with a somewhat obvious ending.

title: Vayas con Dios, Gringo
actors: Glenn Saxon, Pasquale Simeoli, Spartaco Battisti, Lucretia Love
description: Six men escape from prison. Among them there is also Gringo who was in jail because he was accused of a murder that he did not actually commit. But, once he is free, he will be able to find the real culprit and prove his innocence. Spaghetti-western cheap.

title: Vecchia guardia
actors: Mino Doro, Gianfranco Giachetti, Franco Brambilla, Ugo Ceseri
description: In a town near Rome, hospital nurses went on strike. Roberto, the son of the primary, leads the fascist squads who clash with the strikers: in the brawl Mario, the younger brother of Roberto, dies. Blasetti wanted to make Old Guard an epic of the origins of fascism, but the regime did not like the film that made the epic of squads.

title: The Old Man and the Sea
actors: Spencer Tracy, Felipe Pazos, Harry Bellaver
description: The long struggle of an elderly Cuban fisherman against a huge swordfish. The "duel" between man and animal takes on epic tones and metaphysical values: intelligence against brute force, nature against civilization. Sumptuous images and beautiful interpretation by Spencer Tracy for the transposition of the last novel published in life by Ernest Hemingway. Oscar to the soundtrack of Dimitri Tiomkin.

title: The Merry Widow
actors: Lana Turner, Fernando Lamas, Richard Haydn, Una Merkel
description: The king of Moravia entrusts Count Danilo with the task of seducing the beautiful and very rich widow Radek. With the woman's patrimony it will be possible to rearrange the finances of the kingdom, rather in bad shape. But the woman learns of the plan and instructs her lady-in-waiting to replace her. Useless counter move, because when Danilo meets her in disguise he falls in love with her anyway. And viceversa. This is the third cinematic remake of Franz Léhar's famous operetta. Great scenographic binge, but nothing like the two previous versions, by Stroheim and Lubitsch.

title: La vedova
actors: Isa Pola, Leonardo Cortese, Osvaldo Valenti, Emma Gramatica, Cesco Baseggio
description: A young Venetian marries a scion of the good bourgeoisie, against the will of his parents. Then she remains a widow and she begins a difficult coexistence with her in-laws. Taken, without too much fluency, from a play by Renato Simoni.

title: Black Widow
actors: Debra Winger, Theresa Russell, Sami Frey, Dennis Hopper
description: Alexandra Barnes is a federal agent who, following a cross-investigation carried out on the computer, discovers the mysterious deaths of three rich people, in different places in the States, the presence of a widow who has immediately disappeared. Three different women or always the same one? The investigation continues in Hawaii, where Alexandra makes friends with the charming Catharine, the suspect, and manages to frame her, combining a trap in which yet another designated victim and the police participate. In the best tradition of noir, a treacherous nocturnal film, where Good and Evil in the course of their necessary struggle seem to attract rather than repel each other. Absolute protagonists, the two women opposed by role and body constitute a couple of the most engaging of the cinema of the 80s.

title: Kotch
actors: Walter Matthau, Deborah Winters, Felicia Farr, Charles Aidman
description: A sprightly retiree doesn't want to be pushed aside by his children. At the first director, Jack Lemmon gives a good performance thanks to a great protagonist, his friend Walter Matthau. Screenplay by ex-blacklisted John Paxton.

title: A Gathering of Eagles
actors: Rock Hudson, Rod Taylor, Mary Peach, Barry Sullivan, Kevin McCarthy
description: Colonel Jim Caldwell leads a special bomber squadron. His rigor and meticulousness put him in friction with the commanders of other squadrons and even with his wife, who is willing to leave him. But, when the moment of action has come, precisely those prerogatives for which the officer was opposed by all prove to be decisive for the success of the mission. The story is quite banal and obvious and the narration does not give much to do to enhance it. Fortunately, some shots of in-flight maneuvers are spectacular. Remake of "Sky of Fire" (1949).

title: Blue Velvet
actors: Kyle MacLachlan, Isabella Rossellini, Dennis Hopper, Laura Dern, Hope Lange, Dean Stockwell, George Dickerson, Priscilla Pointer, Frances Bay, Jack Harvey, Ken Stovitz, Brad Dourif, Jack Nance
description: The young Jeffrey reports to the police that he found an ear in the lawn near the house; along with Sandy, the lieutenant's daughter whom he has a crush on, he gets involved a little too much in matters that don't concern him. He ends up in the bed of Dorothy, a nightclub singer blackmailed by the evil Frank, and then is taken hostage by the gangster's henchmen. Lynch works intelligently on gender stereotypes to subvert them from within; all in the name of premeditated unpleasantness and a narrative that progressively slips into the nightmare. The result is a vision on the loss of innocence, in which good and evil are not distinguished.

title: The Mistery of Mr. Wong
actors: Boris Karloff, Dorothy Tree
description: A wealthy American collector comes into possession of a jewel considered sacred by the Chinese, stolen in Nanjing. During a party the collector is killed in mysterious conditions. But as it happens, a few minutes earlier he had talked to investigator Mr. Wong, showing him an envelope in which he had written the name of who he suspected was putting his life in danger. At a certain point both the letter and the jewel disappear. The Chinese investigator solves the intricate puzzle. Second of five films dedicated to Mr. Wong.

title: The Return of a Man Called Horse
actors: Richard Harris, Gale Sondergaard, Jorge Luke, Geoffrey Lewis
description: After his long period of stay with the Sioux tribe of the "Yellow Hands", Lord Morgan has returned to England. But here he feels irresistible the call of the boundless landscapes of the prairies and above all of his Sioux friends, of which he is now a part. He returns among them, discovering that in the meantime the tribe has been decimated. Morgan, whom the Indians call "Shunka Wakan", then trains the men and women of the tribe to fight against the usurpers ...
notes: Richard Harris plays Lord Morgan for the second time. The film, although inferior to the first, is a good western in which action blends with ecology.

title: Revenge of the Pink Panther
actors: Peter Sellers, Herbert Lom, Dyan Cannon, Robert Webber
description: The Parisian boss of Cosa Nostra has Inspector Clouseau killed in an attack. Great relief in the circles of the underworld, but above all in the brain of Inspector Dreyfus who comes out of the asylum and resumes his place in the police. But Clouseau, who actually escaped the attack, keeps watch and continues the investigation. The finale in the fireworks factory is lightning-fast and pyrotechnic. But the whole film works beautifully thanks to Peter Sellers' disguises, Herbert Lom's tics and Cato's sudden outings. Of course, the opening credits are not to be missed.

title: Ator: The Fighting Eagle
actors: Miles O'Keefe, Lisa Foster, David Cain
description: Only the brave Ator is able to defend the source of the peace and well-being of all men, that "geometric core" which, if used by evil powers, could turn into a tremendous weapon. for all humanity. Film of sword and spells, a formula that unfortunately for the director David Hills does not release any magic.

title: The Valley of Gwangi
actors: James Franciscus, Gila Golan, Richard Carlson, Curtis Arden
description: A circus in dire straits, a tiny horse that should become its attraction; a gypsy who has the mini beast stolen; the mysterious valley with prehistoric animals and consequent dangers; the capture of the dinosaur Gwangi (to be exhibited in the circus); the sacrosanct rebellion of the enormous beast; its miserable end in a fire. Science fiction of series B for the quality of the ideas and the realization, just saved by the excellent workmanship of the "special effects" curated by Ray Harryhausen. Based on a subject by Willis O'Brien, who in his time took care of the special effects of King Kong.

title: No Retreat No Surrender
actors: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Kurt McKinney, J. W. Fails
description: Jason Stillwell is a karate student who is treated like a nobody by the toughs in the neighborhood. After amassing an endless series of scorching humiliations, Jason finally finds the help of a martial arts expert. The opportunity for the great revenge on those who never wanted to believe in him comes when Jason has the opportunity to meet the terrible Russian Ivan, superstar of world karate, in the ring.
notes: Van Damme at his debut, in the part of the very bad Ivan. The film is a hybrid between "Karate Kid" and "Rocky IV": it may have some appeal only for fans of the muscular Belgian actor.

title: Next of Kin
actors: Patrick Swayze, Liam Neeson, Adam Baldwin, Helen Hunt
description: Hailing from the mountainous region of Kentucky but now urbanized by the Chicago PD, Sergeant Truman has made a name for himself as a tough guy. But one day his younger brother Gerald is killed and Truman goes wild. On the trail of the killers, however, the other brother, Briar, who has come down from the mountains determined to take revenge on his own, also sets out.
notes: Intrusion of the plot and dissolution through final shooting. A dignified, dramatic and tense detective story, the film portrays the classic will of the American man to take justice for himself, and the equally classic theme of the city-country clash. Honest interpreters.

title: The Punisher
actors: Dolph Lundgren, Louis Gossett jr., Jeroen Krabbe, Kim Miyori
description: A former police officer, believed dead by all, is actually the avenger everyone is looking for. Not that his business is totally despised: eliminating 125 gangsters in five years is still a service rendered to society. However, the police cannot help but investigate and discover that the avenger started his private war the day some bandits killed his wife and child. Based without too much imagination on a Marvel comic book character, the film makes use of the pompous and expressionless Dolph Lundgren (Ivan "You Spiezzo in two" Drago) and the solid Louis Gossett jr. (Oscar for "Officer and Gentleman").

title: Cattle King
actors: Robert Taylor, Joan Caulfield, Robert Middleton, Robert Loggia
description: The usual honest farmer who would like to live quietly in his "lonely valley", however, is confronted by a shady businessman who would like his land. The "Chisum" of the situation sends his henchmen to convince the protagonist to negotiate. He refuses and finds his girlfriend killed. Revenge takes place, and a gun will be unearthed ...
notes: Western full of stereotypes that traces the typical theme of the clash between rampant capitalism and rural tradition according to Serie B schemes. Shooting routine and discreet interpretation, especially by Taylor and the character actor Loggia. Film of the decadence of a director once considered one of the masters of comedy and melò.

title: Cuatro balazos
actors: Fred Canow, Paul Piaget, Fernando Casanova, Angela Cavo, Miguel Del Castillo
description: Gunfighter Frank arrives in Kansas City to avenge his sister and gets into trouble. A film that mixes the western with the yellow, but which nevertheless fails to differentiate itself from other contemporary westerns.

title: Dubrowsky
actors: Rosanna Schiaffino, Paul Dahlke, Nerio Bernardi, Guido Celano
description: Vladya takes revenge on the arrogant baron who caused his father to die of a broken heart after stripping him of all his possessions.
notes: Sword and cape in European mixed sauce with American imitation.

title: Rose of Cimarron
actors: Mala Powers, Jack Buetel, Bill Williams, Jim Davis, Art Smith
description: A group of redskins belonging to a rebel tribe, assault a caravan of pioneers. Only a little girl survives the massacre and is picked up by Willy, son of the chief of the Sioux tribe. The girl, who is given the name of Rose of Cimarron, is raised and educated by Solitary Eagle and his partner Red Deer. The two parents are, however, murdered by a gang of outlaws. The girl sets out in search of the killers. Western film routine.

title: The Long Memory
actors: John Mills, John McCallum, Elizabeth Sellars
description: Unjustly convicted of murder, abandoned by his girlfriend, after twelve years in prison Philip Davidson (Mills) settles on the old Jackson's boat and has a single purpose: to expose his accusers. The love for Elsa mitigates his desire for revenge, but he does not escape the appointment with destiny. Excellent and pressing direction by the Englishman Robert Hamer (1911-1963), a veteran of editing who arrived by chance to direct in '43. Great John Mills.

title: Friday the 13th, Part VIII: Jason Takes Manhattan
actors: Jensen Daggett, Scott Reeves, Kane Hodder, Barbara Bingham
description: Old Jason embarks on a cruise ship this time. Here, too, he is intent on slaughtering cocaine students and bigot teachers. When the four survivors of the inevitable shipwreck land in New York, Jason scrupulously follows them to complete the job.
notes: Eighth stage of the catchphrase "Friday the 13th", with Jason leaving the Crystal Lake campsite for the Hudson River banks. For those who love statistics, the total number of murders at the end of the film is seventeen.

title: La Venere dei pirati
actors: Gianna Maria Canale, Massimo Serato, Livio Lorenzon, Scilla Gabel, Paul Müller
description: Sandra, daughter of Captain Mirko, is embarked on a slave ship by a wicked duchess. Having become a privateer, in the end she obtains justice and something more. Trivial and unimaginative adventure.

title: Venere imperiale
actors: Gina Lollobrigida, Stephen Boyd, Raymond Pellegrin, Micheline Presle
description: The loves, adventures and scandals of Paolina Bonaparte, Napoleon's sister, the happy widow of Marshal Leclerc and the uninhibited model of the sculptor Canova. The young woman arrives from Corsica with her family in the wake of her brother Napoleon's conquests and is immediately noticed among the nobles for her beauty. The emperor of the French soon used it for his political aims. A boring historical film that follows the private events of a great lady (an unlikely Lollo).

title: Boys' Night Out
actors: Kim Novak, James Garner, Tony Randall, Howard Duff, Janet Blair
description: Three married friends instruct a fourth, Fred, the bachelor of the group, to find a small apartment in the city in which to live a few adventures. However, Kate (Novak), a young sociologist dedicated to studying the behavior of a married man, has settled in the apartment. She doesn't believe his eyes when she discovers that she has so much human material available for her studies.
notes: Michael Gordon was one of many directors forced into exile by Senator Joseph McCarthy's witch hunt. This is a simple, solid and classic comedy that doesn't fully exploit the nice starting point.

title: Butterfield 8
actors: Elizabeth Taylor, Laurence Harvey, Eddie Fisher, Betty Field
description: Gloria Wandrous (Taylor) is torn between the desire for an honored life and the urge towards sordid experiences. Outraged at having received money from an occasional companion (Harvey), she takes possession of his wife's fur coat and forgets it in the home of Steve Carpenter (Fisher), a musician to whom she is fraternal affection.
notes: Oscar for Taylor, a box office record in 1961, is a film of discreet psychological introspection and strong, above all, of very effective interpreters. Not only the protagonist, at that time in her greatest splendor.

title: Veneri al sole
actors: Raimondo Vianello, Carlo Delle Piane, Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia
description: Episode film that tells the adventures of a girl and a suitcase, a Sicilian delivery boy and a shy young man. Monotonous and collected comedy.

title: Venezia, la luna e tu
actors: Nino Manfredi, Alberto Sordi, Marisa Allasio, Inge Schoener, Niki Dantine
description: Bepi, a Venetian gondolier, is engaged to Nina, but he cannot refrain from having some sentimental adventure. All the skirts are hers. Every time Nina is desperate, she changes her boyfriend by putting herself with the foolish Toni, but then always returns to Bepi. When he makes two Americans fall in love with himself, everything seems over, but once again Bepi will be able to win back Nina's heart.
notes: The real season of Italian comedy has not yet begun. Dino Risi moves here, albeit with a certain air, in the sphere of sentimental intrigues, demonstrating all his good qualities.

title: Venga a fare il soldato da noi
actors: Katia Christine, Gianni Nazzaro, Luigi De Filippo, Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia
description: Nicoletta Bianchi was mistakenly entered in the registry with the name of Nicola. She is thus enlisted but, instead of clearing up the misunderstanding, she takes advantage of the situation to closely monitor her boyfriend Fabrizio Lorenzi, in turn in the army as a medical lieutenant, quite prone to sentimental adventures. She will make herself unrecognizable with a fake mustache, and will be able to discover the (expected) betrayals of her boyfriend. Late and somewhat sad musicarello built for Gianni Nazzaro. Depressing.

title: The Great Locomotive Chase
actors: Fier Parker, Jeffrey Hunter, Jeff York
description: During the Civil War a group of northerners, after an action of sabotage, must cross the enemy territory to regain their lines. Our heroes steal a locomotive, but the path is littered with danger. Discreet craft of the director, interpretation and good feelings tailored to a family audience in this Disney war reconstruction, which rewards the winners without raging on the losers.

title: Parrish
actors: Troy Donahue, Claudette Colbert, Karl Malden, Vincent Gardenia
description: The widow Ellen McLean, governess of his daughter, arrives at the rich planter Mr. Post. The girl is sensitive to the charms of Parrish, Elen's nineteen-year-old son, but he flirts with another. Things go wrong when an earthworm invasion destroys Post's tobacco plantations while Judd Raike, a Post competitor, courts Ellen.
notes: As is often the case with this type of film, everything is always oversized, including the disarming inexpressiveness of the lead actor, Donahue. Two years after "Scandal in the sun", Daves tries again with less success. The original version lasted twenty-two minutes longer.

title: The Wind and the Lion
actors: Sean Connery, Candice Bergen, Brian Keith, John Huston, Geoffrey Lewis
description: We are in Morocco, in 1904. The sheikh of the Berber tribes of the Riff kidnaps the American widow Eden Pedecaris (Bergen) with her two children. As a ransom he asks for gold, weapons and freedom from Franco-German colonialism. President Theodore Roosevelt (Keith) sends the marines.
notes: Second prominent film by Milius after "Dillinger". The desert, the open skies of Africa, the endless landscapes: great passions and great emotions break between history and legend, in a pessimistic vision that individualism and freedom are outside (anti/cons) America.

title: Reap the Wild Wind
actors: John Wayne, Ray Milland, Paulette Goddard
description: A sailing ship is shipwrecked on the coast of Florida. The shipowner instructs lawyer Sullivan to investigate the causes of the disaster and the possible responsibilities of Captain Stuart; Sullivan arranges for Stuart to be put to rest. The captain, not guilty of the shipwreck, accepts the offers of the shady lawyer Cottler, who organizes shipwrecks for profit. But something is wrong: on board the ship there is an illegal immigrant who dies in the shipwreck ...
notes: Classic seafaring adventure film, shot by a recognized specialist in spectacular dramas of all kinds such as De Mille. And for once, Wayne is being bad.

title: The Belly of an Architect
actors: Brian Dennehy, Chloe Webb, Lambert Wilson, Sergio Fantoni, Stefania Casini, Vanni Corbellini, Alfredo Varelli, Geoffrey Copleston, Francesco Carnelutti, Marino Masé, Marne Maitland, Claudio Spadaro, Rate Furlan
description: Stourley Kraklite, an American architect, goes to Rome where he has to set up an anthological exhibition on the 18th century French architect Etienne-Louis Boullée. He is accompanied by his wife who has just become pregnant. In Rome Kracklite feels the first symptoms of an illness that turns out to be cancer. He is expelled from the direction of the exhibition and kills himself at the same moment in which his wife gives birth.
notes: Greenaway's bitter reflection on life and death, the film is also an investigation into the rigor of artistic (and cinematographic) composition, conducted with the usual perfection and obsessiveness, even of music (by Wim Mertens and Glenn Branca), typical of the director British. Photograph by Sacha Vierny.

title: Vera Cruz
actors: Gary Cooper, Burt Lancaster, Cesar Romero, Denise Darcel, Sara Montiel, Ernest Borgnine, George Macready, Jack Elam, Charles Bronson
description: After the Secession War, Ben goes to Mexico where the clash between the revolutionary followers of Juarez and the regular troops under the orders of Maximilian of Austria is bloody and merciless. Meet the bandit Joe and with him try to get hold of a carriage full of gold. Stunning fresco of two men grappling with a great historical event that surpasses everyday events: large scenes en plein air, energetic stars, Aldrich baroque.

title: Jack the Ripper
actors: Michael Caine, Armand Assante, Ray McAnally, Susan George
description: We are in 1888, in London. Scotland Yard is on the hunt for one of the most notorious serial killers in history, Jack the Ripper. Inspector Frederic Abberline (Caine) is the protagonist of the investigation aimed at freeing the East End from the nightmare represented by the impregnable and bloodthirsty criminal. Although Jack has never actually been identified and captured, this somewhat fictionalized reconstruction of the story prefers to end with his unmasking. Television film, made on the basis of research conducted by the director himself, an evident supporter of the traditional English detective acumen.

title: Showdown at Boot Hill
actors: Charles Bronson, John Carradine, Carole Mathews, Robert Hutton
description: A guardian of order, complicated by his small stature, attracts the aversion of an entire country that believes him a bounty hunter. After having risked being lynched, he finally manages to find understanding and affection from a woman, who decides to start a new life with him. Fowler had been an editor for Lang before turning to directing; this True Lucky Welsh story is one of its most dignified outcomes.

title: Green Mansions
actors: Audrey Hepburn, Anthony Perkins, Lee J. Cobb, Sessue Hayakawa
description: In 1900, following a revolution that broke out in Caracas, the young Abel (Perkins) flees the city and enters the jungle south of the Orinoco. He will find himself involved in the indigenous "culture", in its beliefs, in its mysteries. He will be charmed by Rima (Hepburn), the only survivor of an extinct race, who lives with old Nuflo (Cobb), apparently her grandfather.
notes: Mel Ferrer, a well-known actor, tries his hand as a director, conceding too much to a sweet sentimentality and the picturesque aspects of the environmental setting (which is false).

title: The Terror
actors: Boris Karloff, Jack Nicholson, Sandra Knight, Dick Miller
description: The French officer André Duvalier meets a mysterious woman whom he then recognizes in the portrait of Baron von Leppe's wife, who, however, should have been dead for many years. Duvalier learns that she was murdered by the baron: what he saw is a simulacrum resulting from a curse ...
notes: In the wake of the series inspired by the stories of Edgar Allan Poe, Corman insists on the gothic atmosphere of cursed castles, where intricate family curses roam. Old glory Boris Karloff plays Baron von Leppe; among the assistant directors is a young man who will go a long way: Francis Ford Coppola.

title: La vergine, il toro e il capricorno
actors: Edwige Fenech, Alberto Lionello, Aldo Maccione, Alvaro Vitali
description: He gets busy with all women. She takes pains and tries to make him jealous with a false betrayal, but he doesn't fall for it. So she goes to Ischia with the intent of consummating a betrayal, this time real. He finds the young Patrizio, loves him and takes him back to Rome. Of course, the husband does not flinch and consoles himself with some secretary. Farsaccia more elaborate than usual, with Lionello and above all the playboy loser Maccione rather funny.

title: Una vergine per il principe
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Virna Lisi, Philippe Leroy, Vittorio Caprioli
description: Don Vincenzo Gonzaga (Gassman), having obtained the annulment of his marriage with Margherita Farnese, intends to remarry, also for the "reason of state", with Eleonora De 'Medici. But her family has some doubts about the suitor's sexual vigor. These will have to give valid proof of himself with the maid Giulia (Lisi).
notes: The story - taken from authentic documents - is amusing, but often at the level of a farce with easy effects. From Festa Campanile, director of literary extraction, one could expect better.

title: The Moon Is Blue
actors: Maggie McNamara, David Niven, William Holden
description: The story of a beautiful girl, a young architect, his ex-girlfriend, his ex-girlfriend's father, her father, etc ... In short, it's a sophisticated comedy, set partially in the upper floors of the Empire State Building, based on a smash hit on Broadway.
notes: At the time the film had quite a few problems with censorship for the use of terms such as "virgin", "lover", etc ... Today it remains a quick and effective comedy, with quite pungent moments and excellent direction of the actors.

title: The Naked Truth
actors: Terry-Thomas, Peter Sellers, Peggy Mount, Shirley Eaton
description: Nigel Dennis, editor of a tabloid newspaper called "The Naked Truth", has a lot of people in his grip with his secret information. Among these are a Lord, a mystery writer, an ex-dancer and a TV star. The four decide to get together to try to eliminate the annoying blackmailer, but the operation seems more difficult than expected.
notes: The humor is typically English, but it is capable of producing laughter at any latitude.

title: Il vero e il falso
actors: Martin Balsam, Terence Hill, Paola Pitagora
description: Luisa is a teacher who is unjustly condemned for a crime of passion, which was never actually committed. Released for good behavior, Luisa decides to actually kill the woman for whose fake death she was incarcerated.
notes: Honest thesis film, with all the limitations and forcing of the case. Screenplay by Luigi Malerba and Visconti. Very dated.

title: Die sehnsucht der Veronika Voss
actors: Rosel Zech, Hilmar Thate, Cornelia Froboess, Annemarie Düringer, Doris Schade, Erik Schumann, Peter Berling, Günther Kaufmann
description: A sports journalist meets a mysterious woman by chance: he follows her and discovers she is a former film star at the time of the Third Reich. But now the woman lives only on memories and is dominated by morphine and an unscrupulous doctor. It was the penultimate film by the great German director and the last in a series of female portraits of German culture and life. Ambiguously played on the relationship between life and the film set, it makes use of a prodigious black and white photograph that underlines the nostalgic and tragic tone of the story, yet another splendid melodrama on power relations. He won the Golden Bear at the Berlin Film Festival.

title: Fire in the Dark
actors: Olympia Dukakis, Lindsay Wagner, Jean Stapleton, Ray Wise
description: The unfriendly relations between Janet and her elderly mother only improve when the latter begins to no longer be self-sufficient.
notes: Olympia Dukakis became famous some time ago because in the same year her cousin ran for the White House and she won the Oscar as a supporting actress for Norman Jewison's "Witch by the Moon".

title: Goin' South
actors: Jack Nicholson, Mary Steenburgen, Christopher Lloyd, John Belushi
description: Henry is a bandit condemned to the gallows; a woman asks to marry him and so, according to an old law, she saves him. He looks forward to wedding joys, but she only wants to make them the worker on her farm. Western comedy with Jack Nicholson actor and director. Small appearance of John Belushi, Mexican cowboy.

title: Verso sera
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Sandrine Bonnaire, Lara Pranzoni, Paolo Panelli
description: During the "years of lead", Professor Bruschi, an old communist, is left in the custody of his son Oliviero with his niece Mescalina, known as Papere. Oliviero leaves, and the grandfather soon becomes fond of the child. The mother arrives, Stella, who clashes with the professor; mutual understanding comes with great difficulty. Finally, still alone, the elderly professor leaves Duck a letter in which he explains what happened in those months at his home.
notes: Supported by the great sensitivity of Mastroianni, the film works better in delineating the grandfather-grandchild relationship than the historical framework and the political-generational conflicts.

title: Irreconciliable Differences
actors: Ryan O'Neal, Shelley Long, Drew Barrymore, Sam Wanamaker
description: Albert and Lucy are a successful couple. He is a director, she collaborates on the scripts and their life is like "the great Gatsby". Then Albert gets mad at his lead actress and Lucy leaves him taking little Casey away. Then the situation is reversed: Lucy writes a bestseller and returns rich, Albert insists on a remake of "Gone with the Wind" and returns poor. Casey, now nine years old, can't take it anymore and denounces the parents. The court will entrust the child to the housekeeper.
notes: Halfway between "Desire for tenderness" and "Kramer against Kramer", full of movie quotes, Shyer's film is not entirely convincing, but it is not unpleasant.

title: Laura
actors: Gene Tierney, Dana Andrews, Clifton Webb, Vincent Price
description: Laura, protected by a successful writer, has become part of the big world. When he falls in love with a cheap playboy, his pygmalion's jealousy is immense. The body of a woman with a disfigured face is found: is it Laura? The investigating policeman falls in love with the deceased in turn, just by looking at her portrait. Suddenly Laura reappears ... Absolute masterpiece of film noir, under her supreme elegance she lets the fire of the most unmentionable passion flow, which only ghosts can arouse. Gene Tierney is splendid and rightfully conquers a privileged place in the contemporary male imagination. Oscar for photography, the song "Laura by Mercer and Raskin is famous.

title: Marjorie Morningstar
actors: Natalie Wood, Gene Kelly, Claire Trevor, Ed Wynn
description: Marjorie Morningstar (Wood) meets Noel (Kelly) and Wally, two young men who get busy in show business. The girl falls in love with the reckless and Don Juan Noel, chases him around the world and tries to help him in his career, but receives only disappointments. Final in the arms of the arrived and conformist Wally. Convincing account of the parable of an "amour fou", where an Ed Wynn emerges as Marjorie's uncle. Producer Warner wanted to mitigate the "Zionist" character of the story, essential in the Herman Wouk novel from which the subject is taken, to make the film more marketable.

title: Red Ensign
actors: Leslie Banks, Carol Goodner, Frank Vosper, Alfred Drayton
description: David Barry, director of a shipbuilding company, designs a new boat, but is met with opposition from board members. To complete his project he will be forced to face the left-handed shots of rivals and superiors.
notes: A "masculine" melodrama developed around the sharing of power and the sense of responsibility of individuals. Powell, at the beginning, already insists on the scenographic and iconographic aspects that so often, in his subsequent cinema, will be a symptom of the inner struggles of the protagonists.

title: The Emperor's New Clothes
actors: Sid Caesar, Clive Revill, Robert Morse
description: A witty tailor makes new clothes for a presumptuous emperor, clothes that everyone "sees", though nonexistent, except for a child. The protagonist is a well-known comedian in America but not here.

title: Gone With The Wind
actors: Clark Gable, Vivien Leigh, Olivia de Havilland, Hattie McDaniel, Leslie Howard
description: Daughter of a wealthy landowner, Rossella loves Ashley, who prefers her cousin Melania. Rossella accepts the marriage offer of a suitor who, as soon as the Civil War broke out, dies of rubella. Due to the conflict, Rossella's property and family go into ruin. She has to move to Melania's home in Atlanta, a city that is set on fire by the now victorious Northerners. At the end of the war she finds the adventurer Rhett, enriched and still willing to take care of her ...
notes: Huge (in all senses) melodrama signed by Fleming, but attributable to its producer, the legendary David O. Selznick.

title: Far from the Madding Crowd
actors: Julie Christie, Terence Stamp, Peter Finch, Alan Bates, Prunella Ransome
description: Bathsheba Everdene runs a farm: Shepherd Oak and landowner Boldwood are in love with her. But Bathsheba chooses Troy, an officer known and married almost by chance. The soldier, addicted to the game and still in love with his former girlfriend, makes life impossible for her. Believing her husband dead by drowning, the woman promises herself to Boldwood, but suddenly Troy returns ...
notes: Schlesinger and screenwriter Frederic Raphael faithfully adapt (perhaps with an excess of formalism) the well-known novel by Thomas Hardy. The photography of the future director Nicolas Roeg is beautiful and evocative; radiant and good - as always - the Christie.

title: La via dei babbuini
actors: Catherine Spaak, Pippo Franco, Fabio Garriba, Lionel Stander, Ada Pometti
description: Fiorenza and Orazio live in Rome, they are married but their marriage is not going well at all. Suddenly Fiorenza has to leave for Somalia to assist her father, whom she had never met and who shows up at the point of death. He finds him dead now but begins to get curious and to rebuild the life he led there; and discovers a way of life completely different from what she is used to. Orazio tries to get her back on the decision but Fiorenza is adamant: she will leave to walk the path of the baboons, a mythical path in the savannah. Faint anti-bourgeois satire, dull like many Magni films.

title: Boulevard du rhum
actors: Brigitte Bardot, Lino Ventura, Bill Travers, Clive Revill, Jess Hahn
description: 1919, Caribbean Sea. Cornelius is a rum smuggler who shuttles between Cuba and the coasts of Texas with his ship, taking advantage of the opportunities for illicit gain given by prohibition.
