In love with the movie star Linda, one day he really meets her and manages to conquer her. Linda follows him on his ship, which is however cornered by the financiers. The woman is saved by Lord Hammond, who marries the woman after a few days, while Cornelius ends up in jail ...
notes: From a novel by Jacques Pécheral, a film of pure fun in homage to the 1920s and silent cinema, interpreted with irony by Lino Ventura and the divine B.B.

title: The Way West
actors: Kirk Douglas, Robert Mitchum, Richard Widmark, Lola Albright
description: Senator Tudlock leads a pioneer caravan on its way to Oregon, but his harsh manners make him unpopular. After a festive meeting with the Indians, the tribal chief's son is found killed and Tudlock hangs the unwitting killer. Chased out of the caravan, the senator returns to join it when it comes to tackling the last obstacle.
notes: The film is spectacular, and the performers are a guarantee. However, a story lacks compactness, which one would like to unite and instead is just a messy overlapping of events.

title: Via Montenapoleone
actors: Marisa Berenson, Corinne Cléry, Luca Barbareschi, Valentina Cortese, Carol Alt, Renée Simonsen
description: A career woman, seductress disarmed by unexpected motherhood; a wealthy housewife seeking distractions from a cynical playboy who is far from disarmed; a teenager initiated into sex by a friend of his mother's to her mother's dismay; a homosexual at the crossroads between hiding and gay pride. These are the main protagonists of the stories that, against the background of the famous Milanese street, intertwine or juxtapose. A bit of overheard sociology, a fragile screenplay, a glossy packaging, the indispensable (and prudent) dusted with eroticism: the film, like the characters it talks about, is rightfully part of a well-known sample of the Eighties.

title: Die freudlose Gasse
actors: Asta Nielsen, Greta Garbo, Valeska Gert, Renate Brausewetter, Gregori Chmara, Mario Cusmich, Agnes Esterhazy, Karl Etlinger, Maria Forescu, Jaro Fürth, Robert Garrison, Valeska Gert
description: At the end of the First World War, Marie, a resident of a popular street in Vienna, became a prostitute by trade. Another girl, Greta, would follow the same path were it not for the intervention of an American officer. Stunning narrative solutions in a joyless and hopeless story. The interpretations of Asta Nielsen and Greta Garbo stand out from the others.

title: The Three Worlds of Gulliver
actors: Kerwin Mathews, Basil Sydney
description: Gulliver goes to the town of Lilliput and immediately has to deal with its tiny and bellicose inhabitants, before arriving in Bromdingnag. Colorful children's film freely inspired by Jonatfan Swift's eighteenth-century pamphlet. Excellent effects by Ray Harryhausen and music by Bernard Herrmann.

title: Journey to the Seventh Planet
actors: John Agar, Greta Thyssen, Ann Smyrner, Mimi Hendrich
description: In the year 2001 five astronauts sent to explore Uranus encounter a mysterious being whose mind is able to make the deepest memories, of desire or fear, become real. A crew member suffers from nostalgia and a replica of his hometown appears. Another has a phobia of mice and is attacked by a giant rodent. The subject too closely resembles that of the Forbidden Planet, but the result is equally pleasing.

title: Fantastic Voyage
actors: Stephen Boyd, Raquel Welch, Edmond O'Brien, Donald Pleasence
description: A scientist who has perfected the principle of miniaturization of objects and people suffers an attack and risks dying. Having entered a coma, he undergoes an operation that uses the techniques he developed. A team of scientists, with an FBI agent in tow, is miniaturized in a submarine and injected into the patient's body. Their purpose is to operate the patient from the inside, but one of the attackers is hidden within the medical team.
notes: Small science fiction jewel, with special effects of considerable impact and effectiveness for its times (in fact they won the Oscar, as well as the sets that reproduce the inside of the human body). Remade by Joe Dante: "Leap in the dark", 1989.

title: Mutter Krausens Fahrt ins Gluck
actors: Alexandra Schmidt, Holmes Zimmermann, Ilse Trautschold
description: In working-class Berlin in the 1920s, mother Krausens is a newsagent who sublet a part of the apartment; the tenant, who lives with a prostitute and her daughter, ends up seducing the daughter of the protagonist and leading her son on the road to the underworld. When the latter ends up in prison, mother Krausens embarks on her last journey, that of the title, together with the child, opening the gas tap. A controversial "militant" film at the time; a very successful social melodrama with some documentary sequences of notable impact shot in the working class districts and following a demonstration.

title: The Journey of Natty Gann
actors: Meredith Salenger, John Cusack, Ray Wise
description: Natty (Salenger) is a Chicago girl who, escaping all custody, travels in search of her lumberjack father somewhere in Washington State during the Great Depression. Numerous dangers and encounters, including the one with a wolf which Natty gives freedom; in exchange he will have a precious help until the end of the research. The idea of ??inserting the fabulous journey in search of the father into the realistic picture of the most frightening economic crisis works. Disney manufacturing ensures good product care. Convincing the protagonist in the role of the young heroine, excellent Cusack in the part of the young and experienced Harry Slade.

title: Il viaggio
actors: Sophia Loren, Richard Burton, Ian Bannen, Annabella Incontrera, Barbara Pilavin
description: Adriana, the only daughter of a Sicilian bourgeois, married Count Antonio Braggi, but in her heart she has always loved her brother-in-law Cesare. On the death of her husband she closes in a very close mourning from which she only leaves to go to Palermo to consult a cardiologist. Based on a short story by Pirandello, the latest film directed by De Sica is unbearable and tearful, one of his worst.

title: Voyage to the Bottom of the Sea
actors: Walter Pidgeon, Joan Fontaine, Peter Lorre, Barbara Eden
description: To save Earth from a sudden surge in cosmic radiation, Admiral Nelson proposes to launch a missile from his atomic submarine into the sky.
notes: The story is silly, but for old-fashioned science fiction fans the movie is fun.

title: No Highway in the Sky
actors: James Stewart, Marlene Dietrich, Glynis Johns
description: Professor Honcy (Stewart) is one of the leading exponents in the field of aeronautical building materials research. After he became a widower, he went even further into his work. He thus discovers that the cause of the structural failure of the tail of the aircraft is the fatigue that the material must endure: this occurs after 1440 hours of flight. Sent to the scene of an accident, the professor discovers that the plane on which he is traveling is at its 1440th hour of flight ... At times funny, above all thanks to the tone of serious lightness that Stewart manages to give his character. At his side Marlene Dietrich.

title: Sunset Boulevard
actors: Gloria Swanson, William Holden, Erich Von Stroheim, Nancy Olson, Fred Clark, Cecil B. DeMille, Hedda Hopper, Buster Keaton, Lloyd Gough, Jack Webb
description: A seasoned silent star, Norma Desmond feeds on glorious memories and lives isolated in her mansion. A broke young screenwriter meets her by chance, agrees to write the script that should mark her triumphant return to the scene and becomes her lover.
notes: The supreme fascination of this masterpiece directed and co-written (with Charles Brackett: and the two won the Oscar) by Billy Wilder unfolds from the brilliant opening, with the voiceover of the corpse floating in the pool. From there to the end, in a very long flash-back, the film is an unsurpassed metaphor of the "floating world" of cinema, always suspended between reality and illusion, grandeur and cialtroneria. Heartbreaking cast of veterans of the silent film, from Swanson ("I'm still great: it's the cinema that has become small") to the butler Stroheim, to De Mille in the part of himself.

title: Vice Versa
actors: Judge Reinhold, Fred Savage, Corinne Bohrer, Swoosie Kurtz
description: An eleven-year-old boy suffers from feeling neglected by his father, too busy with his affairs. The conflict between the adult world and that of childhood finds an unpredictable turn thanks to the complicity of a skull stolen in Bangkok, with evident magical powers. Father and son exchange bodies and roles, with consequences that are easy to imagine. Actors and scripts not of great level, and we laugh a little.

title: The Vikings
actors: Kirk Douglas, Tony Curtis, Ernest Borgnine, Janet Leigh
description: For a long period of the Middle Ages, the seas of Northern Europe were dominated by Vikings, Scandinavian warriors who often pushed themselves to the English coasts, sowing terror and death. From one of these raids the film begins, which unfolds between bloody battles, dethroned kings, raped queens, heirs to the throne hidden to protect them from intrigues, disputed princesses, up to a final duel. sure call, one of the best adventurous films of the 1950s. A barbaric and cruel Middle Ages, a certain exactness in the reconstruction, sanguine actors, an exciting rhythm. A little classic.

title: Neighbors
actors: John Belushi, Dan Aykroyd, Cathy Moriarty, Kathryn Walker
description: Earl and Enid Keese are a very respectable, mediocre and predictable middle-class couple. One day the villa next to theirs comes alive with the arrival of a new couple, Vic and Ramona. Progressively the exuberance of the newcomers also infects the routine life of the Keese. Enid discovers a vocation for the study of Indian history. Earl is persuaded to abandon his trusty TV to run away with Vic and Ramona. The subject is based on a novel by Thomas Berger, that of the Little Big Man, and it's not bad. But the real stroke of genius of the film is the idea of ​​filming the same couple of Blues Brother in a violent and sinister counter-role.

title: Victor Victoria
actors: Julie Andrews, Robert Preston, James Garner, Lesley Ann Warren, Alex Karras, John Rhys-Davies, Graham Stark, Peter Arne, Herb Tanney, Michael Robbins
description: Paris, 1934: Victoria is an unemployed and hungry singer. Convinced by a transvestite, a cabaret artist, she makes herself believe a Polish homosexual noble with musical ambitions. It is success: but things get complicated when an American boss starts turning around, unconvinced by his gay identity ...
notes: With _Victor / Victoria_, Edwards realizes, as usual, a film with a sophisticated and brilliant ferocity about that cult of appearances that is the basis of respectable morality. In the cast a group of amazing performers; let us at least mention the impressive ease with which Andrews builds her character and the glittering performance of the great Robert Preston.

title: Videodrome
actors: James Woods, Deborah Harry, Sonja Smits, Lee Carlson
description: The director of a TV network catches a disturbing broadcast and finds himself catapulted into the nightmare.
notes: Powerful work of hallucinatory cinema, full of Macluhanian and cyberpunk suggestions. As always ahead of its time, political in the depths of the flesh. Special effects are by Academy Award winner Rick Baker.

title: I Walk Alone
actors: Burt Lancaster, Kirk Douglas, Lizabeth Scott
description: "Franky and Nick were partners in the days of Prohibition. They had also made a deal in case one of the two was captured. Franky is the one of the two actually ended up in prison; but when he returns to look for his part, once he is released, Nick has it for him. refuses. Clash between the two is inevitable as is Franky's revenge. Haskin (The War of the Worlds) gives us a nice noir, with all the ingredients mixed in the best way: money, night, revenge, the city and its places of perdition Lancaster is the confident Franky, Douglas is Nick, greedy and traitor.

title: Vieni avanti cretino
actors: Lino Banfi, Franco Bracardi, Adriana Russo, Luciana Turina
description: Released from prison thanks to an amnesty, Pasquale Baudaffi first wants to move into a brothel he knows, but, in its place, he finds a dental office. Subsequent attempts to find work as a bartender, garage owner and then in an electronics company will yield equally disastrous results. It will be a lost dog to solve his problems ...
notes: Luciano Salce puts together on a slender canvas some of Lino Banfi's warhorses, from the gag of the mime to that of the automaton, from the demanding client to the seductress. Pure avanspettacolo with some hint of social satire, and in many moments the Apulian comedian is really hilarious. Detail for Moana Pozzi.

title: Tour of Duty
actors: Terence Knox, Stephen Caffrey, Tony Becker, Ramón Franco
description: The infamous Colonel Cooper and Captain Vinh, of the American army, taken prisoner by the Vietcong and sentenced to death, meditate on the escape with other comrades. Through a thousand ups and downs, they will find freedom in the very last days before the fall of Saigon. Yet another film on the tragedy of Vietnam, with good action scenes.

title: My Father, My Son
actors: Keith Carradine, Karl Malden
description: An American general, Elmo Zumwalt, decides to use the deadly defoliant Orange in the Vietnam War. His son, Elmo jr., Enlisted in the navy, returns from the dirty war and finds himself fighting against cancer: almost certainly due to the action of the terrible chemical agent.
notes: Two years after "Platoon", this film arrives which attempts to document, in a somewhat too rough way, the consequences of the war.

title: Villa Borghese
actors: Giulia Rubini, Antonio Cifariello, François Périer, Anna Maria Ferrero, Vittorio De Sica, Giovanna Ralli, Gérard Philipe
description: The film consists of several episodes that take place in the park of Villa Borghese from early morning until late evening. They range from the gossip of the nannies to the jokes of soldiers on leave, from the high school student who wants to compromise her professor and discovers that he is going blind. Good film with some of the protagonists of the golden age of Italian comedy. Photo by Mario Bava.

title: Village of the Damned
actors: George Sanders, Barbara Shelley, Michael C. Gwynne
description: A small Scottish village remains mysteriously isolated for a few hours and its inhabitants fall into a strange drowsiness. Subsequently, all the fertile women are pregnant and give birth to a dozen babies. Dr. Zellaby notes not only that they are extraordinarily precocious, but that they act in unison and have telepathic powers. Little by little, the kids begin to dominate men and women ...
notes: Low-cost sci-fi thriller, but excellent and unconventional for its time. The tension winds undertone to the maximum of the thrill and the final horror. George Sanders (Zellaby) face and aplomb are perfect. Remade in 1995 by John Carpenter.

title: From a Whisper to a Scream
actors: Vincent Price, Lawrence Tierney
description: Four horror stories told by Vincent Price. Series product, for enthusiasts only.

title: La villeggiatura
actors: Adalberto Maria Merli, Adolfo Celi, Milena Vukotic, John Steiner
description: Professor Rossini (Merli) refused to swear allegiance to the fascist regime and for this reason he was sent to confinement on a small southern island. of the concern shown by the commissioner (Celi) towards the protagonist. The story overshadows an acute analysis of the behavior of Italian culture during Fascism, of class separations, of the understanding between Church and regime (with a chronological shift of the Concordat). A lucid film in its political significance, and well interpreted.

title: Final Impact
actors: Lorenzo Lamas, Mike Worth, Gary Daniels, Art Camacho
description: Nick Taylor, former kickboxing champion, sees in the young Danny Davie, the makings of the probable champion and becomes the coach. In reality, Nick sees in Danny the only one who has that capacity for concentration and willpower that will make him capable of beating the ruthless Jack Gerard, the man who, years earlier, had beaten Nick himself during a violent encounter. The film tells the adventures of some characters from the world of kickboxing, perhaps the most violent sport that exists. Training and fighting alternate with scenes from private life. Deadly boredom.

title: I vinti
actors: Franco Interlenghi, Anna Maria Ferrero, Peter Reynolds, Jean-Pierre Mocky
description: Three episodes for three crimes set in France, Italy and England. Protagonists as many young people from good families, but without solid ethical horizons, who, for various reasons, succumb to the charm of extreme transgression. Shot in three languages. According to Antonioni's film, it underwent various censorships for its desolate vision of bourgeois youth. Especially noteworthy is the English episode.

title: Blood Sport
actors: William Shatner, Heather Locklear, Don Murray
description: T.J. Hooker, after the numerous adventures already made to defend the law, is entrusted this time with a secret mission. He will have to go to the Hawaiian Islands together with two policemen to protect a senator who went there with his wife: informers have in fact announced that the man could be in the crosshairs of a dangerous and ruthless terrorist organization. A television film inspired by a series of successful series in the United States. The director is best known for some films made with Disney.

title: Violette nei capelli
actors: Lilia Silvi, Irasema Dilian, Carla Del Poggio
description: Carina works as a saleswoman in a tailor's shop and acts in an amateur dramatics. Oliva, a dancer, gets stuck in a painful love story; while Mirella, employed in a boarding school, after some misunderstandings will be able to marry the man she loves. They are three friends who have always promised to stay together forever and help each other. Like when Oliva finds herself having to raise a child alone after being abandoned.
notes: Based on the novel of the same name by Luciana Peverelli. It is a narration made up of three sentimental small squares veined with realism, made in a time of autarchy and conducted harmlessly but with certainty by the light hand (perhaps too much) of the director Bragaglia.

title: Vip mio fratello Superuomo
description: Supervip and Minivip are two brothers: the first beautiful and strong, the second ugly and weak. Together, they are an extraordinary couple, thanks to the intelligence of the smallest. They manage to defeat the empire of Happy Betty, the department store tycoon. As in a science fiction movie, the lady has designed mini missiles to be fired into consumers' brains, so that they become supermarket-addicted. It is a "sessantottino" cartoon by Bozzetto, to be revisited with renewed pleasure and to be enjoyed for its numerous, witty ideas. Next to the contents, which are not negligible, there is an adorable and very tender Minivip.

title: The Virginia Hill Story
actors: Dyan Cannon, Harvey Keitel, Allen Garfield, Herbert Anderson
description: Virginia Hill (Cannon) was the woman of the bandit Bugsy Siegel (Keitel), one of the most famous gangsters in the history of crime. Now Virginia is alone and she has decided to appear before the commission chaired by Senator Estes Kefauver (Anderson). But the bad does not forgive: Virginia dies at the hands of the men he has helped to denounce. It's just a TV-movie, but the cast is excellent. Apart from Dyan Cannon and the unreachable Harvey Keitel, we also find Allen Garfield, the co-protagonist of the state of the things of Wenders.

title: Viridiana
actors: Silvia Pinal, Francisco Rabal, Fernando Rey
description: Before going to take her vows, VIridiana visits her uncle Don Juan. He falls in love with her and, unable to do anything else, hangs himself. Viridiana will no longer leave. One of Bunuel's masterpieces, and the film that inaugurates his second youth. Viridiana is an impossible saint, who will cross the world bringing more death and destruction than good. A very secular and restless film, whose representation of religion made it scandalous. Palme d'Or in Cannes representing Spain.

title: La visita
actors: Sandra Milo, François Périer, Mario Adorf, Gastone Moschin
description: Pina is 36 years old and lives alone in San Benedetto Po, in the Lower Mantua area. She placed a wedding announcement in the newspaper to which Adolfo, a salesman from Rome, replied. After a series of letters, the man goes to see her. They spend a day together during which however Pina discovers that a life together would be impossible.
notes: One of the most bitter and darkest Italian comedies of the period, an atrocious cross-section of peasant provincial Italy and that of the boom. Actors at their best. From a story by Carlo Cassola.

title: House Calls
actors: Walter Matthau, Glenda Jackson, Art Carney
description: Dr. Charlie Nicols, widower, meets Ann, divorced. The two get together for a trial period; Ann is strictly monogamous and it doesn't bother Charlie too much, habitual and quiet. The storm comes when the man has to go out on business with an attractive and aggressive widow. Matthau and Jackson on the American road to comedy of manners, with acute criticism of the US health system.

title: That Touch of Mink
actors: Cary Grant, Doris Day, Gig Young, Dick Sargent
description: Philip, a rich bachelor, takes a fancy to Cathy and after a tight court invites her to follow him on a vacation to Bermuda. The girl accepts. Over there, the night appointments fixed from time to time fail due to the most unpredictable setbacks. The two finally discover that they have really fallen in love and end up getting married. But even the fateful first night goes up in smoke.
notes: Enjoyable comedy, even if at the time of its release it could already appear dated, with gracefully satirical implications on traditional marriage conventions. All supported by the interpretation of an expert Cary Grant and a diligent Doris Day.

title: La vie à l'envers
actors: Charles Denner, Anna Gaylor, Jean Yanne, Yvonne Clech
description: Jacques suddenly sees his life as a comedy in which he no longer wants to act. He loses his job, his partner and, now alone and happy, tells him about him at the magnetophone.
notes: Enjoyable, elaborated irony on the boundaries between reason and madness.

title: La vie devant soi
actors: Simone Signoret, Samy Ben Youb, Claude Dauphin
description: The Jewish Madame Rosa (Signoret) experienced the Nazi horror, then got on with prostitution, finally looking after the children of former "life" colleagues. She ends up poor and sick, with only the affection of two children, Moses and Momo.
notes: Drama with simple script and direction. From a novel by Emile Ajar (pseudonym of Romain Gary), Goncourt prize. Oscar for best foreign film.

title: The Story of Vernon and Irene Castle
actors: Fred Astaire, Ginger Rogers, Edna May Oliver, Walter Brennan
description: Vernon Castle (Astaire) is featured in a comedy company. When he meets Irene (Rogers), a girl from a good family who is passionate about theater, he falls in love with her and marries her. After many attempts and as many failures, the two suddenly meet success thanks to a successful ballet number and become famous. It seems like a happy and rosy love story, but the idyll is interrupted by the world war. Biography of a famous couple of dancers, marks the end of the golden period of the duo Astaire / Rogers (they will be back together again, ten years later, in the "Berkeleys of Broadway"), and already the rhythm and the grace not are more those.

title: Una vita difficile
actors: Alberto Sordi, Lea Massari, Lina Volonghi, Franco Fabrizi, Claudio Gora
description: Silvio Magnozzi fought in the communist partisan formations; after the war he found himself working as a journalist. However, man does not accept compromises and his life faces economic and social obstacles of all kinds. For this reason, his wife decides to leave him until he is able to rise socially. To win her back, Silvio abandons his idealism and begins to work and humble himself in the pay of an industrialist. It is one of Sordi's memorable interpretations. Risi in one of his most successful films channels the typical Sordian character into the bitter meanders of a merciless portrait of Italy of reconstruction.

title: La vita è bella
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Ornella Muti, Enzo Fiermonte, Stefano Madia
description: Antonio Murillo fought for a long time in Angola against the independence guerrillas (the action took place before the Portuguese revolution of 1975). Back in Lisbon he works as a taxi driver and falls in love with Maria, ignoring the fact that the girl is a member of a left wing group. Attending the girl costs him arrest, but Antonio manages to escape and join the revolutionaries, among whom he finds Maria. Confused and misinterpreted Italian-Soviet co-production, directed by a post-Stalinist director (The ballad of a soldier).

title: La vita è bella
actors: Maria Mercader, Anna Magnani, Alberto Rabagliati, Carlo Campanini
description: A penniless noble and idler runs out of money and thinks about suicide. A professor promises him money in exchange for a risky favor: to undergo an injection of an unknown serum to check its effects. The experiment will have to take place after ten days. In the meantime, the noble understands the value of existence, of work and also knows a girl who could love him. Rabagliati was a good singer; the classic light comedy plot is enriched by very Bragaglian fantastic ideas and by the mild anti-aristocratic polemic, very common at the time.

title: It's a Wonderful Life
actors: James Stewart, Donna Reed, Henry Travers, Thomas Mitchell, Ward Bond
description: It's Christmas Eve and George Bailey is alone, on a bridge, with bad intentions. He who has given up everything to keep his father, who died prematurely, is now facing the specter of failure. It would have been better to never have been born, he thinks. At that point an angel descends from heaven to show him what would have happened if he had never been born.
notes: The spiritual testament of Capra, a film that shows the horror and reality of post-war America and then, with superhuman effort, affirms the dream, the solidarity, the utopia of the small community. Perfect Jimmy Stewart, absolutely overwhelming the ending. A masterpiece.

title: La vie et rien d'autre
actors: Philippe Noiret, Sabine Azéma, Pascale Vignal, Maurice Barrier
description: In 1920 Major Dellaplane was charged with identifying the unnamed French fallen of the recent conflict; the government, meanwhile, must choose the unknown soldier to honor. Irène is looking for the body of her missing husband. Between her and Dellaplane, so different and hostile at first, an understanding will be born that only two years later (perhaps too late) the disillusioned officer will decide to admit. Intense interpretation of Sabine Azéma and Noiret in this painful return to post-war normality.

title: The Girl Who Had Everything
actors: Elizabeth Taylor, William Powell, Fernando Lamas, Gig Young
description: Jean Latimer, the beautiful daughter of a well -known lawyer, gets angry of a boss of illegal bets and abandons her boyfriend. Then Santa is commissioned to support the accusation against the betting racket and the drama breaks out. From a novel that had already inspired "I love" of Clarence Brown, a slightly greve and predictary melodrama, but made with the usual professionalism.

title: La vita ricomincia
actors: Alida Valli, Fosco Giachetti, Eduardo De Filippo, Nando Bruno
description: After years of absence, a veteran from captivity (Giachetti) finds the serenity of existence with his wife (Valli) and son. But during the absence of her husband, the woman went through a dramatic moment which is now reaching its tragic conclusion. However, the man finds the strength to forgive and reunite with his woman. Rhetorical melodrama but also absolutely sincere, starting from the harsh post-war reality but with pathetic thrusts (and Chopin's music on the soundtrack). The best is given by the presence of the Giachetti-Valli couple.

title: Hors la vie
actors: Hippolyte Girardot, Rafic Ali Ahmad, Hussein Sbeity
description: Frenchman Patrick (Girardot), a free lance photographer in Beirut, is taken hostage by a group of Islamic fundamentalists. He does not know the reason why he was kidnapped, he "innocent" witness of a tragedy that concerns him only from the point of view of documentation, as a professional occasion. He is not a hero and the phases of his detention seem to him, as well as painful and depressing, also absurd. Excellent interpretation of the protagonist, who holds a film not free from rhetoric.

title: I vitelloni
actors: Franco Interlenghi, Alberto Sordi, Franco Fabrizi, Leopoldo Trieste, Carlo Romano
description: Fausto, Riccardo, Alberto, Leopoldo and Moraldo, children of the petty bourgeoisie, waste their youth in the most complete idleness and in the longing of unrealizable dreams. Fausto betrays his young wife, Leopoldo has literary ambitions and Alberto can do nothing but cry at the news that his sister has run away from home. In the end, only Moraldo will be able to leave.
notes: The director knows the characters of these idlers well: they are his friends from Rimini, from whom he left to come to Rome. Now he describes them with a keen eye and with pungent irony. Famous is the sequence in which Sordi mocks the workers from a car, which then stops.

title: La vittima designata
actors: Tomas Milian, Pierre Clementi, Katia Christine, Luigi Casellato, Marisa Bartoli
description: Stefano lives in luxury thanks to his wife's money, but when he falls in love with a model, Count Tiepolo offers him a deal ...
notes: Although the cast also includes Pierre Clémenti, among others, the film is nothing more than a clumsy attempt to remake _Delitto per delitto_.

title: Betrayed by Love
actors: Patricia Arquette, Steven Weber, Mare Winningham
description: Deanne is a young Kentucky girl with a rather restless temperament, who is only waiting for the right opportunity to leave that squalid provincial world to which fate has relegated her. And the opportunity comes with Jeff, a federal cop who happens to be over there. The girl hopes for marriage, but then her sister discovers that Jeff is already married. Places, characters, aspirations, disappointments: all already seen countless times in American cinema (and not only). For those who want to keep up to date on the new Hollywood stars, the interest is all in the presence of Patricia Arquette (A Life at the Most), sister of the more famous Rosanne. First TV viewing.

title: Casualties of War
actors: Michael J. Fox, Sean Penn, Don Harvey, Thuy Thu Le
description: Private Eriksson, recently in Vietnam, is saved in action by his sergeant, the brave but grim Meserve. He is later involved in the kidnapping of a young peasant woman. Raped by the members of the team (but not by Eriksson), the girl is later killed in a fight, by order of Meserve himself. Eriksson does not rest until he sees his comrades condemned.
notes: Ambiguous and distressing, one of the few films on Vietnam capable of remaining in the memory. For his part, De Palma stages the sense of guilt and regression that that war produced and maintains in the generation that had to fight it.

title: Go Tell the Spartans
actors: Burt Lancaster, Craig Wasson, Marc Singer, Jonathan Goldsmith, Joe Unger, Evan Kim
description: Vietnam, 1964. Major Barker despatches a mixed unit, consisting of South Vietnamese troops and American troops, to occupy the old French base at Muc Wa. When the Vietcong show up, the Americans prove unprepared for a totally different tactic from those described in the war manuals on which they trained. In addition, the South Vietnamese commander shows an unprecedented cruelty ...
notes: It is one of the best films made about the "dirty war", especially in relation to the time in which it was made. Harsh and devoid of emphasis, even if at times a little too predictable, he is excellently played by Burt Lancaster.

title: Viuuulentemente mia
actors: Diego Abatantuono, Laura Antonelli, Roberto Della Casa, Christian De Sica, Sandro Ghiani
description: Anna, a charming adventurer, deceived the clumsy agent Achille Cotone, flees to Spain. Stopped by the local gendarmerie, the woman is joined by the policeman and his superior, but gets rid of the latter. Cotton does not give up: it does not give in to flattery and brings it back to its homeland. Anna then threatens a scandal: she takes out a secret dossier with the names of important personalities involved in financial scandals. Her freedom, the poor agent a punitive transfer.
notes: An entertaining film, unpretentious and a little sluggish; the highlight is Diego Abatantuono with his unmistakable talk.

title: W Django!
actors: Antonio De Teffé, Stelio Candelli
description: A woman, who lives in solitude on her farm, is attacked and brutally killed by three passing men. The famous gunslinger Django arrives at the site of the tragedy and decides to chase the attackers to avenge her. Mediocre western-spaghetti directed by a third-row director, with various character actors, referring to the successful Corbucci film of '67.

title: Viva l'Italia
actors: Renzo Ricci, Paolo Stoppa, Franco Interlenghi, Giovanna Ralli, Remo De Angelis
description: Landed in Marsala, Garibaldi with his volunteers passes from victory to victory against the Bourbon troops. The decisive battle will take place on the Volturno river, when the Bourbons have now abandoned Naples and the population has risen everywhere. Once the soldiers loyal to the king of Naples finally bowed, Garibaldi met with King Vittorio Emanuele II and decided not to continue on Rome and Venice as his men would like; the management of national unity will take place under the banner of the Savoy family. Rossellini is not so comfortable in this sumptuous historical reconstruction: the best things are small ideas about some characters, but ruined by a little rhetoric.

title: Vive la vie
actors: Michel Piccoli, Charlotte Rampling, Jean-Louis Trintignant, Evelyne Bouix
description: Disappeared under mysterious circumstances, a manager and a young actress who say they don't know each other reappear together three days later, carrying a message of peace from an alien civilization. Someone doubts, but not for long. Even those who accuse the most recent Lelouch of rhetorical excesses will recognize, in this case, the qualities of a refined suspense narrator.

title: Viva Las Vegas
actors: Elvis Presley, Ann-Margret, Cesare Danova, William Demarest
description: Lucky Jackson, a car racer (Presley), without a means and without means, works as a waiter to make ends meet. He goes to Las Vegas with his mechanic Shorty, on the trail of Rusty, a girl he has fallen in love with. Lucky in the gambling capital is looking for a rich sponsor to allow him to compete. After so much effort he will manage to find the money to run, but then he will promise his girlfriend to stop.
notes: Presley's best comedy, thanks also to the songs "The Lady Loves Me" and "I Need Somebody to Lean On".

title: Viva Maria!
actors: Brigitte Bardot, Jeanne Moreau, Claudio Brook, Paulette Dubost
description: Maria Fitzgerald O'Malley, daughter of an Irish terrorist, left alone and without means in the village of San Miguel, joins a company of street artists. When the friend of the soubrette Maria kills herself for love, Fitzgerald takes her place. The adventurous and wandering life really pleases the Irishman, who has the opportunity to be wooed by the men who besiege his dressing room. One day, all the members of the company are brought into the presence of the evil and powerful Don Rodriguez. The two Marys, finally aware of the living conditions of the peons harassed by the ferocious squire, decide to lead the revolt.
notes: Libertarian and smashing comedy, typical of a certain Malle cinema. It's not one of her best films, but it's worth it for the star couple.

title: Villa Rides
actors: Yul Brynner, Robert Mitchum, Charles Bronson, Maria Grazia Buccella
description: The revolutionary Pancho Villa struggling with the traitor General Juerta. The revolutions seen by Hollywood are always ridiculous, but the cast is good. Peckinpah's script (who knows what it was like ...) was rewritten by Robert Towne.

title: To Live and Die in L.A.
actors: William Petersen, Willem Dafoe, John Pankow, John Turturro, Debra Feuer, Darlanne Fluegel, Dean Stockwell, Steve James
description: Chance and Vukovich are two federal agents on the trail of a forger named Eric Masters. Chance, who among other things wants to avenge a colleague killed by Masters himself, does not hesitate to go off the rails of legality in order to frame him. In the end he succeeds, but at a very high price ...
notes: Powerful film by William Friedkin, returned to the levels of _The violent arm of the law_. In the splendid photograph of the German Robby Müller the game is played between cops and bad guys, while the boundaries between Good and Evil blow up. The pursuit on the Los Angeles highways is memorable. The best "action" of the 80s together with Michael Mann's _Volent Roads_.

title: Vivere in pace
actors: Aldo Fabrizi, Gar Moore, Ave Ninchi, Mirella Monti, John Kitzmiller, Heinrich Bode, Ernesto Almirante, Nando Bruno, Aldo Silvani, Gino Cavalieri, Piero Palermini, Franco Serpilli
description: During the war two American soldiers, one white (Moore) and one black (Kitzmiller) found refuge in the Umbrian farm of Zio Tigna (Aldoabrizi). One evening a German soldier (Bode) also happens to be there but, thanks to the wine, the situation is resolved.
notes: Awarded by American critics as the best foreign film of '47, the film, written by Zampa himself in collaboration with Aldo Fabrizi, Suso Cecchi D'Amico and Piero Tellini, is a less cynical neorealist comedy than other Zampa films, but almost always succeeds to avoid rhetoric with a participatory observation of an era.

title: The Fall of the House of Usher
actors: Vincent Price, Myrna Fahey, Mark Damon, Harry Ellerbe
description: The two last descendants of the Usher, Roderick and Madeleine, live in the ancestral home. Madeleine is in the throes of an apparent death, and her brother buries her alive. From the short story "The Fall of the Usher House", the film that inaugurated Poe's series of adaptations directed by Corman for AIP. In reality the story is a trace, the film focuses on atmospheres and on a decisive stylistic baroqueism. There are already Price superb protagonist, and Floyd Crosby's color photography.

title: Santee
actors: Glenn Ford, Michael Burns, Dana Wynter, Jay Silverheels, Harry Townes
description: Santee is a former sheriff and former bounty killer. He makes friends with Johnny, without knowing that the young man is the son of one of his victims and that he has decided to kill him in revenge. But things take a different turn when Santee is faced with the gang of criminals who once killed his little son. A Glenn Ford seasoned for this twilight western of good trade, but he did not leave great memories of himself. Nelson is best known for his sci-fi Black Hole.

title: La cage aux folles II
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Michel Serrault, Marcel Bozzuffi, Paola Borboni
description: Renato and Albin get involved in a spy affair. Sequel of Il vizietto: as the first is supported by the verve of the protagonists, but the game works less.

title: Il vizio di famiglia
actors: Renzo Montagnani, Edwige Fenech, Gigi Ballista
description: The old count is about to die and there is great agitation among his descendants. Fearing that the beautiful Ines can obtain the entire inheritance, relatives commissioned a former prisoner to conclude it and ruin the reputation. But erotic intrigues do not go as expected and involve all the members of the family. In the end, the reading of the testament will reserve a sad surprise for everyone.
notes: It is the usual erotic farce with great exposure of jurories and stripteases in the shower, with the usual Montagnani and the usual (beautiful) Fenech.

title: Il vizio di vivere
actors: Carol Alt, Andrea Occhipinti, William Berger
description: Following a car accident, a girl is completely paralyzed and forced to live in a lung of steel. Among the dramatic consequences of this situation there is also the abandonment by her boyfriend. However, she manages to find the affection of a journalist.
notes: Television film inspired by the story of Rosanna Benzi, the woman who lived for 28 years in a lung of steel. Risi relies on the not-so-brilliant presence of Carol Alt in the title role. The result is flatly televised.

title: Le désordre et la nuit
actors: Jean Gabin, Danielle Darrieux, Nadja Tiller, Paul Frankeur
description: Inspector Valois is in charge of investigating the death of a nightclub owner. The best lead is Lucky Fridel (Tiller), the victim's girlfriend, a German drug addict. Valois falls in love with her and draws the disapproval of bosses who consider her unprofessional behavior. But Valois is right: the track is right.
notes: Genre film, but it is a genre that the French, and Grangier do well. The monolithic Gabin is as big as ever.

title: The Whisperers
actors: Edith Evans, Eric Portman, Avis Bunnage, Nanette Newman
description: An elderly lady has the obsession with being spied on and begins to feel the voices. Things worsen when her son and husband happen to her. A melodrama in suspense not always satisfactory. However, Edith Evans obtained an Oscar nomination.

title: Distant Voices, Still Lives
actors: Freda Dowie, Pete Postlethwaite, Angela Walsh, Dean Williams, Lorraine Ashbourne, Sally Davies, Nathan Walsh, Susan Flanagan, Michael Starke, Vincent Maguire, Antonia Mallen, Debi Jones, Chris Darwin, Marie Jelliman, Andrew Schofield
description: A film of great suggestion for its sensitivity and narrative originality, which talks about the family of Eillen, Maisie and Tony, who grew up with a father capable of neurotic hardships and a mother who is, instead, the authentic angel of the hearth. After the death of the parent, the fates of the children take their own paths .. With a very personal style, with an extraordinary intensity, with an excellent evocative capacity of the environment (Liverpool), of the time (starting during the Second World War) and of the social context, Terence Davies achieves an excellent result. Fascinating musical column, masterful acting. Preceded by "Trilogy" and followed by "The long day ends".

title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
actors: Sarah Jessica Parker, Lee Montgomery, Helen Hunt, Morgan Woodward, Shannen Doherty
description: College friends Janey and Lynne attend an audition along with hundreds of other teenagers. Their dream is to become famous by dancing rock in front of the cameras of the Dance Tv Show.
notes: Debut behind the camera for Alan Metter who would later give the "best" of himself with _Police School - Mission to Moscow_.

title: Terms of Endearment
actors: Shirley MacLaine, Debra Winger, Jack Nicholson, Bill Pullman, John Lithgow, Danny DeVito
description: Between Emma and her mother, Aurora, relations have never been ideal. Her marriage to a teacher didn't have maternal approval either. After the birth of two children, Emma is pregnant again and does not want to hear about an abortion. Meanwhile, Aurora begins a flirtation with her neighbor, Garret Bredlowe, a former astronaut, less cynical than he appears. And when Emma discovers that she has cancer, she will entrust the children to her mother, whose bond with Bredlowe seems to give guarantees of solidity.
notes: A film that targets the heart and tear glands of the viewer and Academy Award members, and it undoubtedly works. With both he was successful: excellent box office and five Oscars (film, direction, non-original screenplay, MacLaine leading actress and Nicholson supporting role).

title: Teen Wolf
actors: Michael J. Fox, James Hampton, Susan Ursitti, Lorie Griffin
description: Martyn excels neither as a student nor as a basketball player, and he gasps for Pamela as sweet Boof falls in love with him. When an increasingly thick fleece begins to appear, courage, strength and skill also arrive. In short, Martyn is, like his father, a werewolf and this condition brings him many advantages. But he will want to win the decisive game as a man, not as a wolf. Rather insipid film, with a short-term central idea. Even as a parody of the "genre" about werewolves it is not the best. Michael J. Fox, he is in the game, but it is not enough.

title: La voglia matta
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Catherine Spaak, Gianni Garko, Franco Giacobini
description: The Milanese engineer Antonio Berlinghieri is on his way to visit his son at boarding school for the weekend. Along the way he meets a group of boys heading to the sea, who first target him with their jokes and then invite him to spend Sunday together. Antonio accepts and ends up falling in love with a sixteen year old. But Sunday soon ends, and with her the last illusion of youth. It is the film with which Salce made his debut in the comedy of manners. Tognazzi is perfectly in part; the very young Spaak, in her role of impossible prey, is all pepper. Although not among the best Italian comedies of the period (the description of the young sons of fathers is superficial), it remains very enjoyable and bad, with sincere traces of the air of the time.

title: To Be Or Not to Be
actors: Jack Benny, Carole Lombard, Robert Stack, Lionel Atwill
description: After the Nazi invasion, a Polish theater company is in dire straits albeit rich in talent and with a first-rate repertoire. When the situation becomes unbearable comes the entrepreneur's stroke of genius: staging an ingenious fraud, taking advantage of the resemblance to Hitler of one of them. The pace is overwhelming, the lines are irresistible and the acting is masterful. Lubitsch manages to marry the humor of situations with a genuinely democratic message: you joke with fire, but humor triumphs.

title: Vogliamoci troppo bene
actors: Francesco Salvi, Holly Higgins, Enzo Braschi, Barbara D'Urso
description: Francesco Salvi between a joke and a gag plays with the cinema and tries (he doesn't always succeed) to entertain us. It went badly and the film marked the end of his short career.

title: Shall We Dance
actors: Fred Astaire, Ginger Rogers, Edward Everett Horton
description: Petrov (Astaire), the famous Russian dancer, is madly in love with Linda Keene (Rogers), an American magazine dancer who he is willing to follow around the world in order to win her heart. Some rivals spread the word of their secret marriage, which Petrov, despite his best efforts, is unable to deny. To put an end to the gossip and regain the lost tranquility Petrov and Linda then decide to get married in earnest and then divorce. Classic story from "comedy of marriage", very popular in the 30s, is a pretext for beautiful performances on Gershwin's music, including "Let's Call the Whole Thing Off" on roller skates.

title: My Forbidden Past
actors: Robert Mitchum, Ava Gardner, Lucille Watson, Melvyn Douglas
description: Barbara Beaurevels is the beautiful descendant of a fallen noble family and has long loved the doctor Lukas. During a trip to South America, he marries Cora. Barbara has meanwhile received a rich inheritance from a distant relative and uses the money to hire a man to seduce Cora, who doesn't love her husband. The man, during a quarrel, kills Cora and Lukas is accused of the murder: it will be Barbara who will save him from the accusation, thus managing to show him her love. As usual, Mitchum manages to be very good even if the melodrama, directed by a specialist in children's films, certainly does not live up to his fame.

title: Ich will doch nur, dass ihr mich liebt
actors: Vitus Zeplichal, Elke Aberle, Alexander Allerson, Erni Mangold, Johanna Hofer, Wolfgang Hess, Armin Meier, Erika Runge, Katherina Buchhammer
description: The court just decided: Peter was sentenced to ten years for murder. A reporter discovers that Peter has had problems since childhood. He had an oedipal relationship with his mother that was never resolved, while his father despised him and kept him tied to himself through money. As a married man, Peter knew only one way to be liked by his wife: to buy her whatever he wanted. Once he lost his job, Peter killed a man who mistreated his drug addict son, projecting all his frustrations into that gesture. Realistic drama, inspired by a real event, conducted with the rhythm of an American black film.

title: Volere volare
actors: Maurizio Nichetti, Angela Finocchiaro, Patrizio Roversi, Mariella Valentini
description: Maurizio (Maurizio Nichetti) works with his brother in a company specializing in cartoons. He is shy and clumsy, and a turning point in his life could give him the meeting with Martina, an enterprising girl who deals only with cases of sexual perversion. And a relationship is born between the two. But everything doesn't go smoothly: Maurizio becomes prey to a real metamorphosis: strange allergies and strange mutations, until he becomes a cartoon himself.
notes: 120,000 drawings and 750,000 photographic shots were needed to make the sequences with Nichetti cartoon version. Contemporary fable for which Nichetti is joined by the designer Guido Manuli.

title: Volevamo essere gli U2
actors: Marco Galli, Enrico Lo Verso, Paola Magnanini, Carolina Salomé, Alberto Molinari, Federico Scribani, Marina Giulia Cavalli, Valentina Forte, Massimo Ghini
description: Six Roman boys led by the volcanic Marco come together to form a rock group that re-evaluates the repertoire of the seventies. The group includes Marco, on drums, Rocco, on guitar, Matteo, on keyboards, Saverio, on bass, and Margherita and Sonia, the singers. After a year of rehearsals the group is booed during a concert at the university and disbanded. The members of the band will reunite following the tragedy that engulfed one of them.
notes: Based on the comedy of the same name by Umberto Marino, the film tries (and partially succeeds) to trace the boundaries of a generational biography: that of children who grew up with TV and the false myths of success and stardom, between realism and stereotype.

title: Volevo i pantaloni
actors: Giulia Fossà, Lucia Bosé, Angela Molina, Natasha Hovey, Pino Colizzi
description: Annetta, daughter of Sicilian peasants, suffers from the contrast between male and female conditions of life: the former permissive, the latter marked by very severe restrictions. Rebelling against this state of affairs, she is withdrawn from school and locked up in the home of some relatives. Here her uncle tries to rape her and Annetta denounces him. Back at her parents' house, she marries her Nicola with whom she has a little girl. Upon its release, the novel by Lara Cardella, from which the film is based, caused a certain sensation, immediately amplified by the mass media. The film follows the plot pedestrianized without ever having a shot of originality.

title: O melissokomos
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Nadia Mourouzi, Serge Reggiani, Dinos Illiopoulos
description: Spyros elementary teacher of peasant origins, a wife and a daughter now married, one day abandons everything and everyone to go back to being a beekeeper like his father and grandfather. Load the hives on a truck and leave for the highest pastures. On the way he meets a hitchhiker to whom he gives a ride. He meets her again the next day, then the next and spends a night with her. Resuming his journey, he frees the bees and lets himself die pierced by their stings. Beautiful, slow almost to exasperation, intense and with exciting moments (the final piano-sequezna): this is Anghelopulos' cinema. Take or leave. Screenplay by Tonino Guerra.

title: The Taking of Flight 847
actors: Lindsay Wagner, Eli Danker
description: In June 1985, flight 847 from Athens to London was diverted to Beirut by two Arab terrorists. Seventeen days of growing anxiety will be told through the testimony of a hostess. Good TV-movie based on a real episode. Directs a prolific specialist.

title: One of Our Aircraft Is Missing
actors: Godfrey Tearle, Eric Portman, Hugh Williams
description: During the Second World War a RAF plane left to bomb Stuttgart. Upon returning from the mission, a failure forces the crew to parachute into Dutch territory. Here, after the first mistrust, they are helped by the generous population to hide from the Nazis and then to return to their homeland. A powerful and spectacular war film by the Powell / Pressburger couple that exalts the courage and tenacity of a people against Nazism.

title: Flight to Mars
actors: Cameron Mitchell, Marguerite Chapman
description: Scientists who accidentally landed on Mars find apparently hospitable inhabitants there. The leader of the extraterrestrials, however, plots behind them. Small science fiction film, very enjoyable for fans in its naivety.

title: Gone to Earth
actors: Jennifer Jones, David Farrar, Cyril Cusack
description: Noble Jack Reddin courts beautiful and wild Hazel. This, fond of a fox cub she has tamed, is fascinated by the squire but does not want to give in to him. Finally she marries the young local shepherd. One day, however, in the woods she is seduced by Reddin, who then leads her to his castle. A refined melodrama on the archetype of the impossible pacification of the senses; only death can resolve the conflict between the spirit and the flesh. Cut by manufacturer Selznick, it was restored in 1986.

title: With a Vengeance
actors: Melissa Gilbert Brinkman, Jack Scalia, Michael Gross
description: Valerie is sixteen and the only survivor of the massacre that a homicidal maniac has committed at her home. Valerie remembers nothing of that episode, but the killer remembers her well. Six years later, the memoryless girl calls herself Gene and babysits with a lawyer who has a ten-year-old boy. With the help of these Valerie / Gene tries to piece together the shreds of her past. If Melissa Gilbert is having trouble remembering her past, we can help her: she spent ten years on TV in Little House on the Prairie, then she married a certain Brinkman and now she is finished in this low-key thriller.

title: Rollover
actors: Jane Fonda, Kris Kristofferson, Hume Cronyn
description: A petrochemical magnate is mysteriously murdered. His widow teams up with a financier who discovers an intricate plot: emissaries from Arab countries are converting all their bank deposits into gold with the intention of simultaneously withdrawing the funds and thus causing a serious economic crisis throughout the West. . Political fantasy combined with the "mélo" of a couple's story. A cartoon in which it is difficult to recognize the hand of the 70s Pakula.

title: A Woman's Face
actors: Joan Crawford, Melvyn Douglas, Conrad Veidt, Reginald Owen
description: A woman's face was deformed by an accident in her childhood. Envious and full of resentment, the protagonist is ruthless in every way against those who flaunt their beauty and almost gets stained with murder to please the man who dominates her with passion. A providential cosmetic surgery, however, will radically change the cards on the table.
notes: Cukor, a great director of women, remakes a Swedish film of 1938 with Ingrid Bergman and creates a story of considerable emotional suggestion, even if with rather unlikely characters.

title: A face in the Crowd
actors: Andy Griffith, Patricia Neal, Anthony Franciosa
description: Discovered by a brilliant reporter from a small radio station in Pigott, Arkansas, Solitario Rodhes is a wandering singer-songwriter who quickly becomes a successful character. His power and influence on the public are such as to unleash an ambition in him that will lead him to ruin. From Elia Kazan an excellent example of ferocious American realism that gives us a merciless portrait of the USA in the 1950s, and of the dangers of the mass media. Screenplay by Budd Schulberg.

title: Von Buttiglione Sturmtruppenführer
actors: Jacques Dufilho, Mario Marenco, John Steiner, Isabelle Marchal, Peter Boom
description: During the Second World War, a regiment of the German army is commanded by Major Hoffman. At the news of his dismissal Hoffman would like to commit suicide, but withdraws from his plans when he learns that Colonel Von Buttiglione will take over the command.
notes: Third and last cinematic adventure, always under the direction of Guerrini, of the little sketch created by Mario Marenco for the radio. Ramshackle farce with subject and screenplay by Enrico Vanzina.

title: I'd Rather Be Rich
actors: Sandra Dee, Robert Goulet, Maurice Chevalier, Andy Williams
description: Philip Dulaine (Chevalier), a wealthy businessman, has suffered a heart attack and asks as a last wish to have his niece Cynthia (Dee) next to him. She would like to leave with her boyfriend, but he falls ill. The girl then asks a friend to replace him and accompany her. The situation becomes complicated when the grandfather recovers and the real boyfriend returns to the scene.
notes: It is a comedy, based on the misunderstanding created by the mistaken identity, where everything flows pleasantly smoothly. Remake of "The First Was Eve", with Deanna Durbin and Laughton.

title: Mind Field
actors: Michael Ironside, Lisa Langlois, Christopher Plummer
description: A policeman from Montreal is persecuted by continuous problems at work: around him mysterious murders are accomplished, while strange mental flashes make a character linked to the CIA re -emerge from his memories. Not only. Something connects our hero even to one of the major cases of the last thirty years: the murder of John Kennedy ...
notes: Police, psychological thriller, espionage: multilayer film this "mental emptiness" by Jean-Claude Lord, a Canadian filmmaker perhaps a little too ambitious for his actual possibilities. Among the interpreters stand out the well -known and disturbing faces of Ironside and Plummer.

title: W le donne
actors: Little Tony, Luciano Fineschi, Pippo Franco, Pippo Baudo
description: Tony Marconi, an Italian-American singer, has to undertake a tour in Italy, but on arrival he is stopped by the carabinieri because he did not complete his military service. However, the barracks did not prevent him from continuing his career and even finding a girlfriend ...
notes: One of the thousand "musicarelli" of the sixties.

title: Waco
actors: Howard Keel, Jane Russell, Brian Donlevy, Wendell Corey, Terry Moore
description: Waco, a former outlaw turned sheriff, brings law and order back to the town of Emporia. A quiet western routine.

title: Walker
actors: Ed Harris, Marlee Matlin, Richard Masur, Peter Boyle
description: In 1885, the American journalist-lawyer William Walker assembles a handful of armed men who call themselves "The Immortals", and with the money of the Yankee banker Vanderbilt goes to Nicaragua to support the dictator of the moment. Walker, however, is an idealistic reactionary, he quarrels with Vanderbilt and directly assumes power, causing an uproar. It looks like a novel but it is history, which also illuminates the relevance of relations between North and Central-South America. A deliberately irritating film, from the director of Sid and Nancy.

title: Wall Street
actors: Michael Douglas, Charlie Sheen, Martin Sheen, Daryl Hannah
description: Young Bud works as a stock broker for a Wall Street listed company. A true New York yuppie, Bud is taken under the protection of Gekko, an unscrupulous businessman who dominates the market, often ruining small savers with his intrigues. But when Gekko also adopts his methods towards the company where Bud's father works, the boy opens his eyes. After Vietnam and the South American guerrilla, Stone roams the jungle of Wall Street. The director plays a relaxed story, with melodrama twists and frontal juxtaposition of good and bad, yet again demonstrating his attachment to civil issues and the analysis of American problems. The boss is Michael Douglas, who shows off a notable determination, while the student and his father are played by Charlie and Martin Sheen, father and son also in real life.

title: Walter e i suoi cugini
actors: Walter Chiari, Riccardo Billi, Valeria Fabrizi, Alberto Bonucci
description: Walter, an Apulian who emigrated to Milan, lives for the day. He boxing every now and then and has to watch out for the hostess on a daily basis. He is joined by his cousins ??Nicola and Rosario who resemble him like drops of water. The neurotic life of the metropolis engulfs them in a whirlwind of frantic adventures that culminate in a crime. But it's all a game.
notes: The star of the film is the unleashed Chiari, also the author of the story and the screenplay. The reference would like to be "Rocco and his brothers", but the satirical intent does not rise above the farce.

title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
actors: Rutger Hauer, Gene Simmons, Robert Guillaume
description: Nick was one of the best CIA agents. Despite being retired, he sets out on the trail of the Middle Eastern terrorist Malak al Rahim ...
notes: Crude detective story, badly modeled on the figure created by Steve McQueen, the film is an endless succession of actions and double games of its treacherous protagonists.

title: Warbus
actors: Daniel Stephen, Romano Kristoff, Steve Eliot, Urs Althaus
description: We are in Vietnam during the war. A group of Westerners evacuated by a village threatened by the Vietcong offensive is embarked on a bus of the local mission. The journey to salvation is fraught with dangers; To the survivors are added three skimpy marines and a South Vietnamese officer and other civilians are accepted along the way.
notes: Behind the pseudonym is an eclectic filmmaker for palates ready for everything. Vietnam is only an occasion envelope for yet another recycling of overwhelming situations.

title: Wargames
actors: Matthew Broderick, Dabney Coleman, John Wood, Ally Sheedy
description: David (Broderick), a very young computer enthusiast, manages to connect clandestinely with various computerized networks. But what seems like just a harmless game risks turning into tragedy when one day, quite by chance, it manages to dialogue with the memory of the computer that controls and programs the nuclear defense of the United States. Convinced that he is dealing with a video game company, David launches into a confrontation that actually sets off the irreversible preparations for a new world war. Youth-science fiction apologue with a nice pacifist aftertaste, directed with good hand following a remarkable basic intuition.

title: Wavelength
description: A 25 meter loft. The camera shoots it with a 45-minute zoom. The room and the zoom are interrupted by four human events, including a death.
notes: A sum of the author's nervous system, his religious and aesthetic ideas. A great experiment that explores the boundaries of medium cinema.

title: Weekend at Bernie's
actors: Andrew McCarthy, Jonathan Silverman, Terry Kiser, Catherine Mary Stewart
description: Larry and Richard are two young employees in an insurance company. Working overtime, they accidentally discover a two million dollar scam in the settlement of a claim and run triumphantly to report it to the boss, Bernie Lomax, not knowing that he was the one who rigged the cards. Lomax can't help but rejoice and even invites them to spend a weekend in his villa as a reward. In reality he would like to eliminate them, but in the meantime the mafia boss of which he is an accomplice has decided to have him killed.
notes: Huge success for a harmless comic film supported by a single gimmick. The film had a sequel.

title: Weekend at Bernie's II
actors: Andrew McCarthy, Jonathan Silverman, Terry Kiser
description: It starts from Bernie, the dead man of the first episode who is revived thanks to a voodoo rite so that he can show where he has hidden all the money he stole. Larry and Richard, the two who had had their work cut out for the previous weekend, were fired; they decide to take advantage of the opportunity, among scammers, mafia and safety deposit boxes in the Virgin Islands.
notes: The sequel to "Weekend with the Dead" guarantees a minimum of fun for all those who have not already tired of the initial pretext, which is undoubtedly a bit weak.

title: Losin' It
actors: Tom Cruise, Jackie Earle Haley, John Stockwell, Shelley Long, John P. Navin jr., Henry Darrow
description: Aboard a flamboyant Chevy convertible, Dave, Wendell, Woody, Spider and Perlman leave for Tijuana. On the way they pick up Kathy, who goes to Mexico to get a quick divorce. At their destination, the group looks for easy emotions and finds serious trouble. To cross the border safely again, the six will need a lot of skill and luck.
notes: Yet another initiatory and "passing" American fable, where the teenage protagonists lose their virginity and at the same time discover the banality of reality behind the mythical Mexican cross-border. Not original idea and characters, Tom Cruise repeats the character of "Risky Business" for the worse.

title: Welcome to L. A.
actors: Keith Carradine, Harvey Keitel, Sally Kellerman, Geraldine Chaplin, Lauren Hutton, Sissy Spacek, Viveca Lindfors
description: A young musician who rebels against his rich father's lifestyle returns home after spending three years abroad. A group of women soon moved around him, more or less interested in the family heritage, but also dissatisfied with their love life and consequently quite available. The boy, who indulges himself in moderation, soon falls in love with his father's lover.
notes: Choral film, amused, very well interpreted, which marks the debut of Alan Rudolph, even if it looks like a film by Altman (who is the producer).

title: West and Soda
description: In the Wild West a very bad landowner wants to take possession of the only fertile land in the valley, owned by the young Clementina, indomitable and combative girl, but without friends. To protect her, Johnny arrives, an initially rather apathetic cowboy, but at the right moment he goes wild.
notes: A classic of Italian animated cinema directed by veteran Bruno Bozzetto. From the anthology the scene of the final duel is modeled on the famous one of "Mezzogiorno di fuoco" and ironically parody towards the endless analogous sequences of Sergio Leone. The sound counterpoint is also not to be neglected.

title: West Side Story
actors: Natalie Wood, Richard Beymer, Russ Tamblyn, Rita Moreno, George Chakiris, Simon Oakland, Ned Glass, William Bramley, Tucker Smith, Tony Mordente, David Winters, Elliot Feld, Bert Michaels
description: In the West Side of New York, the jets, white, and the Sharks, Puerto Richals face. A situation of normal metropolitan rivalry. The situation rushes when Mary, Puerto Richam and Tony, former leader of jets, fall in love. In an relentless succession of extreme gestures there will be three to die, including Bernardo, brother of Mary, and Tony himself.
notes: Based on the successful musical comedy inspired by "Romeo and Giulietta", Wise's film keeps the music of Bernstein and the corographs of Jerome Robbins. While suffering from some discontinuity between the most dramatic moments and love scenes (a little faded), it still remains a classic. Ten Oscars: Film, direction, photography, actor and asset actress (Chakris and Moreno), costumes, scenography, assembly, soundtrack and a special premium for choreography.

title: Il West ti va stretto, amico... è arrivato Alleluja
actors: George Hilton, Agata Flori, Raymond Bussières, Umberto D'Orsi
description: The gunslinger Alleluja agrees, for a fair fee, to provide the revolutionary leader Ramirez with an Aztec idol, known by all as "El Niño". Possession of the precious statue would guarantee the insurgent the support of the Indians against Maximilian and his general Miranda.
notes: A humorous humorous western.

title: Who?
actors: Elliott Gould, Trevor Howard, Ed Grover, James Noble, John Lehne
description: Lucas Martin, an American atomic physicist, is captured and "recomposed" by the Russians after a car accident on the border between the two Germanys. A bit of a man and a bit of a robot, he is pressed on the very secret "Neptune" project but does not speak; released, his compatriots struggle to believe his identity.
notes: The British Jack Gold ("The Touch of the Medusa") signs, between espionage and science fiction, a psychological drama with a tragic and "protestatory" ending.

title: Wichita
actors: Joel McCrea, Vera Miles, Lloyd Bridges, Wallace Ford, Peter Graves
description: Recently sheriff of Wichita, a rich but turbulent town, John clashes with the powerful who control its economy. The trouble is that he falls in love with the daughter of one of them.
notes: Jacque Tourneur, a director more at ease with noir atmospheres, creates a tense, non-trivial western, enriched by the presence of actors of the first magnitude. Lloyd Bridges is Jeff's father.

title: Willow
actors: Warwick Davis, Val Kilmer, Jean Marsh, Joanne Whalley
description: To escape a dire prophecy, the wicked Queen Bavmorda sends her emissaries to kill the newborn Elora Danan. Naturally, the child is rescued from death with a ruse: placed in a basket, she is left to go by the current of a river. It is picked up by a young farmer, Willow, of a peaceful breed of dwarf farmers who later works to get her rights back.
notes: Based on a subject by Lucas, the film is an adventurous fantasy classic with the unusual presence of a real dwarf in the lead role, played in a convincing way.

title: Xanadu
actors: Olivia Newton-John, Gene Kelly, Michael Beck, Sandahl Bergman, Marilyn Tokuda
description: One of the nine Muses descends to Earth with the name of Kira and a pair of roller skates on her feet. Here he meets Sonny, an uninspired designer with his head in the clouds, who tries to change his life. Kira, Sonny and a disarmed former clarinet player try to set up a dance club. When Kira, for Sonny's sake, renounces immortality, she becomes the star of the club that will be called "Xanadu".
notes: An incredibly failed musical despite the beautiful cast names. Animated sequence created by Don Bluth.

title: Yaaba
actors: Fatimata Sanga, Noufou Ouedraogo, Rokietou Barry
description: In a village in Burkina Faso, young Bila is the only one who does not consider old Sana a witch. Indeed to call her grandmother (yaaba). When a child falls ill and risks dying, the only one to find the right remedy is the old woman who thus wins the gratitude of the entire community.
notes: Ouedraogo is a young but already established director of African cinema, author of authentic masterpieces. This is a mild fairy tale, enjoyable all over the world but with precise cultural roots.

title: Red Sonja
actors: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Brigitte Nielsen, Sandahl Bergman, Paul Smith
description: Sonja is the last survivor of a royal lineage exterminated by the evil Queen Gedren who extended her domain with iron and fire and thanks to the magical virtues of a green stone. Sonja is joined by Yado, a strong warrior, and a young boy, also ousted, cared for by a masochist squire, Falcon. The four, after various vicissitudes, arrive at the heart of the enemy stronghold and, after epic duels, definitively defeat their opponents.
notes: Variant on the theme of "Conan", the film mixes the canonical ingredients of fantasy with an epic-muscular background without excessive flashes of fantasy, but also without overdoing it.

title: Yanks
actors: Richard Gere, Lisa Eichhorn, Vanessa Redgrave
description: Between 1943 and 1944, England was filled with American soldiers. The great Normandy landings are being prepared. In a small town, the arrival of soldiers from overseas soon gives rise to some sentimental bonds that intertwine and sometimes clash with existing situations. For at least three of these couples, the bonds are much deeper than mere sentimental escapades. And perhaps, for one of them, there will also be a future.
notes: On the basis of a well-constructed script, Schlesinger gives us a picture of everyday English life in the war years and of the contradictory relations between the "natives" and the American soldiers, focusing on an excellent reconstruction of the environment and a very fine work of actors . Great sentimental and "civil" tension.

title: Yes, Giorgio!
actors: Luciano Pavarotti, Eddie Albert, Kathryn Harrold
description: Giorgio Fini (Pavarotti) is an internationally renowned tenor but is full of fears and insecurities. Among other things, he is terrified of facing the Metropolitan, the most famous American theater. A beautiful doctor falls in love with him and heals him from phobias. When Giorgio finally performs the Turandot at the Metropolitan, the woman goes away in silence: in fact Giorgio is married and she does not want to disturb his new balance. Pavarotti's singing skills are remarkable, his recitative skills are very inferior.

title: Yvonne la nuit
actors: Totò, Olga Villi, Eduardo De Filippo, Gino Cervi, Frank Latimore
description: Carlo, a young man from a good family, loses his head for a café-chantant singer. Then he leaves for the Great War and loses his skin, while she becomes pregnant and gives birth to a baby. Carlo's father, however, makes the child disappear and makes his mother believe that he is dead. Only after many years, Yvonne, whose career has meanwhile suffered an unstoppable decline, discovers the deception.
notes: A melancholy Totò in a dramatic film: it is one of the first times that the "mask" of the prince of laughter is used on the screen in a wider range than the conventional one. The few similar episodes will be more significant.

title: A View to a Kill
actors: Roger Moore, Tanya Roberts, Grace Jones, Christopher Walken
description: The tycoon Max Zorin wants to cause an earthquake that destroys Silicon Valley to hold a monopoly on the world production of microchips and thus impose his own market laws. James Bond manages to mess up the criminal's plans. With the help, of course, of beautiful women and with the blessing, for once, even of the KGB.
notes: Last 007 of the Roger Moore era, with the actor a little tired and too often (visibly) replaced by stunts. Super-tech comic book pack, featuring an Aryan villain excellently played by Walken, a dazzling virago like Grace Jones and one of the most negligible Bond Girls in the entire series, Tanya Roberts. Nice ending on the San Francisco bridge and the chase up and down the Eiffel Tower.

title: Licence to Kill
actors: Timothy Dalton, Carey Lowell, Robert Davi, Talisa Soto
description: A prominent drug trafficker had the wife of a friend of Bond's rape. Her husband was also seriously injured. Bond decides to act on his own, given that his license to kill has been taken away and that the case belongs to the CIA. In his enterprise, our hero is helped by the boss's young lover, now out of love, and by the beautiful and courageous Pam, a secret agent.
notes: There's a lot of underwater footage in the first part and a classic, predictable chase in the finale. Even James Bond is no longer what he used to be and in fact, for the second time, he has the face of Timothy Dalton. Sean Connery was something else.

title: 08/15 - In der Heimat
actors: O. E. Hasse, Hans Friedrich, Stig Roland, Mario Adorf, Peter Carsten
description: The war is coming to an end and the defeat for the Germans is now evident. According to Lieutenant Ash, the soldiers could go home, but two shady SS figures are opposed. They deceive themselves into a suicide attack on the Americans and then run away. Ash chases them and catches up with them. The execution of one of them overlaps with the arrival of the allies, with further complications. Episode of a series of semi-serious films, very lucky at home.

title: Sapphire
actors: Nigel Patrick, Yvonne Mitchell, Paul Massie, Bernard Miles
description: A mixed-race girl goes missing and is found dead. Investigations reveal that he led a double life. David, her boyfriend, who pleads innocent, is blamed for the murder. After several searches, Scotland Yard will be able to discover that ...
notes: Good detective film directed by Basil Dearden in 1959, along the line of "denunciation" detective stories that characterized part of British cinema of those years. The theme of racism is likely to take his hand, but the director manages to control the intrigue and the black atmosphere.

title: Zanna Bianca alla riscossa
actors: Henry Silva, Maurizio Merli, Renzo Palmer, Gisela Hahn
description: Burt Alloway, called by White Fang, travels to the Klondike region on the trail of the assassins of his friend, the gold digger Benjamin Dover. Once here Burt has to contend with the bandits, the police and Benjamin's son, Kim to whom Burt must be the father. It will only be thanks to White Fang's help if Burt can get away with it.
notes: Variation on the character of Jack London, is a kind of sequel to Fulci's film. But we do not go beyond the stereotype and the banal characterization: a routine work.

title: Zanna Bianca e il cacciatore solitario
actors: Robert Woods, Pedro Sanchez, Malisa Longo, Franco Lantieri, Linda Sini, Massimo De Cecco, Robert Hundar
description: Two trappers, Daniel and Dollar, with their dog White Fang line up in defense of a young widow and her land, against the abuses of an unscrupulous speculator. Having recovered the documents of the murdered husband, the two manage to frame the bad news.
notes: Attempt (unsuccessful) of self-sufficient realization at Disney.

title: Old Yeller
actors: Dorothy McGuire, Fess Parker, Tommy Kirk, Kevin Corcoran
description: Trevis is a little boy who lives in the countryside with his family and little brother Erlys. When Erlys finds a large dog and takes it home, Trevis is not thrilled, but quickly changes his mind when Yellow Fang saves Erlys from a bear attack. The two become inseparable to the point that even the owner of the dog, who one day shows up, doesn't have the heart to take him away and leaves him on the farm with the boys. When the dog becomes infected with rabies, the little boy will be forced to make a painful decision.
notes: At the beginning of his long and successful engagement with Disney (culminating in the direction of "Mary Poppins"), Stevenson signs this well-acted film, with a careful setting, in which the adventurous component blends with the subtlety of the notations.

title: Zapped
actors: Scott Baio, Willie Aames, Felice Schachter, Scatman Crothers
description: Barney and Peyton are two friends who attend the same college. One is all school and laboratory (he is a great lover of botany), the other is mainly dedicated to hunting skirts. One day Barney discovers a strange substance that gives him telekinetic powers, with which among other things he literally strips college girls.
notes: Coming from "Happy Days", Baio's clean face wanders mischievously in a college-movie of candid guardianship, supported by a single gimmick.

title: Ice Palace
actors: Richard Burton, Robert Ryan, Carolyn Jones
description: Zeb and Thor love the same girl, but neither marries her. Zeb marries a rich young lady, Thor instead with an Eskimo with the result that their respective children fall in love with each other and get married.
