Richard Burton and Robert Ryan could not even be seen in private life and this gave a particular touch of realism to the film, but it was not enough to save him from boredom.

title: Zazà
actors: Isa Miranda, Antonio Centa, Aldo Silvani, Ada Dondini
description: During a trip a Parisian engineer (Centa) meets the singer Zazà (Miranda) and falls in love with her. Spend passionate hours with her, then return to Paris. Driven by the impulse of love, Zazà goes to his house, but she is pleasantly surprised to find him married and the father of a child. The singer disappears and when the man, really in love, offers her a new life together, Zazà refuses.
notes: The second work by a still young Castellani, the film is proof of the narrative elegance that the director masters, without the story suffering from excessive aestheticism. Isa Miranda ennobles a conventional role with class. From the comedy, brought to the screen several times, by Berton and Simon.

title: Zelig
actors: Woody Allen, Mia Farrow, John Buckwalter
description: The peculiarity of the New Yorker Leonard Zelig is that of knowing how to transform his appearance and his personality according to the interlocutors he has in front of him. In this way he manages to "adapt" to the proximity of people of any social category and function: a chameleon man. Curated by Dr. Fletcher, he rediscovers his true identity and becomes the symbol of American democracy.
notes: Allen works on manipulated repertoire material and superbly "falsified" fictional material, with the complicity of true intellectuals such as Susan Sontag, Bruno Bettelheim, Saul Bellow. The result is a parable about man-mass, and yet another brilliant portrait of schlemil, a little Jew looking for his place in the world.

title: Tatie Danielle
actors: Tsilla Chelton, Catherine Jacob, Isabelle Nanty, Neige Dolsky
description: Aunt Angelina (Tsilla Chelton), terrible in her eighties, moves into her grandchildren's house in Paris after causing the death of a mild-mannered maid, her age, whom she treated very badly. In the new family the old woman continues to make all the colors and only a girl hired to take care of her during a grandchildren's vacation will be able to tame her. An unexpected friendship is born.
notes: After the satire on the bourgeoisie with his first film, "Life is a long quiet river", Chatiliez annihilates all the "pietas" towards the elderly. Is it just a fierce game, or, albeit in a paradoxical form, does it denounce it as an authentic malaise? Great Chelton.

title: Ziegfeld Follies
actors: Fred Astaire, Gene Kelly, Cyd Charisse, Lucille Ball, Judy Garland
description: Florenz Ziegfeld, the great musical producer, is dead. But also in Paradiso he obtained permission to stage a series of musical numbers with the greatest performers of the genre.
notes: Fred Astaire appears in four of the fourteen episodes; in his company we find Cyd Charisse, Lucille Ball and also Gene Kelly. Solo instead Red Skelton, Judy Garland and Esther Williams. Not all episodes are at the same level, but Minnelli coordinates some of them from the anthology.

title: Ziggy Stardust and the Spiders from Mars
actors: David Bowie, Mick Ronson, Trevor Bolder, Mick Woodmansy
description: The film, shot in 1973 and appeared only ten years later for a series of productive woes, shows David Bowie in concert in London as his androgynous alter ego Ziggy Stardust.
notes: A treat for Bowie fans, a spectacular master of sexual ambiguity here in the middle of the "glam-rock" phase. Directed by a documentary mastreo.

title: Le gitan
actors: Alain Delon, Annie Girardot, Marcel Bozzuffi, Paul Meurisse, Renato Salvatori, Maurice Barrier, Michel Fortin, Bernard Giraudeau
description: For more than two years, Hugo Sennart, "the Gypsy", leader of a gang of robbers in league with Jo and Jacques, his escape companions, has kept Commissioner Blot and the police in check. Novello Robin Hood, decides to take revenge for the injustices committed against his people by donating the fruit of his robberies to nomads ...
notes: Director, writer, screenwriter, playwright: José Giovanni is undoubtedly an author to be rediscovered. This is not his masterpiece (of a very different level _Due against the city_), but the story is fascinating and above all Alain Delon gives the character a great sense of mystery.

title: Lo zio indegno
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Giancarlo Giannini, Andréa Ferréol, Stefania Sandrelli, Beatrice Palme, Simona Cavallari
description: The old uncle Luca, poetic, libertine and braggart who has suddenly reappeared, leaves his mark on the orderly and ordinary life of the wealthy Riccardo. Rather tired grotesque comedy, sewn on old Gassman's gigionism.

title: Dyadya Vanya
actors: Innokentj Smoktunovskij, Irina Kupcenko, Sergey Bondarchuk
description: Uncle Vanya and young Sonja sacrificed themselves for years to allow a scientist, to whom they are linked by hidden affections, to live in the city to carry out his research. But when he arrives at their dacha he shows all his ingratitude and his ambitions. The two benefactors resign themselves and will continue to sacrifice themselves for him.
notes: A very bitter portrait of Russian society, faithful to Chekhov's drama from which it is based. The direction emphasizes the decadent aspects of the relationship, showing through individual defeats the situation of a country that is immobile, ignorant and prey to impotence. Bravo Smoktunovskij as the protagonist.

title: Zombi 2
actors: Tisa Farrow, Ian McCulloch, Richard Johnson, Olga Karlatos
description: A journalist and the daughter of a scientist discover that an island in the Antilles is haunted by the undead. Together with the scientist who is trying to study the phenomenon, the two protagonists are besieged by zombies and only miraculously find a way out. But back in New York a nasty surprise awaits them.
notes: Despite the aura of cult movie, this "Zombie 2" does not live up to other titles such as "The afterlife" and "Fear in the city of the living dead". The special effects of Giannetto De Rossi are excellent and the sequence of the fight between the zombie and the shark is spectacular.

title: Zombi 3
actors: Deran Sarafian, Beatrice Ring, Alex McBride, Richard Raymond
description: Terrorist steals the vial with a mysterious virus created for biological warfare, and ends up infected. It is the beginning of an epidemic that turns people into cannibal zombies. The trip of a group of young people is thus shipwrecked in horror, not only by the threat of monsters, but also by the military who have the order to exterminate anyone who moves in the contaminated area. Horror filmed without care by Fulci, is one of his least interesting.

title: Dead Men Don't Die
actors: Elliott Gould, Melissa Anderson, Mark Moses
description: The anchorman of a successful TV show is murdered by some drug traffickers, but returns in front of the cameras thanks to a voodoo ritual.
notes: The zombie is Elliott Gould and, of course, he doesn't scare anyone. The film is a TV production.

title: Zoo
actors: Asia Argento, Marco Maria Parente, Daniel Olbrychski, Louis Ducreux
description: Martina lives alone with her father who is the keeper of the zoo and dreams of being able to free all the animals. One day he discovers a wild boy in the zoo who is hiding from everyone after escaping the tyranny of the gypsy who had kidnapped him. The two boys run away together on the back of an elephant.
notes: Cristina Comencini, daughter of art, has dedicated a fairytale film to the little ones that interprets their dreams with tenderness. The vein is fragile but the emotion is sincere in the description of the small sensations of the very young. Good protagonist, Asia Argento, another daughter of art.

title: Alexis Zorba
actors: Anthony Quinn, Alan Bates, Irene Papas, Lila Kedrova, George Foundas
description: Basil, an English writer, goes to Crete where he inherited a disused mine. He makes friends with Zorba, a Greek with a thousand professions. Arriving on the spot, Zorba binds himself to Hortensia, a former French dancer, while Basil is attracted to a young widow whom local males also aspire to. The attempt to restart the mine ends in failure, while the two love stories end in drama. But Zorba's vitality is enthralling and inexhaustible.
notes: The film was crafty and bogus, but it became a cult movie. Thanks to the music of Theodorakis and an apt "tragic" staging for tourist use. Oscar to Lila Kedrova (supporting actress) and to the splendid photography of Walter Lassally.

title: Zorro
actors: Alain Delon, Stanley Baker, Ottavia Piccolo, Enzo Cerusico, Moustache, Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Adriana Asti
description: Diego de la Vega assumes the identity of a killed friend and becomes governor of a province, showing himself unable to better deceive a ferocious colonel, commander of the military garrison. The young man, however, has a secret identity: in the role of Zorro he is on the side of the people and helps them to defend themselves from the abuses of the soldiers and to rebel.
notes: The eventful adventures of the famous masked executioner in a well thought out version interpreted by Alain Delon, no longer set in California, but in South America.

title: Zorro alla corte d'Inghilterra
actors: Spyros Focas, Spartaco Conversi, Dada Gallotti, Mirella Pamphili
description: Sir Basil Rutherford, governor of Hamilton Island, in Bermuda, tyrannizes his subjects, depriving them of their possessions and barely suppressing any attempt at rebellion. The only one trying to fight him is Zorro, who hides under the identity of a quiet landowner, apparently committed not to challenge the authority of Sir Basil. Saved a man from hanging, Zorro entrusts him with the task of traveling to England and revealing the truth about the situation on the island to Queen Victoria.
notes: Cheeky adventure of the masked hero.

title: Zorro il dominatore
actors: Charles Quiney, Maria Pia Conte, Aldo Bufi Landi, José Jaspe
description: Antonio Sandoval, having finished his studies, returns to his native town. Because the head of the garrison, Colonel Cordoba, unbeknownst to the governor, subjects the defenseless citizenry to harassment of all kinds. Antonio decides to straighten things out by becoming Zorro. Low-cost Italo-Iberian Zorro, with faces of well-known character actors.

title: Zorro il ribelle
actors: Renato Rossini, Dina De Santis, Howard Ross, Arturo Dominici
description: In a small town on the border of Texas, Zorro (Ross) fights alongside the rebels against the tyrannical governor Alvarez (Dominici).
notes: Tired attempt "made in Italy" to revive, in the era of western spaghetti, the masked hero defender of freedom against the Spanish oppressor. Howard Ross is actually called Renato Rossini.

title: Zorro the Gay Blades
actors: George Hamilton, Lauren Hutton, Brenda Vaccaro
description: The famous Zorro had two children, one of whom is gay.
notes: It is a pleasant but weak farce and tainted by clichés.

title: Zucchero, miele e peperoncino
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Lino Banfi, Pippo Franco, Edwige Fenech
description: Three episodes. In the first, the good Lino Banfi is mistaken for a ferocious murderer, and ends up in the hands of a journalist on the hunt for a scoop, with easily imaginable consequences. Then there is Pippo Franco, unemployed, who finds work as a "waitress", becomes the mistress of the hostess and is discovered by her husband, a manesco butcher. Finally, Renato Pozzetto is a quiet taxi driver who dotes on his new car.
notes: Terno dry at the box office of the time, a joke film served up under the pretext of the comedy "of manners".

title: Zum zum zum. La canzone che mi passa per la testa
actors: Little Tony, Isabella Savona, Peppino De Filippo, Walter Brugiolo, Enzo Cannavale, Nino Terzo, Vittorio Congia, Enzo Guarini, Elvira Tonelli, Enrico Montesano, Mario Meniconi, Paolo Panelli, Orietta Berti, Pippo Baudo, Bruno Canfora
description: Tony and Rosalia, neighbors in a southern village, love each other with a simple but sincere love. However, they are hindered by their respective families, especially by her father who would prefer the son of the landlady as son-in-law. Tony then, to force the situation, and with the complicity of his mother, "kidnaps" Rosalia.
notes: The film is a more than modest work that, taking advantage of the catchy tune in vogue in those years, is a pure pretext for Little Tony's singing performances. The Roman singer for his part visibly remembers Elvis Presley, an actor himself in numerous singing films.

title: Zum zum zum n. 2 - Sarà capitato anche a voi
actors: Little Tony, Isabella Savona, Pippo Baudo, Orietta Berti, Walter Brugiolo, Peppino De Filippo, Dolores Palumbo, Enzo Cannavale, Nino Terzo, Enzo Guarini, Carlo Delle Piane, Lino Banfi
description: Tony is engaged to Rosalia, but one day he meets Valeria, a beautiful airplane pilot. Rosalia is a traditional girl, Valeria goes to the rich and goes shopping on Carnaby Street. A disappointed lover of Valeria accuses her rival of theft. Tony escapes and has the real culprit arrested. Then he decides to leave Valeria's company and return with Rosalia.
notes: Little Tony sings some of his biggest hits, but the golden age of songs is long gone. Only the incredible glimpse of "swinging London" seen by Italian eyes is memorable.

title: Amore vuol dir gelosia
actors: Enrico Montesano, Barbara Bouchet, Gino Santercole, Pino Ferrara, Milena Vukotic
description: Gian Galeazzo is a dentist in Procida and bears less and less the social conventions to which he is subjected by his bigoted wife and her family. He then decides to look for a mistress and finds her in Corinna, a beautiful northerner married to a policeman who in turn betrays her. Adultery fails at first, but surprisingly the same relatives of the woman will help Gian Galeazzo in his escapades. Erotic-family comedy, with a pale attempt at social satire and costume, which wastes the brilliant talents of Enrico Montesano. The blonde Barbara Bouchet at the time was, like Edwige Fenech, a permanent presence in this genre of films.

title: Les bas fond
actors: Louis Jouvet, Jean Gabin, Suzy Prim, Vladimir Sokoloff, Junie Astor
description: The love story between the pickpocket Pepel and the daughter of the violent owner of the squalid hotel in which they live. Intense cinematic version of the drama "The poor hotel" by Maksim Gorki. Dark atmospheres, great performers, co-screenwriter the writer Evgenij Zamyatin.

title: O meu caso
actors: Bulle Ogier, Luis Miguel Cintra, Axel Bougousslavsky
description: On the stage of a theater, as soon as the curtain is raised, a person is installed, an intruder who begins to expose his personal "case" to the public which, according to him, is essential for the salvation of the world. The hall staff try to chase him away: the expected show will not be staged. Saraband with variations on the themes of creation and man: a de Oliveira in splendid shape.

title: Badman's Country
actors: George Montgomery, Buster Crabbe
description: To fight Butch Cassidy, Sheriff Pat Garret enlists the help of colleagues Wyatt Earp and Bat Masterson, and Buffalo Bill. The famous names of the western are all there. But the western is modest and a bit confusing.

title: Bandido
actors: Robert Mitchum, Ursula Thiess, Zachary Scott, Gilbert Roland
description: Three US citizens in the turbulent Mexico of Pancho Villa's revolution. Two of them are an arms dealer and his wife, but their marriage is on the brink of crisis; the third is the one who at the conclusion of the adventurous affair will pair up with the lady, who in the meantime has passed to the status of widow. But before that happens, a lot of things will happen: battles, captures, death sentences and escapes. The film uses the geographical and historical setting simply as a frame, and the rest is entirely second-hand. The interpretation of the actors is also affected by the commercial nature of the production.

title: Bright Leaf
actors: Gary Cooper, Lauren Bacall, Patricia Neal, Jack Carson, Jeff Corey
description: Major Singleton, a wealthy owner of a company that makes cigars in Kingsbury, has Brant Royle, who had dared to kiss his daughter Margaret, kick out of the country. After a few years Brant returns to collect money from an inheritance. Engineer Barton offers him a design for a cigarette making machine, which Singleton has rejected. Brant realizes the importance of the project and asks for help from Sonia, a former lover.

title: The Sun Comes Up
actors: Jeanette MacDonald, Lloyd Nolan, Claude Jarman jr
description: The famous singer Elena Winter interrupted her career for ten years following the death of her husband. When he takes her back, his only son is the victim of a car accident. Distraught, the woman retires to the solitude of a small house in the mountains with the faithful dog Lassie, and becomes attached to an orphan.
notes: A traditional and melodramatic story that adds misfortune to misfortune and that, as if that were not enough, uses all possible tricks in an attempt to move. It was the last film and sadly quite anonymous, starring Jeanette MacDonald.

title: Buonanotte... avvocato!
actors: Alberto Sordi, Giulietta Masina, Mara Berni, Andrea Checchi, Tina Pica
description: A married lawyer, temporarily alone, finds himself in the house a beautiful lady who has run away from her jealous husband. The lawyer thinks he can take advantage of the situation, but it goes wrong. Furthermore, when the woman leaves, the professional discovers that he lacks money. The lawyer traces her down and badly asks her to return the sum. She, I think he is a blackmailer, accepts; However, he discovers the mistake when, upon his wife's return, he discovers that the money had been taken from her ... Between chases, here pro quo and embarrassing explanations we arrive at the end that ...
notes: Among the screenwriters of the film, inspired by an old film from Matarazzo, there is also a very young Ettore Scola. The gallery of specks and intrigue are average for the comedy of the time.

title: Hellzapoppin'
actors: Ole Olsen, Chic Johnson, Martha Raye, Hugh Herbert, Jane Frazee
description: A director describes the show he intends to stage and his words embody the numbers in the program, but then an operator error creates havoc in the film. The two young lovers, Jeff and Kitty, are also involved. Here is a cult, absolutely impossible to label and imitate, which the passage of time continually embellishes. THE father of all idiotic and metacinematographic films, based on a Broadway musical.

title: The Beastmaster
actors: Marc Singer, Tanya Roberts, Rip Torn, John Amos, Rod Loomis
description: The valiant warrior Kaan sets out on the trail of the villains who have destroyed his village, assisted by an eagle, two ferrets and a black panther. Fantasy for Don Coscarelli after two horror stories.

title: Ossessione
actors: Massimo Girotti, Clara Calamai, Juan De Landa, Dhia Cristiani
description: Gino happens by chance in the Bragana shop and falls in love with his wife Giovanna. She wants to get rid of her husband. They organize a fake car accident, but the ending will be different. Dazzling debut of Visconti in full fascism. It is the culmination of a reflection on realism that began on the pages of the magazine "Cinema", and has behind it French poetic realism (Visconti had been Renoir's assistant) and American social realism (the film is inspired by "Il postino always plays twice "by James Cain). Two stars of the time used in a context of raw realism, an absolutely innovative use of natural sets (the Po delta). The film was banned by fascism and was released in a mutilated version.

title: Les favoris de la Lune
actors: Pascal Aubier, Alix de Montaigu, Peter Cloos, Jean-Pierre Beauviala
description: The real protagonists of the film are a portrait of the last century and a precious service by Sèvres. Once stolen, the two objects pass from hand to hand, in a whirlwind carousel of owners. Money never stops; fortunes collapse and are created suddenly; feelings and people are interchangeable, because that's how the world works. Apologue on the power of money and the neurosis of a civilization, awarded with the special jury prize in Venice. Fierce Iosseliani: the poison is hidden in a crystal bottle with delightful shapes.

title: Captain January
actors: Shirley Temple, Guy Kibbee, Buddy Ebsen, Slim Summerville
description: A lighthouse keeper welcomes, after a terrible storm, a little girl who no longer has anyone in the world and keeps her with him. The girl fits in well in that environment of sailors and sea wolves and makes friends with another survivor of a shipwreck: Captain Nazaro. The two grumpy and rude old men are, however, in constant antagonism to get the little girl's friendship.
notes: Anyone who thinks that the "poor" Macaulay Culkin has been sinfully exploited by the star system or that the "poor" Jodie Foster has suffered indelible trauma from having trod the scenes since she was a child, see this little Temple of the good old days. The Dream Factory also makes monsters.

title: The Adjuster
actors: Elias Koteas, Arsinée Khanjian
description: Noha is a claims liquidator who is too interested in the affairs of his policyholders. Hera works in the censorship department, but her behavior is not upright. Bubba is a former football player with identity issues. Such different characters collide due to a film to be made ... Original version with subtitles. First Vision TvEgoyan works as usual on voyeuristic, sexual and family obsessions. Original version with subtitles. First TV viewing

title: Calendar
actors: Arsinée Khanjian, Atom Egoyan, Ashot Adamyan
description: The relationship between a woman and her husband, a photographer, who is making a calendar with illustrations of ancient Armenian churches. The woman falls in love with the guide, and he can only reconstruct the story afterwards, based on the travel videos. The director of Black Comedy between research of ethnic roots and criticism of the family institution, intrusive means of communication and drift of feelings,

title: The Lady Vanishes
actors: Margaret Lockwood, Michael Redgrave, Paul Lukas, Cecil Parker
description: A young Englishwoman meets an elderly lady on a train, on the borders of Germany in the Third Reich, then the lady disappears and no one seems to have ever seen her. Hitchcockian jewel with an espionage background, a paradoxical tour de force solved in ease. Remade in '79 ("The mystery of the missing lady").

title: I miserabili - Caccia all'uomo
actors: Gino Cervi, Valentina Cortese, Giovanni Hinrich, Aldo Nicodemi
description: Jean Valjean (Gino Cervi) stole out of hunger and was imprisoned. Then he tried several times to escape, but was always caught by the policeman Javert. When his attempt is successful, he changes areas and gradually builds a huge fortune by becoming a respectable man. It is the first of two episodes of the film by Riccardo Freda, the Italian master of adventure. One of the best films of the author and the best film adaptation of Hugo's novel.

title: The McMasters
actors: Burl Ives, Brock Peters, David Carradine, Nancy Kwann
description: Benjie, a black soldier enlisted in the Northern Army, returns to the southern town of Ironwood after the Civil War. The old landowner Mc Masters welcomes him as a son and takes him as a partner on his farm. Unfortunately, however, most of the citizens, who sided with the southerners during the conflict, proved hostile towards him and also towards the Mc Masters, who gave him hospitality. Benjie reacts, but things get complicated when he marries a young Red Indian. Robust storytelling and fast pace, with some forcing too much.

title: Sono stato io!
actors: Eduardo De Filippo, Titina De Filippo, Peppino De Filippo, Alida Valli
description: Remained unemployed, the shy and candid Giovannino Apicella is staying with wealthy relatives. When Carlino, the daredevil son of his guests, gets the maid into trouble and refuses to assume her responsibilities, Giovannino generously accuses himself.
notes: Thin film, supported above all by the trio of interpreters Eduardo, Titina and Peppino De Filippo. From a play by Paola Riccora.

title: Le mépris
actors: Brigitte Bardot, Michel Piccoli, Jack Palance, Giorgia Moll, Fritz Lang
description: In Rome, screenwriter Paul Javal is adapting the "Odyssey" for a film by Fritz Lang. Meanwhile, his marital relationship with Camille (Brigitte Bardot) cracks and finally breaks up on the set of the film, in Capri, when she leaves goes with the manufacturer Prokosch.
notes: A splendid tribute to purity, not just of cinema. Famous for Brigitte's nude cut, but even better when the producer, to paraphrase Goebbels, tells Lang: "When I hear about culture, I put my hand to the checkbook." Goebbels put his hand to the gun. The film was distributed in two versions: in France without cuts, in Italy scissored by the producer Carlo Ponti making it incomprehensible. Fortunately, the original version often goes on TV.

title: I miserabili - Tempesta su Parigi
actors: Gino Cervi, Valentina Cortese, Marcello Mastroianni
description: Hunted by Javert, Jean Valjean takes refuge in Paris under a false name. He became rich and could be saved if his adopted daughter Cosetta did not fall in love with Marius, one of the leaders of the insurrection. The riot fails and Valjean rescues Marius from arrest, but he is recognized and killed. Freda's direction is very skilled especially in the exciting battle scenes. Debut film for Mastroianni. Second part of the beautiful Fredian version of "I miserabili" by Hugo.

title: Imputato alzatevi!
actors: Erminio Macario, Leila Guarni, Ernesto Almirante, Greta Gonda, Enzo Biliotti
description: Cyprian, a nurse and handyman in the pediatric clinic of a doctor, his milk brother, is unjustly accused of having committed a murder. But the trial proves his innocence, and Cyprian becomes so popular that he gets a play for a play that tells the true story of the crime. But the culprit is always lurking ...
notes: Macario also brings the fame gained with variety to the cinema. Numerous screenwriters: Giovannino Guareschi, Vittorio Metz, Carlo Manzoni, Marcello Marchesi, Steno, Ruggero Maccari, Federico Fellini (uncredited) ... Excellent Ernesto Almirante in the role of the president of the jury.

title: The Thief Who Came to Dinner
actors: Ryan O'Neal, Jacqueline Bisset, Warren Dates
description: An electronic engineer turns into a thief and even steals the famous Mokinor diamond during an exhibition. Sophisticated comedy on the subject of a young Walter Hill, to be seen only for the grace of Bisset and the sympathy of Clayburgh.

title: Revak the Rebel
actors: Jack Palance, Milly Vitale, Guy Rolfe, Melody O'Brien, Austin Willis
description: Taken hostage by the Carthaginians and reduced to the rank of slave, Revak is forced to harsh humiliations. Kerata, sister of the Carthage governor, falls in love with him. Revak, however, does not abandon his intentions of revenge, causes a slave revolt and manages to escape to Rome, taking away with him also cheate. Film vaguely historical, vaguely spectacular and decidedly dozen.

title: Body and Soul
actors: John Garfield, Lilli Palmer, Hazel Brooks, Anne Revere
description: Charly Davis, boxing's rising star, is persuaded by his manager to lose a match. Then halfway through the match he rebels and wins.
notes: Photographed by a brilliant immigrant, James Wong Howe, and written by a great immigrant (because of McCarthyism), Abraham Polonsky, it is one of the best films ever made about boxing. Oscar for editing.

title: Sophie's Choice
actors: Peter MacNicol, Meryl Streep, Kevin Kline, Rita Karin, Stephen D. Newman
description: Sophie is a Polish immigrant who has undergone the terrible experience of the concentration camp. Nathan is a Jewish intellectual obsessed with the Holocaust. The two try to survive as best they can. They live next to a young writer, Stingo, who over time becomes friends with both of them. Stingo understands that Sophie's troubles began when she let a daughter die in Auschwitz to save her son.
notes: The moral tension is high, even if it is difficult to enter the story (the prologue is too dilated). Meryl Streep, not yet subjected to hysteria by Actor's Studio, is sublime.

title: They Live by Night
actors: Farley Granger, Cathy O'Donnell, Howard Da Silva, Helen Craig
description: Young Bowie escapes with two companions. Together they rob a bank. Later, Bowie is injured in an accident; Keechie, Dub's nephew, one of the other two, takes care of him. Bowie and Keechie fall in love and take refuge in a house on the mountain to get out of the loop. But not everything goes so smoothly. Nick Ray's dazzling debut.

title: Il vostro super agente Flit
actors: Raimondo Vianello, Raffaella Carrà, Fernando Sancho
description: Agent Flit fights against extraterrestrials, saves the world and flirts with the alien Raffaella Carrà. So absurd as to be, for a few minutes, almost funny.

title: Song of Love
actors: Katharine Hepburn, Paul Henreid, Robert Walker, Henry Daniell
description: Hollywood and fictionalized biography of the life and love story of the great composer Robert Schumann and his wife Clara Wieck, and relationships with Brahms and Liszt. Classical music according to Hollywood, with unlikely actors and enjoyable moments. Not recommended for music lovers. The piano performances are by Arthur Rubinstein.

title: S'en fout la mort
actors: Isaach De Bankolé, Alex Descas, Jean-Claude Brialy
description: Two friends, the African Dah and the Martinique Jocelyn, raise fighting cocks and organize evenings for Pierre, owner of a bar-restaurant, but also of several nightclubs.Claire Denis, former assistant of Wenders, is on his second film and insists on patrol of the hybrid (his first film was called Chocolat).

title: S.H.E.
actors: Omar Sharif, Fabio Testi, Cornelia Sharpe, Anita Ekberg
description: Lavinia Kean, under the pseudonym Jessica Blake, is a special mission expert for the American Intelligence Agency. In Rome he deals with an ex-boxer suspected of criminal acts. He will discover that there is an international organization which, under the cover of an Italian nobleman, even threatens the destruction of all the oil existing on Earth. Luckily, she'll take care of it. Screenwriter Richard Maibaum has written many of the James Bond films and here he has done nothing but female the secret agent. The director comes from children's television "spy stories". And it shows.

title: Hustle
actors: Burt Reynolds, Catherine Deneuve, Ben Johnson, Ernest Borgnine, Eddie Albert, Eileen Brennan
description: A girl's lifeless body is found on a Los Angeles beach. The police immediately dismiss the fact as suicide, but this hypothesis does not convince the girl's father, Marty Hollinger, and detective Phil Gaines. The two continue their investigations in the world of drugs and prostitution frequented by the girl and discover that the threads of the crime lead to an unsuspected lawyer. Hollinger finds him and kills him but Phil will manage not to indict the desperate parent. Aldrich himself has stated that he prefers the romance between Burt Reynolds and Cathrine Deneuve (also a prostitute) more than the obvious police investigation.

title: Il nemico
actors: Evi Maltagliati, Paola Borboni, Luigi Pavese
description: Chief Inspector Pietro Stoll is investigating the murder of a servant in a luxurious country villa. Shortly thereafter, the gardener, who was about to reveal everything, is also killed. At that point the inspector finds a microphone connected to a radio transmitter hidden in a piano. Detective debut with an espionage aspect for Guglielmo Giannini, playwright and future founder of the "UOmo whatever" party.

title: Disamistade (Inimicizia)
actors: Joaquim De Almeida, Laura Del Sol, Maria Carta, Massimo Dapporto
description: Sebastiano is a young son of shepherds, quiet and studious. His father is killed and everyone expects him to engage in revenge. He refuses, but the atmosphere of the country ends up involving him, despite everything. Not even love for Domenicangela, a girl similar to him, saves him. He will end up in jail, after various thefts of livestock, also accused of crimes never actually committed. Sardinian drama shot with little means but with a good pace almost like a western. The only one out of place is, unfortunately, Massimo Dapporto.

title: Death Wish 3
actors: Charles Bronson, Deborah Raffin, Ed Lauter, Martin Balsam
description: The executioner / architect Paul Kersey has returned to New York. As soon as he arrives, he is accused of murder. He is then released with a promise to help the police fight a gang of thugs. The result is that he sets a neighborhood on fire, kills the bad guy and leaves for an unknown destination. Nothing changes compared to the previous episodes. There is just an escalation in the quantity of weapons, but that is a minor detail.

title: The Bad News Bears Go to Japan
actors: Tony Curtis, Jackie Earle Haley, Tomisaburo Wakayama
description: A professional gambler finds a way to make some money on the Bears baseball team. Third film dedicated to the adventures of the team of kids. Here is Tony Curtis, but the film is, if possible, weaker than the previous ones.

title: Bianco, rosso e...
actors: Sophia Loren, Adriano Celentano, Fernando Rey, Enzo Cannavale
description: Veiled feeling between a nun and a young patient with communist ideas, hospitalized without need, Latuada ventures to combine Loren-Celentano with poor results. Music by Fred Bongusto, part for the gastronome Maffioli.

title: Il bandito dagli occhi azzurri
actors: Franco Nero, Dalila Di Lazzaro, Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Giovanni Iavarone
description: During the day he is a meek archivist as his mother taught him, poor and lame, but at night, without his wig and brown contact lenses, Renzo Dominici turns out to be a very different type of fabric: athletic and ingenious, he prepares a shot from two billion to the detriment of the Genoese company where he works. And luck assists him: the robbery succeeds and Renzo leaves undisturbed for the South Seas. With a few less simplicity in the narrative solutions and a greater attention to the figure of the protagonist, the film would have been better. Overall it is not bad, written and directed by Alfredo Giannetti, screenwriter of the Railwayman and of Un giorno da leoni.

title: Golgotha
actors: Robert Le Vigan, Jean Gabin, Lucas Gridoux, Edwige Feuillère
description: A reconstruction of the Passion of Jesus Christ as it is told in the Gospels. The film version is faithful to the sacred texts in its essential parts. At the time it passed for a progressive and author's fresco. Today it just looks like a lot of trombone. You absolutely have to see Jean Gabin in the role of Pontius Pilate.

title: Ti conosco, mascherina!
actors: Eduardo De Filippo, Peppino De Filippo, Titina De Filippo, Lidia Baarova
description: A mediocre but charming actress receives the attention of a noble and wealthy gentleman and a pharmacist. The actress's manager, however, has already decided which of the two will be the chosen one and devises a plan to carry out the operation.
notes: We are not much farther than the filmed theater, but the Scarpetta comedy from which the film is based was a classic of the De Filippo repertoire.

title: Ninotchka
actors: Greta Garbo, Melvyn Douglas, Felix Bressart, Sig Ruman
description: Three Russian agents, in Paris to sell jewels for the government, are seduced by Parisian life and the maneuvers of Léo (Douglas), the lawyer who advocates the cause of the former owner of the jewels, requisitioned during the revolution. To put things right, Mosca sends the incorruptible Ninotchka (Garbo) who, after a while, will allow himself to be corrupted by his love for Léon. Memorable movie. "Your five-year plan has interested me for at least ten years," Douglas tells Garbo as soon as they meet. From the anthology the restaurant scene. Douglas tells jokes and the serious Garbo. Douglas falls off his chair and Garbo laughs.

title: Comrades
actors: Robin Soans, William Gammara, Vanessa Redgrave, James Fox
description: In 1830, six farm workers from Dorset formed a kind of union to defend their rights and those of their comrades. Taken to court, they are forced into exile in Australia where they have to undergo the most ferocious humiliating. Based on the true story of the Tolpuddle Martyrs, Douglas's film is a bit too long and his intentions are too overtly didactic. Two faults, however, that are largely bearable.

title: Sotto la croce del Sud
actors: Doris Duranti, Antonio Centa
description: An engineer, engaged in reclamation work in Italian East Africa, grants the management of the shop to a rather equivocal couple. She likes to attract the attention of men, he trades in alcohol. The engineer is also about to fall for it, but he redeems himself. Not too propagandist colonial film, with exciting moments for lovers of the popular exotic (from Salgari to Cino and Franco) and a nice rhythm. The best film by Brignone, modest craftsman.

title: Love Streams
actors: John Cassavetes, Gena Rowlands, Diahnne Abbott, Seymour Cassel
description: Sarah, a divorce behind her and a daughter who has chosen to live with her father, moves to her brother Robert's home. Moreover, he too does not have a quiet life. A writer with a good predisposition to alcohol, Robert also has a rotten marriage and a son he hasn't seen in years. Golden Bear in Berlin in 1984, the film is not the best thing about Cassavetes. But with a cast like this, you are happy to pass over it, and the pain it manifests is rare sincerity.

title: L'air de Paris
actors: Jean Gabin, Arletty, Roland Lesaffre, Folco Lulli, Ave Ninchi
description: Dede, a young worker, arrives in the gym of the old boxer Le Garrec. It's a promise and Le Garrec counts a lot on it. Dedé starts well, but after a while he finds himself having to decide between his sporting career and his love for the young Corinne. A little feuilleton, a song by Montand and Jean Gabin (awarded in Venice): in short, a good ambient film, as solid as the fists of its protagonists.

title: È arrivato mio fratello
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Carin McDonald, Armando Bandini, Pamela Prati
description: The very boring and banal Professor Ovid has a twin brother who, on the contrary, is exuberant and a troublemaker. More banal than that you die and in fact both Pozzetto and Castellano and Pipolo have never recovered.

title: La contessa Castiglione
actors: Doris Duranti, Andrea Checchi, Luigi Allodoli, Alessandra Adari
description: Countess Castiglione on a diplomatic mission to Paris on behalf of her cousin, the Count of Cavour, reunites with an old flame. The countess thus finds herself having to choose between fidelity to the commitment made and the temptation to re-establish the old relationship. In the end, the Reason of State wins. There is neither flesh nor blood in this Calzavara film. In a very short role, the young Gabriele Ferzetti.

title: The Moon and Six Pence
actors: George Sanders, Herbert Marshall, Steve Geray
description: A London stockbroker leaves his wife, children and job to go to Paris to fulfill his life's dream: to paint. Here he manages to get into trouble and then runs away again. He arrives in Tahiti where he will die of leprosy, assisted by an indigenous woman who promises to burn his canvases.
notes: The story is more less that of Gauguin, as Somerset Maughan tells it in the book of the same name. Sanders is absolutely unattainable.

title: A tu per tu
actors: Johnny Dorelli, Paolo Villaggio, Marisa Laurito, Moana Pozzi, Marilda Donà
description: Emanuele Sansoni, a fixer with few scruples, after having managed to escape daringly from a financial control, leaves to retrieve a whole series of compromising documents that he keeps well hidden. In his traffic he involves the taxi driver who accompanies him, the Genoese Gino, who is as good as bread but is haunted by a lot of problems. The latter, however, will manage to have his revenge.
notes: Johnny Dorelli (who also appears here in an "en travesti" version) and Paolo Villaggio (who repeats, with a few variations, his lucky character of the chronic jellato), manage to keep the film, which otherwise would not be much of an originality, on a barely passable level.

title: La battaglia d'Inghilterra
actors: Frederick Stafford, Van Johnson, Francisco Rabal, Luigi Pistilli, Renzo Palmer
description: A group of German saboteurs infiltrates the Allies during the Dunkirk retreat: their aim is to disable the radar system on British soil to allow the bombing of London. Discovering the enemy plan by chance, Captain Stevens must identify the saboteurs, one of whom has even managed to settle in his house.
notes: An endless war film, absolutely conventional, where moments of tension and action make you sigh. Directed and co-written by Castellari, pseudonym of Enzo Girolami.

title: The Great Los Angeles Earthquake
actors: Joanna Kerns, Dan Lauria, Ed Begley jr., Joe Spano
description: The life and worries of a Southern California family, waiting for the "Big One". The daughter is a geologist who is experimenting with a new earthquake prediction system. Her husband, an architect, has differences of opinion with a wealthy real estate developer who is speculating on land, regardless of the high seismic risks in the area. The earthquake arrives, and everyone will have to deal dramatically with it.

title: Angels with Dirty Faces
actors: James Cagney, Pat O'Brian, Humphrey Bogart, Ann Sheridan
description: Rocky Sullivan (James Cagney) is a gangster. He is a friend of Father Connelly (Pat O'Brian) with whom he grew up and with whom he still has a sincere and deep friendship. Sentenced to the electric chair, Rocky agrees, under pressure from the priest, to pretend to be afraid of death, thus debunking, for the use of the neighborhood boys, the myth of the tough and inflexible gangster.
notes: Typical Warner product of the New Deal, a little didactic, but ennobled by the great interpretation of James Cagney and the craft of Curtiz that he manages to move by making the atmosphere of the slums. The Dead End Kids are those of "Road Barred", which Warner used in various other gangster dramas. The ideal sequel was entitled "Angels wash their face".

title: Casque d'or
actors: Simone Signoret, Serge Reggiani, Claude Dauphin, Gaston Modot
description: Raymond, member of a gang of thugs, meets Manda, an old friend of his. Through his friend, Manda meets and falls in love with Maria, a prostitute nicknamed the Golden Helmet. The leader of the gang, Leca, jealous, provokes the clash between Roland, the protector of Maria, and Manda who, in a duel, kills the opponent. Manda ends up on the guillotine after killing Leca too.
notes: A masterpiece by Jacques Becker, it is one of the most beautiful French films of the post-war period, dominated by a sensual air tinged with omens and set in a period underworld that couldn't be more romantic. A song of love and death, with an extraordinary Simone Signoret.

title: Tresure Island
actors: Robert Newton, Bobby Driscoll, Basil Sydney, Walter Fitzgerald, Denis O'Dea
description: Little Jim is in search of treasure on pirate island led by Long John Silver, Disney's version of Stevenson's novel.

title: Block-Heads
actors: Stan Laurel, Oliver Hardy, Billy Gilbert, Patricia Ellis
description: During the Great War Laurel is forgotten in a trench in Europe. He is recovered twenty years later and the former comrade Ollio invites him to his house. Here Stanlio immediately enters a collision course with Ollio's shrewish wife and with all the inhabitants of the condominium. Great catastrophic comedy of the incredible duo.

title: The Duchess and the Dirtwater Fox
actors: George Segal, Goldie Hawn, Conrad Janis
description: Charlie Malloy is a globetrotting cheat who is about to be hanged. Bloodworth saves him, a bandit who forces him, in return, to participate in a robbery. Charlie, however, takes possession of the loot and escapes to a town where he meets Amanda who, in turn, steals his money and escapes. Charlie catches her back and the two get rid of the bandit. Western comedy that borders on farce, with two comedians at full speed.

title: Sur
actors: Miguel Angel Sola, Susu Pecoraro, Philippe Léotard, Lito Cruz
description: One night in Buenos Aires, in the Sur district, at the end of the dictatorship, the protagonist wanders after having spent five years in jail and with the fear that his woman is not very happy to see him again. Luckily, a friend (who died years ago) arrives to keep him company.If you don't like that mix of sentimentality / anger / kidnapping / passion typical of the Solanas films there is nothing to do. For everyone else, even the music (by Piazzolla) is beautiful and tearful.

title: La voce della luna
actors: Roberto Benigni, Paolo Villaggio, Nadia Ottaviani, Angelo Orlando
description: Bassa Padana: the dreamer Ivo Salvini hears the voices from the wells lit by the moon and looks for the ideal woman. He has little adventures with slightly crazy characters, until he meets the former prefect Gonella, who sees conspiracies everywhere. Together they break into a disco, witness the "capture" of the moon on live TV. Only the two of them, out of love or anguish, can "listen" to the silence of the night.
notes: Despite the quiet melancholy of the finale, Fellini's latest film is a desolate comment on the invasive vulgarity of our time, sometimes smiling but often very bitter. Neither Benigni nor Villaggio are "comic" characters. From the novel "Il poema dei lunatici" by Ermanno Cavazzoni.

title: Che ora è
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Massimo Troisi, Anne Parillaud, Lou Castel
description: A wealthy sixty-year-old Roman lawyer spends a day in Civitavecchia in the company of his son Michele who is finishing his military service. Michele, with a closed and unambitious temperament, is annoyed by the intrusiveness of his father who, for his part, is aware that he is almost a stranger to his son, but makes a mistake with him.
notes: Many ideas, some happily resolved, but others decidedly undeveloped, in a film that retains little of the evident ambitions of a complex investigation of a difficult parental and generational relationship. The duet Mastroianni-Troisi, however, works (the two were awarded for the best interpretation in Venice).

title: Crazed
actors: Laszlo Papas, Belle Mitchell, Beverly Ross, T.J. McFadden, Rigg Kennedy
description: A psychopath who is staying in a landlord is seized by an insane obsession with a girl, young and beautiful, and begins to haunt her. A worn story for a little film so sloppy as to be irritating.

title: Mr. Roberts
actors: Henry Fonda, James Cagney, William Powell, Jack Lemmon
description: World War II: On an American freighter in the Pacific, Lieutenant Roberts interprets the intolerance of the crew towards an authoritarian commander. Then the Japanese attack the ship. John Ford's minor film who, ill, was replaced by Mervyn LeRoy.

title: Curly Sue
actors: James Belushi, Kelly Lynch, Alisan Porter, John Getz
description: Curly Sue, a nine-year-old orphan, is placed in the care of Bill Dancer (Belushi), a little con man with a heart of gold. The life that the two lead is quite eventful and slowly the need to find a mother also emerges. The choice falls on Gray Ellison, a successful lawyer with only one handicap: she is engaged to the insufferable Walter McCormick. But not for long. A touch of melò comedy, served by a good cast. Hughes, big money machine as demonstrated by "Mom I missed the plane", tries the way halfway between laughter and the blow of tears in the back. With fair results.

title: Gulag
actors: David Keith, Malcolm McDowell, David Suchet, Warren Clarke
description: A former athletics champion participates as a telecroist at a sports meeting in Moscow. The KGB sets a trap for him, arrests him as a spy and sends him to a labor camp. Exasperated, he organizes a daring escape with three other prisoners. Uneven film, with some good sequences but too long.

title: Il cortile
actors: Eduardo De Filippo, Peppino De Filippo, Marisa Merlini
description: Nando is a thirteen year old thief. Locked up in a reformatory, he flees to the city where a busker believes in the fundamental goodness of his soul and takes him with him. A suspicious landlady risks ruining everything.

title: Tunnel
actors: Helmut Berger, Corinne Cléry, Franco Citti, Marzio Honorato
description: The story of Marco, a life like many of those made feverish and desperate by drugs. A woman, Pina, loves him and is close to him trying in every way to snatch him from his terrible rival, death by overdose.
notes: A busy and demanding story, an attractive cast, which unfortunately escape the director's control. Encouraged by the critic Morando Morandini. According to some fans of Italian cinema it is a cult film, due to the strong scene of Clery's hole in the private parts. In reality it is just a specious mess. Also known as "Heroin".

title: Woodstock
actors: Jimi Hendrix, Joe Cocker, Joan Baez, the Who, Carlos Santana, Janis Joplin, Arlo Guthrie.
description: Pages from the most exceptional concert-event of the rock counterculture of the 1960s: the great three-day gathering that in Bethel, New York, attracted over four thousand young people from all over the world and hundreds of pop, rock and folk singers . Among the protagonists of the music who took turns on stage: Jimi Hendrix, Joe Cocker, Joan Baez, Crosby, Stills, Nash & Young, Carlos Santana and Arlo Guthrie. The images of the singers alternate with interviews collected on the fly between the boys present and among the locals.
notes: A classic of the documentary, preceded by an immense job of collecting the shots. Today it immediately gives the flavor of an era and it is impossible not to get excited. Martin Scorsese, who had made his debut as a director the year before, also put his hand to editing the material shot.

title: Agatha Christie's The Man in the Brown Suit
actors: Rue McClanahan, Tony Randall, Edward Woodward
description: During a quiet trip to the Middle East, an American ends up getting involved in an intricate affair centered around the theft of diamonds and murder. A slightly static TV adaptation from a 1924 novel by Agatha Christie.

title: Sotto il sole di Roma
actors: Oscar Blando, Francesco Golisano, Liliana Mancini, Alberto Sordi
description: Ciro, a Roman teenager son of a security guard, is part of a gang of children. Under the German occupation he makes a living with the black market and goes to prison. Then the Americans arrive, but for him it is as if nothing has changed. He also has a love affair with a married woman. Only the dramatic death of his father, caused by his companions, will make him understand his mistakes and change his life. Shot on natural locations and with non-professional actors, in the middle of the Neorealist period, it is an airy and funny film, almost already "pink".

title: L'attenzione
actors: Ben Cross, Stefania Sandrelli, Amanda Sandrelli, Arnoldo Foà
description: On the plane that brings him back to Rome, a well -known journalist lets himself go to unbridled and a little melodramatic romance -erotic fantasies about his wife (with whom he is in crisis) and on her young daughter. Deadly and unwatchable transposition from Moravia which undeservedly overwhelms the two Sandrelli.

title: House of Evil
actors: Boris Karloff, Julissa, Andrés García
description: Boris Karloff is a crazy composer. His heirs end up killed one by one in his old house, which is teeming with murderous traps, accompanied in the afterlife by ad hoc organ music. Last film for Karloff, it is a terrifying Mexican-American production that would be inspired by Poe.

title: Zapped Again
actors: Todd Eric Andrews, Kelli Williams, Linda Blair, Lyle Alzado
description: There is great excitement in the college science group. A new student has arrived, who has accidentally come to an amazing discovery: a secret potion that allows him to overcome the force of gravity. The various implications of the discovery lead to paradoxical, comic and sometimes risky situations. Follow-up to "Zapped!", With Scott Baio, who was already quite bizarre. For not too demanding palates.

title: Nel continente nero
actors: Diego Abatantuono, Corso Salani, Anna Falchi, Ivo Garrani
description: A young manager, Alessadro Benini, goes to Kenya for the funeral of his father, of whom he had not heard from for twenty years. The man died in a mysterious plane crash; owner of a plantation, he had a partner, Fulvio Colombo, who soon turns out to be the deceased's sole creditor.
notes: Marco Risi tries the strings of dramatic comedy. The environment is that of luxury emigrants, in that of Malindi: businessmen, traffickers, politicians, etc. The intentions, corrosive, are not up to par. Abatantuono is good but he plays a bit too much.

title: Nightmare in the Daylight
actors: Jaclyn Smith, Thomas Mason, Christopher Reeve
description: Peter Lambert, director of education, is in San Francisco with his wife Megan and little son. They meet a certain Sean Farrell, who recognizes Megan as his wife, who disappeared seven years earlier in Mexico during an earthquake. The woman had actually escaped the violence to which her husband subjected her. Now the nightmare resumes, with Sean doing everything to get it back. Desperate, Megan uses the gun ... The topic is topical: family violence. The exhibition, according to the ways of the thriller, transforms it into a spectacularly attractive subject. The usual Hollywood mastery of the medium makes it a typical entertainment film.

title: Dirty Dancing
actors: Patrick Swayze, Jennifer Grey, Cynthia Rhodes, Jerry Orbach
description: Unforgettable 1963 holidays for the Houseman family. In particular for her daughter Baby, who lets herself be attracted by the wild dances that take place in the East Coast hotel where they stay. The queen couple of the evenings is the one formed by Johnny Castle and Penny Johnson, indefatigable dancers. Baby becomes friends with Penny and even finds herself replacing her on the dance floor.
notes: Great success for Emile Ardolino (who died of AIDS), but above all a great launch for Patrick Swayze.

title: Kickboxer
actors: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Dennis Alexio, Rochelle Ashana
description: Kurt, the brother of a kickboxing champion who was paralyzed after a fight, engages in grueling training. Objective: to beat Tong Po, the Thai champion responsible for his brother's infirmity. The company is far from easy and the path fraught with obstacles, but tenacity and determination are superior to any difficulty.
notes: Martial arts film with a protagonist reminiscent of Rocky. The result is complacent and often gratuitous violence. It is the film that launched Van Damme.

title: Winterhawk
actors: Michael Dante, Leif Erikson, Woody Strode
description: Cheyenne Winter Hawk is in charge of procuring medicine to combat smallpox. However, he runs into two criminals who steal his skins and kill some men. To get medicine, Winter Hawk kidnaps a girl and her brother. The pursuers will discover the truth and have second thoughts about which side to fight for. Furthermore, the kidnapped girl is conquered by the deep humanity of Winter Hawk.
notes: It is intended to be a tribute to the Indian race, but the result has been partially disregarded. However, it remains a dignified western, to be reported above all for the excellent sense of the landscape that one breathes.

title: La donna del fiume
actors: Sophia Loren, Rik Battaglia, Gérard Oury, Lise Bourdin, Enrico Olivieri
description: The beautiful and busty Nives, very much courted by the smuggler Gino, surrenders to him during an eventful party. However, the man, having become her lover, mistreats her. Nives, who is expecting a child from him, has him arrested. Two years later Gino escapes and goes to the woman to take revenge. Nives, however, has lost the baby, drowned in a ditch and is watching over him. Gino moved promises to marry her.
notes: Inspired by a certain documentarism and the atmosphere of "Riso amaro", of which it is almost a remake, the film is based on the subject of Moravia and Flaiano, but suffers from a certain opacity of the direction (the project was not by Soldati but by the producer Ponti ). Pier Paolo Pasolini's debut as a screenwriter.

title: The Big Combo
actors: Cornel Wilde, Richard Conte, Brian Donlevy, Jean Wallace
description: Susan, the girlfriend of a well-known mobster, Brown, fed up with the dangerous coexistence with the bandit, attempts suicide. Detective Diamond, who has been stalking the outlaw for some time, saves her hoping for a confession. Diamond thus arrives at the bandit's ex-wife but he has her killed and kidnapped the detective who is tortured but resists. Brown kidnaps Susan but Diamond finds them and kills the mobster. The film is certainly one of the great noirs in the history of cinema. John Alton's stunning photography fully underlines the (sexual) ambiguities and brushes the atmosphere with mystery. Some excellent direction solutions.

title: I due carabinieri
actors: Enrico Montesano, Carlo Verdone, Massimo Boldi, Paola Onofri
description: Marino (Verdone) and Glauco (Montesano), for different reasons, join the Carabinieri. Marino courts Rita, who however prefers the court of Glauco. Marino is transferred to Piedmont but here he finds Glauco again: the two participate in an anti-drug action, after which they succumb to the temptation of a taste of the "dust". They will prove their heroism in rescuing a team of kidnapped scouts.
notes: It is a film that has nothing to do with the usual film-joke about the weapon, indeed: it had the help (men and means) of the carabinieri themselves. Sober and the characters of Verdone (also director) and Montesano, but the only one to make you laugh is Boldi.

title: Heaven Can Wait
actors: Warren Beatty, Julie Christie, James Mason, Jack Warden, Charles Grodin
description: The soul of Joe Pendleton, an American football player, is taken to heaven by an overly hasty angel. In fact, Joe is not dead yet. What's more, he was about to play a very important game. In heaven they make up for it: they assign him the body of a billionaire who is about to be killed by his wife and secretary. Joe accepts, also for the love of a beautiful teacher, but how to find a remedy for the "second" death?
notes: Although homonymous with the one signed by Lubitsch, the film is instead the remake of Alexander Hall's "Elusive Mr. Jordan". Polite, a little bit mannered, but definitely successful.

title: The Last Hour
actors: Michael Paré, Shannon Tweed, Bobby Di Cicco
description: Susan is too ambitious to live long with her husband Jeff Flin who is just an honest cop. Much better to hang out with Eric, a wealthy stockbroker with a dark past. In fact, to get rich Eric had to take out a mafia boss and now, with a new name, he hopes to get away with it. But boss John Lombardi doesn't let himself be scammed, and honest cop Flinn comes in handy again. Anything with Michael Paré can only be disastrous. With his never grown-up baby face he would have a chance, but he would have to learn acting first. Shannon Tweed (Lethal Woman) on the other hand, you can see right away that she doesn't look like a child.

title: Double Suspicion
actors: Gary Busey, Kim Cattrall, Darianne Fluegel
description: Detective Dwight Meadows, retired from physical trouble, is recalled to investigate the misdeeds of the serial killer known as Lakeside Surgeon. Together with Dana, the colleague who is assigned to him, he manages to trap a suspect; Dana kills him, but Dwight doubts that this is Surgeon. Then he discovers that Dana is the sister of one of the victims ...
notes: Variation on the theme that most passionate about the made in USA detective story of recent years. Gary Busey's face recently seems to have regained some chances.

title: Past Midnight
actors: Rutger Hauer, Natasha Richardson, Clancy Brown, Kibibi Monie
description: Ben Jordan is on parole after fifteen years in prison for stabbing his wife to death. Laura, the social worker who follows her case, however, has doubts. Among them, among other things, there is some tender and the girl begins to think that the evidence on the basis of which Ben was convicted is not conclusive. Then he begins to think otherwise and therefore to fear for his life.
notes: When Rutger Hauer is made to be a maniac who may not be a maniac, but perhaps he is, he is perfect. Less well works Eliasberg, a television director who makes his debut here in cinema. Honest, but not memorable. Quentin Tarantino is also among the writers.

title: Jagged Edge
actors: Glenn Close, Jeff Bridges, Peter Coyote, Robert Loggia
description: A very rich woman and her maid were killed. Jack Forrester, her husband, a successful publisher with political ambitions, is charged with the two crimes. Not long before, Jack had tried to destroy the career and reputation of the district attorney, who is now happy to make the man the main suspect. A beautiful lawyer defends him, at first rather reluctant.
notes: As a construction of an intrigue full of surprises, the film works in its "Chinese box" structure. Less convincing is the definition of the characters, except that of the lawyer, to whom Glenn Close gives solidity.

title: The Desperate Hours
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Fredric March, Martha Scott, Arthur Kennedy
description: Three fugitives, Griffin, his brother and the big Kobish, take refuge in Mr. Hilliard's house, holding the entire family (father, mother, daughter Dolly and little son Ralph). Griffin's friend has to bring the money to escape. Time passes and tension grows; Griffin's brother attempts to leave but is intercepted and killed by the police, who then surround the house. Bogart, in the role of the ferocious and desperate criminal, is at the limit; the disease gnaws at him and it shows. This will be his penultimate film. High-level tension, masterfully held by Wyler's directing work. Cimino remake of the same name in 1990.

title: Off Beat
actors: Judge Reinhold, Meg Tilly, Harvey Keitel, Joe Mantegna, John Turturro
description: Joe Gower, a librarian, agrees to substitute cop friend Abe Washington at the audition for the annual police dance. Here, however, Joe falls in love (reciprocated) with the policewoman Rachel Wareham, with whom he ends up making a steady couple. Thus begins a series of lies and misunderstandings, which will have its epilogue when, kidnapped by two bandits in a bank, Joe will become a hero in spite of himself.
notes: A harmless and fairly boring comedy, which vaguely refers to the various "police schools". Especially to taste the "side" cast made up of luxury actors.

title: Blue Steel
actors: Jamie Lee Curtis, Ron Silver, Clancy Brown, Elizabeth Peña, Louise Fletcher, Philip Bosco, Kevin Dunn, Tom Sizemore, Mary Mara
description: New agent Megan Turner kills a robber whose weapon is stolen by a distinguished stockbroker. He feels like a kind of emissary of God and begins to kill, after having engraved the name of Megan on the bullets. Then he does everything to get to know her, and he succeeds, while the woman takes a big crush on him. At this point all that remains is a final showdown, on the streets of the city, between the gunwoman policewoman and her mad admirer.
notes: Kathryn Bigelow focuses on atmospheric work to frame the shifting and disturbing relationship between executioner and victim. Jamie Lee Curtis in uniform is perfect in the role of Megan.

title: The Affair
actors: Jamie Smith Jackson, Natalie Wood, Robert Wagner, Bruce Davison
description: Carol Patterson, 32, polio, has lived since the age of 9 in a kind of grumpy isolation. He composes songs, which he records with the help of his friend Bobby; he is in confidence with his brother and a friend, while he is unable to communicate with his parents. When she meets Mark, a lawyer, she is the great love; after a short period of intense happiness, however, the two realize that it cannot work. Psychological drama of television production that sensitively portrays the vulnerable figure of a young woman. The script lacks a bit of narrative bite, but the interpretation of the two protagonists is adequate and convincing.

title: Desperate Hours
actors: Mickey Rourke, Anthony Hopkins, Kelly Lynch, Mimi Rogers
description: Michael Bosworth escapes with his younger brother, Willy, and Albert, another inmate. Their accomplice is Bosworth's charming lawyer Nancy. The three take refuge in the Cornell family home, where they await Nancy's arrival. During the kidnapping, all the flaws emerge from which the Cornell menage is spoiled. The story ends with the return to order and the newfound family harmony. Always at odds with Hollywood producers, Cimino directed this remake of Wyler's film with Bogart. The operation was successful both in terms of script and direction and interpretation. Great Hopkins and even Rourke is credible.

title: Odd Man Out
actors: F. J. McCormick, James Mason, Robert Newton, Kathleen Ryan, Cyril Cusack, F.G. Fay, William Hartnell, Denis O'Dea
description: Johnny McQueen, an Irish revolutionary, has escaped from prison and now lives in hiding in a friend's house. During a robbery, organized to finance the movement, he almost involuntarily kills a policeman. At that point, wounded and abandoned by everyone, a nocturnal odyssey through the city begins for him. It is not a film based on a Graham Greene novel, but it comes very close. Shot all on location and in the rain, with photography by Robert Krasker, Reed's film is a splendid urban and nocturnal nightmare.

title: The Return to the Blue Lagoon
actors: Milla Jovovich, Brian Krause, Lisa Pelikan, Courtney Phillips, Garette Ratliff Henson
description: A boy and a girl grow up together on a remote island.
notes: Eleven years later, Randal Kleiser tries again, this time as a producer. Different actors (including a 15-year-old Jovovich) and new director, but the soup doesn't change. Topics and scenarios already seen and heard.

title: Come See the Paradise
actors: Dennis Quaid, Tamlyn Tomita, Sab Shimono, Shizuko Hoshi
description: Jack is Irish; in 1930s Los Angeles he works in Little Tokyo. When he marries a girl of Japanese origin, everything is fine until war breaks out. While Jack has to leave for the front, his wife, daughter and all relatives are interned because they are considered potential enemies by the US government. Only after very hard trials, at the end of the war, does Jack find his family again. The intentions of dusting off an unglorious page of recent American history are meritorious, but the film doesn't offer much more. Dennis Quaid works, but the whole is often boring. In Parker's filmography, however, it gets worse.

title: She's Back
actors: Carrie Fisher, Robert Joy
description: Victim of metropolitan violence, she does not agree to remain in the afterlife without making a fuss. Here she is, in fact, who returns thirsty for revenge and turns to her husband to obtain justice. He is a meek guy, but the request is precise: the ferocious killers who killed her must be punished as they deserve. What will our hero do to please the wifey spirit? Premiere Tv The ingredients are those of a horror thriller. But the film focuses on another register, namely that of black comedy. The protagonist is Carrie Fisher, Princess Leia from Star Wars, a good performer in search of an identity. First TV viewing.

title: Basic Instinct
actors: Michael Douglas, Sharon Stone, George Dzundza, Jeanne Tripplehorn, Dorothy Malone, Stephen Tobolowsky
description: Detective Nick investigates a murder committed with an ice pick. The main suspect is a successful writer with particular and scandalous sexual tastes. A twisted and perverse relationship also arises between the two, which gradually becomes complicated due to the presence of Beth, a psychologist from the District linked to Nick. The case must be solved by digging into the past that pathologically links the two women.
notes: Verhoeven is a hard-working director, but this time he lets himself be dominated by the sensationalist script by Joe Eszterhas. The story is as intricate, morbid and tense as the relationships that are established between the characters. But sometimes he thunders into ridicule.

title: The Sting
actors: Paul Newman, Robert Redford, Robert Shaw, Charles Durning
description: Johnny Hooker lost everything he had managed to steal from a criminal organization in the game. He manages to ally himself with Henry Gondorff, superman of the fraud, and with him he concocts a memorable blow against the powerful Lonnegan.
notes: Seven Academy Awards, including Best Picture and Best Director; a soundtrack by Marvin Hamlisch that recovers Scott Joplin's ragtime (another Oscar) among the most famous in the history of cinema; Newman and Redford, already directed by Hill in "Butch Cassidy", are really unleashed: beautiful spectacular machination.

title: Ultrà
actors: Claudio Amendola, Ricky Memphis, Giuppy Izzo, Alessandro Tiberi, Gian Marco Tognazzi
description: Luca, 25 years old, nom de guerre Prince, is the leader of the Romanist ultras. He spent two years in jail, but today he leaves and tomorrow there is Juve-Roma. At night, on the train to Turin, he discovers that his ex-girlfriend and his best friend have gotten together. Upon arrival at the station, there are the first clashes and then the stadium. The game has already begun, but who cares: the battle finally breaks out in the toilets. The crazy microcosm of the stadium thugs is described with energy by Tognazzi, here in his second direction. Claudio Amendola is perfect in the part of the forced.

title: Italia-Germania 4 -3
actors: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Nancy Brilli, Giuseppe Cederna, Massimo Ghini
description: At the 1970 World Cup, the semi-final between the Azzurri and the Germans went down in history (with a decisive goal from Rivera). Twenty years later, three ex-high school mates get together to review the meeting on TV. Fatally, the meeting becomes the occasion for a rather disconsolate assessment of lost illusions, aspirations and betrayed ideals.
notes: From the theatrical work of Umberto Marino, the starting point - certainly not new - of "what we have become" is a bit mechanical and too pleased. Barzini takes advantage of the genre of "generational" films, but he doesn't even have Salvatores' lightness.

title: The Good Mother
actors: Diane Keaton, Liam Neeson, Jason Robards, Ralph Bellamy, Asia Vieira, James Naughton
description: Anna, a young mother separated from her husband, has found in Lou a new partner who often lives with her and Molly, the woman's six-year-old daughter. One day Molly candidly tells her father that she touched the genitals of Lou, who was in the shower. The result is a severe conflict between the spouses and Anna, while refusing to see Lou forever, also loses custody of the child.
notes: The unusual theme (of the child's innocent curiosity and her mother's painful admissions during the resulting judicial proceedings) is treated with a realism that concedes nothing to complacent morbidity. Rhythm and decent actors.

title: Il bambino e il poliziotto
actors: Carlo Verdone, Federico Rizzo (II), Adriana Franceschi, Barbara Cupisti
description: Rosanna Clerici is arrested by the commissioner Carlo Vinciguerra for drug dealing. His son Giulio has no intention of ending up in an institution and the policeman takes him into the house, reorganizing his entire bachelor life according to the boy. Rosanna, however, who risks a long detention, does not like the matter at all, until one day, Giulio is kidnapped. Triumph of good feelings (and molasses in wagons) in a period when Verdone did not know which way to turn. The character is little more than a speck; the photogenic Adriana Franceschi has never seen herself again.

title: Die Büchse der Pandora
actors: Louise Brooks, Fritz Körtner, Franz Lederer, Carl Goetz
description: Lulu, a cabaret actress, is an irresistible attraction for all the men who gravitate around her, and she, amoral and available, gives herself without hesitation and without scruples. She will get to kill one of her lovers, escape from prison, risk being sold to an Egyptian brothel. On a Christmas night in London, she will look for a client and be stabbed to death by Jack the Ripper. Taken from the two plays by Frank Wedekind "The Spirit of the Earth" and "Pandora's Box", it is the triumph of instinct. , candid and demonic, which unmasks the rottenness of bourgeois society. A great text, a great director, a great protagonist.

title: Poison Ivy
actors: Drew Barrymore, Tom Skerritt, Sara Gilbert, Cheryl Ladd, Alan Stock
description: Sylvie, ugly and from a rich family, introduces her schoolmate Ivy to her family. The latter ends up settling in Sylvie's house, surrounding all the inhabitants. After subjugating the head of the family, he causes the death of Sylvie's mother. Finally he tries to bend the latter too, but finally the girl finds the strength to react.
notes: For those who still remember her little girl in "E.T." the surprise is inevitable: Drew Barrymore in the role of the evil and sensual Ivy embodies a character that is not particularly new, but that Katt Shea Ruben manages to outline with a discreet hand. Detail for a very young Leonardo DiCaprio.

title: Homicide
actors: Joe Mantegna, William H. Macy, Natalija Nogulich, Vincent Guastaferro
description: Untangling the ranks of two different cases, Agent Bob Gold uncovers a secret war between two gangs, one pro-Nazi and the other Zionist. A Jew by origin, Bob gets involved and participates in an attack on a neo-Nazi hideout, but then refuses to hand over a list of names to the Zionist group. He is then injured in an attempt to avenge the death of another agent and is eventually disbarred by the police.
notes: An intricate mental labyrinth is constructed by the playwright David Mamet, starting from the terrorist-police idea to arrive at the crisis of ethnic and cultural identity. Deliberately ambiguous and disorienting, the film does not try to recompose the conflicts it causes, but aims to disturb consciences.

title: Delicatessen
actors: Dominique Pinon, Marie-Laure Dougnac, Jean-Claude Dreyfus, Karin Viard, Ticky Holgado, Anne-Marie Pisani, Boban Janevski, Mikael Todde, Edith Ker, Rufus, Jacques Matho, Howard Vernon, Chick Ortega, Silvie Laguna
description: Young cellist Julie lives with her butcher father who trades in human flesh. They live in a dilapidated building, populated by creepy tenants. Julie falls in love with the clown Louison, her father's next intended victim, and to save him she finds help in a sect of vegetarians who live and plot underground. In the crescendo of a catastrophic ending, the butcher dies and love triumphs. Debut film, original for the narrative and visual solutions that characterize it, bringing it closer to the taste of French comics or of course Terry Gilliam. A sort of middle ground between science fiction and horror film, all played on the register of black humor.

title: Baby Snatcher
actors: Veronica Hamel, Nancy McKeon, David Duchovny, Michael Madsen
description: Bianca, thirty-eight in crisis with her husband, is willing to do anything to keep him tied to her: thus she invents a non-existent pregnancy, carrying on the comedy until the hypothetical date of birth. Karen, on the other hand, has a lover, with whom she is pregnant: when she gives birth to a child, the man refuses to recognize her. Bianca sneaks into the apartment and kidnaps the baby girl: Karen will do everything to find the little girl ...
notes: Nothing new under the sun, even if it makes a smile to find David Duchovny away from the alien plots of _X Files_. Despite its presence and that of Michael Madsen, the film remains modest.

title: The Courtship of Eddie's Father
actors: Glenn Ford, Shirley Jones, Ron Howard, Stella Stevens, Dina Merrill
description: After years of widowhood, Tom thinks he can find a new mate. But the fashion expert Rita does not convince little Eddie: he is much more sympathetic to Elisabeth, the neighbor ...
notes: A little long, but basically successful, this romantic comedy by Minnelli, which was so successful that it inspired a TV series.

title: La condanna
actors: Vittorio Mezzogiorno, Claire Nebout, Andrzej Seweryn, Grazyna Szapolowska
description: The young Sandra gets lost in a museum and remains locked inside; a man appears to her and accompanies her through the halls and seduces her. When the two go out and she finds out that he had the keys to the place, she accuses him of rape. At the trial the Public Prosecutor, who is experiencing a moment of marital crisis and therefore calling into question a number of things, asks for a sentence for him. The usual Marco Bellocchio paired with his psychoanalyst Fagioli, aimed at demonstrating that in sexual intercourse the woman's consent should not be demanded: after all, the rapist is her ideal man, and she should be grateful to him. No comment. Silver bear in Berlin.

title: Zuppa di pesce
actors: Philippe Noiret, Macha Meril, Chiara Caselli, Renzo Montagnani
description: In a large villa in Ansedonia, the family of the producer Ragonelli, a rich widower who has married an attractive widow, gathers. The children of the previous unions and the couple's only daughter, Isabella, therefore converge in the villa. It is she who recounts the successes and misadventures of her father, his contradictory character between scenes and tenderness, his own life and those of his family. Then, when she became an adult, Isabella devoted herself to cinema, which her parent loved so much.
notes: It is, broadly speaking, the director's autobiography and, at the same time, a tribute to his father Carlo (even in a love-hate relationship) and to cinema. But the outcome is mixed, with some merits and as many defects, above all due to poor balance.

title: Francesco
actors: Mickey Rourke, Helena Bonham Carter, Andréa Ferréol, Paolo Bonacelli
description: A few years after his death, Clare and five of the very first followers of the Saint reconstruct his life, from the dissipation of his youth to imprisonment in the war against Perugia, the renunciation of material goods and the choice to dedicate himself entirely to the poor and lepers, approval of the "rule" by Pope Innocent III, gradually until the miracle of the stigmata and death.
notes: Liliana Cavani takes up the character already faced in her first film, in 1966, with the "challenge" of Mickey Rourke as protagonist. As then, an "uncomfortable" Francesco and a hard film, without the rhetoric of easy "poetry" even if with a slightly more glossy style. Rourke isn't too bad.

title: Storia di ragazzi e di ragazze
actors: Alessandro Haber, Felice Andreasi, Lucrezia Lante Della Rovere, Anna Bonaiuto, Monica Cervini
description: At the beginning of 1936, in Porretta Terme, on the Emilian Apennines. More than twenty people gather for the engagement between Silvia, daughter of small landowners, and Angelo, a bourgeois from Bologna. It will be a gargantuan lunch, according to tradition, but also an opportunity for embarrassments, tensions, uncomfortable allusions, as well as spontaneous outbursts and rough courtesies.
notes: A picture of an Italy that once was.
