Perhaps not everything is perfect, but it is one of the best (and most demanding) films by Avati in its complex structural articulation, in the happy narrative touch of almost all situations, in the global rendering of excellent performers in a state of grace.

title: Frantic
actors: Harrison Ford, Betty Buckley, Emmanuelle Seigner, John Mahoney
description: An American surgeon goes to Paris to attend a scientific congress. His wife accompanies him: the two made their honeymoon in the Ville Lumière and experience the return with nostalgia. The woman mysteriously disappears from the hotel. The doctor, at first only worried, meets a homeless man who saw the woman dragged heavily into a car by a stranger, perhaps the Middle East. Thus begins, for the protagonist, a long odyssey in the labyrinth of the city's slums, helped only by a girl involved in an international intrigue against her will.
notes: The plot is, as usual, a pretext. Polanski focuses on the figure of a man who does not speak a word of French and finds himself practically isolated in a hostile context. Disorientation becomes the theme of the film and the sense of suspense.

title: Soul Man
actors: C. Thomas Howell, Rae Dawn Chong, Arye Gross, James Earl Jones
description: Due to a long series of coincidences, not least that of being short of money after his father's decision to cut his funds, Mark risks not being able to enroll at the university. The last possibility may be to win a scholarship: but this is reserved for students of color. Mark decides to "turn" into black. However, he did not take into account the beautiful Sarah of whom he falls in love, reciprocated.
notes: Miner happily succeeds in carrying out a comedy that is inscribed in the American tradition of the B-Movie. The model remains the classic comedy, exploiting all the comedy inherent in the "race" exchange of the protagonist.

title: Spies Like Us
actors: Chevy Chase, Dan Aykroyd, Steve Forrest, Donna Dixon, Bruce Davison
description: A mad American general sends two clumsy and unsuspecting CIA employees into the freezing cold of the Pamir to start a missile installed by the Soviets, thus allowing the testing of the "star shield" developed by the Pentagon.
notes: It is a farcical and "family-friendly" "Doctor Strangelove", weak in the script but held together by the free-wheeling gags of the protagonists. Memorable is the scene in which Chase and Aykroyd perform an appendectomy posing as surgeons.

title: White Sands
actors: Willem Dafoe, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Mickey Rourke
description: The body of a stranger is found in the ruins of Anasazi, in the New Mexico desert. The man is holding a gun and clutching a briefcase. Sheriff Ray Dolezal, called for the death report, opens the briefcase. Surprise: it contains five hundred thousand dollars in cash. The sheriff soon finds himself involved in an international intrigue related to an arms trafficking run by Gorman Lennox, a shady trafficker perhaps in league with the CIA.
notes: Action director Donaldson doesn't hit his target well. The film is modest and exhausting. The actors seem lost in a plot whose end they don't see.

title: Bis Ans Ende Der Welt
actors: William Hurt, Solveig Dommartin, Jeanne Moreau, Max Von Sydow
description: We are in 1999. Claire is returning from Eugene, in Paris. After a car accident, two robbers entrust her with a suitcase full of money; later he gives a ride to a mysterious man, Trevor, hunted by a killer and in possession of a revolutionary instrument for the reproduction of memories ... Thus begins a long chase through nine nations, from Europe to Australia, in search of himself.
notes: Wim Wenders throws himself headlong into the civilization of the image of a tomorrow that is already today, to re-emerge with the exhortation to a healthy return to the written word. Between homages to cinema and painting, a dense and dizzying work. Great music column.

title: Suburban Commando
actors: Hulk Hogan, Christopher Lloyd, Shelley Duvall, Larry Miner
description: We are on the quiet outskirts of any American city where the incredible suddenly happens. An extraterrestrial warrior swoops from interplanetary space, chased by none other than fierce alien bounty hunters. Shep, this is the name of the fugitive, finds refuge in the home of an anonymous couple, Charlie and Jenny Wilcox who are thus involved in the battle.
notes: The idea is to mount a comedy on a science fiction plot, focusing on the ironic presence of a wrestling star as the protagonist. An extremely odd idea: Christopher Lloyd, Shelley Duvall and some decent gags are not enough to keep the level of the film high.

title: Aces: Iron Eagle III
actors: Louis Gossett jr., Rachel McLish, Paul Freeman
description: Chappy Sinclair, a former US aviation ace, enjoys a quiet retirement running a sort of flying circus with his three friends: the Japanese Hirokoshi, the English Palmer and the German Leichman. One day Chappy learns that an old student of his died in a plane crash while transporting drugs. Chappy and his friends leave for South America where they discover a former Nazi behind the foul traffic. He is still the surly but likeable Louis Gosset jr. to play the role of the intrepid pilot. Great adventures and unlikely Rambo shootings, for the third installment of a series that looks at "Top Gun" and current affairs.

title: Cruising
actors: Al Pacino, Karen Allen, Paul Sorvino, Richard Cox, Don Scardino, Joe Spinell, Jay Acovone, Randy Jurgensen, Barton Heyman, Gene Davis, Arnaldo Santana, Larry Atlas, Allan Miller, Ed O'Neill
description: In New York a killer strikes homosexuals in their thirties with black hair and about five feet tall. Matching these somatic characteristics, agent Steve Burns is tasked with infiltrating gay circles to discover the killer. Thus begins a true descent into the underworld of sadomasochism, at the end of which he will discover the murderer but also, dramatically, his own ambiguous nature.
notes: It is a merciless and thankless investigation, bordering on sociological and beyond pathological (the film was accused of racism by the gay community and rejected by the public for its violence), into the murder and the substantial ambiguity of man.

title: The Barbarian and the Geisha
actors: John Wayne, Eiko Ando, Sam Jaffe, Sô Yamamura
description: In 1865, Townsend Harris, the first American ambassador to Japan, lands in the city of Shimoda, welcomed hostile by the inhabitants and the governor, who has him spied on by the beautiful Okichi. Townsend struggles with a cholera epidemic and the climate around him changes dramatically. Taken to Tokyo, he is signaled to a conspiracy and only the sacrifice of Okichi, in love with him, saves him.

title: Joe Dakota
actors: Jock Mahoney, Luana Patten, Charles McGraw, Barbara Lawrence
description: A foreigner arrives in a village where, for venal reasons, citizens have killed an Indian friend of his. There is only the shadow of Sturges' excellent Day of Cursed, in this routine western directed by a specialist.

title: Romeo and Juliet
actors: Leslie Howard, Norma Shearer, John Barrymore
description: Giulietta Capuleti and Romeo Montecchi, two young Venetians belonging to two rival families, Giulietta Capuleti and Romeo Montecchi, secretly love each other and get married. Due to a misunderstanding, Romeo believes that his beloved has ingested poison ...
notes: Sumptuous MGM version of a classic adapted dozens of times. Norma Shearer and Leslie Howard are good but they are more than double the required age.

title: The Killers
actors: Burt Lancaster, Edmond O'Brien, Ava Gardner, Albert Dekker
description: Two killers arrive in town and kill a guy known by all by the nickname "Swede". It might seem like a settling of scores but an insurance agent sets out to investigate the victim's past. He discovers that the Swede, once an excellent boxer, joined a gang led by the criminal Colfax. And with him he made an unforgivable mistake, falling in love with his wife.
notes: Based on a lightning tale by Hemingway, a powerful noir, with an atmosphere full of anxiety, all built on the dialectic between past and present (sensational flashbacks). John Huston collaborated on the script. Remade years later by Don Siegel.

title: Destination Tokyo
actors: Cary Grant, John Garfield, Alan Hale, John Ridgley, William Prince
description: Cassidy, commander of a submarine, is ordered to leave San Francisco Bay for an unknown destination. The instructions relating to the mission to be carried out are contained in a sealed envelope that the commander opens twenty-four hours after departure. Cassidy, having reached a certain point, loads an officer aboard an airplane. Arrived within sight of the bay of Tokyo, the commander manages to break through the barriers and penetrate the port.
notes: First film by Delmer Daves, who worked using a lot of documentary footage and navy footage. To be seen.

title: Everybody Sing
actors: Allan Jones, Fanny Brice, Judy Garland
description: Bizarre family of artists risks ruin, but is saved by the youngest daughter and the house cook. Pleasant musical farce with fresh interpretations by Judy Garland and Fanny Brice.

title: Wings of the Hawks
actors: Van Heflin, Julie Adams, Abbe Lane, George Dolenz, Noah Beery jr.
description: In 1911 a "gringo", engineer of a gold mine, becomes the target of the abuses of a Mexican colonel. He thus finds support with the revolutionaries where he meets the beautiful Raquel. Sloppy and mundane 3D production.

title: Manpower
actors: Edward G. Robinson, George Raft, Marlene Dietrich
description: A clumsy and ugly worker (Robinson) marries the daughter of a colleague (Dietrich) who is too different from him. Nasty and successful variation on Hawks' "Pacific Tigers" theme, in the curious environment of power line workers.

title: House of Dark Shadows
actors: Jonathan Frid, Kathryn Leigh Scott
description: A vampire wants at all costs to reunite with his lost girlfriend two centuries ago. Good movie for gore buffs.

title: The White Buffalo
actors: Charles Bronson, Jack Warden, Kim Novak, John Carradine, Slim Pickens
description: A huge white bison roams the Black Mountains, spreading terror among hunters and Indians. The Sioux Crazy Horse chases him to avenge the death of his little girl. Wild Bill Hickox is in turn on the trail of the quadruped, in the company of his friend Charlie Zane. The paths of the Indian warrior and the white gunslinger cross a few times, before the two face the bison together.
notes: What could have been a western version of "Moby Dick" results in a film whose script focuses entirely on the adventurous aspect. The "monster" is the work of Carlo Rambaldi.

title: Goodbye Charlie
actors: Tony Curtis, Walter Matthau, Debbie Reynolds, Pat Boone, Walter Matthau, Tony Curtis
description: Dongiovanni and thug, Charlie is killed by his jealous consort of one of his flames. Reincarnated in the features of the blonde Virginia, he arouses a certain disturbance in his dear friend George ...
notes: From a play by George Axelrod, Minnelli draws an idea that will be taken up again in '91 by Blake Edwards ("In the role of a blonde").

title: The Divorcee
actors: Norma Shearer, Chester Morris, Conrad Nagel, Robert Montgomery
description: Jerry and Ted are a couple of in love with the New York jet set. Jerry's decision to marry him therefore appears to be a natural consequence and the start of a happy and lucky relationship, but his friend Paul - who was secretly in love with Jerry - takes her badly: he gets drunk and causes an accident in which Dorothy remains disfiguredMoved by the sense of guilt and compassion Paul thus decides in turn to marry Dorothy. Years after the marriage between Jerry and Ted has come to a dead track: he cheats on her, he decides to reciprocate him with the same coin. But he can't stand it and decides to divorce. And when Jerry meets Paul, who has never stopped loving her, the possibility opens that he divorces to finally join her.

title: See You in the Morning
actors: Jeff Bridges, Alice Krige, Farrah Fawcett, Drew Barrymore, Lukas Haas
description: Larry and Beth meet at a party. He still mourns his beautiful wife Jo who left him three years ago. She still has not recovered from the suicide of her husband, a famous pianist. With all their pasts on, and with a couple of children each, the two begin a relationship. But Beth's children don't take it well.
notes: Barrymore had already been on "E.T." and had to, apart from a parenthesis with drugs, get to "My worst friend". Lukas Haas had already made a name for himself three years earlier with "Witness". Culkin would soon become a monstrous money machine. Pakula directs the actors with sobriety and taste.

title: A Great American Tragedy
actors: George Kennedy, Vera Miles, James Woods, William Windon
description: Brad Wilkes (George Kennedy) has a beautiful house, a wife named Gloria (Vera Miles) and a job as a aerospace engineer. Everything is fine as long as they fire him. From that day the world falls on him. He, looking for a new place, spend time in useless and endless job interviews. To keep the house, his wife gets back to work. Meanwhile, the family breaks out. Definitely a good cast (there is also James Woods in a minor role), well directed by Jack Lee Thompson, that of the old promontory of fear. The problem is that the story languishes more than the bank account of Brad Wilkes and that the ending is disappointing.

title: Hero and the Terror
actors: Chuck Norris, Jack O'Halloran, Brynn Thayer, Jeffrey Kramer
description: Nothing to say about detective O'Brien: he's a tough guy who knows his job well. Even if he's not the same since the time he managed to put Simon Moon, a multi-murderous psychopath, also known as "the Terror", in jail. Since that day O'Brien suffers from nightmares and is no longer able to sleep like he used to and, now that Simon has escaped from the criminal asylum, he risks not sleeping at all. The result is mediocre, but with Norris there is nothing to be done. He works in obtusely action roles, but never make him play a cop with inner worries. The very fact that he is capable of thinking is hardly credible.

title: L'altra metà del cielo
actors: Adriano Celentano, Monica Vitti, Mario Carotenuto, Glauco Onorato
description: In Fiumicino, among the passengers on a flight to Australia, there are a priest and a prostitute. The two meet and then find themselves in the continent of kangaroos in a mining town populated mostly by Italians: he is the new parish priest, she is away from work for the joy of the local males. Knowing this, the priest tries by all means to redeem the woman until he comes to blows with her protector. This forces him to return, but something has really changed in the woman's soul. The script leaves something to be desired and the uplifting duets between Celentano and Monica Vitti border on unbearable.

title: Sciuscià
actors: Franco Interlenghi, Rinaldo Smordoni, Aniello Mele, Emilio Cigoli
description: Giuseppe and Pasquale are two young friends who earn their living by being shoeshines and, sometimes, even with some small illicit initiative. Involved in a theft, they end up in the hell of the reformatory, where they come into contact with a reality of abuse and violence. Their souls harden, even their friendship cracks and Joseph, in an attempt to escape, loses his life. The first great film by De Sica in the neorealist vein, built with lucid force of denunciation and with fairytale touches in the pure style of the screenwriter Zavattini (the white horse). And the director guides his young actors (one is Franco Interlenghi) on a path that still excites today. Oscar for best foreign film.

title: I fidanzati
actors: Carlo Cabrini, Anna Canzi
description: Giovanni, a Milanese worker, accepts the temporary transfer to Sicily for a better professional qualification, but also as an opportunity to rethink his engagement with Liliana, which has lasted for years and which has now become a routine relationship. Loneliness weighs, despite the daily commitment at work, but the letters he receives from the girl strengthen a love that was withering.
notes: One of the most convincing results in Olmi's work, who builds a psychological investigation of profound and accurate exactness on a very slight idea, also painting an acute and pertinent picture of the environment: the boom, the North and the South, all told in a complex construction without stereotypes. Excellent non-professional actors.

title: Champion
actors: Kirk Douglas, Arthur Kennedy, Marilyn Maxwell
description: Midge (Douglas) works as a waiter in a small bar and becomes the mistress of the owner's daughter. Forced to marry her, he immediately abandons her and goes to town, where a boxing coach offers him a contract. He will go a long way, but his boundless pride, his selfishness and his lack of scruples will be fatal to him on the human level. Among the many boxing films of American cinema, this is one of the best. The protagonist's analysis is ruthless but convincing, as is that of the ring environment, in a story of robust effectiveness. Excellent the "hard" Douglas; script by Carl Foreman from a story by Ring Lardner.

title: Caccia alla vedova
actors: Isabella Rossellini, Tom Conti, James Wilby, Michel Duchaussoy
description: The young and beautiful Rosanna, widowed the same day of the wedding, discovers that she has inherited a huge capital, which makes her the most coveted party of the Serenissima. Three foreign aristocrats - an Englishman, a Russian and a Frenchman - go after the widow. But the government of Venice does not take kindly to the fact that the enormous wealth of women ends up in foreign hands ... Freely inspired by the comedy "La vedova scaltra" by Carlo Goldoni, the film is lively in the whirlwind of lovers, secret agents, suitors, aristocrats and beggars. He is also quite witty, discreetly acted, but Goldoni is something else.

title: Gator
actors: Burt Reynolds, Jack Weston, Lauren Hutton, Jerry Reed, Alice Ghostley, Dub Taylor
description: The Greenfield agent of the FBI blackmails Gator McCluski, a young man with no art or party, and forces him to engage against his former friend Booma McCall, a mob boss in the city of Dunston. Hired by McCall as a collector of bribes, Gator tries to carry out his task without violence, with the help of Aggie, a TV star, but after the murderous reaction of the boss will switch to the hard way.
notes: Burt Reynolds is self-directed in his first experience behind the camera, a sequel to "McClusky, half man half hate". He does so without infamy but also without particular merits, "citing" important authors (Aldrich, Penn, Peckinpah), but failing to give the film a personal imprint.

title: Night on Earth
actors: Gena Rowlands, Winona Ryder, Béatrice Dalle, Roberto Benigni, Giancarlo Esposito, Rosie Perez, Armin Mueller-Stahl, Isaach De Bankolé, Pascal N'Zonzi, Paolo Bonacelli, Matti Pellonpää, Kari Väänänen
description: Los Angeles - Film agent Valeria offers rough but likeable cab driver Corky a career as a star. But she wants to be a mechanic and start a family. New York - A black driver replaces a bad German taxi driver at the wheel, then picks up a night owl sister-in-law with whom he has a furious quarrel. Paris - A bit too proud black cab driver is downsized by a blind and confident young woman. Rome - Gino, a taxi driver with a varied sexual experience, believes he is responsible for the death of an old priest to whom he has told his exploits. Helsinki - Taxi driver Mika tells his sad story of a missing father to two customers who are too sympathetic to the friend they are accompanying.
notes: Jarmusch drives us through five metropolises in a bizarre patchwork film, in which the search for an exemplary encounter produces repetitiveness and ups and downs. The cast is still four-star.

title: Quattro passi tra le nuvole
actors: Gino Cervi, Adriana Benetti, Giuditta Rissone, Carlo Romano
description: Paolo Bianchi, a traveling salesman married to an unpleasant woman, meets the young Maria who returns to the village, terrified of having to confess at home that she was made pregnant by a man who later left her. Paolo agrees to pretend to be Maria's husband for a few hours, and manages to get her strict relatives to forgive her when the deception is discovered. Then it returns to its gray existence. Fresh and very pleasant, well acted and narrated with elegant levity despite its far from frivolous problematic, the film is considered as a forerunner of the neorealistic vein. One of the best results of Italian cinema of the time.

title: A Big Hand for the Little Lady
actors: Joanne Woodward, Henry Fonda, Jason Robards
description: In Dodge City, the four richest men in Kansas gather for a game of poker. They are joined by Meredith, someone who is about to emigrate to Texas with his family, but who cannot resist the temptation of the game. Meredith, however, at the crucial moment faints and is replaced by his wife.
notes: Fielder Cook's honest craftsmanship ensures good-quality cinema and safe entertainment. The cast is very respectable. The subject is ingenious, even if there is not much real action, and this in a western is not really recommendable.

title: Stealing Home
actors: Mark Harmon, Jodie Foster, Blair Brown, Jonathan Silverman
description: Billy is a baseball player in the twilight of a not so great career. Back home for the first time in twenty years, he learns of the suicide of Katie, his first girlfriend. On the wave of memory he relives the old times with her and the past enthusiasm of youth. Katie left him the burden of taking care of her ashes. For the first time, the irresponsible Billy knows what to do. Bittersweet existential account, the film makes use of a good performance by Jodie Foster.

title: Natale al campo 119
actors: Aldo Fabrizi, Vittorio De Sica, Peppino De Filippo, Massimo Girotti
description: The war has long since ended, but the Italian prisoners locked up in camp 119, in California, are still waiting for their release and in the meantime they are preparing to celebrate a sad Christmas away from their families. The prisoners, coming from the most disparate areas of Italy, begin to remember episodes of their life.
notes: Dramatic events tempered in the lightness of comedy, in a film that is almost a historical document.

title: Mean Streets
actors: Robert De Niro, Harvey Keitel, Amy Robinson, David Proval, Richard Romanus, Cesare Danova, Victor Argo, David Carradine, Robert Carradine
description: Johnny Boy is a messed-up thug who piles up debts and enmities. His best friend Charlie, nephew of a mobster, is obsessed with religion and sex. Another, Tony, runs a dodgy bar. A fight and the subsequent settling of scores put an end to their lives. It ends badly for Johnny's epileptic sister too ...
notes: Granguignolesca, an extraordinary reconstruction of the Little Italy that the director knew in his childhood. Scorsese's third feature film develops a theme that will innervate many of his major works: that of the city as hell, in which the characters experience an all-earth ordeal.

title: Nobody's Fool
actors: Rosanna Arquette, Eric Roberts, Louise Fletcher
description: Cassie is a single mother disillusioned with family, life and love. She works as a waitress in a drugstore in a small town in the American province, but her secret dream is to be a theater actress. She meets and falls in love with Riley, a lighting technician who reciprocates her sentiment and helps her break through. Pink comedy barely colored with a vein of problematic sadness and social criticism.

title: Assolto per aver commesso il fatto
actors: Alberto Sordi, Angela Finocchiaro, Enzo Monteduro, Marco Predolin
description: Emilio Garrone is a retired former SIAE official. Taking advantage of his profession, which he now practices illegally, and the help of his trusted secretary Mariuccia and the driver, he manages to take over numerous local networks that do not comply with the books. He soon becomes a fearsome competitor of Cavalier Serra's television networks, and indeed, he burns him on the purchase of a large American network.

title: Les ripoux
actors: Philippe Noiret, Thierry Lhermitte, Regine, Grace De Capitani
description: Commissioner René has been working in the same neighborhood for twenty years. And for twenty years he has been arranging himself, asking for bribes, organizing intrigues. Now his superiors have joined the young François, a bit of a careerist, a bit inexperienced, but above all an uncompromising moralist. It takes René a while to explain to him how life works, but in the end she manages to convince him that crime pays. The tone is halfway between comedy and yellow. Zidi is almost a master on this. Lhermitte is good enough. In the role of the somewhat corrupt but basically good commissioner, there is Philippe Noiret who is a real ace in this role.

title: L'Atlantide
actors: Tchéky Karyo, Christopher Thomson, Anna Galiena, Jean Rochefort
description: A patrol of French soldiers, led by the young officer André Saint Avit, is suddenly attacked by a band of Tuareg in the desert. During the battle, Saint Avit saves the life of Lieutenant Morhange and the two become great friends. One day Saint Avit does not return from an expedition in the desert. Morhange, to repay his debt of honor, then decides to go in search of his friend and ends up discovering the fabulous kingdom of Atlantis ruled by the fascinating and dangerous Antinea.
notes: Re-creation of Jacques Feyder's silent French film of the same name (from 1921). A magical Sahara, but otherwise the film does not hold up.

title: The Stranger
actors: Orson Welles, Loretta Young, Edward G. Robinson, Philip Merivale
description: A Nazi criminal is purposely escaped from Allied prison to join his former superior and thus allow him to be identified. In fact, the police do not know the characteristics of the evil hierarch; he only knows that he has a passion for watches. On the trail of the fugitive, a detective arrives in a quiet town in the United States, where an esteemed professor is about to marry the daughter of a notable. The professor is repairing the old church clock ...

title: Holiday Inn
actors: Bing Crosby, Fred Astaire, Marjorie Reynolds, Virginia Dale
description: Jim leaves the magazine world to retire to a Connecticut farm. The beautiful Laila does not follow him: Ted convinces her to stay, for him and for the art of the show. Jim gets bored after a while and turns the farm into a music studio. He also finds a new girlfriend, Linda, but here comes the usual Ted, abandoned by Laila, and gives Linda a future of fame. The film belongs to a moment of uncertainty in Astaire's career, after the great exploits of the Thirties. Here he is even forced to the second role, giving the lead role to Crosby, who sings "White Christmas" (Oscar). Songs by Irving Berlin.

title: Barefoot in the Park
actors: Robert Redford, Jane Fonda, Charles Boyer, Mildred Natwick
description: Paul and Corie are newly weds who take possession of their apartment which if the second is adorable, the first is detestable. One of their neighbors, Victor Velasco befriends the woman, who prepares a meeting between him and his mother, Ethel. Corie's aim is to raise her spirits depressed by loneliness.
notes: From a Neil Simon comedy: bubbly, but a little dated.

title: Una bella grinta
actors: Renato Salvatori, Norma Bengell, Antonio Segurini, Marina Malfatti
description: An ambitious industrialist has a new factory built despite being on the verge of bankruptcy. The (neglected) wife has a mistress. The industrialist discovers him, kills him and simulates an accident, so he manages to straighten the business of his company as well. Special Jury Prize at the 1965 Berlin Film Festival.

title: Darkness Before Dawn
actors: Meredith Baxter-Birney, Stephen Lang
description: Mary Ann is a nurse and already has a divorce behind her, but even her second marriage doesn't look very promising. The new husband is a drug addict and the two of them will be the one to give in, thus entering the world of drugs. The two then bring a child into the world, which complicates family life even more. Only by separating will the two be able to free themselves from drugs. John Patterson is a sensitive director. He had already dealt with rape (When she says no), with degenerate and destitute mothers (Torn away), and with bad media influences (Original Sin). How could he pretend that he didn't have his say on drugs as well?

title: Indochine
actors: Catherine Deneuve, Lihn Dan Phan, Vincent Perez, Jean Yanne
description: We are in the 1920s, in Indochina, a French colony. Eliane Devres, landowner, is a beautiful, mature woman who is courted by the chief of police, Guy Asselin, in vain. Eliane has adopted a young orphaned princess named Camille; The girl is sixteen, but the two women become rivals in love when Jean-Baptiste Le Guen, a naval officer who had won Eliane's heart, falls in love with Camille. This renunciation of man, but manages to send him to a remote outpost. Le Guen and Camille flee together, while the anti-French revolt is now underway. The obvious objective of the film is to combine the atmosphere of a great exotic melodrama with a reinterpretation of the collective situation that forms the background. In terms of entertainment, the film holds up well, however: solid script, beautiful photography (facilitated by the scenographic richness of the landscapes), setting with attention to detail, credible cast where the presence of the always fascinating Deneuve and the thanks of Lihn Dan Phan stand out.

title: He Said, She Said
actors: Kevin Bacon, Elizabeth Perkins, Sharon Stone
description: He and she make a career together: from the pages of the local newspaper where they have a column, they land on a television talk show, where they have to express the diversity of male and female points of view in matters of the heart. Soon profession and private life end up identifying, until the inevitable "live" crisis. During the usual face-to-face she, exasperated by the fact that he refuses to marry her, loses her temper and throws a glass on his head. The clash is healthy and leads the man to take better account of the requests of his partner and to a better coexistence.

title: Thelma & Louise
actors: Susan Sarandon, Geena Davis, Harvey Keitel, Michael Madsen, Brad Pitt
description: Thelma, a little goose housewife, completely devoted to her husband, and Louise, a waitress in a fast food restaurant, leave for a weekend in the mountains. On the way they stop at a club where Thelma meets a man: he gets her drunk and tries to rape her, but Louise kills him. Thus began their flight to Mexico.
notes: After the metaphysical horror of "Alien" and the noir horror of "Blade Runner" Scott philosophizes on feminism and turns the classic places of the film "on the road" upside down, re-reading, no longer mythical, landscapes and film genres where violence is colored with nostalgia and men are condemned without hope.

title: Ascenseur pour l'échafaud
actors: Jeanne Moreau, Maurice Ronet, Georges Poujouly, Yori Bertin
description: Julien is the mistress of his boss's wife. The couple plans the murder of the poor husband, which goes through. For a trivial mishap, however, Julien remains locked in the elevator all night, while his car is stolen by a young hooligan. The latter commits a murder, which Julien himself is blamed for, who cannot give an alibi. And the last minute intervention of the lover is worthless ... Malle's successful debut with this controversial film, close to the "Nouvelle Vague" explosion. The staging is shrewd and the tension maneuvered with skill. The musical column is of great quality, signed by a Miles Davis in a state of grace.

title: Il nome della rosa
actors: Sean Connery, F. Murray Abraham, Christian Slater, Michael Lonsdale, Valentina Vargas
description: In the autumn of 1327 the Franciscan William of Baskerville arrived in a majestic Italian monastery with the novice Adso for a meeting between Dominicans, Franciscans and papal delegates. Mysterious deaths follow one another and Guglielmo's investigations are hindered. The papal delegate proceeds with an inquisitorial method: for him heresy and murder are identified, but the solution lies elsewhere. From Umberto Eco's best seller, Annaud attempts a transposition that at least saves the fascination of Sherlock Holmes-like intrigue in the Middle Ages. More, honestly, could not be expected. Refined interpretation of Sean Connery.

title: Freejack
actors: Emilio Estevez, Anthony Hopkins, Mick Jagger, Rene Russo
description: Alex Furlong, a famous racing driver, dies during a race in 1991. In reality, he does not die because his body is stolen just a moment before by a gang of assassins who comes from the future. Alex wakes up in a 2009 operating room and discovers that someone is trying to use his body to feed their brain into it. Scientific progress allows it, but Alex goes to great lengths to avoid it. It was since "Performance" (1970) that Mick Jagger hadn't been in a movie. For what weird reasons did he break his fast with this? And Hopkins? For what vile motives will he have allowed himself to be persuaded to add his name to this short film?

title: Gli eroi del doppio gioco
actors: Mario Carotenuto, Aroldo Tieri, Carlo Croccolo, Wandisa Guida, Gianrico Tedeschi, Gino Bramieri
description: Son of a mayor and brother of two provincial fascist hierarchs, Benito returns from the Russian front and joins the partisans. The relatives in black shirts also pass by his side as soon as they realize the (new) wind that is blowing ...
notes: Really "Italian" comedy made with the usual exquisite professionalism by Camillo Mastrocinque. Of course there are all the faults of this kind, first of all the not even hidden attempt to be indulgent with the typical faults of Italians. In this case the endemic desire for transformation. The cast is essential.

title: Little Man Tate
actors: Jodie Foster, Dianne Wiest, Adam Hann-Byrd, Harry Connick jr.
description: Doctor Jane Grierson discovers that Fred is a child prodigy and invites him to her institution. His mother Dede, perplexed, reluctantly gives in. The relationship with other children is not idyllic, but life at home is worse. Things don't get better when Fred moves in with Jane to go to college. It is no coincidence that for her directorial debut Jodie Foster chose this story, she who at three years old showed herself naked in the advertisement for "Coppertone" sunscreen and at seven she was already a well-known television actress. Convincing Adam Hann-Byrd (a nine-year-old little prodigy) and also Harry Connick jr., Also, as a child, an authentic pianist prodigy.

title: Moment by Moment
actors: John Travolta, Lily Tomlin, Andra Akers
description: Strip is a guy who lives for the day, and upset over the killing of a drug dealer friend. Trisha, embittered lady of good society, defies convention for her sake. Film put together with the least worst in an attempt to exploit John Travolta's sudden fame.

title: Terra madre
actors: Sandro Salvini, Leda Gloria, Isa Pola, Vasco Creti, Carlo Ninchi
description: Duke Marco has half ruined himself to satisfy the whims of his mistress and is now about to sell the lands he owns as well. But he realizes in time that the buyer is a sinister speculator and then blocks the sale, abandons his lover and returns to live in the countryside. And, completely repentant, he marries the daughter of his farmer, who for some time, in the shadows, had been in love with the prodigal aristocrat. Based on a didactic "morality", in line with the dictates of the Fascist regime, the film is tasty and smooth, even if it concedes a little too much to rural specter. One of the first Italian sound productions, technically respectable.

title: The Honeymoon Machine
actors: Steve McQueen, Paula Prentiss, Jim Hutton
description: An American navy officer (McQueen) takes advantage of a stop in Venice to try to break the bank using the electronic equipment on board. With two accomplices he puts in place a series of tricks that fail because of a beautiful girl. The ship's reports are also interpreted by the Admiralty as war messages.
notes: The useless wealth of production ends up completely crushing a comedy without verve. McQueen in uniform, however, is impeccable.

title: White Fury
actors: Deke Anderson, Sean Holton, Douglas Harter
description: During a quiet weekend in the snow, two couples are kidnapped by a gang of sadistic thugs.
notes: Authentic Z series directed by a specialist.

title: Safari
actors: Victor Mature, Janet Leigh, Roland Culver, John Justin, Earl Cameron
description: A hunter in Africa, Victor Mature sees his son and old aunt killed by the Mau Mau murderers. He swears revenge, but before getting his hands on the culprit he has to go through numerous vicissitudes related to a hunting trip. Finally he also finds a new love. Predictable adventures stitched on a vague exotic background.

title: Hamlet
actors: Laurence Olivier, Basil Sydney, Eileen Herlie, Norman Wooland, Peter Cushing, Terence Morgan, Jean Simmons, Felix Aylmer, Jean Simmons, John Laurie, Stanley Holloway, Russell Thorndike
description: The king of Denmark was killed by his brother, who took his place on the throne and in the heart of the queen. But the ghost of the father appears to Hamlet to drive him to revenge. The prince, to fulfill his tragic mission, renounces the love of Ophelia (who will kill himself), pretends to be mad, survives a conspiracy organized by the king and dies too.
notes: Golden Lion in Venice (amid vibrant controversies on film and film theater) and four Oscars for the well-known masterpiece by William Shakespeare in the version of Laurence Olivier, fascinating for its iconographic qualities and compelling dramatic compactness.

title: Colpo gobbo all'italiana
actors: Mario Carotenuto, Marisa Merlini, Andrea Checchi, Gina Rovere, Gino Bramieri, Aroldo Tieri
description: The night watchman Orazio is a friend of everyone in the neighborhood where he does his work, even of thieves. When a theft is consummated in a bank that falls under his territorial jurisdiction, Orazio turns to some thieves to recover the stolen goods who, in turn, ask for the help of a well-known "professional". In fact, everything works out for the best. The best thing about the film is the starting idea, quite original. On the other hand, when you consider the realization, the troubles begin: it is of poor and unsatisfactory rhythm, artificial, with an awkward direction and a superficial acting.

title: Chuchela
actors: Cristina Orbakaite, Yuri Nikulin
description: In a small town live Nikolai Nikolaievich, considered half mad, and his granddaughter Lena nicknamed by his fellow scarecrows. Dima Somov is Lena's boyfriend, and it will be he who accuses her unfairly (out of cowardice). Lena and her grandfather leave the city but their companions, repentant, write on the blackboard: "Scarecrow, forgive us". A good film between comedy and drama that delves into the often cruel relationships between children and between them and adults.

title: The Sunshine Boys
actors: Walter Matthau, George Burns, Richard Benjamin, F. Murray Abraham
description: Willie Clark and Al Lewis have spent a lifetime as a couple treading the vaudeville scenes. Forty years of success, of working together, but also of furious quarrels and systematic spite. Today they are two old bitches out of the loop for some time. But just today they are both called on TV to remake their classic "doctor's sketch". Things haven't improved much in the meantime. Neil Simon's script and it's one that promises havoc. The actors are more than appropriate and indisputable. Then maybe Herbert Ross is to blame if the result is ultimately less than the sum of its parts. In any case, we laugh. Oscar to George Burns.

title: The Curse of Frankenstein
actors: Peter Cushing, Christopher Lee, Hazel Court, Robert Urquhart
description: Frankenstein and his friend Kempe graft the brain of a genius and the hands of an artist on the corpse of a hanged man. The film that launched Hammer as a horror production company, and the Cushing / Lee duo. Perhaps not the masterpiece of the house, but a classic in every sense nonetheless: the direction, the performers, the color.

title: A World Apart
actors: Barbara Hershey, Jodhi May, Linda Mvusi, Jeroen Krabbe, Albee Lesotho, Carolyn Clayton Crass, Tim Roth
description: Johannesburg, 1963. 13-year-old Molly, the daughter of two white journalists active against apartheid, sees her father forced to flee. She is marginalized at school, her mother is arrested and attempts suicide for fear of betraying her fellow fighters. Molly berates her mother for putting politics before family, but killing a black leader gives her awareness of the situation. Special Film Award and Palme d'Or to the three female performers (mother, daughter and black maid) in Cannes. The film tells a true story (Molly's mother was murdered in 1982) with a detached, reportage style, but of great dramatic effectiveness.

title: Cry of the Hunted
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Barry Sullivan, Polly Bergen
description: Joe was the driver of a robbery. He escapes from prison without having mentioned the names of his accomplices. A policeman sets out on his trail suspecting that he is headed home, in the swamp area, where his wife and child are waiting for him. The two face each other with no holds barred but, first the cop and then Joe save each other's lives.
notes: Gassman's unfortunate American trip in a film with eccentric melodramatic ideas. The direction of the little Maetsro Lewis is excited, with bursts of ideas.

title: Backdraft
actors: Kurt Russell, Robert De Niro, Scott Glenn, William Baldwin
description: Dad McCaffrey was a firefighter and died on duty. Today his son Stephen heads the legendary team 17, the most efficient. His brother Brian also tries but, at the first opportunity, he gets scared and ends up behind a desk working with Inspector Rimgale. The rivalry between the two brothers remains latent, but a dangerous arsonist remains in hiding on the streets of Chicago.
notes: Not to belittle the work of the actors, but here the protagonist is the fire which is not only a killer beast, but takes shape, body and intentionality. Howard builds a complicated story well, but the fire alone eats him the whole film.

title: Scandalo
actors: Franco Nero, Lisa Gastoni, Raymond Pellegrin, Andréa Ferréol
description: Pursued by the mafia father of a seduced, an Italian play boy takes refuge in Paris with an uncle and is still in trouble with women, husbands and lovers. The good Caprioli on a French trip, in a patchy and heavy film.

title: Ambush
actors: Robert Taylor, Arlene Dahl, John Hodiak, Don Taylor
description: A woman is kidnapped by the Apaches and her sister does everything to free her along with a very brave Indian guide. A solid western directed by Sam Wood, who died the same year, shortly after finishing editing. Robert Taylor in one of two films in which he plays a Red Indian.

title: The Boy Who Cried Bitch
actors: Harley Cross, Karen Young, Jesse Bradford, Jason Biggs, Gene Canfield, Adrien Brody
description: When Dad leaves home, little Dan takes her badly to the point that he gets sick in his mind. The treatment is worthless, so much so that the boy is locked up in a psychiatric hospital. To shake him from his psychosis seems to be another young man with mental problems, a Vietnam veteran, to whom Dan is bound by deep friendship. This relationship, however, in the long run, worsens the situation and Dan is about to become a real monster, very dangerous. What will his mother do, now unable to control her violent reactions? Convincing first work by the young Juan José Campanella.

title: If Winter Comes
actors: Walter Pidgeon, Deborah Kerr, Janet Leigh
description: A philanthropist welcomes a single mother into his home, unleashing the malevolence of his world. Definitely sentimental.

title: Baby Boom
actors: Diane Keaton, Sam Shepard, Kristine Kennedy, Harold Ramis
description: J. C. Wiatt (Diane Keaton) is a career woman who unexpectedly finds herself having to raise the tiny daughter of a cousin who died in an accident. Forced to radically change her life, she decides to leave her career and city and move in with her child in a cottage in Vermont. But even there he does not know how to stay with his hands and starts a big business with natural foods.
notes: Diane Keaton is the undisputed protagonist of this comedy of great feelings and with a more than rosy ending, which updates old values ??with a brilliant attitude and uplifting objectives, according to the morality of a long-gone Hollywood.

title: What's the Matter with Helen?
actors: Debbie Reynolds, Shelley Winters, Micheal MacLiammóir
description: Adelle and Helen, mothers of two young men sentenced to death, open a dance school in Hollywood. But Helen's psyche is undermined and drives her to kill. Melò-thriller written by Henry Farrell, author of the novel from which it was based "What happened to baby Jane?" (also vaguely referred to in the original title). Strong emotions, excellent female cast and splendid supporting characters (including MacLiammoir, the Iago of Welles); he directs ex-underground Curtis Harringron with a visionary hand.

title: Benvenuti in casa Gori
actors: Alessandro Benvenuti, Athina Cenci, Ilaria Occhini, Novello Novelli, Carlo Monni
description: It is Christmas 1986 in a town in Tuscany. The Gori family is reunited for the traditional lunch attended by members of three generations. In theory it is the occasion for a peaceful meeting, but little by little dormant frictions reappear, old disagreements are revived, the climate is poisoned between old and new reproaches. Then, when the oldest guest dies, a certain serenity is restored. Cinematic transposition of the homonymous comedy by Ugo Chiti which is too much affected by its theatrical origins and which does not know how to give itself a consistent dimension, beyond the limits of the sketch. A lot of "color", but very little substance.

title: Dicembre
actors: Pamela Villoresi, Alessandro Haber, Pino Colizzi, Mattia Sbragia
description: Upon the death of her husband Alberto, Gianna discovers that she no longer has anything to do with her relatives, many and all very close to each other. The Christmas period is approaching and Gianna has no desire to participate in family rites. The only one with whom he continues to get along well is his nephew Alberto. After all, he is the only one who believes her when she claims that her house was visited by a thief. Modest family portrait in an interior that employs at least good actors and excellent technicians. If Monda, newcomer with a film financed by Rai, were not also the nephew of the former minister Misasi, perhaps he would have been taken a little more seriously.

title: Wutherings Heights
actors: Merle Oberon, Laurence Olivier, David Niven, Hugh Williams
description: After the death of the landlord who had adopted him, foundling Heatchliff is relegated to the kitchens by his eldest son; thus ends the love that bound him to his half-sister Cathy. Heatchliff escapes: he will return after several years, rich and new owner of the house. Cathy is regularly married and the despot's eldest son is an alcoholic. Heatchliff will take desperate and sterile revenge ...
notes: From the novel _Wuthering Heights_ by Emily Brontë: the great spaces of the moor, combined with the strength of social conventions, ferociously separate the ancient lovers. Pure romance. Photograph by Gregg Toland (_Fourth Estate_).

title: Rossini! Rossini!
actors: Philippe Noiret, Jacqueline Bisset, Sergio Castellitto, Sabine Azéma, Giorgio Gaber
description: Gioacchino Rossini by now old and ill (imaginary) recalls his youth in his house in Passy, ??near Paris: from drummer in the band to composer courted by theaters all over Europe. Monicelli reconstructs the life of the great Pesaro composer, but without the backbone and passion that would have been necessary.

title: Wild Justice
actors: Roy Scheider, Patricia Millardet, Ted McGinley
description: Peter Stride is a former colonel hired by wealthy Magda Altman to track down a dangerous international terrorist: the Caliph. Things get tough quickly. First the Caliph kidnaps his daughter and then kills his best friend who helped him in the search. Peter comes to the conclusion that the Caliph is just Magda, but then comes the showdown with a final twist. Episode shortened from an American television miniseries. Full throttle guards and robbers for seen and seen adventures. Non-existent characters and childish dialogues make an operation that simply aims to fill two hours of programming on TV even more vain.

title: The Driver
actors: Ryan O'Neal, Bruce Dern, Isabelle Adjani, Ronee Blakley
description: The Driver is an ace of the wheel in the service of the underworld. The Inspector tries to frame him by blackmailing some half-notch thugs. The Player acts as a side for the Driver to avoid nasty surprises and after the blow the two have their headaches to get rid of the traitor accomplices. But then she runs away with the loot. The driver is on the ropes, but once again the police have no elements to indict him.
notes: Brilliant Walter Hill: unnamed characters; script geometrically devoted to the application of archetypes. Ryan O'Neal and Isabelle Adjani are serious one last time. We are on the verge of parody, but it is black that wins: without reservations.

title: La mortadella
actors: Danny DeVito, Sophia Loren, Gigi Proietti, William Devane
description: Maddalena Ciarrapico, a worker in a sausage factory, leaves her job and Italy and leaves for the United States to join her boyfriend in New York. Once in the United States, however, the customs authorities do not give her permission to leave the airport, because Maddalena has a mortadella with her, and American law prohibits the importation of sausages.
notes: Rather limping farce directed by a not too fit Monicelli.

title: The Out-of-Towners
actors: Jack Lemmon, Sandy Dennis, Sandy Baron, Anne Meara, Robert Nichols
description: George Kellerman dreams of living in a big metropolis. Having become reality, the dream turns out to be a disappointment. Crackling comedy about the neuroses of the metropolis and the manias of the provincials, written by Neil Simon in his prime. Very good Lemmon, but also Sandy Dennis who plays his wife.

title: I nostri mariti
directors: Luigi Zampa, Dino Risi, Luigi Filippo D'Amico
actors: Alberto Sordi, Nicoletta Machiavelli, Ugo Tognazzi, Liana Orfei
description: Film in three episodes due to three different hands. In the first, by D'Amico, a young man is attracted to a rather masculine woman. After the wedding she refuses any relationship and, indeed, decides to ... Luigi Zampa is the author of the episode entitled "Olga's husband": a man, in order to get hold of an inheritance linked to a strange clause, pushes his wife in the arms of a friend. In the episode of Dino Risi a thief gets caught by the police out of jealousy, but he is very happy because he has had proof of his wife's loyalty.
notes: Three episodes that would like to combine satire with social denunciation. In reality, three harmless farcical occasions. The best known is that of sex change, with Deaf.

title: Slam Dance
actors: Tom Hulce, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Millie Perkins, Harry Dean Stanton
description: Drood, a Los Angeles-based comic artist, is charged with the murder of Iolanda, the girl he has had an affair with since he separated from his wife. Persecuted by the police, Drood discovers that Iolanda was involved in a prostitution ring and was killed by order of the boss, a rich and untouchable lady. Other murders follow one another and the situation for Drood becomes difficult. Wang made his debut in 1985 with Dim Sum, a sui generis detective story set in the Chinese community of San Francisco. Here the game becomes a little open and pleased, even if conducted with brio for a good part of the film.

title: Kid Galahad
actors: Elvis Presley, Gig Young, Charles Bronson
description: Walter Gulick starts as a sparring partner in Willy Grogan's gym. But he is so good that he also starts playing matches and winning them. Then Rose, Willy's sister falls in love with him, and he decides to quit. There is still a match to be played and Willy wants to convince him to lose.
notes: Remake of the old Curtiz movie with Bogart and Edward G. Robinson "The Bronze Man". And there is no match between the two versions. Especially since Walter is played by Elvis Presley, certainly more effective as a singer than as a boxer. Curiously, the film was also released in Italy with a title that enhanced this latter aspect, namely "The executioner of the ring".

title: Il Bi e il Ba
actors: Nino Frassica, Marco Messeri, Leo Gullotta
description: Antonino Scannapieco doesn't have a lira, but he has a shocking speech. Having obtained the money from friends to go to Rome to consult a famous professor on the problem of dandruff, he actually leaves for the capital and hunts for various misadventures. Launched by Arbore, Frassica attempted this unique feature film as a protagonist with forgettable results both for him (which made people laugh on TV) and for the director Nichetti.

title: Sous le soleil de Satan
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Sandrine Bonnaire
description: The religious crisis of Father Donissan who is visited at night by a Satan disguised as a horse dealer. Palme d'Or in Cannes '87. From a novel by Georges Bernanos, one of Pialat's best films; an intense and powerful confrontation with the world of the writer, without giving anything to the public (who in fact whistled him at the award ceremony). Extraordinary performers, inevitable the comparison with "Ordet" in the scene of the miracle.

title: Marathon Man
actors: Dustin Hoffman, Laurence Olivier, Roy Scheider, Marthe Keller
description: A Jewish university student, all absorbed by his thesis and training for the New York marathon, finds himself unwillingly involved in an international intrigue between sadistic ex Nazis and stolen diamonds. From the novel by William Golding, a thriller that leaves no respite and manages to evoke disturbing ghosts. The film proceeds by assembling fragments of a puzzle, but the image that gradually comes together, far from becoming clarifying and reassuring, accumulates increasingly disturbing deceptions. The torture sequence in the dentist's chair is truly creepy, but the first love scene with Marthe Keller is also not bad. The confrontation of actors between Hoffmann and former Nazi criminal Laurence Olivier is magnificent.

title: Folks!
actors: Tom Selleck, Don Ameche, Anne Jackson, Christine Ebersole, Wendy Crewson
description: Jon Aldrich (Selleck), a successful Chicago businessman, is forced to host his parents at home. Mom Mildred has just recovered from an operation, while Dad Harry recently set fire to his Florida home. With Harry stoned, Jon for some strange reason wanted by the FBI and with a sister on the way, the situation is definitely in danger of precipitating. The plot is quite incongruous because the film is incongruent. Robert Klane, the writer of Weekend with the Dead, tries to repeat the coup, but here everything is wrong. Don Ameche has faded a bit, but Tom Selleck is not perfectly lucid either.

title: Giant
actors: Rock Hudson, Elizabeth Taylor, James Dean, Carroll Baker
description: Bick Benedict (Hudson), who comes from a family of wealthy Texan ranchers, marries Leslie (Taylor), a beautiful girl from Maryland. Jett (Dean), a farmhand who is hopelessly in love with Leslie, inherits a piece of land that turns out to be rich in oil. Jordy enrolls in medical school, then marries Juana, a Mexican. Judy is in rural economics school. With the Second World War, Jett grew enormously rich. During a party attended by the Benedict's, Bick discovers that Jett is courting his third child, Luz. For a rudeness done to Juana, the Benedict leave the party. In the old house, the two spouses rediscover serenity. The film is normally remembered for being the last of three played by James Dean, who died in a car accident before filming was even finished. It is a vigorous work, whose robust narrative rhythm has some bending only in the final part. The title giant is Texas, the largest of the fifty American states. Best Director Oscar.

title: The Bonfire of the Vanities
actors: Tom Hanks, Bruce Willis, Melanie Griffith, Morgan Freeman
description: Sherman McCoy, an established stock trader, goes on a date with his mistress, Maria Ruskin. By mistake, the couple find themselves in a bad neighborhood, where they are attacked by two black thugs. They manage to get out of it by running over one, which is then hospitalized in a coma. The other saw two numbers on the license plate and reported the accident. Eventually Sherman is identified and sent for trial. Peter Fallow, an unknown reporter determined to make the most of the occasion, finds a tape showing that it was not Sherman but Maria at the wheel of the car. The revelation causes a series of unforeseen consequences. De Palma starts from the homonymous novel by Tom Wolfe, without too much respect for the oleography of the Big Apple. We find ourselves immersed in a confused and frenetic humanity, from which nobody is saved: neither the representatives of the big white bourgeoisie, nor those of the black underclass, nor the reverend arruffapopolo, nor the chroniclers of dubious professional ethics. The register is the mocking one, but without any condescension towards the subject matter. Stellar cast and virtuoso staging.

title: Last Train from Gun Hill
actors: Kirk Douglas, Anthony Quinn, Carolyn Jones
description: Catherine, Indian and wife of Sheriff Pat Morgan, is raped and killed by Rick, son of Craig Belden, who is an old friend of the Sheriff. Pat soon traces the identity of the murderer and sets out on the hunt. He finally manages to reach him and frame him in a town that is outside his jurisdiction. John Sturges prefers situations of exasperated tension, when the clash becomes inevitable, beyond the intentions of the protagonists. There is no more space for the epic: the protagonists of the Frontier are lonely and tormented individuals, grappling with their moral and psychological conflicts without any collective breath. The inspiring model is "That Train to Yuma" by Delmer Daves.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes at the Whistle Train Stop
actors: Mary Stuart Masterson, Mary-Louise Parker, Kathy Bates, Jessica Tandy, Stan Shavy
description: Evelyn (Bathes), overweight and frustrated by her husband's indifference, makes friends in a hospice with the elderly Ninny (Tandy) who tells her, in installments, a story from many years before which has as protagonists two friends, Idgy (Masterson ) and Ruth (Parker), in a bar near a railroad (where the specialty is fried green tomatoes). Idgy grows wild and rebellious and frequents disreputable environments. She manages to convince her friend Ruth to leave her violent husband, whom she married against her will, and to keep her baby.
notes: Two films in one: the one about the present, with the story of Evelyn, her line problems and her marriage in crisis; and that of the past, with Idgy, Ruth and several supporting characters. But the first is treated trivially and that all the interest and merits (of richness of ideas, of narrative air and environmental reconstruction) reside in Ninny's story. So it happens that Masterson and Parker affect more than the very good Bates and Tandy.

title: Jim Thorpe, All-American
actors: Burt Lancaster, Charles Bickford, Steve Cochran, Phyllis Thaxter
description: Jim Thorpe is an Indian boy who goes to a college in Pennsylvania with little profit, but his physical education teacher discovers in him extraordinary skills as an athlete. Jim wins the 1912 Stockholm Olympics, gets married, but the death of his only son plunges him into alcoholism. Thanks to his former "coach", he became the coach of the children of his parish. Good biography of an athlete who, accused of professionalism, had to return the Olympic medals and then established himself in football. Curtiz tells with robust craft and avoids platitudes; Lancaster, struggling with sport, plays at home.

title: Out for Justice
actors: Steven Seagal, William Forsythe, Jerry Orbach, Jo Champa
description: Gino Felino is from Brooklyn: contrary to many of his Italian-American friends, who have all become small or large criminals, he decided to be a policeman. But now he is quite angry about the death of his colleague Bobby Lupo. To get justice, Gino arrests the killer's sister and father, a certain Richie Madano. So he goes to find Roxanne, his girlfriend, and finds her dead. But it is by talking to Bobby's widow that Gino discovers the motive. Steven Seagal is a man of a thousand talents. He is an expert in martial arts, he is an actor and he also writes the music for the film here. He already has three films behind him and a pigtail in the same place. If only he had some expression on his face it would be perfect. Even if it is certainly not the acting that counts in these films: and from this point of view, that is the brutally spectacular one, the audience is amply satisfied. Shootings and killings, in the most brutal ways, follow one another at a rapid pace, however, taking the action to the extreme of the grotesque.

title: The Concorde: Airport '79
actors: Alain Delon, George Kennedy, Susan Blakely, Sylvia Kristel, Robert Wagner, David Warner, Bibi Andersson, Eddie Albert, Sybil Danning
description: A Concorde is about to leave Washington for Moscow. The crew and passengers take their seats on the plane, including a well-known journalist who has documents with her that prove that the powerful businessman Kevin Harrison is an arms dealer. That's why Harrison wants to shoot down the plane. The first attempt is made with a surface-to-air missile and is avoided. In the vicinity of Paris a fighter attacks the Concorde, but the impact does not occur.
notes: Now in its fourth film, the series, inaugurated in 1970 with "Airport", shows heavy signs of fatigue. The narrative modules are the same: a gallery of types, the heroism of the pilots, the amorous complications. Stretched film and sluggish in acting and modest also in special effects.

title: La villa del venerdì
actors: Julian Sands, Joanna Pacula, Tchéky Karyo, Lara Wendel, Marco Di Stefano
description: Stefano and Alina are married and really love each other, but they have chosen to be an "open couple". While Stefano's trespasses are occasional and temporary, Alina ends up binding to Paolo in an increasingly intense sadomasochistic relationship. At this point Stefano becomes jealous and, while respecting the agreements, he no longer knows what to do.
notes: From a story by Moravia, Bolognini's film expands too much on a story that already left some perplexity in the original. The international cast is showcased, but it does not serve to avoid disaster. Armani clothes, Lanci photography, Morricone music.

title: Castle Keep
actors: Burt Lancaster, Patrick O'Neal, Jean-Pierre Aumont, Peter Falk
description: World War II: Major Falconer, Captain Beckman and seven American soldiers take up residence in Maldorais Castle, in the Ardennes. The count owner of the manor - eager to have a child - allows his wife to have a relationship with Falconer, but also wants to save the works of art kept in the building. His anxiety is shared by Beckman, an art scholar: who clashes with Falconer, determined to make Maldorais a defensive outpost against the Nazis ...
notes: A very special war film, which compares the values ??of culture and the sense of destruction of war. Based on a William Westlake novel.

title: Repo Man
actors: Harry Dean Stanton, Emilio Estevez, Tracey Walter, Olivia Barash
description: The feats of some car recovery workers held by defaulting buyers mix with the intrigues of crazed scientists, CIA, UFO sighters and radioactivity phenomena. Surprising first work by Alex Cox, photograph by Robby Müller.

title: The Blood of Heroes -The Salute of the Jugger
actors: Rutger Hauer, Joan Chen, Vincent D'Onofrio, Anna Katarina
description: In a bleak future Middle Ages. Groups of new gladiators, the Jaggers, are rampant. Sharko, at the head of one of these teams, wants to reach the Red City, to challenge the fearsome team led by an old friend of his Bonzo. It will succeed, after a long and adventurous phase of approach. A victory achieved, after a bloody confrontation, he will resume his wandering.
notes: Comic-book science fiction and action without too many problems, following a super-tested plot. In the role of Young Gar is Vincent D'Onofrio, Lardo Ball in "Full Metal Jacket" as well as Orson Welles in "Ed Wood".

title: The Assassination of Trotsky
actors: Richard Burton, Alain Delon, Romy Schneider, Valentina Cortese, Enrico Maria Salerno, Luigi Vannucchi, Jean Desailly, Simone Valère, Duilio Del Prete, Peter Chatel, Jack Batts, Michael Forest, Carlos Miranda, Joshua Sinclair, Pierangelo Civera
description: Lev Trotzky, founder of the IV International and opponent of Stalin, who took refuge in Mexico City, is assassinated by Frank Jackson, a cold-blooded hitman who transforms his gesture into the affirmation of an otherwise uncertain identity.
notes: A film of strong psychological tensions, in the manner of Losey that alternates the rhythms of the narrative and builds a discontinuous but dense charm story.

title: The Sign of the Pagan
actors: Jeff Chandler, Jack Palance, Rita Gam
description: The centurion Marcian is captured by the barbarians, but manages to free himself and reach Byzantium, the capital of the Eastern Empire. Here he meets and falls in love with Pulcheria, sister of the emperor Theodosius who, out of fear, prefers to pay tribute to Attila's Huns rather than face them in battle. The scourge of God then directs his hordes towards Italy where, however, he is stopped by Pope Leo. Meanwhile, Marciano was appointed general and, at the head of the Roman legions, inflicts definitive defeat on the Huns. A palace conspiracy finally brings him to the throne.
notes: Flamboyant historic melò at low cost, robust, even if it is certainly not worthy of Sirk.

title: Atlantis, the Lost Continent
actors: Anthony Hall, Joyce Taylor, John Dall
description: An adrift Atlantean princess is rescued, brought back and loved by a young Greek fisherman. A predictable adventurous tale.

title: Our Man Flint
actors: James Coburn, Lee J. Cobb, Gila Golan, Edward Mulhare, Benson Fong
description: On behalf of the world powers, Agent Flint (Coburn) takes out a diabolical secret organization that threatens the globe. Sparkling parody of the "007" genre, with a perfect Coburn.

title: La collera del vento
actors: Terence Hill, Mario Pordo, Carlo Alberto Cortina
description: We are in Andalusia, in the early years of the century. A landowner hires two brothers to kill the leaders of a clandestine trade union organization that has called a laborers' strike that has had the support of all the workers of the land. In carrying out their mission, however, the two find themselves taking sides on opposite sides: while one does not question the orders of the master, the other begins to reflect on the reasons of the strikers and goes to their side. Thus a fratricidal confrontation is looming.
notes: Eccentric and shipwrecked Italian-Spanish film with western echoes with a Terence Hill not yet voted to the cause of Trinità & C.

title: Seduced
actors: Gregory Harrison, Cybill Shepherd, José Ferrer
description: The lover of an ambitious politician is assassinated and he must find the killer to get up from the mess. Television production without infamy or glory, cheered by the fascinating charm of Cybill Shepherd.

title: The Hand that Rocks the Cradle
actors: Annabella Sciorra, Rebecca De Mornay, Matt McCoy, Ernie Hudson, Julianne Moore, Madeleine Zima
description: Claire Bartel, Emma's mother (5 years old), is harassed by Dr. Mott, a gynecologist. Claire denounces the doctor and so do other women. He commits suicide and his widow, Peyton, loses the child she was pregnant with. A few months later Claire gives birth to Joe. Determined to take revenge, Peyton hires the Bartel family as Joe's babysitter and sets up a monstrous web of initiatives.
notes: Although it is built on the portrait of a diabolical character, a true personification of evil, the film focuses rather on the lucid presentation of a "clinical case" absorbed by the thirst for revenge, made even more dramatic by the skill of Rebecca De Mornay. The direction doses the emotional progression of the story, letting itself be carried away only in the final by some smug savagery.

title: Salvador
actors: James Woods, John Savage, Michael Murphy, James Belushi
description: In 1980, journalist Richard Boyle left California with his friend Rock and went to Salvador, a supposed "paradise" where they both hope to be able to forget their many personal troubles. Instead they find themselves in the midst of a tragic situation, in which the most grim reactionary forces backed by the United States are raging ...
notes: The visual delirium of Stone (also screenwriter with the real Richard Boyle, here played by the usual great Woods) found its measure at the time in a melee with burning historical events, and limited the rhetoric. If the ideological enthusiasm overwhelms the clarity of the exhibition, many moments are exciting and spectacular.

title: Captain Carey, U.S.A.
actors: Alan Ladd, Francis Lederer, Wanda Hendrix
description: Captain Carey works with the partisans of the Lake Orta area. His secret refuge is in the villa De Cresci, where he has a sentimental affair with Countess Giulia. Raid by the Germans: Giulia arrested, Carey injured. At the end of the war, the American returns and realizes that he is suspected of treason. Giulia married Baron Greffi and Carey discovers that it was he who betrayed ... Curious Hollywood interest in the events of the Italian Resistance, revisited according to the forms of the genre film and with the appeal of the great star of the moment. The film that brought one of the great post-war hits to success: Mona Lisa.

title: Zappatore
actors: Mario Merola, Regina Bianchi, Gerardo Amato, Mara Venier, Michele Placido
description: With great sacrifices the farmer Francesco Esposito, owner of a small field, makes his son Mario study and leads him to graduate in law. The boy, who his parents would like to marry with his cousin Assuntina, falls in love with an American daughter of an electronic industrialist. He therefore abandons his family and Naples because he is ashamed of his origins. Only the imminent death of his mother will make him return home to his family.
notes: One of the most robust and convinced film scripts. Merola wallows, small parts for Placido and Venier!

title: Compartiment tueurs
actors: Catherine Allégret, Jacques Perrin, Simone Signoret, Yves Montand
description: On the train that connects Marseille with Paris, Bambi, a girl who has found a job in the capital, meets Daniel, a student who has escaped from a boarding school. When, upon arriving at their destination, everyone got off the train, only Daniel notices that a woman's body is in his compartment. The police begin their investigation by trying to identify everyone who has traveled in the carriage. But the mysterious killer is also looking for them.
notes: Costa-Gavras' first film, based on a novel by Sebastian Japrisot, is a thriller directed by profession. Finding traces of later films is a very difficult undertaking.

title: Cattle Annie and Little Britches
actors: Burt Lancaster, John Savage, Rod Steiger, Diane Lane
description: Towards the end of the last century, two orphan girls take the road to the West in search of adventures. They'll have plenty of them, including bandits and sheriffs, train assaults and saloon brawls. Of them, the girls, they put a spicy temper. The rest comes by itself, in a light-hearted little western.

title: Vendetta... sarda
actors: Walter Chiari, Mario Riva, Riccardo Billi, Carlo Croccolo
description: Two Sardinian cousins ??have long since emigrated for work to a large northern city. When a common relative dies, they are forced to return to their country of origin to settle inheritance issues. However, things are not that simple, as a real family feud is underway over the inheritance. Comedy with a curious setting, bizarre ideas and actors who at times amuse.

title: Absolution
actors: Richard Burton, David Bradley, Dominic Guard, Bill Connolly
description: A priest (Richard Burton), a teacher in a school for children, engages in an educational struggle with a sensitive and restless pupil. When the priest thinks he has achieved his goal, the boy will play a trick on him.
notes: Richard Burton in cassock is as comfortable as an elephant in the glassware shop. Eye-catching makeover of the "City of Boys"

title: The Guardian
actors: Martin Sheen, Louis Gossett jr., Arthur Hill, Maury Chaykin
description: Charlie convinces his roommates to hire a security guard, but the ensuing order hides the sheer lack of freedom for condominiums. Tense and disturbing television movie released in theaters, starring a good Martin Sheen

title: Il giudice ragazzino
actors: Giulio Scarpati, Sabrina Ferilli, Leopoldo Trieste, Regina Bianchi, Renato Carpentieri, Ileana Rigano, Marcello Perracchio, Roberto Nobile, Paolo De Vita, Turi Scalia, Ninni Bruschetta, Salvatore Puntillo, Giacinto Ferro
description: Rosario Livatino, one of the magistrates that President Cossiga defined "child judges" for their young age, acts as a substitute for the Agrigento prosecutor's office. He is one of the first to engage fully against the Mafia, helped by a Marshal of the Arma who will soon be murdered. His work knows more and more obstacles, until, on 21 September 1991, Livatino falls victim to an attack. A film of undeniable civil commitment that is deliberately kept by the author away from the narrative schemes typical of TV dramas. The impression one gets from it, however, is that of a story that has all too passed through a "cooled" reconstruction. Excellent Scarpati and Ferilli.

title: Validità giorni dieci
actors: Antonio Centa, Laura Solari, Sergio Tofano, Luigi Cimara
description: Paolo, a modest employee, finds a railway ticket for Venice and takes advantage of it for an unscheduled journey. In the hotel he knows Clara, a girl he exchanges for a thief and who is, instead, the official of a insurance company on the trail of a stolen necklace. By combining their efforts, the two recover the precious jewel and are preparing to live together. Without waste of fantasy, the film stands (so to speak) on stereotyped ideas, situations and characters, who already knew of stale at the time of its release.

title: La liceale al mare con l'amica di papà
actors: Renzo Montagnani, Alvaro Vitali, Marisa Mell, Gianni Ciardo
description: Married for twenty years, Massimo and Violante can't stand each other anymore. Massimo also has a lover, Laura, who he takes with him on holiday to the sea disguised as a nun. Two bandits kidnap Massimo, but Violante does not pay the ransom. Then they kidnap the woman and finally Massimo can enjoy the company of his lover, but it doesn't last long. Squalid little comedy like a hundred others in the vein.

title: Giornata nera per l'ariete
actors: Franco Nero, Ira Fürstenberg, Wolfgang Preiss, Rossella Falk, Pamela Tiffin
description: Andrea Bild gets to work for his newspaper on two news episodes. The first is an attack on a young English teacher, the second is the murder of a doctor's wife. The latter, however, who is a shareholder of the newspaper, ensures that Andrea is relieved of his post. From that moment the murders multiplied. Silver-like yellow with effects; not the best.

title: Lui, lei e il nonno
actors: Walter Chiari, Gilberto Govi, Yvonne Furneaux, Lauretta Masiero
description: A cannery industrialist from Naples, Commendatore Bordoni (Govi), sends his nephew Eugenio (Chiari) to the United States for a business trip. On his return, mostly to please his grandfather, Eugenio marries his secretary, whom he soon neglects. It will be the advances towards Gabriella by the American partner of the Bordoni to bring Eugenio back under the marital roof. Shy Italian attempt at comedy based on the exchange of wives. Govi and Chiari can give free rein to their comedy. But their interpretations do not save the film from banality.

title: Who's That Girl?
actors: Madonna, Griffin Dunne, Haviland Morris, John McMartin
description: Loudon is a shy lawyer who is getting married to his boss's daughter. The day before the wedding, however, he receives the assignment to accompany a thief, Nikki, from prison to the bus to Philadelphia, but she wants to find out the instigator of the murder of her boyfriend. He will succeed in an unpredictable way, even making Loudon fall in love with himself, who will eventually give up getting married.
notes: Madonna is a bit like her character from "Desperately Seeking Susan". The pace, however, is discontinuous: between comedy and action detective, the film does not know how to distribute its energies well. Foley had done better with "At Close Range".

title: The Owl
actors: Adrian Paul, Erika Flores, Patricia Charbonneau, Brian Thompson
description: The Owl (Adrian Paul) looks like a real tough guy when he shows up in his flak jacket and heavily armed, but he actually has a heart of gold. When little Lisa asks him to find his father for him, he doesn't think twice about helping her. The dad in question is a biochemist, who has synthesized a new steroid with miraculous properties, and for the Owl it starts with this S.O.S. a new adventure.
notes: Which in reality was also the only one, since this pilot has never been transformed into a TV series. The character, who comes from comics, is not bad, but the direction manages to crush any ambitions. Good photography by Steve Yaconelli.

title: Cerasella
actors: Claudia Mori, Terence Hill, Luigi De Filippo, Alessandra Panaro, Carlo Croccolo
description: Having fled shortly before the wedding in order not to marry the boyfriend she does not love, Cerasella meets Bruno, a nice and rich man but engaged to Nora, who is only interested in his money. The two fall in love, but Nora slanders Cerasella ...
notes: Matarazzo returns to directing after two years, but the outcome is disappointing. Girotti is the future Terence Hill.

title: Pony Express
actors: Charlton Heston, Forrest Tucker, Rhonda Fleming, Jan Sterling
description: The strenuous struggle between Buffalo Bill and his friend Wild Bill Hickok, who want to activate a Pony Express service between Missouri and California, and a group of breeders who oppose it. Jerry Hopper takes up a true story, that of the birth of the Pony Express, and makes it a slightly too romanticized western. At the time the story unfolds, Buffalo Bill was between eleven and fourteen - too little even for someone as quick as he was.

title: In This Our Life
actors: Bette Davis, Olivia de Havilland, Charles Coburn, George Brent
description: Stanley leaves her boyfriend and runs away with her sister's ex-husband. But the man, having discovered the perverse character of the woman, kills himself.
