Stanley returns home where he tries to win back his ex-boyfriend, now tied to his sister. Blinded by jealousy, Stanley runs away in a car and runs over a girl, killing her daughter; then she tries to have a black man blamed but, unmasked, she kills herself. Great performance of Davis in one of the toughest and most dramatic roles of her career, from a Pulitzer Prize winning novel.

title: Escape from Fort Bravo
actors: William Holden, Eleanor Parker, John Forsythe, William Demarest
description: At Fort Bravo, Arizona, at the time of the Civil War, a Confederate garrison was held captive by the Northerners. The fort's surroundings are infested with the Mescaleros Indians. During an escape attempt, the prisoners and pursuers are attacked by the Indians who hold them in a deadly siege.
notes: Good western that attempts to combine the classic themes of the genre with the more sentimental ones of love rivalry.

title: Amanti senza amore
actors: Clara Calamai, Roldano Lupi, Jean Servais
description: Piero, a young doctor, and Nora get married but soon realize they have nothing in common. Not even the birth of a daughter can bring them closer together and save a marriage that is heavily compromised. Nora, among other things, begins to take an interest in a famous violinist, thus arousing the jealousy of her husband who, exacerbated, one day decides to face his rival. The outcome of the meeting will prove to be dramatic. The film is based on the short story "The sonata in Kreutzer" by Tolstoy, but it only keeps the external aspects of the plot. Good, however, the performance of Clara Calamai, diva of the time.

title: It's My Turn
actors: Jill Clayburgh, Michael Douglas, Charles Grodin, Dianne Wiest
description: Kate Gunzinger is a woman who sincerely believes that everything in her life goes smoothly. She is satisfied with her job as a math teacher and lives in Chicago with Homer, a divorced real estate agent. One day Kate goes to New York with the intention of doing a job interview and attending her father's wedding. Upon arriving in the Big Apple, Kate finds many surprises. Over a dinner at a Central Park restaurant, she discovers that she is wrong about her stepmother and that she gets along well with her stepbrother Ben.
notes: Film without excessive pretensions. Debut for Dianne Wiest.

title: Love and Death
actors: Woody Allen, Diane Keaton, Harold Gould
description: Story of a perfect coward during the Napoleonic wars. Some Allenian gems in the midst of a reinterpretation of the famous Russian novel.

title: First Blood
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Richard Crenna, Brian Dennehy, David Caruso
description: John Rambo, a Vietnam veteran, lives in search of a job and his psychic balance. After being arrested and mistreated, Rambo breaks free and escapes. Hunted by lawmakers, he quickly knocks them out. It is called the National Guard, but for the former Green Beret it's child's play to keep it in check. Eventually Rambo surrenders to his former colonel, who has come from Washington on purpose.
notes: Unlike the two sequels, the first "Rambo" is anything but a video game. Kotcheff is skilled enough to keep a story in tension that risks running out of interest quickly. Beautiful photography and a good sense of the landscape, which recalls the image of "Vietnam in one's own home". Stallone, who also collaborates on the script, manages to give credibility to the character. He would then have plenty of time to make him lose it.

title: La liceale seduce i professori
actors: Gloria Guida, Alvaro Vitali, Fabrizio Moroni, Lino Banfi
description: Angela is not devoured by the thirst for knowledge but, since there is a high school where her uncle is the principal, she enrolls. However, her relationship with the school head does not make things easier, especially with the young, but particularly severe, history teacher. Angela then decides to make him fall in love and she does it so well that love becomes mutual.
notes: A typical example of junk cinema, the film asks the actors to give what little they have in acting and the actresses what they have in sex appeal. It follows that the global level of the film can only be disheartening.

title: The Two Jakes
actors: Jack Nicholson, Harvey Keitel, Meg Tilly, Madeleine Stowe
description: Jake Gittes is a private investigator who Jake Berman asks to follow his wife, suspected of infidelity. Gittes manages to catch the woman who meets that Mark Bodine and photograph them, just before Berman, who arrives, fires on his rival. Gittes also discovers that Berman and Bodine were rivals in a shady oil development deal and that the woman is the daughter of Catherine Mulrway, an old flame. The investigation will lead to drama. Jack Nicholson reprises the character of the Chinatown detective, but there was Polanski behind the camera. Here is a muddled yellow ennobled only by the presence of Harvey Keitel.

title: Cabaret
actors: Liza Minnelli, Joel Grey, Michael York, Helmut Griem, Marisa Berenson
description: In Berlin in 1931 Sally Bowles is the star of a cabaret, shyly courted by Brian. Then comes Nazism. Between famous numbers ("Money, money") the air of time is effectively restored. Oscar for Liza Minnelli, for Fosse, for music, photography and also for the great Joel Gray.

title: Miracolo a Milano
actors: Emma Gramatica, Francesco Golisano, Paolo Stoppa
description: Little Totò ends up in an orphanage after the death of Lolotta who, after having found him under a cabbage, had taken him with her. Once he grows up he manages to miraculously defend, also thanks to the intervention of the spirit of his deceased godmother, a group of poor people who live in an area on the outskirts of Milan, victims of the maneuvers of an unscrupulous speculator. Masked by the tones of the fairy tale, the film is a fierce denunciation of oppression. When the class struggle fails, only the weapons of utopia and hope that do not die remain. One of the best scripts by Cesare Zavattini that can rightly be placed before De Sica in the role of "author" of the film.

title: The Deer Hunter
actors: Robert De Niro, Christopher Walken, John Savage, Meryl Streep, John Cazale
description: Mike (De Niro), Nick (Walken) and Steven (Savage) work at a steel mill in Clayton, Pennsylvania, and hunt deer in their free time. They are called up to be sent to Vietnam, but Steven marries Angela first. In war, the three friends suffer a terrible imprisonment. When they manage to escape, they are separated: Steven is in a hospital, paralyzed; Nick goes into hiding in Saigon, prey of the Russian roulette organizers; Mike, back home, comforts Linda, Nick's girlfriend; on a hunt, spare a deer within range; then convinces Steven to reunite with his wife. Back in chaotic, hellish Saigon in complete decay, Mike tries in vain to stop Nick from one last, deadly match.
notes: The film is divided into three parts: life before the call to arms (a chapter of exceptional vigor), the war with its atrocities and the return to Saigon. Michael Cimino, in his second direction, achieves a prodigy of narrative mastery in a film of extreme complexity and leads all the performers to an acting of absolute excellence. Romance of great tradition, powerful allegory and an attempt at epic catharsis, the film won 5 Oscars: best film, best direction, supporting actor (Walken), editing and sound.

title: Neapolitanische Geschwister
actors: Ida Di Benedetto, Romeo Giro, Antonio Orlando, Tiziana Ambretti, Maria Antonietta Riegel
description: Maria Pagano, wife of an unemployed man, gives birth to Vittoria and Massimo, only to die when it seems to begin a period of prosperity for Naples and, consequently, also for the woman's family. Later, Vittoria, after many vicissitudes, has to provide for her father and brother who has become a fervent Communist, convinced that the party can solve his long-standing problems.
notes: Award-winning in various festivals, the film is perhaps richer in ambitions than in authentic validity, rather schematic in the presentation of the social and political framework in which the characters act. However, the author's narrative style is very interesting.

title: Treacherous Crossing
actors: Lindsay Wagner, Angie Dickinson, Grant Show, Charles Napier, Mel Harris
description: Lindsay Gates (Lindsay Wagner) is a beautiful young heiress about to spend her honeymoon on a cruise. The problem is that, shortly after leaving, the new husband disappears without a trace. So it turns out that Lindsay may be young and rich, but she already has a rather turbulent past with a stay in a psychiatric hospital and a previous husband who committed suicide. Dull remake of Joe M. Newman's 1953 "Dangerous Crossing", based on a short story by John Dickson Carr. Over the years, the story has become more and more obvious. Over the years, even Angie Dickinson is no longer the same.

title: Il ritorno di Zanna Bianca
actors: Franco Nero, Virna Lisi, John Steiner, Raimund Harmstorf, Renato Cestié
description: The misadventures in Klondyke of little Bill, his grandfather John Tarwater and a wolf dog named White Fang, struggling with the evil Beauty Smith. The Jack London epic has nothing to do with this hodgepodge, made by Lucio Fulci with the waste of the western spaghetti.

title: Hopscotch
actors: Walter Matthau, Glenda Jackson, Ned Beatty, Herbert Lom
description: Mile Kendig, a CIA agent, concludes an operation against the KGB by having two spies arrested, but voluntarily freeing Colonel Yaskov, head of Soviet espionage in Western Europe. To punish him, his was a completely personal initiative, the head of his section, Myerson decides to relegate him to the archives of the CIA, thus removing all active positions. Kendig reacts by destroying her own file. He reaches Salzburg and settles in his home to devote himself to writing a novel that reveals all the mistakes made by the CIA.
notes: Matthau is even more irresistible than James Bond.

title: Zamri, oumri, vokresni
actors: Pavel Nazarov, Dinara Drukarova, Elena Popova
description: We are in 1947. Valerka, twelve years old, lives in Sutchan, in Siberia, a village in which there is a concentration camp and a mine. Valerka is a friend of Galia, the only one who can understand him. Valerka is accused of derailing the train. He escapes and is recruited by a gang of thieves. Galia will still be the one to save him at the cost of his own life. Kanevski mercilessly records, in a series of stark portraits, the brutal life of the village and the inhuman strength of power, where love can be the only redemption. One of the most beautiful films of perestroika, an example of revived nouvelle vague on the rubble of the Soviet Union.

title: The Last Boyscout
actors: Bruce Willis, Damon Wayans, Chelsea Field, Danielle Harris
description: As a secret agent he had saved the President but now, fallen from grace, Detective Joe Hallenbeck lives for the day and is abandoned by his wife and daughter, because he has made a mistress. In addition, the black stripper Corey, who was supposed to protect, is killed. Together with Corey's boyfriend Jimmy Dix, he sets out in search of the killers. The two thus end up on the trail of a shady businessman who will be able to unmask only after daring chases and breathtaking actions. Bruce Willis seems to have specialized in tough but easy-to-beat detective roles. And it is precisely the irony with which the story is dealt with the aspect that differentiates this film from others of the genre.

title: If Looks Could Kill
actors: Richard Grieco, Linda Hunt, Roger Rees, Gabrielle Anwar
description: A high school student, traveling with his school in Paris, is mistaken for an undercover secret agent. He, who is an exuberant, does nothing to prove otherwise. On the contrary, he gets a taste for the new situation, also because there is an organization that is ready to provide him with fast cars, elegant clothes and beautiful women. But then things change and the student is forced to deal with enemy agents. We are not much above the usual American teen film. Still, seeing Linda Hunt as the villain is always a good time. Not to mention that there's Gabrielle Anwar (Scent of a Woman), which alone makes the film worth seeing.

title: Wild Orchid II: Two Shades of Blue
actors: Nina Siemaszko, Wendy Hughes, Tom Skerritt, Joe Dallesandro, Brendan Fraser
description: The young Blue remained orphaned when her father, alcoholic and trumpeter, made herself killed in a car accident. The virginity had already lost it with Jules, the owner of a jazz club, so it is not a big problem for her if the only person ready to help her is Elle, the mistress of a brothel. And that's how it then arrives on the set of porn movies.
notes: The trouble by Zalman King, former screenwriter of "9 and a half weeks", is that he is boring. From a declaredly erotic film one does not wait for the philosophical discussions. But he would like at least the protagonist to resemble a zombie.

title: Betrayed
actors: Debra Winger, Tom Berenger, Betsy Blair, John Mahoney
description: Cathy Weaver works for the FBI. Under the identity of Katie Philips she is sent to the Midwest to investigate the murder of an anti-racist Jewish journalist. The investigation leads her to suspect Gary Simmons, a farmer, war hero and not so bad. With him Cathy / Katie starts a relationship. Except Cathy discovers that it's all true and that Gary is really a lousy racist. Screenwriter Joe Eszterhas (the one from Basic Instinct and Sliver) plays here on the contrast between love and loyalty to the sacred principles of humanity and even the FBI. The result in the end is not so upsetting that it makes you jump in your chair.

title: Dio perdona... io no!
actors: Terence Hill, Bud Spencer, Frank Wolff, Gina Rovere, José Manuel Martín
description: Among various agents and outlaws, Terence Hill and Bud Spencer also chase a runaway robber with $ 300,000 in gold. The couple, who will later become famous with the Trinity series, is the protagonist of a traditional and well-made Italian western, even if their formula of good-natured punishers has not yet been tested.

title: La muerte viviente
actors: Boris Karloff, Julissa, Carlos East
description: On the island of Kulabai, Captain Labiche tries to stop the activity of a mad scientist. Boris Karloff, now semi-paralyzed, in one of his latest films.

title: Il cavaliere, la morte e il diavolo
actors: Paolo Bonacelli, Mirella D'Angelo, Piero Vida, Francesco Costa
description: Dad, mom and eleven-year-old daughter in a distressing intrigue between dream and reality. Irritating psycho-magical-erotic mess.

title: Eye of the Devil
actors: David Niven, Deborah Kerr, Emlyn Williams
description: Its vineyards have not borne fruit for three years, so the noble Marquis Philippe de Bellac reaches the old family fiefdom to understand what is happening. The cause of the mystery is not of natural origin, but, what is worse, he discovers that to break the spell he must undergo an ancient pagan rite.
notes: Devilish thrills with the wrong cast. Wrong in the sense that it is too sumptuous for a rather modest film.

title: Of Human Bondage
actors: Paul Henreid, Eleanor Parker
description: A good London boy in Paris falls in love with a beautiful and not very serious waitress, and for her he torments himself and becomes brutish. Flattened remake of the '34 bel mélo with Leslie Howard and Bette Davis, from the Somerset Maugham novel.

title: Bye Bye Vietnam
actors: Christopher Alan, Antonio Sabato, Graham Scott
description: A platoon of marines on a mission in the Vietnamese jungle storms an enemy "sanctuary" to free a captive American pilot. Homemade production film.

title: The Gang That Couldn't Shoot Straight
actors: Jerry Orbach, Leigh Taylor-Young, Robert De Niro
description: Two gangs of Italian-American gangsters, a bit bungling, "work" and fight in New York. Unsuccessful black comedy, based on a bestseller by Jimmy Breslin with the young De Niro in a minor role.

title: The War Wagon
actors: John Wayne, Kirk Douglas, Bruce Dern, Howard Keel, Keenan Wynn, Emilio Fernández
description: After unjustly serving a jail term, gunslinger Taw Jackson returns home determined to take revenge on Frank Pierce, the dishonest landowner who took away his ranch and mine. The plan is to rob a heavily guarded stagecoach transporting Pierce's gold, and to achieve this, Jackson allies himself with the killer Lomax, his former enemy, and with an Indian adventurer ...
notes: Counterpoint work between classic western and comedy, with John Wayne and Kirk Douglas ironic old lions. Kennedy likes to contaminate the genre with parody accents, and in this case the attempt has a pleasant outcome. The tragic depth of the epic of the West is very lightened, but it is felt.

title: Regarding Henry
actors: Harrison Ford, Annette Bening, Bill Nunn, Mikki Allen
description: Henry is a very skilled lawyer. His latest professional success came at the expense of a poor man, a certain Matthews, who had sued the managers and doctors of a hospital in court for a therapeutic error that had caused him irreversible damage. Henry, by hiding evidence, had his clients exonerated. But one evening the lawyer was seriously injured during a robbery. He falls into a coma, and after a long period of treatment he wakes up completely devoid of memory. Determined to start a new life, Henry proposes to his wife Sarah to start all over again, giving a clean break to previous habits. To remedy his past misdeeds, Henry then begins by providing Matthews with evidence to reopen the case.
notes: Nichols takes charge, aided by Harrison Ford's trustworthy face, and signs a film shamelessly devoted to good feelings. Cinema poster against careerism of the Eighties.

title: Maciste contro i mongoli
actors: Mark Forest, José Greci, Grazia Maria Spina, Ken Clark, Howard Ross
description: Maciste, the strong defender of the weak and oppressed, comes into conflict with the sons of Genghis Kahn who hold the White Princess prisoner. The tyrants want the woman to reveal to them the hiding place of a very rich treasure. After inane battles, tournaments, betrayals and reversals in the face, Maciste defeats the wicked and can also fulfill his dream of love by marrying Bianca. The film is one of the countless mass-produced products shot in the 1960s. And, between muscles with camphor oil and papier-mâché backdrops, a little irony emerges.

title: Samurai Cowboy
actors: Hiromi Go, Catherine M. Stewart, Matt McCoy
description: A Japanese manager, fixed with western cinema, moves to America, in Montana, to make a dream caressed for a long time: live like the heroes of his films and become an authentic, rude cowboy. Buyed a farm and a herd, the game seems to be done, but the matter proves to be less simple than expected because the classic speculator on duty is involved that wants to get your hands on the valley for the shady ends of him. The improvised almond -eyed cowboy does not have an easy task, but its resources are unpredictable. It is the fault of the success of "Scappe from the city - Life, love and cows" if films come out like this. Despite everything, however, the Japanese pop star Hiromi Go makes her character acceptable.

title: La polizia incrimina, la legge assolve
actors: Franco Nero, Fernando Rey, Delia Boccardo, Silvano Tranquilli, James Whitmore
description: Between Genoa and Marseille, two rival gangs compete for drug trafficking. Inspector Belli is on their trail. He arrests "the Lebanese", but some hitmen kill him because he doesn't speak. Belli, suspecting that a well-known industrialist is hiding behind the traffic, asks his superior (who already has a rich dossier on the suspect) to be able to frame him.
notes: The film is a dignified detective story that tackles with a raw and violent tone, typical of the genre, a discourse on the connivance between financial power and crime. Castellari's usual job in action scenes. The film was a huge success.

title: Napoli spara
actors: Henry Silva, Leonard Mann, Jeff Blynn, Evelyne Stewart, Massimo Deda
description: The bandit Santoro, thanks to the support given to him by the "godfather" Don Alfonso, puts Naples on fire: he attacks banks, hijacks and robs a train, kills anyone who comes within range and blows up entire buildings. Commissioner Belli tries in every way to capture him but, when he succeeds, Santoro escapes. At this point only a bullet can stop him ...
notes: Rather grim Neapolitan version of the Italian detective story.

title: Un mauvais fils
actors: Patrick Dewaere, Yves Robert, Brigitte Fossey
description: He returns home after five years in prison in the US for drug use and drug dealing. Dad rejects him, he moves in with Catherine and resumes taking drugs. The low and marginal floors of Eighties society narrated in plain language by the director of A heart in winter.

title: Night Must Fall
actors: Albert Finney, Susan Hampshire, Mona Washbourne
description: A handsome and well-mannered young man, but in reality a psychopath, he wins the trust of a rich old lady.

title: Un meurtre est un meurtre
actors: Catherine Spaak, Jean-Claude Brialy, Stéphane Audran
description: Jean kills Paul's paralytic wife and wants five million francs so as not to put the blame on him. Good tension and exceptional cast, but the developments of the story are predictable. In a secondary role the director Claude Chabrol.

title: Young Bess
actors: Jean Simmons, Stewart Granger, Charles Laughton, Deborah Kerr
description: The early years of the reign of Elizabeth I of England (Simmons), daughter of Henry VIII and Anne Boleyn, and her conflicted love affair with Admiral Tom Seymour (Granger). When he is imprisoned and sentenced, she finds herself helplessly witnessing the plots of the palace. Elizabeth ascends the throne always keeping the memory of the admiral in her heart and will never marry. Costumed drama without quality, with Laughton remaking Henry VIII as in an old Korda movie.

title: Humoresque
actors: Joan Crawford, John Garfield, Oscar Levant
description: The son of a grocer, Paul becomes a famous violinist thanks to the protection of a wealthy lady. Rich melodrama about the afflictions of high society, well directed and performed, with some surprising visionary peaks.

title: Woman Times Seven
actors: Shirley MacLaine, Peter Sellers, Rossano Brazzi
description: Portraits of seven women, from the widow to the stewardess, from the betrayed bride to the flirtatious wife. Comedy with an international cast typical of the time, written by Zavattini, directed by De Sica and produced in the USA.

title: Green Fire
actors: Stewart Granger, Grace Kelly, Paul Douglas, John Ericson, Murvyn Vye
description: Taken by a fever of wealth, he quarrels with his partners and his fiancée over an emerald mine, but in the end he gives up everything out of love. Good action sequences neutralized by boring dialogue and sentimentality.

title: T'amerò sempre
actors: Elsa De Giorgi, Nino Besozzi, Mino Doro, Robert Pizani
description: Adriana (De Giogi) was made a mother and then abandoned by Count Diego (Doro). The young woman is hired as a clerk in an elegant perfumery and a shy accountant (Besozzi) who works in the same company falls in love with her. But here is the count again, who would like Adriana as a lover; the clerk, however, finds the courage to put him at the door. Dealing with a typical subject of popular literature, Camerini draws from it a sober film of admirable style. Ten years later, starring Alida Valli, the director will remake the same film.

title: Le due tigri
actors: Massimo Girotti, Luigi Pavese, Sandro Ruffini, Alanova
description: The fanatic leader of the bloodthirsty Indian tribe of the Thugs kidnaps a girl to make her the priestess of the goddess Kali. The father of the unfortunate woman asks Sandokan for help who, with the "tigers", goes in search of her. After various vicissitudes, the decisive battle takes place in the temple of the goddess: fight to the death, extermination of the Thugs and salvation of the girl. Salgari's novel of the same name was one of the cult of adventure literature for those who were, at the time, the right age. Simonelli does all he can to maintain, with the non-pharaonic means at his disposal, the epic and exotic charm.

title: Code Name: Vengeance
actors: Robert Ginty, Shannon Tweed, Cameron Mitchell, James Ryan
description: In a third world country, a group of guerrillas, led by Tabrak, kidnaps the wife and daughter of King Tabal Tasrallah. There is only one man in the world capable of fighting on equal terms with Tabrak: Munro Beeler, but it so happens that he is temporarily in prison. Promptly released by the American authorities, Beeler accepts the mission and frees the hostages. It would be nice to say that David Winters is one who is more comfortable in horror than in action cinema. But also his musical version of Dr. Jekyll and mr. Hyde with Kirk Douglas was heartbreaking. In any case, action cinema is not for him.

title: The Perils of Pauline
actors: Betty Hutton, John Lund, Billy De Wolfe, William Demarest
description: We are at the beginning of the century, when cinema was taking its first steps and Pearl White was young. Pearl and her friend Julia have just left Mike Ferrington's theater company, which Pearl is in love with. Julia accepts a role in a comedy movie and, sooner or later, gets a pie in the face. Pearl is indignant and acts like a devil to defend her friend's honor. She will be immediately engaged. It is the biography of an early film diva. Marshall's reconstruction isn't exactly faithful, but it's fun enough.

title: Underworld
actors: George Bancroft, Evelyn Brent, Clive Brook, Fred Kholer
description: Bull, a Chicago gangster, takes the tramp called "Rolls Royce" as his lieutenant, but a sympathy arises between him and the gangster's girlfriend. When another gangster attempts to kidnap the woman, Bull kills him. Arrested and then escaped, he takes refuge from "Rolls Royce". Sure he hasn't been betrayed by the two, he lets himself be captured again; the woman and "Rolls Royce" are now free to love each other.
notes: With this film the director influenced the French cinema of the thirties and the whole subsequent gangster movie. His irrepressible vocation for visionary emphasis and Baroque formalism remains intact. Story by Ben Hecht (and Howard Hawks, uncredited).

title: The Amsterdam Kill
actors: Robert Mitchum, George Cheung, Bradford Dillman, Leslie Nielsen
description: A big Chinese drug dealer wants to get out of the loop. So he asks for help from former policeman Larry Quinlan, who has been disbarred for the habit of drinking. In Hong Kong, Larry and his team land a few hits against the traffickers, but some of the policemen play double crosses and accuse Larry of treason; he is thus excluded from the investigation. However, it will be Larry who will unmask his colleagues and stop the traffic. It is a dignified action detective story certainly ennobled by the presence, always great, of Mitchum.

title: The Deadly Affair
actors: James Mason, Maximilian Schell, Harriet Andersson, Simone Signoret
description: Samuel Fennan works in the British counter-intelligence office. One day an anonymous phone call arrives claiming that Fennan is an untrustworthy individual. Shortly after this phone call arrives, Fennan dies. Agent Dobbs is in charge of the investigation, although his superiors quickly dismiss the fact as suicide. Dobbs then gets fired to continue the investigation, at the end of which he finds the culprit. The film is based on one of the most famous novels by John Le Carré, although the story was partially reworked during the script. The atmosphere is disturbing and dramatic, a mixture of murky and sentimental.

title: Blind Date
actors: Hardy Krüger, Stanley Baker, Micheline Presle, Robert Flemyng
description: The young painter Jan Van Rooyen is found by the police in a house where a woman has just been killed. Van Rooyen hastily recognizes his mistress in the victim, but rejects the murder charge. He tells of his love affair to Inspector Morgan, who finds him guilty even when it turns out that she was receiving money from a diplomat. But the truth is full of surprises. Losey, a "fugitive" from America, paints with shrewd critical attention the environment in which he places the story and is careful to bring out the psychological dimension of the characters. Direction accurate for the contents and elegant in its formal aspects.

title: The Electric Horseman
actors: Robert Redford, Jane Fonda, Valerie Perrine, Willie Nelson
description: Sonny Steel was a five-time rodeo world champion and is now handsomely paid for a cereal company's advertising carnivals. One day he must ride a splendid stallion who has been dangerously stuffed with tranquilizers. Sonny kidnaps him and takes refuge in the prairies where he was born. An enterprising telereporter assembles the "case", finds it and helps it. Less mean than other times, Pollack still manages to give some hints to some aspects of contemporary America. Nothing very new, but a story conducted with brio and well acted.

title: V. I. Warshawski
actors: Kathleen Turner, Jay O. Sanders, Angela Goethals, Charles Durning
description: Vic is a forty-year-old from Chicago, an expert in martial arts, a detective by profession. He falls in love with Boom Boom, a former hockey player, who tragically dies leaving his 13-year-old daughter Kat in Vic's own custody. Japanese speculators are planning a new port complex and Boom Boom has been killed by his brother who also wants to eliminate Kat. It is at this point that Vic steps in, with his journalist friend Murray ... Despite the presence of Kathleeen Turner, who plays for her part, the film was not kissed by a great success. However, the story unfolds according to narrative and spectacular mechanisms oiled by a long tradition of genre even if, obviously, a little predictable.

title: The Man without a Face
actors: Mel Gibson, Nick Stahl, Margaret Whitton, Gaby Hoffmann
description: 12-year-old Chuck, fatherless, lives with his mother and two half-sisters in a Maine village. Chuck would like to be a pilot, like his father, but to try he must find a guardian. The boy turns to McLeod, a mysterious and misanthropic man who retired from school after being disfigured in an accident in which one of his students died. On the occasion of his passage behind the camera, Mel Gibson does not give up the role of the protagonist, but, with a certain amount of reverse exhibitionism, he decides to do without sex appeal and act behind a plastic mask. The story, tearful as much as you want, is however treated with a certain sobriety.

title: Big Wednesday
actors: Gary Busey, Jan-Michael Vincent, William Katt, Patti D'Arbanville
description: In the summer of '62 Jack, Matt and Leroy are young, carefree and absolutely crazy about surfing. Their life mostly spends on the beach waiting for the "big wave" to prove their worth. Then comes Vietnam. Jack spends three years in the hell of war. The other two manage to avoid the front. In the spring of 1974, on the occasion of a violent storm, the three find themselves back on the beach. Life has changed them and their friendship is now exhausted. But all still in love with surfboards are waiting, perhaps for the last time, for the big wave that is coming. A film that gradually grows to become an epic generational film. Great aquatic shots and poignant melancholy.

title: Die Geduld der Rosa L.
actors: Barbara Sukowa, Daniel Olbrychski, Otto Sander, Doris Schade
description: Rosa Luxemburg was born in Poland, but at the time, we are at the end of the nineteenth century, it was the Tsar who ruled in those lands and it was the Tsar who sent her to jail, years later, when the girl began to show socialist sympathies. Having passed to Germany, Luxemburg takes sides against the impending war and ends up in prison again. Freed at the end of the conflict, she was killed in January 1919. Margarethe Von Trotta's luck is to have an actress like Barbara Sukova, who won the Palme d'Or at Cannes (but Olbrychski should not be forgotten too). But the film is didactic in the worst sense, simplistic and heavy.

title: L'arbitro
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Joan Collins, Gabriella Pallotta, Ignazio Leone
description: The meeting will be refereed by Mr. Carmelo Lo Cascio from Acireale. And Mr. Lo Cascio is really a man of one piece, a maniac of impartiality and honor. All until one evening he meets the journalist Elena Sperani. Between the two begins a secret relationship that undermines Carmelo's physical integrity (forced to resort to amphetamines to referee) and above all the psychic one.
notes: The intent was to propose a comedy of manners that mocked the vices of the Italians, but with a smile on his lips. What comes out, on the other hand, is the usual sham, a little haggard and a little itchy, with the usual, unwatchable Buzzanca.

title: The Toy
actors: Richard Pryor, Jackie Gleason, Ned Beatty, Scott Schwartz
description: U.S. Bates is the tycoon of the city. Ten-year-old son Eric, who has arrived to spend a week's vacation with his parents, can choose the toy of his choice as a gift. The spoiled little boy does not find better than to set his sights on a black salesman, Jack.
notes: A Hollywood remake of Francis Veber's debut film, "Le jouet," is a comedy about the conflict between the power of money and that of friendship. Compared to the original film, Donner's (somewhat naively) declares an opportunistic reference to Capra. Overall, the show, while not exalting, works.

title: Love, Honor & Obey: The Last Mafia Marriage
actors: Eric Roberts, Nancy McKeon, Tomas Milian, Ben Gazzara
description: Rosalie, niece of boss Joe Profaci, is induced to marry Bill, son of the legendary Joe Bonanno. She was raised and educated in a convent: she knows nothing of the trafficking on which her family's wealth is based, but she soon realizes the situation. Will her honesty, perseverance and love change her husband?
notes: Patterson's TV movie aims to show the public and the private of a "mafia couple" of important lineage, in search of a truth that goes beyond the judicial news. Ultimately, however, he chooses the staging of the traditional dynamics of feelings. Based on a novel by Rosalie Bonanno.

title: Anselmo ha fretta
actors: Gino Cervi, Gina Lollobrigida, Ave Ninchi, Nando Bruno
description: On the day of his wedding, Anselmo Brunelli has a series of misadventures that get him into trouble with his bride.
notes: A discreet comedy enhanced by the skill of Gino Cervi and the beauty of Gina Lollobrigida in the part of the bride who waits in vain for Anselmo's arrival.

title: That Lucky Touch
actors: Roger Moore, Susannah York, Shelley Winters, Lee J. Cobb, Raf Vallone
description: The great maneuvers of NATO are taking place in Brussels. Arms trafficker Michael Scott (determined to do big business) and anti-militarist journalist Julia Richardson also arrive on the scene. The reporter will mess up the arms merchant's business, but she will fall in love with him. It is a funny, light-hearted and unassuming comedy based on the good characterizations of the characters.

title: Un tenero tramonto
actors: Mel Ferrer, Cristiana Borghi, Patrick La Place, Laura De Marchi
description: Franz Bollenstein is a shady individual dedicated, among other things, to the export of currency. One day, jealous of his stepdaughter Nicoletta's rich heritage, he instructs Antonio, his trusted man, to track down the girl (who has since run away from home) and lock her up in a Swiss clinic. Antonio however falls in love with Nicoletta thus triggering a tragic chain of fate. Dull and goofy drama of a notorious tear-movies specialist.

title: Confortorio
actors: Emidio Simini, Franco Pistoni, Emanuele Carucci
description: We are in 1736, in Rome. Abramo Cajvani and Angeluccio della Riccia, two Jews found guilty of burglary, are sentenced to the gallows. According to the practice, the comforting fathers of the Archconfraternity of San Giovanni Decollato try by every means to convert them in the last hours, to save at least their souls. But the two turn out to be stronger than expected and keep faith in their religion. Benvenuti's film, which had its debut with "Il bacio di Giuda", is based on a research that has reconstructed a real event. Between History and Cinema, a film with vivid and singular images, which rejects commonplaces and chooses essentiality.

title: I clowns
actors: Fanfulla, Tino Scotti, Riccardo Billi, Annie Fratellini, Pierre Etaix, Alvaro Vitali
description: Fellini follows some clowns and reconstructs the magical world of the circus starting from when, as a child, he entered a tent for the first time and remained fascinated by it. Some characters from his Rimini childhood are in turn similar to clownish figures: the dwarf nun, the stationmaster targeted by the jokes of the students, the train drivers ... The conclusion is a ramshackle parade, allegorical reminder of the clown's death.
notes: With an unusual documentary slant, but without giving up his usual imagination, Fellini creates on the screen a metaphor of life through the life of the circus and its performers. Under the guidance of Tristan Rémy, the film features some members of famous circus families: the Italians Orfei, the French Annie and Gustav Fratellini, the last descendants of the famous dynasty, and then, again: Fanfulla, Père Loriot, Alex and Bario ...

title: Now and Forever
actors: Gary Cooper, Carole Lombard, Shirley Temple, Guy Standing
description: Left penniless and with a decent history as a thief behind him, a man steals a necklace and hides it among the things of his six-year-old daughter. The child discovers the truth about her father and causes him to see himself and decides to return the stolen goods to the legitimate owner. The clash with the accomplice, who instead does not want to repent. But the accomplice doesn't want to know about returning the loot. Carole Lombard remains somewhat in the shadow of Gary Cooper, who, in turn, lets Shirley Temple put his feet on his head.

title: Gregory K
actors: Kathleen York, Robert Joy, Bill Switrowich, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Melanie Griffith
description: Little Gregory lives happy with his adoptive family. The fact that exists somewhere in the United States The real mother of him does not upset him much, is a shadow that belongs to him more remote than him and he thinks he never had to review her again. Even the family who adopted him not suspicious of having to compare one day with the woman. We can therefore imagine everyone's reaction when, like a lightning bolt, this is alive to officially require the custody of the son. The film is based on a real case that happened in Florida. One of those cases that occupy the news of newspapers and TV for a week and then end up straight inside the TV movies. If this type of things passionate ...

title: Innamorato pazzo
actors: Adriano Celentano, Ornella Muti, Adolfo Celi, Gerry Bruno
description: Cristina, daughter of King Gustav of S. Tulipe, is in Rome with her father on a diplomatic mission. In fact, the king has come to ask for a large loan to restore the disastrous finances of his state. Bored with the routine of protocol, one morning Cristina escapes control and jumps on a bus driven by Barnaba Cecchini. It is the classic love at first sight and Barnabas takes her for a walk around Rome declaring himself in love with her. But the class difference seems insurmountable. Barnabas takes the princess back to the embassy, ??where she finds her father disappointed for not having received the loan but, as if by magic, it is Barnabas who solves the situation.
notes: Celentano in his cinematic "magic moment", led by the shrewd couple of screenwriters Castellano & Pipolo. Between comedy and fairy tale, you can smile with a vintage Mollevato, even if not exactly the best.

title: Verdict
actors: Sophia Loren, Jean Gabin, Julien Bertheau, Henri Garcin
description: André Leoni is tried for rape and murder of Annie Chartier, the girl who loved him. One evening, André's mother goes to the very severe Leguen, president of the court, to judge her son with clemency, but he refuses to receive her. Then the woman kidnaps his sick wife. The judge thus blackmailed manages to get the young man acquitted, but the epilogue of the story will be tragic, because, once freed, the young man confesses to his mother in his own crime. Cayatte skillfully reconstructs the greyness of the city and the feelings of the protagonists, played by a great Gabin and a talented Loren.

title: The Good Father
actors: Anthony Hopkins, Jim Broadbent, Harriet Walter, Fanny Viner, Simon Callow, Miriam Margolyes, Joanne Whalley, Michael Byrne, Jennie Stoller, Johanna Kirby
description: Bill Hooper can't rest easy: he divorced his wife and now she lives with their son and a new partner. At a party Bill meets Roger who is in a similar situation: his ex-wife is having an affair with another woman and, together with their son, intends to leave for Australia. Bill then unloads his anger on his friend's affairs and pushes him to take his ex-spouse to court. The theme is a bit like Kramer versus Kramer, but it is enriched with greasy lawyers, leaden atmospheres in winter London, a sanitation strike that leaves the streets cluttered and above all the interpretation of Anthony Hopkins.

title: Running on Empty
actors: Christine Lathi, Judd Hirsch, River Phoenix, Martha Plimpton
description: Arthur and Annie Pope got into trouble at the time of the anti-Vietnam demonstrations, even taking part in acts of sabotage. Since then they have lived under a false name, fleeing from one state to another because they are wanted by the FBI. Fifteen years have passed, the children have grown up and one of them is in crisis because this type of life does not allow him to realize his dream of becoming a musician. A "liberal" film shot by Lumet in the form of a family drama. Little success at the time, but the actors are all admirable starting with Phoenix got an Oscar nomination for supporting role.

title: Mamba
actors: Trudie Styler, Gregg Henry, Bill Moseley
description: His wife has treated him badly, but her husband's reaction seems somewhat excessive: he locks her in a luxurious loft with no exits (the windows are blocked) together with a mamba, an aggressive and very poisonous snake. Before leaving, however, he managed to apply a "detector" to his wife (one had already applied it to the reptile), in order to follow her movements on a monitor as in a video game.
notes: After experiences in the field of comedy, director Mario Orfini devotes himself to pure thriller. There is tension, there is no lack of metaphors (the protagonist is called Eva ...), the music is by Giorgio Moroder, the protagonist is Sting's wife.

title: Father of the Bride
actors: Steve Martin, Diane Keaton, Kimberly Williams, Martin Short
description: After a year of studying in Europe, Annie Banks returns home to America and announces to dad and mom that she wants to get married. Dad George, owner of a shoe factory, is shocked by the news that instead makes Mom Nina radiant. George finally agrees to the wedding between Annie and Brian, a good boy from a good family. He will regret it: not because of his future son-in-law, but because of the nervous breakdowns that arise from the need to organize a worthy reception.
notes: Minnelli's comedy of the 1950s was a satire of the madness of marriage and, underneath, of the American matriarchy. In this remake, the writers have kept the story intact, transforming its meanings, however: George is worried not so much about the costs of the reception, as about the fact that he is no longer "the only man" in the life of his "baby". We are in the midst of a midlife crisis which, however, would not hold up much if Martin did not make us forget every psychologism with his verve. But Martin isn't worth Spencer Tracy, and the director doesn't have Minnelli's class or wit.

title: Pink Cadillac
actors: Clint Eastwood, Bernadette Peters, John Dennis Johnston
description: Tommy Novak (Eastwood), skilled bounty hunter, is tasked with picking up a certain Lou Anne (Peters) who just got out of jail on bail and then disappeared, with $ 250,000, in a pink Cadillac . The man turns her back, but things get complicated because there is a young daughter and a husband involved in action with his group of neo-Nazis. Directed by Buddy Van Horn, but in reality it is Eastwood's personality that dominates the entire film. Perhaps, if he had also signed the direction, we would have avoided some length and many platitudes.

title: Death Wish 5: The Face of Death
actors: Charles Bronson, Lesley-Anne Down, Michael Parks, Saul Rubinek
description: Paul Kersey (Bronson) is no longer a young man and has promised to stop his exuberant sense of justice and keep the gun in the drawer for the future. Lieutenant King, DA Hoyle and, above all, Olivia, the fashion designer with whom Paul is having an affair believed in the promise. Tommy O'Shea, Olivia's ex-husband, decides to have her killed and then to demand custody of her daughter as well. Kersey is upset, but there is no evidence against O'Shea and therefore the police can do nothing.
notes: At 72, Bronson is still sprightly, but once again the women in his films come to a violent end. Unlike the first few episodes of the series, this one plunged violently to the bottom of the box office charts.

title: Eye of the Tiger
actors: Gary Busey, Yaphet Kotto, Seymour Cassel
description: Buck Matthews returns home from jail. All that matters in his life is the love of his wife Christie and their little Jennifer. But his return soon turns into a war: a gang of bikers kill Christie in revenge and reduce Jennifer to death. From that moment on Buck seeks only his revenge together with his friend J.B. Deveraux, aide to the sheriff.
notes: Sarafian had her golden moment a long time ago with films like "White Man Go With Your God". But to make a living, however, he was really bad, forced to direct stuff like this similjustiziere of the night: an hour and a half of unpretentious action.

title: The Candidate
actors: Robert Redford, Peter Boyle, Don Porter, Melvyn Douglas
description: A California lawyer is persuaded to run for the Senate for the Democrats. He apparently has no hope against a prejudiced adversary and a great navigator of politics. The electoral campaign, managed by a very skilled advertiser, manages to overturn the prediction, but our immaculate candidate in the cynical race for the seat loses his wife and ... his soul.
notes: Typical liberal product of the 70s, which sows doubts about the democracy-show made in the USA. Great Rdeford. Oscar for the script.

title: The Decks Ran Red
actors: James Mason, Broderick Crawford, Dorothy Dandridge
description: In order to become the captain of a ship, Eddie Rumill agrees to take the place of the captain of the Berwind, who died under mysterious circumstances. He then finds himself facing the diabolical plan of two crew members. Solid melodrama of the sea, with excellent performers.

title: The Brother from Another Planet
actors: Joe Morton, Darryl Edwards, Steve James, Leonard Jackson
description: A black leather slave from outer space falls to New York. Always chased by two policeman automatons, he discovers the pains and values ??of metropolitan slums. A little farce, a little satire, a little science fiction, with a strong anti-racist message, from one of the best American independent directors.

title: Broadway Melody of 1938
actors: Eleanor Powell, George Murphy, Sophie Tucker, Judy Garland
description: A young impresario plans to put on a memorable show on Broadway and works hard to collect the best "numbers" and artists around. After several setbacks, we happily go on stage. After the success of "Broadway Melody of 1936", MGM put on the track this parade of great talents of the time, on which Eleanor Powell stands out. Garland is even pre- "Wizard of Oz" here.

title: Cry Terror
actors: James Mason, Rod Steiger, Angie Dickinson
description: Paul Hoplin, an unscrupulous criminal, hides a bomb of tiny proportions, but of great power, on an airliner. The thug intentionally warns the head of the airline indicating the exact spot where he placed it. The FBI and the police, immediately rushed, found the device and managed to render it harmless as soon as the plane lands. But Paul's threats are not over: his intention is to blackmail the airline with the threat of placing more bombs.
notes: Fast paced thriller written and directed by Andrew L. Stone.

title: Ebirah, Horror of the Deep
actors: Akira Takarada, Kuni Mizuno, Akihiko Hirata
description: On an island, protected by a giant lobster, a secret base for the manufacture of the atomic bomb is discovered. Awakened from his long slumber, the antediluvian monster Godzilla sets things right. Like many others in the series dedicated to the monster, it is cult, for the ingenuity of the story and the tricks.

title: Jeopardy
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, Barry Sullivan, Ralph Meeker, Lee Aaker
description: On a lonely vacation in Mexico, Doug is imprisoned under a collapsed bridge. His wife frantically tries to rescue, even relying on a dangerous fugitive. Unusual melodrama, it combines many stereotypes of the anguished genre with fertile narrative ambiguities.

title: The Sea Chase
actors: John Wayne, Lana Turner, David Farrar, Lyle Bettger, Tab Hunter
description: A German freighter leaves Sydney Harbor at night for Valparaiso. At his command is Captain Karl Ehrlich, among the passengers is Elsa Keller, in love with him. The boat, an outlawed freighter, is chased by the British warship "Rockhampton" captained by Jeffrey Napier, an enemy but a great admirer of Ehrlich. But when Napier believes that some fishermen from an island have been killed on Ehrlich's orders, he swears him deadly hatred and pursues him, determined to eliminate him.
notes: Spectacular film that unravels between hatred and thirst for revenge, but which also enhances the courage and ideals of its protagonists: the classic self-respecting enemies of many war films. Wayne is German!

title: The Green Years
actors: Charles Coburn, Dean Stockwell, Tom Drake, Beverly Tyler
description: Orphaned at an early age, he is welcomed into the home of his grandfather, a stingy and bigot Scottish. Luckily there are the women of the house, and above all a great grandfather who knows what life is. Heavy family saga from a Cronyn novel, but with a very effective cast.

title: Cat and Mouse
actors: Kirk Douglas, Jean Seberg, John Vernon, Don Fellows, Suzanne Lloyd
description: Mature and pusillanimous, therefore nicknamed "mouse", he marries the young and pregnant Laura who only wants to give a father to her son. When she goes to Canada and marries another, "the mouse" turns into a killer. Good product for TV with a sinister, convincing Kirk Douglas.

title: Blood Beach
actors: David Huffman, Mariana Hill, John Saxon
description: After the mysterious disappearance of some bathers from a beach, it turns out that a monstrous and voracious being is hidden under the sand. Aside from the poverty of production, it is a boring and patched-up attempt to re-propose the story of the Shark.

title: Once a Thief
actors: Alain Delon, Ann-Margret, Van Heflin, Jack Palance, Tony Musante, John Davis Chandler, Jeff Corey, Steve Mitchell, Tammy Locke
description: A vengeful policeman is relentlessly persecuted against a former convict (Alain Delon) who, in the end, pressured by family needs, agrees to participate in a robbery. Big risk for him ...
notes: For Alain Delon on an American trip, a rather routine social crime story served by Robert Burks' excellent photography.

title: Manhattan Melodrama
actors: William Powell, Clark Gable, Myrna Loy
description: In Nex York, two orphans collected and raised by a philanthropist take two different paths: Jim serves the law, Blackie becomes a gangster. For the sake of a woman, the outlaw will be useful to the other. Melodrama in grand style, with many elements later taken as a model for subsequent films. Oscar for the subject to Arthur Caesar.

title: Please Don't Eat the Daisies
actors: David Niven, Doris Day, Janis Paige, Spring Byngton
description: Larry (David Niven) writes about theater for a major New York newspaper; his wife (Doris Day) has her work cut out with their four children. They are all roses and flowers (daisies) until the critic's severity begins to bring him trouble. His distant attempts as an author, not exciting, further complicate things.
notes: The comedy is enjoyable, thanks also to a sparkling interpretation by all the performers. The excellent Doris Day performs in the tune "Please Don't Eat the Daisies".

title: El Diablo
actors: Anthony Edwards, Louis Gossett jr., Joe Pantoliano, Robert Beltran
description: A clumsy teacher teams up with a black gunfighter to retrieve his student kidnapped by bandits. Cheerful Western with final escalation of violence, written by John Carpenter among others and shot for cable TV.

title: Chi l'ha vista morire?
actors: George Lazenby, Adolfo Celi, Anita Strindberg
description: The sculptor Serpieri ingada on the "accidental" death of his young daughter. Yellow with a Venetian setting with music by Morricone, in the wake of the successes of Dario Argento. Both Lazenby and Celi had made a 007. I don't even know that.

title: Bad Trip
directors: Philip J. Roth, James E. Lowry
actors: Dino Castagno, Cynthia Sheperd
description: Seventy-two hours in the life of Tom Snelling, a man haunted by misfortunes, psychopaths and creditors. The title, however, is double-edged: even the film is a really bad trip.

title: Happy Birthday, Wanda June
actors: Rod Steiger, Susannah York, Michael Hickey
description: Missing for seven years, Major Ryan returns home to find his wife somewhat changed. Based on a play by Kurt Vonnegut, it is notable, however, above all for the rehearsal of the actors.

title: Mildred Pierce
actors: Joan Crawford, Ann Blyth, Jack Carson, Zachary Scott, Eve Arden
description: Mildred Pierce (Crawford), after years of misunderstanding and quarrels, finally manages to get the long-awaited divorce from her hated husband. Working day and night, he opens a shop of his own. Mildred after the death of one of her daughters is forced to raise Veda (Blyth), and to indulge her every wish. She, who has a capricious and upbeat character, blackmails her husband from whom her mother divorced. To regain her affection, Mildred remarries, but the new partner ruins her financially and seduces Veda.
notes: From a novel by James M. Cain. A melodrama with noir and almost gothic incursions, directed by a Curtiz perfectly in the mood and with an interesting female character at the center. Crawford Oscar.

title: La ripetente fa l'occhietto al preside
actors: Anna Maria Rizzoli, Lino Banfi, Alvaro Vitali, Carlo Sposito
description: After a love misadventure, Angela Pastorelli, daughter of a rich industrialist from the North, resumes her interrupted studies. Among the classmates there is the handsome Carlo Lucignani whom the girl would like to hook up, but who received from her father, an employee of Pastorelli, the veto to get busy with Angela. And still many other amenities on matters of the heart, possible or impossible, lucky or not. Perhaps the film is a tad above the average of other similar by-products. However, we are always at the level of a joke.

title: Tre tigri contro tre tigri
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Paolo Villaggio, Enrico Montesano, Dalila Di Lazzaro
description: The tongue twister of the title only serves to indicate the number of episodes: in a "red" country the church fills up only when people believe that the parish priest has a love story going on; Nanni Loy's "secret mirror" plays a bad joke on a fugitive; a lawyer with a phobia of the plane has to deal with a female pilot who, while at the controls, goes into catalepsy twice. It took eight screenwriters to build the three chapters of the film, and their main merit was that they did not fall into excesses of vulgarity despite the Boccaccio character of the vicenduole. The performers give flavor to the film.

title: Harlem Knockout
actors: Massimo Girotti, Amedeo Nazzari, Elisa Cegani, Osvaldo Valenti
description: Tommaso, a young Italian, joins his brother Amedeo in New York who made his fortune there, with the intention of launching himself into the world of boxing. The enterprise is far from easy, also because Amedeo is unjustly accused of murder and imprisoned. When Tommaso wins against a black boxer, he pays the bail for his brother, but the latter is killed by his enemies.
notes: To be a work of the regime, with the clear intention of denigrating the American demos / pluto / Jewish people, it has at least the merit of the originality of the subject. The boxing match was noteworthy (again for those times); it is already something. Primo Carnera appears in the part of himself.

title: Tomorrow Never Comes
actors: Oliver Reed, Susan George, Raymond Burr, Donald Pleasence
description: Jim Wilson, police lieutenant of a tourist town, decides to resign and go back to the village. But, just the last day of service, hell breaks out. Frank, as soon as he returned to the country, discovers that his girlfriend, Janie, has a relationship with Lyne, a very powerful man. Frank takes Janie hostage and threatens to kill her if Lyne does not come to the closer. At that point everyone asks Wilson a quick solution to the story. Wilson though ...
notes: The one gathered by Collinson is just a nice cast. Too bad that the story is not standing and the direction does nothing to make it a little more credible.

title: Gremlins 2: The New Batch
actors: Zach Galligan, Phoebe Cates, Christopher Lee, Dick Miller
description: From their small town in the province Billy and Kate go to live in New York in the skyscraper of billionaire Daniel Clamp. With them comes a curious animal that cannot resist the sunlight, which cannot eat after midnight and above all must not come into contact with water.
notes: The story doesn't change much from the first "Gremlins" and everyone agrees that a sequel is rarely as good as number one. But they haven't reckoned with Joe Dante, a man capable of turning even the most obvious subjects into successes. In the opening and closing credits the characters of the Looney Tunes squabble.

title: The Plague
actors: William Hurt, Sandrine Bonnaire, Jean-Marc Barr, Robert Duvall
description: In Buenos Aires, a rat invasion transmits the plague virus to the population. Doctor Bernard Rieux throws himself with self-denial into caring for the sick (his wife is also affected). A cameraman films the sick, a Vatican priest prophecies of death, a journalist seems indifferent to the drama. Based on the novel of the same name by Albert Camus, the film loses its strength to dissolve into scenes of everyday horror, with all the heaviness of superproduction and tons of fake Latin American "fantastic realism".

title: Unman, Wittering and Zigo
actors: David Hemmings, Douglas Wilmer, Carolyn Seymour
description: The professor is dead and the class is entrusted to a substitute teacher (David Hemmings). We are in an English college where the discipline is very tough, but the pupils warn the teacher that, as they killed his predecessor, they could easily do the same with him. The man does not listen to the threats and then the boys, to make him understand that they are serious, kidnap his wife. For a while David Hemmings wanders around with a bewildered air and with Rebecca syndrome in his head. Then the latent violence, carried on by allusions and threats, finally comes out and the film gains in tension and malice.

title: Doppio delitto
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Agostina Belli, Ursula Andress, Peter Ustinov
description: After a period of quarantine for failing to prevent the escape of a murderer, Commissioner Bruno is assigned a new case: the death of Prince Dell'Orso and the electrical engineer Colasanti. The suspects are many and all based on a possible motive. But the key to the crime lies in Colasanti's niece, the feminist Teresa, the custodian of an unexpected family secret.
notes: An international cast all glitter and sequins moves to old Rome for this thriller that winks at comedy. Despite the intrigue, what matters most are the actor numbers, favored by an "ad hoc" script.

title: La bellissima estate
actors: Senta Berger, John Richardson, Alessandro Cocco
description: Vittorio, an industrialist with a passion for car racing, is killed during a race. The wife keeps the matter hidden from her son: she only tells him that after the holidays they will not return to Milan. Gianluca, however, will dramatically discover the truth. Pretentious melodrama that remains suspended in a surface elegance.

title: Magic Town
actors: James Stewart, Jane Wyman, Kent Smith, Ned Sparks, Wallace Ford
description: Rip Smith is a brilliant statistician with a theory of his own: there must be a town, what he calls the "magic city", that faithfully reflects the opinion of people across the United States. One day he thinks he has found it and the first polls prove him right.
notes: Happy satire of the mania of polls conducted with a style reminiscent of Frank Capra (the screenplay is in fact by Robert Riskin, his regular collaborator).

title: 80 mq. Ottantametriquadri
directors: Cecilia Calvi, Dido Castelli, Luca D'Ascanio, Luca Manfredi, Ignazio Agosta
actors: Alessandro Haber, Isa Barzizza, Giulio Scarpati, Amanda Sandrelli
description: The film, which metaphorically takes its title from the living space of a modest apartment in a big city, consists of five episodes: two lovers find themselves unable to love each other; a mother exploits the gastronomic weaknesses of her succubus son for her own ends; a man, after a quarrel with his wife, cleans the apartment of strange traces; a man is cornered by his wife and lover; two elderly spouses look back on their past.
notes: The attempt to sew stories of ordinary numbness of feelings without falling into speck or patheticism was only partially successful. Perhaps too many hands in the control room have hurt a little.

title: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
actors: Jack Nicholson, Danny DeVito, Louise Fletcher, Will Sampson, Brad Dourif, Christopher Lloyd, Scatman Crothers, Vincent Schiavell, William Redfield, Sydney Lassick, Peter Brocco, Mwako Cumbuka, William Duell, Michael Berryman
description: Randle McMurphy, arrested for petty crimes, is taken to a psychiatric clinic because he tries to pretend to be insane to escape prison. Here he comes into contact with the other patients of whom he soon becomes the darling: he makes fun of psychoanalysis sessions, improvises commentator, organizes a small "trip" by boat. The hospital is headed by an iron chief nurse, Miss Ratched. McMurphy decides to escape. With him is a giant Indian who has always pretended to be deaf and dumb. Before escaping, however, McMurphy organizes a little party introducing two girls among the sick. A Nicholson in splendid shape gives body and soul to this outsider, a hero in spite of himself. The film is fundamentally based on him and above all on his opposition to the nurse, a great Fletcher with a sharp acting. Forman touches some strings of emotion by relying on the most elementary feelings. Based on the novel of the same name by Ken Kesey, the film won five Academy Awards: film, direction, Nicholson and Fletcher as protagonists, and screenplay.

title: Tutti gli uomini di Sara
actors: Nancy Brilli, Giulio Scarpati, Claudio Bigagli, Luciano Bartoli, Antonella Lualdi
description: Sara Lancetti, lawyer and betrothed to Max Altieri, is the victim of obscene and threatening phone calls. Try to figure out who could be the author, investigating all his former lovers. Without results. The wedding date is approaching, Max has to go abroad for business and returns on the day of the ceremony. During the same, Sara sees suspicious scratches on his hands and runs away scared ... Tescari arrives from the video clip and can be seen in the editing solutions that support the story: a "strong" story in which yellow tones prevail. pink, diffused light and chic underwear. The complex, however, does not work.

title: Le amiche del cuore
actors: Asia Argento, Carlotta Natoli, Claudia Pandolfi, Michele Placido
description: Sixteen-year-old Claudia sleeps with anyone who can help her make a career as a TV valet. Morena is studying as a nurse and looks after her former drug addict mother. The introverted Simona (Asia Argento) lives an incestuous relationship with her father, separated from his wife. He meets Lucio and falls in love with him, but dad (Michele Placido), jealous, summons the boy.
notes: A film about parent-child relationships that is not didactic, but a little too colorful and melodramatic. Second and best success in directing (after "Pummarò") for Michele Placido, served here by a good cast of young actresses.

title: Naufraghi sotto costa
actors: Sabrina Ferilli, Tony Palazzo, Claudio Spadaro, Giorgio Trestini
description: Lano, keeper of the Phoenician museum, and his daughter Lola live on the Sicilian island of Mozia. Antonio arrives on the island, a fugitive Lola falls in love with. Loiò, Lola's boyfriend, however, discovers that the man, on behalf of a cynical local aristocrat, has stolen a precious statue of a Greek god from the museum and warns Lola and her father.
notes: In the cast Sabrina Ferilli who helps to make this film without rhythm watchable and with a non-ingenious use of the set.

title: Fortress
actors: Christopher Lambert, Loryn Locklin, Kurtwood Smith, Lincoln Kilpatrick
description: Year 2013: the second pregnancy became a crime. Captain John Brennick, however, does not control himself and his wife Karen becomes pregnant for the second time. The two are discovered and imprisoned. The prison is an upside-down skyscraper (it goes from level zero to minus thirty). All inmates are made to swallow a gastric fibrillator capable of giving horrible spasms if only a yellow line is crossed. John ends up at the wheel of torture and falls into a catatonic state. Karen is coveted by the prison director and, at least apparently, she can't say no.
notes: The subject is not really that science fiction, since there is such a law in China. The sequence in which the inmates discover the way to expel the gastric fibrillator and the fight on the catwalk are good. Lambert is also good, especially in the moments when he is catatonic, also because it comes naturally to him. Delicious Loryn Locklin. Too bad that Gordon is not as lightning-fast as his namesake Flash.

title: Il marito in collegio
actors: Enrico Montesano, Anna Proclemer, Silvia Dionisio, Mario Carotenuto, Bombolo
description: To take possession of the inheritance of her uncle Zanin, of modest origins but wealthy, the noble and poor Carlotta Madellis agrees to marry the gas station attendant Camillo Proietti. With the proviso that the marriage will not be consummated before the groom has acquired the manners of a refined person. So poor Camillo ends up in a Swiss boarding school to soften up, but in the meantime Carlotta risks falling into the traps of a dowry seeker, a self-styled baron.
notes: Based on a short story by Giovanni Guareschi, a deliberately outdated film, but also not very funny.

title: The Lord of Discipline
actors: G.D. Spradlin, David Keith, Robert Prosky, Barbara Babcok, Michael Biehn, Mark Breland, John Lavachielli
description: In the "Carolina Military Institute", directed by General Durrel, there is a code of training for aspiring officers of extreme toughness, often bordering on pure sadism. Now nearing his final exams, cadet Will is tasked with taking the lead of a rookie. The latter, upset by the oppression suffered, commits suicide. Will learns that a mysterious "Group of Ten" has always been operating in the boarding school and is now raging against pupil Pierce, guilty of being a black man.
notes: Against the abuses and distortions of a fanatical and criminal militarism, the film is a real indictment, sometimes even bordering on the grotesque, but of undeniable dramatic effectiveness.

title: The Woman Who Sinned
actors: Susan Lucci, Tim Matheson, Michael Dudikoff
description: The brothers Wilder and Wallace Foudroyant both had the gift of mother nature to raise fire with the power of thought alone. While Wilder doesn't take advantage of this talent, Wallace uses it in a circus comic number. When, after years of separation, the brothers reunite, their relationship ... Between the fantastic and the grotesque, a foolish film with a bewildered Winger.

title: La settimana bianca
actors: Anna Maria Rizzoli, Gianfranco D'Angelo, Enzo Cannavale, Bombolo, Giacomo Furia, Paolo Giusti, Graziella Polesinanti, Carmen Russo, Vincenzo Crocitti
description: A company outing on the snow sees participants engaged in playboy feats; the competition aims to conquer the beauty of the group (Rizzoli). In moments of pause our heroes try their hand at barracks jokes or console themselves for their failures in the arms of a complacent waitress.
notes: The direction of Mariano Laurenti and the interpretation, of rare sloppiness, perfectly match the tone of the story.

title: Roma come Chicago
actors: John Cassavetes, Gabriele Ferzetti, Riccardo Cucciolla
description: A certain Mario Corda is put in prison for a robbery at a post office. Enrico, his accomplice, on the other hand, gets away with it and continues in his criminal activity without stopping at nothing, not even in the face of murder. One of the victims is Corda's young wife who refused to flee abroad with him. Only Mario stops him, released at the end of jail with intentions of revenge. A direct detective story without great flair, but with a remarkable cast.

title: La schiava io ce l'ho e tu no
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Catherine Spaak, Adriana Asti, Gordon Mitchell
description: Demetrio Cultrera (Buzzanca), called Dedé, is the prototype of the Sicilian male; plus he is rich and single. Rosalba Giordano, daughter of the local king of tuna, manages to make him fall in love and marry him. The woman tries to acculturate him, but Dede feels enslaved. To distract himself he becomes a lover, but this too haunts him. So he goes to the Amazon and buys a native woman to be his slave.
notes: Spaak had not yet entered her television "Harem". The "Sicilian itch" genre, unworthy child of the Italian comedy, was already gasping. Buzzanca, who had built his career on the genre, was also winding down.

title: Le silence de la mer
actors: Howard Vernon, Jean-Marie Robain, Nicole Stéphane
description: Werner von Ebrennac is a young German officer stationed in a small village in the French countryside. With a noble soul and refined tastes (in civilian life he composes music), he manages to obtain the silent esteem of the old man and the girl who have been forced to give him accommodation. After a leave in Paris, disgusted by the attitude of his fellow soldiers, however, he asks to be sent to the front. It is Melville's debut feature film. Taken from the novel of the same name by Vercors, considered a sort of sacred text by those who had made the Resistance, it is an interesting example of contrast with a literary text and an exciting film. Shot in the real house of Vercors.

title: Maledetto il giorno che t'ho incontrato
actors: Carlo Verdone, Margherita Buy, Elisabetta Pozzi, Giancarlo Dettori
description: Bernardo and Camilla know each other from the analyst. He (Verdone) is Roman, transplanted to Milan, is a rock critic and has the hope of writing a book about Hendrix. She (Buy) is from Milan and lives in Milan, she is an actress, but she is insecure. She fatally falls in love (it is the transfer) of the analyst, Bernardo discourages her and in the end they quarrel. Two years later they meet again in London, apparently healed. Camilla is now in love with the director she works with. Bernardo is on the trail of a crucial testimony about Hendrix's death. The squabbles between the two start again as before then, thanks to a trip to Cornwall, they finally discover that they are in love with each other.
notes: It is the Italian answer to "Harry, meet Sally", even if poor Verdone puts it this way. In fact, the script works, even if it has some empty lines. Buy is perfect in the role that suits her best: that of Margherita Buy, adorable neurotic. Every time he tries to do something different it is a disappointment. Verdone, who actually has an inordinate passion for Hendrix, conducts gracefully. Of course, if the film didn't touch two hours, everything would be more pleasant.

title: Fratelli e sorelle
actors: Franco Nero, Anna Bonaiuto, Paola Quattrini, Lino Capolicchio, Luciano Federico, Stefano Accorsi
description: Gloria and Aldo have been married for twenty years. One day Aldo goes to live with Alessandra, a twenty year old girl. The distraught woman takes refuge with her two children from her sister Lea who lives in St. Louis in the United States. Lea and her husband Franco are also in crisis. In different ways Gloria and her children Matteo, who is better off than everyone, and Francesco, who tries a timid reconciliation with his father, will try to adapt to the new situation. Pupi Avati ventures into the minefields of the investigation, between the sociological and the intimist, of family problems. He does it with his usual calm style, without however being able to scratch and getting lost in banal moralisms.

title: Deceived
actors: Goldie Hawn, John Heard, Robin Bartlett, Ashley Peldon
description: Adrienne is a restorer, has a tender daughter and a loving husband named Jack, who is also involved in the ancient art business. Adrienne begins to have doubts about his work when a fake is discovered in a museum and he becomes involved in the case. So Jack dies in a car accident and doubts become certainty: the man she married has actually been dead for years! Yellow a la Hitchcock, but Harris doesn't have the master's pulse. Goldie Hawn is full of goodwill, but she doesn't save the movie.

title: L'avaro
actors: Alberto Sordi, Laura Antonelli, Miguel Bosé, Lucia Bosé, Christopher Lee, Anna Kanakis
description: Arpagone, a rich Roman usurer, even creditor of the Pope, has a problem: Cardinal Spinosi wants to marry him his sister Isabella, well known for having already killed her previous husbands. Terrified, Arpagone declares that he has already committed himself to a young woman, so he sets out to look for a wife. His choice falls on Mariana, not knowing that she is engaged to her son Cleante. That Molière turned in the grave for this reduction of one of his most famous works is a secondary fact. That the spectators do not roll over in their chairs for the great laugh, but only for the great sleep is instead a serious problem. Indeed a deadly problem.

title: Sono un fenomeno paranormale
actors: Alberto Sordi, Eleonora Brigliadori, Elsa Martinelli, Pippo Baudo
description: Roberto Razzi is the host of a television series in which he enjoys unmasking fake mediums, discovering their tricks. During a trip to India he falls off the back of an elephant; the blow gives him truly exceptional powers that cause him dismay rather than enthusiasm. He then returns to India where a true fakir teaches him how to live with them by putting them at the service of the whole world.
notes: A film and television cast surrounds Sordi in a film that sbertuccia the alleged "psychics". Screenplay obsequious to the star who now plays to remake (wearily) himself.

title: Mia moglie è una strega
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Eleonora Giorgi, Helmut Berger
description: A young and beautiful witch, condemned to the stake in the seventeenth century, in revenge asks the devil to return to earth today to persecute a distant descendant of the prelate who incriminated her. However, the woman has not come to terms with love ... And when Altieri decides to marry another, here is the witch "making fire and flames".
notes: Eighties version of a film classic, which has been revisited many times. And that is "I married a witch" made by René Clair in 1942. Despite some variations with respect to the plot and some updates, Castellano & Pipolo are unable to go beyond a cabaret repertoire.

title: Walker, Texas Ranger
actors: Chuck Norris, Clarence Gilyard, Gailard Sartain
description: Cordell Walker is a Texas ranger of Indian blood. He and his colleague Jimmy Trivette investigate the mysterious death of a vet. He tried to understand the reasons for the death of cattle that afflicts the region. During a difficult investigation ...

title: Waterloo Bridge
actors: Robert Taylor, Vivien Leigh, Lucille Watson, Virginia Field
description: An English captain leaving for the front in 1915 meets a dancer and the two fall in love; however, they are unable to marry for the short time they have available. At their next meeting, the events of the war have profoundly transformed the girl who, in order not to deceive the officer, chooses to die by throwing herself under a truck on the Waterloo bridge, the place of their first meeting.
notes: From the play by R. E. Sherwood, a film for which generations of viewers shed tears of emotion. The English Vivien Leigh is beautiful, the American Robert Taylor is fascinating, the notes of the "Candle Waltz" "galeotte".

title: Reservoir Dogs
actors: Harvey Keitel, Michael Madsen, Tim Roth, Steve Buscemi, Chris Penn
description: The robbery went bad. In the abandoned warehouse the members of the gang arrive one by one and it is immediately clear that something has not gone well, that someone has spoken. Which is not surprising because everyone talks too much, argues too much, points guns in each other's face for almost no reason. The only one who speaks little is the one with the razor, the one who kidnapped the policeman and now has turned on the radio. Michael Madsen's sequence cutting off the policeman's ear is the strongest of the whole film (will it remain intact on TV?). And anyway, the whole story is full of tension from start to finish. Great script, but above all great actors.
notes: Debut with a bang, it is appropriate to say. Quentin Tarantino changes the perspective of cinema. Many have "vampirized" the style without ever reaching its power, its rigor. Edward Bunker (Mr. Blue) is a former convict author of the novel "Like a ferocious beast".

title: La principessa del sogno
actors: Irasema Dilian, Antonio Centa, Maria Melato, Annibale Betrone
description: Elisabetta (Dilian), a guest of an orphanage, built a dream world in which he imagines meeting the Prince Charming and becoming his happy bride. In fact, he knows a real prince (Centa), he falls in love with it and, despite his external opposition, he manages to marry him. Melense and flat fairy tale.

title: Look Who's Talking Too
actors: John Travolta, Kirstie Alley, Elias Koteas, Olimpia Dukakis
description: The couple from the previous film (John Travolta / James and Kirstie Alley / Mollie) will have a common child this time, but Mickey (of whom James is not the father) has some tinges of jealousy. Julie is born, James finally finds the job he wanted - jet pilot and no longer a taxi driver - but frictions arise in the family and he leaves his wife and children.
notes: Ironing the gimmick of the first chapter, here are two children who are given an early voice as adults (Villaggio and Anna Mazzamauro, plus a "cameo" by Lino Banfi), but the whole has a lot of heated soup (or baby food) .
