title: The Lawnmower Man
actors: Pierce Brosnan, Jeff Fahey, Jenny Wright, Mark Bringleson
description: Jobe Smith, a harmless mentally retarded, undergoes drug treatment in the laboratory. The goal is to dilate and stimulate his intelligence. The research company that exploits it does not, however, have peaceful aims; Jobe also becomes the guinea pig of an experiment that crosses an increase in aggression with the inclusion in virtual reality. From a story by Stephen King (who seems to have disowned the adaptation), a banal science fiction film, yet another variation of "Frankenstein", supported by amazing special effects.

title: Cape Fear
actors: Robert Mitchum, Gregory Peck, Polly Bergen, Martin Balsam, Jack Kruschen, Telly Savalas, Barrie Chase, Paul Comi, Edward Platt, Will Wright, Joan Staley
description: Cady, a criminal released from jail after serving an eight-year sentence, decides to make Sam Bowden pay, a prosecution witness he holds responsible for his sentence. Cady takes it out on Sam's wife and little daughter. But the lawyer will know how to take revenge by luring the former convict in the swamps of Florida, where the showdown takes place.
notes: Great Mitchum, who gives Max Cady a considerable erotic charge. Definitely the best Jack Lee Thompson movie. Of _Cape Fear_, based on the novel _The Executioners_ by John D. McDonald, Martin Scorsese has made a splendid remake.

title: The Rocketeer
actors: Billy Campbell, Alan Arkin, Jennifer Connelly, Paul Sorvino, Timothy Dalton, Jon Polito
description: In Los Angeles in 1938, a gangster hides a package in an old plane and then dies in a car accident. The package is found by pilot Cliff (Campbell) and contains a device that, worn as a backpack, allows a man to soar in the sky. The famous actor Neville Sinclair (Dalton), a Nazi spy, is interested in the invention, who goes on to kidnap Jenny (Conelly), Bill's girlfriend, in order to get hold of it. The Rocketeer is a comic strip from '81 by Dave Stevens that tries to re-read the comic strips of the thirties. Disney has put all of its talents on the production design, saving some money on writing, directing and everything in between. The protagonist couple does not create major thrills and right Dalton seems to be enjoying the role of the villain. Final proceeds for Italy: one hundred and thirty million; a sensational flop.

title: Touch of Evil
actors: Orson Welles, Charlton Heston, Janet Leigh, Joseph Calleia, Marlene Dietrich, Akim Tamiroff, Joanna Moore, Ray Collins, Dennis Weaver, Valentin de Vargas, Mort Mills, Victor Millan
description: Mike Vargas, Mexican police inspector, and his wife Susan must interrupt their honeymoon to come to terms with the killing of wealthy owner Linnekar, which took place on the border between the United States and Mexico. Vargas participates in the investigation alongside the American inspector Quinlan. Meanwhile Susan is tricked by a shady guy, who, by blackmailing the woman, aims to free her brother who has been arrested by the Mexican inspector.
notes: Open from the most famous sequence shot in film history, enclosed by Welles's huge body floating in the river and the line of fortune teller Tanya, the contemptuous Marlene Dietrich ("He was a dirty cop, but in his way he was also a great man "), here is the film that Welles directed in 1958. The impact of the film is still shocking: a thriller where dirty politics mixes with personal and collective perversions, where the hero is an obese and buggered policeman, who nevertheless retains its size compared to the small shoplifting of the undergrowth that surrounds it. A film oppressed by ceilings and walls, by a Mexican sky that weighs tragically, by the cut of the shots, by the deformations of the camera. Quinlan is evil in his pathetic disorientation; Vargas, however much he does, is too healthy to snatch his scepter of shadow from him. Marked by ambiguity, like modern masterpieces.

title: Acqua e sapone
actors: Carlo Verdone, Natasha Hovey, Florinda Bolkan, Glenn Saxon
description: Sandy, a young American model, arrives in Rome accompanied by her mother. She immediately starts looking for a tutor to provide her daughter's education. The choice falls on Father Spinetti, a severe prelate who is bypassed, thanks to a stratagem, by Rolando, a graduate janitor who pretends to be a priest. Sandy discovers the trick, but willingly lends herself to the game.
notes: A feeble sentimental story, seasoned with some funny gimmicks, directed by Carlo Verdone in a smooth and correct way. Newcomer Natasha Hovey looked like she was going to be a star at the time.

title: Cuba
actors: Sean Connery, Brooke Adams, Jack Weston, Denholm Elliott, Hector Elizondo
description: To save the government of Fulgencio Batista from the threat of the rebels commanded by Fidel Castro, the English major Robert Dapes is called. He is a counter-revolution specialist, but he also has a heart. In Cuba, in fact, he finds Alexandra Lopez, his former lover and now the wife of a local capitalist. Dapes is actually very unconvinced of the possibility of saving Batista; and when he finds himself in the midst of a decisive action by the Castroites, seized by doubts, he chooses to change sides: also because Alexandra has long ago chosen a side and is fighting for the revolution ...
notes: Lester is more interested in the romantic side of the story than the political one. However, he manages to reconstruct the confused, chaotic and crepuscular atmosphere of the Cuba of that period. And he naturally adds traits of his biting sarcasm. Connery, once again a secret agent in the service of Her Majesty, offers his side to a reinterpretation of his most famous character, impersonating an expert in military tactics very distant, in character and attitude, from the Bondian clichés. In a particularly tasty sequence, the dictator Batista watches Hammer's _Dracula_ on television.

title: The Child
actors: Laurel Barret, Rosalie Cole, Frank Janson
description: A woman accepts the position of housekeeper in a remote region and finds herself grappling with an 11-year-old who, in revenge for her murdered mother, leads a group of zombies to kill those she believes responsible for the crime or who obstruct her

title: Sansone contro i pirati
actors: Kirk Morris, Margaret Lee, Daniele Vargas, Aldo Bufi Landi, Frank Leroy
description: A ruthless pirate plunders and rages on Spanish sailors and women in the Antillean Sea. Amanda manages to escape and reach the island where Samson reigns.
notes: Hood, sword and muscles for a blockbuster all homemade (and it shows!), From "Ed Wood Italiano" Tanio Boccia under a pseudonym.

title: The Bedford Incident
actors: James McArthur, Richard Widmark, Sidney Poitier, Martin Balsam
description: The zeal of Finlander, commander of a US destroyer, borders on paranoia. Journalist Munceford notices this, occasionally boarding the ship and helpless witness to a breathtaking hunt for a Soviet nuclear submarine.

title: Cast a Deadly Spell
actors: Fred Ward, David Warner, Julianne Moore
description: Private investigator H. P. Lovecraft has only 48 hours to retrieve an ancient and precious book of black magic, the Necronomicon, and deliver it to the mighty Amos Hackshaw. To hinder his mission, a thousand obstacles veiled in mystery. Pretty funny thriller Pastrocchio with the snout of Fred Ward.

title: Doctor Faustus
actors: Richard Burton, Andreas Teuber, Elizabeth Taylor
description: The elderly Doctor Faustus, a great medieval scholar, signs a pact with the devil to obtain 24 years of "total knowledge" in exchange for his soul.
notes: Pretentious directed by Richard Burton from a classic of German literature, with unbearably kitsch moments.

title: Experiment in Terror
actors: Glenn Ford, Lee Remick, Stefanie Powers, Roy Poole
description: A man threatens a bank employee with death to make her steal a large sum. Despite the help of the police, the criminal kidnaps the girl's sister and continues to blackmail her. Agree with the agents, she carries out the robbery ...
notes: One of Blake Edwards' best films, wrongly considered at ease exclusively with the codes of comedy (not surprisingly, the Italian title looks like that of his previous success, _Operazione sottoveste_, which has absolutely nothing to do with it), and instead very good at handling the thriller atmosphere. Amazing tension, also thanks to a cast that makes sparks.

title: S. O. S. Titanic
actors: David Janssen, Cloris Leachman, Susan Saint James
description: Under the orders of the mature and experienced Captain Edward J. Smith, the superb ocean liner Titanic departs Southampton for her maiden voyage: destination New York. There are more than two thousand people on board. By telegraph comes the report of numerous ice adrift in the waters of the North Atlantic, but the captain does not take it into account and continues with the machines at full speed: he wants to arrive early on the scheduled time. An iceberg tears apart the side of the largest and safest ocean liner in the world.
notes: An overabundant and boring television production, with a mixed Anglo-American cast.

title: Cuore
actors: Vittorio De Sica, Maria Mercader, Giorgio De Lullo, Ave Ninchi
description: The "red pen" teacher recalls the years of school and her love for the master Perboni heroically fell in Africa.

title: Vendetta for the Saint
actors: Roger Moore, Rosemary Dexter, Ian Hendry, Aimi Mac Donald
description: Detective Simon Templar, known as Il Santo, discovers that a former employee of the Continental Bank, Dino Cartelli passes himself off as the powerful boss Alessandro Destamio, who has been dead for some time. Knowing that he has been discovered, Cartelli orders his men to take him out. Having escaped two attacks, Simon is captured and locked up in a castle where the leaders of the gangs are planning criminal plans.
notes: Roger Moore in the role that made him famous before replacing Connery in the role of agent 007. The film is based on the TV series then also resumed in the recent film with Val Kilmer ("The Saint"), and is probably the most delusional mafia- movie never made.

title: Relative Fear
actors: Darlanne Fluegel, Matthew Dupuis, M. Emmet Walsh, Denise Crosby
description: Connie and Linda give birth on the same day, in the same hospital. Then the two children are swapped and about Connie and the other child nothing is known. Actually Linda understands that something is wrong. Four years later, his son Adam still hasn't said a word, his facial expression is not a little disturbing and too many people are dying nearby. From the series "child with the face of an angel who is perhaps a killer" this film comes after "The innocence of the devil", but it is not bad. The actors work (especially Fluegel and Walsh) and Denise Crosby would work too if only they gave her more space.

title: Le tigri di Mompracem
actors: Ivan Rassimov, Claudia Gravy, Andrea Bosic
description: After the evil maharaja Varauni has exterminated his whole family, the brave Sandokan decides to retire to the island of Mompracem to meditate a terrible revenge against him.
notes: A very banal Italian adventure film, without any pretensions, directed by Mario Sequi. The dramaturgical construction is non-existent, the characters seem like puppets, the settings are ready for use.

title: Uno sceriffo tutto d'oro
actors: Luigi Giuliani, Caterina Trentini, Jacques Berthier
description: Sheriff Jeff Randall saves the life of an outlaw ready to be hanged, with the excuse of having to take him as a witness to an important trial. In reality the sheriff needs an accomplice for a robbery - an indistinguishable low product of the spaghetti western.

title: Una bruna indiavolata
actors: Silvana Pampanini, Ugo Tognazzi, Nando Bruno, Anna Campori
description: Carlo Soldi wins a fair sum at the game and from there his troubles begin. He leaves for Rome with the intention of having fun, but he immediately gets his money stolen and at that point he begins, together with the betrothed of a friend of his, a wanderings in a taxi that there

title: Parigi è sempre Parigi
actors: Aldo Fabrizi, Lucia Bosé, Marcello Mastroianni
description: For a football match between France and Italy, a group of our compatriots goes to the French capital. There are those who hope to enjoy a short stay in the city among fashion shops and "hairdressers" and those who dream of transgressions. Only the youngest, who did not expect anything special, will be satisfied with the trip.
notes: The film follows the pattern (small episodes relating to the members of a group) of the previous "Domenica d'agosto". But this time the concatenation appears more disjointed. Some parts are splendid (Fabrizi temptato adultero), Bosè is divine, and Yves Montand is also seen singing.

title: Sherlock Holmes in New York
actors: Roger Moore, John Huston, Charlotte Rampling
description: The hated Moriarty is alive and in New York. He kidnapped a little boy and wants a golden boat in return. Holmes rushes. Intelligent television apocryphal, complete with a love story. The actors have a lot of fun, Holmes falls in love with Rampling.

title: The Spanish Gardener
actors: Dirk Bogarde, Cyril Cusack, John Whiteley, Bernard Lee
description: Harrington Brande, an elderly English consul, retired in a small town on the Spanish coast, employs a young local gardener, José Santero, and a treacherous scheming butler named Garcia. The first makes a strong friendship with Nicola, the consul's son, the other tries to divide them. Then one evening, completely drunk, Garcia confronts the little boy with a knife.
notes: Good adaptation, but without excessive emotions of a novel by Archibald J. Cronin. Even if all the clear homosexual implications of the original are carefully disguised here. In any case, Dirk Bogarde is as flawless as usual.

title: Antonio Gramsci - I giorni del carcere
actors: Riccardo Cucciolla, Paolo Bonacelli, Franco Graziosi, Biagio Pelligra, Mimsy Farmer
description: Born in Sardinia in 1891, Gramsci is a socialist student in Turin. In 1919 he founded the newspaper "The new order", leads the council workers movement. In 1921 he was among the founders of the Communist Party. Parliamentary, in 1926 the fascist regime sentenced him to twenty years of imprisonment which Antonio served in the prison of Turi, where he ended up alienating his "comrades" in prison. Biography from the television trend. Good performances by Cucciolla and above all by Bonacelli (the police chief).

title: Yol
actors: Tarik Akan, Halil Hergün, Necmettin Cobanoglu, Serif Sezer
description: Five Turkish detainees obtain, after long years spent in prison, a long-awaited eight-day leave. The youngest of the five loses his documents and is immediately arrested. The other four join their families located in different regions of Turkey. Omer joins his Kurdish countrymen who are fighting for independence; Molvüt is not free even in the family, where he is guarded by all the family members; Mehemet ends up being killed by his young brother-in-law; Seyit knows he has to kill his wife, who betrayed him during his incarceration.
notes: The film was written and discussed in prison by the director (held for an obscure murder case) and translated into images by his assistant Serif Gören. The editing was carried out by Guney himself who fled to Switzerland, thanks to a semi-liberty permit. The realistic style and melodramatic tone is the trump card that Guney uses to create a vibrant and intense picture of Turkish society. He won ex-aequo with "Missing" the Palme d'Or at the Cannes Film Festival.

title: L'India vista da Rossellini
description: The destination of my trip is India, which everyone defines as mysterious and which I personally consider absolutely not mysterious !, so said Rossellini before leaving. The result of his journey is this documentary that starts from Bombay to go into the most hidden territories of the nation to discover a world apart.

title: Westfront 1918
actors: Gustav Diesse, Hans Joachim Moebis, Fritz Campers, Claus Clausen
description: German soldiers in the trenches at the end of the First World War. A student, after bloody attacks on the white weapon, spends a night of love with an "enemy" girl. Karl, on leave, finds his wife in bed with her lover; he then decides to return to the front line and volunteers for a suicide mission. A classic of pacifist cinema and the first sound cinema (the musical commentary is missing for a realistic choice).

title: High Sierra
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Ida Lupino, Arthur Kennedy, Joan Leslie
description: Mad Dog Roy, a former robber, has already been in jail and does not want to go back. A shot at the hotel succeeds, but four corpses remain on the field and two of these are his cronies. Roy is hopeless, but he also has a heart. He finances an operation for a destitute girl, with whom he is in love, but she becomes engaged to another. Disappointed in life and hunted by the police, Roy has no escape.
notes: It's a classic full of ambushes, tears, big leaps and gorgeous sequences. Bogart, chosen by the production after the rejections of Paul Muni and George Raft, confirms his vocation to the role of the hard-hearted. Screenplay by John Huston and W. R. Burnett.

title: A Gunfight
actors: Kirk Douglas, Johnny Cash, Karen Black, Keith Carradine, Raf Vallone
description: Willy Tenneray lives in a New Mexico village with his wife, son and a reputation as a gunslinger behind him. Abe Cross arrives in the village, also no longer young, but with an illustrious past. The two would have no desire to challenge each other, but fate confronts them, forcing them to sell the spectacle of their latest duel. Typical adult western, dirty and well written, even produced by an Indian community.

title: Non ci resta che piangere
actors: Roberto Benigni, Massimo Troisi, Amanda Sandrelli, Paolo Bonacelli, Iris Peynado, Carlo Monni, Livia Venturini, Elisabetta Pozzi, Nicola Morelli, Peter Boom
description: The master Saverio and the janitor Mario, surprised by a storm in the countryside, find refuge in an old inn. When they wake up the following day, they discover that they are finished in 1492. After a first bewilderment, they try to adapt to the situation, with predictable results. Then, Saverio gets the great idea of ??going to Spain to stop Christopher Columbus before he discovers America. Benigni and Troisi in a film directed and interpreted by four hands. A pairing that could have been memorable. Too bad it doesn't work properly. However, the film was a huge success and some gags remained famous.

title: Postcards from the Edge
actors: Meryl Streep, Shirley MacLaine, Dennis Quaid, Gene Hackman
description: Susanna Vale, who risked death from an overdose while shooting a film she played, is entrusted to her mother, Doris Mann, a famous star of the 1950s musical comedy. The climate is tense between the two women: on the one hand the possessive mother is also afflicted with alcoholism problems; on the other hand, the daughter, who in addition to recovering from the trauma must endure the temperament of the former.
notes: Based on the autobiographical book by Carrie Fisher, daughter of Debbie Reynolds and Eddy Fisher (who therefore knows what it's about), the film is certainly well-interpreted and well-conducted. It is a pity that the original spirit, more bitter and pungent, has been lost a bit.

title: House Party
actors: Christopher Reid, Robin Harris, Christopher Martin, Tisha Campbell-Martin
description: His name is Peter, but everyone calls him Play. She is a minor, black and has a house of her own, at least for one evening. Together with his friend Kid he decides to organize a party, but everything seems to go wrong. First one and then the other find themselves dealing with ...
notes: Typical comedy for teenagers, this time in black version, with a hint of suspense. Everything goes smoothly, but without wheelies.

title: In nome della legge
actors: Massimo Girotti, Jone Salinas, Charles Vanel, Camillo Mastrocinque
description: A first-hair magistrate arrives in a town in Sicily intent on fighting the mafia. Only a boy named Paolino is on his side. Due to the widespread silence, the results are poor also because the men of the village are in the hands of Baron Lo Verso, owner of the solfatara that gives work to everyone. When the baron closes the mine, the judge seriously thinks about leaving. Following the murder of Paolino, he realizes that his duty is to stay.
notes: Southern Western: Sicily like Ford's Panoramic Valley, and the fight between mafia and the law like that between bandits and sheriffs. In the wake of a beautiful novel by Giuseppe Lo Schiavo, an airy and captivating direction by Germi, which despite its singular perspective manages not to be too superficial and folkloric. Great actors.

title: A Stranger Among Us
actors: Melanie Griffith, Eric Thal, Jamey Sheridan, Mia Sara, Lee Richardson
description: Emily Eden is a young NYPD detective, apparently resistant to any human emotion. She is entrusted with the case of the disappearance of Yaakov Klausman, a member of the Hasidic Jewish community and a large quantity of diamonds. For Emily, the person responsible for the theft, rather than the missing person, is to be found among the other members of the community; for this she decides, in agreement with the Rabbi and his son Ariel, to blend in by living with them as one of the family. The rabbi's guest like her is also another girl, a former drug addict. In this way he manages to track down Klausman, who is dead, and to discover the murderer. But, what is more important, the experience in close contact with the traditions and spirituality of the community that welcomed it will ultimately be the cause of its detachment and its human coldness. Behind the police pretext, Sidney Lumet tackles the very topical theme of the encounter between different cultures, underlining how in the metropolitan context such diversity touches us every day, in general indifference. The risk associated with such an attempt was that of falling into the trap of the cheap "picturesque"; Lumet must be acknowledged for having avoided it, managing instead to outline a decidedly unusual model of community with sober participation. Only in the finale does the logic of gender prevail again, with ritual chases and shootings.

title: Buon Natale, buon anno
actors: Virna Lisi, Michel Serrault, Tiziana Pini, Paolo Graziosi
description: We are in Rome. The spouses Gino (ex barber) and Elvira must separate after forty years of marriage. An eviction has deprived them of their homes and now they live, one with one daughter and one with the other, on opposite ends of the city. The distance, however, awakens in them feelings of affection and desires that seemed to be dormant forever.
notes: The two protagonists do their best to make acceptable a script that has glaring gaps. However, the result is not despicable.

title: The Conquest of Paradise
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Sigourney Weaver, Armand Assante, Angela Molina, Fernando Rey
description: Columbus's idea of ??reaching China by sailing to the West was rejected by Spanish intellectuals, but a shipowner, a banker and, finally, Queen Isabella of Castile also believed in him. After an exasperating journey, he arrives in San Salvador, in the Caribbean, and, returning to Spain, announces success. Back in the West Indies as viceroy, he dreams of building an ideal civilization there, but has to deal with the greed of the Spaniards who enslave and massacre the Indians.
notes: Technically solid Kolossal where, in some sequences, Ridley Scott knows how to deploy a masterful visual power. The whole is however disappointing, flattened in the unsolved oscillation between historical truth and novel, with too many themes that pile up without finding development.

title: Montenegro or Pigs and Pearls
actors: Susan Anspach, Erland Josephson, Bora Todorovic, Marianne Jacobi
description: Marilyn, a middle-class housewife, is bored and dissatisfied. Her husband takes her with him on one of his trips but she misses the plane, and with two Slavs met at the airport she reaches the Zanzi Bar, a local meeting place for Yugoslav immigrants in the heart of theirs.

title: Night Game
actors: Roy Scheider, Karen Young, Paul Gleason, Richard Bradford
description: The Astros baseball team has struck a winning streak. Lieutenant Michael Seaver cheers for the Astros, is engaged to Roxy, but is more concerned about the serial killer who has already killed three girls with a hook, on three different nights, all near the carnival. The breakup will have to do with base-ball, but the film starring poor Scheider is really silly.

title: Problem Child
actors: John Ritter, Michael Oliver, Jack Warden, Michael Richards, Amy Yasbeck
description: Junior is seven years old and lives in an orphanage run by nuns. There is no shortage of couples ready to adopt him, the problem is that he is a small hurricane: after a few days of foster care the "probationary parents" bring him back terrified. The last to try are Florence and Ben: Junior quickly sets fire to his room, destroys a supermarket, teaches bad words to the parrot, gets into a fight with the house cat, messes up a game and a little girl's party. But Ben manages to break through the baby's heart. In the wake of "Mom, I missed the plane", a fake-bad and very sugary comedy, with the usual Hollywood children.

title: Split Second
actors: Rutger Hauer, Kim Cattrall, Neil Duncan, Michael J. Pollard
description: In a leaden and rainy London, just past the year 2000, a serial killer is wandering around. Detective Stone is agitated against him, already suspended by the police and now reinstated to face the threat. Stone discovers that the man strikes only on new moon nights. More than a thriller, a futuristic thriller made with the leftovers of a thousand other films.

title: White Fang
actors: Ethan Hawke, Klaus Maria Brandauer, Seymour Cassel
description: Young Jack Conroy arrives in the Klondike in 1898 to claim the rights to his missing father's mine. With the help of guide Alex Larson, Jack heads to the mine area through countless adventures. He stops at Gray Beaver where he meets White Fang, half dog and half wolf, ready to give him his friendship and even save his life. But, as Jack continues his journey, White Fang is taken by the cruel Beauty Smith who intends to make him a fighting animal.
notes: The film is inspired by the London novel, but White Fang only reaches the middle of the film and is never the protagonist. The protagonist is Ethan Hawke, quite bewildered.

title: Airport
actors: Burt Lancaster, Dean Martin, Jacqueline Bisset, Helen Hayes
description: On the Chicago-Rome flight, there is a mad bomber who intends to blow up the plane so that his wife can collect life insurance. Commander Vernon tries in vain to dissuade him and the situation remains tense until, because of a passenger. From Arthur Hailey's bestseller, a meatloaf with a cast of stars and ex-stars (Helen Hayes won the Oscar for supporting).

title: Black Moon Rising
actors: Tommy Lee Jones, Linda Hamilton, Robert Vaughn, Bubba Smith
description: The Black Moon is a prototype car capable of reaching 500 kilometers per hour, in which Quint has hidden a hot audio cassette, stolen on behalf of tax officials.

title: Der Prinz und der Bettelknabe
actors: Sean Scully, Guy Williams, Laurence Naismith, Niall MacGinnis
description: In 16th century England a young prince discovers he has a double, a very poor boy. The two, for fun, decide to switch roles. Yet another version of Twain's novel, and not the best, produced by Disney for TV.

title: Il viaggio di Capitan Fracassa
actors: Vincent Perez, Massimo Troisi, Ornella Muti, Emmanuelle Béart, Tosca D'Aquino, Jean-François Perrier, Ciccio Ingrassia, Lauretta Masiero, Claudio Amendola, Giuseppe Cederna, Toni Ucci, Massimo Wertmüller, Remo Girone, Marco Messeri, Naike Rivelli
description: To reach the court of Paris, the penniless Baron de Sigognac joins a troupe of actors. It is the total initiation to life, to love, to the theater, which transforms him into the bold mask of Captain Fracassa. The walkers embark on an adventurous journey between the counties of that ancient world, and the noble baron renounces the house to devote himself exclusively to art.
notes: The storytelling power of staging, of theater and art, manages to be more true than true. Scola's last successful film, before his creative decline, is a picaresque adventure that leads to the fantastic.

title: Eaux profondes
actors: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Isabelle Huppert, Christian Benedetti, Bertrand Bonvoisin
description: Vic, the owner of a small perfume company on the island of Jersey, is married to Mélanie, a woman he adores, but by whom he is blatantly betrayed. Then Vic spreads the rumor that he kills his wife's lovers.
notes: Based on a novel by Patricia Highsmith, Deville's film is full of nuances and absolutely non-trivial.

title: Blackmail
actors: Anny Ondra, Sara Allgood, John Londgen
description: The girlfriend of a Scotland Yard detective lets herself be courted by a painter who, led to his studio, attempts to rape her. She kills him with a knife. Frank, the boyfriend tries to find out the truth. Hitchcock's first sound film: suspense and experimentalism.

title: All That Money Can Buy
actors: James Craig, Walter Huston, Simone Simon
description: A destitute farmer sells his soul to the devil and becomes rich. But it also becomes greedy and selfish.
notes: Faust in New Hampshire with Walter Huston playing the devil Beautifully photographed by Joseph August (the ideal shoulder for Dieterle's visual talent), it is a film that digs not too deep but witty into the perverse folds of American optimism order. Oscar to Bernard Herrman for the soundtrack. To be seen.

title: Juarez
actors: Brian Aherne, Bette Davis, Paul Muni
description: Maximilian of Habsburg obtained the crown of Mexico as a gift from Napoleon. The republican party, led by Benito Juarez, organized a strenuous resistance against him, which resulted in full guerrilla warfare. Davis is memorable, especially in the hysterics scene.

title: I Know My Name: Is Steven
actors: Cindy Pickett, John Ashton, C. 'Corky' Nemec, R. Walston
description: Steven Staynor is a seven -year -old boy. One day, while he is going to school, he is kidnapped on the street by a stranger. The first thing that is strange to the police is the fact that a single individual has kidnapped Steven and not, as usually happens, a band of kidnappers. The second singular thing is that Steven remains in captivity for seven long years. In all this time, the family, desperate, has no news of him and even the most scrupulous searches are useless ...
notes: It is not the first time that cinema addresses such a delicate theme as that of the kidnappings. This time, however, the limit of the most unbridled imagination has passed.

title: Fun with Dick and Jane
actors: George Segal, Jane Fonda, Ed McMahon, Richard Gautier, Allan Miller
description: Engineer Dick Harper is fired. Choked between mortgages to pay and the impossibility of finding a new job, he ends up giving himself to thefts and petty robberies. His wife Jane is his accomplice. Knowing that his former boss has "black" money, the result of corruption, Dick scores with Jane the blow, for which the man will not be able to report them. The problem of unemployment is just a pretext for this discreet comedy that winks at a "counter-current" morality, without taking itself very seriously. Screenplay and direction focus on traditional, Segal and Fonda on their (at the time) solid charisma.

title: Il re si diverte
actors: Michel Simon, Rossano Brazzi, Maria Mercader, Doris Duranti
description: Rigoletto is the court jester of the French king Francis I and is also his accomplice in his gallant adventures. One day some jealous courtiers decide to kidnap Rigoletto's daughter and offer her to the king. The revenge will be immediate and will be revolted

title: The Fast Lady
actors: Stanley Baxter, Julie Christie, James Robertson Justice, Leslie Phillips
description: Young employee Scott Murdoch Troon is hit by a Rolls Royce during a cycling trip; thus he meets Claire, the daughter of the car owner, and between them it is love. For the love of the girl, Scott buys a Bentley Sport (which is then the "lady sprint" of the title), with which he combines all the colors. A comedy that does not venture particular narrative modernities, but which, remaining faithful to the classic British trend of the genre, unfolds with brilliance and humor, thanks also to the impeccable professionalism of the performers. From the novel of the same name by Keble Howard.

title: Le magnifiche sette
actors: Carlo Dapporto, Valeria Fabrizi, Alberto Bonucci, Ave Ninchi
description: Seven officers, all women, belonging to an international police organization are on the trail of a man involved in the white trade. The main suspects are a writer, a former French colonel and Baron Orso della Portella. Rare case of a film starring Dapporto; actually, a missed opportunity.

title: The Addams Family
actors: Anjelica Huston, Raul Julia, Christopher Lloyd, Christina Ricci, Carel Struycken, Judith Malina, Jimmy Workman, Dana Ivey, Dan Hedaya
description: The Addams family experiences happy moments of horror and suffering in their ancient castle. In the tender family nest there are all: Gomez and Morticia Addams (Julia and Huston), little Wednesdays and Pugsley, the witch grandmother (Malina), the servant Lurch and the Hand. After years of absence, unexpectedly, his brother Fester (Lloyd) returns accompanied by an androgynous German doctor. But little Wednesday has doubts. What if Fester was just an impostor, interested in the treasures hidden in the castle? Based on the famous 1960s television series, the film has an impressive cast. Huston looks like she was born to make Morticia and Lloyd is a perfect Fester. He and Raul Julia perform a sword duet which is the most successful sequence in the film. Unfortunately Sonnenfeld, celebrated director of photography, does not show great personality on his directorial debut.

title: The Horse Soldiers
actors: John Wayne, William Holden, Constance Towers, Althea Gibson
description: Northern Colonel Marlowe sets out to infiltrate enemy territory and sabotage Confederate supplies. Following him is Kendall, a medical officer. It soon becomes clear that the two hate each other. At a certain point they are forced to join a woman, who after hosting them was caught spying on them. During the trip we discover the reason for Marlowe's hatred for doctors: they caused the death of his wife through inexperience. Meanwhile, not only Kendall wins the esteem of the officer, but also the woman. Pure military Ford, less melancholy and profound than others, but with masterful scenes (the departure of the soldiers-children)

title: The Adventures of Baron Munchausen
actors: John Neville, Sarah Polley, Eric Idle, Oliver Reed, Uma Thurman, Jonathan Pryce, Robin Williams, Valentina Cortese, Alison Steadman, Bill Paterson, Sting
description: The noble cavalry officer Karl Friedrich Hyeronimus Von Münchausen recalls the amazing adventures he had with four companions with extraordinary abilities. With their collaboration he saves a town besieged by the Turks after having been, in the company of a little girl, on the moon, by the god Vulcan in the bowels of the earth and having escaped every trap. Eventually death will await him
notes: Lavishly crafted by one of the legendary "Monty Pythons", the film is a triumph of prodigious baroque, a highly spectacular game as a function of intelligent entertainment. Loosely based on the novel by Rudolph Eric Raspe. Camei of Robin Williams (dribbling his own head), Valentina Cortese and Sting. It was a notable commercial failure.

title: The Accused
actors: Jodie Foster, Kelly McGillis, Bernie Coulson, Ann Hearn
description: Young Sarah Tobias is raped in a bar by three individuals, amid the laughter of other customers. A boy calls the police, but to no avail. Deputy Prosecutor Katheryn Murphy takes charge of the case and ultimately decides on the rape charge, accused of instigating all those who witnessed it. The defense thesis is all about provocation by the victim.
notes: A film denounces the exemplary construction that makes use of the tense, hard-nosed interpretation of a Jodie Foster in a particular state of grace. For this film, the ex-girl prodigy of "Taxi Driver" won the Oscar for Best Actress in a Leading Role.

title: Missing
actors: Jack Lemmon, Sissy Spacek, John Shea, Melanie Mayron
description: Charles, a young American who lives in a Latin American country with his wife Beth, has always been interested in the social and political conditions of the state where he lives. When this is upset by a bloody coup, Charles disappears. Beth, along with some friends, begins the search, with no results. Not even the arrival of his father, a businessman from New York, solves the situation.
notes: The historical reference is the Pinochet coup in Chile and the denunciation aspect is effective. Excellent Jack Lemmon in the role of the increasingly distraught parent and Sissy Spacek in that of the wife who does not want to give up. The shock sequence of searches in the Stadium is unforgettable. Palme d'Or in Cannes.

title: K-9
actors: James Belushi, Mel Harris, Kevin Tighe, James Handy, Ed O'Neill
description: A narcotics squad policeman conducts the investigation of a dangerous gang of thugs with a bulky and original trained Alsatian dog. The beginning of their "collaboration" will be terrible, but then the two will become inseparable ...
notes: Detective plot, strongly marked by a not always fresh comedy, with a James Belushi now "confined" to such roles. The real protagonist thus becomes the friendly shepherd Jerry Lee with his stunts. Although the production is by Disney, the film often indulges in jokes of a certain vulgarity.

title: La cage
actors: Lino Ventura, Ingrid Thulin, William Sabatier
description: The ex-wife summons Julien to his isolated villa with the excuse that she wants to sell it to him, but imprisons him in a basement and forces him to a long awareness of the failure of their marriage. Psychological symbolic drama supported by the good performance of the two protagonists.

title: The Americanization of Emily
actors: Julie Andrews, James Garner, Melvyn Douglas
description: Emily, an English war widow, weaves a love story with Charlie, an American lieutenant who is in London ahead of the Normandy landings. Charlie has absolutely nothing of the heroic fighter, but he can't help but be the first to set foot in France. A pinch of black comedy, in a comedy interpreted with wit and written by Paddy Chayefsky.

title: They Only Kill Their Masters
actors: James Garner, Katharine Ross, Hal Halbrook, June Allyson
description: Three months pregnant Jenny was found murdered on the beach of a small California beach town. Detective Abel Marsh investigates, discovering a tangle of murky relationships around the murdered man, while other crimes are added to the first. Noir of classic atmospheres.

title: The Secret Partner
actors: Stewart Granger, Haya Harareet, Bernard Lee
description: Brent, representative in London of a navigation company, is blackmailed by Beldon who once has been in jail with him. Threatened in turn by a mysterious character, Beldon scores a theft to the navigation company and faults the blame on Brent.
notes: The story is rather complicated but of good pace. There are some echoes from Hitchcock ("the other man").

title: The Wheeler Dealers
actors: James Garner, Lee Remick, Phil Harris, Chill Wills, Jim Backus
description: An enterprising Texan boy goes to New York determined to make money. He meets a Wall Street employee, falls in love with her, and with her complicity sets up an ingenious financial soap bubble, which produces a shower of millions. A pleasant and superficial comedy about the world of finance, directed by the future director of Love Story.

title: Robbery
actors: Stanley Baker, James Booth, Frank Finlay
description: A robbery from a jeweler serves Paul Clifton only to finance another even more spectacular heist, targeting the night mail train on the Glasgow-London line. Fictionalized chronicle of a famous robbery of 1963, exciting and accurate.

title: Watusi
actors: George Montgomery, Taina Elg, David Farrar, Rex Ingram
description: Harry Quartermain travels to Africa on the trail of his father who died during an ill-fated expedition in search of King Solomon's fabled mines. On the spot, Harry meets Rick Cobb, an experienced hunter and friend of his father. The two decide to organize a safari and go into the forest. After a few days of walking they discover the remains of a Protestant mission. While searching the area, Harry and Rick find some women's clothing that lead them on the trail of Erica, daughter of the missionary and prisoner of the Kaluana warriors.
notes: A skilful variation work on the delightful 1937 Gainsborough production, "King Solomon's Mines".

title: Frenchie
actors: Shelley Winters, Joel McCrea, Paul Kelly
description: She calls herself Yvonne and, from New Orleans, returns to her native village in the West to avenge the murder of her father, carried out by two bad guys when she was a child. His private warfare soon finds an affectionate ally in the sheriff.
notes: Modest and conventional western melodrama.

title: The Journey
actors: Yul Brynner, Deborah Kerr, Jason Robards, Anouk Aimée
description: Blocked at the Budapest airport during the 1956 Hungarian uprising, fourteen Westerners headed to Vienna are interrogated and detained for a few days by Soviet Major Surov (Brynner), who doesn't really like doing what he does.
notes: International super-cast for a slow melodrama with a vague political background.

title: Alex in Wonderland
actors: Donald Sutherland, Jeanne Moreau, Federico Fellini
description: After the success of his first film, an American director debates to escape the grip that Hollywood, as a production system and model of life, inexorably squeezes around him. Another "eccentric" stage in the eccentric filmography of Paul Mazursky, with showy tributes to Fellini's poetics, which also appears in the film.

title: Never Let Me Go
actors: Clark Gable, Gene Tierney, Richard Haydn
description: An American reporter and a British diplomat in Moscow become friends and marry two Russians. Unnoticed by the Soviet authorities, the two are forced to repatriate without being able to take their wives with them. They "recover" them later with a daring operation.

title: Two Weeks with Love
actors: Jane Powell, Ricardo Montalban, Louis Calhern, Debbie Reynolds
description: At the turn of the century, the Robinson family (he, she, two children and two girls) went to the sea for a summer vacation. Seventeen-year-old Patty, in competition with a more savvy girl, falls in love with a young and wealthy Cuban. A relaxing musical comedy with Jane Powell and Ricardo Montalban. Debbie Reynolds dances and sings.

title: Texas Across the River
actors: Dean Martin, Alain Delon, Rosemary Forsyth, Joey Bishop, Tina Marquand, Stuart Anderson
description: Andrea, a Spanish noble, is in Louisiana to marry the beautiful Isabella; the provocation of a jealous officer starts a fight in which the officer dies. Andrea repairs in Texas, where he escorts a caravan; after saving a young Indian girl from human sacrifice, he finds himself having to face the angry Indians, the United States army on his trail and Sam, the leader of the caravan who fell in love with Isabella.
notes: The western setting is used to create a humorous comedy full of gags. Trouble is, the film failed completely either as a western or as a parody of the genre. But the fun, at least there is.

title: Zandy's Bride
actors: Gene Hackman, Liv Ullmann, Harry Dean Stanton
description: The difficult marriage between a Swedish immigrant (Liv Ullmann) and a rude and rude cowboy (Gene Hackman). With perseverance and patience, but not without worries, the woman finally manages to overcome the misunderstood machismo of her husband and to make him a responsible father and husband. Great actors for a kind of atypical western, centered solely on interpersonal relationships.

title: Second Wind
actors: James Naughton, Lindsay Wagner
description: Roger Mathieson is thirty years old, a good job for a major Toronto firm and a decent financial situation that has recently allowed him to buy a luxurious home. Roger also has a wife named Linda and relations with her are idyllic, at least until he discovers he has an uncommon talent for running. From that moment on, running became a sort of obsession for him. Shebib watches a couple fall apart under the blows of that harmless madness, so common in our times, for marathons, jogging and the like. Naughton ("An American Werewolf in London") is the marathon runner. Wagner ("The Bionic Woman") is the victim.

title: La figlia del Corsaro Verde
actors: Doris Duranti, Fosco Giachetti, Camillo Pilotto, Mariella Lotti
description: Under a false name, the son of the governor of a Spanish colony manages to enter the ranks of the pirates who rage with their banditry actions, in order to defeat them. But, after passing many tests, he is unmasked and sentenced to death. The daughter of the deceased Green Corsair, in love with the daring young man, will take care of freeing him and helping him until the final victory. Based on a novel attributed to Salgari, the film is full of action, but today it is almost pathetic for how naive and childish it is. He saves himself for a certain elegance in the setting and for the commitment of the performers. In a small part the boxer Primo Carnera.

title: Mimì Bluette... fiore del mio giardino
actors: Monica Vitti, Shelley Winters, Tommy Tune, Hella Petri
description: Daughter of a prostitute from Belluno, the dancer Mimì Bluette is the idol of Parisians. The most beautiful names in politics and finance court her, but when she is about to get married she meets a mysterious man with whom she lives three days of passionate love. Then he disappears and she, as much as she looks for him, even in Africa, will never find him again. She starts dancing again, but now she is a different woman. Cinematic adaptation of Guido Da Verona's novel of the same name, the film is based on the protagonist's passage from libertinage to loyalty to one man. An unsuccessful mixture of irony, sentimentality and the grotesque. Discreet interpreters.

title: Where Were You When the Lights Went Out?
actors: Doris Day, Robert Morse, Terry-Thomas, Patrick O'Neal
description: Actress Margaret returns home earlier than expected one day and discovers that her husband was about to cheat on her. Outraged, she retires to a Connecticut villa where, due to some power outages in the state of New York, a certain Valdo arrives and has stolen two million dollars from the company he works for. Margaret's repentant husband joins his wife in the villa, but now it is he who suspects Margaret's fidelity, due to the presence of Valdo. To complicate matters further, here is Margaret's impresario who has an interest in ruining her marriage.
notes: In the "mare magnum" of Hollywood comedies, this is certainly not among the most remarkable nor among the most hilarious. The mechanism of misunderstandings finds a decent application here, but without inventions of particular importance, and not even the humorous spiciness of the dialogues is excellent.

title: The Bodyguard
actors: Kevin Costner, Whitney Houston, Gary Kemp, Bill Cobbs
description: Someone is trying to kill the famous rock star Rachel Marron (Houston). Frank Farmer (Costner), a former CIA agent, is called to watch her back. Rachel can't stand Farmer at first, then breaks up. Meanwhile, the madman, the one who sends the anonymous letters to Rachel, tries a couple of times to score, but Frank parries the blows. The most dangerous moment seems to be that of the Oscars ceremony: Rachel will be on stage, Frank will be in the wings with the earphone to his ear. Even the madman will be around. The film is all about Kevin's wry smirks and Whitney's dazzling voice. The rest is negligible, including the bucolic parenthesis, a real expedient to lengthen the soup Perhaps the success of the film was simply driven by the hit "I'll Always Love You" (but you have to wait two hours and ten, and that is the last two minutes of the film, to listen to it for the first time).

title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
actors: Errol Flynn, Basil Rathbone, Claude Rains, Olivia de Havilland
description: Richard the Lionheart left for the Crusades in the Holy Land and his brother Giovanni took the opportunity to take power in England. The noble Robin Hood rises against him, who organizes a band of rebels and gives himself to banditry to fight the usurper.
notes: At the time, it cost a whopping two million dollars. Great action, great technicolor and Oscar-winning music.

title: Whose Child Is This? The War for Baby Jessica
actors: Susan Dey, Michael Ontkean, Amanda Plummer, David Keith
description: Dear Clausen and Dan Schmidt are definitely not a wealthy couple, so when little Jessica is born, her mother agrees to give her up for adoption. His new parents, Robby and Jan DeBoer, are respectable, wealthy, and well-mannered. Some time passes, and Cara regrets and tries to get her daughter back. The case ends up in court and on the front pages of newspapers. Baby Jessica's story actually caught America a little over a year ago. With speed worthy of a better cause, American television put together a boring and completely skewed film in favor of the DeBoers, the ones who later won the case.

title: Krakatoa East of Java
actors: Maximilian Schell, Diane Baker, Brian Keith
description: Under the command of Captain Hanson, the "Batavia Queen" leaves Singapore for the volcanic island of Krakatoa. As soon as it arrives, the volcano begins to show signs of activity. Very spectacular for the time, even if we are used to it by now. And anyway Krakatoa is west of Java.

title: Movers and Shakers
actors: Walter Matthau, Charles Grodin, Vincent Gardenia, Steve Martin, Gilda Radner
description: Old producer Saul Gritz, on his deathbed, had Joe Mulholland promise to produce a film based on the book "Love in Sex". Joe brings together the best brains of the firm, but, despite collective efforts, the film does not move forward.
notes: The idea (of the film) was not bad, the actors involved are excellent, but in the end the result is rather bland. Exactly like in cinematic fiction.

title: 4 marmittoni alle grandi manovre
actors: Gianfranco D'Angelo, Sergio Leonardi, Gianni Agus, Lino Banfi, Alida Chelli, Tony Ucci
description: One was a shepherd in Abruzzo, another was a thief in Rome, the third comes from Sicily and the fourth from Naples, but with a family tree behind him. They find themselves together thanks to military service and together they make jokes, have fun, court girls and other similar things. In the end, during a NATO exercise, they also manage to make the Italian army stand out: they will be decorated. Amendola and Bruno Corbucci. A few big laughs, winks and other platitudes.

title: Le roman de Werther
actors: Pierre Richard-Willm, Annie Vernay, Jean Galland
description: Young Werther works at the Walheim courthouse; he meets the beautiful Charlotte and falls in love with her, without knowing that she is already betrothed. The future husband is Werther's superior. Forced to step aside, the young man indulges in a dissipated life; summoned to order by his superiors and urged by Charlotte, he comes to his senses but briefly. Desperate, Werther eventually decides to kill himself.
notes: Max Ophüls grappling with Goethe through a screenplay by Hans Wilhelm and Fernand Crommelynck. The original undergoes some changes there: Ophuls favors its romantic sweetness, underlined by the splendid exteriors (shot in Alsace).

title: A me mi piace
actors: Enrico Montesano, Rochelle Redfield, Dan Doby, Lara Wendel
description: Arturo (Montesano) works in Milan for a private television. One evening Mike, an American friend, is seen arriving in the house, desperate because his wife Marion ran away with a man named Jack. In an attempt to help him, Arturo meets Marion and love is born between the two. After having overcome the ensuing storm unscathed (with her husband and the other, now allies against him, the new "usurper"), Arturo the serene returns, under the sign of true friendship, which cannot end for so little. . In fact, Mike finds a new girlfriend and Arturo joins Marion in the United States.
notes: Enrico Montesano makes his directorial debut with a comedy that tries to look at American classics, adapting their spirit to today.

title: What About Bob?
actors: Bill Murray, Richard Dreyfuss, Julie Hagerty, Charlie Korsmo
description: The neurotic Bob Whiley decides to seek the care of a psychoanalyst, Dr. Leo Marvin. The latter, leaving for the holidays, advises him to read his latest book. But Bob tracks him down and starts harassing him until the exasperated doctor tries to kill him. The doctor's family, however, likes Bob, so much so that Leo's sister decides to marry him. Bob, finally healed, in turn undertakes his psychology studies. Here is an example of a funny, brilliant film, perhaps not always amazing (but the whole first part certainly is), which occasionally arrives on our screens. The credit goes to the lively and easy-going direction and above all to the duo Murray-Dreyfuss.

title: The Goonies
actors: Sean Astin, Josh Brolin, Jeff Cohen, Ke Huy Quan, Anne Ramsey, Corey Feldman, Martha Plimpton, Kerri Green, John Matuszak, Robert Davi, Joe Pantoliano, Lupe Ontiveros, Mary Ellen Trainor, Steve Antin
description: A group of powerful people is buying all the houses in the Goon Docks neighborhood with clear speculative intent. A gang of neighborhood kids, the Goonies, try to fight back, but don't even know where to start. Then, one evening, while rummaging in the attic, the boys discover a yellowed Spanish map that contains precise indications on how to find an ancient treasure. The small band thus enters an abandoned chalet and from there into a labyrinth of caves. However, the boys do not know that the place is the secret base of operations of a gang of thieves headed by "Mamma Fratelli" and her two violent sons. After a thousand ups and downs, traps, underground rivers and pirate vessels, our heroes will arrive at the treasure and save the neighborhood. The film is a reinterpretation of the pirate film, smashing and funny, shot for kids but with cinephile taste (the subject is by Spielberg, who is also a producer, the screenplay by Chris Columbus). The underground scenographies are beautiful.

title: Family Express
actors: Peter Fonda, Victoria Vera, Maurizio Latini, Nicola Pistoia, Teco Celio
description: Marcello is a Milanese orphan who gets upset with his uncle Franco by stealing what he finds in tourist buses. One day he is so tired, but so tired that he falls asleep just as he is "working" on a bus and wakes up in Zurich ...

title: Palermo oder Wolfsburg
actors: Nicola Zarbo, Ida Di Benedetto, Magdalena Montezuma, Otto Sander, Johannes Wacker, Antonio Orlando, Brigitte Tilg, Gisela Hahn, Calogero Arancio, Cavaliere Comparato, Padre Pace, Harry Baer, Ula Stöckl, Tamara Kafka, Ines Zamurovic
description: Nicola Zarbo, eighteen, Sicilian, in Wolfsburg to work at Wolkswagen, in short: a soul in pain. There he makes friends with some Italians, with the owner of a restaurant and in the end also with the blonde Brigitte, beautiful, German and, at least in appearance, in love. Then one evening of celebration she goes away with two compatriots and he kills them. At the trial Nicola remains silent until almost the end.
notes: Schroeter likes melodramas. Here the highlight is the final process in which the linguistic misunderstandings, the muteness and the warm perorations together make up a great theatrical coup.

title: S. I. S.
actors: Lou Diamond Phillips, Scott Glenn, Chelsea Field
description: LAPD Sergeant Jeff Powers is suspended from duty due to his reckless behavior. Lieutenant Dan Vaughn then proposes to him to join his special team: a special corps of agents, specialized in hunting down the most dangerous criminals. But Powers soon realizes that Vaughn takes advantage of his power to exasperate the clashes with the criminals and thus be able to kill them. Very often the cinema has told the more or less unhealthy deeds of solitary or accompanied executioners, but this film is based on a true story and this gives it an even more disturbing aura.

title: Jaws 2
actors: Roy Scheider, Lorraine Gary, Murray Hamilton, Joseph Mascolo
description: In the same place where the first sighting of the giant shark took place, another even more dangerous one appears. The only one who seems to realize the real danger is only the police chief, Martin Brody. Brody's alarmism, however, by contrasting with the tourist and speculative interests of the town, led to his dismissal. But he will be the one to face the monster.
notes: Released three years after Spielberg's "Jaws", this film inevitably takes up some elements: the struggle, the dimension of the monstrous, the social denunciation. However, everything remains as on the surface, without being able to descend into the abyss of the progenitor.

title: Vito e gli altri
actors: Nando Triola, Rosaria De Cicco, Giovanni Bruno
description: Vito is twelve years old. He was miraculously saved one New Year's Eve when his father took out his mother and little brother in a frenzy. Now he lives with his aunt and for him begins a life as a petty criminal: he also ends up in prison where, put in a cell with three older boys, he is raped. Once out of jail, things do not improve. The aunt who sees him so upset (Vito still pees in bed) would like to see a doctor. He prefers to entrust his fate to a gang of Camorra who will teach him how to become a killer. Capuano's debut is a film that throws away the tradition of the social film to dive into the protagonist's imagination, but at the same time choosing a very stylized staging, made up of flashes and narrative jumps. More than a social film, a moral film.

title: The Living Daylights
actors: Timothy Dalton, Maryam D'Abo, Joe Don Baker, Jeroen Krabbe
description: James Bond is engaged in an exercise during which, however, he must eliminate an agent who shot him seriously. After this prologue he is sent to Bratislava to organize the defection of Georgi Koskov, a general of the KGB. Here he thwarts an attack organized by a pretty cellist-spy. He then goes to Afghanistan where he discovers that Koskov is behind it all.
notes: 007, after the glorious seasons Connery and Moore, has recycled himself in the role of Timothy Dalton: the mythology of the character is affected, but not the spectacularity of his cinema.

title: The Far Horizons
actors: Fred MacMurray, Charlton Heston, Donna Reed, Barbara Hale
description: In 1803 the United States bought Louisiana and the officers Clark and Lewis were entrusted with the exploration. In their mission the two soldiers come across a tribe of Indians at war with that of the Scioanes, the sister of whose leader is their prisoner. Clark falls in love with her, reciprocated, who decides to take her with him to Washington to marry her. But the Indian immediately realizes that this is not her world. Rudolph Maté, former cameraman for Dreyer, Lubitsch and Hitchcock, is considered one of the most interesting B-movie directors. This western is one of his most successful products, despite the sentimental component being a bit forced.

title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Richard Crenna, Charles Napier
description: Rambo was sentenced to forced labor. Colonel Trautman offers him, in exchange for his freedom, to return to Vietnam to photograph the American prisoners' camps. Rambo agrees but, breaking the orders, frees a prisoner. Abandoned by the helicopter that was supposed to take him (without his knowledge the orders had changed) he is captured and tortured by a Soviet officer. The super warrior, however, manages to free himself, exterminates the enemies and, taking possession of a helicopter, returns to the American base.
notes: Continuation of the previous "Rambo" which, however, accentuates America's frustration with the Vietnam War. The film was a great success with the public.

title: The Return of the Pink Panther
actors: Peter Sellers, Christopher Plummer, Herbert Lom, Catherine Schell, Burt Kwouk, John Bluthal, Gregoire Aslan
description: The "Pink Panther" diamond was stolen. Inspector Clouseau is in charge of the investigation, suspecting the well-known international thief Phantom, aka Sir Charles Litton. This is why he keeps an eye on his beautiful young wife, Claudine. Litton tries to prove his innocence, but discovers that his wife is the culprit. Clouseau is about to arrest the couple when his superior Dreyfuss arrives. Third episode (twelve years after the second, "A shot in the dark") of the saga of Inspector Clouseau with the hilarious, ineffable Sellers. The film is perhaps a bit out of step in pace, but it remains a lot of fun.

title: All That Jazz
actors: Roy Scheider, Jessica Lange, Ann Reinking, Leland Palmer
description: Joe Gideon is a renowned choreographer who is putting on a big show for Broadway. He is a perfectionist and this complicates the work, which is already heavy in itself. Gideon has already overstepped the time and financial terms that the producers had made available to him. Add to that an unruly love life and smoking and exciting abuse. The heart attack is lurking and invariably strikes. Four Oscars (set design, costumes, editing, music) and a Palme d'Or in Cannes (ex aequo with Kagemusha) decorated this musical at the time, atypical for the dramatic tones that characterize it. An autobiographical and premonitory film: Bob Fosse would also die of a heart attack.

title: Fletch
actors: Chevy Chase, Joe Don Baker, Dana Wheeler-Nicholson
description: Fletch is a reporter that the local police chief is involved in drug trafficking. Stanwick, a wealthy industrialist who claims to be suffering from cancer, offers him a hefty compensation for being killed by him. However, Fletch discovers that cancer is a lie and that Stanwick and the police chief are complicit. Against all odds, our hero comes out of the affair alive and, to top it off, with an extraordinary scoop.
notes: From a detective story, Michael Ritchie invents an action comedy. The operation succeeds him discreetly thanks to the bewildered expression of Chevy Chase (do you remember him in "The three amigos"?), To some good jokes and to a passable pace.

title: Nebbie sul mare
actors: Viveca Lindfors, Gustav Diessl, Otello Toso, Umberto Spadaro, Claudio Ermelli, Carmen Navasqués, Adele Garavaglia
description: An engineer kills a man who blackmail him and then disappears. Her wife is believed to be thanks to her and undergoes a process that scagiona. When the man decides to return, he dies in a sea accident. Drama in suspense in which Pagliero dampens propaganda tones. Great interpretation of Viveca Lindfors.

title: Which Way to the Front
actors: Jerry Lewis, Jan Murray, John Wood, Kaye Ballard, Sidney Miller
description: Billionaire and patriot, discarded at the draft, he participates in the war against the Nazis with a personal army.
notes: Comic-political tale a la Chaplin, directed and performed by the great Jerry Lewis. The comedy is pure slapstick, even if the starting idea is less dazzling than elsewhere.

title: The Swan
actors: Grace Kelly, Alec Guinness, Louis Jourdan, Agnes Moorehead
description: Alessandra, a princess in exile, lives in a European country with her mother Beatrice. One day the crown prince arrives on a visit to the castle and mother Beatrice takes it into her head to marry her daughter. During the ball Alessandra will have to flirt with the young tutor Nicola and arouse the jealousies of Prince Albert. The girl, on the other hand, falls in love with the tutor, but eventually marries Alberto.
notes: A Grace Kelly at the end of the contract, the next wife of the Prince of Monaco, is involved by Metro in this operation that is truer than truth. The starting point is a faded comedy by Molnar and the result is not great, but the effect is calculated to the millimeter.

title: The Crowd
actors: James Murray, Eleanor Bordman, Bert Roach
description: Johnny goes to New York in search of fortune. Here he meets Mary, a good and kind girl. Soon the two get married, but life as a couple is not easy, especially if they soon become ... three. A few years pass; the child dies in an accident and he is fired, but it doesn't take much to hope again ...
notes: A melancholy and dry masterpiece of silent cinema. One of the most extraordinary representations of the metropolis and of the life of the middle-class, an almost prophetic film (the Weall Street crisis is the following year) and which has set a school. The rhythm is masterful, some sequences (the protagonist who, at his son's bedside, tries to silence the cars from the window) and a happy ending imposed by the production that does not affect the meaning of the film.

title: Moving
actors: Richard Pryor, Beverly Todd, Dave Thomas, Randy Quaid, Stacey Dash
description: An engineer moves from New Jersey to Boise, Idaho, where a new job awaits him. The move will be half an odyssey. From the dark period of Pryor, just a year before Don't Look at Me, I don't hear you.

title: Le complot
actors: Christopher Lambert, Ed Harris, Joanne Whalley
description: In Warsaw, Father Alec, a sympathizer of Solidarity and a supporter of human rights, is persecuted and finally murdered by the police. Inspired by the real events of Father Popieluzko, the film has its own weakness in a kind of uncontrolled ideological fury from which Ed Harris' interpretation is characterized and as a strong point. Mediocre, however, Christopher Lambert.

title: Alice, Sweet Alice - Communion and Holy Terror
actors: Paula Sheppard, Brooke Shields
description: A twelve-year-old girl kills her sister, parents and the rest of the family. It is the debut film by Brooke Shields, who also dies in the first reel at the hands of Sheppard.

title: Charro!
actors: Elvis Presley, Ina Balin, Victor French, Barbara Werle, Salomon Sturges
description: Jess Wade, aka Charro, tries to quit the bandit profession to start an honest life, but the gang leader disagrees. Presley wasn't made for the western.

title: I Take This Woman
actors: Spencer Tracy, Hedy Lamarr, Verree Teasdale, Kent Taylor, Laraine Day
description: An American doctor marries a beautiful European who is temporarily in crisis, but who loves the good life. Emotionless affairs of the heart.

title: Pony Soldier
actors: Tyrone Power, Cameron Mitchell, Robert Horton, Thomas Gomez
description: Towards the middle of the nineteenth century the border area between the United States and Canada was subject to the raids of the Indians. Following their repeated attacks, Private Chris and Lieutenant Duncan are sent to the scene to try to persuade Brown Bear to stop his parents. After various events Duncan manages to persuade the leader to bury the hatchet and free two prisoners. But Brown Bear finds the hostility of a member of his tribe.
notes: Predictable film, with Power showman.

title: Il soldato di ventura
actors: Bud Spencer, Franco Agostini, Enzo Cannavale, Philippe Leroy, Andréa Ferréol, Jacques Herlin
description: Ettore Fieramosca (Spencer), in 1503, humiliates the supposed French knights in the famous Challenge of Barletta. He is not Brancaleone, he is simpleton, but there is no lack of gags and funny jokes.

title: Conspirator
actors: Robert Taylor, Elizabeth Taylor, Harold Warrender
description: An English officer, spies, marries a beautiful American, but his behavior makes his wife suspicious. He confesses everything, but the tragedy is inevitable. Ramshackle cold war melodrama.

title: Boccaccio
actors: Enrico Montesano, Sylva Koscina, Pascale Petit, Isabella Biagini
description: Buffalmacco and Bruno degli Olivieri mock Calandrino. Brother Ignatius seduces a naive beauty. Buffalmacco again punishes and cornifies a usurer, but he suffers the revenge of another cuckold ... Caricatural "anthology" from the Decameron.

title: Never Cry Wolf
actors: Charles Martin Smith, Brian Dennehy, Zachary Ittimangnacq
description: In Canada, wolves are thought to threaten the last of the caribou. A biologist goes to the "white desert" of the North and discovers unexpected truths. Smiling ecological fairy tale and beautiful images of wild Alaska, directed by the director of "Black Beauty", but without too much sillyness despite the Disney production.

title: The Kissing Bandit
actors: Frank Sinatra, Kathryn Grayson, J. Carrol Naish
description: In Spanish-dominated California, the son of a deceased gallant outlaw, called "the kiss bandit," is compelled to trace his father's glorious footsteps. Not exciting directorial debut by Laslo Benedek, in a musical comedy sewn on Sinatra.

title: Pack of Lies
actors: Alan Bates, Ellen Burstyn, Teri Garr, Sammi Davis, David Corti
description: The quiet life of a couple is turned upside down by the arrival of a secret service official who settles into their house to spy on the moves of a friend of theirs. A dramatic film that has its strong point in the cast of great actors who play it. Ellen Burstyn was nominated for an Emmy Award, a TV Oscar.

title: Home from the Hill
actors: Eleanor Parker, Robert Mitchum, George Peppard, Luana Patten, Eleanor Parker
description: Wade Hunnicut (Mitchum), a wealthy landowner, is married to Hannah (Parker), but the marriage was, from the start, a failure. Their son Theron falls in love with Libby, but her father opposes the marriage. Pregnant, Libby says nothing to Theron and his half-brother Rafe, whom Wade had with another woman, offers to marry her.
notes: Final with tragedy. The melodramatic tone is typical of a certain portrait of the sanguine South with strong tensions, as from a well-known literature. Good narrative hold, excellent performers (especially Mitchum) in a frame of convincing dramatic evidence.

title: Fedora
actors: Luisa Ferida, Amedeo Nazzari, Osvaldo Valenti, Memo Benassi
description: Princess Fedora's fiance is murdered on the eve of the wedding and the woman vows to avenge him. In Paris Fedora meets a handsome painter and falls in love with him, but when she discovers that he is the killer, she denounces him. This causes the death of the painter's mother and brother. Fedora takes her own life too. From the homonymous play by Victorien Sardou. The music by Umberto Giordano (adapted) comments on the film, which refers to the theatrical "pièce", not the opera. Wealth of means, robustly effective screenplay, suitable interpreters for a more than dignified example of "film theater".

title: Giorno di nozze
actors: Armando Falconi, Anna Vivaldi, Paola Borboni, Antonio Gandusio
description: Two spouses of modest economic resources let their daughter Mariella study in a boarding school for the rich: for the girl's marriage to a wealthy boyfriend, they have to set up a luxurious home by resorting to various subterfuges. But at the last moment the wedding is postponed by a week: the creditors show up immediately, and the two have to invent a lot of stories to be able to face them ...
notes: Some of the stars of the distant 40s (Falconi, Gandusio, Campanini, la Borboni); in addition, the nineteen year old Anna Vivaldi, later known as Anna Proclemer: the home-made perfume of a cinema of the time that was, perhaps a little too naive, but still capable of amusing today.

title: The Secret of Convict Lake
actors: Glenn Ford, Gene Tierney, Ann Dvorak, Ethel Barrymore
description: Year 1870. Some escaped people arrive in a town inhabited only by women, because the men are in the mountains in search of gold. Among the fugitives is James, innocent, but condemned for false testimony. There lives Marsha, the girlfriend of the man who got him convicted. After many contrasts for James and Marsha there will be a new peaceful life.
notes: A story that follows a classic pattern; directing by profession. The best of the film lies in the actors and in an accurate script full of twists.

title: Il Passatore
actors: Rossano Brazzi, Valentina Cortese, Carlo Ninchi, Carlo Campanini
description: Stefano Pelloni sees his beloved woman taken away by a priest uncle who wants her to be married to another, so he kills his rival. Having become a famous bandit throughout Romagna and blessed by the people for his generosity, he leaves behind many victims, including that priest. The woman tries to get him captured, then instead dies trying to save him. Finally Pelloni gets killed by a friend, who will get the bounty. Some naivety and some uncertainty in the narrative, but the film is well done. Rossano Brazzi, in the role of Stefano Pelloni, manages not to make a comeback. There is also a very young Deaf.

title: Footloose
actors: Kevin Bacon, Lori Singer, Dianne Wiest, John Lithgow, Chris Penn
description: Ren (Bacon), a music lover and enthusiastic dancer, transplanted from Chicago to Bomont, a small provincial town, finds himself unable to devote himself to his favorite pastimes. In fact, a shepherd rages in the city who sees a sinful activity in dancing and fights it bitterly. But Ren is not there and, with the help of the shepherd's young daughter, Ariel (Singer), in love with him, unleashes a real youth rebellion. Pretty stupid juvenile comedy, in the years of "Flashdance" and "Fame", with a soundtrack that was a good success.

title: Come Live With Me
actors: James Stewart, Hedy Lamarr, Ian Hunter
description: A girl illegally expatriated from Austria to the United States is identified by the police and destined for repatriation, unless she marries an American citizen. A publisher in love with her offers herself. But the girl meets a writer and marries him. He draws a novel from his story. In the meantime, the two really fell in love. Brown was the director most faithful to Metro and its sober style, like this comedy where everything is in its place.

title: The Soft Kill
actors: Michael Harris, Corbin Bernsen, Brion James, Carrie-Anne Moss
description: A private cop is in trouble. The woman who was killed was not only his client, she had also been his mistress. It doesn't take much longer to become suspect number one. Add to this that the deceased was married to an influential politician. Eli Cohen is a wandering Jew. After his Israeli debut with Ricochets, a good anti-war film, he went to Canada for the quasi-theatrical The Quarrel. Too bad that, now that he has arrived in the US, he has agreed to shoot this harmless thriller.

title: The Stepfather
actors: Terry O'Quinn, Jill Schoelen, Stephen Schellen, Shelley Hack
description: Stephanie, sixteen, lives with her mother Susan and her stepfather, Jerry Blake, who is professionally involved in real estate and dotes on his new family. Meanwhile, there is someone who is investigating a man who exterminated his family a short time before and then disappeared. And for Jerry, in fact, the "home" is a real maniacal obsession ...
notes: The screenplay is by celebrated crime writer Donald E. Westlake and the subject of his colleagues Lefcourt and Garfield. Directing is the least convincing thing, but the story holds up well and is capable of wringing more than a thrill.

title: La putain du roi
actors: Timothy Dalton, Valeria Golino, Stéphane Freiss, Margaret Tyzack
description: The French Countess Jeanne de Luynes, wife of the Count of Verrua, resists the "advances" of Vittorio Amedeo I of Savoy until she is convinced that everyone, even her husband, wants her to yield. She will be a despotic lover towards the court, slave and ruler of the sovereign. He falls ill with smallpox, flees to France and then returns one last time when the king has abdicated and is in very poor health. High-sounding topic, named actors, spectacular scenographic splendor. But the (Austrian) director fails to blend everything into a coherent and functional whole. Disappointing result for a film as expensive as it is, in practice, unrealistic.

title: Hot Shots!
actors: Charlie Sheen, Cary Elwes, Valeria Golino, Lloyd Bridges
description: Harley Topper is the most skilled pilot in the entire American aviation, but she doesn't have a perfectly fine brain. At the moment when they call him to "save the homeland", he is sitting comfortably in his Indian tent listening to rock music. During the prep work, Topper meets a beautiful horsewoman whom he falls in love with before realizing that she is the psychiatrist in charge of checking if he's okay with his head.
notes: The trio Zucker / Abrahams / Zucker ("The Craziest Plane in the World", "A Blunt Bullet") now has a recognizable style, made up of sublime nonsense, sloppy parodies and gags fired at hellish speed.

title: Bomber
actors: Bud Spencer, Jerry Calà, Mike Miller, Valeria Cavalli, Gegia, Kallie Knoetze
description: Bomber is a former boxer who is now a sailor. In Livorno he meets a bizarre boxing manager who is looking for young talents. Bomber has the right element in sight: Giorgio. The first meeting will take place between the boy and the champion from the nearby US military base. However, there are those who want to take advantage of the opportunity to fix the result and then Bomber takes on the role of executioner.
notes: The replacement father figures, the discipline of innate youthful aggression, and so on. All trite and coy ideas: Lupo tries to go back to it by leveraging the corpulent Bud and the comic verve, still not inflated, by Jerry Calà. Not a great film, of course, but harmless and fun, which became a generational comic cult in the 80s.

title: Wild Orchid
actors: Greta Garbo, Lewis Stone, Nils Ashter
description: On a trip to Java, a married woman loses her head for a wealthy travel companion. The married woman is Garbo and this is enough to make the film advisable.

title: Rangers: attacco ora X
actors: Dale Cummings, Carlo Hintermann, Franco Ressel, Ben Carrà
description: A group of Allied prisoners, commanded by Colonel Davenport, are about to escape from the Altring concentration camp in Germany, but the arrival of Major Higginson changes everything. After having been parachuted in the area, he, having been captured specifically, has the task, entrusted to him by the supreme command of the allied forces, of destroying an atomic research center that rises in the vicinity of the camp ...
notes: Bad genre movie with a remedied cast.

title: Procés de Jeanne d'Arc
actors: Florence Carrez, Jean-Claude Fourneau, Marc Jacquier
description: Joan of Arc has been a prisoner for many months in a cell of the castle of Rouen. The film follows the trial, the death sentence and the execution based on the texts of the time, the detailed chronicles of the events. The accused finds herself progressively lost in a labyrinth made up of bureaucracy and malevolent persecution, at the end of which inevitable defeat awaits her. Bresson does not seek historical reconstruction, but wants to show how Giovanna's naive sensibility can open the doors of a mysterious world, closed to most people.

title: Batman Returns
