Splendid Jagger, but also linked to the Stones are Anita Pallenberg (girlfriend of Brian Jones and later Keith Richards) and the author of the soundtrack Jack Nitzsche.

title: Hands of the Ripper
actors: Eric Porter, Angharad Rees, Jane Merrow, Keith Bell
description: A medium is found dead at the end of a séance. Dr Pritchard, a passionate follower of psychoanalysis, tries to discover the person responsible and restricts the field to two people present at the session: a politician and a young orphan. Then she realizes that the man has nothing to do with it and that the girl, as a child, saw her father kill her mother. The father is Jack the Ripper.

title: Ladri di saponette
actors: Maurizio Nichetti, Caterina Sylos Labini, Federico Rizzo (II), Heidi Komarek
description: While in a television studio there is a cultured debate about a film shot "in the manner" of neorealism, strange exchanges between film and advertising, between reality and fiction begin to take place on the television of a family of couch potatoes, between reality and fiction, without anyone noticing. In the general homologation, in the "cathodic jam" that spreads every day from the small screen, everyone can find what they want. Smart film about television stupidity and funny pastiche that prides itself on being the first film to break with commercials. An unprecedented Nichetti without a mustache is, as always, director and actor: director of the film and actor in the role of director and interpreter of the film in the film!

title: Yolanda and the Thief
actors: Fred Astaire, Lucille Bremer, Frank Morgan
description: He pretends to be the guardian angel of a naive heiress to lighten her up. A real cherub intervenes. Great fantastic-musical-sentimental with Fred Astaire.

title: Superman
actors: Christopher Reeve, Marlon Brando, Margot Kidder, Gene Hackman, Glenn Ford, Maria Schell, Ned Beatty, Trevor Howard
description: The distant plant Krypton is about to be destroyed by a terrible explosion. Yor El, one of the members of the Supreme Council of the planet, with the intent to save his race, sends his baby son to Earth with a rocket: Superman. Welcomed by the Kent spouses, two elderly farmers, the alien is raised as an earthling and kept in the dark about its origins. Upon the death of his adoptive father, Superman travels to New York and is hired as a reporter for the Daily Planet.
notes: Spectacular, with some length and too much seriousness, the film version of the famous comic was a huge success. Stellar cast, (not brilliant) script by Mario Puzo, Robert Benton and David Newman.

title: City Heat
actors: Clint Eastwood, Burt Reynolds, Jane Alexander, Madeline Kahn
description: Kansas City, 1933. Lieutenant Speer and Private Investigator Murphy came out of the same police school: they remained friends, but their paths diverged markedly. When Murphy gets in trouble because of his partner's blackmail, Speer is quick to rush over.
notes: Classic action movie based on the couple of cops with opposing characters: the taciturn all action and the braggart who always gets in trouble. We laugh and have fun enjoying the vintage atmosphere also through the songs of Gershwin sung by the good Irene Cara.

title: High Wall
actors: Robert Taylor, Herbert Marshall, Audrey Totter
description: A veteran hospitalized in a psychiatric clinic confesses to having assassinated his wife, but the truth is another. Farraginous, but passable yellow with a claustrophobic start.

title: Northwest Passage
actors: Spencer Tracy, Robert Young, Ruth Hussey, Walter Brennan
description: Major Rogers is charged with a very dangerous mission: to reach and destroy a camp of Indians (allies of the French) who have massacred a group of English settlers. Their village is located in the intricate and impenetrable virgin forest that hides a thousand human and natural dangers. Once the mission is completed, Rogers is entrusted with the task of finding the passage to the Northwest.
notes: Spectacular and violent adventure film about a group of rough men in the harsh environment of the late 1700s American Great North. It was the first color film made by King Vidor which was to be followed by the part of the search for the Northwest Passage that was not carried out.

title: Johnny Belinda
actors: Jane Wyman, Lew Ayres, Charles Bickford
description: In a fishing village, a deaf and dumb girl is raped. The good doctor conducted is unjustly suspected. Solid melodrama well interpreted. Academy Award to Jane Wyman.

title: You Can't Get Away with Murder
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Billy Halop, Gale Page
description: Johnny, a boy in disarray, teams up with a gangster, goes to jail and repents to save an innocent. Not surprisingly, but with the ever vigorous Humphrey Bogart.

title: To Please a Lady
actors: Clark Gable, Barbara Stanwyck, Adolphe Menjou, Will Geer
description: A rude and reckless car driver falls in love with the journalist who haunts him with peppered articles. Remake of "Arditi aria" by Victor fleming (1938). Good action and performers.

title: Cause for Alarm
actors: Loretta Young, Barry Sullivan, Bruce Cowling
description: Malto and obsessed, before dying he accuses his wife of wanting to kill him with a letter. She desperately tries to retrieve the already sent letter. A small but exciting film.

title: Ducktales - The Movie Treasure of the Lost Lamp
description: Uncle Scrooge leaves with Qui, Quo, Qua and their little friend Gaia, in search of the fabulous treasure of Collie Baba, which has remained hidden for many centuries. Having found the treasure, the gang of ducks lets it be blown by the evil wizard Merlock. Scrooge and grandsons return home only with an old lamp. But this is the lamp of the Genie who, freed, defeats Merlock and then turns himself into a duck too.
notes: Inspired by the television series "Ducktales", the first feature film starring the famous ducks. The film vaguely harks back to the adventures of Indiana Jones.

title: Merry Andrew
actors: Anna Maria Pierangeli, Danny Kaye, Robert Coote, Noel Purcell
description: Professor Andrew (Kaye) is depressed: the position of principal and the marriage with a childhood friend await him. Instead, the benign case makes him come across an Italian circus, owned by a large and turbulent Sicilian family. An opportunity not to be missed to escape an embalmed and predictable existence, boring at best. And in addition, around the corner, there is also love, that of the sweet Concetta (Annamaria Pierangeli, for Americans Pier Angeli).
notes: Tailored to Danny Kaye's humor and numbers, the film has a very thin plot, but the result is discreet.

title: Les douze travaux d'Astérix
description: Julius Caesar challenges his traditional Galli adversaries to overcome twelve fearsome labors, almost as if they were new Hercules. Asterix and the inseparable Obelix are designated by the village to take up the challenge and, of course, brilliantly overcome every obstacle.
notes: Even then, the characters of Goscinny and Uderzo showed some signs of fatigue in the cinema.

title: Sahara
actors: Brooke Shields, Lambert Wilson, Horst Buchholz, John Mills
description: We are in 1928: Dale Gordon participates, disguised as a man, in a dangerous rally in the desert. Among the competitors is a German who sells weapons to Arabs engaged in a war in which Dale and his faithful mechanics become involved. Taken prisoner, Dale agrees to marry the tribal chief Jaffar, madly in love with her. However, he escapes from him immediately after the wedding: only for the time to win the rally, however, then he returns. Cartoon in which everyone, from the director to the actors, take the matter lightly, in the face of the public.

title: L'armata Brancaleone
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Catherine Spaak, Gian Maria Volonté, Enrico Maria Salerno, Maria Grazia Buccella, Barbara Steele, Carlo Pisacane
description: Brancaleone da Norcia, as ragged as he is grandiloquent, is about to participate in a tournament. Here he is approached by a small group of wretches in possession of a parchment which assures the knight who holds it the fief of Aurocastro. On the way they meet the Byzantine Teofilatto, occupy a country where the plague is raging, save an extravagant betrothed. Having reached their destination, they are attacked by the Saracens ...
notes: The witty reinvention of a courtly language, the joyful commitment of the performers and the brilliant directorial management give life to an excellent comedy of considerable intelligence. An authentic masterpiece of Italian popular cinema, written by Monicelli with Age and Scarpelli.

title: Once Upon a Crime
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, John Candy, James Belushi, Cybill Sheperd, Ornella Muti, Sean Young
description: In Montecarlo Inspector Bonnard (Giannini) deals with the murder of the wealthy Madame Van Dougen. It is certainly not the suspicious elements that are missing, indeed he must find the culprit among seven people who may have had an interest in the death of the lady. The investigation develops, bumpy, between a chain of grotesque events, until the discovery of the unexpected truth. It is the remake of "Crimen" directed by Mario Camerini in 1960. Excellent photography, rich scenographic setting, actors of proven notoriety, but the script is weak and the direction never manages to rise from the greyness.

title: Reversal of Fortune
actors: Jeremy Irons, Glenn Close, Ron Silver, Annabella Sciorra
description: Beautiful billionaire Sunny Crawford falls into an irreversible coma from an insulin injection. Her husband Claus von Bulow, charming but penniless scion of the European aristocracy, is accused of attempted murder and, in the first instance, sentenced to thirty years. He then appeals by hiring a prince of the Forum, Alan Dershowitz. The lawyer, with the help of a group of his Harvard students, discovers new elements.
notes: Inspired by the memoirs of Dershowitz, the film takes up a story that, in the early Eighties, morbidly fascinated American public opinion. Schroeder limits the scenes of the trial in court, but the film is uncertain between mélo, thriller and comedy. Jeremy Irons was awarded an Oscar.

title: Shot
actors: Tony Curtis, Richard Cabourie, Robert Delbert, Susan Hogan
description: Frank Renzetti, boss of Cosa Nostra, recognized and feared by the entire American underworld, earns large sums by betting on sporting events. Frank manages to win because, thanks to a computer, he knows the results in advance. To organize a boxing match valid for the heavyweight title, he asks and gets a big loan from a sinister individual. Unfortunately, the stubborn agent Blake gets in their way, who has fallen out of favor after a bad operation and wants to make up for it.
notes: Tony Curtis away from Canada, unlike his character, fails to achieve great results.

title: Pardners
actors: Dean Martin, Jerry Lewis, Lori Nelson, Agnes Moorehead
description: The son of a cowboy, but raised in New York, Walter (Jerry Lewis) returns to the prairie where, with his friend Slim, a genuine and rude man of the Frontier, he has to contend with dangerous outlaws. Appointed sheriff because of his inability, at the moment dark Walter, always backed by Slim, shows unsuspected skills and saves a ranch from the assault of criminals. Penultimate film by the Martin / Lewis duo, this parody is not one of their best results, despite being directed by specialist Taurog.

title: Carmen
actors: Julia Migenes Johnson, Placido Domingo, Ruggero Raimondi
description: A brigadier falls in love with a sensual cigar woman and, for her, deserted. It will end up in the blood. Despite the enthusiasm Rosi is not exactly at ease in the opera film.

title: L'oro dei Bravados
actors: Georges Ardisson, Linda Veras, Rick Battaglia
description: Two adventurers are hiding gold bars, they will have to wait for the end of the Civil War to recover them. Mediocre example of an Italian western.

title: Solomon and Sheba
actors: Yul Brynner, Gina Lollobrigida, George Sanders, Marisa Pavan
description: Dying King David chooses Solomon as his successor on the throne of Israel, evading the hopes of his eldest son Adonia, who had long hoped to succeed his father. Solomon immediately gave proof of wisdom and farsightedness and worked hard to have a monumental temple built, destined to testify to his greatness, as well as that of the god of Israel. The growing political and economic power of the king, however, worries the Pharaoh, who brings together the eastern monarchs to study the best way to counter him.
notes: An unlikely and expensive classic peplum, it is one of Vidor's least personal and interesting films (under his latest direction). Yul Brynner, who plays Solomon, replaced Tyrone Power who died in Spain during the filming of the film.

title: Operazione San Gennaro
actors: Nino Manfredi, Senta Berger, Totò, Mario Adorf, Claudine Auger, Harry Guardino
description: Three Americans, and a woman and two men, arrive in Naples to rob the treasure of San Gennaro. They ask the boss Don Vincenza for advice, who directs them to Armando Girasole, known as Dudù. The blow is carried out on the night when the "Song Festival" monopolizes ordinary people and police forces in front of the TV.
notes: International packaging that exploits Neapolitan folklore in a somewhat banal way, but with a rhythm that no one has today. Manfredi is also among the screenwriters. The best thing about the film remains the "cameo" of Totò, a gentleman thief.

title: From the Mixed-Up Files of Mrs. Basil E. Frankweiler
actors: Ingrid Bergman, Richard Mulligan, George Rose
description: Two boys visiting New York with their school group naturally go, as well as in the other places of artistic interest of the city, also at the Metropolitan Museum, who had long dreamed of seeing. Taken by enthusiasm, the two soon get lost and meet an elderly lady (perhaps a fairy) that helps them.
notes: Nice and edifying fairy tale with Bergman in one of his latest interpretations.

title: The Muppets Take Manhattan
actors: Art Carney, Elliott Gould, Liza Minnelli, Dabney Coleman
description: Will Kermit, Piggy and the whole Muppets gang manage to stage their musical and conquer New York? Probably the best movie with the famous animated puppets.

title: Melody Time
directors: Clyde Geronimi, Wilfred Jackson, Jack Kinney, Hamilton Luske
description: Assembly of seven cartoons: "Giovannino, apple seed", "Donald carioca and their exotic friend", "Pecos Bill", "The bumblebee" (with music by Rimsky Korsakov), "Little Toot" (on a small tug), "Trees" and "Once Upon a Wintertime" (a romantic story about a winter landscape). Sample book of pure Disney style, a sort of update of the old "Silly Symphonies" with an eye to "Fantasia".

title: Things To Come
actors: Raymond Massey, Cedric Hardwicke, Edward Chapman
description: After a long war, the exhausted inhabitants of the Earth create a new world order based on the achievements of progress. But soon people rebel against a life that is too orderly and perfect. The first launch of men on the moon appeases the revolt. Brilliant and disturbing vision, in a science fiction key, of the pre-war world climate. Excellent screenplay by the novelist Herbert G. Wells. The scenographies are splendid.

title: Show People
actors: Marion Davies, William Haines, Dell Henderson
description: Peggy Pepper is a young girl who arrived in Hollywood with her father determined to make a career in film. He gets what he wanted, but at the cost of a lost love. But soon he comes to regret the past. Good-natured, but realistic, mockery of the world of cinema in an unrecognized masterpiece by Vidor.

title: Frankenstein and the Monster from Hell
actors: Peter Cushing, Shane Briant
description: Baron Frankenstein, a doctor in an asylum, reconstructs the body of a suicide with parts of dead patients. Last Frankenstein film directed by Fisher.

title: Das Riesenrad
actors: O. W. Fischer, Maria Schell, Rudolf Forster, Doris Kirchner
description: In old Habsburg Austria, the noble Rudolf marries the beautiful Elizabeth. The outbreak of the First World War inevitably ends up separating the couple. The woman, during the forced separation, establishes a relationship with a young musician.

title: Gli amici di Nick Hezard
actors: Luc Merenda, Lee J. Cobb, Luciana Paluzzi, Dagmar Lassander, Isabella Biagini
description: A petty crook takes the leap in quality and ingeniously reduces a shady American businessman to the streets. Noir all'americana directed by the Italian master of the genre, with an excellent cast and a melancholy background. It is not one of your masterpieces, but it remains a valid example of the genre.

title: The Mackintosh Man
actors: Paul Newman, James Mason, Dominique Sanda, Nigel Patrick
description: British agent ends up in jail for a diamond theft, escapes and unmasks a spy organization that has taken root even in the English Parliament. Scripted by Walter Hill from a Desmond Bailey novel, it is a film with many scenarios but with little action.

title: Acquasanta Joe
actors: Lincoln Tate, Ty Hardin, Richard Harrison, Silvia Monelli
description: At the end of the Civil War, taking advantage of the disorder that reigns everywhere, the "Cannon Band" dominates, so called, because it possesses a piece of artillery with which it carries out deadly bank robberies. In the same territory, however, a bounty killer also operates, Acquasanta Joe, a priest who used to distil brandy to then sell to the Indians. When Joe loses all of his savings deposited in a bank targeted by Bill, he decides to frame the bandit.
notes: A very weak spaghetti-western directed by Mario Gariazzo, who, at the time, called himself John Walker and who later directed a trash masterpiece like "The balloon seller".

title: Saraband for Dead Lovers
actors: Stewart Granger, Joan Greenwood
description: Already married for political convenience, Sofia Dorotea falls in love with a gentleman, but a courtesan has him killed and denounces her. Ealing Pictures' first color film, it is a sumptuous melodrama in color, with a great pomp of scenography and extraordinary actresses accompanying Granger.

title: Sfida sul fondo
actors: Frederick Stafford, Dagmar Lassander, Enzo Majorca
description: To induce the engineer Luca Valdesio to sell the construction plans of an advanced minisubmarine, unknown criminals, who act on commission, kidnap his son Massimo. Kasan, the boy's dog, chases the bandits and manages to discover the place where they are keeping the child hidden. This causes the kidnappers to transfer the hostage to a cave that is only accessible by underwater. At this point, the boy's uncle, an expert diver, enters the scene. Of note is the underwater shooting with Enzo Maiorca, the first record holder of descent into the abyss without a respirator, but the film offers nothing more.

title: The Blob
actors: Steve McQueen, Aneta Corseaut, Earl Rowe, Olin Howlin
description: A meteorite falls to earth, but it doesn't have a great consistency. More than anything else, it is a gelatinous mass capable of sucking up and incorporating everything it comes into contact with. An old man from a small town in the province pays for it, then the doctor who treated him and then his nurse. Meanwhile, the blob goes on unstoppable, overflowing and refractory to everything. Anything but the cold. Teenager Steve McQueen (in his third film) saves citizenship, instead of targeting them with a rifle, as he would often do later. The subject is splendid, the realization less. In short, the metaphor is worth more than all the rest.

title: Labor of Love: the Arlette Schweitzer Story
actors: Ann Jillian, Tracey Gold, Bill Smitrovich, Donald Logue
description: Christa Schweitzer is fifteen when, thanks to a gynecological examination, she discovers that she was born without a womb. The little girl is upset, but finds the comfort of her mother Arlette (Jillian) who promises her that one day she will help her. Years pass, Christa gets married and the day arrives: Arlette will carry Christa's son in her womb, but to do so she will have to overcome many more obstacles than expected. There is one thing that differentiates this film from the usual, dull drama TV-movies: screenwriter Susan Baskin has the good idea of ??not letting the two leading women lose their sense of humor. And it is not cheap.

title: I quattro tassisti
actors: Gino Bramieri, Peppino De Filippo, Erminio Macario, Aldo Fabrizi
description: Film in four episodes. "The bridegroom": a boyfriend, reluctantly headed to the church where he is expected for the wedding, changes his mind in favor of the beautiful taxi driver. "A good work": a false nun swindles a driver and extorts a large sum from him. "Treasure hunt": a lady from high society makes a tantrum at the expense of a taxi driver. "The man in blue": a killer customer also wants to eliminate the man who carries him.
notes: Four taxi drivers, as many as six scriptwriters to build little stories where valid ideas are few and the direction leaves the initiative to the skills of the comedians.

title: Robin Hood
description: Robin Hood (a fox) and faithful Little John (a bear) fight against the throne usurper and greedy Prince John (a lion) and his minions (the snake Bitz and the wolf, Sheriff of Nottingham). Twice the heroes steal heavy tax money from Prince John and redistribute it to the poor. In addition, Robin, disguised as a stork, manages to win the shooting competition which has a kiss from Lady Marian (a fox) as a prize.
notes: Although not among the top of the Walt Disney production, neither for vivacity of inventions nor for narrative mastery and, not even for the inspiration of the songs that accompany the story, it is pleasant and engaging.

title: Howards End
actors: Anthony Hopkins, Emma Thompson, Helena Bonham Carter, Vanessa Redgrave
description: The non-engagement between the rich Paul and the whimsical intellectual Helen causes the rupture of relations between the two families. The young and penniless Leonard meets Helen and her older sister, Margaret. With time the reasons for friction disappeared, Paul's mother became very close friends with Margaret, so much so that, on her deathbed, she entrusted the will to leave her Casa Howard, a cottage she owned, to a note. Many other dramatic events follow one another, until Howard House will host Margaret, now separated from her husband, who assists her sister Helen and her baby, had by Leonard. James Ivory's third film based on Forster's novels, after Room with a View and Maurice, again with the screenplay by Ruth Prawer Jhabvala. Still a perfect reconstruction of the environment and atmosphere, still a lucid (and ruthless) analysis of feelings in the contrast of social classes, ethical conceptions and culture: under the rigid rules of a rigorous formalism, poisons and deep lacerations boil. As usual, Ivory guides all her actors to interpretations of rare accuracy and intensity, where it is not possible to identify weak points.

title: Marinai senza stelle
actors: Tito Stagno, Otello Venturi, Antonio Gandusio
description: Two children embarked on a school brig are left in Trieste due to the outbreak of the war. Both, however, do not know how to stay still and board again, one on a warship, the other on a merchant ship.
notes: Beautiful photography and especially good documentary sequences. One of the two very young protagonists, Tito Stagno, would have announced years later to all Italians that Armstrong had set foot on the moon.

title: Hot Pursuit
actors: John Cusack, Robert Loggia, Wendy Gazelle, Ben Stiller
description: A student misses at the last moment the opportunity to go on a vacation with his girlfriend and spends the rest of the time trying to reach her.
notes: Despite claims of speed, it's harder to get to the end of the film than swimming in the Caribbean.

title: Paolo e Francesca
actors: Odile Versois, Armando Francioli, Andrea Checchi, Aldo Silvani
description: The Malatestas besiege Ravenna, and Paolo, brother of Gianciotto Malatesta, enters the city to destroy the grain stores; wounded, he is cared for by a sweet gentlewoman. Gianciotto, who has decided to make peace with Ravenna, sends Paolo there as the spouse by proxy (his) of Francesca da Polenta, the daughter of the local lord. But the woman is the one who saved him: a passionate kiss between the two, and a passion is born that is destined to end in tragedy ...
notes: Inspired by the famous story narrated in canto V of Dante's Inferno, Matarazzo moves from contemporary melodrama to that in costume: but despite the undoubted professionalism, it works less.

title: ¿Qué he hecho yo para merecer esto?
actors: Carmen Maura, Angel de Andrés López, Veronica Forqué, Kiti Manver
description: Gloria is desperate: she works as a cleaner in a gym, her husband Antonio lives in the memory of Ingrid, his German mistress; of the two children, Toni is a drug dealer and Miguel, a homosexual, leads "life". Moreover, Antonio's mother also has to put up with her mother at home. Luckily there is Cristal, a prostitute but a true friend. In a quarrel, Gloria will end up killing Antonio with a ham bone, but this does not mean things will fall into place ... Pedro Almodovar unleashed, in one of his best films, when his fame still barely crossed the Spanish borders and his name was not yet a signature destined for international circuits. Turbulent narration and free-wheeling vitriol.

title: Great Balls of Fire!
actors: Dennis Quaid, Winona Ryder, Stephen Tobolowsky, John Doe
description: We are in 1956, when the stalwart pianist Jerry Lee Lewis moves to Memphis in search of glory and dollars in the name of rock'n'roll. Success comes immediately, but Jerry does it big by marrying Myra, the 13-year-old daughter of his cousin. Biography of the young Lewis, agile and at times overwhelming thanks to the direction of McBride, a director who is between the underground and the video clip. Very good Dennis Quaid.

title: 00-2 agenti segretissimi
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Ingrid Schoeller, Aroldo Tieri, Carla Calò
description: Franco and Ciccio, two simpletons, fall into the hands of the American counter-intelligence which mistakes them for two secret agents. Russians and Chinese take advantage of the situation to weave shady plots using the two as a convenient screen. The gullibility of the two, however, is such that the communist agents end up eliminating each other. At some point a big swag also appears ...
notes: Usual doublet not too funny. Only for fans of the comic duo.

title: Black Robe
actors: Lothaire Bluteau, August Shellenberg, Aden Young, Sandrine Holt
description: In 1634 the French Jesuit Father Laforgue, a missionary in Quebec, had to reach the distant mission to the indigenous Hurons, going up a great river. He is accompanied by the chief Chonina and other natives, in addition to the young Frenchman Daniel who aspires to the priesthood but is fascinated by Annuka, the daughter of the chief. The missionary is disgusted by Daniel and Annuka who flirt freely; the group is attacked by other natives and the survivors are tortured, but then manage to escape. The film seems to fluctuate between the admiration for the missionary's faith and the vision of his work as violence against the indigenous culture, but ends up favoring the second angle, for which the Jesuit is the victim of senseless fanaticism. Beresford, scripted by Brian Moore from his novel of the same name, gets along better in terms of atmosphere than when he has to build credible characters.

title: Nikita
actors: Anne Parillaud, Marc Duret, Jean-Hugues Anglade, Tchéky Karyo, Jeanne Moreau, Jean Reno, Philippe Leroy, Patrick Fontana
description: Nikita, sentenced to life imprisonment, is hired in prison by the secret services: officially declared dead, in reality she undergoes three years of very hard training, under Bob's orders. After a brilliant baptism of fire, Bob gives her a new identity as a nurse. Nikita meets Marco, who works in a supermarket. The two go to live together, without Marco suspecting anything. The girl would like to quit, but her bosses won't let her ...
notes: Besson demonstrates remarkable mastery in action scenes, focusing on the combination of Parillaud's sex appeal and her relentless murderous efficiency. The romantic part of the story was less successful.

title: Przypadek
actors: Boguslaw Linda, Tadeusz Lomnicki, Jacek Borkowski
description: The stories of the same character, Witeck, narrated from three different points of view that the case could have provoked, making him take the plane that should take him away from Communist Poland. Party activist, opponent or unpolitical scientist: but in any case there will be no escape for the protagonist.
notes: A lucid apologue of the most cruel and pessimistic Kieslowski, before the Decalogue. "Sliding Doors" is a sort of undeclared remake. Completed in 1981, the film was blocked by Polish censors and only released in 1987.

title: Der müde Tod
actors: Bernhard Goetzke, Lil Dagover, Walter Janssen
description: Death's arrival in a German town divides two lovers; to save her beloved, the girl has to pass three tests (in Baghdad, Venice, China), but fails. Only by giving herself will she defeat Death. Romantic fairy tale with a riot of scenographic inventions, which sinks into folkloric heritages from around the world, but with an eye that is always that of the German nineteenth century and expressionism. Ironic and pessimistic, crossed by the noble figure of Bernard Goetzke who is "tired death" (as the original title states), a jewel of the silent Lang.

title: Detour
actors: Tom Neal, Ann Savage, Claudia Drake, Edmund MacDonald
description: A hitchhiking trip to Los Angeles turns into hell (with two corpses). Chilling film with a Kafkaesque atmosphere, in which a relentless series of events is unleashed from a casual beginning (the man the protagonist gives a ride to dies in the car). Narrated in flashback by the voiceover of the protagonist, one of the absolute masterpieces of the B-movie, which transforms all economic and production deficiencies into strengths. Celebrated the final six-minute sequence shot with the phone ringing.

title: Le signe du Lion
actors: Jess Hahn, Van Doude, Jean-Luc Godard, Stéphane Audran
description: Pierre, a penniless musician, is about to become rich thanks to an inheritance. To celebrate the event, he borrows some money from his friends and throws a big party. Then the inheritance goes to his cousin and then Pierre is left alone to wander in a summer and deserted Paris, getting acquainted with the homeless, getting drunk in the bars. It is in one of these that the news reaches him: his cousin died in an accident.
notes: Rohmer's first film, released in France three years late and almost clandestine. It is a moral tale in which destiny (and music) plays a determining role. A brief role, that of the melomaniac, for Jean-Luc Godard.

title: Opera
actors: Cristina Marsillach, Urbano Barberini, Daria Nicolodi, Ian Charleson, Barbara Cupisti, William McNamara
description: The titular singer is hit by a car on the eve of the premiere. The director believes himself to be a genius and has planned a staging with crows around the stage. Betty, who replaces the protagonist, is very young. Despite all this, the premiere of Verdi's "Macbeth" is a triumph. But poor Betty doesn't have time to enjoy success because she immediately finds herself involved in a series of murders. Nothing strange, given that in the world of opera it is said that this Verdi opera is bad.
notes: Despite some virtuosity of directing (aerial shots and some elaborate truculities) the film increasingly highlights some of Argento's classic weak points (plot, dialogues, actors) without the merits of his first films. And even the rhythm doesn't always captivate.

title: Lucy Gallant
actors: Jane Wyman, Charlton Heston, Claire Trevor, Thelma Ritter
description: Lucy Gallant (Wyman) accidentally lands in a small Texas town where she opens a fashion shop. A feeling arises between her and breeder Casey Cole (Heston), but Lucy has the ambitions of an industry captain and has no time for such things. Accomplices some adversity, Casey, who in the meantime has discovered oil fields in his lands, will eventually convince her to become his wife. Heavy southern melodrama without polish.

title: The Wild North
actors: Stewart Granger, Wendell Corey, Cyd Charisse, Morgan Farley
description: Accused of murder, Jules Vincent (Granger), a Canadian fur trapper, is on the run being chased by Officer Pedley (Corey). Life in the North is tough and wolves attack in packs. This is how Pedley ends up losing his mind and it will be Vincent who will help him get home and, above all, come to his senses. At trial, Pedley's testimony will be instrumental.
notes: Adventures in the snow, avalanches, wolf attacks and river rapids. Only romantic interludes are Granger's paddles together with Cyd Charisse in an Indian role. In short, standard adventures for which it is difficult to get excited.

title: The Blue Max
actors: George Peppard, James Mason, Ursula Andress, Jeremy Kemp
description: During the First World War, the rivalry between Lieutenant Bruno Stachel and Willi von Klugerman was very strong in the most aristocratic squadron of the German air force. The first aspires to the blue cross, the other, the son of a general, has already received it. The two challenge each other both in matters of the heart and in military and acrobatic aviation feats. Their quarrel, during a battle with the enemy, comes to tragic results.
notes: The aerial sequences are remarkable. However, the love affairs of the commander's wife with both protagonists are not entirely essential, but with Andress on stage there is nothing to complain about. The rest is in the average of the war movies of the time.

title: Love Is a Many-Splendored Thing
actors: Jennifer Jones, William Holden, Torin Thatcher, Isobel Elsom
description: Han Suyen is a doctor in a Hong Kong hospital. Her husband, a general from Beijing, was shot by the Communists. He never intends to fall in love again, but then he meets the American journalist Mark Elliott, separated from his wife. The latter will be the insurmountable obstacle on the road to their marriage. Eventually, Mark will be sent to Korea, where he will die in an airstrike. An evergreen cinematic bestseller; not to mention the musical tune that accompanies it. The sentimental catchphrase, in truth, is rather static in its development, but how can you resist the charm of Jennifer Jones and William Holden?

title: ...continuavano a chiamarlo Trinità
actors: Terence Hill, Bud Spencer, Yanti Somer, Jessica Dublin, Enzo Fiermonte, Enzo Tarascio, Harry Carey jr., Gérard Landry, Franco Ressel
description: Trinity (Terence Hill) and Bambino (Bud Spencer), brothers and soft-hearted vagabonds outlaws, are mistaken for federal agents by Parker, a violent arms dealer. Taking advantage of the misunderstanding, the two first gladly let themselves be "bought" by the shady character's dollars, then try an even bigger blow. They go to the friars who, under threat, have made their convent the unsuspected intermediary base for Parker's businesses. Continuing to pass themselves off as guardians of the law, they manage to be handed over by the religious fifty thousand dollars paid out by the Mexican revolutionaries for a load of arms. At the most beautiful comes the gang of the trafficker. The battle breaks out: to the sound of slaps and with the valid help of the religious, this time decided to get rid of the overbearing Parker, Trinity and Bambino get out of the way. In the end though ...
notes: The film perfects and expands the ideas that a year earlier had made the extraordinary commercial fortune of "They called him Trinity". To snatch the laugh, the jokes point to the bass and there is an interminable scuffle in the finale, a worthy replica of the one that concluded the previous film. The whole, which is not lacking in clever ideas (the scene of the slaps being beaten by Trinity at accelerated speed), appears a bit repetitive and fragmentary and would perhaps be a little indigestible if it were not sewn on a couple of close-knit professionals like Bud Spencer and Terence Hill.

title: Across the Great Divide
actors: Robert Logan, Heather Rattray, Mark Edward Hall
description: Two kids "for a walk" in the wild mountains. They find someone who first tries to rip them off, then helps them. Adventure film for children in beautiful landscapes.

title: Jane Eyre
actors: Orson Welles, Joan Fontaine, Margaret O'Brien, Henry Daniell, Peggy Ann Garner, John Sutton, Sara Allgood, Agnes Moorehead, Aubrey Mather, Edith Barrett, Barbara Everest, Hillary Brooke
description: Jane Eyre (Fontaine), an orphan and raised under the strict tutelage of an aunt, is hired by Rochester (Welles), a shady and mysterious owner of a castle, as the housekeeper of her child. When Rochester asks her to marry him, Jane accepts, but on her wedding day she discovers the secret that the man is hiding: a demented wife locked in an isolated wing of the castle. Based on Charlotte Brontë's "Jane Eyre", the film is dominated by Welles' interpretation who, they say, has also had a hand in directing, accentuating its expressionist slant.

title: Pirates
actors: Walter Matthau, Cris Campion, Charlotte Lewis, Damien Thomas
description: Capitan Red (Matthau) and Frog (Campion) are on a raft adrift. They are saved by the three trees "Neptune" on board of which is the beautiful Dolores, with whom Frog immediately falls in love. But there is also a throne of pure gold, of which Captain Red falls in love to the point of starting to stir up the revolt. The mutiny does not take place, but the fate of the golden throne will be quite turbulent. It's a healthy, solid adventure film where Polanski is a little less bad than usual. Even if the scene in which they serve a boiled mouse to Captain Red on a silver platter is an anthology. Thanks to a great Walter Matthau.

title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
actors: James Mason, Pat Boone, Arlene Dahl, Diane Baker, Thayer David
description: Professor Lindenbrook finds a message in a fragment of lava and organizes an expedition that, following a tortuous path, reaches the center of the Earth where he finds dinosaurs and troglodytes. Members of the group: the young Carla, the student McEven, the guide Hans. An unscrupulous madman gets in the way and makes them lose their way underground. From Jules Verne, an adaptation that dampens the underground nightmare with comedy tones. Vintage special effects for fans and Pat Boone's good boy smile that counterpoints Mason's professorial meticulousness.

title: Yuppi du
actors: Adriano Celentano, Charlotte Rampling, Claudia Mori, Gino Santercole, Lino Toffolo
description: Remarried after the suicide of his wife Silvia, the Venetian fisherman Felice Della Pietà discovers that it was a fake and that she lives with someone else in Milan, surrounded by the luxury she has always coveted. An attempt to mend fails: the woman loves him, but is unable to give up wealth; therefore she abandons him again, taking her daughter away. Felice gets a large sum in exchange for the small one, but it is a very meager consolation.
notes: With a bitter story, but also with songs and ballets, Celentano - who has the advantage of not taking himself too seriously (yet) - wonders about money and happiness. The whole is messy but nice.

title: The Reckless Moment
actors: Joan Bennett, James Mason, Geraldine Brooks
description: Lucy tries to induce Darby, the mature suitor of her daughter Beatrice, to give up the girl, but the man demands a price for this renunciation. When Darby insists Beatrice for her mother to pay, the young woman hits him in the head. Lucy finds Darby's dead body and is blackmailed again, this time by a man who is in possession of compromising letters from Beatrice, with a worse accomplice than him. A dark drama, "saved" at the end by the noble gesture of a repentant criminal, is the material on which Ophüls works with his usual narrative elegance. A classy melodrama.

title: The Covered Wagon
actors: Lois Wilson, J. Warren Kerrigan, Alan Hale, Charles Ogle
description: In 1848 a caravan of pioneers moved from Westport Landing (the future Kansas City) to the lands of Oregon, three thousand kilometers to the west. The journey, adventurous and fraught with danger, is made even more dramatic by the rivalry of two men, Woodhull and Banion, for Molly. Part of the convoy turns to California in search of gold, but it is in Oregon that the story ends. The film, made with an exceptional breadth of means on the authentic places of action, is one of the recognized cornerstones of the entire western genre. Epic, historically reliable and honest even when it describes the struggle of the Indians for their land.

title: Skyjacked
actors: Charlton Heston, Yvette Mimieux, James Brolin, Claude Akins
description: A Boing 707 under Captain O'Hara's command is in flight to Minneapolis. However, there is an unknown hijacker on board. He first signals his presence with a writing in the bathroom, then with a message written on a ticket: the plane will blow up if it does not go to Alaska. Here the terrorist, who turns out to be a young psychopathic officer, intends to take the plane to Moscow to seek political asylum.
notes: The film fits into the terrorist-catastrophic vein by neither adding nor subtracting anything. All in all, the suspense is modest.

title: The Crowd Roars
actors: James Cagney, Joan Blondell, Ann Dvorak
description: Joe Greer becomes his younger brother Eddy's worst "enemy" due to the rivalry that separates them in the sport. Both are in fact racing drivers. To foment the rust it also takes care of the affairs of the heart. During a race, again due to the rivalry between the two, Joe causes the death of Spud, his closest friend. Out of remorse, Joe abandons racing and soon falls out of favor. At the end of the tunnel, however, he finds Lee, the girlfriend he had left, and also reconciles with Eddie. Custom role for Cagney, setting and themes dear to Hawks.

title: High Risk
actors: James Brolin, Cleavon Little, Lindsay Wagner, Ernest Borgnine
description: Four citizens of Los Angels are enlisted in the mercenary troops and then catapulted to Colombia, to fight against the drug traffickers led by the ferocious Serrano. After having stolen five million dollars from the latter's treasure they will come (in order): captured by the police, freed by a group of revolutionary bandits, robbed, bombed several times ...
notes: The director, Stuart Raffill, is above all an expert on children's films. Here too, in a certainly more adult setting film, fun and picaresque prevail, despite the rawness of the firefights. The script runs into several very implausible passages.

title: Preparati la bara!
actors: Terence Hill, Horst Frank, George Eastman, Pinuccio Ardia, Lee Burton
description: David proposes to his friend Django to help him get the position of governor. Django refuses to give him a hand and prefers to travel with a precious cargo of gold to be transported to the federal warehouse. During the journey, some bandits, led by Lucas, attack the convoy, massacre the escort and kill Django's wife. Determined to take revenge, he leads a gang.
notes: A Terence Hill still on this side of the character and the western comedy with which he became famous. For the rest, a normal spaghetti-western.

title: Speedway
actors: Elvis Presley, Nancy Sinatra, Bill Bixby, Gale Gordon
description: Susan, a pretty tax agent, pursues Steve, the famous wheelie ace with big money. Relations between Steve and Susan remain extremely tense until the two young men discover they are in love with each other. After a series of victories that allow Steve to earn a large sum of money, the couple manages to reconcile the reasons of the taxman and those of love in the best possible way.
notes: Elvis shares the scene with Nancy Sinatra. Unfortunately Elvis, who was never a great actor, is no longer even "The Pelvis".

title: Shining Through
actors: Michael Douglas, Melanie Griffith, Liam Neeson, John Gielgud
description: In 1940, in New York, Linda Voss, the daughter of an immigrant German Jew, realizes that Ed Leland, the man she works for, is part of the secret services. When the United States enters the war, the woman gets to go to Berlin to try to save some relatives and to steal important military secrets. He succeeds in this last part of the mission, saved in extremis by Ed.
notes: Disconcerting example of how, from a good novel (Susan Isaac's "Shining Through"), with good actors and a pharaonic budget, but with a clumsy script and a mediocre and presumptuous direction, you can get an almost laughable film.

title: Taxi di notte
actors: Beniamino Gigli, Danièle Godet, Philippe Lemaire, Carlo Ninchi
description: Nello Spadoni, a singing taxi driver, after having driven a girl in tears, finds an abandoned child in the car. Not having tracked down the alleged mother, he takes the baby home for that night. Then it turns out that the baby is not the crying girl's, but that she risks having to marry a man other than the one she loves. Nel sings and, fortunately, everything settles down. Vehicle for Gigli, directed without backbone by veteran Gallone.

title: 5 Card Stud
actors: Dean Martin, Robert Mitchum, Inger Stevens, Roddy McDowall
description: During a game of poker, a player accused of cheating is lynched; later the other players are mysteriously killed one after the other. Curious suspense western, not one of the best directed by Hathaway.

title: The Painted Veil
actors: Greta Garbo, George Brent, Herbert Marshall
description: In China, she leaves her doctor husband but returns to her decision to support him in the fight against an epidemic. Greta Garbo and other superstars in a honeydew overflowing with sentimentality, by W. Somerset Maugham.

title: From Beyond
actors: Jeffrey Combs, Barbara Crampton, Ken Foree
description: A rather ambiguous scientist and his assistant invent a machine that allows us to look into another dimension.
notes: Suspence, horrible monsters and imaginative special effects from the director of Re-Animator, an ironic specialist in the genre who is also inspired by Lovecraft here.

title: Speak Easily
actors: Buster Keaton, Jimmy Durante, Thelma Todd, Hedda Hopper
description: Timoleon is a Greek professor who is announced that he has inherited a fortune. Since he is a fan of musicals, he decides to use his future money to finance a Broadway show. But right behind the first, it turns out that the longed-for inheritance is inconsistent. Buster Keaton's interesting "talked about" film; but the gaga are still silent films and the comedian is now on the decline of his career.

title: Fiat Voluntas Dei
actors: Angelo Musco, Maria Denis, Sarah Ferrati, Nerio Bernardi, Matilde Casagrande
description: Don Attanasio is a very busy parish priest of a country village. In fact, he not only helps the poor, helps orphans and administers the sacraments, but he also finds himself recomposing marriages already made and arranging new ones among the children of the village. Angelo Musco seems to be at ease in the role of the good-natured and whole-hearted priest. The film, however, does not go beyond the usual pathetic-rural picture.

title: La danza dei milioni
actors: Nino Besozzi, Carlo Campanini, Jole Voleri, Miretta Mauri, Armando Migliari
description: The secretary of the president of an important bank has a graduate but unemployed friend; He convinces him to bring him to the office by making him pass for an employee. Soon the skill and resourcefulness of the young man are noticed and rewarded with the employment and marriage to the president's daughter.
notes: Lively "Hungarian" comedy as he used at the time, ennobled by the verve of his interpreters and a little weighted by propaganda intentions.

title: The Man Who Loved Cat Dancing
actors: Burt Reynolds, Sarah Miles, Lee J. Cobb, Jack Warden
description: Witness to a train assault by a gang led by Jay Grobert, Catherine Crocker (who has just abandoned her rich but abusive husband), must follow the bandits. Along the way, the woman and their boss fall in love, but the gang is joined by the sheriff and his men including Catherine's husband ... Films with extended times and typical themes of a season that seems light years away.

title: Billy Bathgate
actors: Dustin Hoffman, Loren Dean, Nicole Kidman, Bruce Willis
description: We are in 1935, in New York; Billy, a street kid ready to seize the opportunity, manages to join the Dutch Schulz gang. Thanks to his qualities he soon became a close collaborator of the boss; the latter, struggling with a trial, entrusts him with the protection of his beautiful, Drew. Naturally the two fall in love; the gangster's revenge on the woman is not long in coming, but Drew is saved thanks to the intervention of her husband, warned by a tip from Billy himself. A new man appears in the city: it is Lucky Luciano. His path and that of Dutch do not take long to cross. In an ambush set by Luciano's men, Dutch and his gang are eliminated; Billy is the only survivor, to whom Luciano gives money and recommends giving up the profession of gangster. This foray into the gangster genre of the director of Kramer against Kramer is not completely convincing. Doctorow's novel is adapted by the English playwright Tom Stoppard and Benton stages with care, paying attention more to the atmosphere than to the numbers of skill, but also with a certain weariness. Excellent photograph of the late Nestor Almendros.

title: Puerto Escondido
actors: Diego Abatantuono, Valeria Golino, Claudio Bisio, Renato Carpentieri
description: Mario Tozzi is a bank manager involved in spite of himself in the crimes committed by a police commissioner. To get out of the trouble he flees to Mexico where he meets two other expats: Alex and Anita. Mario struggles between cockfights and drug trafficking until he finds the commissioner, himself an exile. The four will all end up in jail, after a big coup and an attempted escape.
notes: Picaresque and captivating story, at least on the surface, but the characterization of the characters is rather disheveled and the script suffers from some implausible "holes". After "Mediterraneo", Salvadores disappoints a lot.

title: L. 627
actors: Didier Bezace, Jean-Paul Comart, Charlotte Kady, Jean-Roger Milo
description: "We are in Paris; the police investigator Lucien Marguet, known as Lulù, ends up in the narcotics brigade. Together with his new workmates, he faces the risks and frustrations of a backbreaking and basically not very exciting job, between stalking, searches , catches, blows. Lulù cultivates a strange friendship with the drug addict Cécile: a thread of hope when she comes out of the loop ... Beautiful film by Tavernier; tense and dramatic, it takes up Hollywood modules and transfers them to the Parisian reality. Police life described without free spectacularization; great work on the psychological facets and excellent interpretations. "

title: THX 1138
actors: Robert Duvall, Maggie McOmie, Donald Pleasence, Ian Wolfe
description: In a future authoritarian society, men live underground and are reduced to being a serial number. Even the differences between the sexes have been abolished, love proscribed, reproduction entrusted to laboratory techniques. So when THX 1138 falls in love with LUH 417 the authority intervenes by setting in motion all its repressive capacity to defend itself. Only one of the two "rebels" manages to escape. Excellent "negative utopia" a la Orwell; the film is aseptic, anguished and white. It is the first - but also the most subtle - work of George Lucas, the director who will become famous with "Star Wars" and yet will never be so good again.

title: Alien 2. Sulla Terra
actors: Belinda Mayne, Mark Robin
description: A spaceship returns to Earth. However, the astronauts who piloted it have disappeared. In their place are strange space minerals that are actually alien life forms. Their presence is felt by a speleologist with extrasensory powers who, with a group of friends, faces them en masse while exploring a cave. The evil stones attack and kill human beings and then take their form. The girl is the only survivor of the group, but when she emerges from the underground she finds the deserted city, now prey to the evil extraterrestrials. The original narrative cue is burned by a sloppy staging full of low blows. Obviously the film has nothing to do with the "Alien" series: it is a plagiarism shot under a pseudonym by the Neapolitan producer-director Ciro Ippolito.

title: Wolfen
actors: Albert Finney, Diane Venora
description: A New York detective tries to neutralize some mysterious beasts that wreak havoc on the city.
notes: A fine photograph contributes to the surreal atmosphere of the film.

title: Gli invincibili fratelli Maciste
actors: Richard Lloyd, Claudie Lange, Tony Freeman, Mario Novelli, Antonio De Teffé
description: Prince Akim, with his girlfriend Jhana, is building a temple helped by the strong Maciste brothers. The queen of an underworld has Jhana kidnapped to lure Akim, with whom she is in love, into her territory. The two Maciste go after him and, while one is saved, the other is captured and drugged. The revenge, however, is only postponed, after the usual twists.
notes: Completely negligible "Sandalone". Low cost, shooting on location and fast processing, second and third row actors.

title: 28 minuti per 3 milioni di dollari
actors: Richard Harrison, Franca Polesello, Claudio Biava, Ferruccio Viotti
description: A French billionaire collector hires a thief to take possession of a fabulous diamond exhibited in Rome. Carefully prepared, the blow succeeds and the precious stone sets off for France. The instigator of the theft, however, is mocked at the most beautiful, when the delivery is almost complete, from the usual, unpredictable, third wheel. But even for the latter there will be a nasty surprise. Italian Giallorosa pulled away. Only for nostalgics.

title: Il debito coniugale
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Barbara Bouchet, Orazio Orlando, Pippo Franco, Mario Carotenuto
description: Tired of work and his wife, Romolo goes off in search of adventures with a former comrade in arms and a stripper. Tired gags and joke-collecting rhythm.

title: E alla fine lo chiamarono Jerusalem l'implacabile
actors: Scott Holden, Delia Boccardo, Philippe Leroy, Keenan Wynn
description: Nothing better than an old bandit to protect the transport of two crates of gold destined for Southern General Briscott. The task is entrusted to Billy Bronson and his son Jessy called Jerusalem, who will have to face a large group of eager "suitors": Indians, false priests and real thieves, Mexicans. All of them have been hired by an unsuspected person. The film attempts the card of the grotesque and the surreal and at times it almost succeeds; much more often, however, he relies on coarse-grained comedy and sloppy staging.

title: Another Pair of Aces: Three of a Kind
actors: Kris Kristofferson, Willie Nelson, Joan Severance, Rip Torn
description: Rip Metcalf is part of the Texas Rangers corps. He is on the trail of a very dangerous killer but, to be able to catch him, he will have to use the help of Billy Roy Barker, a well-known gambler, accused of the heinous crimes of the man they are looking for.
notes: Nice performance by two actors (equally divided between music and cinema) in a detective-film with a modern western vein. The two characters graft a completely contemporary awareness and self-awareness on the classic story of the hunt for the guilty on the run. It is the sequel to "Pair of Aces", shot as a quetso for TV and with the same actors.

title: Der schrei der Schwarzen Wolfe
actors: Ron Ely, Raimund Harmstorf, Gila von Weitershausen, Arthur Brauss, Angelika Ott
description: In the past of the trapper Bill, known as Manolesta, there is a murder, but committed in self-defense. Suspicions of the killing of Mike Williams, an adventurer, friend of the outlaw Tornado Kid, now fall on him. Bounty hunter Butch Harper sets out on Bill's trail, incited by the Tornado Kid and a three thousand dollar bounty that the dead man's sister put on Bill's head. Butch, however, becomes convinced of Bill's innocence and, in the final confrontation, helps him.
notes: German-made adventure film based on a story by Jack London set in Alaska. Ron Ely was a TV Tarzan.

title: Il brigante di Tacca del Lupo
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, Cosetta Greco, Saro Urzì, Fausto Tozzi
description: A company of bersaglieri led by Captain Giordani must find the lair of the bandit Raffa Raffa. The company beats the mountains of Calabria engaging in numerous firefights with outlaws. It will be a girl, however, who had been raped by the bandit, to lead the soldiers on his trail. The film starts from a historical fact and reinterprets it in an adventurous and almost western key.

title: La casa del sorriso
actors: Ingrid Thulin, Dado Ruspoli, Enzo Cannavale, Maria Mercader, Nuccia Fumo, Lucia Vasini, Francesca Antonelli, Elisabeth Kaza
description: La Casa del Sorriso is a hospice for the elderly. Among the guests there is also Adelina who, despite her age, would still be open to love, but her rivals, disappointed and envious, wickedly take their revenge by stealing her magnificent dentures.

title: The War Lover
actors: Robert Wagner, Steve McQueen, Shirley Anne Fields
description: Buzz Rickson, a pilot captain at an American base in England, is not very popular with his colleagues. In particular, his second pilot Ed Bolland hates him since he tried to steal his girlfriend. Upon returning from a riskier mission than the others, their plane is hit. Ed parachutes, while Buzz tries to save the aircraft until the end and crashes with him. Philip Leacock is an English documentary maker who ended up directing TV serials in the US. Steve McQueen had just returned from "The Magnificent Seven" and was about to shoot "The Great Escape". His name and clear eyes were about to become famous all over the world.

title: There Was a Crooked Man
actors: Kirk Douglas, Henry Fonda, Warren Oates, Burgess Meredith
description: After a bloody robbery, the bandit Pitman eliminates the accomplices and hides the loot in a pit of rattlesnakes. He is captured by Sheriff Lopeman who sends him to jail. Pitman soon becomes the leader of the inmates. Cleverly spreading word of his rich hidden booty, Pitman bribes the director, but he is killed. He is replaced by Lopeman, who involves Pitman in his re-education programs, but at the inauguration of the new refectory Pitman escapes. Penultimate film shot by Mankiewicz, the characters of a painful pessimism on humanity are found, amplified. Using the conventions of the western genre and the prison film, Mankiewicz metabolizes them and replays them, however, in an existential key. Major Douglas and Fonda.

title: Joey
actors: Joshua Morell, Tammy Shields, Jerry Hall, Sean Johnson, Mathias Kraus, Christine Goebbels, Eva Kryll, Barbara Klein, Jan Zierold
description: After the death of her father, 11-year-old Joey lives with her mother Laura in the suburbs of an American town. The boy misses his father terribly; however he manages to establish contact with the deceased parent thanks to his supernatural sensitivity which allows him to talk to him through his toy phone. These extrasensory abilities, however, increasingly marginalize him from his peers. So Joey begins to create his own fantasy world, using his telekinetic abilities to animate his own toys, which become his only friends. But these abilities have their dark side. After the success of The Principle of Noah's Ark, Emmerich shoots a film in pure Spielberg style, with a sure hand but with a script devoid of flickers and inventiveness.

title: The Witches
actors: Anjelica Huston, Jasen Fisher, Mai Zetterling, Rowan Atkinson, Bill Paterson
description: An orphan lives a terrible adventure, similar to grandmother's fairy tales: a group of witches, apparently a respectable gentleman, want to turn him into a mouse. From a very bad children's novel by Roald Dahl, a black fairy tale in which a wicked Anjelica Huston dominates.

title: I Thank a Fool
actors: Susan Hayward, Peter Finch, Diane Cilento, Cyril Cusack
description: Dr. Christine Allerson, who has already been sentenced to euthanasia, is hired by Stephen Dale, a prosecutor at her trial, to assist his wife, Liane, who is mentally ill following an accident in which she lost her father. . Christine discovers that Liane is having an extramarital affair, that her husband is also unfaithful to her and, above all, that the woman's father is not dead at all. He leads Liane to the village where her father lives, but the distraught woman falls into a ravine.
notes: The story is unlikely and the direction is unable to unravel its obscurities.

title: To Sir, with Love
actors: Sidney Poitier, Christian Roberts, Judy Geeson, Suzy Kendall
description: Mark Tackeray (Poitier), a "colored" graduate in electrical engineering, agrees to teach at a London school frequented by rowdy and rebellious children. Knowing that others before him have failed, Mark decides not to be too rigid, but tries to win the respect and cooperation of the students by hooking his lessons to everyday reality. Despite a thousand difficulties, he manages to arouse in the students a sense of dignity for themselves and for others. Very schematic film and, in essence, caramel. Poitier is well understood, but his character is ridiculously good-natured.

title: Una donna per Ringo
actors: Sean Flynn, Pilar Bayona, Emilia Bayona, Renato Baldini, Luigi Induni
description: Bob and Ringo discover a plot against two beautiful twins, headed by the town sheriff. A western undecided between sentimentality and action.

title: Nomads
actors: Pierce Brosnan, Lesley-Anne Down, Anna Maria Monticelli, Mary Woronov, Adam Ant, Nina Foch
description: A man in shock and with numerous injuries is hospitalized in a hospital in Los Angeles, who dies after biting Dr. Eileen Flax who had approached to steal his words. It turns out that the man was Charles Pommier, an anthropologist who studied African and Eskimo myths. Eileen relives the last days of Charls's life discovering that he was following a gang of young punks, the incarnation of the spirits he studied. Film with a baroque and complex construction made in flashbacks, centered on the struggle between good (science) and evil (spirits). Disturbing and technically very remarkable.

title: Shattered Trust
actors: Melissa Gilbert, Kate Nelligan, Ellen Burstyn
description: Shari, a career lawyer, is the victim of anxiety, a disastrous love affair and a heavy lack of communication with her mother. Emotionally solicited by a child custody case, Shari goes into crisis: her repressed childhood resurfaces. Committed to the fight against child violence, the film tactfully tackles the burning topic of incest.

title: The Asphalt Jungle
actors: Sterling Hayden, Sam Jaffe, Jean Hagen, Louis Calhern, Marilyn Monroe
description: While in prison, Doc has devised a foolproof plan to steal a batch of jewelry. When he comes out he prepares to execute it. Alonzo Emmerich, an unscrupulous lawyer, agrees to help him by getting him the necessary money, obtaining it on loan from the loan shark Cobby. The blow succeeds, even if one of the gang members is killed. But then things fall apart: between internal clashes during the division of the loot and police intervention, the gang crumbles.
notes: Huston faces noir by overturning it. No longer Sam Spade ("The Mystery of the Hawk"), but the point of view of the robbers, swallowed up, one by one, by the spiral of rivalry, greed, revenge. Based on the novel by W. R. Burnett and written by Huston himself with Ben Maddow, it is a masterpiece of narrative and moral vigor, locked in a world of harshness and betrayal, outlined by Harold Rosson's lightning black and white. The three protagonists Sterling Hayden, Louis Calhern, Jean Hagen are perfect, the very young Marilyn Monroe sulking in the first small part of relief.

title: La Bibbia - I parte
actors: Michael Parks, Ulla Bergryd, Richard Harris, Gabriele Ferzetti, John Huston, Stephen Boyd, George C. Scott, Ava Gardner, Peter O'Toole
description: After the world and life, on the sixth day God creates Adam and Eve from dust and mud and places them in the garden of Eden. However, they yield to the temptation of the evil one and are chased away. The firstborn of the primordial couple, Cain, kills his brother Abel out of jealousy, then God sends the flood to punish the wicked mankind, but has Noah save the family and animal species on the ark. Once the waters of the flood have flowed back, the Earth is repopulated, but with the Tower of Babel an act of pride is committed that God punishes by confusing tongues and making men strangers to each other. Time passes, and Abraham is chosen as the progenitor of the chosen people. Before confirming all his promises, God puts him to the test several times, to the point of commanding him the sacrifice of his son Isaac. John Huston reads the Bible as a great novel, a summa of adventures, love stories and suspense even before faith. Its version is robust but not great. Unforgettable only his interpretation of the bizarre Noah. Highly spectacular, without pompierism, in the Babel sequences. For the rest, a great waste of out-of-the-way stars (some really ridiculous), too many sacred speeches, in which the director is not completely comfortable, and a general impression of fragmentation.

title: Caddyshack II
actors: Chevy Chase, Jackie Mason, Robert Stack, Dyan Cannon, Dina Merrill, Dan Aykroyd
description: Jack Hartounian is very proud of the recently accumulated wealth. But this is also his problem; like every neo-rich, in fact, he must find a way to enter the ranks of the people who "count", in the ranks of the so-called VIPs, even when these are not entirely to his taste. In particular, his first goal is to be admitted to a very exclusive golf club, also to make his daughter Kate happy. How will our hero be able to be accepted by the other members, who are far from well disposed to his candidacy? A wacky farce from the director of Rock'n'Roll High School (they were other times). The gags are predictable and the entertainment turns out to be uninteresting. Brief appearances of Dan Aykroyd and Chevy Chase. The film appeared in the US as a sequel to Harold Ramis' "Caddyshack".

title: Seven Minutes in Heaven
actors: Jennifer Connelly, Maddie Corman, Byron Thames, Alan Boyce
description: Natalie has big plans: she wants to become President of the United States. But for the moment she is forced to settle for a fling with a high school student who works like her for the presidential campaign and the company of Jeff, a friend with serious family problems. Polly, on the other hand, aspires to be a cheerleader for the baseball team: the first step is the "story" with a photographer who accidentally got her out of trouble at the stadium. It is an "under 20" comedy, with some pretense of costume satire. The rather rambling script and the not too happy dialogues do not help her to realize her intentions, however. The good is all in the intentions.

title: A Double Life
actors: Ronald Colman, Signe Hasso, Edmond O'Brien, Shelley Winters
description: An actor playing comic roles finds great success playing Othello alongside his ex-wife who plays Desdemona. The reruns of the show take place for two years during which the actor gradually begins to identify with his character, almost strangling his ex-wife on stage. Instead, he will really kill one of his mistresses before committing suicide on stage after the last monologue. Excellent foray of Cukor's cinema into the world of theater (from which it came) with a chiaroscuro style and a strong suspense. Oscar to the protagonist Colman and to the music of Miklos Rosza.

title: The Mountain
actors: Spencer Tracy, Robert Wagner, Claire Trevor, William Demarest
description: Zaccaria is a former mountain guide who has stopped working since a tourist died ten years earlier while climbing with him. He lives with his young brother Cristoforo, who cannot resign himself to their poor existence. A plane crashes over the mountains; the rescue expedition returns after losing the garment. Cristoforo wants to throw himself into the enterprise to get hold of the values ??aboard the wreck. Zacharias follows him only to prevent him from harming himself. Dmytryk points the card of the film "interpreters": much of the story sees only the two brothers on stage, but the drama is still accompanied by the spectacle of the majestic, well-photographed Alpine landscapes.

title: The Iron Horse
actors: George O'Brien, Madge Bellamy, Charles Edward Bull
description: In 1862 Abraham Lincoln began construction of the railroad, which will connect the Atlantic coast to California. Nine years earlier, an engineer attempting the feat had been murdered. Among a thousand vicissitudes and after a great battle against the Indians, the project is finally completed. A John Ford not yet thirty years old raises, with his first western, a monument to the railway builders and also to President Lincoln, not without some excess of rhetoric. The film is a real "blockbuster" of great spectacular effectiveness.

title: I gabbiani volano basso
actors: Nathalie Delon, Maurizio Merli, Mel Ferrer, Dagmar Lassander
description: A former Vietnam fighter, deserter, is blackmailed by an Italian industrialist and forced to kill a partner of the principal. The killer then wants to return to his homeland, but for a mistake he runs away: now he has against the police and his former accomplices. The owner of a Roman boutique helps him, but when the protagonist discovers that she is arrested for this, he lets himself be reached by his opponents. Unlikely and cartoonish "noir", with a plot so absurd that not even a few touches of the craft in the making can save.

title: Li chiamavano i tre moschettieri... Invece erano quattro
actors: Tony Kendall, Ettore Manni, Stan Cooper, Gino Santercole
description: To find out if the sterility of the royal couple depends on the very fat queen, it is necessary to examine her urine, collected in the gold pital signed Cellini. But the precious container is traveling to England on her lover's head. The Musketeers must retrieve it, but Cardinal Richelieu has it mistaken for an imitation. It takes more to put the unbeatable musketeers in check. Heavy film, with a complacent and ostentatious vulgarity. 1

title: Summer School
actors: Mark Harmon, Kirstie Alley, Dean Cameron
description: A teacher is forced to go on vacation in an attempt to educate a group of juvenile offenders. A decent variation on the college-movie, with some good gimmicks.

title: The Daring Dobermans
actors: Charles Knox Robinson, Tim Considine
description: Three thieves train Dobermann to rob the black funds of a political party. Spectacularity in the name of simplicity on the lines of the lucky Dabermann gang from 1972.

title: Saratoga
actors: Clark Gable, Jean Harlow, Lionel Barrymore
description: The daughter of a racehorse breeder gets engaged to a very wealthy industrialist with the intention of reorganizing the company of her recently deceased father. A friend of the deceased comes between the two and tries to lure the rich boyfriend into a trap with the intention of stealing a sum of money from him.
notes: A spectacular saraband between bets, racehorses, racetracks and games of the heart. It is the last film shot by Jean Harlow, who died during the filming.

title: The Gorgeous Hussy
actors: Joan Crawford, Lionel Barrymore, Franchot Tone, James Stewart
description: The love life of Peggy O'Neal, the protégé of Andrew Jackson, the third president of the United States. Solid production between history and (a lot) of fantasy, with a cast of all stars.

title: Killer Kid
actors: Anthony Steffen, Liz Barrett, Fernando Sancho, Ken Wood
description: An army captain, charged with crushing an arms trade on the border with Mexico, investigates by pretending to be the dangerous outlaw Killer Kid. Thus he knows the unfortunate life of the peons and sympathizes with their rebellion.
notes: Limping spaghetti westerns on the side of the oppressed, like others around 1968.

title: Vie Privée
actors: Brigitte Bardot, Marcello Mastroianni, Dirk Sanders
description: Jill (Brigitte Bardot), a pretty naive provincial girl, goes to Paris to study dance. Almost unwittingly, step by step, he becomes a movie star instead. Harassed by the worldly press, she has a nervous breakdown. Coming to Italy with her lover, a theater director, she is invariably tracked down by the paparazzi and literally dies under the flashes of their flashes.
notes: B.B. she's a credible performer in this celebrity cruelty movie that Louis Malle seals with a nice, dramatic conclusion. Thirty years ahead of issues related to the protection of privacy.

title: Shadow of the Thin Man
actors: William Powell, Myrna Loy, Barry Nelson, Donna Reed
description: Murder on a racing track. Nick and Nora, a married couple of high society, investigators by profession he, for pleasure she, find the key. Pleasant, but somewhat mannered chapter of the series with William Powell and Myrna Loy (to keep quiet about the dog). Arrived at n. 4, the cycle and the characters fatally show some weak points.

title: Wild Geese II
actors: Scott Glenn, Barbara Carrera, Laurence Olivier
description: Robert McCann, a television magnate, instructs the journalist Kathy Lucas and Allen Fraulkner, to make the scoop of the century: to kidnap Hitler's former hierarch Rudolf Hess, locked up for forty years in the Spandau prison, and make him reveal the many secrets in his possession. The two in turn charge the mercenary John Haddad who, with a command, will attempt the enterprise. The film has nothing to do with "Four of the Wild Goose"; is a routine action film in which Laurence Olvier can be seen as Rudolph Hess.

title: Another Thin Man
actors: William Powell, Myrna Loy, Otto Krüger, C. Aubrey Smith, Virginia Grey
description: Nick Charles, with his young wife Nora, their son Nick jr. and a small dog with surprising gifts, he agrees to spend a holiday with a colonel, a friend of the family. But suddenly things get complicated, the officer, in fact, is murdered and there are many suspects. Third of the famous series, the last taken from Hammett, and already less brilliant than the previous ones.

title: Something of Value
actors: Rock Hudson, Sidney Poitier, Dana Wynter
description: The young settler Peter grows up in Kenya together with the indigenous Kimani, until the reality of the race wall divides them dramatically. Unconvincing attempt to reason on the Mau Mau revolt, which shocked the news in the 1950s.

title: After the Thin Man
actors: William Powell, Myrna Loy, James Stewart, Elissa Landi, Joseph Calleia
description: The now famous amateur detectives Nick and Nora Charles, always with the inseparable dog Asta, investigate the disappearance of a relative of her. The mystery deepens more and more, but ... Skillful interweaving and brilliant dialogues; the first sequel after the excellent "Shadow Man", from 1934, again with the close couple Powell-Loy and the fox-terrier Asta.

title: Ensign Pulver
actors: Robert Walker jr., Burl Ives, Walter Matthau, Larry Hagman, Tommy Sands
description: Old Captain Morton, commander of a US Navy unit, is an old-fashioned sea dog. His way of acting alienates the sympathies of the entire crew. In the course of a storm, Morton falls overboard. He is saved by his second, Ensign Pulver, who joins him in a lifeboat. Together they land on a desert island.
notes: Along the lines of Ford's "Mr. Roberts", Logan stages this meager, but enjoyable comedy of characters. Above all, the departure is a bit difficult, but then ... the ship goes.

title: El buque maldido
actors: Maria Perschy, Jack Taylor, Blanca Estrada
description: Three men and three women at the mercy of the waves climb onto a drifting galleon inhabited by zombies condemned to sail forever. A C-series Hispanic horror, so delirious as to touch surrealism.

title: Una donna senza nome
actors: Lisbeth Hummel, Giulia Orso, Pierangelo Pozzato, Beatrice Palme
description: The rich Elize is confined to a wheelchair since childhood, living alone in her big house, assisted by Giulia, a nun, by the faithful driver Angelo and by Vivian, the maid. Giulia and Angelo are named his heirs, on condition that ...

title: Dick Tracy Versus Cueball
actors: Morgan Conway, Anne Jeffreys, Lyle Latell
description: A group of criminals, who Tracy is monitoring for implication in a series of jewelry thefts, has a problem. The bandits, in fact, are decimated by a mysterious killer. Tracy investigates and discovers that the relentless killer is none other than the former gang boss. In fact, he wants to avenge the betrayal suffered by his men. After starring in three pre-war serials, Dick Tracy is back on top, promoted to feature film. This is the second played by Morgan Conway (particularly effective) as the intrepid hero.

title: È forte un casino!
actors: Enzo Cannavale, Licinia Lentini, Bombolo, Sandro Ghiani, Gianni Ciardo
description: Michele and his three friends find an advertisement in the newspaper: a rich American heiress is looking for an Italian noble with a romantic temperament. The cronies organize the scam, taking advantage of the fact that one of them is a guardian in the villa of a count. Of course, however, even to pretend to be noble a minimum of class would be necessary. But the woman is actually a crook herself ... The tireless couple Bombolo / Cannavale rages in this farce, which scrapes the bottom of the barrel, looking for four chewed gags for an audience of few pretensions. A worthy product of the darkest years of Italian "popular" cinema.

title: Outback
actors: Jeff Fahey, Tushka Bergen, Steven Vidcer
description: Alice Richards lives a carefree existence on her father's estate; his only concern is the care of the horses, for which he has a strong passion. But when his father dies, everything changes: the estate risks ending up in the hands of a greedy creditor. Alice, with the help of a young businessman and a handsome herdsman, will resolve the situation. But the two are both in love with her ... Rural comedy set in the vast Australian spaces; beyond the suggestive location of the story, the film does not leave much to remember. Intrigue and characters fall within the expected standard, for a result marked by fairness.

title: Rasputin and the Empress
actors: John Barrymore, Ethel Barrymore, Lionel Barrymore, Ralph Morgan, Diana Wynyard, Tad Alexabder
description: The dark events of the court of Tsar Nicholas II on the eve of the October revolution. Great the three Barrymore brothers, for the only time all together.

title: China Seas
actors: Jean Harlow, Clark Gable, Wallace Beery, Rosalind Russell
description: Although his jealous mistress is on board, the captain of a ferry traveling between Hong Kong and Singapore is engaged to a rich widow. To get revenge, the girl gives a bandit the keys to the armory of the ship that is attacked by the pirates, who, however, are unable to seize the cargo of gold. Justice will triumph.
