notes: Thwarted loves, strong passions, pirate raids in the South Seas: if we tried to define the idea of ??"classicism" in the system of genres, this film would provide an ideal synthesis. A simple but well-cooked recipe, with all the ingredients in the right place, as today we can do more and more rarely.

title: Boudu sauvé des eaux
actors: Michel Simon, Charles Granval, Marcelle Hainia
description: Desperate for having lost his dog, the homeless Boudu throws himself into the Seine. A liberal-minded bookseller sees him and throws himself into the water to save him. Tearing him off the river, he then welcomes him into the house and tries to recover him socially. Result: Boudu devastates his savior's apartment, woos his maid and cuts the rope when he should marry her in a repairing wedding. Jean Renoir and Michel Simon construct a paradox of irresistible ferocity, which contrasts the hairy charity of the good bourgeois with the anarchic yearning for freedom of the bum. To the advantage of the latter.

title: The Wrath of God
actors: Robert Mitchum, Rita Hayworth, Victor Buono, Frank Langella
description: An adventurer, an Indian girl in love with him and a priest are in league with the smuggling of alcohol in Central America. The priest has long since stopped carrying out his ministry, but the persecutions to which the religious are subjected pushes him to celebrate a mass that turns into a violent insurrection. Weird in both substance and form.

title: Bulletproof
actors: Gary Busey, Darlanne Fluegel, Henry Silva, Thalmus Rasulala
description: Frank McBain, nicknamed Bulletproof, is a former Los Angeles cop, sick of individualism. He had to abandon his post as a secret agent in the CIA following a mission in which his partner was killed. He is offered a second chance when it comes to confronting and neutralizing a dangerous group of international terrorists based in Mexico.
notes: Steve Carver is one of the many offspring of the Corman Factory. Gary Busey is a "face" that has been around for about twenty years and has never received the attention it perhaps deserved. The film, all in all, also works thanks to the effective cast.

title: Cacciatori di navi
actors: Perry King, Fabio Testi, Michael Beck, Paolo Bonacelli, Yukj Okumoto
description: Four boys have decided to spend their holidays fishing on an old boat along the mouth of the Amazon River. Upon hearing of a large prize offered to those who recover an abandoned ship loaded with explosives, they decide to hunt it down. However, the enterprise is not within their reach. Folco Quilici is undoubtedly better when directing documentaries.

title: Boy, Did I Get a Wrong Number!
actors: Bob Hope, Elke Sommer, Phyllis Diller, Cesare Danova, Marjorie Lord
description: The "queen of the bubble bath", that is the French Didi, escapes from the golden world of Hollywood and takes refuge in an Oregon hotel. Suddenly a mass of hypotheses about his disappearance are unleashed. Misunderstood by a misunderstanding in contact with her, the mature and sprightly head of the family Tom Meade sees the possibility of advertising a house that he cannot sell.
notes: Misunderstandings chain and conclusion in glory. Very few ideas and moreover abused. An empty Bob Hope just can't handle the fragile shack. To report the explosive beauty of Elke Sommer, at the time in full splendor.

title: Mayflower: the Pilgrim's Adventures
actors: Anthony Hopkins, Richard Crenna, Jenny Agutter, David Dukes
description: In 1620 a group of English Puritans, persecuted at home for religious reasons, embarked on the Mayflower and headed for the American coasts. The religious are convinced that they have landed on the coasts of Virginia, a territory that is already completely civilized. But the ship's commander, Captain Jones, in agreement with a group of speculators, disembarks them much further north. TV version of The Adventurers of Plymouth, directed in 1952 by Clarence Brown: Anthony Hopkins has nothing to envy to Spencer Tracy, who played the same role there, but the whole cast is excellent.

title: Calamity Jane
actors: Doris Day, Howard Keel, Allyn Ann McLerie, Philip Carey, Gale Robbins
description: Calamity Jane (Doris Day) falls in vain for an army lieutenant only to end up in the arms of Wild Bill Hickox.
notes: Classic comedy with Doris Day, strangely set in the climate of the Old Frontier. Torrential music and songs with the most incredible pretexts.

title: Gung Ho
actors: Michael Keaton, Gedde Watanabe, Mimi Rogers, John Turturro
description: Closed the local car factory, Hadleyville is on the pavement but Hunt, a worker, convinces a Japanese house to reopen the plants. However, friction immediately arises between US employees and new managers. With skill and sympathy Hunt and his manager friend Kazahiro everything turns out for the best. Comedy full of clichés and not very funny.

title: The Love Bug
actors: Dean Jones, Michele Lee, David Tomlinson, Buddy Hackett
description: Jim lost his car in a race and bought a "beetle" from Peter, another driver, in order to continue racing. The car behaves strangely. Jim is convinced that these are mechanical problems, but in reality it is because the vehicle has a soul. Only over time does Jim realize this. Meanwhile the two gradually fraternize and become inseparable companions in competitions and victories. A famous Disney film that made history for having imposed here the term "beetle" to indicate the best-selling car of the last sixty years. Between acrobatics and cartoon-like gimmicks, guaranteed fun for children and accommodating adults.

title: The Black Arrow
actors: Louis Hayward, Janet Blair, George Macready
description: Under the reign of Edoardo VI, Sir Richard Shelton returns from the thirty -year war and discovers that his father was killed by Sir John. Only later does it understand that it is a conspiracy hatched by his uncle, Sir Daniel Brackley. Stock far away from the novel of the same name by Stevenson, with good pace.

title: The Fisher King
actors: Robin Williams, Jeff Bridges, Amanda Plummer, Mercedes Ruehl
description: Jack Lucas is a very successful radio disc jockey. Following his encouragement to the letter, one of his listeners carries out a massacre in a luxury venue. Three years pass: Lucas is with Anne and makes a living. He meets Parry, a bum and former history professor, obsessed with the legend of the Holy Grail. Parry has gone mad with grief after the death of his wife, killed in the massacre that also changed Jack's life. The d.j. he feels compelled to help his new friend and tries to help him approach Lydia. Determined to everything, he enters the building where according to Parry the Grail (a sports cup, actually) is kept and seizes it. Gilliam unleashes her visionary genius in contemporary New York. The tones of the comedy are intertwined with those of the drama about loneliness and madness lurking in the metropolis. Williams is in great shape and Bridges is scruffy enough, but the real revelation is female performers Amanda Plummer and Oscar-winning Mercedes Ruehl. Debut in the screenplay by Richard LaGravanese.

title: La ronde
actors: Anton Walbrook, Simone Signoret, Gérard Philipe, Danielle Darrieux, Daniel Gélin, Jean-Louis Barrault, Isa Miranda
description: The prostitute and the soldier; the soldier and the maid, who then ends up with the master's son. A young wife refuses to betray her husband who, on the other hand, does not have too many scruples in the face of the occasion. A poet, an actress, a count ... After a troubled night, the latter courts the prostitute of the beginning. Between one meeting and another, the images of a riding school and the melody of a waltz and a carillon that looks so much like the cinema machine. Passionate encounters without tomorrow, in a Vienna of other times. From Arthur Schnitzler's comedy, a sparkling film, staged by a Max Ophüls in a state of grace and starring an absolutely extraordinary cast of actresses and actors. A reflection on death, time and cinema, with a sumptuous style that has made school.

title: Glengarry Glen Ross
actors: Al Pacino, Jack Lemmon, Alan Arkin, Ed Harris, Alec Baldwin
description: Blake has arrived at the offices of the Premiere Properties real estate agency to make a clear speech to the four sellers. Given the difficult situation, the best will be rewarded with a Cadillac, the second will receive a set of knives and the other two will be fired. The one who has the greatest chance of making it to the Cadillac is Ricky, an unscrupulous, but winning one. George, on the other hand, is almost resigned, even if he doesn't go so far as to hook up with Dave, who is planning to steal a list of possible clients from the offices and sell it to a competing agency. Finally Shelley is desperate: he has a daughter in the hospital and knows she will never make it. Then the headquarters of the company is actually robbed and for everyone comes the showdown. Based on a play by David Mamet, who also wrote the screenplay, Foley's film is a piece of theater loaned to the cinema. This is not necessarily a reason for weakness: Mamet, in fact, when he does not direct himself, it is not bad. Foley also knows how to make his actors perform at their best, although he did it best in both At Close Range and After Dark My Sweet. Here the actors are all more than commendable; except for that vain Alec Badlwin, the film is an uninterrupted clash between sacred monsters: from Arkin to Pacino to Lemmon. Their presence is enough to save the film.

title: La ragazza con la pistola
actors: Monica Vitti, Stanley Baker, Carlo Giuffrè, Stefano Satta Flores, Anthony Booth, Corin Redgrave
description: Assunta, a Sicilian girl very attached to traditions, agrees to be kidnapped by a man from her country, Vincenzo, with whom she is secretly in love, hoping for a shotgun wedding. The next day, however, the seducer, to avoid the consequences of his gesture, flees to England. Assunta, determined to defend her honor, pursues him armed with a pistol. Here she finds Vincenzo's address, but he manages to escape her. While on her trail, Assunta meets a doctor. He takes his case to heart and, little by little, manages to change his mentality. Now it is Vincenzo who, struck by the girl's change, wants to marry her. Bubbly comedy with a very funny part set in Swinging London. He launched Vitti as a comic actress.

title: Joshua's Heart
actors: Melissa Gilbert, Tim Matheson, Matthew Lawrence, Lisa Eilbacher
description: Claudia has an affair with Tom Lawrence, an architect so obsessed with his work that he neglects both his ten-year-old son, Joshua, and his wife who in fact doesn't take long to leave him. Thus Claudia gradually enters the role of the missing mother. Indeed, since the bond with Tom is destined to end, it is precisely on the boy that his affection is directed. At this point Claudia tries to assert her reasons for staying next to Joshua, but legally there is nothing to be done. The fact of being the ex-girlfriend of the father does not give her any right to obtain custody of the son. The story does not stand, and not only from a legal point of view. On the other hand, the actors are not bad (especially Gilbert) and Michael Pressman doesn't insist on easy tears too much.

title: Nobody's Perfect
actors: Chad Lowe, Gail O'Grady, Patrick Breen, Vitas Gerulaitis
description: Stephen Parker is a brilliant student of the University of Branton, California. The brightest at least until the moment he falls in love with the beautiful Shelly. She is the best tennis player on campus, but that doesn't stop her from dating someone else. All this instead prevents Stephen from studying, to the point that his friends no longer know what to do to cheer him up. And to say that Robert Kaylor had started his career with a splendid Carny. A black and exciting film. This is a play for minors, predictable but not despicable.

title: Nothing But Trouble
actors: Chevy Chase, Dan Aykroyd, Demi Moore, John Candy
description: Chris, an economic journalist, and Diane, a lawyer, plus two Brazilian clients, leave New York for Kansas City but end up in the village of Valkenvania, where, for a trivial traffic offense, they are brought before Judge Valkenheiser, one who uses the law to own use and consumption. The film is not as funny as one might expect from people of the Saturday Night Live / National Lampoon generation. There is a dose of nastiness, but Dan Aykroyd's direction is weak and confused.

title: The Gift of Love
actors: Lauren Bacall, Robert Stack, Evelyn Rudie, Lorne Greene
description: After five years of perfect marriage, Julie discovers she has a serious heart condition. Her thoughts are two: keeping her husband Bill in the dark and finding someone, preferably an orphan, who can take his place when she passes away ...
notes: A "negulesconnerie", to quote Godard. Only Bacall is saved.

title: The Long, Hot Summer
actors: Paul Newman, Orson Welles, Joanne Woodward, Anthony Franciosa, Lee Remick
description: Ben is a troublemaker, changing jobs more often than shirt, a smack-faced tramp. The fame of arsonist also follows him when he goes to work at Willy Varner. Willy Varner is the master of everything: of the lands, of men, of beasts and also of his family that he commands despotically. From the naive daughter Clara, to the weak son Jody. A sort of understanding is established between Ben and Willy: they are the two strongest of the group. One day Jody, envious, loses his head, locks dad Willy in a stable and sets it on fire.
notes: Irving Ravetch and Harriett Frank Jr take some short stories by William Faulkner and hand Ritt a script that is almost a classic. There is the whole South of the United States, violent and suggestive. There is all the unspoken and unspoken sex running in the folds.

title: Jack's Back
actors: James Spader, Cynthia Gibb, Rod Loomis, Rex Ryon
description: Exactly a hundred years have passed since the time when Jack the Ripper terrorized London with his horrific crimes. Of course, nobody thinks about celebrating the anniversary. Suddenly, however, a strange series of murders begins to take place targeting young Los Angeles prostitutes. Suspect number one is a young doctor (James Spader), but he has a brother ... James Spader (the blond from Sex, Lies and Videotape) does not fare badly in the double role of good and bad. And the attempt to actualize Jack the Ripper's story isn't exactly clumsy either. But not too original.

title: Jona che visse nella balena
actors: Jean-Hugues Anglade, Juliet Aubrey, Luke Petterson, Jenner Del Vecchio
description: Jona Oberski is four years old and lives in Amsterdam with her parents when, after the occupation of the city by the Germans, her family ends up in the Bergen-Belsen camp. Here Jona will spend the whole war, in a shack separated from his parents and forced to grow up undergoing oppression and violence, and not only by his jailers. After the death of her father in the concentration camp and that of her mother in a Soviet hospital, Jona is first placed in the care of a girl and finally adopted by a mature couple from Amsterdam. The film is based on Oberski's autobiographical book, Years of Childhood, and faithfully adheres to it. Faenza has the advantage of maintaining a tone of dry realism that does not exclude emotional participation. It is not so much another Holocaust film as the story of a second birth, as the biblical title transpires, told through the point of view of the child. Vibrant musical commentary by Ennio Morricone.

title: Ti presento un'amica
actors: Giuliana De Sio, Michele Placido, Kate Capshaw, Luca Barbareschi
description: Dangerous relationships between an aspiring journalist, a frustrated actor, a p.r. of the fashion world, a surgeon, lovers of lovers and other representatives of the strangest human fauna. Despite intimist claims, it is a silly and televised comedy.

title: Empty Cradle
actors: Kate Jackson, Lori Loughlin, Eriq La Salle, David Lansbury
description: Jane Morgan (Lori Loughlin) is in her third pregnancy and hopes that the latter will help her marriage get back on track. Rita (Kate Kackson), a psychopath, is a nurse in the hospital where Jane is admitted. To hold on to her lover she makes him believe she is pregnant, after which he narcotizes Jane, makes her give birth in secret, kidnaps the girl and makes her believe that the baby is dead. The film is based on a true story, but it does not differ from the dozens of films for television, which spectacularize news stories. Kate Jackson, not as bad as Charlie's Angels, doesn't age very well.

title: Una sull'altra
actors: Jean Sorel, Marisa Mell, Elsa Martinelli, John Ireland, Alberto De Mendoza
description: George, a young American doctor who owns a clinic together with his brother Henry, entrusts his seriously ill wife Susan to the care of a nurse. Despite the treatment, Susan dies, leaving her husband a large sum, the result of life insurance. The amount allows George to cover the costs of building the clinic. While at a nightclub with Jane, his mistress, George is struck by a stripper's striking resemblance to Susan.
notes: An unlikely story, but with a decent hold. Famous lesbian scene between Marisa Mell and Elsa Martinelli.

title: L'alba
actors: Nastassja Kinski, Massimo Dapporto
description: Karen owns a boutique in Milan; Massimo is a technician who often resides abroad for work. The two have been lovers for a long time, although their encounters are far from frequent. Karen is now waiting for Massimo in the hotel and in the room where they have continued to meet since the first time. He thinks back to their past, to their respective marital misadventures, to his decision to change his life, finally at Massimo's side. Between thoughts and memories the hours pass. When the switchboard announces a call from the man, Karen suddenly decides to break the bond and says she's already gone. Citto Maselli faces the eternal dilemma of what is the true relationship between passion and love. A psychodrama that subjected the emotional Nastassja Kinski to a particularly heavy tour de force

title: Satyricon
actors: Don Backy, Ugo Tognazzi, Tina Aumont, Mario Carotenuto
description: Encolpius, a slacker and parasite, leaves Rome with his friend Ascilto for the villa of his uncle Anneo Mela. There he discovers that he has become master of all the property of his relative, committing suicide at the behest of Nero. From that moment Encolpius goes on numerous adventures: he meets the sorceress Circe, knows the curses of the god Priapo, is a guest of Trimalcione and runs into terrible storms. In short, for him there is no more peace. The starting text should be that of Petronius Arbiter, but great fidelity could not be expected from Polidoro. Tognazzi is a perfect Trimalcione and Tina Aumont is not as bad as Circe.

title: Bank Shot
actors: George C. Scott, Sorrell Brooke, Joanna Cassidy, Bob Balaban
description: Walter Ballantine is serving a sentence for an incredible series of criminal companies, all performed brilliantly. Helped by some accomplices, Walter escapes and prepares to create the blow of the century: to rob a bank, provisionally set up in a prefabricated, subtracting ... the entire building. However, on his traces there is his bitter enemy, the policeman Frank Streiger, called Bulldog. However, the thief's moves are so unpredictable that the agents always come late.
notes: Following "the stone that burns" (and also suddenly from a novel by Donald Westlake), a tasty comedy that mixes the tones of yellow to those of the grotesque and rose. A spectacular work in the execution and nice in acting.

title: La nave bianca
actors: Attori non professionisti
description: The crew of a warship, hit by a cannon shot during an action, is rescued by a hospital ship: the white ship. On this, with tireless dedication, they are cared for and cared for by the volunteer Red Cross women, who make them rediscover some of their lost serenity. It was the first film, also edited with archive images, by Rossellini in which we can already glimpse some elements of what Neorealism will be, even if the proximity is more than anything else with the setting of the naval films of Francesco De Robertis, his "anti-rhetoric" was basically not so unwelcome to the regime.

title: Witness
actors: Harrison Ford, Kelly McGillis, Lukas Haas, Josef Sommer, Jan Rubes, Alexander Godunov, Danny Glover, Brent Jennings, Patti LuPone, Angus MacInnes
description: Rachel Lapp is a young widow traveling with her son Samuel (Haas). During a stop at a train station, he witnesses a brutal murder. Inspector John Book (Ford), who suspects one of his colleagues, takes over the investigation and takes charge of the protection of the child and the mother. Badly wounded during his mission, Book takes refuge within the rural community of the Amish, who live off the products of the earth, still preserving the customs and traditions of the eighteenth century and to which Rachel and her son belong.
notes: For his first Hollywood film, Weir chooses a detective cue to show the clash between two cultures, and knows how to transform a more than traditional intertwining into an exciting tale. Excellent choice of interpreters: Ford confirms himself as a mature actor, while Kelly McGillis imposes himself with sweetness.

title: The Dead Zone
actors: Christopher Walken, Brooke Adams, Martin Sheen, Nicholas Campbell
description: Johnny is the victim of a car accident and comes out of a coma after five years; its existence is upset. His girlfriend has married another, and what's more, he realizes in dramatic circumstances that he has the power to "see" the future. An idea haunts him: how to intervene to prevent a megalomaniac politician from becoming president and then unleashing a nuclear war. Christopher Walken is the excellent protagonist of this film, based on a Stephen King novel. What interests Cronenberg is the dimension of foresight as a clinical residue, as "disease" and physical suffering. A horror with a melancholy charm.

title: Vertigine
actors: Beniamino Gigli, Emma Gramatica, Ruth Hellberg
description: The misunderstandings, the passions, the tremendous renunciations and the dramatic sacrifices that dot the relationship between Alberto and the daughter of the tenor Riccardi.
notes: The veteran Brignone (active since 1913 as an actor and since 1916 as a director) signs a film that is nothing more than a vehicle for Beniamino Gigli's warbling.

title: Il suo nome era Pot... ma... lo chiamavano Allegria!
actors: Peter Martell, Lincoln Tate, Daniela Giordano, Gordon Mitchell
description: Pot, an outlaw with a light-hearted and mocking way, carries out a big blow against a bank, with the help of his brother, an old gravedigger and the ferocious bandit Steve. The latter, determined to keep the entire booty for himself, kills Pot's brother, but falls, in turn, a prisoner of Lobo. A western-spaghetti in a comic key, like others of the time, shot to try to revive the fortunes of a genre now in decline. He can't even make people smile.

title: Lo squartatore di New York
actors: Jack Hedley, Almanta Keller, Howard Ross, Cinzia De Ponti, Barbara Cupisti
description: Lieutenant Williams of the NYPD is sure he is dealing with a maniac. The victims are all women and all were killed with the same ritual. The only trace is provided by Fay, one who escaped unscathed from his attack: the ripper is missing two fingers of his right hand. The investigations seem to be moving towards a conclusion, but the trace is false and the massacre continues. One of the most sadistic and cruel films by Fulci, a small master of our local thriller, who here mercilessly tortures victims and spectators. Cheap and scruffy, but fans won't be disappointed. Detail for Andrea Occhipinti. On TV he goes widely scissored.

title: Happy Birthday, Turke!
actors: Hansa Czypionka, Ozay, Doris Kunstmann, Lambert Hamel
description: Kemal Kayankaya is Turkish by birth, as the name implies, but German by adoption. He is a detective by trade and the case that presents itself to him (finding a missing man) is one of the easy ones. Then things get complicated and he finds himself involved in a smuggling and prostitution ring. Eventually everyone, including the Frankfurt police, would like him to abandon the investigation, but Kemal is stubborn.
notes: On a fairly predictable plot, Doris Dörrie ("Men", "Me and He") managed to build a decidedly original film. Particularly successful is the character of the protagonist, a rough detective, a womanizer and very witty.

title: La lunga ombra del lupo
actors: John Manera, Aliza Adar, Ivano Davoli, Lucy Chevalier
description: The partisan Marco, hunted by the Germans, takes refuge in the hidden house where his wife, son and sister-in-law live. The task of finding him and flushing him out is entrusted to his friend Andrea, who plays in the opposing field, but who has no intention of betraying him. Indeed, he will refuse to shoot him during a retaliatory action.
notes: Gianni Manera signs, in addition to directing, the subject, and together with Enrico Manera) the screenplay, while the protagonist is - surprise! - John Manera. As if to say: family business, certainly with the best of intentions. Unfortunately, only with those.

title: They All Laughed
actors: Ben Gazzara, Audrey Hepburn, John Ritter, Colleen Camp, Dorothy Stratten
description: The private detectives of the Odyssey Detective Agency take the profession very ... to heart. So often they confuse work with feelings and it happens that they fall in love with the women they have been tasked with stalking by their respective husbands. The director of the agency turns a blind eye, busy flirting with the secretary. The result is a roundabout of couples in joy, between exchanges and misunderstandings.
notes: New York in the early Eighties like Schnitzler's Vienna, between gallantry and libertinism; a reminder of the carefree sexual freedom before AIDS, with the eye to the perfect rhythm of classic Hollywood comedy (Hawks, in particular).

title: To Have and Have Not
actors: Hoagy Carmichael, Lauren Bacall, Humphrey Bogart, Walter Brennan, Lauren Bacall, Hoagy Carmichael
description: We are in Martinique, a French colony, in 1940. After the defeat suffered by the Germans, the island is governed by the representatives of Vichy. Resistance members organize an expedition with the aim of freeing a comrade detained in the country. For this they need the collaboration of an "outsider", identified in an American, Harry, owner of a fishing boat ...
notes: Taken very freely from "To have and not to have", based on a screenplay by Jules Furtmann and William Faulkner, one of the happiest results of the great filmmaker Howard Hawks, an adventure and love film in which his great moral themes return: loyalty, dignity, loyalty to oneself. The duets between Bogart and Bacall are unforgettable.

title: Reunion in France
actors: Joan Crawford, John Wayne, John Dorn
description: The Nazi occupation upsets the pleasant world of a Parisian, fashion designer. Blanda action with propaganda ideas and a female portrait entrusted to Crawford.

title: Stand Up and Fight
actors: Wallace Beery, Robert Taylor, Florence Rice
description: A young aristocrat from the South investigates a shady slave trade. Fast pace with a good cast.

title: Rose Marie
actors: Howard Keel, Ann Blyth, Fernando Lamas
description: A redcoats sergeant falls in love with a young woman who prefers an adventurous peer. Despite some good musical numbers, it is the banal remake of a better successful 1936 film (based on a Hammerstein musical already adapted into a silent film).

title: Busting
actors: Elliott Gould, Robert Blake, Allen Garfield
description: Los Angeles Department Police officers Michael Keneely and Patrick Farrel are skilled but downright nonconformist and undisciplined cops. The bosses try to entrust them with minor cases, while the two focus their investigations on Carl Rizzo, a dangerous boss implicated in a nightclub and high-profile ring. But corruption is both inside and outside the police force.
notes: Plenty of gunfights and confrontations in this eventful debut from editor Peter Hyams. Gould and Blake are a close-knit and convincing couple of protagonists, however the film is predictable and often taken for granted. At the exit it aroused some controversy because it was considered offensive towards the gay community.

title: Experiencia prematrimoniales
actors: Ornella Muti, Alessio Orano, Alberto Closas
description: The family example causes Sandra to refuse the healthy way of marriage. Beautiful Ornella Muti in a kitschy comic.

title: Hoffman
actors: Peter Sellers, Sinead Cusack, Jeremy Bulloch
description: Benjamin blackmails a young typist to spend a week with him. Sexy comedy failure, despite Peter Sellers.

title: Barfly
actors: Mickey Rourke, Faye Dunaway, Alice Krige
description: An alcoholic poet prefers slum life and the love of a prostitute rather than money and success. A cult film written by the exaggerated Charles Bukowski, starring perfectly "in part" Mickey Rourke and Faye Dunaway.

title: Amityville 3-D
actors: Tony Roberts, Tess Harper, Robert Joy, Meg Ryan, Candy Clark
description: A journalist who does not believe in supernatural forces (during his career he has exposed several people who made people believe they have powers as a medium) decides to buy a house. The man, as a sign of defiance, goes to live with his family in the famous house in Amityville, where a man possessed by irrational forces has massacred his family. The idea is not exactly the best in fact ...
notes: Rcihard Fleischer's film is disjointed and unlikely, especially because it makes the mistake of scrambling the themes of the first two episodes badly. Excellent three-dimensional effects, visible, however, only in the cinema.

title: Watch on the Rhine
actors: Paul Lukas, Bette Davis, Lucille Watson, George Coulouris
description: A German anti-fascist militant with an adventurous and semi-clandestine life marries an American and goes to her in Washington. But he is discovered and persecuted by the Nazis and, initially, also looked upon with suspicion by his wife's relatives. Robust drama from a story by Lillian Hellman. The refined dialogues of Dashiell Hammett, husband of Hellman, are decisive for the success. Oscar to leading actor Paul Lukas.

title: Colpi di timone
actors: Gilberto Govi, Dina Sassoli, Elio Steiner, Amelia Chellini
description: An elderly Genoese shipowner was diagnosed by a doctor who was a little too hasty a few months old. The man then begins to sum up his life and to deal with a series of people, thus also managing to unmask some shady trafficking. This, however, gives him a duel challenge. But at the last moment we learn that the doctor was wrong. The film suffers a little from the theatrical system, but with Gilberto Govi ??it ??is an almost invisible flaw.

title: I vendicatori dell'Ave Maria
actors: Tony Kendall, Alberto Dell'Acqua, Peter Thorrys, Ida Meda
description: In the California of the gold rush, a troupe of acrobats witness a robbery carried out by a gang of alleged Mexicans. Instead, the bandits are Yankees, and the powerful father of one of them exterminates the sheriff's family to free his captured son. Only Katie is saved: the acrobats, allied with a Mexican rebel, defeat all the wicked in his name.
notes: Adalberto Albertini's film is also part of the tide of spaghetti westerns baked between the 60s and 70s, rather obvious but with some notable action scenes.

title: Sono Sartana il vostro becchino
actors: Gianni Garko, Frank Wolff, Ettore Manni, Klaus Kinski, Gordon Mitchell
description: Three hundred thousand dollars is the spoils of a bank robbery in the West, killing all the employees. The director, the only survivor, accuses Sartana, on which a bounty is placed. But he is innocent and, aided by the clever thief Buddy Ben, he comes to town, avoids all the ambushes that are set against him, discovers the real culprits and, as a reimbursement of expenses, he takes the fat swag. Under the guise of Anthony Ascott, the very Italian Carnimeo directs actors of a certain caliber among many banalities but with a touch of self-irony. Fairly acceptable.

title: Le plaisir
actors: Gaby Morlay, Madeleine Renaud, Jean Gabin, Daniel Gélin
description: The sufferings of the wife of a viveur who hid advanced age under a mask in order to obtain more love conquests. Madame Tellier's "house" closes one day to allow guests to attend a first communion: sacred and profane. A model attempts suicide after she is planted by her painter lover; he will marry the woman now immobilized forever in a wheelchair. Three short stories by Maupassant adapted by the great Ophüls. Superb mastery of narrative virtuosity (with the best of the French cinematic firmament of the time in the cast) in a masterful balance of refined lyricism and controlled, but caustic irony. When cinema is a pleasure.

title: The Texas Rangers
actors: Fred MacMurray, Jack Oakie, Lloyd Nolan, Jean Parker
description: At the end of the last century, three bandits split up: one continues the old life of misdeeds alone, the other two, convinced that the Rangers are inflexible in their vigilance, join the corps of volunteers. One of the two is killed by the bandit, the other, who had been arrested, is freed and settles accounts with the former friend; now he can marry the daughter of his boss, whom he loves, loved in return. The transition from bandits to guardians of the law is not trivial. Solid directing in the canons of western cinema, with functional use of the landscape.

title: Stalked
actors: Maryam D'Abo, Jay Underwood, Lisa Blount, Tod Fennell
description: Despite her husband's death, Brooke (Maryam D'Abo) hasn't lost heart. Work hard and carry on looking after your child. Which is not to say that he refuses the possibility of starting a new family. The possibility seems to become concrete the day he meets Daryl, a sensitive and caring man. Only later does Brooke discover that Daryl is a dangerous psychopath. It cannot be said that, after being a Bond girl in the 007 danger zone, Maryam D'Abo has had other opportunities to show off. Nor can it be said that this thriller by Canadian Doug Jackson offers her a particularly tempting opportunity.

title: The Clairvoyant
actors: Perry King, Elizabeth Kemp, Norman Parker, Kenneth McMillan
description: A woman's body is rescued by the Hudson. The woman has handcuffs on her wrists. Shortly after another macabre discovery: a man is found dead in a swimming pool; he has the handcuffs on his feet. On the third body, Detective Larry Weeks is sure he is dealing with a madman. Up to that point, however, his only trace is Virna, a girl capable of "seeing" the murders before they happen, but not the killer's face. The idea is not exactly original and in fact reminds a little of Kerschner's The Eyes of Laura Mars. Mastroianni is not an eagle, but she still manages to keep the suspense all the way through and without abusing particularly gruesome effects.

title: The Web
actors: Vincent Price, Edmond O'Brien
description: An unscrupulous businessman (Price) hires a lawyer as a bodyguard and involves him in a murder. Solid and small thriller, with the sublime Vincent Price.

title: Victory at Entebbe
actors: Helmut Berger, Kirk Douglas, Anthony Hopkins, Burt Lancaster, Elizabeth Taylor, Christian Marquand
description: In July 1974 a Palestinian commando hijacked a plane and forced it to land at the airport of Entebbe, Uganda. Under the threat of exterminating the entire crew, the hijackers demand the release of a group of political prisoners held in Israel. With a lightning-fast action of war the Israeli leatherheads intervene and save the hostages. A television film shot with the same lightning speed with which the hostages were released in Entebbe. The cast is great and screenwriter Ernest Kinoy even got an Emmy Award, but the whole thing is packaged too hastily.

title: La donna degli altri è sempre più bella
actors: Walter Chiari, Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Mario Carotenuto
description: Five episodes populated by shrewd lifeguards, jealous husbands with or without a lover, capricious or unfaithful wives, runaway girlfriends, tenacious boyfriends and mature satyrs. Many banalities, redeemed at times by some interpretative flicker.

title: Mignon è partita
actors: Leonardo Ruta, Céline Beauvallet, Stefania Sandrelli, Massimo Dapporto
description: The Forbicioni family (parents and 5 children, from 17 years of Tomaso to 18 months of Giacomino) hosts the Parisian Mignon in Rome, daughter of a brother of the head of the family with some trouble with French justice. The girl (15 years old) is quite haughty and binds only with the shy thirteen year old Giorgio, while with Chiara. It will be an impossible teenage love, unrequited. Promising directorial debut by Francesca Archibugi, light but often happy. Even in the choice of a reduced spectacle (the insistence on modest petty-bourgeois interiors), the story has a full-bodied core and the interpreters, children and adults, give due importance to their respective characters. In evidence Cèline Beauvallet (Mignon) and Leonardo Ruta (Giorgio), in addition to Sandrelli.

title: I giochi del diavolo - La Venere d'Ille
actors: Daria Nicolodi, Marc Porel, Mario Maranzana
description: A young landowner, close to marriage, finds a statue of Venus. This, animated, falls in love with him to the point of being jealous and killing him during the wedding night ...
notes: The great Bava, already ill, gets help from his son Lamberto in the adaptation of a story by Prosper Mérimée.

title: Roy Colt & Winchester Jack
actors: Brett Halsey, Charles Southwood, Marilù Tolo
description: Roy Colt, a former outlaw, became sheriff in Karton City. Winchester Jack and the Reverend, who are still outlawed, are tempted by the map of a fabulous treasure guarded by Roy. The treasure hunt will have unexpected implications. Bava was fine in horror films, if he shot a spaghetti western it was only for food reasons. This one, which also turns to the comic, is really out of his ropes.

title: La morte al lavoro
actors: Federico Pacifici, Eva Axen, Giovannella Grifeo, Fausta Avelli
description: The young Alex (Pacifici), completely foreign to the world of cinema, discovers its charm through a direct experience: the suicide of an actor who lived in the apartment where the protagonist goes to live.
notes: From a sentence by Jean Cocteau (Cinema is death at work on the actor), from the novel The Spider by Hanns H. Ewers and from a soundtrack (music by Bernard Hermann written for Hitchcock) chosen before building the images on it, an Amelio debut in the feature film draws inspiration for a tribute to cinema and a reflection on its essence. Filmed for Rai.

title: Effetti speciali
actors: Aldo Reggiani, José Quaglio, Olga Karlatos, Jacques Herlin
description: A man who has made a lot of cinema - even if it is now his past - and has built his existence on the fantastic images with which he transmitted real thrills to the audience, receives an ambitious young cinephile in his home. But the invitation to be introduced to the "shop secrets" hides a diabolical machination. The old "magician" is at his last scene ... Amelio, with emotion and humor, talks about cinema with cinema, with quotes, references, allusions, through the fiction of a protagonist who has produced cinema, that is, fiction.

title: Escape from the Planet of the Apes
actors: Roddy McDowall, Kim Hunter, Sal Mineo, Bradford Dillman
description: The three sapiens monkeys, Milo, Zira and Cornelius, escaped the destruction of the terrestrial planet in 3955, due to a failure of the instruments of their spaceship, make a leap in time and find themselves on Earth in 1973. Finished in the sea, they are fished out and brought in front of them. to a commission of inquiry. It seems that the earthlings treat them with deference, but a scientist is troubled by their revelations ... The reflections on human pride and on the science that claims to replace God, are the basis of this third episode of the series. A bitter apologue for society, according to the tones that America of the time, in an identity crisis, preferred.

title: Full Metal Jacket
actors: Matthew Modine, Vincent D'Onofrio, Adam Baldwin, R. Lee Ermey, Dorian Harewood
description: Sergeant Hartman is rampaging at Parris Island Marine Training Camp. Insults the recruits, enslaves them, harasses them by any means. Their only companion must be the rifle, their only aim being to become war machines. Joker (Modine), however independent and nonconformist, succeeds. The soldier Lawrence (D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Ball of lard", cannot stand the military life and the abuses of which he is continually victim and goes mad: he shoots the sergeant, then kills himself. In the second part of the film Joker, assigned to the propaganda section, he finds his old companion "Cowboy" in Vietnam and follows his department in some war actions. The group advances into a bombed-out city, apparently abandoned. Until it is under the fire of a sniper who begins to decimate the ranks. With a sortie Joker and some companions go to track down the Vietcong: they will discover that it is a girl, little more than a child.
notes: It is a film without heroes, without anyone to identify with, without hope and above all without rhetoric, in a meticulously reconstructed yet almost abstract Vietnam. And, as always for Kubrick, a masterpiece.

title: Lycanthropus
actors: Barbara Lass, Carl Schell, Maurice Marsac, Curt Lowens
description: A girl from a re-education institution is found killed in a forest. From the state of the body, the police deduce that it was attacked by a pack of wolves. It then turns out that the girl was blackmailing a certain Whiteman who, unable to stand it anymore, had threatened her with death by letter. The police investigate, but then the letter disappears and another girl from the institute is attacked. Dull attempt to add some itch from the early 60s to the horror atmosphere. The attempt fails on both fronts.

title: Goodfellas
actors: Robert De Niro, Ray Liotta, Joe Pesci, Lorraine Bracco, Paul Sorvino, Frank Sivero, Mike Starr, Frank Vincent, Chuck Low, Frank DiLeo, Gina Mastrogiacomo, Suzanne Shepherd
description: Henry Hill tells his story as a gangster from when, as a young boy, he watched the bosses of the neighborhood. Thus begins to frequent the environment where James, Tommy and Paul introduce him to crime. In the meantime, Henry has married a Jewish girl, who is ignorant of her real profession, but who will gradually become entangled in her husband's business. Disgraced and fearing of being eliminated, Henry decides to "sing" with the FBI. With this film, Scorsese tackles the Italian-American mafia environment already described in Mean Streets. Built on the syncopated tempo of the songs on the soundtrack that follow each other in bursts, the film discards, deforming them, the commonplaces of the genre, mixing paranoia and violence to give us back a picture, paradoxically, truer than reality. A tour de force for the spectator's eye and mind, Goodfellas stages masterful technical skill and directorial intelligence. Director Award at the Cannes Film Festival.

title: Questi pazzi, pazzi italiani
description: It is a collage made of songs, interpreted by the most famous singers of the time, and sewn from a series of animated drawings. It is part of a trilogy with The Avenue of the Song and 008 Rhythm Operation.

title: Married to the Mob
actors: Michelle Pfeiffer, Matthew Modine, Dean Stockwell, Alec Baldwin
description: Angela, a new widow of the Mafia, is the object of desire of the "Tiger". She changes neighborhoods, refuses money and ignores old friendships, but it is difficult to get rid of the affection of the mafia family. Just as it is difficult to get rid of the attentions of MIke, a harmless and clumsy neighbor. Mike is actually a cop who is trying to frame Tony Russo, but Angela is so charming and helpless ...
notes: As in "Something Overwhelming", Demme mixes different genres: the comedy is subjected to shock treatment, based on massive doses of gangster films. Great work on the music column by David Byrne, formerly of Talking Heads. Pfeiffer is perfect, good Modine. From the anthology the sequence at the supermarket with all her friends, horrible and fluffy.

title: Sunday Bloody Sunday
actors: Glenda Jackson, Peter Finch, Murray Head, Daniel Day-Lewis
description: Bob Elkin, a young sculptor, has an affair with a divorced woman, Alex Grenville (Jackson). Which doesn't stop him from also having an affair with a doctor named Daniel Hirsch (Finch). The strange triangle falls when Bob decides to leave both of them to try his talent in America. Alex and Daniel sadly adapt to the new situation.
notes: One of the best films of Schlesinger's best period. A sober and antiscandalistic film with a great Glenda Jackson. Debut for Daniel Day-Lewis in the role of a young hooligan.

title: Professione bigamo
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Terry Torday, Raffaella Carrà, Peter Weck
description: The railway worker Vittorio Coppa, on the Rome-Munich line, finds a way to always feel at home: in both cities he has a wife and gets along very well by dividing his time equally between the two menages. That is until one of the women finds out, teams up with the other and drags him to court. But there is the twist: in fact, a third wife appears, Sicilian, impaled by Vittorio in his youth ...
notes: There are those who have "a woman in every port" and those who are satisfied with having a wife at every station: worse for him, but worse for those who endure an hour and a half of little affairs that make you laugh very little.

title: Gentlemen Prefer Blondes
actors: Marilyn Monroe, Jane Russell, Charles Coburn, Elliott Reid
description: Gus, a young billionaire, falls madly in love with Lorelei, a blonde dancer with a penchant for (very) rich men and decides to marry her. The two plan a trip to Europe to fulfill their dream of love, but Gus's father, at the last moment, throws up the trip. Lorelei, however, does not want to miss the opportunity and, since the tickets can no longer be returned, she leaves with Dorothy, a brunette colleague. Gus's father, on the other hand, who smells burnt, entrusts the surveillance of the two women to a private detective who embarks with them under a false name. During the journey, however, he falls in love with Dorothy. When the trio arrives in Paris, the adventures aren't over. The film captures with its wealth of situations and dialogues of sparkling intelligence, the quality of interpretation and musical numbers. And lets filter a laughing pessimism about the relations between the sexes.

title: Making the Grade
actors: Judd Nelson, Jonna Lee, Gordon Jump, Dana Olsen
description: Palmer Woodrow III (Olsen) has his future secured by his family's money as long as he can finish high school on time. The boy, however, is rather listless and little inclined to studies, nor does he seem worried about the consequences of this attitude. Eddie Keaton (Nelson) is a New Jersey boy, full of cunning, but constantly chased by his creditors. During one of these escapes, Eddie literally falls on Palmer and that's where the idea of ​​swapping roles is born. Eddie starts badly by not being able to hide his common origins, but little by little he gets a taste for it and manages to exploit all the privileges of the new situation. The film, which remotely harks back to Mark Twain's Prince and the Pauper, tries to make people laugh starting from class differences, using the usual unglued situations and filling the rest with outline specks. In short: the usual nonsense for American teenagers.

title: Moon 44
actors: Michael Paré, Lisa Eichhorn, Malcolm McDowell, Dean Devlin, Brian Thompson, Leon Rippy, Stephen Geoffreys
description: In the year 2038, peace reigns on Earth, but not in the galaxy. In particular, the struggle between multinationals to secure the rights to exploit the various planets is very bloody. On Moon 44 then there are well-founded suspicions that a saboteur is about to strike. To investigate, Felix Stone (Michael Paré) arrives on the planet a sort of private investigator, who presents himself in the false guise of an inmate. Less stupid than it may seem from the plot and than one could suspect for the mere presence of Michael Paré. The film can be easily seen, although in some places it is not very successful. Malcolm McDowell almost always does the same part, but he does it well.

title: Memoirs of an Invisible Man
actors: Chevy Chase, Daryl Hannah, Sam Neill, Michael McKean, Stephen Tobolowsky
description: Nick, a dull businessman, falls victim to an inexplicable accident in a chemical industry and transforms into an invisible being. The CIA entrusts the case to Jenkins, who has a great desire to get his hands on Nick to make him a tool for his political plots. A tenacious pursuit begins that takes Nick (and Jenkins) to a colleague's mansion by the ocean, where he enlisted the help of the beautiful Alice with whom he has long been in love. It does not have the disruptive force of carpenter's masterpieces, but it is still enjoyable entertainment, with fun special effects and an almost didactic "moral" about invisibility as a metaphor for the common man.

title: Il grande cocomero
actors: Sergio Castellitto, Alessia Fugardi, Anna Galiena, Lara Pranzoni
description: Twelve-year-old Pippi, prey to epileptic seizures since childhood, arrives at the pediatric neuropsychiatry department directed by the young Arturo. He soon realizes that the problem is attributable to the family environment, made up of enriched and absent parents, lacking any ability to listen and to communicate. He therefore decides to attempt analytic therapy. The relationship, intense and not always easy, with the girl will be an opportunity for him too - after a marital crisis - to rediscover a sense of his own existence.
notes: Mature proof of Archibugi, who confirms herself as a sensitive director, but also confident in the writing and direction of the actors, the true strength of the film with interpretations rich in nuances.

title: L'ultima neve di primavera
actors: Bekim Fehmiu, Agostina Belli, Renato Cestié, Nino Segurini
description: Little Luca has lost his mother and suffers from a lack of paternal affection. He lives in a boarding school while his parent, a successful lawyer, is taken up solely by his career and by his love for Veronica, the girl he is romantically attached to. Veronica will be able to remove the boy from his isolation, but it will be for a short time: Luca is in fact ill with leukemia.
notes: A tearjerking melodrama that relies on the most elementary feelings. Cestié had made himself known for having given the face to Leonardo da Vinci in the Rai drama. At the time, the film grossed the considerable sum of one billion and two hundred million.

title: Good Morning, Miss Dove!
actors: Jennifer Jones, Robert Stack, Kipp Hamilton, Robert Douglas
description: Favorite of her father, bank president, Miss Dove abandons her adventurous dreams of youth for the profession of geography teacher. In fact, a large cash shortage has been discovered, the person responsible for which is the deceased, and the daughter undertakes to return the stolen goods. A life for the school that will reward the gratitude of generations of students and the town.
notes: Koster will go down in history (of cinema) for having directed the first film in cinemascope, "La tunica", a little less for this "Good morning, Miss Dove!" kneaded with good feelings.

title: Maxie
actors: Glenn Close, Mandy Patinkin, Ruth Gordon, Barnard Hughes
description: Jean (Glenn Close) and Hick (Mandy Patinkin), her secretary to Bishop Campbell, he a librarian, live in the house that belonged to a 1930s actress: Maxie Malone, who died in an accident. One day Maxie materializes expressing a desire to find the success she had missed in life. Thus enters the body of Jane who manages to get a part in a Hollywood movie. Film all built on a histrionic Glenn Close, who thus gives a proof of being a great star, really holding up a not excellent film by herself.

title: Renegades
actors: Kiefer Sutherland, Lou Diamond Phillips, Jami Gertz
description: Buster, a policeman not very loyal to the regulations, together with the Indian Hank sets out on the trail of the boss Marino. The latter, among the many crimes he is responsible for, is wrong in killing Hank's brother and outraging a spear sacred to the Sioux. After the inevitable disagreements, the policeman and the red man get along with love and harmony and, then for the criminals there is trouble ...
notes: The two killers are nice (already together in "Young Guns") and fairly expressive and this saves the situation a bit. There is movement and for once you are sure you are on the right side. But the script and direction leave something to be desired.

title: Condannato a nozze
actors: Sergio Rubini, Margherita Buy, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Patrizia Piccinini
description: Roberto arrives at the wedding without having resolved the contrast between the desire for a stable love, with its corollary of mutual fidelity, and the charm of the game of seduction and adventures without tomorrow. This indecision leads him to a drastic split and to lead, with equal rigor and extremism, two parallel and irreconcilable lives. Until the inevitable confrontation.
notes: As in many recent Italian films, another irresolute character, a step beyond the responsibility of choices. Piccioni's merit is that he tried to play it on the ground of irony and the grotesque; pity that his bet has resulted in a slip.

title: A Few Good Men
actors: Tom Cruise, Jack Nicholson, Demi Moore, Kevin Bacon, Kiefer Sutherland, Kevin Pollak, James Marshall, J.T. Walsh, Christopher Guest
description: A soldier is killed victim of an "exemplary" punishment in the military camp of Guantanamo, in Cuba. Two of his comrades are accused of murder; Lieutenant Kaffee, in charge of defense and considered malleable, is gradually persuaded to investigate thoroughly the responsibilities of the camp commander, Colonel Nathan R. Jessup. A film conducted along the lines of the judicial drama, but which offers no support for consoling identifications.

title: Il grande Blek
actors: Sergio Rubini, Roberto De Francesco, Dario Parisini, Francesca Neri
description: While waiting for the train that will take him to work, and to live in another city, Yuri remembers his adolescence and his friends in Ascoli Piceno. Especially the virile and somewhat enigmatic figure of Rocket, an older friend who dies in a car accident. Then the political demonstrations, the Lambretta races, the loves and disappointments, the joys and sorrows. Interesting first work Il grande Blek takes its title from that of a well-known comic of the time, which immediately defines the cut of nostalgia and memory that Piccioni confers (despite some naivety) to its story.

title: Hero
actors: Dustin Hoffman, Geena Davis, Andy Garcia, Joan Cusack
description: Bernie La Plante, a jobless, separated, and child-bearing crook, is a born indifference. But one evening he saves the crew of a plane crashed on the highway and then leaves. One of the passengers, a television reporter, chases him to "sanctify" him as "the angel of flight 104". In its place, however, he finds a homeless man who, thanks to the television advertising launch, becomes a national star. Frears made a film that under the edifying guise of comedy hides a ferocious indictment against selfishness and passion for money in the US, and against the power of TV. The style is explicitly that of 1940s comedies. .

title: La vache et le prisonnier
actors: Fernandel, Pierre Louis, Ellen Schwiers, Inge Schoner
description: A French soldier, taken prisoner by the Germans and assigned to a farm as a worker, decides to escape with an unusual stratagem: he will walk towards France carrying the cow he takes to pasture and no one will be able to suspect his true intentions. Between dramatic adventures, but above all comic, he crosses the whole of Germany. An excellent starting idea, which, however, would have required a more "dry" screenplay and a more biting direction. However, Fernandel also manages to make up for the slow pace of the film.

title: La femme de Rose Hill
actors: Marie Gaydu, Jean-Philippe Ecoffey, Denise Péron, Roger Jendly
description: A Mauritian girl married by mail order to a Swiss landowner realizes she will never love him. She does not cooperate in the running of the house and refuses to have contact with her husband. One day she meets the son of a wealthy industrialist and with him, instead, it is overwhelming love. But the young man's father hinders their relationship in every way. Until the tragedy. More interesting, because more "subtle", in the first part, the film is still a noble indictment against racism, exemplified in a story that scratches the backward respectability of a community that fiercely defends its privileges.

title: Fai in fretta ad uccidermi... ho freddo!
actors: Monica Vitti, Jean Sorel, Roberto Bisacco, Daniela Surina
description: Giovanna and Franco, both adventurers and scammers, after trying to bugger each other, decide to join forces. Among the many victims, here is a girl who says she is persecuted by her brother because of a pharaonic inheritance. Idea: What if Franco married her and then killed her? What if Giovanna did the same thing with her brother? But the matter ends in joy, without anyone dying. A horrendous title for a plot that echoes that of Ernest Lubitsch's competent Mancha. Which would not be bad, as long as Maselli also had comedy among his strings. Which it absolutely is not.

title: Höstsonaten
actors: Ingrid Bergman, Liv Ullmann, Lena Nyman, Halvar Björk, Marianne Aminoff
description: Eva, wife of a Protestant pastor, invites for a stay in her house, where her sister Helena is also hosted, immobilized by a serious illness, her mother, an established pianist. A few hours are enough for the situation to become fraught with heavy friction, fueled by mutual accusations. Especially Eva is very hard on her mother, and she starts again. The daughter will then send a letter offering peace. The "sonata" (which our ineffable translators confuse with symphony) is for two "instruments": Eva (Liv Ullman) and her mother (Ingrid Bergman, directed for the first time by her namesake). Very intense, very tense, with two exceptional performers.

title: Vivre pour vivre
actors: Yves Montand, Annie Girardot, Candice Bergen, Irene Tunc
description: Robert Coster is a French television journalist, happily married to Catherine. One day he meets Candice, a young American he met some time before. A relationship is born between the two. Robert, however, lives it distressed by feelings of guilt. For this he agrees to leave for Vietnam. On his return, however, shocked by the tragedy of the war, Robert has changed. He looks for his wife and finds her on vacation: between the two it seems all over, however ... In the area "A man, a woman", including the music of Francis Lai, with an extra rhetoric. Great wasted actors.

title: Trinità e Sartana figli di...
actors: Robert Widmark, Harry Baird, Beatrice Pellh, Stelio Candelli
description: Sartana and Trinità reach the town of Quintana; here they carry out a robbery against a bank. In the town, thanks to the connivance of the sheriff, Barton, the bully on duty, is the master. The man is taking over all the land to the detriment of the small landowners in the area. Trinity, left Sartana struggling with Klein, decides to stay in the nomadic community of Geremia, where the vine is grown. The bandit gives the fruit of the robbery to the community so that they can continue in their work. Wester-spaghetti really of the lowest range.

title: I figli... so' pezzi 'e core
actors: Mario Merola, Anna Maria Ackermann, Carlo Giuffrè, Michele Esposito
description: Tommaso is a luckless singer who earns his living on the streets and in taverns. His wife Matilde is expecting their first child who dies soon after giving birth. In the same hours a single mother dies giving birth to a beautiful and healthy baby. With the complicity of the midwife Tommaso and Matilde exchange the little ones and raise the "stolen" baby with great love. Then Matilde also dies and Tommaso is left alone with the boy. One day, however, the natural father, a little good, shows up and gets the baby back from the court. This time the Neapolitan drama points to the dearest feelings. Bandit or beggar Merola is always the same.

title: Killer in the Mirror
actors: Ann Jillian, Len Cariou
description: Samantha and Karen are two physically indistinguishable twins from each other, but one is good and the other perfidious. When Samantha's rich husband is killed, all suspicions converge about her wife, who risks the capital penalty.
notes: Passable TV production that refers to a classic thriller theme and echoes "The dark mirror" by Robert Sodmak.

title: Top Line
actors: Franco Nero, Deborah Barrymore, Mary Stavin, William Berger
description: Ted Archer, novelist and trader of archaeological finds, discovers in Cartagena, Colombia, the clues of an ancient passage of an extraterrestrial civilization. On the trail of the discovery, however, there are the secret services of half the world and also a cyborg-killer and a mutant woman, so that the protagonist passes from one danger to another, against very fierce opponents. It will have matter for a book. Discreet attempt of Italian production in the territories of spectacular fantasy. The setting is suggestive and some scenes of superhuman prodigies have an undoubted effectiveness. Within certain limits, a not unworthy competitor of the typical US product.

title: Times Square
actors: Tim Curry, Trini Alvarado, Robin Johnson, Peter Coffield
description: Two girls run away from a psychiatric clinic and, thanks to the help of a radio broadcaster, they conquer New York with provocative numbers and songs. Amazing fable was not successful, with the protagonist of "Rocky Horror Picture Show".

title: Forsaking All Others
actors: Clark Gable, Joan Crawford, Robert Montgomery, Charles Butterworth
description: A woman (crawford), abandoned to the altar, almost manages to make a mistake twice. Mediocre romantic comedy of the MGM, despite Joseph Mankiewicz's screenplay and extraordinary actors.

title: Crossplot
actors: Roger Moore, Martha Hyer, Alexis Kanner
description: Advertising agent ends up embroiled in an eventful espionage affair. Skillful amalgamation of action and typical twists of the genre.

title: A Free Soul
actors: Lionel Barrymore, Norma Shearer, Leslie Howard, Clark Gable
description: A lawyer's daughter turns her back on the beautiful world to marry a glamorous gangster. Thirties production perfect for a slightly dated melodrama that launched Clark Gable among the stars. Oscar for interpretation to Lionel Barrymore. Remade with the title "Restless Life" (1953).

title: Parole de flic
actors: Alain Delon, Jacques Perrin, Fiona Gélin, Jean-François Stévenin, Aurelle Doazan, Jacques Perrin, Vincent Lindon
description: Following the death of his wife, Daniel Pratt (Delon) resigned from the police and now runs a small fishing business in Africa. When he learns that his daughter was killed in Lyon, he returns to France and, determined to avenge her, kills the murderers one by one. Their leader is none other than Commissioner Reiner, his great friend, who, discovered, commits suicide. The action flows well oiled in its mechanisms, and willingly one passes over some improbability. Everything is naturally tailor-made for Delon, who knows how to be convincing in the role of the handsome lonely and melancholy avenger.

title: Firestarter
actors: Drew Barrymore, George C. Scott, David Keith, Martin Sheen
description: Little Charlie (Barrymore) is equipped with Pyrocinesi, that is, the faculty to set fire with the mind. The secret services, who would like to use it, kill her mother and try to kidnap her, but dad Andy, also with paranormal powers, neutralizes the agents and runs away with the girl. Branched and finally captured, they are studied in military workshops, where they pretend to have tamed. But they consider escape.
notes: Stephen King's novels do not always work well in the cinema, and this film, tortuous and boring, directed by Mark Lester a year before "Commando", gives us confirmation. Too bad for the overall interesting cast. The film met a first remake in 2002, Firestarter, and a second, always with the same title, in 2022.

title: Fire in the Sky
actors: D.B. Sweeney, Robert Patrick, Craig Sheffer, Peter Berg
description: On November 5, 1975, in an Arizona forest, six lumberjacks saw an inexplicable light in the sky. Travis Walton, one of the group, is thrown to the ground by a mysterious force; the others flee and for five days there is no trace of their companion, so much so that the woodcutters are suspected of having killed him. Then Travis reappears and recounts his dramatic stay with the aliens. It seems that the one underlying the film is a true story, but the story, perhaps precisely because it is linked to a need for "reality", is less compelling than others, admittedly fantastic. There are also some effective moments.

title: Forever Young
actors: Mel Gibson, Jamie Lee Curtis, Elijah Wood, Isabel Glasser
description: In 1939 the driver Daniel McCormick is (almost) at the height of happiness; he only lacks the audacity to ask for a wife for the woman he loves. Suddenly she is the victim of an accident and falls into a coma. Now destroyed, Daniel lends himself as a guinea pig for a scientific project: for more than half a century he will remain in hibernation. The man will be "resurrected" fifty years later by an enterprising boy. The affection towards the fiancée friend will remain forever. The film, directed by a horror film specialist, is a curious mixture of romance and science fiction. The film spreads tons of molasses in its first dimension but is more enjoyable in the second, thanks to the dynamic frugoletti more than the languor of Mel Gibson "broken heart".

title: Cop and a Half
actors: Burt Reynolds, Norman D. Golden II, Ray Sharkey, Ruby Dee
description: It's his life's dream: to be a policeman. He knows everything, the moves, the jargon, the tricks of the trade. The TV is good for something! Therefore, when he happens to witness a murder, he, Devon, from the height of his eight years of age, asks the police a precise and non-negotiable "either or": either they hire him for all intents and purposes or what he knows, he keeps it to himself. Variation of the traditional couple of US policemen. Here little Norman D. Golden II is brilliant, but the movie is all there.

title: Le rapace
actors: Lino Ventura, Xavier Marc, Rosa Furman, Aurora Clavel
description: Mexico, 1938. A foreigner was hired by the revolutionaries to kill the President. Skillfully, the killer overcomes all checkpoints and settles in the house where he must wait for the set time. Having completed the mission with the help of the young Miguel, the new danger is the revolutionaries themselves who want to eliminate the man. Lino Ventura is the real trump card of the film, skilled as he is at building a well-rounded character, more than the evident attempts of the director to build a climate of tension, only partially successful. Although José Giovanni, he tells with a good pulse.

title: Cliffhanger
actors: Sylvester Stallone, John Lithgow, Michael Rooker, Janine Turner, Caroline Goodall
description: Traumatized by an accident in which he was unable to save a girl's life, Gabe Walker decides to do away with the mountains. However, when a plane crashes in the middle of the mountains, and he is in those parts, he cannot resist and agrees to leave in search of the survivors. He finds them immediately, but at the same time discovers that they are criminals. They take him hostage, together with another guide, to retrieve three briefcases full of dollars which, following the accident, ended up on the rocky walls and glaciers in the area. Shot halfway between Cortina and Hollywood, Harlin's film did not have the expected success. Yet there are some very impressive high-altitude footage and then there's Michael Rooker in one of his rare appearances after "Henry, Rain of Blood".

title: Equinox
actors: Matthew Modine, Marisa Tomei, Tyra Ferrell, M. Emmet Walsh, Lara Flynn Boyle
description: Henry Petosa (Modine) works as a mechanic in his adoptive father's garage. What shy Henry does not know is that his twin brother Freddy Ace lives in the city who, unlike him, is outgoing, enterprising and also not a little criminal. The paths of the two brothers, who do not even suspect the existence of each other, are destined to meet. The plot seems to go back to the good old appendix novel with the two twins who sooner or later meet with great mutual surprise. Rudolph, however, sets everything in a vaguely futuristic scenario that is convincing.

title: Madame de...
actors: Danielle Darrieux, Charles Boyer, Vittorio De Sica, Jean Debucourt
description: Louise (Darrieux), Count André's wife, sells earrings without her husband's knowledge to pay off debts. From that moment on, the earrings passed from hand to hand, finally arriving among those of Count Franco Donati (De Sica) who, falling in love with Louise, offers them to the woman as a token of love. It all ends with a duel between her husband and the suitor. From the novel by Louise de Vilmorin; the art of Max Ophüls transforms it into a great, very tender piece of cinema, melancholic, sweet and cruel evocation of a belle epoque homeland, ideal for the author and destination of life.

title: The Public Enemy
actors: James Cagney, Jean Harlow, Edward Woods, Joan Blondell, Donald Cook, Leslie Fenton, Beryl Mercer, Robert Emmett O'Connor, Murray Kinnell, Mae Clarke
description: Portrait without reticence of Tom Powers' education, an Irish family gangster: from childhood on the streets of Chicago, to the first criminal companies, to the tragic end.
notes: Interpreted by a great James Cagni, capable even of having the character assume heroic dimensions despite his total negativity, is together with Piccolo Cesare (1931) and Scarface (1932) the founding film of the gangster movie. The direction of Wellman is very tight, with the laconinca final sequence of the abandonment of the body of Cagney. Famous the grapefruit that Cagney crushes his girlfriend to face.

title: Unforgiven
actors: Clint Eastwood, Gene Hackman, Morgan Freeman, Richard Harris
description: A group of prostitutes wants to take revenge on two cowboys who have scarred one of them. The Kid comes forward and convinces the former gunslinger rusty from age and grief for the loss of his beloved wife William Munny. Munny's trusted friend the black Ned Logan is also added. The latter is killed and Munny beaten to death. But the killer’s soul has the upper hand, and the former gunslinger clashes with the enemy of the past ...
notes: Eastwood has made a film in which the strong themes of the western genre are praised in the cold and desperation of tragedy. This is why the film resembles a "noir" where heroes can no longer exist. Oscar for Best Picture, Direction, Gene Hacman as Supporting and Editing.

title: ... e il terzo giorno arrivò il Corvo
actors: Lincoln Tate, William Berger, Fiorella Mannoia, Lorenzo Fineschi, Richard Melvill
description: We are at the decline of the western spaghetti, the films, all Italian, shot in Sardinia or Spain, with strictly local actors and strictly hidden by Anglo-Saxon pseudonymous fantasies. The only reason for curiosity: the presence of Fiorella Mannoia in the cast. Before becoming a singer, she was an actress and a stunt woman. Seeing is believing.

title: Un mostro e mezzo
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Margaret Lee, Alberto Bonucci, Anna Maria Bottini, Lena von Martens, Giuseppe Pertile, Consalvo Dell'Arti, Susanna Clemm
description: Franco (Franchi), a thief in action on an international train, steals the suitcase of a surgeon (Ingrassia). Only later does he discover that he has only stolen the remains of a corpse, but at that point the same surgeon intervenes to save him from the police. In fact, he needs the thief to attempt a scam against a billionaire. In this gothic parody, which is one of Steno's best films as well as being one of the best of the Franchi / Ingrassia duo, the pace is unleashed and the supporting actors are excellent. To be rediscovered.

title: Conquest of the Planet of the Apes
actors: Roddy McDowall, Don Murray, Ricardo Montalban
description: A year after the turn of the century, monkeys have become completely slaves of man and, thanks to training, have been forced to perform the humblest jobs. Among them was a particularly evolved species, capable even of speaking English, which for this very reason had been exterminated. But not quite, because Caesar is still alive, he has arrived in the city and is now ready to lead the revolt.
notes: Fourth installment, increasingly sluggish and less and less original, of the "Planet of the Apes" saga. Compared to the first film in the series, only Roddy McDowall and screenwriter Paul Dehn remain.

title: Thrilling
directors: Ettore Scola, Gian Luigi Polidoro, Carlo Lizzani
actors: Nino Manfredi, Walter Chiari, Dorian Gray, Alberto Sordi, Sylva Koscina
description: A Latin teacher (Manfredi) goes to the psychoanalyst because he is convinced that his wife intends to kill him. Eventually he will be killed, but by his mistress. A husband (Chiari) disguises himself at night as Sadik to indulge his wife's fantasies. A motorist (Deaf) exits the highway and ends up in an inn run by unsavory characters. Despite the claims of the title, there is no thrilling in any of the three episodes of which the film is composed. Everything rests on the shoulders of consummate actors.

title: Paris - When It Sizzles
actors: William Holden, Audrey Hepburn, Noël Coward, Gregoire Aslan
description: A screenwriter and his typist relive the story, which they are writing as a cinematic script: the film will not be made, but love blossoms.

title: Il brigante
actors: Adelmo Di Fraia, Francesco Seminaro, Serena Vergano, Anna Filippini
description: Unjustly accused of murder by the fascists, Michele is imprisoned. Having fled, he joins the allied troops and returns to the country after the Liberation: here he leads the occupation of the land by the peasants, but the old accusation reappears and he must flee again. His partner follows him and is killed by mistake by the carabinieri: Michele, mad, commits a massacre before dying.
notes: The film is based on the novel of the same name by Giuseppe Berto, of which it maintains the breath and epic tone. The story touches, through the personal story and the reconstruction of the peasant world, the crucial node of the passage from fascism to the Republic.

title: La signora gioca bene a scopa
actors: Carlo Giuffrè, Edwige Fenech, Didi Perego, Franca Valeri, Oreste Lionello
description: Matteo, of Neapolitan origins but owner of a shoe shop in Parma, is an inveterate poker player and well-known libertine. Having accumulated heavy gambling debts, he begins to demand from his women, obtaining it, money for his "benefits". The troubles begin when Matteo, forced into an erotic overwork by increasingly heavy losses, asks for help from his clerk, Tonino; for a while it works, but soon the assistant starts ... on his own.
notes: A farcical comedy, with many itchy winks and few undertones.

title: Qiu Ju de guan si
actors: Gong Li, Lei Laosheng, Ge Zhijun, Liu Peiqi, Zhu Wanging
description: In a Chinese mountain village, the husband of the beautiful Qiu Ju was kicked between the legs by the village chief. The wife, worried above all about the possible consequences, demands an apology from the offender. The latter, however, does not even think about it. The woman, who is also pregnant, sets in motion the machinery of justice which, however, from step to step, risks becoming a real "monster".
notes: Golden Lion in Venice and award to actress Gong Li, after the success obtained by "Red Lanterns". The change of gaze compared to the previous film is radical: sequences "stolen" in the streets, among the people, very few professional actors and a deliberately poor style.

title: Storie dell'anno Mille
actors: Franco Parenti, Carmelo Bene, Giancarlo Dettori, Cosimo Cinieri, Marina Berti, Federico Boido, Cosimo Cinieri, Veriano Ginesi, Gabriella Giorgelli, Philippe Hersent, John Karlsen, Folco Lulli, Anna Maestri, Gordon Mitchell
description: The year one thousand is about to close. The knight Fortunato and the two soldiers Famine and Corncob, survivors of a battle and victims of constant misunderstandings, face some hard and cold ones. Disguised as religious, they stumble upon the Pope who wants to be confessed; they are then involved in a siege; they risk the stake as heretics and are saved for a providential flood; they are given a realm as a gift and the next day they are once again sentenced to death. They flee, but they won't find peace at home either.
notes: This picaresque film, scripted by Tonino Guerra and Luigi Malerba and also presented in a 4-episode television version, offers a fun remixing of traditional medieval imagery. He succeeds fully, thanks also to the excellent performers (including Bene dubbed!)

title: Le fatiche di Ercole
actors: Steve Reeves, Sylva Koscina, Gianna Maria Canale, Gabriele Antonini
description: The strong-willed Hercules does all he can to bring Jason, the legitimate ruler of the kingdom of Thessaly to the throne, defeating the perfidious usurper Pelias. In order to officially consecrate him king, he also helps him recover the fabulous Golden Fleece, the official symbol of royal power. Hercules finds his personal reward in the love for the beautiful Jole, daughter of Pelias, who goes away with him.

title: La ragazza che sapeva troppo
actors: John Saxon, Leticia Roman, Valentina Cortese
description: Nora Davis, an English girl on vacation in Rome, finds herself at the center of a frightening series of murders. The trouble is, no one believes her.
notes: The title refers to The Man Who Knew Too Much by Hitchcock. Bava builds a thriller according to the classic rules of the genre, but with desecrating intentions. Some moments are very enjoyable.

title: Peyton Place
actors: Lana Turner, Hope Lange, Lee Philips, Arthur Kennedy, Diane Varsi
description: Peyton Place is not a quiet New England town, it is a nest of vipers. Under the apparent normality, in fact, there are deep dissatisfactions and incurable dramas. Constance Mckenzie (Turner) has not yet recovered from a past love that her daughter Allison was born from, but that doesn't stop her from yielding to the attentions of the new school principal (Philips). Selena Cross (Lange) is raped by her stepfather Lucas (Kennedy) and becomes pregnant. Her mother commits suicide and eventually Selena, desperate, kills her rapist. At the following trial she will be acquitted. Great literary and therefore cinematic success that subsequently gave rise to a long and successful television series. In some ways he is an ancestor of Paths, but with more class.

title: Desperado: Avalanche at Devil's Ridge
actors: Alex McArthur, Alice Adair, Rod Steiger
