description: A cowboy, condemned for a murder he has not committed, gets an inspected possibility of saving the skin. Just he puts herself looking for a kidnapped girl. The girl is the daughter of the local boss (Steiger), but things are not easy as they seem. Not all Cormanians succeed with the hole. Compton had started with Angel Die Hard! (Corman production), now only makes television movies.

title: Wildcats
actors: Goldie Hawn, James Keach, Barney McGill, Tab Thacker, M. Emmet Walsh, Swoosie Kurtz
description: Molly's dad (Goldie Hawn) was a famous American football coach. Today Molly lives with her two children, she has a hateful ex-husband named Frank (James Keach), but her dream remains the same: to become a football team coach. Then finally, thanks to the interest of Darwell (Barney McGill), they give her a chance. His team will be that of a school in the most infamous area of ??the city. She is white, small and blonde, they are black, big, abusive and not all of them of a proper school age. It will be hard for Molly to gain respect and lead her boys to victory.

title: Fiori di zucca
actors: Marina Suma, Massimo Ciavarro, Manuela Gatti, Isa Barzizza, Enzo Decaro
description: Three thirty-year-olds meet, after years of being away, to pay homage to a friend who has passed away. All three are in an important moment in their life, always full of problems and this meeting becomes an opportunity to reflect on their past and future. Enzo has a wife who makes life hard for him; Sergio is a father boy who has decided not to get married; Pietro, a drug addict and homosexual, is forced to a life of hardship.
notes: From the series "pathetic generational balance" already seen a thousand times in the cinema. The presence of Massimo Ciavarro was embarrassing.

title: Amico mio... frega tu... che frego io
actors: Red Carter, Bud Randall, Sleepy Warren, Gordon Mitchell
description: A small scammer, always despised by his fellow citizens, manages to earn their respect by taking their defense (with punches) and protecting them from the cheating of a purebred malefactor. Forerunner of the most famous series played by Bud Spencer and Terence Hill.

title: I, the Jury
actors: Armand Assante, Barbara Carrera, Paul Sorvino, Laurene Landon
description: Politico-criminal organizations and a shady sex clinic are involved in the murder of a detective. Mike Hammer investigates. Modest thriller based on one of the most famous novels in the series written by Mickey Spillane. Screenplay by Larry Cohen.

title: Hotel
actors: James Brolin, Connie Sellecca, Shari Belafonte, Shea Farrell
description: A crime boss, unscrupulous, has set his greedy eyes on the luxury hotel in New Orleans, taking advantage of the owner's financial woes, wants to seize it at all costs.
notes: Based on a novel by Haley. The same interpreters gave life in the same years to a famous television series set this time in the St. Gregory of San Francisco. The series aired successfully on the ABC network, from 21 September 1983 to 6 August 1988. Among the stars James Brolin, current husband of Barbra Streisand.

title: Storia de fratelli e de cortelli
actors: Maurizio Arena, Guido Mannari, Tina Aumont, Ninetto Davoli, Franco Citti
description: In Rome in 1904 the widow Armida lives with her two sons, Nino and Gigi, both happily engaged. But the glamorous Mara Del Fiore enters Gigi's life and upsets her existence. The most conventional folklore for a dramatic comedy that points to the grotesque. De Sica is almost touching as a marshal.

title: Solo per te
actors: Beniamino Gigli, Maria Cebotari, Peter Bosse, Hans Moser
description: An opera singer is accused of killing the man who seduced her in the past and then abandoning her with a son. Shot in German and Italian versions, written by Lang's ex-wife (Thea von Harbou), a short film entirely dedicated to the performances of Beniamino Gigli.

title: Napoli... serenata calibro 9
actors: Mario Merola, Nick Jordan, Leopoldo Mastelloni, Ria De Simoni
description: Don Salvatore Savastano, cigarette smuggling boss, loses his wife and only child, killed by four masked robbers while the family, with all the relatives, is gathered at the restaurant for lunch after the boy's first communion. From that moment the man turns into a solitary executioner. Very classic Neapolitan "drama", between strong emotions, melodic songs and easy tears with a Merola, as usual, star performer.

title: Lola Montès
actors: Martine Carol, Peter Ustinov, Anton Walbrook, Ivan Desny
description: Under the awning of a circus, Lola Montès, Countess Maria Dolores de Lansfeld, relives her past by answering questions from the audience. From her escape from home with her mother's mistress to escaping a marriage imposed on her with an old man, to her collection of famous lovers. Then the descending parable, the somersault every night in the circus, the kiss of the hand granted for a dollar. The formal daring with which Ophüls built the film, disconcerted the audience at its release and the producers intervened heavily on the film. The film is however a jewel for the elaboration of the images, the use of color and the scenography, the true spiritual testament of the author.

title: Una romantica avventura
actors: Assia Noris, Gino Cervi, Leonardo Cortese, Ernesto Almirante
description: A lady who lives with her husband and daughter, when she confesses that she wants to run away with her boyfriend, disapproves. Then she thinks back to her life, to the young man who had accompanied her to a dance and with whom she had fallen in love; but he, knowing she was engaged, had disappeared. For twenty years her relations with her husband were cold, in regret of that brief adventure. Only now can she understand her husband's love. A tale of elegant suggestion, of gentle melancholy, with the scent of the past. Camerini tells with subtlety and Assia Noris is effective in the three roles of the protagonist, as a girl and a woman, and her daughter. The musical commentary is excellent. From a story by Thomas Hardy.

title: Singles
actors: Bridget Fonda, Campbell Scott, Kyra Sedgwick, Matt Dillon
description: In Seattle, the stories of some young people unfold: there is Linda, an ecologist, who is in love with Dunne, a serious designer (he is working on the subway layout). Janet, on the other hand, is in love with a musician, Cliff, who, however, loves her complex more than the girl, while she, in order to win him over, would also have her breasts remade. Linda has a car accident that causes her to have an abortion: she leaves for Alaska and on her return finds Dunne. Sentimentality film without feelings (and vice versa) "Singles" stages a small circle of couples, with precarious happiness, lost in the difficulty of living and looking for a balance.

title: Much Ado About Nothing
actors: Kenneth Branagh, Emma Thompson, Denzel Washington, Kate Beckinsale, Keanu Reeves, Robert Sean Leonard
description: Don Pedro, Claudio, Benedick and Don John return from the war and reach the villa of the rich Lonato. Here Benedick finds Beatrice, with whom he has always had a somewhat contradictory relationship. Claudio, on the other hand, is in love, reciprocated, with the splendid Hero. And while everyone is plotting to get Benedick and Beatrice to marry, Don John plots a shady deception so that Claudio and Hero leave each other (he insinuates doubts about the girl's virtue). The ending will be happy for everyone. Branagh shifts the action from Sicily to the Tuscan hills and the film acquires a crisp air of sweet ease, underlined by the good rhythm of the sequences and by the airy and sunny choreography.

title: Groundhog Day
actors: Bill Murray, Andie MacDowell, Chris Elliott, Stephen Tobolowsky
description: Phil, a television reporter, goes to Punxsutawney in Pennsylvania for "Groundhog Day", the day of the groundhog. Once the service is completed, he would like to leave immediately, but a snow storm blocks him. He takes up lodging in an inn and, in the morning, waking up he relives all the events of the day before. So also the following mornings. At first incredulous, then alarmed, then terrified, Phil turns the situation in his favor. Ramis (formerly Ghostbuster) made a very serious film disguising it as a comedy. Bill Murray (another former Ghostbuster) moves like in a video game, the stake of which is not only the hand of the beautiful princess, but the reconquest of time.

title: The Devil Doll
actors: Lionel Barrymore, Maureen O'Sullivan, Rafaela Ottiano
description: A banker who has been unjustly sentenced to many years in prison escapes. In his cell he had learned, from a mad scientist, the formula for making a substance that, when ingested, shrinks people. Disguised as an old lady, the banker opens a shop in Paris with his "toys". He actually uses them, after having hypnotized them, to take revenge on those who played a part in his sentence. One of these in effect confesses his guilt but, a raging fire in the shop also destroys the laboratory, nullifying the vengeful work. Very effective and still valid horror that manages to combine fantastic themes with scientific ones. Browing confirms himself as a master of the genre, assisted by Barrymore's luciferian lucidity.

title: Latin Lovers
actors: Lana Turner, Ricardo Montalban, John Lund, Louis Calhern
description: Nora, a young heiress, is tormented by the atrocious doubt that the suitors who aspire to her hand are actually aiming at her fortune. The heiress would like to marry Paul, a very wealthy industrialist, only on condition that he is romantic and resolute. Unfortunately for her Paul, following the advice of his psychoanalyst, tries in every way not to fall into Nora's clutches. When Paul leaves for Brazil with the polo team, Nora joins him, hoping to turn the tables around.
notes: Arid and simpleton sentimental film, albeit with a respectable cast. The satire of psychoanalysis was particularly successful.

title: The Prince of Tides
actors: Barbra Streisand, Nick Nolte, Blythe Danner, Kate Nelligan
description: Tom Wingo (Nolte), an English teacher and failed football team coach, arrives in New York. He must help Dr. Lowenstein (Streisand), the psychiatrist who treats her twin, to reconstruct the complex family events that led the woman, a brilliant poet, first to attempt suicide and then to take refuge in her own world of madness. . Little by little, in their conversations, that past emerges that has contributed to destroying even Tom's life. Despite their total cultural and character diversity, love is born between the two. Based on a 1987 best seller by Pat Conroy. Barbra Streisand is an inspired director and producer, as well as an interpreter. Among the other actors, in addition to Nolte and Jeroen Krabbe (in the role of the hateful husband), to report, in the role of the psychiatrist's son, the young Jason Gould, son of Streisand and Elliott Gould.

title: The Virginian
actors: Joel McCrea, Brian Donlevy, Sonny Tufts, Barbara Britton
description: A young breeder, known as Il Virginiano, falls in love with a girl who has been called to be a teacher in a western town. The girl at first escapes his care, but in the end she gives in, and agrees to take a ride on horseback with him. During the walk, the two meet a friend of the man who is burning a stolen calf. The Virginian thus has clear proof that his friend is Campos' accomplice, a bad guy who systemically robs the farmers in the area.
notes: Modest remake of Victor Fleming's 1929 film of the same name with Gary Cooper. Pure craft.

title: Private Parts
actors: Ann Ruymen, Lucille Benson, Laurie Main, John Ventantonio
description: A girl runs away from home and settles in her aunt's strange motel. Paul Bartel's directorial debut ("Class Struggle Scenes in Beverly Hills") is a curious black comedy in abundant, ironic, erotic sauce.

title: The Assassin
actors: Bridget Fonda, Gabriel Byrne, Dermot Mulroney, Anne Bancroft, Harvey Keitel
description: Maggie (Fonda) is a misfit, sentenced to death. Secret agent Bob offers her safety: in exchange she must become a killer for the dirtiest operations of counterintelligence. After months of hard training and some missions, falling in love with a photographer, Maggie asks to break away from the organization but receives a new assignment that seems to go wrong.
notes: This "Nikita" remake doesn't have the odd charm of Luc Besson's work, but it's still enjoyable. In the cast, Keitel is already a great "liquidator", one year before "Pulp Fiction".

title: Innocent Blood
actors: Anthony La Paglia, Anne Parillaud, Robert Loggia, Chazz Palminteri
description: Marie (Anne Parillaud) has decided she wants to eat Italian. Marie is a vampire woman and the Italians she would like to eat are the men of the mafia, among which the boss Sal Macelli (Robert Loggia) stands out. Marie is also pretty, with her glow-in-the-dark eyes, and Sal doesn't take long to invite her over for dinner. Result: Sal bleeds to death and turns himself into a vampire. At that point the troubles begin. Landis falters, gets lost behind unpromising projects (The prince seeks a wife) then hits a short film that is already a cult. Parillaud (Nikita) is really nice. Among the minor roles try to recognize Sam Raimi, Michael Ritchie and Dario Argento.

title: Honeymoon in Vegas
actors: James Caan, Nicolas Cage, Sarah Jessica Parker, Anne Bancroft
description: Jack actually doesn't want to gamble on his wife. Besides, Besty isn't even his wife, because he swore to his mother on his deathbed that he would never marry. It is Tommy who organizes the poker game in which Jack loses everything and it is always him who proposes to cancel the debt in exchange for a weekend with Betsy in Hawaii. Jack agrees and then repents, rushes to Hawaii, turns back, gets stuck in Salt Lake City with a pack of Elvis lookalikes ready to parachute. The serious problem with this film is that it came out after Indecent Proposal., Of which this is a more humorous version. The second is an unlikely casting. James Caan is no longer him, Sarah Jessica Parker is just colorless and Nicolas Cage looks dumb. The only notable thing about the film is a version of Are You Lonesome Tonight sung by Brian Ferry without desire and without passion.

title: Trois couleurs - Blanc
actors: Zbigniew Zamachowski, Julie Delpy, Janusz Gajos, Jerzy Stuhr
description: Karol, a Polish hairdresser in Paris, is forced by his French wife to accept a divorce due to his impotence. Back in Poland clandestinely with the help of an occasionally known compatriot, he gradually insinuates himself into the circle of speculators and enriches himself. To get back his wife, with whom he is always very much in love, he organizes his own fake death and has the woman incarcerated for murder.
notes: The fiercest of Kieslowski's three "colors", where "equality" seems to be realized in revenge, but instead sublimates itself into immense love precisely because it is "absurd" (or absurd precisely because it is immense). It is one of the exemplary films of the end of communism in Europe. Best Director Award in Berlin.

title: Abissinia
actors: Enrico Salimbeni, Mario Adorf, Grazyna Szapolowska, Milena Vukotic, Paki Valente
description: 25-year-old Antonio is fired from a large restaurant on the Romagna Riviera and beaten up after he tried to steal his salary from the cash register. He wakes up in another restaurant, squalid and without customers, in an area so peripheral that it is called Abyssinia. Various figures meet and rotate in a disturbing sketch of passions and dead-end lies.
notes: The director, here in his second film, has no shortage of ambitions. However, he lacks the means, economic and professional, to give adequate narrative body to an evanescent material almost to the point of abstraction. Interesting presence of Grazyna Szapolowska, the woman of the "Decalogue 6".

title: Le donne non vogliono più
actors: Pino Quartullo, Lucrezia Lante Della Rovere, Francesca Reggiani, Antonella Ponziani, Jane Alexander (II)
description: Luca would like a child with his partner Francesca, but she disagrees and therefore the couple falls apart. At a sperm bank, where he wants to leave his in the guarantee of being able to procreate, Luca meets two lesbians, Ricky and Claudia, who want a baby. Agreement made between the three and everything seems to be finally successful; but there is a surprise lurking around the corner.
notes: Pervicly, Quartullo insists on transposing the "content" comedies he writes (with the vulgarity that characterizes him) to the screen, and on interpreting them. He looks like a follower of the Actor's Studio out of time; on texts, silence is charity.

title: Posse
actors: Mario Van Peebles, Stephen Baldwin, Charles Lane, Billy Zane, Isaac Hayes, Pam Grier
description: Take a group of buffalo soldiers, black soldiers used by the US military in the 1894 war against Spain, add the infallible gunslinger Jesse Lee (Mario Van Peebles), the white Little J, plus a few deserters and you have a posse. That is a group of bastards determined to move to Freemanville despite the opposition of their former commander, Colonel Graham. Director and actor Van Peebles continues to disappoint. Here he wanted to make the first "all black" western in the history of cinema and instead he only made any white western, casually played by black actors.

title: Trespass
actors: Bill Paxton, Ice T, William Sadler, Ice Cube, Art Evans
description: Two white Arkansas firefighters, following directions obtained from a man who died in a fire, set out in search of hidden treasure in an old ruined factory in East St. Louis. Unfortunately, there the two are witnesses of a settling of scores: between black drug dealers. They are discovered and so the battle continues. The abandoned factory immediately becomes a sort of hellish universe.
notes: Hill doesn't always get it right, but when he takes the right path he is a bolt of war. Here he immediately gives up any socio-political premise, and launches into a breathtaking action film that restores the spirit of the times.

title: A Place for Annie
actors: Sissy Spacek, Joan Plowright, Mary-Louise Parker
description: Linda Marston abandons her daughter, who tested HIV positive, two days after giving birth and disappears from circulation. Susan Lansing (Sissy Spacek), one of the nurses at the hospital, takes care of little Annie. With her, to give her a lot of support, there is the elderly Mrs. Dorothy who lends herself to taking on the role of full-time babysitter. A year later, when things seem to have started for the best, suddenly, the birth mother reappears determined to get her daughter back.
notes: The whole film is based on the talent of Spacek and Plowright.

title: The Secretary
actors: Mel Harris, Sheila Kelly, Barry Bostwick, James Russo, Ray Baker
description: Ellen Foster has a dependent baby and an unemployed husband. When she finally finds a job she almost believes it. Furthermore, the work is pleasant, the pay is good and the chances of improving it are there. Everything too beautiful to be true and in fact there is something wrong: a colleague of hers involves her in a criminal plan from which she will struggle to go out. Andrew Lane (mortal passion, desperate motive) is one who has no imagination even in the titles.

title: Paper Tiger
actors: David Niven, Toshiro Mifune, Hardy Krüger, Irene Tsu, Ronald Fraser
description: A Japanese diplomat is about to move to England as an ambassador. In order to prepare his son Koichi for English culture and customs, he hires the self-styled Major Bradbury as tutor. He boasts of having performed phantom heroic deeds in battle, only to become really brave, when he is kidnapped by terrorists together with the son of the Japanese ambassador he is under guardianship. Comedy with few ideas, but with polite irony and nice humor, thanks above all to the contribution of a good David Niven.

title: Monpti
actors: Romy Schneider, Horst Buchholz, Mara Lane, Boy Gobert, Olive Moorefield
description: A young Hungarian painter lives in Paris of art and love. The woman he is in love with and who he believes is very rich is called Marie Claire. She doesn't dare tell him that she is as poor as he is. Then the painter discovers the truth and everything ends in tragedy. We are in full bohemia, but Romy is worth seeing a year before her twentieth birthday.

title: Navajo Joe
actors: Burt Reynolds, Nicoletta Machiavelli, Fernando Rey, Aldo Sambrell, Tanya Lopert, Franca Polesello, Lucia Modugno, Pierre Cressoy, Roberto Paoletti, Nino Imparato, Mario Lanfranchi (I)
description: A band of pale faces terrorizes Indian reservations, but Navajo Joe is ready for revenge. Disappointing Corbucci film with a fledgling away Burt Reynolds.

title: Confidential Agent
actors: Charles Boyer, Lauren Bacall, Katina Paxinou, Peter Lorre
description: A Spanish agent, in the period of the Civil War, leaves to go to England to buy weapons. The film is based on a Graham Greene novel.

title: Austerlitz
actors: Pierre Mondy, Vittorio De Sica, Martine Carol, Michel Simon
description: The somewhat fictionalized events of Napoleon between the breaking of the Amiens treaty and the victory of Austerlitz.
notes: The first part is a parade of stars in the most incredible roles (De Sica plays Pius VII). The second is better with the actual battle.

title: The Last of the Mohicans
actors: Daniel Day-Lewis, Madeleine Stowe, Russell Means, Wes Studi
description: Hawkeye is a young white man who grew up in the Mohican tribe, of which Chingachgook and his son Uncas are the last survivors. Major Heyward accompanies Henry Cora and Alice, daughters of Colonel Munro, to Fort. Their guide is Magua, a Huron who pretends to be faithful but is actually sold to the French.
notes: Yet another version of the classic novel by James Fenimore Cooper, directed with passionate and bombastic style, with a superman Day-Lewis and a beautiful Stowe.

title: Twilight's Last Gleaming
actors: Burt Lancaster, Richard Widmark, Charles Durning, Melvyn Douglas
description: We are in October 1981 and the President of the United States David T. Stevens is faced with a bad choice. Either let General Dell, who has barricaded himself on a missile base, blow up half the world or make some burning truths about the Vietnam War public. Stevens would eventually be willing to compromise, but the army hawks are lurking. Dark and disenchanted, an action film that overturns the premises of the beginning and plays with an extraordinary cast, while expressing an absolute pessimism about the future of America.

title: Bersaglio mobile
actors: Paola Pitagora, Ty Hardin, Vittorio Caprioli, Gordon Mitchell
description: Jason, king of escape, once again manages to escape during a transfer. Those who helped him, however, want a counterpart from him: he will have to recover a certain microfilm that interests too many people. Constructed with care, and even with some attempt at refinement, Corbucci's film gives way visibly in terms of interpretation.

title: Sono stato io
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Silvia Monti, Hiram Keller, Orazio Orlando
description: A poor window cleaner (Giannini) with a desire to become famous, accuses himself of a crime he did not commit, convinced that he can prove his innocence in the end. Giannini does almost everything by himself in this film, accompanied by a secluded direction by Lattuada. From a story by Luigi Malerba, with Piero Chiara among the performers.

title: La più bella del reame
actors: Carol Alt, Jon Finch, Sergio Vastano, Mirella Banti, Helmut Berger
description: In a hotel in Deauville, Marina Ripa di Meana (Alt) is typing a book about her life. With this pretext, we are witnessing an anthology of spicy episodes that come from his past: from a sleeping car to a swimming pool to a bathtub. The only emotional relationship that is not here is that with Jeremy (Finch), an elderly homosexual. The film is based on the book of the same name written by Marina herself. Or rather, it is based on two things: the presence of Carol Alt and the scandal that normally accompanies the name of Ripa di Meana ex Lante della Rovere. Critics generally lash out (with good reason) against this type of film, but in this case, the audience wasn't enthusiastic either.

title: The World of Don Camillo
actors: Terence Hill, Colin Blakely, Mimsy Farmer, Andy Luotto
description: There is no good blood between don Camillo and Peppone. The match between the two football teams of the country: the Angels and the Devils ends 3 to 2 for the Devils. Don Camillo, who discovered too late that the referee was bought by Peppone, takes revenge by cheating at the broom tournament. All this attracts the attention of the ecclesiastical hierarchies on him and his "ease". Don Camillo is transferred to a remote parish. At the station there is no one to greet him (so the mayor wanted). All the parishioners are, in great secrecy, at the next station. Peppone and his companions are in the next one.
notes: For his first film as a director, Terence Hill fished out the character of Don Camillo with an eye on the American market. The painting of modernity does not save the film from a decided mediocrity. In the football match it is possible to recognize Boninsegna, Ancelotti, Pruzzo and Spinosi among the players.

title: Lassiter
actors: Tom Selleck, Jane Seymour, Lauren Hutton, Bob Hoskins
description: On the eve of the Second World War Nik Lassiter, a well-known gentleman thief, is charged (with a little blackmail) by the British counter-intelligence to steal the diamonds kept in the safe of the German command. Nik manages to ingratiate himself with Kari, a charming German spy, thanks to which ...
notes: Pleasant comedy on the border between yellow-pink and war.

title: Amore Formula 2
actors: Mal, Giacomo Agostini, Lino Banfi, Annabella Incontrera, Tery Hare, Gérard Herter, Elio Pandolfi
description: Paul and Giorgio are pilots and best friends. Following an accident, Giorgio is seriously injured, but continues to run, while Paul decides to abandon the tracks and quickly becomes a successful singer. The paths diverge, but the friendship does not loosen, until the beautiful and chatty Lorelei enters the scene, with whom they both fall in love and become bitter rivals. Women and engines seasoned with a bit of cloying songs: built around the figure of Mal (fresh from successes as singer of the Primitives) and the motorcycling champion Agostini, the film relies entirely on the elementary recipe, without paying too much attention to the rest. And it shows.

title: La professoressa di scienze naturali
actors: Lilli Carati, Michele Gammino, Alvaro Vitali, Giacomo Rizzo
description: To replace the seasoned high school science teacher, the pharmacist from a Sicilian town suggests an attractive recent graduate who wreaks havoc not only among the students, but also among their parents. It is the pharmacist's son, Andrea, who conquers the girl.
notes: The beautiful Lilli Carati in a classic sexy comedy pulled away with two ideas and set in a post-Brancati and pre-Malèna Sicily (although in reality many scenes were shot in Ischia).

title: Cool Hand Luke
actors: Paul Newman, George Kennedy, J.D. Cannon, Harry Dean Stanton
description: Nick Jackson (Newman) is not a real criminal but a rebel who does not bow to anyone. More than anything else he has an intractable character and that is also why he gets two years in a labor camp. Nicknamed "cold hand" by other prisoners for his imperturbability, he has a knack for getting into trouble. First he clashes with his own comrades in an endless fist fight, then with the prison guards as he tries to escape. The first escape ends badly and so does the second. Rosenberg is not a master of cinema and if this film is a jewel it is due to a Paul Newman in great shape, then to the script by Frank Pierson, to the precious photography by Conrad Hall and finally to the contribution of George Kennedy who for this film earned the Oscar for Best Supporting Actor.

title: Under Siege
actors: Tommy Lee Jones, Steven Seagal, Erika Eleniak, Gary Busey
description: A helicopter with playmate Jordan Tate and William Strannix's band is about to land on the battleship "Missouri". The occasion is the commander's birthday party, but it's an excuse. With the help of Commander Krill, in fact, Strannix takes possession of the "Missouri" and blackmails the President of the United States with the threat of nuclear devices the ship is armed with. The plan seems to work perfectly were it not for the presence of chef Casey (Seagal). Davis, ("The Fugitive"), to make a tense and convincing action film like this one, starring that granite wall by Steven Seagal is forced to make real flips.

title: I quattro dell'Ave Maria
actors: Eli Wallach, Bud Spencer, Terence Hill, Kevin McCarthy, Brock Peters, Steffen Zacharias
description: Cacopoulos is now an old bandit who, due to the betrayal of his cronies, is serving a long prison sentence. A proposal is made to him to be able to end his stay in prison: he must find Cat and Hutch, two robbers, and recover the money that the two criminals have stolen from a bank. Finding them, he relieves them of the booty which he begins to distribute to the poor. Second film by the couple Terence Hill-Bud Spencer, one year before the resounding success of the Trinity cycle, when the comic and manesque formula was not yet finalized; it stands out for its epic and light-hearted tone, although there are some delays mainly due to the script by Colizzi himself.

title: Anche nel West c'era una volta Dio
actors: Richard Harrison, Gilbert Roland, Enio Girolami
description: Bandit Butch's men are on the trail of Bob Ford who owns a treasure map. The man manages to hide it in the ceiling of his room. Not finding it, the thugs set fire to Pink's inn where Bob has taken refuge. It is the little Tommy who discovers it and, together with a stranger, who hires a guide, Chasquito, in Pink and Ceralbo, sets out in search of the treasure. The stranger turns out to be a priest, on the trail of the gold stolen from his mission: after a few failed attempts to take possession of it, by both Butch and Ceralbo, the gold returns to the mission. Distantly inspired by the "Treasure Island", an Italian western that adds nothing to what was already known about the genre, at least in its most obvious forms: banality of the story and poor interpretation.

title: La matriarca
actors: Catherine Spaak, Jean-Louis Trintignant, Gigi Proietti, Luigi Pistilli, Paolo Stoppa, Renzo Montagnani
description: Widowed while still young, the beautiful Margherita, known as Mimmi, discovers that her deceased husband was an unrepentant Don Juan. Shocked by this revelation, the woman wants to take revenge and finds nothing better than to beat him on her own ground, giving herself to several men. One of these, a doctor, falls in love with her. Mimmi marries him, but even after the wedding she continues in her ... revenge. Upon its release, the film was promoted as an attempt to tell a story on the woman's side. In reality, the story does not go beyond the farce with excellent actors.

title: La lupa
actors: Kerima, May Britt, Ettore Manni, Mario Passante, Giovanna Ralli
description: A woman who lives in a small town is nicknamed the "Lupa" for her unscrupulous attitudes. Many men fall in love with her but it is Nanni, a soldier who came to town on the feast day of Sant'Agata, who becomes her lover. The man also knows Maricchia, the woman's daughter, who arouses in him a feeling of sincere love, among other things reciprocated: the two get married. The "Lupa" tries in vain to divide them. Rereading Verga's dark drama, Lattuada updates it and moves it to post-war Lucania, keeping above all the melodramatic aspects of the novel.

title: Gladiator
actors: James Marshall, Cuba Gooding jr., Brian Dennehy, Cara Bono
description: Tommy Riley (Marshall), who has recently moved to a seedy neighborhood, finds himself grappling with a reality of youthful violence completely unknown to him. A former high school boxing champion, he is spotted during a street fist fight by an organizer of illegal boxing matches. To pay off the debts of his father, a gambler and alcoholic, Tommy accepts. Film of good feelings, starring one of the actors of Twin Peaks. Not exciting.

title: Splendor
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Massimo Troisi, Marina Vlady, Paolo Panelli
description: Jordan, owner of a movie theater in Arpino, is forced to close it due to lack of spectators and to sell the place that will become a supermarket. The man thinks about his life, all linked to that room, while his projectionist, a "fanatic" of cinema, takes refuge in a fictitious way populated by stars of the screen. And the dream of a last miracle is triggered on the reality of the demolition. Contemporary to Tornatore's Nuovo cinema Paradiso, Scola's film is also inspired by the crisis of cinema in Italy, but in a more muddled way, much less "poetic", substantially unsuccessful in the global relationship between intentions and results.

title: The Battle of the Sexes
actors: Peter Sellers, Constance Cummings, Robert Morley, Jameson Clark
description: An American woman manager, fanatically efficient, upsets the blissful routine of a Scottish tweed company. A chief accountant thinks about killing her to solve all the problems at the source. It is not a masterpiece but it is fun, and the protagonist is Peter Sellers.

title: Roadie
actors: Meat Loaf, Kaki Hunter, Art Carney, Deborah Harry, Alice Cooper
description: Worthy scion of a peasant family of geniuses and nutcases, for love Travis becomes a technical handyman of a rock band, goes to New York and helps a failed flying saucer. Lots of music amidst handfuls of surreal humor, in a film starring some of the most imaginative rock stars between the 70s and 80s.

title: Giovanni Falcone
actors: Michele Placido, Anna Bonaiuto, Giancarlo Giannini, Massimo Bonetti, Ivana Monti
description: Collaborator of Judge Chinnici, Falcone hypothesizes a "third level" of mafia organizations, a meeting place and connivance between crime and politics. His action, in close working relationship and friendship with Cassarà and Borsellino, bears excellent results thanks also to the contribution of the testimonies of repentants such as Buscetta. Having become too dangerous for the powerful, he is transferred, then assassinated in Capaci. Unfortunately, a disappointing film, plagued by the rhetoric that is perhaps inevitable when shooting close to an emotional wave. Placido is not very in tune with the character. Excellent and measured instead, in the role of Borsellino, Giancarlo Giannini.

title: Tennessee Johnson
actors: Van Heflin, Lionel Barrymore, Ruth Hussey, Marjorie Main
description: Reconstruction of the ascent to the White House of Democratic President Andrew "Tennessee" Johnson (Van Heflin), and the subsequent conflicts between him and the then Republican majority Congress. Well thought out historical drama and equally well performed. At the management a William Dieterle in great shape and, as always, generously committed to democratic-progressive issues. Coated Mgm production of the golden years.

title: Duchess of Idaho
actors: Esther Williams, Van Johnson, John Lund, Paula Raymond
description: Romantic intrigues and misunderstandings at a beauty pageant. Pleasant comedy with Esther Williams, guests some stars of the musical.

title: The Wild and the Innocent
actors: Audie Murphy, Joanne Dru, Gilbert Roland, Sandra Dee
description: Tommy, a young and rough trapper, is torn between a simple girl like himself and a citizen of easy virtue, Western in style, with some comedy hints.

title: La fin du jour
actors: Madeleine Ozeray, Michel Simon, Louis Jouvet
description: Melancholy, resentment and madness, in a retirement home for actors where the arrival of the seducer Saint-Clair wreaks havoc. Desperate reflection on the drift and fragility of old age and on the vanity of the acting profession, conducted by Julien Duvivier with impeccable style and an almost perfect cast.

title: Blindsided
actors: Jeff Fahey, Mia Sara, Ben Gazzara, Rudy Ramos
description: A former policeman, turned burglar, gets caught during a drug operation and temporarily loses his sight. So he goes to a luxury seaside resort to recover and there he meets a mysterious and fascinating woman. He doesn't know that the girl is a gangster's woman, and he obviously doesn't know what she looks like. When he regains his sight he starts looking for it and thus his troubles begin. With that good-girl face, Mia Sara isn't bad either, but she's totally off the mark in the role of the dark lady. Fahey works best in that of the corrupt cop.

title: Snowbound: The Jim and Jennifer Stolpa Story
actors: Neil Patrick Harris, Kelli Williams, Susan Clark, Alexander Ahnert
description: Jim and Jennifer Stolpa, a happy young married couple, live happily with their five-month-old son, Clayton. Happy at least until the day they are caught in the car by a terrible snowstorm during a trip. The car goes off the road and at that point it seems difficult for anyone to come and rescue them, also because they were trapped in a ditch, submerged in snow. But the Stolpas do not lose heart and decide to split up in an attempt to save at least their little one. Jim manages to get out of the cockpit and sets off in search of help trying to reach the town, which is many kilometers away. The woman with the child tries to adapt the car to shelter and survive the cold. The story is true and this seems to justify the fact that someone has thought of making a film, which is not very compelling. In spite of everything, Susan Clark, who was the mother of little Webster in the homonymous series of TV series, gets along fairly well, as well as Michael Gross (starring in the Keaton House). The result, however, is very disappointing.

title: Wittgenstein
actors: Karl Johnson, Tilda Swinton, Michael Gough, John Quentin, Clancy Chassay
description: Ludwig Wittgenstein was born in Vienna at the end of the last century from a rich family. The fact remains that at some point he decides to give his share of the inheritance to charity and then goes to Switzerland to be an elementary teacher. So that he goes to teach philosophy at Cambridge, managing to get in the way of everyone because of his surly temper and his incomprehensible theories. Innovative and genial biopic, shot in theatrical style with curtains on a black background, disrupting the temporal rules and attempting a sort of stylistic visualization of the theories of the second Wittgenstein, that of the theories of linguistic games. Jarman's film, after all, is too.

title: Pet Sematary
actors: Dale Midkiff, Fred Gwynne, Denise Crosby, Michael Lombard, Blaze Berdahl, Miko Hughes, Brad Greenquist, Stephen King
description: The new doctor, Louis Creed, has arrived in a small town in Maine. His wife, Rachel, and two children, Ellie and Gage, also move in with him. Near their house there is an ancient Indian cemetery which has the characteristic of transforming the corpses that are buried there into zombies. This happens to Curch, Ellie's kitten, and to little Gage, who is run over by a truck right on the road in front of the house. The first sequence of the truck accident shot pretty well. The novel from which the film is based bears the signature of Stephen King, also author of the screenplay. The name is a guarantee, but this time the result is rather disappointing.

title: Passenger 57
actors: Wesley Snipes, Bruce Payne, Tom Sizemore, Robert Hooks
description: John Cutter was a counterterrorism star until he witnessed his wife's death in a robbery. Today Cutter is flying to Los Angeles where he will work as head of security for an airline. On the same flight there is also the terrorist Charles Rane, duly handcuffed and escorted by a bevy of agents. Cutter starts his work one day earlier.
notes: Wesley Snipes is the star, but if the script had been less obvious the result would have been better.

title: La tendre ennemie
actors: Simone Berriau, Catherine Fonteney, Georges Vitray, Marc Valbel
description: During the engagement dinner of Mrs. Dupont's daughter, with a man she does not love, the shadows of the husband and the lady's lover appear, fraternizing and telling each other their adventures. Then, here is a third shadow, that of a young man who killed himself for his opposed love for the same woman. A comedy by André-Paul Antoine that Ophüls himself had already staged in the theater, full of "gags" in the silent film genre; a comic, ironic, uncertain dialogue of the dead. As in life, Ophüls himself says.

title: Il Gattopardo
actors: Burt Lancaster, Claudia Cardinale, Alain Delon, Romolo Valli, Paolo Stoppa, Rina Morelli, Serge Reggiani, Ida Galli, Terence Hill, Lucilla Morlacchi, Giuliano Gemma, Maurizio Merli, Ottavia Piccolo, Ivo Garrani
description: In 1860, Garibaldi landed in Sicily and Prince Fabrizio Salina witnessed - more as a witness than as a protagonist - the ensuing changes. Despite the threat of war, the prince and his family move to the country residence, in Donnafugata, where his favorite nephew, Tancredi, falls in love with Angelica, the mayor's daughter, an exponent of the new and rapacious bourgeoisie. Tancredi also participates in the Garibaldi's enterprise and stands out in the battle of Palermo. The union of Angelica and Tancredi, a living symbol of the passage of power between the landowner nobility and the merchant bourgeoisie, is made official during a great ball held in the sumptuous princely residence ...
notes: From the well-known novel by Giuseppe Tomasi di Lampedusa, a masterpiece of spectacular historical reconstruction and subtle psychological introspection. Great interpreters led by a masterly direction in a sumptuous and fascinating setting. Visconti put, as always, an obsessive care in the details of the scenography and costumes. An extremely expensive although entirely Italian production, the film barely repaid the costs despite the great success it obtained in Italy and abroad and the Palme d'Or achieved in Cannes.

title: My Blue Heaven
actors: Steve Martin, Rick Moranis, Joan Cusack, Melanie Myron
description: The Italian-American mobster Vinnie Antonelli must testify in two trials against his former cronies. To protect him, the FBI transfers him under a false name to the quiet town of Fryburg and entrusts him to shy agent Barney Coopersmith. By combination, the two men are planted almost simultaneously by their respective wives and thus end up, after some initial friction, to become friends ...
notes: Variant of the situation so often narrated in the cinema of the protection of a witness, here twisted in a farcical key, with punctual digs also against the myth of the "American dream". The Martin-Moranis pair always runs at full throttle.

title: The Catholics
actors: Trevor Howard, Martin Sheen, Cyril Cusack
description: In a small community of Irish monks, in contravention of the conciliar rules, Mass is celebrated in Latin and the faithful confess individually. A young priest, sent by the Vatican to put an end to this anomaly, receives an invitation from the prior father to share the life of the community before discussing its orthodoxy. Are the monks really narrow-minded traditionalists or do they live an intense and genuine faith that can do without "modernist" formulas? The theme of this TV film is unusual, but the reasons for friction between the new and the old, represented respectively by the prior and the envoy from Rome, are represented too superficially. However, the interpreters, especially Trevor Howard, were sober and effective.

title: Blind Side
actors: Rutger Hauer, Rebecca De Mornay, Ron Silver
description: A quiet American couple, Lynn and Doug, driving through the Mexican town of San Felipe, hit a staggering man. The man dies and it is revealed that he was a policeman. The two decide it is best for them to escape and cross the border. It is at this point that, having reached their home, they are contacted by Shell, who claims to have witnessed the accident ...
notes: Thriller attempt that fails miserably, both for the mediocre construction of the story, and for the sloppy narrative management of the direction. More than tension, after the first half hour just discreet, the film conveys a lot of involuntary comedy.

title: La crise
actors: Vincent Lindon, Patrick Timsit, Zabou, Maria Pacome
description: Victor, a brilliant Parisian lawyer, experiences a double set of fortunes on the same day: he is left by his wife and fired from the legal department where he works. None of his friends help him, taken as they are by their many problems. Only a tramp, Michou, a bit like a friend and a bit like a freeloader, sticks to his ribs.
notes: Coline Serreau's ambitious intention to compile the "yellow pages" of the malaise of our times holds true in the first part of the film but gets tangled up in the second.

title: La corsa dell'innocente
actors: Manuel Colao, Federico Pacifici, Sal Borgese, Lucio Zagaria, Francesca Neri, Jacques Perrin
description: Twelve-year-old Vito's family is exterminated in an ambush the day after his father killed two shepherds. The child then takes refuge with a brother, in the mountains, but here he discovers that a peer of his age, Simone, who died of hardship, has been held hostage. Vito picks up the small victim's backpack and, facing endless risks and vicissitudes, runs away to reach Simone's distant family. The first film by the young Carlei, the film describes a fairly plausible situation, but using an excessively effective narrative, with overly complacent calligraphic elegance. Still interesting.

title: Due strani papà
actors: Pippo Franco, Franco Califano, Viola Valentino, Piera Bassino
description: Alberto and Franco, two thugs, who share the rooms of a long-uninhabited children's home, find an abandoned black child. The two, who are living with the earnings of the bets, at first do not feel like keeping him, but slowly they end up fond of him. When the child turns six, the school priest realizes the situation and advises them to adopt him. But the undertaking will not be easy.
notes: It would like to be a parody, but it doesn't even manage to have the thickness of a joke, even if Pippo Franco and Franco Califano do their best not to disfigure. After all, there is little to expect from Mariano Laurenti.

title: Sans sommation
actors: Maurice Ronet, Mario Adorf, Bruno Cremer, Anny Duperey
description: Back in Paris, a veteran from Indochina is charged with killing an undisciplined "colleague" who knows too much.

title: Sud
actors: Silvio Orlando, Francesca Neri, Gigio Alberti, Antonio Catania, Claudio Bisio
description: In a small village in southern Italy, on the eve of the elections, a ballot paper disappeared from the polling station: it will be the one that will be used, "marked" and passed from hand to hand, to elect the Honorable Cannavacciuolo, local boss in the smell of crime . Suddenly four young men break into the seat and, with fake weapons (but one of them has a real gun instead), order the bystanders to come out and occupy the seat by barricading themselves inside it. But the unexpected is lurking: at the moment of the raid, Lucia, the honorable's daughter, and a friend of his were trapped in the courtroom. Salvatores tries the card of a more committed cinema. But the game succeeds in half: "South" is in fact weak in the complaint and tied to some clichés. From his he has an excellent editing, photography and rap music of 99Posse, as well as good intentions.

title: Mais où est donc passée la 7ème compagnie?
actors: Aldo Maccione, Jean Lefebvre, Pierre Mondy, Pierre Tornade
description: A French patrol, during the Second World War, remains cut off and is surrounded by German troops. A group of stragglers manages to free her. Nice comedy that combines a light-hearted reconstruction of the war events, also through well-chosen characterizations, with his good-natured satire. Huge success in France, where it had two sequels.

title: Double Negative
actors: Michael Sarrazin, Susan Clark, Anthony Perkins, Howard Duff
description: Michael Taylor is a photojournalist who was subjected to a mock execution by a group of terrorists. Upon returning home, he discovers that his wife has been killed. No wonder he begins to get caught up in guilt complexes and sudden bouts of amnesia. Also because the night of the murder he was with Paula, his mistress. The way to the truth will be long and bloody. Canadian thriller, based on a McDonald's novel, rather complicated and inconclusive.

title: Le mani sulla città
actors: Rod Steiger, Salvo Randone, Guido Alberti, Angelo D'Alessandro
description: A Neapolitan city councilor, Eduardo Nottola (militant of a right-wing party) and building developer is forced to retire from political life due to the collapse of a building he built. After changing party (he moves to the center) he manages to get himself elected again and to start a gigantic speculative project.
notes: The film, scripted by Rosi himself with the collaboration of Raffaele La Capria, Enzo Provenzale and Enzo Forcella, won the Golden Lion at the Venice Film Festival, arousing much controversy. It remains one of the best examples of Italian political cinema, exciting and non-rhetorical, clear but not excessively schematic.

title: Dark Victory
actors: Bette Davis, George Brent, Geraldine Fitzgerald, Humphrey Bogart
description: Giulia, a young and carefree heiress, would have everything to be happy. Unfortunately, she discovers that she has a brain tumor which inexorably condemns her. They operate her, but the intervention only serves to prolong her life a little. The surgeon who performed the surgery falls in love with her, but she, suspecting that he is not sincere, does not want to marry him. Then, won over by his affection, she changes her mind.
notes: Rightly praised, it is one of Davis' most intense interpretations, grappling (like the whole film) with a subject that was taboo for cinema at the time.

title: Sette note in nero
actors: Jennifer O'Neill, Marc Porel, Jenny Tamburi, Gabriele Ferzetti, Gianni Garko
description: Ever since she was a child, Virginia has had visions: for example, she has foreseen the suicide of her mother. Now, newly married to Francesco Ducci, she "sees" the murder of a woman walled up in her husband's villa. He ends up first in prison then, cleared, he goes out, but the murder planned by Virginia has yet to happen ... Skilful, and partly successful, attempt to transfuse scientific elements into a paradoxical horror story.

title: Kiss kiss... bang bang
actors: Giuliano Gemma, George Martin, Lorella De Luca, Nieves Navarro
description: Someone managed to frame secret agent Kirk Warren (Gemma), who ended up in jail on high treason charges. And this can cost him his life. Unable to exonerate him, his superiors decide to exploit the situation and offer him a sort of pact: if Warren manages to steal a precious secret formula before it falls into the hands of the dangerous Mister X, his accusations will undergo a revision. Kirk uses all his skills and brilliantly fulfills the task entrusted to him, even going so far as to unmask the mysterious individual. Nice and light-hearted example of a spy film that winks at James Bond between English humor and Roman spirit.

title: The Sand Pebbles
actors: Steve McQueen, Richard Attenborough, Candice Bergen, Marayat Andrienne
description: The American gunboat San Pablo is anchored on the banks of the Yang-Tze. It is 1926: Chinese nationalists and communists are fighting against Western colonialism. Holman antagonizes the ship's Chinese personnel and is then wrongly found guilty of the death of a woman. Disgusted by the general situation, Holman wants to desert, but ends up dying as a hero defending the local mission.
notes: Three-hour colossal handled with confident hand and beautiful photography by Robert Wise. There is no shortage of spectacular sequences. The work of the interpreters is of good quality.

title: Portrait in Black
actors: Lana Turner, Anthony Quinn, Lloyd Nolan, Sandra Dee, Virginia Grey, John Saxon, Richard Basehart
description: Sheila, wife of the well-known shipowner Cabot, has David, the family doctor, for her lover. The two kill Cabot, but his secretary, Mason, secretly in love with the woman, suspects what the terrible truth is. Some anonymous letters, however, convince David to eliminate him; the two evil lovers feel safe at this point. Now it is Cathy, however, Cabot's daughter, who feeds suspicions that she recklessly reveals to David. Michael Gordon is considered by critics to be a good craftsman; victim of McCarthyism, he did not find work in Hollywood for about ten years; then he shot this honest thriller.

title: Man Trouble
actors: Jack Nicholson, Ellen Barkin, Beverly D'Angelo, Harry Dean Stanton
description: Joan is an opera singer back from a failed marriage and haunted by a mysterious and violent "suitor". He is a guest in the villa of his sister Hattie, who has written a book about her former lover: a mob boss who now tries to prevent it from being published in every way. Joan, after yet another attack, rents a guard dog trained by a certain Henry; the latter, who is said to be in a marriage crisis, falls in love with the singer. Nicholson and Rafelson are old accomplices since the days of Five Easy Pieces: their collaboration, however, at the time gave much tastier fruits than this unsurprising swing between drama and comedy.

title: El verdugo
actors: Nino Manfredi, Emma Penella, Guido Alberti, José Isbert
description: José Luis is a quiet young man in charge of the funeral home. His trouble is that he married the hangman's daughter; to get an apartment assignment, he must agree to succeed his father-in-law who is retiring. He hopes he will never have to exercise but, after a period of actual tranquility, the baptism of the gallows arrives, to which he will be dragged, recalcitrant, by his energetic father-in-law. Powerful black humor against Franco's mephitic society in the screenplay by Rafael Azcona and Ennio Flaiano. Nino Manfredi is perfect in the role of the harmless protagonist who the banal necessities of life transform into a legal murderer. Presented in Venice, the film provoked violent reactions at home and was released censored.

title: Dona Flor e seus dois maridos
actors: Sonia Braga, José Wilker, Mauro Mendonça, Dinorah Brillanti
description: Donna Flor, a young man from a good family, marries Vadinho, a reckless man who loves her in his own way but has all the canonical defects of a bad husband: he plays (and loses), drinks and goes to women. On the death of Vadinho, struck down by his addictions, the woman remarries a boring and respectable gentleman, but then she cannot resist the nostalgia of her first and most fiery companion and finds a way to "resuscitate" him. Transposition on film of the novel of the same name by Jorge Amado which only partially restores its surreal charm and cultural depth to definitely veer towards farce, especially in the second part. However, the film is well directed and entertaining.

title: Die Grosse Ekstase des Bildschnitzers Steiner
actors: Walter Steiner
description: The film is a sort of biographical reportage shot by Herzog over the course of a season following the Austrian Walter Steiner: "the greatest ski jumper that ever existed". Steiner, a valley craftsman who works as a wood carver, is followed during training and especially during competitions. Among these the most important is the Planica race in Yugoslavia where Steiner beats the world record, but during which he seriously injures himself due to a fall. Spectacular in slow motion shooting, it reaches moments of rarefaction thanks also to the music of the Popol Vuh which contribute to the suspension of time and underline the loneliness of the jumper.

title: I cannibali
actors: Britt Ekland, Pierre Clementi, Delia Boccardo, Tomas Milian
description: The streets of the city are littered with corpses. The city for which Antigone wanders desperately is large and modern. The corpses are those of the rebels and must remain there, in the open air, by order of the city authorities, as a warning to discourage other insurrections. Only Antigone seems to notice the absurdity of the situation and begins to bury the corpses. She too will be killed. Modern and somewhat simplistic version of Sophocles' tragedy. The bourgeois Antigone discovers the inhumanity of power and rebels. In short, a typical film of its time. The sequences of the streets of Milan full of corpses, however, retain their own suggestion.

title: Il barbiere di Siviglia
actors: Tito Gobbi, Ferruccio Tagliavini, Nelly Corradi, Vito De Taranto
description: Everyone wants Rosina. Her guardian Don Bartolo wants her to get hold of the dowry that he himself has already partly squandered. Count d'Almaviva also wants her who, falling madly in love with her, does not hesitate to hire Figaro and organize the kidnapping of the girl with him. The kidnapping ends badly, but the count's choice of the astute Figaro was a good one, because it is he who solves the situation. First example of that strand of the film-opera that raged until the 1950s, often at the hands of Costa himself. In the cast we find Tito Gobbi and Ferruccio Tagliavini, singing celebrities of the time.

title: I ragazzi del juke box
actors: Tony Dallara, Betty Curtis, Fred Buscaglione, Mario Carotenuto, Adriano Celentano
description: Between the commendator Cesari, owner of a record company, and his daughter Giulia there is an irremediable disagreement as the first fiercely supports the superiority of the Italian-style melodic song, the second that of the modern song. Cesari, who is determined to remove from his company all those who do not think like him, promotes the foundation of a fan club in Appio Claudio, a champion of melodic music.
notes: The subject is seen and seen, but the songs are beautiful and represent an important sociological document. Appio Claudio is an obvious parody of Claudio Villa, the undisputed "reuccio" of the song.

title: Used Cars
actors: Kurt Russell, Jack Warden, Gerrit Graham, Frank McRae
description: The rivalry between used car dealers leads to spectacular strategies to win over potential customers. Fun and caustic.

title: Personals
actors: Jennifer O'Neill, Stephanie Zimbalist, Robin Thomas
description: A woman (Jennifer O'Neill), who by day is apparently as harmless as she is clumsy librarian, at night becomes a charming and mysterious dark lady who uses newspaper personal ads to get dates. The trouble is that the girl has the habit of killing the unfortunate knights, after having seduced them. A married reporter (Robin Thomas) takes care of the case, but he too ends up like the others. It will be his widow (Stephanie Zimbalist) to take matters in hand by continuing the investigation of her husband and engaging in a fight to the death with the charming maniac. Although the theme is not new (Bob Rafelson had already worked on it in 1987 with the praiseworthy "The Black Widow"), this film benefits from a good ability to keep the tension high, especially towards the end.

title: Un esercito di 5 uomini
actors: Peter Graves, Bud Spencer, Nino Castelnuovo, James Daly, Tetsuro Tamba, Claudio Gora, Carlo Alighiero
description: An American outlaw, who lives in Mexico and calls himself "the Dutchman", instructs the young Luis to find three cronies to organize a coup. The members of the quintet arrive in a country where they save Esteban, the leader of the revolutionaries, from being shot. Esteban "enlists" them immediately to make them carry out a very audacious blow: rob the gold, transported by an army train, with which to finance the purchase of weapons for the revolutionaries. The five accept but fall prey to the military.
notes: In the first place it is a classic adventure film, banal and obvious but it is interesting to note the attempt to mix different genres.

title: Open Fire
actors: Jeff Wincott, Patrick Kilpatrick, Mimi Craven, Steph Duvall
description: Life in the American metropolises is getting more difficult every day as crime increases. Citizens just have to arm themselves and develop new self-defense techniques. Alec, whose colleague they killed, decides to go to the bottom and find out the killers. So he asks for help from a group of ex-comrades, experts in martial arts, with whom he finds himself having to face a band of aggressive terrorists. Yet another variant on a trite subject, based on "do-it-yourself" executioners.

title: Il ragazzo dal kimono d'oro
actors: Kim Rossi Stuart, Jared Martin, Janet Agren, Ken Watanabe
description: A young boy sets out in search of his missing father in the Philippines. However, he must learn the art of karate from an old master to be able to defeat a powerful band of thugs. Shameless Italian remake of Karate Kid.

title: I Wake Up Screaming
actors: Betty Grable, Victor Mature, Carole Landis, Laird Gregar
description: An actress is killed. The businessman, suspected, escapes from prison and discovers the real killer. Discreet detective with a good cast.

title: Countdown
actors: James Caan, Robert Duvall, Barbara Baxley, Joanna Moore
description: The Soviets prepare to be the first to land on the moon, the Americans try to beat them on time. Science fiction that makes you think, directed by Altman two years before the real Armostrong & C.

title: Nosferatu a Venezia
actors: Klaus Kinski, Barbara De Rossi, Christopher Plummer, Donald Pleasence, Yorgo Voyagis, Anne Knecht, Elvire Audray, Clara Colosimo
description: A Venetian nobleman summons an expert to destroy the vampire who has slept in the basement of her palace for centuries. Patinated, emphatic mess with Klaus Kinski.

title: Assault on Precinct 13
actors: Austin Stoker, Darwin Joston, Laurie Zimmer, Martin West
description: In Los Angeles, an isolated police station is stormed by a bloodthirsty gang. Suspense, irony and action alternate in a powerful and perfect mechanism. A masterpiece written (under the pseudonym of John T. Chance, in homage to a character from Hawks' "Un d'ollaro d'onore", of which the film is an ideal remake) set to music and directed by John Carpenter.

title: Le cercle rouge
actors: Alain Delon, Bourvil, Yves Montand, François Périer, Gian Maria Volonté
description: A young offender, Corey, just released from prison takes revenge for a wrong he suffered by robbing a former accomplice and killing the hitmen that the latter has chased him. On the same day, an Italian criminal, Genco, escapes the surveillance of the escort policeman, during the transfer from Marseille to Paris. The two criminals accidentally end up meeting and decide to team up to rob a jewelry store in Place Vendôme, Paris. The two turn to a specialist. Penultimate film by Melville, it stands out for its dry style and an almost documentary style. It was the swan song for Bourvil.

title: No Small Affair
actors: Jon Cryer, Demi Moore, George Wendt, Peter Frechette
description: Sixteen falls in love with an unemployed twenty-three year old rocker, with a gimmick makes her a star and she notices him. Sentimental fable shot by Schatzberg with the usual measure.

title: Cast a Giant Shadow
actors: Kirk Douglas, Angie Dickinson, Senta Berger, Frank Sinatra, John Wayne, Yul Brynner
description: 1948; American Colonel David Marcus is recruited as a consultant for the constitution of the army of the state of Israel, then still in formation, and has a conflicting relationship with his Jewish heritage ...
notes: Taken from the biography of the historical figure: a spectacular "all stars", but overall a bit opaque.

title: Children of Sanchez
actors: Anthony Quinn, Dolores Del Rio, Lupita Ferrer, Katy Jurado
description: The emotional life of a widowed worker with children, who lives in a very poor neighborhood in Mexico City, is marked by a gruff "machismo". Adapted by Zavattini and Hall Bartlett from a once famous novel by Oscar Lewis. Solid and a little heavy. Chuck Mangione soundtrack.

title: Today We Live
actors: Joan Crawford, Gary Cooper, Robert Young, Franchot Tone
description: During the First World War, an English aristocrat and her three lovers meet at the front. Two of them will not return.
notes: Love and War from a novel by William Faulkner, co-writer of the film. Warlike and patriotic, but Hawks' direction is always impeccable.

title: Showdown at Abilene
actors: Jock Mahoney, David Janssen, Martha Hyer, Lyle Bettger
description: A veteran of the Civil War, on his return he finds his girlfriend married and grudgingly accepts a post as sheriff. A restless and interesting low-cost western.

title: It Started with a Kiss
actors: Glenn Ford, Debbie Reynolds, Eva Gabor, Gustavo Rojo
description: Maggie Applebauer has sworn to marry a millionaire. During a benefit party, however, Maggie meets Major Joe Fitzgerald, falls in love with him and marries him. Joe is not only not a millionaire, but he must also reach the American air base in Barcelona. Life in Spain for the two is not immediately idyllic.
notes: Film that had some success in 1959, the year in which Debbie Reynolds was left by Eddie Fisher and Glenn Ford divorced Eleanor Parker.

title: Le infedeli
actors: Gina Lollobrigida, Anna Maria Ferrero, Pierre Cressoy, May Britt
description: The decision of an industrialist to have his wife stalked, in the hope that some infidelity of his will offer him the pretext for obtaining a divorce and he can therefore marry a model he has fallen in love with, is the move from which the description of a context of illicit relationships, blackmail, theft, silence and suffocated scandals. The culmination of this situation will be murder.
notes: The portrait of this corrupt environment under a respectable appearance is drawn with remarkable attention. However, the film lacks the necessary vigor to transform even an appreciable complaint into the stimulus for a beneficial awareness.

title: Un marito per Anna Zaccheo
actors: Silvana Pampanini, Amedeo Nazzari, Massimo Girotti
description: Anna and the sailor Andrea have sworn eternal love. The woman, who works at a photo agency, is seduced by the boss and tries to kill herself. Andrea, returning from a cruise, does not forgive her, and while Anna is about to marry an elderly merchant, she withdraws at the last moment. Having met Andrea again, the two spend the night together.
notes: The neorealist mortgage that De Santis had been carrying since the time of "Riso amaro" weighed heavily on the fate of this title, considered (and crushed) by the critics of the time as a kind of Matarazzo mello. And in fact, like the Melos of Matarazzo, it is a good film!

title: La vita agra
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Giovanna Ralli, Giampiero Albertini, Nino Krisman
description: Sacked by the mining company for which he worked, Luciano goes to Milan determined to blow up the headquarters. Here he meets Anna and goes to live with her. Turning out to be an advertising genius, he is hired by the same company where he was previously employed. His intentions of revenge are now forgotten and so his wife and son left in the province.
notes: The biting satire of the novel of the same name by Luciano Bianciardi from which the film is based, becomes the starting point for an Italian comedy more bitter and ferocious than the others, set in a paranoid Milan and interpreted by a great Tognazzi.

title: The Gazebo
actors: Glenn Ford, Debbie Reynolds, Carl Reiner
description: Elliot Nash, an established crime writer, married the charming actress Nell. When a blackmailer threatens to release photographs that could jeopardize his wife's career, Elliot pays, then kills the criminal and buries him in the backyard. But in reality there was no crime. How is it possible?
notes: With a cleverly constructed script around a brilliant subject and Ford's surprising interpretation, the film is enjoyable.

title: Agatha Christie's "Murder with Mirrors"
actors: Helen Hayes, Bette Davis, John Mills, Leo McKern, Dorothy Tutin, Geraldine Chaplin
description: Miss Marple lends a hand to an old friend who tries to save the old family home from unknown and dangerous "suitors", who would be willing to take it out to get it. Based on the novel of the same name by Agatha Christie, the film, shot for television, stars Helen Hayes and Bette Davis, who play here for the first time together. The screenplay is by George Eckstein, the result is not the most satisfactory.

title: Gole ruggenti
actors: Pippo Franco, Pamela Prati, Leo Gullotta, Stefano Antonucci, Manlio Dovì
description: In the imminence of a song festival, behind the scenes intractable and pressures of all kinds are unleashed: the script must be continually adapted according to who temporarily prevails in the corridor maneuvers, with record companies, politicians and schemers of various caliber intent on fighting each other without exclusion of blows to grab the victory in advance. Meanwhile, the organization is falling apart. Having recruited the almost complete cast of the Bagaglino, under the parody of Sanremo we see yet another reframing of "Champagne" or "Banana peels".

title: Cat's Eye
actors: Drew Barrymore, James Woods, Alan King, Kenneth McMillan
description: The title cat is little more than an extra in the first two of the three stories that make up the film. Here they are in line: an anti-smoking therapy that turns into a nightmare for the patient and his family; a sadistic test of audacity imposed by an old billionaire on his wife's lover: as a prize, according to him, the wife herself; in the third, she plays the lion's share, first saving her own skin, then her mistress from the monsters that haunt her. Subject and script by Stephen King, the film is part of the successful horror vein tinged with irony and uses excellent special effects. I show the cat by interpretation, but the others are also good.

title: Le souper
actors: Claude Brasseur, Claude Rich, Tichy Holgado, Yann Collette
description: In the acrid candlelight, on the night between 6 and 7 July 1815, two men sit at a richly laid table for a dinner, which will prove decisive for the destinies of France. The two are the former archbishop and diplomat Talleyrand and the Jacobin revolutionary and former police minister of Bonaparte Fouché. Shortly after the defeat of Waterloo, the two ("the vice in the arm of crime", as the voiceover recalls) will hand over France to the new king.
notes: The film is based on a comedy that has been staged for years and has, logically, its strong point in the acting of the actors: two real sacred monsters of great professionalism.

title: Colpi di luce
actors: Erik Estrada, Ennio Girolami, Michael Pritchard, Peggy Rowe
description: A mad scientist uses his invention, the ability to condense electronic energy and then absorb it via laser beams, to destroy the entire city of San Francisco. After some "tests" with railway wagons and car depots, the scientist is preparing to implement his threat, but Inspector Ronn will be able to neutralize him after spectacular clashes and chases, blackmail and explosions. The film is all here: a whirlwind of fireworks that, between bursts of light (the laser), chases, carom and other effects and effects, drags itself towards the defeat of the villain.

title: Il ladrone
actors: Enrico Montesano, Edwige Fenech, Bernadette Lafont, Claudio Cassinelli
description: Caleb is a petty thief. One day he witnesses the miracle of Jesus transforming water into wine and decides to follow him, believing him to be nothing more than a scammer. However, he will remain fascinated and in some way touched by Grace. He will die with him on the cross. Unsuccessful attempt to see the story of Jesus from a different point of view, which results in a modest comedy played entirely on Montesano, and moved only by setting.

title: Defenseless
actors: J.T. Walsh, Barbara Hershey, Sam Shepard, Mary Beth Hurt
description: T. K. Katwuller (Hershey) is a lawyer always on the verge of a nervous breakdown who has a terrible idea of ​​starting a romantic relationship with a client, Steven Seldes. Trouble is, he's married, and his wife was T. K.'s classmate. Things get worse when Seldes is found murdered and T. K. has to defend his wife from murder. There are more inconsistencies in this film than can be enumerated in this space. On the other hand, Hershey is perfect in the role of the hysteric and Walsh is treacherous enough. He directs Martin Campbell (Escape from Absolom) almost unnoticed.

title: Snake Eyes
actors: Harvey Keitel, Madonna, James Russo, Nancy Ferrara
description: Director Eddie Israel (Harvey Keitel) is making a film about a couple in crisis. As the lead actor he chose Francis Burns (James Russo), an old friend of his. The actress instead set her up for production and is an emerging TV starlet named Sarah Jennings (Madonna). The situation on the set is not ideal, it gets worse with the arrival of Eddie's wife and then ends tragically.
notes: Abel Ferrara had become famous for his hard, fast and violent films. Here he tries to be a problematic intellectual and doesn't make much money. Madonna is better than one is willing to admit and Keitel more than one can imagine.

title: The Corn Is Green
actors: Katharine Hepburn, Ian Saynor, Bill Fraser, Patricia Hayes
description: Tilly Maffit (Hepburn) leaves London to teach in a mining village in North Wales. The area is poor and the kids are naturally listless. The rewards for Miss Tilly are not excessive, at least until she discovers a glimmer of hope in one of her pupils. Her name is Morgan Evans and, thanks to her, she will go as far as admission to Oxford. Old theatrical text directed by Cukor for TV, with greater sobriety than Rapper did in 1945 (protagonist Bette Davis). Hepburn and George Cukor find themselves together for the tenth time in their lives. And always with great results.

title: McQ
actors: John Wayne, Eddie Albert, Diana Muldaur, Colleen Dewhurst
description: Lieutenant Parker (Wayne) goes straight to the point without paying too much attention to the forms and opinions of his superiors. When his colleague Sten Boyle is killed, he decides to abandon the police and continue his crusade alone. What he discovers is that behind the drug trafficking there are connivance in the political world and in that of the police itself. The drug shipment will eventually be scattered overboard. The plot is the usual of this type of film. What is striking is that politicians and policemen victoriously contend with the traffickers for the palm of the bad guy. Hurricane Watergate had just passed and Wayne himself must have been a little bit bitter.

title: Atlantic City
actors: Burt Lancaster, Susan Sarandon, Michel Piccoli, Kate Reid, Robert Joy, Hollis McLaren
description: Dave steals a drug game and leaves with Chrissie for Atlantic City, where Sally lives. This is at the same time Dave's ex-wife and Chrissie's sister, but she has no desire to get into trouble and therefore only hosts her sister. Dave ends up in the house across the street from Lou, an old gangster who never had the courage to be a gangster. Then come the killers. Memorable is the sequence in which Sarandon, spied on by Lancaster, spreads her lemon breast. We're not kidding, it's the strongest image in the film. The other strong image is the old Burt with his eyes still ironic despite all the weight of the years.

title: La morte accarezza a mezzanotte
actors: Nieves Navarro, Simon Andreu, Peter Martell, Ivano Staccioli, Carlo Gentili, Claudio Pellegrini, Luciano Rossi, Claudie Lange, Roberta Cifarelli
description: Valentina is a model, and they offer her to reconstruct, with the help of drugs, the murder of a woman. The experiment succeeds, but trouble begins for Valentina because the killer sets out on her trail and, in addition, the police do not listen to her as they continue to consider the case closed, classified as suicide. Second film by Luciano Ercoli starring Susan Scott, aka Nieves Navarro after Death walks in high heels. This is also a low-quality soft thriller.

title: 5 Branded Women
actors: Silvana Mangano, Jeanne Moreau, Carla Gravina, Vera Miles, Van Heflin
description: Kidnapped by the partisans and expelled from the country for having had relations with the Germans, five Yugoslav women end up joining another formation of resisters. The rules are strict and infringements are paid for with life. The life that Jovanka will end up sacrificing, together with the leader of the partisans, to save his comrades after a very hard battle against the Nazi troops. Great photography and classy musical commentary. Some excess of rhetoric, sometimes a bit superficial acting and a direction not supported by a particular vigor, but an admirable ending. The theme of the war suffered by women is interesting.

title: La bisbetica domata
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, Lilia Silvi, Lauro Gazzolo, Rossana Montesi
description: Back from America where he made his fortune, Pietruccio takes the daughter of the town tailor, Catina, as his wife. She has a very, very independent temper, so much so that everyone considers her indomitable. But her husband, pretending to indulge her and actually subjecting her to bullying and abuses, manages to reduce her to reason and docility. At this point, it will be full happiness for the young couple. Modernized (and very free, in an openly farcical key) reinterpretation of the famous play by Shakespeare. The direction sets a good pace, the actors give it their all.

title: Chino
actors: Charles Bronson, Marcel Bozzuffi, Jill Ireland, Vincent Van Patten
description: Chino Valdez (Bronson) is a mestizo who raises horses for a living and tries not to get into trouble with anyone. But he falls in love with Paloma, Maral's half-sister, the most sadistic landowner in the area. If you ask the Americans this movie is called "Chino" and is directed by the old John Sturges. The actors are the same and the plot as well, but the direction is not by Duilio Coletti. In any case, whoever is to blame, the result does not change: a great bore.

title: Una donna da scoprire
actors: Jean Marie Marion, Marina Suma, Agostina Belli, Bruno Riccardo Di Luia
description: Donna (Marina Suma) is a successful rock singer romantically linked to her manager, Aldo. The evenings go well and the couple as well, until Marco enters the scene. He is a photographer and after a first shoot with the diva he falls in love with her. Donna is there, leaves Aldo and prepares a new show. On the evening when she debuts with the new band, Aldo waits for her in the crowd and shoots her. There was a time when Marina Suma looked like she could be the new hope of Italian cinema. A fate that never happened to director Sesani. The result is identical, but the Suma, at least at the time of The Occasions of Rosa, seemed good.

title: Stasera niente di nuovo
actors: Alida Valli, Carlo Ninchi, Antonio Gandusio, Tina Lattanzi
description: A songwriter saves an alcoholic journalist from death. Some time passes. Destiny has a new meeting in store for them: however, the two find themselves in a police station where she was taken on charges of prostitution. All the clues are against the woman, but the reporter immediately works to get her out of trouble. Excellent staging of melodrama with a social background that skillfully mixes high themes (morality) and popular themes (sentimentality).

title: Hunted
actors: Dirk Bogarde, Jon Whiteley, Kay Walsh, Elizabeth Sellars
