description: Chris, a sailor wanted for murder, meets little Robbie on the run from home. The two run away together. But Robbie is ill: one step away from freedom, Chris, now also accused of kidnapping, is constituted so that his little friend can be treated. Escape, journey towards tenderness and redemption in this sober melodrama. First important role for an already great Dirk Bogarde.

title: Nel blu dipinto di blu
actors: Domenico Modugno, Giovanna Ralli, Vittorio De Sica
description: Turi, a young Sicilian transplanted to Rome, is accused of complicity in a theft, but is cleared by a waitress with whom he gets engaged more than anything else to strengthen his alibi. But his ease in female friendships triggers crossed jealousies and desires for revenge. The thin story holds up thanks to a light hand direction and the good performances of the actors. The atmosphere of the villages is bizarre, almost Pasolinian. "Volare" is sung by Vittorio De Sica in the role of a fraud while Mimmo Modugno sings "Pasqualino Maraja", Strada anfosa "and" Resta cu me. "Screenplay by Scola, Tellini, Zavattini.

title: Libeled Lady
actors: Jean Harlow, Myrna Loy, Spencer Tracy, William Powell
description: Accused of being a family wrecker by the columns of a newspaper, a young heiress sues the director asking for billionaire damages. But the defendant defends himself by asking his girlfriend and a journalist for help in organizing a staging intended to sweep the girl into a scandal. However, the reporter falls in love with the intended victim and tries to foil the plot. The intrigue is complicated but it follows with ease, punctuated with brilliant ideas and sparkling dialogues. But the strong point are the numerous pieces of skill of the performers, headed by a Jean Harlow of irrepressible vitality.

title: The Cutting Edge
actors: D.B. Sweeney, Moira Kelly, Roy Dotrice, Terry O'Quinn
description: Doug Dorsey (D. B. Sweeney) was no ordinary hockey player: he was tough, a champion, an Olympic national, someone who considered hockey a real sport and figure skating a pastime for girls. Then a bad accident creates trouble for his eyes and for him his career is over. After the bad moment, at this point he has only three alternatives left: he can become a bartender, go to work in that factory which he had escaped thanks to hockey, or continue skating on ice, but in a completely different context. paired with a figure skating champion, with whom to prepare to participate in the Olympics. Despite the biases, the choice is inevitable. She is Kate Mosely, she is rich, spoiled, very good, even pretty, but she has always been a nightmare for all her partners. The training starts badly but, little by little, an understanding begins to be established between the two, a harmony, which will eventually lead them to a triumphal gold medal. D.B. Sweeney (Stone Gardens) and Moira Kelly (Twin Peaks - Fire Walk With Me) are the two protagonists and they are nice. The fact that after the first frictions they come to spin of love and agreement and that together they reach the maximum Olympic podium, is a bit trivial, but it is inevitable in a film of this kind. Skating fans especially will appreciate it.

title: Lion Strike
actors: Don 'The Dragon' Wilson, Bobbie Phillips, Morgan Honier, Robert Costanzo
description: A doctor decides to go and spend a rest period with his little son in a mountain resort. At first everything seems to be going well: the stay is restful and mother and son end up under the "protective" wing of a charming forester which only makes their excursions more interesting. But the holiday turns into a nightmare when they are attacked by a group of killers perfectly trained in the manhunt even in winter and in the middle of the forest. "The newest race of Evil, meets the oldest race of heroes. ", said the advertisement for this film. And indeed, although unknown to most, Don "the Dragon" Wilson has been making films for a lifetime. All strictly the same and disappointing.

title: The Life and Times of Judge Roy Bean
actors: Paul Newman, Ava Gardner, Jacqueline Bisset, Tab Hunter
description: Really existed, the Texan bandit Roy Bean has combined all the colors during his "career". At a certain moment he decides to go over to the side of the law and proclaims himself a judge, appointing a heterogeneous band of outlaws to his aides and administering justice with unorthodox methods. He finds himself having to defend the old frontier from the advance of a greedy new America. Huston has drawn, with the complicity of Paul Newman, the portrait of a picturesque character from the West who passes from his profession as a killer to that of an executioner, without changing his methods much. But it is America that changes around him: the satire is lashing.

title: Mina... fuori la guardia
actors: Mina, Arturo Testa, Aroldo Tieri, Vittorio Congia, Carlo Croccolo
description: The famous singer Tony Rino is in the military; his presence in the barracks causes agitation, among soldiers, girlfriends and daughters of the graduates. He falls in love with a certain Valeria who doesn't want to know. Milly, Tony's girlfriend, out of jealousy leaves him during the preparation of a show. Valeria replaces her: success and love are guaranteed. Without rhyme or reason the story, but of course it is only a pretext for singing performances. Mina is already established, both as a singer and as a film presence and of course the real star is her, not Tony Rino / Arturo Testa. There is also Peppino di Capri (who sings "Voce 'e notte".)

title: Out Cold
actors: John Lithgow, Teri Garr, Randy Quaid, Bruce McGill
description: Ernie married Sunny, but he cheats on her, and has opened a butcher's shop with his friend Dave. Sunny hires a detective, Atlas, to expose Ernie and get a divorce. At the first opportunity, however, he kills him and declares his love to Dave and tries to make him an accomplice. Together they also kill Atlas, who had photographed Ernie's murder without recognizing Sunny. But then it's Dave who takes control of the situation ... Strong atmospheres suit Malcolm Mowbray. The satirical register of "Royal Lunch" worked much better, but even here, apart from a few missteps in the script, there is no complain. Good actors, especially Randy Quaid.

title: The Quare Fellow
actors: Patrick McGoohan, Sylvia Syms, Walter Macken, Dermot Kelly
description: In a prison, two men are waiting to be hanged; a young jailer wonders about the meaning and ethical admissibility of the death penalty. Good movie from a play by Brendan Behan.

title: Fighter Squadron
actors: Edmond O'Brien, Robert Stack, John Rodney, Tom D'Andrea
description: During the Second World War, the commander of an American fighter squadron applies a risky combat technique. This creates numerous problems due to the contradictory nature of the orders gradually given. In particular, an additional tank is tested but its testing causes the death of two officers who were trying to fly low, despite having given good results against the enemy at first. It is not among Walsh's best films, and it is to be remembered more than anything else as his first film in color and for the use of archive materials.

title: Bullwhip
actors: Rhonda Fleming, Guy Madison, James Griffith, Don Beddoe
description: Cheyenne, beautiful and independent, can only have her father's inheritance when she is married; he finds it convenient to marry a man sentenced to death, who is promised pardon only to persuade him to marry. Pleasant adventures with the beautiful, and underrated, Rhonda Fleming.

title: Cabin in the Sky
actors: Eddie Anderson, Ethel Waters, Lena Horne, Louis Armstrong, Rex Ingram
description: An idle, gambling husband is injured. Unconscious he dreams that God and Satan are competing for his soul, and upon awakening he decides to change his life. Interesting and lively "all black" musical, carefully served by Sidney Wagner photography. There is also Duke Ellington with his band.

title: Sitting Bull
actors: Dale Robertson, Mary Murphy, J. Carrol Naish
description: 1876: in the Black Hills sacred to Native Americans, relations with whites become increasingly difficult. While Sitting Bull suggests patience, Crazy Horse is ready to go to war. At the fort, Major Bob Parrish understands the Indians and refuses to support the actions of the gold diggers trespassing into the hills. With Custer's return to the command post, Parrish finds himself in the minority, and his girlfriend, irritated by his fallacious career choices, decides to break the engagement. The war is now looming ...
notes: Despite being quite ahead of its time in sketching the Indians, it remains a crude cross between westerns and melos.

title: La tête contre les murs
actors: Jean-Pierre Mocky, Charles Aznavour, Anouk Aimée, Paul Meurisse, Pierre Brasseur
description: François's psyche is "cheated" and his father locks him up in an asylum. The boy escapes but is recovered and his escape companion commits suicide. Try again, and for a while she finds refuge with her friend Stéphanie. A touching story that is both a still effective denunciation of the psychiatric totalitarian universe and a visionary hymn to freedom, supported by an extraordinary cast.

title: Dal sabato al lunedì
actors: Marianne Hold, Geronimo Meynier, Sandro Panseri, Andreina Pezzi, Renzo Montagnani
description: Sandrino and Enrico are two friends who are eager to have their first experiences with a woman. Having to go to Switzerland to attend to an errand, the two set out to conquer a pretty tourist they met on the bus. Quite obvious in dealing with the theme of the "first time", the film is based on the pictures of the environment and its somewhat light-hearted air.

title: Custer of the West
actors: Robert Shaw, Mary Ure, Robert Ryan, Jeffrey Hunter, Lawrence Tierney
description: At the end of the Civil War, General Custer is tasked with taming the Cheyenne (insurgent because the treaties have been trampled on). His victory would have positive electoral implications, and Custer obeys causing a massacre, with the inevitable Indian reaction. Under investigation for these facts, he returns to fight the Cheyenne, but is defeated and killed in the Battle of Little Big Horn.
notes: Reinterpretation of the life of the famous general, a little weak in the script - even historically inaccurate - but perfectly successful from a spectacular point of view. Penultimate film by Siodmak, shot in cinerama in the arid expanses of Spain.

title: Tennessee's Partner
actors: John Payne, Ronald Reagan, Rhonda Fleming
description: A gambler and a young woman nicknamed "Duchess" run a saloon. The "Duchess" is in love with the player who one day escapes an ambush thanks to a cowboy. A solid friendship is born between the two, but it crumbles when the player discovers that the cowboy's girlfriend is a bad guy, tries (and succeeds) to divide them. Western with sentimental tones taken from a short story by Bret Harte and directed with perfect measure by an old master. Among the performers, the future American President Reagan.

title: Dragon: The Bruce Lee Story
actors: Jason Scott Lee, Lauren Holly, Robert Wagner, Nancy Kwan
description: Bruce is a guy who is passionate about martial arts. He often gets into trouble and is not well seen by the Hong Kong police. For this he moved to San Francisco as a karate instructor. In the meantime, however, the cinema realizes him and makes him a real idol. But Lee, obsessed with strange visions (especially a faceless samurai), meets his tragic fate. The film basically follows two paths: on the one hand the rather obvious one of the biography, of the rags-to-riches genre; on the other hand, the ambiguity and enigmatic nature of man's destiny. But the best thing is still the action scenes.

title: Rapa Nui
actors: Jason Scott Lee, Esai Morales, Sandrine Holt, Zac Wallace
description: Noro, champion of the noble Long Lobes caste, wants to marry Ramana, of the submissive Short Lobes caste. The leader of the Long Lobes wants to have another huge statue erected, in addition to the existing ones, and this provokes the revolt among the enslaved Short Lobes. In the traditional contest of the "bird men" Noro will have to fight against his friend Make, a Lobo Corto, who is also in love with Ramana. Authentic places, many natives to act as extras (but the protagonists are "white"), sought-after spectacularity, many tourist sequences for yet another revival of impossible love due to social divisions, but also with an ecological message.

title: Dimmi che fai tutto per me
actors: Johnny Dorelli, Pamela Villoresi, Jacques Dufilho, Andréa Ferréol
description: Francesco Salmarani, a well-known Treviso doctor, finds himself in trouble when his Mafia father-in-law falls into his house from America. Francesco discovers that his money has been used for the purchase of a villa and tries to console himself with the housekeeper-mistress of his father-in-law, who holds an illicit treasure. He thus organizes a blow against the relative, but he will not be the one to enjoy the fruits. Bad farce that laboriously trudges by dint of slaps, misunderstandings and banal jokes. The subject is by Piero Chiara, but the two screenwriters Castellano and Pipolo provide it to heavily vulgarize it. The actors adapt to the general trend.

title: Vortice
actors: Silvana Pampanini, Massimo Girotti, Gianni Santuccio, Irene Papas
description: To save her father from financial distress, Elena leaves Guido and marries Luigi. Between the two there is not even a semblance of love, but Elena does not yield to Guido even when her husband suffers a serious accident. Then Luigi is killed and Elena is accused of murder. Comic book that exudes tear-jerking emotions with every frame. Except that Matarazzo was a master of this kind of film and knew how to "speak to the heart" of his audience.

title: Dark Bar
actors: Richard Hatch, Marina Suma, Vincent Regina, Barbara Cupisti
description: Elisabeth leaves the house because she has an appointment with Mark, then goes to the station where someone gives her a red raincoat, then she is found killed in the toilet of the Dar Bar with the raincoat on. His sister Ann, on the other hand, is a saxophonist at Blue Sister's Bar and, finding Elisabeth's absence, begins to investigate: she will discover that the deceased was involved in a drug story. Suma, who doesn't hit a movie right from The Occasions of Rosa, is the protagonist of this "thing" released in theaters in 1989 under the signature of Stanley Florency. The passage on television is instead signed by Stelio Fiorenza. A surge of sincerity or just a self-defeating attempt?

title: Seizure
actors: Jonathan Frid, Martine Beswick
description: A writer of horror stories besieged in a dream (only in a dream?) By his characters. First direction by Oliver Stone, in a totally anonymous genre film.

title: Greetings
actors: Jonathan Warden, Robert De Niro, Gerrit Graham, Richard Hamilton
description: Three young men among the mysteries of the Kennedy murder, the Vietnam tragedy and private obsessions. On his debut in commercial cinema, De Palma smiles sourly as he tells of young radical and non-radical protesters. Experimental and amused, with a very "New Hollywood" desire to attack America and its cinema.

title: Vento del Sud
actors: Renato Salvatori, Claudia Cardinale, Annibale Ninchi, Laura Adani
description: Eastern Sicily. Antonio is a worker affiliated with a clan. When he receives the order from his leaders to kill the Marquis Macri, he does not carry out the crime. Reason? Because between him and Grazia, a daughter of the Marquis, there has been something tender for a long time. The two flee together to Palermo, where, however, they are found by the mafia. To save the girl, Antonio leaves her, but she, desperate, kills herself and then ...
notes: First and only film directed by Enzo Provenzale, assistant director, screenwriter and production manager. Curious and underestimated at the time, it is one of the first films about the mafia, and it is not one of the worst, also because it chooses to tell it "from below" and "from within".

title: Chicken Park
actors: Jerry Calà, Demetra Hampton, Rossy De Palma, Lawrence Steven Meyers
description: Vladimiro is a former fighting chicken farmer desperate for a chicken named Jo. His research leads him to Dr. Eggs, a mad scientist, slightly taller than a dwarf, whose secret project is to grow to be as tall as his statuesque girlfriend. Thanks to the help of a doctor's assistant, Vladimiro will be able to stop the scientist's plan. Directorial debut for the former Gatto di vicolo dei miracoli who uses his old partner Umberto Smaila for the music. In the film also the Almodovarian Rossy De Palma and Demetra Hampton-Valentina. Demented beyond words; a delight for aficionados of trash.

title: Bridge to Silence
actors: Marlee Matlin, Lee Remick, Josef Sommer, Michael O'Keefe
description: A deaf woman (Marlee Matlin) struggles to overcome the crisis following the death of her husband in a car accident. Added to this is an almost incurable conflict with her mother, a conflict that risks causing her to lose custody of her daughter as well. Marlee Matlin (Oscar for Children of a Lesser God) and Lee Remick go to great lengths to make this predictable film exciting.

title: The Dark Half
actors: Timothy Hutton, Amy Madigan, Michael Rooker, Julie Harris
description: Thad Beaumont is a moderately successful teacher and writer. George Stark is the pseudonym under which Beaumont publishes a series of highly successful novels. When this is revealed, Beaumont publicly decides to do the funeral at his double. But Stark is not there and takes revenge by killing anyone he believes responsible for his demise.
notes: Romero meets Stephen King. The result isn't quite the sum of the two, but it's still good.

title: Body Snatchers
actors: Gabrielle Anwar, Meg Tilly, Christine Elise, Forest Whitaker, R. Lee Ermey, Terry Kinney
description: Marty Malone's father is a biologist for the US military. Marty is seventeen, a stepmother she can't stand and a craving to run away from Fort Daly. Also because strange things happen there: there is a major doctor on the verge of neurosis, an accident with chemicals and in addition, unseen, strange cocoons that form under the beds or on the roofs of the houses.
notes: Remake of the splendid Invasion of the Body Snatchers by Don Siegel. Gabrielle Anwar is cute, Christine Elise is deadly and Meg Tilly works, even if sometimes she is a little out of the ordinary. Full Metal Jacket "Sergeant Hartman", Lee Ermey, is a rather out-of-the-way General Platt here.

title: White Hunter, Black Heart
actors: Clint Eastwood, Jeff Fahey, George Dzundza, Marisa Berenson
description: John Wilson, a charismatic but bizarre director and intolerant of good conveniences, is in Africa to make site inspections for an important film. With him is Pete Verrill, screenwriter and his friend. Wilson, a passionate hunter, wants to kill an elephant as a statement of his courage. His obsession causes moments of intense tension in the crew and with Verrill himself and ultimately ends in tragedy.
notes: A harsh evocation of the great John Huston on the set of the Queen of Africa. After the self-destruction of Charlie Parker in Bird, for Eastwood another descent into hell, this time in the restlessness of a protagonist of the Hollywood myth.

title: Dinamite Jim
actors: Luis Davila, Fernando Sancho, Rosalba Neri, Aldo Sambrell
description: Dynamite Jim is a likeable adventurer and don Juan whom the handsome, but not very sharp, Margaret mistakes for the guide to whom the northern states have entrusted the gold with which to buy the alliance of the Indians. The web of misunderstandings and shady interests thickens around our hero. He, however, imperturbable, comes out of it by winning the love of the beauty and the heap of gold in question. The luck of the western spaghetti is at its peak; here we look for the fanciful subject, between comedy and adventure, and we simply arrive at the improbable. Neither the direction nor the script work together to improve the situation. Soundtrack by Nico Fidenco.

title: The Magnificent Rebel
actors: Karlheinz Böhm, Ernst Nadhering, Ivan Desny
description: Episodes from the life of composer Ludwig Van Beethoven from his youth in Munich. Apart from the totally miserable title (it almost looks like a western), the musical sequences are good and so is the filming done in Europe. It's a Disney movie that's not exclusively aimed at children, but it's equally childish despite its technical accuracy.

title: Exodus
actors: Paul Newman, Eva Marie Saint, Ralph Richardson, Lee J. Cobb
description: In 1947, in Cyprus, thirty thousand Jews, coming from the Nazi concentration camps, pressed to go to Palestine. While the decision of the United Nations is delayed, a group of six hundred refugees, led by an exponent of the Jewish underground organization, intends to force the blockade organized by the British to reach the coveted Promised Land as soon as possible. The resistance of the Arabs, who have been occupying the Palestinian territories for millennia, must also be overcome. The six hundred Jewish refugees manage to overcome the strong Anglo-Arab opposition by organizing a hunger strike for one hundred hours. Subsequently they arm a ship which they give the name of "Exodus" and set sail, then disembarking in Palestine.
notes: The needs of the show do not exclude a fairly accurate and balanced reconstruction of the facts and different points of view (with the exception of the position held during the crisis by the non-moderate Arabs). The "all star" cast is functional to the story.

title: The Mysterious Affair at Styles
actors: David Suchet, Hugh Fraser, Philip Jackson, David Rintoul, Beatie Edney, Gillian Barge, Anthony Calf, Joanna McCallum, Lala Lloyd
description: We are in England, World War I and Captain Arthur Hastings, wounded in the front, is invited by an old friend to spend a holiday on the country estate of Styles Court. The captain seems to recover from the wound in his leg and forget the horrors of the front but a far worse nightmare is about to hit the quiet life of the Cavendish family. His friend's mother, married in a second marriage to the obscure Alfred Ingletorp, is brutally killed by a fatal dose of strychnine and the suspicion that he was a member of the family is more than a simple Scotland Yard conjecture. Hastings can't allow the Cavendish future to be destroyed by village gossip but, luckily for him, a cute little Belgian man comes to help. He is the famous Hercule Poirot, a detective with formidable gray cells, who arrived in England as a refugee and temporarily housed in a small house near the crime scene. Poirot and Hastings begin to investigate by uncovering the grudges and wickedness that lurk in that quiet and happy strip of old England, discovering that a merciless hand lurks behind the mysterious death of Styles Court.
notes: Although it is part of a television series, this episode is particular because it is taken from the first story by Agatha Christie in which the unbearable, unbeatable and very intelligent Hercule Poirot appears. David Suchet is perfect right down to the details.

title: Beaches
actors: Bette Midler, Barbara Hershey, John Heard, Spalding Grey
description: C. C. (Midler) and Hillary (Hershey) have known each other since they walked around the Atlantic City beach at the age of eleven. One is from a poor background, the other comes from a wealthy family. One lives in San Francisco, the other is in New York. A strong friendship is born between the two, based on an assiduous exchange of letters. Years pass and Hillary, after graduating in law, joins her friend, who in the meantime has become a singer, in New York. She is attracted to her independence, so he decides to stay with her. When they fall in love with the same man, trouble begins. The original title plays on the double meaning between "beaches" and "bitches" (bitches, but also aggressive and unstoppable women). Which is not so much for Princess Hershey, but it is perfect for that undefused TNT charge that is Bette Midler. In short, actress films and little else.

title: The Master Gunfighter
actors: Tom Laughlin, Ron O'Neal, Lincoln Kilpatrick, Barbara Carrera
description: Finley McCloud is a former adventurer who has had the opportunity to make a clean break in his precarious and vagrant life. In fact, he recently married the daughter of Don Santiago, a "fazendero" owner of an immense ranch in California recently annexed to the United States. In her new home, Finley witnesses the extermination of a group of Indians by her brother-in-law Pablo, the son of Santiago. Three years later Pablo is about to try again, but this time Finley isn't watching ...
notes: In the years in which the western had discovered the "good Indians" an ambitious film, but with unrealistic results. A (very violent) remake of a Japanese film.

title: For the Boys
actors: Bette Midler, James Caan, George Segal, Patrick O'Neal
description: Dixie and Eddie are a couple of singers who go from war to war from '42 onwards, touring first Korea and then Vietnam. The duo disbanded, until both were awarded a medal by the President. Dixie and Sparks are no longer young and she doesn't want to appear on television with her old partner she hasn't seen in years ... Throughout the film, it's never clear if Rydell wants to launch himself against the collusion between war and show business or if he wants instead glorify the contribution of American artists to the war effort. Then, one realizes that he is building a classic wartime mélo, with many feelings, some obvious, but also a good command of stereotypes. Bette Midler's performances are amazing. When he sings "In My Life" and closes with the sign of peace, tears almost come.

title: Frankie & Johnny
actors: Michelle Pfeiffer, Al Pacino, Hector Elizondo, Kate Nelligan
description: Frankie is 36 years old and a tragic marriage behind her, with an abusive husband who has reduced her to the condition of no longer being able to have children. All she has left is her job as a waitress. A new cook arrives in the place: Johnny, just out of jail, where he served a year and a half for scam. He's an outgoing guy and flirts with everyone a bit, but he's in love with Frankie. Marshall tries to renew the setting and characterization of the characters, aided by the work of Terrence McNally, who signed the starting comedy. The problem is that Pfeiffer should be a sloppy scullery maid and Pacino the loser without a hint of charm. The play featured Kathy Bates and F. Murray Abrahams in the theater. Some of the strength of the original is lost; yet, the two protagonists are so good that the story continues to work.

title: King Ralph
actors: John Goodman, Peter O'Toole, John Hurt, Camille Coduri
description: When the entire British royal family accidentally dies, it turns out that the heir to the throne is a certain Ralph Jones (Goodman), a Las Vegas pianist, the result of an underground love of the Duke of Warren. Secretary Willingham (O'Toole) takes care of teaching him the job of king, but Ralph just isn't right. Even his flirtation with a girl who works as a strip teaseuse doesn't quite agree with the fact that, for reasons of state, he should marry a Finnish princess. The comedy isn't overwhelming, although Goodman is always good. Besides, any film that ends with Peter O'Toole's coronation can't be completely wrong.

title: Strategia del ragno
actors: Giulio Brogi, Alida Valli, Pippo Campanini, Tino Scotti, Franco Giovannelli, Giuseppe Bert, Allen Midgette
description: Athos Magnani, the son of an anti-fascist hero killed in 1936, returns home to discover the truth about his father's death. Based on a short story by Borges, one of Bertolucci's best films, here more "Po Valley" than ever. Produced by Rai, it is a dreamlike and oedipal reinterpretation of the Resistance with moments of great suggestion.

title: Il ragazzo dal kimono d'oro 2
actors: Kim Rossi Stuart, Amy Baxter, Christopher Alan
description: Anthony, an American student, returns home after a stay in Manila. He is immediately challenged by the Tiger gang that dominates the college, to a karate match. Anthony accepts the challenge and beats the treacherous Dick who, humiliated, hires a former karate champion to challenge Anthony with the aim of killing him. However, after having escaped an ambush and thanks to the advice of his martial arts master, Kimura, he will have the better of the grim opponent.

title: Vigil in the Night
actors: Carole Lombard, Brian Aherne, Anne Shirley, Peter Cushing
description: Lucy to Anne are two nurse sisters. Lucy unintentionally causes the death of a child with diphtheria. The older sister, however, takes responsibility and leaves the job. She finds work in Manchester, where she has the opportunity to prove her worth, but where she is forced to suffer the snares of the president of the institute. The two sisters will find themselves at the outbreak of a diphtheria epidemic during which Lucy will demonstrate all her heroic self-denial before falling victim to evil too. A tear-jerking drama that investigates the maze of guilt and its redemption through the staging of human suffering: excellent performances by the two leading actresses.

title: Malcolm X
actors: Denzel Washington, Angela Bassett, Albert Hall, Al Freeman jr., Spike Lee, Delroy Lindo, Theresa Randle, Kate Vernon, Lonette McKee, Tommy Hollis, James McDaniel, Ernest Thomas, Jean-Claude La Marre, O.L. Duke, Larry McCoy
description: Little Malcolm Little, the son of a Protestant pastor, grows up in Nebraska. His childhood is tragically marked by racist violence: his father is in fact killed by the men of the Ku Klux Klan who set fire to his farm and thus reduce them to misery. The mother goes mad and dies in an asylum. After years of passing from family to family, he is now a teenager in New York. He is intelligent, but his condition leads him to delinquency: theft, drug dealing, prostitution are his fields. Until he is arrested and, after years in prison in which he knows all sorts of negative experiences, he converts to Islam, studies and learns to oppose white power. Once outside, completely transformed, he gets married, joins an Islamic organization and becomes a political driver. Having become one of the most prominent personalities in the African-American world, he creates several enemies. Due to his increasingly less extremist positions, but in favor of a dialogue with whites, he is threatened on several occasions ...
notes: Spike Lee accepts the risks of the political-militant-didactic film. What matters to him is to save the contradictory but decisive figure and thought of a great contemporary black leader from oblivion. He succeeds, even if the best things in the film are those "in music".

title: Il brigante Musolino
actors: Silvana Mangano, Amedeo Nazzari, Guido Celano, Ignazio Balsamo, Rocco D'Assunta
description: Giuseppe Musolino, a young Calabrian charcoal burner, was convicted of an unspoken crime: the murder of the mafioso Don Pietro, to whom Mara was betrothed, with whom the young man is in love. Two years later he escapes, thirsty for revenge, and is joined by Mara, who then becomes pregnant. The woman ends up killed by Don Pietro's murderer. Joseph completes his revenge and constitutes himself. Between neorealism and westerns, Camerini skillfully directs this story of honor and despair, inspired by a famous story. The real Musolino will protest the inaccuracies, justifying the final caption on creative freedom.

title: Chaplin
actors: Robert Downey jr., Dan Aykroyd, Geraldine Chaplin, Marisa Tomei, Nancy Travis
description: The story of the great comedian and filmmaker unfolds through successive flashbacks, starting with the questions that a biographer asks him. The encounter with the world of cinema is not all roses, but then an extraordinary career opens up for success and artistic quality. Together, however, there are also sentimental and marital misadventures, plus other bitter disappointments. Finally, Chaplin decides to retire to Switzerland, comforted by Oona O'Neil. The film was a disaster at the box office and certainly does not thrill on a cinematic level. The life, career and loves of Chaplin are on paper a subject of great interest, intertwined with the history of Hollywood of the past. But the initial project remained trapped in its own greatness: it gets lost in the search for a biographical "correctness", without being able to become a "work" itself, with its own autonomous compositional depth and its own original inspiration. Diligent, but also soulless.

title: Body of Evidence
actors: Madonna, Willem Dafoe, Joe Mantegna, Jürgen Prochnow, Julianne Moore
description: A billionaire has died and left everything to his mistress, Rebecca Carlson, much to the desperation of his secretary who now throws accusations and suspicions. Rebecca is actually indicted and taken to court on charges of having consciously worn out and sexually executed the old Marsh who was, among other things, suffering from heart. The lawyer defending Rebecca is called Frank Dulaney. Nothing to say about his legal skills. But he doesn't put up much resistance to Rebecca's sexual offers.
notes: The film is all built on Madonna's man-eating vamp image. And it's a shame because Willem Dafoe, Joe Mantegna and Julianne Moore, who are good actors, seem almost half-served. Uli Edel is the German who became famous with "Christiane F. We the boys of the Berlin zoo" and then has never been able to repeat himself. From the same land comes Jurgen Prochnow ("U-Boot 96" and "Beverly Hills Cop 2") who, as always, plays the villain.

title: The Alamo
actors: John Wayne, Richard Widmark, Laurence Harvey, Frankie Avalon
description: 1836. In the ancient fortified mission of Alamo, Texas, volunteers under the command of Jim Bowie and Colonel Travis are barricaded, with David Crockett and a group of loyalists, who came from Tennessee, to defend Texas from the expansionist aims of Mexico. In front of them stand seven thousand Mexican soldiers in arms, under the orders of General Santa Ana. The fighting continues for three days before fate is fulfilled. But the heroic resistance will allow General Houston's soldiers to defeat Santa Ana and restore freedom to Texas. Hagiographic and spectacular narrative-river of a milestone episode in US history. Wayne makes his directorial debut: large landscapes and mass scenes, but also a search for the characterization of individual characters. While the western is now entering its "twilight" phase, Wayne, against the tide, takes it upon himself to resurrect the legend. The famous musical commentary is by Dimitri Tiomkin.

title: Totò, Peppino e una di quelle
actors: Totò, Peppino De Filippo, Lea Padovani, Aldo Fabrizi, Armando Annuale
description: A young woman, a widow, with a seriously ill child is forced, driven by a desperate need for money, to seek occasional meetings in the evening. A provincial runs into her in turn in search of adventures. Arriving in her house, however, the son has a violent attack of diphtheria and the man does his utmost to help the poor woman. Twilight comedy, more pathetic than hilarious, in which Fabrizi stands aside as an actor and directs Totò and Peppino in two rather moving roles. The tearful excess is felt only occasionally.

title: Chameleon
actors: Bob Glaudini, Nick Richardson, Lee Kissman, Kathlee McKay
description: Terry traffics in fakes and drugs; we follow him at work as he commissions fake serigraphs to a recalcitrant artist, while he procures cocaine from a client, while he threatens or "punishes" those who do not play the game; simply as he travels, by car or plane, in the city or in the desert, while chatting with friends or casual acquaintances about personal events in his life or the more frivolous and extravagant things. Among the first films of Jon Jost, an indomitable, charming and spiteful independent, he captures with an elegant photography, a convincing protagonist and pieces of skill ... and displaces with "gaps" of action full of things, people, chatters.

title: Nightmare 3
actors: Heather Langenkamp, Patricia Arquette, Robert Englund
description: The victims of the evil Freddy Krueger's nightmares join forces and, in a collective dream, defeat him. Third and, perhaps, one of the most interesting episodes of the Elm Street monster saga.

title: Happy Together
actors: Patrick Dempsey, Helen Slater
description: Chris, a nerd and of few words, is determined to become a playwright. In college, however, the computer plays a nasty trick on him, putting him in the room with Alex. Big mistake, given that Alex stands for Alexandra and that the latter is exuberant and festive, just the opposite of her forced roommate. But after the quarrels of the beginning, of course things end up marching beautifully. The film takes up, in a comedy version, the subject of Alan Pakula's old Pookie with Liza Minnelli. The protagonists get along fairly well; Helen Slater has sufficient charm and no inferiority complex towards her illustrious colleague.

title: Other People's Money
actors: Danny DeVito, Gregory Peck, Penelope Ann Miller, Piper Laurie
description: Lawrence Garfield is a Wall Street vulture. When he sets his sights on New England Wire & Cable, President Andrew Jorgenson turns to stepdaughter Kate for the lawsuit. Garfield realizes that the woman is clever; he tries to seduce her and then falls in love with her. For the sale of the factory he finds an ally in the general manager.
notes: The environments and characters are those to which the "financial" cinema has accustomed us. But the film, based on a theatrical text and professionally directed by Jewison, works in its satire and above all is based on a gigantic (artistically) De Vito.

title: Klute
actors: Jane Fonda, Donald Sutherland, Charles Cioffi, Roy Scheider
description: Klute, a former cop and now a detective, is hired by Cable, an industrialist, to investigate the death of one of his collaborators, Gruneman. On the trail of some letters, Klute arrives at Bree Daniels, a prostitute with a complex personality. While a story is born between Klute and Bree, the investigation ends up framing Cable as a murderer of Gruneman. Bree will change her life, but the ending is melancholy. These are the golden years of Pakula. His cinema shows us fragments of America in a profound identity crisis. "Why a Murder" focused on the political tale; here it is the private sphere that comes out of it: figures against the backdrop of the timeless cinema noir.

title: Hudson Hawk
actors: Bruce Willis, Danny Aiello, Andie MacDowell, James Coburn
description: Eddie Hawkins (Willis), aka Hudson Hawk, is a skilled thief who comes out of prison after serving ten years, determined not to return, giving up his honorable career. However, his acrobatic expertise makes him in great demand for the jobs he now refuses to accept. Two elegant thugs, Darwin and Minerva Mayflower, turn to him to get hold of a Leonardo code that continues the formula for turning lead into gold. The two manage to convince him mainly thanks to threats against Tommy, his best friend. But a certain Anna Biragli (MacDowell) also enters the scene, a beautiful and mysterious woman who passes herself off as a nun. Filmed by Michael Lehmann right after the remarkable Splinters of Madness, the film is just an adventurous firework. The figure of the gentleman thief, here well embodied by Bruce Willis, is reinterpreted in a modern key. It was a very expensive flop, but it's actually quite nice.

title: The Man with Bogart's Face
actors: Robert Sacchi, Misty Rowe, Michelle Phillips, Franco Nero, Yvonne De Carlo
description: Aided by his resemblance to Bogey, a mediocre detetctive gets several assignments and even manages to solve them. Nostalgic and pleasant farce, even without great gimmicks. Cameo of George Raft, famous gangster in the Warner films of the 1930s.

title: Law and Order
actors: Ronald Reagan, Dorothy Malone, Preston Foster, Alex Nicol
description: He leaves the assignment of sheriff and moves to a cottonwood farm with the brothers, but the tin star must get back. Skilbo remake of the "Texas Avenger", with Ronald Reagan.

title: Don't Go Near the Water
actors: Glenn Ford, Fred Clark, Gia Scala, Romney Brent, Anne Francis, Keenan Wynn
description: During the Second World War a special "information department" works at the naval base of Tulura. The men provide news and reports on the Pacific War, but are instructed not to leave the island. The romantic relationships with the local girls begin, which will not fail to cause scandals. Almost a "M.a.s.h." ante litteram, certainly not iconoclastic and compact like Altman's film, but with moments of great comedy.

title: The Competition
actors: Richard Dreyfuss, Lee Remick, Amy Irving, Sam Wanamaker
description: Personal aspirations and sentimental intertwining among the participants in an important competition for piano virtuosos. A little heavy Romanzone; the portrait of the environment is interesting.

title: The Younger Brothers
actors: Wayne Morris, Janis Page, Bruce Bennett, Geraldine Brooks
description: The Younger brothers, ferocious banites get into trouble as they await amnesty to be able to return to their native Missouri. Fictional story of three famous outlaws arbitrarily related to the James in the Italian version.

title: The Unsinkable Molly Brown
actors: Debbie Reynolds, Harve Presnell, Ed Begley, Jack Kruschen
description: Orphan Molly Brown grows up willing to become a member of Denver's good society. She meets Johnny, owner of a silver mine, who convinces her to marry him. The union between the two is cemented by the discovery of a rich silver vein that makes Johnny one of the wealthiest men in Colorado. Although the husband does not care about having an "à la page" wife, she leaves for Europe, eager to learn good manners.
notes: Weak musical comedy backed by good-natured Reynolds, inspired by a Broadway hit.

title: The Keep
actors: Scott Glenn, Alberta Watson, Jürgen Prochnow, Gabriel Byrne
description: In 1941, German soldiers occupying a castle in the Carpathians meet there and collide with a supernatural evil force. Good combination of war and fantasy, directed by a future action master.

title: House of Bamboo
actors: Robert Ryan, Robert Stack, Shirley Yamaguchi
description: In Tokyo, after the war, too many demobilized American soldiers turn to crime. An agent is infiltrated into the Dawson gang to steal information. Samuel Fuller guarantees quality action and suspense.

title: Who Is Killing the Great Chefs of Europe?
actors: George Segal, Jacqueline Bisset, Robert Morley, Jean Rochefort
description: The best "cordon bleu" from all over the world are gathered in Paris to create a historic banquet financed by a very rich and unrepentant glutton. Among these the beautiful Jacqueline Bisset, specialist in desserts. One by one, however, his colleagues come to a bad end, starting with the "magician" of the appetizers, course after course. Tasty sketches in a yellow-pink sauce.

title: Intimo
actors: Eva Grimaldi, Leonardo Treviglio
description: Double life for tea, waitress and model, and double erotic initiation: with an invaded intellectual and a hotel goalkeeper.

title: Across the Wide Missouri
actors: Clark Gable, Ricardo Montalban, John Hodiak, Adolphe Menjou
description: Flint Mitchell, who married Kamiah, the daughter of a Blackfoot chief, plans a big hunt in the Missouri Valley. His caravan, however, is attacked by Indians led by the young and warlike leader Ironshirt, who aspired to Kamiah's hand and now plots revenge for the "mischief" suffered by Flint. After the winter truce, during which Kamiah gives birth to a child, the fight between Flint and the Indian chief resumes, however, more bloody than before.
notes: The film, which was to be Wellman's masterpiece and testament, was heavily edited by the producer, but retains some moments of great lyricism.

title: The Tamarind Seed
actors: Julie Andrews, Omar Sharif, Anthony Quayle, Oskar Homolka, Dan O'Herlihy
description: A colonel of Russian espionage falls in love, reciprocated, with an assistant to the British interior minister, creating panic in their respective governments. Before and more than a spy intrigue, the film is a very traditional love story, set in Barbados, and with touches of feuilleton. Partly the Andrews-Sharif couple. Edwards' direction, free from comedy, is only correct.

title: The Gun Runners
actors: Audie Murphy, Eddie Albert, Everett Sloane, Patricia Owens, Richard Jaeckel
description: Sam Martin with his wife Lucy lives by renting his boat (which is still paying) to tourists and fishermen who go on vacation in warm Florida. Cornered by his creditors, he is forced to accept the offer, actually rather suspicious, of a shady character who wants to be taken with his girlfriend to Cuba. He quickly reveals himself to be a dangerous arms dealer who must supply a revolutionary group. Sam then decides to intervene, even though he knows he is facing overwhelming forces. Vaguely inspired by "To have and not to have" (and its cinematgographic version Acque del Sud) it does not reach the top, remaining however a robust adventure film.

title: Benny & Joon
actors: Johnny Depp, Mary Stuart Masterson, Aidan Quinn, Julianne Moore
description: Benny and Joon are brother and sister: Benny is a hard worker, maybe a little apprehensive, but always ready for sacrifice. His only vice is the game of poker. Joon is a painter, rather extravagant, however she is good and above all pretty. Between the two swoops a splash for real: Sam, a fan of Buster Keaton and Charlie Chaplin. It will be he, and especially his love, who will save Joon from madness. Former Edward Scissorhands Johnny Depp didn't hit the mark this time - but it's not just his fault. From the script down it is the whole operation that does not work. Including quotes and accompanying characters.

title: Prima della rivoluzione
actors: Adriana Asti, Francesco Barilli, Allen Midgette, Morando Morandini
description: Parma, 1962. Fabrizio, a young man from the upper middle class, is gripped by a series of personal and ideological anxieties. He has a girlfriend, the very bourgeois Clelia, with whom, however, he leaves quickly. He has a half idea of ​​joining the PCI, but even that doesn't seem like a solution. There would always be Aunt Gina, the one who comes from Milan, and with whom she has a relationship. But even this does not last long. The film is full of literary references (from Stendhal, up to the closing with a piece by Melville) and cinematic (from Godard to Howard Hawks' The Red River), and above all it is one of the very few examples of our local nouvelle vague. Probably this "provincial" and rebellious Bertolucci is better than the more recent and cosmopolitan one.

title: Hidden Agenda
actors: Frances McDormand, Brian Cox, Brad Dourif, Mai Zetterling
description: Paul Sullivan, a lawyer for the International League for Civil Rights, in Ireland for an investigation, is coldly killed by the police. The official version attributes the death to Sullivan's attempt to force a roadblock, but that's a lie. Of this is convinced Ingrid, his girlfriend, who begins to investigate and, with the help of an English policeman, finally discovers the truth. Ken Loach, special jury prize, re-emerges at the 1990 Cannes Film Festival with a film that is hard, cold and political like no more. Frances McDormand (Joel Coen's Blood Simple and Robert Altman's America Today) is very good.

title: The Abc Murders
actors: David Suchet, Hugh Fraser, Philip Jackson, David McAllister
description: The first murder sees poor Mrs. Ascher of Andover as the victim. Then a certain Betty Barnard is strangled in Bexhill. Then Sir Charmichael Clarke ends badly too. The murder takes place in Devonshire, in a village called Churston. At this point everything becomes clear: there is someone who has made up his mind to commit a series of crimes following the alphabetical order. What is still unclear is the name of the murderer, but even this is not a problem if the famous inspector Hercule Poirot is investigating. Reduction of one of the most famous novels by Agatha Christie in which we find the irreproachable David Suchet in the role of the very insightful Belgian investigator.

title: A Far Off Place
actors: Reese Witherspoon, Ethan Randall, Maximilian Schell, Jack Thompson
description: A commando organized by the ivory traffickers raids the Parkers' home causing a massacre. Only fourteen-year-old Nonnie and her peer Harry Wislow remain alive. The two boys' only hope of salvation is to travel 1600 miles across the Kalahari Desert to reach the only person capable of helping them: Colonel Mopani Theron. Mikael Salomon is a former cinematographer, and therefore the images in the film are all very accurate. But underneath the pictures, there isn't much to get excited about. In short, we are in the usual exotic genre where the frame is more important than the painting.

title: The Innocent
actors: Campbell Scott, Isabella Rossellini, Anthony Hopkins
description: Leonard, an English telephone technician, took part in an espionage action against the Soviets in the team of the American Bob in Berlin in 1955. Leonard falls in love with Maria, who is however married to a thug. Leonard unintentionally kills him, but this causes the mission to fail. For the director of the "Maratoneta" it is really a bad slip.

title: Little Buddha
actors: Keanu Reeves, Alex Wiesendanger, Chris Isaak, Bridget Fonda, Ying Ruocheng, Greishma Makar Singh, Sogyai Rinpoche, Jo Champa
description: In Seattle, some monks from Bhutan ask the parents of the child Jesse Konrad to accompany the child to Tibet, because perhaps he is the reincarnation of the Dalai Lama who died a few years earlier. To make their faith understood, they give him a book that tells the story of Prince Siddhartha, the Buddha, the Enlightened One, which is in turn told in the course of the film. From the "examinations" carried out in the monastery it emerges that Jesse and two other oriental children are reincarnations of the Lama.
notes: As ambitious as it is smoky, Bertolucci's attempt to tell a complex adventure of the spirit mixes, without resolving it, the spectacular attraction to philosophical reflection. A fairy tale about cinema, dotted with pure moments, but also falls and naivety.

title: Major Barbara
directors: Gabriel Pascal, Harold French, David Lean
actors: Wendy Hiller, Rex Harrison, Robert Morley, Deborah Kerr
description: Barbara, who holds the rank of major in the Salvation Army, is the daughter of a gunmaker. Her father offers to finance the charitable movement, but the girl refuses. But when her superior accepts other equally questionable grants, Barbara and the man who fell in love with her leave the Army. It is useless to preach to men that poverty renders corruptible. From the well-known comedy of the same name by George Bernard Shaw, a film that brilliantly spreads the irony of the original text, supported by an easy narrative and by a group of excellent actors (including newcomer Deborah Kerr).

title: Zéro de conduite
actors: Jean Dasté, Louis Lefebvre, Gilbert Pruchon, Robert Le Flon, Coco Golstein, Gérard de Bédarieux
description: A group of adolescents, at the end of the holidays, return to the boarding school, to its teachers and supervisors, to its rigid and ill-tolerated discipline. Between transgressions, provocations and exemplary punishments, the tension grows. While a young overseer passes to the opposite camp, the boys join forces, led by a trio of rebels, and they come to unleash a real revolt.
notes: Massacred at the time by censorship and branded as "anti-French", immersed in a realistic and dreamlike atmosphere at the same time, it is an autobiographical film, violent, anarchic and evil, which inaugurates the demythicized representation of childhood in the cinema. Numerous memorable sequences: the pillow fight with feathers flying like snowflakes, the outdoor theater with mannequins and papier-mâché skeletons among the public of the authorities and the final escape of the three brats on the roofs of the college.

title: Novecento atto I
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Robert De Niro, Burt Lancaster, Sterling Hayden, Dominique Sanda, Alida Valli, Stefania Sandrelli, Laura Betti, Werner Bruhns, Ellen Schwiers, Anna Henkel, Romolo Valli, Stefania Casini, Francesca Bertini, Anna Maria Gherardi, Paolo Pavesi, Paulo Branco, Giacomo Rizzo, Antonio Piovanelli, Liù Bosisio, Maria Monti, Roberto Maccant, José Quaglio, Pippo Campanini, Patrizia De Clara
description: Born on the same day, Alfredo Berlinghieri (De Niro), son of landowners, and Olmo Dacò (Depardieu), son of their farmers, live in parallel, but with the differences of belonging to two different social classes, their personal cases and the Italian events: adolescence, military service, the First World War, the advent of fascism. Meanwhile, they both got married. The great historical-political fresco that Bertolucci intends to compose also includes elements of easy melodramatic effect and somewhat rough schematisms. In an "all stars" cast, the best here is the two "old men", Burt Lancaster and Sterling Hayden.

title: Murder of Innocence
actors: Valerie Bertinelli, Stephen Caffrey, Graham Beckel, Jerry Hardin
description: The film tells the story of Laurie, a happy girl at least in appearance. She is happy and satisfied because her parents love her more than that. She is happy because she married a man who loves her and who tries in every way to make her happy and make her live a peaceful life. In short, everything seems to proceed for the best, until she, who had already manifested psychic disorders some time ago, gives in to the aggression of mental illness and gradually slips into madness. From that moment the whole world around her seems to hide pitfalls, which only she can see, everything becomes dramatically and irremediably threatening. Laurie then decides to defend herself, at the cost of the crime ...
notes: The film is based on a real story and that's fine, but the reality may very well be obvious as well. Cinema, however, when it is obvious, unfortunately also becomes unbearable.

title: Kings Row
actors: Ann Sheridan, Robert Cummings, Ronald Reagan, Ernest Cossart
description: Paris Mitchell studies medicine and practices in Dr. Tower's office. He falls in love, reciprocated, with Cassandra, the doctor's daughter. The two young men, however, cannot meet due to the prohibition of her father. One day, Dr. Tower discovers that his daughter, like her mother, is suffering from insanity and so he kills her and takes her own life. A friend of Paris has meanwhile had his two legs amputated and suspects that the doctor acted in revenge. Paris will discover the truth. Delusional melodrama (from a Harry Bellamann novel that caused a sensation) with extraordinary performers and great photography and set design. Upon its release it was a huge success.

title: The Stalking Moon
actors: Gregory Peck, Eva Marie Saint, Robert Forster, Nolan Clay
description: Sam Varner (Peck) saves Sarah Carver (Saint), a white woman who escaped a massacre years ago, from the threat of the terrible Indian chief Kataua. Seasoned and a little slow Western, but with good moments and a suspense all played on the threat of a villain you never see.

title: Paris Trout
actors: Dennis Hopper, Barbara Hershey, Ed Harris, Ray McKinnon
description: Paris Trout, a crude merchant, is married to a young and sensitive teacher. We are in Georgia, in the forties. Paris scams a black guy by selling him an uninsured car; when he refuses to pay, Paris kills his sister in a fit of rage. He feels no guilt for the murder he just committed, despite what his lawyer tells him. Paris knows she can get away with the trial because the jury is made up of whites. And in fact the trial ends with his acquittal. But the crisis erupts later, when he knows that his wife has got involved with the lawyer.
notes: The film effectively reconstructs the atmosphere of social violence and the historical context. Excellent interpretation of Dennis Hopper.

title: Clean and Sober
actors: Michael Keaton, Kathy Baker, Morgan Freeman
description: Daryl Pointer, a partner in a real estate firm, misses a major investment and moreover finds himself in trouble because the woman who supplies him with cocaine ends up in a coma in his bed. At the disposal of the police, Daryl takes refuge in a community for drug addicts and alcoholics. Despite the initial negative disposition, he manages to break the habit and also falls in love with Charlie, a woman he met during therapy. Fired by his partners, Daryl plans to rebuild a life with Charlie, but she dies in an accident. All he has to do is face existence with humility and renewed commitment. The screenplay of the film is built with the clear intention of tackling the theme with a "realistic" attitude. Good interpretation of Michael Keaton, still pre-Batman.

title: Dames galantes
actors: Richard Bohringer, Isabella Rossellini, Marianne Basler, Eva Grimaldi
description: We are in France in the second half of the 16th century, Brantôme is a small provincial gentleman who, having reached the age of forty, decides to devote himself exclusively to women. At court he binds to various ladies, whose body and spirit he knows how to appreciate. Protected by Caterina de 'Medici, he consecrated himself to what is the sole purpose of his life. Most of all, a passionate and sentimental widow will be his friend whom he consoles on the occasion of each new bereavement. Having become seriously ill, Brantôme decides to write about all the women he loves to pay homage to them and bond with them forever. An effectively sketched Renaissance picture; costumes and scenes are sumptuous, customs and "transgressions" described with humor and complicity. A tribute to women, who know how to avoid any vulgarity.

title: Pascali's Island
actors: Ben Kingsley, Charles Dance, Helen Mirren, Stefan Gryff
description: We are in 1909, at the decline of the Ottoman Empire, on an island of the Aegean. Basil Pascali lives as a local guide and also as an interpreter, but in reality he has been hired as a spy for the regime for twenty years. Anthony Bowles is an archaeologist, he is English and he lands on the island with the idea of ??carrying out important excavations, but in reality he is a small crook with a precise plan in mind. Among them is the beautiful Lydia Neuman, painter adored by Pascali, but finally coveted by Bowles. Then there is the Greek insurrection; the Ottoman empire ends, Bowles and Neuman are killed while Pascali awaits his fate. Well built, well photographed and very well interpreted, the film risks a little bit of the exercise in calligraphy. Special mention for Charles Dance, the David Wark Griffith of "Good Morning Babilonia" by the Taviani brothers.

title: Cold Heaven
actors: Theresa Russell, James Russo, Mark Harmon, Talia Shire
description: Marie is married to Alex and has an affair with Daniel, who is also married. But the very day when the two lovers have decided to tell everything to their respective spouses, tragedy occurs. In Acapulco, while taking a bath, Alex is hit by a speedboat and dies. Or rather, he seems to be dying, because his body is not there the next day in the morgue. He comes back to the hotel later and is very tired. The rest of the film abounds in visions, warning signs and various miracles. In reality it cannot be said that Roeg is a mystic, an original of course, but not a mystic. Sometimes this originality turns into great cinema and sometimes it doesn't. As in this case.

title: Heart of a Child
actors: Ann Jillian, Michele Greene, Bruce Greenwood, Terry O'Quinn
description: Karen Schouten came to the eighth month of pregnancy. Everything seems to proceed without problems, when the future mother is said that the small nasciture has a serious injury to the brain. It will not survive. Torn by pain, Karen, together with her husband Fred, decides to give the girl's heart for a transplant on another child. Five years later, the woman will meet little Paul Gabriel. A television film of evident civil commitment in favor of the availability for organ donation. The film, inserted in the "women at the crossroads" cycle, also allows you to reflect on the question of responsibility for everything that is relevant to procreation.

title: Walker, Texas Ranger
actors: Chuck Norris, Noble Willingham, Sheree J. Wilson, Clarence Gilyard
description: A man of few words and many deeds, Cordell Walker is the modern version of a ranger, a criminal hunter of the West but with tools adapted to the times. His friend and inseparable assistant is Jimmy Trivette, a good detective who escaped from the Baltimore ghetto, the metropolis where he lived and worked to avoid trouble. Even if they seem to be able to reach him even in this remote and distant land. He is also joined by an old friend, former sheriff, C.D. Parker, now a reporter for the local newspaper.
notes: This film is the first in a series centered around a bizarre Deep West cop and his equally unusual investigative companion. For Chuck Norris it is an opportunity to revive the glories of the past with action films set in a setting that is new to him.

title: Deliverance
actors: Jon Voight, Burt Reynolds, Ronny Cox, Ned Beatty, Ed Ramey
description: Four friends, united by a passion for nature, decide to leave the chaotic city behind and spend a peaceful ecological weekend. Lewis, the leader of the group, Drew, idealistic and refined, Bobby, fat and simpleton, and Ed, shy and clumsy, go to a remote valley in the South of the United States and canoe down the river that crosses it. The outing soon turns into hell and unspoiled nature shows its most ruthless face.
notes: Boorman's fundamental theme (the conflict between nature and culture) falls into the great archetypes of American literature. The result is a great film, still shocking today. From the anthology the initial duet between the banjo and the guitar.

title: I due parà
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Linda Sini, Maria Silva
description: Franco and Ciccio, by mistake, end up in a South American republic. Because of their gullibility, they seize power, but it won't last long.

title: Bugsy
actors: Warren Beatty, Annette Bening, Harvey Keitel, Ben Kingsley
description: Benjamin "Bugsy" Siegel, psychopathic gangster and inveterate womanizer, with partners Charley "Lucky" Luciano and Meyer Lansky, controls the gambling racket in New York. Sent on a mission to Los Angeles, he meets Virginia Hill, a handsome film actress, and falls in love with her. Once the local boss has been eliminated, his plans become ambitious: he decides to open a grandiose gambling house in the Nevada desert, the Flamingo, with Virginia. Despite having numerous Oscar nominations '92 (winning those for scenography and costumes), the film is only partially successful. However, he has to his credit the interpretation of Beatty, even if a little too over the top.

title: Glory
actors: Matthew Broderick, Denzel Washington, Cary Elwes, Morgan Freeman
description: In 1863, during the Civil War, the Northern army resolved to also employ black soldiers, mostly former slaves who had fled from the South. The film tells of the training of a battalion of black soldiers entrusted to Colonel (white) Shaw (Broderick ). The latter, a Bostonian from a bourgeois family, with the help of his comrade in arms Cabot Forbe (Elwes) and the tireless white sergeant Mulcahy, after having won the trust of his men, and in particular that of Trip (Washington), leads them until the first fight which ends in a useless massacre. Those men, despised by all, show that they die with indomitable courage. Epic tale with realistic rawness, it does not neglect the psychological conflicts of the characters. Strengths of the film are photography and performers.

title: Brannigan
actors: John Wayne, Richard Attenborough, Judy Geeson, Mel Ferrer, John Vernon
description: Jim Brannigan is a Chicago police lieutenant who has been keeping an eye on gangster Ben Larkin for a long time. Knowing this in London, he follows his trail. However, the latter, who in the meantime has hired a killer to get rid of him, is kidnapped, and Brannigan has his work cut out in tracking down kidnappers and "hostages". He succeeds and finally catches Larkin, the real instigator of his kidnapping. The killer remains to be liquidated.
notes: A well-directed detective story, but a little too stereotyped, with a John Wayne who compares his brisk ways with the phlegm of British cops.

title: Beethoven
actors: Charles Grodin, Bonnie Hunt, Dean Jones, Oliver Platt
description: A Californian family "adopts" a restless and bulky San Bernardo puppy. The three children are very happy, dad and mom a little less. The dog is nice, but it is not enough to cover the banalities of the script and the direction.

title: Bob & Carol & Ted & Alice
actors: Natalie Wood, Robert Culp, Elliott Gould, Dyan Cannon
description: Convinced to free themselves from inhibitions during a group psychotherapy session, two couples decide to practice sexual freedom and plan a party for the exchange of partners. Sharp but at the same time romantic comedy about the puritanical obsessions of sex at the end of the Sixties, Paul Mazursky's directorial debut.

title: The Black Legion
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Erin O'Brien Moore, Dock Foran, Ann Sheridan
description: Worker Humphrey Bogart becomes involved in the criminal activities of the Ku Klux Klan. Robust horror story organized by the hooded racist sect. Bogart is directed by Archie Mayo for the second time, following The Petrified Forest of 1936.

title: The Giant Spider Invasion
actors: Barbara Hale, Steve Brodie, Leslie Parrish, Alan Hale
description: The fall-out of a nuclear explosion produces gigantic spiders. They must be stopped or they will invade the planet. Fifties themes and atmospheres in a sluggish production of more recent twenty years.

title: None But the Brave
actors: Frank Sinatra, Clint Walker, Tommy Sands, Tony Bill
description: Lost on a small island in the Pacific, a group of marines comes into contact with some Japanese soldiers, also cut off from their lines. After several skirmishes, during which the respective commanders highlight all their strategic ability, a truce is reached. There are even episodes of camaraderie between enemies, but the iron logic of war soon regains the upper hand ...
notes: While there is a pacifist message in the film, the best parts are those shot on the battlefield. Directed and starring Sinatra, who proves he knows how to do it even behind the camera.

title: The Spoilers
actors: Anne Baxter, Jeff Chandler, Rory Calhoun, Barbara Britton
description: In the wild Yukon, two adventurers vie for property rights and mining exploitation, as well as the favors of the beauty of a saloon. Yet another version, without originality, is a novel by Rex Beach brought to the screen, among other things, in 1930 with Gary Cooper and in '42 with Dietrich and John Wayne.

actors: Roy Scheider, John Lithgow, Helen Mirren, Bob Balaban
description: An expedition made up of Soviet and American astronauts is sent into space to search for a lost spaceship and a mysterious monolith, which should contain many of the mysteries of the cosmos. They discover that Discovery, as the space shuttle is called, has broken down because the onboard computer has "gone mad". Then the mission is recalled to Earth, where a war is about to break out between the United States and the Soviet Union, but ... Attempt to follow, explanation and therefore trivialization of Kubrick's masterpiece. Hyamd is solid and nothing more.

title: Desiderando Giulia
actors: Serena Grandi, Johan Leysen, Valeria D'Obici, Sergio Rubini
description: Emilio is a former promise of literature, which now corrects the manuscripts of authors in search of success. Through one of them, Stefano makes the acquaintance of Giulia, an actress of commercial commercials with disordered life. It is for him the beginning of a hopeless obsession, which will produce devastating effects on his personality.
notes: In the film there are obviously Swabian reminiscences, (the starting point is the novel "senility") which aim to give a "cultural" painting to the performance of the forms of Serena Grandi. A little plausible attempt and rightly rewarded by the total disinterest of the public.

title: Zeder
actors: Gabriele Lavia, Anne Canovas, Bob Tonelli, Paola Tanziani
description: From the mysterious "k land", the dead can come back to life and attempt to drag the living with them calling them to share a terrible and horrifying existence. Science and, above all, a young Bolognese writer (Lavia), investigate the worrying phenomenon. But curiosity can sometimes be fatal.
notes: Scripted with the contribution of Maurizio Costanzo and his brother Antonio Avati, it is the second Po Valley horror made by Pupi Avati after that of his rather brilliant debut ("The house with laughing windows"). And the quiet atmosphere becomes more and more sinister.

title: The Liquidator
actors: Rod Taylor, Trevor Howard, David Tomlinson, Jill St. John
description: A former war hero, who likes to enjoy life, is recruited by the English secret service as a liquidator of agents suspected of treason. How will he be able to reconcile these two "occupations" so different from each other?
notes: Funny and well interpreted British product, by a novel by John Gardner.

title: T.R. Baskin
actors: Candice Bergen, Peter Boyle, James Caan, Marcia Rodd
description: A very unhappy girl tells her story of loneliness to a wealthy businessman she met by chance. A very sentimental, almost melodramatic film, unusual for a comedy director like Herbert Ross. The interpreters hit the spot.

title: One of Our Dinosaurs Is Missing
actors: Peter Ustinov, Helen Hayes, Derek Nimmo, Clive Revill, Joan Sims
description: A precious microfilm was stolen from China and mysteriously disappeared. A Chinese detective is tasked with finding him. The precious object ended up in the skeleton of a dinosaur found in a natural history museum. The dinosaur, however, was stolen by a housekeeper and a group of her colleagues who were involved in the intricate affair. Quite lively Disney comedy, with a good Ustinov.

title: Il trapianto
actors: Carlo Giuffrè, Renato Rascel, Graziella Granata, Liana Trouché
description: An American billionaire offers a thousand million to those who, with a transplant, will be able to restore his virility. A Roman employee is chosen, but a penniless Sicilian baron pretends to have been the "donor" to weave his sentimental plots undisturbed. Discovered the deception, the baron really suffers emasculation. Predictable and farcical humor.

title: Senza sapere niente di lei
actors: Philippe Leroy, Paola Pitagora, Graziella Galvani, Giorgio Piazza
description: After taking out life insurance for her children, a woman dies under unclear circumstances. A young insurer is in charge of the investigations during which he falls in love with Cinzia, one of the daughters. But he also discovers that the woman did not die of natural causes ... A thriller tinged yellow with a touch of sentimentality. It is not one of the best things about Comencini, who nevertheless attempted a bizarre experiment.

title: Whispers in the Dark
actors: Anthony La Paglia, Annabella Sciorra, Alan Alda, Jill Clayburgh, John Leguizamo
description: Ann Hecker (Annabella Sciorra) is a New York psychiatrist with latent sado-masochistic tendencies. The stories of one of her patients do not leave her completely indifferent. Meanwhile, Ann begins a passionate relationship with a man and then discovers that the man is her patient's lover. When the latter is found dead, an investigation begins. This Christopher Crowe film also proceeds on the tried and tested model of "sex, crime and psychiatry". The story is not the maximum of originality, but the performances of the actors (especially Sciorra and Lapaglia, alongside "veterans" like Alda and Clayburgh) largely save the situation.

title: Nachts, wenn der Teufel kam
actors: Hannes Messemer, Claus Holm, Mario Adorf, Peter Carsten
description: Summer 1944: a maid is murdered in Hamburg and an innocent man is accused of the crime. A police inspector discovers the real culprit, but the SS who would like to take advantage of the opportunity for a further racist crackdown get in the way. Any attempt to do justice fails and the inspector himself is punished for his insistence on trying to bring the truth to light. On the basis of a fact that really happened, a posthumous indictment of the Hitler regime by Siodmack, who returned home after the end of the war. Solid in the narrative, the film (of German production) presents an effective environmental reconstruction and makes use of convincing interpreters.

title: Mogambo
actors: Clark Gable, Ava Gardner, Grace Kelly, Donald Sinden, Philip Stainton
description: In Africa, the American dancer Eloise is forced to stay in a remote farm belonging to Vic Maxwell. Love is born between the two, but both have a rather angular character. During an expedition with a married couple, Donald and Linda Nordley, Vic falls in love with Linda, but tries to stifle the feeling so as not to ruin her marriage. Linda is also torn, both because she still loves Donald and because she has become friends with Eloise. Ford does not put too much effort into it and, with impeccable skill, carries on the film with big-name actors, also highlighting the exotic scenarios that form the background.

title: Novecento atto II
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Robert De Niro, Donald Sutherland, Dominique Sanda, Romolo Valli, Alida Valli, Stefania Sandrelli, Laura Betti, Werner Bruhns, Ellen Schwiers, Anna Henkel, Romolo Valli, Stefania Casini, Francesca Bertini, Anna Maria Gherardi, Paolo Pavesi, Paulo Branco, Giacomo Rizzi, Antonio Piovanelli, Liù Bosisio, Maria Monti, Roberto Maccant, José Quaglio, Pippo Campanini, Patrizia De Clara
description: Alfredo (De Niro), too dominated by the fascists, is left by his wife (Sanda); Olmo (Depardieu) undergoes political repression until the Liberation, when he leads the peasants along with the owner, Alfredo. The farmer (Sutherland) is killed with his mistress (Betti), Alfredo is symbolically sentenced to death. But the friendship between the two men who grew up together does not fail. In this second part, the dichotomy between historicist ambitions and compromises of spectacle is accentuated, with a "sublimated" ending in a populist choreography. Interpreters are also affected.

title: Trial
actors: Glenn Ford, Dorothy McGuire, Arthur Kennedy
description: A young lawyer defends a Mexican boy from the wrongful accusation of rape and murder. The political organization behind the young Mexican intends to "sacrifice" him to make him a hero of the social struggle. The only one who believes in the Mexican's innocence is the lawyer himself.
notes: Racial drama with a good cast but a bit stereotyped and too blatantly anti-Communist.

title: The Romance of Rosy Ridge
actors: Van Johnson, Janet Leigh, Thomas Mitchell
description: In Missouri, at the end of the civil war, between hooded fanatics and secessionist peasants. Effect drama in which Janet Leigh debuts.

title: Invitation to the Dance
actors: Gene Kelly, Tamara Toumanova, Igor Youskevitch, Claire Sombert
description: A clown in love, a precious bracelet and an American sailor are the protagonists of the three episodes, which make up the film. There is only music and dance. No dialogue and, unfortunately, very little originality.

title: La stazione
actors: Sergio Rubini, Margherita Buy, Ennio Fantastichini
description: Domenico, stationmaster in a small southern town, is a meticulous little man who spends his time between small daily tasks. But one night a beautiful blonde in an evening dress comes to him with some problems. Domenico confronts the woman's disreputable companion, who has come to take her back to bring her back with him, and establishes a tender relationship with her.
notes: From a comedy by Umberto Marino brought to the theater by Sergio Rubini, the latter makes his directorial debut with a version full of pathos and unspoken feelings. She is Margherita Buy, one of the best actresses of the new generation.

title: Il dominatore del deserto
actors: Kirk Morris, Rosalba Neri, Hélène Chanel, Paul Müller, Aldo Bufi Landi
description: The tyrant Yussuf, in one of his numerous raids, kidnaps a group of women. Among these is the beautiful Fatima, who however manages to escape. He takes refuge in the desert where he risks dying. At the last moment, however, she is saved by the brave Nadir, a Brber warrior who already has, on his own, more than one reason to oppose Yussuf. After a bloody battle, Nadir defeats the tyrant. A film that oscillates between adventure and exoticism, action and struggle, but without a shred of fantasy. Amerigo Anton is actually Tanio Boccia.

title: Professionisti per un massacro
actors: George Hilton, George Martin, José Bodalo, Edd Byrnes
description: Chattanooga Jim, Still and Fidel are sentenced to death, but pardon is granted to capture Major Lloyd, who has escaped with a shipment of gold. The three join him, but the gold ended up in the hands of ferocious Mexicans.
notes: A western that is not very original but full of action and twists.

title: I tulipani di Haarlem
actors: Carole André, Frank Grimes, Gianni Garko
description: The young Pierre meets the British Sarah who tried to kill herself for a failed love. He is happy to help her, to give her back the pleasure of life; when he declares his love for her, Sarah decides to stay in Holland with him. But now it is the girl's jealousy to which Pierre has to pay a heavy price.
notes: Very tender in its bitterly poetic substance, full of pictorial references, the story blends realism and fairy tale with elegance and sensitivity.

title: Dellamorte Dellamore
actors: Rupert Everett, François Hadij-Lazaro, Anna Falchi, Barbara Cupisti, Stefano Masciarelli
description: Francesco Dellamorte has chosen to lock himself up in a sort of voluntary exile as a guardian of the cemetery of a small village. Only a strange creature lives with him, a kind of mute elf called Gnaghi. One bad day, however, the dead decide to come back to life, leaving their graves and sowing terror in the village. Dellamorte is thus forced to intervene, killing the dead for the second time and burying them again. Italian horror tries to revitalize itself by turning to Dylan Dog's "noir" imagery. The result is appreciable, especially for the unusual dose of irony. The interpretations of Everett and Falchi are singular.

title: Raining Stones
actors: Bruce Jones, Julie Brown, Ricky Tomlinson, Tom Hickey
description: Unemployed worker always looking for jobs to make up for a few pounds, Bob also sees himself robbed of the van. He buys a new dress for his daughter for the first commune by telling his wife that he has won the money at the bets. In reality he asked Tansey, the neighborhood loan shark, who in fact swoops into the house claiming the debt. Bob chases and confronts him but Tansey escapes, swerves with the car and crashes to his death. Bob wants to turn himself in, but Father Barry advises against him.
