After "Riff raff", Loach remains faithful to the harshest themes of social commitment, with an affectionate realism and acrid irony, towards tatcherism but also towards the "soft" left.

title: Robocop 3
actors: Robert John Burke, Nancy Allen, Rip Torn, John Castle, Jill Hennessy
description: One of the poorest neighborhoods in the city is identified by a powerful Japanese holding company as a possible location for a grandiose real estate speculation operation: the futuristic Delta City should rise in its place. The company hires actual death squads to deport and kill the inhabitants. However, these organize themselves and, thanks also to the intervention of Robocop, they fight.
notes: At the third episode of the series even Robocop no longer holds up, both from a visual and narrative point of view. And then there is no longer Peter Weller's square jaw under the cyborg-cop's armor.

title: Moment of Truth: Why My Daughter?
actors: Antonio Sabato jr, Linda Gray, Jamie Luner, Joseph Burks
description: Gayle Moffit (Linda Gray) is a rather quiet woman who is no longer young and lives in an equally quiet town in the United States. Her daughter Diana, who lives with her, is a not-so-easy girl who has proven to have some problems when it comes to getting in touch with other people from an early age. Essentially, however, Gayle is convinced that Diana is a good girl, dating only good guys. Then one day, quite by chance, Gayle discovers that one of these distinguished boys has managed to persuade his Diana to join a prostitution ring. Mum Gayle, however, is one who does not give up easily. Helped by a policeman friend, she then tries in every way to bring her daughter home and get her out of that dangerous ride. Despite all her efforts, Gayle fails to reach her goal because Diana suddenly dies, but she still manages to rescue April, a young friend of Diana who is also trapped in that environment. From the series "intrepid mothers against the horrors of the world". Unwatchable.

title: I corpi presentano tracce di violenza carnale
actors: Suzy Kendall, Tina Aumont, Luc Merenda, John Richardson, Roberto Bisacco, Ernesto Colli, Angela Covello, Carla Brait, Conchita Airoldi, Patrizia Adiutori
description: A maniac brutally kills several girls and some witnesses, then dies fleeing after an authentic massacre.

title: L'amico del giaguaro
actors: Walter Chiari, Gabriella Pallotta, Carlo Romano, Elke Sommer
description: Alberto escapes from the orphanage and goes to Rome. Here he joins a band of lazy people who organize a pickpocket. The blow yields a good booty soon squandered, but the robbed recognizes Alberto and demands compensation. The boy is thus forced to look for a job to avoid prison.

title: Io ti amo
actors: Dalida, Alberto Lupo, Marisa Quattrini, Gioia Desideri, Sheyla Rozin
description: Prince Tancredi, an abstract painter, meets Judy, a stewardess, during a trip by plane and is struck by her. The girl agrees to pose for the prince, but some negative appreciation of his art plunges him into a violent crisis. Judy, however, has a flight that awaits her and leaves Tancredi, who continues the portrait. However, the two are destined to meet again. Antonio Margheriti in his career has directed many films, also using the pseudonym of Anthony Dawson, but unfortunately the result has always been the same: bleak. At the time, the song "I love you" that gives the title to the film was quite successful.

title: Un homme et une femme
actors: Anouk Aimée, Jean-Louis Trintignant, Pierre Barouh, Valerie Lagrange
description: Both widowed and severely tested by life, they meet and slowly give in to feelings. The film that launched Lelouch: Palme d'Or at Cannes and Oscar for best foreign film. Lelouch's mastery and pleasure in filming are undeniable, but the film appeared even then honeyed and cunning in its use of rhetoric and clichés. Still, it worked and how. Francis Lai's music with his "sciabadabada" has remained famous.

title: Provaci anche tu, Lionel
actors: Oreste Lionello, Ubaldo Lay, Claudio Gora, Elena Veronese, Aldina Martano, Orchidea De Santis, Giacomo Furia
description: A detective who is on the trail of risqué briefs, lost in unspeakable circumstances, finds himself in the middle of a spy story. Crazy attempt to build a yellow plot about Oreste Lionello, Woody's sotrico voice actor, who also mimics him in the body. In its own way, an experimental film, so unlikely that it is at times brilliant (right from the title).

title: L'eredità Ferramonti
actors: Fabio Testi, Anthony Quinn, Dominique Sanda, Gigi Proietti
description: The beautiful and unscrupulous Irene married Pippo Ferramonti, son of the rich Gregorio. Greedy for money, Irene points to the old man's inheritance. Therefore she first becomes the lover of her brother-in-law, and then of Gregory himself, who names her his heir.
notes: Bolognini tries, through the portrait of a woman as angelic as ruthless, thirsty for success and money, to tell the passage from Umbertine Rome to the modern one, but equally corrupt.

title: Il tenente Giorgio
actors: Massimo Girotti, Milly Vitale, Gualtiero Tumiati
description: A young lieutenant, during an expedition on the Sila, spends a night of love with a woman who cannot see her face. A few years later, having returned to Calabria as administrator of the Monserratos, he discovers that the mysterious woman of that night is the count's niece who had resorted to that expedient fearing he would be left without heirs. One of the classic melodramas of Matarazzo and certainly not the most successful.

title: Operazione San Pietro
actors: Jean-Claude Brialy, Lando Buzzanca, Edward G. Robinson
description: A band of down-and-out robbers leaves Naples for Rome to steal Michelangelo's Pietà. The theft succeeds, but the statue is stolen from them by the gangster Joe Ventura who intends to blackmail the Vatican State. With the help of one of the first thieves who repented, a group of fierce priest-detectives, led by Cardinal Braun, sets out on the trail of the boss and his gang.
notes: The subject is blatantly "cloned" from that of "Operation San Gennaro". Fulci's film, however, comes out as the loser in comparison: Edward G. Robinson fails to make one forget Totò's absence.

title: The Cemetery Club
actors: Ellen Burstyn, Diane Ladd, Olympia Dukakis, Danny Aiello, Lainie Kazan
description: Esther (Burstyn), Doris (Dukakis) and Lucille (Ladd) have been friends for a lifetime. They were married and they are, all the more so now that they are widows. Of course, adapting to the new life is not easy, but the three "girls" still have interests, not least that of men. One of them, Esther, finally finds the right man in the aged Ben Katz (Aiello). Dukakis (Oscar for "Bewitched by the Moon") and Ladd are good. But Ellen Burstyn (Scorsese's "Alice Doesn't Live Here Anymore") towers over them. Even if the film does not emerge from a golden mediocrity, she is always delightful.

title: The Whole Town's Talking
actors: Edward G. Robinson, Jean Arthur, Wallace Ford
description: Model employee Arthur Jones discovers he looks strikingly like a dangerous criminal, Mannion. When he escapes the police arrest Jones and release him only thanks to the intervention of his office manager. Mannion, taking advantage of the similarity, takes the place of Jones to carry out his crimes with impunity but, thanks to a stratagem and the courage of Jones, he will be killed by his own men. Ford expertly blends gangster film, physically represented by Edward G. Robinson, with comedy. The result is a brilliant and sarcastic film that plays on resemblance and the confusion of appearances. From a novel by W. R. BUrnett, based on a (perfect) script by Robert Riskin and Jo Swerling.

title: La circostanza
actors: Ada Savelli, Gaetano Porro, Raffaella Bianchi, Mario Sireci, Barbara Pezzuto
description: For everyone there is a circumstance capable of changing, even imperceptibly, the course of people's entire existence. Laura Liberti, a spirited career woman, meets by chance a young motorcyclist involved in a road accident. Her husband, an industry executive, ends up being fired due to industrial modernization. And also for their children, Silvia, Beppe and Tommaso, there will be a special moment, a crucial "circumstance". This is how Olmi had begun, with an almost subdued cinema, very modern, but light. Then he too got lost. His old films were much better. Small, small.

title: Beyond the Poseidon Adventure
actors: Michael Caine, Sally Field, Telly Savalas, Karl Malden
description: Mike Turner (Michael Caine) has a tugboat named Jenny, an elderly boy, and a mountain of debt. On board, when they spot the wreck of the Poseidon, a boat mysteriously sunk on New Year's Eve, there is also the shipwrecked Celeste Whitman (Sally Field), picked up shortly before. The problem is that the Poseidon has also been spotted from Stefan Vevo's boat and so the adventure begins.
notes: This should be the sequel to the "Poseidon Adventure", even if that ended differently and therefore the two films do not coincide. But this is the least: there are also many other things not exactly congruent in this disastrous "disaster-movie".

title: Trauma
actors: Christopher Rydell, Asia Argento, Frederic Forrest, Piper Laurie
description: After being rescued from a suicide attempt, 16-year-old anorexic Aura is brought home by the police. His mother is a medium; that evening, after the dramatic interruption of a séance, the woman flees to the street chased by her husband. The two end up beheaded and Aura sees the killer walk away in the rain. The girl takes refuge from David, the young man who saved her, and together they try to discover the mysterious killer who continues to kill ...
notes: Here the director of _Inferno_ and _Tenebre_ tries to recompose his universe of personal nightmares around a rationalizable narrative core, but fails his intent.

title: Hairspray
actors: Sonny Bono, Divine, Ricki Lake, Jerry Stiller, Colleen Fitzpatrick, Deborah Harry, Ruth Brown
description: We are in Baltimore, in 1962. Tracy, fat, nice and outgoing, Penny, thin, shy and oppressed by her parents, are two friends who are passionate about dancing. Tracy wins success in a musical television show, the "Corny Collins Show", and together with her friend she manages to organize a big television party dedicated to racial integration despite the open hostility of the "right-thinking" of the place.
notes: John Waters' fame and importance are rightly attributed to his previous excessive and shameless films (for example "Polyester"). This "Fat is beautiful" is perhaps less biting, but it has great rhythm, music and fun on its side.

title: Windwalker
actors: Trevor Howard, Nick Ramus, James Remar, Serene Hedin, Dusty McCrea
description: An old Cheyenne near death recounts his long existence to save his family from his son's revenge: a twin who, after killing his mother during a Crow raid, was kidnapped when he was born and then raised in the enemy tribe. The word to the Indians in this western out of the traditional schemes, which in the original was entirely spoken in the Cheyenne and Crow languages.

title: Un bambino perso per sempre
actors: Beverly D'Angelo, Max Gail
description: Jerry is 17 years old and is in a juvenile detention center. She manages to escape and during a night meeting she lets her boyfriend know that she is pregnant and that she wants the baby at all costs. But, when he returns to the reformatory, he discovers that it will absolutely not be possible, so when the baby is born, he is given up for adoption. After 19 years, the law allows Jerry, who in the meantime has had three other children and leads an irreproachable life, to see his son. But the longed-for meeting will never happen: the child died when he was three, of peritonitis. But some things that the adoptive mother and a relative of this say make her suspicious for their incongruity and strangeness. With the help of a journalist and a policeman, he then reconstructs what had happened many years ago. It is a chilling reality that he discovers: the child died of the beatings and mistreatment suffered by the woman who had adopted him. Jerry then manages, always with the help of his two allies, to bring the woman before the Supreme Court. And it is during a close and dramatic debate that the truth comes out: one of the children of the woman herself confesses it in a decisive and tragic testimony. Jerry then gets a heavy and exemplary sentence for her. It is a not particularly original film for television, inspired by a real story.

title: Montana
actors: Errol Flynn, Alexis Smith, S. Z. Sakall, Douglas Kennedy
description: An Australian sheep farmer clashes with Montana cattle ranchers, who want to reserve grazing only for their herds. A modest film, with star Errol Flynn now on the avenue of sunset.

title: For Me and My Gal
actors: Judy Garland, Gene Kelly, George Murphy, Martha Eggerth
description: Just before World War I breaks out, a vaudeville showgirl has to choose between two partners. Choice only professional or even sentimental, given that the suitors risk being enlisted?
notes: A romantic story excellently directed and interpreted while the Second World War was in progress. Debut of Gene Kelly, who duets with Judy Garland.

title: Impatto mortale
actors: Bo Svenson, Fred Williamson, Marcia Clingan
description: Young couple wins at Las Vegas slot machines with a gimmick. Bad guys take out the two, a policeman grabs them and ... Pseudo-American police made in Italy, weak and frayed.

title: Jack the Ripper
actors: Ewen Solon, Ewen Patterson, Eddie Byrne
description: In London, in 1888, a maniac killed women at night who surprises sun on the street. The technique with which the crimes are accomplished is heinous, but very refined and shows that the killer has uncommon scientific knowledge. Two policemen, an English and an American, investigate. The suspicions focus at a certain point on a primary hospital.
notes: Banal screenplay and granuignoleschi effects a little too insisted. Rather than discreet the vintage reconstruction.

title: Too Late the Hero
actors: Michael Caine, Henry Fonda, Cliff Robertson, Ian Bannen, Ronald Fraser
description: On a Pacific island, a twelve-man commando must destroy a Japanese radio station, hidden in the heart of the jungle. Among them an English and an American officer who overcome their mutual mistrust to carry out a very risky mission.
notes: Aldrich's dozen even dirtier. Free of lyricism, the film is harsh and full of memorable sequences. Above all, the race of the two protagonists under the crossfire of the enemies. All the actors look rougher than their usual.

title: Devil's Doorway
actors: Robert Taylor, Louis Calhern, Paula Raymond, Marshall Thompson
description: An Indian fights bravely with the North in the American Civil War, but upon returning to Wyoming he finds himself hated and discriminated against by his former comrades. Excellent pro-Indian western, even more beautiful than the contemporary Indian Lover, marks the debut in the genre of Mann, who will be one of the greatest masters.

title: The Corn Is Green
actors: Bette Davis, John Dall, Nigel Bruce, Joan Lorring, Rosalind Ivan
description: In the late nineteenth century, Miss Moffat sets up a school in a Welsh mining village. So many tribulations, but what satisfaction when one of his pupils goes to Oxford!
notes: Very mannered treatment of a beautiful play by Emlyn Williams. Rapper was an excellent acting director who staged some of the best melodramas with Davis.

title: Revenge of the Nerds II: Nerds in Paradise
actors: Robert Carradine, Curtis Armstrong, Timothy Busfield, Andrew Cassese, Larry B. Scott, Courtney Thorne-Smith, Anthony Edwards
description: The athletic and stolid students of the Alpha-Beta group want to crush the ugly but nice and intelligent colleagues of the Nerds by any means. Farce champion of coarseness.

title: Live Wire
actors: Pierce Brosnan, Ron Silver, Ben Cross, Lisa Eilbacher
description: The city of Washington is the scene of two very serious bomb attacks. In the first, a senator dies while having lunch in a restaurant. In the second, another senator blows up during a press conference. On the two episodes investigates the young expert Danny O'Neill, who suspects that the terrorists have used a new, deadly type of explosive.
notes: Not yet in the comfortable shoes of James Bond, Pierce Brosnan tries to give life to a dark and haunted detective, but his eternal dandy air doesn't help him enough. Routine action movie.

title: Ladybird Ladybird
actors: Crissy Rock, Vladimir Vega, Sandie Lavelle, Mauricio Venegas
description: Maggie has had a rather difficult life, in the course of which she gave birth to four children of four different men, two of them of color. She meets Jorge, a South American immigrant, and conquered by his sweetness, she goes to live with him. Social assistance, however, which intervened following a fire that broke out when the children were alone in the house, discovered the "irregularities" of this family. He then declares Maggie unreliable, taking her children away.
notes: Based on a true story, the film is a crude and seemingly neutral reconstruction of the story. After "Riff Raff" and "Raining Stones", Loach's cinema has become even harder: like the "family-life" that Maggie lived.

title: Nocturne indien
actors: Jean-Hugues Anglade, Otto Tausig, Clémentine Célarié
description: A man leaves for India in search of an old companion who has been mysteriously missing for more than a year now. In his long wandering he arrives, after the city of Bombay, in Goa where, now in the grip of a sort of delirium, he confuses reality with fantasy. Based on the homonymous, fascinating story by Antonio Tabucchi, the film tells the search for oneself through the progressive loss of one's own identity.

title: Quatorze Juillet
actors: Georges Rigaud, Annabella, Pola Hillery, Paul Olivier
description: It is the night between 13 and 14 July. Jean and Anna love each other, but there is Pola, an enterprising foreigner. There is dancing in the streets, the musicians drink, but Anna's mother is ill and the young woman does not participate in the party. Moreover, he quarrels with Jean and he is not insensitive to the charm of Pula. A delightful film, in which Clair paints the popular context of the national holiday with polite irony, inserting a love story, which is little more than a pretext, functional to the narrative seal. Music by Maurice Jaubert.

title: La luna
actors: Jill Clayburgh, Matthew Barry, Fred Gwynne, Elisabetta Campetti, Tomas Milian, Alida Valli
description: The famous soprano Caterina Silveri after the death of her husband comes to Rome, from America, with her son Joe. The boy takes drugs; to save him, the woman leaves the theater and gives Joe too much intimacy. Then Caterina, in crisis, takes refuge in Parma, where she is joined by Joe. Back in Rome, the woman gives her son the opportunity to discover his real father, and this is the key to reconciliation.
notes: Bertolucci faces a theme of psychoanalytic introspection, with some abuse of symbolism, some gratuitous ideological "shot" and some narrative naivety. But also with the merit of elegant solutions.

title: The House of the Spirits
actors: Jeremy Irons, Meryl Streep, Glenn Close, Winona Ryder, Antonio Banderas
description: Esteban Trueba hopes to find gold in his mine and marry the aristocratic Rosa. He finds gold, but Rosa dies and he marries his sister Clara, who has occult powers. Blanca is born, who falls in love with Pedro, the leader of the peasants in revolt. Esteban supports the military coup, his daughter ends up in prison. The old man comes to his senses and makes Pedro flee. Blanca, freed, will write a book.
notes: Famous performers, beautiful photography, remarkable environmental reconstruction for a story that could be fascinating. Instead, it is a pompous and presumptuous cartoon, a tremendous "brick", with some disconcerting lapses in taste.

title: The Silence of the Hams
actors: Ezio Greggio, Dom DeLuise, Billy Zane, Shelley Winters, Joanna Pacula, Charlene Tilton
description: An FBI agent, Joe Dee Fostar, follows the case of a super serial killer who committed 120 murders in one week. He consults Dr. Animal in prison, but he gets nothing out of it. His girlfriend steals $ 400,000 from her employer, escapes and takes refuge in Antonio Motel's hotel. Then his sister Lily and private detective Balsam arrive. The matter is getting more and more complicated. Greggio goes to the USA to make his debut as a director and makes a film that is below his usual comedy as an actor. He has a good cast available, but his parody (between "Psyco" and "The Silence of the Lambs") is not biting. In addition, others have already done similar things and much better.

title: Nowhere to Run
actors: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Rosanna Arquette, Joss Ackland, Kieran Culkin
description: Sam Gillen was left alone. It was his friend Billy who helped him escape from jail, but then Billy got shot by the police and now Sam is hiding in the woods of California. Right there lives Clydie, a widow with two children who is completely reluctant to sell her land to a speculator named Franklin. A relationship arises between the widow and the fugitive and he helps her get rid of the bad guy.
notes: Van Damme tries to get out of his "iron hands and feet" character and to do so he uses an old script by Joe Eszterhas ("Basic Instinct") directed by Robert Harmon ("The Hitcher - The Long Road of Fear"). Try it one more time, Jean-Claude.

title: For Queen and Country
actors: Denzel Washington, George Baker, Amanda Redman, Dorian Healy
description: After nine years of parade service, the Falklands War and the IRA guerilla warfare, Reuben takes his leave. However, he finds a degraded society, disbanded former comrades, the contempt of the people for his militancy in the parà, a youth prey to drugs and without ideals.
notes: A vigorous "pamphlet", full of sacrosanct civil rage, with a significant setting, with all convincing interpreters, even if narrated in a too obvious and superficial way.

title: The Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse
actors: Karlheinz Böhm, Glenn Ford, Charles Boyer, Ingrid Thulin, Paul Henreid, Yvette Mimieux
description: Before the war, Heinrich returned to Argentina from Berlin full of enthusiasm for Adolf Hitler. His cousin Julio instead tries to keep himself equidistant from extremism. The old patriarch reunites the family and when he learns of Heinrich's faith, he reacts by calling Nazism the apocalypse of humanity. But his anger is fatal: he dies in Julio's arms.
notes: Spectacular but not very detailed, all resolved in a splendid formal surface, also because Minnelli had to work on a subject that did not belong to him. Inspired by the novel by Vicente Blasco-Ibanez, it is a remake of the 1921 silent film of the same name with Rudolph Valentino.

title: Sitting Target
actors: Oliver Reed, Jill Saint John, Ian McShane, Edward Woodward
description: Harry has been convicted of a bloody robbery and is serving a long prison sentence. He knows that his wife is cheating on him, in addition to the police chief. Harry therefore has only one purpose: to escape and kill the woman. When he escapes from prison, his wife gets police protection, but that's certainly not what can stop Harry.
notes: An exhilarated but predictable "noir" in characters and twists.

title: The Return of Dr. X
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Rosmary Lane
description: The body of the diabolical Dr. X, executed, was stolen and revived by a colleague. But you always need new blood to feed the monstrous creature. Chain murders follow one another. Unusual Bogart in the part of the monster, but the film is a Serie B Cosetta.

title: Death in the Clouds
actors: David Suchet, Philip Jackson, Sarah Woodward, Cathryn Harrison
description: We are on the Paris-London flight there is the noble, but now, poor Lady Horbury, there is a famous mystery writer, a very courteous hostess and then there is the private detective Hercule Poirot. Of course there is also a murderer, one so shameless as to commit his crime while Poirot is sleeping. The Belgian detective does not forgive him and is not happy until he can reveal his identity. New installment of the series starring David Suchet. There is nothing missing, neither Poirot's lashing jokes, nor the false traces, nor the ending in which all the suspects are brought together and then accused one by one of being the culprit. How classic it is in Agatha Christie.

title: The Last Emperor
actors: John Lone, Joan Chen, Peter O'Toole, Vivian Wu, Ying Ruocheng
description: The film traces, with a series of flashbacks, the life of Pu-Yi, the last emperor of China: from a child to whom everything was due, being a son of Heaven, to a puppet king of the "Manchukuo" in the hands of the Japanese, to a prisoner of political re-education camps in Mao's time, after a period spent in Siberia hostage by the Russians. Until his anonymous death, which occurred during the cultural revolution. Biography, bordering on hagiography, is a highly spectacular superproduction that has been awarded with nine Oscars (best film, direction, screenplay, photography by Storaro, editing, music by David Byrne and Ryuchi Sakamoto, scenography, costumes and sound) . But it is also a meditation on cinema, on the relationship with history and dreams, from the very first image of the train arriving at the station.

title: Champ Thiaroye
actors: Ibrahima Sane, Pierre Orma, Gabriel Zahon
description: In 1944 the black French troops who fought in Europe during the Second World War were gathered in Senegal. The soldiers have been promised a demobilization allowance, but the officers in charge of liquidating them seem to stall. The tension mounts and calls for calm are repeated throughout the day. During the night the blacks are massacred by the French troops. Sembene Ousmane, one of the historical representatives of African cinema, active since 1963, makes a bitter denunciation of colonial racism and with this film wins the special jury prize at the 1988 Venice Film Festival.

title: Ghosts Can't Do It
actors: Bo Derek, Anthony Quinn, Leo Damian, Don Murray, Julie Newmar
description: An inconsolable widow (Derek), with extra shapes and inexhaustible desire, cannot give up on lost happiness. Her strongest desire would be to have her husband back or perhaps to "transplant" the spirit of her beloved spouse into the body of another man. But the operation can only be done when he has found a perfectly shaped male.
notes: One of the deadliest couples in cinema of all time is certainly the one made up of Bo Derek and her husband John who insists on believing himself a director and signing terrible shit. Sorry to see old glories like Anthony Quinn and Don Murray involved here.

title: Le choix des armes
actors: Yves Montand, Gérard Depardieu, Catherine Deneuve, Michel Galabru
description: Noël falls, tragically, into the circle of the underworld hosting a fugitive. History of hatred, fidelity and friendship as in the rhetoric of the French underworld; great actors and tight editing.

title: Ercole l'invincibile
actors: Dan Vadis, Spela Rozin, Ken Clark, Carrol Brown, John Simons
description: Hercules, after killing a lion that terrified the king's daughter, ends up falling in love with it. The father, however, in exchange for the girl's love places as a condition the killing of a terrible dragon that slaughters his people. Of course the enterprise succeeds. When Hercules returns to the village to collect the coveted "prize", he realizes that everything has been destroyed by the violent tribe of Demios, who live in the extinct basin of a volcano. A thousand ups and downs still await our hero before the happy ending.
notes: Among the interpreters, all hidden under an Anglophone pseudonym, appears Maria Fiore, discovered by Renato Castellani for "Two soldi of hope". By now the genus peplum was in decline; this is a very mediocre remnant of it.

title: La casa del buon ritorno
actors: Amanda Sandrelli, Stefano Gabrini
description: Jacob Luca, returns with his girlfriend Margit to his childhood home. The air of the countryside and the silence attract him a lot. But the house hides a secret: about twenty years earlier, during a party of kids, Luca made his peer Lola, a pretty little girl he fell in love with, fall from the terrace. Memories inevitably reappear, to the point that, little by little, Luca becomes obsessed. He sees Lola everywhere and even seems to meet her. Horror signed by Beppe Cino ("Diceria dell'untore") that drags itself towards a predictable end.

title: Can I Do It 'Til I Need Glasses?
actors: Victor Dunlap, Moose Carlson, Robin Williams, Roger Behr
description: A succession of golirdiche skits with spicy softness. In a small part added after the "premieres" to exploit the success of Mork and Mindy, Robin Williams also appears.

title: Pietà per chi cade
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, Antonella Lualdi, Nadia Gray, Andrea Checchi
description: Believing her husband dead in the war, Anna accepts Andrea's court. When the husband, to everyone's surprise, returns home, he discovers the two lovers and, in a fit of anger, kills his rival. To suffer the most from the tragedy, it is Bianca, the daughter. The real responsible for everything for her is the mother.
notes: Matarazzo-style drama without the touch of genius of the original, but with decent professionalism and adequate actors.

title: La rabbia
actors: voci di Renato Guttuso, Giorgio Bassani, Carlo Romano, Gigi Artuso
description: It is a two-part story of the events that characterized the period between the 1950s and 1960s. They range from the death of Pius XII, and subsequent election of John XXIII, to the death of Marilyn Monroe. From the invasion of Hungary in '56 to the flight of Gagarin, from the coronation of Queen Elizabeth to the arrival of Ava Gardner in Rome or to the visit of Sophia Loren in the flooded Polesine. The curious formula compared an author on the right (Guareschi), and one on the left (Pasolini). The two parts are also very different from a stylistic point of view; revised today may be interesting. The most beautiful part, however, remains Pasolini's "filmed poem" dedicated to Marylin Monroe.

title: The Damned Don't Cry
actors: Joan Crawford, Kent Smith, David Brian, Steve Cochran
description: Tired of a life without emotions, Ethel Whitehead leaves her husband and dreams of a social climb that allows her to live in luxury and comfort. Her life is thus divided between two men: at first she becomes the lover of the leader of a gang of criminals; but when everything seems to be going well, he falls in love with another criminal, sworn enemy of the gang boss. When the latter discovers the affair, Ethel has no choice but to flee: the challenge between the two contenders will have only one winner ...
notes: After the success of _Viale Flamingo_, Crawford tries again the role of a beautiful middle-class woman who throws herself into the world of crime. Result inferior to the original, but superior to many B-movies.

title: This Woman Is Dangerous
actors: Joan Crawford, David Brian, Dennis Morgan, Richard Webb
description: Beth is the mistress and inspirer of the bandit Mat's exploits. After a big hit at a casino, Beth is forced to undergo a delicate operation to avoid loss of sight. She is operated on by Dr. Halleck, who falls in love with her. Mat, overcome by jealousy, although sought after, sets out on Beth's trail.
notes: Joan Crawford in the classic role of the bandit's woman, in a conventional but at times exciting story. Excellent photography by Ernest Haller.

title: Longtime Companion
actors: Stephen Caffrey, Patrick Cassidy, Brian Cousins, Campbell Scott, Dermott Mulroney, Bruce Davison, Mary-Louise Parker
description: The protagonists of the story are eight young homosexuals of well-off social status: one is a lawyer, the other seven work in the golden world of television. We are in 1981: the New York Times reports of an unknown disease that is claiming victims among gays. The group of friends will be decimated: nine years later, only two of them remain alive, still hoping that the terrible disease, sooner or later, will be defeated. One of the most interesting films made on the AIDS theme. The drama of the eight friends is followed by the first ironic jokes about the new disease as the contagion grows, but the tragedy never completely closes hope.

title: Hora cero: Operación Rommel
actors: Jack Palance, Alberto De Mendoza, Andrea Bosic, Antonio Pica
description: A group of American officers, with an anti-Nazi German major, are infiltrated behind the lines to free the imprisoned Hitler bombers and take Rommel across the border. Rommel refuses to follow them, the mission fails. In the final battle the Nazis are defeated, but only one of our heroes survives. Unlikely war adventures on the basis of some fleeting historical element.

title: With Hostile Intent
actors: Melissa Gilbert, Mel Harris, Holland Taylor, Peter Onorati
description: Kathy and Miranda don't know each other. But both are police officers and for both of them life is not easy. Kathy risks her life because of her colleagues during an operation in which she acts as a decoy. Miranda suffers sexual harassment from co-workers especially after she ends her affair with a married sergeant. The two women later get to know each other when they decide to take their cases to court.
notes: The original title is "With Hostile Intent" and gives a better idea of ??the environment in which the two protagonists find themselves working. The Italian one is a bit misleading because it refers to murders that are missing in this television movie.

title: Problem Child 2
actors: John Ritter, Michael Oliver, Jack Warden, Laraine Newman, Ivyann Schwan, Amy Yasbeck
description: Junior is ten years old and moves to Mortville with his adoptive father Ben. Mortville is a quiet town full of divorced women who find Ben's arrival very interesting: but they haven't dealt with Junior. The only one that would be fine would be Annie Young, also because her daughter is a ten-year-old girl who is as bad as he is ...
notes: What is not clear is how _Little Plague_ managed to be so successful in the United States that it deserved this sequel as bad as the previous one. With us, on the other hand, they were both failures, and this time the public certainly had their good reasons.

title: Djävulens öga
actors: Bibi Andersson, Jarl Kulle, Nils Poppe, Gertrud Fridh, Sture Lagewall
description: A woman's honesty is a sty in the devil's eye says an old Scandinavian proverb, and in fact, in the depths of Hell (more like a banking office than Dante's Gehenna), Satan has grown a sty that it ... evil of the devil. Reason? The virtue of the young and honest Britt-Marie, deaf to all male seduction. To heal, Satan devises a solution ... diabolical: he sends Don Giovanni himself to earth so that he can finally break through the girl's heart.
notes: An apparently light Bergman, but who under the guise of comedy (or rather: comic opera) stages the favorite theme of the impossibility of loving.

title: Il ragazzo dal kimono d'oro 5 - La sfida degli skinheads
actors: Christopher Alan, Katy Johnson, Dorian D. Field
description: This time the enemy to beat is called Alabama Bull and it is a pit of negligence, but our Larry Jones, always supported by the Japanese master Masura, does not fear confrontation. How this series could have reached the fifth episode is a mystery.

title: Another You
actors: Gene Wilder, Richard Pryor, Mercedes Ruehl, Stephen Lang, Vincent Schiavelli, Vanessa Williams, Jerry Houser
description: Eddie Dash agrees to be a "social volunteer" to avoid jail. He will accompany George, a chronic liar recently released from a psychiatric clinic. When he discovers that George is actually Abe Fielding, a missing billionaire, Eddie sets up a hoax with his client.
notes: Same formula and same pair of protagonists as _Non look at me: I can't hear you_. The first film, although stretched, made a lot of money. This, which is a very feeble repetition, also did badly at the box office. Too bad for the performers, Richard Pryor and Gene Wilder, who compete in a comic frenzy, overlapping with gags, misunderstandings and jokes.

title: The Hard Way
actors: Michael J. Fox, James Woods, Annabella Sciorra, Luis Guzmán
description: Nick Lange is a young actor who has to play the part of a policeman on screen. To better immerse himself in the role of the character, he manages to get himself placed alongside a real agent, detective John Moss, engaged in a risky investigation on the trail of a homicidal maniac. Moss is taciturn and bearish as the other is fatuous and talkative.
notes: Fox is the vain star who finds himself tossed between fiction and reality beyond his initial predictions. Woods, focused and essential as always, is the policeman who is frowning and troubled by personal problems. Annabella Sciorra is irresistible as always. Badham is a successful and loose-handed director, but his verve has faded, and he resolves in simple action, between detective and comedy, a subject that could have lent itself to even more demanding variants.

title: The Duellists
actors: Keith Carradine, Harvey Keitel, Cristina Raines, Albert Finney
description: The duel between Lieutenant Hussar Armand d’Hubert and Officer Gabriel Féraud is an endless duel. The latter is a particularly angry type and, after challenging d’Hubert for the first time for a very futile reason, continues to haunt him with subsequent challenges. After the war, which saw them engaged on the same fronts in the various Napoleonic campaigns in which they cover themselves with decorations and promotions, d’Hubert returns home, but Féraud finds a way to make himself alive again ...
notes: Taken from the novel _The duel - Military tale_ by Joseph Conrad, this is Ridley Scott's remarkable first work.

title: The Heartbreak Kid
actors: Claudia Karvan, Alex Dimitriades, Steve Bastoni, Nick Lathouris
description: Christina, a young teacher, and Nick, her 17-year-old pupil, have in common the origin of Greeks who emigrated to Australia. It is precisely because of the ethnic differences that the boy finds it difficult to fit into the school environment. For this Christina takes him under her wing. As sometimes happens in cases like this, an idyll arises between the two: Nick pays her a tender but urgent court and Christina, who already has a boyfriend, does not prove insensitive to her attentions. But Christina, whose family is rather traditional, is presented with a rather difficult choice ...
notes: Born as a theatrical comedy, the story is packaged in a not excellent but acceptable way, with a good script well served by the two main interpreters.

title: Le locataire
actors: Roman Polanski, Isabelle Adjani, Melvyn Douglas, Shelley Winters
description: A modest employee of Polish descent, Trelkovski, is looking for an apartment in Paris. He finds one of a girl, Simone Choule, who attempted suicide by jumping out of the window. Trelkovski goes to the hospital where the girl is dying. Having taken possession of the room, he begins to be subjected to a series of harassment by the tenants (almost all elderly with a disturbing appearance).
notes: . Based on a novel by Roland Topor, it is one of the highest achievements of the Polanskian poetics of everyday life turning into a nightmare. In the Italian, French and English versions, the director voiced himself.

title: Foxes
actors: Jodie Foster, Cherie Currie, Marilyn Kagan, Kandice Stroh
description: Annie, Madge and Deidre live together in Jeanie's house, but they hope they can each have their own quarters. Between the family ones, the school ones and the sentimental ones, they are all full of problems. Once Madge has access to the house of her no longer young friend, the party organized by the girls degenerates. At the time of the reckoning, the balance sheet is far from flattering.
notes: A film by Adrian Lyne recovered on the Italian market after the glories of "9 1/2 weeks", interesting for some narrative solution, but not supported by a rather disordered script. The very young Jodie Foster is already good.

title: Fantozzi in Paradiso
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Milena Vukotic, Anna Mazzamauro, Gigi Reder
description: During the funeral of a friend, Fantozzi has an accident and, at the hospital, he discovers from an x-ray that he is only one week old. His wife decides, in agreement with Miss Silvani, to let him spend a last weekend of extramarital eroticism, but things do not go according to forecasts.
notes: As almost always in the series, you can't say "all good" about the film, but not "all bad" either. There are interesting ideas and there are platitudes. Villaggio always tries hard and leaves the door open for any other chapters. The verve and originality of the first three episodes, however, is only a memory.

title: Fast Company
actors: William Smith, John Saxon, Claudia Jennings, Nicholas Campbell
description: Dragster champion Lonnie dumped by her manager Phil tries to build a career as an independent. Thus he decides to become part of the funny cars category.
notes: It is an anomalous film in Cronenberg's production; unrelated to the horror genre, it rather testifies to the director's passion for the world of motor racing. Long before "Crash"!

title: The Big Land
actors: Alan Ladd, Virginia Mayo, Edmond O'Brien, Anthony Caruso
description: A group of ranchers led by Chad Morgan allies with a group of farmers and together they decide to extend the Kansas City railroad to transform the region into a larger, freer, livestock trading center. The project finds adhesions, but also ruthless adversaries.
notes: Western that tells in a simplistic way the vocation of the pioneers to progress. Ideologically, something sounds a bit false, but the western clichés are all respected and will please fans.

title: D'Annunzio
actors: Robert Powell, Stefania Sandrelli, Florence Guérin, Paolo Bonacelli, Sonia Petrovna
description: D'Annunzio is in Rome, a bored husband and father, plus the prospect of another child on the way. Megalomaniac and candidly penniless, he passes, without apparent commitment, from one city to another. He meets Elvira, he weaves a relationship with her made of passion, which will end up being exhausted in a predictable routine. Faint staging from the novel by Piero Chiara.

title: La ragazza del bersagliere
actors: Graziella Granata, Antonio Casagrande, Tony Renis, Leopoldo Trieste
description: A group of Bersaglieri arrives in a small town in Emilia for the great maneuvers. Among them is Salvatore Caputo who falls in love with Anita in return. The two are already planning the wedding but Antonio takes a bath in the river and dies. The girl tries to console herself with other suitors, but Antonio's ghost puts them all on the run: Anita will join him in the afterlife. Curious and impalpable comedy of theatrical origin, suspended between realism and surrealism.

title: Nicholas and Alexandra
actors: Michael Jayston, Janet Suzman, Laurence Olivier, Michael Redgrave
description: Public and private life of Nicholas II, the last Tsar of Russia, and of Tsarina Alexandra. Inept sovereigns, their end was facilitated by Rasputin's influence and accelerated by the Revolution, up to the shooting with his sons in 1918.
notes: Rich and weighty English production. Two Oscars, for the scenography and costumes.

title: Key Witness
actors: Jeffrey Hunter, Pat Crowley, Dennis Hopper
description: A ferocious thug rages with his gang. Someone overcomes fear and decides to testify against him, but in this way he runs into big trouble. An appreciable suspense film against the backdrop of the then emerging problem of urban violence. In the cast, the "burnt young man" Dennis Hopper.

title: Attack Force Z
actors: John Phillip Law, Sam Neill, Mel Gibson, John Waters (III)
description: World War II: an allied plane crashes on an islet transformed into a bridgehead by the Japanese navy. The crew is saved but is not convinced that they have been lucky. The "Japs" are pressing, and only a commando of guerrilla experts can get the survivors out of trouble.
notes: War film reminiscent of certain American productions such as "Missing in action". Abuse of stereotypes, however, with a certain rhythm. To report some well-known faces next to the protagonist John Philip Law ("Diabolik"). Australian Mel Gibson and New Zealander Sam Neill, still far from becoming international stars, stand out.

title: The Jayne Mansfield Story
actors: Loni Anderson, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Raymond Buktenica
description: The life of the explosive and platinum-plated Hollywood sex symbol of the 1950s. Typical product for TV. In the cast also Arnold Schwarzenegger.

title: Man on a Swing
actors: Cliff Robertson, Joel Grey, Dorothy Tristan
description: A self -styled medium helps an investigator to solve a turbid murder case. Tortuous and dilated, based on a true story.

title: La moglie del prete
actors: Sophia Loren, Marcello Mastroianni, Pippo Starnazza, Venantino Venantini
description: Valeria is a former singer of Neapolitan origin saved from an attempted suicide. She discovers that the voice she had listened to on the phone of "Voce amica" and that had deeply affected her was that of a priest, Don Mario. She falls in love with him and, little by little, he too falls in love with her. But, called to Rome and become monsignor, he will have to make a choice.
notes: Seventh film starring the Loren / Mastroianni couple. Risi, in those years with a somewhat tarnished vein, portrays his couple against the backdrop of the backward Italian province.

title: The Carey Treatment
actors: James Coburn, Dan O'Herlihy, Melissa Torme-March, Robert Mandan
description: A girl dies of a clandestine abortion, a doctor (Coburn) investigates and risks her life. Thriller with moralizing pretensions, at times vigorous.

title: The Good Earth
actors: Paul Muni, Luise Rainer, Walter Connolly, Tilly Losch
description: A Chinese peasant family suddenly becomes rich. As the (non-Chinese) saying goes, wealth doesn't always bring happiness. In fact, the sudden well-being in the family gives rise to a series of big troubles.
notes: The film is based on a novel by Pearl S. Buck. Oscar for photography to Karl Freund and for the female protagonist Luise Rainer.

title: One Two Buckle My Shoe
actors: David Suchet, Philip Jackson, Carolyn Colquhoun, Joanna Phillips-Lane
description: The first victim is a dentist. Poirot investigates, gathers the usual suspects, engages in his brilliant deductions, but gets nothing out of it. The second murder is that of a former theater actress and the investigator is not unbalanced, indeed the case begins to make him nervous. But it is on the third dead that it becomes clear that there is someone trying to throw red herrings between the legs of the unreachable Belgian detective. Again the South African Ross Devenish directing an episode of the series starring David Suchet. We find the usual Inspector Japp, but not the faithful Hastings. We also find the reassuring predictability of the plots conceived by Christie.

title: Bmx Bandits
actors: Nicole Kidman, David Argue, John Ley, Angelo D'Angelo
description: We are near Sidney in the midst of a group of fanatic kids for Bmx, a special type of cross bike. Our heroes, Povic, P. J. and Judy, would have no intention of becoming such if they did not by chance find hot goods: radio tuned to police frequencies, which should be used by burglars. And so the adventure begins. Lots of excitement, good pace, great photography by John Seale. It's a classic teen movie, with a baby Nicole Kidman.

title: Bram Stoker's Dracula
actors: Gary Oldman, Winona Ryder, Anthony Hopkins, Keanu Reeves, Sadie Frost, Richard E. Grant, Cary Elwes, Billy Campbell, Tom Waits, Monica Bellucci, Micaela Bercu, Florina Kendrick, Jay Robinson
description: In 1462 the armies of the Transylvanian prince Vlad defeated the Muslims. Elizabeth is driven to suicide by a false message announcing the death of her husband. Following this dramatic event, Vlad vows forever to Evil, thus becoming the immortal Dracula. Four centuries later he receives in his castle the young London real estate agent Jonathan Harker, engaged to the diaphanous Mina whose features are identical to those of Elizabeth. The vampire decides to move to Victorian London after temporarily knocking out Jonathan. Arrived at his destination, the prince vampirizes Lucy, a casual friend of Mina's also close to the wedding, but before he can do the same with Mina he finds himself facing the Dutch professor Van Helsing, who gives him a fierce battle. Meanwhile, Jonathan manages to escape from Transylvania. The showdown is near and, after a hellish gallop on the way back, Vlad, Mina, Jonathan, Van Helsing and other characters find themselves in Dracula's castle as the sun is about to rise ...
notes: Coppola carries out a rereading job on the original text which, while keeping the form unchanged, exasperates its content. Great interpretation of Gary Oldman, who gives face and body to an anthology Dracula. Oscar for costumes (Eiko Ishioka), sound effects editing and makeup. Soundtrack with the voices of Diamanda Galas and Annie Lennox. In minor parts Tom Waits and the Italian Monica Bellucci.

title: The Lolly Madonna War
actors: Rod Steiger, Robert Ryan, Jeff Bridges, Scott Wilson, Season Hubley
description: Laban Feather inherited a piece of land and little ability to preserve it from his Cherokee ancestors. So his lands are auctioned off and bought by Pap Gutshall. At that point war breaks out between the two families. The Gutshalls destroy the underground Feather distillery. They react by killing Pap's wife. This rural melodrama is not director Sarafian's best thing. Robert Ryan, here in his latest film, also deserved to end his career better.

title: Cento anni d'amore
actors: Aldo Fabrizi, Vittorio De Sica, Maurice Chevalier, Gabriele Ferzetti
description: A Garibaldian and the parish priest's niece: when the papal troops counterattack, the priest helps the red shirts. Adulterous relationships in Roman high society of the late nineteenth century. A girl is not worthy to receive the latest message from her man who fell in the Great War. A couple of emigrants in Switzerland do not like fascist Italy. A partisan sentenced to death in 1944 and his wife.
notes: Even without being able to boast particular merits, the film is certainly decent and not lacking, in its best moments, of effective scenes. An average product of discreet workmanship, in which the interpreters honestly do their part.

title: Le sorprese dell'amore
actors: Walter Chiari, Sylva Koscina, Franco Fabrizi, Anna Maria Ferrero, Dorian Gray, Silvana Pampanini
description: The shy Ferdinando is engaged to the exuberant and extrovert Didì, his enterprising friend Battista with the shy and romantic Marianna. Maybe it would be better to swap boyfriends, the two girls think. Hence the maneuvers to make the unsuspecting young men fall in love with each other's girlfriend. The matter presents some complications, but in the end, somehow, everything works out.
notes: The starting point is too thin to withstand the entire duration of the film. Comencini gets along.

title: Gli attendenti
actors: Gino Cervi, Vittorio De Sica, Renato Rascel, Luigi Pavese
description: Five recruits are assigned, as attendants, to five officers. One falls in love with the colonel's daughter, another arranges his mother's wedding, the third places his wife as the colonel's maid, the fourth is in the service of the newly married lieutenant, the fifth suffers from jealousy.
notes: More than a screenplay, the whole of these stories is a tangled skein that the director is unable to unravel. The humor is mediocre in tone and the actors do little to improve the situation.

title: Arriva la bufera
actors: Diego Abatantuono, Margherita Buy, Silvio Orlando, Marina Confalone, Angela Finocchiaro
description: Upon his arrival in the southern town to which he was destined, Judge Fortezza (Diego Abatantuono) finds a very clear situation: the whole town is controlled by the three sisters Emma, ??Esmeralda and Eugenia Fontana. Who acts as fixer is the solitude lawyer, Eugenia's next husband. Fortezza falls in love with Eugenia and puts her future husband in jail, then the nearby volcano awakens. Luchetti is that of "Domani accadrà" and "Portaborse". Here he lets himself be tempted by the metaphoric cinema complete with a rain of garbage in the finale. It is a serious weakness that not even the presence of Orlando, Buy and Abatantuono can hide.

title: The Prime of Miss Jean Brodie
actors: Maggie Smith, Robert Stephens, Pamela Franklin, Gordon Jackson
description: The strict and impeccable "Marcia Blaine" girls' boarding school in Edinburgh officially opens the 1932 school year. The faculty is distinguished by Miss Jean Brodie, a mature teacher with many ideas about life, somewhat personal and not all orthodox. Her pupils adore her, then they fear her, but basically they remain quite upset. From a novel by Muriel Spark. Oscar, well deserved, for Maggie Smith.

title: The Strawberry Statement
actors: Bruce Davison, Kim Darby, Bud Cort, Murray McLeod
description: A playground of an American university is set aside for the training of soldiers leaving for Vietnam and a riot breaks out on the campus. Simon looks at things with a certain detachment, then he meets Linda and thanks to her he understands that there is much more to the reasons for the dispute. Eventually, when the police arrive to forcibly evict them, Simon will know which side to stand on. After Easy Rider, this is the film that has most directly affected public opinion, not only in America. Revised today it may seem a bit naive (Hagman's direction isn't overwhelming), but it still retains some of the vibe of the time. The final scene of the charge against the students is famous.

title: L'homme blessé
actors: Jean-Hugues Anglade, Vittorio Mezzogiorno, Lisa Kreuzer, Roland Bertin, Annick Alane, Sophie Edmond, Claude Berri, Gérard Desarthe, Hammou Graïa, Armin Mueller-Stahl, Roland Chalosse
description: Henri (Anglade), eighteen, met Jean (Noon) at the station. Indeed in the station toilets while Jean was beating up an elderly man. From fear, to attraction, to obsession, the step is not very short, but Henri takes it. Jean tries to discourage him, to distance him from his world, almost to protect it. Then he gives in, even physically, and that's the end.
notes: Third film by director Patrice Chéreau, more than theater than cinema, known to the general public for the historical fresco "Queen Margot". There is a lot of Jean Genet in the conception of this film and there are good actors. It is a pity that the author's cinematographic conception is cumbersome, pretentiously provocative, visually annoying.

title: Soldati e caporali
actors: Tony Renis, Gabriele Antonini, Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia
description: Jokes, jokes and songs in an infantry unit put up for competition with one from the navy. Tony Renis sings a couple of songs, Franco and Ciccio make an appearance.

title: Dressed to Kill
actors: Nancy Allen, Michael Caine, Angie Dickinson, Keith Gordon
description: Kate Miller is being treated by Dr. Robert Elliott for ailments related to sexual dissatisfaction. One day the woman is murdered with razors. Liz witnesses the crime, a young call girl who sees the killer: a blonde woman. Liz, distraught, picks up the bloody razor from the ground and is therefore strongly suspected by police lieutenant Marino. Meanwhile, a transsexual named Bobby telephones Dr. Elliott, of whom he is a patient, accusing himself of the crime and announcing that of the witness.
notes: De Palma revisits Hitchcock's lesson in the light of an aesthetic of violence and sexuality (man-woman ambiguity, voyeurism, perversion, deviance). Flesh and blood mix with splendid moments of cinema (the pursuit of the museum), quotes and baroque suspense. The music of Pino Donaggio also contributed to the success of the film.

title: Bingo
actors: David Rasche, Cindy Williams, Robert J. Steinmiller jr.
description: The Bingo dog is a mutt collected by circus owners. But when he refuses to perform the fire jump number, he is thrown out. He becomes inseparable friend of little Chuckie after saving him from drowning. The boy and the mutt don't separate even when Chuckie moves in. It will still be the little dog who will save his life by extracting him from the flames of a fire and at the same time overcoming his phobia for fire.
notes: It is a film that takes the anthropomorphization process of animals on the screen to excess, often bordering on the typical universe of cartoons. Between parodies and some successful sequences, however, a beautiful story of friendship unfolds.

title: The Preppie Murder
actors: Danny Aiello, William Baldwin, Joanna Kerns, Lara Flynn Boyle
description: Jennifer got a crush on the edge of obsession with Rob. However, he is not a type, he is always without a penny, looking for cocaine and in the middle of an undergrowth of half-notch criminals. When Jennifer starts buzzing around him, Rob finds no reason to deny himself an easy easy adventure. Jennifer, dumped without too many compliments, one evening still manages to take the boy out of the pub to take a stroll with him through the dark streets of the city. The next morning, Jennifer's battered body is found in the bushes of Central Park and it is almost inevitable that Rob is the first to be suspected. It is the story of the sensational trial of Rob Chambers which in 1987 made the headlines of newspapers in America. Aside from that, the film has a good cast and poor appeal.

title: Speriamo che sia femmina
actors: Liv Ullmann, Philippe Noiret, Bernard Blier, Catherine Deneuve, Stefania Sandrelli, Lucrezia Lante Della Rovere, Giuliana De Sio
description: Elena, Count Leonardo's separated wife, lives in a farmhouse in the Tuscan countryside. With her are the youngest daughter, an old uncle, the administrator and the Fosca maid with her daughter. Count Leonardo, always on the hunt for money, shows up at the farmhouse with his lover to ask for yet another loan from his ex-wife. The eldest daughter also reaches the farmhouse with her boyfriend. In a car accident Leonardo dies and Elena wants to sell the estate. But when the contract is ready, the eldest daughter leaves her boyfriend, the younger one returns from Rome, Fosca renounces to join her husband in Australia, because she discovers that there she has already rebuilt a family.
notes: Monicelli throws a look, more merciless than the lightness of the film reveals, on the male universe, enhancing the female one. Verbose and a little rhetorical, the film, however, has a supebo parterre of actresses on its side.

title: Der Stand der Dinge
actors: Patrick Bauchau, Viva Auder, Samuel Fuller, Allen Goorwitz, Paul Getty III
description: A group of people, dressed in overalls and with their faces covered, is advancing in a desert region to the sea. They appeared in a science fiction film. The operator informs the director that he has run out of film: the production stops. The crew is housed in a dilapidated oceanfront hotel in Portugal. Director Fritz tries to get in touch with the producer in Los Angeles and, failing to find him, leaves for the American city. Wenders signs one of his masterpieces (Golden Lion in Venice) between exasperated intimacy and bitter reflection on cinema and death. Photograph by Henri Alekan and prominent role for director Fuller.

title: Shameful Secrets
actors: Joanna Kerns, Tim Matheson, Teresa Saldana
description: Maryanne Walkes has been living for some time with the nightmare of being beaten by her husband. The continuous violence to which the man subjects her does not cease even in the presence of her two children, little Jason and Josie. One day she is even hospitalized and, when she comes out, her husband throws her out of the house: she asks for a divorce and keeps the children. The woman then kidnaps them and runs away with them to another city under a false name. The pretext of the film is that, noble, of addressing the problem of violence in the home. Even if the story told is not exempt from an excess of dramatization, especially in the brutality displayed.

title: Rock'n' Roll Mom
actors: Dyan Cannon, Michael Brandon, Thelma Hopkins, Heather Locklear
description: A housewife, who lives in a suburban neighborhood with teenage children, suddenly becomes a pop star. Lovely Disney fairy tale.

title: The Crowd Roars
actors: Robert Taylor, Frank Morgan, Edward Arnold, Maureen O'Sullivan
description: Young boxer is involved in the world of the underworld, also because of a father who likes to raise his elbow. Melodrama without genius, but with excellent characterizations.

title: Right Cross
actors: Dick Powell, June Allyson, Lionel Barrymore, Ricardo Montalban
description: Monterez (Montalban), medium weight world champion, realizes that he has serious problems in one hand so that his career is practically finished. He therefore lets himself be convinced to play rigged encounters in order to put aside a nice nest egg and get married to the woman he loves, daughter of his old manager (Barrymore). The latter, however, leaves him, while his girlfriend (Allyson) and a journalist friend (Powell) try in every way to make him change his mind.
notes: The actors save a film for the rest very weak, on a rather obvious theme. Sturges gave the best in the western and its surroundings ("cursed day").

title: Presenting Lily Mars
actors: Judy Garland, Van Heflin, Fay Bainter, Richard Carlson
description: A very determined girl reaches the pinnacle of success on Broadway. Nothing new, but pleasant. The film strangely did not come out in Italy at the time, and has only recently been seen on TV.

title: Battle Circus
actors: Humphrey Bogart, June Allyson, Keenan Wynn, Robert Keith
description: Misunderstandings and past bitterness stand in the way of the love between Humphrey Bogart and June Allyson, officers of a field hospital in the horror of the Korean War. There is dramatic force, but overall the film is a bit flat and slips into sentimentality despite the direction of the excellent Brooks and the actors.

title: Enrico Caruso, leggenda di una voce
actors: Ermanno Randi, Gina Lollobrigida, Maurizio Di Nardo, Carlo Scafa
description: The son of Neapolitan workers (with his father opposing his son to study singing), Enrico Caruso falls in love with the granddaughter of a failed entrepreneur, Stella. Later, his mother who was convinced of his singing abilities died, Caruso studies with an excellent teacher and continues to think about Stella. After mediocre experiences, the triumph in Trapani, the woman present. Enrico and Stella, however, will never see each other again. The character was a great lyricist, but the film about him is an unpretentious and unimportant little thing, told within the limits of decorum but with little bite. The whole realization is dedicated to a small, modest anonymous craftsmanship.

title: In weiter Ferne, so nah!
actors: Otto Sander, Willem Dafoe, Bruno Ganz, Solveig Dommartin, Nastassja Kinski
description: Six years ago the angel Damiel chose to be a man for the love of Marion (The sky above Berlin). Now Cassiel also makes the same choice to save a little girl. Berlin, once the wall fell, has changed and the new man has to deal with the new situation. To put an end to an arms trade, Cassiel organizes a coup against the gangster who protects him. The enterprise succeeds, but Cassiel pays with his life. A few narrative inventions of splendid visionary nature are not enough to redeem a film as ambitious as it is substantially unsolved: a wrong film, with beautiful moments. What Mikhail Gorbachev is doing in the role of himself remains an unfathomable mystery.

title: Trois couleurs - Rouge
actors: Irène Jacob, Jean-Louis Trintignant, Jean-Pierre Lorit, Frédérique Feder
description: Valentine, a model from Geneva, casually meets a former judge who intercepts phone calls from neighbors. At first scandalized, the girl is increasingly attracted to the human "mystery" of the magistrate. Meanwhile, a young neighbor of his unconsciously repeats the stages in the life of the elderly lawyer. Destiny is lurking and intervenes in the lives of all the characters. Splendid closing of the Kieslowski trilogy, wonderfully constructed and narrated, with excellent interpretations. Complex characters acutely analyzed, a perfect mechanism of the cinematic story, a fascinating and precious overall outcome.
notes: Splendid closing of the Kieslowski trilogy, wonderfully constructed and narrated, with excellent interpretations. Complex characters acutely analyzed, a perfect mechanism of the cinematic story, a fascinating and precious overall outcome.

title: Radio Flyer
actors: Lorraine Bracco, John Heard, Adam Baldwin, Elijah Wood, Joseph Mazzello, Garette Ratliff Henson
description: Two siblings with wild imaginations suddenly have to face a new and risky situation. Their world of childhood dreams and monsters is invaded by a real monster: a psychically unstable stepfather. The two brothers do not lose heart and once again resort to their visionary skills: "The Big Idea", an extraordinary escape project, in which magic plays a central role: the older brother will take the smallest's red cart and will transform it into a superpowered machine, with which they can soar and fly away forever.
notes: Donner is a filmmaker accustomed to big budgets, stellar castes, companies with a high commercial rate. This film is ideally deployed in defense of all child victims of adults but, despite the profuse means, it remains above all a missed opportunity.

title: Thicker Than Blood: The Larry McLinden Story
actors: Peter Strauss, Rachel Ticotin, Lynn Whitfield, Bob Dishy, Brenda Bazinet
description: Larry McLinden (Peter Strauss) cannot complain. He is happily married to Diane (Rachel Ticotin) and has a five -year -old son he loves. He who had an unhappy childhood because of the lack of his father, now he makes everything to stay close to his son. Then suddenly Diane leaves him taking the child away. Larry gets in his hand to a lawyer, claims his son's custody, but Diane does not give up. The translation of the original title is something analogous to the phrase "Blood is not water". Dinner dives into this family tangle with discreet results. Rachel Ticotin was the female protagonist, next to Schwarzenegger, in the act of strength.

title: Falling Down
actors: Michael Douglas, Robert Duvall, Barbara Hershey, Rachel Ticotin
description: William Foster is stuck in a giant traffic jam and it's hot in Los Angeles. He abandons the car to go and call his wife, from whom he is divorced, and for a disagreement with the owner of a drugstore he becomes violent to the point of breaking up the place. From that moment William never stops: he beats whoever he finds and kills whoever comes within range until ...
notes: Michael Duglass, in one of his best interpretations, drags us into the hell of the average man and avenges him (hypothetically) for all his frustrations. Joel Schumacher captures the spirit of an era well, the end of hedonism, thanks also to supporting actors in a state of grace, Duvall above all.

title: Truly Madly Deeply
actors: Juliet Stevenson, Alan Rickman, Bill Paterson, Michael Maloney
description: Nina still hasn't recovered from the death of her man, Jamie. The fact is that she still feels him present in her London home, so present that Jamie returns as a ghost one night. Things go well for a while until he gets too pushy: he rearranges her apartment, invites her ghost friends over. Then Nina meets Mark and finally breaks free from her obsessions. Don't get confused: this is not Ghost, Juliet Stevenson is not as weepy as Demi Moore and the whole story is more ironic and subtle than that of the Zucker movie. Minghella writes the part on Juliet Stevenson and wins a tough bet.

title: The Culpepper Cattle Company
actors: Billy Green Bush, Gary Grimes, Luke Askew, Bo Hopkins
description: Ben Mockridge dreams of the adventurous life of the cowboys. For this he joins, as an assistant cook, Frank Culpepper who has to bring his herd to Fort Lewis. During the trip, however, there are thefts of livestock, shootings with bandits and violence of all kinds. Ben will also end up having to kill a man. Path of a boy from illusion to disenchantment: the Great West is not that of myth but the violent one where the law of the strongest is in force. A typical, successful anti-western from the 1970s.

title: Cagliostro
actors: Bekim Fehmiu, Curd Jürgens, Evelyn Stewart, Luigi Pistilli, Rosanna Schiaffino, Massimo Girotti, Anna Orso
description: Count Alessandro di Cagliostro wanders the courts of Europe, together with Countess Serafina. Introduced by a naturalist monk to the activities of healer through herbs and telepathy, he amazes anyone who witnesses his para-scientific practices. In Rome, Pope Clement XIII becomes a friend and heals a cardinal, future pontiff with the name of Pius VI. But the Vatican Curia does not look favorably on him and is plotting to frame him. To betray him will be the gloomy prophecies made to Marie Antoinette, wife of Louis XVI of France. Accused of superstition, he was first sentenced to death by the Inquisition and then locked up for life in the fortress of San Leo in Montefeltro. Fictionalized and not too compelling biography of the healing magician.

title: L'amante scomoda
actors: Linda Carol, Frank Angelini, Antonio Zequila, Geoffrey Copleston
description: A professional aspires to a promotion, but having a beautiful lover in need of attention severely hampers his career opportunities. However, a killer enters the scene and tries to kill the girl: does the killer have a principal?
notes: The cast is, now as then, completely unknown to the general public (except "er Pant" Antonio Zequila, recently returned to the honors - so to speak - of the news thanks to the Island of the Famous). The plot is immediately tinged with yellow, but the screenplay often leaks; furthermore Russo, although he does his best, is really not a director.

title: Of Pure Blood
actors: Lee Remick, Patrick McGoohan, Gottfried John, Katharina Bohm
description: An American woman (Remick) returns to her native Germany to rediscover her tragic past. A reflection on death and Nazism with the re-enactment of Himmler's "Lebensborn". Produced for TV, rather ambitious but of little substance.

title: Il pirata del diavolo
actors: Richard Harrison, Paolo Solvay, Walter Brandy, Annamaria Ubaldi
description: The bitter struggle between Marco Trevisan and the Turk Rabenek known by all as "the devil's pirate" in an imaginary city of Venetian rule temporarily occupied by privateers. After the first defeats, Marco manages to prevail thanks also to the decisive help of a woman, the daughter of a Turkish leader. The final showdown will be terrible and the "happy ending" is behind the door.
notes: Autarchic swashbuckling, shot quickly and with very modest technical contributions.

title: Germinal
actors: Renaud Sechand, Gérard Depardieu, Miou-Miou, Jean Carmet
description: The young Etienne arrived in a mining town in the north of France. The man finds work, in place of a miner who died in an accident, in the team of Maheu, father of five children. And with one of these daughters he begins to flirt, but then she leaves him for another. Meanwhile, the discontent among the miners grows and leads to a strike. Great French production based on a famous novel by Emile Zola. The result, however, is schematic and disappointing. Gérard Depardieu (in the role of Maheu) is saved exclusively by virtue of his own qualities, but it is not enough, alone, to save the film.

title: Matinée
actors: John Goodman, Cathy Moriarty, Simon Fenton, Lisa Jakub, Dick Miller
description: October 1962: the world is on the verge of a world conflict due to the Cuban crisis, but for the young Gene from Key West the most exciting event is the arrival of Lawrence Wolsey, a truly unique director, with his latest film. of the horror "Mant!". In fact, it is Gene who takes care of the premieres of his films, who organizes the advertising and a whole series of small tricks capable of electrifying the public.
notes: Halfway between "as we were" and "as we were ugly", Joe Dante continues to demonstrate more intelligence than many other colleagues. Here he combines the climate of anti-communist paranoia with the affectionate memory of the old Serie B cinema.

title: Bhowani Junction
actors: Ava Gardner, Stewart Granger, Bill Travers, Francis Matthews
description: Victoria (Gardner), daughter of an Englishman and an Indian, lives with difficulty in the moment: she has enlisted as an auxiliary and she is in love with the half-breed Taylor and the English Savage. A terrorist uses her to organize an attack against Gandhi and the two men team up to save her: Taylor will die and Savage will marry Victoria. Ava Gardner is splendidly convincing in the role of the half-breed, more so than the film itself. Cukor's hand is more suited to brilliant comedy, but even in this adventure drama it doesn't fail to make itself heard. Excellent Gardner.

title: The Vanishing
actors: Jeff Bridges, Kiefer Sutherland, Sandra Bullock, Nancy Travis
description: Jeff and Diane are on vacation in Oregon. They stop at a gas station, she gets out for a moment and never comes back. The investigations lead to nothing and so, three years later, there is still only Jeff who is committed to the search for the truth. And, finally, after three years something seems to clear up: there is a trace that leads to a certain Barney Cousin, a respectable chemist, but not entirely sane. George Sluizer had already made this film in France. Then the Americans liked the story and that's how he was offered the opportunity to do it all over again, but with a lot more money. The original film was not good, this is slightly better.

title: Carlito's Way
actors: Al Pacino, Sean Penn, Penelope Ann Miller, John Leguizamo
description: Carlito Brigante (Pacino) manages to escape from jail by a miracle thanks to the quibbles of his lawyer friend Kleinfeld (Penn). Back in freedom, he would like to close with the past, raise the money to open a car rental and abandon the life of the gangster. But things aren't that easy and when Kleinfeld, who got into trouble with a drug boss, asks for help, he can't say no.
notes: Everything already seen in this film by De Palma. The story is predictable but Pacino is amazing, Sean Penn is almost unrecognizable but completely unsurpassable. And above all De Palma (look at the sequence of the billiard room) the camera really knows how to use it.

title: Hot Shots! Part Deux
actors: Charlie Sheen, Valeria Golino, Lloyd Bridges, Jerry Haleva, Richard Crenna
description: A Middle Eastern dictator holds three American soldiers prisoner. Three rescue missions fail. Only Topper Harley can succeed where so many braves have failed and Topper decides to intervene after Colonel Denton Walters has also fallen into the hands of the enemy. All sorts of things happen, of course, but in the end our folks return home safe and sound. Jim Abrahams' secret is not to try to "renew himself", nor are his strong points "smart" winks. His cinema is pure madness, which points straight to the most blatant and therefore more effective predictability. It is impossible to imitate him.

title: The Private Life of Sherlock Holmes
actors: Robert Stephens, Colin Blakely, Irene Handl, Christopher Lee, Geraldine Page
description: One evening at Holmes's house a woman who is desperate for the disappearance of her husband, a Belgian engineer, shows up. Together with his loyal Watson, the famous detective leaves for Scotland and ends up in an inn on the shores of Loch Ness. That's when Watson thinks he's seeing a monster, which is actually a submarine. Just as the distraught woman who "hired" them turns out to be a German spy. Atypical as both a Holmes film and a Wilder film. Too private, with allusions to misogyny and drugs, compared to the classic Holmesian iconography. Too romantic compared to the proverbial Wilderian malice. A great movie.

title: Per grazia ricevuta
actors: Nino Manfredi, Lionel Stander, Delia Boccardo, Mariangela Melato
description: Out of remorse for not having confessed a "very serious" sin to the parish priest, little Benedict falls off a cliff and gets up unscathed: convinced that he has been miraculous, he spends his youth in a convent waiting for a sign that induces him to take the votes. But this sign does not arrive and Benedetto returns to the world, becomes a friend of Oreste - an atheist pharmacist and free thinker - and above all of his daughter ...
notes: The first feature film made by Nino Manfredi is a bizarre film in terms of subject and narrative tone: a good intertwining between popular ballad and comedy of manners around a risky theme such as that of the marriage between religion and superstition.

title: When a Stranger Calls
actors: Carol Kane, Charles Durning, Colleen Dewhurst, Tony Beckley
description: Did you check the children? Says the man on the phone to babysitter Jill Johnson. She calls the police, but from the switchboard they just have time to tell her that the calls come from the same house: the madman is therefore already in action. Jill is saved with the arrival of the police, the children are not. The man goes to jail, but escapes after seven years. Meanwhile, Jill got married, had two children and the situation repeats itself.
notes: The idea of ??the film is so good that Fred Walton doesn't mind using it twice in a row. After all, when the film comes out in daylight, much of the tension is lost. Walton himself (Murders of the Rosary) has never been so good again.

title: Obiettivo ragazze raggiunto Stop missione compiuta
actors: Walter Chiari, Carlo Campanini, Alighiero Noschese, Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Antonella Steni, Elio Pandolfi
description: Ordinary military life stories told at a gathering of ex-combatants. There is the soldier who, thinking of going to a brothel, ends up in the house where the three sisters of his terrible sergeant major live. There is the sailor who, under hypnosis, believes he has changed his sex. Finally, there is the conscript who, in order to avoid the call to arms, courts the daughter of the marshal, then marries her and becomes a career soldier.
notes: Franchi and Ingrassia appear marginally, the Chiari-Campanini duo cannot go beyond the routine. Little more than barracks stories, very dated too.

title: Damage
actors: Jeremy Irons, Juliette Binoche, Miranda Richardson, Rupert Graves
description: Stephen Fleming is undersecretary in the British government: married, has a son, who works as a journalist. His life runs smoothly, but one day he meets his son's girlfriend, Anna. Passion is unleashed between the two. In Anna's past there is a brother who committed suicide due to their incestuous love. Stephen's existence is upset; but one day, by chance, Stephen's son discovers the two lovers in bed in the apartment in preparation for the wedding. The theme of passion capable of ruining lives is certainly not new. Malle tries to get out of the trap with the subtleties of directing and acting, but the results are not always at his height.

title: Shadows and Fog
