actors: Woody Allen, Mia Farrow, John Malkovich, Madonna, Jodie Foster, Kathy Bates, Donald Pleasence
description: A strangler wanders through the streets of a central European city of the 1920s. Kleinman, a trembling Jewish clerk, is involved by his fellow citizens in the hunt for the killer. He finds himself alone, frightened and without instructions, in the night. Her drama is intertwined with that of Irmy, the sword-eater of the circus camped in the city, who fled after finding Paul, her man, in the arms of the trapeze artist. Overnight, shame and virtue of many will come to a head before the wizard Armstroff makes the killer and Kleinman vanish ...
notes: In adapting an old pèce of his, Allen plays with the atmospheres of expressionist cinema (evident the reference to "M", the music is by Kurt Weill), to outline the not too captivating moral profile of human coexistence between drama and humor.

title: La chartreuse de Parme
actors: Gérard Philipe, Maria Casarès, Maria Michi, Tina Lattanzi, Louis Salou, Tullio Carminati, Renée Faure
description: After joining the Napoleonic army, Fabrizio Del Dongo joins his aunt, the Duchess of Sanseverina, in Parma, who is burning with passion for him. Arrested due to a duel, he falls in love with Clelia, the daughter of the governor of the prison.
notes: Spectacular, but banal adaptation of Stendhal's novel.

title: Totò contro i quattro
actors: Totò, Aldo Fabrizi, Erminio Macario, Peppino De Filippo, Rossella Como
description: The day starts badly for a poor police commissioner whose car was stolen. And it gets worse and worse, with a man who brings a parrot as a witness to his wife's infidelity, a madman who mistakes a group of actors for bandits, a priest who knows all the shady criminals in the city.
notes: Totò is always good even if he is now very old. He is surrounded by tried and tested comedians of his age who are content to act as his shoulder. Some moments of fun.

title: Nora Prentiss
actors: Ann Sheridan, Kent Smith, Bruce Bennett, Robert Alda
description: A San Francisco doctor, Richard Talbot, all devoted to family and profession, loses his head for a singer, Nora. One day one of his patients has a heart attack and the doctor replaces his documents with those of the dead man, then makes his body disappear by staging a car accident to flee to New York with the girl. The police, however, suspect that the doctor has been murdered and arrive on his trail. Talbot lets himself be arrested without revealing his true identity. Interesting example of a mixture of noir and melodrama, well interpreted by the two protagonists. Perhaps the best Sherman movie.

title: Oh, What a Lovely War
actors: Laurence Olivier, Dirk Bogarde, John Gielgud, Ralph Richardson
description: At the outbreak of the First World War, the enthusiasm of the high English military spheres skyrockets: the war propaganda exalts heroism and patriotism. The five Smith brothers, on the wave of enthusiasm, enlist, but they will die at the front. Antimilitarist film in a musical comedy key. Behind the fun, however, you can glimpse the horror of war. Excellent cast.

title: Army of Darkness
actors: Bruce Campbell, Embeth Davidtz, Marcus Gilbert, Bridget Fonda
description: Ash, a not too shrewd boy, a supermarket clerk, is thrown back in time to the time when Lord Arthur ruled and fought against his mysterious enemies. Ash immediately ends up in a kind of jail that is actually a pit of horrors, but he manages to get out thanks to the use of a chainsaw that he applies to his missing right arm. The only chance for Ash to return to his world is to find the "Necronomicon", a book made of human skin, which contains the right formula. The search is not easy and also involves a battle with the skeletons. Third episode of the saga started by Sam Raimi with "The house". Here some production problems make the path uncertain, but the clash with the dead (a tribute to Ray Harryhausen) is an anthology piece.

title: Universal Soldier
actors: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Dolph Lundgren, Ally Walker, Ed O'Ross
description: Sergeant Scott and Private Luc died in Vietnam in 1969. Scott actually killed Luc, but what matters is that the two were transported to the United States and, in great secrecy, cryogenized to be good later. . Several years later Scott and Luc are invincible soldiers, used for counter-terrorist operations. But Luc is always good, while Scott continues to be a murderous fanatic.

title: Showdown in Little Tokyo
actors: Dolph Lundgren, Brandon Lee, Tia Carrere
description: Yakuza from Japan have landed in the Little Tokyo neighborhood of Los Angeles. The terrible mafiosi are determined to impose their law and their traffic on the neighborhood after eliminating the local boss and other possible competitors. Two policemen are tasked with dealing with the ferocity of this rival gang war: Chris, an American who grew up in Japan, and Johnny, a Japanese-American. The film would like to mix traces of Hong Kong action with Hollywood tradition, but Lester has no pulse and the production is of series B.

title: Doc Hollywood
actors: Michael J. Fox, Julie Warner, Barnard Hughes, Woody Harrelson
description: Ben Stone is headed to Los Angeles, towards a golden career as a plastic surgeon. But in a small town he has a car accident and is sentenced to work in the local hospital. Stone grudgingly accepts, but soon learns to love his patients; so when his Porsche is destroyed while he is giving birth to a girl in the middle of the night, the community "frees" him from his commitment. But in California, Ben realizes that his heart has remained in the village ... Polite comedy, but predictable. Englishman Michael Caton-Jones is here on his American debut: it is clear that the production did not intend to give him more and that, after all, it was fine with him.

title: Now, Voyager
actors: Bette Davis, Claude Rains, Paul Henreid, Gladys Cooper
description: Charlotte, the unwanted and neurotic daughter of a Boston matriarch, falls in love with an unhappily married man. The two would like to love each other, but the obstacles are too many, starting with the family situation of him, the father of a daughter with serious mental problems. After ups and downs Charlotte agrees to nurse the girl.
notes: It is a classic of melodrama, the first of a splendid trilogy that Rapper dedicated to Davis. Oscar for the music of Max Steiner.

title: Quatermass and the Pit
actors: James Donald, Andrew Keir, Barbara Shelley, Julian Glover
description: In the basement of the London Underground, semi-human skeletons are clearly alien. When the excavation is opened to the public it generates a powerful destructive energy. Third (and best) episode of the famous doctor's saga.

title: Gli orizzonti del sole
actors: Nelly Corradi, Alvaro Piccardi, Enrico Pea, Pina Piovani, Domenico Ruffoni
description: The 11-year-old son of a singer escapes by boat from the boarding school on Lake Maggiore, where he was parked by his mother. A naturalist philosopher collects him half-drowned on the shore of an island, healing him in body and soul. Naive and cloying psycho-pedagogical fable.

title: Rock'n'roll
actors: Rodolfo Banchelli, Rosaria Biccica, Leo Gullotta, Macha Meril
description: Rodolfo and Ornella are together, both in life and in dance which is their main passion. At the first disagreement, however, the two split up and, after some skirmishes, they reunite to win the acrobatic rock'n'roll world championship. There are no words to define this film.

title: Sbamm!
actors: Ezio Greggio, Valeria D'Obici, El Pasador, Cristina Moffa
description: Mr. Pallone (Ezio Greggio) is not very satisfied with either his life or his job as a switchboard operator. His neighbor, the victim of atrocious jokes, pays the price in particular. But even with his girlfriend things are not going very well, so much so that in order to please him she persuades her father to fulfill Mr. Pallone's secret dream: to become an orchestra conductor. Absolute sculpt, it is the attempt to cast Greggio as a surreal comedian a la Nichetti before his television hits. You never laugh.

title: Extreme Prejudice
actors: Nick Nolte, Powers Boothe, Michael Ironside, Maria Conchita Alonso
description: In a country on the border with Mexico, Sheriff Jack Benteen (Nolte) has a problem with drugs. The man holding the ranks of commerce is his old childhood friend Cash Bailey. Now the two don't love each other much, especially as Jack lives with Sarita (Alonso), Bailey's ex-lover. Between the two quarrels comes Lieutenant Hackett with his army of ghosts. In fact, his men officially fell in Vietnam, Lebanon and other theaters of war. In fact, they are still alive and trained to fight the underworld.
notes: A pessimistic western in modern times that suffers from a fugitive logic script. With the exception of Nick Nolte the actors are not in part, but Hill's mastery manages to build the same show moments.

title: Almost Pregnant
actors: Tanya Roberts, Joan Severance, Jeff Conaway, John Calvin, Dom DeLuise
description: Linda and Charlie want a baby, but despite trying for a long time, they can't get one. A check determines that Charlie is sterile; But Linda is against artificial insemination. The only possible solution then seems to be that Linda gets her friend Gordon pregnant. But Gordon's wife reveals a secret to Linda about her husband. Roberts had made a successful start on the television series "Charlie's Angels". Then his lucky stars began to fade to a complete extinction with this film.

title: Flatliners
actors: Kiefer Sutherland, Julia Roberts, Kevin Bacon, William Baldwin, Oliver Platt
description: What does it feel like when you are dead? What happens in the afterlife? Driven by this curiosity, as well as by a scientific interest in the subject, a group of brilliant medical graduates are studying how to cause death on purpose, for a few moments. During these brief parentheses, the boys find their unconscious ghosts which also materialize in normal life.
notes: Starring a cast of talented actors, "Deadline" is a gripping film that mixes psychology and thrilling well.

title: The Happiest Millionnaire
actors: Fred MacMurray, Tommy Steele, Greer Garson, John Davidson
description: A billionaire hostile to the conventions of his class, he ends up favoring his daughter's love for a young man he thought was too "delicate". Disney production with several songs and a little sauce.

title: The Fall of the Roman Empire
actors: Alec Guinness, Sophia Loren, Christopher Plummer, Stephen Boyd, James Mason
description: Marcus Aurelius killed, with the demented and dissipated Commodus for Rome is the beginning of the end. The script is what it is, Anthony Mann's excellent imagery and directorial architecture.

title: No Blade of Grass
actors: Nigel Davenport, Jean Wallace, Patrick Holt
description: An ecological catastrophe pushes an English family to flee to an isolated region. But the troubles are only at the beginning ...
notes: Passable.

title: Skirts Ahoy
actors: Esther Williams, Vivian Blaine, Joan Evans, Barry Sullivan
description: Three broken hearts enlist as naval auxiliaries and among a thousand adventures they manage to find the man of their life. Triviality in profusion in a film, which has a good cast on its side starting with Debbie Reynolds and ending with Esther Williams, who at the time had enjoyed considerable success with films set in the world of what is now called acrobatic swimming.

title: The Light in the Piazza
actors: Olivia de Havilland, Yvette Mimieux, George Hamilton, Rossano Brazzi
description: Margareth Johnson is an American lady who has lived in Florence for some time. Now he is faced with the dilemma of whether or not to let his mentally retarded daughter Clara marry a wealthy Italian, Fabrizio Necciarelli. Having overcome her own doubts, she must overcome those of her husband (separated) who, on the other hand, would even like to lock the young woman in an institution for mental illness. In the end Margareth decides to pay more attention to her heart than to reason, but to say nothing to her future son-in-law.
notes: Maneuvered and not always coherent romantic drama.

title: The Ravagers
actors: Richard Harris, Ann Turkel, Ernest Borgnine, Art Carney
description: In the world of 1991 destroyed by a catastrophe, Richard Harris wanders in search of surviving vestiges of civilization. Deadly and confused fantasy-adventure, with character actors who are almost tender.

title: La belle équipe
actors: Jean Gabin, Viviane Romance, Charles Vanel, Micheline Cheirel
description: Five unemployed people live a life of expedients until they buy a lottery ticket from the company; they win ten thousand francs and decide to use them to build a small hotel. However, various contrasts immediately arise.

title: Paris, Texas
actors: Harry Dean Stanton, Nastassja Kinski, Dean Stockwell, Hunter Carson, Aurore Clément, John Lurie
description: Travis collapses exhausted in the Califoria desert. His brother takes him to his home and here the man finds his eight-year-old son. Little by little Travis comes out of silence and establishes a good relationship with the child. Learning that his wife lives in Houston, he goes there with his son. He finds Jane working in a "peep show", recalls their past with her and leaves her with the baby. Then he sets off again towards the unknown.
notes: Palme d'Or at Cannes '84, is a film of exquisite formal beauty and profound thematic complexity; an itinerary through a fascinating intertwining of feelings and thoughts displayed with great sensitivity. Excellent interpreters.

title: Abbronzatissimi 2. Un anno dopo
actors: Jerry Calà, Eva Grimaldi, Valeria Marini, Vanessa Gravina, Brando Giorgi
description: The main characters of the story are: Martino, who hopes to have a book published; the Boccioni spouses, who promise themselves audacious couple exchanges; Daniela, who returns to the room occupied some time before with her husband Piero from whom she is now separated; Piero, who hopes to reconcile with his ex-wife Daniela; Bea, a girl who is with a man who could very well be her father.
notes: The director Bruno Gaburro, who had made his debut in science fiction, signs a film of grieving inadequacy.

title: Abgeschminkt!
actors: Katja Riemann, Nina Kronjäger, Gedeon Burkhard, Max Tidof
description: Frenzy, a cartoonist, has problems at work, while her friend Maischa is always looking for a partner. Maischa meets René at a party who, under polite appearances, hides the nature of a true pig. Luckier seems to be Frenzy with the witty and charming Mark, but even this story is destined to end in nothing because he has to leave. Without putting too much weight on her hand, the director Katja von Garnier paints a picture of disenchanted female solitude and of more or less marked conflict with the male universe. The search for the ideal partner risks becoming a frustrating utopia, but humor is able to save every situation.

title: Straight Shooting
actors: Harry Carey, Molly Malone, Duke Lee
description: Harry is an outlaw who is hired by some ruthless cattle ranchers to kill settlers who are dedicated to agriculture. But seeing the torment of the Sims family in front of the corpse of one of them, Ted, killed by Fremont, Harry decides to go to the other side. After killing Fremont in a bloody duel, he will lead the settlers to win the final battle with the help of a band of outlaws. This is the first in a long series of successful feature films shot by the great American director John Ford. The director was only twenty-three when he directed the film, but you can already see the great rhythmic wisdom in the action scenes and the remarkable sensitivity for the landscape, for the relationship between man and the boundless grandeur of nature.

title: Partners in Crime: The Secret Adversary
actors: Francesca Annis, James Warwick, George Baker, Peter Barkworth
description: After getting his leave at the end of World War I, Tommy is working hard to get a job. One day he meets a girl he met at the time of the war, Tuppence, and begins with her to do joint work projects. In reality, an offer arrives immediately from a certain Wittington, but the type of work is truly unique: the two must be able to recover a document of vital importance for the security of the entire nation. It is the second novel written by Christie, right at the end of the First World War. It is also the first episode of the television series Partners in Crime which stars Francesca Annis and James Warwick in the roles of Tommy and Tuppence.

title: Cronaca di un amore
actors: Lucia Bosé, Massimo Girotti, Gino Rossi, Marika Rowsky
description: A Milanese industrialist hires an investigator to verify the past of his wife Paola (Lucia Bosé). Thus a woman's youthful passion for a schoolmate of hers, Guido (Massimo Girotti), comes to light. Realizing the situation, he tracks down Paola to warn her and the ancient passion is reborn. But Paola now proposes to Guido to kill her too curious husband ...
notes: Shot between Ferrara and Milan, this film is Michelangelo Antonioni's first work, in which the vaguely yellow structure is bent to an existential and social investigation. At first glance it seems only a noir, but the style, made up of long shots and silences, makes it clear that a great author was born. Lucia Bosé is very young and beautiful.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles III
actors: Elias Koteas, Paige Turco, Stuart Wilson, Vivian Wu
description: Leonardo, Raffaello, Donatello and Michelangelo, the Ninja turtles, have gone back in time. Now they are in Japan, in the seventeenth century, in the place of four samurai just as the fight between the dynasty of Lord Norinaga and that led by the young Mitsu rages. To complicate matters, Walker arrives, an English mercenary ready to put himself in the service of Lord Norinaga. The great success of the first film in this series amazed everyone. The relative failure of this third installment is not very surprising. However, this journey through time is better than the ecological fairy tale invented for episode number two.

title: A Seduction in Travis County
actors: Peter Coyote, Lesley Ann Warren, Jean Smart
description: Frank is a successful lawyer: he has a beautiful home, a great financial position, a beautiful family. His peaceful existence radically changes the day he has to follow the case of Melanie, a woman with a rather dark past, accused of the murder of her husband. Thanks to her ability as a lawyer, the woman is cleared and this triggers a swarm of suspicions that come to put Frank's marriage in crisis. Rather conventional and televised judicial thriller, with good actors who are not enough.

title: Raging Bull
actors: Robert De Niro, Joe Pesci, Cathy Moriarty, Frank Vincent, Nicholas Colasanto, Theresa Saldana, Mario Gallo, Frank Adonis, Joseph Bono, Frank Topham, Lori Anne Flax
description: Jake La Motta grew up in the Bronx Italian-American environment and has always been proud of his strength. It is almost normal for him to engage in boxing, aided by his brother Joey as a coach and manager. However, in order to win the world title, he too must submit to the laws of the mafia organizations that control the undergrowth. A masterpiece of Scorsese and modern American cinema, "Raging Bull" is a fresco on America (and Italy), a tribute to cinema (and his death), superbly photographed by Michael Chapman. Only two Oscars, but impeccable: to the editing of Thelma Schoonmaker, and to De Niro (who gained thirty kilos for the scenes of the old age of the boxer).

title: Alice in den Städten
actors: Rüdiger Vogler, Yella Rottländer, Liza Kreuzer, Eda Kochl
description: Felix Winter returns to Germany from the United States, without the reportage he had to make, but only with a pack of Polaroid photos. At the airport he sees the daughter of one of his compatriots entrusted, who promises to join them at home a few days later. The man and the girl thus begin a journey (in the meantime the mother no longer gives any news of herself) in search of the grandmother's house. Meanwhile, the police managed to track down the woman. Round trip from America emptied of myth and dream, to Europe, the theater of exasperated existentialism. An intimate and ingenious film on the road, which reflects on movement and gaze, and therefore on cinema. One of Wenders' masterpieces, a reflection on cinema and on the history and memory of Germany.

title: Il bandolero stanco
actors: Renato Rascel, Lauretta Masiero, Tino Buazzelli, Lia Di Leo
description: Having become rich with the gold mines, poor Pepito hopes to marry the beautiful Carmen. However, the matter is not that easy. Weak western parody.

title: Il gatto di Brooklyn aspirante detective
actors: Franco Franchi, Luigi Pistilli, Annabella Incontrera, Gianni Agus, Camille Keaton
description: The penniless detective Tony Mangiafoglia and his partner Frank Lonego must ascertain whether a villa is truly haunted, as Countess De Porcaris wants to make it an orphanage, according to the wishes of her niece Guendalina. Received the advance of one million lire, Tony and Frank settle in the villa. While the former does not notice anything and lives quietly in the building, the latter is terrified of all sorts of apparitions. The investigation continues and the mystery becomes more and more dense ...
notes: Franco senza Ciccio tries with Pistilli, without changing his comedy. After the shock of the first moment, we realize that he is deficient as always.

title: La furia dei Kyber
actors: Peter Lee Lawrence, Alan Steel, Antonio Mayans, Luis Barboo
description: Captain Miller and Lieutenant Cullen find themselves shoulder to shoulder on the British expedition to India that seeks to capture the rebel Tantiah. But Miller would like to exterminate them all, Cullen has more humanitarian feelings. A very low level Italian-Spanish co-production.

title: Uccidi o muori
actors: Robert Mark, Elina De Witt, Fabrizio Moroni, Andrea Bosic, Gordon Mitchell
description: Ringo, a former gunfighter who now plays the violin, arrives in a village in the West. The country is dominated by two powerful families in constant struggle with each other: the Griffiths, headed by old Jonathan, and the Drumorts. The Griffiths attack Ringo who, in a shooting, kills the youngest of the brothers. Meanwhile, he knows and sympathizes with Lisa Drumort, but must defend himself from a hitman who injures him. Ringo, however, once cured, kills all opponents. From the Italian Ed Wood, a westernaccio-spaghetti of those that were made by the hundreds.

title: Tutti per uno botte per tutti
actors: Timothy Brent, George Eastman, Karin Schubert, Leo Anchoriz
description: Young Dart wants to join the Texas Rangers. He then leaves his native country but, along the way, he meets a French businessman who is negotiating a cargo of gold with President Ortega, in exchange for the exploitation rights of some mines. The gold travels aboard an "ambulance" driven by the beautiful Alice and escorted by three nice friends always ready to fight. It is a sort of parody of some genres including the western, the picaresque, the karate films, which however, mixed together, cancel the respective potentials of humor and spectacularity, falling into farce.

title: Seduto alla sua destra
actors: Woody Strode, Franco Citti, Jean Servais, Pier Paolo Capponi
description: Maurice Lalubi, independence leader of an African country, fell into the hands of a group of white mercenaries. Lalubi can get freedom again as long as he signs a disavowal of his ideas. He does not even give in under torture, but in the meantime the local government leaders are looking for a solution to get rid of him. Lalubi dies in the desert from a blow with a dagger. Right from the title, but also pay attention to the torture of nails, Zurlini's film presents a double Catholic-Third World reading. All of this, seen today, risks appearing a bit dated.

title: My Girl
actors: Jamie Lee Curtis, Dan Aykroyd, Anna Chlumsky, Macaulay Culkin
description: Harry Sultenfuss (Dan Ackroyd) has been a widower since 1961, when little Vera was born and his wife died in childbirth. Harry is a funeral director by trade, dotes on his daughter, now eleven, and has no intention of remarrying. Vera is a bit strange, she is in love with one of her teachers, she has only one friend, the bespectacled and shy Thomas (Culkin), and she somatises the diseases that her father's clients have been suffering from. Not to mention that she is very jealous of her father. So when Harry starts getting close to Shelly (Curtis), she doesn't take it well. Jamie Lee Curtis body makeup artist is a good idea. As well as the whole macabre side of the film. The other great idea is to have Culkin die from a bee sting. In short, the story is a good coming-of-age story. What doesn't work is Zieff's direction that too often throws it on the sentimental.

title: Tetsuo II: Body Hammer
actors: Tomorowo Taguchi, Nobu Kanaoka, Shinya Tsukamoto, Sujin Kim
description: Two skinheads kidnap little Minori and since that day his father Taniguchi Tomoo's life has never been the same. And life is also the least, because it is his own body that begins to undergo mutations. Also complicit in medical experiments, Taniguchi becomes a kind of lethal cybernetic living weapon. Sequel to "Tetsuo", also by Tsukamoto. Less shocking, but equally inventive and prophetic.

title: Porcile
actors: Pierre Clementi, Jean-Pierre Léaud, Alberto Lionello, Ugo Tognazzi
description: Two stories separated by millennia. In ancient times, a group of savages learn to feed on human flesh, until "society" condemns them to death. In the present, the young son of an industrialist, who has a morbid passion for pigs, rejects his girlfriend. He does not enter the company, but neither does he contest; he will end up mauled by the same pigs while his father teams up with a Nazi criminal. Pasolini explains: "Every society devours both obedient children and those who are neither disobedient nor obedient". A harsh and disturbing parable, deliberately unpleasant and provocative. One of the peaks among the scandal films of an author who is almost always "uncomfortable".

title: La chartreuse de Parme
actors: Gérard Philipe, Maria Casarès, Renée Faure, Tullio Carminati
description: After completing his studies, the young Fabrizio del Dongo joins his aunt, the Duchess of Sanseverina, at the court of Parma, but remains implicated in a murder.

title: Offret - Sacrificatio
actors: Erland Josephson, Susan Fleetwood, Gudrún S. Gisladóttir, Allan Edwall, Sven Wollter, Valerie Mairesse, Filippa Franzén, Tommy Kjellqvist
description: An art critic's birthday is celebrated when, suddenly, the symptoms of destruction break out: an earthquake, military planes in low flight, the announcement on TV that total atomic war is imminent. Man offers all his good to God to save his loved ones. At night he makes love with a maid, and this seems to restore tranquility; but his mind is now upset. A clear metaphor by Tarkovskij on the loss of spiritual values ??and on the need for a "sacrifice" to recover them. From the gloomy despair, however, the director closes on a message of hope. Difficult, demanding, but fascinating cinema. Grand Jury Prize in Cannes.

title: Unlawful Entry
actors: Ray Liotta, Madeleine Stowe, Kurt Russell, Roger E. Mosley
description: Michael (Russell) and Karen Carr (Stowe) hear suspicious noises one night. He is a thief who has broken into the house and, before escaping, holds Karen under the threat of a knife. Finally the police arrive in the person of Pete (Liotta). Pete is kind and understanding and soon the three become friends to the point that Michael, when the thief is spotted, is invited to take part in the beating. Michael refuses and from that moment the friendship between Pete and the Carrs is no longer what it was before. Although she doesn't entirely agree, Michael tries to cut ties with the cop. Pete decides to take revenge by "stealing" Karen from Michael.
notes: Another film about the paranoia of the American middle classes obsessed with urban violence. Stowe is always delicious and Russell works, but the best is Ray Liotta's performance.

title: Messenger of Death
actors: Charles Bronson, Trish Van Devere, Laurence Luckinbill, Daniel Benazali
description: Women and children of a Mormon family are murdered. The police investigate but his father, Orville Beecham, hardly talks to the policemen. Instead, he talks to journalist Garret Smith (Bronson) and reveals to him the existence of a fratricidal struggle between Mormon families. It takes Garret a while to realize that the motive for the massacre is not there, but in the end he finds the real culprits. Bronson, a journalist, may surprise you, but not that much given that in the saga of the Night Enforcer he even passed himself off as an architect. Lee Thompson puts the film together with a useless job.

title: Max Dugan Returns
actors: Jason Robards, Marsha Mason, Donald Sutherland, Matthew Broderick, Kiefer Sutherland
description: A father who returns after a long absence tries to win back his daughter's affection with rich gifts obtained through not exactly legal means. Excellent cast led by Jason Robards, in a Neil Simon comedy adapted for the screen by specialist Ross.

title: Stop! Or My Mom Will Shoot
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Estelle Getty, JoBeth Williams, Roger Rees
description: Los Angeles: Police Sergeant Joe Bomowski is one of the toughest cops in town. One day his mother comes to visit him, a sprightly woman who lives in New Jersey. The first thing the woman does is give her son's house an energetic cleanup, then an equally energetic "fix" to his private life, including his sentimental one. From there a series of chain disasters will start.
notes: Stallone tries to take different paths from the usual ones. The film, while funny, is also very messy and, in the end, redundant and obvious. Fortunately, as the saying goes, there is only one mother.

title: My Cousin Vinny
actors: Joe Pesci, Ralph Macchio, Marisa Tomei, Fred Gwynne
description: Bill and Stan go shopping at a supermarket. Shortly after they are stopped by the police and accused of theft and murder: in the supermarket a couple of boys killed the cashier. Their defense is entrusted to Bill's cousin, Vincenzo, a lawyer with little experience but a lot of chutzpah. This comedy often borders on farce but also has frankly irresistible moments, especially thanks to the great performance of Joe Pesci, the true star of the film. Oscar to Marisa Tomei as a supporting character.

title: Soapdish
actors: Sally Field, Kevin Kline, Robert Downey jr., Cathy Moriarty, Whoopi Goldberg
description: Celeste Thalberg is the star of the long-running soap opera Even the sun sets. Now that the first wrinkles begin to appear, the writers try to come up with changes for his role. One of them, in love with a prosperous supporting actor who intends to oust Celeste, finds an actor in disarmament, already an interpreter in the same soap-opera and also a former partner of Celeste. The purpose is, needless to say, is to damage it. From here on, a carousel of intrigues and twists in pure soap style begins. The intent is clear: to make a critique that is as brilliant as it is ferocious of the world of soap operas, using largely the same stylistic features reversed in a comic key. The gags do not always reach the target, but on the other hand, everything is served very well by an exceptional cast.

title: When Harry Met Sally...
actors: Meg Ryan, Billy Crystal, Carrie Fisher, Bruno Kirby
description: Harry and Sally met in 1977. He argues that friendship without sex is not possible between a man and a woman; she is quite scandalized, also because Harry is the boyfriend of a friend of hers. It is only the beginning of a game of hide and seek that will involve them for eleven years, before life, after having scrambled them very well, makes them understand that deep down they have always loved each other. Rob Reiner hit comedy with a certain grace, winking at model Woody Allen. Billy Crystal and Meg Ryan give the two protagonists the right mix of neurosis and sympathy. In excellent shape Carrie Fisher, former princess of "Star Wars", in the role of Marie.

title: Friendly Persuasion
actors: Gary Cooper, Dorothy McGuire, Anthony Perkins, Marjorie Main
description: Not even the Secession War is a sufficient reason for Jess Birdwell (Cooper), of strict Quaker observance, to renounce his principles that do not in any way admit violence. His son Josh (Perkins), on the other hand, joins the Civil Guard and his mother (McGuire) is desperate. But the head of the family, when Josh's life is at stake, is also ready to arm himself with a rifle.
notes: The film touches on topics of profound human value and develops them without ever betraying its own assumption, making use of a valuable sense of proportion, excellent direction and three famous actors in a skill competition in which everyone wins.

title: The Mad Room
actors: Stella Stevens, Shelley Winters, Skip Ward, Carol Cole, Severn Darden
description: A lady hosts her secretary's two young brothers, discovers that they have come out of a criminal asylum and is killed. Remake of Tenebre (1941), by Charles Vidor, close to the "baby Jane" trend dominant in the late 60s, is quite scary and has some visionary surges.

title: Far and Away
actors: Tom Cruise, Nicole Kidman, Thomas Gibson, Cyril Cusack
description: Joseph Donnelly, a young Irishman with high hopes but no substance, flees to America with Shannon, a beautiful heiress with unconventional aspirations. The two love each other without declaring it to each other and for a while they live as brother and sister. Hunted by their parents and her betrothed, the two manage to crown their love and to conquer a piece of land in Oklahoma after a thousand ups and downs.
notes: The adventure of the enterprising poor man and the beautiful heiress should unfold an epic breath, but only at times does he manage to suggest it. The story is cumbersome and the pace is not quite adequate to the aspirations. In short: glossy, but a little boring.

title: Cheyenne
actors: Dennis Morgan, Bruce Bennett, Jane Wyman, Arthur Kennedy
description: A veteran gambler, he converts to justice, becomes a man of law, catches a robber and marries his woman. The film is among the less brilliant wsterns of the great Walsh, but it inspired a long television series.

title: La cicala
actors: Anthony Franciosa, Virna Lisi, Clio Goldsmith, Renato Salvatori, Barbara De Rossi
description: La Cicala is a hotel bar with an adjoining petrol station run by Annibale Meneghetti and his wife Wilma. But it is also the name of a gypsy who is Wilma's last passionate fan since she was a singer. The place is very unsophisticated and mainly frequented by truckers, but the biggest pitfalls for Wilma come from the anger of her daughter Saveria. Lattuada, just so as not to take himself seriously, has defined his melodrama as a cinematic photo novel. It is actually a passionate melodrama full of flesh, cravings and tears. Virna Lisi (voiced when she sings by Carla Boni) is amazing.

title: La vendetta di Ursus
actors: Samson Burke, Livio Lorenzon, Gina Rovere, Roberto Fantasia
description: Zagro, king of Cadia, wants to marry Sira, daughter of the king of Lycia. He does not love the girl, but has organized the wedding only to have the kingdom after which he plans to get rid of her. Too bad that the very strong Ursus is in love with the princess, who accompanies her in Cadia and thwarts Zagro's machinations.
notes: Modest, but acceptable mythological film made in Italy.

title: Battle Beyond the Stars
actors: Richard Thomas, Robert Vaughn, George Peppard, Sybil Danning
description: The peaceful planet Akir is threatened by the space tyrant Sandor, who - possessing the "absolute weapon" - is trying to subdue all inhabited worlds to its domination. The young Shad decides to hire some mercenaries to defend his planet: he hires six, and among these there is also a cowboy ...
notes: Roger Corman (producer) and John Sayles (writer) take up the plot of _The Seven Samurai_, transferring it from the West of the "Magnificent Seven" series to interstellar spaces. Everything is entrusted to the Japanese-American Murakami of _Quando il vento_ and _Canto di Natale - The film_: the result is amusing and impertinent enough.

title: Follow Me, Boys!
actors: Fred MacMurray, Vera Miles, Lillian Gish, Kurt Russell
description: Lem Siddons, a penniless jazz musician, leaves his band to take root in a small town where he starts working as a shop assistant, earning the affection of the inhabitants. He will marry Vida and adopt an orphaned little boy scout. A sentimental and delicate film, by Walt Disney, in which Kurt Russell appears as a child.

title: The Sea Hawk
actors: Errol Flynn, Flora Robson, Claude Rains, Donald Crisp
description: One of the most daring English privateers of the sixteenth century, Captain Thorpe, intends to plunder the Spanish possessions in Panama with the tacit blessing of Queen Elizabeth, but is captured.
notes: Adventurous film in costume, with a compelling rhythm and sumptuous staging, with an inevitable amorous outline. In the version passed on the English screens, Queen Elizabeth gave highly patriotic speeches with allusions to current events. Based on a novel by Rafael Sabatini, the film was written by the future director Robert Rossen. The music is by Erich Wolfgang Korngold.

title: Astérix chez les Bretons
description: An emissary from a village across the Channel surrounded and oppressed by the violence of the Romans asks for help (and above all a magic potion) from the irreducible Gauls led by the invincible Asterix and the strong Obelix. Of course, our heroes do their utmost to fight their irreducible enemies.
notes: The animation technique of the creatures invented by Goscinny and Uderzo is good, but in the end the result is too repetitive and much more "static" than in print. Among other things, the film arrived on our screens later than its release date in French theaters.

title: Dove vai tutta nuda?
actors: Maria Grazia Buccella, Tomas Milian, Gastone Moschin, Vittorio Gassman
description: Upon awakening Manfredo discovers two things. To be in the garçonniere of the president of the bank he works for and not to be alone. The woman he wakes up with is called "Tonino" (Buccella), she has the habit of always telling the truth and above all of walking around the house with nothing on. The woman is also his wife, but this only happened because he was drunk the night before. The only reason for the film's existence lies in the broad graces of Maria Grazia Buccella.

title: Il giovane normale
actors: Lino Capolicchio, Janet Agren, Eugene Walter, Jeff Morrow
description: Giordano, a penniless young man, accepts the invitation of the mature Sid, his young wife Diana and Nelson, all three Americans, to go with them to Tunisia. While traveling he has the opportunity to appreciate the unscrupulousness of his companions, and in particular of the couple, flirting with Diana. With themes, atmosphere and style close to the comedy of sixties costume, it is a film not without subtleties which, however, does not have the lucid and corrosive determination of Risi's best works. Freely based on a novel by Umberto Simonetta.

title: Indian Summer
actors: Alan Arkin, Diane Lane, Elizabeth Perkins, Vincent Spano
description: A group of friends in their thirties meet for a reunion at the Tamakwa campground in Canada, who had seen them together as young people. Someone is now a yuppie, someone has made more original life choices. The weekend in camping passes quickly between outdoor breakfasts, more or less demanding conversations, reflections, memories and sour-sweet nostalgia.
notes: Among the films of the genre inaugurated with Lawrence Kasdan's _The big cold_ in 1983, this one by Mike Bender is among the most dignified. Also thanks to a very professional cast, with Diane Lane (_Cotton Club_) and the good Alan Arkin, who plays the campsite manager.

title: I mitici. Colpo gobbo a Milano
actors: Claudio Amendola, Monica Bellucci, Ricky Memphis, Tony Sperandeo
description: Giulio is in jail, but he already dreams of the next shot. As soon as he comes out, he recruits his brother Fabio, a good and honest antenna player, but left without a job, and a series of even more down-and-out characters. The goal is a jewelry store in via Montenapoleone, but the blow goes badly and the group finds themselves immersed in the garbage. But it is precisely here that the missed thieves find a real treasure: five billion thrown away by someone because they were too hot. The aim of the film was certainly not to remake "I soliti ignoti" by Monicelli but, on the basis of that, to create a nice and funny story. Bellucci is beautiful and quite self-deprecating.

title: My Life
actors: Michael Keaton, Nicole Kidman, Bradley Whitford
description: Jones (Keaton) is a happy young businessman, groom, and future father. One day, however, he discovers that he is suffering from an incurable disease. He undergoes a series of analyzes and treatments, including some oriental therapy sessions. Meanwhile, he films himself with a video camera in which he talks about himself and gives some life advice to his son, who will be born when he is probably already dead. It is a curious attempt to build a film that addresses the themes of death by acting on a double movement: that of life that is about to arrive and that of life that is about to end.

title: Trois couleurs. Bleu
actors: Juliette Binoche, Benoît Régent, Hélène Vincent
description: In a car accident, Julie lost her partner, a famous composer, and her daughter. Admitted to hospital, she attempts suicide, but is saved. Resigned, she cuts all bridges with the past and tries to destroy her husband's unfinished opera: a great concert for Europe. Digging into her husband's life, Julie discovers that he had a mistress who is now expecting a baby. Meanwhile, Olivier, a friend of her husband's in love with Julie, tries to convince her to complete the concert, but also to seduce her.
notes: An enigmatic and intense film, like its protagonist, opens the trilogy of films dedicated to the three watchwords of the French Revolution, to which the three colors of the flag correspond. Golden Lion in Venice ex-aequo with "America Oggi", and criticisms of the Catholic ending.

title: Falsche bewegung
actors: Rüdiger Vogler, Marianne Hoppe, Hanna Schygulla, Nastassja Kinski
description: Young Wilhelm leaves his small town in northern Germany for Bonn. Along the way he makes a series of encounters: a former Nazi and his young daughter; Therese, a woman he meets on the train; Bernard, wandering poet. Everyone ends up in the villa of an industrialist who commits suicide. They wander the Rhine, then the group falls apart. Wilhelm spends a night with Therese, then leaves for the Alps. On the Grossglockner cable car he swaps his pen for a film camera.
notes: The protagonist of the film, which Peter Hanke freely took from Goethe's "Wilhelm Meister", makes a geographical and interior journey: through his own soul (the symbolic exchange between pen and camera) and the German land in which they are still alive. the ghosts of the past. Debut of Nastassja Kinski with her real surname.

title: A Bronx Tale
actors: Chazz Palminteri, Robert De Niro, Francis Capra, Lillo Brancato
description: Calogero Aniello, a nine-year-old son of a bus driver, forms a friendship with Sonny, the neighborhood gangster. The father, who would like to keep him as far away from the road as possible, does not look favorably on this friendship. Over time, the boy gets to know Sonny's human side. Based on a play by Chazz Palminteri, who also plays the part of Sonny here, the film is De Niro's first direction. A skilful interweaving of comedy, drama and coming-of-age story mark the very happy debut of the Italian-American actor behind the camera.

title: Lambada
actors: Andrew J. Forest, Vya Negromante, Mary Sellers
description: Michael and Mary are in Rio de Janeiro for a television report. She falls in love with Temistocles, a king of the lambada, he with Regina, a former diva of dance. In Themistocles past there is a passion and a murder disguised as an accident. With the arrival of the two Americans, after several ups and downs, truth and love triumph. Pseudo-cinematographic announcement for the Kaoma musical group: the local color is a low-category tourist agency, the eroticism is a postcard for the friends of the bar. An attempt to exploit the success of a song definitely failed.

title: Sai cosa faceva Stalin alle donne?
actors: Helmut Berger, Margaret Lee, Silvia Monti, Benedetto Benedetti
description: Aldo and Benedetto are two former partisans. The first is a member of the Communist Party out of ideological conviction. Benedict, on the other hand, out of snobbery. Convinced that he resembles Stalin, he imitates him to achieve success in leftist circles. With the fall of the Soviet dictator, the two friends go into crisis, obviously for different reasons. Fortunately, Vietnam arrives: a new epic and new myths ready as models to be consumed. Debut in the name of satire for Maurizio Liverani: despite the title, it is all in all polite and not without appreciable ideas. Perhaps this is why silence followed, until the return, seven years later, with the softcore of "Furrow fishing".

title: Sandokan la tigre di Mompracem
actors: Steve Reeves, Geneviève Grad, Andrea Bosic, Rik Battaglia, Mario Valdemarin
description: Sandokan, with some "tiger cubs" and his faithful Yanez, is unable to free his imprisoned father of the English. He takes the governor's niece hostage and attempts the perilous jungle trek. A traitor helps the English, who recapture the fugitives. But Sandokan and his men reverse the situation. Meanwhile, the girl also fell in love with him. Stop in Malaysia for the inexhaustible Lenzi, with the former Maciste Steve Reeves in the role of the pirate.

title: Cuori sul mare
actors: Doris Dowling, Jacques Sernas, Marcello Mastroianni, Charles Vanel
description: The story of two cadets from the Livorno Academy, between love affairs, smuggling stories and other adventures. A very dated comedy with a very young Mastroianni.

title: The Teahouse of the August Moon
actors: Marlon Brando, Glenn Ford, Eddie Albert, Machiko Kyo
description: Captain Purdy, stationed in Okinawa, doesn't understand why people want to build a teahouse instead of a school. Nothing original, ridiculous Brando, good Glenn Ford.

title: Io speriamo che me la cavo
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Ciro Esposito, Maria Esposito, Adriano Pantaleo
description: Due to an error in the computer of the Ministry, Marco Tullio Sperelli (Village) ends up working in Corzano, in the province of Naples. The class would be about twenty boys, but he only finds three when he arrives. The others must go and collect them around, among small stories of ordinary poverty and petty crime. The boys begin to trust in the new teacher, but just then the news arrives of the new transfer to the North of the teacher. Maestro D'Orta's book from which the film is based was only a collection of themes written by elementary school children and could be summed up with the subtitle: "how to entertain adults behind ignorant children". To this Wertmüller added a story, a main character and an uplifting ending.

title: Il cardinale Lambertini
actors: Gino Cervi, Nadia Gray, Arnoldo Foà, Sergio Tofano
description: In 1739 Cardinal Lambertini, close to being elected pope, did his best to ensure that two young people in love were able to marry. Adaptation of a comedy by Alfredo testoni. Great interpretation by Gino Cervi, in an otherwise negligible film.

title: Oliver's Story
actors: Ryan O'Neal, Candice Bergen, Ray Milland
description: Oliver, a young lawyer who prematurely lost his beloved wife Jenny, who died of an incurable disease, tries to fight depression between sessions of psychoanalysis and days of hard work. As if that weren't enough, he still doesn't get along with his father. Then he meets a beautiful industry captain, but the memory of his first wife is still strong. Ideal sequel to Love Story (also based on a novel by Eric Segal), of which it captures the worst.

title: Cabalgando hacia la muerte
actors: Frank Latimore, Maria Luz Galicia, Mario Feliciani, Howard Vernon, Paul Piaget, Robert Hundar, José Marco Davó, Jesus Tordesillas, Maria Silva, Diana Lorys, Raf Baldassarre
description: A mad criminal spreads terror as Zorro, who instead fought valiantly in the Mexican war against the Californians. It is Billy, brother of a ruthless North American officer killed in his time by the masked knight, who in doing so intends to take revenge. Billy kidnaps the beautiful Maria, whom he believes is romantically linked to Zorro. Ours will not be long in getting justice. Shot, like so many other films of the period, in a California clearly rebuilt in Spain, its only peculiarity is to make the protagonist a criminal and psychopathic Zorro, even if it is false. For the rest, it is pure routine.

title: Empire of the Sun
actors: Christian Bale, John Malkovich, Miranda Richardson, Nigel Havers, Joe Pantoliano
description: Eleven-year-old Jim lives in the comforts of the English colony of Shanghai. His favorite pastime is building toy planes. When, in 1941, the Japanese invade the city, in the confusion of escape, Jim is separated from his parents. Wandering through the streets of Shanghai, the boy ends up being arrested by the invaders and locked up in a concentration camp with foreigners of all nationalities. Here Jim lives the difficult years of the transition from childhood to adolescence: his models are the shrewd Basie, but also the courageous Dr. Rawlins. With imagination and cunning, between suffering and play, he manages to overcome the tests of this experience; he even manages to establish a friendship, more or less at a distance, with a Japanese boy.
notes: Excellent direction by Spielberg, who (after _Il colore viola_) still deals with dramatic themes, identifying himself in a certain sense with the little protagonist. Great virtuosity with the camera, complex and highly calibrated movements: think of the sequence with Jim playing in the carcass of an airplane. The story, taken from the autobiographical novel by the great English writer JG? Ballard, shows that kids have tough skin and that the best school is life: for Jim, war is a game at first, then it becomes a universe to go through and to dominate. Notable John Malkovich in the role of Basie, the seasoned prisoner, and already very good the very young Christian Bale, who then re-emerged at the end of the 90s with _Velvet Goldmine_ and then consecrated by Christopher Nolan's Batman.

title: The Trip to Bountiful
actors: Geraldine Page, John Heard, Rebecca De Mornay, Carlin Glynn
description: Carrie, an elderly lady, feels marginalized by her son Ludle and especially by her daughter-in-law, who makes her suffer with her pettiness. One night she has a long conversation with her son during which she recalls a happy past. After yet another quarrel with his daughter-in-law he decides to seize his pension check and leave for Bountiful, the village of his nostalgic memories. At the bus station he accidentally meets Thelma, a helpful and understanding young woman. After a long journey, he finds the village of his memories in complete disrepair and abandonment. A sui generis road movie starring an old lady from the South. Taken from a text for TV by Horton Foote, who also wrote the screenplay, it is a bitter elegy, with delicate tones, which never falls into patheticism, despite the subject lend you. Thanks to the director Peter Masterson, here at his debut, and above all to the talented Geraldine Page, who deservedly received the Oscar for her interpretation of the character of Carrie. Rebecca De Mornay, who in the role of the young Thelma turns out to be a subtle and nuanced actress.

title: There Was a Little Boy
actors: Cybill Shepherd, John Heard, Scott Bairstow, Elaine Kagan
description: Julie (Shepherd) and Greg (Heard) are expecting a child. They are happy, but the wait brings back the pain of the kidnapping, which took place fifteen years earlier, of another newborn child. Julie, who is an English teacher, inexplicably begins to grow fond of her 15-year-old student, Jessie (Bairstow). The surprises will not be long in coming. Halfway between the dramatic and the thriller, it is a predictable story, which nevertheless guarantees its moments of tension. A solid group of actors responds to a dignified direction in which Shepherd's spontaneity stands out.

title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me
actors: Sheryl Lee, Ray Wise, Kyle MacLachlan, Kiefer Sutherland, Chris Isaak, Harry Dean Stanton
description: Gordon Cole, head of the FBI, sends two of his men to Twin Peaks to investigate the murder of young Teresa Banks. After the first searches they mysteriously disappear while, more closely, the story focuses on the last days of the life of Laura Palmer (Lee), and of the dark world in which she has found herself, made of sex and cocaine, dominated by the menacing figure of Bob, his father's terrible alter ego.
notes: Lynch returns to the hit television series "Twin Peaks", but does not make the expected sequel, but a provocative "prequel". A little repetitive and stylistically weaker than the television series, the film nonetheless confirms Lynch's visionary nature and the world it describes is gloomy and dark, dominated by uncontrollable forces of evil. Particles also for Lynch and David Bowie.

title: Caino e Caino
actors: Enrico Montesano, Alessandro Benvenuti, Daniela Poggi, Evelina Gori
description: After the death of their father, a wealthy textile industrialist, Franco and Fabio go to war with each other: the goal is to seize the majority of the shares in the family business. Both owners of 49 percent, they aim for the remaining 2 percent owned by the old flame of the deceased entrepreneur, Adelina. The family conflict goes on between insults, spite, adultery, leaflets and fake kidnappings: who will win?
notes: Different experiences complement each other in this film, which is a solid and coherent product, even if overall less original than the others made by Benvenuti. A transitional work, but on the whole not despicable.

title: Hell Divers
actors: Wallace Beery, Clark Gable, Conrad Nagel
description: Adventures of the air and the heart of two friend-rivals respectively officers of the aviation and navy. Film to be appreciated for the remarkable technical level, even if it dwells a little.

title: Bobby Deerfield
actors: Al Pacino, Marthe Keller, Anny Duperey, Romolo Valli
description: Formula 1 driver Bobby Deerfield lives only for his racing car and for the races that give him moments of glory. During a Grand Prix, one of his team mates dies colliding with an opponent. Wanting to know more, Bobby leaves for Switzerland where the survivor is hospitalized: here he is approached by Lillian, a Florentine girl who begs him to accompany her to Italy in her car. From the meeting a love arises that will reserve Bobby a deep pain: Lillian is in fact suffering from a very serious illness.
notes: The film is reminiscent of Love Story, but is finer and more measured in both direction and interpretation.

title: Wife Versus Secretary
actors: Clark Gable, Myrna Loy, Jean Harlow, James Stewart
description: Clark Gable editor married to Myrna Loy spends a night on business with secretary Jean Harlow. The wife misunderstands and asks for a divorce. Pleasant sophisticated comedy based on an excellent cast.

title: My Wild Irish Rose
actors: Dennis Morgan, Arlene Dahl, Andrea King
description: The biography of the singer and songwriter Chauncey Olcott. A film for those who are very fond of Irish songs.

title: Neptune's Daughter
actors: Esther Williams, Red Skelton, Ricardo Montalban
description: Eve Barret (Williams), swimming champion, intends to present her swimwear line at the polo match between North and South America. Betty, Eve's sister, falls in love with the South American masseur, mistaking him for the captain of the Southern team. The real captain, José, falls in love with Eve as soon as he sees her. In the end, in addition to love, South America also wins.
notes: Esther Williams is the host in this enjoyable musical film. Oscar for the song "Baby It's Cold Outside".

title: Cyclone
actors: Arthur Kennedy, Carroll Baker, Lionel Stander, Olga Karlatos
description: A tropical hurricane sends a plane and several boats down. A group of castaways has been adrift for over a month, reaching levels of absolute desperation also because many are tempted by cannibalism to solve the urgent problem of survival. Horrid-catastrophic film by José Cardona which, like the previous "The survivors of the Andes", takes its cue from the news.

title: Ten Thousand Bedrooms
actors: Dean Martin, Eva Bartok, Anna Maria Alberghetti
description: In Rome to buy yet another hotel, Roy Hunter, billionaire king of hotels, meets Maria and her modest family; falls in love with her and gets married.
notes: An old-fashioned and predictable comedy, seasoned with banal and paternalistic humor.

title: Doughboys
actors: Buster Keaton, Sally Eilers, Cliff Edwards
description: Adventures and misadventures of Buster Keaton, a casual and poetic boy serving in the army. It is the first sound film of the great American comedian.

title: Due volte vent'anni
actors: Mariangela Melato, Jean-François Stévenin, Valeria Milillo, Alessandro Gassmann
description: Arianna is twenty years old and is about to get married. The thing that puts her in crisis is the discovery that her father Bernard has taken a crush on a young musician, who is also twenty. And that, moreover, she looks a lot like her mother when she was young.The episode also puts her mother (Melato) in crisis, so much so that she decides to return for a period to Italy to reflect on her own life. ali Lidia Ravera continued to write. Sometimes he also wrote screenplays and films were also drawn from these. We must not make a tragedy of it, but it is so. I'm only sorry for Jean-François Stevenin who is a good actor.

title: Im lauf der Zeit
actors: Rüdiger Vogler, Hans Zischler, Lisa Kreuzer, Rudolf Schündler
description: Bruno travels the length and breadth of Germany aboard a truck: his job is that of a film projector repairer. Its activity takes place mainly in the province. Robert, on the other hand, deals with language disorders in children, has a Genoese love gone bad and a mad desire to launch his Volkswagen into a river. This is how they get to know each other (Bruno witnesses Robert's attempt) and they decide to make at least a piece of the road together. It is probably Wenders' best film: poignant, serious, funny, almost reserved and shy. Lisa Kreuzer with the smoke-eating candle shaped like Hitler's head is more than an emblematic image.

title: Splitting Heirs
actors: Rick Moranis, Eric Idle, Barbara Hershey, John Cleese, Catherine Zeta-Jones
description: His father dies and Henry becomes the 15th Duke of Bornemouth, as well as the owner of the family bank. But he is a usurper because the real heir is Tommy Patel, an obscure employee of the same bank. At the base of it all is an exchange of children due to a mother distracted by the atmosphere of Swinging London. So one grew up in luxury, the other in a Pakistani family.
notes: The opening credits say "John Cleese for the first time on screen". But even this is a fake because he and Eric Idle are two old members of Monty Python. Although here all the work is done by Idle, screenwriter and lead actor.

title: Quai des brumes
actors: Jean Gabin, Michèle Morgan, Michel Simon, Pierre Brasseur
description: Jean, who has just deserted from the colonial troops, meets in Le Havre Nelly who lives, terrified, with a shady guardian, who has killed her boyfriend. Jean and Nelly try to escape together, but the man is forced to kill the guardian and is himself killed by a gangster who takes revenge for a hard lesson previously suffered by Jean.
notes: A classic "noir" from the golden age of French cinema between the two wars, scripted by Jacques Prevert and directed by a director, Marcel Carné, who is already a great man in his third feature film. Beautiful, disturbing atmospheres and excellent actors.

title: Benito Mussolini
description: With the commentary of Enzo Biagi and Sergio Zavoli, the film proposes the images that document the private and public life of the Duce as it was proposed to the Italian people by the Luce newsreels. So here is Mussolini skier, aviator, horseman, reaper, tennis player, violinist, fencer ... Here he is also in the carousel of various uniforms and street demonstrations. Around him, Galeazzo Ciano, Badoglio, Starace, Petacci. Then, the republic of Salò and the macabre exposure of the body in Piazzale Loreto, in Milan, after 25 April 1945. There is no longer any cinematographic material that documents that period of Italian history and which is unpublished. This montage film was made with material that is mostly already known, but a "refresher" can always be used.

title: Runaway Train
actors: Jon Voight, Eric Roberts, Rebecca De Mornay, John P. Ryan
description: Manny (Voight) has already escaped from jail twice. This is why Ranken, the director of the Stonehaven (Alaska) maximum security prison, has kept him in solitary confinement for the past three years. Manny, however, does not give up and manages to escape again, this time through the sewers, in the company of Buck (Roberts). The two manage to get on an empty departing train. But the driver dies shortly after departure of a heart attack, leaving the train unmanned, launched at insane speed against a chemical plant.
notes: Konchalovski was born in Moscow and emigrated to America. Here, on a subject by Akira Kurosawa, he films an epic about freedom and violence, playing on allegorical characters supported by actors like boulders. The ending with Vivaldi's "Gloria" is superb.

title: Raising Cain
actors: John Lithgow, Lolita Davidovich, Steven Bauer, Frances Sternhagen, Amanda Pombo
description: Dr. Carter is a psychiatrist. As a child he had been subjected by his father, a famous doctor, to some experiments on behavior that deeply marked him. Now he is almost morbidly attached to his daughter Amy and this worries Jenny, his wife. One day Carter meets Cain, his twin brother and "black soul", who leads him to delinquent behavior ...
notes: De Palma surpasses himself with a film that radicalizes the Hitchcockian magisterium in a disturbing divertissement suspended between kitsch amusement and the sublime. The direction is at least as virtuosic as the narrative development (the protagonist is divided between five personalities).

title: Sommersby
actors: Jodie Foster, Richard Gere, Bill Pullman, James Earl Jones
description: Given up for dead, Jack Sommersby returns to his hometown years after the end of the Civil War. Reunite with son and wife Laurel. Jack says he was in prison and changed. In fact, he is no longer able to put on his old boots, the dog is barking at him, he should have a scar that he does not have. However, he is affectionate and ardent with Laurel falling in love with him (although he suspects the man is not Jack Sommersby) and soon they are expecting a child. But one day he is accused of a war crime. He could save himself from the accusation by declaring that he is not the real Jack (as he himself confides to Laurel). The Hollywood vogue to remake successful French films continues. In this case, the prototype is The Return of Martin Guerre, which in turn referred to a historical fact. To interpret it (and partially produce it) is Gere, a bit dazed. Jodie Foster always in better shape.

title: The Program
actors: James Caan, Craig Sheffer, Halle Berry, Kristy Swanson
description: A college football team reaches the final for the first time. The white quaterback must be detoxified from alcohol; a black boy dreams of achieving the decisive goal; the rich black girl loves him even though he, as a student, is half a landslide; the white defender mourns over steroid abuse; the black defender breaks his leg and will not play the final.
notes: There was a lot of talk about the film because in America some guy in the mood for crazy emulation had stretched out on the highway and lost his life. However, the film is nothing special. Good subjective shots of the game actions.

title: Massacro al Central College
actors: Andrew Stevens, Kimberky Beck, Robert Carradine, Derrel Maury
description: A gang of thugs terrifies undergraduates at a California college until a freshman reacts by transforming into a deadly executioner. Except that the young man takes a liking to the smell of blood and soon becomes even more feared than the delinquents he has massacred.
notes: Sufficient despite some clumsiness, the film is a small classic in the USA but decades later it is very dated in its satirical claims. To be verified, however.

title: In the Line of Duty: The Price of Vengeance
actors: Michael Gross, Dean Sockwell, Mary Kay Place, Treat Williams
description: Johnny Moore manages a car rental, but his real profession is that of a armed robber. The detective Tom Williams is on the trail of him and manages to let him stop, but for a short time. In fact, Johnny comes out on a deposit and, just to get safe, Halloween night disguises himself as a clown and goes to kill the policeman. Jack Lowe, Tom's colleague, commits herself to avenge the friend. Lowry is one who has spent his life wandering the story of Jayne Mansfield and other similar nonsense for TV. His stroke of luck was the series in The Line of Duty of which this film is also part. Nothing ingenious, but the rhythm is the right one.

title: Tempi nostri (Zibaldone n. 2)
actors: Vittorio De Sica, Lea Padovani, Totò, Andrea Checchi
description: Nine episodes including: a prostitute falls in love with a teacher; a couple with too many children is tempted to abandon the last born; two elderly extras recall their youthful love ...
notes: Blasetti adapts contemporary short stories with a light and distracted eye. A joke with Totò and Loren is the setting.

title: Assisi Underground
actors: Ben Cross, Maximilian Schell, James Mason, Irene Papas
description: We are in Assisi in 1943; the bishop tries to act in favor of Jews and refugees. Father Rufino works for the stragglers, who increase every day. When some of them are captured, Rufino also ends up in the hands of the Germans. The fake shooting does not bend it. Two of the arrested, with a stratagem, manage to have Assisi declared an "open city"; in the meantime the allies advance ... A cast of some respect, even if rather in plaster. One and three, Alexander Ramati signs novel, screenplay and direction. Everything is predictable, of course, but there is also a gem (so to speak): Alessandra Mussolini in the role of Sister Beata.

title: The Shaggy Dog
actors: Fred MacMurray, Jean Hagen, Tommy Kirk, Annette Funicello
description: Wilson is a postman allergic to dogs. His son Willy comes into possession of a ring that transforms him into a dog, very similar to Geremia, the neighbor's dog. Desperate, the dog-boy turns to whoever gave him the ring; the answer is that he can only become human again by performing a glorious action. It happens that Willy-Geremia discovers that the neighbor's father is a spy about to steal important atomic plans. We are in the medium-low: flat script and lack of ideas in the gags.

title: Cohen and Tate
actors: Roy Scheider, Adam Baldwin, Harley Cross, Cooper Huckabee
description: Nine-year-old Travis witnessed a Mafia murder and is forced to live with his family in Oklahoma, in a secret place guarded by the FBI. The location, however, is not so secret for Cohen and Tate, the two killers who, after killing the parents and the bodyguards, kidnap the child for a 350-mile journey to Houston, where the boss wants to question him. Eric Red's big, eerie and tense debut. After the first twenty minutes the car looks like a walking sarcophagus, the dawn light seems a mirage and the only unknown seems to be who will kill whom. In short, the tension is cut with a knife, the twists are not lacking and Roy Scheider's wrinkles do the rest. Before making his directorial debut, Red was a screenwriter for Kathryn Bigelow. With this film he didn't have much success and it's a shame.

title: Annie Hall
actors: Diane Keaton, Woody Allen, Tony Roberts, Paul Simon
description: Alwy Singer is a comedian who works for radio and television. It is successful, but it leads to depression. Already put to the test in the past by two failed marriages, he has an affair with Annie Hall, intellectual, pretty, wealthy and a little nutty, with personal ambitions in the entertainment industry. Both are on the defensive. They share professional interests, but also a certain emotional instability.
notes: Between the humor of crackling and ruthless dialogues and an incurable melancholy, an autobiographical film that emblematically stages the existential and sentimental neurosis of which Woody Allen is the undisputed champion. Oscar for Best Picture, Direction, Screenplay, Lead Actress (Keaton).

title: In the Heat of the Night
actors: Sidney Poitier, Rod Steiger, Warren Oates, Lee Grant
description: We are in a small town in the South of the United States; a policeman discovers, during his night tour, the body of an industrialist, who was about to open an important factory for the city. Gillespie, the local police chief, gives orders to arrest all suspects. Among others, he is also brought a black, elegant and well-stocked wallet, captured at the station while waiting for the train. But the man is Inspector Tibbs (Poitier) of the federal police. The dead man's widow wants Tibbs to lead the investigation; which will happen, not without open clashes with Gillespie and skids. Once the murderer has been identified, the inspector leaves for the North.
notes: The detective story is reworked in a script that is attentive to social data. Steiger is less baroque than usual. The fame that he brings with him for committed and anti-racist films, after all, plays a bit against him. Better to enjoy it honestly for what it is, even if allusions to civil issues are inevitable. Five Oscars: film, protagonist (Steiger), screenplay, editing (Hal Ashby) and sound.

title: Bang the Drum Slowly
actors: Robert De Niro, Michael Moriarty, Vincent Gardenia, Ann Wedgeworth
description: Henry Wiggen and Bruce Pearson are two baseball players in the New York Mammoths. Bruce is sick with no escape; nobody knows, except Henry, and he risks being torpedoed for his poor performance. Henry, one of the best of the team, decides to help him and for this he manages to impose conditions also on the company. Despite the difficulties and gossips, Bruce will thus be able to give his best. Independent production that includes as protagonists a Bob De Niro not yet famous (the film was distributed in Italy only after the success of Taxi Driver) and a good Michael Moriarty as always (guilty unrecognized actor).

title: Una spada per l'impero
actors: Lang Jeffries, José Greci, Enzo Tarascio, Angela Angelucci, Giuseppe Addobbati
description: In the year 190 d. C. the emperor Commodus sends an expedition against the barbarian Avalo. The consul Marco commands it and the only result is to free the slave Nissia, but not to block the enemy. Since Commodus seems to underestimate the danger to Rome, Mark allies himself with legionaries, gladiators and Christians and gets himself appointed emperor in place of the inept Commodus. This film was shot at the same time as the Fire of Rome. In English this procedure is called "back-to-back" and it means that Grieco with the money of one film was able to make two. To say that you can see it is an understatement.

title: Nell'anno del Signore
actors: Claudia Cardinale, Nino Manfredi, Enrico Maria Salerno, Robert Hossein, Alberto Sordi
description: In the Rome of 1825 the Carbonari tried in vain to raise the people against the papal government. Among them is Montanari, sentenced to death for having attempted the life of Don Filippo Spada, and among them there is also Cornacchia (Nino Manfredi), an illiterate and slightly cowardly cobbler. Few know, however, that he is actually Pasquino, the anonymous author of satires against the clergy and the powerful.
notes: Gigi Magni has specialized in subjects of the Roman environment, linked to events of the past centuries. The operation is not always successful for him; this is certainly one of his best results thanks also to the excellent cast.

title: Ursus
actors: Ed Fury, Cristina Gaioni, Moira Orfei, Mario Scaccia, Mary Marlon
description: Back from the war, Ursus (Ed Fury) discovers that his fiancée Attea (Moira Orfei) has been kidnapped and decides to go in search of her. Doreide accompanies him, a blind slave present at the rapture who thinks she can recognize those responsible by her voice. Overcoming traps and ambushes, Ursus manages to find Attea, but it is she, who has become a cruel queen, who condemns him to death ... the film focuses on the protagonist's spectacular vicissitudes and on the scenography bordering on the surreal.

title: The Rise and Fall of Legs Diamond
actors: Ray Danton, Karen Steele, Warren Oates, Dyane Cannon
description: From thief to leader of a gang of gangsters: the irresistible rise and fall of Jack Diamond.
notes: Excellent gangster-movie with, among others, Warren Oates and a very young Dyane Cannon.

title: Paisà
actors: Carmela Savio, Gar Moore, Dots M. Johnson, Harriet White, Alfonsino Pasca
description: In 1943 the allies landed in Sicily; in Naples occupied by the allies a sciuscià steals the shoes of a black soldier. Rome: a love story between a prostitute and an American soldier. In Florence, Germans and partisans fought on the roofs of the city cut in two by the front. After an interlude in a convent on the Emilian Apennines, we land on the Po delta while the partisan struggle rages. The film consists of six episodes that retrace a moment in Italian history following the path of the allies from the South to the North. It is also one of the fundamental titles of neorealist cinema. Fellini and Vasco Pratolini also collaborated on the script.

title: Alien 3
actors: Sigourney Weaver, Charles Dance, Lance Henriksen
description: In 2525, Ellen Ripley and little Newt were the last survivors of the alien. But the shuttle has an accident and Ripley wakes up, alone, in the desolate penal colony of Fiorina 161. And, as if that weren't enough, the deadly alien from which she managed to escape twice is still in circulation and begins to wreak havoc. of prisoners, as the Company is about to arrive ...
notes: The atmosphere changes completely compared to the other two _Alien_: the tones become dark, Ripley wanders shaved to zero. A sense of apocalypse and defeat weighs on the whole of history. Walter Hill is back among the writers, while director David Fincher, newcomer, rehearses for the next _Seven_. The operation is unusual, perhaps less successful than the previous two films, but very interesting.

title: David's Mother
actors: Kirstie Alley, Sam Waterston, Stockard Channing, Michael Goorjian, Phylicia Rashad
description: Sally (Allen) A single woman, voted for her entire existence to look after her son David, autistic. The commitment you put in this task is admirable, but decidedly excessive. So much so that, in the long run, his character has come out transformed and unachability. So Sally, in the flower of the years, finds himself cut all the bridges with others. Fortunately, an eccentric social worker and a man, remedy her sister, enter his life. Of stories like this were seen in Iosa. In addition, the description of the woman's obsessions risks eating the whole film. Fortunately, in the second part the sympathy of the secondary characters takes on greater importance. Made for TV.

title: American Ninja 2: the Confrontation
actors: Michael Dudikoff, Steve James
description: The two rangers Joe Armstrong and Curtis Jackson, while they are engaged in the search for four missing marines, come across a small island in the Caribbean that, behind its paradisiacal facade, hides a very little peaceful reality.

title: Oh, God! Book II
actors: George Burns, Suzanne Pleshette, Louanne, David Birney
description: The good Lord comes to earth in the shoes of a nice and weird old man (George Burns) that everyone pities. The only one who really believes in him is a little girl and so the old man "enlists" her to let people know that he is not ... dead.
notes: It's the cheesy sequel to the witty "Oh, God!" ("Welcome back God!"), Three years earlier.

title: Key Largo
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Edward G. Robinson, Lauren Bacall, Claire Trevor
description: Returning from the war, Major Frank McCloud arrives on a Florida atoll for the funeral of one of his soldiers. The man ends up falling in love with the charming widow and finds himself having to face a gang of smugglers who dominate the island.
notes: Dense drama expertly administered by John Huston, with excellent performers. Oscar (Supporting Actress) to Claire Trevor, the gangster's babe. Lauren Bacall, then Bogart's partner, had to wait until 1997 to be nominated - for _Love has two faces_ - in the same category, but once again her dream of winning the Oscar was shattered.

title: Tron
actors: Bruce Boxleitner, Jeff Bridges, David Warner
description: A powerful company has appropriated the ideas of Flynn, inventor of electronic games. He enters the virtual world of the computer that guides society and challenges him to a deadly video game. Produced by Disney and ahead of the cyberpunk wave, it did not have the hoped-for success despite the spectacular computer animation scenes (which today appear to be true modernism).

title: The Molly Maguires
actors: Richard Harris, Sean Connery, Samantha Eggar, Art Lund
description: Pennsylvania, second half of the 19th century. Subjected to bestial exploitation, the miners found a secret terrorist sect. A detective dismantles the organization. Beautiful setting, unsatisfactory direction and script.

title: The Shadow of Obsession
actors: Veronica Hamel, Jack Scalia, Jonathan Bamks, Page Hoseley
description: Rebecca Kendall teaches philosophy at Berkeley University. One evening, during a party, she is approached by a young man who pretends to be a student. She lets herself be persuaded to be accompanied home and, during the journey, the boy attacks her. From that moment there is no more peace for Rebecca and the attentions of her "admirer" become so obsessive as to push her to change city, but also to Los Angeles ... Veronica Hamel had her moment of glory at the time when she was a lawyer in the TV series "Hill Street day and night". His cinematic chances have always been few and regularly wasted. This film is no exception.

title: The Hudsucker Proxy
actors: Tim Robbins, Paul Newman, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Charles Durning
description: Norville, a young man on his first day on the job, is appointed chairman by Hudsucker's board of directors, who hope it will ruin the company. On the other hand, Barnes, with the invention of the hula hoop, is doing good business ...
notes: Frank Capra and Franz Kafka shaken by the Coen brothers in a sour and hilarious comedy.

title: Golden Gate
