actors: Matt Dillon, Joan Chen, Bruno Kirby, Teri Polo, Tzi Ma
description: Kevin Walker, fresh out of law school, goes to work for the FBI. We are at the time of the "witch hunt" and the task is to track down the Communists. Kevin is not a fanatic, but when it comes to sending Song to jail, he is not too subtle. Ten years later, Song is free and Kevin controls him: and observes him closely even when Song throws himself from the bridge at the mouth of the San Francisco bay ...
notes: The film seems to be made in installments (there is an epilogue set in 1968), and the connections between the different parts are not too harmonious. Dillon works wonders for sewing the film; the rest of the cast isn't bad either.

title: What's Love Got to Do with It?
actors: Angela Bassett, Laurence Fishburne, Cora Lee Day, Phyllis Yvonne Stickeny
description: A child abandoned by her mother, Anna Mae Bullock grows up with her grandmother until she has the opportunity to sing in a club in Saint Louis. Among the audience is the singer Ike Turner, who takes her with him to make a sentimental and singing couple. Successes on stage and personal bitterness caused by Ike's brutality follow. But Anna, now famous as Tina Turner, finally knows how to go it alone. Based on the pop star's autobiographical book, Tina, where her ex-husband's squalor and wickedness are magnified by comparison with the protagonist's sheer candor, the film ends up sounding crude and phony. Apart from some good songs.

title: Free Willy
actors: Jason James Richter, Lori Petty, Jayne Atkinson, August Schallenberg
description: Twelve-year-old Jesse doesn't get along well with adoptive parents. After a prank, he agrees to clean the tank of an aquarium he has soiled and befriends Willy, an orca that no one has ever managed to train. With him the orca performs amazing stunts, but the sinister intentions of the owner and manager of the aquarium lie in wait. In the end, Jesse finds the truest affections and the animal freedom on the open sea. A boy with many problems and a majestic and captive animal: the combination is of sure impact. The film fulfills its task of "little thing" for families, without exceeding in sillyness.

title: The Firm
actors: Tom Cruise, Gene Hackman, Jeanne Tripplehorn, Holly Hunter, Hal Holbrook, Gary Busey, Ed Harris
description: Mitch McDeere, fresh out of law school, is hired by a prestigious law firm in Memphis. The work takes him to such an extent that he neglects his young wife, who suffers from it. Starting from suspicions about the death of two of his colleagues, Mitch tries to find out who the studio works for and realizes that there is a lot of rottenness hidden. He takes big risks, but comes out triumphant.
notes: From the novel of the same name by John Grisham, Pollack draws a film of considerable dramatic tension and interesting ethical "ease" (the ending of the book also changes). Cruise is committed and does quite well in a complex role.

title: Senza pelle
actors: Anna Galiena, Massimo Ghini, Kim Rossi Stuart, Maria Grazia Grassini
description: Saverio, a young man with some personality disorder, falls in love with Gina, married and with a four-year-old child. Riccardo, husband of Gina, obviously does not like the constant attentions of this mysterious suitor, but his wife, having met the boy, treats him with feelings of maternal understanding more and more similar to love.
notes: D'Alatri (after his debut with "Americano rosso") delicately treats the theme of psychic pathology, forcing the viewer to question his own certainties. All good, excellent Kim Rossi Stuart.

title: Family Plot
actors: Barbara Harris, Bruce Dern, Karen Black, William Devane
description: Blanche Tyler is able to see into the future and the past, or so she says. When the elderly Mrs. Rainbird asks her to look for her illegitimate nephew, abandoned years ago, she doesn't think twice. With the mirage of a salary of ten thousand dollars, Blanche sets off - together with her partner George - in search of her missing nephew ...
notes: In reality, there are two films: on one side there is the fake medium Barbara Harris with a Bruce Dern a bit messy (comedy side), on the other there is the fake jeweler William Devane together with a Karen Black in a blonde wig (yellow side). Last film by Sir Alfred, who was 75 at the time.

title: Capitan Nemo and the Underwater City
actors: Robert Ryan, Chuck Connors, Luciana Paluzzi, Nanette Newman
description: From the sinking of a sailing ship, due to a furious storm, all but six passengers are saved. While they sink, they are rescued from death by the intervention of Captain Nemo who welcomes them on the submarine "Nautilus", in his underwater city. The six, including Senator Frazer, try to return to the surface. They take possession of a submersible but it explodes. The only two survivors are then picked up by a ship's crew.
notes: It is one of the many cinematographic transpositions, and certainly not the best, of two famous novels by Jules Verne "Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea", and "The mysterious island".

title: All in a Night's Work
actors: Shirley MacLaine, Dean Martin, Charles Ruggles, Cliff Robertson
description: The death of the president of a publishing house risks producing a scandal. A half-naked girl was seen leaving her room and now it is feared that the news will leak out. The suspected girl is Katie, a company employee. To silence her, Tony, the nephew of the deceased, raises her salary and invites her to dinner. It will end in idyll. The subject is quite intricate and the result disappointing. Unlike Shirley MacLaine who never is.

title: Zero in condotta
actors: Elena Sofia Ricci, Angelo Maggi, Tiziana Altieri, Gianfranco Barra
description: Sixties: time for songs and lightheartedness. Renato thinks so too, recognized leader of an undisciplined third high school. At school you do everything but study: girls are wooed, they are spied on when they undress to go to the gym, they cultivate short flirts. Renato also falls in love, but with his math teacher's wife. All that remains is to dream of Sweden, a paradise of easy sex.
notes: It is a rather silly comedy whose only idea is to transpose the more or less Boccaccesque events in the Sixties. From the time, at least, you can hear several beautiful songs sung by Gaber, Tenco, Paoli.

title: La valle dell'eco tonante
actors: Kirk Morris, Hélène Chanel, Spela Rozin, Alberto Farnese
description: Princess Farida wants to take over the "land of green pastures" which, by the will of the prophets, belongs to the Gamaly family, led by Selina. The region is also protected by the Echo Men, a wild population with catastrophic sonic powers. The Gamalys find a precious ally in Maciste. Thanks to him, they will be able to defeat the Echo Men, eliminate Farida and reach the coveted pastures. History has no rhyme or reason; the characters do not go beyond the most abused stereotypes; the direction (by Amerigo Anton alias Tanio Boccia, the "Italian Ed Wood") is a pure formality. The end result is even funny in its total improbability.

title: Dracula
actors: Bela Lugosi, Helen Chandler, David Manners, Dwight Frye, Edward Van Sloan, Frances Dade
description: Renfield is a real estate agent sent by his boss to negotiate a sale in Transylvania. His destination is the castle of Count Dracula, a mysterious character who inspires unspeakable terror to the inhabitants of the village and its surroundings. On board a ghostly carriage he reaches the castle and ends up a slave to the evil count, who has decided to move to the city of London. Here he will be stopped by Dr. Van Helsing, a vampire catcher. The legendary Bela Lugosi, already an interpreter of Dracula in the theater, moves with great emphasis in the expressionistic scenography that surrounds him. Browning effectively adapts Stoker's famous novel and relaunches the cinematic myth of the vampire.

title: Luna rossa
actors: Barbara Florian, Leda Gloria, Renato Baldini
description: Lucia loves a sailor, but her stepmother pushes her into the arms of a seducer. It ends up in the blood.

title: Underworld U.S.A.
actors: Cliff Robertson, Dolores Dorn
description: Twelve-year-old witness to the murder of his father, he swears revenge on the killers. To accomplish it, he infiltrates the underworld. Dark gangster film with passages of remarkable visual power, is considered one of Fuller's masterpieces, with his characteristic convulsive style and his characters on the verge of pathology.

title: Amanecer en puerta oscura
actors: Francisco Rabal, Luis Peña
description: During a bloody revolt in a mine in an Andalusian village, Andrea kills a foreman. While trying to calm down, Andrea gets involved in a shooting. At this point Pedro intervenes, who saves his life. The two decide to flee to the mountains, but the troubles are not over.
notes: So-so Spanish production in which Francisco Rabal seems a bit wasted.

title: Uno dopo l'altro
actors: Richard Harrison, Pamela Tudor, José Bodalo, Jolanda Modio
description: Former Colonel Jefferson covets the gold that wealthy ranchers deposit in his bank. To get hold of it, he stages a robbery and does not hesitate to kill his own cashier Bill Ross who tries to react to the "bandits". He is now sure he has gotten away with it when Stan arrives in town, who is not satisfied with the official version of Ross's death. Jefferson tries to put him on red herrings, but fails to avoid the showdown. It looks like a mass-produced western, based on dozens of its predecessors, and indeed it is. In addition it has some slowness that aims to create "suspension" but is ultimately irritating.

title: Ash Wednesday
actors: Elizabeth Taylor, Henry Fonda, Helmut Berger
description: Barbara, a no longer young woman from Detroit, in order to win back her husband who neglects her and dedicates himself to occasional adventures, takes advantage of a vacation to undergo a series of cosmetic surgery operations in a Swiss clinic. In Cortina, a handsome playboy courts her, then her husband too, who joined her, seems to regain some interest in her, but it doesn't last long. Here is a film where art and life, fiction and reality are welded into the figure of the protagonist's character, played by Liz Taylor, a true expert in facelift. Apart from that, the film is not a gem in terms of psychological investigation.

title: King of the Gypsies
actors: Sterling Hayden, Shelley Winters, Susan Sarandon, Eric Roberts, Brooke Shields
description: A community of gypsies is governed by the old King Zharko and his wife, Queen Rachel. To their son Groffo, with a violent and wild character, is given in wife Rose, who gives him two children, Dave and Tita. Dave becomes the favorite of his grandfather and grows kind and attracted by the non -gypsy society. Often he flees to seek escape to his father's inhumanity. The grandfather names him his heir by triggering the ire of his father who causes an accident in which Tita dies: Dave then kills him. It is an attempt, only in part successful, to connect the gypsy universe to modern society. The contrast remains a little in the shade in favor of a glossy folklore.

title: Joshua Tree
actors: Dolph Lundgren, George Segal, Kristian Alfonso, Geoffrey Lewis, Michelle Phillips
description: Wellman Santee has lived for years hauling stolen cars across the Mojave Desert with friend Eddie. The last mission, however, ended badly: in a clash with the police. Eddie died, he was injured and he was arrested. At the first opportunity he manages to escape by taking a girl, Rita, who works as a policeman as a hostage. But it will be precisely his uncomfortable "prisoner" to go over to his side and give him a hand. Daring escapes, breathtaking races, reversal of the head, firefights and dramatic showdown: without giving up winks and cinephile quotes so insistent as to be almost didactic.

title: Miller's Crossing
actors: Gabriel Byrne, Marcia Gay Harden, Albert Finney, John Turturro, Jon Polito
description: The boss Johnny Caspar, of Neapolitan origins, is attempting the rise to the underworld power held by the Irishman Leo. However, he does not give in to his blackmail (he should hand over Bernie who is the brother of Vera, his mistress). But Vera also has an affair with Tom, Leo's right arm, who when he finds out he beats his friend to death, chasing him away. It is the war, which leads to an incredible series of murders after which the two former friends are reconciled but each going their own way. Third film and third center of the Coen brothers (Barton Fink) who reconstruct, between quotes and hyperrealism, a dark sense of destiny and tragedy, the gangster genre and the atmosphere of a novel like "Res Harvest" by Dashiell Hammett. Masterful interpretation by John Turturro.

title: Il tesoro della foresta pietrificata
actors: Gordon Mitchell, Ivo Payer, Eleonora Bianchi
description: In the petrified forest are the golden sword and the treasure of the Nibelungs that the god Wotan has entrusted to the custody of Sigmund and Brunhilde. An army of Vikings leaves for the forest, led by Hunding, but in the end Sigmund, aided by the Valkyries, manages to repel the assault. Mythological series C, willing and unpretentious. Music by Wagner on the soundtrack!

title: The Spy Who Loved Me
actors: Roger Moore, Barbara Bach, Curd Jürgens, Richard Kiel, Caroline Munro
description: James Bond recovered an important microfilm in Cairo by beating the Soviet spy Anya Armasova on time. The news of the disappearance of two nuclear submarines arrives; England and the USSR work together, as one of the two submarines is Soviet. And so 007 finds himself working with Anya. Together they discover that behind the disappearance there is a Scandinavian owner, Stromberg; its goal is to guarantee humanity a post-nuclear future under the surface of the seas. Stromberg has built a submarine base and wants to destroy New York and Moscow.
notes: Tenth episode of the Bond series and third with Roger Moore. Varied setting as befits: Egypt, Sardinia, Scotland, Baffin Island, Austrian Alps; direction glued to the action; script with no surprises, but for this reason solid enough.

title: Those Bedroom Eyes
actors: Mimi Rogers, Tim Matheson, Carroll Baker, William Forsythe
description: William (Tim Matheson) teaches psychology, but all his knowledge doesn't help him easily overcome the trauma of his wife's death. A crack opens when he accidentally meets Ali (Mimi Rogers) on a train. Love is born immediately between the two, but William's apprehensions have no end. In fact, Ali seems to be hiding a secret. Not to mention that some murders take place in the background. Mimi Rogers plays the part of the sophisticated and mysterious woman. Too bad the film is not the same.

title: Lady Beware
actors: Diane Lane, Michael Woods, Cotter Smith, Tyra Ferrell
description: Katia Yarno (Lane) is hired as a window dresser by the president of Pittsburgh's department store Horne's. In front of her works Jack Price (Woods) who is a technician in a radiology laboratory, but more than anything else he is interested in the eccentric poses in which Katia styles her mannequins. Jack, who is married with two children, but who is actually a psychopath, starts stalking the girl and harassing her with obscene phone calls. At first Katia falls down, then decides to go on the counterattack ...
notes: Karen Arthur says enough to films that exploit the terror of single women in the face of the persecution of some psychotic. In the role of the avenger is Diane Lane, enchanting at the time.

title: Ricky & Barabba
actors: Christian De Sica, Renato Pozzetto, Francesca Reggiani, Franco Fabrizi, Sylva Koscina
description: A financier on the brink of ruin and suicide is saved by a bum.
notes: Descent into the underworld of a privileged salvific intervention of a pariah, redemption of both. Already seen, and although you can see the blood vitality of De Sica & C. everything else, you have to invent it.

title: Mortal Thoughts
actors: Demi Moore, Glenne Headly, Bruce Willis, Harvey Keitel, John Pankow
description: A woman goes to the police station for a lengthy deposition on a murder case. The policeman, who records the interviews with a video camera, is patient and understanding. It turns out that the woman, Cynthia, and her best friend, Joyce, are complicit in killing both of their husbands ...
notes: Macabre and gloomy, Rudolph mercilessly photographs the squalid universe of provincial life where violence, against women and women, is more ferocious: apparently naive, in reality he portrays characters and frustrations with psychological depth and the director's skill exudes every shot.

title: Ultimate Betrayal
actors: Ally Sheedy, Marlo Thomas, Mel Harris, Eileen Heckart, Henry Czerny
description: Four sisters exhibit surprisingly severe psychological problems in everyday life. When they find themselves talking about their past, they discover that as children they have all been the object of the "special attention" of their father, an important and unsuspected senior FBI executive. So they decide to go to the law to get compensation for their trauma.
notes: Inspired by a fact that really happened in the United States, yet another film with a tragic correspondence in recent facts of the judicial news, which in reality too often only tickle voyeurism and a certain morbidity in the television audience.

title: Feds
actors: Rebecca De Mornay, Mary Gross, Ken Marshall, Fred Dalton Thompson
description: Two girls decide to become federal agents. The desire to study, get busy and be up to it is great. But they realize that the path they have decided to undertake, even with all their good will, is hard. And it can be more so for two girls who also have to deal with male classmates, idiots and chauvinists.
notes: The story might suggest a "federal" version of the various "Police School", but it's less of a smash (and less fun).

title: Rapid Fire
actors: Brandon Lee, Powers Boothe, Nick Mancuso, Tzi Ma
description: Jake Lo studies in college and is haunted by the memory of his father, who died heroically under a tank in Tiananmen Square. The boy is a quiet type, but he finds himself an involuntary witness to a drug trafficking. Very dangerous situation, were it not for the fact that Jake is a martial arts expert, he learned from him precisely in homage to the memory (a bit uncomfortable) of his parent. In addition, he can enlist the support of a Chicago cop, Mace Ryan. The criminals who are angry with him think they have the easy game, but they will have bread for their teeth. Low budget but well used action movie. The ingredients are the usual, the rather unlikely premises, but the result is not really to be thrown away.

title: L'avventura
actors: Gabriele Ferzetti, Monica Vitti, Lea Massari, Dominique Blanchar, Esmeralda Ruspoli
description: Anna, daughter of a retired ambassador, and Claudia are invited to a trip to the Aeolian Islands aboard the yacht of Sandro, architect, Anna's boyfriend. Other friends of the couple also participate in the excursion, but none seem particularly enchanted by the superb seascape that surrounds them. After a fight with Sandro, Anna suddenly disappears. Sandro and Claudia, initially with the other members of the company, look for her in vain in various places; once they are left alone on the island, an ambiguous relationship is established between them, at first one of mutual tolerance. Then, as hopes of finding Anna fade, they indulge in love. It sounds like a solid story, but the man soon finds a way to indulge in an occasional fling with another woman. Claudia, after a moment of rebellion, resigns herself to forgive him. On a very thin story, Antonioni constructs an analysis of feelings of exceptional value, both in terms of content and form. It is the masterpiece that paves the way for the trilogy on incommunicability: "The night", "The eclipse" and "Red desert".

title: Thousands Cheer
actors: Kathryn Grayson, Gene Kelly, Mary Astor, John Boles
description: The colonel's daughter and a soldier in love with her organize a great variety show at the military base. Mgm propaganda product for civilians and military during World War II; not exceptional but at times very pleasant, with a shower of stars.

title: Hollywood Canteen
actors: Dane Clark, Joan Leslie, Robert Hutton, Janis Paige, Barbara Stanwyck, Dane Clark
description: Sergeant Nolan and Corporal Slim Green, licensed in Hollywood, walk into the Hollywood Canteen, a licensed soldier club run by movie stars. Here they do indeed find various stars, but Slim's dream is to meet actress Joan Leslie. For this actor John Garfield has a brilliant idea: organize a lottery with a kiss to Joan Leslie as the first prize. The place was really there, it was called "Hollywood Canteen". The film is a typical product packaged for "troop morale", where dozens of great stars parade in appearance: Joan Crawford, Barbara Stanwyck, Eddie Cantor, Peter Lorre, Ida Lupino, Bette Davis and many others.

title: Un minuto per pregare, un istante per morire
actors: Alex Cord, Arthur Kennedy, Robert Ryan, Enzo Fiermonte
description: A gunslinger suffers from temporary paralysis in his arm and finds himself caught between a cruel bandit and a sheriff who is perhaps even worse. Giraldi's direction is more messy than usual, and the cast includes some old American glories.

title: ¡Dispara!
actors: Francesca Neri, Antonio Banderas, Walter Vidarte, Eulalia Ramon
description: Ana is a circus acrobat whose specialty is shooting from a running horse. A journalist, Marcos, frequents her and falls in love with her, but one night, Marcos is absent, the woman is raped by three young mechanics. Ana lurks near the garage where the three work and shoots them all. The hunt for the avenging horseman is unleashed all over the country and not even Marcos can save her.
notes: Very fragile both in the narrative structure and in the conceptual system, Saura's film is substantially wrong. Francesca Neri is not saved, despite her beauty, while Antonio Banderas is relegated to a role of no depth.

title: Kalifornia
actors: Juliette Lewis, Brad Pitt, Michelle Forbes, David Duchovny
description: Brian is planning a book on serial killers; Carrie fails to break through with her photographs. They decide to leave for California; they look for travel companions with an ad in the newspaper to which Early and Adele reply. Early is a serial killer on probation. The journey turns into a nightmare for Brian and Carrie, until the showdown in a former nuclear testing range. Debut film for Dominic Sena; the "serial killer" argument is now overused, but the narrative cut shows some interesting ideas. Screenplay not very original but tense. The Lewis-Pitt couple was excellent.

title: Rising Sun
actors: Sean Connery, Wesley Snipes, Harvey Keitel, Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa, Tia Carrere
description: At the inauguration of the new skyscraper of a Japanese multinational, a girl is killed in Los Angeles. The two policemen in charge of the case are Web Smith and John Connor, an expert in relations with the Japanese. Connor lets the prime suspect go; Web protests, but Connor is right. And a senator also ends up in the investigation, apparently an enemy of the Japanese presence in the United States.
notes: Michael Crichton had written a vitriolic bestseller about the Japanese invasion of the American market. Kaufman made this detective story without too much bite, albeit supported by the protagonists.

title: Hotel Room
actors: Harry Dean Stanton, Glenne Headly, Griffin Dunne
description: Three episodes, three different events that have in common the fact that they take place in the same hotel room in distant years. In 1969 a man went there with a prostitute after the death of his wife. In 1992 a woman is dumped there without too many compliments by her lover. In 1936, a married couple found serenity there after the drama that seemed to have to break their union.

title: Mrs. Miniver
actors: Greer Garson, Walter Pidgeon, Teresa Wright, Richard Ney
description: In an English village, Mrs. Miniver sees her husband and the eldest of her three children leave for the war. The village is bombed, but the inhabitants do not allow themselves to be disheartened. There is a flower contest and Mrs. Miniver is the soul of the initiative. Back from the party, a strafing kills his son's girlfriend. The pastor exalts the victims and urges them to continue the struggle. It is a propaganda product in the war period, but carried out with remarkable sensitivity and finesse in the description of the difficult everyday life, as well as enlivened by a great interpretation by Greer Garson. To her one of the six Oscars won by the film (the others: best film, direction, photography, set design and Teresa Wright non-star actress).

title: Il ladro di Damasco
actors: Tony Russell, Luciana Gilli, Gianni Solaro, Ferruccio Amendola
description: During the Roman domination in Syria, two thieves, Jesen and Tisba, used by patriots to create unrest, are pursued by the consul's guards. In the escape Jesen takes refuge in the house of the potter Ammon, and falls in love with his daughter Miriam. The girl is kidnapped and, in an attempt to save her, the two are taken, but the consul recognizes in one of them the son who was kidnapped at an early age. He is one of the mediocre "peplums" of period Italian cinema but at least he is joking.

title: Misunderstood
actors: Huckle Berry Fox, Gene Hackman, Henry Thomas, Maureen Kerwin
description: A wealthy businessman, suddenly a widower, neglects the older and more sensitive of his two sons; the boy will go to extreme means in order to win back the attention and affection of his father. A film that reserves only tears, despite Hackman and Schatzberg's direction. From the famous novel by Florence Montgomery.

title: Nestore. L'ultima corsa
actors: Alberto Sordi, Matteo Ripaldi, Cinzia Cannarozzo, Eros Pagni, Simona Caparrini, Tatiana Farnese, Rosa Pianeta, Enzo Monteduro
description: Gaetano, driver of a horse-drawn carriage in Rome, is 75 years old and the owner of the license wants to retire him. For the horse Nestor, also now old, the "final solution" to the slaughter is looming. But Gaetano doesn't stay there and wanders around Rome with his faithful animal. Nestor is stolen, then found, and Gaetano takes refuge with his grandson with his horse. Both chased from there too, they resume their wandering, followed by the boy.
notes: Some wines, as they age, improve, others, on the other hand, "vanish". Alberto Sordi's wine belongs to the second category, no longer strong flavors and reduced to rosolio that tastes of molasses. He insists on making films and the audience snubbing them.

title: Mazzabubù... quante corna stan quaggiù?
actors: Carlo Giuffrè, Isabella Biagini, Maurizio Bonuglia, Mariolina Cannuli, Renzo Montagnani, Silvana Pampanini
description: Famous and anonymous cases of extramarital affairs: a young and suspicious hubby gets the effect of being cornered; an art critic forces his wife to join in his presence with the artist who painted an abstract painting; an Eskimo is desperate because his wife has not been "hospitable" to a traveler; Minos becomes convinced of Pasiphae's infidelity when the Minotaur is born and so on. Series of jokes, rather than episodes, in the name of the banal vulgarity and squalor of a pedestrian cinematographic production. Half the "firmament" of the Italian screen is involved, the one that never pulled back. Unfortunately.

title: Il dito nella piaga
actors: Klaus Kinski, George Hilton, Ray Saunders, Betsy Bell
description: The arrival of the Germans saves two thieving and violent American soldiers from being shot, but they redeem themselves by fighting to the death.

title: New Frontier
actors: John Wayne, Muriel Evans
description: Rancheros "evicted" for the construction of a dam, at first they defend themselves, then they set out for other, more prosperous lands.
notes: One of the countless C westerns played by Wayne before _Red Shadows_. It has no merit, at least until the final quarter of an hour, which is worth the entire film

title: Tentacoli
actors: John Huston, Shelley Winters, Bo Hopkins, Henry Fonda
description: A fisherman and a child disappear into the sea in California; the mangled corpses are found. As the list of victims grows, it turns out that responsible is a huge octopus, maddened by the ultrasound emitted by the equipment used to build an underwater tunnel. The producer Assonitis, under a pseudonym, to repeat the enormous success of the "Shark", enriching the story with ecological. The latter, however, are naive and schematic, as are the characters. Instead, the scenes with the octopus are effective.

title: Lady Barbara
actors: Renato dei Profeti, Paola Tedesco, Carlo Delle Piane, Franca Dominici
description: The British Barbara is engaged to Edward; during a trip to Italy he meets Renato, a photo novel actor and aspiring singer. The girl falls in love with the young man in return. Her aunt, however, to the sound of plots and deceptions, convinces her to marry Edward. But a subsequent trip to Italy reveals the truth. Edward, with British fair play, gives way to Renato, now an established singer.
notes: Late product of the sentimental-musical trend in vogue in the sixties focused on successful singers. Here the ingredients are revived with some weariness. Protagonist: Renato dei Profeti, minor star of the musical firmament of the time.

title: Gli invincibili tre
actors: Alan Steel, Mimmo Palmara, Rosalba Neri, Lisa Gastoni
description: A tyrant who calls himself Ursus lords over, with his right arm Theomachus, the inhabitants of the city of Atra. The real Ursus arrives by chance in the city accompanied by two friends, Capriolo and Manina; protected by the loyal Prince Darius, the redeemed Queen Alina and with the support of the population, who can no longer stand the tyrant's oppression, the three restore peace and justice. Duels, tests of strength, Far West fights, exotic dances: a cheap cauldron. If you laugh every now and then, it's out of involuntary comedy.

title: Nanou
actors: Imogen Stubbs, Jean-Philippe Ecoffey, Daniel Day-Lewis, Christophe Lidon
description: Nanou is an English girl who travels around Europe before undertaking photography university studies. One day, on the train, she meets a charming Frenchman named Luc and goes to live with him, giving up his family, his country and his career. But Luc is embroiled in dangerous subversive plots and Nanou discovers that she feels a stranger to these positions. Debut feature film for the young director who denotes the ability to psychologically analyze and structure the story (the screenplay is also hers). There is some handwriting concession too.

title: Un, deux, trois soleil
actors: Anouk Grinberg, Marcello Mastroianni, Myriam Boyer, Claude Brasseur
description: At the edges of the most extreme and degraded Marseille suburbs lives the little Victorine, a decidedly little awake girl who has an even less casual mother than her. Becoming Granichella discovers the love and sex that practices without limits. He falls in love with Petit Paul, but they do it out and then she turns into a ruthless killer and takes revenge. In the meantime, her father also died, Constantin, who then reborn as a ghost. The ambitions of the film are many, many of which are frustrated by an excess of grotesque that is lost in the labyrinths of a slightly boring dreamlike.

title: Huozhe
actors: Ge You, Gong Li, Guo Tao, Niu Ben, Liu Tian Chi
description: Young Fugui loses all his luck in the game. He starts to be a walking puppeteer. So he is drafted into the army; when he returns from the war he finds his wife who lives by making enormous sacrifices. They have a son who later dies in an accident. Meanwhile, the Cultural Revolution broke out. Their daughter, who married the head of the village's Red Guards, dies in childbirth, but the baby survives. Zhang Yimou, already appreciated director of Red Lanterns, tells half a century of Chinese history by shifting the perspective from the general to the particular of the life of a village, thus desacralizing the contours between melodrama and humor.

title: Anche i commercialisti hanno un'anima
actors: Enrico Montesano, Renato Pozzetto, Sabrina Ferilli, Milena Vukotic
description: On board an airliner departing for India there are, among the other passengers, Carlo, an unscrupulous careerist, Sonia and Roberto, a bit crazy she, a lover of a quiet life, him, and Cesira. Cesira wants to get to know the famous Subramanian holy man. After a series of adventures, Carlo convinces Cesira to create a company to exploit the image of the saint. To revitalize a glorious genre, such as that of the Italian comedy, it is evidently not enough, as has been attempted here, some injection of exoticism. The interpretations of two of the genre's sacred monsters, Enrico Montesano and Renato Pozzetto, also seem to follow the general trend of the film.

title: 40 Guns to Apache Pass
actors: Audie Murphy, Michael Burns, Kenneth Tobey
description: To respond to the Apache threat it becomes essential to collect forty new repeating rifles. Captain Coburn takes charge of the mission, bringing it to completion happily, although Mike, one of the two young recruits that the captain had brought with him, will remain on the field.
notes: A conventional western more attentive to the characters, and their feelings, than to the story.

title: Le guignolo
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Michel Galabru, George Geret, Carla Romanelli
description: Released before his time because he promised to find a job, Alexandre Dupré, who as a profession has chosen to be a thief and a swindler, embarks on a cruise ship full of billionaires disguised as a sailor. Among the wealthy tourists he spots a young and beautiful widow. When he discovers that the woman does the same job as her, he decides to ally with her. It is a film made to measure for Belmondo, who wallows in the story.

title: Zardoz
actors: Sean Connery, Charlotte Rampling, Sara Kestelman, John Alderton
description: Zardoz is an illusory flying stone deity thanks to which the "Immortals", ruling the violence of the "Exterminators", dominate Vortex with its population of slaves and marginalized, the only mortal beings left in the society of 2293. Until just a "exterminator" ", Zed, destroys the system with all sorts of transgressions: he succeeds in introducing himself into Zardoz and therefore into Vortex, thus giving a new start to human life according to natural cycles.
notes: Corrusco, Dionysian mythological "back to the future" written and directed by John Boorman and vigorously interpreted by Sean Connery, between exasperated symbolism and intellectual lucubrations.

title: Attila flagello di Dio
actors: Diego Abatantuono, Rita Rusic, Angelo Infanti, Mauro Di Francesco
description: At the time of the Romans, a tribe of barbarians who lived by hunting settled in Lombardy. The Romans attack the tribe by stealing livestock and kidnapping women. The barbarians, led by Attila, go down to Rome to take back the stolen goods. The film is unrealistic in loading the whole story on the shoulders of an old-fashioned Diego Abatantuono (ante Salvatores), who has now reached the end of his comedy full of grimaces and ramblings in "tierruncellese". Convict film for the then beautiful B-movie Rita Rusic, daughter of Istrian refugees who landed in Cinecittà from her native Busto Arsizio in search of cinematic glory. A (short) past as a basketball player and model for the Postalmarket catalog, breathtaking curves and a granite determination, the beautiful Rita plays the "barbarian" who makes the king of the Huns lose his head. Off the set, meanwhile, the producer of the film really lost it for her: Vittorio Cecchi Gori. On July 18, 1983, Rita Rusic's film career ended and that of Rita Cecchi Gori began.

title: Trenchcoat
actors: Margot Kidder, Robert Hays, David Suchet, Daniel Faraldo
description: Mickey, stenographer in court and aspiring author of yellow, goes to Malta to focus on her author's work. She will end up involved in the plot she is writing. Produced by Disney out of time, it is a trivial but not flowing intrigue, indeed unnecessarily cumbersome: a not recommended cocktail.

title: March or Die
actors: Terence Hill, Gene Hackman, Catherine Deneuve, Max Von Sydow
description: An active archaeological expedition in the Sahara desert is escorted by the Foreign Legion. The soldiers clash with the Berber rebels. In the wake of the neo-colonial films a la "Zulu", a pseudo-remake of Julien Duvivier's film of the same name from 1935, with very confused interpreters, an annoying rhetoric and evident ideological confusion.

title: La Dama rossa uccide sette volte
actors: Barbara Bouchet, Ugo Pagliai, Marina Malfatti, Marino Masé
description: The Wildenbruch family is haunted by a curse: every hundred years it is struck by the bloody "Red Lady" who reincarnates as a descendant, claiming victims. Martin Wildenbruch, aware of the ominous anniversary is about to approach, suspects that the next lady will be his wife and runs for cover ...
notes: The abundance of characters and intricacies of the plot creates a discreet thriller system, seasoned with frequent suggestions that wink at our local gothic tradition. In practice, it is the classic product of its time with a cast of usual suspects among which stands out, it must be said, a Barbara Bouchet able to give shape and thickness to erotic desire.

title: The Lookalike
actors: Melissa Gilbert, Diane Ladd, Bo Brinkman, Frances Lee McCain
description: Gina, after leaving a clinic, relies on a psychiatrist to try to regain her balance after the death of her daughter. The lost serenity also leads her to separate from her husband, after an attempt at dialogue. He then finds work in a shopping mall, where he meets a little girl who looks like the one she has lost. Her boss warns her that she risks a split in personality ... A television production that entrusts all its chances to the quality of photography. The screenplay is routine and the direction of Gary Nelson is not very convincing, especially as regards the direction of the interpreters.

title: Jack McCall Desperado
actors: George Montgomery, Angela Stevens, Douglas Kennedy
description: During the Civil War, Jack McCall is unjustly accused of treason and locked up in prison from where he manages to escape. Two soldiers chasing him kill his parents. At the end of the war, Jack is determined to take revenge. Western series B without particular signs.

title: Peter Gunn - Rogue Cops
actors: Peter Strauss, Barbara Williams, Jennifer Edwards, Charles Gioffi
description: Elegant, self-deprecating, young and seductive, private detective Peter Gunn is hired by a big shot of the underworld on whom someone has decided to suspect for the murder of another boss. Edwards brings back to the screen the protagonist of a beautiful television series that launched it like thirty years before. But the past years, with the infinite imitations that made the original product the progenitor of a genre, are sadly felt.

title: Il volpone
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Enrico Montesano, Enrico Maria Salerno, Renzo Montagnani
description: Ugo Maria Volpone, a very rich shipowner, tyrannizes his three best friends who are only waiting for his death to throw themselves into the inheritance. With the arrival of the new waiter, Bartolomeo, the game becomes even more poisoned. Finally, the two stage the great number of the death of the landlord. Inspired by Ben Johnson's comedy of the same name, the film is professionally directed by Ponzi. Compared to the original (to which the Joseph Mankiewicz of Masquerade also referred), this version overturns the parts and chooses to employ the waiter Bartolomeo as the engine and protagonist of the intrigue. The choice of giving more space to this character, however, does not do justice to the skill of the Village. The first part is thus more convincing, in which Volpone dominates the scene.

title: Hook
actors: Dustin Hoffman, Robin Williams, Julia Roberts, Bob Hoskins
description: Peter Banning is an accomplished 40-year-old lawyer who is no longer able to devote his time to his wife Moira, nor to his children, Jack and Maggie. Returning home, Peter discovers that Captain Hook has kidnapped his children and taken them to Neverland. Thanks to the help of Tinker Bell, Banning reaches the fabulous island; here, however, there is no lack of mockery, not only by Hook, but also by his former companions, the "lost boys". Only through hard work on body and mind will Banning be the Peter Pan he once was.
notes: In search of the lost ark of adolescence, Steven Spielberg revisits the Peter Pan saga, adding some superficial polemic against yuppism. Behind the images, Disney naturally winks and strangely, the pace is not always controlled. On the other hand, splendid sets and costumes. Parts for Maggie Smith, Gwyneth Paltrow, Glenn Close.

title: Verso Sud
actors: Antonella Ponziani, Stefano Dionisi, Tito Schipa jr., Irene Grazioli
description: Paola, recently released from prison, is looking for a job and occasionally prostitutes herself to give her two-year-old son a gift. In the same degraded environment, Eugenio also lives by expedients. The two know and love each other. She kidnaps her son, he steals a car and they flee to Puglia. Salvation could be illegal expatriation to Greece, but the trip costs two million ... The two marginals in Pozzessere's debut film do not rebel against their condition. Their impossible escape has poetic and desperate accents, but never falls into rhetoric or sociological didactics. The young performers are also convincing.

title: The Great Ziegfeld
actors: William Powell, Luise Rainer, Myrna Loy, Frank Morgan
description: Florenz Ziegfeld, the impresario who went down in history as the father of the musical, or of light theater in music, initially worked adventurously in small provincial clubs. His rise is marked by two marriages and the second will be forever. Engaged in increasingly spectacular, sumptuous and surprising productions, at the peak of his success he suffered a financial crash; he died in misery in 1932.
notes: Produced by MGM in the golden years of the musical, a sumptuous, huge, fascinating show. The black and white does not detract from the scenography of the musical numbers. Three Oscars: Best Film, Choreography and Leading Actress (Luise Rainer).

title: Il piccolo diavolo
actors: Roberto Benigni, Walter Matthau, Stefania Sandrelli, Nicoletta Braschi
description: An American priest, Maurizio (Matthau), is called to exorcise an elderly hairdresser named Giuditta. During the exorcism a little devil (Benigni) emerges from the woman's body, claiming to be Giuditta. A series of troubles begins for poor Maurizio, because the little devil sticks to him like a shadow. To justify his cumbersome presence, Maurizio decides to pass him off as his own nephew. But the poor priest's patience has a limit so, when the little devil falls in love with Nina (Braschi) and neglects him, Maurizio finally believes he has regained tranquility. But Nina is a she-devil sent to Earth to bring the fugitive home. The script is a canvas, the dead times are numerous, Matthau is not at ease. But the film obviously applies to the moments in which Benigni is freewheeling.

title: Third Degree Burn
actors: Treat Williams, Virginia Madsen, Richard Masur
description: Scott Weston is a private investigator specializing in divorce cases. Between one shadowing and another he also finds time to establish relationships with married women. His "hobby" leads him, one day, to meet Anne Scholes, a charming and young lady married to a wealthy elderly man. A fiery affair ensues that will involve Scott in the elimination of his spouse. Raise your hand if you have not already seen this subject shot by other directors. To tell the truth this latest version is not bad either, even if from Spottiswoode ("Under fire") it would be reasonable to expect more. Virginia Madsen is confirmed as excellent in the part of the dark lady.

title: The Swarm
actors: Michael Caine, Katharine Ross, Richard Widmark, Richard Chamberlain
description: After attacking and exterminating a military garrison in Texas, a swarm of killer bees from Brazil sets out on a devastating raid into the heart of the United States. The White House entrusts the task of neutralizing it to entomologist Brad Crane, who calls on the scientist Walter Krim for help. But the solution is late in coming, the bees are rampant, and the military impose remedies worse than the disease.
notes: With a cast of great appeal a plot already exploited both in the cinema and in various TV productions is "pumped" without imagination. The rudimentary dialogues and the ineffective special effects ended up determining a sensational, deserved flop at the box office.

title: A Kiss Before Dying
actors: Matt Dillon, Sean Young, Max Von Sydow, Adam Horowitz
description: In his poor childhood misfit and devoid of true points of reference, Jonathan Corliss developed an insane fixation on Thor Carlsson's family. Once grown up, Jonathan manages to steal the trust of Dorothy, Carlsson's daughter: and secretly engaged to her, he murders her by simulating a suicide ...
notes: The culprit is immediately revealed, the emotion should arise from the threat that hangs over the monster's innocent bride, but the mechanism is not governed with full fluency. Matt Dillon does not cross the shadow line that imprisons him after the star exploits of the early Eighties.

title: Hush Little Baby
actors: Diane Ladd, Wendel Meldrun
description: Susan is a girl who grew up in a foster family. Her life passed quietly and she is now a happy young mother. One day he receives a strange letter: it is his real mother who, after twenty-five years, shows up. The girl meets her and takes her home with her, introducing her adoptive parents, grandchildren, her husband Martin. Hidi, the mother, turns out to be a very affectionate person, but some strange incidents and behavior make Martin suspicious about his true goals. In fact, Martin discovers that the woman served twenty-five years in prison because she mistreated her daughter, who was then given in foster care. When the drama meets the news, intense stories can arise, even if, perhaps, a little melodramatic and conventional. In the role of the mother, Diane Ladd, old Hollywood star, former protagonist of Wild Heart.

title: Malice
actors: Nicole Kidman, Bill Pullman, Alec Baldwin, George C. Scott
description: Andy (Pullman) is the principal of a New England college where a killer is killing female students. Andy is concerned about this and the abdominal pain his wife Tracy (Kidman) is suffering from. After a while, the killer is found, but Tracy's pains do not subside and, rushed to the hospital, she is operated on by Jed, the new surgeon who has recently arrived in town.
notes: And with that we have reached the middle of the plot, but the film is so full of events that it is almost impossible to tell it in two words. Which is not necessarily a good sign. Becker exaggerates with twists and constantly risks losing control of the situation.

title: Three Violent People
actors: Charlton Heston, Anne Baxter, Tom Tryon, Gilbert Roland, Forrest Tucker
description: Joe (Heston) returns home with his wife, whose past he ignores, and confronts a couple of bad guys. Good-paced Western.

title: Texas Carnival
actors: Esther Williams, Red Skelton, Howard Keel
description: A fair artist is mistaken for the daughter of a millionaire and risks trouble. The script almost does not exist, Williams and the "shoulders" remain.

title: The Jazz Singer
actors: Al Jolson, May McAvoy, Warner Oland
description: His father, a rabbi, would like to have him sing in the synagogue but Jackie runs away from home to go to Broadway. Rather conventional, it is important as the first sound film in the history of cinema. Although in reality it is only partially sonorous: some songs and some phrases, including the first, famous: "Hey, wait, I'm not finished yet!".

title: Black Eagle
actors: Sho Kosugi, Jean-Claude Van Damme
description: CIA Special Agent Black Eagle is near Malta with her two little children, but it's not a vacation. In addition, the two children are kidnapped by agent Andrei, of the KGB. Thus the fight between the two protagonists ignites and they continue to fight each other with karate shots every time they meet. In the end, the evil Andrei blows up and Black Eagle, freed his children, returns home.
notes: A "vintage" Van Damme, when ours still had to settle for bad roles, with a final showdown to his detriment. But success was about to arrive and with that also the official admission to the category of "darlings".

title: Moulin Rouge
actors: José Ferrer, Zsa Zsa Gabor, Katherine Kath, Claude Nollier, Colette Marchand
description: Imaginative adaptation of the biography of Henry Toulouse-Lautrec, the Parisian painter of the Belle Époque. Splendid photographic rendering and scenography, which earned Paul Sheriff the Oscar. Fun and kitsch.

title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
actors: Robert Englund, Heather Langenkamp, Ronee Blakley, John Saxon, Amanda Wyss, Jsu Garcia, Johnny Depp, Charles Fleischer, Joseph Whipp, Lin Shaye, Joe Unger
description: Some boys' nightmares materialize with the appearance of a monstrous killer with razor blades instead of fingernails. The film by director Wes Craven marks the debut of Freddie Krueger, a cult character of 1980s horror, in a brilliant film with an almost Bunuelian inventiveness. Great cinematic intelligence and perfect mastery of the archetypes of terror made this film a classic. The protagonist's boyfriend is a very young Johnny Depp.

title: Blow Up
actors: David Hemmings, Vanessa Redgrave, Sarah Miles, Jane Birkin, Peter Bowles, Gillian Hills, Veruschka
description: Thomas, a young well -established fashion photographer in London, is creating a service on discomfort in the London neighborhoods, when he takes the effusions of a couple in a park. The woman, noticing that she was photographed, identifies him and the next day she presents herself in her study and insistently asks the roll, but Thomas, with a trick, instead gives him another. When developing photos, enlargement after enlargement, realizes how the images reveal an attempt of assassination. Back in the park at night, Thomas discovers the corpse of the man who was with the woman. Looking for help from a friend, but ends up in a party and when he returns to the park in the morning after the corpse he disappeared and his photos have been stolen in the meantime. What is the truth and what the illusion?
notes: One of Antonioni's most intriguing and refined films, an exquisite expressive search in the service of an operation of great intellectual charm. The acting of the interpreters, of great efficacy of the London setting, of gold in Cannes in 1967, are impeccable. The music of Herbie Hancock also follow.

title: Riding Shotgun
actors: Randolph Scott, Wayne Morris, Joan Weldon, Charles Bronson
description: Unjustly suspected of agreeing with a gang of thugs, Larry Delong has to go all out to persuade the inhabitants of Deepwater not to pursue the bandits, thus leaving the city unguarded.
notes: A routine western unexpectedly shot almost entirely indoors, which is quite unusual for the genre.

title: Boom Town
actors: Clark Gable, Spencer Tracy, Claudette Colbert, Hedy Lamarr
description: In the US, where everything seems possible and where tenacity and determination are enough to get rich quickly, two close friends are thrown into the most recent economic adventure: the search for oil. Business thrives and friendship strengthens until between the two, despite himself, a woman gets in the way of both of them they fall in love with. Rich production that applies above all to the poker of stars, protagonists in a skilful mix of action and sentiment.

title: Diplomatic Immunity
actors: Bruce Boxleitner, Billy Drago, Tom Breznahan, Meg Foster
description: It is the dramatic story of a father, a marine, whose daughter was killed. Distraught by the story and determined to carry out his revenge to the end, he tracks down the killer and sets out in pursuit of him. The showdown takes place in South America, specifically in Paraguay.
notes: The film mixes dramatic elements with action and violence, firmly pushing on the pedal of strong colors, which do nothing but weaken the film. Bruce Boxleitner, here protagonist, was engaged in the role of Luke in the drama "Conquering the West". Also involved in the collapse is a bewildered Meg Foster.

title: Piccolo grande amore
actors: Barbara Snellenburg, Raoul Bova, David Warner, Susannah York
description: In the Lichtenhaus, a small state on the brink of bankruptcy, it is decided to marry the rebellious Princess Sofia with the heir to the throne of an equally unlikely neighboring kingdom. But Sofia escapes for a holiday in Sardinia where she meets a handsome surf instructor and falls in love with him. Meanwhile, a courtier, who is plotting to turn the statelet into a casino, has the girl kidnapped.
notes: The film, the result of the Vanzina's disarray in the 90s, combines Baglioni (the title song) with the most dull photo story plot.

title: Padre e figlio
actors: Michele Placido, Stefano Dionisi, Claudia Gerini, Giusi Consoli
description: Back from military service, Gabriele finds a job thanks to his father Corrado, a former worker at Ansaldo in Genoa. Gabriele, however, argues with the foreman and is fired. This fact exacerbates the disagreements between father and son. Gabriele gets a job in an arcade where he meets Valeria, a transsexual. To leave with her, he tries to rob his father's house, which surprises him. The two have a violent fight, but then they seem to make peace. In his second film after "Verso Sud" Pozzessere proves that he rightfully belongs to the ranks of young emerging directors. His is an objective gaze that goes beyond the knots of the script.

title: Troppo sole
actors: Sabina Guzzanti
description: Lalla, a Milanese journalist, has to do a report on the famous rock star Matilde. This is a bit 'the precious and, in the end, does not agree to the agreements and does not allow interviewing. Lalla then decides to rebuild her life by getting in touch with people who know her: her mother, her toxic sister, a nun, her psychiatrist (or rather her psychoshampotherapist), a rival singer, and so on. More than a film, a virtuoso tour de force by Guzzanti who, alone, plays all the roles.

title: ...Crésus...
actors: Fernandel, Rellys, Paul Préboist, René Génin, Marcelle Rancon
description: A poor fellow who has always lived on the fringes of society gets a lot of money and wants the whole country to enjoy it, but he almost ends up in jail.
notes: Good-natured satire of village society with the excellent Fernandel and numerous character actors. At the director's desk is Jean Giono, a famous French writer much loved by Alain Delon, on loan here to the cinema.

title: Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
actors: Fredric March, Miriam Hopkins, Rose Hobbart, Holmes Herbert
description: A doctor experiments on himself a concoction of his own invention which transforms him into the monstrous Mr. Hyde, a concentration of all the perversions hidden in the human soul. At first Jekyll manages to regain his own appearance (and his own morality), then the temptation to return to the diabolical and bloody dimension makes it increasingly difficult for him to regain his civil nature.
notes: From the story of Robert Louis Stevenson, a film of great figurative suggestion (thanks to the photography of Karl Struss), enriched by a bold use of sound and subjective (in the famous transformation scene). Reading in a sexual key makes it a rather audacious film for the times. Oscar pe Fredric March leading actor.

title: Homeward Bound: The Incredibile Journey
actors: Veronica Lauren, Robert Hays, Kim Greist, Jean Smart
description: Shadow, a golden retriever, Chance, an American bulldog puppy, and Sassy, ??a Siamese cat, have been entrusted by their owners' family to the loving care of friends. But the three animals are homesick and flee to return. They must cross the Sierra Nevada, overcome the pitfalls of the terrain and above all make it through the dangerous encounters with bears, porcupines and other natural enemies.
notes: Walt Disney usually gets it right with animal stories, but not in this remake of the old "The Incredible Adventure" (1963), amidst the annoying nonsense put into the mouth of poor talking beasts and the flatness of the tale (apart from a couple of sequences).

title: Apache Uprising
actors: Rory Calhoun, Corinne Calvet, John Russell
description: At the time of the Indian raids, the stagecoach serving Apache Welles must hire two gunslingers, Jim and Bill, as an armed escort. They prevent a robbery and defend the passengers from an Indian attack. A nostalgic western that stages, with the most used instruments of the genre, the eternal clash between the good and the bad.

title: Single White Female
actors: Bridget Fonda, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Steven Weber, Stephen Tobolowsky
description: Allie Jones is a successful woman with a beautiful home in Manhattan, a good job and a marriage close at hand. Then, when she finds out that her boyfriend is still sleeping with his ex-wife, the marriage breaks down and Allie, at that point, decides to look for a girl to share the house with. Hedra Carlson responds to the announcement, shy and meek, but with some dangerous trauma in her past. There is a little bit of Hitchcock and a little bit of Bergman (mostly "Persona") in this Schroeder film. Even if the game of the exchange of identities between the two girls slips towards the easier and more effective solution.

title: Scarecrow
actors: Gene Hackman, Al Pacino, Dorothy Tristan, Ann Wedgeworth
description: A former convict and a tramp walk the streets of the States, and of friendship, in search of their impossible dreams. A bitter portrait of America in the seventies, pathetic and sentimental, with an unforgettable couple of actors and the photography of Vilmos Zsigmond. Palme d'Or in Cannes

title: He Ran All the Way
actors: John Garfield, Shelley Winters, Wallace Ford
description: After committing a robbery, during which his accomplice and a policeman died, Nick Robey takes refuge in the home of Peg Dobbs, a girl he met by chance, who has shown him a lot of sympathy since their first meeting. The man instructs the girl to buy a car for him, so that he can continue his escape. She does it faithfully, but Nick, panicked (he fears the girl will cheat on him), suddenly decides to run away. Peg, disappointed and embittered ...
notes: It is a classic of cinema noir, with Garfield (which alone is worth the film) at the end of his short and lightning career and Shelley Winters at the beginning.

title: Buffalo Bill l'eroe del Far West
actors: Gordon Scott, Roldano Lupi
description: The biography, more than fictional, of the famous hero William F. Cody, called Buffalo Bill, struggling with bandits and Indians. Among other episodes, the attempt is narrated, succeeded despite the thousand difficulties, of pacifying the tribe of Volpe wise with the white settlers. A modest spaghetti-western without the originality of other productions of the same period.

title: Hearthquake
actors: Charlton Heston, Ava Gardner, George Kennedy, Geneviève Bujold, Lorne Greene
description: Stuart Graff is a married engineer but romantically linked to a young actress, Denise. Lou Slade is a policeman under investigation. Their lives meet on the day Los Angeles is devastated by a disastrous earthquake. Together they work to rescue but, when all have been rescued, a dam also gives way and the metropolis is submerged by the waters.
notes: Robson gave his best in his youth, first as an editor for Orson Welles and then as a director of busy films. "Terremoto" is his penultimate film: catastrophic with special visual and sound effects.

title: La bella di Lodi
actors: Stefania Sandrelli, Angel Aranda, Elena Borgo, Gianni Clerici
description: Roberta is the young and rich daughter of Lombard landowners, Franco is a penniless mechanic who works in a garage on the Autostrada del Sole. They meet on the beach of Forte dei Marmi and they fall in love. In spite of the disparity of characters, the two seem to get along well: they leave on Roberta's Alfetta for a journey that, amid disagreements and reconciliations, takes them around the Italy of the economic boom. From the famous novel of the same name by Alberto Arbasino, a film that attempts to combine bitter tones with those of comedy.

title: Cattiva
actors: Giuliana De Sio, Julian Sands, Erland Josephson, Milena Vukotic
description: At the beginning of the twentieth century Emilia Schmidt, a Swiss of Italian origins, led a comfortable life with her husband and little daughter. When the latter dies, Emilia develops a strong guilt complex and begins to show signs of mental imbalance. Admitted to the clinic, she is healed with the psychoanalytic method by a young Carl Gustav Jung who, for this reason, must overcome the mistrust of the head physician and also fight his own feelings when he finds himself in love with the woman.
notes: Based on the famous clinical case of Signorina E., the film offers the best interpretation of De Sio, in a story that is more televised than cinematic. Screenplay by Scarpelli and Francesca Archibugi.

title: Alvaro piuttosto corsaro
actors: Renato Rascel, Tina De Mola, Flora Medini, Peppino De Martino, Corrado Lojacono
description: Alvaro is the last descendant of the lineage of the Alvari, talented privateers. In command of his ship he sets out on a hunt for a treasure, of which he possesses only half of the map. The other half is in the hands of Isabella, his betrothed. On the ship, however, there is Esmeralda, disguised as a boy, looking for revenge. During a mutiny, Alvaro's half-map disappears ... From the magazine of the same name by Garinei and Giovannini, Camillo Mastrocinque directed Renato Rascel in this film version, which was a great success at the time. The music is by maestro Gorni Kramer. With "Blue Bells" and "The Peter Sisters".

title: Tammy Tell Me True
actors: Sandra Dee, John Gavin, Charles Drake, Ross Elliott, Lowell Brown
description: Hamina enrolls in college to live up to her boyfriend. To earn some money he agrees to act as a companion to an elderly and rich lady, who moves to the boat where the girl lives. The woman's niece, who is aiming for the inheritance, has the police look for her. Meanwhile, love arises between Hamina and a teacher. Hamina is arrested for a misunderstanding, but ...
notes: Comedy a little inclined to make morals. Harry Keller is not a genius, but he defends himself. Everyone already knew Sandra Dee for "Scandal in the sun" and "The mirror of life". But Gavin was also at his peak, after "Psycho" where he was Janet Leight's boyfriend.

title: The Real McCoy
actors: Kim Basinger, Val Kilmer, Terence Stamp, Gailard Sartain
description: Karen McCoy, exercising the dangerous profession of bank robber, the inevitable happened: she ended up in prison and spent six years in the Athens penitentiary. Now she has come out of it, free on parole. But her situation is far from rosy: the ex-husband, in fact, who in the meantime has remarried, told their son, Patrick, that his mother is dead. As if all this wasn't enough, a certain Schmidt reappears, who needs Karen for a new shot. To convince her, he finds nothing better than to kidnap Patrick and thus blackmail her. The bank to be robbed is the famous Union Bank of Atlanta: a bank considered to be of maximum security. The fact is, Karen has a plan to violate this dollar sanctum: perfect to get in and downright unique to get out ... On paper, the Kim Basinger / Val Kilmer duo should have worked out great. She is smoothed and refurbished, but all in all she manages to divert attention from the wonders of the facelift, thanks to the effort she puts into it, with ultimately decent results. Less in part Kilmer, also because his role is sacrificed by a script (for him) as ungrateful as (for us) predictable from the first moment to the last. Gangster film with some ambition but with disastrous economic returns: a great disappointment for Russell Mulcahy, accustomed to the successes of Highlander.

title: Paradise
actors: Melanie Griffith, Don Johnson, Elijah Wood, Thora Birch
description: Willard Young (Wood) is ten years old when he is sent by his pregnant mother Rosemary for a vacation in the small town of Paradise. Taking care of the boy will be Lily and Ben Reed (Griffith and Johnson), a couple who have never been able to find harmony after the death of their three-year-old son. In Paradise Willard befriends young Billie (Birch), begins to overcome his childhood fears and eventually even manages to bring the Reeds together. A romantic Disney production inspired by a film by Jean Loup Hubert ("Innocence and Malice" with Anémone and Bohringer). Griffith and Johnson were husband and wife in life at the time.

title: Una storia semplice
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, Ennio Fantastichini, Ricky Tognazzi, Massimo Ghini, Tony Sperandeo, Massimo Dapporto, Gian Marco Tognazzi, Omero Antonutti, Paolo Graziosi, Macha Meril, Gianluca Favilla
description: Giorgio Roccella, an elderly diplomat, telephones the police because he hears strange noises in a wing of his villa, which stands isolated near a Sicilian town. The agents, who arrived at the scene only the next morning, found his body. Beside him only a gun and a note with the inscription: "I found.". The investigation begins and the first hypothesis is that of suicide. Professor Franzò, an old friend of the dead man, is not of this opinion.
notes: From the last novel by Sciascia, published a few days before his death, a slightly lifeless but sober and faithful film, dominated by a Volonté identical to Sciascia.

title: Cape Fear
actors: Robert De Niro, Nick Nolte, Jessica Lange, Juliette Lewis, Robert Mitchum, Gregory Peck
description: Max Cady (De Niro) got fourteen years in prison for rape. Not that Max was innocent, but it is true that Sam Bowden (Nolte), his lawyer, failed to present a document that could have lightened the sentence. Today Bowden lives in North Carolina, with his wife Leigh (Lange) and teenage daughter Danielle (Lewis). All these things Max knows because he decided to make him pay for it. But, at least at the beginning, not in an obvious way. It is enough to be seen around in the places he frequents, to sit in front of him at the cinema, to kill his dog, maybe, to put some doubts in the head of the young Danielle. Nothing for which one can be put in jail. Throughout the first half, you don't know which side to stand on. De Niro is not exactly nice, but Nolte is also not a saint's shin. Then in the second part the film plunges into an unbridled "andante con moto", with De Niro who never dies because he is incurable and ineliminable as a remorse. In between is the key scene, that of "Little Red Riding Hood", the one in which De Niro suggests to Lewis to read Henry Miller and she, in response, begins to suck his thumb. An irresistible film.

title: Under Suspicion
actors: Liam Neeson, Laura San Giacomo, Kenneth Cranham, Maggie O'Neill
description: Tony Aaron was a cop, but got kicked out because of a woman, Hazel. Today he is a private detective, but more than anything else he provides false evidence in divorce cases: that is, he uses Hazel (always her ...) to seduce divorcees, and then goes to photograph the unfortunates in the hotel rooms. But this time in front of his lens there are the corpse of Hazel and that of the painter Simon Stasio ...
notes: This is just the beginning. The plot then lines up more twists than you are willing to assume: which means that suspense is assured, and therefore - being a thriller - that the film has hit the mark.

title: The Cocoanuts
actors: Groucho Marx, Harpo Marx, Chico Marx, Zeppo Marx, Margaret Dumont, Mary Eaton
description: A luxury hotel in Florida is headed by Mr. Hammer. Business is pretty bad: there is not even the money to pay employees. Hammer would like to speculate on some land, but the auction fails. Meanwhile, some clients organize the theft of Mrs. Potter's necklace (to which Groucho hopes to sell the land), placing the blame on Bob, the beau of Polly, Mrs. Potter's daughter. Harpo will be the one to unravel the story. The film is the equally wild cinematic version of the homonymous comedy presented on Broadway: puns, jokes and jokes are grafted onto the inevitable love story.

title: High Anxiety
actors: Mel Brooks, Madeline Kahn, Cloris Leachman, Harvey Korman
description: The "Neurological Institute for Very, Very Nervous Patients" in Los Angeles needs a new director. Dr. Richard H. Thorndyke, psychiatrist, former Nobel Prize winner, is named. He soon realizes that the asylum is placed under the strict protection of the nurse "Brother Diesel" and that the patients (all wealthy) are kept locked up even after being healed. After having managed to recover from his phobias himself, Dr. Thorndyke will restore order to the institute thanks also to the daughter of a large industrialist locked up there, whose hand he will also conquer.
notes: Mel Brooks' comedy plays openly here with the Hitchcockian quote, from "Birds" to "Psycho".

title: The Naked Jungle
actors: Charlton Heston, Eleanor Parker, Abraham Sofaer, William Conrad
description: Randolph Langley (Heston) is a rough, hasty South American landowner who gets a woman sent from New Orleans to get married. The woman is called Joanna (Parker) and the impact with her husband is not the best. But family disagreements take a back seat in the face of the arrival of an army of termites who threaten to destroy the plantation.
notes: The story is quite reminiscent of Dieterle's contemporary "The Elephant Trail". Good technicolor and good special effects, especially those relating to the march of termites. The rest is pretty predictable. Produced by George Pal, fantasy specialist.

title: Appunti per un'Orestiade africana
actors: Attori non professionisti
description: Pasolini around Africa, at the end of the sixties, collecting ideas for a staging of Aeschylus' work according to his poetic principle that made contemporary primitive cultures coincide with the mythology of classical Greece. Produced by Rai, but broadcast too many years late.

title: Deadly Game
actors: Roddy McDowall, Marc Singer, Frederic Lehne
description: Seven people, from different backgrounds and who apparently have nothing to do with each other, are gathered on an island off Seattle by a mysterious Mr. Osiris. They will have to walk around the island in search of some previously hidden pots full of money. Groped to put a spoke in the wheel, however, there are three men and a couple of Dobermans, who hunt them in an attempt to kill them. The story is very similar to that of Agatha Christie's "Ten Little Indians", which obviously inspired this TV movie. However, the operation can be said to be quite successful, thanks to a robust script and an equally good interpretation of the actors.

title: Io, io, io... e gli altri
actors: Walter Chiari, Vittorio De Sica, Gina Lollobrigida, Caterina Boratto, Elio Pandolfi
description: A well-known journalist, who also works as a writer (Chiari), wants to conduct an investigation into human selfishness. He thus identifies a number of emblematic characters who should support his very critical position on the subject. Little by little, however, the writer identifies himself, replacing himself, with his characters, thus discovering that the true meaning of life lies in giving rather than receiving; the research then becomes a confession that brings back memories and remorse. Through a gallery of characters with their miseries and weaknesses the inner path of a writer is outlined from the initial skepticism to a more mature awareness. Scripted by several hands, with parts for Manfredi, Mastroianni, Silvana Mangano, Elisa Cegani, Caterina Boratto, Vittorio Caprioli, Franca Valeri, Sylva Koscina, Paolo Panelli, Salvo Randone and many others.

title: Traces of Red
actors: James Belushi, Lorraine Bracco, Tony Goldwyn, Faye Grant
description: In Palm Beach the corpse of policeman Jack Dobson is found in a pool of blood. What happened Dobson tells us himself, who tells his story in a voiceover. Years earlier he was investigating, with his colleague Steve Frayn, a series of murders of women, found with a letter opener in the chest and "scarred" with lipstick. Since, as Dobson says, Palm Beach's inhabitants have three lives, there are many suspects. There are a jealous wife, a "black widow", a candidate for the Senate ...
notes: An erotic thriller that begins as _ Sunset Avenue_ and ends with a hot thrill: but it's just a thrill.

title: Defending Your Life
actors: Albert Brooks, Meryl Streep, Rip Torn, Lee Grant, Buck Henry
description: A successful young advertiser, Daniel Miller has just bought himself a car and crashes into a bus. He dies instantly and finds himself in the afterlife where he is subjected to a trial to determine if he is worthy to go to Heaven or if he should reincarnate and return to Earth. At the trial the accused are shown clips of his life with the mistakes and cowardice committed. How many times has the cinema tried to tell the life in the afterlife: from Il Paradiso it can wait to Happened in Paradise the precedents are wasted. The tone is that of a light comedy; but despite the impeccable interpreters, the whole mechanism is stale and dated.

title: Adam's Father - Broken Cord
actors: Jimmy Smits, Kim Delaney, Michael Spears
description: From the trials of life a family has come apart, as often happens. He and she have decided to separate. But they are not alone: ??from their love of the past a creature was born, a child marked by a congenital mental retardation, without hope. He is, after all, the real victim of the marital failure between his parents. The father does not give up and finally wins the case to keep the unfortunate child with him. A family drama in which it is the paternal responsibility, once in a while, that emerges and asserts itself. The screenplay focuses everything, as is the rule in these cases, on the most elementary emotions, exasperated by the confrontation with the coldness of the law.

title: Kuffs
actors: Christian Slater, Tony Goldwyn, Milla Jovovich, Bruce Boxleitner, Carry Drake
description: George is in crisis because his girlfriend got pregnant. His policeman brother is killed by Kane, a shady figure, and George "inherits" the district his brother was coordinating. He is joined by Ted, a policeman awaiting suspension for having an affair with the boss's wife. Despite everything, George will clean up the neighborhood and will also know how to make up his mind to marry his girlfriend. The basic structure is that of the action detective, but the references to the comic and the concessions to the comedy constitute its true substance. A divertissement for a young audience of few pretensions and even less cinematic memorability.

title: Count Your Blessings
actors: Deborah Kerr, Maurice Chevalier, Rossano Brazzi, Martin Stephens
description: Just before the war, an English girl marries a French officer. Before the two can reunite, however, nine years pass during which the couple's son, born shortly after his father's departure, has become a very smart boy. The family reunion is not very happy for her husband's escapades, so much so that the wife asks for a divorce. At the idea of ??spending six months in London, with his mother, and six months in Paris, with his father, the boy tries in every way to avoid reconciliation between his parents.
notes: One of the attempts to cast Brazzi as a Latin lover. But if the film is bearable, it's thanks to Chevalier.

title: Psycho II
actors: Anthony Perkins, Vera Miles, Meg Tilly, Robert Loggia, Dennis Franz
description: Norman Bates is released after twenty-two years in a criminal asylum and the murders resume. It is the first sequel to Hitchcock's thriller, with Anthony Perkins and Vera Miles reunited twenty-three years later. If the original never existed, it wouldn't be bad either.

title: Cry Baby
actors: Ricki Lake, Johnny Depp, Traci Lords, Amy Locane, Susan Tyrrell, Ricki Lake
description: In the fifties a beautiful girl is torn between the education received and the attraction for the boys who wear black leather and ride a motorcycle. Not one of the sharpest films of the irreverent John Waters, but tasty nonetheless. Appearances of Willem Dafoe, Patty Hearst, Troy Donahue, Joe Dallessandro.

title: The Cement Garden
actors: Andrew Robertson, Charlotte Gainsbourg, Alice Coulthard, Ned Birkin
description: Jack, Julie, Sue and Tom, four boys who live on the outskirts of an English town, first lose their father and then their mother. To prevent little Tom from being entrusted to public assistance, they keep it a secret and bury his mother in the cellar. Now they can live life however they like (and an incestuous bond is also born between Julie and Jack). At least until someone finds out everything. A grotesque representation of the mechanisms of the bourgeois family, poised between tenderness (few) and "ferocious" candor. Of calculated unpleasantness, but undoubtedly solid and intriguing in the disruptive charge of desecrating anarchism.

title: La estrategia del caracol
actors: Frank Ramírez, Fausto Cabrera, Florina Lemaitre, Humberto Dorado
description: The owner of a public housing estate in Bogota intends to throw out the tenants; they try to avert the danger by legal means, but the law is not on the side of the weak. All that remains is to make a virtue of necessity and organize the clandestine and complete emptying of the building to which everyone, according to their abilities, collaborates, with the external support of some trusted friend. A "political" film under the disguise of a paradoxical story, a bit fragile in some forcing of a sometimes simplistic Manichaeism (with Brechtian ambitions?), Even if perhaps acceptable.

title: Clash by Night
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, Paul Douglas, Robert Ryan, Marilyn Monroe
description: Driven by ambition and a desire to escape, Martha (Stanwyck) has moved away from the small fishing town where she was born. She returns there, tired and disillusioned, after ten years and after much hesitation she ends up marrying Jerry Doyle (Douglas), a meek and honest man, owner of a fisherman. He will betray him with the charming projectionist of the country's cinema. Cloudy melodrama about the desperate search for freedom. Notable is the cast where Marilyn Monroe also appears in a minor role.

title: The Woman in White
actors: Gig Young, Eleanor Parker, Sidney Greenstreet
description: The new guardian hired by a castellana finds himself at the center of a dark and sinister story. From a Wilkie Collins gothic classic, a well-performed film with a suggestive setting.

title: High Barbaree
actors: Van Johnson, June Allyson, Thomas Mitchell
description: A pilot falls into the sea and is transported by memories and the current to an imaginary country. Mystical, sentimental and harmless, it is a film that accumulates a discreet originality of the story with obvious visual gimmicks (the exaggerated use of flashbacks).

title: Psycho III
actors: Anthony Perkins, Diana Scarwid, Jeff Fahey, Robert Maxwell
