description: Norman Bates is back to work at his motel again. He has apparently recovered, but suspicions return to hang over him after the disappearance of an elderly woman. The investigations of an enterprising journalist, the aggression of an aspiring rock star, the (mutual) attraction for a former nun, the arrival of some baseball players in sweet company, will end up making him out of his mind for good. Of the three sequels to Hitchcock's masterpiece, this is certainly the worst. Poor Anthony Perkins pays his debt to a character he was effectively marked by for life and decides to take the risks of directing as well. Mal takes it.

title: La scorta
actors: Claudio Amendola, Enrico Lo Verso, Carlo Cecchi, Ricky Memphis, Leo Gullotta, Tony Sperandeo
description: Judge De Francesco (Cecchi), starting from an investigation on water supplies, enters the sights of the mafia and clashes with his own colleagues. His escort faithfully follows him, and someone will pay with their life. Tognazzi, who was Sergio Leone's assistant director, creates a film that tells dramatically plausible facts according to an "American" narrative. And all the interpreters, for their part, assist him in the best possible way.

title: Kamikaze 1989
actors: Rainer Werner Fassbinder, Günter Kaufmann, Boy Gobert, Franco Nero
description: Police Lieutenant Jansen is entrusted with a very delicate and very secret investigation, so much so that his own collaborators have only a vague idea: he has four days to neutralize those who have threatened a bomb attack against a large information group. When a self-confessed culprit turns up, Jansen is convinced that the truth is different, with implications in the high place. Made in 1982 in the "tour" of Fassbinder (with him as the protagonist), the film is a story of anticipation, which aims at the point of "suspense" and, even more, the denunciation of the rot hidden in the folds of the centers of power.

title: Without Warning
actors: Jack Palance, Martin Landau, Tarah Nutter, Cameron Mitchell
description: Deep space aliens find Earth could be a wonderful game reserve. To humans, of course. The first "game" is held in an isolated mountainous region of the United States. Very disappointing, with the participation of some Hollywood veterans.

title: No Deposit, No Return
actors: David Niven, Darren McGavin, Don Knotts, Barbara Feldon, Charles Martin Smith
description: The two small and lively Tracy and Jay, being temporarily absent their mother, are entrusted for the holidays to their billionaire grandfather. Already at the airport, due to the skunk Brush, the first complications arise, then the matter goes on among failed gangsters, fake kidnappings, alarms, dangerous bandits, safe-prisons, last-minute rescues and sympathetic policemen. Typical Disney product. Within the "target" to which it is addressed, it works.

title: Der Philosoph
actors: Johannes Herrschmann, Adriana Altaras, Friederike Tiefenbacher
description: George Hermes has only one passion: philosophy and, in particular, Heraclitus about which he has just finished writing a book that is about to be published. He lives spartanly without a telephone or television. He has never met a woman. Having to attend the conference to present his book, he goes to buy a dress in a shop run by three girls who fall in love with him, "adopt" him and together make him discover the joys of sex and love. Dressing him in the role of comedy, director Rudolf Thome has built a film in which fidelity and betrayal, love and feelings are faced.

title: Jekyll & Hyde
actors: Michael Caine, Cheryl Ladd, Joss Ackland, Ronald Pickup, Diane Keen, Kim Thompson, Kevin McNally, David Schofield, Lee Montague, Miriam Karlin
description: Dr. Jekyll develops a potion in his laboratory which, when ingested, transforms him into the impressive Mr. Hyde, altering his personality and transforming him into a ruthless criminal. From the famous novel by Robert Louis Stevenson, director Wickes and Michael Caine combine an atmospheric work inspired by their previous work on Jack the Ripper. The result is only flat TV-Movie, despite the efforts.

title: Son in Law
actors: Pauly Shore, Carla Gugino, Lane Smith
description: Disembarked from a small South Dakota town in the light-hearted atmosphere of a California college, Rebecca overcame the initial shock with the help of Crawl. Back home for Thanksgiving, she decides to invite him. His arrival does not arouse particular enthusiasm in the girl's very traditional family, and even less in Travis, Rebecca's boyfriend, from whom she now feels very distant: a free-spirited and outspoken young man who wreaks havoc in an environment. of strict conventions. It's a film for teenagers, but maybe even they don't deserve (and drink) certain trivializations.

title: Jennifer Eight
actors: Andy Garcia, John Malkovich, Uma Thurman, Lance Henriksen, Kathy Baker
description: Sergeant John Berlin finds a girl's hand next to a murdered homeless man in a landfill. The case appears to be linked to a series of murders of blind young people. There is a "witness", Helena. She doesn't see either, but she heard the killer's voice. John falls in love with her and is passionate about investigations. Inexplicably opposed by a colleague, he is even indicted and arrested, while the real killer prepares to take out Helena.
notes: Prestigious actors who are at ease in the parts and a classy photograph for a film that works at times, between sequences of great tension and moments of tiredness, with a sudden and not exactly understandable closure.

title: The Inner Circle
actors: Tom Hulce, Lolita Davidovich, Bob Hoskins, Aleksandr Zbruev
description: Moscow, 1939. Ivan is a young projectionist who works at the KGB club. The very evening of his wedding with Anastasia he is secretly taken away: his new assignment will be to show films of none other than Stalin. Ivan works scrupulously at work and cannot tolerate Anastasia going secretly to visit little Katya, daughter of the arrested Jewish neighbors, in the orphanage. After the German invasion, Ivan and Anastasia must follow Beria, the leader of the KGB, towards the Urals; he then sends the projectionist back to Moscow, restraining the woman. When Anastasia returns to Moscow, she is pregnant; he will kill himself, leaving a message for Katya. Konchalovskij at the beginning of the post-communist era returns to Moscow and, thanks to the Italian producer Bonivento, creates a love story intertwined with events and motifs far greater than its protagonists. In the role of Beria the excellent Hoskins.

title: Pierrot le fou
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Anna Karina, Dirk Sanders
description: Ferdinand and Marianne reunite five years after they broke up and during which she was in a gang of criminals. They isolate themselves from the world, they love each other, but communicating is not easy. Once the money runs out, you have to live: Ferdinand follows Marianne who returns to the gang. One shot, one murder, but love is over: Ferdinand kills Marianne and then commits suicide, in search of perfect love in another world. Ferdinand: "Why are you sad?". Marianne: "Because you talk to me with words and I look at you with feeling". The "amour fou", loneliness, excess. Ferdinand wraps himself in dynamite and lights the fuse: the arrival point of the first Godard, a path that started with "Until the last breath".

title: Tammy and the Doctor
actors: Sandra Dee, Peter Fonda, Macdonald Carey, Beulah Bondi
description: Young Tammy (Dee) is in the hospital to accompany elderly Mrs. Call, who is suffering from a heart attack. There he manages to convince Nurse Coleman not to quit his job, to make a curmudgeon patient more reasonable and human, and also to make handsome Dr. Mark Cheswich (Fonda) fall in love with himself. She is not the first Tammy in history (that was in 1957 with Debbie Reynolds), nor the last (there was also a subsequent television series). However, the only reason this silly comedy is remembered is the debut of Peter Fonda.

title: Born Yesterday
actors: Broderick Crawford, Judy Holliday, William Holden, Howard St. John
description: A journalist is hired by a businessman to "educate" his mistress, a beautiful but ignorant dancer. The two fall in love. Amazing "proto-feminist" comedy that earned the Holliday Oscar. Cukor masterfully directs from a beautiful play by Garson Kanin.

title: Animal Crackers
actors: Groucho Marx, Harpo Marx, Chico Marx, Zeppo Marx, Margaret Dumont, Lillian Roth
description: Mrs Rittenhouse throws a party for Captain Spaulding's return from Africa. During the party a canvas by the painter Beaugard will be presented to the guests, but the daughter of the hostess, with the help of Harpo and Chico, replaces the painting with that of her boyfriend. The result is naturally a sequence of qui pro quo in which the four comedians wallow like frogs in the pond. A thin plot, but in the comedy of the Marxes the narrative cue is only a pretext on which to baste a series of absolutely irresistible verbal or mimic gags, especially in their nonsense. Another reason for the film's interest is the presence of Zeppo, who will then abandon the scenes.

title: Oro
actors: Franco Nero, Vittoria Belvedere, Alexander Abdulov, Carlo Cecchi, Enzo Iacchetti
description: Gabriele da Poppi, a painter from Rome in 1527, sees the Lanzichenecchi arrive in his studio. The result is that the studio is destroyed, his model Gesuina is raped and her brother killed. Andreas, the chief of the mercenaries, settles in the shop to live with Gesuina and with the painter from whom he pretends to be portrayed in a painting.
notes: What are Franco Nero, Enzo Iachetti, plus three or four Russian actors and a cinematographer like Mikhail Agranovich doing in Rome in 1527? Nothing. I'm there for yet another historical-cultural-dramatic co-production. In short, a real bore.

title: Trail of the Pink Panther
actors: Peter Sellers, Capucine, David Niven, Herbert Lom
description: This time we investigate the mysterious disappearance ... of the famous Inspector Clouseau, the rambling policeman protagonist of all the cases related to the Pink Panther.
notes: Tribute to the actor Peter Sellers who died at the very beginning of the shooting of this film, through a series of unused clips of his previous films and connecting sequences shot from scratch with other characters.

title: Il provinciale
actors: Gianni Morandi, Maria Grazia Buccella, Sergio Leonardi, Franco Fabrizi
description: Giovanni lands in Rome with the ambition of becoming a journalist. He touches a hard apprenticeship, during which he binds himself to a prostitute whom he will try to change his life. The boy from Monghidoro was not mistaken for the part of a provincial youth stunned by the impact with the city. But the bitter irony often slips alternately into pathetic or farcical.

title: La cage aux folles
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Michel Serrault, Michel Galabru, Carmen Scarpitta, Luisa Maneri, Claire Maurier, Rémi Laurent, Venantino Venantini, Carlo Reali, Guido Cerniglia, Liana Del Balzo
description: Renato, of Italian origins, and Albin, known as Zazà, manage the "Cage aux folles" in Saint Tropez, a nightclub for transvestites. They have lived together as husband and wife for years. Renato however, in the past, had a brief heterosexual experience from which Laurent was born. The son announces his marriage to the daughter of a well-known politician and asks his father, to keep up appearances, to pretend to be "normal", but the truth nevertheless comes out.
notes: From the comedy of the same name by Jean Poiret, a film that deals with homosexuality without morbidity or scandal. The two performers who are responsible for the great success of the film at the time of its release are amazing.

title: La rebelión de los bucaneros
actors: Stan Cooper, Charles Quiney, Maria Pia Conte, Isarco Ravaioli
description: The Queen of England gives the island of Horn, known as the island of sharks, to a group of former buccaneers, to whom she has forgiven the misdeeds, who want to live in peace by cultivating the land and fishing the pearl oysters of which the island she is rich. On the island, however, a shady French trader had also set his sights, aided by a corrupt English officer, trying in every way to prevent the operation. The so-called swashbuckling genre has experienced a season of success that is certainly not ephemeral: thanks, as in this film, to continuous twists and turns of the head, duels to the death, betrayals and victory of the hero.

title: Colpire al cuore
actors: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Fausto Rossi, Laura Morante, Sonia Gessner, Vanni Corbellini
description: The story of the film centers on the relationship of Emilio, an intelligent and sensitive underage boy, with his father Dario who teaches at the University of Milan. During a visit to their grandmother's country house, the two meet a young couple, Giulia and Sandro, who turns out to be a pupil of Dario. A few nights later, in Milan, Emilio witnesses a scene that will upset his fragile balance. The boy witnesses a shooting between terrorists and carabinieri and thinks he sees in the man he sees on the ground, shot to death, the boy he had met days earlier in the countryside. The title, taken from a RB slogan, also indicates the violence that terrorism carries out in human relations. At the center, as always in Amelio's cinema, there is also a difficult relationship between generations and a silent moral dialogue, never ideological.

title: La caduta degli angeli ribelli
actors: Clio Goldsmith, Vittorio Mezzogiorno, Yves Beneyton, Alida Valli
description: A good lady takes a crush on a runaway terrorist and ends badly. It is the second film by Marco Tullio Giordana and already leaves something to be desired.

title: Die dritte Generation
actors: Eddie Constantine, Hanna Schygulla, Bulle Ogier, Margit Carstensen
description: West Berlin, 1978. Police intensify the fight against terrorism using computers purchased from the firm of Peter Lenz (Constantine). On 27 April 1979, Carnival day, a terrorist group, which includes Lenz's secretary Susanna (Schygulla), kidnaps the industrialist and forces him to declare on video that he is a "prisoner of the people". And he, as he says it, almost laughs. From a news story that shocked German public opinion, Fassbinder made an irreverent, impudent and irrational film.

title: Corsa in discesa
actors: Rüdiger Vogler, Bruno Stori, Debbie Jones, Francesco Ventura, Antonello Franco
description: Little Pamela is saved by a stranger as she risks drowning in a pond. The man is a dangerous criminal, guilty of double murder. Pamela's dad is a police inspector. Things get complicated when the "savior" presents the bill to the child's parent, demanding protection for himself and for the beautiful Jasmine who also cheekily looks sweet at the detective. Based on a short story by Cornell Woolrich, an ambitious detective story, both pathetic and bloody, with a turbid-erotic wink and (shipwrecked) artistic ambitions. In short, poor Rudiger Vogler gets involved in one of the worst examples of young Italian cinema.

title: My Breast
actors: Meredith Baxter-Birney, Jamey Sheridan, Barbara Barrie, James Sutorius
description: Joyce Walder (Meredith Baxter-Birney) is a New York-based journalist whose only thought, work aside, is how to keep her story going with handsome Nick Di Stefano (James Sheridan). Then she discovers she has breast cancer and the world collapses on her. At that point, his mother, a colleague and his best friend will be the people he can rely on to deal with the situation. But above all it will be her inexhaustible will to live to help her in the attempt to fight the disease. The story is true, as it always happens in these TV-movies stubbornly centered on the most varied fatal diseases. There is no reason to be ironic on the story of Joyce Walder who, with her book "The Breast", has shown courage to spare. But there is also no compelling need to make films of this genre.

title: Never Say Die
actors: Frank Zagarino, Billy Drago, Jenny McShane, Todd Jensen
description: Reverend James is the head of a sect called "The Garden of Eden": they are in the sights of the FBI and the operation is entrusted to Lieutenant Blake, who once belonged to the same group. The operation is conducted in no uncertain terms, so much is the fear for the fanatical ideas spread by James. Death and destruction, but the reverend manages to escape. His followers cut the rope with him; in particular there is Brooke, a young and naive daughter of a general, who had entered the sect and now finds herself in the unfriendly part of the hostage. The group initially took refuge in a church; then, forced to move, after a long chase he arrives at a disarmed factory ... A television film that is cheerfully inspired by one of those rather frequent cases in the United States.

title: Al di là dell'odio
actors: Jeff Cameron, Stefania Nelli, George Cavendish, Cameron Steel, Laila Shed
description: Two children are the only survivors of an Indian attack on a farm, following the bullying of the pioneers. The child is taken away and raised by the boss as a daughter. Years later, his brother will lead a punitive expedition against the same Indians. Wounded, he will be recognized and lovingly cared for by her. But the will to destroy will take no account of any affection. In years of revision of the western epic by Hollywood cinema, even our own products try to adapt and have their say on the subject. Aside from the bleak lack of ideas, the script is null and the interpretation non-existent.

title: Dio perdoni la mia pistola
actors: Wayde Preston, Loredana Nusciak, José Torres, Joe De Santis
description: Johnny "Texas" Brennan is a ranger charged with shedding light on the hanging of an old landowner, Prescott, accused of robbery and therefore executed, at least in appearance. Brennan realizes that he is strangely frowned upon by Martin, Prescott's neighbor, and eventually discovers that it was Martin who concocted everything for an old rivalry with Prescott. Tired and predictable spaghetti-western. Subject and script re-chew worn-out stereotypes for the umpteenth time, while the interpreters, hidden behind American pseudonyms that do not deceive anyone, make very little effort to be barely credible.

title: Ad uno ad uno... spietatamente
actors: Peter Lee Lawrence, William Bogart, Dianik Zurakowska, Eduardo Fajardo
description: Bill Grayson is on the trail of his father's killers, a northern colonel who died on the infamous accusation of stealing a large sum but actually killed by the real robbers. One after another he finds them all, with the help of the Mexican Charro, gets their confession, kills them and recovers the loot. Small detail: he is by no means the son of the killed colonel, and he has no intention of returning the money.
notes: An Italian Western, and that's said it all: the film exploits a by now codified vein, it proposes situations and canonical characters without innovations, neither better nor worse than many others.

title: Sabato italiano
actors: Francesca Neri, Stefano Dionisi, Chiara Caselli, Isabelle Pasco
description: Rimini and surroundings. A girl's impromptu striptease for a group of peers is interrupted by mothers forcing the boys to flee. A poker fan overlooks the beautiful Parisian who has come to visit him and she takes revenge by seducing her friend. A young man pursues the girl who left him, with the help of a friend and some drugs. Final match at high speed, with a slaughter challenge to show who has the most "guts", at a dangerous intersection.
notes: Frayed in the story, the film is undecided between adherence to the rhythms of the night and paarsociological denunciation. From a story by Tondelli written with Marco Tullio Giordana.

title: Undercurrent
actors: Katharine Hepburn, Robert Taylor, Robert Mitchum
description: She marries an inventor and slowly, thanks also to her brother-in-law, makes a terrible discovery about her. A noir out of the strings of MInnelli. which does not keep all the suspense promised, while exhibiting excellent interpretations and a beautiful photograph by Karl Freund.

title: Downhill Racer
actors: Robert Redford, Gene Hackman, Camilla Sparv, Joe Jay Jalbert
description: Robert Redford, skier with an iron will, wins a place in the national team. Absent plot, sequences and exciting moments scattered almost at random.

title: The Voice of the Turtle
actors: Eleanor Parker, Ronald Reagan, Eva Arden, Wayne Morris, Kent Smith
description: A famous actress falls in love with a soldier. Not a brilliant transposition from a theater play, where the two leading actors, Eleanor Parker and Ronald Reagan, often go over the top.

title: The Outriders
actors: Claude Jarman jr, Joel McCrea, Arlene Dahl, Barry Sullivan
description: Three Southern soldiers who escaped from a Yankee prison camp reluctantly join a band of outlaws. Robust western film series.

title: Delta Force 2: The Colombian Connection
actors: Chuck Norris, Billy Drago, John P. Ryan, Richard Jaeckel, Begonia Plaza
description: Two Delta Force men - Colonel Scott McCoy and Major Bobby Chavez - are sent on a mission to South America. Objective: to capture the powerful and elusive drug trafficker Ramón Costa. Any attempt to get him sentenced by a court, however, turns out to be futile, which triggers Chavez's anger. In response, Costa has the soldier's wife and son murdered: the latter rushes into the criminal's lair with a handful of soldiers to make himself justice, but fails and is himself killed. It will then be up to McCoy to seek revenge ...
notes: The limelight is all for Norris. Much noise, good action scenes rare. Also known as _Delta Force 2: Operation Stranglehold_.

title: Secondo Ponzio Pilato
actors: Nino Manfredi, Stefania Sandrelli, Lando Buzzanca, Flavio Bucci
description: After Jesus died on Calvary and resurrected, Pontius Pilate is assailed by the doubt that the condemned man was innocent. His wife and the centurion Valerian join the followers of the Messiah. Pilate goes to Rome, heals the emperor Tiberius of leprosy with the shroud of Christ received, in prison, by Barabbas, then asks to be beheaded and dies, as a pagan, with the offering for Charon in his mouth. Luigi Magni, who has never been kind to the Church, does not allow himself any irreverence in this fictional tale. And the commitment to highlight the absurdity of the accusation of deicide directed against the Jewish people is remarkable. An excellent Manfredi.

title: Maciste contro il vampiro
actors: Gordon Scott, Gianna Maria Canale, Jacques Sernas, Leonora Ruffo
description: Kobrak, a monstrous being at the head of a band of terrible marauders, has destroyed the village of Maciste and kidnapped the women, including the giant's girlfriend. Together with Ciro, a boy he saved from a sea monster, Maciste sets out on a hunt for marauders and with the help of Kurtik, leader of the blue men, he confronts Kobrak (who has transformed the inhabitants of the city of Salmanak into hideous automatons. ), and defeats him. The coupons are safe. Gentilomo, an old melodramas specialist, half-shot this film, assisted by Sergio Corbucci. The result is a robust and fun fantasy.

title: The Thing Called Love
actors: River Phoenix, Samanta Mathis, Sandra Bullock, Dermot Mulroney
description: Miranda Presley (Mathis) arrives in Nashville on the bus from New York, but her dream of becoming a country singer soon ends at Bluebird Café. On the other hand, he meets Linda (Bullock) with whom he goes to live and attracts the attention of two men: the romantic Kyle and the unfriendly James (Phoenix). Between the two he chooses James, but it doesn't go well. Abused at home and completely unreleased by us, this tender film by Bogdanovich instead has its own charm. Part of the credit goes to the cast and especially to the "beautiful and damned" Phoenix.

title: The Fugitive
actors: Tommy Lee Jones, Harrison Ford, Joe Pantoliano, Julianne Moore
description: Convicted of the murder of his wife, Richard Kimble (Ford) manages to escape and then go in search of the one-armed man who, according to him, is the real killer. The manhunt that is unleashed is powerful, but Samuel Gerard (Jones), in charge of the case, begins to have more than a sympathy towards Kimble and more than a doubt about his guilt.
notes: For the first thirty minutes try to remember to breathe because the film doesn't give you time. The ending is more routine, but the escape sequence is like an anthology. Tommy Lee Jones (Oscar winner) makes Harrison Ford disappear.

title: Hexed
actors: Arye Gross, Claudia Christian, Adrienne Shelly, Ray Baker
description: Matthew is a quiet hotel employee who compensates for the dullness of his life with a vivid imagination: he believes what he makes up and tries to make others believe. Hexina is a beautiful model with many out of place wheels, determined to get rid of someone who is blackmailing her with old photos. When they meet, Matthew finds nothing better than to pretend to be his ex-lover, but he doesn't know what he's going to face ... Alan Spencer, on his big screen debut, learned from Mel Brooks how to handle the distorting lens of hyperbola and moves at ease in insane comedy, with ferocious thrusts to the America of the right-thinking.

title: Les créatures
actors: Michel Piccoli, Catherine Deneuve, Eva Dahlbeck
description: Edgard, a mystery and science fiction writer, seeks inspiration on a fishing island, with his wife Milène, who lost her voice in a car accident. In his fantasy, people become the "creatures" of the book he is writing; in particular an elderly castellan whom he "sees" as a diabolical scientist and whom he imagines he is killing. The man really dies, Milène gives birth to a child and regains her voice. Agnès Varda constantly keeps the narrative on a level of intriguing ambiguity, thanks also to an anti-traditional style, skilfully controlled by a shrewd and fruitful inventiveness.

title: Vale Abraão
actors: Leonor Silveira, Cecile Sanz De Alba, Luis Miguel Cintra
description: The Douro Valley, Portugal. Here lives Ema, who has married, without love, a doctor. She is slightly lame, but since she was a child she discovered her enormous power of seduction over men. Now, with two daughters, a rich estate, a beautiful house, large wealth, many intellectual friends, he seeks, like Gustave Flaubert's Emma Bovary, a lover, then another, then another. Ema, disillusioned dreamer, lets herself fall into the river. The ultra octogenarian De Oliveira, with irony mixed with understanding, composes the fascinating portrait of a "sinner" and the environment (natural and human) in which she lives.

title: Rape and Marriage - The Rideout Case
actors: Mickey Rourke, Linda Hamilton, Rip Torn, Eugene Roche
description: A married couple in crisis makes headlines when the wife has her husband indicted for assault and rape. This is the first trial of its kind, not contemplated by the jurisprudence which has always considered rape a crime feasible only among strangers. The tenacity of the woman, however, makes the case explode ...

title: The Dollmaker
actors: Jane Fonda, Levon Helm, Geraldine Page, Amanda Plummer
description: An illiterate woman (Fonda) follows her husband from Kentucky to Detroit during World War II. Here she puts her extraordinary skills as a carver to good use. Jane Fonda, on her television debut, won an Emmy.

title: Blue
description: British director Derek Jarman, (Wittgenstein) suffering from AIDS, tells his own drama. As he speaks, the screen is constantly turned blue, a particular type of blue like the one used by the painter Yves Klein, a friend of the director, because, as Jarman said, "The virus is invisible, only its effects are visible". The director's voice, some household noises (the washing machine, the refrigerator) and the music of Simon Fisher Turner are associated with the blue screen. Derek Jarman was one of the most brilliant and innovative directors on the English scene, above all for the virulence of his staging and the extremism of his speech. In Blue he frees the image by dissolving it in order to more freely represent not so much his illness as the universe into which the sick person falls.

title: The Appointment
actors: Omar Sharif, Anouk Aimée, Didi Perego, Fausto Tozzi, Lotte Lenya
description: From the novel of the same name by Leone Antonio Viola, the film is the story of a fatal attraction steeped in tragedy, with a young lawyer who marries a model, ex-girlfriend of a friend of his, while haunted by the doubt that the girl has a double life and secretly go to a rendezvous house. Only too late will the protagonist realize that he has married an honest woman instead. To describe a tangle of passions and feelings, the story lingers too slow at the expense of the tension that should be transmitted to the viewer. Furthermore, the fusion of actors from different backgrounds was not very successful.

title: Freaks
actors: Olga Baclanova, Henry Victor, Harry Earles, Wallace Ford, Leila Hyams, Rosco Ates
description: A circus dwarf falls in love with a trapeze artist. Realizing that the admirer has become the heir to a large fortune, the woman concocts a diabolical plan to kill him. This will, however, trigger revenge on the part of the other "monsters" of the company. Browning, master of horror, instead shoots this film with extreme realism, which only in some points, almost naturally, swerves in visionary surges (the ending). A memorable and cursed masterpiece, shot with real circus freaks and, according to legend, a film-freak itself, mutilated by producer Thalberg in just over an hour.

title: True Romance
actors: Christian Slater, Patricia Arquette, Christopher Walken, Dennis Hopper, Brad Pitt, Gary Oldman, Chris Penn, Tom Sizemore, Samuel L. Jackson, Michael Rapaport, James Gandolfini, Anna Thomson, Val Kilmer, Bronson Pinchot, Saul Rubinek, Conchata Ferrell, Paul Bates, Said Faraj
description: Alabama makes life, Clarence sells comics. Their meeting is not accidental: she is the birthday present from Clarence's brother. The two, instead of saying goodbye the next morning, decide to stay together. Clarence, with the idea of ??going to retrieve the suitcase from Alabama, goes to his former protector, kills him and takes the first suitcase he finds. It so happens that this is full of drugs.
notes: The screenplay is by Quentin Tarantino, reorganized chronologically by Scott. If Tarantino had directed it, it would have been more original, but even so it has a good dose of madness. Memorable the duet between Walken and Hopper, beautiful characterizations by Pitt and Oldman.

title: The Lady from Shanghai
actors: Orson Welles, Rita Hayworth, Everett Sloane, Carl Frank
description: One summer evening, in Central Park, the sailor Michael saves Elsa, wife of a famous lawyer, from an attack. Hired in the yacht, the sailor immediately feels a strange atmosphere. During the journey the two fall in love. To get the money needed to escape together, the man decides to accept the shady deal proposed to him by Grisby, a partner of the lawyer. Confident that a killer cannot be arrested until the body is found, Michael puts it in writing that he accidentally killed Grisby so that Grisby can lose track of himself. But Grisby is later found dead with the sailor's hat in his hands. For Michael it is the beginning of a nightmare. Welles was not particularly fond of this film, whose screenplay he wrote on a 72-hour tour de force locked in a motel. In reality we are faced with a fundamental noir, an unstoppable dream vortex within which spectator and protagonist fall. The love dialogue in the aquarium and the final sequence in the hall of mirrors are memorable. With Rita Hayworth mercilessly scissored by the director for script requirements.

title: Wisdom
actors: Emilio Estevez, Demi Moore, Tom Skerritt
description: John has a conviction on his criminal record for theft. Any job opportunity is therefore closed to him. He is on the verge of completely losing faith in himself when he decides to rob banks in various states of America to get his hands on mortgage contracts. His aim is in fact to show himself as a new metropolitan Robin Hood who prevents the rich landowners from throwing the poorest families into despair.
notes: Directed and starring Emilio Estevez, son of Martin Sheen, the film is yet another fable about the end of the American dream starring a rebel without a cause, not fully convincing.

title: Monkey Business
actors: Groucho Marx, Harpo Marx, Chico Marx, Zeppo Marx
description: Groucho, Harpo, Chico and Zeppo Marx are illegal immigrants aboard an ocean liner in which they manage to remain free until the end of the voyage, with the most diverse tricks and disguises. Thanks to two gangsters, one good and one bad, they manage to illegally enter the US, where Zeppo will also be able to fulfill his dream of engagement with the daughter of the good gangster. It is the first subject of the Marx brothers conceived entirely for cinema. The ingredients of their iconoclastic comedy are already present. Plus the extraordinary Harpo sequence that blends into the masks and puppets of a small theater.

title: Rambling Rose
actors: Laura Dern, Robert Duvall, Diane Ladd, John Heard
description: Buddy (Heard) returns to his father's house and recalls the times of his adolescence, when he felt the first sexual disturbances for Rosa (Dern), the young maid. Rosa, who had been forced into prostitution in her youth, was actually a strange mixture of naivety, need for tenderness and nymphomaniacal impulses. His arrival in the Hillyer house had produced some scandal, and many disturbances in the young Buddy (Haas).
notes: A history of the deep South. A long, nostalgic flashback, set in 1935, between tenderness and irony, Martha Cooldige ("Angie") draws an unusual and captivating female character. Young Buddy is played by Lukas Haas, the kid from "Witness". The very good Duvall, young or old does not change much (apart from the hair). Oscar nominations for Diane Ladd and Laura Dern, mother and daughter in life.

title: David e Golia
actors: Orson Welles, Eleonora Rossi Drago, Massimo Serato, Giulia Rubini, Ivo Paver
description: David is introduced to the court of Saul, in crisis after the defeat suffered by the Philistines. The young man wins the trust of the old king and the love of Micol, his daughter. Meanwhile, Prime Minister Abner tries to overthrow Saul and the Philistines resume the war to destroy Israel: but David manages to defeat the giant Goliath, an unbeatable Philistine warrior, and the threat returns.
notes: A production assembled with a discreet wealth of means and a certain attention not to strain too much. There is no shortage of vintage stars: Gino Cervi gives the voice to the legendary Orson, engaged in the role of the indomitable Saul. Decent but also a bit woody.

title: Piraña 2
actors: Tricia O'Neil, Ted Richert, Steve Marachuck, Ricky Paull Goldin
description: In the bay overlooked by a large hotel, on a Caribbean island, horribly mutilated corpses are found. A scuba diving instructor begins to investigate and discovers that the bodies have been disfigured by a new species of ravenous fish with wings, the result of a secret experiment. They are, in fact, piraña who live in the wreck of a ship and who, at nightfall, go out to kill. Very low-cost debut of the future director of "Titanic", it is an anonymous film that can only be enjoyed by fans of the genre

title: Baby Gang
actors: Marco Testa, Daniele Marchitelli, Claudio Boccalatte
description: Luca is a nine-year-old boy who lives in the Neapolitan hinterland. Faced with his older brother in full withdrawal crisis, he decides to personally get him the dose. With the help of a very young transvestite, he comes into contact with a small gang of drug dealers led by the fourteen-year-old Mastino. The latter takes Luca under his protection and takes him with him to deal in exchange for the dose. By the author of The Occasions of Rosa, the film through a hopeless daily fairy tale offers us a ruthless picture of the juvenile reality of the Neapolitan suburbs, made up of families in disarray, drugs and petty crime.

title: Educating Rita
actors: Julie Walters, Michael Caine, Michael Williams, Maureen Lipman
description: The young Rita, a hairdresser not exactly cultured, wants to get educated. He thus entrusts himself to the care of Professor Frank Bryant (Michael Caine), a cynical man, addicted to alcohol, but also full of charm. The contact between the two will change them, little by little both. Rita becomes cultured without losing her qualities of frankness; Frank will find new symbols at his work and emerge from the alcohol tunnel. New version of Pygmalion with Caine in shape and with Julie Walters on his debut.

title: Gross Anatomy
actors: Matthew Modine, Daphne Zuniga, Christine Lahti, Todd Field
description: Father was a fisherman, but he (Modine) has the qualifications to enter a medical school, even if he doesn't seem to take it too seriously and seems more attracted by the inflexible instructor (Lathi). From the title it seems the umpteenth episode of the School of Medicine and the like. In reality it is a decent coming-of-age film with a Matthew Modine undecided between career and life and with a Christine Lathi, actually, totally wasted in an ungrateful role.

title: Ghost Dad
actors: Bill Cosby, Kimberly Russell, Denise Nicholas, Ian Bannen
description: Elliot Hopper, a widower with three dependent children, takes pains to keep up with his work with the result that in the end, he doesn't have any time to devote to the kids. Then he dies in a car accident and discovers, however, that he has a few days left (albeit in ghost form) to try to fix his business on Earth.
notes: Cosby is one of the highest paid actors on American television. His sitcom The Robinsons has always been very successful. The fact that this movie looks like a sitcom is not his fault. It is Poitier's fault.

title: The Death Kiss
actors: David Manners, Bela Lugosi, Edward Van Sloan, Adrienne Ames
description: An actor is killed on set while shooting a shooting scene. Screenwriter Franklyn Drew begins the investigation, ahead of the police. The killer, however, knows how to hide very well. Based on a novel by Madelon St. Denis, the film is not very convincing and the suspense is lost towards the end. However, the reconstruction of the film studio environment and the initial sequence plan should be remembered. Bela Lugosi, horror movie star of those years, here plays the role of a suspected producer.

title: The Front Page
actors: Walter Matthau, Jack Lemmon, Susan Sarandon, David Wayne, Vincent Gardenia, Allen Garfield, Austin Pendleton, Charles Durning, Lou Frizzell, Herb Edelman, Martin Gabel
description: Chicago Court, 1929. Journalists await execution of anarcho-Marxist Earl Williams, convicted on false murder charges. Reporter Hildy Johnson (Lemmon), who has decided to marry and leave the reporter's life for that of an advertiser, resists her cynical editor (Matthau), who tries to hold him back. But the condemned man escapes and falls into Johnson's own arms. Third version of the comedy by Ben Hecht and Charles MacArthur, after that of Milestone in '31 and the "feminine" version of Hawks. Wilder directs but more than actualizes he provides one of his purest style and rhythm lessons. Perfect cast, dominated by an amazing Matthau.

title: The Egyptian
actors: Edmund Purdom, Victor Mature, Peter Ustinov, Bella Darvi, Gene Tierney
description: Around 1300 a. C., two spouses pick up an abandoned child on the Nile. Called Sinhue, he grows up and is appointed physician to the Pharaoh's court, but disobeys the ruler and must flee among the Hittites. When he discovers that these people are preparing the invasion of Egypt, he returns to inform the army chief, his friend Horembeb. But the Pharaoh rejects the idea of ??waging war, and Sinhue is persuaded to poison him. Extracted from a bestseller by Mika Waltari, written by Phlip Dunne and Casey Robinson, it is an ambitious film that willingly ends in mannerisms and in the grotesque epic-historical . However, everything is redeemed by a parallel humorous-adventurous vein.

title: The Power of One
actors: Stephen Dorff, Armin Mueller-Stahl, John Gielgud, Morgan Freeman, Brendan Deary
description: South Africa, 1930s. P.K. he is an orphaned English son who is raised by the Zulu nanny until he is sent to an Afrikaner boarding school. There, persecuted by his fellow Boers, he learns what racism is. Entrusted to a professor who, as a German, is incarcerated at the beginning of the World War, continues to attend him in captivity, learns boxing and knows about racism against blacks. Another young man learning to suffer and fight in Avildsen's filmography, after the first Rocky and a couple of Karate Kids. A somewhat emphatic but interesting drama, with the contribution of solid elderly actors.

title: Milano trema: la polizia vuole giustizia
actors: Luc Merenda, Richard Conte, Silvano Tranquilli, Carlo Alighiero
description: Commissioner Caneparo (Luc Merenda) made it big. He killed two fugitives just as he was about to capture them. For this he is suspended from service, but he does not complain because in this way he can have a free hand in an attempt to avenge the death of a colleague. Caneparo manages to infiltrate a terrorist organization.
notes: At the time, two strands worked in Italian cinema: the sexy one and the detective one with an attached false denunciation of the company. In 1973 Sergio Martino directed two films: this and "Giovannona Coscialunga". It is difficult to say which of the two is the best.

title: Giovannona Coscialunga disonorata con onore
actors: Edwige Fenech, Pippo Franco, Vittorio Caprioli, Gigi Ballista
description: The industrialist La Noce, owner of a dairy near Catania, is distressed by the anti-pollution regulations, but he knows that to get away with it, it is enough to curry favor with the Honorable Pedicò. The problem is that Pedicò normally asks for the graces of the applicant's wife in exchange for a favor; and La Noce's wife is an unbearable bigot. The only solution is to replace her with a prostitute ...
notes: Of course, the prostitute in question is Fenech, the delight of the recruit on release and the lonely teenager. The film is a historical relic of a cinema of yesteryear, coeval with that other "classic" which is _That great piece of Ubalda ..._

title: A Man, a Woman and a Bank
actors: Donald Sutherland, Brooke Adams, Paul Mazursky, Tony Lee
description: United Security of Vancouver prides itself on being the safest bank in the world. A certain Reese (Sutherland) responds to the challenge and tries the shot with the help of friend Norman (Mazursky), an electronic genius, but Stacey (Adams) who is on site taking photos for the next United Security commercial, he photographed Reese himself entering the club. There is a certain amount of suspense in the preparation of the heist and in the finale, but basically it is a comedy. Thanks to this hilarious and almost jaunty tone, Noel Black can afford the luxury of sending his cheerful robbers unpunished.

title: Ricochet
actors: Denzel Washington, John Lithgow, Ice T, Kevin Pollak, Lindsay Wagner
description: At a carnival, black cop Nick Syles captures Earl Talbot Blake in spectacular action followed by thousands of citizens on live television. Thus, from a mere cop on patrol, Nick climbs one after the other the steps of a good career to become Attorney General. Meanwhile, Blake is pondering revenge: he manages to escape and make believe he is dead, and then ...
notes: The Australian Mulcahy directs a film that certainly does not stand out for its originality, with one hundred percent good and one bad fighting with mixed fortunes until a predictable outcome. Discreet, however, the protagonists: the effective Washington and the Luciferian Lithgow.

title: Napoli violenta
actors: Maurizio Merli, John Saxon, Barry Sullivan, Elio Zamuto
description: Destined for Naples in a period in which the Neapolitan city is under the total domination of a ruthless Camorra leader called "O 'Generale", Commissioner Betti immediately takes action with methods that are not exactly orthodox. But the investigation turns out to be more difficult than expected.
notes: Successful policeman of the time, violent and vulgar but professionally directed by Lenzi, especially in the action sequences.

title: Mia moglie è una bestia
actors: Massimo Boldi, Eva Grimaldi, Valeria D'Obici, Mattia Sbragia, Gianni Bonagura
description: Gianni, a Milanese advertising on the verge of a nervous breakdown and in a crisis of ideas, went on vacation to the mountains. It is carnival. Some hotels have organized parties in cave clothes. The next day Gianni finds a real cave at the bottom of a crevasse, which has been hibernating there for millennia, but he believes it to be one of the masks from the night before. He revives her, and here the adventure begins ... The story is little more than a joke; improper to speak of script. Around Boldi and Grimaldi the cast is inconsistent and this is another mistake. Only a few moments are saved with Boldi.

title: Field of Dreams
actors: Kevin Costner, Burt Lancaster, Ray Liotta, Gaby Hoffmann, Timothy Busfield
description: Dad used to play baseball, he, Ray Kinsella, has a farm in Iowa. One day he hears a voice telling him to build a baseball field to bring a champion from the past back to life. Ray mortgages the farm and builds a diamond. Everyone thinks he is crazy, but the magic succeeds. Since that day many other champions flock to Kinsella's home field and, lastly, Ray is also able to play with his father. Dream man Costner has a real passion for baseball (see also "Bull Durham"). The film is one of the best dedicated to this sport, and despite the inevitable rhetoric and "do-good", it is effective and at times exciting in its sincere utopian charge. Behind Kevin to note Liotta, future protagonist of "Those good guys" by Scorsese.

title: The In-Laws
actors: Alan Arkin, Peter Falk, Richard Libertini, Nancy Dussault
description: Daring adventures of a CIA agent (Peter Falk) and his future partner-in-law, a meek and clumsy dentist (Arkin), on the eve of the wedding of their respective children. Nice rhythm for a comedy of few pretensions played by two old foxes.

title: Random Harvest
actors: Ronald Colman, Greer Garson, Philip Dorn, Susan Peters
description: A war wound and the past is erased from the mind of an English officer. A woman will lovingly treat him. From a James Hilton novel, a good sentimental drama, rich and grandiloquent in pure MGM style.

title: Manhattan Baby
actors: Christopher Connelly, Martha Taylor, Giovanni Frezza
description: On vacation in Egypt with her parents, a little girl is approached in a mosque by a witch, who gives her a mysterious amulet. Back in Manhattan, the little girl discovers that she is at the mercy of the amulet's power, and begins to kill unwittingly. Someone will try to neutralize his spells.
notes: Trivial horror suspended between reality and demonism. A minor Fulci, with some apt scenes.

title: Attack of the 50 Ft. Woman
actors: Daryl Hannah, Daniel Baldwin, William Windom, Cristi Conaway
description: Nancy Archer is a woman who does not joke about her height. One day it is exposed to the rays emitted by a spaceship coming from space. The effect is at least disconcerting: it begins to grow out of control. At first she likes it, so much so that she allows herself a revenge against her fallen husband. But it plummets to the point where she becomes a kind of charming Godzilla.
notes: Fans of the 1950s B movie will remember a classic of the genre, directed at the time by Nathan Juran. This remake in its small way is up to it, also thanks to some good interpretations. The only flaw, the excessive length compared to the original.

title: Daens
actors: Jan Decleir, Gérard Desarthe, Antje de Boeck, Wim Meuwissen
description: We are at the end of the nineteenth century. Father Adolf Daens is a Catholic priest who returns to his country, in Flanders. He was immediately struck by the extremely precarious conditions of the workers in the local textile industry. He then decided to immediately put into practice the precepts of Leo XIII's recent encyclical "Rerum novarum", the foundation of a new social doctrine of the Church more attentive to the conditions of the subordinate classes. In his activity in favor of the workers, however, Daens clashes with the more traditionalist clergy, supported by the industrialists.
notes: The limits of the film are soon said: calligraphy, schematism in the narration, prolixity. Limits which, however, are redeemed by the civilization of the subject and by the fact that the story never falls into the trap of easy pathetism.

title: Patriot Games
actors: Harrison Ford, Anne Archer, Sean Bean, James Fox, James Earl Jones
description: Jack Ryan (Ford), a former CIA employee, is on vacation in London with his wife and daughter. Here he manages to thwart an IRA attack against Lord Holmes by chance, allowing the arrest of one of the terrorists, Sean Miller, and killing his brother. Miller manages to escape and from this Ryan will have to brush up on his skills as an agent to defend himself and his family.
notes: Second chapter of the adventures of Agent Jack Ryan, created from the pen of Tom Clancy, this time played by Harrison Ford in place of Alec Baldwin (Hunt for Red October). The action gains us, but the parable of the hero in a forced struggle for love, in the long run, is already seen and repetitive.

title: The Baby of Mâcon
actors: Julia Ormond, Nills Dorando, Ralph Fiennes, Tony Vogel, Philip Stone, Jonathan Lacey, Don Henderson, Celia Gregory, Jeff Nuttall, Jessica Hynes, Kathryn Hunter, Gabrielle Reidy, Frank Egerton, Phelim McDermott, Tatiana Strauss, Louisa Milwood-Haigh
description: In 1659 a masque stages the story of a child to whom divine prerogatives are attributed. Born in Mâcon, a city struck by famine and sterility for his sins, he has a sister who makes him believe she is his mother, a virgin. Unmasked, she herself kills the baby and is condemned to be raped by the soldiers, until she dies. The child's body is dismembered and his relics sold at a high price.

title: Cari fottutissimi amici
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Antonella Ponziani, Beatrice Macola, Eva Grimaldi, Paolo Hendel
description: In August 1944, in the Tuscany just liberated by the allies, a group of starving people performed in grotesque boxing matches in the villages. When the miserable "stable" has to accept the challenge with some American soldiers, things get worse. For better or worse (more harm than good) these bailout boxers continue their little odyssey in a land of rivalry and hunger.
notes: Monicelli is not always at his best, but some claws are still effective.

title: Last Action Hero
actors: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Austin O'Brien, Charles Dance, F. Murray Abraham
description: Thanks to a magic ticket, little Benedict can enter the world of the film of his favorite hero, Slater (Schwarzenegger). When Benedict and Slater are in trouble, the ticket is used for the reverse journey: from fiction to reality. But here things are not going so well for the man who, in the cinema, was a real superman, and Slater decides to go back to the dimension of the illusory.
notes: The Americans didn't like it because it was "too complicated"! Instead, it is witty, very lively, self-deprecating, full of quotes for the pleasure of cinephiles. If anything, it's not a brand new idea, but even Schwarzy tries hard not to be trivial.

title: Rookie of the Year
actors: Thomas Ian Nicholas, Gary Busey, Albert Hall, Amy Morton, Daniel Stern
description: Twelve-year-old Henry is not very good at baseball despite being the orphan of a champion. When he tries to impress a girl, he breaks his arm. Recovered, he discovers that he has acquired incredible strength and becomes a baseball celebrity. But success comes with a heavy price, too many things don't work around him. So Henry decides to go back to his normal school life. God, the homeland, the mother and baseball are the pillars on which a stretched fairy tale rests, in which real champions (by the way almost unknown to us) participated in the realization. The director makes his debut one of the "bad guys" of "Mamma, I missed the plane".

title: Sliver
actors: Sharon Stone, William Baldwin, Tom Berenger, Polly Walker, Martin Landau, Colleen Camp
description: Zake has had a complex system of cameras installed through which he spies on everything that happens in his skyscraper (called Sliver). Since Carly, a young single who works in a publishing house, also lives there, several murders have taken place inside Sliver. Zake and Carly get together (very fiercely). One day he shows her his television "studio" ... To repeat the success of "Basic Instinct", of which he was a screenwriter, Joe Eszterhas wrote another script based on Sharon Stone engaging in frequent erotic exploits. Apart from the photographic virtuosity, the film has only the merits of eroticism.

title: Il cammino della speranza
actors: Raf Vallone, Elena Varzi, Saro Urzì, Saro Arcidiacono, Franco Navarra
description: Left without work, a group of poor Sicilians set out north in the attempt to reach France. But the man who promised them, for a fee, to organize their clandestine expatriation, is in reality a scammer who abandons them to their fate at the foot of the Alps. The Sicilians, however, do not give up and continue the journey that becomes like this a dramatic odyssey.
notes: Silver Bear in Berlin, an epic neorealist melodrama, more beautiful in the bitter Sicilian opening than in the consoling conclusion. Passionate and inspired direction by Germi.

title: Hotel Paradiso
actors: Alec Guinness, Gina Lollobrigida, Robert Morley, Peggy Mount
description: In 1910 in Paris, misunderstandings, betrayals and exchanges of couples in the rooms of the Hotel Paradiso. The playwright Georges Feydeau (Glenville), observing the affairs of his neighbors, takes inspiration for his pochades. Smooth production for a flat directed film, inspired by Feydeau's evergreen "The Free Trade Hotel".

title: La vingt-cinquième heure
actors: Anthony Quinn, Virna Lisi, Michael Redgrave, Serge Reggiani
description: We are in the forties and a Romanian peasant, overwhelmed by the storm of war, ends up in a concentration camp. In the following months, due to a series of fortuitous circumstances, he was transferred to many other fields, in half of Europe.
notes: Interesting cast, but the scene is all of the showman Quinn. Directed by Verneuil rather listless.

title: Pretty Maids All in a Row
actors: Rock Hudson, Angie Dickinson, Telly Savalas, John David Carson
description: Some college students are found murdered. The suspicions center on an athletic Don Juan, psychology professor Michael "Tiger" McDrew.
notes: Yellow comedy, with a surprise ending, conceived with a touch of originality. For sure, Vadim's best movie.

title: Blue Blood
actors: Oliver Reed, Derek Jacobi, Fiona Lewis
description: In an English castle, the new German housekeeper discovers the butler's perfidious maneuvers. Ramshackle, and the idea of ??illegally proposing it as a sequel to Ken russell's "Devils" belongs to Italian distributors, given the presence of Oliver Reed.

title: I cinque dell'Adamello
actors: Nadia Gray, Fausto Tozzi, Teddy Reno
description: A mountaineering expedition must recover the bodies of five fallen from the Great War, who died on the snow of the Adamello after a mission.
notes: Very modest rhetoric and even more inconsistent achievement.

title: Outland
actors: Sean Connery, Peter Boyle, Francis Sternhagen
description: Three killers descend on the third moon of the planet Jupiter to kill Sheriff Sean Connery. By playing cunning, however, the latter prevails over his attackers.

title: The Wagons Roll at Night
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Sylvia Sidney, Eddie Albert
description: A circus director keeps his beloved little sister out of the way, but she falls in love with a trainer. Remake of Curtiz's "Bronze Man", it is the first leading role for Humphrey Bogart.

title: Frontier Rangers
actors: Keith Larsen, Buddy Ebsen, Don Brunett
description: Major Rogers, escaping an Indian ambush, identifies a traitor white and has him executed. Then he goes to the camp of the Black Wolf chief and challenges him to a duel. Jacques Tourneur directs a dignified collage of two television episodes. Tourneur did a lot better.

title: Cannonball
actors: David Carradine, Bill McKinney, Veronica Hamel
description: Drivers with fur on their stomachs face each other in a forbidden car race: six thousand kilometers from California to New York. Little history and chain incidents, with a slowing pace.

title: Halloween 5
actors: Donald Pleasence, Danielle Harris, Donald L. Shanks
description: Michael attempts to kill his young niece. Routine episode, for fans only.

title: La notte dei serpenti
actors: Luke Askew, Luigi Pistilli, Magda Konopka, Chelo Alonso
description: The mayor, the hotelier, a prostitute, the sexton and even the lieutenant of the local police: everyone in the Mexican village plots against the orphan Manuel to whom his father bequeathed ten thousand dollars. Luke is hired to eliminate the intended victim (without knowing that he is predestined to hang, so as not to arouse suspicion). Instead, things are completely different. The attempt to revive a worn-out pattern with complicated gimmicks proves insufficient to save the film. Not at all enjoyable example of spaghetti-western.

title: Un affaire de femmes
actors: Isabelle Huppert, François Cluzet, Marie Trintignant
description: Marie Latour would like a less difficult life for herself and her two children than she is forced into in German-occupied France and with her husband imprisoned in Germany. So he begins to practice abortions and rents rooms to prostitutes. Denounced by her husband, on her return, she will be guillotined. A harsh indictment, without pietism.

title: Maciste nella terra dei Ciclopi
actors: Gordon Mitchell, Chelo Alonso, Vira Silenti, Aldo Bufi Landi
description: Capys, queen of Sadok, is Circe's heir and wants to sacrifice the son of King Agisandro, last descendant of Ulysses, to the last of the Cyclops. Sadok's knights destroy the village of Coos where the child and his parents live and kill Agrisandro, but the child is saved and entrusted to Maciste. He is then captured, but manages to free himself and save the child and the mother. If one does not formalize oneself too much in front of the naivety of the story and the schematism of the characters, the film is discreetly enjoyable for its certain spectacular suggestion.

title: The Wind
actors: Lillian Gish, Lars Harson
description: After the death of her parents, a girl joins her remaining relatives in Virginia. Soon he will have to clash not only with the hostility of the new family, but also with the wickedness of the inhabitants and the adversity of nature. American masterpiece of the Swedish master Viktor Sjöström, with a visionary hand that is shocking even today and a figurative ability that knows how to make the wind present better than in a sound film.

title: Mystery of the Wax Museum
actors: Lionel Atwill, Fay Wray, Glenda Farrell, Frank McHugh, Allen Vincent
description: Having been severely burned in his hands, a sculptor is forced to build his masks by pouring wax directly onto the corpses. A horror classic, directed by a particularly "European" and gothic Curtiz, of which there is also a remake with Vincent Price (1953).

title: Indecent Proposal
actors: Robert Redford, Demi Moore, Woody Harrelson, Oliver Platt
description: Diana (Demi Moore) and David Murphy are two newlyweds very much in love and very indebted. Mature, handsome and cynical billionaire John Gage (Robert Redford) knows their sweet spot and offers the couple a million dollars in exchange for just one night with Diana. Some hesitation, then the capitulation. Later, however, she resents her husband and asks for a divorce. David understands the mistake ... All of Lyne's pimping ability, after the hits of "Nine and a Half Weeks" and "Fatal Attraction", this time is at the service of a story not only "itchy", but dripping with sentimentality. Hypocrisy and banality of the characters, at times, reach the sublime.

title: Alibi perfetto
actors: Michael Woods, Kay Sandvik, Annie Girardot, Philippe Leroy
description: Two narcotics agents, Tony and Lisa, are on top of a drug kingpin. Tony's wife dies in an assassination attempt in which he himself is injured. The connection is all too easy and the agent, cured, follows the most obvious lead. But another truth makes its way, at the end of a mystery where a mysterious house, a mature noblewoman locked up in an asylum and her son disappeared for years into thin air intertwine. The only glimmer of light in this confused and boring film is the unexpected presence of the talented and charming Annie Girardot in the part of the vapid aristocrat. Directed and co-written by Aldo Lado, with music by Romano Mussolini.

title: Per un dollaro di gloria
actors: Broderick Crawford, Elisa Montes, Mario Valdemarin, Umberto Ceriani
description: At the source of Mexico, during the brief reign of Maximilian of Habsburg supported by French troops, clashes with the American confederate states took place. The Indian tribes who claim the territories of the Rio Bravo take advantage of the situation to carry out continuous raids. Attacked, some French dragons take refuge in the fort of a mad Southern colonel. The starting point is tantalizing but immediately folds back on the more usual lines. Former great Broderick Crawford is a little sad.

title: La caza del oro
actors: Anthony Steffen, Daniel Martin, Tania Alvarado, Manuel Guitian, Fernando Sancho, Raf Baldassarre, Luis Induni, Gustavo Re
description: Former hauler Jonathan Carver, who has been in jail for twenty years for making a large amount of gold from the Mining Company disappear, is released. His cellmate, Paco, and the lone gunslinger Trash, help him escape the hunt for four tough guys and Travers of the Company. Carver dies however before recovering the gold, Paco and Trash will have to fend for themselves.
notes: Late Italian-Spanish western that puts together ingredients and narrative places of the "spaghetti" vein. Plot, script and direction by Juan Bosch. In the cast many veterans of the genre, led by our local Anthony Steffen (Antonio De Teffé).

title: Horse Feathers
actors: Groucho Marx, Harpo Marx, Chico Marx, Zeppo Marx, Thelma Todd
description: Groucho gets elected president of Huxley's college, whose football team hasn't won the championship in a long time. In reality, his aim is to take back his son (Zeppo), who has neglected his studies to run after an attractive widow. To improve the team's fortunes, he hires a dog catcher (Harpo) and a barman (Chico) by mistake. University life can only be shaken. Dewmential and refined, messy and theoretical: this is the humor of the Marx, who here offers some brilliant visual gags (Harop making sandwiches with the fingers of others), verbal, and hilarious musical numbers (Groucho plays a backward conductor who opposes every innovation: "I'm against it").

title: Blue
actors: Terence Stamp, Joanna Pettet, Karl Malden, Anthony Costello, Joe De Santis
description: Azul, a young Mexican of American origin is part of a gang of outlaws. When he repents, he helps his former victims, but will die at the hands of a bandit, after killing the leader of the group, of which he had been the favorite.

title: Dirty Money
actors: Frederick Deane, Timothy Patrick Cavanaugh, Biff Yeager
description: Sam Reed is, unfortunately, in the wrong place at the wrong time. On a day like many others, three robbers block his way, steal his car and wallet and slip a key into his pocket, without his knowledge. The episode upsets his existence. From this moment on, Sam's life will in fact be a continuous race in pursuit of criminals, with the police on his heels who believe him a ruthless killer. A classic theme, but always compelling (the pursuit of an innocent, persecuted by both criminals and the police, forced to solve the case with their own means) for a discreet thriller.

title: North to Alaska
actors: John Wayne, Stewart Granger, Capucine, Fabian, Ernie Kovacs
description: In Nome, Alaska, in 1900, Sam McCord (Wayne) and brothers George and Billy Pratt (Granger and Fabian) accidentally discovered a gold vein. Sam returns to Seattle to look for George's girlfriend, but George, tired of waiting, has in the meantime married. In order not to return empty-handed, he then accompanies Michelle (Capucine), a very gracious "entraîneuse" to Alaska as a "substitute" who, however, is in love with him. To all this there is also a complication: a dishonest businessman (Kovacs) manages to have the mine confiscated.
notes: Hathaway turns towards comedy but does not change the vitality and the choral organization of the whole. A brilliant comedy, full of humorous ideas, with an easy rhythm and with the interpretation of actors in the mood. The final fist fight is famous.

title: La poliziotta fa carriera
actors: Edwige Fenech, Mario Carotenuto, Alvaro Vitali, Giuseppe Pambieri
description: Gianna Amicucci, the young daughter of a porter, works in the home of a commissioner. Thanks to the recommendation of the senior official, she manages to fulfill her lifelong dream: enlisting in the women's police. Initially the apprenticeship is not the happiest, but, following three brilliant actions against the underworld, it ends up earning the unconditional approval of colleagues and authorities.
notes: Turpiloquy, double meanings, parnacchie and Edwige's thigh: all the "best" of the award-winning company Fenech-Vitali-Carotenuto directed by the diligent Tarantini.

title: The Riddle of the Sands
actors: Michael York, Simon MacCorkindale, Jenny Agutter
description: Sailing on the Baltic Sea in 1901, a young Englishman finds the maneuvers of a German ship and the attitude of its captain suspicious. He decides to investigate with a friend who has worked for the foreign ministry for years and who could provide him with useful information. And the latter, shocking, arrive quickly. It is at this point that an incredible and very dangerous plan is discovered: a project that even foresees the invasion of Great Britain comes to the surface. The film, which was shot by director Tony Maylam, is a not exactly energetic and effective adaptation of a novel by writer Erskine Childers, with some interesting passages, but few emotions in the development of the story.

title: Grayeagle
actors: Ben Johnson, Iron Eyes Cody, Lana Wood, Paul Fix, Alex Cord
description: John Colter (Ben Johnson) lives with young Beth (Lana Wood), whom he raised as his daughter. But the girl's real father is actually a famous Cheyenne chief, who is now dying and who would like a daughter next to him. So the warrior Gray Eagle is tasked with kidnapping Beth and bringing her to her dying father. Of course, the two will be chased by Colter, his trusty Indian servant and another friendly hunter. After several adventures, the girl arrives at the Cheyenne camp and finds herself in contact with a completely different reality from the one in which she has lived up to that moment. The story is just an adventurous cartoon "on the side of the Indians". All that remains is to enjoy the film for what it is, among the suggestive natural sceneries of Montana. Colter is Ben Johnson, a veteran supporting actor in great westerns (The Wild Bunch).

title: Il comune senso del pudore
actors: Claudia Cardinale, Alberto Sordi, Florinda Bolkan, Rossana Di Lorenzo, Cochi Ponzoni, Silvia Dionisio
description: A worker, to celebrate his silver wedding anniversary, takes his wife to the cinema after four years, but he finds only unseemly films. The woman is scandalized, but in some way suffers the contagion. An intellectual is called to direct a pornographic magazine: he suddenly jumps from misery to well-being. Handcuffs quickly snap on his wrists. The wife of a magistrate on the front line against obscenity is drawn to what her husband condemns. A German actress, multiple Oscar winner, refuses to interpret the most gory sequence of a film about Lady Chatterley in which a Neapolitan producer has invested a lot of money not hers. A group of cinema experts will convince you. Deaf, "champion" of (his) morals, discovers that sex is also a big business on which many profit and thrive. In something - from the screenplay by Sonego and his - he gets it right. But, for much of the film, it runs in circles with little bite.

title: Death in Small Doses
actors: Richard Thomas, Tess Harper
description: A young woman dies suddenly: the police discovers that the cause of the death is arsenic poisoning. At first to be suspected by the investigators is the husband, whose behavior is actually not without elements that can hypothesize a guilt of her. Subsequently, the objective of the investigation moves to her brother, who, moreover, entertained a sentimental bond in the smell of incest with the dead. At this point the investigations to discover the real culprit are increasingly complicated. The story seems to be inspired by a story that really happened in Dallas. Sondra Locke, a wife of Clint Eastwood, diligently directs without reaching the good results of his previous double identity.

title: Red Tomahawk
actors: Howard Keel, John Caufield, Broderick Crawford, Scott Brady
description: A small town is about to be attacked by the Sioux. But the Indians will have to face the fierce resistance of the population. Naive and stereotyped Western, twenty years late.

title: Getting Out
actors: Rebecca De Mornay, Ellen Burstyn, Robert Knepper
description: Arlene just finished serving a long jail term for participating in a robbery that ended in murder. As soon as she is outside she finds herself having to face the ghosts of her past: a mother more than austere, the thought that she will no longer be able to see her son, born in prison and immediately placed in foster care. Even the ghost of what she had been as a young man, a prostitute named Arlie. The story is taken from a successful play, and somehow it feels. In addition to the careful direction, however, the excellent interpretations of DeMornay in the double role Arlene / Arlie, and of Burstyn in the role of the rude mother are worthy of note.

title: Champagne in Paradiso
actors: Al Bano, Romina Power, Francesca Romana Coluzzi, Gegia, Edmund Purdom, Renzo Montagnani
description: Two sprightly old men tell their three grandchildren the story of their love. The two met many years earlier at school, he a teacher, she a reckless student who targeted him with goliardic jokes. For these jokes he loses his job and she is thrown out, only to find themselves face to face as each other's private teacher.
notes: History is already a delusion. And then you see Al Bano as a teacher? Among the television passages of the film to report that of March '99, immediately after the announcement of the legal separation of the Carrisis. Shining example of "cynical TV".

title: Final Analysis
actors: Richard Gere, Kim Basinger, Uma Thurman, Eric Roberts
description: Isaac Barr (Richard Gere) is a well-known (and fascinating) psychiatrist from San Francisco who has as a patient in analysis a young woman (Uma Thurman) afflicted by a strange floral dream. To learn about some episodes of her life, he decides to get in touch with his sister Heather (Kim Basinger), wife of a gangster of Greek origin, violent and morally ambiguous. Passion arises between the doctor and Heather, an irresistible and beautiful woman. But a minimal amount of alcohol is enough for a woman to become psychically unstable. Thus, during a pathological intoxication with relative memory loss, she kills her husband. Found not guilty thanks to the defense coordinated by Barr, she is admitted to a nursing home. In the meantime, however, the psychiatrist realizes that he is at the center of a diabolical machination. Basinger and Gere are somewhat stuck in the conventionality of their public role as sex symbol. Thurman is much more convincing, in the (unfortunately marginal) part of a neurotic girl at the same time disturbing and disturbing. Director Phil Joanou has openly stated that he has taken Hitchcock as a point of reference. In fact, the seduction implemented by the protagonist and some scenes suggest the "Woman who lived twice" and the dreamlike references to "I will save you". The help of uncle Alfred and grandfather Freud does not, however, protect us from lack of inspiration.

title: La cage aux folles 3
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Michel Serrault, Antonella Interlenghi, Saverio Vallone
description: Renato (Tognazzi) and Albin (Serrault), the two cohabitants of Vizietto 1 and 2, have some financial difficulties with their club "La cage aux folles". But here is Albin receiving a rich inheritance from a deceased uncle in Scotland. Or rather, he will come into possession of the enormous sum if he marries and has an heir. Not easy, given the ... premises. Assorted vicissitudes, then everything works out. "A good game does not last long". Our wise ancestors knew this and they even made us a proverb. "Who wants too much, etc., etc.". In short, the third episode of the Vizietto is a poor thing that does not stand up, does not make you laugh and only bores.

title: Bellifreschi
actors: Lino Banfi, Christian De Sica, Lionel Stander
description: Tom (Banfi) and Jerry (De Sica), chased by the US police for shooting a star, find nothing better than to blend in with women's clothes. Two girls, Barbara and Conchita, stay with them for some time, but Tom is also haunted by the "affection" of a rich and weird old man. The two cronies go through trouble, lose sight of each other and meet again only ten years later.

title: Impiegati
actors: Claudio Botosso, Consuelo Ferrara, Elena Sofia Ricci, Luca Barbareschi, Nik Novecento
description: Luigi, in his first job, is hired in a bank in Bologna. The environment is made up of officials who are mostly his peers, with some more experience. Both human relationships and workplace intrigues quickly turn out to be a web that entangles him more and more. In the end, even the dead will escape us (a suicide?), But apparently everything will go on as before. Avati moves between comedy and drama, subtly sketching a series of portraits of cheap yuppies. Absent the more usual tones of memory and fairy tales, the result is a contemporary picture as fierce as it is nuanced.

title: Nottataccia
actors: Stefania Sandrelli, Massimo Wertmüller, Stefano Amatucci
description: Gomma loves Susanna, but without declaring herself. One night, Gino, a gay man, chased by his threatening protector Pierone, bursts into the woman's house. That same night Gomma telephones and, thinking he is talking to Susanna, declares his love. Instead, on the phone it is Gino who, when Gomma enters, locks himself in the room. After assorted misunderstandings, everything clears up for the best and Gino is saved from Pierone. Comedian who would like to be nice but is just foolish, and also wastes Sandrelli.

title: It Started in Naples
actors: Clark Gable, Sophia Loren, Vittorio De Sica, Marietto, Paolo Carlini
description: The American lawyer Hamilton arrives in Naples to settle some legal issues after the death, in an accident, of his brother and the woman he lived with. Thus he discovers that he has a nephew, Nando, who in the meantime has settled with his aunt Lucia. For a true "Yankee" getting used to the rhythms and lifestyle of beautiful Naples will not be easy, but then ...
notes: A sufficiently enjoyable comedy, with that marpione Gable in his penultimate film, who puts in a great job, and Loren who puts all his "arguments" into it. The result is a tourist comedy with postcard landscapes and clichés about Neapolitanism. Unforgettable is the national Sofia singing _Tu vuo ’fa 'l'americano_ and _Carina._

title: Splash
actors: Tom Hanks, Daryl Hannah, John Candy, Eugene Levy, Dody Goodman, Shecky Greene, Richard B. Shull, Bobby Di Cicco, Howard Morris, Patrick Cronin, Charles Walker
description: A young girl emerges from the water under the Statue of Liberty and, as she is dressed only in her skin, ends up at the nearest police station. Allen meets her and takes her home, unable to remember that she, siren, had saved his life long ago. An ichthyologist gets in the way, convinced that he has made a sensational discovery, and things get complicated. Happiness will be underwater.
notes: Ron Howard, former Happy Days star, gets along well in the comedy genre. And if he finds a discreet script, an actor like Tom Hanks (before Philadelphia and Forrest Gump, but already convincing) and a beauty like Daryl Hannah, he can't do any harm.

title: Smokey and the Bandit
actors: Burt Reynolds, Jackie Gleason, Sally Field, Mike Henry, Paul Williams
description: Bill, a nice smuggler, known everywhere for his exploits that have earned him the nickname of "Bandit", manages to escape a sheriff who has been hunting him for some time. Incidentally, Bill is challenged by wealthy Enos father and son to transport 400 cases of beer from Texas to his native Georgia in just 28 hours. The man is enticed by the reward and the fact that he can continue to challenge the sheriff who persecutes him. Meanwhile, Bill gives a ride to Carrie, a girl who has abandoned her betrothed on the altar.
notes: Lightning fast action, with Burt Reynolds. The film had a couple of sequels, given the big and unexpected hit of the tape.

title: The Two Mrs Carrolls
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, Humphrey Bogart, Alexis Smith
description: A man of the American bourgeoisie, shortly after falling in love with another woman, becomes a widower and proceeds to a new marriage, giving a new mother to the daughter of his first marriage. The couple is in love and especially she is, proud of having won a fascinating man who, among other things, has established himself in the cultural and journalistic circles. However, through some fortuitous events, she discovers that behind the impeccable life of her husband, always kind and caring, there is a horrible secret, accompanied by a project about her. Having seen himself discovered, he does everything to discredit his wife's credibility, making her believe she is sick with nerves and keeping friends and acquaintances away from her. Even the unaware and innocent daughter is hurriedly sent to the boarding school, so that he can be alone in the big house with his terrified and anguished wife.
notes: The tension is all in the finale, but the film is basically a confused gothic: a missed opportunity for two big stars, with a curious Bogart in counter-role.

title: Men of Boys' Town
actors: Spencer Tracy, Mickey Rooney, Lee J. Cobb
description: At his school for juvenile delinquents, Father Flanagan (Tracy) brings a urchin back to the right path. A honeyed sequel to the City of Boys (1938) which, with the same direction and the same main performers, had won three Oscars.

title: The Horizontal Lieutenant
actors: Jim Hutton, Paula Prentiss, Miyoshi Umeki, Jim Backus
