description: A lieutenant stationed in Hawaii, in love with an equal degree, is in charge of discovering a Japanese spy. Half a military farce bound on an exotic, absolutely obvious background.

title: The Passionate Plumber
actors: Buster Keaton, Jimmy Durante, Irene Purcell
description: To tease the beloved who does not dare to declare himself, the beautiful hires a fake lover. With Buster Keaton and the excellent shoulder Jimmy Durante, but the script is weak.

title: Stargate
actors: Kurt Russell, James Spader, Jaye Davidson, Alexis Cruz, Mili Avital
description: The great ring found near the pyramid of Giza is actually the gateway to a distant planet. A hard-hearted colonel (Kurt Russell) leads the Earth expedition into the incredible world beyond the threshold. Great staging, good special effects, but intrigue and so-so rhythm for a film that amalgamates classic adventurous and sci-fi schemes. The evil alien monster dresses in the ambiguous guise of Jaye Davidson.

title: De eso no se habla
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Luisina Brando, Alejandra Podesta
description: Charlotte is intelligent and cultured, but she is a dwarf; his mother has managed to make sure that this is not talked about in the city. The wealthy and mysterious Ludovico D'Andrea becomes her friend, then falls in love with her and marries her. Years later, when a circus arrives in the city, Charlotte's mother forbids Ludovico (who is now mayor) to take his wife there, but when the circus leaves Charlotte is at the head of the caravan.

title: Maniaci sentimentali
actors: Ricky Tognazzi, Barbara De Rossi, Alessandro Benvenuti, Monica Scattini, Giuppy Izzo
description: The two twins of Luca and Mara make their first communion and the family reunites in the large country house, just outside Rome. And here comes the problems, the quarrels, the obsessions, between consolidated couples (the hosts), shaky couples (Giusy and Maurizio) and couples who are struggling to form (Claudia and Rodolfo). With many greetings to the party atmosphere that the occasion required. The directorial debut of Simona Izzo, actress, voice actress and screenwriter (as well as Ricky Tognazzi's partner), with a film of alleged "malice" about the bourgeois family, but in which the corrosive charge is completely diluted, more apparent than real.

title: Posate le pistole reverendo
actors: Mark Damon, Richard Melvill, Veronika Korosec, Pietro Ceccarelli
description: In a farcical West, the Neapolitan Geremia, a street vendor of pizzas, and the vagabond Slim team up to steal the treasure he is hiding from Mr. Goldwater. Jeremiah disguises himself as a priest, works false miracles and tries to convince Goldwater to confess where he keeps the treasure, but the maneuver fails. And when it finally succeeds, gold will not be prey to the two cronies. Dull "made in Italy" parody of the western genre, with an inconsistent subject and a very mediocre script.

title: Bad Boy Bubby
actors: Nick Hope, Claire Benito, Ralph Cotterill, Carmel Johnson
description: For thirty-five years Bubby has lived in a small windowless room, alone, with his mother and a cat. Life at home goes smoothly: Bubby and mom take a bath together, go to bed together and not just to sleep. Then one day dad arrives and for Bubby there is no other solution than to repeat the treatment reserved for the cat: wrap the parents in the domopack and make them die of asphyxiation. This is only the first part of the film and it is the best. In the second, the claustrophobic atmosphere of the room is replaced by Bobby's wandering room around the city, with the addition of a banally ecological ending. In any case, a striking film.

title: Stay Tuned
actors: John Ritter, Pam Dawber, Jeffrey Jones, David Tom, Heather McComb
description: Spike is on a mission for the devil. His job is to retrieve souls via cable TV. His victim is Roy Knable, a health care representative and video addict, who ends up in a television schedule with his wife Helen. In the midst of soap operas, westerns and wrestling matches, the Knables must fight for their life (and soul). To satire on television Peter Hyams chooses two actors made famous by TV such as Johnny Ritter and Pam Dawber (she was in Mork and Mindy). The idea is not evil and at times we laugh, but the result is not irresistible.

title: The Public Eye
actors: Joe Pesci, Barbara Hershey, Stanley Tucci, Jerry Adler
description: We are in the forties and being a crime photographer is not really an artist's job. Leon Bernstein (Pisces), aka the great Bernzini, however, insists on doing his job with passion and also with a moral code. When the charming widow Levitz (Hershey) asks him for a hand he can't say no and so ends up getting into trouble with the men of the mafia boss Farinelli. The film manages to give a good reconstruction of the period thanks to great photography, good sets and a great cast. The story, modeled on that of the photographer Weegee, is not very original, but Joe Pesci is still amazing.

title: Aleksandr Nevskij
actors: Nikolaj Cerkasov, Nikolaj Okhlopkov, Aleksandr Abrikossov
description: Prince Alexander Nevsky is charged with countering the advance of the Teuton knights who threaten Russian soil. Very elegant historical essay and valuable story: the sequence of the battle on the ice is very famous, with the music of Prokofiev.

title: La moglie è uguale per tutti
actors: Nino Taranto, Nadia Gray, Renato Vicario, Paolo Panelli, Lea Padovani, Mario Riva, Tina Pica
description: The lawyer De Papis, a specialist in the causes of marriage separation and a convinced advocate of individual freedom, has a nephew who thinks differently. To induce him to give up on this, the lawyer invites his nephew to spend an entire day in his office. During his stay, the young man meets a beautiful lady who is asking for divorce driven by the jealousy of her second husband who cannot bear the idea that the ghost of the first appears to her in a dream.
notes: Nice comedy with all the comic stars of the time and with a Nino Taranto, as usual, very good and funny.

title: Le finte bionde
actors: Cinzia Bonfantini, Alessandra Casella, Massimo Wertmüller, Sergio Vastano, Guido Nicheli, Cinzia Leone
description: In the perennial search for social promotion, some couples of the Roman middle class are preparing to move from their popular neighborhood to a more chic one. Their only occupation and obsession is to "be there": at cocktails, at parties, in Cortina as well as on the Costa Smeralda. The girls form groups and go to the same hairdresser (where they get oxygenated) and where they spend their time gossiping. The film would like to be a satire of a certain Roman environment where appearance triumphs over substance. In reality, the complaint is immediately lost in the aping of behaviors that soon become specks.

title: La carne
actors: Sergio Castellitto, Francesca Dellera, Philippe Léotard
description: Paolo is a municipal employee and in the evening he plays in a piano bar. One evening, in the club, he meets the beautiful and provocative Francesca: it is love at first sight. The two take refuge in Paolo's little house on the Roman coast where, having filled the fridge with food, the two spend their days passing from one embrace to another. When Francesca announces her departure, Paolo kills her, dissects her and keeps her in the refrigerator to eat.
notes: Excessive and overflowing like Dellera's body, Ferreri's film is located in the meeting point between food and sex, obsessions often present in his cinema. Less intense and convincing than other films by the director.

title: La donna scimmia
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Annie Girardot, Achille Majeroni, Elvira Paoloni
description: Antonio Focaccia discovers a woman entirely covered in hair in a monastery and marries her to be able to exhibit her as a phenomenon. On the occasion of a Parisian tour, however, the two really fall in love; when Maria, the "phenomenon", becomes pregnant, Antonio complies with her desire to have the baby.
notes: Ferreri's "scandalous" film, a ferocious apologue on the monstrosity of the family institution. The censorship made him come out without ending: after Maria's death, Antonio gets the embalmed bodies of his wife and son to continue to exhibit them.

title: Nightkill
actors: Robert Mitchum, Jaclyn Smith, Mike Connors, James Franciscus
description: Katy (Smith) is the unhappy and neglected wife of Wandell Atwell, a rude industrialist and alcoholic; Steve is Atwell's partner and decides to put him down so he can marry Katy, even though she opposes the murder. Upon the arrival of Donner (Mitchum), an ambiguous police lieutenant, Katy tries to make her husband's body disappear, but in its place she finds Steve's body with a hole in his head. The classic infernal triangle becomes a square. The film lacks some focus, mostly due to a lazy script, but it has suspense and there's a Mitchum at the end that alone is worth the watch.

title: Smorgasbord
actors: Jerry Lewis, Milton Berle, Sammy Davis jr., Herb Edelman
description: Warren Nefron is lying on a psychoanalyst's couch. His relations with the world, since he was a child, have been conflicting and prone to disaster. The last hope lies in hypnotism: it will be enough to pronounce the phrase "Qua la mano Picchiatello" in critical moments and everything will be solved. Unlike the psychiatrist who thus seems to inherit from him the tendency to accidents and clumsiness. In this return to directing after twelve years, Jerry Lewis plays a dozen roles, aided by loyal screenwriter Bill Richmond (also four roles in the film). The result is not equal to the previous masterpieces, but we can be satisfied.

title: The Funhouse
actors: Cooper Huckabee, Miles Chapin, Largo Woodruff, Elizabeth Berridge, Shawn Carson, Jeanne Austin, Jack McDermott, William Finley
description: Amy, Buzz, Richie and Liz are friends who decide to spend an evening at an amusement park. After wandering among the various stands they are attracted by the horror tunnel where, recklessly, they decide to spend the night. They thus become involuntary witnesses to a murder, that of the fortune teller by the truculent son of the huckster. Thus begins a nightmare night in the amusement park for the boys, which will end in death for three of them.
notes: It's a classic horror movie with all the ingredients of the genre. The director plays on the theme of the freak, poised between pity and horror. Rick Baker's make-up is gorgeous as always.

title: Antes llega la muerte
actors: Paul Piaget, Robert Hundar, Fernando Sancho, Gloria Milland, Jesus Puente, Francisco Sanz, Raf Baldassarre, Antonio Gandía, Luis Induni
description: To defend the honor of his girlfriend, Bob Carey kills Ringo's brother and ends up in jail. When he goes out he discovers that the girl, who in the meantime has married a rich landowner, is ill. A real expedition is organized to transport her to a Mexican hospital. The desert is not very hospitable and the Indians are lurking, but there is also Carey who watches the caravan from afar. That one goes from Texas to look for a hospital in Mexico is rather strange, but the writers of this incunabulum of the European western were not so much for the subtle.

title: Pochi dollari per Django
actors: Anthony Steffen, Gloria Osuna, Frank Wolff, José L. Lluch
description: Django is a bounty hunter on the trail of Trevor Norton, the robber who robbed Abilene's bank. Upon his arrival at Rockstar he is mistaken for the new sheriff and he does nothing to prove otherwise. A Rockstar also falls in love with Sally. She is, among other things, the daughter of the man he should kill, but who cares? In the finale Trevor redeems himself and justice triumphs. Spaghetti-western series C. Believe it or not, the director is called Klimowsky.

title: Despair - Eine Reise ins Licht
actors: Dirk Bogarde, Andréa Ferréol, Klaus Löwitsch, Volker Spengler
description: Hermann Hermann, a chocolate industrialist in Germany in the 1930s, suffers from anguish and split personality. The economic and political crisis of the period seems to be reflected in his soul. At the height of his depression he searches for a double, offers him money and his documents and then kills him, thus fleeing to Switzerland. But the police soon discover the clumsy trick and arrest him. From the Pirandellian cue of Nabokov's novel, Fassbinder draws a dense and meaningful film on the theme of the double. Baroque in the staging full of mirrors that multiply the images, it has its strong point in the splendid acting of Bogarde.

title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 4: The Dream Master
actors: Robert Englund, Rodney Eastman, Danny Hassel
description: Having survived the massacre of teenagers operated by Krueger, the young Kristen suffers from terrible nightmares in which the maniac appears to her, terrifying her. The girl in the nightmares asks for help from her friends, who are also physically affected, to the point that two of them die. Kristen and her friend Alice then try the "Dream Master", a dream technique to defeat the monster with willpower. In the fourth episode of the successful series, the writers and director's imagination is unleashed. Much played on dream situations and on a non-trivial discourse on Evil, the film makes use of excellent special effects.

title: The Guardian
actors: Jenny Seagrove, Dwier Brown, Carey Lowell, Brad Hall
description: Phil and Kate hire a babysitter for their little one. The woman, Camilla, reveals extraordinary gifts of skill and sweetness. In reality it belongs to a druidic sect dedicated to the sacrifices of children to a large tree in which the spirit of Evil dwells. In fact, the woman has already committed numerous atrocious crimes, always managing to make her traces disappear by changing her name. Disturbing film and strongly anchored to the darkest fairytale kingdom.

title: You're Never Too Young
actors: Dean Martin, Jerry Lewis, Diana Lynn, Nina Foch, Raymond Burr
description: A thug chases the barber's boy in a hotel who accidentally came into possession of a large diamond he had stolen. The boy, who pretends to be 12, will eventually succeed in bringing to justice the real culprit of the theft. Comic raid on the verge of madness with a wild Jerry Lewis.

title: The Castaway Cowboy
actors: James Garner, Vera Miles, Robert Culp, Eric Shea
description: A Texan cowboy (the tough James Garner) is found in the Hawaiian Islands due to a shipwreck. Here, we are in 1850, he is saved and then welcomed into the house by a young and charming widow (Vera Miles) with whom he falls in love. Given the abundance of wild cattle, he helps her create a ranch and herd, teaching her and the islanders the art of herding. It also fights against a ruthless local speculator. An uplifting and courageous story, immersed in nature and good feelings. Classic movie for the whole family.

title: Scent of a Woman
actors: Al Pacino, Chris O'Donnell, Gabrielle Anwar, James Rebhorn
description: Charlie Simms, of modest social background, attends an exclusive boarding school. However, he risks not getting the Harward scholarship. The friend, on the other hand, is not at risk: his father is one of the financiers of the college. Charlie, meanwhile, agrees to accompany Frank Slade, a blind, drunkard and grumpy colonel for the weekend; he takes the boy to New York and with his help decides to have fun. Remake of the film by Dino Risi, based on the novel by Giovanni Arpino "The dark and the honey". Bo Goldman's script isn't extraordinary. Pacino, however, did all he could, even earning an Oscar.

title: Play Nice
actors: Ed O'Ross, Michael Zand
description: A policeman is on the trail of a serial killer "specializing" in hitting divorced men suspected of sexual harassment of their children. In an attempt to find the red thread that connects all the crimes together, the policeman ends up running into a woman who looks like she knows a lot about the crimes. Yet another variation on the theme of the serial killer, this time combined with the theme of violence against minors. Fun Fact: The Treas film and Basic Instinct are from the same year and start very similarly.

title: Hardly Working
actors: Jerry Lewis, Stephen Baccus, Susan Oliver, Roger C. Carmel
description: Since being fired, Bo Hooper has lived in his sister's house. He is no longer a young man and the work he did (the clown) does not help him much in his search for a new job. The first attempt at a service station is unsuccessful, even if on this occasion he meets Millie who, out of sheer clumsiness, smashes the car. Bo always tries out new jobs, and the results are always disastrous as long as he's hired at the post office of Millie's father. After a silence lasting about ten years Jerry Lewis returns to the screens all over the world. Which is not exactly correct because the film is from 1979, but it comes out only two years later and with some difficulty (the American version is a few minutes short compared to the European one). It's not the most explosive Lewis one can imagine, but it still works, albeit with some downtime and some indecision. The most serious mistake, however, is to use short pieces of his previous films: one cannot help but make comparisons.

title: Helen of Troy
actors: Rossana Podestà, Jacques Sernas, Stanley Baker, Brigitte Bardot
description: Paris, on his way to Sparta to negotiate trade agreements, is shipwrecked and luckily lands on the coast where he is saved by a slave. He falls in love immediately, not knowing that the girl is actually Queen Elena. Paris, by hook and by crook, takes Helen to Troy, just as the Greeks, who were waiting for nothing, are preparing to besiege the city. More than historical, the genre of this film is "exoticism and fantasy". An insipid parade of clichés and inconsistencies.

title: Le procès
actors: Anthony Perkins, Jeanne Moreau, Romy Schneider, Orson Welles, Elsa Martinelli, Suzanne Flon, Akim Tamiroff, Madeleine Robinson, Arnoldo Foà, Fernand Ledoux, Michael Lonsdale, Max Buchsbaum
description: Joseph, an unnamed bank employee, learns that a trial is underway on him. At first he thinks of a joke, then he realizes that they are being serious. And without anyone ever revealing the charges to him. Welles, with the help of a hallucinatory photograph and an impeccable crowd of actors, composes one of his best films. Based on Kafka's novel, which Welles betrays and rereads (especially in the finale).

title: Grease 2
actors: Maxwell Caulfielt, Sid Caesar, Michelle Pfeiffer
description: At Rydell High School there is a war between the T-Birds and the Balmudo gang. Much uglier than the first Grease.

title: Urban Cowboy
actors: John Travolta, Debra Winger, Scott Glenn, Madolyn Smith
description: Bud is a country boy who has found a job in Houston. In a famous club, "Gilley's", he makes a name for himself as a rodeo champion on a mechanical bull. He marries Sissy, but things change due to a rivalry between the two, to which the mechanical bull is no stranger. At first it ends in divorce, but, after other misadventures in which their respective new partners are also involved, everything falls into place. Travolta recovered some credit on the square, after the Minuto per Minute fiasco; alongside him stands Debra Winger in her first major role. A good insight into the South American province and its "honky tonky" people.

title: The Hill
actors: Sean Connery, Harry Andrews, Ian Bannen
description: Convicted of beating an officer and cowardice in the face of the enemy, Joe Roberts enters a British Army discipline camp during the last war. Since the commander is a weak inept, the camp is run by Sergeant Major Wilson and Sergeant Williams, a true tormentor. The treatment is inhumane and in particular the torture of the "sand hill" claims several victims.
notes: It is one of the hardest films in the denunciation of militarism. The direction of Lumet is very strong, the acting of the actors is tense. There is no music: it is the "real" noises that give the dramatic charge.

title: A Star Is Born
actors: Janet Gaynor, Fredric March, Adolphe Menjou
description: After marrying star Norman Maine, aspiring actress Esther Blodgett manages to break through with the name of Vicki Lester: but fate has bad surprises in store ...
notes: Wellman conducts with admirable sobriety. Not a masterpiece like Cukor's first remake (1954): anyway, Oscar for the original subject and for the color photography.

title: The Awakening
actors: Charlton Heston, Susannah York, Stephanie Zimbalist
description: Matthew Corbeck, archaeologist, and his assistant Jane unearth the sarcophagus of an Egyptian queen on the same day that Matthew's daughter Margaret was born. Years later, Margaret, who has grown up with her mother since Matthew has remarried to Jane, goes to him who is struggling with the restoration of the sarcophagus. She is now a beautiful girl and after her arrival strange things start to happen ... Important cast for the remake of a 1971 film, Cleo, the goddess of love, by Seth Hot: both taken from The Jewel of Seven Stars , novel by Bram Stoker. Mike Newell is that of Dancing with a Stranger; diligent the script.

title: Tora! Tora! Tora!
directors: Richard Fleischer, Kinji Fukasaku, Toshio Masuda
actors: Martin Balsam, Sô Yamamura, Tatsuya Mihashi, Joseph Cotten
description: 1941. The Second World War has been going on for about two years and Japan, sided with Germany and Italy, is conducting its war campaign in China. However, there are those who argue that the time has come to directly attack American interests in the Pacific. Thus we arrive at the bombing of Pearl Harbor, on December 7, 1941, which also drags the United States into war. Two and a half hours for a reconstruction of the treacherous attack, which tries to be meticulous and to respect a sort of "level playing field", showing what was happening in both sides. The result is a film built with a great deal of means, but still too long and potentially engaging only when we finally move from words to actual action. Rich cast and Academy Award winner for best special effects

title: Between Heaven and Hell
actors: Robert Wagner, Buddy Ebsen, Broderick Crawford
description: After Pearl Harbor, a wealthy southern cotton maker goes to fight with other young Americans of many different races. A bit thriller, a bit warlike, with vague moral intentions.

title: Road to Denver
actors: John Payne, Lee J. Cobb, Skip Homeier
description: An honest cowboy gets into trouble trying to help his bad brother. One of the many Republic productions to consume and forget.

title: I Am a Fugitive from a Chain Gang
actors: Paul Muni, Glenda Farrell, Helen Vinson, Noel Francis
description: Although innocent, he is sentenced to forced labor, but manages to escape. Outside, however, he is forced to live in crime. A masterpiece built with almost documentary rawness. Unforgettable the interpretation of Paul Muni.

title: The Sisters
actors: Bette Davis, Errol Flynn, Anita Louise
description: In San Francisco, in 1904, at a party in honor of President Roosevelt, sisters Louise (Bette Davis) and Helen Elliot, the two daughters of a pharmacist, meet their future husbands. In particular, Louise loses her head to the irresponsible journalist Frank Medlin (Errol Flynn) and marries him, however, forcing him into an unhappy marriage that ends after a short time, when Frank agrees to leave for Singapore. Louise is too proud to thwart Frank's plans and does not reveal to him that she is pregnant. The shocking earthquake of 1906 forces Louise to seek refuge at a third-rate inn where, after losing her child, she is consoled by the owner Hunter, who has fallen in love with her in the meantime.
notes: Based on a novel by Myron Brinig.

title: Harry and Walter Go to New York
actors: James Caan, Elliott Gould, Michael Caine, Diane Keaton
description: In the late nineteenth century, Harry (James Caan) and Walter (Elliot Gould) earn their living with small variety shows when Harry is caught red-handed while he was intent on robbing viewers of one of their shows. Taken to prison, the two meet Adam Worth (Michael Caine), a cultured, wealthy and charming robber. Adam is planning to land a massive robbery of a major New York bank and involves them in the plan to be implemented once they are free with the complicity of feminist journalist Lisse Chestnut (Diane Keaton).

title: Born Yesterday
actors: Melanie Griffith, John Goodman, Don Johnson, Edward Herrmann
description: Billie is as beautiful as she is ignorant and Harry, who has taken her to Washington, fears that it will harm him in the realization of the sinister plots in which he is engaged. That's why he hires Paul: to do his best to hunt Billie. The result will be that the two will fall in love and the young woman will mess up her former lover's dirty business. Remake of the homonymous film directed by George Cukor in 1950 with Judy Holliday, it works when it follows it on time, but not when it takes its own. And the actors can't stand comparison.

title: I sovversivi
actors: Giulio Brogi, Lucio Dalla, Ferruccio De Ceresa
description: Against the background of Togliatti's funeral there are four stories of communist militancy: a director leaves the cinema to go around the world in search of more direct contacts with reality and with men; a Venezuelan exile returns to his country to take the place of a comrade killed by the government; a PCI official goes into crisis with his wife; a philosopher turns to photography and turns out to be nonconformist and individualistic.
notes: A look, between documentary and fiction, on the phenomenology of militancy in the traumatic era of the death of the "Best". In the role of a recent graduate there is also Lucio Dalla.

title: The Winter Kills
actors: Jeff Bridges, John Huston, Anthony Perkins, Sterling Hayden, Elizabeth Taylor, Eli Wallach
description: Nick Kegan (Jeff Bridges), the scion of a powerful American family, does his best to wipe out the shadow of the murder of his older brother, a former president of the United States, from his memories. While working at an oil plant, Nick makes the acquaintance of a distinguished gentleman, seriously ill, who confesses to him that he is his brother's second killer. Reopening a wound that has never been mended, Nick is driven by curiosity to dig into what for everyone is a closed case, arriving at a new and unexpected truth.
notes: Based on a novel by Richard Condon.

title: Stacka
actors: Aleksandr Antonov, Mikhail Gomorov, Grigorij Alexandrov
description: In a factory in Tsarist Russia, the suicide of an unjustly punished worker provokes the strike of his comrades, already in turmoil due to the harsh working conditions and the low wages. The bosses do not negotiate, the strikers pledge or sell their meager possessions, the police try in every way to break the workers' front. In the end there is a massacre of men, women, children. It is the first direction of S. M. Ejzenstejn: innovative, epic, of great figurative impact. The real protagonist is the mass, the experimental work on editing is at the beginning but already heralds the following masterpieces.

title: That's My Boy
actors: Dean Martin, Jerry Lewis, Eddie Mayehoff, Ruth Hussey
description: Jack Jackson was a college-level champion and is placing hopes in his son, his namesake, that the boy will become one himself. But Jack jr. he is skinny, shortsighted, sickly and his father entrusts him to the care of Bill, a friend of the young man, who promises well. The beginnings were disastrous to say the least, so much so that Jack would also like to drop out of university, but then comes the great redemption. Here Lewis is still paired with Martin and is only on the threshold of the great season in which he will be able to impose his demented comedy. The film does not have great pretensions, but it is still hilarious.

title: Night of the Living Dead
actors: Tony Wood, Patricia Tallman, Tom Towles, McKee Anderson
description: While visiting their father's grave, John and Barbara are attacked by a being hungry for human flesh. John is unable to escape, while Barbara takes refuge on a nearby farm. From that moment on for her and for the other six people who are on the farm, a long siege begins by an ever-growing group of zombies.
notes: Beware: this is not George Romero's original and now mythical "Night of the Living Dead", but a remake of him. Filmed by Tom Savini with more money and with the collaboration on the script by Romero himself, however, it does not arrive at the results of the original.

title: King of the Hill
actors: Jesse Bradford, Jeroen Krabbe, Lisa Eichhorn, Karen Allen, Adrien Brody
description: We are in Saint Louis in 1933 while America is still in full depression and dad Kurlander (Krabbé) is impatiently waiting for a secure job that will never come. But young Aaron (Bradford) doesn't give up. Forced into a single room with his father, mother (Eichhorn) who suffers from tuberculosis and younger brother Sullivan, Aaron knows he can do it alone. Soderbergh's misunderstanding is also clarified by these "Minori" projects: a well-made and well-prepared comedy in costume, which winks at European auteur cinema.

title: Body Shot
actors: Robert Patrick, Michelle Johnson, Ray Wise
description: A Los Angeles photographer (Robert Patrick), who has always been in love with the famous rock star Chelsea (Michelle Johnson), seems to have the chance of his life. She, following an accident, lives segregated away from everything and everyone. But he knows how to find her and even manages to take a picture of her. What looks like a sensational scoop turns out to be a terrible death trap for the photographer. Michelle Johnson is the one who seduced Michael Caine in That Day in Rio by director Stanley Donen. Robert Patrick instead is the one who let himself be hit by the bullets of Schwarzenegger in Terminator 2: without making a turn. Unfortunately, the film is what it is.

title: The Piano
actors: Holly Hunter, Harvey Keitel, Sam Neill, Anna Paquin
description: Ada, mute since the age of nine, arrives in New Zealand, married by proxy to Stewart, a small landowner. With her are her little daughter Flora, the trunks, a piano. Stewart does abandon the piano on the beach because it is difficult to transport along the rugged paths of the island. Baines, a white man who has approached Maori customs, helps Ada get it back. Having obtained the plan from Stewart, he asks Ada to give him lessons, which foresee a "controlled" availability of the woman for erotic play. To continue playing, she accepts. Baines gives her the piano back; a relationship is established between the two that Flora opposes. The relationship will seem to lead to tragedy. One of Campion's most sumptuous and visionary films, one of the few cionematographic examples of a conscious female gaze on eros. Wonderful use of New Zealand landscapes and hypnotic music by Michael Nyman. Palme d'Or in Cannes (ex-aequo with "Addio mia concubina") and Oscar for the protagonist Hunter, little Anna Paquin and the screenplay by Campion.

title: The Lost Weekend
actors: Ray Milland, Jane Wyman, Philip Terry, Howard Da Silva, Frank Faylen, Doris Dowling, Mary Young, Anita Sharp-Bolster, Lillian Fontaine, Frank Orth, Lewis L. Russell
description: After the initial success, a writer ran into difficulties, entered an existential crisis and turned to alcohol, in vain dissuaded by his brother and girlfriend. He soon ends up in a psychiatric clinic where, after a long ordeal, he tries to take his own life. Fortunately for him, however, his loved ones have not abandoned him and his girlfriend saves him at the last minute. Very hard and very courageous film for the time, with an almost noir atmosphere. The nightmare scene with mice and bat is famous. Oscar for the film, the direction, the screenplay and the protagonist, Palme d'Or at Cannes for the film and for Milland. It seems that originally the protagonist was also explicitly homosexual, but the censorship of the time did not allow it.

title: Diario di un vizio
actors: Jerry Calà, Sabrina Ferilli, Massimo Bucchi, Valentino Macchi
description: Benito, a detergent salesman, leads a nomadic and solitary life. Passing love adventures and squalid pensions are the highlights of his days. Benito keeps a personal diary where his daily annotations alternate with newspaper clippings and photographs. After yet another story of chase and loss, Benito vanishes into thin air; only trace: his strange "logbook". Ferreri describes the loneliness of the protagonist (an unusual Jerry Calà) giving him the benefit of pity. The busty "girlfriend" who torments him has the face and body of Sabrina Ferilli (La bella vita). The music column is by Gato Barbieri.

title: Milou en Mai
actors: Michel Piccoli, Miou-Miou, Michel Duchaussoy, Dominique Blanc, Harriet Walter
description: We are in the middle of the French May, but not in Paris. In a beautiful villa in the South West of France, all the relatives gathered around the remains of the recently deceased old lady Vieuzac. The battle for the inheritance is unleashed, but the news coming from the capital about the workers and students revolt provoke grotesque consequences, from which only the elderly son Milou is saved with dignity.
notes: Bitter comedy from the director of "Goodbye boys": the portrait of a provincial, petty and ridiculous France emerges. The performers are good, Renato Berta's photography is flawless as always, but the film as a whole runs a little in vain.

title: Pummarò
actors: Thywill Amenya, Pamela Villoresi, Jacqueline Williams
description: The dramatic journey to Italy of a non-EU immigrant from Caserta to Rome, and then to Verona, in search of his brother. A look at Italy between realism and bitterness, the Camorra and racism. Placido has a director's sensibility, but here the stereotypes of the social film hinder him a bit.

title: The Battle of Villa Fiorita
actors: Maureen O'Hara, Rossano Brazzi, Richard Todd, Phyllis Calvert
description: Moira Clavering is a quiet lady, wife and happy mother of two boys. One day, during a music festival, he meets and falls in love with the Italian pianist Lorenzo Tassara. The woman's husband proves to be understanding: not so the children, who follow the two lovers on Lake Garda trying to break the relationship ...
notes: A great director like Delmer Daves _ (That train to Yuma) _ struggling with a story not really in his strings. The story is dull, the children of the protagonist really irritating, but the author's job saves everything. Brazzi plays his role as the Latin lover. Anyway, only for enthusiasts.

title: The Great Sinner
actors: Gregory Peck, Ava Gardner, Melvyn Douglas, Ethel Barrymore
description: During a train ride, a writer meets a charming woman and falls in love with her. He follows her and discovers that she is an avid gambler and that the owner of the casino keeps her tied to him with blackmail. To help her, the man tries his luck at the green table: first he wins but then loses everything, reaching the brink of suicide.
notes: The film is freely inspired by Dostoevsky's "Player", while accentuating the sentimental and melodramatic sides.

title: Le silence est d'or
actors: Maurice Chevalier, Marcelle Derrien, François Périer, Dany Robin
description: In the Paris of the Belle Époque, an elderly film director, hailing from variety, continually boasts his female conquests, relentlessly propagating his belief in libertinism. But when he falls in love with the same girl he fell in love with, his assistant sacrifices himself in favor of the young colleague and indeed teaches him the right strategy to break through the girl's heart.
notes: A tribute by Clair to silent cinema and to the world of Paris "Fin de siècle". One of his best films, suspended between irony and melancholy, which marvelously exploits the histrionic vein of Chevalier, rarely so effective.

title: Sherlock Junior
actors: Buster Keaton, Kathrin McGuire, Ward Crane
description: A projectionist (Keaton) enters a film where, contrary to real life, he manages to behave like a hero. One of the most daring and intelligent reflections on cinema and its mechanisms, amesignano of all the metacinema and the subsequent cinema-parody. The depth of a great theorist, the pace of a great master. Also known as "Calm, gentlemen!", It is perhaps Buster's masterpiece who "invented" the metacinema in 1924. It was one of the films that convinced Bunuel to become a director. According to Morandini it is for the Seventh Art what "Six characters in search of an author" is for the theater. From "The Purple Rose of Cairo" to "Pleasantville", everyone owes him something.

title: Ma non per sempre
actors: Elena Sofia Ricci, Massimo Dapporto, Mariella Di Lauro
description: At the end of the nineteenth century, in northern Italy, the peasant Mary is indicated as "masca" (witch) for her independent spirit. Bravi the Ricci and donport in an otherwise mediocre film.

title: The Chalk Garden
actors: Deborah Kerr, John Mills, Edith Evans, Hayley Mills, Felix Aylmer
description: Ms. Maugham's strict morals prevented her from accepting that her daughter Olivia divorced her first husband to remarry. She therefore wanted to raise her granddaughter Laurel, daughter of Olivia and her first spouse, making her believe that she was abandoned by her mother. Laurel is now 16 years old and, thanks to the intervention of a sweet housekeeper, she will be able to reunite with her mother who has never ceased to love her.
notes: Family drama from a play by Enid Bagnold, directed with the usual elegance by the eclectic English director Ronald Neame. A little old-fashioned, but very elegant and effective.

title: Agatha
actors: Vanessa Redgrave, Dustin Hoffman, Timothy Dalton, Helen Morse
description: In the real life of Agatha Christie there is a "hole" lasting a few days, from 3 to 14 December 1926, during which the famous writer lost her tracks without ever later revealing the reason for her disappearance or where she had been. This film reconstructs those ten days as if they were a mystery ... by Agatha Christie. Apted imagines that the woman, shocked by learning that her husband was cheating on her, decides to follow her rival and commit a "perfect crime" in the manner of those described in her famous thrillers. But apart from the biographical curiosity and the elegance of the packaging (leading actors, photography by Storaro) the film has nothing remarkable.

title: Tonight and Every Night
actors: Rita Hayworth, Janet Blair, Lee Bowman
description: During the Second World War London was subjected to massive German bombings. Despite this, life goes on: every night a club presents variety shows. Sometimes the show is interrupted by the bombings: artists, dancers and spectators flee to the shelters. This is where a dancer falls in love with an officer in the English army. Despite the contrary opinion of his father, the two get married. Good sentimental war musical: halfway between propaganda films (London theaters that never close) and melodrama, with a wild Rita Hayworth (dubbed in singing) in the numerous variety ballets.

title: Moby Dick
actors: Gregory Peck, Orson Welles, Richard Basehart, Leo Genn
description: Ishmael, a young sailor embarks on a whaling ship. The captain is the fanatic Ahab who is looking for a white whale, Moby Dick, to whom he owes the loss of a leg. Ahab promises a gold coin to anyone who sees the whale. During the journey the restlessness takes possession of men.
notes: From the great novel by Melville, Huston draws a powerful and austere work, where the seafaring epic mixes with the "theological" invective of man's rebellion against God. Screenplay by Ray Bradbury and splendid color photography inspired by prints. epoch. Great little piece for Orson Welles.

title: John Carpenter's Body Bags
actors: Robert Carradine, David Naughton, Stacy Keach, Roger Corman
description: "The Gas Station" tells the misadventures of a student who works the night shift at a gas station and is harassed by a serial killer. In "Hair", a bald man has his hair transplanted, but it hides a horrible secret. In "The Eye" (the only episode directed by Hooper) a baseball player loses an eye in an accident and in its place is transplanted that of a vicious murderer executed in an electric chair. Passed only on TV. Three chapters suspended between nightmare and surrealism reminiscent of those of the series "At the edge of reality". Carpenter, also author of the music, directs and interprets the frame episode, and in particular Roger Corman and Hooper also appear. To the delight of fans.

title: Lower Level
actors: David Bradley, Elisabeth Gracen, Jeff Yagher, Shari Shattuck
description: He is a famous and successful architect, she is a beautiful girl and also a yuppie. The two are in the same office, outside working hours. It wouldn't be a hard thing to get out except that the security guard is a psychopath obsessively in love with the girl. Among other things, he can tamper with the alarm systems, doors and lifts and for the couple the way out will be long and difficult. Kristine Peterson ("Dirty Deal") has a pretty tough job for a woman: acting as an action movie director. He's not doing badly. The narrative device of the closed place with psychopath is not exactly original, but the fault lies with the screenwriter: Joel Soisson.

title: American Ninja 3: Blood Hunt
actors: David Bradley, Steve James, Marjoe Gortner, Michele Chan
description: To avenge his father's death, Sean Davidson began studying under the guidance of master Izumo to become a ninja. After a hard apprenticeship he becomes so good that the evil Saxon, in order to convince him to work for him in his terrorist organization, does not hesitate to kidnap Izumo. Of course Saxon and his men are also responsible for the death of Sean's father. Our ninja quickly rushes to the aid of his master.
notes: Of the two previous episodes, only the character of Steve James, the African American ninja, remains. In "The American Warrior 4" Bradley and Dudikoff will appear together. Only for super fans.

title: Outcast
actors: John Derek, Joan Evans, Jim Davis
description: Cowboy Jet returns to the country after a long absence to reclaim the family ranch his uncle has taken over. All predictable, with a lot of action.

title: Vampire Circus
actors: Adrienne Corri, Laurence Payne, Thorley Walters
description: Villagers kill a vampire and suffer its curse which materializes with the plague and the invasion of monstrous animals. Imaginative horror film directed with a sense of suspense and produced now out of season by the legendary Hammer.

title: The Beast with Five Fingers
actors: Peter Lorre, Andrea King, Robert Alda
description: The great pianist Francis Ingram is mysteriously murdered. Severed from the corpse, his hand kills several pretenders to the master's conspicuous inheritance by witchcraft.
notes: Excellent weaving, effective tricks and a splendid interpretation by Peter Lorre, in a story inspired by the plot of the novel "The Hands of Orlac", which served as a canvas for dozens of films.

title: Movie Movie
actors: George C. Scott, Trish Van Devere, Barbara Harris, Red Buttons, Harry Hamlin
description: Film in two episodes and an interlude. In the "Boxeur" Joey, a boy, becomes a boxing champion in order to pay for his studies. His new coach, the shady Vince, however, wants to make him lose a match: Joey refuses, but the gesture costs the life of his old coach and friend Gloves. Joey left boxing becomes a lawyer and has Vince sentenced. In the "Ballerina" a Broadway impresario close to death puts on a great show with music by a stranger. A very young dancer will make the show triumph.
notes: It is considered Donen's spiritual testament and at the same time, a nostalgic and ironic tribute to a world that has now disappeared.

title: Nightmare Honeymoon
actors: Dack Rambo, Rebecca Dianna Smith, Bob Steele
description: A young couple on their honeymoon ends up in the clutches of murderers and rapists in the desolate rural province of the United States. A cheap and boring movie.

title: One Way Passage
actors: William Powell, Kay Francis, Frank McHugh
description: Love story on an ocean liner between an incurably ill young woman, who returns to America to die, and a crook expected from jail. Melodrama that made school; Oscar to Robert Lord for the original story.

title: Per amare Ofelia
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Françoise Fabian, Giovanna Ralli, Alberto De Mendoza
description: Orlando Aliberti, advertising manager, has such a morbid attachment to his mother that he is sexually inhibited with any other woman. By chance he meets Ofelia, a prostitute who has started a laundry with her own staff. Ofelia wants to heal Orlando from the unnatural block.
notes: If the film was intended to be a satire of mammism, the result is instead a concentration of vulgarity, from which only Pozzetto is saved with his extravagant dialogues.

title: L'insegnante va in collegio
actors: Renzo Montagnani, Edwige Fenech, Alvaro Vitali, Lino Banfi, Gianfranco D'Angelo
description: Obsessed with kidnappings, an industrialist from the North moves to the South and starts living by pretending to be a bum. The old habits die hard so that, despite being married, he does not stop dating his lover and even tries with his son's English teacher. In this way, although disguised, it begins to attract attention.
notes: Do not deceive the summary of the plot: we are very far from the dignity of comedy and very close, instead, to the (sought after) prosaic nature of vulgar farce. Renzo Montagnani, really good, deserved more. Remarkable box-office success.

title: Caroline Chérie
actors: France Anglade, Vittorio De Sica, Bernard Blier, Charles Aznavour, Isa Miranda
description: The young Caroline De Bièvres, from a noble but fallen family, gives herself to Gaston De Sallanches on 14 July 1789, the day the Bastille is taken. Throughout the long period of the Revolution, the girl will live in a succession of adventures passing from one man to another: from the elderly revolutionary with whom she agrees to marry so as not to have problems with the new political leaders, to those she runs into through vicissitudes. infinite. Then, finally, she reunites with her beloved Gaston from whom she had been separated by the tragic events in France.
notes: From the novel by Cécil Saint Laurent (pseudonym of Jacques Laurent-Cély), a rather mediocre film that tells without much imagination a repetition of events almost always the same as themselves.

title: La discesa di Aclà a Floristella
actors: Francesco Cusimano, Tony Sperandeo, Luigi Maria Burruano
description: The very blond Aclà was born into a large and poor family, so much so that, when he was eleven, he was "sold" for eight years as a "caruso" to a pickaxe in the Floristella sulfur mine. Hard work, homosexuality among the workers (who stay in the mine even at night), blows at work and blows at home: Aclà escapes from the solfatara. First work by Grimaldi, author of the novel "Mery per semper". Aesthetizing and pleased, a film with "high" ambitions and no morality of gaze.

title: Il giudizio universale
actors: Alberto Sordi, Vittorio Gassman, Anouk Aimée, Fernandel, Nino Manfredi
description: We are in Naples, on an ordinary day. Suddenly a thundering voice from heaven announces the beginning of the Last Judgment for that same day. Gradually the obsessive voice is taken seriously and everyone reacts in some way: there are those who despair, those who repent, those who are incredulous, those who dive into pleasures. At the appointed time, however, instead of the dreaded "judgment" only a storm breaks out. Everyone can thus return to their former life (including vices).
notes: Zavattini's screenplay lingers a little too much in the speckled satire, but the idea is curious, the very thick cast and some episodes (Deaf seller of children) bad at the right point. Appearances also by Modugno and Mike Bongiorno. Final in color.

title: Graffiante desiderio
actors: Vittoria Belvedere, Ron Nummi, Serena Grandi, Andrea Roncato
description: Luigi is engaged to Cinzia, a rich bourgeois who is trying to conclude a billionaire contract. The man's destiny is marked by the arrival of his cousin Sonia, the adulterous daughter of an uncle who emigrated with his wife to Venezuela. The gorgeous girl upsets his life and causes Cinzia to jealously see her boyfriend fall into a whirlwind of sex. But Sonia hides a terrible secret and Luigi learns it by reading her secret diary.
notes: Unassuming erotic thriller: roughness and obscenity go to waste. Sergio Martino tries to exploit the success of "Basic Instinct" but fails completely.

title: The Girl in the Red Velvet Swing
actors: Ray Milland, Joan Collins, Farley Granger, Luther Adler
description: Evelyn Nesbit is a beautiful girl. A famous architect (older than her and already married) falls in love with Stanford White, while billionaire Harry K. Thaw is in love with her. When the architect dumps her, Harry marries her, but jealousy torments him to the point of killing his former rival.
notes: Dark melodrama based on a news story, which denounces the hypocrisy of the American society of the time. A curiosity: the same story was told in "Ragtime" by Milos Forman. Shot with the De Luxe process, today, in the era of special effects and digital, it has lost all the advantages of this tecinca.

title: Napoli... la camorra sfida, la città risponde
actors: Mario Merola, Antonio Sabato, Jeff Blynn, Ciro Ippolito, Walter Ricciardi
description: A boss of the Camorra extinguishes the traders. One of them, Gargiulo, opposes the racketeering and reports it to the police. The institutions, however, soon leave him alone to fight against the underworld and the gangs kidnap his son and rape the boy's girlfriend. Police by-product of the most gruesome.

title: Son of Fury
actors: Tyrone Power, Gene Tierney, George Sanders, Frances Farmer
description: We are in eighteenth-century England, the century of the Enlightenment. The noble Benjamin Blake is deprived of his inheritance by a cousin who persecutes him. Having fled to the Marquesas Islands, he makes his fortune there with pearl fishing and returns to London to get justice. Will he succeed in his intent? Who will help him?
notes: Spectacular costume romance (based on the plot of the "Earl of Momtecristo") directed by the excellent John Cromwell with a splendid Gene Tierney.

title: A Tales of Two Cities
actors: Ronald Colman, Basil Rathbone, Elizabeth Allen
description: To take revenge on Charles Darnay, nephew of liberal ideas, who married Lucie Manette, the daughter of a Frenchman, the perfidious and tyrannical uncle, Marquis of St. Evremonde, has him accused of espionage. Sydney, a disillusioned, alcoholic lawyer friend, offers to help. After the outbreak of the French Revolution and the establishment of the Terror, Charles returns to Paris to help his old guardian and is imprisoned.
notes: A grandiose fresco of an era and a hymn to ideals and love: the cast is excellent, while the staging is a triumph of the classic MGM style of the 30s. The Dickens novel from which it is based has been brought to the screen three more times, in 1917, 1958 and 1980.

title: Man of a Thousand Faces
actors: James Cagney, Dorothy Malone, Robert Evans
description: Fictional biography of the life and of the actor Lon Chaney, specialized in the days of the silent, in horror roles. Of his difficult relationships with his wife and son. Classic biopic: James Cagney's amazing interpretation.

title: Romanoff and Juliet
actors: Peter Ustinov, Sandra Dee, John Gavin, Akim Tamiroff, Tamara Shayne
description: In the small state of Concordia, the daughter of the American ambassador falls in love with the son of the Soviet one. Satirical comedy (which loosely refers to the Shakespearean text) on the possibility of overcoming the contrast between the blocks.

title: Descending Angel
actors: George C. Scott, Eric Roberts, Diane Lane, Mark Margolis
description: A student marries a girl of Romanian origin. Little by little, however, he became convinced that the girl's father had worrying relations with the Nazis during the Second World War. Thus begins his personal investigation.
notes: It is a good love story that then turns yellow. Among the actors a dull George C. Scott and a grim Eric Roberts.

title: The Revolutionary
actors: Jon Voight, Seymour Cassel, Robert Duvall, Jennifer Salt
description: A student of philosophy rejects bourgeois life and engages in revolutionary readings and political discussions, without however realizing the desire for revolt that harbors within himself. After sharing his political activity with a workers' group, he is expelled from the university. Called up, he ends up deserting. Finally, he joined the anarchist movement and carried out an attack on a judge. Interesting film about American youthful anxiety between the Sixties and Seventies. He prefers the existential one to political analysis, the cast is remarkable, the narrative tone is dry, the point of view in "direct contact" on reality is effective.

title: Sullivan's Travels
actors: Joel McCrea, Veronica Lake, Robert Warwick, William Demarest
description: Sullivan is a celebrated director. Dissatisfied with his films, he wants to move from comedies to a more committed cinema. A traumatic experience makes him change his mind.

title: Nuit d'été en ville
actors: Marie Trintignant, Jean-Hugues Anglade
description: Emilia slept with Louis she met at a party. After making love, she is afraid of the bond that could arise between them. The two spend the night together, telling each other experiences, disappointments, anguish; and they end up overcoming what prevented the birth of feeling. Portrait of an apparently transgressive couple. The whole is a bit manneristic, even if flavored by the "touch of sex" that the situation itself generates. Good interpretation of the two protagonists who have to stand alone the whole film.

title: Backbeat
actors: Sheryl Lee, Stephen Dorff, Ian Hart, Gary Bakewell
description: Liverpool 1960. Stuart Sutcliffe is hit in the head during a fight. Then he left for Hamburg where he had to play in his group: "Johnny and the Moondogs" which later became "The Beatles". Here he meets Klaus, a local artist, and his girlfriend Astrid. Love is born between Stuart and Astrid so much that Stuart leaves the group and goes to live with her.
notes: Already known as the author of video clips, Iain Softley made his debut with a film that talks about the Beatles without giving in to the rhetoric on the myth of the Beatles. A film that also talks about unemployment, sensational and desperate drinking, factories and pubs that have gone down in history.

title: The Gypsy and the Gentleman
actors: Melina Mercouri, Keith Michell, Patrick McGoohan, Flora Robson, June Laverick, Lyndon Brook, Helen Haye, Mervyn Jones, Laurence Naismith, Clare Austin, Catherine Feller, Nigel Green
description: At the beginning of the nineteenth century, Sir Paul Deverill, who intends to marry the daughter of a rich neighbor to replenish his dying fortunes, meets Belle, a gypsy, and falls madly in love with her. Believing him rich, this leads him to leave his girlfriend and marry her, but when he realizes how things really are, he plans to make up for Paul's sister, who is waiting for a large inheritance.
notes: Delirious reinterpretation of mélo, directed over the top and with a sure hand by Losey, in his first attempts in England after emigrating from the US for political reasons.

title: I Could Go on Singing
actors: Judy Garland, Dirk Bogarde, Jack Klugman, Aline MacMahon, Gregory Phillips
description: Finding herself in London on business, the famous singer Jenny asks the man she once loved and had a child with to let her see the boy, whom she had known nothing about for years. Mother and son meet and a great affection is born that will be broken by the father. Only a serious accident, in which Jenny sees her life in danger, will be able to recreate the family.
notes: This is the latest film shot by Judy Garland. The story told on the film is subtly biographical precisely in relation to the life of the main performer. The artistic result, however, is compromised by a melodramatic and pretentious direction.

title: Sedotta e abbandonata
actors: Aldo Puglisi, Lando Buzzanca, Stefania Sandrelli, Saro Urzì
description: Agnes, sixteen, is seduced by her sister Matilde's boyfriend. The father demands a reparative wedding, but the seducer niche. Forced with hard manners, when the man accepts it is Agnes who refuses. The gentore doesn't give up and the young woman threatens to lock herself up in a convent.
notes: The film tried to repeat the great success of "Divorzio all'italiana", also by Germi. Concessions to homegrown comedy macchiettismo end up being, in the hands of the author, even functional to the balance of the story. The character of Leopoldo Trieste, a "sympathizer" (and not an expert) of pasta, is memorable, like all the specks and secondary characters.

title: National Lampoon's European Vacation
actors: Chevy Chase, Beverly D'Angelo, Dana Hill, Jason Lively
description: The Griswald family, made up of father Clark, mother Ellen and children, Audrey and Rusty, participates in a prize competition called "Grufolo and nest egg" and wins a wonderful fifteen-day trip to Europe. The happiness of the grown-ups is enormous, while Audrey and Rusty don't seem thrilled at all. Audrey doesn't feel like leaving her fiancé Jack at home, who, for her part, doesn't seem too bad about it. The four messed up vacationers leave and begin an endless series of more or less fun adventures, especially for those who find themselves on his way.
notes: New insane episode of the "National Lampoon Vacation" series: this time the Europeans pay the price. The film is all about stereotypes (such as: driving on the left in England, ridiculous Tyrolean clothes like "All together passionately").

title: In the Best Interest of the Children
actors: Sarah Jessica Parker, Sally Struthers, Lexi Randall
description: Callie Cain (Sarah Jessica Parker), a young woman who suffers from frequent depressive maniac crises, returns to the village, in the Iowa, with partner and five children in the hope of finding a remedy for her evil. But here the man does not get used to it and soon leaves it. Callie thus ends in the hospital. What will they be of his children? Fortunately, a family that obtains them in foster care is ahead, but the care for Callie are very long and, when she can finally leave the hospital the relationship between the little ones and the "new parents" has intensified to the point that ...
notes: Despite the obviousness of the story, the film is saved thanks to the commitment of the actors, even the younger ones.

title: Battle of the Bulge
actors: Henry Fonda, Robert Shaw, Robert Ryan, Dana Andrews, George Montgomery, Charles Bronson, Telly Savalas
description: December 1944: the Nazis are close to defeat. At least that's what the allies think. Only Colonel Kiley remains in tension, convinced that the Germans are preparing a sensational counterattack. In fact, Colonel Hessler, in spite of what General Gray and Colonel Pritchard think, launches an offensive on the Ardennes with a division of armored vehicles.
notes: The cast includes the major Hollywood "calibers" of the moment. The best thing about the film, however, is the Panavision, or rather the Ultrapanavision, and with it the Technicolor with which Jack Hildiard photographed everything.

title: The Hunter
actors: Steve McQueen, Eli Wallach, Kathryn Harrold, Tracey Walter, Leval Burton, Ben Johnson
description: Ralph Thorson is a bounty hunter tasked with bringing back those who violate probation rules. Ralph is married to a teacher who is about to give him a child, but he does not want the child because the world that is about to welcome the creature is imbued with Evil, as he teaches his trade. On the trail of Ralph, in addition, there is Rocco Mason, a bandit who because of the "hunter" has done a lot of jail time ...
notes: The numerous action sequences are good, shot at great pace. As always, McQueen's acting is masterful. But the script suffers from a few too many forcing.

title: Una fredda mattina di maggio
actors: Sergio Castellitto, Alessandra Acciai
description: During the years of lead, Ruggero Manni (Sergio Castellitto), a famous journalist of an important newspaper, investigates the attack of an elderly colleague of his. Despite the hostility of some members of the editorial staff, Manni goes on and discovers that some of the children of friends are part of a terrorist organization. He will continue his search with courage, but will end up murdered.
notes: The film is inspired by the murder of Walter Tobagi, a journalist of the "Corriere della Sera", killed for the positions he assumed in his professional activity. As often happens in these cases, however, the rhetoric takes over.

title: Trooper Hook
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, Joel McCrea, Earl Holliman
description: A white woman is kidnapped by an Indian chief and has a son from him. Years later she is "liberated" and returned to "civilization", but people only show feelings of contempt towards her. The ex-husband, among other things, agrees to welcome her back into the house but without her half-breed son.
notes: Politically correct and covertly hypocritical Western. Whites are bad because they despise Indians, but in order not to return the woman with the redskin, the script makes him die. Of course the cast is excellent. Direction without praise and without infamy.

title: Il vigile
actors: Alberto Sordi, Vittorio De Sica, Marisa Merlini, Mara Berni
description: Otello Colletti (Sordi) manages to get himself hired as a "big guy", but he gets into trouble one after the other, both when he has a broad sleeve (as with Sylva Koscina, in the role of herself), and when he decides to be strict and fiscal . He rigorously applies the highway code even towards the mayor (De Sica) and ends up receiving reprimands instead of praise.
notes: The comedy is pleasant and Albertone plays at home with his character, but the most acrid ideas are abandoned for a more speckish taste. Screenplay by Sonego.

title: Gunfight at the O.K. Corral
actors: Burt Lancaster, Kirk Douglas, Rhonda Fleming, Jo Van Fleet, John Ireland, Lyle Bettger, Frank Faylen, Earl Holliman, Ted De Corsia, Dennis Hopper, Whit Bissell, George Mathews, DeForest Kelley, Martin Milner
description: In Dodge City, Sheriff Wyatt Earp (Lancaster) and player Doc Holliday (Douglas) are bonded by sincere friendship. The proximity of Wyatt has a beneficial effect on Doc's conduct: after saving him from an ambush he teaches him not to transgress the law and above all not to respond to the violence inflicted on him by Ringo, a ruthless outlaw in the pay of the Clanton family. But when the provocations against Doc are followed by the murder of a brother of Wyatt, the sheriff decides to settle the matter with a fight to the death. Doc, although seriously ill, follows him in the challenge. A super classic, with the plot based on one of the most visited episodes in the western genre: the famous challenge between the Earps and the Clantons at the Tombstone paddock. Admittedly, the poetic inspiration of Infernal Challenge is missing, but the film is still beautiful, well written and excellently served by the couple of protagonists Lancaster / Douglas at the height of their careers.

title: The Carpetbaggers
actors: George Peppard, Alan Ladd, Carroll Baker, Robert Cummings
description: A capitalist accepts his duties as a husband and father only when he knows he is mentally healthy. Melodrama with famous motif, inspired by the life of the playboy Howard Hughes. Minor film by Dmytryk, with bad taste sequences. After all, not much could be extracted from a Harold Robbins novel.

title: Blade Runner
actors: Harrison Ford, Sean Young, Rutger Hauer, Daryl Hannah, William J. Sanderson
description: In a swarming, immense Los Angeles located in the near future, a former police detective (Harrison Ford), who specializes in the hunting and "retreat" of rebel replicants, is called back into service to track down four, escaped from an extraterrestrial colony. This time, his life will be completely changed.
notes: After the success with the first Alien (1979), Ridley Scott returns to science fiction, mixing it, however, to the noir atmospheres of the police of the 1940s. The result is fascinating: for the labyrinthine, suffocating scenography, for the rough melancholy of the story, for the superb presence of Harrison Ford. The film, modified by the producers, was released according to the original version in 1991. But the changes in the production, for once, had not been stupid. In Scott's version there is the Over voice (which makes a lot of hard boiled) and the "robbed" ending in Shining (1980) by Kubrick. Do you want to put the (fake) happy ending of the first version? At the end of the journey undertaken by Deckard and Rachel there was no earthly paradise but the Overlook Hotel! The film met a sequel, Blade Runner 2049 (2017), by Denis Villeneuve, with Ryan Gosling, Jared Leto and, again in the role of Rick Deckard, of the oxidable Harrison Ford.

title: Cimarron
actors: Richard Dix, Irene Dunne, Estelle Taylor
description: Family saga set in Oklahoma between 1890 and 1915. Great early sound production from a dated but still enjoyable novel by Edna Farber.
notes: Oscar for Best Film and Best Screenplay and Set Design. Remade by Anthony Mann in 1961 ("Cimarron").

title: Possessed
actors: Joan Crawford, Clark Gable, Wallace Ford
description: Tired of a grim life, Joan Crawford moves to New York in search of rich men and becomes Clark Gable's lover. Feminist moods in a luxurious and interesting melò of the years of the great depression.

title: Night of the Lepus
actors: Stuart Whitman, Rory Calhoun, Janet Leigh
description: In Ajo City, in southern Arizona, an irrepressible proliferation of rabbits destroys all types of vegetation. A remedy must be found, however, avoiding side effects that could be disastrous. For this purpose, researcher Roy Bennet, aided by his wife Jerry, experiments with the dosage of injections based on antifecondative hormones. But the unexpected happens.
notes: Fanta-horror-catastrophic which, due to its singularity, has almost become a "cult".

title: Son of a Gunfighter
actors: Russ Tamblyn, Kieron Moore, James Philbrook, Fernando Rey
description: A young man left alone in search of his father, who ran away from home in unclear circumstances. In fact, he holds him responsible for his mother's death. After a long and frantic search he finds him in Mexico, where he took refuge and where he headed a gang of pistoleros. A duel looms between the two, but then things clear up and the real responsibilities also emerge. However, the father dies and the young man finds a new family.
notes: A traditional western with some not unfounded psychological claims. The financial origin of the film is rather unusual: one of the very few Spanish-American co-productions.

title: Dennis the Menace
actors: Walter Matthau, Mason Gamble, Joan Plowright, Christopher Lloyd
description: Dennis is a very lively little boy who plays pretty ferocious tricks on his neighbors including shooting aspirin pills in their mouths with a blowgun or making dentures disappear. At a certain point in the city a criminal appears with the intention of kidnapping a child and asking for his ransom and he has the unfortunate idea of ??choosing the pestiferous Dennis: it will be his undoing!
notes: In the wake of "Mom I missed the plane" (the screenwriter is the same, John Hugues), another precocious "hero" with the precious contribution of marpioni such as Walter Matthau (the neighbor) and Christopher Lloyd (the kidnapper) . Funny.

title: Mr. Jones
actors: Richard Gere, Lena Olin, Anne Bancroft, Tom Irvin
description: A man, with a very normal appearance, occasionally starts doing more or less dangerous oddities, until he is hospitalized in a hospital for the insane. The first treatments of the therapist who follows him have the result of making him totally apathetic. When the patient and doctor then go to bed together, she is distressed by breaking the code of professional ethics. But everything falls into place.
notes: The film has the notable mistake of starting out as the story of this mysterious Mr. Jones and then turning into the story of the doctor and her professional remorse. Result: a superficial and inconclusive cartoon.

title: La dottoressa preferisce i marinai
actors: Alvaro Vitali, Gianni Ciardo, Paola Senatore, Renzo Montagnani
description: Cicca and Gianni are sent to do the cleaning in a large Roman hotel. Here they witness a murder (or so it seems to them) and from this moment they find themselves in a whirlwind of paradoxical situations, between the killer who hunts them, an officer who wants to hide the presence of his lover from his wife, a waiter who must deliver medicine and other messes.
notes: A mixture of pochade, farce and comedy of misunderstandings, the film bases its genuine "strength" on vulgar and very immediate comedy. Vitali doesn't work as well as it could and Paola Senatore doesn't have the intensity of the Shakespearean actress.

title: Nati con la camicia
actors: Bud Spencer, Terence Hill, Buffy Dee, David Huddleston, Faith Minton
description: Doug (Spencer) is out of prison, Rosco (Hill) is a wandering ventriloquist who rides around on his roller skates. For a series of combinations they find themselves together, charged with a very dangerous mission by the CIA. Their task is to defeat a criminal organization led by a madman who would like to subvert the world situation ...
notes: Yet another fruit of the Spencer-Hill partnership, with the typical ingredients of their repertoire: gags and blows at a frenzied pace. The story, inspired by the various 007 agents, is old-fashioned.

title: L'arciere nero
actors: Gérard Landry, Federica Ranchi, Livio Lorenzon, Carla Strober
description: Two cousins, the deformed Lodrisio and the handsome, but perverse, Ludovico, in order to seize the power held by their uncle Alvise, kill the count of Sant'Elia who suspects their plots. The son of these, Corrado, is forced to flee and, to avenge his father, he turns into a bandit.
notes: Justice will finally triumph when all the wicked die, and their accomplices with them. Nefarious projects, cruelty, corruption, violence, duels and, finally, the reward for the good and the punishment for the wicked: the traditional code of the Romanzone is respected, but the film is worth nothing more than its cumbersome story.

title: La muta di Portici
actors: Doris Duranti, Marcello Mastroianni, Floria Mariol, Anna Maria Ferrero
description: In Naples of 1647, the viceroy imposes gabelles that affect the minute people and create widespread discontent. Tommaso Aniello, called Masaniello, a young fisherman of Portici, fosters the rebellion and the police try to capture him. He lives with his sister Lucia, who is in love with Alfonso without knowing that it is the viceroy's son. The historical fact of the Naples revolt headed by Masaniello is an opportunity for a naively fictional reinterpretation and put in images with absolute mediocrity.

title: Breakout
actors: Charles Bronson, Robert Duvall, John Huston, Jill Ireland, Randy Quaid, Sheree North
description: To get an innocent person out of prison, his family relies on a specialist. The first attempts fail because the wife, unaware, reveals her plans to her husband's enemies. Then, with a helicopter ...
notes: Typical action movie tailor-made for Charles Bronson, character actor promoted to lead actor by Sergio Leone. The premise of the film gives hope for a breathtaking film; which is not so true.

title: A Day at the Races
actors: Groucho, Harpo, Chico Marx, Margaret Dumont, Maureen O'Sullivan
description: Standish Clinic is on the verge of bankruptcy. The owner, Judy Standish, is no longer able to meet her debts. The perfidious Morgan takes advantage of this and, with the complicity of the administrator, would like to transform the elegant clinic into a gambling house. A wealthy patient comes to Judy's aid and grants a hefty loan on condition that she is treated by Dr. Hugo Z. Hackenbush who is actually a ... vet.

title: Ascoltami
actors: Luciano Tajoli, Joachim Fuchsberger, Jeannette Vidor
description: After an accident renders him disabled, a former singer is left by the lover for whom he had previously abandoned the family. In his misfortune, however, an extraordinary case happens to him: he finds a son he did not know he had had from an old relationship. The young man, who works as a laborer, has a beautiful voice and performs in the evening in fourth-rate bars. Without revealing himself, his father gives him singing lessons, helping him break into the world of music.
notes: A rhythmic drama based on the warbling of Luciano Tajoli, the voice of a nightingale in a body actually affected by a handicap.

title: Those Darying Young Men in Their Jauntry
actors: Peter Cook, Tony Curtis, Lando Buzzanca, Walter Chiari, Dudley Moore
description: Adventures during the Monte Carlo rally between small and big scams to win the race. Discreet comedy that mixes spectacular and farcical elements, with an international cast and slapstick tones.

title: Man, Woman and Child
actors: Craig T. Nelson, Martin Sheen, Blythe Danner, Sebastian Duncan
description: In Los Angeles, Bob and Sheila live happily with their two little girls. Then comes the news that Nicole, the woman with whom Bob had a child he never knew, died in France. The boy, who is unaware that Bob is his father, is invited to Los Angeles for two weeks. A film of accurate psychological analysis, especially for women. A story that does not fall into the traps of the honey with a good acting.

title: The Rainmaker
actors: Burt Lancaster, Katharine Hepburn, Wendell Corey, Lloyd Bridges
description: A strange preacher who promises rain settles in a family in a small town in the southern United States threatened by drought. The clouds come and for the preacher the senses of a spinster awaken. N. Richard Nash elegantly adapts one of his plays; the film in fact remains almost only a "vehicle" for the two protagonists (who, however, are really fit).

title: Il ragazzo del pony express
actors: Jerry Calà, Isabella Ferrari, Alessandro Benvenuti, Emanuela Taschini, Gabriella Saitta
description: The young Augustine, known as Ago, brilliantly graduated with full marks and honors. However, this does not allow him to quickly find a suitable job. At the suggestion of his girlfriend who already works that way, Ago accepts a job as a pony express, the motorized postman who delivers mail to big cities. During his first round the boy meets (or rather collides) with a dream woman ...
notes: Easy-going comedy, but not always banal. Jerry Calà first style, on the wave of television success, still pulls a few smiles. The worst is yet to come.

title: Cry in the Wild
actors: David Morse, Megan Follows, Dion Anderson, Tom Atkins
description: From a true story, which happened in Pennsylvania in 1966. A mentally ill kidnaps Peggy Ann, a seventeen-year-old girl. During her imprisonment, however, the girl soon establishes a sympathetic relationship with her kidnapper, moved in the extreme gesture only by a need for love. Meanwhile, all the police in the country are on the trail of Peggy Ann and her kidnapper. Director Charles Correll stages a film pervaded by constant tension, but which manages to avoid the risk of grotesque exasperation. The interpreters are convincing; Megan Follows in the role of the girl recalls the Linda Blair of the times of "The Exorcist".

title: Berlin, die Symphonie einer Grosstadt
description: The city of Berlin investigated with the eye of the camera from dawn to dusk. Documentary investigation on the life of a city atomized in its key moments. A page of great avant-garde cinema.

title: What?
actors: Sydne Rome, Marcello Mastroianni, Romolo Valli, Hugh Griffith
description: Nancy is an American girl who hitchhikes the world. Attacked by some brutes on the Amalfi coast, she finds refuge in a splendid villa: here a well-mannered but not very recommendable male company is gathered. In no time at all it becomes the only object of desire.
notes: Polanski in a state of grace scratches and grins, backed by an almost entirely Italian supercast.

title: Avanti!
actors: Jack Lemmon, Juliet Mills, Clive Revill, Pippo Franco, Mario Adorf
description: Wendell, a forty-year-old American industrialist, arrives in Ischia to bring home the body of his father, who died during his annual Italian vacation. Here he finds Pamela, a young lady from London, struggling with similar tasks concerning her mother. What did the two elderly tourists do together every year in Ischia? Wendell's puritanism, put to the test, will eventually yield on all fronts.
notes: A great Jack Lemmon as the sexophobic industrialist, but ready to throw his heart over the fence. Wilder to the max. The intrigue is full of twists and turns; the script extracts the impossible from the most forbidden tourist stereotypes. Appearance of Sergio Bruni and small part for Pippo Franco (very good).

title: Woman of Desire
actors: Bo Derek, Jeff Fahey, Steven Bauer, Robert Mitchum
description: We are in South Africa; Captain Jack Lynch is accused of rape by the beautiful Christina Ford, who also claims that he is the killer of Ted Ashby. He was the lover of the woman and owner of the boat captained by Jack. The accused relies on the lawyer Hill who, with his skill, discovers the true plots of Christina, a woman who uses seduction and deception without scruples. A television production with a high-sounding cast even if a little faded in its most famous names. The suspense is relative, the whole is predictable and anything but exciting.

title: The Tales of Hoffmann
actors: Moira Shearer, Robert Rousenville, Robert Helpmann, Léonide Massine, Ludmilla Tchérina, Ann Ayars, Pamela Brown, Frederick Ashton, Mogens Wieth, Lionel Harris
description: Hoffmann, in love with the ballerina Stella, tells a group of students the story of three of his old loves: one for a doll that he believed to be a woman; the one for Juliet, who wanted to imprison her soul in a mirror; the one for Antonia, who died when she decided to break the prohibition that forbade her to sing. And as he talks, he realizes that his destiny is to be a poet. The visionary talent of the Powell and Pressburger duo is at the service of Offenbach's work: no script, but total adherence to the score. The scenic ideas are phenomenal, the creative tension of the two filmmakers is at an all-time high.

title: Hanover Street
actors: Harrison Ford, Lesley-Anne Down, Christopher Plummer
description: David, a lieutenant pilot of the American air force serving near London, during a German bombing sees and approaches Margareth, a British nurse. The woman is happily married to Captain Paul Sellinger, an Intelligence Service agent, and has a daughter. Nonetheless, the two become lovers and David, who has long suspected that Margareth is cheating on him, begins to lose courage.
notes: Honest sentimental drama with a bitter and moralistic happy ending.

title: Questa volta parliamo di uomini
actors: Nino Manfredi, Luciana Paluzzi, Milena Vukotic, Margaret Lee
