description: Four episodes with Manfredi in the role of as many characters. A wealthy industrialist discovers that his wife steals and blackmails. When he is in dire straits he induces her to continue. An old knife thrower ends up killing his partner and finds it difficult to find a new one. A farmer makes a great living by exploiting his wife's work. A professor makes his wife believe that he was killed by her.
notes: Attempt, only partially successful, of satire on man-woman relationships. Among the few non-kilometer titles of Wertmüller. Manfredi is furious but his characters are spooky.

title: Town Tamer
actors: Dana Andrews, Terry Moore, Lon Chaney jr., Pat O'Brien, Bruce Cabot
description: A large Great Planes landowner who is building the railroad calls Rossen, a former sheriff, to restore order to the village. In fact, the band of Condor dominates you, a ruthless bandit, backed by Sheriff Ring. Rossen with great difficulty (he is also unjustly accused of murder) will be able to defeat the gang thanks to the (belated but effective) help of the repentant sheriff.

title: W USA
actors: Paul Newman, Joanne Woodward, Anthony Perkins
description: A conservative and reactionary radio journalist discovers, after the suicide of his wife ended up in prison by mistake, the hypocrisy of his position and of society. Commendable film-denunciation, with the inevitable simplifications but with remarkable courage and an excellent Newman.

title: The Friends of Eddie Coyle
actors: Robert Mitchum, Peter Boyle, Richard Jordan, Steven Keats
description: Eddie Coyle is fifty years old and doesn't expect much from life anymore. He makes ends meet by mediating between some arms dealers and a gang of robbers. But one day Foley the cop catches him carrying contraband alcohol. To avoid a severe sentence Coyle is forced to reveal the names of "friends". Which of course don't take it well.
notes: A robust detective story, among the best proofs of Yates who had already given us the beautiful "Bullit". Pervasive hard boiled atmosphere, with the characters almost aware of the upcoming end. A film made of men and shadows, of lead and night. One of the best proofs of the last Mitchum.

title: Searching for Bobby Fisher
actors: Max Pomeranc, Joe Mantegna, Ben Kingsley, Laurence Fishburne
description: # A father (Mantegna) discovers that his seven-year-old son Josh has a predisposition for the game of chess. He decides to let him take lessons from a former great champion (Kinsley) who compares the child's talent to that of the most famous American chess player: Bobby Fisher. The child thus begins his career. But very soon the father realizes how this game can be transformed into an all-encompassing and unhealthy passion that can isolate those pervaded from the rest of the world. It is a great risk for the child who will now hardly be able to escape from the mechanisms of success.
notes: For his directorial debut, screenwriter Steven Zaillian ("Awakenings", "Schindler's List") takes the true story of Josh Waitzkin. Zaillian's hand isn't very sure, but the actors give him considerable help.

title: Sleepwalkers
actors: Brian Krause, Mädchen Amick, Alice Krige, Stephen King
description: Charles Brady and his mother Mary are "sleepwalkers" or creatures that are partly human, partly reptilian and partly feline. Their outward appearance betrays their monstrosity in nothing (but not to the eye of cats). So in sleepy little Travis, Indiana, no one at first suspects that they are responsible for so many murders. But luckily there are cats.
notes: Cats, for once in a good version, will save the world. This is the moral of Garris' film ("The Fly 2"). It is the first screenplay written by Stephen King expressly for the cinema but, apart from a few moments, it is not entirely successful.

title: Uncivilized
actors: Sandra Hess, Martin Kove, Richard Alan Hench, Kent MacLachlan
description: Kate and Neil are quietly camping in an isolated area. As fate would have it, a gang of drug traffickers went to take refuge right there, immediately after killing a policeman. Kate manages to escape, while Neil leaves his feathers there. Kate is increasingly exhausted and her end would be near if Richard didn't come to her aid. Neil looks safe, too bad Richard is the leader of the gang. For the woman hours of anguish are looming, but her spirit is not tamed: she manages to escape from her persecutors and lure them into a police trap. A low-profile film with low commercial probability, so much so that we only come out on television.
notes: The only face that could come to your mind is that of Martin Kove. He was in _Rambo 2_ and was a bad guy in a couple of _Karate Kid_.

title: The Burning Hills
actors: Natalie Wood, Tab Hunter, Skip Homeier, Eduard Franz
description: When Trace discovers the lifeless body of his brother Johnny, he immediately senses that the responsibility for the murder lies with the men of Joe Sutton, a great cattleman. Trace meets Sutton and warns him that he will go to Fort Stockwell to report what happened and what he suspects. The breeder tries to kill him, but Trace, faster than him, hits him in the chest and runs away. The manhunt by Sutton's men begins.
notes: Only Natalie Wood can push you to see this film lacking in subject and script. In short, the usual shootings and the usual horse chases.

title: Young Man with a Horn
actors: Kirk Douglas, Lauren Bacall, Doris Day, Juano Hernandez
description: Rick Martin, orphaned at an early age, is placed in the care of one of his sisters; that instead of taking care of him, she neglects him. From the earliest years Rick has shown a considerable interest in music. One day he meets Artie, an excellent trumpet player, who reveals the secrets of that instrument to him. He did his first studies with him, but his jazz talent is so great that Rick can improvise any musical theme. Rick begins his career and also knows love, but soon realizes that happiness is not always within reach.
notes: The fictional story of Bix Beiderbecke, to whom Pupi Avati will dedicate "Bix". The interpreters and the dark tone of Curtiz's direction are notable.

title: La vendetta è il mio perdono
actors: Tab Hunter, Erika Blanc, Piero Lulli
description: Durango is a former law man who has thrown the toga to nettles because in the West the only jurisprudence that matters is that of the guns. A bad day his girlfriend is brutally killed by a group of bandits. Ugly day for the criminals because Durango, determined to make himself justice by himself, launches himself on their tracks.
notes: Western spaghetti among the tastiest. Very little distributed and known, and it is clear why.

title: A Guide for the Married Man
actors: Walter Matthau, Robert Morse, Inger Stevens, Terry-Thomas, Jayne Mansfield
description: A middle-aged man, Paul Manning, although in love with his wife Ruth, lets himself be convinced by his friend Edward and decides to betray her. After having invented various excuses and having found both the nightclub and the motel suitable for the purpose, the "adultery operation" is triggered. Paul turns his attention to a married woman, Joselyn Montgomery, but his love for Ruth convinces him to desist from his plans.
notes: Good bittersweet sixties comedy directed by Gene Kelly. Walter Matthau is priceless as always. Also in this case his proverbial cynicism is not denied and fun is guaranteed.

title: Who's Minding the Store?
actors: Jerry Lewis, Jill St. John, Ray Walston, Agnes Moorehead
description: A young man who earns his living by walking dogs does not know that his girlfriend is a rich heiress, whose mother boycott the relationship in every way by making him entrust the most absurd tasks.

title: Kidnapped
actors: James McArthur, Peter Finch, Bernard Lee
description: A boy who is about to inherit the family fortune is kidnapped by his evil uncle on a ship. He will be able to save himself thanks to the help of an outlaw. The film is a Disney-like reduction - without infamy and without praise - of the classic bestseller for children by Robert Louis Stevenson, the great nineteenth-century novelist casually named after the director of the film.

title: Riso amaro
actors: Silvana Mangano, Vittorio Gassman, Raf Vallone, Checco Rissone, Doris Dowling, Nico Pepe, Adriana Sivieri, Lia Corelli, Maria Grazia Francia, Dedi Ristori, Mariemma Bardi, Maria Capuzzo
description: Francesca is a hotel maid and not a thief. At the instigation of her boyfriend, Walter, however, she steals a necklace and runs away. On the train he mixes with the mondine and in the evening one of these, Silvana (Silvana Mangano), steals it from him. At that point Walter arrives who immediately understands how things will end and seduces Silvana. But all this is not important because ...
notes: In post-World War II rural Italy, a seduction drama that made history and broke the box office. Never were the performers so well placed in the part. La Mangano in black stockings in the water of the rice fields is the Italian equivalent of the Marilyn with her skirt up on the grate of the subway.

title: Lola
actors: Anouk Aimée, Marc Michel, Jacques Harden, Alan Scott, Élina Labourdette, Annie Duperoux, Margo Lion, Catherine Lutz
description: Lola, night singer in Nantes, single mother, was with a man, Michel, lost who knows where and now he is with another, Roland, who would like to marry her. It is the story of people who never meet, touch each other and always miss a little, a musical without musical numbers (for budget problems) poignant and never affected.

title: Deception
actors: Bette Davis, Claude Rains, Paul Henreid
description: A cellist and a pianist get married in New York. But married life is disturbed by the arrival of a composer, her old flame. When he threatens to reveal his past relations with the woman, Christina, exasperated, makes an extreme gesture.
notes: American melodrama of the forties in strong colors, which makes its good figure among the "women films" of the decade thanks to the interpretation of Bette Davis.

title: Belle de jour
actors: Catherine Deneuve, Jean Sorel, Michel Piccoli, Geneviève Page
description: A surgeon's wife indulges in her sadomasochistic inclinations. Thus began a double life: love for her husband at night; frequenting a dating house during the day.

title: The Magnificent Seven
actors: Yul Brynner, Eli Wallach, Charles Bronson, Steve McQueen, James Coburn, Robert Vaughn, Brad Dexter, Horst Buchholz, Rosenda Monteros, Rico Alaniz, Pepe Hern
description: The peasants of a Mexican village, desperate for the abuse of a gang of outlaws, ask for help from Chris, a Texan gunslinger, who agrees to defend them. He arrives in the village after having gathered a group made up of six other companions, equally skilled and courageous. They arrive just in time, when the bandits are about to storm the village. The first battle is resolved in favor of the defenders, who are defeated in the second battle: captured by the bandits, they are forced to leave. The humiliation burns and the seven are not there. They decide to retrace their steps and embark on a definitive confrontation. Fun and engaging remake of Kurosawa's "Seven Samurai", launched McQueen, Bronson and Coburn and above all the hit by Elmer Bernstein. Directed with an impeccable hand by John Surges, although it is perhaps not his best western.

title: Live and Let Die
actors: Roger Moore, Yaphet Kotto, Jane Seymour, Clifton James
description: News arrives that three of Her Majesty's agents have been killed overseas. The same day, James Bond is sent on a mission to investigate. Bond moves to Sainte Monique, a small island in the Caribbean Sea, where Dr. Kananga, aka Mister Big, has set up the powerhouse of a huge drug trafficking with which to subjugate the white population of the United States. Needless to say, agent 007 falls in love with the beautiful Solitaire, a seer in the pay of the evil Kananga, who will help him.
notes: Eighth film in the James Bond series and debut for Roger Mooore third protagonist (after Sean Connery and George Lazenby). Compared to the previous episodes, this one is less lively and fun, despite the attempts to season the Caribbean adventure with self-irony: strangely absent are the gimmicks and futuristic contraptions. A lack that affects the result.

title: Ercole al centro della Terra
actors: Reg Park, Christopher Lee, Leonora Ruffo, Marisa Belli
description: Hercules must reach the center of the Earth to find the living stone needed to save his fiancée Deianira, a prisoner of the tyrant Licos, from madness. The enterprise is far from easy even for the son of Zeus; dangers and traps dot his path and terrifying monsters try to stop him from his mission. The hero's strength is, however, equal to his cunning. Scripted by Bava, Sandro Continenza, Franco Prosperi and Duccio Tessari, the film represents a real foray into mythology for our master of horror cinema (but even here there is more than a hint in that direction). The character of Hercules is played by Reg Park, former Leeds footballer, then bodybuilder, three-time winner of the Mister Universe title as well as editor of industry magazines and owner of gyms.

title: Good News
actors: June Allyson, Peter Lawford, Patricia Marshall
description: The squabbles between the students come together as the college team has to win a big football game. Color version and with a lot of rhythm (the screenplay is by the specialists Comden and Green) of musicals from the 1920s, already brought to the cinema in 1930. Passed only on TV.

title: The Champ
actors: Wallace Beery, Jackie Cooper, Irene Rich, Roscoe Ates, Edward Brophy
description: A disarmed boxing champion and his little son, who adores him, are separated against their will. Here is a film, a great commercial success of the time, a pathetic melodrama masterfully directed by the great Vidor. Oscar to the "boxer" Wallace Beery and to the screenplay by Frances Marion. Remade twice, in '53 ("The Clown") by Robert Z. Leonard and in '79 by Zeffirelli.

title: Enter the Dragon/Long zheng hu dou
actors: Bruce Lee, John Saxon, Shih Kien, Jim Kelly, Ahna Capri, Robert Wall
description: Martial arts expert agent of the British, Bruce Lee is tasked with investigating a dangerous opium smuggler. The agent must then infiltrate the enemy's headquarters by penetrating the island off Hong Kong, where he reigns as an absolute despot. It is the first American action film based on kung fu, and in producing it, Hollywood preferred not to take risks. So the best interpreter of the genre was "hired" and the writers were blatantly inspired by James Bond films. The result is highly effective.

title: The 7th Dawn
actors: William Holden, Tetsuro Tamba, Capucine, Susannah York
description: In Malaysia, in 1952, some former comrades in the anti-Japanese partisan struggle, of different nationalities, found themselves together again. However, the years have not passed in vain and everyone has gained political or existential experiences that now oppose him or bind him to others differently from what happened during the occupation. The country is also on the verge of civil war, so much so that the differences between the characters lead in some cases into open struggle.
notes: Political-racial-sentimental meatloaf as naïve and obvious in the dramatic lines as it is unnecessarily complicated in the plot.

title: Free and Easy
actors: Buster Keaton, Anita Page, Robert Montgomery
description: A bungling impresario, Buster Keaton takes a beauty queen to Hollywood. At the dawn of sound, Keaton is still very popular, but close to waning.

title: A Girl Named Tamiko
actors: Laurence Harvey, France Nuyen, Martha Hyer, Michael Wilding
description: A Tokyo photographer cynically makes an American fall in love to fulfill the dream of moving to the United States. You yawn over and over.

title: The Young Adventurer
actors: Robert Shaw, Anne Bancroft, Simon Ward, Anthony Hopkins
description: The first part of Winston Churchill's life, from being neglected by his parents to not being a brilliant student to becoming a deputy. Spectacular smooth and rhetorical, taken from the memoirs of the British statesman. Curiously, Attenborough will make an equally hagiographic film about Gandhi, an enemy of English imperialism and Churchill.

title: The People under the Stairs
actors: A.J. Langer, Brandon Adams, Everett McGill, Wendy Robie
description: Penetrating into the home of an unsuspectedly wealthy couple, a thirteen-year-old thief discovers that they are keeping kidnapped boys locked up and tortured in the cellar. A good supense horror film, which also suggests a sketch of social criticism, from the director of the first "Nightmare".

title: Needful Things
actors: Max Von Sydow, Ed Harris, Bonnie Bedelia, Amanda Plummer
description: In Castle Rock, the kind and helpful owner of the antique shop “Cose precious” attracts everyone's sympathy. More than money, he asks his customers for "favors"; in reality it exploits the weaknesses and secret desires of the inhabitants to subjugate people to its evil plots. Only the sheriff tries to oppose his terrible powers.
notes: From a novel by Stephen King, the undisputed master of the nightmare. The story itself is beautiful, some twists are worth the vision, Max von Sydow is a splendid Satanassus. But the direction, for a horror, is too flat.

title: The Getaway
actors: Kim Basinger, Alec Baldwin, Michael Madsen, James Woods
description: Released from prison thanks to the interest of Jack Benyon, Doc McCoy participates in a robbery to repay his debt, promising his wife Carol that he will be the last. The shot succeeds, but a guard is killed. Doc, who has the loot left, runs away with Carol (of whom he learned that, to save him, she gave herself to Jack) to Mexico, hunted by her accomplices. Home reconciliation and happy ending. Same title and same subject as Sam Peckinpah's 1972 film. A remake, then, but also a trivialization, with a lot more sex, but a lot less "nastiness". A low-market operation, in spite of the previous one.

title: Body Parts
actors: Jeff Fahey, Lindsay Duncan, Kim Delaney, Brad Dourif
description: Bill Crushank is a criminologist who loses an arm in an accident and is seen attacking someone else's arm in return by Dr. Alice Webb, a pioneering surgeon in the field. The arm comes from the corpse of a serial killer and that doesn't bother Bill at the moment. Then the arm starts doing things that Bill can't control. Don't be misled: this is not a butchery movie. It is the second film (the first being "The Streets of Fear") by Eric Red, the screenwriter of "The Hitcher", "Near Dark" and, above all, "Blue Steel". In a minor role there is also Brad Dourif.

title: Money for Nothing
actors: John Cusack, Debi Mazar, Michael Madsen, Benicio Del Toro
description: Joey Coyle is twenty-six and has little faith in the future. Then, one day, he picks up a bag that has fallen from a car and realizes that, with one million and two hundred thousand dollars, life seems very different. Too bad it's dirty money. It's too bad there's a cop (Madsen) on the trail of that money. Joey tries for a while, but he also knows that he will never be able to enjoy them. The ending is obligatory and this does not fuel the suspense much. Apart from an understanding and very human Madsen, even the actors don't seem to believe much. This is strange if you think that in "Le iene" is the one who cuts ears to the rhythm of rock.

title: Gunmen
actors: Christopher Lambert, Mario Van Peebles, Denis Leary, Patrick Stewart
description: Cole Parker is a New York agent for DEA, the federal drug agency. He is sent to a South American country to confiscate the illicit earnings of a drug dealer: the very one who, some time before, had killed his father. The operation, however, turns out to be more complicated than expected and Parker is forced to enlist the help of a convict, Dani Servigo. But the two are followed by a ruthless killer hired by traffickers. Dirty action movie with sloppiness, with chases, endless shootings, unlikely characters.

title: L'enfer
actors: François Cluzet, Emmanuelle Béart, Marc Lavoine, Nathalie Cardone
description: Paul has finally managed to own a nice hotel and is now working at an exhausting pace to keep it going. But stress plays a bad joke on him: he gets it into his head that his wife is cheating on him with a garage owner. Paul's obsession worsens day by day, the man resorts to alcohol and sleeping pills. A doctor visits him and promises that the next day he will have him hospitalized ... Claude Chabrol achieved his most flattering results when he faced the nests of vipers hidden under an apparent flat calm. Here he creates a beautiful and terrible, elegant and anguished film, where the love-jealousy relationship is scary.

title: I fratelli Castiglioni
actors: Camillo Pilotto, Ugo Ceseri, Amedeo Nazzari, Luisa Ferida
description: In search of the winning lottery ticket, the heirs of a landowner go to the grave of the deceased to find it. But nothing is found, and the deadline for the collection of the premium is approaching inexorably.

title: Jolanda, la figlia del Corsaro Nero
actors: May Britt, Marc Lawrence, Renato Salvatori, Barbara Florian
description: Now an adult, Jolanda discovers that she is not the daughter of the gypsy who raised her, but of the Count of Ventimiglia, the Black Corsair, killed by Van Guld, current governor of Maracaibo. With the help of some former companions of her father, the young woman who has sworn to avenge her parent succeeds in her intent after multiple adventures. Vanquish the wicked, find a boyfriend and recover the father's treasure. Mario Soldati puts in images the novel of the same name by Emilio Salgari. Without particular pretensions, the film is, however, quite compelling and ironic.

title: L'uomo dagli occhi di ghiaccio
actors: Antonio Sabato, Barbara Bouchet, Faith Domergue, Victor Buono
description: Eddie, a young Albuquerque reporter who works for the local newspaper "The Sentinel," has serious doubts about the Mexican sentenced to death for the murder of Mr. Roberts, a local senator and financier. Escaping various attacks, he finds a precious witness and ...
notes: Without De Martino & C. it could also have been a good thriller, although too blatantly based on the plot (and even the names) on Orson Welles' "Infernale Quinlan". A comparison between the two is however unthinkable.

title: Ciao ma'... Baci da Roma
actors: Lorenzo Flaherty, Silvia Ramenghi, Marco Leonardi, Valerio Andrei, Claudia Gerini, Marco Carsi, Sonia Cameriere
description: In the hot Rome of early summer, four stories of young people intertwine around the concert by Vasco Rossi. These are the events of two orders and two "burghers".
notes: Giandomenico Curi, music and film critic, attempts the sociological portrait of the boys who attend the concerts of the national Blasco, but is wrecked miserably.

title: Tecnica di un omicidio
actors: José-Luis De Villalonga, Robert Webber, Franco Nero, Michel Bardinet
description: Clint Harris, a killer, is tasked with killing Frank, a former gang member who disappeared after betraying. Frank had a facial plastic surgery and took on a new identity. All we know for sure is that he lives in Paris. Harris, however, is in turn in the crosshairs and, once the mission is completed ... Crimes and sales beyond credibility.

title: The Amorous Adventures of Moll Flanders
actors: Kim Novak, Vittorio De Sica, Richard Johnson, George Sanders
description: In London in the 1700s, Moll Flanders, young and beautiful, but of humble origins, gave rise to society by exploiting her attractiveness. From the novel by Daniel Defoe, and in the footsteps of Richardson's "Tom Jones", a somewhat mechanical and superficial film, but enjoyable.

title: Invitation to a Gunfighter
actors: Yul Brynner, Janice Rule, George Segal, Pat Hingle
description: Returning home after the end of the Civil War, Confederate veteran Matt Weaver discovers that all of his assets have been expropriated by order of Samuel Brewster, the domineering boss of the city. Weaver is more than ever determined to assert his rights, but Brewster decides to stop him by hiring a famous gunslinger, Jules Gaspard d'Estaing: the latter will solve the situation, but with very different methods than expected.
notes: Wilson's is a great unknown western, very ambitious and attentive to the psychological side: the cast stands out for an amazing Yul Brynner who, in the role of the mestizo and crazy killer, gives life to a character that is difficult to forget.

title: Cento giorni a Palermo
actors: Lino Ventura, Giuliana De Sio, Stefano Satta Flores, Arnoldo Foà
description: After the killings by the mafia of Inspector Giuliano, Pier Santi Mattarella and Pio La Torre, General Carlo Alberto Dalla Chiesa is appointed prefect of Palermo, without however being granted the powers that he considers indispensable to defeat the mafia, also powerful in Rome, to the point of blocking the laws that would oppose it. On September 3, 1982 Dalla Chiesa and his wife Emanuela are murdered with the escort agent. The director Giuseppe Ferrara makes a film of civil denunciation that is more noble in intent than it has succeeded in the narrative balance, too fictional, obvious and sensational.

title: Everybody 's Baby: The Rescue of Jessica Mc Clure
actors: Beau Bridges, Pat Hingle, Roxana Zal, Patty Duke
description: Jessica is an eighteen month old baby girl. His life flows quietly between games and meals, in Odessa, Texas. But one bad day the little girl accidentally falls into an old abandoned well. Jessica's life hangs in the balance, while desperate attempts to save her alternate, and the family is distraught with anguish.
notes: The film is inspired by a story that really happened and we immediately think of Alfredino Rampi, the child who died at the bottom of a well while the TV was trying, at all costs, to make him the protagonist of a story with a happy ending.

title: La legge della violenza
actors: George Greenwood, Igli Villani, Angel Aranda, Ugo Adinolfi
description: Jack Sparrow has been in jail for a couple of years for a crime he didn't commit and is now back in Red Rock with the intention of taking revenge. The sheriff who had arrested him ends up badly and, in his place, Jack puts the meek Chris. This is because Jack has intentions of exploitation towards the peaceful town. Eventually Chris takes courage and confronts him. Usual Italian-Hispanic co-production with actors with fake names, fake-looking scenarios and banally plagiarized stories.

title: Cul-de-sac
actors: Jack Mac Gowran, Donald Pleasence, Françoise Dorléac, Lionel Stander
description: Georges (Pleasance) divorced his wife, sold the factory and moved to a castle in Ireland with his new, young and not entirely faithful wife, Teresa. Suddenly, two runaway gangsters arrive: Richard (Stander) and Albert (Mac Gowran). Albert dies immediately, but the other becomes a cumbersome presence to the point that Georges will have to kill him. When this film went on to win an award at the Berlin Film Festival in 1966 Polanski was not yet Polanski. His ability to mix reality with nonsense, to mix evil and perversions, was not yet known. So a nice surprise. Great bad play, written with Gerard Brach, set to music by Krystzof Koumeda and starring a superlative cast. Dorléac, who died very young, was Catherine Deneuve's sister.

title: The In Crowd
actors: Donovan Leitch, Joe Pantoliano, Jennifer Runyon, Bruce Kirby
description: A TV dance show, run by Perry Parker, is at the center of the hopes of all the kids in 1960s Philadelphia. Dukan, the star of the show, gets caught by the traffic police one day and his career freezes for a while. He is replaced by Del (Leitch) who, paired with Dukan's girlfriend, falls madly in love with her. Then Dukan returns to freedom. The story is similar to that of John Waters' "Hairspray", even if Rosenthal lacks the necessary nastiness and just composes the usual period picture. The protagonist Donovan Leitch is the son of the famous singer Donovan.

title: Le tatoué
actors: Jean Gabin, Louis De Funès, Paul Marcey, Yves Barsacq
description: Count Jean-Louis de Montignac, a former colonel of the foreign legion, has a Modigliani tattooed on his back. An antique dealer would like to take possession of it, indeed he has already sold the count's skin before he even took possession of it. In exchange, however, de Montignac wants the merchant to restore his house in the countryside, which is actually a huge ruined castle.
notes: Here the greats of French cinema are at least two. The first is Gabin, the tough-skinned count. The other is de Funès, the antique dealer all grimaces and outbursts of anger. Too bad the film doesn't go along with them.

title: The Thrill of It All
actors: Doris Day, James Garner, Arlene Francis, Edward Andrews
description: Beverly, wife of a well-known gynecologist, can't resist a rich offer because she plays advertising skits on TV. But the husband does not like it and is committed to the full-time reconquest of his wife. When cinema could still afford to exercise its irony on television.

title: Il conte Max
actors: Alberto Sordi, Vittorio De Sica, Anne Vernon, Susana Canales, Tina Pica
description: Alberto, who has a kiosk in via Veneto, has a hidden desire to be part of that high society with which he has to deal every day, but from which he is fatally excluded. To realize his dream, an extravagant client comes to his aid, the fallen count Max Orsini Baraldo: thanks to his precious advice, Alberto manages to have a relationship with a baroness. But then he realizes that that world was not made for him ...
notes: Brilliant comedy, conducted with rhythm and vivacity of ideas. It is the first remake of Il Signor Max, shot in 1937 by Camerini and starring Vittorio De Sica. His son will do the second makeover in 1991.

title: Badge 373
actors: Robert Duvall, Verna Bloom, Henry Darrow
description: Kicked out by the NYPD, Lieutenant Ryan is reduced to being a waiter. The murder of a colleague, however, prompts him to return to action.
notes: In the vein inaugurated by "The violent arm of the law", a dry action film directed by an old specialist of the B series and played by a Robert Duvall in his golden years.

title: Boomerang
actors: Eddie Murphy, Robin Givens, Halle Berry, David Alan Grier
description: Marcus Graham, deputy director for an advertising agency, is a ruthless playboy. The company merges with a large cosmetics company and Marcus finds himself in the middle between a charming marketing director, a pretty painter and a star who is as sexy as she is foul-mouthed. Between career aspirations, erotic encounters of the fourth kind, embarrassing dinners, falling in love and complications, Marcus eventually marries.
notes: A self-styled comedy that completely lacks humor: unless you want to reduce it to the laugh-cliché of its protagonist. Beautiful women are displayed on the plate like the other status symbols of the beautiful Californian world: a necessity.

title: Hawaii
actors: Julie Andrews, Max Von Sydow, Richard Harris, Gene Hackman
description: Keoki, a Hawaiian prince raised by the Calvinists, gets missionaries sent to the islands. Reverend Abner Hale, stopped in his village, encounters various obstacles, both in traditional customs and in the brutal reactions of the sailors who see him as an enemy of the easy morals of local girls. He will eventually be removed from office, but his mission may not end. The setting is suggestive, the cast is five-star, the screenplay is signed by Dalton Trumbo; on the whole, however, this exotic-religious blockbuster does not take off.

title: How To Murder Your Wife
actors: Virna Lisi, Jack Lemmon, Eddie Mayehoff, Terry-Thomas
description: Stanley Ford, successful comic book author, in the throes of alcohol, marries a Greek girl, aspiring miss world; from that moment on, he began to engineer the perfect crime, through the stories of his characters. Frightened, the wife runs away; he is accused of murder. At the trial he proves his innocence, but he also realizes that he is really in love; she comes back, this time with her mom. George Axelrod was also the screenwriter of "When the wife is on vacation", but there the director was Billy Wilder ... Virna Lisi's American debut. Question: why are you Italian in all versions and in the Italian version, instead, you become Greek?

title: Das Boot
actors: Jürgen Prochnow, Herbert Grönemeyer, Klaus Wennemann, Hubertus Bengsch, Martin Semmelrogge, Bernd Tauber, Claude-Oliver Rudolph, Heinz Hoenig, Jan Fedder, Rita Cadillac, Oliver Stritzel, Günter Lamprecht, Uwe Ochsenknecht, Erwin Leder
description: In autumn 1941 a German submarine leaves the port of La Rochelle on a mission to attack and sink convoys from the United States with aid destined for the British. After suffering two attacks, he manages to return to La Rochelle, but an air attack causes the definitive sinking and the death of almost all the crew. At the origin of the film, which tells a story that really took place during the Second World War, there is the book written by a journalist, L. G. Bucheim, who was among the few survivors of the fatal bombing. The submarine is the real "protagonist" of the accurate reconstruction made by Petersen; the film was shot in two full-size submarines, with the effect of claustrophobic realism. It is also one of the few films that gave us the German fighters' point of view on the Nazi war.

title: Child of Darkness, Child of Light
actors: Paxton Whitehead, Anthony Denison, Sela Ward, Brad Davis, Sydney Penny
description: From the Vatican Father Rossetti is sent on a mission to the USA: he will have to investigate the case of two pregnant virgins. Apparently, one of the two will give birth to the new Savior, the other the Antichrist. For Father Rossetti the experience ends dramatically: he returns, in fact, mad and is replaced by the young father Justin, who will thus try to face the beginning of the Apocalypse - yet another variation on a worn-out theme. Subject and script are in serious danger of sinking her into ridicule at every step.

title: In Harm's Way
actors: John Wayne, Kirk Douglas, Patricia Neal, Tom Tryon, Paula Prentiss
description: In the aftermath of the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor, American troops try to fight back and fight back. Ambitious war drama in which Preminger skillfully blends personal dramas against the backdrop of the collective one of the Great War. Just before Aldrich's "dozen", an uncertain fresco between traditional warfare and more "dirty" cinema. Among so many names, Barbara Bouchet also makes her debut!

title: Justin Case
actors: Molly Hagan, George Carlin, Timothy Stack, Kevin McClarnon, Douglas Sills
description: A girl presents herself for a secretary place but discovers a corpse ... and her ghost that I help the help to find her killer. Blake Edwards TV movies, on a rather abused Sroria, but pleasantly poised between yellow, fantastic and comedy.

title: You Ruined My Life
actors: Soleil Moon Frye, Paul Reiser, Mimi Rogers
description: A young girl, Minerva, raised by an uncle who owns a luxury hotel in Las Vegas, who hasn't paid much attention to her upbringing, will have to learn good manners to enter society. Disney family comedy.

title: The Island at the Top of the World
actors: David Hartman, Donald Sinden, Jacques Marin, Mako, Agneta Eckemyr
description: At the beginning of the century, an expedition led by Sir Anthony Ross and Professor Ivarsson, an expert in geology and primitive cultures, left for Greenland in search of Ross's son who disappeared there. They are accompanied by Captain Brieux, inventor and builder of the Hyperion, a newly designed airship. The group reaches a strip of land which, despite being surrounded by ice, maintains a mild climate due to the presence of volcanic phenomena. The three must clash with the locals who are descendants of the ancient Vikings.
notes: Good movie of adventures to the limit of the imagination, typical of the Disney home cinema.

title: The Bridges at Toko-Ri
actors: William Holden, Mickey Rooney, Fredric March, Grace Kelly
description: Just before leaving for a risky mission to Korea, Air Force Lieutenant Brubaker (Holden) gets the chance to see his wife and children in Tokyo again. Then he leaves to go and bomb the Toko-Ri bridges with sad forebodings. The operation succeeds, but he is shot down. His friend Mike Forney (Rooney) also ends badly trying to rescue him. The aerial and naval sequences are especially good (a little aged, but not too much) and the script is solid. The rest ensures a great cast with Holden, Rooney, an anxious and tortured Fredric March and with a (too short) appearance of Grace Kelly.

title: The Magnificent Amberson
actors: Tim Holt, Joseph Cotten, Dolores Costello, Anne Baxter
description: Widow Amberson would like to remarry an old lover. The proud and selfish son prevents her, causing her to die of pain. Only then does the young man understand his mistake. A family saga of great ambitions, from a novel by Booth Tarkington. The second direction of Welles, a masterpiece that is difficult to talk about without using superlatives, even if it was disowned by the author himself (who here cuts the part of the narrator) due to the brutal cuts (more than 40 minutes) made by the producers.

title: The Thomas Crown Affair
actors: Steve McQueen, Faye Dunaway, Yaphet Kotto, Paul Burke
description: An unscrupulous banker made the heist in his own bank. A beautiful detective finds out. A sympathy arises between the two that soon turns into love, but she still wants to denounce it. So he, to convince her to flee together to Brazil, announces the place of his next shot. He then gives her an appointment at the place where the stolen goods will be taken.
notes: Sophisticated thriller for Norman Jewison who moves within genre cinema with a desire for renewal that leaves its mark. The fascinating protagonists are Steve McQueen and Faye Dunaway.

title: The Cat from Outer Space
actors: Ken Berry, Roddy McDowall, Sandy Duncan, Harry Morgan
description: An extraterrestrial cat descends to earth due to a damage to its spacecraft. Thanks to his telepathic abilities he manages to convince a NASA scientist to help him with repairs. Nice comedy from Disney.

title: The Longhorns
actors: Wild Bill Elliott, Myron Healey, Phyllis Coates, Stanford Jolley
description: Jim Kirk decides to leave with his friend Andy, to go and buy a herd. The two plan to travel to Oregon from their native Wyoming. But Andy agrees with a dangerous band of outlaws who are determined to take over the cattle. On the way out, Jim saves Andy's life during an Indian ambush. Upon returning, therefore, Andy no longer betrays his friend. Western series B for encyclopedic enthusiasts.

title: The Graduate
actors: Anne Bancroft, Dustin Hoffman, Katharine Ross, William Daniels
description: Benjamin Braddock, a promising scion of a wealthy family, has finished his studies (but the "graduate" is something less than our graduate). A party is given in his honor, but he retires to his room. He is joined by Mrs. Robinson, a friend of the family, who asks him to accompany her home: here she tries to seduce him, but her husband arrives. Later, however, Benjamin and Mrs Robinson become lovers. The relationship ends when Benjamin meets Elaine, the daughter of the Robinsons: the two fall in love, but Elaine's mother doesn't like it and reveals to her how things are. The girl leaves Benjamin and prepares to marry the good boy her parents want for her. But Benjamin tries it all out in the church during the ceremony.
notes: The undisputed manifesto of the youthful malaise of a generation intent on rejecting the convenience of bourgeois values ??and compromises. It was also the springboard for semi-newcomer Dustin Hoffman (his real debut film had been, a few months earlier, "A Dollar for 7 Cowards", Giorgio Gentili's spaghetti western). The soundtrack with the songs of Simon and Garfunkel is mythical.

title: Il Tigre
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Ann-Margret, Eleanor Parker, Fiorenzo Fiorentini
description: Francesco Vincenzini (Gassman) at forty-five is a successful man. He runs a company, has a faithful wife, two rather modern children, and even has a little girl who would be crazy for him. It's the latter that gets him into trouble. Carolina insists, he is not insensitive, the paranoia of old age are strong and the omelette is done. All this will change the life of engineer Vincenzini.
notes: Those were the times when Risi roared and Gassman "mattatoria". It is not even the best film of the duo, but it has a charge, especially compared to that of the children's films, which was already half enough. Ann-Margret lets herself be watched.

title: Porca vacca
actors: Laura Antonelli, Renato Pozzetto, Aldo Maccione, Raymond Bussières
description: Thrown at the front during the Great War, despite all the stratagems attempted to be reformed, the dance singer Barbasini (Pozzetto) concentrates on responding in kind to the cheating of two peasants, Tomo Secondo and Marianna, experts in the precious art of getting by. But the girl is a tough nut to crack and it will take all the rawness of war to scratch her. This is the story, but the film is tailor-made for Pozzetto. Free-range comedy, sketches and some mischievous accents in the face of an evident sloppiness in the realization.

title: The Naked Maya
actors: Ava Gardner, Anthony Franciosa, Lea Padovani, Gino Cervi
description: The tormented love between the famous painter Francisco Goya and the Duchess of Alba (Gardner) is born in a tavern where he defends the noblewoman. It continues when she is sent into exile and he is a court painter. And it does not end even when she, for fear of ruining it in the eyes of the king, decides to end the relationship. It is really difficult to get a film wrong if you have an exciting subject at your disposal, the masterful photography of Giuseppe Rotunno and a leading actress like Ava Gardner. Henry Koster succeeds and above all he manages to be boring.

title: Le battant
actors: Alain Delon, François Périer, Pierre Mondy, Anne Parillaud, Marie-Christine Descouard, Andréa Ferréol, Michel Beaune
description: Jacques Dernay is one of the old guard. He recently got out of jail and, in the midst of the new gangsters of the technological age, we never meet again. Among other things, the new gangsters use their relentless methods even towards Jacques' friends. The problem is that everyone would like to know where are the diamonds for which Jacques went to prison and which have not yet been found. Alain Delon, in 1982, was 47 years old, a slew of films behind him as an actor and only one test as a director. This is his second film and it doesn't add much to his reputation as a tough guy. Least of all to his fame as a director.

title: Knightrider 2000
actors: David Hasselhoff, Edward Mulhare
description: The Knightrider foundation is concerned with defense and security, but is also in the process of developing a revolutionary car. Meanwhile in the city, following the murder of the mayor, criminals are increasingly using weapons that were previously in the possession of the police and which are now officially illegal. A policewoman goes to work, together with Michael from Knightrider, to see clearly ... Semi-sci-fi action detective. The male lead, David Hasselhoff, previously blinked from comedy to adventure to drama, amassing an enviable string of trash movies. What does something mean?

title: Return of the Seven
actors: Yul Brynner, Fernando Rey, Emilio Fernández, Virgilio Teixeira
description: We are in Mexico where a certain Francisco Lorca kidnapped the men of three villages, to rebuild a church that was destroyed, in which his children died years ago. Upon hearing of the fact, Chris gathers a group of six gunfighters around him and forces Lorca to release her hostages. The film is rather flat: a decidedly subdued debut for scriptwriter, future horror cult director Larry Cohen. Burt Kennedy confirms his anonymous streak as a director, in contrast to his good performances as a screenwriter in Budd Boetticher's films.

title: Die Sieger
actors: Herbert Knaup, Hans Czypionka, Heinz Hoenik
description: In Düsseldorf, a Special Squad agent kills his son born with severe brain malformations. Then he takes his own life (at least so it seems). Four years pass. The police intercept three criminals in action; two of them are arrested, while the third manages to escape. Commander Karl Simon thinks he has visions: the fugitive seems to him his old companion, who committed suicide a few years earlier. But no one shows to believe him: what mystery hides behind this "reappearance"? Is the solution perhaps in the kidnapping of the Secretary of State who uncovered a political scandal?
notes: A German thriller not without ambitions. Director Dominik Graf is no stranger to international attention, having already won an award at the 1990 Venice Film Festival for his previous film, "Spieler".

title: Breakheart Pass
actors: Charles Bronson, Ben Johnson, Jill Ireland
description: The train on which Governor Fairchild, Sheriff Pearce, Reverend Peabody, Dr. Molineaux and a platoon of soldiers commanded by Major Clairmond travel - destined for Fort Humboldt, an important center for the sorting of precious metals extracted in the nearby mines - undergoes a series of mysterious attacks. A fake cheater solves the mystery, in reality a secret agent of the government in charge of foiling an arms trafficking ...
notes: Solid cast in the service of a perky Bronson, great photography, snappy and exciting action sequences. Nothing memorable, okay, but Gries staged with a sure hand, unpretentious and therefore very effectively.

title: Judith
actors: Sophia Loren, Peter Finch, Jack Hawkins, Hans Verner, Zharira Charifai
description: The commander of an Israeli kibbutz is looking for a former Nazi general suspected of complicity with neighboring Arab states. The former wife of the general, Jewish and returning from Dachau, helps him.

title: Vibes
actors: Cyndi Lauper, Jeff Goldblum, Peter Falk, Michael Lerner
description: Harry Buscafusco's son has mysteriously disappeared in the mountains of Ecuador. To find him, Harry hires two psychics: Nick and Sylvia. The trio sets off for South America, but it quickly becomes clear that Buscafusco has no children, much less dispersed. His only hope is to get his hands on a fabulous Indian treasure ...
notes: Lowell Ganz and Babaloo Mandel are two highly respected comedy writers (including _Scappo dalla città_). Cyndi Lauper, in her first starring role, is the lead singer of _Girls Just Want to Have Fun_. Here, however, hardly anyone has fun. Also wasted the big names of the cast, from Jeff Goldblum to Peter Falk.

title: Face of a Fugitive
actors: Fred MacMurray, Lin McCarthy, Alan Baxter, James Coburn
description: Unjustly accused of murder (in reality he just committed a theft), Bill Parker builds his life in a border town. Interesting western atmosphere with melodramatic veins.

title: Le spie amano i fiori
actors: Roger Browne, Emma Danieli, Dan Vargas, Marino Masé
description: Martin Stevens, her British Majesty's secret agent, has completed a difficult assignment. In just forty-eight hours he recovered the gamma electro-meter, a newly developed electronic device, which had been stolen in London. But the mission is not yet complete, Martin must in fact eliminate three individuals who took part in the theft. Not infamous Italian spy, directed by a young Lenzi.

title: Il conte Dracula
actors: Christopher Lee, Klaus Kinski, Herbert Lom, Soledad Miranda, Maria Rohm, Fred Williams, Paul Müller, Jack Taylor
description: Count Dracula instructs the lawyer Jonathan to buy a house for him. Having taken possession of the house, the count keeps the young lawyer with him, then makes him his victim.
notes: Fairly faithful adaptation of Stocker's novel with Christopher Lee, one of the most well-known Draculas in the genre, by a specialist in low-cost films. Here, however, not even Lee manages to lift the shack from a level of dull mediocrity.

title: Windsurf
actors: Pierre Cosso, Lara Naszinski, Philippe Leroy, Paola Onofri, Guido Mannari
description: Pierre, a young son of divorcees, comes from Australia to Circeo, where his uncle Lupo lives. The boy proves to be very attached to this relative of his, also because he is the owner of the "Aloha", a beautiful boat, used for excursions in the surroundings by the customers of the Sporting Club. Unfortunately Lupo nurtures a visceral passion for the game table and loses the boat during a game of poker. How to "redeem it"? Pierre devises a plan ...
notes: Pierre Cosso a few years ago had become famous in Italy for having interpreted "Il tempo delle mele 2". Traces of him have been lost. In this film there are beautiful women, beautiful beaches, some amorous fights and no. There is no cinema.

title: A Little Romance - I Love You, je t'aime
actors: Laurence Olivier, Arthur Hill, Sally Kellerman, Diane Lane
description: Two thirteen-year-olds try a romantic getaway from Paris to Venice, a nice old swindler helps them. Laurence Olivier imposes himself, who plays a bit, but is always a top class actor.

title: Roberta
actors: Fred Astaire, Ginger Rogers, Irene Dunne, Randolph Scott
description: Sentimental and professional vicissitudes of a penniless American musician in Paris. Interesting musical: among the songs, the famous "Smoke Gets In Your Eyes", sung by Irene Dunne (who is practically the protagonist of the main plot, together with Randolph Scott who is the fashion designer!). The plot is non-existent, but some numbers of the Astaire / Rogers duo are irresistible.

title: Il testimone deve tacere
actors: Bekim Fehmiu, Rosanna Schiaffino, Aldo Giuffré, Luigi Pistilli, Guido Leontini
description: A big speculator silences a possible dangerous witness with an incredible series of intimidations (they rape his wife in front of his eyes). The film oscillates between the policeman and the drama, with a thousand effects.

title: Un fiocco nero per Deborah
actors: Bradford Dillman, Marina Malfatti, Gig Young, Delia Boccardo
description: Young Deborah (who is unable to have children) is endowed with powers that allow her to predict the future. When she announces her pregnancy to her husband, he thinks she is crazy, like the doctors who diagnose her with a hysterical pregnancy. Nothing could be more false: Deborah is in fact expecting a child that she will give birth to after a car accident that will cost her her life. The little one then ...

title: A Dangerous Woman
actors: Debra Winger, Barbara Hershey, Gabriel Byrne, David Strathairn
description: Martha is an awkward thirty-year-old with a big flaw: she can't help but tell the truth. At first he works at a laundry, and gets kicked out when he accuses his boss of scamming customers. Then, having gone to live with a very rich aunt, she will have an affair with an idler, she will kill the head of the swindler laundry, she will become a mother.
notes: A "strong" role for Debra Winger who cleverly exploits the opportunity of the character of Martha for an acting full of grimaces and moves; but the defect lies in the story, more superficial than profound, albeit with some moments of undoubted interest.

title: Sneakers
actors: Robert Redford, Sidney Poitier, David Strathairn, River Phoenix
description: A former 1960s rebel (Redford), a paranoid named Mom (Aykroyd), a former CIA man (Poitier), a computer wunderkind (Phoenix), a blind audio expert (Straitharn), a villain (Kingsley) , a reassuring and maternal woman and the man of the Services collide in an organized "game" to get hold of an extraordinary universal decoder, which also affects the mafia.

title: Zulu
actors: Stanley Baker, Jack Hawkins, Ulla Jacobsson, Michael Caine, James Booth
description: In January 1879, Reverend Otto Witt (Hawkins) and his daughter Margareta (Jacobson) attended the wedding ceremonies of the Zulu warriors in Natal. Suddenly, the news that 1,200 Brits have been slaughtered pushes the natives to revolt against the whites. In the fort there are only one hundred and five men, while the arriving Zulus are at least four thousand. The resistance, led by Chard and Lieutenant Bromhead (Caine), is desperate. Then, just when surrender seems near, the Zulus retreat.
notes: The fact is historical and the film reconstructs it with a wealth of means. Cy Endfield directs, writes (with John Prebble) and produces (with Stanley Baker) the film. Baker gets a very serious wound in battle which then disappears by magic as the story unfolds.

title: Cuori senza frontiere
actors: Raf Vallone, Gina Lollobrigida, Cesco Baseggio, Enzo Staiola
description: After the Second World War, the commission charged with tracing the new border between Italy and Yugoslavia establishes a line that cuts a village in half. The barrier made of poles and barbed wire separates not only houses and things, but also feelings. Among others, there are also children to pay the price and one of these pays for this dramatic situation with his life.
notes: At the time of the making of the film, the problem was of intense and painful topicality. Zampa, however, succeeds better in the good-natured irony of institutions than in embodying the tension of the multiple lacerations created by this emergency. Staiola was the child of "Bicycle Thieves"; in particular Tullio Kezich and Callisto Cosulich appear.

title: Lo sbaglio di essere vivo
actors: Vittorio De Sica, Isa Miranda, Gino Cervi, Dina Galli, Giuseppe Pierozzi
description: Following an illness, a young man is presumed dead. But here, to the dismay of his wife, the consort ... resurrects. An excellent opportunity to collect life insurance and indulge in a long, sweet honeymoon, without the petty worries of the living poor. But the reserve of money is not inexhaustible, the "widow" is courted by a friend. Here are new problems. From the comedy of the same name and from the screenplay by Aldo De Benedetti, Bragaglia draws a film that is not too affected by theatrical origins and where the wit of the dialogues are the backbone. The actors are elegantly in the game.

title: They Shoot Horses, Don't They?
actors: Jane Fonda, Michael Sarrazin, Gig Young, Susannah York
description: During the Great Depression, a couple participates in a dance marathon for $ 1,500. The woman, however, after having lost all illusion, is killed by her partner. Claustrophobic and pessimistic apologue pervaded by despair, it is one of Pollack's best films and a metaphor on the American dream. Based on a novel by Horace Mc Coy. She had 6 Oscar nominations and won the one for Supporting Actress (Gig Young).

title: Quella carogna dell'ispettore Sterling
actors: Henry Silva, Beba Loncar, Charles Palmer, Paul Carey, Keenan Wynn
description: Sterling, a police inspector whose son was killed by a gang of robbers, is charged with murder. Only after a strenuous hunt for the real culprits, will he be able to prove his innocence. Action thriller chock full of totally improbable scenama shots, directed with an eye to American models but far from them.

title: Thunder Heart
actors: Val Kilmer, Sam Shepard, Graham Greene, John Trudell
description: Ray Levoi is an FBI agent, of Indian origin, charged with investigating the murder of a Sioux Oglala. Official suspicions converge on the activist Double Look, but Ray's obstinacy opens up new perspectives: the exploitation of the region's uranium vein, its lethal consequences for the population, a government plot against the activist movement are involved. Indians.
notes: Based on real events and produced by Robert De Niro, the film seeks to combine the detective genre with a political reflection on the situation of the Indians in America today. A decent product, but predictable in every sense.

title: Scanners
actors: Jennifer O'Neill, Stephen Lack, Michael Ironside, Patrick McGoohan
description: Consec, a multinational armaments company, is endangered by a mysterious organization formed by Scanners, individuals capable of killing by telepathically exploding the heads of their opponents. With double plays and twists we arrive at the final confrontation between two "champions" of this murderous technique, who discover that they are both children of the doctor who "created" the Scanners. A Cronenberg already mature although still confined to genre cinema. The discourse on the coexistence of Good and Evil in our society dominated by money goes hand in hand with the use of special effects as a narrative and never just spectacular.

title: Night Shift
actors: Henry Winkler, Michael Keaton, Shelley Long, Gina Hecht
description: Forced to make way for the boss's nephew, Chuck Lumley III (Winkler), a former financial advisor, adapts to work the night shift in the morgue. This is how he meets Belinda, a prostitute whose protector has just been killed, and above all Billy Blaze (Keaton), a wimp, full of explosive ideas. The idea of ??setting up a call company, at least initially, works. Ricky Cunningham and Fonzie, the old duo from "Happy Days", find themselves together in this pleasant, but not exceptional comedy. The starting idea is not burning, but slowly, thanks to the script by Ganz and Mandel, the story picks up a rhythm.

title: Cyborg Cop 2
actors: David Bradley, Morgan Hunter, Jill Pierce
description: Jack Ryan, a licensed cop, grapples with a psychopath named Jesse Starkraven, whose brother Jack killed the previous year. The battle ends in Jack's favor, but Jesse does not die, but is kidnapped by a para-government organization and transformed into a cyborg. Jesse thus becomes the perfect and invincible warrior, but the idea of ??revenge against Jack remains. I don't know who could have noticed, but a "Cyborg Cop 1" already existed. The main actor is always Bradley, the director is always Firstenberg, the basic idea is always poor and the end result is always the same: lots of action and little fun.

title: Reckless
actors: Aidan Quinn, Daryl Hannah, Kenneth McMillan, Cliff De Young
description: Johnny Rourke jr. lives in Ohio with his father, Johnny Senior, a metallurgist and alcoholic since his wife's death. Tracey Prescott is engaged to the iron master's son. Johnny jr. takes a while to seduce Tracey. Then Johnny Senior dies in an accident at work and the son discovers that his father wasn't that bad. So he sets the house on fire, picks up Tracey and drives off with her.
notes: Aidan Quinn's expressiveness is reminiscent of a marble slab and the whole story is all too obvious. But forget the story and look at Johnny Senior's watery eyes, look at the city and the industry. Foley is also not as bad as it sounds.

title: Il mio nome è Shanghai Joe
actors: Chen Lee, Klaus Kinski, Carla Romanelli
description: Shanghai Joe is hired by a farmer to move cattle, but in reality it is contraband. In the end, the Chinese will succeed in vanquishing the shady trade. Movies of adventures and fights, as they used to do

title: The General
actors: Buster Keaton, Marian Mack, Glen Cavender, Jim Farley
description: During the Civil War, a Southern machinist (who had been reformed) becomes a hero out of love. Magnificent example of Buster Keaton's comedy: film full of gimmicks and sustained by an overwhelming rhythm. Splendid scenes of Keaton struggling with the locomotive and with the disasters that hit the railway. It is inspired by an authentic episode.

title: Ercole contro i figli del sole
actors: Mark Forest, Giuliano Gemma, Anna Maria Panaro, Giulio Donini
description: This time Hercules is committed to righting the wrongs and punishing the evil ones in what was called the empire of the sun: the kingdom of the Peruvian Incas. Hercules arrives, rescues the daughter of the deposed king Huascar, defeats Athahualpa and puts an end to the raging struggle between the Incas. Giuliano Gemma is not Hercules, but Prince Maytha. After all, even Civirani is not a director.

title: La veuve Couderc
actors: Simone Signoret, Alain Delon, Ottavia Piccolo, Monique Chaumette, Jean Tissier, Bobby Lapointe
description: Fresh from the Cayenne, where he was imprisoned for murdering two politicians, the anarchist Jean Lavigne reaches France and finds work on the farm of the widow Couderc. The age difference does not prevent Jean from becoming the woman's lover, arousing considerable gossip in the village and a great concern of the widow's greedy brothers-in-law who report the presence of the fugitive to the police thus determining the tragic end of the story.
notes: From one of Simenon's best detective novels that do not have Maigret as protagonist, a beautiful dark drama that perfectly renders the desperate atmospheres of the Belgian writer. And then any film that has Simone Signoret in the opening credits is worth seeing.

title: The Most Dangerous Game
actors: Joel McCrea, Fay Wray, Leslie Banks
description: Count Zaroff is the owner of a remote island in the middle of the sea with a singular passion for a strange kind of game. When a ship looms on the horizon, he manages to wreck it and then sets out to hunt down the few survivors who have taken refuge on the island. Among his latest victims are a famous hunter (Joel McCrea) and a rather pretty girl (Wray). Shot on the same set, with the same cast and at the same time as "King Kong", the film did not have the same success at the time. But the story, written by Richard Connell, was very successful, inspiring a good number of other films. Today the film is considered a small masterpiece of cinematic fantasy, distressing and full of metaphorical echoes.

title: Il giovedì
actors: Walter Chiari, Michèle Mercier, Silvio Bagolini, Edy Biagetti
description: Separated, Dino can see his son once a week and takes on the attitudes of a great man with him that do not even convince the boy. During one of these days, reality takes it upon itself to ruthlessly demolish its pathetic mask.

title: Days of Wine and Roses
actors: Jack Lemmon, Lee Remick, Charles Bickford, Jack Klugman
description: Joe Clay and Kirsten Arnesen are two alcoholics. He manages to heal. Not her, but Joe doesn't leave her alone. Much more wine than roses for an atypical Blake Edwards.

title: Mayrig
actors: Omar Sharif, Richard Berry, Cedric Coucet
description: The film tells the story of the young Azad, originally from Armenia and immigrated to France with his family. In particular, the memory of the protagonist focuses on the figure of the mother (mayrig, in Armenian) and her attempts to survive in an initially very hostile environment. She will prove herself capable of facing events and piercing the thin wall of distrust that surrounds them.
notes: Azad is the alter ego of director Henri Verneuil, a usually light author who is serious here.

title: Meet Me In Las Vegas
actors: Cyd Charisse, Dan Dailey, Agnes Moorehead
description: Jack owns a ranch but regularly frequents the green tables in Las Vegas, where he regularly loses everything he earns from his job. One day he bets holding Maria, a dancer by the hand, and wins; he tries again and wins again. Is she his lucky charm? When in doubt he convinces her to follow him, even to the ranch; Maria accepts and falls in love, but he doesn't: he considers her nothing more than an amulet, but ...
notes: Handyman of MGM, Roy Rowland passes with ease from one genre to another and not infrequently hitting good results. Here he is helped by Charisse (who dances). Cameo by Frank Sinatra, Peter Lorre and Debbie Reynolds.

title: The Company of Wolves
actors: Sarah Patterson, Angela Lansbury, David Warner, Stephen Rea, Tusse Silberg
description: Young Rosaleen likes to dream. These dreams, fueled by the fairy tales that her grandmother told her from an early age, are populated by wolves. Thus she sees the funeral of her sister, torn to pieces by a wolf, a party in which the noble as well as cynical guests turn into beasts and she herself cannot help but be fascinated by a hunter-werewolf who killed her grandmother. But when he wakes up the nightmares are not over. Excellent adult reinterpretation of fairy tales, based on a novel by Angela Carter, by Irish director Neil Jordan who, with the claustrophobic scenographies of Anton Furst (the forest is entirely rebuilt in the studio) and the impressive special effects, makes the story an effective mix of thriller and horror, exploring the dark charm of the fairy tale.

title: Napoli milionaria
actors: Eduardo De Filippo, Titina De Filippo, Delia Scala, Leda Gloria
description: Gennaro returns to his Naples after a long period of imprisonment in Germany. At his home he discovers that the war has profoundly changed the existence of his family: his wife has enriched herself with the black bag, the son has become a bad guy and the daughter easily gives herself over to all the men she knows. Gennaro is deeply frustrated by these changes. Fortunately, a poor man, with a rare drug (penicillin), saves the life of his youngest daughter and a thread of hope is reborn in Gennaro's heart. Based on the comedy of the same name by Eduardo De Filippo and directed by him for the screen, this version is faithful to the original to which it adds some unforgettable gags by Totò.

title: Pride of the Marines
actors: John Garfield, Eleanor Parker, Dane Clark, John Ridgley, Ann Todd
description: During the Second World War, the young marine Al loses sight and hope of a happy future with Ruth, the fiancée who awaits him.

title: The Best Years of Our Lives
actors: Fredric March, Dana Andrews, Harold Russell, Myrna Loy, Teresa Wright, Virginia Mayo
description: The difficult reintegration of three ex-combatants who returned to their small provincial town at the end of the war. One works for his ex-comrades, one is betrayed by his wife, another returns mutilated. Tears and sighs in a poignant story well told by Wyler. At the time a great success with audiences and seven Oscars: film, direction, lead actor (March), supporting actor (Harold Russell), non-original screenplay (Robert Sherwood), editing (Daniel Mandell), music (Hugo Friedhofer).

title: Il bandito
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, Anna Magnani, Carla Del Poggio, Carlo Campanini, Eliana Banducci
description: Back from captivity in Germany, the young Ernesto finds the house destroyed, his parents dead, his sister turned into a prostitute. During an argument with the protector, the girl is killed and Ernesto in turn kills the man. Thus begins his career in the world of crime where, however, Ernesto stands out for his good heart and is therefore frowned upon by others. He will find death after being denounced by his own lover. Lattuada made a neorealist film shooting it with the ways of the American detective. The result is a raw and nervous portrait of post-war Italy between the will and the impossibility of starting a normal life again. Spelndido use of Aldo Tonti's cast and black and white.

title: Bello onesto emigrato Australia sposerebbe...
actors: Claudia Cardinale, Alberto Sordi, Riccardo Garrone, Angelo Infanti
description: Amedeo Battipaglia, no longer young Italian who emigrated to Australia, decides that the time has come to marry and, considering the Australians too emancipated for his tastes, he brings Carmela from Italy. The fact that he is not handsome, rather he suffers from epilepsy, and that she is not unharmed, indeed she is a former prostitute, does not prevent the two, after various vicissitudes, from joining a happy marriage.
notes: A comedy that, even with some narrative slowness and an excessive and farcical caricaturization of the characters, retains an underlying bitterness of the story well rendered by the excellent interpretation of the actors and the happy hand of the director.

title: Giulio Cesare, il conquistatore delle Gallie
actors: Cameron Mitchell, Rick Battaglia, Raffaella Carrà, Dominique Williams
description: Caesar moves his army beyond the Alps, against the Gauls who have risen under the command of the brave Vercingetorix. Even at home, however, the leader has to contend with treacherous political opponents ...
notes: A tacky and self-sufficient version of the "De bello gallico", so approximate that it even disfigures among our local "peplums".

title: Milano violenta
actors: Claudio Cassinelli, Silvia Dionisio, Elio Zamuto, Vittorio Mezzogiorno
description: A robbery at a factory checkout did not end as planned. Warned by a worker, the police arrive almost immediately. Two of the robbers manage to escape with the loot, while Raul Montalbani, known as the Cat, has to capture some hostages to earn his escape. Track down the accomplices, who try to kill him. He does not take his revenge, but is shot down shortly thereafter by the hand of a commissioner.
notes: Perhaps the film would like to refer to classics of the "robbery gone bad" genre such as "Asphalt Jungle". What this film lacks unfortunately is that Caiano, even with all the good will, is not John Huston.

title: Madame Sans-Gêne
actors: Sophia Loren, Robert Hossein, Marina Berti, Carlo Giuffrè
description: The beautiful and prosperous washerwoman Catherine Hubscher found some revolutionaries at home during the Paris riots of 1792. At first annoyed, she then fell in love with one of them, Sergeant Léfèvre. She marries him and follows him in his dazzling career which culminates with his appointment as Duke of Danzig. The new duchess, however, for her language and brusque manners, is not well seen at court.
notes: Taken from a well-known theatrical comedy, the film (third adaptation for the screen) aims to be both a re-enactment of the Napoleonic period and a good-natured satire. The film is tailor-made for Loren in the role that was Arletty: but the comparison has no history.

title: Harlem Nights
actors: Eddie Murphy, Richard Pryor, Redd Foxx, Danny Aiello
description: Sugar Ray runs a club in Harlem. Between a game of dice and a drink, find time to look after the orphaned little Quick. Twenty years later, the two are members of a very elegant club that is doing good business. The success of this club for blacks annoys a local boss a lot, who hires Cantone, a corrupt Italian-American policeman, the bellona on duty and a team of henchmen to blow up the place. Everyone will be knocked out by the duo. To enrich his image, Murphy decided to try his hand at screenwriting and directing. Result: a confused and banal story, a flat and rhythmic direction. Richard Pryor is good, but it's not enough to save the film. Murphy's bad service to himself.

title: Return to Snowy River
actors: Tom Burlinson, Sigrid Thornton, Brian Dennehy
description: After three years in the mountains, Jim Craig returns to Snowy River, intending to go horse breeding and marry beautiful Jessica. Alistair, the son of a dishonest banker, has fallen in love with him, who from now on tries in every way to make life impossible for the two of them. Sequel to the "Snowy River Man", produced by Disney. Apart from the landscapes it has few reasons of interest.

title: Soylent Green
actors: Charlton Heston, Edward G. Robinson, Joseph Cotten, Chuck Connors, Dick Van Patten
description: In a world starving for overpopulation, two policemen discover that a food company, Soylent, is recycling human corpses.
notes: Some forgivable inconsistency for the liveliness of the whole and some moments of real tension. Beautiful settings in a decadent nocturnal New York, excellent actors. For Edward G. Robinson, this was the last interpretation. One of the best science fiction movies of the 70s.

title: Dark Passage
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Lauren Bacall, Agnes Moorehead
description: Vincent Parry is an innocent victim of a mistrial. He escapes, gets help from Irene and discovers that his best friend has been killed. So he gets facial plastics done and unrecognizable goes on the hunt for killers.
notes: Delmer Daves, adapting a novel by David Goodis, signs his masterpiece: an experimental noir filmed for 64 minutes as a subjective. Bogart is so big that it fascinates even if we don't see him for more than an hour. Lauren Bacall reflects the anger of her "invisible" partner. Tense, very dark, ruthless despite the happy ending. Similar to "La donna del lago", another subjective noir, but ten times more beautiful.

title: Private Lessons
actors: Sylvia Kristel, Howard Hesseman
description: Taking advantage of the crazy of the young landlord and blackmailing the beautiful housekeeper, a handyman, a handywarm runs through an extortion, but in the end only the boy enjoys it. Poor soft-core with Sylvia Kristel.

title: Seven Faces of Dr. Lao
actors: Tony Randall, Arthur O'Connell, Barbara Eden, John Ericson
description: In a remote town of the West, the traveling, magical and sinister circus of an old and mysterious Chinese magician arrives. Like all exotic things, the strange caravanseraglio arouses conflicting feelings: attraction and distrust. But who or what really hides under the elusive mask of the phantom and unpredictable Dr. Lao?
notes: Under the precious direction of the magician of the George Pal tricks, a tour de force for Tony Randall, interpreter of six different roles.

title: The Fearless Vampire Killers
actors: Roman Polanski, Sharon Tate, Jack Mac Gowran, Alfie Bass, Jessie Robins, Ferdy Mayne, Iain Quarrier, Terry Downes, Fiona Lewis, Ronald Lacey
description: Professor Abronsius and his assistant Alfred arrive in Transylvania to hunt for vampires. They enter the castle of Count von Kroloc, chief of the vampires, who has kidnapped the beautiful innkeeper of which the good Alfred is already familiar.
notes: Polanski's foray into the world of Dracula & Co, memorable for cinematic knowledge, between horror and comedy. Polanski-Alfred is truly remarkable, Sharon Tate is gorgeous.

title: Le ragazze di Piazza di Spagna
actors: Lucia Bosé, Marcello Mastroianni, Cosetta Greco, Ave Ninchi
description: Three dressmakers, who work in the center of Rome, but live in the township, have different love stories: Marisa, engaged to a worker, must choose between being in love and a career as a model. What will he choose? Elena, after a disappointment in love, even thinks about suicide. Luckily for her she soon meets a good young man, who is a taxi driver, who reconciles her with life. Lucia finally accepts the court of a suitor she has constantly rejected.
notes: Classic example of pink neorealism, pleasant and airy, with graceful and vital actresses like there are no more. Appeared for Eduardo De Filippo. The narrator is Giorgio Bassani.

title: Eversmile, New Jersey
actors: Daniel Day-Lewis, Mirjana Jokovic, Gabriela Acher
description: Fergus, a New York dentist, completely changes his life when he is convinced to leave for Patagonia to treat the inhabitants. The problems in that land are much more serious and no one seems to take the willing dentist seriously. Only Estela understands her good intentions and falls in love with them. But a dentist who fears the rivalry of the stranger tries to seduce him by his wife.
notes: Argentine Sorin has put his rather amusing critique of the false humanitarianism of rich countries into a comedy. The dentist is Daniel Day-Lewis, who has not yet become a sex symbol.

title: The Woman in Red
actors: Gene Wilder, Kelly LeBrock, Charles Grodin, Joseph Bologna, Judith Ivey, Gilda Radner, Michael Huddleston
description: Teddy is a quiet advertising clerk from San Francisco. One day he is fascinated by a beautiful girl dressed in red, who then finds himself in the office. He calls her for an appointment, but doesn't notice he's talking to his colleague, ugly and passionate. After several misunderstandings and spite, he finds the beautiful stranger again. Another missed date, but then she invites him to Los Angeles, for a night ... The film is a pleasant and fake-transgressive remake of "Certi piccolissimi sati", by French director Yves Robert; Kelly LeBrock is custom-built. Oscar to Stevie Wonder's honeyed song, "I just called to say I Love You".

title: Till the Clouds Roll By
actors: Robert Walker, June Allyson, Dinah Shore, Van Heflin, Judy Garland
description: The story of Jerome Kern, author of musicals, soundtracks and songs like "Ol 'Man River" and "Smoke Gets in Your Eyes". Good biography with a large number of extras.

title: La passante du Sans Souci
actors: Michel Piccoli, Romy Schneider, Helmut Griem, Mathieu Carrière, Wendelin Werner, Gerard Klein, Dominique Labourier, Maria Schell
description: Max Baumstein, industrialist and president of an organization for the protection of human rights, kills the ambassador of Paraguay. Max's wife and collaborators are shocked, but at the trial - where Max pleads guilty - the truth emerges: the ambassador was a former Nazi officer who had persecuted Jews, including Max and his family. And Nazism is not dead yet. It is the latest film starring Romy Schneider. Too bad that the realization, while not effective, is also a bit messed up.

title: L'arcidiavolo
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Claudine Auger, Mickey Rooney, Ettore Manni
description: In 1478, after a long hostility, Innocent VIII and Lorenzo de 'Medici make peace, which displeases Beelzebu & C. The archdevil Belfagor and his valet Adramelek are therefore sent to earth to remit tares among the powerful. Here is the marriage of Maddalena de 'Medici messed up at the last moment, here is the girl forced to show herself naked to the entire citizenry. For Belfagor it will be the stake, but ...
notes: Scola's film attempts a re-enactment of the Tuscan novelist tradition of the 15th century, foul-mouthed, spicy, irreverent. The frame is there, but the value of the biting criticism of human weaknesses is moralistic.

title: Brancaleone alle Crociate
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Adolfo Celi, Paolo Villaggio, Gigi Proietti, Beba Loncar, Stefania Sandrelli, Lino Toffolo, Gianrico Tedeschi, Shel Shapiro
description: Traveling to conquer the Holy Sepulcher, Brancaleone loses all his men and invokes Death, only to ask for an extension. He saves the life of a newborn baby, the son of a Norman king, and, with a ragged new army, he sets off on his journey. Between one comic adventure and the next she will discover that a fake leper is, instead, a beautiful princess: she will fight for her and, of course, she will lose. As almost always happens with the "sequels", this attempt to repeat, five years later, the very happy exploit of the "Brancaleone Army" was only partially successful. Great parade of actors.

title: Travels with My Aunt
actors: Maggie Smith, Alec McCowen, Robert Stephens
description: Augusta Bertrand (Maggie Smith) is an elderly woman with a troubled past. Among the many adventurers she has allowed herself, she has kept a good memory of only one man, the Neapolitan Ercole Visconti (Robert Stephens), and above all two children. Memé, who lives in Milan, exploiting women, and Henry, a bank manager who believes her to be his aunt. The sprightly old woman who lives with Wordsword, a black drug and currency trafficker, decides to help Hercules kidnapped by ferocious blackmailers.
notes: Clever and funny version of Graham Greene's novel, reread by Cukor with acidity and non-conformism, the film won the Academy Award for costumes by Anthony Powell. Very good Maggie Smith.

title: La tigre venuta dal fiume Kwai
actors: George Eastman, Krung Sirvilai, Kan Won Long
