description: On the death of his young American friend, a Thai tries to deliver some precious items to the parents of the deceased, but the company will be tough. Italian-style adventure films, without interest.

title: Professor Kranz tedesco di Germania
actors: Paolo Villaggio, José Wilker, Maria Rosa, Adolfo Celi, Vittoria Chamas
description: Professor Otto von Kranz is a German psychoanalyst residing and practicing in Rio. Together with a down-and-out band of desperate people (including a boy, a prostitute and his sister), he decides to kidnap an oil king sheikh, but instead of the tycoon they kidnap his driver.
notes: The film is little more than a pretext to allow Villaggio to produce himself in his wild performances.

title: Timestalkers
actors: Klaus Kinski, Lauren Hutton, William Devane, Forrest Tucker
description: A twentieth-century professor is alarmed by a charming woman of the twenty-sixth to return with her in the eighteenth. The problem is that a scientist of the future (partner of the girl's father) has made up his mind to go back in time to assassinate an old president of the United States. But our heroes will make sure that he doesn't complete the task. Time travel movies are all a bit the same, but if the cast works it's okay. Here we have Klaus Kinski on his American TV debut and the gorgeous Lauren Hutton ("American Gigolo"). What more do you want?

title: Men of War
actors: Dolph Lundgren, Charlotte Lewis
description: A mining company interested in deposits under a remote tropical island hires seven mercenaries to iron out misunderstandings with the natives. One of the seven is called Nick Gunar (Dolph Lundgren) and the way in which the negotiations should be conducted is rather clear and hasty. But even among the men on the expedition some doubts creep in. Action movies shot for the sake of action can like and dislike. Action movies with some ecological and humanitarian undertone are completely unbearable. The inexpressive Lundgren ("Rocky IV") keeps making mistakes one film after another.

title: I soliti ignoti
actors: Claudia Cardinale, Vittorio Gassman, Marcello Mastroianni, Totò, Carlo Pisacane
description: An inexperienced and down-and-out group of thieves has organized a theft in a Roman pawnshop. The old former stable boy Capannelle, the Sicilian Ferribotte, the photographer Tiberio, the mammon Mario and the boxer played Peppe take lessons from the burglar Dante. The action, despite some unforeseen events, goes through; but instead of breaking through the right wall the group ends up in ...
notes: Screenplay by Age, Scarpelli, Suso Cecchi D'Amico and Monicelli: from the series "everything you need to create a perfect film". The Italian comedy at its top and first comic role for Gassman, who in the role of the stutterer "er Pantera" is simply hilarious.

title: Ultimo tango a Zagarol
actors: Franco Franchi, Martine Beswick, Gina Rovere, Franca Valeri, Nicola Arigliano, Carla Mancini, Loredana Mongardini, Ugo Fangareggi, Luciano Bonanni, Nerina Montagnani, Grazia Di Marzà, Giuseppe Bruno Bossio, Jimmy il Fenomeno, Franca Scagnetti
description: His wife keeps him on the spot to feed his lover hidden in the attic, and Franco goes to live alone. Then he meets a mysterious and vicious young woman. This involves him in particular erotic games, but leaves him hungry as before. When it seems that his wife is dead, Franco is under the illusion that he has finally finished tightening his belt, but it is instead a further rip-off. Franchi alone, in a scatological and extremist comedy "a la Nando Cicero". At the time a cult (and there are those who defiantly preferred it to the original).

title: Cimarron
actors: Glenn Ford, Maria Schell, Anne Baxter, Arthur O'Connell
description: Towards the end of the last century, Yancey Cravat, a restless and adventurous colonizer, emigrated with his wife to Oklahoma. Here, not having occupied the land he wanted, he founds a newspaper, but then sets off in search of other emotions. He will find plenty of them, but the weight of the newspaper falls on his wife. It will always be like this, until his death, between a few short returns home and long absences.
notes: Second transposition on the screen, after the one, better, of 1930, of the homonymous novel by Edna Ferber. Perhaps the only mediocre western of an absolute master of the genre.

title: Decision Before Dawn
actors: Richard Basehart, Gary Merrill, Oskar Werner
description: After the Normandy landings, the allies recruit elements from among the German prisoners willing to collaborate as secret agents beyond enemy lines. A meticulously constructed spy film.

title: Der oel Prinz
actors: Stewart Granger, Macha Meril, Terence Hill
description: A pioneer caravan is on its way to Arizona. A cynical speculator, in order to take over the oil-rich region, tries in every way to turn the Indian tribes against the settlers. The caravan leader, Surehand, with his Indian friend Winnetou, fights risking his life so that the plan doesn't go through.
notes: A bit naive Western that would like to cross over into the political.

title: A Place to Be Loved
actors: Richard Crenna, Rhea Perlman, Linda Kelsey, Cotter Smith
description: Gregory Kingsley is an eleven year old boy who was abandoned by his parents. His life was spent in and around the orphanages. Pitying his condition, attorney George Russ asks for and gets custody.

title: Scanners II: The New Order
actors: David Hewlett, Deborah Raffin, Yvan Ponton, Isabelle Mejias
description: David Kellum has discovered that he is a "scanner" (men capable by telepathy to condition and kill by willpower). Captain John Forrester, who had the police chief assassinated by another "scanner", uses David to take his place, but when he also has the mayor killed, David manages, with the help of his sister, to unmask and eliminate him. The film is based on the characters created by David Cronenberg for his "Scanners", but the affinities between the two films stop there, where a mannered horror prevails (we would save the special effects) compared to the almost metaphysical one created by the Canadian author. .

title: Short Cuts
actors: Andie MacDowell, Jack Lemmon, Tim Robbins, Julianne Moore, Matthew Modine, Chris Penn
description: In contemporary Los Angeles (continuously sprayed with insecticide from helicopters to eliminate the so-called fruit fly) we follow the stories of some people chained by apparent randomness. Earl, a rental limo driver, is married to Doreen, a waitress in a fast food restaurant. One day Doreen runs over a boy who, for this, ends up in the hospital. Here we follow the stories of other patients and some doctors, including Dr. Wyman who has many problems with his wife. From the latter we pass to her sister, husband and lover. A small dog pays the price of a difficult relationship between two lovers and a man, mad with jealousy, destroys his ex-wife's apartment while she is out with her new partner. There is also a group of fishermen who find the body of a girl in a river ... In one way or another these stories (and others) intertwine to culminate in the sequence of the earthquake a few years ago. Altman constructs a merciless fresco (from the tales of Raymond Carver) in which the characters no longer seem to have a way out other than to go around in circles around themselves to satisfy only basic needs, without prospects or ideals. America and its children, once the dream is over, wake up in the nightmare of a society which seems to be denied any future.

title: Waterloo
actors: Rod Steiger, Christopher Plummer, Orson Welles, Jack Hawkins
description: Napoleon (Steiger) is forced into exile in Elba while Louis XVIII (Welles) takes the throne in Paris. But Marshal Ney, his old comrade in arms, who would have the order to arrest him, becomes enthusiastic and welcomes him again as the true emperor. Then Napoleon triumphantly returns to Paris, while Louis XVIII escapes and all the European powers put themselves on the alert again. But Lord Wellington (Plummer) finally defeats him at Waterloo.
notes: Expensive co-production between De Laurentis and the Russians. The whole last hour, devoted to the battle scene, is well shot and quite exciting too. Too bad that the whole first part (which lasts about eighty minutes) is not up to par. Steiger, who had won the Oscar three years earlier, looks like he can afford anything. Which in the role of Napoleon does not hurt.

title: Il sergente Rompiglioni diventa... caporale
actors: Franco Franchi, Mario Colli, Maria Pia Conti, Luciano Pigozzi
description: Mistakenly mistaken for an important person, Sergeant Francesco Garibaldi Rompiglioni (Franchi) upsets the NATO Headquarters with insane initiatives. Franco Franchi is unleashed in jokes without restraint, to the point of stifling even some not strange ideas such as the confusion of languages ??and races in the Babel of Born.

title: Indiscreet
actors: Ingrid Bergman, Cary Grant, Phyllis Calvert, Cecil Parker
description: A singer falls in love with a brilliant economist, but he (for fear of marriage) makes her believe ... that he is already married. Brilliant sophisticated comedy, from a Norman Krasna play adapted by the author. The glamor of the protagonist couple is enough.

title: Project X
actors: Christopher George, Greta Baldwin, Henry Jones
description: In the future, the world is divided into two opposing blocs. A Western agent reveals, before he dies, that the Orientals will destroy the world. Scientists bring him back to life to avert the threat.

title: Red Garters
actors: Rosemary Clooney, Guy Mitchell, Gene Barry
description: In a small town in the West, three very quarrelsome couples go to war. It will end in a triple marriage. Fairly successful attempt at a musical-western: a little theatrical but effective.

title: I fratelli corsi
actors: Geoffrey Horne, Valerie Lagrange, Emma Danieli, Amedeo Nazzari, Jean Servais
description: Two twins grew up apart after their family was exterminated. Paul, raised by a doctor, is now a brilliant student. Leone, who grew up in the environment of the Bonapartist partisans, became a brigand. They find themselves by chance and from that moment on they live only for one goal: to avenge their parents. They will of course succeed, but Leo will pay with his life once the battle is over. Adapted from the novel of the same name by Alexandre Dumas father. Anton Giulio Majano, not at all intimidated by the intricacies of the reference literary intrigue, practices what will become the television specialization that will make him popular.

title: Freefall
actors: Eric Roberts, Jeff Fahey, Pamela Gidley, Ron Smerczak, Warrick Grier
description: Katy, sent to South Africa by her boss (and boyfriend) Dex Dellum, has to photograph the very rare "taita" falcon. Instead he meets Grant Orion, officially stuntman, with whom he has a love affair. Grant actually turns out to be an Interpol agent and Katy risks being put in the middle of a much bigger story than her, since Dex also appears to belong to a rival spy organization.
notes: The intrigue wears out wearily in the inexorable succession of clichés. Eric Roberts, Julia's brother who once promised something better, never misses a chance to miss film.

title: Io, Chiara e lo Scuro
actors: Francesco Nuti, Giuliana De Sio, Marcello Lotti, Renato Cecchetto
description: Francesco is an excellent amateur pool player. After beating the Scuro once, a national champion, he gets involved in a series of cash challenges and piles up debt after debt. Thanks to a fortuitous and propitious exchange of cases, he meets Chiara, a saxophone player who lives in her own building and the two fall in love. And it is Chiara, by engaging her musical instrument at the pawnshop, who allows him to register for the national championships of Chianciano.
notes: A film that remains one of Maurizio Ponzi's best and funniest works. Marcello Lotti, known as "Lo Scuro", was truly a champion of billiards.

title: By Love Possessed
actors: Efrem Zimbalist jr., Lana Turner, Jason Robards, George Hamilton
description: Painful sentimental entanglements between the associates of a law firm. Marjorie, whose husband Julius has suffered a serious accident, is having an affair with Arthur. Arthur's son, Warren, is denounced for rape by a prostitute who wants to take revenge for an offense suffered by the young man. But Helen, Warren's girlfriend, pays the consequences.
notes: It is a bourgeois melodrama, a genre certainly not too congenial to John Sturges, director of western heroisms ("Challenge to the O.K. Corral") and energetic detective stories ("Giorno cursed"). Twenty-year-old George Hamilton (Warren) in the 1960s and 1970s seemed on course for a bright future.

title: Uno scugnizzo a New York
actors: Nino D'Angelo, Yawe Davis, Claudia Vegliante, Enzo Cerusico
description: Nino (Nino D'angelo) lives in New York as a pianist in a Brooklyn restaurant. His friend Matumba, on the other hand, is an amateur boxer willing to do any job. Nino would love to go back to Naples, but the money is hardly even enough to take his girlfriend out. Then Matumba has the chance of his life: to meet the New York state boxing champion and Nino bets on him.
notes: The golden helmet on the road. In its own way, a superproduction. Horrible like all D'Angelo's films in that period.

title: La belle noiseuse
actors: Michel Piccoli, Jane Birkin, Emmanuelle Béart, Marianne Denicourt
description: Frenhofer hasn't painted any more for ten years; and the last painting, the one for which his wife Liz had posed, remained unfinished. Now, however, Marianne arrives in his country residence, allowing him to complete the work.
notes: "Short" version - edited in a very different way - of the film presented (and awarded) at Cannes '91, lasting four hours. The elaborate gestation of the painting, paradigm of the very essence of the creative-expressive processes, also acts as the "engine" of the relationships between the characters, for which Rivette can count on the magnificent "underplaying" of Piccoli and Birkin and on the cold, ostentatious Béart's nudity.

title: High Time
actors: Bing Crosby, Fabian, Tuesday Weld, Nicole Maurey
description: At the age of fifty, rich and widowed, he enrolled in university becoming the most popular student. A pretty little play directed with brio and some hints of almost pop taste by Blake Edwards before his great hits.

title: MacArthur
actors: Gregory Peck, Ed Flanders, Dan O'Herlihy, Marj Dusay
description: In 1942, the United States must fight back to respond to Japan's conquest of supremacy in the Pacific. It is MacArthur who demonstrates the possibility and then leads the operations. After the war, in contrast to the upper echelons, he worked hard for the rebirth of Japan and, later, for the direct attack on North Korea. Political opportunities, however, determine the final torpedo.
notes: MacArthur did not have the luck of Patton, brought to the screen by Schaffner and scripted by Francis Coppola. Sargent and Peck do their best, but without freeing themselves from a certain congenital woodiness, in staging and interpretation.

title: All the Vermeers in New York
actors: Emmanuelle Chaulet, Katherine Bean, Stephen Lack
description: Mark, a stockbroker who likes to relax while contemplating Vermeer's painting "The Girl with the Veil" at the Metropolitan Museum, makes the acquaintance of Anna, a French and aspiring actress, right here and falls in love. She has to go back to France, but she is struck by the man's sentiment. However, he decides to return home. He calls her, leaves a love message on the answering machine and dies of a hemorrhage. From a minimal story Jost draws an exciting cinematic reflection on impossible happiness, whose particular realism is given by the intertwining of essentiality and visionary nature. Emmanuelle Chaulet came from Rohmer's My Friend's Friend.

title: Anzio
actors: Robert Mitchum, Peter Falk, Mark Damon, Giancarlo Giannini
description: Italy, 1944: the Germans are stemming the Allies in Cassino, and the American command stationed in Naples decides a diversion to lighten the front. The marines landed in Anzio, a few kilometers from Rome, without encountering resistance. Dick Ennis, a war correspondent, is surprised by this fact: he gets to go ahead in a jeep with two soldiers and discovers that the road to the city is unguarded. Commander Lesly, however, fears an ambush and chooses not to advance. The German commander Kesserling thus has plenty of time to organize a counter-offensive that annihilates the marines: only a few, including the journalist, are saved. After a four-month siege, the German resistance is broken and the Allies enter Rome, commanded by a new general ...
notes: Italian-American co-production directed by the specialist Duilio Coletti and commissioned by Dino De Laurentiis, who is about to move overseas. As a consequence of the particular production contingency, Edward Dmytryk is credited as supervisor to the director. Nothing special, but effective in terms of entertainment despite initial slowness. The cast is screaming: in the foreground is Robert Mitchum in the role of the war journalist, as always very good. There is also Giancarlo Giannini, on his first cinema experience of a certain weight. Beautiful photograph, signed by Giuseppe Rotunno.

title: Good Day for a Hanging
actors: Fred MacMurray, Robert Vaughn, Maggie Hayes
description: Young Eddie Campbell is arrested after a bloody robbery, but not everyone is convinced he's guilty. A western tinged with psychology and yellow.

title: Heat
actors: Burt Reynolds, Karen Young, Peter Mac Nicol
description: A Vietnam veteran who loves gambling and whiskey and makes a living by putting his martial and muscular skills to good use, ends up clashing with a gang of sadists. Disorderly rhythm and absent direction.

title: Pirates of Tortuga
actors: Ken Scott, Dave King, Letitia Roman
description: In the seventeenth century, Captain Bart must go to the Caribbean to defeat the rebel pirate Henry Morgan, on the order of the King of England. A rather modest job, only for fans.

title: The One and Only
actors: Henry Winkler, Kim Darby, Gene Saks, William Daniels
description: Andy has the show in the blood and does not care for his wife and son. Abandoned, he knows the success and bitterness of solitude. With surreal and bewildered humor, the film also emphasizes the psychological facets.

title: Boeing Boeing
actors: Tony Curtis, Jerry Lewis, Dany Saval, Christiane Schmidtmer
description: Bernard Lawrence, International Press correspondent from Paris plays (sentimentally) on three tables at the same time. His three women are all stewardesses, from different airlines, and each believes herself to be the Don Juan's official (and only) girlfriend. When airlines increase the frequency of flights, things get complicated for Bernard. Until one day, the "tragedy" breaks out ... The film transposes on the screen a comedy written for the theater by Marc Camoletti, and it suffers a little, despite the attempt to liven it up for the needs of cinema. Direction is not bad, the interpreters are good, but the pace is not very brilliant.

title: Beiqing chengshi
actors: Tony Leung Chiu Wai, Liang Chaowei, Li Tainlu, Xin Shufen, Gao Jie
description: In 1945 Taiwan returned to China after the Japanese defeat and Chiang Kai Shek's nationalists, expelled from the continent, stifled any independence movement. The story is the odyssey of a family consisting of a father and four children: the first will be killed by drug traffickers, the second is lost in the war, the third is imprisoned and tortured, the fourth is deaf and is a photographer. Golden Lion in Venice in 1989, penalized by theatrical distribution, the film has an unspectacular but highly dramatic structure: fixed camera, no close-ups, long shots, no didacticism. Difficult, but of undeniable charm.

title: Una pura formalità
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Roman Polanski, Sergio Rubini, Tano Cimarosa
description: A man is arrested at night, in the flood, and taken to a dilapidated police station. He is increasingly nervous, but when the commissioner arrives, the tension subsides. Interrogation. A dead body has been found and the man (who qualifies as a famous writer) is unable to reconstruct his final hours. At dawn, after the dialectical skirmish, everything will finally become "clear".
notes: An ambitious film in its "metaphysical" perspective and in the Kafkaesque forms of the story. Difficult, unusual (in Tornatore's work, but also in Italian cinema as a whole), intriguing even if not perfect. Great "duel" Depardieu-Polanski.

title: I tre corsari
actors: Ettore Manni, Cesare Danova, Renato Salvatori, Mark Lawrence
description: During the war between the Franco-Piedmontese and the Spanish, Captain Van Gould treacherously kills the Count of Ventimiglia. The count's three sons, Alberto, Enrico and Luigi are captured and embarked for the Antilles. But the galleon is attacked by pirates. The three Ventimiglias take the names of Corsaro Rosso, Verde and Nero and, allied with the corsairs, fight to avenge their father, but Enrico will die. From "Il Corsaro Verde" by Emilio Salgari, a cinematic adaptation with few attractions. Mario Soldati doesn't even try to put a hint of elegance on it.

title: Paolo il freddo
actors: Franco Franchi, Ileana Rigano, Guido Leontini, Isabella Biagini, Annie Carol Edel, Mimmo Baldi, Elio Crovetto, Grazia Di Marzà, Tino Scotti, Linda Sini, Dante Cleri, Xiro Papas, Luca Sportelli
description: Son of the Don Juan "Paolo il Caldo", the little Pauline swears to his dying parent fidelity to work and hatred of women. For twenty years he was exploited in a convent, then, after being fired, he was sent to an aunt, who owned a brothel. Paolino, wherever he works, is in big trouble and is also persecuted by a jealous husband, but he will end up finding love in Lucia, a village girl.
notes: Ciccio Ingrassia directs his fellow Franco Franchi in what is not even, if not in the title, the parody of "Paolo il Caldo", the film by Marco Vicario based on the novel by Vitaliano Brancati. A farce of puppet comedy, which improves a little in the ending.

title: Travolti da un insolito destino nell'azzurro mare di agosto
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Mariangela Melato, Riccardo Salvino
description: A rich Milanese lady, Raffaella Pavoni Lanzetti, is on a cruise in the Mediterranean. He does not scruple to cruelly snub the crew, but when he is shipwrecked on a desert island with the only company of the sailor Gennarino Carunchio, a rude Sicilian and communist, the hierarchy of powers is overturned. After a first moment of fear, the lady also takes pleasure in it ...
notes: Lina Wertmüller has the ambition to make social criticism with a smile on her face and sometimes, as in this case, she hits the mark. The bickering and beating between Giannini and Melato have made history and are often honored and mentioned on TV (Enterprise) and in the cinema. To forget the remake with Madonna.

title: London Kills Me
actors: Justin Chadwick, Steven Mackintosh, Fiona Shaw, Brad Dourif
description: It is on his twentieth birthday that Clint (Chadwick) decides to change his life: he stops selling drugs, gets beaten up and robbed by two other pushers to whom he owed money and suffers for Silvie who has joined her best friend. He finds work almost immediately, but his future master (Dourif) places a condition on him: he will have to find a decent pair of shoes. Hanif Kureishi is the young British writer of Pakistani origins who wrote the screenplay for the remarkable "My Beautiful Launderette" and who recently published the novel "Black album" inspired by the controversial Prince disc. So there were many expectations for his directorial debut. Perhaps too many and that is why, despite guessing various things, no one shouted at the masterpiece.

title: Freaked
actors: Alex Winter, Megan Ward, Randy Quaid, Brooke Shields, Keanu Reeves
description: Ricky Coogin (Winter), a TV star who has sold out to a multinational, his aide Ernie and Julie, a young ecologist, end up in a strange amusement park by accident. The attractions of the park are monstrous characters, the result of the perverse experiments of a certain Elijah C. Skuggs (Quaid) and even Ricky, Ernie and Julie will become victims of his madness. Shot with two lire and with two ideas, the film by Stern and Winter is a funny and captivating little horror. Provided that the obvious vulgarity of the whole does not bother you before the end. In a short role there is also Keanu Reeves, but you have to know how to find him.

title: Sotto il ristorante cinese
actors: Claudio Botosso, Amanda Sandrelli, Nancy Brilli, Bernard Blier
description: Ivan (Botosso) is about to marry Ursula (Brilli), a graduate in engineering, but very respectable, of little imagination and who is also his boss. One day, to escape from criminals, he crosses the door of a basement and finds himself on a beach with a blue sea, where Eva (Sandrelli) and her nutty parent live. She falls in love and follows Ivan into her world, making a mess. Surreal fable written and directed by Bozzetto, who gives you the same poetic and light-hearted stamp of his splendid cartoons. Around the great old Bernard Blier revolve some new faces (Brilli, Sandrelli, Cederna) of Italian cinema.

title: The Unholy
actors: Ben Cross, Ned Beatty, Trevor Howard, William Russ, Jill Carroll
description: Father John Michael (Cross) is intended for the church of Sant'Agnese in New Orleans. It will be that he has just escaped death after making a flight of seventeen plans, it will be that the two priests he goes to take the place died three years earlier in mysterious circumstances; In any case, our father John starts to come. And above all he begins to meet too many girls.
notes: It is the devil who procures the girls at Ben Cross in this routine horror in which one is clear: sex is a product of the devil. The type to which this strange philosophy is due is called Camilo Vila and turns on the loose.

title: Adieu l'ami
actors: Alain Delon, Charles Bronson, Olga Georges-Picot, Brigitte Fossey, Bernard Fresson
description: Dino is a military doctor in the Foreign Legion. He wants to help Isabelle put compromising titles back in the firm's safe. He gets hired and arranges the heist for the Christmas weekend; at the last moment he finds himself in the company of a legionnaire who hates him to death. The two carry out the blow anyway, but a nasty surprise awaits them, with the safe open. Debut film by Jean Herman, a singular figure of filmmaker who, at the beginning of the seventies, successfully recycled himself as the author of detective novels (pseudonym: Jean Vautrin). The film is well constructed and builds on the Delon-Bronson combination.

title: Garde à vue
actors: Lino Ventura, Romy Schneider, Michel Serrault, Guy Marchand, Elsa Lunghini, Jean-Claude Penchenat, Michel Such
description: Martinaud is called to the police station following the discovery of the bodies of two girls. Inspectors Gallien and Belmond openly suspect him, who cannot offer convincing alibis. Martinaud is stopped; after listening to his wife's statements, the policemen put Martinaud under pressure. In the end he confesses, but, the next morning, the real culprit is discovered ... A commissioned film in which, however, Claude Miller demonstrates his great filmmaking mastery by playing with the atmosphere, the succession of moods, the duets of actor. Romy Schneider plays his penultimate role there before the tragic death.

title: Passed Away
actors: Bob Hoskins, Jack Warden, Mauren Stapleton, Nancy Travis
description: All relatives gather at the funeral of the head of the family. The occasion is not the happiest, but the fact remains that it ends up being scattered with bizarre events, surprises, human cases: from the woman who has labor pains during the procession, to the appearance of a beautiful mysterious girl, to the midlife crisis. Johnny, who will not get anywhere anyway and will end up returning to the familiar harbor. A skilfully woven comedy, both in terms of situations and dialogues. All the more remarkable as a first work. Life is celebrated there with full black humor but with remarkable taste, supported by an impeccable interpretation.

title: I due figli di Ringo
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, George Hilton, Gloria Paul
description: Franco and Ciccio, assuming the identity of Django and Gringo, sons of the famous Ringo, are involved in a series of adventures in the boundless landscapes of the Wild West.
notes: One of the many feeble parodies of the Italian western made by the duo.

title: Si muore solo una volta
actors: Ray Danton, Pamela Tudor, Dada Gallotti, Mirella Pamphili
description: Investigator Mike Gold investigates between Beirut and Malta to unmask a criminal organization.
notes: Z-series spy adventures, a bit murky in the plot, and shot with two lire. The director is a pseudonym of Giancarlo Romitelli.

title: Veneri in collegio
actors: Raimondo Vianello, Sandra Mondaini, Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia
description: Journalists and photographers try to break into a Swiss girls' boarding school to photograph the future bride of a very rich Arab. Discreet comedy rose water.

title: La grande guerra
actors: Alberto Sordi, Vittorio Gassman, Silvana Mangano, Folco Lulli
description: First they try them all to hide when the others attack, but then they will die as heroes so as not to betray their homeland in the face of the enemy. Indovinatissima mixture of tragedy and comedy. Amazing Deaf and Gassman.

title: Il corsaro nero
actors: Terence Hill, Bud Spencer, Silvia Monti, George Martin, Sal Borgese, Diana Lorys
description: The adventures of the English privateer, Captain Blakie, between kidnappings, ransoms and boarding ships loaded with gold. Very modest and light-hearted adventure film; Salgari has little to do with it.

title: Hawk the Slayer
actors: Jack Palance, John Terry, Bernard Bresslow
description: The heroic Hawk and his magic sword (and a small army of helpers) defeat the evil Voltan, degenerate brother and blackmailer.
notes: The "vilain" par excellence, Jack Palance, plays for his part in a role that is now saturated to be credible. The rest is less than business as usual.

title: I Will Fight No More Forever
actors: James Whitmore, Sam Elliott, Ned Romero, Emilio Delgado, Nick Ramus
description: The dramatic story of the trip to Canada of the Pierced Nose tribe. Historical fresco that reconstructs the epic of the Indians.

title: Padella calibro 38
actors: Scott Holden, Delia Boccardo, Philippe Leroy
description: An old bandit and his son are commissioned by the sheriff to escort a cargo of gold, but there are only stones in the crates. A grotesque western, but funny at times.

title: L'isola del tesoro
actors: Kim Burfield, Orson Welles, Lionel Stander, Rik Battaglia
description: Before dying, an old pirate entrusts to little Jim Hawkins the treasure map that belonged to a famous and feared buccaneer: Captain Flint. The boy gives it to two gentlemen of his friends, Knight Trelawney and Doctor Liversey, who decide to arm a ship, the Hispaniola, and set out in search of the treasure. The command is entrusted to Captain Smollet and with it the three set sail for the South Seas. The cook on board, however, Long John Silver was once in the crew of Captain Flint ...
notes: Discreet transposition of Stevenson's novel with a very bad Orson "Long John Silver" Welles.

title: The Patsy
actors: Jerry Lewis, Peter Lorre, Everett Sloane, Ina Balin, Keenan Wynn, John Carradine, Scatman Crothers
description: To replace a deceased comic movie star, some advertising agents decide to bring a delivery boy to success. Comic film but that delves into the mechanisms of Hollywood stardom.

title: Will Success Spoil Rock Hunter?
actors: Jayne Mansfield, Tony Randall, Betsy Drake
description: Rock Hunter, an advertiser, has the idea of ??using actress Rita Marlowe to advertise a lipstick, but things quickly turn sour for him. The diva in fact claims to pass him off as her lover and this irritates Rock's girlfriend, Jenny. Sweeping comedy and excellent television satire based on a play by George Axelrod. A very modern, intelligent film and one of the first and best satires of advertising.

title: Thunder in the Sun
actors: Susan Hayward, Jeff Chandler, Jacques Bergerac, Blanche Yurka, Carl Esmond
description: A caravan of Basques who emigrated from France tries to reach California. When their boss dies, his wife (disputed by the guide and brother-in-law) takes over. Extravagant western contaminated by sentimental themes.

title: Doc Savage: The Man of Bronze
actors: Ron Ely, Michael Miller, Paul Wexler
description: 1936: Doc Savage returns to New York to settle the matter of his father's inheritance, but only after a thousand adventures in the South American jungle does it discover that the inheritance is a lake of gold. From some of the comic book booklets of the 1930s, an old fashion production by the old George Pal that respects his adventures and spirit.

title: The Purple Plain
actors: Gregory Peck, Win Min Than, Maurice Denham, Bernard Lee
description: A pilot, prostrated by the loss of his young wife to German bombs in London, is sent to fight in Burma. Here he fights like a hero and finds love again. Combination of adventure and psychological study in a sometimes powerful film. Editor Passish directs with realism and rhythm, on a screenplay written by the great spy-story specialist Eric Ambler.

title: The Wild Women of Chastity Gulch
actors: Priscilla Barnes, Joan Collins
description: The husbands are at war, so the women of a remote mining town in Missouri find themselves having to take up arms against a band of deserters. Enjoyable western comedy.

title: The Deadly Bees
actors: Suzanna Leigh, Frank Finlay, Guy Doleman
description: To recover from a severe nervous breakdown, a singer settles on the island of gulls, in the house of Mr. Hardgrove who conducts strange experiments on bees. From a great cinematographer and horror specialist, a film steeped in mystery that holds up well especially in the first part.

title: Django
actors: Franco Nero, José Bodalo, Loredana Nusciak, Angel Alvarez, Gino Pernice, Simón Arriaga, Giovanni Ivan Scratuglia, Remo De Angelis, Rafael Albaicin, José Canalejas, Eduardo Fajardo
description: To punish him for a gold theft they kill the woman and Django makes a massacre. One of the cornerstones of the Italian western: violent and ferocious beyond all limits. Nero, in his first important role, wanders around carrying with him a mysterious coffin of which only at the end he will reveal the contents. From here will start numerous explanations full of violent black humor and titles based on coffins, deaths and funerals.

title: Butterflies Are Free
actors: Goldie Hawn, Eileen Heckart
description: Don Baker, blind, and Jill, aspiring actress, know each other and move in together. His mother, however, is not happy. Fast pace, good dialogue, Oscar for Heckart.

title: Just for You
actors: Bing Crosby, Jane Wyman, Natalie Wood
description: Jordan Blake, author of musical comedies, has problems with his children, and even one of them falls in love with the woman his father is to marry. The movie isn't great and Cropsby is unbearable, but there's Nathalie Wood.

title: You Can't Take It with You
actors: Jean Arthur, Lionel Barrymore, James Stewart, Edward Arnold
description: A wealthy banker wants to marry his secretary, but her father has problems. Good feelings and tears as only Capra can pack.

title: Johnny Tremain
actors: Hal Stalmaster, Jeff York, Luana Patten, Sebastian Cabot, Richard Beymer
description: Boston, 1773. Unjustly accused of theft, Johnny Tremain is acquitted and joins the American revolutionary troops. Historical film produced by Disney rather woody but with a meticulous reconstruction of the environment. From a novel by Esther Forbes.

title: Papà diventa mamma
actors: Aldo Fabrizi, Ave Ninchi, Paolo Stoppa, Luigi Pavese
description: Sor Peppe, owner of a fabric shop in Rome, is in trouble because his wife Margherita accuses him of having fun with customers. The children are also somewhat restless. Thus, to restore peace in the family, he accompanies everyone to the theater to see the performance of a fakir. However, he hypnotizes him so much that, back home, he begins to behave like a mother of a family. At this point Margherita is forced to go to the shop and serve the customers ...
notes: Ave Ninchi and Aldo Fabrizi, for obvious similarities in weight, were a fairly stable couple in the Italian cinema of the 1950s. The film is very modest, but the sympathy of the protagonists is undeniable.

title: Juke Box, urli d'amore
actors: Mario Carotenuto, Marisa Merlini, Karin Baal, Aroldo Tieri
description: Mario, a little slacker who thrives on his wits, has just been released from prison after serving a sentence for scam. Always looking for a way to make ends meet without working by taking advantage of the gullibility of others, he meets Marisa, a mature woman, owner of a record company. Although Marisa soon realizes who she is dealing with, despite everything, she falls in love with him and is even willing to marry him. To strengthen the intention, the woman decides to impose the blocking of the wedding on her employees: in fact, no one will be able to marry until she is married. The fact is that among the employees there are some couples who have already fixed their wedding day ...
notes: Good old Carotenuto and dear, tender Merlini in any movie. of the sixties, a decade that was particularly notable for its current production bordering on idiocy. Of the rsto who thought about it, all busy not losing the wave of the economic boom.

title: Fortunella
actors: Giulietta Masina, Alberto Sordi, Paul Douglas, Franca Marzi
description: Nanda, known by all as Fortunella, is a girl of humble origins who lives in the neighborhood of junk dealers and is in love with one of these, a certain Peppino. To save him he goes to prison, taking on the responsibility of a crime of receiving stolen goods. When she is finally released she learns that Peppino has gone to live with another woman. Fortunately, the girl is supported by her unshakable faith in the illusions that represent a reason for living for her. Fortunella is believed to be the illegitimate daughter of Prince Guidobaldi, whose palace is located right in her neighborhood.
notes: Bizarre script by Fellini, Flaiano, Pinelli and Eduardo, a curious cast, but the film remains a feeble and discontinuous fairy tale.

title: Homer and Eddie
actors: Whoopi Goldberg, James Belushi, Karen Black, Nancy Parsons
description: Homer Lanza (Belushi) is a dumb boy who works as a dishwasher in Arizona. His troubles begin when he decides to leave for Oregon to visit his father with cancer. Immediately robbed by two thugs, Homer is picked up by Eddie Cervi (Goldberg), a bit crazy, a bit thief, but above all the owner of a Lincoln. And so the journey begins. The Russian Konchalovski, like all immigrant directors, had to make a road movie sooner or later. Not quite a masterpiece, but watch Whoopi Goldberg freak out and bang his head against the walls.

title: Creepshow
actors: Adrienne Barbeau, Viveca Lindfors, Ted Danson, Leslie Nielsen, Stephen King
description: An old man, dead for seven years, comes out of the grave on his birthday and takes revenge on the one who killed him, that is, his daughter. Then he enjoys his cake in peace. A betrayed husband buries and drowns his wife with her lover, but then has to deal with both of them returning as zombies. A monster from the Arctic regions helps a frustrated professor get rid of his petulant wife. A cruel and miserly hygienic fanatic suffers the assault of an impressive colony of cockroaches.
notes: A very happy meeting between Stephen King (who wrote the stories) and George A. Romero, the author of the "living dead", for once with an interesting budget available. "Creepshow", in its attempt to intersect comic book aesthetics and cinematic visions, is in the end almost experimental, and reminds us that horror is the most suitable genre for similar "research" operations and for the mixture of "low" languages. . Inspired by the Ec Comics series entitled "Creepy" (we are "Uncle Tibia"), the stories maintain the macabre humor of the model, for which a sort of retaliation turns the evil on those who commit it. In the television version, however, the first episode is missing, played by Stephen King himself in the role of a yokel contaminated by a meteorite, which instead is available on videotape.

title: Le belle famiglie
actors: Totò, Sandra Milo, Annie Girardot, Jean Rochefort, Adolfo Celi, Nanni Loy, Susy Andersen
description: "Four episodes. Sicilian girl becomes a nun so as not to marry the man imposed on her by the family. To make her husband jealous, she hires a Vietnamese waiter; the consort will prefer the latter to his wife. 'other. Donna divides herself between sick husband and lover; they recover and she chooses the doctor, injured in an accident. With the collaboration of Steno in the screenplay, Ugo Gregoretti makes his contribution to the satire of costume, but lets himself go to farce the more he ran. "

title: È permesso maresciallo?
actors: Peppino De Filippo, Lorella De Luca, Roberto Risso, Giovanna Ralli
description: Maria, owner of the village bar, is disputed by the police marshal and an enriched former emigrant. Will the charm of the uniform or the scent of money emerge? Inspired by the song "Tuppe tuppe marescià", Bragaglia turns a playful comedy that has the flavor of an era.

title: Warlock
actors: Henry Fonda, Anthony Quinn, Richard Widmark, Dorothy Malone, Dolores Michaels, Wallace Ford, Tom Drake, Richard Arlen, DeForest Kelley, Regis Toomey, Vaughn Taylor, Don Beddoe, Whit Bissell, Bartlett Robinson
description: The town of Warlock is at the mercy of McQuown and his gang; to get rid of this humiliation, the inhabitants ask for the help of a mercenary, Clay Blaisdell. All dressed in black, with guns with gold handles and accompanied by a lame player, he soon finds a real sheriff on his way who arrives with the intention of enforcing the law by all. A great western, full of atmosphere and ideas, based on the confrontation between the anarchist individualism that was at the basis of the race to the West and the will for order that prevailed once the pioneer communities were founded. The three protagonists are charismatic.

title: Roma a mano armata
actors: Maurizio Merli, Giampiero Albertini, Ivan Rassimov, Arthur Kennedy
description: Commissioner Tanzi, from the Rome homicide squad, is not really a guarantor and for this reason he also clashes with his girlfriend who works as a psychologist at the juvenile court. For the brutal methods used during an interrogation, Tanzi is transferred to the administration, but with a personal initiative he returns to the arena to defeat drug dealers, robbers and kidnappers in his style.
notes: A sort of Italian-style Callaghan that focuses on commonplaces and the primary reactions of the viewer, without making his characters or their stories interesting. The denunciation of the evils of the metropolis is of course only a pretext.

title: Houdini
actors: Tony Curtis, Janet Leigh, Torin Thatcher, Ian Wolfe
description: Biography of the famous magician and illusionist who showed a passion for sleight of hand from childhood. When he grows up he is convinced by his wife to work in a factory, but, unbeknownst to her, he enters a competition for amateur magicians and wins it. It is the beginning of a dazzling career. Fictionalized biography of the illusionist celbre, he manages to extricate himself in the reconstruction also thanks to a very partially Curtis.

title: A Night in the Life of Jimmy Reardon
actors: River Phoenix, Ann Magnusson, Meredith Salenger, Ione Skye
description: Jimmy gets his money stolen by a girl who says she has to have an abortion, even if it's not true. Then he tries to steal a hundred and ten dollars from a friend by promising him a girlfriend, but it doesn't work. So he tries with Lisa, who is still a virgin and denies herself. It goes better with Joyce, divorced, but still attractive. Which means he arrives late at the party and finds Lisa accompanied by Matthew.
notes: There are many girls with whom Jimmy has to do in this sort of "coming of age novel". And after all, it is precisely from his own novel that Richert made this film.

title: When a Stranger Calls Back
actors: Jill Schoelen, Carol Kane, Charles Durning, Gene Lythgow
description: Julia is a babysitter. One evening, when the children are put to bed, he hears a knock on the door. It's a guy who asks to be able to make a phone call. Julia is not stupid and does not open, but she offers to make the call anyway. But the phone is off the hook and the man from the outside insists. Five years pass, Julia is in college, that night is just a bad memory and her apartment has a triple lock, but ...
notes: It's not been five years, but fifteen since the release of "When A Stranger Calls". Meanwhile, Walton's talent hasn't blossomed and so he's reduced to picking up on the story of his old movie. It was a good idea, but not twice in a row.

title: Mayerling
actors: Omar Sharif, Catherine Deneuve, James Mason, Ava Gardner
description: Crown Prince Rudolph of Habsburg lives in Vienna, bored and ill-married to Stefania of Belgium. One day he meets the beautiful Maria Vetsera, falls in love with her and, for this reason, arouses the ire of the Emperor. Meanwhile, some secondary things are happening, such as the Hungarian revolution. But love is stronger. Stronger than anything, even gunshots. The tragic, historical, double suicide of Rodolfo and Maria had already been brought to the screen on other occasions. Here there is a cast of big names, a great director of photography (Henri Alekan), but also a director who has never stood out in terms of originality.

title: Noi duri
actors: Fred Buscaglione, Totò, Paolo Panelli, Scilla Gabel, Bice Valori, Elio Pandolfi
description: Lieutenant Bombardone is in Paris to defeat a gang of drug traffickers. To infiltrate the environment of the criminals, who have their lair in a nightclub, he gets hired with an orchestra made up of French police officers. Bizarre attempt to bring Buscaglione and Totò together (which remain valid reasons to see the film), it is one of Totò's least seen films. Also because he has a small part here and the film had a short life due to Buscaglione's death. But it's very nice.

title: Ransom
actors: Sean Connery, Ian McShane, James Maxwell, Jeffry Wickham
description: Four terrorists kidnap the British ambassador to Norway to obtain the release of some comrades detained in Great Britain. Another group hijacks a plane. Colonel Tahlwik is in charge of the negotiations. Already reluctant, he discovers that those on the plane are fake terrorists: is there a British counterintelligence plan behind it? Tahlwik takes action and unleashes a forty-eight. Sean Connery protagonist of this story in which terrorist intrigues and do not overlap until the dramatic and spectacular final dissolution. Unusual the setting and the contrast between the services of two Western countries.

title: Comanche Station
actors: Randolph Scott, Nancy Gates, Claude Akins, Skip Homeier
description: Jeff, in search of his wife kidnapped by the Comanches, frees another hostage and runs into a trio of rascals. Masterpiece and last film of the "Ranown" team: relaxed, melancholy and ferocious, a film of tired heroes, with few elements almost to abstraction, thanks also to the dry script by Burt Kennedy.

title: Song of the Thin Man
actors: William Powell, Myrna Loy, Keenan Wynn, Dean Stockwell
description: A couple of recreational detectives who have retired from the business find themselves having to investigate a murder that happened, almost before their eyes, on a floating nightclub. It is the last, disappointing episode of the popular MGM series launched thirteen years earlier starting from a novel by Dashiell Hammett, with the guessed tandem of star William Powell-Myrna Loy.

title: Love Is a Racket
actors: Douglas Fairbanks jr., Frances Dee, Ann Dvorak
description: A well-known journalist gets a girl suspected of murder out of trouble, but she returns him with a completely different coin. A little bit of comedy and a little bit of drama, the story unfolds in the Broadway nightlife. Not bad. Never released at the cinema, it has only been on TV.

title: La visione del Sabba
actors: Béatrice Dalle, Daniel Ezralow, Corinne Touzet, Omero Antonutti
description: The court instructs a psychiatrist to examine a mentally ill, accused of murder, who believes she is a witch. The doctor is overwhelmed by the visions and the turbid charm of the woman. One of the most encrypted and distressing stages of that long filmic self-analysis which is the work of director Marco Bellocchio.

title: Marie Antoinette
actors: Norma Shearer, Tyrone Power, John Barrymore
description: Portrait of the strong-willed wife of Louis XVI, from the last frivolous days of the Ancien Régime to the guillotine. Lavish Mgm production from the Thirties, resulting in a false but sumptuous and spectacular film.

title: The Conspirators
actors: Hedy Lamarr, Paul Henreid, Peter Lorre
description: A Dutch patriot works in Lisbon for the anti-Nazi spy network. The opponents are on the verge of framing him, but in the end he manages to expose the plot and liquidate a traitor. War melò that recalls "Casablanca", but without the same romantic vigor.

title: Night Moves
actors: Gene Hackman, Jennifer Warren, Melanie Griffith, James Woods
description: Detective Harry Moseby, with a troubled family life, must track down 16-year-old Danny, the daughter of a former film actress. Danny is with his stepfather in Florida. The tragic and mysterious death of her friend Marv convinces her to go back to her mother, but from here a chain of crimes begins. Moseby unknowingly got his hands on a traffic of works of art in which too many people are involved ...
notes: Five years after Little Big Man, Penn returns to fictional cinema (in 1972 he had participated in a documentary on the Olympics) with this dark, painful anthology detective film, which stars Gene Hackman in the role of Harry Moseby.

title: The Silencers
actors: Dean Martin, Stella Stevens, Daliah Lavi, Victor Buono, Robert Webber, Cyd Charisse, Nancy Kovack
description: Dean Martin, a secret agent on the trail of an organization that threatens the world, gets along very well with certain beautiful and dangerous opponents. A James Bond-esque film that pushes the accelerator of humor, but not nearly as accurate in construction.

title: San Antonio
actors: Errol Flynn, Alexis Smith, Paul Kelly
description: A young Texan discovers that the owner of the most elegant haunt in San Antonio is pulling the strings of the cattle thefts affecting ranchers in his area. Typical average Warner Bros western, complete with a star and final shootout, but rather thin.

title: La voie lactèe
actors: Paul Frankeur, Laurent Terzieff, Alain Cuny, Edith Scob, Pierre Clementi
description: Two vagrants (Frankeur and Terzieff) go from France to the sanctuary of Santiago de Compostela, Spain, sent by a strange man in a cape and hat. Between encounters, stories, re-enactments, apparitions and other narrative devices, theirs becomes a journey through twenty centuries of Christianity, of doctrinal conflicts, of disquisitions, of heresies, of anathemas, of miracles, in a curious and unscrupulous assemblage. The "atheist by the grace of God" Buñuel (with the help of Jean-Claude Carrière for the screenplay) offers a very personal reinterpretation of the history of the Church, conducted with witty manipulation of doctrinal sources. A clear and brilliant meta-historical journey, of an old surrealist who has never repented.

title: Il sorpasso
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Jean-Louis Trintignant, Catherine Spaak, Claudio Gora, Luciana Angiolillo, Linda Sini, Barbara Simon, Lilly Darelli, Mila Stanic, Nando Angelini, Luigi Zerbinati, Franca Polesello, Edda Ferronao
description: Bruno Cortona, extroverted and superficial forty years old, accidentally meets, in the depopulated Rome of Ferragosto, the university student Roberto Mariani, shy and studious, and convinces him to join him for a car raid. They are two very different temperaments, and the young man feels a mixture of repulsion and attraction for his occasional companion. Perhaps the masterpiece of the Italian comedy of the boom, a cross section so perfect that it is charged with allegorical force. Masterly Gassman, unforgettable the wandering of the two, suspended between hilarious moments and other tragic ones. To understand Italy in the 1960s (and beyond), better than a history book.

title: Ciccio perdona... io no!
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Adriano Micantoni, Mario Maranzana
description: Two modest horse thieves steal, without knowing its value, a golden chariot that the bandit El Diablo had built for himself. The latter, in order to act undisturbed, pretends to be dead, while two of his former partners rob a bank together with Franco and Ciccio, but find the safe empty. Now they are all, including the revived El Diablo, against the two miserelli.
notes: Like countless other times before and after, the distortion of a successful title serves as a pure pretext under which to baste any vicissitude. Then we think Franchi and Ingrassia. And this, in truth, is not even the most stupid.

title: Romanzo d'amore
actors: Danielle Darrieux, Rossano Brazzi, Charles Rutherford
description: Louise of Habsburg-Lorraine, young and beautiful wife of the Crown Prince of Saxony, manifests democratic sentiments that make her welcome to the people, but not to the court. In 1902 the old King George would like to have her interned in an asylum, but the woman flees to Florence where she meets and loves the musician Enrico Toselli. Theirs will be a dramatic story, with the death of the man and her madness.
notes: Two stars of the time, the fascinating French Danielle Darrieux and the Italian lover par excellence, Rossano Brazzi; a plot taken from historical reality, but elaborated with heavy romantic excesses, they make a wrong film.

title: North Shore
actors: Matt Adler, Nina Peeples, John Philbin, Gerry Lopez, Cristina Raines
description: A guy who considers himself the greatest surfer in Arizona (landlocked US state!) Wants to test himself on the Hawaiian waves. He decides to leave when he learns that on the island they are organizing a prestigious race called "The waves of Oahu". Initially he is mocked by the other competitors who then, however, to the test of the facts ...
notes: Excellent surf shots. But honestly after a movie like "Big Wednesday" what should we expect from a film set in the world of surfers? Everything is already seen. As usual, the interpreters are completely unknown.

title: The Busy Body
actors: Sid Caesar, Robert Ryan, Anne Baxter, Richard Pryor
description: A farcical comedy that targets the gangster undergrowth between scams and corpses. It was the first film starring Richard Pryor. Director Castle was much more at home in horror and thriller.

title: Fra' Manisco cerca guai
actors: Aldo Fabrizi, Carlo Croccolo, Maurizio Arena, Marisa Merlini, Carlo Pisacane
description: Fra Pacifico, known as Fra 'Manisco for his rather brisk manner, brings peace and order back to a small town in the Neapolitan area where a gentleman dominates who, among other things, also claims to determine his daughter's love choices. Apart from Fabrizi who proceeds to the sound of slaps, the film does not have much fun.

title: The Proud and the Profane
actors: Deborah Kerr, William Holden, Thelma Ritter
description: A Red Cross nurse goes in search of her dead husband's body in Guadalcanal. Here she meets the rude Colonel Black who, deceiving her, seduces her but then falls in love with him and marries her.

title: Pronto ad uccidere
actors: Ray Lovelock, Martin Balsam, Elke Sommer, Ettore Manni, Heinz Domez
description: To avenge his mother, shot in a shootout between robbers, agent Torlani infiltrates the members of the gang of drug traffickers responsible for the crime. Political with "American" pretensions of when Italian genre cinema still existed. But it's not the best, despite the cast of old Americans.

title: Suspicion
actors: Joan Fontaine, Cary Grant, Cedric Hardwicke, Nigel Bruce
description: Lina is a shy and rich girl. One day he meets Johnnie Aysgart, Don Juan and player on the train. Despite learning of these details, Lina falls in love with him and marries him, breaking up with the family, who is against the wedding. Johnnie continues his life even after marriage; after losing his job due to a petty theft, he goes into business with his friend Beaky. Lina suspects that Johnnie wants to get rid of Beaky to take over the company and in fact Beaky dies while traveling with his friend. The film, based on a good novel by Francis Iles, remains one of the most proverbially Hitchcockians (the shot of Cary Grant climbing the stairs carrying the luminescent glass of milk). Academy Award to Joan Fontaine.

title: Cool World
actors: Brad Pitt, Gabriel Byrne, Kim Basinger
description: In 1945 a veteran died in an accident. A strange scientist transfers him to Cool World, the world of cartoons created by a cartoonist in prison for murder. He too ends up in Cool World and falls in love with one of his creatures. Back with her in the real world, he is about to do it big, but then it all works out. Our veteran stays at Cool World and marries the beautiful Lonette. The new male sex symbol Brad Pitt finds himself catapulted into a kind of Cartoonia that is anything but reassuring, since sex and violence are at home here. Goliardic and aggressive style, non-existent script. Basinger makes the bellona.

title: Deep Star Six
actors: Taurean Blacque, Nancy Everhard, Greg Evigan
description: Dr. Van Gelder, on behalf of the US Navy, has created an underwater base where an underwater colonization project is developed in order to increase the fauna. The project, however, hides another purpose, that is to install a missile base. The mission, made up of eleven people, including three women, comes to an end when a terrible creature comes out of an open cave with explosives and attacks the base and begins to wreak havoc.

title: Mani di fata
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Eleonora Giorgi, Sylva Koscina, Maurizio Micheli
description: Just as his wife gets a promotion, Andrea, who is an engineer, is fired. Then he secretly acts as the man of the house, but then the lady finds out. To which Andrea is employed by a countess as a servant, but even this solution has drawbacks. Marriage crisis and healthy rethinking. With the final twist, everything falls into place, in the relations between the spouses also from an economic point of view. The film touches on serious topics such as the blind pursuit of well-being or roles within the family, but it certainly does not engage in in-depth analysis.

title: Il prezzo della gloria
actors: Gabriele Ferzetti, Eleonora Rossi Drago, Pierre Cressoy, Mike Bongiorno
description: During the last war the destroyer "Sagittario", returning from a long war mission, was once again used to transport fuel from Taranto to the North African coast. There is no bad blood between the very strict commander and the first officer, but when the captain is killed, the first officer will valiantly take his place until he too falls as a hero. Very modest film, both in terms of spectacularity and psychological definition of the characters. The direction is awkward, and the presence of actor Mike Bongiorno certainly does not raise the fortunes of the operation.

title: The Caddy
actors: Dean Martin, Jerry Lewis, Donna Reed, Barbara Bates, Joseph Calleia
description: Joe is tired of living on his fishing father's boat and goes in search of his fortune. Like him does Harwey, who would be a good golfer, if he managed to overcome the panic that takes him in the public eye. Then Joe will play under the guidance of Harwey, who will be his caddy. After a won tournament, the tumultuous vacation in a mansion is the prerequisite for their success as comedians.
notes: It is not that the film is an uninterrupted bubbling of brilliant ideas and gimmicks to spread out. The mechanism revolves around a couple of valid cues, but the level of comedy is barely medium caliber. The best of Jerry Lewis is yet to come.

title: Ieri, oggi, domani
actors: Sophia Loren, Marcello Mastroianni, Tina Pica, Giovanni Ridolfi
description: Adelina sells contraband cigarettes in Naples. To avoid jail, which she would be destined to after the many complaints, she always lets herself be found pregnant. Until an accident interrupts a gestation. Anna, a rich Milanese lady, has a flirtation with a man of modest conditions, but wealth comes first. Mara is a call girl, for which a seminarian risks losing his head.
notes: Three episodes (written respectively by Eduardo De Filippo, Alberto Moravia and Cesare Zavattini) tailored for the successful couple Loren-Mastroianni and directed by a not particularly inspired De Sica. However, he won the Oscar for best foreign film and the ironic (and not very sexy) striptease of Loern to the tune of "Abat-jour" remained famous. In "Prêt-à-porter" by Altman, a replay of Mara's striptease, but this time Mastroianni falls asleep.

title: The Delicate Delinquent
actors: Jerry Lewis, Darren McGavin, Martha Hyer
description: Sidney is involved in a fight against his will and is arrested; acquitted, he decides to become a policeman to help the children of the area. Jerry Lewis ditches the crackling comedy of Frank Tashlin movies for a quieter streak, but he's still big.

title: Castle on the Hudson
actors: John Garfield, Ann Sheridan, Pat O'Brien, Burgess Meredith
description: During a license from prison a gangster, to save his girlfriend, self -accusations of a murder. The criminal records of him put him at risk of a very severe condemnation, but, despite this, the young man does not portray, thus serving his life of him in the electric chair. Drama with dark colors on the theme of redemption and guilt.

title: Creepshow 2
actors: Tom Savini, George Kennedy, Dorothy Lamour, Lois Chiles
description: The statue of an Indian chief stands out at the entrance to Roy and Martha Spurce's drugstore. When the shop is attacked by thugs, the statue comes alive and does justice. Two couples on an off-season vacation swim in a lake and end badly. Upon returning from an extra-marital affair, a woman overwhelms a black hitchhiker with her car, runs away and continues to live in remorse. Second episode of "Creepshow", but the structure (that of the comic album) is identical to the first. The inspiration is offered by stories by Stephen King, the screenplay is by Romero (director of the first film), but then: why doesn't it work this time?

title: Judgement Night
actors: Emilio Estevez, Cuba Gooding jr., Stephen Dorff, Denis Leary
description: To go to a boxing match, four friends from the Chicago suburbs decide to go big and borrow an RV. It so happens that, by taking the wrong road, they end up in a disreputable neighborhood and that, while they are there, they witness a murder. Thus begins a manhunt by the killers, which lasts all night. The idea of ??the film is to discover a Vietnam, a criminal jungle, which is on the doorstep. Our protagonists, not so much heroes, in the end win. Cuba Gooding jr. and Stephen Dorff, but just because they are good at acting.

title: Sniper
actors: Tom Berenger, Billy Zane, J.T. Walsh, Aden Young, Ken Radley
description: Panama, June 1992. Five "narcos" are crossing the virgin forest. Suddenly one of them is shot in the chest by two Marine snipers: Sergeant Tom Beckett (Tom Berenger) and Corporal Richard Miller (Billy Zane). Not only is there bad blood between the two, although each needs the other to neutralize a colossal drug trade and eliminate its leader.
notes: Thanks to this film Llosa was then called to shoot "The Specialist" with Stallone and Stone. But it is not that he shows great talent, in addition to being able to handle situations of narrative tension with the two "good guys" grappling with overwhelming enemies. The game is all about the Manichean definition of the characters: one with an easy trigger, the other full of complexes. The rest matters little.

title: The King of Kickboxers
actors: Loren Avedon, Richard Jaeckel, Don Stroud, Billy Blanks, Sherrie Rose
description: Ever since Kahn, a famous Thai-born kickboxer, killed his brother, Jake Donahue has been thinking of nothing but revenge. This is why he decided to become a policeman and that is why, at the first opportunity, he started studying the art of kickboxing with master Prang. The opportunity is also tempting because it is a mission in Bangkok and here Jake will be able to put into practice all the teachings of the master and thus be able to carry out his desire for revenge.
notes: Everyone knows what kickboxing is. No one can yet explain why so many small productions have allowed themselves to be seduced by the idea, however strange, of being able to make money with films on the subject. This is one of many, not too original.

title: The Counterfeit Traitor
actors: Ernst Schroeder, William Holden, Lilli Palmer, Hugh Griffith
description: Eric Erickson (Holden), American despite his name, works in Sweden trading oil. This is how he finds himself working with the Nazis on the construction of a refinery. But Erickson is also an English espionage man and that is why we find a correspondent in Berlin, Marianne (Palmer). Then the girl is discovered and he is forced to flee to Denmark. Seaton still manages to build a good film on a good script (based on a true story) and a good film (all shot in real environments) and not to bore for two hours.

title: Slaughter of the Innocents
actors: Scott Glenn, Jesse Cameron-Glickenhaus, Darlanne Fluegel
description: Federal agent Stephen Broderick grapples with a serial killer who strikes his victims and then uses their bodies to compose Flemish-inspired paintings. Stephen's son, Jesse, is so impressed with his father's work that he takes it into his head to help him investigate. Not only does he succeed, but he is even the first to discover where the killer is: his ability, however, risks costing him his life.
notes: It is a clear imitation of The Silence of the Lambs, with Scott Glenn playing Scott Glenn and the little boy who, narratively, plays the role of Jodie Foster. Which is not to say the film is a disaster. It just means it's a B-movie.

title: Mosby's Marauders
actors: James McArthur, Kurt Russell, Nick Adams, Jack Ging
description: Rebel young soldier Willie Prentiss forges a solid manly friendship with Yankee corporal Henry Jenkins. Together, during the civil war, they will find themselves fighting the dark maneuvers of Lieutenant Mosby, a spy within the Confederate forces.
notes: Disney production immediately reduced to a TV movie for a 1960s television series.

title: Rockabye
actors: Constance Bennett, Joel McCrea, Paul Lukas, Walter Pidgeon
description: Back from Europe, the famous actress Judy (Bennett) meets a young playwright. The meeting is professional because he is the author of the text that she will have to interpret in the near future. But love is born between the two despite the fact that he is married and has recently become the father of a child. Faced with this situation, however, Judy sacrifices herself and makes him go back to his wife. George Fitzmaurice started the film, but the producers called Cukor for a couple of weeks of further shooting. Eventually the film came out with Cukor's signature, but that's not something to be particularly proud of.

title: La poliziotta a New York
actors: Edwige Fenech, Alvaro Vitali, Renzo Montagnani, Aldo Maccione
description: Mac Caron (Renzo Montagnani), the most stupid and inept of New York cops, is grappling with two gangs of drug dealers fighting each other. Reinforcements from Italy (Edwige Fenech and Alvaro Vitali) arrive to his aid. The two replace, respectively, the lover and the bodyguard of the boss Big John and in the end, after various chases, misunderstandings and fist fights, they solve the case.
notes: Comedy with some erotic concessions, it was the last of the short series with the Fenech in uniform.

title: Le motorizzate
actors: Totò, Ave Ninchi, Bice Valori, Walter Chiari, Raimondo Vianello, Sandra Mondaini, Riccardo Billi
description: A casual nun (Ninchi) collides with a car and then hits the three passengers because they are communists. A prostitute, all home and work (in the sense that she works in her trailer), gets stuck in a quagmire. Urbano Cacace (Totò) pretends to be vigilant in order to pocket the money from the fines. A poor guy tries to make money by being invested, but ends up in the hospital and doesn't get a penny.
notes: In reality there are five episodes (there is another one with Walter Chiari engaged in a car race), but the discussion does not change: more than episodes they are specks. All that remains is the pleasure of seeing the usual great Totò again.

title: Esterina
actors: Carla Gravina, Domenico Modugno, Geoffrey Horne
description: Esterina is a country girl, bored with the life she leads and, what's more, mistreated by her masters. Two truck drivers save her and take her away, around Italy. The new life, however, is not as exciting and golden as she had imagined it. In fact, Esterina risks becoming a prostitute, ends up in jail and even attempts suicide. In the end, however, love comes. La Gravina as a young man is always a show. It's the rest that doesn't work. On the one hand there is the countryside with the exploitation it entails, on the other the city with all the pitfalls and disappointments. In between, a not too exciting melodrama.

title: Mafioso
actors: Alberto Sordi, Norma Benguell, Ugo Attanasio, Gabriella Conti
description: Nino Badalamenti, a Sicilian immigrant to Milan, has returned, after many years of being away, to his native land for a short vacation. The local mafia forces him to obey his orders: he is secretly sent to New York to eliminate a man. All this will have to be done in a couple of days; to his wife, Nino says he will be away for a hunting trip.
notes: With tones of "black" comedy, to which the presence of a Deaf at the height of success gives further strength, the film deals with a burning topic: the insertion of the honored company into the normal production system. Extraordinary Deaf, the screenplay is by Marco Ferreri and Rafel Azcona.

title: La morte cammina con i tacchi alti
actors: Susan Scott, Frank Wolff, Simon Andreu, Carlo Gentili
description: Nicole Rochard's (Scott) father was killed on the train to France shortly after carrying out a diamond theft. Nicole is a stripper and she knows nothing about that story, but there is someone who is convinced that, before dying, her father entrusted the diamonds to her. In the Italian yellow genre, Ercoli's works do not shine either for originality or for mastery. Shot in co-production with the Spaniards, this is just a very weak film.

title: His Majesty O'Keefe
actors: Burt Lancaster, Joan Rice, André Morell, Abraham Sofaer, Archie Savage
description: A captain is abandoned adrift by his mutinous sailors. He ends up on an island where he wins the favor of the natives. Later, with the help of a Chinese from Hong Kong, he starts the coconut trade, but is attacked and injured by pirates. Cared for by a young white girl, he falls in love with her. Folklore adventure film.

title: The Sandpiper
actors: Elizabeth Taylor, Richard Burton, Eve Marie Saint
description: Laura Taylor is a nonconformist and vaguely hippy painter. She lives alone with her little son Danny as she refused to marry his father. When the court requires her to entrust the boy to a boarding school to receive adequate education, Laura enters into a relationship with the staid head of the boarding school, a Protestant pastor married to the father of twins. She lives it without problems, but he is macerated with remorse. Between the two contenders, it is logical that the children are the ones who pay the price for the situation.
notes: Sentimental drama too pushed towards ... the border of the ridiculous. Oscar to the song.

title: Ci troviamo in galleria
actors: Nilla Pizzi, Carlo Dapporto, Mario Carotenuto, Sophia Loren, Alberto Sordi
description: Ignazio Panizza treads the scenes of the avanspectacle with the stage name of "Gardenio". Perhaps this is why success does not smile on him. In a mountain village, after the usual disastrous performance, he listens to a singer with a beautiful voice and hires her. He soon became her husband. The woman goes from success to success while he continues to remain in the shadows. One evening, the woman organizes an evening of honor for her husband who, moved, can taste success for once. Graceful comedy that reconstructs the world of variety, with all its typical characters, its characterizing specks and its vaguely retro taste.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles II - The Secret of Ooze
actors: Paige Turco, David Warner, Kevin Clash, Michelan Sisti
description: Donatello, Raffaello, Michelangelo and Leonardo, the four turtles skilled in martial arts and in gobbling pizzas, live in New York at the home of the journalist April. The evil Shredder wants to build his own army of mutants using the same fluid that years earlier had also given rise to the ninja turtles. For the purpose, he kidnaps a scientist (Warner). Ninja puppet movies are fun, loud, multicolored, over the top and fast paced. The only problem is that the series doesn't seem to have a big breath. Already in the second episode the inventions became more predictable and the audience itself reacted in a much less warm way.

title: I prepotenti
actors: Aldo Fabrizi, Ave Ninchi, Nino Taranto, Mario Riva, Ferruccio Amendola
description: A long series of quarrels between two families, one Roman and the other Neapolitan, ends with an engagement. Amusing jumble of regionalist parochialism, adequately supported by the actors on the field. The film had a good success and today it remains enjoyable even without great pretensions.

title: Once Around
actors: Richard Dreyfuss, Holly Hunter, Danny Aiello, Gena Rowlands, Laura San Giacomo
description: Renata Bella has lived up to now without engaging romantically with anyone. The warm family atmosphere that surrounds her was enough for her. But when the older sister gets married, something clicks inside her too. She tries to force her boyfriend to make a final decision; in the face of his refusal he leaves him. Then she went to the Antilles for a professional internship, she met Sam, a middle-aged man, arrived and exuberant.
notes: The Swedish Lasse Hallström had captured the attention of Hollywood with his debut film, also released by us with the title "My life on 4 paws". The film moves between comedy and melodrama, on a subject that is actually a bit weak, but still contains positive elements.

title: The Sell-Out
actors: Richard Widmark, Oliver Reed, Gayle Hunnicutt, Sam Wanamaker
description: A former CIA agent, now an antiquarian in Jerusalem, welcomes and protects a former colleague hunted by the secret services of the East and the West. Complicated romance and all cliché.

title: A Man Alone
actors: Ray Milland, Mary Murphy, Ward Bond, Raymond Burr, Arthur Space
description: Wes, a gunslinger who has already had some trouble with the law (he was accused of having carried out a robbery), risks being framed for a crime he did not commit. Curious chamber western directed and performed by Milland without great inventiveness, but trying to tackle some stereotypes of the genre on the counterattack.

title: Salem's Lot: the Movie
actors: David Soul, James Mason, Bonnie Bedelia
description: A writer expert in paranormal phenomena returns to his hometown, discovers that it has fallen into the hands of vampires and defeats them. From a Stephen King novel, it was originally a two-part mini TV series, later refurbished into this version for the big screen. Hooper wallows in his own genre, and Mason is ambiguous enough.

title: Alive
actors: Ethan Hawke, Vincent Spano, Josh Hamilton, Bruce Ramsay
description: On 13 October 1972 a passenger plane with a rugby team on board crashes in the Andes. The survivors struggle for survival in the bitter cold, until hunger drives them to eat the corpses. Three young people decide to seek help by walking through the mountains. On 23 December they reach the civilized world and return by helicopter to rescue their friends who are still alive.
notes: Faithful and realistic as you like, the reconstruction of this real disaster is a disappointing spectacle, even of little dramatic effect. The story had already inspired another low-budget Mexican film, directed by René Cardona jr.

title: Piedone d'Egitto
actors: Bud Spencer, Enzo Cannavale, Baldwyn Dakile, Angelo Infanti, Cinzia Monreale, Robert Loggia
description: On the basis of a few clues, Commissioner Rizzo, called Piedone, Marshal Caputo and Bodo, a black boy friend of Piedone, look for a scientist in Egypt, kidnapped because he is the custodian of very important secrets on the exploitation of oil. Botte da orbi as thunderous as harmless, for a successful film thanks also to the "shoulder" Cannavale and the trusted Bodo.

title: Buddy Buddy
actors: Jack Lemmon, Walter Matthau, Paula Prentiss, Klaus Kinsky
description: Trabucco (Walter Matthau), a killer by profession, and Victor Clooney (Jack Lemmon), a TV censor and would-be suicide by marriage crisis, find themselves door to door in the same hotel. Trabucco must kill a witness; Clooney, almost unwittingly, stops him. However, the attack succeeds, but Trabucco, a refugee on a remote Pacific island, never gets rid of Clooney. Hollywood remake of the French film "L'emmerdeur" (The pain in the ass), directed in 1973 by Edouard Molinaro, this, by the seventy-six-year-old Billy Wilder, is perhaps less hilarious, but much more "bad". The close-knit Matthau and Lemmon are always two "sacred monsters".

title: Ferragosto in bikini
actors: Walter Chiari, Raimondo Vianello, Ennio Girolami, Valeria Fabrizi
description: From Rome the people go to Fregene for the mid-August: Cavalier Bonaccorsi full of debts with a secretary in tow; Heinrich, former Wermacht officer, with his friend Ainé; the very jealous accountant Piccoli who spies on his wife; Dario and Denise, two young people who love each other; a pseudo Protestant pastor with his wife, equally pseudo; the two thieves Raf and Carlo in search of prey, and so on.
notes: Stupid of absolute inconsistency and discrete vulgarity built on the alibi of August. An anthology of (dull) jokes.

title: A Divina Comédia
actors: Maria De Medeiros, Miguel Guilherme, Luis Miguel Cintra, Mario Viegas
description: It is not the transposition of Dante's "Comedy", but a reflection on the human condition built on the dialogue of some guests of a nursing home for insane people who believe themselves to be Adam, Eve, Maria, Martha, Sonia and Raskolnikov from "Crime and punishment" , Ivan and Alioscia of the "Brothers Karamazov".
