The great themes of existence and transcendence filtered by De Oliveira with virtuosic elegance. When he made the film, the director was 83 and he was fresher and more intelligent than ever. The film is anything but a sermon. If anything, a very enjoyable encounter between the Sacred Mystery and the Funny Mystery, under the banner of an unattainable class.

title: Intrigo a Taormina
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Walter Chiari, Sylva Koscina, Gino Cervi
description: On Commendator Lemeni's yacht, leaving for a cruise from Lacco Ameno di Ischia, a man who wants to divorce chooses a new partner for his wife: the ex-husband of his lover; Luciana, taken aboard hoping that she will be able to "wake up" the sluggish son of the Commendatore, finds love elsewhere; the photographer Walter manages to "fix" his suffocating girlfriend with the apathetic scion of the host. The texture is thin and, as a filler, tourist-sports digressions are used.

title: Beau Geste
actors: Gary Cooper, Robert Preston, Ray Milland, Brian Donlevy
description: To try to prevent their adoptive mother's unscrupulous husband from stealing a very precious jewel, three orphans decide to steal it. In order not to be accused of the theft of the precious jewel they are forced to enlist in the Foreign Legion. As soon as they arrive in Morocco, the three men realize how hard military life is. On their way, in addition to ferocious Tuaregs, the newly enlisted also find a sadistic sergeant.
notes: The film had two Oscar nominations, one for Brian Donlevy and another for editing. The scene of the fort defended by corpses is famous. Great performance by Gary Cooper.

title: Due mafiosi nel Far West
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Aroldo Tieri, Hélène Chanel
description: Two "picciotti" inherit a gold mine from two elderly relatives who emigrated to the United States some time before. To take possession of it they go from Sicily to the village of Puerca Vaca where, however, they find the hostility of the bandit Rio and his gang, intent on getting their hands on the precious metal. Elected sheriffs for fortuitous reasons, with the help of the population they manage to defeat the criminals and ...
notes: Modest performance of the classic Franco and Ciccio repertoire. A couple of gags (including Franco's poker) get some laughs.

title: Le coppie
directors: Mario Monicelli, Alberto Sordi, Vittorio De Sica
actors: Monica Vitti, Alberto Sordi, Enzo Jannacci, Rossana Di Lorenzo
description: Gavino and Adelina Puddu, two Sardinian spouses who emigrated to Turin decide to buy a refrigerator in installments. When the time has come to settle the bill, Gavino loses the money. He will get the money with a very special expedient. A metalworker and his wife want to celebrate their tenth wedding anniversary in a luxury hotel, frequented by sovereigns and industrialists. The welcome given to them is anything but hospitable. Two lovers find themselves locked in their room by a lion who has escaped from a circus, which blocks the door of the house.
notes: To report the episode in which Jannacci plays in Sardinian (!) For the rest, a mediocre film in episodes, sub-genre marked the crisis of the Italian comedy.

title: Ator l'invincibile
actors: Miles O'Keeffe, Sabrina Siani, Ritza Brown
description: Having escaped the massacre of the innocents, little Ator grows up cared for by the wise warrior Griba. Once grown, he defeats the evil high priest.

title: California Holiday/Spinout
actors: Elvis Presley, Shelly Fabares, Carl Betz, Diane McBain, Dodie Marshall
description: Singer Mick McCoy travels with his small band and is happy with the life he leads. But three girls, Cynthia, Diana and Lee, are on his way, willing to do anything to win him over. While the girls get busy, Cynthia's father tries to convince Mick to drive a racing car on the Santa Fé circuit.
notes: Norman Taurog is seen to have run out of narrative, but Elvis is still fascinating.

title: C'era una volta
actors: Omar Sharif, Sophia Loren, George Wilson, Dolores Del Rio
description: In the seventeenth century, in Naples, the Spanish prince Rodrigo was cornered by his father to marry, naturally with a noblewoman. The young scion, however, has long set his sights on a beautiful and busty commoner, Isabella, who, to conquer him, does not disdain to resort to bills, magic filters and the prophecies of San Giuseppe da Copertino. At first his efforts seem to have the opposite results, but then everything works out. Francesco Rosi makes a foray into the world of fairy tales using a short story by Gianbattista Basile as a basis. The result is a baroque and, at times, grotesque story. Great success for the Loren-Sharif couple.

title: Rugantino
actors: Adriano Celentano, Claudia Mori, Toni Ucci, Renzo Palmer, Renato Baldini
description: Rugantino (Celentano) loves Rosina (Mori) who is married to the violent Gnecco. When he is killed by a conspirator, the blame invariably falls on Rugantino who accepts, out of pride, to go up to the gallows.
notes: From the musical comedy of Garinei and Giovannini. Celentano in the Trastevere version is unlikely but energetic. It can be considered as the first commercial success of the Molleilato.

title: Peccati d'estate
actors: Dorian Gray, Daniela Rocca, Elaine Stewart
description: A Milanese industrialist spends all his free time (and his money) on extramarital affairs. His wife tries in every way to bring him back on the right path but his attempts prove fruitless. So he decides to go on the attack, playing on his own turf. Discreet sentimental comedy even if played on stereotypes. The soundtrack by Lelio Luttazzi is interesting, with a song by Umberto Bindi.

title: Das letzte U-Boot
actors: Ulrich Muehe, Manfred Zapatka, Ulrich Tukur, Kaoru Kobayashi
description: In April 1945 a German submarine is charged with bringing a cargo of uranium to Japan which should be used for the construction of the atomic bomb ...

title: Perché quelle strane gocce di sangue sul corpo di Jennifer?
actors: Edwige Fenech, George Hilton, Paola Quattrini, Giampiero Albertini
description: Marilyn and her friend Jennifer, both models, go to live in a building in which two girls were recently killed. The police follow a line of investigation that leads to suspicion of the architect Andrea Antinori, a friend of Jennifer, but he is not found. Meanwhile, still in the same building, Jennifer is attacked by the real killer while in the company of Sheena. A widely predictable and suspense-free thriller with a young Fenech.

title: Heart and Souls
actors: Robert Downey jr., Charles Grodin, Alfre Woodward, Tom Sizemore, Elisabeth Shue
description: San Francisco 1959: a bus crashes from a viaduct to avoid a collision with a car that is taking a lady to the hospital where little Thomas will be born. Four people are killed, but from that moment their angelic task will be to watch over the newborn baby. Then little Thomas grows up and becomes a lousy yuppy, but they don't lose heart.
notes: There is no point in bothering Lubitsch, but for such a film it would have taken at least Herbert Ross. On the other hand, the rude Underwood is completely unsuitable. If the film does not become unwatchable after two minutes it is only thanks to the cast (especially the four angels are amazing).

title: Ticks
actors: Ami Dolenz, Rosalind Allen, Seth Green, Alfonso Ribeiro
description: A social worker and a sociologist organize the vacation of a group of teenagers in Northern California. The guys aren't thrilled with the idea and the follow-up proves them right. As soon as they arrive in the forest they begin to be attacked by strange mutant animals capable of sucking the saliva of the unfortunates they manage to reach. Final scene with the horde of insects marching towards the boys' hut.
notes: Yet another horror variant on the perverse nature of chemical agents that produce biological mutations: in this case it is fertilizers used to grow marijuana. What is not clear is why Randel believes he is a director.

title: Costa Azzurra
actors: Alberto Sordi, Giovanna Ralli, Elsa Martinelli, Franco Fabrizi
description: An American diva renounces love so as not to ruin the family of the man she is with. A young woman, between her wealthy partner and the penniless journalist who courts her, chooses wealth. A girl makes a schoolboy lose his mind. Two Sicilians on their honeymoon risk throwing their happiness overboard. A Roman greengrocer is "saved" by his wise wife. The Côte d'Azur does its duty as a setting with great landscape qualities. The various vicissitudes of the film do it a little less, weak as they are almost all. The best is in the couple Alberto Sordi-Giovanna Ralli, but the whole is very little.

title: Three Ring Circus
actors: Dean Martin, Jerry Lewis, Joanne Dru, Zsa Zsa Gabor
description: Pete and Jerry find work in a circus after their military service. While Jerry becomes an excellent clown, Pete makes a career as an organizer and, with the help of trapeze artist Saadia, gets to run the circus himself. But not all of his initiatives are fair, and refusing to organize a children's benefit show turns him against the troupe. Then, however, everything is sorted out. The magical atmosphere of the circus strikes again. Perhaps the harmony between Martin and Lewis works a little less well here than on other occasions, but the setting of the circus show patches up the cracks of a fairly modest story.

title: La captive du désert
actors: Sandrine Bonnaire, Dobi Kore, Dobi Achinke, Atchi Wahi-Li
description: A young European girl is a prisoner in the Sahara of a tribe of nomads, as a hostage for a cause she does not know. No one ever speaks to her, only, in rare moments, the children playing. The woman escapes, wanders in the desert and is brought back to the tribe by a little boy who has found her, exhausted. Days, weeks, months go by, until she is told that the next day she will be released. From a real story, Depardon has written and directed a film that is a difficult bet: almost no action, almost no words, the rigorous visualization of a dramatic loneliness. With Sandrine Bonnaire, a winning bet.

title: Square Triangle - Flight Pat - Kill Straker
actors: Ed Bishop, George Sewell, Michael Billington
description: Captain Foster's ship is attacked by aliens and upon returning to Moon Base, both he and the pilot show strange signs of hostility and try to kill Commander Straker ...
notes: The film is the three-episode adaptation (_The Square Triangle_, _Flight Pat_ and _Kill Straker! _) Of the cult science fiction series _Ufo_.

title: Dr. M
actors: Alan Bates, Jennifer Beals, Jan Niklas, Hans Zischler
description: A wave of suicides shakes Berlin. An inspector (whose wife has killed herself) leads the investigation that leads him on the trail of the shady owner of the mysterious Theratos club. Chabrol is evidently inspired by Fritz Lang's films on Dr. Mabuse, updating their themes to developments in the mass media. The idea is curious, the atmospheres sometimes disturbing, but the execution is strangely listless.

title: Dogfight
actors: River Phoenix, Lili Taylor, Richard Panebianco, Anthony Clark
description: It is November 21, 1963, Eddie Birdlace (River Phoenix) and three of his friends are leaving for the Vietnam War. But before leaving they have the bad taste to organize a cruel bet between them: the winner is whoever manages to bring the ugliest girl to a party. With some effort Eddie manages to convince a young waitress, Rose Fenney (Taylor). The next day Kennedy is killed.
notes: After a very captivating debut ("True Love"), Nancy Savoca makes a deliberately unpleasant film, which becomes a powerful allegory of a nation and a generation. Great performance of the actors. Even if taking Lili Taylor (she was the New York Times correspondent in "Prêt-à-porter") to be ugly is a bit 'nonsense.

title: Mrs. Soffel
actors: Diane Keaton, Mel Gibson, Matthew Modine, Trini Alvarado
description: We are close to Christmas 1901 and Kate Soffel (Keaton), wife of the warden of the Pittsburgh prison, sends her charitable wishes to all the inmates. Among them is Ed Biddle (Gibson) sentenced to death, with his brother Jack (Modine), for theft and murder. She visits them in jail to read the bible, but the attraction for Ed is stronger than all the rest.
notes: Mark Isham's music is fascinating and the actors are impeccable from first to last. Which, said in Italian, means that this film is a deadly bore. One of those films that are unassailable from many points of view, but also absolutely exhausting.

title: Flying Down to Rio
actors: Dolores Del Rio, Ginger Rogers, Fred Astaire, Gene Raymond
description: The owner of a club in Rio de Janeiro has been reduced to a bad start because the clientele has progressively deserted his place. To relaunch the meeting he sets up a variety and launches a new dance: the "carioca". Some shady individuals try to boycott the company but the aviator boyfriend of the master's daughter solves the matter with a magnificent gimmick.
notes: First cinematic performance by the Rogers-Astaire couple, still relegated to a secondary plot, they conquer audiences all over the world with the number "Carioca".

title: Johnny Reno
actors: Dana Andrews, Jane Russell, Lon Chaney jr.
description: While heading to Chanson, to reunite with his woman, Federal Sheriff Johnny Reno is shot at by two individuals: he kills one and captures the other, a certain John Conners. In town, Mayor Yez would like Conners to be handed over to the Indians because he is accused of the murder of Little Bear's son. Western cheap and almost pathetic in its lingering on stereotypes. The interpreters were all at sunset.

title: Battling for Baby
actors: Debbie Reynolds, Suzanne Pleshette, Courteney Cox, John Terlesky
description: Helen (Reynolds) and Marie (Pleshette) have known each other since they were little girls. Then one, Marie, became an appreciated concert performer, the other started working as a hairdresser. Over the years, to tell the truth, the relations between the two have deteriorated. And the news that their respective children, Katherine and Philip, have married and are expecting an heir, doesn't help matters. Do you remember Suzanne Pleshette still young in Hitchcock's "The Birds"? And do you remember Debbie Reynolds singing in the rain with Gene Kelly? Well: they have both aged. And judging by this film, they've gotten pretty sour too.

title: The Aviator
actors: Christopher Reeve, Rosanna Arquette, Jack Warden, Sam Wanamaker
description: Texas, 1918: Edgar Anscombe is a US Air Force flight instructor. While witnessing a rookie he is forced into a forced landing, during which the young man is killed and Edgar is wounded and forever emotionally compromised. Comforted by his boss Moravia, he meets his sixteen-year-old daughter: and thanks to another plane crash, he falls in love with her ...
notes: The feelings are shouted, the dialogues inappropriate, the conclusions (?) Left to the viewer; the landscapes - beautiful - do not redeem the wavering construction of the plot. George Miller, director of _The Man by the Snowy River_, is just the namesake of the author of the Mad Max series.

title: American Guerrilla in the Philippines
actors: Tyrone Power, Micheline Presle, Tom Ewell, Jack Elam
description: Eight Americans who miraculously survived a Japanese air attack land on the Philippine coast and decide to split up. Lieutenant Chuck Palmer tries in vain to fly to a plane that will take him to Australia. He then contacts the Filipino resistance in the people of Martinez and his wife Jeanne, two plantation owners. Thanks to them, Chuck comes into contact with an American officer who is in charge of the resistance. In Bogdanovich's interview, Lang states "Directors have to eat too." This is to say that this film hadn't really come from his heart. In fact, it's a pure action movie, enjoyable but impersonal.

title: De Mayerling à Sarajevo
actors: Edwige Feuillère, John Lodge, Gabrielle Dorziat
description: It is the story of Francesco Ferdinando d'Este, heir to the throne and grandson of Francesco Giuseppe. Of his happy, as opposed, marriage to the Czech countess Sophie Chotek married to a marriage that excluded her from the inheritance line as a lower class, and of their killing in Sarajevo by the student Gavrilo Princip. Action that will start the First World War. Ophüls deserves the credit for having staged the tragedy that led to the Great War for the first time. The shooting of the film, ironically, had to be interrupted in September 1939, at the outbreak of the Second World War and then resumed in February 1940.

title: Le tardone
actors: Didi Perego, Ave Ninchi, Walter Chiari, Raimondo Vianello
description: Episode film: a widow takes revenge for the jokes she suffers; two killers kill the husband instead of the wife; an actress pretends to be younger thanks to a trick; a mature woman wins the competition of a girl; an industrialist drives an employee into adultery with his wife. Classic comedy with episodes; but it is worth seeing it to find some forgotten actresses (especially Franca Marzi).

title: Il secondo tragico Fantozzi
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Anna Mazzamauro, Gigi Reder, Ugo Bologna, Antonino Faà Di Bruno
description: From Montecarlo where it inflates with water until it takes off like a balloon, to Genoa where the bottle of champagne destined for the launch of a ship crashes on its head, to Rome where a very ferocious Great Dane follows it, to Agrigento where it is shot as a circus bullet man, in Capri where he causes an earthquake by crashing into the Faraglioni ... the world is always against the unhappy accountant Ugo.
notes: Still under the direction of Luciano Salce, the second chapter of Fantozzi's catastrophes is completely detached from a plausible reality, with an even more absurd dimension, and is perhaps the best of the series. Memorable the episode of the cineforum, with the famous line of the exhausted accountant: "The battleship Kotiomkin is a crazy shit!".

title: The Professionals
actors: Burt Lancaster, Lee Marvin, Robert Ryan, Jack Palance, Claudia Cardinale
description: Rasa, a Mexican revolutionary, has kidnapped the wife of the wealthy Mr. Grant, who hires four men to free her and bring her home: Bill, an explosives expert; Harry, an Army veteran; Hans, expert on horses; Jack, a very skilled hunter at lasso throwing. The four, enticed by the reward, overcome the pitfalls of the desert and the mountains between Texas and Mexico and manage to free the woman. But, having completed the mission, they discover that hers had been a forced marriage and that, before, she had been Rasa's woman. At the origin of the film is the novel "A Mule for the Marquesa" by Frank O'Rourke, which Brooks uses as a classic western canvas for one of the most lucid political films of those years. The liberal disenchantment, the contradictions and the needs of the revolution (in a famous final speech by Lancaster that overturns the moral of Kazan's "Viva Zapata"), memorable jokes, ambiguous and complex characters and a rhythm of a great classic "dirty". Perhaps Brooks's masterpiece.

title: Passport to Murder
actors: Connie Sellecca, Ed Marinaro, Pavel Douglas, Peter Bowles
description: Helen Hollander (Connie Sellecca) has a failed marriage, a lot of money and a great desire to take a vacation. The choice falls on Paris where the young American lands triumphantly and where she is incredibly mistaken for an arms dealer. Luckily Hank McCabe (Ed Marinaro), the detective her ex-husband hired to stalk her, fortunately saves her from worse trouble. David Hemmings is famous for two things: having made a film as an actor with Michelangelo Antonioni ("Blow Up") and having directed a film with Marlene Dietrich ("Gigolò"). The rest of his career is completely negligible. Including this movie.

title: Heartbeat
actors: John Ritter, Polly Draper, Kevin Kilner, Michael Lembeck
description: Adrian Townsend (Polly Draper) is a TV producer and is unhappily married to Steven, someone who had a difficult childhood and doesn't even want to hear about children. The same TV network also works Bill Grant (Johnny Ritter), author of soap-opera, good, sensitive and absolutely bored by all the curvy pin-ups with whom he goes out every night. In short: love is born between the two. A very successful TV-movie in the USA thanks to the original text by Danielle Steel, in the presence of Johnny Ritter ("... and everyone laughed") and thanks also to the fact that the formula is infallible: a little bit of tears, a few laughs , and a lot, a lot of feeling.

title: Ensayo de un crimen
actors: Ernest Alonso, Myroslava Stern, Rita Macedo, Ariadna Welter
description: Alejandro saw his housekeeper die as a child and had a shock that leads him as an adult, to a murderous obsession with women every time he hears the music of a music box that also played on the occasion of that first death. But something always happens where his murderous impulse comes ... late, but he feels (wants to feel) guilty. One of the most remarkable results in Buñuel's filmography during his Mexican "exile": surrealist inventiveness, taste for paradox, caustic irony. A small masterpiece in which the director hits his targets with infallible aim.

title: Assassinio sul Tevere
actors: Tomas Milian, Marina Lante della Rovere, Roberta Manfredi, Bombolo
description: Manfredo Ruffini, a member of the "Tiberina Family", an unsuspected criminal association, is stabbed and the obtuse prosecutor of the republic arrests the owner of the boat on which the crime was committed. But the marshal Nico Giraldi, known as "Monnezza" for his methods which are certainly not refined, is not convinced and, although he has been deprived of the investigations, he works on his own and arrives at the truth.
notes: In the series of films built on the character of Monnezza / Tomas Milian, this is one of the least sinister. Which does not mean that it is passable: usual shameless game with assorted vulgarities, usual lack of ideas, usual heavy jokes.

title: Valentino
actors: Rudolf Nureyev, Leslie Caron, Michelle Philips, Carol Kane, Felicity Kendal, Seymour Cassel, Huntz Hall, Alfred Marks, David de Keyser, Linda Thorson, Leland Palmer, Lindsay Kemp, Peter Vaughan, Anthony Dowell, Penelope Milford
description: Emigrated from Puglia, Rodolfo Gugliemi (born in 1895) manages to make his fortune in Hollywood. During the filming of the "Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse" he meets Natascia Rambova who becomes his wife. First linked to Paramount, Valentino moves to United Artists. Meanwhile, Natasha divorces him. In 1926 he died after winning a boxing and alcohol challenge with a reporter to prove his manhood.
notes: Ken Russell, a whimsical director like few others, here puts a stop to his sometimes disconcerting figurative inventions, but not at the very fast pace of his narration. The film is sumptuous, and the great dancer Nureyev gives the protagonist an admirable liveliness.

title: The Texican
actors: Audie Murphy, Broderick Crawford
description: Armed with suspicion (but not evidence) and a desire for revenge, Ringo hunts down his brother's killer. Find some allies and many enemies. Anonymous B-series western directed by a prolific specialist and played by the big boy Murphy.

title: The Ambushers
actors: Dean Martin, Senta Berger
description: The search for a missing flying saucer with its owner leads secret agent Matt to a den of totalitarian fanatics, just in time to thwart their plans.

title: Cisco Pike
actors: Gene Hackman, Karen Black, Kris Kristofferson, Harry Dean Stanton
description: Cisco Pike, ex-rock singer, wants to get rid of drugs. A dilapidated policeman on the verge of retirement forces him into one last, huge drug deal. Nice 70s noir, melancholy but above all tense and exciting, with Kris Kristofferson singing several songs.

title: Milano calibro 9
actors: Gastone Moschin, Barbara Bouchet, Mario Adorf, Frank Wolff, Luigi Pistilli, Ivo Garrani, Philippe Leroy, Lionel Stander, Mario Novelli, Giuseppe Castellano, Salvatore Arico, Fernando Cerulli, Giulio Baraghini
description: Accused of trying to cheat the boss, the gangster Ugo is forced to kill in order not to be killed. A guy takes his side and avenges him when his woman cheats on him and gets him killed by her new lover.
notes: Very loosely based on a Scerbanenco mystery, one of the best films by Fernando Di Leo, the recently revalued Italian master of noir. Beautiful suspense, excellent direction of the actors ..

title: Accadde al commissariato
actors: Nino Taranto, Walter Chiari, Lucia Bosé, Alberto Sordi
description: A gruff but beneficial police commissioner (Nino Taranto) is grappling, in the space of twenty-four hours, with a series of human cases. The last is that of an abandoned child that he and his wife would like to adopt with great difficulty.
notes: Not an excellent comedy that takes advantage of the natural verve of some of the protagonists without too much inventiveness (Sordi hilarious in the role of a street vendor) and follows the formula of films such as "A day in the district court" by Steno (a great success of the previous year). However, the role of Nino Taranto, an actor too often relegated to the roles of "shoulder", is of importance.

title: On Wings of Eagles
actors: Burt Lancaster, Richard Crenna
description: American billionaire Ross Perot (himself, the presidential candidate) tries to save two of his collaborators from the Khomeini prisons of Iran. Action film that wastes even the old Lancaster.

title: The Little Girl Who Lives Down the Lane
actors: Jodie Foster, Martin Sheen
description: A thirteen year old left to herself struggling with her loneliness, with intrusive or violent attention from others, with the weight of her own extreme actions. A drama that slides towards psychological horror, with an effective description of the environment and a very young and disturbing Foster.

title: Coneheads
actors: Dan Aykroyd, Jane Curtin, Michelle Burke, Michael McKean
description: A spaceship carrying a pair of Remulakians, Beldar and Prymaat, crashes into the East River. The two, who have skulls in the shape of a very long cone, prepare to live on Earth where they begin to feel good (apart from the controls of the immigration police). Taken from a very successful television series, the film is the cinematographic extension of it, full of references to the series of the same name that are practically unintelligible to the European viewer.

title: Rigoletto e la sua tragedia
actors: Aldo Silvani, Janet Vidor, Gérard Landry, Cesare Polacco
description: The Duke of Mantua, a libertine always in search of new amorous adventures, is surrounded by a host of courtiers whose only concern is to flatter and please him. Rigoletto, the court jester, on the other hand, does nothing but tease them all the time. Naturally the courtiers hate him and in agreement with the Count of Ceprano they promote an atrocious mockery against him.
notes: Second version of Verdi's opera, after that of Gallone in 1946, again with the voice of Tito Gobbi.

title: Bad Dreams
actors: Jennifer Rubin, Bruce Abbott, Richard Lynch, Harris Yulin
description: Cynthia survives the collective suicide of a mad reverend and his sect. She is safe, but rather battered, so much so that she remains in a coma for thirteen years. Out of the coma, she is entrusted to a psychiatrist. Despite so many years having passed, she continues to be haunted by visions of the terrible "guru", as strange and horrible suicides begin to occur in her therapeutic group.
notes: Reagan America of the 1980s does not re-read the era of the counterculture, it simply remembers it as a nightmare. On the value of the spectacle it would be better to remain silent; psychologisms and effects galore.

title: Tre croci per non morire
actors: Ken Wood, Craig Hill, Peter White, Evelyn Stewart
description: Three gunslingers ended up in jail come into contact here with a young man sentenced to death although innocent. Having learned of some secrets of the boy, who spoke during a delusion, they are mysteriously released with the task of proving the innocence of the young man. Western spaghetti not memorable.

title: The Thin Man
actors: Myrna Loy, William Powell, Maureen O'Sullivan, Nat Pendleton
description: A distinguished amateur detective, his aristocratic lady (plus their lively dog ??named Asta) undertakes to collaborate with the police in an investigation to find a mysteriously missing scientist.
notes: From a novel by Dashiell Hammett, the prototype of all the yellow-pinks to come. The irresistible lightness of the Loy-Powell couple is truly inimitable. Van Dyke shot the film in just two weeks. The film launched a full-fledged series (five films up to 1947). The fox terrier Asta also became a small celebrity.

title: The Awful Truth
actors: Cary Grant, Irene Dunne, Ralph Bellamy, Alexander D'Arcy
description: A couple decides to divorce, but ninety days must pass before the divorce becomes legal. In this period, having changed his mind, he messes up her new engagement and regains her love. Delightful sophisticated 1930s comedy: light and sparkling but with a vitriolic undertone, and a creeping melancholy. Oscar for the direction of McCarey.

title: The Karate Kid
actors: Noriyuki Pat Morita, Ralph Macchio, Elisabeth Shue, Martin Kove
description: Daniel, without a father and with a mother who is forced to move to California for work, leaves his native New Jersey. In San Fernando Valley Daniel immediately falls in love with the young Ali, but is then forced to endure the harassment of her boyfriend, a karate champion. Master Miyagi will teach him the art of karate and also that of becoming an adult.

title: House
actors: William Katt, George Wendt
description: Fresh from Vietnam, the abandonment of his wife and the loss of a child, Roger seeks refuge in an empty house. But there all his nightmares assail him. Effective horror with a few touches of irony.

title: The Disorderly Orderly
actors: Jerry Lewis, Glenda Farrell, Everett Sloane, Karen Sharpe
description: Jerry Lewis, a kind and caring but clumsy and clumsy nurse, saves a girl from suicide and finds love.
notes: Among the lesser-known films with Jerry Lewis, it is actually a comedy of refined intelligence, directed with excellent sense of rhythm by Frank Tashlin (also writer). Lewis, comedian devastator, indulges in a long series of irresistible gags. Misleading the Italian title. To be re-evaluated quickly.

title: Le cameriere
actors: Giovanna Ralli, Valeria Moriconi, Xenia Valderi, Sergio Raimondi
description: Giovanna, a maid with a wealthy family, is accused of having stolen a necklace belonging to her mistress. Innocent, but unable to prove it (she should tell a story that her boyfriend might misinterpret), she is denounced. Then her colleagues who work in the building enter the scene and, thanks to a ruse, the real culprit is unmasked. The idea of ??a group of maids engaging in the unusual role of detective is not bad. We don't go much beyond this, but the narrative hold is discreet and, all in all, the film is quite funny.

title: Project X
actors: Matthew Broderick, Helen Hunt, William Sadler, Jonathan Stark
description: Simulated flight experiments with chimpanzees are conducted at an American air force base. In the base a young pilot (Broderick) happens to become attached to one of the monkeys. Thus he discovers that the animals are actually used for a top secret atomic experiment and that they are doomed to death. With a good dose of courage and the help of a scientist, the pilot manages to save his chimpanzee friend. Apparently light and spectacular film with a denunciation of the aberrations that technology can bring.

title: Le bambole
directors: Dino Risi, Luigi Comencini, Franco Rossi, Mauro Bolognini
actors: Nino Manfredi, Elke Sommer, Monica Vitti, Gina Lollobrigida, Jean Sorel, Piero Focaccia, Virna Lisi, Maurizio Arena, Akim Tamiroff
description: The phone call between the wife and the mother-in-law never ends and the husband flirts with a beautiful neighbor. A young Swede has come to Italy to look for the perfect father for her perfect son, but then she chooses a man who is anything but an Adonis. Giovanna plans the elimination of that peasant husband of her, but does not conclude. How to be delivered, for erotic purposes, by a monsignor his nephew. A "vacation" for four directors, under the banner of vulgarity rather than comedy. Franco Rossi (third episode) is saved as staging, and the profession of actors. The rest is to be forgotten.

title: I due maghi del pallone
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Karin Schubert
description: Ciccio Ingrassetti, in charge of finding the coach for Pizzusiccu's team, signs a "magician", K.K., who is a fortune-teller who is completely unfamiliar with the game of football. For a fortunate set of circumstances (and thanks to an excellent striker) everything works wonders, until, on the eve of the derby with Ghindinedda, the striker is kidnapped. Then K. K. himself takes the field.
notes: In their genre (and, above all, for their audience) Franchi and Ingrassia were unbeatable, but scriptwriters and directors have almost always employed them with tales made at their best. This is not the worst. Nordic beauty is Karin Schubert before the erotic and hard turning point.

title: The Secret of the Incas
actors: Charlton Heston, Nicole Maurey, Robert Young, Thomas Mitchell
description: An American, Harry, and a Romanian girl join an archaeological expedition digging in the Incas area: Harry finds a precious gold disc, but a competitor steals it from him. Harry and the natives chase him: the villain falls into a ravine and they recover the precious object. Discreet adventure film that mixes exoticism and folklore.

title: Femmine tre volte
actors: Sylva Koscina, Mario Carotenuto, Bice Valori
description: The Soviet Union women's basketball team arrives in Rome to play a match. The athletes are closely monitored, but, as we know, the tighter the guard, the sharper the ingenuity is made to evade the controls. The wild girls will in fact be able to combine all the colors ...
notes: Discreet comedy full of specks and jokes.

title: Non si sevizia un paperino
actors: Florinda Bolkan, Barbara Bouchet, Tomas Milian, Irene Papas, Marc Porel, Georges Wilson
description: In a superstitious Lucanian village three children are cruelly killed. A journalist on vacation investigates with the carabinieri. Suspicions fall on a dissolute city lady who has come to detox, then on a witch. Both are found innocent, but the second, once released, is massacred by the parents of the little victims. The situation becomes gloomier when a fourth child is murdered.
notes: Non sivizia un donaldino is a thriller by Lucio Fulci that insists on the links between backwardness, superstition, the Catholic religion and eroticism. The attempt to create an unprecedented suspense starting from the Mediterranean landscape was successful. A couple of sequences (the stoning of Florinda Bolkan) are quite impressive.

title: Tradimento
actors: Mario Merola, Nino D'Angelo, Regina Bianchi, Ida Di Benedetto
description: Naples. Gennaro is an illegal peddler, his wife Carmela runs a drinks kiosk and his daughter Titina goes to elementary school. The little family would go on, but he rebels against the Camorra who ask for protection money on his trade. His wife turns to a shady lawyer, he snares her, she doesn't give in. Gennaro fights with the Camorra boss, ends up in prison and throws his wife out, deeming her unfaithful. For fans of the genre it is a film not to be missed given the contemporary performance of two superstars of the Neapolitan "drama". The final apotheosis of the sanctuary of Montevergine is from cult.

title: Intruders
actors: Richard Crenna, Mare Winningham, Susan Blakely, Daphen Ashbrook
description: For some time the military authorities have been recording strange reports attributable to visits from other planets, but they keep the strictest confidentiality on the subject. At the same time, a psychologist from Los Angeles discovered through hypnosis that two of his patients in shock were artificially fertilized by aliens to create a "middle race". Everything will be silenced. Nothing new in this "psychological" science fiction television film, an ideal sequel to a 1970s TV movie starring Harrison Ford. Its merit, however, is to create a good suspense based more on the "not shown" than on special effects, although the production made use of excellent specialists in computer "tricks".

title: Gettysburg
actors: Tom Berenger, Martin Sheen, Stephen Lang, Richard Jordan, Jeff Daniels
description: It is the story of the greatest battle of the American Civil War. In the intentions of the Confederate General Robert E. Lee, the battle to remove the town of Gettysburg from the control of the Union, which took place between 1 and 3 July 1863, should have reversed the fate of the Secession war, allowing him to impose his terms of peace on President Lincoln himself. Instead it was a ruinous defeat. Perhaps not everyone knows that this battle caused more casualties among American soldiers (at least 53,000) than any other in history.
notes: Monumental historical reconstruction, rather successful on a spectacular level. Based on the Pulitzer Prize winning novel "The Killer Angels" by Michael Shaara, it was shot in the national park on the Gettysburg battlefield. The extras are five thousand; the leading actors, Berenger and Sheen, very good.

title: Franco e Ciccio... ladro e guardia
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Gianni Agus, Giusi Raspani Dandolo
description: Brigadier Ciccio chases his cousin Franco, a professional thief, across the rooftops. The two rush into the room where a murder was committed and end up being suspects. The police, however, believe in their innocence and to find the real culprit they are hired in the circus where he seems to be hiding. The two nutcases make trouble and escape various attacks before everything is resolved.
notes: Another of the poor mass-produced products by Franchi and Ingrassia at the moment of maximum popularity. This time Franco's gags and mimic exuberance rest on a plot that recalls "Guards and Thieves" and the trend of American circus cinema.

title: Trapped
actors: Kathleen Quinlan, Bruce Abbott, Ben Loggins, Katy Boyer
description: Marianne, a young manager, works in the management center of the controversial Nts Industries. One evening, leaving work for last with a secretary, she finds the gates locked and the phones out of order and is confronted by a gunman. Marianne escapes on an elevator, the other is killed. Trapped in the palace and chased, Marianne runs into an industrial spy who she joins to face the killer. The responsibility for the weak direction and fragmentary script rests entirely with Walton. The whole thing stands thanks to the good interpretation of the protagonist, Kathleen Quinlan, and Bruce Abbott ("King Animator") who supports it worthily.

title: Gardens of Stone
actors: James Caan, James Earl Jones, Anjelica Huston, D.B. Sweeney, Mary Stuart Masterson
description: In Arlington, Virginia, a special department of the Army is in charge of honor guard service to fallen soldiers in Vietnam. The guard includes veterans Clee Hazard and Goody Nelson (a black and white) highly decorated veterans. Both are very good friends and take a liking to a rookie in whom they see the values ??they believed in reincarnated. It will be up to them to bury his body when he returns in a coffin from Vietnam. Almost ten years after "Apocalypse Now", Coppola is back to talking about Vietnam. But it does so with an inverted perspective: probing the pain of those who stay at home. James Caan's interpretation is excellent and very controlled.

title: Hot to Trot
actors: Bob Goldthwait, Virginia Madsen, Dabney Coleman, John Candy
description: Fred is a dull boy who inherited, on the death of his mother, half of a brokerage agency and Don, a prodigious horse: the beast is in fact gifted with not a little wit and even the gift of speech. Thanks to Don, Fred gets invaluable information on horse racing.
notes: The only funny thing about the film is the voice that the late John Candy in the original lent to the horse.

title: Smith!
actors: Glenn Ford, Chief Dan George, Nancy Olson, Warren Oates
description: Farmer Smith has always wanted to be on good terms with his Indian friends. Now he finds himself having to fight against prejudice and ignorance to defend one of his friends from the murder charge. Good family film, with a very human Glenn Ford and the excellent Chief Dan George who six years later, will participate in "One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest".

title: La battaglia di Algeri
actors: Brahim Haggiag, Jean Martin, Yacef Saadi, Tommaso Neri
description: Ali La Pointe, a simple former convict until 1954, was conquered by the ideals of the anti-colonial revolution. Three years later he headed the increasingly active National Liberation Front. But in 1957 Paris sent Colonel Mathieu's paratroopers, whose repression dismantled the resistance until Ali himself was liquidated.
notes: Detailed and dry, on the side of the Algerians without being Manichaean or triumphalistic, it is a successful hand-to-hand combat between cinema and great historical-political topicality that retains its dramatic and evocative power. Golden Lion in Venice and two Oscar nominations: to director Gillo Pontecorvo and to Franco Solinas for the screenplay. In France it was forbidden.

title: Son of Flubber
actors: Fred MacMurray, Nancy Olson, Keenan Wynn, Paul Lynde
description: Volcanic inventor, Brynard Flubber is haunted by the tax authorities, speculators, and justice. Even his jealous wife abandons him. Everything seems to go to hell for our hero when one of his inventions, from which he had only gotten into trouble so far, begins to give incredible results. Disney Production: It is the dignified, but not as entertaining, sequel to "A Professor in the Clouds".

title: A Woman Under the Influence
actors: Gena Rowlands, Peter Falk, Matthew Cassel, Matthew Labyorteaux
description: Mabel, married to the Italian-American Nick, with three children, feels the conflict with the reality that surrounds her grow, especially in the relationships with her husband whose work often keeps him away from home and who imposes such rhythms as to make him often nervous. and intractable. After yet another fight, Mabel suffers a nervous breakdown after which she has to spend a period in the clinic.
notes: Intense drama full of subtleties, where the excellent Gena Rowlands and Peter Falk tear each other up and confront themselves with an impressive veracity. One of the best wedding movies ever. Powerful final solo by Gena Rowlands.

title: Kill Straker, a Question of Priorities
actors: Ed Bishop, Suzanne Neve, Barnaby Saw, George Sewell, Sonia Fox
description: An officer who has the task of identifying and destroying hostile UFOs coming from space sacrifices on the altar of duty first marriage, then also the life of his son.
notes: The film is actually a reduction made with fragments of three episodes of the cult science fiction series _Ufo_.

title: The Haunted
actors: Jeffrey DeMunn, Sally Kirkland, Louise Latham, Joyce Van Patten
description: A small family from Pennsylvania moves into a new home where a series of terrifying phenomena soon unfold. Between movements of objects, noises, frightening voices and so on, they must fight above all in order not to lose their mind. The film, shot for TV, deals with events that were widely dealt with in the American news and is based on the book (1988 best-seller) in which the protagonist family narrated their experience. The realization has some effectiveness.

title: Guardatele, ma non toccatele
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Caprice Chantal, Johnny Dorelli, Raimondo Vianello, Fred Buscaglione
description: At an Italian military airport, the arrival of a US aircraft is reported and will have to land with its load of soldiers. Who turn out to be ... soldiers, in the riot of our airmen who ask for nothing better than to fraternize. Some complications arise, also due to a solemn drunk of the stars and stripes pilot, but then everything is resolved in the best way.
notes: No one has made an effort, in any phase of the realization - from the drafting of the subject onwards - to go beyond the stage of a miserable commitment, no one has put a little something in it beyond a minimum of profession. Should it be pointed out that it is a mediocre film?

title: Death Wish
actors: Charles Bronson, Vincent Gardenia, Hope Lange, William Redfield
description: One evening three thugs enter the house of the architect Paul Kersey, kill his wife and rape his daughter who ends up in an asylum. At that point, having also abandoned his job, Paul begins to think about getting justice for himself. His new business as a private executioner is a resounding success. Ordinary people side with him and the criminals themselves begin to fear him. Then a more stubborn policeman than others discovers his identity and convinces him to stop.
notes: It's not as bad as you normally think, and still not as bad as its sequels. Winner is good at action sequences and Bronson is not bad when he doesn't overdo it. Music by Herbie Hancock.

title: The Great Missouri Raid
actors: Macdonald Carey, Wendell Corey, Ward Bond, Ellen Drew, Bruce Bennett
description: Brothers Frank and Jesse James participate in the anti-Unionist guerrilla warfare during the Civil War. Once peace is restored, they would like to return to legality, but the persecution of the northern major Trowbridge, whose brother was killed by their gang at the time, prevents them. With other partisans of the South, Frank and Jesse live on robberies, but the major continues to give them a merciless hunt ... Mythologized reinterpretation of the figure of the famous bandit brothers. The story, recalled by Jesse and Frank's mother, is too moralized and dull even for a second-rate director like Gordon Douglas, capable of better westerns ("Rio Conchos").

title: Stage to Thunder Rock
actors: Barry Sullivan, Marilyn Maxwell, Scott Brady, Keenan Wynn, Allan Jones
description: Sheriff Horne recovers the hefty fruit of a robbery, kills a bandit and captures another named Sawyer. Now, in a remote station, he waits for the stagecoach to transfer the prisoner to jail. Around, several characters, travelers and not, very interested in the loot.

title: Smokey and the Bandit Ride Again
actors: Dom De Louise, Burt Reynolds, Jackie Gleason, Jerry Reed
description: Eager to win the elections in the state of Texas, Enos senior and junior decide to hire the champion of American truck drivers, Snowman Cledus, to bring a mysterious "package" from Miami to the governor in the city of Austin. However, the man needs the support of the "Bandit" who is not new to such enterprises. He is a country singer in crisis because his Carrie is about to marry another man. His biggest surprise comes when he discovers that there is a pregnant elephant in the package. On the other hand, isn't the elephant the symbol of the republican party?
notes: Pursuits, destruction, paradoxical comedy for the sequel to "Il bandito e la" Madama ".

title: The White Cliffs of Dover
actors: Irene Dunne, Alan Marshall, Frank Morgan, Dame May Whitty
description: Young American marries an English sir who dies in the Great War. Her father wants her back to the US, but she stays in Great Britain with her son, who is destined to perish in the conflict of '39. Artificial, tearful MGM homage to British aristocraticism and patriotism, at the time the main US partner against the Axis powers.

title: Bachelor in Paradise
actors: Bob Hope, Lana Turner, Janis Paige, Don Porter, Jim Hutton
description: Adam Niles is a famous writer whose agent has seen fit to escape with all his money. In difficulty with the Treasury, without a passport, he decides to get busy in another way. So he moved incognito to a locality in the Californian province, to better observe the customs of the community and thus write a book. Here it ends up in court ...
notes: Bob Hope's comic vis is held back by banal and inappropriate sentimental interludes, and in general the subject is not very original. Sliding by Jack Arnold, one of the masters of the fantastic ("Tarantula", "Destination Earth", "The Monster of the Black Lagoon").

title: This Property Is Condemned
actors: Natalie Wood, Robert Redford, Kate Reid, Charles Bronson
description: Alva, the beautiful and tuberculous daughter of the owner of a boarding house in Dodson, Mississippi, knows briefly the joys, but above all the pains, of sex and love. A classic melodrama of the American Deep South by Tennessee Williams, brought to the screen by Sydney Pollack with energy and freshness. Great acting direction, superlative photography by old James Wong Howe.

title: The Wrecking Crew
actors: Dean Martin, Elke Sommer, Sharon Tate
description: The United States lends a billion dollars to Britain, but the treasure is robbed with a clever assault on the train that carries it. Matt Helm uncovers the culprits, recovers the malloppone and saves the Western world from a financial meltdown. A comedy that tries unsuccessfully to look brilliant. More than Dean Martin, the beauties surrounding him deserve a look.

title: Thirty-Two Short Films About Glenn Gould
actors: Colm Feore, Gale Garnett, Katya Ladan, David Hughes
description: It is the life story of the famous Canadian pianist. Through thirty-two short episodes, we see his biographical and artistic path, from concerts to his controversial withdrawal from any public performance in the mid-1960s in favor of studio recording; from his experimental research for Canadian radio, to the many small eccentricities that made him famous beyond his piano skills.
notes: Structured on the model of Bach's "Goldberg Variations", the performance that made Gould most famous, the film is an intelligent mixture of documentary and fiction, which never gives in to the risk of hagiography or sketching.

title: Stangata in famiglia
actors: Femi Benussi, Lino Banfi, Piero Mazzarella, Romy Schell, Isabella Biagini
description: A series of paradoxical events push a rigorous tax official (Lino Banfi), relentlessly engaged in the hunt for tax evaders, to discover altars on which he would gladly close both eyes. Tattered and lean farce that Femi Benussi's forms cannot fill.

title: Geheimaktion schwarze Kapelle
actors: Dawn Addams, Peter Van Eyck, Franco Fabrizi, Gino Cervi
description: Before the outbreak of hostilities, by order of the commander of the Reich secret services, Admiral Canaris, who does not share the policy of the Führer, a German agent does everything he can to prevent Italy and Germany from entering the war.
notes: Spy film without infamy and without praise.

title: Tristana
actors: Catherine Deneuve, Fernando Rey, Franco Nero, Lola Gaos
description: The young Tristana, orphaned, is entrusted to the elderly libertine tutor Don Lope, of whom she soon becomes the lover. However, when she meets Horace, a painter, Tristana leaves with him. Two years later, ill, so much so that they have to amputate her leg, the woman returns to Don Lope and marries him. But when the man is seized by a fatal heart attack, Tristana does nothing to help him.A compendium of classical themes in Buñuel's work: l the inextricable tangle of evil and good in the weakness of human nature, the the uselessness of a choice between the two opposite poles, the ferocious satire of respectability. With impeccable elegance.

title: The Concierge
actors: Michael J. Fox, Gabrielle Anwar, Anthony Higgins, Michael Tucker
description: Doug Ireland, a doorman at a luxury New York hotel, is adept at solving any problem of his wealthy clients. His personal problem, however, that of finding the money to set up his own business, seems unsolvable. Until a rich man offers him the money he needs, as long as he babysits his young mistress. Doug accepts the offer, and wins on both tables.
notes: Barry Sonnenfeld, the director of the double "Addams Family", finds a rather lackluster base material here and doesn't get much out of it. Michael J. Fox at the time was doomed to eternal jujube roles.

title: A Home for Our Own
actors: Kathy Bates, Edward Furlong, Tony Campisi, Soon-Teck Oh, Clarissa Lassig, Sarah Schaub, Miles Feulner, Amy Sakasitz, T.J. Lowther
description: Frances Lacey (Cathy Bates) has just been fired from the potato chip factory where she works: she no longer agrees to be harassed by the overseer. Back home, she loads her six children on a ruined car and drives from Los Angeles to Hankston, a remote Idaho village, where there is a dilapidated shack that the woman obtains for use by the owner, Mr. Munimara. , of Korean origin, pledging to restructure it. Meanwhile, Frances has found a job as a waitress at the bowling alley and has entered into a relationship (albeit a bit turbulent) with the owner. There are a lot of problems, big and small (one of the children is injured by falling from the roof, a fire threatens the house) but, in one way or another, the family gets to the head: they are strong , in spite of bad luck, the future looks good. For the series "optimism is the winning recipe", a film that pours molasses in rivers and touches the hearts of good (but really good) souls. As an unrealistic fairy tale - as well as being discreetly soporific - it works discreetly. The story, set in the 1960s, is still based on a true story and Bates holds up her role quite well. Rising to fame with "Fried Green Tomatoes", she won the Oscar as a "perverse" persecutor of "Misery", a role perhaps most congenial to her.

title: Giuramento
actors: Mario Merola, Nino D'Angelo, Ida Di Benedetto, Regina Bianchi
description: Due to lack of means, Don Salvatore and Concetta cannot marry. An American aunt offers to have Concetta's blind mother operate at her expense, and the two women leave for New York, along with Nino, the girl's brother. After some time, Don Salvatore also goes to New York, and finds Concetta married to a mob boss. Nino will be the one to resolve the situation when he kills the boss. Classic Neapolitan drama, seasoned with all the canonical elements and interpreted by two authentic "stars" of the genre: Mario Merola and Nino D'Angelo. Decent storytelling for a film intended for fans.

title: The Three Musketeers
actors: Charlie Sheen, Kiefer Sutherland, Chris O'Connell, Oliver Platt, Gabrielle Anwar
description: In 16th century France, Cardinal Richelieu dissolves the body of the Musketeers. Porthos, Aramis and Athos, to which the aspiring musketeer D'Artagnan is added, are not there. When Richelieu sends the perfidious Milady to Calais with a proposed agreement with the English enemies, the four swordsmen get in the way.
notes: Fifth version for the cinema of the novel by Dumas Padre (1844), but certainly not the happiest. Actors with the only merit of youth. A lot of movement, but few ideas. Disney produces.

title: A Special Magnum for Tony Saitta
actors: Stuart Whitman, John Saxon, Martin Landau, Tisa Farrow
description: To Tony Saitta, captain of the Montreal police, someone kills his sister during a party; Dr. Traser ends up in jail, but a second crime, victim of a transvestite, reopens the investigation, including that relating to another, previous killing. Another suspect, another blunder, until the truth - in part very uncomfortable for investigator Tony Saitta - finally comes to the surface.
notes: The film is Italian, but the form is that of the American police, all frantic chases and summary justice. Much rougher result than the models, despite the good characters.

title: Casotto
actors: Jodie Foster, Catherine Deneuve, Mariangela Melato, Michele Placido, Paolo Stoppa, Ugo Tognazzi
description: In a collective booth in Ostia, on a Sunday in August, many characters parade: the members of a basketball team, two bodybuilding soldiers, two gas station attendants with their girls, a priest who hides a ... big secret, two grandparents with pregnant niece, two women quarreling with insurance, a couple who want to end their first love relationship. It's not good for almost anyone. Sergio Citti, in his third direction after collaborating with Pasolini, offers a glimpse, far from rosy, of humanity and behavior. The inspiration is there, many are clever, the pace is good.

title: Re-Animator 2
actors: Bruce Abbott, Claude Earl Jones, Fabiana Udenio, David Gale
description: Dr. West, with colleague Dan Cain, works in a front-line hospital in Peru during a bloody revolution. Using corpses for his experiments, he discovers a substance capable of restoring life not only to the dead, but even to individual parts of a corpse. Back in Massachusetts, the two attempt to revive Cain's dead girlfriend, whose heart has been preserved. Even with some gimmicks, the sequel to "Re-Animator" does nothing but mix the ingredients of the progenitor horror comedy, without reproducing its proper functioning. From director Brian Yuzna, who made his debut with the impressive "Society", more could be expected.

title: The Violent Men
actors: Edward G. Robinson, Barbara Stanwyck, Glenn Ford, Brian Keith, Dianne Foster
description: John Panish buys land in Texas. There the landowner Wilkinson dominates, a paralytic dominated by his wife Martha and his cousin Charles, her lover. Panish does not want to give him his properties. At the instigation of the unfaithful couple, deaths and devastation follow, until Wilkinson opens his eyes, thanks to his daughter Judith who takes him to safety from Panish after a fire ... The story progresses in spurts of wickedness and also thanks to the couple of great interpreters of the genre, Edward G. Robinson and Barbara Stanwyck, relates the film to the noir classics. It is a pity that the ethical-aesthetic moralism of the 1950s productions prevails.

title: Critters
actors: Dee Wallace, M. Emmet Walsh, Billy Green Bush, Scott Grimes
description: A group of hairy globe-looking aliens who have escaped from prison on a distant planet swoop into the Brooks family's garden in Kansas. While the Browns with their two children barricade themselves in the house, the voracious and gnawing monsters proliferate ever more threatening. Two space bounty hunters are sent to Earth to eliminate the escapees. Will they succeed?
notes: Comparing it to this simple tale, so simple as to be irritating, one authoritative critic said that "Gremlins" appears to be a masterpiece of the caliber of "War and Peace". In the US, this childhood horror has become a cult object, with three sequels to its credit.

title: A Tale of Five Cities
directors: Romolo Marcellini, Emil E. Reinert, Wolfgang Staudte, Montgomery Tully, Géza von Cziffra
actors: Bonar Colleano, Barbara Kelly, Lana Morris, Anne Vernon, Gina Lollobrigida
description: Bob, a RAF driver, has lost his memory after an accident. To reconstruct his identity, he only has a photo of a child and five banknotes, each with the name of a city and a woman written on it. Bob travels through Europe and puts together the puzzle of his personal history. Eventually he finds the child, who is his nephew, and the sister who works in a circus, like him before going to war.
notes: Arrived on the screens after a troubled gestation (two years of production) and not before having changed its title twice before taking the final one, it is a passable Anglo-Italian sentimental comedy. Secondary roles for Marcello Mastroianni and Gina Lollobrigida. In the end the directors turn out to be: Montgomery Tully, Romolo Marcellini, Geza von Cziffra, Wolfgang Staudte, Emil E. Reinert.

title: Sansone
actors: Brad Harris, Brigitte Corey, Alan Steel, Serge Gainsburg, Walter Reeves
description: Mila, Sullan's queen, was ousted by Warkalla, her treacherous advisor, and replaced by Romilda. Samson, arrived in Sullan, is imprisoned, but manages to escape by joining the rebels who fight against the evil Warkalla. The giant then manages to free the sister of the rebel leader, but is again captured. This time he is saved by the intervention of Romilda, who is secretly in love with him.
notes: A somewhat cumbersome adventure, with a banal subject, without grace. Genus that shows signs of premature wear.

title: La ballerina e il buon Dio
actors: Vera Cecova, Marietto Angeletti, Vittorio De Sica, Gabriele Ferzetti
description: Having escaped from the home of his adoptive parents, little Marietto (Angeletti) chooses Camilla (Cecova), a dancer seen in the photograph, as his mother. He manages to track her down and be hosted for a night, but then he realizes that he is in her way and walks away. It will be the girl, troubled by his escape, to set out on his trail with her boyfriend. The little one is found and the three begin a life together.

title: L'oro di Napoli
actors: Totò, Sophia Loren, Vittorio De Sica, Silvana Mangano, Eduardo De Filippo, Tina Pica
description: Il guappo: Totò victim of the abuse of a Camorra. "Pizzas on credit": Sophia Loren saves her adultery in extremis. "The players": De Sica, a forbidden noble, challenges the child of the building's goalkeeper to broom. "Il funeralino": a poor child died; that at least has a worthy funeral path. "Teresa": the prostitute Silvana Mangano gets married. "The professor": Eduardo teacher of pernacchio. From the book of the same name by Giuseppe Marotta, six sketches, between comedy and drama, told with intense participation and skilful elegance. Great performers employed at their best (Totò, Eduardo and Loren at their best) for a kaleidoscope of life scenes with many flavors.

title: Parent Trap III
actors: Hayley Mills, Barry Bostwick, Ray Baker, Patricia Richardson
description: Sharon Ferris and Susan Corey (both played by Hayley Mills) are twins who, separated very young when their parents divorced, discovered they were only after a long time and after a series of misunderstandings and adventures. Now that they have grown up, they have started competing for the same man (Barry Bostwick), a widower who, ironically, is the father of triplets. Hayley Mills insists on the character that, aside from Pollyanna, has brought her more luck throughout her career. Almost thirty years after the first film ("Cowboy in the Wedding Veil") Mills still looks fit. The problem is that the initial cue now seems worn out.

title: I 2 sergenti del generale Custer
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Moira Orfei, Margaret Lee
description: During the Civil War, the Northern army enlisted two soldiers of Sicilian origin: they are Franco and Ciccio. Accused of desertion and sentenced to death, they are saved as long as they accept a dangerous mission as spies. Their task is in fact to cover two real secret agents. It is almost superfluous to add that our heroes manage to get noticed in all possible ways.
notes: The Simonelli-Ciccio-Franco tricycle more and more unleashed. Between jokes and nonsense the histrionic skills of the duo always emerge, but they are insufficient to save the ship from the inexorable sinking.

title: Sepolta viva
actors: Agostina Belli, Maurizio Bonuglia, Fred Robsahm, Dominique Darel
description: Philippe, Duke of Cambyse, married Cristina, the daughter of a fisherman. The duke's two brothers, Ferdinand and Gael, have the woman (who is pregnant) kidnapped, making them believe she is dead. Meanwhile Gael, rejected for the umpteenth time by his beloved, kills himself; while Philippe, having discovered the deception (he was warned by Giovanna la Pazza) challenges Ferdinand to a duel.
notes: From a famous novel by Francesco Mastriani, a foolish update that accentuates the underlying morbid sides.

title: Blume in Love
actors: George Segal, Susan Anspach, Kris Kristofferson, Marsha Mason
description: A divorce lawyer, Steven Blume, tells his married misadventures and attempts to regain his wife who left him (he was a dongovanni) for a clearing musician. Nice comedy who satires the life of a couple, with Mazursky's polite and intelligent tones.

title: The Dark at the Top of the Stairs
actors: Robert Preston, Dorothy McGuire, Shirley Knight, Angela Lansbury
description: Oklahoma, 1920s. Left unemployed, Rubin Flood unloads his anger on his wife (who accuses him of an alleged betrayal). But then it all works out. Discounted portrait of a rural and troubled America, from a play by William Inge.

title: Mordi e fuggi
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Oliver Reed
description: Three Red Brigades rob a bank and run away. They try to cover their escape by taking a pharmaceutical industrialist and his mistress hostage. From Risi with irony and malice, an intelligent farce tensions that crossed Italy. Perhaps dated today, but at the time it scratched and how.

title: Topper
actors: Cary Grant, Constance Bennett, Roland Young, Billie Burke
description: Young, rich and worldly, the Kirbys are killed in a car accident and find themselves paired as ghosts with the possibility of being invisible. To distract themselves, the two former "bon-vivants" instill a bit of movement in the monotonous life of their friend Topper, shy and awkward, bank president, and all sorts of things happen. Classic fantasy comedy with two sequels and countless apocryphal plagiarisms. Enjoyable even today, despite its ingenuity.

title: Polvere di stelle
actors: Alberto Sordi, Monica Vitti, Wanda Osiris, Carlo Dapporto
description: The dreams of glory of a ramshackle show company during the second world war. Taking advantage of the post-liberation euphoria, the avanspectacle company of Mimmo Adami and Dea Dani manages to obtain a resounding success at the Petruzzelli Theater in Bari. Then, however, after the moment of glory, everything returns to the most banal normality, and even the success fades . Alongside Sordi and Vitti appear some myths of the avanspettacolo (of which the film is a nostalgic re-enactment) such as Wanda Osiris and Carlo Dapporto.

title: Picnic
actors: William Holden, Kim Novak, Susan Strasberg, Rosalind Russell, Cliff Robertson
description: In Kansas, Labor Day is celebrated with a picnic on the grass. Madge and Millie, the no longer young teacher Rosemary, family friend Howard and Alan, Madge's boyfriend, prepare for the event. But this year there is something new: it is Hal Carter, a friend of Alan. Its presence acts as a catalyst for all tensions in the group. From a famous comedy by William Inge, the newcomer (at the cinema) Logan directs a choral film, a bitter drama about the American provincial bourgeoisie.

title: El valle de las espadas
actors: Cesar Romero, Frankie Avalon, Broderick Crawford, Alida Valli, Espartaco Santoni, Teresa Velázquez
description: Fernan Gonzales is a young Castilian patriot who fights against the Arab invasion. For this he would like to unite the armies of Castile and Navarre but his project is opposed and Fernan imprisoned. In the meantime, the Arabs are rampant but Fernan, freed by his beloved, runs into battle where he will be reached in extremis by the finally reunited armies. Historical story on which the inevitable sentimental elements are grafted.

title: All That Heaven Allows
actors: Jane Wyman, Rock Hudson, Agnes Moorehead, Virginia Grey, Conrad Nigel
description: A widow experiences a new season of love. However, she falls in love with her gardener who is ten years younger than her. The woman's children disapprove of this choice and try to hinder it, but then love triumphs.
notes: One of Sirk's great melodramas: the age difference is a screen and metaphor for class conflicts, the exasperated chromatisms are functional to the dramaturgical conflicts, and the final parenthesis in the transcendentalist commune is brilliant. At the end, the appearance of the television, a symbol of loneliness, was chilling.

title: Untamed
actors: Tyrone Power, Susan Hayward, Richard Egan, Agnes Moorehead
description: The film tells the long and tormented love story between Katie and Paul that takes place on two continents, from Ireland to South Africa, where Paul fights against the British for the cause of the autonomy of the Boers. A sentimental drama with an adventurous background.

title: Paper Moon
actors: Ryan O'Neal, Tatum O'Neal, Madeline Kahn, Randy Quaid
description: In the America of the Great Depression, a man and a girl (who may be his daughter) get by as they can by scams. Delicious nostalgia operation towards an America and a cinema that no longer exist, with a splendid black and white by Laszlo Kovacs. Little Tatum O'Neal (Ryan's real daughter) won the Oscar.

title: Little Spies
actors: Mickey Rooney, Robert Costanzo
description: A gang of kids, with the help of a war veteran, tries to free from the clutches of the acalappiacani a nice little dog that the group has decided to adopt and that seems destined for a horrible end. In fact, two shady employees of the kennel had captured him with the intention of making a guinea pig for unprotected scientific experiments. Nice comedy in pure Disney style.

title: The Night of the Hunter
actors: Richard Chamberlain, Diana Scarwid, Amy Bebout, Reid Binion
description: In search of a hidden nest egg, a psychopathic preacher menacingly pursues the two children who know his secret. Those who have not seen "Death runs on the river", the 1955 masterpiece signed by Charles Laughton, will find this remake produced for TV with some narrative variant passable.

title: Something Wicked This Way Comes
actors: Jason Robards, Jonathan Pryce, Diane Ladd, Pam Grier
description: A strange circus arrives in the small town of Greentown. The novelty intrigues two inseparable kids, Will and Gene, but after the mysterious disappearance of some citizens, they discover with dismay the evil powers of the owner, Mr. Dark The two risk their lives but with Will's father they come to the head of the spell. From a story by Ray Bradbury, a curious "horror for children" by Disney, with an almost hypnotic rhythm.

title: Celebrità
actors: Nino D'Angelo, Regina Bianchi, Sonia Viviani, Lino Crispo
description: Pasqualino's (Nino D'Angelo) family is poor, but honest. She is also numerous and full of ailments, but honest. Pasqualino, a mechanic, is also honest. His ambition would be to be a singer, but you know, to break through, you need support and support also means having to get in touch with the underworld. Pasqualino then makes it, but at the moment of success he begins to have doubts.
notes: Nino D'Angelo's was one of the rare cases of regional cinema, that is, of films that gross well in Naples (in this case) and nothing else. This is a D'Angelo before the mainstream, still free-range (and frankly unwatchable).

title: Dave
actors: Kevin Kline, Sigourney Weaver, Frank Langella, Ben Kingsley, Laura Linney
description: Dave Kovic is any US citizen but he looks strikingly like the President. So when he gets a stroke while he's having a "hand-to-hand" with a secretary, the men from the White House put Dave in his place. After some embarrassment, Dave gets along just fine, even with the First Lady who was on a total break with her husband. And everything will be fine.
notes: Take an iron script, hand it over to a director of proven craft, hire brilliant and close-knit actors. It's the sure recipe for an enjoyable, intelligent movie, something Hollywood has always been a master of.

title: Mr. Wonderful
actors: Matt Dillon, Annabella Sciorra, Mary-Louise Parker, William Hurt
description: Gus works as a worker for an electrical company and passes out to pay alimony to his ex-wife who goes to university (and, also, in a teacher's bed). Some co-workers suggest that Gus join them and run a bowling alley. Great idea, but the money? The only solution would be to find a new husband for the ex-wife and Gus tries and tries again.
notes: Not a bad idea. But then, sadly, she went through Amy Shor and Vichy Polon's screenplay and became a watery and tasteless broth. At this point, Anthony Minghella's direction was no longer able to improve anything.

title: Sister Act 2 - Back in the Abit
actors: Whoopi Goldberg, Kathy Najimy, Barnard Hugues, Maggie Smith, Wendy Makkena
description: The nuns from the convent of Santa Caterina have moved to downtown San Francisco, but their school here is dilapidated, on the verge of closure, and the boys are pests. All that remains is to rely again on Deloris, who has returned to her true job as a night singer, in Las Vegas. She will take care of solving all the problems and enthusing the students, amalgamating them in an excellent choir. That Goldberg is a force of nature is now well known but it is also well known that "sequels" very rarely work at the prototype level. And here the rule is confirmed, especially due to a very weak script.

title: Tutti a casa
actors: Alberto Sordi, Serge Reggiani, Eduardo De Filippo, Carla Gravina
description: Lieutenant Innocenzi, overwhelmed like all his comrades by the armistice of 8 September 1943, tries to go home with three soldiers from his unit. In the end - now left alone with the engineer Ceccarelli - he succeeds, but his father would like to see him enlisted with the Germans ...
notes: A classic of our cinema, a great comedy with a very bitter moral. Comencini makes a film in which the tones of comedy and those of historical tragedy blend with excellent balance. Neither rhetoric nor feel-good, with one of the best interpretations by Alberto Sordi. Screenplay by Comencini, Age, Scarpelli and Marcello Fondato.

title: La dame d'onze heures
actors: Paul Meurisse, Micheline Francey, Jean Tissier, Pierre Renoir
description: Dr. Pescara receives numerous anonymous letters of threat, but despite this he does not want to turn to the police. A friendly friend of him, the explorer Stanislao Ottavio Semichon, nicknamed S.O.S. Dr. Pescara's son, who managed to individuals the source of the anonymous letters in Normandy, is the first victim of a long series of murders that make the "case" increasingly intricate and increasingly dramatic. Taken from the novel of the same name by Pierre Apesteguy, the film is conducted with a robust hand that skillfully supports the complex intrigue. Interpreters and pack of good level.

title: Naked
actors: David Thewlis, Lesley Sharp, Katrin Cartlidge, Greg Cruttwell, Toby Jones
description: Johnny, young and cultured "displaced", goes to visit Louise, his ex-girlfriend who is now in London. Found the house he makes love with Sophie, who shares the house with Louise. At night he goes out on the streets of the city and makes a series of meetings. Battered returns to Louise and Sophie, where the snobbish landlord has violently installed himself. Impossible to summarize all the folds and characters of the plot. More than anything else, what counts is the desperation and anger, the sense of helplessness and disorientation that Johhny bears, made more excruciating by a disturbing mixture of tragicomic effects. Awarded at Cannes for Direction and Best Actor (Thewlis).

title: Cry Freedom
actors: Kevin Kline, Penelope Wilton, Denzel Washington, Alec McCowen, Katie Hardie
description: In South Africa, Steve Biko is a non-violent black leader against the apartheid regime. Confinement with his family, he wins Donald Woods (Kline), editor of a progressive newspaper, to his ideals. Biko died of torture in 1977, Woods also suffers repression. To save himself with his family and continue the fight against Pretoria's racism, he adventurously takes refuge in England. Alternating historical portraiture with adventure, social denunciation with suspense, Richard Attenborough ("Gandhi") also pours his passion for realism and the richness of staging into this film. Oscar nomination for Denzel Washington (in the role of Biko) who, however, did not get the statuette.

title: Sjecas li se, Dolly Bell
actors: Slavko Stimac, Slobodan Aligrudic, Ljiljana Blagojevic, Mira Banjac, Pavle Vujisic
description: Dino is a teenager who lives in Sarajevo in the early 1960s, a period of great opening of Tito's 8oslavia towards the West and neighboring Italy. His father, a Marxist intellectual, ultimately allows him to live a poor youth but much freer than that of previous generations, between friends who are a bit bully and the first, awkward falling in love with a too shrewd girl. With this coming-of-age story conducted with tenderness, humor and linguistic freshness, 26-year-old newcomer Kusturica portrays with twilight affection a whole era of change and hope in the former Yugoslavia. Golden Lion in Venice in 1981. Celentano's "24000 kisses" triumphs in the soundtrack.

title: The Kiss
actors: Joanna Pacula, Meredith Salenger, Mimi Kuzyk, Nicholas Kilbertus
description: Belgian Congo 1963. During a trip, Aunt Ilary gives Amy a strange majolica in the shape of a bird of prey. Since then, the girl has been subjected to disturbing visions and facts. Ilary dies in a mysterious accident and another aunt appears, Felice, who is actually a witch determined to invade Amy's life. The evil witch will only be destroyed thanks to Amy's father's coalition with a brave neighbor. The style is the flattened one of the TV, but you don't die of boredom.

title: Valley of the Dolls
actors: Barbara Parkins, Patty Duke, Sharon Tate, Susan Hayward, Paul Burke
description: Anne, Jennifer and Neely come to New York from the provinces in search of success. Neely finds him in Broadway "musicals", Anne in commercials, and Jennifer marries an accomplished actor-singer. But then things get worse: Neely ruins herself with alcohol and drugs, Jennifer commits suicide after dramatic vicissitudes and Anne, disgusted by the environment, returns to the country she left from. Between social denunciation and melodrama (but closer to the latter), the film has ambitions that it does not realize, due to a certain narrative muddiness and the choice of fairly obvious solutions. Interpretations over the top.

title: Birdman of Alcatraz
actors: Burt Lancaster, Karl Malden, Thelma Ritter, Edmond O'Brien, Betty Field
description: Robert Stroud is serving twelve years for murder when he kills another inmate in a fight. Transferred, he is targeted by two sadistic guards. He kills one after yet another provocation and is sentenced to death, but his mother is pardoned. In life imprisonment, Stroud devotes himself to ornithology, becomes an authority on it and marries a scholar. Public opinion gets more humane treatment for him. This story of the metamorphosis of a murderer taken from a news case is not very easy, even if a careful editing work and some good dramatic junctions serve to dynamize it. Excellent photography and performance by Burt Lancaster.

title: Dead Reckoning
actors: Cliff Robertson, Rick Springfield, Susan Blakely
description: Unfaithful Alex's birthday present to her husband, Dr. Daniel Barnard, is a brand new yacht, ready to embark the couple on a splendid cruise. The captain of the boat, however, is Kyle, Alex's lover, and everything is actually part of the diabolical plan developed by the woman to eliminate her husband. Barnard understands everything when he is already on the high seas and therefore has to face the bad situation.
notes: Triangle of love and betrayal, explosive passions that manifest themselves in the storm-swept ocean: the story told by this passable TV movie would look good in a Fifties B-movie. Nor would your unfaithful wife Susan Blakely ("Over the Top") disfigure you.

title: Fresa y chocolate
directors: Tomàs Gutiérrez Alea, Juan Carlos Tabío
