actors: Jorge Perugorría, Vladimir Cruz, Mirta Ibarra, Francisco Gattorno, Joel Angelino
description: In Havana, David promises Vivian that he will no longer ask her to make love before the wedding. Then Vivian marries another, David is destroyed. Approached by Diego, a gay artist, he enters step by step his world as a refined intellectual, meets his friend Nancy and tries to help another gay artist to exhibit his sculptures. All this smacks of subversion for a dogmatic colleague of his from the Communist Youth.
notes: The story of the pygmalion who discloses to the student a world of non-hypocritical culture and love conveys the political and civil message with sympathy for the deviant-marginalized and satire against dogmatism. Successful bittersweet comedy.

title: Sorcerer
actors: Roy Scheider, Bruno Cremer, Francisco Rabal, Amidou, Ramon Bieri
description: Taking refuge in a battered South American country, a Parisian bankrupt, a New York robber, an Arab terrorist and a Nazi tormentor are desperately trying to get by. In exchange for a large sum, they accept a crazy assignment: transporting a load of explosives in two trucks to a two-hundred-mile track in the jungle. Only one survives the feat. Expensive, good remake of a splendid film written and directed by Clouzot in 1952. The tension is constant and the photography makes the jungle a disturbing character in itself. Beautiful soundtrack with music by Charlie Parker, Keith Jarrett, Tangerine Dream.

title: The Stooge
actors: Dean Martin, Jerry Lewis, Polly Bergen, Marie McDonald, Eddie Mayehoff
description: Variety artist Bill (Martin) has found a new sidekick. Young Ted (Lewis) is naive and bungling, but he proves very effective on the scene. Presumptuous and jealous, Bill doesn't recognize Ted's merits, leaves no room for him. At one point he even hunts him and presents himself to the public alone. Ted, who loves him, unexpectedly intervenes, saving him from the fiasco and from himself. In his early days, Jerry Lewis made sixteen films with Dean Martin. In many of them, as in this one that overshadows the royal parable of the couple, his extraordinary comic vis was trapped by frequent sentimental and singing interludes tailored to the partner.

title: Sposi
actors: Carlo Delle Piane, Elena Sofia Ricci, Nik Novecento, Simona Marchini, Jerry Calà
description: The five episodes show the encounters and quarrels of Mario, a married businessman, and Silvia, a twenty-year-old tied to another; the reparative wedding between the mask of a cinema and the cashier; the cynical advertising wedding of a declining star; the night Giacomo spent confiding in his friend who will be his wedding witness; the meeting of Robby and Federica ten years after the separation. There are five directors but the film is homogeneous, in the name of nostalgia for the values ??of the desecrated and crisis institution of marriage. The consequent choice was to frame everything by passing 16 mm clips, from real weddings, on the opening and closing credits.

title: La donna del lago
actors: Peter Baldwin, Salvo Randone, Valentina Cortese, Virna Lisi
description: Bernard is a writer who returns to a hotel to see Tilde, the maid he fell in love with. They tell him that she committed suicide, but little by little she realizes that someone has killed her. Bernard initially suspects Enrico, the owner of the hotel and his son Mario, alleged lovers of Tilde. Eventually, however, he receives a decisive confession from Irma, Mario's sister. But that's the truth? From a novel by Giovanni Comisso, a film that favors the typical yellow solutions of a dreamlike atmosphere linked to the fact that the protagonist is a writer and that his investigations start from imaginative conjectures.

title: The Eye of the Neddle
actors: Donald Sutherland, Kate Nelligan, Ian Bannen, Christopher Cazenove
description: David and Lucy's quiet life on a small island off the coast of Scotland is shattered by the arrival of German secret agent Heinrich Faber (Sutherland), the only one to know of the imminent Allied landing in Normandy. The Ken Follett novel from which the film is based was hyper-complex and Marquand had his work cut out to make it intelligible. Sutherland is cold, kind and unsurpassed.

title: No Way to Treat a Lady
actors: Rod Steiger, George Segal, Lee Remick
description: An insane strangler enjoys mocking Morris Brummel, the policeman in charge of the investigation. The final confrontation takes place in a theater. A bit thriller, a bit romantic comedy and a bit macabre farce. A little too much all together, but pleasant.

title: Islands in the Stream
actors: George C. Scott, David Hemmings, Gilbert Roland, Sysan Tyrrell
description: Thomas Hudson, sculptor and fisherman, lives only in the Bahamas. He had three children from two wives whom he loves and who join him. One joins the Canadian Air Force and Thomas gets the news from the boy's mother. To stay close to the others, the protagonist goes to sea. He saves some Jews, sees a dear friend of his die and, in turn, will die in the arms of a faithful Negro servant. Out of fidelity to the literary source (a Hemingway novel), the film is divided into chapters and uses off-screen voices; the whole effectively recreates the figure and the poetics of the writer. Overall a very decent realization.

title: The Lady Takes a Flyer
actors: Lana Turner, Jeff Chandler, Andrea Martin, Richard Denning
description: Maggie Colby and Mike Dandridge are two pilots who work for the same transportation company. Even though Maggie, ever since she became Mrs. Dandridge and gave birth to a baby girl, is more occupied with her personal life than with the idea of ??flying. Then Nikki arrives, a driver too, recently hired in the company and then Maggie realizes that the time has come to get back on track. Lana Turner excels over a less than exceptional cast and a fairly predictable story. Good aerial shots for the time.

title: L'attrazione
actors: Florence Guérin, Marino Masé, Martine Brochard
description: Nadine, fashion photographer, accepts the singular chess challenge that the rich Victor Schneider proposed her. The stake is herself. Guerin aside, it is pure nonsense.

title: Il venditore di palloncini
actors: Renato Cestié, Lee J. Cobb, Marina Malfatti, James Whitmore
description: Maria, a variety dancer, runs away with Dimitri, leaving her husband Antonio and little Giacomino. After six years, Antonio is an alcoholic and Giacomino keeps him, despite his young age and frail constitution, by being a puppeteer. The child is undermined by a deadly form of anemia; his agony will make his father come to his senses and return his mother to his bedside, even if only an hour before death. After having signed some third-row spaghetti westerns as John Walker and having tried the path of detective and erotic horror, Gariazzo arrives at the family mélo. Easy tear leads to involuntary humor.

title: I padroni della città
actors: Jack Palance, Al Cliver, Harry Baer, Gisela Hahn, Edmund Purdom, Vittorio Caprioli
description: The clash between Luigi's gang and that of the "Scarred" is unequal. The latter is stronger, so much so that Beppe, Luigi's lieutenant, kills his boss and goes to the other side. But the "Scarred" did not deal with Ric and Tony, who set up a trap at the slaughterhouse and make a clean sweep of their enemies by taking possession of all their wealth.
notes: Usual spaghetti gangster with nice cast, dry action scenes and effective directing. Di Leo is such a specialist, but the fact remains that he often works with his left hand (even in this beautiful noir).

title: Dead Ringers
actors: Jeremy Irons, Geneviève Bujold, Heidi Von Palleske, Barbara Gordon
description: Twins Elliot and Beverley Mantle (Irons) are two established gynecologists. One is more unscrupulous, the other more shy, one knows how to deal with women, the other less so. Apart from that it is very difficult to distinguish them. Not even Claire Niveau (Bujold) can do it, at first patient, then Elliot's lover, then also Beverley, but without noticing the change. The delusional triangle will be the beginning of a deep descent towards the abyss.
notes: It is probably Cronenberg's best film and one of the best of the 1980s. Remain in mind the gynecological tools transformed into instruments of torture, the last silent phone call and then the two extraordinary protagonists: Jeremy Irons and Jeremy Irons.

title: Once in a Lifetime
actors: Lindsay Wagner, Barry Bostwick, Amy Aquino, Duncan Regehr
description: Daphne Fields (Lindsay Wagner) is a successful writer with a past full of ê We find her in a coma in the hospital after being hit by a car on Christmas Eve. With this narrative device we go back in time, to the fire in which she lost her husband and daughter, a delightful little girl of a few years. Daphne is in the eighth month of pregnancy of her second child who, at birth, probably due to the trauma suffered, manifests a severe form of deafness. The woman's ordeal then begins all over again, in an attempt to recover the baby to normal. Daphne therefore has a contradictory relationship with Dr. Dane, the director of the institute for disabled children to which she turned. Misfortunes as if it rained on the life of the writer Fields. Which cannot be said of Danielle Steel, the lucky author of the book from which this TV-movie is based. Lindsay Wagner does everything she can not to make a fool of herself, but history doesn't really help her.

title: A Challenge for Robin Hood
actors: Barrie Ingham, James Hayter, Leon Greene
description: Through the fault of his stepbrother Roger De Courtnay, Robin is forced to go into hiding, taking refuge in Sherwood Forest. With the name of Robin Hood he becomes the leader of the revolt, defeats Roger and frees the beautiful Marion. In each film version of the story, the history of the British folk hero changes. Here is a stepbrother who has sprung up from who knows where. However, the choreography, the scenes and the plots are not well cared for; almost a telefilm of the "Ivanhoe" series with Roger Moore.

title: The Incredible Journey
actors: Emile Genest, John Drainie, Tommy Tweed, Sandra Scott, Syme Jago
description: Temporarily left to fend for themselves, a cat and two dogs cross Canada and, at the end of a 250-kilometer journey, manage to reach their distant owners. Of course it's a Disney movie. And you understand immediately.

title: L'étudiante
actors: Sophie Marceau, Vincent Lindon, Elena Pompei, Robert Attias
description: In the French Alps we meet Edouard (Lindon), a young musician and composer, and Valentine (Marceau), a girl who studies at the Sorbonne, but who has already started working as a primary school teacher. Back in Paris, the two meet again and fall in love. But he's always around to give concerts and she doesn't want to give up her college career.
notes: Empty but not infamous, the film, however, has nothing to do with "Tempo delle mele", and the Italian title is a deception of the distributors.

title: La fortuna di essere donna
actors: Sophia Loren, Marcello Mastroianni, Charles Boyer, Nino Besozzi
description: By chance, Antonietta (Loren), a young girl from a modest family, becomes a cover girl. Corrado, the photographer who discovered her, falls in love and she makes him jealous by attending Count Senetti, who "scorns" her by teaching her good manners. The nobleman gives Antonietta a fur coat and promises to marry her, but, at a lunch, the legitimate consort of the count shows up ...
notes: One of the many films, but certainly not the best, by the Loren-Mastroianni couple.

title: Death Ship
actors: George Kennedy, Richard Crenna, Nick Mancuso, Sally Ann Howes
description: A cruise ship collides with a ghost ship. The survivors are welcomed into the ship itself and face the nightmare. The same for the spectators.

title: Major Dundee
actors: Charlton Heston, Richard Harris, James Coburn, Warren Oates, Senta Berger
description: Major Dundee and Lieutenant Tyreen were once friends. Now the former is a Northern officer sent to New Mexico to eliminate the dangerous Indian chief Sierra Charriba, while the latter is just one of many captive Southerners. However, the situation is really tough and Dundee, in the absence of men, makes a pact of honor with the prisoners (and with Tyreen) and enlists them in the hunt for Charriba.
notes: It is hatred that drives the world forward. At least in this we recognize the hand of Peckinpah. For the rest, it cannot be said that the film is his. Production reassembled it by cutting twenty minutes. The American distribution threw away fourteen and the Italian one another nine. Probably a cursed masterpiece.

title: Lo studente
actors: Nino D'Angelo, Jenny Tamburi, Chris Avram, Maria Fiore
description: Baron Mario di Villalta returns to Naples after spending many years in Venezuela. He hires young Nino as his secretary, a penniless senior high school student and confidant of a Camorra boss. It turns out that Nino is actually an unrecognized son of his that he had just before his departure. Direction, screenplay, photography and editing are almost non-existent. Nino D'Angelo's songs are not enough.

title: Carcerato
actors: Mario Merola, Regina Bianchi, Erika Blanc, Aldo Giuffré
description: Francesco has no faults. His only fault is that of having been betrayed by a mafioso, now, unfortunately dead. Accused of the murder, Francesco is in prison and is desperate because his mother is sick and above all because his daughter Fiorella has to make her first communion. And he who had promised to sing during the ceremony, not only will not sing, but he will not even go there. It is the type of film that descends from the great tradition of the Neapolitan drama. At least this is what we say when we want to talk about it well. When you want to talk badly about them, however, you tell the truth: that they are deadly boring films.

title: Lost in Africa
actors: Ashley Hamilton, Jennifer McComb, Timothy Ackroyd, Mohamed Nangurai
description: A multinational group of tourists on vacation in Africa is taken hostage by a gang. Young Michael kills the chief of the tribe and escapes with Elisabeth and Charles. Thus Michael and Elisabeth (Charles in the meantime has been torn to pieces by a lion) find themselves dealing not only with scorpions, crocodiles and vultures, but also with the vengeful anger of Rabar, son of the chieftain.
notes: As they say in these cases: beautiful natural landscapes and good animals. The rest is pretty predictable. The only singular note is that this is the debut of Ashley Hamilton, son of George Hamilton and Alana Stewart.

title: Station West
actors: Dick Powell, Jane Greer, Agnes Moorehead, Tom Powers, Steve Brodie
description: In a town devastated by gold fever, two soldiers who were escorting a precious cargo are killed. The investigations are entrusted to a young policeman, who goes there with the excuse of looking for work. But hospitality is not the main prerogative of citizens who in fact begin to insult him. Having emerged victorious from the diatribe, he can begin the investigations that lead him to suspect the owner of the saloon.
notes: The film is well done, but a little too predictable. The script by Frank Fenton and Winston Miller has close dialogues. There is also a colored version.

title: One Hundred Rifles
actors: Burt Reynolds, Raquel Welch, Jim Brown, Fernando Lamas, Soledad Miranda
description: Joe has just robbed a bank to get the money to buy the weapons that the Yaqui Indians will need to fight General Verdugo who is exterminating them. On Joe's trail there is also a black sheriff, but he too falls, along with Joe, into Verdugo's hands. The two are about to be shot when they are saved by the intrepid Sarita at the head of a band of Indians to which the two will join. The characters are nice, and the rhythm holds up enough ..

title: The King and Four Queens
actors: Clark Gable, Eleanor Parker, Jean Willes, Barbara Nichols
description: Of the four McDade brothers, perpetrators of a $ 100,000 robbery, only one remained alive, but it is not known which one. Thus, of the four wives who live in the village of Wagon Mound, three are widows, but it is not known which ones. But what Dan Kehoe cares about most is what happened to the money. So he sneaks into the McDade house and gets into the good graces of Sabina, one of the four women.
notes: Semi-serious Western of a master of the genre; at times pleasant, but without excitement. The likeable rogue Gable wallows in the role, but his acting is a bit too much repertoire.

title: Hard Target
actors: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Lance Henriksen, Yancy Butler
description: Chance Boudreaux, a lone sailor who is now in New Orleans, agrees to find her father who has mysteriously disappeared on behalf of a lawyer. Chance discovers that he has been eliminated by some guys who, for the simple "taste" of hunting, occasionally organize hunts in which the prey are human beings. This is not only a successful remake of a 1930s Schoedsack classic ("The Dangerous Game"), but also the American debut of Hong Kong director John Woo.

title: Che!
actors: Omar Sharif, Jack Palance, Cesare Danova, Robert Loggia, Woody Strode
description: In 1956, in Cuba, the young Argentine doctor Ernesto "Che" Guevara becomes number two, after Fidel Castro, in the armed struggle against the Batista regime. After the victory, "Che" tries to trigger the revolution in Latin America, but dies fighting in Bolivia. The fact that Guevara is played by Omar Sharif already gives an idea of ??the artificiality of this fictionalized biography.

title: Blood on the Arrow
actors: Dale Robertson, Martha Hyer, Wendell Corey
description: To get the kidnapped boy back, Clint is forced to supply weapons to the Coyoteros Indians on a war footing. The golden-hearted bandit Wed Cooper, moved by Clint's wife, breaks into the Indian camp to fix everything.
notes: Naive and utterly predictable Western.

title: Going Hollywood
actors: Bing Crosby, Marion Davies, Patsy Kelly
description: In love with a famous singer (Crosby), she goes to Hollywood and works to win him over by pretending to be a French waitress. Rich Mgm production from the Thirties, with songs like "Temptations".

title: Good Guys Wear Black
actors: Chuck Norris, Anne Archer, James Franciscus
description: The officer (Norris) who led a commando action in North Vietnam scrambles to find out who betrayed him and his men. Yet another short film that rummages in the syndrome of the American defeat, where you badly try to graft a "martial arts" genre made in the USA. Ted Post will direct a good Vietnam film, "Lost Victories" the following year.

title: Dogtags
actors: Clive Wood, Baird Stafford, Robert Haufrecht
description: Three American soldiers in Vietnam are instructed to retrieve some cases of missing secret documents with the helicopter that was carrying them. Having reached the goal, they discover that the purpose of the dangerous mission was something else. Low-profile Italian-American product of the Vietnam trend, with confused moralizing claims.

title: No Minor Vices
actors: Dana Andrews, Lilli Palmer, Louis Jourdan
description: A young pediatrician has achieved a good position. Happily married, he lives with his wife in the small pediatric clinic, which he owns. One day the doctor, while on his way to visit a little patient, meets a whimsical artist and hosts him at his home. The new friend begins to put in the head of the woman, that her husband has always treated her badly. One day the painter invites her to his studio and the pediatrician reluctantly lets her go. Soon, however, jealousy takes hold of him. Classic wedding comedy with characters and situations that are too stereotyped, and actors who are not too partially. After all, Milestone excelled rather in war films.

title: La venexiana
actors: Laura Antonelli, Monica Guerritore, Jason Connery, Claudio Amendola, Clelia Rondinella
description: During the feast of Thanksgiving, a foreign gentleman arrives in Venice and immediately finds a way to impress two women: the widow Angela, hot with desires in the role of mourning, and the young Valeria, whose husband is temporarily absent. Thus the stranger will satisfy them both. In Bolognini, no one has ever been able to deny elegance, but here, grappling with the comedy of an anonymous man of the sixteenth century, all the salt of the original text is sacrificed to an aestheticism of a manner.

title: Il vichingo venuto dal Sud
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Pamela Tiffin, Renzo Marignano, Gigi Ballista
description: Rosario Trapanese, a Sicilian with open views (he says), gets sent by his employer to direct the Danish branch of the company. He gets busy, with little success, as a "Latin lover", then marries the beautiful Karen. Except discovering, a little late, that his wife has a past as the protagonist of a "hard" short film. Bad money, with Buzzanca in his usual stereotype.

title: Addams Family Values
actors: Anjelica Huston, Raul Julia, Christopher Lloyd, Joan Cusack, Christina Ricci, Carol Kane, Jimmy Workman, Carel Struycken
description: Another little Addams comes into the world, Pubert, to whom Wednesday and Pugsley try to party. And Uncle Fester falls in love like a little boy with Pubert's nanny, who turns out to be deadly and hungry for money. Wednesday and Pugsley, after setting fire to a hideous campground they were sent to on vacation, manage to save the family situation.
notes: Team that wins does not change and, not even two years after the first cinematic version of the characters created by Charles Addams, here is another chapter of macabre humor. Of a good standard: in the part of the campsite there is something to lick your mustache.

title: Hocus Pocus
actors: Bette Midler, Sarah Jessica Parker, Kathy Najimy, Omri Katz, Thora Birch, Vinessa Shaw
description: Three hundred years ago they burned them at the stake and their house was turned into a museum. When a visiting kid utters the ad hoc formula, the Winifred sisters, Sarah and Mary Sanderson come back to show up. Especially since, being Halloween night, their "démodé" clothing goes unnoticed. A little trembles, a little laughs for the three witches who find a way to rejuvenate.
notes: Disney comedy with some horror streak, the film is cheap and has had a miserable distribution. But Bette Midler, Sarah Jessica Parker and Kathy Najmy are really good.

title: Heaven & Earth
actors: Hiep Thi Le, Tommy Lee Jones, Joan Chen, Haing S. Ngor
description: Le Ly, a young Vietnamese girl, is tortured by the Vietcong after her village was razed to the ground by the French. In Saigon a rich Vietnamese gets her pregnant, in Da Nang she ends up in the brothel where her sister is already there. And at home they treat her like a plague. Then an American sergeant marries her. But not even the USA, California, San Diego are paradise. And the husband is not an angel. After "Platoon" and "Born on July 4", Oliver Stone returns to Vietnam in a more rhetorical way and the result is a long-winded film, with good moments but a confused overall vision.

title: Love and Human Remains
actors: Thomas Gibson, Ruth Marshall, Cameron Bancroft, Mia Kirshner
description: David had become famous as the protagonist of a TV show, but today, for reasons that only he knows, he adapts to being a waiter in a restaurant. His sexual tastes are also vague: he lives with Candy, his ex, but today he seems more attracted to male bodies. All while a serial killer terrorizes the city by killing young women and collecting their earrings. With or without lobe.
notes: Taken from a play (but hardly noticeable), Arcand's film is striking after all. There is some naivety, but there are also excellent actors including Mia Kirshner, star of Egoyan's "Exotica".

title: Martha
actors: Margit Carstensen, Karlheinz Böhm, Adrian Hoven, Ingrid Caven
description: Martha met her husband in Rome. He, Helmut, is thoughtful, charming and protective. From the moment they move in together, however, things change. Helmut from caring becomes obsessive, from protective he turns maniacal. First he unplugs the phone, then prevents his wife from leaving the house. She, who in the meantime has met the young Kaiser, begins to harbor gloomy thoughts.
notes: Stuck for years by copyright issues, this film is heartbreakingly cold. The trap structure of the original text by Cornell Woolrich remains, but Fassbinder puts all the necessary normality into it to turn it into a daily nightmare.

title: Noyade interdite
actors: Philippe Noiret, Guy Marchand, Anne Roussel, Marie Trintignant, Laura Betti, Stefania Sandrelli
description: We are in the Charente, in a seaside village. It is there that young Marie, intent on taking a bath, discovers a floating corpse. Inspector Molinat (Philippe Noiret) arrives (or rather returns) to investigate, assisted by his very suspicious assistant Leroyer. Which actually does well to suspect everything, everyone, but above all of Molinat's past. Routine work for Granier-Deferre, one who built his reputation on similar films, all frighteningly similar to each other. The choice of actors, then, is significant: old well-known faces including Stefania Sandrelli, Andréa Ferreol, Suzanne Flon and Laura Betti.

title: Apprentice for Murder
actors: Donald Sutherland, Chad Lowe, Mia Sara, Rutanya Alda
description: We are in 1929 and Dr. Reese has already done four years in an asylum, but this does not prevent him from exercising his profession as a "healer" in a small town in Pensylvania. Strange spells and suspected animal deaths rock the country, and Reese realizes that the fault lies entirely with Hoeglin. The solution is simple: cut a lock of the madman's hats and bury it along with human remains. Believe it or not, this is a true story. Reese eventually got twenty years in prison for murder. Aside from the ending, kept in tension by the unveiling of the crime, everything that comes first leaves much to be desired in logic.

title: Amore all'italiana. I superdiabolici
actors: Walter Chiari, Raimondo Vianello, Paolo Panelli, Vivi Bach, Isabella Biagini
description: A child who failed his exams. A diabolical old man who, with the simple announcement of his own death, manages to pit his grandchildren against each other. A foreigner prefers a peasant to the rich. An employee blackmails the boss with the risqué photos of his wife. A fan discovers his wife's affair with the referee whom he repeatedly called a cuckold during the game. A dynamite tape recorder as a wedding gift from a rejected lover. A mysterious ray capable of making eunuchs.

title: The Man Who Came to Dinner
actors: Bette Davis, Monty Wolley, Jimmy Durante
description: The famous Sheridan Woolcott, traveling around the province for a series of lectures, sprains his foot and is forced to spend a month in a family of his fervent admirers. At the end of the period, the admirers will cease to be fans. A sharp and brilliant comedy. Jimmy Durante mocks Harpo Marx and Gardiner mocks Noel Coward.

title: Son of Paleface
actors: Bob Hope, Jane Russell, Roy Rogers
description: Pale Face, after being a famous Indian exterminator, leaves a treasure to his son John, but the recovery of the inheritance is not easy. John finds himself struggling with his father's creditors and with the attentions of Mike, a girl as beautiful as she is dangerous. It is the sequel to "Pale Face". Tashlin from screenwriter is promoted to director, to the Hope-Russell couple is added the old B-movie star Roy Rogers and his horse Trigger and everything takes on an even more satirical and light-hearted air.

title: Le corbeau
actors: Pierre Fresnay, Ginette Leclerc, Pierre Larquey, Noël Roquevert
description: A small town in the French province is shocked by a series of anonymous letters that strike a respected professional. It is Dr. Germain who is accused of being the lover of Laura, the wife of Dr. Vorzet. Then everyone feels called into question, while the investigation languishes.
notes: Slowly, with great attention to detail and atmosphere, Clouzot creates one of the masterpieces of French cinema. The film was banned for two years after the Liberation, while the director and screenwriter were suspended for six months. From the same subject Otto Preminger drew _The red pen_.

title: Angel Face
actors: Robert Mitchum, Jean Simmons, Mona Freeman, Herbert Marshall
description: Diana is a rich and charming heiress who adores her father and hates her stepmother. Frank is an ambulance driver who is overwhelmed by an irresistible (and reciprocated) passion for women. Blood bond, whirlwind of violence and then a crime ...
notes: Beyond some justified imperfections, a small cult made by Preminger with practically no completed script (it seems he wrote it the evening before each shoot, although other sources attribute it to Frank S. Nugent, Oscar Millard and even Ben Hecht). He ironically called the film "a casually interesting incident", but it was too modest. Simmons is a furious and unforgettable dark lady. Idiot the Italian title.

title: La principessa delle Canarie
actors: Silvana Pampanini, Marcello Mastroianni, Gustavo Rojo, Elvira Quintilla
description: The Spaniards, in 1450, set out to conquer the Canary Islands. Among them is Don Diego, an officer of his majesty, who falls in love with Almadena, the daughter of the indigenous king. War is inevitable, but love is stronger. Matroianni before success, in a very mediocre imitation adventure film.

title: I carabbinieri
actors: Diego Abatantuono, Giorgio Bracardi, Leo Gullotta, Donatella Damiani, Renzo Montagnani, Bombolo
description: To investigate a scandal related to the supply of methane, a special team of carabinieri is set up. Unfortunately, however, the men who make it up are chosen randomly by the computer. It so happens that the most idiots of all are chosen, especially since they end up in the middle of a homosexual party ...
notes: Diego Abatantuono, in the epoch preceding the meeting with Salvatores, is flanked by a group of recurring actors of the most sheepish comedy, such as Montagnani and Bombolo. Weapon jokes abound, but the level couldn't get any lower and punishment largely replaces laughter.

title: Mr Klein
actors: Alain Delon, Jeanne Moreau, Michael Lonsdale, Juliet Berto, Suzanne Flon
description: Robert Klein is a wealthy Alsatian, intent on further enriching himself in Pétain's collaborationist France. The case makes him discover the existence of his namesake of Jewish origin, wanted by the police due to anti-Semitic laws. His fate is now sealed; little by little the fate of the other Klein becomes his. After an attempted emigration, Klein ends up on the same lead train leaving for a concentration camp, along with his namesake.
notes: Losey's very nasty apologue on the devastating combination of Nazism and police bureaucracy; the film is also supported by the presence of an excellent and measured Alain Delon. Screenplay by Franco Solinas.

title: Last Embrace
actors: Roy Scheider, Janet Margolin, Sam Levene, Charles Napier
description: Henry Hannan (Scheider) suffers an attack in which his wife is killed. Then at the station a man tries to push him under the wheels of a train. But it is not clear why anyone would want to take him out. Just as it is not clear the letter in Aramaic that Henry sees himself delivered and that he has Professor Peabody and Rabbi Drexel deciphered. Nor does the presence in his house of Ellie reassure him, a young anthropology student who happened to be there by mistake, but who in the meantime does not leave the apartment. Hitchcockian thriller that marks Demme's first statement with the general public. An increasingly exciting intertwining, up to a breathtaking finale on Niagara Falls.

title: Dazed and Confused
actors: Jason London, Wiley Wiggins, Sasha Jenson, Rory Cochrane
description: Austin, Texas. In the 24 hours in which the story takes place (the last day of school) the young protagonists perform, among other things, in various feats in the supermarket, and in the re-enactment of the main episodes of the television series "Gilligan's Island". Delusional suburban adventures follow one another before the summer really begins with its hangover, the clashes, the mutual humiliations. Bitter comedy about the condition of youth in the American province. A very low-budget production that fits into the panorama of "made in USA" adolescent cinema, to give us a non-trivial picture of the situation.

title: The Tresaure of the Amazon
actors: Stuart Whitman, Donald Pleasence, John Ireland, Ann Sidneey
description: Gringo, an unscrupulous adventurer, joins forces with two former miners in the search for a diamond treasure that is also tempting Klaus, an old Nazi hierarch, and three young geologists: Barbara, Dick and Clark. After an assault by the natives, the struggles for the possession of diamonds begin, in which everyone is a bit against everyone (and where men do not arrive the crabs arrive). It seems that at the basis of the story there are some real events, but probably with less ferocity than the film exhibits.

title: Foul Play
actors: Goldie Hawn, Chevy Chase, Burgess Meredith, Dudley Moore
description: The visit of Pope Honorius XII to the United States is threatened by an attack. Gloria Mundy (Hawn) has nothing to do with this, but one day she gives a ride to a guy named Scott. He is killed shortly after while Gloria discovers that she still has a pack of her cigarettes containing the photos relating to the plot. But of course nobody believes her. That Higgins is not Hitchcock is undisputed. Despite this, the film is funny at times. Goldie Hawn, as usual, plays the part of the fool who gets into bigger trouble than she is.

title: The Four Musketeers: The Revenge of Milady
actors: Michael York, Oliver Reed, Faye Dunaway, Raquel Welch, Richard Chamberlain, Frank Finlay
description: The famous adventures of swordsmen loyal to the rulers, against the murky intrigues of the Cardinal and his most perfidious agent, the beautiful Milady. Second part of "The Three Musketeers", shot by Lester together with this one, is a free and airy reinterpretation, very ironic and with actors making fun of themselves. Almost a parody.

title: Skin Game
actors: James Garner, Louis Gossett jr., Susan Clark, Brenda Sykes
description: Two young people, one black and one white, live on small scams: the white pretends to sell black as a slave, then make it flee and start the game again. Nice anti -racist comedy.

title: City Streets
actors: Gary Cooper, Sylvia Sidney, Paul Lukas
description: The young Nan, daughter of a gangster, ends up in prison for complicity with her father's gang. Kid, her boyfriend (manager of a shooting gallery) joins the gang to free her. During a party in honor of his release, Nan suffers the heavy advances of the gang leader, who orders the elimination of Kid. It will be the boss, however, to be eliminated by his ex-lover. Based on a story by Dashiell Hammet, the film is one of the best gangster-movies in the history of cinema: echoes of the German expressionist lesson and important narrative solutions are found there.

title: Lo scopone scientifico
actors: Alberto Sordi, Silvana Mangano, Bette Davis, Joseph Cotten
description: In Rome, year after year, the card challenge is repeated between a couple of huts and a tough American rich woman. After yet another humiliating defeat of the two poor people, their eldest daughter will take revenge. Original and gripping comedy with a quartet of sacred monsters at their best. On the rubble of the Italian comedy, Comencini constructs a ferocious allegory on the relations of class and power (and on the relations between America and vassal states). Screenplay by Rodolfo Sonego.

title: Star
actors: Jennie Garth, Craig Bierko, Ted Wass, Terry Farrell
description: Between Crystal, who lives on a beautiful ranch with her parents, brother and sister, and the young lawyer Hill, the classic love at first sight breaks out. But after the sudden death of her father and that of her brother who tried to defend her against Tom, the brother-in-law who raped her, Crystal, desperate, flees to Los Angeles. In the city of angels she finds success in the world of entertainment by performing first as a singer in a nightclub and then as an actress.
notes: Michael Miller has a couple of good police and prison films not distributed in Italy. Here he throws himself into a melodrama that has too obvious developments.

title: La settimana al mare
actors: Anna Maria Rizzoli, Andrea Occhipinti, Enzo Cannavale, Francesca Romana Coluzzi, Bombolo
description: Carlo is the only child of a mother who tries to protect him from the pitfalls of women and of a father who would like him to give himself a little more to do. Taken by the latter on holiday in a tourist village in Sicily with a friend with the aim of introducing him to the joys of love conquests, the young man proves that he knows how to do more than his own "guides". Comedy not the worst, shot in Bagheria with the most classic of cast. If you want, you can also laugh, especially at the jokes of Bombolo street vendor.

title: Una botta di vita
actors: Alberto Sordi, Bernard Blier, Andréa Ferréol, Vittorio Caprioli, Alberto Sorrentino
description: It is the eve of August 15th and the elderly Elvio Battistini (Alberto Sordi), after the departure of his family who went to Greece, was left alone. The same age Giuseppe Mondardini (Bernard Blier) is also alone, but he still has a great desire to live and, moreover, also a Lancia Aurelia. The two leave for Bordighera, but end up in Saint Tropez, between only imaginary conquests and other pathetic adventures.
notes: As a child Oldoini wanted to become an Italian comedy director. Now that he's grown up and that kind of comedy isn't done anymore, he doesn't know what to do. Here obviously the actors save him and not so much Deaf as a splendid Blier.

title: The Laughing Policeman
actors: Walter Matthau, Bruce Dern, Louis Gossett jr., Anthony Zerbe
description: Among the passengers on a San Francisco bus killed by an unknown killer is Bill Evans, a policeman and friend of Inspector Jack Martin. The latter does not believe in the case and devotes himself, helped by Inspector Larsen, to the search for the reasons why Evans could have been in the crosshairs of a criminal. The traces are vague, but in the end Martin reconstructs a plausible picture of the situation: his suspicions fall on a homosexual, ex-husband of a murdered prostitute.
notes: This descent into the San Francisco slums remains among Rosemberg's best exploits, with a Matthau in great shape.

title: Lacrime napulitane
actors: Mario Merola, Angela Luce, Pupella Maggio, Benedetto Casillo
description: "The good Salvatore commutes between Milan and Naples. His wife, a former singer of some success, is courted by a well-known Camorrista. Angela naturally does not give in to the advances of the individual, but the malice of the Camorrista, combined with a series of fraudulent circumstances, they convince Salvatore of the betrayal of his wife who is expelled from home. Salvatore emigrates to America, but when the Camorra driver runs over Salvatore's daughter with his car, the family is reassembled around the child. The Neapolitan drama is made up of simple elements : the passion, the betrayal, the honor, the family; here all present and sewn to Merola's size. "

title: The Man with One Red Shoe
actors: Tom Hanks, Dabney Coleman, Charles Durning, Lori Singer
description: In order to make shoes for Ross, the head of the CIA, his deputy, Cooper, makes sure that he blatantly "patches" a mission to Morocco. And Ross, who (later) has figured out everything and wants to give back tit for tat, architects a trap himself. Only a young musician, Richard, who has to do with it like cabbages as a snack, should get involved. Luckily there is Mandy, Cooper's collaborator, who falls in love with Richard. Brilliant remake of a French film, acted with a lot of wit.

title: The Butcher's Wife
actors: Demi Moore, Jeff Daniels, George Dzundza, Mary Steenburgen
description: Marina is a young farmer whose romantic visions impress Leo, a Greenwich Village butcher, with whom she marries. Back in the Village, Marina seems to beneficially influence the people of the neighborhood who seem to need Marina's premonitions more than the advice of the psychologist Alex who decides to investigate this mysterious phenomenon. After the sensational success of "Ghost-Phantom", Demi Moore still hangs out in the world of the surreal in this subtle 1940s-style romantic comedy. Next to her the likeable Jeff Daniels ("Something overwhelming") in the role, congenial to him, of the psychologist.

title: They Came to Cordura
actors: Gary Cooper, Rita Hayworth, Van Heflin, Tab Hunter
description: Charged with reporting heroic deeds during Pancho Villa's war against Mexicans (1916), Major Thorn of the American cavalry gathers four worthy of mention and sets off with them to Cordura, home of the depot. He has an episode of cowardice behind him, but he carries out the mission very firmly, even when the "heroes" behave like bad soldiers.
notes: Interesting analysis of contradictory human behavior, convincing precisely because it is not at all stereotyped. Good narrative rhythm (with only some length), big name performers, subtle underlying melancholy.

title: Bloodrun
actors: David Bradley, Ashley Laurence
description: The lifeless body of a beautiful young girl, Billly, is found in a hotel room, and detectives Brad and Paige are put in charge of the investigation. The first suspicion falls on Spike, Billy's boyfriend, with whom she had had a fight shortly before. When Brad and Paige go to Spike for questioning, they find him in the middle of a drug transaction. From Boaz Davidson, specialist of the genre and purebred horse of the Golan Globus stable, yet another variation on the theme, with little originality and many obvious things.

title: Los amigos
actors: Anthony Quinn, Franco Nero, Pamela Tiffin
description: In Confederate Texas, Johnny and his deaf-mute friend Erastus foil the plot of a general who wants to establish a dictatorship with the help of the Prussians. Italian production between comedy and action, with beautiful setting, unlikely story and bad direction. Not even two good actors like Anthony Quinn and Franco Nero are saved.

title: The Stepford Wives
actors: Katharine Ross, Paula Prentiss, Nanette Newman, Peter Masterson, Mary Stuart Masterson, Tina Louise, Carol Eve Rossen, William Prince, Patrick O'Neal
description: From New York, Walter and Joanna move with their children to Stepford. She finds the other wives in the country too submissive to their husbands and thinks of a purely psychological addiction. But he is wrong. Unusual gothic-feminist atmospheres that would have been better enhanced by a little more rhythm. But the story, taken from the novel by Ira Levin ("Rosemary's Baby") and written by William Goldman ("The Marathon Runner") has a disturbing force.

title: Housesitter
actors: Steve Martin, Goldie Hawn, Dana Delany, Julie Harris
description: Newton, a brilliant architect, is madly in love with Becky. Sure that the woman will marry him, he builds a beautiful villa for them. But Becky refuses and so Newton goes back to Boston. Here he meets Gwen. The two spend the night together and Gwen settles into his house pretending to be his wife.
notes: The story is not new, and the structure inevitably recalls the classics of the 1930s genre. Unfortunately, the screenplay is not always up to par with many models, Oz as a director does what he can, but the performers manage very well, saving possible moments of tiredness.

title: La traviata
actors: Anna Moffo, Gino Bechi
description: From "The Lady of the Camellias" by Dumas, the tragic and impossible love between the noble Alfredo and the courtesan Violetta, who abandons him believing she is doing him good only to see him again at the point of death. Verdi's opera interpreted by two glories of national bel canto, Anna Moffo and Gino Bechi. Director the same husband of the soprano.

title: Beau-père
actors: Patrick Dewaere, Ariel Besse, Nicole Garcia
description: Rémi loses his partner, Martine, in an accident. Marion, a fourteen daughter from Martine, prefers to live with him rather than with the real father of her. A relationship is born between the two. The rough theme is treated with great delicacy in this film written and directed by Bertrand Blier.

title: The Crow
actors: Brandon Lee, Michael Wincott, Rochelle Davis, Ernie Hudson
description: On the eve of Halloween, dark musician Eric Draven is brutally murdered with his girlfriend by a gang of drug addicts. Exactly a year later, Eric is resurrected, pale, black-clad and accompanied by a mysterious crow. Immortal, he hunts down the killers and their leader, Dollar, but the latter, thanks to his lover, an expert in occultism, puts him in difficulty.
notes: Evocative black fairytale, a skilful mix of horror, fantasy, thriller, well rhythmic, with a broken montage and a rock soundtrack. Brandon Lee died of an accident on set and some scenes were completed by entering his electronic image. Based on a comic, which later became a cult, by James O’Barr.

title: The Glass Shadow
actors: Elias Koteas, Angelina Jolie, Allen Garfield, Billy Drago, Jack Palance
description: Pinwheel Industries built Cash, a female cyborg. Her martial arts instructor Colt falls in love with her, but certain plans call for Cash to blow up. Colt escapes with his beloved. Thinking of a case of industrial espionage, Pinwheel dispatches two killers on the hunt for fugitives. But a cyborg dog rescues them and leads them to the unarmed battleship of the strange Captain Mercy. Despite the title, this B-movie has nothing to do with the "Cyborg" interpreted by Van Damme in 1989, if anything we are in the wake of "Blade Runner". In the cast, in addition to the disturbing cybernetic woman Angelina Jolie, to report the "cameo" of Jack Palance.

title: Guilty As Sin
actors: Rebecca De Mornay, Don Johnson, Jack Warden, Dana Ivey
description: Jennifer Haines (De Mornay), although still young, has gained a reputation as a lawyer who is very skilled in defending her clients. She is introduced to David Greenhill (Johnson), accused of murder, who pleads innocent but boasts of being a perfect gigolo. She, attracted by the ambiguous individual, accepts the defense.
notes: Lumet sometimes allows himself a "food" parenthesis, with dignity.

title: Before the Rain
actors: Rade Serbedzija, Katrin Cartlidge, Grégoire Colin, Labina Mitevska
description: The young monk Kiril hides in his convent in Macedonia an Albanian girl whom some Macedonians want to kill; instead, her own will kill her. Aleksandar, a Macedonian photographer who works for a London agency, returns to his native village; his wife's husband is killed.
notes: Golden Lion in Venice '94, the film uses an unusual construction to denounce the horrors of a fratricidal war, but ends with a message of hope. Sociologically honest, but cinematically too clever.

title: The Good Guys and the Bad Guys
actors: Robert Mitchum, George Kennedy, Martin Balsam, David Carradine, Tina Louise, John Carradine
description: Sheriff Jim Flagg is dismissed when he asks the mayor to organize the citizens of Progress against a group of bandits. So he goes on his own and ... they capture him. Then, however, the ferocity of the criminals is such that even a former outlaw who was holding him prisoner comes over to his side. Grand finale with collective shooting.
notes: The transition period between the adventurous lawlessness of the pioneers and the order (?) Of a civilization based on precise rules is described here in tones of (at least occasionally) effective satirical humor. Two old Hollywood stars, Robert Mitchum and George Kennedy, face off.

title: Jumping Jacks
actors: Dean Martin, Jerry Lewis, Mona Freeman, Robert Strauss
description: His friend Jack (Martin) is in the military in a parachute camp, and Sam (Lewis), to help him set up a magazine show, sneaks into the soldiers. He will combine all the colors, and will also be forced to jump with a parachute. But, despite his clumsiness, it will be his own unit, under his command, to win the military maneuvers. One of the best outcomes of Jerry Lewis, in the fifteen films he played in a steady couple with Dean Martin. The setting of the armed forces is a "classic" of smashing comedy, and here too the gimmick works.

title: Infelici e contenti
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Ezio Greggio, Marina Suma, Francesca D'Aloja
description: Aldo, a banker, former water polo champion, now lives in a wheelchair due to a car accident. Vittorio, half a rogue, blind, manages to live with small scams. The two meet by chance and by chance they get into various misadventures that lead them to the casino of Sanremo where Aldo finds Petrilli, the man responsible for his car accident.
notes: This is the Italian mockery of "Don't look at me, I don't hear you" and it's not funny. The subject is not ignoble and Greggio is also good, but Pozzetto who is the former water polo champion is definitely too much to swallow.

title: Blossoms in the Dust
actors: Greer Garson, Walter Pidgeon, Felix Bressard
description: After the death of her husband and daughter, Edna is committed to helping orphans. Technicolor teardrop with a great Greer Garson. The screenplay is by Anita Loos, that of the novel "Men Prefer Blondes"

title: Marguerite de la nuit
actors: Michèle Morgan, Yves Montand, Jean-François Calvé
description: George, an old professor who has spent his life on books, one evening meets Léon, a strange kind of gentleman who takes him to his nightclub. The man is struck by the beauty of Margherita the girl who is performing on stage. Léon who has supernatural powers makes a strange and terrible proposal to the old professor. George must sell his soul, abandoning it to damnation after death, in exchange for Margaret's love and eternal youth.
notes: Rereading of the Faustian myth with Faust in a marginal position: protagonists Margherita and Léon, love and evil (Morgan and Montand at best).

title: Dom za vesanje
actors: Davor Dujmovic, Bora Todorovic, Ljubica Adzovic
description: Perhan and Daza, two Slavic boys, are tossed between Yugoslavia and Italy, in the hands of a bunch of criminals who are trafficking with human beings. Before the dissolution of the Titoist republic. Kusturica in his third film changes screenwriter and it shows. Abdullah Sidran is gone and so we miss out on much of the atmosphere and fun. Goran Brgovic's music is excellent, and some moments are captivating, even if the film has moments of tiredness.

title: The Brave Little Toaster
description: Fatally bored by the absence of their master from the house, five appliances, led by a small toaster, set out in search of him. A pleasant animated film based on a novel by Thomas M. Dish, a famous science fiction writer.

title: Brainstorm
actors: Christopher Walken, Natalie Wood, Louise Fletcher
description: Some scientists invent a machine that can record emotions and transfer them to another person. The thing works as long as you remain in the game: wearing a special helmet you can experience the thrill of the roller coaster without getting up from the chair. The matter becomes complicated when the military wants to take possession of the device, but especially when someone reproduces the "sensations" of someone who is about to die.
notes: Dramatized science fiction that anticipated virtual reality. Natalie Wood died during the filming and the story had to be reworked: the electronics still did not allow anyone to "resurrect".

title: Batman: Mask of the Phantasm
description: There is a mysterious Phantom who is killing all the most important underworld leaders in the world. The problem is, from the press to the police, everyone thinks this is Batman's doing. It goes without saying that Batman is perplexed. And it is even more so when Adrienne Beaumont appears in his life, the woman who years earlier had agreed to marry him and then had mysteriously disappeared. Warner Bros has the rights to Batman and therefore can do whatever it wants with it, even an animated film. The thing, in the form of a television serial, had worked well. What doesn't quite work is its theatrical version.

title: Ultimate Desire
actors: Martin Kemp, Kate Hodge, Robert Miranda, Deborah Shelton
description: A series of murders shocks Beverly Hills. What remains at the crime scene every time, apart from the corpses, is the aroma of the perfume "Desire". This worries Grace Lantel, owner of the company that produces the perfume, to the point of pushing her to hire the private detective Lauren. Lauren's suspicions confirm the idea that the relationship between the perfume and the murderer is by no means coincidental. As for the perfume, which is very expensive and sophisticated, we will have to trust what the actors say. What you see for sure is Deborah Shelton, the girl who ended up impaled on the tip of a drill in De Palma's "Murder in Red Light".

title: Chiari di luna
actors: Lello Arena, Tosca D'Aquino, Julia Nickson, Giovanni Mauriello
description: Accompanied by a nun aunt, Davide, at the age of thirty, leaves the country to go and live in Naples. After trying many jobs without success, he finally realizes an old dream of his: he becomes a magician and joins a ramshackle company. Lello Arena began his artistic career with Massimo Troisi and the Neapolitan group of the "Smorfia", but in this film he does not demonstrate that he has a talent in directing similar to that of an interpreter.

title: Due mafiosi contro Al Capone
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, José Calvo, Moira Orfei
description: Franco and Ciccio, who emigrated to New York, find themselves enlisted, due to a misunderstanding, in the police of the city. Despite their total inexperience, they unmask the clandestine distillery of Joe Minasi, Al Capone's right hand man (we are in full prohibition) and then, infiltrated into the gang as fake mafiosi, they even arrest the famous gangster.
notes: A certain accuracy in the reconstruction and some gags of the duo, make the film quite enjoyable.

title: Il cavaliere del castello maledetto
actors: Massimo Serato, Irene Tunc, Luisella Boni
description: Giannetto, aka the Masked Knight, fights against the abuses of Ugo di Collefeltro (Serato) and also conquers the heart of the beautiful Isabella. Silly Italian adventure film co-produced with France.

title: Il magnifico gladiatore
actors: Mark Forest, Marilù Tolo, Oreste Lionello
description: Zuddo, leader of the praetorians, plots a conspiracy against Hercules, son of the king of the Dacians and now hostage of the Romans. Weird as the names of the characters. Brescia will continue to work for decades, specializing in Neapolitan dramas. He died in 2001.

title: Justice est faite
actors: Noël Roquevert, Antoine Balpêtré, Jean Debucourt, Annette Poivre
description: Elsa Lundenstein, a graduate in medicine, kills her elderly lover, struck by an incurable disease, after having cared for him for two years. The seven jurors who must express the verdict are influenced both by their different ethical convictions and by the events that have marked their respective lives. The woman is sentenced to five years in prison. Few? Too many? Was justice really done? Cayatte, standard-bearer of the cinema of civil commitment of the time (for this film he won the Golden Lion in Venice and the Golden Bear in Berlin) then became proverbial as a didactic, heavy and courtly director. But in his best results, like here, he has to be recognized as having a certain job in directing the actors and in suspense. Of course, giving him the Golden Lion in Venice in 1950, the year of Ophüls' "La ronde", was a bit of an exaggeration.

title: Il bestione
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Michel Constantin, Giuliana Calandra, Giuseppe Maffioli
description: Sandro Colautti, a rough Lombard truck driver, is assigned Nino Patrovita, a young and exuberant Sicilian, as second driver. At the beginning, also given the profound difference in character, between the two they are sparks, but then Sandro and Nino even decide to go on their own. They will have trouble with the "big beast" they now own, but they will come out unscathed and more friends than ever. The two protagonists are well defined, but the mixture of humorous and dramatic elements is a little too strident; the opportunity is wasted for a convincing analysis of an under-exploited environment.

title: La bionda
actors: Sergio Rubini, Nastassja Kinski, Ennio Fantastichini, Luca Barbareschi
description: Tommaso, a young southern watchmaker occasionally in Milan, runs over a beautiful blonde with his car. It's nothing serious, but she takes refuge in Tommaso's house. The man is not insensitive to the charm of his "victim" and, when he discovers that she is embroiled in a circle of ill repute, he tries in every way to help her out. But fate is cruel. After his directorial debut with "La stazione", Sergio Rubini plays the card of a more marked drama, while maintaining some basic elements of his previous film. There is some fragility in the script, but the result is still decent.

title: Riusciranno i nostri eroi a ritrovare l'amico misteriosamente scomparso in Africa?
actors: Alberto Sordi, Bernard Blier, Nino Manfredi, Franca Bettoja
description: The publisher Di Salvio (Sordi) and his collaborator, the faithful accountant Palmarini (Blier), go to Angola in search of the brother-in-law of the former (Manfredi), who has not given any news of himself for a long time. Between adventurous adventures and misdirections, they will end up finding him and convincing him to go home, where his wife, civilization, well-being, etc. await him. But it's worth it? The satire of our world and its much vaunted "values" is there, and at times even biting, but the film is based above all on the dialogues, which makes it rather weak, despite the presence of consummate histrions.

title: Pure Luck
actors: Martin Short, Danny Glover, Sheila Kelley, Sam Wanamaker
description: The unfortunate and bungling daughter of a finance mogul goes missing while on vacation in Mexico. The father, desperate, does a sensible and a foolish thing. Hire a solid detective to go find her. And this is the right thing. Together with the latter, however, he also sends his accountant as bungling and unfortunate as the missing girl. American remake, directed by an Australian director, of the French film "The Goat", starring Gérard Depardieu. An unfortunate and messy film, which remained unreleased in Italy probably because "The goat" was the film screening at the Statuto cinema in Turin the day it was destroyed by the fire.

title: Excessive Force
actors: Thomas Ian Griffith, Lance Henriksen, James Earl Jones, Tony Todd
description: Boss Burt Young has a nasty suspicion that one of the cops who blew up a large drug purchase slipped away from the crime scene and took away the three million dollars in cash that was supposed to be used for the purchase. Of the three policemen involved in the operation, only Terry McCain remains alive who, before becoming the third corpse, decides to pay a visit to Young ... In addition to breaking a good number of arms and dislocating dozens of shoulders, this is Thomas Ian Griffith also appears as a producer and screenwriter. Too much for his frail forces. Throw away the talents of Henriksen and Jones.

title: Year of the Comet
actors: Penelope Ann Miller, Tim Daly, Louis Jourdan, Art Malik, Ian Richardson
description: Margaret is a highly experienced winemaker. When, among the bottles preserved in an ancient Scottish castle, she discovers a magnum of Lafitte vintage 1811, it is for her a remarkable personal success. She does not know yet, but her troubles will begin precisely from this success: that was in fact the year of the comet and, as everyone knows, the passage of these wandering celestial bodies always brings with it harmful influences. However, Margaret finds unexpected help in the role of the hero of the moment who leads her by the hand through the vicissitudes necessary to reach the happy ending. Between comedy and adventure, we are in the neighborhood of the lucky "In pursuit of the green stone": ordinary entertainment even if scripted by William Goldman ("Butch Cassidy" and "Misery must not die").

title: Dirty Dingus Magee
actors: Frank Sinatra, George Kennedy, Anne Jackson, Lois Nettleton
description: Dingus Magee steals $ 400 from Hoke Magee. He, appointed sheriff of Buco Stanco by the mayor Belle Knaps, owner of the local brothel, captures him, but Dingus is freed by the beautiful Indian Anna Horwater. He later gets involved in an Indian war, finds a jade chest hidden in a cemetery and gets married, but the marriage goes awry.
notes: Western between farce and adventure: a divertissement signed by Burt Kennedy with an "all star" cast but without great verve.

title: The Crucifer of Blood
actors: Charlton Heston, Richard Johnson, Susannah Harker, Edward Fox
description: The famous British private investigator, always accompanied by his faithful friend Dr. Watson, is this time grappling with an ancient curse concerning a stolen treasure.
notes: The stainless Charlton Heston is directed here by his son Fraser. Both had already made for television the remake of "A man for all seasons", the story of Thomas More, and here they try a flat version of the adventures of Holmes, a character very far from the ropes of Heston.

title: Hellbound
actors: Chuck Norris, Calvin Levels, Sheree J. Wilson, David Robb, Christopher Neame
description: King Richard the Lionheart defeats a demon sent by Satan, shattering the fearsome "scepter of command" into nine pieces. Eight centuries later, a Los Angeles detective (Norris) investigates a series of seemingly related murders, one rabbi and eight prelates killed. The investigator follows a trail that leads him to Jerusalem and the satanic plans of an archaeologist (Neame).
notes: Produced by the Israeli Cannon, more than an action film it is an indigestible mess of genres, with Chuck Norris facing the devil as we have already seen him do with the Vietcong, with karate shots. Only the diabolical Neame is saved, with professional demeanor.

title: Thunder over Arizona
actors: Skip Homeier, Christine Miller, George Macready
description: Foster, the speculator mayor, attempts to extort a mine from the Ralstons, killing the patriarch. The four sons Ralston, including a girl, barricade themselves in the galleries. To resolve the matter, Foster sends for a gunslinger, but another very different one arrives in his place. From Republic Pictures a typical, passable, B-grade western.

title: Scirocco
actors: Joshua McDonald, Fiona Gélin, Enzo Decaro
description: She is an ex model, he an engineer; They move to North Africa. Beauty likes to play with a mysterious character with an eloquent nickname: "The snake". When the bond tightens too much, satiate and more mature, she returns to Europe. Eros without fantasy, Amnnnito with pseudo-libertarian commonplaces and dusty symbolisms.

title: Someone She Knows
actors: Markie Post, Gerald McRaney, Jeffrey Nordling, Spencer Garrett
description: Laurie lives in a trailer with her second husband and five-year-old first-bed daughter: Marilee. One evening the little girl disappears. They find her, after several hours of terrible waiting, raped and killed. Police investigations do not lead to any useful results in finding out who is the culprit and all the clues turn out to be inconsistent. Mama Laurie almost goes crazy and starts to investigate maniacally on her own, even if formally inhibited by the authorities to take the place of the investigators. Of one thing Laurie is absolutely sure: Marilee would never go away with a stranger and so all friends, relatives, acquaintances are suspected, at the cost of alienating their esteem and affection forever. The stubbornness of the woman, however, is rewarded and, indeed, her report serves to prevent a second, heinous crime, just a few moments before the maniac attacks a little friend of Marilee. The script is the weak point of this TV-movie. Not only is it full of inconsistencies, but it leaves very little doubt from the start about the identity of the killer. All that is saved are the actors, headed by the desperate and hallucinatory Markie Post.

title: Electric Dreams
actors: Lenny Von Dohlen, Virginia Madsen, Maxwell Caulfield, Bud Cort
description: Miles is a young architect with a big job to do and, a few days ago, also with a brand new personal computer. The problem is that computers aren't foolproof, and sometimes they even have a heart. So that of Miles, following a sort of computer collapse, wakes up and proves to be an affable conversationalist, a good musician and, moreover, an incorrigible sentimental.
notes: A modern fairy tale full of good feelings and comic situations. This is the intention of the authors. The result, on the other hand, is an ugly pateracchio of clichés and foolishness. Giorgio Moroder's music is not enough to save the situation.

title: Bodies, Rest & Motion
actors: Phoebe Cates, Bridget Fonda, Tim Roth, Eric Stoltz
description: It all happens in a weekend: TV salesman Nick, who had an affair with Carol and now lives with her best friend, Beth, decides to return to his hometown. But Beth doesn't follow him. Instead, she accepts the court of the painter Sid, but when he asks her to live together, she leaves. Here comes Nick, who orders Sid to follow Beth and, for his part, gets back together with Carol.
notes: Less superficial than it may appear from the plot summary, the film is a convincing denunciation of the malaise of a generation (post-teenagers) presented with a sensitive eye. Good rock soundtrack.

title: Look Who's Talking Now
actors: John Travolta, Kirstie Alley, Olympia Dukakis, Lysette Anthony
description: James Ubriacco's family lives an almost happy period: he works (finally as an airplane pilot) for the president of a cosmetics company, she has lost her job, but she has to look after the two frugoletti. However, the suspicion arises that between James and his boss there is something tender. Then two dogs arrive and, between one thing and another, the clouds disappear and the clear sky returns.
notes: There is nothing new in the idea of ??talking dogs: generations of street vendors have lived there among village fairs and third-rate circuses. Yet it is the smartest thing in the film, the only thing that makes this poor "sequel" bearable at times.

title: I Love Man in Uniform
actors: Tom McCamus, Brigitte Bako, Kevin Tighe, David Hemblen
description: 31-year-old Henry is a good banker and a decent amateur actor, but his life's dream is to become a television actor. He therefore touches the sky with his finger the time he is chosen for the role of a policeman in a television series. But Henry unable to separate within himself the reality of fiction "lives" his role not only on the set, thus fatally walking towards the tragic conclusion of his dissociated existence.
notes: Favorably received at Cannes in 1993 and multiple award-winning the same year at Cattolica's Mystfest, the film is based on an interesting narrative structure even if it lacks some excess of moralism. The protagonist's interpretation is commendable.

title: Money from Home
actors: Jerry Lewis, Dean Martin, Marije Millar, Pat Crowley, Richard Haydn
description: There is a bookmaker who, blackmailed by a gangster, has to make sure that a certain horse does not participate in a certain race. He therefore relies on his cousin Virginio, who will have to mount the horse in question instead of the real jockey. The horse wins and the bookmaker, duly repentant, marries the beautiful owner.
notes: The Italian title has nothing to do with it, and the film is not the best thing about the Martin-Lewis tandem. Every now and then we laugh, but the genius of Tashlin or Lewis director is missing.

title: Another Country
actors: Rupert Everett, Colin Firth, Michael Jenn, Robert Addie, Rupert Wainwright
description: Guy Bennet, an Englishman who was employed by the KGB, tells an American journalist in Moscow about his youth. When he was studying, in the thirties, in a public school; of the climate of opportunism and hypocrisy that permeated the environment; the widespread homosexuality among students; his friendship with Tommy, who later died during the civil war in Spain; of his betrayal ...

title: Roar
actors: Noel Marshall, Tippi Hedren, Melanie Griffith, John Marshall
description: An ethologist, Hank, has lived for years in Africa in a farm house with many wild beasts that man has raised since they were puppies and with whom he lives in harmony. One day his wife and children go to visit him but, due to a mistake, they arrive at the farm when Hank is not there and suddenly find themselves among the animals.
notes: Partly autobiographical and all shot in the family by Hedren's husband and Griffith's father. Unmemorable in itself, the film is curious precisely because it sees the two actresses mother and daughter together.

title: Ehrengard
actors: Jean-Pierre Cassel, Audrey Matson, Lea Padovani, Alessandro Haber
description: In an imaginary Central European kingdom, the well-known painter and Casanova Wolfgang Cazote tries to seduce the virginal Ehrengard while the Grand Duchess plots with him to marry her son Lothair. Discreet transposition of the homonymous story by Karen Blixen. Bloodless, he loses much of the enigmatic and dizzying charm of the text, but is supported by a good Cassell in the role of the seducer.

title: I due magnifici fresconi
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Ennio Girolami, Valeria Fabrizi
description: Franco and Ciccio are unable to sell a load of wine and so they try to exploit the beauty of their wives to entice buyers, but they get a taste for it. They are later hired by an individual who wants to get rid of his wife. Boring and patchy.

title: Der Tod des Empedokles
actors: Andreas Von Rauch, Vladimir Baratta, Martina Baratta, Ute Cremer
description: The famous philosopher Empedocles is chased from Agrigento by his jealous enemies of the very high degree of spirituality he has achieved. Only his disciple Pausanias follows him into exile. Realizing their mistake, however, his former enemies beg him to return but Empedocles refuses and kills himself. Exemplary cinematographic transposition of Hölderlin's tragedy, set in suggestive Sicilian locations (Donnafugata, Etna, Segesta).

title: Fahrenheit 451
actors: Oskar Werner, Julie Christie, Cyril Cusack, Anton Driffing
description: In a hypothetical society of the future, reading is forbidden and the firefighters are assigned to fire the books. Among these, the most diligent is Montag, who however begins to have doubts when he meets Clarissa. She is a young governess and introduces him to some members of a group of book men who keep the practice of reading alive in hiding. Montag becomes a rebel.
notes: Based on a novel by Ray Bradbury, one of Truffaut's least loved films. He made it in England in the midst of many difficulties. The result is still good, especially for the evoked atmospheres. Wonderful music by Bernard Herrmann and photography by Nicholas Roeg.

title: The Squeaker
actors: Edmund Lowe, Sebastian Shaw, Ann Todd, Alastair Sim
description: A receiver (very skilled in not being identified) is used to agree on a figure with the thieves that bring him the goods: those who do not accept ends up reported to Scotland Yard. For this reason he is known as "the informer" in the environment. But a police inspector, for months on his tracks, manages to find him.
notes: Good detector taken from a novel by Edgar Wallace and produced by Alexander Korda.

title: Wind Across the Everglades
actors: Christopher Plummer, Burl Ives, Peter Falk, Gypsy Rose Lee
description: An ecologist working in Florida wages a gruesome personal battle against poachers who hunt endangered species of birds for the sole purpose of selling their beautiful feathers.
notes: Film with contrasting processing: at the end of filming Ray, on the verge of chronic alcoholism, was removed from the producers and therefore could not supervise the editing. However, the visual appeal of some sequences remains, and the beauty of the story, very courageous for the time. John Boorman honored the film with his "The Emerald Forest". Peter Falk debut.

title: The Swiss Conspiracy
actors: David Janssen, Senta Berger, John Ireland, Ray Milland
description: David Christopher once worked for the US Department of Justice, now lives in Switzerland and is a private detective. He is currently dealing with five clients of a bank in Zurich who are victims of blackmail. Two of these die immediately, among the three remaining there is a very charming woman. A somewhat rambling thriller shot at the end of his career by a science fiction specialist.

title: The Rose and the Jackal
actors: Christopher Reeve, Madolyn Smith Osborne, Carrie Snodgress
description: At the beginning of the Civil War, there is a Confederate spy network operating in Washington. When the network is discovered, it is Alan Pinkerton (Reeves), the founder of the Unionist intelligence service, to save the day. He frames and has a woman arrested who passed information to the enemy, but, locked up in prison, he falls in love with her. Fortunately, with the end of the conflict and the pacification, the reasons that stand in the way of the feelings of the two lovers no longer exist. Carrie Snodgress (Frank Perry's "restless housewife") is no longer twenty and her identification with the character is a bit forced.

title: Tha Ballad of Cable Hogue
actors: Jason Robards, Stella Stevens, David Warner, Strother Martin, L. Q. Jones, Slim Pickens, Peter Whitney, R.G. Armstrong, Gene Evans, William Mims, Kathleen Freeman, Susan O'Connor, Vaughn Taylor, James Anderson
description: Although robbed of everything and abandoned by his associates in the desert, Cable Hogue, a gold digger, manages to survive and set up a service station for stagecoaches. The initiative turns out to be spot on and the man reaches a discrete comfort. He is still saved when his former associates try again to rob him, but fate lurks.
notes: Pekinpah tells of the end of the mythical West of the pioneers, relentlessly overwhelmed by progress.

title: East of Eden
actors: Julie Harris, James Dean, Raymond Massey, Jo Van Fleet
description: We are in 1914 in Salinas Valley, in Northern California. Adam Trask lives on a farm with his sons Aaron and Cal. One is good, the other bad because he thinks he is little loved by his father. The mother abandoned her husband long ago and now runs a brothel in Monterey. Economic setbacks, the outbreak of war and personal torments lead to the ruin of the family.
notes: Shot from Kazan based on a part of John Steinbeck's novel, the film travels the paths of American history through the biblical theme of Cain and Abel with a great sense of drama. It's the movie that made James Dean famous. Oscar to Jo Van Fleet as Supporting Actress.

title: Deathtrap
actors: Michael Caine, Christopher Reeve, Dyan Cannon
description: A mature playwright in crisis (Caine) invites a brilliant newcomer (Reeves), author of an interesting script, into the country house. The intent is to kill him to steal the work, but the presence of his wife and the bond that is established between the two men produce more than a twist. In fact, the dead man escapes, but in reality things are not what they seem ... enjoyable at the theater (the play from which it is based was by Ira Levin) and at the cinema. Caine looms large as the playwright.

title: Cactus Flower
actors: Ingrid Bergman, Walter Matthau, Goldie Hawn
description: Julian Winston, a dentist by profession and a bachelor by vocation, pretends to be married so as not to suffer the marital advances of the young Toni. This, desperate, tries to take her own life. Julian, moved by the gesture, promises to marry her as soon as he is divorced. At this point, however, he has to invent a wife, whom he believes he will find in the nurse in his office ...
notes: Screenplay by the great I.A.L. Diamond and excellent interpretation of Walter Matthau and Ingrid Bergman. In the cast stands Goldie Hawn, in her first major role, who with this film obtained the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress.

title: Mac
actors: John Turturro, Katherine Borowitz, Michael Badalucco, Ellen Barkin
description: Mac and his two brothers live in New York; we are in the fifties and, on the death of his father, Mac convinces the other two to follow him in founding their own construction company. It won't be easy to overcome the difficulties, but Mac is supported by a personal belief in the beauty of the work that allows him to start the adventure in a promising way. Then the union between the three cracks and the dream ends.
notes: John Turturro's face has been made familiar to us especially by the films of Spike Lee and the Coen brothers. Standing behind the camera, the Italian-American actor proves to be a complete and intelligent filmmaker. His Italian-American fresco has at times the flavor of the stories heard.

title: L'Ave Maria
actors: Nino D'Angelo, Maria Rosaria Omaggio, Elena Valentino, Lino Crispo
description: Nino, 25 years old, widower and father of little Ciro, sings at the wedding banquets. He meets the teacher Angela: between the two it is immediately love. Gaetano, a jealous and treacherous boyfriend, has Nino arrested accusing him of selling fake money. Released from jail, Nino is successful as a singer, he risks losing "Ciruzzo his" due to an accident, he catches Angela on the altar, while he is about to marry Gaetano.
notes: Second feature film for Nino D'Angelo; the first of the four he raged with in 1982, establishing himself as the star of the Neapolitan musical. Love, tears and songs: the factors are the usual; the order changes, but not the result.

title: Mystery Date
actors: Ethan Hawke, Teri Polo, Fisher Stevens, B.D. Wong, Tony Rosato
description: For a very long time, young, naive and shy Tom McHugh (Ethan Hawke) has wanted to go out with the beautiful neighbor Geena Matthews. The return of older brother Craig is a good opportunity. Tom borrows credit cards, suit and car, a 1959 DeSoto, which, however, contains in the trunk ... two corpses. This attracts the dangerous attention of the Chinese mafia to the boys. Hawke had already done "The Fleeting Moment", but not yet "Young, cute and unemployed" or had not yet entered the Top Ten of the beautiful for the nineties. Wacks does what he can, but a less rough script would have come in handy.

title: Ulisse
actors: Kirk Douglas, Silvana Mangano, Anthony Quinn, Rossana Podestà
description: while Ulysses wanders the seas desolate, the faithful Penelope has to contend with the suitors who have taken power in Ithaca. Thanks to an amnesia, Ulysses has the opportunity to appreciate the love of the young Nausicaa. Then his memory comes back, he remembers being married and having to go home. King Alcino offers him a ship to return to Ithaca where the suitors await him ...
notes: The most expensive blockbuster produced in post-war Italy by Ponti and De Laurentiis for Lux. A lot of money was spent on sets, Technicolor and actors. Kirk Douglas acted like a perfect hound throughout the making. Mario Camerini, due to gout, headed from a stretcher. The result is even higher than the American average for the period.
