title: La bamba
actors: Lou Diamond Phillips, Rosana DeSoto, Elizabeth Peña
description: Ricardo Valenzuela is a young farmhand of Mexican descent living in California. His passion for music is thwarted by his family (relations with his half-brother Bob are particularly difficult), but he does not give up. Under the pseudonym of Ritchie Valens, in 1958, he became a famous representative of the new music, rock'n'roll. But on the threshold of fame he dies in a plane crash.
notes: The film returns the disquiet of the character and his music, the tension between the rough immediacy of his roots (social and musical) and the rigidity of the rules of show business. The music is performed by Los Lobos, contemporary "mestizos" of rock.

title: Broken Lance
actors: Spencer Tracy, Robert Wagner, Richard Widmark, Katy Jurado, Jean Peters
description: Matt, a farm owner, is very much loved by his son Joe, who was had by an Indian woman. He takes the blame for the clash his father had with a mine owner and goes to jail. Matt dies of an illness following yet another conflict he had with one of his legitimate children, who hate him and who would like to take his property at all costs. As they battle over the inheritance, Joe gets out of jail and leaves with the woman he loves. But a showdown awaits him.
notes: An anomalous Western, in fact a remake of Mankiewicz's "Bitter Destiny" even if the director Dmytryk insists more on the analogies with Shakespeare's "King Lear". The western context is both tragic and mythical, the family drama, dear to the author, explodes with unprecedented violence. Wonderful actors (Robert Wagner best proof; Tracy and Widmark two guarantees) and an Oscar, to Philip Yordan, for the subject.

title: A double tour
actors: Madeleine Robinson, Antonella Lualdi, Jean-Paul Belmondo
description: The Marcoux family lives in a beautiful mansion in the Provencal countryside. Henri, the head of the family, falls in love with the beautiful Leda; Thérèse, his wife, endures for fear of scandal ...

title: Viaggio in Italia
actors: Ingrid Bergman, George Sanders, Anna Proclemer, Leslie Daniels
description: An English couple in marital crisis arrives in Naples. Strangers to the world around them, they gradually reconnect. Bourgeois alienation in a neorealist system. At first it was not really understood, today it is considered one of the director's masterpieces and one of the founding films of modern cinema, a precursor of the nouvelles vagues. The final scene of the miracle is also the secular miracle of spontaneously unveiling reality. AN example of sublime earthly religiosity, a utopia of vision.

title: Billy the Kid
actors: Johnny Mac Brown, Wallace Beery, Kay Johnson
description: Long pursuit of the relentless sheriff Pat Garrett (Wallace Beery) on the trail of the famous and young outlaw. Western of the early years of sound originally shot in 70 mm., Proposes the more traditional and idealized image of the Kid.

title: This Child is Mine
actors: Lindsay Wagner, Chris Sarandon, Michael Lerner
description: A single mother entrusts the fruit of her mistake to the Wilkersons, but later thinks about it and engages in a long legal battle to get her daughter back. Dramatic exploration of feelings and confrontations based on legal gimmicks in medium television style.

title: Tom & Viv
actors: Willem Dafoe, Miranda Richardson, Tim Dutton, Nicholas Grace, Geoffrey Bayldon
description: At first, the marriage of poet Thomas Stearns Eliot (Dafoe) to Vivienne, a brilliant high society girl, seems blessed with happiness. Then she has health problems and takes drugs that also debilitate her psychically. Years pass and as Eliot's fame grows, his wife becomes more and more intractable, so much so that she is eventually interned in a psychiatric clinic. Linear storytelling, smooth photography, beautiful costumes and suggestive settings: it is the typical product of an academic but flat cinema that has been home to England for some years. Among the least credible interpretations in Dafoe's career.

title: Per un pugno di dollari
actors: Clint Eastwood, Gian Maria Volonté, Marianne Koch, Josef Egger, Wolfgang Luschky, Sieghardt Rupp, José Calvo, Margarita Lozano, Daniel Martin, Benito Stefanelli, Mario Brega, Bruno Carotenuto, Aldo Sambrell
description: A lone gunslinger arrives in San Miguel, on the Mexican border. Here the Rojo and Morales families have been fighting each other for years to control smuggling. Our hero plays a double game, trying to incite them to the final battle. Discovered and tortured, he returns to consume a terrible revenge, after his torturers have managed in the meantime to eliminate all their opponents. Leone has the dazzling idea of ??making an exasperated and ironic western from Kurosawa's "Challenge of the Samurai". The film will be a worldwide success, with its baroque and funereal style. The "spaghetti" variant will help to revive a legendary genre, but in search of oxygen. A prestigious parable begins for Eastwood.

title: The Joy Luck Club
actors: Kieu Chinh, Tsai Chin, France Nuyen, Lisa Lu, Lauren Tom
description: Young June takes the place of her deceased mother in the "Circle of Luck and Happiness", that is, in the group of friends of Chinese origin who gather to play mah-jong. When June is leaving for China, where she will find the sisters abandoned many years earlier by her mother, the elderly "members" relive their experiences as daughters, wives and mothers in the community with which they have not broken the emotional ties.
notes: An evocation of poignant affective density in the "re-reading" of distant parental ties that formed the basis of a coexistence and a life of relationship that the move to the United States destroyed, but not erased from memory.

title: The Age of Innocence
actors: Daniel Day-Lewis, Michelle Pfeiffer, Winona Ryder, Mary Beth Hurt
description: New York, second half of the nineteenth century. Newland Archer, who belongs to the best middle class, gets engaged to May Welland but is attracted, reciprocated, by Ellen, a cousin of hers who returns from Europe where her marriage has failed. May manages to anticipate the wedding and to restart Ellen, now "compromised" by unjustified slander, for Europe. Years later, the widower Newland, in Paris, gives up seeing Ellen again. From the novel of the same name by Edith Wharton, Scorsese makes a film that is unusual in its production for the environment and the time, but cruel, in its refined elegance, at least as much as his works in the current setting. Great performers and great cinema.

title: Storyville
actors: James Spader, Joanne Whalley, Jason Robards, Charlotte Lewis
description: Cray Fowler, a young New Orleans attorney, is in the running for a seat in Congress, despite some shadow in the family past (his father's suicide). Cray has an affair with the beautiful Lee, but her father blackmails them. When the man is killed and the girl is accused, Cray defends her. Meanwhile, he carries out his own investigation into his own family which will lead him to shocking discoveries. A troubled path among the misdeeds of Southern capitalism in search of the unconfessable roots of the cynicism of the powerful.
notes: The director collaborated with David Lynch on "Twin Peaks", but, despite the good actors, the film has heavy limitations.

title: In the Line of Fire
actors: Clint Eastwood, John Malkovich, Rene Russo, Dylan McDermott
description: Since the day they killed Kennedy in Dallas, Frank Horrigan, a United States intelligence agent, has never recovered. Today Horrigan is one step away from retirement but is still there to look after the safety of the current President. One day an aspiring bomber begins to show up. The man calls himself Booth - after Abraham Lincoln's killer - and proves to be aware of Horrigan's obsessions. Thus begins a long-distance duel between the mysterious character and the agent.
notes: Director Petersen isn't that great. The subject is not exactly fulminating. All this to say that the best of the film, much talked about and based mainly on dialogue, is played by Eastwood and Malkovich. Old Clint is priceless when he listens to Miles Davis in solitude, in the dim light. A twilight thriller with remarkable moments.

title: In the Name of the Father
actors: Daniel Day-Lewis, Pete Postlethwaite, Emma Thompson, John Lynch
description: Gerry Conlon, his father Giuseppe, his friend Paul Hill and their families are arrested after an IRA bombing. Under torture, Gerry and Paul "confess", and despite clear evidence of their strangeness all are condemned. Only in 1989, after fifteen years, during which Giuseppe Conlon dies, a counter-information campaign will lead to the revision of the trial.
notes: The film follows a double path: that of the dramatic events of the protagonists and that of the relationship between Gerry and his father. Narrative of strong emotional effectiveness and great performances by the actors. The story told in the film is inspired by a fact that really happened, in turn taken from Gerry Conlon's autobiographical book "The Price of Innocence". And in England, the film opened a debate on the relationship between London and the Northern Irish Republicans. Bono is among the authors of the soundtrack.

title: Scared Stiff
actors: Jerry Lewis, Dean Martin, Lizabeth Scott
description: Larry and Mike are friends, variety artists. One day, Larry fires a pistol to defend Mike and a gangster is killed. Convinced that they are responsible (it is not true), the two flee to Cuba. On the ship they meet Mary, who has inherited a castle in Havana; she thinks there are ghosts, instead there is a gold mine in the garden. Remake of another George Marshall film, "The Woman and the Ghost" (1940) with Bob Hope. Jerry Lewis mocks Carmen Miranda and Humphrey Bogart with truly irresistible results.

title: Big Shots
actors: Ricky Busker, Darius Mc Crary, Robert Joy, Jerzy Skolimowski
description: To a boy, recently remained orphan, steal bicycle and clock (father's gift); A friend of color helps him in research, but the two get into trouble. After recovering not without difficulty the clock from a bieco receiver, to save themselves, they are forced to steal a car. In the trunk of the car, however, there is a ... corpse.
notes: Discreet work on friendship and on the difficult fathers-pairs relationship. The gaze on the slums of the cities is devoid of complacency and leziness even if every now and then you can notice some wink of the conventions.

title: Night and Day
actors: Cary Grant, Alexis Smith, Monty Wooley, Jane Wyman
description: Cole Porter belongs to a traditional bourgeois family. Thus, when he expresses the intention to devote himself to music, the young man incurs the disapproval of the family. Cole goes to great lengths to try to put on musical performances, but the outbreak of World War I abruptly interrupts his dreams of glory. He enlisted in the army and in a break from the fighting he met Linda, a friend of his cousin, with whom he falls in love ...
notes: Curtiz brings the vicissitudes of the great Cole Porter to the screen, from family misunderstandings to success. Obviously the soundtrack is beautiful.

title: The Savage Innocents
actors: Anthony Quinn, Yoko Tani, Peter O'Toole
description: An Eskimo lives in his natural environment, among the eternal ice of the Arctic Circle. Even in those desolate lands, however, the so-called "civilization" arrives, with its technology, its rhythms and its pollution. The old man of the North is destined to perish.
notes: Unsuccessful film by the great Nicholas Ray. Quinn's presence is too "Hollywood" to make the figure of the "good savage" credible, even if some anthropological notes are interesting in the end. Shot in 70 millimeters and therefore irremediably limited in its edition for the small screen.

title: The Miracle
actors: Carroll Baker, Roger Moore, Vittorio Gassman, Walter Slezak
description: In Spain invaded by Napoleonic troops, a nun, Teresa, falls in love with an officer of the dragoons and leaves the convent. During an action the dragon is given up for dead and Teresa marries a gypsy who initiates her into flamenco. When the gypsy also dies, Teresa returns to the convent. Melodrama with historical cues, but dangerously close to comics. The original title refers to a statue of the Madonna who miraculously turns into a double of Teresa to hide her escape from the convent. From the piece "The miracle" by Karl Gustav Vollmoeller, a not very credible meatloaf that escaped the hand of the good rapper. Dumb cast.

title: Redl ezredes
actors: Klaus Maria Brandauer, Jan Niklas, Gudrun Landgrebe
description: The son of a railway worker, Alfred Redl manages to attend military school. He makes a career out of his zeal, cleverly hiding his love for a partner. Placed at the head of counterintelligence, he makes many enemies. It will be Archduke Francesco Ferdinando, who is plotting against the emperor, who will make him fall into the trap, revealing his homosexuality and forcing him to commit suicide.
notes: Meticulous historical reconstruction of an ambiguous and controversial character. Szabo contains Brandauer's histrionics well.

title: Anastasia, mio fratello
actors: Alberto Sordi, Richard Conte, Edoardo Faieta, Maria Tedeschi
description: Don Salvatore leaves Calabria for New York, where he is hired as assistant parish priest in Santa Lucia, Little Italy. His brother Alberto, Big Al to friends, is believed to be the head of the Assassini Company, but Don Salvatore does not realize the situation. When Alberto is tried (and then killed, after his detention), Don Salvatore returns to Italy, still convinced of his brother's innocence.
notes: Loosely based on the autobiographical book by Don Salvatore Anastasia, the film undoubtedly offers some interesting descriptive elements, but exceeds in granting, especially to the character of Alberto Sordi, purely speckish opportunities.

title: Pane, amore e Andalusia
actors: Vittorio De Sica, Peppino De Filippo, Carmen Sevilla, Lea Padovani
description: In order not to marry Donna Violante, the former Carabinieri Marshal Antonio Carotenuto (De Sica) participates with the Sorrento gang, which he directs, in the international competition in Seville. Here is the rich Dolores who courts him and would like to marry him, but the fiery protagonist falls in love with the young Carmen, who loves Paco, loved by the boy but opposed by his father.
notes: Fourth chapter of the saga (now on the verge of saturation) of Marshal Carotenuto that the screenwriters and director try to revitalize with a pinch of exoticism and with the inclusion of Peppino De Filippo.

title: Made in America
actors: Whoopi Goldberg, Ted Danson, Nia Long, Will Smith, Paul Rodriguez
description: Zora (Nia Long), a black high school student, discovers that her father is an anonymous sperm donor. So much so that he manages to identify the ... supplier: Hal (Ted Danson), a car salesman, maybe nice but also, irreparably, white. A series of messes ensue involving his mother (Whoopi Goldberg) and the man in question, before everything settles down, of course, with all due respect.
notes: The film does not hold up (despite the virtues of the protagonists) due to the script and, above all, the direction. There was certainly way to do better.

title: Soldier of Fortune
actors: Clark Gable, Susan Hayward, Michael Rennie, Gene Barry
description: An American reporter mysteriously disappears in Hong Kong. His wife then goes to the Asian city to find out what happened to her husband. Here the inspector following the investigation suggests that the woman seek help from an American adventurer who has been in Asia for years. The man agrees to help her and ends up falling in love with her ...
notes: Edward Dmytryk, shooting in Hong Kong, manages to create discreet atmospheres, also capturing the peculiarities of the environment. The interpreters are quite persuasive, a Clark Gable who starts at dusk but keeps his charm intact, and a Susan Hayward who goes along well with him.

title: Queen's Logic
actors: Joe Mantegna, John Malkovich, Tom Waits, Jamie Lee Curtis, Kevin Bacon
description: They are all thirty or so: Al (Mantegna), with a pestiferous wife and a fish shop; Eliot (Malkovich), homosexual devoted to chastity; Dennis who tried his luck in Hollywood without finding her and Monte (Waits). They reunite for Ray's bachelor party. Then suddenly Grace (Lee Curtis) arrives.
notes: A sort of "big chill" set in Queen's, a New York neighborhood. With such a cast it was almost impossible to make a bad movie. Mantegna is a bit of a showman, Tom Waits is a dazed one; Jamie Lee Curtis plays a far too short part.

title: Koyaanisqatsi
description: Collapses of buildings, natural disasters, accelerated visions of sunsets: all places where the world is in precarious balance, that is in "koyaanisqatsi", as the Hopi Indians say. Do not miss the musical commentary by Philip Glass.

title: Brazil
actors: Jonathan Pryce, Kim Greist, Robert De Niro, Bob Hoskins, Michael Palin
description: Sam Lawry is in charge of the endless archives of a megalopolis, the capital of an unidentified country, in which power and bureaucracy dominate. Nothing escapes the computerized system of the Information Department. For some time now in the city groups of terrorists have started to act, sowing terror in order to move something. Sam, for his part, opposes the dullness of routine with his possibility of escaping in the dream. But one day ...
notes: Free reinterpretation of Orwell's novel "1984", the film is a work where the taste for the mockery, typical of Monty Python, triumphs. The entrance of the plumber De Niro is from an anthology.

title: Choices
actors: George C. Scott, Jacqueline Bisset, Melissa Gilbert, Laurie Kennedy
description: Evan Granger (Scott) has been a judge all his life. And even now that he is retired, his rigor does not seem to have given way as the years go by. What makes him give up are two pregnancies. The first is that of his young wife Marisa (Bisset). The second is that of his unmarried daughter Terry (Gilbert). For both, the most real perspective is that of abortion. A television film already old at the time of its release, and not saved by the actors.

title: Il motorino
actors: Mario Da Vinci, Sal Da Vinci, Eleonora Vallone, Nunzio Gallo
description: Daniela left Mario years before, tired of a life of hardship and the useless illusions of her husband, a singer with no luck. Today Daniela is back in charge because she wants her son Sal with her. Mario, however, rather than succumb to the blackmail of the woman, gives himself up to the underworld and ends up in prison. So Daniela gets the custody of her son who, in truth, only wants to own a moped.
notes: Predictable degraded little script, it is one of Nino D'Angelo's first successes in the cinema.

title: Una giornata particolare
actors: Sophia Loren, Marcello Mastroianni, John Vernon, François Bard
description: On May 6, 1938, while all of Rome is in turmoil because there is a visit from Hitler, Antonietta, mother of six children, wife of a fanatical black shirt and a fascist in turn, meets a neighbor in her popular block: a former Eiar announcer, who lost his job as a homosexual. It will be a special day for both of us, and certainly not because the Führer is a guest of the Eternal City. The meeting and the mutual discovery of two "different", both victims of the vulgar machismo of the regime.
notes: A compact film, masterfully told in the pregnancy of its many meanings, perfect characters entrusted to excellent interpreters.

title: Home Alone 2: Lost in New York
actors: Macaulay Culkin, Joe Pesci, Daniel Stern, Brenda Fricker, Tim Curry
description: Another misunderstanding in the McCallister family: while his parents go to Miami for Christmas, little Kevin finds himself alone in New York. But he gets along very well: he lives as a nabob at the Plaza Hotel, runs into the two criminals from the first film again and again reduces them to a bad start, thus saving the proceeds of the huge Duncan toy emporium. Then he befriends the "pigeon lady" in Central Park.
notes: It was inevitable a "sequel" after the success of the 1990 film. This is repeated flat plate and can not boast the inventiveness of the first episode. The rockers Kevin meets at the airport are members of Springsteen's E-Street Band.

title: Fontana di Trevi
actors: Claudio Villa, Maria Grazia Buccella, Carlo Croccolo, Mario Carotenuto
description: Claudio and Roberto, two Roman boys who work in a tourist agency in front of the Trevi Fountain, meet Dolores, a Spanish girl. Roberto, who does not let any kind of sentimental adventure escape, believing her to be wealthy, pays her court. When the two are sent to Barcelona Claudio, to please his friend, tries in every way to facilitate his meeting with Dolores. At this point, Rosita appears, who impresses Claudio.
notes: Thin slender film with the "reuccio" Villa, which was quite denied for acting.

title: Racconti d'estate
actors: Alberto Sordi, Michèle Morgan, Marcello Mastroianni, Gabriele Ferzetti, Sylva Koscina
description: Episodes of various humanity, in the splendid summer setting of Rapallo. At the center of the story, the story of an administrator who accidentally finds an old flame, but is blackmailed by his lover. Meanwhile, a police commissioner, charged with escorting a French thief across the Ventimiglia border, falls madly in love with the woman.
notes: The screenplay is based on a story by Alberto Moravia. The great Ennio Flaiano worked on the adaptation, among many others (Rodolfo Sonego, Sergio Amidei, Gianni Franciolini, Edoardo Anton, René Barjavel, the same Sordi). Music by Piero Piccioni.

title: Zandalee
actors: Erika Anderson, Judge Reinhold, Nicolas Cage, Viveca Lindfors
description: Thierry Martin is a poet and a failed husband. Between him and his beautiful wife Zandalee there is only affection left. When an old friend of his, the painter Johnny Collins, returns to the city, events precipitate. While the painter paints the portrait of Martin, Zandalee becomes his lover: Johnny in fact reveals himself as a passionate lover as much as violent.
notes: This is the umpteenth variation on the theme of the love triangle, revisited through the heavy atmospheres of the swampy landscape of the Southern States and strengthened by warm embraces. Bad acting.

title: House of Cards
actors: Kathleen Turner, Tommy Lee Jones, Asha Menina
description: Sally is a child traumatized by the death of her father: he was a restorer who fell from a scaffold while working on a Mayan temple. Now Sally does nothing but climb trees, gutters and similar places, causing risks to herself and others. The psychologist who takes her for observation will have to treat, before her, the mother who refuses to take her illness into consideration.
notes: This is the last of the three Pentamerica productions, which sent the Berlusconi-Cecchi Gori axis into crisis. Turner is now overflowing, Jones is a clone of himself and the film might be interesting but it's just weird.

title: Ci hai rotto papà
actors: Elio Germano, Luca Virgulti, Francesca Martana, Tzebo Leokaoke
description: Rome, Prati district. A group of young people, who all live in a building in the neighborhood, usually meet at the Esperia cinema. The leader of the group is called Riccardo, then there are Karate Kid (so called for his muscles), there is Stefania who goes to school from the nuns, the son of the goalkeeper and also that of an African diplomat: little Zibbo. Between one film and the next, the kids play, joke, grow up: they live small and big dramas.
notes: A banal short film with a predictable plot that can be seen without thoughts.

title: The Good Woman of Bangkok
actors: Yagwalak Chonchanakun
description: Aoi is a young prostitute who works on Bangkok's sidewalks, hooking tourists around the city's bars. She does everything to be good: but how is it possible to be good in this world? Especially someone like her, often in contact with violent protectors who steal her income. Not to mention the customers, looking for ever stronger emotions.
notes: Australian O'Rourke shot in the streets of Bangkok, also shooting scenes from life. Prostitution is seen as a real metaphor for capitalism. Here and there the film is boring even for the most willing viewer, but it knows how to redeem itself when the live episodes appear on the screen.

title: Huang Tudi
actors: Xue Bai, Wang Xueqi
description: In 1937, a soldier who collects popular songs is hosted by a farmer; his twelve-year-old daughter asks him to take her with him. Debut of Chen Kaige ("Goodbye my concubine"). Great sense of landscape and direction, in a film linked to the times and places of the peasant world.

title: National Lampoon's Loaded Weapon
actors: Emilio Estevez, Samuel L. Jackson, Jon Lovitz, Whoopi Goldberg
description: Police Sergeant York is found dead in her home. This is how colleague Wes Luger, who was paired with her, is left alone to fight crime. The command, however, supports him with another companion: Jack Colt. This turns out to be a real disaster: he woos Luger's daughter, breaks into his house with a team of bomb squads believing that there is a bomb and other similar things. However, the two are put to investigate drug trafficking marketed through children's cookies. The most immediate references that are captured by the vision of this funny and ramshackle film are those to the series of "Lethal Weapon" and those to the films of the Zucker brothers.

title: Dead Again
actors: Kenneth Branagh, Emma Thompson, Andy Garcia, Derek Jacobi, Robin Williams
description: Mike Church, a private detective from Los Angeles, is entrusted with the case of a beautiful girl in the throes of severe amnesia. Under hypnosis, the girl remembers the troubled married life of Margaret, a famous pianist, and Roman Strauss, a composer, who died in more than dramatic circumstances forty years earlier. It sounds like a case of metempsychosis, but the solution will be even more shocking than expected. On an American trip (the film is produced by Sydney Pollack), after the success of the Shakespearean "Henry V", Branagh creates a thriller perhaps a little too complicated in the construction of the plot, but with a certain taste for the atmosphere. Excellent performances by Branagh, Thompson and, above all, Jacobi. Robin Williams also makes an appearance in a secondary role.

title: Altri tempi
actors: Aldo Fabrizi, Vittorio De Sica, Gina Lollobrigida, Paolo Stoppa, Amedeo Nazzari
description: Film in eight episodes (linked by _Il carrettino dei libri vecchia_, in which a seller shows some volumes): it starts with _Ballo Excelsior_, taken from Marenco, and continues with _Meno di un giorno_ (from Boito), _Il tamburino sardo_ (from De Amicis), _Questione d'amore_ (from Fucini), _L'idillio_, _La morsa_ (from Pirandello), _Pot-pourri of songs_ and the famous _The trial of Phryne_ (from Scarfoglio).
notes: Blasetti reviews life situations more or less directly inspired by famous passages of Italian literature, rendering with sufficient fidelity the atmosphere of the second half of the nineteenth century. The segment with De Sica and Lollo was memorable.

title: Justine
actors: Anouk Aimée, Michael York, Dirk Bogarde, Anna Karina
description: In 1930 in Alexandria, Egypt, the British were about to cede power to the local Muslim majority. The beautiful Justine, a Coptic Christian, generously uses the weapons of seduction for the political cause of her co-religionists. From a novel by Lawrence Durrell, an exotic melodrama not too much in the strings of Cukor, which also succeeds in transforming it into a hypnotic and morbid game, also exploiting the changed customs of the public. Refined conducting of actors.

title: The Gambler
actors: James Caan, Paul Sorvino, Lauren Hutton
description: Professor Axel Freed has a self-destructive passion for the game. He gets a large sum from his mother to pay off a debt, but he plays it and loses it. Threatened by shady creditors, to save himself he bribes one of his basketball champion students and makes him a pawn in the betting mafia.
notes: A vivid psychological and moral portrait, vaguely inspired by Dostoevsky's "The Player". Great tension and superlative James Caan, for a desperate film. Directed by the English Reisz, that of "Saturday evening, Sunday morning".

title: The People Against O'Hara
actors: Spencer Tracy, Diana Lynn, Pat O'Brien, John Hodiak, Eduardo Ciannelli
description: Attorney Jim Curtyane (Spencer Tracy) is a former alcoholic who has left the profession. The lawyer returns to the toga to defend an innocent, accused of a murder instead committed by the underworld. To save his client he also resorts to corruption, then puts his own life on the line.
notes: A somewhat didactic and moralistic drama, but tight and with a fit Spencer Tracy.

title: It's a Great Feeling
actors: Jack Carson, Doris Day, Dennis Morgan, Gary Cooper
description: Warner Bros can't find a director to entrust with a new film starring Jack Carson, so it's the actor himself who has to take over the direction of the film. Together with his friend Dennis Morgan he works hard to find the female interpreter. Life of the Studios in a light key with the appearance of many Warner stars. Directed by such a veteran.

title: My Dream Is Yours
actors: Doris Day, Jack Carson, Adolphe Menjou
description: An impresario looking for a new musical star discovers a talented employee and takes her to Hollywood. For the girl, the first experiences are not roses and flowers, but with a bit of luck in the end she achieves success and marriage. Remake of the "Universe in love", from 1934, directed with fairness but little imagination by Michael Curtiz.

title: American Ninja V
actors: David Bradley, Lee Reyes, Anne Dupont, Tadashi Yamashita
description: A big brain has developed a deadly preparation. A gangster who wants to seize it for his shady and crazy purposes blackmails the inventor by kidnapping his daughter. Joe Castle, martial arts expert, intervenes. The title is linked to a series with Michael Dudikoff, known among fans, who however does not appear in the film.

title: Task Force
actors: Gary Cooper, Walter Brennan, Jane Wyatt, Stanley Ridges
description: Admiral Scott is about to ski the service and is reminiscent of his long career. A pioneer of the air in 1921, he became an ardent supporter of the new aircraft carriers. He marries and trains hundreds of air and naval weapon pilots, then participates in the war in the Pacific. Spoken war propaganda, with action sequences taken from war newsreels.

title: The Super Cops
actors: Ron Leibman, David Selby, Pat Hingle, Dan Frazer, Joseph Sirola
description: Two nonconformist friends who graduated from the police school are entrusted to the 21st district. Here they fight drug dealing, annoying corrupt superiors and hindering the investigations of other colleagues. A funny film by the director of "Shaft", who knows how to navigate lightly between gory themes.

title: Born to Win
actors: George Segal, Paula Prentiss, Karen Black, Robert De Niro
description: Jay takes drugs and makes a living, and not even his new girlfriend can change his course. Together with Billy he fools a big drug dealer thinking he is making the hit of his life, but it is his undoing. Excellent noir with a social background, tinged with bitter humor, by the Czech director and screenwriter Ivan Passer, who emigrated to the United States in 1968.

title: I Love Trouble
actors: Nick Nolte, Julia Roberts, Saul Rubinek, James Rebhorn
description: Sabrina, a novice journalist, blows the very expert Peter, who works for another newspaper, the scoop on a railway derailment. Peter doesn't like it and, at the first opportunity, he gives her back the joke. Then one thing leads to another, the edges smooth out and the two decide to work with love and agreement on a corruption case. And love goes beyond the professional "side" of the matter.
notes: Even the most inexperienced spectator takes a few minutes to understand how the game works, built for the glory of two stars struggling with a trifle of very little weight.

title: Jurassic Park
actors: Sam Neill, Laura Dern, Jeff Goldblum, Richard Attenborough, Ariana Richards, Joseph Mazzello, Samuel L. Jackson, Bob Peck, BD Wong, Martin Ferrero, Wayne Knight
description: A multimiliary is preparing to inaugurate the most exciting zoo in the world: he recreated the dinosaurs for cloning in an island of the Caribbean. But while some guests, including two children, are visiting, a sabota technician the safety systems and lizards combine with cooked and raw. When you manage to take up the situation, the owner decides not to do anything about it.
notes: It is not the best film by Spielberg, but it is a perfect show machine that admirably puts technologies to the time very advanced to create visual wonders and narrative tension. A scheme nothing more than elementary that becomes a sophisticated attraction. From a novel by Michael Crichton. He conscious a sequel -the lost world. Jurassic Park (1997) -always directed by Spielbeg, and a third chapter -Jurassic Park III (2001) -where Spielberg was held the part of executive producer, entrusting the direction to Joe Johnston.

title: Flesh and Bone
actors: Dennis Quaid, James Caan, Meg Ryan, Gwyneth Paltrow, Scott Wilson
description: In the endless Texan plain, Arlis supplies the distributors with food and condoms with his truck. Everything is always calm, until the day when his path crosses that of Kathy, a young woman who is weighed down by a ruined childhood and a failed marriage. Between the two it is immediately passion, but here the past reappears, under the guise of the disturbing Roy, Arlis's father. Director Steve Kloves, in his second film after "The Fabulous Bakers", confirms his talents as a quick storyteller and an excellent director of actors.

title: The Adventures of Priscilla, Queen of the Desert
actors: Terence Stamp, Hugo Weaving, Guy Pearce, Bill Hunter
description: Felicia, Mitzi and Bernadette are on their way to Alice Springs, in the middle of the Australian desert, where they have to perform in a cabaret. Felicia and Mitzi are two transvestites, Bernadette is a transsexual. The trip with Priscilla (the name of the bus on which they travel) is the pretext for a pyrotechnic display of the most unbridled kitsch and many calculated hysteria, with parentheses of humanity.
notes: A deliberate "sideshow" that, perhaps, could even be more daring. But the fun is there, noisy and mischievous. However, the three "women" are truly priceless.

title: Father Hood
actors: Patrick Swayze, Halle Berry, Diane Ladd, Sabrina Lloyd, Michael Ironside
description: Patrick Swayze plays the part of a funny and messy scammer. He is on the eve of his biggest blow, the one that will fix him for life. Instead, he runs into Kelly and Eddie, two cheeky brats who introduce themselves as his children. In fact, they are chased by the police and, to save themselves, they slipped into his convertible, dragging their father on a series of incredible adventures thereafter. A mixture of yellow and pink, the film is a not too successful comedy that mixes "Paper Moon" with "Beware of those two". Patrick Swayze casually plays the role of the false parent.

title: Two-Fisted Tales
directors: Richard Donner, Tom Holland (II), Robert Zeme
actors: Brad Pitt, Kirk Douglas, Eric Douglas
description: The film is divided into three episodes: the first, "Showdown" (by Donner) is a western in which two cowboys are transformed into zombies. The second, "King of the Road" (by Holland) tells the horrifying deeds of a reckless car racing teddy boy. The third, "Yellow" (by Zemeckis) has been called a remake of "Paths of Glory" starring Kirk and Eric Douglas. On the exact border between horror and fantastic are these three episodes, real nightmares, similar to the universe of "At the edge of reality". The mix of genres and the claustrophobic atmospheres are the winning cards of the film, which includes some episodes of a luxurious TV series.

title: Flashpoint
actors: Kris Kristofferson, Treat Williams, Rip Torn
description: Logan and Ernie are two border guards between the United States and Mexico. Logan is a shrewd and disillusioned Vietnam veteran; Ernie is a young loyal to work. They find a charred car with a dead guy in it and a briefcase with a bunch of dollars. The two, for a moment, think of getting the money, but then they begin to investigate the body.
notes: Strange mix of themes and problems: from adventure, to virile friendship, to politics. The film is the portrait of two people, two agents unwilling to compromise with their conscience.

title: Chitty Chitty Bang Bang
actors: Dick Van Dyke, Sally Ann Howes, Lionel Jeffries, Gert Fröbe, Anna Quayle, Adrian Hall, Heather Ripley, Robert Helpmann, Benny Hill
description: A penniless inventor, a refurbished car, a kidnapper from the kingdom of Vulgaria. Fun and brilliant musical for children, based on stories by Ian Fleming (that of James Bond) and close to the aesthetics of certain Disney products ("Marry Poppins", "Brass knobs and broomsticks").

title: Under Fire
actors: Nick Nolte, Joanna Cassidy, Gene Hackman, Ed Harris, Jean-Louis Trintignant
description: Russell Price is a famous American photojournalist; goes to Nicaragua to collect images to sell at a high price. Finally, he will be forced to make a decisive choice between "professionalism" and solidarity. Film of great emotional impact that shows with equal involvement the horrors of military repression and the moral strength that supports the guerrillas.

title: Non è vero... ma ci credo
actors: Peppino De Filippo, Carlo Croccolo, Liliana Bonfatti
description: Superstitious to the point of unbelievable, Commendatore Savastano accepts that his daughter marries a young man with a hump. But it was all just the boy's trick to get the Commendatore's consent. A hilarious and merciless look at the ultra Neapolitan manias of superstition. From a comedy by Peppino De Filippo.

title: The Last Temptation of Christ
actors: Willem Dafoe, Harvey Keitel, Barbara Hershey, Verna Bloom
description: Jesus carpenter makes crosses for the Romans. Reprimanded by Judas, he begins the preaching; then, in order for his destiny to be fulfilled, he asks Judas to betray him and, on the cross, the last temptation, he dreams of the life he would have led by marrying the Magdalene. Scorsese's Christ is an original creature of visionary poetry, a fragile and compromised god, foreign to the oleographic vulgate and iconoclastic ambitions. Heavily contested by the Vatican and Catholic fundamentalists, it is an amazing film about doubt and the missed possibilities of a destiny.

title: Assi alla ribalta
actors: Silvio Bagolini, Marco Tulli, Fausto Guerzoni, Nino Taranto, Raimondo Vianello, Ugo Tognazzi, Carlo Croccolo, Tino Scotti
description: A jewelry thief roams the world of magazine theater. The director of the detective agency "The rapid", entrusts the task of finding the thief to two detectives who are not exactly the smartest. The two investigators thus set out on the thief's trail by touring the various theaters: the investigation then becomes the pure pretext to show a series of classic magazine theater numbers.
notes: In fact, the film is practically a montage of skits taken from the repertoire of the most famous companies of the time, held together by the thin thread of the police investigation. Actors such as Vianello, Tognazzi, Taranto parade on the various stages in a race to the last laugh.

title: Star Trek V. The Final Frontier
actors: William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley
description: In the stellar year 8454, on the planet Nimbus III, three consuls are taken hostage by a Vulcan mystic. Commander Kirk, flanked by loyal Spock and dr. McCoy, is in charge of resolving the situation and therefore is hastily sent into space aboard the "Enterprise" spaceship which is still in imperfect operating conditions. The universe of "Star Trek", unlike that of other cinematic stellar explorations, is the space of an adventurous metaphysical research. The God we meet here this time, however, is as disappointing as the shortened script, inferior to the previous chapters of the sequel and to many of the television episodes.

title: That's Entertainment!
actors: Fred Astaire, Bing Crosby, Gene Kelly, Elizabeth Taylor
description: Through clips taken from the best musicals by Metro Goldwyn Mayer, commented live by Fred Astaire, James Stewart, Gene Kelly, Liza Minnelli, Frank Sinatra, Elizabeth Taylor, Mickey Rooney and other stars, a fascinating overview of one of the most characteristic genres of the classical era of the "Mecca of cinema".

title: Holiday in Mexico
actors: Walter Pidgeon, Ilona Massey, Josè Iturbi
description: The slightly spoiled daughter of the US ambassador to Mexico organizes a big party with the presence of the famous pianist Iturbi. The latter, believing her to be a singer, forces her to perform and congratulates her on the voice. The father, who is a widower, finds an ancient flame; the girl takes it badly and decides to throw herself on the pianist, but he benevolently disilludes her.
notes: How to turn themes from melodrama into comedy: Sidney is an honest craftsman and manages to gild the pill. History, on the other hand, offers no particular surprises. Nice actors.

title: A League of Their Own
actors: Tom Hanks, Geena Davis, Madonna, Lori Petty, Jon Lovitz
description: In 1943, in the midst of the world war, it was women who gave life to the American baseball championship. The film evokes the (true) story of the "Peaches" team, from the selection to training and matches, to the various problems of some players to the figure of the coach (a former player whose career was cut short by an accident and alcohol) to the gathering of the now "old glories". When the war ends, however, and the male players return from the front, the business of the girls in the diamond loses consistency and, with it, also the good dream. Madonna with the baseball bat? Well yes, and in a well-acted film, by no means negligible, rather convincing in the psychological analysis of the characters and skilled in "mythologizing" this national sport even in its "pink" version.

title: Primo amore
actors: Ornella Muti, Ugo Tognazzi, Mario Del Monaco, Caterina Boratto
description: Ugo, a former show actor, lives in a boarding house for old glories. Here he meets the 18-year-old janitor Renata and falls in love with her. With the back money of the pension he takes her away: Milan, Rome, Capri, then the nest egg ends and with that the passion of Renata. Ugo introduces her to a private TV in Rome hoping for a double engagement, but Renata falls in love with an executive. All that remains for Ugo is the return to the pensioner.
notes: Bitter comedy by Dino Risi that crosses the clichés of the senile crush and the cynical exploitation by the young "prey"; unfortunately Risi and Tognazzi no longer have the bite of the past.

title: The Left Hand of God
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Gene Tierney, Lee J. Cobb, Agnes Moorehead
description: Jim Carmody, an American aviator shot down over the skies of China, is taken prisoner. When, having taken the identity of a murdered missionary, he manages to escape, he takes refuge in a mission: he will be able to save the village from destruction and, after leaving his cassock, he will also find love. The presence of Bogart is interesting and curious, at ease even in the unusual cassocks. Dmytrik had been one of the "Hollywood Ten" and, after he retracted, also made this explicitly anti-Communist film.

title: Saint Jack
actors: Ben Gazzara, Denholm Elliott, Joss Ackland, Cheong Ah Lew
description: Jack Flowers is in the Singapore prostitution ring but, in his own way, he is a good person and has his own moral code which he never fails. It is precisely this belief in principles that leads Jack to ruin for not wanting to obey the rules of too dirty games.
notes: Excellent film with a bitter moral, produced by Roger Corman. In the cast stands an effective and measured Ben Gazzara.

title: Magnificat
actors: Luigi Diberti, Arnaldo Ninchi, Massimo Bellinzoni, Dalia Lahav, Lorella Morlotti, Michelangelo Brancato
description: During Holy Week, in the 10th century. Executions of death sentences; the favorite of a king who hopes for a son; a little girl nun in exchange for a millstone; a libertine king awaiting death, surrounded by his bastards; a monk who records the dead but who dies ignored by all; two newlyweds spied in intimacy. Meanwhile, the rites of the Passion follow one another.
notes: Pupi Avati makes an unusual film (for him and for Italian cinema), "strong" and conceptual, mystical and ferocious, fascinating for its thematic complexity and for the rendering in images; brave for the anti-commercial choice: his best work.

title: L'ultima volta insieme
actors: Massimo Ranieri, Enrico Maria Salerno, Anna Orso, Dedi Savagnone
description: Paolo, the son of a high Neapolitan magistrate, is hired at the law firm of a friend of his parent's. The young man believes he has lost his mother, but the woman, who has long since left her family, is now the lover of the boss of the shop racket. Escapes from prison, blackmail, killings, trials, recognition at the last minute between mother and child: more than a brightly colored mélo, a real cartoon.

title: Black Magic
actors: Orson Welles, Akim Tamiroff, Nancy Guild, Frank Latimore
description: The adventurous life of Giuseppe Balsamo, hypnotist, magician, lover, plotter of intrigues. Many mysteries to at least as many enemies. An Italian-American co-production with a bean-shaped part for Welles, a more than talented magician in life and a magician of the set (who also directed some scenes). But despite the premises, the film is a missed opportunity.

title: True Believer/Fighting Justice
actors: James Woods, Robert Downey jr., Margaret Colin, Yuji Okumoto, Kurtwood Smith
description: Eddie Dodd is a lawyer who is disillusioned with the meaning of his profession. His aide Roger Baron convinces him to defend a Korean, Shu Kai Kim. The latter, already in prison for a murder he says he did not commit, is accused of killing another inmate. Eddie and Roger, aided by Detective Kitty Greer, find evidence of Shu's innocence. The lawyer thus regains professional enthusiasm ...
notes: The determination of James Woods in the service of a thriller that wants to dig into the undergrowth of police intrigues, corruption and prison blackmail. The director knows how to discreetly master a complicated script.

title: Babies
actors: Lindsay Wagner, Dinah Manoff, Marcy Walker
description: Laura, Ivonne and Cindy are three friends. Their lives differ in terms of experiences and conditions, but one thing unites them: the desire for a child. Only Cindy will become a mother, at the cost of a dramatic pregnancy. Female portraits compared on the dilemma-desire theme of motherhood: in the conflict between nature and social condition she is the first to be right. Everything is regular, even if some doubts about the slightly feminine point of view seem legitimate to us.

title: Boxing Helena
actors: Julian Sands, Sherilyn Fenn, Bill Paxton, Betsy Clark
description: Nick is a successful young surgeon. Apparently he has everything of man arrived and at peace with himself, but things are different. Traumatic childhood experiences affected her psyche. At the expense of it will be Helena, too charming and independent: everyone thinks she is on vacation and instead she has been kidnapped by Nick, who chooses a rather bizarre way (it's just an understatement) to have her all to himself. Jennifer Lynch, daughter of a great father, decides to follow in his footsteps. In the production events the real scandal is given by the renunciation of Kim Basinger, who will have to pay a very high penalty. Too much hype for a pretentious and inconsistent film.

title: White Men Can't Jump
actors: Wesley Snipes, Woody Harrelson, Rosie Perez
description: Sidney is black, a great talker and can play basketball. His favorite activity is making bets, taking on occasional opponents in those metropolitan concrete pitches seen in so many films. His partner is the fake dumb Billy: two against two and ours often win, but things don't always go smoothly. Then two Mafia killers appear who seem to have it right with them ... The idea is not the most original, but the racial connotation of the pair of heroes is new. Which, among other things, play really well. Wesley Snipes is the protagonist of "Jungle Fever", while Woody Harrelson is the bloodthirsty Mickey of "Natural born killers".

title: Year of the Gun
actors: Andrew McCarthy, Valeria Golino, Sharon Stone
description: We are in the spring of 1978. The American journalist David Raybourne, in Rome for work, is captivated by the idea of ??writing a book on Italian terrorism. For this reason his acquaintances, aimed at the collection of materials and testimonies, are becoming more and more dangerous. On the one hand, subversive circles consider him a provocateur, on the other hand the police regard him as a terrorist. Confused and superficial reconstruction of a sadly important period in our most recent history. A false step in the filmography of a director not without merits ("Go and kill"). Sharon Stone is also in the role of a sexy photojournalist.

title: Gotcha!
actors: Anthony Edwards, Linda Fiorentino, Jsu Garcia, Alex Rocco
description: A young Californian, during a European vacation, is involved in an incredible international intrigue by a beautiful girl who later reveals herself as a CIA agent. Love awaits them. Polite mockery of the spy genre: pleasant result.

title: That Night
actors: Juliette Lewis, C. Thomas Howell, Eliza Dushku, Helen Shaver
description: We are in Coney Island, in 1961. Sheryl O'Connor is a 17 year old girl whose father dies. Completely in disarray, it ends up in the arms of the bowling boy, Rick. He already has a past to tell, but he immediately falls in love with the girl, who will become pregnant ... Everything is seen through the eyes of little Ally who loves chasing fireflies in the evening through the woods. Craig Bolotin wrote the screenplay for "Black Rain", but the fact remains that his directorial debut is anything but exciting. Despite Juliette Lewis and a few hits from the repertoire, a film that fails to take off.

title: Alex and the Gypsy
actors: Jack Lemmon, Geneviève Bujold, James Woods, Robert Emhardt, Titos Vandis
description: The love for a bizarre, liar and almost uxoricidal gypsy changes the life of a cynical American bail bonder (Lemmon). On paper it would seem like an original story, in reality it is all very predictable. Lemmon and Bujold, however, are very good indeed.

title: Una vita lunga un giorno
actors: Mino Reitano, Ewa Aulin, Philippe Leroy, Eva Czemerys, Luciano Catenacci
description: In exchange for the sum to pay an expensive operation to the cardiopathic girlfriend, an unemployed sailor participates in the deadly game proposed to him by a billionaire.
notes: Rusping pathetic thriller with Mino Reitano who also signs the music with his brother Franco. Directed by Sam Livingstone, pseudonym of Ferdinando Baldi.

title: The Fly
actors: Jeff Goldblum, Geena Davis, John Getz, Leslie Carlson, Joy Boushel
description: There are two mertallo bells in Dr. Brundle's (Goldblum) laboratory. He calls them "telepods" and uses them to transport matter. At first, everyone doesn't take him seriously, including journalist Veronica Quaife (Davis). Then Brundle decides to try the new invention on himself. The result would be perfect if only one fly did not slip into the bell at the wrong time.
notes: Remake of an old film by Kurt Neumann which, in Cronenberg's hands, becomes a philosophical question on the heaviness of flesh and the lightness of flies. Unmissable, like every Cronenberg film.

title: The Trouble with Angels
actors: Rosalind Russell, Hayley Mills, June Harding, Barbara Hunter
description: Mary and Rachel, very lively young girls, wreak havoc in a boarding school run by the nuns, lovingly watched over by the wise superior. Other times brilliant, Ida Lupino directs Rosalind Russell in a poorly original comedy.

title: The Last Hurrah
actors: Spencer Tracy, Jeffrey Hunter, Dianne Foster, Basil Rathbone
description: Frank Skeffington has been elected mayor of his town four times: of Irish origins he has to his credit the realization of numerous public works, but also an unscrupulous and personalistic management of power. In the fifth term, however, he is defeated. American society seen through the portrait of an old-fashioned man: sharply sketched psychologies and personalities.

title: The Dressmaker
actors: Joan Plowright, Billie Whitelaw, Jane Horrocks
description: In Liverpool in 1944, the young Rita falls in love with an American soldier without knowing that her aunt is already his lover. The latter, who is a seamstress, will dramatically put an end to the murky game.
notes: Effective portrait of women (and of the environment) between history, intimism and repressed impulses. Great duel of actresses between Plowright and Whitelaw.

title: Cool Runnings
actors: Rawle D. L. Mewis, Leon, Doug E. Doug, Malik Yoba, John Candy
description: From the sun-drenched, sleepy beaches of Jamaica to the dizzying ice rinks of Calgary for the Winter Olympics. A paradox? Perhaps yes, however, a more brilliant starting idea: that of an equatorial crew that trains (on the sand) and then faces the trip to compete with people who were born and lived on the ice. With, in addition, a hint of "yellow".
notes: To say that the film maintains all the premises of a happily "crazy" idea would be an excessive compliment; however, the dose of fun it provides is undoubtedly discreet, faithful to its declared and exhibited "goliardic" dimension.

title: La Reine Margot
actors: Isabelle Adjani, Daniel Auteuil, Jean-Hugues Anglade, Virna Lisi, Asia Argento
description: The marriage, dictated by reason of state, between Margaret of Valois, sister of Charles IX of France and daughter of Caterina de 'Medici, with the Huguenot Henry of Navarre; the hideous court intrigues; the massacre of the Huguenots on the night of San Bartolomeo (1572); the love between Margot and La Motte, who escaped the monstrous massacre of his parents; the passage of Margot herself in the camp of the oppressed ... Dumas father's novel finds in Chéreau's film a sumptuous but unsatisfactory version, "fictional" in the most superficial sense of the term, which sacrifices many big-name actors and "cast" Isabelle Adjani. Palme d'Or in Cannes for Virna Lisi.

title: El Mariachi
actors: Carlos Gallardo, Consuelo Gomez, Reinol Martinez, Peter Marquardt
description: Arriving in town with his guitar, the mariachi (walking storyteller of Mexican origin) finds himself in the middle of the war between the bands of Moco, owner of all the bars and all the a guitar case). For further complication, the young man falls in love with Domino, Moco's woman. Result: a massacre, which only the protagonist survives. Robert Rodriguez's sensational debut, with a very low-cost film, suggestive in the shots and with a frenzied rhythm. A narrative that makes this brazen anarchy its best gift. The director himself made a remake of it in Hollywood, "Desperado", starring Antonio Banderas.

title: Somebody to Love
actors: Rosie Perez, Harvey Keitel, Anthony Quinn, Michael De Lorenzo, Samuel Fuller
description: Mercedes, with career ambitions in film, gets by as a dancer in a shabby club. She's with Henry, who was a TV star, but who's on the sunset boulevard. The two would marry if Henry's wife allowed a divorce, but the woman wants ten thousand dollars for that. Then Ernesto, a young Mexican who fell in love with Mercedes, agrees to become a commissioned killer. A discreet script, good cast actors, Hollywood personality appearances (Fuller, Tarantino) work. But sadly, Rockwell's directing spoils everything.

title: No Child of Mine
actors: Patty Duke, Tracy Nelson, G. W. Bailey, Susan Blakely
description: Jesse was born with Down syndrome, while his twin brother is normal. The mother decides that she will never be able to endure all the problems related to Jesse and begins the paperwork to give him up for adoption. The maternal grandmother, however, opposes the choice, offering to raise the child herself. The tension between the two women grows to the point where it will be inevitable to resort to court judgment. Patty Duke is one of the few people to have won an Oscar at sixteen (for "Anna of Miracles"). Even if his film career is nothing compared to that of television (three Emmys). Apart from you, this television movie is not very interesting.

title: The Geisha Boy
actors: Jerry Lewis, Robert Hirano, Nobu McCarthy, Marie McDonald, Sessue Hayakawa, Suzanne Pleshette
description: If it weren't for the prowess of his partner, the bunny Harry, the clumsy Gilbert would be an unemployed magician. Even in Japan, on a tour for the benefit of US troops, the situation does not change: Gilbert does more trouble than tricks. But he also has a heart of gold and takes pity on little Mitzuo, an orphan but with a charming aunt. The presence of Jerry Lewis is quite explosive in itself. But Tashlin feels compelled to add a plot, moreover with trivially sentimental implications. Lewis didn't need Japanese orphans to impress the viewer.

title: The Marauders
actors: Dan Duryea, Jeff Richards
description: During the Civil War, a furious struggle for the possession of a land broke out between a builder and a ranchero replaced, after his death, by his diabolical accountant. Strange western with sinister accents: a classic and noble B-series product.

title: Lies
actors: Ann Dusenberry, Bruce Davison, Gail Strickland, Clu Gulager
description: An actress discovers that she has been involved in the plot to get her hands on the substances of the wealthy patient of a psychiatric clinic, but when she tries to expose the plot, no one believes her. The dramatic machine of the film is not the simplest, but in the end it holds well and entertains thanks to some gimmicks and the convincing evidence of the actors.

title: Un americano in vacanza
actors: Valentina Cortese, Andrea Checchi, Adolfo Celi, Leo Dale
description: Two American soldiers are on their way to Rome; one of them falls in love with a pretty teacher who is going to the capital to find the necessary funds for the reconstruction of his country, destroyed by the war. After some misunderstandings and some difficulties, the American finally manages to declare himself.
notes: A polite sentimental chronicle against the dramatic backdrop of history. The technique is that of the White Phones, but this time the Americans "pay" (the film, we read in the titles, is made with "the cordial interest of the Allied Military Authorities"). For this, a curious document.

title: Prova di memoria
actors: Franco Nero, Karin Giegerich, Peter Davies, Don Hodson, Ivano Marescotti
description: A writer returns to Prague, a city where ten years earlier a woman had committed suicide because of him. This memory haunts him, but, from some disturbing clues, he begins to suspect that the woman is still alive. He also knows his sister and some strange characters somehow involved in the suicide. He then throws himself into research and keeps a sort of diary in the pages of the novel he is writing. Unusual and rambling attempt at a psychological thriller, with out-of-role actors and a lopsided script that even manages to frustrate the visual appeal of the Czech capital.

title: La congiuntura
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Joan Collins, Jacques Bergerac, Hilde Barry
description: Giuliano, a Roman prince, is persuaded by a beautiful girl to take a trip to Switzerland using his comfortable car with a diplomatic plate. In reality, the girl is thinking of taking a large amount of money abroad rather than a vacation. Only after crossing the border Giuliano understands the trick.
notes: Hints of social criticism and abundant doses of farce in a decidedly minor Scola.

title: Cartagine in fiamme
actors: Pierre Brasseur, Daniel Gélin, Anne Heywood, Ilaria Occhini
description: As Carthage declares war on Rome, the exiled Hiram enters the city to see his woman again. Meanwhile, the Roman Fulvia is designated to be sacrificed to the god Moloch. The model of the blockbuster "De Mille" remains distant, but the film is decent.

title: Io non vedo, tu non parli, lui non sente
actors: Enrico Montesano, Alighiero Noschese, Gastone Moschin, Isabella Biagini
description: Valerio and his wife Reginella arrive in Venice to return a terrier she has lost in the capital to a rich Frenchwoman. The couple went on a long journey with the little dog to receive the fair compensation that the owner promised them. But when they arrive at the noblewoman's quarters, they find her corpse there. In a panic they run away, but they forget the suitcase in the house of the dead woman. From there the troubles begin. Modest remake of "Crimen" (1960), by Camerini himself. The Italian comedy was at an all-time low, Camerini was seventy-six. The cameo of the old De Sica is almost tender.

title: Eleni
actors: Kate Nelligan, John Malkovich, Linda Hunt
description: Eleni Gatzoyiannis was killed in 1948 in Greece. His son Nicolas now lives in New York, has changed his name to Nick Gage and works successfully for the "New York Times". But the memory of his mother haunts him. And with that the desire for revenge. True story, great cast yet it's a bit boring.

title: Bullitt
actors: Steve McQueen, Jacqueline Bisset, Robert Vaughn, Robert Duvall
description: Frank Bullitt (Steve McQueen) is a San Francisco lieutenant charged with guarding a repentant, a certain Johnny Ross, who, after robbing the gang he was part of, is now willing to talk. This does not prevent two killers from killing the man, but Bullitt does not lose heart, he discovers that the deceased was a certain Albert Remick and then sets out on the hunt for the real Ross.
notes: We are in '68 and even in the detective story we discover the anti-hero, very well played by Steve McQueen. For the rest fast pace, some breathtaking scenes including a famous chase and an excellent editing (Frank P. Keller won the Oscar)

title: This Boy's Life
actors: Robert De Niro, Leonardo DiCaprio, Ellen Barkin, Eliza Dushku
description: Before the 1950s are over, Caroline (Barkin) picks up her son Toby (Di Caprio) and leaves Utah to live in Seattle. The ex-husband lives somewhere on the east coast and the other son is studying at Princeton,. Young Toby, left to himself, gets into bad company, starts to smoke, learns bad words etc ... Then Caroline meets Dwight Hansen (De Niro), who starts courting Caroline and would like to straighten Toby. De Niro plays the sax that sucks, he is violent, vulgar and with a big heart. Only he in the world is capable of doing such a part. Ellen Barkin, from a young age, has always had that bitter fold of the lips. The young Di Caprio stands out. The story is unpleasant and Caton-Jones's flat direction doesn't help, but with three actors like that it would have been impossible to make a bad movie.

title: Profession: Aventuriers
actors: Nathalie Delon, Charles Southwood, Curd Jürgens, André Pousse, Francis Lemonnier
description: Henry Ralston is shipwrecked in the middle of the Atlantic and luckily lands on an island where the Japanese classic still lives, who, thirty years later, has not yet realized that the war is over. It is only the beginning of an endless series of vicissitudes, but the only thing to remember is the presence of Nathalie Delon.

title: Judgment at Nuremberg
actors: Spencer Tracy, Maximilian Schell, Marlene Dietrich, Burt Lancaster
description: In Nuremberg, in 1948, a modest American magistrate must judge four German "colleagues" accused of having applied, in addition to the letter, obviously unfair laws to the point of having allowed aberrant medical tests on prisoners and favored the persecution of the Jewish people. The indictment evidence is overwhelming, but political reasons linked to the opposition of the blocs would like the sentence to be "accommodated" to the reason of state.
notes: Intense and sober reconstruction of the Nuremberg trial, with a parade of stars all controlled and unforgettable, from Dietrich explaining "Lili Marlene" to a devastated Clift. Perhaps Kramer's best film, didactic but never didactic. Oscar to Maximilian Schell and the screenplay.

title: Strictly Ballroom
actors: Paul Mercurio, Tara Morice, Bill Hunter, John Hannah, Sonia Kruger-Tayler
description: Scott wants to participate in the paso doble championships by introducing some personal variations in traditional figures and accompanying himself as a partner to Fran, a school secretary, instead of Tina, the reigning champion. Between the anger of his mother and the threats of the president of the Federation, but with the approval of his father, he perseveres, wins and even reunites the family. From the land of the kangaroos a kind of fairytale, between musical and comedy, with a thin slender thread of irony. The costumes are lively and the music predictably captivating; at command tears and smiles emerge, without surprises but with a discreet politeness.

title: 84 Charing Cross Road
actors: Anne Bancroft, Anthony Hopkins, Judi Dench, Jean De Baer
description: In 1949, a New York writer, Helene Hanff, entered into correspondence with Frank Doel, a London-based bookseller specializing in second-hand classic books. By letter, a deep friendship grows between the two. He is married and Helene becomes friends with the family without ever knowing the members. Only in 1969 did he go to London, after Frank died and found only the abandoned shop.
notes: A real challenge is to build a film on an exchange of letters, showing how feelings can grow through the written word. A great work of script and of course a great interpretation of the two protagonists.

title: Street Smart
actors: Christopher Reeve, Kathy Baker, Morgan Freeman, Mimi Rogers
description: Jonathan Fisher offers the editor of his magazine a report on prostitution in New York; it is actually a reportage invented from scratch, but due to a series of circumstances Fisher ends up being suspected. Police think he is hiding evidence of a murder that took place earlier. Jailed, he is released on bail, but at this point he is cornered by a mala boss. The film offers a glimpse of the most infamous reality of the Big Apple. Christopher Reeve plays the role of the reckless journalist.

title: The Court Jester
actors: Danny Kaye, Glynis Johns, Basil Rathbone, Angela Lansbury
description: Danny Kaye, disguised as a jester, manages to dethrone a tyrannical and usurper ruler. Playful and well thought out adventures with an athletic and witty Danny Kaye.

title: Claudine
actors: Diahann Carroll, James Earl Jones
description: A small strip falls in love with a very poor young woman and mother of six children. All in a miserable American urban ghetto inhabited by people of color. A sugary film that superficially and consolant mixes romantic and social themes.

title: The Van
actors: Danny DeVito, Stuart Getz, Deborah White
description: Adventures of a young boy chasing beautiful girls with his friends. He tries to catch his prey by striding with his new and well-equipped camper. Silly and harmless farce of the sub-genre "Californian beauties and youthful itches". In the cast there is also a young Danny De Vito.

title: The Story of Louis Pasteur
actors: Paul Muni, Josephine Hutchinson, Anita Louise
description: At the cost of enormous sacrifices, scientist Louis Pasteur fine-tunes his groundbreaking vaccines, ultimately triumphing over the hostility of conservative academics. Parent film of a genre, it obtained the Oscar for the original story, the screenplay and for the interpretation by Paul Muni. Honest, solid and dated.

title: Shattered Innocence
actors: Jonna Lee, Melinda Dillon, John Pleshette
description: By chasing the dream of the golden world of Hollywood, a provincial beauty ends up in a mechanism that makes her become a pornstar. The matter ends badly. Typical Teledrama that proposes, in a fictional version, the true story of the porn star Shauna Grant.

title: The Big Gamble
actors: Stephen Boyd, Juliette Gréco, David Wayne
description: Three on an old truck towards a remote African village where they think they start an activity. Curious, with some convincing passages. Written by Irvin Shaw.

title: The Angel Wore Red
actors: Ava Gardner, Dirk Bogarde, Joseph Cotten, Vittorio De Sica
description: Father Alberto Carrera abandons the cassock, has a love story with the dancer Soledad and is dramatically involved in the Spanish civil war.
notes: Excellent screenwriter, Nunnally Johnson ("Furore", "That Dirty Dozen") directed a few films in the 1950s. Often with controversial results or, as in this case, decidedly mediocre.

title: Artists and Models
actors: Dean Martin, Jerry Lewis, Shirley MacLaine, Dorothy Malone
description: Rick, a painter, and Eugene, a fairy tale writer, live together, but are forced to move frequently because the latter has dreams so lively that they annoy the neighbors. When the two meet Bessie and Abby, a professional collaboration is born, because the girls are also in the publishing branch. But then Eugene dreams of part of a top secret formula for a new weapon and the matter gets complicated. This time, alongside Dean Martin and Jerry Lewis, are Shirley McLaine and Dorothy Malone (as well as Anita Ekberg), and the whole makes a lot of money. McLaine in particular has an overwhelming comic charge and holds up more than a comparison with Lewis.

title: Love Field
actors: Michelle Pfeiffer, Dennis Haysbert, Stephanie McFadden, Brian Kervin
description: On November 22, 1963, Laurene witnessed President Kennedy's arrival in Dallas. When the news of the attack spreads, she, who in her wild imagination identifies with the first lady Jacqueline, decides that, at any cost, she will have to attend the funeral in Washington. During the journey, Laurene intrudes on the life of a black man and girl, and it causes trouble for everyone.
notes: A parable about the meeting of two Americas, not exactly according to Kennedy's dream. Well-played, the film is built on the basis of a dramatic charge of manner and does not lift itself from a lackluster mediocrity.

title: Ruby in Paradise
actors: Ashley Judd, Todd Field, Bentley Mitchum, Allison Deanne
description: Ruby Dee is looking for something better than his Tennessee hills and so he starts in the car for the "paradise" of Florida. She stops in Panama City Beach, where she finds work, she does a friend, falls into the arms of the wrong man (the son of the friend), but then she knows the right one of her. Find the time to write a diary and also the reasons for making important decisions about his life. The director put eight years to find the funds for this third film, that is, for a story that refuses all the abused Hollywood canons, who jams a little at times, but who has an absolutely extraordinary protagonist in Ashley Judd.

title: Late for Dinner
actors: Brian Wimmer, Peter Berg, Marcia Gay Harden, Peter Gallagher
description: Willie was injured in a shooting and is fleeing, together with his brother-in-law Frank, to Southern California. He stops at Pomona where, instead of receiving the necessary treatment, he is put in the freezer for thirty years. When he wakes up in the early 1990s, his wife Joy (Harden) is no longer the girl she used to be, but her daughter Jessica is already a young lady. The story is rather thin and after ten minutes it is already lost. On the other hand, Marcia Gay Harden, even in her fifties, is not bad.

title: Trapped and Deceived
actors: Jennie Garth, Jill Eikenberry, Paul Sorvino, John Galecki
description: Laura's parents are a little anxious. The girl has bad friendships, drinks and moreover one day has an accident while driving while intoxicated. The psychologist they rely on has a sure remedy; gives them the address of a center specializing in the recovery of difficult children. The parents fall for it and send the girl there, but she immediately realizes that the place where she is locked up is a real concentration camp.
notes: Iscove is a well-known television director. It's not like he's making his own films, but he's got an interesting cast in his hands. There is Paul Sorvino in the role of Dr. Winslow and Jennie Garth, the famous Kelly of "Beverly Hills 90210".

title: The Bad Seed
actors: Nancy Kelly, Patty McCormack, Henry Jones, Eileen Heckart
description: Eight-year-old Rhoda kills a schoolmate for a very trivial reason. It turns out that it's just one of the bloody links in a chain. The terrible truth is in fact that the little girl has inherited her grandmother's crazy killing instincts. The excellent direction sets the film in an oppressive atmosphere, capable of transmitting all the discomfort of a disturbing, atrocious and ineluctable destiny. From a play by Maxwell Anderson, performed in the theater by the same interpreters.

title: Sarahsarà
actors: Kim Engelbrecht, Giulio Brogi, Ciro Esposito, Lucio Allocca
description: Sarah is a black South African girl who grew up in a middle-class family that made her go to the best schools. The girl has a malformation in her leg, but her parents pushed her to take swimming lessons anyway. Her coach (a half-mad drunkard) realizes that Sarah has an iron will and enrolls her, against the opinion of the federation, in the very tough Capri-Naples.
notes: The triumph of will and good feelings, but not that of cinema. In fact, beyond good intentions, the film is an exercise in sterile direction at the service of a dull story.

title: Shalako
actors: Sean Connery, Brigitte Bardot, Stephen Boyd, Peter Van Eyck
description: Some nobles of European origin went to Apache territory for a puma hunt. For an imprudence three Indians are killed and then the indigenous leader orders the intruders to leave. But among the whites there are also scoundrels and the situation is further complicated. Many stars gathered in a film with a completely decent realization, according to the rules of the "genre". Dmyryk in the waning phase, a curious attempt at multiple miscasting; but the film does not stand up.

title: Three Coins in the Fountain
actors: Clifton Webb, Dorothy McGuire, Jean Peters, Louis Jourdan, Maggie McNamara
description: Three young Americans in Rome, between reciprocated loves, attempts at seduction and aspirations for sacrifice. Clouds on the horizon, but the end (after the traditional coin in the Trevi fountain) is soothing. Amazing success, at the time, for a film able to blend story and frame. Oscar for photography and best song.

title: The Spirit of Saint Louis
actors: James Stewart, Murray Hamilton, Patricia Smith, Marc Connelly
description: Charles A. Lindbergh is a young aviator who dreams of accomplishing the great feat: crossing the Atlantic on a single-seater plane. On May 20, 1927, after several failures of heroic but unfortunate pilots, he left New York with little food and no radio, but with enough fuel to reach his destination: Paris. It will be a long and risky journey, during which fatigue will bring him about to collapse: but in the end ...
notes: The bet was not to bore, as most of the film takes place with James Stewart alone on the small plane. Wilder wins it, as usual, brilliantly.

title: Faces
actors: John Marley, Lynn Carlin, Gena Rowlands, Seymour Cassel
description: After fourteen years, the marriage between Maria and Richard Forst seems to have come to an end. He spends an evening with a prostitute (Rowlands), he is hosted in his house, but when he wakes up everything turns out to be unpleasant. She goes dancing with some friends and ends up picking up a stranger (Cassel). The next morning Maria and Richard are reunited and their problems are still intact ...
notes: It is a film shot in the spare time, with a process that, in all, lasted three years, almost improvised, almost real. John Cassavetes and his friends stage a family drama, almost banal, almost any: absolutely unsustainable.

title: Thor il conquistatore
actors: Conrad Nichols, Maria Romano, Malisa Longo, Rosalba Ciofalo
description: The evil Gnut killed his parents in Thor. He is the strongest man in the world, thanks also to the advice of Etna, the bird man who took care of him. Now Thor goes around the countryside with his girlfriend Ino and, right in the middle of the countryside, he finds a farming village that can no longer stand the harassment of Gnut.
notes: The clash is nothing when compared to this film. Tonino Ricci, under a false name, packs this late-mythological short film by putting a bunch of English names and an even greater number of platitudes in the middle.

title: Monte Miracolo
actors: Louis Trenker, Mino Doro, Evi Maltagliati
description: Rivalry between two engineers (one mountain, the other a citizen) who work on a dam in Val d'Aosta. An ascension, an accident, a miracle. Beautiful landscapes, but a very naive, almost childish story.

title: Laser Mission
actors: Brandon Lee, Ernest Borgnine, Debi Monahan, Graham Clarke
description: The largest diamond in the world has been stolen and, what's worse, there is a scientist (Borgnine) who knows how to use the gem to build a very powerful laser. Then the professor is kidnapped by the Russians but, at that point, two secret agents (Lee and Monahan) have already set out on his trail who save the professor, the diamond and the world in one fell swoop. Brandon Lee is no longer famous just for being the son of Bruce Lee. He is also famous because he accidentally died on the set of "Raven". For this reason, any one of his six films has now become a small cult object.

title: A River Runs Through It
actors: Craig Sheffer, Brad Pitt, Tom Skerritt, Emily Lloyd, Brenda Blethyn
description: There are two values ??that Reverend Maclean passed on to his sons Norman and Paul: religion and fishing. Brothers yes, but different: the first is calm and serious, the other turbulent and unpredictable. Grown up, their destinies will be dramatically different. If Norman eventually marries his Jessie and leaves for Chicago to teach, restless Paul instead ...
notes: Robert Redford based his film on Norman Maclean's autobiographical novel. Visually the film was successful: beautiful photography by Philippe Rousselot (awarded with the Oscar) and evocative environments (we are in Montana). The pace is slow, there is some aestheticism too much, but the sensitivity is authentic.

title: Processo alla città
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, Silvana Pampanini, Paolo Stoppa, Mariella Lotti, Dante Maggio
description: We are in Naples, at the beginning of the century. Two important figures of the Camorra have been arrested following a murder and are going on trial. Their high-ranking friendships affect the course of the trial. Judge Antonio Spicacci is at first taken by despair, to the point of wanting to abandon his post. Rare "film of denunciation" in costume, on the Camorra of the dawn. Perhaps schematic, but very close, indeed of a clear American school, and with an excellent reconstruction of the environment.

title: To meteoro vima tou pelargou
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Jeanne Moreau, Gregory Karr, Dora Chrysikou
