description: A young reporter sent to a border town, a destination for refugees looking for a future, recognizes among them a politician who has mysteriously disappeared. History nourishes the visions of Anghelopulos and the screenwriter Guerra, with a lot of metaphors and an exhausting pace.

title: One Good Cop
actors: Michael Keaton, Rene Russo, Victor Reyes, Tony Plana
description: In New York, a young policeman has been serving in the American metropolis for several years. Between robberies, shootings, arrests and car chases, our hero finds time to get married and a son is about to be born from the happy union. Faced with this happy prospect, the future father makes a profound examination of conscience. What future will it give to the child who is about to be born? Michael Keaton protagonist of a conventional urban portrait.

title: The Naked Gun 2 1/2: The Smell of Fear
actors: Leslie Nielsen, Priscilla Presley, George Kennedy, O. J. Simpson
description: A serious attack hits the research institute headed by Professor Meinheimer. Lieutenant Frank Drebin is in charge of the investigation. Despite his clumsiness, Drebin discovers that Meinheimer, who had drafted the new national energy plan, has been kidnapped by the industrialists who oppose that plan. Drebin will expose the plot. Second installment of Lieutenant Frank Drebin's adventures beyond the edge of madness, effectively played by Leslie Nielsen. Burst of jokes and gags and cinephile references make the thin plot very tasty. O. J. Simpson also stars in the film.

title: White Witch Doctor
actors: Susan Hayward, Robert Mitchum, Timothy Carey, Walter Slezak
description: Elena is the widow of a doctor who specializes in equatorial diseases. Almost to continue his work, she goes to Congo as a nurse. On the journey she is escorted by a guide, Loney Douglas, who falls in love with her. Arriving in the village, Elena learns that the elderly doctor is dead; agrees to replace her and Loney stays with her. After Elena has gained the trust of the Baku king by healing his son, an unscrupulous adventurer, Loney's old acquaintance, reappears in search of gold deposits. Equatorial adventure for the Hayward-Mitchum couple, who had recently worked together in Nicholas Ray's memorable "The Daredevil". The film remains a collage of stereotypes of exotic-adventurous cinema, even if Mitchum occasionally knows how to revive it. Leon Shamroy's photography is good, while Hathaway handles the directing practices without impetus. The music is by Bernard Herrmann.

title: Iron Will
actors: Mackenzie Astin, Kevin Spacey, David Odgen Stiers, August Schellenberg
description: In 1917, 17-year-old Will Stoneman from Dakota entered the sled race on the route from Winnipeg (Canada) to St. Paul (Minnesota). With the $ 10,000 first prize he wants to save his family and farm from bankruptcy. The race is very tough and, what's more, there are also dangerous additional pitfalls. Audacity and luck: it is the classic formula of success made in the USA that Walt Disney enhances here with the usual outline of splendid landscapes. For spectators of proven innocence and a lot of good will.

title: Another Stakeout
actors: Rosie O'Donnell, Richard Dreyfuss, Emilio Estevez, Madeleine Stowe
description: Chris Lecce and Bill Reimers are cops who must locate a key witness in a trial against a Las Vegas gangster. With them there is also the district attorney Gina Garret, with a big dog in tow. Posing as a family, they take home near their prey's hideout. While making a lot of trouble, they eventually achieve the purpose of their unusual mission. The couple Dreyfuss-Estevez, also directed by John Badham, had already played "Special Surveillance" and, as almost always happens, this second chapter is not worth the first (which was not exceptional). We giggle, but still we get bored.

title: Schindler's List
actors: Liam Neeson, Ben Kingsley, Ralph Fiennes, Caroline Goodall, Embeth Davidtz, Beatrice Macola
description: Oskar Schindler, of Moravian origin, arrived in Krakow in 1939 with the intention of enriching himself by exploiting Jews in a pottery factory. But, struck by the Nazi ferocity, he decides to "play" a dangerous adventure: to save his workers from extermination. He will be reduced to poverty, but, thanks to him, more than a thousand Israelites, destined for extermination camps, will survive the war. Spielberg puts all his cinematographic talent at the service, this time, of a dramatic and exciting story, choosing a black and white not chronicle but Hollywood and inventing pages of great cinema, on the edge of melodrama. Seven Academy Awards: film, direction, photography (Janusz Kaminski), music, editing, non-original screenplay, set design.

title: Cabin Boy
actors: Chris Elliott, Ritch Brinkley, James Gammon, Brion James
description: Nathaniel Mayweather is a wealthy, snobbish student about to set sail for Hawaii where his father owns a hotel. For a trivial mistake, instead of boarding the right ship, Nathaniel finds himself in a filthy schooner, the "Filthy Whore", populated by a quintet of gruff sailors ready to torment him. But the worst comes when the boat approaches the island called Hell's Bucket .. Chris Elliott and Adam Resnick come from the television show "Late Night with David Letterman", a program for which Tim Burton and Denise Di Novi go crazy. That must be why they decided to produce this film. A wrong choice happens to everyone.

title: Brutti, sporchi e cattivi
actors: Nino Manfredi, Francesco Annibali, Maria Bosco, Maria Luisa Santella
description: In a Roman slum lives a family of Apulian immigrants made up of the old and tyrannical father, Giacinto, his wife, ten children and a host of relatives. The main purpose of these is to take possession of the million that Giacinto obtained for the loss of an eye. Grotesque comedy and social drama are mixed in this film by Scola: we laugh bitterly. Best Director at the Cannes Film Festival.

title: Buck Rogers in the 25th Century
actors: Gil Gerard, Pamela Hensley, Henry Silva
description: Thawed after a hibernation of more than five hundred years, Buck Rogers finds himself fighting King Draco, the tyrant who wants to invade Earth. Modern and disappointing version of a hero of the thirties, he was the pilot of a TV series.

title: Silent Running
actors: Bruce Dern, Cliff Potts, Ron Rifkin, Jesse Vint
description: In 2002 there is no longer any green on Earth. Only in some orbiting stations do greenhouses remain active. Then they disappear from there too.
notes: The author of the special effects of "2001" directs with skill. Screenplay by Michael Cimino.

title: Fort Ti
actors: George Montgomery, Joan Vohs, Irving Bacon
description: In the 18th century, in America, during the war between the British and the French, intrigues of spies, alleged spies, fierce Rangers and helpless girls. Originally projected in 3D, Castle's film was already pretty bad at the time.

title: Funny Girl
actors: Barbra Streisand, James Caan, Omar Sharif, Walter Pidgeon, Kay Medford
description: The life of the singer and dancer Fanny Brice who leaves the scenes for love, then takes them back for love and in the end is left alone. Film debut for Barbra Streisand who immediately wins the Oscar for best actress, and remains the best thing about a well-made and slightly retro musical.

title: The Thing
actors: T.K. Carter, Kurt Russell, Wilford Brimley, David Clennon
description: Scientists at a research base in Alaska collect a wolfhound that their Norwegian colleagues attempted to cull. They put it in the kennel while two of them go to the Norwegian base which they find abandoned and full of corpses. They also find the remains of what looks like a flying saucer. In short, the dog is possessed by a strange force and turns into a beast. Panic spreads to the base.
notes: Remake of a classic by Christian Nyby (and Howard Hawks) from 1951, a science fiction film but contaminated by horror. Equipped with spectacular special effects (by Rob Bottin) it has a master's suspense, a setting of great suggestion and remains suspended in an ending of terrible uncertainty. Soundtrack composed of Ennio Morricone.

title: The Day of the Locust
actors: Donald Sutherland, Karen Black, Burgess Meredith, William Castle
description: In the late 1930s, as Tod and Faye try in vain to make their way to Hollywood, Homer ends up being lynched by the mob. A bitter and bad film, based on a famous book by Nathanael West.

title: The Asphyx
actors: Robert Stephens, Robert Powell, Jane Lapotaire
description: An eighteenth-century English scientist is convinced that he can isolate the spirit of death. Its purpose is to become immortal.
notes: In the end, what is saved is only a good photograph and a good cast. The intentions are good, but they are not enough to save the film, which is all too boring and above all without backbone. Boredom reigns supreme.

title: Phar Lap
actors: Tom Burlinson, Ron Leibman, Martin Vaughan, Judy Morris
description: At first, Phar Lap is just a skinny horse, but then, thanks to the care of his trainer, he becomes a famous racehorse. Throughout the 1920s, his name was a legend for Australian racetracks, so much so that it also attracted the attention of the underworld. Phar Lap will die in America, in 1932, a few days after his last success. The causes of death still remain unclear.
notes: At the time Simon Wincer seemed like a great promise of Australian cinema, today (after "Harley Davidson and the Marlboro Man" and 'Free Willy ") we know that this is not the case. But this film, despite some excess honey, has turned out well .

title: Deep Red
actors: Michael Biehn, Joanna Pacula, Tobin Bell, John Alden
description: An alien spaceship descends to Earth. A girl is in the front row in the close encounter and suffers the irrevocable effects: that is, she becomes immortal. Thanks to a strange mutation, his aging process is blocked. Great thing, she thinks, at least until she realizes there's a lot of people ready to do anything to get their hands on her and find out her secret.
notes: Baxley's growth stalled in 1988 with "Action Jackson", then aging took over. That film was the great opportunity to show his mastery to the world. Lost that, now he's reduced to making mediocre films like this one.

title: India: Matri Bhumi
description: The destination of my trip is India, which everyone defines as mysterious and which I personally consider absolutely not mysterious !, so said Rossellini before leaving. The result of his journey is this documentary which starts from Bombay to go towards the south of the country and then towards the Malabar lagoons and the dam on the Mahadi river. A great director grapples with a great country: a great reportage comes out of it.

title: Cattle Queen of Montana
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, Ronald Reagan, Gene Evans, Lance Fuller
description: The only survivor of the massacre of her family by the Indians, Sierra Nevada fights with all her strength to defend her cattle and to oppose the power of Tom Mc Cord, a rapacious landowner: the son of an Indian chief will help her. Good western that grows in a tight and pressing way towards the end. Among the performers the future president of the United States Ronald Regan.

title: Fari nella nebbia
actors: Fosco Giachetti, Luisa Ferida, Antonio Centa, Mariella Lotti, Mario Siletti, Lauro Gazzolo, Carlo Lombardi, Nelly Corradi, Lia Orlandini
description: Cesare, a rude and taciturn truck driver, is married to Anna who would like him less absorbed in work. After one of the many quarrels between the two, the woman returns to her mother. Cesare meets the sensual Piera and lives with her until he discovers her betrayals. Determined to take revenge, he finds Anna instead, regretting having left him. Built with appreciable commitment, it is played by then very famous actors. A film full of instinct and popularity, which in referring to the poetic realism of Renoir and Carnè, anticipates neorealist atmospheres.

title: The Court Martial of Billy Mitchell
actors: Gary Cooper, Charles Bickford, Rod Steiger, Ralph Bellamy
description: General William Mitchell is an aviation pioneer. Convinced that air supremacy is the trump card of any future conflict, he fights strenuously against the obtuse leaders of the American military administration to affirm his convictions. All that comes with it is humiliation and even a court-martial trial. Only at the end will he have the accolades he deserves. Based on a true story, it is a great fable about the struggle between power and the individual. Great portrayal of loyal but free Gary Cooper, and Rod Steiger as the prosecutor.

title: Victim
actors: Dirk Bogarde, Sylvia Syms, Dennis Price, Anthony Nicholls, Peter Copley, Norman Bird, Peter McEnery, Donald Churchill, Derren Nesbitt, John Barrie, John Cairney, Alan MacNaughton, Nigel Stock
description: A boy's suicide leads a respected lawyer to question himself and declare his homosexuality. Excellent film on a then thorny theme, chiaroscuroed by the "yellow" tone of the story. Very good Bogarde.

title: La contessa azzurra
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, Zsa Zsa Gabor, Paolo Stoppa, Elly Davis
description: An elderly silent film star recalls her past. She remembers when she was an unknown girl whom a director chose (instead of a recalcitrant diva) to make a film, entitled "The Blue Countess", which achieved great success. A love story was also born between the two, however, but since the beginning of the First World War. Produced by Achille Lauro and interpreted by his protégé Elly Davis, a gentle sentimental comedy that is also a passionate homage to the city of Naples, to its cinematographic and variety tradition.

title: The Entity
actors: Barbara Hershey, Ron Silver, David Labiosa, George Coe
description: Carla Moran lives in Los Angeles with her son Billy. One night he suffers an attack from an unknown entity. The following nights the assaults are repeated and also involve the son. Beaten, bruised and raped, Carla first turns to a neurologist, then to a group of parapsychologists who will be able to force the mysterious entity to manifest itself. But the story doesn't end like that.
notes: The film, directed by an old craftsman, is an ordinary fantathriller.

title: The Bounty Hunter
actors: Randolph Scott, Dolores Dorn, Ernest Borgnine
description: Three robbers are hiding in Twin Forks under the guise of honest citizens. Jim Kipp, in charge of tracking them down, manages to unmask them thanks to a clever ruse. Helps him Julia, the doctor's daughter, who will eventually join him. Discreet western that effectively mixes action, shooting and sentiment: color photography and actors are also good.

title: Crash Dive
actors: Tyrone Power, Anne Baxter, Dana Andrews, James Gleason
description: On board the submarine "Corsaro" Lieutenant Stuart and Captain La Rocca become excellent friends. During a brief mission, Stuart meets a beautiful girl and flirts with her without knowing that she is already engaged. Returning to base after a war action, Stuart sets out on the woman's trail, but discovers that her boyfriend is none other than Captain La Rocca. The two try to resolve the situation as good comrades in arms, without their rivalry in love changing the relationship of collaboration.
notes: Brilliantly resolved attempt to tell a sentimental story by making a war propaganda film.

title: La valle di pietra - Kalkstein
actors: Charles Dance, Aleksander Baldini, Fabio Bussotti, Klara Neroldova
description: In the last century, in Bohemia, a land surveyor who works for the government catches a glimpse of a priest who intrigues him at a dinner. Finding themselves years later in a stony valley, the two men are bound in a deep friendship: the elderly priest will tell the other about his youth and the friend will discover, after the priest's death, the great generosity of spirit of the churchman, ignored by all. From the novel of the same name by Adalbert Stifter, Ermanno Olmi and the director have drawn a script that is profound and alien to gratuitous spectacle, which Zaccaro then covered with modest, highly suggestive images.

title: Teorema
actors: Silvana Mangano, Massimo Girotti, Terence Stamp, Laura Betti, Anne Wiazemsky
description: Lucia (Mangano) and Paolo (Girotti) are a quiet middle-class couple with two student children, Odetta (Anne Wiazemsky) and Pietro (Cruz Soublette). The maid Emilia (Betti) also lives in the house. Then comes a guest (Stamp) who becomes the center of attention, and not just platonic, of the whole family. It will be the beginning of the end: the father leaves the factory to the workers, the mother turns out to be a nymphomaniac, the daughter goes mad, the son gives himself up to art and the waitress dies in the odor of sanctity.
notes: Ferocious anti-bourgeois satire of Pasolini in the year of the protest. The bourgeois family is blown into an ambiguous and fascinating actualization of the myth. In Venice Laura Betti and (from the Catholic Cinema Office) the film itself were awarded.

title: Bad Lieutenant
actors: Harvey Keitel, Frankie Thorn, Zoe Lund, Anthony Ruggiero
description: In the background of the story is the baseball final between the Dodgers and the Mets. LT (Harvey Keitel) has bet on the Dodgers. LT, among other things, is a police lieutenant, but spends all his time taking his children to school (when he has to), seizing drugs and then reselling them (when he can), seizing drugs and then using them (almost always ). The only time he does a good deed is also the last deed of his life. Written without the help of the usual collaborator Nicholas St. John, a metropolitan noir that turns into a Catholic parable suspended between sublime and obscene. Visionary and excessive (after much violence, at one point a very colorful and mute Christ appears), obsessed with the theme of violence and redemption, it is among the best films of Ferrara. Impressive Harvey Keitel, showing all the heaviness of the flesh and the wounds of the spirit. The finale, shot with the hidden camera, was splendid.

title: The Long Walk Home
actors: Whoopi Goldberg, Sissy Spacek, Ving Rhames, Dwight Schultz, Richard Pearce
description: We are in Montgomery, Alabama, in 1955, just as the black protest against segregation on means of transport is mounting. But we hear very little of all this at the Thompson home. Miriam is not a vulgar racist, but it would take her a long time to admit that we are all the same. Her maid, Odessa, is not a militant, but the humiliations she receives are too many ...
notes: It turns out that we are all better off and this is always the limit of such operations. But if you let yourself be carried away by the acting of the two protagonists, the film becomes a delight: between the tormented Spacek and the humble Goldberg it is a good competition.

title: Our Sons
actors: Julie Andrews, Ann-Margret, Hugh Grant, Zelijko Ivanek
description: It is the story of two mothers who are no longer very young. Una (Julie Andrews) is a rich lady. The other (Ann-Margret) is a bartender in Arkansas and her son hasn't seen him for years. The two women have nothing in common except that they both have two sons, in love with each other. But even this would not prompt the two women to talk to each other if only one of the two boys was not sick with AIDS. More talked about than anything else, this John Erman television movie involves a good number of talented actors. At the head of all Julie Andrews in his television debut and Hugh Grant, not yet kissed by the luck of "Four Weddings and a Funeral".

title: Shoot Out
actors: Gregory Peck, Pat Quinn, Susan Tyrrell, Robert F. Lyons, Dawn Lyn
description: Clay Lomax just got out of jail where he spent seven long years, convicted of a bank robbery. The first thing he intends to do as a free man is to take revenge on Sam Foley, the accomplice who shot him in the back and got him captured. In the seven years that Clay was in prison, Foley has instead become a big shot in another city. When he learns that Clay is on his trail he sends three killers to meet him. Clay, meanwhile, has been entrusted with a little girl who appears to be the result of an ancient relationship. In the clash with the three killers, Clay colds one, but the others kidnap the child and take refuge in Foley's house. Hathaway doesn't age well. Gregory Peck looks forward to his duties as a hero not exactly positive, but redeemed by honor.

title: Mutiny on the Bounty
actors: Marlon Brando, Trevor Howard, Richard Harris, Hugh Griffith
description: Captain Bligh commands the Bounty with extreme hardness. After loading breadfruit plants in Tahiti, he rationes the water to irrigate them. Thirst claims some victims among the sailors and second mate Christian rebels, along with the majority of the crew. Bligh and some faithful, abandoned on a lifeboat, will try to return to their homeland.
notes: Important cast for this version of the famous story. The brightest star is of course that of Brando. Milestone obtains a film interpreted in strong colors and with attention to the setting. Engagement and show well photographed by Robert L. Surtees.

title: Some Came Running
actors: Frank Sinatra, Dean Martin, Shirley MacLaine, Martha Hyer
description: After his leave Dave (Sinatra) returns to his hometown. With him is Ginny (MacLaine), a prostitute he met in Chicago. Dave's (Kennedy) brother, a local notable, is not very happy with it. Gwen, a literature professor is attracted to the young rebel, who has also published a novel, but he ends up choosing Ginny. And when the former boy friend of this girl shoots Dave out of jealousy, it is Ginny who dies for him.
notes: Visionary and risky melodrama by a great director, based on a James Jones novel and scripted by John Patrick with Arthur Sheekman, attentive to the construction of characters and with an extraordinary scenographic system.

title: Jetsons: the Movie
description: In the distant and unknown future, the Jetson family faces and solves the problem of some alien sabotitioners. Tedious feature film in which little or nothing remains of the all -television originality of the "Pronipoti", future fees of the perhaps most famous Flintstones (the "ancestors") created in the sixties by Hanna and Barbera.

title: Only the Valiant
actors: Gregory Peck, Ward Bond, Gig Young
description: Cavalry captain Lance goes to defend a New Mexico fort threatened by the incursions of the Apache Indians with a handful of six men chosen from among the most violent and undisciplined. Lance shows off all his skill by managing to command them and carry out their duty. A western that does not depart from the dignified standards of the time, despite the presence of Gregory Peck.

title: The Man with a Cloak
actors: Joseph Cotten, Barbara Stanwyck, Leslie Caron
description: In New York, in 1848, a mysterious broke poet helps the Parisian Madeleine to take possession of the inheritance, which a diabolical couple would like to steal from her. Curious production poised between thriller and melodrama, inspired by episodes from the life of Edgar Allan Poe. Excellent photography by George Folsey, interesting cast.

title: Doctor Zhivago
actors: Omar Sharif, Julie Christie, Rod Steiger, Alec Guinness, Geraldine Chaplin
description: Yuri and Lara met before the Great War, when he is married to his cousin Tonya and she to the idealist Pasha. During the conflict they reunite because he fights and she is a nurse. Meanwhile, Pasha has become a major player in the Communist Party, which came to power after the October Revolution, while Yuri's family has been reduced to poverty. Upon returning to Moscow, Yuri moves to the Urals and it is there that Lara becomes his mistress, but the happiness is short-lived.
notes: A great cast for a luxurious transcription of a famous Pasternak novel.

title: Viva Max
actors: Peter Ustinov, John Astin, Pamela Tiffin, Jonathan Winters, Keenan Wynn
description: A Mexican general wants to redeem national pride humiliated in 1836 by recapturing Fort Alamo. To this end, he crosses the border into Texas at the head of about fifty soldiers. Actors over the top and mechanical situations: little laughs, even if the gimmick is not bad.

title: Timerider
actors: Fred Ward, Peter Coyote, Belinda Bauer
description: Lyle, champion of off-road motorcycles, is accidentally thrown in the Far West of 1875. Here he realizes that the reality of the last century is very similar to that of today. Small science fiction film, nice and enjoyable for fans.

title: Manhattan Murder Mystery
actors: Diane Keaton, Woody Allen, Alan Alda, Anjelica Huston
description: Spouses Carol and Larry Lipton (Diane Keaton and Woody Allen) hang out with their neighbors, House. When Mrs. House dies, apparently of a heart attack, Carol Lipton instead nurtures suspicions about the deceased's husband and manages to involve her spouse, at first completely reluctant, in an investigation that will lead, after various vicissitudes, to the solution of the "case" . A "thriller" filtered through Allen's caustic humor, full of tasty cinephile "quotes" and which ends, after so many films on the couple's crisis, with the reinforcement of that of the protagonists.

title: Undercover Blues
actors: Dennis Quaid, Kathleen Turner, Stanley Tucci, Fiona Shaw
description: Jeff and Jane Blue, linked not only by marriage but also by the common profession of spies, are on maternity leave, but the theft of nerve gas by the dangerous Czech agent Novacek forces them to take action. Jeff and Jane also get in the sights of local police lieutenant, Theodore Sawyer, after Jeff gives a lesson to a thug, nicknamed "Muerte". After a further blow, he is also used by the couple as an informer. At the end of the day, Jeff and Jane will have to deal convulsively on two fronts.
notes: Herbert Ross wasn't born yesterday, but he does little to save the film from a mediocre script.

title: La carrière de Suzanne
actors: Catherine See, Philippe Beuzen, Christian Carrière, Diane Xilkinson
description: The young Susanna meets Guillaume and Bertrand, both students, the first lucid and rational, the second impetuous and spirited. The girl is at the center of the speeches with which the two students contrast and compare their respective philosophies. With Bertrand's complicity, Guillaume takes Susanna to bed, but then ...

title: Camilla
actors: Jessica Tandy, Bridget Fonda, Elias Koteas, Hume Cronyn
description: Freda is a young musician in crisis; Camilla is an elderly and eccentric violinist who boasts a past of high-ranking loves. During a vacation, the two women decide to travel to Canada together for a concert of Brahms music, while their relatives search for them in vain. Camilla will meet Ewald, the old love of yesteryear. Comedy with a quiet narrative dignity to its credit, a nice lack of presumption and a sincere affection for its (excellent) protagonists.

title: Fixing the Shadow
actors: Charlie Sheen, Linda Fiorentino, Michael Madsen, Courtney B. Vance
description: The policeman Don Saxon hates the motorcycle gangs and when Blood arrives in his city, he does not trust the agreements of non-belligerence between his boss and that of the roaring guests and infiltrates the camp of the "enemies". The plan, despite a few hitches, works and Dan can get away with the beautiful journalist Renée Jackson. Attempt, only half successful, to renew the glories of the legendary "biker-movies" of the seventies. The best are the chrome and shiny motorcycles, but the rest is not that great (except for a ferocious fist fight between Dan and a colleague, also "covered").

title: Romeo Is Bleeding
actors: Gary Oldman, Juliette Lewis, Annabella Sciorra, Lena Olin, Roy Scheider
description: Jack Grimaldi (Oldman), an agent who has led an honest career up to now, decides to "sell himself" as an informer to a powerful Mafia boss. Neither his wife nor his mistress know of his illicit and conspicuous earnings and, even less, that Jack has fallen in love with the boss's woman (which he, moreover, wants to eliminate) and this infatuation is the basis of his decision to "pass" to the enemy. The script was known in Hollywood as "the best of the unrealized in recent years". And the original title is splendid too. The film doesn't always pay off expectations, but it has charm. And Oldman takes hold of his character.

title: City of Joy
actors: Patrick Swayze, Pauline Collins, Om Puri, Shabana Azmi
description: Max Love, a brilliant young doctor, leaves the United States after a girl dies under the knife and goes to India. In Calcutta his stories intersect with those of a poor farmer who, after an attack, is taken to the "City of Joy", a very poor neighborhood inhabited by desperate people. At first Max refuses to get involved, but then, little by little ...
notes: From the novel by Dominique Lapierre, a discontinuous film, which alternates rhetorical (albeit spectacular) and intense moments with slowness and superficial solutions. Swayze is out of the question.

title: Prisoners of Honor
actors: Richard Dreyfuss, Oliver Reed, Peter Firth, Jeremy Kemp, Kenneth Colley
description: In England, in 1923, two men recall the "case" of Alfred Dreyfuss, a Jewish officer of the French secret services, unjustly convicted of espionage in 1895 and deported to Devil's Island. France was torn apart by the "Dreyfuss affair", which exposed terrifying infamies in the highest ranks of the army and civil power, involved in a disgusting anti-Semitic alliance.
notes: Russell's cinematic narrative is clearly "biased", portraying the military upper echelons in a grotesque key. The merits of the story's frame are evident, but it has gaps and fragility.

title: Assassination Bureau
actors: Oliver Reed, Diana Rigg, Telly Savalas, Curd Jürgens
description: The Assassination Bureau is a secret association that carries out commission murders. It is made up of some unsuspected ones including a publisher. One of his journalists (unaware of her boss's double life) wants to challenge the organization by commissioning the murder of her publisher. He accepts the game, but will be smarter than his pursuers. Brilliant comedy between yellow and pink that confirms the visionary talent of the English director.

title: Le jour et l'heure
actors: Simone Signoret, Stuart Whitman, Michel Piccoli
description: During the German occupation, a French widow falls in love with an American paratrooper that resistance tries to make expatriate in Spain. Crudeness and feelings that touch the melodrama.

title: Fanny Pelopaja
actors: Fanny Cottençon, Bruno Cremer, Ian Sera, Francisco Algora
description: To prevent her man from going to prison, Estefania Sanchez, known as Fanny, gives herself in to a policeman, Andrés Gallego. A few years later, Fanny has the opportunity to take revenge by organizing a theft of an armored van which Gallego supervises. In these violent and desperate love stories, Aranda always gives the best of himself.

title: Critters 3
actors: Aimée Brooks, John Calvin, Katherine Cortez, Leonardo DiCaprio
description: Annie (Brooks), little brother Johnny and dad are on an RV trip when they meet Josh (Di Caprio) and his hateful stepfather. They also come into contact with a Critters hunter who gives them a warning signal in case of need. And the case arises immediately, as the Critters sneak into the camper and then into the house where Annie and her family live. With two films already shot on the Critters was there really a need to make a third? With a bright career full of probable Oscars in the future, did Leonardo Di Caprio really need to fall into this film? Unfathomable questions.

title: Consenting Adults
actors: Kevin Kline, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Kevin Spacey, Forest Whitaker, Rebecca Miller
description: Richard Parker is a jingle composer and is happily married to Priscilla. She's not bad, but the neighbor, financial advisor Eddy Otis, offers Richard his flashy spouse, Kay. Then Kay is found dead and ...
notes: If Pakula was trying to surprise us, he definitely missed the mark.

title: The Man Who Wouldn't Die
actors: Roger Moore, Malcolm McDowell
description: Thomas Grace is a journalist, but he achieved notoriety by writing detective stories starring Inspector Fullbright and the villain Morrissey, a character inspired by a thug named Drake. Then reality overcomes fantasy, in the sense that Drake begins to kill following the plot of the novels of which he is unwittingly the protagonist. And Grace will also have to fix it. Bill Condon, despite a highly evocative name, is not a particularly famous director. Not even his latest film, "Candyman 2", has managed to make it so. Roger Moore and Malcolm McDowell, however, make up for any shortcomings.

title: The Story of Three Loves
actors: Moira Shearer, James Mason, Kirk Douglas, Leslie Caron
description: Paola had to abandon her artistic career because of heart disease. A famous choreographer notes her and invites her to his home where she has the courage to confess her infirmity. The man asks her to dance just for him. Little Tommy, who is with his parents in Rome, to get rid of the governess decides to turn to a witch. Pierre, the famous acrobat who killed his partner, saves the life of an aspiring suicide.
notes: Discreet psychological portraits between sentiment and drama. Of the three, the most successful episode is the one directed by Minnelli.

title: Montana
actors: Gena Rowlands, Richard Crenna, Lea Thompson
description: A rather quarrelsome couple does not decide on the fate of the family ranch: she wants to keep it, he wants to sell it to an oil company. Classic product for TV, of modest spectacle and with declining actors.

title: Nerosubianco
actors: Anita Sanders, Terry Carter, Nino Segurini, Umberto Di Grazia
description: In London, an Italian woman becomes aware of the sexual repression she is a victim of and gives herself to a black man who courts her in Hyde Park. It is '68 by Tinto Brass in an underground version, already in decline compared to previous results.

title: Sex and the Single Girl
actors: Tony Curtis, Natalie Wood, Henry Fonda, Lauren Bacall, Mel Ferrer
description: Bob Weston, editor of a tabloid magazine, wants to interview psychiatrist Helen Brown, author of a book on women's sexual behavior. To this end, he appropriates the name and the unfortunate marriage experiences of his friend, Frank, and introduces himself to the doctor as a patient. With many complications, but, in the end, everyone's problems will have found a solution.
notes: No particular originality, but the mechanism, well oiled, works, with a frankly hilarious outcome.

title: Night and the City
actors: Robert De Niro, Jessica Lange, Cliff Gorman, Jack Warden, Eli Wallach
description: Harry Fabian is a struggling lawyer, someone who, to make the big leap, would like to be a boxing match organizer. Difficult, both because Harry doesn't have the money, and because Boom Boom Grossman, the boss of the sector, is against it. But Harry is not discouraged, he finds money, a woman who helps him, a former heart boxer who supports him and finally also finds a bullet in an alley. Producer Winkler directs this noir, based on "Traffickers of the Night", the noir classic directed by Dassin in 1950. But it lacks the necessary grit and the film remains modest and dignified.

title: Mr. Destiny
actors: James Belushi, Linda Hamilton, Michael Caine, Jon Lovitz
description: On his 35th birthday, clerk Larry Burrows walks into a bar. The bartender's name is Mike and he serves him an elixir called "Spilled Milk". And so Larry goes back through the years to the day of his damn mistake in a baseball game. But this time instead he hits a "home run" and from that moment his life is a triumph. Too bad Larry isn't happy either. If you are unfamiliar with the rules of baseball, think about a missed penalty. If you are not familiar with Frank Capra's cinema, check out this movie. If, on the other hand, you have seen at least "Life is wonderful" you can also let it go.

title: Stick
actors: Burt Reynolds, Candice Bergen, George Segal, Charles Durning
description: Stick (Reynolds) just got out of jail. His intention is to rebuild a life away from the world of crime, but his friend in trouble over a drug deal, tries to involve him in the operation and in the end he succeeds. When he is killed in an ambush, Stick is forced to contend with a killer chased by a drug kingpin.
notes: Burt Reynolds builds on himself a film played with self-irony: it is what saves him because the story seems rather obvious. Some parts of the film were turned around because they were considered bankruptcy by the production and by the actor-director himself. Elmore Leonard, author of the novel from which this film is based, also collaborated on the screenplay.

title: Sister Act
actors: Whoopi Goldberg, Harvey Keitel, Maggie Smith, Kathy Najimy
description: Deloris is a singer in a casino in Las Vegas. One evening she accidentally witnesses a murder committed by her lover, the boss Vince La Rocca: she thus becomes a dangerous witness. The police, to safeguard her safety in view of the testimony at the trial, induce her to hide in a convent of nuns. Deloris will upset (for a good purpose) the life of the austere place and the "sisters" will be able to help her against the killers who have found her in the meantime.
notes: Nice comedy with a wild Whoopi Goldberg. It was one of Hollywood's biggest hits, earning it a sequel: "Sister Act 2 - Crazier Than Ever".

title: La pagella
actors: Mario Trevi, Marc Porel, Massimo Deda, Rosalia Maggio, Marisa Laurito
description: Gennarino, all ten in the report card for the repetitions of the good Amelia, is killed during the robbery in the goldsmith's shop where dad was about to buy him a gift: a watch. Dad is Salvatore, a good mechanic and friend of Inspector Saliani. Shocked by what happened, Salvatore ends up in a crazy ride of big motorcycles to be rigged at the head of which (but Salvatore doesn't know) is Angelo, Gennarino's killer. Scripted genre, it is a bloodless imitation of the films with Mario Merola directed by Alfonso Brescia. Good feelings and little melodrama.

title: Buster
actors: Phil Collins, Julie Walters, Larry Lamb, Stephanie Lawrence
description: We are in England in 1963. Buster, a cheap thief, is part of a gang that manages to carry out a record robbery on a train. The police catch everyone except Buster and Bruce, who flee to Acapulco: Buster is with his wife and little daughter. Running out of money, Buster sends his lady with the baby back to London, then tries to join them, but for their peace of mind he ends up turning himself in. The robbery is that of the Glasgow-London train. Phil Collins protagonist is a sure attraction for the fans of the excellent British musician. As for the rest, the attempt to involve ourselves in the affairs of the good Buster Edwards is a substantially missed goal.

title: Bonus Malus
actors: Claudio Bigagli, Gigio Alberti, Felice Andreasi, Claudio Bisio, Giulia Boschi
description: Marco Altoviti, a career insurance inspector, goes from town to town to check local agencies. Two weeks of his life are narrated, in a crescendo of events, revelations, abandonments, small everyday scams that mark him indelibly. Maybe Marco is coming out of his greyness. Perhaps a new awareness is being born in him. Maybe a different future awaits him. Maybe.
notes: A good subject (Solinas prize) chastised by a script without depth. All the potential drama of the character ends up fading into the predictable "Italian" misery nurtured and cemented by decades of comedy of banality.

title: Perfect Weapon
actors: Jeff Speakman, John Dye, Mako, James Hong, Mariska Hargitay
description: Martial arts have no secrets for Jeff, but sometimes his aggression and passion for violence, even when used without the will to do harm, have separated him from his family. When a friend is brutally killed by the Korean mafia, Jeff decides to avenge him, despite his brother Adam, a police detective, advising him not to challenge fierce and dangerous opponents for the city police themselves. Inexorable, our hero rebuilds the ranks of the gang and aims for the boss; not even Adam's injury stops him. Also because Jeff has become wise and has learned to make the most of his body.

title: Wayne's World
actors: Mike Mayers, Dana Carvey, Rob Lowe, Tia Carrere
description: "Wayne's World" is a crazy teen TV show conceived, conducted and handcrafted from the basement of their home by two friends, Wayne and Garth. An executive of a large television company, smelling the big shot, writes them but the two, realizing that their show has been distorted for advertising purposes, send it into tilt live, still obtaining a resounding success beyond which it will arrive for the two friends also love. Inspired by a hugely successful program broadcast in the United States, the film is a vitriolic satire of the television world, peppered with the healthy madness of Saturday Night Live.

title: Plenty
actors: Meryl Streep, Charles Dance, Tracy Ullman, Sting, John Gielgud
description: Susan Traherne is a young partisan sent by the British secret services to France. Here he meets a fellow paratrooper and falls in love with him, but their relationship lasts the space of one night. After the war he returns to London, passing wearily from one relationship to another, from one failure to another. Despite the somewhat confused plot and the melodramatic nature of some situations, the film is remembered above all for Streep's great acting performance. From a play by David Hare.

title: A Bridge Too Far
actors: Sean Connery, Michael Caine, Gene Hackman, James Caan, Liv Ullmann, Laurence Olivier, Elliott Gould, Ryan O'Neal, Dirk Bogarde, Edward Fox, Anthony Hopkins, Ben Cross, Denholm Elliott, Arthur Hill
description: Three months have passed since the Normandy landings. The allied command tries to hasten the end of the war with the "Market-Garden" operation: 35,000 paratroopers are launched in Holland to seize several bridges over the Meuse, the Waal and the Rhine. They will then have to keep them until the arrival of the armored troops . However, things do not go as the command expected: the Arnhem bridge does not fall into the hands of the allies and turns into a trap for the British paratroopers. An important moment of the last world war reconstructed with a profusion of means and actors of rank. But the show is more in quantity than in quality: as usual, Attenborough's direction is overweight and short of breath.

title: Raising Arizona
actors: Nicolas Cage, Holly Hunter, Trey Wilson, John Goodman
description: She takes the mug shots of the inmates, he's a robber. By dint of seeing each other in the penitentiary they fall in love. They marry, but are unable to have children. They kidnap one of five twin babies of a rich man from Arizona. Two friends who have recently escaped see the baby and understand everything. Whoever returns the frugoletto has been promised $ 25,000. Everything happens, but in the end the good ones smile. Second work by the Coen brothers (Joel director, Ethan screenwriter) really very enthralling. In terms of images, the shots and camera movements make the space a chewingum; on that of the story the screenplay makes appetizing meatballs of traditional genres.

actors: John Belushi, Dan Aykroyd, Toshiro Mifune, Robert Stack
description: A few days after the attack on Pearl Harbor, word spreads in Los Angeles that the Japanese are preparing to attack the United States. Indeed, a Japanese submarine is trying to locate Hollywood to attack it. It is panic: a general takes refuge in a cinema where "Dumbo" is shown, while the city is in the throes of chaos. The submarine launches a torpedo and moves away.
notes: Long before dealing with dinosaurs, Spielberg shot this delusional antiwar kaleidoscope, chock full of movie references and gimmicks. Unforgettable the pilot John Belushi. Dozens of cameos and parts (Sam Fuller, John Landis, Christopher Lee).

title: Phantasm 2
actors: James LeGros, Reggie Bannister, Angus Scrimm
description: A boy fights against a being belonging to the mysterious dimension of nightmares and endowed with tremendous powers. As in the "Phantasm" of nine years earlier, the screenwriter and director Coscarelli knows the tricks that cause the shock, but he does not have the gift of consistency.

title: South of St. Louis
actors: Joel McCrea, Alexis Smith, Zachary Scott, Dorothy Malone, Douglas Kennedy, Alan Hale
description: In Texas divided and battered by the civil war between Unionists and Confederates, three friends, co-owners of a ranch, take dramatically different paths. A very decent western that abounds with action, well served by a solid cast. Color photograph by Karl Freund.

title: The Rain People
actors: Shirley Knight, James Caan, Robert Duvall, Tom Arledge
description: Dissatisfied, Natalie leaves her husband a note and leaves. A half-played football champion grows fond of her and tries to help her when she's in trouble with a cop. Coppola's fourth film, very sad, evocative, with three perfect performers.

title: The Night We Never Met
actors: Annabella Sciorra, Matthew Broderick, Kevin Anderson, Jeanne Tripplehorn
description: Sam Lester, cook; Brian McVeigh, stock broker; Ellen Holder, housewife. All three of New York, share a pied-à-terre and attend it at different times. Brian organizes smoky poker with friends there. Ellen goes to paint away from her husband and has to tidy up the mess Brian left behind. Sam cooks wonderful dishes which he then leaves to the roommate. They will continue like this for a while ...
notes: Director and screenwriter, Warren Leight starts from a not new idea and takes (wastes) time before triggering the mechanism of misunderstanding. Two super beauties in the cast: Annabella Sciorra and, to a lesser extent, Naomi Campbell.

title: Ma nuit chez Maud
actors: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Françoise Fabian, Marie-Christine Barrault, Antoine Vitez
description: Michel, an engineer, returns to Clermont-Ferrand after ten years in America and tries to meet Françoise, with whom he feels in love. His friend Vidal takes him one evening to Maud, a charming divorcee with whom Michel talks all night, learning the reasons for the separation of the woman from her husband. Years later, married to Françoise, Michel has a revelation about his wife's past.
notes: Rohmer perfectly masters his own "cinema of the word", and guides the actors to a highly sensitive acting, in a story that is only apparently "light". A perfect, philosophical and melancholic film.

title: Four Weddings and a Funeral
actors: Hugh Grant, Andie MacDowell, Kristin Scott Thomas, Simon Callow, Anna Chancellor
description: 32-year-old Charles, one hundred percent English, is convinced that getting married is not for him and, every time he attends a friend's wedding, this conviction becomes even more solid. When, however, he meets the American Carrie, who hits him deep inside, Charles is almost ready to capitulate. There is, however, a considerable obstacle to her intentions: Carrie is super-engaged ...
notes: A comedy that owes its enormous success to an impeccable script, intelligently witty dialogues, actors in a state of grace and flawless direction. The poem read at the funeral is by W. H. Auden.

title: Three of Hearts
actors: William Baldwin, Kelly Lynch, Sherilyn Fenn, Joe Pantoliano
description: Connie is dumped by her fiancée Ellen and, to attend her sister's wedding, she "rents" Joe, a handsome but decidedly cheeky gigolo. The two sympathize, so much so that Joe settles in Connie's house, but she only cares about Ellen coming back with her. You just have to make Joe woo Ellen and then, at the right moment, unload her. And the contraption works. In the fashion of films centered on homosexual loves this fits in a little appreciable way, with artificial characters, pretentious dialogues and actors of mediocre effectiveness, with the exception of Kelly Lynch (Connie).

title: The Distinguished Gentleman
actors: Eddie Murphy, Lane Smith, Sheryl Lee Ralph, Joe Don Baker
description: The negro Thomas Jefferson Johnson, a small-time scammer, exploits the homonymy with a recently deceased MP and is elected. He skillfully manages to enter the Committee on Energy and Industry, with far from honest intentions. But a dramatic case involving a little girl leads him on the right path to fight and unmask the sinister maneuvers of political scoundrels. Eddie Murphy had his best moment at the time (1983) of John Landis' "Armchair for Two". Later, now overflowing, he imposed nonsense or silly quibbles like this (see "Mr. Smith Goes to Washington", by Frank Capra, 1939).

title: Honey, I Blew Up the Kid
actors: Rick Moranis, Marcia Strassman, Lloyd Bridges, Robert Oliveri
description: Scientist Wayne Zsalinski takes two of his three children to the laboratory where he works. Little Adam, two years old, by a fortuitous case undergoes radiation that makes him grow bigger. He will grow, in various stages, to measure twenty meters and against him a fighter will be unleashed which will involve helicopters, the National Guard, paralyzing bullets. Three years after "Honey, I Shrunk the Kids", Walt Disney tries to repeat the fortunes with the same and opposite idea, but the matter works much less well.

title: Le cercle des passions
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Max Von Sydow, Assumpta Serna
description: Returning to Sicily from the United States, where he lives, Anthony Tursi meets Count Carlo di Villafratti who invites him to his property. Here Anthony meets Elisa, the count's daughter, and falls in love with her. The woman, however, will drag him into an absurdly dramatic plot. A melodrama only partially redeemed by beautiful photography and beautiful music.

title: The Ultimate Warrior
actors: Yul Brynner, Max Von Sydow, Joanna Miles
description: The atomic war destroyed the earth. In a deserted New York the group led by the "Baron" and the one led by the ruthless "Carrot" fight. The Baron hires Carlson, a powerful warrior, to fight his rival but internal disagreements in the group lead to his elimination. Carlson will be able to reach a peaceful island with the Baron's daughter. Quite silly sci-fi movie, with a cast of stars.

title: Child's Play 2
actors: Alex Vincent, Christine Elise, Jenny Agutter, Grace Zabriskie, Greg Germann, Gerrit Graham
description: Chucky is a good doll, unfortunately possessed by the soul of a serial killer, a certain Charles Lee Ray. Little Andy Barcaly is back from a bad adventure with Chucky, but now it's all over: the doll has been sent back to the factory to be destroyed, while Andy has gone to live with his new adoptive parents. The sequel proves it's not that easy to get rid of Chucky. Who will be able to save their skin in the end?
notes: The story does not end with this sequel, but continues in the third episode released the following year directed by another director. But in these cases, who is looking to the director?

title: Crossing Delancey
actors: Amy Irving, Peter Riegert, Reizl Bozyk, Jeroen Krabbe, Sylvia Miles
description: Isabell Grossman works in a fine bookstore and doesn't need anyone or anything. Even less than her grandmother Bubbie Kantor introduces her to possible boyfriends.
notes: New York comedy. Despite the years wasted being Spielberg's wife, Amy Irving still has gorgeous blue eyes.

title: Cameriera bella presenza offresi
actors: Elsa Merlini, Gino Cervi, Peppino De Filippo, Alberto Sordi, Eduardo De Filippo
description: While waiting to marry her fiancé Berto, (who is waiting for the death of her uncle to inherit a small estate) Maria (Elsa Merlini) works as a waitress, but systematically changes bosses, always remaining involved in the family affairs of her various employers. Meanwhile, the uncle does not decide to "remove the disturbance". Parade of great comedians on a very thin sentimental comic canvas.

title: I vigliacchi non pregano
actors: Gianni Garko, Sean Todd, Elisa Montes, Jerry Wilson
description: Returning from the Civil War, after going through a thousand vicissitudes, the young Brian finds his young wife raped and killed. He vows to take revenge but his revenge turns into a boundless and insane hatred that drives him mad. Ruthless, violent and wild western, but spoiled by the clichés of the genre.

title: The True Story of the Menendez Murders
actors: James Farentino, Jill Clayburgh
description: Jose and Kitty Menendez, husband and wife, are found killed. It is only the confession of Erik, one of the two sons, to his psychoanalyst that allows the police to arrest the two brothers. At the trial, the boys claim to have killed to defend themselves from an unbearable family situation, amidst oppression and indifference; they manage to obtain the cancellation of the trial and to return to freedom. Television film that reconstructs a real event. Good attention to the dramatic elements; the direction is tight and on the whole the performance of the interpreters is discreet. Here and there you run the risk of slipping into family melodrama.

title: Friday the 13th
actors: Betsy Palmer, Adrienne King, Harry Crosby, Robbi Morgan, Kevin Bacon
description: A group of boys and girls are setting up the Crystal Lake campsite, heedless of the curse that hangs over the place, after the tragic death, back in 1958, of the son of Mrs. Voorhess, owner of the land. It is a Friday 13, as well as a full moon night: only Alice is saved from the collective massacre, after having beheaded the "monster": the usual unsuspected character. The first episode of a series destined for numerous and ominous shots. This as a whole is still saved: the repetitive mechanism, the erotic allusions, the mix between full moon and cabala manage to obviate the total absence of narration.

title: Billy Liar
actors: Tom Courtenay, Julie Christie
description: Absorbed in his dreams, Billy is a bad employee. What's more, he promised marriage to a couple of girls, being in love with a third. The latter, Liz, knows how to understand, but this is not enough to bring Billy back to reality. Free English Cinema of the Golden Years; excellent Schlesinger, great Courtenay.

title: The Black Tent
actors: Anna Maria Sandri, Anthony Steel, Donald Sinden, André Morell
description: Charles Holland is not convinced that his brother David, an army captain, disappeared during the Libyan war. He searches for a clue and thus reaches the Bedouin chief who reveals to him that he had hosted David, who was wounded, during the war, but that he then lost track of him. When Charles is about to leave the nomad camp he sees a child with western features who looks a lot like David and then questions the child's mother. The action languishes and the story soon loses interest.

title: The Secret of Stamboul
actors: James Mason, Valerie Hobson, Frank Vosper
description: Larry Destine, a young English officer, is thrown out of the army because, in order to defend a young girl, he has had a quarrel with a member of the Turkish ruling house. He thus finds himself working for a Western planter whose business covers an organization that wants to overthrow the government. James Mason was in his fourth film and was barely twenty-five: he must be excused.

title: Just Like a Woman
actors: Adrian Pasdar, Julie Walters, Paul Freeman, Susan Wooldridge
description: Gerald (Pasdar) is a happily married young bank officer. Happily at least until the wife discovers women's clothes (not hers) around the house. The same thing then happens with Monica, a divorced housewife, who rents a room to Gerald, falls in love with him and then chases him away when she sees a woman slipping into his room at night. And to say that he is completely innocent. That is, Gerald likes to dress up as Geraldine every now and then and who are we to blame him?
notes: At least this seems to be the basic idea of ??Christopher Monger. But if Monger had also made a slightly brighter film, it would have been better for everyone.

title: Città di notte
actors: Antonio De Teffé, Henri Vilbert, Patrizia Bini, Corrado Pani, Adriana Asti
description: A group of young people with theatrical aspirations try to put on a show. The tests take place in the warehouse of Marina's father, a wealthy merchant. To be able to go on stage, however, money is needed. In the meantime, relationships and amorous provocations develop between boys and girls, with almost dramatic outcomes. Eventually, Marina's father decides to finance the show. Not without reason, Leopoldo Trieste is certainly known more as an actor than as a director. This "City of Night" was his directorial debut, interesting but a little naive in the general structure, which was followed by the disappointing "Sin of the verdì years".

title: Il colosso di Roma - Muzio Scevola
actors: Gordon Scott, Gabriella Pallotta, Massimo Serato, Maria Pia Conte
description: The Etruscans, led by Porsenna, besiege Rome incited by the overthrown King Tarquinio the Superb. Muzio Scevola enters the Etruscan camp to kill Porsenna, but having failed to do so he burns his right hand to punish himself. Tarquinio, meanwhile, has kidnapped Muzio's betrothed and imprisoned Porsenna and his family. Muzio Scevola then confronts him in a duel and, even fighting with the left, wins him. Between history and legend, a film of friendly craftsmanship.

title: Jacknife
actors: Robert De Niro, Ed Harris, Kathy Baker, Charles S. Dutton
description: Megs and Dave are Vietnam veterans. The memories of the war haunt them and the past is not without obstacles, including the relationship between Megs and Dave's sister, opposed by the latter.
notes: Good work of actors on the characters and the evolution of the characters. The screenplay is somewhat affected by the theatrical origins of the subject.

title: Chappaqua
actors: Jean-Louis Barrault, William S. Burroughs, Allen Ginsberg
description: Russell is at the clinic in Paris to be detoxified. He escapes to get the drugs, but is caught back. Cinema, beatnick poetry and hallucinogens in a curious experiment in which there is a whole era.

title: Imagine: John Lennon
actors: John Lennon, Yoko Ono
description: The life, the songs, the sexual-mystical-political performances of the most emblematic component of the Beatles.
notes: A version that is perhaps a little too hagiographic, but almost inevitable in these circumstances (criticism does not suit the myth. And the songs, of course, are splendid.

title: Il posto
actors: Alessandro Panzeri, Loredana Detto, Tullio Kezich
description: The young Domenico Cantoni arrives in the city to participate in a competition organized by a large company. Domenico passes the competition and, together with him, also Antonietta, a girl known in exams, passes it. Domenico, however, for the moment, has to be content with helping usher even if, more than this, he worries about the fact that he can no longer see Antonietta who has different shifts. But the girl invites him to the corporate prom. Domenico participates in it, but Antonietta does not arrive. Disappointed, Domenico returns to work where he learns that, due to the death of an elderly employee, he will take his place. Delicate, ironic, but also ferocious representation of the world of work in the busy Milan of the Sixties (you can see the underground excavations) told against the background of a friendship that does not turn into love.

title: In Love and War
actors: Robert Wagner, Dana Wynter, Jeffrey Hunter, Bradford Dillman
description: Story of friendship, love, blood and glory of three US marines who, coming from very different backgrounds, meet and become friends in the army. Routine war propaganda during the 1950s: we talk about the war won against Japan with an eye to the new conflicts that broke out in Southeast Asia.

title: Ice Castles
actors: Robby Benson, Lynn-Holly Johnson, Tom Skerritt, Jennifer Warren
description: Lexie Winston, sixteen years old from a minnesota town and passionate with artistic skating, would like to represent his country at the Winter Olympics and win a gold medal. She does not miss her talent, but she is forced to face two apparently unsurpassed obstacles: the refusal of her father Marcus and the need to join a nursery. The father's resistance is bent by the intervention of Beulah Smith, a former skater. But one day the girl suffers a serious accident. He will reuse to return to the races thanks to his willpower and the lovely support of the boyfriend.
notes: Despite the beautiful photograph and a certain psychological finesse the result is yet another sweet soap.

title: Davy Crockett and the River Pirates
actors: Fess Parker, Buddy Ebsen, Jeff York, Kenneth Tobey
description: Crockett, a friend and Captain Cobb on one side, Captain Fink on the other, make it to whoever gets to New Orleans first by sailing the Mississippi. Then they return to the mountains amidst attacks by bandits and Indians. Collage of two episodes originally made for TV, a traditional Disney production for kids and families.

title: Wake of the Red Witch
actors: John Wayne, Luther Adler, Gig Young, Gail Russell
description: A captain purposely causes the sinking of his sailing ship carrying a gluttonous load of gold. Why does it act this way? He has calculated everything down to the smallest detail and of course the intention is to recover the precious metal at a later time, with the necessary calm. But the shipowner has sensed the fraud and pursues him determined to unmask him. Tight action, with a cast that works. Moments of kitsch have made it a cult for critics from across the Alps, and the bizarre film actually retains a certain charm.

title: Eleven Days Eleven Nights
actors: Jessica Moore, Joshua McDonald, Mary Sellers, Tom Mojack
description: Michael is preparing to marry Helen, but in the eleven days that separate him from the wedding he knows new erotic and emotional horizons thanks to a beautiful and unscrupulous girl. Dazzinal eros and falsely transgressive story. All directed by our Aristide Massaccesi, aka Joe D'Amato. The title obviously winks at "nine and a half weeks".

title: The Wild Little Bunch
actors: Jack Wild, June Brown, John Bailey, Diana Reevers, Alun Armstrong
description: After the death of both of their parents, a brood of siblings is divided as each child is entrusted to a different family. Everyone accepts the new situation except one, the oldest, who sets out in search of each of the others, eager to reunite the family. Taken from a true story, which in its time moved America.

title: Casey's Gift: For Love of a Child
actors: Kevin Dobson, Michael Tucker, Belinda Montgomery, Karen Austin
description: Terry Stilwell and Donna Bolen have decided to open a travel agency. Their respective daughters Kathy and Linda are best friends and both cheerleaders. Their husbands Peter and Hank have been friends for a lifetime. The Stilwell house adjoins that of the Bolens. Life is beautiful and everyone loves each other. Then little Casey Stilwell drowns in the Bolen pool and there the drama begins. It is of course an actor's film. Also of script, but above all of actors. To mention Michael Tucker who appears occasionally in Woody Allen's films ("The Purple Rose of Cairo", "Radio Days") and on a permanent basis in the telefilm "L. A. Law".

title: Bopha!
actors: Danny Glover, Malcolm McDowell, Alfre Woodward, Maynard Eziashi
description: The eighties. Micah Mangema is a South African policeman who believes in the order of the world, as he has always seen it: the order of whites. His son Zweli believes it much less. The beauty is that the town is really peaceful and orderly. De Villiers, the man of the Special Corps, will take care of making it unmanageable. A full page is not enough to contain the filmography of actor Morgan Freeman ("The Ruthless", "Lethal Virus"). This is his directorial debut and it is a great debut. The fact that it is unpublished by us is something that cries out for vengeance to heaven.

title: Ladybugs
actors: Rodney Dangerfield, Jackée, Jonathan Brandis, Ilene Graff
description: The mature Chester Lee has been waiting for years for a promotion in Dave Mullen's company, where he works as a salesman, also to be able to finally marry Bess, Matthew's mother. But the dismissal looms over his head and to save his job he lets Mullen know that he was a great footballer as a young man. Just what it takes to bring the company's sponsored women's soccer team back to the top of the table.
notes: It is not a Mariano Laurenti film and the protagonist is not Lino Banfi, but we are still in those neighborhoods.

title: Rancho Deluxe
actors: Jeff Bridges, Sam Waterston, Slim Pickens, Harry Dean Stanton
description: Jack and Cecil, two vagabonds without art or part who manage to survive only on the fruit of petty theft against the rich owner of a ranch. Lively comedy very 70s. Nice rhythm, desecration and two great character actors like Slim Pickens and Harry Dean Stanton.

title: Le genou de Claire
actors: Jean-Claude Brialy, Aurora Cornu, Béatrice Romand, Laurence de Monaghan
description: On the eve of the wedding, Jérome meets Claire, identifies in her knee the "magnetic pole" of his desire and tries in every way to caress it. He does not hesitate to tell her that he has seen her boyfriend, Gilles, with another woman and, in the moment of despair of Claire, here is the famous caress. Jérome deludes himself that he has managed to separate Claire from Gilles, whom he deems unsuitable for her. One of Rohmer's most fascinating films for its thematic richness, for its narrative elegance and for the subtle perfidy that runs through it in the analysis of the behavior of the characters, especially adults, of their fragile and transient certainties.

title: Map of the Human Heart
actors: Jason Scott Lee, Anne Parillaud, Robert Joamie, Annie Galipeau, Patrick Bergin
description: Avik, an elderly Eskimo, recounts his life since, at 15, he was sent to Montreal by a Canadian aviator to treat himself for tuberculosis. Here he meets Albertine, also a half-breed, whom he will meet again years later, during the Second World War, in London. Shot down on Dresden, Avik is disgusted by the horrors of war and returns to the Polar Circle. Later she will also find again the daughter she had from Albertine. The "map of feelings" of the original title, is exhibited according to the modules of a meatloaf film, in the interminable conflict between Avik and the father figure. Some hilarious scenes in the sanatorium and the erotic acrobatic sequence on the balloon.

title: The Client
actors: Susan Sarandon, Tommy Lee Jones, Brad Renfro, Ossie Davis, Mary-Louise Parker
description: Mark Sway is only eleven years old and pays dearly for a smoked cigarette. In fact, he witnesses the suicide of a lawyer implicated with the mafia and thus finds himself on both the Cosa Nostra (which wants to silence him) and the FBI (with opposite intentions). She really needs a good lawyer and she puts herself in Reggie Love's hand. How it will turn out, it is not difficult to guess. From the book of the same name by John Grisham, with a good narrative pace, excellent actors, but a basic flaw: the predictability of the epilogue.

title: Pentathlon
actors: Dolph Lundgren, David Soul, Renée Coleman, Roger E. Mosley
description: A year before the fall of the Berlin Wall, an East German pentathlete escapes the Marxist "paradise" and lands in the United States. He has a hard time here, but his employer helps him get back in shape. Except, there is his former coach who took it into his head to kill him and, from a Stasi agent, he turned into a neo-Nazi. The criminal plan is doomed to predictable failure. There is very little to say about this film that mixes sport, politics and espionage: no one is saved, neither Dolph Lundgren, the Ivan Drago of "Rocky IV", nor David Soul, star of the telefilm "Starsky and Hutch ".

title: Portami via
actors: Stefania Orsola Garello, France Demoulin, Sergio Troiano, Michele Di Mauro
description: Friends Luigi and Antonio, the first social worker, the second representative, cherish the dream of being able to meet Cinzia and Cristina, two callers from the East with services that are too expensive for their pockets. Finally found the money, they meet the two women, but just when they killed their protector. Perhaps, in France, all four of them will have a better future.
notes: The setting was excellent, a dark, cold, harsh and inhospitable Turin. On the other hand, the "damnation" of the protagonists and the surrounding figures is far too insistent and monotonous.

title: Ten Little Indians
actors: Donald Pleasence, Frank Stallone, Brenda Vaccaro, Herbert Lom
description: Ten tourists on an African safari in the 1930s find themselves isolated in the jungle with a mysterious killer who appears to have targeted them. The tourists thus become nine and then eight, while someone reminds others of the rhyme of the "ten little Indians". And then seven and then six, as the survivors begin to suspect each other. Let's face it, the original idea, that of Agatha Christie's novel, wasn't bad. But what harm have we done to endure yet another remake of this story? Donald Pleasance's haunted eyes aren't enough to save the day.

title: Farewell, My Lovely
actors: Robert Mitchum, Charlotte Rampling, Jack O'Halloran, John Ireland, Sylvia Miles, Harry Dean Stanton, Anthony Zerbe
description: The private detective Philip Marlowe investigates on behalf of a certain Moose Malloy, a beast ex convict, in the search for the woman who dumped him, but who still loves. "The Shadow of the Past"), is one of the best films based on Chandler, plus the typical Hollywood gloom of the 70s. Absolutely perfect Mitchum as a disenchanted detective, in one of his great interpretations of maturity.

title: And Then There Was One
actors: Amy Madigan, Dennis Boutsikaris, Jane Daly
description: Roxy and Vinny are happy and their life is full of satisfaction. Only a child is missing them. After numerous spontaneous abortions, Roxy finally manages to give birth, with great risks. Following a disease of little Miranda, it turns out that the girl has AIDS; The two spouses are also positive and the only explanation lies in a transfusion suffered by Roxy after one of his abortions.

title: Black Widow
actors: Gene Tierney, Van Heflin, George Raft, Ginger Rogers, Peggy Ann Garner
description: Detective Bruce must investigate the murder of the beautiful Tancy Ordway, killed in the home of the businessman Peter Denver. The body was found by Denver's wife, Iris, on her return from a trip. The murdered woman was a smart girl, but a little too enterprising, in search of personal success and "right" relationships. Eventually the case is resolved although there are many suspects.
notes: Nunnally Johnson is by right one of the great screenwriters in the history of cinema (his collaboration with John Ford is exemplary), but he was also a producer and, in some cases, director. As for this thriller set amidst the allurements of Broadway.

title: Stefano Quantestorie
actors: Maurizio Nichetti, Elena Sofia Ricci, Amanda Sandrelli, Caterina Sylos Labini
description: The forty-year-old Stefano, irresolute as much as imaginative, thinks back to all the different opportunities that life has presented to him: if he had left for America, if he had been admitted to the Carabinieri, if he had graduated pilot, if he had married Angela, or Chiara, or Costanza ... So many possible stories, an intertwining of hypotheses and dreams. But, after all, one life is as good as another. Nichetti-magician "plays" in his surreal story with joints that are authentic narrative virtuosities without a net, reckless, but, at the same time, always kept under control. Too bad the story is a little too repetitive.

title: Em busca de ouro
description: Documentary on the difficult living conditions of the Brazilian Indians. Set in the Amazon, it tells the adventures of Uira, the protagonist.

title: Tatu Bola
description: Italian-Brazilian collective film made in Italy with Glauber Rocha, after his departure for exile. Rocha and the other friends involved strike up an argument around a famous character's deathbed.
notes: On the verge of experimentalism: but as always with Rocha, with some brilliant insights.

title: Tropici
actors: Joel Barcelos, Janira Santiago, Graciele Campos, Batista Campos
description: A family of agricultural workers moves from the Brazilian Northeast, to Racife, and then decides to move to the metropolis of Sao Paulo in a desperate search for a job ...
notes: A film that stands out for its rigorous staging, between Rossellini and the Brazilian "cinema novo".

title: Roma
actors: Peter Gonzales, Fiona Florence, Marcello Mastroianni
description: A boy who lives in Rimini and who knows the eternal city only through the notions learned at school, the few local ruins and the descriptions of his school teachers, now grown up, arrives at Termini station on the eve of the Second World War. Then begins a journey that winds through the streets of the city highlighting ghosts of the past, alleys and streets. One of Fellini's most hallucinated and indicative films. Apparently devoid of a common thread, guided by the director's voice off, it is a collection of digressions between past and present, all unforgettable: from the initial reconstruction (the most substantial part) of guesthouses and taverns during the war, to the parade of cardinals, to the vision of the ring road in the rain, to the sublime lightning appearance of Anna Magnani. Famous is the scene in which during the works for the subway the frescoes dissolve in contact with the air. The sequence in which Sordi and Mastroianni appear were cut by Fellini himself for copies destined abroad.

title: Sin and Redemption
actors: Richard Grieco, Cynthia Gibb
description: Billie is a serious and studious girl who works part time as a waitress at a drive-in. One evening she is attacked and raped. From the violence a girl is born that the girl's father would like to entrust to an institution. But Billie has met a good guy, Jim, who offers to marry her. The two have other children but Jim, addicted to drinking, becomes more violent every day until, having to donate a kidney for his sick eldest daughter, the exams reveal that he is the natural father ... the violent thriller with the psychological drama, stirring the waters of a dark and disturbing contemporary melodrama.

title: La dottoressa Giò - Una mano da stringere
actors: Barbara D'Urso, Flavio Bucci, Riccardo Cucciolla, Fabio Testi, Sergio Abbagnato, Luciano Mazzi, Paolo Calissano
description: Giorgia Basile, known as Giò, is a doctor in the gynecology department of the Sandro Pertini hospital in Rome. A young pregnant drug addict, Benedetta, is hospitalized in her ward. This arouses the ire of some of his colleagues, the head physician and the girl's neighbor. Meanwhile, the doctor is also expecting a child. One day, however, in settling a quarrel between Benedetta and a drug dealer, Giorgia loses her son. It is a pilot film for a television series that is expected to kick off next season. The film sees some young sons of art lined up together with some old glories of Italian theater and cinema.

title: The Beast
actors: Jason Patric, George Dzundza, Steven Bauer, Kabir Bedi
description: We are in Afghanistan. A Russian tank tries to escape the hunt given by a group of partisans, intent on avenging one of their comrades killed under its tracks. The commander's cruelty pushes the young lieutenant Kovercenko to rebellion. Sentenced to a horrible death, he is saved by the Afghans and with them he will finally be able to destroy the tank and its crew. Beyond the "content" judgments, the film stands out above all for the skill of the staging, thanks to which the director of "Waterworld" manages to make the huge tank a real added character of the story.

title: Twilight Zone: The Movie
directors: John Landis, Steven Spielberg, Joe Dante
actors: Dan Aykroyd, Vic Morrow, Scatman Crothers, Bill Quinn
description: A racist is thrown into alternative worlds where he is the one being persecuted. The elderly in a chronic care unit are unhappy: a mysterious companion makes them children as if by magic, but even childhood has its pains. A child shows his creepy paranormal powers to a young teacher. On an airliner, a passenger is prey to monstrous visions, or so others think. The collage of the events as a whole leaves a little perplexing, especially for those who have appreciated the dry and magnetic style of the series of series of the sixties from which the inspiration is drawn. Taken one by one, however, each episode has its own charm.

title: Come prima più di prima t'amerò
actors: Barbara Ravaglioli, Piera Robbiani, Ulrico Pagani, Marta Debetto
description: About twenty HIV-positive people speak of their coexistence with the AIDS virus. These are reflections on life, on the meaning of time, but also existential stories that highlight the difficulty of relationships with others, the desire to love and the fear of being rejected, the desire and terror of having a child. . Testimonies made more acute and piercing by the not only ideal proximity to death. Daniele Segre, Turin militant filmmaker author of "Manila Paloma Blanca" (1992), documents a dramatic reality of today without rhetoric or whining, indicating that "we" are no different from "them".

title: Mourir d'aimer
actors: Annie Girardot, Bruno Pradal, Claude Cerval, Jean Bouise
description: Danièle Guénot, a young teacher from a high school in Rouen, is very attached to her students with whom she spends a lot of time even outside of school. One of them soon becomes her lover. The parents denounce the woman: the boy will end up in an asylum, the teacher will take her own life. Social cross-section of a certain '68, between melodrama and news, taken from a real case that caused a sensation both in France and abroad.

title: Une femme est une femme
actors: Anna Karina, Jean-Claude Brialy, Jean-Paul Belmondo
description: Angela (Karina), a young Danish stripper who works in a Parisian club, would like a child with her partner, Emilio (Brialy), but he fears a marriage trap and disagrees. Indeed, he suggests that she take Alfredo (Belmondo) as an occasional partner, who is in love with Angela. Said and done, but then Emilio is moved and decides to stay by the woman's side forever. One of the most captivating "chapters" in Godard's filmography, as creative in the narrative form as it is insightful in the analysis of characters and situations. The participation of the performers was excellent, especially the charming Anna Karina.

title: Lamerica
actors: Enrico Lo Verso, Michele Placido, Carmelo Di Mazzarelli
description: Two Italian fixers, Fiore and Gino, buy a state-owned shoe factory in Albania. They also find a "straw man" as a local partner, a poor old man with mental problems, Spiro. When he evaporates, Gino looks for him and finds him, but the deal goes awry. To return to Italy, Gino is forced to board a ship full of desperate people who come to us, deluded to find "lamerica". Italian cynical corrupters in a country in collapse, an odyssey in the hell of misery and in the utopia of a neighboring town of Bengodi. Amelio describes with dry incisiveness and realizes an intense message of civil significance. Glimpses of great cinema.

title: Life with Mickey
actors: Michael J. Fox, Christina Vidal, Nathan Lane, Cyndi Lauper
