description: Michael Chapman was once the famous star of the sit-com titled "Life with Mickey". Now that he has aged Michael is no longer him. Since he is no longer fifteen, his life has completely changed. The right idea to move forward comes to him the day when a ten-year-old girl steals his wallet, gets caught and, to save himself, plays a number that not even Meryl Streep ... The idea of ??the former child prodigy who opening an agency for new child prodigies is not bad. Not everything works out well, but for Michael J. Fox, playing Peter Pan is like playing at home. To mention Cyndi Lauper in the role of secretary.

title: Viva la rivista!
actors: Carlo Dapporto, Isa Barzizza, Walter Chiari, Carlo Campanini
description: The film is divided into four episodes. In the first, a variety actor is committed to his number in front of a single spectator, a paralytic boy. N. 2. A naive dancer on a broken boy, following the advice of some friends accepts the invitation of another man. Repenting, the friends organize a burland against the new spasimante. N. 3. The daughter of a Saltimbanco is engaged to an eternal black jersey cyclist. N. 4. An actor performs at the theater in his father's parody waiting for his first child. However, scenic fiction becomes reality. Magazine curtains a little with rose water. Chiari plays the last episode, perhaps the best.

title: Probable Cause
actors: Michael Ironside, Kate Vernon, Kirk Baltz, Craig T. Nelson
description: Someone brutally murdered some politicians. The police take action; Detective Gary Yanuck is in charge of the investigation and his superior joins him with a female detective, Lynn Reilly. It doesn't take long for Gary to discover that not everything is clear in Lynn's life: from here to suspect that in some way the woman has something to do with the crimes in question, the step is short ... Yet another variation on the theme of the couple of mixed policemen and on that of the political-business intrigue and on that of the polluted police forces. Etc. Rightly programmed on Saturday night, it will not take the public away to cinemas.

title: The Indian Fighter
actors: Kirk Douglas, Walter Matthau, Lon Chaney jr., Elsa Martinelli
description: After the end of the civil war, Johnny Hawks returns to the West; once hostile to the Indians, he later made peace with the tribe of Chief Red Cloud. Now he has to lead a caravan in full Sioux territory ...
notes: Matthau and Chaney jr. they are bad guys, Douglas produces and dominates, Martinelli makes her American debut.

title: Adam's Woman
actors: Beau Bridges, John Mills, Jane Merrow, James Booth, Andrew Keir
description: At the beginning of the last century, when there were more inmates in Australia than kangaroos, Governor Philip MacDonald took it into his head to be a Democrat and set up re-education programs for inmates. The first to benefit is Adam Beecher and he is not at all enthusiastic about it. London-based documentary maker Leacock goes to Australia to shoot a not-so-exciting film.

title: Doctor at Large
actors: Dirk Bogarde, Brigitte Bardot, Shirley Eaton
description: Simon Sparrow has just graduated from medical school and has a dream of becoming a surgeon. His first work experience, however, was disastrous. The second is already a step forward, but only by returning to St. Swithin's hospital will Sparrow be able to fulfill his dream.
notes: Third episode of the series "Doctors" produced by Rank (we are entitled "Four in medicine", "A doctor on the high seas" and "Undress ... doctor!". In this and the next one there is Dirk Bogarde, but it is little consolation.

title: Le voleur d'enfants
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Angela Molina, Michel Piccoli, Virginie Ledoyen
description: In 1925 Paris, the former Argentine colonel Bigua built a kind of hostel for abandoned children. Thus he manages to have those children that his wife Desposoria cannot give him. They find food, warmth, tranquility and even a home. It all ends when Gabrielle arrives, a little girl in need of affection too, but far too beautiful. A French / Italian / Spanish co-production for a confused and pretentious film. Virginie Ledoyen is actually too beautiful and Mastroianni a little too over the top.

title: Labyrinth
actors: Jennifer Connelly, David Bowie, Toby Froud, Shelley Thompson
description: Sarah is a teenager with a vivid imagination. One evening her parents entrusted her with her little brother. Impatient by the constant crying of the latter, Sarah invokes Jareth, the lord of the gnomes, to take him away. But Jareth really exists and, taking it literally, makes the little one disappear. Sarah goes in search of him, entering a world of dreams and wandering in a parallel world. Henson was the inventor of the Muppett, the script is by Terry Jones who was one of the Monty Phyton), the producer is George "Star Wars" Lucas. But the story is without rhythm and without magic, if we exclude the inventions of some puppets and some space-time displacements that restore the atmosphere of the dream.

title: Clownhouse
actors: Nathan Forrest Winters, Brian McHugh, Sam Rockwell
description: Three brothers, left alone on Friday evenings, go to the circus. Casey is the youngest; he does not have much fun, on the contrary he is afraid of the insinuating ways of clowns. Randy, the eldest of the three, teases him, but will have something to regret it. He soon realizes that little Casey was right to be terrified: someone or something terrible is hiding in the night shadows of the suburbs. Salva plays with traditional elements (children's fears, the night, creepy clown masks). It is a debut work of discreet workmanship that does not disappoint fans.

title: They Made Me a Criminal
actors: John Garfield, Gloria Dickson, Claude Rains, Ann Sheridan
description: Believed to have died in an accident, a young boxing champion decides to rebuild his life under a false name. In a colony for backslidden boys he becomes attached to a girl and, to help the community, he resumes boxing in a sideshow. Interesting excursus into the drama of a specialist in musicals. Great performance by Garfield, in his classic loser role.

title: Come to the Stable
actors: Loretta Young, Celeste Holm, Hugh Marlowe, Elsa Lanchester
description: "Sister Margaret and Sister Scholastica want to found an orphanage in New England to dissolve a vow. The land is given to them, but the house has a large mortgage; despite their efforts, they get to the point of having to abandon the company, but here it is. unexpected help arrives. Free initiative and divine providence arm in arm, in a film beyond the threshold of ridicule. "

title: Les nuits fauves
actors: Cyril Collard, Romane Bohringer, Carlos Lopez, Corinne Blue
description: Jean is thirty years old and has an unbridled desire to live: his availability for any experience is total, without inhibitions. Meet Laura, a 17 year old girl. He also has a love affair with her, which soon becomes important even if anything but peaceful. Jean is HIV-positive, but that doesn't change anything in his habits or Laura's feeling for him. Thanks to her, Jean will learn to love. Cyril Collard made it with an "excessive" disposition before dying of AIDS and this cannot leave us indifferent. In France they shouted at the masterpiece but, with all due respect for the drama it reflects, it does not seem to us that it is.

title: Sea Wife
actors: Richard Burton, Joan Collins, Basil Sydney, Cy Grant, Ronald Squire
description: On the run from Singapore threatened by the Japanese invasion, an English ship is sunk by a submarine. Four are saved: a nun (Collins), a journalist (Burton), a businessman and the ship's steward. The four find refuge on an island and the journalist, without knowing he is dealing with a nun, also finds a way to fall in love with the woman. Dramone bolso and dated, with actors that go inside.

title: The Remarkable Mr. Pennypacker
actors: Clifton Webb, Dorothy McGuire, Charles Coburn, Jill St. John
description: Orazio Pennypacker is honest and good-hearted, but also a bit crazy. For example, he has the idea of ??building two families, one in Philadelphia and the other in Harrisburg, procreating between them the beauty of seventeen children. And of course there is no shortage of troubles. This adaptation of a successful play is not much, despite the likeable protagonist.

title: Como agua para chocolate
actors: Lumi Cavazos, Marco Leonardi, Regina Torné
description: Tita, the third and last daughter of a Mexican landowner, cannot marry Pedro because the other two sisters are still unmarried and the youngest child traditionally has to look after her mother for life. Pedro then marries his second child, Rosaura, to stay as close as possible to Tita. After an infinite number of events involving a series of characters, the two will have their moment of love that will be fatal to man and that will make Tita take an extreme decision.
notes: Laura Esquivel wrote the book from which, on her screenplay, the film is based, in a narrative that mixes realism and fantasy. Certainly an interesting work, but also discontinuous, with ingenious solutions and others of more modest effectiveness.

title: Footlight Parade
actors: James Cagney, Joan Blondell
description: A Broadway "producer" is denied funding for musical comedies because now only cinema counts. Then our man is dedicated to the show. But the competitors play a bad joke on him ... Spectacular, brilliant choreography by the great Busby Berkeley and a spirited, hilarious Cagney, surrounded by a crowd of splendid "chorus girls".

title: The Winsflow Boy
actors: Robert Donat, Margaret Leighton, Cedric Hardwicke, Francis L. Sullivan
description: Unjustly accused of a theft, the young Ronnie Winsflow is expelled from the real naval academy. Father Arthur, convinced of the boy's innocence, after having attempted to resume the judgment issued without the possibility of defense, brings the case to court. The result is a process with dramatic implications, with sensational repercussions, but, in the end, justice will be done. Taken from a piece by Terence Rattigan inspired by a news factory, a exemplary historical reconstruction and a refined game of actors. Remake by David Mamet in 1999, with the title "The Winslow case".

title: So Long at the Fair
actors: Jean Simmons, Dirk Bogarde, David Tombison
description: Traveling to Paris with her brother John, Vittoria Barton wakes up in her hotel room, which is n.17, and discovers that n.19, in which her brother slept, no longer exists. After several searches he learns that John had been struck by the plague and that the authorities had transferred him to the hospital and therefore had walled up his room trying to silence the incident.
notes: Beautiful mysterious atmosphere and suggestive scenography for Fisher's first personal direction.

title: The Front
actors: Woody Allen, Zero Mostel, Michael Murphy, Herschel Bernardi
description: A TV screenwriter is banned because of the anti-Communist "witch hunt" sponsored by Senator McCarthy. To keep writing, he asks Howard Prince (Allen), a modest bar cashier, gambler and bookmaker, to act as a figurehead. He becomes rich and famous by proxy, offering himself in the same way to other victims of McCarthyism. Ritt, who at the time was himself a victim of Senator McCarthy's anti-Communist crusade (as well as Zero Mostel and Hershel Bernardi), opts for the tone of bitter comedy in the reconstruction of those years, and the film is laudable if a little discontinuous (and the choice of Allen as the protagonist is not very happy).

title: Predator 2
actors: Danny Glover, Gary Busey, Rubén Blades, Maria Conchita Alonso, Bill Paxton
description: Los Angeles, 1997. In the city it is everyone's war against everyone; one group, in particular, leaves behind quartered corpses, marked with voodoo symbols. The affair is dealt with by Mike Harrigan, a black policeman, who discovers and confronts a group of aliens barricaded in a slaughterhouse.
notes: Between science fiction and horror, an action film that tries to build somewhat improbable gothic atmospheres. Bungled and smashed, with some spectacular moments. Schwarzy, protagonist of the first "Predator" is not here; the hero of the moment is Danny Glover.

title: The Fly II
actors: Eric Stoltz, Daphne Zuniga, Lee Richardson, John Getz
description: Veronica, pregnant with Dr. Brundle (killed by her because he was monstrously transformed), gives birth to a child who at the age of 5 is already a sleepless and very intelligent young man. The billionaire Bartok, with shady ends, puts him to work in a laboratory to complete his father's work. But the love for the beautiful Beth disrupts the evil Bartok's plans. Apocalyptic ending with the release of the prisoner. Clumsy attempt to follow up on Cronenberg's good movie. We are light years away from the results of the first. Here the special effects win, without a shadow of direction.

title: Forced Vengeance
actors: Chuck Norris, Mary Louise Weller, Camilla Griggs, Bob Minor
description: A veteran, fresh from Vietnam, works as a security manager at a Far Eastern gambling house, with all the complications involved. Poor action-movie with American martial arts star Chuck Norris.

title: Hot Millions
actors: Peter Ustinov, Maggie Smith, Bob Newhart, Karl Malden
description: A nice scammer (Peter Ustinov) just released from prison manages to get hired by a financial company and, using its computer, manages to obtain large payments on a network of (fictitious) companies he controls which he then collects quickly with frequent and frenetic do you travel. The wife, unaware of everything, risks compromising the fruitful "tour" ...
notes: Comedy perhaps a little bit of a quibble, but with sensational performers.

title: The Prisoner of Zenda
actors: Stewart Granger, James Mason, Deborah Kerr, Robert Douglas
description: During a vacation in Ruritania, an English citizen helps to eradicate a local political conspiracy by also exploiting his extraordinary resemblance to the country's king. Swashbuckling adventures with broad comic twists. Rich, faithful and pleasant version of the well-known story, almost a remake of John Cromwell's 1937 masterpiece. Bright technicolor and James Mason splendid villain.

title: Go Naked in the World
actors: Gina Lollobrigida, Anthony Franciosa, Ernest Borgnine
description: The young scion of a self-made entrepreneur, not only does not want to follow in his father's footsteps, but he would like to marry a prostitute (Gina Lollobrigida). The parent naturally denies his consent, but when he realizes that he too knows the woman well ... Melodrama in which everything sounds nineteenth-century, from the incredible plot to the decidedly over-the-top acting.

title: Mannequin
actors: Joan Crawford, Spencer Tracy, Alan Curtis, Ralph Morgan, Mary Philips
description: A good girl (Crawford) marries a good for nothing. Tired of keeping him, she divorces, gets a job as a model and marries a tycoon. The ex-husband blackmails her, the new one fails. Solid Hollywood drama with a social background, star Crawford reigning supreme.

title: The Naked Runner
actors: Frank Sinatra, Peter Vaughan, Derren Nesbitt
description: The head of British counterintelligence must eliminate an enemy spy, but cannot act discoverically. Thus elaborates a diabolical plan to transform an innocent businessman into the light killer, so that motive and principal remain completely covered. Scocking spionic thriller, completely ruined by the pretentious direction choices.

title: Act of Violence
actors: Van Heflin, Robert Ryan, Janet Leigh, Mary Astor, Phyllis Thaxter
description: A group of US prisoners preparing to escape from a German camp is discovered and exterminated. After the war, the only survivor finds the man who betrayed him and his companions. A story kept in constant tension, well directed, well interpreted and served by the excellent photography of Robert Surtees.

title: Lost Horizon
actors: Peter Finch, Liv Ullmann, Bobby Van
description: Richard does not know that he is the designated heir of a Great Lama until, fleeing with others from a country ravaged by a revolt, he is kidnapped by a community of Himalayan monks. This remake of Frank Capra's excellent "Lost Horizon" (1937) is a super colorful mess, which gets lost in excessive ranting and tedious songs.

title: Son of the Pink Panther
actors: Roberto Benigni, Claudia Cardinale, Herbert Lom, Debrah Farentino, Burt Kwouk, Graham Stark
description: Jasmine, a Middle Eastern princess, is kidnapped on French soil. For a fortuitous circumstance, the second-class gendarme Jacques Gambrelli is in charge of the "case". Unfortunately, he is none other than the natural son of the "notorious" Inspector Jacques Clouseau, and, like his father, he is a total clumsy. But Clouseau-son will unravel the matter and, moreover, will break through the heart of the woman. Fiasco in the USA and good success in Italy, for a Benigni not at ease in a scheme that does not give him enough freedom to "break". We laugh, but much less than we expect.

title: Salades russes
actors: Agnès Soral, Sergej Dontsov, Victor Mikhailov
description: From the window of an apartment in St. Petersburg, you are wonderfully in the heart of the "City of Lights". What better occasion to start a whole series of clandestine trafficking between poor Russia and opulent France? If you also add the charm of a "sur Seine" embalmer, the game becomes even more stimulating for the Russian professor who has discovered the passage.
notes: The film worked miracles in the former USSR, but, seen by us, it appears more like a rather missed opportunity, with a brilliant starting idea and a result on which predictable solutions and presences that have only the thickness of the specks weigh. .

title: Yin shi nan nu
actors: Sihung Lung, Chien-lien Wu, Yang Kuei-Mei, Yu-Wen Wang
description: Master Chu, recognized as the top chef in Taipei, is retired but does not give up his art. Except that the daughters, for whom he cooks his very refined dishes, now have independent lives and no longer recognize themselves in the unity of the traditional family. Many things change, so many problems arise that take them away from the home. And then Master Chu makes a decision. After the resounding success of "Banchetto di matrimonio", Ang Lee re-proposes the theme of the fracture between generations in a metaphor of the fundamental impulses of existence. Cooking is preparing life, consuming (or not, and not just food) is living.

title: Anni 90. Parte II
actors: Massimo Boldi, Nino Frassica, Christian De Sica, Carol Alt, Francesco Benigno, Nadia Rinaldi, Pippo Baudo
description: A taxi driver from the Milan station loads a mafia boss and ends up in jail with him. Two "VIPs" argue in a bar in Ostia run by a couple of "Novella 2000" fanatics. A country priest pretends to be a porno star in the meritorious intent of finding a lost sheep. A young boy in the mood for erotic adventures meets a rich lady who invites him to BDSM games. A conductor is convinced that he is the victim of a joke. A poor fellow can only pee in the other world. In addition to directing, Enrico Oldoini also signs the screenplay. The film is, therefore, in its own right, the flour of his sack: sheepish comedy and many stars of television extraction for a cinema to which a public with a good mouth decrees success.

title: The Good Son
actors: Macaulay Culkin, Elijah Wood, Wendy Crewson, David Morse
description: Little Mark (Elijah Wood) has to go and stay with his uncles for a couple of weeks where there are two cousins, his peer Henry (Macaulay Culkin) and little sister Connie (Quenn Culkin). Except that Henry is a true genius of evil, capable of terrible atrocities and even with a past already stained with blood. It will be terrible days, a bleak nightmare of ever-increasing anguish. Not bad the idea of ??taking the nice little devil of "Mom, I missed the plane" and turn him into a chilling criminal, but if the script did not make water on all sides it would be much better. More disappointing than anything else.

title: South Central
actors: Byron Keith Minns, Lexie D. Bigham, LaRita Shelby, Christian Coleman
description: Bobby, a member of a neighborhood gang in Los Angeles, gets out of jail after a year and discovers he has a son named Jimmie. The friendship that binds Bobby to Ray Ray, leader of the same gang, leads him to accept the project of a murder. Another capture and, this time, there are ten years in prison. After serving his sentence, Bobby discovers that Jimmie has followed in his footsteps, always under the orders of Ray Ray. Produced by Oliver Stone, the film gives a dramatic portrait of metropolitan violence with a touch of moralism that may appear irritating at first but which sets it apart from many similar products.

title: Double Standard
actors: Robert Foxworth, Michele Greene, Christianne Hirt, James Kee
description: A reputable St. Louis judge takes advantage of his frequent business trips to a nearby town to have an affair with a young secretary. He is married with two children. She is in love and anxious, especially when she discovers she is pregnant. The drama is about to break out and instead nothing breaks out because the judge thinks it is good to run two families simultaneously. Negligible television movies.

title: Betrayal of the Dove
actors: Helen Slater, Billy Zane, Kelly LeBrock, Heather Lind, Harvey Korman
description: Ellie was married, with one daughter. Now, after the divorce, she stayed with the baby. And while she's all busy putting the pieces of her life back together, here comes a charming doctor. Perhaps all is not lost, and perhaps it is possible to forget the past and start a new life. It takes Ellie a while to realize that this is just an illusion.
notes: The cast, if nothing else, is not bad. Billy Zane terrified Kidman in "10 Hours: Calm Down". Helen Slater kidnapped Betty Midler in "Please Kill My Wife". And Kelly LeBrock is the one who showed her legs in the "Lady in Red".

title: House of the Long Shadows
actors: Christopher Lee, Vincent Price, Peter Cushing
description: A publisher is betting $ 20,000 with young writer Kenneth Magee that he won't be able to write a novel in twenty-four hours. To ensure the necessary tranquility, he makes an old abandoned castle available to him. But the castle becomes the seat of horrendous crimes that follow one another in a gruesome way: do not worry it was all a joke of the publisher. Discreet comedy-horror farce starring great old men and based on a short story by Earl Dear Biggers.

title: Born to Be Sold
actors: Lynda Carter, Harold Gould, Dean Stockwell, Philip Sterling
description: A social worker discovers the infamous commerce of children fed by an unscrupulous couple who, managing an institution for mothers, supplies children an equivocal adoption agency. Discreet film for television, not very spectacular, but if nothing else useful to understand the mechanisms of an increasingly rampant social scourge also in our part.

title: ¡Ay, Carmela!
actors: Carmen Maura, Andrés Pajares, Gabino Diego, Maurizio De Razza
description: Carmela, Paulino and Gustavete during the Spanish Civil War organize little shows for the fighters of the International Brigades. Captured by the Francoists, they are ordered to play for the soldiers; Paulino agrees, but in the end it is Carmela who rebels, at the cost of her life. Saura between civil commitment and theatrical passion.

title: Cercasi Gesù
actors: Beppe Grillo, Maria Schneider, Fernando Rey, Nestor Garay
description: A Catholic publishing house is looking for a face that can embody the figure of Jesus in a modern key for the launch of a serial publication. A penniless hitchhiker is chosen and entangled with a terrorist who kidnaps him asking for a ransom from the priests (who in the meantime are exploiting his image). The terrorist is killed by her companions and the priests send Jesus / John to a nursing home. Apologue directed by Luigi Comencini on the exploitation of the figure of Christ.

title: A Man Called Sledge
actors: James Garner, Laura Antonelli, Fausto Tozzi, Didi Perego
description: An adventurer, Sledge, on whose head hangs a large bounty, arranges a strike to get hold of the gold transported to a fortress. He enters the fort by being arrested and manages to get his hands on the gold but, in the shooting between his accomplices, his woman is killed. Spaghetti- western not banal and rather disenchanted.

title: The Commitments
actors: Robert Arkins, Michael Aherne, Andrew Strong, Angeline Ball, Felim Gormley, Johnny Murphy, Ken Mc Cluskey
description: Dublin, Ireland. The young Jimmy Rabbitte has made up his mind to found a group that plays soul music: because soul is the music of blacks and the Irish are the "blacks" of Europe. He begins to contact a series of young musicians and, finally, puts together a band flanked by three choristers. After the first successes, however, the group begins to quarrel (accomplices jealousies and spite) and soon ends up dissolving. Generational and musical cross-section of Irish youth, told with humor and boldness (co-writer is the writer Roddy Doyle from whose novel the film is based). Excellent performers and excellent soundtrack.

title: The Adventures of Bullwhip Griffin
actors: Roddy McDowall, Suzanne Pleshette, Karl Malden
description: The brothers Jack and Arabella Flagg are in serious financial difficulties, as they found themselves with many debts to pay when their grandfather died. Jack decides to leave - despite his twelve years - for San Francisco. Arabella, desperate, sends the faithful butler Griffin (who is secretly in love with her) on the trail of her little brother. Griffin manages to track down Jack, and together with him a map that leads to a gold mine ...
notes: Classic family comedy between the adventurous and the sentimental, built in pure Disney style: a little bit of suspense, the good (feelings) winning over the bad ones, etc. etc.

title: The Last Flight of Noah's Ark
actors: Elliott Gould, Geneviève Bujold, Ricky Schroder, Vincent Gardenia
description: A somewhat foolish aviator, Noah, agrees to transport the young missionary Bernadette with some animals on an old B29 to an island in the Pacific where she is awaited by the local inhabitants. A storm forces them to make a crash landing on another island where they find Japanese veterans. Together with them they build a makeshift boat and leave. They are collected by an American ship. Disney-branded comedy that recycles Elliott Gould and Geneviève Bujold into a story that is as inconsistent as its staging. Syrupy sentimentality and plentiful clichés for the joy (?) Of adults and children without too many pretensions.

title: L'auberge rouge
actors: Fernandel, Françoise Rosay, Marie-Claire Olivia, Caussimon
description: Pierre and Marie Martin run a small hotel in the high mountains. To "supplement" their meager income they get into the habit of killing and robbing their guests and thus making the corpses disappear. When a busker arrives, the usual crime occurs, but the arrival of a carriage prevents the two from disposing of the body. When a friar Marie arrives, he repents and confesses to the religious all his misdeeds ... Intelligent black comedy written by Aurenche and Bost and inspired by a tale by Balzac.

title: Anna
actors: Silvana Mangano, Raf Vallone, Vittorio Gassman, Faby Morlay
description: Anna, a young nun who is a nurse, is seen arriving at the hospital with her ex-boyfriend in serious condition. As the surgeon completes the delicate operation, the woman is reminded of images of her past and her connection with the man. Reflection on the decisions made is inevitable and Anna sometimes finds herself regretting having taken her vows, but for other circumstances her resolution appears to be right. Strong melodrama, it is the first Italian film to gross over a billion.

title: Children of the Damned
actors: Ian Hendry, Alan Badel, Barbara Ferris, Bessie Love
description: Six super-intelligent, mind-reading children are found in different parts of the world and brought together for study by Unesco agents. End with explosion in a church in London.
notes: More than a sequel, it is a remake of Wolf Rilla's "Village of the Damned". Also in the cast is Bessie Love, who began as an extra in "Rise of a Nation".

title: 2 + 5 missione Hydra
actors: Anthony Freeman, Roland Lesaffre, Kirk Morris, Leonora Ruffo
description: During an earthquake, a farmer believes he sees a spacecraft disappear into the hills of an uninhabited area. Immediately rushed to the place, the man realizes that the surrounding land dries up in an inexplicable way. The institute of geology sends the scientist Solmi on the spot to investigate the strange matter: the scholar is kidnapped, however, by three extraterrestrials who transport him to the planet Hydra ...
notes: The title of the film is suggestive, but the rest is quite demoralizing. There is a glorious season of Italian science-fiction, but this effort by Francisci is a rather modest example.

title: The Red Pony
actors: Myrna Loy, Robert Mitchum, Peter Miles
description: Little Tom had a pony as a gift, but the horse falls ill and dies, throwing Tom into despair. Good children's film written by John Steinbeck.

title: The Sister-in-Law
actors: John Savage, W. G. McMillan, Anne Saxon, Meredith Baer
description: John Savage puts himself in the shoes of the fool who is set up by his brother and sister-in-law in a drug ring. Soundtrack by Savage himself.

title: Untamed Heart
actors: Christian Slater, Marisa Tomei, Rosie Perez, Kyle Secor
description: The new assistant cook (Christian Slater) from the Minneapolis bar where Caroline and Cindy work is handsome and dark. His name is Adam and he doesn't talk to anyone. Unlike Caroline, who is outgoing and dynamic. One evening, returning home, the girl risks assault and rape, but good Adam rushes to her aid. The relationship between the two thaws and he finds a way to confess his secrets.
notes: Almost unbearable romantic-dramatic comedy were it not for the presence of the three leading actors: Slater in the period prior to "Interview with the vampire", Tomei at the same time as "My cousin Vincenzo" and Perez irresistible, as always.

title: Blanche Fury
actors: Stewart Granger, Valerie Hobson, Walter Fitzgerald, Michael Gough
description: The young Blanche proposes herself to her very wealthy uncle as the guardian of her young cousin. In reality what he wants is the conspicuous inheritance and his plots do not stop at nothing: he ensnares a young administrator, pushes him to kill family members one by one, then denounces him and has him sentenced to death. Nice gothic melodrama directed by Marc Allégret on an away trip to England.

title: Via Margutta
actors: Antonella Lualdi, Gérard Blain, Yvonne Furneaux, Claudio Gora, Franco Fabrizi
description: Several episodes set in the famous Roman road: there is the creative artist, the self-styled talented painter, but who also has her self-portrait painted by another, the failed actress who is a voice actress, and so on. The relationships between the characters explode in a final banquet, at which they are all present. The old Camerini remains faithful to comedy, but the updating of themes and situations is only partially successful.

title: Love With the Proper Stranger
actors: Natalie Wood, Steve McQueen
description: Rocky got Angela, an Italian-American with three brothers assigned to defend her honor, pregnant. Angela seeks an abortion, but then thinks about it; Rocky fell in love with her and he can prove it to her. Urban sentimental drama with an excellent couple of actors, directed by a quiet specialist.

title: Irresistible Force
actors: Harris Stone, Cynthia Rothrock, Paul Winfield
description: An elderly police detective has to fear for his life and decides to defend himself by taking on a young recruit in martial arts as a work partner. The baptism of fire is very hard: a group of terrorists occupied a large shopping center on the day of its inauguration. Among the hostages captured there are the police chief and big personalities of the place ...
notes: As can be deduced from this brief summary, it is not that the film imposes itself due to originality of content. On the other hand, this is not a quality that Cynthia Rothrock fans have the air of attributing great importance.

title: The World, the Flesh and the Devil
actors: Harry Belafonte, Inger Stevens, Mel Ferrer
description: A "colored" believes he is the only survivor of an atomic destruction. Instead he meets a woman and another man, white and sick. Pregnant images of desolation, a message a little too "exposed".

title: Il vedovo allegro
actors: Carlo Dapporto, Isa Barzizza, Amedeo Nazzari
description: Bebè, a penniless magazine actor, tries to find the money necessary to have his beloved daughter treated by blackmailing his partner. Denounced, a sympathetic police commissioner will save him. The film is saved only for Dapporto in a semidrammatic role. The rest is to be forgotten.

title: Attack!
actors: Jack Palance, Lee Marvin, Eddie Albert, Robert Strauss
description: An American army company engaged on the French front against the Germans is decimated due to the cowardice of its commander, Captain Cooney. One of the survivors will kill him. One of the most beautiful war films in the history of cinema: realistic and raw in its bare simplicity. Of course, it is not an anti-war film but "against those who hurt it"; but Aldrich's paroxysmal style is of an absolute modernity, and the fury with which Palance is followed is almost Coppolian.

title: Kansas
actors: Matt Dillon, Andrew McCarthy, Leslie Hope, Alan Toy
description: It can happen that you are wanted by the newspapers for an act of heroism and at the same time by the police for a bank robbery. It happens to Wade Corey who, on his way to New York, meets Doyle and naively gets involved in a robbery. In the next escape he takes refuge under a bridge, just in time to save the governor's daughter from drowning. Wade is a good guy, but he'll have to hide. Dillon always plays James Dean's heir. Mediocre, confusing and unoriginal script by director Stevens, for a film that adds nothing to the "on the road" mythology.

title: The Indian Runner
actors: David Morse, Viggo Mortensen, Charles Bronson, Sandy Dennis, Valeria Golino, Dennis Hopper
description: Joe Roberts is a cop from Plattsmouth, Nebraska, happily married to a Mexican girl. Work gives him less happiness as he was forced to kill a man in self-defense. There has been no news of his brother Frank since he went to Vietnam. Then Frank comes back and doesn't seem too happy either. When Frank kills a bartender, Joe will have to arrest him. Fortunately the film is dubbed and therefore you will not have to listen to Golino mistreating the English language. But this is also the only flaw in this Sean Penn's debut work. Hopper is the wise bartender. And the Bronson / Dennis duet is almost tearful.

title: And God Created Woman
actors: Rebecca De Mornay, Vincent Spano, Frank Langella, Donovan Leitch
description: Robin (De Mornay) escaped from the reform school, but the escape did not last long. The safest way would be to get married and thus obtain parole. Billy, the juvenile plumber, falls for it, but the marriage starts badly. Robin becomes the lover of a local politician and in her spare time the singer in a band. He just doesn't have time for poor Billy. But hadn't we already seen this movie? Hadn't it already come out with the same French title ("Piace a too many" in the Italian version), directed by that less talented director named Roger Vadim? And the protagonist (with all due respect to De Mornay who is good and pretty) wasn't Brigitte Bardot?

title: Akira
description: A group of young people from the late twentieth century, the result of a failed scientific experiment, rebels. Not really a family movie.

title: Tetsuo
actors: Tomorowo Taguchi, Kei Fujiwara, Nobu Kanaoka, Renji Ishibashi
description: Shaving an ordinary man discovers that his body is transforming. In a short time it gradually becomes a hodgepodge of flesh and metal. Great metal and carnal delirium. Tsukamoto is a talent.

title: The Honey Pot
actors: Rex Harrison, Cliff Robertson, Susan Hayward, Capucine, Maggie Smith, Adolfo Celi
description: After seeing the "Volpone" at the theater, the American billionaire Cecil Fox (Harrison) summons the three women of his life to his Venetian palace and tells them he is on the verge of death. Thus arrive Merle McGill, movie star, Princess Dominique (Capucine) and Mrs. Sheridan (Hayward) with a nurse in tow (Smith). The problem is that he doesn't have any more money. Inspired by Ben Johnson's "Volpone", a film that mixes life and entertainment with irony and wickedness. Rex Harrison has a perfect part and Joseph L. Mankiewicz (also author of the script) directs with geometric refinement.

title: The Stratton Story
actors: James Stewart, June Allyson, Frank Morgan, Agnes Moorehead
description: A passionate amateur manages to become a baseball star but has to have his leg amputated. Face the trauma assisted by family affections and an iron will. Predictable sports-sentimental drama, but made with professionalism.

title: Old Acquaintance
actors: Bette Davis, Miriam Hopkins, Gig Young, Philip Reed
description: A writer is in love with her closest friend's husband and is reciprocated by him. In the name of friendship, however, he renounces his feeling. Then, after years of solitude, she falls in love with the boyfriend of the same friend's daughter. Here too the man matches her, but she gives up again.
notes: Magnificent Bette Davis and Miriam Hopkins in a film full of bitter complicity.

title: Abuna Messias
actors: Camillo Pilotto, Mario Ferrari, Enrico Glori, Corrado Racca
description: End of the 19th century: Cardinal Guglielmo Massaia leaves the Italian comforts to evangelize Abyssinia, where he has the support of the sovereign Menelik. But Abuna Atanasio, spiritual guide of the Coptic church, sets the Emperor Johannes against him and Massaia, to avoid a war, leaves Africa.
notes: Made in the midst of the fascist era, under the guise of a Catholic hagiography, Alessandrini's film - awarded in Venice in 1940 - clearly reveals its propaganda intentions towards regime colonialism. In any case, from a strictly cinematographic point of view, it denotes an uncommon productive effort for the time.

title: Get Carter
actors: Michael Caine, John Osborne, Britt Ekland, Ian Hendry, Tony Beckley
description: A crime professional, Jack, flies from London to Newcastle to take revenge on the gangsters who killed his brother.
notes: Very hard and well thought out, a cocktail of sex and death that echoes Chandlerian atmospheres. Excellent interpretation of Michael Caine, at ease in the part of Jack. Britt Ekland is no exception.

title: Le parfum d'Yvonne
actors: Jean-Pierre Marielle, Hippolyte Girardot, Sandra Majani, Richard Bohringer
description: Summer 1958. Victor Chamara, blue blood and no money, meets Yvonne Jacquest, with ambitions as an actress. The elderly homosexual René Meinthe always gravitates around her and warns Victor about the girl's character. In fact Yvonne leaves him for a ski champion playboy. A few years later, Victor returns to the places of his passion, and will witness René's spectacular suicide. From the novel by Patrick Modiano "Villa triste", the director and screenwriter Patrice Leconte attempts an operation of subtle recreation of a time and an atmosphere. But the operation fails and the film turns into a presumptuous exercise in style.

title: Aiqing wansui
actors: Chen Chao-jung, Yang Kuewei, Lee Kang-sheng, Yang Kuei-Mei
description: Taipei, 1990s. The girl May works for a real estate agency; the young Hsiao-kang sells funeral urns; the third, Ah-jung, sells feminine clothes. Hsiao "occupies" an empty apartment among those treated by May, and tries to commit suicide. Here the girl takes Ah-jung for a night, then the two males share the house, with Ah-jung who is attracted to her partner.
notes: A bitterly sarcastic title for a film about a city without a soul, about the desolation of relationships, about loneliness; with a final sequence that is a real "challenge" to the viewer. More than a plot, the description of the void, from the inside.

title: Angie
actors: Geena Davis, James Gandolfini, Stephen Rea, Philip Bosco
description: Angie Scacciapensieri lives in Brooklyn and is engaged to the plumber Vinnie the day after tomorrow. When she becomes pregnant, she prepares for marriage for a time; then, instead, she leaves her man and goes with an Irish lawyer. But even with him things are not going well. So, after giving birth to the baby (and it is the most original sequence of the film), Angie sets out in search of her mother who had abandoned her as a child. Based on the novel "Angie, I Sais", by Avra ??Wing, the film hangs between comedy and drama without being able to give itself a convincing physiognomy. Excellent Geena Davis, but the whole (apart from the impossible surnames of the Italian Americans) works little.

title: Hsi Yen - The Wedding Banquet
actors: Winston Chao, May Chin, Mitchell Lichtenstein, Sihung Lung, Ah-Leh Gua
description: Wai Tung, a successful real estate agent in Manhattan, lives happily with Simon, but his parents, who live in Taiwan, insist that he find a wife. There is Wei Wei who would be the case, and the marriage (pro forma) is celebrated. But here comes Wai's father and mother in New York: there will be a sumptuous ceremony in the Chinese style followed by many, many complications. And not easy explanations. A first part in a comedy key; a second in which the dramatic element takes over. The clash between different cultures, the weight of traditions, prejudices and stereotypes about gays: a mixture dosed at the right point, through a very skilled storytelling and an enviable pace. Golden Bear in Berlin.

title: Lightning Jack
actors: Paul Hogan, Cuba Gooding jr., Beverly D'Angelo
description: Jack Kane, aka Lightning, is the sole survivor of a famous band of outlaws, the Younger Brothers. After a bank robbery that has earned him a decent amount of money, he finds himself clinging to Ben, a dumb black boy whom he had taken hostage. It will be thanks to him that he will be able to overcome the subsequent adventures in which both will be involved. Despite the presence of the protagonist Paul Hogan, this is not "Crocodile Dundee 3", but a western, a genre that is back in fashion after "Dances with wolves". Hogan is nice, the guy, Cuba Gooding jr., Too, but the movie doesn't have much to say. And he says it so-so.

title: Robin Hood: Men in Tights
actors: Cary Elwes, Amy Yasbeck, Roger Rees, Patrick Stewart, Richard Lewis
description: Taken prisoner in the crusade to the Holy Land, Robin of Loxley escapes with the dark sneeze and returns to England by swimming. Here Prince John Without Land and the Sheriff of Ruttingham, with the complicity of the witch Latrina, perform brutality in series, but Robin, together with some cheerful companions, will arrange everything for the best.
notes: Mel Brooks, after having "revisited" other film genres in his own way, shoots zero on the "genre" Robin Hood, with his admittedly heavy comedy. But this time it doesn't hit the mark.

title: Police Women
actors: Sandra Currie, Tony Young, Phil Hoover, Elizabeth Stuart
description: A female police officer unleashes panic in a female gold trafficking gang. Violence and female shootings for a banal cop-movie.

title: Sgarro alla camorra
actors: Mario Merola, Franco Acampora, Enzo Cannavale, Pietro De Vico
description: Andrea Staiano, although innocent, was in jail. He is now on the loose, but his life as a fisherman is full of pitfalls. Neapolitan drama badly converted to cinema.

title: Island of Terror
actors: Peter Cushing, Edward Judd, Carole Gray, Sam Kidd, Eddie Byrne
description: On an Irish island, Dr. Philippe, a scientist, is engaged in top-secret laboratory research against cancer. On the beach of the island, however, some dead are found whose corpses seem to have been sucked up from inside. The culprits are mysterious animals, mutant parasites following the experiments of the doctor. Philippe. "Lateral" horror in Fisher's production, with a distressing suspense and a notable underlying gloom.

title: Four for Texas
actors: Frank Sinatra, Dean Martin, Anita Ekberg, Ursula Andress
description: Joe and Zack are two adventurers who fortunately came into possession of the sum of one hundred thousand dollars. Joe wants to install a gambling house on a boat. Zack deals with a shady banker to make his life difficult, but when the banker manifests his true purposes, Joe and Zack team up and manage to knock him out, thus cementing their friendship. Stellar cast (both in the couple of protagonists and in the two side bellone) for Aldrich who gives us a western not without irony. If the film never takes itself seriously and fails to reach the scatentao rhythm it set itself, there are still some enjoyable moments.

title: Detective
actors: Frank Sinatra, Lee Remick, Ralph Meeker, Tony Musante
description: Sergeant Leland brilliantly solves a murder case: the killer, a young homosexual, ends up in the electric chair. Promoted to lieutenant, he investigates the suicide of a certain McIver, but here the problems begin. First someone tries to bribe him to make him desist, then he suffers an attack. But Leland doesn't let himself be intimidated. He thus discovers a major round of corruption and building speculation, but above all that the man he had sent to the electric chair was innocent. Sinatra plays the role of the incorruptible policeman who fights against Evil and corruption in this tense police drama well scripted, and excellently photographed by the great Joseph Biroc.

title: Rob Roy, the Highland Rogue
actors: Richard Todd, Glynis Johns, James Robertson Justice
description: In 1715 the Scottish chieftain Rob Roy MacGregor fought the British for the independence of the Highlands. Despite the wrongs suffered, he does not hesitate to submit to the crown to speed up the pacification process. Good film of adventures and landscapes. Recently remade with Liam Neeson and Jessica Lange.

title: Il bivio
actors: Raf Vallone, Charles Vanel, Saro Urzì, Saro Arcidiacono, Pierangelo Attino
description: A deputy commissioner of police is, in fact, the leader of a gang of robbers to whom he provides the "tips" for the shots. Led by such a leader, the criminals strike a perfect blow that leads to the indictment of three policemen, held responsible. A few days later the wife of one of the agents is found dead. The deputy commissioner understands that it is a crime committed by a man of his gang. He thus falls into a moral crisis that leads him to ...
notes: Interesting Italian noir, sober and dry, which makes use of the interpretation of some beautiful names of the cinema of the time. When there was still no white Uno gang. To be rediscovered.

title: Vincent et moi
actors: Nina Petronzio, Christopher Forrest, Tchéky Karyo
description: The drawing of a very passionate girl by Van Gogh is mistaken for an original by the master. More or less fantastic adventures back and forth in time.

title: Young Guns II
actors: Emilio Estevez, Kiefer Sutherland, Lou Diamond Phillips, James Coburn, Christian Slater
description: 1950, New Mexico desert: a law firm reporter runs into a very old man who claims to be Billy the Kid, the boy everyone believes was killed by Pat Garrett years ago. To convince him, the octogenarian begins to tell his story: the conflict with Governor Lee Wallace, the clash with the landowner John Chisum, and so on ...
notes: Modest sequel to _Young Guns_ (which was not already essential), designed and created to grab a young audience. After all, a certain Sam Peckinpah had already told us something about the story of Billy the Kid. Definitely, of course.

title: Ethan Frome
actors: Liam Neeson, Patricia Arquette, Joan Allen, Tate Donovan, Katherine Houghton
description: Reverend Smith, who has just arrived in a small town in Massachusetts, is interested in the story of Ethan Frome, an elderly and ill-equipped man whom he has hired as a helper. Intrigued, he gets a local woman to tell his story. Ethan, married to a shrewish and bossy woman, had fallen in love with her cousin many years earlier, but their relationship had had tragic consequences. Adapted the same year as the "Age of Innocence" from another short story by Edith Wharton, sadly "Ethan Frome" does not reach the same levels as Scorsesian film. It remains a decent transposition well played by Neeson and Arquette.

title: Le ciel de Paris
actors: Sandrine Bonnaire, Marc Fourastier, Paul Blain, Eveline Bouix
description: Suzanne, who has found a job in Paris, shares an apartment with Marc, a young homosexual. In their free moments, the two go to a swimming pool where they meet Lucien. The boy feels attracted to Suzanne and falls in love with her. But unfortunately for him, Marc has also set his sights on him. However, Marc also feels attracted and rejected by Lucien.
notes: First and unfortunately also last work by Michel Bena, who died of AIDS before the film was released (fate similar to that of Cyril Collard). Excellent interpreters and beautiful opening titles. The former editor of the "Cahiers du cinema", Pascal Bonitzer has a small role.

title: The Pack
actors: Joe Don Baker, Hope Alexander Willis, Richard B.Shull
description: On the Isle of Seals the mangled bodies of a horse, an old man and his dog are found. Jerry Preston, who runs a marine biological station there, discovers that the dogs abandoned by tourists have gradually gathered in a ferocious and hungry pack. After more raids by the wild animals, Jerry finally manages to free the island from the threat with a ploy. Ecological horror with a rather banal story. The realization is without particular flashes.

title: Prom Night III: The Last Kiss
actors: Tim Conlon, Cyndy Preston, David Stratton
description: Already a prom queen, dead, she returns to her college mates and, for love, kills repeatedly. A very obvious horror that, here and there, fades into noir comedy without being able to save itself.

title: The Intruder Within
actors: Chad Everett, Joseph Bottoms, Jennifer Warren
description: The occupants of an isolated oil rig are threatened by a fearsome primitive creature that has risen from the mysterious abyssal depths. It is a decent television production suitable for those who love to tremble, but in moderation.

title: The Haunting
actors: Richard Johnson, Claire Bloom, Russ Tamblyn, Lois Maxwell
description: Unexplained paranormal phenomena occur in a long-uninhabited villa. The locals are terrified and an expert on the matter is recruited: Dr. Markway. To better study the phenomena, he settles in the house in the company of three women, two of whom are mediums.
notes: In his long career Robert Wise has done better. Despite the delays, however, this film will not completely disappoint horror fans.

title: American Flyers
actors: Kevin Costner, David Grant, Rae Dawn Chong, Alexandra Paul
description: After the death of his father from an aneurysm, Marcus Sommers, a doctor, goes to Wisconsin to work in a sports clinic. His brother David stays in St. Louis and dedicates himself to cycling, a passion shared by Marcus too, but he fears he has inherited his paternal predisposition to evil and suspects that his brother will hide it from him.
notes: The construction of the film is ambitious but Badham ("Saturday Night Fever") ends up dispersing into personal dramas, losing sight of the action and rhythm. Kevin Costner shoots "Fandango" in the same year, which will launch him among the stars.

title: Rage
actors: Glenn Ford, Stella Stevens, David Reynoso
description: The doctor of a village in Mexico, tormented by a strong sense of guilt, is bitten by an angry dog. There is little time to run in the city and get the vaccine inoculate, but it must face an urgency. The doctor undertakes in a delicate surgical operation to save a life: at the risk of his own.
notes: Not bad suspense, Ford's interpretation is good.

title: Un coeur en hiver
actors: Daniel Auteuil, Emmanuelle Béart, André Dussollier
description: Stephan and Maxime, after attending the conservatory together, are now business partners. Camille, a talented young violinist, joins their lives and is linked to Maxime. But the cold, skeptical Stephan feels the irresistible urge to take the woman away from his friend, as if to demonstrate the impossibility of love. And he himself finds himself entangled in the "game" of feelings ...
notes: An exemplary analysis of existential malaise in a film with excellent narrative balance, a perfect symbiosis between images and music (by Ravel) and a masterful interpretation, remotely inspired by a story by Michail Lermontov.

title: Il postino
actors: Massimo Troisi, Philippe Noiret, Maria Grazia Cucinotta
description: Mario, a postman from a small island in southern Italy where the exiled Chilean poet Pablo Neruda comes to live, establishes a friendship with him that initiates him into the fascinating secrets of poetry. Thanks also to this, Mario manages to marry Beatrice, then Neruda leaves and seems to forget his Italian friend. Who will be "beaten" to death during a political rally and will leave a son named Pablito.
notes: Reworked in the chronology and setting of Skàrmeta's novel "The Postman of Neruda", the film contains some platitudes and excellent moments (mainly thanks to Troisi, who died as soon as shooting was finished). A touching farewell from the actor. The film was in the running for five Oscars; he only got the one for the music.

title: Vanya on 42nd Street
actors: Wallace Shawn, George Gaynes, Julianne Moore, Brooke Smith
description: The rehearsals, in a dilapidated New York theater, of a company that is staging "Zio Vanya" in a modern version, directed by André Gregory. Professor Serebryakov's family is reunited on his country estate. From small daily events to a growing tension: ancient grudges never subsided come to light, tragedy is touched upon. Then everything subsides, between serenity and resignation.
notes: Louis Malle's latest film (who died on November 23, 1995) is a delightful fusion between the reality of the actors, the recitation of Chekhov's text (adapted by David Mamet) and the intervention of the camera, in a masterful "game. of the parties ".

title: Big Girls Don't Cry... They Get Even
actors: Hillary Wolf, David Strathairn, Margaret Whitton, Griffin Dunne
description: Young Laura (Wolf) lives with mom Melinda, stepfather Keith (Strathairn) and three half-brothers. His father (Griffin Dunne) is no longer with his second wife, but with a new girlfriend, who is also pregnant. With a family like this it's easy for Laura to have some problems. Although his biggest concern at the moment is not going on vacation with others to Hawaii.
notes: The family in the film appears to come straight from a sitcom. Better then the real sitcoms.

title: Avalanche
actors: Michael Gross, Deanna Milligan, Myles Ferguson, David Hasselhoff
description: After a diamond theft, during which he was forced to kill, a man jumps on a plane and goes to glide in the middle of the Canadian mountains right near a shelter where a writer and his two children are on vacation. The impact is disastrous to the point of causing an avalanche. The writer, the two boys and the killer find themselves cut off from the world. The Canadian mountains and Alar Kivilo's excellent photography would already be enough to save this TV movie from mediocrity. To these must be added the script by Tim Redman which, if it does not shine for originality, still holds up to the end.

title: Un certo giorno
actors: Brunetto Del Vita, Lidia Fuortes, Vitaliano Damioli
description: A group of advertising creatives is engaged in a major campaign to launch a new product. Among all, one in particular stands out for his zeal and passion: a rampant young man, married and with a lover. The deal represents his golden opportunity for a career breakthrough and he does not intend to let it slip away. But one day he runs over a pedestrian and kills him. The accident creates a lot of legal headaches for him, but, above all, it upsets him on a moral level and makes him question his whole life, so much so as to induce him to radically change his morals.
notes: Interesting meditation by Ermanno Olmi on the meaning of life and family.

title: Fun and Fancy Free
directors: Jack Kinney, Hamilton Luske, William Morgan
description: Little teddy bear Bongo leaves the circus, where he performed as an acrobat, and ventures into the woods. Here he meets the teddy bear Lulubelle: the two fall in love but, due to a misunderstanding, Bongo believes that Lulubelle is in love with the giant bear. Bongo challenges him to a duel and beats him. A classic cartoon of the endless Disney production, not one of the lucky ones.

title: Libera
actors: Iaia Forte, Ninni Bruschetta, Enzo Moscato
description: Three episodes. In the first Aurora lives in a luxurious apartment. Among some workers called into the house she recognizes an old lover, who returns to court her, but then empties her house. In the second, a boy who has come out of reform school discovers that his mother is actually his father: a transvestite. In the third, a newsagent, suspecting that her husband, who always gives himself sick, is cheating on her, places a camera in her room. Thus he records his embraces on a videotape that he will sell at newsstands. On his directorial debut Corsicato shows an acid and poetic talent (he was Almodovar's assistant) in drawing three portraits of women that are as many portraits of his city, Naples.

title: Alice in Wonderland
directors: Clyde Geronimi, Wilfred Jackson, Hamilton Luske
description: Little Alice falls asleep while listening to a fairy tale and starts dreaming. He chases a rabbit into the hollow of a tree and ends up in Wonderland. The country is populated by a series of strange and fascinating beings: the White Rabbit, the Cheshire Cat and the Queen of Hearts. Alice drinks strange potions that make her shrink or enlarge but, at some point, she has to flee because the Queen has sentenced her to death.
notes: From the famous tale of Lewis Carroll, Disney derives one of his strangest works, accentuating the already high eccentricity of the original work. Accurate as always the design of the characters and environments.

title: La terra trema
actors: Antonio Arcidiacono, Maria Micale, Sebastiano Valastro
description: The fisherman 'Ntoni Valastro and his family live and work in Aci Trezza, exploited, despite their profound misery, by wholesale fish traders. Tired of suffering the abuses of wholesalers, 'Ntoni incites the other fishermen to rebel against the oppressive situation which has now become intolerable. Colleagues, convinced by 'Ntoni's proposal, cause riots to break out. Determined to go out on his own, 'Ntoni mortgages the house and buys a boat of his own. From "I Malavoglia" by Verga, Visconti draws a film that borders on the documentary (the actors are real fishermen who speak in dialect) and accentuates the "political" tones of the story, divided between realism and contemplative pessimism, leading neorealism to refined aestheticism.

title: The Agony and the Ecstasy
actors: Charlton Heston, Rex Harrison, Tomas Milian, Harry Andrews
description: Michelangelo (Heston) was already an accomplished sculptor when he was commissioned by Pope Julius II to fresco the Sistine Chapel. Amidst artistic torments and personal quarrels with the rough client, Michelangelo destroys his paintings, falls ill, falls from the scaffolding. He is about to abandon the undertaking, but in extremis comes the reconciliation with the pope and with his own pictorial genius. Spectacular pseudo-historical work, even if overflowing with kitch banalities and exasperating slowness.

title: Dark Places
actors: Christopher Lee, Joan Collins
description: Edward Foster inherits a house and the £ 210,000 mirage hidden behind a wall from the late Edward Marr. Along with these, he also inherits the devious attentions of the lawyer Prescott and the unscrupulous Sarah Mandeville, attracted by money, as well as the nightmares that haunted Marr. Non-original thriller, but with some thrills.

title: La valigia dei sogni
actors: Umberto Melnati, Maria Pia Casilio, Roberto Risso, Pietro De Vico
description: The knight Omeri was a silent film actor: now he is satisfied, after having collected some films of the time, to go around the squares showing clips of that cinema. However, a fire destroys all the material but, thanks to the help of a producer, Omeri will have the means to create a cinema museum.
notes: A tribute to silent cinema shot with the sober and sentimental style typical of the director. Created to finance the Cineteca Italiana in Milan, it is basically a collection of clips, even rare ones, of Italian silent cinema.

title: La guerre est finie
actors: Yves Montand, Ingrid Thulin, Michel Piccoli, Geneviève Bujold
description: Diego Mora, who for twenty-five years has lived in exile in Paris following Franco's victory in Spain, is sent back to his homeland with the task of directing an anti-regime trade union action. At the border, however, an accident occurs and Mora is forced to return to Paris to prevent a comrade from getting into trouble. But, once he returns, the organization of the exiles puts him under accusation. Mora goes into crisis and the meeting with some young people with terrorist intentions sharpens her doubts. The exhibition complexity of Resnais is the narrative tool for a film (written by Jorge Semprun) of strong civil tension in the analysis of a political-existential crisis. Excellent interpreters.

title: Funny Lady
actors: Barbra Streisand, James Caan, Omar Sharif, Roddy McDowall
description: Fanny Brice, the musical's established star, has divorced a husband she still loves and, due to lack of Broadway shows, takes part in the show in a nightclub, of which she also marries the owner, Billy Rose. But the professional paths of the two do not run parallel and when Fanny, after a chance meeting with her ex-husband, reunites with Billy, he has fallen in love with another actress. It is the sequel to "Funny Girl" (William Wyler, 1968) about the life of the famous Fanny Brice, but the first is not worth it. Not very faithful both as a story and as a reconstruction of the environment, the film is saved more than anything else by the richness of the realization.

title: Top Secret!
directors: Jim Abrahams, David Zucker, Jerry Zucker
actors: Val Kilmer, Lucy Gutteridge, Omar Sharif, Jeremy Kemp
description: An American rock musician, Nick Rivers, is invited for a tour in East Germany. Here he casually meets Professor Flammond's daughter, Hillary, who, with members of the French Resistance, tries to free her father locked up by the Germans in a castle. Nick gets involved in a spy intrigue full of twists, double crosses and betrayals.
notes: It is a wild parody (typical genre of the three directors) of spy films. Surreal gags (the duel in the underwater saloon) and fulminated jokes follow one another in a frenzied whirlwind of gimmicks (the singing horse), linguistic games and brilliant satirical touches.

title: The Keys of the Kingdom
actors: Gregory Peck, Thomas Mitchell, Vincent Price, Rose Stradner, Edmund Gwenn
description: Francis, orphaned as a boy, is raised by an aunt who dreams of an ecclesiastical career for him and then sends him to the seminary. After completing his studies, the boy hesitates to take the grades because in the meantime he has fallen in love with a girl. The sudden death of the latter takes away any uncertainty about the future. Francis gets sent as a missionary to China. His attempts are successful but the outbreak of the civil war ruins everything.
notes: From a short story by A. J. Cronin, an edifying film of high professionalism, but rather boring and dated.

title: Vanina Vanini
actors: Sandra Milo, Laurent Terzieff
description: In Rome in 1823 a Roman princess falls in love with a young Carbonaro and in order to keep her beloved by her side, she denounces his companions. Discovering the betrayal, the young man surrenders himself to the police and is executed. From a story by Stendhal, Rossellini, on the eve of his second and television season, draws a delicate film on human relationships and power.

title: Los olvidados
actors: Miguel Inclán, Estela Inda, Alfonso Mejia, Roberto Cobo, Alma Delia Fuentes
description: In Mexico City, Jaibo is the leader of a gang of young thugs fresh out of reform school. Pedro is a hooligan like him, but with some desire for redemption. It is the most famous film of Buñuel's Mexican period, Palme d'Or at Cannes and the ideal model for every film on violated childhood and every third world director. There is not a single pathetic scene, there is not a single naturalist failure. Buñuel is still the old, cruel surrealist of yesteryear, one of the most lucid diagnostic of the evils of society that cinema has ever had. Still shocking today. Masterful photography by Gabriel Figueroa, whose aestheticisms are tempered by Buñuel only to be unleashed in sequences like that of Paco's dream.

title: The Deadly Companions
actors: Brian Keith, Maureen O'Hara, Steve Cochran, Chill Wills, Strother Martin
description: An army sergeant, a Southern deserter, an outlaw gunslinger and a saloon singer team up to rob a bank. Peckinpah's beautiful cinematic debut, already marked by an original distortion of the epic canons of the western.

title: Logan's Run
actors: Michael York, Richard Jordan, Jenny Agutter, Peter Ustinov
description: After a planetary catastrophe, a human society has been reconstituted underground where, upon reaching the age of thirty, individuals are "regenerated" (ie suppressed) with a triumphal ceremony. Dissidents suspect deception. Two of them, Logan and Jessica, manage to reach the surface.
notes: After a good start, unfortunately the film falls into schematism and predictability.

title: Satan's Cheerleaders
actors: Kerry Shermann, John Ireland, Yvonne De Carlo
description: A group of cheerleaders fall into the coils of a satanic cult. To get out of trouble, they have to draw on all their wits. A few good strokes of humor and the contribution of some old glories of cinema are all that is saved in the general flatness of the film.

title: Bad Day at Black Rock
actors: Spencer Tracy, Robert Ryan, Ernest Borgnine, Walter Brennan
description: An elderly, one-armed man (Tracy) arrives in a small town in the southwestern United States. He is looking for a farm owner, a Japanese naturalized American, to present him with a gold medal in memory of his son who saved his life during the war.
notes: Even without an arm (indeed for this reason) Tracy is always great.

title: Nostra Signora dei Turchi
actors: Carmelo Bene, Lydia Mancinelli, Salvatore Siniscalchi, Anita Masini
description: At the base of it all is the memory of a massacre carried out by the Turks in Otranto. A memory obviously not personal, but almost genetic, given that the protagonist is an intellectual of our days. His visions include childhood memories, imaginary conversations and the presence of a woman named Margherita (Lydia Mancinelli), who announces herself in the guise of Santa Maria d'Otranto. Some time has passed and in the meantime Bene has stopped making films for a while. It is very easy to hate him and even consider him outdated, but his five films are the most vital, original and interesting Italian cinema has ever managed to produce.

title: The Nutcracker Prince
description: Clara, an eleven year old girl, lives a dream in which she is transported to the magical world of the Nutcracker Prince.
notes: From the homonymous fairy tale by E.T.A. Hoffman, set to music by Tchaikovski, a modest and not very original cartoon film.

title: Cristo si è fermato a Eboli
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, Paolo Bonacelli, Alain Cuny, Lea Massari
description: The Turin doctor and painter Carlo Levi is sent to confinement by the fascist dictatorship. His destination is a small Lucanian town where he will veer between the desolation of the landscape and the people. Back in Turin, he will write a novel about his experience. From the autobiographical novel by Carlo Levi, a film that delves deeply into the human soul and into that of a nation adrift. Even without reaching the extraordinary dryness of Levi's book, Rosi made a decent television film (released in theaters in a reduced version) also making use of an extraordinary Volonté.

title: Beethoven 2nd
actors: Charles Grodin, Bonnie Hunt, Nicholle Tom, Christopher Castile, Chris Penn
description: The Sanbernardo of the Newton family, already protagonist of the previous film, has found the "soul mate" who gave him a litter of wild dogs. But among the Newtons there are disagreements and those who pay for it are the quadrupeds, with female and heirs kidnapped (to be sold), which the puppies Newton (the bipeds) do not like at all. After daring adventures seasoned with humorous gags and paradoxical situations, the "good guys" (of both races) will win it. More sluggish than the first episode. Wonderful dogs.

title: A Perfect World
actors: Kevin Costner, Clint Eastwood, T. J. Lowther, Laura Dern, Keith Szarabajka, Leo Burmester, Paul Hewitt, Bradley Whitford, Ray McKinnon, Jennifer Griffin, Leslie Flowers, Belinda Flowers, Darryl Cox
description: We are near Dallas, in November 1963. Butch Haynes escapes from prison with a violent partner who ends up having to kill. Circumstances "force" him to take little Philip hostage. While a friendly relationship is established between the man and the child, the fugitive hunt is led by ranger Red Garnett, an honest man, which cannot be said of all those who collaborate with him. In this "perfect world" a president can be assassinated and a manhunt can result in legalized murder. Clint Eastwood bitter, lucid and effective narrator of an America suffering from violence.

title: Mrs. Doubtfire
actors: Robin Williams, Sally Field, Pierce Brosnan, Harvey Fierstein
description: Daniel Hillard, wife and two children, is a film voice actor with a slightly too whimsical temperament. When, having divorced, the children he adores are taken away from him, he becomes a handyman maid and gets hired in what used to be his home. All sorts of things happen, but then the matter gets better, with the reassembly of the family in rediscovered harmony.
notes: That Robin Williams is a monster of skill, capable of launching into very risky interpretations, is well known. Here he takes on the weight of the whole film, far beyond the merits of a screenplay that is more smoke than roast, and knows how to come out of it as a triumph.

title: Natale con papà
actors: Gabriele Ferzetti, Alessandro Sacco, Floy, Michael Roll
description: They are all musicians: grandfather Vittorio; the father, Riccardo, widower, who undergoes an audition in Munich as a keyboard player for a pop band; the son, Vittorio junior, who awaits the return of his father from Bavaria. Riccardo is hired for the Christmas concert in Munich and returns to Turin to take his son, who in the meantime, however, has left, with his grandfather, to join his father. Multifaceted (but not really excellent) veteran of cinema, Giorgio Capitani packs an "occasional" story, in the sense that Christmas is talked about and Christmas is shown. That is when, by definition, we are all better, and we wish each other happy birthday.

title: An American Tail: Fievel Goes West
description: The Mousekewitz family finds the city too unsafe and leaves for the far West, enticed by the descriptions of the cat Crudelio who promises a real land of Bengodi. But it's all a mess. In fact, first the journey and then the settlement are studded with a succession of assorted pitfalls. But there is him, Fievel, who with a few, but trusted friends, arranges everything as best he can.
notes: After the "review" of the arrival in the new world of the persecuted of the "progrom", here is that of the conquest of the "new frontier". Spielberg still produces, and it is a guarantee of professionalism.

title: Jour de fête
actors: Jacques Tati, Guy Decomble, Paul Frankeur, Santa Relli
description: The annual festival is held in Sainte Sévère, a small French rural town. Among the various "attractions", there is also that of a traveling cinema and François, the postman, thanks to a few glasses too many, is exalted in front of the prodigies shown by a documentary on the US postal service. So, in his own small way, he tries to emulate his "colleagues" from overseas, with catastrophic results. The color edition of Jacques Tati's first feature film could only be printed in 1994. An authentic gem, an enjoyment of vivid intelligence and great finesse; the gentle and subtle humor of an unforgettable master of comedy.

title: Aventuras de Robinson Crusoe
actors: Dan O'Herlihy, Jaime Fernandez, Felipe de Alba, José Chavez
description: Robinson Crusoe, an English sailor en route to the South Seas, is shipwrecked on a desert island. Years pass and Robinson adapts himself to the solitary life of the island as a castaway. Until, one day, he discovers that the island is also inhabited by a savage, whom he will call Friday.
notes: Buñuel transposes Defoe's novel by inserting ironic and alienating touches (the load of women's underwear, Robinson's gesture of oppression towards Friday prostrate at his feet). A small, clever reading "against the grain".

title: Moon Pilot
actors: Edmond O'Brien, Brian Keith, Tom Tryon, Dany Saval
description: A pilot is selected for a difficult mission in space. During his training he meets and falls in love with a girl who seems to know a lot more about galaxies than he does. For this reason the woman is taken for a spy of the Russians: in reality she is an alien sent to earth to help our hero establish contact with the inhabitants of other worlds. Nice comedy by Disney, an authentic relic of the cold war.

title: Napoleone
actors: Renato Rascel, Carlo Ninchi, Marisa Merlini, Loris Gizzi
description: In a schoolroom, the statues of Julius Caesar and Napoleon come to life when everyone is gone. Napoleon tells Caesar the story of his deeds, which appear in a new light. Here then is the young Bonaparte, animated by a lack of military spirit, who wins the stripes thanks to the mystifications of an acrobat.
notes: Borghesio draws an obvious film from a sketch by Rascel. In the cast also Raimondo Vianello in the part of Cambronne.

title: Non me lo dire!
actors: Erminio Macario, Wanda Osiris, Tino Scotti
description: Michele Colombelli was once the viscount of Castel Perrone, but now that he is decayed and penniless and is forced, to live, to guide the castle he once owned, he calls himself Jimmy. But his misadventures are not over. Not exceptional comedy, like all those played by Macario. The one who appears in the opening credits as Vanda Osiri is the famous Wanda Osiris.

title: My Sister Eileen
actors: Janet Leigh, Jack Lemmon, Betty Garrett
description: Eileen and Ruth Sherwood arrive in New York from Ohio with the idea of ??making a fortune, one as an actress, the other as a writer. Eileen immediately finds two suitors: a bartender and a newspaper reporter. Ruth even finds a publisher, but the intentions of these do not seem really serious. Remake of a 1942 film in which the young Quine was a shop assistant. Choreography by Bob Fosse.

title: Due soldi di speranza
actors: Vincenzo Musolino, Maria Fiore, Filomena Russo, Luigi Astarita
description: Antonio is the only support of his large family. He would like to marry Carmela, but he has no money and in addition he has to work hard to put together the dowry of his sister, seduced by a landowner. So during the day the sacristan in the village church does, at night he moves to Naples to attack propaganda posters for the PCI.
notes: With the neorealism already almost exhausted, Castellani realizes this serious, popular and intelligent comedy and wins the grand prize at Cannes in 1952. One of the freshest and most participatory representations of the Italian popular world, with an irresistible female protagonist.

title: Wholly Moses
actors: Dudley Moore, Jamos Coco, Madeline Kahn, Richard Pryor
description: In a cave in Israel a papyrus is found that narrates the adventures of a certain Herschel whose life has always crossed with that of Moses, ever since, entrusted to the waters of the Nile, his cradle was "doubled" by that of Moses; thus, while the other had ended up at the court of the Pharaoh, he had become a sculptor of idols. And so on, for a series of exchanges between the two characters. Mel Brooks' zany biblical parody.

title: Spider Man
actors: Nicholas Hammond, David White, Liza Eilbaker, Michael Pataki
description: Peter Parker, a student with a dream of becoming a photojournalist, finds himself in the midst of a series of crimes of which Professor Edward Byron is guilty. But Parker, thanks to the providential bite of a radioactive spider, becomes Spider-Man. The character of Spider-Man was born in 1963 in the "strips" drawn by Steve Ditko and Stan Lee. In his first film appearance (but designed for TV) space is also given to the comic dimension of extraordinary adventures, with very modest special effects.

title: Spider Man Strikes Back
actors: Nicholas Hammond, Robert F. Simon, Joanna Cameron
description: Peter Parker has made it: he is officially a photojournalist of the newspaper directed by Mr. Jameson who, however, are interested only in the reports concerning Spider-Man. With a journalist at his side who wants to discover the identity of the mysterious individual, Parker deals with a theft of radioactive material. It is the second episode based on the superman-photojournalist: modest in effects, television in rhythm, but almost sympathetic in its poverty.

title: Spider Man The Dragon's Challenge
actors: Nicholas Hammond, Robert F. Simon, Ellen Bry, Chip Fields
description: A Chinese politician accused of treason can prove his innocence only by tracking down the three marines who, in his time, had known him. Unfortunately for him, however, the three are now dead. The only help comes from the journalist Peter Parker (Spider-Man) who is away in Hong Kong, will solve the intricate story. It is the third film based on the famous Marvel Comics comic; here too, nothing memorable.

title: Il corsaro
actors: Robert Woods, Tania Alvarado, Cris Huerta, Armando Calvo
description: After losing his ship to the game, the English pirate Jeffrey Brook is captured by the French and deported to a desert island. During the journey he leads a mutiny, frees all prisoners, finds his boat and recaptures it. Then he lands on an island controlled by the Portuguese, leads the pro-British revolt, distributes gold to the rebels and resumes the sea route ...
notes: Adventures in freedom, assembled in an attempt to resume a trend that years before had a good success in Hollywood. The situations are obviously pushed to the limit of comics, but the approximation of the staging neutralizes the fun of the story.

title: Force 10 From Navarone
actors: Robert Shaw, Barbara Bach, Franco Nero, Harrison Ford
description: We are in 1943. English commandos are sent to Yugoslavia with two objectives: to eliminate a Nazi spy and block an armored column.
