The British, intercepted twice, end up in the hands of the Germans. With the help of a group of partisans they will still be able to carry out the double mission, but the price paid will be expensive and the survivors will end up isolated behind enemy lines.
notes: Neither the sea nor the island of Navarone are involved in this film. Guy Hamilton is a craftsman who also wrote some 007s. Franco Nero is the Nazi spy.

title: Seems Like Old Times
actors: Goldie Hawn, Chevy Chase, Charles Grodin
description: Nick, a bit of a bear writer, is totally innocently involved in a robbery. Hunted and desperate, he takes refuge in the home of his ex-wife Glenda, a lawyer, now married to the Attorney General of the State. As expected, misunderstandings, complications and endless jealousies ensue. In the trial that follows, Nick, defended by Glenda, is acquitted. Back to writing in solitude, but until when?
notes: Behind the film is the usual hit theatrical comedy signed by Neil Simon. The story is unlikely enough to be able to embroider on it, respecting the most functional clichés. Adequate Interpretation: The best of the three is Goldie Hawn.

title: Cinderfella
actors: Jerry Lewis, Anna Maria Alberghetti, Judith Anderson, Ed Wynn
description: With an evil mother and two wicked half-brothers, poor Freddy is reduced to the role of a slave. Successful parody of "Cinderella", with a cartoon Lewis.

title: Caro papà
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Stefano Madia, Andrée Lachapelle, Aurore Clément
description: Albino Millozza (Gassman) is a businessman with little time to devote to his family. In fact, his wife periodically and unsuccessfully tries to commit suicide. The son sympathizes with terrorists, and perhaps even more.
notes: Risi, Gassman and terrorism don't work.

title: The Sheriff of Fractured Jaw
actors: Kenneth Moore, Jayne Mansfield, Henry Hull, William Campbell
description: Jonathan Tibbs is English, the son of an arms manufacturer himself the son of an arms manufacturer. But Tibbs is very enterprising and understands that the US could be a much more thriving market for his illegal products. And then he leaves for the new continent to get straight to the town of Fractured Jaw where he will be able to become a sheriff and where he will also meet the beautiful Kate. Shot in Spain, Walsh's film is unfortunately not very inventive, even if the parody game is quite original.

title: La città si difende
actors: Gina Lollobrigida, Fausto Tozzi, Renato Baldini, Paul Müller, Tamara Lees
description: Four bandits steal the takings from a football match and run away. One dies trying to take refuge in Corsica. Another kills himself out of desperation. A third is arrested with the complicity of his ex-lover. And the fourth threatens to throw himself out of a building and then thinks about it. Germi has always loved black American cinema. Here he packs an episode from the series "Il delitto doesn't pay".

title: Toys
actors: Robin Williams, Michael Gambon, Joan Cusack, Robin Wright
description: Close to death, Kenneth Zevo, manager of a toy company, asks his brother Leland to take over the company while his son Leslie (Williams) is mature enough to replace him. The problem is that Leslie is not, at least by birth, a child. The second problem is that Leland is a general and his first idea is to build war toys.
notes: It is the most personal, desired and heartfelt film, and also the most unfortunate of a director who, while working on commission ("Rain Man"), made millions of dollars. This, apart from the Oscar nomination for Scarfiotti's scenography, was a real flop.

title: The Great St. Trinian's Train Robbery
actors: Frankie Howard, Dora Bryan, Reg Varney, Desmond Walter-Ellis
description: Hiding the loot from a robbery in an abandoned school - great idea, but as long as no one reactivates the building for its original function. Which, however, happens so that the criminals have to contend with a group of wild students. Original starting point, with some tiredness in the course of work and lots of satire on costume.

title: Necessary Roughness
actors: Scott Bakula, Hector Elizondo, Harley Jane Kozak, Robert Loggia
description: High school star Paul Blake never played football. At university, things change: he is in fact enrolled in the university team coached by coach Gennero, who wants to rediscover his professional dignity with the poor students, stained by previous disciplinary measures. Add a not very sporty headmaster and a helpful and good-looking teacher, the rest follows accordingly.
notes: Stan Dragoti directed, 15 years ago, a not bad vampire parody: "Love at first bite". Scott Bakula stars in Clive Barker's latest horror film, "Lord of Illusions" and the television series "Time Travel". They both did better.

title: Lionheart
actors: Eric Stoltz, Gabriel Byrne, Nicola Cowper, Dexter Fletcher
description: Richard the Lionheart has already left for the Crusades and is on the way to the Holy Sepulcher. A very young knight (Stoltz) tries to intercept him in France to be able to join him. Instead, it happens that flocks of disadvantaged and homeless kids (and moreover on the run from the evil Black Prince) join him. What was initially a solitary initiative thus becomes a small army. You wouldn't expect such an enjoyable and original film. Yet here everything works: from the subject to the choice of actors.

title: A Christmas Romance
actors: Olivia Newton-John, Gregory Harrison
description: Julia's husband died in an accident some time ago. She now lives with her two daughters in a family home, located in the middle of the mountains. After being left alone to carry on the cart, she got into debt with the bank and now she no longer knows how to pay compensation. The bank sends an arrogant and superficial employee to carry out the eviction. Christmas is approaching, but also a snow storm. A Christmas novel, with the usual elements. Julia is the Newton-John, who went to TV after the glories of the Travoltian era.

title: Arrivederci e grazie
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Ricky Tognazzi, Gian Marco Tognazzi, Milly Carlucci
description: Carlo, in his sixties, leaves his wife and goes to live in an apartment in the heart of Rome. An oversight of the agency and his son Paolo, a depressed playwright, comes to his house; then comes the second son, Giacomo, with a pregnant girlfriend. What's more, Carlo is diagnosed with cancer. But he does not care: and in the end he will make everyone happy before going to the East with his wife.
notes: Everything should be based on the idea of ??putting the three Tognazzi together, keeping the story between fiction and forays into the reality of (true) family feelings. But it would take another screenwriter for this television movie that pretends to be a movie.

title: The Return of the Musketeers
actors: Michael York, Oliver Reed, Jean-Pierre Cassel, Philippe Noiret
description: In 1648 King Louis XIV was just ten years old and in France he commanded Cardinal Mazarin. In England, meanwhile, King Charles I, defeated by the leader of the Puritans Oliver Cromwell, risks his head. But at that point the three musketeers return to the scene who, twenty years after their last exploits, are still ready to defend the King and France. The expedition to England does not save King Charles, but in the end ours win anyway.
notes: Richard Lester had already amused young and old with the previous two episodes ("The Three Musketeers" and "The Four Musketeers"), filmed in 1973. This new episode is a bit too melancholy to hold a candle to.

title: Parenti serpenti
actors: Marina Confalone, Paolo Panelli, Alessandro Haber, Cinzia Leone
description: Christmas Eve: the four children and their families gather around the elderly parents Trieste and Saverio. The eve passes quietly: dinner and midnight mass. Then the parents reveal to their children that they intend to spend the last years of their life with any of them, in exchange for the inheritance. The children, however, in order not to host them, prefer to eliminate them by simulating a gas explosion. Monicelli takes his discourse on the family to its extreme consequences: the petty bourgeois is here fiercely portrayed in all its vices and meanness. Uneven in its development, the film soon expires in the mockery.

title: Madamigella di Maupin
actors: Catherine Spaak, Robert Hossein, Tomas Milian, Ottavia Piccolo
description: In the France of the Sun King a girl, Magdalene, in order not to undergo a marriage of convenience, joins the army. For this he must disguise himself as a man taking the name of Theodore. However, he soon falls in love with Captain Alcibiades who shows him great camaraderie. Her identity, however, is discovered by the perfidious D'Albert who falls in love with her but in the end, having cleared up the misunderstanding, back in the role of Magdalene, she will declare her love to Alcibiades. Based on the novel of the same name by Teophile Gautier, the film cleverly mixes adventure and sentimentality with that bit of scabrous given by the ambiguity of the character of Magdalene.

title: The Million Pound Note
actors: Gregory Peck, Jane Griffiths
description: An American in England is handed a one million pound note and discovers that it is very difficult to spend it. A Mark Twain story told with good grace by Ronald Neame.

title: L'aile ou la cuisse
actors: Louis De Funès, Coluche, Claude Gensac, Vittorio Caprioli
description: A meticulous food critic (Louis de Funès), aided by his son (Coluche), tries to unmask a swindler tycoon of prepackaged foods. The latter, who has many things to hide, tries to make canned meat out of them. The mimicry of the two great comic actors produces pearls, but the film itself is very little.

title: On Deadly Ground
actors: Steven Seagal, Michael Caine, Joan Chen, John C. McGinley
description: Forrest Taft is a kind of superfighter in the field of oil wells. He extinguishes one that burned in Alaska, but when the boss of the company voluntarily provokes the bursting of another well for grim speculative maneuvers, the hero fights against the wicked, evicts them (albeit in conditions of numerical and potential inferiority) and avoids an ecological disaster of enormous proportions. Seagal, producer, director and performer, becomes a crusader for ecology. His expression is always absolutely granite. The film is almost all taken for granted.

title: Stalingrad
actors: Dominique Horwitz, Thomas Kretschmann, Jochen Nickel, Olivier Broumis
description: The young German lieutenant Hals is sent as punishment to the Stalingrad front. It is the winter of 1942-43 and the situation, hitherto favorable to Hitler's troops, is reversed. In the frightening climatic conditions, as the latest criminal follies of some of the most fanatical of their officers unfold, the Germans realize that defeat is inevitable and death is certain.
notes: A German "blockbuster" in the fiftieth anniversary of the battle that marked the beginning of the end of the war and of Nazi power. Diligent for narrative fidelity, ideologically honest, the film is however also burdened by a wholly Teutonic heaviness.

title: Peter's Friends
actors: Stephen Fry, Kenneth Branagh, Emma Thompson, Alphonsia Emmanuel, Rita Rudner
description: Having recently lost his father, Peter reunites his old college friends at home, after a decade, for the New Year's Eve. Passions, anxieties, various problems come to the surface under the bark of a student who is now out of time. Eventually, Peter announces the real reason why he organized the meeting.
notes: A Branagh with deliberately muted tones, without vibrant undertones, for a film that manages to render the icy climate of the Thatcherian restoration, of conservative well-being and unbridled consumerism. Intelligent dialogues for excellent interpreters.

title: The Secret Garden
actors: Kate Maberly, Heydon Prowse, Andrew Knott, Maggie Smith, John Lynch
description: Daughter of English living in India, Mary is hosted, after the death of her parents, in the manor of an uncle. The latter, a widower, has a sick son who lives in seclusion in his room. Mary discovers a secret garden and, with the help of a farmer, manages to involve her cousin in his raids in this garden, who thus heals from his illness. Even the uncle regains his serenity.
notes: From the novel of the same name by Frances Hodgson Burnett, the Polish director draws a film with a remarkable "gothic" iconography, but which suffers from excesses of honeyed sentimentality. Careful, elegant packaging, but at times decidedly cloying content. Screenplay by "Burtonian" Caroline Thompson ("Nightmare Before Christmas", "Edward Scissorhands", music by "Kieslowsky" Zbigniew Preisner.

title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
actors: Jim Carrey, Courteney Cox, Sean Young, Dan Marino
description: Strange specialization, that of Ace Ventura: the search for lost or kidnapped animals. When he is hired to retrieve the Snowflake dolphin, mascot of the Miami Dolphins team, kidnapped on the eve of the Superbowl, Ours does all he can. Which means that, from madness to madness, from insanity to insanity, he brilliantly carries out his professional "mission".
notes: After several apprenticeships in ultra-secondary particles, the Jim Carrey phenomenon explodes, an authentic bomb with a fracassona, delirious comedy. It is the only raison d'être of the film, with its million-volt frenzy, wild, multifaceted, overwhelming.

title: Natural Born Killers
actors: Woody Harrelson, Juliette Lewis, Robert Downey jr., Tommy Lee Jones, Tom Sizemore
description: Mickey and Mallory, after massacring her family, begin a journey in which they kill anyone who comes in front of them. Having become a legend, they are followed by TV and, captured, they manage to escape by killing, along with a lot of other people, even the television journalist who interviewed them. In the end, there they are peaceful and serene, bourgeoisly surrounded by a swarm of children. A film that divided critics and audiences. Violent beyond words, but in the name of the grotesque; fierce against the sinister power of the media, but in search of a "sympathy" built with low blows. Stone ultra-provocative, but how honest?

title: Shadow of the Wolf
actors: Lou Diamond Phillips, Toshiro Mifune, Jennifer Tilly, Donald Sutherland
description: The Eskimo Agakuk has been defrauded by a white man and he kills him. Forced to abandon his people with his woman, he is pursued by the curse of his father, the shaman of the tribe, who threatens him with the shadow of the wolf. A wolf in flesh and blood puts him in a bad way. Meanwhile, the father, who has forgiven the young man, kills a policeman who wanted to arrest Agakuk and, captured, turns into an eagle.
notes: "The shadow of the wolf" is a film that comes too late, when the customs and habits of the Inuit have given substance to many other films, often even better packaged. And then, what is the great Toshiro Mifune doing under the skins of an Eskimo?

title: Il Piccolo Lord
actors: Mario Adorf, Antonella Ponziani, Marianne Sägebrecht, Francesco De Pasquale
description: A penniless German artist, who lives on a small island in the Mediterranean and who is about to have a child with his girlfriend Gioia, drowns in the sea. Only ten years later the father of the deceased, a rich and arid industrialist, knows he has a grandson, named Christian. She meets him, becomes attached to him and seems transformed by this bond, but she wants the boy all to himself and tries to take him away from his mother.
notes: Ugly Italian TV version of Burnett's novel, with actors looking for help.

title: Street Justice
actors: Michael Ontkean, Joanna Kerns, Catherine Bach
description: A former CIA agent returns from a long, unfair, detention. A lone hero, he cleans up his corrupt city dominated by a rich and powerful family. Predictable and slow Richard Sarafian film ("White Man Go With Your God") in full decline.

title: Incubo sulla città contaminata
actors: Hugo Stiglitz, Laura Trotter, Maria Rosaria Omaggio, Francisco Rabal
description: Nuclear contamination has produced horrific bloodthirsty mutants. A TV reporter and his wife escape the hordes of monsters, but are ultimately trapped in an amusement park. Directed by Umberto Lenzi, as always, he plunders American genre cinema with little money and a lot of talent.

title: Ghost in the Machine
actors: Karen Allen, Chris Mulkey, Ted Marcoux, Will Horneff
description: Karl Hochman, a computer shop employee, has a serious car accident and is taken to hospital under the watchful eye of a brain scanner. From a sudden electrical blackout, Hochman dies, but his spirit continues to circulate within the electronic network Datanet Corp.
notes: The starting idea, copied among other things from "In shock" by Wes Craven, was anything but evil, but the director Talalay (which is that of "Nightmare 6") proves that she does not know how to go beyond a work of pure routine. The virtual reality sequence copied from "Tron" is useless.

title: La grande illusion
actors: Pierre Fresnay, Erich Von Stroheim, Jean Gabin, Gaston Modot, Dita Parlo, Marcel Dalio
description: Scenes from a German POW camp during the Great War. A French officer of aristocratic origin sacrifices himself to facilitate the escape of two of his subordinates of popular origin. Mirror of the French is the German commander of the camp, also old-fashioned, undermined in physique and morale. Both embody a world destined to disappear while the fugitives are a metaphor for the new society. A masterpiece of anti-militarist cinema, a melancholy and pacifist manifesto of a generation in danger of extinction.

title: FernGully: The Last Rainforest
description: Crysta, a fairy who lives in the forest, saves the life of young Zak who, following an accident, was about to be killed by a car used for work in the woods. Zak thus comes into contact with the world of FernGully and ends up falling in love with the fairy but then decides that her place is in the world. A silly film that mixes Disney fantasies with a bland ecological message and deadly songs.

title: Star!
actors: Julie Andrews, Richard Crenna, Michael Craig, Daniel Massey
description: Gertrude Lawrence begins her dazzling career according to script. First she goes to dance school, then she becomes a dancer in a row, then the star of the show falls ill and she becomes a real star in the space of one night. This is followed by the birth of a daughter, divorce from her husband, several successful tours, friendship with Noel Coward and, eventually, marriage to a banker.

title: Kvidebjørn Kong Valemon
actors: Maria Bonnevie, Jack Fjeldstad, Tobias Hoest, Anna-Lotta Larsson, Bent Aserud
description: The princess of the Far Lands wants to marry young Valemon, king of the Summer Lands at all costs. He denies himself and at that point she transforms him into a polar bear with a spell (even if the spell only works during the day and at night the prince returns to normal again). Desperate, Valemon manages to convince the princess of the Winterlands to help him return to himself. Pleasant fairy tale based on a traditional Norwegian tale. It is a classic Christmas movie, professionally directed by Ola Solum ("Orion's Belt") and supported as far as the animation of the puppets is concerned by Jim Henson's Creature Shop (that of the Muppets).

title: Appointment with Death
actors: Peter Ustinov, Lauren Bacall, John Gielgud, Piper Laurie, Amber Bezer
description: Emily Boynton is traveling to Palestine with her daughter Ginevra and their three grandchildren. With them are an English aristocrat, an American aristocrat (Lauren Bacall), Colonel Carbury (John Gielgud) and the famous detective Hercule Poirot (Peter Ustinov). While the group is on a desert excursion, Emily is killed, but Poirot is not fooled into knowing that the killer is one of them. Winner comes out of time, when the series has already lost all its bite. And what's more, he chooses one of the most obvious plots written by Christie. Ustinov himself, for the fifth time in the role of Poirot, seems unable to take it anymore.

title: Paper Mask
actors: Paul McGann, Amanda Donohoe, Frederick Treves, Tom Wilkinson
description: Matthew Harris, a London stretcher bearer, assumes the identity of Dr. Hennessey, who died in a car accident, thus managing to get the job the deceased had applied for: working in an emergency room. Thus he begins to prescribe medicines, to assist the patients and at first he has no problem making himself believe a doctor. Until a nice nurse begins to doubt Matthew and his work and begins to keep an eye on him.
notes: An intelligent thriller, which is very rare, set inside a hospital and which results in a cynical representation of the world of healthcare.

title: Theodora Goes Wild
actors: Irene Dunne, Melvin Douglas, Thomas Mitchell
description: A provincial girl lives suffocated by the closed and gossipy environment that surrounds her. Thus he begins to write rather driven novels, signing them with a pseudonym. These soon reach great success. Nice comedy played entirely on the contrast between environment and character, which gives rise to irony and humor. The film was based on a short story by Mary McCarthy.

title: Red Rock West
actors: Nicolas Cage, Dennis Hopper, J.T. Walsh, Lara Flynn Boyle
description: En route to Wyoming Michael arrives at Red Rock, once a thriving oil town. The owner of the café, Wayne, mistakes him for the killer he hired to take out his wife. Michael accepts, pockets the sum, but then drifts everything to the woman who offers him the double to take out her husband. Michael also accepts this assignment and then escapes. In the meantime, however, the real killer has arrived and does not want to give up his share of money ... It is a film that has divided the critics: there are those who have taken it for granted and those who have praised it as a superb example of thriller. It is certainly a film full of action and twists, often of grim violence.

title: Bawang bieji
actors: Leslie Cheung, Zhang Fengyi, Gong Li, Lu Pei Qui, Ying Da, Ge You, Li Chun, Lei Han, Tong Di, Jiang Wenli, Lu Qi
description: It is the story of Qui Douzi and Shitou, two children from the Beijing Opera School. Then the two children grow up and become famous actors. One specializes in female roles, the other in the interpretation of the opera "Goodbye my concubine". Then comes the Japanese invasion, the postwar period, the Communist Party and the Cultural Revolution, but the relationship between the two remains intact.
notes: Chen Kaige uses the Peking Opera tradition as a constant against which to measure the passage of time and the changes in history. The result is one of the most famous Chinese films ever distributed in Italy. Which isn't much, but Gong Li is gorgeous.

title: Airport 1975
actors: Charlton Heston, Karen Black, George Kennedy, Myrna Loy
description: A Boeing 747 bound for Los Angeles is hijacked due to bad weather at the Salt Lake City airport. For the same reason, a tourist plane is also diverted to the same airport, which crashes right into the cabin of the Boeing. The second pilot and the radio operator die, the commander is seriously injured. The head stewardess takes over, led from the control tower by company director Alan Murdoc (who is also her boyfriend) and another executive who has the family on board. Murdoc reaches the plane aboard a military helicopter and drops into the cabin taking command of the aircraft.
notes: If the idea of ??the group of strangers trapped in an extreme situation is not new, the way to elaborate it is also predictable: manner notations on the "mass", heroic characterization of the protagonists, absolute priority to the growing tension, even sacrificing all likelihood. Example of the catastrophic kind it helped to bring about and which proliferated for much of the late 1970s.

title: The Cheap Detective
actors: Peter Falk, Ann-Margret, Eileen Brennan, Sid Caesar, Stockard Channing, James Coco, Dom DeLuise, Louise Fletcher, John Houseman, Madeline Kahn, Fernando Lamas, Marsha Mason
description: We are in 1940, in San Francisco. Lou is a detective suspected of killing his partner. In the course of the investigation he conducts to prove his innocence, he ends up involved in an international diamond trade. Almost not enough, he finds Marlène, his old French flame, now persecuted by Nazi spies as a partisan. Incredibly, everything works out, even between Lou and Marlène.
notes: Neil Simon, author of the story and the screenplay, works from the heritage of the classic detective movies, adding evident references to "Casablanca". All played in a parody key. A lot of fun, thanks also to wild actors.

title: I'd Climb the Highest Mountain
actors: Susan Hayward, William Lundigan, Rory Calhoun, Barbara Bates
description: Pastor William Thompson carries out his ministry in a village in the mountains. With him is his wife Mary. The two come from the city, but their participation in the life of the community soon leads them to share the joys and sorrows of the parishioners, whether they are believers or not. When William and Mary have to leave by order of a higher order, everyone regrets them.
notes: Sugary and dated family drama. Henry King was approaching the twilight of a successful career.

title: L'assassino
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Salvo Randone, Micheline Presle
description: The antique dealer Alfredo Martelli is stopped by the police on charges of killing his ex-lover for money reasons. The stay in the police offices makes Alfredo reflect on some unclean episodes of his life, and a sense of guilt emerges. Then the real murderer is discovered: Alfredo, released, ends up forgetting the anguish of those hours and returns to life as usual.
notes: Petri's debut moves on the difficult terrain of the contamination between detective, psychological thriller and comedy of manners. The goal is to stigmatize the moral mediocrity of the social climber in the boom years.

title: O Henry's Full House
directors: Henry Hathaway, Howard Hawks, Henry King, Jean Negulesco, Henry Koster
actors: Anne Baxter, Richard Widmark, Marilyn Monroe
description: Five episodes taken from short stories by O. Henry. A homeless man goes to great lengths to spend the winter in the heat in prison. A young agent solves his case of conscience and arrests his homicidal friend. A painter falls ill and dies after inventing the ruse that will save the life of a friend. Some kidnappers pay to get rid of their unleashed victim. He and she sell what they hold most dear to give each other a Christmas present. Between drama and comedy of manners, five important directors tell five minimal stories, misewre, moving or ironic.

title: The Long, Long Trailer
actors: Lucille Ball, Desi Arnaz, Keenan Wynn, Marjorie Main, Gladys Hurlbut
description: He and she are on the eve of the wedding. The hubby also has to move to California immediately after the wedding; she convinces him to buy a giant caravan on which they can also enjoy a wonderful honeymoon. Of course this is not the case. In fact, everything happens and misadventures even risk breaking the dream of love.
notes: Minnelli enjoys this wild comedy that targets the all-American craving for existence as a perennial journey. That is: how to transform a mythical place of the American imagination into a nightmare, managing first of all to make us laugh.

title: La spiaggia
actors: Martine Carol, Raf Vallone, Mario Carotenuto, Valeria Moriconi
description: Anna Maria is a prostitute who went on vacation to the sea with her little daughter Caterina. In the hotel where she is, she is well liked by everyone, but of course no one knows who she really is. When she rejects the attentions of someone who knows her, it causes scandal. Anna Maria risks being banned, but here comes a billionaire who has fallen in love with her ... The comedy of manners dissolves in the fairy tale to increase the strength of his morale. A bitter and explicit comedy against the moral hypocrisy of the Italian bourgeoisie of the time. The staging with a skilful use of color is very refined. Screenplay by Cahrles Spaak, Rodolfo Sonego, Luigi Malerba. Still breathtaking Valeria Moriconi teenager in the shower.

title: Rough Night in Jericho
actors: George Peppard, Dean Martin, Jean Simmons, Jaohn McIntire
description: Flood's gang attacks the stagecoach on which they find Dolon and Ben Hickman, future partner of Mollie, a businesswoman who has always stood up to outlaws. The situation in the city is serious. Dolon, who is a player, would like to slip away, but Mollie's energy conquers him. In the end, he will be the one to lead the inhabitants against the criminals.
notes: In full respect of the traditional clichés, a western of discreet craft supported by an all-star cast. Action, movement and landscapes are combined with a psychologically in-depth drawing of the characters and a fluid narration conducted with an attitude.

title: The Right Stuff
actors: Scott Glenn, Sam Shepard, Dennis Quaid, Barbara Hershey, Fred Ward, Lance Henriksen
description: On October 14, 1947, Chuck Yaeger, aboard an XI, was the first to cross the sound barrier. From that moment the struggle for supremacy in the sky flared between the Russians and the Americans. The Russians launched the first Sputnik in 1957. On April 9, 1959, the director of the Mercury space program introduces the group of future astronauts including John Glenn (Ed Harris) and Alan Shepard (Scott Glenn). A reconstruction of the race to the sky conducted by Philip Kaufman halfway between the documentary and the drama. The best is the choice of actors: lots of "tough faces", with special mention for Ed Harris, Scott Glenn and Lance Henriksen.

title: Lifestyles of the Rich and Animated
description: The life of the stars is not easy, says Professor Ludwig Von Drake (Pico de Paperis) and, to corroborate his thesis, shows brief examples from the lives of various famous people. Like the one in which Goofy tries to spread out a hammock or the one in which Mickey, Donald and Pippo again find themselves playing polo or the one in which Donald finds it difficult to fall asleep due to a leaking tap. The problem of how famous people live is obviously completely specious and serves only as a glue to put together various short films produced between 1936 ("Moving Day", the opening one) and 1952 ("Two Chips and a Miss", with Cip and Dale).

title: Pocahontas: The Legend
actors: Sandrine Holt, Miles O'Keefe, Tony Goldwyn, Gordon Tootoosis
description: John Smith (Miles O'Keefe) arrives in the wilderness of America in 1607 in search of fortune and with the idea that everything is lawful. When he is captured and sentenced to death by the Powathan tribe, it seems that his adventure is over. At that moment, however, Princess Pocahontas (Sandrine Holt) comes forward and intercedes for him, saves his life and earns the contempt of her people.
notes: Shot and presented just in time to exploit the popularity of the Disney cartoon almost of the same name, it is a version with real actors. "Flesh and bone" is however a booklet for O'Keefe ("Tarzan") who has the expressiveness of a tombstone.

title: Seishun zankoku monogatari
actors: Yusuke Kazazu, Miyuki Kuwano
description: Makoto is a university student of easy virtue, used to boarding passing motorists. The passion that binds her to Kiyoshi, however, proves much stronger. The boy decides to move into the small room where Makoto lives. But soon, the only way to get over their poor financial situation is to bring Makoto back into prostitution.
notes: Great film by Nagisa Oshima and a very bitter portrait of the Japanese youth of the early 1960s.

title: Sanma no aji
actors: Chishu Ryu, Shima Iwashita, Keiji Sata, Mariko Okada, Nakaburo Nobuo
description: Old Shunei, at the moment his daughter Michiko gets married, is left alone. It is Ozu's latest film: the taste of sake is very bitter.

title: Två människor
actors: Georg Ryderberg, Wanda Rothgardt
description: Professor Zander is found killed. The culprit is Marianne (Rothgardt), wife of psychiatrist Arne Lundell (Ryderberg), who has found no other solution to escape the professor's blackmail. Arne discovers the truth and decides to accuse himself of the murder, so as to allow his wife to escape. But she anticipates it and poisons herself, imitated soon after by Arne himself. There is a lot of work especially in sound in this Dreyer film. Too bad that the original play is so stereotyped and the protagonists so uninteresting. Even if Dreyer ungenerously said of the film: "For me it does not exist", it is still a great proof of authorship.

title: Tilai
actors: Rasmane Ouedraogo, Ina Cisse, Roukietou Barry
description: The young Saga returns to the village and discovers that his fiancée, Nogma, has become his father's wife. The relationship that resumes between the two young people is considered by the tribal law ("tilai" precisely means "the law") a form of impiety. Destiny looms, as in an Aeschylus tragedy: a classic tragedy in Burkina Faso.
notes: From one of the most important and valid directors of black Africa. More than a fairy tale, a tragedy that we Europeans can remember Aeschylus among the huts. Special Jury Prize in Cannes.

title: Les plus belles escroqueries du monde
directors: Roman Polanski, Claude Chabrol, Hiromichi Horikawa, Ugo Gregoretti
actors: Jean-Pierre Cassel, Nicole Karen, Gabriella Giorgelli, Francis Blanche
description: Four episodes: the first, by Roman Polanski, tells of a high-class thief who manages to cheat a fabulous necklace in disguise; the second, signed Chabrol, tells of a hardware merchant who buys the Eiffel Tower by weight of iron; in the third, by Hiromichio Horikawa, she makes him die of erotic exhaustion to steal his dentures, which he believes to be platinum, but then discovers that it is not; finally, Gregoretti shows us a prostitute who combines a marriage of convenience with the wrong old man ... Four directors, but there should have been five: the planned episode of Godard, "Le grand escroc", was cut. Unequal like all films of this type.

title: Huevos de oro
actors: Javier Bardem, Maribel Verdú, Maria De Medeiros, Rachel Bianca, Alessandro Gassmann
description: Benito Gonzale, of humble origins, manages to become a wealthy building owner. To achieve this, he had to go down a path that is anything but honorable, but his only goal has always been wealth; without prejudice to an inordinate propensity for sexual activity, especially with rich women whom he seduces repeatedly. Benito has no social or cultural complexes: his idols are Salvador Dalì and Julio Iglesias. From the car accident in which his mistress is killed, however, a series of troubles begins, up to the ruin. Bigas Luna, when he was really bad (as in the glorious days of "Caniche", 1979) gave deadly claws to bourgeois myths and knew how to make sexual obsession a sharp instrument. The old enamel has been lost. In this film, at least, the idea of ??a satire of the times remains.

title: Cin cin
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Julie Andrews, Jonathan Cecil, Ian Fitzgibbon
description: Cesareo Grimaldi made his fortune in France, where he also got married; Noiret is a Parisian heart surgeon, married to Pamela. Noiret and Margherita, Cesareo's wife, abandon their respective spouses to live together. Cesareo seeks an agreement with Pamela so that the families of departure can come back together. They will succeed but, despite their diversity, they will end up becoming lovers themselves.
notes: Comedy of theatrical origin that had Mastroianni as an interpreter also on the stage. Gene Saks is in his seventh film as a director: a career that has its best known title in "Cactus Blossom" (1969), with Bergman. This is one of his weakest films.

title: Rasoi
actors: Iaia Forte, Licia Maglietta, Enzo Moscato, Toni Servillo, Marco Manchisi
description: In today's desperate and surreal Naples, various characters, poised between reality and dream, real figures and ghosts or symbols, shout their discomfort. Scugnizzi in underwear and madonnas talking, guappi and desperate people sing, tell, invent, dialogue with the accompaniment of a café-chantant piano between a "blue morgue" sea and strange melodies with contaminations between ancient and modern. The author, seated at the proscenium, in front of the curtain announces his own death and so the show can begin ...
notes: The film is based on the play of the same name written by Enzo Moscato and Toni Servillo and staged under the direction of Martone himself, and is the testimony of a successful collective work, in which the United theaters group gives its best. All the actors are extraordinary; the most overwhelming is Toni Servillo in the final couplet-monologue.

title: Sátántángo
actors: Mihaly Vig, Putyi Horvath, János Derzsi, Miklós Székely B., László feLugossy, Éva Almássy Albert, Irén Szajki, Alfréd Járai, Erzsébet Gaál, Péter Dobai, Zoltán Kamondi, Barna Mihók
description: The film is completely set in the boundless Hungarian plain where, under constant pouring rain, a desperate humanity contends for the last shreds of awareness. Eventually men will be deceived by a false messiah and will find themselves back where they started. Extreme and terrible work, the film is an obsessive homage to the end of our millennium. A superb black and white, the flatness of the Hungarian plain, real-time scenes (a half-hour dance, 10-minute sequence shots) and a total duration of six and a half hours. Hypnotic.

title: La vita appesa a un filo
actors: Liu Zhongyuan, Huang Lei, Xu Qing
description: A blind old Chinese musician and singer believes he will regain his sight. This will happen, according to him, only when for the thousandth time the string of his "qin", a traditional instrument, will be broken. The old storyteller has a pupil, who is also blind and also possesses a magical "qin". The pupil, however, is more impatient and therefore shows greater haste in waiting for destiny to take its course.
notes: A small fable full of symbolism in which, through the metaphor of instruments and their strings, it speaks of the destiny of man and his interiority. Kaige is still suspended between her initial inspiration and her "international" turn.

title: Totò nella fossa dei leoni
actors: Totò, Vera Carmi, Enrico Glori, Primo Carnera, Arturo Bragaglia
description: Totò acts as a bodyguard to the beautiful Laura, saving her from the aims of a self-styled explorer (but an actual swindler) and returning her to her father who is with a tribe of savages. After that, love triumphs.
notes: The film was released in '43 with the title "Two hearts among the beasts" I was re-edited after the war, after the success of Totò. It is not yet the great period of Totò, but some surreal gags can entertain.

title: Yinghung bunsik
actors: Leslie Cheung, Chow Yun-fat, Ti Lung, Lee Tse Ho
description: Story of two brothers and their difficult relationship. The first is a policeman who puts his all into his job, the second is an outlaw who unwittingly hindered his brother's career and perhaps played some part in their father's death. When the "bad" brother returns, after a period of detention and with the intention of changing his life, he realizes how difficult it is to reintegrate into society.
notes: The "Martin Scorsese of Hong Kong", in this film, as in all his other works, proves to have a pulse in the story and a notable pyrotechnic taste for action scenes.

title: The Adventures of Huck Finn
actors: Elijah Wood, Courtney B. Vance, Robbie Coltrane, Jason Robards, Garette Ratliff Henson
description: Huck, a lively boy who lives with his widow Douglas, stages his own death to be able to venture out along the Mississippi. On board a raft he goes up the river and among his traveling companions is the black Jim, fleeing towards the anti-slavery North. The friendship between the two leads Huck to help the black man against the aims of two shady characters who would like to capture him and sell him as a slave.
notes: From Mark Twain's novel yet another (and rich) transposition for cinema. Maybe Elijah Wood is a little too delicate for the role of Huck, but the supporting actors are excellent, starting with Jason Robards (the "King") and Robbie Coltrane (the "Duke").

title: Per amore, solo per amore
actors: Diego Abatantuono, Penélope Cruz, Alessandro Haber, Stefania Sandrelli
description: In Palestine, a couple of millennia ago, the carpenter Giuseppe had a life experience in his wanderings with his (dumb) friend Socrates and decided that marriage is not for him. But he did not deal with the determination of the young Maria who fell in love with him.
notes: A film that manages not to be irreverent despite the story told. A skilful script full of ideas (by the director and Ugo Chiti), with interpreters who know their stuff, in particular Abatantuono and Haber.

title: La bella vita
actors: Claudio Bigagli, Sabrina Ferilli, Massimo Ghini, Giorgio Algranti
description: When Bruno (Bigagli) and Mirella (Ferilli) got married in 1989, Piombino was a city in full prosperity. Then Ilva, the steel mill where he works, knows the crisis Bruno goes into layoffs with the real danger of a future loss of his job. Mirella, who works as a cashier in a supermarket, in the meantime has entered into a relationship with Gerry Fumo (Ghini) popular host on local television; when he decides to interrupt the relationship, Bruno has now learned of everything. The couple then decide to separate, but, after some time, a tender and affectionate correspondence runs between them. The film skilfully combines the private aspect of the story with the social problems in which they are inserted, presenting situations and characters of convincing depth. Good actors, wonderful Ferilli.

title: Richard III
actors: Laurence Olivier, Claire Bloom, Ralph Richardson, Cedric Hardwicke, Nicholas Hannen, John Gielgud, Mary Kerridge, Pamela Brown, Andrew Cruickshank, Clive Morton
description: Adaptation from Shakespeare of the plots for the power of the deformed Richard of Gloucester, cruel and bloodthirsty: the one who said "My kingdom for a horse". Great interpreters for a classic text. Olivier's direction is dry and careful, less baroque and sprimental than in the previous adaptations.

title: Henry V
actors: Laurence Olivier, Robert Newton, Leslie Banks, Renée Asherson, Leo Genn, Felix Aylmer, Robert Helpmann, Vernon Greeves, Gerald Case, Morland Graham, Michael Warre, Ralph Truman
description: First Shakespearean direction by Laurence Olivier for cinema. Henry V's war against the French. The victorious battles, the marriage with Catherine of Troyes, daughter of Charles VI ... Figuratively exceptional, it starts from an Elizabethan theater rebuilt in the studio and, following Shakespeare's script to the letter, then blends beautifully with a more cinematic. Special Oscar to Olivier.

title: Naked Lunch
actors: E. J. Scorsiani, Peter Weller, Judy Davis, Ian Holm, Julian Sands
description: A drug addict writer, Bill Lee, who is an exterminator, kills his wife by shooting target. In a bar he is contacted by an extraterrestrial who sends him, as a secret agent, to the Interzone, near Tangier. Here the typewriter he usually uses turns into a cockroach that dictates phantom relationships. Bill is now prey to a parallel, hallucinating and horrifying life.
notes: After "The Fly" and "Inseparables" David Cronenberg continues and broadens his discourse on horror, adapting the famous autobiographical novel by William Burroughs and placing himself in an intermediate zone between literature (hallucinated at the origin) and special effects. Extraordinary and never free special effects.

title: Young Again
actors: Robert Urich, Lindsay Wagner, Jack Gilford
description: He gets to fulfill his great desire to return to adolescence. Who knows, perhaps returning to the past could change the course of its present existence.
notes: Passable variation on the theme of "Back to the Future", produced by Disney. A secondary part for the very young Keanu Reeves.

title: Tarzan and the Lost Safari
actors: Gordon Scott, Robert Beatty, Yolande Donlan, Betta St. John
description: Tarzan saves the five passengers of a plane crashed in the jungle. Then he must defend them from an evil man who uses a tribe of savages for his plans. In the 1950s and 1960s, Tarzan's films, previously well-edited by MGM, were strikingly close to standard television serials.

title: Zabriskie Point
actors: Mark Frechette, Daria Halprin, Rod Taylor, Paul Fix, Bill Garaway, G.D. Spradlin, Kathleen Cleaver
description: Mark, a rebellious student wanted by the police in Los Angeles for killing an agent, manages to escape on a stolen touring plane. In the Californian desert he meets and loves a girl, Daria, who is traveling to Phoenix to spend a holiday. In the ghostly landscape of Zabriskie Point (the point of maximum geological depression in the United States) the two young people spend long hours of love, but ...
notes: Having left to make a film about America, about the protest in American universities, Antonioni finds himself, as always, making a film about man and his destiny. Although not one of his masterpieces, and discounting a certain misunderstanding of the place and generation narrated, it remains a film with very high moments, including the "love in" in the desert and the final explosion on Pink Floyd music.

title: The King's Thief
actors: David Niven, Edmund Purdom, Ann Blyth, George Sanders
description: The ambitious and cruel Duke of Brampton plots against Charles II, ruler of England, over whom he exercises a great influence. In fact, the king, instigated by the perfidious adviser, banishes some nobles who are loyal to the monarchy as traitors. Among the latter there is also a young ex-officer who is forced to live as an outlaw.
notes: Mediocre swashbuckling film, which sadly wastes a good cast (there's also a young Roger Moore). It was the last film directed for MGM by modest Leonard.

title: The Canterville Ghost
actors: Charles Laughton, Robert Young, Margaret O'Brien
description: The specter of Simon of Canterville will find peace only if one of his descendants performs a feat of valor. So for three centuries he wanders in the family castle, until the Americans arrive ... From the famous story by Oscar Wilde, a funny satire of the world and of English customs, with a very good Charles Laughton.

title: The Comedians
actors: Elizabeth Taylor, Richard Burton, Alec Guinness, Peter Ustinov
description: In the dangerous and corrupt Haiti of the dictator "Papa Doc" Duvalier, political intrigues and shady deals are the daily practice not only for the miserable population, but also for those who flaunt liberal ideas. On the island there are also two strange characters, each committed to proving that he is different from what he is: Brown, an Englishman in love with the wife of a diplomat, and Jones, an adventurer and filibuster who seeks an impossible redemption in death.
notes: In flashes, the large cast gives some good performances (especially Guinness), but the film is heavy and hardly reminiscent of the happy novel by Graham Greene which inspired it. The Italian version is mutilated by about 40 minutes.

title: Totò, Peppino e... la dolce vita
actors: Totò, Peppino De Filippo, Mara Berni, Francesco Mulè, Rosalba Neri
description: The notables of a southern village would like to divert the route of the highway near the village. For this they send Antonio to Rome, after having stuffed him with money. However, nothing more is known about Antonio, therefore Peppino sets out from the town in search of him. Tracked down Antonio, Peppino discovers that the companion has given himself up to the dolce vita and promptly follows in his footsteps. The two frequent nightclubs and beautiful women until a relative brings them home. Based only in part on Fellini's original, the film has some exhilarating moments in the confrontation between the two provincials and the city.

title: No Contest
actors: Shannon Tweed, Andrew Dice Clay, Robert Davi, Roddy Piper
description: We are in a hotel in Toronto awaiting the election of Miss Galaxy. Guest of honor is Sharon Belle (Tweed), already winner of the same competition and now a movie star, as well as an expert in Tae Kwon Do. Surprisingly, a group of terrorists led by Raymond Bryce (Clay) in search of a handful of diamonds and one of the competitors, rich daughter of a senator, put the hotel to fire and sword. But the thugs didn't deal with Sharon ...
notes: Paul Lynch is English, but has always worked in Canada. Unfortunately, he's not too imaginative a guy. To do this dull version of "Die Hard" he chooses Shannon Tweed instead of Bruce Willis. She is prettier, but that's not enough.

title: Spaghetti House
actors: Nino Manfredi, Leo Gullotta, Gino Pernice, Rudolph Walker
description: Five Italians working in London cultivate the secret dream of opening a "Spaghetti House", and therefore work hard to scrape together the necessary amount for the original project. Then, one day, three black robbers break into the room where the Italians work and take them as hostages. The police intervene and the place is besieged. But, inside, among the eight men, a current of solidarity is established. Comedy with grotesque and pathetic hints, sewn on a Manfredi now far from his best times.

title: Staircase
actors: Rex Harrison, Richard Burton
description: Two mature homosexuals, who have been living together for decades, furiously tear each other apart. But loneliness is a very bad beast.
notes: Great interpreters for a play by Charles Dyer which is trivially effective; but it was one of the first times in Hollywood that homosexuality was explicitly addressed.

title: Agatha Christie's 'Thirteen at Dinner
actors: Peter Ustinov, Faye Dunaway, David Suchet, Jonathan Cecil
description: Wealthy English lord George Edgeware has been killed and celebrated detective Hercule Poirot is right there to investigate the case. To confuse the waters there are two characters: a certain Carlotta Adams and the widow of Lord Edgeware, a famous American actress. But Poirot is not the type to be easily duped.

title: Remote Control
actors: Kevin Dillon, Deborah Goodrich, Jennifer Tilly, Christopher Wynne
description: A video store manager and a client take on aliens who intend to take over the world with a videotape.

title: Mona Lisa
actors: Bob Hoskins, Cathy Tyson, Michael Caine
description: Released from jail, George has to make do for a living. His friend Diny offers him a job as a driver for Simone, a gorgeous black prostitute whom he ends up liking. She asks him to track down a fifteen-year-old girl, Cathy, of whom she no longer knows anything; George risks his life to fulfill the mission. He finds himself alone, but happy for having regained his daughter's affection. The Best of Neil Jordan ("In the Company of Wolves"), who also co-wrote the script with David Leland ("Wish You Were Here"). The ambiguity of classic noir at the service of a different image of Britain in the 1980s. Great performance by Bob Hoskins.

title: September
actors: Mia Farrow, Sam Waterston, Dianne Wiest, Denholm Elliott, Elaine Stritch
description: A group of people, linked by family ties or friendship, spends a few days of vacation in a Vermont villa. The owner, Lane, is very much in love with Peter, who is in love with Stephanie, a friend of Lane, who is loved in silence by Howard. Within twenty-four hours the whole tangle of affections, resentments and passions will emerge, including the traumas of a dramatic past.
notes: The most "intimate" of Allen's films, traversed by a smoldering fire. Extremely fine psychological investigation, in a narrative as apparently simple as it is rich, in substance, of compelling problems. High-performance interpreters.

title: No Down Payment
actors: Joanne Woodward, Tony Randall, Cameron Mitchell, Jeffrey Hunter
description: Sunrise Village is a quiet neighborhood on the outskirts of a large city. Here live the families of Roy, Jerry, David and Herman who have forged strong good neighborly ties. The four men and their wives, however, hide problems and small and big dramas behind the apparent light-heartedness. Theatrical and solidly acted, it is a film that digs (it was one of the first times) under the respectable crust of the American bourgeoisie.

title: Turk 182
actors: Timothy Hutton, Robert Urich, Kim Cattrall, Robert Culp
description: Terry Linch is a firefighter who saved a little girl one night off duty but was seriously injured. Authorities deny him his pension so his brother Jimmy wages a personal fight against corrupt mayor Tyler. His tactic is simple, but effective: to ruin every rally of the mayor with jokes and demonstrative actions. Jimmy soon becomes a sort of Robin Hood (signed with the initials Turk 182) supported by the popular enthusiasm that leads him to victory.
notes: For the series: Citizen Against the World, the film is a comedy that tries to give itself a "social" tone under the light surface of its packaging. It doesn't always succeed.

title: Chasers
actors: Tom Berenger, Erika Eleniak, William McNamara, Crispin Glover
description: Young Eddie is in his last post before leaving the navy: he will have to escort a prisoner to the base where the trial will take place. But the prisoner is a beautiful blonde, moreover arrested for reacting to the bastard of a treacherous superior. Thus, Eddie, together with the veteran Rock who supports him, fully fulfills the mission entrusted to him, but then adds a queue.
notes: Great narrative rhythm, ability to give meaning to the streets and environments from life, to combine images with the musical column and to tell rough characters (rare commodity in the 90s): he is a good Dennis Hopper, still lively and biting, if not quite like in the heyday of _Easy Rider_.

title: L'amico d'infanzia
actors: Jason Robards III, Amy Galper, Lee R. Sellars, Richard Grubbs
description: Following the death of the previous presenter, Arnold Gardner, he obtained the direction of the television talk show "The twenty-fifth hour". But, here comes a distant schoolmate from the past who wants to ruin him because he harbors ancient grudges and who does not hesitate to commit atrocious murders. Television is the "medium" that records the conclusion. Pupi Avati returns to the United States and shoots a film definitely built on the rhythms and models of the most recent American products. An agonizing, agitated, technically flawless story. But he is not the best Avati, nor the best of thrillers.

title: Demolition Man
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Wesley Snipes, Sandra Bullock, Nigel Hawthorne
description: In 1996, in Los Angeles, Sergeant John Spartan captures the insane and dangerous psychopath Simon Phoenix, but then has to share with him a sentence (for involuntary massacre) of seventy years in cryogenic prison. In 2032, thawed, here they are again against each other, in San Angeles, the old Los Angeles, so clean that you can't even say a bad word. Who will win? It's the same old story, set in the future instead of in the present (and again no news!). A few modest chuckles for the new civilization of obligatory respectability, and little else. Snipes is better than Stallone, but the star is the other.

title: M. Butterfly
actors: Jeremy Irons, John Lone, Barbara Sukowa, Ian Richardson
description: We are in 1964. René Gallimard, a French diplomat in China, falls in love with Song, a diva of the Peking Opera, who takes the opportunity to steal military secrets from him. Sent back to France, he meets her again and, believing he is saving the son he is convinced he had with her, passes her top secret documents. On trial, Gallimar discovers that Song is actually a man.
notes: Based on a true story, the film describes the illusory search for the perfect being through the projection of a desire, until the destruction and merger with the "other" in death.

title: The Remains of the Day
actors: Anthony Hopkins, Emma Thompson, James Fox, Christopher Reeve, Hugh Grant
description: After having faithfully served Lord Darligton for decades, Stevens butler uses the vacation days granted by the new owner of the castle to visit Miss Kenton, former housekeeper at Darligton House. Thinking back to the past, Stevens realizes that absolute dedication to service has prevented him from intellectual autonomy and, also, the ability to seize the opportunity of love. From a novel by Kazuo Ishiguro, another precious period reconstruction in Ivory's film, together with a strong dramatic tension underlying the formalism unreasonably experienced as a religion. And, again, an extraordinary performance of actors.

title: The Devil and Max Devlin
actors: Elliott Gould, Bill Cosby, Susan Anspach
description: An unscrupulous manager is hit by a bus and finds himself in hell, where he is offered to return to earth on one condition: that within two months he can snatch three souls from the devil. After the death of old Walt, Disney comedies struggled to find the sober elegance that saved even the most flimsy productions.

title: Gli italiani e le donne
actors: Gino Bramieri, Walter Chiari, Aldo Fabrizi
description: Five episodes more or less bizarre and imaginative, but united by the joke tone, with "parrots" haunted by bad luck, marital escapades and females as attractive as they are cunning. Extremely puny great variety with several big gauges of Sixties humor.

title: At The Circus
actors: Harpo Marx, Groucho Marx, Chico Marx, Margaret Dumont, Florence Rice
description: A lawyer who doesn't give a damn about jurisprudence and two bunglers save a circus from bankruptcy and a dishonest businessman. The Marx Brothers are nearing their decline, but their cinematic gags are still very effective. Memorable the scene of the big party, Groucho singing "Lydia" and seducing Mrs. Dukesbury. On the subject of the leguleio Groucho and Chico also held radio broadcasts published also in volume.

title: Night of Dark Shadows
actors: David Selby, Grayson Hall, Lara Parker, Kate Jackson, John Karlen
description: Quentin and Tracy, husband and wife, inherit an ancient castle and spend their holidays there. But a tragic past weighs on the manor and Quentin reincarnates a man who lived two centuries earlier, thirsty for revenge. A gross horror that mixes stereotypes without much conviction.

title: The Mercenaries
actors: Rod Taylor, Yvette Mimieux, Kenneth More, Jim Brown
description: In the revolted Belgian Congo in 1960, the captain of a formation of mercenaries must free the inhabitants of a town besieged by rebels. This, at least, is the official purpose of the mission which actually has a very different purpose: to secure a treasure in rough diamonds that is about to fall into the hands of the rebels and hand it over to the legitimate government. The enterprise succeeds, but another mercenary, a former Nazi, seizes the treasure and escapes. The captain pursues him, catches up with him and, in a dramatic face to face, is forced to brutally kill him.
notes: An old-fashioned adventurous plot, built by accumulation of episodes, with different and unexpected sequences of violence.

title: La rivolta dei sette
actors: Tony Russell, Massimo Serato, Nando Gazzolo, Livio Lorenzon
description: Unjustly imprisoned and tortured by Milo, a tyrant of the city of Sparta and traitor of the Achea League, Keros manages to enter the ranks of the rebels, unmasks the evil in front of the Athenians and then kills him. One of the many noisy "peplums", but also quite imaginative.

title: Ercole sfida Sansone
actors: Kirk Morris, Richard Lloyd, Liana Orfei, Enzo Cerusico, Aldo Giuffré
description: Hercules and Ulysses are shipwrecked among the Jews where Samson suspects they are spies of the Philistine oppressors. Between the two strongmen, Delilah also starts sowing discord. A harmless tale where the real protagonists are the scenarios and the papier-mâché boulders, as well as the shiny and always evident muscles of the two giants.

title: I Know My Son Is Alive
actors: Amanda Pays, Corbin Bersen, Al Waxman, Mimi Kuzyk
description: Since Katherine had a child, her life has been a disaster. Doctors diagnose postpartum depression, but this does not resolve the situation. Because the child disappears leaving behind a bloodstained blanket and at that point the fault seems to be Katherine and her neurosis. Will the woman be able to prove her innocence? And who is it that wants to make her look crazy?
notes: Amanda Pays is that of "Max Headroom" and "Flash". Which is to say that it owes its fame exclusively to television (as does Bersen, for that matter). But that's a shame because he has a bad face that wouldn't look bad even on the big screen.

title: To Save the Children
actors: Richard Thomas, Wendy Crewson, Robert Urich, Jopanne Vannicola
description: David Young is a diabetic and desperate offender. One day he tries to kidnap an entire elementary school in Cokeville and asks for a blackmail of two million dollars for each child. Too bad nothing works. The request itself is exaggerated, he lacks insulin and, in the end, the device with which he threatened to blow up the school bursts in his hands. The only original thing about this film for television is that it is not inspired, as happens in ninety percent of cases, by a true story. Also because the reality is often even unlikely, but swallowing this story of the diabetic and clumsy delinquent is really difficult.

title: If Someone Had Known
actors: Kellie Martin, Kevin Dobson, Linda Kelsey, Ivan Sergei
description: Kathy leaves a happy family to marry Jimmy, the man she loves. After some time the young woman's relations with her father, mother and sister become loose and the official reason is that Kathy, now that she has a baby, has no time to be assiduous with them. But here, one day, his sister discovers the truth, a painful truth, which will have very dramatic developments ... The show brings a close-up, with decorous measure, a "case" of those who remain (more often than not believe) hidden under a shell of apparent normality, overwhelmed by the shame of having to confess very thorny family situations.

title: Grand Prix
actors: James Garner, Eva Marie Saint, Yves Montand, Toshiro Mifune
description: The film opens with the spectacular collision between American driver Pete Aron and Briton Scott Stoddard, at the Formula One Grand Prix of Monte Carlo. Pete comes out unscathed, Scott will have it for several months. The fight for the world title is now an affair between Pete, the Italian Barlini and the French Sarti, but between one dramatic competition and the next, sentimental emotions are certainly not lacking. International cast and great show on the track, conventional and discounted "pink" counterpoints. Oscar for editing, sound and special effects.

title: The Incident
actors: Tony Musante, Martin Sheen, Beau Bridges, Ian Sterling
description: Two thugs (Musante and Sheen) board the subway late at night and rage on the other passengers with violence and humiliation, until a soldier with one arm in plaster (Bridges) finally confronts them. None of the other passengers support him and the man at first feels really bad. The mechanism, effective but elementary, of the trap acquires depth in the choice of characters, each - except the most defenseless among them - champion of a more or less small moral meanness. Excellent interpreters; very effective assembly.

title: Mommie Dearest
actors: Faye Dunaway, Diana Scarwid, Steve Forrest, Howard Da Silva
description: The famous Hollywood diva Joan Crawford depicted, in its worst aspects, in the biography of her adopted daughter Christine: neurotic, alcoholic, hysterical, paranoid, choleric to the point of almost sadism. And the adopted children (four in reality, two in the film) bear the consequences. Christine is sent to boarding school twice, the second of which is a kind of correctional house.
notes: It is possible that Joan Crawford's daughter forced the dyes, but certainly some unfinished business must have been. Faye Dunaway takes on the difficult character with exceptional intensity and director Frank Perry just "manages" the story.

title: Agatha Christie's "Dead Man's Folly"
actors: Peter Ustinov, Jean Stapleton, Constance Cummings, Jonathan Cecil
description: An American writer has a very special hobby. His passion is organizing fake manhunts with tragic endings. These hunts are of course simulations and never cause anyone to die. However, for once, the corpse actually materializes and then the infallible investigator Hercule Poirot (Ustinov) enters the field.
notes: Ustinov is someone who has slipped into Poirot's shoes half a dozen times. Half of which in the cinema. But, fortunately, he did other things too and that's why we still remember him today. His television Poirot, however, is flawless.

title: An Unmarried Woman
actors: Jill Clayburgh, Alan Bates, Michael Murphy, Cliff Gorman
description: Erika is abandoned by her husband, Martin, struck by a new passion for Macha, who is a few years younger. A psychologist encourages her to make new friends. Erika seems to find the solution to her problems in the relationship with an English painter, but here Martin, abandoned by the girl, starts to return. At this point Erika has had enough of both her husband and the new knight. Clever comedy that winks at feminist themes then in the air. Discreet dialogues and interpreters.

title: La collina degli stivali
actors: Terence Hill, Bud Spencer, Woody Strode, Glauco Onorato, Lionel Stander, Victor Buono, George Eastman
description: A young gunslinger, wounded in a fight, is hidden and cared for by the performers of a circus. The man is pursued by outlaws who want to appropriate his gold concession. The revenge of the bandits hits an acrobat, but from that moment the gunfighter and his new circus friends go on the counterattack. The showdown will take place during a show, with the help of local miners. The famous couple in a pre-Trinity western, where the first parody temptations already find their way. Colizzi administers stereotypes without particular flashes.

title: Tu mi turbi
actors: Roberto Benigni, Olimpia Carlisi, Nicoletta Braschi, Claudio Bigagli
description: First episode: the shepherd Benigno finds the lost flock, after having babysat the little son of Joseph and Mary. Second: Benigno's Guardian Angel has fallen in love with another. Luckily it's just a dream. Third: Benigno rebels against bank traps and ends up among the gendarmes. Fourth: to overcome boredom, Benigno, on guard at the Altare della Patria, scoffs at his fellow soldier. The first time of Benigni director. In the script there is also the hand of Giuseppe Bertolucci. On a strictly cinematic level, not everything goes smoothly, but our hero's ideas and comic art make us forgive him willingly.

title: Extremities
actors: Farrah Fawcett, James Russo, Diana Scarwid, Alfre Woodward
description: Marjorie escapes a man who would like to rape her, but her documents remain in the maniac's hands. Now the woman lives in terror that he may find her again and, in fact, here he is again, animated by the worst intentions. Marjorie, however, manages to immobilize him and anticipates the acrid pleasure of a ferocious, immediate revenge, aware that, legally, she has very little chance of obtaining justice. The film, with themes of dramatic effectiveness (the position of the woman not even guaranteed by the law, the impulse to summary justice, etc.) is held from the very beginning on a string of very high tension. Psychologically remarkable and well acted.

title: Il diavolo in convento
actors: Gilberto Govi, Carlo Ninchi, Ave Ninchi
description: Brother Angelo (Govi) organizes a fake miracle to prevent the sale of the convent to an industrialist who wants to make it a hotel. History doesn't matter: only Gilberto Govi ??counts.

title: Io e mia sorella
actors: Carlo Verdone, Ornella Muti, Elena Sofia Ricci, Mariangela Giordano
description: In Spoleto lives the meek and sedentary Carlo, oboist, while his sister Silvia is around the world, struggling with various messes, sentimental and otherwise. When her mother dies, Silvia falls into her brother's house, taking with her the stories of an ex-husband, a sick husband and a son in Hungary, a lover in Milan, a creditor in Turin. And it is still and always up to Carlo to get busy.
notes: Perhaps the best film by Verdone (and also by Ornella Muti), funny and bitter at the same time, with characters of a certain depth. There is some yielding to a spooky comedy, but also an undeniable human depth.

title: Double Edge
actors: Faye Dunaway, Amos Kollek, Mohammad Bakri
description: Faye is an ambitious photojournalist who landed her first assignment in Israel. At first her work takes place amidst difficulties, in front of which Faye can show her professionalism. Gradually her ability leads her to an ever greater involvement; the Palestinian reality and the increasingly harsh reality of clashes, of "accidents", of murdered people, opens up before his eyes. Interesting mix of Israeli-American fiction and documentary production. The dramatic reality takes shape in the interviews with the real protagonists of the situation (one of them, Rabbi Meir Kahane, will die murdered shortly after the making of the film).

title: Johnny Oro
actors: Mark Damon, Valeria Fabrizi, Franco Derosa, Ettore Manni
description: Over the heads of the Perez brothers, a dangerous band of brigands, hang countless bounties. The exception is Juanito who, unlike the others, usually travels unarmed and makes others do his bullying. While one of his brothers is forcing a girl into forced marriage to Juanito, famous bounty hunter Johnny Oro interrupts the ceremony.
notes: Avalanche action, on a large copy of "A dollar of honor".

title: Air Raid Wardens
actors: Stan Laurel, Oliver Hardy, Edgar Kennedy
description: Expelled from the Air Force Defense Service after causing yet another catastrophe, the eternal bunglers Laurel and Hardy redeem themselves by discovering a secret spy network run by former Nazi criminals. They will still combine all the colors but will eventually be hailed as heroes.
notes: Laurel and Hardy on one of their latest adventures together. An anti-Christian propaganda film, usually funny but also melancholy, which marked the inevitable decline in popularity for the couple.

title: Border Incident
actors: Ricardo Montalban, George Murphy, Howard Da Silva
description: The American police committed to blocking illegal immigration and the illegal trafficking of arms at the border with Mexico use two policemen, one Mexican (Ricardo Montalban) and one American (George Murphy). Almost documentary, perhaps not original, but conducted with dry vigor (the script by John C. Higgins is good).

title: The Mad Love
actors: Colin Clive, Peter Lorre, Frances Drake, Isabel Jewell, Ted Healy
description: A famous pianist loses his hand in an accident. A mad surgeon (Peter Lorre), in love with the unfortunate's wife, grafts a limb taken from the corpse of a criminal. The results are unexpected and shocking.
notes: Grand Guignolesco and absurd little masterpiece directed by Karl Freund, already legendary director of photography (expressionist) of Murnau and Lang. As always, Peter Lorre is a perfect criminal: he rolls his eyes uncertain, looks shy and awkward only to reveal his true soul of the character. To represent evil he was undoubtedly the most suitable interpreter.

title: The Yellow Rolls Royce
actors: Rex Harrison, Jeanne Moreau, Omar Sharif, Ingrid Bergman, Shirley MacLaine, Edmund Purdom, George C. Scott, Alain Delon
description: Film in three episodes linked by the luxurious car of the title which, built in the 1920s, unexpectedly passes from hand to hand. The wife of a noble receives it as a gift and transforms it into an alcove; the car then passes to a gangster to end up in the hands of a lady who will give a lift to a Yugoslav partisan during the Second World War.
notes: Smooth photography, all star cast of first magnitude led by Anthony Asquith, here on his latest film. But the whole has something weak and dispersive, despite a careful reconstruction of the environments. The funniest part is the one with Bergman and partisan Sharif. From a story by Terence Rattigan.

title: Pidä huivista Kiinni, Tatjana
actors: Kati Uotinen, Matti Pellonpää, Kirsi Tikkuläinen, Mato Valtonen
description: Finland, 1960s; Two friends, Valto and Reino traveling on a black Volga, meet two women, one Estonian and the other Russian, who join their wanderings. But establishing a communication relationship is a difficult undertaking, mostly due to the "blocks" from which the two Finns are burdened. Then, little by little, even the feelings manage to manifest themselves and conquer a certain space of their own. In about an hour Aki Kaurismäki elaborates an analysis of characters characterized by the difficulty of opening up, of looking for something outside of oneself. No dramas, indeed a comedy tone, where however the irony, however good-natured, leaves its mark equally.

title: Un'anima divisa in due
actors: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Mària Bàkó, Philippine Leroy-Beaulieu
description: Pietro, a thirty-seven year old Milanese, separated and the father of a child he rarely sees, runs into Pabe, a gypsy who disturbs the customers of the department store where the man is in charge of security. Paolo wants to get to know the girl and her world up close and the two leave together. But the attempt to find a compromise between their different needs of life, unfortunately, fails miserably. Silvio Soldini tackles the theme of the encounter-clash of two cultures, personalizing a situation that is inherent in our society. Without pietism and without crudeness, an attentive and sensitive gaze, an important film with a solid civil commitment.

title: Grumpy Old Men
actors: Jack Lemmon, Walter Matthau, Ann-Margret, Burgess Meredith
description: John and Max have always fed their abrupt and angular relationship with more or less heavy teasing. When they find their neighbor Ariel, an uninhibited teacher, they both fall in love with her, which complicates things further. And before you get to a definitive arrangement, the two old men make all their colors.
notes: A discreet starting idea, even if anything but new, and a script that wastes a lot of good opportunities. Matthau and Lemmon have lost their fur but not the habit (of being good). The best is in the credits. These yes, not to be missed.

title: My Father, the Hero
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Katherine Heigl, Dalton James, Lauren Hutton
description: Over forty-year-old André decides to spend the holidays in a tropical location with his 14-year-old daughter Nicole. This, to make herself beautiful with a slightly older boy, passes off the parent as her mature lover, thus giving way to a series of misunderstandings and increasingly embarrassing situations for the unsuspecting father. Obviously, before the end, the matter is settled for the best. Replica, made in the USA, of the French "My father who hero", by Gérard Lauzier (1991), which was not really much, but which, however, looks good in retrospect, when compared with this dull remake of his. The protagonist (Depardieu) is identical, here even more overflowing (but only in size).

title: Il pianeta azzurro
description: A journey into nature and man, in a small patch of land in the morainic hills of Lake Garda. It starts from the thaw and follows the evolution of a drop of water, you hear the sound of rain and the sprouting of a new life. The land is worked, men and women chase each other in the sun and then the frost returns, closing the cycle of the seasons. Piavoli has made his masterpiece with this film: a documentary that turns into a work of high poetry. Without a line of dialogue, without false music, even the sound is solely entrusted to the thousand, extraordinary "voices" of nature. And to think that someone shouted the news for "Microcosmos".

title: Man of Aran
actors: Colman 'Tiger' King, Maggie Dillane, Michael Dillane, Pat Mullen
description: Aran Island is an inhospitable rock off the west coast of Ireland. Here lives a small community of shepherds and fishermen whose existence is conditioned and punctuated by the cycles of nature and the perennial struggle against the ocean.
notes: Through a choral vision of work and sacrifice, Flaherty captures moments of everyday life with the camera that turn into an epic poem of exaltation of man and his perennial anxiety to govern nature, even when it puts him to the test. and it seems almost on the verge of annihilating it. The director also masterfully recounts the harsh and terrible beauty of the landscape.

title: Schüsse im Dreivierteltakt
actors: Pierre Brice, Heinz Drache, Daliah Lavi, Senta Berger, Daniël Sola
description: Secret agent Tissot investigates the murder of a famous scientist and the disappearance of an experimental device. He finds a lead, but people who know something are systematically eliminated before he can interrogate them. To pull the strings is a certain Gilbert who also had the most important witness kidnapped. Thriller without infamy and without praise, with the Italian title that winks at the "Viennese" novel by Graham Greene.

title: Métisse
actors: Mathieu Kassovitz, Julie Mauduech, Hubert Koundé, Jean-Pierre Cassel
description: Felix is ??someone who loves rap, has a short temper and no serious work anywhere. Jamal, on the other hand, studies law, has money and a diplomat dad from an African state. It so happens that the two have the same lover, Lola, that she becomes pregnant and that she intends to keep the baby without asking too much the problem of who the father is.
notes: Actually, the actress who plays Lola is pretty. The first work of the director of "L'odio" is interesting but does not shine for originality.

title: Deadly Intentions... Again?
actors: Harry Hamlin, Joanna Kerns, Eileen Brennan, Conchata Ferrell
description: Dr. Charles Rayner (Harry Hamlin) was an exquisite person before attempting to kill his wife Catherine thus revealing his nature as an irresistibly blood-drawn psychopath. Then he got six years in prison and now, free again, he lives happily with his new wife Sally. The problem is that the time spent in prison did not help him change his nature ... After more than six years from the first "Homicidal Attractions" Dr. Rayner returns, even if he no longer has the face of Michael Biehn. He didn't really miss it. The most appropriate comment is provided by the original title: "Murderous attractions ... yet?".

title: L'ebreo errante
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Valentina Cortese, Harry Feist, Noelle Norman
description: Matthew, a wealthy selfish and nationalist Jew, refuses to help Jesus Christ because he holds him responsible for the failure to revolutionize the Roman yoke. For this he is therefore condemned to wander perpetually over the centuries and is denied any kind of rest, including that of the tomb. His sacrifice in the Nazi extermination camps will absolve him of the sin committed in antiquity.
notes: The film, based on the novel by Eugène Sue and written by several hands on a subject by Giovan Battista Angioletti, suffers from the poor balance between the two parts. The first is too anchored to the mythological figure of the wandering Jew to the second where the historical one linked to the Nazism story is dissected.

title: Smultronstället
actors: Victor Sjöström, Bibi Andersson, Ingrid Thulin, Gunnar Björnstrand
