description: Elder Professor Isak Borg, a medical luminary, goes to collect a coveted award in Lund University's Aula Magna. Before embarking on the journey he has a premonitory dream that invites him to reconsider his whole life. On the long journey he is accompanied by his daughter-in-law Marianne who is in crisis with her husband, a cold and selfish man. The stop at Borg's birthplace is an opportunity to rethink the past and return to the "place of strawberries".
notes: It is one of the masterpieces of the Swedish director who traces, between dream and nightmare, the existential itinerary of a man who is not calmly heading towards death. The film won the Golden Bear at the Berlin Film Festival and numerous other awards around the world.

title: Mr.Belvedere Rings the Bell
actors: Clifton Webb, Joanne Dru, Hugh Marlowe
description: Mr. Belvedere lectures throughout the US on the art of aging well. Arriving in a village where the situation of the hospitalized patients is particularly serious, he is admitted incognito and begins to put his theories into practice. Despite difficulties and suspicions, his intervention works wonders; when he can no longer support the fiction, the atmosphere of the hospital is very different from what he found on arrival.
notes: The story is the most obvious and predictable thing a screenwriter can think of, but there is no lack of good moments of authentic comedy.

title: Letter to Three Wives
actors: Linda Darnell, Jeanne Crain, Ann Sothern, Kirk Douglas
description: Three ladies who are about to take a trip to the countryside receive a letter from a mutual friend, Eva Ross, announcing that she ran away with the husband of one of them. The three women pretend not to care, but during the day they are worried and fearful of the news they have received. It occurs to the youngest of the three that her husband Bill had once been in love with Eva. Rita, wife of a literature professor, is anxious when recalling an episode from her married life. Gradually, therefore, a cross section of meanness, restlessness, small tragedies is composed. Mankiewicz, who won the Oscar as the screenwriter and director of this film, creates a jewel of sophistication and malice, one of the most bitter comedies about the American bourgeoisie.

title: Agatha Christie's "Murder In Three Acts"
actors: Peter Ustinov, Tony Curtis, Emma Samms, Fernando Allende
description: Famous detective Hercule Poirot is called to investigate a difficult murder case. The crime happened in Acapulco, in the sumptuous residence where a famous actor retired to find his youth. The mystery is thickened by a second, probable murder about which Poirot has many doubts, but whose mystery he is called upon to dissolve with the acumen that is proverbial. The site of the crime and other miserable events is a fabulous residence in Acapulco; here lives a famous actor, retired from the world of entertainment and intent on rediscovering his youth ...

title: Men in War
actors: Robert Ryan, Robert Keith, Aldo Ray, Vic Morrow
description: In 1950, during the Korean War, an American patrol was cut off from the main troops. Their jeep also breaks down and the materials can no longer be transported. In the meantime, however, another jeep arrives in which Sergeant Montana and a wounded colonel travel. Anti-heroic war film that even recalled, at the time, the Norman Mailer of the "Nude and the Dead".

title: The Blue Bird
actors: Shirley Temple, Johnny Russell, Gale Sondergaard
description: Little brother and sister embark on a fantastic journey in search of the little bird of happiness. For three quarters of the film they have endless adventures, until, discouraged, they return home, just in time to make the incredible discovery. The mythical bird has always been in their garden ...
notes: Based on the fairy tale "The Blue Bird" by Maurice Maeterlinck, the film recalls and attempts to exploit the success of "The Wizard of Oz", released the year before. Walter Lang deploys a dazzling technicolor for the use of a Shirley Temple no longer a child prodigy.

title: La pecora nera
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Lisa Gastoni, Adrienne La Russa
description: The figure of the honorable Mario Agosti is immaculate and untouchable. Much less that of his twin brother Filippo who, exploiting the similarity, manages to sneak into the world of politics and finance and combine excellent deals, while his brother Mario ends up in an asylum.
notes: The intentions of the results are always improving, in most of Salce's films. The political allegory is not always convincing but the fun is not lacking.

title: Lotte in Italia
actors: Cristiana Tullio Altan, Anne Wiazemsky, Jerome Hinstin
description: It is the story of the ideological formation of Paola, a militant bourgeois girl in an extra-parliamentary group. Excellent and practically unpublished Godard halfway between fiction and documentary.

title: Fata Morgana
description: Werner Herzog traveling in Saharan Africa, Kenya, Tanzania, Guinea and the Canary Islands, captures with the camera the images of a world that can be considered as a metaphor for the development of life (and death) on the earth's crust. The German director, to shoot this singular documentary, is inspired by the sacred text of some Indians of Guatemala, the "Popul Vuh", dividing it, like that, into three sections: "Creation", "Paradise" and "Age Of their". Extreme meditation on the present and future of man, an apocalyptic geographical and spiritual itinerary in the realms of a nature raped by civilization and industrialization.

title: Les Baliseurs du désert
actors: Nacer Khemir, Soufiana Makni, Chedi Ben Hadj, Hassiba Rochdi
description: A teacher sets off to reach a village in the desert where he will have to settle as an educator. But the new experience, lived in contact with the wild nature of the desert, will turn into an inner journey to the center of the enigmas of existence.
notes: First work whose subject is based on a legend handed down orally.

title: Sands of Iwo Jima
actors: John Wayne, John Agar, Forrest Tucker
description: Sergeant Stryker (Wayne) is in command of a platoon of Marine recruits. For his brutal and violent ways of training he is hated by the whole troop. Stryker is a soldier who knows what good training is worth to face a battle. This is why he asks the best of his men. They will notice this during the landing at Iwo Jima, where they will discover the human side of their sergeant. Classic war film centered on the figure of the soldier all homeland and spirit of body (a very effective Wayne). The film alternates fiction with real documentary passages from the Iwo Jima landing, including the sequence of the flag.

title: Gold
actors: Roger Moore, Susannah York, Ray Milland, John Gielgud
description: A group of speculators wants to raise the world price of gold: this is why he plans to blow up a large mine by taking advantage of the fact that a large body of water extends behind a rocky wall. The task of the excavation is entrusted to the engineer Rod Slater, specially promoted and kept in the dark. Slater provides some safety measures but, while he is absent, the flooding of the tunnels occurs: he will have to intervene promptly, with the help of a heroic miner ...
notes: Based on a Wilbur Smith novel, the film immediately abandons the ambitions of denunciation to concentrate on the show, but it turns out to be a bit slow in its development.

title: Mio figlio Nerone
actors: Alberto Sordi, Gloria Swanson, Vittorio De Sica, Brigitte Bardot, Giorgia Moll
description: The life of Emperor Nero was beautiful, amidst idleness, excesses, wines and beautiful women. The sensible words of Seneca or the indignant ones of her mother Agrippina are worthless. He enjoys life with Poppea and, if he really has to commit to anything, the only thing that attracts him is the death of Agrippina, badly attempted and failed several times.
notes: We are in full parody, which dad Steno knew how to handle and enrich much better than his children did in "S.P.Q.R.".

title: Lady Ice
actors: Donald Sutherland, Jennifer O'Neill, Robert Duvall, Patrick Magee
description: Hired by an insurance company to investigate a jewelry theft, private investigator Hammond Klute is hired as a mechanic by a certain Fred Booths, whom he suspects is the head of the organization responsible for the thefts. What he does not suspect is that he will end up falling in love with his daughter, Paula.
notes: You know Donald Sutherland, silent and thoughtful who plays Klute in Alan J. Pakula's film of the same name? Well, forget it because this has nothing to do with it: he is talkative and vain beyond all limits. Not to mention that Jennifer O'Neil is not Jane Fonda.

title: Anni 90
actors: Christian De Sica, Nadia Rinaldi, Massimo Boldi, Andrea Roncato, Ezio Greggio, Nino Frassica, Valeria D'Obici
description: The adventure of a night of sex ruined by the girl's excessive sanitary objections; a phone call ended with a rear-end collision; a child takes them from his father and also from the inspector of the association for the protection of children; a spoiled wedding anniversary; a curious group sex therapy; an inglorious end to carnival; the collective psychosis of fear.
notes: When Italian cinema (in its most squalid component) seeks the consent of the most naïve public, tickling it with an underdeveloped humor, for decerebrated spectators, and obtains the disheartening triumph of the worst of the worst at the box office.

title: Mo' Money
actors: Damon Wayans, Stacey Dash, Joe Santos, Marlon Wayans
description: Johnny, a young young man, starts to travel the underworld road with his younger brother Seymour. He gets away in a first trial with supervised freedom and, from here on, found a job, it is all a frenetic adventure based on manipulated credit cards and blackmail of dishonest superiors, with love stories lived or rejected.
notes: The film is not unworthy, but it is certainly a fragassone and superficial, in a mixture of genres not always controlled, from bloody violence to dementia comedy. Good Damion and Marlon Wayans (the two brothers).

title: Murder, She Said
actors: Margaret Rutherford, Charles Tingwell, Arthur Kennedy, Muriel Pavlow
description: Through a train window, elderly Miss Marple spots a man intent on strangling a girl. The police don't listen to his story, but a librarian does. The two begin to investigate: disguised as toll booths, they search the railway line and discover a track that leads to the Crackenthorpe villa, where Miss Marple gets hired as a maid. Once in the mansion ...
notes: Taken from _Istantanea di un delitto_ by Agatha Christie, with an excellent interpretation of the protagonist Margaret Rutherford (the writer, however, never approved of this choice). At the time, Ron Goodwin's tune was a great success.

title: La morte negli occhi del gatto
actors: Jane Birkin, Hiram Keller, Françoise Christophe
description: In Dragstone Castle, the curse that weighs on the MacGrieffs seems to be fulfilled: the members of the family are killed one after the other. Young Corringa MacGrieff suspects her cousin. Minestrone between yellow and horror, with a sprinkle of eroticism, written and directed by Antonio Margheriti.

title: Les visiteurs
actors: Jean Reno, Christian Clavier, Valérie Lemercier, Marie-Anne Chazel
description: In 1122 the noble Goffredo di Montalcino left the war to marry, according to the will of King Louis VI of France, the beautiful Frenegonda. But he makes up a mess and, to make up for it, he drinks, together with his faithful squire Giancoglione, the potion prepared for him by a sorceress. Something is wrong and the two find themselves thrown forward by 871 years, which is to say today.
notes: A colossal success, and not only in France, for a film with some screenplay hitch, but with some occasion for entertainment, albeit in the use of an expedient (the "leap" of centuries, with relative hindrances) that is anything but original .

title: Conagher
actors: Sam Elliott, Katharine Ross, Barry Corbin, Billy Green Bush
description: A cowboy abandons his wandering life to help the widow Teale, whose husband one day left to sell cattle and never returned. Since then, the woman has been running a diligence station dangerously close to Indian territories on her own, and is also raising two children. But out there there are not only the Red Indians: in fact the bandits are always ready to take advantage of the most defenseless, at least until a noble gunslinger gets in the way ...
notes: Produced for TNT cable TV, it has a somewhat slow pace: the result is an effective western atmospheric, full of poetry and with a perfectly partially Elliott.

title: Creature
actors: Stan Ivar, Wendy Schaal, Lyman Ward, Klaus Kinski
description: A space expedition is sent on a mission to Titan, satellite of the planet Saturn, to investigate life forms that have proved fatal to a previous expedition. Upon landing on the celestial body, the astronauts make a terrifying discovery ...
notes: Science fiction in the wake of "Alien". With the participation of Klaus Kinski who shines in the grayness of the cast.

title: Forever Lulu
actors: Hanna Schygulla, Alec Baldwin, Deborah Harry
description: Bad luck rages against a woman aspiring novelist (Schygulla) who, waiting for her long-awaited success, works in a toilet seat factory and writes sexy letters in "Penthouse". Everything changes, incredibly, when she ends up involved in an adventurous affair of drugs and killings.
notes: Comedy that you would like to be light, but it's just boring and grungy. First film for actor Alec Baldwin, it also marked Hanna Schygulla's debut in US cinema.

title: Mille bolle blu
actors: Matteo Fadda, Giacomo Fadda, Stefano Masciarelli, Carla Benedetti, Stefano Dionisi, Claudio Bigagli
description: Rome, summer 1961, before the solar eclipse. Sandrino is nine years old and perceives many stories concerning the condominiums of the popular building in which he lives: a fugitive who has joined his wife; two boys who love each other opposed by her family; three brothers around their father's deathbed, with the maid who is the only one truly afflicted; a man who has had eye surgery ...
notes: An appreciable directorial debut by Leone Pompucci, narrator with the sign of elegance, without too much honey, forced youthfulness or presumptuous autobiographical ostentation. Little Sandrino's "point of view" holds up with measure and sensitivity.

title: The Beverly Hillbillies
actors: Diedrich Bader, Dabney Coleman, Erika Eleniak, Cloris Leachman
description: The Clampetts, very crude mountaineers, have sold their farm, under which an oil field was discovered, and are now full of money. They therefore move to Beverly Hills where, however, the first impact with the opulent society is rather abrupt. Vultures aiming for their money are busy, but our heroes, lacking in refinement, are not at all in flair and intelligence. At the origin of the film there is an unknown television series in Italy (and many specific references from us are lost). The humor is rather coarse, but there are some tasty moments. The director is that of "Fusi di testa" and (alas!) Of "Piccole canaglie".

title: Un été inoubliable
actors: Kristin Scott Thomas, Claudiu Bleont, Olga Tudorache, Marcel Iures
description: Romania, 1920s. Captain Dimitriu's wife rejects the advances of a general and he assigns the officer to a garrison on the border with Bulgaria. It is a turbulent area and, when the order comes to capture hostages and shoot them in response to the killing of some border guards, Captain Dimitriu is torn between military discipline and his sense of justice. The film speaks of the past, but as an obvious metaphor for a current reality. It is a "poor" production, but of high moral tension as well as accurate and convincing narrative, also embellished by the impeccable acting of the performers.

title: Sirens
actors: Hugh Grant, Tara Fitzgerald, Sam Neill, Elle Macpherson, Portia De Rossi, Kate Fischer
description: The young Anglican pastor Anthony Campion, who has just arrived in Australia from England, is sent, with his wife, to the estate of the painter Norman Lindsay to persuade him to withdraw one of his paintings considered obscene from an exhibition. But here, amid the pagan theories of the artist, the casual behavior of his models and the initiatives of a neighbor, the marriage of Reverend Campion risks crisis.
notes: The attempt to suggest morally disturbing atmospheres - in the real Lindsay estate, in the Blue Mountains - has succeeded and the story is sufficiently appealing. The models are sculptural, but the revelation is Tara Fitzgerald, Campion's wife.

title: For the Love of Nancy
actors: Tracey Gold, Jill Clayburgh, William Devane, Cameron Bancroft
description: Nancy Walsh is the youngest of the house, she is well liked at school as well as by her parents. In short, there is no reason why he starts to reject food, to invent subterfuges to hide it from his people and, in the end, to refuse even the help of doctors. The topic and the cast are touching. The first is because anorexia is a more widespread and unmentionable disease than is usually thought. The second is because, in addition to Devane and Clayburgh, she features a Tracey Gold ("Shoot the Moon") definitely in the role.

title: Le bon plaisir
actors: Catherine Deneuve, Jean-Louis Trintignant, Michel Serrault
description: Claire, an established designer, had a son of a prominent politician ten years earlier, who has now become Head of State. One evening the purse in which she keeps the letter revealing the scandal is stolen. From here starts a chain of dramatic events in which the naive good faith of those who believe in the value of truth and the shady interests of those seeking their own advantage are confused. The film would like to be a denunciation of the intrigues and cynicism of the Power, but the results give the feuilleton. The superficiality of the approach gives space to the good job of the interpreters.

title: Omen IV: The Awakening
actors: Faye Grant, Michael Woods, Michael Lerner, Madison Mason
description: The girl adopted by the York spouses is called Delia and brings with her strange omens. At baptism the priest dies of a heart attack and Sister Francesca too. The other sister responsible for the adoption turns into prostitution. Years later Delia risks getting under a truck, but is saved by a dog. An unpleasant school friend of hers dies beheaded. Does it take long to understand that she is the daughter of the Antichrist? It is the fourth episode of the series and was born under bad omens. The project languishes for years before turning into a TV movie. The first director Othenin-Gérard is declared incapable and replaced with Montesi. The result is terrifying.

title: Dominick and Eugene
actors: Tom Hulce, Ray Liotta, Jamie Lee Curtis
description: Nick and Gino are twenty-six-year-old twins. The first works to keep the other at university (medicine). Nick is mentally retarded. Everything is fine with Gino: study, love. The story of a child killed by a abusive father brings out the shocking reason for Nick's condition from the past. And this memory, strengthening the affection between the two, will give more security to the less fortunate. Robert Young is not looking for melodrama numbers. The pathetic is contained by a very careful script and sober direction. Well done the two protagonists.

title: Violent Saturday
actors: Victor Mature, Richard Egan, Lee Marvin, Virginia Leith
description: One Saturday morning, four bandits storm the Branderville bank. After the blow, three of them fall back on the Stadt farm, where a fourth accomplice with the truck awaits them. The bandits take over the house, with the Stadt and the engineer Shelley Martin. Shelley, however, gets rid of their accomplice and confronts them, immediately killing two of them. The survivor injures him but has not reckoned with the quiet farmer Stadt.
notes: Good gangster movie with an unusual countryside setting. This allows for some unusual formal solutions, thanks to Fleischer's close direction. The film was the springboard for Lee Marvin.

title: The Turning Point
actors: Anne Bancroft, Shirley MacLaine, Mikhail Baryshnikov, Leslie Browne
description: Emma Jacklin and Deedee Rodgers were friends when they competed in dance; then the second got married, but had a grudge against Emma. When a daughter of Deedee decides to devote herself to ballet, the relations between the colleagues of the past become even more stormy ...
notes: Eleven Oscar nominations for a film that is made strong by two great actresses and the prodigious exploits of Mikhail Baryshnikov. Drama, music and fourteen numbers of the American Ballet for a show of proven craft and great appeal. Written by Arthur Laurents, former writer of Hitchcock's _Knot in the Throat_ and Pollack's _How We Were_.

title: L'insegnante balla... con tutta la classe
actors: Nadia Cassini, Lino Banfi, Alvaro Vitali, Mario Carotenuto, Renzo Montagnani
description: In a high school, gymnastics teacher Claudia Gambetti (Nadia Cassini), wreaks havoc thanks to her attractiveness and her particular teaching method, based on dance. Then he heals the school's finances (squandered by the principal) by winning an acrobatic rock competition. Yet another variation on the scholastic-erotic theme.

title: Storia di Piera
actors: Hanna Schygulla, Marcello Mastroianni, Isabelle Huppert, Bettina Grühn, Maurizio Donadoni
description: The father is engaged in politics, the mother is a candid nymphomaniac who goes where the senses lead her. Little Piera grows up tossed between her father's disorientation (very much in love with his wife, but distressed by her behavior) and her mother's sexual raids. The parents both end up in an asylum, and the daughter, surprisingly, becomes an actress.
notes: From the novel of the same name by Piera degli Esposti and Dacia Maraini, a surreal apologue on femininity described as an absolute, almost mythical nature, extraneous to the movements of history. Maraini scripts with the director and certainly her didacticism does not help the representation.

title: Body Puzzle
actors: Joanna Pacula, Tomas Arana, François Montagut, Gianni Garko
description: A highway in the pouring rain: a car and a motorcycle whiz by at high speed, collide, the motorcyclist is thrown from the saddle. The beautiful young Tracy remains a widow. But, suddenly, a series of murders upsets her life: the victims are the people who have had the organs of their deceased husband transplanted ... A thriller with horror implications (a la Dario Argento) by one of the Italian specialists of the genre. Also redistributed as "Mysteria".

title: Kongshan lingyu
actors: Shi Jun, Hsu Feng, Sun Yue, Wu Mincai, Tian Feng
description: Attracted by the precious Mahayana Sutra scroll, a dignitary, a governor, a Buddhist teacher, a thief named White Fox and other similar characters arrive at the San Bao Temple. Colorful fairy tale set at the time of the Ming dynasty.

title: Hsia nu
actors: Shih Chun, Hsu Feng, Roy Chiao, Pai Ying, Han Hsue, Han Yin-Chieh
description: At the time of the Ming, the young scholar Ku Sheng-chai helps the mysterious Yang Hui-chen in her fight against the men of the secret police. It is the most famous film of the Pekingese, transplanted to Hong Kong, King Hu. A swashbuckling masterpiece, a postmodern fairy tale that revolutionized action cinema. The Italian subtitle is "La fanciulla cavaliere errante".

title: Cinema of Vengeance
actors: Bruce Lee, Jackie Chan, Lance Henriksen
description: Old clips of Bruce Lee, interviews with Jackie Chan, Cynthia Rohtrock and many others. Plus an interview with Lance Henriksen on the set of "Hard Target". It is a sort of essay on Hong Kong action cinema with various excerpts from films unreleased by us.

title: The Sting II
actors: Jackie Gleason, Mac Davis, Oliver Reed, Teri Garr, Karl Malden
description: New York, 1940. The gangster Doyle Lonnegan (Reed) is on the hunt for Henry Gondorff (Gleason) and Johnny Hooker (Davis), the two brilliant crooks who "stang" (and ridiculed) him, stealing five hundred thousand dollars. Meanwhile Hooker passes himself off as a promising middleweight and convinces Macalinski, a shady nightclub owner, to bet on him. But of course it's a scam. Don't expect an echo of the film that had captivated audiences ten years earlier. The inevitable confrontation is lost from the start. Jackie Gleason, Newman's opponent in 1961 in the "Spaccone", here replaces him as Gondorff.

title: The Shanghai Gesture
actors: Gene Tierney, Victor Mature, Walter Huston, Ona Munson
description: The owner of a dubious Shanghai gambling house bribes (with games, drugs and sex) the daughter of her ex-husband and now her enemy and moralizer of the mores of the city. But revenge will turn against her. Extraordinary film crossed by a perverse and ominously melodramatic air which at the time caused scandal. Some scenes are truly memorable starting with the Chinese New Year, ending with the Mother Gin Sling banquet. Too bad that among the surviving copies there is not one that has the same duration as the other.

title: Three Faces of Eve
actors: Joanne Woodward, David Wayne, Lee J. Cobb, Edwin Jerome
description: A young woman, Eva, wife of Ralph White and mother of a baby girl, suffers from severe migraines. One day in full crisis he tries, without realizing it, to strangle his daughter. Her husband manages to get her a good specialist doctor. After a thorough examination, he discovers that Eva suffers from schizophrenia and therefore from a split personality.
notes: Based on the book of two doctors, a drama with strong colors, written by Johnson himself, who also produced it. Intense interpretation of Woodward that earned her an Oscar.

title: The Taking of Pelham One Two Three
actors: Walter Matthau, Robert Shaw, Martin Balsam, Hector Elizondo
description: Four bandits, with chronometric precision, storm the New York subway and hijack the Pelham 123 wagon with 17 passengers and a controller on board. To free the hostages they ask for a million dollars otherwise they will kill them one by one. Lieutenant Garber is in charge of the operation. Carrying the money to the wagon, he senses the moves of the bandits and confronts them by vanquishing the gang.
notes: Excellent detective story with an exemplary dramatic crescendo. The suspense almost never drops, and Matthau is good and also manages to be ironic (for example in the finale).

title: Blood and Sand
actors: Tyrone Power, Rita Hayworth, Linda Darnell, Anthony Quinn
description: Juan Galliardo is a son of art. In the sense that he chooses, despite maternal opposition, to be a bullfighter like his father (who died in the arena). Having become famous and rich, married to the woman of his heart, he falls into the seduction of a high-class adventurer, Donna Sol, in whose hands he becomes a toy.
notes: Re-creation, from the story by Vicente Blasco Ibañez, of a 1922 film with Rodolfo Valentino. With so many stars and valuable images (Oscar for photography), Mamoulian is sure to aim for melodrama. Today it is very dated, but the Hayworth reigns supreme.

title: The Scalphunters
actors: Burt Lancaster, Ossie Davis, Telly Savalas, Shelley Winters
description: Hunter Joe Bass is stolen from the Indians all the hides he intended to sell and, in exchange, he is left with a black slave, Joseph Lee. Joe wants to take back the stolen goods, so he gives life to his personal "treasure hunt" which will be full of unexpected events and pitfalls, so much so that he will risk leaving his own skin several times.
notes: An ironic and original western. To remember the finale, with Lancaster and Savalas in the desert, and again Lancaster with Ossie Davis in the mud.

title: Comizi d'amore
actors: Pier Paolo Pasolini, Alberto Moravia, Cesare Musatti, Io Apolloni, Ignazio Buttitta, Camilla Cederna, Graziella Chiarcossi, Peppino Di Capri, Oriana Fallaci, Graziella Granata, Antonella Lualdi, Giuseppe Ungaretti
description: Investigation film composed of various interviews on sex and surroundings (relationships, marriage, divorce, prostitution, detours, etc.) shot in all Italian regions and in different social environments. The answers (there are hundreds!) Are interspersed with interventions by the writer Alberto Moravia and the psychologist Cesare Musatti. A curious unicum in the history of Italian cinema.

title: Mad Dog and Glory
actors: Robert De Niro, Uma Thurman, Bill Murray, David Caruso
description: Dobie, a Chicago Criminal Police officer, is shy. One day, by foiling a robbery in a grocery store, he saves the life of a gangster who, gratefully, gives him his babe as a gift for a week. Dobie feels a little uncomfortable, but then falls in love with the girl and is faced with the dangerous gangster.
notes: Quite atypical detective story, comedy is a bit schematic (and cynical), but luckily there are Robert De Niro and Bill Murray to support the story, ensuring the fun. Cult scene: De Niro in love who enters a bar where a corpse lies, but is so happy that he selects "American Gigolo" on the juke-box and starts dancing and singing in front of his astonished colleagues.

title: Cracker Jack
actors: Thomas Ian Griffith, Nastassja Kinski, Christopher Plummer
description: Jack, a Chicago cop, just escaped a bombing in which his wife and child were killed. Having entered into a depressive crisis, he goes, in the company of his brother and sister-in-law, to a tourist resort in the Rocky Mountains for a holiday. Here he has to contend with a group of mercenaries who intend to eliminate a mafia boss to steal a treasure in diamonds. Originality is banned. Between shootings, attacks, Mafia bosses in crisis of conscience, plots and massacres announced, the hero arrives as expected who also takes the opportunity to dispel the ghosts of his past. A little sorry that Nastassja Kinski got lost in these productions.

title: Shampoo
actors: Warren Beatty, Julie Christie, Goldie Hawn, Lee Grant, William Castle
description: George is a Beverly Hills hairdresser for ladies and a well-known seducer. We are on the eve of the 1968 presidential elections, and around the protagonist revolve Jill, unemployed starlet, Jackie, divorced and lover of Lester and Felicia, who is Lester's wife. George seeks funding for a new salon and finds himself in a "tour" so unscrupulous that it makes him uncomfortable. A comedy, but full of bitter and caustic juices. The portrait of a vitriolic environment, the picture of a society without values ??other than those of money, without ideals other than those of success at any cost. Excellent interpreters.

title: Wrestling Ernest Hemingway
actors: Robert Duvall, Richard Harris, Shirley MacLaine, Sandra Bullock
description: Walter, a retired barber, and Frank, a former sea captain, meet on a bench in Florida. They have very different characters, the first shy and elegant, the second extrovert and womanizer, and perhaps for this reason they get along well with each other. Frank often talks about his youth challenge to fight with Ernest Hemingway. For both of them this friendship will have important consequences. Not everything in the film works perfectly (some pauses, some refinements), but when the elements blend well (tenderness, melancholy) the result is respectable. And the two protagonists do not have moments of tiredness: absolutely perfect.

title: Strane storie
actors: Ivano Marescotti, Silvia Cohen, Mariella Valentini, Flavio Bonacci, Alfredo Pea
description: On the train, a girl asks her father to tell some "fairy tales". And here is the man whose air is cut off for not paying his bill; the woman who buys a man at the supermarket and then brings him back because "expired"; the real war between a family from the South and the neighboring "northerners". In conclusion, the characters pass by the remains of a wrecked train. Discreet debut in the "long" by Sandro Baldoni, also screenwriter with Johnny Dell'Orto. Fantastic events, but with precise allusions to reality. And the ending, with the "Italicus" ripped apart by the bomb, is an idea that is worth the film.

title: Zelly and Me
actors: Isabella Rossellini, Glynis Johns, Alexandra Johnes, David Lynch
description: A rich but very unhappy girl who lives with an overprotective grandmother finds comfort with her housekeeper.
notes: Psychological survey, with interesting results, on the issue of the damage that certain "good intentions" of adults can cause to children. But the most curious thing is the cast.

title: Shaft's Big Score
actors: Richard Roundtree, Moses Gunn, Joseph Mascolo
description: Cal Asby, a friend of black private investigator John Shaft, is killed in a coup against an insurance company. Which investigates.
notes: Violent and tangled accumulation of episodic actions in the sequel to the classic blaxploitation _Shaft the detective_.

title: Murder at the Gallop
actors: Margaret Rutherford, Flora Robson, Robert Morley
description: Miss Marple investigates the suspicious death of old Mr. Enderby. The trail of his investigation is soon littered with corpses.
notes: Tasty setting and well characterized interpretations. British production based on a novel by Agatha Christie, whose protagonist was actually Poirot.

title: Le rayon vert
actors: Marie Rivière, Béatrice Romand, Amira Chemakhi, Sylvie Richez, Rosette, Vincent Gauthier, Basile Gervaise, Marcello Pezzutto
description: Delphine cannot decide where she will spend her holidays: the sea makes her bored, the mountain makes her sad. A boy manages to convince her to spend a few days in a fishing village: here they will witness the revealing phenomenon of the "green ray". Rohmer in its purest form: lightness and freedom. Improvisation in the dialogues, distant inspiration from a novel (of the same name) by Jules Verne. Golden Lion in Venice.

title: Les sept pechés capitaux
directors: Jean-Luc Godard, Claude Chabrol, Philippe De Broca, Jacques Demy, Sylvain Dhomme, Max Douy, Edouard Molinaro, Roger Vadim
actors: Claude Brasseur, Jean-Louis Trintignant, Marina Vlady
description: Episode movies: the seven deadly sins are the pretext to tell seven stories bordering on comedy. It's hard to imagine seven more different directors. The results are also very similar, and on the whole there is no memorable episode, even if the whole is curious and pleasant. Dhomme's episode "Wrath" was written by Ionesco. In Molinaro's "Invidia", for example, a waitress becomes the lover of the rich man who maintains a diva she envies. In Godard's "Laziness", which is the most original and mocking episode, an actor (Constantine) renounces the offers of an attractive actress out of laziness.

title: The Scarlet Empress
actors: Marlene Dietrich, John Lodge, Sam Jaffe, C. Aubrey Smith
description: The young Sofia is given in marriage to the Grand Duke Pietro, future Tsar of all the Russias. The bridegroom, however, turns out to be very different from how they had written it. Sofia will have him killed and will ascend the throne with the name of Catherine II. Probably von Sternberg's masterpiece. A historical drama permeated with an exasperated sensuality, wrapped in baroque and redundant scenographies that point to absolute visionaryness that leads to total delirium.

title: Divina creatura
actors: Laura Antonelli, Terence Stamp, Michele Placido, Marcello Mastroianni
description: In the Rome of the 1920s, an aristocrat falls in love - reciprocated - with a bourgeois woman, Manoela Roderighi. However, he discovers that the woman attends a brothel in which environment she had been introduced by the perverse cousin. For a while, the strange "triangle" works, until Manoela, no longer holding up the situation, flees to Paris ...
notes: A film with ambitions of denunciation (politics and customs), but which does not come out of the way sketches. It is a calligraphic reinterpretation of the novel _La divina fanciulla_ by Luciano Zuccoli. The irony is not lacking, but Antonelli is unable to give depth to Manoela's character.

title: Deux
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Maruschka Detmers
description: Marc Lambert, concert organizer, wants to buy the Montmartre house that belonged to his teacher Stadler. This is how he meets Hélène, a real estate agent. The result is a relationship that goes into inevitable ups and downs.

title: Kiss Them For Me
actors: Cary Grant, Jayne Mansfield, Suzy Parker, Ray Walston
description: During the Second World War, three US naval officers, stationed for some time in the Pacific, are granted a few days' leave. The desire to have fun is great, but the time available to them is very little. The three young men decide to spend a weekend in San Francisco. Their time thus passes among seductive women, vulgar speculators and nightclubs. Then comes the news that their aircraft carrier has been sunk ...
notes: Without Jayne Mansfield and her "forms" this comedy is very little, despite the fact that it is directed by a talented professional like Stanley Donen.

title: La città delle donne
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Ettore Manni, Anna Prucnal, Bernice Stegers
description: Snaporaz, a middle-aged man, gets off the train on which he is traveling with his wife to follow a mysterious woman. He finds himself first in a hotel where wild feminists hold a tumultuous conference (of which he understands nothing), then in the castle of a certain Katzone, a guru of eroticism, then in a court where women condemn him and in an arena where he must be lynched. Unbridled fantasy, highly inventive iconography for what appears to be the attempt to exorcise once and for all a fundamental Fellini "taboo": the woman. But, with a tiring and tangled path, an effort of little construct. Perhaps the director's least successful film.

title: Correre contro
actors: Stefano Dionisi, Stefania Rocca, Massimo Bellinzoni
description: Following an accident, Pablo was left paralyzed in his legs and since then his life has passed through a center for the disabled. His best friend is a volunteer named Daniele, but also the relationship with him seems to crack when Chiara arrives in the life of both. Pablo sacrifices himself and pushes Daniele into the girl's arms, without knowing that she is in love with him. For unknown reasons Antonio Tibaldi had his debut years ago in Canada with "The color of his eyes" a film starring Judy Davis. For other reasons, albeit still unknown, he returned to Italy to shoot this silly and predictable story.

title: Shopping
actors: Sadie Frost, Jude Law, Sean Pertwee, Marianne Faithfull
description: Billy (Law) is nineteen when he gets out of jail and the first thought is to regain his position as a field in the world of night, crime and "shopping". "Shopping" means shopping, but in this case it means stealing a car, entering a shop window with it and taking what you need. And Billy for "shopping" is unbeatable. Paul Anderson is part of that English new wave that, rather than staging a Forster novel, would get himself killed. Its model is "Lethal Weapon", but also Besson's cinema. This is his first work. The second is "Mortal Kombat".

title: Cinque marines per Singapore
actors: Sean Flynn, Marc Michel
description: Five Marines must investigate the disappearance of some US Army officers in Singapore. The kidnapper is a mad doctor who intends to blackmail the US government.

title: Fort Apache, the Bronx
actors: Paul Newman, Danny Aiello, Rachel Ticotin
description: Senior Officer Murphy works in the high-crime district of the Bronx. The new captain is strong-willed, the policemen indulge in often unjustified violence. After the killing of an innocent boy by two officers and the death of a nurse friend from an overdose, Murphy wants to resign. Then he thinks about it and decides to report his homicide colleagues. A fresco in strong colors of a certain American metropolitan reality. At the center of the action is Paul Newman, who imposes his presence and in this way helps Daniel Petrie to overcome the shallows of a script that is all in all a bit obvious.

title: The Unnamable
actors: Charles King, Mark Kinsey Stephenson, Mark Parra, Alexandra Durrell
description: Joel, Randolph and Howard, three college student friends, want to discover the secret of an old country house, abandoned for centuries. Joel enters it first, but does not come out alive. The same fate awaits two couples who take refuge unaware in the house. Finally, Randolph and Howard bravely enter the mansion and manage to neutralize the bloodthirsty "creature" that inhabits it.
notes: The film is an adaptation of a Lovecraft tale, with decidedly splatter accents. Despite the illustrious literary authorship, it does not offer memorable implications.

title: House of Games
actors: Joe Mantegna, Lindsay Crouse, Mike Nussbaum, J.T. Walsh
description: Margaret is a psychoanalyst with a few too many curiosities. Professional reasons lead her to meet Mike, a refined scammer. But then she also collaborates with him in small scams, only to get caught up in a too big game in which she will eventually be the victim. But Margaret is a resourceful woman.
notes: Sparkling cinematic debut for playwright David Mamet. The story works, it has twists and turns and it's bad. Mantegna is a prince of seduction and dishonesty. At the time Mamet had just written "The Untouchables".

title: The Man in the Middle
actors: Robert Mitchum, France Nuyen, Trevor Howard
description: The story narrated by the film is set in India, during the Second World War. US Army Lieutenant Winstone is charged with the murder of a British Petty Officer. The British command wants exemplary punishment, but defense attorney Adams doesn't give up even though his own client doesn't do anything to help him. With the help of a nurse, Adams gets his hands on a document thanks to which ...
notes: Classic military-trial film just ennobled by the exotic setting and the participation of the great Mitchum in the role, always very congenial to him, of the handsome tenebrous.

title: The Glass Managerie
actors: Jane Wyman, Kirk Douglas, Gertrude Lawrence, Arthur Kennedy
description: In the deep South of the United States a woman, abandoned by her husband, lives with her two children, Tom and Laura. The boy contributes with his modest salary as an employee to support the family and takes refuge, as soon as he can, in dreams, while the shy sister suffering from a slight handicap, ends up suffering from an inferiority complex. From the Tennessee Williams comedy of the same name, who co-wrote it inevitably sweetening it. In 1987 Paul Newman shot another version with his wife Joanne Woodward.

title: China Girl
actors: Gene Tierney, George Montgomery, Lynn Bari
description: In Burma, during the Cino-Japanese conflict, an American film operator falls in love with a Chinese girl engaged in resistance. But the war will have the upper hand. Sentimental war film with a pinch of adventure and exoticism.

title: Shout at the Devil
actors: Lee Marvin, Roger Moore, Barbara Parkins, Ian Holm, René Kolldehoff
description: Africa, 1913. On the eve of the First World War, Flyn Patrick O’Fean found himself near Lake Tanganyika. An American of Irish descent, Flyn is busy stocking up on ivory in league with a fellow trafficker, the Englishman Sebastian Oldsmith. His patriotism is close to zero, but conflict is upon us and even a swindler like him will be persuaded by the British to hit a German destroyer ...
notes: Based on a Wilbur Smith novel, Hunt's film is as long and predictable as ... a Wilbur Smith novel. Lee Marvin is always fun and at least for a while he manages to keep the attention awake, but one hundred and fifty minutes is really too much!

title: Evelina e i suoi figli
actors: Stefania Sandrelli, Roberto De Francesco
description: Evelina (Sandrelli) is a still young lady who lives separated from her husband, but with the comfort of two teenage children who adore her. Everything is fine until a new man enters Evelina's life. The children then show all their jealousy towards the intruder. Then one evening they come back upset by the death of a friend in a car accident ... Released two years after "Mignon is gone" and also based on a screenplay nominated for the Solinas prize, Livia Giampalmo's debut did not have the same luck as that of Archibugi. Sandrelli does the same role, but despite the brevity the film manages to have moments of boredom.

title: Rage
actors: Gary Daniels, Jillian McWhirter, Fiona Hutchison, Kenneth Tigar
description: A bakery was burned to the ground. The boy is contacted by a businessman, who offers him to confess the crime, promising him twenty-five thousand dollars. In reality the person responsible is the son of the latter, who acted in the grip of love madness. The boy agrees, but the matter becomes complicated because first the owner of the bakery and then his wife "confess" ... A bizarre comedy, which brings together disparate references. The cast is also rather anomalous and the director (from television, making his big screen debut) has his work cut out not to lose control of a complicated situation.

title: Il viaggio clandestino
actors: Enzo Moscato, Enzo Vetrano, Donato Castellaneta, Elena Bucci
description: San Gil seeks holiness through prayers and suffering. Instead, his spiritual partner, Ciccio Bavaria, obstinately seeks sin because only in this way does he find the way to spiritual life. Together the two embark on a journey that will lead the first to damn himself and the second to save himself, reincarnating in Buddha. Meanwhile, Christ, grappling with the modern world, has a hard life.
notes: "Lives of saints and sinners", sounds the subtitle of this bizarre film, shot by a visionary director, who controversially overturns every tradition and, referring to the apocryphal Gospels, argues that the ways of the Lord are truly infinite. Almost amateur production, among the ruins of Gibellina "covered" by Alberto Burri.

title: L'Atalante
actors: Michel Simon, Jean Dasté, Dita Parlo, Gilles Margaritis, Louis Lefebvre
description: Just married, Jean and Juliette set sail on his river boat, the "Atalante". On board the sailor Père Jules tries to seduce the woman, as will a tramp. Juliette's escape, Jean's despair, the woman's return. Vigo's latest film, which died the same year, poised between realism and poetry, between social and avant-garde gaze.

title: The Power Within
actors: Ted Jan Roberts, William Zabka, Karen Valentine
description: Stan Dryer, a normal high school student, one day meets a mysterious old man named Master Yung. Before dying, he gives him the mysterious "Ring of Power". With this jewel, Stan realizes that he has inherited from Yung magical powers that never in life would have dreamed of receiving a day as a gift. The less pleasant side of it is that now he has to contend with the evil Vonn, who owns the other twin ring. To get him, Vonn also kidnaps his girlfriend. Stan loses the ring, but still manages to get the better of and defeat the villain. Action scenes galore, filming a pure video clip style, a touch of oriental mysticism that never hurts, a comic book villain; all grafted into the usual, stereotyped American postcard high school environment. The recipe for the film is all here.

title: Prophecy
actors: Robert Foxworth, Talia Shire, Armand Assante, Richard Dysant
description: The heads of a paper mill set up in a Maine forest to store the logs cut to make paper pour a poisonous substance into the water. This substance changes the nature of the fish in the ponds, and - by eating it - the local Indians are especially victims of it. They are listed as responsible for the disasters, but the investigation conducted by a couple of their friends uncovers the truth. An ecological adventure that deals with too many themes at once; better then the twists and turns of pure action and the use of magnificent natural backgrounds.

title: The Formula
actors: George C. Scott, Marlon Brando, Marthe Keller, John Gielgud
description: There was a German plan, called "Genesis", to make synthetic fuel from coal, the documents of which a general was assigned to bring to Switzerland at the end of the war. Nowadays, after the killing in Los Angeles of the chief of police (who had captured that general at the time), Detective Barney Caine reconstructs the power struggles linked to oil production.
notes: From the novel of the same name by Steve Shagan, Avildsen draws a film with decorous craft which, however, harms the excessive entanglement of the subject.

title: Murder Ahoy
actors: Margaret Rutherford, Lionel Jeffries, Charles Tingwell, Stringer Davis
description: A gentleman from an old English family, linked to the activity of a training ship in the Navy of Her British Majesty, is killed in mysterious circumstances. Miss Marple investigates: when, at a certain point, the clues gathered bring the detective right to the center of the ship's activity, she does not hesitate to embark to try to find out more. His discoveries are followed by new murders, which unnerves police inspector Craddock ...
notes: Little mystery and long dialogues. A weak example of the large British series dedicated to the character of the amateur detective that came from the pen of the famous Agatha Christie.

title: Dames
actors: Joan Blondell, Hugh Herbert, Guy Kibbee
description: A great bourgeois fanatically puritan tries in every way to block the Broadway staging of a show written by a degenerate nephew.
notes: Warner product from the golden age of the musical, written by Delmer Daves and with the choreography of Busby Berkeley reaching their apotheosis in the finale.

title: The Odd Couple
actors: Jack Lemmon, Walter Matthau, John Fiedler, Herb Edelman, David Sheiner, Larry Haines, Monica Evans, Carole Shelley
description: Oscar, an unrepentant bachelor, offers hospitality to his friend Felix who is archidepressed for his recent divorce. But the coexistence between the two turns out to be a disaster.
notes: Lemmon and Matthau in their heyday, perfect interpreters of a Neil Simon comedy among the best conceived. Light movie theater, but fun.

title: The Manitou
actors: Tony Curtis, Susan Strasberg, Michael Ansara
description: The growth that appeared on Karin's neck does not hide a tumor, but a fetus. Her lover, a passionate spiritist, discovers that the girl is possessed by a centuries-old Indian demon. The ingredients are the same as the "Exorcist", the result is much less convincing.

title: Colpo in canna
actors: Ursula Andress, Woody Strode, Marc Porel, Isabella Biagini, Lino Banfi, Aldo Giuffré, Maurizio Arena, Rosario Borelli, Carla Brait, Renato Baldini, Raul Lovecchio, Sergio Ammirata
description: Nora Green, a busty American adventurer, unleashes a war between rival gangs of Neapolitan crime, thus managing to neutralize them both, and then seize a large booty.
notes: One of the worst films by Fernando di Leo, which tries to rework a "topical" story (after all, the same as _For a fistful of dollars_) but in the feminine and in a police-like context. The comic "numbers" of Lino Banfi and Jimmy the phenomenon (!), However, shift the axis from the action to the pecoreccia parody, with results that the director himself defined modest. For Andress a leading role, a little thrown away.

title: Pover'ammore
actors: Carmelo Zappulla, Lina Polito, Rosa Fumetto, Nicola Pignataro, Mariolina Fano
description: Carmelo, married and with children, completely loses his head for another woman, but his daughter brings him back to the right path. Rosa Comic, former star of Crazy Horse, follows Zappulla in a terrible scene.

title: Anime fiammeggianti
actors: Giuseppe Cederna, Elena Sofia Ricci, Alessandro Haber, Monica Scattini, Doris von Thury
description: Rosario, a teacher in a Roman high school, was left by his wife and is very depressed; the interventions of the Madonna are of little value (yes, she!) to comfort him. In addition: an intrusive colleague; a criminal who courts him; the return of his wife, with a suitor in tow; the principal who harasses him. Rosario attempts the path of crime, but then falls back in flight (not alone).
notes: If it is true that the grotesque is the most difficult genre to sustain, Davide Ferrario's second feature film is a respectable result. Much less "evasive" than it might seem (indeed!) And almost all at a very captivating level.

title: Un eroe borghese
actors: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Michele Placido, Omero Antonutti, Laura Betti
description: The lawyer Giorgio Ambrosoli, married and father of three children, is appointed liquidator of the private bank of Michele Sindona, the financier linked to the mafia. The legal task is extremely difficult, both for the internal situation of the bank and for the numerous implications that inevitably interfere with his work. Ambrosoli is determined to fulfill his mandate as best as possible, without allowing himself to be misled or intimidated, despite having the exact perception of the dangers to which he exposes himself. The threats, the "friendly" advice do not stop him: the lawyer wants to highlight all the rottenness behind the Sicilian financier, the complicity, the connivance, at any level and in any capacity. And Sindona, realizing the moral stature of a ruthless and incorruptible antagonist, has him killed. But the state is also jointly responsible for the crime. Michele Placido (director, as well as interpreter in the sober role of Marshal Novembre, of Finance) tackles with seriousness and measure (except for some rare uncontrolled moments) one of the most infamous, most shameful "cases" in our recent history: that of a man became a "hero" only for wanting to do his duty. A man whom the state should have supported and protected and who instead, through its most sordid channels, helped to assassinate. Excellent proof of interpreter for Fabrizio Bentivoglio, but also the minor figures are delineated with attention and vigor.

title: I pavoni
actors: Rinaldo Rocco, Nicola Russo, Sabrina Knaflitz, Vincenzo Crivello, Victor Cavallo
description: Vittorio, a boy from a good family, but spoiled, arrogant and with money as his only value, with the help of some friends he kills his family. Inspired by the story of Pietro Maso, with some pretense of formal rigor and some verbose sociologism too many.

title: Shadowlands
actors: Anthony Hopkins, Debra Winger, Edward Hardwicke, Michael Denison, Joseph Mazzello
description: The American poet Joy Gresham, after the union with an alcoholic, goes to England with her son, to meet the writer C. S. Lewis, whom she greatly admires. His arrival upsets Lewis's very traditional environment, but love is gradually born between the two, which will lead them to marriage. Joy's life, however, will be very short, and the emptiness she left cannot be filled. Attenborough is responsible for spectacular films ("Gandhi"), but also sensational slips. Here, trying to imitate Ivory, he creates a work that is not so bad as clearly "wrong" (but the ending is really bad), despite the big name actors.

title: Sleepless in Seattle
actors: Tom Hanks, Meg Ryan, Ross Malinger, Bill Pullman
description: Sam, an inconsolable widower, changes jobs and cities, pulling his little son with him, but he can't find a remedy for the pain that has also taken away his sleep. Little Jonah resorts to a radio show and his father's "case" becomes of national interest. On the other side of the United States, journalist Annie is moved and writes him a letter. Then he throws it away, but fate is happily lurking.
notes: The ultraclassic "he meets her" scheme here is extended over time, but the outcome is the same. Not without some touches of class, especially the "copy" of the ending of "A splendid love" (Cary Grant and Deborah Kerr, for Leo McCarey, 1957)

title: So I Married an Axe Murderer
actors: Mike Myers, Nancy Travis, Anthony La Paglia, Amanda Plummer
description: Charlie Mackenzie got close to marriage several times, but he always pulled back at the last minute. Instead with the butcher Harriet said yes, and everything is going well. At least until the hubby begins to suspect that the one responsible for the death of his three predecessors in Harriet's heart and bed is his better half, and that an identical fate is upon him.
notes: If director Thomas Schlamme, instead of constantly oscillating between comedy and thriller, had chosen a path and followed it, he could also have made that good film (given the starting point) which instead made a mistake.

title: The Pelican Brief
actors: Julia Roberts, Denzel Washington, Sam Shepard, John Heard, John Lithgow
description: Darby, who is about to graduate in law, starts studying a case: the death, which took place the same night, of two Supreme Court judges and formulates a disturbing hypothesis. Her teacher, as well as lover, with whom she confided, is also killed; a black journalist helps her to escape the many who want to kill her (even at the top, very high loco). John Grisham, the author of the novel from which the film is based, is a "manufacturer" of best sellers. But Pakula, the director of "All the President's Men", falls short and makes a cumbersome and tired film, which is not revitalized by some aestheticism scattered here and there.

title: Il segreto del bosco vecchio
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Giulio Brogi, Riccardo Zannantonio, Lino Pais Marden
description: Colonel Sebastiano Procolo and little Benvenuto, his nephew, have inherited a mountain house and the surrounding woods. Benvenuto immediately gets in tune with the animals, the genes of the trees, the songs of the Matteo Wind and other metaphysical presences. His grandfather, on the other hand, thinks that the woods are only a source of income. And if the child is an obstacle to the realization of this gain, the worse for him ... A story by Dino Buzzati, photography by Dante Spinotti, a Paolo Villaggio in an unusual part and, in the direction, a "poet" like Olmi. But even poetry can be exceeded; and this is what happens here in Olmi, which is lost in delays and dolls, without being able to merge the fabulous dimension and the naturalistic one. Embarrassing dubbing.

title: Fantasma d'amore
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Romy Schneider, Eva Maria Meineke, Wolfgang Preiss, Michael Kroecher, Paolo Baroni, Victoria Zinny, Giampiero Becherelli
description: Nino, an accountant from Pavia, accidentally meets an old and shabby lady on a bus. Bewildered, he discovers that it is the woman, Anna, whom he had loved in his youth. But Anna died of cancer three years earlier. However, he continues to appear to Nino who begins to relive the ancient passion: the two even take a boat trip on the river where the woman drowns. But the corpse, of course, is not found ...
notes: From a novel by Mino Milani, scripted by Risi and Zapponi, a film that unfolds in the Po Valley fog to tell a story suspended between past and present, metaphysical horror and ghost story. Extraordinary Mastroianni and Schneider.

title: Hail the Conquering Hero
actors: Eddie Bracken, Ella Raines, Raymond Walburn
description: A young recruit who has just arrived in the marines to take part in World War II is immediately sent home due to hay fever. Due to a transcription error, the telegram announcing his return declares him a hero. In full conflict Sturges allows himself to shoot one of the most wicked and fun antiwar comedies, with the corrosive humor that is typical of him and with an irresistible rhythm.

title: A Child is Waiting
actors: Judy Garland, Burt Lancaster, Gena Rowlands, Lawrence Tierney
description: Reuben Widdicombe is a retarded child, left by his father in Dr. Clarke's rehabilitation facility. Reuben is a very sensitive introvert who is unreservedly attached to Jane Hansen, the new assistant. The woman, with her exclusive attention and the adoption of personal initiatives towards her, risks irreparably compromising the tiring work of recovery.
notes: Shot live in a Pomona hospital, Cassavetes' third film is a decent punch in the stomach, even though the editing was taken from the director and ended up in the hands of Stanley Kramer. While in Hollywood, Cassavetes's merciless gaze and work on the actors are all.

title: Vacanze alla baia d'argento
actors: Anthony Steel, Valeria Fabrizi, Mario Carotenuto
description: Two rich men, fallen into poverty, decide to focus on their respective offspring to try to raise their finances by convincing them to marry the "right" women. One has a son, the other a daughter; naturally the two meet and the fathers, believing that the right party has arrived, encourage friendship. Guys are quick to go from friendship to love. When, however, the parents, noting the inconsistency of each other's finances, try to break the engagement, the two refuse.
notes: Mediocre brilliant comedy, set in the evocative scenery of Circeo, which takes on the cadences of a musical film. Even the interpreters are modest, the photography is good.

title: The Day the Earth Caught Fire
actors: Janet Munro, Leo McKern, Edward Judd, Michael Goodliffe
description: In the editorial office of a major London newspaper, there is an exaggerating tension due to the incredible news that is going on about a sudden increase in the earth's temperature. Contradictory reports attribute the fact to two contemporary nuclear experiments; one from the Americans and one from the Russians.
notes: Realistic Cold War Concerns.

title: An Early Frost
actors: Gena Rowlands, Ben Gazzara, Aidan Quinn, Sylvia Sidney
description: Katherine (Gena Rowlands) and Nick Pierson (Ben Gazzara) live in the countryside in the state of Pennsylvania. Their son Michael (Aidan Quinn) instead studied and is now a brilliant Chicago attorney. Then Michael comes home with two things to say to his folks. The first is that he is homosexual. The second is that he fell ill with AIDS. The Piersons have a hard time getting used to both ideas. This is the first television film (but also the first film tout court) to deal with AIDS. Between mum Rowlands and dad Gazzara it is honestly difficult to say who is the best. Emmy Award for Screenplay by Ron Cowen and Daniel Lipman.

title: The Mighty Ducks
actors: Emilio Estevez, Joss Ackland, Lane Smith, Heidi Kling, Josef Sommer
description: Convicted for his easy way of driving to socially useful work for six months, lawyer Gordon Bombay (Estevez) finds himself coaching a hockey team. At first the kids can't stand him and he warmly reciprocates them in the same way. Then Gordon begins to take to heart the fate of the team and also those of the mother of one of his young athletes. Only in the US can they consider being a coach a socially useful job, and they can consider a perfect incompetent like Estevez an actor to be entrusted with the leading role.

title: Street Knight
actors: Jeff Speakman, Christopher Neame, Lewis Van Bergen, Jennifer Gatti
description: Jake hasn't recovered since, in his role as a cop, he unintentionally caused the death of a girl. Now Jake is a mechanic by trade, but the world of crime won't leave him alone. A new fight between gangs of thugs forces him to come out. He will discover that behind it all is a paramilitary organization run by a psychopath named Franklin. This is not a movie, it is an anthology of stereotypes. The result, however, is not unwatchable and Magnoli's direction is not too weak either. But if Richard Friedman (the screenwriter) had come up with at least an original idea ...

title: Love Potion No. 9
actors: Sandra Bullock, Tate Donovan, Anne Bancroft, Dale Midkiff
description: Paul Mathews (Donovan) and Diane Farrow (Bullock) are neighbors. They are both biochemists, both sloppy and boring as death. One day Paul goes to have his hand read by Madame Ruth (Anne Bancroft) and receives love potion number 9 from her. As soon as he gets home he throws it away, then discovers the effect it has on cats and then decides to try. if it works with the neighbor. There is little to laugh about, the story is true, the Bullock looks almost pretty. After some brilliant scripts ("My Cousin Vinnie", "Blind Date"), Launer makes his debut in a lackluster way.

title: Amore rosso
actors: Marina Berti, Massimo Serato, Arnoldo Foà, Guido Celano
description: In Sardinia, at the beginning of the century, an impossible love was born between the rich Marianna and the good bandit Simone Sole, a former servant who chose freedom. Their story is fiercely opposed by Sebastiano, Marianna's cousin, who wants to marry her to take over her large fortune. When Simone constitutes himself to the police in order to finally marry Marianna, he is accused of being the perpetrator of a crime that was actually committed by Sebastiano. Marianna then tries to make Simone escape, but ... "Melodrammone" with high passionate tension, based on the novel "Marianna Sirca" by the Sardinian writer, and Nobel Prize winner for literature, Grazia Deledda.

title: Arrivano Joe e Margherito
actors: Keith Carradine, Tom Skerritt, Sybil Danning, Pepe Calvo
description: The American Joe must transfer the Sicilian mafia boss Don Salvatore and his huge assets to the United States. In the tragicomic enterprise, between chases and the struggle between rival gangs, he is helped by an eccentric and phlegmatic Englishman and by the sailor Margherito. Unconventional but fun adventures.

title: Nightflyers
actors: Catherine Mary Stewart, Michael Praed, John Standing
description: A professor organizes a scientific expedition to study a strange galaxy but, during the journey, the spaceship wants to eliminate its own occupants. Science fiction with psychoanalytic claims.

title: Lady in the Lake
actors: Robert Montgomery, Audrey Totter, Lloyd Nolan
description: Investigator Philip Marlowe investigates the disappearance of an inconvenient publisher's wife. All the clues point to a kidnapping. Incredibly, his searches, which seem to have taken the right lead, are hindered ... by the police, who find a way to slow them down with bureaucratic quibbles. What is hidden under this strange behavior of the institutions? Marlowe does not give up, and wants to go through with it ...
notes: Based on the novel of the same name by Raymond Chandler, it is famous because it was shot almost entirely as a subjective from the point of view of the investigator. The operation is mechanical and a bit boring, but certainly courageous and interesting.

title: Bloodhounds of Broadway
actors: Mitzi Gaynor, Scott Brady, Mitzi Green
description: Pat Foster, a likeable gangster, helps orphaned peasant Emily Ann break into the world of show business. Pleasant musical comedy, sentimental, funny and unpretentious, based on Damon Runyon ("Bulli e pupe") There is also a very young Charles Bronson, again Cahrles Buchinsky.

title: The Snake Pit
actors: Olivia de Havilland, Leo Genn, Mark Stevens, Celeste Holm
description: The incredible experience, inside an asylum, of Virginia Cunningham (de Havilland), a girl suffering from mental disorders. Five nominations and no Oscar for a problematic film that aroused controversy and acclaim.

title: Malone
actors: Burt Reynolds, Cynthia Gibb, Scott Wilson, Cliff Robertson
description: By accident, former CIA agent Malone learns of a speculator who is violently driving away landowners in a region of Oregon. He understands that there is something big underneath: it is in fact a plot that aims to replace local politicians with others of far more undemocratic ideas. Although Malone also finds himself up against his former colleagues, he manages to foil the plot.
notes: In this western in modern clothes Burt Reynolds has the opportunity, despite the years that inevitably pass, to bring out all his determination. It is a pity that Cokliss, former author of "Il giorno della luna nera", is unable to provide a direction that goes beyond pure profession.

title: Nessuno
actors: Roberto De Francesco, Davide Bechini, Fabrizia Sacchi, Lucrezia Lante Della Rovere, Sergio Castellitto
description: Nico, who as a child had been very struck by Homeric Ulysses who saves himself by saying his name is Nobody, is at the age of eighteen in a luxurious boarding school. Her mother, an unfaithful spouse, is now separated from her husband and attempts suicide. Then Nico closes himself in silence, endures various oppressions and resumes his voice only after his mother has died, also to save a stepsister to whom he is very fond. A perhaps a little too pretentious attempt at psychological analysis, an exercise in style weighed down by the excess of cultural references. But the sense of Nico's angry lack of communication is evident in a way that is not at all trivial.

title: Husbands and Wives
actors: Woody Allen, Mia Farrow, Judy Davis, Sydney Pollack
description: Professor Gabe Roth and his wife Judy have been happily married for ten years, but their marriage begins to crack the day friends Jack and Sally announce they are about to separate. Gabe is having an affair with a student, Jack goes to live with a very young teacher, Sally is desperate and Jody pushes her into Michael's arms. Now the Roths are separating too, but that's not all ...
notes: Released immediately after the outbreak of the crisis between Allen and Mia Farrow, the film seems to relate to that situation. It is the director's most "neurotic" work (even in the narrative style), the most bitter in his cruel game of feelings and resentments.

title: The Bride
actors: Sting, Jennifer Beals, Geraldine Page, Clancy Brown
description: After his first creation, Baron Frankenstein "built" a second one, the splendid Eve, to complete the couple. But Eve, at the sight of her designated partner, feels only horror, and he runs away. Each on their own, the two "inhumans" will experience many adventures, also scattered with violent deaths, and then rejoin. Remake of Whale's "Frankenstein's Bride", the film has the characteristic of taking the side of the two anomalous "creatures" against the evil of some human beings. A discontinuous result, but at times interesting. Delusional cast.

title: The Man From Snowy River
actors: Tom Burlinson, Kirk Douglas, Jack Thompson, Sigrid Thormton
description: A young man from the Australian highlands is hired on a lowland cattle rancher's farm and makes himself useful. He is skilled with horses, brings lost cattle back to the pen, saves his master's daughter from an accident and falls in love with her. But the tyrant parent doesn't want to give it to him. Our hero returns to his parts, but he will return to take what he feels is his.
notes: It's a kind of western transported from American to Australian landscapes. Wide spaces, stallions in freedom, suggestive photography. With the curiosity that Kirk Douglas plays two roles, that of the bossy boss as well as his good brother.

title: Blast of Silence
actors: Allen Baron, Molly McCarthy, Larry Tucker
description: Frank is a killer by profession, but not as "tough" as he should be. Sent by his clients to kill a rival, he buys a gun, kills the seller and then, with some difficulty, finds the intended victim in the company of a friend and carries out the task.But when he shows up to collect, the principals commission a killer to take out the killer. It is a "small" but interesting film of the "noir" genre (excellent black-and-white) made in the context of independent US cinema.

title: Cyberjack
actors: Michael Dudikoff, Brion James, Suki Kaiser, Jon Cuthbert
description: Nick was a good cop, but after losing his mate badly he had to quit. Now, seeking consolation in the bottle, he works as a keeper in a highly secretive scientific research institute. Here a good moment finds something to make up for from past humiliations when he discovers, running for cover, that someone steals a very dangerous supervirus to use it criminally. Sci-fi thriller co-produced between Canada and Japan, with action scenes (chases, explosions, fights to the death), spectacular special effects, a genius scientist with a cute daughter and, in short, everything in place to be accepted.

title: A Good Man in Africa
actors: Joanne Whalley, Colin Friels, Sean Connery, Louis Gossett jr.
description: Morgan Leafy, a British diplomat in a small West African state, must ingratiate himself with a favorite local politician in the upcoming elections. But he blackmails Leafy and forces him to try to bribe Alex Murray, a Scottish-born doctor who opposes the candidate's building speculation. Flamboyant and farcical satire of the perverse relations between European politics and powerful Africans.

title: Clerks
actors: Brian O'Halloran, Jeff Anderson, Marilyn Ghigliotti, Lisa Spoonauer, Jason Mewes, Kevin Smith, Scott Mosier, Scott Schiaffo, Al Berkowitz, Walter Flanagan
description: Dante, a young shop assistant, has the day off today. Indeed, he would have it, if the boss didn't throw him out of bed to ask him to replace him in the shop. Together with his friend Randall, Dante spends a "typical" day of events bordering on the absurd, in the frame of a clientele, friendships and straitjacket acquaintances. And, grotesquely, the dead also escapes.
notes: New director, unknown actors, grainy black and white, very basic structure, very ... free dialogues. A youthful, very lively and irreverent unscrupulous film that won the director's award at the 1994 Sundance Festival.

title: Murder Most Foul
actors: Margaret Rutherford, Ron Moody, Charles Tingwell
description: Miss Marple is the only one who believes in the innocence of Harold Taylor, accused of murder. Her investigations into the crime, alternatives to those of the police, lead to a theater company and Miss Marple gets hired ...
notes: Good intertwining with the priceless Margaret Rutherford as the character of Agatha Christie.

title: Il sepolcro dei re
actors: Debra Paget, Ettore Manni, Corrado Pani
description: Having killed the rulers of Syria, the pharaoh Nemorat marries their daughter Shila, who despises him and loves a court doctor. Complicated court intrigues, potions and Egyptian pitfalls follow. Twisted and rough costumed feuilleton.

title: Thirty-Six Hours
actors: James Garner, Eva Marie Saint, Rod Taylor, Werner Peters
description: The Nazi secret services have learned of the impending landing project in Normandy. To find out the date they make an American officer, their prisoner, believe that the war is over and that he, after amnesia, is now in an allied hospital. The officer first falls into the trap and talks about the landing then begins to suspect something and then his doctor sets him a new trap. Meanwhile, the Gestapo finds it hard to take the information that comes from the hospital at face value.
notes: A well-oiled narrative device soon passes from the climate of the war genre to the psychological nightmare atmospheres more suited to the thriller.

title: BrainWaves
actors: Tony Curtis, Keir Dullea, Suzanna Love, Vera Miles, Ryan Seitz
description: Falling into a coma after a car accident, Kaylie is reanimated by electronically transferring brain waves taken from the brain of a newly dead woman. The operation seems to be successful, but in a dream the girl begins to relive the donor's last days, thus discovering that the woman has been the victim of a murder. The deceased's mind increasingly takes control of her body, while the killer is on her trail.
notes: Here is how the old myth of Frankenstein is dusted off thanks to the miracles of electronics, the queen of modern special effects. From the director of _Tenerezza del lupo_.

title: La tenda nera
actors: Luca Barbareschi, Anna Kanakis, Valeria Cavalli, Gianni Musy
description: At first an elderly woman denounces the disappearance of her cats. Then the parish priest of the Romagna town where the action takes place has a fatal accident and cannot make the important revelations promised to the carabinieri captain, Leonardi (who replaces a dead colleague in mysterious circumstances). The corpse of a cat is found in the church -plated waterstrack. And it's not that the beginning ...
notes: Among the dead variously killed, parties with sex and drugs, transsexual fortune tellers and seven with demonic rites, the subject is little saved in terms of strong arguments. And the direction has not sufficient wrist to administer everything discreetly.

title: Classe mista
actors: Alfredo Pea, Dagmar Lassander, Gabriele Di Giulio, Femi Benussi, Valeria D'Obici
description: In a high school in Trani Tonino is in love with the literature teacher, Carla Moretti. While dreaming, her teacher consoles herself in the bed of her aunt Thecla who was prematurely widowed. One day Tonino and his teacher are kidnapped and find themselves alone in a trullo, where they can finally love each other. Moretti, however, is transferred to Rome. A new teacher arrives in the classroom ... Erotic comedy of the school line typical of the seventies.

title: L'etrusco uccide ancora
actors: Alex Cord, Samantha Eggar, John Marley, Enzo Tarascio
description: In Spoleto, during the Festival dei due Mondi, an archaeologist, friend of an orchestra conductor and especially of his wife, discovers in a tomb a fresco depicting a human sacrifice in honor of the ancient demon Tuchulca. Soon a chain of crimes, inspired by the sepulchral discovery and accompanied by Verdi's _Messa da Requiem_, involves the protagonists: Commissioner Giuranna will unravel the intricate skein.
notes: Discreet yellow, albeit a bit cumbersome in the finish. The colors are often macabre, but less daring than in other films of those years, despite the crimes here having a horror motive.

title: Sette contro tutti
actors: Roger Browne, Liz Havilland, Al Northon, Harold Bradley
description: The valiant centurion Marco (Browne) takes the lead of a group of seven gladiators with whom he intends to fight Vadio, a military tribune, who has now become a tyrant and who dominates the kingdom of Aristea. The seven, assisted by a dwarf, who frees them from the prison where they ended up, first destroy the sect of Kiva mercenaries, then eliminate the despot. Rather modest in design and direction, the film is saved by the good dose of irony of the story even if the circus aspects prevail a little too much.

title: Quiet Cool
actors: James Remar, Adam Coleman Howard, Daphne Ashbrook, Nick Cassavetes
description: A New York policeman is on the trail of an illegal marijuana grower active in the United States After a series of laborious investigations, he must leave for the West. On the trail of her man, he reaches California, but here is someone who is waiting for him with certainly not friendly intentions ...
notes: A film as stupid as its plot.

title: Deadbolt
actors: Justine Bateman, Adam Baldwin, Michele Scarabelli
description: Marty (Bateman) is a medical student with a vacancy and a desperate need to share the household expenses. Alec (Baldwin) responds to his announcement, handsome and for the moment not even dangerous. In fact, Alec's manias are revealed little by little. In fact, in a short time he becomes the absolute master of the house by contracting Marty in a role of pathological slavery. Adam Baldwin is an only child, so never confuse him with brothers Alec, Daniel, William or Stephen. This Baldwin was the Animal in "Full Metal Jacket". The film is a normal thriller released only on TV and videotape.

title: Major League 2
actors: Charlie Sheen, Tom Berenger, Corbin Bernsen, Dennis Haysbert, Alison Doody
description: Five years have already passed since Cleveland's baseball team, the Indians, won the championship.
