Now the situation is back to normal with the team at the bottom of the standings and with the old heroes who retired, some for a knee problem (Berenger), some to work in advertising (Sheen). But at the right time they will all be ready to return to the field. David S. Ward has lived a lifetime on writing "The Sting". Since that day he hasn't gotten one right. The first "Major League" was actually a good success. This second part no, between quarrels on the set and directing ignorance.

title: Breaker! Breaker!
actors: Chuck Norris, George Murdock, Terry O'Connor
description: The story begins with an intervention by the traffic police; some agents stop a young truck driver and challenge him for a series of infractions, of which the victim turns out to be innocent. The aim is only to extort money from him. He tries to escape, but they catch up with him, beat him up and make him disappear. The brother will think about playing the devil until he finds him again. Do you know the expressiveness of Chuck Norris at its best? Here he was a beginner, be warned. As for the film: action movie of the lowest rank that also claims to want to make comedy. Like an elephant in a crystal shop.

title: Testament
actors: Jane Alexander, William Devane, Ross Harris, Rebecca De Mornay
description: A day like any other in the city of Hamlin, until a blinding light marks the beginning of the atomic holocaust. The Wetherly family is made up of parents and three children: the father will never return from work. What the explosion did not do was done by radiation. People die like flies; of the Wetherly the mother and a child will remain to await the end, with courage and dignity.
notes: The documentary origins of director Lynne Littman allow her to avoid any spectacular complacency. At the same time, however, the film does not find the right narrative breath; the story remains fragmented and tainted by easy sentimentality.

title: Grosso guaio a Cartagena
actors: Barbara De Rossi, Franco Nero, Franco Javarone, Galo Ahumada
description: A sailor who went ashore only for a bank payment finds himself involved in a whirlwind of misadventures and ups and downs. He will have to recover his ten thousand dollars (which he would like to invest in opening a bar in Tahiti) before the ship sets off.
notes: Exotic adventure in a made in Italy television film. It's not that great.

title: Good Morning, Vietnam
actors: Robin Williams, Tung Thanh Tran, Chintara Sukapatana, Forest Whitaker
description: We are in 1965 and the radio of the armed forces in Vietnam has a new d. j., Adrian Cronauer, who soon becomes much loved by the soldiers for his alluvial and irreverent impetuosity; for the same reason, superiors hate him. Adrian knows the young Trinh, but the girl keeps him at a distance. He will save himself from the Vietcong, but he will understand the aversion that the Americans arouse in the population. A "tour de force" for Robin William (dubbing does what it can) and an unusual point of view to tell, with an explicitly critical angle towards the military institution, the Vietnam War.

title: Raid on Entebbe
actors: Peter Finch, Charles Bronson, Eddie Constantine, Martin Balsam
description: A group of Arab guerrillas seized the Athens-Paris flight and diverted it to Entebbe, Uganda. Non-Israeli passengers are released. For the others, the hijackers demand the release of Palestinian guerrillas detained in Israel. The Israeli secret services, thanks also to the logistical support granted by Kenya, however, organize the counter-offensive, which is successfully carried out.
notes: Supercast in service for this reconstruction of the Entebbe raid, the third in a short time. The story lent itself, moreover, for its spectacular aspects. Deployed on the Israeli side, it is not too rhetorical, but not exciting either.

title: Hoffa
actors: Danny DeVito, Jack Nicholson, Armand Assante, Carol D'Alessandro
description: Hoffa and his friend Bobby are in a car parked in front of a diner. They are expecting someone. For subsequent flashbacks, the trade union, political and criminal history of the former head of the American truckers union is reconstructed. In its final part it becomes clear that this man has now become an uncomfortable character, dangerous for too many people. The hand of the mafia will hit him. Director Danny De Vito relies on David Mamet's writing arts and Jack Nicholson's histrionic skills. For himself he reserves the role of faithful Bobby Ciaro. The film is not without exciting moments and good insights, but it is not perfectly successful.

title: Orlando
actors: Tilda Swinton, Billy Zane, Lothaire Bluteau, John Wood, Quentin Crisp, Toby Jones
description: The nobleman Orlando is well-liked by Queen Elizabeth I (1533-1603) and, after his death, falls in love with a Russian princess who, however, abandons him. During the reign of William I (1689-1702) she was ambassador to the Middle East, when she was transformed into a woman. Back in England, Lady Orlando, in the Victorian era (1837-1901), finds the man of her dreams, but he leaves her. In 1992 she is the mother of a little girl. Virginia Wolf's fantastic novel on sexual ambiguity finds in Sally Potter's work a skilful script and an intelligent, as well as elegant, transposition into images. Great proof of the protagonist Tilda Swinton.

title: The Player
actors: Tim Robbins, Greta Scacchi, Fred Ward, Whoopi Goldberg
description: Griffin Mill (Robbins, awarded the Palme d'Or at Cannes), who works for a Hollywood major, has a double concern: the arrival of a possible rival in the studio's staff and a series of threatening letters. Believing he has located the anonymous enemy, Mill kills him, managing to get away with the investigation that follows, although he is often on the verge of collapsing. He will then produce a film that more or less tells his story. Robert Altman's gaze on Hollywood is as ferocious as his construction of the film is compelling and the storytelling in the complex labyrinth of the story is elegant. Around the main roles (all perfect), a crowd of stars in fleeting appearances, from Anjelica Huston to Jack lemmon, from Cher to Jeff Goldblum, from Nick Nolte to Burt Reynolds. The film in the final film, a parody of the politically correct action film, stars Julia Roberts, Bruce Willis and Susan Sarandon among others.

title: Deep Cover
actors: Laurence Fishburne, Jeff Goldblum, Victoria Dillard, Charles Martin Smith
description: Detective Stevens jr. he's a good cop. This is why his bosses choose him for a risky mission: to infiltrate the world of drugs and then, slowly, trace back to the bosses of the organization. He does not flinch, takes an apartment in the worst part of the city, enters the business, starts peddling small quantities and then gets carried away by both drugs and money. The photography is by Bojan Bazelli ("Kalifornia", "King of New York"), the screenplay is by Michael Tolkin ("The protagonists") and Larry Fishburne is great. But the film only works halfway, because the story is too obvious.

title: D'amore si vive
description: Through interviews with prostitutes, transsexuals, marginalized and handicapped people, the director tells a series of stories between sexuality and feelings. An investigation that becomes a research on the "other side of love".

title: Star Trek VI. The Undiscovered Country
actors: William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley, Kim Cattrall
description: The planet of the Klingon people (for 25 years fighting the earthlings) is on the verge of an ecological catastrophe. Its inhabitants thus decide to lay down their arms and ask for help. The crew of the Enterprise rushes to their rescue. Two assassins kill Grand Chancellor Gorkon but Dr. Spock and Captain Kirk are accused of the crime and, after a trial, are sentenced to forced labor. Saved by the crew of the Enterprise, the two discover that there is a traitor aboard. The film celebrates 25 years since the birth of the successful series: the spaceship in fact is about to change crew. Interesting are the current issues that allude to the end of the Cold War and the Shakespearean quotations.

title: The Nightman
actors: Joanna Kerns, Jenny Robertson, Ted Marcoux, La Tanya Richardson
description: When she was younger, Maggie lived with her mom in their lakeside hotel. A quiet life, upset by the arrival of Tom, a veteran of Vietnam and immediately the object of love on the part of both. The situation then degenerates to the point where the mother, during a fight, is killed. Tom goes to jail for this for sixteen years, but then comes back outside to tell Maggie the truth.
notes: It begins as a thriller, then ends in drama.

title: Compulsion
actors: Orson Welles, Dean Stockwell, Bradford Dillman, Diane Varsi, E.G. Marshall, Martin Milner, Richard Anderson, Robert F. Simon, Edward Binns, Robert Burton
description: Two father's sons (Stockwell and Dillmann) enrolled in law school are infatuated with the theories of the philosopher Nietzsche, naturally misunderstood. Feeling superior to the laws they study themselves, they decide to commit a particularly serious crime to test their odd theories. So they kidnap and kill a little boy.
notes: From the same case that inspired Hitchcock's "Knot in the throat", a very tense and baroque judicial "black" headed by a great craftsman. The three protagonists (the two boys and the lawyer Orson Welles) were awarded in Cannes.

title: The Glass Menagerie
actors: Joanne Woodward, John Malkovich, Karen Allen, James Naughton
description: Tom returns to his deserted house after years of wandering and remembers: his mother frustrated by her husband's abandonment and obsessed with the duty of a strict education of the children; his sister, limping and emotionally fragile; a friend who had been "chosen" by him, Tom, as a possible boyfriend for his sister and who was already engaged ... Desolation for everyone, suffering and adverse destinies. From the swollen play drama of Tennessee Williams, a controlled Paul Newman direction that manages not to betray the cinema, a great interpretation of his wife Joanne Woodward in the role of the mother and a good proof for the other performers.

title: Tender Mercies
actors: Robert Duvall, Tess Harper, Ellen Barkin, Betty Buckley
description: Mac Sledge was a famous songwriter. Now divorced, he lives in disarray and ends up in a small Texas motel run by Rosa, a young widow (her husband died in Vietnam), mother of little Sonny. With her the hope of a new life is reborn. The ex-wife, renowned singer, is on tour nearby: the meeting with her and her daughter ends in tragedy. Mac is back for good with Rose and Sonny. Even if the story is a bit mushy, Beresford's Australian gaze captures the spirit of the Deep South. Oscar deserved for a great Duvall, who sings songs of his own composition. Another Oscar to the screenwriter, Horton Foote.

title: The Sound Barrier
actors: Ann Todd, John Justin, Denholm Elliott, Nigel Patrick, Ralph Richardson, Dinah Sheridan
description: Tony Garthwaite is a pilot who marries Susan, the daughter of an aeronautical industrialist engaged in the construction of an airplane that crosses the sound barrier. In the various tests, first Susan's brother died and then Tony himself. Susan, after giving birth prematurely, breaks up with her father, but the two will reconcile just when a friend of Tony's succeeds in the decisive test. Passionate about flying, David Lean intertwines aerial ideas with a dramatic structure with a familiar background. Despite turning to famed playwright Terence Rattigan for the script, the result falls short of its best.

title: Desideria e l'anello del Drago
actors: Anna Falchi, Sophie von Kessell, Franco Nero, Joel Beeson, Stefania Sandrelli, Marek Vasut
description: The Warrior King (Black) became ruler of kings by overcoming King Karl. The only survivor is the little prince Victor who, grown up, will lead the rebels in the revolt against the ruthless ruler. He falls in love with the King's daughter, the beautiful Desideria (Falchi) but their love is thwarted by Selvaggia, the princess's evil half-sister who, endowed with magical powers, aims to conquer power. Practically born in the wake of the success of "Fantaghirò" - which also had some merit - it is a repetition of the same themes and the same schemes based on the traditional fairy tale. Too bad that here, more than once, boredom appears.

title: The Deerslayer
actors: Lex Barker, Rita Moreno, Forrest Tucker
description: The adventures of a young white man raised by the Mohicans, who with his friend Cingagook and Harry, a nomadic trader, finds himself fighting against the ferocious Hurons. Taken from James Fenimore Cooper's novel "The Last of the Mohicans", but without much originality and inspiration.

title: Gold Diggers of 1933
actors: Warren William, Joan Blondell, Aline MacMahon, Dick Powell
description: Three young dancer friends in a row on Broadway scramble to find a wealthy husband. Extraordinary choreographic inventions by Busby Berkeley, in an ensemble that proceeds with crackling and mischievous lightness from start to finish. Busby Berkeley's choreography remains among the top of the genre ("We're in the Money", with Ginger Rogers solo, and "Remember My Forgotten Man", almost an epic theater piece).

title: Noose for a Lady
actors: Dennis Price, Melissa Stribling, Charles Lloyd Pack, George Merritt
description: I agree with the lover, a wife with a stone heart prepares the murder of the naive husband. Serie B film, it is the debut of Wolf Rilla director of "The village of the damned".

title: Trial by Jury
actors: Joanne Whalley, Armand Assante, Gabriel Byrne, William Hurt
description: Valerie Alston, a young woman with a son, is called to be part of the jury in the trial against Rusty Pirone, a boss of Cosa Nostra. And here his (big) troubles begin. One of Pirone's men alludes menacingly to the child, and suggests that the woman might persuade the other jurors to acquit him. After the acquittal, he still wants to kill Valerie, but there are some surprises. A well-timed script is ruined by the direction, of coarse effect.

title: Delitto passionale
actors: Serena Grandi, Fabio Testi, Florinda Bolkan
description: We are in Sofia; a successful writer is found dead and a young inspector investigates the murder by questioning family members. Then a bum accuses himself of the murder and it all seems to end there. But no: shortly thereafter the writer's husband's lover dies. Cat cats us. New investigations and the man, dying after an escape attempt, confesses. But he is lying too.
notes: A subject as improbable as it is abused: we are from the parts of the Z series and the one who, shot after shot, is served to us only relentlessly confirms the premises. One question: what need was there to shoot it in Bulgaria?

title: Fearless
actors: Jeff Bridges, Isabella Rossellini, Rosie Perez, Tom Hulce
description: Max Klein is among the survivors after the plane he was traveling on crashed to the ground. From that moment on, man radically changes his habits, he lives an existential condition in which there is no longer any place for the previous affections, for the daily "banalities", as well as in a continuous challenge to death. The path towards the reconquest of a dimension of human normality will be arduous and suffered. With his fifth American film, the Australian Peter Weir ("Picnic a Hanging Rock", "The fleeting moment") attempts an excursus between earthly concreteness and the territories of metaphysics. Ambitious, "risky", but basically successful thanks also to some visionary moments and the interpretation of Bridges.

title: Bring Me the Head of Alfredo Garcia
actors: Warren Oates, Isela Vega, Robert Webber, Gig Young, Emilio Fernández, Kris Kristofferson
description: El Jefe, a wealthy planter, having discovered that his daughter was made pregnant by Alfredo Garcia, is giving away a prize of one million dollars for whoever brings him the head of the guilty. Bennie, a pianist by profession, learns that Garcia is now dead and gone and wants to win the prize. He will unearth the head of the deceased, he will kill anyone who tries to hinder him but will not be able to enjoy the money.
notes: The film represents the pinnacle of Peckinpah's pessimism in a tragic, desperate "epic" of ferocity and inhumanity. The director declared: "Censored and contested - and not just by critics - but good or bad, good or bad, it's how I wanted it". Great monologues by Warren Oates.

title: Caro diario
actors: Nanni Moretti, Renato Carpentieri, Antonio Neiwiller, Moni Ovadia, Jennifer Beals, Carlo Mazzacurati, Alexandre Rockwell, Marco Paolini, Claudia Della Seta, Lorenzo Alessandri, Raffaella Lebboroni
description: In the first episode ("In Vespa") Nanni Moretti wanders through a summer and semi-deserted Rome, goes to the cinema, reaches the Lido di Ostia up to the place where Pasolini was killed. In the second ("Isole") we leave Lipari to arrive in Filicudi in the company of Gerardo, an unconfessed couch potato. The final episode ("Medici") instead follows the odyssey of Moretti who is diagnosed with a tumor in the lymphatic system. Of the three episodes the best is the first, all tracking shots and shots from below in the middle of the Roman palaces. But the third also works well, so dry and devoid of rhetoric, moreover on an autobiographical subject in which it would have been easy to lose the measure.

title: Infiltrato
actors: Valerio Mastandrea, Massimo Wertmüller, Anna Melato, Antonio Paglia
description: Matteo was imprisoned for five years for a robbery, but he still feels responsible for the fact that, during that robbery, his brother Sergio was left dead. Now Matteo has decided to change his life, find a job and a girlfriend. The girl is called Marika and she is a drug addict prostitute. The job is offered to him by a certain Giuliano and he is that of police informant. Dramas of life and crime in the Roman suburbs. Homegrown version of American TV movies based on hot topics, news stories and the like. The director Sestieri is the one who, years ago, had directed "Barocco". And it is not a title of merit.

title: Night Patrol
actors: Murray Langston, Linda Blair, Pat Paulsen, Billy Barty
description: Melvin as a cop is a perfect incompetent, so much so that he gets sent as punishment on the night service. But as a comedian he's not bad. He likes to go on stage, but in order not to be recognized, since he should be on patrol at that hour, he shows off with a paper bag over his face. Things get complicated when a man begins to carry out robberies with a bag on his head. From a technical-formal point of view this film is a disaster. But if the "trash" does not terrify you and you are willing to listen to an endless series of double meanings, sexist, racist jokes etc ... then the Jackie Kong movie is for you.

title: Bersaglio altezza uomo
actors: Luc Merenda, Gabriella Giorgelli, Paola Senatore, Pamela Villoresi
description: Police inspector Keaton manages to defeat a gang of drug traffickers thanks to the double game of a skilled shooter. Bloody and banal detective turned to the dramatic.

title: Musoduro
actors: Cosetta Greco, Marina Vlady, Fausto Tozzi, Gérard Landry
description: The woodcutter Musoduro associates with an old poacher, called "The toad", with whom he hopes to be able to start a lucrative hunting activity. But the couple's stables are watched over by the area's gamekeeper, the treacherous Romulus, who owes much of his interest to being madly in love with Musoduro's woman. Romulus then manages to frame Musoduro making him unjustly accused of murder. Director Bennati wrote a sentimental drama that was defined by the critics of the time as "the first Italian western". Really good use of color.

title: Cluny Brown
actors: Charles Boyer, Jennifer Jones, Peter Lawford, Helen Walker, Richard Haydn
description: A mature Polish refugee and the young niece of a plumber prove that they are the only ones who know how to live in the gloomy home of an English aristocratic family. Portrait of ambitious and ferocious and hilarious social classes. Penultimate, great Lubitsch.

title: Dichiarazioni d'amore
actors: Alessio Modica, Delia Boccardo, Arnaldo Ninchi, Carlo Delle Piane, Carlotta Miti
description: The film (which takes place in Bologna, mainly in 1948) evokes family, scholastic, sentimental problems and early erotic fantasies of the fifteen-year-old Dado and a group of his peers. The clumsy and clumsy "love story" between Dado and Sandra is highlighted and, many years later, the existential crisis of Sandra, married, and neurotic, which will have a tragic conclusion.
notes: Pupi Avati's touch is happy and full of witty sensibility when he paints his "little ancient world" of post-war Bologna; the part that moves to the present is cold and rather insignificant.

title: Philadelphia
actors: Tom Hanks, Denzel Washington, Jason Robards, Antonio Banderas, Roberta Maxwell, Jason Robards, Joanne Woodward, Anna Deavere Smith, Stephanie Roth Haberle, Lisa Talerico, Buzz Kilman, Chandra Wilson, Bradley Whitford, Mary Steenburgen
description: Andrew Beckett is a brilliant young attorney, one of the leading associates of one of the most prestigious law firms in Philadelphia, but is fired on the spot when his employers find out that he has contracted AIDS. Beckett wants to assert his rights and turns to several lawyers, but no one accepts. Even the famous black criminal Joe Miller initially refuses the assignment, but having met Beckett in a library, where he is preparing to support the case alone, he changes his mind.
notes: The first merit of the film is the validity of its battle. "Philadelphia" tackles the problem without beating around the bush and does it with vigor and lucidity, thanks to a robust and impeccable script and interpreters who put the best of their skills into it. Oscar for Tom Hanks and the beautiful song "Streets of Philadelphia" by Springsteen (but the soundtrack also includes "Philadelphia" by Neil Young).

title: Halloween II
actors: Donald Pleasence, Jamie Lee Curtis, Charles Cyphers
description: Mike, the Killer of the first "Halloween", although wounded by the eight gunshots fired at him by Dr. Loomis, resumes his murders. In the hunt for the killer, a boy dies in the stake of two cars, then the action is concentrated in the clinic where Michael's sister is hospitalized. The name of John Carpenter remains, director of the first episode to whom he owes his fame, but only as co-writer and author of the music, interesting in their contamination. Here the modest rookie Rosenthal directs.

title: Les sultans
actors: Gina Lollobrigida, Louis Jourdan, Corinne Marchand, Philippe Noiret
description: Lisa, a young Italian photographer who lives in Paris, waits in vain for the man who lives with her. A phone call informs her that he is having a good time in a nightclub with a very young woman. Distraught, Lisa attempts suicide, but is saved. The next day her man tells her that the girl was his daughter. And that same evening he still has a good reason to refuse the invitation to stay with Lisa ...
notes: A strong-colored melodrama, redundant with aestheticisms that were already stale at the time of the film. Unbelievable characters and situations that dangle dangerously on the abyss of absurdity. One of the interpreters is barely saved.

title: Tai-Pan
actors: Bryan Brown, John Stanton, Joan Chen, Tim Guinee, Kyra Sedgwick
description: Tai-Pan, "supreme leader", is the Chinese name of the unscrupulous Scottish Dirk Struan, who runs the most important trading company in the East in Canton. His existence was as libertine as his professional conduct was unscrupulous and in 1839 the authorities expelled him from Canton. Struan founds what will become Hong Kong and resumes his business. When he dies, his son will continue. The exotic charm of the novel by James Clavel from which it is based is lost, in a vacuous spectacle.

title: The Triple Echo
actors: Glenda Jackson, Oliver Reed, Brian Deacon, Jenny Lee Wright
description: In England in 1942, a recruit, John Burton, falls in love with a woman, Alice, whose husband is a prisoner of war. John deserted and disguised himself as a woman posing as Alice's sister. But an officer discovers the trick. Debut between the intimist and the dramatic by Michael Apted.

title: Voltati Eugenio
actors: Saverio Marconi, Dalila Di Lazzaro, Memé Perlini, Francesco Bonelli
description: Eugenio, the son of two ex-sixties in crisis, grows up raised more by the couple's grandparents and friends than by his parents: he will be alone with a dog. Comencinian apologue (which does not take a stand) on the separate worlds of adults and children. Sober, bitter, well interpreted.

title: Any Which Way You Can
actors: Clint Eastwood, Sondra Locke, Geoffrey Lewis, William Smith
description: Philo Beddoe, a mechanic, is also a boxing champion. At the end of the "normal" job he goes around the local clubs to dispute the meetings and find Lynne, his girlfriend who performs in the same places as a singer. To put a spoke in the wheel, however, there is a group of neo-Nazis, the Black Widows, and a frustrated policeman. Philo's new opponent is the fearsome Jack Wilson, but he and Jack will become friends and later defeat the persecutors. It is the sequel to "Filo da torcere" and does not say much more in the characterization of the main characters, wearily equal to themselves.

title: The Ozerov Inheritance
actors: Tony Curtis, Roger Moore
description: First Danny Wilde and Brett Sinclair save an American trade unionist from a bombing. Then they go to Switzerland to save a Grand Duchess from her troubles. It is actually two episodes of the series "Beware of those two" glued together with tape. The directors were two specialists in English fantasy cinema.

title: China Girl
actors: Richard Panebianco, Sari Chang, David Caruso, James Russo
description: Between Little Italy and Chinatown the thwarted love of Tony and Tyan. Updated version of "Romeo and Juliet" hybridized with "West Side Story". Tragic ending and "hand in hand". Despite the production limits, Ferrara offers at least a couple of memorable sequences.

title: Fiorile
actors: Claudio Bigagli, Galatea Ranzi, Michael Vartan, Lino Capolicchio, Chiara Caselli
description: Elizabeth loses her beloved Jean, who is shot, due to the greed of her brother Corrado. One hundred years later Elisa, descendant of Elisabetta, suffers from love for Elio, but this time she does not let herself be fooled and kills her two brothers. In '44 another descendant of the family joins the partisans, but is ingloriously spared by the enemy and loses his head. Today the last heir, who moved to France, takes his wife and son to see his birthplace.
notes: The Taviani brothers have already given. They gave two or three films of absolute importance to Italian cinema (_San Michele had a rooster_, _Allonsanfan_), then they got lost behind the bizarre convulsions of history and spring weaknesses like this one.

title: Storia di una capinera
actors: Angela Bettis, Johnathon Schaech, Sinead Cusack, Vanessa Redgrave
description: Taking advantage of a cholera epidemic, Maria, a young novice, is sent home from the convent. The occasion is good to savor the joys of freedom and also those of infatuation with Nino. After the cholera parenthesis, however, Maria is forced to return to the convent where she is pining with anguish. At the news that Nino is about to marry his sister, Maria loses her head. From the story of Giovanni Verga, a licked and cloying film. Critics have declared that we are not facing Zeffirelli's worst film. And this is a good example of "understatement".

title: Switched at Birth
actors: Bonnie Bedelia, Brian Kerwin, John M. Jackson, Eve Gordon
description: Regina (Bonnie Bedelia) and Ernest Twigg are expecting a baby girl who they have decided to name Arlena. The same thing happens in the Mays house where the birth will have the name of Kimberly. The happy event, which took place at the same time, is marred by a trivial hospital error thanks to which the one who should have been Arlena, goes to live in the Mays house and vice versa. Only ten years later the mistake is discovered, but putting things right is not easy. For what it counts, the idea on which this TV movie is based is a real fact. In fact, at least fifty percent of films made for American television are based on real events. As evidence of the fact that reality is varied, while television films do not.

title: Johnny Apollo
actors: Edward Arnold, Tyrone Power, Dorothy Lamour
description: A university student is marginalized by his classmates because his father has ended up in the cold for embezzlement. So he thinks that if he can get his parent out of jail he will be able to fit into college better. To achieve his goal, however, he puts up with a few good things and even risks becoming a criminal. Well done, but poorly original melodrama.

title: Men Don't Leave
actors: Jessica Lange, Arliss Howard, Joan Cusack, Kathy Bates, Chris O'Donnell
description: Beth Macauley lives in the Baltimore neighborhood along with her husband John and their two children. It is not until John's sudden death that Beth discovers that she has inherited a debt of sixty-three thousand dollars. Forced to move, Beth drags her family to Baltimore, gets a job, and even finds a suitor. At that point, however, his family begins to fall apart.
notes: It is one of those films in which, even though the most tragic and terrible things happen, the characters always come out thanks to "a little understanding". And to think that Brickman had made his debut with "Risky Business" and had also written Demme's "Citizen Band".

title: The Devil at Four O'Clock
actors: Spencer Tracy, Frank Sinatra, Jean-Pierre Aumont, Barbara Luna
description: A Pacific island is about to be destroyed forever by a volcano. All the inhabitants are gone. There is only a small community of leper children left, cared for by an old Irish priest (Tracy) and a few others. Three convicts are also forced to reside on the island. The priest manages to get their cooperation to work together with the leper colony. Exotic adventure films with some pretense of psychological definition in the characters of the priest, who has given himself up to drinking, and the head of the convicts sensitive to moral values ??(played by Sinatra). And then, in the end, a spectacular eruption of the volcano.

title: Dancing in the Dark
actors: William Powell, Mark Stevens, Adolphe Menjou
description: An actor, famous in the silent era, agrees to be a talent scout for a film company. While auditioning a certain Julie she discovers that this is the daughter she had abandoned as a young man. Discreet but dull musical written under a pseudonym by producer Darryl F. Zanuck.

title: The Girl Can't Help It
actors: Tom Ewell, Jayne Mansfield, Edmond O'Brien, Julie London
description: Second-rate gangster Marty Murdock hires ad promotion specialist Tom Ewell to turn his little friend Jerri Jordan into a big rock 'n' roll star. Jerri, however, is out of tune as a bell and moreover she is not interested in success, she likes to be a housewife very well.
notes: Tashlin, together with screenwriter Herbert Baker, signs his most successful performance without Lewis, an amazing all-curvy (Mansfield) and rock'n'roll musical, full of daring double meanings. The soundtrack entrusted to Little Richard, Eddie Cochran, Fats Domino, Gene Vincent and the Platters is really excellent.

title: The Wayward Bus
actors: Joan Collins, Rick Jason, Dan Dailey, Jayne Mansfield, Larry Keating, Dolores Michaels
description: The little stories and the big and small dramas of a group of passengers on a bus traveling to San Juan. The drama is always around the corner but all is well that ends well. From a Steinbeck novel, a solid little film well performed.

title: The Woman of Summer
actors: Joanne Woodward, Richard Beymer, Claire Trevor
description: Young Lila's dreams of success have now been shattered in a mediocre career. The shabby company in which she is engaged makes a stop in Lila's hometown which is hosted by an old friend who has been widowed. Her friend's son falls in love with her ...
notes: Mediocre drama with strong sentimental tints.

title: Night Hunt
actors: Helen Shaver, Stefanie Powers, Kathleen Robertson
description: We are in New York, any night. Three friends in a car are forced to cross a neighborhood from which it would be better to stay away. As if that weren't enough, their vehicle runs out of petrol; lost and defenseless, the three women become easy prey for a gang of thugs, whose leader, moreover, does not have much thought: a tragic hunt that not all of them will survive. The film is a sum of clichés of the metropolitan cinematographic imaginary of the last decades. Among the three protagonists, the best known face is undoubtedly that of Helen Shaver ("Hearts in the desert" and "The color of money", among others).

title: A Private's Affair
actors: Sal Mineo, Barry Coe, Gary Crosby, Christine Carere
description: Three friends, Luigi, Jerry and Mike, end up in the army and are assigned to the same body; here they meet Louise, Marie and Kathy. The three soldiers have also formed a complex with which they must debut on a television show, but Jerry falls ill with laryngitis. Due to a misunderstanding, however, he is mistaken for a dying bed neighbor and married to an unknown woman.
notes: Filmed by Walsh without too much conviction and for simple contract reasons, it is a spirited musical comedy but quite obvious and often close to farce.

title: Jubal
actors: Glenn Ford, Ernest Borgnine, Felicia Farr, Rod Steiger, Valerie French
description: Jubal is a skilled and experienced cowboy who, having won the friendship of a ranchero, becomes his right hand. But the boss's wife falls in love with him and the trouble begins. Western jealousy drama, solidly directed by a master of the genre, and with a first-rate cast.

title: Southern Confort
actors: Keith Carradine, Powers Boothe, Fred Ward, Peter Coyote
description: Nine National Guard boys in training wander through a swampy area of ??Louisiana. This is the territory of the Cajuns, an ancient community of hunters of French origin. The soldiers are smargiassi and steal some canoes from the natives. Thus began a ruthless guerrilla: the children in uniform, lost and with weapons loaded with blanks, are hunted down and slaughtered like rabbits. With minimal means, exploiting the full evocative potential of the extraordinary locations, Walter Hill creates a masterpiece of action cinema. The reference to Vietnam and the American macho culture is clear, but the parable, with passages of masterful and unsustainable tension, pushes reflection on almost metaphysical levels.

title: When a Man Loves a Woman
actors: Meg Ryan, Andy Garcia, Ellen Burstyn, Lauren Tom, Mae Whitman, Tina Majorino
description: The Green family is exemplary: two spouses who love each other and who raise their two daughters with equal love. Until, one bad day, what is the skeleton in Mrs. Green's closet emerges: her relationship of addiction to alcohol that no one has ever noticed. And it will be a dramatic series of worries and tensions, until the poor woman manages to get out of it. The Mexican Luis Mandoki directed the remarkable "Hot emotion" in 1990, then, swallowed up by the Hollywood apparatus, it has never been able to repeat itself. And here - even the fault of a banal script - almost everything is wrong (and his actors with him).

title: Outomlionnye solntsem
actors: Oleg Mencikov, Nikita Mikhalkov, Igeborga Dapkunaite, Nadia Michalkova
description: Summer '36. Colonel Sergei Petrovic Kotov lives with his family in a Russian village, with a glorious past. When Dimitri appears, the first love of Kotov's wife, who works for Stalin's police, brings death with it. Which will be, for the colonel and his wife in front of a firing squad.
notes: Nikita Michalkov has learned to make products that are pleasing to producers and the public in the West. It is not the elegance that he lacks, rather it is precisely the smug aesthetic research that goes to the detriment of the film's vigor and backbone. Kotov's daughter is played by Nadia Michalkova, the director's daughter.

title: Fuck the World
actors: Mickey Rourke, Lori Singer, Brion James, Peter Berg
description: Frank T. Wells was a rodeo champion and now, after ten undeserved years in jail, he says, he is somewhat in disarmament. When his path crosses that of Scarlett Stuart, a girl too "tied" to her robber brother, the two discover that they are made for each other. But happiness is not of this world, much less for characters predestined (according to mediocre literature) to perdition.
notes: The author of the subject, under a noble pseudonym, is Mickey Rourke himself. And, in its multifaceted paucity - presumptuous dialogue, heavy sex, begging "romanticism" - the film is at the service of the actor and his well-known mediocrity.

title: Geronimo
actors: Wes Studi, Jason Patric, Gene Hackman, Robert Duvall, Matt Damon, Rodney A. Grant, Kevin Tighe, Steve Revis, Carlos Palomino, Victor Aaron
description: In 1886, now alone with thirty-five Ciricahua Apaches to fight against a few thousand light cavalrymen of the United States Army, Geronimo surrenders: "Do what you want with me." The film reconstructs the last year of the epic, desperate resistance of the Native American warriors before the surrender, in a narrative filtered through the eyes of the young Lieutenant Gatewood, fresh from West Point. "Dances with wolves" has given new life to a genre, that of the "good" Indians, which seemed now extinct, but Walter Hill's film lacks warmth in its making, too sensitive to stylistic affectation and not very exciting.

title: Calendar Girl
actors: Jason Priestley, Gabriel Olds, Jerry O'Connell, Joe Pantoliano, Stephen Tobolowsky
description: Roy, Ned and Scotty, all in love with Marilyn Monroe from an early age, travel to Los Angeles to meet their idol. After several failures, it happens that one of them really manages to spend an evening with the diva. A very chaste evening, for heaven's sake, delicate, under the stars, by the sea. But it's always better than nothing. Then Marilyn dies and the three of them grow up. How come a film like this, which could have been written by a child, found its way to Italian screens? Only because it is strengthened by the presence of Jason Priestley, hero of "Beverly Hills 90210", here at his cinematic debut.

title: Naked Gun 33 1/3: the Final Insult
actors: O. J. Simpson, Leslie Nielsen, Priscilla Presley, George Kennedy, Anna Nicole Smith, Fred Ward
description: Having reached retirement age, the catastrophic Lieutenant Frank Drebin leaves the service to devote himself to housework. However, when he is recalled to help fight the group of the grim terrorist Rocco, who escaped from prison with a crazy project in mind, his wife leaves him. But his is a real mission, and Drebin is forced to intervene: he will also have to save the night of the Oscars, which is in the sights of the criminals. Although in the end, in truth, not much remains standing ... After those of 1988 and 1991, the third episode of the series does not come out of the rut of the previous ones: we are always in the wild and paroxysmal parody of the conventions of the detective and the noir, conducted on the strength of a smashing and accumulatory comedy. In previous episodes of the "saga of the bullet", the clumsy Drebin - played, as always, by the hilarious Leslie Nielsen - first found himself at the center of a ramshackle political fantasy adventure and then the protagonist of an anti-ecological plot (and, in spite of himself , savior of none other than President Bush sr.). The screenplay is again signed by the unstoppable trio Zucker-Abrahams-Zucker, who - consistently with the style of the "firm" - do not retreat from anything: here, then, between one mockery and another, quotations from the "Wife of the soldier "or from" Thelma & Louise ". Do not miss the credits and the cameos by Elliott Gould, Pia Zadora, Al Jankovic and Mariel Hemingway ..

title: Heart of Darkness
actors: John Malkovich, Tim Roth, Isaach De Bankolé, James Fox
description: On behalf of a Belgian traffic and transport company, Marlow (Roth) goes up the Congo River to get to the Internal Station, the one managed by Kurtz (Malkovich). Kurtz's name, even for Marlow who is the latest addition, is like a legend. The latest news about him is vague, patchy and disturbing. Maybe it's hiding large quantities of ivory or maybe it's dead. This is the film that Orson Welles wanted to make and that Coppola instead made it calling it "Apocalypse now". Roeg adapts it for TV correctly but without big flights. Too bad because the cast promised.

title: The Face on the Milk Carton
actors: Jill Clayburgh, Kellie Martin, Sharon Lawrence, Edward Herrmann
description: Jamie is haunted by a recurring dream, in which a man and a woman unknown to her appear. One bad day, the girl discovers a disturbing secret about her: she was kidnapped as a child and the couple she grew up with are not her natural family. Jamie then decides with great determination to search for his true origins in order to decide who to stay with. How little is needed to lose security in one's personal identity. Waris Hussein is a television production specialist; Jill Clayburgh had some cinematic notoriety a few years ago ("The Moon", "A Woman All Alone").

title: Far From Home
actors: Matt Frewer, Drew Barrymore, Richard Masur, Karen Austin
description: A little girl (Drew Barrymore) is spending the holidays with dad, but is targeted by a dumb killer. Seven years after her role in "E. T.", we find Barrymore disoriented and lost in this rather mediocre film in which, for the first time, she finds herself grappling with a teenage role. The director fails to get the story off the ground, also due to obvious flaws in the script.

title: Straight to Hell
actors: Dick Rude, Sy Richardson, Joe Strummer, Courtney Love, Dennis Hopper, Jim Jarmusch, Grace Jones
description: An unfortunate trio of robbers is blocked in seedy El Blanco, the realm of boss McMahon. Failed attempt at spaghetti westerns with a good cast made up almost exclusively of stars from the world of music. In fact, alongside Dennis Hopper we find Grace Jones, Elvis Costello, Joe Strummer (former member of the Clash), Courtney Love (widow Cobain and founder of the band "The Hole"), the Irish group of the Pogues and independent director Jim Jarmusch. Directs Alex Cox, author of a good film ("Sid and Nancy", 1986) about the life of Sid Vicious, leader of the Sex Pistols and his partner Nancy Sprungen.

title: The Persuaders
actors: Tony Curtis, Roger Moore, Susan George
description: Wilde and Lord Sinclair are two happy friends on holiday in Monte Carlo; while water skiing they discover a corpse, but their complaint is met with disinterest by the police. The two turn into detectives, discover the killers and a gold trafficking between France and Italy. Not only that: they identify the reasons for the poor hearing obtained by the policemen in the private interests of a judge. Don't look for the title in official filmographies; these are two episodes of the successful television series, reunited in Italy for the big screen. International intrigues told with strong British humor (Val Guest among the screenwriters).

title: The Fiction Makers
actors: Roger Moore, Sylvia Syms, Justine Lord, Kenneth J. Warren
description: Actor Simon Templar (Roger Moore), known as the "Saint", casually involved in the adventure, defeats, together with a writer of detective stories, a gang of thieves who took the cue for their own criminal enterprises from those books . The fusion of adventure and humor works quite well and the film, while unpretentious, is very enjoyable.

title: Octopussy
actors: Roger Moore, Maud Adams, Louis Jourdan, Kabir Bedi
description: James Bond discovers that an Indian prince, a Soviet general and a fascinating and mysterious woman who calls herself Octopussy, owner of a circus that serves as a cover for the traffic of precious things, are involved in a mysterious trade in fake jewelery from the USSR. . But the real purpose of the criminal organization is to introduce a nuclear device into Germany.
notes: Sixth Bond for fifty-five-year-old Roger Moore, the second directed by John Glen, the thirteenth in the series. Cuba, Karl Marx Stadt, London, Udaipur, Berlin and a US base in the GDR are the locations where 007 (and its stuntmen) perform traditional wonders.

title: Perdiamoci di vista
actors: Carlo Verdone, Asia Argento, Aldo Maccione, Sonia Gessner
description: Gepy Fuxas hosts a television program based on the protagonists' live account of their existential misfortunes. One day a handicapped girl, host of the show, accuses him live of exploiting the misfortunes of others. The program crashes and Gepy loses his job. The girl goes to look for him and with her friendship awakens humanity. The intent is to demolish the television mechanism of the "live tear" with the weapon of comedy. The operation is unsolved and at times contradictory. Actor Verdone is too comical. Excellent, however, Asia Argento.

title: Donne con le gonne
actors: Francesco Nuti, Carole Bouquet, Gastone Moschin, Cinzia Leone
description: Renzo Calabrese, a thirty-year-old doctor, falls in love with Rita, a beautiful, restless woman with a politically stormy past. He is a traditionalist, faithful and jealous. Their relationship goes through successive complications, not excluding that of kidnapping by a Renzo who became the master husband. Tried and jailed, the two will get back together loving and fighting for life. Nuti pretends to address topical issues, filtering them with irony and paradox. But the film runs in vain due to the approximation of the discourse and the stylistic mess that characterizes the staging. The profession is not enough to always hit the spot.

title: The Breaking Point
actors: John Garfield, Patricia Neal, Phyllis Taxter, Wallace Ford
description: Harry Morgan (Garfield) makes a living in Newport, California by ferrying tourists on his boat. One day he takes a certain Hannagan to Mexico, but he disappears on arrival before paying. Without a penny, Harry doesn't know how to get home and so he agrees to illegally transport eight Chinese to the American shores. And this is only the beginning of his troubles.
notes: Second version of Hemingway's famous novel "To have and not to have" (or, if you like, remake of "Waters of the South" by Hawks). We no longer have Bogart or even Bacall who proved he can whistle and sing, but Garfield, in his latest film for Warner, is extraordinary and the direction of Curtiz is in perfect balance between the realism of the outsiders and the spirit of adventure. The ending is memorable.

title: She Fought Alone
actors: Tiffani Thiessen, Brian Austin Green
description: Caitlin Rose studies at Lockhart High School, has a mother with whom she systematically argues and a hope: to become part of the most exclusive club in the high school. In that club is, among other things, Ethan, the guy for whom Caitlin has a passion. Unfortunately, Jace is also in the club who first molests her, then rapes her and then denies everything. Caitlin is desperate and only her mother will be able to help her. At first it looks like one of the many college-movies, the ones in which the kids do a little bit of mischief, but deep down they are basically good. Then it turns to the drama even if the result is not, in the same way, particularly interesting.

title: Rocking Gibraltar
actors: Burt Lancaster, Macaulay Culkin, John Glover, Kevin Spacey
description: Levi Rockwell (Lancaster) is one of those writers who got blacklisted during the "witch hunt" era. She now lives a quiet old age in Saggaponack, Long Island, and is looking forward to celebrating her seventy-seventh birthday along with her four children, their respective wives and eight grandchildren. But Levi's heart is too weak ... All in all, a good opportunity thrown away by director Petrie's ignorance. Lancaster in the role of the patriarch and Kevin Spacey do not compensate for the presence of the hateful little Culkin.

title: Crime in the Street
actors: James Withmore, John Cassavetes, Sal Mineo, Mark Rydell
description: Denounced by a man for a dangerous fight, the young Frankie Dane, a hooligan from New York neighborhoods, is sentenced to one year in reform school. After serving his sentence, Frankie plots revenge, even if he struggles to find accomplices: in fact, only two boys of his gang are willing to follow him. Frankie's younger brother tries to use the neighborhood social worker to dissuade the young man from his intentions, but the boy remains numb. Just as Frankie is about to stab the "spy" ... Bitter and dramatic, the film is, for its time, a remarkable example of an appropriate analysis of juvenile distress and delinquency in US metropolises. Even today, albeit for more "savvy" spectators, it retains robust qualities.

title: The Wild Geese
actors: Richard Burton, Roger Moore, Richard Harris, Stewart Granger, Hardy Krüger
description: Sir Edward Matherson summons the adventurer Colonel Allen Falkner to whom he asks to free the former president of an African state ousted by the coup leader Zembala. Falkner gathers three of his close associates and recruits about fifty mercenaries with whom he carries out his mission. In the meantime, however, Sir Edward has made an agreement with Zembala and leaves the mercenaries to their fate. But these manage to survive and so ...
notes: Classic action and adventure film with a war background: big and spectacular action scenes, star cast and a half-serious, smashing spirit.

title: Happy Birthday To Me
actors: Glenn Ford, Melissa Sue Anderson, Sharon Hacker, Frances Hyland
description: Virginia Wainwright studies at Crawford Academy, but it's not all in her head. After the accident in which her mother was killed, Virginia recovered from the brain trauma, but from the moment some of her schoolmates are found killed, the situation has become dire. Virginia then enlisted the help of Dr. David Faraday (Glenn Ford) with even more bloody results.
notes: If the term "craftsman" did not exist, it would have to be invented for Lee Thompson (and not just in a good way). Glenn Ford in the post "Halloween" environment is like a fish out of water. Perhaps it is for a jolt of dignity that he gets killed before the end.

title: The Incident
actors: Walter Matthau, Susan Blakely, Robert Carradine
description: In a small town in the United States, a German army sergeant is accused of killing a prison camp doctor. The lawyer realizes that the sentence of the sergeant has already been decided since, once found guilty, he can be used as a bargaining chip with American pilots who are prisoners of the Germans. He then decides to fight for the truth to come out.
notes: A dramatic case of conscience is treated in this television film by the cast of exception but without major surprises. Joseph Sargent's career has developed above all in television, with some appearances on the big screen.

title: Hard Justice
actors: David Bradley, Charles Napier, Yuji Okumoto
description: The story begins with the brave agent Nick Adams who narrowly lets the dangerous Jimmy Wong escape during a robbery. Later, after his best friend is killed during a prison investigation, Nick gets imprisoned undercover to find out about the weapons trafficking in which Wong is still involved. The clashes take place to reach a real final battle. It is a non-stop action film, held with some verve by director Greg Yaitanes. There are no stars in the cast, but cinephiles will not fail to recognize Charles Napier, effective in the role of the sadistic warden of the prison.

title: The Great Mom Swap
actors: Mary Kate Schellhardt, Shelley Fabares, Valerie Harper, Hillary Tuck
description: Terry and Karen are two high school classmates. Companions, but not friends: their character and different social origins divide them. Terry is the daughter of merchants and Karen comes from the upper middle class. After yet another clash, the school authorities require them to live for a month by exchanging families. At the end of the experience, not only do the two overcome the old mutual prejudices but, on the contrary, they even become close friends. Disposable comedy. The script, like the dialogues and the basic assumption, is flat and predictable: neither the shadow of a smile nor the shadow of any reflection on those social contrasts which it would pretend to allude to.

title: Le Samouraï
actors: Alain Delon, Nathalie Delon, François Périer, Cathy Rosier, Catherine Jourdan, Jacques Leroy
description: Jeff Costello is a killer who, having carried out the murder commissioned to him, escapes arrest with the help of his lover. His life hangs by a thread, hunted by the police and their principals. Frank decides to take an extreme solution. The original title gives a good idea of ??the film, an intense and bitter meditation on destiny and loneliness. Those of Melville are anti-heroes, his times are meticulous and dilated, his suspense is entirely moral. Delon's unperturbed mask serves the purpose perfectly. A masterpiece of style.

title: The Return of Frank James
actors: Henry Fonda, Gene Tierney, Jackie Cooper, John Carradine
description: Jesse James, the famous bandit, was killed by the Ford brothers. Arrested, they are jailed but, under political pressure, they are released. Jesse's brother Frank sets out on their trail. Thanks to a journalist, he publishes the news of his death, thus managing to move undisturbed, to track down the Fords and kill one of them first and then, after returning to his country and having to undergo a trial, the other as well. A year after the excellent "Jess the Bandit" by Henry King, the young Fonda, still in the role of Frank James, but this time the absolute protagonist. Lang's first western (and first color film). An unusually documented and realistic classic, sustained by the director's sense of destiny and justice.

title: Stone Cold
actors: Brian Bosworth, Lance Henriksen, William Forsythe
description: A policeman, Joe Huff, suspended from service for insubordination, witnesses a shooting in a supermarket caused by some thugs on motorcycles. Jeff reacts and takes out the thugs. At this point the FBI forces him to infiltrate the gang where he enters the graces of the grim boss, Chains, and falls in love with Nancy, his woman. This, however, will betray him by revealing his true identity ...
notes: Unsuccessful attempt to throw former American football champion Brian Bosworth, a blonde with a square jaw but with a dull expression, into the cinema. Discreetly shoot the numerous chase sequences and endless shootings.

title: Young Mr. Lincoln
actors: Henry Fonda, Alice Brady, Ward Bond, Marjorie Weaver, Arleen Whelan
description: Future President Lincoln is a young lawyer struggling with two brothers accused of murder.
notes: Exciting and vigorous: a masterpiece. Public and private, history and myth in a moving celebration of American virtues. The film thrilled Eisenstein with its cinematic representation of harmony.

title: Death Becomes Her
actors: Meryl Streep, Goldie Hawn, Bruce Willis, Isabella Rossellini
description: Madeleine and Helen live and work in Beverly Hills. The two women, dangerously close to the fateful threshold of half a century, are two former friends now bitter rivals, despite still flaunting smiles and affected sympathy for each other. Both, a writer, the other actress, on the avenue of the professional sunset, are also in crisis from the sentimental point of view. A modern witch offers them a filter that restores youth and makes them practically immortal. The two rival friends win it, but they will discover that the remedy is worse than the disease. The film is in part yet another variation of the Faustian myth of immortality. But it is above all a comedy that makes fun of the manias of youth at all costs. The two women will in fact end up looking like two puppets (with the body in pieces that are badly reassembled). The special effects are effective and fun.

title: B. F.'s Daughter
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, Van Heflin, Charles Coburn
description: The daughter of a millionaire marries a proud and penniless writer helping him, without his knowledge, to be successful. When he discovers everything, furious, he leaves her. But for a short time. High Bourgeois comedy, solid in the direction and cast.

title: The Passage
actors: Anthony Quinn, James Mason, Malcolm McDowell, Patricia Neal
description: A scientist and his daughter flee occupied France. A Basque shepherd (Quinn) leads them over the Pyrenees, escaping the SS that chase them. Routine war drama. Sloppy direction, manner interpretation, at times even caricatured.

title: Passage to Marseille
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Michèle Morgan, Claude Rains, Peter Lorre
description: Having escaped from Devil's Island, some criminals in the mood for redemption swear to fight Nazi-fascism and become war heroes in an air squadron of free France.
notes: Dark melodrama of war, often poignant, marked by the accumulation of flashbacks. Great cast, with Humphrey Bogart and Claude Rains again side by side two years after "Casablanca".

title: I, Madman
actors: Jenny Wright, Clayton Rohner, Randall William Cook, Stephanie Hodge
description: The insane psychopath Dr. Kessler haunts Virginia, an admirer of her horror novels. But he will be devoured by his son, a hideous creature resulting from his insane plans. Winner of the specialized festival of Avoriaz, he has all the ingredients to satisfy the lovers of the genre, but lacks particularly original ideas.

title: Bridge Across Time
actors: David Hasselhoff, Stepfanie Kramer, Adrienne Barbeau, Randolph Mantooth
description: London Bridge is where Jack the Ripper ended his days in 1888. The usual American eccentric bought the artifact and rebuilt it for tourist purposes in Arizona. On the day of the inauguration, however, brutal murders occur that seem to follow Jack's technique ...
notes: Disturbing film that combines "English" gothic elements with "American" police investigations.

title: Chronos
actors: Federico Luppi, Ron Perlman, Claudio Brook, Margarita Isabel
description: An alchemist who escaped the Inquisition takes refuge in Mexico bringing with him his tragic and sensational discovery: a mechanism capable of stopping time, but also of inducing the happy immortal to an inextinguishable dependence on human blood. In the Thirties the machine reappears, discovered by chance by an antique dealer (Luppi). Then the billionaire Dieter de la Guardia becomes interested in her. Great debut by the Mexican (from Guadalajara) Benicio Del Toro. It's still the same old vampire story (and the script isn't quite bombproof), but shot with inventiveness and good style. The Argentine Federico Luppi is always a certainty.

title: El exterminador de la carretera
actors: Robert Jannucci, Alicia Moro, Luca Venantini
description: The Exterminator and his girlfriend looking for drinking water. Low post-atomic co-production, designed for depressed markets. There is also Luca Venantini ("Strangled Lives").

title: Fatal Instinct
actors: Armand Assante, Sherilyn Fenn, Kate Nelligan, Sean Young
description: Ned Revine is a busy man in his profession. Which are two professions, given that at night, as a policeman, he arrests criminals and during the day, as a lawyer, he defends them in court. His life is not peaceful, as is his sentimental situation, so much so that his wife (who cheats him abundantly) and his mistress join forces to send him to the creator. The title refers, combining them, to the two "hot" films with Michael Douglas but, here and there, other ironic "quotes" also appear. All this, however, works only in flashes (not very frequent). Remarkable, on the other hand, is Assante in a comic role.

title: Once Were Warriors
actors: Rena Owen, Temuera Morrison, Mamaengaroa Ker-Bell, Shannon Williams
description: The Heke family lives, like many other Maori natives, in a modest house on the outskirts of Auckland, New Zealand. The father, with a powerful physique, is often intractable, his wife suffers the violence, but still feels a strong attraction for him. One son is about to join a gang of young rebels, another is in trouble with the police, a 13-year-old daughter is raped by an uncle ... Tough, fed on multiple violence, Tamahori's robust debut feature puts a strong centerpiece at its core. figure of a woman, the mother of the Heke family, the focus of a story of tormenting complexity. In the role, Rena Owen is great.

title: Lost in Yonkers
actors: Mercedes Ruehl, Irene Worth, Richard Dreyfuss, David Strathairn, Brad Stoll, Mike Damus
description: Jay and Arty Kurnitz (15 and 13 years old) are entrusted by their father to their grandmother, a terrible Jewish matriarch who lives with her daughter Stella, 36 years old but a child's brain. Every now and then a nice rash uncle also appears who lives by expedients. From a certain moment on, Stella, with a generous heart, becomes the true protagonist of this ensemble comedy based on feelings. Based on a comedy that is part of an autobiographical triptych by Neil Simon, the film wastes most of the merits of the text in a film direction of little acumen and weak bite. The period reconstruction is meticulous, the interpretation is good.

title: Intersection
actors: Richard Gere, Sharon Stone, Lolita Davidovich, Martin Landau
description: A Vancouver architect, to whom life seems to have given everything it can (professional success, a beautiful wife and teenage daughter who love him), falls in love with a much younger journalist. The protagonist tries not to put himself in the situation of having to choose between his wife and his lover, but fate lurks in the form of a car accident.
notes: Remake of the French "Les choses de la vie" (here "L'amante"), by Claude Sautet, 1970, does not stand up to any comparison with the valuable original. Only the interesting Sharon Stone deserves a mention, she is not the lover but the betrayed wife.

title: Le notti bianche
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Maria Schell, Jean Marais, Clara Calamai
description: Mario meets Natalia who, like every evening, is waiting to meet a man she is madly in love with. It seems that a feeling must arise between the two, when the stranger really appears.
notes: From Dostoyevsky's short novel. The scenographic reconstruction in Cinecittà of the city of Livorno is extraordinary (by the scenographers Chiari and Garbuglia), in which Visconti manages to create an enigmatic and murky tenderness. However, the film remains bloodless and monotonous.

title: Frauds
actors: Phil Collins, Hugo Weaving, Josephine Byrnes, Peter Mochrie
description: Roland Copping (Collins) is an insurance investigator with a background of malignant sadism that comes straight from childhood. When Beth and Jonathan's house is burgled and Beth herself snatches the thief only to discover that it was a friend in the mood for jokes, then Roland enters the field. For him, "torching" the two spouses is child's play. Phill Collins, singer and (above all) drummer, also shows good skills as an actor. Stephan Elliott's ("Priscilla") script is decidedly original, the direction makes good use of bizarre sets.

title: The Persuaders
actors: Tony Curtis, Roger Moore, Suzy Kendall
description: The Englishman Lord Brett Sinclair and his inseparable American friend Danny White, unmask a counterintelligence agent sold to the Russians and make the plan of a skilled and handsome scammer fail. Two funny adventures taken from the well-known television series.

title: Hard Evidence
actors: Gregory Harrison, Joan Severance, Colin Cunningham, James Crescenzo
description: Trent Tunner and Adam Russell are friends and business partners; the first has a beautiful wife and a fabulous house, the other is single. But Trent's marriage isn't going too well; The man thus accepts his friend Dina's invitation for a weekend out of town, but discovers - too late - that Dina is a drug courier. After being forced to kill an agent of the Goddess, Trent and Dina fall into a whirlwind of blackmail and murder that will risk destroying their lives.
notes: The usual story that moves from a situation of normality (sentimental and existential) to precipitate the protagonists - and the viewer with them - in a (predictable) circle of nightmares.

title: Touch of Truth
actors: Patty Duke, Melissa Gilbert, Bradley Pierce
description: Michael, an autistic child, is assisted by his mother, who is totally dedicated to him, and by a teacher who tries to bring him back to life. However, no one knows that the child was raped by a young assistant: once again the teacher, with great patience, will bring out the horrible truth, frame the rapist and bring the child back on the path of even partial recovery. There are more and more films destined for television that deal with children, their traumatic experiences, their handicaps, the dramatic relationship with the adult world. Civil commitment supported by unsurprising suspense.

title: The Best Man
actors: Henry Fonda, Cliff Robertson, Lee Tracy, Mahalia Jackson
description: On the occasion of a political congress, the two most accredited aspirants to the White House compete for the sympathies of the outgoing (and dying) President. The latter is very undecided between the two because those who have character have little ethical sense while the more honest lacks a bit in "decisionism".
notes: Great script by Gore Vidal who in his own way makes a great apologue on power referring to Stevenson and Nixon.

title: A Foreign Affair
actors: Marlene Dietrich, Jean Arthur, John Lund, Millard Mitchell
description: An American parliamentary commission is sent to Berlin in the immediate postwar period to investigate the moral behavior of American troops. The most zealous of the commission is Phoebe Frost, who focuses her attention on an officer who is too interested in Erika, a singer who was already a friend of Hitler. From Billy Wilder, with his usual, biting malice capable of screwing up any moralistic arrogance, a spirited and sexy spy comedy, with Marlene singing as well.

title: Vacanze in America
actors: Jerry Calà, Christian De Sica, Claudio Amendola, Antonella Interlenghi, Edwige Fenech
description: A group of pupils and alumni of a Roman college run by priests make a two-week leisure trip to the United States, in the company of a couple of religious. For some of them there is a bin around the corner, for others there will be more or less successful sentimental adventures. For everyone a lot of mishaps that will be resolved in a happy ending with the return home. "Exotic" variant of one of the usual cheap films of the stainless Vanzina brothers.

title: Dr. No
actors: Sean Connery, Ursula Andress, Joseph Wiseman, Eunice Gayson
description: James Bond, an agent in the service of her British majesty, is sent to Jamaica to investigate two mysterious murders. With a local girl who has offered to be his guide, Bond arrives at Crab Key, the refuge of prof. Dent and dr. No. Captured, Bond learns of No's sinister plans for American missiles, but with a skilful coup he escapes with the girl after destroying the shelter.
notes: Before this film Connery was a good Scottish actor, Ursula Andress a completely unknown Swiss woman and James Bond a character from the press. Everyone knows what became of them after this film. Still one of the best examples of the series. Brilliant opening credits, Andress's dazzling appearance, uninterrupted suspense.

title: Mr. Belvedere Goes to College
actors: Clifton Webb, Shirley Temple, Tom Drake, Alan Young, Jessie Royce Landis
description: Endless problems for a writer looking for a degree in record time, to participate in a rich literary prize. Hitches and bureaucratic issues and varied relationships with the students, but also love ties. In particular, a budding journalist (Temple) begins to take an interest in him. Obviously everything works out in the end.
notes: At the end of the 1940s, Hollywood cinema often constructed truly incredible stories, passing them off as the misadventures of the "neighbor". The public enjoyed themselves in front of these crazy events and the eternal happy ending.

title: Audrey Rose
actors: Marsha Mason, Anthony Hopkins, John Beck
description: The father of a girl who died in an accident at the age of five claims to be sure that his daughter's spirit has reincarnated in Ivy, a girl who is now eleven. Of course, Ivy's parents do not want to accept the strange thesis and, tired of her insistent attentions, they sue the man in court. In order to deliver a verdict, the judge requires Ivy to undergo a hypnosis experiment in which it is proven that she is true reincarnation.

title: Spider Baby, or The Maddest Story Ever Told
actors: Jill Banner, Lon Chaney jr., Carol Ohmart, Sid Haig, Beverly Washburn
description: Young Virginia Merrye (like her brothers Elizabeth and Ralph) is mentally retarded with a vocation for cannibalism. When she plays, Virginia pretends to be a spider. When the postman arrives, Virginia kills him. Too bad, because he was bringing the news of Aunt Emily's arrival.
notes: A mix of horror, sexy and demented comedy directed by Jack Hill, one who begins his career (along with Coppola and Hellman) with Roger Corman's "The Terror". Lon Chaney jr. plays the driver and sings in the opening credits. The film is also known as "The Liver Eaters".

title: Vacanze di Natale
actors: Jerry Calà, Christian De Sica, Stefania Sandrelli, Karina Huff, Marilù Tolo, Claudio Amendola, Antonella Interlenghi, Moana Pozzi
description: In a large hotel in Cortina, various events intertwine against the backdrop of the Christmas holidays. There are the enriched who would like to promote themselves socially, the playboys who chase after the ladies, the husbands who are looking for extramarital affairs, there are those who find their first love and those who are looking for a new one. And there is a boy who finds the courage to declare his homosexuality to his parents. Snowy version of "Sapore di mare", based on the presence of television stars, directed with the usual style by the specialist Carlo Vanzina. The interpretation of De Sica in the role of the young gay is perhaps the only original note.

title: Strepitosamente... flop
actors: Dalila Di Lazzaro, Urbano Barberini, Gabriele Gori, Donatella Rettore, Adriana Russo, Giovanna Rotellini, Claudio Maria Passoli, Rossana Gavinel
description: Massimo, Alessio, Paolo, Milly and Cinzia live in a farmhouse on the outskirts of the city. Each of them is looking for its realization in society and for this they are busy. But their enthusiasm is forced to deal with a hard reality. Comedy is a collection of specks and stereotypes with ambitions of social criticism.

title: Porky's
actors: Dan Monahan, Mark Herrier, Kim Cattrall, Scott Colomby, Kaki Hunter, Nancy Parsons
description: Some Angel Beach high schoolers pop into the infamous "Porky's" in Wallace County. Here they are variously mistreated and even the sheriff is against them. Mickey tries again, but things get even worse for him. At this point his friends organize a "punitive expedition" which will be the ruin of "Porky's" and a bad setback for the sheriff who protects the place.
notes: In the background of this laughing sexual-student epic are "American graffiti" and "Animal House", revisited, however, with heavy concessions to a comedy that, rather than goliardic, we would call "militresca" (ie barracks).

title: Crimewave
actors: Louise Lasser, Paul Smith, Brion James, Sheree Wilson
description: Vic Ajax is already in the electric chair, waiting for the fatal discharge; only Nancy, his girlfriend, could save him. Meanwhile, he tells his version of events: he has not killed anyone and the perpetrators of some of the crimes charged to him are two rat exterminators who, every now and then, overflow from their profession and also kill human beings. All sorts of things have happened, and Nancy is still not seen ... Sam Raimi, here in his second direction, creates a film that clearly refers to animated drawings for rhythm and narrative extravagance. nice result. Written with the Coen brothers.

title: Forrest Gump
actors: Tom Hanks, Robin Wright, Gary Sinise, Sally Field, Mykelti Williamson
description: Forrest Gump is a slow-talking Southern boy who, thanks to his kindness and incurable optimism, becomes a football star, a war hero, an athlete, a millionaire and also marries the girl of the gods. his dreams. Throughout his life, Forrest has the opportunity to meet the great leaders of his time, from Nixon to Lennon; le to travel from Vietnam to Washington, from the Republic of China to London, to New York.
notes: The film, which won six Oscars (including film and direction), is an American portrait balanced between show and sensibility. The direction of Zemeckis leaves the audience with bitterness and a sense of uneasiness, despite apparently telling us a good story. Among the Oscars there is also the one attributed to Tom Hanks, "perfect idiot" of great talent (who repeats the award obtained the year before with "Philadelphia") and special effects (which allowed the interaction of the different characters historians with Hanks).

title: Le nuove comiche
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Renato Pozzetto, Ramona Badescu
description: A covered truck. On the tarpaulin the writing "Generator Group". The tarpaulin falls and he discovers some cyclists pedaling all together spinning a giant bicycle wheel which in turn turns the dynamo fixed to the tire. It is the most silent and sympathetic gimmick of Neri Parenti's "New Comics". First, a ballet without electricity and a magistrate in need of an escort pay the price. Or it is they themselves, Villaggio and Pozzetto, who damage each other in order to compete for a girl at the campsite. The inspiration of the protagonists is inversely proportional to the number of lines they pronounce. The imitation of silent cinema therefore gives the happiest results.

title: Tutti gli anni una volta all'anno
actors: Giorgio Albertazzi, Lando Buzzanca, Paola Pitagora
description: Ten elderly people meet every year in a Roman trattoria to celebrate the birthday of two of them. This year, however, one of the celebrated died leaving a curious legacy: an old convent in which the nine survivors could all go to live together.
notes: The director (thirty-seven) is light years away from his characters. He says their stories are ageless, but it's his cinema that demonstrates the stale age of a now defunct comedy.

title: Fever Pitch
actors: Ryan O'Neal, Catherine Hicks, Giancarlo Giannini
description: In Las Vegas, a reporter (O'Neal) is disastrously sucked into the vicious whirlpool of gambling. Fragile and declamatory, Richard Brooks' latest work falls short of his long and brilliant career as a screenwriter ("The gangsters") and director ("The professionals"). But the final editing was imposed by the production.

title: Wyatt Earp
actors: Kevin Costner, Dennis Quaid, Gene Hackman, Isabella Rossellini, Tom Sizemore
description: The Earps had originally been settlers. While studying law, Wyatt plans to stay in Missouri and start a family with the woman he has married and has loved since childhood. When his wife dies of typhus, his life changes forever. It is his father who shakes him from his torpor by calling him back to his duties towards his brothers. Wyatt starts a new life again. Until the famous duel at the Ok Corral in which the Earps challenge the Clanton and McLaury.
notes: It is rare to see a Hollywood movie in a big way and with big names with such modest results. A boredom equal only to the sense of uselessness and helplessness of those who have found a broken toy in their hands. Costner is also overwhelmed in the enterprise.

title: Mr. Skeffington
actors: Bette Davis, Claude Rains, Walter Abel, Richard Waring
description: Fanny Trellis, a beautiful girl from good society, after turning the heads of many men, ends up marrying the banker Job Skeffington, a wealthy businessman. The precarious economic conditions of the family forced her to this step. Fanny, as soon as she becomes his wife, begins to bully him: forced to divorce, Skeffington goes away. Years pass, she fades, repents and is forced to make a choice ...
notes: Classic melodrama, scripted by brothers Julius J. and Philip G. Epstein (also credited as producers) and excellently performed by both Davis and Rains. Double nomination for the two protagonists, but no statuettes.

title: Man Friday
actors: Peter O'Toole, Richard Roundtree, Peter Cellier, Christopher Cabot
description: Strong and proud of his identity, the "good savage" Friday (Richard Roundtree) does not submit to the white, civilized and paranoid castaway (Peter O'Toole). Distorted, stylistically unresolved and disappointing version of Defoe's "Robinson Crusoe". All too evident, even if legitimate, the anti-imperialist reinterpretation of the screenwriter

title: Il mostro
actors: Roberto Benigni, Nicoletta Braschi, Michel Blanc, Jean-Claude Brialy
description: Loris lives alone and carries on as best he can. The police discover, not far from his home, the body of a woman. It takes little to understand that the killer is the same one who hit other times. The police chief sets up a trap to capture the monster with the help of a female police officer. Unfortunately, Loris is the biggest suspect.
notes: The film alternates between the comedy of horror and the horror of comedy. Loris is not candid, neither good nor bad. His "monstrosity" is in not being in tune with the present and with the pace of others. Beautiful opening credits designed by Franco Matticchio.

title: Amateur
actors: Martin Donovan, Isabelle Huppert, Elina Löwensohn, Damian Young
description: Thomas, a young criminal with many enemies, was thrown out of the third floor window by Sofia, the porn star he exploited and married: he does not die, but he loses his memory. Isabelle, a writer of porn stories (and from the past ... unusual) helps him and together they get into trouble, including hired hitmen, shootings, treacherous friends and assorted complications. Thomas will never know who he was before. Fourth feature by a now "cult" author, the film is intelligent, refined, elegant, "perfect" (perhaps even too much) in its skilful juggling between drama and grotesque. Very "head", at the risk of losing a little the "heart" dimension.

title: Wes Craven's New Nightmare
actors: Robert Englund, Heather Langenkamp, Miko Hughes, Wes Craven
description: Wes Craven feels the need to resurrect Freddy Krueger, his monstrous creature buried with "Nightmare 6", and asks Heather Langenkamp to once again be Nancy, the victim of the hellish individual in the parent episode, ten years earlier. In this bold new "game" there are all: Englund, Dylan, (Heather's little son), John Saxon (who was Nancy's father), the producers, etc. Fictional nightmares and "real" nightmares coexist and intertwine in a perfectly calibrated narrative, with accurate special effects and traversed by a precious stream of humor. A recovery, in which fear has a subtler dimension.

title: OcchioPinocchio
actors: Francesco Nuti, Chiara Caselli, Joss Ackland, Victor Cavallo
