title: Nightmare Alley
actors: Tyrone Power, Coleen Gray, Joan Blondell, James Flavin
description: A fair barker turns into a fortune teller and begins a lucrative career through mind reading and séances, but his woman eventually unmasks him. A more original than successful film, but still interesting.

title: Bed of Roses
actors: Constance Bennett, Joel McCrea, John Halliday, Pert Kelton
description: A girl (Bennett) comes out of the juvenile school determined to get rich, but eventually falls in love with a riverboat captain (McCrea). A bad and insinuating comedy, with two typical "goldiggers", directed with brio by La Cava, also co-author of the dialogues.

title: Death of a Cheerleader
actors: Kellie Martin, Tori Spelling, James Avery, Eugene Roche, Andy Romano
description: Stacey Lokwood is rich, she is the head of the "Larks", that is the most "in" girls of the high school, and has all the students at her feet. But she is also haughty and unfriendly with her companions. Angela Delvecchio envies all of Stacey's talents, to the point where she kills her. Now everything seems to be going well for Angela, especially as another student, Monica, is suspected of the murder. Instead ...
notes: The youth environment in general, and school in particular, seen as a nest of vipers has an undoubted suggestion, but the story is artificial and not very convincing.

title: Vacanze di Natale 90
actors: Diego Abatantuono, Massimo Boldi, Christian De Sica, Ezio Greggio
description: Nick, made rich (and aphonous) by winning horses, finds his voice and wins over a woman by defending his former partner, now a waiter, from the bullying of the customers. Toni and one of his former comrades agree to eliminate their respective wives; nothing will be done about it. Arturo uselessly woos Arabella, Pippo's discontented wife. Beppe, an unrepentant Don Giovanni, is attributed a daughter who is not his.
notes: Years later, the film recalls "Christmas Holidays", but in a less youthful and a bit more vulgar-televised version.

title: The Lavender Hill Mob
actors: Alec Guinness, Stanley Holloway, Sidney James, Alfie Bass, Marjorie Fielding
description: Holland (Alec Guinness) is an employee of the firm that deals with transferring gold bars from the foundry to the Bank of England. Pendlebury (Stanley Holloway) instead works as a souvenir trader. The simplest idea is to steal the bars and turn them into pretty replicas of Eiffel towers. Everything works, except that five of those end up in the wrong hands. One of the best plays produced by Ealing. Alec Guinnes is extraordinary and makes the most of the screenplay for which T. E. B. Clarke was awarded the Oscar. For Guinness instead only one nomination, burned by Gary Cooper with "High Noon".

title: Ladri di futuro
actors: Roberto De Francesco, Pietro De Vico, Anna Campori, Tosca D'Aquino, Angelo Orlando, Nicola Pistoia
description: We are in a popular condominium in Naples. There is a pensioner who suffers from loneliness, there is the one who always takes it out on the state, there is the administrator who has made up his mind to open an agency for lonely hearts, there is what he hates TV, there is an oppressive wife and so on ... The usual minimalist film that does not tell anything, but tries to tell it in a polite way.

title: L'inchiesta
actors: Keith Carradine, Phyllis Logan, Harvey Keitel, Lina Sastri
description: The disappearance of the body of Jesus from the tomb after the crucifixion becomes a state affair and the emperor Tiberius sends two magistrates to investigate. Even after the "investigation", however, the mystery remains, thanks above all to the misdirections put in place by Pilate. An international cast grappling with a subject written years earlier by Ennio Flaiano. What is missing is the director's wrist.

title: Botte di Natale
actors: Terence Hill, Bud Spencer, Anne Kasprik, Ruth Buzzi, Ron Carey, Eva Hassmann
description: Moses has become the wildest bounty hunter in the West, with a family of eight, nine, or maybe ten children to support, and he would need to pocket that five thousand dollar bounty on the evil Sam Stone's head to secure the future of the his children. Travis realizes that the only way to get Moses home after so many years is to lure Sam Stone into Mom's house. Word spreads that the family holds an immense treasure and frees the bandit on the eve of his hanging. The trap works and, barring last-minute fights between the two quarrelsome brothers, maybe the mother will be able to have Christmas with her children.

title: Belle al bar
actors: Alessandro Benvenuti, Eva Robin's, Assumpta Serna, Andrea Brambilla
description: Leo is in crisis. In crisis especially in his relationship with his wife: ten years of marriage and the usual misunderstandings. But luckily he has to leave. In the city where he is for work reasons, he realizes that he is being followed by an unknown woman and, when he is struck by a faint, she is the one who helps him. Leo wakes up in the house of the woman who shows he knows various details of her childhood. Stunned and confused, Leo finally manages to understand: the stranger is none other than his cousin Giulio who in the meantime has become a charming transex. Thus began an eventful coexistence.
notes: A funny but not trivial film with a rich and articulated script. Without being a serious moralist, Benvenuti "photographs", with a few jokes and the help of well-chosen character actors, the daily crises of identity. Good actors: Welcome, Zuzzurro and above all Eva Robin's who is part of his life and is really beautiful.

title: Tystnaden
actors: Ingrid Thulin, Gunnel Lindblom, Jorgen Lindström, Birger Malmsten, Håkan Jahnberg
description: In a country tormented by the impending war, two sisters experience a profound conflict. During a trip they are forced to stop in an unknown town because one of them feels bad because of her alcoholism. It is the occasion that explodes the profound constraints between the two women, both selfish and abusive in their own way. A silent witness is a boy, the son of one of the two. After yet another quarrel, the sick woman is abandoned by her sister to her fate.
notes: Conclusion of the trilogy of the "silence of God" (after "As in a mirror" and "Winter lights"), it is one of the most metaphorical and risky films of the author, who goes almost in his own way. The forest of symbols and the tetragonal upzza can, in the wild, fascinate or disconcert.

title: Picture Perfect
actors: Richard Karn, Mary Page Keller, Dave Thomas
description: George and Vicky, despite being neighbors, do not have real good relations. One day George's daughters and Vicky's son, who are good friends instead, jokingly decide to submit their names to the "Perfect Family" contest, pretending that they are all brothers and that Vicky and George are husband and wife.
notes: Comedy without infamy and without praise, based on a principle, that of forced coexistence, already used abundantly. If the story is well known and in many places even a little frayed, nevertheless there is no lack of funny ideas.

title: The Mask
actors: Jim Carrey, Cameron Diaz, Peter Riegert, Amy Yasbeck, Richard Jeni
description: Stanley, a simpleton mocked by everyone, has fallen in love with a beautiful and unattainable woman. As he walks by a pier he seems to see a body in the water. He throws himself to the rescue but finds only an old mask. When, out of curiosity, the sock undergoes an extraordinary metamorphosis: now Charlie is another, transformed into a real human tornado capable of combining all colors.
notes: The film lives all on the latex makeup and special effects of Lucas' Industrial Magic & Lights, which play amiably with the follies of Warner cartoons. Too bad that the script, in practice, does not exist: thin, predictable and without inventions. On the other hand, Carrey is unleashed and Diaz a real discovery.

title: Miracolo italiano
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Ezio Greggio, Athina Cenci, Anna Falchi, Nino Frassica, Giorgio Faletti, Claudia Koll, Nadia Rinaldi, Maria Amelia Monti
description: Film in eight episodes. A parliamentarian from AN spends a furious night of love with a member of the PRC; Maria Carla lets herself be boarded during the screening of "Balla con wolves"; Rosalia has just got married, but that same evening, in the disco, she lets herself be tempted by a star of the soap operas; an accountant makes up a disease to take advantage of the graces of a busty nurse; a family discovers that their son's girlfriend is a transsexual; a TV presenter makes up a friendship with Kevin Costner to win over a fanatic reporter for the star; two friends tell each other extraordinary erotic adventures; a husband leaves his wife in the Seychelles in the hands of a masseuse and does not realize that she is a man instead.
notes: The usual TV showmen who, with the only comic actress of the cast (Athina Cenci), offer lines and rhythm to a film totally devoid of ideas.

title: Junior
actors: Danny DeVito, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Emma Thompson, Pamela Reed
description: Dr. Hesse and Dr. Harbogast have just developed a revolutionary drug that allows even the most difficult pregnancy to be completed without complications. But the university they work at cuts their funds. To conclude their studies, the two then elaborate a singular plan: Hesse will have an egg inoculated, stolen by deception from the "collection" of Doctor Reddin, to then artificially fertilize it and then experiment the drug in vivo.
notes: Thompson stumbles where she can, Schwarzenegger moves with the ease of a robot, De Vito crosses the rooms with his usual nervous step. The film struggles to give birth to a smile. It would take a cesarean.

title: Interview with the Vampire
actors: Tom Cruise, Brad Pitt, Kirsten Dunst, Stephen Rea, Antonio Banderas
description: Louis is a vampire who decides to tell the journalist Mallory about his experience which began in 1791. Louis De Pointe du Lac, a wealthy landowner from New Orleans, lives in retreat in his luxurious home, annihilated by the pain of the loss of his wife and daughter. Lestat, a man with a perverse charm dedicated to vampirism, knows him and decides to introduce him to the world of the undead. Louis grows fond of an orphaned child. Lestat, who has noticed it, vampirizes the little one, in order to make a gift of it to his friend. Claudia thus becomes a vampire too.
notes: Struggling with a triangle of blood and passion between the reticent vampire Louis, Lestat and the diabolical little Claudia, Jordan indulges in visions of sensuality and ambiguity, chasing Coppola and Polanski. Perhaps more at ease in noir than in fantasy, Jordan (as he did in "In the Company of Wolves") never forgets touches of comedy.

title: Down by Law
actors: Tom Waits, John Lurie, Roberto Benigni, Nicoletta Braschi
description: Zack and Jak end up in jail in New Orleans for petty crimes. The Italian Bob is also locked up in their cell, accused of involuntary murder, which lifts the gloomy environment of the prison. In his wacky English, Bob tells his fellow inmates about a successful escape plan. Then Zack and Jak split up, while Bob finds a way to settle down with a compatriot.
notes: When Benigni "enters" the film, he becomes its protagonist and fulcrum, with his humor on the edge of the absurd and his multifaceted vitality. Excellent first "emigration" of our comedian, much better than that of the "Son of the Pink Panther". Lunar photograph in black and white by Wendersian Robby Muller, the part in the swamps of Louisiana is evocative.

title: Come due coccodrilli
actors: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Giancarlo Giannini, Valeria Golino, Sandrine Dumas, Ignazio Oliva
description: Forty-year-old Gabriele has made a solid position in Paris in the field of art dealers. In his past there is a beloved mother, a father who had a double family and many humiliations suffered by his half brothers. Now Gabriele returns to Varenna, on Lake Como, where his father lived and has the opportunity to take revenge for all the wrongs that have been done to him and to a younger brother ...
notes: Figurative elegance, convincing setting, sensitivity for childhood problems, but also some junctions of the screenplay that perplexes us in Campiotti's film. And, in the end, a twist that borders on the ridiculous.

title: Con gli occhi chiusi
actors: Debora Caprioglio, Gabriele Bocciarelli, Marco Messeri, Stefania Sandrelli, Alessia Fugardi, Sergio Castellitto
description: Piero, the son of a rough and greedy Sienese merchant, lives between the city, where he studies without much profit, and the family farm, in Poggio a 'Meli, where he falls in love with the peasant girl Ghìsola. Very short-sighted physically, the boy is also short-sighted for his inability to see clearly in his own and in others' lives. Which leads him to suffer constant humiliation and to complicate his life.
notes: From the novel by Federigo Tozzi (1883-1920), a transcription that alternates ruthless harshness with formal elegance that is all too complacent. However, the remarkable performances of the actors, both children and adults, are to be ascribed to the film's assets.

title: The New Age
actors: Peter Weller, Judy Davis, Samuel L. Jackson, Patrick Bauchau
description: Brilliant, uninhibited, career professionals, Peter and Katherine form a typical couple of the "good" Los Angeles society, as effervescent as it is poor in solid values. Katherine, however, endures her husband's betrayals with increasing difficulty and when they both lose their jobs, the situation worsens. The high-end boutiques they open together will not be the lifeline.
notes: Tolkin, author of the screenplay of "The protagonists" for Altman, and makes a film of costume criticism in which the rendering of the images matches the evident ambitions of the "script".

title: The Last Seduction
actors: Linda Fiorentino, Peter Berg, Bill Pullman, J.T. Walsh
description: Bridget is an insurance agent from New York, but she is not satisfied and, together with her doctor husband, traffics in drugs. Then let the spouse deal with his "business partners", take the money and run away. He stops in a small town where he gets hired by an insurance company. When a detective goes after her, Bridget hires Mike, a barber, to get him out of the way. Yet another variant on the theme of the tremendous "dark lady" who leads to ruin all the men she meets. Only this time the realization is on the verge of involuntary comedy. The director cut his teeth with the vice clips. And it shows.

title: The Princess Bride
actors: Cary Elwes, Robin Wright, Mandy Patinkin, Billy Crystal, Peter Falk
description: Grandfather reads to Jimmy, in bed with the flu, the fairy tale of the beautiful Princess Bottondoro, in love with her faithful servant Westley. Come and go between reality and fantasy, duels and spells. The irony and the sure hand of Reiner, who tells a metaphorical story of growth in an intelligent fairy tale, make everything truly "magical". From a William Goldman novel, adapted from the same.

title: A Connecticut Yankee in King Arthur's Court
actors: Bing Crosby, Rhonda Fleming, William Bendix
description: An American (Crosby) dreams of going back in time, among the knights of the Round Table. The comparison between different lifestyles and mentalities is a source of adventures and humorous episodes.
notes: A journey back in time from a short novel by Mark Twain which he enjoys here with Garnett in his third version (the others are from '21 and '31). The complicity of Bill Crosby and a good selection of character actors makes him the best of the series that will still have life in '79 and later for television.

title: Sindbad contro i sette saraceni
actors: Gordon Mitchell, Dan Harrison, Bella Cortez, Bruno Carotenuto
description: The Yeriti, a proud and combative people, rebel against the tyrant of the city of Cufra. For this they send Sindbad to the tournament which will decide who will be the new regent. During the journey, Sindbad is about to be captured, but finds the support of Princess Fatma, related to the tyrant, who saves him from death. During the tournament, as Sindbad and the despot face off, the people rise up. Fantasy without rhyme or reason, with the muscular Gordon Mitchell.

title: The Sea Wolf
actors: Charles Bronson, Christopher Reeve, Catherine Mary Stewart
description: Adventure of Christopher Reeve and Catherine Mary Stuart kidnapped aboard the fishing boat commanded by a sadist Charles Bronson.
notes: Modest television adaptation of a London novel. In Michael Curtiz's beautiful 1941 film of the same name, Robinson gave one of his best performances as the crazy captain. In general, however, between the two creations there is the same difference in class and style that passes between that great gentleman of the screen that was Robinson and that Bronson chard.

title: 13 Rue Madeleine
actors: James Cagney, Annabella, Richard Conte, Frank Latimore
description: In the G77 group of American counter-espionage there is a spy paid by the Nazis. Instead of exposing him, the leader of the group, Bob Sharkey (Cagney), decides to use him to provide false information to the enemy. For a while it works, but then, during a CIA mission to the Netherlands organized to kidnap the engineer Duclois, the situation worsens.
notes: Espionage film shot with a semi-documentary approach, definitely exciting. Aggressive Cagney, sober and robust direction.

title: Ester e il re
actors: Joan Collins, Richard Egan, Daniela Rocca, Sergio Fantoni
description: Esther (Collins) is beautiful, young, Jewish and betrothed to a Persian soldier. The king, however, wants her as his wife and Esther yields to him, to the insistence of her uncle Mordecai and to the reasons of politics. But Prime Minister Haman does not give up. The usual biblical cinemascope, large in format and poor in ideas, which gets out of hand to the great Raoul Walsh. Some sequences were directed by Mario Bava.

title: Walk, Don't Run
actors: Cary Grant, Samantha Eggar, Jim Hutton, John Standing
description: The housing situation in Tokyo is rather complicated. During the 1964 Olympics, finding a home is even more difficult. British billionaire Sir William Rutland, in Japan on business, finds himself sharing an apartment with Christine Easton, a beautiful English girl, and an American athlete. The cohabitation will end with a marriage. Who will be the chosen one: the slightly arid rich man or the penniless but nice hunk?
notes: Sophisticated (but not too much) comedy in the purest Hollywood style with authentic samples of the genre. Directs a skilled craftsman of the camera.

title: Questa specie d'amore
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Jean Seberg, Ewa Aulin, Angelo Infanti, Evi Maltagliati
description: Federico Ferrari (Ugo Tognazzi) has made a marriage that has elevated him socially compared to his humble origins, but he is not happy, just as his wife Giovanna is not. The troubled return to Parma (from Rome) resolves the situation. Great Tognazzi, but Bevilacqua's direction is what it is.

title: Suez
actors: Tyrone Power, Loretta Young, Annabella
description: The French engineer Ferdinand De Lesseps (Tyrone Power) has come up with an extraordinary idea: to open the Suez Canal. He is comforted by the love of a young and beautiful Egyptian woman who will sacrifice her life for him and that of Countess Eugenia de Montijo. The latter will leave the young engineer to marry Napoleon III. To Ferdinand the satisfaction of seeing ships pass where the desert used to be.
notes: The true story is obviously very fictional, the psychologies are simplified, but the film is spectacular and engaging.

title: Gaby - A True Story
actors: Rachel Levin, Liv Ullmann, Norma Aleandro, Robert Loggia
description: Gaby Brimmer (Levin) was born into a wealthy family, but with a severe handicap. Basically the only thing that works is her left foot, everything else is paralyzed. Her parents are loving and understanding, but Florencia (Aleandro), a housekeeper, and Fernando, her schoolmate, will really help the young woman out of her isolation. A dramatic film, even an unpleasant one, which naturally bases everything on the goodness of the cast. The Aleandro was that of Puenzo's "Official History". But the real revelation is Rachel Levin.

title: Tell Me No Lies
actors: Steven Weber, Robert Hy Gorman, Mary Page Keller, Katherine Helmond
description: When Terry (Steven Weber) and Amanda meet she already has a son named Jay (Robert Hy Gorman), born of a previous marriage. When Amanda dies in a car accident, Terry still doesn't suspect anything and begins in good faith the practices to adopt Jay. That's when Terry discovers that Jay's birth certificate doesn't even exist. And this is only the first discovery. It starts out as a family drama and turns into a thriller with stories of unhappy childhoods and kidnapped children. Sandor Stern writes and directs this film for television, but it is not clear in which of the two things he is more denied. The ending is almost laughable.

title: In a Child's Name
actors: Michael Ontkean, Valerie Bertinelli, Timothy Carhart, Andy Hirsch
description: Ken Taylor is from Indiana and is a dentist. Teresa Silvano comes from New Jersey and has a very strong bond with her family of origin. The two get married, but Angela, Teresa's sister, begins to have doubts from the moment she finds out that Ken has been beating Teresa since their honeymoon. When Ken kills Teresa, a conflict arises between the two families over who will have custody of the child. A television film originally scheduled in two parts (total duration four hours) and based on a book by Peter Maas (that of "Joe Valachi" and "Serpico"). Murder is involved, but the real core of the film is the clash between the two families.

title: Cinque poveri in automobile
actors: Eduardo De Filippo, Titina De Filippo, Aldo Fabrizi, Walter Chiari
description: An extra, a cabman, a porter and a waiter win a luxury car with a company-bought lottery ticket. Before reselling the car, they decide to use it only once per shift. Each of them has a desire to fulfill: not all will be good, but some will serve as a lesson. Then, having sold the car, they donate a share of the proceeds to a fifth poor man. To the finale of Zavattini (author of the story), Mattoli preferred a more smiling one. Overall discontinuous, but good interpretation.

title: Tenebre
actors: Anthony Franciosa, Daria Nicolodi, Giuliano Gemma, John Saxon
description: Peter Neal is a successful writer in the thriller genre. In Rome to present his latest novel, _Tenebrae_, he finds himself involved in the exploits of a serial killer who is inspired by his book. The murderer kills some women guilty - according to his distorted way of thinking - of infamous aberrations. Neal sets out to investigate on his own ...
notes: An all in all unusual thriller for Argento: aseptic setting (the film is shot at Eur), some moments of great cinema (the sequence shots inside and outside the palace of the two homosexuals, the final solution) and some authentic fright make it precious in the filmography of the Roman director.

title: La fièvre monte à El Pao
actors: Gérard Philipe, Maria Felix, Jean Servais, Victor Junco, Roberto Canedo, Andrés Soler
description: In the penal colony on the island of Ojeda, largely reserved for political prisoners sentenced to forced labor, the governor is killed by a subordinate who then goes into hiding. While waiting for his successor, the reins of the prison pass to Ramón Vasquez, secretary of the murdered, a young idealist eager to "change things from within". Ines, the governor's widow, falls in love with Ramón and seduces him. When the government sends its new emissary, the woman feels lost: it is in fact a former lover who is able to blackmail her. Knowing from Ramón that the detainees intend to organize a revolt, the woman makes sure to be away from the island with the new governor so that he is dismissed and the place passes permanently to Vasquez. But fate has a more bitter ending in store for her.
notes: Imposed by the production, the two "stars" are the real weak point of the film: Philipe, in his last interpretation and already undermined by evil, is the shadow of himself and Felix always seems very distracted. Despite this, however, the film reveals, albeit in filigree, the themes dear to the Spanish director. In particular, here emerges the setback that history gives to the utopias that men elaborate in the illusion of improving themselves and their societies.

title: Clear and Present Danger
actors: Harrison Ford, Willem Dafoe, Anne Archer, James Earl Jones
description: A CIA agent has to make very serious decisions for the security of the country ...
notes: Third adaptation of a best seller by Tom Clancy (_Hunting in Red October_ and _Giochi di power_) which features John Milius among the screenwriters. Ordinary administration.

title: With Onors
actors: Joe Pesci, Brendan Fraser, Moira Kelly, Gore Vidal
description: Monty Kessler is a Harvard graduate student. He's good, he got into college for merit and not for money, but he's also an insufferable nerd a bit dumb. One evening, due to a black-out, everything "jumps" to him: computer, hard disk and thesis. Monty runs out to make photocopies of the only printout he has, but it falls to him in the basement of the library where a homeless man lives illegally. For everything Monty gets him (food, clothes), he can get a page back. Then a friendship is born between the two and Monty begins to understand something about life.
notes: A bit of "fleeting moment", a bit of Christmas atmosphere, a bit of progressive style. Of little worth the excellent interpretation of Joe Pesci, bearded and dirty as it should be, the photography of Sven Nykvist (operator of Ingmar Bergman) and the appearance of the writer Gore Vidal.

title: Serial Mom
actors: Kathleen Turner, Sam Waterston, Ricki Lake, Matthew Lillard
description: The Suthpin family owns it all. Family happiness is defended with the teeth by mother Suthpin so that nothing damages the perfection of the home. Apart from this Beverly Suthpin cultivates two bizarre hobbies: to have tapes sent with the voice of the famous serial killer Ted Bundy and to torment Dottie Hinkle with obscene phone calls, guilty of having inflicted on her at the supermarket. When her daughter complains about her boyfriend's lack of attention and a professor recommends psychiatrist treatment for her son Chip, she decides to become a serial killer. Waters has the courage to joke about the new "myth" of the serial killer and to bring him back to his disturbing homely dimension. And Kathleen Turner brings out the determination she had in the "Honor of the Prizzi" and in the "War of the Roses" to slaughter a neighbor with leg blows. A little too tame, a little less swirling than "Fat is beautiful", but the mockery works and the nastiness strikes again.

title: Color of Night
actors: Bruce Willis, Jane March, Rubén Blades, Lesley Ann Warren
description: Traumatized by the suicide of one of his patients, Bill Capa, a New York psychiatrist, goes to Los Angeles to the home of a colleague who is killed shortly after. The killer is likely one of five patients in the Monday therapy group who have been sending death threats to the analyst for weeks. Bill then begins to investigate, replacing the colleague as the group's therapist. In the meantime, however, he finds a way to fall in love with the young Rose.
notes: After director Rush fell ill, the film was entrusted to George Pan Costmatos. American cinema hates, by ingrained custom, shrinks. Jane March performs in fiery multiple seductions (partly censored) and in a predictable split of personality. The spectator's embarrassment, like the cure, is endless.

title: Prestazione straordinaria
actors: Sergio Rubini, Margherita Buy, Alessandro Haber, Simona Izzo
description: Clara is a career woman who, from Milan, moves to the Roman office of a publishing house. Aldo works in this office, and although he doesn't seem to have anything of the kind that routinely appeals to the sexual appetites of women like Clara, he ends up in the erotic sights of his superior. At first Clara tries to ensnare him by promising him career advancements. Then, when he refuses, he takes revenge by downgrading him. Rubini, in his third direction, creates a discontinuous comedy of manners and with several changes in script and dialogue.

title: Bad Girls
actors: Andie MacDowell, Drew Barrymore, Mary Stuart Masterson, Madeleine Stowe, James LeGros
description: Cody, Anita, Eileen and Lilly work in the same brothel. One day the sheriff disrespects Anita and Cody snorts him. Forced to flee, the four girls head to the bank where Cody keeps his life's savings. But the same idea was also had by Kid Jarret, an old flame of Cody, who has no account in his name, but has a gun. Cody does not give up and leaves with her friends in search of Jarret.
notes: The idea of ??"Bad Girls" is in itself a good one and the cast, made up of discreet actresses without the presence of prima donnas, arouses some preventive curiosity. The script, the direction and the direction of the actors are, however, disconcerting, bordering on parody.

title: Pulp Fiction
actors: John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson, Uma Thurman, Tim Roth, Harvey Keitel, Maria De Medeiros, Christopher Walken, Amanda Plummer, Bruce Willis, Ving Rhames, Rosanna Arquette, Steve Buscemi, Eric Stoltz
description: Pumpkin and Honey Bunny decide to rob the diner they are eating at. Vincent and Jules are two gangsters who have to do a job. Vincent is worried because he has to keep company with Mia, his boss's cocaine wife. Butch, a boxer in Marsellus' service, did not carry out the boss's order to lose a match. Vincent and Jules are in the apartment from the beginning, they have killed two thugs and have a third at gunpoint. Epilogue. The action returns to the diner of the beginning.
notes: The iconic film of the 90s. Much imitated, he modified the classic narrative structure of Hollywood cinema.

title: The Gun in Betty Lou's Handbag
actors: Penelope Ann Miller, Eric Thal, Julianne Moore, Alfre Woodward
description: Betty Lou Perkins has a police husband, an obscure librarian job, and a dictatorial boss. Then he accidentally finds a gun, which was used to kill an FBI informant. Betty Lou has read many detective stories in her work. So why not give yourself a shot at life and confess that she is the killer? The actors and the dialogues are not bad. Moyle, then, is the one who made "Pump Up the Volume" years ago. But an old adage goes: "If you show a gun in a film, it must shoot sooner or later." Well, he doesn't shoot here.

title: The Specialist
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Sharon Stone, James Woods, Rod Steiger
description: May Munro is obsessed with avenging her parents' deaths. Death caused, when she was a child, by the Leon clan, a family of Latin American criminals headed by Joe, instigator of the murder, and by his son Tomas. May manages to convince Ray Quick, a former CIA agent specializing in explosives, to brush up on her qualities to help her out. The two carry out revenge and end up loving each other. Only Ned Trent, former colleague of Ray and now on the side of the Leon, turns out to be a tough nut to crack. Bombs and sex with "Rambo" Stallone and the sensual Sharon Stone, but the film is very obvious.

title: Amici miei
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Gastone Moschin, Philippe Noiret, Adolfo Celi
description: Five professionals in their fifties: Perozzi (Noiret), Melandri (Moschin), Mascetti (Tognazzi), Necchi (Del Prete) and Sassaroli (Celi), are inseparable friends and wild jokers. Their adventures are called "gypsies" and take place near Florence. Doctor Sassaroli met the other four when they were admitted to his clinic after an accident and has since joined the group. In their sights everything and everyone (passengers on a train are slapped), but above all the retired Righi, the target of their jokes even at a funeral. Entrusted to some "masks" of Italian comedy, the film is a hilarious gallery of jokes (some have become proverbial) and jokes. Conceived by Pietro Germi, however, it was directed by Monicelli due to the untimely death of his colleague and friend. It was a great success with the public and won the David di Donatello in 1975.

title: A Matter of Time
actors: Ingrid Bergman, Liza Minnelli, Spiros Andros, Tina Aumont
description: Nina has become a star and remembers her life. Immediately after the war, Nina, then a girl, arrived from the Castelli Romani in a large hotel where she was hired as a waitress. Here he meets the elderly Countess Sanziani. The noblewoman is in conditions of poverty and abandonment but, in her youth, she had been the lover of famous artists and princes. The elderly woman gives young Nina some valuable tips to make it into the world of entertainment. Affectionate and nostalgic evocation of a world, that of the show, to which Minnelli has dedicated his entire life; and "summa" of his idea of ??life and cinema. He was very unlucky at the box office.

title: Un borghese piccolo piccolo
actors: Alberto Sordi, Shelley Winters, Romolo Valli, Vincenzo Crocitti
description: Giovanni Vivaldi (Alberto Sordi) worked for a lifetime as a modest employee of the ministry. His only dream is that his son Mario (Vincenzo Crocitti), a graduate accountant, will replace him in the job. To facilitate his son in the ministerial competition, Vivaldi agrees to join the Masonic lodge to which Dr. Spaziani, his superior belongs. The trouble is that, on the very day of the exam, in front of his father's eyes, Mario is killed by a bank robber. Vivaldi then sets out in search of the killer, finds him and, instead of handing him over to the police, kidnaps and kills him by torturing him slowly. Fierce portrait of an ordinary man who becomes the portrait of the violent and monstrous Italy of the seventies. Valuable is the interpretation of Alberto Sordi who, for once, overcomes the mask of the speck and gives life to a character who, while not renouncing the tics and charms of the usual repertoire, manages to reach an unusual depth for the national Albertone. Perhaps the last true, great interpretation of a Deaf man on a slow and inexorable decline.

title: The Luck of the Irish
actors: Tyrone Power, Anne Baxter, Lee J. Cobb, Cecil Kellaway
description: A journalist arrives in a small hotel on a wooded island, where he is warmly welcomed by a dwarf and his daughter Nora. The dwarf hands him a gold coin warning him that it will turn into a stone if he succumbs to the thirst for gain. So it happens. The reporter returns to Nora, who comforts him with love.

title: Exorcist II: the Eretic
actors: Linda Blair, Richard Burton, Max Von Sydow, Ned Beatty
description: Regan, the possessed girl protagonist of the first "Exorcist", seems to be on the road to recovery, but she has some problems. Father Lamont, suspicious, identifies in the ancient Assyrian demon Pazuzu the root of the Evil that upsets Regan. In contrast, Boorman makes a "number two" more complex than the first: visionary and anticipator.

title: Stregati
actors: Ornella Muti, Francesco Nuti, Novello Novelli, Alex Partexano, Sergio Solli
description: Lorenzo is the host of a night program for a local Genoese radio. After keeping up the morale of the night owl listeners, he himself does the very small hours between jokes and jokes, accompanying a girl to buy the wedding dress. Time passes in skirmishes and of course she will never marry again.
notes: Nuti's third film as a director; Ours tries to find the right poetic madness of the author, but in the end he only betrays an inordinate narcissism both as a character and, above all, as a comic. The result is an inconsistent film.

title: Herz aus Glas
actors: Joseph Bierbichler, Stefan Guttler
description: The death of the master glassmaker from a mountain village, who disappeared with the secret of the "glass-ruby", produces disturbing effects on his fellow villagers. A hypnotic film based on a Bavarian legend. An archaic and secret Germany, relived by a Herzog to the best of himself

title: It's Always Fair Weather
actors: Gene Kelly, Dan Dailey, Michael Kidd, Cyd Charisse, Dolores Gray
description: Douglas, Angie and Ted fought together during World War II. They meet again after ten years, but the bitterness of life has changed them. Through Douglas, who works in television, Ted meets Jackie, who is a television programmer. Thanks to a stratagem of the latter, Ted is saved from the threats of a gangster and Douglas reconnects with his wife. Pink final for Ted and Jackie. The subject could be that of a social melodrama; instead we are faced with a lively comedy with splendid musical numbers. However, a melancholy and an underlying bitterness remain unbearable: the passing life gives no escape. Written by musical specialists Betty Comden and Adolph Green, it has some split screen sequences.

title: S.P.Q.R..2000 e 1/2 anni fa
actors: Massimo Boldi, Christian De Sica, Leslie Nielsen, Nadia Rinaldi, Cash
description: After moving to Rome from his native Mediolanum, the magistrate Antonio Servilio immediately clashes with senator Cesare Attico, a womanizer and corrupt. He will try for a long time and in vain to frame him for tax evasion, thanks also to the testimony of Ottavia, a former lover of Atticus. Instead, he will be sent to a small island in Sicily, where a protomafia is already operating from which he will have well-founded reasons to beware. Farce that alludes to Tangentopoli under the guise of ancient Romans, with indifference that does not get to be funny and Boldi and De Sica free to improvise at random. Leslie Nielsen bewildered; however famous is the grim two-way monologue addressed by De Sica to "Iside", while Anna Falchi is obviously Poppea.

title: Spoorloos
actors: Bernard-Pierre Donnadieu, Gene Bervoets, Johanna Ter Steege
description: Rex and Saskia, a couple of Dutch tourists, cross the south of France when, at a gas station, the woman disappears. Rex searches for her in vain until, three years later, he comes into contact with a chemistry professor, who promises to reveal Saskia's mystery to him if Rex agrees to undergo the action of a sleeping pill. The subject has elements of originality (the vertigo of the lucid choice of evil, etc.), but the script develops them in a superficial way and the direction has no pulse. Five years later the same Sluizer made a remake of this film in the USA ("The Vanishing-Disappearance").

title: Nails
actors: Dennis Hopper, Anne Archer, Tomas Milian, Keith David, Carlos Carrasco, Cliff De Young
description: Harry, a spotless and fearless policeman, takes it upon himself to avenge his friend and companion who lost his life, killed by members of a gang of criminals in the service of a powerful drug trafficker. It will be a battle with no holds barred. Sometimes one wonders if drugs are the worst evil or not, however, certain anti-drug films all violence, scurrility and gratuitous sex. Hopper is often available for questionable operations. Here even Tomas Milian is seen again.

title: La polizia ringrazia
actors: Enrico Maria Salerno, Mariangela Melato, Mario Adorf
description: Two boys attack a jewelry shop, but the owner puts them on the run: one of the robbers reacts, however, by killing both the owner of the shop and a worker who tried to stop them. The investigations are assigned to Commissioner Bertone: the latter moves immediately amidst many difficulties (he is also put under investigation by the deputy prosecutor), which however does not prevent him from setting out on the trail of an "Anonima anticrimine" which also includes the former commissioner and other authorities ...
notes: Bitter reflection on "private" justice, the first step to undermine democratic institutions.

title: Themroc
actors: Michel Piccoli, Béatrice Romand, Marilù Tolo
description: Anti-social revolt of the worker Themroc, who, together with the walls of the house, breaks all taboos and joyfully regresses to the troglodyte-cannibalistic state. His behavior infects the city. A grotesque story a la Ferreri, which does not find the figure to transform itself into the radically anarchic parable it aspires to be.

title: Vietato ai minori
actors: Alessandro Haber, Mariella Valentini, Massimo Venturiello, Massimo De Rossi, Angelo Orlando, Nicola Pistoia
description: Director Scalpo (Alessandro Haber), with a colorful cast, attempts to shoot a porn film on the Island of Elba. But the gifted actor taken from the street "doesn't work", and all sorts of things happen. Mediocre Italian comedy, "flavored" and colored with little imagination by a hard theme. Haber, a professional histrionist, naturally stands out and, at his side, an equally good Mariella Valentini stands out.

title: Lt. Robin Crusoe, U.S.N.
actors: Dick Van Dyke, Nancy Kwan, Akim Tamiroff, Arthur Malet
description: Pilot Robin Crusoe (Van Dyke) crashes with his plane and finds refuge on a desert island. One day he discovers a beautiful girl on the island whom he gives the name of Tuesday. It turns out that Robinson helps the women of his tribe to rebel against the macho tribal laws. A slow-paced family comedy, this is the little fun parody of Defoe's novel. Produced by Walt Disney, and try to read the name of the screenwriter Retlaw Yensid backwards.

title: Heatwave
actors: Judy Davis, Richard Moir, Chris Haywood, Bill Hunter, John Gregg
description: An Australian community fights against the activities of a Sidney company, capable of enormous environmental damage. The story is complicated by the sentiment born between an activist of the protest movement and a company designer. Inspired by facts that really happened, it is an excellently finished melodramatic drama where the compelling fiction zest also serves to pass ecologist themes without moralisms. Excellently directed by Philip Noyce ("10 am: flat calm", "Power games") at the time not very famous.

title: Criminal Behavior
actors: Farrah Fawcett, A Martinez, Dakin Matthews
description: When not working out at the gym, Jessie Lee Stubbs is a lawyer. She, who comes from a family of criminals (dad is in jail, mom exploits prostitution), fights against criminals with great determination. To get a client out of jail, he sets out on a search for an actor named Gaines. From that moment on, however, the corpses on his path begin to multiply. It is not true that Farrah Fawcett comes from a family of criminals, she comes from a series of bad movies and TV series that have attached her to the label of pretty and goose. In fact he can also act as this good mystery directed by Michael Miller proves.

title: Guarding Tess
actors: Shirley MacLaine, Nicolas Cage, Austin Pendleton, Edward Albert
description: Tess Carlisle, former First Lady, is considered something of a national monument. As such she poses herself, hiding behind the official facade a curmudgeon, obstinate, demanding and authoritarian character. The people who look after her pay the price, especially Doug Chesnic, the secret service agent in charge of her security. Doug, for his part, trained in far more adventurous tasks, already feels uncomfortable in the role of guardian angel.
notes: Clever Hugh Wilson. In this film, he deploys a great actress, Shirley MacLaine, who is so good as to make even limited types like Nicolas Cage good.

title: The Anniversary
actors: Bette Davis, Sheila Hancock, Jack Hedley, James Cossins, Christian Roberts
description: Ms. Taggart (Bette Davis) is blind in one eye, on which she wears a mysterious black blindfold, and is a widow. This does not prevent her from still being a real tyrant towards her three children, who are forced to meet every year on the anniversary of their father's death.
notes: Custom built for Bette Davis who was truly unsurpassed in these roles as a sour and domineering woman.

title: Ladro lui, ladra lei
actors: Alberto Sordi, Sylva Koscina, Mario Riva, Ettore Manni, Anita Durante, Mario Carotenuto, Marisa Merlini, Carlo Delle Piane, Alberto Bonucci, Guglielmo Inglese, Nando Bruno, Gianni Baghino
description: Heir to the family tradition, Cencio, between one stay and another in Regina Coeli, lives on small and large scams. Cesira keeps him a staff, a beautiful girl who sympathizes with him, until he falls in love with one of his victims. At this point the force of jealousy can be dangerous.
notes: One of Zampa's less sparkling and comedies, albeit with a vintage Albertone.

title: Young Again
actors: Robert Urich, Lindsay Wagner, Keanu Reeves, Jack Gilford
description: Michael Riley (Urich) is forty years old, is still in love with Laura Gordon (Wagner) and has a great desire to be young again. Which happens on time. 17-year-old Michael (Reeves) is quite excited by the new situation, but a meeting with Laura makes him realize that there is no going back and that the right thing to do is to try and face reality. Looking at the plot it looks like a Frank Capra film or, at worst, a Zemeckis film. Watching the film it turns out that the director is Hiliard Stern, which is quite another thing. Even the presence of the young Reeves does not save the situation.

title: Il sole buio
actors: Michael Paré, Jo Champa, Phyllis Logan, Luciano Catenacci, Leopoldo Trieste
description: Ruggero Villamarina-Bolt lived for over twenty years with his father in the United States. Now he returns to Palermo for a ceremony in honor of his dead mother who has placed a copious bequest in favor of a female juvenile prison. Here he meets the young Lucia, a former prostitute and now a drug dealer. He helps her when the girl's father is killed by the mafia, and she falls in love with him. Then the story gets complicated ... It can be said that, between cinema and TV, Damiani is a "regular" of Sicily and the mafia, but not all donuts have succeeded with the hole. Apart from the acting of the Italian-French-American Jo Champa, here she is saved just a little.

title: Camera d'albergo
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Monica Vitti, Enrico Montesano, Nestor Garay, Daniele Formica
description: Three young cinema enthusiasts experiment with "cinema truth" using cameras and microphones hidden in the rooms of a hotel. They then try to place the footage with an old debt-laden producer and he suggests that the kids manipulate the material into a commercial product. Although with little enthusiasm, the three aspiring filmmakers find the garbage man Fausto and his mistress Flaminia, who loves him but marries Cesare, owner of a driving school. Reminded close for script requirements, Flaminia and Fausto discover that they are made for each other.
notes: The screenplay of Age and Scarpelli "exhumes" the invention of the film within the film and, with a delay of decades, the discovery of the cinema truth; then he bases everything in a story that, alongside a few funny situations, fails to give consistency to the ambitions of the dialectic between fiction and reality in cinema. Thus only the gigionerie by Gassman and Vitti remain, which fortunately is counterbalanced by the good performance of Nestor Garay. But, for a film signed by Mario Monicelli, it is a miserable consolation.

title: Dancing Machine
actors: Alain Delon, Claude Brasseur, Patrick Dupond, Tonya Kinziger
description: Alan Wolf (Delon) runs a dance school. It is true that, over the years, various violent deaths have occurred in that school, but it is also true that no investigation would have started if only Ella had not gone to confide her suspicions to her neighbor, Inspector Epervier (Brasseur). . Then Ella dies, as does Chico, Alan's right arm. Then there is the twist, a twist a little pulled by the hair and uninspired. Completely intrombonized, Delon moves between French noir atmospheres and Italian thriller effects. Béhat is not Melville.

title: She Married Her Boss
actors: Claudette Colbert, Melvyn Douglas, Michael Bartlett
description: He is a divorced businessman and completely absorbed in work, she is his secretary, always in love with him. The girl also helps him in his domestic life and is so good that the man decides to marry her. But here the real trouble begins. Funny and bubbly romantic comedy, with moments of social satire, in the sober and intriguing style of the author of "The incomparable Godfrey". Screenplay by Sidnety Buchman. Excellent actors.

title: Russicum - I giorni del diavolo
actors: Treat Williams, F. Murray Abraham, Danny Aiello, Rita Rusic, Rossano Brazzi
description: Founded in Rome in 1929 by Pius XI, the Russicum college is a renowned Institute of Oriental Studies. It is there that the Pope's next trip to the Soviet Union, opposed by both the Soviets and the Americans, is being prepared in great secret. A woman named Silvia who is killed in Piazza Navona and who pretended to be a nun, for example, was an American agent of the CIA. The young Alexandra (Rusic), on the other hand, is a Soviet spy, while the young American diplomat Mark (Williams) doesn't know what to do and finds himself in his hands with several corpses. Tremendous spying by Squitieri, a total sculpt for improbability and sloppiness. Among the actors is saved F. Murray Abraham. But there is also Rita Rusic, "magician and spy from rotogravure and thigh", as Morando Morandini wrote at the time.

title: Super Mario Bros
actors: Bob Hoskins, John Leguizamo, Dennis Hopper, Samantha Mathis
description: Millions of years ago the fall of a meteorite opened a chasm, in which lives a world parallel to ours, where New York is now. A young paleontologist tries to stop a building speculation in order to continue digging under Manhattan. But, over there, there is the tyrant King Koopa, and it is against him that the plumber Mario Mario and his brother Luigi Mario fight.
notes: For the transition from video games to cinema Super Mario was gifted with a brother. Despite the technical skill and the amount of citations from video games, the film remains a disarming obviousness. Dennis Hopper is, of course, the villain.

title: Yuppies 2
actors: Massimo Boldi, Jerry Calà, Christian De Sica, Ezio Greggio
description: Giacomo, Lorenzo, Sandro and Willy, different professions, but identical propensity for an anachronistic student spirit, are engaged in their favorite activity: that of combining assorted jokes. For one thing, Lorenzo (Massimo Boldi) disguises himself as a nun in order to attempt a big deal with the Vatican. In various ways (wives, coveted prey, doubles of others, etc.), the story also deals with their women.
notes: The second "Yuppies" is more vulgar and televised than the first.

title: Amici miei atto II
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Gastone Moschin, Adolfo Celi, Renzo Montagnani
description: Count Mascetti, the surveyor Melandri, the surgeon Sassaroli, the innkeeper Necchi have not lost their taste for "gypsies", not even on the occasion of the funeral of their fifth partner, the journalist Perozzi. Without awe for anything or anyone (the Church, the tragic flood of the Arno in 1966), every occasion is exploited for ferocious mockery, even among themselves, brand new or recalled. Seven years after the very successful first chapter, the streak of screenwriters and directing has not run out, and the film is worth the previous one, biting, supported by a cruel humor that often turns to black. And the actors are always in great shape.

title: Elena et les hommes
actors: Ingrid Bergman, Jean Marais, Mel Ferrer
description: A charming Polish widow, Éléna Sorokovska, helps all those who lack self-confidence in the climb to success. First it is the turn of a young musician who, however, the woman leaves as soon as the young man manages to achieve success. Then it is the turn of General Rollan, of which the woman hopes to become the inspiration. A curious Renoirian divertissement between patriotism and sentimentality.

title: L'arbre, le maire et la médiathèque
actors: Fabrice Luchini, Arielle Dombasle, Clémentine Amouroux, Pascal Greggory
description: The mayor of Saint-Juire-en-Vandée, a country village, elected from the ranks of the Socialist Party has a grandiose project: he intends to equip the village with a cultural center that includes, in addition to a swimming pool and a theater, also a so-called media library. His relations with the politicians of Paris allowed him to find the necessary money and everything, according to his intentions, should go well. Except that...
notes: A treatise on the relationship between politics and public opinion, where the intertwining is deliberately reduced to a minimum. On Rohmer's part there is no intention of coming to a full stop, so much so that the film ends ... with a song.

title: Amici miei atto III
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Gastone Moschin, Adolfo Celi, Renzo Montagnani
description: The architect Melandri, the surgeon Sassaroli and the innkeeper Necchi join Count Mascetti one by one in the luxurious gerontocomio where he is reduced to a wheelchair. But this does not mean they renounce to put in place other perfidious jokes, indeed the guests of "Villa Serena" find themselves the victims of the mocking machinations of the four friends to whom age has brought neither wisdom nor pity. The director of the film changes, after the two signed by Monicelli in 1975 and 1982, and the screenwriters resort to heavy unpleasantness, often bordering on vulgarity, if not beyond. An epilogue that, after all, it would have been more decent to spare.

title: Speed
actors: Keanu Reeves, Dennis Hopper, Sandra Bullock, Jeff Daniels
description: There is a bomber threatening to put the city on fire. The first shot tempts him with the lift of a skyscraper, but Jack Traven, a skilled police officer, promptly intervenes to avert the massacre. Then it's the turn of a bus, packed with explosives and with a detonator that will explode if the vehicle drops below eighty miles per hour. But Traven still arrives to resolve the situation, also thanks to the help of the pretty driver.
notes: "Speed" does not leave a moment of respite to the spectator or the protagonists. The graph of narrative tension is always very high. Like the speedometer hand that must never go below that certain threshold.

title: Brigham Young - Frontiersman
actors: Tyrone Power, Dean Jagger, Linda Darnell, Brian Donlevy
description: Joseph Smith, the founder of the Mormon sect, was lynched by the Presbyterans of Illinois who force his disciples, led by Brigham Young, to leave that land. Thus began the long journey to the West of the pilgrims, in search of a safe home. To the difficulties of the environment are added the pitfalls of a false preacher who would like to divert the caravan to his own advantage.
notes: Reconstruction, between adventure and sentimental western, of the life of Brigham Young and the first Mormon community. Of epic ambitions, but in reality of limited scope.

title: Apartment for Peggy
actors: Jeanne Crain, William Holden, Edmund Gween
description: After the Second World War, the young Jason resumed his university studies, despite the fact that his wife Peggy is expecting a child and the two do not even have a home: they have in fact reduced to living in a caravan. Their condition is certainly not enviable, but, fortunately, Peggy is full of courage and spirit of initiative. One day he meets by chance, in a public park, an old retired professor on the verge of suicide who, conquered by the girl, will offer them his accommodation.
notes: Sentimental comedy with dramatic veins: a little lesson in optimism in the manner of Frank Capra, but without its corrosive acids.

title: Ride, Vaquero
actors: Robert Taylor, Ava Gardner, Howard Keel, Anthony Quinn
description: After the civil war, King Cameron and his wife settle in New Mexico and suffer the raids of groups of natives turned into bandits. Among them there is one, named Rio, which attracts the attention of Mrs. Cameron. Western without vigor, he manages to almost completely neutralize the group of stars who play him.

title: We're no Angels
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Aldo Ray, Peter Ustinov, Joan Bennett, Basil Rathbone
description: Escaped from Devil's Island, three convicts win the trust of a modest shopkeeper. In turn conquered by the good heart of the man, his wife and daughter, the three will be very useful to the little family. In their own way.
notes: From a successful play by Albert Husson, this almost Christmas-looking comedy has humor, the flawless pace of classic cinema and excellent performers, with a hilariously self-deprecating Bogart.

title: Amelia Earhart: the Final Flight
actors: Diane Keaton, Bruce Dern, Rutger Hauer
description: The film portrays a famous American aviation pioneer, with the problems of her private life and the obstacles to her will to public affirmation. Despite everything Amelia manages to become the first female pilot of the USA. Convincing television story of a female existence struggling for emancipation, based on a solid script by Carol Sobieski.

title: Baby's Day Out
actors: Adam Robert Warton, Jacob Joseph Warton, Joe Mantegna, Lara Flynn Boyle
description: He has a pompous name, Bennington Augustus Cottwell IV and is kidnapped to make his very wealthy family pay the ransom. Easy as drinking a glass of water, especially since the "prey" is a little frugoletto of just nine months. But the wicked must be made aware of the fact that between saying and doing there may be the sea, defeated by the initiative capacity of our mine.
notes: John Hughes, a specialist in films where the under-18s are rampant, has written another, borrowing characters and situations from cartoons and thinking of spectators who go in ecstasy in front of a child. Glad them ...

title: Cuore cattivo
actors: Kim Rossi Stuart, Cecilia Genovesi, Massimo Wertmüller, Massimo Ghini
description: In Rome, the young Claudio fails a robbery and takes a paraplegic hostage in her apartment. The woman looks for a way out by letting the TV intervene, and things seem destined to end without bloodshed. But a major attack in Milan hijacks the interest of television, which ends up with a tragic impact on the development of the already dramatic situation.
notes: Second direction by Umberto Marino from one of his theatrical texts. Catastrophic sociological claims and non-existent rhythm. Poor Rossi Stuart is forced to scream for an hour and a half.

title: La vera vita di Antonio H.
actors: Alessandro Haber, Giuliana De Sio, Ennio Fantastichini, Massimo Ghini
description: The life of Antonio Hutter, actor, according to Antonio Hutter. Childhood in Israel, youth in Verona, then Rome. The first roles in the cinema, the meeting with Orson Welles, the love story with Giuliana De Sio, the call to Hollywood to be De Niro's brother in "Raging Bull", then gradually until today, with the failure to commit suicide final and, once again, a phone call from the Mecca of cinema ...
notes: Antonio H. is, almost entirely, Alessandro Haber. Much of the biography of the former corresponds with that of the latter. And the film, first directed by Monteleone (screenwriter of Salvatores), becomes almost a metaphor of manias, presumptions, illusions of the Italian cinema of the last decade.

title: David Copperfield
actors: W. C. Fields, Freddie Bartholomew, Frank Lawton, Basil Rathbone, Edna May Oliver
description: Little David is forced by his stepfather to drop out of school to go to work. When the factory closes, David joins an old aunt, quirky but affectionate, who helps him by making him continue his studies. Raised, David gets married, but remains a widower.
notes: From the famous novel by Charles Dickens, a film made with breadth of means and above all with an exceptional cast that received wide acclaim from audiences and critics. Unforgettable is the characterization of Micawber by the very bad comedian W. C. Fields.

title: Third Man on the Mountain
actors: James McArthur, Michael Rennie, Janet Munro
description: Rudy lives in a Swiss village at the foot of an bold mountain: the "citadel". Rudy's father was an alpine guide who died during a climb, so the boy's uncle does not want Rudy to follow his tracks. The boy, however, learned that a group of climbers is trying a climb, runs away from home and reaches them. The uncle in turn, noticed the disappearance of his nephew, follows him on the mountain. English adventure movie for teenagers, "the third man" has nothing to do with it.

title: Knight Movies
actors: Christopher Lambert, Diane Lane, Tom Skerritt, Daniel Baldwin
description: Peter Sanderson, a very young chess player, has won a game but is suddenly attacked by the loser. Years later, Sanderson, who has become a chess champion, is engaged in an international tournament. Sanderson has an affair with Debbie, one of the tournament hostesses who is found dead: at the same time Sanderson receives a phone call from the killer. Thus begins a deadly match against the mysterious murderer.
notes: Classic thriller, however, pulled too much in the final. So-so, the plot is a bit twisted, the interpretation of Lambert who is also a producer is rather monotonous.

title: Blind Faith
actors: Robert Urich, Joanna Kerns, Joe Spano, Dennis Farina
description: We are in Toms River, New Jersey in 1984. Rob Marshall (Robert Urich) has a job as an insurance salesman, three children and a wife named Maria (Joanna Kerns). After a while Rob still has all of these things, except for his wife Maria, killed (he says) by a gang of thieves during a picnic on the grass. At first, no one doubts his version. Then the doubts surface. As well as the truth. The books based on news cases (better if bloody) are now a real literary genre. TV movies based on books based on news cases have now become a deadly bore. Here the cast is of a decent level, but no more.

title: Braindead
actors: Timothy Balme, Diana Penalver, Elizabeth Moody, Ian Watkin
description: Lionel knows he has a nosy, nosy mom. What he does not imagine is that his mother, thanks to the bite of a carnivorous monkey, has become a zombie. Her first victim is a nurse, the second is the priest who accompanies her during her funeral, with the result that the priest and nurse mate immediately afterwards and give birth to a zombie cub. For Lionel there is just no peace. "Creature del cielo" with which Jackson competed in Venice is an almost normal (and I stress almost) film. Here we are from quite different bands. Halfway between splatter and comedy, Jackson shows inventiveness and a sense of proportion in both fields.

title: Chicago Joe and the Showgirl
actors: Emily Lloyd, Kiefer Sutherland, Patsy Kensit
description: Five days (from 3 to 8 October 1944) in the life of Georgina Grayson and Ricky Allen. She is eighteen, a fake name and a great desire to show off. He is not from Chicago and is not a gangster. He's just an American defector with a great desire for adventure. Despite Kiefer Sutherland and despite an excessive stylization of the environments, the film is quite interesting.

title: Pasolini, un delitto italiano
actors: Carlo De Filippi, Nicoletta Braschi, Toni Bertorelli, Andrea Occhipinti, Claudio Amendola, Giulio Scarpati, Adriana Asti, Antonello Fassari, Claudio Bigagli, Francesco Siciliano, Claudia Pozzi, Rosa Pianeta, Victor Cavallo
description: Pier Paolo Pasolini died the night between 1 and 2 November 1975, assassinated in Ostia. The only accused and the only one found guilty in a trial that was running water on all sides was Pino Pelosi, a seventeen-year-old "life boy" arrested that night and confessed.
notes: An honest and heartfelt film, which starts from the night of the murder and reconstructs the stages of the investigation and the trial, written with a dry and non-rhetorical style by Giordana himself, by Stefano Rulli and Sandro Petraglia. A film that is historically necessary and right, but cinematically rather fragile: not because it adheres to the investigation and does not make the story spectacular, but because it has rather confusing parts and because part of the cast is not up to the situation.

title: Carrington
actors: Jonathan Pryce, Emma Thompson, Janet McTeer, Steven Waddington
description: We are in 1915. The World War upsets Europe, but the world of the artists and writers of bohemian London leads the usual carefree life. Lytton Strachey, a tall, thin, bearded, evidently homosexual bachelor leaves his environment to embark on a journey to the south coast of England, where he will be the guest of Vanessa Bell, sister of Virginia Woolf. There Strachey is dazzled by a figure who seems to him a beautiful teenager, but who instead turns out to be the young and wild painter Dora Carrington. From that moment on, a deep affection will bind them. The first film directed by the screenwriter of Stephen Frears, "Carrington" has all the characteristics of English cinema: political commitment, photography, direction and perfect editing up to the affectation, textbook acting. Fortunately, the boredom made inevitable by these premises is somewhat mitigated by the humor of some scenes. Jury Prize and Best Actor Award (Pryce) in Cannes.

title: My Man Godfrey
actors: William Powell, Carole Lombard, Alice Brady, Eugene Pallette
description: Butler in the house of a very rich family, Godfrey (who is actually a young man from a good family) gives a hard financial lesson (he bought the shares of the family company he works for, throwing it on the street) and also wins the love of his daughter of your employer. Yet another lesson in lightness combined with a lashing social denunciation (the gap between wealth and poverty) by La Cava: an ironic and sarcastic comedy impeccably performed and staged.

title: La belle histoire
actors: Marie Sophie L., Gérard Lanvin, Béatrice Dalle, Vincent Lindon, Vincent Lindon, Patrick Chesnais, Jacques Gamblin, Paul Préboist, Elie Chouraqui, Constantin Alexandrov, Denis Charvet, Amina Annabi, Jean-Michel Dupuis
description: A man and a woman met two thousand years ago. He is called Jesus, she is Odona. Today he is a gypsy who bought a Ferris wheel for an amusement park; Odona is a bad guy who redeems herself thanks to an auctioneer. Life is complicated and happiness almost impossible to find but in the end Jesus and Odona cross paths in an airport and they understand that they have always loved each other.
notes: Lelouch is unmistakable, a "magician" of the image and the montage who does not care about the credibility of the whole. Or at least of its "lightness". A film that is too long, with some good moments and some aestheticizing failures.

title: Crimson Tide
actors: George Dzundza, Matt Craven, Denzel Washington, Gene Hackman, Matt Craven, George Dzundza
description: A leader of Russian ultranationalism, leading a small army of rebels from the ranks of the dissolved Soviet army, managed to seize an atomic base, unleashing the most serious world crisis since that of the Bay of Pigs. With a world on the brink of disaster, the "Alabama" submarine leaves its moorings to patrol a stretch of Russian territorial waters, carrying nuclear warheads capable of unleashing World War III. At one point "Alabama" receives the order to launch nuclear missiles ...
notes: The main flaw of the film is an irrepressible boredom in the whole central part, the one that precedes the direct confrontation between Hackman and Denzel Washington. The fault lies with the flat direction and the story, predictable from the first to the last shot.

title: Butterfly Kiss
actors: Amanda Plummer, Saskia Reeves, Kathy Jamieson
description: Eunice, unpredictable and very dangerous, travels the streets of Northern England in search of Judith, the only person who has ever loved her. It is animated by a blind hatred and every time something goes against it, it reacts by killing the unfortunate person on duty. As he wanders he meets Miriam, a lonely and unhappy woman who works at a gas station and in her spare time looks after her old paralyzed mother. Miriam has never met a person like Eunice: this is funny, impulsive, passionate ... and completely insane. Miriam remains inebriated by it and, regardless of the danger, she gives herself completely to her until she becomes his mistress. The two women set off together in search of Judith. The film is created at the table to scandalize. The character of Eunice is evil to the point of banality, cursed and negative, but Amanda Plummer's interpretation is so intense that it surpasses any cliché. Despite her young age, she manages to support the weight of a film on her own: she is definitely a face to keep an eye on.

title: Dumb and Dumber
actors: Jim Carrey, Jeff Daniels, Lauren Holly, Karen Duffy
description: Lloyd Christmas, a limo driver, is the epitome of human stupidity. Shares a flat with Harry Dunne, a crazy, nutty friend. Lloyd pines for the ideal of a woman and is shocked when, one day, he meets Mary Swanson, a beautiful high society girl whom he must accompany to the airport. But, just as the woman is about to disappear, Lloyd notices that she has left a briefcase in the terminal. It is an unexpected opportunity. The grullo retrieves the briefcase and tries to return it by combining one disaster after another.
notes: Carrey and Daniels are the decerebrated version of all the most famous comic couples in the cinema, with the difference that, while usually one of the two was smarter than the other, here, however, the idiots are just two.

title: Holiday
actors: Katharine Hepburn, Cary Grant, Doris Nolan, Lew Ayres
description: Linda (Hepburn), the rich and dissatisfied daughter of a banker, snatches her boyfriend (Cary Grant) from her sister. After the film's failure, the producer refused to work with Hepburn again for ten years. History proved him wrong: Hepburn easily eats all the other actors.

title: I buchi neri
actors: Iaia Forte, Vincenzo Peluso, Marinella Anacleto, Manuela Arcuri
description: Following the sudden death of his mother, Adam returns to the village; here he finds the house where he was a child and meets his childhood friend Adelmo, who offers him a job. So Adam fills his days by driving a truck that brings rotten fruit to the pulp. One morning he stops to spy on an intimate couple in the fields. Suddenly, what seemed like a love meeting turns into a robbery that Adam manages to foil. Thus the trust of the girl, who is called Angela, is gained. She is a prostitute who is convinced that she has found the right person for her in Adam. An emotional bond arises between the two which, although it never materializes in a direct relationship, seems to momentarily fill the emptiness of their lives.
notes: Obsessed and surreal narration, which does not make us regret the lighter tone of the debut "Libera". Inspired by Camus' "Stranger" and drawing heavily, almost "Cocteau" style, from Greek tragedy (the centaur Chiron is always sitting on his Vespa, "Kronos" is seen on TV) and from the Italian background (the Campania suburbs, " The boy with the tuft "by Little Tony), the director tells of a South outside the box, in which degradation and palingenesis parade in front of a" camp "and imperturbable gaze.

title: Land and Freedom
actors: Ian Hart, Rosana Pastor, Iciar Bollain, Tom Gilroy
description: Spain 1936. A young Englishman joins the International Brigades to fight against Franco's troops. It mixes with Spaniards, Italians, Americans, French. He falls in love with Blanca, witnesses the violent and painful disintegration of the solidarity of the left: the Stalinist communists on one side and the POUM communists and the anarchists on the other. It is above all the story of a betrayed revolution, annihilated by the politics of the Russian Communist Party of the time.
notes: It is above all the story of a betrayed revolution, annihilated by the politics of the Russian Communist Party of the time.

title: Armed and Innocent
actors: Kate Jackson, Gerald McRaney, Andrew Starnes
description: 11-year-old Chris is alone in the house when two robbers are introduced and the boy is forced to kill them to defend himself. His parents and everyone in the village consider Chris a hero, but the terrible experience has left him with excruciating feelings of guilt that create serious psychological problems. Now there is an accomplice of the two criminals who wants to avenge the cronies and attacks the boy's house ... The problem of violence is particularly acute in the United States and, in its own way, the film presents an emblematic case. However, it is treated too simplistically and schematically to take on the value of a convincing warning.

title: La vela incantata
actors: Massimo Ranieri, Monica Guerritore, Lina Sastri
description: During Fascism, two brothers, Angelo and Tonino, wandering cinematographers, return to the town, in the Lower Po Valley. But everything has changed, around and within them. Angelo reconnects an old relationship and tries to open a cinema, Tonino turns to politics, risking arrest. The portrait of two brothers that becomes that of the Italy of fascism and of the laceration (like that of the cinema screen) that separates them.

title: They Call Me Mister Tibbs
actors: Sidney Poitier, Martin Landau, Barbara McNair, Anthony Zerbe
description: A prostitute was murdered. An anonymous voice telephones the police accusing Father Logan, a well-known priest in the neighborhood, of the murder. Inspector Tibbs, a friend of the priest, is in charge of the investigation. Some elements make us suspect Father Logan, but none in a decisive way. Therefore Tibbs dismisses the case also because it turns out to be the anonymous telephone operator. But a prostitute friend of the victim puts Tibbs on the trail of the killer. A raw and convincing detective story for Sidney Poitier who returns, after the sensational success of the "Hot night of Inspector Tibbs", in the role of the investigator.

title: Sotto... sotto... strapazzato da anomala passione
actors: Enrico Montesano, Veronica Lario, Luisa De Santis, Massimo Wertmüller
description: Oscar learns from his wife Ester that in the most intimate moments between them it is another person that she thinks of. The man takes it very badly and also believes he has identified his rival, but the truth is another: a visit to the park of the "monsters" in Bomarzo has stimulated extravagant impulses between Ester and her friend Adele. Then everything returns to normal, but perhaps with some unacknowledged nostalgia.
notes: Lina Wertmüller, who wrote the story and (with Enrico Aldini) the screenplay, wastes the potential of the story with a direction that is as loud as it is superficial.

title: Vacanze di Natale 91
actors: Christian De Sica, Massimo Boldi, Andrea Roncato, Alberto Sordi, Ornella Muti, Ezio Greggio
description: Mimmo and Rino live together in love and in agreement, until the first takes a crush on Simona. The auxoricide Leopoldo is disturbed by the ghost of the first wife he killed while he is in intimacy with the second. Nanni and Ingrid are given the same suite as Enzo and Fernanda. Giuliana, on a pleasure trip with a count, does not want to look like Sabino's daughter, a waiter in the hotel ... Oldoioni (plus six screenwriters) wrap up a fourth-rate television rubbish, with the cast placed there in bulk.

title: Waterworld
actors: Kevin Costner, Jeanne Tripplehorn, Dennis Hopper, Tina Majorino
description: We are in the future, the polar ice caps have melted and the earth is covered with water. The inhabitants dream of a mythical place called Dryland (dry land). The men who survived built strange islands for themselves, threatened by gangs of raiders. A lone hero fights the fierce pirate leader, the Deacon, and goes in search of a new life accompanied by a beautiful woman and a mysterious girl.
notes: Pure action, lots of irony and insightful jokes that never forget the present reality. Kevin Reynolds' work was briefly the most expensive in the history of cinema with its 175 million dollars (used for numerous underwater special effects): then came "Titanic". The photography is by Dean Semler and the music by James Newton Howard. Costner plays the unpleasant hero, but in the end he is the usual unblemished and fearless knight.

title: Poetic Justice
actors: Janet Jackson, Tupac Shakur, Regina King, Joe Torry
description: Justice is a beautician by trade, but cultivates a secret passion for poetry. She's having a hard time because her boyfriend just got murdered. Lucky, a postman who flirts with her with no luck, discovers that his ex-girlfriend is taking drugs. He then decides to take their baby girl and take her to her mother. Thanks to a trip in the car, the two become lovers, but things are already starting to spoil when Lucky shows that he wants to look only for a woman to take care of his daughter. Then Lucky goes into crisis for the assassination of the rapper cousin, It wouldn't be a bad movie if he managed to render the story well, served by a good script. The language is particularly bad.

title: Il verificatore
actors: Antonino Iuorio, Roberto De Francesco, Elodie Treccani
description: Crescenzio, a big boy of thirty, weighed down by an enormous body, works as a verifier at the gas company: he reads the meters house by house. He still lives with his family and has no friends. Giuliana is the secretary of an electronic repair laboratory, run by a violent old man who moves on the edge of legality, where Crescenzio's brother, Beniamino, vital and optimistic, also works. For Giuliana, shy and taciturn like him, Crescenzio almost nurtures an adoration, which however does not seem to be reciprocated. When the old man's attentions become insistent, the girl, who lives alone in the city, seeks protection in Beniamino The story of Incerti, also the author and screenwriter of the film, is one that Italian cinema usually does not tell. The protagonist Iuorio is very good, with his bulky and shy silhouette reminiscent of certain characters from Fassbinder.

title: Destiny Turns on the Radio
actors: Dylan McDermott, James LeGros, James Belushi, Quentin Tarantino, Nancy Travis
description: Las Vegas is a kind of Disneyland for adults. And then it can also happen that from the swimming pool of a shabby motel a weird gentleman emerges who, between electric shocks and a pinch of mystery, makes the loot, the result of a robbery, disappear under the nose of an astonished young man. But the young man has to explain everything to his partner out of jail.
notes: A couple of songs by Nancy Travis wrapped in a jessica-rabbit style, some flashes by James Belushi, a vulgar manager, an eccentric Allen Garfield, for a film already seen if it were not for the unusual fairytale aspect.

title: Free Willy 2: The Adventure Home
actors: Jason James Richter, Michael Madsen, August Schellenberg
description: Since they separated two years earlier, both the whale Willy and the little boy Jesse have faced numerous difficulties. The boy learned that his real mother died of heroin and he has an overbearing stepbrother in his new family that he knew nothing about. At a campsite in the Pacific, Jesse finds old friend Willy struggling with brother and sister unwilling to accept her in the pack. Thus resumes that relationship of magical understanding: together they will fight against an oily stain, the result of pollution. Since Warner's previous ecological fairy tale had some success, here comes the sequel. Characters and situations have remained more or less the same and the cheesy ecology ends up being irritating. But the children have fun.

title: L'anno prossimo vado a letto alle dieci
actors: Angelo Orlando, Ricky Memphis, Claudia Gerini, Barbara Cupisti
