The maneuver is successful, but the woman truly falls in love. During the trip to Reno, for the divorce, the woman realizes that she still loves her husband. It is the classic sentimental comedy, a genre in which the director excelled, full of twists and turns of the heart.

title: Ultimo minuto
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Elena Sofia Ricci, Diego Abatantuono, Massimo Bonetti
description: Walter Ferroni is the manager of a provincial team that still plays in Serie A. Despite the various leagues experienced in the low ranking, Ferroni has almost always managed to save the team from relegation, often playing "dirty". Football, however, has ruined his private life, starting with his relationship with his daughter.
notes: The country of football has never been able to produce major films about our most popular sport. This is the only exception. Not everything goes smoothly, to tell the truth. Pupi Avati exceeds in moralism but the melancholy of the protagonist is authentic, and the situations are dramatic. Amazing Tognazzi.

title: Black Rainbow
actors: Rosanna Arquette, Jason Robards jr., Tom Hulce, Mark Joy
description: Martha Travis (Rosanna Arquette) has paranormal powers, but she's tired of having them. One evening he predicts the murder of Tom Kuron, one who seems to be on the verge of telling the whole truth about the wrongdoings of a chemical industry. The result is to attract the attention of Lloyd Harley, Kuron's killer in the pay of the industry itself. But Lloyd only kills Martha's father while she vanishes into thin air ... Too much grace! This film contains an energetically ecological side, a standard thriller trend and, in addition, an almost inexplicable supernatural streak. Too much meat on the fire: only half of it was enough. The Arquette, however, is never to be thrown away.

title: Les diaboliques
actors: Simone Signoret, Véra Clouzot, Charles Vanel, Paul Meurisse
description: Michel Delassalle authoritatively directs the college he founded with the money of his wife Cristina. Nicole is a new teacher becomes Michel's lover. However, the two women end up becoming allies against the man they have in common. With a ruse they lure him into a trap, kill him and simulate an accident in the boarding school swimming pool. But Michel's body disappears ... A classic of French cinema and thriller. Inspired by a novel by Boileau and Narcejac, Clouzot reaches the maximum in his ruthless analysis of the ferocity that can be hidden in the human spirit. 1996 remake by Jeremiah Chechik, with Isabelle Adjani and Sharon Stone.

title: La ragazza di Piazza San Pietro
actors: Vittorio De Sica, Walter Chiari, Johnny Dorelli, Dolores Palumbo
description: The Conforti family has a souvenir kiosk in St. Peter's Square. In reality it is only Lucia who keeps up with the business, since her brother is an amateur boxer, the other brother Paolino is in boarding school and dad Armando runs after the tourists. Paolino risks being thrown out of boarding school and so Linda goes to talk to the professor. The result is that they fall in love. It is always nice to see De Sica being the "tombeur de femmes" and Chiari the somewhat clumsy teacher. But it is not enough to make the film a barely dignified thing.

title: Santa Clause
actors: Tim Allen, Eric Lloyd, Judge Reinhold, Wendy Crewson
description: On the night of Christmas Eve, Santa Claus falls from the roof; all bruised, he cannot make his nocturnal journey and risks disappointing the children who are waiting for his gifts all over the world. We need a replacement as soon as possible: it will be up to Scott, newly divorced and a bit of a clumsy father. The hardest obstacle to overcome is actually the skepticism of the ex-wife and the psychologist. Modest fairy tale full of sugar with a few moments of hilarity: the part of the transformation of the young man into a self-respecting Santa Claus, with a big belly and a white beard. The rest only serves to confirm a Hollywood tradition: that is, that movies with Santa Claus are the ugliest, or at least the most dull.

title: Casper
actors: Christina Ricci, Bill Pullman, Cathy Moriarty, Eric Idle, Garette Ratliff Henson
description: In Friendship, Maine, there is a castle which contains a treasure and which appears to be inhabited by ghosts. When the scheming Carrigan gets his hands on the property he inherited, he hires a ghost hunter to get rid of the bulky presences. Dr. Harvey then enters the castle accompanied by his daughter Kat. Waiting for them they find Casper, a kind ghost (especially with Kat) of a child who died at twelve, but also his three weird and dirty uncles: Molla, Ciccia and Puzza, who do not intend to interrupt a tradition of bullying and spite.
notes: Casper, a tender and melancholy ghost born in the 1940s, talks, shows emotions and can even earn a couple of hours of life "in the flesh" and dance a languid slow with Kat. However, the most striking part of the film is obviously the pyrotechnic, chaotic and wonderful part of the special effects, the marghingegni, the comic stunts. Look at it: the production is signed by Spielberg.

title: Bad Medicine
actors: Steve Guttenberg, Alan Arkin, Julie Hagerty, Bill Macy
description: Jeff is forced by his father, a rich and famous plastic surgeon, to enroll in medical school. For his poor performance, however, he was expelled from several universities. His father, exasperated, then enrolls him in an expensive university in Latin America run by the despotic rector Madeira. The population is hostile to students who prefer the sorcerer but these, led by Jeff (who meanwhile has found love and a vocation) open a clinic to treat the poor for free. The film starts on the wave of the demented comedy of the various "medical schools" but then he would like to make a more serious speech. Neither thing is too good for him.

title: White Lightning
actors: Burt Reynolds, Jennifer Billingsley, Ned Beatty, Bo Hopkins, R. G. Armstrong
description: McKlusky is in prison for smuggling. He attempts to escape to avenge the killing of his brother by a corrupt sheriff. The police then make an agreement with him: they will break him out if McKlusky agrees to infiltrate the gang which also includes the corrupt sheriff, Connors, to expose him. So it happens but Connors suspects McKlusky who, only after a spectacular escape, manages to get rid of his men and crash the car with the sheriff into a lake.
notes: The tenaciously pursued theme of revenge, at the cost of all suffering, is not new to cinema. Here it is embroidered on it a little roughly and without too much vivacity.

title: Murder, So Sweet
actors: Harry Hamlin, Helen Shaver, K. T. Oslin, Eileen Brennan
description: Steve Catlin (Hamlin) is no loyalty monster. His third wife, Edie (Shaver), knows something about it, who in the end, desperate, has decided to divorce. Steve, however, does not disarm, he marries again and, this time, the new wife ends up dead. Edie begins to get suspicious. When Steve marries again and is widowed for the second time, Edie's suspicions become certainties. Tv-movie in the (low) average.

title: Ace Ventura -When Nature Calls
actors: Jim Carrey, Ian McNeice, Simon Callow, Sophie Okonedo
description: Ace Ventura goes through a spiritual crisis for failing to rescue a lost raccoon. He is torn from his isolation by a new, very dangerous mission: he must find the sacred animal of the placid tribe of the Wachati, in Africa. And he must retrieve it before the wedding day of the chief's daughter with the eldest son of another warrior tribe: otherwise a fierce war between "clans" will break out. Ace thus embarks on an adventurous journey into the jungle.
notes: Tuft on the forehead, incredible grimaces and idiotic jokes (with a clear preference, as always, for various body noises): the mimic champion Carrey re-proposes the "pet detective" who made him famous. Easy fun fans will not be disappointed. The others abstain, or look for some films by Franchi & Ingrassia that at least made people laugh.

title: Pocahontas
description: In 1607 a group of British adventurers, including John Smith, landed in the New World. In Virginia, the young Indian Pocahontas, daughter of Chief Powhatan, is betrothed to Kakoum, a brave warrior. Relations between the British settlers and the Indians are becoming increasingly tense, and could lead to conflict. From the meeting of Pocahontas and John Smith comes the love that will ultimately save the peace between the British and the Indians. Even if you have to sacrifice in the face of "reason of state". In illustrating one of the founding myths of the American nation, Casa Disney exceeds in romanticism and loses color and vigor. In addition, the traditional happy end is missing, even disconcerting news. Tasty as always is the presence of animals: the raccoon, the dog and the hummingbird, quarrelsome and spiteful, remember the best creations.

title: Seven
actors: Brad Pitt, Morgan Freeman, Kevin Spacey, Gwyneth Paltrow
description: A cunning and ruthless killer is killing carefully chosen characters in the most gruesome ways. On his trail are the young and ambitious Mills, on his first mission, and the expert Somerset, now close to retirement; opposite personalities who tolerate each other badly. They learn to "coexist" as the hunt for the killer becomes tighter and the mystery begins to unravel: the monster chooses the victims and kills them following the seven deadly sins (gluttony, avarice, sloth, lust, pride, envy and anger).
notes: In its own way, a classic of the 90s thriller. The screenplay has ideas to spare, and Fincher confirms that he has a keen eye for the murky and obsessed atmospheres (already heralded by the good opening credits), while demonstrating that there is no limit to human atrocity. Great photograph by Darius Kondhi.

title: The Scarlet Letter
actors: Demi Moore, Gary Oldman, Robert Duvall, Lisa Joliffe-Andoh, Edward Hardwicke, Robert Prosky, Roy Dotrice, Joan Plowright, Malcolm Storry, James Bearden, Larissa Laskin, Amy Wright, George Aguilar, Tim Woodward, Joan Gregson, Dana Ivey
description: We are in the seventeenth century, in the puritanical Boston of the first British colonizers. Hester Prinne is a young woman married to an elderly English scientist who was taken prisoner by the natives. While waiting for her husband to be freed, the woman is tainted with the gravest shame: she commits adultery with a prelate and gives birth to a daughter. For this act the community condemns her to the public pillory forcing her to wear forever, sewn in red on her breast, the infamous letter "A" (which stands for "adulterous"). Hester however, with proud obstinacy, refuses to reveal the name of the child's father. Nathaniel Hawthorne's novel is a poignant and damned masterpiece. Joffé has certainly not consolidated these qualities. Demi Moore can never have the compressed and painful dignity of Hester Prinne. Oldman and Duvall are good, but the film boils down to a photo novel-flavored meatloaf. With the addition of a happy ending Hawthorne never dreamed of.

title: Barton Fink
actors: John Turturro, John Goodman, Judy Davis, Michael Lerner, John Mahoney
description: In 1941, Barton Fink, a young playwright, comes to Hollywood hired by a producer. Stayed in a seedy hotel, he befriends Charlie, an outgoing roommate. W. P. Mayhew, a successful but now alcoholic screenwriter, is of no help to him. His secretary, Audrey, gives him a hand; Barton and Audrey also sleep together, but the next morning he finds her horribly murdered. Charlie helps him get rid of the corpse and then disappears. Palme d'Or in Cannes '91. The Coen brothers reconstruct an environment and an atmosphere, ignoring any realistic claim and focusing on the oneiric, the grotesque, the absurd. On the contamination of genres they found a criticism of the Hollywood system of considerable breadth. Great in the role of Barton Fink is John Turturro, a fragile and spirited spectacle, grappling with the ghosts of art and the monsters of cinema.

title: White Man's Burden
actors: John Travolta, Harry Belafonte, Kelly Lynch, Robert Gosset
description: Pinnock is white, he works as a worker and risks unemployment. Thaddeus is black and is the owner of the factory where Pinnock works. Thaddeus is rich, satisfied, he can afford whatever he wants. The anger of the worker, frustrated and humiliated, explodes violently against the black boss: he kidnaps him and takes him to the ghetto, to experience the hell life that whites do.
notes: Nice idea: try to imagine what can happen in a world where blacks are rich, privileged, educated, and whites are the "culturally inferior" race. Unfortunately, however, it does not go beyond a simple exchange of roles and the game at first makes you smile, but then it is only repetitive.

title: Bitter Moon
actors: Peter Coyote, Emmanuelle Seigner, Hugh Grant, Kristin Scott Thomas
description: Two married couples on a cruise on the Istanbul route: Nigel (Grant) and Fiona (Scott-Thomas), in crisis "for the seventh year", Oscar (Coyote) and Mimì (Seigner), himself a poorly successful writer, immobilized in a wheelchair , she young and sparkling. Oscar tells Nigel about his dramatic life with Mimì and involves him in a devastating relationship of temptations. Tragic conclusion for the second couple. For the first one, who knows ... A "ferocious" Polanski bordering on sadism, sardonic to the grotesque, explores the heights and abysses of attraction and rejection that results in hatred. From the novel by Pascal Bruckner.

title: L'arte di arrangiarsi
actors: Alberto Sordi, Marco Guglielmi, Franco Coop, Luisa Della Noce
description: Rosario Scimoni, known as Sasa, does not believe in anything. At first he is secretary of the mayor of his city, as well as his nephew, but he betrays him on some compromising documents. Then he becomes the right arm of the Tuscan socialist. World War I breaks out and he pretends to be crazy, then marries an ugly but very rich woman. He adheres to fascism and, later, to communism, and so on ... Alberto Sordi dominates the portrait of the cynical protagonist (how many similar characters will he make in his career!). But the film doesn't always hold convincing. Alongside happily biting moments, there are also pauses and downtime.

title: Man on Fire
actors: Scott Glenn, Brooke Adams, Joe Pesci, Jonathan Pryce, Jade Malle
description: A wealthy Italian family hires a former CIA agent in an existential crisis as bodyguard for their little daughter. Christian Creasy, this is the man's name, becomes a friend of the girl and this friendship brings him back to trust in life. When she is kidnapped, Creasy begins a solitary hunt which, within about 48 hours, allows him to take down the criminals and reach the baby.
notes: A Franco-Italian thriller supported by an interesting all-American cast in the main roles. Starting from a subject little more than a chronicle, Chouraqui tells us the story of a man who finds himself accepting himself in his true nature.

title: La più bella serata della mia vita
actors: Alberto Sordi, Michel Simon, Charles Vanel, Claude Dauphin, Pierre Brasseur
description: The Italian industrialist Alfredo Rossi is in Switzerland to illegally deposit a large sum in a local bank. The bank is closed, and not finding any open hotels, he obtains hospitality in a castle, with four retired magistrates. They set up, partly as a joke, partly not, a fake trial against Rossi, guilty of killing his predecessor in the company. Based on a good short story by Dürrenmatt, Scola's film is full of ambitions that it can only partially support. Too bad, if only for the excellent quartet of old French glories in the parts of the judges.

title: Underground
actors: Miki Manojlovic, Lazar Ristovski, Mirjana Jokovic
description: During the Nazi occupation of Yugoslavia, Marko and Blacky enriched themselves by practicing all kinds of trafficking and supplying the Resistance with weapons. When Blacky has to disappear from circulation, Marko hides him in a cellar where other rioters are also taking refuge and becomes their only link with the outside world. In order not to share Natalija's love with his friend, Marko continues to make people believe that the war goes on even after the liberation.
notes: Exaggerated, redundant and even consoling: the mega fresco composed by Kusturica on his country has an uncontrolled vitality, colors, music, blood and overflowing passions. It may be that the film is also ideologically contradictory and cinematically astute, but it strikes the generosity with which feelings and images are dispensed.

title: The Long Ships
actors: Richard Widmark, Sidney Poitier, Rosanna Schiaffino
description: Around the year 1000, Sheikh Ali Mansuh captures Rolf, a Viking adventurer, and forces him to guide him to retrieve a gigantic golden bell. The affair is complicated by the presence, between the two, of a couple of girls. The film leaves too much room for speech and little to action and, apart from the setting, offers very little satisfaction.

title: Kidnapped
actors: David Naughton, Barbara Crampton, Chick Vennera, Lance LeGault
description: A sixteen-year-old girl is brutally kidnapped by a gang of criminals who want to use her for a porn movie, one of those destined for the underground market. The kidnappers, however, will have to deal with the girl's older sister, and with a nice policeman who helps her in the research.
notes: Poor action-thriller with Barbara Crampton, already seen in _Re-Animator_.

title: Grunt!
actors: Andy Luotto, Giorgio Faletti, Gianni Ciardo, Roberto Della Casa
description: There is a conflict between two tribes of cavemen over the possession of an egg which, by chance, has assumed "magical" virtues. Another case causes the two groups to return to coexist peacefully. Fantastic-allegorical story that would like to be humorous, directed and interpreted by an Andy Luotto willing to exploit in this way the wave of his ephemeral television success.

title: Family Secret
actors: Stefanie Powers, Maureen Stapleton, Melissa Gilbert, Marlena Giovi
description: Three women, each belonging to different generations, during a vacation confide the secrets of their lives to each other, comparing destinies and feelings. The collective balance is not the most exciting. A mildly dramatic and dispersive intimate drama. With Maureen Stapleton, also interpreter of "Cocoon".

title: Children of Times Square
actors: Howard Rollins jr., Joanna Cassidy, David Ackroyd
description: A little boy runs away from home and begins to lead the life of a tramp. He ends up in Times Square where he meets the harsh reality of the metropolis, populated by prostitutes, pimps and drug traffickers. So he too becomes a courier in the cocaine trade, a member of a gang made up of minors. The situation seems desperate but the mother comes into play and will do everything to snatch him from bad company
notes: A strong impact film, directed by Curtis Hanson for TV. The idea is to warn parents of the misadventures of young people who run away from home. The result is a violent and well-performed film by Howard E. Rollins jr (an '81 Oscar nomination for Ragtime). Shot on real locations in New York.

title: Lashou shentan
actors: Tony Leung Chiu Wai, Chow Yun-fat, Teresa Mo, Philip Chan, Philip Kwok, Anthony Wong Chau-Sang, Hoi-Shan Kwan, Wei Tung, Bowie Lam, Meng Lo, Bobbie Au-Yeung, Shui Ting Ng, Kong Lau
description: There is a gang war around the clandestine importation of arms into Hong Kong. During a police operation, Detective Yuen (Yun Fat) loses his partner and at that point his investigation also becomes a personal matter. With the help of killer Tony (Leung), actually an undercover cop in the organization, Yuen sets off on his crusade against the bad guys. John Woo is a bartender in this movie, but that's a fake because he's actually one of the best directors of the 90s. His are not gunfights, they are choreographic numbers. Don't mind the inconsistencies of the plot: listen to the music.

title: Lies of the Heart: The Story of Laurie Kellogg
actors: Gregory Harrison, Jennie Garth, Steven Keath, Francis Guinan, Alexis Arquette
description: A young woman is in prison, burdened by a very heavy accusation: having instigated some of her friends to kill her husband. A dramatic contradiction emerges from the investigation: apparently the man was normal, but in love with his wife and affectionate with her; other testimonies instead give him an opposite portrait, that of a violent, abusive and sadist. Which side is the truth on? That "reality" can have as many faces as there are those of those who report it, is quite obvious. Here the gap is even excessive between one version and another due to a somewhat too forced contrast in its ambiguous duplicity.

title: Twenty Bucks
actors: Linda Hunt, Christopher Lloyd, Steve Buscemi, Elisabeth Shue
description: A gust of wind snatches a brand-new twenty-dollar bill from the hands of a mother of a family, and the film follows the complex course: from a tramp to a boy, from this to a young groom, then to a stripper, to a thief, his young protege, a novice writer, a prize in an oratorial bingo, even as a criminal offense in a murder.
notes: In 1942 the French Duvivier shot "Destiny on Manhattan" in Hollywood, with thrilling scriptwriters and performers, which was the story of the hardships of a tailcoat. On a similar point, "A piece for twenty" is not too bad, but certainly does not hold up the comparison.

title: Kourotchka Riaba / Riaba ma poule
actors: Inna Chukova, Alexander Surin, Gennadi Iegorichev, Gennadi Nazarov
description: Asja lives in the village of Bezvodnoie with only the company of the Riaba hen. Asja's son lives on the black market and theft and she has never married the man she had him with, who is now with a gypsy and is close to alcoholism. The woman is in a dispute with the owner of the sawmill and, for an illegal initiative, she also ends up in jail. Then, one day, Riaba bowl a golden egg ...
notes: It is the sequel, shot thirty years later (with a different protagonist but in the same village), of "The story of Asja", a jewel of juicy rural comedy. And it is a full center, a little crazy, with hints of melancholy for the past youth.

title: De amor y de sombras
actors: Antonio Banderas, Jennifer Connelly, Stefania Sandrelli, Camilo Gallardo
description: Irene, from a cultured and wealthy family, was a journalist during the Pinochet dictatorship. Engaged with a brilliant officer, Irene meets a photographer who asks her to become a collaborator of his magazine. Together the two discover (as well as their mutual attraction) an abandoned mine used by the regime as a mass grave for the bodies of suppressed opponents. And for them it's big trouble.
notes: A curious fate is that of Isabel Allende's novels: they are worth a lot on the page but, on the other hand, they give rise to films that are wrong when not horrible. Wrong was "The House of Spirits" (by Bille August, 1993), "Of Love and Shadow" is even worse.

title: Palla di neve
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Alessandro Haber, Leo Gullotta, Anna Falchi, Monica Bellucci
description: Billy Bolla, an elderly actor on the eve of retirement, takes a cruise. During a storm, a white beluga escapes from a dolphinarium on the coast and starts following the ship from which Billy throws him some food every day. The problem arises when, inadvertently, at sea (and in the belly of the dolphin) Billy's pension book ends. From this moment the hunt for the poor beluga begins, unaware of his "crime" and indeed inclined to socialize.
notes: Bravo the beluga, but only him: all the others seem to come from a company of amateurs; including Village, which by now too often finds itself supporting children and animals (we know, deleterious for any actor).

title: Selvaggi
actors: Ezio Greggio, Leo Gullotta, Cinzia Leone, Franco Oppini, Monica Scattini
description: During the Christmas holidays, a small tourist plane carrying a group of ten Italians crashes on a desert island in the Caribbean Sea. Forced to coexist indefinitely, men and women involved in the unusual adventure must help each other, organize themselves and endure while waiting for help. There are the rampant Milanese Berlusconi, the Roman borgataro fan of Bertinotti, the geography professor who admires Prodi, supermodels and some complex ladies. A sample of various humanity that reproduces Italy, cheerful, confusing and "caciarona", on a tropical background.
notes: It is a pity that the Vanzina brothers, specializing in Christmas and commercial cinema, rather than a sort of mirror film in a comic key of Italy between the first and second republics, have limited themselves to recycling a repertoire now inflated by television. Ezio Greggio professionally rattles off his usual repertoire, but all in all he is wasted, like all the other performers.

title: Viaggi di nozze
actors: Carlo Verdone, Veronica Pivetti, Claudia Gerini, Cinzia Mascoli
description: First episode: Dr. Professor Raniero Cotti Borroni is an unbearably fussy and talkative baron of medicine. Left a widower, he remarries with poor Fosca, hypersensitive and derelict. Second: the honeymoon of a shy and naive banker with his tender bride is marred by family misfortunes of various kinds. Third: An enriched ex-bully, superficial and animalistic, grapples with the overwhelming sexual appetites of his worthy partner during his honeymoon.
notes: Returning to the episodic film and to the characteristic characters of the beginnings, Verdone does not forget the vein of melancholy disenchantment that often ran under his most recent comedies. This film, although discontinuous, has moments worthy of its golden years. He launched the catchphrase "'O famo weird?". Good female partners.

title: Vacanze di Natale 95
actors: Massimo Boldi, Christian De Sica, Paolo Bonacelli, Luke Perry
description: Lorenzo goes on vacation to Aspen, Colorado with his daughter Marta. The girl is willing to do anything to get to know Luke Perry (the interpreter of _Beverly Hills 90210_), a regular visitor to the place; this worries zealous dad. Remo is an avid card player in pursuit of his wife who left him. Due to an exchange of suitcases, Lorenzo and Remo know each other "deeply" ...
notes: Yet another stadium film with the award-winning couple De Sica-Boldi. Someone is having fun (lucky him): but if you really have to choose, better - and that is all to say ... - the original Vanzina "Christmas holidays". However, as they say, persevering is diabolical.

title: Facciamo Paradiso
actors: Margherita Buy, Lello Arena, Philippe Noiret, Aurore Clément
description: Claudia Bertelli was born in 1949, the only daughter of a Milanese secular upper middle class family. At seven she organizes her baptism, at seventeen she joins the flower children, later undergoes the fascination of student struggles, then becomes an advocate of free love, has a baby, gets married, repents. As long as he finds comfort in a religious group. At the time of his death in 2011 ...
notes: Monicelli has given life to many beautiful comedies and some cheesy. But he has probably never been as confused, ambitious, unsolved and pathetically out of tune as here. This feminine story does not hit upon an atmosphere, a character, a joke. A film (generously) to forget.

title: Conflict
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Alexis Smith, Sydney Greenstreet, Rose Hobart
description: Richard Manson (Bogart) is a wealthy engineer who has been married to Kathryn for five years. Everyone thinks they are happy, but in reality Richard, in love with his sister-in-law Evelyn, is fed up with his wife and devises a plan to get rid of her. The operation succeeds, but the corpse does not come out. In the end, he can no longer resist and returns to the scene of the crime. Based on the subject of Robert Siodmak, the script isn't exactly sinless, but all in all it's not a big deal. The important thing is to observe Bogart's grim looks and Sidney Greenstreet's broad face, and the noir atmospheres.

title: Fifth Avenue Girl
actors: Ginger Rogers, Walter Connolly, Tim Holt, James Ellison
description: Alfred Borden is an industrialist who can no longer communicate with his family. The son only thinks about sport; his wife and daughter are concerned only with shopping. It is also only his birthday, when he meets a pretty, sensible girl with little financial resources. With her he elaborates a risky plan, but one that will bring peace and common sense back into the family. Taking advantage of the fact that he was photographed with her by some paparazzi, he imposes the girl on relatives as if she were his mistress. La Cava moves at ease in this sophisticated comedy, which focuses on a brilliant actress (and occasionally dancer) Rogers.

title: I laureati
actors: Leonardo Pieraccioni, Rocco Papaleo, Gian Marco Tognazzi, Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Alessandro Haber, Massimo Ceccherini
description: The graduates (or rather "undergraduates") of the title are Leonardo, a newly divorced, Rocco, southern night watchman, Bruno, a Roman emigrant, Pino, a failed entertainer. Four thirty-year-olds largely out of school, who share the same suburban apartment trying to graduate more out of respect for their parents than for personal ambition. During the day everyone has their own commitments, in the evening they all get together to tell each other and share male embarrassments, apparitions (more or less fleeting) of women, weaknesses, small dramas and a lot of daily boredom.
notes: Italian cinema has an ancient and tired vocation for categorization: it is enthusiastic about social, cultural and anthropological "types", believing it can draw interesting insights for analysis or satire. In reality, it generally does not come out of superficial catalogs of gags and sketches. Trivial dialogues and some witty gimmicks alternate without the film being able to take off. Pieraccioni rehearses the success before the "Cyclone".

title: El Desperado
actors: Chip Gorman, Rosemary Dexter, Franco Giornelli, Dana Ghia
description: As soon as he escaped the gallows Steve, known as "El Desperado", runs into Bill, a seriously wounded soldier belonging to the Southern army. The man, who is now dying, begs Steve to go to Overton to persuade his father Sam to buy an old ranch. Steve, pretending to be Bill, introduces himself to the old man who has now gone blind. Meanwhile, a ferocious group of thugs has entered the city. Violent Italian western. Stereotyped and grim Western.

title: Assassins
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Antonio Banderas, Julianne Moore
description: A mysterious client assigns, via computer, murderous missions to two professional killers: Robert, a specialist since the days of the Cold War, now sick of the job; and Miguel, an ambitious history buff and determined to replace the former. Supervisory expert Electra is unbeatable in the appropriation of top-secret information. The three destinies cross in different ways: while Robert and Electra struggle together to get out of a world made only of risk and loneliness, in which they no longer recognize each other, Miguel uses all the weapons at his disposal, with no holds barred, to become the best of that world.
notes: "Assassins" is a dark variation on the duelist theme. Unfortunately, it completely fails both in the evident and badly resolved aspiration to noir, and in the improbable sentimental interference. Pursuits, explosions, killings, make use of a photographic and directorial system of great stars. The dialogues and psychologies of the characters are instead squalid and embarrassing, the result of a screenplay from a series B film.

title: Badkonak e sefid
actors: Aida Mohammadkhani, Mohsen Kalifi, Mohammad Shahani
description: On March 21, the day of the Iranian New Year, a seven-year-old girl leaves the house with her mother's last banknote to go and buy a goldfish. On the way Razieh lingers looking at the acrobats and loses his money in a manhole. Desolate, but not resigned, she remains there, waiting for help. And the street corner turns into a theater: the protagonists are the little girl's brother, a soldier, a tailor, an Afghan boy who sells balloons. A small, delicious, Iranian film by a pupil of Kiarostami (author of the screenplay) who does not fear dilated times and improvised dialogues: on the contrary they succeed very well. An hour and twenty-five of pure pleasure of encounters, of paradoxical conversations that only children can construct, of reality observed "from below" (in the true sense). "The white balloon" mixes races, professions, ages, small daily events: everything, told in real time with affection and irony, captures the attention without ever getting bored. Camera d'or in Cannes.

title: While Justice Sleeps
actors: Cybill Shepherd, Tim Matheson, Karis Paige Bryant, Dion Anderson
description: Upon her husband's death, Jody Stokes (Shepherd) returns to her hometown along with daughter Samantha. The baby is small, so Jody needs someone to look after her to go out. His old friend Winn Cooke (Matheson) is happy to babysit. But things get complicated when it turns out that Samantha has been raped and that old friend Winn is the culprit.
notes: Perhaps not everyone knows that Alan Smithee is the conventional name used when a director decides not to sign a film. On the other hand, Cybill Shepherd is just her and this is enough to make any TV movie bearable.

title: Love and Bullets
actors: Charles Bronson, Jill Ireland, Rod Steiger, Henry Silva, Strother Martin
description: To frame the mafia boss Joe Bomposa, the FBI decides to arrest Jackie (Ireland), his lover who lives in Switzerland. So he sends an agent (Bronson) to Europe, while the boss's killers try to eliminate the girl.
notes: Rosenberg, thank goodness, isn't Winner, but the real trouble is, Bronson is still Bronson. Steiger sometimes believes he is Brando, but only he believes in it.

title: Goldeneye
actors: Pierce Brosnan, Famke Janssen, Sean Bean, Izabella Scorupco, Desmond Llewelyn, Judi Dench
description: Agent 007 James Bond, betrayed by a former colleague and friend, must challenge an organization of highly "computerized" criminals from the new Russia. The criminals have seized a weapon of deadly power, the "Goldeneye", stolen from a Siberian plant. Between Monte Carlo and St. Petersburg Bond will put things right.
notes: Seventeenth chapter of the Bondian saga. A great return, with Pierce Brosnan who in terms of phisique du rõle has nothing to envy to the legendary Connery. And a sincere fidelity to classic schemes: irony, invincibility, incredible weapons (procured by the timeless Q), casinos, chases and beautiful women. Some concessions to changing times: the boss, M (Dench) is a woman; Miss Moneypenny allows herself to go on gallant dates with others; and among the beautiful women who traditionally fall at Bond's feet there is a dangerous sado-masochist. A tasty and spectacular film, with a more Anglo-Saxon first half (anticipated by good politically correct opening credits), and a second a bit more Americanized and "bombastic", but always fun.

title: Moonlight & Valentino
actors: Kathleen Turner, Whoopi Goldberg, Gwyneth Paltrow, Elizabeth Perkins, Jon Bon Jovi
description: Rebecca, a young widow, is comforted by her eccentric friend Sylvie, her neurotic sister Lucy and tyrannical ex stepmother Alberta. The intimacy between the four women brings out, little by little, all the insecurities that each jealously concealed. A (particularly sexy) house painter, called by Alberta to fix the house before Rebecca's birthday, acts as a catalyst for their confessions. This film based on a play by Ellen Simon (Neil's daughter) is polite and brilliant.

title: Quella sporca storia nel West
actors: Andrea Giordana, Gilbert Roland, Horst Frank, Françoise Prevost
description: Johnny, a veteran of the war, discovers that his father was killed by the bandit Santana and that his mother has married her husband's ambiguous brother. There is so much rotten underneath. Crazy project by Sergio Corbucci ("Hamlet" in spaghetti western version) staged without flights by Enzo Castellari alias Girolami.

title: Man in the Wilderness
actors: Richard Harris, John Huston, John Bindon, Prunella Ransome
description: Adventurer Bess, a member of an expedition to North America led by Captain Henry, is attacked by a bear and then abandoned dying by his companions on their way to Missouri. Little by little he manages to recover, thanks to the miraculous herbs of nature and his tenacity, which keeps him alive to allow him one day to take revenge on those who betrayed him.
notes: Story of a dramatic solitude told with an undoubted epic sense which is joined by a faithful representation of Indian life and the contradictions (and hypocrisy) of the colonists.

title: Swimming with Sharks
actors: Kevin Spacey, Frank Whaley, Michelle Forbes, Benicio Del Toro
description: Powerful and sadistic Buddy Ackerman is one of Hollywood's most feared producers. Working for him, if you put up with arrogance and megalomania, is a sure key to success. Guy, his new assistant, realizes that it is worth biting a few toads to advance his career; but when Buddy does one too many, he kidnaps the producer and tortures him to take revenge.
notes: Shot in a few days and with little money, it is a discreet product that, rather than defining the world of Hollywood, sheds light on the world of work: the frantic and ruthless search for success, prevarication, exploitation, the desire for revenge. No wonder screenwriter and director Huang was a major company official. Just a little too self-satisfied.

title: Aerograd
actors: Stepan Sagajda, Sergej Stoljarov, Stepan Shkurat
description: Around 1930, the USSR plans to build a city, Aerograd, in the heart of the Siberian taiga. The construction of the new urban agglomeration is opposed by some retrograde peasants, stirred up by the counter-revolutionary bandit Sabanov and by Japanese agitators. The film, built on a succession of episodes, tells the struggle of the Siberian partisans against these enemies.
notes: While telling a totally different story, Alexandr Dovzenko also exalts the values ??of nature in this film as in his masterpiece, "La terra" (1930), giving them a precise function of primary structural and narrative importance.

title: Bright Light, Big City
actors: Michael J. Fox, Kiefer Sutherland, Phoebe Cates, Swoosie Kurtz
description: "Jamie Conway, abandoned by his wife who is now a supermodel, is a failed writer who works as a corrector of articles. Cracked and addicted to cocaine is also fired; an attempt to reconnect with his wife fails miserably. Brother Michael tries to bring him back. on the right path, but Jamie's only comfort is friendship with Vicki, a cousin of reckless friend Tad.
notes: Based on the novel by the minimalist McInerney, the film cannot be said to be entirely successful, however it offers a glimpse of the Big Apple of the 1980s of some interest. The malaise of an empty generation emerges, albeit with some narrative weakness.

title: Dead of Winter
actors: Mary Steenburgen, Roddy McDowall, Jan Rubes, William Russ
description: Katie is an aspiring actress with no scriptures in sight; when an opportunity presents itself to her, thanks to her resemblance to a missing actress, she does not hesitate to go to the producer's remote villa. He goes around the house in a wheelchair, but Katie soon realizes that everything is a staging and that a dark and deadly plot is unfolding around her. The director of films such as "Little Big Man" and "Night Target" abdicates genre cinema here. The central idea (the actress forced to play a part in reality) is interesting, but nothing more. The impeccability of the form folds in on itself.

title: Don't Raise the Bridge, Lower the River
actors: Jerry Lewis, Jacqueline Pearce, Terry-Thomas, Bernard Cribbins
description: George is a bummer and his wife, tired of his small but repeated domestic accidents, decides to get a divorce. In a final attempt to rehabilitate himself, he transforms the woman's house into a Chinese restaurant after mortgaging her. She wants her money back. Convinced by a friend, George tries to steal the design of an innovative drilling rig from his wife's new boyfriend. Trouble ensues ...
notes: Jerry Lewis's heyday is winding down. Here the great comedian would have to support everything thanks to his art, but a dull script and an awkward direction make it all upset. Lewis does not appear very interested and appears on the set almost by chance.

title: The Net
actors: Sandra Bullock, Jeremy Northam, Diane Baker, Dennis Miller
description: Angela Bennet is an analyst who specializes in eliminating errors and viruses from computer programs. His nights are spent chatting via modem with other Internet enthusiasts. One day the woman comes across a code that gives access to highly confidential databases and so the trouble begins: her data disappear from the archives, no one recognizes it as existing because "it is not on the computer". Bullock moves in a thriller at times exciting, but with big inconsistencies and sudden changes in rhythm.

title: Babe
actors: James Cromwell, Magda Szubanski
description: Babe is a happy pig, just arrived at the taciturn Mr. Hogget's farm, and still oblivious to the fact that humans slaughter animals on holidays. The little pig, who wants to be a sheepdog, talks and sings "Jingle Bells". Beside him are real shepherd dogs, geese, sheep, horses, cats; all respectful of their role. Except Babe, who discovers the value of resourcefulness by challenging fate.
notes: Director and screenwriters, aided by expert trainers who have worked for months with 48 different "Babe", have been able to create a picture full of humor and tenderness on the life of the farm: and they have done so by treating the animals without dolling up, often touching horror of gothic fables. In America "Babe" has become the flag of animal protection leagues. A good example of how to make films that appeal to children but also to adults.

title: Le Hussard sur le toit
actors: Juliette Binoche, Olivier Martinez, Claudio Amendola
description: France 1832. After the Napoleonic wars and the revolutionary uprisings of 1820-21, we are in full restoration. Provence has become a land of asylum for the Piedmontese Carbonari, hunted by the Austrian police and decimated by a cholera epidemic. The brave rebel Angelo Pardo renounces the escape to help his companions, and during the fight against enemies and illness he meets the young aristocrat Pauline. It is love immediately, but the woman, married and in search of her missing husband, will not immediately succumb to passion. Loosely based on the novel by Jean Giono, "The hussar on the roof" confirms Rappenau's profession. Beautiful costumes, unforgettable Provencal landscapes, rhythm, spectacularity and historical facts as the setting for a poignant story of love and heroism. La Binoche is intense and measured; the sex symbol Martinez is as dark as befits a romantic hero.

title: Waiting to Exhale
actors: Whitney Houston, Angela Bassett, Loretta Devine, Lela Rochon
description: Four colored upper-class friends from Phoenix, Arizona; four different ways of experiencing feelings, sexuality, career and family. With a common denominator: the expectation of a man who proves himself to be such and leaves them "breathless". The antidote for not succumbing to the "Prince Charming Syndrome" and the daily struggle with ex-husbands, lovers, sex and work, is to play down; and, if you need help, count only on female solidarity.
notes: Forest Withaker, a directorial debut here, has called with him Withney Houston (also interpreter of the soundtrack) and Angela Bassett to make this sentimental comedy that in reality remains halfway between a soap opera and a commercial.

title: Blue in the Face
actors: Harvey Keitel, Lou Reed, Jim Jarmusch, Lily Tomlin, Mira Sorvino, Madonna, Michael J. Fox
description: At the center of the scene is the corner tobacconist between two streets in Brooklyn, a crossroads of people, problems and obsessions of all kinds. Auggie, while pondering whether to leave the shop to go on his own, observes and listens to everyone: Jim Jarmusch bids farewell to the latest Luky Strike, Lou Reed talks about smoking and its effects, Madonna delivers a sung telegram, Lily Tomlin torments everyone with nostalgia for the "gaufres", Mira Sorvino gets mugged by a black boy ... Everyone is talking and venting to be "blue in the face", out of breath. The idea for this bizarre instant-movie came to Wang and writer Paul Auster as they finished filming their "big brother", "Smoke". The two authors decided to take advantage of more time (a week), contracts and locations at their disposal to create impromptu scenes and dialogues, without a script, leaving practically everything to the inspiration of good, creative and enthusiastic actors. The result is a delightful experimental film, where the protagonists have fun like crazy, and entertain the audience.

title: Mighty Aphrodite
actors: Woody Allen, Mira Sorvino, Helena Bonham Carter, F. Murray Abraham, Michael Rapaport, Olimpia Dukakis, Jack Warden, Peter Weller
description: Lenny, a sports journalist married to Amanda, is persuaded by Amanda to adopt a child. The child, with his intelligence and vivacity, bewitches him to such an extent that he is obsessed with discovering who the real parents are. The research has disconcerting results: the mother is this Judy Orgasm, whose stage name is all a program. The astonished Lenny thus embarks on a strange and mostly platonic relationship with the young porn actress and spare time prostitute, whom he tries to procure a minimum of respectability. At the same time he must keep a restless wife at bay and a strange Greek choir with singing ambitions, which acts as a counterpoint to his decisions.
notes: Paradoxical, unpredictable and self-deprecating, Allen hits the challenge of mixing the usual New York neuroses with the pleasure of staging, even replacing the traditional psychoanalyst's couch with a Greek choir: a risky project that in Allen's hands becomes a masterpiece of balance visual and narrative, humor, comic and cinematic timing. With the revelation of the very nice Mira Sorvino, Oscar winner '96 as Judy Orgasm.

title: Celluloide
actors: Massimo Ghini, Lina Sastri, Giancarlo Giannini, Massimo Dapporto, Anna Falchi
description: June 1944. In the newly liberated Rome Roberto Rossellini and Sergio Amidei decide to shoot, against everything and everyone, a film that tells the real, dramatic events of the Romans under the German occupation: "Rome open city" is about to be born. The difficulties are many, the projects are partly divergent, but the awareness of working on something disruptive unites and involves Anna Magnani, Aldo Fabrizi, the young Fellini and even an American soldier. Returning, by dramatizing it, the birth of a milestone in Italian cinema was a delicate matter, exposed to the risk of trivialization or hagiography. All in all, Lizzani gets along well, limiting himself to documenting facts and atmospheres with honest television-style expertise, between comedy and sketch, without being presumptuous. Instead, Sastri is sinning in the role of Magnani, always over the top and in the end cloying. Much better Giannini, very good and credible in the part of Amidei.

title: La sindrome di Stendhal
actors: Asia Argento, Paolo Bonacelli, Thomas Kretschmann, Marco Leonardi
description: While groups of visitors contemplate the paintings at the Uffizi Museum in Florence, a girl, in front of Bruegel's "Flight of Icarus", faints and falls into a state of hallucination: she suffers from "Stendhal's syndrome", a disorder that occurs right in front of particularly suggestive works of art. Anna is a policewoman and is investigating a series of heinous murders that took place in Rome ...
notes: Dario Argento mixes psychoanalysis with his idea of ??cinema; naturally folding the first to the second. The first half hour of the film is remarkable, with the talented Asia Argento victim of the disturbing power of great painting and the maniacal cruelty of the murderer. Then the weak points of the film begin to be felt, the suspense disappears and sinks into the glossy boredom (photography by Rotunno, music by Morricone).

title: Highlander - The Final Dimension
actors: Christopher Lambert, Mario Van Peebles, Deborah Kara Unger
description: Immortal Scotsman Connor McLeod, in 1995, finally has a family and is successfully integrating into modern life, among mortals. But the tranquility is destroyed by a terrible new enemy: Kane, a black-skinned, bloodthirsty and power-hungry wizard, unwittingly brought back to life by a team of scientists. McLeod must now return to the ancient places where he was born, to rebuild the sword that was broken and to prepare for the fight. Always suspended between fantasy and science fiction, more and more in a video clip style. Christopher Lambert is completely expressionless as usual. It's up to Mario Van Peebles to bear the weight of the film alone. The Celtic-philosophical parts, so important in the first episode, are now just parentheses stuck in a bad way.

title: Stesso mare stessa spiaggia
actors: Margaret Chaplin, Renzo Montagnani, Luciana Turina
description: Summer holidays on the Romagna beach for a small group of slightly shabby young people in the roaring sixties. More than transgressing, they try to kill bathing boredom by resorting to any expedient, but above all by "hunting for foreigners". Predictable string of nonsense passed off as humorous gimmicks. Nostalgic soundtrack and go-go specks.

title: The Secret Life of Walter Mitty
actors: Danny Kaye, Virginia Mayo, Boris Karloff, Florence Bates, Thurston Hall
description: Oppressed and intimidated by an obsessive mother, a young employee of an adventurous literature publishing house indulges in wild daydreams. Until he gets seriously involved in a dangerous adventure. Imaginative, funny and gentle comedy, it quickly became a classic. With a Danny Kaye in top form and a self-deprecating Karloff. From a short story by James Thurber.

title: Invitation to Hell
actors: Robert Urich, Joanna Cassidy, Susan Lucci
description: The myth of Faust revisited and modernized, which transforms the original alchemist into a space scientist and the Mephistopheles, who undermines his soul, into a provocative female (Lucci). Unconvincing TV movie, not up to par with other excellent direction by Wes Craven ("Nightmare").

title: Clean Slate
actors: Dana Carvey, Valeria Golino, James Earl Jones, Kevin Pollak
description: After a car explosion, a private investigator is struck by a serious and unusual discomfort: every time he goes to sleep he forgets the information collected during the day. Helped by his intelligent but one-eyed dog, he must find a precious coin and try to escape the criminal who has already tried to blow it up. He is joined by a mysterious woman, whom he believed dead. Does the subject seem curious and promising to you? Too bad it is practically cloned from "Start over", with Bill Murray, just a year earlier. Apart from that, the whole leaves a lot to be desired. The gags of which the handicapped terrier is the protagonist are saved.

title: Diexue shuangxiong/The Killer
actors: Chow Yun-fat, Sally Yeh, Danny Lee, Kenneth Tsang
description: Frank (Yee Fan-Wei) is a hit man, perhaps the best in his field, who accidentally blinded the woman he is in love with, singer Jenny (Sally Yeh). He accepts what should be his last job before retiring and devoting himself entirely to his beloved, but the gangsters who hired him betray him. To get revenge on them, Frank teams up with the policeman who has been hunting them for some time.
notes: Action thriller produced in Hong Kong, written and directed with extraordinary creative energy by the undisputed master of this genre, John Woo. Explosive action scenes, powerful melodramatic implications, excellent character design.

title: Beverly Hills Cop III
actors: Eddie Murphy, Judge Reinhold, Hector Elizondo, Theresa Randle
description: In his third mission in California, the "colored" Alex Foley, a Detroit cop, has to contend with a gang of forgers who have killed his boss and who have their headquarters in a colossal amusement park, the Wonder World. When the tightrope walker of the law finds himself circling among the entertainment facilities ...
notes: Although this time there is John Landis in the direction (as for "A chair for two" and "The prince seeks a wife", again with Eddie Murphy), the third chapter of Alex Foley's ridiculous-cop adventures is now out of breath.

title: The Priest
actors: Linus Roache, Tom Wilkinson, Cathy Tyson, Robert Carlyle
description: The desolate suburbs of Liverpool. A parish priest, Father Matthew, "left". A young curate, Father Gray, who does not share the ideas of his superior. The parent of a child who sexually abuses her daughter and has no intention of giving up her foul practices. And Father Gray also has his own big personal problem: he's homosexual, and he gets caught in. flagrant. The director goes down hard, but in reality she is more of a crude scandal than anything else. Only the look on a Liverpool devastated by Thatcherism is saved.

title: Apocalypse Now
actors: Marlon Brando, Martin Sheen, Robert Duvall, Frederic Forrest, Sam Bottoms, Laurence Fishburne, Albert Hall, Harrison Ford, Dennis Hopper, G.D. Spradlin, Jerry Ziesmer, Scott Glenn, Bo Byers, James Keane, Kerry Rossall, Colleen Camp, Cynthia Wood
description: Kurtz, a colonel in the US Army in Vietnam has dropped out of line, crossed into Cambodia with his men and built a sort of personal empire where he fights his own ferocious private war. Captain Willard is entrusted with the mission of reaching Kurtz in his territory and eliminating him. It will be a terrible journey, punctuated by pitfalls and, even more, poisoned by multiple horrors. Coppola transposes Joseph Conrad's "Heart of Darkness" into the intricate, filthy worm of the Vietnam War, making a formidable war film that is, also and above all, a shocking journey into the murky abysses of human consciousness.

title: Rampage
actors: Michael Biehn, Alex McArthur, Nicholas Campbell, Deborah Van Valkenburg
description: Six heinous crimes shock a California town. The young prosecutor Tony Fraser, who is entrusted with the case, captures without much difficulty the serial killer who claims to have killed in order to purify himself by drinking the blood of the victims. He is naturally declared insane. The trial becomes the occasion for an excavation of self-awareness by the prosecutor, who wants the death of the accused.
notes: Crude and politically incorrect (Friedkin re-edited it because, from being opposed to the death penalty, he had become favorable), one of Friedkin's harshest films, with nihilistic features, without concessions.

title: Palermo-Milano solo andata
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Raoul Bova, Ricky Memphis, Romina Mondello, Stefania Sandrelli, Valerio Mastandrea, Francesco Benigno, Rosalinda Celentano
description: An unsuspected accountant of the mafia must be escorted from Palermo to Milan by five young inexperienced policemen, who face a predictable massacre ...
notes: Under _Piovra_ already ready for TV, with characters and scenarios are unlikely, and a not particularly engaging plot.

title: Heat
actors: Al Pacino, Robert De Niro, Val Kilmer, Jon Voight, Tom Sizemore, Diane Venora, Amy Brenneman, Ashley Judd, Natalie Portman, Dennis Haysbert, Wes Studi, Mykelti Williamson, Ted Levine, Danny Trejo
description: A crime professional, Neil McCauley (De Niro), manages to get out of any situation in less than thirty seconds. His gang, made up of three weak and violent robbers. A cop-hound, Vincent Hanna (Pacino), failed in his feelings and relentless in his profession. When McCauley and his companions attack and rob an armored car killing three agents, the cop goes after them and manages to identify them. By now he knows everything about them; it's just a matter of framing them. A long and tense game between cat and mouse begins in preparation for the dramatic final confrontation. Pacino and De Niro face to face for the first time: hunter and prey in a hide and seek game during which a strange instinctive bond grows between the two. One hundred and seventy minutes of deep and detailed tension, eyes and stories that tell each other a common desperate precariousness. Up to transforming a classic cinematic challenge into a very sad, exhausted, disillusioned human fresco.

title: Va' dove ti porta il cuore
actors: Virna Lisi, Margherita Buy, Massimo Ghini, Galatea Ranzi
description: Olga, elderly, addresses her sentimental will to her granddaughter Anna, retracing the stages of a difficult and contradictory maturation; to spare the girl at least the "breakdowns" that complicated her life. Growing up in a family that accustomed her to repressing emotions, Olga married, for convenience, an ordinary man. The one true love of his life, a doctor he met on vacation, died in a car accident. Susanna Tamaro's successful best seller has become a mediocre film: the film adaptation, of a story in itself elementary, is slow, heavy, suffocated by literature.

title: Father of the Bride Part II
actors: Steve Martin, Diane Keaton, Martin Short, Kimberly Williams
description: Having overcome the "trauma" of his daughter Annie's marriage ("Father of the Bride" # 1), George Banks is calm and happy again, enjoying this serenity next to his wife Nina. But new surprises await him around the corner. First, Annie announces that she is expecting a baby. But the beauty is that, just as George is adapting to the idea of ??becoming a grandfather, Nina has a surprise for him: she too is pregnant! So George now has to digest two new roles: precocious grandfather and late father. To frame his confusion there are the usual, daring preparations for the double celebration. The gap between Vincente Minnelli's films ("Dad becomes a grandfather" and the first "father of the bride") and this is evident. There is the craft and also a certain good taste, but the flavor of the original is missing. 1995 Families Acting Like 1950's Are Grotesque; certain upheavals nowadays appear excessive. Although Steve Martin and Diane Keaton, always nice, joke about it and seem to enjoy what they do.

title: Er Più. Storia d'amore e di coltello
actors: Adriano Celentano, Maurizio Arena, Claudia Mori, Fiorenzo Fiorentini
description: In 1900 Rome, Nino Petroni, a fishmonger nicknamed Er Più, gets out of prison and is welcomed into his neighborhood like a king. He has to deal with a police confidant and another boss who bullies and woos Rosa, his girlfriend. The whirlwinds that the two exchange are a prelude to a rustic duel; but the matter is resolved by a third-party pistol shot.
notes: There are dead and wounded in this film, but Celentano's personality - Er Più - brings him back to comedy atmospheres and slips into the picturesque and local color. His rival Maurizio Arena is more sober, who takes himself more seriously: however the show is well thought out and there is the atmosphere of the time.

title: I corvi ti scaveranno la fossa
actors: Craig Hill, Fernando Sancho, Dominique Boschero
description: A transport company hires a bounty hunter and some gunslingers to defend itself from bandit raids. One of these, Jack Sullivan, also has a personal revenge to do: the criminal Glenn Kovacks has in fact murdered his wife ...
notes: Conventional and rather poor Western spaghetti.

title: Giovani e belli
actors: Anna Falchi, Luca Venantini, Edoardo Scatà, Carlo Croccolo
description: Zorilla, a beautiful gypsy and thief, makes two friends from different families who share the same fate fall in love with herself: Luca is a student, the scion of a family well overwhelmed by tangentopoli; Gino is a young dreamer, the son of proletarians. Zorilla first robs them, then looks for them, finally conquers them. A strange bond of affection arises between the three. The two boys are totally subjugated by the charm of the beautiful gypsy, who first runs away with one, then changes her mind and wants the other, then abandons both of them and goes away ... It's not a remake of "Poveri ma beautiful ", but it is undeniable that the Falchi with its generous (and generously displayed) curves alludes to the oversized Allasio type. There are some funny ideas and some illustrious participation such as Ciccio Ingrassia, Carlo Croccolo, Venantino Venantini and Gina Rovere. But overall the film is somewhat superficial and a little too "feel-good".

title: Jane Eyre
actors: Charlotte Gainsbourg, William Hurt, Anna Paquin, Elle Macpherson
description: Orphaned and poor, Jane Eyre spends her childhood with a cruel aunt and her youth in an institution with a treacherous headmaster who hates her. She grows up closed, used to unhappiness, but also very proud and sensitive. She finally finds a job as a governess in an imposing country house owned by the mysterious Mr. Rochester. Jane, who is neither beautiful nor lively, falls in love with this sad man who seems to be hiding some dark secret. Classic nineteenth-century novel about unhappiness defeated by a tormented love, with a plot in strong colors, suggestive scenarios and twists. From the work of Charlotte Brontë Franco Zeffirelli distills the sentimental essence, focusing on the effect passages (the death of Jane's friend, the madness of Mr. Rochester's wife, the agony of the bad aunt, the fire of the castle) .

title: Desperado
actors: Antonio Banderas, Salma Hayek, Quentin Tarantino, Joaquim De Almeida, Steve Buscemi
description: The mariachi is a somewhat peculiar gunslinger who goes around with guns and guitar and clashes with an infamous criminal linked to Mexican drug bosses, Bucho. With the help of his best friend and an attractive girl, he manages to emerge victorious from the fight. Creating his own handful of "desperados" and leaving behind a trail of bullets and blood.
notes: After "El Mariachi" in 1992, shot by Rodriguez with little money and a lot of inventiveness, in 1995 comes "Desperado", which, however, is a remake more than a sequel: with a more substantial budget, brighter colors, more famous actors; but also, unfortunately, a much more obvious trend. Have fun, drag, but it's already seen stuff.

title: The American President
actors: Michael Douglas, Annette Bening, Martin Sheen, Michael J. Fox
description: A hypothetical president of the United States, a Democrat, a Clintonite, and above all a widower, falls in love with a fascinating environmentalist. But for the mayor of a superpower, managing an innocent love affair is almost more difficult than keeping the state secret ... An appointment, a gallant dinner, a bouquet of flowers to send, become arduous undertakings, with the mass media always ambush.
notes: The romantic comedy works, even if it is not articulated in all its shades: it almost seems that in the end Reiner does not leave much room for his usual wit. Although Bening does not possess the talent and energy of the holy monsters she harks back to (Katharine Hepburn, Jean Arthur), she figures better than Douglas.

title: L'ira di Dio
actors: Montgomery Ford, Dana Ghia, Fernando Sancho, Howard Ross, Wayde Preston
description: The film tells the terrible revenge of Mike Barnett who stole everything and killed his girlfriend as well. He may have his reasons, but what does it matter to us?

title: Orazi e Curiazi
actors: Alan Ladd, Franca Bettoja, Franco Fabrizi, Robert Keith, Jacques Sernas
description: The war between the Romans and the Albans, which has been going on for years with great mourning on both sides, will be resolved with a clash of six of the most valiant fighters of the two sides, three on each side. The episode is historic and is probably the first play-off case in history. But the direction of Ferdinando Baldi is so poor that it removes any attraction from the event.

title: Questa è la vita
directors: Giorgio Pàstina, Mario Soldati, Luigi Zampa, Aldo Fabrizi
actors: Totò, Aldo Fabrizi, Lucia Bosé, Myriam Bru, Walter Chiari
description: Four-episode film based on Pirandello's short stories. In _La giara_ a walking umbrella maker, after having repaired a jar, remains locked inside. In _Il Ventaglino_ a young woman without work and without a home asks for charity in a park. In _La patente_ a father of a family with a reputation as a jinx obtains a document from the court that proves his condition. In _Marsina narrow_ an old professor invited to the wedding of one of his very poor ex-pupils, borrowed a tailcoat.
notes: _La giara_ is undoubtedly the most famous story, but what remains in the mind is _La patente_, with Totò a true protagonist.

title: Il cielo è sempre più blu
actors: Asia Argento, Luca Barbareschi, Margherita Buy, Roberto Citran, Monica Bellucci, Giulio Scarpati, Ivano Marescotti, Gigio Alberti
description: The daylight fades in the sky and on the terraces of Rome. And it is immediately evening, indeed night. A man does gymnastics and contemplates the void; three young men rob a restaurant; a dentist talks about financial strategies. At dawn the city wakes up and the traffic, the voices, the office and street life begin again. The robbers try to sell the stolen goods; a reporter tries to write her article; four masons argue. A birthday party, a seduction, a heart attack, a taxi driver, two policemen, a killer: many fates touch each other in the space of twenty-four hours, without recognizing each other. Grimaldi orchestrates this small metropolitan symphony formed by a constellation of characters in constant expansion. The choral dimension is used as a sort of family album of Italian cinema of the Eighties and Nineties, which would seem to collect the incipits of thirty or more virtual screenplays.

title: Species
actors: Ben Kingsley, Forest Whitaker, Natasha Henstridge, Michael Madsen, Alfred Molina, Marg Helgenberger, Michelle Williams
description: Twenty years have passed since a radio telescope sent information about the Earth and the DNA of human cells into space. From an unknown elsewhere a DNA sequence arrives in a terrestrial laboratory with instructions for combining it with the human one. A presumptuous scientist attempts the experiment: the result is a female creature that grows with monstrous speed. The beautiful girl is actually a hideous alien, who escapes to Los Angeles and from there prepares the extraterrestrial invasion.
notes: Genre films but with a solid structure, with a balanced cast and effective special effects without being confusing.

title: David Holzman's Diary
actors: L. M. Kit Carson, Eileen Dietz, Lorenzo Mans, Louise Levine
description: Eight days (between 14 and 21 July 1967) in the life of aspiring director David Holzman, between the neighbor being spied through the window, the death of his uncle and the theft of all his equipment. Curious and funny episode of cinema-truth curated by the then newcomer Jim McBride ("Last breath", "Great Balls of Fire").

title: Nothing Personal
actors: Ian Hart, John Lynch, Maria Doyle Kennedy, James Frain
description: We are in the mid-1970s and Northern Ireland is experiencing one of its hottest times. An IRA bomb just went off in a crowded beer hall. A Protestant paramilitary group is trying to negotiate a truce with Catholic opponents. Meanwhile, he tries to reflect on the role of violence in his actions and on his own structure, similar to a regular army.
notes: "Nothing personal" is what one of the Protestant loyalists says to a former Catholic friend as he tortures him. A tormented, passionate film, also courageous in telling a violence with no ends and no redemption on both sides. However, especially in the second part, it falls into an excessive schematism that ends up flattening the narrative.

title: Gli schiavi più forti del mondo
actors: Roger Browne, Scilla Gabel, Giacomo Rossi Stuart
description: Sent as punishment to a distant African province, the Roman tribune Marco Aulo becomes the champion of the rights of slaves and thus enters into conflict with the perfidious centurion Gaius. Technicolor, cinemascope, two or three strong men, the beautiful Gabel and zero ideas. In the role of the evil Gaius is the father of Kim Rossi Stuart.

title: Souvenir d'Italie
actors: Vittorio De Sica, Alberto Sordi, Massimo Girotti, Gabriele Ferzetti
description: Three foreign hitchhikers travel around Italy visiting cities and collecting dazzling but fleeting flirts. After many adventures, the girls only have to return to their country of origin.
notes: Pietrangeli's third film, which cuts out small but relevant roles for De Sica, Sordi and Dario Fo.

title: Two Much
actors: Antonio Banderas, Melanie Griffith, Daryl Hannah, Danny Aiello, Eli Wallach
description: Art, a failed and unfortunate painter even as the manager of an art gallery, meets Betty, a "loose cannon" with the hobby of marriage: the young woman is looking for her third husband and now decides to have found him. Art is convinced by Betty's impetuousness, but problems arise when he meets her sister, Liz, a sensitive, sweet and much more charming creature. After unsuccessfully trying to postpone the marriage, Art devises a solution: he invents a twin brother, disheveled and seductive, who ...
notes: Comedy of misunderstandings exploited with a skilful and light hand. Trueba also skilfully curated the script, which in fact has a lively and crackling rhythm. The film is brilliant and the actors defend themselves well. Impeccable choice of secondary roles.

title: Cutthroat Island
actors: Geena Davis, Matthew Modine, Frank Langella, Maury Chaykin
description: Morgan is the beautiful and daring daughter of a pirate, a worthy follower of her father's footsteps. At a slave auction he buys William, a charming adventurer, with whom he sets out in search of a secret treasure buried on Cutthroad Island. The treasure map, however, is partly found on the shaved head of an old pirate, while another piece is in the possession of a dangerous filibuster. Between duels, deceptions, chases, there will also be time for love to blossom.
notes: Renny Harlin ("Cliffhanger", "Die Hard 2") stages spectacular adventures to the glory of his wife Geena Davis, with great special effects and a subtle ironic streak in the most daring stunts. However, the skirmishes are taken for granted, as is the end of the game. Pleasant for lovers of the genre and for Davis fans.

title: Visioni private
actors: Jessica Forde, Patrick Bauchau, Anthony Caldarella, Antonio Alveario, Peter Berling, Maurizio Puglisi, Donald Ranvaud, Nathalie Raiman
description: Virginia is convinced that producer Petronio will choose her for the lead role in his new film. This does not happen and Petronius is found dead. Boris, Virginia's boyfriend, is suspicious of the girl. Shot during the 1988 Taormina Festival by six hands (the critic Donald Ranvaud, the director Francesco Calogero, the actor Ninni Bruschetta), it is little more than a nice backstage divertissement, with various appearances (from Tatti Sanguineti to Cyd Charisse !).

title: Jumanji
actors: Robin Williams, Kirsten Dunst, Bradley Pierce, Bonnie Hunt
description: Jumanji is a magical board game of ancient origin. Its peculiarity is that when someone starts it, their whole life is invaded until the game comes to an end: however, few have finished one, and even fewer have started a second. In 1969, Alan and Sarah come across the game and roll the dice: Alan is sucked into the surreal world of Jumanji and remains trapped there for twenty-six years. When he finally breaks free, he has to find Sarah for the game to be over ...
notes: Johnston is truly a magician in handling special effects: it is a pity that the same cannot be said of his skills as a director.

title: Vite strozzate
actors: Sabrina Ferilli, Vincent Lindon, Luca Zingaretti, Ricky Memphis, Lina Sastri, Violante Placido
description: The respectable accountant Sergio is actually a ruthless money lender. Those who cannot repay the disproportionate interest that they apply are forced to sell all their assets to a company run by the widow of a Camorra. In this way, dirty money is also laundered. One day, in Sergio's life, Francesco reappears, an old friend of the past, now in ruins due to a series of financial difficulties. Francesco would be in dire need of a loan to try to relieve his situation; but the banks refuse him.
notes: The Luciferian character of Zingaretti ends up eating the film, which is not particularly exciting despite the emphasis of Morricone's direction and music. From a subject of the Taurisano magistrate.

title: Dangerous Minds
actors: Michelle Pfeiffer, George Dzundza, Courtney B. Vance, Robin Bartlett
description: LouAnne Johnson quits her arms to devote herself to teaching literature. They assign her a class of young people who are maladjusted and therefore not very motivated to study. LouAnne understands how much they really need understanding and communication. To motivate them, it leads them to feel the beauty of poetry, opening their minds and hearts.
notes: Inspired by a true story, it is a cliched and stereotyped film. Criticism of the oppressive and short-sighted school system has been exploited with better results. Pfeiffer does what she can.

title: Storie d'amore con i crampi
actors: Sergio Rubini, Chiara Caselli, Debora Caprioglio, Pino Quartullo, Rossella Falk
description: Roberto and Marcella break up. But for a little while: the girl chases him to Africa, where he is on vacation with someone else; to make him jealous he brings a "companion for a fee", who after so much wandering would like to be something more than a travel companion ... Then there are Alessia and Francesco, who seem to be able to fall in love. But then they break up, they get lost for a year, and in the end they find each other again ... Nothing is destroyed, everything is combined. Love affairs get tangled up and couple bonds don't necessarily end: they just have cramps. Pino Quartullo, who is in his third film here, is becoming a specialist in comedies on the hardships of the Italian couple. Here he tries to reproduce certain ideas of brilliant American cinema, on an African postcard background. In part, the enterprise was successful; it is a pity that the quartet of actors is "agitated" a little more than necessary.

title: Adios Gringo
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Evelyn Stewart, Robert Camardiel, Jesus Puente
description: While chasing a man by whom he has been scammed, Brent finds a tortured and tied up girl on his path. He takes her to the nearest doctor, but is suspected of being a dangerous criminal. Brent tries to leave together with the girl he saved, but the matter becomes even more complicated, until the final shooting that solves (almost) all the problems for the best.
notes: Giorgio Stegani, aka George Finley, directs this co-production with his foot pressed on the pedal of violence and, apart from this, he doesn't show that he has many other ideas. In short, a spaghetti-western among many and certainly not the best.

title: Dracula: Dead and Loving It
actors: Leslie Nielsen, Peter MacNicol, Mel Brooks, Amy Yasbeck, Steven Weber, Lysette Anthony, Harvey Korman
description: In 1893 the famous vampire (Nielsen) infiltrated London high society, and Dr. Van Helsing (Brooks) tries to expose him. Although the doctor is on his trail, Dracula manages to vampirize Mina, a beautiful and repressed young woman who turns into a sex bomb after the fateful bite. Then it's Lucy's turn, who ends up with a stake in her heart. The decisive confrontation between Dracula and Van Helsing, in a ruined chapel, will irremediably change British high society.
notes: Mel Brooks had to foresee the inevitable confrontation not only with "Dracula" but also with his own masterpiece "Frankenstein Junior": and from the comparison he comes out rather battered. "Dracula - Dead and happy" is nothing more than a series of jokes, quite crude, on the theme of vampires. Cameo by Anne Bancroft and Ezio Greggio.

title: Get Shorty
actors: Danny DeVito, John Travolta, Rene Russo, Gene Hackman, Dennis Farina, Delroy Lindo, James Gandolfini, Jon Gries, Renee Props, David Paymer, Martin Ferrero, Miguel Sandoval
description: Chili Palmer is a debt collector for Miami loan sharks. He is sent to Los Angeles to collect the debt of film producer Harry Zimm, and the life of the two takes a turn: instead of breaking Harry's legs, Chili, who is a film buff, proposes the subject for a film. The two get together: the idea is provided by Chili, the capital is put by Harry by deducting it from his debts (with some "discreet" help from his friend). It's about finding the star and dribbling those who want to interfere with their projects. And Chili discovers how his past career can be useful in the cinema ...
notes: De Vito also produced "Pulp Fiction", and some analogies can be seen in the striking jokes and unexpected solutions. Travolta is always nice, Gene Hackman is irresistible, and the supporting roles are very tasty, the script is valuable. While perhaps it is the direction that does not completely keep the pace.

title: Gorilla Bathes at Noon
actors: Svetozar Cvetkovic, Anita Mancic, Alexandra Rohmig
description: Russian Major Victor Borisovic, stationed in Berlin with the occupation troops, is left behind by his company, but refuses to go home. Dusan Makavejev, back light and irreverent as in the good old days, revisits the myth of the USSR with sharp irony.

title: Innocenza e turbamento
actors: Edwige Fenech, Vittorio Caprioli, Lionel Stander, Roberto Cenci, Anna Maria Pescatori
description: Tonino comes away from the seminary to reflect well on the decision to take the cassock. At home he finds his new stepmother and, as if by magic, his ideas clear up. Strange title. To feel upset with this film you must have spent the last forty years on Sing Sing. From the parts of "Malizia", ??but without a shadow of eroticism.

title: New Jack City
actors: Ice T, Wesley Snipes, Chris Rock, Mario Van Peebles
description: Black gangster Nino has set up a lucrative crack trade. Scotty and Nick, two cops, want to frame him, but their infiltrator is discovered. The two agents are relieved of their duties, but the investigation continues in private. This time they manage to take the boss to court. He manages to get a mild sentence but is then "executed" by an old black patriarch of the neighborhood. Van Peebles addresses the issue of drugs and black marginalization with one eye (sincere) on civil denunciation and the other on entertainment. The result is appreciable.

title: Split Decisions
actors: Craig Sheffer, Gene Hackman, Jennifer Beals, Jeff Fahey
description: Ray and Eddie are the last offspring of a family with ancient boxing traditions. Ray is a professional, while Eddie still plays amateurs and has good chances for the upcoming Olympics. Things go wrong when Ray, urged to pay for a rigged match, refuses to accept. He will die; Eddie will avenge him in the ring by giving up the Olympics and then quitting boxing forever.
notes: "Sporty" meatloaf, which rehashs without the slightest cliché fantasy, environments and characters as old as cinema. Everything is fine, even laundering unemployed Jennifer Beals, but what is Gene Hackman doing in a movie like this?

title: Family of Cops
actors: Charles Bronson, Daniel Baldwin, Lesley-Anne Down, Angela Featherstone
