description: Police Inspector Paul Fein has four children: two sons, Ben and Eddie, are policemen; of the daughters, Kate is a lawyer, while Jackie is the black sheep of the group, restless and isolated from the family. She is involved in the murder of a very rich man and then arrested. The compact family works to prove his innocence; happy ending, with obligatory reconciliation for all. Bronson ages but does not give up, even if the gritty of his character has to deal with the limits of age. Genre films without particular signs.

title: Beau Brummell
actors: Stewart Granger, Peter Ustinov, Elizabeth Taylor, Robert Morley
description: The young George Brummel is an elegant gentleman who, in early nineteenth-century London, stands out in royal circles for his independent spirit and witty manners. Taken in favor of the Prince of Wales, he becomes his best friend. But when, due to court intrigues, Brummell and the prince quarrel, the former goes off to France, where he ends up living in hardship.
notes: Shot with a great profusion of media, with sumptuous sets and dazzling photography, it is the typical historical Hollywood romance. And it's not bad, especially thanks to an amazing Ustinov in the role of the Prince of Wales and the elegance of Granger.

title: Tarzan, the Ape Man
actors: Johnny Weissmuller, Maureen O'Sullivan, Neil Hamilton
description: Jane Parker has reached her father in Africa who, at the head of an expedition, wants to discover the elephant cemetery. The woman is kidnapped by Tarzan, falls in love with him, but is unable to make friends with his fellow countrymen. Tarzan saves the explorers from a pygmy attack. Jane's father finally discovers the elephant graveyard and then dies. Jane then decides to stay in Africa with Tarzan.
notes: First film version of the famous character, played by swimming champion John Weissmuller. Fidelity to the original novel is weak, but the show is guaranteed; it is the birth certificate of one of the most fortunate myths of cinema.

title: One Foot in Hell
actors: Alan Ladd, Dan O'Herlihy, Don Murray, Dolores Michaels
description: Mitch Barret tried to treat his seriously ill wife, but the village pharmacist denied him a medicine that Mitch didn't have the money to pay, and the woman died. At this point, a sense of revenge against everything and everyone is triggered in the protagonist, which will lead him to become a ferocious criminal. The accurate setting and the presence of Ladd guarantee an average product

title: Sabrina
actors: Harrison Ford, Julia Ormond, Greg Kinnear, Fanny Ardant, Nancy Marchand
description: Sabrina, daughter of the chauffeur of the very wealthy Larrabee family, grows unhappily in love with David, who doesn't even notice her. Sent to Paris to heal from lovesickness, she returns to Long Island after two years transformed into a woman of class. And it wreaks havoc on the Larrabee clan when David falls in love with her and decides to screw up her previous, very convenient engagement.
notes: Remake of the caustic fairy tale filmed in 1954 by Wilder. However, Audrey Hepburn was and remains inimitable. The commitment of Pollack and a not indecent protagonist couple are in vain.

title: Italiani
actors: Giulio Scarpati, Giuliana De Sio, Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Vanessa Gravina
description: In the mid-1960s, in August, a train leaves Palermo for Milan. Its passengers are for the most part emigrants, each of whom carries its load of experiences and hopes towards the North of the economic boom. There is the pregnant girl who runs away, the priest who helps her, the industrialist with his young lover, the aspiring novelist looking for a publisher ... So many lives intertwine and are destined to meet again, on the same train but in the opposite direction, almost thirty years later. "Italiani" wants to be a choral comedy built around the idea of ??"flash-forward". Unfortunately, the gimmick ends in a heavy accentuation of style and scholastic development. And the screenplay, full of populist clichés and conventions of the most obvious Italian comedy, does not help the actors, who are unable to give depth to the characters.

title: Strange Days
actors: Ralph Fiennes, Angela Bassett, Juliette Lewis, Tom Sizemore
description: Los Angeles, December 31, 1999. Racial and social tensions are reaching their limits. The new drug is the squid, a vector of artificial memory: a kind of cd player allows you to relive your own experiences or those of others in the most realistic way. Lenny Nero is one of the highest rated squid dealers. Coming into possession of a disk with evidence of the murder of a black leader by white cops, Lenny must decide whether to go public with what he knows.
notes: The talented Bigelow talks about a livid and disturbing world, in which tension is photographed, not invented; and evil arises from our real impulses, from a desire for emotions that overcomes voyeurism to become an unbridled appropriation of experience. The final sequence, on the party at the end of the millennium, has a remarkable visual power.

title: Sense and Sensibility
actors: Emma Thompson, Hugh Grant, Kate Winslet, Alan Rickman, Imelda Staunton, Gemma Jones
description: Elinor and Marianne are two sisters belonging to the poor branch of the Dashwood family. The first, proud and reserved, tries to keep the family going while she has to suppress her love for Edward, a rich relative. The second, more romantic and instinctive, indulges in passion without hesitation. A sense of duty prevents Elinor from fulfilling herself sentimentally, while Marianne's passion exposes her to deceptions.
notes: Emma Thompson once more proves her intelligence, and is pleased by it: her screenplay is a beautiful job, capable of drawing the salient features and the sharpest points of criticism of Anglo-Saxon society from Jane Austen's novel. But the script, in the hands of Ang Lee, acquires an excessive smoothness, to the point of being affected by "Ivoryan" echoes that make development lose sincerity.

title: Leaving Las Vegas
actors: Nicolas Cage, Elisabeth Shue, Julian Sands
description: Ben is a failed screenwriter, a slave to drinking. In Las Vegas he meets Sara, a prostitute who immediately feels sympathy for him. The two quickly fall in love. But he is now devoted to self-destruction.
notes: Mistaken by American critics for a masterpiece, "Away from Las Vegas" was actually overrated. The story doesn't have many possibilities for development, but the alcoholic character always works, without requiring great acting skills (even if Cage is good, and he won an Oscar for this performance). The direction of Figgis is marked by his advertising training, all detachments and colors, with incessant music. Well done Elisabeth Shue who had a nomination for best actress.

title: Fluke
actors: Matthew Modine, Eric Stoltz, Nancy Travis, Colin Willcox, Max Pomeranc
description: A car accident prematurely kills the life of a young man. The poor man is reincarnated in Fluke, a mutt with a tawny fur. Now it is a question of finding the widow and the orphan and of communicating with them. Difficult undertaking: only the boy immediately accepts the truth; the mother, on the other hand, considers the dog's behavior simply bizarre, which, among other things, proves jealous towards the friend who is "comforting" her ...
notes: Bittersweet and slightly puerile tale for cinephiles and children: a cascade of molasses played on the dog's sympathy and good feelings, with a spot montage, many "four-legged" shots and discreet special effects.

title: Dead Man Walking
actors: Susan Sarandon, Sean Penn, Robert Prosky, Raymond J. Barry, R. Lee Ermey, Lois Smith, Scott Wilson, Roberta Maxwell, Margo Martindale, Celia Weston, Kevin Cooney, Clancy Brown, Adele Robbins, Jack Black
description: Dead man walking is the cry with which the guards accompany the condemned to the execution room. Matthew, accused of rape and murder, is waiting to hear those terrible words, and asks for help from Helen, a lay Catholic nun, who accepts, not without perplexity, the very difficult role of spiritual assistant of the condemned. The search for a truth that redeems instead of raging on the condemned gives Helen the clarity to reconcile the sense of pity and that of justice and Matthew the strength to sincerely repent.
notes: The film shows that no type of death is fair: neither that of the victims nor that of the culprit. Unusually controlled direction, great play of actors. Oscar for Susan Sarandon.

title: Othello
actors: Laurence Fishburne, Irène Jacob, Kenneth Branagh, Nathaniel Parker, Gabriele Ferzetti
description: The union of Othello and Desdemona brings with it pain and death instead of joy and celebration. Iago spies on them and plots against them, insinuating the germ of jealousy in the proud Moro: wickedly suggesting the idea that Desdemona secretly loves Cassio, chosen as lieutenant in place of Iago himself. Othello is blinded by suspicion, which slowly, always stirred up by Iago, turns into stubborn conviction. Passion gives way only to revenge and tragedy. Shakespeare and his play return for the umpteenth time in a film adaptation. This of Oliver Parker (actor and theater director, in his first feature film for the cinema) wants to be particularly attentive to the atmosphere, emotional shocks and erotic charge. Nothing to do with Welles and Laurence Olivier.

title: Uomini senza donne
actors: Alessandro Gassmann, Gian Marco Tognazzi, Alessandra Acciai, Veronica Logan
description: Alex is a copywriter in an advertising agency. He is handsome, athletic, and surrounded by a bevy of girls in love with him; but he has eyes only for Eleonora, who instead denies him. Max plays the saxophone, is shy, drinks beer, smokes cigars and marijuana. What unites them in any case is unhappiness in relationships with the other sex.
notes: Taken from the play of the same name staged by Longoni in the 1993-94 season, "Men without women" tries to portray a generation, with its behavioral and emotional weaknesses. Without being able to draw attention to either one or the other. The two main interpreters reproduce, updating them, some of the character notes of their respective fathers. But with much lower outcomes.

title: Nelly & Monsieur Arnaud
actors: Michel Serrault, Emmanuelle Béart, Jean-Hugues Anglade, Charles Berling
description: In a Paris bar Nelly, twenty-five years old in a marriage crisis, meets Mr. Arnaud, an elderly ex magistrate who is writing his memoirs. Nelly agrees to be his typist. During the intense days of work at Mr. Arnaud's home, an increasingly deep relationship of understanding is established between the two. The only but profound element of disturbance is the love affair that arises between Nelly and the publisher Vincent. Sautet is a master of refined, nuanced cinema: like his two protagonists, who slowly get to know each other, talk to each other, choose each other. And slowly the maturation of an atypical relationship made of confidence, complicity and tenderness, without sex, makes its way.

title: The Outfit
actors: Robert Duvall, Karen Black, Robert Ryan, Joe Don Baker
description: Gangster Harly Macklin finally gets out of jail and, with the help of his woman Betty, wages war against rivals who killed his brother. But he too runs the risk of being exactly like his brother.
notes: The usual gangster film that offers many events, but which wastes them by relying on a poor narrative rhythm. To be enjoyed, however, the many excellent character actors who animate the characters.

title: Mr. Holland's Opus
actors: Richard Dreyfuss, Glenne Headly, Olympia Dukakis, William H. Macy
description: From 1965 to 1995 the story of Glenn Holland, a music lover who believed he had the vocation and talent of a composer. Throughout his life he has to accept many disappointments, including his son's deafness, and understands that his destiny is not so much at the piano as at the blackboard: his career is in fact fulfilled as a music teacher. Easy melancholy and a great search for tears, with Dreyfuss reduced to trying to make an obvious character credible. A sort of "fleeting moment" in a tear-jerking version, cloying and shot with sloppiness.

title: City Hall
actors: Al Pacino, Bridget Fonda, John Cusack, Danny Aiello, Martin Landau
description: John Pappas and Kevin Kalhoun are Mayor and Deputy Mayor of New York, respectively. If for the second good and bad are clearly lined up on opposite sides of a barricade, for the first the boundaries are much more blurred and the contaminations much easier. However, they form a close-knit duet, which manages the city efficiently. Everything suggests a fortunate rise of Pappas to the top of US politics. But the balance is upset due to an "accident" between the mafia and the police, which brings back past scandals and old compromises. Before his name is involved, the mayor resigns from office.
notes: First case of film production authorized to shoot inside the New York City Hall building. The classic game of politics takes on thriller cadences, with a nice tense pace, a slap-up script, a no-nonsense direction and the charge of Al Pacino. The figure of the mayor is inspired by Ed Koch, Fiorello La Guardia, Rudolph Giuliani, and the former Governor Mario Cuomo.

title: Silenzio si nasce
actors: Sergio Castellitto, Paolo Rossi, Filippa Lagerback, Ermanno Vaglietti
description: In a womb, two heterozygous twins are waiting to come into the world. The Small, frightened and curious, and the Strong, overbearing and impulsive, make hypotheses about what the external environment may be, based on the information that reaches them from outside. During a nine-month preparation, the two must begin to imagine and assimilate the basic rules of coexistence. The interior of the uterine cavity, imagined as a hairy and dark cavern, is the background to uninterrupted dialogues. So the more or less positive moments (a little fun but also a little boredom) alternate. Castellitto takes the part better, while Rossi struggling with non-cabaret structures loses immediacy.

title: Grosse fatigue
actors: Michel Blanc, Carole Bouquet, Philippe Noiret, Josiane Balasko
description: Actor Michel Blanc, in the film directed by Michel Blanc, is having a bad time: he is tired from too much work and, moreover, he is suspected of deeds that he does not remember having done. The beautiful Carole Bouquet consoles him (in the role of the splendid Carole Bouquet), but when the "case" seems solved, the mess of a double Philippe Noiret arises. The idea is far from original. But it must be said that Michel Blanc works on it with skill and, thanks to himself and his colleagues, he obtains a pleasant product. Presented at the Cannes Film Festival, the work won the award for best screenplay.

title: Nella mischia
actors: Giacomo Ciarrapico, Cristina Aubry, Manrico Gammarota, Daniel Alegi, Paolo Sassanelli
description: Two years earlier, Lorenzo, a suburban Roman boy, had faked the imminent death of a friend and, with other companions, had convinced a prostitute to spend the night with the ... dying man. Now the same group struggles with tricks and thefts until Lorenzo, who unloads vegetables in a warehouse, has an idea: to steal the boxes of tomatoes and sell them to local traders. First feature film by Gianni Zanasi, which takes up the characters of one of his "short" of '92, with sensitivity, tact and narrative control. There is a collection of Truffaut (also quoted as "I quattrocento shots"), but there is also a personal stamp.

title: Il sogno della farfalla
actors: Thierry Blanc, Bibi Andersson, Roberto Herlitzka, Simona Cavallari
description: Massimo decided, when he was still a boy, to interrupt verbal communication with his peers. Now, in his early twenties, he is an actor by profession but, outside the stage, he continues to entrench himself in silence. Many, in the family and in other contexts, try to distort him from his purpose, but to no avail. Then, during a summer vacation on the island of Crete, an earthquake occurs ...
notes: The banality of everyday language denied for the purity of that of art, the pettiness of real life redeemed in the nobility of the great texts; admirable images. But the dialogues written by the psychiatrist Massimo Fagioli are terrifying.

title: Fresh
actors: Sam Nelson, Giancarlo Esposito, Samuel L. Jackson, N'Bushe Wright, Cheryl Freeman
description: Fresh is a black 12-year-old who always arrives late for school, but it's not his fault: it takes time to deliver drugs early in the morning. Neither Aunt Frances knows anything about this, nor the eleven cousins ??he lives with, nor Dad Sam who lives in Washington Square and with whom he plays chess. Then one day in a clash between drug dealers a friend of hers is killed and Fresh decides to take revenge. Revenge against drug bosses really resembles a game of chess. Newcomer Boaz Yakin tells about a twelve-year-old who is not very banal, in a harsh and disturbing film. Big as usual Sam L. Jackson, but the little boy Sam Nelson is unforgettable.

title: Mary Reilly
actors: Julia Roberts, John Malkovich, Glenn Close
description: Mary Reilly, who grew up amidst hardship and violence, found some peace in Doctor Jekyll's home for the first time. The waitress job is tough, but it's a safe haven Mary wouldn't give up for anything in the world. Admiration for her boss leads her to accept everything about him: including her ambiguous assistant, Mister Hyde. For this man totally devoid of moral limits, Mary feels at the same time repulsion and attraction, difficult to reconcile with the pure and devoted love she feels for the doctor, while she herself wonders about how much "double" there is also in her person. .
notes: Frears builds the story of the double par excellence by playing above all on atmospheres. Malkovich creates a sensual and seductive Mister Hyde. Stevenson's drama seen with the frightened and enraptured eyes of the faithful servant is framed in gray and alarming sets, which are a prelude to the tragic ending chosen from among three different ones.

title: El Gringo
actors: Richard Harrison, Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Mikaela
description: In Carterville, a village on the border with Mexico, a mysterious and dangerous gang of thugs dominate. One night the gang storms the home of a Mexican family made up of Don Diego, Manuel and Lisa and Wilson, an orphan of American nationality adopted by Don Diego and who is known by all as "El Gringo". The gang kills the head of the family and steals the gold that the family has in the house. In the end, the man discovers the true identity of the evildoers. Only against all "El Gringo" succeeds with cunning and courage to free the town forever from the presence of evildoers. Mediocre Italian-Spanish western held together by a series of twists.

title: Una nuvola di polvere... un grido di morte... arriva Sartana
actors: Gianni Garko, Susan Scott, Massimo Serato
description: Sartana makes Grande Full escape from prison to be revealed where she has hidden the huge loot of a robbery. However, many are interested in the loot: everyone tries to kill Sartana who finds help only in Belle, Johnson's widow (accomplice of Grande Full). But this will turn out to be involved in the death of her husband. Classic spaghetti western full of (gratuitous) violence and daring twists.

title: L'avvertimento
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Martin Balsam, Laura Trotter, Giancarlo Zanetti
description: Commissioner Barresi discovers that an anonymous person has paid a hundred million into his account. No explanation, just a phone call: behave yourself in the course of an investigation to come. And the investigation actually arrives: one of his superiors was killed just as he was about to question a decisive witness. Barresi receives the assignment and immediately understands that it is a complex intertwining of drug trafficking and high finance ...
notes: Before the TV series _La piovra_ and after many films of civil denunciation, Damiani engages in a detective story that sees his best moments in the American-style action scenes, with good rhythm and many twists.

title: Ferry to Hong Kong
actors: Curd Jürgens, Orson Welles, Sylvia Syms, Jeremy Spenser
description: The quarrelsome sailor Conrad is expelled from Hong Kong and boarded a ferry to Macau, where however he is preceded by his fame and therefore prevented from disembarking. Remained on board, despite the intolerance of Captain Hart (Welles), Conrad bravely intervenes on the occasion of a typhoon and a pirate attack, earning the coveted visa and the love of a passenger.
notes: The film, which makes use of Gilbert's correct direction, does not lack efficacy in the description of the environments and in the spectacular rendering; the interpreters do their number by exaggerating.

title: Out of Bounds
actors: Antony Michael Hall, Jenny Wright
description: Daryl arrives in Los Angeles and collects the wrong bag. Repeated trouble ensues with drug traffickers and the police. But he will get away with it and find love too. Conventional detective.

title: La sposa americana
actors: Stefania Sandrelli, Thommy Berggren, Trudie Styler, Harvey Keitel
description: A young Italian literature teacher meets young Edith in the United States, where he teaches, and marries her. But he soon falls in love with her sister, Anna, who is married to the homosexual Sacha. The two become lovers consuming adultery practically under the eyes of Edith who seems, at times, to indulge her husband's adventure. But one day Edith reveals that she is suffering from an incurable disease. Based on the novel of the same name by his father Mario, Giovanni Soldati stages a sentimental story for four which, however, seems only the pretext to show a series of genuine erotic performances by his wife Sandrelli.

title: Jamón jamón
actors: Penélope Cruz, Anna Galiena, Stefania Sandrelli, Javier Bardem
description: Carmen (Galiena) runs a putibar on the side of a truck-driven road. He has a parrot, an arrogant body and a daughter named Silvia (Cruz). The latter works in the nearby factory, and became pregnant with José Luis. He would be very ready to marry her, but Conchita (Sandrelli), his mother, doesn't want to. To avert the danger Conchita, who is the owner of the factory, decides to hire Raul, someone who works in the hams branch but would like to be a bullfighter. Raul should seduce Silvia and thus distance her from José Luis. The film is based on half a dozen double meanings and winks. In his Bigas Luna films ("Bilbao", "Lola") his erotic-culinary obsessions had produced surreal and cinematically higher results. Here we slip instead into farcical comedy.

title: La gabbia
actors: Tony Musante, Laura Antonelli, Florinda Bolkan, Blanca Marsillach, Cristina Marsillach
description: Hélène has left to visit her grandmother who lives outside Paris and so Michael finds himself alone. This is how he meets Marie, a woman loved by the sea many years before and immediately abandoned afterwards. Michael goes to see Marie and has no qualms about spending the night with her, but the next morning he wakes up and finds himself tied to the bed. There was a period in which Patroni Griffi managed to collect some success with these completely meaningless erotic-existential dramas. Today, thank goodness, this doesn't happen anymore. In two minor roles the Marsillach sisters are almost tender.

title: The Last Elephant
actors: Isabella Rossellini, John Lithgow, James Earl Jones, Tony Todd
description: Ecologist Maria Di Conti (Rossellini) is in Kenya trying to defend elephants from poachers when photographer Liz Page arrives in the area, sent there by a writer in the mood for local color. Liz witnesses a pachyderm massacre, takes pictures and then disappears. At that point the writer, Robert Carter (Lithgow), feels compelled to go find her. What he discovers is horrible.
notes: The "daughter of art" is not the only trouble with this film for television, tourist, right-thinking and false.

title: Casino
actors: Robert De Niro, Sharon Stone, Joe Pesci, James Woods
description: Sam "Ace" Rothstein has forged ahead in the Mafia ranks thanks to his exceptional intuition. Thanks to that same intuition he is now (1973) at the head of four casinos in Las Vegas, completely in good standing were it not for the part of income that regularly flows to the coffers of the "godfathers" and for the fact that Ace does not have the license for the business. Business is booming, and Sam now has an empire in his hands, but he makes two mistakes. First he decides to marry Ginger, a splendid unscrupulous player, succubus of the bottle, of drugs and of another man. Then he allows the casino to become a hunting ground for his old friend Nicky, a hysterical killer with a very easy trigger. The unhealthy triangle leads to self-destruction.
notes: It may be that in "Casino" there are many self-quotations, but what matters are the images, the rhythm, the style. And Scorsese offers an overabundant, enormous imaginary, torn apart by the violence and delirium of the characters who, as in a melodrama of the past, inexorably lead to annihilation. The first two hours, all played between the voiceovers of De Niro and Pesci, are the prelude to the explosion of the last act in which the tragedy that forgives no one takes place.

title: Il tuffo
actors: Vincenzo Salemme, Carlotta Natoli, Gianni Cajafa
description: Matteo, at the age of thirty, still lives with his parents in a quiet town in central Italy. During a very hot summer, to raise some money, he decides to give physics repetitions to two boys, Giulio and Elsa. The first is closed and insecure, the second is outgoing and temporarily free (her boyfriend is on vacation). In the end, both students and professors fall in love with her, but this feeling will bring about a real revolution, especially in Matteo's soul and life.
notes: The story is known, however, Martella and the three protagonists manage to extract a non-trivial juice from it. Presented at the Critics' Week in Venice, the film winks a little at Truffaut and a little at Olmi.

title: The Doom Generation
actors: James Duval, Rose McGowan, Johnathon Schaech, Cress Williams, Skinny Puppy, Dustin Nguyen, Margaret Cho, Lauren Tewes, Christopher Knight, Nicky Katt, Johanna Went, Perry Farrell, Amanda Bearse, Parker Posey, Salvator Xuereb
description: Amy Blue is a 17-year-old "speed princess" and Jordan is her sweet, naive boy friend. The two are subjugated by Xavier, enigmatic and dangerous, who drags them into increasingly violent adventures as they travel across America. Ever since Xavier forced them to flee with him (after killing a salesman), every time they stop somewhere, someone is brutally killed. It's a strange triangle of sex, blood and despair that keeps them out of reality.
notes: A youth burnt in a psychedelic version, extremely erotic not to say pornographic. The sex scenes are raw, unbridled, however viewed through an unmistakably gay filter. (Araki is famous on the festival circuit for his underground homosexual films.) More commercial than the director's previous films, but always merciless and ironic.

title: La flor de mi secreto
actors: Marisa Paredes, Juan Echanove, Joaquim Cortez, Rossy De Palma
description: Talented as a writer of sentimental novels and very unlucky as a wife, Leo is on the verge of the abyss: she is unable to face the fact that her marriage is about to end and hides behind illusions, as well as for the books she writes she hides behind. a fake name. Her friend Betty gets her an interview with a new publisher, and Leo decides to write a destructive critique of her books, hiding behind a new pseudonym.
notes: In this film where everyone would be good, yet everyone causes pain to others, Almodóvar takes comedy to the most unlikely and comical aspects of tragedy. We pass from tears to laughter and vice versa, crossing the paradoxes of everyday life. Almodóvar shows her most dazzling form since "Women on the verge of a nervous breakdown": there is a great sensitivity behind her protagonist who "has the strength of a Tennessee Williams character and finds herself abandoned as a character. by Cocteau "(words of the director).

title: Toy Story
description: Woody is a cowboy puppet, leader of the toy community. Which Supramzia is questioned by Buzz, astronaut toy. The cowboy decides to get rid of the opponent. But the two find themselves catapulted into the world of humans, and risk being made to pieces by a terrible boy. The two enemies must turn into allies to save the "skin".
notes: "Toy Story" is the jewel born from the collaboration of Disney, a monopolist of the imagination, and Pixar, clone of the Lucas empire who controls the graphic animation. Technically, graphically leaves drugs for its technical perfection. The imagination is colored with restless suggestions that suggest a Tim Burton who collaborates with the Tod Browning of "Freaks". The universe seen from the perspective of the toys is extraordinary; The doll head with one eye and mechanical spider legs is a very sad nightmare. The film has known several sequels -Toy Story 2. Woody & Buzz Alla Riscossa (1999), Toy Story 3. The great escape (2010) and Toy Story 4 (2019) - In addition to a spin -off dedicated to the character of astronaut Buzz and entitled Lightyear - The true story of Buzz (2022)

title: Broken Arrow
actors: John Travolta, Christian Slater, Samantha Mathis, Delroy Lindo
description: Vic and Riley are two friends, also linked by work. They are in fact expert military pilots and have been assigned a delicate mission: they have to test the B3 Stealth bomber, a new aviation vehicle with two nuclear warheads. But someone has betrayed, and the missile called "Broken Arrow" is lost. Vic and Riley are involved in blackmail, but ...
notes: Great start, with the camera that falls from the top towards the ring. It would like to be the metaphor of the film: two friends armed against each other. Yet "Broken Arrow" fails to rise above average. It wouldn't be bad if the director wasn't John Woo.

title: Home for the Holidays
actors: Holly Hunter, Robert Downey jr., Anne Bancroft, Geraldine Chaplin, Dylan McDermott
description: Every year Claudia returns to her family's home on the occasion of Thanksgiving. This year her situation is not the happiest as she is already divorced, plus she lost her job and then her daughter has embarked on an unedifying relationship with a peer. At home with loving but suffocating parents, a nice brother with an ambiguous chaperone, a victimist sister, a yuppie brother-in-law and a slightly distracted aunt, Claudia tries to better understand herself and her strange emotional ties.
notes: A family comedy as sharp and intelligent as its director. Many ideas are reminiscent of Woody Allen's "Interiors" in a more comical version. Neurotic and slightly overexcited in the first part, it takes off in the second, more relaxed and analytical, and takes off in the finale. Jodie Foster is skilled in probing the contradictions of family relationships, with a good-natured realism.

title: Cuori al verde
actors: Gene Gnocchi, Margherita Buy, Giulio Scarpati, Antonio Catania, Gaia De Laurentiis
description: Stefano studied philosophy, English and French. For a while he taught, then he quarreled with everyone: the Dean of the University, his girlfriend, his friends; and now his occupation is preparing for suicide. Giulio studied for a while and then started working as a plumber; he also got married, but it didn't last long. There is also Lucia, who after moving to the city has found nothing but a job as a waitress, but has not lost her optimism and her incurable trust in the world. Initially the three do not know each other, but sometimes the destinies follow mysterious paths ...
notes: A pleasant Italian film, well written, well acted and not pretentious. Giuseppe Piccioni made his debut well with "Il grande Blek", he had a setback with "Sentenced to marriage", and now he returns to enjoy the taste of the story.

title: Stealing Beauty
actors: Liv Tyler, Jeremy Irons, Jean Marais, Sinead Cusack, Stefania Sandrelli, Francesco Siciliano
description: After her mother's suicide, Lucy, a nineteen year old American, is sent on vacation to Tuscany to the home of her father and a couple of friends. In the splendid isolated villa in the Sienese hills there are also other guests. From this stay Lucy expects to find a boy she met years before but above all to discover the identity of the real father and clarify the personality of the mother.
notes: A shameless video camera caresses the figure of Lucy, discovers her beauty and circumscribes her contours: Bertolucci's complacency is felt for the instinctive talent and almost wild sensuality of the very young Liv Tyler, around which the whole film revolves.

title: A comédia de Deus
actors: João César Monteiro, Claudia Teixeira, Manuela de Freitas
description: João de Deus is the name of the mild-mannered little man who runs the "Ice Cream Paradise". He is renowned for inventing the house specialty, "Paradiso" ice cream; but few know his true masterpiece, which is a collection of pubic hair. João also delights with the girls who frequent the ice cream parlor, to whom he offers very special performances.

title: Running Scared
actors: Gregory Hines, Billy Crystal, Steven Bauer, Darlanne Fluegel
description: The desire of Ray Hughes and Danny Costanzo, daring colleagues of the Chicago police, would be to change jobs and open a restaurant. Instead, caught a drug kingpin and taken a prize vacation to Florida, they find the delinquent set free.
notes: A black and a white, friendship, adventurous investigations, "other" problems that interfere: all already seen and reviewed countless times. But here there is a respectable brilliance and gassy performers: heart-pounding fun.

title: Sansone e il tesoro degli Incas
actors: Alan Steel, Tony Sailer, Mario Petri, Anna Maria Polani
description: Alan Fox, wrongly accused of killing old Nixon, Janet's father, is taken to Silver City to be tried. During the journey, the stagecoach is attacked by a group of bandits led by the real killer: Jerry Damon. In the ensuing battle, Alan manages to escape with a young Indian. Samson, an old friend of Alan, believing him dead, sets out to avenge him.
notes: Halfway between the western and the adventure film, he fails in both fields.

title: Tri pesni o Lenine
description: A tribute to the founder of the Soviet Union, ten years after his death. Admirable and shocking images drawn from the reality of popular life, keeping the religious, metaphysical aspect of the commemorative ritual to a head, at least in appearance. The "cult of personality" takes shape rather in the shots dedicated to Stalin.

title: Chekist
actors: Igor Sergeyev, Alexei Poluyan, Mikhail Vasserbaum, Sergei Isavnin
description: We are in the years following the revolution that brought the Bolsheviks to power. Sroubov is an anonymous official charged with eliminating the enemies of the people: priests, nobles, anti-communist leaders, intellectuals. The obsessive repetition of the executions will drive him to madness. Tough anti-Bolshevik pamphlet, which gets a little carried away by rhetoric.

title: Casablanca Casablanca
actors: Francesco Nuti, Giuliana De Sio, Daniel Olbrychski, Marcello Lotti
description: Chiara accepts the proposal to embark on a cruise ship, where she will have to manage a complex. The decision involves his separation from Francis. He joins her in Morocco, in Casablanca, where he engages in a romantic and desperate attempt to find her again. As expected, the Dark will touch a decisive sacrifice.
notes: The characters of _Io, Chiara and Lo Scuro_ return in a sequel of music, billiards (from Gorizia) and many references to the film with Bogart and Bergman. Nuti makes the big leap behind the camera and proves that he has learned something from his previous trusted director, Maurizio Ponzi, but the pulse is not yet the best and the film suffers a little.

title: Scenes from a Mall
actors: Woody Allen, Bette Midler, Paul Mazursky, Bill Irwin, Daren Firestone
description: For spouses Fifer, Nick (lawyer) and Deborah (psychiatrist), it is the sixteenth wedding anniversary. As they go shopping at a large mall, Nick confesses to his wife that he was having an affair. Upon hearing the news, she wants a divorce. But Deborah also confesses to her husband that she has an affair with a colleague. He too decides to ask for a divorce. Instead, nothing will be done.
notes: A director who has also signed notable films, a protagonist who is a celebrity of the comedy and, above all, Woody Allen as husband of the latter. Many ambitions, but the result is not equal to the premises. More effects than substance.

title: Bump in the Night
actors: Meredith Baxter, Christopher Reeve, Wings Hauser, Richard Bradford
description: Martha is a writer who has some problems with the bottle. But when they kidnap her little son, she reacts and it is she herself who sets out to find him, not hesitating to beat all possible and imaginable leads and frantically devoting herself to the search. Unfortunately, her investigations lead her to Lawrence, a pedophile who may have lured the boy on behalf of a director of porno movies in which minors are used. Then comes the time for her not to give up and go all the way, to be able to bring her son home safe and sound. Thrilling melodrama for TV, saturated with "effect" ingredients (alcoholism, child abuse) which, however, is conducted with a certain discretion and narrative skill by the director. Note the unconventional use of the actors employed in the main roles.

title: Batman
actors: Adam West, Burt Ward
description: Accompanied by the faithful Robin, Batman battles a group of supervillains: the Penguin, Joker, the Riddler and Cat Woman, who plot against the UN. The masked hero tries to defeat the criminal plans of the four and save the important political figures that are threatened ...
notes: Cinematic version of the famous TV series whose broadcasting began the same year, of which it maintains the priceless camp features and the comic-pop aspect (complete with onomatopoeias displayed on the screen). Distributed in the US between the first and second seasons of the series, it was made in a hurry to exploit its success, and it shows: direction and screenplay are less than televised.

title: The Prisoner of Shark Island
actors: Warner Baxter, Gloria Stuart
description: Although innocent, Dr. Dunne becomes involved in the Lincoln murder trial. Sentenced to life imprisonment, he is relegated to the islet of Tortoise. After a failed escape attempt, he is locked up in a solitary cell. On the island, however, an epidemic of yellow fever spreads which also affects the doctor. Dunne must thus take his place. The self-denial shown in the circumstance allows him to obtain the grace. Back to normal life he also manages to demonstrate his extraneousness to the facts for which he was sentenced.
notes: Ford stages an exemplary story, which really happened, which summarizes his ideals of freedom and truth in an epic melody. Screenplay by Nunnally Johnson.

title: Ferie d'agosto
actors: Silvio Orlando, Sabrina Ferilli, Laura Morante, Ennio Fantastichini
description: Two "clans" of vacationers: one is headed by the progressive journalist Sandro Molino, intellectual, meditative, snobbish; the other is represented by the Mazzalupi family, Roman caciaroni shopkeepers and video employees. They find themselves, in spite of themselves, opposite on vacation on the island of Ventotene, and must somehow survive each other's presence. Hostility explodes immediately, together with a disdainful contempt. Yet the two lifestyles, under the superficial rind, are not so dissimilar: all are intimately discontented and this creates the premise for inevitable reconciliation.
notes: Virzì has the advantage of looking at the defects and stereotypes of both groups without excessive partiality and without too heavy trivializations. Too bad that detachment and irony are not maintained until the end. However, the actors are very good.

title: Nixon
actors: Anthony Hopkins, Joan Allen, Ed Harris, James Woods, Bob Hoskins
description: Between 1963 and '73 Nixon represented the dark, pragmatic, intriguing side of American politics, capable of very lucid political intuitions and unacceptable baseness. And he never resolved the inner conflict with his predecessor Kennedy, who entered the myth without getting his hands dirty. Oliver Stone stays true to his isetric inquiry style. But he particularly insists on the self-destructive aspect of the president's personality, the tragic story of his childhood and the dramas that marked his private life. The resemblance that Hopkins manages to obtain with his character is extraordinary.

title: Fair Game
actors: Cindy Crawford, William Baldwin, Salma Hayek, Steven Berkoff
description: Until yesterday, the life of Kate McQuean, a civil lawyer, took place entirely between home and work, in Miami. But, after asking for the hijacking of a client's husband's ship, her troubles begin: her house explodes, she is shot at and suddenly Kate is forced to flee at breakneck speed. The one who wants her badly is a gang of former KGB agents, whose plans for a robbery have been thwarted by the lawyer. Fortunately, to protect her, and also to console her in the escape, there is a handsome detective.
notes: This action-thriller full of explosions and clichés would never have deserved more than two lines if it hadn't marked the film debut of supermodel Cindy Crawford. Which is beautiful, healthy and willing. But to act is not enough. Although at least you can recognize the mitigating factor of the debut, which is not true for Baldwin, who claims to be an actor for the longest time with the same results. Useless story, ridiculous script, film that is forgotten in a matter of minutes.

title: August
actors: Anthony Hopkins, Kate Burton, Leslie Philips, Gawn Grainger
description: August 1896. Ieuan Davis lives on a farm in the mountains of Wales with his niece Sian. But Sian's father, Alexandre Blathwaite, arrives with his second wife, Helen. Blathwaite hates the countryside and would like to sell the house to make a large sum of money. Helen, meanwhile, makes all the men in the neighborhood lose their heads: first of all Ieuan; then also Dr. Lloyd, with whom Sian had long been in love. The intertwining of passions, wrongs, disappointments, will have a dramatic ending and within a weekend Ieuan will see all his dreams of happiness fail.
notes: Anthony Hopkins goes behind the camera to direct Chekhov in this adaptation of "Uncle Vanya". The theatrical training of the Welsh actor is certainly robust, but in the cinematographic direction he suffers from a careless care that irreparably penalizes the result. Even photography and music are exaggeratedly "refined" and complacent. Not even the skill of Hopkins-actor can lift an "Ivoryan" film that fails due to an excess of perfectionism from its academicism.

title: Jack Frusciante è uscito dal gruppo
actors: Stefano Accorsi, Ivano Marescotti, Athina Cenci, Violante Placido
description: Alex is a teenager like many others, passionate about music and oppressed by school and parents brutalized by television and daily chores. Spend your days in school desks (naturally in the back row), rehearsal rooms, parties with friends. But one day a companion, Aidi, telephones him, proposing an exchange of poetry books. A trivial episode that subverts Alex's existence. The boy falls madly in love with Aidi, who however, although attracted to him, is reluctant to deepen and "formalize" their relationship. Detachments, disturbances, second thoughts follow.
notes: From the lucky book by Enrico Brizzi who also signed the screenplay, but then denied the film. Which is actually modest and unoriginal.

title: Ninfa plebea
actors: Stefania Sandrelli, Raoul Bova, Lucia Cara, Peppe De Rosa, Ennio Coltorti
description: In the Thirties, before the outbreak of the Second World War, Miluzza (Cara) is little more than a child, candid and sensual. In the village of the deep South where the young woman lives, many morbid looks are focused on her. To save her from an announced scandal will not be her mother (Sandrelli), generous and passionate, nor her father, a simple and impotent man, but a fugitive soldier (Bova). Few times, in Italian cinema, quality had gone so low. The string of obviousness oscillates between the tragic and the ridiculous: whoever manages to resist this painful southern-sentimental meatloaf for almost two hours, will perhaps prefer to laugh so as not to cry. You don't even get to kitsch: it's just a stew for television audiences looking for "popular-chic" stereotypes in a slightly more risque sauce. Domenico Rea's beautiful book of the same name won the Strega Prize in 1993.

title: Copycat
actors: Sigourney Weaver, Holly Hunter, Dermot Mulroney
description: Helen Hudson is a criminal psychologist who suffers from agoraphobia and has been living in a high-tech home since a maniac tried to kill her a year earlier. Helen, who only communicates with the outside world via the Internet, is involved in the police detective M.J. Monaham in the investigation of a chain of crimes all committed in San Francisco. But there is another, far more disconcerting factor common to the crimes: they are all inspired by the famous murders of history, from Jack the Ripper to the Boston strangler. Helen Hudson is now fully aware of the killer's mental processes. But he too has figured out who's hunting him ... And he knows where to find her.
notes: Serial killers have always exerted a particular fascination on the collective imagination. Here there is an additional morbid element constituted by the psychologist's disorder and her previous "contact" with a maniac. The Weaver is at a level that can handle the weight of the whole film well by herself.

title: Flirt
actors: Bill Sage, Parker Posey, Dwight Ewell, Dominik Bender, Miho Nikaidoh, Toshizo Fujiwara
description: New York, February 1993. Bill receives an ultimatum from his girlfriend leaving for Paris: he must decide to marry her, or she will leave him. Bill takes ninety minutes to reflect ... Berlin, October 1994. Dwight, a young and ambitious American, lives with Johan, an art dealer who supports him. Johan has to go to New York; she asks the young lover if their story will have a future, and Dwight asks him for ninety minutes to give an answer ... Tokyo, March 1995. Miho, a dancer, is put at loggerheads by her boyfriend who wants to strengthen the relationship. She too, "casually", gets ninety minutes to decide.
notes: Nine fates are played out in three similar places. Hartley, a talent of the American independent cinema of the 90s, has a particular taste for paradox and the ability to tell even the smallest stories with wit and originality. But this is his most pretentious and least successful film.

title: Come mi vuoi
actors: Enrico Lo Verso, Vincent Cassel, Monica Bellucci, Urbano Barberini
description: During a raid, the agent Pasquale runs into Desideria, a rather peculiar transvestite: first, because he is an old schoolmate of hers; second, because Desideria falls in love with him and begins to court him. Pasquale is disgusted and in addition he is already engaged to a beautiful and healthy girl. The policeman accepts a rapprochement with Desideria only to try to make her mend. In reality, however, it will be he who will review his positions ... The film suffers from an uneven narrative, which wobbles between comedy, photo-novel and melodrama, without succeeding in any area. An Enrico Lo Verso who in a miniskirt and stiletto heels is only clumsy and unpleasant, is echoed by a general acting and a decidedly low level screenplay.

title: Papà dice messa
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Teo Teocoli, Felice Andreasi, Giacomo Pozzetto, Marta Forghieri
description: Father Arturo is a suburban parish priest, full of good will despite the absenteeism of the parishioners and the "harassment" of his bishop. One day Francesco happens to him in church, a son that the priest had twenty years earlier and that he has always kept secret. His girlfriend, Matilda, is pregnant: Don Arturo is about to become a grandfather! The next day Francesco disappears and the priest and the girl start looking for him.
notes: Pozzetto in his second film as director (after "Saxophone" in 1978) wants Teocoli, Andreasi and their son Giacomo back with him. Too bad that this dip into the past does not come out of mediocrity: it accumulates many small findings hoping that quantity will translate into quality, but the miracle does not happen.

title: Antonia
actors: Els Dottermans, Willeke Van Ammelroy, Jan Decleir, Veerle Van Overloop
description: Antonia is at the end of her life and retraces the stages of her existence over the span of fifty years, from the postwar period to today. She remembers the day she returned to her native village and decided to cultivate the land left to her by her mother. She remembers the birth of her daughter Danielle, the arrival of her granddaughter Thérèse, who in turn will bring Sarah into the world. Many bizarre characters revolve around them and their maturation paths, always with the clear preponderance of the female sex and some excursion into the homosexual field. The seasons pass, but temperament and emotions are always recognized. Between emotion and irony, between births, aging, follies and strange behaviors, in the end what always wins is the taste for life, whatever it may be.
notes: Winner of the 1996 Oscar for best foreign film, "The Tree of Antonia" is a feminist film without malice, shot with grace and a remarkable sense of the funny.

title: On an Island with You
actors: Esther Williams, Peter Lawford, Jimmy Durante, Ricardo Montalban
description: An actress who went to Hawaii to shoot a movie meets a young naval officer. He falls in love immediately, she takes a while, but in the end she is overwhelmed. The diva of the water musical, Esther Williams, and an interesting cast in a product that, in the end, turns out to be below average for the genre.

title: The Fallen Idol
actors: Ralph Richardson, Michèle Morgan, Bobby Henrey, Sonja Dresdel, Denis O'Dea, Dora Bryan
description: A young boy who is very fond of the house butler risks having him indicted for a murder that he did not actually commit. Excellent psychological film, written by Graham Greene.

title: Heidi
actors: Elsbeth Sigmund, Heinrich Gretel, Thomas Clameth
description: Torn from her mountains, where she lives with her grandfather, and from her few friends, Heidi is taken to the city to look after Clara, a sick girl. The house is dominated with an iron fist by the selfless and insensitive housekeeper Rottermeyer who sees badly the sincere friendship that is born between Heidi and Clara. The patient shows signs of improvement, but Heidi saddens away from the mountains. Comencini skilfully avoids the sillyness of the classic Swiss literature known above all for the Japanese cartoon series.

title: The Age of Consent
actors: Dorothy Wilson, Arline Judge, Richard Cromwell, Eric Linden
description: Michael (Richard Cromwell) and Betty (Dorothy Wilson) are engaged, but their affair is likely to end the day Michael discovers that Betty has agreed to date Duke, a student known for his success with women. The situation calms down, but Michael begins to wonder if it is worth waiting the two years that separate him from the end of his studies to get married with Betty. The problem is: abandon your studies to immediately and legally sleep with Betty, or wait for the right age, doing things right? The alternative seems today to be an unparalleled absurdity, but La Cava brings out a sensible and well-balanced film.

title: Four Rooms
directors: Quentin Tarantino, Robert Rodriguez, Alexandre Rockwell, Allison Anders
actors: Madonna, Tim Roth, Valeria Golino, Quentin Tarantino, Bruce Willis, Antonio Banderas, Jennifer Beals, Marisa Tomei
description: For Ted, waiter at the Mon Signor Hotel in Los Angeles, it will be a special New Year's Eve. Lived in four different episodes. "Strange Brew": Ted, who enters the bridal suite with the ice bucket, is involved in a meeting of witches. "Two sides to a Plate": in another room a jealous husband is about to shoot his wife, accusing her of having had an affair with Ted. "The Misbehavers": Ted has to babysit two vandals aged six and nine, who destroy a hotel room. "The Thrill of the Bet": a strange bet involves Ted with the usual ice bucket plus a hatchet, a cutting board, string and three nails ...
notes: A group of young directors with inhomogeneous talent (apart from the head of class Tarantino) try to reinvent the film in episodes. The micro-stories are paradoxical, but not for this very successful. Very disappointing, apart from the Rodriguez episode.

title: Wilder Napalm
actors: Debra Winger, Dennis Quaid, Arliss Howard, M. Emmet Walsh
description: The Wilder brothers and Wallace Foudroyant both had the gift of Mother Nature to stir up fire with the power of thought alone. While Wilder does not exploit this gift of his, Wallace uses it in a comic circus number: and when, after years of separation, the two reunite, their relationship ... sparks (Wallace's passion is also involved. for Wilder's wife) ...
notes: Along with the grotesque, even the fantastic genre is one of the most dangerous to face: the always lurking risk is to trivialize some idea theoretically heralding good results in the realization. As it happened with this _Triangle of fire_.

title: The Young Americans
actors: Harvey Keitel, Iain Glen, John Wood, Terence Rigby
description: John Harris, an American policeman, is on a mission to London to investigate the dirty business of Frazer, a psychotic drug dealer, also from the United States, who tries to conquer a slice of the British market. The boss has recruited young Londoners who go there with a heavy hand. To help Harris find evidence against Frazer, a Temple bartender lines up. A lot of blood will flow.
notes: The young Americans of the title are, in reality, English boys who are putting themselves on the path of their overseas "masters". The director describes a dark and dangerously rotten environment with vigor and without rhetoric. Keitel is always Keitel.

title: Farinelli
actors: Stefano Dionisi, Enrico Lo Verso, Elsa Zylberstein, Caroline Cellier, Marianne Basler
description: Carlo Boschi, aka Farinelli, was the most acclaimed castrato singer of the eighteenth century. We see him in the partnership with his older brother Riccardo, whose music he plays, becoming rich and famous, pampered and besieged by many women, morbidly attracted by his surgically induced "deficiency" - by the same brother. Then, between the two, there will be a dramatic break. It is an irritating film for what could have been in the hands of a capable author, and for how it turned out: a nonsense of baroque pretentiousness, with an insipid interpreter (Dionisi / Carlo) and one out of the ordinary (Lo Verso / Riccardo) .

title: The Flintstones
actors: John Goodman, Elizabeth Taylor, Rick Moranis, Rosie O'Donnell, Elizabeth Perkins, Halle Berry
description: Two million years before Christ, Fred and Barney work in a quarry. Fred, with the help of Barney, is promoted to vice president of the company, but gratitude for his friend is not his forte. Also, the fat guy doesn't realize he's just a pawn in the dirty game of a manager and his secretary. But, in the end, the wicked will be defeated and sbertucciato, as should be.
notes: The plot is just like a cartoon, the best in terms of fun consists in the distortions in a ... futuristic key of the prehistoric context. After 15 years Liz Taylor returns to the cinema and Fred, her son-in-law, apostrophes her: "What is this fossil doing here?".

title: Corrina, Corrina
actors: Whoopi Goldberg, Ray Liotta, Tina Majorino, Don Ameche
description: Since her mother died, little Molly has gone into total silence. Her father, among other problems, also has to find a housekeeper to entrust her to. After several unsuccessful attempts, here is the "coulored" Corrina Washington who embodies a lot of skills. It seems that the director has transfused her distant vicissitudes as a little orphan into the film. All good, but perhaps he exaggerated a bit with the character of Corrina, essentially making him something between Leonardo Da Vinci and Pico della Mirandola.

title: La fine è nota
actors: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Valérie Kaprisky, Carlo Cecchi, Mariangela Melato
description: A popular lawyer (Bentivoglio), while returning to the house, is touched by the body of a man who falls from the fourth floor of the building, that is, from the apartment of the lawyer himself. Who was the man, whom the lawyer had never seen or known? The lawyer undertakes his own personal investigation, parallel to the official one entrusted to a magistrate. The surprises will be many and of great importance. In her third film, Cristina Comencini transposed the story of an American novel by Geoffrey Holliday Hall to Italy, but the resulting screenplay has many gaps, which fatally reverberate on the structure of the story.

title: Richard III
actors: Ian McKellen, Annette Bening, Nigel Hawthorne, Robert Downey jr., Maggie Smith
description: After the killing of King Henry, the throne goes to King Edward. But the kingdom was also wanted by the king's brother, the deformed, bloodthirsty and very cunning Richard, Duke of Glouchester. The duke first seduces Lady Anna, widow of the prince he killed, then eliminates Clarence, the third brother. Soon King Edward rises from the middle and his heir prince dies too. Elizabeth, the queen, is increasingly isolated and desperate: her brother, Count Rivers, is brutally killed; the elderly Duchess of York, Riccardo's mother, is powerless in the face of her son's wickedness.
notes: Appropriate transposition of Shakespeare's tragedy into a 1930s England reminiscent of the glories of Nazi Germany. McKellen, also the screenwriter of the film, is a brilliant Richard III, extraordinarily perverse and sly, who does not forget the most famous tirades of the original. There is no vulgarization, no banal fiction.

title: El Zorro
actors: George Ardisson, Jack Stuart, Femi Benussi, Pedro Sanchez
description: The powerful don Jaime, supported by don Pedro, the head of the guards, has decided to reunite the two provinces of San Juan and Santa Maria del Consuelo. This project is opposed by some nobles of the region and, in particular, the "bandit" Zorro.
notes: The intentions are parodic, but they rarely hit the mark.

title: Before and After
actors: Meryl Streep, Liam Neeson, Edward Furlong, Alfred Molina
description: A respectable family from the American province is thrown into a nightmare when, after the discovery of the body of their son's girlfriend, the boy goes missing. Carolyn and Ben Ryan, as they struggle to uncover the truth, or at least part of it, are tortured by doubts that their son may really be responsible for the crime. The terrible uncertainty pushes them to divergent choices: collaborate with justice, hide evidence, rely on quibbles and jurisprudence.
notes: Schroeder, director of the "Mystery Von Bulow", is evidently fascinated by the impossibility of the elusiveness of certainties, especially in the judicial field. Screenwriter Ted Tally won the Oscar for "The Silence of the Lambs". But here something is not working: the actors are only discreet, the direction is traditional and the plot does not live up to the premises. It would be more suitable for a television film-dossier.

title: Pump Up the Volume
actors: Christian Slater, Samantha Mathis, Ellen Greene, Anthony Lucero
description: Mark Hunter is a high school boy from Arizona. A model student and a sensitive teenager by day, however, he leads a double life at night: he is in fact the wild animator of a pirate radio station. In his broadcasts, which are gaining increasing success, he embodies the frustrated desires of his peers. Until one day a boy, influenced by one of his transmissions, kills himself. Perhaps a bit Manichaean in its schematisms, Moyle's film, however, has the merit of touching (with its bitter-sweet gaze) alive knots of youthful sensitivity. Very good Christian Slater.

title: Greedy
actors: Kirk Douglas, Michael J. Fox, Olivia D'Abo, Nancy Travis, Ed Begley jr., Phil Hartman, Jere Burns, Colleen Camp, Bob Balaban, Joyce Hyser, Mary Ellen Trainor, Siobhan Fallon
description: The uncle Joe of the title is an old man who is far from defenseless, despite being in a wheelchair, and very rich: he made his money trading in scrap iron. His relatives look around him awaiting death. Panic when Joe has a crush on young Molly. Then a nephew, Daniel, angel-faced but far from deaf to the call of money, is put on the track.
notes: The stainless Kirk Douglas is involved in a comedy that mixes, without particular fantasy, the clichés of the variant "old miser versus greedy relatives". He probably had a lot of fun, especially at the idea of ??lusting Olivia d'Abo.

title: Alexander the Great
actors: Richard Burton, Fredric March, Claire Bloom, Danielle Darrieux
description: The parable of the great Macedonian leader from quarrels with his father Philip, to the conquest of Greece and Persia, to a death tormented by remorse.
notes: Narrated with static, Hollywood rhetoric gigantist, by a director more at ease in noir and urban realism (_Lo spaccone_).

title: Così parlò Bellavista
actors: Luciano De Crescenzo, Renato Scarpa, Isa Danieli, Lorella Morlotti
description: Doctor Cazzaniga, from Milan who has been transferred to Naples as manager of Alfasud, is uneasy: too much confusion. Professor Bellavista lives in his palace, who has a strong dislike for him. Bellavista's daughter, pregnant, gets married: her husband is an unemployed architect. Aided by a broken lift, Cazzaniga and Bellavista make friends and the young couple's troubles can be solved.
notes: De Crescenzo directs and interprets, adapting his book for the screen. The comparison between "Milanese" and "Neapolitan" does not go beyond the game of manner. Stereotypes win.

title: Flight of the Phoenix
actors: James Stewart, Richard Attenborough, Peter Finch, Hardy Krüger
description: Following a crash landing, a group of people, including one injured, awaits help in the middle of the desert. The wounded man dies, but no trace of the rescue. One of the survivors is an aeronautical designer and proposes to build a makeshift aircraft with the pieces of the wreck; the enterprise seems crazy, but it is completed, despite other deaths. Ordinary individuals in an extraordinary situation: a classic formula that Aldrich was particularly fond of; great work of actors to give the right emphasis to characters and conflicts.

title: Bluff. Storia di truffe e di imbroglioni
actors: Adriano Celentano, Anthony Quinn, Capucine, Attilio Dottesio
description: In 1930s France, a skilled scammer, Belle, wants her former lover, the well-known scammer Philip Bang, to escape from prison. By mistake, however, the Italian Felice Brianza escapes. The woman then forces Felice to return to prison disguised as a chaplain to get Bang to escape. The two men team up to play the woman their biggest shot. In reality, Bang also wants to scam his Italian friend who, however, turns out to be smarter than his colleague. Nice comedy that makes the verse to the gangster film. Corbucci, certainly not new to this kind of film, guides with a sure hand a Celentano not yet inflated and, above all, not left to fend for himself.

title: Encino Man
actors: Brendan Fraser, Pauly Shore, Sean Austin
description: Dave and Stoney are two high schoolers eager to show off, especially with the beautiful Robin that Dave is in love with. The two decide to build a swimming pool for the end of year party. An earthquake, however, brings to the surface a block of ice inside which there is a prehistoric man. The two friends defrost him and the newcomer soon becomes a model student who will even be able to break through Robin's heart.
notes: Built around the starting idea, the film then actually retraces all the clichés of American teenage films. However, the gags of caveman education are amusing.

title: The April Fools
actors: Jack Lemmon, Catherine Deneuve, Myrna Loy, Charles Boyer
description: Brubaker, a shy stock clerk with problems deriving from a bad marriage, meets a woman who has all the characteristics of her soul mate. But she too is married, and moreover to the man who offered an unexpected and prestigious job to Brubaker. It is almost superfluous to specify that, in the reckoning, it will be the reasons of the heart that have won over any obstacle.
notes: Great cast for a slightly dated comedy. Rosenberg puts in his own some refinement too much, with the risk of loosening the narrative rhythm.

title: Il corpo della ragassa
actors: Enrico Maria Salerno, Lilli Carati, Renzo Montagnani, Giuliana Calandra
description: The beautiful Teresa, known as Tirisin, who grew up with her father among the hard work on the banks of the Po (we are in the 1920s), is weaned at the "Blue Grotto" casino. She is noticed by Doctor Quario who hires her as a waitress, educating her in the arts of femininity. Arts that Tirisin will put to work with the doctor. The film could be the portrait of a sentimental and erotic education and at the same time the historical fresco of an era, as in the beautiful novel by Gianni Brera from which it is based. Instead, we fall into the banality of erotic comedy, even if Carati (before personal drift and hard-core) was one of the sexiest actresses in Italian cinema.

title: Danielle Steel's Mixed Blessing
actors: Bess Armstrong, James Naughton, Alexandra Paul, Gabrielle Carteris
description: Having a child doesn't always come this way, of course; sometimes the joy of being a parent has to deal with difficult obstacles. Three couples, three stories: Andy and Diana, unable to have children, want to adopt one, but the bureaucracy is tyrannical. Brad and Pilar are a little over the years and generating is a risky gesture for them. Charlie wants a child, Barbie doesn't: what will become of their love?
notes: From the series "true stories and surroundings" so much in vogue lately on the video, yet another family catchphrase, this time multiplied by three (breathless writers?). In search of the easy and digestive tear with the alibi of "let's talk about it".

title: Hemingway's Adventures of a Young Man
actors: Richard Beymer, Paul Newman, Jessica Tandy
description: An American boy passes his youth in Michigan in the midst of disagreements between a weak father and a bigoted mother. Tired of that life he moved to New York where he tries to break through as a journalist, but waiting for the great opportunity, he adapts to the most humble crafts. Then, the First World War drags him to fight in Italy where he is injured and hospitalized in a hospital. Here he knows and falls in love with Rosanna, but fate has other evidence for him in store.
notes: It is the story of Nick Adams taken from the stories of Ernest Hemingway. Ritt cannot transfer the dry vigor of the story from the page written to the film, and one of the least happy films of him comes out.

title: The Crossing Guard
actors: Jack Nicholson, Anjelica Huston, David Morse, Robin Wright, Piper Laurie
description: August 17 is a pivotal day for Freddy: the same day, a few years earlier, a drunk boy at the wheel ran over and killed his daughter Emily. For Freddy, that loss marked the end of his life: his marriage was also shattered and he now lives like a drifter. On August 17, John, the boy who killed his daughter, is released. But for Freddy he has not paid enough: late at night the man goes to the boy's house to kill him. John begs him to "pardon him". Freddy gives him three more days to live: then he'll come back. Penn's second film confirms his talent and strangeness to today's Hollywood. The tension of the film is above all moral, the direction of the actors impeccable.

title: Grumpier Old Men
actors: Jack Lemmon, Walter Matthau, Sophia Loren, Ann-Margret, Daryl Hannah, Burgess Meredith
description: It is summer and the town of Wabasha (Minnesota) is ready for a thaw. John has re-married, and now prefers domestic tranquility to traditional battles with his neighbor Max. Max is a bit lost without a friend to torment; but soon Maria Ragetti arrives in the city, a busty and stubborn Italian, determined to open a typical restaurant in place of the old fishing shop. The fight against the skirt-clad menace begins, and for once John and Max are allies.
notes: The eternal "strange couple" of American comedy is always gritty and crackling. Loren moves smugly between the two "irresistible grumblers", and the polite comedy amuses everyone a bit. Do not miss the credits with the wrong takes and the wild improvisations.

title: L'arcano incantatore
actors: Carlo Cecchi, Stefano Dionisi, Arnaldo Ninchi, Andrea Scorzoni
description: 1750. Giacomo Vigetti, seminarian, must leave Bologna to avoid being sentenced for having a young girl pregnant and having an abortion. Through an old lady in the smell of witchcraft he obtains a safe conduct and leaves for Tuscany, to work in the service of a mysterious character: a former parish priest, removed from the Church for his experiments that earned him the definition of "arcane enchanter", condemned to live isolated with the only presence of the secretary. James must in fact replace the old scriptural who has just died. Having overcome the initial terror, the young man is convinced that his master's experiments are not at all demonic, and begins to support him in his studies on telepathic powers.

title: The Birdcage
actors: Robin Williams, Nathan Lane, Gene Hackman, Dianne Wiest, Dan Futterman, Calista Flockhart, Hank Azaria, Christine Baranski, Tom McGowan, Grant Heslov, Kirby Mitchell, James Lally, Luca Tommassini, Luis Camacho, André Fuentes
description: Armand and Albert have been living together for years: together they manage the nightclub "The Birdcage" and together they raised Val, Armand's son. When Val announces that he wants to marry the daughter of an ultra-conservative senator, the two must prepare for the meeting with the consuoceri, to whom the nature of their family certainly cannot be revealed. Among other things, Senator Keely supports this meeting (convinced that it is a regular and prestigious couple) to clean up the image of his party in front of the media.
notes: The remake of the 1978 comedy with Tognazzi and Serrault works, thanks to Nichols and screenwriter Elaine May. The performers are also good, and among all the protagonist is certainly Gene Hackman who with age has revealed a comic streak not to be overlooked.

title: Hideway
actors: Jeff Goldblum, Alfred Molina, Christine Lahti, Alicia Silverstone
description: Hatch Harrison has already been declared clinically dead, but an avant-garde medical team brings him back to life. However, experience leaves strange marks on his personality. Only afterwards does he discover that a psychic bond has been established between him and a murderer who has gone through the same resurrection. Hatch must convince the others that he is not the dangerous subject, and at the same time he must prevent the killer from finding his next victims, seen through his eyes: they are Hatch's wife and daughter. Leonard, after "Il tagliaerbe", directs a new film in which special effects take the lion's share. To the disadvantage of the story, in which everything is assembled at an unnecessarily frenetic pace. Goldblum wanders around with the usual expression of amazement.

title: Compagna di viaggio
actors: Michel Piccoli, Asia Argento, Lino Capolicchio, Silvia Cohen
description: Cora, a restless and wandering twenty year old, lives for the day. One day they offer her a particular assignment: she has to assist an old retired professor, so distracted that he often leaves home and forgets the way back. The man refuses to be assisted, so the girl should watch over him in secret, following him at a distance and intervening only in times of need. For a while, things went smoothly. But one day the professor gets on a train, and Cora follows him. A strange journey through Italy begins, and from station to station the girl begins to confront a previously unexplored dimension of life. An opportunity completely missed by Peter Del Monte, a director whose narrative intentions will never be up to the visual system: beautiful images, beautiful industrial landscapes, but the script is just an unlikely "mess". And to think that Del Monte had an actor of the caliber of Piccoli on his hands: he could have limited himself to following his wanderings, in silence, and would have found more coherence anyway.

title: Critical Decision
actors: Kurt Russell, Steven Seagal, Oliver Platt, John Leguizamo
description: A 747 headed for Washington is hijacked by an Islamic terrorist. David Grant, an American intelligence officer expert in international terrorism, understands the criminal's true intent: to detonate a lethal load of nerve gas on Washington. So you have to decide whether to endanger the lives of thousands of people by landing the plane, or whether to sacrifice four hundred passengers by blowing it up. But there is a third solution: "hook up" the 747 at an altitude of eight thousand meters and secretly transfer on board a group of experts who solve the situation "in their own way" ... The saraband of incredible twists is not convincing . All in all, the older "Airport" movies were nicer. The political motivations of the terrorists are curious, crude and primitive as rarely seen in the cinema.

title: Mute Witness
actors: Marina Sudina, Fay Ripley, Evan Richards, Oleg Jankovskij
description: Billy is an expert make-up artist in special effects and is in Moscow to collaborate on a low-cost film. One evening the girl, who is mute, remains closed in her studies and witnesses a murder. Initially she mistakes it for fiction, but then, frozen, she realizes that blood and corpses are real. A night of terror begins, hunted by the killers. Meanwhile, even Billy's American friends, who intervened to help her, end up caught in a dense web of intrigues and dangerous situations involving the KGB, the Moscow police and a fearsome underworld leader known as "the Executioner". "The witness's eyes" is a funny horror-comedy that sweeps with intelligence and cunning in both genres, unmasking many horror conventions, with some references to the De Palma of the first films. The newcomer Anthony Waller (English) knows how to keep the tension and laughter equally high, he knows how to move from one register to another, he knows how to make cinema while also talking about cinema. Beware of the mysterious actor, "the Executioner", a great who appears only at the end and is not mentioned in the opening credits.

title: Duo luo tian shi
actors: Takeshi Kaneshiro, Leon Lai, Karen Mok, Michelle Reis, Charlie Yeung
description: It's been a hundred and fifty-five days since Killer started his Agent business. She - Agent - makes her reservations and cleans up after "work", and everything runs smoothly. But Agent begins to get a little obsessive towards Killer. Until one day Killer escapes with Punkie, towards an adventurous life. "Lost Angels" is an ideal development of "Hong Kong Express". It was supposed to be the third episode of the previous film, but it was dropped because it would have made it too long. Here it becomes the backbone of the intertwining of a metropolitan reality increasingly crushed by individual solitude, so oppressive that it does not even find the outlet of tragedy. Wong Kar-Wai knows how to smile bitterly and discreetly conveys his idea of ??the world.

title: The Secret of Roan Inish
actors: Jeni Courtney, Eileen Colgan, Mick Lally, Richard Sheridan
description: Mother orphaned Fiona moves to live at her grandparents' home on the west coast of Ireland. From the window of his bedroom he can see the island of Roan Inish, from which his family comes and to which some legends are linked: Fiona's little brother, who slipped into the sea with his cradle during the transfer from the island, would still be alive, and would live on the island. Fiona tries to convince her grandparents to return to the Isle of Roan. Fairy, elegant, very delicate in its crossing of Celtic legends and harsh realism. Sayles, an American independent director, never gives in to mannerism and follows the pace of the fairy tale even when he resumes the daily efforts of fishermen, and in the end even seals and seagulls seem mythological creatures.

title: Marciando nel buio
actors: Jean-Marc Barr, Massimo Dapporto, Roberto Citran, Flavio Albanese, Thomas Kretschmann
description: Saro is a twenty year old boy, sunny and naive. He is doing military service in an infantry battalion, and becomes close friends with his drill sergeant Gianni Tricarico. It is the beginning of a descent into hell, for which other fellow soldiers are also responsible. Saro will experience firsthand the sexual violence from a superior and the tremendous difficulties to obtain justice. The film, of the cinema-denunciation genre, is directed without continuity by Massimo Spano, a directorial debut after various experiences as a screenwriter. In addition, it suffers from a banal photograph and a pretentious text that at times makes it grotesque. Jean Marc Barr, already over the top, could have avoided the ridiculous ending.

title: The Juror
actors: Demi Moore, Alec Baldwin, Lindsay Crouse, Tony Lo Bianco
description: Taking part as a juror in the trial against the Mafia Boffano proves to be a double-edged sword for Annie Laird, sculptor and single mother. In fact, there are those who plot in the shadows and want to use her to influence the jury. "Il Maestro" is a collaborator of the mafia, a ruthless man capable of killing friends, children, women with whom he has just made love in cold blood. Annie is subjugated by this man whose identity she does not know, so intellectual and seductive. The discovery of who she really is is a terrible blow for Annie, which will have unpredictable consequences. Based on the best seller by George Dawes Green, the film mixes a judicial thriller and the ambiguity of the relationship between the protagonists. And it is above all in them that the flaws come out. If Demi Moore has at least the necessary athletic energy, Baldwin would not have been credible as a fatal man twenty pounds ago.

title: Le affinità elettive
actors: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Isabelle Huppert, Jean-Hugues Anglade, Marie Gillain
description: In a villa in the Tuscan countryside, in the Napoleonic era, four people meet: the spouses Edoardo and Carlotta, their friend Ottone and the eighteen-year-old daughter of Carlotta's previous marriage, Ottilia. The initial harmony is shattered when the "elective affinities" begin to act, revealing new attractions and creating unpredictable grooves. Refined, thoughtful, flawless in respect of Goethe's novel, the film is too cold, and does not convey the sense of drama. The operation remains elegant, but useless and inexplicable.

title: Diabolique
actors: Sharon Stone, Isabelle Adjani, Chazz Palminteri, Kathy Bates
description: Nicole (Stone) is aggressive and self-confident, Mia (Adjani), a former nun, is shy, weak and suicidal. What unites them is a man, Guy, of whom they are respectively the lover and wife.
