And even more unites them the desire to eliminate him, tired of his abuses. Nicole devises a plan and convinces Mia to help her with the execution. The murder succeeds, but disturbing consequences do not take long to manifest ...
notes: In 1954 Henri-Georges Clouzot made "I diabolici", supported by a great trio of actors (Simone Signoret, Véra Clouzot, Paul Meurisse). The structure and ambiguity of the French masterpiece are, in this remake, a pure pretext for a discreet but superficial genre confection: the twists and turns and spectacular forcing stifle the morbidity of the characters. And as for "prevarications", Stone wipes Adjani from the screen.

title: Twelve Monkeys
actors: Bruce Willis, Brad Pitt, Madeleine Stowe, Christopher Plummer, David Morse, Frank Gorshin, Joey Perillo, Lisa Gay Hamilton, Jon Seda, Christopher Meloni
description: In 2035, the survivors of mankind live in an underground world. Ninety-nine percent of the population no longer exists and the earth's surface is now uninhabitable after the terrible 1996 epidemic. As survival is increasingly precarious, a group of scientists seeks to realize the last hope: travel back in time and recover. the resources of the past to save the future.
notes: Freely inspired by Chris Marker's "La Jetée", the film takes up the tradition of the "philosophical" journey through time and through the self-destructive impulses of humanity, adding the strength of macabre laughter and a taste for paradoxical vision.

title: Imaginary Crimes
actors: Harvey Keitel, Kelly Lynch, Fairuza Balk, Vincent D'Onofrio, Chris Penn
description: Ray Weiler has been chasing a "big deal" all his life that should have made him rich and famous. The coup never happened and in the meantime Ray has accumulated a series of defeats. The death of his young wife forced him to take care of his two daughters alone - a task he never adapted to. The life of the family is seen through the eyes of 17-year-old Sonya. The girl remembers the squalor, the disappointments, the lack of communication and her sense of rebellion in the face of her father's defeats. But also remember the rare good times. And he tries to unravel the thread of his memory and his affections. From the autobiographical novel by Davia Nelson, the film fails to rise from a monotonous and annoyingly predictable chronicle of the protagonist's teenage journey.

title: Search and Destroy
actors: Griffin Dunne, Dennis Hopper, Christopher Walken, John Turturro, Rosanna Arquette, Ethan Hawke
description: He has a debt of almost $ 150,000 with the taxman, professionally he is in the stall phase, his wife is about to ask him for divorce, the bankruptcy is around the corner. But Martin Mirkhein, a New York cinematogafico producer, does not intend to give himself up: he wants to make a film based on a book written by a television guru. And his troubles are far from finite ... among the producers (real ones) there is Martin Scorsese, and, probably not by chance, "Search and destroy" recalls in the "re for one night" atmospheres " hours". But despite the cast and goodwill the film is a confused and presumptuous mess; Probably also because of the "artistic" presumptions by David Salle, a debutant in the direction, but a rather well -known painter in America. To each his own job.

title: Primal Fear
actors: Richard Gere, Edward Norton, Laura Linney, Frances McDormand
description: Martin Vail is a brilliant criminal lawyer. He is rich, charming, famous, and above all he is extremely combative and exhibitionist. For this he offers to defend an inexperienced young man accused of murder: everything comes together to point to Aaron, shy, frightened and stammering, as the murderer of a high prelate.
notes: Classic judicial thriller with mild twists, based mostly on the interpretation of Richard Gere.

title: Fargo
actors: Frances McDormand, Steve Buscemi, Peter Stormare, William H. Macy
description: Jerry Lundegaard, a debt-ridden Minnesota auto salesman, decides to have his wife kidnapped and demand a ransom from her wealthy father. To do this, he hires two criminals, Carl and Gaear, who turn out to be very clumsy. Without it being in the plans, the two turn the kidnapping into carnage, killing a policeman and two passers-by who had accidentally witnessed the fact. The situation worsened and the streak of blood lengthened. But on the trail of the killers, the local police chief, Marge Gunderson, a policewoman in the first case of murder and in the seventh month of pregnancy, is unleashed. Impeccable black comedy (Palme d'Or at Cannes in 1996 for directing): ferocious irony, paradoxical dialogues, a series of bizarre and highly guessed figures that chase each other in an exemplary narrative interlocking: nothing is superfluous, and everything works perfectly.

title: Tout le monde n'a pas eu la chance d'avoir des parents communistes
actors: Josiane Balasko, Maurice Bénichou, Catherine Hiegel
description: We are in 1958, in the middle of the cold war. In France, the left is under the illusion of winning the political elections, but it cannot. Irène is a militant of the Communist Party. Her husband Bernard, no. The two love each other, but political militancy disturbs family harmony. But there are two facts that upset Irène's life: the referendum on the constitution proposed by De Gaulle and the arrival in Paris of the Red Army Choir, which brings the woman together with the soloist Ivan ... with great wit, he makes fun of slogans and clichés of the period with the awareness and the easy-going good-naturedness of those who have really experienced certain things.

title: Living in Oblivion
actors: Steve Buscemi, Catherine Keener, Dermot Mulroney, James LeGros, Danielle Von Zernick
description: On the set of Nick Reve, a down-and-out crew puts a strain on their nerves, between the tantrums of the leading actress and her love-hate towards the other performer, the quirks of the director of photography and the cold phlegm of the assistant director . All this makes the atmosphere on the set explosive: it takes nothing to ruin a shot. Until the director wakes up: he's in bed, it's 4.30 in the morning and shooting has yet to begin ...
notes: It had already been done by Truffaut in 1973 with "Night Effect": to captivate the viewer with the repetitiveness of the profession of cinema. Di Cillo re-proposes the topos conveying the fascination of the crazy duality that is found on the set of a film. And he manages to make fun of himself with intelligence and skill.

title: Les Misérables
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Alessandra Martines, Annie Girardot, Michel Boujenah
description: Former inmate Jean Valjean tries to change his life, but is haunted by the evil Inspector Javert, relentless in hunting him down. One day Valjean intervenes to save a young woman, Fantina, who has been arrested by the policeman, and undertakes to take care of her daughter. He will free Cosetta from the oppression suffered in Thenardier's house, and will save her lover wounded during the revolutionary uprisings of 1832. On that same occasion he will also demonstrate all his worth and his magnanimity towards those who had unjustly tormented him.
notes: Loved or hated, "The Miserable" is a novel that made history: even that of cinema, judging by the impressive number of film adaptations. Lelouch insists above all on the private life of the characters and on the contrast between the purity of the "good guys" and the perfidy of the "bad guys".

title: Stardust Memories
actors: Woody Allen, Charlotte Rampling, Jessica Harper, Marie-Christine Barrault
description: Comedy director-actor Sandy Bates is a weekend guest at the old Stardust Hotel, New Jersey. Here he participates in a debate with the public who has seen one of his films, but this is also an opportunity for a sentimental confrontation with three women, one from his past, that of the present and that of a possible future. Bates will ask himself questions about life and its value.
notes: Allen attempts a personal "Eight and a Half", full of perfidious humor, fantastic digressions, "philosophical" yearnings (of Allen's philosophy, of course). A thud at the box office in America, but the author's class is there, and how.

title: Night of the Running Man
actors: Andrew McCarty, Scott Glenn, Janet Gunn, John Glover
description: Jerry Logan, a taxi driver from Las Vegas, carries a passenger who is killed before his eyes. Thus he finds himself with a suitcase containing a million dollars. Unfortunately for him, it's dirty money that the mafia has no intention of giving up. A spooky narrative cue, taken up here without any originality. A genre film and also a low profile one.

title: Conte d'eté
actors: Melvil Poupaud, Amanda Langlet, Aurélia Nolin, Gwenaëlle Simon
description: July 17-August 5. Gaspard goes to the sea on the Breton coast. He installs himself in the house of some friends; then he goes to the beach: a beach crowded with teenagers, facing Saint-Malo. Gaspard is there because he has some kind of date with a girlfriend who is also more "probable" than real. But the girl does not show up, and Gaspard spends his time intertwining gossip, walks, confidences, with two other peers met on the spot. "Conte d'été" develops the themes of "The green ray", however, taking them in different directions. In short, it is a classic Rohmerian, flawless, light, elegant as always. The Italian title is of course completely unmotivated for this refined and acute "summer's tale". Rohmer is more cynical and the dialogue in the film is far less random than it seems on the surface.

title: Il lupo e l'agnello
actors: Michel Serrault, Tomas Milian, Ombretta Colli, Enrico Luzi
description: Leon de Paris was, in France, a hairdresser for dogs, but, after getting married in Italy, he became a "coiffeur pour dames". However, an escapade cost him a state of humiliating subjection to the women of the house (wife, mother-in-law, two daughters). Also, for "shop" reasons, he has to pretend to be gay. When a thug being chased by the police comes to his house, the two are victoriously communal. The idea was to put together the Serrault of the "Vizietto" with the "Monnezza" Tomas Milian. But the comedy only works in tears, with two characters who can't find a meeting point.

title: Lunga vita alla signora!
actors: Marco Esposito, Simona Brandalise, Stefania Busarello, Simona Dalla Rosa
description: In a castle in the mountains, an old lady gathers a table of powerful people for a dinner. A group of young people is called to serve. Among them Libenzio, of very humble origins. The banquet ritual is very meticulous and must be observed with care because the lady does not admit exceptions or innovations. The guests arrive, take their seats and begin a subtle game of prevarication and abuse to gain places in the hierarchical ladder and in consideration of the great lady who appears only at the last, veiled and inaccessible. A bitter and amused apologue on power and death built through the meticulous dinner ceremony, sometimes heavy but sincere, out of the director's usual atmosphere.

title: Accion mutante
actors: Antonio Resines, Frédérique Feder, Alex Angulo, Juan Viadas
description: After five years in prison, Ramon Yarritu cultivates a sensational project to finance his terrorist group called "Mutant Action", made up of horrible handicapped people, against the beautiful, the healthy, the lucky ones in life. It is a question of kidnapping, on the day of her wedding, the daughter of the very rich Orujo and transporting her to the planet Axturias, where the ransom must be paid. But there is a surprise. Produced by Pedro Almodovar and his brother Augustin, Alex De La Iglesia's debut film was intended to be a source of grungy entertainment. The carelessness of the screenplay makes it essentially a vehicle of boredom, with very few advantages.

title: I leoni di Pietroburgo
actors: Mark Damon, Erna Schurer, Gary Wilson, Barbara O'Neil
description: Eldar Kan fights alongside the oppressed in 19th-century Russia. However, he does not know that he is descended from an ancient noble family. Kan, with his deeds, is an obstacle to the expansionist aims of two noble families who try to eliminate him by also resorting to the kidnapping of his girlfriend, Tamila. Confused movie of adventure, sword and alcove.

title: Mamma mia che impressione!
actors: Alberto Sordi, Giovanna Pala, Carlo Giustini, Frank Colson
description: Alberto, a young "explorer" of Don Isidoro's parish, is in love with Margherita, but is unable to attract the attention of the young lady to himself. Instead, he does a lot of trouble, due to his shyness and his dullness. And when he takes part in a foot race, he also risks having a bad time with all the other competitors, enraged by the accidents he caused.
notes: Taking advantage of the ideas of some lucky radio broadcasts that saw him as a protagonist, Sordi mobilized none other than Cesare Zavattini and Vittorio De Sica to script (with him) one of his subjects. But the outcome leaves a lot to be desired.

title: Gangsters
actors: Ennio Fantastichini, Giuseppe Cederna, Isabella Ferrari
description: Genoa, 1945. Three partisans of the Gap have not laid down their arms, determined to find and execute the Nazi-fascist torturers who, thanks to their complicity, are still hiding in the city. The three also hang up their old commander (who has become the lover of a morphine addict) to whom they ask to participate in their actions. It will be he, however, who will cause their end. The attempt to "use" the Resistance as a material from which to extract a strong narrative plot is not new. Unpublished is to want to do it having as a model the gangster film of the forties. This reinterpretation, however, is a bit unrealistic and stylistically pleased.

title: Blue Sky
actors: Jessica Lange, Tommy Lee Jones, Powers Boothe, Carrie Snodgress
description: He is blind and she is crazy. This is the judgment Hank's daughters give of the two parents, a nuclear engineer incorporated into the army, and Carly, his wife of warm temperament and frequent extramarital escapades. The constant shifts from one base to another exacerbate Carly's dissatisfaction, up to an episode more sensational than the others. In the background, the tensions of the "cold war" of the 1960s.
notes: The latest film by Englishman Tony Richardson (Oscar to Jessica Lange), held in storage for two years, is based on the private and political tracks. The first is more convincing, but the whole, however imperfect, is suggestive.

title: Star Trek: Voyager
actors: Kate Mulgrew, Robert Duncan McNeil
description: Voyager is the most modern ship in the Starfleet. Under the command of a woman, the fearless Captain Kathryn Janeway ventures adventurously into the space between mysterious worlds and populations. Pilot episode of a TV series conceived as a continuation of the classic "Star Trek".

title: The Quiet Room
actors: Chloe Ferguson, Celine O'Leary, Paul Blackwell
description: Cloe is a seven-year-old girl. She has her own bedroom, her toys, her goldfish, her parents. But family life hides a deep unease due to the crisis of the girl's parents. And Chloe reacts by stopping to speak. Silent, in her room, while her parents' marriage crashes and disintegrates.
notes: De Heer, director of "Bad Boy Bubby", presented this new story of loneliness at Cannes in 1996. Nice idea and guessed the choice of the young protagonist, who is not cloying like many other children on the screen. Beautiful scenography, aided by a "polite" use of the camera. Too bad only for a certain didacticism and a certain repetitiveness that disperse the claustrophobic tension.

title: Trois vies et une seule mort
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Chiara Mastroianni, Anna Galiena, Marisa Paredes, Melvil Poupaud, Arielle Dombasle, Feodor Atkine, Jean-Yves Gautier, Jacques Pieiller, Pierre Bellemare, Lou Castel, Roland Topor, Jacques Delpi, Jean Badin
description: Three men, one character. A man leaves the house, crosses the street, enters another house and stays there for twenty years; then he returns to his wife and stays with her until his death. A rich anthropology professor decides to be a homeless man and falls in love with Tania, a prostitute from Pigalle. A young couple inherits a nice house as long as the butler keeps it. A businessman invents a family abroad to cover up some financial speculation, and the invention becomes reality. Ruiz has managed to create a philosophical-existential divertissement that is pleasant for anyone who loves an elegant but not affected cinema. Perfect script and superb actors: a film dedicated to the mild pleasure of intelligence.

title: S.F.W.
actors: Joey Lauren Adams, Stephen Dorff, Reese Witherspoon, Jake Busey, Joey Lauren Adams
description: A terrorist group, called Split Image, takes customers of a Madison Height supermarket hostage. Why they do it is not known. What they want is for the TV networks to broadcast the videos of the kidnapping that they are shooting at the moment. Among the hostages the one who does best is Cliff Spab, partly because he is quick in his answers and partly because his favorite line is "So Fucking What". Or how you become heroes even unintentionally, with all the possible satirical notations on the world of media and the like. There are people who have been saying for years that Dorff will become a big movie star. In the meantime, he is getting old.

title: Lipstick Camera
actors: Brian Wimmer, Ele Keats, Corey Feldman, Terry O'Quinn
description: The situation is this: there are two people making love while a third is filming them. The particular thing is that the two people at the center of the lens are husband and wife. The strange thing, however, is that the third party, the author of the shoot, is someone who has nothing to do with it, a stranger to whom the woman simply asked for the favor of moving the camera. What follows proves that the favor was not that simple ... There is never exhibitionism, Freud said, without voyeurism. Just as there is no voyeurism in the cinema without some homicide in between. Just as there is no remedy for the banality of screenwriters. And this may not have been said by Freud, but it is true.

title: Invasion: UFO
directors: Jeremy Summers, David Tomblin, Cyril Fra
actors: Ed Bishop, Mike Billington, Wanda Wentham
description: Against the threat of extraterrestrials, the Pentagon has created a special body named Shado under the orders of Captain Straker. The problem is that aliens are able to control the minds of humans: they hypnotize an astronaut, convince three earthlings to launch suicide attacks against military targets, up to the point of stopping time ...
notes: A film that is actually the reduction of three episodes of the cult series Ufo from the Seventies. The show is excellent, but this adaptation is less successful and cannot compare with the more famous _Star Trek_. Nothing exceptional of course, apart from Captain Straker's irreplaceable straw yellow wig.

title: Heaven Can Wait
actors: Don Ameche, Gene Tierney, Charles Coburn, Eugene Pallette
description: Just dead, Van Cleve tells the devil about his life: he has always been spoiled by his parents, he was soon initiated into the pleasures of the flesh by a young waitress, he loved women very much, but always remained faithful to his wife. Mephistopheles does not consider Van Cleve "worthy" to be hosted among the damned, and directs him to Heaven.
notes: A masterpiece of very elegant, subtle transgression and well-deserved fame, in which the famous "Lubitsch touch" manifests itself to the best of its exquisite abilities, in an amused, fantastic and metaphysical spiritual testament. The interpreters "play the game" as best they could.

title: Any Wednesday
actors: Jane Fonda, Dean Jones, Jason Robards
description: John Cleves is a loyal business executive and husband for ... six days a week. Every Wednesday, in fact, with an excuse he goes to New York where, in the apartment of the company he has installed Ellen, his young lover. One day, however, a representative of the company arrived in the city, mistaking the girl for a "diversion" reserved for guests. Meanwhile, John's wife also arrives. Based on a hit comedy, the film, almost entirely shot indoors, is a brilliant satire on relationships, but also on the American lifestyle of the 1960s.

title: La casa del tappeto giallo
actors: Erland Josephson, Béatrice Romand, Vittorio Mezzogiorno
description: A young lady of the good bourgeoisie has nights and sleeps tormented by nightmares of an Oedipal nature. Nightmares have a common denominator in a yellow carpet that the woman owns and that she now sets about selling, thus convinced to free herself from her phobias. The potential buyer, however, seems to accentuate his fantasies so much that the woman, after having been "questioned" by the client, ends up killing him.
notes: Unrealistic and uselessly specious.

title: Wrong is Right
actors: Sean Connery, George Grizzard, Robert Conrad, Katharine Ross, Leslie Nielsen, Hardy Krüger, Henry Silva, Ron Moody, Cherie Michan, Rosalind Cash, Jennifer Jason Leigh
description: The CIA maneuvers a gigantic international intrigue based on petrodollars, terrorism and the trafficking of nuclear weapons. There are Arabs, Israelis and the President of the United States in between. Two H-bombs, after several passes, are about to raze New York to the ground. Apocalypse Now?
notes: An unscrupulous and reckless television reporter guides us along the war path. The labyrinth of intrigues, murders and the most abject interests serves as a vehicle for an apocalyptic critique of the contemporary world. The script is a bit wheezy, Brooks doesn't always control the film at the end of his career, but Connery is good.

title: La riffa
actors: Monica Bellucci, Giulio Scarpati, Massimo Ghini, Elena Cantatore
description: Francesca, a fresh widow, falls from the stars to the stables. She doesn't fit in and, in agreement with a friendly lawyer, is giving herself away in a sort of lottery: four years with her for the lucky draw. A raffle with 20 tickets for sale at a price of 100 million each. He also has an affair with a penniless and rather interested young man. The raffle scandal is about to break out, but Francesca will be able to come out rich and free.
notes: The film punishes the vulgarity of a consumer society. Too bad it falls into the same vulgarity. Bellucci can't act.

title: Olivier, Olivier
actors: François Cluzet, Brigitte Roüan, Jean-François Stévenin, Faye Gatteau, Emmanuel Morozof, Grégoire Colin, Marina Golovine, Emmanuel Morozof, Florian Billion, Carole Lemerle, Madelaine Marie, Jean-Bernard Josk
description: The Duval family lives in the French countryside: his father Serge is a veterinarian, his wife Elisabeth takes care of the children: Nadine and little Olivier. One day Olivier takes his bicycle and disappears. Inspector Druot takes care of it, but despite his research, the boy is not found. The Duval family falls apart. Six years later Druot finds a boy who could be Olivier on the pavements of Paris and returns him to his family. A discontinuous director, the Polish Holland starts from a true news story, but revisits it according to two interpretations: one paradoxical, the other of ambiguity.

title: Grazie tante - Arrivederci
actors: Carmen Villani, Mario Scarpetta, Memmo Carotenuto
description: Monica, a former model, and Lello, a former seminarian, meet during an organized trip. Around the Peninsula they will learn to know each other and end up getting together. One of the attempts to launch the former singer Carmen Villani in the cinema, but this, like the following ones, will be useless.

title: Mister Johnson
actors: Maynard Eziashi, Pierce Brosnan, Edward Woodward, Beatie Edney
description: Mr. Johnson (Maynar Eziashi) is the personal secretary of Harry Rudbeck (Pierce Brosnan), the administrator of an English colony in West Africa in 1923. Johnson is not a lion-hearted, but he has a cursed desire to marry the young woman. indigenous Bamu. However, he does not have the money to "buy" the woman and this creates problems for him. Based on a Joyce Cary novel, the film tells the tragicomic story of a native who, for a moment, believes he is part of the empire. Beresford puts all his talent into the company, that is, almost nothing.

title: Une femme douce
actors: Dominique Sanda, Guy Frangin, Jane Lobre, Dorothée Blank
description: A woman (Sanda) flies out of a window. In front of the corpse reassembled on the wedding bed, the husband wonders why and goes back with his memory. Think back to the first time they met (at the pawnshop), the marriage, his passion as mad as his jealousy, the time she tried to kill him, her final submission. If you think this is a flamboyant and passionate story, full of twists and turns and extreme feelings, you can see that you have never seen a Bresson film (which here, in adapting Dostoevsky's "La mite", does not allow its characters not even a proper name). But it means that you have never seen the Sanda either, so cold, so sweet. A masterpiece.

title: Due sul pianerottolo
actors: Erminio Macario, Rita Pavone, Margherita Fumero, Gianni Agus
description: At the pension of Maria Boccioni Stagno they are all a bit artists. The violinist Luigi Savoia takes the young Mimma under his protection, who arrived from the province with so many hopes and so much naivety.
notes: Erminio Macario at the end of his career struggling with an unhappy screenplay by Amendola and Corbucci.

title: Une histoire de vent
actors: Joris Ivens, Fu Dalin, Han Zenkiang, Liu Guilian, Liu Zhuang
description: Old Joris is ninety years old, many of whom spent traveling the world making documentaries. Now he is in Mongolia, determined to film the wind that rises (must rise) over the desert. Lyrical and meditative visual poem, it is the spiritual testament of the ninety-year-old director.

title: Where's Poppa?
actors: George Segal, Ruth Gordon, Ron Leibman, Bernard Hughes
description: His father died, his brother married, poor Gordon, a lawyer, is the only one left to take care of his elderly mother, now out of her mind. Faithful to his promise to his father, Gordon does not intend to hospitalize his mother in a hospice, but when the woman's temper and whims threaten to ruin his agreement with the pretty nurse Louise, the situation must be resolved. A theme faced from an uncommon angle. A satire, in the form of farce, of mammism (and also of bloodthirsty militarism), held on remarkable narrative rhythms and excellently acted.

title: The World's Great Lover
actors: Gene Wilder, Carol Kane, Dom DeLuise, Fritz Feld
description: His name is Rudy Valentin, he is a bungling pastry chef and his wife dotes on the almost homonymous and much more famous star. So, he tries it too in Hollywood. Funny taking for a ride on the cinema and its surroundings, even if Wilder egista does not have the immordent of the contemporary parodies of Mel Brooks.

title: Guns of the Magnificent Seven
actors: George Kennedy, James Whitmore, Monte Markham
description: Quintero, leader of the Mexican revolutionaries, is imprisoned along with his faithful. The only one of them who escaped capture hires the gunslinger Chriss to try to free him. Chriss assembles a group of fearless seven and then organizes the attack on the prison.
notes: Anonymous craftsmanship for this sort of response to the western made in Italy of the time.

title: Chi dice donna dice donna
actors: José-Luis De Villalonga, Gigi Proietti, Lea Massari, Stéphane Audran, Françoise Fabian, Jacques François
description: Five episodes. "Business women": neglected by their husbands, Belle and Mimi open a pleasure house. They sell themselves, husbands "buy". "Miss X", suffering from amnesia, is wrong about her husband and children. "The erotic woman": a worker invents herself as a sexy star, but makes a mess. "Papa and Maman": Sonia and Gilbert, professional transvestites, have ... a son. "But they don't marry us": in Sweden, Philip marries a priestess.
notes: The actors have a great time trying to save the script and the script. But, as everyone knows, very little is extracted from a blood turnip. And the concept does not change even if there are five turnips.

title: Cipolla Colt
actors: Franco Nero, Sterling Hayden, Martin Balsam, Dick Butkus
description: Onion bought some land in Paradise City to grow the much-loved onions. But that doesn't appeal to a bully owner of oil wells. A little messy, but fun enough. One of the last roles of the great Sterling Hayden, star of "Johnny Guitar".

title: Rock-a-Bye Baby
actors: Jerry Lewis, Marilyn Maxwell, Connie Stevens, Reginald Gardiner
description: To do a favor for a friend he is in love with, Clayton agrees to take care of the triplets that she intends to keep secret because they could harm her acting career.
notes: Jerry Lewis in shape, without Dean Martin, with an ex-cartoonist director with a demented streak. Inspired by Tashlin's "Miracle of the Village", it has an impeccable rhythm and hints of rather sour satire.

title: The Neptune Factor
actors: Ben Gazzara, Yvette Mimieux, Walter Pidgeon, Ernest Borgnine
description: Following an underwater earthquake, the "Oceanlab II" underwater laboratory is engulfed by a crevasse. Its three occupants are trapped there, leaving oxygen for just one week. Failed the rescue attempt carried out with a normal submarine, it is up to the crew of the bathyscaphe "Neptune" to try.
notes: Underwater adventures with relative shots of some effect, decisive sentimental coloring and inevitable final thrills. You dive between a screenplay without salt and a direction without jolts.

title: The Great Elephant Escape
actors: Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Stephanie Zimbalist, Julian Sands, Leo Burmester
description: Matt and his mother Beverly arrive in Kenya for a two-week vacation. While the divorced young woman awakens the attention of Clive Porter, an Englishman transplanted to Africa, Matt meets Jomo, a Masai peer, and the elephant Ellie. When she is kidnapped by the shady Carlos, the two boys do not hesitate to risk a bad end to find her again. Happy end of practice.
notes: Calm down guys, this George Miller is not the one from "Mad Max" and the "Witches of Eastwick". The crisis of values ??is fine, but there is a limit to everything. There are some well-known faces in this fairy tale for families of television production.

title: Artic Blue
actors: Rutger Hauer, Dylan Walsh, Rya Kihlstedt, Richard Bradford
description: Eric Desmond and his wife live in the forests of Alaska, employed by the multinational that operates an oil pipeline. Eric also looks after poachers. One of them, Ben Corbett, accused of murder, is to be escorted, after the sheriff is dead, to the nearest town, and the assignment falls to Eric. But the prisoner manages to crash the plane carrying him and his keeper ...
notes: The film is built on traditional stereotypes (the not-so-bad outlaw, the honest naive man, the emergence of a virile friendship between the two, etc.). Unusual, however, the setting. And the Alaskan landscapes are a splendor.

title: Exotica
actors: Bruce Greenwood, Elias Koteas, Don McKellar, Mia Kirshner
description: Exotica, a "peep show" where you can watch but not touch, is directed by Zoe, pregnant with Eric, who is a DJ. Christina performs there, undressing for the benefit of Francis, a tax inspector who has lost his wife and daughter. One evening, convinced by Eric, Francis touches Christine and is expelled from the "peep show". Then there's Thomas, who illegally trades in animals. Tragedy touches, painful truths emerge.
notes: Extravagant characters, morbid atmospheres, anti-linear narrative. One of Egoyan's most fascinating films.

title: Pet Sematary 2
actors: Edward Furlong, Antony Edwards, Clancy Brown, Jared Rushton, Fred Gwynne
description: After the death of his mother who was starring in a horror film, 13-year-old Geoff Matthews moves with his father from Los Angeles to the town of Ludlowe. Here the boy has problems with the bully Clyde, while instead he makes friends with the same age Drew, who hates his stepfather, Gus. And Gus, one day, kills Drew's little dog. It is the beginning of an endless series of nightmarish events.
notes: The first "Living Graveyard" was based on a Stephen King short story and it worked. We wanted to give it a follow-up, but, apart from a few marginal ideas, the results are far below those of the original film. As it often happens.

title: Lost Angels
actors: Adam Horovitz, Donald Sutherland, Amy Locane, Dom Bloomfield
description: Tim is a slightly aggressive teenager who can't stand living with his mother and stepfather, whose only concern seems to be wallowing in the wealthy wildlife of Beverly Hills. Thus the boy ends up in a private reformatory, half prison and half psychiatric clinic, where he meets a non-aligned psychiatrist who tries to make him find a liberating balance. The English Hudson ("Moments of Glory", "Greystoke") makes an "uncomfortable" and non-trivial film, with the active collaboration of the young on-screen debut protagonist, Adam Horovitz, of the funky white rap group "Beastie Boys".

title: Il dottor Antonio
actors: Ennio Cerlesi, Maria Gambarelli, Lamberto Picasso
description: In the nineteenth century an English girl who is passing through Livorno is treated by an Italian doctor and falls in love with him. When he, who participates in the riots in Naples in '48, is imprisoned by the Bourbons, the enterprising young lady flies to the aid of her beloved. From a novel by Sergio Ruffini, a film with a traditional structure but solidly set and not without rhythm.

title: Pocket Money
actors: Paul Newman, Lee Marvin, Strother Martin, Wayne Rogers, Hector Elizondo
description: Jim and Leonard, two penniless dreamers, engage in a sale of calves believing they have smelled a great deal. Naive, they run into one trouble after another and eventually discover that they have worked for a cheater even more penniless than them. An example of the evolution of the western, where the place of the classic heroes is taken by more prosaic "dropouts" capable of dreaming and loving life despite every defeat.

title: Codice privato
actors: Ornella Muti
description: Alone, in a luxurious apartment, Anna (Muti) searches on the phone and in the computer of Emilio, a writer who was her pygmalion and who has now abandoned her, for the reasons for her sentimental failure. Artifact work with experimental intentions. Holding back the yawns and irritation, one cannot help but compare this pretentious operation by Maselli to Magnani's monologue in Rossellini's "Amore".

title: Il segreto delle tre punte
actors: Massimo Girotti, Tamara Lees, Umberto Spadaro, Arturo Bragaglia
description: The lawyer Massimo Del Colle returns to Sicily after having fought alongside the Garibaldini. The diligence is attacked by brigands, but a patrol of soldiers, which has arrived in the meantime, foils the attack. Among the occupants of the vehicle, however, one discovers a Bourbon emissary carrying important documents. He tries to escape, but is killed. Maximus takes the place of the emissary to steal the secrets of the Bourbon conspirators. Successful attempt to combine historical and patriotic plot with sentimental adventure in the film. A good craftsmanship swashbuckling, produced by the Sicilian Panaria Film (that of "Vulcano" and "La carrozza d'oro").

title: L'umanoide
actors: Corinne Cléry, Richard Kiel, Leonard Mann
description: Some inhabitants of Metropolis (helped by a mysterious child) fight the evil Brother of the Night who wants to transform everyone into humanoids.
notes: Ordinary administration for this shabby sci-fi apologue made in Italy inspired by Star Wars.

title: Chuka
actors: Rod Taylor, Ernest Borgnine, John Mills, Luciana Paluzzi
description: Chuka, a gunslinger, escorts a stagecoach to Fort Clendennon just in time before the fort is besieged by the Indians. These will make a slaughter of the soldiers, saving only Chuka, who had helped them in the past. A psychological western attentive to the almost documentary reconstruction of the various characters.

title: The Toxic Avenger
actors: Mitchell Cohen, Andrée Maranda
description: Melvin works in a body building gym where he is systematically mocked by everyone for his physique. Then one day he throws himself out the window, falls on a toxic waste truck and becomes a superhero. Disgustingly hilarious, ironic and unwatchable.

title: Storia di fifa e di coltello. Er seguito der Più
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Maurizio Arena, Mario Carotenuto, Ninetto Davoli, Fiorenzo Fiorentini, Anita Durante, Ileana Rigano, Lando Fiorini
description: The new "Er Più" arrives in the Borgo district of Rome and the rivalry with that of San Giovanni returns. It is the parody, with Ciccio and Franco, of the film "Er Più", the one with Celentano. Among the most foolish of the duo.

title: The Haunting of Seacliff Inn
actors: Ally Sheedy, William R. Moses, Louise Fletcher, Lucinda Weist
description: Susan and Mark Richards leave San Francisco to buy an old Victorian house to turn into a "Bed & Breakfast" hotel. Good price and lovely location. Is it possible that everything is so easy? As soon as they take possession of the property, the two new owners discover the catch: the house has a history of grief and blood behind it. Once again the story of the haunted house? Alas, yes!

title: Les voraces
actors: Helmut Berger, Françoise Fabian, Paul Meurisse, Massimo Girotti
description: A young croupier attacks and robs an industrialist of his big win. The woman of the industrialist, who witnessed the attack, fell in love with the croupier, becoming his lover with blackmail. Fierce portrait of a company interested only in success and money.

title: La tratta delle bianche
actors: Eleonora Rossi Drago, Ettore Manni, Mark Lawrence, Vittorio Gassman, Silvana Pampanini, Tamara Lees
description: Alda, pregnant, takes part in a dance marathon to pay the lawyer to her boyfriend Carlo with the prize. He was sent to prison by Manfredi, who wants to lead Alda to the sidewalk. Manfredi, in fact, practices the "white trade" and, to get rid of Carlo who discovered his shady traffic, he had him arrested. However, Carlo manages to escape, he has time to see Alda dying for the last time, then captures Manfredi, but, instead of handing him over to the police, with some friends he improvises a sort of popular court that tries the criminal. Bloody and risque melodrama, written with Antonio Pietrangeli and performed by a cast of stars.

title: Wild Hearts Can't Be Broken
actors: Gabrielle Anwar, Cliff Robertson, Kathleen York, Michael Schloeffling, D. Jussman
description: The events that led Sonora Webster to become a famous acrobat in the 1930s; the number that made her famous was the jump from forty feet, on horseback, into a tub full of water. Becoming blind following an accident, the woman did not surrender to misfortune ...
notes: After a career in the name of horror _ (The murderer sits next to you, Weekend of terror, Who is buried in that house?) _, Miner moves on to comedy and melodrama: two genres that are intertwined in the story of this "exemplary life". The result is a typical good-feeling film about the value of hope and will.

title: Lady Killer
actors: Judith Light, Jack Wagner, Ben Masters, Tracey Gold, Elizabeth Lennie
description: Janice's marriage to her husband is apparently happy; in reality, however, the woman overcomes the boredom of her union by weaving a relationship with a young plastic surgeon, Guy. However, when the situation between Janice and her husband improves, the woman leaves her lover. But Guy does not hear us from that ear and the story is gradually loaded with an increasingly massive dose of drama.
notes: Yet another version of a "mess" as old as the man (and the woman) - that is, since someone began to cornify the spouse - represented countless times. In such a vein, the film fits without particular merits, but also without infamy.

title: Not as a Stranger
actors: Robert Mitchum, Olivia de Havilland, Frank Sinatra, Gloria Grahame
description: Lucas Marsh (Mitchum) studies medicine hard. When he runs out of money for university, he marries Cristina, the head nurse of a very wealthy family. Even after graduating, his passion for the profession remains all-encompassing, so much so that his wife leaves him. Then a dramatic accident threatens to cause his downfall.
notes: Kramer's directorial debut unfolds with some moralistic excess, but several notations in the construction of the characters are remarkable. And the interpreters are excellent.

title: Il letto in piazza
actors: Renzo Montagnani, Rossana Podestà, John Ireland, Franco Bracardi, Daniele Formica
description: The town is small, but Luca Reali has conquered all the women “on the square”, from the pharmacist to the barman's daughter. One day, Luca saves an American girl from suicide, but for once he refrains from seducing her, with the result that she falls in love with him. Attracted by the dollars of the girl's family, fellow citizens push for the wedding, but Luca has other plans ...
notes: Just to give a patina of nobility to the operation, this film is based on a novel by Nantas Salvalaggio. Just to explain that instead it is the usual itchy and provincial comedy, there is Renzo Montagnani as the protagonist.

title: Supertotò
actors: Totò, Peppino De Filippo, Isa Barzizza, Sophia Loren
description: Seven chapters ("The mask", "The women", "The art of getting by", "The hunger", "The rich", "The bullies", "The variety") to summarize the film career of one of the personalities most loved of the Italian show.
notes: Sober homage to the great comedian, with some of his funniest sketches.

title: The Third Secret
actors: Stephen Boyd, Jack Hawkins, Richard Attenborough
description: A psychoanalyst dies, the police think they are facing a suicide. However, one of his patients is not convinced and begins to investigate. Thus five stories intertwine to form a philosophical thriller, very dialogued and ambitious, but not devoid of suspense.

title: January Man
actors: Kevin Kline, Susan Sarandon, Harvey Keitel, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio
description: Detective Frank Starkey, to catch a serial killer, enlisted the help of Nick, his brother, a former policeman. Rust runs between the two: Nick got into trouble to get Frank out of it (a corruption case). Furthermore, he married the woman the other loved one. Despite this, Nick agrees to take the case. He soon finds himself against the whole police force, which is in a hurry to close the case ...
notes: Pat O'Connor had made his debut with a beautiful and unusual film, _A Month in the Country_. In this detective story with a comedy vein, the director takes a step back. Despite the slap-up cast, there's no getting out of an uninteresting normality.

title: The Curse of the Fly
actors: Brian Donlevy, Carole Gray, George Baker, Michael Graham
description: A young man escapes from a psychiatric hospital and believes he will find generous hospitality with the extravagant Delmabre family. But it is only an illusion: he ends up involved in the relentless attempts of the Delambre to make the famous material transfer machine work ...
notes: In today's eyes, the "make-up" appears dramatically inadequate and the script is not exactly excellent. But the atmosphere is very engaging and, after so many years, it continues to be quite effective. During the 1950s, several films were made on similar themes (science and attempts to manipulate matter).

title: Le baiser de Tosca
actors: Sara Scuderi, Giovanni Puligheddu, Leonida Bellon, Salvatore Locapo
description: The elderly opera singers guests of the Milanese retirement home designed for them by Giuseppe Verdi tell their life on stage. An original and effective docudrama, enhanced by the palpable emotional charge invested by the old bel canto lions.

title: La furia di Ercole
actors: Brad Harris, Brigitte Corey, Mara Berni, Serge Gainsbourg
description: While traveling through the territories of the king of Nisia, his old friend, Hercules of Thebes is informed by Daria, the handmaid of Queen Cnidia, that the king has long since died and his daughter, Cnidia, has seized power and it is united with the violent Menisto, who does nothing but oppress the people with the help of mercenary troops. Hercules will do all he can to thwart their plans. Naive, spectacular and populist, according to the canons of the genre. Brigitte Corey is actually Luisella Boni.

title: Ocean's Eleven
actors: Frank Sinatra, Dean Martin, Sammy Davis jr., Peter Lawford
description: A war veteran gathers former comrades to combine a series of heists in Las Vegas. Complete Sinatra clan and in great shape, Martin Scorsese likes it very much.

title: Continuavano a chiamarli er Più e er Meno
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Didi Perego, John Bartha
description: Franco Pietrasicca and Prince Francisco Ribanera de Espinosa, one just out of jail the other penniless noble, team up to try to trick a millionaire uncle. Posing as a South American prelate in search of funds, Franco manages to get a nice pile of millions delivered. Usual comedy of the two Sicilian comedians at the apex (so to speak) of fame.

title: Greyfriars Bobby: The True Story of a Dog
actors: Donald Crisp, Laurence Naismith, Alexander Mckenzie
description: A terrier dog, in the Edinburgh of the last century, moves the city for the extraordinary attachment to its master. Remake of "The Return of Lassie", is a British production with all the charm of the best Disney recipes: good feelings, irresistible animals, effective reconstruction of the environment.

title: Blink
actors: Madeleine Stowe, Aidan Quinn, Laurie Metcalf, James Remar
description: Emma, ??a young violinist, has been blind since childhood. When the corneas are transplanted, she starts seeing again but, temporarily, she has a delayed identification faculty. Thus, the day the woman who lives above her is killed, Emma "sees" the killer but is only able to identify him after many hours. And the killer had come for her: he had just made the wrong plan and, of course, he will come back. Who knows if this case of "retroactive vision" is scientifically reliable; as for the film, there are, interestingly, some nuanced, marginalized subjective subjects, but almost nothing else.

title: La vie sexuelle des belges
actors: Jean-Henri Compère, Noé Francq, Isabelle Legros, Sophie Schneider
description: Jan lives in a small village with her parents, a little sister and an aunt. The boy is a reserved type who, during the summer holidays, suffers his first love disappointment. Grown up, he goes to Brussels and, when he thinks the right time has come, he gets married. But his marriage fails and, at the end of the day, Jan is torn between the belief that it is difficult to bear women and the inability to do without them. Bucquoy, known as a "cultural provocateur", made his debut in the cinema with a film with anarchic traits both in content and form, capable of saying very serious things.

title: The Last Outlaw
actors: Mickey Rourke, Dermot Mulroney, Ted Levine, Steve Buscemi
description: The protagonist is a southern landowner, overwhelmed by the Secession war in which he lost, at the hands of the enemies of the North, his wife and three daughters, raped and killed. To live, after the defeat, he was forced with his soldiers to become a robber. Now, escaping after a robbery becomes an opportunity to settle scores between this hard-hearted boss indifferent to the pain of others, and his own.
notes: Draft copy of Sam Peckinpah, with swerves in the trash. But with Mickey Rourke starring, you can't expect much more.

title: Four Men and a Prayer
actors: Loretta Young, Richard Greene, George Sanders, David Niven
description: The four sons of Colonel Loring Leigh undertake to rehabilitate the memory of their father unjustly expelled from the army. It's not Ford's most loved film, nor his best, but the story, split between respect for authority and the right to rebel, works.

title: Class of Nuke'Em High
actors: Janelle Brandy, Gilbert Brenton, Robert Prichard
description: Tromaville High School is hit by a lot of radiation. Chrissy and Warren are partially saved, having a baby, or rather a lizard. Pure kitsch.

title: Romuald & Juliette
actors: Daniel Auteuil, Firmine Richard
description: Juliette is the cleaning lady, Romulad is her boss. Juliette is black and has five children with five different men. Romuald is white, has a wife who cheats on him and a scandal is coming. The two fall in love. Will they be able to crown their "dream of love" in spite of all prejudices?
notes: The story is not very original, but the mix between the two main actors is excellent, and Serreau still offers some nice counter-current situations.

title: Chato's Land
actors: Charles Bronson, Jack Palance, James Withmore, Richard Basehart
description: We are in New Mexico, in 1873, a time and a place in which, for a "half-breed", killing a white sheriff, albeit in self-defense, means condemning oneself to persecution and flight. This is what happens to Chato (Bronson), half white and half Apache. When the pursuers attack his family, Chato thinks back, decides to face them and takes them down one by one. The Winner-Bronson duo, for once on vacation from the saga of the "executioner of the night", moves to the West and builds a film substantially identical to the others. Good craft, a good dose of violence and, thank goodness, a good cast.

title: Caravan
actors: Stewart Granger, Anne Crawford, Dennis Price, Jean Kent, Robert Helpmann
description: Richard Darrel is the son of a poor country doctor who is madly in love with the young Oriana. The rich Francis is also in love with the girl. To make money and thus get married, Richard agrees to follow a shipment of jewels to Spain, but the hit men paid by Francis also leave on his trail. Exotic made by Gainsborough. Very exaggerated, very artificial and also very romantic, but these were the rules of the game in the genre.

title: Unstrung Heroes
actors: John Turturro, Andie MacDowell, Michael Richards, Maury Chaykin, Nathan Watt
description: They collect everything that the rest of the people throws and stipulate it in their home, a real anthrole of the esolito or a wonderland. These are the uncles of Steven, a twelve -year -old boy who, overwhelmed by a coexistence that has become unsustainable (with a mother who turns off day by day and a man emotionally distant) escapes to go and live with the uncles. This is where the journey that will lead him to understand life.
notes: Written by Richard La Gravennese and directed by Diane Keaton the film is basically "female". Not only for her part of her reserved for her mother Andie Mac Dowell, but above all for the lightness with which Keaton touches the trauma of death and the dimension of solitary light up. Environmental reconstruction accurate. Too bad that sometimes the film will turn to himself and he never really manages to reconcile the bizarre with the tragedy.

title: Echo Park
actors: Tom Hulce, Susan Dey, Michael Bowen, Christopher Walker
description: May would like to be an actress, but after working as a waitress in a bar for a while, she embarks on a career as a home stripper. August, a bodybuilder of Austrian origin, aspires to follow in Schwarzenegger's footsteps; it will end up in advertising. Jonathan writes songs with no future and makes ends meet as a pizza delivery boy. Three dropouts among which friendship, solidarity and affectionate intertwining runs. First work, presented in Venice in 1985, which met with a certain consensus. Tom Hulce, fresh from the glories of "Amadeus", moves in more common atmospheres; overall, Echo Park, a suburb of Los Angeles, acquires a familiar air, like the three protagonists.

title: Il presidente del Borgorosso Football Club
actors: Alberto Sordi, Margarita Lozano, Tina Lattanzi, Omar Sivori
description: Benito (Sordi), an obscure Vatican employee, inherits the Borgorosso team from his father, a winemaker. At first, his interest in the team is low. But, after several defeats, Benito takes matters into his own hands, replaces the coach personally, hires a "magician" of the South American football and wins back the fans. Written, performed and over-performed by Sordi, it is one of those films that lack air. Sure, he knows how to fill the scene, how to make himself nice, and he gets a lot of the right moves, but he eats the movie.

title: All'onorevole piacciono le donne
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Lionel Stander, Laura Antonelli, Corrado Gaipa, Eva Czemerys
description: The Honorable Giacinto Puppis is in the running for the Quirinale, when he, up to then very sober, absolutely chaste, even inhibited, "discovers" the joys of sex and makes it hard and raw, even in a convent for women. But a monsignor, of which Puppis is politically the creature, by all means, also resorting to the criminal help of the mafia, manages to get his protégé elected anyway. Do not mislead the alleged "political" references of the story: in reality the film is a vulgar and vulgar farce, without the slightest intent of satire.

title: Appuntamento a Ischia
actors: Domenico Modugno, Maria Letizia Gazzoni, Mina, Antonella Lualdi, Carlo Croccolo
description: Mimmo, a widowed singer, has a nine-year-old daughter, Letizia, who she has to carry with her during the long and numerous tours. Mimmo's partner, Mercedes, advises him to put the child in boarding school, but Letizia meets a girl, Mirella, who seems ideal to her to become his second mother. And he will do so much that his father will "unload" Mercedes and everything will end, as expected, in the best possible way. The views of Ischia, in fact, are not bad; the songs are pleasant (Mina sings Il cielo in una stanza and Una zebra a pois), the plot is overwhelming. In the annals (so to speak) of cinema for the debut of Pippo Franco (a guitarist) and Franchi-Ingrassia (two smugglers).

title: Hackers
actors: Jonny Lee Miller, Lorraine Bracco, Angelina Jolie, Matthew Lillard
description: Zero Cool - real name Dade Murphy - is a legend among her peers. In 1988, he alone blew 1507 computers on Wall Street, creating global financial chaos. Eleven-year-old Dade Murphy has been banned from using any keyboard by the FBI. Even that of the telephone. It's been seven long years now ... Kate Libby - aka Acid Burn - owns a "rigged" laptop. When Zero Cool collides with Acid Burn, the war of the sexes moves to the hard drive. But the situation changes completely when the two combine their resources to fight "The Plague", a master of cyber sabotage hired by a giant company that uses its extraordinary genius to crush the competition.
notes: Almost a western set in the virtual world. Anonymous actors except Lorraine Bracco (and of course Angelina Jolie, but at the time very young and still almost unknown). The director had made a name for himself in Great Britain with "Backbeat", a film about the beginnings of the Beatles.

title: The Admirable Crichton
actors: Kenneth More, Diane Cilento, Cecil Arker, Sally Ann Howes
description: Lord Loam, a wealthy English landowner, having lost his wife, lives with his three daughters in a luxurious castle near London. Man professes, at least in theory, advanced ideas in terms of social equality. His ideas, however, are not shared by his irreproachable butler Crichton, who holds the reins of the domestic company. A tea served at the same time to aristocratic guests and the servants is enough to cause such a scandal, as to force Lord Loam to flee. Remake of a 1934 musical ("We're Not Dressing") unreleased in Italy.

title: Un tentativo sentimentale
actors: Françoise Prevost, Jean-Marc Bory, Gabriele Ferzetti, Giulio Bosetti
description: Carla and Dino, with their marriages in crisis, meet and begin a relationship that is not perfect due to his "cowardice". Some atmosphere a little Antonioni style, today very dated. Franciosa and Festa Campanoile will find their dimension in comedy.

title: Giugno '44: sbarcheremo in Normandia
actors: Michael Rennie, Bob Sullivan, Lee Burton
description: A very risky mission (the destruction of a German radio station) is entrusted to the worst elements of the American army, all scum with creepy criminal records. The task is accomplished, but the toll is extremely heavy: only one of the "heroes" is saved. This Mankiewicz has nothing to do with the "real" one (in fact his name is Leon Klimowski) and the film is an incredible "hoax".

title: The Italian Job
actors: Michael Caine, Noël Coward, Maggie Blye, Benny Hill, Raf Vallone
description: How to steal four million dollars from Fiat by creating frightening traffic jams. But there is the unexpected. Hilariously "exaggerated".

title: Justice in a Small Town
actors: Kate Jackson, John Shea, Terry O'Quinn, Beth Broderick
description: To make ends meet, Sandra, divorced with two children, gets hired by the Georgia Ministry of Labor. Here he soon realizes the climate of corruption and violence that reigns there with the forced connivance of almost all the employees who are silent for fear of losing their jobs. Despite this, however, Sandra denounces the situation, luckily backed up by Tommy, a colleague who shows some sentimental interest in her. The complaint finally materializes to the point of bringing in the FBI.
notes: In this curious story of American-style Tangentopoli, what is most surprising is not so much the happy end as the fact that corruption is considered an absolute exception to the rule.

title: Death Dreams
actors: Christopher Reeve, Marg Helgenberger, Fionnula Flanagan
description: Rich and happily married, the protagonist has to face a family tragedy: her little daughter dies. On the verge of madness, he manages to get out of it only thanks to the belief that he can communicate with the little deceased. She is helped by an eccentric psychiatrist; the only one who does not believe in such a possibility is the husband: does he do it out of his personal skepticism or because he hides something? Drama tinged with yellow and parapsychology. Discreet interpretation of the protagonists, but the story is carried on without script ideas: in the end everything is rather predictable and not free from sloppiness.

title: Mask
actors: Richard Dysart, Eric Stoltz, Cher, Sam Elliott, Richard Dysart
description: Sixteen-year-old Rocky Dennis suffers from leontiasis, a monstrous deformation of the skull, but is gifted with lively intelligence and a lot of wisdom; more than his mother, who took refuge in drugs and leads a life that is certainly not exemplary. But their relationship is fruitful, as is that with the "lively" band of their friends. Rocky's fate, however, is sealed.
notes: A true story, which Bogdanovich tells by prodigiously avoiding all the traps of pathetism and giving the film a strong, exciting structure, with the help of very effective interpreters, first of all an extraordinary Cher (who won the Palme d'Or at the Festival of Cannes).

title: L'ultimo uomo della Terra
actors: Vincent Price, Franca Bettoja, Emma Danieli, Giacomo Rossi Stuart
description: Scientist Robert Morgan is the last man on Earth: in the sense that the rest of the human race has been wiped out by a terrible epidemic, which has turned everyone into hideous vampires. The lonely Morgan is forced to organize a personal resistance: at night he barricades himself at home between garlic and mirrors, during the day he wanders around the city in search of basic necessities, armed with ash stakes ...
notes: Surprising Italian B-movie based on the novel I am Legend by Richard Matheson (later remade in 1971 with Charlton Heston and in 2007 with Will Smith). Shot in the EUR district of Rome, it is made spooky by the beautiful photography by Franco Delli Colli.

title: Tempest
actors: John Cassavetes, Gena Rowlands, Vittorio Gassman, Susan Sarandon, Raul Julia
description: The New York architect Dimitrios decides that he is fed up with the life of the metropolis and his boss Alonzo and goes, together with his daughter Miranda, to Greece. Once in Athens, the two leave, in the company of Aretha, for a remote island where the shepherd Kalibanos lives alone. On the same island, due to a storm, Alonzo, his son Freddy and Antonia, Dimitrios' wife. Mazursky wastes a fairytale cast on a rather grueling Scespirian adaptation. The Greek landscapes and some successful moments do not save the operation, which however counts at least on an amazing Cassavetes.

title: Les vierges de Rome
actors: Louis Jourdan, Sylvia Syms, Ettore Manni, Corrado Pani
description: Despite the valor of Orazio Coclite, Porsenna imposes his conditions on Rome, won thanks to the help of the barbarian Drusus. The requested hostages are chosen from among the women who fought alongside Clelia. While Drusus and Porsenna are inclined to forge an alliance with Rome, the Greek Strabos, their ally, is determined to destroy the city.
notes: Peplum as imaginative as all those of Cottafavi (who however abandoned it halfway due to contrasts with the production), is one of Bertrand Tavernier's favorite films.

title: Il coraggio di parlare
actors: Gian Luca Schiavoni, Riccardo Cucciolla, Lello Arena, Giuliana Calandra
description: A Calabrian boy risks becoming part of the 'Ndrangheta. He first emigrated to Milan, then returned and had the local bosses arrested, causing a healthy awareness of the young people of the country. Bad pseudo-denunciation film, based on a horrible children's novel, made by a dull "educational" author (his is also the biography of Don Bosco with Gazzara).

title: Strangers When We Meet
actors: Kim Novak, Kirk Douglas, Barbara Rush, Walter Matthau
description: Larry, happily married to Eva, has a new neighbor, Margaret, the victim of a failed marriage. The two fall in love, oppressed by feelings of guilt and the fear of being discovered. This is done by a friend of Larry's, who, after being rejected by Eva, reveals everything to her. From the novel by Evan Hunter, written by the same. The cast is attractive, the protagonists chosen to measure. The story is tearful enough. Quine's direction is ordinary.

title: The World Moves On
actors: Madeleine Carroll, Franchot Tone, Reginald Denny, Sig Ruman, Louise Dresser, Raul Roulien
description: The American and German branch of a large family divided by the Great War and then gathered by the love and crisis of '29. Historical-family meatloaf, directed with efficiency but without great inspiration from Ford.

title: Judge Priest
actors: Will Rogers, Tom Brown, Anita Louise
description: A judge is accused of bias by an up-and-coming lawyer who would like his place, but is able to prove his good faith. Southern tale with comedian Will Rogers, gay but intense in narrating the small and large intolerances of the West. Written by Lamar Trotti and Dudley Nichols.

title: It Happened to Jane
actors: Doris Day, Jack Lemmon, Ernie Kovacs
description: Jenny is a young widow who owns a lobster farm. A batch of the prized crustaceans arrives spoiled at its destination: the fault lies with the railway and Jenny sues the owner, a powerful capitalist named Malone. A lively comedy openly deployed in defense of the rights of small businesses in the face of the overwhelming power of monopolies, so to speak.

title: Bell Book and Candle
actors: James Stewart, Kim Novak, Jack Lemmon, Ernie Kovacs, Elsa Lanchester
description: Young Shop (Stewart), editor, is about to marry Merle. Except that there is Gil (Novak), a witch pupil, who, by putting into practice the teachings of an aunt (witch in service), makes him fall in love. So Shop leaves his girlfriend and courts Gil (who, however, precisely as a witch, cannot really fall in love). And before everything works out for the best, some good things have to happen. The film is based on a skilful script, on the actors, on a well-sustained pace. Besides, what man wouldn't be bewitched by Kim Novak?

title: Hook, Line and Sinker
actors: Jerry Lewis, Anne Francis, Peter Lawford, Pedro Gonzales Gonzales
description: Peter's peaceful existence, married with offspring, is suddenly upset by a terrible medical diagnosis: he only has a few months left to live. So, let it be at least a good life: and away with the crazy expenses, with debts that he will not pay anyway. Instead it was a mistake: Peter is healthy as a fish but, at this point, he is also very inguaiatissimo. And your doctor has an idea ...
notes: When Jerry Lewis unleashes his comedy puppetry, the film is sufficiently enjoyable because the protagonist is - as always - a true force of nature. Then unfortunately there is everything else, and here the positive notes are scarce: indeed, to be honest, they are almost non-existent.

title: The Gate
actors: Stephen Dorff, Louis Tripp, Christa Denton, Kelly Rowan, Jennifer Irwin
description: Glen and Al are two friends, united by family loneliness and a passion for the occult sciences and rock. Reconnecting disparate elements, they guess that the demons are working to take over Glen's home.
notes: The film mixes situations and characters typical of horror, in the umpteenth version of the eternal war between "normality" and the supernatural. All with an eye to the young audience.

title: Angélique, marquise des anges
actors: Michèle Mercier, Claude Giraud, Robert Hossein, Rosalba Neri
description: In the France of the Sun King, the noble Angelica falls in love with the son of the castle farmer, Nicholas, but is forced to marry Jeoffrey de Peyrac. Despite his unpleasant appearance, the nobleman wins the heart of Angelica, who will fight for him when he falls from grace. Having been executed her husband, Angelica takes refuge in the Court of Miracles, where she finds her beloved Nicola.
notes: First film in a long series based on the novels of Anne and Serge Golon. Easy rhythm and sumptuous scenography for the transposition on the screen of an altogether pleasant feuilleton. Michèle Mercier, beautiful, became a star ..

title: The Life an Extraordinary Adventure of Private Ivan Chonkin
country: Great Britain, France, Italy, Czech Republic, Russia
actors: Gennadij Nazarov, Zora Buriajak, Vladimir Ilyn, Valerij Zolotuchin
description: In a village in the USSR, in 1941, Ivan is commanded to guard a plane forced to make a crash landing and "forgotten" there. Actually, he gets along fine, he becomes the lover of a peasant woman with robust appetites, but with the German invasion things get complicated because there are those who denounce him as a deserter. A real battle breaks out for him, but the end is happy.
notes: Vladimir Vojnovic, for the novel from which the film is based, was expelled from the USSR twenty years ago. Director Jiri Menzel, who has had a lot of trouble from the Czechoslovakian communist power, takes a tasty revenge and ridicules the idiocies of the regime.

title: Sodoma e Gomorra
actors: Stewart Granger, Anna Maria Pierangeli, Stanley Baker, Rossana Podestà, Anouk Aimée
description: Lot, chief of a Jewish tribe, leads his people across the desert to the promised land. A camp is built near Sodom and Gomorrah. Lot marries Ildith, the queen's slave. After the victory over the Ammonites, the Jews get involved in the vices of Sodom. God helps Loth and his daughters escape and then destroys the city.
notes: Boring meatloaf listlessly directed by Aldrich away. Leone does what he can in mass scenes.

title: Vogliamo i colonnelli
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Claude Dauphin, Duilio Del Prete, Giuseppe Maffioli
description: Far-right deputy Giuseppe Tritoni (Tognazzi) organizes a coup, but interior minister Li Masi makes the enterprise fail. The Head of State, threatened by Tritoni, dies of a heart attack and Li Masi, acclaimed as "savior of the fatherland", implements some anti-parliamentary and anti-constitutional measures. Tritoni, years later, resells his project to African opponents.
notes: Comedy with a political inspiration (made after the attempted Borghese coup), in reality it disperses much of its message in the accentuated farcical climate. A discreet flavor of anti-militarist satire and a great Tognazzi remain.

title: L'uomo del colpo perfetto
actors: Richard Harrison, Alida Chelli, Luis Davila
description: Agent Steve Norton investigates the disappearance of a shipment of diamonds en route from Lebanon to Amsterdam. The manager looks like a French colleague of his, but the gang leader is actually someone else. A film devoid of originality and that minimum of rhythm necessary to not fall asleep.

title: Montana Belle
actors: Jane Russell, George Brent, Scott Brady
description: Her husband is killed while carrying out a robbery, she is saved from lynching by the Dalton brothers who want her as a partner in their bandit enterprises. But she has the temperament of the boss. Pre-cooked and melodramatic Western, with Jane Russell. Shot in 1948, it wasn't released until four years later.

title: Scream and Scream Again
actors: Vincent Price, Christopher Lee, Peter Cushing
description: A mad scientist builds supermen in the laboratory composed of parts selected from different human beings. Its goal is the conquest of the world. Energetic and well-built British production, which aligns a trio of cult actors from the horror genre in the cast.

title: Tickle Me
actors: Elvis Presley, Julie Adams, Jocelyn Lane
description: Unemployed and hired at a ranch-beauty salon to look after the horses, a singing cowboy rescues a girl and her belongings from bad guys. Bespoke production for Elvis Presley, with an unexpected surge of tension in the finale.

title: Femme Fontaine: Killer Babe for the C. I. A.
actors: Margot Hope, Catherine Dao, James Hong, David Shark
description: Drew Fontaine (Hope) is a killer by profession, although at the moment her mission is to find her father, a spy who disappeared in South America in 1986. Investigations lead her first to a porn film producer in Los Angeles. , who launders dirty money on behalf of a Chinatown boss, then by a tai chi master, and then on to a neo-Nazi organization. Margot Hope writes, directs, interprets and produces, all together. And what comes out of it is, from a technical point of view at least, a notch above the average of the Troma films. However, this does not mean that the plot does not make sense.

title: A Woman Scorned
actors: Andrew Stevens, Shannon Tweed, Stephen Young, Dan McVicar
description: Truman Langley escaped to a tropical island with Alex Weston's secretary leaving his wife Patricia (Shannon Tweed) alone, penniless and obviously distraught. The blame for all this must be Alex's, Patricia thinks, not too lucid yet. So, using the name of Amanda Cressfield, she sneaks into the Weston house, ready to do anything to get her revenge. Shannon Tweed, despite her young age, must have already made two or three dozen films in which she plays the part of the fatal woman, a little obsessive, capable of seducing anyone with a snap of her fingers. A constancy which is, moreover, worthy of a better cause.

title: The Oklahoma Kid
actors: James Cagney, Humphrey Bogart, Rosemary Lane, Ward Bond
description: In the city of Tulsa, the Kincaids and the McCords clash. The old Kincaid ends up in jail with a non-existent charge that will lead him to the gallows anyway. His son vows to avenge him. Cagney is the good guy (so to speak) fighting the bad Bogart, in a stereotypical and foolish western.

title: Purple Rain
actors: Prince, Apollonia Kotero, Olga Karlatos, Morris Day, Clarence Williams III
description: A black guy from Minneapolis struggles to break into the world of rock.
notes: History is loffia, music is not. However, Prince is more interesting on stage than in a movie like that. The song "When Doves Cry" won the Oscar.

title: So Goes My Love
actors: Myrna Loy, Don Ameche, Rhys Williams
description: A girl from Boston (Myrna Loy) is looking for a satisfying, comfortable and rich marriage. Instead, it falls on a certain Hiram Stephen Maxim (Don Ameche), an inventor by profession and an economic solidity close to zero. But marriage works. The two main actors make us forget the thinness of the story and the paucity of the direction.

title: Nero
actors: Sergio Castellitto, Chiara Caselli, Luis Molteni, Hugo Pratt
description: Between Federico (Sergio Castellitto) and Zardo there is only Francesca (Chiara Caselli) in common. But Federico ends up finding Zardo's corpse in his hands, only to take his place and make everyone believe that the other is still alive. Based on a novel by Tiziano Sclavi, it is directed by a former advertiser and feels, in a bombastic and somewhat vacant style. It is the last appearance in the cinema of Hugo Pratt, the music is by Guccini and Mau Mau.

title: Gleaming the Cube
actors: Christian Slater, Steven Bauer, Art Chudabala, Peter Kwong
description: Brian only thinks about skateboarding; his brother Vihn, adopted son of Vietnamese origin, is instead all study and work. When Vihn is killed, Brian is the one to discover the culprits.
notes: Good pace and discreet hold for an unusual film set in the world of skaters. The cast highlights a really good Christian Slater.

title: Crash Landing: The Rescue of Flight 232
actors: Charlton Heston, Richard Thomas, James Coburn, Leon Russom
description: In 1989, Volo 232 of the United Airlines falls on Sioux Falls Nello Iowa. From the moment it is clear that the only hope is that of an emergency landing, the captain of the plane (heston) does everything he can to limit the damage. But what is most important is that even on the ground, the managers of the town have ready an emergency plan. Then the plane falls and the work begins. It is not exactly the usual movie menagram to avoid if you have an exotic holiday scheduled. It is more attentive to the post-glue than to the description of the first, but, despite this, in the end it is not original too much.

title: Face the Music
actors: Patrick Dempsey, Molly Ringwald, Lysette Anthony
description: Lisa and Charlie Hunter were a successful musical duo. Now, after the divorce, he deals with a construction company and thinks he has closed with the songs. When a film producer asks Lisa and Charlie di Comore for a song for her film, Charlie understands the mistake made by abandoning the world of light music, but now it seems late to start again since she is about to marry another woman, Julie, contrast to the reconstitution of the duo. Lisa, however, does not give up and tries to convince the old partner to leave his lover jealous and resume the old profession.

title: Rosemary's Baby
actors: John Cassavetes, Mia Farrow, Ruth Gordon, Elisha Cook
description: Guy is a theatrical actor, his wife is called Rosemary and she is expecting a baby. The neighbors, the Castevets, are very cordial, even if a little intrusive. And Rosemary is a bit apprehensive and paranoid, even if you have to understand her if she gets a little anxious in her state. Perhaps the founding film of modern horror, and perhaps Polanski's masterpiece. The (unsustainable) tension is created starting from a meticulous realism, and a bright and crowded New York becomes the place of terror par excellence, of the coexistence of ancestral fears and metropolitan phobias. The almost "minimalist" finish is shocking. Oscar to Ruth Gordon for Best Supporting Actress.

title: Un eroe dei nostri tempi
actors: Alberto Sordi, Franca Valeri, Giovanna Ralli, Tina Pica
description: Alberto (Sordi) grew up fearful and fearful that everything and everyone will conspire to damage him. Employed in a hat factory, he has a widow as head of office who maneuvers to get married by him who, moreover, has no desire to. One night when he was away from home, an attack causes some people to be injured and Alberto is suspected. He will get away with it and decide to join the Celere. Too confused and fragmented, the story relies excessively on Sordi's histrionics, but precisely because of this fragile structure it ends up losing part of its satirical value, even if it does not lack hilarious ideas.

title: Appuntamento in riviera
actors: Tony Renis, Mina, Graziella Granata, Francesco Mulè
description: Tony Renis signs a contract without taking a careful look at the clauses it contains. So, after getting married, he discovers that the famous contract forbade him for two years. Once the contract itself has changed hands, the new impresario announces the upcoming wedding of Tony Renis with Mina (who is already engaged). And we arrive at the day when the wedding should take place ... A purely "food" film for Mario Mattoli (like so many of his "opus"). For singers, a way to exploit the period of maximum notoriety. For the public of that time, well-known songs and voices. For today's, Mina aside, almost nothing.

title: Three on a Couch
actors: Jerry Lewis, Janet Leigh, Mary Ann Mobley, Gila Golan
description: Chris, an advertising designer, has earned a prestigious job in Paris and asks his fiancée, the psychiatrist Elizabeth, to marry him and follow him to the Ville Lumière. But Elizabeth is treating three girls with a persistent hatred of men and she does not intend to abandon them. Then Chris impersonates three different men and overcomes the phobias of Elizabeth's patients. Jerry Lewis directed by himself works well in terms of macchiettistica vivacity, transformism, puppetry. Irresistible moments, soft and nightmarish comedy tones.

title: Who Was That Lady?
actors: Janet Leigh, Tony Curtis, Dean Martin, James Whitmore
description: David, assistant professor of chemistry, is surprised by his wife kissing a girl and now risks divorce. Desperate, he asks for help from his friend Mike, a television screenwriter, and the latter immediately offers him a way out: it will be enough to make his wife believe that he is a secret agent. She believes it, but after a while the FBI and foreign spies arrive too. And they believe it too. Comedy tailored to the couple Tony Curtis-Janet Leigh (Jamie Lee Curtis' parents), who (married for ten years in reality) for the whole film quarrel with each other. Pleasant, but far from irresistible.

title: Grizzly
actors: Christopher George, Joan McCall, Joe Dorsey, Andrew Prine
description: Two campers are found mauled in a national park. The illustrious professor Arthur Scott, consulted on the subject, has no doubts: the person responsible is a "grizzly", a bear of gigantic proportions believed to be extinct. The park superintendent hesitates to close it so as not to lose money. He will be persuaded to do so only after the list of victims has grown considerably.
notes: There is nothing wrong with trying to exploit the success of the "Shark". You just need to know how to shoot a film, have decent actors and some not ridiculous special effects. Too bad that in this case none of the three hypotheses occurs even remotely.

title: The Eddie Duchin Story
actors: Tyrone Power, Kim Novak, Victoria Shaw, James Whitmore
description: Young pianist Eddie Duchin makes a career in New York. He marries Marjorie, who then dies giving birth to little Peter. Holding a grudge against the child for the death of the woman he was in love with, Eddie entrusts him to his uncles and leaves for Europe: five years of touring, then the return, then the war. Finally, at home: he has regained affection for his son, but is struck by an incurable disease. Dramatic biography of the famous 1930s pianist, Eddie Duchin.

title: Il bianco, il giallo, il nero
