actors: Giuliano Gemma, Tomas Milian, Eli Wallach, Manuel de Blas, Jacques Berthier, Romano Puppo, Nazareno Zamperla
description: Speculator Butler had a sacred pony sent by the emperor of Japan to a colony of immigrants from the Rising Sun kidnapped. His intention is to provoke an Indian war. Sheriff Black Jack has to give him the box with the ransom money; he is joined by the aspiring samurai Sakura and the gunslinger Blanc de Blanc.
notes: Western parodic as it was fashionable, with a trio of specialized actors. Unpretentious, but quite fun.

title: Oklahoma Crude
actors: George C. Scott, Faye Dunaway, John Mills, Jack Palance
description: An oil company wants to get their hands on Lena Doyle's land. She intends to look for oil on her own, helped by an Indian. Lena's father, Cleon, comes to her aid, with a tramp named Mase. During the hostilities with the men of the company, first the Indian and then Cleon himself die; after discovering that there is no oil on her land, Lena will leave with Mase. The cast is tough, but the result of this modern western is barely decent.

title: Il giustiziere sfida la città
actors: Tomas Milian, Joseph Cotten, Maria Fiore, Mario Piave, Femi Benussi
description: Rambo, a former gangster, takes his own way on the side of justice to avenge his brother, a private detective killed by the kidnappers of a boy, whom he unmasked. To defeat them, he sets them up against another gang: the two criminal groups almost exterminate each other. Finally, Rambo intervenes, concludes the work and frees the prisoner boy. Then, he goes off on his motorcycle. The setting is metropolitan and contemporary, but the spirit is not very far from that of the western made in Italy. There is no shortage of touches of humor, which characterize the character of Milian. Among the protagonists an elderly Joseph Cotten.

title: An Affair to Remember
actors: Cary Grant, Deborah Kerr, Cathleen Nesbitt, Richard Denning
description: Nickie Ferrante, a young and elegant Don Juan, is engaged to Lois Clarke, an heiress. Nickie decides to join her in New York and then embarks. On the luxurious ocean liner, the man meets Terry MacKey, a beautiful woman who sings in night clubs by profession and is in turn engaged to a young and wealthy industrialist. An understanding is immediately established between the two, which increases more and more when the ship calls at Villafranca on the French Riviera. At the end of the journey the two find themselves in love. Remember the quote in "Sleepless in Love"? And the (ugly) remake of Warren Beatty "A Great Love"? This too is already a remake of a 1939 film (same director), but it's great.

title: Gabriel Over the White House
actors: Walter Huston, Karen Morley, Franchot Tone, Arthur Bryon, Dickie Moore
description: Judson Hammond, president of the United States, does not shine for the interest aimed at the real problems of the nation. Following a road accident that brought him near his death, Hammond, pervaded by a sacred fury, changes and undertakes increasingly fierce battles against the economic crisis, organized crime and in favor of unions and world peace. Excellently accused of fascism at its release, in reality this is the most fervent cinematographic manifesto of the Rooseveltian politics of the New Deal. The acting of the great Walter Huston for a miserable masterpiece is very "presidential", authoritative and passionate.

title: Ternosecco
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Victoria Abril, Lino Troisi
description: When Domenico Aniello Capatosta, known as Mimì, ended up in jail, he obtained the respect of everyone for his ability to interpret dreams. Unfortunate Giannini's only direction, quite Wertmuller-style but without the same excesses. As an actor he is much better.

title: The Bridge at Remagen
actors: George Segal, Ben Gazzara, Robert Vaughn, Bradford Dillman
description: On one side of the Remagen bridge are the Germans, who - although willing for a long and desperate defense - are ready to blow it up, so as to prevent a further and rapid advance of the American troops. Which, in turn, are on the other side and think that the rescue of the bridge could shorten the times of the war. In the end, with great sacrifice on the part of Ours, the bridge remains standing ...
notes: Guillermin is an old fox of the war genre, and you can find other skins by scrolling through the cast (especially Vaughn and Gazzara). Nothing overwhelming, but everything according to the rules and at times even exciting.

title: Sorelle di scena
actors: Xie Fang, Cao Yindi
description: The story of the friendship between two Chinese actresses from 1935 to 1950. It looks like "Goodbye my concubine", but the result is less.

title: No Man's Land
actors: Charlie Sheen, D.B. Sweeney, Randy Quaid, Lara Harris
description: Young cop Benjy Taylor infiltrates an organization of car thieves and recyclers who, perhaps, killed an agent. Benjy becomes friends with the leader of the gang, Ted Warrick, and is fascinated by the environment. Meanwhile, the chain of murders lengthens and, finally, Beniy shakes up. And Ted, dying after the decisive fight, will spare him.
notes: Rather conventional in the delineation of the characters and in the nodes of the story (such as the relationship between the policeman and the boss's sister), the film, however, has an easy narrative rhythm and, in some sequences, of masterly frenzy.

title: Manolesta
actors: Tomas Milian, Giovanna Ralli, Paco Cardini, Armando Pugliese
description: Gino, a young borgataro abandoned by his wife, has a little son, Bruno, whom he grows up as best he can. Which does not always mean flawlessly and the altars are discovered when the child tells his life in a school theme. Gino risks having his son taken away, he also goes to jail, but then Angela, a social worker, intervenes, who, by marrying Gino, will be the mother of Bruno. Tomas Milian removes himself from the character of Monnezza which has earned him the favor of the public with a good mouth, but his language is still trivial, to edify the child.

title: Kickboxer 5
actors: Mark Dacascos, James Ryan, Geoff Meed, Tony Caprari, Greg Latter
description: Kickboxing champion Matt Reeves witnesses the murder of his friend Johnny. He was killed because he did not want to join a new kickboxing association founded by a certain Mr. Neegal. Reeves does not intend to give up, but he does not have many chances, since Neegal is a man of few scruples and boundless ambitions. But our champion finds an ally, as unexpected as it is providential ...

title: Crooklyn
actors: Alfre Woodard, Delroy Lindo, Spike Lee, Zelda Harris
description: Woody is an unemployed jazz mucisita because he refuses to adapt his style to the current tastes of the public. The occupation of his four children consists in watching television, gorging himself on various junk and trying to get out of the mess they got into. When the family is plagued by problems, it takes a sense of humor to deal with the low joys and frequent headaches. The "family chronicle" according to Spike Lee is above all a narcissistic and sterile insistence of camera movements, an incessant pounding of music, a desire to prove himself "author" at any cost, even to oppress the meaning of his film.

title: Immortal Beloved
actors: Gary Oldman, Jeroen Krabbe, Isabella Rossellini, Johanna Ter Steege
description: On the death of Ludwig van Beethoven, in 1827, one discovers among his papers a letter addressed to a not better defined "immortal beloved". Anton Schindler, trusted man of the Bonn genius, sets out in search of the recipient, according to the testimonies and confidences of some of the women that Beethoven had known and associated with. And, in the end, the "immortal beloved" turns out to be a surprise. An invention, that of the letter on which the film is based, which could also bear fruit. As long as you avoid moments that are too trivial (such as the attack of the "Fifth" on the composer's death) and not to overdo it with improbable romanticisms.

title: Jefferson in Paris
actors: Nick Nolte, Greta Scacchi, Jean-Pierre Aumont, Simon Callow
description: In 1784, Thomas Jefferson was ambassador of the newborn United States to the court of the king of France. Still shocked by the death of his wife, Jefferson meets the Anglo-Italian noblewoman Maria Cosway and falls in love with her, but their relationship does not go beyond the correspondence. Jefferson's concubinage with the sister of the slave inherited from his wife is one of the reasons for the subsequent estrangement between the two.
notes: The characters, the story, the environment, the time: everything could give hope for another masterful "reinterpretation" signed by Ivory. Instead the succession of "pictures" painstakingly linked to each other constitutes a terrible misstep by the director.

title: Angelique et le Roy
actors: Michèle Mercier, Claude Giraud, Rosalba Neri, Jean Rochefort, Jean-Louis Trintignant
description: Angelica has retired to her lands as a sign of mourning, but Louis XIV calls her back to Paris and puts her on the back of the ambassador of Persia, from whom she obtains a treaty of alliance with France. The Oriental would like her as a slave, but the king declares her his favorite (and would like to enjoy her favors). It turns out that Angelica's first husband, Earl of Peyrac, is not dead at all, and she will look for him ...
notes: From the sacred texts, this would turn out to be the second film of the "Angelica series", and not the third, but nothing changes. The formula works (with the admirers) without decisive variations: proven module and interpreters who do not betray.

title: Jungle Fever
actors: Wesley Snipes, Annabella Sciorra, Spike Lee, Ossie Davis
description: A black New York architect, married and father of one daughter, is having an affair with his secretary of Italian descent, with a father and two brothers to look after. Their "story" is badly received in both communities and ends up causing expulsion from their respective families. Then the "fever" passes and the protagonists are faced with a bitter and dramatic balance.
notes: Spike Lee deals with a double theme: the tensions of interracial relationships and drugs (with an explicit condemnation in both cases) skillfully exploiting the concreteness and clarity of the story, the strength of a ferocious sarcasm.

title: Timebomb
actors: Michael Biehn, Patsy Kensit, Tracy Scoggins
description: Eddy Kay, a watchmaker who miraculously escaped death in Vietnam, suffers from tremendous hallucinations. He turns to a psychoanalyst client, and discovers that he was the guinea pig of a CIA colonel bent on making her a killing machine. Honest fun based on robust action scenes. In the cast, a fleeting appearance of two glories of American boxing: Ray "Boom Boom" Mancini and Carlos Palomino.

title: An Enemy of The People
actors: Steve McQueen, Charles Durning, Bibi Andersson, Richard Bradford
description: For absolutely venal reasons, his colleagues would like to hide a serious phenomenon of pollution that threatens the community. He (Steve McQueen), a doctor from a small town, rebels by antagonizing everyone.
notes: Revisiting of a play by Ibsen. Among the best, and as he himself declared, among the most heartfelt films of the last phase of McQueen's career.

title: Horror Safari
actors: Edmund Purdom, Stuart Withman, Woody Strode, Laura Gemser
description: During the Pacific war, a Filipino officer hides a treasure. Years later, an American adventurer aware of the matter Part to recover the loot, but he does not know what awaits him ... incredibly ramshackle production for a film without head or tail.

title: Eye for an Eye
actors: Sally Field, Kiefer Sutherland, Ed Harris, Joe Mantegna
description: Karen McCann is happily married, mother of two daughters, with a satisfying job, and good principles. Life offers you a lot. Suddenly, a stranger walks into his home, kills his daughter and, despite the overwhelming evidence, is set free thanks to quibbles. Heartbroken and obsessed with the desire for justice, Karen embarks on a perilous personal journey. It is in the irruption of abnormality into normality that Schlesinger reveals the author's sure hand: the beautiful opening sequence, of a day like all others broken by the murder (which the mother hears on the phone), the tension accumulated by daily details that the foreground makes menacing, a walk to the botanical garden that takes the step of the nightmare. For Schlesinger, the fable of family serenity always borders on horror, even in the choice (moral or not?) To which the protagonist is ultimately forced.

title: Vampire in Brooklyn
actors: Eddie Murphy, Angela Bassett, Allen Payne
description: Maxmillian (Murphy) is a vampire who has ventured into New York City in search of Rita Veder (Bassett), a City Police Department detective who is oblivious to their unique blood relationship. As Max and Julius, her unfortunate "ghoul" (Hardison) - spirit who wanders around corpses - attempt to turn Rita into Max's vampire, the girl's devoted partner at the police precinct, Justice (Payne), finds that protecting her from an ancient evil means going into big trouble. Craven, a director who certainly knows about horror, has an idea to raise Eddie Murphy's ratings. It is curious how Craven recreates all the typical situations of the new horror cinema and then laughs at them, however detaching himself from the typical banalities of parodies.

title: Screamers
actors: Peter Weller, Roy Dupuis, Jennifer Rubin, Andrew Lauer, Charles Powell
description: Year 2078. On a remote mining planet devastated by ten years of war, scientists have created a race of self-replicating automatons called Screamers, destined to destroy all forms of enemy life. But these continued to evolve autonomously and, in the end, they chose a new mission: to erase all forms of life. Colonel Hendricksson decides to negotiate a separate peace with the forces decimated by the New Economic Bloc. But to do so he must cross a no-man's land, where the most fatal threat comes from the weapons he helped create. The film is based on Philip Dick's short story "Second Variety". His inspiration is material for a good genre film: only special effects, insistent and uninteresting, screech.

title: L'assedio di Siracusa
actors: Rossano Brazzi, Tina Louise, Sylva Koscina, Enrico Maria Salerno
description: Love, forced abandonment, ignored children, marriages of convenience, accidental deaths, travels: and so on and so forth. All to finally arrive at the siege of Syracuse, an ally of Carthage, by the Romans led by the consul Marcellus, rival (also in love) of the Syracusan scientist Archimedes.
notes: A story that has very little to do with history, a "feuilleton" story drawn at least as long as possible. In any case, it is characters who no longer have the right to reply to pay the price. And the cinema is known to have broad shoulders.

title: Persuasion
actors: Amanda Root, Ciarán Hinds, Susan Fleetwood, Corin Redgrave
description: Sir Walter Elliot, a spendthrift and widower baronet, is forced to rent the family home to the Admiral and Mrs Croft to cut costs. The eldest daughter, Elizabeth, haughty and unmarried, is 29 years old; the second, Anne, intelligent and nice, had been engaged eight years earlier to a young naval officer, Frederick, Mrs. Croft's brother.
notes: A lot of sharp social realism, in the frequent close-ups of aristocrats and ordinary people, in the wide narrative space left to the "chorus" of secondary characters and in the obvious annoyance for certain social rites.

title: Poltergeist III
actors: Heather O'Rourke, Nancy Allen, Tom Skerritt, Lara Flynn Boyle
description: Carol Anne (O'Rourke) is sent by her parents to Chicago by Aunt Pat (Allen) just for a change of scenery. He suffers from hallucinations, the windows of the rooms crack as he passes, the heating stops. Between disturbing presences, sensitive dwarfs and evil forces, the situation worsens.
notes: Third episode, unfortunately directed by Gary Sherman, of the series opened by Tobe Hooper in 1982. Everything smells of refracted and unnecessarily mephitic air. The effects of H. R. Giger are no longer there either. There's Lara Flynn Boyle ("Twin Peaks"), but that's certainly not enough.

title: Surf Nazis Must Die
actors: Barry Brenner, Gail Neely, Dawn Wildsmith, Barry Brenner
description: After a tremendous earthquake that left debris and despair, Californian beaches are at the mercy of Nazi surfers' raids. One of their victims, an African-American boy, however, has an unlikely grandmother who, armed with a shotgun, decides to avenge him, killing as many surfers as she can ...
notes: One can only be benevolent towards a film with a similar plot, moreover made by the trashissima Troma. Then, between us, everything is shot and played a lot per kilo, but the intent is clear: to avenge the "nerds" from all over the world, harassed and tyrannized by the "surfers" on duty.

title: La banda del Gobbo
actors: Tomas Milian, Pino Colizzi, Isa Danieli, Guido Leontini
description: Back from a long hiding, the bandit Vincenzo Marazzi, known as "the Hunchback" organizes a robbery. The shot succeeds, but his three accomplices, Sogliola, Perrone and Albanese, shoot him to eliminate him. The Hunchback, however, is saved and is hidden by a prostitute. He immediately carries out his revenge against his comrades, but the police are on his trail and, thanks to the help of his twin brother, they find him. The Hunchback tries to escape, but his car swerves and ends up in the river ...
notes: Soulless Italian detective with many shootings and chases (worthy of the genre). Milian doubles and remakes Garbage but, apart from the always grim language, the film is a prisoner of its clichés.

title: I dieci gladiatori
actors: Roger Browne, Susan Paget, Dan Vadis, Mirko Ellis, Giuliano Dell'Ovo
description: Ten gladiators led by Glauco Valerio conspire against Nero. They will manage to eliminate him but not before the emperor has set fire to Rome. Modest film of the gladiatorial genre. The athletic sequences of the clashes in the arena are interesting.

title: L'amour, l'après-midi
actors: Bernard Verley, Zouzou, Françoise Verley, Daniel Ceccaldi, Malvina Penne
description: Frédéric is a married man; his wife is expecting the second child. Everything is fine between them. Then, from the past, Chloe, an old schoolmate, emerges. Chloe, so far from the tranquility of bourgeois life, represents for Frédéric the charm of transgression. For a while he plays at being a Don Juan; but, when the fantasies are about to become reality, he stops: it is with his wife that he will make love in the afternoon.
notes: Rohmer deals with the two themes that have almost completely marked his cinema: seduction and fidelity. The gaze is rigorous, the approach to reality is immediate, but always alert and intelligent.

title: Dead Man
actors: Johnny Depp, Gary Farmer, John Hurt, Gabriel Byrne, Robert Mitchum
description: In the second half of the nineteenth century, the young William Blake embarks on a journey to the extreme western American frontier. Lost his way and with a bad wound, William Blake meets a very strange Indian. He believes that Blake is the late English poet of the same name. Circumstances will make Blake a wanted outlaw and murderer. The western is serious business and Jim Jarmusch presumptuously forgets about it. The result is an uneven film, certainly not up to the director's previous good performances ("Stranger than Paradise", "Daunbailò").

title: Down Periscope
actors: Kelsey Grammer, Lauren Holly, Rob Schneider, Bruce Dern
description: Frigate Captain Thomas Dodge has been dreaming of one day taking command of a nuclear submarine. When the opportunity presents itself and Dodge is proposed for promotion, a few big guns in the General Staff turn pale in horror. The captain is considered by his superiors to be an extravagant and reckless type.
notes: This film marks the cinematic debut of Kelsey Grammer, one of America's best-known television comedians. While not possessing the charisma and static elegance of Cary Grant, Grammer casually leads a group of actors in tune with the style of the play.

title: Girl 6
actors: Theresa Randle, Isaiah Washington, Spike Lee, Debi Mazar
description: Girl 6 (Randle) was a young actress struggling to establish herself on the New York scene. But work and money are scarce and so, to make ends meet, she decides to become an operator of an erotic line. The girl soon discovers the pleasure of living with one foot in the world of fantasy. The more Girl 6 advances on her journey of self-discovery, the further she moves away from her fundamentally good but thief ex-husband. Spike Lee enjoys making fun of the most swanky and gritty of Hollywood characters (Quentin Tarantino, John Turturro and Madonna, in three self-punishing cameos, and Naomi Campbell) and smiling at his own personal imagination. Underneath, however, it opens up glimpses of loneliness, of inability to relate and gaps in communication.

title: Sometimes They Come Back
actors: Tim Matheson, Brooke Adams, Robert Rusler
description: Four thugs attack two little brothers who are crossing the railroad tracks and kill little Wayne. Three of them, however, are run over by a train. Thirty years later, the surviving brother, who suffers from nightmares related to that episode, returns to the town where the incident happened and is haunted by the ghosts of the three thugs killed determined to make him do the same fate as his brother. Will they succeed in their intent?
notes: From a story by Stephen King, a film halfway between fantasy and horror, swept by waves of dark madness. Sometimes, however, too much is too good and so the final result does not live up to the premises.

title: Edward II
actors: Steven Waddington, Andrew Tiernan, Tilda Swinton, Nigel Terry, John Lynch, Dudley Sutton, Jerome Flynn, Jody Graber, Kevin Collins
description: In England in 1325 the young Edward II, newly appointed sovereign, takes his lover Gaveston to court. This attitude puts him in conflict with the court, his wife Isabella of France and the ecclesiastical world. Isabella then plots to remove Gaveston and dethrone Edoardo and succeeds with the help of her lover, Roger de Mortimer. Edoardo is arrested and brutally murdered in prison. But a few years later Isabella and Mortimer also end up in the same way.

title: The Double Man
actors: Yul Brynner, Britt Ekland, Clive Revill, Anton Diffring, Moira Lister
description: Lured with a macabre trick to an Austrian mountain resort by agents of a foreign power, American agent Dan Slater (Brynner) is kidnapped and replaced with a double. Then Slater manages to free himself, but in the meantime his double is on his way to the USA ... Brynner performs ignoble actions in the sacred places of "Heidi", in a mediocre spy film.

title: CyberTracker
actors: Don 'The Dragon' Wilson, Richard Norton, Stacie Foster, John Aprea
description: Eric (Wilson) is one of Senator Dilly's (Aprea) security men, but he doesn't always agree with his boss. In particular, Dilly's idea of ??building a new police force made up of invincible and very powerful androids does not convince him: the Trackers. Eric is alone, the Trackers are many, but he is not afraid.
notes: PM Entertainment has thus produced dozens of films. P stands for Richard Pepin. M for Joseph Merhi. Entertainment is more of an omen than anything else. Don "The Dragon" Wilson is muscular, but since he appeared in "Batman Forever" he is no longer the same.

title: Noises Off
actors: Carol Burnett, Michael Caine, Denholm Elliott, Christopher Reeve
description: A rather shabby company the night before the debut begins to rehearse their new show for the first time. It is only the first act and it takes a lot of patience, between various interruptions, hysteria and quarrels, to get to the end. On the night of the premiere, things continue in the same tone, but this time we follow what happens behind the scenes. And that's just the second act. Bogdanovich takes an original play by Englishman Michael Frayn, secures an unsurpassed cast and makes a delightful farce, with actors in the mood.

title: Traitement de choc
actors: Annie Girardot, Alain Delon, Michel Duchaussoy, Robert Hirsch
description: Hélène is being treated in a thalassotherapy institute, due to her depression; here he finds Jérôme, an old friend, hospitalized for similar reasons. The staff, made up of young Portuguese, has a strange behavior. After Jérôme's mysterious death, Hélène discovers that the director of the institute uses the corpses of the attendants for therapy; she kills him, but the police don't believe her. Why?
notes: An agonizing climate, with some slips into the slaughter, but without exceeding. Behind the denunciation of those cases in which medicine has no scruples in following barbaric methods in order to achieve the necessary effectiveness. The setting is suggestive.

title: Tacones lejanos
actors: Victoria Abril, Marisa Paredes, Miguel Bosé, Feodor Atkine
description: Mom (Paredes) is a singer, calls herself Becky del Paramo and is back on a plane from Mexico. The daughter (Abril) is called Rebecca, she lives with Manuel, her mother's ex-lover, and more than anything else she has never managed to resolve the inferiority complex that conditions her towards her mother. Then Manuel is found dead and it is Rebecca who publicly accuses herself of the murder. Alluring and shameless melodrama, full of all the clichés of the genre and of the Spanish director's cinema: conflicting relationships between mother and daughter, passions, acknowledgments, transvestism. Memorable the performance of Miguel Bosè "en travesti" who imitates Mina singing "A year of love" and the confession, broadcast live on the news with "simultaneous translation" for deaf and dumb.

title: Viva la muerte... tua!
actors: Franco Nero, Eli Wallach, Lynn Redgrave
description: A journalist, Mary, bribes a sheriff to free a hero of the Mexican revolution. Instead of the hero (who is dead) the sheriff frees two bandits. The two each have a share of the information to find a treasure, but are arrested by the soldiers of the regular army who seize the loot from them. Mary frees the two who lead the revolutionaries against the army to recover the loot. Picaresque Western, nice and braggart, but without the energy of others of the period, it is still quite enjoyable for the Black-Wallach pairing.

title: The Birds II: Land's End
actors: Brad Johnson, Chelsea Field, James Naughton, Tippi Hedren
description: Still devastated by the death of their son a few years earlier, Ted and May Hocken went to live on Gull Island with their daughters Joanna and Jill. A marine biologist has already been attacked by a group of angry seagulls, but the locals, including shopkeeper Helen Matthews (Hedren), don't worry too much. Then the birds attack the Hocken house.
notes: Tippi Hedren's presence is the only thing that ties this stupid television movie to Hitchcock's. Rick Rosenthal, in order not to ruin a career, has chosen to sign as Alan Smithee, which is the conventional name used in Hollywood when a director decides not to sign a film. There is also a completely apocryphal titled "Birds 2" shot by René Cardona jr.

title: Johnny & Clyde
actors: John White, Michael Rooker, Diana Reis
description: Johnny and Clyde aren't too good friends either. Johnny is ten and Clyde is the house dog. It all starts in the morning when mum (Reis) and dad (Rooker) leave for work. Johnny stays alone in the house with the dog and the trouble starts immediately: Trixie, the little bird, comes out of the cage and flies away. Johnny and Clyde set out to find him and end up running into other problems. There is nothing original about this children's film. It is scandalous that Michael Rooker, the one from "Henry, Rain of Blood", is reduced to being a fool in children's films.

title: Way... Way Out
actors: Jerry Lewis, Connie Stevens, Robert Morley, Dennis Weaver
description: The two American astronauts on a lunar mission are going crazy. Reason: lack of women. Regular couples should be sent into space, but NASA does not have them; a marriage of convenience is quickly celebrated between Peter (11 years awaiting launch) and Eileen. The two then join the Soviet colleagues, regularly and really married; in their company, they will end up really falling in love. Jerry is still Jerry, but he's had better chances.

title: Six Degrees of Separation
actors: Stockard Channing, Will Smith, Donald Sutherland, Ian McKellen, Catherine Kellner, Osgood Perkins
description: He is young, likeable, cultured. He is black and he is wounded. He is the son of Sidney Poitier. He is a fellow student of their children at Harvard. It is logical that the Kittredges, well-to-do couple who live in an apartment in Central Park, treat Paul as best they could. But in the morning Paul is kicked out of the house, and begins a whole series of embarrassing discoveries about the guest, his identity, his actions.
notes: From a successful play (which Channing herself brought to the stage), a bizarre comedy but with an impeccable and engaging mechanism. The six degrees of separation of the title are those of kinship that bind all men to each other.

title: Herbie Rides Again
actors: Helen Hayes, Ken Berry, Stefanie Powers, John McIntire
description: A construction tycoon wants to demolish an elderly widow's dilapidated home to make room for its skyscrapers. But he did the math without the widow's combative granddaughter and, above all, without Herbie, the "beetle" of infinite, inexhaustible resources.
notes: Another installment of the adventures of the Disney car equipped with superfaculty. A pleasure for the children, a little less for everyone else.

title: Merveilleuse Angélique
actors: Michèle Mercier, Robert Hossein, Roger Pigaut, Christian Rode
description: Angelica, elected lady of Parisian beggars, loses her beloved Nicola and even a son, killed after a kidnapping. Transformed a tavern into an elegant place, he will see it set on fire by some shady courtiers. After various other vicissitudes, Angelica will win the favor of the Sun King and will marry a noble cousin she has saved from the accusation of treason ...
notes: Second episode of the epic taken from the novels of Anne and Serge Golon: the charm of Mercier knows no decline, but from the point of view of the plot, the romanticizing tones fall to the advantage of an "apologia for revenge" which downsizes the spectacular scope of the each other.

title: Detenuto in attesa di giudizio
actors: Alberto Sordi, Elga Andersen, Lino Banfi, Mario Pisu, Gianni Bonagura
description: Giuseppe Di Noi has been a surveyor for seven years who emigrated to Sweden, where he made his fortune with his small construction company. He returns to Italy to let his wife Ingrid know his country, but is inexplicably stopped at the border and then arrested. Translated into prison, he discovers he is accused of manslaughter. Giuseppe is involved in a revolt and for this reason sent to an even harsher prison ...
notes: Successful attempt (apart from some concessions to the show) to draw the inhuman and dehumanizing picture of Italian justice. Sordi's interpretation is very effective.

title: Dust Devil
actors: Robert John Burke, Zakes Mokae, Chelsea Field, John Matshikiza
description: Namibia, 1990. Only a few days before the proclamation of independence and the city of Betheny is now on its last legs, bent by seven years of drought. In this atmospheric and social climate, the investigations of a policeman chasing a ferocious serial killer take place. The prey in reality is a shapeshifter known as the "Dust Demon" who, to increase his mortal power, must collect the souls of the dead ...
notes: Inspired by the "animist" legends of the African desert, the film mixes pure horror with elements of the classic detective investigation. The background is a pinch of magic and the director's visionary gaze.

title: La decima vittima
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Ursula Andress, Elsa Martinelli
description: In an unspecified remote future, warfare is abolished but the aggression of human beings is discharged into a particular sport: legalized hunting of other men. Ursula Andress, famous American "hunter", a creature born from artificial fertilization and therefore very efficient in her work, has already killed nine other hunters. The woman flies to Rome to confront (and kill, she believes) Marcello, an indolent example of "homo romanus" with family problems.
notes: The gears of the comedy do not turn properly, but the script reserves some good acid paw as it is right to expect from Elio Petri.

title: Buchanan Rides Alone
actors: Randolph Scott, Craig Stevens, Manuel Rojas, Barry Kelley
description: Passing through Agaytown, Buchanan saves the young Mexican Juan, who has avenged his sister offended by the evil Agay brothers, from being lynched. Then his gun puts everyone in their place, according to justice. A western so so that it becomes stronger in the end. Not the best of the Scott-Boetticher partnership.

title: Giovani, belle... probabilmente ricche
actors: Nadia Cassini, Carmen Russo, Olivia Link, Gianfranco D'Angelo
description: Of four friends, three get married. The fourth, who has gone abroad, dies. By will, her large inheritance will be divided among the others as long as they betray her husband, giving proof to the notary. The most obvious exhibition of plus-sized underwear dressed in pseudo-humor.

title: Dracula Has Risen From the Grave
actors: Christopher Lee, Rupert Davies, Veronica Carlson
description: A Catholic priest and an inveterate atheist make common cause to liquidate Dracula who, after centuries of dark sleep, has returned to exercise his canines on unsuspecting and beautiful girls. The Hammer production revises the traditional formula of the genre by making explicit and emphasizing the sexual side. With Christopher Lee and some interesting gimmicks, but this is not a classic.

title: A Pàl utcai fiuk
actors: Andras Avar, Paul Bartleft, Martin Beaumont
description: Two gangs of boys, that of Boka and the "red shirts" of Franco Atis, compete on a playing field. The two groups have given themselves a form of military organization: in that of Boka, where all are officers, only Nemecsek has the rank of private. However, having disobeyed an order, he is declared a traitor. But Nemecsek redeems himself by revealing to Boka the time and day when Atis will attack to conquer their playing field.
notes: A dignified cinematic transcription of the novel by Ferenc Molnar, whose poetic breath is sufficiently preserved, without distorting it into sentimentality.

title: Reckless Kelly
actors: Yahoo Serious, Hugo Weaving, Melora Hardin, Alexei Sayle
description: The latest descendant of the famous Australian outlaw Ned Kelly lives on a small happy island bearing the same name as his famous ancestor. After a successful bank robbery in Sydney, Ned decides to visit the United States, the natural home of outlaws. Meeting a low-profile producer secures him and his fiancée Robin Banks a part in a Las Vegas B movie. Yahoo Serious is just a namesake of one of the most popular search engines used on the Internet. In reality he is an Australian who with "Young Einstein" had earned well at home and just outside. This film confirms the trend: Yahoo only makes people laugh at home.

title: Chopper Chicks in Zombietown
actors: Jamie Rose, Catherine Carlene, Lycia Naff, Vicki Frederick
description: A group of busty bikers collide with a madman who has an army of zombies under his command. Unhealthy, demented and inconclusive. Refrain if you don't know what the Troma people are capable of.

title: Solo con tu pareja
actors: Daniel Gimenez Cacho, Claudia Ramirez, Luis De Icaza, Astrid Hadad
description: Tomas (Cacho) is a true seducer. He has a woman in his apartment, another in a neighboring apartment and, in the passage, he can't help but spy on his new neighbor Clarisa (Ramirez) as well. This goes on until one of his loved ones manages to make him believe he has contracted the AIDS virus. Mexican farsaccia, moreover made with discreet care, which presents yet another variation on the theme of the unrepentant seducer forced to surrender. The unprecedented setting manages to overshadow the obviousness of the idea.

title: Parigi o cara
actors: Franca Valeri, Vittorio Caprioli, Fiorenzo Fiorentini, Margherita Girelli
description: Delia, a prostitute, joins her brother Carlo, a homosexual in Paris. Various setbacks prevent her from getting to know the city, then she is also evicted, although she has granted her thanks to the son of the landlady. A generous Italian pizza maker, Avallone, will represent Delia's momentary salvation.
notes: Caprioli guesses the meticulous and amused observation of his characters, but the rhythm of the story has several phases of tiredness. Franca Valeri collaborates in the realization of her husband by building the protagonist with flair and inventiveness.

title: In the Line of Duty: Ambush in Waco
actors: Timothy Daly, Dan Lauria, William O'Leary, Neal McDonough
description: David Koresh is the fanatic leader of a religious sect. The community gathers on a ranch in Waco, Texas, where David primarily uses his charismatic personal charm and musical creativity to enslave his followers. David proposes himself as the new messiah and one of his rights is to join all the women in the community. Against the law, he prefers to respond with weapons to the siege of the police, dying with all his followers.
notes: The film is the reconstruction of the news that shocked America (and the world) on April 19, 1993. An opportunity to reflect on the phenomenon of religious sects and on mass suicides.

title: Gli esecutori
actors: Roger Moore, Stacy Keach, Ivo Garrani, Fausto Tozzi, Ennio Balbo
description: There is a crucifix full of drugs sent by the boss Salvatore Francesco from Sicily to San Francisco. In truth, the boss refuses the authorship of such a sacrilegious gift and in addition gives a mandate to his nephew Ulysses to seek the truth. Meanwhile, the three men who had taken possession of the crucifix are found dead. Ulysses recovers the drugs and also discovers the truth.
notes: Between one James Bond and another, Roger Moore was not ashamed of making such films. Who knows for what obscure reasons. Certainly not for the honor of being able to work with Maurizio Lucidi.

title: La banda del Trucido
actors: Luc Merenda, Tomas Milian, Elio Zamuto, Franco Citti, Katia Christine
description: Commissioner Ghini is the new head of the Antirapine Squad to replace Taddei, who died on the field. The case Ghini is working on is that of a Sicilian criminal, a certain Belli, who committed a massacre in an attempt to rob jewelry representatives. Lending a hand to Ghini will be "Monnezza", a criminal who has good reasons to take revenge on Belli ...
notes: Tomas Milian has only one part: on the other hand we have the plastic face of Luc Merenda in the foreground. The texture is also plastic: you can pull it as you like, but it remains identical to all the others of the genre. Fortunately, a genus now extinct.

title: Charlie Chan at the Opera
actors: Warner Oland, Boris Karloff, Keye Luke, William Demarest
description: A baritone, suffering from mental illness, is locked up in a health home. He escapes and a singer receives threatening anonymous letters. The baritone is even suspected of being the author of two murders. Infallible Charlie Chan discovers the truth. On the traditional scheme (suspected, therefore innocent), yet another deductive triumph of the Chinese investigator.

title: Charlie Chan at the Circus
actors: Warner Oland, Keye Luke
description: Was it the ape who killed the ringmaster? Where the police don't come (that is, to the truth), Charlie Chan arrives. And the real culprit is a human being. Decent episode (number 11) of the series dedicated to the Sino-American detective.

title: Charlie Chan on Broadway
actors: Warner Oland, K. Luke
description: Called to New York for a celebration in his honor, Charlie Chan must immediately commit to his role as an investigator. There are two killed: a young woman who kept a compromising diary for many Broadway personalities and an individual who stalked her.
notes: One of the best of the many investigator-centered films invented by Earl Derr Biggers.

title: Charlie Chan at Monte Carlo
actors: Warner Oland, Keye Luke, Virginia Field, Sidney Blackmer
description: Chinese-born private detective Charlie Chan is on vacation on the French Riviera with some of his many children. A bank official carrying a suitcase containing over twenty million francs in securities is murdered in the very hotel where Charlie Chan is staying, so he inevitably begins to investigate ...
notes: Decent realization, but not the best of the series. Last played by Warner Oland.

title: Fiorina la vacca
actors: Janet Agren, Felice Andreasi, Gastone Moschin, Ewa Aulin
description: A poor farmer sells the Fiorina cow to become a soldier of fortune. From here begins a series of changes of ownership for the beast - some lawful and others not - which end in the stable of a rich man, who then procures as a lover the farmer's wife, also named Fiorina. Which will refuse to return with her legitimate husband when he returns to look for her. Set in the 16th century and vaguely inspired by the theatrical work of Ruzante, the film fits into the "Boccaccio" trend that was raging at the time, but remaining above average.

title: La vendetta di Ercole
actors: Mark Forest, Broderick Crawford, Gaby André, Wandisa Guida
description: The son of Hercules falls in love with Thea, the daughter of the king of Hecalia, but an ancient curse that hangs over his head complicates things. Illo, son of Hercules, falls in love with Thea, the pupil of the king of Ecalia who does not look favorably on the relationship. And the very strong demigod also has to deal with an ancient curse that hangs on his head.
notes: Cottafavi gave his best with "The revolt of the Gladiators" and "Hercules conquering Atlantis". His "Vendetta" is instead below average.

title: Fright Night
actors: Chris Sarandon, William Ragsdale, Roddy McDowall, Amanda Bearse, Stephen Geoffreys, Jonathan Stark, Dorothy Fielding, Art Evans, Stewart Stern
description: Charley is with his girlfriend, Amy. At one point he notices something in the apartment of his new neighbor, Jerry: he, with the appearance of a vampire, is attacking a girl. Distraught, Charley informs both his mother and Amy of the matter, but is not believed. The boy, however, is not mistaken and Jerry, seeing himself discovered, tries to kill him. Amy is also in danger. But Charley has a precious, if reluctant, ally ... Yet another variation on the theme of vampirism. The film, while keeping intact the horror components typical of the genre (the transformations are spectacular), however, introduces a massive dose of irony that makes it a nice comedy-horror.

title: Montecarlo Gran Casinò
actors: Christian De Sica, Paolo Rossi, Ezio Greggio, Massimo Boldi, Florence Guérin, Lisa Stothard
description: Stories that intertwine at the Monte Carlo Casino. Furio loses a lot of money and sees as his only lifeline a very rich, elderly lady who wants to be satisfied in return. Gino arrives with the cash to buy an apartment, but ends up burning it at the card table. Oscar, a professional cheater, takes his revenge on his French colleague Duroc. You don't laugh much. In the cast there is also Paolo Rossi for reasons that even he no longer remembers. And then Christian De Sica who tries, in vain, to imitate his father even in his passion for the game.

title: Cyber-Tracker 2
actors: Don 'The Dragon' Wilson, Stacie Foster, Tony Burton, Jim Maniaci
description: Cyber ??Trackers are a new police force made up of indestructible androids. Those that our hero, Eric Phillips, finds himself fighting against are even more dangerous because they are programmed by a mad scientist named Carpenter. One of these, for example, with identical features to those of Eric's wife, kills the Governor of California on live television. Eric doesn't take it well.
notes: Eric may not be happy, but Don "The Dragon" Wilson can't really complain. This will be at least his fortieth film and, for someone who only knows how to lead his hands and at most emit disjointed sounds, it is not a result to be thrown away.

title: Dangerous Touch
actors: Kate Vernon, Robert Prentiss, William Lawrence Allen, Greg Stone
description: Amanda Grace is a successful psychologist in L.A., complete with a high-ratings radio column. Cold and professional in public, she hides not indifferent private vices with an erotic content. A mysterious stranger appears, Mick Larson, who uses his uncontrollable sexual urges to involve her in a deadly game of revenge that targets a patient of hers. bamba "or the young red man from" Young Guns ". Here Lou passes behind the camera, but also reserves the role - look at it - of the mysterious Mick.

title: Give a Girl a Break
actors: Marge Champion, Debbie Reynolds, Bob Fosse
description: To replace the star of a show, which he left a few days after the premiere, advertisements are placed in the newspaper. After the first meetings, three girls are selected; each of them has an important supporter among the production managers, who fight among themselves for the choice. One is drawn by lot, but subsequent twists lead to the final decision, the result of conspiracies, compromises and desperate gestures ...
notes: Dancing comedy in absolute respect of genre schemes. Donen follows the run of the three young dancers in a multiplication of scenographic inventions well choreographed by Bob Fosse, future director of _Cabaret_ (here at his debut).

title: L'uomo dai calzoni corti
actors: Alida Valli, Edoardo Nevola, Francisco Rabal
description: Little Salvatore "Pagnottella" escapes from a Sicilian orphanage to look for his mother. He will chase her, between one adventure and another, in Naples, Milan, Venice. Picaresque trip to Italy with pathetic brushstrokes and many obvious things.

title: Madigan
actors: Henry Fonda, Richard Widmark, Steve Ihnat, Harry Guardino
description: Barney Bennesh is wanted for murder. Two policemen, Daniel Madigan and Rocky Bonner, are tasked with arresting him. The two, however, are mocked by the wanted man who even steals their guns. The chief of police then gives the two officers three days to catch the criminal who has killed another officer in the meantime in a firefight. The two find his hiding place and engage in a shootout in which ...
notes: A tense and harsh metropolitan detective film shot by a Siegel in full maturity. Fonda and Widmark compete in skill.

title: Avenging Force
actors: Michael Dudikoff, Steve James, James Booth, Allison Gereighty
description: In New Orleans, the black Larry Richards is heavily involved (supported by his entire family) in the electoral campaign: he has a great chance of being elected senator. Ex-secret agent Matt Hunter also gives him a hand. Larry, however, has enemies: a group of ruthless racist terrorists who make a massacre during a march killing even Larry's eldest son. At this point Matt and Larry go alone against the terrorists, but there will be a bloodbath. The film fits into the vein of the revenge action movie. A lonely man against terrorists fights to save his affections and ideals. The numerous sequences of violence are spectacular.

title: Ice Cream Man
actors: Clint Howard, Sandahl Bergman, Steve Garvey, Jan-Michael Vincent
description: A quiet provincial town, where everything seems to run on the rails of the daily grind. And so it is, until the ice cream van appears, so much so that a moment of innocent pleasure turns into a blood-dripping nightmare. A scream in the night, and here is the first innocent victim. The police immediately suspect the ice cream maker.
notes: It is difficult for a horror plot to be completely original and, in fact, "Tastes of Terror" sometimes recalls that of "It", Stephen King and "Stuff". However, the realization is decent and we are not faced with a real tracing.

title: True Colors
actors: James Spader, John Cusack, Richard Widmark, Imogen Stubbs, Mandy Patinkin
description: The careers of the young adjutant to the district attorney (Spader) and his peer, a senator's bag carrier (Cusak), have progressed hand in hand, to the point of even meeting. Which happens when the elderly senator (Widmark) gets himself into big trouble. Now the two young people, who are friends, are on opposite sides. And it is a heartbreaking drama. Production with big names: from that of the director to those of the two young protagonists (not to mention the "sacred monster" Widmark). In truth, it must be recognized that all honor their respective coats of arms.

title: Charlie Chan in Honolulu
actors: Sidney Toler, Victor Sen Yung, Phyllis Brooks, Robert Barrat
description: A murder on a plane bound for Honolulu, but Charlie Chan is also on board. And the killer has no escape. Sidney Toler takes over from Warner Oland from this film.

title: Charlie Chan in Reno
actors: Sidney Toler, Victor Sen Yung, Ricardo Cortez, Phyllis Brooks
description: In the city of easy divorce, Reno, in Nevada, the investigator hits a divorced Hawaiian accused of murder.
notes: Curiously in the novel from which the story is taken, there was no character of Charlie Chan, introduced by the screenwriters, Albert Ray and Robert Kent.

title: Charlie Chan at Treasure Island
actors: Sidney Toler, Cesar Romero, Pauline Moore, Sen Yung, Douglas Fowley
description: With the help of a famous wizard, our hero comes to the head of a complicated murder case disguised as suicide. In fact, a friend of Charlie's took his own life, but his death does not convince the investigator.
notes: Entertaining adventure of the famous detective, here in the interpretation of Toler (the second in chronological order).

title: Charlie Chan in City in Darkness
actors: Sidney Toler, Lynn Bari, Lon Chaney jr., Richard Clarke, Harold Huber
description: In Paris, the investigator unmasks an arms manufacturer who wants to sell his dangerous wares to a foreign power.

title: Charlie Chan in Panama
actors: Sidney Toler, Victor Sen Yung, Lionel Atwill, Jean Rogers
description: Who is plotting to sabotage the Panama Canal to block the US fleet? Charlie Chan thwarts the plots of enemy espionage.

title: Charlie Chan at the Wax Museum
actors: Sidney Toler, Victor Sen Yung, Marc Lawrence, C. Henry Gordon
description: A criminal hides in the wax museum and, like a plastic surgeon, changes his appearance. But Charlie Chan still wins.

title: I due nemici
actors: David Niven, Alberto Sordi, Amedeo Nazzari
description: Abyssinia, 1941. A unit of Italians captures the English major Richardson. Shortly after, however, during a clash with an English unit, the commander of the Italians lost his life. The command is then taken by the junior officer, Captain Blasi. The latter, convinced that the English major will induce his own to give up hunting the Italians given the smallness of their forces, leaves him free. The scenario in which the story takes place is the tragic one of the Abyssinian war. But immediately the film, inspired by those tragic events, focuses on the sketches of military life.

title: Piranha
actors: Soleil Moon Frye, Darleen Karr, Monte Markham, Alexandra Paul
description: Piranhas do not naturally live in the rivers of the United States. Least of all in the rivers that every summer are chosen as a destination by crowds of tourists. When some of these disappear, then the story resurfaces that the military had designed a piranha crop for use in the Vietnam War.
notes: Roger Corman produces this TV movie plagiarism of another much more glorious production of his. The remake lacks the charm of the original.

title: Maniac Nurses Find Ecstasy
actors: Susanna Makay, Hajini Brown, Nicole A. Gyony
description: A group of nurses with unique surgical skills gather in a desolate, out-of-the-way castle to await the next victim. Torn apart and beautiful women in a film by Troma: a confidence in bad taste.

title: Rasputin the Mad Monk
actors: Christopher Lee, Barbara Shelley, Richard Pasco, Francis Matthews
description: Rasputin, possessing tremendous hypnotic powers, uses them to heal an innkeeper's wife. But when he tries to use violence on the host's daughter, he is forced to flee. After taking refuge in Petersburg, the monk attracted the interest of Sonja, lady-in-waiting of the tsarina. Having become his lover, he uses the woman to more easily reach the Tsarina who, completely subjugated by him, causes an accident to the Tsar's son.
notes: A historical figure is that of Rasputin, here transfigured by the eccentric and "gothic" sensitivity of Hammer. A powerful, violent and long underestimated film. Christopher Lee's favorite.

title: Quantrill's Raiders
actors: Steve Cochran, Diane Brewster, Leo Gordon, Gale Robbins, Will Wright
description: A Southern captain has the task of destroying an arsenal in the town of Lawrence: to carry out the mission, he asks for help from the bandit William Clarke Quantrill ...
notes: A series B western, quite predictable. The previous year, Steve Cochran had interpreted _The cry_ by Michelangelo Antonioni.

title: Il vedovo
actors: Alberto Sordi, Franca Valeri, Livio Lorenzon, Nando Bruno
description: Commendator Alberto Nardi owes his good social position to his wife's large money. One day he receives the news of his life: his wife is among the victims of a train crash. Nardi thinks he has solved all his problems thanks to the inheritance, but the lady, alas, is more alive than ever.
notes: "What's the accountant doing, pushing?" Very wild Albertone in one of Risi's best comedies. Perfect balance of the times, the formidable presence of Valeri who with her "cretinetti" creates the sonorous leitmotif for the exhilarating rise (and descent) of an operetta commander. Almost a cult.

title: I due toreri
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Maria Teresa Vianello, Rossella Como
description: Our two heroes, peasants in Sicily, accept the offer of a certain Signor Pierre, unaware of his shady activity. As far as they know, they should grow a special salad - but it's actually marijuana. The two are shipped with their cargo to Barcelona. There is the bulk of the gang that hired them, and the two unwitting and clumsy protagonists begin to combine all the colors. Between one adventures and another, they will find themselves in the unlikely guise of matadors. For them, of course, everything will end in the best way. The plot, as almost always in similar cases, is solid as a spider's web, and all the weight - so to speak - of the film rests on the jokes of Franchi and Ingrassia. Back then, the film seemed too bold in terms of language. Today it is almost for boarders.

title: Baree, the Wolf Dog
actors: Jeff Fahey, Jacques Welbern, Geneviève Rochette, Neve Campbell
description: The young Nepeese, orphan of an Indian mother, lives with her father in a house in the woods. Here he makes friends with a half-wolf dog to whom he gives the name of Baree. The evil Taggart would like the land of Neepese's father and, as his wife, the girl, who is instead in love with the zoologist Paul. Bloody adventures ensue, with the defeat of the villain and the victory of the good (those who survived) and the dog-wolf.
notes: Second episode taken from the novels of James Oliver Curwood (from which a previous film is also based, with Baree's father, Kazan), the film strictly respects all the canons of the specific "genre" and exploits the resources of environmental beauties.

title: Zire derakhatan zeyton
actors: Tahereh Ladanian, Hossein Rezai, Mohamad Ali Keshavarz
description: Director Keshavarz is filming "And Life Goes On". He chose two non-professional actors to play a young married couple, but the male lead suddenly needs to be replaced. The young Hossein takes his place, the factotum of the troupe, actually really in love with his partner on the set. The beautiful Tahereh initially refuses to act with him: too poor, illiterate and suffocating with his marriage proposals. But filming must continue, so Tahereh resigns himself. And for Hossein it is a question of turning the situation to the best.
notes: Kiarostami translates his training into a lightness of touch, an ability to paint simple characters and gestures, transforming them into poetic material. Let the love story within the film expand until the two boys master the scene; thus continues his discourse on the intertwining of cinema and reality. "And Life Continues" is really the title of one of his films from 1992.

title: The Innocents
actors: Deborah Kerr, Martin Stephens, Pamela Franklin, Peter Wyngarde, Megs Jenkins, Michael Redgrave, Clytie Jessop
description: A housekeeper, Miss Giddens, is hired to look after two children Flora and Miles who live in Bly's castle. Soon the woman suspects that the two children are possessed by the spirits of two lovers who died in mysterious circumstances. From "Turn of the Screw" by Henry James a disturbing mystery (co-written by Truman Capote) and ambiguous: is the woman's perverse mind imagining everything or is there something real? Superb Deborah Kerr.

title: Silent Fall
actors: Richard Dreyfuss, Liv Tyler, John Lithgow, Linda Hamilton
description: Jake Rainer was a prominent child psychiatrist specializing in autism problems. After a patient's tragic demise, she stopped exercising and entered a depressive tunnel, which her marriage is also paying for. The return to reality comes when his help is asked to solve the case of the murder of a couple: the only witnesses are the two children, an autistic child and the super-protective sister. A film of minimal thickness and irrelevant tension, the result of Hollywood's unwavering infatuation with the psychoanalyst's bed. Rightly passed over in silence at the Berlin Film Festival in 1994, it was promptly reintroduced to the cinema in '96 after the sudden notoriety of Liv Tyler.

title: Bullet
actors: Mickey Rourke, Tupac Shakur, Alberta Watson
description: Butch "Bullet" Stain is released from prison after eight years in prison for drug dealing. It once seemed to have a future in baseball, but has now hopelessly embarked on the path of crime. In fact, as soon as he is outside he gets involved again in fights between drug dealers. Bullet also drags his younger brother Ruby into trouble, an aspiring artist clearly set out to follow in his footsteps as a misfit criminal. Between dealing, ambushes, family difficulties, Bullet's life burns without even the sincere love of a girl being able to save him.
notes: The collapse of Mickey Rourke is now unstoppable: every year it comes with some unthinkable crap (see "F.T.W."); different plots, but regularly united by a high rate of boredom, inconsistency and above all boredom. A badly written film and perhaps even worse made, crowded with pathetic and caricatured characters who compete for the palm of dementia for Rourke.

title: How to Make an American Quilt
actors: Winona Ryder, Anne Bancroft, Ellen Burstyn, Jean Simmons, Johnathon Schaech
description: In a house among the California orange groves, seven women sew together a "quilt", the classic American quilt with patchwork motifs, which will be the wedding blanket of the hostess's granddaughter: Finn, a student from Berkeley struggling with her degree thesis and with boyfriend. Each of the seven women is preparing a personalized piece of blanket: the work reflects the different sensitivities, stimulates the imagination and the resurfacing of memories.
notes: The film starts off quite well, but then the literary nature of the text, with an excessive recourse to the flashback, ends up breaking the narrative tension: the past is, in reality, much less interesting than the present. Too bad because among the protagonists there are excellent actresses.

title: Georgia
actors: Jennifer Jason Leigh, Mare Winningham, Ted Levine
description: Georgia is a successful singer, with a devoted husband acting as an impresario, two children and a third on the way. His sister Sadie, on the other hand, never had any talent. On the other hand, he has always admired his sister, dreaming of being like her. Now he gets by as best he can, between piano bars, drug stories and second-rate clubs, still looking for a personal style or at least a lifeline.
notes: All governed by familiar words and catchphrases, a film that is opaque and smoky like the places it evokes, very theatrical, with echoes of Tennesse Williams and Sam Shepard. Jason Leigh in the role of Sadie is too over the top: Winningham is better than Georgia is quieter and more intense.

title: A Goofy Movie
description: Pippo has decided to leave to go fishing, taking his teenage son Max with him, who actually follows him reluctantly. Among the intentions of the father would be to get closer to his son, experiencing "great moments to remember". Max would like to spend the "great moments" in a completely different way and with completely different people (like sweet Roxanne, who had given him an appointment). The boy even sees a possible resemblance to his father as one of the worst nightmares, so you can imagine his enthusiasm for the journey in which Pippo drags him. After sixty years as Mickey's wingman, Pippo is promoted to star in a feature film. He is supported by a real son, while before there was the hateful nephew Gilberto. This confirms an innovative line at Disney, where once kinships were banned online. Always distracted and clumsy, with his irremediable idiosyncrasy for order, rationality and discipline, Pippo closely resembles Jerry Lewis.

title: Backlash
actors: Richard Widmark, Donna Reed, John McIntire, William Campbell
description: Jim's stepfather is given up for dead along with his four traveling companions who were ambushed by the Apache, Arizona. While Jim searches for her body, he meets a woman, Karil who, in turn, is looking for her husband's, victim of the same ambush. More than out of pity for her husband, Karil is driven by the desire to recover the $ 60,000 in gold that the man had with him. Jim and the widow, having overcome the initial distrust, continue the research together.
notes: Borden Chase's screenplay (from the novel by Frank Gruber) introduces psychoanalytic and Oedipal elements into the story, and Sturges focuses on action.

title: Scuola di ladri. Parte seconda
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Massimo Boldi, Florence Guérin, Enrico Maria Salerno
description: In this second episode Dalmazio and Egisto leave prison and the criminal asylum respectively. They risk a second arrest for their clumsiness and, desperate, they return to the hands of their "uncle", who has become blind. A first shot of 300 million on a train, a second (of 30 billion!) On a ship. The "trio of wonders" of the cousins ??of the first "School of thieves" got lost on the street Amalio / Lino Banfi. The film that is even more sloppy than the previous one. The beautiful presence of Guérin stands out, at the time of the glorious soft-core.

title: Yesterday 2 - Vacanze al mare
actors: Eleonora Giorgi, Massimo Ciavarro, Jerry Calà
description: After the first episode, the memories continue, between the poignant and the amused, of past carefree holidays on the beach and overwhelming seaside adventures that last the space of a summer. Each character lives his own story that is only marginally intertwined with those of the others so that each can be said to be the protagonist of a fragment of life.
notes: After the first part, Marina Suma threw in the towel. Others persevere. The film is signed by the youngest of the Risi, former author of the "Ragazzi della III C". If the first part was not a masterpiece, imagine the second ...

title: Anna Christie
actors: Greta Garbo, Charles Bickford, Marie Dressler
description: An experienced prostitute, with a stormy past (Greta Garbo), falls in love with a young sailor against all conveniences. From a play by Eugene O'Neill, a rich melodrama of yesteryear that went down in history as the first sound film of the "divine". The claim of its advertising launch is famous: "Garbo talks!".

title: Hondo and the Apaches
actors: Ralph Taeger, Kathie Browne, Michael Rennie, Noah Beery jr.
description: To restore peace with the Apache Indians, the American government instructs Hondo, a white man who married the daughter of a tribal chief, to carry out a delicate diplomatic mission. Predictable and drawn-out story. The director is Lee H. Katzin, known for the television series "Space 1999".

title: Arthur 2 on the Rocks
actors: Dudley Moore, Liza Minnelli, John Gielgud, Geraldine Fitzgerald
description: To marry the beautiful, but poor Linda (Liza Minnelli), the nabob Arturo (Dudley Moore) has left his girlfriend Susan. Her billionaire father takes revenge on his missing son-in-law by hindering him in every way. Disappointing especially for those who appreciated the verve of "Arturo", of which he is the sequel, which had the same cast, but another director.

title: La vita, a volte, è molto dura, vero Provvidenza?
actors: Tomas Milian, Gregg Palmer, Janet Agren, Dieter Eppler, Stelio Candelli, Hans Terofal
description: A cultured and very penniless bounty hunter, Provvidenza captures the Hurricane Kid for the umpteenth time. Then it has to do with a girl who goes fast, a rascal sheriff, a criminologist, a group of pious pioneers ...
notes: The western canon deformed to the point of grotesque, in a fragmentary delirium of music (Ennio Morricone), twists and gags.

title: Lightning Strikes Twice
actors: Ruth Roman, Richard Todd, Zachary Scott
description: Shelley meets in fortuitous circumstances a young man who has just been acquitted (thanks to the testimony of a friend) from the accusation of murder: she falls in love with him and marries him. But the surprises are not over ... It is not among Vidor's best works, but it is certainly a film that has the right doses of restlessness and mystery.

title: Raton Pass
actors: Dennis Morgan, Patricia Neal, Steve Cochran
description: To take over her husband's ranch, a woman teams up with a creditor (with whom she has an affair) and starts a war between ranchers. A western centered on the portrait of a strong and greedy woman, with melodramatic accents.

title: I paladini - Storia d'armi e di amori
actors: Zeudi Araya, Barbara De Rossi, Rick Edwards, Leigh McCloskey
description: A sorceress has predicted to the Christian warrior Bradamante that she will fall in love with an enemy: a Saracen named Ruggero who, however, is destined to die at the hands of Rolando who loves Isabella, who is a prisoner of Bradamante ... courtly tradition (and, perhaps involuntarily, to the puppet opera), Battiato makes a film that is not very inspired, aesthetic and not at all involving.

title: Trouble Along the Way
actors: John Wayne, Donna Reed, Charles Coburn
description: The sporting victories of his football team should save a religious college from closure: but the new coach decides to complicate his life a little with an unexpected love story. Curious comedy with an uplifting character with a John Wayne in the unprecedented role of sports coach.

title: Highway to Hell
actors: Patrick Bergin, Kristy Swanson, Chad Lowe, Adam Storke
description: Charlie Sykes is in the car with his beautiful Rachel, when he is in a remote place called Black Canyon Road. At the gas station called Last Chance, the owner tries to explain to the boys that the road from there on is dangerous. But they don't listen, Rachel is kidnapped and from that moment Charlie has only 24 hours to take her out of hell. There isn't much to say. Apart from the fact that hell seems to be made of polystyrene, that the script loses its pieces at every moment and that Patrick Bergin ("In bed with the enemy") is not exactly a monster of sympathy, apart from all this the film lets itself be seen.

title: Hand of a Stranger
actors: Paul Lukather, Joan Harvey, James Stapleton, Ted Otis
description: From the car accident he suffered, pianist Vernon Paris comes out with mangled hands and a surgeon transplants those of a recently dead criminal. Paris, however, is no longer able to play and, indeed, it almost seems that now the directives for his actions come from those "foreign" hands. With which he begins to commit murders, almost to the point of murdering the surgeon. The subject has been brought to the screen several times: this should be the fourth, and not the worst.

title: On the Beat
actors: Norman Wisdom, Jennifer Jayne, Raymond Huntley, David Lodge
description: Norman Pitckin lets the clients of the guesthouse where he is staying believe that he is a brave Scotland Yard policeman, but instead his role is only that of keeper of the police cars. But he really needs him to bring the leader of a dangerous band of thieves to justice. And Norman, after having made a certain pact with the bosses that is close to his heart, accepts ... We are almost more on the side of farce than on that of real comedy, and "forcing" is part of the game. But the film is certainly hilarious, albeit far from the best in British entertainment.

title: Charlie Chan's Murder Cruise
actors: Sidney Toler, Marjorie Weaver, Lionel Atwill
description: A policeman friend of Charlie Chan is killed when he is about to reveal to the investigator his plan to catch a killer on a cruise. Chan will do it himself.

title: Charlie Chan in Rio
actors: Sidney Toler, Victor Sen Yung, Mary Beth Hughes, Cobina Wright
description: Collaborating with the local police (which, for once, does not seem to be made up of pure idiots), Charlie Chan investigates two murders, connected to each other. The plot is that of "Black Camel", one of the first episodes of the series.

title: Dead Men Tell
actors: Sidney Toler, Victor Sen Yung, Sheila Ryan, Robert Weldon
description: An elderly lady who was on the trail of a family treasure hidden by an ancestor, a famous pirate, was murdered. Charlie Chan finds out how and by whom.

title: Castle in the Desert
actors: Sidney Toler, Arleen Whelan, Richard Derr, Douglass Dumbrille
description: Invited by a millionaire to a ghostly castle in the desert, Charlie Chan unexpectedly finds himself having to work overtime at his "job" as the other guests mysteriously begin to die one after another.
notes: Chan's last film produced by 20th Century Fox before moving to Monogram. Sidney Toler was the second of the three "historical" interpreters of the detective, after Warner Oland, active in the Thirties, and before Roland Winters, who played the Monogram series. Toler's films are characterized above all by locations, often exotic: Honululu, Panama, Rio and even Treasure Island.

title: Bad Company
actors: Lance Henriksen, Eric Roberts
description: Jack is a traveling salesman by trade and travels the streets of the United States alone in his car. Now he is traveling through a desert in the southwest, while the radio reports that an impressive series of crimes has occurred in the area. Jack doesn't pay much attention to it and doesn't say no to the hitchhiker who stands by the side of the road waiting for a ride. In the middle of the desert Henriksen's wrinkles ("Alien", "When the Dark Comes") are more frightening than Eric Roberts' grown-up face, but so be it.

title: Guncrazy
actors: Drew Barrymore, James LeGros, Joe Dallesandro, Michael Ironside
description: Anita (Drew Barrymore) is sixteen years old and a morality under any suspicion. She lives with her mother and with a stepfather with long hands. After all, she does not seem to make it a drama. The boy with whom he exchanges letters is called Howard and is in jail. When he comes out, it seems that he starts for the two a escape of normal life, but the idea of ​​killing some people takes over.
notes: The original title ("Guncrazy") and the excelled, obsessive fascination towards the weapons come from the old, classic film by Joseph H. Lewis. Bitter, tense; The hysterical Drew Barrymore and the controlled James Legros is good.

title: Totò d'Arabia
actors: Totò, Nieves Navarro, Georges Rigaud, Fernando Sancho, Mario Castellani
description: The head of the Intelligence Service entrusts the servant Totò with a very important mission concerning the oil of Kuwait. In fact, Totò was entrusted with the task of convincing the sheikh to grant the rights to exploit the wells to the British; but ours has to contend with a charming American spy. Endless ups and downs, but in the end Totò himself becomes the absolute master of the deposits.
notes: Made in co-production with Spain, the film is one of the latest to be played by the now tired and almost blind comedian. We laugh very little, and the spying idea is very clumsy.

title: Yesterday - Vacanze al mare
actors: Jerry Calà, Marina Suma, Massimo Ciavarro, Eleonora Giorgi
description: An old restaurant by the sea is about to be torn down. A group of friends decide to organize a party to say goodbye to the place where they have spent so many happy moments: there is the son of an industrialist who loses everything at the game, the starlet in search of success, an unlikely master of tennis, all in search of the past.
notes: The long wave of seaside cinema is really hard to die. This film, shot for the small screen, gathers an "all star" cast of Italian comedy, Jerry Calà in the lead, who give life to a sort of generational amarcord. For the rest, flat direction, lack of inventiveness and abundant clichés.

title: Enter the Ninja
actors: Franco Nero, Susan George, Sho Kosugi, Christopher George
description: Cole, an expert teacher of ninjitsu (a martial art that mixes karate, judo and hypnotism), goes to the aid of his friend Frank who, in the Philippines, is threatened by a gang of speculators. Mediocre genre film that accumulates stereotypes and clichés almost without realizing it.

title: Eccezzziunale... veramente
actors: Diego Abatantuono, Massimo Boldi, Teo Teocoli, Stefania Sandrelli
description: Three episodes to satirize (so to speak!) The national passion for football. In the first, a Milan fan of southern origin clashes with Inter opponents. The Nerazzurri boss ends up in the hospital with total amnesia. In the second, an Inter fan makes 13 at the Totocalcio: he gives up his wife and mother-in-law and gives himself up to the good life until he discovers that it is a joke of his friends. Lastly, a Juventus truck driver exchanges his vehicle with that of a colleague headed to Belgium: in this way he thinks he is attending an important match, but the truck is stolen and he gets into trouble. Vanzinata "doc", with Abatantuono "first manner".

title: The Psychopath
actors: Patrick Wymark, Margaret Johnston, Alexander Knox
description: Inspector Holloway investigates a murder: next to the corpse of the victim, named Klermer, he finds a doll with his features. The trace of the doll brings Holloway to the elderly Mrs. Von Sturm, a doll collector and widow of a German industrialist condemned at the end of the war by a commission of which Klermer was a member. The conclusions seem obvious, but the inspector is still not entirely convinced ...

title: Testa o croce
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Mara Venier, Nino Manfredi, Ida Di Benedetto
description: The lost sheep: Don Remigio, who became a priest after having suffered an accident as a boy, receives a blow to the head and falls in love, reciprocated, with a girl. Another hit, and everything goes back to normal. "The son of the Bedouin": a very "macho" worker, named Bedouin, is shocked at the idea that his son may be gay. He will find that his fears have absolutely no reason to exist. If the second episode offers a respectable Manfredi and a non-trivial vision of the world of the Roman townsfolk, the first (with Pozzetto prete) is rather heavy. Overall, little more than two jokes.

title: Through the Eyes of a Killer
actors: Marg Helgenberger, Richard Dean Anderson, David Marshall Grant, Melinda Culea
description: Laurie just broke her engagement and moved into an apartment in need of a major renovation. Met on this occasion the carpenter Ray begins a relationship with him that ends when Laurie discovers that there was something between Ray and her best friend. Except that, at this point, the chain of deaths in the story and poor Laurie will take tremendous risks before coming out of it. There is a whole "sub-genre" of trhilling cinema based on the binomial "house-danger", at various levels of tension. This television film is also part of it, with the merits of a self-confident narrative despite some ingenuity.

title: Skipper
actors: Fabio Testi, William Berger, Corinne Cléry, Gianni Garko, Barbara D'Urso
description: A skipper - that is, the captain of a sailboat, the one who decides the maneuvers to be done - lives a series of exciting adventures, seafaring and non -seafaring adventures.
notes: Television series designed at the time for the first evening and which instead, despite the presence of the cléry can make the opposite think, is more suitable for the band for the boys.

title: Frankie Starlight
actors: Anne Parillaud, Matt Dillon, Gabriel Byrne, Corban Walker
description: We are in 1946. Bernadette, an eighteen year old French woman, is alone in Ireland, without money and pregnant. She gives birth to Frank, suffering from dwarfism. In the difficult daily struggle Bernadette finds support in her relationship with Jack, an Irish amateur astronomer who also helps little Frank. After a few years, Frankie made a name for himself in literature after publishing a moving autobiography.
notes: A story that would have what it takes to captivate and move, but fails to take off: the story of Frankie's life runs without a soul, alternating past and present without delving into either level. Macroscopically incomplete in the psychological excavation of the characters (all aligned with Byrne's zero degree expressiveness), the film is entirely governed by the two talented dwarf interpreters of Frankie (child and adult).

title: O convento
actors: John Malkovich, Catherine Deneuve, Luis Miguel Cintra, Leonor Silveira
description: Professor Michael Padovic is working on a thesis in Paris aimed at proving that Shakespeare was of Spanish descent. He needs some documents that should be found in the ancient convent of Arrabida, Portugal. Michael then leaves for Portugal with his wife Hélène. While staying at the convent, the diabolical guardian Baltar, who is strongly attracted to Hélèn, weaves his plots ...
notes: De Oliveira, over 80 years old master of Portuguese cinema, is always treacherous and pungent. In this film, for the first time with international stars, he triggers a refined couple game that smells of sulfur.

title: Feast of July
actors: Embeth Davidtz, Tom Bell, Ben Chaplin, Gemma Jones, James Purefoy
description: The young Bella Ford travels lonely in the dark and long British winter in search of the boyfriend from whom he was abandoned. After being deeply marked by a new tragedy-the loss of the son that she brought on the womb-girl finally finds comfort and sheltered at the home of acquaintances, the Wainwright family. The men of the house end up competing with each other to conquer the love of the eventful and mysterious guest.
notes: The film is a kind of re -edition of "wind of passions", but dried up and moved from the new to the old world.
