A completely superfluous and artistically negligible operation of the award -winning director of Screenproof Christopher Menaul. By-product of the equally awarded and pedantic merchand-Ivory company.

title: A Promise Kept: The Oksana Baiul Story
actors: Monica Keena, Miguel Ferrer, Sonja Lanzener, Susanna Thompson
description: Oksana Baiul is three years old when they give her the first skates. He fits them and practically never takes them off. Thirteen years later your country (Ukraine) went through a radical transformation from a satellite of the Communist empire to an independent state, as she became a little champion capable of winning gold in an Olympic competition.
notes: A little anti-communism never hurts: it's a pity it's out of time.

title: La settima stanza
actors: Maia Morgenstern, Adriana Asti, Jan Novicki, Elide Melli
description: Edith Stein, born Jewish but converted to Catholicism in 1922, is a world-renowned scholar, assistant to the philosopher Husserl. While political tension increases in Germany, Edith's religious vocation matures up to the decision to become a Carmelite nun. Meanwhile, outside, the Nazi persecutions against the Jews are getting harder and harder. Edith, as a Jew, is also deported to Auschwitz to meet her terrible fate.
notes: Director Marta Mészàros translates into images the story of an extraordinary woman (declared a saint by Pope Wojtyla in 1994) making a difficult and uncomfortable film, but one that has a lot to say.

title: Torch Song
actors: Joan Crawford, Michael Wilding, Marjorie Rambeau, Dorothy Patrick
description: A famous and capricious musical singer (Crawford) meets a pianist who has gone blind from a wound sustained in the war. Perhaps because of her infirmity the man is the only one who tells her frankly what he thinks of her and her tantrums. She first gets him fired, then falls in love with him. Pretentious and banal at the same time. Crawford "eats" the whole scene, but in the musical numbers she is excellent.

title: Tom Horn
actors: Steve McQueen, Linda Evans, Richard Farnsworth
description: Wyoming ranchers, annoyed by cattle thieves, hire a gunslinger. On the advice of John Coble they turn to Tom Horn, a lone cowboy who lives in the mountains loyal to his horse and, above all, to his Winchester. Within a few months, Tom clears up the cattle raiders. Breeders, among other things, fear an intervention by the federal authority concerned that they have had to resort to the help of a bounty killer.
notes: The myths of the West at sunset and a man displaced by the end of his world. For Steve McQueen it is the latest notable interpretation. Richard Farsworth, here in the role of John Coble, is the protagonist of the beautiful "A True Story".

title: The Executioner
actors: George Peppard, Joan Collins, Judy Geeson
description: Joe, a British secret agent, suspects his colleague Adam of being a dangerous double agent. He investigates, and when he thinks he has proven his guesswork, he kills. But it is a tragic mistake. The non-triofalistic side of espionage: it is a pity that realization and interpretations are so conventional.

title: Storm Over the Nile
actors: Anthony Steel, Laurence Harvey, James Robertson Justice, Mary Ure
description: An English officer takes his leave before the troops leave for the colonial wars. Girlfriend, father and friends brand him as a coward. Then he leaves for Egypt and, disguised as an Arab, demonstrates all the heroism he is capable of. Discolored (in every sense) remake of "The Four Feathers" (1939), by Zoltan Korda.

title: S.S.S. Snake
actors: Strother Martin, Dirk Benedict, Heather Menzies
description: A scientist invents a serum to turn humans into snakes, uses the unwitting assistant as a guinea pig for his experiments, and protects his secret with murder. The drama falls into a sinister atmosphere. A bare B-movie, but at times very effective.

title: The Steel Trap
actors: Joseph Cotten, Teresa Wright, Jonathan Hale
description: A bank official (Joseph Cotten) steals half a million dollars and prepares to flee. Then, seized by conscientious scruples, he works to return the stolen goods before they discover it. Excellent and growing suspense, written and directed with great firmness by Andrew Stone.

title: Police Academy: Mission to Moscow
actors: George Gaynes, Michael Winslow, Christopher Lee, Ron Perlman, Leslie Easterbrook
description: Konstantin Konali, powerful "godfather" of the Russian mafia, has devised a system that allows him to infiltrate all computers in the world, including those in the Pentagon and the Kremlin. The former Soviet police are unable to neutralize him and call Lassard's men to help. Through daring adventures, the mission is accomplished. The "Police School" barrel had already been drained in the previous six episodes of the series. We are now in total bolsaggine, between some postcard views and milk gags in the knees.

title: Young Billy Young
actors: Robert Mitchum, Angie Dickinson, David Carradine, Jack Kelly
description: With Kane's help, Billy Young escapes lynching after killing a cheater in self-defense. Kane is on his way to take on the role of sheriff in a small town, and he takes Billy with him to be tried. But above all he wants to avenge his son, killed by a certain Boone: he will capture the latter's son, but Billy will free the young man and ...
notes: The cast of Kennedy's film (former writer of Budd Boetticher's best westerns) includes important names, but the story pays little attention to the psychological digging of the characters, limiting itself to a superficial, pure routine characterization.

title: Lizzie
actors: Eleanor Parker, Richard Boone, Joan Blondell
description: Prisoner of a triple personality for a terrible shock she suffered as a young girl, after so much suffering she finally meets the psychiatrist who will be able to free her by revealing the secret buried in her soul. Film of the psychoanalytic vein a little out of time.

title: Rabid Grannies
actors: Catherine Aymerie, Caroline Brackman, Richard Cotica
description: Two old ladies with an harmless air open a mysterious package and turn into cannibal monsters. Typical troma production.

title: Brevi amori a Palma di Maiorca
actors: Alberto Sordi, Dorian Gray, Belinda Lee, Gino Cervi
description: Sentimental adventures of Italians on vacation: a couple of arranged marriages, an industrialist who spends a boatload of money on his girlfriend, a funny limp who tries to conquer a movie star, he can't, but he is equally happy.
notes: The idea is obvious, but the film is not without humor.

title: George Balanchine's The Nutcracker
actors: Macaulay Culkin, Jessica Lynn Cohen, Darci Kistler, Damian Woetzel
description: Among the Christmas gifts that little Marie (Cohen) received from her grandfather, there is also a funny nutcracker (Culkin), a little man with big teeth. The spells that the nutcracker can produce are so many and such that Marie, getting up alone in the night, will be led into a fairytale world where the fairy palace is located. Final with general dance to the rhythm of waltzes. The late Emile Ardolino ("Dirty Dancing", but before that the TV series "Dance in America") knew about ballets. This version of the "Nutcracker" is unexciting, but it's not his fault either. Macaulay Culkin doesn't even look bad on us.

title: Brotherhood of Justice
actors: Keanu Reeves, Lori Loughlin, Kiefer Sutherland, Joe Spano
description: A vandal raid by unknown thugs at school is the straw that breaks the camel's back. At that point the kids in the area decide to set up a group of vigilantes that can fight drugs, violence and all the rest. Then things go on on their own and almost without realizing it the boys begin to impose their violence and their personal justice on everyone else. The anti-violence message is clear and it is also quite obvious. The making of Charles Braverman is mediocre and nothing can be done about it. What can be done is to observe a decent group of talents (Keanu Reeves above all) close to blossom.

title: Man of La Mancha
actors: Peter O'Toole, Sophia Loren, James Coco, Harry Andrews, John Castle
description: Miguel de Cervantes languishes in a prison in Seville who has the idea of ??defending himself from the charges for which he was incarcerated by reading and miming a novel he is about to finish: "Don Quixote". Thus the same author becomes his character, the famous knight with a sad figure, next to whom the squire Sancho Panza, the beautiful Dulcinea and all the other supporting actors soon appear.
notes: The film is derived from a Broadway show and is structured as a sequence of acting and songs. O'Toole is Cervantes-Quixote while our national Sophia sings (dubbed in English) the songs of Dulcinea, more convincing as a scullery maid than as a lady.

title: Ferragosto Ok
actors: Mauro Di Francesco, Alessandra Mussolini, Sabrina Salerno, Gianni Ciardo, Gegia, Gioia Scola
description: Mid-August, a tree on the sea, private beach, guests and their stories: the playboy who tries with the most beautiful, the aged lady who dreams of conquests, a young tennis player in pre-competitive retreat who would like (and could) conclude but comes held back by the inflexible coach. Television film, born on the (late) wave of the cinema successes of similar films by the Vanzina brothers. 2

title: Wyatt Earp - Return to Tombstone
actors: Hugh O'Brian, Harry Carey jr.
description: 65-year-old Wyatt Earp has been retired for some time. He therefore decides to return to Tombstone to fulfill a promise. On the way he meets the old cemetery guardian, Digger, and then Sheriff Sam Darling, saloon owner Clay Riordan and one of the town's founders, Ted Spooner. With them he remembers the old days, when he was the one who represented the law and enforced order.
notes: A film played on the thread of memory (there are many sequences in flashbacks) of one of the mythical figures of the American western. Harry Carey Jr., himself the son of a western star, is an old John Ford movie icon.

title: Il petomane
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Mariangela Melato, Vittorio Caprioli, Ricky Tognazzi
description: Joseph Pujol performs in a Parisian club enjoying great success thanks to his versatility in the emission of farts, accompanied by an orchestra composed of his five children. When one of them leaves the complex, Pujol organizes an audition to replace him. So he meets Catherine, and love is born between the two. It will be a very troubled story.
notes: A not very salty subject treated without vulgarity. The film is darker than expected, and can be seen thanks also to a very good Tognazzi.

title: Il sole è di tutti
actors: Dino, Luciana Gilli, Ave Ninchi, Carlo Delle Piane, Elio Pandolfi
description: Someone has summoned seven girls to Rome for the sharing of an inheritance. But, instead, it was a joke organized by some young men, including a singer who thus has the opportunity to make his artistic creations known. Second-rate musicarello, conceived as a vehicle for singer Dino. Only for fans of the trash-sculpt-camp.

title: Il ginecologo della mutua
actors: Renzo Montagnani, Paola Senatore, Mario Carotenuto, Isabella Biagini, Karin Schubert, Aldo Fabrizi
description: Doctor Lobianco, burdened with debts, flees abroad and hands over the well-started gynecological study to his colleague Giovannaldi. The latter is able to win the trust of high society and, thanks to the relationship started with the wife of a wealthy builder (enough to get her pregnant), he gets a luxurious clinic financed by his cuckold husband. And there will also be a prize for Lobianco.

title: Rush
actors: Jason Patric, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Sam Elliott, Max Perlich
description: Jim Ranor, a narcotics agent from a small town in Texas, joins his young colleague Kristen Cates on a mission that aims to frame Will Gaines, a drug trafficker. The two infiltrate the "circle", but they also fall victims. Based on a novel by Kim Wozencraft and directed by the director in a harsh, harsh style, the film offers an unconventional glimpse of the environment represented, seen as a hellish, desolate Dante's circle. Good soundtrack by Eric Clapton.

title: Stonewall
actors: Guillermo Diaz, Fred Weller, Brendan Corbalis, Duane Boutté
description: New York, summer 1968. We are in the period when homosexuality was still illegal. Stonewall is the mythical haunt of transvestites, among its patrons there is LaMiranda, who always has very provocative attitudes. The young Matty Dean also arrives there, torn between admiration for LaMiranda and attraction for the more serious and committed Ethan. One evening, after yet another raid by the police, a transvestite revolt begins.
notes: "Stonewall", finished by Finch shortly before dying of AIDS, reconstructs some stories of maturation, of brazen vindication, of radical hypocrisy, of colorful and joyful love. The film photographs with sincere humor the paradoxes of the gay condition (irresistible the tour of bars with the journalist). On the other hand Finch was not a rookie and it shows.

title: Maicol
actors: Simone Tessarolo, Sabina Regazzi, Giovanni Crespi, Maria Teresa Oldani
description: On a Saturday evening, an apartment in the Milanese suburbs. Here lives a young woman, a worker in a hosiery factory, with her little son named Maicol. Like every Saturday, the girl gets ready to go out and go dancing in the disco but, this time, due to a series of setbacks, she can't find someone to look after the baby. He then decides to take it with him, but forgets it on the subway. The child remains on the train that crosses the city all evening. Brenta is a pupil of Olmi, and he feels himself in the attention to detail and silences. The film, released at a time of depression in Italian cinema, greatly struck critics for its gaze on metropolitan atmospheres.

title: Cominciò tutto per caso
actors: Margherita Buy, Massimo Ghini, Raoul Bova, Barbara Jane
description: Stefania has definitively abandoned the idea of ??becoming an actress, permanently dedicating herself to dubbing. She is married to Luca, a left-wing journalist, who has finally managed to enter the editorial office of an important weekly. If the economic situation improves, the sentimental one, on the other hand, definitely worsens when Stefania discovers that Luca is cheating on her. Meanwhile, love blossoms between their Filipino maid and a young plumber.
notes: Playwright and also skilled screenwriter, Umberto Marino amuses himself with the cuteness typical of the minimalist Italian cinema of the 80s. Indigestible.

title: La seconde vérité
actors: Michèle Mercier, Robert Hossein, Jacques Castelot, Bernard Tiphaine
description: The lawyer Pierre Montaud is accused of the murder of a certain Olivier Lacat, killed with a gun owned by the lawyer. The accusation is reinforced by the fact that Nathalie, a former partner of Lacat, is now Montaud's mistress. Despite the weight of the clues, however, Montaud was acquitted at the trial amid general disbelief.
notes: Typical French work in which the "yellow" plot is never separated from sentimental and psychological notations. Sophisticated images, elaborate dialogues, just a pinch of eroticism and the recipe is ready to be cooked.

title: Fotografando Patrizia
actors: Monica Guerritore, Lorenzo Lena, Gianfranco Manfredi
description: On the death of the old housekeeper Edmea, who up to that point has looked after the young Emilio, Patrizia, the latter's sister, returns home, selling the prosperous fashion company she owns. His intention is to take care of his brother, with an introverted character, physically handicapped (he is often forced to resort to a torso and a rigid collar) who spends his days locked in his room reading pornographic magazines and watching hard videotapes. Relations between the two soon become increasingly murky. Samperi, having passed from transgression to glossy eroticism, now appears to have died out. Despite her theatrical curriculum, Guerritore does not have the charm of Antonelli in "Malizia".

title: Qua la mano
actors: Enrico Montesano, Philippe Leroy, Adriano Celentano, Lilli Carati, Renzo Montagnani
description: In the first episode Orazio (Enrico Montesano) is a coachman full of debdn the fixed idea of ??meeting the Pope (Philippe Leroy). He will succeed by winning a large bet with which to settle the creditors. Celentano, in the second episode, plays the role of Don Fulgenzio, a priest with the demon of the dance. The beautiful Rossana (Lilli Carati) falls in love with him with whom he will win a dance competition.
notes: The more complete the first, the more frayed the second, they are two episodes so different that they are practically two films in themselves. Celentano as usual tends to overflow while Montesano repeats for the umpteenth time his typical Roman character.

title: Straight on Till Morning
actors: Rita Tushingham, Shane Briant, James Bolan
description: A young writer moves to London where she meets a charming boy, Peter, who is actually a ferocious killer. A kind of yellow version of Peter Pan.

title: The Savage Guns
actors: Richard Basehart, Don Taylor, Alex Nicol, Rafael Albaicin, Manolita Barroso
description: A former Civil War fighter moved to Mexico and is now a ranchero. The experience of the war upset him to the point that he vowed never to touch the gun again, even though he was an infallible marksman. However, the man must contravene his purpose because of a gang of evildoers. American-Spanish production. The plot is of the most banal, and the staging is no less.

title: Una vacanza del cactus
actors: Anna Maria Rizzoli, Enzo Cannavale, Bombolo, Vincenzo Crocitti, Bruno Minniti
description: Mr. Zerboni (Cannavale) goes on vacation to Greece with his wife Fedora and a group of employees: the rag. Pistilli, Augusto and Angela (Rizzoli). Misunderstandings and messes multiply and while Zerboni tries to seduce the busty employee, his wife gets in the way of her terrible myopia; Augusto (Bombolo), on behalf of the widow, searches for the tomb of an uncle.
notes: Coarse comedy that, canonically, slips one "comic" episode after another, focusing on the repetitiveness of specks and clichés. It goes without saying that the landscapes of the island of Rhodes are overwhelmed by those offered by Rizzoli.

title: Week-end à Zuydcoote
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Catherine Spaak, Georges Géret, Marie Dubois
description: June 1940: overwhelmed by the panzers, the Franco-British troops mass on the beach of Zudycoote waiting for a boarding for England. Sergeant Julien Maillat finds a place on a freighter, but the Luftwaffe sinks it. Maillat returns to Jeanne, a friend who lives in a nearby villa, in time to kill a couple of drifters who want to rape her. The two dream of escaping together ...
notes: Odyssey-melò of war, based on a novel by Robert Merle. Verneuil's direction is nothing brilliant, but you can enjoy Belmondo's dynamism and a good dose of spectacular scenes, made possible by a relatively rich production.

title: Wind
actors: Stellan Skarsgård, Matthew Modine, Jennifer Grey, Cliff Robertson
description: Will Parker, a young American sailor, is one of the crew on Cliff Robertson's boat. We are in 1983 in Newport and the races that must award the prestigious America's Cup trophy are about to begin. Everyone is in agony to try to break the cycle of 130 victories for the Americans and a crew seems to be able to do it.
notes: Endless shipwreck in boredom, despite the suggestive sequences of nautical competition.

title: Rich and Famous
actors: Jacqueline Bisset, Candice Bergen, David Selby, Meg Ryan
description: Merry Noel and Liz, friends in their years of study, reunite after ten years. Liz is now a famous busy writer, and even Marry Noel wants to publish a book, which she has ready, about the frivolities of her neighbors. She is successful too, but with an easier audience, and it's rivalry between the two women, fueled by other factors as well. Years later, the two lonely women console themselves with memories of their youth.
notes: George Cukor's latest film, now 82: moving and secular testament, split autobiography (the intellectual and the bestselling author), a poem about friendship and the passage of time. A sex scene between Bisset and a boy on a plane caused quite a stir. Remake of Vincent Sherman's "Friend".

title: Tarzan the Magnificent
actors: Gordon Scott, Jock Mahoney, John Carradine, Al Mulock
description: During a bank robbery in Equatorial Africa, a police inspector friend of Tarzan is killed. He captures the culprit and, overcoming difficulties in series, delivers him to justice. In the meantime he also manages to fix other things.
notes: He is the best Tarzan played by Scott. However, we feel that the trend is now exhausted.

title: Hue and Cry
actors: Harry Fowler, Frederick Piper, Alastair Sim, Douglas Barr
description: There is a criminal organization, in the East End in London, which has chosen a comic book newspaper as unsuspected means of communication to transmit orders and operational plans. But there is also a group of awake and daring kids who discovers makeup and who mobilizes to defeat the bad guys. The police are skeptical, but the peers of young investigators rush en masse. A film that resists time thanks to the brilliant liveliness of the script, to an excellent soundtrack and a real use of the scenography in a London still scattered with (authentic) rubble. In England the film was a huge success.

title: When Dinosaurs Ruled the Earth
actors: Victoria Vetri, Patrick Allen, Robin Hawdon, Drewe Henley
description: In the Stone Age, a virgin escapes a blood sacrifice, is rescued from the sea by a handsome fisherman, and fraternizes with a baby dinosaur. Light but not despicable, from a treatment (the first past in film) by James G. Ballard.

title: Culo e camicia
actors: Enrico Montesano, Daniela Poggi, Renato Pozzetto, Maria Rosaria Omaggio, Leopoldo Mastelloni
description: The TV: Rick hopes to make a career in the TV where he works. A pair of shoes given to him by an elderly shoemaker who has returned from the afterlife allow him to fulfill three wishes. "A man, a man and ... long live a woman!": The quiet, ten-year coexistence of Renato and Alberto Maria is put in crisis by the appearance of Ella. Then everything settles down, according to ... traditional values. In the first episode, Enrico Montesano masters the situation well and, without overdoing it, builds a fairly good character. In the second, however, also due to a vulgar script, Renato Pozzetto drowns in a sea of ??vulgarity.

title: Oh, mia bella matrigna
actors: Sabina Ciuffini, Gianfranco de Angelis, Crippy Yocard, Gloria Piedimonte
description: The archaeologist Luigi is left a widower due to a frightening car accident and remarries a young student, Lalla. However, an ardent carnal passion arises between his son Claudio and his stepmother. The thing becomes more and more murky and serious, until the two lovers come to plan the murder of the inconvenient father and husband.
notes: It is an inconsistent trash photo novel, but the attempt to transform Sabina Ciuffini into a vamp, at the time the famous television valley without the right to speak in the television quiz Rischiatutto, has something heroic and desperate. Needless to say, the plot is totally inconsistent.

title: House on Haunted Hill
actors: Vincent Price, Richard Long, Carole Ohmart, Alan Marshal
description: Loren (Price), an eccentric American billionaire, rents a house where numerous murders have occurred, and haunted by ghosts, to give a strange reception. To each of the four guests who agree to spend the night in the cursed house, he offers ten thousand dollars and a coffin-shaped case containing a revolver. The vigil is studded with tragic twists and turns. Suspense and grandguignolesque effects to be enjoyed without too many questions on the logical coherence or credibility of the story. When the film was released, the screening was also accompanied by easy "live" tricks to increase the fear of the audience in the hall.

title: The Blue Lamp
actors: Jack Warner, Jimmy Hanley, Dirk Bogarde
description: Young London policeman Andy Mitchell rents a room in the home of Officer Dixon, who guides him through the first steps of the trade. But Dixon is killed by two thugs, Spud and Tom Riley, during a movie robbery. And, with the collaboration of the local underworld itself, the hunt for murderers begins.
notes: A successful film in all its components, from the treatment of the story with the masterful dosage of the different elements, to the cinematographic narration, to the rendering of the performers.

title: Rhapsody in August
actors: Tomoko Ontakara, Mie Suzuki, Titsunori Isaki, Richard Gere, Sachiko Murase
description: An elderly survivor of the August 9, 1945 bomb hosts four grandchildren whose parents are temporarily in Honolulu. The grandmother tells them about the terrible tragedy of the atomic bomb, of which young people practically no longer find any feedback. The arrival of Clark, a grandson of America of the woman, does not close the ancient wounds, even if everything seems to conspire to cause the past to be forgotten. Kurosawa's heartfelt plea for memory of the tragedy to remain and for Japan not to renounce its culture takes shape in a film that has been unjustly classified among the elderly master's "minors". Quiet, didactic, with an apparently minimalist trend and a couple of high rhetoric surges (the visit to the monument to the fallen and the final image of the old man with an umbrella, to music by Schubert).

title: Somebody Killed Her Husband
actors: Farrah Fawcett, Jeff Bridges, John Wood, Tammy Grimes, John Glover, Patricia Elliott Marvin, Mary McCarthy, Laurence Guittard, Beeson Carroll
description: A young, blonde, attractive and unhappily married lady (Fawcett) is busy shopping at Macy's when she suddenly meets the man of her life in the form of the toy shop assistant (Bridges). The affair proceeds happily until her husband is found with a knife stuck in his back, which puts the two lovers in some anguish. Farah Fawcett (still Major at the time) was a veteran of the success of "Charlie's Angels". Now in retrospect it is easy to say that the man who advised her to participate in this film would be hanged. It would be easy, but it wouldn't be wrong.

title: Il cav. Costante Nicosia demoniaco...
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Rossano Brazzi, Sylva Koscina, Moira Orfei
description: Costante Nicosia is the Sicilian owner of a toothpaste industry, the "Pasta del Colonnello". Vampirized by Count Draculesco, of whom he was a guest during a business trip to Romania, he returns to Italy and finds the ideal solution to satisfy his craving for plasma with his existence as a respectable bourgeois: he organizes the Nicosia blood bank for the employees of the his company, which encourages blood donation by giving bonuses.
notes: The "Marxist" parody of the vampire myth does not exceed the dimension of the joke. Curious ridge for Lucio Fulci, who as a director of the comic genre will soon switch to pure horror. Screenplay by Amendola, Corbucci and Pupi Avati.

title: Romolo e Remo
actors: Steve Reeves, Gordon Scott, Ornella Vanoni, Virna Lisi, Massimo Girotti
description: Romulus and Remus live their life as shepherds until Faustulus, who had adopted them, dies revealing their origin shrouded in mystery. The two put themselves at the head of their people and attack Albalonga where Romulus kidnaps Julia, the daughter of the king of the Sabines, Tazio. The relations between the two brothers meanwhile deteriorate and lead to hatred. In fact, when Romulus traces the boundaries of the new city, Remo challenges him to a duel that will prove to be fatal.
notes: The film starts from the story, but ends immediately in the adventure. The performers should be noted: Steve Reeves (ex-Mister Universo) and Gordon Scott (ex-Tarzan) in the spectacular final duel.

title: Ruba al prossimo tuo
actors: Claudia Cardinale, Rock Hudson, Leon Askin, Ellen Corby
description: Descending from an Italian line of law enforcement officers, Esmeralda seeks a colleague of her father in New York to help her put some of the jewels she stolen back in their place. Amidst great difficulties, the devised plan is successful in Austria, except that Esmeralda takes advantage of the opportunity to steal other joys. These would have to be returned to Rome, but things take a different turn.
notes: A pseudo-political comedy with an international cast. Direction elegant, but pleased.

title: Thank You Mr. Moto
actors: Peter Lorre, Thomas Beck, Sidney Blackmore
description: Investigator Mr. Moto is on the trail of some Chinese maps that joined together lead the indications to reach the treasure of Genghis Khan. Moto finds and destroys them before a gang of assassins takes them over. One of the best films in the Mr. Moto series with the great Peter Lorre.

title: Think Fast, Mr. Moto
actors: Peter Lorre, Virginia Field, George Cooper
description: A shipowner sends his son to the Far East to investigate the smuggling that takes place, clandestinely, on his boats. The boy is kidnapped but Mr. Moto frees him and crushes the shady traffic. Spectacular and eventful adventure for the Chinese investigator here on his first screen release.

title: Breaker Morant
actors: Edward Woodward, Jack Thompson, John Waters, Bryan Brown
description: Transvaal, 1901, Boers and British fight to defend their independence, the others to suffocate it. The British Army includes an Australian special corps, the Bushwell Carabiniers, in which Harry Morant, known as Morant, has enlisted for his skill as a tamer. To avenge his friend, Captain Hunt, killed by the Boer guerrillas, Harry has some prisoners shot without trial.
notes: From a true story, the episode refers to an episode of the Anglo-Boer War, a controversially courageous film. A good Beresford, before he emigrated to Hollywood. Oscar for defense attorney Jack Thompson.

title: The Hit
actors: Terence Stamp, John Hurt, Tim Roth, Fernando Rey
description: Gangster Willie Parker sued his friends and got them convicted. Ten years later, through Spain, the revenge plan is triggered, but the matter becomes terribly complicated. From a traditional point of view, a dynamic, acid, "bad" film with excellent actors. Stephen Frears already knew how to do it.

title: Roma, l'altra faccia della violenza
actors: Marcel Bozzuffi, Enio Girolami, Jean Favre, Roberta Paladini
description: Shocked by the death of his daughter Carol, killed at the hands of four robbers, the engineer Alessi takes it into his head to help Commissioner Carli in the raid of the guilty. Meanwhile, the underworld rages in the capital and a robbery of a valuables van leaves other dead on the street. Between this last blow and the one in which Carol died there seem to be many connections. A gang of burghers is identified as the probable author of the blows. Alessi goes wild, in spite of the advice of caution that comes from Carli.
notes: Poor Bozzuffi made better films. As for Marino Girolami, when Franco Martinelli signed himself he made even worse ones.

title: Less than Zero
actors: Andrew McCarthy, Jami Gertz, Robert Downey jr., James Spader
description: In Los Angeles, Clay and his girlfriend Blair go to great lengths to get their friend Julian out of the cocaine grip (even though Julian had momentarily snatched Blair from Clay). Julian must also beware of Rip, a dangerous drug dealer with a big credit to him. But all is in vain: during the journey that was supposed to be that of salvation, Julian succumbs. A novel by the minimalist Breat Easton Ellis, an Anglo-Polish director on his second film (after "Another Country"), a very glossy photography, not very expressive performers and a juicy musical column (Cult, Aerosmith, Bangles, David Lee Roth). So and so.

title: La tulipe noire
actors: Alain Delon, Virna Lisi, Dawn Addams, Akim Tamiroff, Francis Blanche, José Jospe, Adolfo Marsillach, Robert Manuel
description: June 1789. In a village in the French province, ruled by the cruel Marquis de Vigone, someone attacks the aristocrats who try to escape from the specter of the Revolution. This is Guillaume de Saint Preux, whom de Vigogne believes to be very trustworthy. And when Guillaume is wounded (and therefore recognizable) his place will be taken by a brother-double. Then comes July 14th.
notes: The story, beautifully taken by the collar first by Alessandro Dumas (father) and then by the film, is narrated with lighthearted joy and experienced by the interpreters with bold complicity.

title: They're a Weird Mob
actors: Walter Chiari, Clare Dunne, Chips Rafferty, Alida Chelli
description: An Italian journalist (Chiari) is invited to Australia by a cousin, who had immigrated to the country of kangaroos some time before, to collaborate with an Italian-language sports newspaper. This seems tempting and the journalist, who is not doing very well in our country, willingly accepts the invitation and leaves for the antipodes.
notes: Intriguing comedy with an inevitable but not obvious sentimental implication, directed by old Powell. A curiosity: Chiari starred in English and in the Italian version of the film he was voiced by another.

title: Lust for Gold
actors: Ida Lupino, Glenn Ford, Gig Young
description: A boy sets out in search of the gold mine his grandfather discovered in Arizona a hundred years earlier. The man had been hunted by a woman who wanted to steal the map with the location of the mine and killed her and her husband.
notes: Anomalous dramatic western told with many flashbacks that enliven the narrative.

title: The Barkleys of Broadway
actors: Fred Astaire, Ginger Rogers, Oscar Levant
description: Dinah and Joah Barkleys are a couple in life and in the theater, where they have a resounding success as protagonists of a magazine. However, Dinah also feels drawn to the dramatic roles that her husband denies her. The woman then leaves him to work with a French director who is in love with her.
notes: The plot naturally works as a pretext, the things that matter are the musical numbers interpreted by the famous couple of dancers and choreographed by the great Hermes Pan. Memorable Astaire dancing in the midst of animated shoes. To replace Judy Garland who had given up, Ginger Rogers makes a rentrée after 10 years alongside Astaire (the last film together was "Girandola" of '38). This will be their last film, almost a commemoration of the association.

title: Eyes in the Night
actors: Edward Harnold, Ann Harding, Donna Reed, Horace McNally
description: A dangerous band of spies is trying to get hold of some scientific-military secrets. On his trail, however, there is a shrewd blind policeman who, aided by his intelligent dog, will vanquish the gang.
notes: Curious yellow with men and dogs. It was Zinneman's first American film.

title: Kanal
actors: Wienczyslaw Glinski, Teresa Izewska, Tadeusz Janczar, Emil Karzwicz
description: In September 1944, with the strength of desperation, Warsaw rose up against the German occupiers, who counterattacked with the full weight of their military structure. A group of patriots tries to escape the German encirclement through the sewers and it is a terrible odyssey that progressively becomes charged with tones of tragedy, as the ranks of these daring ones dwindle. A famous, dark masterpiece by Wajda to commemorate an authentic episode of desperate heroism. A lean and vigorous narrative that gives the film an overwhelming force, almost a dramatic documentary imbued with the flavor of death.

title: C'eravamo tanto amati
actors: Nino Manfredi, Vittorio Gassman, Stefania Sandrelli, Stefano Satta Flores, Aldo Fabrizi, Giovanna Ralli, Marcella Michelangeli, Elena Fabrizi, Fiammetta Baralla, Mike Bongiorno, Marcello Mastroianni, Federico Fellini, Vittorio De Sica, Ugo Gregoretti, Dino Curcio, Isa Barzizza, Carla Mancini
description: Gianni, Nicola and Antonio made the Resistance, certain to fight for a better future. Then, after the war, they took different paths: Antonio is a porter at the San Camillo in Rome; Thanks to his marriage, Gianni entered the family of a building owner; Nicola teaches in Nocera Inferiore until he breaks up with his family and school and tries to fit into film criticism in Rome. Luciana, in love with Antonio, goes through several experiences - including a suicide attempt - before returning to him and marrying him. On the occasion of an unexpected meeting, the protagonists recall the times gone by and the cases of their lives, and take note of the changes, some of which are dramatic.
notes: A full-bodied screenplay (by Age, Scarpelli and Scola), a realization of the wrist and the excellent performance of the performers give the film - under the surface of the private existential budget of the characters - the value of a broader and well-articulated representation of the changes that have taken place. in Italian society. From the dreams and utopias of the Resistance to the sad reality of a subsequent flattening, or even (as in the case of Gianni, who "made his fortune" and pretends to be a poor man so as not to have to tell his friends his true story) of betrayal of ideals . Comedy yes, but with a lot of gall. Dedication to Vittorio De Sica, who passed away shortly before the release of the film, who appears in a cameo in which he tells the public an anecdote about the workmanship of _Ladri di bicycles_.

title: Anna
actors: Edwige Fenech, Corrado Pani, Richard Conte, John Richardson
description: Cashier in a Bergamo bar, Anna falls in love with Guido, who is part of a gang of drug traffickers. She follows him to Milan and agrees to transport heroin and "entertain" wealthy clients. Pregnant and without her man who ended up in jail, Anna moves to Rome, where she gives birth to a son and meets an honest doctor. But Guido gets out of prison earlier than expected, and it will be tragedy. To attempt the daring undertaking of an Edwige Fenech dramatic actress, here is a story that wallows in the worst "mello" and some partners willing to do anything to collect the appropriate compensation for the heroic coexistence. The ways of cinema are endless.

title: Sleep With Me
actors: Eric Stoltz, Meg Tilly, Craig Sheffer, Lewis Arquette, Todd Field
description: Joseph (Stoltz) and Sarah (Tilly) get married. Which doesn't change anything in their life and that of their friends. Except at that point Frank, who has been in love with Sarah for a lifetime, breaks free and kisses her in front of everyone. She resists a little, then gives in to Frank, then discovers that the thing is not so bad and that you can go very well in three. Shot in six clips, written by six different screenwriters, one of those films where everyone talks from start to finish, while the camera never stops shaking. But it is also funny, fake and pimp. Appearance of the ubiquitous Tarantino.

title: L'orso di peluche
actors: Alain Delon, Francesca Dellera, Regina Bianchi, Paolo Bonacelli, Laure Killing
description: A gynecology "guru", married but unrepentant Don Juan, receives an anonymous phone call threatening him with death. After the threatening warning he receives a teddy bear that belonged to one of his nurses, seduced and abandoned by him, and who for this reason had put an end to his days by committing suicide. For the doctor it is the beginning of a nightmare ... The well-established Delon-Derey couple destroys and trivializes a Simenon novel with a story that goes round in circles and touches the ridiculous moment by moment. The presence of Dellera, then, will cancel any hope.

title: La prima notte del dottor Danieli, industriale col complesso del... giocattolo
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Françoise Prevost, Katia Christina, Saro Urzì
description: Carlo Danieli, a Sicilian industrialist with an intense love life, discovers that the girl he married wanted to remain untouched until the wedding. He receives such a shock that he is totally inhibited in his sexual abilities, turning the honeymoon into a real disaster. It will be the mother-in-law, given all the attempts useless, to resolve the situation by putting a prostitute in his bed.
notes: Taken from "Aragoste di Sicilia", a comedy written by Grimaldi with Bruno Corbucci, it is a concentrate of banalities and gags that make no one laugh.

title: Sballato, gasato, completamente fuso
actors: Edwige Fenech, Enrico Maria Salerno, Diego Abatantuono, Liù Bosisio
description: The busty Patrizia, editor of the periodical "La Week", is very dissatisfied with having to edit only a marginal rubricetta. After several unsuccessful attempts to achieve greater professional gratification, she makes a proposal to the director: he will entrust her with an important investigation; if it is a success, she will have won, if it is a fiasco, Patrizia will grant him her graces ...
notes: There is, here and there, almost an attempt to hook up a discourse of customs, but always in a very, very bland way. What remains in the foreground is a comedy that focuses heavily on pecoreccio. And Abatantuono (still "first way") is seen very little. A Steno of pure profession.

title: Mission of Danger
actors: Keith Larsen, Tania Elg, Buddy Ebsen, Don Burnett
description: British and French colonies at war in North America. Major Rogers has a secret plan to break into the French fort in Quebec. Historical B series film.

title: Relentless
actors: Leo Rossi, Judd Nelson, Robert Loggia, Meg Foster
description: In the dreams of his father, a brisk policeman and more than authoritarian even in the family, Buck Taylor should have followed in his footsteps in the police force. Rejected by the academy, Buck has instead become a ruthless serial killer, who chooses his victims by scrolling through the names on the phone book. Inspector Sam Diez is entrusted with the case. Difficult and dangerous investigation, but in the end the detective comes to the head.
notes: First episode of the series dedicated to Sam Diez, excellently played by Leo Rossi. Directed by William Lustig, the one from the "Maniac Cop" series, a master in creating nightmare atmospheres and managing the low budget of a B series production.

title: Relentless
actors: Will Sampson, Marianna Hill, Monte Markham
description: An Arizona cop nicknamed "the relentless" sets out on the hunt for a gang of robbers who are on the run, taking a woman with him as a hostage. The kidnappers flee to the mountains, certain they won't be caught, but they haven't come to terms with the policeman who knows those places better than anyone else.
notes: A dignified action-movie bordering on the thriller played by the Indian who two years earlier had played "One flew over the cuckoo's nest".

title: The Only Game in Town
actors: Elizabeth Taylor, Warren Beatty, Charles Braswell, Hank Henry
description: Fran, a dancer in Las Vegas, left by Thomas for three months, gives herself to Joe, a pianist who dreams of being able to leave the city forever. But Joe, having scrapped up the necessary money, loses it in the game and goes to live with Fran. Thomas returns, but Fran doesn't want to know any more. Again Joe has the money to leave, and again he loses it. Then, finally, he has a stroke of luck, which he will share with Fran. The film, which is influenced by its theatrical origin (from the comedy by Frank D. Gilroy, who wrote it), has conventional characters, too little excavated even for the comedy tone of the story. And the interpreters act purely by profession.

title: Tintorera
actors: Susan George, Fiona Lewis, Hugo Stiglitz, Andrés García, Jennifer Ashley
description: On the Mexican tourist coasts Esteban and Miguel first compete for girls, then they become friends and share them. But a gigantic female tiger shark begins to devour their friends ... Poor eroticism and traces from "The shark" in a heavy mix of genres.

title: Delitto d'amore
actors: Stefania Sandrelli, Giuliano Gemma, Brizio Montinaro
description: Carmela (Sandrelli), who emigrated to Lombardy with her parents from Sicily, falls in love with a worker from the North (Gemma), her workmate. The factory is alienating and harmful and the two young people find themselves too different in education and mentality: he is an anarchist of vaguely populist and barricade ideas, she is inhibited by an archaic and superstitious religiosity. The contrast of characters is also exasperated by the environmental conditions that are certainly not easy and so ...
notes: A story set in the Milanese province which, however, does not do justice to Comencini, which has been able to demonstrate all its undisputed value with other films.

title: The McConnell Story
actors: Alan Ladd, June Allyson, James Withmore, Frank Faylen
description: Joseph McConnell is a health soldier who, thanks to his passion for flying, manages to switch to the air force. He fights in World War II as a navigational officer and becomes one of the best jet pilots in the Korean War. He receives decorations and honors and dies testing a new device. Obvious and sugary, a deadly bore.

title: Viva Zapata!
actors: Marlon Brando, Jean Peters, Anthony Quinn
description: Emiliano Zapata, together with Pancho Villa, rebels against the dictator Diaz and overthrows his tyrannical regime. But the new government, of democratic inspiration, does not last long. Zapata, returned to fight for equality and freedom, is killed by treason. A film about the corruption of revolutions and Kazan's ambiguous self-reflection in the years of McCarthyism, it is above all a powerful and fresco portrait of a hero, written by John Steinbeck and played by a superhero Brando (who won the Palme d'Or at Cannes). Oscar for Anthony Quinn as a supporting character.

title: Five Easy Pieces
actors: Jack Nicholson, Karen Black, Susan Anspach, Lois Smith
description: Robert (Nicholson), a good pianist, broke up with the educated and middle-class family and now lives for the day with Rayette, a slightly dizzy girl pregnant with him. Since his father is very ill, he returns home, has an affair with his brother's girlfriend, but does not take root. Suspended and atmospheric anti-drama, like an "upbeat" sonata. Second, excellent proof of film direction for Bob Rafelson, with whom Nicholson is as always in full harmony.

title: A Summer Story
actors: James Wilby, Imogen Stubbs, Susannah York
description: At the turn of the century, a country girl falls in love with a young London lawyer and is reciprocated. But the social difference between the two makes the sentimental union inconvenient according to the rigid code in force in the England of the time. Sentimental drama that follows tried and tested canons, but well written and interpreted with conviction.

title: The Omega Man
actors: Charlton Heston, Rosalind Cash, Anthony Zerbe, Paul Koslo
description: After a biological war, a monstrous humanity wanders in New York that can only live in darkness and that destroys everything that resembles the scientific civilization responsible for the disaster. Neville, a scientist who escaped the infection thanks to a vaccine, barricaded in his home-laboratory fighting for his life against these zombies. Then he discovers the existence of other survivors and manages to deliver them a dose of vaccine ...
notes: The plot of the film turns in a "realistic" sense the novel I Am Legend by Richard Matheson from which it is inspired, where the threat is represented by vampires. There is some drop in pace, but there is intrigue and suspense to sell.

title: Sbirro, la tua legge è lenta... la mia no!
actors: Maurizio Merli, Mario Merola, Carmen Scarpitta, Francisco Rabal, Nando Marineo
description: Commissioner Ferro (Maurizio Merli) is in Milan to investigate some excellent murders, of suspected Mafia hand. But Don Alfonso, an old man of honor, puts him on another track, the right one, of an organization of commissioned murders headed by a former Camorra man (Mario Merola). To defeat the gang, Ferro commissions the murder of himself, but he would not succeed without Don Alfonso's "parallel justice". Merli against Merola, the codes of honor of the old gangs against the brutality of the new criminal generation. A cartoon with all the clichés of a popular line of Italian detective stories from the 70s.

title: Waterhole # 3
actors: James Coburn, Carroll O'Connor, Margaret Blye, Claude Akins
description: After a "hit" three bandits hide a chest full of gold in the desert. The adventurer Cole, however, kills one of the three and recovers the gold. The two survivors, who hold the witness of the theft, a cobbler hostage, go after Cole, in turn chased by the cobbler's daughter who fell in love with him. Western parodic at times funny. Blake Edwards produces.

title: Mysterious Mr. Moto
actors: Peter Lorre, Mary Maguire, Henry Wilcoxon, Leon Ames
description: Mr. Moto is on the trail of a powerful gang, the League of Assassins, which holds Scotland Yard in check. His investigations lead him into the Devil's Island prison from which he manages to escape with his cellmate, one of the League of Assassins. From here the two arrive in London, where Moto is welcomed by the bandits as one of their own. Fifth episode of the series with Peter Lorre.

title: Mr. Moto in Danger Island
actors: Peter Lorre, Jean Hersholt, Amanda Duff
description: On behalf of the US government, Mr. Moto goes to Puerto Rico to investigate an illegal diamond trade, after the previous investigator was killed. Moto is not afraid and discovers those responsible.
notes: It is the last film in the series, directed by the way not by the usual Norman Foster, but by Leeds. Even if this one of the previous "Mr. Moto goes on vacation" came first in the cinema.

title: Mr. Moto Takes a Vacation
actors: Peter Lorre, Joseph Schildkraut, Lionel Atwill
description: An American archaeologist is busy recovering the Queen of Sheba's crown. The operation succeeds and he triumphantly returns to San Francisco only to discover that his sponsor is actually a famous thief who wants to keep the jewel for himself. Last chapter of the Mr. Moto series, pleasant as always.

title: Mr. Moto Takes a Chance
actors: Peter Lorre, Rochelle Hudson
description: Mr. Moto is in Sumatra where he finds himself lending a hand to a British spy who is trying to avoid a popular uprising led by a priest. It is one of the most incredible and unlikely of the entire series.

title: Mr. Moto's Last Warning
actors: Peter Lorre, John Carradine, George Sanders
description: Intrigue of spies in Port Said where there is someone trying to pit the British and the French against each other. The idea is to sink some ships of the French fleet passing through Suez and then put the blame on the British. The plan is good, but Mr. Moto is also in Port Said. The cast is far beyond necessity.

title: Body Language
actors: Heather Locklear, Linda Purl
description: Betsy is a career woman with some problems with both her boss and her boyfriend who would like her a little less in her career. Betsy's new assistant is called Norma and she is patient, understanding and, ultimately, obsessively determined to make Betsy's shoes. It's kind of an "Eve versus Eve" in white collar format. Imagine the fun.

title: Johnny Eager
actors: Robert Taylor, Lana Turner, Van Heflin
description: Johnny, after a few years in jail, is a driver, but he is also the leader of a gang of gangsters. Maria, the DA's daughter, falls in love with him, and Johnny, while loving her, uses her to blackmail the girl's father. So it can't last: will heart or duty prevail? Full-bodied "mèlo" technically flawless, but not very compelling. Heflin won the Oscar as a supporting actor.

title: Mikey and Nicky
actors: Peter Falk, John Cassavetes, Ned Beatty, Rose Arrick, Carol Grace
description: Always friends, Mikey and Niky have taken different paths: the former, married and father, is a quiet bourgeois; the second is a half gangster. When Nicky is in trouble and turns to his old friend, he says he is very willing to help him ... A film that sacrifices spectacularity to a cruel analysis of human misery, shot by a comedy writer.

title: 13 Ghosts
actors: Charles Herbert, Jo Morrow, Donald Woods, Martin Milner
description: On the death of the old and misanthropic Dr. Zorba, his penniless nephew Cyrus (Woods) inherits the family home. Cyrus moves in with his wife and children and discovers that the house is inhabited by a dozen ghosts. The Zorba are a little impressed and a little worried because a treasure seems to be hidden in the house and the presence of ghosts clearly does not facilitate searches. The movie is nonsense, but Castle is a gimnick genius. Only he could convince the spectators of the time to wear stupid pink goggles (which he himself distributed at the entrance) without which it would have been impossible to see the ghosts.

title: My Favorite Year
actors: Peter O'Toole, Mark Linn-Baker, Lainie Kazan, Jessica Harper
description: At the beginning of the 1950s, some producers decide to invite an old movie star, whom years and oblivion have made a friend of the bottle, as guest of honor on a TV show. In addition to being a drunkard, the star is also quite extravagant, so much so that it becomes necessary to work alongside a young screenwriter who, under the pretext of being his guide, instead makes sure to "limit the damage". Needless to say, the star will still be in a lot of trouble ...
notes: The eventful comedy is inspired by Errol Flynn's alcoholic performances in his later years, but many allusions escape non-American audiences. Peter O'Toole finds himself acting in a role written specifically for him and thanks to which he manages to give the best of himself. Too bad that the direction is not at its height.

title: Le soulier de satin
actors: Luis Miguel Cintra, Patricia Barzyk, Anne Consigny, Anne Gautier, Bernard Alane, Jean-Pierre Bernard, Marie-Christine Barrault, Jean Badin, Isabelle Weingarten, Henri Serre, Jean-Yves Berteloot, Catherine Jarret, Anny Romand
description: At the time of the Spanish colonization of Latin America, the love of the young Rodrigo for Donna Prodezza (who is married) and whom he pursues throughout his life: from Spain to Latin America to Africa. Claudel that de Oliveira transfigures through cinema: fixed floors, theatrical acting, stylized sets. The title refers to the fact that Donna Prodezza gives her satin slipper to the statue of the Virgin.

title: A Cry in the Night
actors: Perry King, Carol Higgins Clark, Annie Girardot, Chris Wiggins
description: Erich is a successful painter with great charm. It is thanks to this that he conquers Jenny. The two decide to get married and go to live far from New York, in the countryside. Here, however, Jenny realizes that she looks strikingly like Erich's deceased mother who, for her part, is beginning to show signs of imbalance ...
notes: A family thriller with a vague Hitchcockian flavor.

title: Elvis: That's the Way
actors: Elvis Presley
description: Documentation film set at the "Elvis Summer Festival", a 1970 concert at the International Hotel in Las Vegas. Filming of the preparation phases, interviews with fans of all ages, and execution of many timeless hits. A good job, a small sum of a long and brilliant musical career.

title: The Extraordinary Seaman
actors: David Niven, Faye Dunaway, Alan Alda, Mickey Rooney
description: World War II: four American sailors are shipwrecked on a small island and collect a woman and a commander of the English navy there. But the latter, in reality, is a ghost who must redeem his honor with a war action ...
notes: A little uncertain, but curious and well acted. However, Frankenheimer did better.

title: Risky Business
actors: Tom Cruise, Rebecca De Mornay, Joe Pantoliano, Curtis Armstrong
description: Taking advantage of a trip by his parents, Joe, a high school student by storm, transforms his house into a meeting place for mercenaries, thanks to the beautiful Lana, who introduces him to the "tour". This of course does not go down to Lana's protector who declares war on the two, stealing all the furniture in the house from poor Joe, who manages to recover the situation just a moment before the arrival of the parents. Or how you become a yuppy without knowing it.
notes: Brickman's film is not particularly bad towards American society, but it has the merit of entrusting the first important role to Tom Cruise and above all of making Rebecca De Mornay debut.

title: Dead Air
actors: Gregory Hines, Debrah Farentino, Beau Starr, Gloria Reuben
description: Since they killed his girlfriend, Jim Shepard (Hines) is no longer in Los Angeles. He now lives in a provincial city and makes Disc-Jockey in a local radio. But the past does not leave him in peace: there is a journalist named Karen who wants to interview him and who in the end is not a journalist and above all there is a mysterious woman who continues to call him, claiming to know many things about him. Nobody asks to broadcast "Misty" and therefore the analogies with "thrill in the night" of Eastwood end here. The story in this case at times confused. However, Hines gives the best of himself.

title: Guns of the Timberland
actors: Alan Ladd, Jeanne Crain, Frankie Avalon, Gilbert Roland
description: Two speculators have obtained the government concession for the cutting of a large portion of woods in a mountainous area of ??the USA. So they send a team of woodcutters to the place. Farmers in the area, aware of the danger that deforestation would cause to crops, intend to stop them at any cost.
notes: Passionate vaguely ecological western with a sentimental ending.

title: Mary, Queen of Scots
actors: Vanessa Redgrave, Glenda Jackson, Trevor Howard, Timothy Dalton, Nigel Davenport, Trevor Howard, Daniel Massey, Ian Holm, Andrew Keir, Tom Fleming
description: Mary, on the interested advice of her cousin Elizabeth I, ascends the throne of Scotland, a land little inclined to accept her Catholicism. The situation worsens when Mary marries Elizabeth's lover Lord Henry Darnley. After a thousand intrigues and twists, Elizabeth will have her cousin imprisoned and beheaded.
notes: Comic strip not historically reliable, but enjoyable in the duel between the two first actresses who seem born for their respective parts. But Jarriot's direction is woody and theatrical as always, so you end up regretting Bette Davis's Elizabeth I and Katharine Hepburn's Mary of Scotland.

title: Come svaligiammo la Banca d'Italia
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Mario Pisu, Lena von Martens
description: The unstoppable thief called "The Master" has two dumb and bungling brothers. To get them out of the way, he puts them next to a butler and two freaky girls. The two fools, however, come into possession of a plan from the "master" for a very audacious blow that they try to execute with their band of down-and-outs. The "teacher" tries to remedy, but finally remedies the arrest, while the two donkeys remain honor, glory (and money).

title: Io, Emmanuelle
actors: Erika Blanc, Adolfo Celi, Paolo Ferrari, Milla Sannoner
description: Emmanuelle lives with a man, a professor. When he leaves, the woman realizes she has an extreme need for tenderness and starts looking for him. Thus ends up in the beds of four men, a vicious writer, a merchant who has been betrayed by his wife, an imbecile journalist and a fake long-haired. Later, he rejects a particular relationship with a woman and finds himself, at the end of the day, in a bar where he learns that her man died in a car accident.
notes: A film that would like to tell contemporary anguish, but which is only the pretext for an erotic tour. At the time a critic wrote: "The most expressive detail of Erika Blanc is the navel".

title: Tripoli bel suol d'amore
actors: Alberto Sordi, Maurizio Arena, Lyla Rocco, Mirko Ellis, Fulvia Franco
description: Alberto does his military service among the Bersaglieri. For his provincialism and his naivety (he flirts with the marshal's daughter) he becomes the target of his three comrades with whom, however, he forms a strong friendship. They will be sent to fight in Libya. A comedy between the sentimental and the dramatic with Sordi in the foreground.

title: Farewell to the Flesh
actors: Tony Todd, Kelly Rowan, William O'Leary, Veronica Cartwrigt
description: As anyone who saw the first episode knows, the ghost of a colossal ex slave named Daniel Robitaille survives in New Orleans who, for having loved the white Caroline, had made a very bad end. Now there is Annie, a teacher who finds herself with her family decimated by Daniel's revenge not yet sated with blood. In the wake of the first film, a richer but more banal production in its refined effects, with a rhythmic narration on the fragments of the scene of the punishment of the reprobate, then completely re-proposed in the finale. And nothing forbids other chapters ...

title: Murder in the First
actors: Christian Slater, Kevin Bacon, Gary Oldman, Brad Dourif
description: Recovered after an Alcatraz escape attempt, Henry Young, who ended up in jail for a petty crime, spends years in the frightening dungeons of the famous prison and then kills the man who had betrayed him. Now he risks the electric chair, but his young lawyer turns the trial into an accusation of Alcatraz's inhumanity, of the director's sadism, of the sins of the authorities.
notes: In the prison genre, American cinema has often given works of considerable value. We can add this film, which re-proposes a story that really happened and which finds narrative modules that are sometimes artificial (and often blackmailers), but of robust intensity. With a great Gary Oldman.

title: Escape from Absolom
actors: Ray Liotta, Lance Henriksen, Stuart Wilson, Kevin Dillon
description: We are in 2022, in the Absolom maximum security prison where a former Marine officer sentenced to life imprisonment for having "executed" a superior is transferred. The man tries to escape to assert his reasons, but it is an almost impossible undertaking given the particular organization of the place of punishment, the controls to which it is subjected and the conflicts between opposing groups of prisoners.
notes: Already "Criminal Law" had shown the directorial skills of Martin Campbell, confirmed in this film based on a novel by Richard Herley. In science fiction form, references to the present are transparent. Solid B series, as it once was.

title: I Like Flint
actors: James Coburn, Lee J. Cobb, Jean Hale, Andrew Duggan
description: Three women have a plan to seize power. It's about kidnapping the President and replacing him with a double. Agent Flint, overcoming deadly tests, thinks he's solved the case. But then he discovers that there is more ...
notes: You have to play along and take the hero's amazing adventures for good.

title: Le fate
directors: Mauro Bolognini, Mario Monicelli, Antonio Pietrangeli, Luciano Salce
actors: Monica Vitti, Raquel Welch, Capucine, Claudia Cardinale, Enrico Maria Salerno, Anthony Steel, Gastone Moschin, Jean Sorel, Alberto Sordi
description: "Sabina, a hitchhiker, proves insatiable despite three rapes. Armenia courts a health care doctor but, at the right moment, she slips away. Elena cheats on her husband with a guest, who, however, was perhaps at the same time betrayed by his wife. Marta. , wife of a famous surgeon, loses all inhibitions when she has drunk and gives herself over to the waiter; only to forget everything when she becomes sober. The names (of the directors, of the female and male performers) are certainly not to be thrown away, but the thickness of the episodes doesn't go much beyond that of jokes. And the characters have, more or less, the consistency of shadows. You save your job. "

title: Bunny Lake is Missing
actors: Laurence Olivier, Carol Lynley, Keir Dullea, Noël Coward, Martita Hunt, Anna Massey, Clive Revill, Finlay Currie, Adrienne Corri
description: Anne Lake (who with her brother Stevens has just moved to London from the United States) goes to pick up her daughter Bunny from school. The little one, however, is not there. Indeed, no one seems to know anything about her. Inspector Newhouse, in charge of the investigation, will slowly discover a diabolical and treacherous network of complicity and madness. Elegant and disturbing psychological yellow.

title: 20.000 dollari sporchi di sangue
actors: Montgomery Ford, Herman Lang, Fernando Sancho
description: Fred Leinster, a former sheriff who has lost his job on suspicion of excessive addiction to the bottle, is unwillingly involved in the kidnapping of a child, the son of a widow. Arrested by the new sheriff, Fred escapes and frees the boy but is captured by the bandits who accuse him of taking possession of the ransom. But Fred manages to free himself, to find out who is hiding behind the kidnappers and to get justice with all due respect to his superiors.
notes: Rather teasing and inconclusive, both on the moralistic side and on that of the action. Negligible.

title: Stradivari
actors: Anthony Quinn, Stefania Sandrelli, Valérie Kaprisky, Francesco Quinn
description: In the mid-seventeenth century, Antonio Stradivari was born in Cremona. Placed in the workshop while still a boy by the luthier Amati, he soon reveals an innate ability in the art of making bowed instruments which, in short, makes him the most renowned instrument maker in all of Europe. Meanwhile, he meets and falls in love with a widow older than him whom he marries, despite the opposition of the families. With domestic tranquility, work thrives although numerous wars stir up the country and bring invaders of all sorts. Soporific drama and less than television.

title: The Mangler
actors: Robert Englund, Ted Levine, Daniel Matmor, Vanessa Pike, Lisa Morris
description: The "mangler" is a contraption that works as a clothes ironer in a laundry. It is fed by workers who are increasingly exhausted by their incessant work and harassed by their boss, a crippled half-blind. At a certain point, fatal accidents begin to occur near the infernal machinery: a policeman begins to investigate those deaths and comes to a disconcerting conclusion ...
notes: The film has rightly been called a "Dickensian-Gothic horror". Note the presence of former Freddy Krueger, Robert Englund, in the role of the sinister master, who humorously frees himself from the character who made him famous and who risked "enslaving" him.

title: Aenigma
actors: Jared Martin, Susan Kendall, Lara Naszinsky, Ulli Reinthaler
description: In a Boston girls' boarding school, the introverted Kathy is the constant target of the pranks of a group of evil classmates. After yet another insult, the girl runs away in terror and suffers an accident that sends her into a deep coma. While she is in hospital, other strange "accidents" cause the death of the companions who harassed her.
notes: Bloody horror by one of the Italian specialists of the genre. The tension remains high for a good part of the film, even if the subject is affected by a script that is a little too weak here and there. The film has a virtue: that of being really scary, but it suffers from a conspicuous decline in enthusiasm in the staging typical of the author's latest directories.

title: Narcos
actors: Juan José Pinero, Adriana Sforza, Aldo Sambrell, Joel Maldonado
description: Jesus, Miguel and Diego are three Colombian boys for whom life does not reserve many chances: the most immediate and profitable is crime. Entering the service of drug trafficking organizations means money and women and will, but also being willing to be ferocious without limits. Not to mention that the young killers sooner or later end up eliminated as uncomfortable witnesses.
notes: Ferrara starts from the news for an indictment against underdevelopment and the international interests behind the phenomenon of drug trafficking. Aggressive, too emphatic.

title: Lungo il fiume
description: The path of the Po, its waters and the world that lives along its banks, along the seasons. It starts from its sources on the Monviso to descend into the great plain, where the river widens and becomes populated. The spoken commentary of the film is largely taken from the Gospel of John, to establish a parallel between the life-giving work of the waters and the words of divine Grace.
notes: Olmi made his debut as a documentary filmmaker and has always excelled in this film genre. Here the ecological theme is assumed as a "pretext" for reflection on the relationship between man, nature and the supernatural.

title: Vite perdute
actors: Alfredo Li Bassi, Salvatore Termini, Filippo Genzardi, Carlo Beretta
description: Stefano is part of a group of drifters from Palermo. With friends he kidnaps Lucia, the girl he is in love with. Intercepted by the police, they go astray and die in the fire of their car. Rosario wants to avenge his friend and kills Lucia's father. Pietro is suspected of being a traitor and, to prove the contrary, he organizes a robbery during which he dies. Salvatore and Rosario kill a protector.
notes: The real name of the director is Giuseppe Greco, son of Michele (himself, the boss of Ciaculli and head of the Dome). His film is an upside-down version of "Ragazzi fuori", demagogic and shouted, with many of the boys who interpreted Risi's film, plus a protagonist who is a Neapolitan singer in life (but he's from Catania).

title: Road to Morocco
actors: Bing Crosby, Bob Hope, Dorothy Lamour
description: Bing Crosby and Bob Hope are shipwrecked on the Moroccan coast. They both fall in love with a beautiful princess (already promised to a ferocious sheikh) and experience a thousand adventures and vicissitudes that will lead them back to New York aboard a ... raft. One of the many funny episodes of the hit series "Road to ..."

title: Dédée d'Anvers
actors: Simone Signoret, Bernard Blier, Marcel Pagliero, Marcel Dalio
description: Dédée is a prostitute from Antwerp determined to change her life when an Italian captain falls in love with her. But his partner and protector, Mario, kills the Italian. Dédée with the help of the owner of the bar where she works kills Mario. Classic French noir (today perhaps a little dated) with a splendid interpretation by Simone Signoret, an endless pessimism and a beautiful harbor setting.

title: Nema-ye nazdik
actors: Hossain Sabzian, Hossain Farazmand, Mohsen Makhmalbaf
description: Ali, a young unemployed man, manages to break into a wealthy family, passing himself off as the well-known director Moshen Makhmalbaf and bragging about a film project, for a film in which that family will have to be the protagonist. When the deception is discovered, Ali goes to court. At the end of the trial he meets the real Makhmalbaf, with whom he goes to the scammed people to ask for forgiveness.
notes: The desire of the marginalized young man to obtain esteem and admiration from others, at the cost of deception, becomes the premise for a film in which realism and social issues are continuously intertwined with the investigation of the relationship between reality and fiction. Masterpiece of the new Iranian cinema.

title: Era lei che lo voleva!
actors: Lucia Bosé, Walter Chiari, Enzo Fiermonte, Carlo Campanini
description: The boxer Dynamite has broken through the heart of the beautiful researcher Nausicaa. The two get married, but she is jealous and ends up abandoning him. Dynamite returns to the ring totally unmotivated, but then the misunderstanding is dissolved. Walter Chiari (who had been a cavvero boxer) goes free, but the film is non-existent.

title: In Calabria
description: Calabria as a land of encounter and clash between old and new. This is the main idea of ??the documentary that the director Vittorio De Seta shot over the course of a year and a half in the Pollino and Sila mountains, between Gioia Tauro and Lamezia Terme, looking above all for traces of marginalization and cultures in crisis. . Faces, hands, gestures to give a sense of a lost time and values. A film that is deliberately not "objective" and that has the ambition of still shaking consciences with the power of images.

title: L'edera
actors: Columba Dominguez, Roldano Lupi, Juan De Landa, Franca Marzi
description: The servant Annesa kills old Decherchi, who is also ill, in order to save the man she loves from economic ruin. But then he repents. A novel by Deledda in a telenovela version, shot with a distant and vaguely glossy style, in which the protesting force of the book is lost.

title: La fille de D'Artagnan
actors: Sophie Marceau, Philippe Noiret, Sami Frey, Gigi Proietti
description: 1654. Eloise, daughter of D'Artagnan, is locked up in a convent. When she witnesses the Mother Superior being killed by the evil Duke of Crassac, she suspects the crime is part of a plot against the future King Louis. He runs to Paris where he tries to convince his father to intervene. But D'Artagnan is no longer what it once was: he is tired, embittered, indifferent. So Eloise embarks on the adventure alone. Only at the end, thanks to his example, will the ancient quartet of musketeers take the field. Freda, an Italian master of adventure cinema, at 86 was about to get back to work with this new film, but he quarreled with Marceau and the story was then directed by Tavernier. Freda would surely have given the action a more pressing pace. Tavernier, on the other hand, faithful to his own style, has favored the psychological characterization of the characters.

title: American Yakuza
actors: Viggo Mortensen, Michael Nouri, Yuji Okumoto, Ryo Ishibashi
description: Nick Davis (Viggo Mortensen) has just gotten out of jail and his hopes of finding a job are limited to the most infamous areas of the city, namely those of the San Pedro docks. And so it happens, except that at the port it is easy to get involved in a settling of scores, witness a shooting, maybe save the life of an Eastern Mafia boss and then join the family, willy-nilly.
notes: Viggo Mortensen is a face to remember. He was the returning brother in "Lone Wolf", the film that marked Sean Penn's directorial debut and also appeared in "Carlito's Way" and "Red Alarm". Too bad that this by Frank Cappello is just a food film.

title: Article 99
actors: Ray Liotta, Kiefer Sutherland, Forest Whitaker, John Mahoney
description: Article 99 is the one that provides for health care to those veterans who are sick for service reasons. But article 99 is not the only enemy of Dr. Richard Sturgess, a surgeon in one of these centers. There are also bureaucratic hindrances, obvious incapacities and cases of outright corruption. But he and a handful of other doctors will also be able to overcome these obstacles.
notes: The intentions may be laudable, but Deutch (or rather the screenwriter Damian Harris) had to decide immediately whether to make "Mash" or a throbbing film of denunciation. Ray Liotta is always great, Donald Sutherland's "degenerate son" of course not.

title: Les baisers de secours
actors: Brigitte Sy, Philippe Garrel, Anémone, Maurice Garrel
description: Mathieu, filmmaker, is preparing a film. She chooses to entrust the role of female protagonist to a well-known actress. His wife Jeanne, who is also an actress, takes the decision as a betrayal of him, as the film will tell "their story". As a consequence the two separate: for Mathieu the fact constitutes the beginning of a long and painful period of loneliness and doubts. Garrel usually builds his cinema starting from autobiography, but thanks to the breath of poetry he knows how to instill in situations and characters, the film easily crosses their boundaries. The photograph (black and white) by Jacques Loiseleux is very beautiful.

title: J'entends plus la guitare
actors: Benoît Régent, Johanna Ter Steege, Yann Collette, Edith Boulogne
description: In Positano, with Martin and Lolla, Gérard lives perfect love with Marianne. One day, in Paris, Marianne leaves Gérard for another. Not an easy film, but very interesting due to the rigorous stylistic choice.

title: Les amants du Pont-Neuf
actors: Juliette Binoche, Denis Lavant, Klaus Michael Grüber, Crichan Larson
description: Alex (Denis Levant) is a young homeless man on whose body, when he lies dead drunk in the center of the boulevard Sébastopol, the cars of middle-class couples pass happily. With horror, Michéle (Binoche) approaches him, a painter with a colonel father and a bastard boyfriend whom, one day, she will shoot. Between Alex and Michéle, homeless out of necessity or desperation on the Pont-Neuf closed to the public for work, "amour fou" is born.
notes: Over three years of filming. A scenario, that is, the bridge, the river with its "quais" and related buildings, entirely reconstructed on two hundred thousand square meters on the side of Montpellier. Virtuosic delirium that has divided criticism between enthusiasm and perplexity.

title: I giganti della Tessaglia
actors: Roland Carey, Ziva Rodan, Alberto Farnese, Luciano Marin
description: Jason, king of Thessaly, is on his way to Colchis in search of the Golden Fleece. Argo's ship, after passing a violent storm, lands on a small island, where Jason kills a monster that demands offerings in human flesh. Meanwhile Adrastus, who the king had left to rule Thessaly in his absence, aims to seize the throne and threatens Queen Creusa.
notes: Adventures and mythology with the special effects of a very young Carlo Rambaldi. Riccardo Freda conducts with little means and does what he can.

title: Gelosia
actors: Erno Crisa, Alessandro Fersen, Vincenzo Musolino, Liliana Gerace
description: The Marquis of Roccaverdina falls in love with the peasant Agrippina and becomes her lover. To keep up appearances, the Marquis marries her to Rocco, a farmer, but prevents the consummation of the marriage. However, suspecting that Rocco does not keep the pacts he kills him. An innocent person is blamed for the murder and the Marquis will live forever in remorse. A melodrama based on the novel by Capuana "Il Marchese di Roccaverdina", directed by a Germi always in love with his Sicily / West but less inspired than usual.

title: Nowere to Go
actors: George Nader, Maggie Smith, Bernard Lee
description: After being escaped in prison, a thief has to deal with the blackmail of his ex-comprompice (which kills) and then with the difficulty of recovering the booty: he will end badly. Cupo cinematic drama very forward for her time. One of the latest films of the legendary Ealing Studios Londonse, directed by an underrated director.

title: Tim Burton's Nightmare Before Christmas
description: Jack Skellington, from the town of Halloween, discovers Christmastown, where everything is white and where, at Christmas, Santa Claus distributes gifts to good children. Jack decides to take the place of Santa Claus and give the children the "terrifying" gifts typical of Halloween. Santa Claus, captured, risks his skin, but then, thanks to Sally, the creature of rags in love with Jack, everything returns to normal. Superb fairy tale represented by "puppets", with hints of horror, melancholic and romantic, inspired and produced by Tim Burton, captivating for the prodigious animation and the fascinating musical column (Renato Zero sings the songs of Jack Skellington).

title: Le buttane
actors: Ida Di Benedetto, Guia Jelo, Lucia Sardo, Sandra Sindoni, Paola Pace
description: Liuccia and Blu Blu "beat" on the street; Veronica and Minuccia practice in a clandestine brothel, Orlanda at her home; Maurizio has as a client a well-off mature man (whom he will kill); the transvestite Kim advertises himself through newspaper ads.
