Their lives, their profession, the relationships with their customers, the inconveniences, the dramas.
notes: Annoying, aesthetic, pleased in his "ennobled" dialect and full of citations (Pasolini, Antonioni's "Eclisse twist"). But in many moments Grimaldi's screaming and bloody style captivates and shows the presence of an author.

title: Villain
actors: Ian McShane, Richard Burton, Nigel Davenport
description: London police have long been looking for evidence to indict alleged East End boss Vic Dakin (Burton), who runs an organization based on gambling, drugs and prostitution. Inspector Bob Mathews, who fails to frame him with normal investigations, sets a trap for him, but Vic holds a political personality who blackmails some gory aspects of his private life. Naturalist drama in dark tones, from a novel by James Barlow.

title: El tirano Banderas
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, Ana Belén, Juan Diego, Ignacio Lòpez Tarso
description: Santos Banderas (Volonté), the despot of an unspecified Latin American state, holds his tyrannical power over the blood of opponents and former friends who have fallen into disgrace, amid the connivance of debauched Spanish dignitaries and local notables. But the day Banderas orders the death of one of his faithful officers, he goes over to the side of the Indians and leads their revolt. A bad twist of fate wanted that the last role completed by Volonté was that of Santos Banderas in a film (from the novel by Ramòn Del Valle Inclàn) totally wrong, up to the involuntary ridicule.

title: The Deadly Tower
actors: Kurt Russell, Richard Yniguez, John Forsythe
description: Locked up in the tower of the University of Texas and armed with a rifle, Charles Whitman, a student with mental problems, kills thirteen people and injures more than thirty. Effective reconstruction of a true news story that happened in 1966, starring the young Kurt Russell. Shot for TV.

title: White Water Rebels
actors: Catherine Bach, James Brolin, Pepe Serna
description: A kayak enthusiast (James Brolin) and a freelance photojournalist collide with an unscrupulous businessman bent on building a dam with ruinous effects. A passable adventurous drama produced by CBS in the long wave of "A quiet weekend of fear".

title: Crossed Swords
actors: Oliver Reed, Raquel Welch, Mark Lester, Ernest Borgnine, Rex Harrison, George C. Scott, Charlton Heston
description: The thief Tom falls (from the fireplace) into the room of Edward of Wales, heir to the throne of England. Since they resemble each other like two drops of water, the two boys, for fun, exchange clothes, but before returning to their respective shoes, Edward is thrown out of the palace and Tom is forced to take the place of the prince. Life will not be easy for the noble reduced to poverty, but not even for the beggar raised to the honors (and burdens) of the court ...
notes: Twain's tale had already had the honor of the screen several other times. There are numerous celebrities here in one "cameo" after another, but the overall outcome is one of golden mediocrity, with only a few enjoyable moments.

title: La scimitarra del saraceno
actors: Lex Barker, Chelo Alonso, Massimo Serato, Graziella Granata
description: The pirate Dragut kidnaps Bianca, the daughter of the governor of Rhodes. The latter instructs Captain Drago, an adventurer out of jail, to retrieve his daughter. Drago defeats Dragut, frees the girl and falls in love with her. Sword and cloak also lower than the Italic medai.

title: Double Vision
actors: Kim Cattrall, Macha Meril, Gale Hansen, Christopher Lee
description: Caroline (Cattral), a medical student, takes the first flight to London as soon as she learns that her twin sister Lisa is missing. Arriving in London, Caroline gradually begins to immerse herself in her sister's life until she takes her place. The problem is that Lisa led a kind of life that was not entirely exemplary and so for Caroline the trouble began. Of course, for someone who starred in the first "Porky's" and the first "Police School", this doubles story must have seemed incredibly complex. Not so for us viewers that we have already seen a story like this dozens of times.

title: Maciste alla corte del Gran Khan
actors: Gordon Scott, Yoko Tani, Dante Di Paolo, Gabriele Antonini
description: The emperor of China has to contend with the Tartars who flock to the borders of the state. He asks the Great Khan for help, but the latter betrays him, has him killed, sends his daughter to a convent and raises his son as his own. Fortunately, Maciste is in those parts.
notes: Low cost and craftsmanship. Some sequences of the "Adventures of Marco Polo" will then be made with the same scenarios and costumes. Freda is mainly involved in color work. Gordon Scott was already known as Tarzan's interpreter.

title: Il bidone
actors: Broderick Crawford, Giulietta Masina, Richard Basehsart, Franco Fabrizi
description: Augusto is a modest scammer who acts in partnership with Roberto and Picasso. When Picasso's wife begins to have doubts about her husband's activity, he cuts off all relations with his accomplices. Augusto, on the other hand, who has long since left his family, commits another scam to help his daughter, trying to pocket the entire loot. His new buddies won't forgive him.
notes: A year after "La strada", Fellini made a less "poetic" film, more harsh, but with a no less religious background; it is one of the director's least loved films, but today it is absolutely worth re-evaluating. Unforgettable the interpretation of Crawford (who apparently played constantly drunk), harrowing the ending with the stoning.

title: Una lucertola con la pelle di donna
actors: Florinda Bolkan, Stanley Baker, Leo Genn, Jean Sorel, Anita Strindberg, Silvia Monti, Alberto De Mendoza, Penny Brown, Mike Kennedy, Ely Galleani, George Rigaud, Ezio Marano, Franco Balducci, Luigi Antonio Guerra, Erzsi Paal, Gaetano Imbrò
description: Carol Hammond, wife of a lawyer, tells the psychoanalyst the dream in which she herself killed her neighbor, a woman of little virtue. When the woman is actually found dead (in the manner described by Carol) the police suspicions turn first on her and, only later, on several other people, including Carol's husband.
notes: Lucio Fulci has never been a refined narrator, quite the opposite, and it is not even on this occasion, with all the performances he granted. But this time, if nothing else, the interpreters are crying, and something manage to save. Soundtrack by Ennio Morricone.

title: Becky Sharp
actors: Miriam Hopkins, Cedric Hardwicke, Frances Dee, Billie Burke
description: Raised for heaven's sake in an aristocratic college, a girl is welcomed in the house of a partner, of whom she tries to get her brother. Removed, she gets married by the first -born of a family of which the housekeeper was and whose heritage is dilated. He then Civetta with a creditor of his husband, but he discovers it and leaves it. But, despite other vicissitudes, the protagonist does not surrender.
notes: Taken from William M. Thackeray's "Vanity Fair", the film has its place in the history of cinema as it is the first in Technicolor (still trichromatic). Quite theatrical, it has little narrative amalgam, despite the search for spectacularity.

title: Killer: A Journal of Murder
actors: James Woods, Robert Sean Leonard, Ellen Greene, Harold Gould
description: Henry, an upright and idealistic man, gets a job as a prison guard. Among the inmates is Carl Panzram, a brutal and "savage" criminal. But the most shocking discovery is that of the violence and injustice that reigns in the prison system: this leads Henry to feel a sort of solidarity towards Carl. By breaking the rules, the guard provides the detainee with a pen and paper to write down his chilling memoirs. The arduous construction of a friendship begins, which even leads Henry to try to save Carl from the death sentence. Topped off with obvious references to "Dead Man Walking" and "The Wings of Freedom", this prison drama produced by Oliver Stone is directed with honesty but without particular jolts. The multiple murderer Panzram, in 1929, really managed to write his memoirs (published however only in 1970, due to a series of insurmountable censorships) thanks to Henry Lesser. Then, to end it, he accused himself of yet another crime, refusing the defense and ending up hanged.

title: Shallow Grave
actors: Ewan McGregor, Christopher Eccleston, Kerry Fox, Ken Stott
description: Three friends, two boys and a girl, share an apartment in Glasgow. When they decide to look for a fourth roommate, they are very much for the subtle. After discarding and mocking various candidates, they choose a man apparently without secrets. But soon the newcomer is found dead, right in his room. Here the three also discover a suitcase containing a lot of money. The merits of macabre humor are not lacking, and the skill of the actors overcomes the gaps and some inconsistencies in the script.

title: Higher Learning
actors: Ice Cube, Laurence Fishburne, Omar Epps, Jennifer Connelly, Regina King
description: The Columbus University campus is a microcosm in which students of all races and political beliefs confront each other, each with problems - more or less serious - of identity, sex, racial and social discrimination. There is a young black man, a high school athletics champion, who now has to learn to run faster and faster to win a scholarship. There is a white girl who is raped by a peer. There are those who discover that college is not the big party they had imagined ... In the midst of all, there is the professor who welcomes the freshmen with an ironic "Welcome to reality". A reality made up of ignorance, violence and racism. Overrated director since his debut in 1991 ("Boyz'n the Hood"), John Singleton is confirmed instead as an author not particularly interesting or original.

title: Loch Ness
actors: Ted Danson, Joely Richardson, Ian Holm, Harris Yulin, James Frain
description: Dr. Jonathan Dempsey is a brilliant internationally renowned zoologist specializing in "mythical" animal studies. His new mission is to prove once and for all the non-existence of the Loch Ness monster. While he also strikes up a relationship with his landlady, whose daughter knows strange secrets, Dempsey gets closer and closer to the truth.
notes: Although this new reinterpretation of the more traditional Scottish mystery is not (nor does it want to be) particularly sophisticated, the pace is good. A sliding film that often makes you think of an adventure by Martin Mystère. The special effects are nice, even if a bit smashing.

title: Forbidden Nights
actors: Robin Shou, Melissa Gilbert, Victor Wong
description: Judith is American, she is a teacher, she is animated by enthusiasm for her profession and curiosity for oriental culture and history. Their in-depth knowledge does not spare her an existential shock, however, when she moves to China to teach English in a college. To aggravate the situation is his love for Liang, a student leader capable of facing any risk ... The theme of cultural clash, Western disorientation in front of the East, its too radical diversity is not new in cinema. Here it is taken up and updated with reference to the anxieties that are going through Chinese society today.

title: The Incredible True Adventure of Two Girls in Love
actors: Nicole Ari Parker, Maggie Moore, Laurel Holloman, Dale Dickey
description: Randy, a rebellious girl, lives with her lesbian aunt and her lover. Randy leads a boring and unmotivated life. One day he meets Evie, a beautiful and rich student, and is love at first sight. Evie, who is still busy with her boyfriend, hesitates. But in the end he lets himself be persuaded and a story begins between the two young women that will continue despite the opposition of their respective families.
notes: Obviously, racial and sexual prejudices play the lion's share of the story, which however is polite and always kept in the tone of comedy. In any case, the success of the film is due in large part to the two interpreters, who are almost newcomers and yet very good.

title: Dr. Jekyll and Ms. Hyde
actors: Sean Young, Tim Daly, Lysette Anthony, Stephen Tobolowsky
description: Dr. Richard Jackson does not have a very satisfying life: mortified at work, in a perfume house, he is also frustrated in his relationship with his girlfriend. After the death of a great-uncle he inherits some journals with mysterious notes from his great-grandfather, Dr. Jekyll. Intrigued, he decodes them, and elaborates a potion which he experiments on himself. The metamorphosis takes place, but Richard's alter ego is a woman, and it will create big problems for him: Helen Hyde in fact has the charm and grit that he lacks, and really likes his superior in the office ...
notes: The parody of the most famous horror films is now a classic, and usually at least a few laughs can be ripped off. But here we go really bad. Price fails across the board, assembling only; all seasoned with an irrelevant script.

title: Bloodknot
actors: Kate Vernon, Margot Kidder, Patrick Dempsey, Allan Royal
description: Martin Reaves died while he was a soldier and above all he died without ever telling any of his family about Kaye (Kate Vernon), his girlfriend. However, Kaye arrives shortly after the funeral and settles in the Reaves home. Kaye is not without charm, let alone worrying ambiguities. The men of the house seem to yield to the former, the women of the house seem more attentive to the latter. In fact, Kaye is hiding a secret.
notes: Kate Vernon was Vincent Spano's wife in "Alphabet City" (1985), a New York New Wave classic, then Malcolm X's first girlfriend in Spike Lee's film. What are you doing in a Jorge Montesi film?

title: French Kiss
actors: Meg Ryan, Kevin Kline, Timothy Hutton, Jean Reno
description: She, an American, is engaged to a Canadian who, in Paris, got together with someone else. So she, who has a blue fear of the plane, flies to Paris and, during the flight, meets an "unpunished" Frenchman who uses her to pass, without her knowledge, a necklace stolen at customs. From here, and from everything that follows, there are quarrels a go-go in the canonical places of the "douce France". Until the happy end kiss.
notes: It's not that the performers are inadequate, or that the film can't make people smile. But everything is so obvious, so well known, in short, so phony that it passes without leaving the slightest trace, and is forgotten after ten minutes.

title: The Ref
actors: Judy Davis, Denis Leary, Kevin Spacey, Robert J. Steinmiller jr.
description: It is Christmas Eve in the charming village of Old Baybrook (Connecticut), but for Gus, a robber with no luck, it is not a particularly lucky day: the "blow" he tries is bad, and he gets away by a hair. He then seeks refuge in the home of Caroline and Lloyd Chasseur, determined to use them as hostages. Instead, he will have other tasks in the economy of the Chasseur family.
notes: Demme's film (Ted, not to be confused with the much more badass Jonathan) starts well, but it takes little to exhaust the momentum and to pour us a sea of ??molasses and good feelings. If the model was Frank Capra, we are not there.

title: Cobb
actors: Tommy Lee Jones, Robert Wuhl, Lolita Davidovich, Lou Myers
description: The now old Tyrus Raymond Cobb, known as Ty, the legendary baseball champion between the 1920s and the 1930s (Lee Jones), charges sports journalist Al Stump with his biography. Living alongside the client, he discovers the true nature of the former champion, a racist who despised women, blacks, Jews and who drank. What should he write? What would Cobb want or how does it actually stand? Here (apart from perhaps baseball fans, who are not legions) the name of Ty Cobb says nothing, but in the United States he was a star of the first magnitude. But the problem is that, for once, a Hollywood sports biography is dull.

title: In the Mouth of Madness
actors: Sam Neill, Julie Carmen, Jürgen Prochnow, Charlton Heston
description: Locked up in an asylum following an acute crisis, a man tells the doctor that he is John Trent, a private investigator tasked with finding Sutter Cane, a bestselling author of horror, who has mysteriously disappeared. Trent looked for him in Hobb's End, an unmarked town, where Cane set his previous novel. And Trent was thinking of an advertising gimmick. Instead ... One of the most "gothic" and most complex horror films, where the metaphysical dimension takes on the value of an intellectual mess. A journey marked by anguish through the disturbing meanders of the human mind and the labyrinths of the manipulation of the masses. A relentless narrative progression.

title: The Master of Ballantrae
actors: Errol Flynn, Anthony Steel, Roger Livesey, Yvonne Furneaux
description: When Prince Charles Stuart attempts to reconquer the throne in 1745, the lord of Ballantrae joins him in Scotland. However, the revolt fails and the noble, in order not to succumb, asks for help from his brother who, however, apparently betrays him. Thus began a long series of vicissitudes for Ballantrae that led him first to the brink of slavery and then the captain of a filibusta ship.
notes: Tepid transposition of Stevenson's classic novel, with Flynn at the end of his career.

title: Wetherby
actors: Vanessa Redgrave, Ian Holm, Judi Dench, Tim McInnerny, Stuart Wilson
description: At the party held in the country house of a mature and lonely teacher, a young stranger is mistaken for a guest. The next day, the man is found dead. The investigations go into a labyrinth. Halfway between the thriller and the psychological drama, this is David Hare's debut film, based on one of his plays. Golden Bear in Berlin in 1985. Redgrave was very good.

title: Vengeance Valley
actors: Burt Lancaster, Robert Walker, Ray Collins
description: While running his paternal ranch, Lee Strobie, the son of a wealthy Colorado farmer, attempts to put his milk brother Owen Daybright on the right track. The latter, who is treated like a son by Arch Strobie, however, not only turns out to be a slacker, but also has an ungrateful and evil soul and will turn the relationship with his brother to a dramatic epilogue.
notes: Western drama with psychological and Oedipal overtones, played by a Lancaster in top form.

title: Outback Bound
actors: Donna Mills, Andrew Clarke, John Meillon
description: A Beverly Hills beauty queen, who has gone to great lengths to achieve a notable position in the fashion world, sees her lucky stars decline rapidly. So one day he decides to make a change in his life. Buy a plane ticket and set off for the wilds of Australia, where he has a hard time searching for the exhausted opal mine that once belonged to his late father.
notes: Production for television in the qualitative average of the genre. Unknown interpreters. The images of the Australian "outback" where the story takes place are well photographed and remain impressed.

title: Gaslight
actors: Anton Walbroock, Diana Wynyard, Frank Pettingell
description: Bella is pushed by her husband Paul to think she is crazy, but the former Inspector Rough opens her eyes: it is Paul who is actually schizophrenic, moreover a murderer, and she must collaborate to trap him. Excellent transposition of a play by Patrick Hamilton, more effective than the remake directed four years later by George Cukor, with Boyer and Bergman.

title: Flirt
actors: Monica Vitti, Jean-Luc Bideau, Alessandro Haber, Eros Pagni
description: Giovanni (Bideau) and Laura (Vitti) are a close-knit couple: she is a brilliant real estate agent, he is an appreciated electronic technician. Giovanni often works overtime and in his sleep he pronounces a name: Veronica. Suspicious, Laura follows him, discovering that Giovanni has an imaginary lover. Man, in fact, suffers from hallucinations and it will take a long time, a lot of patience and a pinch of cunning, to bring him back to reason. With the same lighthearted air of its friendly protagonists, the film also deals with challenging themes (life as a couple, alienation, betrayal), but in a dreamy and sometimes superficial way. Soundtrack by Francesco De Gregori.

title: Un amore di donna
actors: Laura Morante, Bruno Ganz, Claudine Auger, Ivan Desny, Cinzia De Ponti
description: The lawyer Bernasconi was first the lover of Gabriella's mother and then he married her daughter. But now they are separated. Gabriella falls in love with a test driver and therefore tries to get a divorce, but Bernasconi does not grant it. It will be his mother who will precipitate things with a cruel confession about his past ... Tragic melodrama enlivened by aerial performances.

title: 7 dollari sul rosso
actors: Anthony Steffen, Fernando Sancho, Loredana Nusciak
description: In Johnny Hashley they kill his wife and kidnap his son. He then sets off on the trail of the bandits, creating a reputation for being an executioner and, on the other hand, cannot find them. One day in Wishville he clashes with Wilson's gang who is the kidnapper of his son: he defeats the gang but the boy, now grown up with the bandits, does not recognize his father and challenges him to a duel. Western frayed and at times irrational.

title: Occhio al ninja, Jack!
actors: Bud Spencer, Michael Winslow
description: A Vietnamese ninja arrives in South Florida to take revenge on a group of former US soldiers. The Extralarge detective is monitoring the situation. Did you say a Vietnamese ninja?

title: Lush Life
actors: Forest Whitaker, Jeff Goldblum, Kathy Baker, Lois Chiles, Tracey Needham
description: Buddy Chester (Whitaker) and Al Gorky (Goldblum) live in the Village. Buddy plays the trumpet and has a headache. Al plays the sax and has not yet recovered from the sixties. Both are sidemen, that is, those ready to play with anyone and for anyone, but not to marry. When Buddy discovers he has a tumor in his head, Al arranges for him one last big festive jam session. Goldblum and Whitaker aren't doing badly pretending to play. Even Elias is not doing badly despite the somewhat obvious ending. Even though, when Al gives Buddy the Clifford Brown trumpet, it is hard to stay dry.

title: Courage Mountain
actors: Juliette Caton, Leslie Caron, Charlie Sheen, Laura Betti, Urbano Barberini
description: World War I breaks out and little Heidi starts going to school. For her it will certainly not be a year like any other. The pains and worries will force the girl to come to terms with a harsh reality.
notes: The story is quite conventional. The cast, on the other hand, is very unique. Yet another version of Johanna Spyri's novel "Heidi". Good cast, the direction is mediocre.

title: Weep No More My Lady
actors: Daniel J. Travanti, Shelley Winters, Kristin Scott Thomas, Stéphane Audran
description: When the neurotic, capricious, alcoholic and no longer very young movie star Leila is found dead by drowning, everyone or almost everyone immediately thinks it is suicide. Then the investigations go on and the hypothesis is progressively discarded in favor of that of murder. The major suspect appears to be Ted, the victim's boyfriend, but Elizabeth, Leila's younger sister, doesn't believe it. French-Canadian co-production that features a very respectable cast starting with two great ladies like Shelley Winters and Stéphane Audran to get to the young Kristin Scott-Thomas.

title: Maciste nella valle dei re
actors: Mark Forest, Chelo Alonso, Vira Silenti, Angelo Zanolli
description: Smedes, the perfidious Persian queen who dominates Egypt, kills her husband, the pharaoh Amirtee, sensitive to the pains of his people. His stepson Kenamun is subjugated by a magical filter served to him by Smedes, and he doesn't even remember the Egyptian Nofret who had fascinated him long ago. Maciste, who became leader of the anti-Persian resistance, settles everything for the best, both politics and love affairs.
notes: One of the first Italian pepla. Great success, thanks to the experience of the old Campogalliani.

title: The Counterpoint
actors: Charlton Heston, Maximilian Schell, Katryn Hays, Leslie Nielsen
description: In a Belgian town just liberated by the Americans, an (American) orchestra performs for the soldiers. But here's a sudden German attack, and all the orchestras are taken prisoner. The order for the extermination of the musicians arrives from Berlin, but a German general, a music lover and admirer of the famous conductor of the orchestra, objects. All sorts of things will happen.
notes: Taking the cue from the war, everything seems legitimate. Also to invent a totally absurd story, like that of the novel by Alan Sillitoe from which the film is based. Director Ralph Nelson's credit for getting away with it was no small feat.

title: Una ragione per vivere e una per morire
actors: James Coburn, Bud Spencer, Telly Savalas, José Suarez, Reinhard Kolldehoff
description: Colonel Pembroke's defense of Fort Holman wasn't heroic, but the Southerners were holding his son hostage and so we can't blame him too much either. The surrender is worth, however, the loss of degrees and a period of imprisonment. Pembroke manages to escape and, after various vicissitudes, manages to return to Fort Holman, along with a dozen companions to take revenge. A western spaghetti that has more nationality than soul (Italian, German, French and Spanish capitals). The result is a bit of a mess, with a delirious cast (Bud Spencer) and the solid action direction of the usual Valerii. Screenplay by Ferreriano Rafael Azcona.

title: Vaghe stelle dell'orsa
actors: Claudia Cardinale, Jean Sorel, Michael Craig
description: Sandra returns to her native Volterra with her husband Andrew Dawson. Here she finds her brother Gianni and her elderly mother hospitalized in a psychiatric clinic, where she is cared for by her second husband. The first died in a concentration camp. Andrew also discovers that Gianni and Sandra have been united by a murky bond. Certainly not one of Visconti's best films, it still won the Golden Lion in Venice in '65. However, the murky charm of a splendid Cardinal is noteworthy, and D'Annunzio's setting in Volterra.

title: Frozen Assets
actors: Corbin Bernsen, Shelley Long, Larry Miller, Dody Goodman
description: Zach arrives in Hobart, Oregon, perfectly convinced that he has been appointed president of a very ordinary bank, the kind that holds and distributes dollars. The fact that this is storing sperm doesn't upset him that much. Determined to make the institute economically profitable, Zach invents a competition for the "Stallion of the year" with a final prize of one hundred thousand dollars ...
notes: We can be proud when we see American cinema copying Italian cinema. Unfortunately, here we have Corbin Bernsen who is not worth either Renzo Montagnani or Alvaro Vitali. Also disappointing is the level of the jokes, which are not… vulgar enough.

title: Trinità e Bambino... adesso tocca a noi
actors: Heath Kizzier, Keith Neubertn Yvonne De Bark, Fanny Cadeo
description: Trinità jr., 25 years old, is informed by the doctor who made him come into the world of the existence of Bambino jr., His age. He then recognizes him as a horse thief and saves him from the gallows. The meeting is turbulent at first, but then the two team up as sheriff and deputy to defend a village from bandits: the partnership is productive and is a great success among the villagers.
notes: Film that takes up the two "historical" characters, updating them in their interpreters and "habits and customs". The catalog of skills and the light-hearted character of the action remain unchanged, respecting the consolidated "paternal" tradition.

title: Io Amleto
actors: Erminio Macario, Luigi Pavese, Franca Marzi, Rossana Podestà
description: The "blond prence of Denmark" must avoid the deadly traps that the faithless uncle Claudius sets him. Shakespeare awkwardly parodied. You don't even laugh.

title: Star Struck
actors: J.T. Walsh, Kirk Cameron, Chelsea Noble, Ned Eisenberg
description: Runner and Rose were only "engaged" for the duration of a vacation, at the summer camp. They were twelve years old, but the crush on Runner has not yet passed, twelve years later. not even a magazine ... Now Rose is a capricious movie star, famous all over the country: when the newspapers announce her marriage, Runner leaves the farm and sets out to win her back ...
notes: Television production for a play that does not pose too many problems of script; the collective memory, modeled by dozens of other films on the same theme, has the task of oiling the mechanisms where they screech.

title: Speechless
actors: Michael Keaton, Geena Davis, Christopher Reeve, Bonnie Bedelia
description: You work for the Democratic candidate for the New Mexico Senate as a "ghostwriter" (that is, you write his speeches); he has the same function for the republican one. They meet by chance in the pharmacy (both suffer from insomnia), they never miss an opportunity to boycott each other for the whole film and then - who would have thought that? - they clamorously declare their mutual, deep, eternal love. Classic example of how a more than discreet starting point is wasted: brilliant dialogues that hardly ever scratch and a few pinpricks (only a pinprick) to the "system" and its organization. Interpreters have a job: so what?

title: Jimmy Hollywood
actors: Joe Pesci, Christian Slater, Victoria Abril, Jason Beghe
description: Jimmy Alto waits for someone to call him for a movie; his girlfriend, Lorraine, would like to be a hairdresser for the stars. Jimmy happens to film his car thief and hands him over to the police; then, seeing that there is no lack of opportunities, he repeats the operation by passing himself off as the "Sos Group". But the police do not like this unusual collaboration ... Starting with the story (a bit of "Enforcer of the night" + a bit of "King for a night"), the film demonstrates, at its own expense, its assumption , namely that Hollywood is in crisis. But this, with its smallness, will not be the lifeboat.

title: Le sourire
actors: Jean-Pierre Marielle, Richard Bohringer, Emmanuelle Seigner
description: The well-known psychiatrist Dr. La Clainche (Marielle), a great petticoat, decides to indulge in one last erotic adventure, even if the doctors tell him that his heart is in dangerous disorder. So, accidentally meeting Odile (Seigner), he follows her through a tortuous and ambiguous path of circumstances until he manages to take her to bed. The ending is, fatally, fatal. It is not the ambition that Claude Miller lacks, but here there is too much clutter in the script and too many cerebral conundrums. The palm among the interpreters goes to Bohringer, the slimy stripteaseures manager.

title: Deadfall
actors: Michael Biehn, James Coburn, Nicolas Cage, Sarah Trigger
description: Joe, according to the last wishes of his father (whom he himself has unintentionally killed), searches for and finds the twin of his parent, who has been missing for thirty years and has become a big gangster. With him, Joe prepares a mega-scam against a diamond fence. In the course of the heist, his uncle is killed and Joe runs away with the loot. But there is a surprise in store for him, as sensational as it is unpleasant. There is a lot of the Coppola family in this cheap crime story (the director and screenwriter, stars Nicolas Cage and Talia Shire), but no one can take pride in it, as well as none of the outsiders who take you. part.

title: My Bodyguard
actors: Chris Makepeace, Adam Baldwin, Ruth Gordon, Matt Dillon
description: The boy Clifford does not intend to give in to the blackmail and violence of a gang of thugs of his schoolmates. And like him Rik - big, fat and with a terrible experience behind him - who becomes his bodyguard and close friend.
notes: Director Tony Bill makes his debut with a seemingly simple film. The cast, very young, defends itself well, with Matt Dillon and Adam Baldwin above all.

title: Last of the Redmen
actors: Jon Hall, Michael O'Shea, Evelyn Ankers
description: Two young ladies and a boy, the sons of an English general, cross the territories of North America infested with aggressive Indian tribes under escort. A noble and courageous Mohican, the only survivor of his people, acts as their defender and guide. This version of the Fenimore Cooper novel is neither the best nor the worst.

title: Due detective per una bambina
actors: Bud Spencer, Michael Winslow
description: Affiliated to a powerful Colombian narcos organization, Eduardo decides to team up with detective Extralarge and his friend Dumas. The traffickers manage to hit him by kidnapping the child. But who can stop a force of nature like Extralarge?

title: Carve Her Name with Pride
actors: Virginia McKenna, Paul Scofield, Jack Warner, Denise Grey, Alain Saury, Maurice Ronet
description: The young widow of an English officer is enlisted as an intelligence agent in 1940. After rendering numerous services to the country, she is killed by the Germans. Mix of genres that starts as a comedy and ends in tragedy. A solid English production, well directed and well interpreted.

title: Ercole e la regina di Lidia
actors: Steve Reeves, Sylva Koscina, Sylvia Lopez, Primo Carnera, Gabriele Antonini
description: On the way to Thebes, his hometown, together with his woman and the young Ulysses, Hercules must fight against Antaeus; then, trying to pacify Thebes, outraged by the conflict between Eteocles and Polynice, sons of Oedipus, she falls victim to the spells of Onfale, queen of Lydia. Eteocles and Polynice succumb in the course of a deadly duel, while Ulysses with the Argonauts rescues Hercules and releases him from the enchantment.
notes: Lydia's queen is just one of the many characters that make up this patchwork story, in which mythology is plundered for pure fun. Steve Reeves is a Hercules d.o.c .; Sylva Koscina is in full possession of her physical faculties.

title: The Helen Morgan Story
actors: Paul Newman, Ann Blyth, Richard Carlson
description: In the years of Prohibition, Helen is a singer in dubious clubs and is romantically linked to Larry, an alcohol smuggler ...
notes: Curtiz focuses strongly on the female character, whose interpreter is not always convincing, however. One of the most revisable results in the director's filmography.

title: The Angry Silence
actors: Richard Attenborough, Anna Maria Pierangeli, Oliver Reed, Brian Murray, Penelope Horner, Bernard Lee
description: Tom refuses to participate in a strike. The trade unionist Travers convinces the other workers to create a vacuum around him; this conspiracy of marginalization goes on until the next strike, when Tom is attacked and one of his comrades denounces the injustice. In times of Free cinema
notes: , a clever operation with the implications of ferocious anti-unionism.

title: Una gita scolastica
actors: Carlo Delle Piane, Tiziana Pini, Rossana Casale, Lidia Broccolino
description: An elderly lady recalls the best memory of her life: a school trip on foot from Bologna to Florence, through the Apennines, on the eve of the final exams. The thirty boys are accompanied by a teacher of letters and a teacher of drawing. The latter will have an adventure with one of the pupils. But the professor, in love with her, will defend her from the scandal.
notes: Pupi Avati takes a journey through memory and history by telling a story made up of little things, but always with the muted tones of a bit honeyed nostalgia.

title: Cookie
actors: Emily Lloyd, Peter Falk, Dianne Wiest, Brenda Vaccaro
description: Cookie, 18-year-old uninhibited and gum-chewing, reunites with her father who has been inside for thirteen years. In fact, the man is a powerful mafia boss who is serious about getting back into business immediately. Cookie immediately gets in tune with him and soon joins him in his "business". It is a question of playing both the former partners and the police and, at the same time, ironing out some issues of the heart.
notes: Based on the typical gangster movie cue, Susan Seidelman ("Desperately Seeking Susan") engages a comedy that is also the portrait of a nice rebel as often found in her cinema.

title: Powder
actors: Mary Steenburgen, Jeff Goldblum, Sean Patrick Flanery
description: A mysterious young man with very white skin and completely bald is found in the cellar of a country house. The boy, immediately nicknamed "Powder" (face powder) for the color of his skin, was born of lightning because his mother gave birth to him in the rain during a storm. Powder lived with his grandparents for twenty years, isolated and protected from the outside world. But now he has to face the rejection of the community that hates its diversity. And yes, the boy has extraordinary intelligence, is very sensitive and has paranormal powers. An easy easy moral in a film that is done pretty well and can be seen to the end.

title: Citizen X
actors: Donald Sutherland, Max Von Sydow, Stephen Rea, Jeffrey DeMunn
description: Between 1980 and 1990 a serial killer in Russia massacred fifty-two people (thirty-five of whom were under 17). In 1982, the first eight corpses were found in Rostov, horribly mutilated. The coroner Viktor Burakov immediately spoke of a very dangerous serial killer, but the head of the investigative commission argued that these deviations were an exclusively Western phenomenon. Meanwhile, the findings of corpses multiplied. Burakov decided to pursue the investigation alone. The monster was arrested in November 1990. Only thanks to Gorbachev's perestroika could the case be resolved: the solution was long prevented by the CPUS authorities because the suspect was a faithful supporter of the Party.
notes: A barely discreet script, saved however by the passion of the protagonists, Sutherland and Rea. Chris Gerolmo, director and screenwriter, is the author of "Mississippi Burning".

title: Alvarez Kelly
actors: William Holden, Richard Widmark, Janice Rule
description: Alvarez Kelly is a breeder of Irish descent. During the last months of the American Secession War he must lead a herd of 2,500 to the Federal Army camp which is preparing to take over the city of Richmond. But the cattle are also tempting to the Southerners who, led by Colonel Rossiter, plan to raid the herd and for this, taking advantage of a reception, they imprison Alvarez Kelly ...
notes: Honest traditional western and a bit of a manner. It does, however, contain some spectacular sequences of the charge of the herd; and equally great actor duels between William Holden and Richard Widmark.

title: Used People
actors: Shirley MacLaine, Marcello Mastroianni, Kathy Bates
description: Pearl Berman became a widow after 37 years of marriage. She has dedicated her entire life to her husband and daughters and now believes that her mission in life is to continue advising her now married daughters. Right at her husband's funeral, however, the woman meets an Italian American, Joe Meledandri, a friend of the deceased and secretly in love with her, who will soon make her fall in love and join her on the altar. Effectively set in 1969 (at the time of the moon landing), the film is a fun and sentimental insight into the life of two communities, the Jewish and the Italian-American, and at the same time the portrait of an exemplary woman and couple.

title: A noi piace freddo...!!
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Raimondo Vianello, Yvonne Furneaux, Francis Blanche
description: Rosalina, a starlet who cannot see the Germans tyrannizing the Eternal City, takes it into her head to help the Cat, a secret agent who works for the allies. She has only heard about the Cat, she has never seen it and, in her recklessness, she thinks she identifies him with Ugo, who is instead just a black stock marketer. The result is a whole series of complex misadventures.
notes: In this comedy that harmlessly jokes the Resistance, the most consistent reason for fun is the presence of the French actor Francis Blanche who makes an almost irresistible sketch of the ferocious major von Krussendorf.

title: If Lucy Fell
actors: Sarah Jessica Parker, Eric Schaeffer, Elle Macpherson
description: Lucy's birthday is only a month away, a New York psychoanalyst who shares an apartment with her best friend, Joe, a painter. The date marks a fundamental deadline in their lives, due to a pact made years ago: if by their thirtieth birthday they hadn't found true love, they would both have jumped off the Brooklyn Bridge. Now time is running out and neither of us has settled down yet. Joe continues to love and paint a beautiful neighbor, without finding the courage to talk to her. Lucy continues to sleep with a man she doesn't care about ... Will they find the courage to get out of the impasse?
notes: It is obvious that the answer is yes; it is obvious that love will not be where they imagined; it is also obvious that in reality they had no intention of really jumping into it. On the other hand, it is all obvious in this superfluous film that it copies many others without telling anything new. Elle MacPherson improves, but almost imperceptibly, in acting. For the rest, nothing to report.

title: Haut, Bas, Fragile
actors: Nathalie Richard, Marianne Denicourt, Anna Karina
description: Paris, summer 1994. Three women wander around the capital, in the streets, gardens, discos, laboratories and libraries. Everything is a bit more muffled than usual, due to the exodus of vacationers. In this sultry environment, two girls meet: it is a point of arrival in their search for the self. The third will decide to continue along a more autonomous and secret road.

title: Dancing in the Dark
actors: Victoria Principal, Nicholas Campbell, Robert Vaughn
description: Anna Forbes, a dance teacher, underwent a terrible experience: she was raped by her father-in-law. This is a very powerful character and the woman, at first, does not have the courage to accuse him. Then, she manages to overcome her fears and tells everything to her husband. He, however, not only does not believe her, but manages to have her hospitalized in a psychiatric clinic. Will Anna be able to get justice? Television production of the most popular genre: family drama with a sexual background. Victoria Principal made her debut in '72 ("The man of the seven halters", John Huston); Robert Vaughn has been in the breach since 1957 ("The Magnificent Seven" and "Bullitt", among others).

title: La moglie ingenua e il marito malato
actors: Fernando Rey, Stefania Sandrelli, Carlo Giuffrè
description: He (Rey) is an elderly professor; she (Sandrelli), is the tender wife, much younger than her husband. One day a rumor begins to circulate around the country which, although unconfirmed, certainly does not please the professor: his sweetheart would be cheating him. From here begins a series of gossip and misunderstandings that will put a strain on their union. Based on an excellent novel by Achille Campanile, difficult to adapt to the screen, this TV movie is a successful bet, thanks above all to superlative interpreters, a good script and Monicelli's solid experience.

title: The Rock
actors: Sean Connery, Nicolas Cage, Ed Harris, David Morse, Michael Biehn, Claire Forlani, William Forsythe, Vanessa Marcil, John Spencer, John C. McGinley, Tony Todd, Bokeem Woodbine, Todd Louiso
description: A group of visitors' trip to the former Alcatraz prison turns into a nightmare when they are taken prisoner and held hostage by an organization of "rebel" Marine officers. Soldiers would be noble: they demand that the US government compensate the families of soldiers who have fallen in battle and are ignobly forgotten by the state. To neutralize them, there's an FBI super-expert chemist. As for penetrating the fortress, there is only one person who can do it: the only one who has ever managed to get out.
notes: Second film by Michael Bay ("Bad Boys"): there are so many ideas that perhaps, more than a two-hour film, two could have been released. If the explosions only partially renew the image of the genre, the presence of Connery and a slap-up script, snappy action and fun are enough to keep the audience on the rope until the end.

title: Hellfighters
actors: John Wayne, Katharine Ross, Jim Hutton, Vera Miles, Bruce Cabot
description: Chance Buckmà is a specialist in extinguishing fires in oil wells. During one of these actions he is injured and his wife (who lives apart) and the daughter whom Chance has not seen for some time are warned. Chance's young collaborator Greg falls in love with the girl and marries her, also taking over Chance's company, which feels too old by now. However, he will still be the one to make a decisive contribution when fires break out in the wells in Venezuela. It is a spectacular film, even if, in the long run, the sequences of the fires are all a bit alike, starring an aged, but never tame, John Wayne.

actors: Jonathan Silverman, Helen Slater, Martin Landau, Paxton Whitehead
description: Barry Thomas, employee, loves from a distance, undeclared, Lisa, a colleague of his. This one bad day gets murdered. He, out of desperation, gets drunk, gets caught up in a storm, gets a nice electric shock and, the next day, wakes up realizing that he is reliving exactly the day before. Now it is a question of resolving the temporal paradox, perhaps taking advantage of it to "resurrect" Lisa. Based on a short story that has some affinity with "Ricomincio da capo", released the same year, it is a breezy sci-fi comedy with good interpretations and a good ability to alternate moments of comedy, suspense and sentiment.

title: Tombstone
actors: Kurt Russell, Val Kilmer, Powers Boothe, Joanna Pacula
description: Wyatt Earp, former sheriff of Dodge City, has moved with brothers Virgil and Morgan to Tombstone where he dominates a gang of outlaws called "The Cowboys". Soon, Doc Hollyday, a gunfighter, and his woman, Kate, also join the three. When the outlaws take out the sheriff, brothers Earp and Doc take on "The Cowboys" at Ok Corral.
notes: An attempt, only partially successful, to resurrect the western genre by revisiting one of its founding myths: the Ok Corral shootings. There is a lot of shooting, but the myth, the real one, is now far away.

title: Nobody's Fool
actors: Paul Newman, Melanie Griffith, Jessica Tandy, Bruce Willis
description: Sixty-year-old bricklayer Sully has always been a "free spirit". He divorced when his only child was one year old, he continued to live in his town, he is in a dispute with his employer, but loses the case. The return of his son, in a marriage crisis, brings Sully closer to him and his grandchildren, gives him that sense of family he had never had before. A film of actors (all excellent), which the director ("Kramer against Kramer") guides with a skilful hand. A film of juicy, savory atmospheres captured with masterful sensitivity. A film as it once was: excellently, greedy "anachronistic".

title: Obstruction of Justice
actors: Sara Botsford, Richard Zeman, Frank Skorpion, Alan Fawcett
description: Ray Coleman is an upright police officer: a person above all suspicion. One bad day, however, some of his friends discover the corpse of his wife, who has been savagely murdered. And what's worse, investigations seem to point to Ray as the prime suspect in the crime. Faced with such a prospect, all the policeman's colleagues rise up, precisely because of the integrity that has always distinguished him. Detective Higgins proceeds alone in the investigation; eventually he will have to force Ray's co-workers to accept the bitter need to blame the co-worker. A detective story that makes use of characters, places and situations without surprises: everything works according to the codified rules and the direction is limited to administering the elements at its disposal, without attempting anything more.

title: I.D.
actors: Reece Dinsdale, Richard Graham, Claire Skinner, Sean Pertwee
description: John is a young and ambitious police officer, highly regarded by his superiors. Faced with the constant escalation of violence inside and outside the football stadiums, together with three colleagues he receives the task of infiltrating the most extremist supporters in order to unmask their leaders and bring them to justice. John takes the mission to heart and becomes a regular visitor to the "Rock", a pub that serves as the headquarters for supporters of the Shadwell, B team. Day after day his relationships with hooligans - in particular with Martin, Nick and Gumbo - they hug, and John identifies himself to the point with his fictional role that he participates with total conviction in the life of the "pack" and its hooligan actions. Obviously his own sense of identity suffers heavy consequences; not to mention married life, now definitively compromised.
notes: Let's start with the original, apparently cryptic title: "i.d." stands for "identity document", as if to underline the true thematic backbone of the film. Rather than building a "denouncing" work, Davis - a television director here at his debut for the big screen, with numerous participations as an actor behind him - wanted to highlight the profound social and psychological similarities that unite the universe of the thugs from the stands and that of the guardians of the law. Realistic and stylized together, an original and interesting film.

title: Margaret Bourke-White
actors: Farrah Fawcett, Frederic Forrest, Mitchell Ryan
description: The film tells the life and career of Margaret Bourke White, a famous American photographer who collaborated with "Life" in the Thirties and Forties, as well as the protagonist of a love story with the writer Erskine Caldwell, the author of the famous "La via del tobacco" .
notes: The script is based on Vicki Goldber's biographical book. The protagonist is Farrah Fawcett (who in her time was launched by the television series "Charlie's Angels", but who on the big screen had very few opportunities to prove her skills), credible enough until she busies herself around lenses and tripods.

title: Cuore di cane
actors: Cochi Ponzoni, Max Von Sydow, Eleonora Giorgi, Mario Adorf
description: On Bobi, a stray dog, Professor Preobazensky and his assistant transplant the vital organs of a bureaucrat who has died a few hours ago. The resulting anthropomorphic creature, Bobikov, with his ingenuity and impetuosity upsets the rigid surrounding society and the tranquility of the two scientists, who soon bring him back to the canine condition.
notes: From the homonymous story by Bulgakov, one of the most touching results of Lattuada's "literary cinema", with excellent actors and a well-kept staging.

title: Improper Conduct
actors: Tahnee Welch, Steven Bauer, Lee Anne Beaman, John Laughlin
description: Ashley is a beautiful girl who acts casually with male colleagues at the company where she works as a graphic designer. This makes it an object of desire. One bad day, the new boss tries to rape her and she denounces him. Helped by her sister Kay and a lawyer friend, Sam, she loses the case. She then dies, drunk and desperate, in a car accident, but Kay doesn't give up ... Characters and situations are predictable, the tension is tamed. The "prey" is Tahnee Welch; his lawyer is Steven Bauer, who perhaps someone will remember in the role of Al Pacino's villainous friend and accomplice, in "Scarface" (De Palma, 1983).

title: Anno uno
actors: Luigi Vannucchi, Dominique Darel, Rita Calderoni
description: The film, based on Alcide De Gasperi's meetings and dialogues or speeches, unfolds in the period from 1944 to 1954: from when the Allies are anxiously awaited in Rome to when the politician, after the DC congress in Naples from which he emerges almost defeated, he retires to Selva di Valsugana. In this penultimate film, Roberto Rossellini sets a historical "didactic" discourse on the troubled and fundamental period for Italy, consisting of the first years following the end of the war and this through the events and thoughts of one of the most prestigious political leaders in Italy. epoch. Beautiful interpretation of Luigi Vannucchi.

title: Anima nera
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Annette Stroyberg, Eleonora Rossi Drago
description: Adriano, who has a troubled past behind him, wants to end that kind of life and agrees to marry Marcella, a girl from a good family. One day he receives the inheritance from a longtime friend who is not too recommendable. Marcella leaves him to this discovery. Unconvincing film of the latest Rossellini based on a comedy by Patroni Griffi.

title: Il caso Mattei
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, Luigi Squarzina, Peter Baldin, Franco Graziosi
description: In addition to the pilot, Enrico Mattei and an American journalist, the Eni twin-jet that was carrying from Sicily to Milan crashed into the sky of Bascapè (Pavia) on 27 October 1962. Rosi reconstructs the life of the "state entrepreneur" from the immediate after the war until his death, his action that had put against him very powerful enemies and tries a hypothesis on the accident. Thanks to a tight script, a robust narrative management and a masterful interpretation of Gian Maria Volonté in the role of the protagonist, the film captivates for its spectacular effectiveness and for the charge of civil commitment.

title: An Awfully Big Adventure
actors: Alan Rickman, Hugh Grant, Georgina Cates, Alun Amstrong
description: Liverpool, 1960. Stella, 16, orphaned by her father and abandoned by her mother, lives with a couple of uncles. To try to emancipate himself, he hires a theater company as a stage assistant. The girl is fascinated by the actor and director Meredith Potter, but it will be a mature comedian who will make her lose her virginity and make her aware of the meanness and arrogance that dominate in the theatrical environment. Same director of "Four Weddings and a Funeral", and again Hugh Grant; but, due to some excessive yielding to the tones of the melodrama and an all too obvious coloring of the context, the "miracle" of the previous film is not repeated.

title: City Slickers II: The Legend of Curly's Gold
actors: Billy Crystal, Daniel Stern, Jon Lovitz, Jack Palance
description: Two years after the unusual "vacation" that gave substance to the first film, Mitch Robbins (Cristal) leaves for the West with his friend Phil (Stern) and, this time, with his younger brother Glen (Lovitz). The map of a hidden treasure is involved and, above all, the "ghost" of Curly (Palance) who was deceased in the previous adventure. As often happens, the "sequel" is not worth the film from which it was born. Neither for originality, nor as a mockery of metropolitan yuppies. The character of Glen is good, the series of "quotes" that cinephiles can have fun identifying is endless.

title: Zendegi edame darad
actors: Farhad Kherardmand, Buba Bayour, Hocine Rifahi, Ferhendeh Feydi
description: A man and his son travel to the Gilan region, which has recently been hit by a terrible earthquake. We are in 1990; the two want to find out if the young protagonist of the film "Where is my friend's house?" is still alive. In fact, he lives in one of the affected villages. The research reveals to them that mourning does not stop life and that the catastrophe does not make them forget the football world championships. By interweaving reality and fiction with great cinematic intelligence, Kiarostami gives a sample of his idea of ??"realism". It also shows us how it is possible to tell even the most terrible tragedy with the tones of comedy. Theoretical and exciting at the same time.

title: I'll Met by Moonlight
actors: Dirk Bogarde, Marius Goring, David Oxley
description: Crete, 1944. A group of partisans, assisted by the British, plans to kidnap the German general Kreipe. One evening the general's car is intercepted and the man kidnapped. He cleverly sows clues, but a boy manages to mislead the Germans.
notes: More than a real war film, it is an adventurous, spectacular and nocturnal vision in the typical style of its authors.

title: The Mouse on the Moon
actors: Margaret Rutherford, Bernard Cribbins, Ron Moody
description: The little Duchy of Gran Fenwick asks for a loan to the United States to finance his missile research. The Russians also offer to collaborate by offering a missile gift. This is put in orbit thanks to the local wine which, it has been discovered, has explosive properties. The great Fenwick thus wins the race to space. Funny playing with evidently satirical intent; It is the sequel to the "roar of the mouse" but without Peter Sellers, directed by a Lester who is about to meet the Beatles.

title: Convict Cowboy
actors: Jon Voight, Kyle Chandler, Ben Gazzara, Marcia Gay Harden, Stephen McHattie
description: Clay was sentenced to two years in prison for fighting with a policeman. In jail he dreams of participating in the great rodeo organized by the prisons of three states, convinced that he can win. However, he has to deal with a fellow inmate, a drug dealer, his bitter opponent. Intense prison drama with "Midnight Cowboy" Jon Voight.

title: Il figlio di Spartacus
actors: Steve Reeves, Jacques Sernas, Gianna Maria Canale, Claudio Gora
description: It turns out that Spartacus had an heir, Rando, who, when he is a Roman centurion, is captured by the Lydians and reduced to slavery. Rando leads the revolt of his unfortunate companions, only he - contrary to what happened to his parent and his followers - comes out the winner.
notes: A deliberately improbable and bizarre story, in a well-kept and entertaining short film.

title: Face to Face
actors: James Mason, Gene Lockhart, Robert Preston, Marjorie Steele
description: Two-episode film. In "Mysterious Passenger" (from Conrad) the commander of a British vessel in the Pacific waters rescues a young officer from another ship. In "Pistol Shots" (by Stephen Crane) a drunkard has a habit of shooting in the city; the sheriff, unarmed, heals him. A very curious double adaptation. In the first episode, Mason's atmosphere and interpretation are enjoyable; in the second the rhythm and the picaresque tone.

title: Francis of Assisi
actors: Bradford Dillman, Dolores Hart, Stuart Whitman
description: Francesco (Dillman) is a rather reckless young man. One day he hears the divine call and strips himself of all his possessions and all his riches to live in poverty serving God. He builds his own church at the Porziuncola and draws up a monastic "rule", also clashing with papal power. He dies after receiving the gift of the stigmata. Hollywood version without infamy and without praise of the life of the Saint of Assisi.

title: Prospero's Books
actors: John Gielgud, Michael Clark, Erland Josephson, Michel Blanc, Isabelle Pasco, Tom Bell, Kenneth Cranham, Mark Rylance, Gerard Thoolen, Pierre Bokma, Jim van der Woude, Michiel Romeyn, Ute Lemper, Deborah Conway
description: Prospero, now old, was ousted by his brother and thus lost the Duchy of Milan. Now he lives on an island from which, by unleashing a storm, he wrecks passing ships. Baroque and figuratively dazzling version (with extensive use of new electronic technologies) of Shakespeare's "Tempest".

title: Max e Jérémie
actors: Philippe Noiret, Christopher Lambert, Jean-Pierre Marielle
description: Max is a former professional killer who has reached the age of retirement. He lives without financial problems and is bored. A bad day enters his life Jérémie, rough and arrogant; Max realizes that the young man has the task of eliminating him due to too many secrets his career has brought him to know. And on the track there is also Inspector Almeida, who wants to retire with a master stroke ... From a novel by Teri White, Devers creates a thriller that sets aside any moralistic scruple to dedicate herself to sketching two "classic" characters "of cinema noir, entrusting them to actors who compete with each other to propose them to us. Vince Noiret.

title: Seminole
actors: Rock Hudson, Anthony Quinn, Barbara Hale, Lee Marvin
description: Lieutenant Caldwell arrives at Fort Klig: here he finds Revere, the childhood companion he is in love with, but not John, the friend of the time. John, the son of an Indian, has placed himself at the head of the Seminole tribe with the name of Osceola. Major Degan would like to exterminate the Indians and both Caldwell and Osceola will, to varying degrees, fall victim to his hatred of the Indians.
notes: Making one of the first westerns of his filmography, Boetticher stigmatizes militaristic drifts and starts his own personal journey within the American genre par excellence. The contribution of Russell Metty's "luxuriant" photography was decisive.

title: I Hired a Contract Killer
actors: Jean-Pierre Léaud, Margi Clarke, Kenneth Colley, Serge Reggiani
description: Destroyed in morale from being fired after thirty years of work, Henry Boulanger pays a killer to be killed. But then he thinks about it ...

title: Sonatine
actors: Takeshi Kitano, Aya Kokumai, Tetsu Watanabe, Masanobu Katsumura
description: Murakawa, right-hand man of a boss, falls into a trap: he is sent on a mission with his men to target enemy killers. At the end of a dripping of the dead, isolated on a beach, in love with a girl, he goes to the extreme consequences. A yakuza in search of "his" death.
notes: A masterpiece. Takeshi Kitano, known as "Beat", in memory of his past as a comedian, revolutionizes the syntax of noir by introducing a solemn rhythm into the action, almost a symptom of contemplative beauty that clashes with the stylized violence of death.

title: Cybertech P.D.
actors: Lorenzo Lamas, Kari Salin, Chris Sarandon
description: Once drug trafficking was definitively defeated, international crime threw itself into the clandestine trade of virtual realities of all kinds. Chase and Phillips belong to the Cybertech team, struggling with this new, deadly phenomenon. They find an ally in Pamela, a virtual sex star, of which the boss Matthews wants to exploit the DNA to obtain clones to be put into circulation ...
notes: The intertwining of action and science fiction sinks into a tide of banality.

title: Class
actors: Jacqueline Bisset, Andrew McCarthy, Rob Lowe, Cliff Robertson
description: Jonathan, of petty bourgeois extraction, studies at Vernon Academy and has as a roommate Skip, rich in money and love experiences, with whom he befriends, after some initial disagreements. One day, in Chicago, Jonathan is initiated into sex (in the elevator!) By a beautiful lady, with whom he then enters into a relationship. Except to discover that the woman who took him as a lover is Skip's mother. The film is a mixture, nonchalant if not pimp, of goliardic farces and dramatic comedies of initiation into sex, told with a certain skill but also devoid of emotion.

title: A Time for Killing
actors: Glenn Ford, George Hamilton, Inger Stevens, Paul Petersen, Timothy Carey, Dick Miller, Harrison Ford
description: The Civil War is over but, thirsty for revenge, the Confederate Captain Bentley hides the news from the soldiers who fled with him from a northern fort where they were prisoners. Moderately violent, with some rhetoric about the ugliness of war.

title: The Trap
actors: Oliver Reed, Rita Tushingham, Rex Sevenoaks
description: In the middle of the last century, a rude Canadian trapper buys a mute scullery maid in a village to make her his wife and take her to live in the forest. She is initially terrified, then saves her husband from certain death and ends up appreciating his shy humanity.
notes: Unusual sentimental story in a splendid natural setting, with beautiful action sequences.

title: The Road Killers
actors: Christopher Lambert, Craig Sheffer, Michelle Forbes, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, David Arquette
description: Two cars traveling in the desert towards San Diego. In one, Jack with his wife and teenage daughter; in the other, his friend Glen with his son. The group meets a bloodthirsty fugitive who beats the area with three of his cronies. Glen dies immediately, in the flames, and Jack is presumed dead; the others are imprisoned in a horrid shack. But Jack (Lambert) has seven lives and his revenge will be merciless.
notes: Classic "B-movie" signed by the son of a director (Richard) who was worth more than his scion. If we pass over the improbability and forcing, the rhythm is not lacking. Lambert is not worth much, but this is nothing new.

title: Ma saison preferée
actors: Catherine Deneuve, Daniel Auteuil, Marthe Villalonga, Chiara Mastroianni
description: The elderly Berta goes to spend some time, without much enthusiasm, with her daughter Emilia. She doesn't like her son-in-law or the house very much. Emilia invites her brother Antonio for Christmas, with whom she had not had relations for three years. Antonio quarrels with his brother-in-law and takes his mother back to his home. This, after having had an illness, no longer wants to live alone, but neither Emilia nor Antonio are willing to host her ... A very interesting starting point, which however loses a lot of its vigor due to the too thick outline with which the screenplay l 'wanted to "enrich". Too bad, because Téchiné uses the camera well and the interpreter are excellent.

title: Pagine chiuse
actors: Duilio Laurenti, Silvano De Munari, Maria Gazziola
description: When his parents separate, little Luciano is sent to boarding school. But here, accustomed to the free life of the countryside, he withdraws into himself by isolating himself from everyone. The religious who run the institute are also very rigid without carrying out real pedagogical work. Luciano feels more and more alone. Delicate and at times dramatic portrait of a boy and above all of the circles of the broken up family and of the institute.

title: The Brave One
actors: Michael Ray, Rodolfo Hoyos, Elsa Cárdenas, Fermin Rivera
description: To Leonardo, the son of one of his employees, Don Alessandro gives a bull to which the child grows fond. But Don Alessandro dies, the fazenda is put up for auction and with it all the animals, including the young bull. Leonardo must therefore fight to avoid the fate of the arena for his four-legged friend. Decent drama by an honest craftsman specializing in melò.

title: Old Shatterhand
actors: Lex Barker, Pierre Brice, Daliah Lavi, Rik Battaglia
description: A gang of white bandits commits a series of crimes managing to put the responsibility on the Indians. This creates friction with the federal authorities who are forced to break the peace treaty. A pioneer, a friend of the Indian chief, tries to prevent the war, but the battle will take place at Fort Apache. A European western that follows, somewhat naively, the classic models trying to overturn some stereotypes.

title: Border River
actors: Joel McCrea, Yvonne De Carlo, Pedro Armendariz, Ivan Triesault
description: A major in the Confederate army wants to buy weapons from a rebel Mexican general. But he is a kind of bandit and the transaction turns into a high-tension adventure. Actors of considerable appeal for a western that, at least in part, is detached from the schemes of the genre.

title: Padri e figli
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Vittorio De Sica, Marisa Merlini, Antonella Lualdi
description: Four families and a waitress, witness to their problems. In the first, the father is worried about his children in love; in the second the trouble is that husband and wife cannot have children; in the third the widowed father wants to leave the tailoring to his son so that he can have a good time; in the fourth there is a quasi-father terrified at the idea of ??becoming one. A film between neorealism and comedy of manners. The stories are only sketchy, but the elements are staged with insight and sensitivity. At the center is the moral aspect of the generational contrast, linked to the new problems of urban life.

title: Tracce di vita amorosa
actors: Stefania Sandrelli, Walter Chiari, Laura Morante, Roberto Herlitzka, Andrea Occhipinti
description: What is love, in how many forms can it manifest? Lots of little episodes to answer. A young woman does not rent an apartment because she learned that the previous tenants broke up; a child is jealous of his newborn brother; a woman follows the person in whom the heart of her dead boyfriend has been transplanted; a respectable lady is irresistibly attracted to a thief; a young man does not intervene while two thugs rape a crush ... Good idea of ??departure; title inspired by a famous essay by Barthes, but disastrous film and asphyxiated screenplay, full of clichés. Unintentional comedy, actors wasted.

title: Festa di laurea
actors: Carlo Delle Piane, Aurore Clément, Lidia Broccolino, Nik Novecento
description: The pastry chef Vanni Porelli is commissioned to restore a country house, which the years and neglect have degraded, and to organize the graduation party for Sandra, the daughter of the owner. This is a lady who, ten years earlier, had given him a kiss on the day of Italy's entry into the war. The party will be a failure, certainly not because of Vanni, but because of the meanness of the guests.
notes: In the usual "minimal" style, Avati creates yet another variant on the theme of being and appearing, more attentive to speckish details than to the breath of action. The character actor Delle Piane, promoted to lead actor, shows expressive strings a little too short.

title: I 2 gattoni a 9 code... e mezza ad Amsterdam
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Joan Harwick, Elisabeth Sennfors
description: Franco and Ciccio are two journalists. One day they have to do a report on van Goulden, the king of diamonds. But just as they are photographing him, van Goulden is killed. The two travel to Amsterdam in search of two people who appear to be involved in the murder. Here they wander around the hippie circles and manage to take another compromising photograph for a group of smugglers who get on their trail, but an Interpol agent ... Limply led along a yellow line (the title alludes to "The cat with nine tails "by Argento, which also provides some hints of the plot), there is no shortage, being in Amsterdam, pseudo malicious or winking scenes.

title: Lektionen in Finsternis
description: German director Werner Herzog films Kuwaiti oil well fires caused by the Gulf War. The images of this earthly hell are interspersed with oral testimonies of some victims of war violence. The soundtrack is entrusted to the music of Mahler, Prokofiev, Verdi, Wagner and some verses of the Apocalypse of St. John. The director's nomadic gaze goes beyond simple documentarism to delve into the territories of myth and the cinematic unconscious.

title: Battle at Apache Pass
actors: Jeff Chandler, John Lund, Susan Cabot, Bruce Cowling
description: Major Colton, who commands a fort on Indian territory, has befriended Supreme Leader Cochise, but a government envoy, Baylor, would like to drive the Indians out of their territory. To do this, he does not hesitate to stir up Geronimo, Cochise's enemy, to attack a caravan so that the blame falls on his opponent. Bloody conflicts will follow, before a new peace. Without too many concerns for historical fidelity, and without particular spikes of originality, the film follows the patterns of the western of the time. This is the second time that Jeff Chandler plays the great leader of the Apaches, Cochise.

title: Marked Man
actors: Roddy Piper, Jane Wheeler, Miles O'Keeffe, Alina Thompson
description: Frank Stanton ended up in jail on charges of murder. One day a drunk invested and killed his girlfriend (and soon marries) and he, blinded by his anger, killed him. The life behind bars is hard, but for Frank it becomes dramatic when he witnesses a brutal murder made by two guards. At this point he has no further escape even with the escape. The police, in fact, trigger immense manhunt. Frank, however, has an ace in his sleeve ... "Supervised exposed" immediately presents himself with the credentials of the classic prison film (the condemnation, the sharp and corrupt jailers) but then turns into the thriller and the story is tinged with the colors of the Rissed.

title: Foreign Correspondent
actors: Joel McCrea, Laraine Day, Herbert Marshall
description: Shortly before the outbreak of World War II, a young American reporter uncovers a plot: an elderly leader of the international peace movement is kidnapped by the Nazis. At the head of the plot is a fake English pacifist, actually a Nazi hierarch. When the first is released, the war has already broken out; the Englishman dies in an air attack while his daughter and the reporter are saved. Traditionally considered a "minor" hitchcock of the American period, the film is actually conducted with direction and ideas that match the master's most celebrated films. The film was born as a B movie and for this reason Gary Cooper turned down the part of the protagonist.

title: Berlin-Yerushalaim
country: Israel, Netherlands, Italy, France, Great Britain
actors: Lisa Kreuzer, Rivka Neuman
description: The parallel destinies of two Jewish women: the German poet Else Lasker-Schüler in the Berlin of rising Nazism and Tania, a Russian exile engaged in the construction of the nascent Jewish state. The Holy Land as a poetic ghost and as a political utopia and the failure of both protagonists, overwhelmed by contradictions that still tear Israeli society.

title: My Fair Lady
actors: Audrey Hepburn, Rex Harrison, Stanley Holloway, Wilfrid Hyde-White
description: We are in London, at the beginning of our century. Misogynist Professor Higgins bets with a friend that he can turn a florist into a classy woman. He will win the bet and discover love. At the origin of the film are the comedy "Pygmalion" by George Bernard Shaw and the musical of the same title by Alan Jay Lerner and Frederik Loewe. The set of elements is perfect: the vitriolic humor of the Irish playwright, the resounding success of the theatrical version, a director of refined craft and top-class performers. 8 Oscars: best film, direction, leading actor, photography, set design, costumes, musical and sound arrangements.

title: Second Best
actors: William Hurt, Chris Cleary Miles, Keith Allen, John Hurt
description: Graham Holt is in his forties, he has never had a woman of his own, and not even his old father occupies his heart that much. James is about a dozen years old, has lost his mother and dotes on his parent (who is in jail). Graham asks to be able to adopt James and, in the meantime, gets him foster care. But James has a temperament that is not easy at all and getting along with him is a difficult problem ... A story nourished by convincing and moving sensitivity that never falls into the pathetic tearjerker. An amazing William Hurt for masterfully contained intensity, an environment rendered with precise precision to act as an exact frame to the story.

title: Les roseaux sauvages
actors: Elodie Bouchez, Gaël Morel, Stéphane Rideau, Frédéric Gorny, Michèle Moretti, Jacques Nolot, Eric Kreikenmayer, Nathalie Vignes, Michel Ruhl, Fatia Maite, Elodie Soulinhac, Claudine Taulère
description: Henri arrives at the boys' boarding school in a small town, a young "pied-noir" who has his tooth poisoned with his compatriots who have left Algeria, and who is frowned upon by his classmates. Among these, he has relations with Serge and François. Serge's brother dies in the colonial war, François lives his homosexual tendencies very badly. Then there is Maïté, daughter of a teacher and communist militant ... The beautiful film by Téchiné is part of a series produced by TV and by several directors ("Toutes les garçonnes et les filles de mon age"): a collective rethinking in which this episode has the merit of a very well told context and credible characters, without the traps of nostalgic mellowing.

title: I Walked with a Zombie
actors: Frances Dee, Tom Conway, James Ellison, Edith Barrett, Christine Gordon
description: Jessica Holland, the wife of a farmer on the island of San Sebastian, is in the grip of a mysterious paralysis. A nurse is hired, Betsy who quickly discovers that the woman is a victim of voodoo. Underneath there is mello as well as a healthy dose of horror (all of atmospheres and psychologies) and a monstrous ability of Tourneur. A classic.

title: ...e vennero in quattro per uccidere Sartana
actors: Jeff Cameron, Anthony C. Stanton, Celso Faria, Dennis Colt
description: Together with four other "specialists", on behalf of the sheriff, the gunslinger Sartana must clean up a western town of a gang of thugs. The work is accomplished with the discovery of the unsuspected leader of the outlaws.

title: Imitation of Life
actors: Claudette Colbert, Warren William, Rochelle Hudson, Louise Beavers, Ned Sparks, Fredi Washington, Juanita Quigley, Alan Hale, Henry Armetta, Wyndham Standing
description: A white widow and her black housekeeper are enriched with the formula of a flour for pancakes, of which the housekeeper is the custodian, who, as only compensation, asks for a funeral in grand style for herself. The white woman's daughter loves her future stepfather and the black woman's daughter is ashamed of her lineage. Remade by Sirk in 1959. But in this case the original has aged worse than the makeover, despite Stahl's mastery of direction.

title: The Stranger Beside Me
actors: Tiffani Thiessen, Eric Close, Steven Eckholdt
description: Jennifer, married to Chris, a naval officer, discovers that her husband is responsible for violence and that he could turn this tendency towards his daughter. This terrible discovery is associated with the problem of man, who suffers from claustrophobia and who cannot avoid his nocturnal wanderings. Chris's sister also confesses to Jennifer that she was molested by her brother. It is a film produced for cable television. Family drama that forces a woman to make capital decisions in cruel solitude. The story moves on issues that have recently been very strong and which are now giving rise to a real trend.

title: Ku fu? Dalla Sicilia con furore
actors: Franco Franchi, Gianni Agus, Enzo Andronico, Nino Terzo, Gino Pagnani, Alfredo Thomas
description: Franco, known as "Fico d'India", wants to participate in a competition to become a traffic policeman. He thus moved to Rome where he will have to take a karate test. He enrolls in the school of master Kon Chi Lay who instructs him (with poor results) in the difficult martial art.
notes: Franco, unfortunately without Ciccio, mimics Bruce Lee's films. Sympathetically null.

title: Platinum Blonde
actors: Loretta Young, Robert Williams, Jean Harlow
description: Stew Smith is a young reporter sent by the newspaper to do a news report. Thanks to her quick reflexes in foiling blackmail, the service turns into her marriage to an heiress. In short, however, Stew discovers that he is out of place in that high bourgeois environment. Drop everything and go back to his old colleagues and his old girlfriend. One of the great Capra films: an entertaining and amusing investigation of a certain American society

title: Invaders from Mars
actors: Jimmy Hunt, Helena Carter, Arthur Franz, Leif Erickson, Hillary Brooke
description: A boy discovers that a group of Martians who have landed on planet Earth are turning some locals into robots. Among the "robots" are his father, his mother and a friend of his. But nobody believes him, except a young doctor. Together the two try to defeat the invaders by first having to fight against general skepticism.
notes: Despite the poverty of means, the film, designed for 3D and scripted by Richard Blake, stands out for its visionary style. As often happened at the time, the film was massacred in the Italian edition. Seen today it keeps its naive charm intact.

title: The Devil Bat
