actors: Bela Lugosi, Suzanne Kaaren, Dave O'Brien, Guy Usher
description: A doctor with a passion for a scientist is esteemed for his kindness and seriousness by the whole community of the small town of Minnesota where he lives. One day, however, strange murders begin to happen: it turns out that it is a ferocious and gigantic bat of an unknown species to commit them. The monster is shot down, but, inexplicably, the kills continue. A journalist arrives in town to investigate.
notes: Fumettone with horror veins whose only interest lies in the presence of Bela Lugosi.

title: The Bamboo Saucer
actors: Dan Duryea, John Ericson, Lois Nettleton
description: An alien spaceship has landed in Central Asia, in Chinese territory. Anglo-American and Soviet troops are parachuted into the area to attempt to recover the secrets contained in the flying saucer. The Chinese, however, do not intend to sell what could prove to be very precious secrets for their war industry and thus intercept the commandos. A bloody battle ensues at the end of which, the only survivors, an American and a Russian flee together on the alien aircraft.
notes: It was certainly not the first time that intergalactic affairs served American cinema to warn of various "red" dangers. Before the ping pong politics (and before Tien An Men).

title: The Portrait
actors: Gregory Peck, Lauren Bacall, Cecilia Peck, Paul McCrane, Donna Mitchell
description: Gregory Peck and Lauren Bacall, an elderly couple but very much in love, are struggling with a neurotic and pain in the ass daughter who wants to paint their portrait. Production for cable TV above the usual standards, directed by an Arthur Penn who returns to directing television after many years.

title: Der Arzt von Stalingrad
actors: O.E. Hasse, Eva Bartok, Hannes Messemer, Mario Adorf, Walther Reyer, Siegfried Lowitz, Paul Bösiger, Vera Tschechowa, Michael Ande
description: Fritz Bohler, a great surgeon, is a captain of the defeated Wermacht, a prisoner of the Soviets. Good and talented, he towers over the meanness of the "reds", in particular over a cruel doctor and the deputy commander of the prison camp. Semi-forgotten propaganda film, which re-emerges from time to time on TV.

title: The Raid
actors: Van Heflin, Anne Bancroft, Richard Boone
description: In 1864, six Southern soldiers escape from a Union prison and take refuge in Canada, from where they will organize a revenge raid against a small town in Vermont. Lively film, well constructed and characterized. Directed by Hugo Fragonese, an Argentine-born director very skilled in low-budget action cinema, the film is based on an authentic episode in American history.

title: The Man Who Understood Women
actors: Leslie Caron, Henry Fonda, Myron McCormick, Cesare Danova
description: Willie Bausche, a successful Hollywood director, discovers Anna, a young woman in whom he sees great talent. Having made him a diva, Willie marries Anna and does not allow her to end her career to devote herself completely to him. Thus Anna ends up yielding to the court of a French officer. At this point, Willie, devoured by jealousy, hatches a plan to get rid of his rival ... It is not uncommon for Hollywood, representing itself, to fleas on itself. This is also what happens in this "mélo", where the Mecca of cinema is certainly not described in idyllic terms. And this aspect is also the best part of the film.

title: The Last Hard Men
actors: Charlton Heston, James Coburn, Barbara Hershey, Christopher Mitchum
description: Sheriff Sam Burgade retires after capturing the bandit Zach Crov. In the capture, Zach's wife died and the outlaw escapes to avenge her. Kidnaps Suzan, Sam's daughter; he goes on a hunt with his men, but ends up being alone with Suzan's boyfriend, Hal. It will be the two of them who will clash with Zach and his gang; Sam dies but Hal kills Zach and frees the girl. The great era of the western is about to close and it shows. Despite its "epic" intentions, the story suffers from a short-lived script; the direction is conventional despite the Peckinpah winks; the cast, however, is of a certain appeal.

title: Where Sleeping Dogs Lie
actors: Dylan McDermott, Sharon Stone, Tom Sizemore
description: Bruce Simmons is a Hollywood writer who, put under pressure from his agent, tries success as the author of bloody stories. He seeks inspiration in reality, referring to the events of a killer who lived in the same house where he himself now lives. Of course, the thing will not be without disturbing consequences.
notes: Everything revolves around the clash between two conflict personalities, that of the writer and that of a psychotic pensioner. Little convincing. The director is Peter Finch's son. Sharon Stone has the (small) part of the literary agent.

title: Amor non ho! però... però
actors: Renato Rascel, Gina Lollobrigida, Luigi Pavese, Aroldo Tieri
description: Theodore is not what is said to be a winner: despite the problems with his brother who despises him, when he sees a girl, Gina, who throws herself into the river (in the Tiber) he dives to save her (and is saved). Gina is desperate: her boyfriend has been arrested for a crime she did not commit and there are those who, of this, have evidence but do not give it up. Teodoro arranges everything for the best, but ... remains empty-handed. Even at the time of this film (early 1950s) the national comic production was inflated by absolutely mediocre films. Here, if nothing else, there is the meritorious attempt to put together a show of a certain dignity.

title: Lo svitato
actors: Dario Fo, Franca Rame, Giorgia Moll, Carlo Bagno, Alberto Bonucci
description: Achille is a messenger from the editorial office of a Milanese newspaper who is mistaken for a journalist. Gigi, a swindler, decides to take advantage of Achille's ingenuity and journalistic ambitions, proposing him to steal purebred dogs, so that he can then be the first to spread the news. The theft and the possible scoop, however, go towards total failure. It is one of the rare forays into the cinema of the award-winning Fo-Rame company, here very young. Of course, the two work better in the theater, but the versatility of Fo's interpretation is not disputed, not even in this attempt at journalistic satire directed by Lizzani.

title: Union Pacific
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, Joel McCrea, Robert Preston, Akim Tamiroff
description: In 1862 the construction of the railway line was started that will have to connect the Atlantic coast with the Pacific. The construction is disputed between two companies and, moreover, the operation is the subject of stock market speculation. Jeff Butler, a government agent, who has to contend with two saboteurs, is called to supervise the work. Meanwhile, Jeff falls in love with Molly, the daughter of an engineer. Together they will carry out their mission. An epic film, an adventurous and beautifully shot western. The mass scenes and the sequences of the laying of the tracks are exceptional.

title: Sognando la California
actors: Massimo Boldi, Nino Frassica, Antonello Fassari, Bo Derek, Maurizio Ferrini
description: Giovanni, Lorenzo, Tonino and Silvio celebrate fifteen years from graduation. They decide to leave for California in the hope of meeting willing girls. As soon as they arrive, they run out of money and credit cards. The four go on the road, but the adventures they promised remain in the imagination. The back room of the film allows a glimpse of the ghosts of "My friends" and "Marrakech Express" and, to be good, an intention of satire on costume. But the operation turns out to be yet another holiday prankster destined to play with the lowest expectations of an audience. Low-grade humor for one of the worst Vanzinas.

title: For the Love of My Daughter - Semi-Precious
actors: Sephanie Zimbalist, Joanna Kerns, Michael Shulman
description: She had been forced to abandon her two children. For a long time she did not show up, but now after ten years she has returned. He wants them back because he has never stopped loving them. Her ex-husband has died in the meantime, but his second wife is opposed. She too has her reasons: she raised them and now she loves them like a mother. Therefore he does not want to lose them.
notes: Another family story with dramatic implications; provided that the repetitiveness of the situations and the anonymity that characterizes the direction of these products allow us to talk about drama again. It would be better to talk about soap operas in pills, rather.

title: Backfire
actors: Karen Allen, Keith Carradine, Jeff Fahey
description: Someone has orchestrated a meticulous staging to finally get a millionaire back from Vietnam in shock out of his mind. Who pulls the strings of the cruel farce, and why? Karen Allen (the veteran's wife) and Keith Carradine, with a nice characterization of their respective characters, help to sharpen the curiosity for the solution to the end.

title: Endangered Species
actors: Robert Urich, JoBeth Williams, Paul Dooley
description: In a county in the American West, the local sheriff and a New York detective (Robert Urich) work together to discover the source of some mysterious incidents and mutilation of cattle. At the end of the investigation it turns out that in a secret laboratory, some shady businessmen are developing a genetic alteration plan.
notes: Alan Rudolph diligently directs a pretentious fantasy thriller, with a good cast in which, in addition to Robert Urich, Peter Coyote (Roman Polanski's "Bitter Moon") stands out. Partially based on real events.

title: The African Queen
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Katharine Hepburn, Robert Morley, Peter Bull
description: World War I in Africa. A rough American adventurer and an energetic North American missionary travel together, not without contrasts, on an old boat to escape the Germans, then sink a gunboat. Striking mix of comedy and adventure, with unforgettable Bogart-Hepburn duets. The great critic James Agee is co-writer, Bogart won the Oscar. The adventurous production of the film inspired the novel "White Heart Black Hunter" and the film based on it by Clint Eastwood.

title: Chief Crazy Horse
actors: Victor Mature, Suzan Ball, John Lund, Ray Danton
description: The resistance to the arrogance of the whites, the defeat and death at the hands of a traitor, the proud Crazy Horse (Mature), leader of the Lakota Indians, who was one of the major architects of Custer's defeat at the Little Big Horn. Fictional biography from the side of the Indians, competently directed by a specialist of the genre.

title: L'eau froide
actors: Virginie Ledoyen, Cyprien Fouquet, Laszlo Szabo, Jean-Pierre Darroussin
description: Both Christine's parents and Gilles' parents are divorced and the two boys cannot accept the rules of a society that, in practice, abandons them to their own painful, dramatic insecurities. Christine ends up in an institution, then escapes and joins Gilles. Together they leave for the South, spend a night together, but, in the morning, Gilles finds next to him only a blank page of notebook. Olivier Assayas, probably the most prominent personality of the young French cinema, tells his protagonists with participatory accuracy, with profound sensitivity (obtaining an admirable acting) and with great elegance of images.

title: The Chase
actors: Charlie Sheen, Kristy Swanson, Henry Rollins, Johh Mostel
description: Jack Hammond doesn't like being in prison, especially since he accidentally gets cold. He therefore manages to escape and, to escape, he takes Nathalie hostage who, in addition to being very pretty, is full of money and has a bright red BMW. Thus begins the adventure, with police and telereporter chase, towards Mexico. Spiced adventure also by the "love story" between the two "lovebirds".
notes: If the script (unfortunately due to the director himself) were not so poor, the alleged seductive faculties of Charlie Sheen would be better tolerated. As it stands, what little fun there is is involuntary.

title: L'eredità dello zio buonanima
actors: Franco Franchi, Grazia Di Marzà, Maria Bosco, Patrizia Gori
description: Franco, a modest employee with a large family, lavished hypocritical attention on his wealthy uncle Calogero who, dying, left him heir universal. But the swag is immediately cleared of heavy debts. True, there would be millions more, but they are deposited in a bank that has gone bankrupt in the meantime. Rude and bungled farce, from a comedy by Russo Giusti. Franco Franchi protagonist without Ingrassia and without brakes, is surrounded by unknown and very bewildered actors.

title: O Pioneers!
actors: Jessica Lange, David Strathairn, Tom Aldredge, Reed Diamond
description: US Midwest at the turn of the last century. A woman, Alexandra (Jessica Lange), takes over the reins of the family farm in rural Nebraska. The enterprise is not the easiest. Alexandra in fact has to face not so much the fatigue of work and the climatic elements of the region, as the resentment on the part of her brothers.
notes: The film is the adaptation of a famous novel by writer Willa Cather. It is a well-set but somewhat lifeless TV movie, all built on the presence of Jessica Lange, here at her debut in television drama.

title: 002 Operazione Luna
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Linda Sini, Ignazio Leone
description: To make the world believe that their unsuccessful space launch is perfectly successful, the Soviets send a second spacecraft to the sky with two inexperienced Italians who are the double of the Soviet astronauts. They will combine all the colors.
notes: The formula is overused: a parody of James Bond films with all the weight of the slender script on the shoulders of the two Italian comedians. Lucio Fulci has done better (especially with horror films) and this time he doesn't seem to believe it too much either. One of the protagonists is Lino Banfi, who then signed himself with his real name Pasquale Zagaria.

title: A toi de faire, mignonne
actors: Eddie Constantine, Christiane Minazzoli, Philippe Lemaire
description: Lemmy Caution is dispatched to Europe to free Whiteaker, an American scientist kidnapped by a gang of thugs. Enrico, the leader of the gang, plans to sell the scientist to the United States or, if the Americans weren't in the game, to an enemy nation. Thanks to the help of Geraldine, Whiteker's girlfriend, Lemmy defeats the gang, discovering, with a twist, the real boss.

title: Honeysuckle Rose
actors: Willie Nelson, Dyan Cannon, Amy Irving, Slim Pickens
description: A famous folk music singer pairs up on stage with his best friend's daughter. Little by little the two fall in love, but the singer's wife and the girl's father put things right.
notes: Musical-sentimental comedy set against the backdrop of the country & western scene. Singer Willie Nelson plays himself.

title: Operation Amsterdam
actors: Peter Finch, Tony Britton, Eva Bartok, Alexander Knox
description: At the outbreak of the Second World War, while the Hitlerian armies are invading Europe, some elements of the British counterintelligence are sent to Amsterdam to take and save a large quantity of diamonds in English coffers before they fall into the hands of the Germans.
notes: A curious war film, with a semi-documentary slant. Realistic and well acted with a hint of sentimentality.

title: La vie des morts
actors: Thibault de Montalembert, Emmanuelle Devos, Roch Leibovici, Marianne Denicourt
description: The relatives of a boy who has attempted suicide, Patrick (who is in a coma in the hospital) find themselves in the house of their cousin's provincial town. Living together is difficult and tense while waiting for a phone call from the hospital ... A film kept constantly on the inclined plane of emotions without falling into anger or manner. The young Desplechin (later author of "La sentinelle") already demonstrates all his talent.

title: Romper Stomper
actors: Russell Crowe, Daniel Pollock, Jacqueline McKenzie, Alex Scott
description: Hando is the leader of a gang of violent Melbourne skinheads. Racists and readers of "Mein Kampf", the members of the group unleash their hatred against the Vietnamese community of the city they call "Gooks". The fuse of the riots is triggered by the sale of a bar, a meeting place for neo-Nazis.
notes: Good first work, a sort of "A Clockwork Orange" in a punk style.

title: Switchblade Sisters
actors: Joanne Nail, Robbie Lee, Monica Gayle, Asher Brauner, Chase Newhart
description: The "Debs" are a violent gang of terrible, easy-going girls raging in their high school. When Maggie is admitted to the group, Patch, a blindfolded girl, feels threatened by the newcomer and decides to boycott her. Exploitation 70s film redistributed by Rolling Thunder, Tarantino's distribution house.

title: Pianoforte
actors: Giulia Boschi, François Siener, Giovannella Grifeo
description: Paolo, an established journalist, and Maria, a university student, are two drug addicts. The detox in the clinic seems at first to take them away from the circle. But it is only the illusion of a moment, especially for him. In fact, only Maria, thanks to the study of the piano, will be able to detach herself from drugs and return to normalcy. Comencini, here in her first work, chooses a difficult topic, but, also with the help of the screenwriter Vincenzo Cerami, she resolves it in a discreet and non-rhetorical way.

title: The Art of Love
actors: James Garner, Dick Van Dyke, Elke Sommer, Angie Dickinson
description: To make the work of a painter without a market economically interesting, he would have to die tragically. Which seems to happen, and a friend of the "dead" cynically exploits the operation. He will, however, tit for tat and will literally risk losing his head. Film of pure profession, but lively and sufficiently original.

title: The Long Day Closes
actors: Marjorie Yates, Leigh McCormack, Anthony Watson, Nicholas Lamont, Ayse Owens, Tina Malone, Jimmy Wilde, Robin Polley, Peter Ivatts, Joy Blakeman
description: Liverpool, 1950s: Bud experiences the difficult transition from childhood to adolescence. Of a solitary nature, he is marginalized by his classmates and divides his time between his passion for cinema and that for music. Above all, the songs and small shows of his mother, the dominant figure, accompany his hours until, one day, he is disturbed by a young bricklayer who winks at him. Throughout his cinema, Terence Davies has never strayed from autobiography, capable of reconstructing everyday squalor through the poetry of memory and cinema. And here, for the lonely teenager of the 1950s, it is precisely cinema that plays a fundamental role. Very refined and visionary.

title: Primo amore
actors: Carla Gravina, Lorella De Luca, Geronimo Meynier, Raf Mattioli
description: Francesca, who suffers from the separation of her parents, cannot decide between her two suitors and ends up losing them both. The Swiss Elisabetta has sworn never to fall in love with an Italian, but then she falls for Luigi, the son of a modest veterinarian. Lello falls in love with the presumptuous Andreina. Lello's friend, Enrico, of Andreina's mother. With alternating happiness of narrative touch, the different episodes run parallel or, at times, overlap. Good collective performance of the young performers, particularly a fresh Gravina.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
actors: Judit Hoag, Elias Koteas, Raymond Serra
description: The members of the Foot Club, a gang of young delinquents led by a Japanese with a masked face, sows panic among New Yorkers. Helped by Casey Jones, a young man armed with clubs, the ninja turtles intervene once again to save April, a young journalist attacked by criminals. In response, the Foot Club organizes the kidnapping of the mouse Splinter, spiritual master of the Ninja.

title: Belle époque
actors: Penélope Cruz, Miriam Díaz-Aroca, Jorge Sanz, Fernando Fernán Gómez
description: In Spain in 1931, taking advantage of the disorder following the fall of the monarchy, the young Fernando deserted from the army and was welcomed by Manolo, a painter who lived alone, becoming his friend. When Manolo's four daughters come to spend a holiday in their father's house, Fernando has, with the painter's approval, amorous adventures with all of them, before marrying one. Oscar (somewhat surprisingly) as best foreign film for a film that travels through the difficult territories of the grotesque, at times with scathing derisive effectiveness but also, at times, with a more disordered and "goliardic" rather than controlled boldness.

title: The Great White Hope
actors: James Earl Jones, Jane Alexander, Lou Gilbert
description: Jack Jefferson is the first black boxer in boxing history to take the world championship title of the heavyweight. A smear campaign starts that also leverages his love affair with a white woman. He emigrated first to Europe and then to Mexico, on the eve of the First World War. After his woman's suicide, he returns to the ring for a rigged match, but has one final surge of pride.
notes: Martin Ritt is dedicated to the reconstruction of the story of Jack Johnson, mangling the names. From a theatrical work by Howard Sackler, it is a courageous film also in the harshness of the narrative system, in which, however, you can also feel the hand of the old craftsman. Earl Jones, decades later, will become known as one of America's best character actors.

title: Merril's Marauders
actors: Jeff Chandler, Ty Hardin, Peter Brown, Andrew Duggan, Will Hutchins
description: American troops, under the command of General Merrill, fight against the Japanese in Burma. They collide victoriously with the enemy; new orders from headquarters keep them at the forefront. The soldiers are at the end of their strength, as is their commander. After a new battle sustained with heavy losses, at the first light of dawn they win the decisive battle, but Merrill, ill, dies.
notes: On a story with conventional appearances, Fuller makes a film of great ambiguity and often unsettling. And this despite the fact that he was taken away from the control over the editing and the musical commentary by frightened producers.

title: Gunman's Walk
actors: Van Heflin, Tab Hunter, James Darren, Kathryn Grant, Mickey Shaughnessy
description: Hackett is a wealthy and rude cattle rancher. Of the two children he has, Ed is the one he prefers also because, in brisk ways, he looks more like him. But, following in the footsteps of his father, the boy soon goes very far, sowing deaths. Hackett tries to reason with him, then he has to clash with him. Convincing western melodrama directed by a good "B-movies" director.

title: Il miele del diavolo
actors: Corinne Cléry, Brett Halsey, Blanca Marsillach, Stefano Madia, Paola Molina
description: Cecilia Ama Gaetano, young and transgressive saxophonist. After an accident, the man dies in the operating room and Cecilia seized Guido, the surgeon who considers responsible. He locks him in an isolated villa, chains him, submits it to humiliations and torture. Corinne Clery becomes a executioner, as a victim who was in "Histoire d'O.", in yet another, baroque proof of manipulation of the genres conducted by Fulci.

title: No, il caso è felicemente risolto
actors: Riccardo Cucciolla, Enzo Cerusico, Enrico Maria Salerno
description: While fishing by a lake, Fabio accidentally witnesses the murder of a prostitute. Pursued by the murderer, he escapes him and, a lover of quiet life, he does not report the facts. But the shrewd perpetrator of the crime goes to the police, bringing the suspicions to converge on Fabio who, seized by panic, only aggravates his position to the point of undergoing a sentence of 24 years in prison.
notes: Yellow comedy series B.

title: Land Raiders
actors: Telly Savalas, George Maharis, Arlene Dahl
description: Vicente, who moved from Mexico to the US, has become the very rich owner of Forge River, a sadistic persecutor of the Apaches. A brother of his, Pablo, joins him and unsuccessfully opposes his bloody follies and heavy methods of making money. Only the Indian nemesis will be able to stop Vicente.
notes: Drama in the shaky, Manichean spaghetti-western era, with arch-villain Telly Savalas.

title: Holy Matrimony
actors: Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Patricia Arquette, Armin Mueller-Stahl, Tate Donovan
description: Havana works in an amusement park, but her dream is Hollywood. To make it happen, he steals, with his accomplice-lover Peter, the chest of the park itself, after which the two have to hide in the religious colony where Peter's relatives live. Here they get married, but Peter dies in a trivial accident and Havana - according to biblical prescriptions - would be forced to marry his brother Zeche: a twelve-year-old child.
notes: It is curious how, in times of "politically correct", Disney produces a film full of pitfalls and falls into it with self-defeating recklessness.

title: Before Sunrise
actors: Ethan Hawke, Julie Delpy, Andrea Eckert, Hanno Pöschl
description: The Frenchwoman Céline is on the train, bound for Paris. Jesse is on the same train and must return to his country, the United States. A look, a few words, and it is immediately feeling. So Jesse convinces Céline to stop for a few hours in Vienna. Almost nothing happens, but it is as if everything happens: dialogues, silences, glimpses of the city, encounters, fill the evening and the night. Then, everyone goes back to their own path. It was not an easy bet (especially in the current vulgar times): a film made of very little (at least apparently), which said (even when not talking) many small and big things. The two actors are excellent, the affectation is not excessive.

title: Hostile Advances: the Kerry Ellison Story
actors: Rena Sofer, Victor Garber, Karen Allen, Maria Ricossa, Réal Andrews
description: Kerry Ellison, a young and rampant professional, is just a few steps away from deserved promotion in the company where she works. The tension in the office, however, suddenly rises as a colleague of hers begins to torment her with insistent advances. Faced with the constant and obsessive offers of man, Kerry, after a failed help from an internal commission, turns to the judges. As often happens in these TV movies, the film is inspired by a real event, one of the most controversial cases of sexual harassment at work in the United States. Good for debates, and nothing more.

title: Le baccanti
actors: Taina Elg, Alberto Lupo, Akim Tamiroff, Pierre Brice, Alessandra Panaro
description: To appease the wrath of Minerva, who dried the wells of Thebes, the king of the city Pentheus decides to make a human sacrifice. The choice falls on Manto, the young daughter of the blind soothsayer Tiresias: but Dionysus, pitying, intervenes in person and saves the girl. Meanwhile, Pentheus learns that the young servant Lacdamo, who loves Manto, is designated by a prophecy to become king. Penteo does not resign and orders the guards to arrest him, but fate must be fulfilled ...
notes: Harmless mythological film, inspired by the homonymous tragedy of Euripides, with Tamiroff in the role of Tiresias. In the cast also the great Alberto Lupo and Alessandra Panaro.

title: I due compari
actors: Aldo Fabrizi, Peppino De Filippo, Giulia Rubini, Carlo Ninchi
description: Giovanni Bettini (Fabrizi) is a peddler of fountain pens and has a partner. He is a widower and his only daughter, Juliet, attended schools in an exclusive boarding school. In fact, the girl believes that her father is an important and wealthy businessman. Juliet is in love with Enrico, the son of the industrialist Carletti but, when she discovers the truth about her father, she breaks the engagement. In the end, however, everything works out for the best. The film attempts to revive the Fabrizi-De Filippo couple with a subject by Fabrizi himself. It works as long as it stays on the comic register, a little less when it throws it on the pathetic.

title: Totò e Marcellino
actors: Totò, Pablito Calvo, Fanfulla, Jone Salinas, Memmo Carotenuto
description: Totò, caught stealing, gets confused among the participants in the funeral of Marcellino's mother and is mistaken for the uncle of the child. Marcellino becomes attached to this alleged relative of his, but here comes a real uncle, the shady Alvaro, exploiter of children. In this way, the little Spaniard Pablito Calvo "pays" for the immense fame he acquired with "Marcellino pane e vino". For (too) good souls with an adequate supply of handkerchiefs. Even Totò's curtains do not do justice to the prince of laughter.

title: The Golden Salamander
actors: Trevor Howard, Anouk Aimée, Herbert Lom, Jacques Sernas
description: An English archaeologist, David, in Tunisia on behalf of a company in his country, has the task of recovering crates containing precious ancient finds. On his way to a village he comes across two arms dealers by chance. One of these - Max, brother of Anna, the woman David is in love with - on the advice of the archaeologist tries to flee to France, but his accomplices reach him and kill him. Neame was one of the most prolific British directors from the 1940s onwards. Despite the actors, the film doesn't take off and, in the end, it turns out to be boring.

title: Mondo cane
directors: Gualtiero Jacopetti, Franco Prosperi, Paolo Cavara
description: Starting from the inauguration of the monument to Rudolph Valentino in Castellaneta, passing through the report of pearl fishing and a series of animal killings, the film is nothing more than the reportage of curious and above all horrifying events, unearthed in various nations of our planet. . It was the first of a successful series of sensationalist documentaries in the 1960s. Bad taste. Famous soundtrack by Riz Ortolani.

title: Rosebud
actors: Peter O'Toole, Richard Attenborough, Cliff Gorman, Claude Dauphin
description: Sabine, the granddaughter of a very wealthy Jewish industrialist, invites four friends for a vacation on the "Rosebud" yacht, but a "Black September" commando kidnaps the women to draw public attention to the plight of Palestinians detained in Israel and on the trades of some speculators, including the owner of the yacht. A CIA agent, posing as a journalist, manages to get on the yacht.
notes: Rosebud, a mythical word for cinephiles (it is Orson Welles' sled in "Fourth Power"), is debased as the owner of a film where lack of script and narrative dispersions shine. One of the many thuds of Prmeinger as an old man.

title: Love Has Many Faces
actors: Lana Turner, Cliff Robertson, Hugh O'Brian, Ruth Roman, Stefanie Powers
description: On the beach of Acapulco lies the corpse of Billy, a "beach boy" who lived at the expense of solitary and wealthy tourists. Police investigations lead to a Yankee couple on vacation on the spot. The marriage between the spouses is in crisis and things are further complicated when the fiancée of the deceased and then a professional seducer come into play. The case will find the solution only in extremis. Custom built for a dying diva (Turner), the film sports pretentious dialogue but has little emotional appeal. Local color is used as a filler.

title: The Eagle and the Hawk
actors: John Payne, Rhonda Fleming, Dennis O'Keefe
description: During the Mexican War of Independence, in the 19th century, Captain Randolph investigates the disappearance of Captain Bruce, which took place in the middle of a mission. Thus he comes across a Swiss adventurer in the pay of the French.

title: Crying Freeman
actors: Mark Dacascos, Julie Condra, Masaya Kato, Rae Dawn Chong
description: Emu O'Hara accidentally witnessed the murder of a Chinese boss in San Francisco. The killer, a rather handsome and handsome young man, cried as he killed his victim, and even revealed his name, Yo. Now, according to an Asian tradition, when a killer tells a witness his name, then he will kill him. Emu flees to Vancouver, but is obsessed with the memory of Yo, which terrifies and fascinates her. She meets him again, when again she witnesses one of his execution. By now Emu is fully involved in the story of Yo, the crying killer, of whom she becomes the lover. From a famous manga comic of the 80s, an elegant and original "kung fu-movie" that winks at various precedents: from Bruce Lee to Tarantino, passing through John Woo and "The Crow". Mark Dacascos, the "Crying freeeman", has Chinese, Irish, Spanish and Japanese blood in his veins. In addition, he is champion of six combat practices.

title: La bruttina stagionata
actors: Carla Signoris, Edi Angelillo, Fabrizio Gifuni, Isabella Biagini
description: Marilina is on the threshold of forty, and one cannot say very satisfied: she is a spinster, sloppy, repressed at home and at work. The meeting with a gigolo begins to stir something in her: with Berto she sets up, secretly, a relationship based on sex. Then it's the turn of Jan, the manager of a porn shop, whose friendship further helps her in the emancipation process. Until Nicky arrives: handsome, rich, distinguished. The journey from spinster to man eater was a sales champion thanks to the pen of Carmen Covito. The action moved from Milan to Padua. The actors are good, but it's the script that limps: comedy doesn't have the courage to push on the accelerator to overcome genre stereotypes. Excessive do-goodness affects the result.

title: The Babysitter
actors: Alicia Silverstone, Jeremy London, Nicky Katt, J.T. Walsh
description: It's Friday night and the babysitter arrives at the Tuckers' house. She is a very beautiful girl, and immediately the head of the family makes advances to her. Then the husband and wife go out to a party and the girl stays at home with the children. Meanwhile, in a bar in the town, they meet Jack, the babysitter's boyfriend, and Mark, a bad guy who begins to provoke him by insinuating that he was having an affair with the girl. Jack becomes inflamed with jealousy and goes to the Tuckers' house to check on his girlfriend. Mark follows him and continues to cheer him on.
notes: Other than thriller! There is not a minimum of suspense or emotion. A real scam, which starts with the title. If the emotion is on the run, then the eroticism is even below zero. Even the most avid fans of the handsome Silverstone will be disappointed. A botched and silly story, an inconclusive script, and ridiculous acting create the painful mix.

title: I briganti italiani
actors: Ernest Borgnine, Vittorio Gassman, Rosanna Schiaffino
description: A Neapolitan brigand, in the service of King Francesco II, wants to hand himself over to the Piedmontese, now masters of the former Kingdom of the Two Sicilies. Having learned this, the nobles who maneuver him decide to eliminate him.
notes: Cinematographically correct, but with little historical depth. Based on the novel of the same name by Mario Monti.

title: Mondo cane n. 2
description: A collection of horrors assembled around the world to create disgust (and, less nobly, to vellify the sadism of viewers interested in the genre). Among other things you can see dogs operated on the vocal cords, men made sterile by crocodile meat, children made deformed to pity, monks who are burned alive, birds killed at sea by oil spilled from ships and other similar things. With less bite than "number 1", a substantially cynical and cynically commercial operation.

title: My Girl 2
actors: Anna Chlumsky, Dan Aykroyd, Jamie Lee Curtis, Austin O'Brien
description: Leda, a thirteen-year-old girl, left behind her father and stepmother, travels from Pennsylvania to Los Angeles to find information on the life of her mother, who died shortly after her birth and about whom her father has always been very reticent. In California, together with his cousin Nick, he tries to reconstruct the personality of the deceased.
notes: It is the sequel to "Dad I found a friend", obviously without Macaulay Culkin, who died in the previous film from bee stings. Unbearably sugary.

title: Al di là delle nuvole
actors: John Malkovich, Fanny Ardant, Kim Rossi Stuart, Irène Jacob, Ines Sastre, Peter Weller, Chiara Caselli, Sophie Marceau, Vincent Perez, Jean Reno, Marcello Mastroianni, Jeanne Moreau, Enrica Antonioni, Carine Angeli, Alessandro Bonarotta
description: A decisive failure to approach in a guest house in the Ferrara area. In Portofino a director spends the night with a girl who will later confess to him that she killed her own father. Paris: Patrizia fails to win back her husband who is cheating on her and establishes a relationship with a man abandoned by his wife. Aix-en-Provence: a young woman has a nagging suitor, but she is about to enter the convent.
notes: Over ten years of silence for Antonioni, then this direction with the collaboration of Wim Wenders. An upward trend, from the first episode (almost ridiculous) to the last (very intense). Beautiful images, but too often inaudible dialogues. A partially missed opportunity. Sin.

title: Dolores Claiborne
actors: Kathy Bates, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Christopher Plummer, David Strathairn
description: Dolores Claiborne (Kathy Bates) has worked as a housekeeper for the aristocrat Vera Donovan for twenty-two years. The rich lady is fussy and always ready to make life impossible for poor Dolores, but one day she dies and the maid is naturally accused of her death, from whose past, among other things, the never-clear mystery of her husband's death re-emerges. Her daughter Selena also returns and, together with her, Dolores will remember the darkest chapters of her life.
notes: "The Last Eclipse", based on a story by Stephen King, is a beautiful thriller played on flashbacks and memories and masterfully interpreted by the two protagonists.

title: The River Wild
actors: Meryl Streep, Kevin Bacon, David Strathairn
description: Gail lives in Boston: a beautiful house, an architect husband, two children and a dog, but she was born in the territories of the Wild West. It is there that he returns to spend a few days of vacation practicing his favorite sport, rafting, that is the descent of the rapids of a river on a rubber dinghy. It goes without saying that the trip, when I took on board two young boys who turn out to be runaway robbers, soon turns into a nightmare.
notes: Embroidered around the strong figure of the mother played by Meryl Streep, the film is a hallucinatory journey into a wild nature that is the mirror of that, equally wild, of men. The Streep dominates everyone for strength, courage and intensity of the looks: they are the ones that are remembered at the end of the film.

title: Wolf
actors: Jack Nicholson, Michelle Pfeiffer, James Spader, Christopher Plummer
description: Will Randall is the powerful editor of a publishing house. A young and ambitious colleague is trying (successfully) to steal his job. One evening Will runs over a wolf who bites him. From that day on, his senses became more acute and his body found an extraordinary energy (also to beat the cheating colleague). Will has turned into a werewolf. Man is a beast and the city (and the workplace) of the woods worse than those where animals live.
notes: "Wolf" is a reflection turned into gothic horror on the feral nature of man and on love which is perhaps his only antidote. Nicholson, more sly than ever, lets out a few empty jokes. Pfeiffer is always beautiful.

title: Enchanted April
actors: Josie Lawrence, Miranda Richardson, Joan Plowright
description: London, 1920s. Lottie Wilkins' life goes by under the banner of depression. Every day the monotony is interrupted only by the evening complaints of her husband, always ready to check the bills and household expenses. So, when with her friend Rose, Lottie reads the announcement of a happy holiday in a small Italian castle in the Times, the decision to escape is immediate. The two women will find themselves spending an enchanting April in Portofino that will change the course of their lives.
notes: The boredom of the British upper class, the holiday in Italy: Richardson's interpretation is not enough to distract the film from the weight of clichés. A draft of the Ivory films.

title: Underground Father
actors: Chris Noth, Peter Mac Nicol, Nathalie Cole, Loryn Locklin
description: Larry Coster has noticed that his wife Andrea, from whom he has just separated, is mistreating their daughter, Jessica. Having obtained nothing from the police and social workers to whom he turned, he decides to kidnap the little girl and, through a clandestine organization, obtains a new identity. Arrested, he is accused of kidnapping. Will her lawyer, Lorenza Gaines, be able to prove her innocence? This TV movie is part of the "Donne al bivio" series. As in the other films intended for this purpose, detective and family misadventures are mixed. As in the others, the result is at least mediocre.

title: The Cable Guy
actors: Jim Carrey, Matthew Broderick, Leslie Mann, Amy Stiller
description: It is common practice to give the "cable man" an extra tip to install all encrypted TV channels for free. But when Steven makes the gesture to extend the classic $ 50, the technician reacts strangely. When Steven realizes the danger it is too late: now the cable man will begin to destroy his life.
notes: The real insanity of this film lies in the contract obtained by Carrey: 20 million dollars to lend his famous rubber face to a film in which there is very little laugh. A gloomy satire on a face of America not too far from the truth: the face of those who live attached to television. The ideas were discreet, but the realization is of a low level: the result is an indecisive and embarrassing film.

title: The Stupids
actors: Tom Arnold, Jessica Lundy, Alex McKenna, Bug Hall, Mark Metcalf
description: Stanley and Joan Stupid live with their little children Buster and Petunia. They sleep with their feet on the pillow, read the rolled-up newspaper, iron the bacon slices, Stanley puts shaving cream on his back and then shaves with an electric razor, Buster says he's shrinking because, placed next to a seedling, this gets higher and higher.
notes: Landis, king of the demented, this time disappoints: there is no trace of the irreverent genius of films like "Animal House". Here the Stupids are really stupid, the jokes are obvious, the gags are predictable.

title: Gli infermieri della mutua
actors: Pino Caruso, Alida Chelli, Peppino De Filippo, Bice Valori, Maurizio Arena, Isabella Biagini, Rossano Brazzi
description: Dr. Berselli's office is the center of a lucrative trafficking of patients and false prescriptions. Doctor Venanzi, having discovered the traffic, denounces it, but everything will be as before. Farce cloned on the success of the "health care physician" with Sordi.

title: Elmer Gantry
actors: Burt Lancaster, Jean Simmons, Dean Jagger, Shirley Jones
description: Elmer Gentry (Lancaster) is a salesman who joins the mission of the "revivalists" because he is in love with the apostle of the movement, Sister Sharon (Simmons). Problems arise when a girl, loved and abandoned by the man a few years earlier, blackmails Gentry with some compromising photos. The scandal ends up involving the mission itself. Gentry manages to rehabilitate his position, but the whole affair ends up compromising his relationship with Sharon.
notes: Based on a novel by Sinclair Lewis, Richard Brook's film is a tense, controversial and exasperated melodrama that delves into the moralist province of America and gives a non-superficial portrait of religious sects in the age of the mass media. Excellent interpretation of Burt Lancaster (awarded with the Oscar), Jean Simmons and Shirley Jones (Oscar for her too).

title: The Scarlet Pimpernel
actors: Leslie Howard, Merle Oberon, Raymond Massey, Nigel Bruce
description: During the years of the French Revolution, the Red Primrose helps aristocrats escape the guillotine. The French ambassador to London, Chauvellin, is convinced that he has identified the true identity of the king's dangerous partisan in Sir Percy and has also guessed right. But he did the math without the cunning of our hero and without the love that unites him with his wife, devoted even if a little chatty.
notes: A classic of adventure films set in the golden period (for cinema) of the French Revolution. Splendid scenes and costumes, horses, swords always ready for a duel: reactionary as long as you want, but always fascinating.

title: Man in the Moon
actors: Kenneth Moore, Shirley Ann Field, Michael Hordern
description: An astronautical research center is desperate for men to train for the launch of a human being to the moon. A certain William is chosen and immediately undergoes a training course. Finally the big day arrives. Scientists make the final complicated calculations and the rocket, with William aboard, is launched. But the experiment fails and William lands not far from the research center. Just in time to prevent another man from being thrown into space. A dated English comedy, which oscillates between mild satire and grotesque farce. This does not detract from the story a certain liveliness and a certain taste: thanks above all to a well-calibrated screenplay.

title: Nez de cuir
actors: Jean Marais, Françoise Christophe, Mariella Lotti, Jean Debucourt
description: Count Roger de Tachebray had his face disfigured and his nose removed by a sword he received during a battle. Only the care of a doctor friend can save him from certain death. The count thus resumes, with a leather mask that covers part of his face (hence his nickname) his life as an unrepentant libertine, until he falls in love with the only woman who rejects him. Based on the novel by Jean de La Varende, the film stages a mysterious and imperious passion. A dramatic film, which gladly slips into sentimental and adventurous, magnificently interpreted by Jean Marais.

title: Lost Command
actors: Claudia Cardinale, Anthony Quinn, Alain Delon, George Segal, Michèle Morgan, Maurice Ronet
description: After the battle of Dien Bien Phu, which sanctioned the abandonment of Indochina by France, Colonel Raspeguy commands the 10th regiment of French paratroopers in Algiers. He thus finds himself in the midst of another fierce war in which every means is used to gain an advantage over the enemy and where not even women are spared. And there is a young captain who is disgusted by it.
notes: It is on the spectacularity of the narration that the film plays its cards. Big-name actors of different nationalities (there is also Claudia Cardinale) gathered in a production with an impressive budget.

title: The Comfort of Strangers
actors: Natasha Richardson, Rupert Everett, Christopher Walken, Helen Mirren
description: Colin, a journalist, and Mary, an actress, are two young English lovers on vacation in Venice to decide their future. In fact, Mary already has two children, but the man is not yet ready for a lasting relationship. One evening they meet Robert, a charming man married to Caroline, who, after seducing young people with his charm, invites them to stay in his beautiful palace in the streets.
notes: From a novel by Ian McEwan, Schrader sets up an exercise of great elegance and alarming eroticism. A bitter reinterpretation of the classic disorientation of the British traveler in Italy.

title: Der Amerikanische Soldat
actors: Karl Scheydt, Elga Sorbas, Hark Böhm, Margarethe Von Trotta, Rainer Werner Fassbinder
description: Ricky, an American killer, a veteran of the dirty Vietnam War, born in Munich and just released from prison, is hired by three policemen to kill some people considered uncomfortable. It is in this period that the man finds his old friend Franz and ends up falling in love with Rosa, the girlfriend of one of the policemen.
notes: Godardian noir. Some events remain suspended and not fully explained and there is also space to tell the plot of future works (this is the case of Von Trotta which tells the subject of "Fear eats the soul"). Gorgeous black and white.

title: Der Händler der vier Jahreszeiten
actors: Hans Hirschmüller, Hanna Schygulla, Irm Hermann, Ingrid Caven
description: Hans had joined the Foreign Legion to escape the protection of his mother. Back in Germany from a wife who does not love him and who has asked for a divorce, he collides with the harshness of reality and starts selling fruit in the courtyards of the houses. One of Fassbinder's first major films; a merciless analysis of the relations between the sexes in bourgeois society.

title: Die bitteren Tränen der Petra von Kant
actors: Margit Carstensen, Hanna Schygulla, Irm Hermann, Eva Mattes
description: Petra Von Kant, a stylist from Bremen widowed by her first husband and separated from her second, falls in love with Karin, who is ten years younger. Petra is possessive in her love, while Karin wants to keep her independence and just take advantage of the situation. Sadomasochistic and claustrophobic melodrama, based on a play written by the director himself, is a chilling exposing of power relations disguised as erotic relationships. Morbid, austere, one of Fassbinder's best films.

title: Deutschland im Herbst
directors: Alexander Kluge, Volker Schlöndorff, Rainer Werner Fassbinder, Alf Brustellin, Bernhard Sinkel, Katja Rupé, Hans Peter Cloos, Edgar Reitz, Maximiliane Mainka, Peter Schubert
actors: Rainer Werner Fassbinder, Mario Adorf, Wolf Biermann, Vadim Glowna
description: Montage film, between fiction and documentary, which involves some important German directors of the seventies. It starts from the funeral of Schleyer, assassinated by the RAF (the German Red Brigades), to Fassbinder's relationship with his partner, to documents on anti-Nazism (episode of Klüge), up to the television censorship of Böll's "Antigone (Schlöndorff).

title: In einem Jahr mit 13 Monden
actors: Volker Spengler, Ingrid Caven, Gottfried John, Elisabeth Tissenaar
description: Elvira, a transsexual, gave an interview to a newspaper to tell about her experience. Beaten to death by a group of thugs, also abandoned by her partner, Christopher, she finds comfort and friendship in Zora, a prostitute.
notes: The film was shot in just 25 days and is inspired by the suicide of Armin Meier, Fassbinder's lover. The title refers to the belief that a year with 13 moons is bad for sensitive people.

title: Wild at Heart
actors: Nicolas Cage, Willem Dafoe, Laura Dern, Diane Ladd, Harry Dean Stanton, Isabella Rossellini
description: Sailor Ripley, on probation, falls in love with Lula Pace, a crazy girl always in the throes of nightmares due to a rape suffered in adolescence. Passion is born between the two. They decide to leave for Texas, where Sailor hopes to escape justice. But Lula's mother, rejected by Sailor to whom she offered herself, unleashes two killers, her former lovers, on the heels of the young people. From motel to motel, Sailor and Lula begin to run out of cash ... Palme d'Or at the 1990 Cannes Film Festival. references to the "Wizard of Oz"), an observation of the infantile state of the American imagination. From a novel by Barry Gifford.

title: The Pathfinder
actors: George Montgomery, Helena Carter
description: We are in North America, in 1754. "Pathfinder" is a frontier man who keeps himself out of the colonial war that rages between the British and the French until he discovers that the latter instigate the Indians to fight alongside them. So he decides to offer himself to the French as a guide, but to work for the British flag. With a woman who acts as his interpreter, he will fulfill the mission and save his skin.
notes: Classic B-series product in the era of studio heyday.

title: The Rape of Richard Beck
actors: Meredith Baxter-Birney, Richard Crenna, Pat Hingle, Frances Lee McCain
description: Richard Beck is the typical cop who looks macho. Passion for women, but no esteem for the fairer sex, considered a hunting ground. Richard is so convinced of his own ideas that he is even cynical of women who are victims of sexual assault. Fate, however, is lurking: in fact, fate wants Richard to completely review his position when he himself is raped by a couple of brutes.
notes: The cop struck by the nemesis is played with sensitivity by Richard Crenna, who was awarded the Emmy award for this test.

title: Kiss of Death
actors: David Caruso, Samuel L. Jackson, Nicolas Cage, Helen Hunt
description: After a long time in jail, Jimmy has decided to go straight. But he can't say no to a cousin who needs an accomplice for a stroke and thus ends up in prison again. Jimmy does not betray his accomplices, at least until his wife dies and he finds out that she was betraying him. Then he talks and gets reinstated as an informant in the gang.
notes: It is the remake of Henry Hathaway's 1947 film of the same name and it would only be a mediocre job were it not for Nicolas Cage who, in the role that was Richard Widmark, gives the worst of his histrionics. Photography is by Luciano Tovoli.

title: Little Odessa
actors: Tim Roth, Edward Furlong, Vanessa Redgrave, Maximilian Schell
description: Joshua Shapira, a killer by profession, returns to Little Odessa, a neighborhood of Russian immigrants in Brighton Beach, Long Island, where he was born, for a "clean job". His father forbids him to set foot in the house, where his mother is dying and his younger brother, Reuben, dotes on him. Joshua wants to do the job that night, but his dad "sells" it to the neighborhood boss. Only the people he loves will pay. First film by director James Gray, the film features an excellent Tim Roth in the lead role and big names (Schell, Redgrave) in the minor ones. But it re-proposes atmospheres, characters and patterns already known, with little originality.

title: Nattevagten
actors: Nikolaj Coster-Waldau, Sofie Graaboel, Kim Bodnia, LotteAndresen
description: Martin is studying law and wants to support himself without asking for money at home. What better, then, than a workplace that is almost a sinecure: night watchman in a hospital, with a morgue attached? But Martin did not take into account two things: that there is a serial killer in circulation and that the police inspector dealing with the "case" may be suspicious of him. Danish film, directed by a newcomer with experiences on TV. A big success in his homeland and, in Italy, the first prize at the Fantafestival. Good settings, but the script (by the director himself) is not a prodigy of consistency and solidity.

title: Rough Magic
actors: Bridget Fonda, Russell Crowe, Jim Broadbent, D.W. Moffett
description: Cliff Wyatt killed the wizard Myra was an assistant to. Knowing that she is the target of the murderer, the girl flees to Mexico, in search of Tojola, her spiritual sister. Here he meets Alex. Tojola makes Myra drink an elixir that gives her magiri powers, falls in love with Alex but becomes cold and merciless when she discovers that the man has been chased by Cliff. A series of twists and turns, and Myra retraces her steps ... Inspired by a novel by James Hadley Chase, the third film by Clare Peploe (ex-partner of Michelangelo Antonioni, wife of Bernardo Bertolucci) juggles between drama, comedy, fairy tale and romance. But Bridget Fonda is worth seeing.

title: Hour of the Gun
actors: James Garner, Jason Robards, Robert Ryan, Larry Gates
description: In Tombstone, Sheriff Wyatt Earp battles Clanton, a cattle dealer. His two brothers, Virgil and Morgan, and his friend Doc Holliday join him in the enterprise. Clanton is defeated in a duel and, in revenge, treacherously kills Earp's two brothers. Doc Holliday tries to convince his friend to give up revenge, but Earp does not stop even in the face of the danger posed by the number of men in the pay of Clanton: he forms a group of gunslingers and faces his rival in a deadly match at the Ok Corrall.
notes: Yet another version of the duel that really took place and several times subject of westerns.

title: Le schiave di Cartagine
actors: Gianna Maria Canale, Jorge Mistral, Marisa Allasio, Luisa Peluffo
description: Giulia Marzia is jealous of the love between the tribune Marco Valerio and a Carthaginian slave, Lea. A series of political intrigues leads to the indictment of Christians for the murder of the proconsul (killed by Flavio Metello): Lea and Marco are imprisoned. But Marco's friends free him and prevent the massacre. Lea and Marco get married. Historical reconstruction and sentimentality intertwine in the adventurous story.

title: The Wild Country
actors: Frank de Kova, Steve Forrest, Vera Miles, Ronny Howard, Jack Elam
description: After leaving their hometown Pittsburg, the Tanners settle on a dilapidated ranch in Kelly Wyo, Wyoming. With great tenacity they rebuild the house and work the land. Everyone in the house gets busy: dad Jim and mom Kate, but also sons Virgil and Andy, although still very young, give their precious help. Nature and men, however, hinder them and, after a period of drought, they collide with a neighbor who, with a dam, has blocked the flow of water to their lands.
notes: Classic western by Disney.

title: Bedlam
actors: Boris Karloff, Anna Lee, Billy House, Richard Fraser, Glen Vernon
description: In 1760 the Bedlam asylum is placed under the leadership of the sadist Sims. The latter enjoys organizing shows whose protagonists are the patients of the clinic. Nell Bowen would like to denounce it publicly, but thanks to her intrigues, Sims manages to get her banned and interned like crazy. But the sick, struck by Nell's natural grace, rebel against Sims and even end up killing him. Inspired by the tables of Hogart, a film that releases a visionary horror, interpreted with great intensity by a masterful Karloff.

title: Laws of Gravity
actors: Perer Greene, Edie Falco, Adam Trese
description: Jimmy and Jon are a pair of Brooklyn's thief. Jimmy, who is happily married to Denise, leads him quite quietly on him on behalf of Tommy, a receiver, while Jon always has the police on the heels. One day Frankie, an old acquaintance, presents himself with a car full of pistols. Jimmy and Jon decide to get into business with the man and help him sell the stolen goods. Gomez is a young New York filmmaker, among the most promising American directors outside of Hollywood. This film, shot with a reduced budget and marked by a convincing urban realism, is his first work of good narrative impact.

title: Il cappotto di Astrakan
actors: Johnny Dorelli, Andréa Ferréol, Carole Bouquet, Marcel Bozzuffi
description: Piero (Dorelli), on a visit to Paris, is involved in a sentimental adventure with two charming Frenchmen. The merit, however, is solely due to her extraordinary resemblance to Maurice, the "tough" (now in jail) husband of one and lover of the other. The gangster's return to freedom, however, seems to put an end to Piero's adventure. Compared to the novel by Piero Chiara from which it is based, the film by Marco Vicario is more bluntly farcical.

title: Mondo Candido
actors: Christopher Brown, Michelle Miller, Gianfranco D'Angelo, Alessandro Haber
description: In a Westphalian castle, after having assimilated the irreducibly optimistic sentences of Doctor Pangloss and after having attacked the virtue of Cunegonde and having therefore been expelled, Candido accompanied by the faithful black servant Cacambo, starting from the eighteenth century, crosses the centuries and continents, running into assorted atrocities everywhere, but always fed on a stubborn, absurd optimism.
notes: Voltaire revisited by Jacopetti and Franco Prosperi is saying something. The two offer us a film full of empty formalism and cynical indifference, just like in the previous "Mondo cane". In the cast incredibly emerge the names of Gianfranco D'Angelo and Alessandro Haber.

title: Magnificent Obsession
actors: Jane Wyman, Rock Hudson, Barbara Rush, Otto Kruger, Agnes Moorehead
description: Bob Merrick is a bored young millionaire. Hospitalized after an accident, he indirectly causes the death of a doctor. This makes him think. He then tries to be forgiven by the doctor's widow and, of course, ends up falling madly in love with her. Having become a surgeon himself, when the woman is in danger he will save her life and restore her sight with a risky operation.
notes: Douglas Sirk's flamboyant mélo masterpiece immediately became a cult film. The narrative cue is a pure pretext for the director who adopts his "extreme" narrative and aesthetic choices.

title: Anguish
actors: Zelda Rubinstein, Michael Lerner, Talia Paul, Àngel Jové
description: A horror movie is being shown in a cinema: a young nurse, mesmerized by an eye-collecting mother / monster, works for her. A maniac imitator of the protagonist of the film is at work in the hall's toilets. Discovered by two girls, the maniac is then killed by the police, while the insane nurse continues his work in the audience of a cinema: is it fiction or reality? A metacinematographic Bigas Luna, playing with mirrors, skilfully using parallel editing and the soundtrack. Dizzying example of contagion between screen and room: a sort of horror and perfidious version of "The purple rose of Cairo".

title: Camelot
actors: Richard Harris, Vanessa Redgrave, Franco Nero, David Hemmings
description: King Arthur leads his young wife Guinevere to the castle of Camelot where he reunites the most famous knights. Lancelot arrives and falls in love with the queen in return. After the informing of the perfidious Mordred, Ginevra is condemned to the stake. Lancelot saves her, but she chooses the convent. Despite the success of the "musical" from which it is based, this transposition is only good at times.

title: Pacco, doppio pacco e contropaccotto
actors: Leo Gullotta, Alessandro Haber, Marina Confalone, Angela Luce, Gigi Savoia
description: Ten episodes that have the scam as their theme. There is the fake blind, the swindler of the taxman, an extortion against an extortionist, a ghost who evicts the illegal tenant, a janitor who buys the apartment against the gamblers he works for, a trip on a ship without an engine, a teacher tricked with the help of a prostitute, a scammer who "examines" a scammer and so on.
notes: Nanni Loy's cinema has known much better times; like our country that Loy tries to photograph by choosing the grotesque angle of deformation and the consolidated and somewhat stale Neapolitan art of "getting by".

title: Renaissance Man
actors: Danny DeVito, Cliff Robertson, James Remar, Stacey Dash
description: After losing his job at an advertising agency, Billy Rago finds a job as an English teacher in a barracks. He thus finds himself dealing with a class of "students" not really used to handling books and even less willing to do so. But Billy has an idea: dust off Hamlet. A first mixed idea that was prohibitive but then a winning one, judging by the results that ensue. Penny Marshall is that of "Big" with Tom Hanks. Here is De Vito, and so far it's fine, but overall the film isn't very brilliant. The final picture of the barracks as a big family where the best is always possible is too dull.

title: The Nevadan
actors: Randolph Scott, Dorothy Malone, Forrest Tucker
description: A robber is imprisoned and then released to allow a sheriff to follow him and discover the gold hoard he has hidden. The plan, adventurously, succeeds, with the help of a determined girl. Solid traditional western by the versatile long-time director of "Sympathetic Canaglie" and "L'urlo dei comanches".

title: The JFK Assassination: the Jim Garrison Tapes
actors: Jim Garrison
description: History of the investigation into the assassination of President Kennedy conducted by the New Orleans Attorney Jim Garrison, which resulted in the only trial ever brought on the matter. Interviews with Garrison and other characters. Among the period films, the now famous shot of Zapruder on which the prosecutor relied to refute the thesis of the lone shooter. An excellent and compelling work of documentation.

title: Roadhouse 66
actors: Willem Dafoe, Judge Reinhold, Kaaren Lee, Stephen Elliott
description: Due to a car breakdown, a yuppie (Judge Reinhold) gets stuck in a remote New Mexico town where life is very different from the world he comes from. Naturally the young man immediately goes into crisis. Luckily there is a tough guy who knows life (Willem Dafoe) willing to give him a hand. Some length and an often over the top Dafoe, a year before the "Live and Die in Los Angeles" exploit.

title: Old Boyfriends
actors: Talia Shire, Richard Jordan, John Belushi
description: A woman who has suffered a serious psychological crack after divorce goes in search of the men in her life to try to understand the source of her unhappiness. Empathic psychological-sentimental journey, with some acute directorial notation, written by Paul Schrader with his brother Leonard. In the cast, alongside the protagonist Talia Shire ("Rocky"), John Belushi is wasted.

title: China Moon
actors: Ed Harris, Madeleine Stowe, Benicio Del Toro, Charles Dance
description: We are in a small town in Florida. Kyle, a homicide detective, falls in love with the beautiful Rachel, married to a wealthy banker. When the woman kills her husband, Kyle takes steps to protect her. But as soon as the clues lead to him, he begins to suspect he is the victim of a plot by Rachel to frame him. Detective Dickey will be the one to solve the case. Classic noir classic structure, all centered on the ambiguity of a "femme fatale". Nothing new, but the director gets along more than discreetly, aided by the cast which includes, in addition to Stowe, Benicio Del Toro.

title: Cops and Robbersons
actors: Chevy Chase, Jack Palance, Dianne Wiest, Robert Davi
description: Jake Stone, a tough and cynical cop settles down with a young colleague in the Robberson family in order to get a hold of a criminal who lives next door. Apart from Mr. Robberson, a fanatic of the crime series on TV, the other members of the family are not at all enthusiastic about the situation. The script is weak and no one seems to commit. Not the director, and not even the performers. The final outcome is miserable.

title: Stesso sangue
actors: Daniele Nuccetelli, Alessandra Monti, Rick Hutton
description: After the death of their parents and to escape a forced and inevitable separation, Bruno, twenty-four, and his sister Irene, fourteen, flee the city. The two orphans live wandering and committing petty thefts and robberies, almost for fun. The agreement between the two is not perfect, because there are those who would like to go back. But the game will still become more and more serious and will lead to their death. A small example of independent and courageous Italian cinema. The structure is that of the road movie (the place crossed in this case is Molise), but the directors focus above all on the humanity of the characters, lingering on their faces.

title: Storia d'amore
actors: Blas Roca Rey, Valeria Golino, Livio Panieri, Luigi Diberti
description: Nineteen-year-old Bruna, who lives with her father and two brothers in the Roman suburbs, does the cleaning in the offices of the center: she gets up at 3 am to be at work, between one bus and another, at nine. When he meets Sergio, he is immediately love, but the boy leaves when Bruna gets together with the very young Mario. A bit of serenity, then Sergio returns, and for Bruna the situation becomes unbearable. Elegant in its iconographic style, the film, however, appears rather artificial in terms of sociological ambitions. Presented in Venice, the film obtained the special jury prize, while Golino was awarded the prize for best actress.

title: La maschera
actors: Michael Maloney, Helena Bonham Carter, Roberto Herlitzka, Feodor Chaliapin
description: The noble Leonardo wastes his existence between play and drunkenness. During the performance of a theater company in the park of his villa (we are in the eighteenth century, not far from Venice), he falls in love with the prima donna and tries a brutal approach. Rejected (and so also the next day), he follows the girl in her movements with her face, however, always hidden by different masks. Will he be able to break through the beauty's heart?
notes: Infascelli's debut takes place with a film that has the flavor of a fairytale, with valuable figurative references and an interesting intertwining of themes between love story and self-knowledge.

title: Drugstore Cowboy
actors: Matt Dillon, Kelly Lynch, James Remar, William S. Burroughs
description: Bob, drug addict, with his wife Dianne and friends Rick and Nadine steals drugs from pharmacies and hospitals. Lieutenant Gentry tries in vain to frame him. The four change scenery, then Nadine dies of an overdose and the others bury her body in a forest. Bob makes it out of drugs, but the past lurks. Badly injured for revenge, however, he refuses to name the police. A good film by Gus Van Sant in which Matt Dillon makes you forget the many "professional injuries" of his career. Here we do not aim to gratify anyone: as tense and ambiguous as necessary. Great Old William Burroughs is priceless in the part of the elderly priest.

title: Lili Marleen
actors: Hanna Schygulla, Giancarlo Giannini, Mel Ferrer
description: Willie is a singer, Robert a Jewish pianist. We are in Zurich, at the end of the 1930s. Robert helps the Jews escape from Germany; his rich family forces the two to separate. Willie becomes a symbol of the regime with the song "Lili Marlene". To find her, Robert ends up arrested, but the family redeems him. She falls from grace; will be able to reach Robert, but in the meantime he has married. One of Fassbinder's last films, and not the best, too artificial in its reinterpretation of the melò. The Schygulla is only decorative. On the other hand, the director of photography, Xaver Schwarzenberger, is extraordinary.

title: Prepotenti più di prima
actors: Aldo Fabrizi, Nino Taranto, Ave Ninchi, Alice Sandro, Luca Ronconi
description: Gennarino and Marcella, returning from their honeymoon, are forced to separate (she in Rome, he in Naples) due to the conflicting impositions of their respective fathers. Not even the news that Marcella is expecting a baby brings peace and the two lovebirds flee to Milan. The two fathers, irreducible in their contrasts, join them, but finally let the young people organize their existence.
notes: It is the sequel to "I prepotenti" (with Alice Sandro in the role of Marcella in place of Wandisa Guida and with Mattioli as director, substitute for Mario Amendola). Like the previous one, it is a cheap film, despite the efforts of Fabrizi, Taranto and Ave Ninchi.

title: Noi tre
actors: Lino Capolicchio, Ida Di Benedetto, Christopher Davidson, Carlo Delle Piane
description: Bologna, 1770. The fourteen-year-old Wolfang Amadeus Mozart is a guest in the villa of the counts Pallavacini to prepare for the examination of the Accademia dei Filarmonici. It was in this period that he found the friendship of Giuseppe Pallavicini, his contemporary, and of Antonia Leda, a fifteen-year-old of noble birth. In order not to interrupt his stay, he decides to insert a gross error in the written paper for the exam. Also in this film there is the usual intimate minimalism of all the films of the Bolognese Pupi Avati, redeemed by a certain lightness.

title: La historia oficial
actors: Norma Aleandro, Hector Alterio, Chela Ruíz, Hugo Arana, Chunchuna Villafañe
description: Buenos Aires, 1983. Alicia, a teacher, begins to suspect that her adoptive daughter's parents are disappeared. In fact, her husband hides a terrible truth from her. One of the most disturbing films on the tragedy of the disappeared and its aftermath in democratic Argentina. It gets a little rough in development, but it remains very effective and honest. Award in Cannes for the protagonist Aleandro. Oscar for best foreign film.

title: Zeppelin
actors: Michael York, Elke Sommer, Peter Carsten, Marius Göring, Anton Diffring
description: During the First World War, a young English lieutenant of German descent is sent to Germany to spy on the Zeppelin airship project. Earning the trust of a colonel, he manages to sneak into the design base.
notes: Good British spy movie, with lots of characters but not confusing. Great cast.

title: Mamma, mi si è depresso papà
actors: Andrea Roncato, Eleonora Giorgi, Adriano Pantaleo, Nicola Pistoia
description: From the day his mother Maria left home, little Adriano has been living alone with his father Stefano, who is a marriage lawyer by profession. The latter, however, took it really badly: unable to accept the separation and convinced that his wife has a lover, he is in fact constantly in the throes of depression. Thus, in spite of himself, it is the boy himself who has to play the role of the therapist for the parent, demonstrating patience and understanding in industrial doses. When Maria comes back home asking for help, Adriano will always come to meet her, doing his best to give her a hand ...

title: Ed McBain's 87th Precint: Ice
actors: Dale Midkiff, Joe Pantoliano, Paul Johansson, Michael Gross
description: Detectives Carella and Meyer from the 87th Precinct investigate a series of murders in which a dancer, a drug dealer, a petty informant and a respected jeweler were murdered. The two men are in fact convinced that the crimes are connected by a bond that unites this sequence of corpses, which apparently seem to lead back to the deeds of a serial killer. They will soon face a colossal international drug and dirty money trafficking. Discreet poiziesque film for TV, predictable enough but compelling enough. Loosely based on a novel from the 87th district cycle, the very successful series by novelist Ed McBain.

title: Conte d'hiver
actors: Charlotte Very, Frederic Van Den Driessche, Hervé Furic
description: Félicie has a lover, Loic; he also has a daughter, Elise, aged four; finally, she worries that she has never seen Charles again, Elise's father, after the summer prisoner in Brittany during which she became pregnant. Broken with Loic, she goes to Nevers, but that won't help her heal her lovesickness for Charles.
notes: The houses, the meetings, the relationships are intertwined, according to the ways that Rohmer has accustomed us to. But every time his cinema involves, smuggling the narrative ability for direct adhesion to reality and his refined writing for naive freshness. Here he even uses the late Shakespearean romances as an invisible subtext (right from the title).

title: Betrayed: A Story of Three Women
actors: Meredith Baxter, Swoosie Kurtz, John Terry, John Livingston
description: Joan has a grown-up daughter, Dana. It is a very bad day for her when she discovers that the girl is having an affair with Rob, Amanda's husband. She has been friends with Joan for a long time and, when she notices what has happened, the drama is inevitable, despite Joan has in the meantime chased Dana from home.
notes: Family drama of TV production that brings together situations drawn from the mélo tradition, in a contemporary context. The conclusion is "unscrupulous" only in appearance: nothing new under the sun, from any point of view you want to look at it.

title: Les nuits de la pleine lune
actors: Pascale Ogier, Tchéky Karyo, Fabrice Luchini, Christian Vadim
description: Louise lives with Remi but gladly takes the opportunity of a "pied-à-terre" in which to be alone sometimes. But, having met the young Bastien (on a full moon night), she has a short adventure with him. Then Remi confesses that he has a mistress, and Louise finds herself truly alone.
notes: The usual sly, delightful Rohmer and the usual witty, ironic analysis of feelings and characters. For this interpretation Pascal Ogier won the prize for best female interpreter in Venice, but died a few months later of heart disease.

title: A Man Called Horse
actors: Richard Harris, Dame Judith Anderson, Jean Gascon, Manu Tupou, Shannon Williams, Corinna Tsopei
description: Sir John Morgan, hunting in Montana in the early 1800s, is captured by the Sioux (who have never seen a white man) and used as a pack animal. Morgan will prove to be a man, marry the daughter of the chieftain, pass the terrible test of courage and thus become a full-fledged warrior. He will then decide to stay with his new "brothers", indeed he will become their leader.
notes: The film offers elements of spectacular rendering, but it is even more interesting in its ethnographic aspect, as well as for the clash-encounter envisaged for the two civilizations that came into contact. Great acting performance for the protagonist, Richard Harris.

title: Seduced and Betrayed
actors: Susan Lucci, David Charvet, Mary Ellen Trainor, Gabrielle Carteris
description: Valerie is a student who begins to have an epistolary relationship with a convict, Adam, convicted of killing six women. The exchange of letters continues and a true friendship seems to be born between the two: Adam in his pages even seems a sensitive man. But when he gets out of jail, he shows up at Valerie with not exactly friendly intentions.
notes: In America, correspondence with convicts is spreading more and more, especially among young girls. But Kiersch makes a film without infamy and without praise.

title: The Last Picture Show
actors: Timothy Bottoms, Jeff Bridges, Cybill Shepherd, Cloris Leachman
description: In the village of Anarene, Texas, between the sexual effervescence of the youngest, the frustrations of the forties and the nostalgia of the elderly, the line between boredom and drama is increasingly blurred. We are in 1951 and young Sonny's life education is far from easy. In 1971 Peter Bogdanovich made this true cult movie of the (bitter) nostalgia cinema that launched a group of excellent actors. Oscar for the two supporting actors, Cloris Leachman and Ben Johnson.

title: Salome's Last Dance
actors: Glenda Jackson, Stratford Johns, Nickolas Grace
description: It is 1892, in London: the owner of a luxury brothel sets up a private staging of Oscar Wilde's "Salomè" (whose performances in public theaters have been banned), for the benefit of the author himself, his friend. Alfred Douglas, known as Bosie, and the patrons of the place. All variously involved in the heterogeneous and irreverent staging, with a Herodias dressed as Snow White and a Salomè very busy peeling bananas. At the end of the performance, the police arrive and arrest the writer and the improvised director.
notes: Russell loves excesses and here too he does not contradict himself, not without a touch of spirit.

title: Ed McBain's 87th Precinct: Lightning
actors: Randy Quaid, Alex McArthur, Eddy Jones, Ving Rhames
description: A new serial killer appeared in the city, which drives the police crazy. The murderer leaves a "very particular" and indecipherable clue on the bodies of his victims. The detectives of the 87th district gropes in the dark; Yet these are highly experienced agents, accustomed to dealing with the most difficult and heinous cases. In particular, between them they distinguish Kling and Carella, ready for anything ...
notes: The figure of the serial killer is now a fixed guest of the detective genre. Here is accompanied by the presence of the couple of investigators who always come out victorious. Randy Quaid, Dennis's oldest and least sexy brother is still on the breach.

title: Le confessionnal
actors: Lothaire Bluteau, Patrick Goyette, Lean-Louis Millete, Suzanne Clément
description: In 1952 Hitchcock filmed in Canada, in Quebec, "I confess" and a girl, who was cleaning in the church chosen as a set, became pregnant, confessing only to the confessor the name of the man who had made her a mother. Shortly after the baby was born, the young woman committed suicide.
