In 1989, that "bastard" tries to discover the identity of his unknown father, involving, in his search, his stepbrother who has just returned from China. First film by a Québec director with extensive experience in theater and TV, the film is built on a very complex "plot", with daring narrative solutions and ambitious images, even if at times the outcome appears uneven.

title: Beyond Rangoon
actors: Patricia Arquette, U Aung Ko, Frances McDormand, Spaldin Gray
description: An American whose husband and son have been killed takes a tourist trip to Burma. Having lost her passport, the woman finds herself involved in the ferocious repression of the army and is forced to make a dangerous escape to the country together with others persecuted by the dictatorial regime in power. The denunciation of one of the most tragic political and human situations in the Far East, a large scene dedicated to the leader of dissidence Aung San Suu Kyi (Nobel Peace Prize winner), but what matters is the breath of adventure, led by a Boorman still in great shape.

title: Blue Ice
actors: Michael Caine, Sean Young, Ian Holm, Bobby Short, Alun Armstrong
description: A former agent of the British counterintelligence service has now closed (at least so he believes) with the life of the spy and is dedicated only to his beloved jazz music. But his hope for a finally peaceful existence is not destined to last: in spite of himself, in fact, he finds himself once again brought into play due to an illegal arms trade to be dismantled.
notes: Michael Caine plays and produces; Sean "Blade Runner" Young is the beauty of the day; Ian Holm countersigning for Britishness; Bob Hoskin makes a friendly and always welcome appearance. Directs Russell Mulcahy, with a video clip style. But with a cast like this it's like winning the lottery.

title: Without Her Consent
actors: Melissa Gilbert, Madison Mason, Barry Tubb
description: Emily Briggs is a young woman who finds herself going through the atrocious experience of rape. Casually met a man, he rapes her after a few days. Bravely, Emily finds the strength to take her attacker to court. But as often happens, the man during the trial accuses the woman of having circled him and invited him to aggression. Only with the help of her boyfriend Trey, will Emily be able to overcome this second humiliation as well. Like the other TV movies of the "Women at the crossroads" type, this film is also based on a true story. However, the film adds nothing more than what we already know about the problem of rape trials.

title: La scoumoune
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Michel Constantin, Gérard Depardieu
description: Robert ("the excommunicated", in the Marseille environment), trying to save his friend Xavier from prison, confronts the gangster Villanova, kills him and thus takes over the shady dealings of the dead. Captured after a bloody confrontation with a gang of blacks, he is sentenced to twenty years in prison. After the war, Robert resumes his business, always with a thousand risks, but now more and more alone. A well-structured gangster-movie, which idelizes the evil of the past. Belmondo is a fascinating "tough guy", the others are a suitable crown.

title: Go Fish
actors: V. S. Brodie, Guinevere Turner, T. Wendy McMillan
description: Ely and Daria share the apartment and have Kia, a teacher, as their mutual friend. She stays with Evy, a nurse, and shares the apartment with Max, an aspiring actress. Kia, Evy and Daria are convinced that Max and Ely could get together. A project easier said than done, also because Ely already has another partner. American independent film with a lesbian theme, lively and involved.

title: Le ultime ore di una vergine
actors: Massimo Farinelli, Don Backy, Sydne Rome, Sebastiano Amara
description: Enrico is a photojournalist who takes photos of the complaint. However, the editorial staff of a journalist friend of his is not interested in this kind of photo. Meanwhile, his girlfriend is expecting a baby. Enrico falls into a crisis from which he will not be able to get out even with the help of a kind of psychoanalyst clown. Bad movie. And not even the shadow of virgins.

title: Ain't Misbehavin'
actors: Rory Calhoun, Piper Laurie, Mamie Van Doren, Jack Carson
description: A brilliant young billionaire, Ken, falls in love with a dancer, Sarah. The two hang out for a while and eventually decide to get married. Aware of the social divide that separates them, Sarah accepts that Ken's cousin teaches her etiquette lessons. But the cousin's "lessons" are misinterpreted.
notes: Buzzell tells the same story as "Born yesterday", with some variations and with very little imagination, embroidering on the theme of social differences.

title: Mal d'Africa
description: In search of the contradictory faces of Africa in the 1960s: between innovations and tribal legacies, unspoiled nature and guerrilla warfare, hunger and riots.
notes: Stanislao Nievo, Ippolito's great-grandson, films a less crude version of the various _Mondo Cane_, even recycling Ortolani's own scores.

title: The Monster Club
actors: Vincent Price, John Carradine, Britt Ekland, Donald Pleasence
description: A slightly outdated nightclub has found a formula to attract customers again: inside you can find all the most famous horror movie monsters. Four Gothic stories unfold in the same environment: in one of them the protagonist is the son of a cross between a vampire and a werewolf. Roy Ward Baker brings together some actors who have now reached their third age, in a subdued atmosphere of pleasant fright. Worth seeing if only for Carradine and Price.

title: Crooked Hearts
actors: Vincent D'Onofrio, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Juliette Lewis
description: A thin but indissoluble thread binds the relationships between the members of the Warren family. Despite affection, no one manages to lead a completely independent life. Charlie and his sister Ask in particular try to escape the oppressive influence of their father, a man with a contradictory character. Then when Tom, the older brother, drops out of college and returns home with a girl, the conflicts finally reach a breaking point. Good family drama. The direction moves gracefully between the personal dramas of the various characters, played by a remarkable cast (in addition to D'Onofrio and Jason Leigh, there is also Peter Coyote in the role of the father).

title: Compagni di branco
actors: Giulio Scarpati, Carlotta Natoli, Renato Scarpa, Victor Cavallo
description: Massimo Minardi, an unemployed graduate, is staying in a pension inhabited by prostitutes. One day he is given a tenured position in a suburban school. It could be an opportunity for redemption for his life, but there is little possibility of dialogue between him and the "herd" of his students. Things get complicated when the professor helps arrest a mugger who turns out to be one of the school's pupils. This TV movie takes up the theme of the relationship between teacher and suburban children already undertaken many years ago on TV by dramas such as "Diary of a master" by De Seta. In this case, however, the result leaves something to be desired.

title: Road House
actors: Patrick Swayze, Ben Gazzara, Kelly Lynch, Sam Elliott, Marshall R. Teague
description: Dalton is a philosophy graduate, loves the quiet life, but is also an expert in martial arts. To earn some money he works as a bouncer in nightclubs. So he decides to take care only of a place, the Double Douce, the scene of daily fights, drug dealing, prostitution and solemn drunkenness. But the local mafia boss will be on him until the final duel.
notes: Contemporary Western all fist fights and stereotypes of the "Criminal of the night" style. The musician of the place is the blind guitarist Jeff Healey, also author of the soundtrack. Excellent proof of Ben Gazzarra.

title: La casa dove abitava Corinne
actors: Barbara De Rossi, Massimo Ranieri, Gottfried John, Giada Desideri
description: Doriana Polis, prosecutor of the republic, has just taken possession of her Roman apartment when she learns that a girl had been killed there some time before and that the murder went unpunished. Doriana receives strange messages and, moreover, she discovers that the police commissioner who dealt with the case has resigned without giving explanations. The new investigation is fraught with dangers. To say that the story is supported by an iron logic would be excessive.

title: Amos & Andrew
actors: Samuel L. Jackson, Nicolas Cage, Dabney Coleman, Michael Lerner
description: A black intellectual has bought a house on a small island on the border with Canada, and is going there for the first time. Nosy neighbors, mistaking him for a thief, call the police. This uses very quick methods, with devastating results. When the "police forces" realize the mistake made, they find a white delinquent who has nothing to do with it as a scapegoat ...
notes: Still a white man-black man couple, but in a different version from the one we are all too used to. It is an original idea, which, however, is wrong in running out too soon. With a more solid script, it could have been a much better movie.

title: The First Power/Pentagram
actors: Lou Diamond Phillips, Tracy Griffith, Jeff Kober, Mykelti Williamson
description: Los Angeles is under the nightmare of Patrick Channing, a maniac who wreaks havoc on his victims during satanic rites. Agent Russell Logan manages to capture him with a ruse and have him sentenced to death, but Channing has a supernatural power: he can reincarnate in the bodies of the victims, escaping the police. Logan, however, relentlessly continues his hunt, also aided by a young nun expert in exorcisms ...
notes: Lou Diamond Phillips (_La Bamba_, _Young Guns_) is the fearless agent of this detective / horror film who does not hide his screenplay approximations but saves himself for directing, confident in the action sequences.

title: Ed Wood
actors: Johnny Depp, Martin Landau, Sarah Jessica Parker, Patricia Arquette, Bill Murray, Jeffrey Jones, G.D. Spradlin, Vincent D'Onofrio, Mike Starr, Lisa Marie, Juliet Landau
description: Hollywood, 1950s: the young Ed Wood, who loves to dress like a woman, makes, in the most incredible way, some very poor films through "productive" devices, often grotesque. Becoming a friend of Bela Lugosi, now old, miserable and morphine addict, he assists him until his death. After a meeting with Orson Welles, Ed Wood makes his first successful film: "Plan 9 from Outer Space".
notes: For a tribute to the filmmaker's profession, Tim Burton chooses perhaps the most shabby director in history and tells him in a calculated balance between irony, affection and melancholy, in a re-enactment that "sublimates" his work and results in a mythical dimension. Brave the choice of the subject and black and white. (photographed by Peter Czapsky). Burton confirms his painful vision and Martin Landau, who won the Oscar in the role of Lugosi, his sensitivity as an interpreter. His monologue ("Home ... I have no home") and the moment he bends down to pick a rose remain in the memory.

title: Miracle on the 34th Street
actors: Richard Attenborough, Elizabeth Perkins, Dylan McDermott, Mara Wilson
description: Little Susan, skeptical about the existence of Santa Claus, knows one, named Kriss Kringle, who works in a department store and is convinced that he is the real Santa Claus. Some competitors from the big store attempt to have old Kriss declared insane in court, but the trial will not only decree the man's sanity, but will even certify his identity with Santa.
notes: Ugly remake of the 1947 film of the same name, directed by George Seaton, starring Edmund Gween and Natalie Wood. This takes up the script, but the outcome is much more modest and sluggish, despite the efforts made by Sir Richard Attenborough.

title: Renegades
actors: Evelyn Keyes, Larry Parks, Willard Parker, Edgar Buchanan
description: The only one in the family who does not practice banditry, Bill Dambrows retires to the mountains to change his life. He is arrested for aiding and abetting, but finds a defense in Dr. Martin. He falls in love with the doctor's girlfriend, he is paid, and a bloody affair ensues. Fairly crafted narrative for a story that lies entirely in the codified canons of tradition.

title: Casanova '70
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Virna Lisi, Marisa Mell, Enrico Maria Salerno, Michèle Mercier
description: Andrea, major of the army, succeeds in gallant conquests only in conditions of danger or hardship. Not having followed the psychoanalyst's advice for moderation, she finds herself on trial for the death of a husband who has been falsified by him. Acquitted, he gets married, but he still needs the risk.
notes: Frivolous but elegant variation on the theme of incommunicability. Mastroianni plays with class.

title: Ci vediamo in tribunale
actors: Nancy Brilli, Tullio Solenghi, Amanda Sandrelli, Blas Roca Rey
description: Carlo and Giulia, both lawyers, are professionally very different: he is correct and idealistic, she is all too casual. When they find themselves as adversaries in a cause of separation, passion arises between them. But various events push them against each other, so much so that Giulia ends up in handcuffs. And Carlo will have to do violence to his principles to get it out: but there is an excellent reason why he does it ... It certainly cannot be said that this is a particularly robust story. Within its limits, the story works discreetly, at a passable pace and with performers who get along well.

title: The Loveless
actors: Willem Dafoe, Robert Gordon, Marin Kanter
description: Vance and his fellow bikers are staying in a provincial motel; they have to fix the vehicles before heading to Florida. A reputable customer is complaining about their right to be served. The man is revealed to be the father of a girl who gets together with Vance and accuses the parent of pushing his wife to suicide. When the man gets down to business, the girl shoots him and then kills herself. This is Kathryn Bigelow's first feature film ("Strange Days"), of which he co-directs with Monty Montgomery: with an eye to the bikes movies of the 1950s, he gives us an image of youth alienation and loneliness at the sunset of the 1970s. .

title: Squanto: a Warrior's Tale
actors: Adam Beach, Mandy Patinkin, Michael Gambon
description: We are in the 12th century. A group of English traders, who went to the New World to buy furs by paying for them with trinkets, returns home dragging some red Indians with them to show them to compatriots as souvenirs. Among them is Squanto, who manages to escape. His escape could have tragic consequences if he fortunately did not find refuge in a community of monks. A Disney production with an evident ethnic and moralistic background.

title: Hotel
actors: Rod Taylor, Catherine Spaak, Karl Malden, Melvyn Douglas, Richard Conte, Merle Oberon
description: In New Orleans, a historic, debt-ridden hotel is about to close. A speculator would like to turn it into a guesthouse for tourists while the manager of a company has in mind the construction of a skyscraper. The elderly owner of the hotel would like to hand it over to someone who would continue the tradition. Who will get it?
notes: Many good actors, old and young, directed with a light hand by a specialist in comedies. A little out of fashion.

title: Past Tense
actors: Anthony La Paglia, Scott Glenn, Lara Flynn Boyle
description: Gene is an agent who is in the throes of a decidedly embarrassing murder. Only he, in fact, is certain of what happened: the victim's body is gone, there are no clues, there is no motive. The facts, as they arise, seem to escape any investigation. And who is really the girl in the house of which Gene saw the mangled body of the victim? A detective story that relies on situations that are anything but new in the genre, with a cast of character actors.

title: Le schiave esistono ancora
description: The film starts from the assumption that forms of slavery still exist in the world and goes to their research focusing above all on the Middle Eastern geographical area. Here the camera enters the princely harems, places of destination for modern slaves. Even some European girls try "luck" in those countries trusting in their attractiveness. It is a documentary film with vague claims of social denunciation. It actually became a good excuse to sneak in and peek into Arab harems. So much so that Folco Quilici, originally involved in the project, took off his signature in controversy with the result.

title: Prince: Sign o' the Times
actors: Prince, Sheila E., Sheena Easton
description: The film is the recording of the famous pop star Prince's show "Sign o 'the Times", which took place in Rotterdam and Antwerp. The songs deal with different themes: the breakdowns of a world threatened by hypocrisy, the joys of pure sex but also the need for lasting bonds. Cinema at the service of music.

title: La tecnica e il rito
actors: Jozsef Madaras, Marco Guglielmi, Adalberto Maria Merli, Luigi Diberti
description: On the eastern edge of the Roman Empire a new leader rises, Attila. He manages to impose his dominion on the Huns through a series of wildly irrational ceremonies. He will complete his ascent by killing his brother. Produced for Rai, on the theme of dictatorship; built with great visual expertise but with some didactic pretensions too.

title: The Canterville Ghost
actors: Patrick Stewart, Neve Campbell, Cherie Lunghi
description: The American physicist Hiram Otis goes to England, to Canterville Hall, for his research, with his wife, daughter Virginia and two younger boys. Virginia and the two boys meet Sir Simon's ghost, but Otis doesn't listen to them. There is a prophecy involved that will restore peace to the old home and a nascent feeling of Virginia for a young neighbor.
notes: The film is inspired by a bizarre gothic tale by Oscar Wilde in which humor is not a secondary component. The screenplay, however, prefers to emphasize the romance component of the story, also adding a good dose of Shakespeare.

title: Bloodsport 2
actors: Daniel Bernhardt, Don Gibb, James Hong, Pat Morita
description: Alex is a thief who as a prisoner learns the secrets of martial arts. His teacher is the wise Sun. Alex learns that the sword he stole from a wealthy art collector is the trophy for the winner of the Kumite, the toughest martial arts tournament in the world. Now redeemed from his past life, he returns it to its rightful owner, to then conquer it regularly in combat. "Bloodsport" ("No holds barred") had the function of launching the Van Damme myth. No. 2 tries to exploit his memory, using an imitation of the now famous Belgian as the protagonist. Full throttle action; history is optional.

title: Le due vite di Mattia Pascal
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Laura Morante, Flavio Bucci, Laura Del Sol
description: Forced by a reversal of fortune to marry a woman he does not love, Mattia Pascal has a troubled marital relationship. After yet another quarrel with his wife, he goes to Monte Carlo where he wins a large sum at the casino. Taking advantage of news that mistakenly gives him for dead, the man settles in Rome under a new identity. But not even this second existence of his will be propitious to him. Neither the choice of having actualized the story nor the choice of having opted for a grotesque dimension that softens the charge of bitterness helps this new transposition of Pirandello's novel for the screen. The film is based on pure craft, by Monicelli and Mastroianni.

title: Borsalino and Co.
actors: Alain Delon, Riccardo Cucciolla, Daniel Ivernel, Catherine Rouvel, René Kolldehoff, André Falcon, Adolfo Lastretti
description: The young gangster Rock Siffredi avenges the death of his friend François by killing his alleged murderer, the Italian Francesco Volpone. But he has, in Marseilles, his brother Giovanni who, duly protected, aims for dominance in the area and destroys the rival's empire. Rock, however, manages to recover and, in turn, annihilates Volpone and then leaves for the United States with his loyalists. In the passage from the first to the second "Borsalino" the ironic component that caused a healthy detachment from the story has been lost. The fine setting and the narrative ability remain, but here the violence and ferocity go crazy.

title: The Fighting Prince of Donegal
actors: Peter McEnery, Susan Hampshire, Tod Adams
description: Hugh O'Donnel, after being proclaimed Prince of Donegal, is committed to the reunification of Ireland by organizing the various clans against the government of Elizabeth I. But the British, preventing his action, capture him and imprison him in Dublin Castle . However, he manages to escape and, despite the merciless hunt of Captain Leeds, to lead the revolt.
notes: A good Disney adventure movie.

title: Il trono di fuoco - Il giudice sanguinario
actors: Christopher Lee, Hans Hasse, Maria Shell, Margaret Lee
description: In seventeenth-century England, the perfidious judge Jefferies, to crush the conspiracy against King James II, burns the young Alicia Gray, guilty of witchcraft. His sister Mary, who is about to do the same, is saved by a lord. One of the delusional horror-adventurous-gothic-sadistic assemblages of the legendary Spanish director Jess Franco, magician of the Z series. Here the model is "The Grand Inquisitor" by Michael Reeves.

title: The Wedding Party
actors: Jill Clayburgh, Charles Pfluger, Valda Setterfield, Robert De Niro
description: 60's. Two college mates, Charlie and Josephine, get married in a hurry and have a small wedding party where they also invite friends Baker and Cecil. The problem is, Charlie isn't entirely sure about getting married. On the one hand, Josephine is rich and can only guarantee him a wealthy future. On the other hand, married life marks the end of all bohemian dreams. First film directed by De Palma. Produced in 1966 and released only three years later, it marks the screen debut, in a supporting role, of the barely 20-year-old Robert De Niro.

title: Above Suspicion
actors: Christopher Reeve, Joe Mantegna, Kim Cattrall
description: During a gunfight with thugs, Rhinehart, a policeman, is seriously injured. The doctors manage to save him, but he remains paralyzed and forced to spend the rest of his life in a wheelchair. Faced with his tragedy, the solidarity of friends and colleagues is total. Rhinehart takes advantage of the situation to concoct a plan to get rid of his unfaithful wife and her lover. The film is a decent thriller, painted in rather morbid colors. Good cast that includes in addition to Christopher Reeve ("Superman") also Joe Mantegna (star of "Homicide" and other films by David Mamet).

title: Bambi
description: Bambi is a fawn that is celebrated from birth by all the other animals of the forest. Together with the hare Thumper and his mother, Bambi discovers the secrets of the forest, but also its dangers. In fact, one day the hunters kill the mother doe. It will be the advice of the wise deer lord of the forest, and the meeting with the doe Feline, to help him overcome the pain of the loss of his mother.
notes: With Bambi Disney aspired to a realism and a realism of the staging in harmony and along the lines of documentaries he would soon produce. Since the animators of the House were not particularly skilled in reproducing animals, especially in movement, some authentic fawns were brought into the studios and carefully analyzed by the designers. At the time he was also loved by the master of Russian cinema Sergej Ejzenstejn who considered him a very successful apologue on the cyclical evolution of life and nature. Today it doesn't seem like Disney's best movie, but it's still a great classic.

title: Star Trek: Generations
actors: Patrick Stewart, William Shatner, Jonathan Frakes, Malcolm McDowell, Brent Spiner, LeVar Burton, Michael Dorn, Gates McFadden, James Doohan, Brian Thompson
description: Four generations have passed since the catastrophe of Captain Kirk's spaceship and the new crew receives a distress call: Dr. Soran is saved and then tries to reach Nexus, the ribbon of energy that seems to dispense happiness. This quest threatens to lead to the destruction of the solar system and Soran has the evil Klingons on his side. But a chronological distortion ...
notes: In the umpteenth cinematic episode of the TV series "Star Trek" the overwhelming power of special effects is increasingly felt, but the subversion of chronological conventions has its own charm.

title: Even Cowgirls Get the Blues
actors: Uma Thurman, Rain Phoenix, Lorraine Bracco, John Hurt, Keanu Reeves, Angie Dickinson
description: Sissy is known as the super hitchhiker because of her huge thumbs. In New York, a gay man called the Countess makes her meet an asthmatic painter who is in love with her, but the girl abandons him. On the Rubber Rose ranch, Sissy foments the revolt of the cowgirls against the owner (still the Countess) and falls in love with Bonanza Jellybean. And there are the pink cranes fed with hallucinogens ... The "revolutionary" charge of Gus Van Sant finds fertile ground in the novel by Tom Robbins from which he draws the film. Grotesque and subversive, a "game" with many targets of respectability and normality in its perspective, conducted with prudent boldness.

title: The Disappearence of Nora
actors: Veronica Hamel, Stephen Collins, Dennis Farina, Stan Ivar, Leon Russom
description: Nora Fremont's mind is haunted by violent flashbacks, which seem to suggest only one horrible truth: that of having been the murderer of a man. Nora struggles to understand what this all means: she can't believe she's truly a killer. But discovering the truth and returning home could be the source of a terrible misunderstanding, with deadly consequences. What is the boundary between nightmare and reality? This television thriller does not reveal anything new on the subject, already extensively examined previously. Chopra is a former documentarian; in her "Smooth Talk" (1985) Laura Dern had her first major role.

title: Noi siamo le colonne
actors: Vittorio De Sica, Franco Fabrizi, Aroldo Tieri, Laura Betti, Antonio Cifariello
description: Three students enrolled at the University of Pisa make up a close-knit group; the leader is the reckless Aldo, who involves the serious Ugo and the clumsy Bartolozzi in his adventures. The life of the student is exciting, but Ugo has his work cut out when it seems that his love affair with Lea is at the expense.
notes: Comedy with a slender narrative thread, which entrusts its chances to the lines written by Metz and Marchesi and to a flashy cast. Laura Betti also peeps out in one of her first film appearances.

title: Palookaville
actors: William Forsythe, Vincent Gallo, Adam Trese, Kim Dickens
description: Sid, Russ and Jerry are longtime friends. They live in a provincial town and spend their time talking about their troubles. They have no job or prospects, save the hope of someday making the hunchback that will make them rich. But, besides being naïve, they are unlucky. They try to rob a jewelry store through a tunnel carved into the wall, but discover they have broken through the wrong wall ...
notes: Alan Taylor's debut unfairly neglected at the Venice Film Festival in '95. Airy and interesting comedy, with perfect actors and fun you find. The demonstration that billions are not needed (only) to get a good result.

title: Un angelo a New York
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Tina Majorino, Karen Black
description: Enzo decides to spend Christmas in New York with his son Antonio, daughter-in-law Gloria and granddaughter Laura. In reality, things are not going too well between Gloria and Antonio. But Enzo doesn't have time to realize it because, as soon as he arrives at the station, he witnesses the sudden death of a Santa Claus. Loaded the body on a trolley, grandfather and granddaughter escape a robber and get lost in the metropolis. But is Santa Claus really dead? This Santa Claus has indeed something magical.
notes: Curious and anomalous Christmas TV movie directed by Vinicius Mainardi, director of "16060". In addition to Giannini, also Tina Majorino, the girl from "Waterworld", is worth mentioning.

title: Cervellini fritti impanati
actors: Alessandro Haber, Anna Galiena, Roberto Citran, Oliviero Scardicchio
description: Tonino, forty-five, lives with his brother Valerio. He does not go out, he does not talk to others: he is abnormal, or rather "schizophrenic". But not always: he lost his reason the day when, a few hours after the wedding, his wife Elisabetta died in a car accident. At the wheel was Valerio who, perhaps also out of guilt, has now become Tonino's guardian and sole interlocutor. But there is also Marianna, Valerio's girlfriend, who after meeting her unfortunate brother will never be the same ...
notes: The film, based on a play brought to the theater by Nanni Loy), aims to demonstrate that "the opposite of love is not hate, the opposite of memory is not oblivion, the opposite of sanity is not madness, but always indifference ". Comedy of actors and nothing more.

title: Nostalghia
actors: Oleg Jankovskij, Erland Josephson, Domiziana Giordano, Patrizia Terreno
description: Andrei, a Soviet musicologist, is in Bologna for research. Eugenia, a charming and restless woman, accompanies him in his research. One day he meets a man discharged from the asylum. A relationship of solidarity is created between Andrej and the eccentric character that distances the scholar from his research and leads him to increasingly exclude the companion. In praise of slowness, full of long sequence shots and full of difficult-to-understand symbolisms, the film is one of the most hermetic of the Russian filmmaker. A film that entrusts its meaning above all to the strong suggestion of the images.

title: Willy Signori e vengo da lontano
actors: Francesco Nuti, Isabella Ferrari, Anna Galiena, Alessandro Haber, Cristina Gaioni
description: Willy Signori is a journalist, has a girlfriend with whom he is about to marry and a paralyzed brother. His existence is quiet and somewhat monotonous until he is involved in an accident in which a young man dies. Lucia, the dead man's girlfriend, is expecting a baby and Willy begins to take charge of it, neglecting his girlfriend.
notes: Nuti, who became the director of his films, accentuates the pathetic side of the stories and cites insistently Chaplin.

title: Leaving Normal
actors: Christine Lahti, Meg Tilly, Patrika Darbo, Lenny Von Dohlen
description: Darly is a waitress who inherited a house and a piece of land in Alaska. Marianne is a demoralized and restless housewife waiting for her moment of glory. They both live in Normal, Wyoming, a town whose name says it all, especially the way people live there. When the two women meet in a parking lot, they decide without much preamble to go north together in a convertible, abandoning Normal and his "normality". The film tells about their journey, stops, visits to relatives and chance encounters.
notes: Do you think you've seen something similar before, perhaps with a little more violence? You're right, it was "Thelma and Louise". A female road movie that gives the opportunity to draw portraits of losers, but which often shows a false tone.

title: Agenzia Riccardo Finzi. Praticamente detective.
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Simona Mariani, Enzo Cannavale, Olga Karlatos
description: Riccardo Finzi is a private detective living in Milan. One day he notices the photo and the related article in the newspaper that talks about the mysterious death of Susi, a girl with whom he had been accosted in the disco some time before. With the help of Giuseppe Marchini, known as Ciammarica, he begins to investigate and discovers that the girl is actually Pierpaola Moser, daughter of a well-known financier.
notes: The film dates back to 1979, which is the period of greatest success in Pozzetto's career. The limits of the Italian comedy of those years are all there, but it cannot be denied that this fake Milanese yellow is sometimes quite funny.

title: Prince of Darkness
actors: Donald Pleasence, Victor Wong, Anne Howard
description: In a Los Angeles church, a priest discovers a strange case containing a greenish liquid. According to an ancient book, the substance refers to the powers of the Evil One. Together with a team of scientists, the priest begins to study the reliquary, but, during a terrible night, everyone is hit by the spray of the liquid and consequently infected by Evil, which will bring them into contact with a nightmare, in which the Antichrist threatens humanity.
notes: Of all the films directed by Carpenter, a recognized master of new horror, this is certainly one of the most disturbing. The representation of the Antichrist is so gloomy that it assumes metaphysical connotations, close to Gnostic positions.

title: A Walk with Love and Death
actors: Anjelica Huston, Assaf Dayan, Anthony Corlan
description: Heron De Foix, expelled from university for having written an obscene poem, is traveling in France in the fourteenth century devastated by the Hundred Years War. He finds hospitality for a night in the castle of the count of Valois where he falls in love with Claudia, the count's sixteen-year-old daughter. Soon the two, having become lovers, set off on their journey again, crossing the territories inflamed by the riots until they too, having found a temporary refuge, await death. Odd costume film with quite sixty-eight anarchoid atmospheres, it was one of the director's greatest fiascos, blocking the career of Anjelica Huston, daughter of the director who made her debut here, among other things for fifteen years. Based on a delightful book by Hans Koningsberger.

title: Aces High
actors: Malcolm McDowell, Christopher Plummer, Simon Ward
description: All the English boys dream of the amazing adventures of the aviation pilots who are fighting in the First World War. John Gresham is the most famous of these heroes. Steve Croft arrives in Amiens where Gresham, his idol and former classmate, is stationed. However, Croft soon realizes that life on the field is far from ideal: many pilots die in battle, many, including Gresham, try to overcome fear with alcohol. Destiny lurks for Croft as well.
notes: It's a classic war movie with all the right ingredients: spectacular battles, camaraderie, heroism. But also a strong anti-militarist streak. Particine for John Gielgud, Trevor Howard, Ray Milland.

title: Where Are Children?
actors: Jill Clayburgh, Max Gail, Frederic Forrest, Harley Cross, Elisabeth Harnois
description: The Eldridge are a serene family who lives in New England, made up of Santa Ray, mother Nancy and the little Michael and Missy. Life flows quiet, but a bad day the two small ones are kidnapped. As if that were not enough, the woman's drama resurfaces: a few years earlier Nancy had seen two other children who had a previous marriage die murdered, whose death had been unjustly accused.
notes: Family melodrammone with discretion in thrilling, good atmosphere and superlative interpreters (on which an unpublished Frederic Forrest excels). Too bad that the director cannot always be behind a slightly tangled plot.

title: Il tradimento - Passato che uccide
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, Caterina Boratto, Gianna Maria Canale, Camillo Pilotto
description: Although innocent, he was convicted of the murder of a creditor and served many years in prison. Meanwhile, his daughter frequents dangerous environments. Here comes the alleged dead man who this time the protagonist kills in earnest. But for the law it will be self-defense. Inspired by a real fact, it is a drama d.o.c. crafted by the excellent Freda.

title: Saturn 3
actors: Kirk Douglas, Farrah Fawcett, Harvey Keitel, Douglas Lambert
description: Captain James goes to the rescue of the moon base where Major Adams and his assistant Alex work. During the journey, James is eliminated and replaced by the criminal Benson. On the basis, however, the robot Hector accuses him of murder and Adams begins to have doubts. Hector eliminates Benson, but things get complicated when the robot falls in love with Alex.
notes: Donen is an old Hollywood fox who gave his best in the fifties in comedies and musicals (his legendary "Singing in the rain"). Here his profession, a suggestive scenography and a very respectable cast help him.

title: American Pop
description: Through four generations, the story of a family: from Zamie, the son of a Russian immigrant, to his son Benny, to his son, Tony and, lastly, Pete. All with musical ambitions (and with a lot of music as a frame) but with different destinies. A bitter and biting journey through the time of a demythologized America, by the author of "Fritz the Cat" and "The Lord of the Rings".

title: The Last Valley
actors: Michael Caine, Omar Sharif, Florinda Bolkan
description: Around the middle of the seventeenth century, a learned Heidelberg scholar flees the horrors of the Thirty Years' War that is ravaging Germany, apparently with no hope of victory for anyone. After many pilgrimages, he ends up in a remote Swiss village that miraculously escaped the massacres: here, using the force of reason, he tries to save the population from a ferocious horde of mercenaries and from the waves of fanaticism and "witch hunts" that periodically run through those districts.
notes: A product full of solid and disturbing questions, well acted and with a historically accurate script.

title: The Sword and the Rose
actors: Richard Todd, Glynis Johns, James Robertson Justice
description: Henry VIII's sister Mary is to marry the old king of France even though she is in love with the captain of the guards Charles Brandon. But if her royal husband Louis XII dies, they promise her, she will be able to join the man she loves. Finally widowed, it is the Duke of Buckingham who thwarts her dream of love. In fact, the illustrious nobleman would like his hand and even resort to assassins to get rid of Brandon. A frankly boring film, unusually far from Disney standards.

title: The Broken Chain
actors: Eric Schweig, Wes Studi, Buffy Sainte-Marie, Pierce Brosnan, Girard Swan
description: The friendship of two brave Mohawk warriors is put to the test after the destruction of the Iroquois confederation during the French-Indian war of the 1700s. Born and raised in the same tribe, the two warriors find themselves having to face a problem of conscience: fight to the bitter end against the colonizers and risk extermination or join the new political order and collaborate with the invaders and save what remains of the old confederation. Fascinating re-enactment of one of the least known pages of American history. The film is the second installment of a television series produced by Ted Turner, entitled "Native Americans".

title: The Glass Slipper
actors: Leslie Caron, Michael Wilding, Elsa Lanchester, Keenan Wynn
description: Neglected by her stepmother and hated by her stepsisters, Cindy has to do the heaviest housework. But a benign fairy allows her to participate in the prince's ball, who falls in love with her. Sugary musical translation of Cinderella's fairy tale. Leslie Caron's Cindy works, but actor Michael Wilding as a dancing prince is really out of place, even though the choreography is by Roland Petit.

title: L'uomo che sfidò l'organizzazione
actors: Howard Ross, Karin Schubert, José Calvo, Stephen Boyd, Alberto Dalbes
description: An airport employee gets his hands on a drug shipment and, thanks to the intrepid girlfriend, sells it abroad for a billion. The swindled criminal organization, however, gets on the heels of the two, who can momentarily count on the support of an inspector. Italian action comic that recalls the ingredients and structures of the old spaghetti wetern with punches, shots, escapes and chases.

title: I'll Do Anything
actors: Nick Nolte, Whittni Wright, Albert Brooks, Julie Kavner, Tracey Ullman
description: Attracted by the mirage of Hollywood, Matt Hobbs, a talented New York actor, however, had a far from happy impact with the capital of cinema. For three years his wife has left him, and Matt finds himself having to "manage" by himself even the existence of his six-year-old daughter: who, ironically, becomes the star of a television series. For Matt, the future may be less gray ...
notes: The film was designed as a musical, but Nick Nolte's singing skills fell short of the bare minimum. If they had thrown away the rest as well, not much would have been lost. Director James L.?Brooks is the one of _Voglia di tendzza_ and the more recent _Spanglish_.

title: Professione reporter
actors: Jack Nicholson, Maria Schneider, Jenny Runacre, Ian Hendry
description: David Locke, a well-known reporter, during a trip to the Sahara, comes across the corpse of arms dealer David Robertson, almost his double, and, disgusted with his life, assumes his identity. Back in Europe and specifically in Spain, he will be helped by a mysterious girl to escape from Robertson's wife who is looking for her husband.
notes: Antonioni casts a glance of lucid pessimism on the existential void of his characters, constructs a film of exceptional dramatic intensity, despite its apparent narrative fragility. A great Nicholson and a "revelation": Maria Schneider.

title: Angel
actors: Stephen Rea, Veronica Quilligan, Alan Devlin, Peter Caffrey
description: Danny, a saxophonist in a dance club, meets Annie, a dumb girl, the same night that three killers kill both the band manager and Annie herself and blow up the entire club. Danny does not provide investigative elements to the police and sets out on his own hunting for criminals. His will be an adventure studded with corpses and dramatic discoveries about the infiltration of the underworld in the upper echelons. After his beginnings as a narrator and screenwriter, Irishman Neil Jordan directs his first film, a "metaphysical mystery" full of disturbing issues and notable for its robust, compelling cinematic management. An excellent debut.

title: Quel maledetto treno blindato
actors: Bo Svenson, Peter Hooten, Fred Williamson, Michael Pergolani
description: Some American soldiers stationed in the Ardennes have an unfinished business with justice. Taking advantage of a bombardment that disperses the platoon, they try to reach the Swiss border. They are soon joined by a German deserter, but events lead them to take the place of a special patrol of American soldiers tasked with neutralizing an armored train carrying material of enormous strategic importance. A classic war film that keeps an eye on spectacle rather than verisimilitude. Cult by Quentin Tarantino.

title: The Browning Version
actors: Albert Finney, Greta Scacchi, Matthew Modine
description: Crocker Harris is a teacher on his way to retirement. At one time, for twenty years, he was a distinguished professor of Latin in a prestigious public school, but now he is forced to teach English to foreign students. It is the finding of a failure that places him in front of the progressive disaster of his marriage with Laura, an unfaithful wife. The cast of this film is very respectable, and Finney's performance is, as usual, very convincing. But that's not enough to free the film from a sense of boredom and stale academicism that pervades it from start to finish. Poor service rendered to Asquith's beautiful '51 movie ("Goodbye, Mr. Harris"), of which it is a remake.

title: Corri ragazzo corri
actors: Josef Abraham, Libuse Jafrankova, Zdenek Sverak
description: Forty-year-old Dalibor Vrana, a frustrated humble bookseller, improvises himself as a scammer. Wearing a tuxedo, he pretends to be a waiter every night in a different restaurant, to collect customer bills and then run away. It will be the envy of a neighbor and the suspicion of a bookseller's shop assistant to hand him over to the police. Discreet comedy with historical-sociological significance.

title: Il comandante
actors: Totò, Andreina Pagnani, Britt Ekland, Isa Crescenzi, Linda Sini, Franco Fabrizi
description: The new general Cavalli is retiring. The new life does not satisfy him at all: he gets bored and, fidgeting, annoys everyone a little. His wife hires him by a real estate agency (she secretly pays his salary), to get him out of the way. The "employers" are two handlers who nearly end up in jail. Finally, Cavalli adjusts to his new status of nothing.
notes: Totò protagonist of a twilight comedy, discreetly built around a character that is not purely comic. But the serious claims soon slip into the pathetic and enclose the talent of the interpreter. Rodolfo Sonego's script is also not very sharp.

title: Fellini Satyricon
actors: Martin Potter, Hiram Keller, Max Born, Salvo Randone, Mario Romagnoli
description: In Nero's Rome two young men on strike, Encolpius and Ascilto, go through adventures and debauchery of all kinds, chasing the handsome Gitone, whose favors they vie for. Among the characters they meet are the actor Vernacchio, the Hermaphrodite, the Minotaur, the enriched freedman Trimalcione and the poet Eumolpo, in an initiation story with a tragic outcome. Drawing inspiration from the work of Petronius Arbiter and giving free rein to his unbridled vision, Fellini draws a fresco in which the defects and "sins" of modernity are reflected, hidden and distorted under the guise of a phantasmagoric and funereal staging.

title: Warlords of Atlantis
actors: Doug McClure, Peter Gilmore, Shane Rimmer, Lea Brodie
description: In the sea of ??Bermuda, with a bathyscaphe, to explore the depths where the mythical Atlantis once stood. A giant golden idol, a huge octopus, submerged cities, the blueprint for a Nazi empire and more. Finally, for the few survivors, salvation. A bit of Verne, a bit of the Bermuda triangle together with many other "sources", for a lively but childish film.

title: Canyon Passage
actors: Dana Andrews, Patricia Roc, Hoagy Carmichael, Susan Hayward
description: Times of summary justice, towards the middle of the last century, in the West facing the Red Indians and with turbulence even among the pioneers. Robert does not know how to adapt to this climate of precariousness of the law, and is both witness and protagonist of dramatic conflicts resolved with more barbarism than civilization. Excellent actors and direction of the wrist for a film of robust construction.

title: Latino
actors: Robert Beltran, Annette Cardona, Tony Plana
description: Eddie Guerrero is a Vietnam veteran in the special squads sent by the US government to support the Contras against the Sandinista regime in Nicaragua. He therefore has the opportunity to see with his own eyes the violence and brutality perpetrated by the Contras against the population. It will be the daily horror, together with the love for a beautiful Nicaraguan, that will slowly make him pass to the other side of the fence. The film, shot in Nicaragua at the time of the war with the consent of the Sandinistas, is intended to be an example of cinema truth. In reality, his being too allied makes him at best a kind of mediocre left-wing "green Beretti". Wexler, one of the major cinematographers of the 1970s, was also a militant filmmaker (his documentary "America, America ... where are you going?")

title: The Ladykillers
actors: Alec Guinness, Katie Johnson, Peter Sellers, Danny Green, Cecil Parker, Herbert Lom
description: The professor. Marcus, fake musician and real robber, arranges a heist with his gang. The base is the room that the man has rented from Mrs. Wilberforce, who thus collaborates, without knowing it, in the crime. When she learns the truth, the bandits take pity on her, don't kill her and instead eliminate each other for the money.
notes: A classic of English comedy. The icy Guinness as boss is extraordinary, and there is also one of the first important parts of Peter Sellers. Hilarious and chilling.

title: Frankenstein
actors: Randy Quaid, Patrick Bergin, Fiona Gillies
description: Confident that science can not only cure disease but also overcome death, young Dr. Victor Frankstein constructs an artificial creature using a corpse stolen from the scaffold on which he grafted a new brain. The doctor manages to give life to the new creature but it turns out to be a bloodthirsty monster that soon escapes his control. The creature then escapes and swears revenge against its artificer. For Victor it is the beginning of a nightmare that will compromise his marriage to Elizabeth.
notes: Discreet television version of Mary Shelley's immortal novel. Nothing new and great, but Quaid is good at playing a monster that is a little smarter than usual.

title: Emperor of the North Pole
actors: Lee Marvin, Ernest Borgnine, Keith Carradine, Charles Tyner, Malcolm Atterbury, Simon Oakland, Harry Caesar, Matt Clark, Elisha Cook jr., Joe Di Reda, Hal Baylor
description: In 1933, with the US still in the grip of the terrible economic crisis, an outcast called "Number One" for his superior ability to poach the railways, challenges the ferocious Shak, conductor of the freight train between Salem and Portland, determined to stop him. to complete the entire path freezing. The result is a very hard fight, ruthless, steeped in violence, blood and death. Made as a ballad, the film highlights its own metaphorical nature of the eternal conflict between libertarian individualism and the servitude of power. The tense narration, the tight rhythms give effect to the raw, uncompromising "message" of the work.

title: Les aventures d'Arsène Lupin
actors: Robert Lamoureux, O. E. Hasse, Sandra Milo, Liselotte Pulver
description: Arsenio Lupine steals two paintings, but leaves the third one because it is false, then steals some jewels and sends one to the President's wife ... Melancholy and light, one of the last films by Maestro Becker. It is not one of his best things, although Lamoreux is a good Lupine and the whole adventure, in color, has a certain old-fashioned charm.

title: Five Weeks in Ballon
actors: Red Buttons, Barbara Eden, Cedric Hardwicke, Peter Lorre
description: In 1862 a group of Englishmen organized an expedition to reach the Volta River, in Africa, aboard a balloon. Five people take part in the enterprise: an inventor, his assistant, an officer, a journalist and his girlfriend.
notes: Dignified, but somewhat colorless version of the well-known novel of the same name by Jules Verne.

title: Fletch Lives
actors: Chevy Chase, Hal Holbrook, Julianne Phillips
description: Reporter Fletcher travels to Belle Isle to take possession of a plantation and mansion which he has become the owner of through an inheritance. But when the solicitor who informed him of the bequest is killed, big trouble begins for him. Arrested and released on bail, he investigates on his own, eventually unmasking illegal trafficking in radioactive substances.
notes: Second adventure for the reporter Fletch all on the shoulders of the good Chevy Chase who does all he can to make people laugh: he puts some of his own, and is particularly good in disguises. Which unfortunately are not enough to save a film so-so, which retraces comic forms already seen.

title: Kådisbellan
actors: Stellan Skarsgård, Jesper Salén, Basia Frydman, Niklas Olund
description: Being the son of a socialist and a Russian Jewess in Stockholm in the 1920s is not the best, and Roland is 12 years old, not enough to calmly face a hostile environment. Neither does his older brother, an aspiring boxer, help him. Roland's only friend is a prostitute, and her strength is to be able to "invent" objects, including the sling made with two condoms, which will be useful to him. A resounding success and a lot of awards, in Sweden, for a pleasant film, with some original ideas (especially that of the slingshot), well acted and with its good morale in full evidence. And with the advantage of being an "alien" product.

title: Pee-wee's Big Adventure
actors: Pee Wee Herman (Paul Reubens), Elisabeth Daily, Mark Holton, Diane Salinger
description: Probably it was Francis, the hateful big boy next door, who stole Pee Wee's wonderful bicycle, who, in his search, has only the help of his dog Speck and Dottie, the bike shop assistant. Pee Wee leaves for the Alamo, makes curious encounters, sees his bicycle on television destined for a star and, finally, retrieves it. He'll make a movie out of it. Burton brings to the screen a famous character in the United States (theater and TV), a clown and a smash. The director adapts to the commercial needs of the client and prepares to do (much) better, but already gives some surreal paw (the trip to Hollywood, the use of Danny Elfman's music).

title: Limelight
actors: Charles Chaplin, Claire Bloom, Buster Keaton, Sydney Chaplin
description: He was a successful clown, but now he has lost his audience and seeks consolation in alcohol. One day he saves Teresa from suicide, a young dancer who a psychological crisis has made unable to move her legs. Calvero manages to give her the zest for life and now it is she who tries to help the elderly clown.
notes: Third last film by Chaplin (later "A King in New York" and "The Countess of Hong Kong" will come), but perhaps the last great masterpiece: a prodigy of romantic optimism and poignant bitterness. A great opportunity also for Elder Buster Keaton. And Claire Bloom is gorgeous.

title: Sunrise: A Song of Two Humans
actors: George O'Brien, Janet Gaynor, Margaret Livingston
description: The young farmer Ansass is fascinated by a woman who has come from the city and, on her advice, he prepares to kill his wife Indre, but then does not find the courage. The couple go to the city, where they spend a peaceful day. On their return, a storm overturns their boat and, while Ansass is saved, Indre disappears into the water. She will be found unconscious, and the marriage of the two is again safe. The German Friedrich W. Murnau on his American debut creates a work of admirable technical skill (note the long trolley on the tram), with images of strong suggestion. Three Oscars for the film, but a weak success with the public.

title: Le bossu
actors: Jean Marais, Bourvil, Jean Le Poulain, Sabina Selman
description: Isabella of Caylus, secretly married to Philip of Nevers, is threatened by the sinister prince Gonzaga and must entrust their little Aurora to her husband. Gonzaga kills Philip, who, before dying, entrusts the child to his friend Henri de Lagardère. It is only the beginning of a series of dramatic events that will end, years later, with the punishment of the wicked and the victory of the deserving.
notes: A classic "swashbuckling" film that brings Paul Féval's novel to the screen for the fourth time. Jean Marais at his best is the star of this film for fans of the genre.

title: Seventh Cavalry
actors: Randolph Scott, Barbara Hale, Jay C. Flippen
description: Captain Tom Benson, who accidentally escaped the Little Big Horn massacre, is considered a coward. He then offers himself as a volunteer to carry out a very dangerous mission: to penetrate into Indian territory and recover the body of General Custer. A low-cost action film specialist directs the star of small homemade westerns. To the delight of fans.

title: Man in the Saddle
actors: Randolph Scott, Ellen Drew, Joan Leslie, Alexander Knox
description: Owen, a small ranch owner, is unfortunate enough to have a wealthy neighbor who is overbearing and jealous of his wife, who torments him by unleashing his bravadoes on him. The violence multiplies, Owen is forced to take refuge in a lonely place with the village teacher ...

title: Night of the Comet
actors: Catherine Mary Stewart, Kelli Maroney, Robert Beltran
description: The return of a comet, the same that caused the extinction of the dinosaurs in the passage of millions of years ago, almost completely destroys humanity on Earth. Among the few survivors, two bad California girls ... Tasty low cost film, tinged with irony, which reserves some good moments of thrill.

title: Snoopy, Come Home
description: The dog Snoopy finds the horizons of his kennel rather limited. So, together with the little bird Woodstock he decides to go to know America. The irreverent and caustic vision of the life of one of the most famous characters of the "Peanuts" becomes a flat and monotonous cartoon, which fails to fully render the fulinee stripes.

title: Delirious
actors: John Candy, Emma Samms, Mariel Hemingway, Raymond Burr
description: Jack Gable, author of the lyrics for a show titled "Beyond Your Dreams", has an unrequited infatuation with the now mature star Rachel, but one day he meets the one who will be the real girl of his dreams: the aspiring actress Janet. A blow to the head sends Jack into a fantastic dimension where, as a Wall Street shark, he must split between the two women. The idea is to play with the fictional reality relationship, starting from the golden world of soap operas. The story is a little too complicated, the cast is showy but the result a little less. Poor John Candy certainly had better opportunities.

title: Our Hospitality
actors: Buster Keaton, Natalie Talmadge, Buster Keaton jr., Joseph Keaton
description: The Canfields and the McKays hate each other. Will McKay, who grew up in New York, arrives in his hometown, where the last scion of the Canfields (but he doesn't know it) invites him to dinner. When the others in the family recognize him they would like to kill him, but the patriarch, in the name of the laws of hospitality, forbids this from happening under his roof. Jewel of the Golden Age by Keaton, a film made up of gimmicks and paradoxical humor. The unflappable actor is involved in an absurd world, and the great director directs with dizzying pace and an ironic eye towards the Old West. Also known as "Accidentoi what hospitality!".

title: Santa Claus - The Movie
actors: John Lithgow, Dudley Moore, David Huddleston, Burgess Meredith
description: A few centuries ago Claus and Anya were two nice old men who made Christmas toys for the children of the village. After welcoming them into their world, the Elves name him Santa Claus. And we are in our day; Santa has to save his bungling helper from a cynical industrialist who intends to speculate on children's dreams.
notes: Rugged super meatloaf, made with a view to Christmas consumption but which failed to involve anyone. The brightest idea lies in the cast choices: Dudley Moore as the goofy gnome. Beautiful sets.

title: Vivi o preferibilmente morti
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Nino Benvenuti, Sydne Rome, Cris Huerta
description: To collect their grandfather's inheritance (three hundred thousand dollars), the two cousins ??Monty and Ted Mulligan have to live together for six months. The two are quite different in habits and character. Nonetheless, they team up to kidnap a banker's daughter and to seize a shipment of gold. In both cases, their criminal intentions fail miserably and the two are forced to take sides with the law.
notes: Comedy western comedy written by Ennio Flaiano and directed with brio by Duccio Tessari. Among the performers, in addition to Giuliano Gemma, the unusual presence of the boxer Nino Benvenuti should be noted, but he proves to feel much more at ease in the ring.

title: The King and I
actors: Yul Brynner, Deborah Kerr, Rita Moreno, Martin Benson, Terry Saunders
description: The king of the backward state of Siam knows well that his country needs to open up to the spread of Western civilization. For this he decides to entrust the education of his children to Anna Lenowens, a widow who seeks new life in the East. Despite the difference in character, the king and Anna end up appreciating each other to the point that the woman becomes the sovereign's adviser and intermediary in relations with foreign nations. Based on the musical comedy by Rodgers and Hammerstein, the film won five Oscars in its time (actor, set design, costumes, musical direction, sound, noting above all for the interpretation of Yul Brynner. In its own way a classic of Christmas television programming .

title: Oliver!
actors: Ron Moody, Oliver Reed, Shani Wallis, Mark Lester, Jack Wild, Harry Secombe
description: The orphan Oliver Twist reaches London where he makes friends with "the Straight" who leads him to his house, an old attic. Here live the boys, led by old Fagin, who uses them to carry out a series of thefts. Accused of a theft committed by his companions, Oliver is taken under the protection of a wealthy gentleman, but fearing that the boy may denounce everyone, Fagin kidnaps him and brings him back to the attic ... It is a clever adaptation of the classic Dickensian immortal in musical comedy version. Upon its release, a huge success; won six Oscars (best film, direction, music, set design, sound and choreography).

title: Pardon Us
actors: Stan Laurel, Oliver Hardy, James Finlayson, June Marlowe, Wilfred Lucas
description: In a penal bathroom, Laurel and Hardy have a first problem with the prison dentist due to a "whistling" tooth. Then they find themselves in the midst of a group of rioters. It will be the clumsiness of the two to make the revolt fail.
notes: The couple Stan Laurel and Oliver Hardy in a movie from their prime.

title: The French Lieutenant's Woman
actors: Meryl Streep, Jeremy Irons, Leo McKern, Emily Morgan, Patience Collier, Hilton McRae, Charlotte Mitchell, Lynsey Baxter, Jean Faulds, Peter Vaughan, Colin Jeavons, Liz Smith, John Barrett, Leo McKern
description: In Victorian England, housekeeper Sarah Woodruff is banished from the community and shunned by all for shaming herself with a French lieutenant. Everyone thinks she is crazy, but for this very reason she can wander alone at all hours, unlike other women. When one day Charles saves her from the stormy sea, the love story begins that is intertwined with that of the same two interpreters of the film.

title: Hell on Frisco Bay
actors: Alan Ladd, Edward G. Robinson, Jayne Mansfield
description: Police officer Steve Rollins, convicted of a crime he did not commit, leaves prison after serving his sentence determined to find the real culprits. His suspicions are directed towards a major shipowner of the port of San Francisco, Vic Amato, who has long imposed his dominion over the bay. During the search, all the people who could provide evidence for Steve begin to mysteriously disappear. Good movie about gangster domination in the 1930s. Robinson, with his evil character, once again provides his fair share of violence and malice.

title: Rent a Kid
actors: Leslie Nielsen, Christopher Lloyd, Sherry Miller, Tabitha Lupien
description: Harry Haber, a retired traveling salesman, has always been what one might call a likeable cheater. When his son, the director of an orphanage, leaves for the holidays, he takes the opportunity to "rent" the children to anyone who is interested. The Syracuse, a pair of career professionals and their first clients, agree on a favorable price and take away three little ones for the price of one. A kind of comedy of manners, this film is nothing more than a rather merciless satire on the world of adoptions and on the cynicism of would-be parents. Nielsen works.

title: Last Man Standing
actors: Jeff Wincott, Jillian McWhirter, Steve Eastin, Robert LaSardo
description: Kurt, private investigator, one bad day falls in a town where two gangs have been fighting for a long time. With clever double-cross maneuvers, he manages to make the two factions slaughter each other, restoring peace to the city.
notes: Yet another transposition from Hammett's novel _Red Harvest_.

title: Battlestar Galactica
actors: Richard Hatch, Dirk Benedict, Lorne Greene, Herb Jefferson jr
description: A spaceship collects the survivors of an endangered human colony on a distant planet, and embarks on a perilous odyssey to return to Earth. Very disappointing film in terms of ideas, with some discreet special effects in the style of "Star Wars", it takes up a segment of five episodes of a television series ("Galactica") that is already quite tasteless on the small screen.

title: A Christmas Story
actors: Peter Billingsley, Melinda Dillon, Darren McGavin, Scott Schwartz
description: In a small Indiana town in the 1940s, a little boy's greatest wish is to receive a shotgun as a Christmas present. From a novel by Jean Sheperd, who collaborates on the screenplay, the story is told almost without intertwining and spreads nostalgic moods with both hands. The director is that of "Porky's".

title: Upperseven. L'uomo da uccidere
actors: Paul Hubschmid, Karin Dor, Vivi Bach
description: Criminal organization serving the Communist bloc wants to sabotage American peacekeeping in Africa. To settle things, flying from Switzerland to Denmark, from Rome to South Africa, there is a beautiful blonde from the CIA and the British agent Upperseven, very skilled in dressing up. Penoso 007 local, written and directed by Alberto De Martino.

title: Wonder Woman
actors: Lynda Carter, Cathy Lee Crosby, Kaz Garas, Ricardo Montalban
description: Wonder Woman puts her superpowers at the service of justice, recovering some very important documents stolen by an international spy as fascinating as she is cruel.
notes: After the successful television series starring Lynda Carter herself, a TV movie with a new adventure of the comic book heroine created in the 1940s.

title: Come perdere una moglie e trovare un'amante
actors: Johnny Dorelli, Barbara Bouchet, Felice Andreasi, Stefania Casini
description: Having found his wife in bed with the plumber, Alberto Castelli, manager of a Roman milk industry, entrusts himself to the care of a doctor who sends him to Val Malenco to a cabin inhabited by a couple: erotic adventures in sight ...
notes: A little more cunning in proposing sheepish situations and daring dialogues, but we are always there.

title: Alexandre le bienheureux
actors: Philippe Noiret, Françoise Brion, Marlène Jobert, Paul Le Person
description: Anguished by an authoritarian and inflexible wife who forces him to work like a beast in the fields, Alexandre finally feels free when his better half perishes in a car accident. And he decides to spend the rest of his life in bed, in absolute inactivity. Now whoever gets him food) Gaspare, a dog of superior intelligence, who shuttles between the grocery store and his master's bed every day. In this way, however, the fields go to ruin, arousing the anger of Stanghetta, a hard worker. A great protagonist for a film that can be funny and, at the same time, quite naughty.

title: Languidi baci... perfide carezze
actors: Giovanna Ralli, Gigi Proietti, Cristiano Censi, Giacomo Rizzi
description: Orpheus, accidentally escaped from prison, takes refuge in the villa of Elena, the wife of a surgeon, whom he met in prison. One day, Elena gives in to the court of Orpheus, but is then overcome with remorse, and, on the advice of her confessor, tries to kill him.
notes: A bright first half, a more difficult second half.

title: Richie Rich
actors: Macaulay Culkin, John Larroquette, Edward Herrmann, Christine Ebersole
description: The wealth of the Rich family amounts to about 70 billion dollars, cent plus cent less, but the young Richie begins to get tired of the life of a nabob that cuts him off from the world. When a treacherous individual, taking advantage of the forced absence of his bosses, tries to rob him of his wealth, Richie manages to foil the trap. And, in the meantime, he discovered the existence of the poor. Poor (?) Macaulay Culkin forced to cheat on age (he's from 1980) in a film that takes up a Harvey Comics strip from the seventies, with a few tasty ideas drowned in a sea of ??platitudes. Good parody of the heads of Mount Rushmore.

title: Disclosure
actors: Michael Douglas, Demi Moore, Donald Sutherland, Caroline Goodall, Roma Maffia, Dylan Baker, Rosemary Forsyth, Dennis Miller, Suzie Plakson, Nicholas Sadler
description: Tom Sanders (Douglas), an executive at a large computer company, gets a promotion from the enterprising Meredith Johnson (Moore), with whom he had a hot relationship ten years ago. And while she would like to pick things up where they left off, he's no longer of the opinion. So it is Meredith who sues Tom for sexual harassment with the intention of ruining him.
notes: Michael Crichton's novel is not the writer's best; the film is certainly not Levinson's best (responsible for the sensational "Toys" flop); Douglas's performance is arguably his worst in years, not to mention Moore's.

title: Black Beauty
actors: Sean Bean, David Thewlis, Jim Carter, Peter Davison, Alun Armstrong, Anthony Walters
description: Now elderly, the old thoroughbred Black Beauty remembers and reviews his entire life as a horse. From childhood spent in the countryside and from the first terrible masters, members of the aristocracy, to his experience as a coachman in Victorian working-class London. From his relationship with the coachman Jerry Barker and the two years he spent pulling heavy wagons, to the final well-deserved "retirement" on a farm in the countryside. The character of the horse Black Beauty, the protagonist of Anna Sewell's novel, had been transposed on the screen before, but never with this fidelity to the original text. Note: the story is told from the animal's point of view. Thompson and Danny Elfman were Tim Burton's screenwriter and musician.

title: Lassie
actors: Thomas Guiry, Helen Slater, Jon Tenney, Brittany Boyd, Frederic Forrest
description: When Steve Turner informs his family that he needs to move from Baltimore to his latest wife's farm in the countryside, his little daughter Laura is thrilled. Not so, however, the adolescent and rebellious son Matthew. On the road that leads them to the new house, however, they will meet the dog Lassie. Thanks largely to the company of the very intelligent animal, the family will adapt quickly to change.
notes: It is one of the most recent transpositions on the big screen in which the legendary collie is the protagonist. The result is discreet, and the director offers a fairly convincing description of a family's daily problems.

title: The Land Before Time II: The Great Valley Adventure
description: In the great valley, the peaceful life of a dinosaur community flows with great tranquility. For the young brontosaurus Foot, together with his friends and the little dinosaur T-Rex, the trouble begins as soon as the curious Cera convinces him to follow him into the mysterious afterlife, where they will meet the two ostriches Strut and Ozzie, the sharp-toothed tyrannosaurus and a mysterious egg about to hatch. It is the second episode of an animated series directed by Don Bluth (there is also a third part). Directed to an audience of children, it is fun and adventurous at the same time, with particular attention paid to the characterization of the characters.

title: Marooned
actors: Gregory Peck, Richard Crenna, Gene Hackman, David Janssen
description: After five months on an orbiting station, three US astronauts are unable to return to Earth due to a failure. NASA does not want to send help to avoid risks, but a young scientist leaves alone on a shuttle to reach the station. Here, the commander tries everything to save the other two ...
notes: That John Sturges gave his best in the western and its surroundings (_Challenge all'O.K. Corral_, _The magnificent seven_) is no mystery. Here he is entrusted with the task of building suspense in a space setting that is as realistic as possible, and he performs by putting his whole craft into play.

title: Cammina cammina
actors: Alberto Fumagalli, Antonio Cucciarrè, Eligio Martellucci, Renzo Somminiatesi
description: Starting from a popular representation of the Magi, a new narrative develops of the journey of the three characters to the place where the newborn Savior is found, of the delivery of gifts and of the snare that comes from the "power" of men. It is not one of Olmi's most successful films, even if his message for a faith not subject to earthly hierarchies is unequivocal.

title: Quatre nuits d'un rêveur
actors: Isabelle Weingarten, Guillaume des Forêts, Jean-Maurice Monnoyer, Jérôme Massart
description: Jacques, one night, saves Martha from suicide from the Pont Neuf in Paris and, in the next three, the girl tells him of her love for a man who had rented a room in her house and who had left with the unfulfilled promise of return. But here is the man, and Jacques is left alone. From Dostoevsky's "White Nights", a transposition of intense and impeccable rigor, a sort of Bresson's "vacation" from his religious themes towards a dream dimension. A minor film, but not spurious with respect to the author's path.

title: Banshun
actors: Chishu Ryu, Setsuko Hara, Yameji Tsukioka, Haruko Sugimura
description: The elderly widower Shikichi pretends to be willing to remarry; but it is only an expedient to convince the very affectionate daughter Noriko to marry herself and not to sacrifice her own existence to stay close to her father. Masterpiece of one of the most important authors of Japanese cinema in his admirable style, limpid and dry, of prodigious essentiality.

title: The Killing Kind
actors: John Savage, Ann Sothern, Ruth Roman
description: He has just come out of prison, and he is eager to take revenge on those who put it in it. This is why a young ex -prisoner immediately begins to persecute the district prosecutor and the same lawyer of the defense, guilty according to him that he has not defended him enough. Non -original plot, but directed with an excellent hand from an ex pupil of the Corman school.

title: Panther
actors: Kadeem Hardison, Bokeem Woodbine, Joe Don Baker
description: In the sixties, Judge is a twenty-year-old who, witnessing the police repression against blacks, begins to side with the Black Panthers movement. The local authority contacts him to try to make him an infiltrated spy. The young man soon ends up finding himself in the uncomfortable position of the fragile individual, caught in the midst of the violence and extremism that follow one another on both sides. Van Peebles ("Posse") tackles, with the invention of the character of Judge, a subject that is anything but pacified in the American memory of the last thirty years. A film very "felt" by its director and which offers vigorous discussion points.

title: A Personal Journey with Martin Scorsese Through American Movies
description: The splendor of the Hollywood studios in the golden age the absolute power of the producers; the great directors of westerns (Ford, Mann, Boetticher), gangster films (Walsh, Haskin) and musicals (Curtiz, Minnelli); the wonders of technology at work in the dream factory; an acrobatic overview of films and directors who have made American cinema great and built the imagery of this century. A sparkling tribute to the first hundred years of cinema signed by one of the greatest filmmakers of today: a very personal and virtuosic reinterpretation from which references, obsessions, love at first sight, venerations of the Italian-American director emerge.

title: Love Affair
actors: Warren Beatty, Annette Bening, Katharine Hepburn, Garry Shandling, Pierce Brosnan
description: Mike, a former football champion, and Terry (engaged to a big in finance) meet on the flight to Sydney. An unexpected stop in Tahiti favors the birth of love and the two meet at the Empire State Building. But Terry, hit by a car, can't be there.
notes: Leo McCarey shot this story twice, in 1939 (with Irene Dunne and Charles Boyer) and then in 1959 (with Cary Grant and Deborah Kerr) and both versions were markedly better than this third, both in direction and performance.

title: Sugar Hill
actors: Wesley Snipes, Michael Wright, Theresa Randle, Clarence Williams III
description: The "colored" Roemello and Raynathan Skuggs are brothers, sons of a mother who died of an overdose and a drug addict father, and both of them are among the most important drug dealers in Harlem. The first is tired of this life, and the meeting with the splendid Melissa is another opportunity to get out of the loop.
notes: In a context that traces the stereotypes of the black gangster film, remarkable moments emerge (such as the death of his father), a wonderful music column (by Terence Blanchard) and the merits of photography (by Bojan Bazelli).

title: Love in the Afternoon
actors: Gary Cooper, Audrey Hepburn, Maurice Chevalier, John McGiver
description: Arianna, daughter of a Parisian private investigator who watches over the wife of a banker on behalf of her husband, learns that the man intends to kill her wife and her lover, the American billionaire Flannagan. Arianna warns him and falls in love with him. But before the plot ends according to the rules, the girl will have to put all her cunning into play.
notes: It is the first collaboration between Billy Wilder and screenwriter I.A.L. Diamond, who will form an inseparable couple from now on, churning out masterpieces of brilliant "perfidy" in a chain. On this basis, with these performers, an excellent film.

title: Il processo di Verona
actors: Silvana Mangano, Frank Wolff, Salvo Randone, Françoise Prevost
description: In 1943, five members of the Fascist Grand Council voted on an agenda that defeated Mussolini. Among these there is also Galeazzo Ciano, son-in-law of the Duce. Indicted for rebellion, the five are jailed in Verona and put on trial. In vain, Ciano's wife tries to negotiate with the Germans to save her husband's life. Not even the request for pardon (which will never reach its destination) will be able to stop the machine of "justice". The director Lizzani has made with this film one of his best works and a chilling portrait of the fascist regime, seen through the family drama of Edda Mussolini Ciano.

title: Beyond Forgiveness
actors: Thomas Ian Griffith, Joanna Trzepiecinska, Rutger Hauer, John Rhys-Davies
description: Frank Wushinsky, of Polish origin, is part of the Chicago police. When some killers from Poland kill his brother, he goes to Warsaw to find out the culprits. Investigations lead him to a shady trade in transplant organs and, with the help of Sergeant Shmuda, Frank succeeds in his mission despite the initial hostility of other members of the local police. The performance of Rutger Hauer (who has always accepted everything they offer him, for better or for worse), here completely embodied in the role of the "bad guy", is the paradigm of a film that collects everything in the cinema should instead be banned for law.

title: La strega in amore
actors: Rosanna Schiaffino, Gian Maria Volonté, Richard Johnson, Sarah Ferrati
description: Behind a generous reward Sergio, a journalist in a sentimental crisis, agrees to tidy up the library of an elderly and mysterious lady. He therefore goes to the building where the woman lives and here, between endless rooms and dusty old codes, he meets the fascinating Aura. But the young woman, with whom he immediately falls in love, is only the incarnation of the old landlady.
notes: Superficial eroticism and mystery that does not give chills. The story is inspired by a novel by Carlos Fuentes.

title: Per amore... per magia...
actors: Gianni Morandi, Rosemarie Dexter, Mischa Auer
description: Aladino (Gianni Morandi) is a young thief who marries Princess Esmeralda, loves her and is loved in return. Jealous, a treacherous viscount, joins forces with the terrible Maghreb wizard. The diabolical couple kidnaps Esmeralda, and Aladdin will have to face his enemies with the only help of his courage and thieving friends. Seventh film in Morandi's career, the first film that deviates from the "musicarello" genre.

title: Jeff
