actors: Alain Delon, Mireille Darc, Georges Rouquier, Gabriel Jabbour, Suzanne Flon, Natalie Nerval
description: After a jewelery robbery, leader Jeff takes off with the loot and leaves his partners with a dry beak. These chase him, but they find themselves dealing with Laurent, faithful right arm and accomplice of the I flee. The deal is complicated because, fatally, there is a beautiful and unfaithful woman.
notes: A French gangster story, without surprises but quite solid. With Alain Delon and Mireille Darc.

title: Al piacere di rivederla
actors: Miou-Miou, Ugo Tognazzi, Françoise Fabian, Alberto Lionello, Paolo Bonacelli
description: Cesare Bonfigli, patriarch of a family of real estate and welfare businessmen, dies in rather obscure circumstances. Mario Aldara, a ministerial official who in his youth had been engaged to the wife of the deceased, investigates what increasingly appears to be a crime. The secrets of the corrupt Bonfigli family all come to the surface ...
notes: Unfair and uncertain between denunciation and satire, Leto's film confirms the director's difficulty in expressing himself fully. Fortunately, to give a minimum of dignity to the film, there is the great Ugo Tognazzi.

title: The Caine Mutiny
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Van Johnson, Fred MacMurray, José Ferrer, Robert Francis
description: In the middle of the World War on the "Caine" minesweeper the order is not the best. Commander De Vriess is replaced by Captain Queeg, a tough man with an unstable balance. The other officers forcefully dismiss him; for this real mutiny they are tried. They will be acquitted, but the defense officer himself will say that Queeg is actually worth a lot more than them.
notes: Tense and ambiguous film on the military obligation to obey, even in the face of the doubt of madness. The screenplay is enriched with a "pedagogical" element by introducing an external point of view. Great all the performers, in particular Bogart (Queeg).

title: Notre Dame de Paris
actors: Gina Lollobrigida, Anthony Quinn, Alain Cuny, Robert Hirsch
description: In 1486, in Paris, the alchemist Frollo lives in the cathedral of Notre Dame with the monstrous bell ringer Quasimodo. In love with Esmeralda, who however loves Captain Febo, Frollo stabs Febo and then contributes to Esmeralda's death sentence as a witch. Quasimodo kidnaps the woman and hides her in the cathedral. From the famous novel by Hugo now revisited in cartoons, it is the third version, after those of Wallace Worlsey (1923) and Dieterle (1939). The sets and costumes are gorgeous; Gina Lollobrigida proposes herself in all her sensuality.

title: Les parents terribles
actors: Jean Marais, Yvonne De Bray, Gabrielle Dorziat, Josette Day
description: Yvonne loves her son Michel morbidly. Michel falls in love with Madeleine, who has a mature protector (Georges, Michel's father). The latter forces Madeleine to confess to Michel that she has a third lover (who, however, does not exist). The truth will come out and then the two young people can get married, but, immediately after the wedding, Yvonne commits suicide.
notes: Drawing the cinematic script from his own theatrical drama, Cocteau directs Jean Marais in a dark, baroque film. Not new to plumbing the abysses of the human psyche, the poet-director creates one of his masterpieces.

title: Ad ogni costo
actors: Janet Leigh, Robert Hoffman, Klaus Kinski, Edward G. Robinson, Adolfo Celi
description: James, who has been teaching in Brazil for thirty years, just returned to the United States makes an agreement with Milford for a "blow" to the Brazilian diamond company. Once the necessary accomplices have been found, the criminal action succeeds perfectly, despite some hitches, which have been overcome properly. But now a chain of kills begins, with a final double surprise. The devil, you know, makes the pots, but not the lids ...
notes: Famous actors for a film that, alongside unoriginal situations, also knows how to present moments of inventive autonomy. It is all a "game" (despite the numerous corpses) conducted with fluency and skill, which knows how to make itself discreetly enjoyable.

title: Dark Star
actors: Brian Narelle, Dre Parich, Dan O'Bannon, Joe Saunders
description: In the 21st century the spaceship "Dark Star" with four crewmen on board, is involved in the search and destruction of unstable planets and stars. Between one bombing and the next, life is a monotonous edge until the moment when an alien element wreaks havoc. Plus a computer failure sets off a bomb. Doolittle then "talks" with the bomb to convince it not to explode but, when he seems to have succeeded ... Born as a university short film-essay, the film is only completed later. It is a small masterpiece of the genre created with intelligence and irony towards cinema and the American Dream.

title: King of the Khyber Rifles
actors: Tyrone Power, Terry Moore, Michael Rennie
description: An English garrison, stationed in a mountainous region of India, is besieged by a band of rebels. They are convinced that destroying the garrison will put an end to English rule. Captain King, frowned upon because he is of mixed blood and because he is in love with the commander's daughter, asks for permission to venture outside to try to kill the rebel leader. His action fails, but the information gathered by King will lead to the defeat of the rioters. A classic adventure film that mixes military and sentimental themes: all against the backdrop of Indian landscapes.

title: The Earthling
actors: William Holden, Ricky Schroder, Jack Thompson, Olivia Hamnett
description: Patrick Foley, who in his life has done a little 'all the trades, on the threshold of old age returns to Australia, where he was born. Here he meets the child Ricky Daley, a spoiled and rebellious brat, raised in the comforts of the city, orphaned following an accident. Of bad grace, Patrick takes him with him. The forced coexistence will benefit both.
notes: This is the last film by Peter Collinson, who died at the age of 44. The fairy tale is mushy, the landscapes are gorgeous, Ricky Schroeder was an unbearable child prodigy and Holden a wonderfully sunset actor. Average a little.

title: Desperate Trail
actors: Sam Elliott, Linda Fiorentino, Craig Sheffer
description: Nothing seems to distract an inexorable sheriff from the decision to hand over a beautiful outlaw to the executioner. But she escapes with a kind and brave bandit. Thus began the chase.
notes: Solid well-performed television western, with some strong sequences and some surprises in the finale.

title: Da Do Da - Da una sponda all'altra
actors: Totò Onnis, Gilla Novak, Donato Castellaneta
description: The god Jupiter still exists and falls in love with the Statue of Liberty, which he believes to be an ancient flame that has disappeared in the oceans. Juno is jealous and instructs the people closest to Olympus, the Apulians, to kidnap the new passion of her divine husband. A film without rhyme or reason, the second feature by the Bari-based director Nico Cirasola who is also its co-writer. The starting idea is not bad, it is a pity that everything is ruined by a too much television style and by actors that we find it very difficult to define as such.

title: Ladri si nasce
actors: Pippo Franco, Serena Grandi, Eva Grimaldi, Leo Gullotta, Oreste Lionello, Daniele Formica
description: The story of a bribe, actually not that big at first (just half a million), which passes from hand to hand through the most disparate characters. His "wanderings" range from a trader to a professor, to a trade unionist, from a bureaucrat to a singer to a politician, increasing in value and finally running aground in the pockets of a character who will pay the price for everyone.
notes: As if the show wasn't enough, here are the "heroes" of Bagaglino in fictional sauce. A vaguely topical idea, coarse-grained humor and a filigree moralistic "shot". All with the usual "finesse" of ours. Abstinence is recommended.

title: Una stagione all'inferno
actors: Terence Stamp, Florinda Bolkan, Jean-Claude Brialy
description: The young poet Rimbaud, after having participated in the Paris Commune, forms a bond with Verlaine, which however does not last long. Disappointed by the poem, he leaves for Africa, where he trades in slaves and weapons until his return to Europe and an early death. Biography of the French poet, a little chilly, but with some reason of interest. However much better than the recent Holland version.

title: The Ghost and Mrs Muir
actors: Gene Tierney, Rex Harrison, George Sanders, Edna Best
description: Lucy Muir, a young widow, moves into a house by the sea inhabited by the ghost of a navy captain. When he realizes the fact, the woman is overcome with dismay and thinks of running away, but the ghost is a gentleman and the two soon become excellent friends. Without Captain Lucy she can no longer do anything and he lovingly guides her through her most difficult choices. Very large, poignant melodrama with surreal tones and typically Anglo-Saxon touches of comedy. The script is also very well served by both the director and the performers, all of high class.

title: The Purple Rose of Cairo
actors: Mia Farrow, Jeff Daniels, Danny Aiello, Dianne Wiest, Van Johnson
description: During the great depression of the Thirties, Cecilia, married to an obtuse bullying male chauvinist, finds consolation for her miserable existence by letting herself be fascinated by the films she witnesses. One day, from the screen on which "The Purple Rose of Cairo" is projected, the protagonist "comes out" and goes outside with Cecilia. It is chaos in the room, but it is a dream break for the young woman.
notes: Allen in one of his directorial summits: an amusing and amusing tribute to cinema, a delicious delicacy of storytelling, a very fine humor imbued with subtle melancholy. A masterful work, in which the homage to the cinema of the past is not separated from the bitterness of the defeat of small and losing characters.

title: Killing Zoe
actors: Eric Stoltz, Julie Delpy, Jean-Hugues Anglade, Gary Kemp
description: Zed was called to Paris, from the US, by his partner Eric to rob a bank. The company is very difficult and the two are not particularly skilled, so that immediately they are forced to sow death among the people imprisoned within the credit institution. Zed finds in the bank Zoe, a prostitute he met the previous evening, and the two will get away with the general massacre. Avary says he wrote the script for his film in a week. If that's true, hats off. And hats off to his narrative rhythm, to the ease with which he moves the camera, in short, to how he does cinema.

title: Monkey Trouble
actors: Thora Birch, Harvey Keitel, Mimi Rogers, Christopher McDonald, Adam Lavorgna
description: Zampalesta is a Capuchin monkey that its master has trained to carry out thefts. The "thief" is skilled enough to attract the attention of a gang of gangsters who are planning a colossal heist. But Zampalesta, tired of mistreatment, runs away and finds refuge in the home of a girl in a crisis of jealousy for her newborn brother. Amurri is the director of "Da grande" (with Pozzetto). Moving to Hollywood, he made a silly little movie for kids. Harvey Keitel is a little sorry.

title: Boiling Point
actors: Wesley Snipes, Dennis Hopper, Lolita Davidovich, Viggo Mortensen
description: Red returns to Hollywood in the company of young Ronnie, whom he met in prison. The two have a plan: Ronnie will take charge of trading counterfeit currency, so that he can finance a heist. But Ronnie kills a policeman and his colleague, Jemmy Mercer, goes on a hunt to avenge his friend. And it will give no respite to its prey, hunting them inside and outside the confines of the law. A narrative form with attempts at originality for a content that is the "summa" of the detective genre but, in a certain way, distorted and "parodied". More ambitious than successful, despite some interesting insights.

title: Irma la Douce
actors: Shirley MacLaine, Jack Lemmon, Lou Jacobi
description: Nestor, a former policeman, falls in love with Irma, a Parisian prostitute. She has a beer-loving dog, small eyes and green stockings, he has a heart of gold, but he's also pretty naive. To prevent her from practicing the profession, Nestor impersonates an elusive and very generous Mister X who will thus be her only client. Then Mister X disappears and Nestor is accused of his murder. But friend Mustache puts things right.
notes: Full pages would not be enough to tell this film with an overwhelming rhythm: from the feline twins, to the first fight in the bar, to Mustache, a philosopher bartender ("But that's another story"). One of Wilder's most thrilling films.

title: Quelqu'un derrière la porte
actors: Charles Bronson, Anthony Perkins, Jill Ireland, Henri Garcin
description: A psychiatrist betrayed by his wife takes advantage of a man suffering from amnesia to take revenge with impunity. He convinces him that he is the cuckold, prompting him to kill his rival. But, as they say, the devil makes the pots ...
notes: Perkins still in the role of psycho, but the rest is as unlikely as Bronson in the role of the psychiatrist.

title: Burning Secret
actors: Faye Dunaway, Klaus Maria Brandauer, David Eberts
description: Sonya, married to an American diplomat, lives in Vienna. To treat her son Edmund, who suffers from asthma, she leaves with him for a holiday in the mountains. The boy befriends a noble, who then starts courting Sonya. Debut of the director of "The cement garden". The departure is a story by the Viennese Stefan Zweig, already adapted by Siodmak and extensively designed by Stanley Kubrick; Birkin works above all on the interpretation, having two protagonists with a too "strong" presence, and on the setting. But the result is glossy and boring.

title: Liebelei
actors: Magda Schneider, Wolfgang Liebeneiner, Luise Ullrich
description: In Habsburg Vienna, at the turn of the century, the young Lieutenant Fritz was the mistress of a baroness. During a party, the meeting with a very young violinist, Christine, is fatal to him. In fact, a very deep love is born between the two that pushes Fritz to abandon his lover. Nevertheless, Baron Eggersdorf has decided to challenge the lieutenant to a duel. When Christine learns of Fritz's death, she kills herself. Beautiful film by Max Ophüls based on Amoretto by Arthur Schnitzler. The ending without dialogue is splendid, with Beethoven's symphonic background. The protagonist, at the very young time, Magda Schneider, Romy's mother.

title: U samogo sinego moria
actors: Elena Kuz'mina, Lev Sverdlin, Nikolaj Kriuchkov
description: After being shipwrecked, the two friends Alioche and Youssouf are saved by the inhabitants of a kolkoz located on a small island. Here both fall madly in love with the young Machenka, for whom they will become bitter rivals. Wonderful comedy about love and friendship between two young Soviets set in a vaguely utopian space. The use of natural exteriors was extraordinary, the parable was clear and tender, which cost the director fierce accusations (it was in full Stalinism).

title: Miss Mend
actors: Vladimir Fogel, Natal'ja Glan, Igor Ilyinskij, Boris Barnet
description: Film in three episodes. In the first, Miss Mend, who is a typist in a newspaper, escapes the Tsarist police after a street demonstration. Chased, she finds refuge in the home of a millionaire who takes a liking to her. In the second episode, Miss Mend's grandson is kidnapped by strangers. Her colleague Tom Hopkins helps her find him safe and sound. In the third, the head of a fascist organization tries to spread the plague among the population with a special device. He is stopped in time. Feullietton of Soviet action, in the tradition that goes from Fantomsa to Doctor Mabuse. In three episodes.

title: The Kremlin Letter
actors: Patrick O'Neal, Richard Boone, Bibi Andersson, Orson Welles, Max Von Sydow, Nigel Green, Dean Jagger, Raf Vallone
description: Charles Evans is a former officer hired by a spy organization to recover a letter sent by the Americans to the Kremlin, before it is intercepted by the Chinese. With his group, also composed of an adventurer and a girl, he settles in the apartment of Potkin, a Soviet agent. He, in the pay of the ruthless Colonel Kosnov, immediately betrays the group. But this is only the beginning of a complicated series of intrigues on an international scale. The plot of this spy movie is terribly complicated. In fact, Huston wants to provide a delusional portrait of the world of secret services, merciless not only towards the USSR but also towards America.

title: Dead Before Dawn
actors: G. W. Bailey, Cheryl Ladd, Jameson Parker, Kim Coates
description: After years of physical and emotional violence, Linda finds the courage to ask for a divorce from Robert. He wants to snatch her children and, failing to do so due to the skill of her lawyer, he turns to a killer. Linda has to fight an uneven fight, desperately alone, despite the intervention of the FBI who, however, fails to frame Robert. Will he really have to risk his life to keep his children? This television production thriller is based on a true story. The adaptation has no particular references: a variation on the theme of the family drama in raw colors, according to the canons of a genre quite in vogue lately.

title: 8 Seconds
actors: Luke Perry, Stephen Baldwin, Red Mitchell, Cynthia Geary
description: Lane Frost is a young man from Oklahoma who dreams of becoming a rodeo champion. Having learned the rudiments of this sport from his father, he begins to frequent its circuits by making friends with Tuff, his most dangerous opponent in the arena, and with Cody, a cowboy with a poetic soul. He falls in love with Kellie, marries her, and in 1987 wins the world bull riding championship ...
notes: The life and environment of a well-known rodeo star, who died in an accident in 1989, reconstructed in a sentimental and hagiographic key. Directing to the most common television standards acts as a sedative even on the most dramatic competition scenes.

title: The Shining Hour
actors: Joan Crawford, Melvyn Douglas, Margaret Sullavan
description: Rich landman marries a dancer and brings her with her in the family residence she divides with a married brother and a sister. The latter, irritated by the beauty and strong character of the new coming, matures feelings of hatred that will bring it to extreme gestures.
notes: Melodrama with the young and strong -willed Joan Crawford.

title: The Watcher in the Woods
actors: Bette Davis, Carroll Baker, David McCallum, Lynn-Holly Johnson
description: An American composer settles in an old English country house. Soon, the youngest daughter is haunted by terrible visions and experiences, apparently of supernatural origin. Disney production that, without appreciable results, tries to mix cuteness and thrill.

title: Airheads
actors: Steve Buscemi, Brendan Fraser, Joe Mantegna, Adam Sandler
description: Chazz, Rex and Pip are the three members of a hard rock band snubbed by record producers. One day the group has the opportunity to have their own song heard on a radio broadcast. So, faced with the snobbish behavior of the DJ of the broadcaster Chazz definitely loses his patience. Grab a water pistol and force airing. But other misadventures are lurking ... Lehmann's film is a funny satire on the world that revolves around hard rock music. Unrecognizable Steve Buscemi with the hair of a rock star. To report the cameo of the cult group White Zombie.

title: You Are My Everything
actors: Dan Dailey, Anne Baxter, Anne Revere
description: Hannah and her husband Tim are two famous silent film artists. With the birth of their first daughter Jane and the advent of sound, Hannah retires from the stage. The woman would like to remove her daughter from the world of entertainment. Against his wife's advice, Tim instead makes the little girl appear in one of the many musical films he stars in.
notes: Discreet musical comedy directed with a sure hand by a director usually active on the sets of western or action films. The result is flawless. The discreet cast performs well.

title: True Identity
actors: Lenny Henry, Frank Langella, Charles Lane, J.T. Walsh, Anne-Marie Johnson
description: Miles Pope is a black-skinned actor. His dream is to play the role of Shakespeare's Othello in America's most prestigious theaters, but to survive he has to adapt to the generic roles of petty thief in action movies. Power of the "Strasberg method" comes into contact with a real gangster whose secret identity he discovers. At this point the boss wants to eliminate him so that the poor actor must from the bottom of his repertoire to save his skin. Thanks to the make-up we see it transformed into a task sir ... white. Disney production for a slender comedy that makes fun of itself by making the verse of the most famous, and successful, "Tootsie".

title: The Cheyenne Social Club
actors: James Stewart, Henry Fonda, Shirley Jones, Robert Middleton
description: John inherited "something" down in Texas and sets off with his friend Harley to see what it is. When he realizes he has inherited the Cheyenne Social Club, a luxury brothel, he wants to turn it into a hotel. But she soon faced opposition from girls and the local population.
notes: Polite parody of the western genre with two super-luxury protagonists. The defect of the film, poor rhythm, the value, the wit in the dialogues.

title: Luci del varietà
actors: Carla Del Poggio, Peppino De Filippo, Giulietta Masina
description: After attending the variety show directed by the guitto Checco, Liliana, an attractive girl, leaves her village and joins the company. Success smiles at her from the start, to the point that a wealthy lawyer tries to break into her room during the night. Then when the group arrives in Rome, Liliana should be the soubrette. But he will soon abandon the old Checco to make his debut in a large magazine company.
notes: In his first film, directed jointly with Lattuada, Fellini pays homage with affection and irony to the world of variety. Particular for a very young Sophia Loren, who still signed herself with the real surname Lazzaro.

title: Payback
actors: C. Thomas Howell, Joan Severance, Marshall Bell, Richard Burgi
description: In prison, Oscar Bonsetter swears to his cellmate, dying in front of him, to avenge him by killing his attacker: a prison guard. So, when he finally gets out of prison, Oscar is more than determined in his intentions. But his revenge plan comes to a halt as he gets a ride in the car from the now handicapped guard and his handsome wife, Rose. The tension becomes more palpable as Oscar feels more and more attracted to Rose ...
notes: Erotic thriller, it does not give particular shocks, but it is crossed by a subtle vein of sadism more than evident in the character of the prison guard.

title: La ragazza di Cortina
actors: Vanessa Gravina, Isabel Russinova, Stefano Abbati, Paolo Calissano
description: A charming young woman sees the resurgence of the ghosts of a disturbing past from which she was convinced she had finally escaped ...
notes: First and last film by Maurizio Vanni who, after this first work, has made us lose all traces of himself. The production is by Sergio Martino, the screenplay is by his brother Luciano.

title: Day of the Badman
actors: Fred MacMurray, Joan Weldon, John Ericson
description: Four outlaws, belonging to the infamous Hayes family, arrive in a small village in the West. Their intention is to prevent the death sentence of Rud Hayes, a relative awaiting trial. For this they try to intimidate Sheriff Wiley, the jury and Judge Jim Scott himself. The citizens, terrified, would like to bow to the will of the bandits, but the sheriff disagrees. Also, Wiley's girlfriend is in love with Jim. It is a western by way and by profession, without great emotions. Incidentally, the cinemascope format is unmotivated, as the film takes place mostly indoors.

title: Delitto sull'autostrada
actors: Tomas Milian, Viola Valentino, Bombolo, Olimpia Di Nardo, Giorgio Trestini, Adriana Russo
description: Nico Giraldi (Milian) turns, after many other adventures, into a truck driver to sneak into a gang that raids at the expense of the Tir. The "case" leads Inspector Giraldi to meet the singer Anna, so that the tranquility of the protagonist's family runs, for this reason, some risks ... The usual Tomas Milian in the usual character of the inspector. The narrative is not superior to that of the other films in the series. Corbucci and his interpreter will also have a job, but they definitely waste it.

title: Treasure Island
actors: Charlton Heston, Christian Bale, Julian Glover, Christopher Lee, Oliver Reed
description: Young Jim and his mother make it by running a tavern in a coastal town. In the club a pirate is attacked and wounded and, chased away the attackers, the man - now dying - gives the two the map of his treasure, starting a great adventure: but also the pirate Long John Silver is interested in the loot, and will give the boy a lot of trouble ...
notes: Successful television production, faithful to Stevenson's immortal original text. Written and directed by Fraser C. Heston, Charlton's son (here as Long John Silver), with the great Christopher Lee and young Christian Bale. A curiosity: The sailing ship is the same as the _Gli mutinati del Bounty_.

title: The Evil Empire
actors: Christian Slater, Patrick Dempsey, Anthony Quinn, Chris Penn
description: We are in New York, in the years of prohibition. Charlie Luciano and Frank Costello, Italian Americans, team up with two Jews, Meyer and Benny, becoming the ras of the neighborhood and then the new stars of smuggling in the city. In the conquest of the territory they will have to deal with the boss Faranzano; the escalation of the war is unstoppable. Eventually Charlie "Lucky" Luciano will be the new boss. The years of organized crime around alcohol smuggling have made the history of cinema. This is a recent product that adds nothing to the topic, even if the setting is curated and the script works discreetly.

title: Il diario di una schizofrenica
actors: Ghislaine D'Orsay, Margarita Lozano, Marija Tocinowsky, Umberto Raho, Manlio Busoni
description: Anna is eighteen and has suffered from a mental illness since childhood that no cure has been able to solve. His parents don't want to leave any stone unturned. Anna is taken to Switzerland, where she is treated by Madame Blanche, a psychiatrist who uses non-traditional methods and great emotional participation. She will be the one to heal her. Upon release, the film, which had psychologist Franco Fornari as its consultant, caused great admiration.

title: Vampira
actors: David Niven, Teresa Graves, Jenne Linden, Nick Henson
description: Count Vladimir Dracula seeks the triple zero negative blood with which to resurrect Countess Vampira, immobilized for half a century following a transfusion of infected blood. Maybe some beautiful models are for you. Parody reinterpretation of the mythical vampire character and his macabre adventures. We laugh at times, and admire Niven's aplomb.

title: Die Puppe
actors: Ossi Oswalda, Hermann Thimig, Victor Janson, Max Kronert
description: To ingratiate himself with his wealthy uncle, Baron von Chanterelle, Lancelot must marry. But, being afraid of women, the young man organizes a fake wedding in which the bride is a human-sized doll made by Hilarius. Except, a misunderstanding happens. Inspired by Hoffman, Lubitsch creates an unusual and biting masterpiece (the heirs, the ambiguous apprentice, the transition from doll to woman, etc.).

title: The Forbidden Planet
actors: Walter Pidgeon, Anne Francis, Leslie Nielsen, Jack Kelly, Warren Stevens
description: In 2200 a space mission descends on Altair. In the whole planet, of an entire terrestrial colony only Professor Morbius and his daughter, served by the robot Robby, have survived the incursions of monstrous and mysterious entities. The astronauts begin to have some suspicions about the professor when they discover what the mysterious devices in the laboratory really are for.
notes: Classic of co-cinematographic science fiction, it is an imaginative reworking of Shakespeare's "Tempest", in a psychoanalytic key. One of the first "adult" examples of the genre, and one of the first robot characters on the screen. A small masterpiece.

title: Far From Home
actors: Mimi Rogers, Bruce Davison, Jesse Bradford, Tom Bower
description: Angus McCormick lives in Canada with dad John, who runs a transport company, and mom Katherine. Her life is peaceful, cheered up by the encounter with a stray Labrador dog who, despite Katherine's opposition, manages to take home. The animal and the boy become inseparable, and when Angus experiences a dangerous mishap at sea, it will be his four-legged friend who saves him in a daring way.
notes: The idea is among the most stereotyped that can be imagined, but the director develops it with amused measure. In the background, the splendid natural scenery of the great North American.

title: Executive Action
actors: Burt Lancaster, Robert Ryan, Will Geer
description: Some powerful Americans find John F. Kennedy's policy disastrous. In 1963, two shooting teams are tasked with solving the problem in Dallas. A mixture of fiction and real facts, a little confusing but not without efficacy. Written by Dalton Trumbo, a great screenwriter who was a victim of McCarthyism. The murder of the most beloved president by the Americans, still shrouded in mystery, leaves room for the most diverse reconstructions. Among the many, this is one of the most dignified and credible.

title: Rimase uno solo e fu la morte per tutti!
actors: Tony Kendall, James Rogers, Dean Stratford, Sophia Kammara
description: The leader of a gang of robbers manages to have Sheriff Dakota indicted and locked up in prison, accusing him of an assault on a stagecoach. Slim, Dakota's brother, will challenge the criminals at the cost of his own life and free the sheriff. Mediocre western spaghetti from the 1970s, with the addition of tragic-familiar connotations.

title: Bianco e nero
description: Montage documentary that, starting from archive images relating to the world war, reaches the rebirth of fascism, the workers' struggles of the sixties and seventies, together with the protests for the massacres in Piazza Fontana, Brescia and Italicus. The images are alternated with interviews with various protagonists, more or less known, of those historical events.

title: Galileo
actors: Topol, Edward Fox, Colin Blakely, Michael Lonsdale, Tom Conti
description: The Church's review of the crucial moments of the trial against Galileo Galilei. From Brecht's play, which Losey had already staged on stage 27 years earlier, the director creates an extremely spoken and claustrophobic cinematic work. The relationship between Brecht and cinema remains unsolved.

title: Non aspettare Django, spara
actors: Sean Todd, Pedro Sanchez, Rada Rassimov
description: Django chases the bandits who killed his father, robbing him of a hundred thousand dollars. He kills them, but has yet to deal with the cruel principal. Fortunately, between one shooting and the next, he made a precious friend. A film that belongs to a vast catalog of miseries, in the vein of the Italian western.

title: Le bonheur est dans le pré
actors: Michel Serrault, Eddy Mitchell, Carmen Maura, Sabine Azéma
description: Francis lives a difficult and neurotic existence, squeezed between the strikes of his employees and the hysteria of an unbearable wife. His friend Gérard, cynical and uninhibited, is the only one who understands him and gives him serenity. After a heart attack Francis spends a few days stopped at home, and witnessing a transmission like "Who has seen it", he discovers the existence of his double, who has been missing for years and is desperately sought by a loving wife. Gérard convinces him to replace the deceased: it is the beginning of a new life and a new serenity, even if built on misunderstandings.
notes: Very pleasant French comedy starring the veteran Serrault, with bad ideas and a good rhythm.

title: Carla's Song
actors: Robert Carlyle, Oyanka Cabezas, Scott Glenn, Salvador Espinoza
description: George, a Glasgow bus driver, accidentally meets a girl, Carla, who has had to leave Nicaragua. The girl, who in the meantime has fallen in love with George, cannot forget her country of origin and her ex-boyfriend. The man decides to accompany her on her journey.
notes: The meeting between two young people from different cultures, with linguistic stammering, feelings told with eyes and gestures, sudden poetry. The film starts well; pity that Loach weighs down the part set in Nicaragua with excessive didacticism.

title: Striptease
actors: Demi Moore, Burt Reynolds, Armand Assante
description: Erin Grant is a former FBI employee; she is divorced and custody of her seven-year-old daughter, Angela, has been removed. To raise the money she needs to regain custody of Angela Erin begins performing as a stripper
notes: "Striptease" is meant to be not so much a "hard" film as a comedy that combines sex, politics, and thriller. It is neither one thing nor the other: it is just a "mess" made up of easy jokes and even easier moralisms, with a set of clichés that are now outdated even for Americans. On top of that, Demi Moore's stripteases are the least sexy you can imagine.

title: Mission: Impossible
actors: Tom Cruise, Jon Voight, Emmanuelle Béart, Jean Reno, Vanessa Redgrave, Kristin Scott Thomas
description: A former Russian spy is selling top-secret information to the international black market via the Internet. The group specializing in impossible missions, led by Jim Phelps, must unmask the mole and recover a list with the names of the most important secret agents in the world. But during the mission, in Prague, something goes wrong: Ethan Hunt (Cruise) and Claire (Béart) are the only survivors of the special core. Hunt will have to find out what really happened and why the American secret services are now accusing him of being the mole, and in the meantime seize the list with someone else's help. In "Mission Impossible" there is not only great action and fun. There is the hand of a director who is a master of style and technique: who here takes a vacation from his darkest themes and does so - admittedly - for reasons of gain as well as leisure; but without absolutely renouncing his extraordinary control of staging and tension. The television series was spectacularized without distorting its spirit, with at least three textbook sequences: the initial one in Prague, the one inside the CIA headquarters and the final one of the melee on the moving train.

title: La mia generazione
actors: Silvio Orlando, Claudio Amendola, Francesca Neri
description: In 1983 a captain of the carabinieri (Orlando) escorts an imprisoned terrorist (Amendola) from Sicily to Milan: they gave him permission for a series of talks with his girlfriend (Neri), whom he has not seen for three years. The journey becomes, for the terrorist and the escort officer, an opportunity to know and compare motivations and values ??that remain irreconcilable. The "irreducible" such they are and such they remain; at the cost of living.
notes: A calm yet very firm contrast between revolution and state, with a striking force of feelings. Wilma Labate and her screenwriters (two of them former militants, who ended up in prison at the time) move as equilibrists between such different and burning positions. But the alignment and the sympathies are clear: Amendola is a tough guy with a heart of gold; Neri is "sadly beautiful"; Orlando is a sneaky cynic behind the democratic appearance.

title: Natural Enemy
actors: Donald Sutherland, Lesley Ann Warren, William McNamara, Tia Carrere
description: Ted and his second wife Sandy are a quiet professional couple. Sandy is pregnant and with them lives Chris, the teenage son they had from Ted's first marriage. To solve some financial problems, they let Jeremy into their lives: after being appreciated in business management, Jeremy reveals the intent to destroy their existence. The reasons are to be found in a terrible secret from many years ago. The intention was to be an attempt to deepen the psychology of many criminals and serial killers, with sad stories of abandonment and difficult adoptions behind them. In fact it is a modest thriller, made on television, which in fact passed practically in silence at the cinema. The plot is obvious, there is no emotional involvement. Sutherland, Warren and McNamara are saved, redeeming the predictability of the subject with non-trivial recitations.

title: Normal Life
actors: Ashley Judd, Luke Perry, Bruce A. Young, Jim True, Edmund Wyson
description: Chris is a cop and loves his job. His dream is simply to earn enough to start a wealthy family. When he meets Pam, beautiful and sexually overwhelming, he falls in love with her and marries her. But Pam spends her time between bars and joints, and squanders her husband's earnings, who also loses his job. Getting hired as a private guard, Chris begins robbing banks in an attempt to supplement his income. When Pam discovers her husband's double life, she is fascinated to the point of preventing him from quitting. Inspired by a true story, an existential drama about the diabolical degeneration of the American dream. McNaughton is the director of "Henry: Rain of Blood", and his style is also deliberately sloppy, but in reality dry and relentless, and does not give anything to the characters and the viewer. Luke Perry tries to make people forget "Beverly Hills 90210".

title: Independence Day
actors: Bill Pullman, Jeff Goldblum, Will Smith, Mary McDonnell, Robert Loggia
description: Huge "unidentified objects" appear in the sky. The methodical destruction of the great cities of the Earth begins, and all seems lost until the American president himself gets on a plane and goes to fight the aliens. Together with him a weird scientist and a brave pilot will save the planet.
notes: From the same director and producer of "Stargate", the "big movie" of 1996. Programmed, only in Italy, in 520 screens, it was preceded by a colossal hype, as are the special effects and the Americanate of the screenplay. A mammoth and smashing toy, made on purpose to break the box office and give an answer - too little ironic - to the pro-alien mysticism of Spielberg's brand.

title: Totò le Moko
actors: Totò, Carlo Ninchi, Gianna Maria Canale, Carla Calò, Franca Marzi, Luigi Pavese
description: Totò is chosen for the succession of the famous criminal boss Pepé le Moko, who has nothing to do with it. He is kidnapped and taken to the casbah of Algiers. A potion makes him brave, but a jealous woman cuts his hair and makes his audacity disappear ...
notes: One of the most successful parodies of Totò (the model is "Pepé le Moko" with Jean Gabin), with the tango sequence that has been taken up in all the anthologies of the great actor. His also the song "My beautiful lady".

title: A Town Like Alice
actors: Virginia McKenna, Peter Finch, Takagi, Marie Lohr
description: Miss Paget, who works in a British office in Malaysia, escapes with her compatriots when the Japanese arrive in 1942, but her group is taken prisoner. The well-known Japanese ferocity puts everyone to the hardest test. It will be a terrible odyssey, studded with terrible labors and marked by many deaths. At the end of the war, the protagonist returns to Malaysia to start a new life.
notes: From a well-known novel, a good reduction that was successful not only for virtue of chauvinism, but for indisputable qualities of script and staging.

title: Taras Bulba
actors: Yul Brynner, Tony Curtis, Christine Kaufmann, Sam Wanamaker
description: We are in the sixteenth century: the Poles, threatened by the Turks, are saved by the Cossack Taras Bulba, but then the fate of the war is reversed. Taras is saved and, far from the land of his ancestors, awaits the moment of revenge. He will also have to kill one of his sons, Andrei, who has deserted to join the girl he loves.
notes: Gogol's novel in a barely discreet visualization, with a lot of naivety. In the cast Brynner in one of his most famous roles, and Tony who manages to be a credible Cossack.

title: People Will Talk
actors: Cary Grant, Jeanne Crain, Finlay Currie, Hume Cronyn
description: Noah Pretorius is a nonconformist gynecologist, much appreciated by his students and patients. When his pupil, Deborah, discovers she is pregnant and attempts suicide, Noah takes her under his wing and then marries her. Meanwhile, however, a colleague jealous of his success has Noah appear before the judge, accused of having protected a murderer in his time.
notes: The film is a splendid apologue on honesty in which, rare in Mankiewicz's cinema, good triumphs in the end. Excellent as usual the interpretation of Cary Grant. Curiosity: medicine was the director's first love.

title: Decameron proibitissimo. Boccaccio mio statte zitto
actors: Franco Agostini, Enzo Andronico, Alberto Atenari, Bruna Beani
description: Fra Pasquale is discovered by the bishop in "intimacy" with the servant of the widow Piccarda (but he wanted the mistress). Guidobaldo, convinced by a gypsy, delivers his wife to Rufolo. Fra Domenico Fa Penance while the prior enjoys Martina. Brunetta fucks her with Filippo, in the face of her jealous husband. Rinaldo with the wife of the vaccaro Giannotto. Agilulfo discovers the adultery of his wife, but ...
notes: How to rewind the classic disqualification of an immortal masterpiece of Italian literature impudent, making it a matter of episodes conducted in the name of the most becera vulgarity. To revive the poor Boccaccio in the tomb.

title: Love Letters
actors: Jennifer Jones, Joseph Cotten, Ann Richard, Gladys Cooper
description: From the front, Alain writes love letters to Vittoria, on behalf of his friend and fellow soldier Roger. Roger marries Vittoria, but when, over a year later, Alain meets the woman, she is already a widow (Roger was stabbed) and has totally lost her memory. Despite this, Alain marries her and, little by little, Vittoria recovers her memories. It also sheds light on the dramatic truth of Roger's death. The romantic pedal is pressed without much lightness in this film which is however captivating at times.

title: Bugie rosse
actors: Tomas Arana, Alida Valli, Gioia Maria Scola, Lorenzo Flaherty
description: Marco, a television journalist, conducts an investigation into the homosexual circles of his city. His wife, Adria, follows her husband's work with concern because he gets too involved in the environment in which he is working. All the more so when murders take place in the "tour" and Marco is suspected. Then, however, everything will end up with the best accommodation.
notes: There is a bit of "yellow" in the story, but its core seems to be the discovery, by Marco, that he is starting to like men. However, the film is a failure and one wonders what poor Alida Valli is doing there.

title: Un figlio a metà
actors: Gigi Proietti, Kathy Connelly, Andrea Giordana, Matteo Bellina, Bettina Giovannini
description: In Miami Sandro (Gigi Proietti) is looking for his son Luca (Matteo Bellina), whom his wife Nathalie has stolen from him in Italy by taking him to live with him and his new partner. The task, despite the help of his friend Carlo, is not the easiest: Sandro will be arrested, beaten and robbed by two thugs before being able to find Luca. On returning to Italy, in order not to leave traces, he plans a zigzag air itinerary, with stopovers in various cities in the USA.
notes: It is the "condensation" in a single part of the miniseries of the same name that had great success last season. Project, no doubt, he's good, but the script and the subject are what they are. Along with the comic moments, there is no shortage of highly avoidable "mother scenes".

title: No One Could Protect Her
actors: Joanna Kerns, Anthony John Denison, Peter MacNeill, Lori Hallier
description: The neighborhood where Jessica lives was recently the scene of a bloody event: a madman killed a woman. When the same killer tries to attack her, however, he is put to flight. At that point, Dan, her husband, equips the house as if it were a fortress. That's not enough for Jessica. She continues to live in terror so much that she decides to counterattack, tired of undergoing the psychological pressure of the mad murderer. Then he begins to get busy and studies the assassin's moves to prevent him. The story is not new, but there is a fair amount of ability to make the viewer take the parts of the woman in danger. It was all that the authors and actors of this TV movie set themselves and the goal has been fully achieved.

title: Putëvka v zizn
actors: Mikhail Zarov, Nikolai Batalov
description: After the civil war, in Ukraine, in 1923, several gangs of unregulated children running around in the fields and villages, living by tricks and stealing. Inspector Sergeev proposes the creation of a community where children can be empowered by involving them in economic activities.
notes: The first sound film of the Soviet Union, it was presented at the first Venice Film Festival in 1932 where it won the referendum for the "most convincing direction".

title: Johnny Suede
actors: Brad Pitt, Alison Moir, Catherine Keener, Nick Cave, Tina Louise
description: Johnny, an aspiring rockabilly musician who makes ends meet as a house painter, makes his living in a New York City where he feels like a fish out of water. Friendship with Deke and a couple of tormented love affairs lead him to mature. Debut film by DiCillo, former assistant of Jarmusch. In the footsteps of the master, the director creates a pleasant, surreal story of maturation, well served by Brad Pitt.

title: The Count of Monte Cristo
actors: Richard Chamberlain, Trevor Howard, Tony Curtis, Kate Nelligan
description: Finished in prison on the eve of his wedding due to the intrigues of four unscrupulous people, Edmond Dantès learns from the abbot Faria, his fellow prisoner, of a fabulous treasure. Escaped from prison, replacing the corpse of the dead friar, Edmond recovers the treasure and returns to his homeland to carry out his revenge.
notes: Not particularly successful version of the novel by Alexandre Dumas, with a Chamberlain (Emmy nominated, TV Oscar) specialist at the time of Dumas (he was already in the "Three Musketeers").

title: Len Deighton's Bullet to Beijing
actors: Michael Caine, Jason Connery, Mia Sara, Michael Sarrazin
description: With the Soviet bloc dissolved, even a seasoned counterintelligence agent like Harry Palmer (Caine) finds himself unemployed. But immediately, with a mysterious phone call, he is offered a mission. Harry flies to St. Petersburg where Alexei, a former KGB colleague, explains the task: to recover Alorax, a deadly biological weapon stolen from Russian laboratories and now traveling to Beijing on the Trans-Siberian.
notes: Fleming-like suggestions and melancholy-acid notations a la Le Carré in an amalgam that is not convincing. Created by Len Deighton, Agent Palmer had already been played by Caine three times, most recently in "The Billion Dollar Brain," in 1968.

title: Love Hurts
actors: Jeff Daniels, Judith Ivey, John Mahoney
description: Back home on the occasion of his sister's wedding, an incurable womanizer, unhappily divorced, meets his ex-wife there with their children, as well as his parents. Thus, he is forced to reexamine his past as an irresponsible daredevil, who had no qualms about abandoning his wife.
notes: A little bit of drama, a little bit of comedy, it's a film that would like to be all about bittersweet, but sometimes it exaggerates and ends up in caricature. Jeff Daniels (who in 1994 would have joined Jim Carrey in "Dumb & Dumber") in the part of the protagonist is the only one who is saved, the rest of the cast does not hold up.

title: Jezebel
actors: Bette Davis, Henry Fonda, George Brent, Margaret Lindsay
description: Giulia, a wealthy heiress of New Orleans, is engaged to Preston. She is so capricious and spoiled that he, tired of her constant tantrums, goes to New York. Here he meets and falls in love with another woman, who agrees to marry him. But soon the man must return to the South and his wife agrees to follow him. Here Preston falls ill with yellow fever and Giulia will be able to show him all her love to the point of extreme self-sacrifice.
notes: Rich melodrama with great direction, excellent photography and impeccable script. Bette Davis won her second Oscar.

title: Just Cause
actors: Sean Connery, Laurence Fishburne, Kate Capshaw, Blair Underwood
description: Paul Armstrong, a professor of law at Harvard, who has always been an opponent of the death penalty, is interested in the case of the young Bobby, sentenced to death. His searches, in the small town of Florida where the boy lived, are hampered by the inhabitants and the police, but Armstrong does not allow himself to be intimidated. The result will be a surprise.
notes: The film starts as a denunciation of the death penalty, then becomes a trial investigation, then a detective story, then a psycho-claustrophobic thriller. In short, a botched and presumptuous concoction. As always, only the timeless Connery is saved.

title: Mrs. Parker and the Vicious Circle
actors: Jennnifer Jason Leigh, Campbell Scott, Matthew Broderick, Peter Gallager, Jennifer Beals, Andrew McCarthy, Wallace Shown, Martha Plimpton, Sam Robards, Lily Taylor
description: Hollywood, 1937. Dorothy Parker and her second husband, Charles Campbell, recall the past, the work for "Vanity Fair", the "vicious circle" of the group of intellectuals who gathered at the usual table in the restaurant of the Algonquin hotel in New York, Dorothy's love for journalist Robert Benchley, her first marriage to Charles McArthur ... Dorothy will die, aged 74, in 1975. A badly wasted opportunity for a biting portrait of a world for which there is the characters, the atmospheres, even the dialogues and jokes were available, ready-made. And, instead, we have a twisted, fragmented, repetitive film.

title: Regarde les hommes tomber
actors: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Jean Yanne, Mathieu Kassovitz, Bulle Ogier, Yvon Back
description: Simon, a business card representative, helps young Mickey, a homosexual policeman, in his spare time. When Mickey is injured and falls into a deep coma, Simon searches for the truth about the assault on his own. Three years earlier, here is the elderly Max, involved in very shady affairs, with whom the young Johnny becomes a friend. Max involves Johnny in his misdeeds, to the point of making him a murderer ... Audiard, son of art, exhumes the "noir" with a skilful and accurate script (from the novel "Triangle" by Teri White) and a narrative capable of shrewd atmospheres , carried out in involving rhythms.

title: Heat and Dust
actors: Julie Christie, Shashi Kapoor, Greta Scacchi, Christopher Cazenove
description: Anna, a BBC journalist, decides to go to India, attracted by the letters her great-aunt Olivia wrote to her grandmother in the 1920s. In this way she will not only be subjected to the fascination of the rites and magic of India, but also to retrace the sentimental itinerary of her aunt, sixty years later. Analysis of British colonial sentiment in one of Ivory's best films.

title: Westward Ho the Wagons
actors: Fier Parker, Kathleen Crowley, Jeff York
description: Hank and John Doc lead the pioneer caravan to Oregon, through Sioux-dominated territory. But the Indians establish a concession to the passage: they must be given Laura's little sister (a girl Doc is in love with) because the sorcerer claims the girl's blond hair. Western Disney: optimistic, but without the typical passion of the genre.

title: La notte che Evelyn uscì dalla tomba
actors: Anthony Steffen, Marina Malfatti, Giacomo Rossi Stuart
description: In his castle, Sir Alan Cunnigham is haunted by the memory of his wife Evelyn, whom he himself had killed after catching her in bed with another. Therefore, it regularly hosts red-haired prostitutes that it kills with brutality. Low-grade Italic horror.

title: La moglie vergine
actors: Edwige Fenech, Renzo Montagnani, Carroll Baker, Ray Lovelock
description: Between Giovanni and Valentina the marriage is at a standstill. He is helpless, and he also has to put up with the complaints of her mother-in-law and her uncle. The situation becomes complicated with the arrival of two friends, authentic sexual maniacs: Gianfranco and his German wife Brigitta. Paradoxically, Giovanni will find satisfaction only with his mother-in-law.
notes: Film afflicted by an embarrassing poverty of ideas with the Fenech / Montagnani couple in their period of maximum fortune. The director is Marino Girolami under a pseudonym.

title: The Land Before Time III: The Time of the Great Giving
description: In the large and fertile valley the protagonists are always the same: the little foot dinosaur lives peacefully together with his friend Triki, the little triceratops, and the other puppies of their band. But a terrible drought endangers their existence and that of other dinosaurs. All that remains is to set off again, in search of a source that can quench their thirst. It is the third episode of the saga with Piedino. In the first he set out in search of the valley, in the second he went on a journey to the afterlife. In short, it is always a struggle for survival, and director Don Bluth is good at communicating lightly to children about such delicate and fundamental themes.

title: Tout ça... pour ça!
actors: Fabrice Luchini, Marie Sophie L., Francis Huster, Alessandra Martines, Vincent Lindon, Gérard Damon, Jacques Gamblin
description: Marie and Fabrice are lawyers; she is the mistress of Judge Francis, married to Alexandra, a former dancer. Marie and Francis try to bring Fabrice and Alexandra together; over the course of a weekend the two pretend to flirt only to make their respective spouses jealous. Marie and Fabrice are then engaged in defending three thugs in a trial presided over by Francis; they make them acquitted for "sentimental" extenuating circumstances.
notes: As usual, Claude Lelouch plays on intricate and ridiculous subjects, saving everything thanks to his exceptional sense of direction and editing. And as usual the cast is remarkable, with the excellent Fabrice Luchini in first position.

title: Ostinato destino
actors: Monica Bellucci, Alessandro Gassmann, Angela Finocchiaro, Lauretta Masiero, Marina Berti
description: A wealthy lady dies. At the opening of the will it turns out that the woman has left the inheritance to the first of her children who is about to get married. The other brothers, envious, organize a plot to take out the eldest son with the intention of sharing the loot. Things, however, will not turn out according to their plans. Directed by Gianfranco Albano, the film would like to be a black comedy, but it fails in its intent as it is too tangled, of little depth and, at times, approximate in the staging. Among the interpreters Monica Bellucci, who generously offers herself to the lens.

title: The Hunters
actors: Robert Mitchum, Robert Wagner, May Britt, Richard Egan, Lee Philips
description: During the Korean War, Major Clive Saville (formerly a hero in the Second World War) commands the air squadron which also includes Lieutenant Abbott, a fragile man, addicted to alcohol. The latter's wife then recommends Saville to watch over her husband. But between the eldest and the woman a feeling of love that is impossible to realize is making its way. So, when Abbot's plane gets lost in the forest, Saville himself goes to rescue it. Dick Powell's film is an anomalous war film, which combines melò and exemplary battle scenes, enhanced by the cinemascope.

title: Jesse & Lester
actors: Richard Harrison, Donald O'Brien, Anna Zinneman
description: The two brothers Jesse and Lester are in complete disagreement regarding the management of a land they own. Jesse would like to build a brothel over it; Instead, Lester would like to build a church there. But first we need to solve the problem of the bandits who have occupied their property ...
notes: Western spaghetti in which, more than violence, the comedy tone predominates.

title: Carousel
actors: Gordon MacRae, Shirley Jones, Cameron Mitchell, Gene Lockhart
description: Bill tells the "administrator of the ether" his story (of when he was alive): of how he married Julie, of not having been a model husband, of dying on the run after a failed robbery, of never having known the child Julie was expecting. He will have 24 hours of "leave".
notes: From "Liliom" by Ferenc Molnar, a musical more ambitious than successful.

title: Fate is a Hunter
actors: Glenn Ford, Rod Taylor, Nehemiah Persoff, Nancy Kwann, Suzanne Pleshette
description: An airliner crashes to the ground shortly after take-off. Only one stewardess survives from the plane crash. The investigation fails to establish the causes of the accident. A friend of the pilot is committed to establishing the truth and even repeats the flight. With the help of the stewardess, he discovers the real cause of the disaster.
notes: The story, the narration and the contribution of the interpreters are good. The tension is a crescendo. Too bad that the dialogues are often of an annoying pretentiousness.

title: The Stranglers of Bombay
actors: Guy Rolfe, Allan Cuthbertson, Andrew Cruickshank, Jan Holden
description: In India, in 1926, worshipers of the goddess Kali raid, robbing and maiming thousands of victims who then bury them in huge mass graves. Captain Lewis, in the pay of the Company of the Indies, sets out on their trail and proves the existence of the sect.
notes: "Colonial" adventurous horror produced by Hammer and directed by Terence Fisher, master of the genre.

title: The Curse of the Mummy's Tomb
actors: Terence Morgan, Fred Clarck, Ronald Howard
description: An unscrupulous American businessman has the very bad idea of ??exhibiting an Egyptian mummy, transporting it around the world. The mummy in question wakes up and begins to kill everyone who has violated his deadly sleep.
notes: Film dominated by the classic gothic atmospheres of the films produced by Hammer, with a nice tension in the ending.

title: Sanremo, la grande sfida
actors: Mario Carotenuto, Teddy Reno, Adriano Celentano, Domenico Modugno
description: During the Sanremo Festival, two record companies, bitter rivals, try by every means to ensure victory for one of their singers. However, their rivalry ends up harming both of them. The plot only serves to give space to the performances of the singers.

title: Nemesis 2: Nebula
actors: Sue Price, Chad Stahelski, Tina Cote, Earl White, Jahi J.J. Zuri
description: In the distant, but not too distant future, humanity is enslaved by cyborgs. But some scientists, after some important discoveries, begin to have serious hopes for the redemption of humans. They then choose a volunteer, but he, discovered by the cyborgs, has no choice but to flee into the past aboard a spaceship. Arriving in 1980, however, he still manages to find a solution to future problems.
notes: The sequel to a film that, in terms of inventiveness and science fiction imagery, did not shine very much, is a jumble of traces and clichés not even so well sewn together. Very scarce special effects. Direction fugitive.

title: The Man in the Gray Flannel Suit
actors: Gregory Peck, Fredric March, Jennifer Jones, Marisa Pavan
description: A quiet man, fresh from a war experience that left him with some mark on his conscience, is now employed by a television station and has a promising future ahead of him; but he gives up his career in order to be close to his family. Nunnally Johnson has always been better as a writer than a director. Here it gives a good product, well supported by the performers.

title: Mission of Justice
actors: Jeff Wincott, Adrian Ricard, Karen Sheperd, Brigitte Nielsen
description: Kurt Harris is a former cop whose life has taught us that you shouldn't have too much hope in your fellow man. Disillusioned and embittered, he is investigating the murder of a friend undercover. The investigation brings him into contact with the world of politics: a woman, in particular, who has decided to compete in the elections for the office of mayor and who is ready for anything to reach her goal ... Power, corruption, violence, martial arts are the key words that frame the film. As is customary in these cases, the subject is only a pretext to justify the action scenes that lead to the conclusion. And to the freeing of the spectator.

title: Wayne's World 2
actors: Mike Myers, Dana Carvey, Christopher Walken, Tia Carrere
description: Wayne and Garth continue their business as cable hosts and musicians after high school. Wayne, in a sentimental crisis, is saved by the vision of a Native American who puts him in contact with the late Jim Morrison. The latter advised him to organize a great rock concert. Unbelievable, but true: Wayne and Garth make it, despite everything. In the wake of the success of # 1, the direction changes and the second episode pushes on the pedal of the Woodstockian parody and the mockery of the myth of the 60s ... A pure trashy comedy, of course, that only appeals to American teenagers. Appearances by Charlton Heston and Drew Barrymore.

title: St. Helens
actors: Art Carney, David Huffman, Cassie Yates
description: Scientists have predicted a terrible volcanic eruption, but elderly Mr. Harry Truman refuses to evacuate the home that is his entire life.
notes: Fifteen years ahead of the wave of castastrophic films that have invaded American cinema, Ernest Pintoff's film is appreciable thanks to the effective interpretation of Art Carney. However, the director must do without special effects and rely only on the skill of the performers.

title: Gorgo
actors: Bill Travers, William Sylvester, Vincent Winter
description: A large prehistoric marine animal is caught and brought to London, where it is named "Gorgo". His aggression is worrying, also because he is only a puppy destined to grow and become even more dangerous. Not to mention that even monsters have a mother ... Even without great technical and screenwriting gimmicks, it is a pleasant, studiously naive, genre film.

title: L'udienza
actors: Enzo Jannacci, Claudia Cardinale, Ugo Tognazzi, Michel Piccoli, Vittorio Gassman
description: A man, Amedeo, wants at all costs to be received in a private audience by the pope. Thus begins a process at the Vatican bureaucracy that will bring him into contact with a series of incredible characters and paradoxical situations. In vain, a commissioner of the Vatican police first tries to dissuade him from the intention, then helps him by putting him in contact with fixers and exponents of the black aristocracy, but always to no avail.
notes: One of Ferreri's best films. Effective satire of clear Kafkaesque inspiration ("The Trial") against a certain power metaphorically embodied by the Catholic Church. Jannacci proves to be an excellent actor.

title: Francis in the Haunted House
actors: Mickey Rooney, Virginia Welles, James Flavin, Paul Cavanagh
description: Francis, the famous speaking mule, is a witness of a murder disguised as an accident, which took place in a Scottish castle that was transported and reconstructed to the United States. Francis will still help his naive friend Prescott (who has been suspended) to get out of trouble. A pleasant comedy, the last of the series of the speaking mule and perhaps, not the best.

title: Falling in Love Again
actors: Elliott Gould, Susannah York, Stuart Paul, Michelle Pfeiffer
description: Everything had worked out very well in its time: falling in love (she rich, he poor), marriage despite the boycott of their respective families. Now the routine has ruined everything, between the couple and in the relationship with the children who live isolated under their stereo headphones. He tries, with a "pilgrimage" to his native Bronx, to shake up his life. And the miracle takes place. An overdose of molasses in the name of an almost fairytale optimism. For hearts prone to emotion and (very) simple souls.

title: La chasse aux papillons
actors: Narda Blanchet, Pierrette Pompom Bailhache, Lilia Olivier
description: The elderly Marie-Agnès, assisted by her cousin Solange, lives in a large castle in the French countryside. A bizarre lawyer, his neighbor, would like to have him sell it to the Japanese. When Marie-Agnès dies she leaves everything to her sister Hélène, who lives in Russia. This comes with her daughter Olga and sells. Iosseliani shows us his point of view on how the world now goes with melancholy skepticism. A ferocious fresco of the French province and of all humanity: no one is saved, but it is better to rely on derision rather than give in to anguish. In 1989 "A fire seen from afar" and in 1996 "Briganti briganti" obtained the special Grand Prix of the jury, but not the Golden Lion. In receiving the prize, Iosseliani himself underlined, with an ironic joke, this singular situation of his. And besides, this delightful and cruel fable, in the typical Georgian director's style, is a little gem.

title: L'amico immaginario
actors: Victor Cavallo, Valeria D'Obici, Nico D'Alessandria, Rocco Mortelliti
description: The inadequacy of the life of Dino, a fifty-year-old intellectual, is evident both in his relations with women and with his son. The death of Daniele, a close friend, should increase his loneliness, but, through this disappearance, Dino will cultivate a new form of presence, dedicating himself to an imaginary figure.
notes: Beautiful portrait, full of modesty, of the drama of loneliness. It somehow updates a story told by a beautiful film by François Truffaut, "The green room", in which the former young Turkish man, in addition to being a director, plays the role of a man who loses his wife and dedicates himself to I remember her.

title: Per sempre - Forever
actors: Ben Gazzara, Eva Grimaldi, Gioia Scola, Corinne Cléry, Janet Agren
description: Marcelo Rondi, a wealthy Brazilian businessman, is found dead in his Sao Paulo apartment. The daughter Berenice and the police then begin to investigate the man's past. For the girl, it will also be a matter of becoming aware of her father's promiscuous sexual life.
notes: It starts off as a detective story, but then gradually turns into a kind of Oedipal drama. To be avoided.

title: The War of the Roses
actors: Michael Douglas, Kathleen Turner, Danny DeVito, Marianne Sägebrecht, Jack Palance
description: After eighteen years of marriage, crowned by the presence of two children, Barbara Rose realizes that something is wrong in her life: her husband, Oliver, who has also ensured her a high-level existence, has never gratified her. The perfect world that Oliver has been able to set up for them all those years seems meaningless and when the couple goes into crisis the effects are devastating.
notes: Very poisonous film directed by a De Vito in great shape. The story develops cynically devoted to the most ferocious black humor: the target against which one shoots mercilessly (at times with an even excessive ease) is constituted by the family institution and by American respectability.

title: The Puppet Masters
actors: Donald Sutherland, Eric Thal, Julie Warner, Keith David
description: An alien spaceship lands in a small town in Ohio. Sent by NASA and the Office for Scientific Intelligence, scientists Mary, Andrew and the latter's son, Sam, come running. But the extraterrestrial organism has already exited the spaceship.

title: Street Fighter
actors: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Raul Julia, Ming-Na Wen, Damian Chapa
description: A very powerful criminal has built a veritable super-technological empire and is now demanding a boat of billions in exchange for the lives of a few dozen hostages. Against him, Colonel Guile (Van Damme), of the United World forces, and a group of very trusted and skilled martial artists.
notes: That poor Raul Julia ended his career before his death with this film is a cause of great sadness. He deserved better. Based on a hugely successful video game and with characters that have become iconic, the film does not capitalize on mythology built on source material in other media and lacks both a zest for the show and intriguing character rivalries.

title: Funny Bones
actors: Oliver Platt, Lee Evans, Leslie Caron, Jerry Lewis, Freddie Davis
description: Tommy Fawkes makes his Las Vegas debut under the eyes of his father, a famous comedian, but his debut is disastrous. So he decides to return to Blackpool, the city of his childhood, to look for new material and new inspirations. And here he ends up discovering the unflattering truth about the sources of the parent's success (as well as the unsuspected existence of a half-brother). Jerry Lewis and Leslie Caron embellish the cast of a courageous film for their rejection of banal narrative and stylistic solutions.

title: La battaglia di Maratona
actors: Steve Reeves, Mylène Demongeot, Daniela Rocca
description: Athens is at war with Darius, king of the Persians. Philippides, who has just won the Olympic Games, puts himself at the service of his homeland, led by Miltiades. Philippides will resist the flattery of the pro-Persian party, until, with the intervention of Sparta, the war ends in the historic battle of Marathon.
notes: Muscle Mister Steve Reeves in a modest retelling of Greek history. Supervision by Jacques Tourneur and photography by Mario Bava.

title: An Inconvenient Woman
actors: Rebecca De Mornay, Jill Eikenberry, Jason Robards, Peter Gallagher
description: Flo, a waitress with actress ambitions, becomes the lover of Jules, a married businessman. His wife, through an anonymous letter, finds out, but pretends nothing has happened. The matter becomes more and more complicated when a family friend is found dead and Jules, strangely, tries to make them believe it is a suicide. A television production thriller, set in the uptown. In the cast, faces of the most recent notoriety, together with the always fascinating one of the veteran Jason Robards.

title: Après l'amour
actors: Isabelle Huppert, Bernard Giraudeau, Hippolyte Girardot, Laure Killing
description: Lola, writer, lives with David, an architect who has abandoned his wife and children for her. One day, Lola falls in love with Tom, a musician himself married and father of a family; Tom and Lola leave for a weekend in Italy, but the woman understands that he, unlike David, will never leave his family. Love adrift for the veterans of a generation lived under the banner of liberation and contestation. The intention is almost chronicle, but the clichés are not lacking. Isabelle Huppert had better chances.

title: Satanik
actors: Magda Konopka, Julio Peña, Umi Raho, Luigi Montini
description: The professor. Greeves, a genius scientist, invents a potion that restores youth. Greeves has as an assistant the old maid Marnie who, after killing him and taking possession of the potion, turns into the beautiful Satanik. It will be good for her for a while (and it will be bad for her victims).
notes: Stupid transposition on the screen of the comic book character of Magnus and Bunker, made with (involuntarily) pop taste, and with an unlikely cast.

title: Strange Lady in Town
actors: Greer Garson, Dana Andrews, Cameron Mitchell
description: At the beginning of the twentieth century Love Simpson, beautiful and independent, brings the scandal to a small town in the South by marrying Rucker, the owner of the store where she works, much older than her and a fresh widower.
notes: Unpretentious feminine sentimental Western, but pleasant enough.

title: Chase a Crooked Shadow
actors: Richard Todd, Anne Baxter, Herbert Lom
description: Kim, an heiress, finds in her mansion a man who claims to be Ward, the woman's brother who died in a car accident. Kim, faced with the fact that the man is aware of the most intimate details of the family, must surrender to the evidence. Actually the self-styled brother wants to get his hands on Kim's jewelry ...
notes: Good yellow with a really surprising finish.

title: The V.I.P.s
actors: Richard Burton, Elizabeth Taylor, Louis Jourdan, Margaret Rutherford, Orson Welles
description: At London airport, all flights are temporarily blocked due to very dense fog. Forget it, the various waiting passengers make friends with each other. There is a billionaire with his wife, a playboy left without money, an industrialist with his secretary, a famous film director in the company of a novice actress, the old Duchess of Brighton ... will prove particularly useful.
notes: This film uses a banal narrative device to give space to a roundup of famous actors. In addition to Taylor, Burton and Welles, there are also Margaret Rutherford, Maggie Smith, Louis Jordan, Linda Christian, Elsa Martinelli.

title: Feuer, Eis & Dynamit
actors: Roger Moore, Shari Belafonte, Simon Shephered, Uwe Ochsenknecht
description: A rich financier pretends to be dead. The man's three children (from three different women) take part in the reading of the will, whom he had not seen for years and who do not know each other. Sir George will in fact leave all his huge assets to those who win a difficult series of sports competitions. The races (climbing, ski trials) begin, disturbed by unfair competitors who try to sabotage them even with dynamite.
notes: Spectacular film, but narratively non-existent in its simply aligning a series of sports numbers. Landscapes and acrobatics are not enough.

title: The Black Windmill
actors: Michael Caine, Donald Pleasence, Delphine Seyrig, Joss Ackland
description: David, the son of an intelligence major, is kidnapped. The kidnappers (a terrorist group linked to the IRA) ask for the release of a batch of diamonds that the secret services had bought for a mission. Tarrant suspects (rightly) that the tip-off to the terrorists originated from the inside and tries to expose the traitor. But it will not be easy, also because Tarrant himself at some point will be accused of treason. A Don Siegel perhaps slightly subdued compared to his masterpieces but always in shape, in packaging a high school thriller. Flawless as always Michael Caine.

title: Såsom i en spegel
actors: Harriet Andersson, Max Von Sydow, Gunnar Björnstrand
description: On a Baltic island, writer David spends his summer holidays in the company of his son Minus, his daughter Kårin - recently discharged from a psychiatric clinic - and Kårin's husband, Martin. Each of them constitutes for the others a sort of mirror, in which the anguish and the difficulty of communicating of each one are reflected.
notes: One of Bergman's films - along with the subsequent "Lights of Winter" and "Silence" - most marked by existential tension and religious restlessness, with God appearing in Kårin's dreams in the form of a huge spider. Outstanding performers, and Oscar 1961 for best foreign film.

title: Ansiktet
actors: Max Von Sydow, Ingrid Thulin, Gunnar Björnstrand, Bibi Andersson
description: To take revenge for the arrest and taunting of a doctor and a policeman, an illusionist magician pretends to be dead. He can thus appear to the doctor who believes he is doing an autopsy on his body, like a ghost, terrifying him. One of the greatest and most personal films of the Swedish author: allegory, between dream and reality, of art and power. Wonderful photography.

title: Nattvardsgästerna
actors: Gunnar Björnstrand, Ingrid Thulin, Max Von Sydow, Gunnel Lindblom
description: Tomas Ericsson, a Protestant pastor, after the death of his wife not only realizes that he has lost his faith, but, perhaps, that he never had it. In full crisis he is no longer able to give comfort to his parishioners, one of whom will kill himself. It is one of the peaks of Bergman's production: shot in an icy black and white held in gray tones like those of the characters' lives. Disturbing and still unexplained, the open ending.

title: Sommarlek
actors: Maj-Britt Nilsson, Birger Malmsten, Alf Kjellin, Georg Funkqvist
description: Marta, a ballet dancer, receives in the mail the diary of Henrick, her old boyfriend, who died years earlier in an accident. Reading the diary pushes Marta, on the thread of memories, to the places where that great love blossomed. Immersed in the beauty of the landscape, Marta reviews her life and opens up to hope. A reflection on the past and memories in a sort of elegy of memory (and love) played between nature and feelings.

title: Sommarnattens leende
actors: Ulla Jacobsson, Eva Dahlbeck, Harriet Andersson, Gunnar Bjõrnstrand
description: Fredrik Egerman, a well-known lawyer, married a very young woman, Anne, whom Fredrik's nephew, Henrik, pays a bit of court to. Fredrik is a bit jealous and consoles himself with Désirée an actress his ex-lover (with whom he had a son). The actress is currently the mistress of Count Malcolm whose wife, Countess Charlotte, teams up with Anne to win back their respective husbands. During a dinner, and the following night, thanks to a magical atmosphere, everything will fall into place. It was the film that revealed Bergman's talent when, in 1956, he was awarded at Cannes. It is a film halfway between elegant comedy and drama, which skilfully mixes the Shakespearean lightness of the text with the Ophülsian grace of the staging.

title: Arabesque
actors: Gregory Peck, Sophia Loren, Alan Badel, Kieron Moore
description: David Pollock is an American philology professor who is commissioned to decipher a hieroglyph from an oil tycoon from an Arab country. Only later does he discover that someone has decided to kill him, for reasons that even he does not understand well.
notes: Of course, the plot is much more complicated and whirlwind, but it doesn't matter much. In this kind of vaguely spy, often hilarious and breathtaking film typical of the 1960s, the plot is the least important. Stanley Donen, Academy Award for Lifetime Achievement, proves he knows how to fine-tune adventure films like this one. Magnificent Sophia Loren in Christian Dior dresses.

title: Princess Caraboo
actors: Phoebe Cates, Jim Broadbent, Kevin Kline, John Lithgow, Stephen Rea
description: England, 1817. Two peasants pick up a girl who does not know who she is, who does not speak English, has some coins of unknown origin and is dressed in an exotic way. Mrs. Warrel takes care of her, who saves her from prison and from the gallows (her fault is that of not speaking English) and, while the most extravagant conjectures are made about the girl, a journalist investigates ...
notes: Apart from the reconstruction of a few quite tasty period pictures, it is not clear what the purpose that the film set itself was. Denounce perilous times? Warn about unjustified bias against the "different"?

title: Le garçu
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Géraldine Pailhas, Antoine Pialat, Dominique Rocheteau
description: Antoine, son of Sophie and the "big Gégé", lives with his mother in Paris, where his father also lives but with occasional presence in the apartment. Because Gégé is not exactly a model of marital fidelity, he keeps up stories with other women and, as for his son, tries to make friends with him with more or less clumsy initiatives. Gégé's father dies ("le garçu" is the dialectal voice for "le garçon") ...
