A very human father-son relationship (also because it is very "messed up"), with a Depardieu who finds the "feeling" with the its director Pialat (of which the small, spontaneous Antoine is the son).

title: The Trollenberg Terror
actors: Forrest Tucker, Laurence Payne, Jennifer Jayne, Janet Munro
description: The Swiss town of Trollenberg is located at the foot of a valley surrounded by high mountains. A strange cloud has been standing on one of these for some time, which actually hides a group of extraterrestrials. They kill some climbers and reanimate their bodies to make them commit more murders and invade the valley. A strange science fiction film that owes part of its charm to the unusual setting.

title: Homeboy
actors: Mickey Rourke, Christopher Walken, Debra Feuer
description: Johnny Walker is an alcoholic boxer by now on the avenue of the sunset. He is hired by the shady Pendergrass to fight in some matches. Johnny hangs out with the owner of a filthy booth of the fair and, between a fist fight and a drunkenness, he carries on a wretched existence. Debut behind the camera of the former director of photography Seresin: without infamy and without praise but Rourke, also author of the subject, steals the show too much.

title: Cornered
actors: Dick Powell, Walter Slezak, Luther Adler, Micheline Cheirel
description: A Canadian aviator, Gérard, married a French girl. While Gérard is away, his wife, who is the daughter of a patriot, is shot by adherents of the Vichy government. Gérard, mad with grief, sets out on the hunt for the killer whom he discovers he is protected by the Nazis in Argentina.
notes: Curious film of denunciation of Nazism through the reconstruction, with the stylistic features of noir, of a private vendetta.

title: The Favor
actors: Harley Jane Kozak, Elizabeth McGovern, Bill Pullman, Brad Pitt
description: Kathy is the mother of two beautiful girls and the wife of a university professor. Despite this, her life flows in a way that she considers rather boring. The opposite of what happens to her best friend who is engaged to the handsome painter Elliot (Pitt) and spends her time traveling. Kathy begins to cultivate a series of sexual dreams and fantasies. Try to make them with Tom, an old flame ...
notes: A good cast for a comedy that is in many ways unsuccessful and inconclusive. The screenplay is in fact watered from all sides and the director, an honest trader, despite his efforts just fails to patch it up.

title: Rossini
actors: Nino Besozzi, Paola Barbara, Camillo Pilotto, Armando Falconi
description: The film tells the life of Gioacchino Rossini from his first successes to the creation of "Guglielmo Tell", his latest work, from his marriage to the singer Isabella Colbran, to the difficult period that followed the loss of her voice. Typical product of the Italian film-opera trend, it is more heartfelt and successful than other examples. Bonnard has a nice romantic streak and manages to make the tribute to the musician quite exciting.

title: E la nave va
actors: Freddie Jones, Barbara Jefford, Peter Cellier, Norma West
description: Italy, 1914. The "Gloria N" sails with a heterogeneous group of admirers of the soprano Edmea Tetua on board to scatter his ashes in the Aegean. During navigation, the characters are defined. Then the ship picks up some Serbian refugees fleeing after the Sarajevo attack. And due to the action of one of these, the "Gloria N" is shelled and sunk. But someone is saved.
notes: A paradoxical humanity and a world that end up observed through the lens of the grotesque, with the fiction of the story openly revealed in the finale. Splendid photography, with the beginning turned sepia. Screenplay by Fellini and Tonino Guerra.

title: Trail of Tears
actors: Pam Dawber, Katey Sagal, William Russ, Jeffrey Nordling
description: Ceryl is what could be called a perfect mother, with two children, but also with an unemployed husband. Annie instead works as a croupier in a Las Vegas club, and she is also the mother of two boys. It will happen that both women find themselves victims of the same fate: that of the kidnapping of their children by their men. A long search begins on the streets of the United States, with appeals to newspapers and television.
notes: Again a story of brave women who fight against an adverse and cruel fate. Happy ending guaranteed: just as the mediocrity with which these TV movies are made is a guarantee.

title: Getting Even with Dad
actors: Macaulay Culkin, Ted Danson, Glenne Headly, Saul Rubinek
description: Released from jail for attempted theft, Ray is a pastry chef, but he doesn't say no to a millionaire heist and scores it with two cronies. But the aunt, who was in the care of her son Timmy, sends him back the little boy that Ray hasn't seen for some time. The terrible little one, to get his father's attention, blackmails him by hiding the booty. Ray has to please Timmy, his associates are furious and, moreover, the police appear ... A mediocre film that, with the protagonist Macaulay Culkin, echoes the characters and mechanisms of "Mom, I missed the plane", without having any the rhythm. Danson (Ray) is again condemned to be a dad, as in "Three Men and a Cradle" and "Made in America".

title: Inhibition
actors: Claudine Beccarie, Ivan Rassimov, Ilona Staller, Cesare Barro
description: Rich, bored and depressed following the death of her husband, she satisfies her cravings with the uninhibited secretary Anna (Ilona Staller). During a trip to Africa, the latter knows a leafy archaeologist and falls in love with it. However, the mistress blows him. Anna is fired imbufalita, the young man leaves for an expedition. The widow is not long in finding another adventurer willing to turn off his ardor. A film not only insignificant and extremely boring, but destined to disappoint even the expectations of the most modest Voyeur. Claudine Beccarie (La widow), already interpreter of porn movies, does not show off great. "Cicciolina", here in a lesbian version, in the same year he interprets "the naive".

title: Il figlio di Cleopatra
actors: Mark Damon, Scilla Gabel, Arnoldo Foà, Livio Lorenzon
description: The valiant nomad El Kebir is actually the son of Caesar and Cleopatra. Now that Egypt is oppressed by a cruel governor of Rome, he leads the revolt of the people. Even the emperor Octavian will have to recognize that he has every right to it.
notes: Magniloquent dialogues, great coming and going of horses and crests, Homeric fights and battles. Last fires of the peplum, the era of the Italian western has already begun.

title: Iron Eagle
actors: Louis Gossett jr., Jason Gedrick, David Suchet, Tim Thomerson
description: Doug is the son of a US Air Force colonel. The boy trembles with impatience to be able to emulate his father's feats, but for now he has to be content with a flight simulator. However, he learns so well that when his parent falls into the hands of Middle Eastern terrorists, he seizes an aircraft and rushes to the rescue. Everything ends well and Doug also earns the long-awaited badges.
notes: Reaganian film of the series "top gun to the rescue", in which Sidney J. Furie gives ample proof of his technical skills during the aerial shots, breathtaking as it should be. But the story and the staging are pure routine.

title: The Rapture
actors: Mimi Rogers, David Duchovny, Will Patton
description: Sharon goes from one occasional embrace to another, in total debauchery. But the meeting with a group of evangelizers who came to her house changed her life in a radical way. Now the woman not only denies her past, but also tries to convert all those with whom she comes in contact. His new life, however, will be marked by madness, up to an atrocious crime and prison. A disconcerting, crazy film, in which the most heterogeneous elements are absurdly assembled. Mimi Rogers, who crosses it from end to end, is out of phase; as it happens to the poor spectator who does not understand it. But Tolkin, screenwriter of Altman's "Protagonists", has inventiveness and originality.

title: Pin
actors: David Hewlett, Terry O'Quinn
description: Brother and sister, Leon and Ursula live alone, fond of a large wooden Pinocchio they call "Pin". But she makes a boyfriend. Leon, jealous and manifestly mad, takes action with his puppet. Robust low-budget genre film, directed by Sandor Stern, the screenwriter of "The Amityville Horror".

title: L'elisir d'amore
actors: Nelly Corradi, Gino Sinimberghi, Tito Gobbi, Silvana Mangano, Gina Lollobrigida
description: Nemorino, a young farmer, fails to win over the rich and beautiful Adina. Thanks to a love potion from the charlatan Doctor Dulcamara, and a conspicuous inheritance, the lover finally obtains the longed-for object of his desires. Successful film translation of Gaetano Donizetti's masterpiece. Mario Bava directs photography.

title: Asterix in Amerika
description: Julius Caesar's Romans kidnap the druid Panoramix from the warlike Gallic village they never managed to subdue. Asterix and the faithful Obelix undertake the task of freeing their old friend, but a terrible storm seizes them at sea which tosses the three heroes among the American aborigines. They will return in time to mock and defeat the divine Caesar for the umpteenth time. The famous characters created by Uderzo and Goscinny are (almost always) prodigious on the page, but they lose a lot if "dilated" to the extent of the film. And if the script is weak, as in this case, the result leaves something to be desired.

title: Legends of the Fall
actors: Brad Pitt, Anthony Hopkins, Julia Ormond, Aidan Quinn
description: Colonel William Ludlow, who resigned from the army because he was disgusted by the government's treatment of Indians, is a widower and lives in Montana with his three children Alfred, Tristan and Samuel. Tristan, who is the wildest, is drawn to the Aboriginal culture. The arrival of the refined Susannah unleashes the rivalry between Alfred and Tristan. Then the First World War breaks out and things get complicated ... Zwick has a sense of entertainment but, amidst redundancies, complacent descriptions and concessions to the gigionism of his interpreters, he has created a less than modest product. And Hopkins sick, for once, is detestable.

title: A Blueprint for Murder
actors: Jean Peters, Joseph Cotten, Gary Merrill
description: The circumstances of his brother's death have left Fred Kent with some doubts, but when Dolly, the daughter of the deceased, also dies in mysterious circumstances, doubt becomes certainty. The suspicions are pinned on the sister-in-law, who would become the heir of the large inheritance if the second child also died. Fred investigates and discovers that his suspicions are well founded. A dramatic thriller with the central figure of a dark lady typical of many film noir.

title: Deep Waters
actors: Jean Peters, Dana Andrews, Dean Stockwell, Cesar Romero
description: Little Donny has been orphaned since his father, a fisherman, died at sea. He is entrusted by Anna, his guardian, to a widow, in whose house he meets Edie, a fisherman who takes him with him into the sea. Anna refuses to let the boy follow in his father's footsteps in the dangerous profession of deep-sea fishing. But Donny, who has a passion for the sea in his blood, runs away to embark with Edie. A decent teen film that's more wordy than adventurous.

title: Innocent Victims
actors: John Corbett, Ricky Schroder, Hal Holbrook, Tom Irwin
description: 1985, North Carolina. It is a Tuesday night when Sergeant Tim Hennis is arrested with a very serious accusation: having slaughtered two children after raping and killing their mother, a woman from whom Tim had bought a dog. Several witnesses accuse man, and alibi seems fragile. Tim's father hires the best lawyers and detectives. But Tim will still have to wait for the sentence for more four years in prison. More or less four hours of original duration (then reduced to less than two) for a fairly discreet TV-Movie, likely to the point of seeming inspired by a true story. Making such a long film about a judicial case without boring is already a good result.

title: I due pericoli pubblici
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Margaret Lee, Riccardo Garrone
description: Two clumsy fraudulent brothers cause the failure of a fake diplomat's plan to steal money from an industrialist. Forced to repay the gang for the damage suffered, they collect failure after failure, until they find themselves ... in Heaven. Farce that even steals some ideas from Kubrick's "Doctor Strangelove".

title: The Haunting of Lisa
actors: Cheryl Ladd, Duncan Regehr, Aemilia Robinson, Don Allison
description: Lisa is only nine years old when she begins to periodically have strange and disturbing visions: just while the small village in which she lives is still in shock for the mysterious murder of a child, a ghostly lady appears to her and prophesies other crimes that are punctually committed . In reality, the little girl has the same powers as her mother and grandmother: visions that will allow her to identify the killer ...
notes: A TV movie that goes seamlessly from thriller to paranormal horror. We are not at the level of _X Files_, but we can be satisfied. At times, quite frightening.

title: When Friendship Kills
actors: Lynda Carter, Katie Wright, Marley Shelton, Josh Taylor, Colleen Winton
description: Her parents just split, and 16-year-old Lexi has to start another life at her new school in Seattle. He quickly makes friends with Jennifer, the most beautiful and sought after girl in college. Lexi begins to imitate her friend in manner and appearance, and little by little she transforms. A competition and an obsession with always being the best that will lead both girls into a spiral of self-destruction. The merit of this film is that of shedding a sinister light on the American teenage world, what is presented to us in the series as "Beverly Hills" as glittering, but which in reality hides rivalries and deep neuroses.

title: Murderock. Uccide a passo di danza
actors: Olga Karlatos, Ray Lovelock, Claudio Cassinelli, Cosimo Cinieri, Giuseppe Mannajuolo
description: Commissioner Borges investigates a disturbing series of murders linked to a dance school. The owner is a former dancer, who interrupted her career after a very serious accident. Now his students are killed, one after the other, by a mysterious murderer, whose modus operandi foresees that the fatal blow is inflicted with a sharp pin.
notes: Lucio Fulci gave his best with horror. This time, however, by choosing a thriller version of Flashdance, he fails to impress situations. Cassinelli does not help him. Typical senile product of a Fulci in a descending parable, now accustomed to the TV Movie standards imposed by the producers.

title: La dentellière
actors: Isabelle Huppert, Yves Beneyton, Florence Giorgetti
description: Béatrice, young and awkward, lives with her mother in Paris, works as a hairdresser and has a friend who is a little too exuberant. This takes her with her to Normandy, on vacation. Here Béatrice falls in love with François, a middle-class student. Back in Paris, the two get together, but he soon gets tired. Abandoned, Béatrice ends up in an asylum, where she spends her time silently embroidering.
notes: First film as a true protagonist for Isabelle Huppert, sober and intense. A good intimate drama, inspired in the title by the famous painting by Vermeer.

title: Shestaja cjast' mira
description: Vertov paints a portrait of the USSR divided into six parts: the exploitation of the working class before the revolution; the geographical description; the various economic activities; Soviet products and their possible export; commercial problems; the prospects for transformation and development. A "cinematic poem" already too daring for the official culture of the time. Today it remains suggestive and surprising, perhaps an idea of ??what cinema could have been and was not.

title: L'eroe della strada
actors: Erminio Macario, Delia Scala, Carlo Ninchi, Folco Lulli, Arnoldo Foà
description: Felice, unemployed, is accused of stealing a barrel organ. Saved by the testimony of Gaetano, a swindler who pretends to be a partisan, Felice falls in love with a cigarette seller whose husband is missing; he finds work, but the climate is difficult and he is fired. The strike causes his arrest. Released from jail, Gaetano procures him a barrel organ, but this only plays fascist hymns ...
notes: In a comic key, a small picture of the Italian immediate postwar period. Macario, coming from the show, here manages to put his bewildered face at the service of a story with some depth. The screenwriters are Steno and Mario Monicelli.

title: Hard Times
actors: Charles Bronson, James Coburn, Jill Ireland, Strother Martin
description: We are in the 1930s, in New Orleans. Speedy, a clandestine bare-fisted boxing matchmaker, finds the goose that lays the golden eggs in the person of Chaney, a fighter no longer so young. Chaney, after making Speedy make some money, leaves, only to reappear when the impresario gets into trouble with loan sharks. After that, the mysterious boxer disappears into thin air. After a remarkable career as a screenwriter (remember "Getaway" and "Special Agent Mackintosh"), Walter Hill made his debut as a director with this film, where it is easy to find elements and situations that will remain constant throughout his subsequent cinema.

title: The Good Old Boys
actors: Tommy Lee Jones, Sam Shepard, Sissy Spacek
description: Hewey Calloway is a mature cowboy, as proud as the land he comes from. After long wanderings, he returns to his brother Walter's farm in the endless Texas countryside. He struggles to adapt to sedentary life, also because Walter is very different from him, used as he is to the rhythms of the small town. But when it comes to taking sides against the bullying of a banker, Hewey finds in Walter a valid ally; at the same time the rude cowboy falls in love with a proud teacher.
notes: Actor Tommy Lee Jones not only stars, but makes a convincing debut as a screenwriter and director.

title: The Lighthorsemen
actors: Jon Blake, Peter Phelps, Tony Bonner
description: During the First World War, the Australian cavalry prepares a charge against the city of Beersheba, in North Africa, held by a fierce German garrison. Among the other members of the commando of assailants is a young recruit who cannot accept the idea of ??having to kill human beings, his fellow men, even if not to be killed.
notes: Well set reconstruction of a historical episode, which actually happened although very little known, which works best especially in battle scenes.

title: Teo
actors: Ludgero Fortes Dos Santos, Francesca Romana Messere, Stefania Sandrelli, Helmut Berger, Renzo Montagnani
description: Since he was three years old, Teo, after having fled with his mother from his native Somalia, has lived in Rome. The mother works in the service of a professional family and the boy has settled in very well. So much so that when his mother dies in an accident, Teo is welcomed as one of the family. Mimma also lives in the building, a girl who seems to have problems with her parents, and Teo is in love with them ... Certainly there is no shortage of events in the story of "Teo"; indeed there is even an excess of it, so much so that the story is a bit confused.

title: Scam
actors: Christopher Walken, Lorraine Bracco, Martin Donovan
description: Normally, Maggie lures rich businessmen into Miami hotels and then scams them. The girl works on behalf of a shady individual. She soon leaves him to follow one of her clients, who promises her richer earnings in the plan she has been archiving for some time. The idea is to scam a famous bookie, who is also linked to a dangerous gangster family, the same one that has always held control of the racket in the area. A decent film for TV, which takes up a theatrical play successfully performed in 1992. Excellent cast.

title: P.O.W. The Escape
actors: David Carradine, Charles R. Floyd, Mako
description: The infamous Colonel Cooper and Captain Vinh, of the American army, taken prisoner by the Vietcong and sentenced to death, meditate on the escape with other comrades. Through a thousand ups and downs, they will find freedom in the very last days before the fall of Saigon. Yet another film on the tragedy of Vietnam, with good action and adventure scenes.

title: Up Close & Personal
actors: Robert Redford, Michelle Pfeiffer, Stockard Channing, Joe Mantegna, Kate Nelligan
description: Anchor-woman Telly Atwater is one of the most loved women in the United States. Yet not long ago Tally had been a waitress and had also worked at the craps table at a casino in Reno, Nevada. In those days she called herself Sallyanne, she had a lot of ambitions and a talent about to blossom. Warren noticed her, a brilliant television journalist, who quickly became her protector and lover. Thus the inexperienced Sallyanne transforms herself from the "weather girl" of a provincial network into the attractive Tally Atwater. Yet it is their work that threatens to divide them. Classic vehicle for stars: Redford defends herself with her profession and Michelle Pfeiffer with beauty married to skill. Valgano - for the record - the following data: fifty minutes to have the first kiss, eighty-five to get married, one hundred to quarrel, one hundred twenty-two to regret.

title: Vesna va veloce
actors: Tereza Zajickova, Antonio Albanese, Silvio Orlando, Roberto Citran, Antonio Catania
description: Along with the "yugos", people who come from the East with shabby buses to shop in Trieste and then leave immediately, a Czechoslovakian girl also arrives. The first Italian he knows is an employee who spends his holidays in the city, while his wife and children are at the seaside. Vesna has no trouble accepting her court in exchange for money. Thus began her ordeal that will lead her into prostitution. Luckily she will find Antonio, a young bricklayer willing to help her.
notes: The film is made up of the right atmospheres, of close-ups (especially the very clear and serious one of the protagonist), of silences, of music that underlines the images; in short, of cinematographic materials worked with rare care and sensitivity.

title: Colpo di luna
actors: Tchéky Karyo, Nino Manfredi, Isabelle Pasco, Jim van der Woude
description: Lorenzo has lived in Milan for years. Now he returns to his native Sicily to restore the old family home and then sell it. The trio of workers to whom he entrusts the work comes from a therapeutic community for mental illnesses, so that Lorenzo comes into contact with this new and unsuspected reality, which causes him to rethink not only on the use of the house, but also on the whole its existence.
notes: Nothing to do with the homonymous (and beautiful) novel by Georges Simenon. Nor with the advertising campaigns with which the director has established himself. His debut in the cinema is unrealistic, confused, dull, despite his "committed" intentions.

title: La smania addosso
actors: Gérard Blain, Annette Stroyberg, Nino Catelnuovo, Vittorio Gassman
description: Sicilian friends Totò and Nicola rape Rosaria. Later, neither of them intends to "make amends" with the marriage. To convince at least one of them to act as a remedial one, everyone goes there: parents, carabinieri, mafia, luminaries of the forum and so on. Totò and Nicola end up in prison, but two well-known lawyers manage to prove that Totò had been provoked and that Nicola is afflicted with psychic impotence. In the meantime, Totò and Rosaria really fall in love and Nicola enters into a relationship with Carmelina, thus denying, in fact, her lawyer ...
notes: In the wake of Germi, a grotesque comedy about Italian customs of the time. Despite Sciascia collaborating on the screenplay, and despite the swarm of character actors, a wasted opportunity.

title: Pianese Nunzio 14 anni a maggio
actors: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Emanuele Gargiulo, Manuela Martinelli, Tonino Taiuti
description: Naples. Don Lorenzo Borrelli, 35, is a new parish priest in the Sanità district. An ancient neighborhood inhabited by a vast proletariat now degraded by unemployment, television and the Camorra. Borrelli stands out for his courage in the fight against crime. He also often holds catechetical meetings with young people, and it is to one of them, Nunzio, an introverted thirteen year old, difficult and in need of affection, who is particularly attached.
notes: A harsh, hard-fought story that starts well, "holds" in the central part and makes us regret the film that Capuano probably could have made, more immersed in tragedy, in bodies, in the Neapolitan baroque.

title: Revolver
actors: Oliver Reed, Fabio Testi, Paola Pitagora, Agostina Belli, Frédéric de Pasquale
description: Blackmailed by a gang of thugs who have kidnapped his wife, Vito Cipriani, the director of a prison, has to free a prisoner. But he soon realizes that he is just a pawn in a much bigger (and dirtier) game involving some politicians. He thus solidarizes with the prisoner with whom he tries to unravel the problem. Police with vague ambitions of social denunciation, but the direction of Sollima is always a good job.

title: L'immensità
actors: Don Backy, Gunj Marchesi, Caterina Caselli, Piero Mazzarella
description: Monica and Dario are engaged. Dario plays in a symphony orchestra while Monica is passionate about beat music. Misunderstandings often arise between the two. One day Monica and some friends steal guitars to be able to do a concert, right in the warehouse where Dario's brother works. Monica realizes she has done a bad deed and returns the guitars. The two engaged couples reconcile. In turn, Dario begins to appreciate beat music. On a plot that is so thin as to be almost evanescent, a series of singing performances by singers and ensembles then (1968) on the crest of the wave are grafted.

title: Trainspotting
actors: Ewan McGregor, Robert Carlyle, Ewen Bremner, Jonny Lee Miller, Kevin McKidd, Kelly Macdonald, Peter Mullan, James Cosmo, Eileen Nicholas, Susan Vidler, Pauline Lynch, Shirley Henderson, Irvine Welsh
description: Edinburgh. Mark Renton, a thief out of necessity, has chosen an honest and sincere drug addiction. Begbie, a violent, alcoholic psychopath scares even his friends, but he wouldn't even dream of touching drugs. Spud, a desperate but lovable heroin addict. Sick Boy, a narcissist with encyclopedic knowledge of Sean Connery, able to keep his addiction to heroin in check. Then there's Tommy who doesn't do drugs, he's a freak of outdoor excursions and Iggy Pop. At the edge of the story, there are the girls of the group.
notes: At breakneck speed inside and out the lives, visions, obsessions and "addictions" of the protagonists. Indeed, in one place, inside and outside a toilet bowl ("the worst in Scotland", a sign warns). Very skilled, engaging, perhaps cunning: from Irvine Welsh's bestseller, a film that symbolizes a time and a place.

title: Welcome to the Dollhouse
actors: Heather Matarazzo, Brendan Sexton jr., Christina Brucato, Victoria Davis
description: Eleven-year-old Dawn Wiener (Matarazzo), the second child of a Jewish family, attends a regular school in any town in New Jersey. Sometimes hated, often scolded, rarely understood, Dawn tries in vain to be open and cheerful as she struggles to overcome what appears to be endless puberty. Dawn is ugly, she wears thick glasses and ugly clothes. Parents prefer her Missy, always looking good in her little pink dress. Dawn's only friend is thug Brandon who always threatens to "rape" her, but who isn't really that bad after all.
notes: Todd Solondz's second film paints a story of ordinary collective madness on a canvas already stained with suffused violence. The description is so realistic that it seems false, proving - once again - that in the cinema you have to step on the fictional pedal if you want to get some truth. The film won Sundance in 1996. Great Heather Matarazzo.

title: Festival
actors: Massimo Boldi, Isabelle Pasco, Gianni Cavina, Irene Grazioli
description: Franco is in his forties. Until a decade ago he was the most courted Italian comedian by film and television producers. At some point, however, the public got tired of him. In this unhappy period of his career, he is offered a dramatic role in a small film by a new director, which will be presented at the Venice Film Festival. Will it be the right time to get back on the crest of the wave? Unfortunately, "Festival" is not as twilight as "Christmas Present", nor is it so bad. Unfortunately: because Avati knows how to outline these sharp and bitter portraits of everyday pettiness, because Boldi is certainly an actor to be redeemed, because Cavina is as always very good, all shades and undertones. The script seems hasty, sometimes too respectful, others distracted; dialogue has unthinkable falls for a director with Avati's experience.

title: The Celluloid Closet
actors: Lily Tomlin, Tom Hanks, Susan Sarandon, John Schlesinger, Gore Vidal
description: Cinema is over a hundred years old and the presence on the screen of gay characters has accompanied us from the beginning, even during the years of the infamous "Hays Code", when "sexual perversion" was explicitly forbidden. From effeminate comedians to lesbian vampires, from pathetic transvestites to sadistic conquerors, Hollywood has defined our thinking on homosexuality. Based on the book "The Celluloid Closet: Homosexuality in the Movies" by Vito Russo, who died of AIDS in 1990, and narrated by Lily Tomlin, the two directors thank the seventh art by retracing the lesbian-gay iconography. They do this very well without resorting to scandals or unearthing shameful pages, but focusing instead on the evolution of costume through films.

title: Walking and Talking
actors: Catherine Keener, Anne Heche, Liev Schreiber, Todd Field
description: You've been married for 19 years - you don't know what it's like out there. The single Amelia takes it out on the analyst: men stay away from her and her best friend is about to get married. He tries a videostore clerk, he meets Andrew, a former flame and "porn addict", discovering that he is having a good time on the phone with a girl from Los Angeles. Moreover, Big Jeans dies, the beloved cat. What to do?
notes: Nicole Holofcener's feature film debut confirms two essential sides to the success of a fist-worthy film: a good screenplay and flaky actors, including Catherine Keener.

title: Albergo Roma
actors: Claudio Bisio, Alessandro Benvenuti, Tchéky Karyo, Debora Caprioglio, Lucia Poli
description: We are in 1939: due to the imminent arrival of the Duce, the orchestra of a small Tuscan town seeks harmony on the notes of Rossini's "Gazza ladra". The poisonous inhabitants, on the other hand, are something to talk about, aided by a dog who, on a dark and stormy night, picks up a decaying fetus. Whose wretched creature will it ever be?
notes: A discreet film and theater actor, Ugo Chiti made his debut in directing with a comedy that one would like to be harsh, but which is acidulous, tinged with yellow, but only faded, "acting", but in a manner. Classist cinema? No: old, outdated and generous cinema exclusively with television aesthetics updated to the itches of time.

title: La lupa
actors: Monica Guerritore, Raoul Bova, Alessia Fugardi, Michele Placido, Giancarlo Giannini
description: Gna 'Pina in the village called her "La lupa" because she never seemed to be satisfied with anything. Women, when they saw her, shunned her, while all men were obsessed with her. Maricchia, a girl little more than a teenager, suffered the loneliness and isolation to be the daughter of the "Lupa". So no one in the village dared to approach her. One day "La lupa" falls madly in love with the young Nanni, who confesses that he prefers Maricchia to her, because she is young and virgin. In order to be close to him, the woman agrees to Nanni's wedding with Maricchia.

title: Easy Living
actors: Jean Arthur, Ray Milland, Edward Arnold
description: Mary Smith wears the mink coat of a billionaire's wife on her head that he threw out of the window during a fight. When he convinces her to keep it and accompanies her to buy a hat too, everyone is convinced that the two are lovers.
notes: A classic of the Hollywood comedy of the Thirties, which, laughing and joking, leaves its mark on the respectability and hairy moralism of American society. Screenwriter Preston Sturges would soon switch to directing himself.

title: Bambola
actors: Valeria Marini, Stefano Dionisi, Anita Ekberg, Antonino Iuorio, Jorge Perugorría
description: Everyone calls her doll, but its name is Mina. His mother owns a trattoria, in Comacchio, usually frequented by truck drivers. Doll has a homosexual brother who loves, but who has no good relationships with his mother. The latter dies in tragicomic circumstances and the two decide to transform the place into a pizzeria. The money to set up the business is anticipated by Ugo, a banker in love with a doll. Jealous, Ugo challenges the boyfriend's boyfriend to fight, but he has the worst.
notes: Small cuts in the version for the rooms: via the "insistence" on the Sederone in Cinemascope della Marini; Via ten percent of free carnal violence, mostly standing, among the fetid walls of a prison. Bigas Luna seems to have lost courage and brazenness, and develops an involuntarily hilarious script where the finest joke is: "to women you have to give the fuck, fuck, fuck. And barrels!". The ambition is the mélo, but the result is a festival of the aesthetic Rovagnati. Third inconvenient: a capitone. Ate too much? Digned badly? A Cul-Movie doc.

title: Nitrato d'argento
actors: Iaia Forte, Luciana De Falco, Sabrina La Leggia, Doriana Bianchi
description: An empty movie theater. A full cinema room, but there are only mannequins on the armchairs. The lights go out and a ride through one hundred years of cinema history begins with alternating, on the screen, clips of old films, great classics or secondhand works, while the audience lives, loves, cries, screams, runs away, arises. , dream. Here Ferreri is celebrating the centenary of the "seventh art": a young and "anti" film even if directed by a great old man.

title: Hotel paura
actors: Sergio Castellitto, Iaia Forte, Isabella Ferrari, Francesco Paolantoni
description: Due to a sudden dismissal, the administrative director of a company, Carlo Ruggeri, finds himself unemployed. What's more, he is in the throes of an eviction and things in the family are not going very well. His wife and children hurry to unload him and for the man to find another job becomes a desperate undertaking. Thus begins for Carlo a descent into the hell of the homeless who crowd the stations and towards small hotels of the lowest order. "Hotel Fear" is the second feature film by Renato De Maria, after "Il trasloco", a curious homage to the Bolognese movement of '77 and to Radio Alice. Realistic, well interpreted and measured, it has the advantage of playing above all with psychological nuances. The path in the city is slightly anonymous and the script and the side characters are not always up to par. Overall, interesting.

title: The Brothers McMullen
actors: Edward Burns, Mike McGlone, Jack Mulcahy, Shari Albert, Maxine Bahns, Elizabeth McKay
description: Three brothers, happily orphaned by a memorable drunkard, proudly Irish, ferociously sarcastic. The eldest is married to Molly, one of those women that everyone would like to have; the youngest is an observant Catholic and is looking for a wife; the pimp (Burns himself) doesn't believe in love, even though he lines up with the gorgeous Maxine Bahns.
notes: Circular - opens and closes on the same shot -, talkative (as a good independent), is a first work that hops between the small movements of the heart and the squalid corners of an America where the emigrant nostalgia is always that of the past . An entertaining family comedy, winner of the 1995 Sundance and made with fifteen thousand dollars.

title: Classe mista 3ª A
actors: Leonardo Ruta, Eleonora D'Urso, Alessio Federici, Paolo Bonolis
description: Three boys are preparing to face the maturity, but their main interest is certainly not the study. Stefano leaves his girlfriend for the beautiful Caterina, but his partner Gianluca forces him to disguise himself as a Jim Morrison fan to win over another schoolmate. Annalisa, the girl abandoned by Stefano, will find the man of her dreams.
notes: The example that the director has in mind is that of American teen comedies. Our teenagers naturally have all the charms of Roman dialect, they say "mythical" every three words and they seem like the stupid children of the calves of forty years ago. The newcomer Federico Moccia (son of Pipolo of the couple Castellano & Pipolo), does not even have the job of his father. The only (involuntary) comedy is in the alleged romantic scenes.

title: Breaking the Waves
actors: Stellan Skarsgård, Emily Watson, Katrin Cartlidge, Jean-Marc Barr, Adrian Rawlins, Jonathan Hackett, Sandra Voe, Udo Kier, Mikkel Gaup, Roef Ragas, Phil McCall
description: Seven chapters, plus a prologue and an epilogue: each one introduced by a kind of colorful and slightly naive "curtain" and a song from the '70s (from "Whiter Shade of Pale" to "Suzanne"). Each chapter tells a piece of the love story of Bess, an innocent Scottish young man who puts passion above everything, and of Jan, a Danish worker who works on an oil rig. Positive characters, overwhelmed by an atrocious twist of fate (he goes into a coma due to an accident), controlled by the anachronistic moralism of the puritan Church of England and redeemed by her extreme sacrifice.
notes: We are in the land of melos; as Von Trier said, between Dreyer (cold melon and hollowed out by the sense of sin) and Sirk (mello overheated by color and the need for transgression). Von Trier has the courage to expand the narrative for 158 minutes; that of daring, shamelessly, a final miracle.

title: Les gens normaux n'ont rien d'exceptionel
actors: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Melvil Poupaud, Marc Citti
description: Martine, 25, a job and a normal existence. But her relationship with François was interrupted and the girl doesn't know how to deal with it. A scene is followed by other alarming episodes, which will cause Martine to be hospitalized as mentally ill. At this point the girl demonstrates an unexpected vitality: she takes an interest in the love life of other patients, attracts the ire of the people in charge of her and others' custody. After directing several short films and a documentary about Bergman, 35-year-old Ferreira Barbosa makes her debut in a fresh and meaningful feature, written in collaboration with Cedric Kahn. And it reveals the talent of Valeria Bruni Tedeschi.

title: Tre
actors: Christian De Sica, Leo Gullotta, Anna Galiena, Paolo Conticini
description: Baron Jacopo lives with his beautiful wife and spends his days amidst pleasant jokes and worries about not having children. His life could change when a young revolutionary enters the scene, Leonardo, belonging to a group to which Jacopo has always procured the weapons for fun. Leonardo, pushed by Jacopo himself, will actively participate in the couple's sexual activity; then he will get the woman pregnant and leave the palace.
notes: De Sica works in low comedy while he is glossy and affected when he wants to tackle more complex issues. In this latest effort he is inspired by the canons of "quality European cinema", bordering on boredom.

title: Eraser
actors: Arnold Schwarzenegger, James Caan, James Coburn, Vanessa Williams
description: John Kruger, a commander of the federal police, is part of the WITSEC special group, which is concerned with providing a new identity to witnesses under protection. The exceptional physical strength and intensive training he undergoes make him the best member of the group. Eraser (this is his nickname) is faced with the most demanding challenge of his career: protecting the witnesses entrusted to him by a mole, which from within his own organization constitutes a terrible threat to their safety. Arnold Schwarzenegger deceives us every now and then: he did it with "The Twins" and especially with "True Lies", where James Cameron threw him into intelligent satire (of himself, James Bond and all his emulators), without giving up super effects. But from "The Eliminator" don't expect anything that vaguely resembles "True Lies". Here Schwarzy has returned to take himself seriously and is a full-blown action man, very acrobatic and rather dull, within a plot that could not be more obvious.

title: Le huitième jour
actors: Daniel Auteuil, Pascal Duquenne, Miou-Miou, Isabelle Sadoyan
description: Harry, accomplished at work, but with a precarious family situation, accidentally meets Georges, a Down boy who has escaped from an institution. The man invites him to his home and grows fond of him. Between the two, different from every point of view, a very deep bond is born. Thanks to this meeting, Harry's life will change radically.
notes: A bittersweet comedy, with dramatic and comic implications, "L'ottavo Giorno" has the advantage of treating in a predominantly surreal key a story that could easily fall into mellow tones. Van Dormael has a great visual inventiveness, a subtle sense of humor and almost never yields (except in the last part) to the blackmail of the subject.

title: Face of Evil
actors: Tracey Gold, Perry King, Shawnce Smith
description: Darcy is a not too successful young painter. So, after killing a student, he takes her place to enter an exclusive college. Here he soon meets his roommate's father, who, seduced by Darcy's beauty, introduces her to the world of art collectors. But the man then discovers the bitter truth: Darcy has already killed more than one girl to get hold of their identity. The script idea of ??this TV movie is to demonstrate, as in a certain classic noir, that evil can have a thousand faces. But the charm of this contemporary dark lady is not the same as the protagonists of many Hollywood films of the 1940s

title: Il disco volante
actors: Alberto Sordi, Monica Vitti, Silvana Mangano, Eleonora Rossi Drago, Gianluigi Crescenzi, Alberto Fogliani, Liana Del Balzo, Carlo Mazzarella, Lello Bersani, Graziella Polesinanti, Guido Celano, Lars Bloch, Piero Morgia, Erika Blanc
description: In a village of Veneto a flying jug launches. A carabinieri brigadier is in charge of the investigation. Thus begins to question the witnesses but these, including the brigadier, will end up in the asylum: the case will soon be forgotten.
notes: Tinto Brass Satires the provincial company through a Dolceamaro apologist tending to farce. A little more than specks the characters (four) played by deaf. When he still tinted he was committed and had not discovered the sex delights.

title: The Pirate Movie
actors: Kristy McNichol, Christopher Atkins, Ted Hamilton, Bill Kerr
description: Mabel is really in love with Frederick, to the point of chasing his yacht with a small sailboat. However, she falls into the sea and, after having reached the shore by swimming, she falls asleep exhausted and begins to dream. She will find herself immersed in a strange dream full of braggart pirates and with Frederick in the guise of the king of corsairs. After a series of grotesque and completely incongruous adventures, Mabel ends her fantasy by marrying her boyfriend. But then he wakes up.
notes: Mediocre rock adaptation of the operetta "Pirates of Penzance" by Gilbert and Sullivan, signed by Australian director Ken Annakin. The humor, unfortunately, is missing.

title: Scanner Cop 2: The Showdown
actors: Daniel Quinn, Robert Forster, Patrick Kilpatrick, Jim Blumetti, Khrystyne Haje
description: It was some time after agent Samuel Staziak (Quinn), a policeman who uses his telepathic abilities to fight crime, brought the dangerous scanner Volkin (Kilpatrick) to justice, which instead gave his skills to the crime. When the latter returns to the city, determined to take revenge on the agent, Samuel will have to deal with his powers, which in the meantime have become more and more deadly. Contrary to what usually happens, this sequel is, in its own way, successful. Action, suspense, narrative rhythm, even if elementary, are there.

title: Klondike Annie
actors: Mae West, Victor McLaglen, Philip Reed, Harold Huber, Helen Jerome Eddy
description: We are at the end of the 19th century: Rose, queen of a local misunderstanding in San Francisco's Chinatown, kills the owner, a Chinese who was threatening her, then embarks on a ship bound for Alaska. The captain falls in love with the woman, but she is now on the way to redemption, fascinated by the figure of a young missionary with whom she shares the cabin. Upon her death, Rose assumes her identity ... A shift in the career of Mae West, up to now struggling with characters not exactly edifying. And director Raoul Walsh pampers her, both in the sinful and in the redeemed version. The sequence of the sermon and the collection is famous.

title: MacGyver: Lost Treasure of Atlantis
actors: Brian Blessed, Sophie Ward, Christian Burgess
description: Our hero MacGyver and a former college teacher of his are engaged in a new adventure: that is, in the search for some artifacts that are traced back to Zeno, an ancient scientist from Atlantis; from here in search of the mythical disappeared continent, the step is short ... Go-go adventure for those who want to spend ninety minutes in complete carefree.

title: Too Young to Die?
actors: Juliette Lewis, Michael Tucker, Brad Pitt, Alan Fudge, Emily Longstreth
description: The protagonist of the story narrated in the film is a teenager with a devastated soul. At fourteen she was already married to a little good who, soon after, leaves her alone. Without means and without any help, at fifteen she hit the pavement. Due to her mental condition, every man who had sex with her virtually raped her, including her father. A murderer before she turned sixteen, she's now in the hands of a lawyer trying to get her a fair trial.
notes: Television production that has as its protagonist still far from notoriety. In the cast there is also another future star: Brad Pitt. However, all this does not serve to raise the general level of the work which remains that of a conventional production.

title: Cellar Dweller
actors: Jeffrey Combs, Debrah Farentino, Brian Robbins, Yvonne De Carlo
description: Based on enigmatic texts and equally enigmatic figures contained in an ancient book he came into possession of, a draftsman invents a monstrous creature. The creature materializes and, for the designer, it is the end. Much later, an aspiring designer rediscovers the unfinished work of her forerunner and decides to continue it to complete it ...
notes: You know "Jumangi"? Here is the previous one, but for older readers how can we not think of the famous "Archivernice"? Nothing new, then: demons, black magic, some special effects. For enthusiasts, any recycling works.

title: The Fan
actors: Robert De Niro, Wesley Snipes, Ellen Barkin, Benicio Del Toro
description: Bobby Rayburn (Wesley Snipes) is a baseball ace recently hired by the San Francisco Giants for a nice $ 40 million. Gil Renard (Robert De Niro) is a knife rep on the way of layoff from work and family. Gil adores Mick Jagger, a "solo-rocker-musician" - with a special fondness for "Simpathy for The Devil" - and is a Bobby fanatic, expecting all the best, including the championship. Thus begins to haunt him. A two-player game, extremely dangerous; the launches are "pure poetry in motion" and the projections, such as to bother even Herr Sigmund Freud. De Niro wallows in the characterization of the obsessive and obsessed maniac, pathological to the point of abandoning his son in the stands of the stadium in order to serve his cause; or, indeed, to kill. After all, this is the prosthesis of the unforgettable Travis Bickle from "Taxi driver" and Rupert Pupkin from "Re per una notte". With the tragic common denominator summarized in the virtual joke: "Hey, I'm here too". A sports thriller between "The Best" and "Cape Fear", serious "like a heart attack", uncertain as a "off screen" suspended in stop-frame.

title: The Funeral
actors: Christopher Walken, Chris Penn, Vincent Gallo, Isabella Rossellini, Annabella Sciorra
description: Johnny Tempio is a young mafioso, he's twenty-two, and has just come out of the cinema where he saw "The Petrified Forest". A volley of bullets hits him dead. The Tempio family accustomed to violence does not accept Johnny's death. His brothers, Ray and Chaz along with their friend Sali and their women are all around his coffin; thus begins a wake that turns into a pretext to retrace the tormented life of Johnny.
notes: All set in one night, Ferrara's film has a narrative and temporal circularity that takes your breath away, with the stages of the long night of wakefulness, pain and revenge intertwined with the flashbacks that enter the flashbacks (a virtuosity that only the narrators really great cinemas manage to sustain without being artifacts). "Fratelli" is not a mafia film, but a classic tragedy, guided by the death touch of the nemesis, and which has the courage not to deny the genre, to suddenly explode into violence, to make us see death in the face, in the foreground , eyes wide open. Chris Penn won the Coppa Volpi in Venice for the best male interpretation.

title: Mulholland Falls
actors: Nick Nolte, Chazz Palminteri, Chris Penn, Melanie Griffith, Michael Madsen, John Malkovich
description: Los Angeles 1954: Max Hoover of the Police Department heads the "Hat Squad", an anti-crime unit that does not have to answer to anyone. More feared than the most ruthless gangster, Hoover rules the city. But when his ex-lover is brutally murdered, everything changes. In fact, the woman had immortalized every moment of her relationship on film.
notes: First Hollywood product by Lee Tamahori, the New Zealand director of "Once Were Warriors". A beautiful Los Angeles noir atmosphere, beautifully photographed by Haskell Wexler. A huge cast, led by Nolte and Palminteri and supported by the intimate and ambiguous undertones of Griffith and Malkovich respectively. A script that knows how to mix public misdeeds and private anguish, in the tradition of Chandler, Ellroy and "Chinatown". An accurate dose of action, tension and cynical humor. Even if certain characters get lost along the way and sometimes the tension eases.

title: Die Gebrüder Skladanowsky
actors: Udo Kier, Otto Kuhnle, Nadine Buettner, Christoph Merg
description: In 1892 Max, Eugen and Emil Skladanowsky, three amateur artist brothers, without any support, had already produced "living photographs"; while six weeks before the Lumière brothers' historic premiere - November 1, 1895 - they projected eight short scenes in Berlin through a device of their own invention called Bioskop. Their projector was certainly not as good as the Lumière's, but it worked. One hundred years later, Wim Wenders, with the active collaboration of the Munich film students, brings to light the sensational claim: we Germans invented the Seventh Art! The film, therefore, presents itself as a kind of historical document in the form of fiction in the manner of silent cinema with a second part entirely dedicated to the ninety-year-old Lucia, daughter of Max, still lucid and full of memories. Silvery black and white, temporal differences of delicate elegance and an air of affectionate homage with hints of jaunty chauvinism.

title: Il barbiere di Rio
actors: Diego Abatantuono, Rocco Papaleo, Zuleika Dos Santos, Irene Grandi
description: Matteo is a forty year old in a growing identity crisis since - after fifteen years of marriage - he separated from his wife Silvia. To prove to the woman that she is unable to meet her requests for an increase in the monthly allowance, she is reduced to living, with her two children aged ten and seven, in a loft above a small barber shop. Until fate makes him come across a real guardian angel who invites him to go to Brazil. There must be Vittorio Cecchi Gori's hand in this timid operation to relaunch the Italian comedy. Ingredients: a star with a strong and bulky personality, who already eliminates the competition from the opening credits; a script written in haste by two horses of the Florentine stable (Chiti and Veronesi): a "Brazilian" trip to show that the money has been spent in earnest. The guardian angel is Irene Grandi.

title: Phenomenon
actors: John Travolta, Kyra Sedgwick, Forest Whitaker, Robert Duvall
description: Everyone in the town of Harmon knows George Malley as a good guy and a great mechanic. But on his 37th birthday George begins to change. A light descended from heaven will allow him to devour books, to give birth to projects and to frighten friends and acquaintances.
notes: A pro-Scientology commercial, the sect that - in the early 1980s - seriously disrupted Travolta's habits and customs. The aims are apparently harmless: to communicate to the whole world the real potentialities contained in each existing cerebral cortex. At the beginning you fall into the muffled and almost fairytale atmosphere. Then a doubt arises: that extraterrestrials are already on Earth and want to deprive us of the only good left, the brain? Dry us E.T.

title: Metalmeccanico e parrucchiera in un turbine di sesso e...
actors: Tullio Solenghi, Veronica Pivetti, Gene Gnocchi, Cyrielle Claire, Cinzia Leone, Piera Degli Esposti
description: In Zvanin, a metal mechanic from Rifondazione and in Tunin, a friend of mine, married to Palmina and Mariolina, respectively, their hands itch when they meet some leaguers. It will be during a fight, after the '94 elections, that Zvanin is struck by Rossella, a tawny hairdresser who has Bossi in her heart. The woman will be his only if Zvanin becomes Northern League.
notes: An idea, a slender script that limits itself to amplifying television modules, a push to exaggeration that decades ago arrived at the grotesque, but today it only reaches the vulgar. Solenghi and Pivetti are good, but they are not Giannini and Melato, forced moreover, with all the other actors, to an Emilian pronunciation that makes the accent of Gene Gnocchi the only "native" pale. Thus, between wives of metalworkers dressed as feminists of the good bourgeoisie, too red shirts and too furious embraces, class and sex struggle (and cinema) are consummated without glory according to Lina Wertmuller.

title: The Pillow Book
actors: Vivian Wu, Yoshi Oida, Ewan McGregor, Ken Ogata, Hideko Yoshida, Judy Ongg, Ken Mitsuishi, Yutaka Honda, Barbara Lott, Miwako Kawai, Lynne Langdon
description: Nagiko (Wu), the young daughter of a poor calligrapher, raised by her father in the cult of the Japanese tradition of "chamber" writing, moves to Hong Kong and begins to passionately practice writing on the body with her lovers. Through this practice he ends up taking revenge on the perverse homosexual publisher (Oida) who destroyed the life of his father and then that of his lover.
notes: Taken from the zibaldone of Sei Shonagon, a lady of the court born around 966, the film is divided into thirteen chapters corresponding to as many "books" of meat. Poetic ending, with Nagiko listing the seven things worth living for: "A lover in the garden, still and pouring water, love in the afternoon, imitation of history, first love and love after, the flesh and the writing, write about love and find it ".

title: The Portrait of a Lady
actors: Nicole Kidman, John Malkovich, Barbara Hershey, Mary-Louise Parker
description: Isabel Archer, an American girl living in England, refuses an advantageous marriage proposal for her desire to experience; closed for too long at home she wants to know the world. His gesture scandalizes the relatives. Her cousin Ralph Touchett is the only one who takes her side and who manages to persuade her father to leave her part of the inheritance.
notes: Campion takes great risks because she treats the novel, already extreme by Henry James, as an extreme champion of romanticism: cruel, mangled, only apparently staid by crinolines and nineteenth-century narrative conventions. He throws himself into Isabel Archer's sentimental and cultural education while apparently respecting the rules of "literary" cinema, but, in reality, the violence and tension run underground and explode in a harsh and angular style. Very good NIcole Kidman.

title: Cresceranno i carciofi a Mimongo
actors: Daniele Liotti, Valerio Mastandrea, Rocco Papaleo, Francesca Schiavio
description: Sergio, who has recently graduated in agriculture, begins to follow the advice contained in a manual to the letter. He needs a job and his fussiness seems to match "market demands" well. Prepared for months, on the day of the first important interview at a frozen food company, he will make everything go wrong through the fault or thanks to love. Surprise: one of the latest "articles 28" is a first feature in black and white that is half funny and snappy. A debut that frees itself from the embarrassing shyness that usually accompany such operations, refreshed by actors among which the shrill voiceover of Chiambretti and Valerio Mastandrea, TV face launched by Costanzo, stand out. For the record, Mimongo exists: in Gabon.

title: Sleepers
actors: Dustin Hoffman, Kevin Bacon, Robert De Niro, Brad Pitt, Vittorio Gassman, Jason Patric, Minnie Driver, Ron Eldard, Terry Kinney, Bruno Kirby, Frank Medrano, Joseph Perrino, Brad Pitt, Brad Renfro, Geoffrey Wigdor, Jonathan Tucker
description: New York, 1960s: Holy Angels church and elementary school are the hub of the infamous Hell's Kitchen neighborhood. The place is a refuge for many children in the area who live in difficult situations. Father Bobby, the head of the center, has his favorites. It is these men, however, who cause the death of a man: arrested and sentenced, they suffer violence and torture in the reformatory. Back in the wild, they return to their old environment ...
notes: Despite De Niro (who remakes himself, with class) and Hoffman (in the beautiful, curious and grumbling part of the lawyer from whom no one would want to be protected), the film is a bit obvious and rhetorical. But also touching.

title: Tin Cup
actors: Kevin Costner, Rene Russo, Cheech Marin, Don Johnson, Linda Hart
description: Roy "Tin Cup" McAvoy, former golf champion, has retired to the town of Salome in Texas, where he gives lessons, of course for a fee, to anyone who wants to learn how to play. But one day he decides to return to racing at a professional level because he is spurred on by his long-time rival and eager to impress the beautiful psychologist Molly Griswold.
notes: Boring for the layman (forty minutes of golf is, frankly, unbearable), ridiculous for non-traditionalists (one hundred and twenty minutes to convince the lovebirds to go to bed claim "no comment"), vulgar for double entenders. In short, a wasted opportunity.

title: Irma Vep
actors: Maggie Cheung, Nathalie Richard, Jean-Pierre Léaud, Nathalie Boutefeu
description: One of the greatest Asian actresses arrives in Paris to play the role of Irma Vep in a film based on Musidora, the character who led the gang of "Les Vampires", in the French silent film series conceived and directed by Louis Feuillade. it has now become a cult among enthusiasts. Of course she doesn't know a word of French and everyone around her on the set tries to speak to her in English, especially René Vidal, the director who sees her as the only actress capable of playing that role.
notes: A film that mixes the nostalgia of classic cinema and the passion of modernity, with dazzling jokes about cinema and affectionate and exemplary quotes.

title: Crash
actors: James Spader, Holly Hunter, Elias Koteas, Rosanna Arquette
description: James Ballard (Spader) is a commercial director by profession, and thanks to a car accident he learns to associate sexual pleasure with car crashes and the risk of dying on a highway. James begins a dangerous relationship with Dr. Helena Remington (Hunter), who has lost her husband in an accident and manages to involve his wife in complex marriages. The man meets and suffers the charm of Vaughan (Koteas), author of reconstructions of famous accidents. The film that the Canadian director based on "Crash", a cult book by James Ballard written in 1973 is circular, lucidly turbid and obsessed. The characters, in continuous sexual activity, are suspended in a psychic universe that binds the idea of pleasure (and love) to that of death, and which extends seamlessly between a mechanical and impersonal today and an immediate future of mutations. Cronenberg's cut to the material "scandalized" some critics at Cannes, where the film won the award for best director.

title: Squillo
actors: Raz Degan, Jennifer Driver, Paul Freeman, Bianca Koedam
description: A young Polish girl, Maria, arrives in Milan with the intention of making a surprise for her older sister, Eva. They haven't seen each other for seven years. Maria looks at Eva's luxurious apartment in amazement and soon realizes that her sister is a prostitute. One day Eva disappears and the investigation is entrusted to detective Messina.
notes: The film is resolved in a series of luxury rings and mobile phones to justify the advertising, not so hidden, of Telecom.

title: La notte e il momento
actors: Willem Dafoe, Lena Olin, Miranda Richardson, Jean-Claude Carrière
description: A writer, who is fame of great seducer, is invited by a French noblewoman in his castle. In the evening, when the other guests retired to their rooms, the writer shows up in the Marquise Chamber. From that moment on, a series of amorous skirmishes, of fertilizers and denials, of stories begins. From the novel of the same name of Crébillon Fils, screenplay by Jean-Claude Carrière, photography by Giuseppe Rotunno, editing of Ruggero Mastroianni, Music by Morricone. More Dafoe, Lena Olin, Miranda Richardson. Everything is of a unique boredom.

title: I Like It Like That
actors: Lauren Vélez, Jon Seda, Tomas Melly, Jesse Borrego, Rita Moreno
description: A family of weak financial resources in the unpleasant universe of the Bronx: Chino, Lisette and three children. When the man ends up in prison, the woman has to work hard to find something to support the family, and ends up finding a job that satisfies her and is valued. But the slander, about her and her husband when Chino is released from prison on bail, spreads insidious poison ... First directed by Darnell Martin (also screenwriter), which describes the Bronx in which she grew up. With a lot of good will, but with some excessive burdens and without much originality. The evident intentions are more appreciable than the results.

title: Alice Adams
actors: Katharine Hepburn, Fred MacMurray, Evelyn Venable
description: A girl tries in every way to escape her petty bourgeois condition by trying to fit into the worldly life of high society. He does not miss a dance, he gets invited to parties, but often undergoes humiliations. Having met a charming boy, he falls in love with him and, to conquer him, builds a castle of lies.
notes: A fun comedy with social intent built around the character of Hepburn (who won an Oscar nomination), sparkling and very lively.

title: I pagliacci
actors: Alida Valli, Paul Hörbiger, Beniamino Gigli
description: Served twenty years in prison for a passionate murder, a man tries to reconcile with his daughter (who knows nothing of his past) who grew up in a wealthy family. The man tells his story to a composer who draws an opera from it, witnessing which the girl is moved by understanding the drama of her father. A curious variation on the theme of Leoncavallo's "Pagliacci" which skilfully mixes cinema (the re-enactment of the real news story that inspired Leoncavallo's opera) and melodrama (you can see a scene from the opera).

title: The Addiction
actors: Lili Taylor, Christopher Walken, Annabella Sciorra, Edie Falco, Paul Calderon, Fredro Starr, Kathryn Erbe, Michael Imperioli
description: It is night when a university student, Kathleen, is attacked in an alley by an elegant woman with bites on the neck. The days pass, and the girl realizes that she has contracted a virus that not only infects her body, but also her mind. He wanders the streets of New York in search of victims who can satisfy his new form of addiction: the irresistible one for blood. Before "Fratelli", Ferrara shoots this small masterpiece, distributed only three years later in the cinemas of our country. Sick Black and White, for a film in which the archetype of vampirism becomes an (autobiographical) metaphor for the terrible drug addiction.

title: The Rainbow
actors: Sammi Davis, Paul McGann, Glenda Jackson, Amanda Donohoe, Christopher Gable, David Hemmings, Dudley Sutton, Jim Carter, Judith Paris, Kenneth Colley, Glenda McKay, Mark Owen
description: We are at the turn of the century in old England. Here, in a country town, a teenager, torn between the love of a teacher and that of a soldier, embarks on a path of escape from conventions, for a personal search for identity and life. Luckily she is not alone: ??her closest friend in fact thinks like her and shares her choices and battles.
notes: Twenty years after the excellent "Women in love" Ken Russell is once again inspired, with good results, by D.H. Lawrence.

title: Lair of the White Worm
actors: Amanda Donohoe, Hugh Grant, Sammi Davis
description: During an archaeological expedition to Scotland, scholars come across a strange fossil lying in the soil layers of a farm inhabited by two pretty sisters. A local legend tells that in ancient times a Lord held a dragon prisoner. Things are even more horrifying: in order to restore life to a demonic creature, a centuries-old vampire seeks a virgin to sacrifice.
notes: From a minor novel by Bram Stoker (author of "Dracula"). Russell takes pleasure in resorting to visual effects and phantasmagoria, until he loses control of the film.

title: Roommates
actors: D.B. Sweeney, Peter Falk, Julianne Moore, Jan Rubes
description: Of Polish descent, Rocky lives in Pittsburgh where he raised his grandson Michael, who became a young doctor in Ohio. Evicted from his old home, he goes to live with Michael, who imposes himself with his strong personality: he doesn't particularly like his nephew's "sinful" relationship with Beth, and Michael marries the girl. The couple moves, has two children, is in danger of falling apart. But Rocky still has to teach ... Peter Falk, heavily made up to look thirty years older and older, is the humoral, stubborn and wise Rocky. Directed by Peter Yates avoids sentimental excesses with far too much professional correctness, leaving room for a few yawns.

title: Few of Us
actors: Katerina Golubëva, Sergei Tulayev, Piotr Kishteev
description: Like in a science fiction movie, a beautiful and equally mysterious alien lands in a remote corner of Siberia. Thus begins his journey on planet Earth, which seems to have been the victim of a tremendous explosion. His presence and his wandering in the wastelands of the ice region are greeted, by the surrounding nature, by a vague feeling of disquiet and bewilderment. In 105 minutes of extraordinary images, without dialogue, the director constructs a mysterious, hypnotic and disturbing visual poem. A people forgotten by God, a cold and hostile nature, living conditions at the limit of tolerability, a feeling of oppression that contrasts with the immensity of the surrounding landscapes. On the whole meaning of an apocalyptic tragedy lurking, or perhaps already occurred. The violence of the sub-final could be nothing but the echo of an explosion of which the last gasps are felt. Bartas films things as they are (or as they appear), injecting shreds of fiction with calculated avarice. Radical questioning on the meaning of seeing, material and metaphysical film together.

title: Ritorno a casa Gori
actors: Sabrina Ferilli, Alessandro Benvenuti, Athina Cenci, Alessandro Haber
description: Mother Adele died and the family reunited for the funeral, mingling with friends and acquaintances. Luciano and Sandra are forced to interrupt their holidays in Ghana, where they went with the hope of recovering their relationship. But in crisis, it is also Bruna, Sandra's mother and sister of the deceased: she is infatuated with Flavio who is ten years younger than her and intends to leave her husband. Six years after "Welcome to the Gori house", the Tuscan actor and director gathers his "serpent relatives" around the body of aunt Adelina (Ilaria Occhini, involved, among other things, in an experiment of "Italian way" to the effects special not despicable). The choral fresco of the Gori and their neighbors and friends is a catalog of neurosis, resentment and envy. Between drama and pochade, many closed and open doors, a bittersweet and terribly universal portrait of a family.

title: A Time to Kill
actors: Sandra Bullock, Matthew McConaughey, Samuel L. Jackson, Donald Sutherland, Kevin Spacey, Ashley Judd, Tonea Stewart, Charles S. Dutton, Oliver Platt, Brenda Fricker, Kiefer Sutherland, Patrick McGoohan, Rae'Ven Larrymore Kelly
description: We are in a small town in the South of the United States, where two white people rape and think they have killed a ten-year-old black girl. His father, Carl Lee, a Vietnam War veteran, decides to take justice for himself. A racial conflict breaks out around the black man. The most serious risks are run by the defense lawyer, targeted by the Ku Klux Klan.
notes: Grisham took seven years to hand over the rights to his first novel (vaguely autobiographical) and demanded the "final cut" on screenplay, director (Schumacher, who had already directed "The Client") and actors. Result: the weakest and most predictable of Grisham-based films. Miniseries-style diluted script, with all the twists "phoned" at least two sequences before and pedantic dialogues; suggested eroticism, with the protagonists always a little wet and shiny (which is sexy); and the "discovery" McConaughey totally expressionless. A deadly bore.

title: The Bounty Killer
actors: Dan Duryea, Rod Cameron, Audrey Dalton
description: Willie is a peaceful man; arrived in the West in search of fortune, he falls in love with Carol, just back from an emotional misadventure. After finding work, he kills a bandit he was attacked by and collects the bounty. He then decides to become a bounty hunter, but soon his new life transforms him into another man. And in the end it leads him to ruin.
notes: B-western with an evident moral, with old actors of the silent and sonorous western, from Bronco Billy Anderson to Buster Crabbe.

title: Viale della canzone
actors: Bobby Solo, Edoardo Vianello, Pino Donaggio, Nico Fidenco, Los Marcellos Ferial
description: The film is part of the trilogy whose two other titles sounded "These crazy, Italian crazy" and "008 operation rhythm". The three films are constructed in the same way: a review of singers, especially Italian and particularly in vogue at the moment, who interpret one of their successes. Between one performance and another, short animated drawings are inserted with commentary by a voiceover.

title: Racconti a due piazze
directors: Jean Delannoy, François Dupont-Midi, Gianni Puccini, Al World (Alvaro Mancori)
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Sylva Koscina, Nino Castelnuovo, Margaret Lee, France Anglade, Michel Serrault
description: Five episodes. First: a night of promiscuity for guests of an inn. Second: she reevaluates her husband, accused of being a maniac. Third: he offers her a nice sum for his favors, but the money was a gift from her brother. Fourth: she improvises herself as a prostitute to pay the funeral for him, who pretends to be dead. Fifth: the fiancé must prove to the future brother-in-law that he knows how to do it in bed.
notes: We should classify it as an "Italian comedy of manners" but it is an improper definition, given that out of five episodes, three are directed by French hand. However, the best (or least worst) segment is that of Al World (alias Alvaro Mancori), taken from a text by Eduardo de Filippo.

title: Questo pazzo, pazzo mondo della canzone
actors: Sandra Mondaini, Aroldo Tieri, Valeria Fabrizi
description: A real plot does not exist because the film serves only as a container for the various curtains that surround the singing performances of some famous singers of the sixties. In order: Gianni Morandi, Edoardo Vianello, Lucio Dalla, Petula Clark, Nico Fidenco, Gino Paoli, Luigi Tenco, Little Tony, I Flippers, Ricky Gianco, Los Marcellos Ferial, Jenny Luna and many others.
notes: Some of them have entered the history of light movement by right, others have passed as true meteors.

title: Götterdämmerung
actors: Dirk Bogarde, Ingrid Thulin, Helmut Berger, Charlotte Rampling
description: The film tells the saga of the Essenbeck family, owners of large steel mills, on the eve of the Nazi takeover in Germany. The old Joachim is willing to pass the hand to his sons, among whom are Hitler's supporters and opponents. Among the closest relatives there is also a sympathizer of the SS who takes advantage of the situation to get rid of his opponents within the family with violence. Incest and suicides complete the picture of the situation that has the course of a Greek tragedy and the spirit of the novels of the beloved Thomas Mann. Starting from these references, Visconti elaborates a story of epic grandeur and extraordinary formal elegance.

title: The Seven Thieves
actors: Edward G. Robinson, Rod Steiger, Joan Collins
description: Theo Wilkins, a senior former scholar, has long since concocted an elaborate plan to break into the safe at the Monte Carlo Casino. To implement his plan, he brings Paul Mason, a gangster who has just finished serving a sentence, from America. With a group of accomplices, they sneak into the building on the day of the traditional Red Cross Grand Ball.
notes: Entrusting Edward G. Robinson with the role of a gangster is like giving a child a cone. The rest of the cast is top notch, but the story is banal and Hathaway's directing is tarnished.

title: Every Woman's Dream
actors: Jeff Fahey, Kim Cattrall, Delane Matthews, Walter Addison
description: Mitch Parker has two wives. One knows him as a secret agent of the CIA, constantly engaged in secret missions. The other believes him a philanthropist billionaire, as well as a brave man who has just fought the difficult battle with cancer. In reality, Mitch is a very vulgar fixer, loosely tied to the world of finance. Sooner or later, of course, one of the wives comes to discover her double life, and then ... Between comedy and crime, this film wants to be first and foremost a story about the naivety of women. But maybe it's just a fairly obvious film, good only for spending two hours before bedtime

title: The Desert Rats
actors: James Mason, Richard Burton, Robert Newton, Robert Douglas
description: In Tobruk, in North Africa, in the face of the advance of General Rommel's troops, the training of an Australian unit was entrusted to the English captain McRoberts. From the destruction of a column of German tanks lured into a trap to that of a large enemy ammunition depot thanks to a particularly risky mission, Allied soldiers cover themselves in glory. The film probably owes its existence to the success of the "Desert Fox" (with James Mason still wearing General Rommel's uniform). In the average of the infinity of war films.

title: Once a Thief
actors: Sandrine Holt, Michael Wong, Ivan Sergei, Nicholas Lea
description: Li Ann, Michael and Mac are three thieves in the pay of Hong Kong's most important godfather. Michael is also his birth son. Li Ann has decided to marry Michael, even though she is in love with Mac; the two men are both in love with her. The trio decide to escape Hong Kong with the boss's money. The ingredients of John Woo's cinema are all there, even if it is a film produced for television.

title: Twister
actors: Helen Hunt, Bill Paxton, Jami Gertz, Cary Elwes, Lois Smith
description: Jo Harding, as a child, saw her father die being sucked into a whirlwind. Some time has passed and the girl, who has meanwhile become a tornado scholar, continues her fight against the force of nature and against her husband who pursues her to get her to sign the divorce papers. Soon, however, Jo gets involved by the man to place in the heart of a tornado of exceptional size a special machine that, in homage to the "Wizard of Oz", is called Dorothy.
notes: The first part of "Twister" is boring, even for lovers of the catastrophic: about 45 minutes of descriptions of clear characters from the beginning, of sentimental bickering with an obvious outcome, of car races, to get to the core, that is the heart of the tornado. But when he gets there, Jan Da Bont doesn't deny the fame he has earned with "Speed" and, in the second part, he doesn't give himself a moment's respite.

title: Jude
actors: Kate Winslet, Christopher Eccleston, James Nesbitt, Liam Cunningham
description: England, late 19th century. Jude Fawley, an intelligent and simple boy, who works as a stonemason, dreams of imitating the hero of his childhood, Professor Phillotson, a famous university professor. The boy aims to enter the famous Christminster University. But when Jude falls in love with Arabella Donn, the daughter of a pig farmer, he is forced to abandon his studies.
notes: Taken from Thomas Hardy's "Judas the Dark", the film is very far from the literariness of the contemporary Austenian reductions. Two young actors with a hollow, modern expression (Eccleston, the accountant of "Little Murders Among Friends", and Winslet pre-"Titanic") meet and collide in a landscape that goes from a majestic harshness to a pictorial metropolitan squalor. "Jude" starts almost quietly, with a descriptive appearance, and slowly grows to a tortured and compressed dimension that does not disappoint the fans of the "contemporary" Winterbottom (they are his "Butterfly Kiss", the magnificent television miniseries "Family" written by Roddy Doyle and "Welcome to Sarajevo"). "Jude" is a tragedy of freedom and experience, a beautiful demonstration of non-lacquered costume cinema.

title: Jack
actors: Robin Williams, Diane Lane, Bill Cosby, Jennifer Lopez, Brian Kerwin
description: Jack Powell (Williams) is not a child like everyone else. Due to a very rare genetic dysfunction that abnormally accelerates growth and physical development, Jack, despite being only ten years old, has the appearance of a forty-year-old. Animated by the best of intentions, his mother Karen (Lane) and father Brian (Kerwin) try, in every way, to keep him safe from the dangers of the outside world, entrusting him to a guardian (Cosby). But Jack feels the overwhelming need to know the world around him.
notes: A very good, awkward and unpredictable Williams is the protagonist of a comic and sad film, an ideal corollary of "Peggy Sue got married". It is a film about loneliness, about dreams, about those who are different, about those who would like to remain children and above all about death and the need, despite everything, to live.

title: The Young One - La joven
actors: Zachary Scott, Bernie Hamilton, Kay Meersman, Claudio Brook
description: Southern United States. A black clarinetist, wrongly accused of raping a white girl, flees to an island to escape being lynched.
