The island is a hunting lodge and old Pee Wee live here with his 14-year-old granddaughter Ewie and warden Miller. The fugitive finds Ewie alone and befriends her. Upon his return, Miller hunts down the black and violent Ewie. Then a racist sheriff lands, who hunts down the fugitive, and a priest. Respecting the Aristotelian units, Buñuel collides with each other the primal instincts of survival, sex and violence. The social foundations of the so-called civil life explode in all their contradictions.

title: Multiplicity
actors: Michael Keaton, Andie MacDowell, Zack Duhame, Harris Yulin
description: Doug Kinney (Keaton), a successful businessman, devoted father and husband, has a wife, Laura (MacDowell) who adores him and a demanding job. He has only one problem, there are too many things to do and the time to do them is getting smaller and smaller. Doug meets a genetics expert Dr. Owen Leeds (Yulin), who offers him the opportunity to be cloned. With a photocopy cinema, the former "ghostbuster" Ramis tries to repeat the success of "Ricomincio da capo". The result is pleasing, thanks to Lowell Ganz and Babaloo Mandel, talented dialogists and writers of memorable lines. The special effects curated by Richard Edlund are effective.

title: Geronimo
actors: Joseph Running Fox, Michael Greyeyes, Tailinh Forest Flower
description: Chief Geronimo leads the Chiricahua Apache nation in a heroic, long and desperate guerrilla war against white arrogance.
notes: Produced by the American Cable TV TNT, as it cannot compete in the show with the contemporary film by Walter Hill, it makes historical correctness its strong point. Nominated for 5 Emmys, he won one.

title: The Cure
actors: Joseph Mazzello, Brad Renfro, Annabella Sciorra, Diana Scarwid
description: Dexter, a boy from Minnesota, was infected with AIDS as a result of a blood transfusion; Erik, on the other hand, is healthy, but he carries with him another "infamous" brand: his origin from the South. Two different discriminations that end up favoring the friendship between Dexter and Erik and their decision to go and conquer the "big country" ", despite all the fears and all the prejudices.

title: Pontiac Moon
actors: Ted Danson, Mary Steenburgen, Ryan Todd, Eric Schweig, Cathy Moriarty
description: Extravagant and limping science professor Washington Bellamy takes his 11-year-old son in a car (a yellow Pontiac) 1800 miles across the American province to arrive at their destination exactly when the Apollo 11 astronauts land on the moon.
notes: Director Peter Medak is practically unknown in Italy, even if some of his films deserve interest, like in part this nostalgic raid not without grace.

title: Gente di rispetto
actors: Franco Nero, James Mason, Jennifer O'Neil, Orazio Orlando, Aldo Giuffré
description: An elementary school teacher who, due to her unconventionality, has changed various destinations, arrives in Ragusa. Here she is greeted with a mixture of hostility and respect. A boy who courts her is found killed, the same fate touches others. Meanwhile, the woman finds herself at the center of a cumbersome feud between mafia gangs: too late she will realize that she was just a pawn in a dirty game.
notes: Based on the novel of the same name by the journalist Giuseppe Fava, Zampa's film soon slips into folklore and melodramatic.

title: I padroni dell'estate
actors: Christiane Jean, Jean Boissery, Enrico Maria Salerno, Gianni Agus
description: The intact coasts of Sardinia have always been the subject of attempted or successful building speculations. A group of young people who for years have been spending their holidays in those places are experiencing some experiences related to an attack on a villa and the upheaval of a fishing village.
notes: In a jumble of themes (ecology, speculation, terrorism) the director gets lost a bit on the road between continuous flashbacks (past events) and flashforwards (future events).

title: The Last Supper
actors: Cameron Diaz, Annabeth Gish, Ron Eldard, Jonathan Penner
description: In a small town in Iowa, five young people meet during a dinner and ask themselves the following question: "You are traveling back in time and you are in 1909 in Austria. You are sitting in a pub and drinking schnapps in a café with a stranger, a young art student named Adolf, who has only one testicle. Adolf, is a boy who made no mistakes in his life and never hurt anyone. What do you do? You kill him? Poison his schnapps to save millions of innocents? ". It is by answering this question that the group decides to start murdering a Nazi truck driver, then an anti-gay priest, a bigot, a male chauvinist, a racist fanatic. Comedy that at first promises more than it delivers, "An almost perfect dinner" (but the original title, "Last Supper" is much more incisive) is explicitly inserted in the Anglo-Saxon tradition of "Arsenic and old lace". Director Stacy Title (new feature film) explicitly mentions the Capra film and the names of Kubrick and Buñuel, which keep the audience "on edge, undecided whether to cry, laugh or scream". And in the first part, the Title manages to keep the attention and tension awake, with a nice play of characters and a decisive cruelty. Too bad that the screenplay becomes a bit confused, undecided between a moral judgment, the desire to get out of the obligatory scheme and the inability to deepen other narrative ideas. A cross between "The conspiracy of the innocents" and "Little murders among friends", but unfortunately without the amoral elegance of Hitchcock and the shameless cynicism of Danny Boyle.

title: Francesco d'Assisi
actors: Lou Castel, Mino Bellei, Marco Bellocchio, Riccardo Bernardini, Giuseppe Campodifiori, Riccardo Cucciolla, Roberto Di Massimo, Giampiero Frondini, Gérard Herter, John Karisen, Ludmilla Lvova, Franco Marchesi
description: Witness to the horrors of war, Francis decides to change his life to live like Christ. He takes leave of his family and takes a vow of poverty. Bernardo and Pietro join him, with whom he goes to Innocent III who approves the first Franciscan rule. Thus began the preaching, while Clare began a female community. Until the brotherhood loses its original spirit through new rules not dictated by Francis. This transposition on screen of the life of the saint from Assisi appears today linked to the climate of the 1960s, with all the ferment of the Second Vatican Council and the signs of '68. Although dated, it is an intelligent and sober interpretation, superior to the makeover carried out 23 years later with Mickey Rourke.

title: The Crow: City of Angels
actors: Vincent Castellanos, Vincent Perez, Mia Kirshner, Iggy Pop
description: In a post-industrial era, in a dirty, rotten and heartless city "The crow", made up by Pierrot, rises from the world of the dead. He is seeking revenge against the villains, who in the first film, had eliminated him and his son. This time next to him is Sarah (Mia Kirshner, the stripper from "Exotica"), a woman he feels irresistibly attracted to and who is actually the little girl our hero had saved in the previous episode. The sequel to "Il Corvo" is actually a clever remake that steals frames at the speed of a déjà vù cinema from a by now worn and tired imagery. Vincent Perez, disguised as Brandon Lee (the actor who died on the set of the first "crow"), returns to the mortals to avenge his and his son's death. Aided by the jinx of the title and the congenital imbecility of outcasts and emblems of an Evil so overloaded with symbols that it involuntarily becomes parody.

title: Luna e l'altra
actors: Iaia Forte, Maurizio Nichetti, Ivano Marescotti
description: Miracle in Milan: the shadow of Luna Di Capua, an all-in-one teacher who moved to the North from Naples with her elderly father, after thirty years of forced cohabitation she decided to rebel. With the result that, in the school of the Lombard capital in the mid-fifties, Luna will be overwhelmed by the Other, naturally renamed Ombretta. There will finally be time (and desire) to love the janitor for years hopelessly in rapture, to displace the fascist colleague and the mellifluous headmaster.
notes: The beauty of Nichetti's ninth film - obsessed with the poetics of the clone from "Ratataplan" (his mechanic) to "Stefano Quantestorie" (six characters six) - is that you can read it or enjoy it as you want: sentimental comedy? fantastic neorealism? animated tale?

title: Chacun cherche son chat
actors: Garance Clavel, Zinedine Soualem, Reneé Le Calm, Olivier Py
description: A girl, Chloé, to go on vacation for a few days is forced to leave her beloved cat, Gris Gris, in the custody of an elderly lady. Upon his return, the woman informs her that the cat has disappeared, disappeared through a window on the roofs: the search begins, among the picturesque streets of the Parisian district of the Bastille.
notes: The idea is a classic expedient: Klapisch is interested in faces, people's crossed paths, the trash way of life (the expression is his) observed from a kitsch point of view (idem). A cinema-banlieue that, unlike Kassovitz's "Hate", does not live on violence and surprise action, but on colorful humanity, small contradictions, "direct writing". Romantically, "Fellini".

title: La freccia azzurra
description: It is the night of the Epiphany: the perfidious Scarafoni, assistant to the Befana, with the excuse of treating her from an annoying flu, is actually poisoning the old woman because he does not want her to give the toys, but to sell them. But they rebel and run away, finding the solidarity of a poor child, who wants the Freccia Azzurra at all costs, a train complete with locomotive. Three years of work and five billion to make the first European co-production cartoon. The film, based on a short story by Gianni Rodari and scripted by the director with Umberto Marino, is built on an educational story (the consumerism of sedan gifts), on a non-trivial drawing (the characters have a trait reminiscent of Tintin's) and on beautiful music by Paolo Conte. To design the town he took inspiration from the topography of Orbetello, while Dario Fo reinterpreted the dialogues.

title: Chain Reaction
actors: Keanu Reeves, Morgan Freeman, Joanna Cassidy, Rachel Weisz, Fred Ward
description: A young man of high hopes, mechanic and inventor, and a physicist with the right physique and a brain focused on the discovery of the century. They are being chased by the FBI, the Chicago PD and their double-cross professor. At stake is the formula for economic energy obtained from hydrogen: it does not dirty, does not stink, it is unlimited, available to everyone, free of charge. Davis ("Trap in the high seas", "The fugitive") tries again the shot he managed with the couple Ford-Lee Jones, but he holes dramatically. Hiding of charisma in the cast and, above all, in the script that leaks from all sides.

title: La métamorphose des cloportes
actors: Lino Ventura, Charles Aznavour, Irina Demick, Maurice Biraud
description: Alphonse, known as Lo Scaltra, specialized in the theft of works of art, takes part in a coup together with three thieves who are his friends: Arthur, Edmond and Rosso. The blow fails miserably due to manifest ineptitude, but only Alphonse is caught by the police and sentenced to five years in prison. Released from jail, for Alphonse it will be a question of revenge against his ex-accomplices, who in the meantime have had a good time. We are on the safe side, given that we are dealing with a typical French noir of the 60s. Valid not so much for the story, as for the quality of the performers, with Lino Ventura a true icon of the French crime scene of those years.

title: Alligator people
actors: Beverly Garland, Bruce Bennet, Lon Chaney jr.
description: A scientist attempts to heal the wounds of his patients by grafting a secretion of reptiles into the human skin. The result is literally monstrous: everyone undergoes mutations and goes to populate the swamps. Like a young doctor who transforms into a kind of caiman. The old "scientist" Lon Chaney in a typical 1950s B movie.

title: Dangerous Crossing
actors: Jeanne Crain, Michael Rennie, Carl Betz, Casey Adams, Mary Anderson
description: A young American has just recovered from the death of her father who, leaving her alone, has passed on to her a multi-billion dollar inheritance. The girl meets and marries a handsome young man; the two embark on an ocean liner to spend their honeymoon in Europe. During the journey he disappears. She looks for him desperately, but the man has dissolved into nothing. In reality, the strange affair is part of a criminal plan.
notes: A film well constructed by a specialist of the genre, albeit with some lack of narrative coherence, from a novel by John Dickson Carr.

title: Fury at Furnace Creek
actors: Victor Mature, Colleen Gray, Albert Dekker
description: To obtain the opening to the settlers of a territory rich in mineral resources, the attack by the Indians of a supply convoy is favored. A general is then tried for the fact and dies during the trial. Years later, the two sons, convinced of his innocence, investigate to rehabilitate him.
notes: A "detective" western; in the first part traditional places and situations prevail, including landscapes, forts to be besieged, soldiers and red Indians; in the second, the trial and the investigation prevail, with a final duel that closes the accounts.

title: Mistress
actors: Danny Aiello, Robert De Niro, Martin Landau, Robert Wuhl
description: Martin Landisman, a commercial video director, is contacted by producer Jack Roth, who is enthusiastic about the old movie script ("Darkness and Light") that Martin has wanted to make for years. For Martin, the occasion of his life suddenly places him in front of the pettiness of the Hollywood world. Outrageous financiers, cheap starlets, complicated sentimental plots, bogus contract clauses ... Desecrating portrait of Hollywood and its contradictions and idiosyncrasies, as in Altman's next "The protagonists". Great cast of performers, but, in the end, it is precisely the excessive weight on the shoulders of the actors and blocking the film a bit.

title: Mobius
actors: Leslie Stevens, David Weck, Mark Oliver, Harold Hall, Bob Harter
description: Dede, a young computer expert, is sent on behalf of the US government to smuggle a program into the Inocumation computer. In the company he falls in love with Chip, one of the managers of the company. Together they discover that the program contained a virus, inserted specifically to manipulate the computer data of the Shuttle, the spacecraft. It is then a question of discovering the access key and canceling the virus ... It is a timid attempt at a computer thriller. It's not that great, but at least it has a slightly different plot from the thrillers usually scheduled at this time slot on Rai 2.

title: Ladoni
actors: Attori non professionisti
description: Ten "chapters" on the miserable existence of beggars and homeless people in today's Russia. A real people made up of homeless, homeless, poor, mentally ill, marginalized pours into the streets of the cities after the collapse of the communist regime. The propaganda hypocrisy of the old regime had in fact locked up these people in the gulags or psychiatric hospitals. Now that the reeducation camps are gone and the asylums are admitting only real patients. The bubo explodes in all its virulence.
notes: Expressive, disturbing documentation in black and white, shot in a style that combines realism and lyrical-visionary suggestions. All this is accompanied by an equally moved, penetrating comment on the mechanisms and significance of social exclusion.

title: The Last Hunt
actors: Robert Taylor, Stewart Granger, Debra Paget, Lloyd Nolan, Russ Tamblyn
description: In Dakota, bison herds are nearly extinct due to unstoppable hunts. Charles is a bloodthirsty hunter, who also hates Indians, while Sandy is tired of the useless carnage. Sandy falls in love with an Indian captured by Charles and at one point runs away with her. Charles chases them for revenge, but in the end he will be the one to succumb in this "last hunt".
notes: A western that combines the show with a sort of ante litteram environmental awareness and a rethinking of the relationship between white men and Indians (the latter, however, is not entirely original). Good as always the direction of Brooks and captivating cast.

title: On Moonlight Bay
actors: Doris Day, Gordon MacRae, Jack Smith, Leon Ames, Billy Gray
description: In a small town in Indiana, Marjorie loves Bill, a student not too popular with her father for his progressive ideas. Bill has to leave to continue his studies, but he doesn't abandon the girl. Upon graduation, Bill enlisted to fight World War I in Europe. She would like to follow him, but Bill first convinces his future father-in-law, then marries his sweetheart, who will wait for him at home. A comedy with sentimental intentions. Environment and historical period of reference would like to trigger the magic of the good old days, but the formula does not work.

title: Murphy's War
actors: Peter O'Toole, Philippe Noiret, Sian Phillips, Horst Janson
description: Murphy is an Irish corporal, the sole survivor of a British ship sunk by a German submarine in Venezuelan waters. Saved by the natives, Murphy stubbornly seeks revenge. The first attempt fails and, as a consequence, causes a deadly retaliation by the Nazis on the civilian population. Murphy does not disarm as long as he succeeds, although the war is over in the meantime. The idea of ??personal war as an obsession that subsides only when revenge is obtained is not particularly original. Yates plays easy on the exotic character of the setting and on the undoubted charisma of Peter O'Toole, who however jokes a bit.

title: Nickelodeon
actors: Ryan O'Neal, Burt Reynolds, Tatum O'Neal, Brian Keith, Stella Stevens, John Ritter, Jane Hitchcock, Jack Perkins, Brion James
description: Leo Halligan, a young lawyer who defends the interests of Mr. Cobb, an independent film producer struggling with the overwhelming power of the Patents Company, becomes a director. We are in the years between 1910 and 1915.
notes: Bogdanovich's homage to the origins of Hollywood: the years of light-heartedness, but also the years in which cinema was looking for itself. O'Neal father and daughter together again after another nostalgic "Paper Moon".

title: Last Man Standing
actors: Bruce Willis, Christopher Walken, Leslie Mann, Bruce Dern
description: Jericho, state of Texas, 1931. A frontier town with a rapidly declining population. The latest cowboys have given way to tweed-clad mobsters from hot Chicago. They arrive driven by the need to control the illegal liquor trade arriving from neighboring Mexico. In the city, two rival gangs, headed by Doyle and Strozzi, rule. One day a mysterious stranger arrives who calls himself Smith. He is kind, cynical and elusive, but he is perfectly aware of the evil that dominates the city ...
notes: Modern, deafening and angry Western with a gold cameo by Christopher Walken. Its weak side is the inexpressiveness of Bruce Willis.

title: The Nutty Professor
actors: Eddie Murphy, Jada Pinkett Smith, James Coburn, Larry Miller
description: Professor Sherman Klump is number one on campus, but his body is disproportionate and the family is going through a crisis. But Sherman has come up with a formula that will allow him to lose some of his 180 pounds and decides to try it. In no time at all, the mild academic turns into Buddy Love, an irresistible Don Juan.
notes: Running out of ideas, Eddie Murphy dusts off a workhorse of the legendary Jerry Lewis (executive producer here). And so the brilliant comic variant of "Doctor Jeckyll and Mr. Hyde" known as "Doctor Jerryll's Crazy Nights" (1963), turns into the "Mad Professor", dull and vulgar remake where farts go crazy and fart ideas. Murphy struggles by stepping into the shoes of seven characters. But the only Oscar goes to the great Rick Baker ("An American Werewolf in London"), king of special effects.

title: Head Above Water
actors: Harvey Keitel, Cameron Diaz, Craig Sheffer, Billy Zane
description: George, a respectable judge, and his young, charming and neurotic wife Nathalie are having the best vacation of their lives with their friend Henry. One day George and Henry decide to go fishing with the intention of returning the next day. Left alone in the house, Nathalie is surprised by the visit of her former lover, the charming Kent. But the next morning, she finds Kent in his marriage bed, naked and - more worryingly - dead. Terrified (her husband is terribly jealous), Nathalie frantically tries to drag the body into the cellar with the intention of hiding it ...
notes: Black comedy is a genre that must be handled like a clockwork mechanism. The film starts well, but, as it progresses, the narrative fails to sustain the rhythm and the initial inventiveness. Too bad that the humor and the tension end up dispersing: too many traces - all barely sketched - and little, true underlying evil.

title: Moll Flanders
actors: Robin Wright, Morgan Freeman, Stockard Channing, Brenda Fricker
description: Flora has dreamed all her life of being the illegitimate daughter of a noble who, one day, would take her away from the orphanage. One day Hibble arrives, a wealthy foreigner who claims to have known his mother. This is how the man begins to tell her the story of Moll Flanders, born in Newgate prison and who, later, was entrusted to a convent. Soon Moll finds himself in a rendezvous house.
notes: Pompous, not very exciting, too "conciliatory" the reinterpretation of the director and screenwriter Desham with a style that oscillates between television didacticism and the pomp of "literary" cinema. Robin Wright (healthy bony American) has little to do with the brazen impetuosity of Defoe's English heroine. Instead of the rebellious and irreverent vitality of the novel, a predictable and feeble moral tale.

title: Sunchaser
actors: Jon Seda, Woody Harrelson, Anne Bancroft, Talisa Soto
description: Dr. Michael Reynolds is preparing to take over the direction of the Cancer Institute of one of the most renowned clinics in Los Angeles. To achieve this, the man ended up sacrificing his married life. There are a few days left for his inauguration and Michael is entrusted, Brandon "Blue" Monroe, an extraordinary patient. The boy is a sixteen-year-old half-breed, considered dangerous by the police and suffering from an incurable tumor. When he was a child, an old Navajo stegone had told him about a lake with miraculous waters. That's where Brandon, after kidnapping the doctor, intends to go.
notes: It begins as a thriller, but immediately turns towards the road movie with an existential and initiatory background: films as they were made in the 70s, all steeped in the melancholy of the irremediably compromised American myth, despair and dreams. The film opens in images of awe-inspiring and mangled beauty. Only at the end, when the myth takes shape, does the film seem to tarnish.

title: Michael Collins
actors: Liam Neeson, Julia Roberts, Aidan Quinn, Alan Rickman
description: During the Easter Rising of 1916, the Irish revolutionaries surrender to the British army. Among the revolutionary leaders, only Eamon De Valera, an American citizen, was spared from the firing squad. Many of his followers including Michael Collins and his close friend Harry Boland end up in prison. Upon their release, they find themselves the new leaders of the independence movement. During a violent confrontation with the Royal Irish Police, Collins is wounded and lovingly cared for by Kitty, who will become his partner.
notes: The protagonist has the halo that had been of Robin Hood and the progressive division of the fighting companions echoes the unraveling of the Arthurian Round Table. An adventure film and reason of state and, above all, of concise editing, capable of circumventing rhetorical traps. Honest, solid and romantic, the film won the Venice Golden Lion.

title: Bloodfist VII: Manhunt
actors: Don 'The Dragon' Wilson, Jim Trudell, Stephanie Williams
description: A man victim of a terrible machination is hunted down, forced to fight to redeem his good name and possibly not get killed. Two objectives that are not easy to achieve, since his real enemies are policemen.
notes: Grungy action based on barrels and sganassoni. The director of the seventh episode of a little-known series in Italy also has the courage to appear as an actor in the film, in the role of a certain Weener.

title: Easter Parade
actors: Fred Astaire, Judy Garland, Ann Miller, Peter Lawford
description: Nadine, his artistic partner, argues with Don and separates from him. He finds another to pair, but on the night of her debut Nadine invites Don to repeat a number they did together ...
notes: The protagonist was supposed to be Gene Kelly, but the dancer was injured. The music is by Irving Berlin, excellent musical numbers.

title: Vigilante
actors: Robert Forster, Fred Williamson, Richard Bright
description: His family is attacked by a group of deviant punk killers and rapists. He (Robert Forster), from the quiet man he was, turns into a bloodthirsty avenger. The story recalls "The executioner of the night"; Lustig will then do "Mania Cop" but here he does not get out of the routine.

title: Wuthering Heights
actors: Anna Calder-Marshall, Timothy Dalton, Harry Andrews
description: Heathcliff, a gypsy raised by a landowner, loves and loves his daughter, Cathy. But she marries a wealthy owner and he leaves to return years later, after making a fortune, and take revenge. But the tragedy hangs over the two lovers who have found each other because she dies and he ...
notes: Well set and photographed, the evident attempt to adapt the sumptuous drama of Emily Brontë to a modern taste does not convince. Third version of the novel, after the American one of 1939 by William Wyler, with Merle Oberon and Laurence Olivier, and the Mexican one of 1953 by Luis Buñuel.

title: The Swan Princess
description: Prince Derek and Princess Odette, heirs to the throne of two neighboring states, love each other deeply and are about to join in a just and sumptuous wedding. Except that the devil puts his tail on it, in the sense that the evil sorcerer Rothbarth kidnaps the girl and turns her into a swan. Derek, desperate, goes in search of his girlfriend, finds her, but to save her he must challenge and win the sorcerer. Nothing new under the sky of the "cartoons", in a very obvious story. Which is, however, undoubtedly pleasant, and where the villain Rothbarth (as is proven tradition in the Disney house, from which Richard Rich comes) is the most successful character.

title: North
actors: Elijah Wood, Bruce Willis, Dan Aykroyd, Kathy Bates
description: Borth, 11, is a genius admired by everyone, except his parents who seem to ignore him. Recommended by his friend Winchell, North asks for a divorce from his father and mother, and the judge gives him two months to find another family, otherwise his destination will be the orphanage. The boy begins a world tour, from Texas to Paris passing through Hawaii, Alaska and even China ... it is certainly not at "Stand by Me" levels. Remarkable Bruce Willis disguised in various versions.

title: Bad Company
actors: Ellen Barkin, Laurence Fishburne, Frank Langella, Michael Beach
description: Nelson Crowe was part of the CIA, but now he accepts jobs from anyone. He is thus hired by the private organization headed by Margaret Wells and Vic Grimes to convince a judge to change his mind and sentence in a trial against the boss of a large corporation. Then a relationship between Nelson and Margaret takes over, hence her proposal to kill Vic and get involved ...
notes: As long as the story is centered on the more or less hidden powers that manipulate society, everything works quite well; when you change register and other components intervene, the film makes a slip that greatly compromises its validity.

title: Milk Money
actors: Melanie Griffith, Ed Harris, Michael Patrick Carter, Malcolm McDowell, Adam Lavorgna
description: Three provincial kids, eager to initiate sex, go to town, "hook up" a prostitute and are scammed. Then the woman repents and saves them from trouble. Frank, one of the three, eager to fill the void left by his mother's death, convinces the woman to follow him into the village and introduce herself as a math teacher. Who knows if the concocted plan will be successful.
notes: The best part of the film is the first, the one with the itches of sexual initiation from which the three very young "womanizers" are moved. Then the tone of the play falls off a lot, the story becomes unlikely, the acting over the top.

title: There Goes My Baby
actors: Dermot Mulroney, Ricky Schroder, Kelli Williams, Noah Wyle
description: Thirty years later Anne Archer remembers with nostalgia the time of her adolescence, the days spent in college with her friend Mary Beth. That year, their class had been selected by Look magazine for a feature. But soon times were about to change. Kennedy is assassinated, the war in Vietnam begins, rock'n'roll makes its way. And among the college kids there are those who develop a political conscience and those who prefer to stay on the beach to surf. A film on the model of "American Graffiti", not only for the temporal location, but for the theme of nostalgia. The risk of déjà vu is strong, but the director manages to make this portrait of the Sixties credible.

title: Tank Girl
actors: Lori Petty, Naomi Watts, Malcolm McDowell, Ice T, Don Harvey, Jeff Kober, Reg E. Cathey
description: The Earth in 2033 became an immense desert, controlled by the "Water and Power" department, which holds control of the water. Rebecca lives in a rebel commune with her boyfriend, Sam. It is night when the troops of the department massacre and capture the girl, sentenced to forced labor in the mine. But Rebecca, along with Jet, a woman who works as a mechanic, manages to escape in a tank truck. and learns that Sam is alive.
notes: Film based on the cult comic by Jamie Hewlett (that of Gorillaz) and Alan Martin, also published in Italy. But here the character loses the punk wickedness that distinguishes it.

title: The Quest
actors: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Roger Moore, Jack McGee
description: New York, 1920s. Shrewd Chris (Van Damme) leads a gang of pickpocketing orphans. However, things go wrong and Chris is forced to work as a slave on a Turkish vessel. During an attack by the pirates the man shows off his skills as a fighter. He is then taken to the island of Muay Tahi where he can train and challenge the best kickboxing fighters in the world. Van Damme tries to legitimize a second half in "Mortal Kombat" style with a first part reminiscent of "Once upon a time in America", with a nostalgic flavor, but bordering on ridicule. The revived Roger Moore also appears, who accepted the role to support the costs of the divorce, played by Arsenio Lupine with James Bond options. A terribly boring film, even for fans.

title: A Couch in New York
actors: Juliette Binoche, William Hurt, Stephanie Buttle, Barbara Garrick
description: He is a psychoanalyst from New York, a little neurotic and on the brink of engagement, she is a Parisian dancer. For different needs they decide to exchange each other's apartments, with the consequence that she will have fun pretending to be a doctor of the soul in the Big and Bacata Mela while he will soon fall in love with the bohemian atmosphere circuit that surrounds him in the Ville Lumière.
notes: The first "commercial" film by the Belgian director devoted to formal research, takes up the last William Hurt all imperceptible moves, alongside the very sensitive Juliette Binoche who seems a cheerful version with panache of the character he played in "Blue Film".

title: Beautiful Girls
actors: Matt Dillon, Annabeth Gish, Uma Thurman, Mira Sorvino, Martha Plimpton, Noah Emmerich, Rosie O'Donnell, Lauren Holly, Michael Rapaport, Natalie Portman, Timothy Hutton, Max Perlich
description: Knight's Ridge, central Massachusetts, a weekend that looks the same as many others. Waiting for a party that will bring together old high school friends, four young people spend the evening in their favorite bar talking about themselves. Willie has returned from New York where he was a pianist and was living with difficulty his relationship with a young lawyer; Tommy makes do with odd jobs and doesn't give up on escapades that jeopardize his engagement; Michael got married and can't stand the monotony of married life anymore; Paul dreams of the shapes of a supermodel. Mediocre them, mediocre their stories: therefore the arrival from Chicago of an impenetrable Uma Thurman and other women will alter that precarious balance of hopes and frustrations.
notes: Yet another sentimental comedy focused this time on the generation of thirty-year-olds. The dialogues and situations are sometimes banal; but the numerous actors employed by Ted, nephew of Jonathan Demme, are always able to not go below the sufficiency.

title: Larger than Life
actors: Bill Murray, Anita Gillette, Maureen Mueller, Kimberly Thornton
description: While celebrating his engagement to Celeste, famous writer Jack Corcoran discovers that his parent left him an old trunk, worth $ 27,000. The main asset value, however, is a female elephant named Vera. Jack discovers that the father he never met was a circus performer. Jack doesn't know what to do with an elephant and is looking for someone willing to take care of it.
notes: "On the road" ecological and familiar sewn on Bill Murray by the director who directed him in "Escape with the swag" and then signed the beautiful "Prying Eye". Here, however, everything is discreet. Cameo by Linda Fiorentino and over the top characterization by Matthew McConaughey.

title: La ribelle
actors: Penélope Cruz, Stefano Dionisi, Laura Betti, Marco Leonardi
description: Enza (sixteen) with her sister Rosaria (seventeen) one day, in a supermarket, trying to steal a wallet they are pinched. The judge sentenced them to a period of imprisonment in a religious institute run by nuns. During the leave Enza meets Sebastiano: she falls in love with him and, to be with him, runs away from the institute. But things are not going as she thought. It will be only another man, Franchino, to give her a glimmer of hope. Grimaldi drew this interesting "La rebelle" from his novel "Storia di Enza", a mix of melodrama and denunciation shot with determination. Excellent la Cruz: alone is worth the film.

title: Gospa
actors: Martin Sheen, Michael York, Morgan Fairchild
description: Bosnia, 1981. In Medjiugorje some children say they periodically have visions of the Virgin, who invites them to pray for peace. Thousands of pilgrims gather to witness the miracle. The Franciscans are skeptical, but in favor of growing religious fervor. The Communists in power in what is still the Yugoslav federation instead try to counter the phenomenon.
notes: First film inspired by the controversial case of the supernatural apparitions of Medjiugorje.

title: A spasso nel tempo
actors: Massimo Boldi, Christian De Sica, Ela Weber, Dean Jones, Marco Messeri
description: On vacation in America, Prince Ascanio Colonna and the Lombard merchant Walter Colombo decide to try Professor Mortimer's time machine, which allows them to experience a virtual past. But the machine really starts working: so the two find themselves catapulted into prehistory, into medieval Florence, into 18th century Venice, into Nazi-occupied Rome, into the holiday Italy of the 1960s and into the future.
notes: They did worse, the Vanzina juniors. Hurried like the others, with no desire for a script like the others, with De Sica and Boldi who do not spare us any musical-political-cinematographic-scatological jokes, yet "A spasso nel tempo" lets itself be seen. It may be because they take full advantage of the cinema of all times, it will be for the amusing Lorenzo the Magnificent played by Messeri, or because the Capri episode of the 60s has the taste of the old "Taste of the sea". We giggle, we don't get angry. And that's already a lot.

title: We're Back! A Dinosaur's Story
directors: Dick Zondag, Ralph Zondag, Phil Nibberlink, Simon Wells
description: Louie and Cecilia, two children living in New York, don't have a single true friend. Always looking for new playmates, they spend their days in absolute boredom. One day, however, they discover that four cute and intelligent little dinosaurs have arrived in the city; they make their acquaintance and soon become inseparable friends. It is the beginning of a series of fun adventures. Presented by Steven Spielberg, it is an adventure film without too many flickers of originality, animation techniques or ideas. However, the "trademark" guarantees an excellent show for all the little ones: the characters immediately capture the sympathy and the story involves.

title: Pope Joan
actors: Liv Ullmann, Keir Dullea, Robert Beatty, Olivia de Havilland
description: At the time of the war between the Franks and the Saxons for the succession to the throne of Charlemagne, the daughter of a preacher, Giovanna, became a nun. She fled to Rome with a painter, of whom she became the lover, disguised as a friar. Here, mistake her for a man and notice in her incredible oratory and diplomatic skills, the Pope appoints her cardinal. Arrived at the papal throne, however, it will be discovered. A somewhat botched comedy from both a historical and a cinematographic point of view. Not even Ullman's presence saves her.

title: Jericho Fever
actors: Perry King, Stephanie Zimbalist, Ramon Chavez, Peter Cirano, Ari Barak
description: Along the border between Mexico and the United States, a group of Mexican terrorists is chased by the police. What the terrorists don't know is that a terrible virus has infected them and destined them to certain death. On the other hand, two doctors are engaged in a race against time and against the very dangerous patients themselves, to intervene in time, thus preventing a catastrophic spread of the virus.
notes: Despite some references to social situations and medical issues, what really matters in the film is the action. Every element of the script is bent to it, according to an inflexible logic of genre.

title: Captains Courageous
actors: Robert Urich, Kenny Vadas, Kaj-Erik Eriksen, Robert Wisden
description: Harvey Cheyne jr., Rich and corrupt, finds the sea on his way. Fate leads him to board a fishing boat in Gloucester. It will be for him three months of very hard and dangerous life among the ocean waves, which will make him mature through dramatic and decisive experiences. From the novel by Rudyard Kipling, a version produced directly for TV.

title: Captain Ron
actors: Kurt Russell, Martin Short, Mary Kay Place, Paul Anka
description: A stressed-out Chicago businessman decides to cut his schedule. He would like to go on a boat trip to the Caribbean with the whole family. Having no navigation practice, he hires the self-styled captain Ron to whom he entrusts the direction of the boat. The strange "sea wolf" will drag everyone into trouble.
notes: A sleepy Sunday afternoon comedy, unpretentious, with a modest script and all entrusted to the skills of the actors. Brilliant the couple Kurt Russell-Martin Short. In a minor part, that of the boat seller, _Diana_ singer Paul Anka.

title: The Plot Against Harry
actors: Martin Priest, Ben Lang, Maxine Woods, Henry Nemo
description: Harry is a middle-of-the-road crook who, after nine months in jail, finds his environment turned upside down: business to hell, the best of his men missing; to these misfortunes are added new ones, together with a series of vicissitudes that Harry will have to face in an attempt to return to the surface ... An irresistible satire of the New York Jewish environment, interpreted by amateur actors.

title: Manhattan By Numbers
actors: John Wojda, Branislav Tomich, Mary Chang Faulk
description: George Murphy is an unemployed reporter who only has one day to find the money to give to his wife. To solve his problems he must be able to find a certain Tom Ryan. A New York comedy with Kafkaesque tones.

title: Shadows
actors: Lelia Goldoni, Ben Carruthers, Hugh Hurd, Anthony Ray
description: Hugh, Ben and Lelia are three black brothers with artistic and intellectual aspirations, destined to clash with the mediocre reality of the environment they frequent, but also with the ambition of their castles in the air. Leila, for example, meets a young man who seduces her and then, knowing her social condition, abandons her. In the end, only compromise or drift awaits them.
notes: Directorial debut by John Cassavetes who, to complete the cast, turned to the authoritative "New York Times". A semi-documentary film that marked a new way of making cinema. Charles Mingus signs the seductive soundtrack.

title: Physical Evidence
actors: Theresa Russell, Burt Reynolds, Ned Beatty, Kay Lenz
description: Joe Paris, a policeman disliked for his quick methods, is accused of killing an informant. At the trial Jenny Hudson, the lawyer who defends him, has to contend with a hostile environment and with a series of people who would rather see Paris finally harmless in jail. The story escalates when the murders resume, and will end with Jenny forced to kill in self-defense.
notes: Theresa Russell is charming and creepy. Unfortunately, Michael Crichton has gotten much worse as a director since he achieved extraordinary success as a novelist. Confused, flat, very far from the originality and rhythm of the "World of robots".

title: Surviving Picasso
actors: Anthony Hopkins, Natascha McElhone, Julianne Moore, Peter Eyre
description: We are in 1943, Paris is occupied by German troops. Pablo Picasso, whose fame has already reached its peak, lives in that city surrounded by women who love him. Even Françoise, who is twenty years old and aspires to a career as a painter, feels fatally attracted to him. Between the two begins an intense relationship, but not without contrasts.
notes: A lot of chatter and lack of psychological depth of the characters: a pity for Ivory, often a bit academic, but rarely so empty.

title: Sono pazzo di Iris Blond
actors: Carlo Verdone, Claudia Gerini, Mino Reitano, Andréa Ferréol
description: Left by his girlfriend after an honored career as a keyboard player in Rome in the seventies, Romeo falls into a depressive crisis, and plays in Brussels for an elderly audience. Romeo falls in love with Iris Blond, a waitress of Italian immigrant origin. He decides to partner with her, but the age difference and her sudden success are felt. Verdone returns to sentimental comedy, recounting the meeting of two neurotics in search of affection and professional creative affirmation. All built on Claudia Gerini, "Iris Blond" starts well, abandons a bit to the macchiettismo in the central part and goes back to the 'last half hour. Shot of the wing, the trip to Charleroi, a Belgian mining town, where Adam and Mino Reitano triumph.

title: Alaska
actors: Thora Birch, Vincent Kartheiser, Dirk Benedict, Charlton Heston
description: After the death of his wife, Jake decides to leave Chicago and travel with his two teenage children Jessie and Sean to a remote Alaskan village: he will transport supplies by plane to hard-to-reach areas. During one of these missions, his plane crashes into a mountain location and the two boys set off in search of him and come across a polar bear cub who has fallen into the trap set by a poacher who will immediately go after them. Charlton Heston returns to the screen directed by his son Fraser in an ecological tale that wisely exploits the beautiful landscapes of Alaska, British Columbia and Baffin Island. The story is conventional, the performers below average. In short, nothing new under the snow.

title: Evita
actors: Madonna, Antonio Banderas, Jonathan Pryce, Jimmy Nail
description: The action starts with the death of one of the most talked about post-World War II characters: Eva Peron, former actress and wife of Juan Domingo Peron, the populist leader who, on several occasions, held power in Argentina in the 1940s and 1950s. . Died in 1952 at the age of 33, Evita had been able to influence the favor of the less well-off masses in an incredible way, thus guaranteeing power to her husband.
notes: Announced several times with various directors, "Evita" was directed by Alan Parker combining two sex symbols of the new Hollywood: Madonna and Antonio Banderas. The film, without dialogue, is based solely on the melodies and songs of Lloyd Webber's musical. Slow and static Muiscal, without a moment of grace, has catchy songs (one won an Oscar) and a beautiful photograph of Darius Khondji.

title: White Squall
actors: Jeff Bridges, Caroline Goodall, John Savage, Scott Wolf
description: 1960. The most difficult part of the course begins for thirteen students of the Ocean Academy (a sailing school). In the company of the enigmatic skipper Christopher Sheldon, the boys will have to spend a whole year at sea, sailing between the Caribbean and the South Pacific. A very hard experience, marred by a terrible accident: during a sea storm, the ship sinks causing the death of four students and the two crew members. The survivors will have to face a delicate problem: was the shipwreck caused by the commander's inexperience? A real process within the group will have to resolve the problem.

title: Daylight
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Amy Brenneman, Stan Shaw, Viggo Mortensen, Sage Sylvester
description: The underwater tunnel that connects the island of Manhattan to New Jersey is traversed by a huge number of commuters every day. One evening, during rush hour, a car accident causes a devastating explosion: the tunnel turns into a hell of twisted metal while the explosions of fuel follow one another unstoppable; and this situation endangers a small number of survivors. But the danger stimulates the courage and skills of Kit Latura, one of the many prisoners in the gallery. Version of the most typical catastrophic 70s updated to the era of computer special effects. The film contains everything you would have liked to have found twenty years ago. The only exception is that the character who takes on the role of the leader is not the ordinary type who improvises himself as a hero. He is the hero par excellence, Stallone at his best.

title: Extreme Measures
actors: Hugh Grant, Gene Hackman, Sarah Jessica Parker, David Morse
description: Only the young doctor Guy Luthan (Grant) seems to be interested in the fate of a homeless man who dies in the ER of a New York hospital. A strange strap, similar to those that are used in the hospital, caught his attention. Guy discovers that behind the dead there may be a private research plan that also includes the use of human guinea pigs and in which Lawrence Nyrick (Hackman), one of the most respected and respected American primaries, would be involved. At that point, Guy begins to take serious risks.
notes: Rhythm, editing and setting to the "E.R.", with touches of mystery to the "X Files"; a variation on the dark nightmares of "Seven" and, above all, many memories of an old, good Michael Crichton film: "Deep Coma". Which doesn't mean "Extreme Measures" is a bad movie; if he ever puts too much meat on the fire. And in fact he swerves: he starts very well; plunges into the adrenaline of the "doctors in the ward"; it insinuates disturbing doubts in Gene Hackman's homely bonhomie (a look at him, it's worth entire movies). But Michael Apted is not Hitchcock.

title: Jingle All the Way
actors: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Phil Hartman, Sinbad, Rita Wilson, James Belushi
description: Christmas Day is approaching for all families looking for the gift and it also infects the busy businessman Howard Langston. Realizing that he has been very close to his family and son, he decides that he will give him the most coveted gift: Turbo Man, the toy of the year. But the puppet is nowhere to be found, and Howard must also defend himself from those who, like a strange Santa Claus (Belushi) even offers him a copy of the puppet that speaks in Korean. Schwarzenegger continues to casually switch from action movies to comedies, but the results of the latter are not as good as the former. Yet Schwarzy tries hard, and the hunt for his son's favorite toy becomes a slapstick adventure. Even for a Christmas tale like this, there are too many politically correct elements (black, children, animals, bad toy dealers "spoiled") and an excess of molasses.

title: Threshold
actors: Donald Sutherland, John Marley, Mare Winningham, Jeff Goldblum
description: A surgical genius, helped by a researcher and an eccentric philanthropist, but opposed by his colleagues, develops a prototype of an artificial heart and implants it on an otherwise incurable young heart disease.
notes: Reflection on the relationship between risks and benefits, between courage and recklessness, when science and technology are applied to a human life. Jeff Goldblum and Mare Winningham are respectively the brilliant inventor of the artificial heart and the sick young woman. The film, which flies the Canadian flag, was released in the United States only in 1983, when the first open heart operation on Barney Clark made headlines.

title: Sundown
actors: David Carradine, Maxwell Caulfield, John Ireland
description: A typical American family, optimistic enough, decides to move from the East coast to the heart of the Big Country, in that West that is still partly wild. The destination chosen for the new stay, however, is a strange village surrounded by the desert that certainly does not make a good impression. The place is in fact populated by a community of vampires who try in every way to vampirize the newcomers.
notes: The story begins by aligning some original ideas that promise well, but gradually flattens out on the easier stereotypes.

title: New Jersey Drive
actors: Sharron Corley, Gabriel Casseus, Saul Stein, Gwen McGee
description: Jason, a black teenager, lives with his mother and sister in the most deprived part of Newark. During a night raid with two friends, the police shoot their car and injure a boy. Why not tell how things went one of the agents, Roscoe, harasses Jason, who is linked to a gang of car thieves. A hard story, which wants to look from the inside, even effectively, at the life of the street and the constraints of misery. Spike Lee is executive producing this which is Gomez's second film, and you hear it.

title: The Ghost and the Darkness
actors: Michael Douglas, Val Kilmer, Brian McCardie, John Kani
description: East Africa, late 19th century. Two ferocious lions hinder the construction of a railway that the British want to build in a wild area. The lions have already killed an incredible number of people and are considered by the indigenous Swahili as real incarnations of the spirit of Evil. To prevent the work from going wrong, the engineer John Patterson (Kilmer) and the hunter Remington (Douglas) undertake to hunt down the two animals.
notes: Picked up in the maze of history by William Goldman, author of the book "The Man Eaters of Tsavo" and also of the screenplay, the film was shot in South Africa by a director who became known above all for small horror films ("Nightmare 5" and " Predator 2 "). In fact, the film offers the best in horror scenes. The worst, in Douglas' acting.

title: Padre padrone
actors: Saverio Marconi, Omero Antonutti, Marcella Michelangeli, Nanni Moretti, Fabrizio Forte
description: At the age of six, after a few days of school, Gavino is removed from the class: his father wants to make him the shepherd of his sheep. At twenty, Gavino is illiterate and speaks only Sardinian. After his military service, the dramatic redemption from his paternal tyranny begins for him, which coincides with the acquisition of a culture, up to the degree in linguistics and the university chair.

title: La ragazza di via Millelire
actors: Oria Conforti, Maria Monti, Mario Orlando, Lisa Policaro
description: Betty is thirteen years old, she immigrated from the south and lives, with a large family in disrepair, in the infamous Via Millelire in Turin. His is a continuous escape: from the family, from the degraded environment, from the assistance centers and from the reformers. For you, "difficult" girl, there can be no peace. Gianni Serra, "specialist" in social issues, makes a film of vibrant denunciation.

title: Love and Other Catastrophes
actors: Frances O'Connor, Alice Garner, Radha Mitchell, Matt Day
description: Mia (O'Connor), bisexual, lesbian, is on the verge of a nervous breakdown. Alice dreams of finding the perfect man and finishing her thesis on "Doris Day Fighter Feminist". Danni was permanently discharged by Mia. Ari is a nihilist and his motto is: "Try everything once, except incest and folk dances." Michael is shy and awkward. Everyone concentrates on a winter day that leads to a cinephile party where the game is to choose the three best films seen and explain the reasons. From Australia, with sweet cynicism, comes a small (3 weeks of production) and very lovable film by a director who, starting with the name, flirts with Jane Austen with sophisticated persuasion.

title: Fantozzi il ritorno
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Milena Vukotic, Anna Mazzamauro, Gigi Reder
description: We left Fantozzi in Heaven, but his troubles didn't end there. In Paradise, in fact, there is overpopulation and obviously the most famous accountant in Italy will pay the price. Back on Earth, he resumes his usual routine, with some confirmations (his office mates) and some news, obviously not pleasant. The niece Uga is kidnapped and forces Fantozzi to enter an unknown and degraded world of youth. The trend of chat-lines infects him to the point of falling madly in love with a telephone operator who turns out to be Pina. Miss Silvani accuses him of getting her pregnant, while the megapresident involves him in a bribery trial. Fantozzi, however, will be called to Heaven: but the convocation will take place at the least opportune moment.
notes: After eight episodes and twenty-two years after the first episode, Fantozzi returns to strike. But this is one of the weakest bets.

title: Microcosmos
description: To make "Microcosmos" - instead - it took fifteen years of research, three to print eighty thousand meters of film (two thousand meters that choice) and six months of editing. The enterprise is the work of Calude Nuridsany and Marie Pérennou, biologists from Paris who, in '69, decided to abandon their academic career to devote themselves to studying the development of special techniques of "scientific framing", especially using microphotography. Shot in the garden of their home, the bizarre medium-length film catalogs the many terrestrial inhabitants living in grass and water in sixty-five minutes. Microorganisms often almost invisible and (in) voluntarily "walkable" of which the authors invite us to learn about habits, customs and even small tricks.

title: Kansas City
actors: Jennifer Jason Leigh, Miranda Richardson, Harry Belafonte
description: In 1934 Kansas City is one of the few American cities not to be involved in the crisis that is oppressing the country. Favorable to gamblers and adventurers, it exerts an irresistible attraction on all those who have a taste for risk. Jazz in this city represents a meeting point between the classes. It is in this universe that the story of Blondie takes place, a young telegraphist who intends to save the life of her husband by kidnapping the bride of one of the most influential politicians in Kansas City.
notes: Almost all concentrated in one night and the next day, marked by an abysmal pessimism, by a pasty and nocturnal photography, the film is a classic Altman.

title: I magi randagi
actors: Silvio Orlando, Patrick Bauchau, Rolf Zacher, Gastone Moschin
description: Three acrobats, veterans of a failed circus, wander around the centers of the Italian province organizing a small show: and, since they have no animals available, they interpret the beasts themselves. To survive, they also accept to play the Three Kings in a living nativity scene called by the parish priest of a small village where no more children are born; at that point, between drinking and mystical crises, they actually fall into the role of Magi.
notes: An old project repeatedly shelved by Sergio Citti born on the inspiration of Pier Paolo Pasolini and written by the journalist David Grieco (formerly author with Citti of the beautiful Mortacci), I magi randagi is a kind of comic-grotesque odyssey set against the backdrop of an Italy that it is disappearing as opposed to another modern, technological and cynical one.

title: The Glimmer Man
actors: Steven Seagal, Bob Gunton, Keenan Ivory Wayans, Brian Cox, John M. Jackson, Michelle Johnson, Stephen Tobolowsky, Peter Jason
description: An FBI agent is sent from New York to Los Angeles to investigate a maniac who kills people with the crucifixion ritual. Flanked by a local agent, the FBI man suspects that some of these crimes are not the work of the maniac, but have another matrix. The mission will unveil an international conspiracy. Steven Seagal moves less than the previous films and shows off his martial arts skills only on a couple of occasions, which also coincide with the film's most successful moments. For the rest, the plot (confused and cumbersome enough) is only an explicit cast of the leading themes of "Seven", enriched by a little surprising political fictional background.

title: Tenshi no kuzu
actors: Kaho Minami, Takeshi Wakamatsu, Etsushi Toyokawa
description: Tokyo, at night. The city is terrified of a mysterious killer who only kills young women. The killer punctually kills every Monday by hitting in the subway. Victims are killed with a lethal injection. Setsuko Suma is a young employee of the homicide investigation department who takes the case very seriously. Moreover, the young woman is passionate about psychoanalysis and it is precisely there that the solution of the enigma seems to lurk. But there is a surprise ... The surprising Japanese director, having abandoned the visual excesses of the previous films, enters the claustrophobic universe of the police investigation. The result is a nocturnal and disturbing film, full of twists and unexpected solutions.

title: A Low Down Dirty Shame
actors: Keenen Ivory Wayans, Charles S. Dutton, Jada Pinkett Smith
description: Shame is a former Los Angeles cop, now forced to practice as a private detective after his police career ended with the case of a drug trafficker, Mendoza, in love with the beautiful Angela. Pushed by a colleague of his, Rothmiller, in a new investigation, Shame again runs into Mendoza who, believed to have been dead for some time, is actually still alive and fully operational in his trades.
notes: It's kind of an action comedy. The director and performer had at the time made a parody of the African American detective stories of the seventies. Here, on the other hand, we take ourselves seriously. Result: little action and comedy almost reduced to zero.

title: In Name Only
actors: Cary Grant, Kay Francis, Carole Lombard, Charles Coburn
description: Alec is married to Maida, but for her it is only a marriage of interest. But when Alec falls in love in turn with a widowed mother of a five-year-old girl, Maida refuses to agree to the divorce, and threatens to report her husband for adultery. Thus begins a long battle of spite.
notes: Cary Grant, Carole Lombard: a great cast for a good family comedy.

title: Quattro bravi ragazzi
actors: Michele Placido, Riccardo Salerno, Patrizio Fumagalli, Lorenzo Bianchi
description: Milan's displaced heroes from minor crimes to murder.
notes: The immodesty in referring to the title of Scorsese's film is equal only to the presumption of a film that sketches a sociological investigation of very little seriousness. But Michele Placido ("ideologue" on occasion) is, with his gigionerie, an irresistible fun.

title: Les grandes vacances
actors: Louis De Funès, Ferdy Mayne, Martine Kelly, François Leccia
description: Charles Bosquier, who runs a French boarding school for well-to-do boys, sends his son to England (he has to fix his English exam) and welcomes a girl from the best British society as an au pair. But Philippe, the son, does not study in England: he meets the Englishwoman Shirley and the two fall in love. To pursue them, the poor director will throw himself into a sea of ??hilarious troubles. These were the golden years of De Funès. With a decent script and the good vein of the frenetic protagonist, the laugh machine works.

title: Momo
actors: Radost Bokel, John Huston, Mario Adorf, Armin Mueller-Stahl
description: Momo is an orphan who lives in the basement of an old abandoned amphitheater. He has many friends and the days pass quietly, until he meets the "gray man", the "time thief" who steals time from men making them selfish and only interested in gain. From a fairy tale by the German writer Michael Ende, the author of the "Neverending Story", a disastrous European superproduction, without magic.

title: The Temp
actors: Lara Flynn Boyle, Timothy Hutton, Faye Dunaway
description: Kriss Bolin is a beautiful secretary who works in a confectionery company. The strange thing is that he is making a relentless career, at the expense of colleagues who run into mysterious and sometimes fatal traffic accidents. Anyone trying to figure it out is Kriss' boss, Peter Derns. The trouble is that a disturbing attraction also develops between Peter and the woman: Is Kriss aiming for the top of the firm? Tom Holland is a veteran of horror ("The Vampire Slayer") and thriller ("Fatal Beauty"); he enjoys hitting his viewers with breathtaking camera movements. Lara Flynn Boyle comes from "Twin Peaks", Timothy Hutton and Faye Dunaway from a little further away.

title: The Van
actors: Colm Meaney, Donald O'Kelly, Ger Ryan, Caroline Rothwell
description: Barrytown, Dublin north suburb, November 1989. Baker Bimbo is fired. Unlike his friends from the pub, who have been unemployed for years, Bimbo sets out to find a job that will allow him to provide for his wife and three children. He then decides to buy, with the liquidation money, a van to sell "fish & chips", hamburgers and hot dogs. Business is booming also because Eire qualified for the 1990 World Cup, the whole city is glued to the television and no one has time or desire to cook.
notes: Third chapter of the "Barrytown Trilogy" (after "The Commitments" and "The Snapper"), written by Doyle between 1987 and 1994. "Two on the road" is less successful than "The Snapper", less compact and paradoxical, less rich in the facet of the characters and their relationships. Nonetheless, his dialogue is fulminating and his proletarian grit is vigorous. And anyway, he has a great actor (Colm Meaney) and an irresistible central part.

title: Grace of My Heart
actors: Illeana Douglas, John Turturro, Matt Dillon, Bidget Fonda
description: Edna's dream is to become a successful singer-songwriter, a difficult feat in 1960s America. The girl decides to leave her beloved Philadelphia to go to New York. Once she arrives in the Big Apple, she turns to Joel Millner impresario who, first of all, suggests her to change her name (from now on she will be called Denise Waverly) and promises to launch her in the world of music. So Edna / Denise finds herself in a tiny office with an upright piano composing songs that sell millions of copies. Having now achieved success, she has only one dream left, that of becoming a singer-songwriter. And the undertaking will be more difficult than expected. Nobody would have bet on the career of Allison Anders, after the ugly episode she directed in "Four Rooms" (that of the witches). Instead, here the American director finds a nice rhythm, intelligence, humor, a caustic and non-victimistic vision of life (for women). The film is also a colorful, ironic and enthusiastic overview of a great musical period and a legendary place in American musical culture (the Bill Building in New York, where young composers worked for $ 150 a week). Produced by Scorsese, with a priceless Turturro and the good Illeana Douglas.

title: Shine
actors: Geoffrey Rush, Armin Mueller-Stahl, Lynn Redgrave, Noah Taylor, John Gielgud
description: David is a little boy who lives in Australia. Her father, Peter, is a strict parent with an overwhelming personality. Already at an early age the young man proved to be a very talented musician, so much so that he immediately attracted the attention of an internationally renowned concert performer. The man would like to offer him some money to study in the United States, but Peter opposes the idea of ??separating from his son. Meanwhile, David becomes friends with an older writer than him, who convinces him to leave. This time David, disobeying his father, goes to London.
notes: A musical-biographical melodrama that at home contended for the top of the box office on "Independence Day", "Shine" re-elaborates the story of David Helfgott (still alive and well), romanticizing it that much. Geoffrey Rush (who won the Academy Award for Best Male Performance in 1997) plays the piano with his hands. Great Armin Muller-Stahl in the role of his father and John Gielgud in that of the professor.

title: The Hunckback of Notre Dame
description: The deformed bell ringer Quasimodo is confined between the spiers of the bell tower of Notre Dame Cathedral. Twenty years earlier, Judge Frollo, obsessed with cleaning up the city of gypsies, had killed Quasimodo's mother. For this he was punished with the obligation to take care of the child. Since then Quasimodo has lived locked up in the bell tower under the supervision of his despotic guardian, dreaming of being able to join the people who animate the square. One day, during the Festa dei Pazzi, Quasimodo finds the courage to go out. In the square he meets Esmeralda, the woman who will change his life. Sensual and sinuous, the film has an impetuous vitality and a subtle ability to mix terror, comedy and emotion. All suspended between the top of the bell tower and the square below, scripted without delays and cheeks. The idea of ​​animating three gargoyles (the stone devils that adorn the cathedral) and making them Quasimodo's comic companions was brilliant; Frollo's cursed invocation is magnificent (he already has a place among the great bad guys of the company).

title: Hommes, femmes, mode d'emploi
actors: Fabrice Luchini, Bernard Tapie, Alessandra Martines
description: Two men find themselves in the waiting room at the gastroenterologist, both due to a small ulcer. The first, a captain of industry, has almost everything in life, but he wants everything else. The second, who agreed to be a policeman, had very little. The case, in the hands of a doctor who wants to take revenge on the industrialist, will exchange their analyzes and their destinies
notes: The film has the agreeableness of all recent Lelouches, its great ability to intertwine situations and stories, the lightness of touch of someone who no longer cares so much about proving something. And above all he has a precise sensitivity towards the actors: Lelouch is capable of enhancing the cinematic naturalness of the financier Bernard Tapie and making him act almost as well as Fabrice Luchini (who is a great actor).

title: Dr. Giggles
actors: Larry Drake, Holly Marie Combs, Glenn Quinn, Cliff De Young
description: Dr. Rendell takes hearts from living donors, who are naturally unwilling, to attempt a transplant on his cardiopathic wife. Discovered, he is killed by popular anger. Her eight-year-old son Evan goes mad and grows up in a mental asylum. One day, however, he escapes from the clinic and, mindful of his father's medical glories and pathologically obsessed with the new frontiers of surgery, he in turn begins to apply unique therapeutic "treatments" to a group of teenagers, naturally unwilling.
notes: Larry Drake (adult Evan) has a good stature, but the film as a whole is monotonous.

title: The Black Hole
actors: Maximilian Schell, Robert Forster, Anthony Perkins
description: Near a black hole, astronauts on a scientific mission find a space station that had long since been lost. It is directed by the megalomaniac dr. Reinhardt, who transformed his crew into robots. Served by effective special effects, this Disney production inspired by "Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea" is however weak in narrative solutions, and ends up disappointing.

title: The Time Guardian
actors: Tom Burlinson, Nikki Coghill, Dean Stockwell
description: An earthly city of the future escapes the threat of terrifying cyborgs by traveling through time. Coming from the 40th century, the two of them made contact in 1988 with an Australian geologist, Annie, to jointly repel the deadly danger.
notes: Bungled little film, shot quickly after the success of the first "Terminator", in which, moreover, events sow questions destined to remain unanswered.

title: Mixed Nuts
actors: Anthony La Paglia, Steve Martin, Madeline Kahn, Robert Klein
description: We have already saved 1,423: this is how the Salvagente Agency in Venice, California, where the sensitive Catherine and the foul-mouthed Blanche are on the phones. Among the "cases" that the company has to take on, the most serious is that of Philip who, if he does not find a large sum of money in a short time, will be evicted.
notes: Another European film remade in the US: the French "Le Père Noël est une ordure", by Jean-Marie Poiré (that of the "Visitors"). If it was to do it again, they could save themselves the trouble. Directed by Nora Ephron, that of "Insomnia d'amore".

title: Secrets and Lies
actors: Brenda Blethyn, Timothy Spall, Marianne Jean-Baptiste, Phyllis Logan
description: Hortense, a young black woman who is an optometrist, has recently lost her father and feels the need to find her birth mother. She is suggested to contact a social worker who agrees to give her her file. The woman, dismayed, discovers that her mother is a white, her name is Cynthia is a sad woman, who works in a factory and lives in a dilapidated semi-detached house with her daughter Roxanne, a sweeper. Hortense finds the courage to call her and make an appointment. A quintessential Leigh (Palme d'Or at the Cannes Film Festival), which here (unlike "Belle speranze" and "Naked") doesn't care too much about arrogant rich people: even in the middle class there are good devils, who suffer and succeed at some point to look inside. Moving to the point of agony, it expands realism to abstraction, with very long floors where the jokes turn into tears and these into laughter. Blethyn, best performer at Cannes, is capable of making us sick by acting on the phone from the back.

title: Gonin
actors: Koichi Sato, Masahiro Motoki, Takeshi Kitano
description: Bandai, the owner of a nightclub, is pressed by the Ogoshi gang. The situation comes to a final break when Mitsuya, one of Bandai's aides, kills the gangster and drives the gang out of the nightclub. It is at this point that Bandai decides to steal the money from Ogoshi's safe. Jimmy, the protector of a Thai prostitute, and Hizu, a former policeman, also participate in the robbery. The director is a master of the typical Japanese thriller / noir, very violent, dark and bloody. But here the representation of despair remains an end in itself, not supported by an effective script. Among the performers, Takeshi Kitano as a blindfolded killer.

title: Lontano da dove
actors: Claudio Amendola, Monica Scattini, Victor Cavallo
description: After completing his studies and military service, the young Mario leaves for New York. Here he is hosted by his friend Paolo who has lived in the metropolis for years. Mario immediately finds himself at ease in that glittering world of people, artists, journalists, girls, parties. Underneath, however, he will soon discover that all this vitalism hides a great nostalgia that everyone has for Italy. Curious, but only at times successful, generational portrait.

title: Isle of the Dead
actors: Boris Karloff, Ellen Drew, Marc Cramer, Katherine Emery, Helen Thimig
description: Going to his wife's grave in a cemetery on an island in the Greek sea, a general discovers that the grave has been tampered with. The military group also includes an American journalist and the British ambassador with his wife. Panic breaks out in the group when it appears that one of them is possessed by a vampire spirit. Who will be?
notes: Unusual exotic setting for a horror movie. It produces Val Lewton, a magician of the fantastic genre ("The Kiss of the Panther"), but it is not one of his masterpieces.

title: Panarea
actors: Andrea Livio, Hoara Borselli, Alessandro Mascali, Alessia Merz, Georgia Riccardi
description: The disc-jokey Captain Cook attends the thousand holiday stories of teenagers in Panarea. Two sisters, for example, are in love with the same boy; while Riccardo and Luca, famous for their ability to conquer, literally lose their heads in front of a beautiful guest. There is also one with a reputation for gifted and nicknamed, guess what, Pea: another teenager uses it to arouse her boyfriend's jealousy. The two old sea wolves Castellano and Pipolo have renounced the famous actors to put together some young hopefuls, among which only Alessia Merz, is a known face (and body). The humor is vulgar, the tourist images.

title: Sabotage
actors: Mark Dacascos, Carrie-Anne Moss, Graham Greene, F. F. Twaine
description: Three years after a failed mission to Bosnia on behalf of the CIA, Michael Bishop has become the bodyguard of Jeffrey Trent, a prominent businessman who hides an illegal international smuggling activity behind organizing humanitarian flights for the third world. When Trent is killed at the airport, Bishop, who was unharmed, is accused of complicity by the FBI. In the fratricidal struggle between the FBI and the CIA, Bishop is in fact only a scapegoat. Tv movie with social and historical connotations. In Reagan's time these films were about the struggle with the Arabs. Now, with Clinton, everything must be politically correct.

title: Man from Del Rio
actors: Anthony Quinn, Katy Jurado, Peter Whitney, Douglas Fowley
description: Dave was given the town sheriff's star after he rebelled against the oppression of the men of Bannister, owner of the saloon. But the locals stay away from him and Dave, who has a broken wrist, is forced to fight Bannister. A western without particular merits or gaps, with some pretense of psychological analysis and some (for the times) concession to violence. Quinn, who has been of every race in the world in his career, is authentically Mexican here.

title: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum
actors: Zero Mostel, Phil Silvers, Buster Keaton, Jack Gilford, Michael Crawford
description: The slave Pseudolus combines the union between Hero, the son of his master, and the courtesan Philia, but this has already been promised to the Miles Gloriosus. Never ending troubles ensue which, fortunately, lead to a happy ending. From a Harold S. Prince comedy built on a potpourri of characters and Plautian situations, a film that alternates humorous inventions with other surrealistic ones. Richard Lester, director of feature films with the Beatles, made his debut with this film in the USA.

title: Al mumiya
actors: Nadia Lotfi, Ahmed Mirai, Ahmed Higazi
description: Towards the middle of the 19th century, an Egyptologist notices the plundering of the tombs of the Pharaohs near Thebes. A mission in Luxor discovers that the members of a tribe have lived for centuries from the thefts committed by devastating ancient burials, of which only they know the location. On the death of the chieftain, his two sons refuse to continue these robberies, and one of them, for this, will be killed. Considered among the best films of Egyptian cinema and a masterpiece worldwide.

title: Uomini uomini uomini
actors: Christian De Sica, Massimo Ghini, Leo Gullotta, Alessandro Haber
description: An architect, a film producer, a tailor and an orthopedist, all gay, form a quartet of close-knit friends who spend most of their time together. Everyone has some problem in interpersonal relationships (in the family and / or outside) which sometimes provoke real crises. The tailor's mother dies, who moves to New York, the orthopedist dies of a heart attack ... Christian De Sica, when he gets behind the camera, seems convinced that he is facing important problems. And maybe it is. It is a pity, however, that his films are systematically a disconcerting banality. To say the least.

title: Paint It Black
actors: Rick Rossovich, Sally Kirkland, Martin Landau, Julie Carmen, Doug Savant
description: A young sculptor (Rick Rossovich) at the beginning of his career becomes the lover of an older woman (Sally Kirkland) who, however, has an irresistible appeal: she works as an art dealer. However, the relationship between the two soon becomes stormy due above all to the anger and dissatisfaction of the woman, but one day she is mysteriously killed.
notes: Yellow that has only one good subject on its side, but treated with little bite. The setting, quite unusual, in the world of art gave hope for something better, especially in terms of psychological notations.

title: I tre nemici
actors: Gino Bramieri, Cristina Gajoni, Hélène Chanel, Raimondo Vianello
description: An international spy, who has come into possession of a formula for a new explosive, has the unfortunate idea of ??transcribing it into an embarrassing body part of Leo (Bramieri), a tattoo addict. A woman, a doctor and a painter try in every way to get hold of it. Predictable farce, without bite and repetitive, directed by such a specialist.

title: Passi furtivi in una notte boia - Zelmaide
actors: Carmen Villani, Walter Chiari, Carlo Croccolo, Raffaele Triggia
description: At Castello di Imola, the waitress Ida (who goes by the name of Zelmaide) serves at the Ranieri bar, but in her heart there is the hope of soon becoming the owner. But her income is very poor, not to mention those of her fiancé Pompeo. The two decide, in collaboration with the surveyor Marchesi, to rob the town bank.
notes: The film is almost a pretext to show the graces of Carmen Villani, a famous singer of the sixties. Despite the presence of Walter Chiari, the moments of comedy are very few.

title: Losing Isaiah
actors: Jessica Lange, Halle Berry, Samuel L. Jackson, David Strathairn
description: One day, a white woman accidentally finds a black child abandoned in the trash. Pity decides to adopt it. After various vicissitudes he manages to legally obtain the child who is very loving towards the new mother. Things start to get complicated when, after several years, the real mom comes back to get her son back.
notes: The director goes from a noir like "The Black Heart of Paris Trout" (even if he had already done the dress rehearsal with "Dangerous Woman" produced by Spielberg) to this work where tears are wasted. Good, Jessica Lange's interpretation.

title: Babylon 5
actors: Michael O'Hare, Claudia Christian, Jerry Doyle, Mira Furlan
description: We are in the mid-23rd century and the Babylon 5 space station, a metal structure weighing two and a half million tons and located about 25 light years from planet Earth, has become a sort of free port for diplomats, players of d ' unscrupulous gambling and vagabonds. Babylon 5 represents the last hope of peace for the five most powerful races in the galaxy.
