Jeffrey Sinclair, the station commander, along with his men, are grappling with the mysterious seismic phenomena of the planet Epsilon 3. Despite the low budget imposed by the production, the film that combines two episodes of the television series made in the USA, "Babylon 5 ", is a suggestive example of science fiction that has, on its side, good tricks due to computer graphics.

title: In the Army Now
actors: Pauly Shore, Andy Dick, Lori Petti, David Alan Grier, Esai Morales
description: Bones Conway (Pauly Shore) is definitely not a good soldier. Become part of the National Reserve to get all the benefits that this entails: room and board and a fixed salary. Things get complicated when he sets off the Red Alert. The well-known American TV comedian Pauly Shore creates a rather obvious parody of military life. "In the Army Now" is the original title of the film and it is not clear with what logic in Italy they called it "Operation Desert Storm", since the Gulf War has nothing to do with it.

title: La vieille fille
actors: Philippe Noiret, Annie Girardot, Marthe Keller, Maria Schneider
description: Muriel, single and with a few years on her shoulders, decides to spend a holiday in a tourist resort. Due to a breakdown in his car Gabriel, unmarried, also no longer young, is forced to a forced stop. The arrival of the unexpected guest wreaks havoc in Muriel's heart.
notes: The film is all played on psychological notations. Annie Girardot, in the main role of the tardona (horrendous Italian title!) Gives the best of herself, despite a direction, here and there, uncertain.

title: Getting Gotti
actors: Lorraine Bracco, Anthony John Denison, Ellen Burstyn, Kathleen Laskey
description: Diane Giacalone is a female magistrate who is trying to expose the mafia activities of the dangerous Gambino family and its greatest exponent, John Gotti. The woman, of clear Italian origins, is determined to redeem the reputation of Italian Americans through the process. Things, despite his efforts, are looking bad. The jury, in fact, does not consider the witnesses against him reliable and acquits the man. Only a few years later the woman will be compensated, in some way, because it will be known that the jury had been bribed. The film is inspired by the events that saw the trial and subsequent conviction of Mafioso John Gotti. Good direction and good interpreters.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
actors: Harvey Keitel, George Clooney, Quentin Tarantino, Juliette Lewis, Salma Hayek
description: The infamous Gecko brothers, two of the most dangerous criminals in the United States, are on the run from Texas. Across the border in Mexico, the mysterious Carlos offers the two safety in exchange for a percentage of their loot. For the two brothers it is a question of escaping the trap that the police are preparing and crossing the border to get to the appointment with Carlos before daylight. It is at this point that ...
notes: Trash films among the most authentic recently appeared. An adventure punctuated by a great musical column and a very safe editing as well as studded with mockery of the clichés of Hollywood cinema and homages to the classics of the genre.

title: Ransom
actors: Mel Gibson, Rene Russo, Gary Sinise, Brawley Nolte, Delroy Lindo
description: Tom (Gibson) owns an airline. The man, who is married to Kate and has a son he adores, Sean (Brawley Nolte, Nick's son), is seen falling apart when a gang of criminals kidnaps his son. After a failed attempt by the FBI, it will be Tom who will take the field in first person. On paper it looked promising: Gibson in one of those respectable parts lit with madness that befits him; the direction of Howard, who gave a good performance in the action with "Killer Fire"; Kieslowski's cinematographer (Piotr Sobocinski), a screenwriter loved by Scorsese (Richard Price), a subject inspired by a solid '56 thriller starring Glenn Ford ("Vile Blackmail"). One by one, none of these elements disappoint; but, all together, they do not coagulate. The alternation between tension and dead times seems to be combined a bit haphazardly, the motivations of some characters end up as obscure (or too simplistic), those of others trivial (the black policeman).

title: Un inverno freddo freddo
actors: Cecilia Dazzi, Carlotta Natoli, Valerio Mastandrea, Armando De Razza
description: The "Guya Valentine Beauty Salon" is a modest beauty salon located in a popular Roman neighborhood. Guya, a former manicurist from the French province, is the unlikely owner of the place, where Daniela, Monica and Rosanna work. Relations between the four women are very tense. Guya, instead of dealing with the problems of the beauty salon (it takes three hundred million to pay all the debts), wastes time in clumsy attempts to track down Bruno, a scruffy playboy, unreliable and, moreover, a troublemaker.
notes: After having produced and distributed some interesting films (a title for everyone: Virzì's "La bella vita"), Roberto Cimpanelli decided to go behind the camera to create his old project of an all-female story set in our era. . A very small film that can be considered an investment towards the future.

title: Escape from L.A.
actors: Kurt Russell, Stacy Keach, Steve Buscemi, Peter Fonda, Cliff Robertson
description: Fifteen years after Jena's insane exploit in New York's maximum security prison, the last anarchist soldier in the United States - again arrested by law enforcement - is forced on another mission: to travel to L.A. and intercept Utopia, the president's daughter who flirts with a Third World guerrilla. The enterprise is not easy: the "city of angels" has become a no man's land in the middle of the sea ...
notes: Sequel of _1997 - Escape from New York_, which reflects on the mystifying power of images and plays imaginatively with genres, deliberately flaunting "handcrafted" special effects. To be rediscovered, without making comparisons with the unrivaled model.

title: Blood & Wine
actors: Jack Nicholson, Judy Davis, Jennifer Lopez, Michael Caine
description: Alcoholic beverage retailer Alex plans the perfect crime that will allow him to solve his financial situation. Enlisting the help of an unsuspected friend, he steals a multi-million dollar diamond necklace from his billionaire client Frank Reese. Help is provided by the latter's housekeeper, a Venezuelan girl named Gabriella and who is Alex's current partner.
notes: It seems that the idea of ??"Blood & Wine" dates back to the time of the first collaborations between Rafelson and Nicholson ("Head", "Five Easy Pieces", "Marvin's King of the Gardens") in the film you can see and "hear" : a déjà vu air from the 70s, a cinema of malaise from the former New Hollywood, but without the strength and shamelessness of the time. Luckily there are the actors: Nicholson (in the "Shining" area) is Alex Gates; Lopez his woman; Caine (honored for this role at the San Sebastian Film Festival) is a shady individual.

title: High School High
actors: Jon Lovitz, Tia Carrere, Mekhi Phifer
description: Clark, raised in a private high school where his father is principal and where even the receptionist inquires about the skin color of whoever is calling, is transferred to a school where crime reigns supreme and where there are metal detectors, barbed wires, bulletproof vests and gangs of youngsters ready to rob him. But his passion for teaching will manage to prevail. Nice start, which finally makes fun of "The fleeting moment"; then the film, produced and scripted by the wizard of the madman David Zucker ("The craziest plane in the world") gets lost a bit and becomes a good-natured in turn. But some gags remain memorable: in particular, the headmaster with criminal tendencies and the dialogue on the link between romance and big breasts.

title: Boys
actors: Winona Ryder, Lukas Haas, John C. Reilly, James LeGros, Skeet Ulrich, Matt Malloy, Spencer Vrooman, Charlie Hofheimer, Bill Sage
description: Patty, mysterious girl who lives at the bottom of a avenue, falls from horse and loses knowledge. Some guys from a nearby high school rushed to help it. One of these, John Baker, decides to host Patty in his room, contravening the school regulations. Love breaks out between the two: on the run from a secret (she) and from a life that is too close to him (he) find themselves making love under the reflection of the lights of a Luna Park, while parents and authorities do They give a lot to do in the whole city to find them. Everything in one night, because at dawn John returns to mom and dad and Patty comes, momentarily, arrested.
notes: Surprise final with the music of Stewart Copeland and the Dolly of the director (despite the name, is a woman) who unfold on the landscape with ... stickers. Indigesta, boring and useless comedians also for Winona's tireless fans. As for the young Lukas Haas, ex-Bimbo Hamish of "Witness", better to taste him in "Everyone says I love you" by Woody Allen where he plays his son rebellious of republican sympathies.

title: Courage Under Fire
actors: Denzel Washington, Meg Ryan, Lou Diamond Phillips
description: January 1991: as the fires of war erupt in the sky over Baghdad, Colonel Serling of the US infantry accidentally fired at one of his units, with the imaginable consequences. Sent home, the Pentagon tries to revive him by entrusting him with the delicate task of deciding whether or not to give a gold medal for military valor to an alleged hero, a female helicopter pilot. From the novel of the same name by Patrick Sheane Duncan, also author of the screenplay, the first "official" film on the Gulf War arrives from the United States. The occasion was interesting. But the courage remained under fire, in the middle of the desert, far from the cinema.

title: Go Now
actors: Robert Carlyle, Juliet Aubrey, James Nesbitt, Sophie Okonedo, Tricky
description: Nick is a boy who lives in Bristol, works as a plasterer and in his spare time plays as a center forward for the local football team. Nick often spends his evenings in the brewery with Sammy, his coach, and Tony, his best friend, obsessed with sexual performance. On a Saturday night Nick and Tony meet two girls, Karen and Paula. Nick and Karen meet again and after several hesitations they decide to get together. One day, while at work, Nick gets a hammer out of his hand. These are the first symptoms of multiple sclerosis.
notes: "Go Now", a title that comes from the song by Bessie Banks, is the film that Michael Winterbottom shot between "Butterfly Kiss" and "Jude". He lives on two simply beautiful characters, played by two actors that all films in the world would like to have: the Robert Carlyle from "Carla's Song" and "Trainspotting" and the sweet Juliet Aubrey. The writers are shrewd in avoiding the obvious pitfalls of compassion. Winterbottom is skilled in dribbling ellipses, in accelerating with pressing, in sowing obligatory stop frames with stop frames.

title: Il ciclone
actors: Leonardo Pieraccioni, Lorena Forteza, Natalia Estrada, Benedetta Mazzini, Paolo Hendel, Alessandro Haber, Barbara Enrichi, Tosca D'Aquino, Massimo Ceccherini
description: Five flamenco dancers, who are setting up a show, get lost in the Tuscan countryside to the delight of the town and the Quarini family. Family in which the father who is in charge of the old Communist Party (the only newspaper he reads is "L'Unità") and who has baptized his children, Levante, Selvaggia and Libero. Country that has its characters: the pharmacist Isabella who gets on with Selvaggia, the waitress Franca who is ready to be infatuated with the entrepreneur who is a little too big and Pippo who has only a fixed idea. The beautiful women throw everyone into turmoil and prove ready to be courted. For (almost) everyone the happy end is around the corner.

title: Killer per caso
actors: Ezio Greggio, Jessica Lundy, Rudy De Luca, Dom DeLuise
description: Joe Fortunato, a half-rogue, escaped from Italy and landed in New York. Despite everything, he is also reached here by the Italian underworld that intends to eliminate him. While in a car, which he has stolen, Joe receives a call from Vince, a lawyer who works in a small town in California and offers him a million dollars to complete a job.
notes: For the second film after the unwatchable "The silence of the hams", Greggio steals the cue from Sordi-Lattuada's "Mafioso", spreads alleged Landis poisons (Jessica Lundy was one of the "Stupids": is it a coincidence?), Shoots blunt bullets with Zucker wet gunpowder. But the story of the Italian who escaped to the United States and involved in a series of misadventures worthy of James Tont, just fails to make people laugh. And since it is shot in English and live, it will be an experience to see it in the original. Other than Ed Wood.

title: First Wives Club
actors: Goldie Hawn, Diane Keaton, Bette Midler, Maggie Smith, Bronson Pinchot
description: For Brenda, Elisa and Annie, who had been college mates many years ago, the marriages ended in as many shipwrecks. The first married the owner of an electronics store chain, the second became a movie star, while the third is a housewife. All of them worked hard to build their husbands' businesses, and were dumped to make room for younger, sexier companions. They then decide to join forces. Goldie Hawn does not lose an ounce of her clownish charge, Bette Midler knows how to wither into the part of the Italian-Jewish matron and then explodes, Diane Keaton is called Annie and keeps the neuroses, the comic explosions, the melancholies of Allen's heroine. They are good and determined to resurrect the snappy times and cynicism of classic sophisticated comedy. But the film isn't up to par: pleasant, but not overwhelming, mean, but not brave enough to be perfectly amoral.

title: Prelude to a Kiss
actors: Alec Baldwin, Meg Ryan, Kathy Bates, Ned Beatty, Sydney Walker, Patty Duke, Stanley Tucci
description: Between the calm Peter Hoskins and the lively Rita Boyle it is love at first sight, and soon the two get married. During the ceremony, a mysterious old man shows up and kisses the bride, and it is only the first disturbing sign for Peter, who during the honeymoon has the strange feeling that he has not married the woman he thought he knew ...
notes: It starts as a romantic comedy, but quickly turns into a psychological drama with fantastic and almost horror touches, which however does not rule out the happy ending. Calibri da ninety in the cast for a little thing of theatrical origin (the author is Craig Lucas, here also a screenwriter) thin thin.

title: Hickey and Boggs
actors: Bill Cosby, Robert Culp, Rosalind Cash, Nancy Howard
description: A gang of robbers land a heist at a Pittsburg bank. During the escape with the loot there is a fire fight with the police at the end of which three bandits and three agents remain on the ground. The loot ends up in the hands of another gang who takes advantage of the situation to get their hands on the money. Made famous by the "Robinson" TV series, Bill Cosby is here a detective with Chandlerian accents that are anything but despicable. Too bad history doesn't help him.

title: Senior Trip
actors: Matt Frewer, Tommy Chong, Valerie Mahaffey, Jeremy Renner
description: Stories and misadventures of a group of unruly high school students who go on a trip to Washington at the invitation of the White House. It all ends in a chain of accidents.
notes: "School" scurrility for a good-mouthed audience.

title: The Red Badge of Courage
actors: Audie Murphy, Bill Mauldin, John Dierkes, Royal Dano, Douglas Dick
description: During the Civil War, Henry Fleming, a young man who works as a farm boy, is drafted into the Northern army. After a regular period of training, the regiment is sent into the trenches. At the first clash with his opponents, Henry in a fit of terror, when he sees his teammates flee, he follows them. After rescuing a wounded soldier, the young man decides to return to the front. The film, based on Stephen Crane's "The Red Mark of Courage", was cut by 10 minutes from MGM and completely turned upside down in editing. But Huston still managed to give him an anti-rhetorical, doubtful, very hard air.

title: Revenge
actors: Joanna Cassidy, Brian Dennehy
description: A girl is kidnapped by a gang of thugs. The kidnappers then ask his parents for a large ransom. The father, a former policeman, pretends to accept the blackmail, but informs the police who, however, are groping in the dark. When things get decidedly bad he then decides to go personally on the trail of the kidnappers, willing to do anything to save his daughter.
notes: The German-produced film has an all too obvious plot; however, he redeems himself thanks to the interpretation of Brian Dennehy and the sensual touch of the always attractive Joanna Cassidy (the unforgettable replicant snake charm of "Blade Runner").

title: Cronaca di un amore violato
actors: Isabella Ferrari, Roberto Zibetti, Sophie Broustal, Marisa Paredes
description: Luca is a twenty-year-old with a fragile and calm appearance, in short, what is called a good boy. Without interests and passions, he seems to have an apparently balanced character, but in reality he is unable to communicate with the world around him. Luca has developed an intolerable resentment towards women, guilty, according to him, of rejecting him. During the day the boy spies, with the help of a camera, the gestures of Valeria, a girl who works in a dental office located in the building opposite his. Consumed by the passion for her, he will come to attack and rape her. The film, inspired by the novel by Anna Maria Pellegrino entitled "Diaries of a rapist", falls into the trap of the thriller with a sexual background, without even attempting to delve into the characters or the situations.

title: Eye of the Cat
actors: Michael Sarrazin, Gayle Hunnicutt, Eleanor Parker, Tim Henry, Laurence Naismith
description: Wylie, has a repulsion for cats, in fact, at their contact falls into a cataleptic state, is approached by Karol, an unknown, who offers him a way to get rich quickly. The young man must show up, after years of absence, in the house of his aunt Dennie, be appointed sole heir, taking advantage of the morbid affection that the woman has for him and kill her. The only problem is that the aunt is surrounded by a swarm of cats. Small classic of the English thriller, with the photography of the great Russell Metty. A few scenes were added to the American TV version.

title: The Kingdom
actors: Ernst-Hugo Järegård, Ghita Nørby, Kirsten Rolffes, Søren Pilmark
description: "The Kingdom" Hospital, Copenhagen. A patient, Mrs. Drusse, is convinced that she hears the cry of a child coming from the elevator column. In a modern hospital, where it is customary to fight all forms of superstition, there should be no ghosts. Trying to discover the truth, the woman decides to organize some séances together with a group of elderly patients. Meanwhile, the "Morning Air" operation is underway, an initiative by Professor Moesgaard aimed at improving the climate among staff members and which should at the same time help silence the chatter about conflicts between doctors and patients who have suffered bankruptcy interventions.
notes: Between horror and soap, "The Kingdom" is the closest "Twin Peaks" operation to ever come out of European television. Von Trier explicitly declares a debt to the glorious old French Belfagor, who had very impressed him as a boy, and shoots in his usual excited and unpredictable style. For almost four hours, Von Trier keeps us suspended between laughter (hilarious the tirades of the Swedish primary who considers Denmark an inferior country and praises Swedish products from the top of the building) and fear (gruesome flashes with the dead child) , we can only be happy that the director has found the funding to complete the story.

title: Nirvana
actors: Christopher Lambert, Diego Abatantuono, Sergio Rubini, Stefania Rocca
description: Northern agglomeration, 2005. There are only three days to Christmas, the snow falls and Jimi (Lambert) is alone. His woman left him for a year and disappeared. Jimi is one of the highest rated video game creators and works for a multinational company. But an electronic virus drove the Nirvana program crazy and Solo (Abatantuono), the protagonist of the video game, became aware of being just a virtual character. The film, rather than the American models ("Blade Runner" and "Strange Days") seems to be inspired by the romantic science fiction of the comic "Nathan Never". The story is never linear, the script is not perfect, but the atmosphere is dreamlike and the direction of the actors is interesting. Very good Italian technicians, who have shown that they have nothing to envy to Hollywood. Complex film, perhaps twisted, never banal.

title: Michael
actors: John Travolta, Andie MacDowell, William Hurt, Bob Hoskins
description: Michael is an Angel. Fallen to earth for the last time, he lives in Iowa. But if it weren't for a pair of very long white wings, he would look like a man. With all the classic flaws: beers, cigarettes, swear words, Latin lover charm and a dancer step (of course: it's Travolta). The mission is clear: to make Frank's heart beat again, a journalist marked by a harsh and arid life. There is a path to be built that will take him into the arms of Dorothy, earthly with the eyes and the celestial smile. The new film by the director of "Insomnia d'amore" smells of biscuits, marrying the new age philosophy. The miracle of making you believe you are involved is halfway through.

title: Il sindaco
actors: Anthony Quinn, Anna Bonaiuto, Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Raoul Bova, Romina Mondello, Franco Citti, Lino Troisi, Gaetano Amato
description: Antonio Barricano (Anthony Quinn), nicknamed the Mayor, is an important Italian American godfather of the 1930s. He lives in his immense villa with his wife Armida (Anna Bonaiuto) and their children and in the Italian community everyone respects him, following his orders without ever saying a word. Looking for help, Eddy (Raoul Bova) and Rita (Maria Grazia Cucinotta), a young couple expecting a baby, also turn to him. Eddy's father, however, refuses to obey Barricano's orders, sparking a bloody feud between families.

title: Everyone Says I Love You
actors: Woody Allen, Goldie Hawn, Alan Alda, Julia Roberts, Drew Barrymore, Tim Roth
description: Spouses Bob and Steffi, married for twenty years, anxiously follow the stories of their children: Dj who, every time, falls in love with a different boy, Scott in revolt against his parents and their radicalism and Skylar, who is to marry Holden. It happens, however, that Holden's engagement ring, served as a surprise on a dessert, is unwisely swallowed by the beautiful Skylar. Meanwhile, the planned marriage between Skylar and Holden goes up in smoke, because the girl has fallen in love with a gangster. Places and rhythms known to Allen fans, this time in a musical version: a feast for the eyes.

title: Looking for Richard
actors: Al Pacino, John Gielgud, Kevin Spacey, Winona Ryder, Vanessa Redgrave
description: Shakespeare works everywhere and in every age, because it tells stories and feelings that can be safely brought back to our day. This is what the prolonged research of Al Pacino tries to demonstrate, who, in the film, questions and exchanges opinions with actors such as John Gielgud, Vanessa Redgrave, Kevin Spacey, but also with passers-by, including a black taxi driver. Al Pacino (all American, complete with a baseball cap with the brim back) is betting on Shakespeare. He bets out of his own pocket (the film is produced by him), working for three and a half years in his spare time and using a rather difficult formula for the public, halfway between fiction and documentary. The documentary has the snappy tempo of the best American "street" cinema, it is ironic, tireless. The drama, on the other hand, is in the tragedy, in the dark solemnity of the scenery and stage costumes. A continuous coming and going, a boundless love for cinema and theater, a great courage.

title: Testimone a rischio
actors: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Margherita Buy, Claudio Amendola
description: Piero Nava is a man from the North, madly in love with the South, the land where he chose to live and where he works as a sales representative. On the morning of September 11, 1990, the man has a business appointment with his Sicilian agent. While driving along the Canicattì-Agrigento highway, he accidentally runs into the mafia commando who is murdering Judge Rosario Livatino. He decides to go to the police immediately, transforming himself into a super-witness.
notes: Pozzessere made a film about morality, natural and necessary for every society, without selling off its history to the easy effect. The direction is there and you can feel it, it is not replaced by words; the tension arises above all from the disorientation of the characters, from the imperceptible fear that grows within them, from the disturbing coincidences.

title: Marianna Ucrìa
actors: Emmanuelle Laborit, Laura Morante, Roberto Herlitzka, Philippe Noiret
description: Sicily, first half of the eighteenth century. The life of the Ucrìa family from Palermo is a succession of weddings, dances, monacations and hangings. At one of these executions, the twelve-year-old Marianna is brought to her grandfather with the secret hope that the shock will cure her of her silence. Protected by her grandmother, wrapped in the love of a desperate and taciturn mother, the girl is forced to marry the old Duke Pietro, who is also her mother's brother, at the age of thirteen. Having become a woman, she learns the language of signs and the pleasure of literature from a French tutor. The reduction of the book by Dacia Maraini is beautiful, clean, very well furnished and dressed (the costumes of Danilo Donati are extraordinary), but inexorably flat, predictable and cowardly.

title: Cuore di mamma
actors: Carla Gravina, Beba Loncar, Philippe Leroy, Paolo Graziosi
description: These are the years of the dispute. A woman separated from her husband, an industrialist, becomes infatuated with the revolutionary ideas of extra-parliamentary groups and joins one of them. Meanwhile, the eldest of his three children, a dangerous psychopath, kills his younger brother and sister in succession, then tries to blame his mother for the crimes.
notes: Social engagement films are obviously not in Salvatore Samperi's strings, much more at ease with the eroticism of "Malizia". "Cuore di mamma" suffers from the barricading fashion of those years but does not add much to the "contestation" genre.

title: Dragonslayer
actors: Peter Mac Nicol, Caitlin Clarke, Ralph Richardson, John Allam
description: A kingdom beyond time and space is haunted by a terrible dragon that demands the sacrifice of a girl from the country every year. The unfaithful sovereign is unable to resist, and then a girl turns to a powerful wizard who dies before being able to help. His helper only manages to get the dragon to go wild. The king's daughter offers herself for the sacrifice, but ...
notes: From ancient Celtic legends, a classic escape film. From time to time the story takes on a hint of humor: if he had pressed more on the adventure pedal, the film would certainly have earned it.

title: Roger and Me
description: In 1986 General Motors decided to lay off 30,000 workers from the Flint, Michigan factory. Moore investigates the reasons and tries to interview Roger Smith, president of the automaker. The documentary raised a lot of controversy at the time, because Smith claimed to have had many talks with the director, which the latter denied. For their part, the inhabitants of Flint resented the irony used towards them. Funny and serious response to the reigning Reaganism in those years, it is an innovative and at times hilarious semi-documentary.

title: In the Soup
actors: Steve Buscemi, Seymour Cassel, Jennifer Beals, Will Patton
description: A New York filmmaker (Buscemi), desirous of making a film, turns to an unsuspected financier in a half-baked thug (Cassel). The man involves him in petty thefts and, of course, the film doesn't start hands, but the meeting between the two becomes a life lesson. Inspired by the cinema of Jim Jarmusch (who appears in the role of a shady television director) the film is too self-satisfied and pandering. Also in the cast is Jennifer Beals, the director's partner. Very good Seymour Cassell.

title: Sweeney 2
actors: John Thaw, Dennis Waterman, Denholm Elliott, Georgina Hale
description: Police Inspector Regan and Sergeant Carter are on the trail of a gang of skilled thieves, who, in order not to leave witnesses, kill anyone who gets in their way. The two policemen follow them to the island of Malta where finally there will be a showdown. Detective film with little rhythm and little inventiveness.

title: Maciste il gladiatore più forte del mondo
actors: Mark Forest, Erno Crisa, Scilla Gabel, Vittorio Sanipoli
description: The beautiful princess Salima (Scilla Gabel) is coveted by the dictator Rufus (Vittorio Sanipoli), who wants to marry her to reign supreme. The tyrant, however, did not reckon with Maciste and his group of gladiators, faithful until death. Directed by Michele Lupo, who, having exhausted the peplum vein, will become Bud Spencer's trusted director. But these films already have an air of funny fistfights.

title: The Fixer
actors: Alan Bates, Dirk Bogarde, Georgia Brown, Hugh Griffith
description: The young Jewish Yakov Bok, while in the city of Kiev, helps Nicolai Lebedev, a rich Christian merchant. The man, out of gratitude, entrusts him with the task of closely monitoring one of his dishonest administrators. One day, Yakov is arrested by the police and brought before the judge, on charges of rape against Zinaida, Nicolai's daughter.
notes: Scripted by Dalton Trumbo and based on a short story by Bernard Malamud, the film tells about the anti-Semitism of the Tsarist age, a little known phenomenon. Great Alan Bates.

title: The Thin Man Goes Home
actors: William Powell, Myrna Loy, Lucille Watson, Harry Davenport
description: Nick decides to leave New York to spend a few days of vacation in Sycamore Springs, at his parents' house. While crossing the threshold of the house, a man is shot to death. Nick is then forced to give up the longed-for rest to begin the investigation. The victim was a worker who worked at a power plant. Some time earlier he had stolen turbine plant designs and sold them to competitors ...
notes: With this episode we have now reached the penultimate of the series, and the comedy takes over the yellow. For the first time, Nick's parents appear, played by Harry Davenport and Lucille Watson.

title: Aunt Julia and the Scriptwriter
actors: Peter Falk, Barbara Hershey, Keanu Reeves, Bill McCutcheon
description: We are in New Orleans in 1951. The screenwriter Pedro Carmichel (Falk) manages to revive the fortunes of a radio station on the verge of bankruptcy. The feuilleton which he gives life tells the story of a young colleague (Reeves), in love with his aunt (Hershey), an attractive thirty-five year old, who is now a widow.
notes: The film, based on the novel "Aunt Julia and the hack" by Mario Vargas Llosa, betrays its spirit, transporting, among other things, the story from Peru to the United States. A few moments of fun thanks to the actors. In addition to Wynton Marsalis with his orchestra, the "Neville Brothers" also appear in the film.

title: Il boia di Lilla
actors: Rossano Brazzi, Yvette Lebon, Armando Francioli, Jean-Roger Caussimon, Massimo Serato
description: Anna, a maid in a monastery, falls in love with Erberto, a young officer. For his sake she steals a precious necklace and runs away with him. The two are arrested. The officer, accused of desertion and theft, is sentenced, while the girl, without worrying about her fate, runs away. Erberto's brother, who is an executioner in Lilla, to punish the girl, imprints the stigma on her shoulder.
notes: Rossano Brazzi was one of the sex symbols of the 1950s, while Cottafavi was an expert director of swashbuckling films. The combination gives life to this film, which does not rise above the average of the works produced in that period.

title: The Weapon
actors: Steve Cochran, Lizabeth Scott, Herbert Marshall, George Cole
description: Some boys, while they are playing in the rubble of a building in a suburb of London, find a gun. It is little Henry who, handling it, accidentally fires a blow that hits one of his mates. Believing that he has killed the boy, Henry runs away and never returns home. Called on the spot, Inspector Mackenzie comes to the conclusion that the bullet that hit the boy comes from a weapon used some time before to commit a crime ... Set in a foggy suburban London, the film makes use of the good proof of all actors. The direction of Val Guest is also good.

title: The Lion
actors: William Holden, Trevor Howard, Capucine, Pamela Franklin
description: An American girl, Tina, lives on a game reserve in Kenya, along with her stepfather John (Holden) and her mother (Capucine), who has long since divorced Robert (Howard). The girl, living in contact with nature, slowly takes on the characteristics typical of the natives. The worried mother calls her ex-husband to beg him to take Tina to the United States. Robert, who, in the meantime, has arrived in Africa manages to convince Bullit to let the child go. A very obvious melodrama, which is raised only in some description of the environment.

title: Nudo e crudele
description: The film is nothing more than a pretext to show cruel scenes that should strike the viewer for their brutality. In fact, we are shown a man eaten by an alligator, the prostitution of adolescents in Hong Kong with a sort of guided tour of the sex shops and brothels of the city. The last cannibals, the proboscis man, the emasculation of a rapist and so on cannot be missing. By reworking the waste of "Mondo cane" and the like, Bitto Albertini with the pseudonym of Albert Thomas, offers us a spectacle beyond the trash. The soundtrack is by Nico Fidenco.

title: Only You
actors: Marisa Tomei, Robert Downey jr., Bonnie Hunt, Joaquim De Almeida, Billy Zane
description: To Faith, a sorceress foretells, when she is still a young age, marriage to a certain Damon Bradley. Years go by without this alleged individual showing up. When the grown-up girl discovers that Damon really exists, she doesn't hesitate to abandon the man she has married in the meantime, and goes to Italy where she desperately looks for him.
notes: The couple Marisa Tomei and Robert Downey jr. Are right, making the push and pull between lovers credible. Too bad that Jewison exceeds the easy American folklore and clichés about the beauties of our country. The attempt to remake "Roman Holidays" is ridiculous. Sumptuous costumes by Milena Canonero and photography by Sven Nykvist.

title: Lawnmower Man 2: Beyond Cyberspace
actors: Patrick Bergin, Matt Frewer, Austin O'Brien, Ely Pouget
description: Job's body is found dying after the final explosion of the first episode. Even though his body is disfigured and legless, there is still a thread of life in him. It's up to Dr. Cori Platt to rebuild it. But Dr. Platt goes beyond the simple physical recomposition of Job: thanks to virtual reality, he is also able to reconstruct his mind. The film is a sort of photocopy of the first episode which, however, was already quite weak. The virtual effects, if in the first film could surprise, here they end up tiring even the most well-disposed viewer.

title: Stasera mi butto
actors: Lola Falana, Giancarlo Giannini, Marisa Sannia, Nino Taranto
description: A group of friends meet for the holidays in a seaside resort. One of the girls, Marisa, was sent back to Italian. This circumstance allows her to meet a young and shy professor, Carlo, who offers to teach her lessons. Between the two a contrasted idyll arises. Marisa rejects Carlo's timid approaches. The arrival of a beautiful singer gives Carlo the opportunity to provoke a strong jealousy in Marisa. In the cast make their appearance Franco Franchi and Ciccio Ingrassia in the role of lifeguards. The level of comedy is low, the rest worse.

title: Gunsmoke: Return to Dodge
actors: James Arness, Amanda Blake, Buck Taylor, Fran Ryan
description: Sheriff Matt Dillon is back in action, ready to fight Mannon again, his longtime opponent. This time he must defend the woman he loved in his youth and her friends from a dangerous band of outlaws. Who will be the winner in the end? The direction is entrusted to Vincent McEveety who worked for Disney. And it shows.

title: The Miracle of the White Stallions
actors: Robert Taylor, Lilli Palmer, Curd Jürgens, Eddie Albert
description: During the Second World War the famous Lipizzan horses of the Vienna school are in great danger. However, the director of the riding school manages to save all his animals after a lucky trip to Czechoslovakia. At the end of the war, the triumphal return to the Austrian capital is ensured by the American troops of General Patton. Bad imitation of a Disney movie produced ... by Disney.

title: La tregua
country: Italy, France, Great Britain, Sweden, Germany
actors: John Turturro, Massimo Ghini, Rade Serbedzija, Stefano Dionisi, Claudio Bisio, Teco Celio, Roberto Citran, Andy Luotto, Agnieszka Wagner, Lorenza Indovina, Marina Gerasimenko
description: A group of Italian veterans from Auschwitz, freed by the Russians, embark on a long march to reach their homeland. First of all, this is the occasion to observe with new eyes the surprising reality of Europe freed from Nazism and to get back in touch with one's own body, friendship and love.
notes: It is very difficult to evaluate the film regardless of the weight of the homonymous book by Primo Levi, from which the film is based. Rosi's cinema has lost what it had in the 1960s: lucid anger, a desire to challenge excess, a compelling sense of history. "The truce" does not seem dictated by necessity, but by duty. And the "homework" was born from duty. However, the film won four David di Donatello's: directing, best film, production and editing (edited by Ruggero Mastroianni, who was replaced, due to his sudden death, by Bruno Serandrea).

title: The Mirror Has Two Faces
actors: Barbra Streisand, Jeff Bridges, Lauren Bacall, Pierce Brosnan
description: Rose Morgan teaches "romantic literature" at Columbia University, but there is very little in her romantic life. Gregory Larkin teaches mathematics at the same university, has returned from a series of passionate relationships and is looking for a relationship based on friendship and mutual respect. The two, who have different characters, are destined to meet, thanks to the good offices of Rose's enterprising sister. The comedy does not have much originality and is obsessively centered on the actress-director, perpetually framed with soft focus that soften the face that is certainly not regular, especially in the second part of the film. Now in her third direction, Streisand continues to seek only in herself the resources necessary for the success of the film. But her duets with her mother Lauren Bacall, as elegant as they are cynical, are definitely of a good standard, unfortunately Lauren did not make it to receive the Oscar for best female performer.

title: Copacabana Palace
actors: Sylva Koscina, Paolo Ferrari, Walter Chiari, Mylène Demongeot
description: The film is divided into three different stories set in Rio de Janeiro, during the famous carnival. Three international thieves are duped by as many "colleagues". Three hostesses try to have fun by picking up bold young men, but they only remedy blows. A prince, separated from his wife, wants to catch her in flagrant adultery because a certain clause of the marriage contract provides that, in similar circumstances, the estate passes to him, but the occasional companion is ...
notes: As in too many similar cases, the stories (little more than jokes) would like to make people laugh with the vices of the Italians and instead they are only painful.

title: Mamma
actors: Emma Gramatica, Beniamino Gigli, Carlo Campanini
description: A famous tenor marries a woman who, however, soon proves intolerant of the quiet provincial life of her husband's village of origin. The woman thus accepts the court of a suitor, but her mother-in-law notices everything and induces the seducer to step aside.
notes: Carefree and tearful film that certainly contrasts with the dramatic climate of the war years. Almost a pretext to stage Beniamino Gigli who sings (also arias by Giuseppe Verdi), and the tones of a popular novel are decidedly banal, not sanguine like those to which Raffaello Matarazzo will soon get used to.

title: First Do No Harm
actors: Meryl Streep, Fred Ward, Seth Adkins
description: Lori is a mother of a family with a part time job and three children to look after. Life is hard, but happy until, one bad day, the youngest of her boys is diagnosed with severe epilepsy. Lori is soon forced to quit her job and move home. However, Lori's tenacity is finally rewarded when she finds, outside of mainstream medicine, a cure that seems to produce some improvement. Tv movie of the series "true stories for easy tears" uses a gigionesque Streep in a role that is all too congenial to her.

title: Sabrina, the Teenage Witch
actors: Melissa Joan Hart, Sherry Miller, Charlene Fernetz, Ryan Reynolds
description: Sabrina is a very normal teenager who, at the age of sixteen, receives a very special gift: magic. The two aunts, with whom she lives temporarily, have the task of introducing her to the world of witches, guiding her in her first spells. After the first, imaginable bewilderment, Sabrina enthusiastically accepts this novelty and begins to use her new "gifts" in everyday life, with great satisfaction. The most unpleasant tasks become a game and the quality of his life acquires to a large extent. At this point Sabrina thinks of using her powers to win the boy she is in love with, but, unfortunately for her, she realizes that witches of her kind are not allowed to make love spells. He then decides to attract the attention of the boy, who is called Seth, by other means. Since he will lead the girl who wins the school's athletics competitions to the Spring Ball, Sabrina is intensely engaged in training, first using magic again, then, later, relying solely on her own strength. Successful, however, she realizes that Seth is not that tender boy he thought, but a profiteer. True love is close at hand, however, and his name is Harvey, a shy boy full of cares that Sabrina had never considered. The name Sabrina immediately evokes the freshness and grace of Audrey Hepburn. Here: get it out of your head.

title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
actors: Fred Ward, Christopher Garlin, Helen Shaver, Michael Gross
description: The giant "worms" that turned the Nevada desert upside down in the first episode of the series are digging a new series of tunnels through the oil fields of Mexico, devastating plants and engulfing men and things. On their trail they put three fearless hunters: the tough Earl Bassell (Ward), a young man eager to change his life (Garlin) and an intrepid scientist (Shaver). Very fashionable sequel, which highlights the most smashing ingredients and back-up actors.

title: Uomo d'acqua dolce
actors: Antonio Albanese, Valeria Milillo, Antonio Petrocelli, Sara Anticoli
description: A young married couple, Antonio and Beatrice live their lives on the outskirts of Milan. He is a history teacher, while she gives private lessons to the neighborhood children. The two love each other and have been together since childhood. Beatrice is pregnant and Antonio is very apprehensive. One day Beatrice gets a terrible craving for mushrooms in oil, which forces Antonio to go to the supermarket. Here Antonio has an inciednete and loses his memory. Like "La Linea" of the well-known brand of pressure cookers, Albanese's cartoon moves madly within its implosive comedy. Piovani's soundtrack follows the comic as Henry Mancini followed the Pink Panther, the script is ambitious, the direction hastily cordial.

title: Beautiful Thing
actors: Glen Berry, Scott Neal, Tameka Empson, Ben Daniels
description: An English proletarian suburb, made up of ugly terraced houses all the same, an open space where kids play football, the inevitable pub. Bright colors, ethnic and generational mix, deafening music, prosperous mothers juggling the shopping cart and difficult children. This is the environment in which Jamie, Ste and Leah live. The former has trouble settling into school and is laughed at by his classmates. Unlike Jamie, Ste is good at sports, but at home he is beaten up by his alcoholic father and drug dealer brother. Leah has been kicked out of school and spends her free time listening to the music of Mamas & The Papas. One night it happens that Ste runs away from home and finds himself in Jamie's bed and slowly discovers homosexual.

title: Star Trek: First Contact
actors: Patrick Stewart, Brent Spiner, Alice Krige, LeVar Burton
description: April 5, 2063 is the most important date in the history of the Federation of United Planets: the day Earth reached warp speed and first encountered the Vulcanians. From the 24th century the dangerous Borg decide to go back in time and interfere in this event to assimilate the human race. But Jean-Luc Picard's Enterprise pursues them, protecting Dr. Zefram Cochrane, an unlikely father of the Fatherland ...
notes: Eighth chapter of the cinematic adventures of the _Star Trek_ saga and the second with the crew of Jean-Luc Picard. For many one of the best in the series, thanks to a nerdy enough script. The low budget can be seen, but in the end it is not a bad thing.

title: The People vs. Larry Flynt
actors: Woody Harrelson, Courtney Love, Edward Norton, Brett Harrelson
description: We are in the early seventies and Larry Flynt and his brother Jimmy decide to publish a magazine, called "Hustler", which with its unsightly images represents the trashy side of "Playboy". Photographs of Jacqueline Onassis sunbathing naked launch the magazine. Written by two screenwriters so crazy as to be the favorites of Tim Burton (Scott Alexander and Larry Zaraszewski), produced by Oliver Stone, and directed by Forman, who must have breathed a sigh of relief at the idea of ??returning after a long eighteenth century ("Amadeus "," Valmont ") to a contemporary setting, comes the story of the scandalous Larry Flynt. A demented character and brave enough to challenge the state in defense of an abstraction, the First Amendment, which guarantees freedom of the press, even in the name of immorality. It is a film that has the courage not to escape the stubborn madness and perversions of Flynt, merciless and painful in telling the love story between Larry and his wife Althea, but which loses a little strength in the narration of the legal case.

title: Heavy
actors: Pruitt Taylor Vince, Shelley Winters, Liv Tyler, Evan Dando, Deborah Harry, Joe Grifasi
description: The young and beautiful Callie (Tyler), a student in an existential crisis, is hired as a waitress in the restaurant of Dolly (Winters), the domineering and energetic mother of the obese and introverted Victor (Vince) who works as the head cook in the same place. In short, Victor conceives an impossible feeling for the beautiful Callie, to the point that when Dolly dies in the hospital, Victor tries to hide the fact for fear that something changes in the routine of the club.
notes: A young New York author from Robert Redford's stable, Mangold makes a bitter comedy about metropolitan neuroses. The three main interpreters help him very well.

title: Something to Talk About
actors: Julia Roberts, Dennis Quaid, Robert Duvall, Gena Rowlands, Kyra Sedgwick
description: Grace (Roberts) lives with her husband Eddie (Quaid) in a sleepy provincial town. Upper middle class, quiet ménage. At least until Grace catches Eddie in bed with someone else. Said and done she gives up on the spot, but everyone's respectability, starting with her parents, gradually tries to bring the matter back into "normality".
notes: A conventional subject for a traditional comedy. However Hallstrom offers us once again a precise representation of the American province, not the proletarian one of "Happy Birthday, Mr. Grape", but the rich and brilliant one that refers, in fact, to the classic sophisticated comedy. Excellent play of the actors, not only the sacred monsters Duvall and Rowlands, but also the young people, especially the witty Kyra Sedgwick who plays Grace's sister. Photography is by Sven Nykvist.

title: Les cent et une nuits de Simon Cinéma
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Michel Piccoli, Robert De Niro, Mathieu Demy
description: Time for assessments and memories for Monsieur Cinéma (Piccoli). But, since a century has passed since his birth, the poor fellow needs a refresher. What could be better, then, than entrusting oneself to the care of a specialist, moreover young and pretty, and of a distant Italian friend (Mastroianni)? A century at 35 millimeters, between past, present and future of the "seventh art". Under the banner of affectionate tenderness towards cinema, a film on the thread of memory whose fragments, statements, memories are all played on the wonder that dreams materialized on the screen continue to arouse.

title: The Crucible
actors: Daniel Day-Lewis, Winona Ryder, Paul Scofield, Joan Allen
description: In 1692 in Salem, Massachussetts, a community lives that spends all its time serving and praising God. Oppressed by the obsessive religiosity of the elders, some girls dance naked in the woods. Among them is Abigail, who lost her virginity in the bed of John Proctor, a farmer married to another woman. The witch hunt begins: religious intolerance bordering on mystical hysteria, and opportunities for personal revenge. From "The Crucible", which Arthur Miller wrote in 1953, with obvious references to McCarthyism. The text has not lost its vigor, but the production focuses on simplification and the film ends up in a pompous spectacle, with cultured and "politically correct" implications. Once the mocking vein of "King George's madness" is gone, Hytner's representation is mannered.

title: Brigands
actors: Amiran Amiranachvili, Dato Gogidedachvili, Guio Tzintsadze
description: Vano is the king of a small and rich country that whets the appetites of its neighbors. The man spends all his time in war and is surrounded by envious courtiers, hypocrites and traitors. His wife, Queen Eka, is bored, but her chastity belt is not such a difficult obstacle to break. The sultan's favorite, Lia, received as a reward after a battle, excellently replaces the queen, but she has not forgiven her kidnapper and is planning to take revenge. After the great films shot in the West and Africa, Iosseliani returns to Georgia. His "Brigands" travel from one end of history to the other: once it is the king who is a brigand, another time it is a Communist leader, yet another time it is the turn of a mafioso. The brigandish power is eternal. A film with the war in Georgia, with the wars of the medieval knights, with the new mafia wars. With torture chefs who prepare instruments of torture in an atrocious Stalinist kitchen. A film where everyone, from children to parrots, are informers. A tragic comedy where sound and song are as good as images. To say that pain and overwhelm are the constants in the history of men. Light and tragic.

title: Seven Cities of Gold
actors: Richard Egan, Anthony Quinn, Michael Rennie, Jeffrey Hunter
description: In 1789 the expedition led by Gaspar Portola from Mexico set out to conquer California. Another purpose of the mission is to found religious communities. Father Serra is entrusted with the project. Having reached, after various vicissitudes, the set goal, Portola decides to send one of the ships back to Mexico to ask for reinforcements. In the meantime, he sets out in search of the mythical cities of gold. Above average acting for a classic 1950s adventure film.

title: Hell Camp
actors: Lisa Eichahorn, Tom Skerritt, Anthony Zerbe, Robert Wightman
description: The US military authorities decide to subject a group of officers to a course, which aims to train them for survival. The tough trials are to take place in a wooded location in the Philippines. Parachuted in place, Major Casey and the youngest Katherine are captured and locked up. Unfortunately, the camp is directed by Captain Becker, a sadist and psychopath, who has taken his task so literally that he has subjected the unfortunate to unspeakable humiliation and torture. Mediocre adventure film that adds nothing to the genre, if not an accentuation of the gory side.

title: La donna nel mondo
directors: Gualtiero Jacopetti, Paolo Cavara, Franco Prosperi
description: Usual intercontinental raid by documentary maker Jacopetti in search of strong sensations, contrasts and curiosities (possibly macabre) on a fixed theme. Here the female condition. As in the other similar films by the same author ("Africa addio", the two "Mondo cane") the desire to hit below the belt also frustrates the few good intentions.

title: De Jurk
actors: Henri Garcin, Ingeborg Elzevier, Frans Vorstman, Peter Blok
description: It all starts with a fabric, which, as the dominant motif, has yellow and red leaves on a blue background. The fabric does not completely convince the director of a textile company, who immediately clashes with his artistic consultant. Even the stylist who is in charge of designing the model cannot be said to have a completely normal sexuality. Finally the dress is put up for sale in a shop. The first woman to wear it is quite old and, despite this, strange desires awaken in her that will be fatal. Worn by Johanna arouses insatiable desires in the conductor of a train and bus. The third film (presented at the Venice Film Festival in 1996) by the Dutch author of "Abel" has a liberating streak, here and there wild (not to say anarchic). Which instigates madness, not forgetting to point out the price to pay.

title: R.D.F. - Rumori di fondo
actors: Francesco Dominedò, Giuditta Del Vecchio, Francesco Meoni, Andrea Occhipinti
description: Francesco and Zago are two brothers who live in the Roman suburbs. The first is a shepherd, the second has just got out of jail. The latter decides to rob the usurer of the area, because he dreams of escaping with the booty to Yugoslavia. Francesco and Chiara, Zago's girlfriend, try in vain to dissuade him. The robbery ends with the murder of the usurer, whom no one misses. After Zago takes a woman hostage, Inspector Tiresias enters the scene. Camarca's second film is a sort of metropolitan western, which tries to draw inspiration from the cinema of the Coens and Sam Raimi. The result is mediocre and the operation is only partially redeemed by the good work on the image and sound.

title: Jack & Sarah
actors: Richard E. Grant, Samantha Mathis, Judi Dench, Ian McKellen, Eileen Atkins
description: An English lawyer with a well established law firm loses his wife, who died in childbirth, and finds himself having to take care of little Sarah. The man first runs into a drunken bum who wants to give him a hand and then Amy, a young waitress completely unaware of baby food and diapers, who, however, offers to help him. Eventually she will prove to be the right person not only for the child, but also for the ... dad.
notes: The directorial debut of Tim Sullivan, screenwriter of "Lady Brenda's Wedding", is certainly not the best. The subject is not original and the actors, except McKellen, are below average.

title: Las amazonas contra los "superman"
actors: Nick Jordan, Mark Hannibal, Yueh Hua, Karen Yeh, Lin Moody
description: A gang of particularly aggressive Amazons trained in the arts of war holds captive a group of men who live in neighboring villages. Only the keeper of the Sacred Fire, which is nothing but oil, dares to break their dominion, but the man is lured into a mortal trap. But there are those who are ready to avenge their death and defeat the terrible Amazons. Para-Hong Kong fantasy, but actually directed by our local Alfoso Brescia.

title: Clandestino a Trieste
actors: Jacques Sernas, Doris Duranti, Edda Albertini, Massimo Girotti
description: During the bombing of Tunis, an Italian aviation officer is taken prisoner. Subtracted to captivity he takes refuge in Monfalcone, where he finds a job as a worker in a construction site. Giulio, so he calls herself the military, falls in love, reciprocated, of Marcella, employed in the construction site. In the meantime, Giulio is sought by the allied police because he was accused, unfairly, of having caused the sinking of a hospital ship. Giulio, who before the relationship with Marcella, had a son from his lover, often goes to Trieste to find him and it is here that he triggers the trap.
notes: Melodrama Matarazzo style which, seen today, is boring and of little interest. Among the interpreters Doris Duranti, former "regime diva".

title: Il castello dei morti vivi
actors: Christopher Lee, Gaia Germani, Philippe Leroy, Donald Sutherland
description: A small group of acrobats receive an invitation from Count Drago (Lee) to hold a show in his castle. During the performance Bruno, one of the actors, dies. In a short time, other deaths of a mysterious nature follow one another, until the guests discover who was responsible for those killings. It is the count who has given them a drug of his own invention that causes death and instant embalming. Typical autarchic horror of the sixties directed by Luciano Ricci under the pseudonym of Herbert Wise. Donald Sutherland makes his debut playing two roles (one of which in costume).

title: Bellezze a Capri
actors: Nando Bruno, Ave Ninchi, Tamara Lees, Adelchi Bianchi
description: An ancient rivalry exists between Don Violante, parish priest of Anacapri and an old-fashioned priest, and Don Camillo who heads the community of Capri and who has modern ideas. When Gennaro, a young organist protected by Don Camillo, falls in love with Clelia, Don Violante's nephew, the sentimental affair exacerbates the disagreement between the two priests. The organist would like to get engaged officially, but meets the opposition of his uncle priest. Adelchi Bianchi, not to be confused with Giorgio, directs a comedy and sets it on the blue island, where it is easy to set anything. Unfortunately the interpreters are not up to par and the indisputable sympathy of Ave Ninchi is not enough.

title: The Preacher's Wife
actors: Denzel Washington, Whitney Houston, Courtney B. Vance
description: A guardian angel (Washington) is sent to Earth to support a priest from a Baptist community in crisis with his wife (Houston), who is the choir teacher, with his five-year-old son and even his mother-in-law. To complicate matters, even a capitalist who wants to tear down the church to build a residential center.
notes: Yet another, anabolic, but tired remake of Hollywood, wanted by Denzel Washington in a desperate attempt to replicate Cary Grant (protagonist of the "Bishop's Wife" of 1947) and prove that it is also suitable for sentimental comedy. But the trend of the angels does not pay: the original was witty and polite as much as this is listless and caramel, directed by a director who, after "Big", has shown an increasingly shortness of breath. Remarkable only the voice of Whitney Houston, accompanied by a music at the height.

title: Space Jam
actors: Michael Jordan, Bill Murray, Larry Bird
description: Bugs Bunny has engaged himself and his friends in a basketball challenge with the Nerdlucks, a gang of irritable little creatures from outer space. They were sent by the ruthless and warlike Swackhammer (voiced in the original by Danny De Vito) to kidnap the Looney Tunes. If the Looney Tunes win they can stay on earth, if the aliens win. Bugs decides to kidnap Michael Jordan and make him play on his team. The commercial of a well-known sports brand in which Jordan challenges a handful of "cartoons" has become a film: same director (Pytka is the king of American commercials), same star, same drawings. The story is expanded and updated on the "Independence Day" model and enriched with another NBA basketball ace, Larry Bird. In the dubbing, voices of Sandro Ciotti, Giampiero Galeazzi and Simona Ventura.

title: Strana la vita
actors: Diego Abatantuono, Monica Guerritore, Domiziana Giordano, Amanda Sandrelli
description: Dario is a listless psychologist from a Usl struggling with the gray routine of the patients in the clinic, the friends of the bar, his girlfriend Nora and his parents. Just as he is getting bored at the bar, he is approached by Mario, a schoolmate who has married Anna, his first love. His friend tells him how he cheats on his wife with Ester, a very helpful teenager. In the middle of the story, Mario dies, suffering from a heart attack. It is from this moment that trouble begins for Dario. Taken from a novel by Giovanni Pascutto, a surreal film, an unusual element in the Italian panorama of the Eighties, the film manages to avoid any sentimental sketches.

title: Turbulence
actors: Ray Liotta, Lauren Holly, Hector Elizondo, Brendan Gleeson
description: On December 24, the flight to Los Angeles departed from New York and everything points to a smooth flight. The typical joy of Christmas Eve, however, is soon dampened by the sinister presence among the passengers of an unusual group of travelers. These are four feds who are escorting two dangerous criminals. The former Ray Weaver (Liotta) is a death row serial killer, while Stubbs (Gleeson) is a ruthless robber who does nothing to hide his hatred of federal agents.
notes: Between dignified special effects and routine performance, an hour and a half of show, old-fashioned, but not despicable.

title: Sogni infranti (ragionamenti e deliri)
description: Journey through the "years of lead" made through the assembly of period documents, interviews with some historians and with some protagonists of those events. Bellocchio listens, among other things, to the opinions of Vittorio Foa and of the repentant former Brigadier Enrico Fenzi and reconstructs the "proletarian trial" brought by the Red Brigades against Roberto Peci, sentenced to death and executed for being the brother of the "traitor" Patrizio. Some of the interviewees are still serving a semi-liberty sentence. An anomalous film-document, difficult to classify, which provokes consciences, with the evidence of images and words that do not need comment.

title: The English Patient
actors: Ralph Fiennes, Juliette Binoche, Kristin Scott Thomas, Willem Dafoe, Naveen Andrews, Colin Firth, Julian Wadham, Jurgen Prochnow, Kevin Whately, Nino Castelnuovo
description: During the Second World War, four people take refuge in the hills around Florence: a mysterious man with a vast historical and geographical culture, rendered unrecognizable by burns; twenty-year-old Hana, a nurse who left her detachment to look after the unknown patient; Caravaggio, an Italian-Canadian thief, and finally the gunsmith Kip, an Indian Sikh, who becomes Hana's lover. The mysterious patient recounts his tragic adventure in colonial Africa. Impossible love, war, exoticism, adultery, romantic death, beautiful photography, a bit of "phone call" tension. The novel by Michael Ondatjee from which the film is based is not very long, three hours are too long and above all the film does not have the courage to dare the shameless mélo, even if the best moments (besides the aerial images) are the mélo duets between Fiennes and Kristin Scott Thomas.

title: Ghost from the Past
actors: Alec Baldwin, Whoopi Goldberg, James Woods, Craig T. Nelson
description: Shortly after midnight on June 12, 1963, Medgar Evers, first secretary of the National Association for the Advancement of Black People, was killed on the doorstep. Thirty years later Bobby (Baldwin), assistant district attorney, manages to get the case reopened. He risks shattering his marriage and jeopardizing his career, but his tenacity ultimately rewards him. Byron De La Beckwith (Woods), a Ku Klux Klan fanatic, is convicted by a mixed jury.
notes: "I love the Mississippi Delta - it's the most beautiful place in the world." "Yes, if you are a mosquito": over one hundred and twenty minutes for a single funny joke are too many even for those who expect democratic stances, legitimate revenge, justicialist harassment from cinema. But the film is predictable. And Alec Baldwin, boiled fish that can't be boiled anymore.

title: Il carniere
actors: Massimo Ghini, Antonio Catania, Paraskeva Djukelova, Leo Gullotta
description: Three friends, Paolo, Renzo and Roberto, on board a station wagon, are reaching a game reserve in the Balkan peninsula. The journey is repeated every year, as soon as autumn begins just when the deer become less suspicious and come out of the woods in herds. The three have an appointment with Boris, the huntsman who will have to escort them to the waiting boxes placed in a splendid clearing. But this year, unlike previous years, something is not working, in fact, in the place of Boris, the three find the daughter of the guide. A mysterious, beautiful and taciturn girl who does not give explanations and who replaces her father. Suddenly the group of friends find themselves embroiled in the war that has bloodied Yugoslavia.

title: Ardena
actors: Luca Barbareschi, Lucrezia Lante Della Rovere, Francesca Antonelli, Arnoldo Foà, Aiace Tugnoli
description: The summer of 1969 is truly special for Andrea, a 13-year-old boy who, like every year, leaves Milan to move with his family to a small village in the hills of northern Italy. His large family usually find themselves full during the summer holidays. Summer passes, hot autumn is approaching and Andrea is forced to grow up.
notes: There is no doubt that the highlight on television of 1969 was the American spacecraft to the moon. And the television images of that event play the role of a Greek choir in this story. Everything is boringly thought out and shot according to the cliché of films reminiscent of the sixties. However, it must be said - the only positive note - that the actors are quite good and Barbareschi the director precisely characterizes the tics of a father suspended between lazy superficiality and courage on important choices. The title indicates beyond the ancient village where the story is set, also the anagram of the protagonist's name.

title: Mars Attacks!
actors: Danny DeVito, Jack Nicholson, Glenn Close, Pierce Brosnan, Natalie Portman, Lisa Marie, Annette Bening, Martin Short, Michael J. Fox, Sarah Jessica Parker, Rod Steiger, Tom Jones, Jim Brown, Lukas Haas, Pam Grier, Sylvia Sidney, Jack Black, O-Lan Jones, Christina Applegate
description: The aliens have landed on planet Earth and have chosen the United States. But, unfortunately for us and the Americans, they do not have the peaceful aspect of ET, on the contrary, they do not miss an opportunity to destroy everything they find. After all, America does not deserve a president like James Dale, whose main concern is the suit to wear for the meeting with the Martians. No less is First Lady Marsha, always obsessed with appearances and who does not want to have "those things" in the house. Even Professor Donald Kessler turns out to be a fool after all. Eventually a country kid, his goofy grandmother, and some country music will make things right.
notes: "Mars Attacks!" by Tim Burton is a great game on the naive science fiction of the 1950s (starting with the opening credits, beautiful), but also a great mockery of all our myths, our rituals and our alibis: we will not become better by not eating pig and converting to Buddhism. "The Martians - says the (stupid) professor who goes on television - are very intelligent and therefore must be peaceful". No, the Martians, who derive directly from a series of fashion stickers in the 1960s, are very intelligent, and that's it. Therefore, after a haughty look, they may only want to destroy us. We who still have Tom Jones (who appears in person and closes the film in a hilarious naturist-Disney idyll) deserve nothing else.

title: Jerry Maguire
actors: Tom Cruise, Cuba Gooding jr., Kelly Preston, Jerry O'Connell, Jonathan Lipnicki, Renée Zellweger
description: Jerry Maguire is a man on the crest of the wave. He is one of the most important agents of Sports Management International and feels himself in control of the world. He is handsome and devoted to his glorious clients and to his girlfriend Avery, a journalist who treats sex, love and work with the same frenetic ambition. But one day Jerry is fired because he dared to write a programmatic report titled "The Things We Think But Don't Say". Suddenly everything changes around him and following him in the new solitary adventure are a young widow with a dependent child, a rising American football champion, the only one who does not turn his back on him. The five Oscar nominations, the "Golden Globe" for the always mediocre Cruise and the Oscar as a supporting actor in Cuba Gooding jr., And the (suspicious) criticisms from overseas, do not deceive. "Jerry Maguire" is a very clever "reconnaissance" on the "exchange of goods" that endorses any type of sale. A highly studied mix of pseudo-committed film ingredients.

title: Big Night
actors: Stanley Tucci, Tony Shalhoub, Ian Holm, Isabella Rossellini, Campbell Scott
description: The Primo and Secondo brothers, who emigrated from Italy, decided to open "The Paradise", an authentic Italian restaurant. The two brothers are convinced that the family recipes and the great culinary experience can transform their place into the best Italian restaurant in the city. But more often than not, it happens that there isn't even a customer. Among other things, right in front of their restaurant there is Pascal's restaurant, which is sold out every night. But in town there is Louis Prima with his orchestra and Pascal offers to contact him to help Primo and Secondo relaunch "The Paradise". Low budget, good actors (magnificent Ian Holm in the role of the mafia contestant), clever script. "Big Night" crosses the minimalism of "Smoke" and the Italian-American exasperations of Scorsese: it works above all in the first part and in the "big evening", while it gets lost a bit in the intertwining of the characters. They would have benefited from subtitles instead of dubbing, which in a film born bilingual tends to generate absurd situations.

title: Fratelli coltelli
actors: Simona Ventura, Emilio Solfrizzi, Fabio Canino, Flavio Bucci
description: Under the eyes of the classic butler and in the background of an elegant ancestral villa, a Tuscan prince and an Apulian waiter live a new life after discovering that they are half-brothers and have to share their maternal inheritance. They all try to damage themselves: and since the real consistency of the patrimony is not certain, the fluctuation of their relationships is continuous. All this, of course, will end up favoring a beautiful scammer. The comedy from which the film is based was written by the Vanzina brothers and conceived for Christian De Sica and Abatantuono: today Maurizio Ponzi takes it to the cinema with Emilio Solfrizzi made known by "Striscia la Notizie". Stretched story, just saved from the director's hand. Disappointing Simona Ventura.

title: Kamasutra
actors: Sarita Choudhury, Naveen Andrews, Indira Varma, Ramon Tikaram
description: In the 16th century India live Maya and Tara, the first young servant, the second princess. While Tara wears fine silk dresses and jewels and learns the Kama Sutra label, Maya remains excluded from the entourage. Despite the difference in caste, Tara is threatened by the natural sensuality and the grace of Maya. On the eve of Tara's wedding with the powerful Raj Singh, Maya, who suffered for a long time because of Tara, finally has the opportunity to take revenge.
notes: In the third Mira Nair film, the two most prolific cinema souls in the world, the Indian one, attempt to coexist: the tear melodramas and the author film. The "love lessons" (literal translation of the title and of the fundamental oriental erotic "philosophy") have been censored in India despite chastity and pudorus. If you accept the game of PhotoRomanzone in Technicolor with "depth" that touch the "Lavia's touch", you can get to the bottom dreaming of seeing the unpublished and beautiful Indira Varma (Maya) out of the screen.

title: The Rabbit Trap
actors: Ernest Borgnine, David Brian, Leslie Bethel
description: Eddie is a modest travet all dedicated to work. To the point that he agrees to give up the holidays just started to return to the office. His son, an eight-year-old boy, would instead want his father to go and check the rabbit trap they had set in a forest. Back in town, Eddie realizes the wrong done to his son and sends the boss to that country. The trap, however, is empty and his gesture was useless. Classic film of sober and a little theiod realism taken from a teleplay.

title: Sono otoko, kyobo ni tsuki
actors: Takeshi Kitano, Maiko Kawakami, Makoto Ashikawa, Shiro Sano
description: A violent policeman struggles with unorthodox means in contemporary Yakuza Japan. The first film directed by Kitano, comedian, writer, TV star, appeared in Oshima's "Furyo", is an extraordinary mix of genres (especially action and noir) and experimentalism. A film out of all the rules.

title: 3-4x jugatsu
actors: Masahiko Ono, Yuriko Ishida, Takeshi Kitano, Minoru Iizuka
description: The life of a reckless affiliate of the Yakuza, the Japanese mafia, in a small provincial town. Between bars, baseball games, murders, Takeshi Kitano, in his second work, is shooting a film completely free from any narrative and genre convention. Perhaps it is the least convincing of his films, but it remains very interesting.

title: The Disappearance of Vonnie
actors: Joe Penny, Ann Jillian, Graham Beckel, Kim Zimmer, Alexandra Purvis
description: It's been six years since Vonnie and Ron met on a Green Bay bowling alley and decided to get married. Now, however, things between the two are not going very well. Ron's job as a cop monopolizes all of his time and energy. Vonnie ends up losing her temper when her husband doesn't show up at her daughter's birthday party and the two begin to argue. The next day Ron decides to take her on a trip to nearby Appletone, but once they arrive there he leaves her there. Back home alone he makes everyone believe that his wife has left him.

title: The Man with Three Wives
actors: Beau Bridges, Pam Dawber, Joanna Kerns, Kathleen Lloyd
description: Norman Grayson is a respected surgeon, a good father and a devoted husband. At least that's what it seems to everyone who knows him. But one day the doctor begins to be stressed at work, wanting to give up a brilliant career and abandon his wife and children to take refuge in the arms of his ex-lover who he cannot forget. It soon turns out that Norman was married to three women at the same time ... The film is based on an actual event.

title: Stolen Innocence
actors: Thomas Calabro, Tracey Gold, Bess Armstrong, Nick Searcy
description: Stacy Sapp leaves the house where she grew up and ventures onto the road with a partner. Also because her parents oppress her. The mother, in fact, is always hypercritical towards him and the father is a champion of inertia and passivity. Soon Stacy is alone as her friend suddenly decides to go home. Alone and scared, the girl befriends Richard Brown, a charming ex-convict who spends his time traveling across the States. Stacy, naive, agrees to follow him and ends up falling in love with him, not considering that the man has a natural predisposition for everything that is outside the law. Mediocre film for American television with Thomas Calabro known to the general public for having interpreted the television series "Melrose Place".

title: Thrill
actors: Antonio Sabato jr, Stepfanie Kramer, George Castillo, Rory Edelman
description: An amusement park ends up as an inheritance to brother and sister, Jack and Theresa. Jack, recently widowed, however, does not want to know and leaves the city with little Alice, his daughter. Carl, who hates technology, and Norman also work on the rides. The moment is difficult and Theresa plans to sell. At this point, however, begins a series of attacks on the rides that drive away the patrons. Suspicions fall on Norman, but threats continue even when the man is imprisoned. The little girl is kidnapped and a triggered bomb is placed on the roller coaster. It's up to Jack, although he suffers from dizziness, to climb the carousel and neutralize the bomb after unmasking the criminal. The setting of a thriller in an amusement park allows you to play on overly abused contrasts. After all, Pillsbury is neither Hitchcock (the crazy carousel of "The Other Man"), nor, even less, Orson Welles (the "Lady of Shanghai" escape in the Luna Park).

title: The Manhattan Project
actors: John Lithgow, Christopher Collet, Cynthia Nixon, Jill Eikenberry
description: A very smart kid is particularly attracted to nuclear physics who dreams of being able to study thoroughly at university. He knows everything about atoms, neurons and protons and his little room is crammed with books and magazines that explain every detail of the matter. Every detail: even how to make a plutonium reactor at home! So why not give it a try? Driven by curiosity and unconsciousness, the boy penetrates a "top secret" facility and steals a small amount of radioactive material, sufficient, however, to develop a deadly device. Now that he has built it, how will he prove his skill without running into serious trouble? Fantastic teen comedy as it was in fashion in the 80s.

title: Jeffrey
actors: Steven Weber, Michael T. Weiss, Patrick Stewart, Bryan Batt
description: Love and chastity. To exorcise the AIDS nightmare, a homosexual, unemployed actor and a waiter out of necessity, decides to do away with sex. How to vent, then, the impulses of youth? Maybe in the gym, between weights and weightlifters. One of these, however, is as beautiful as the sun and perhaps even could prove to be the much sought-after soul mate. From the comedy by Paul Rudnick (scarsetta), with the declared intention of "facing the devastating tragedy of AIDS with humor", the newcomer Ashley derives a romantic operina evoking the ghosts of Rock Hudson, Doris Day and the beloved Liza Minnelli of "Cabaret". We are in New York, in tourist snobbish territory, the "Six Degrees of Separation" neighborhood, between dancers of "Cats" and interior decorators who have the appearance of Captain Piccard of "Generations" (the exquisite Stewart who plays the role of the protagonist's best friend ).

title: Le mani forti
actors: Francesca Neri, Claudio Amendola, Enzo Decaro, Toni Bertorelli
description: Claudia, a young psychoanalyst at the beginning of her career, has been treating Tancredi for about three months. In the course of a session, the man, a correspondent for a news agency, tells her that he witnessed a serious crime in Bosnia. The woman is shocked and disturbed by the precision of the details. When, in subsequent sessions, Tancredi returns to the subject, adding more and more precise details each time, Claudia's doubts become suspicious. Franco Bernini, screenwriter for Mazzacurati, Luchetti, Piccioni and Salvatores, defines his first work as a "philosophical mystery".
