Among excellent corpses, abstract Petri-like atmospheres of "Buone Notizie" and a very declared desire to retrace the happy path of the cinema of civil commitment, "Le mani forte" (those of occult and eternal powers ...) insinuates itself into life daily routine of a novice analyst. The construction moves elegantly between flash-forward and flash back, the purposes are noble (we want to talk about the massacres) the acting moves with alternating current, the defects float above all (paradoxically?) Right on the script.

title: God's Army - The Profecy
actors: Christopher Walken, Elias Koteas, Eric Stoltz, Virginia Madsen
description: It all begins with the murder of a hermaphrodite, whose corpse is found without eyes. The policeman Thomas Daggert, a former seminarian, begins the investigations which are immediately more difficult than usual. They are implicated in the murder of Gabriel, an archangel denied by God and Simon faithful divine nuncio. Both are fighting to steal the soul of an American general, guilty of heinous atrocities in Asia. Directorial debut for the screenwriter of "Highlander" and "Killer Fire", the film is a very curious horror that, through a nice atmosphere and a handful of good actors, manages to make the story credible.

title: Trapper County
actors: Bo Hopkins, Don Swayze, Robert Estes, Betsy Russell
description: Bobby and Ryan are two vagabonds who live day to day playing guitar on the streets of California. Always on the lookout for adventure, they stumble upon the dreaded Luddiger clan. The meeting for the two will only be a source of trouble: in fact they will be accused of murders never committed. Film of little interest, directed by an unknown director.

title: Modesty Blaise
actors: Monica Vitti, Terence Stamp, Dirk Bogarde, Harry Andrews, Michael Craig, Tina Marquand, Clive Revill, Rossella Falk, Joe Melia
description: To obtain an oil concession in the Middle East, the British government undertakes to deliver a large quantity of jewels to a sheikh. To prevent the precious cargo from being stolen during the journey, the secret services engage agent Modesty, who is helped by Willie, a man with an easy knife, and clashes with her eternal enemy Gabriel. Based on a comic by Jim Holdaway and Peter O'Donnel, Losey's work is a sort of James Bond-esque parody of secret agents. At the time it seemed silly, today perhaps the pop side can be re-evaluated; but it is still a missed film. The magician Silvan also appears in a small part.

title: Léonor
actors: Michel Piccoli, Liv Ullmann, Ornella Muti, Piero Vida, Antonio Ferrandis
description: A feudal lord loses his wife Léonor (Liv Ullmann), who died following a fall from a horse, and decides to bury her with his own hands. Time passes, but the man cannot forget her despite having remarried to the beautiful Catherine (Muti). He thus asks Satan to give him back Léonor, whom he glimpsed during one of his usual walks in the woods.

title: Faites sauter la banque
actors: Louis De Funès, Jean-Pierre Marielle, Yvonne Clech, Anne Doat, Michel Tureau, Catherine Demongeot, Georges Wilson, Jean Valmont, Claude Piéplu, Georges Adet
description: Mr. Garnier has a sporting goods shop and among his many customers also includes the bank manager Durand-Moreuil. One day the man is persuaded to invest his life savings by buying shares on the stock market. The suggestion turns out to be wrong and Garnier loses all his money and soon finds himself on the brink of ruin. Garnier does not lose heart and together with his family decides to take back what he has lost by concocting a blow to the bank. Louis de Funès was France's leading comedian in the 1960s. This may not be one of his best films, but fun is guaranteed.

title: Finalmente soli
actors: Rocco Papaleo, Daniele Liotti, Marco Milano, Giorgio Panariello, Domiziana Giordano
description: One is a lawyer, another is a dentist, another plays football and the fourth installs methane systems. The boredom of daily ménage oppresses them: wives are a strange and fleeting object that leaves them and makes them leave, who wants to have children and is not resigned to being the reassuring refuge of those who are distressed by fanatic suitors all the time. Misunderstandings from pochade just made more modern by the insistent use of mobile phones: the greatest theorist of generational comedy, Umberto Marino, takes up situations and characters already seen, withdrawn, superficial. Daniele Liotti, former interpreter of "The artichokes will grow in Mimongo", is a candidate as the main interpreter of the very latest draft; Giordano forgets Tarkowski and Godard, but has a scenic grip that makes her unique in the Italian panorama.

title: 101 Dalmatians
actors: Jeff Daniels, Joely Richardson, Glenn Close, Joan Plowright
description: Pongo is a gorgeous Dalmatian who lives with his master in London. Tired of being single, he tries to make Rudy fall in love with Anita, the pretty owner of the Dalmatian dog Peggy. The four find themselves together. While Rudy and Anita are tidying up the house, Cruella De Mon, an old schoolmate of the girl, shows up. Cruella knows that Peggy is about to give birth to her puppies and she wants to buy them, to make a fur coat with their coat. If "101 Dalmatians" animated in 1961 was the triumph of the black and white dog horde, the live version is "stolen" by the rampant presence of Cruella, a Glenn Close who, dressed with a touch of genius by Anthony Powell, looks like having found the part of his life. Otherwise, the film doesn't rise from honest family fun, without the rhythm and heat of the original and without the writing intelligence of "Babe". Completely missed the effect of the charge of the puppies on the snow; a bit unsophisticated, like all good Disney people, Daniels and Joely Richardson; very good Kipper, the airdale who saves puppies.

title: Emma
actors: Gwyneth Paltrow, Ewan McGregor, Greta Scacchi, Toni Collette, Alan Cumming
description: Beautiful, intelligent and self-satisfied Emma Woodhouse spends her life with her widowed father in the town of Highbury. Determined to arrange marriages, she takes under her wing Harriet Smith, a girl who, alone, would not be able to enter good society. Jane Austen was a writer who, coupled with an astonishing punctuality of environmental description, had the grace of wickedness. But McGrath's script isn't worth Thompson's, and the actors are bad, all intent on mimicking parts they don't hear (Ewan McGregor in a dandy dress) or feel too much (Gwyneth Paltrow, with the doll-like pout of the good-country girl). Instead of a relentless novel, a much-talked-about film centered around an irritating heroine.

title: Smilla's Sense of Snow
actors: Julia Ormond, Gabriel Byrne, Richard Harris, Vanessa Redgrave
description: Smilla Jasperson is an Eskimo born in Greenland and moved to Copenhagen. When Isaiah, a six-year-old Eskimo boy is found dead face down in the snow after a fall from the roof of his house, the police dismiss the case as a tragic accident. The son of a chronic alcoholic, the child was Smilla's inseparable friend, who, not convinced by the police's conclusions, begins to investigate.
notes: There is a lot of snow, some great shots of Greenland (in the beginning) and some shots of the beautiful urban scenery of Copenhagen. Then there is a story that demands tension, both on a narrative level (after all, it's a thriller) and on a psychological level (the rediscovery of a submerged identity). Too bad that August's sense of tension is much less than Smilla's sense of snow.

title: Get on the Bus
actors: Richard Belzer, DeAndre Bonds, Andre Braugher, Thomas Jefferson Byrd, Ossie Davis
description: In October 1995, a group of men boarded a bus to participate in the Million Men March organized by Farrakhan, leader of the Muslim movement of color. The group includes an outcast father who struggles to reconcile with his son, an aspiring actor full of hatred, a policeman who wants to put an end to the massacre that takes place every day on the streets, a devout Muslim and other various humanity.
notes: Fifteen powerful African Americans (including Danny Glover, Will Smith, Wesley Snipes and Spike Lee himself) hunt for $ 2.4 million and produce this militant 16mm instant film shot and edited in three months. Didactic, but a bit boring.

title: Kolya
country: Great Britain, Sweden, France, Czech Republic
actors: Zdenek Sverak, Andrej Chalimon, Libuse Safrankova, Ondrez Vetchy
description: In 1988 Prague, still under Soviet domination, an elderly and non-aligned musician agrees to marry a Russian for convenience: she will receive a Czechoslovakian passport, he will have a nice sum of money to buy a Trabant and pay some debt. But at the wedding (not) consummated, the wife escapes to Germany leaving little Kolya, her son, in front of her husband's door by chance. The child speaks only Russian and cries in the bathtub: the man, shocked at first, will learn to live with it until the collapse of the communist block. Presented at the '96 Venice Film Festival, winner of the Golden Globe and the Oscar for best foreign film, the family work of Sverak son (director) and Sverak father (screenwriter and protagonist) has the gift of showing dramas and lacerations with the weapon of irony, of non-shouted counterpoint, of cheerful (but not too much) phrasing. Under the sign of death (cemeteries, tombstones to be restored) perhaps slips into sentimentality, but the blackmail works.

title: Pedale douce
actors: Fanny Ardant, Patrick Timsit, Richard Berry, Jacques Gamblin
description: Adrien during the day takes on the role of the businessman. At night he devotes himself to the wildest fun in the bar run by his best friend Eva, trying to satisfy his ambiguous homosexual nature. Invited to a dinner by Alexandre, a banker with important friendships, Adrien makes Eva pass as his wife. A chain of misunderstandings is triggered, which will involve unsuspected characters.
notes: Comedy of misunderstandings fast, jaunty and ambiguous. Not a masterpiece, but a carefree divertissement with a sunny Fanny Ardant like not seen since "Finally Sunday!" and a Patrick Timsit neo-Coluche. The soundtrack is full of old-time hits: Dalida, Dean Martin, "Sans contrefaçon" by Mimsy Farmer. Observe how it is sung on the end credits by Fanny: it alone is worth the cost of the ticket.

title: Ridicule
actors: Charles Berling, Jean Rochefort, Judith Godrèche, Fanny Ardant, Bernard Giraudeau
description: Before the French Revolution, laxity and corruption of soul reigned in Versailles. Gregoire de Ponceludon, a farmer caught by the courtier past, leaves his native land, massacred by mud and mosquitoes, with the mirage of being able to convince Louis XVI of his reclamation project. But the ways of the lone kings are somewhat limited and humiliating: from the lounges frequented by bored nobles and intrigued only by jokes, to the beds of sailors.
notes: The moral of the French blockbuster most loved by the French (opening at Cannes '96, 4 César and Oscar nomination) is all too clear: things change, but up to a certain point. "The vices are without consequence, but the ridicule kills": Leconte risks dying of his own motto. Nothing to complain about the costumes of Christian Gasc, about the photography by Thierry Arbogast and about the good Rochefort. A lot about the final result.

title: La promesse
actors: Jérémie Rénier, Olivier Gourmet, Assita Ouedraogo
description: In today's very sad Belgium, a boy manages a trafficking of immigrants with an unscrupulous father ready to beat him if he catches his son in an attitude of solidarity towards them. On the visit of some emissaries from the emigration office, an African falls from a scaffolding in an attempt to escape the controls. At the point of death, the man asks the young man to take care of his wife and daughter still in diapers. To do so, he will have to send the ugly parent to the devil and start an ordeal to hide from the woman the true end of the unfortunate husband. The dry first work of the Dardenne brothers resumes their path developing it towards fiction. The two know exactly what to show us and what to cut: the observation is, at the same time, anthropological and melodramatic. The firm style allows the actors to appear as if taken from the street. Intense and burning with anger.

title: Le pistole non discutono
actors: Rod Cameron, Dick Palmer, Angel Aranda, Vivi Bach, Luis Durán
description: Bill the lonely, inveterate outlaw, and his brother George, who is a novice, attack a bank and steal thirty thousand dollars and then take refuge in Mexico. Sheriff Garrett sets out on their trail and catches them across the border. The three then clash against Mexican "bandidos", eager to seize the loot. Western spaghetti more sober and less smashing than the average.

title: Fierce Creatures
actors: John Cleese, Jamie Lee Curtis, Kevin Kline, Michael Palin
description: A Texan billionaire in the name of business plans to close a zoo and send the poor beasts to the slaughter. The somewhat foolish son of this man wants to be emancipated from his father. Eventually there will also be a body exchange and a heartless manager appears. A winning team does not change, even after eight years: the dream team of "A fish named Wanda" tries again the hit of the comedy daughter of Monty Python's delusions: Cleese writes the script and plays the director of the zoo, while Palin gives stutterer becomes a lover of animals with a subtle and devastating logorrhea. Jamie Lee Curtis is always erotica & exotica. Kline doubles up, Texan billionaire and foolish son. Delicious dish ingredients but, unfortunately, little amalgamated. Begun by Robert Young and finished by Fred Schepisi, the film denounces the atrocities of the free market with a predictable "phone call" comedy. In short, the "wild creatures" are them: the capitalists. Nice discovery.

title: Kavkazski plennik
actors: Oleg Menshikov, Djemal Sikharulidze, Sergei Bodrov jr, Susanna Mekhralieva
description: In the war-torn Caucasus, two Russian soldiers are captured and taken to a small mountain town by Abdul-Murat, a Chechen, who hopes to exchange them for his own son taken prisoner by the Russian army. While the two soldiers try to escape, one is killed. The exchange, in this way, can no longer take place, also because, in the meantime, Abdul's son was killed during a collective escape from prison.
notes: Looking for light in Tolstoy's poetics, the author of the extraordinary "Freedom is Heaven" (1989) tries to explain the madness of a small and dirty war by creating a chamber "Apocalypse Now", lost in the mountains of a distant region. by God and by men. The epilogue in which no one goes home as a winner is very bitter. Bodrov's fiction is almost documentary. A beautiful film suspended in the atrocious silence broken only by inexorable discharges from machine guns.

title: Seven Thunders
actors: James Robertson Justice, Stephen Boyd, Kathleen Harrison
description: Two British prisoners of war manage to escape and take refuge in the old quarter of the port of Marseille, a haunt of smugglers and partisans. Here one of the two meets and falls in love with a lonely girl. When the Germans decide to raze in the neighborhood, the two and the young woman manage to embark clandestinely for England. Typical war film without infamy and without praise.

title: Matilda
actors: Danny DeVito, Mara Wilson, Rhea Perlman, Embeth Davidtz
description: Matilda is an extraordinary girl, gifted with an amazing intelligence. Unfortunately Harry and Zinnia Wormwood, her dull and absent-minded parents, are too engrossed in their petty existences to care for her. When the Wormwoods decide to indulge the child's desire to attend school, they send her to Crunchem Hall, which looks like a gloomy brick prison in every way. The girl clashes with Agatha Trunchbull, the corpulent and terrible director of the institute. The company of Miss Honey, a first-grade teacher who understands the child's remarkable qualities, saves her. An unsweetened, non-pathetic children's film, capable of mixing horrific shocks and poetry, as in the best tradition of Anglo-Saxon children's fiction (based on the book by Roald Dahl). De Vito directed "Matilda" with a nice bad hand, almost magnifying the glimpses of familiar "harmony" of the first part of "The War of the Roses": he crushes little Matilda against the horrors of the adult universe, underlines the tacky vulgarity of the parents, uses the unreality of the cartoon, does not forgive and does not redeem anyone in the finale. A film in love with reading and everything from the side of the kids.

title: Camere da letto
actors: Simona Izzo, Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Diego Abatantuono, Ricky Tognazzi
description: A couple has sex problems due to shifts that never coincide; another, made up of theatrical actors, struggles between the certainty of having nothing more to say and the difficulty in combining love and marriage; a miser completely changes his life for the love of a Russian who has come to Italy with two little girls. For all four stories the background is the city of Ostia. The couples summarize the private world of Ricky Tognazzi and Simona Izzo, who play the two actors and use blood and in-laws relatives for many other roles. Engaged from the outside are Abatantuono and Cucinotta, the most physically exuberant couple, and Giobbe Covatta, here in his first film.
notes: Direction a bit dull and without verve; the most interesting note of the film, however, is the realism and crudeness of the dialogues, which are never good-natured and come out of the whispered minimalism of many Italian films.

title: Pour rire
actors: Ornella Muti, Jean-Pierre Léaud, Antoine Laurent, Antoine Chappey
description: The marriage between Alice (Muti) and Nicolas (Léaud) is apparently happy. She is a successful lawyer, he is a housekeeper. A couple of their friends decide to separate and he tries to console the woman left alone: ??so he discovers that his wife has a lover. To win her back, he pretends to be a friend of his lover and unaware of everything: and he makes sure that in the clandestine couple all the mechanisms of official marriage are reproduced, the same ones from which the brilliant jurist was trying to escape. A comedy at times distressing, but also a bit foolish, with the wrong cast.

title: The Basketball Diaries
actors: Leonardo DiCaprio, Lorraine Bracco, Juliette Lewis, Bruno Kirby
description: Wandering through the New York suburbs of the early 1960s, a very young and promising amateur basketball player, rebellious and desperately vital, enters the drug tunnel. The frantic search for money, human and social marginalization, excesses and heroin almost end up killing him. But sport, and especially poetry, will show him a way out.
notes: Taken from the cult autobiography Jim enters the basketball field, which the poet and author of rock lyrics Jim Carroll wrote in 1978. Recovered from the oblivion of Italian distribution thanks to the presence of Leonardo DiCaprio, then in the height of success as an actor and above all as an idol for teenagers.

title: Menzogna
actors: Yvonne Sanson, Alberto Farnese, Irene Galter, Emma Baron
description: Luisa Sangro is a young and very rich widow who immediately consoled herself with Fabrizio, her waiter. Without regretting the poor husband too much. At least until he realizes that man is actually exploiting it. To escape this embarrassing situation, Luisa takes refuge in a fishing village. Rocco, owner of the house, also owns a fleet of fishing boats and is in love with Mariella. The girl, however, is in love with di Gianni, embarked on one of Rocco's boats. The sailor is also coveted by Luisa ... The director is an emulate of Raffaello Matarazzo.

title: Kauas pilvet karkaavat
actors: Kati Outinen, Kari Väänänen, Sakari Kuosmanen, Elina Salo
description: Ilona works at "Dubrovnik", a Helsinki hotel and is married to Lauri. The TV they have at home still has to pay for it, as well as the sofa and library. But it happens that Lauri, from one day to the next, finds himself without a job. The same thing happens to Ilona. Minimalist style (apparently), laconic characters, bittersweet tension: the latest, beautiful film by Aki Kaurismäki (who, as always, wrote, directed, edited and produced it). Inspired by "Bicycle Thieves" and "It's a Wonderful Life", Dickensian in the accumulation of catastrophes and underground humor, a film all played on the range of blue and on a mathematical composition of the frame, which moves without ever being pathetic . It is dedicated to Matti Pellompaa, Kaurismäki's favorite actor, who died the year before, who is the baby in the framed photo.

title: Kids
actors: Leo Fitzpatrick, Justin Pierce, Chloë Sevigny
description: A group of young skaters, frequent visitors to the Washington Square park in New York, face their problems with drugs and sex. The group includes an HIV-positive young woman who desperately tries to find her "benefactor" and a teenager who, as a favorite hobby, loves deflowering little girls. It is the first work of Larry Clark, an American over fifty from Oklahoma, unknown to the cinema, but very famous as a photographer. In 1971, his album "Tulsa" (titled after the American town where the director was born in 1943) was described as "icy and disconcerting". In 1983, the second collection "Teenage Lust" confirmed his talent and predilection for adolescent mysteries and provocations. "Kids", right from the title, insinuates itself among the disconcerting kids of the 90s, a group of which is followed for twenty-four hours. A film "beyond good and evil", as the French newspaper "Libération" wrote.

title: Things to Do in Denver When you're Dead
actors: Andy Garcia, Christopher Walken, Gabrielle Anwar, Christopher Lloyd, Fairuza Balk
description: Jimmy said the Saint is a former gangster in crisis, "Afterlife Advice" business is not going too well. So he agrees to put himself at the service of the godfather of the city, who calls himself "The Man with the Plan". In order to get the job done, he recruits a group of old friends who are a bit elderly. The group includes Olden "Pieces" Polymeros, a leper designer, who spends his time keeping the seats of a porn cinema clean, Earl "Easy Wind" Denton, who continues the extermination operation he used to do as a young man, and finally Franchise Chyser. What they have to accomplish is very simple, to scare the hell out of Meg's new lover, betrothed to Bernard, the godfather's stupid son.

title: The Devil's Own
actors: Harrison Ford, Brad Pitt, Treat Williams, Margaret Colin
description: Belfast: Rory Devaney is a terrorist. New York: Tom O'Meara, another Irish policeman who fights violence in his neighborhood every day. Nobody would think that Tom and Rory can meet. But Devaney escapes from Ireland and takes refuge right at the policeman's house, posing as an innocent young man in search of escape. The film starts well, with two successive sequences (in 1972 in a small town and in 1992 in Belfast) compressed and well organized, worthy of Pakula's old talent. But then the story moves along predictable channels. The second part, in its frantic attempt to save everyone, seems written to avoid the viewer the shadow of a doubt or a thought.

title: Un paradiso di bugie
actors: Antonella Ponziani, Claudio Amendola, Monica Scattini, Carlotta Darò
description: After the death of their elderly mother, Anna and her daughter Nanà decide to move to Milan with a billion. They rely on a handsome financier who vows to make money, a real estate agency for a super-luxury apartment and a porter with a candid soul and an adventurous past. The second film for the cinema of the handyman Casini (the first, "Far from where", was from 1983) would like to revive the glories of the "Kim Novak" comedy. But, as usual, the latent courage and the desire for "sublime fiction" is held back by a cumbersome realism. Good, perhaps, as a pilot for a television series.

title: Final Verdict
actors: Treat Williams, Glenn Ford, Olivia Burnette, Ashley Crow, Raphael Sbarge
description: We are in the city of Los Angeles and the year is 1919. A girl slowly feels an immeasurable adoration for her father, who is a lawyer by profession, growing within her. Things get really bad when this affection turns into something more serious and dangerous. Based on an episode that really happened in the California megalopolis, the film, conceived and produced for American television, does not stray from mediocrity. The story is shot at a too slow pace.

title: Sweeney
actors: John Thaw, Dennis Waterman, Ian Bannen, Diane Keen
description: In the midst of the oil crisis, the Foreign Office is forced to give in to the blackmail of the Arab sheikhs. Between price rises and falls, the strings of an international intrigue pass by the desk of Elliott McQueen, a press agent who keeps numerous politicians in check through a circle of high-profile prostitutes. When one of these women ends up killed, Inspector Swenney is called who, for his investigation, is at one point forced to leave due to exoneration. But the prey is too big for the policeman to let go ... Great international scenario for a very modest detective film that also lacks suspense.

title: Final Justice
actors: Patty Duke, Martin Sheen, Jason London, Alexandra Powers
description: Bored with life in his hometown, a small provincial town, 17-year-old Chris joins the marines. Away from home, he is seduced by an older woman who convinces him to marry her, naturally against the will of the parents who are faced with a fait accompli. A girl is born, but this does not prevent the woman from betraying her young husband who, finally, decides to ask for a divorce. Confident that she will lose the privileges she now enjoys, she contemplates killing Chris so that she can take advantage of his substantial life insurance. Once the crime is complete, Chris's mother engages in a relentless fight with her daughter-in-law in an attempt to prove his guilt.

title: Deux hommes dans Manhattan
actors: Jean-Pierre Melville, Pierre Grasset, Jean Darcante, Jerry Mengo, Jean Lara
description: Moreau, who works at the France Press agency, receives a delicate assignment from its director. He must investigate the reasons that led to the defection of the French delegate Fèvre-Berthier during an important political meeting. Aided by the photographer Delmas, the journalist tracks down Judith Nelson in New York, a woman who had been seen in the company of the politician. She reveals to the two that the politician died in her apartment following a heart attack. Delmas, convinced that he can create a photographic scoop, enters the house, transports the corpse of the politician and photographs him. Melville with this film pays homage to American noir, offering the viewer a dark vision of Manhattan.

title: Piso pisello
actors: Luca Porro, Fabio Peraboni, Valeria D'Obici, Alessandro Haber
description: Oliviero is a serious and mature boy despite his thirteen years. His dream is to become a nuclear engineer, but he lives in a family that is far too messy. The father and mother are two wrecks from '68. Surprisingly, the boy has his first love experience with May, a foreign girl who, drunk, ended up in his bed. The girl then disappears, but, after some time, reappears claiming to be pregnant with Oliviero. Metropolitan fable that, here and there, recalls Zavattini. The film, written by the director together with Bernardino Zapponi, is unsolved and a bit too affected.

title: The Sin of Harold Diddledock
actors: Harold Lloyd, Frances Ramsden, Jimmy Conlin, Raymond Walburn, Lionel Stander
description: Twenty-two years ago, Harold was the mainstay of the football team, but now he's reduced to being the archivist of an advertising company. One day they decide to fire him and in taking leave of his colleague Otis he confesses that he has always loved her, as he has always loved his seven sisters who, before her, have followed one another in the office. It is a Wednesday and Harold, finally free from any commitment, decides to get drunk and with the money of an unexpected win he buys a circus. Last film by Harold Lloyd, star of silent cinema, who underwent heavy production manipulations (a smaller version is also circulating). Unfortunately for the comedian, the golden days are over, even if some gags remain irresistible.

title: When We Were Kings
actors: Muhammad Ali, George Foreman, Don King, James Brown (II), Spike Lee, Norman Mailer
description: On October 30, 1974, in Kinshasa, the capital of Zaire, world heavyweight champion George Foreman was knocked out. in the eighth round. Winner: Cassius Clay, who since 1964 called himself Muhammad Ali for religious reasons, who in 1967 had challenged the American government by refusing to participate in the Vietnam War, who hopped, chatted, "danced" incessantly around his opponents and who became the symbol of the redemption of blacks and their return to African roots. In 1974, following the two boxers was the documentarian Leon Gast. It took Gast 22 years to find the funding to finish the film and to reduce the 173 hours of material shot to an hour and a half. There is more emotion and intelligence in this documentary than in many fictional films; and a big twist, in the fifth round, when the sorcerer's prophecy ("a trembling woman will possess Foreman during the match") seems to come true, Foreman shows signs of fatigue and Gast superimposes Miriam Makeba's "bewitched" face on the two boxers that sings. The documentary won the Oscar in its category in 1997.

title: William Shakespeare's Romeo + Juliet
actors: Leonardo DiCaprio, Claire Danes, John Leguizamo, Pete Postlethwaite, Paul Sorvino, Diane Venora
description: We are in Verona Beach today and it is in this town that the eternal love story between Romeo and Juliet takes place. The families of the two young people openly oppose each other, only the young woman's father is a boss in the smell of the Mafia. Romeo's company is a mob that also includes Mercutio, a transvestite. The love story goes on until Romeo believes that Juliet is dead.
notes: In this film, all the postmodern and youthful imagery is confused with that jumble of aestheticism and popularity, grandguignol, gothic, tragedy, comedy, blows in the stomach and absolute stylization, which was (and is) the Shakespearean imaginary.

title: Metro
actors: Eddie Murphy, Kim Miyori, Michael Rapaport, Carmen Ejogo
description: In San Francisco, as is well known, crime is at home. For this reason, the police without hesitation make use of one of his men, who specializes in long chats with the perpetrators of kidnappings who have contributed decisively to solving the case more than once. This is in fact a psychopathic killer that the policeman will have to face assisted by an inexperienced partner and a reporter in love with him. Abandoned the special effects of the "Mad Professor", Eddie Murphy returns to action focusing everything on the barrage of words and contagious laughter. Unleashed pace (the director comes from the crime series), but situations that are too predictable: in any case, Murphy shows that over the years he has not lost familiarity with the slapstick, since he does everything.

title: One Fine Day
actors: Michelle Pfeiffer, George Clooney, Charles Durning, Joe Grifasi
description: Melanie (Michelle Pfeiffer) is a single mother who goes all out to meet the needs of her career (she is a successful architect) and those of her six-year-old son. As fate would have it, he has to spend an entire day side by side with a divorced father, Jack (George Clooney), an assault journalist, who is also struggling with the daughter left to him for a week by his ex-wife. It so happens that ...
notes: Very glamorous film (even too much in some moments), sly and conventional, but absolutely irresistible. It is not, mind you, the sequel to "Frankie & Johnny". Just another story that is still worth "living".

title: Space Truckers
actors: Dennis Hopper, Stephen Dorff, Debi Mazar, Shane Rimmer
description: In the year 2196 John Canyon is an intergalactic and independent truck driver. Opposed by the Compagnia, a supra-planetary company that controls everything and everyone, he finds himself allied with the coveted Cindy and the young Pucci. The trio accepts a secret cargo in order to get out of trouble and head for Earth, where Cindy's mother is sick and the transported goods (indestructible robots) are awaited by the sinister President Saggs. Directed by a specialist of the genre and shot entirely in the Ardmore studios in Dublin, the film-video game re-presents the old Hopper in the imperishable role of the flower child, flanked by the clearest eyes of Planet Hollywood (Mazar) and by the divetto Dorff ("Blood and Wine "). Cowboys and cowgirls disguised because underneath there is always the western.

title: All'ombra di una colt
actors: Conrado San Martín, Stephen Forsyth, Franco Ressel, José Calvo
description: An elderly gunslinger takes a bad eye on the love between his daughter and a young "colleague". The latter, however, intends to lay down his arms and become a farmer. Having bought a farm, he is forced to wield the colt again to face two criminals who want to take over the ranch. The arrival of the old gunslinger sets things right. Western spaghetti with a rather unusual subject, but no more appreciable than similar films.

title: My Sister Eileen
actors: Rosalind Russell, Janet Blair, Brian Aherne
description: Two celebrity-seeking sisters come to New York from the provinces. One wants to break through as a writer, the other as a variety artist. The harsh reality of the metropolis, however, puts them in serious difficulty, so much so that they are forced to take up accommodation in a basement room that is not very welcoming. A series of incidents in which they are involved, however, highlights their qualities: success is now within reach. Wind chimes movie with a nice pace, a nice setting and the good Rosalind Russell.

title: Hoop Dreams
description: William Gates and Arthur Agee are two black boys, born and raised in the usual black ghetto of an American metropolis. Their fate seems to be that of too many people in that neighborhood: the street, petty crime and, perhaps, jail. But they are also not there because they have an ace up their sleeve: basketball, a sport for which they have more than a decent propensity. In fact, basketball offers them an unexpected chance: to attend an exclusive white-only college that opens the doors to them for sporting merits. From a starting amount of 250 hours of filmed material, documentary maker Steve James, with a few close collaborators, assembles a story-truth. One of the best American documentaries of the decade.

title: Dao
actors: Xiong Xin-xin, Chiu Man Cheuk, Moses Chan, Valerie Chow
description: A weapons master decides to adopt the son of his best friend who was brutally killed by a gang of dangerous thugs. Day after day, the man, putting his talents to good use and taking advantage of the young man's physical prowess, prepares him for revenge which, as usual, will be successful. Director and producer of John Woo, considered by all to be the new talent of Hong Kong cinema who has now emigrated to the United States, Tsui Hark makes this "Wuxiapian" film, that is to say about Chinese swashbuckling. The genre, born in China in the 1920s, finds the most suitable interpreter in the director and we are sure it will find admirers in Western spectators.

title: Terra di mezzo
actors: Ahmed Mahgoub, Mario Colasanti, Massimo Sarchielli, Paolo Sassanelli, Guglielmo Feraiola
description: At the edge of a road leading out of the city, some Nigerian prostitutes spend their time on broken sofas negotiating their bodies and thoughts with white customers. In another street, Slavic boys are waiting to be hired as bricklayers, but they are willing to do all kinds of jobs. At night, an Egyptian works as a squatter in a gas station.
notes: The general tone is surreal, the raw language has nothing to do with neorealism. With little money and lots of ideas, the young Garrone (28 years old) participated in the Turin Film Festival earning him the exit in the theater.

title: Le acrobate
actors: Valeria Golino, Licia Maglietta, Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Roberto Citran
description: The little girl Teresa has lost a tooth and needs a special place to let it rest forever. Southern Maria is turned off by an everyday life marked by dull routine: unknowingly unhappy, potentially capable of climbing mountains. Elena del Nord is a chemist very good at mixing formulas for cosmetics, but undisciplined with her own life (from) separated: a lover without the courage of confrontation, empty like a day spent watching TV. To heal every urgency, it rains from the sky full of rain, Anita: an angel, probably. Soldini's cinema has a steady, cold, lucid gaze. But in this film of suspended and astonished women, the priorities seem to focus on feelings, the ice seems to melt under the blows of scandalous tenderness.

title: Some Mother's Son
actors: Helen Mirren, Fionnula Flanagan, Aidan Gillen, David O'Hara, John Lynch
description: Kathleen Quigley is a middle-class teacher who lives with her three children in a quiet fishing town in Northern Ireland. The woman, who has always been a pacifist, has managed to stay away from the war that plagues her land. His existence is suddenly shaken when Gerard, one of his sons, is arrested along with an IRA leader.
notes: Rigor, emotion, tension and the ability to avoid rhetoric. These are the most impressive features of the film, first directed by an Irishman from Belfast and screenwriter of "In the Name of the Father" with Jim Sheridan (who reluctantly reserved the role of co-writer and producer here).

title: M. D. C. - Maschera di cera
actors: Romina Mondello, Robert Hossein, Riccardo Serventi Longhi
description: During the New Year's Eve of 1900 in Paris, a pair of lovers are horribly killed and mutilated by a mysterious murderer with an arm wrestling. A ten-year-old girl survives the massacre and thus becomes the only witness. Thirteen years pass and, in Rome, a young man named Luca dies mysteriously in the Wax Museum where some of the most shocking facts of mythology and history are reproduced. Boris, who is the creator and owner of the Museum, mysteriously manages to bring his statues to life. They went out of their way to write the story and screenplay (Dario Argento, Daniele Stroppa, Lucio Fulci, who should have directed it) of this film, from a script by Don Mullay and Carl Erickson, which formed the basis of the two versions. earlier (Curtiz in '33 and De Toth in '53), both cited with no taste. Stivaletti will also know how to do special effects, but is limited to a jumble of canonical situations, copying left and right, from the Grand Guignol as from the Hammer, from the "maestro" Argento as al gore. Acting (apart from Hossein, who always seems to be in a trance) from a photo novel, ridiculous dialogues, an "open" ending from overwork.

title: Go West
actors: Buster Keaton, Howard Truesdale, Kathleen Myers, Ray Thompson
description: A penniless young provincial tries his luck, first in New York, but the metropolis risks crushing him, then in the wild West which he reaches with a lucky and comical train ride. Transformed into a real cowboy, he first grapples with "Brown Eyes", a meek cow he can't manage, then with a whole herd of cattle invading Los Angeles.
notes: Pyrotechnic finale, in the best tradition of silent comic cinema even though it is not the best of Keaton's.

title: La classe non è acqua
actors: Roberto Citran, Valerio Mastandrea, Barbara Livi, Antonio Catania
description: After teaching abroad for many years, Professor Guido Marinelli (Citran) returns to Italy to take possession of his new chair in a high school in Rome. Arriving at Termini station, an unconscious and frightened girl hands him a bag containing ... a child. Once the newborn is fixed, the man is faced with a new problem. In fact, someone, more, so to speak, appreciated by the Superintendent, has seen fit to snatch his chair. First work by a former teacher halfway between "La scuola" by Luchetti-Starnone and "Classe mixed 3A" by Moccia che. The starting point is "realist", the development of an Italian comedy updated at the time of "I Ragazzi del muretto", while "The fleeting moment" is only a faded memory. Bravo Catania in the role of the silent homosexual. Essential, Mastandrea.

title: Night Falls on Manhattan
actors: Andy Garcia, Ian Holm, Richard Dreyfuss, Lena Olin, James Gandolfini
description: After being a simple street cop, Sean Casey, a law student in his spare time, manages to enter the office of the New York District Attorney. His secret hope is to be able to modify the system. After only eight months of work, he is unexpectedly chosen as the prosecutor in a case involving a dangerous drug trafficker who has reduced an elderly police officer to death. The fact, then, that the victim is his father only complicates things. The structure is that of films "that were made once": half of a trial structure and half centered on an investigation aimed at uncovering the dubious implications of the New York Police Department, solidly democratic and in solidarity with the Healthy America united in defending its values. Sidney Lumet was once a specialist: from "Serpico" to "The Prince of the City" to "The Verdict", he juggled with shrewd and tense scripts and with an authentic liberal spirit between the traps and intrigues of power, the ambiguities of justice , human weaknesses. But precisely from "The Verdict" Lumet has lost a lot of its polish, and in this film he is unable to organize a balanced script (the first part is unbalanced compared to the next) and to make credible characters that seem only pale clichés: from Andy Garcia not intense enough to Richard Dreyfuss who continues to remake himself, immutably, to Lena Olin, insignificant and useless in the role of the protagonist's rich girlfriend.

title: Dante's Peak
actors: Pierce Brosnan, Linda Hamilton, Jamie Reneé Smith, Jeremy Foley
description: Harry Dalton is a volcanologist in crisis after losing his wife in an accident. But when his former colleagues ask him to study seismic activity near the town of Dante's Peak, Harry doesn't feel like refusing. The town is ruled by Rachel Wando, who is about to sign a lucrative deal with a billionaire.
notes: The catastrophic is sometimes like porn, repetitive and absolutely predictable: first part, introduction of the characters (many) who will be in danger; second part, catastrophe and death of some of these characters. And that's exactly why it works; provided, of course, the premises are respected and the effects are satisfactory. "Dante's Peak", on the other hand, shoots away the best effects during the opening credits, does not make us in the least fond of its characters and reduces the effects to a lot of smoke (and almost no roast). Dialogue dripping with sweet rhetoric to the point of ridicule.

title: Return of the Texan
actors: Dale Robertson, Joanne Dru, Walter Brennan
description: The hard life of Sam Crockett and his family on a Texas farm. Among overbearing neighbors, disputes between breeders and farmers and young thwarted loves, attachment to the land, dedication to work and solidity of the family are enhanced.
notes: Wezstern realist, refined and smooth, written by Ford's screenwriter (Dudley Nichols) and directed by a specialist.

title: Murder 101
actors: Pierce Brosnan, Dey Young, Anthony Corone, Raphael Sbarge
description: Charlie Lattimore is an established mystery writer and university lecturer. His favorite lesson topic is of course the art of creating suspense. The professor. however, at a certain point he remains implicated in a series of crimes. Only his sagacity in building thriller stories, as well as the help of a promising student, allow him to exonerate himself and find the culprit.

title: Party Girl
actors: Robert Taylor, Cyd Charisse, Lee J. Cobb, John Ireland, Kent Smith
description: We are in 1933 in Chicago and the lawyer Thomas Farrell has achieved a truly enviable economic position, but a somewhat dubious notoriety. In fact, the man is the legal advisor and representative of the powerful gangster John Callagher and the men of his gang. Thomas lives separated from his wife and has suffered bitterness and disappointment, but, in the end, he has achieved what he wanted. One day he meets, by chance, Wicky, a good girl and tries to change his life with her. But he's too attached to John to get away from him. The film, which saved Metro Goldwin Mayer from bankruptcy, is based on an unpublished novel by Leo Katcher and is scripted by George Wells. Delusional (even in color) and desperate, with tragic characters and an implacable sense of destiny, a film from Ray's heyday. Cyd Charisse brings a sensual air of musicals.

title: Dharmaga tongjoguro kan kkadalgun
actors: Hae Jin Huang, Won Sop Sin, Pan Yong Yi, Su-Myong Ko
description: A Zen monk lives in an isolated place with a little five-year-old orphan and a young pupil. Through daily experiences the child knows pain, suffering, fear, but also joy, always led to reflect on his experiences by the elderly teacher. He, feeling close to dying, entrusts his spiritual testament to the pupil, who is leaving. Left alone, the child understands that he will be able to get away with it anyway. Nice debut with slow rhythms, beautiful images and a suspicion of aestheticism. But in the long run the film takes.

title: Camilla
actors: Franco Fabrizi, Gabriele Ferzetti, Luciana Angiolillo, Irene Tunc
description: A young doctor, his family and the maid who came from the country: Camilla. The doctor is not doing well, he has to prepare for the specialty exam and does not have the necessary peace of mind. Moreover, to get out of the economic straits he is in, he listens to a friend who offers him a deal that turns out to be busted. Camilla sees, observes, helps as she can. Eventually, after the storm, the doctor understands that only by throwing himself into the profession can he solve his problems.

title: La supertestimone
actors: Monica Vitti, Ugo Tognazzi, Orazio Orlando, Véronique Vendell
description: An inveterate spinster (Vitti) has an unfinished business with a protector (Tognazzi) of prostitutes. he therefore accuses him of murder and supports the fiction in front of the judges. The man is convicted, but she repents and gets the case reopened. After fixing things she marries him, but soon after he throws her on the sidewalk. Pecoreccio all'italiana with the former muse of Antonioni's incommunicability. Dated and exhilarated, despite the good comedians.

title: The Underneath
actors: Peter Gallagher, Alison Elliot, Elisabeth Shue, Joe Don Baker
description: Michael Chambers is an avid gambler who has gone bankrupt for his insane passion. To raise some money he gets hired as a security guard, but more than the salary he aims at the contents of his briefcases. So, with the complicity of his ex-girlfriend, who dumped him but he would like to win back, and of the current, violent partner of the woman, he plans the coup. From the author of the overrated "Sex, lies and videotape", here is the remake of "Double game" (1949) by Siodmak which, however, had a very different psychological sensitivity. And then Peter Gallagher is certainly not Burt Lancaster.

title: Wong gok ka moon
actors: Andy Lau, Maggie Cheung, Jacky Cheung, Alex Man
description: In a working-class neighborhood in Hong Kong, in the late 1980s, the story of three characters: a little gangster, a completely splashed friend of his and his cousin, with whom the gangster falls in love. City and countryside, old and new values, and above all the new Hong Kong cinema and one of the authors who will become one of its greatest representatives: Wong Kar-Wai, who has revealed himself in Europe with "Hong Kong Express" and "Angeli aduti" and awarded in Cannes 1997 with "Happy Together". This, in 1988, is his debut in directing, lyrical and wild, subtly ironic and, above all, very free. A cinema we are just starting to get used to.

title: Blind Justice
actors: Armand Assante, Elisabeth Shue, Robert Davi, Adam Baldwin
description: San Pedro, a town near the Grand Canyon, is in the hands of a group of bandits led by Alacran. They aim at a shipment of silver guarded by a handful of soldiers. In San Pedro, Canaan happens by chance, a former soldier who became almost blind from a wound, but who, despite this, has maintained an infallible aim. A charming nurse asks him for help in freeing San Pedro from the Alacran gang. Canaan accepts, thinking of the booty.

title: Once Upon a Time
actors: Cary Grant, Janet Blair, Ted Donaldson
description: Gerry is a theatrical impresario on the verge of bankruptcy. Either he finds one hundred thousand dollars in a few days or has to close. On the street he meets a child with a brucus trained. Brilliant idea: "sell" the caterpillar to Walt Disney for the sum you need. Said and done, but the baby is anguished for the loss of his animal. Gerry is ready to give up everything for the child's happiness, but ... a little late on the New Deal, but always in line with the "American Way of Life". It is no coincidence that the caterpillars become ... butterflies.

title: Sentivano... uno strano, eccitante, pericoloso puzzo di
actors: Robert Malcolm, Piero Vida, Rosalba Neri, Dante Maggio
description: The million dollars earmarked for the construction of the railway is tempting to many: the shady banker Costello, the outlaw Brocco Kid, the gunslinger Jenkins. The three naturally come into conflict with each other and each tries, with the means he has, to make the soles of the other two. Western spaghetti in which Italian authors and actors no longer even resort to Anglo-Saxon pseudonyms. It is remembered only for the delusional title.

title: Pappa e ciccia
actors: Lino Banfi, Milly Carlucci, Paolo Villaggio, Pippo Santonastaso, Marina Confalone
description: There are two episodes of this film. In the first Carmel, a southern emigrant who lives in Switzerland and works as a house painter, he pretends to be rich so as not to disappoint his relatives who have remained in the country. But, one bad day, one of his nieces arrives from Puglia. In the second episode, a modest and clumsy employee experiences the extraordinary adventure of a holiday in Kenya, in a tourist village organized almost like a concentration camp, from which he barely saves his skin.
notes: The comedy is well known, the gags seen and reviewed. Villaggio wearily repeats the cliché of the employee who doesn't like one.

title: Guaglione
actors: Terence Hill, Giulia Rubini, Titina De Filippo, Dorian Gray, Tina Pica, Virgilio Riento, Claudio Villa
description: A high school student loses his head for an attractive showgirl and neglects his studies for her. Not only that: do not let the beloved miss the pleasures she is accustomed to, the student comes to rob the father. But his efforts are worthless, rejected by the woman, he even goes so far as to attempt suicide. Melodramatic meatloaf, along the lines of the Neapolitan drama, without major attractions.

title: La boum 2
actors: Claude Brasseur, Sophie Marceau, Brigitte Fossey, Lambert Wilson
description: Repeating the vicissitudes of the previous film, we find Vic, in love with Philippe, who does everything to make him jealous; the father who quarrels with his mother and leaves home to achieve success in his work; the little sister Samantha, now grown up, who has her own adventures and finally the great-grandmother Poupette who, at the last moment decides not to marry her handsome widower anymore. The film no longer even has the pimp grace of the first episode.

title: Salto nel vuoto
actors: Michel Piccoli, Anouk Aimée, Michele Placido
description: After years of semi-marital relationship (one senses an incestuous relationship), the brothers Mauro and Marta Ponticelli enter into crisis. He, thinking that she is going crazy, introduces her to Giovanni Sciabola, an unscrupulous adventurer, hoping that she will fall in love with him. In reality he will end up badly ...
notes: One of Bellocchio's most underrated films (also screenwriter, with Piero Natoli and Vincenzo Cerami), one in which family neuroses and anxieties are dried by a masterful style, with an inspired direction of actors and with a totally sincere gloom . Palme d'Or in Cannes for Piccoli and the Aimée.

title: La boum
actors: Sophie Marceau, Claude Brasseur, Brigitte Fossey
description: Vic, the thirteen-year-old daughter of a couple close to separation, faces her own difficult adolescence amidst sentimental worries, school troubles and family troubles.
notes: A comedy that had the merit of focusing attention on the delicate world of adolescents. Smart and harmless, the film that launched Sophie Marceau. A juvenile cult thanks also to the tunes of Vladimir Cosma ("Reality").

title: Il piccolo vetraio
actors: Massimo Serato, Balpêtré, Lionello Carrel
description: We are in 1815, in an unspecified village in Southern Italy. Pietro and Nino, two very poor boys, are sent by their father to work in France, employed by a greedy and sadistic glassmaker who mistreats his subjects making them almost slaves. The two boys manage to escape, but the younger dies of starvation. The return of Napoleon from the exile of Elba and a noble protector known in fortunate circumstances, allow them to return home.

title: Two if by Sea
actors: Denis Leary, Sandra Bullock, Yaphet Kotto, Mike Starr
description: Frank, a worker and a small-time petty thief, has accepted a new "job": stealing a precious painting and delivering it to the client in an exclusive tourist location. Roz is his woman and accomplice who, however, would like to stop and every time she tells him that this is the last blow. The theft succeeds, but the recipient is not found and the police are on their trail. Meanwhile, in the golden worldly hiding place, a refined connoisseur of art (and beautiful women) has set his sights on Roz.
notes: Nothing original in this lively yellow comedy already seen a thousand other times on the screen, but the dusting off also works thanks to the couple of protagonists.

title: The Navigator
actors: Buster Keaton, Kathryn McGuire, Frederick Vroom
description: A billionaire and his girlfriend accidentally end up on an ocean liner sent adrift by some thugs who have also kidnapped the girl's father. The ship runs aground near an island whose wild inhabitants kidnap the girl. The billionaire frees her. When all seems lost, a submarine emerges and frees them. A series of virtuosic and philosophical variations on objects, spaces, relationships between people. As always, Keaton is beautifully abstract and utterly hilarious.

title: Days of Being Wild
actors: Leslie Cheung, Maggie Cheung, Andy Lau, Carina Lau, Rebecca Pan, Jacky Cheung
description: A nice young man, carefree and heartthrob, has only one thought in life: to conquer females over and over again. But feelings are lurking for him too, especially when he finds the right woman, or rather: the right women. In fact, there are two painful and unresolved love stories that at a certain point seize this romantic and ultra-modern Don Juan and put him in serious ambush. The film that revealed Wong Kar-Wai's talent ("Happy Together", "Hongkong express"). A frenzied rhythm for a melon also appreciated by the European Olivier Assayas, who hired the actress Maggie Cheung for her "Irma Vep".

title: J'embrasse pas
actors: Manuel Blanc, Emmanuelle Béart, Philippe Noiret, Ivan Desny
description: From his native village perched on the Pyrenees, Pierre arrives in Paris, like so many provincials, full of dreams. His desire is to be an actor, but he soon ends up on the sidewalks. After refusing to be supported by a rich homosexual, he falls in love with a "colleague" whose pimp gives him a bad quarter of an hour. Only in the army can Pierre hope for a new life. Caustic and corrosive, as often in Téchiné, the parable of poor Pierre is the emblem of thousands of as many, anonymous, daily odyssey.

title: Come scopersi l'America
actors: Erminio Macario, Carlo Ninchi, Delia Scala, Folco Lulli
description: A simpleton and a crafty swindler join forces. They end up on a barge destined to be a target for the fleet, then migrate to America where they pass all the colors, so much so that they decide to go home. With a small boat they face the waves of the ocean. The gags leave something to be desired by the couple Macario-Ninchi is badly matched.

title: Mario, Maria e Mario
actors: Giulio Scarpati, Valeria Cavalli, Enrico Lo Verso, Jacques Alric
description: We are at the end of the Eighties, the moment in which the Italian Communist Party is transforming itself into PDS. Mario, who works as a typographer at Unità, is convinced of this change while his wife Maria, who works as a saleswoman in a pharmacy, disagrees. Not only. A sentimental clash also arises from the political conflict between the two: Maria begins to look with interest at another Mario, an electronic technician met in the section who is of her own opinion.
notes: The film, written by the director with his daughter Silvia, tries to tell the story also through the private narrative. But what he had succeeded in "We loved each other so much", unfortunately fails here.

title: Vedo nudo
actors: Nino Manfredi, Sylva Koscina, Enrico Maria Salerno, Véronique Vendell
description: The film consists of seven episodes. The first: the actress Sylva Koscina succumbed to an injured person. In the hospital, doctors and nurses allow themselves to be distracted by the diva and forget about the poor guy. The second: a madman, tried for violence against a hen, gets away with the mitigating circumstance of provocation (but is forced to buy his victim). The third: a postal employee has a close love correspondence, under the false name of Ornella, with a Piedmontese accountant. The fourth: a short-sighted bodybuilder thinks he has a beautiful girl in front of him. The fifth: a provincial virgin gives herself to a worker believing him to be a maniac. The sixth: a professional neglects his wife, but there is no other woman involved. Only locomotives. The seventh: a whiz of erotic advertising sees naked all the women he meets. The individual episodes, more than stories, seem like jokes. Mafredi gets away with it; the last episode that gives the title to the film is famous.

title: The Killer Is Loose
actors: Joseph Cotten, Rhonda Fleming, Wendell Corey, Alan Hale jr.
description: Leon Pool, a cashier in a bank, is complicit in a group of criminals who have organized a robbery. When the agents go to arrest him, he resists and during the firefight, Sam Wagner, one of the policemen, kills his wife. Pool is arrested and convicted, but vows to avenge his wife's death. And when for good behavior he is transferred to an agricultural colony, he takes the opportunity to escape.
notes: A dry and tense story, with Corey grande playing the part of the psycho killer.

title: La Marquise d'O...
actors: Edith Clever, Bruno Ganz, Otto Sander, Edda Seippel, Peter Luhr
description: Second half of the eighteenth century, Northern Italy. Enemy troops besiege cities. The governor's daughter is saved by a count who takes her away from a group of soldiers. The young woman unknowingly becomes pregnant. Disowned by her family, she advertises in a newspaper to find out who is responsible.
notes: Taken from a story by Heinrich von Kleist, it is one of Rohmer's most accurate works: refined reconstruction of interiors, subtle analysis of costume, precise iconographic citations, text recited in old German with actors of theatrical origin, in an atmosphere of chaste and compressed.

title: She
actors: Ursula Andress, Peter Cushing, Bernard Cribbins, Soraya
description: The Englishman Leo looks like a drop of water to the Egyptian high priest Killicrates, killed two thousand years ago by Queen Ayesha. Thanks to the secret kept in the Sahara by the "sacred flame", the woman is still alive and leads Leo to fall in love with her. With two companions Leo reaches the ruins of the city of Ayesha where the sacred flame still burns ...
notes: Vaguely inspired by the myths of Atlantis, it is a product that does not differ from the more cheap peplums produced in photocopies in the 1960s. Dull adaptation of the famous fantasy novel by Henry Rider Haggard, entitled "She". The 1935 version ("The Eternal Woman") is much more successful.

title: Brainscan
actors: Frank Langella, Paul Stewart, David Hemblen, Edward Furlong
description: Michael is a sad teenager with a complex family situation: his mother is dead and his father is always absent for work. The boy always lives among computers, role-playing games and horror films. One day he discovers a new pastime: Brainscan, a virtual reality that presents an endless series of gruesome scenes and which threatens to turn Michael into a serial killer. Detective Hayden, however, manages to make contact with the boy.
notes: With an eye to teenage fashions, the film blasts a worn-out repertoire of clichés of the genre repainted with special effects.

title: Sweet November
actors: Sandy Dennis, Anthony Newley, Theodore Bikel
description: The young industrialist Charles Black meets Sara Dover, a strange girl who has the habit of accompanying herself every month with a different man. Sara asks Charles to be her "him" for November. During the month he really falls in love; eventually he discovers that Sara does this because she is seriously ill and tries to spread some goodness among her fellow men. A sensitive comedy, even if not completely successful.

title: Il vecchio testamento
actors: Brad Harris, Susan Paget, Mara Lane, Enzo Doria, Isarco Ravaioli
description: Reconstruction of pure fantasy of the guerrilla struggle that the tribes of Israel waged, in the second second century BC, against the Hellenistic rulers under the leadership of Judas Maccabee and his brothers. A canvas and a good director for all seasons: both when the "peplum" was in fashion, and, a decade later, with the western spaghetti.

title: L'arma, l'ora, il movente
actors: Renzo Montagnani, Bedy Moratti, Adolfo Belletti, Eva Czemerys
description: Commissioner Boito must investigate a triple homicide. The murdered are Don Giorgio, a young priest stabbed in the church of a convent of nuns, Giulia, his mistress, and the husband of Orchidea, a charming woman with whom the priest was also having an affair. However, someone has seen it all, but when he decides to speak, he risks his skin in turn ...
notes: Semi-unknown Italian thriller distributed at a time when the genre was at the peak of its success, and yet it was almost completely ignored. In fact it is not a properly inalienable title. Bedy Moratti is the sister of Inter president Massimo.

title: Il raccomandato di ferro
actors: Mario Riva, Franca Marzi, Aroldo Tieri, Alessandra Panaro, Amedeo Nazzari
description: The brilliant career of Augusto Zinconi, a braggart who, from a humble travet, becomes the manager of an oil company thanks to the vaunted credit of a high-level knowledge. Passing off as a friend of a politician and forging his signature, Augusto gets a job and then is even sent to Rome to plead a project of his company with the politician, who has now become a minister: but the knots will come to a head ...
notes: Good-natured and harmless satire of the (ill) Italic costume of Dorothean imprint in the boom years. Mario Riva, then at the top of popularity also thanks to _Musichiere_, will tragically die the following year.

title: Schizopolis
actors: Steven Soderbergh, Betsy Brantley, David Jensen, Eddie Jemison
description: First of all I was born, and from there the troubles started. When I was five, I tried to lose my parents during a 4th of July party, but they found me again. At nine, during a baseball game, I was floating above my body and we lose three points. At fifteen I have the feeling that something terrible is about to happen to me ... For a character like this, the "urban civilization" of the twentieth century is an obstacle course. From the same author of "Sex lies and videotapes", to the fifth feature film, a film certainly below expectations and certainly more ambitious than the result achieved. Emblematic parable of one of the most overrated authors of recent times.

title: Huo shao hong lian si
actors: Willie Chi, John Ching, Carman Lee, Wong Kam-kong
description: The forces of Good and the forces of Evil face off in single combat. The former are embodied by Shaolin monks, the very skilled ascetics in martial arts, able to endure immense physical fatigue as well as to exhaust all the resources of the mind. The latter are represented instead by the perfidious Manchu governors. In the usual directorial style "brutal and violent, with frantic editing and the baroque style of the shooting technique". but it is neither the densest nor the funniest of the director's films.

title: Stop at Nothing
actors: Veronica Hamel, Lindsay Frost, David Ackroyd, Annabella Price
description: A separated couple fights for the custody of their eight-year-old daughter who is temporarily placed in the care of her father. The mother, desperate, is ready to do anything to get the child back, convinced that her husband has incestuous intentions. A young detective has the task of watching over the little girl. Aided by an illegal organization of women who have lived through the same experience, the mother manages to kidnap her daughter. But only for a short time ...

title: ...altrimenti ci arrabbiamo!
actors: Terence Hill, Bud Spencer, Donald Pleasence, John Sharp, Deogratias Huerta, Patty Shepard, Manuel de Blas
description: A mechanic and a truck driver friend, passionate about autocross, both win a race. The first prize is a precious "dune buggy" type car. Instead of selling it and dividing the proceeds, the two play it in a gastronomic endurance contest, interrupted at the most beautiful by a gang of hooligan motorcyclists who upset the room where the challenge is taking place.
notes: Action comedy among the most successful (and certainly among the most famous) of the famous couple Spencer-Hill. Directed a little flat and fistfights in series, but with an unprecedented verve. In the long run, one remembers above all the song: "Dune buggy" by the De Angelis brothers.

title: The Final Countdown
actors: Kirk Douglas, Martin Sheen, Katharine Ross, James Farentino
description: On December 7, 1980, the American aircraft carrier Nimitz - participating in a military operation in the Pacific - is surprised by a magnetic storm. When the clear sky returns, the Nimitz resumes navigation, the captain and crew discover that the storm has made them regress over time, bringing them on the eve of the attack on Pearl Harbor ...
notes: Film inspired by one of the classic themes of science fiction literature: time travel. Excellent script and direction, good performance of the actors. But the strong point is the spectacularity rate, especially in the sequences in which ships and planes are the absolute protagonists.

title: La gueule de l'autre
actors: Michel Serrault, Jean Poiret, George Geret, Curd Jürgens
description: Mr Perrin is head of a large party, but during the election campaign he learns that a certain Richard Krauss, a criminal, has escaped and intends to kill all the accomplices of a dirty deal consumed in Gibuti. Among the accomplices there is also the Hon. Perrin who, who died of fear, pretends to be sick, then runs away, hides, disguises himself and, in public events, has a failed cousin, who resembles him perfectly, replaced by the cousin Brossard. Funny comedy that has the merit of not taking advantage of the easy rough situations. Serrault plays with seriousness and comedy the two characters of Perrin and Brossard.

title: Heaven Help Us
actors: Donald Sutherland, Mary Stuart Masterson, Wallace Shawn, Patrick Dempsey
description: The story is set in the "fabulous" Sixties, in Brooklyn, in a Catholic school attended by five good-natured friends who are intolerant of the rigid discipline that regulates the life of the community. Small and large dramas, laughter and moving encounters mark the first explorations of the world of adults, the discovery of wine, women and music.
notes: Discreet debut film by screenwriter Charles Purpura and director Michael Dinner who then returned behind the camera the following year with the certainly not memorable "A freaked cop". Tasty Shawn's "cameo" as a dancing priest.

title: Tutti giù per terra
actors: Valerio Mastandrea, Benedetta Mazzini, Carlo Monni, Gianluca Gobbi
description: Walter is twenty-two years old and reluctantly returned to his family in Turin, after spending his adolescence in Rome with his aunt Caterina. Endowed with ferocious irony, but without work, without money and above all without any prospects, he does nothing but hang around the streets of the center. Observe the hated symbols of wealth, fantasizing about a love story worth living.
notes: Ferrario directs a grotesque, acidic and finally non-pimping comedy with a modern (but not fashionable) style.

title: Lone Star
actors: Kris Kristofferson, Chris Cooper, Elizabeth Peña, Matthew McConaughey, Stephen Mendillo, Oni Faida Lampley, Miriam Colon, Jeff Monahan, Joe Morton, LaTanya Richardson, Ron Canada, Eddie Robinson, Chandra Wilson
description: Two US Army sergeants stationed at the military base in Frontera, a city on the Mexican border, find a dead body and a sheriff's badge in an abandoned firing range while they are not on duty. The investigation is being conducted by Sam Deeds, son of the late legendary lawman Buddy. The dead man is Charlie Wade, a corrupt sheriff, forced to leave the city where Sam's father worked.
notes: It has the nostalgic step of the western, the tension of the thriller, the melancholy of a reconnaissance among ancient family dilemmas: all together weave a fresco of America today.

title: Il principe di Homburg
actors: Andrea Di Stefano, Barbora Bobulova, Toni Bertorelli, Anita Laurenzi
description: Prince Friederich Arthur von Homburg, a cavalry officer, launches his squadron into battle before the agreed time, thus breaking the orders he had been given. Despite the victory achieved, the officer is sentenced to death. Faced with the death sentence, the prince, in terror, is first helped by the beautiful Natalia, but then refuses the pardon.
notes: Bellocchio turns to a text by Heinrich von Kleist, in costume, immersed in a rarefaction out of time. It does not modify the text, but brings out its "absolute" qualities, its moral and political dilemmas. The tension, suspended between the dreamlike fictional fantasy and the dry rationality of reality, devours the film, built in an ineluctable crescendo. An absolutely non-formalist work (with a young and inexperienced protagonist), but which possesses formal qualities rare in Italian cinema.

title: Les princes
actors: Gérard Darmon, Muse Dalbray, Céline Militon, Concha Tavora
description: The gypsy Nara lives with his old mother and little daughter on the outskirts of a French city. He considers himself integrated into society because he makes a living doing humble jobs, unlike his mother. The woman in the family is the guardian of nomadic traditions while Zorka, the little girl, dreams of becoming an established veterinarian. Nara, who loves her daughter dearly, prevents her mother Miralda from seeing her. The latter was repudiated by the man, because, on the advice of a social worker, he dared to use contraceptives.
notes: Newcomer Gatlif, who plays the character of Leo, gives a moralistic picture of the life of the gypsies.

title: Tragico ritorno
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Franca Marzi, Doris Duranti, Dante Maggio
description: After eight years of imprisonment, during which he has lost all contact with his family, Marco returns to Italy. In a refugee camp, the man meets his wife Giovanna and their son Bruno. The woman, believing him dead, has in the meantime rebuilt a life and the child does not recognize him. Desperate Marco decides to kill himself. He was saved by the intervention of Elisa, who lives with her elderly father in a bathhouse. Marco goes to the city where he is hosted by Nicola, a fellow prisoner, and his mistress. The two friends would like to emigrate, but to get the money they begin to commit robberies.
notes: Neorealist drama that slips into the cartoon, with a very young Mastroianni.

title: Il coltello di ghiaccio
actors: Carroll Baker, Alan Scott, Evelyn Stewart, Eduardo Fajardo
description: Jenny, a young pop singer who has just returned from a tour, is welcomed at the Montseigny station by her cousin Martha who has been mute for fifteen years due to trauma suffered in a train accident. The two girls arrive at their uncle's house where a series of inexplicable murders begins. The first victim is Jenny, who is soon joined by the housekeeper and little Cristina. Commissioner Duran investigates, flanked by the ambiguous Dr. Lawrence, friend of Martha, who in turn fears of ending up in the assassin's sights. Doing a French noir calling yourself Umberto Lenzi instead of Duvivier or Becker is like playing golf without clubs.

title: When You Remember Me
actors: Fred Savage, Ellen Burstyn, Kevin Spacey
description: A young man suffering from muscle dystrophy, victim of his condition, must fight every day to undergo re -education and thus try to return to a life just remotely normal. Unfortunately he is forced to clash with the thousand concerns that the life of disabled people involves and to confront himself continuously with sick people who have lost the desire to fight. His example becomes a warning for everyone and lesson of great humanity.
notes: The film reconstructs Michael Patrick Smith's story, who told his sad odyssey in a successful book. For an incurable disease it is the only valid "therapy".

title: The Abduction
actors: Victoria Principal, Robert Hays, Christopher Lawford, William Greenblatt
description: Kate Finley married a violent and psychically ill man, but she didn't know it. Life as a couple therefore soon becomes a hell whose remedy can only be one: a quick sentence of legal separation. Having achieved her purpose, Kate hopes that she has finally closed that ugly chapter of her existence, but her husband is not willing to get out of the way so easily. In fact, the man, who cannot bear the idea of ??continuing to live without her, first begins to harass his ex-wife and then even goes so far as to kidnap her ...
notes: The film, which stars Victoria Principal and is based on a real story, does not stray from the average of those seen on television in all these years.

title: Ju Dou
actors: Li Wei, Gong Li, Li Baotian, Zhang Yi, Zhen Jian, Niu Xingli
description: In rural China in the 1920s, the beautiful Ju Dou (Gong), wife of an old and helpless dyer, falls in love with his nephew, a boy in the laundry. The man, who does not forgive her for not being able to give him children, when he learns that his wife is pregnant goes on a rampage. The child will still be born and, once grown, will avenge the honor of his real parents. The film is part of a female trilogy (with "Red Sorghum" and "Red Lanterns"). Yimou's work, taken from the short story "Fuxi fuxi" by Liu Heng, also author of the screenplay, was opposed by the Chinese authorities who also imposed a co-director to check the orthodoxy of the product.

title: O. C. & Stiggs
actors: Daniel H. Jenkins, Neil Barry, Paul Dooley, Dennis Hopper
description: Oliver, known by all as O. C., and Stiggs are two boys, linked by a deep friendship, who live in a small town in Arizona. The first lives with his old grandfather who, reduced to poverty by Randal Schwab, a bad insurer, is forced to be hospitalized in a hospice. For this reason the man is hated by the two boys who persecute his strange family in a thousand ways.
notes: Comedy too rambling, but with a surreal vein typical of Altman (just think of "M.A.S.H."). Tasty parody of "Apocalypse Now" with Hopper who is a veteran from Vietnam. Shot in 1985 and immediately released on videotape, it appeared in theaters a few years later.

title: Shoot-out at Medicine Bend
actors: Randolph Scott, James Craig, Angie Dickinson, David Crayne
description: Captain Devlin together with his two inseparable friends, Sergeant Maitland and Private Clegg, set out for his brother's distant farm, with the intention of settling there. When the three arrive at the town, an attack by the Indians is underway. Settlers defending themselves with defective weapons and ammunition must enlist the help of the three men. Responsible for the attack is Ep Clark, who sold the inefficient weapons. The man arouses the wrath of Devlin, who lost his brother in the attack. Low-cost traditional Western, with a genre icon like Randolph Scott.

title: Il mammasantissima
actors: Mario Merola, Malisa Longo, Biagio Pelligra, Nunzio Gallo
description: Don Vincenzo Tramontano is a smuggler, but a gentleman and, as such, respected by all. He has two enemies, smugglers like him, but without moral codes: the "lawyer" and Don Salvatore. After unsuccessfully trying to steal the dominance of the "market" from him, they kidnap and kill his daughter forcing him to come out into the open. Don Vincenzo, however, manages to get them out and then surrenders himself to the law. Neapolitan drama with Mario Merola. Beyond any aesthetic evaluation.

title: Roma bene
actors: Senta Berger, Vittorio Caprioli, Nino Manfredi, Michèle Mercier
description: Characters in sight of the aristocracy, finance, politics and clergy revolve around the living room of the Duchess Silvia Santi, wife of the industrialist Giorgio. The penniless Baron De Vittis, after having stolen and swallowed a jewel, is forced to return it. The Duchess, in order to extort three hundred million from her husband, organizes a fake kidnapping. Almost everyone will die at sea during a tragic cruise, while an overzealous commissioner will be silenced with a promotion. In the seventies Lizzani, in the wake of the "Italian-style police", dedicated a cycle of films to the social and political malaise of large cities, with mixed results, as in this case.

title: A Kidnapping in the Family
actors: Kate Jackson, Tracey Gold, Jeff Yagher, Linden Banks, Robert Bishop
description: Sarah, divorced young and beautiful, loves to have fun. But when rumors spread about her engagement to a drug dealer, her mother DeDe decides to steal her son Kyle, asking for custody. The fight between the two women comes to a halt when Sarah marries Jack Taylor, a computer programmer, mainly to prove that the years of the "sweet life" are over. But DeDe suddenly disappears with the baby. In fact, the little boy spoke to his grandmother about strange rites carried out in a sort of "church of evil" in which his mother also took part ... Assorted family conflicts for a product of origin and television packaging.

title: L'alibi
directors: Luciano Lucignani, Vittorio Gassman, Adolfo Celi
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Adolfo Celi, Tina Aumont, Franco Giacobini
description: Vittorio, Adolfo and Luciano have been friends since they attended the Academy of Dramatic Art. Then their paths divided: Adolfo left for Brazil, Vittorio became a star of cinema and theater, Luciano, director and playwright, turned to politics. Only the illness of another friend, Luca, causes them to find themselves again.
