notes: An openly autobiographical film for two "sacred monsters" of the scene and one of their assiduous collaborators.

title: Liar Liar
actors: Jim Carrey, Jennifer Tilly, Maura Tierney, Justin Cooper, Swoosie Kurtz, Amanda Donohoe
description: Fletcher Reede is a top lawyer. For him the facts do not count for anything, the important thing is that the final plea comes straight to the goal even at the cost of lying. The hard part comes when his son forces him to tell the truth for a whole day.
notes: Jim Carrey as the films go by tries to legitimize Jerry Lewis's cumbersome legacy. His is one hundred percent bodily comedy: spineless cartoon to be elasticized or deformed according to needs; unbearable when left too free; irresistible when supported by a story that is not a mere pretext, by a winning idea that enhances its indisputable qualities. Accomplice a Tom Shaydac in perfect shape (fresh from the funny "The Nutty Professor"), the film thrives on a functional idea for its protagonist: what would happen if a cynical and cheating lawyer suffered such a spell as to force him - for twenty-four hours - to the truth, nothing but the truth? At least half an hour of hilarious gags.

title: The Evening Star
actors: Shirley MacLaine, Bill Paxton, Juliette Lewis, Marion Ross
description: Fourteen years have passed and Aurora Greenway hasn't changed at all. After the death of her daughter Emma, ??the woman tried to raise her grandchildren in that loving, if a bit stifling way, of her own. Now that the kids have grown up, they can't wait to free themselves from their dictator. Followed fourteen years after "Desire for tenderness", MacLaine's skill and the courage with which she disguises herself as a Texan widow (among curls, ruffles and absurd colors) are no longer enough, the awaited "appearance" of ex-boyfriend Jack Nicholson and the quiet presence of Ben Johnson (glory of Ford and Peckinpah, who died in 1996). The film, directed by the writer of "Steel Flowers" and "The First Wives Club", only at the end does he decide to step on the pedal of shameless emotion. But now the opportunity is gone.

title: Marvin's Room
actors: Leonardo DiCaprio, Diane Keaton, Meryl Streep, Robert De Niro
description: Bessie and Lee are two sisters, one is a hairdresser in Ohio, she has two children, one of them with severe mental illness; the other is a spinster who lives in Florida and has been looking after her sick father for twenty years and a nutty aunt who only sees television. The two have not spun for years and to find each other they do not rely on a television program: a doctor takes care of precepting the family. In fact, Bessie has leukemia and is looking for a compatible bone marrow.
notes: First work by Miramax, and then Disney, which slips into the very unlucky story a spottone of its playground in Orlando. To say hidden advertising is an understatement.

title: Praying Mantis
actors: Jane Seymour, Barry Bostwick, Chad Allen, Frances Fisher, Colby Chester
description: A charming and beautiful woman has the peculiarity of killing her husband on their wedding night. His criminal exploits arouse the ire of public opinion and the police, who begin the investigation. But precautions are useless, given that the fearsome widow reaches the fourth murder. At this point the sister-in-law of the alleged fifth victim enters the scene, who begins to doubt the honesty of the unknown woman. Jane Seymour, known in Italy for having given her face to the "Lady of the West", manages to give the best of herself even in these films for television. It is a pity that the rather dull direction is not up to par.

title: Absolute Power
actors: Gene Hackman, Clint Eastwood, Laura Linney, Scott Glenn, E.G. Marshall, Ed Harris, Judy Davis, Dennis Haysbert
description: An old thief, an amateur of painting and music, decides to vanish with the loot despite being the only witness to an "excellent" crime, involving an old president of the United States who is a criminal. The mature secret service agent who must hunt down the thief, but can't come to terms with his sense of justice.
notes: The new film directed and starring Eastwood is the story of a world of old men, old people without families, who also discover themselves, in front of the voracious mechanisms of power, without history. It is the nightmare of the "Unforgiven" transported to the present day, where the "sheriff" Hackman and the "gunslinger" Eastwood still face each other, even if they never meet here. It is a political thriller, which Eastwood has the intelligence to lighten with irony, with a moment of pure, heartfelt romanticism, with the lightness of his interpretation, suspended between cynicism and melancholy.

title: Guy
actors: Vincent D'Onofrio, Kimber Riddle, Lucy Liu, John F. O'Donohue
description: A young aspiring director wanders the streets in the hope (Hope Davis is called the girl who "impersonates" the camera) to find someone willing to be vivisected for a few weeks in order to build a movie on it. He finds it in Guy (how to say: a "type"), a young boy who clumsily traffics in used cars on behalf of an obnoxious exporter, engaged to Gail, who in turn is Guy's secret lover. Who lives a normal relationship with Veronica quietly. The peculiarity of the film directed by the author of "Attenti al thief!" and "Frankie of the stars" is all in subjective: we will never see the face of the "prying eye" if not in the surprise ending. The gimmick is not new and frequents the theories of camera attraction. Which can become a weapon, a dangerous accomplice, a blanket of Linus, a morbid projection, a filter for the inability to make direct contact. Not surprisingly, in the credits, the protagonist claims warmth and, at the same time, is afraid of being turned off.

title: Cuba Libre. Velocipedi ai Tropici
actors: David Riondino, Sabina Guzzanti, Antonio Catania, Dario Cassini, Remo Remotti
description: On the plane that is flying from Italy to Havana there are not the usual tourists by chance and sex. The seats are occupied, on the other hand, by a ramshackle film crew with high ambitions: to make in Cuba the remake of "Bicycle Thieves", a masterpiece of Italian neorealism; by an elderly poet followed like a shadow by a busty assistant; and by a volunteer with the myth of Che, whose double appears in the streets of the Cuban capital. The storyteller David Riondino's debut behind the camera, fortunately, takes and makes fun of himself, affectionately dismantling all the common "places" on the beloved island of Fidel. And so Guevara appears in the form of a clone, a crafty profiteer of charismatic legend, while the presumed desire for authorship of the director who wants to emulate De Sica crushes under the blows of a caricature of the Author with a pensive "maudit" style hat, in reality, of the Nothing. A hiccup and improvised opera crossed, however, by a fresh and free breeze.

title: Lovest
actors: Giulio Base, Gian Marco Tognazzi, Alessandro Gassmann, Mariangela Fremura, Barbara De Pace
description: Two Roman guys suddenly decide to leave for America. The occasion is given by a job offer, the deepest reason is to change the air, to see if the American myth is still able to make the latest generation dream. Among occasional works, rental machines, boccaccesca adventures or almost (but always with Italians), glimpses of Monument Valley and Grand Canyon, the two will understand that their future is elsewhere.
notes: Second chapter (after "Lest") of a tetralogy that Giulio Base has decided to write, direct and interpret. The style is fragmentary and too many are the unresolved moments.

title: Capitaine Conan
actors: Philippe Torreton, Samuel Le Bihan, Claude Rich
description: At the end of 1918 the French army stationed in Bulgaria tries to "make war", but the dirty dozen led by Conan thinks to win it. A "barbarian" compared to the stalking officers, a volcano that kills enemies with a knife, capable of driving ugly, dirty and evil ex-convicts, but soaked up to their necks with courage.
notes: A very hard film by Tavernier, which reflects on the double standard of war, which presupposes the most brutal murders only to mask them with various moral justifications. The character of Conan is exemplary, protagonist of an ambiguous story inspired by real events.

title: The Associate
actors: Whoopi Goldberg, Dianne Wiest, Eli Wallach, Tim Daly, Bebe Neuwirth
description: Laurel Ayres is a Wall Street financial analyst: she is good, hardworking, efficient, but unfortunately ... she is a woman. Snatched from a well-deserved promotion by a young collaborator, she decides to go on her own: but despite her brilliant qualities, clients don't want to entrust their money to a woman. So he decides to invent a male partner ...
notes: The happy ending of this all-female comedy - which does not skimp on the male-dominated universe of Wall Street, oscillating between the comic vis of _Achair for two_ and _Jerry Maguire_'s desire to make it big - is ensured by an excellent Whoopi Goldberg, well supported by a classy shoulder like Dianne Wiest.

title: Il caricatore
directors: Eugenio Cappuccio, Massimo Gaudioso, Fabio Nunziata
actors: Eugenio Cappuccio, Massimo Gaudioso, Fabio Nunziata, Gianluca Arcopinto
description: The passion for cinema is so great, the means are very few (only one magazine, that is, a box of film). It is the reality against which the three boys who are serious about making their life dream come true. But the script work goes on for a long time, the producer Arcopinto appears enigmatic on his racing bike and forces them to play football, there is no certainty of the future. Yet, in the end, the film will be made. The three directors-protagonists limit themselves to staging one of the many true events of Italian cinema today, accentuating the grotesque aspects. It turns out a quick fun and cool movie. Dedicated to Tanio Boccia (director of Z series peplum), originating from a short film awarded in Locarno. The football match that pits two true independent film producers (Arcopinto and Procacci) and sees aspiring directors lined up with commitment is hilarious, as is self-segregation to write a story that allows you to find the money.

title: Toward the Unknown
actors: William Holden, Lloyd Nolan, Virginia Leith, Charles McGraw
description: Major Lincoln Bond, released from prison, returns to Edwards Airport and asks General Banner to be readmitted as a test pilot. To get what he wants he asks his friend, Colonel McKee, to support his request, which in fact is accepted. While Bond is testing an X-20, he finds a defect in the left wing of the aircraft. His report, however, provokes the manufacturer's protests. Some time passes and an aircraft of the same type happens to fall causing the pilot's death.
notes: A film that is too banal and devoid of nuances, a "minor" of Le Roy.

title: Crime Wave
actors: Sterling Hayden, Gene Nelson, Phillis Kirk, Charles Bronson
description: Three escapees carry out a robbery and kill a police officer. Doc Penny, who is part of the trio and who was seriously injured, seeks asylum from Steve, his former prison partner. The man has cut ties with the past, he lives quietly and honestly with his wife Ellen. At first Steve would like to put him at the door, but fearing reprisals, he decides to welcome the wounded man, who, however, dies shortly after. The police don't believe what Steve says and accuse him of being complicit in the robbery.

title: James and the Giant Peach
actors: Paul Terry, Pete Postlethwaite, Joanna Lumley, Miriam Margolyes
description: James, after tragically losing his parents, is raised by two horrible aunts, who hate insects and who treat him worse than Cinderella. Escaped from their clutches, he sets out on a magical and gigantic fishing with some insects as travel companions, including a loving spider, and after many adventures he finally arrives in New York, the destination of a journey that had been promised to him by his beloved father.
notes: The director of "Nightmare Before Christmas" gives an encore, again with Tim Burton as producer. The film continues to combine the traditional "stop motion" animation technique with computer generated CGI images. Delicate and intelligent, from a story by Roald Dahl.

title: He Liu
actors: Lee Kang-sheng, Miao Tien, Lu Hsiao-ling, Chen Shiang-chyi
description: A young man acts as a stunt double in a film directed by director Ann Hui (in the part of herself). Immersion in the fetid waters of the Tanshui River leaves him with an annoying stiff neck. While the boy goes from doctor to doctor in search of a remedy he cannot find, the father pursues pleasure in saunas frequented by homosexuals and the mother tries to console herself with an apathetic lover.
notes: Tsai Ming-liang ("The Hole") is confirmed as one of the most important directors of the nineties. His is a compelling x-ray of a decaying universe dominated by malaise, fear and desire.

title: Scanner Cop
actors: Daniel Quinn, Darlanne Fluegel, Richard Grove, Mark Rolston, Richard Lynch
description: A boy (Quinn) who, since childhood, has manifested paranormal abilities and who has developed incredible telepathic powers (he is a scanner), joins the police force. Once assigned to a ward, the man is given the task of hunting down a renegade scientist, who leads people to kill police officers. The fight proves to be tough and difficult, especially when the two scanners are armed against each other. Pierre David's debut feature, with frequent narrative lapses and here and there even logical ones, does not prove to be different from the other films in the series.

title: Howards of Virginia
actors: Martha Scott, Cary Grant, Cedric Hardwicke, Alan Marshal, Richard Carlson
description: We are in 1760, in America, during the colonial wars that saw the clashes between the inhabitants of Virginia and their oppressors. The rude and fiery farm owner (Grant), married to the aristocrat Marsha, decides to go to war. Domestic conflicts, class struggles and sentimental problems complicate the story. Acceptable film for the interpretation of Cary Grant, but which shows some flaws, especially in terms of direction.

title: Last of the Dogmen
actors: Tom Berenger, Barbara Hershey, Andrew Miller
description: Lewis Gates (Tom Berenger) hunter famous for his tracking prowess is hired to track down three dangerous escapees who have escaped into the rugged mountainous area of ??Montana. When the fugitives are found killed, Gates grapples with a mystery. Accompanied by passionate Native American anthropologist Lillian Sloane (Barbara Hershey), Gates ventures into the mountains and discovers an isolated village inhabited by a tribe of natives who escaped the massacres of white settlers a century earlier. After being captured by the Native American warriors, the two gradually begin to be accepted into the tribe, but when Sheriff Deegan leads a mountain joke on the trail of the missing, Gates and Sloane must prevent the tribe from being slaughtered a second time.

title: Sur un arbre perché
actors: Louis De Funès, Geraldine Chaplin, Paul Préboist, Franco Volpi
description: A dishonest industrialist, returning to France from Italy, takes a hitchhiker and a beautiful stranded motorist into his car. In an accident, the car of the three ends up off the road, on a tree poised on a cliff overlooking the sea. How will they manage?

title: Caveman
actors: Ringo Starr, Barbara Bach, Dennis Quaid, Shelley Long
description: In the Stone Age, you know, the law of the strongest was in force. Atuk is weak and thin, but he has one more weapon than the other cavemen: intelligence. Thanks to which he puts himself in charge of some stragglers and spreads his "inventions" among them: how to walk standing erect even on all fours, use and reproduce fire and other similar things. Soon, Atuk comes into conflict with Tonda, the rough and violent leader of the tribe he comes from, who tries to subdue him by force. Atuk's wit will prevail in this case too, and victory is matched by the love of the beautiful woman of the country ...
notes: Serie B of the most beautiful water, with the former "Fab Four" Ringo Starr and his wife Barbara Bach.

title: Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex But Were Afraid to Ask
actors: Woody Allen, Lynn Redgrave, John Carradine
description: Woody Allen, borrowing the title of a famous book by Dr. David Reuben published in the years of the sexual revolution, answers seven questions about sex in his own way. A queen with a chastity belt is seduced; the love between a psychologist and a sheep; the pleasure of dangerous embraces; the story of a non-homosexual transvestite; the conflicts over food between a rabbi and his pork-loving wife; the big tit squirting milk and sperm ready for the big journey ... Performance, with some flaws, by the eclectic Allen who plays with film styles. Among his least successful things.

title: Scandal
actors: John Hurt, Joanne Whalley, Ian McKellen
description: London, 1959: Dr. Stephen Ward discovers the charming 17-year-old Christine Keeler in a third-rate club. Led by Ward, Christine establishes friendships and relationships in high society: above all Ivanov, a Soviet diplomat, and John Profumo, a minister of war, are very sensitive to his graces. Arrested, the girl spreads spicy revelations: Profumo must abandon the ministry and give up government and resign.
notes: Caton-Jones recalls a famous scandal which, at the dawn of "swinging London", caused a sensation around the world. The historical reconstruction is good, the staging cold. Hurt, slimy and sneaky, is flawless.

title: Uno a me, uno a te, uno a Raffaele
actors: Eliana Miglio, Maria Vittoria Arenillas, Lucia Gardin, Daniele Formica
description: An American independent director comes to Italy to shoot a film. But inconveniences and obstacles stand in the way at every step. These are the years in which "Tangentopoli" rages and the golden rule of officials and collaborators is "one (bribe) to you, one to me, one to Raffaele".
notes: The story is real: Jon Jost ("All the Vermeers of New York") was really involved, a few years ago, in a similar project, which ended with the inevitable legal consequences. His gaze focuses above all on the desire, for us Italians unconfessable, to absolve ourselves of the rampant malpractice in the awareness that, even for the most upright people, there is always the moment when "one hand washes the other".

title: Demon Knight
actors: Billy Zane, William Sadler
description: The Collector (Billy Zane) is perpetually in pursuit of Brayker, a man who is able, with his powers, to stop the advance of the forces of Evil. Its power is linked to the possession of an ancient key on which many have set their eyes, including the Collector. To obtain it, the latter summons a macabre array of corpses from the afterlife to terrorize the guests of a dilapidated hotel. Thus begins a bloody battle.
notes: From a rib of the TV series "Tales from the Crypt", inspired by horror comics, a splatter that manages to sustain the balance between funny moments and terrifying moments.

title: Canadian Bacon
actors: John Candy, Rhea Perlman, Alan Alda, Kevin Pollak, Rip Torn
description: After the fall of the Wall and the end of the Cold War, the United States lost its traditional historical enemy, the Soviet Union that Reagan called "The Empire of Evil". In the near future, it is imagined that a new president of the United States is frantically searching for a new "enemy" to be fed to public opinion. He must in fact justify to public opinion the missile factories he had built for purely lobbying reasons. Directed by the director of "Roger & Me", the film, one of John Candy's latest interpretations, is a satirical comedy of a good standard, even if here and there there are some drops in tone.

title: Hamlet
actors: Kenneth Branagh, Julie Christie, Billy Crystal, Gérard Depardieu, Kate Winslet
description: On the ramparts of Elsinore, Hamlet sees the ghost of his father appear, who reveals to him that he was murdered by his brother Claudio, in agreement with the queen, mother of Hamlet. The young prince simulates madness to fine-tune his revenge. To do this he abandons his girlfriend Ofelia, who goes mad. During a duel with Laertes, Ophelia's brother, Hamlet is wounded by a poisoned sword.
notes: Branagh said he wanted to make a four-hour Hamlet because the full version makes it easier to understand the text (but he edited a two-hour one so as not to scare exhibitors and the public). The director risks getting lost in the sea of ??possibilities offered by the text, but he certainly succeeds in what seems to be his main objective: to demonstrate that Shakspeare in the cinema can have a strong popular and spectacular impact. Therefore, if some passages are unpopular and static (the first dialogue between Marcello and Orazio) and others excessive (the apparition of the ghost, the didactic flashbacks), in the context of the four hours the operation acquires a curious impact, as d ' total immersion in a darkened and very lucid tragic universe and in a world of cinematographic references. Particles for Charlton Heston, Jack Lemmon, John Gielgud, Billy Crystal, Gérard Depardieu and many others.

title: Scanners III - The Takeover
actors: Liliana Komorowska, Valerie Valois, Daniel Pilon, Claire Cellucci
description: A young woman, whose task is to analyze the television images, to endure the fatigue of her work, begins to use drugs. Since then she has been invested with extraordinary telekinetic powers. This strength greater than her leads her to stain herself with horrible crimes, including that of her own father, and to insinuate itself into the minds of young couch potatoes.
notes: Canadian Christian Duguay, who had previously directed "Scanners 2", is reluctantly putting his hand to this third episode. The actors, including Daniel Pillon interpreter of "Paths" and many other TV series, do their best, but the results are really poor.

title: Tarantella napoletana
actors: Dino Curcio, Clara Bindi, Clara Crispo, Renato Di Napoli, Mario Frera, Rosita Pisano, Giacomo Furia, Dino Valdi, Nunzio Gallo
description: The witty and crafty Pulcinella presents and comments on the various scenes of "Neapolitan Tarantella", the famous Neapolitan magazine, from which this film is based. On the screen there is a colorful series of paintings, sets and scenes aimed at illustrating the costumes of the Neapolitan city. The most popular songs, folk dances, specks and views make us enter a world that no longer exists. The discontinuity and lack of a connection between the various paintings are detrimental to the film, despite the presence of Pulcinella acting as a glue, for better or for worse. However, Mastrocinque's work remains a good testimony.

title: La baraonda - Passioni popolari
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Edy Angelillo, Wanda Aschel Bacciella, Marisa Bonati, Enrico Grazioli
description: Federico Salvi is a sports doctor on duty at the Six Days Cycling which is taking place at the Palasport in Milan. During the demonstration he is stalked by Erminia, a girl from Romagna, who a couple of years earlier had had a flirtation with him. The man not only does not remember having had that adventure, but he refuses to recognize the child born of the relationship. Erminia, exasperated by the situation, decides to leave with the baby. Vancini sketches a thin story without ever getting to deepen it.

title: L'isola degli uomini pesce
actors: Barbara Bach, Claudio Cassinelli, Richard Johnson, Joseph Cotten
description: Lieutenant Claude De Ros, after the sinking of the ship bound for Cayenne with a load of deportees, luckily lands with some of them on an unknown island. As they wander around in search of food, Claude and two surviving inmates end up as prisoners of Edmond Rackham. He lives in a lonely villa where he is fully served by beefy black men and by Shakiva, a Haitian who, when not trafficking with witchcraft, has the task of keeping an eye on Amanda, the daughter of Professor Marvin. He was commissioned to create amphibious men capable of recovering the treasure of the mythical Atlantis. Adventure film that looks more like an obvious cartoon.

title: Il mercenario
actors: Franco Nero, Tony Musante, Franco Giacobini, Jack Palance, Giovanna Ralli
description: Paco Roman, to fight against the troops called by the owner of a mine against which he and his family had rebelled, hires the mercenary Sergheij Kowalski, known as "the Pole", who manages to repel and defeat the attackers. The two make a pact: for two hundred dollars a day, Sergheij will help Paco make the revolution. During one of their exploits, to tell the truth, more thieving than revolutionary, a woman, Colomba, joins them. Falling in love with Paco, the woman warns him of Kowalski's greed. From a subject by Franco Solinas, a Latin-revolutionary spaghetti western according to fashion. The music is by Ennio Morricone.

title: Savrseni krug
actors: Mustafa Nadarevic, Almedin Leleta, Almir Podgorica, Josip Pejakovic
description: Adis and Kerim are two Sarajevo children aged seven and nine. They found refuge by chance in the house of Hamza, a poet, who remained only after his wife and daughter decided to leave Sarajevo. Adis and her brother, one of the two is deaf and dumb, have lost their family with the exception of Aïcha, an aunt who has fled to Germany. Hamza does not feel like abandoning Adis and Kerim, on the contrary he undertakes to find the woman. Day after day, the poet and the children learn to live together, to discover and love each other. After a long search, Hamza finally gets news of his aunt and prepares to leave, but reaching the airport is not an easy task ... "Before us there is darkness": it is with this chilling phrase that Ademir Kenovic's film ends. , shot on the streets of Sarajevo during the recent conflict.

title: Deadly Pursuits
actors: Tori Spelling, Patrick Muldoon, Richard Belzer, Mitchell Laurance
description: A rich industrialist has ended up in the crosshairs of organized crime that has already murdered his wife and daughter because of a "mischief". The industrialist is now left with the only son, a brilliant university student. It is logical that the boy is over guarded, but the criminals have found his weakness: naivety. So they hire a killer in a skirt to seduce and then kill the young man. The girl thus begins her "work", but has not dealt with the unpredictability of the heart so much that she ends up really falling in love with her intended victim. How will he get out of the impasse? Unlikely accomplishment of an equally unlikely accomplishment.

title: Il padre di famiglia
actors: Nino Manfredi, Leslie Caron, Claudine Auger, Ugo Tognazzi, Mario Carotenuto, Antonella Della Porta, Evi Maltagliati, Marisa Solinas, Sergio Tofano, Elsa Vazzoler, Giampiero Albertini, Valerio degli Abbati, Raoul Grassilli, Gino Pernice
description: Two young urban planners, Marco and Paola, meet in Rome in the early postwar years. They marry with the commitment to dedicate themselves to the defense of the city from architectural destruction. Although the agreements were not these, the two have four children in the world. The problems related to modern education force Paola to abandon her job and thus make a first renunciation. Over the years Marco, exhausted by family obligations, seeks escape with another woman.
notes: Loy and the screenwriter Maccari try to tell the transformation and the crisis of the family, just one step away from the moment when the dispute broke out. But the film remains an easy comedy, albeit clever and well written. The role of Tognazzi was offered to Totò, who died after shooting the first scenes (those of a funeral).

title: Gay Purr-ee
description: Musetta is a kitten who lives in a village in Provence. Tired of the quiet country life, she leaves her lover Giallone and leaves for Paris where she experiences a series of adventures. But in the meantime Giallone ... It's not Disney, but this is a merit. Songs by Judy Garland.

title: The Cover Girl Murders
actors: Lee Majors, Jennifer O'Neill, Adrian Paul, Beverly Johnson
description: The publishing crisis has also hit "Image magazine", which is on the verge of bankruptcy. Rex Kingman (Lee Majors) in a desperate attempt to revive the publication's fortunes, convinces ex-lover Kate (Jennifer O'Neill) to lead a group of stunning models on their way to a tropical island. The girls are on their way to that paradise to do a photo shoot. After a few days one of the models is found brutally killed. It is only the beginning of a series of murders that forces crews and models, trapped on the island, to discover the killer in order to survive. The marine setting is reminiscent of the television series "Baywatch" and, in terms of the psychology of the characters, we are not too far from it. The presence of Lee Major, Farrah Fawcett's ex-husband, can only confirm the weakness of the film.

title: Comand decision
actors: Clark Gable, Walter Pidgeon, Van Johnson
description: Dennis, a young air force general, orders a series of daytime bombings on Germany, but his forces suffer heavy losses. For this he is attacked by the press and ends up under investigation. He is ordered to suspend operations, but Dennis rebels and is replaced by the parigrade Carnet. He is forced by the situation to accept Dennis' ideas and carry out his plans. Sam Wood's latest film is an almost embarrassing hymn to the idea of ??total war advocated by some generals during the last conflict.

title: Operation Pacific
actors: John Wayne, Patricia Neal, Ward Bond, Scott Forbes, Philip Carey
description: The "thunder shark" is a submarine in action in the Pacific against the Japanese; during an action, the commander loses his life due to an engine failure. He is succeeded by the second officer, immediately suspected of having let his predecessor die. Eventually he clarifies his position and also makes peace with his wife. The "Duke" John Wayne in a film after all of routine, in which he is paired with another "Fordian" doc: Ward Bond.

title: Night of the Twisters
actors: John Schneider, Devon Sawa, Lori Hallier, Amos Crawley, Laura Bertram
description: Jack Hatch lives in a small town in the Midwest of the United States with his wife, stepson, and a recently born baby. His business is going badly and his relationship with his stepson, Dan, is certainly not the best. Things get worse when the two face a series of catastrophic tornadoes that hit the area together. Dan and his younger brother plan to take refuge in the basement of the house to escape the devastation. The boy then sets out to search for the missing members of the family, thus earning the respect of his stepfather. The Timothy Bond film, shot in 1995, preceded the trend, still in progress, to bring to light the catastrophic genre so fashionable in the 1970s. We certainly did not feel the need.

title: Cutting Class
actors: Donovan Leitch, Jill Schoelen, Brad Pitt, Roddy McDowall, Martin Mull
description: Brian is a pissable boy who, after having left a psychiatric hospital for murdering his father, returns to school. Unfortunately his sick mind has not had any benefit from the treatment, in fact as soon as he comes out he decides to take revenge on the person who, according to him, had hurt him. The person in question is Carson, Paula's father, a girl Brian likes very much. The man is also the district attorney who sentenced him to be interned in the psychiatric hospital.
notes: Very unlikely psychopathological thriller that also features, in the cast, a young and unknown Brad Pitt.

title: Bello di mamma
actors: Philippe Leroy, Carmen Scarpitta, Jenny Tamburi, Carole André
description: Mimì, Duke of Trinacria, is in great difficulty and it is certainly not his family who can help him. The father, Duke William, believes himself to be a stallion and threatens Rosaria, wife of the lawyer Ciccio. The Duchess Esmeralda, William's wife and Mimì's mother, is obsessed with the idea that the future head of the Trinacria family is powerless and, consequently, tries to make him fall in love first with Nunzia and then with the horrendous Filomena, a girl from a good family. Maddalena, sister of Mimì, widowed, would like the inheritance to pass to her son William jr.
notes: The film is a silly mess, which despite the good intentions of the director, ends up boring rather than entertaining.

title: Barnabo delle montagne
actors: Marco Pauletti, Duilio Fontana, Alessandra Milan
description: Banned from the rangers' corps for not having the courage to defend a comrade by shooting, Barnabo finds work as a forest ranger with two women, grandmother and grandson. He will be recalled to the places of his previous service, but once again he will refuse to resort to violence, preferring to remain on guard at an abandoned barracks.
notes: Brenta sacrifices the psychological and action component of Buzzati's story by favoring a feeling of communion with nature and its magical moments in the setting of the Alps, so dear to the writer too. The actors are all non-professionals.

title: Tiger Storm white Tiger
actors: Gary Daniels, John Grogan, Julia Nickson
description: Two police officers, close friends, investigate the Chinese underworld of their city. In an ambush set by the killers of the "Triads" one of them is killed. His colleague, who miraculously survived the ambush, is determined to avenge the death of his companion. To this end, he infiltrates the Chinese community where he finds a trail that leads to a secret martial arts sect. Once the killers are identified, he will have to face them with their own weapons. Along the lines of Chuck Norris, Van Damme & C., yet another example of the line of policemen ready to lead their hands.

title: American Kickboxer
actors: John Barrett, Keith Vitali
description: Two friends, martial arts experts, become rivals. Their once fraternal union takes a back seat to the benefit of an exasperated sporting rivalry. They will end up competing for the title of the kickboxing world champion. The Italian title is misleading: the first "Without exclusion" had Jean-Claude Van Damme in the cast, who is not here.

title: Prime Cut
actors: Lee Marvin, Gene Hackman, Sissy Spacek
description: A killer, traveling to Kansas City to collect a debt, completes his mission but at the same time frees a group of women, saving them from the local boss. To complicate the matter we bring one of the freed girls, who falls in love with the killer, and a blonde of easy virtue. The escape through the fields with the threshing machine at his heels is unforgettable.

title: The Michelle Apts.
actors: Henry Czerny, Mary Beth Rubens, Nancy Beatty, Peter Outerbridge
description: A government official arrives in a desolate town to investigate the tax wrongdoing of a local chemical industry and finds himself a guest of "The Michelle Apartments", a dilapidated and sinister residence. It is here that, seduced by a fatal woman and persecuted by her husband, who is a dangerous ex-con, the man will slowly slip into a maelstrom of corruption, blackmail and jealousy.
notes: The second work by Canadian John Pozer (his was the noir "The Grocer's Wife") is a thriller with grotesque and comical implications, with horror veins. Sensual atmospheres for a film that moves between David Lynch and the Coen brothers.

title: Amazing Grace and Chuck
actors: Joshua Zuehlke, Alex English, Gregory Peck, Lee Richardson
description: Twelve-year-old Chuck Murdock is shocked after visiting a nuclear missile depot with his class. To protest, he decides to stop talking and no longer play on his institute's baseball team. The news also comes to the attention of Amazing Grace Smith, a very famous basketball player, who soon decides to follow his example. The boy's father also ends up sharing his son's ideas, who is summoned by the President of the United States. Fiasco announced for the director of "Four weddings and a funeral" and "Dancing with a stranger", with a pacifist film of rose water.

title: The Pickle
actors: Danny Aiello, Dyan Cannon, Clotilde Courau, Shelley Winters, Chris Penn
description: Harry Stone, a well-known film director, is not having a very happy time and collects one fiasco after another. In order to recover and in the hope of freeing himself from debt, he clings to the only chance that presents itself: direct a science fiction film for teens that tells the story of a flying pickled cucumber. Harry, convinced that he has committed an artistic suicide, seeks comfort in the most important people in his life, but ...
notes: The dose of irony that Paul Mazursky possesses saves a film that recycles the idea, as old as the world, of the film in the film and of the director in the throes of a creative crisis (do you remember "Otto e mezzo"?)

title: Hearts of the West
actors: Jeff Bridges, Alan Arkin, Donald Pleasence, Blythe Danner
description: Lewis Tater, author of a western novel, in order to get to know the world of the pioneers, goes to Titan in Nevada. The man runs into two scammers who are raising money for the maintenance of a university that, in reality, does not exist. In an attempt to escape the two Lewis ends up in the middle of a film crew.
notes: Quite successful satire on the world and the myth of the West. Alan Arkin is good in the role of the director.

title: Dying to Remember
actors: Melissa Gilbert, Ted Shackelford
description: A fashion designer who lives and works in New York has a nightmare that repeats itself every day: she dreams of dying following a fall from an elevator shaft. She then decides to go to a psychologist, who hypnotizes her. Thanks to this investigation, the doctor learns that the woman lived in a previous life in a Victorian mansion in San Francisco and that she died in that horrible way. But not for a misfortune ...

title: La montagna del dio cannibale
actors: Claudio Cassinelli, Ursula Andress, Antonio Marsina, Stacy Keach
description: Harry Stevenson is an ethnologist who has decided to go to an island in New Guinea to explore a mountain considered taboo. His wife Susan and his brother-in-law Arthur, worried that there has been no news of Harry for some time, set out in search of him. They are accompanied by Edward Foster, a friend of Harry and some local porters. The expedition into the forest is immediately revealed to be full of danger and devastated by the appearance of mysterious savages.
notes: Adventurous cartoon, a pretext for the director to show the abundant graces of Ursula Andress and some brutality.

title: I magliari
actors: Alberto Sordi, Belinda Lee, Renato Salvatori, Aldo Giuffré
description: Mario is an Italian worker who left the city of Hanover, where he tried in vain to find his luck, and is about to return to Italy. One day he accidentally meets Totò, a shrewd Roman swindler who trades in fabrics, who convinces him to stay. The two begin to work together, then Mario enters the service of Raffaele, an enterprising Neapolitan who, through a group of knitters, has organized a large-scale trade in fake fabrics.
notes: For his second film after "The Challenge", Rosi got help in the script from Suso Cecchi D'Amico and Giuseppe Patroni Griffi. But the film is uncertain between a film of denunciation and an Italian comedy, with Sordi doing his usual number.

title: La rivolta dei pretoriani
actors: Richard Harrison, Moira Orfei, Giuliano Gemma, Piero Lulli
description: The government action of the emperor Domitian is influenced by the beautiful and perfidious Artamne and by the devious Soter, leader of the gladiators. Valerio Rufo, who leads the praetorians, tries in every way to oppose corruption, the unjust and bloody actions with which the emperor oppresses the people.
notes: Naive Peplum, later re-edited with the title "The invincible warriors".

title: Parole e baci
actors: Ricky Tognazzi, Simona Izzo, Roberto Citran
description: Arianna and Andrea are two in their thirties who live and work in Rome, the first is employed by a private television, while the second teaches in an elementary school. The two met at a party, during which Andrea won her over with an imaginative and obstinate courtship. Six years have passed and from their union a child was born, Francesco, but now their relationship is beginning to deteriorate. To make coexistence difficult is a sum of objective factors and bad feelings: jealousy, misunderstandings, mutual accusations and violent quarrels. Arianna and Andrea thus decide to separate, but living alone after so many years of living together is not easy.
notes: The award-winning firm Tognazzi & Izzo is better off doing something else.

title: Friday the 13th, Part VI: Jason Lives
actors: Thom Mathews, Jennifer Cooke, David Kagan, Renee Jones, Kerry Noonan
description: The owners of the Crystal Lake campground (where Jason, the killer who kills his victims while wearing the hockey mask, has done his brutality) have decided to change his name. But the ploy is completely useless because it turns out that Jason is immortal.
notes: The atrocities that Jason commits in this film are not very different from those committed by the director and the actors of this tired episode of the endless series of "Friday the 13th".

title: Sworn to Justice
actors: Cynthia Rothrock, Tony Lo Bianco, Kurt McKinney, Brad Dourif
description: A wave of violence hit an American metropolis, the work of a gang of thugs. Among the victims of the outlaws a young woman, Janna's sister, an expert in martial arts and endowed with extrasensory faculties. Thanks to these two particular abilities Janna sets out on the trail of criminals and, with karate shots, begins the work of "cleaning". To win, however, it is necessary to find the leader of the gang who is naturally hidden in an unsuspected identity. Between one fight and another, love also makes its way.
notes: When you say "a name, a guarantee", you say it all and Cynthia Rothrock, the Van Damme in a skirt, never betrays expectations: steel muscles under a velvet skin. The only unknown: how will she have styled the blonde hair this time? Bob or curls?

title: Salsa Rosa
actors: Veronica Forqué, Maribel Verdú, Juanito Puigoorbe
description: Koro is the wife of Rosario, who works as a cook in a restaurant. Ana married Tomas who, on the other hand, works as a surgeon by profession. Koro challenges Ana to test each other's husbands' loyalty. How? By building themselves, naturally unbeknownst to unsuspecting men, opportunities for escapades and extramarital temptations.
notes: Pseudo-Almodovar without rhythm, with wasted actresses and an unbearable falsetto.

title: Airborne
actors: Shane McDermott, Seth Green, Brittney Powell, Chris Conrad
description: Mitchel, a bold young Californian surfing champion, is forced to move for a few months with some relatives in Cincinnati, away from the beloved ocean waves. Here, moreover, he fails to mesh with his new schoolmates and comes into conflict with them. To "redeem himself" he has only one option: put on his roller skates and participate in the most reckless competition in the region.
notes: Usual, rhetorical apology for success understood as a violent affirmation of the individual.

title: Gli onorevoli
actors: Totò, Peppino De Filippo, Franca Valeri, Gino Cervi, Aroldo Tieri
description: Five stories of candidates in the political elections: the Christian Democrat Bianca Sereni, the liberal senator Rossi-Breschi, the communist writer Saverio Fallopponi, the missino Giuseppe Mollica, the monarchist Antonio La Trippa, exponent of the Restoration Party who marks his condominium rallies with the slogan "Vote Antonio! Vote The Tripe!".
notes: Corbucci would like to mock the political class, but the satire is modest and indifferent. The only pearl of the film is the pro-monarchist Principe De Curtis with his catchphrase "Vota Antonio".

title: Durante l'estate
actors: Renato Paracchi, Rosanna Callegari, Gabriele Fontanesi
description: In an empty summer Milan, an illustrator of maps for publishing houses makes ends meet by inventing noble titles and heraldic coats of arms for ordinary people, proud to show off a brand new family tree. Regardless of the possible consequences, the man would continue his activity as a "researcher" which, however, is a crime by law.
notes: Little-known title of Olmi's filmography, this work skillfully chisels a minimalist story (but it wasn't called that at the time) that aspires to the dimension of a modern fairy tale. Rai production.

title: Il lungo silenzio
actors: Carla Gravina, Jacques Perrin, Alida Valli, Giuliano Montaldo
description: In an unidentified city, Carla's existence is dominated and conditioned by terror, aggravated by frequent threats, given that her husband is a judge engaged in a complex investigation into cooperation for development and arms trafficking. The investigation arose, in turn, from a previous investigation on business and bribes. When he is killed, she decides to continue her investigations firsthand, without fear of the consequences.

title: Maximilian Kolbe
actors: Christoph Waltz, Eward Zentara, Artur Barcis
description: The film is inspired by the life and work of Father Maximilian Kolbe, a Polish Franciscan who was beatified in 1993. We are in 1941, in the Auschwitz concentration camp. One man managed to escape and, according to the cruel rules of the concentration camp, ten prisoners were chosen, waiting to be put into arms to deter further escape attempts. Among them a father of a family. The priest will voluntarily take his place.
notes: After films that knew how to temper religious anxiety with the structures of "auteur" cinema, from the beginning of the Eighties Zanussi began to put together a series of "themed" films in which the apology for Catholicism has always been more intrusive, even at the expense of intense stories like the one narrated in this film.

title: Innocent Lies
actors: Adrian Dunbar, Stephen Dorff, Gabrielle Anwar, Joanna Lumley, Melvil Poupaud, Sophie Aubry, Florence Hoath
description: We are in the thirties in a country located in the south of France and an English inspector is investigating the suicide of a colleague. Everyone is inclined to believe that man took his own life voluntarily, only our hero is convinced of the opposite. The course of the investigation takes the representative of the law to a mysterious villa, where a family lives among shocking and unconfessable secrets and morbid relationships.
notes: Well-made thriller, which has the peculiarity of seeing an English inspector confronting the intrigues of the French province. More than discreet actors, dignified direction.

title: The Shooter
actors: Dolph Lundgren, Maruschka Detmers, Assumpta Serna, Gavan O'Herlihy
description: Someone killed the Cuban ambassador to the United Nations. American officer of Czech origin Mickey Dane is given the task of traveling to Prague and capturing Simone Rosset, the alleged killer who runs a restaurant in that city. Mickey tracks her down. But the woman claims she retired from the killer business and has not left the Czech capital for the past five years.
notes: Kotcheff is one who is not afraid of anything and makes at least two chase sequences as the god of cinema commands. What do you want it to matter if the script doesn't stand up?

title: Flirting with Disaster
actors: Ben Stiller, Patricia Arquette, Mary Tyler Moore, Lily Tomlin, Téa Leoni, Alan Alda
description: Mel Coplin (Ben Stiller), despite being happily married to Nancy (Patricia Arquette) and having just had a child, is plagued by a worry: he doesn't know his birth parents. Convinced that the time has come to look for them, he sets out on their trail, thanks to the help of Tina, a psychologist who works for the agency that took care - at the time - of Mel's adoption. The man thus begins a long journey through much of the United States, while the adoptive parents go into crisis.
notes: The plot is reminiscent of that sit-com that saw the Reaganian children who were convinced to continually question their father from 1968 (inde) fool. The sinister charm of the (new) bourgeoisie.

title: All This and Heaven Too
actors: Bette Davis, Charles Boyer, Barbara O'Neil
description: English family with four children and a governess. The husband falls in love with the girl, arousing the ire of the jealous wife who causes a scandal. In a moment of anger, the husband kills his wife and then, out of shame, takes his own life. What future for the young woman, involved in spite of herself in the bloody affair, and for the four orphans?
notes: Tailor-made for a Bette Davis at the height of fame, who here confronts the talented Boyer and O'Neill. Good packaging.

title: Anno 79 - La distruzione di Ercolano
actors: Susan Paget, Brad Harris, Mara Lane, Jacques Berthier
description: The tribune Marcus Tiberius met the slave Livia, a Christian, at the imperial court. A man of action, Marco does not adapt to the softness of the building and asks to take up arms again. They grant it to him, but against the Christians whom the tribune has meanwhile begun to appreciate. The awakening of the volcano takes care of him to get out of the way.
notes: In the years of the triumph of the "peplum", a short story of nothing at best.

title: Un delitto quasi perfetto
actors: Philippe Leroy, Pamela Tiffin, Graziella Granata, Fernando Sancho
description: Returning from a trip to Amsterdam, the journalist Paolo Respighi meets Anne Robson, an orphan and very wealthy heiress, who is going to Beirut to take possession of the five million dollar bequest. Partly out of curiosity, partly for the interest aroused in him by the girl, the next day Paolo decides to follow the woman. When the two arrive at a mysterious villa she disappears ...
notes: Camerini, here struggling with yellow even if tinged with pink, directs with too much laziness and too tired. The exteriors were shot in Beirut, which at the time was the Monte Carlo of the Middle East.

title: Rosolino Paternò, soldato
actors: Nino Manfredi, Jason Robards, Martin Landau, Peter Falk
description: The title soldier is an American prisoner of war. In exchange for his freedom he was recruited for a commando action in the Sicilian territory, in view of the allied landing in 1943, to be carried out right in the vicinity of the military's country of origin. With an action group, Rosolino is parachuted to Sicily, but the mission soon takes an unexpected turn and will have an even more unpredictable ending.
notes: Scripted by Age and Scarpelli, it suffers a little from the show's satire but has the right timing. Manfredi is good and supports the part well. Loy's direction is not noted either for inventiveness or sloppiness.

title: Fifty/Fifty
actors: Peter Weller, Robert Hays, Charles Martin Smith
description: A mercenary is contacted to take part, in a state of the Southeast Asian state, in the release of the legitimate president, imprisoned after a coup. Despite the intervention of a friend and the sacrifice of the woman he is in love with, he finds himself having to deal with the dictator he wanted to overthrow. Will he succeed in the enterprise?
notes: Action, pseud-commitment and lots of bangs, but little tension.

title: Io ho paura
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, Erland Josephson, Mario Adorf, Angelica Ippolito
description: Brigadier Ludovico Graziano is a middle-aged man in the midst of a generational crisis. He no longer has faith in what he is doing, with his partner Gloria the disagreements are the order of the day and even with his daughter Silvia things are not going better. One day he was entrusted with the task of escorting Judge Cancedda, an old-fashioned magistrate in charge of investigating a murder. The judge realizes, also thanks to the brigadier's intuitions, that he has got his hands on something that is hot.
notes: Damiani tries, with poor results, to mix the cinema of civil denunciation with the thriller. Screenplay by Nicola Badalucco and the director himself and music by Riz Ortolani.

title: Les enfants du Paradis
actors: Jean-Louis Barrault, Arletty, Pierre Brasseur, Maria Casarès
description: We are in Paris in 1840 and a troupe of actors achieves great success every evening in the popular theater of the "Funambules". Among them there is also a mime, Baptiste Debureau, an artist with a romantic temperament, who falls madly in love with the beautiful Garance. The woman is contested by three other men: Frédérick Lemaître, a brilliant but truculent actor, Lacenaire, a homosexual anarchist, and the Count of Montray ...
notes: Scripted by Jacques Prévert, it is a sort of adaptation of the "Mysteries of Paris".

title: Surf Ninjas
actors: Ernie Reyes jr., Rob Schneider, Nicolas Cowan, Leslie Nielsen, Tone Loc
description: A free-talking dude surfing the beautiful shores of Southern California reaches a distant Asian kingdom. The purpose of his trip is to take back his throne and his prince's crown.
notes: Adventure movie that one would like to be bizarre and is just stupid. Among the performers the rapper Tone Loc.

title: La sceriffa
actors: Tina Pica, Tina De Mola, Livio Lorenzon, Ugo Tognazzi, Tino Scotti
description: A western village is extorted by a gang of outlaws. The sheriff, an old Southern soldier, tries in vain to impose legality, but is killed. Then his widow, Carmela, a pugnacious old woman of Neapolitan origin, takes the field who, a little with strong manners, a little with tarallucci and wine, restores justice.
notes: Became famous with the character of Caramella in "Bread, love and fantasy", Tina Pica was then "exploited" in the following years with some films like this in which she was the absolute protagonist, but the outcome was disappointing.

title: The Strange Love of Martha Ivers
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, Van Heflin, Lizabeth Scott, Kirk Douglas
description: After killing the shrew aunt, Marta Ivers marries the only witness to what happened, buying her silence with the great wealth inherited from the victim. The two accomplices, in an attempt to escape it, have an innocent person condemned to the electric chair and believe, in this way, that they have secured impunity. But one day a certain Sam reappears who, on the day of the murder, was in the house of the victim. Written by Robert Rossen, a melodrama with very black tones dominated by an extraordinary Stanwyck.

title: Il diavolo
actors: Alberto Sordi, Gunila Elm-Tornqvist, Ulf Palme, Anne Charlotte Sjöberg
description: Amedeo Ferretti, a fur sales representative, travels to Stockholm to negotiate the purchase of a stock of these fine garments. The man, who has always heard about the sexual freedom of Swedes, sees the possibility, once he arrives on the spot, to establish romantic relationships with splendid creatures. Although Amedeo flaunts his Latin charm, he does not reach the goal he had set for himself.
notes: Revised today, this film that won the Golden Bear at the Berlin Film Festival is dated and boring. Alberto Sordi transplanted to the planet Sweden is predictable and the semi-documentary tone of the film does not help him.

title: Fools Rush In
actors: Matthew Perry, Salma Hayek, Jon Tenney, Carlos Gomez, Tomas Milian
description: Alex Whitman is a middle-class scion who is a business executive in Manhattan and is currently on a business trip to Las Vegas. Isabel Fuentes is a fiery American of Mexican descent who believes in the power of destiny. It is a single night of passion. When they meet again, three months later, the woman is expecting a baby: how to deal with their respective families?
notes: The originality of this sparkling comedy written by Katherine Reback and directed by the director of "Four Hands Wedding" is that it starts from the end. A man and a woman meet, go to bed right away, she disappears and reappears three months later, pregnant. The "reverse dream" works, despite such conventions and the exploitation of the gambling capital, now at saturation levels.

title: Snow White in the Black Forest
actors: Sigourney Weaver, Sam Neill, Gil Bellows, Monica Keena
description: At the edge of a primeval wood a pack of wolves attacks a carriage, causing it to overturn: the horses are devoured by wolves and a pregnant woman is impaled by a piece detached from the carriage. Dying, the woman begs her husband Frederick to take the baby out of her womb. Asking God for forgiveness, the man obeys his wife, thus Lilli is born. Time passes and Frederick remarries with the beautiful and vain Claudia.
notes: Loosely based on the tale of the Brothers Grimm, the film attempts to combine themes and atmospheres typical of the Hammer horror of the seventies, with a glossy Hollywood finish. But the result disappoints. Snow White, the witch, the mirror, the seven (more or less) dwarfs and the apple are all there, but the story does not take off, making us regret the magical world of Disney's Snow White and keeping the operation going is not enough an old European set (the film was shot in the Czech Republic) and two holy monsters like Sigourney Weaver and Sam Neill.

title: Fratello homo sorella bona
actors: Sergio Leonardi, Krista Nell, Nazzareno Natale, Antonia Santilli, Elio Marconato
description: In a rather approximate and "boccaccesco" Middle Ages the young and beautiful Chiarina is destined by her father to a marriage of interest with the old and fat Tebaldo, repulsive but very rich. With the interested help of the prior of a convent and the help of some false monks, however, the girl manages to avoid getting married, while her lover, a young and handsome gentleman ...
notes: Between double meanings in the dialogues and voyeurisms from avanspectacle, the film drags itself along the usual sheepish tracks. More than the film, however, the "zero" thumb would go to those who fish out similar things from the sewers to set up self-styled "cult" evenings.

title: The Legend of Lylah Clare
actors: Kim Novak, Peter Finch, Rossella Falk, Ernest Borgnine
description: For her extraordinary resemblance, Elsa Brinkmann is chosen to play a film about diva Lyla Clare, who died under mysterious circumstances. Pressed by an unscrupulous producer and a treacherous journalist, she will end up identifying with the late star. To the extreme consequences.
notes: Little appreciated at the time, it is a pop-rhythm film that offers a vitriolic portrait of the world of cinema. A crazy update of "Baby Jane" with amazing cinematic moments.

title: The Kentuckian
actors: Burt Lancaster, Dianne Foster, John Carradine, Walter Matthau
description: Beg Eli, a widowed lumberjack, wants to move with his son from Kentucky to Texas. Beg wants to escape a feud that has been going on since time immemorial, pitting his family against another. However, during the transfer he stops in a city, where he is reached by his relentless pursuers, who try to provoke him at all costs, with a trickle of offenses and abuses and also involving him in bloody fights.
notes: Lancaster's first directing is a solidly structured western, with good and bad, a bit slow in narrative development. Film debut, in an unusual negative role, for Walter Matthau.

title: I nuovi mostri
directors: Mario Monicelli, Ettore Scola, Dino Risi
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Ornella Muti, Alberto Sordi, Ugo Tognazzi
description: Fourteen episodes of ordinary monstrosity: a singer is exploited by her entrepreneur husband; a cardinal brings to order a group of faithful in turmoil; a debauched aristocrat "rescues" a pedestrian; cook and waiter scramble in the kitchen of a trattoria; a group of comedians turns a funeral into a small unscheduled show ...
notes: Born to help a sick colleague, a collective work that would like to revive the glories of the first _Mostri_ (1963): the expansion of cast and authors does not, however, have the desired effect, diluting and weighing down the product. Almost a metaphor for the end of the Italian comedy.

title: Miss Mary
actors: Julie Christie, Guillermo Battaglia, Luisana Brando, Sofia Viruboff
description: Towards the end of the thirties, Miss Mary is an English young lady who goes to be the governess of the three children, a boy and two girls, of a rich Argentine landowner, closed in his class prejudices. When it turns out that the boy has fallen in love with the governess, the drama breaks out.
notes: Interesting picture of the bigoted and neurotic Argentine ruling class at the turn of the war. From the director of "This is not talked about", one of Mastroianni's last films.

title: The Boys Next Door
actors: Maxwell Caulfield, Charlie Sheen, Patti D'Arbanville
description: On graduation day Roy and Bo, cynical and arrogant eighteen-year-olds, fake a murder in the school yard. The tragic game, deplored by teachers and classmates, also continues in the life of every day. Roy confesses to his friend that he feels pushed by a violent murderous instinct and drags him into a criminal escalation that goes from killing a gas station attendant to that of an engaged couple, a prostitute and a homosexual.
notes: The screenplay is by two boys, at the time in their twenties, the direction accentuates the delirium of omnipotence of the two protagonists. Spheeris started out as a "new face" of US cinema, but then she got bogged down in the zany genre of "Crazy" and the like.

title: What's New, Pussycat
actors: Peter O'Toole, Peter Sellers, Romy Schneider, Capucine, Paula Prentiss, Woody Allen, Ursula Andress, Kathrin Schaake
description: Michael James, an English photographer who works in Paris, can no longer bear his girlfriend's jealous scenes even though she, in fact, has reasons to complain. In fact, Michael is certainly not blameless with his constant infidelities. Tired of the trend, the woman convinces him to seek treatment by the psychoanalyst Fritz Fassbender, who, however, in terms of sexual ethics, turns out to be worse than him. There follows a saraband of misunderstandings in a small free trade hotel.
notes: Sparkling cast for the film debut of Woody Allen, who wrote the screenplay, and appears, of course, as a patient of the psychiatrist Sellers. "Cameo" by Richard Burton.

title: Heaven's Prisoner
actors: Alec Baldwin, Kelly Lynch, Mary Stuart Masterson, Eric Roberts
description: Dave Robichaux, former alcoholic and former homicide detective has retreated to the swamps near New Orleans where the Mississippi merges with the ocean. But when a twin-engine plane full of mobsters sinks into the waters of the Gulf, he's forced to put on the cop's clothes again and chase the ghosts of the past.
notes: Phil Joanou, in his fourth film, brings to the screen without great style the exploits of the private investigator created by the pen of novelist James Lee Burke. Alec Baldwin is monochord.

title: Cry, the Beloved Country
actors: James Earl Jones, Richard Harris, Vusi Kunene, Leleti Khumalo
description: Stephen Kumalo (Jones) is a country priest who has never set foot in the city. The disappearance of his sister Gertrude will force him to travel to Johannesburg. As if that weren't enough, his son Absalom is currently in jail, accused of murdering the son of James Jarvis (Harris), a wealthy and conservative landowner.
notes: Alan Paton's novel on racial conflicts in South Africa, "Cry, the Beloved Country", almost fifty years old, is re-done, compared to the 1951 film version, in an undoubtedly more grandiose way, warmer in tone and more allegorical in intention. But more effort would have been required to make the message underground and to deliver an emotional impact equal to that of the book.

title: Captain Horatio Hornblower R.N
actors: Gregory Peck, Virginia Mayo, Robert Beatty, Terence Morgan
description: The British frigate "Lydia", commanded by Captain Hornblower, is sent on a secret mission to Nicaragua. Its purpose is to support a small local leader intent on relieving the Spanish colonies, which can only be useful to England. As soon as the captain gets his hands on the Spanish galleon "Navidad", he learns that, in the meantime, Spain and England have entered into a pact of alliance.
notes: The film, based on two novels by Cecil Scott Forester, manages to entertain and thrill. Colorful and directed by a master of action cinema, it has a Gregory Peck tetragon at its center.

title: Vento di primavera
directors: Arthur Maria Rabenalt, Giulio Del Torre
actors: Ferruccio Tagliavini, Sabine Bethmann, Lauretta Masiero
description: Rudy, the branch manager of a German firm, falls in love with Elisabetta Klinger, his new secretary who the central management has sent to Rome. The man is so impressed by her beauty that he ends up leaving Diana, a dancer, with whom he lived. But Diana takes revenge and manages to upset the relations of mutual trust between the two lovers, making Elizabeth believe that Rudy is a fickle and unscrupulous man. The girl, impressed by the dancer's slanders, returns to Germany. A small story with Tagliavini singing here and there.

title: Don't Bother to Knock
actors: Richard Widmark, Anne Bancroft, Marilyn Monroe, Diana Corcoran
description: An airline pilot, Jed, is abandoned by his girlfriend. The young man, cynical only in appearance, is shaken by what has happened and decides to leave the city. From the room in which he is staying, he glimpses an attractive baby sitter in the apartment opposite and arouses his curiosity. He decides to call her and ask her for an appointment, but the man does not know what he will encounter: she is a psychopath who confuses him with her dead boyfriend.
notes: Monroe's first starring role in a real-time psychological drama and Bancroft's first film. She is good, but the tension is there only at times.

title: Total Eclipse
actors: Leonardo DiCaprio, David Thewlis, Romane Bohringer, Dominique Blanc
description: Arrogant and childish, Arthur Rimbaud arrives in Paris at the age of sixteen and with his poems he immediately wins the esteem of Paul Verlaine, the oldest and already established poet in the literary world of the Ville Lumière. Soon their intellectual partnership turns into a stormy sentimental bond destined, unfortunately, to lead to drama.
notes: Holland fails to make the most of a beautiful story and is reduced to shooting a television drama. However, DiCaprio is good in a role designed for River Phoenix. Screenwriter Christopher Hampton appears as the judge who convicts Verlaine for sodomy.

title: The Next Karate Kid
actors: Pat Morita, Hilary Swank, Michael Ironside, Constance Towers, Michael Cavalieri, Chris Conrad
description: Young Julia (Swank), an animal lover, is persecuted by the Alpha Elite, a group of thugs led by Colonel Dugan (Ironside). The old Myiagi (Morita) must return to the track and, urged by the girl's grandmother (Towers), he will transform her into a perfect karateka.

title: One Tough Bastard
actors: Brian Bosworth, Bruce Payne, DeJuan Guy, Jeff Kober, Lawrence Lowe
description: John North is a Marine officer whose family is slaughtered by a gang of arms traffickers in a drugstore. Recovering from the shock, he tries in vain to track down the killers, but the FBI makes him understand that his interest is not appreciated. In fact, behind the whole story, there is the hand of Karl Savak, a corrupt federal agent, who is trying to recover a shipment of high-tech weapons he promised to a drug dealer in Los Angeles.
notes: According to Lance Henriksen, the man who called John Woo a poet, Brian Bosworth is a kind of John Wayne of our time and we won't blame him.

title: Bad Boys
actors: Martin Lawrence, Will Smith, Téa Leoni, Tchéky Karyo, Theresa Randle
description: Mike Lowrey and Marcus Burnett are two black cops from the narcotics section. Max Logan and Julie Mott are two prostitutes. When Max loses his feathers, Julie remains the only person alive who can identify the men in the gang who stole a large amount of heroin. Julie is kidnapped, but Mike and Marcus are smart enough to free her.
notes: Logorrhea is the stylistic code of Will Smith's acting, perhaps because there was and is a parenthesis as a rap singer. For this he is hired and for this he cannot refrain from pronouncing from four to six words per second. In this sense, "Bad Boys" is a film that aims at the highest degree of specialization: everyone is always and only limited to what little they can do.

title: Slalom
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Adolfo Celi, Daniela Bianchi, Beba Loncar, Isabella Biagini
description: The Christmas holidays have arrived and Lucio Ridolfi together with his wife and a couple of friends goes to Sestrière to spend a holiday period. In search of extramarital experiences, Lucio sets his sights on a beautiful and mysterious foreigner, who engages him in an international conspiracy. During a trip in the snow Lucio is stunned and when he finds himself he is on a plane bound for Cairo with a passport in the name of a foreign citizen.
notes: Harmless parody of James Bond movies. The music is by Ennio Morricone.

title: Full Circle
actors: Corbin Bernsen, Teri Polo, Eric Lutes, Jennifer Barker, Alice Carter
description: Tana is raped by the son of her mother's lover who, falling in love with her, did not accept her refusal. At first the girl does not reveal what happened to anyone and tries, albeit with great difficulty, to return to normal life. One day, he meets Harrison, the father of a friend of his, and falls in love with him. After many doubts and hesitation, she is forced to interrupt the relationship so as not to hurt the sensitivity of her friend. Some time passes and Tana meets Drew, a young lawyer ...
notes: Strong themes for a television film that touches on raw and topical topics, to the point of turning into an act of denunciation.

title: Follow That Dream
actors: Elvis Presley, Arthur O'Connell, Anne Helm, Joanna Moore
description: Pop Kwimper on his wanderings in the United States, finds a beach where fishing is particularly abundant. Without thinking for a moment he decides to settle there with his son Toby, the three foster children and his wife Holly and to make a living by charging the fishermen's entrance. Together with the others, two gangsters also appear and set up a traveling casino, creating serious headaches for the quiet family. The community annoyed by their presence elects Toby sheriff.
notes: Douglas's film is naive, but it allows Elvis to sing "Home Is Where the Heart Is" and "On Top of Old Smokey".

title: Saint-Ex
actors: Bruno Ganz, Miranda Richardson, Janet McTeer, Brid Brennan
description: It is the life story of Antoine de Saint-Exupéry, the French writer who became famous for his exploits in the skies. Due to an accident, he wanders for three days in the Sahara, risking dying from despair and being kidnapped and tortured by nomads. And to test his love for Consuelo Carrillo - a woman he loved deeply but constantly betrayed - Antoine flies away, never to return.
notes: The film is inspired by the book by the English journalist Paul Webster, is scripted by Frank Cottrell Boyce (the one from "Butterfly Kiss") and is far too respectful and sober. In fact, it was a flop at the cinema.

title: Tokyo-Ga
actors: Wim Wenders, Werner Herzog, Chishu Ryu, Yuuharu Atsuta
description: A travel documentary, a cold and lucid look at Japan and Yasujiro Ozu, recalled through the testimonies of Yûharu Atsuta - the director of photography who after his death no longer wanted to work with anyone - and Chisû Ryu, his favorite interpreter .
notes: Wenders - in 1983, 20 years after Ozu's death and during a break in the filming of _Paris, Texas_ - reaches Tokyo to confront one of his pivotal authors, and to compare the country told by the master with the current one. A moving pilgrimage in the footsteps of the great Japanese director, active between 1927 and 1962 and author of some of the most amazing and seminal works in the history of cinema.

title: Angus
country: France, Germany, Great Britain, United States
actors: Charlie Talbert, George C. Scott, Kathy Bates, Ariana Richards
description: Angus is chubby, he is a defender on an American football team and he is in love with Melissa. Rick is handsome, blond, is a quarterback and is engaged to Melissa. Angus suffers from it and can only vent his teenage doubts with a truck driver mother, a complicated friend and a seventy-year grandfather. At the school winter party, however, Angus will be able to take revenge and win Melissa's affection.
notes: It takes exactly half the George C. Scott movie to kick the bucket and get out of trouble. Kathy Bates is not so lucky and stays almost through. The two of them guarantee the only decent moments in a movie about a fat kid being teased by the handsome blond kid. Occasionally George C. Scott falls asleep treacherously. We too, after all.

title: The Tie that Binds
actors: Keith Carradine, Daryl Hannah, Vincent Spano, Moira Kelly
description: A violent couple of murderers, Lean and John Netherwood, abandon their child Janie during a firefight with the police. The little girl is entrusted to a petty bourgeois couple: but the parents are not willing to give up their daughter so easily, on the contrary they try to take her back by force.
notes: Written by Michael Auerbach, Wesley Stricks' first film as a director, starts from an overly abused strand, that of the petty bourgeois family, which suddenly finds itself in danger. The cast is spot on and Keith Carradine with his psychopathic father character embodies the typical Puritan phobias of the United States.

title: El dia de la bestia
actors: Alex Angulo, Armando De Razza, Santiago Segura, Terele Pavéz
description: During Christmas Eve 1995 in Madrid, Angel Berriartua, a distinguished theologian and priest, prepares for the arrival of the Antichrist. His problem is that he does not know the place where it will manifest itself and for this reason he decides to consult Professor Cavan, who hosts an esoteric show on television "The Dead Zone". He calls into question his girlfriend Susanna and an unscrupulous producer. Despite their intervention, Evil advances inexorably.
notes: De la Iglesia, here in his second feature film, tries hard, but his intention to desecrate the best party of the year fails. The music is by Battista Lena, the companion of Francesca Archibugi.

title: Les femmes
actors: Brigitte Bardot, Maurice Ronet, Jean-Pierre Marielle, Anny Duperey
description: Writer Jerome Hervé has accumulated a debt of several million with his publisher, which it will be difficult for him to recover. Since travel and women are an inexhaustible source of inspiration for him, on the advice of his publisher, he hires a handyman secretary and starts traveling the world with the aim of writing an autobiography. Jerome hires Claudia and gets on a train bound for Italy, not before, however, having taken leave of Hélène and Marianne, his last two flames.
notes: Despite the presence of Brigitte Bardot, the comedy, written by Aurel together with Cécil Saint-Laurent, ends up boring.

title: Spiaggia libera
actors: Dominique Boschero, Riccardo Garrone, Raimondo Vianello, Sandra Mondaini
description: On a hot summer Sunday, a whole sample of people belonging to the most diverse social categories pours into a free beach on the Roman coast. There is a forty-year-old engineer pursued by his son's teenage friend; a boy scout captain who leads his group of boys always looking for good deeds to do; two bored husbands in search of sentimental escapes and three skilled thieves chased by a carabiniere.
notes: Marino Girolami tries to repeat, seventeen years later, the success of "Domenica d'agosto" by Luciano Emmer, copying and updating the plot in some way. But the results are poor.

title: Capriccio
actors: Nicola Warren, Francesca Dellera, Andy J. Forrest, Luigi Laezza, Isabella Biagini
description: In 1947 a couple of young Anglo -American spouses, Fred and Jennifer, returned to Capri in the places where they met during the war and where they were happy. Now their relationship is in full crisis and between the two there is only indifference. One day Fred, who has become an UNESCO employee, is reached by the order to leave for Tuscany. It entrusts his wife and son Duccio to Don Vincenzo's concern and leaves Capri. Before, however, he makes a trip to Rome where Rosa reviews, a beautiful and helpful girl with whom, at the time of the war, he had experienced a disgusted love story.
notes: Tinto Brass is inspired by the novel by Mario Soldati "Letters from Capri" to launch Francesca Dellera. We would have gladly done without it.

title: Pesci d'oro e bikini d'argento
actors: Gianni Agus, Mario Carotenuto, Carlo Croccolo, Tiberio Murgia
description: During the summer, a strange competition is launched, which provides for the assignment of a gold fish weighing one kilo to those who, on August 15, will remain closed at home instead of going on vacation. The task of tracking them down is given to some bathers scattered on the most beautiful beaches of the peninsula, who will receive a silver bikini as a prize.
notes: Italian B-series comedy that spoils a bizarre subject.

title: The Legend of Lobo
description: Lobo is a wolf, the only survivor of a family of wolves exterminated years ago. In vain some hunters try to catch him by putting a bounty on him.
notes: Documentary signed by a Walt Disney documentary specialist and which, even today, can be seen with pleasure.

title: Ladri di cinema
actors: Piero Natoli, Joanna Chatton, Carlotta Natoli, Vera Gemma, Valerio Mastandrea
description: Cinema tells the story of a director who fails to make it to the cinema. According to him, the only real reason for his failure lies in the overwhelming power of American authors and films that dominate our national market, taking space away from indigenous authors. As much as he insists with the staff of the "Mantis film", he cannot even approach the boss to plead his cause.
notes: Poised between Kafka and Fantozzi is a film that, precisely because of this basic weakness, badly wastes the subject. The story is not redeemed even with the sympathy of the protagonist-director.

title: Panic in the Skies!
actors: Kate Jackson, Ed Marinaro, Erik Estrada, Maureen McCormick
description: A Boeing 747 departing from London to New York finds itself in the midst of an unexpected storm. After being struck by two lightning bolts at the same time, he remains without a guide: the two drivers, in fact, were electrocuted. The eldest flight attendant tries to enter the program that manages the flight system with a laptop.
notes: Usual disaster film with the usual plane in trouble at the center. The tension remains high for the duration of the film, the actors are all good. And for a TV movie, that's enough.

title: The Handmaid's Tale
actors: Natasha Richardson, Faye Dunaway, Aidan Quinn, Elizabeth McGovern
description: We are in the republic of Gilead in a future where the degree of pollution is so high that some women are forced to have children for those who are infertile. Kate finds herself having to give birth to a son who will then have to yield to the sterile Serena Joy, but at the last moment she thinks about it.
notes: Based on the novel of the same name by Margaret Atwood and written by Harold Pinter, it is a counter-utopia directed without a hand by a director who is too little visionary.

title: The Last Warrior
actors: Gary Graham, Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa
description: The Second World War is over, but an American and a Japanese soldier continue their struggle regardless of the end of the conflict.
notes: Mediocre war film that recycles a foregone theme.

title: La machine
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Didier Bourdon, Nathalie Baye, Erwan Baynaud
