description: With an imaginary machine of his own invention and following a failed experiment, Dr. Marc Lacroix, a psychiatrist, finds himself in the brain of Zyto, a dangerous psychopath and vice versa. In a society that only pays attention to appearances, it is difficult for the doctor to find someone who can believe him. After all, even his wife does not seem to notice the exchange that has taken place.
notes: Based on the noir novel by René Belletto (Italian title "Dangerous Transfer"), Dupeyron's film fails to take off despite the presence of Gérard Depardieu. The only surprise in the excellent performance of Didier Bourdon.

title: Il tassinaro
actors: Alberto Sordi, Marilù Tolo, Alessandra Mussolini, Anna Longhi, Silvana Pampanini
description: Pietro is a taxi driver who travels the streets of Rome day and night on board his "Zara 87". At the end of the service he returns promptly to his little house in Ostia Antica where he lives with his old father, his wife, a university son (more interested in soap operas than in engineering degrees).
notes: Sordi still tries his hand at directing, but what he manages to achieve is always the repetition of a stereotype. But he managed to get Giulio Andreotti and Federico Fellini into his car.

title: A Vow to a Kill
actors: Richard Grieco, Julianne Phillips
description: The young and beautiful heiress Rachel (Julianne Phillips) falls in love and ends up marrying a lengthy photographer named Eric (Richard Grieco). But, in reality, where did the woman know him? Is it by chance a dangerous killer on which a big size has been put on? Is it he who has made himself responsible for a false kidnapping of ten million dollars?
notes: The subject is more than discreet, but the direction of Longstreet, Richard Grieco and Julianne Philips are absolutely not up to par. The setting is acceptable, but everything ends up resolving itself in a weak and not very brilliant representation.

title: Le legioni di Cleopatra
actors: Linda Cristal, Ettore Manni, Georges Marchal, Corrado Sanmartin
description: The inevitable clash between the two former triumvirs Antonio and Ottaviano has been looming for some time. The first has long since settled in the palace of Cleopatra, the queen of Egypt. Here the centurion Curridius arrives incognito and has the task of avoiding the conflict. However, his mission fails and, in the great battle of Actium, the Egyptian army is annihilated.
notes: Failing the attempt to tell the great story through events.

title: Chiller
actors: Michael Beck, Paul Sorvino, Beatrice Straight, Laura Johnson
description: After hibernating for ten years, Miles Creighton is awakened and gradually returns to his life with his family. His behavior, however, shows, more and more frequently, alarming anomalies. In short, Miles is no longer the same as before, to the point that someone begins to suspect that, during his "sleep", his soul has been stolen.
notes: Good cast for such a master.

title: Audace colpo dei soliti ignoti
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Claudia Cardinale, Nino Manfredi, Gastone Moschin, Riccardo Garrone, Renato Salvatori, Carlo Pisacane, Tiberio Murgia, Mario Feliciani, Vicky Ludovici, Gianni Bonagura, Gina Amendola, Elena Fabrizi, Mauro Lemma
description: Peppe and some of his Roman cronies, thieves by trade, are contacted by a Milanese "colleague" for a coup to be carried out in the Lombard capital. It is a question of robbing the van which, every Sunday, takes the money from the Totocalcio games to safety. When the gang arrives in Milan, the boss is arrested and so the thieves have to get by on their own. Despite all the blow he succeeds and the suitcase with the loot takes the road to Rome. Here the gang disperses and even the money begins to pass from hand to hand ending up in a hospital where ...
notes: Not as fresh and sparkling as the first episode, this sequel to the _Soliti ignoti_ nevertheless retains some hints of effective satire and does not entirely disappoint expectations.

title: Taking Back My Life: The Nancy Ziegenmeyer Story
actors: Joanna Cassidy, Stephen Lang, Eileen Brennan, Ellen Burstyn
description: After suffering a brutal sexual violence, Nancy Ziegenmeyer, a young Iowa woman, decides to make his tragic experience public. The purpose of her is to help those who, like her, want to overcome the shame of trauma immediately. Following his brave example other women victims of this absurd and inconceivable violence find the strength to file a complaint.
notes: Usual film for television linked to the sad emergencies of the crime news. Too bad that, as always, the rhetoric pedal is a little too much. Always Joanna Cassidy, interpreter of many films for television.

title: Guns at Batasi
actors: Richard Attenborough, Flora Robson, John Leyton, Mia Farrow
description: In an African colonial country, an English-colored officer starts a riot with his unit. During the insurrection, the revolutionaries take Captain Abraham prisoner. Sergeant Major Lauderdale is called up to face the insurgents, but he has a hard time. Fortunately, and with the help of a rookie, he manages to turn a critical situation in his favor. Meanwhile from London ...
notes: British war film with a good cast in which director Attenborough and a very young Mia Farrow stand out. Accurate setting and good rhythm for an “honestly” racist and cynical film at the right point. Although honest in its staging, it is as interesting as it is dated.

title: Guapparia
actors: Mario Merola, Ida Di Benedetto, Marzio Honorato, Ria De Simone
description: Salvatore Di Donato (Merola) is the guappo of the Sanità district. The boss is aware of everything that happens in the neighborhood: he takes care of maintaining tranquility, rewards the good, helps the weak and confronts the bullies. In short, it enforces the ancient unwritten laws of the "guapparia". One day the boss meets Margherita (Di Benedetto) and abandons her partner for her ...
notes: The film is based on a drama, which in turn takes inspiration from a famous song, "Guapparia", a musical theme and performed, as usual, in the "mother scene".

title: I due sanculotti
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Barbara Carrol, Luigi Pavese
description: On the eve of the French Revolution, two Sicilian bankrupts arrive in Paris. The extraordinary resemblance of one of the two to the king's brother means that they are introduced to the court where they enjoy hitherto unknown pleasures. After the storming of the Bastille, however, troubles begin for them, hunted by the revolutionaries and scrambled by the realists ...
notes: The red primrose, the two orphans, the exchange of doubles: there is all sorts of clichés. In a couple of moments, however, Franco is at his best.

title: On the Beach
actors: Gregory Peck, Ava Gardner, Fred Astaire, Anthony Perkins
description: A catastrophic and massive nuclear war has destroyed all life on Earth. Among the few survivors are some US Navy officers with their men and their families. The military is on a mission to the California coast, but the general situation determines conflicting attitudes in the small community of survivors which, at times, lead to tragedy.
notes: Remarkable and commendable is the effort of Kramer, who is also the producer of the film, to create, in the middle of the Cold War, a hard and dry work on the possible consequences of a nuclear conflict when public opinion was not prejudiced against the idea. A superb cast completes the whole.

title: Three Young Texans
actors: Mitzi Gaynor, Keefe Brasselle, Jeffrey Hunter
description: The three guys in the title are actually two guys and a girl. Friends for the skin the young men and both naturally in love with the girl. She is undecided in the choice and therefore puts herself at the disposal of the one who will be able to put together a fair sum. In the ensuing struggle, there will be trouble in sight for the two boys.
notes: Naive and enjoyable western for teenagers.

title: Fatherland
actors: Rutger Hauer, Miranda Richardson, Peter Vaughan, Michael Kitchen
description: What would have happened if Hitler had won World War II? In the now legendary sixties, a now elderly but indomitable führer, who reigns undisputed over the whole of Europe at the top of the German superpower, is preparing a meeting with American President Kennedy to sign a pact. A mysterious political murder, however, disturbs the eve of the summit. An American reporter and the diligent German police team up to solve the case that could ... change the course of history!
notes: Produced by Warner and passed directly on TV without even the summer "hit and run" in theaters, it is a film that is foolish and senseless. Almost as foolish is the choice of such a script by good actors such as Hauer, Richardson and Vaughan.

title: The Widow's Kiss
actors: Beverly D'Angelo, Mackenzie Astin, Bruce Davison
description: Six months after his wife's death, successful lawyer Justin Sager is engaged to a client, the charming and mysterious Vivian Forbes. But one month after the wedding, Justin dies of a heart attack, perhaps caused by art. The first suspicions fall on the son Sean, who is on bad terms with Vivian: the boy is however convinced that it is she who caused the death of his father. Determined to find out the truth, Sean hires a private detective, who first discovers that ...
notes: After some good rehearsals with auteur films (_Hair_ by Milos Forman), Beverly D'Angelo has been seen almost only in TV movies like this one. Sin!

title: Zingara
actors: Bobby Solo, Loretta Goggi, Pippo Franco, Mario Pisu, Minnie Minoprio
description: The young Franco is a provincial singer in search of success. He meets Marisa, a girl from a good family, and falls in love with her, reciprocated. But Marisa moves away from him to stay next to a sick cousin that her father would like to marry her. The patient, however, enjoys excellent health and when the deception is discovered the two lovers can get back together.
notes: For those nostalgic for the "Friend of the Jaguar", the cast makes your eyes sparkle.

title: Vita da cani
actors: Aldo Fabrizi, Gina Lollobrigida, Delia Scala, Tamara Lees, Marcello Mastroianni
description: Life and loves of three girls, Vera, Margherita and Franca, with different characters, but all eager to emerge in the world of entertainment. After ups and downs their lives are divided: for one success arrives, for another true love away from the scene, for yet another a tragic fate. Begun as a vehicle for Fabrizi, the film becomes a bitter and pathetic comedy, with neorealist features, in which the style of the duo of directors is already fully felt.

title: Jeder für sich und Gott gegen alle
actors: Bruno S., Brigitte Mira, Hans Masius, Clemens Scheinz
description: In 1824 in the main square of Nuremberg a young man who cannot speak, ill-mannered and ragged, appears. After a series of painful humiliations, the young man is treated by a doctor who manages to obtain unexpected progress from him. Perhaps the young man is a noble whose family has disposed of for obscure dynastic reasons. But one day, as he appeared, the boy disappears.
notes: Inspired by a real event and scripted by the director himself, a visionary trip in Kaspar's "other" gaze. His visions were shot in 16mm. around the world and then inflated to 35.

title: Aguirre der Zorn Gotters
actors: Klaus Kinski, Helena Rojo, Ruy Guerra, Peter Berling
description: It is the time of the Spanish "conquistadors" of South America, in the sixteenth century. Starting from the mountains of Peru, Captain Aguirre goes, with some men, into the depths of the Amazon rainforest in search of the mythical Eldorado. Within a few days, the expedition naturally ends up decimated by natives and diseases. However Aguirre decides to continue anyway ...
notes: It is one of the thousand journeys "beyond the confines of the human horizon" that Herzog stages by borrowing real or probable feats here and there on Earth and throughout history. The disproportion between being and wanting to be is the thrust without which man would have created neither progress nor his follies.

title: Auch Zwerge haben klein angefangen
actors: Helmut Döring, Gerd Gickel, Gerhard Maerz, Erna Gschwendtner, Hertel Minkner
description: The dwarves of a prison rebel in an escalation of violence even to the detriment of animals or other human beings even weaker and more defenseless than the insurgents.
notes: Herzog's atrocious metaphor on the collective madness of a humanity that cannot stop in the face of any violence.

title: Dark Avenger
actors: Errol Flynn, Joanne Dru, Peter Finch
description: We are during the Hundred Years War (14th century). A beautiful English noblewoman is forcibly held hostage by a French squire from Aquitaine. The Prince of Wales, disguised as a soldier of fortune, arrives at his castle. After a series of daring adventures, the villain is defeated and the lady can return to England.
notes: Errol Flynn is a swashbuckling guarantee. The film is decent.

title: Shoot to Kill
actors: Sidney Poitier, Tom Berenger, Kirstie Alley, Clancy Brown
description: A policeman is on the trail of a dangerous killer. He takes refuge in a mountain area where he takes a girl hostage, engaged to a gruff local young man who is a guide by trade. The climber and the policeman must then make common cause to arrest the outlaw and free the girl.
notes: Abused plot for an action that weighs all on the shoulders of the performers.

title: Lord of Illusions
actors: Daniel von Bargen, Scott Bakula, Kevin J. Connor, Joseph Latimore
description: Nick, a character with diabilic traits and soul, is the head of a satanic sect dedicated to secret magical rites. A group of followers, however, at a certain point, kills the master to steal his secrets and hides his corpse. Thirteen (!) Years go by. The illusionist Swann, famous "magician" and magician, makes a horrible end in the course of a show which also witnesses the detective D'Amour. Swan's new widow hires D'Amour to investigate her husband's death, and the policeman soon finds himself dealing with Nick's old followers.
notes: Barker is an imaginative writer and a director of good will. But despite several ideas, this film has no charm and is not very original.

title: The Substitute
actors: Tom Berenger, Ernie Hudson, Cliff De Young
description: The literal translation of the original title is "The alternate". With this admittedly ironic definition we intend to designate the new occupation that a mercenary finds in that of Miami, a city not particularly quiet in its suburban neighborhoods. Well, the "teacher" is in charge of teaching "good manners" to a group of delinquent pupils of his wife.
notes: Typical action movie in which urban warfare sequences abound. Tom Berenger has the right physique du role to make up for the lack of expressiveness.

title: The Purple Heart
actors: Dana Andrews, Richard Conte, Farley Granger
description: During a war mission the crew of an American bombing plane, due to an engine failure, is forced to make a forced landing in enemy territory. The men remain unharmed but a Chinese betrays them and has them captured by the Japanese, who subject the American military to torture.
notes: Shot almost like a documentary, with the use of footage provided by the US propaganda services, the story is one of the numerous war productions of the time, while there was still fighting on the fronts.

title: Swann
actors: Miranda Richardson, Brenda Fricker, Michael Ontkean, David Cubitt
description: A small rural community on the prairies of southern Canada. The most bucolic one can suppose, at least in appearance. Instead, even in this peace Evil is hidden. A housewife is in fact brutally murdered: no suspicion, no motive. However, the crime determines the encounter between two strange characters: a cynical and sophisticated successful writer and a lonely country woman who hides an ancient secret guilt ...
notes: After the initial contrast, an interesting starting point with considerable potential, the story sets off on the conventional tracks of yellow, losing a bit of bite along the way.

title: 7 volte 7
actors: Gastone Moschin, Lionel Stander, Raimondo Vianello, Gordon Mitchell
description: How to score a theft and at the same time create an iron alibi? But by going to jail, of course! So six "golden men", imprisoned in the galleys of His British Majesty, taking advantage of a football match to which they are admitted as spectators, score a colossal blow in none other than the headquarters of the State Mint. In the wake of "Sette uominid'oro" (Moschin is here too) a good hit-movie with international circles.

title: I Love You, Alice B. Toklas!
actors: Peter Sellers, Leigh Taylor-Young, Jo Van Fleet, Joyce Van Patten
description: Harold Fine, a well-known lawyer, agrees to marry Joyce, his secretary, after a few years of living together. But the chance meeting with Nancy, a hippy who lives in a community of "flower children", makes him change his mind and just at the moment of the wedding ceremony he runs away to take refuge in Nancy's arms. The professional abandons the comforts of his home and work to go and live in a car.
notes: Comedy set in the world of the hippies supported by a good script and a credible interpretation.

title: Lost Continent
actors: Cesar Romero, Hillary Booke, Chick Chandler
description: During an atomic propulsion experiment, a missile escapes the radio control of the operators. A plane with three officers and three scientists is sent to search the area where the missile is believed to have landed. As the plane flies over an island, all of the plane's instruments cease to function following an inexplicable magnetic storm. The plane is forced to make a crash landing. On the island, the crew learns that the missile has fallen on the top of a mountain overlooking the village, and the group of scientists, at the end of the climb, discover a fantastic world ...
notes: Science fiction film made in an era still without electronic aids and special effects.

title: Mi ricordo, sì io mi ricordo...
actors: Marcello Mastroianni
description: Federico Fellini's mother frying two eggs for her son and his favorite actor, the notes of "Polever di stelle", a girl he met before the war, the holidays in the Dolomites, the drawings of his daughter Chiara still a child, the worst film and the many masterpieces ...
notes: In an apparent disorder parade the memories of one of the greatest Italian actors, Marcello Mastroianni, staged by his latest partner, Anna Maria Tatò, a director of not insignificant fame even before meeting the actor. Long overview of a life condensed into 4 hours of film.

title: Here Comes Mr. Jordan
actors: Robert Montgomery, Evelyn Keyes, Claude Rains
description: For an excess of zeal, a bungling angel takes away the soul of a boxer prematurely: even if the man was in a bad mood, his time had not yet come. In Heaven it is arranged that the unfortunate return to Earth reincarnating as a billionaire victim of his wife's plots, and later, more rightly, in another boxer.
notes: Seven nominations, but only two Oscars: subject and screenplay.

title: An Unfinished Affair
actors: Jennie Garth, Tim Matheson, Leigh Taylor-Young, Peter Facinelli
description: Blaine Connor, a faithful and devoted husband, has made his biggest mistake by having a relationship with Sheila, a woman much younger than him. He fell into his arms when his wife Cynthia was seriously ill and he needed comfort and tenderness; but now that the woman has recovered she feels she has made a mistake. But Sheila does not resign herself to being left after a story that she believed to be true and lasting and decides to take revenge. Thus establishes a relationship with Rick, Blaine's son and in the guise of the boy's official girlfriend he introduces himself to his parents.
notes: More than a thriller, Rod Hardy's film seems, for the amount of gimmicks and dramatic twists, a brilliant comedy sprinkled with eroticism with a surprise ending.

title: Calendar Girl Murders
actors: Tom Skerritt, Robert Culp, Sharon Stone, Barbara Parkins
description: The police are investigating the mysterious death of Miss January, playmate of "Playboy" magazine. But when Miss February is also murdered, the detective, assigned to the case, realizes that it is a serial killer who has planned to kill all the girls on the calendar. How to stop it before ... March?
notes: Quite original subject and a young Sharon Stone who does all she can to get noticed so much that she was cast in the same year for "Allan Quatermain and the mines of King Solomon". The analysis of the Playmate world is investigated with precision and punctuality, it is a pity that the tension in the end tends to subside.

title: Un complicato intrigo di donne, vicoli e delitti
actors: Angela Molina, Tommaso Bianco, Francisco Rabal, Mario Scarpetta, Harvey Keitel
description: Nunziata, a former prostitute, receives the sight of a criminal who, while trying to rape her, is killed. We immediately think of a settling of scores and Nunziata thus ends up under the "protection" of a Camorra gang. Meanwhile, a large batch of drugs arrives on the Neapolitan market and murders similar to the first follow one another at a fast pace. Nunziata's ten-year-old son has also ended up in drugs, while an Italian-American criminal tries to induce the woman to run away with him ...
notes: At times farcical, at times plethoric, excessively loaded, speckish enough: in short, typically Wertmüllerian. But that's not a compliment.

title: Padre papà
actors: Antonio Sabato jr, Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Calogero Zambito
description: Vincenzino by chance witnesses a mafia murder and a killer puts himself on his trail to eliminate him. One day, the child presents himself in the parish of Father Giuseppe and reveals that he is the son of him and Luisa, a young fellow countryman that his father loved in his youth before taking his votes. The priest puts himself in search of his mother ...

title: Rumble in the Bronx - Hung faan kui
actors: Jackie Chan, Françoise Yip, Anita Mui
description: Inspector Keung is in New York for his uncle's wedding and ends up, as usual, in trouble. He seduces the girl of a gang of thugs and finds in his hands the stolen diamonds that are tempting even a dangerous gang of supervillains.
notes: Lucky trip overseas for Jackie Chan who, with this film, conquered American audiences. On the other hand, it cannot be said that it has also conquered the Italian public. The plot is pure idiocy, but, at times, it works; especially when Jackie performs kung fu between supermarket trolleys and refrigerators. The Chinese title means "Red Indians Territory".

title: Io piaccio - La via del successo con le donne
actors: Walter Chiari, Dorian Gray, Mario Carotenuto, Riccardo Billi, Tina Pica
description: In the chemical laboratory of the industrialist Tassinetti, Dr. Maldi has developed a new discovery based on hormones that should give courage even to the most fearful. Convinced of his own discovery, Maldi experiments with the preparation on himself, but soon realizes that the effect is different from what he hoped for: instead of courageous, the serum makes him an irresistible Don Juan ...
notes: The original idea is scarce, the realization even more scarce.

title: Ilona llega con la lluvia
actors: Margarita Rosa de Francisco, Humberto Dorado, Imanol Arias
description: Maqroll is an unscrupulous adventurer and in possession of a Cypriot passport, Ilona is a charming Trieste-born, Abdul is a Lebanese shipowner. The heterogeneous group plans to buy a ship and continue trading undisturbed. While the owner is in prison, the other two open a brothel in Panama with the intention of financing themselves. Business is all too good, but it happens that Larissa, a prostitute, fascinates Ilona ...
notes: Cabrera's third direction is taken from the homonymous short story by Alvaro Mutis, but he fails to maintain the refined baroque style of the book. It all boils down to an obvious soap opera in which cliché is king. The song by Fabrizio De André, taken from a poem by Mutis, which accompanies the film, is splendid instead "Enormous prayer".

title: L'affittacamere
actors: Gloria Guida, Lino Banfi, Adolfo Celi, Enzo Cannavale, Vittorio Caprioli, Luciano Salce
description: Giorgia and Angela, two sisters, inherit a villa with a garden near Bologna from a noble aunt. The building is dilapidated and in need of a radical restoration. To find the necessary money, the two women decide to transform the villa into a pension that soon becomes famous for the ease of Giorgia's costumes. Numerous clients arrive in search of adventures, but a severe magistrate, moralizer of morals, also focuses his eyes on the hotel. Too bad that among the customers there is also his wife with her lover ...
notes: Itchy comedy, as they used to say at the time, when the maximum of cinematic transgression was a little poop in the wind. Now it just makes you yawn.

title: Confidances à un inconnu
actors: Sandrine Bonnaire, William Hurt, Jerzy Radziwilowicz, Denis Siniavski
description: We are in Petersburg in 1907. The beautiful Natalia (Bonnaire), widow of a dentist, accused of being the murderer of her husband confides in a stranger (Hurt) who saved her from the assault of a Cossack. In reality, the confidant is directly interested in the crime. However, this does not prevent him from falling in love with the woman.
notes: Subject and script are absolutely wasted, the performers, William Hurt and Sandrine Bonnaire at the time at the height of their love story, are just enough. The mature George Bardawil directs with little sense of yellow. Need to add more?

title: The Night Flier
actors: Miguel Ferrer, Julie Entwisle, Dan Monahan, Michael H. Moss
description: Richard Dees works for the tabloid "Inside View" and, just to clarify what he thinks, he used to say: "When my wife has finished reading it, I sheath the cat cassette: she absorbs the pee which is a pleasure". The journalist is on the trail of a serial killer who sucks every drop of blood from his victims and then departs aboard a black Cessna that sows worms and plasma at will ...
notes: From the story _The Night Flyer_ by Stephen King, a decent B series horror film directed by a young rookie. The ending overturns the journalist's axiom: "Never believe what you publish, never publish what you believe in".

title: Restoration
actors: Robert Downey jr., Polly Walker, Meg Ryan, Hugh Grant
description: 17th century. Robert Merivel becomes physicist as modern medicine is breaking out of the superstitions of the past. Arriving at the court of Charles II, the doctor is taken by the sensitivity of the ruler.
notes: The visual magnificence is impressive: through a mighty productive effort, Hollywood gives us its vision of the British Restoration, when, after Cromwell's death, the monarchy returned to the throne. In the film even capricious magnificences appear that Charles had imagined, but (not even he) had managed to pay for himself (like the arrival of the favorite on a huge swan-shaped boat, in the throne room invaded by the waters). Think of all the baroque possible, from Greenaway's "Compton House" to "King George's Madness", from Lester's "Three Musketeers" saga to Brook's "Marat-Sade", all fused through the trace of a Rose novel Treiman. Too bad that in the film each of these references pulls on their side, with a jarring and fluctuating result.

title: Albino Alligator
actors: Matt Dillon, Faye Dunaway, Gary Sinise, Viggo Mortensen, Joe Mantegna, William Fichtner
description: A ramshackle trio of thugs take refuge in a bar after the usual robbery gone wrong. Desperate for a way out, the three take five people hostage who have the misfortune of being in the room at that moment. Federal agents and the New Orleans police immediately surround the crime scene and the three robbers begin a long and grueling negotiation based on the misunderstanding of an identity exchange.
notes: After a beginning of action with the beautiful sequence of a car crash taken from above, the work is transformed and takes on "chamber" rhythms, echoing the heavy silences and tension of "That afternoon of a dog day". Winner of the "Noir in Festival '97" of Courmayeur. Promising debut.

title: Nénette et Boni
actors: Grégoire Colin, Alice Houri, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Vincent Gallo
description: Boni is a pizza maker in Marseille, lives in a strange hovel, pursues his dreams and refuses relationships with others. But one day his sister Nenette arrives in his refuge, who has run away from the boarding school where her father has placed her. Relations between the two young people are not easy.
notes: The charm of the film is based above all on the skill of the young leading actors. The multi-ethnic background is perhaps more interesting than private history, but it is appreciable that the film does not seek calligraphic preciousness, even harshly rendering the complexity of private situations.

title: Crescendo
actors: Stefanie Powers, James Olson, Jane Lapotaire, Joss Ackland
description: Susan, an American music student, is hosted in France in the villa of the widow of a composer on which she is working on her degree thesis. The house, however, hides a terrible secret that Susan discovers firsthand and with great terror. Why didn't she immediately listen to the composer's paralyzed son who urged her to leave the villa immediately?
notes: British production, but with little or nothing of the proverbial Anglo-Saxon black humor.

title: Cronaca familiare
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Jacques Perrin, Salvo Randone
description: Enrico, a journalist, receives a phone call announcing the death of his younger brother, Dino. In the throes of pain, she recalls the main stages of their difficult life, starting from childhood, very poor and desolate after the death of their parents. In the following years, various vicissitudes of destiny kept them separated for a long time even if, in the brief moments of life together, their bond had always been strengthened.
notes: Zurlini's melancholy but dry apologue about a generation that, between fascism, war and post-war years, had only known defeats. From the novel of the same name by Vasco Pratolini, one of Mastroianni's most intense interpretations.

title: The Betsy
actors: Laurence Olivier, Robert Duvall, Katharine Ross, Tommy Lee Jones
description: Loren Hardemann Senior, an old patriarch of the Bethlehem Motors of Detroit, despite the age and the wheelchair, has a dream, that of realizing a revolutionary car. The car, suitable for the oil and financial crisis, should be called "Betsy" as the old -fashioned of the old man. The project goes on with difficulty, due to the disputes and misunderstandings that take place within the family.
notes: Based on the novel by Harold Robbins, the film, despite the presence of Laurence Olivier, ends up being an anticipator of the various soap work that would shortly invaded Italian television.

title: Madonna: Innocence Lost
actors: Terumi Matthews, Dean Stockwell, Wendie Malick, Diana Leblanc
description: The film traces a part of the life of the rock star Madonna: from her arrival in New York in 1978 until 1984, the year that saw her debut with "Like a Virgin", the album that brought her to the attention of the international audience.
notes: Frankly, we did not feel the need for a film that would tell us in detail the beginnings of Mrs. Ciccone, but for the fans of the time it was perhaps fine.

title: Segreto di stato
actors: Massimo Ghini, Isabel Russinova, Massimo Dapporto, Mariella Valentini
description: The responsibility for a mafia attack is placed on an upright police officer, Beppe Fossati, who, however, manages to avoid capture. In a daring way, and with the help of a few trusted friends, he manages to slowly bring out the evidence of the guilt of some unsuspected, the same ones who staged the plot against him to put him out of the game.
notes: There is little to expect from a TV product about the mafia other than the usual string of clichés about the genre seasoned with some good dose of violence. Ferrara had started from the cinema of denunciation with "The stone in the mouth" and then slipped lower and lower.

title: Bound for Glory
actors: David Carradine, Ronny Cox, Melinda Dillon, Gail Strickland
description: We are in 1936 in the United States of the Great Depression. Woody Guthrie, who paints shop signs and plays guitar as a hobby to make ends meet, leaves his wife Mary and their two little girls. He leaves Texas and tries to reach California in search of fortune. Joining other desperate people like him and after various vicissitudes he finds work as a fruit collector. But discontent is at its peak among the wage earners and there is already talk of a strike. Guthrie, who in the meantime has made friends with the singer Orzak, thanks to him manages to win a contract with a local radio.
notes: Ashby recounts three years of the life of the well-known American folk singer referring to documentary material from vintage newsreels. The film, based on the autobiography written by Woody himself and adapted for the screen by Robert Getchell, won two Oscars for photography and for best non-original score. The original duration was 147 minutes.

title: Project Alf
actors: John Schuck, Martin Sheen, William O'Leary, Jensen Daggett
description: Five years after the task force in charge of capturing the aliens has captured Alf, a strange being from space, a special commission is asked, led by General Myron Stone, who must decide his future. But while Colonel Milfoil insists on the fact that Alf can represent a threat to humanity, two young scientists, after having subjected the alien to psychological exams, are absolutely convinced of his non -dangerousness.
notes: Television films based on the situation comedy that brings the same title and which successfully broadcast in Italy.

title: The Saint
actors: Val Kilmer, Elisabeth Shue, Rade Serbedzija, Henry Goodman
description: In a boarding school, a difficult and lonely child chooses to give up his name to become Simon Templar. Growing up, he becomes a cynical spy, skilled in transformism, in the pay of the highest bidder. At least until fate puts a charming English scientist in his way, who will have to approach, seduce and ... rob!
notes: In the 60s and 70s he had the face of Roger Moore. In Noyce's hands, Simon Templar takes on the guise of Val Kilmer. After a good prologue, the film lets itself be harnessed in a manneristic love story. The less convincing parts overwhelm the pretty Elisabeth Shue, while the disguises are slaughtered by a laughable dub.

title: Perfect Friday
actors: Ursula Andress, Stanley Baker, David Warner, Patience Collier
description: Forty-year-old Graham, deputy director of the London office of the National Metropolitan Bank, is, on the surface, a perfect example of a banker. In reality, he contemplates relieving his clients with a truly diabolical plan. Will he succeed?
notes: Pleasant English play directed by Peter Hall, based on a short story by C. Scott Forbes.

title: Female Perversion
actors: Tilda Swinton, Amy Madigan, Karen Sillas, Dale Shuger
description: Eve Stephens is a career woman who aspires to fill the prestigious role of judge. His lidibine has to deal with the passion for chocolate, for a vulgar man and for a psychoanalyst approached in an elevator. But the thing that makes her suffer the most are disturbing dreams (seeing her face covered in mud, being poised on a rope) that haunt her.
notes: An intellectual "Emmanuelle", obviously directed by a woman, such Susan Streitfeld who has seen fit to buy the rights to the book by Louise Kaplan, whose title, "Female Perversion: the Temptations of Emma Bovary" is all a program.

title: Corridors of Blood
actors: Boris Karloff, Betta St. John, Finlay Currie, Christopher Lee
description: We are in the nineteenth century and an English doctor is conducting experiments on anesthetics. He becomes so involved that he becomes addicted to it and comes to desecrate the tombs to continue his experiments.
notes: The film was released in theaters only in 1960, when Christopher Lee, who has a supporting role here, managed to obtain from the production company a compensation adequate to his fame. It was originally called "The Doctor from Seven Dials".

title: Le colt cantarono la morte e fu... tempo di massacro
actors: Franco Nero, George Hilton, Nino Castelnuovo, Lynn Shayne
description: Tom responds to the call of Carradine, an old friend of the family and decides to return to the town he left as a child. Here he finds his brother Slim brutalized by alcohol, his family's farm and every business in the hands of Scott, a brutal landlord surrounded by an army of men who obey him in every way. Tom immediately tries to get first-hand information from Silm, who insists on keeping silent, and then from Carradine, who is exterminated with the whole family by Scott's men.
notes: Spaghetti-western almost ironic in its exhilarated reinterpretation of stereotypes. Written by Fernando di leo, with a song by Sergio Endrigo.

title: Black Patch
actors: George Montgomery, Diane Brewster, Tom Pittman
description: An honest sheriff puts a robber in jail, even though he is his friend. An accomplice of the malefactor has the hiding place of the loot revealed, then makes him escape and kills him, placing the blame on the sheriff.

title: Mother's Boys
actors: Jamie Lee Curtis, Peter Gallagher, Joanne Whalley
description: After three years of unjustified absence, Jude Madigan returns home demanding the forgiveness and affection of her three children and her husband Robert. Meanwhile, he has fallen in love with the vice principal of the school his children attend, Callie. Jude gets permission to see his children and begins to weave his underhanded plot to win back the boys and to resume the relationship with Robert. Jude tries to plagiarize his eldest son and with the children organizes a sort of "trial" against his rival.
notes: The thrilling is conducted with great tension even if often drawn in strong colors. Jamie Lee Curtis as Jude is compelling.

title: Clambake
actors: Elvis Presley, Shelley Fabares, Will Bixby
description: To prove that he is able to fend for himself, the young Heyward, the son of an oilman, exchanges his name and occupation with his friend Tom Wilson who works as a lifeguard for a living. One of the more modest Elvid films, albeit full of songs. But it was no longer the golden age.

title: House on Telegraph Hill
actors: Richard Basehart, Valentina Cortese, William Ludigan
description: In a Nazi concentration camp, two women make friends. When one dies the other assumes its identity. At the end of the war, the latter leaves for America in search of her friend's child. Here she meets and marries the child's guardian, but soon realizes that the man tries by all means to eliminate her and the child in order to take possession of a large inheritance. How do you get by?
notes: Direction, performers, subject and screenplay would seem, at least on paper, bombproof. Yet in the cinematographic implementation a little bit gets stuck here and there. Too bad, even if it is ... venial sin.

title: The Frighteners
actors: Michael J. Fox, Trini Alvarado, Peter Dobson, John Astin, Jeffrey Combs
description: A boy with paranormal powers is helped by three ghosts to stop, by coming into contact with the beyond, a dangerous serial killer. In the meantime, our hero manages to free the home of a young widow haunted by uneasy presences.
notes: Without moving from New Zealand, but with a Hollywood superb budget guaranteed by the production of Zemeckis, Jackson is unleashed with gigantic ectoplasms, melancholy ghosts, with a very rapid, dark and sinuous Death. Decided "divertissment" (and, towards the end, mockery of the cinematic fashion of serial killers), "Sospesi nel tempo" tries to merge the fantastic fabulous of Zemeckis (also thanks to Michael J. Fox) and the ironic splatter, the grand Jackson's zany guignol. But the operation in the end was not completely successful: the film shoots in different directions, without ever being really scary.

title: That Thing You Do!
actors: Tom Everett Scott, Liv Tyler, Johnathon Schaech, Steve Zahn
description: In the summer of 1964, Guy was a clerk at his father's electrical appliance store in Pennsylvania. But at night he sits on the drums and starts playing jazz music. A local rock band, who missed the drummer, asks him to replace him. A month goes by and "The Wonders" are now part of the firmament of rock.
notes: Tom Hanks makes his debut in screenplay and directing (and holds a small part). By now, the rock biography has become a definite trend, and, from Hanks, it was reasonable to expect something more than a watered-down portrait of American "nostalgia". More "Happy Days" (but less fun) than Anders' "Grace of My Heart".

title: The Chamber
actors: Gene Hackman, Chris O'Donnell, Faye Dunaway, Lela Rochon
description: Just under a month to go until Sam Cayhall, who is being held on death row at Parchman, Mississippi, will be executed for the murder of two children killed with a bomb in 1967. While he counts the days that separate him from sentencing. , Sam, a staunch racist, receives a visit from Adam Hall, a young and inexperienced lawyer. The professional tries to save this diehard racist to give his life meaning, as Adam is Sam's nephew.
notes: A trip to death row; but also a reminder of racial hatred in the southern United States. The film, based on Grisham, is actually a partially wasted opportunity by a director who hardly dares and by the unhappy choice of Chris O'Donnell (the young lawyer), nullifying the extraordinary proof of Gene Hackman.

title: Welcome to Hard Times
actors: Henry Fonda, Janice Rule, Keenan Wynn, John Anderson, Aldo Ray, Janis Paige
description: A mysterious bandit wreaks havoc in a small western town, burning houses and killing people. Molly, the saloon girl, also takes a big risk, but is saved. Mayor Blue tries to restore serenity and succeeds until, months later, the mysterious dandit returns. The new massacre is even more violent than the first, but this time there are those who are determined to make him pay.
notes: From a novel by E.L. Doctorow, is Kennedy's best western, an excellent screenwriter for Boetticher and an often uncertain director. An adult and metaphorical western, with a palpable tension happily combined with features of strong realism.

title: Bound
actors: Jennifer Tilly, Gina Gershon, Joe Pantoliano
description: Chicago, the city of Al Capone and the night of Valentine's Day, sixty years later. Violet is the submissive woman of a mala boss. Corki a thief, bailed out after yet another arrest, who gets by as the plumber can. The two women get to know each other and, upon discovering they love each other, they discover they can make money by getting their hands on a hefty amount of money that Violet's boyfriend has to hand over to his boss, but the twists and turns are behind the angle...
notes: Voyeuristic enough, under the pretext of the Sapphic relationship, the balance between eroticism and suspense, ends up not going to end either on one side or the other.

title: 2 Days in the Valley
actors: Danny Aiello, James Spader, Greg Cruttwell, Jeff Daniels, Teri Hatcher, Eric Stoltz
description: Around the idiosyncrasies of two paid killers, one efficient, paranoid and obsessed with time and the other a bit rusty because long out of the loop, revolves a whole series of comic characters, spanning two days in the San Ferdinando Valley. Frustrated cops, failed directors, depressed art dealers, black widows, harassed secretaries find themselves crossing the lives of the two killers until the inevitable settling of scores.
notes: Little Tarantinos grow up. Written and directed by television director John Herzfeld, it is another film that fits into the path traced by "Pulp Fiction". The director is good and knows all the tricks of editing, demonstrating that he has assimilated the lessons of Truffaut and Demme, manipulating a plot that is not excellent, which counts on a decent cast with an extraordinary Danny Aiello, a gentleman killer and good feelings.

title: Viagem ao principio do mundo
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Jean-Yves Gautier, Leonor Silveira
description: There are four characters at the start of the car journey. Alfonso a French actor of Portuguese origin who wants to go to his father's village to meet his still life aunt, the director and two actors from the film that the latter is shooting. The director (Mastroianni) Manoel is old, sharp and philosophical, and always wears the typical De Oliveria hat and crewneck pullover.
notes: The first half hour is a long opening. For the spectator who has the patience and curiosity to overcome it, the wing stroke arrives: from the moment Alfonso meets his austere and stubborn aunt and her husband, we are immediately immersed in a very lively atmosphere, the saudade, as a literary, it becomes a feeling of real loss and the words and faces acquire an authentic depth. We laugh, we are moved, we recognize ourselves, with a kind of calmed nostalgia. A priceless blend of sensitivity and intelligence.

title: Lady and the Tramp
directors: Clyde Geronimi, Wilfred Jackson, Hamilton Luske
description: She, Lilli, is a cocker spaniel, spoiled, plump, in love with her owners. He, the Vagabond, is a swashbuckling stray and heartthrob, who for nothing in the world would give up his freedom. The birth of a baby at home puts Lilli in crisis, who feels neglected. He decides to run away from home with the Vagabond. Their intervention will be decisive when the child is in danger.
notes: They are Lilli (Lady in the original) and the Vagabond, the canine couple imagined by Walt Disney in 1955. Based on a story by Ward Greene and set in Victorian England (where the shadow of a kennel that is the antechamber of the death), "Lady and the Vagabond" is the prototype on which the subsequent "Charge of 101" and "The Aristocats" (practically a "feline remake") were modeled. The great idea is to make the cartoon in Cinemascope, which with its horizontal format allows you to place everything at dog height (humans are only framed from the waist down). The "character actors" (the other dogs, noble or beggars) are priceless. Noteworthy is the choir of the unfortunates of the kennel, the perfidious Siamese cats, the convict spaghetti. A Disney doc and anything but dull.

title: The Twelfth Night
actors: Ben Kingsley, Helena Bonham Carter, Imogen Stubbs, Nigel Hawthorne, Steven Mackintosh, Nicholas Farrell, Sidney Livingstone, James Walker, Mel Smith, Imelda Staunton, Toby Stephens, Alan Mitchell, Peter Gunn, Richard E. Grant, Tim Bentinck
description: Viola, disguised as a boy, falls in love with Prince Orsino, who loves Countess Olivia, who falls in love with Viola; only when Viola's twin, Sebastian comes out, can two "regular" couples form. All around, jesters, servants, drunken relatives; and on all the beautiful Cornish background between roughness and Pre-Raphaelite softness.
notes: Yet another Shakespearean reduction, set in the Victorian age. In reality, it is rather boring, oppressed in the first part by an incessant musical column, and by the movements of the camera and rather confused riders, as if to try to make cinema "visibly". However, it has to its bow, of course, the brilliant cunning of the Shakespearean text, which plays shamelessly with sexual misunderstandings.

title: Grizzly Adams and the Legend of Dark Mountain
actors: Tom Tayback, Lindsay Bloom, John Campanella, Jennifer Waldman
description: The professor. Hunnicat and his shady associates want to take possession of the gold mine discovered on Dark Mountain, a sacred place of the Indians. To achieve their goal, Hunnicat and his men take the Indian culture scholar Brummet hostage. Rebecca, wife of the latter, Grizzly Adams, a half-breed who lives in the woods, and Dolce Tempesta, an Indian who wants to give birth in the sacred place, are however on the trail of the kidnappers ...

title: Two Bits
actors: Al Pacino, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Gerlando Barone
description: In Philadelphia, August 26, 1933 is an unforgettable day for 12-year-old Gennaro. Busy to find twenty-five cents to attend the first show of the La Paloma cinema, thanks to his dying grandfather, the boy discovers the essence of life. After confessing to him that he has seen heaven and looks like La Paloma, the last words of his grandfather are: "Wish, wish!". And the young Gennaro goes to the midnight show.
notes: The world of feelings, the love for cinema and its myths are at the center of the film that sometimes manages to move, even if held back by an excessively dull screenplay and a dull direction. Wrapped in the warm photograph of a summer afternoon, trapped in a "cherry garden", there is also Al Pacino engaged in an unusual role.

title: American Buffalo
actors: Dustin Hoffman, Dennis Franz, Sean Nelson
description: The world of the owner of a trinket shop is upset by an opportunistic and diabolical character who leads him, day after day, on the path of violence and betrayal of the principles that govern everyday life. Don thinks he's made a bad deal with a careful customer who's committed to discovering hidden treasures in the mountain of junk that fills his shop. The second-hand dealer is in fact convinced that he was duped by the customer who had paid a very high price in order to grab the coin with a buffalo's head imprinted on it.
notes: The film is illuminated by a great Dustin Hoffman, in a character that refers to those played in two films that marked his career, Schlesinger's "A Man from the Sidewalk" and Schlöndorff's "Death of a Salesman": always ready for merciless and silent foreground, to the controlled explosion, to the all interior suffering. Hoffman is very fond of the text written by David Mamet twenty years ago. In reality, closed in a single space, with only three characters (the third is the very young Bobby), "American Buffalo" would have required a more daring and sinuous direction, more openly claustrophobic; the cruel one of Altman in his best moments or, perhaps, the meticulous one of Mamet himself. Too bad, because the two protagonists are extraordinary.

title: Profundo carmesí
actors: Regina Orozco, Daniel Gimenez Cacho, Marisa Paredes
description: Mexico 1949, Coral Fabre, a prosperous young nurse alone raises two children and is a die-hard fan of French actor Charles Boyer. While in a shop, the woman sees a poster that portrays the actor Nicolas Estrella, Boyer lookalike. Coral, writes to Nicolas and offers him an appointment. When the meeting takes place, the woman abandons her children and begins a new life with Nicolas.
notes: In 1970, a refined American independent, Leonard Kastle, directed a low-budget baddie noir, "Honeymoon Killers," the story of a fat and sexy nurse and her lover who ran across America slaughtering widows. The story of "Profundo carmesì" is inspired by the same news story. Baroque, fleshy and "fragrant", the film by the Mexican Ripstein is less perverse and decisive than one might expect, certainly less disturbing than that of Kastle. A film that is too long, too in love with a Latin sensuality, not radical enough in its grotesque choice.

title: Grosse Pointe Blank
actors: John Cusack, Minnie Driver, Dan Aykroyd, Alan Arkin, Joan Cusack
description: Martin is a highly sought after and foolproof professional killer. However, despite the satisfactions, he begins to realize that his life still lacks meaning. To find himself he decides to return to his hometown of Grosse Pointe in Michigan, on the occasion of the ten-year reunion with his old high school friends. There he plans to reunite with his one-time girlfriend, Debi, and to complete one last "chore".
notes: Eighties music, dialogues that sometimes come close to Woody Allen, explicit quotations from Tarantino. But the impression is that the real references are the dry and bad noir of the Seventies (Boorman, Corman, Siegel), the caustic cynicism of Demme and the icy irony of "Rischiose Habits" by Frears. Interesting work by over-fifty Armitage, veteran of the B series, who began with Corman and returned to the cinema in '90 with "Miami Blues" produced by Demme.

title: That Old Feeling
actors: Bette Midler, Dennis Farina, Paula Marshall, Gail O'Grady, David Rasche
description: She is an actress, he is a successful writer. The divorce came after a difficult relationship, characterized by daily quarrels. The daughter, betrothed to an emerging politician, insists on having them both at the wedding, along with their new partners. The two spark, then the story takes an unexpected turn.
notes: Typical sophisticated comedy, with Bette Midler the absolute star and a ferocious satire of American politics. One joke is particularly apt: "If you've never cheated on me, then the Kennedys are loyal too." Reiner specializes in comedy, but has never managed to get past an average level.

title: A Month by the Lake
actors: Vanessa Redgrave, Edward Fox, Uma Thurman, Alessandro Gassmann, Alida Valli
description: Miss Bentley, a middle-aged English photographer, spends her usual April vacation in a hotel on Lake Como. We are in 1937 and, surrounded by the echoes of the fascist Italina preparing for war, the young lady falls in love with Major Paul Wilshaw, with whom she embarks on an exhausting amorous skirmish. But the woman is the object of the attentions of an Italian boy, while the eldest would like to conquer a young American housekeeper.
notes: Based on a novel by H.E. Bates of the Sixties, the film is boring and affected and the good acting performances of Vanessa Redgrave, Edward Fox and Alida Valli and not even the extraordinary photography of Pasqualino De Santis are not enough to ennoble it.

title: Crossworlds
actors: Josh Charles, Rutger Hauer, Andrea Roth, Stuart Wilson
description: Being wary of inheritances is what the young Joseph should have done when he got into trouble by an amber crystal left to him by his father. The crystal combined with the scepter of Dairachun is in fact the magic key that guarantees its owner control of all the space / time dimensions of the universe. The unsuspecting Joseph is then involved by Laura and AT, two members of the resistance against the Warlords, in a dangerous struggle for the freedom of dimensions.
notes: Oscillating between Philip K. Dick's fascinating theories of parallel universes and the jumbled time / space travel of Terry Gilliam's Time Bandits, it's actually a film with no rhyme or reason. With a patchy script and performers who seem to be saying like Bruce Chatwin "What am I doing here?", The film fails even to offer itself as an idiotic reading of the genre and it is sad to see Rutger Hauer close to retirement.

title: The Truth About Cats & Dogs
actors: Uma Thurman, Janeane Garofalo, Ben Chaplin, Jamie Foxx
description: To make ends meet, photographer Brian shoots his flashes on Great Danes with roller skates for some advertising campaign. Abby, on the other hand, loves animals seriously: she is a veterinarian and hosts a radio show giving advice to anyone who wants "the truth about cats and dogs" (as the original title of the film reads). Brian, after a persuasive live call, falls in love with the woman's voice. Trouble comes from Noelle, an explosive blonde who, for the love of friendship, takes the place of ugly Abby.
notes: Lehmann ("Splinters of Madness") here removes the cynicism for a dip in confused feelings. Obviously, but good interpreters.

title: Brillantina rock
actors: Monty Garrison, Cecilia Bonocore, Auretta Gai, Mauro Frittella
description: Roby, a penniless suburban boy, loves dancing, Sandra and her Russian-made sidecar with which he roams the streets of the town. But when in the disco he meets the American Sindy, the daughter of an industrialist who is in Milan on business, he ends up losing his mind and, for her, he fights with the wealthy Rick. The challenge between the two continues aboard two cars with great risk for a friend of Roby's who at the last moment had the unfortunate idea of ??taking his place.
notes: Scraping, even in the names of the protagonists, of the overwhelming success of "Grease", released the year before.

title: To Gillian on Her 37th Birthday
actors: Peter Gallagher, Michelle Pfeiffer, Claire Danes, Wendy Crewson
description: Over the Labor Day weekend, the Lewis family gathers on the island of Nantucket: there's David, his teenage daughter Rachel, and brothers-in-law Esther and Paul. It is the anniversary of the death of Gillian, David's wife, who disappeared in a boating accident two years earlier, on her birthday. The husband has never resigned himself to this shocking loss and is increasingly depressed. Hoping to help him overcome the pain, Paul and Esther bring an attractive young woman with them.
notes: Elaboration of the impossible mourning that only Spielberg with his "Always" was able to reinterpret cinematically without forcing the spectators to melt in tears to ask for damages to some funeral parlor. Here, unfortunately, the effect is quite different: we use the ax, unbearable music and a Peter Gallagher on a mediocre journey towards "Beautiful".

title: Things I Never Told You
actors: Lili Taylor, Andrew McCarthy, Alexis Arquette, Debi Mazar
description: Ann, a young and quiet saleswoman of a photographic material store in the American province, receives a phone call from Prague: it is her partner, on a business trip, who decrees the end of their relationship. Consequences: a bottle of acetone for the nails swallowed instead of the usual beer, a hospital, a psychologist willing to help her and a "hope line". At "Telefono Amico" there is Don, a volunteer to exorcise an unhappiness that - we will know later - derives from a mother in a coma and a frozen father.
notes: "Love is proof that God has a sense of humor": the phrase - which the director peeks out of a car along with others on road signs - is by Joe Jackson: the (Catalan) author Coixet tries to explain it by ninety minutes with a step in the purest minimalist style. The ending is one that only cinema can afford, the surrounding characters are barely mentioned but not trivial, the romantic inspiration intervenes ironic and punctual.

title: The Ogre
actors: Armin Mueller-Stahl, John Malkovich, Gottfried John, Volker Spengler
description: Abel is so pure in spirit that he can't even think that his attraction to children would raise doubts about him. He, who works as a mechanic in a garage, loves photographing a girl he befriended and is overwhelmed by horror when she accuses him of sexual harassment. Fortunately, the story gives him the opportunity to make a new life. We are in fact in 1939.
notes: Schlöndorff describes "The Ogre" as "a fairy tale, a grotesque film, a great German comic opera", inspired by expressionism, Leni Riefenstahl and Veit Harlan. But it is one of those slightly pompous films that seem to be born already old, where the poetic inspiration and the metaphorical intent are manifested with massive grandeur and cancel the dark dimension of the imagination. As a complaint from the title (which is English), a European co-production, where everything is predictable and "fake".

title: I quattro dell'Apocalisse
actors: Fabio Testi, Lynne Frederick, Tomas Milian, Michael J. Pollard, Harry Baird, Adolfo Lastretti, Bruno Corazzari, Giorgio Trestini, Donald O'Brien
description: The characters in the title are the cheater and ex-convict Stubby, the pregnant prostitute Bunny, the negro Burt and the drunkard Clem. After escaping a massacre perpetrated in their village by a hooded gang, the four wander the desert where they meet the ferocious Chaco who rapes Bunny and kills Clem while Burt goes mad. But the troubles of the gang are not over.
notes: From some short stories by Francis Brett Harte, a mediocre western spaghetti.

title: La vendetta
actors: Louis De Funès, Francis Blanche, Marisa Merlini, Mario Carotenuto
description: A quiet village in the Corsican hinterland is shaken by the sudden death of the mayor. His deputy, at the head of a political faction in the country, and the relatives of the deceased, who lead another camp, immediately come forward to contend for the succession. The political brawl soon turns into armed war as the factions in the field call on American criminals of local origin and outlaw "doc" respectively for reinforcement. In the end, between the two quarrels ...
notes: Bad film from the heyday of De Funés, the comedian who made the French laugh. The original French title is in Italian because the film, taken from a short story by Henry Omessa entitled Le candidat Lauriston, is set on the Corsican island.

title: Quel ficcanaso dell'ispettore Lawrence
actors: Anthony Steffen, Antonio Pica, Maria Kosti, Raf Baldassarre
description: Inspector Lawrence, special agent of the Anti-narcotics Section, is sent to Lisbon for the recognition of the body of a colleague who died under very unclear circumstances. After completing his duty, he pretends to take the plane, but instead stays in the Portuguese capital because someone has let him know they want to make revelations. From this moment on, all people who try to get in touch with him are mysteriously eliminated.
notes: An attempt at a crime film made in Italy directed under a pseudonym by Paolo Solvay, which partially disappoints all expectations. If the actors give it their all, the suspense is far too low.

title: Sidney Sheldon's Bloodline
actors: Audrey Hepburn, Ben Gazzara, James Mason, Omar Sharif, Romy Schneider, Claudia Mori, Gert Fröbe, Maurice Ronet, Michelle Phillips, Irene Papas, Beatrice Straight
description: Sam Roffe, founder and top executive of a chemical multinational, dies in mysterious circumstances. The management of his empire therefore passes temporarily to his only daughter who is soon joined by numerous relatives, as well as shareholders of the group, intending instead to sell off the company to face, each, their debts or their whims. Meanwhile, a policeman investigates Sam's death.
notes: Each of the too many holy monsters involved in the venture did so solely for food reasons. Morricone's music.

title: Petulia
actors: Julie Christie, George C. Scott, Richard Chamberlain, Arthur Hill
description: Archie, a well-known San Francisco doctor married with children, but on the verge of divorce, enters into a romantic relationship with Petulia, a woman dissatisfied with her marriage to the childish and abusive David. Discovering the place where the two are hiding, David takes out his anger as a betrayed husband on Petulia, reducing her to death.
notes: A bitter comedy based on the novel "Me and the Arch Kook Petulia" by John Haase. He directs, with a light but not superficial hand, the director of the Beatles. Photograph by Nicholas Roeg.

title: Mrs. Winterbourne
actors: Shirley MacLaine, Brendan Fraser, Ricki Lake, Miguel Sandoval
description: Connie, a girl without a family, leaves for New York in search of her fortune. The first meeting is with a bad guy who, within a few weeks, only manages to get her pregnant and kick her out of the house. On the eve of giving birth, the wretch ends up on a train to Boston, where she meets the scion of a powerful family: the Winterbourne. But the train derails, killing the young man and his fresh bride anxiously awaiting the heir.
notes: Far from the Hitchcock of "The other man", the little film of a Benjamin on vacation, despite the excellent starting point it is a sad and emblematic example of how excellent ingredients can be diluted in molasses.

title: Carpool
actors: Tom Arnold, Rod Steiger, David Paymer, Rhea Perlman, Kim Coates
description: In Seattle, a "Hammermans" confectionery shop is the subject of a robbery. Cornered by a series of clumsy misunderstandings, a certain Franklin Laszlo seizes a car carrying a man, his two children and three other terrible babies. Thus begins the chase by the police, who try by all means to stop the fugitive.
notes: Poor comedy by Hiller, which after the successes of the 70s and 80s now appears in evident debt of oxygen and ideas. It all boils down to a cheeky spotting of the Toyota MPV, the protagonist of authentic war routes through the streets of the city.

title: Small Faces
actors: Clare Higgins, Joseph McFadden, Steven Duffy, Iain Robertson
description: Set in Glasgow in 1968, the film is the story of the three MacLean brothers, 18, 17 and 13 years old told in first person by the young Lex, attracted, alternatively, by the shadowy and self-destructive vitality of his older brother and the passionate creativity of his middle brother. who dreams of entering the art institute.
notes: Yet another Scottish film on juvenile distress. The quotes are all right: from Terence Davis (in the family and in the cinema) to classic "angry", such as "Taste of Honey" by Richardson (in the large tank in the background). But what is missing overall is the anger, the destructive and controversial energy that runs from Lindsay Anderson to Gary Oldman. The script and the pace languish, despite honest intentions.

title: Como ser mujer y non morir en el intento
actors: Carmen Maura, Antonio Resines, Tina Sianz, Juan Diego Botto, Olaya Aguirre
description: Tired of her third husband, a man in love but somewhat numb, Carmen decides to leave him. But soon the two meet again and ...
notes: Almodovar-style film, with Carmen Maura (the protagonist of "Women on the verge of a nervous breakdown") but without Almodovar.

title: Mr. Saturday Night
actors: Billy Crystal, David Paymer, Julie Warner, Helen Hunt, Ron Silver
description: One day a New York enterteinment turns out to be aging and declining in popularity. In addition, his brother, who has always been his manager, suddenly decided to drop him and go to Florida.
notes: Billy Crystal gives us a Yiddish view of life and comedy. Too bad for the slightly too sugary finish. The actor, for his directorial debut, draws back an old character who had given him success on TV. Jerry Lewis appears in the role of himself.

title: 99 and 44/100% Dead
actors: Richard Harris, Edmond O'Brien, Bradford Dillman, Chuck Norris
description: In the city, the fight between gangsters belonging to rival gangs is in full swing and the river is full of corpses. Uncle Frank, a fearsome outlaw, calls to his aid Harry Crown, known by all as the ace of "private executioners". For his part, Big Eddie hires Marvin Zuckerman who, among other things, wants to take revenge on Harry who mutilated him. The two mastiffs are soon joined by two promising trigger-happy young men. Marvin and his partner take it out on the women of Uncle Frank's gang and Crown has to sweat a lot to save them from the clutches of their opponents.
notes: 70s action movie without infamy and without praise, from a director who did much better at the time.

title: Inherit the Wind
actors: Spencer Tracy, Fredric March, Gene Kelly, Dick York
description: Two famous lawyers, great friends, are called to court in a small town to sponsor two different factions. The Protestant pastor in fact denounced the elementary school teacher because he teaches Darwinian theories to children, thus indirectly opposing the Bible. The lawyers show off all their craft and the sentence ...
notes: Great proof of actors.

title: Bruno aspetta in macchina
actors: Nancy Brilli, Antonello Fassari, Leo Gullotta, Amanda Sandrelli
description: Riccardo and Margherita break up. He immediately consoles himself with the young Tweety, while she lives alone for a while in a loaned house in a big city. Then Riccardo begins to have doubts, but in the meantime Margherita has found a new partner, a rather mysterious type, one that is not seen around: one named Bruno.
notes: But maybe it is destiny that films like "Bruno waits in the car", or "Little misunderstandings" or "Sentimental maniacs", useless, stupid, of a catacombic joy, of one that can entertain the illustrious family or the fauna, continue to exist. of Cinecittà. Dialogues condemned to be witty, equivocal, personal exchanges, couples in crisis, neighborhood gossip and pathetic males, the triumph of stereotypes and the circle of specks.

title: Il decisionista
actors: Gian Marco Tognazzi, Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Luca Lionello
description: The film follows in the footsteps of a fixer, Gian Luigi Rossi, "the decision maker" in fact, who tries to thrive in the shadow of business bigger than himself. He is a man without ideals whose only purpose is money - the non-his billions that he administers in Switzerland, the boards of directors - and not even the passionate encounter with a journalist, engaged in an investigation aimed at unmasking the shady trafficking that surround him, he manages to redeem him.
notes: The - undisputed - optimism of the will of this film is continually disregarded by a screenplay that dispenses dialogues that smell of the most sinister common sense and that gives us a very superficial vision and reading of tangentopoli. Maria Grazia Cucinotta, the female lead, still has a long way to go.

title: Trees Lounge
actors: Anthony La Paglia, Steve Buscemi, Seymour Cassel, Chloë Sevigny
description: Leaning against the counter of a bar, with a large glass of beer and a small glass of scotch in front of them, they kill time like this, almost in the family: there is old Bill, perched on his personal stool, who occasionally loses his breath, but does not never leaves whiskey, a mature couple, the two bartenders Vic and Connie and Tommy, a likeable and idle young mechanic, who has lost his job and his girlfriend.
notes: Directorial debut by Steve Buscemi who has style, measure and clear ideas. Despite his friendship with Tarantino, his cinematographic reference model is above all Cassavetes, whose work with the actors and respect for the characters he admires and to whom he pays an explicit homage, choosing Seymour Cassel.

title: Solo
actors: Mario Van Peebles, William Sadler, Adrien Brody, Seidy Lopez
description: Solo is considered by all to be a perfect soldier. No type of martial art is unknown to him. He has no family or friends and, above all, he has no birth certificate. Should he be injured, he could be abandoned by his superiors without any problems. It looks like it is made of flesh and blood, but it is made of microchips and polymers and is the most advanced type of weapon out there.
notes: Take "The Magnificent Seven" (the exteriors were shot in Vera Cruz) and reduce it to a lab-built war machine. The film is for demented viewers or kids willing to mistake it for one of their video games. What pushed the nice and committed Van Peebles (even producer!) Elsewhere in this indefinable "effort" is a mystery.

title: That Darn Cat
actors: Christina Ricci, Doug E. Doug, Dean Jones, George Dzundza
description: Sixteen-year-old Patricia (Ricci) is a bored girl who, discovered by pure chance a clue relating to a kidnapping, becomes a detective. Following the itinerary of her faithful cat, D.C., Patricia and the new FBI agent Kelso (Doug), will return to solve the mysterious case, complicated by strange cases of double identity.
notes: Remake of one of the best known Disney films, "Fbi - Operation Cat" directed by Robert Stevenson in 1965. The film is a polite and sugary mockery of those sick behaviors that have made the fortune of a filmmaker like Lynch. In the role of millionaire Mr. Flint, is Dean Jones, star of the old version of the film.

title: The Last Days of Frankie the Fly
actors: Dennis Hopper, Daryl Hannah, Michael Madsen, Dayton Callie
description: These are the last days of an apparent licker fed up of being humiliated by a mafia boss on whom he is forced to depend in order to survive. The last hours of a man madly in love with a porn starlet, drugged and tortured by a "hard" and certainly not tender environment with the sensitive souls he meets on his path. The last moments of one of the many "guys" that you might meet in the outskirts of Los Angeles and who finally wants to react to destiny and the miserable life by getting rid of an uncomfortable and irreverent nickname, to change it to "Van Gogh".
notes: The short film is boring, but Hopper is in shape, Daryl Hannah is beautiful and the script of Dayton Callie (also actor in the part of Vic), ambitious and "European", is capable of producing some surprises.

title: Nun va goldun
actors: Ali Bakhshi Jozam, Mirhadi Tayebi, Mohsen Makhmalbaf, Ammar Tafti, Maryam Mohammadamini
description: To choose the actors of the film "Salaam Cinema", director Makhmalbaf has an advertisement published in the newspaper. Among the thousands who respond, there is also a former policeman: the two had already met twenty years earlier when the director, who was in opposition to the Shah's regime, had stabbed him to steal his gun. The policeman had shot him and Makhmalbaf had spent four years in prison.
notes: The film continues a fruitful tradition of Iranian cinema (which, for example, Kiarostami has accustomed us to), namely that of a metatextual cinema that continually talks about itself and in which the line between fiction and reality always seems on the verge of shattering.

title: Die Macht der Bilder - Leni Riefenstahl
actors: Leni Riefenstahl
description: When Hitler and Goebbels wanted to celebrate the Berlin Olympics with a film as the apogee of the Nazi regime, they entrusted the direction to Leni Riefenstahl, photographer and sportswoman, romantically linked to one of the leaders of Nazism. His films have long been banned in post-war Germany: because their propaganda force remained intact. Now he is over ninety, he makes underwater shots; his memoirs (recently published) caused a sensation and thus the idea of ??making a film about his life was born.
notes: When the subject is so interesting, documentaries always succeed: but it is extraordinary to note how, sixty years later, his images retain a strength and charm that go beyond the tremendous ideology that inspired them.

title: I Shot Andy Warhol
actors: Lili Taylor, Jared Harris, Stephen Dorff, Martha Plimpton, Lothaire Bluteau, Anna Levine, Peter Friedman, Tahnee Welch, Jarnie Harrold
description: In 1968, a penniless young artist, lesbian and militant feminist, shot Andy Warhol with a .32 caliber. Warhol did not die and Valerie Solanas, after a trial in which she was presented as a champion of women's rights and after three years in a psychiatric asylum , returned to anonymity. But Warhol never ceased to underline the impression he had made when he met Valerie.
notes: Feature film debut by documentarian Mary Harron, a (true) story plunged into an era and an environment with which cinema and culture are beginning to come to terms: the late 1960s and the eccentric and creative New York of the Factory by Warhol. Unfortunately, despite the vitality and strength of Lili Taylor (one of the best young American actresses, protagonist of Ferrara's "Addiction"), the film remains stuck in its conditions.

title: The War at Home
actors: Emilio Estevez, Kathy Bates, Martin Sheen, Kimberly Williams
description: In 1972 Texas, the brain of a boy from an American middleclass family goes haywire because of the Vietnam War. Back home, the young man just doesn't want to forget, find a job, get engaged and thus overcome the guilt complexes of an insensitive father, a bulky and bigoted mother and a sister who does not hide her shame for a brother. not integrated and (st) rambo.
notes: Domestic drama where there is no air and all of the Sheen brand: Emilio Estevez plays and directs father Martin, the protagonist of "Apocalypse Now". The short circuit is modest, but faithful consumers of "Southeast Asian emotions" will experience some thrills. Very good Kathy Bates. Soundtrack that plunders Crosby, Still, Nash & Young.

title: Hollow Reed
actors: Sam Bould, Martin Donovan, Ian Hart, Joely Richardson, Jason Flemyng
description: Oliver is an intelligent and lively child, but he lives with a big problem: his mother's partner beats him savagely. The series of bruises and fractures alerts the father who discovers the truth and begins a legal fight with his ex-wife for custody. Violated childhood is a burning and current issue, but too much taken up by the (legitimate) defense of the rights of the father and homosexuals, the screenplay disappoints by not delving into the drama of violence against minors. In fact, slowly the film moves on to the contrast between the parents or rather, between the father's choice to live a homosexual love and the mother's fear of being emotionally alone, which does not allow her to see what happens in ua house. First English film for Martin Donovan, well-known face of Hartley's cinema, co-produced by Channel Four is a classic TV movie.

title: Bai fa mo nu zhuan
actors: Brigitte Lin Chin Hsia, Leslie Cheung, Kit Ying Liam, Francis Ng
description: The film tells a story from an ancient Chinese legend about Lin, an evil white-haired goddess, who uses her hair to fight her enemies (it should be remembered that white in China is the color of death). When Lin falls in love with an ordinary mortal, he has to contend with a rival deity, who is also in love with the same man, and must use all the strength of his magical power to counter it.
notes: Fantasy turned to horror from the now former British colony, the forge of recent "cult". Brigitte Lin was among the performers of "Hong Kong express" and Leslie Cheung in those of "A better tomorrow".

title: Fear
actors: Mark Wahlberg, Reese Witherspoon, William Petersen
description: The relationship between 16-year-old Nicole, who lives in a middle-class family, her father and his new wife is certainly not the best. Meanwhile Nicole falls in love with David, but the boy is a psychopath who will soon turn his life, that of his friends and his own family upside down.
notes: Foley knows film grammar well and is directed by a good professional, but he fails to ennoble a rather predictable script. "Fear" thus lives between the suggestions and violence of "Cape Fear" and those of "A Clockwork Orange". But in the cast we should mention Mark Wahlberg (rapper Marky Mark) in the role of David.

title: Stag
actors: John Henson, Ben Gazzara, Mario Van Peebles, Andrew McCarthy, William McNamara
description: At Victor Mallick's house there is a party: the bachelor party of the rich and ambitious landlord. In the fray there are also new acquisitions, ambiguous characters, drug dealers and former convicts. We drink, we smoke, two stripper sisters arrive and everything seems to proceed along the lines of the usual (last) single night of revelry. But it turns out that one of the women is left dry.
notes: A small chamber film (all in a villa) with an early development, a close-knit cast and a proud purpose: that of bringing out the human littleness through the meanness of the cynical and rampant middle class.

title: San Michele aveva un gallo
actors: Giulio Brogi, Daniele Dublino, Virginia Ciuffini, Renato Cestié, Renato Scarpa
description: In 1870 a revolutionary tried to provoke a popular revolt but it failed. He ends up in jail, in a solitary cell. Here he tries in every way to keep himself active, physically and intellectually, convinced that, sooner or later, the revolutionary ideal will prevail. In short, he wants to be ready for the new times when he gets out of prison. Years later, during a boat transfer, other political prisoners brutally show him that his ideas are outdated.
