notes: Film about utopias based on a story by Tolstoy, but whose Risorgimento setting refers to the uncertainties of the post-sixty-eight and pre-years of lead Italian left. Dry (also due to its low-cost television production) and intense, it is one of the best films of the Taviani.

title: The Abdication
actors: Peter Finch, Liv Ullmann, Cyril Cusack, Paul Rogers
description: Due to the untimely death of her father Gustavo Adolfo, Cristina becomes queen of Sweden who is still a child. Once she has grown up, she increasingly feels the disagreement, which dramatically involves her, between reason of state and individual freedom. In order not to give up the second, which will lead to her conversion to Catholicism, she renounces the crown.
notes: Discreet historical-biographical drama with an excellent cast. Boring as the genre dictates, but the actors make up for it.

title: Summer of '42
actors: Jennifer O'Neill, Gary Grimes, Jerry Honser, Oliver Conant
description: It is the summer of 1942 and a fifteen-year-old boy named Ernie is on vacation with two peers in the New England area. Struggling, like her comrades, with sex problems, she runs into Dorothy, a woman whose husband is at the front. A tender feeling erupts between the two. But one day the news arrives that his "rival" has died in the war.
notes: Re-enactment of an era in which the light-heartedness of the young people left at home collides with the tragedies of the war. Oscar for the music of Michel Legrand.

title: Personal Best
actors: Mariel Hemingway, Scott Glenn, Patrice Donnelly, Kenny Moore, Jim Moody
description: During the 1980 Moscow Olympics, two American athletes form a morbid friendship against the advice of their coach, one of the two former lovers. Despite the rough situation, even exploiting it without noticing it, the trainer tries to get the best out of them from the two sportsmen.
notes: First directed by Robert Towne, former screenwriter of the "Godfather", "Chinatown" and "Missouri". Hemingway's interpretation is passionate, even if not too credible in the Sapphic version.

title: Allonsanfan
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Lea Massari, Mimsy Farmer, Laura Betti, Claudio Cassinelli, Bruno Cirino, Benjamin Lev, Renato De Carmine, Stanko Molnar, Luisa De Santis, Biagio Pelligra, Michael Berger, Alderice Casali
description: We are at the beginning of the nineteenth century, in full Restoration. The noble Fulvio Imbriani, of liberal ideas, returns to his father's house where - among the memories of his childhood and the comforts of his family - he forgets his political commitment. His old friends, however, soon make themselves known and induce him to take part in an expedition to the South that should raise the population against the Bourbon government ...
notes: As in all Taviani films of the 1970s, the historical metaphor serves to reflect on the condition of contemporary Italy. For the thematic balance and formal rigor we are facing one of the most convincing proofs of Tuscan directors. Extraordinary interpreters.

title: Storm Warning
actors: Steve Cochran, Ginger Rogers, Doris Day, Ronald Reagan, Hugh Sanders
description: Marsha Mitchell visits her sister Lucy, just married to Hank, at their home in Rock Point. Evening arrives and the woman witnesses, unseen, a murder committed by hooded men affiliated with the Ku Klux Klan sect. Distraught, she tells what she saw to her sister and, after being introduced to her, has no difficulty in recognizing in her brother-in-law the person she saw committing the murder.
notes: Scripted by the young Richard Brooks with the help of Daniel Fuchs, the film is quite compelling and non-trivial in its courageous denunciation and fast pace. Ginger Rogers, in a dramatic role, looks good.

title: Eyes of Laura Mars
actors: Faye Dunaway, Tommy Lee Jones, Brad Dourif, Raul Julia
description: The woman in the title is a rich and bored fashion photographer. His "eyes" are, of course, his camera lenses. The film's TNT is the same as the photo album made by Laura with a series of models who end up murdered. The beauty is that she, for a form of extrasensory perception, "sees" the crime in advance.
notes: From a subject by John Carpenter, a clumsy attempt to combine suspense and parapsychology, traditional yellow investigation and pseudo-modernist language made up of randomly mixed flashbacks and flashforwards.

title: Poliziotti violenti
actors: Henry Silva, Antonio Sabato, Silvia Dionisio, Ettore Manni
description: To prevent him from investigating some cases of corruption in the army, the major of the paratroopers Paolo Altieri is promoted and transferred to Rome. During his stay in the capital he foils the kidnapping of a child, but suffers a violent beating by bandits. On that occasion he realizes that the criminals have used an experimental machine gun supplied to the paratroopers department. Altieri, with the help of a collaborator, begins to investigate ...
notes: Michele Massimo Tarantini gives the last blow of the wing to a genre now in decline. It all boils down to an involuntarily grotesque jumble where "private justice" is exalted.

title: The Badlanders
actors: Alan Ladd, Ernest Borgnine, Katy Jurado, Claire Kelly, Kent Smith
description: Two former detainees arrive in a border town, where however they are badly received. One of them proposes a deal to a local buccaneer, who tries to trick him, even going so far as to use weapons to get him out of the way. The two react and a shooting ensues ...
notes: Daves had the idea of ??remaking John Huston's masterpiece in a western key _Jungla d'asfalto_. The result is this film, which has an excellent cast and excellent direction on its side. There is no shortage of all the strong ingredients of the genre: manly feelings, courage and trigger-happy men. Under the inevitable "happy ending" a certain melancholy and a streak of pessimism emerge.

title: Lost in America
actors: Albert Brooks, Julie Hagerty, Garry Marshall
description: Two yuppies decide to stop their race for success and to live on the road crossing the United States in the manner of the hippies of the sixties. Funny comedy directed and performed by an actor who hasn't had much luck with us.

title: Scuola elementare
actors: Riccardo Billi, Mario Riva, Lise Bourdin, Alberto Rabagliati, Mario Carotenuto
description: A primary school teacher from Lazio, after years of teaching in the village, wins a competition in Milan. In the school he is destined for, he meets an old childhood friend who works as a janitor and who temporarily hosts him at home. In the school the teacher also meets a young colleague with whom he falls in love. Meanwhile, the janitor has plunged into not-so-brilliant business speculations. The world of industry and advertising will offer both of us a ... lifesaver.
notes: The couple Billi and Riva, famous at the time, dives with ease into the world of school to more easily touch the strings of sentiment. Lattuada's hand sketches a beautiful portrait of pre-boom Milan with a series of tender secondary figurines (there is also Dario Fo).

title: Opening Night
actors: Gena Rowlands, Ben Gazzara, John Cassavetes, Joan Blondell, Peter Falk, Paul Stewart, Zohra Lampert, Laura Johnson, John Tuell
description: Myrtle is an actress near sunset boulevard rehearsing a comedy to take to New York. The protagonist is a fifty-year-old woman weighed down by the years and the regret of a lost youth. Myrtle, however, feels younger than her character, fears she will not be able to share his anguish and, therefore, not able to interpret him as best she would like.
notes: Story of an existential crisis in which the relationship between reality and fiction, between art and life is grafted. A glimpse into the neuroses suffered by society victim of the myth of success, one of Cassavetes' most intense films, in which the great Gena Rowlands dominates. The Italian version is cut by forty minutes.

title: Indecent Seduction
actors: Gary Cole, Nicholle Tom, Mac Davis, Mary Kay Place
description: Young Amy, a college freshman from a small town in Oklahoma, is noticed by the botany teacher who, by the way, is also the coach of the football team. Although Amy is perfectly aware of the fame of heartthrob that surrounds the professor-coach, she gives in to the insistence of the man. On the other hand, he is, at least in appearance, rather tender, but over time he proves to be jealous and possessive. Thus, the scandal breaks out and Amy's parents, made aware of the embarrassing circumstances in which their daughter has found themselves, react with determination.
notes: A rather superficial TV film, not too busy investigating the motives and inner impulses, not a little contradictory, of the two protagonists.

title: The Man who never Was
actors: Clifton Webb, Gloria Grahame, Robert Fleming, Josephine Griffin
description: We are in 1943, the year of the turning point during the Second World War. The allies plan to land in Sicily while the Germans concentrate a large amount of armed forces on the island. To deceive the enemy, the allied counter-intelligence concocts an incredible scam: a civilian who accidentally died in London is attributed a false identity, that of an elusive high-ranking officer of the same counter-intelligence. The corpse, equipped with false papers and compromising but equally false plans, is abandoned on the coasts of Spain.
notes: Taken from the novel of Ewen Montagu of 1954, which told how the Mincemeat operation was prepared, it is an excellent English spionistic thriller, which holds the suspense very well. Dell’Eganno -Mincemeat operation, by John Madden.

title: Monty Python's - The Meaning of Life
actors: Graham Chapman, John Cleese, Terry Gilliam, Eric Idle, Terry Jones
description: A series of sketches make up the latest Monty Python film. A professor gives particular demonstrations of sex education to his pupils; Death arrives in a middle-class house, but finds it hard to be recognized; a fat man gorges himself and vomits continuously and eventually explodes eating a mint; a Catholic family sings "Every Sperm is Sacred" and so on.
notes: Too uneven and at times stretched for length, it is too much linked to "And now something completely different". Not a bad start, with the cartoon monster skyscraper. The film won the 1983 Special Jury Prize at the Cannes Film Festival.

title: Empire Records
actors: Anthony La Paglia, Liv Tyler, Rory Cochrane, Johnny Whitworth
description: Twenty-four hours in the life of a record store in an American city. Just the time left for Joe to save the company and not sell it to the powerful competitors of "Music Town". Time for Lucas to escape to Atlantic City with the box, for Corey to finally lose his virginity, for Debra to shave off, for Rex Manning, the girl's idol, to make a fleeting and unexpected appearance.
notes: In the film there is above all a work on "texts": script and music flow in parallel and it is to underline the beautiful work done by Carol Heikkinen (who had already written "That thing called love" by Bogdanovich) and by Mitchell Leib, for the sound part.

title: The Whole Wide World
actors: Vincent D'Onofrio, Renée Zellweger
description: Robert E. Howard (D'Onofrio) is an eccentric writer fond of ancient sagas and author of "Conan the Barbarian", "Red Sonya" and "Kull the Conqueror" among others. Robert is in love, reciprocated, with the young teacher Novaline Price (Zellweger) who shares her literary passion, but does not always appreciate the results. Their relationship will also be made up of controversies and battles, as well as great emotional outbursts.
notes: From Price's own autobiographical novel. For D'Onofrio (the "Ball of lard" of "Full metal jacket") a leading role.

title: The Rage
actors: Lorenzo Lamas, Gary Busey, Roy Scheider
description: There's something rotten inside the FBI: Dean Taggert swore it to Special Agent Nick Travis because of an action gone wrong. Now, however, a madman is circulating around: a Vietnam veteran who has built his own handsome army, sowing deaths, violence and terror. Taggert, convinced that he is not doing him a favor, chooses Nick for the delicate mission. And, not satisfied, he puts a woman next to him, capable, but without experience.
notes: The action film can be seen, thanks above all to the skill of another veteran, the Sidney J. Furie of "A Ovest di Sonora", "Entity" and "Ipcress" who, for the occasion, dusts off his entire repertoire. . Few chances, however, for the rest of the troop, where Lorenzo Lamas "stands out", who brings to mind that line of Ionesco: "All men are actors, except for some actors".

title: Living in Peril
actors: Dana Wheeler Nicholson, Rob Lowe, James Belushi, Dean Stockwell
description: For the young architect Walter Woods, the engagement to design a villa in Hollywood is an important career opportunity. But strangely enough, all his sketches are systematically rejected and for Walter the stay in California turns into a real nightmare, especially when one night he finds his neighbor, dead, in his bed.
notes: The thriller begins well, with the accumulation of disturbing details; unfortunately, however, as often happens, it deflates in the final. The curiosity is above all in the bizarre structure of the residence where much of the action takes place. Although the cast gave more hope, in the United States, the film did not go very well.

title: Bed of Roses
actors: Mary Stuart Masterson, Christian Slater, Pamela Adlon, Josh Brolin, Brian Tarantina, Debra Monk, Mary Alice, Kenneth Cranham, Ally Walker
description: Lisa is young and pretty, she has a best friend to let off steam with, but she doesn't have time for love because her job has already given her a vice presidency. One day, a certain Lewis gives her a wonderful bouquet of flowers in the office and disappears. The cadeau is without a ticket and Lisa, with the complicity of her trusty Kim, tries to trace the alleged lover. The "suspense" is dissolved soon: it is Lewis himself, a little man marked by precocious widowhood and who falls in love with Lisa after seeing her cry through a window.
notes: Very high glycemic risk film. Fortunately, the sugar is dosed, the romanticism blatant, but sincere, the interpreters supported by true fiction (very well Mary Stuart Masterson, so-so Christian Slater). The bohemian atmosphere is beautiful (we are near Greenwich), Lewis's house (with a nursery on the terrace) is beautiful. Director Goldenberg is making his debut. Who knows, maybe it will get a little more sophisticated.

title: The Maker
actors: Mary-Louise Parker, Matthew Modine, Jonathan Rhys Meyers, Fairuza Balk, Michael Madsen
description: On his eighteenth birthday, at the home of Josh's adoptive parents (the real ones are dead: perhaps in a road accident), his older brother Walter swoops. At first glance a good family man by profession as a mover. In reality, a very shrewd thief with a dark past and an insecure future, who would like to involve Josh in his dealings.
notes: Only the faithful consumers of videotapes have been able, in recent years, to follow the career of Tim Hunter, an excellent debut in 1986 with "The River Boys". Not that "Dangerous Choices" differs much from the homevideo step, but the theme addressed - of the series: "burnt youth" - brings the author back to the sympathetically nihilistic atmospheres most congenial to him. Supported by an assorted and well-blended cast.

title: Ulee's Gold
actors: Peter Fonda, Patricia Richardson, Christine Dunford, Tom Wood
description: Ulee Jackson, a war veteran, tries to heal the wounds caused by his family breakdown, in the swamps of Florida, as a beekeeper. But the unsolved past comes back when you least expect it. And so, in addition to having to take care of the two grandchildren, left alone he has to contend with two old accomplices of the first, eager to get their hands on the spoils of a robbery. But for the now wise and serene Ulysses, no obstacle is insurmountable.
notes: A development that Henry, the "great old man" of the Fonda household, would not have displeased, remembered by Peter not exactly warmly. It seems, in fact, that in the rooms also frequented by Jane, you could breathe the same heavy air that hovers in this bittersweet film.

title: Amanda
actors: Kieran Culkin, Dennis Haysbert, Alice Krige, Chris Mulkey
description: Amanda, an exotic name that refers to other cinematographic beauties, is actually a magical mare who with her master Seven solves the problems of little Biddle, a child son of a horse breeder in Montana. Due to a fall from a horse, Biddle risks losing his sight and elaborates a drastic rejection of the horses by coming into conflict with his father. Thanks to the help of the horse everything is back in place.
notes: If there was a top ten of "feel good" films, "Amanda" would surely find a place for herself. Produced by John McTiernan and played by Macaulay Culkin's younger brother, the film centers on a child's attempt at self-determination, who often overflows into the realm of pure fantasy, such as during the medieval tale told by Seven to the boy. But the real magic of the film is in Shelly Johnson's photography, who paints dreamy dawns in the skies of Montana.

title: The Island
actors: Michael Caine, David Warner, Angela Punch McGregor
description: Have you ever heard of the infamous "Bermuda Triangle"? Well, an English reporter (Caine) is determined to solve the mystery. After numerous hardships, however, he finds himself the prisoner of a band of crazy individuals who consider themselves heirs of the ancient buccaneers who infested the Antilles.
notes: It always hurts to find a good actor's name in absolutely negligible films.

title: Murder in Mind
actors: Mary-Louise Parker, Jimmy Smits, Nigel Hawthorne
description: A double assassination was accomplished in the woman's villa: her husband Peter and the gardener Charlie lie on the ground. Caroline is in shock: for this reason they call the (diabolical) Dr. Ellis, which is given the task of shedding light on the incident.
notes: The second part of the film will play us on all unimaginable slopes. Time goes in continuous flash back and flash Foward, just to remind us that Andrew Morahan is the director of "Highlander 3" and various music videos. From a theatrical piece of the playwright Michael Cooney (who scripts).

title: Intimate Relations
actors: Julie Walters, Rupert Graves, Matthew Walker
description: In one of those small English towns where the neighbors are not nice and think of everything but not to meddle, a mature woman not resigned to wrinkles and menopause welcomes a shrewd young man in her home in search of "cuddles". The woman is married to a man now on the boulevard of the alcoholic sunset and has a daughter who winks at Lolita.
notes: The reference to Nabokov's book fits us perfectly: because "Intimate Relationships" is a kind of reversed remake. The event really happened in the spring of 1956, the ending is tragic and the reconstruction dignified. A debut feature poised between "dad's cinema" and a TV drama from a good family. Very good Julie Walters.

title: Chasing Amy
actors: Ben Affleck, Joey Lauren Adams, Jason Lee, Kevin Smith, Dwight Ewell, Kevin Smith, Ethan Suplee, Scott Mosier, Casey Affleck, Guinevere Turner, Carmen Llywelyn, Brian O'Halloran, Matt Damon, Welker White
description: The balance between Holden and Banky, two friends creators of the "Bluntman & Chronic" comic, is shattered by the arrival of colleague Alyssa, a declared lesbian. After a discreet courtship, the more handsome of the two friends manages to make the girl forget about women. Result: a nice mess ...
notes: Final chapter of the "New Jersey trilogy", launched by Smith in '94 with _Clerks_ and continued badly in '96 with _Generation X_. Tasty dialogues, close-knit interpreters, a pleasant air of complicity. And the taciturn "Silent Bob", played by the director-screenwriter also in the previous films, regains the word.

title: Genealogies d'un crime
actors: Catherine Deneuve, Melvil Poupaud, Michel Piccoli
description: A child analyst is seriously concerned about the behavior of her five-year-old grandson, with clear homicidal tendencies. Determined to study in depth the evolution of the character of the potential criminal, the woman even goes into a fatal prophecy: in ten years - she confesses - the boy will kill me. So it happens. Chance creates a stir, even in the world of psychoanalysts.
notes: Since we are talking about Raoul Ruiz, a stateless and avant-garde filmmaker, the plot is a pretext. What counts are structure and form: the first one that freaks out between different eras, chasing parallel montages and displacements; the second with almost "cubist" connotations. The references (clear, right?) Are Freud and Buñuel; the game is that of the "double" (starting with Catherine Deneuve); the purpose of the festival awards ("Silver Bear" in Berlin '97). Cerebralissimo.

title: Twin Town
actors: Llyr Evans, Rhys Ifans, Dorien Thomas, Dougray Scott, Buddug Williams
description: In Swansea, a Welsh town that was the birthplace of the poet Dylan Thomas (widely quoted), life is boringly quiet. The placid appearance hides the current corruption: two police officers trafficking cocaine, sponsored by one of the local rich, vulgar as only those who have become by chance know how to be. Fortunately, another "twin" couple upset the plans of the country's powerful: brothers from the "empty Macao-like" planet, both on the verge of dementia because they are perpetually attached to straws from which they suck glue.
notes: The production, by Danny Boyle ("Little Murders Between Friends" and "Trainspotting") sows panic in the future, is not pleased, shows and does not show, presses and never swerves, despite the very high speed.

title: Il viaggio della sposa
actors: Sergio Rubini, Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Carlo Mucari, Franco Javarone, Umberto Orsini
description: A young noblewoman must be escorted from the Abruzzese convent, where she received a refined education, to her betrothed in the city of Bari. During the ambush set by a band of brigands, Countess Portia's large escort is exterminated. The only survivors, the young woman and Bartolo, a rough stable boy. It will be he who will accompany her along the streets of seventeenth-century southern Italy.
notes: Rubini knows how to tell and, as an interpreter, has a beautiful grotesque and tattered mask; pity that the script is not too rich in events and the images (the poetry of the countryside, the fury of the plague, the stunning discovery of the sea) are rather stereotyped and often insisted. Giovanna Mezzogiorno, in a part designed for Asia Argento, is beautiful, but "acts" without too much measure.

title: Swing Shift
actors: Goldie Hawn, Kurt Russell, Ed Harris, Christine Lahti, Roger Corman
description: Even in America, during the Second World War, women had to replace their husbands working at the front in the factory. The few males left at home therefore find easy prey, especially if, in the factory, they are the foremen ...
notes: Unsuccessful attempt at a bittersweet historical narrative. Hawn, producer as well as performer, reworked the film. In the role of the "master of the ironworks" is Roger Corman, mentor of Demme.

title: Set It Off
actors: Jada Pinkett Smith, Queen Latifah, Vivica A. Fox, Kimberly Elise
description: Stony, Cleo, Frankie and Tisean, four African American friends from Los Angeles, after having discussed it for a long time for fun, one day (after losing their jobs, their son and their little brother) they decide to really start robbing banks.
notes: In America they have already renamed it "Girlz 'N the Hood meets Waiting to Exhale": and indeed "Set It Off" manages to mix well the tense anger of the metropolitan socio-thriller with the features of female comedy. Gray (director of many video clips and of "Friday" with Ice Cube) conducts with a nice tight rhythm and a spectacular sense of action. Great, towards the end, the sequence of the ambush. All the performers work, but one steals the show from all the others: rap singer Queen Latifah, in the part of the wild, regal Cleo, who when she escapes in a stolen car immediately puts a CD of her music. Adrenaline soundtrack.

title: Les démons de Jésus
actors: Thierry Fremont, Patrick Bouchitey, Nadia Farès, Roberto Herlitzka, Marie Trintignant
description: We are in 1968 and the Jacob family has settled in a small house in the Parisian suburbs. Jo, the father, has quit his business and drowns his bad mood in alcohol, Rita instead takes care of the house. Néné and Jésus live by their wits and drag themselves to "Elvis", the infamous bar on the corner. Marie, a cashier in a supermarket, is the only one in the family who works.
notes: Distributed in Italy with a title that betrays the strength of the original, the first work of Boinvoisin (musician and lyricist of the Trust), accompanied by the background of a television always on and by an extraordinary musical column (Aretha Franklin, Jerry Lee Lewis, Janis Joplin and Procol Harum), unfolds like a curious suburban western in pastel colors, with a continually mocked code of honor, where the male characters, grotesque and violent, are dominated by the feminine, pragmatic and mature ones.

title: The Fox
actors: Anne Heywood, Sandy Dennis, Keir Dullea
description: An isolated farm in the heart of the American prairie has become the ideal refuge for two lesbians, who can thus live their love away from prying eyes and respectability. However, their ménage is destined to crack when a handsome and charming man arrives at the farm, involving one of the two romantically.
notes: Based on a short story by D.H. Lawrence, the film caused quite a stir at the time, but today it looks rather dated and quite convoluted.

title: Fire Down Below
actors: Rita Hayworth, Robert Mitchum, Jack Lemmon, Herbert Lom
description: Tony and Felix are smugglers in the sea of ??the Antilles and are great friends, although they have opposite characters. The first is romantic and passionate, the second is cynical and evil. Friendship and mutual business end badly when the two fall in love with the same woman, Irina, a Polish refugee with a troubled past. Which of the two will your choice fall on?
notes: The film, which screenwriter Irvin Shaw intended to be a sort of psychological thriller in flashbacks, is instead a "common" sentimental drama that has its own strengths in the actors.

title: Don Quichotte
actors: Fëdor Shaljapin, Dorville, Renée Valliers, Mireille Balin
description: Maddened by reading too many chivalrous novels, the fallen nobleman Don Quixote sets out on his fortune with the faithful squire Sancho Panza. The feats he carries out (fighting windmills and flocks of sheep) he dedicates to Dulcinea, a peasant woman whom he mistakes for a lady ...
notes: Among the curiosities of this "expressionist" version of Cervantes' novel, there is the presence, for the first and only time on a cinema screen, of the Russian lyric bass Fëdor Scialjapin. The Chinese shadow scenes are by the great avant-garde animator Lotte Reininger.

title: Party
actors: Michel Piccoli, Irene Papas, Leonor Silveira, Rogério Samora
description: After ten years of marriage Leonor and Rogério decide to celebrate their union with a "garden party" in the beautiful gardens of the palace. On a sudden whim, Leonor wants to cancel the party, thus colliding with Rogério. Now nothing can be done, the guests are at the door. Among them is Irene, a famous Greek actress and Michel, a self-styled Don Giovanni who cannot help but flirt with Leonor. In the first forty minutes, until a thunderous storm blows the party up, the film holds up well. Too bad that in the remaining 45 minutes the Portuguese master does not unleash his cold, carnal perfidy. An explosion like the one that overturned "The Cannibals" is expected. Instead nothing changes: very intelligent dialogue, an exemplary measure in the frame of the characters and a precise chromatism (with the sharp contrast between the light of the first part and the darkness of the second), but the fate of couples (and of the world) does not derail from its own binary.

title: Police Story III - Supercop
actors: Jackie Chan, Michelle Yeoh, Maggie Cheung, Ken Tsang
description: Detective Kevin Chan is asked to take out Chaibat, a very powerful boss at the head of a massive drug trade that dominates the Southeast Asian market. The super policeman, who in the meantime has been locked up in a forced labor camp to get in touch with Pantera, brother of the dangerous criminal, is joined by his new boss, Commander Yang.
notes: First star of Asian cinema, Jackie Chan struggles to find an audience in Italy; perhaps because his acrobatic, ironic adventures as "super cop" arrive twenty years later than our Bud Spencer and Terence Hill. But the pace is crazy. Don't miss the credits.

title: Mr. Reliable
actors: Colin Friels, Jacqueline McKenzie, Rhys Kenny, Geoff Morrell
description: Wally, who lives in Glenfield near Sydney with his new girlfriend Beryl and his son Lesley, receives a visit from the police one day who accuses him of some minor crime charges. Wally, in a fit of anger, takes his shotgun and shoots them away. Much to their surprise, however, the police react by laying siege to the house as if it were a dangerous criminal. The news of the siege, which lasted eight days, goes around the world and transforms Wally into a folk hero.
notes: Nadia Tass, an Australian director of Macedonian origins who in 1986 had amazed the Venice festival with the weird and very nice "Malcolm", returns with a less bleak and more hilarious "Ace in the hole", who jumps in the comedy area and re-presents in splendid forms Colin Friels. Absolutely sixty-eight.

title: Swingers
actors: Jon Favreau, Vince Vaughn, Ron Livingston, Patrick Van Horn
description: Mike is a hopeful actor who left the love of his life on the East Coast to seek his fortune in Hollywood. Months later Mike is still wasting time listening to his answering machine waiting for the right call, which never comes. His friends, Trent, Rob, Sue, and Charles decide it's time to stop crying.
notes: Opened by the warm voice of Dean Martin, "Swingers" is a talkative and entertaining independent comedy in the form of a love obsession, set in Los Angeles and crowded with aspiring actors willing to do anything to get a part ("Goofy too"). A group of friends, women and (affectionately) cinema: like that of Tarantino, jokingly honored in replays ("Le Iene"), or Scorsese. A fistful of dollars budget and award-winning script by Jon Farvreau, the actor playing the role of Mike.

title: Kissed
actors: Molly Parker, Peter Outerbridge, Jay Brazeau, Natasha Morley
description: Sandra is a typical girl next door morbidly attracted to everything related to corpses. After vain research, he manages to get a job at a funeral home. While studying the art of embalming, she meets Matt, a lonely medical student.
notes: The film has very little scandalous and traumatic, and ends up resolving everything in the first half hour, between the flashes of the protagonist's childhood and the first work experiences. When the young medical student who falls in love with her and indulges her passion enters the game, the film collapses and runs towards a predictable end. A small independent disappointment, which tries to pass the idea off as a sketch for a feature film.

title: Lo sconosciuto di San Marino
actors: Anna Magnani, Vittorio De Sica, Antonio Gandusio, Giuseppe Porelli
description: In the last years of the world conflict, many refugees found refuge in the neutral walls of the small Republic of San Marino, right next to the Gothic Line. Among these also ends up a young man who has lost his memory. In short, he makes friends with everyone and proves to be good and helpful. A banal event brings back his memories and, with it ...
notes: Professional injury in Nannarella's bright career, a boring and vulgar drama despite the screenplay by Cesare Zavattini and Vittorio Cottafavi.

title: Con Air
actors: Nicolas Cage, John Cusack, John Malkovich, Steve Buscemi, Rachel Ticotin
description: Con Air is an airplane that every year transports criminals who must be tried, hospitalized or transferred to other prisons. When a group of the most dangerous and well-known prisoners in the US prison system is about to be transferred to a maximum security prison, Cameron Poe, bailed out, gets a ride on the plane. Cameron is eager to see his wife again and does not want to miss his daughter's eighth birthday, but remains involved in the hijacking by Cyrus "The Virus" Grissom.
notes: Gased by the success of "The Rock", the Hollywood creators of explosive mixtures with high noise pollution, they step on the accumulation pedal. And so the bad guys become six, eight, ten; and the good ones at least two, even if marked by small shades of the heart. The result is a sort of videogame in which the categorical order is: "Smash everything you come across!". The parody by Anthony Hopkins of "The Silence of the Lambs" made by Steve Buscemi is irresistible.

title: Altri uomini
actors: Claudio Amendola, Ennio Fantastichini, Veronica Pivetti, Ricky Memphis, Stefania Montorsi, Antonino Iuorio, Tony Sperandeo, Vincenzo Peluso, Ugo Conti
description: Milan, 1985, Michele Croce, protagonist of the Milanese underworld between the seventies and eighties, locked up in a security cell, tells his story by answering the questions of a magistrate. Originally from Catania, his destiny, at least at the beginning, is no different from all the southern emigrants who arrived in Milan in the 1950s: misery, exploitation and frustration. Until in the seventies first the youth revolt and then terrorism broke out. Michele is a rebel, only his rebellion is accomplished by joining the underworld.
notes: The first work of the producer Claudio Bonivento (that of "La scorta") borrows the true stories of Angelo Epaminonda (known as "Il Tebano") and Francis Turatello. The names in the film are different and, unfortunately, also the substance, in the sense that the assumptions (mentioned above) are hardly understood. Amendola, this time, remains on the surface and so do the supporting actors. Even if the manager is the new director.

title: Batman & Robin
actors: George Clooney, Chris O'Donnell, Uma Thurman, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Alicia Silverstone
description: A new enemy threatens to destroy Gotham City who must once again rely on Batman and his faithful companion Robin. This is the ferocious and terrifying Mr Freeze who can freeze the entire city. Yet another enemy of the bat man forms a treacherous alliance with the fatal flower daughter Poison Ivy, a devious beauty who can kill with a simple kiss. Alongside our heroes this time is the agile and relentless Batgirl.
notes: Joel Schumacher reduces the superhero and the villains to the one-dimensionality of paper characters, switches to a smashing action in a comic key. Result: loud and boring.

title: In Celebration
actors: Alan Bates, Brian Cox, James Bolam
description: On the occasion of the fortieth anniversary of their parents' wedding, three brothers decide to return to the mining town that saw them born. Of the three, two are in crisis (the first, in fact, discovered that he was homosexual).
notes: Based on the play of the same name by David Storey.

title: Città violenta
actors: Charles Bronson, Telly Savalas, Jill Ireland, Umberto Orsini
description: Jeff, a professional killer, in turn ends up in the crosshairs of the organized crime that ambushes him. However, Jeff manages to escape miraculously and also discovers that Vanessa, his woman, is in league with the hit men. After two years in prison, Jeff ends up in the employ of Al, who in the meantime has married Vanessa. The woman tries to get Jeff to kill Al and then report him, but this time Jeff ...
notes: There is nothing worse than an Italian director who wants to redo American cinema and there is nothing worse than American actors (however not excellent) directed by an Italian director.

title: Madonna che silenzio c'è stasera
actors: Francesco Nuti, Edi Angelillo, Massimo Sarchielli, Gianna Sammarco
description: Francesco is a young man from Prato, torn between his mother's possessive affection and the desire to find a job. He leaves in search of an occupation but his day in the streets of Prato only yields odd encounters. Partial consolation was the evening phone call from Maria, the girlfriend with whom he had had some misunderstanding.
notes: One of the first comedies of "awareness" of the Italian cinema of the 80s, among the best of Nuti, still not affected by subsequent narcissisms. Far too polite, and dated today, but not unpleasant.

title: Sea of Sand
actors: Richard Attenborough, John Gregson, Michael Graig
description: An allied commando must carry out an attack on one of the largest German fuel depots. Two British officers, Bill Williams and Tim Cotton, excellent soldiers, but with an absolutely incompatible character, are entrusted with the organization. This fact complicates and jeopardizes the success of the mission.
notes: War and psychology for a well-acted film, with a little too much slowness

title: O thiasos
actors: Eva Kotamanidou, Vangelis Kazan, Aliki Georgouli
description: Fifteen years of the troubled Greek history (from 1939 to 1952) evoked following the adventures of a group of wandering actors who, moving throughout the country, stage their repertoire.
notes: Reconstruction of the homeland history conducted with antirealistic methods, between the oral story and Brecht (but having behind him a nineteenth-century drama, "Golfo the shepherdess", and on the suffering the classic tragedy) is the masterpiece of Anghelopulos and one of the cornerstones of the cinema of the years '70. A continuous reflection on cinema and history, in which epochs change into one another in masterful sequence shots of hypnotic slowness.

title: L'automobile
actors: Anna Magnani, Vittorio Caprioli, Christian Hay, Donato Castellaneta, Pupo De Luca
description: Now close to old age, a former prostitute left alone decides to buy a car, confident that this can make her independent and help her change her social status.
notes: In Italy in the early 1970s the car was still a status symbol and Anna Magnani, who had played the role of a prostitute for Pasolini nine years earlier ("Mamma Roma"), is the ideal interpreter for this twilight figure and melancholic.

title: Fuzz
actors: Burt Reynolds, Raquel Welch, Tom Skerritt, Jack Weston, James McEachin, Yul Brynner
description: After killing a policeman, a gang of killers kills, one after another, some high-ranking Boston officials. Unpredictably, a not-so-reassuring squad of cops will defeat the criminals. Interesting to see how this happens.
notes: Between irony and rhythm, a fairly original story in which comedy alternates with dramatic moments. But we are at the beginning of the 70s: there is a desire to demystify the figures of authority and to renew old clichés of classic Hollywood cinema. The screenplay is by Evan Hunter (better known as Ed McBain) who derived it from his novel

title: Destination Anywhere
actors: Bon Jovi, Demi Moore, Kevin Bacon, Annabella Sciorra, Whoopi Goldberg
description: Jon is a man who is running away from home due to gambling debts. Now he wants to go to his wife Janie to try to remedy the breakdown of their relationship caused by the sudden death of their little son. When an abandoned child is admitted to the hospital where Janie works as a nurse, a series of events sets in motion that forces the couple to rethink their lives.
notes: After the experience as an actor in "Moonlight & Valentino" Jon Bon Jovi tries again. To launch his new album he called in Mark Pellington, an established video clip director who is about to go direct with "Going All the Way". The film does not lack songs like "Midnight in Chelsea" and "Queen of New Orleans".

title: The Heiress
actors: Olivia de Havilland, Montgomery Clift, Ralph Richardson, Miriam Hopkins
description: New York, 1850. Catherine, a rich motherless heiress, sweet-natured but not excessively attractive, meets Morris Towsend, a handsome young man, casual and gentle, at a ball. The two fall in love, but her father, realizing that the boy's interest is aimed solely at his money, denies permission for the wedding and leaves with his daughter for Europe. On his return Morris continues to court Catherine and between her and her father there is a definitive break. One episode, however, opens the eyes of the girl who ...
notes: From a novel by Henry James, a dark and claustrophobic drama, with extraordinary interpretations.

title: Desert Legion
actors: Alan Ladd, Richard Conte, Arlene Dahl, Akim Tamiroff
description: Paul Lartal is a legionnaire who survived an ambush. He manages to save himself and heal thanks to the loving daughter of the governor of Madara. But the "bad guy" also lives in the governor's palace, with whom the young Paul ends up clashing. Lively but too naive, a rather dated adventure film.

title: Unforgivable
actors: John Ritter, Harley Jane Kozak, Kevin Dunne, Susan Gibney
description: Paul, a father of three, is an overbearing, arrogant and violent man who leaves his wife to hook up with Beth, an energetic woman who is unwilling to be bullied. During an inevitable fight between Paul and Beth, Beth accidentally falls and is in danger of dying. Beth then blackmails him and forces him to go through a recovery program to avoid an attempted murder charge. After a year of "training" Paul realizes that it is better for him to try to reconcile with his wife and children, hoping to return to his family.
notes: Among the classic themes of the TV movie "snatcher" certainly could not miss a variant on the theme of violence within the walls of the house.

title: Now and Then
actors: Christina Ricci, Rosie O'Donnell, Thora Birch, Melanie Griffith
description: It is the summer of 1970 and in the small town of Gaslight Addiction, Indiana, four 12-year-olds are living an intense friendship in the name of adventure. Years later the girls, now women, find themselves in the house of one of them, who is on the verge of giving birth, to recall the old days. Roberta is a doctor, Samantha the writer, Teeny the actress and Chrissy the housewife wife of a dentist. At the end of the re-enactment, narrated by Samantha's voiceover, the four friends will all meet in the delivery room.
notes: This film consists of two different films. There is the film of the girls and the film of the thirties, which merely provide a frame. The second can be dismissed with a few words. The first, on the other hand, is a far from despicable film.

title: Indagine su un cittadino al di sopra di ogni sospetto
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, Florinda Bolkan, Gianni Santuccio, Orazio Orlando
description: The head of the homicide section of the police, known by all as "the doctor", was appointed director of the political office of the police headquarters; but on the day of his promotion, the official kills his mistress Augusta Terzi. Armed with the position he occupies, "the doctor" doesn't even bother to divert investigations; until, when a bomb explodes in the police station and some protesters are stopped ...
notes: Paradigm of "political" cinema and civil commitment, written by Petri together with Ugo Pirro and with a superlative Gian Maria Volonté. Special jury prize at Cannes and Oscar for best foreign film.

title: Sturmtruppen
actors: Renato Pozzetto, Lino Toffolo, Cochi Ponzoni, Teo Teocoli
description: A bizarre Nazi army prepares to fight a useless war commanded by a cocaine addict general, who lives in a luxurious palace disguised as a shack in the company of a puppet depicting Karl Marx. THE
notes: The film, based on Bonvi's caustic strips, in Samperi's hands is reduced to a series of gags that rarely hit the target. The screenplay is written by Renato Pozzetto and Cochi Ponzoni, while the music is by Enzo Jannacci.

title: Not Our Son
actors: Neal Patrick Harris, Gerald McRaney, Scott Allan Campbell
description: A family belonging to the bourgeoisie of Seattle, in the United States, obsessed with guilt and respectability, decides to collaborate in secret with the police in the investigation concerning their son. The young man is in fact accused of being the arsonist who has already caused several fires in the city and injured several people. Of course the alleged Nero protests his innocence, but the clues against him are more and more numerous ...
notes: The subject isn't brand new, but the film is ultimately less worthless than usual. Gerald McRaney was one of two detectives on the television series "Simon & Simon" (the other was Jameson Parker).

title: Manneken Pis
actors: Frank Vercruyssen, Antje de Boeck, Ann Petersen, Wim Opbrouck
description: Orphan of both parents, Harry (Vercruyssen) finds hospitality with the eccentric Denise (Petersen), who owns an apartment in Brussels. Jeanne (De Boeck) also lives with her and drives a tram that Harry usually takes every day. A deep feeling arises between the two, but the drama is lurking.
notes: Debut film for Van Passel who manages to keep a balance between drama and bitter comedy. Good script by Christophe Dirickx. The Italian title refers to a gift that Harry gives to his Jeanne, the original one to the famous statue of the child who pees.

title: The Flying Dutchman
actors: Nino Manfredi, René Groothof, Willy Vandermeulen, Gene Bervoets
description: We are in sixteenth-century Holland, a country torn apart by the revolt against the Catholic domination of Spain. Among adulterers and unscrupulous adventurers we witness the desperate attempts of a child to find his father, the legendary Flying Dutchman who sails on his red-sails sailing ship. In his search, the boy is helped by Campanelli (Nino Manfredi), a minstrel who wanders in the Flemish countryside.
notes: Jos Stelling ("Marika of the Hells", "The Swinger" and the recent short film "The Waiting Room") divides the story into three parts and assumes a little too much about his abilities. In spite of everything, the film lets itself be seen.

title: Kaleidoscope
actors: Warren Beatty, Susannah York, Clive Revill, Eric Porter
description: Barry Lincoln is an avid gamer who organizes a sensational scam to make his life easier: he breaks into a printing establishment and marks the clichés of the playing cards in order to make them recognizable. And indeed he wins a lot of money, but some time later he is summoned to Scotland Yard on the recommendation of Angela McGinnis, daughter of a police inspector who, learning of the scam, proposes to Barry to silence everything on the condition that the loses an equally large sum.
notes: Humorous comedy of the Anglo-Saxon brand which, apart from some slowing of rhythm, still retains all its freshness today.

title: Twin Peaks
actors: Sherilyn Fenn, Piper Laurie, Kyle MacLachlan, Michael Ontkean
description: An impenetrable fog envelops the town of Twin Peaks, hiding the mountain tops, making the roads and the fir trees that are cut in the local sawmill unrecognizable. One morning Pete Martell greets his wife on her way to work. On the road he usually travels he sees a large plastic bundle abandoned on the shore of the lake. Approaching he notices that a tuft of hair comes out of the bag.
notes: Great tension and a thrilling atmosphere in this pilot, a real prologue to a television series that would have been successful all over the world. And they all cry, as in a grotesque caricature of the melò. Brilliant, both as an episode and as a general project.

title: Forest Warrior
actors: Chuck Norris, William Sanderson, Terry Kiser, Max Gail, Roscoe Lee Browne
description: An inaccessible mountain hides a fairytale landscape in its intricate forests where time seems to have stopped. But this pristine paradise is about to be threatened by progress and speculation that wants to ruin everything. At this point, the Lords of the mountains intervene, protectors of these places for centuries, who will guide the population to regain what they thought was lost forever.
notes: Chuck Norris, directed by his brother Aaron for the occasion, is the protagonist of this work with clear ecological ideas. However, the splendid natural sceneries that form the background to the story do not manage to revive the fortunes of the film.

title: The Apartment
actors: Jack Lemmon, Shirley MacLaine, Fred MacMurray, Ray Walston
description: Bud Baxter's career, employed in a large insurance company, makes giant leaps, but the merit is not linked to his professionalism in the work. Bud owes it all to the fact that he owns a small apartment that he gives to his superiors when they want to spend the night with their girlfriends. One day Bud, who has given the key to the chief of staff, discovers that the woman with him is Fran, one of the elevator attendants he has his eye on.
notes: Probably the best film by Billy Wilder, which humorously investigates the relationships that exist between people. He won five Academy Awards: Best Picture, Direction, Screenplay, Editing, Set Design.

title: Dream Lover
actors: James Spader, Mädchen Amick, Bess Armstrong, Fredric Lehne
description: Ray is a handsome and rich young man, but sad and divorced. Lena is a beautiful brunette who is introduced to her by some friends. Between the two it is love at first sight. He decides to marry her and the marriage is happy at first. Until Ray realizes from small clues that Lena's identity is unclear. And perhaps she is not very sincere. A climate of suspicion and nightmares begins ...
notes: Nicholas Kazan is a luxury rookie: son of Elia, experienced screenwriter, he gives himself the direction of making a film in which the slow inexorable trap of the first part is followed by a not entirely original psychological thriller ending.

title: Esta noite encarnerei no teu cadaver
actors: José Mojica Marins (Zé do Caixão), Tina Wohlers
description: Zé works as an undertaker and is obsessed with the idea of ??having a perfect child. He therefore starts looking for the woman who can give him one, seizing some and subjecting them to the tarantula test at midnight. Meanwhile, the first suspects arise in the village.
notes: Creator of Brazilian trash, Zé ??do Caixão makes extreme films in which even spiders are authentic ...

title: Tha Gallant Hours
actors: James Cagney, Dennis Weaver, Ward Costello, Richard Jaeckel
description: 1942, South Pacific. The allies - led by American Admiral Halsey - fight to the death to repel the Japanese who try to conquer the island of Guadalcanal. The battle seems desperate and instead the willpower of the commander and his men will prevail.
notes: A decent professional film, which shows off-screen warfare but has clear ideas about who the "right" ones are, with a "doc" James Cagney.

title: Day of the Outlaw
actors: Robert Ryan, Burl Ives, Tina Louise, Nehimiah Persoff, Jack Lambert
description: The Bhrun gang terrifies and conditions the existence of the town where Blaise, a ranch owner, lives. Who, forced to lead Bhrun and his people towards a pass, actually leads the bandits to a mountainous and inhospitable area.
notes: A series B western perhaps not too original, but with a fair proof of direction

title: Nightmare
actors: Kevin McCarthy, Edward G. Robinson, Connie Russell
description: A musician dreams of committing murder. The next morning he discovers that a murder has really been committed and in the pocket of his jacket he finds a button that he dreamed of snatching from the dead. He turns in vain to his brother-in-law who is a policeman.
notes: Rather tense and well thought out psychological thriller, from a distressing tale by the great Cornell Woolrich already adapted by the director himself in '47 with the title of "Angodcia nella notte". Good interpreters and masterful photography by Joe Biroc

title: Ten Seconds to Hell
actors: Jeff Chandler, Jack Palance, Martine Carol
description: Six German soldiers are commissioned by the American command to defuse some bombs that have remained unexploded since the Second World War. Two of them, Körtner (Palance) and Wirtz (Chandler), are housed in the house of the beautiful Margot (Carol). Körtner and Margot end up falling in love, but Wirtz is too jealous and decides to get rid of the rival.
notes: A colored film in retrospect. A minor Robert Aldrich, but always able to transform a dramatic and tense event into a metaphor for the chaotic and violent world that surrounds us. The film is based on the novel "The Phoenix" by Lawrence P. Bachman.

title: The Music Lovers
actors: Richard Chamberlain, Glenda Jackson, Max Adrian, Christopher Gable, Izabella Telezynska, Kenneth Colley, Maureen Pryor, Sabina Maydelle, Andrew Faulds, Bruce Robinson, Ben Aris, Xavier Russell, Dennis Myers, John Myers
description: The young Tchaikovsky found in Nedeshda von Meck a patron who allowed him to devote himself to art. His restlessness finds partial containment in Nina, an adventurer who manages to persuade him to marry her, despite the musician being homosexual. Disappointed by the experience that will drive her crazy, Nina abandons him in desperation.
notes: The visionary and esthete Russell tells, with delirious style (see the scenes of the train and the asylum), an ambiguous and "impossible" love story. The portrait of Tchaikovsky that emerges, despite its excesses, remains difficult to forget. When it came out, the film impressed critics and audiences a lot. Today, it could be perplexing or even indifferent.

title: The Spikes Gang
actors: Lee Marvin, Gary Grimes, Ron Howard, Charlie Martin
description: Three cowboys, influenced by Henry Spikes, decide to follow him to try their luck. After the first failed shots, the bandits die one after the other. Only Henry is saved at first, but in a firefight he is wounded and falls along the railroad tracks.

title: Town Without Pity
actors: Kirk Douglas, E. G. Marshall, Christine Kaufmann, Barbara Rütting
description: Four American soldiers stationed in Germany rape Karina Steinffe, a German girl, and are sent to trial. Major Garret, who is in charge of the defense, interested in saving the lives of soldiers who risk capital punishment, manages to prove that the girl is also partially guilty, having tempted the men with her own behavior. His plan succeeds and the four soldiers are severely condemned but not to the final sentence. But the dramas don't end there.
notes: Dark and bitter, it uses Kirk Douglas' interpretation, but also remains caged by a traditional construction.

title: The Idolmaker
actors: Ray Sharkey, Peter Gallagher, Tovah Feldshuh, Olimpia Dukakis, Paul Land
description: Vincent Vaccari is an energetic and ambitious Italian American. He feels he has music in his blood and would like to make it big. But, despite having the voice to become an idol, according to him he does not have the beauty and charm to conquer audiences. So think about becoming a talent scout. Reality Vincent, known by everyone as Vinnie, doesn't just find boys with high hopes, but builds them as characters.
notes: Hackford's first feature film, The film breaks out of the classic musical patterns and tries to describe the social environment of Little Italy.

title: Thief
actors: James Caan, Tuesday Weld, James Belushi, Willie Nelson
description: After eleven years in prison, Frank wants to start his own business. He is a good burglar and decides to limit himself to making just a few shots on commission, in the meantime he masks his activity behind an established machinery business. Finally the big chance: a mega hit for third parties that succeeds perfectly. When it comes to collecting his share, Frank has to contend with the plans the boss reserves for him.
notes: Dark and violent noir, crossed by the almost physical attraction for the shining blade of the thermal lance and for the sparkle of diamonds.

title: The List of Adrian Messenger
actors: George C. Scott, Kirk Douglas, Dana Wynter, Clive Brook
description: At the heart of it all is a big legacy. Around it moves a serial killer with a passion for disguises. The criminal tries to eliminate all the people who can somehow hinder his plans for the conquest of the estate of the Marquis Gleneyre. A nephew of the noble, Adriano Messenger, hires a friend of his, Anthony Getryn, a retired intelligence officer, to investigate a series of apparently accidental deaths. At one point, Messenger also dies in a plane crash. But Getryn continues to investigate.
notes: Ironic and very rhythmic thriller, embellished by the presence of famous actors (Tony Curtis, Frank Sinatra, Burt Lancaster, Robert Mitchum) in lightning-fast appearances.

title: Thunder Road
actors: Robert Mitchum, Gene Barry, Jacques Aubuchon
description: After years of mocking the police, a smuggler turns against a powerful Chicago boss. The situation becomes difficult when the criminal finds himself hunted by the cops and the gangster's men. Of course it will end badly.

title: Les deux anglaises et le Continent
actors: Jean-Pierre Léaud, Kika Markham, Stacey Tendeter, Irene Tunc
description: We are at the beginning of the century. Claude is a young Frenchman: invited by Anne Brown to the English province, he falls in love with Anne's sister, Muriel. When Paris is back, it forgets it. But when he meets Anne, who has come to the French capital for a sculpture course, he begins a love story with her ..
notes: A three-way story that overturns the scheme already told by the director in _Jules and Jim_, also based on a novel by Henri-Pierre Roché. The representation of love is very physical, the fate of the characters inexorable and funereal. In the Italian version, a defloration scene complete with blood was cut by the censors (but the television edition has reinstated the missing sequences, leaving them in the original language).

title: Time Limit
actors: Richard Widmark, Richard Basehart, Dolores Michaels
description: An officer is accused of cooperating with the enemy during the Korean War. Taken prisoner by the North Koreans, he had in fact signed a declaration that admitted the use of biological weapons by the Americans. Repatriated at the end of hostilities, a court martial opens a trial against him. He admits the betrayal, but refuses to disclose the circumstances that led to it. What is hiding under this strange reticence?
notes: Although it is somewhat affected by its theatrical origins, the film showcases a good work of direction and a capital proof of all the protagonists.

title: Kings Go Forth
actors: Frank Sinatra, Tony Curtis, Natalie Wood, Leora Dana
description: Second World War. Lieutenant Loggins, who is with his own department on French territory, is entrusted with the task of defending a difficult advanced position. Sergeant Harris is part of his group, and there is no good blood between the two, although one recognizes the merits of the other. The department has held the position for eighty days already, when Loggins obtained a short license to spend on the Côte d'Azur. Here he meets Monique and falls in love with her, but Harris also has his eye on the girl ...
notes: The film, a discreet racial drama in times of war, is enriched by the participation of several jazz artists and is also known as _Attacco in Normandia_.

title: Scream
actors: David Arquette, Drew Barrymore, Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox
description: Sidney is faced with something that overcomes her teenage crises. In fact, her mother was murdered a year earlier, her father is always absent for work and her boyfriend Billy is pushing her to run away from home. A serial killer who has started terrorizing the city using his passion for horror films also puts himself in it. Using all his knowledge on the subject, he plays with his victims and manages to mislead the police.
notes: The film is between the joke and the exercise on fear: a child's play that immediately reveals itself as a real, bloody nightmare race. The irony eases the tension, but the great night finale is enthralling. "Theoretical" film that relaunched Craven and generated various apocryphal and non-apocryphal sequels. The principal is Harry "Fonzie" Winkler.

title: The Island of Dr Moreau
actors: Marlon Brando, Val Kilmer, David Thewlis, Fairuza Balk
description: Doctor Moreau, a talented scientist and great misanthrope, has chosen an island off the beaten track to carry out his genetic engineering research: the result is the so-called "humanimals", creatures resulting (as is easy to guess from the name) from the crossing between a man and a beast. And, as a good positivist scientist, he is very jealous of the primacy of science over any other moral consideration and is ready to defend it against any opponent, even if it is a casual visitor.
notes: Fourth film adaptation of the famous novel by H.G. Wells "Doctor Moreau's Island", with Marlon Brando (now of stratospheric dimensions and overwhelming acting) who fits in the wake of equally illustrious performers (Charles Laughton impersonated the doctor in the version dated 1933, Burt Lancaster that of 1977). Frankenheimer focuses on the psychology of the protagonist and on the moral coordinates within which the various characters move, trying to create the subtle restlessness of Wells' novel; but he can't find the rhythm and dryness of his best films.

title: Addicted to Love
actors: Meg Ryan, Matthew Broderick, Tchéky Karyo, Kelly Preston
description: He is an astronomer used to working with spotting scopes and telescopes; she preferably rides a motorcycle. Both have been abandoned by their boyfriends, they both meet in an abandoned factory where they spy on their ex-partners and take action on their life with the aim of destroying it. And they rage especially with the rival, a Frenchman who moved to America to manage a luxury restaurant.
notes: Dunne's directorial debut, former protagonist of Scorsese's "Out of Hours": at first it seems a rather conventional comedy, but the story unravels unexpectedly and comic opportunities are numerous and not predictable. In particular, the scene that takes place inside the French restaurant is an anthology. The typical comedy happy ending does not detract from the fact of being in front of articulated characters. Broderick is a candidate to be one of the few teenagers in American cinema capable of transitioning to adult characters, Meg Ryan sports a smile and moves that will make her admirers thrilled.

title: Tano da morire
actors: Ciccio Guarino, Enzo Paglino, Mimma De Rosalia, Maria Aliotta
description: Palermo, late 1980s. Tano Guarrasi, a man of honor known for his passionate and violent character is killed by a killer. Of the four sisters left spinsters because of Tano only one, Franca, after her death decides to get married. But the boss is determined to protect her virginity even from beyond.
notes: He is passionate like the old Neapolitan silent school, provocatively tattered and hilarious like the films of John Waters, unpleasant like those of Ciprì (who signs the photograph) and Maresco. This musical about the mafia by Roberta Torre, set to music by Nino D'Angelo, with a cast of office workers, housewives and merchants, has a lot of cinema ideas that make up for obvious budget constraints with color and rigor.

title: I vesuviani
directors: Antonio Capuano, Pappi Corsicato, Antonietta De Lillo, Stefano Incerti, Mario Martone
actors: Tonino Taiuti, Anna Bonaiuto, Iaia Forte, Enzo Moscato, Renato Carpentieri
description: Episode movies. "La linea di Iana": a group of motorcyclists roam the streets of the Neapolitan province sowing terror. "Maruzzella": a transvestite who wanders the corridors of a red light cinema. "Sofialorén": a fisherman catches an octopus which at night turns into a sensual woman. "The devil in the bottle": a bum buys from a stranger a bottle in which the devil would live. "The climb": the mayor of Naples on his way to the top of Vesuvius limps.
notes: A nice disappointment, the collective film of Neapolitan filmmakers. He starts slowly, with the "amazzoni" of "La linea di Iana", directed by Corsicato without the desire to surprise. It continues conventionally, with the melancholy transvestite of the red-light room, where De Lillo indulges in a correct but breathless romanticism. He drowns in boredom with Capuano and in banality with "The devil in the bottle" by Incerti. And from boredom at the end it rises, to become irritating and unrealistic, with "The climb" by Martone. The outcome is watered down like a tourist program. Each of the five directors can do better.

title: Austin Powers
actors: Mike Myers, Elizabeth Hurley, Mimi Rogers, Christian Slater, Carrie Fisher, Rob Lowe
description: Austin Powers - a sort of sixty-eight Superman tuned to the frequencies of free love - is thawed after thirty years of hibernation. Thus his historical enemy, Dr. Evil, parody of all the 007 style villains, in search of superb provocations with classic purposes: blackmail the world and its powerful. The intelligence service must convince Powers that the 90s are not "the formidable 60s".
notes: "Fuso di testa", of course, but this time in perfect shape, adrenaline effect: Mike Myers plays two roles (that of the title and Dr. Evil), writes the very fresh script by himself and wins the bet. Swinging London is rebuilt with extraordinary set design and costume design work and resurfaces in all its glory. Bacharach, Christian Slater, Carrie Fisher, Rob Lowe and Tom Arnold go through the film in complicit friendship. Demi Moore produces. Liz Hurley surprises. And the jaunty air rages.

title: Box of Moonlight
actors: John Turturro, Sam Rockwell, Dermot Mulroney
description: Al Fountain is an engineer with serious relationship problems with other people. His rigid education leads him to deny any indulgence towards his workers, family and himself. Having finished a job prematurely, Al rents a car from Circle-Rent-A-Car, and begins to wander around in a circular route through the places of childhood. The meeting with Kid, a former actor who lives on the fringes of society, is fundamental in directing Al towards a better relationship with himself and the world.
notes: Already champion of the American independent cinema with "Johnny Suede" and the metafilm "It turns to Manhattan", this time Tom Di Cillo accuses a partial empty joke. We are around Frank Capra, but the story is struggling to take flight and Turturro is encased in a flat and waste-free acting which would have benefited from a biting irony, not a sterile ecological do-goodness. The film premiered at the Venice Film Festival in 1996.

title: Shadow Program
actors: Charlie Sheen, Linda Hamilton, Donald Sutherland, Ben Gazzara
description: The president of the United States has to deal with the plot of a shadow government, whose participants nestle among his closest collaborators. And it is only thanks to his assistant Bishop (Sheen) and a combative journalist (Hamilton) that the president manages to avert the danger.
notes: Predictable film in its dramatic development, obsessively punctuated by the capillary and infallible intervention of the most sophisticated technology in the hands of the conspirators, who, thanks to advanced communication software and satellites, hunt down the acrobatic Sheen and her partner. Interesting cast with Donald Sutherland, Ben Gazzara and a cameo from Gore Vidal.

title: The Tango Lesson
actors: Sally Potter, Pablo Veron, Carolina Iotti, Gustavo Naveira
description: A small, bright and slightly woody Englishwoman who, by profession, is a film director and a sinuous, gloomy and slightly tamarro Argentine dancer twirling entwined in a tango, in the Parisian and Argentine dance halls, on the Lungosenna, on the stage of a theater. Between the two, thanks to the dance, love cannot fail.
notes: This is "Tango Lessons", a love story in music along the lines of the true story of director Potter and dancer Pablo Veron (the rest of the film is in black and white, the film about fashion and murder that the director is planning and that Hollywood producers boycott). Kitsch (all the clichés of tango, but also those of certain feminine cinema), wildly narcissistic and a little mechanical; but Sally Potter ("Orlando") is not the first to come and is capable of beautiful sensual moments (the tango foursome, in the completely empty dance studio). And in music she had spoken, before love, of feminism ("The Gold Diggers") and politics ("The London Story").

title: Anna Karenina
actors: Sophie Marceau, Sean Bean, Alfred Molina, Mia Kirshner, James Fox
description: Anna Karenina, married to a powerful minister of the Tsar, decides to leave her family to follow a young official aristocrat with whom she has fallen madly in love. The flight of love, however, will have a tragic outcome: Anna oppressed by remorse and guilt will choose, in a desperate suicide attempt, to throw herself under the train that is arriving at the station.
notes: Sophie Marceau once again chooses a costume role that has had illustrious precedents. For this new edition of the story, the classic European dramatized packaging was chosen, taking care as much as possible to emphasize the proto-feminist aspects of the story; as usual, then, Marceau has demanded an impressive number of close-ups which in fact mark the unfolding of the story. If the European answer to Hollywood is to propose films like these, American tycoons can sleep peacefully.

title: Cinque giorni di tempesta
actors: Roberto De Francesco, Amanda Sandrelli, Chiara Caselli, Massimo Reale
description: After saying no to his cousin Vince, who asks him to move to Australia, Giovanni leaves to join the military. In Bolzano, where he arrives five days in advance, he meets new people and meets old friends. Around Italy he finds himself having to face illusions and disillusions. Until, finding himself on the quay of the port of Venice, he seizes the opportunity that destiny offers him. A freighter named "Australia".
notes: It opens with elegance and good taste, on the clean panorama of the Aeolian Islands. And it continues, always equally clear, with a slightly odd ride, by train, bike, Vespa, car, truck, plane, up and down Italy. A very rare example of an Italian road movie that does not challenge foreign stereotypes. Calogero proves to be able to write (with the Veronesi brothers) a screenplay impregnated with daily eccentricities, to know how to frame with cleanliness, and to tell without ever overdoing it, very attentive to the size of its budget and its history. Bravo De Francesco, always on screen, disarming with one blue and one black eye; muted to the accompanying character actors (Alberti, Ceccherini, Papaleo).

title: La belle verte
actors: Coline Serreau, Vincent Lindon, Philippine Leroy-Beaulieu
description: A volunteer from an extraterrestrial planet (Serreau) is sent to Paris. And if the Ville Lumière turns out to be a real hell, the place it comes from is the exact configuration of paradise: ocean crowds listening to the Silence, green everywhere, swings that work like in American amusement parks. The mission is feel-good: to change people, to sensitize them to nature, to make them better.
notes: Released in France at the same time as Emmerich's film, the director's film "Three Men and a Cradle" was elected by transalpine anti-Hollywoodists as the emblem of "counter-Independence Day". The aliens are not as bad as Emmerich's blockbuster, but exaggerated projections of today's environmentalists. The film, however, is too heavy and intellectualistic.

title: Absolute Strangers
actors: Henry Winkler, Jennifer Hetrick, Patty Duke, Karl Malden, Audra Lindley
description: Marty and Nancy Klein are a happy couple, with a young daughter and a second baby on the way. Unfortunately, Nancy suffers a car accident and is hospitalized in a coma. The husband must choose whether to sacrifice the woman or the creature because doctors cannot save both. Having taken the painful decision to have the woman aborted, Marty now finds himself fighting against fierce anti-abortion associations that drag him to court ...
notes: Classic TV movie based on real life facts and on burning topical issues. With a now unrecognizable Fonzie from "Happy Days".

title: Il caso Raoul
actors: Stanko Molnar, Delia Boccardo, Alida Valli, Milena Vukotic
description: Life, loves and tragedy of a difficult boy, his adoptive parents and his two older brothers. The past, however, hides a secret that turns out to be terrible for the young man.
notes: In the seventies it was fashionable to deepen pseudo tormented stories with protagonists perpetually on the verge of neurosis. Ponzi will fall back in the 80s on films with Francesco Nuti.

title: The Children's Hour
actors: Audrey Hepburn, Shirley MacLaine, James Garner, Miriam Hopkins
description: Karen (Hepburn) and Martha (Maclaine) are two teachers who run a private school. All is well until a student invents a homosexual relationship between them. The small community condemns the two teachers and forces them to close the institute. The unfair isolation brings out the true nature of Martha's attraction for Karen and creates a very tense situation between them as well.
notes: Perhaps less successful remake of "La calunnia", shot in '36 by Wyler himself and based on a comedy by Lillian Hellman. The acting of the two actresses is really excellent, but the clarification of the homosexual relationship between the two does not disperse tension and ambiguity.

title: Fermi tutti... arrivo io!
actors: Tino Scotti, Carlo Romano, Franca Marzi, Giovanna Ralli
description: A mature industrialist is found killed in a hotel with a stab in the back. Police investigations lead to the discovery that the man had had a violent argument with his secretary the night before. At this point, a private dective and an assiduous reader of detective novels come in ...
notes: Unpretentious comedy that uses a yellow subject to try to make people laugh. The sympathy of Tino Scotti, in the role of the commissioner carrying out the investigations, is not enough.

title: Le voleur
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Geneviève Bujold, Marie Dubois, Julien Guiomar
description: Paris, late 19th century: to take revenge on his guardian who prevents him from marrying Carlotta, Georges chooses to pursue the career of the thief and organizes a theft. Given the success of the shot and with the help of a false abbot who taught him the tricks of the trade, in a short time he became a burglary specialist. Also because Carlotta introduces him to the living rooms that matter, where it is easy for Georges to gather useful information for his business.
notes: This graceful and well-performed comedy updates the author's jovial and anti-bourgeois anarchism.

title: Eureka
actors: Gene Hackman, Theresa Russell, Mickey Rourke, Rutger Hauer, Jane Lapotaire
description: Jack McCann was a lucky gold digger. Having become rich, he settled in the Caribbean, where, however, his existence flows amid a thousand torments originating above all from jealousy for his daughter who married a French playboy. A premonition that Jack had at the time of the gold rush came true.
notes: Not shocking conclusion, which Roeg repeats after many others - from Stroheim to Welles. Baroque and a bit twisted as in the director's style, the film twists a bit in on itself. Too bad because the cast was very interesting.

title: Deux ou trois choses que je sais d'elle
actors: Marina Vlady, Anny Duperey, Roger Montsoret
description: The film follows and "interviews" Juliette, a married woman, occasionally prostitutes herself and explains her motives. Juliette, a typical subject of the new consumerism, acts as a guide and metaphor for the city of Paris, which underwent radical transformations in the 1960s.
notes: A detached and Brechtian portrait of a woman and a city (the "she" of the title is not Juliette but Paris), a film-essay, one of Godard's best. Almost documentary parts such as those on the Parisian shipyards and the presentation of the actress Marina Vlady alternate with others that are almost fictional. Immediately after the nouvelle vague enthusiasm and immediately before '68, one of the points of maximum balance of the Godardian path.

title: Prison of Secrets
actors: Stephanie Zimbalist, Finola Hughes, Gary Frank, Rusty Schwimmer
description: Lynn Shaffer is a career woman, married and the mother of a baby girl. For a serious administrative offense she was sentenced to ten years in prison. Here she realizes that most of the inmates have to suffer blackmail and sexual violence by the guards who have organized a lucrative prostitution ring. With the help of her husband, who works in a radio, Lynn reports the fact and manages to obtain the punishment of the perpetrators.
notes: With the specialist of the movie-truth-heartbreaking TV genre Stephanie Zimbalist, it is, among the many similar films, not entirely despicable.

title: The Boys in Company C
actors: Andrew Stevens, Craig Wasson, Scott Hylands, Stan Shaw
description: Five American boys enlist in the Green Berets department on the eve of the outbreak of the Vietnam War. Their friendship, their relationships and their ideals will be severely tested by the military environment and the dirty war.
notes: Sidney J. Furie ("Ipcress", "Entity" and "Steel Eagles") anticipates the themes that will be addressed in films such as "Platoon" and "Hamburger Hill". Unfortunately his hand is not very happy and the product is below average. The subject is not very original and the realization a bit awkward. However, Stan Shaw's performance in the stainless role of the engineering sergeant is a good one.

title: Big Bully
actors: Rick Moranis, Tom Arnold, Julianne Phillips
description: David Leary (Moranis) is a successful writer who, when he was a student, was harassed daily by his classmate Rosco Bigger (Arnold). When David is invited to take a creative writing class at his old school one day, he can't say no. Everything seems to be going well, David also meets an old flame, who in the meantime has become a sex education teacher. But Rosco also wanders around the school ...
notes: Weak and boring, despite the presence of the protagonists Rick Moranis and Tom Arnold, two good comedic actors who ensure a certain fun.

title: Budbringeren
actors: Robert Skjærstad, Andrine Sæther, Per Egil Aske, Eli Anne Linnestad
description: In an ugly and dirty Oslo, Roy Amundsen is a postman without qualities who, in an unstoppable compulsion to repeat, enters the lives of the recipients of his letters. This is not voyeurism because Roy gets rid of the mail in the ravine of a railway tunnel without reading it. Curious Roay sneaks into the life of Line, a deaf young woman, and finds herself in trouble.
notes: History and characters clearly, but not embarrassingly, refer to the cinema of Kaurismäki, a master in mixing tragedy and comedy, desperation and irony, in the world of the margin.

title: The Swan Princess II
description: The evil wizard Clavius ??in search of his colleague Rothbarth's magic sphere, an indispensable tool for the conquest of the world, jeopardizes the happiness of the two young people. But thanks to the help of trusty little animal friends, JeanBob, Arrow, Puffin and Bromley, Prince Derek and his bride Odette manage to foil the pitfalls.
notes: All according to script then: the snare, the overcoming of the test and the happy ending, for the joy of the children and the triumph of good feelings.
