Backed by a discreet animation technique and the consummate direction of the veteran Rich, director of Disney origin, who also has "Red and Toby enemies" and "Taron and the magic pot" to his credit. The film is honestly ordinary and fails to reproduce the magical aura of Disney products nor the visionary nature of the Burton & Selick factory animated works.

title: Air Force One
actors: Harrison Ford, Gary Oldman, Glenn Close, Wendy Crewson, Liesel Matthews, Paul Guilfoyle, Xander Berkeley, William H. Macy, Dean Stockwell, Tom Everett, Jürgen Prochnow, Donna Bullock
description: James Marshall, President of the United States, known for his determination to fight terrorists is holding a conference congratulating the capture of the dangerous General Radek, a dictator who terrorizes a state born from the dissolution of the Soviet empire. While the President is flying on Air Force One with his wife and daughter, the plane is hijacked by a group of terrorists loyal to General Radek.
notes: Clear model: "Delta Force" with Chuck Norris, crossed with massive doses of familiar-popular sentimentality at the "Airport" and demented touches (who knows if volunteers) at the "Craziest Plane in the World". A well thought-out action toy, unfortunately slowed down by the Teutonic grandeur of Wolfgang Petersen, who continues to be in love with U-Boats (even if of the air) and pompous state meetings. It is useless to dwell on ideological narrow-mindedness, when cinematic narrow-mindedness is so irremediable.

title: In the Company of the Man
actors: Aaron Eckhart, Stacy Edwards, Matt Malloy
description: Two vain managers, frustrated and talkative, disappointed at having been abandoned by their girlfriends, spend their time humiliating all those they consider weaker. They cannot believe their eyes when they come across a frail, helpless and deaf typist. A new mission begins for the two.
notes: On an aberrant exasperation is built "In the society of men", the debut film by the American playwright Neil LaBute, who has the courage to be wicked. A little poor from a cinematographic point of view, the film lives on a brilliant writing and on the idea of ??"emptiness" in which it places the characters. A good debut.

title: Stressati
actors: Gian Marco Tognazzi, Eliana Miglio, Barbara Livi, Daniele Liotti, Monica Bellucci
description: Marco and Dado have been friends since high school and are lucky enough to work together with the satirical newspaper, perpetually in crisis, "Ecce Homo". The office is managed by Gino, a fifty-year-old with a quick wit and a sixty-eight past. Dado has great success with women, while Marco has many problems from this point of view. But one day in their life, Adele and Maria appear.
notes: The film stages characters without quality and without center of gravity, who measure themselves in a crudely goliardic theater. But what really bothers is the unbearable attitude of the two protagonists who, rattling off their mediocre jokes, constantly wink at the audience as if to say: "This is beautiful, huh?".

title: Lolita
actors: Jeremy Irons, Dominique Swain, Melanie Griffith, Frank Langella
description: Humbert Humbert is a refined and brilliant professor of French literature who, thanks to his charm, manages to have a lot of luck with women. The professor, who arrived in a small town in New England in 1947, sees in the twelve-year-old daughter of a sensual widow the possible realization of a teenage love never lived.
notes: The camera is determined not to show us anything that cannot be broadcast on television. And everything is soft focus, sometimes with sepia tones, often in slow motion. Lyne has put together all the predictable kitsch, with cadences of deadly boredom. It is useless to think of Nabokov and Kubrick.

title: Contact
actors: Jodie Foster, Matthew McConaughey, James Woods, David Morse
description: As a child, Ellie Arroway would get up at night to listen to her shortwave radio with the hope of picking up mysterious voices. After her father's death she devotes herself to science, which seems to her capable of giving those answers that have always tormented her. At university, her unanswered questions prompted her to specialize in finding messages sent by extraterrestrial beings. Despite the skepticism that surrounds her, Ellie holds firm to her convictions. Until one day ...
notes: In the final part, "Contact" reveals all its splendor, thanks to the millions of dollars spent that give twenty minutes of authentic magical atmosphere up there, somewhere in the universe, where maybe you can find your loved ones walking on the beaches Florida type. The main flaw of the operation is to prepare a religious-scientific-new age cocktail without paying too much attention to measuring the ingredients. In short, the air of "Contact" is too cold, but the journey nevertheless deserves to be conducted and completed.

title: Porzûs
actors: Lorenzo Crespi, Gianni Cavina, Giuseppe Cederna, Giulia Boschi
description: In 1945 at the huts above Porzûs, a hundred partisans of the Garibaldi brigade and the Gap slaughtered about twenty partisans of the Osoppo. Geko commands them who will later say around that that group was accused of treason and collusion with the fascists, all to avoid consequences. But when the war is over, Storno, who has escaped the massacre, has Geko and his men sentenced to life imprisonment in absentia.
notes: The other side of the Resistance is filmed with approximation, with a loud voice, with an often improbable acting, with errors in the likelihood. Crespi (young Geko) has a marked Sicilian accent; Moschin (old Geko) is Venetian spit. The partisan and the beautiful make love upstairs and rubble falls in a room that is not below theirs. The visible transformation of the young starling into the old is already a (negative) cult. If the historical reconstruction is as accurate as the cinematographic one ...

title: Consigli per gli acquisti
actors: Ennio Fantastichini, Silvia Cohen, Ivano Marescotti, Mariella Valentini
description: Scott, a slightly bruised big dog, is recovered in a kennel by Vanda, a successful advertiser, in search of the right "face" for the campaign of a new dog food. Meat, originally intended for humans and now full of worms, must be recycled and properly advertised for dog owners. The demented chatter of Gianfranco and other collaborators of the project are counterpointed by images of a demonstration of the unemployed. But it turns out that they too have a sponsor.
notes: It is an unpleasant film, bad with everyone: with mystical creatives and advertising sharks, career girls and "property finders", Bocconians, Harvardians, and even with the workers, fired and angry, but so involved in the advertising culture that they call their children Nike and Adida. The film has inside the healthy anger of one who likes almost nothing of what he sees and is directed with a style soured by the advertising-television distortions of taste.

title: Attanasio cavallo vanesio
actors: Renato Rascel, Tina De Mola, Kiki Urbani, Peppino De Martino
description: A jockey, while strolling along the river with Attanasio, his beloved horse, meets Lea and falls in love with her at first sight. But an unforeseen happens because Attanasio ends up at auction and Leo has to struggle a lot to get it back.
notes: Taken without any particular effort to adapt from the play of the same name by Garinei and Giovannini, the film is one of the worst by Camillo Mastrocinque, otherwise a solid artisan of film genres. However, it met with great success with the public. Almost exclusively thanks to Renato Rascel, at the time on the crest of the wave, perfectly at ease as the shoulder of a ... horse.

title: School Daze
actors: Laurence Fishburne, Giancarlo Esposito, Tisha Campbell-Martin, Spike Lee, Samuel L. Jackson, Jasmine Guy, Ossie Davis
description: A student on a university campus struggles tenaciously against the administration and fellow students who are part of weird and, at times, dangerous student groups.
notes: Spike Lee deals with everything in this film: from drafting the story, to production and even acting (his is the role of Half-Pint). But the attempt to make an all-black "Animal House" unfortunately fails. Even if the commitment and the idea are to be praised in some way.

title: War of the Buttons
actors: Anthony Cunningham, Gregg Fitzgerald, Colm Meaney, Gerard Kearney
description: As in the rest of the world, in France too, children gather in gangs to create real societies of minors ready to fight each other. The buttons of the title, in this case, are not those of the rooms of power, but, more prosaically, those that hold up the pants and that are the highest stake in the "battles" between the groups of children.
notes: Roberts' film is the remake of a 1961 work by Yves Robert, based on a novel by Louis Pergaud. If the first guaranteed a minimum of freshness and childish lightheartedness, this second has many more defects and an advantage: it does not show the violence taking place.

title: La Traviata
actors: Teresa Stratas, Placido Domingo, Cornell MacNeill, Alan Monk
description: The luxury socialite Violetta Valéry is now alone and near death due to consumption, the disease of the nineteenth century. In flashback she thinks back to her love for Alfredo Germont, the only man she truly loved but abandoned precisely so as not to tarnish his reputation. Only now does Alfredo, who witnesses the woman's agony, understand the purity of Violetta's sentiment.
notes: Cinematic reinterpretation of Verdi's opera. As always, Zeffirelli favors the superficial splendor of the sets. The cinematic duration also sacrifices some important parts.

title: Au hasard Balthazar
actors: Anne Wiazemsky, François Lafarge, Philippe Asselin
description: The title character is a donkey, an involuntary and impartial witness to the tragic events of Marie, a "wild girl" in a rural village in France, the subject of morbid attention and violence. Even the donkey experiences a personal ordeal that culminates in death.
notes: The title is the heraldic motto of the counts of Baux-de-Provence who traced their origins to the "wise man" Baldassare.

title: Aab, baad, khaak
actors: Majid Niroumand
description: After two years of absence, spent elsewhere looking for a job, a boy returns home. Upon arrival, however, he found the village completely deserted: everyone fled due to a terrible drought. Thus began a frantic search for the boy through desolate landscapes. Before finding relatives, he must also fight for his own survival.

title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
actors: Peter Cushing, Christopher Lee, André Morell, Maria Landi
description: Sherlock Holmes, in the company of Doctor Watson, comes to the rescue of the last epigone of the nobles of Baskerville. An ancient curse would in fact want that the family should be extinguished in his person who should die killed by a mastiff dog. In fact, on the moor surrounding the Baskerville villa, on moonless nights, a sinister howl is heard with increasing frequency.
notes: The film is based on the novel of the same name by Arthur Conan Doyle. A faithful transposition but not devoid of original dramaturgical colors. Impeccable acting by Cushing and Lee. The scenography is spot on.

title: La città sconvolta: caccia spietata ai rapitori
actors: Luc Merenda, James Mason, Irina Maleeva, Marino Masé
description: Masked bandits, who carry out their criminal actions on behalf of unsuspected financiers from the North, kidnap little Antonio Filippini, the son of a wealthy engineer, and also Fabrizio, a playmate of his who intervened in his defense. The kidnappers, who came out after a period of silence, negotiate with the secretary of the engineer and ask for the ransom of Antonio, ten billion. Filipinos at first balk, but the kidnappers kill Fabrizio ...
notes: Typical seventies film in which the basic moral is "the citizens have to get by on their own, because if they wait for the police ...". Luc Merenda, star of the time, did his best.

title: O.P. Center
actors: Harry Hamlin, Carl Weathers, Rod Steiger
description: A KGB colonel seizes a nuclear device, twenty-five times more powerful than the one used on Hiroshima during the Second World War. His intent is to obtain the largest possible sum and therefore he places the "booty" on the international market. Meanwhile in Washington, other power games and other intrigues. They too are covered by the most total secrecy. How will it end ?.
notes: Action film that unfolds in a somewhat schematic and rather predictable way. Among the performers the always good Rod Steiger.

title: Getting Straight
actors: Elliott Gould, Candice Bergen, Ronald Stone, Jeanne Berlin
description: Harry is an elderly college student. Protester (we are around 1968), he is in love with a colleague, barricadera as much as he, who would like to marry him. Contrasts arise between the two precisely regarding the ideological-political commitment with alternating phases of quarrels and reconciliation. Graduating is now only one exam, but Harry, who would like to teach, realizes that ...
notes: Less famous than "Strawberries and Blood", it belongs to that small but lively group of American films which, partly riding the wave of protest, partly supporting it, discovered that non-conformism could also be a good economic deal. Appeared for the young and unknown Harrison Ford.

title: Rage
actors: George C. Scott, Richard Basehart, Martin Sheen
description: A man and his son are contaminated with a deadly gas. The little boy dies. Before dying in turn, the parent blows up the factory that produces the evil gas. Good debut in directing for the actor Scott: a tight film, with very 70s political fictional tones.

title: East of Sumatra
actors: Jeff Chandler, Suzan Ball, Anthony Quinn, Marilyn Maxwell
description: A mining engineer arrives on a small island of the South Seas full of tin deposits. Here, with the work and the example, he enters the sympathies of the natives who snog for him in exchange for food and medicines. However, the leader is hostile because of a girl, his promised bride, who shows a certain sympathy for the engineer. The tension increases and some dramatic episodes bring the two to a struggle without a neighborhood that proves to be fatal.
notes: The story is a faithful mirror of the colonial mentality. Things like this become acceptable to the cinema if marked by faces at the Humphrey Bogart or Tyrone Power, but here the interpreters have no attraction.

title: Linda
actors: Virginia Madsen, Richard Thomas, Ted McGinley, Laura Harrington
description: A man is forced by the Linda consort to spend the holidays in a locality of Florida together with the neighbors. Once on the spot, Linda ends up killing the neighbor's wife and manages to accuse her husband of her murder. But he thinks well to take revenge ...
notes: Film thought and produced for the US cable television well acted by Virginia Madsen. What is harmful is the excessive violence of the plot, which, despite having returned to fashion in the cinema and on television in this film it is all too annoying. In the United States it was forbidden to minors of thirteen years.

title: The Horror at 37,000 feet
actors: Buddy Ebsen, Chuck Connors, Tammy Grimes, William Shatner
description: An American arch is called in England to pick up some pieces of an abbey that is about to be dismantled. When he gets on the plane that brings him home a mysterious presence terrifies all passengers. The fault of the finds of the church, protected by a satanic force ...
notes: Television films that clumsily mixes typical elements of the horror and catastrophic genre. Easy to imagine what comes out.

title: In Cold Blood
actors: Robert Blake, Scott Wilson, John Forsythe, Paul Stewart
description: Perry Edward Smith and Richard Eugene Hickcock, just released from prison on probation, trusting vague information about the existence of a safe in a farmer's house, leave for Holcomb. Entering the house at night, after searching in vain for money, they exterminate the entire family. Thus begins an escape while the police continue to grope in the dark, looking for a possible motive for the atrocious crime.
notes: At the basis of the film is the investigative novel that Truman Capote wrote for the "New Yorker" based on a real event. Photographed in stunning black and white by Conrad Hall, it is a work that still baffles today thirty years later.

title: O Cangaceiro
actors: Alberto Ruschell, Marisa Prado, Milton Ribeiro, Ricardo Campos
description: Galdino Ferreira, leader of a gang of criminals, turns the Brazilian Northeast region upside down. During one of the many raids Galdino takes Oliva hostage, a young teacher who fascinated him with her beauty. Theodore, Galdino's lieutenant, who does not approve of this act of arrogance towards a woman, frees her and goes away with her. Realizing that the two have escaped, the bandit puts his men on their trail.
notes: Barreto with this first feature won the Palme d'Or at the Cannes Film Festival (best adventure film), mixing openly western themes with topics from national history. The soundtrack, at the time, was a huge success.

title: Shadow of a Doubt
actors: Joseph Cotten, Teresa Wright, Macdonald Carey, Hume Cronyn
description: Charlie Oakley returns, inexplicably and after many years, to some relatives. Everyone welcomes him affectionately, especially his niece who sees in him an opportunity to escape from everyday life. Charlie is actually a dangerous killer and is afraid of being caught by the police. It will be the niece who ...
notes: More than a thriller, the film outlines an impossible love story and the portrait of a not too unpleasant killer. Hitchcock, who makes his usual appearance as a bridge player on the train, was proud of his writing collaboration with Thornton Wilder.

title: Il corazziere
actors: Renato Rascel, Tino Buazzelli, Claudia Mori, Carlo Giuffrè
description: Urbano Marangoni has only one desire in life: to wear, like his father, the cuirassier uniform. But between the realization of his dream and reality there is only one problem: height. Falling in love with Mirella, the daughter of a hierarch, Urbano feels a decisive refusal from the girl's father, not at all willing to have a half-sock as a son-in-law. Disappointed, Urban is sure to take revenge when bad luck forces him to take part in all the wars of the time.
notes: One of the specks that made Rascel famous is taken as the starting point for a low-level film. A few smiles with the Roman actor, who sings the famous song of the title.

title: Men in Black
actors: Tommy Lee Jones, Will Smith, Linda Fiorentino, Vincent D'Onofrio
description: K. and J. are the "men in black" at the service of an unofficial but funded government agency that deals with everything related to illegal immigration of aliens to Earth. In fact, the extraterrestrials have long since arrived on our planet, they live among us and have taken on different appearances.
notes: Inspired by Lowell Cunningham's strip of the same name, the film is a game about the need for cohabitation between different races. Because after all, even men in black have a heart and are fond of the monsters with whom they have been dealing and collaborating for years. Underneath, it is also a bitter game, in which individuals can be tolerant but people cannot, and it is good to keep them in the dark. Sonnenfeld keeps a flawless pace, mixes genres well (science fiction, detective and comedy) and quotes with measure and irony. Extraordinary the aliens.

title: Love etc.
actors: Charlotte Gainsbourg, Yvan Attal, Charles Berling
description: Benoît and Pierre are friends for the skin: the first is a gray employee of changes, the second a Narcissus professor and a self -finished Maudit. Through an insertion in a newspaper, Benoît meets Marie. The two are liked immediately and immediately decide to get married. But Pierre also falls in love with the woman who, after some hesitation, ends up chapter. The three will meet on a beach, in the early hours of the new millennium.
notes: The third work of Marion Vernoux (after "Pierre Qui Roule" and "Personne nor m'aime") takes inspiration from the novel "Talking it over" by Julian Barnes and, almost compulsorily, by François Truffaut (not to mention Hitchcock). "Love etc." He is a "Jules and Jim" passed to New Age lesson. Yvan Attal and Charlotte Gainsbourg (who also form a couple in life), place their love story in the fiction. While Charles Berling is one of those Frou Frou de Paris actors to whom you disappear after a second.

title: Happy Together
actors: Leslie Cheung, Tony Leung Chiu Wai, Chang Chen, Gregory Dayton
description: Lai Tiu-Fi and Ho-Po Wing are in love when they leave their native Hong Kong to travel to Argentina. But something is wrong in fact, while the two are heading towards the south of the country, Ho-Po Wing abandons her lover. Lai decides to settle in Buenos Aires, gets a job as a bouncer in a tango bar and is putting together the money to finally go home. But one day Ho reappears in her life.
notes: Exciting and passionate film, "hot", disappointed, desperate and unstoppable in the whirlwind progression of his amor fou. Wong Kar-Wai plays with conventions with a style that never forgets originality.

title: Paradise Road
actors: Glenn Close, Frances McDormand, Cate Blanchett, Julianna Margulies
description: The way to heaven is fraught with hardship and suffering, and a large group of European, Australian and Chinese women soon realize this when the Japanese arrive in Singapore in 1942. Thrown into a Japanese prison camp in Sumatra, the women manage to overcome the differences of culture and class that divide them through the engagement in an improvised choir.
notes: The film tells a little known episode of the Second World War and is built on the testimonies of about twenty survivors. Beresford only partially renders the change of perspective produced by the forced encounter between women so distant, and which is lost in the dubbed version in Italian. But the magic of those encounters survives, supported by the music of Dvorak and Chopin, which softens the Japanese and the spectator.

title: She's So Lovely
actors: Sean Penn, Robin Wright, John Travolta, Harry Dean Stanton
description: A neighbor tried to rape Maureen. Eddie, his partner, intervened with the violence that is his habit: and ended up in a psychiatric hospital for ten years. Maureen is now with Joey who married her and also transfers her care to Eddie's daughter, who is now nine years old.
notes: Nick Cassavetes, son of the great John, argues that this was a project strongly desired by his father. But the excesses of acting tics weigh down the story, only partially redeemed by Travolta's gigionery and Harry Dean Stanton's melancholy fixation.

title: In barca a vela contromano
actors: Valerio Mastandrea, Antonio Catania, Emanuela Rossi, Maurizio Mattioli
description: Massimo, thirty years old, is admitted to a public hospital for an operation on his knee ligaments, without which he would have to stop playing football. As a roommate he happens to be Luigi, a forty-year-old stuck on the bed for some years, due to a series of wrong operations. The latter gradually makes him understand that it would be more appropriate to give priority to the hundreds of elderly people who have been on the waiting list for years. At this point Massimo, in the grip of guilt, thinks about giving up his intervention.
notes: After the success (including Oscar nomination) of the short "Exit" and the flop of the feature film "Laggiù nella Jungle", Stefano Reali went to the hospital to have his knee fixed. The experience gave birth to a comedy - "Operation" - which has now turned into a film, almost entirely set in a ward. Dilapidated like the Niguarda in Milan, he is saved by the interpreters: first Valerio Mastandrea, second Catania, third Mattioli.

title: Captain Pirate
actors: Louis Hayward, Patricia Medina, John Sutton
description: Captain Blood has abandoned his adventurous life as a privateer on seas around the world to pursue a career as a doctor while continuing to help people in need. But one day he learns that a pirate is using his identity to commit criminal acts. Thus he gathers his old companions, arms a brig and collides with his opponent.
notes: Mid-level US production with good performers, it is a sort of ideal sequel to "Captain Blood".

title: Ovosodo
actors: Edoardo Gabbriellini, Marco Cocci, Nicoletta Braschi, Claudia Pandolfi, Malcolm Lunghi
description: Piero is one of the many young people who live in the popular Ovosodo district on the outskirts of Livorno. He finds a friend in his teacher, Giovanna, who is always close to him and lends him the masterpieces of literature that he eagerly reads.
notes: "Ovosodo" not only entered (rare case for a comedy) in the competition of the Venice Film Festival, but he even returned home with the Grand Jury Prize. The film is not a "great" Italian comedy, but rather one of those little 1950s comedies built on the intersection of a myriad of characters (who were then variety actors and character actors).

title: The Lost World
actors: Jeff Goldblum, Vince Vaughn, Julianne Moore, Pete Postlethwaite
description: The dinosaurs, locked up in the "Jurassic Park" had fled causing panic. Now a group of scientists led by Dr. Malcolm, documentary maker Owen, paleontologist Harding and specialist Car are investigating what may have happened.
notes: Maybe because a sequel is expected less and less, but the second part of "Jurassic Park" is not bad. The first part is nice and compact, the second, in the city, mentions the 50s B series and is more obvious.

title: Popi
actors: Alan Arkin, Rita Moreno, Miguel Alejandro, Ruben Figueroa
description: Confined to a depressed neighborhood in New York, Abraham Rodriguez, a Puerto Rican widower, knows he cannot secure a future for his two children. Tired of the constant oppression to which Luis of 7 and Junior of 10 are subjected, he looks for someone who can adopt them by making them believe that the two boys have crossed the ocean alone on a small boat from Cuba.
notes: The film skillfully mixes comedy and drama tones. Bravo Alan Arkin.

title: Napló szerelmeimnek
actors: Zsuzsa Czinkóczi, Anna Polony, Jan Nowicki, Pál Szemes
description: Stalin is dead, Hungary is experiencing moments of great euphoria. Life seems to start again: Juli - an orphan who has suffered the sentence of her father arrested by the police, who saw her family friend Janós incarcerated for no obvious reason - thinks that the hard moment of oppression is over. These are flashes of happiness and optimism: when the authorities rehabilitate the memory of Juli's father and release Janós, she thinks it is possible to go to Moscow. To study at the film school. It's just an illusion: when the Soviet tanks enter Budapest, she decides to return home.
notes: Second part of the trilogy by this director who, through the diary structure, tells the difficult moments in Hungarian history and the collective events of her people and their relations with the Soviet Union.

title: The Young Savages
actors: Burt Lancaster, Dina Merrill, Shelley Winters, Telly Savalas
description: In the struggle between bands of Puerto Ricans and Italians, a dead man escapes and a young Puerto Rican is naturally accused of the crime. Burt Lancaster is a high-hoped lawyer with many ideals. He undertakes to save the life of the accused young man who risks the electric chair. For this he investigates by digging into the unhealthy social environment in which the boy grew up and discovers that ...
notes: Judicial film committed from an Evan Hunter novel, better known under the pseudonym of Ed McBain. The initial sequences of the fight between rival gangs, shot with non-professional actors, are interesting.

title: M*A*S*H*
actors: Elliott Gould, Donald Sutherland, Robert Duvall, Sally Kellerman, Tom Skerritt, Roger Bowen, René Auberjonois, David Arkin, Jo Ann Pflug, Gary Burghoff, Fred Williamson, Michael Murphy, Indus Arthur
description: In Korea, too, the war has its rear and its field hospitals. In this, between one operation and another, in the midst of structural deficiencies and chronic shortages of medicines, three surgeons organize a jokey and alternative existence. They prepare even atrocious jokes on officers and non-commissioned officers; they even go so far as to inject tranquilizers to their opponents in the rugby match.
notes: With this film Altman wins the Palme d'Or at the Cannes Film Festival. Structured with great freedom, M.A.S.H. it demystifies military heroism, anticipates the multiplication of characters and the overlapping of voices and points of view that Altman the protester will perfect five years later with "Nashville".

title: Io la conoscevo bene
actors: Stefania Sandrelli, Nino Manfredi, Ugo Tognazzi, Enrico Maria Salerno
description: Adriana leaves the province to try to succeed in the capital. In Rome, however, it is not easy to find luck and the promises of numerous acquaintances lead to nothing. In the end despair prevails.
notes: Fierce portrait of an Italy that perhaps no longer exists. Stefania Sandrelli, at the first important test, is perfect

title: La polizia accusa: il Servizio Segreto uccide
actors: Luc Merenda, Mel Ferrer, Delia Boccardo, Paola Tedesco
description: A series of tragic deaths that could be linked. Apparently random accidents, the disappearance of a major, a colonel and a general are the subject of a careful investigation by Commissioner Solmi. Who, helped by a journalist friend, manages to connect the various clues and to compose the puzzle by putting the various tiles one after the other. His investigation leads him to verify the existence of a clandestine training camp with which the Secret Services are involved.
notes: The analysis is superficial and the twists respond to narrative logic that is often worn and ineffective.

title: Le diable probablement
actors: Antoine Monnier, Tina Irissari, Henri de Maublanc
description: Charles is a Parisian student who lives on his own. He is nonconformist, pacifist and ecologist. While other young people gather to discuss politics, raise awareness or raise public awareness, he understands that all of this is useless because the evil of the world is inextricable and men travel on a ship of fools. Having bought a gun, he asks a drug addict friend to kill him, at night, in the "Père Lachaise" cemetery in Paris.
notes: Filmed in flashbacks starting from the news of the young man's death, it is a rigorous descent into the underworld of the discomfort and existential malaise that emerged strongly in the "years of lead". Metaphorical "via crucis" of a lay and terribly young Jesus.

title: Friends 'Til the End
actors: Shannen Doherty, Jennifer Blanc, Jason London
description: Heather Dunsmore is very famous at her university, because, in addition to being a good student, she is also the leader of a music band that is trying to establish itself. The girl has everything she desires including the love of the group's guitarist. One day, however, Fanne Armstrong shows up and tries in every way to make friends with her. Soon Fanne manages to sneak into Heather's private life as well and pairs up with her on stage. But for a little while, because he soon replaces it. Where does the "timid" Fangs want to go?
notes: Typically television product with some infamy and very little praise. With former "Beverly Hills 90120" Shannen Doherty, more temperamental than ever.

title: The War
actors: Kevin Costner, Elijah Wood, Lexi Randall, Mare Winningham, Donald Sellers, Christopher Fennell
description: We are in the early seventies and two children, Stu and Lidia Simmons, from their little house placed on a beautiful oak tree, witness the return of their father from the Vietnam war. The two teenagers, who have always looked at the world with pure eyes and light-hearted attitudes, are forced to confront a world of abuses and terrible violence. A return, that of the father, who, inevitably, will change the life of the whole family.
notes: The direction and script are signed by Jon Avnet and Kathy McWorter, basically the same team that led to the hit "Fried Green Tomatoes at the Train Stop". Bittersweet comedy, fun and full of vitality with a fit Costner.

title: Safe Passage
actors: Susan Sarandon, Sam Shepard, Robert Sean Leonard, Sean Astin
description: Mag Singer, mother of seven, currently separated from her husband Patrick, perpetually anxious and protective, had a dream. More than anything else, it is the presentiment that one of his boys is in danger. Percival may have been the victim of an attack in Sinai. One by one the other children return home, Patrick also comes back, a moderate anguish also arrives. The only thing to do is to wait.
notes: What is surprising is that this film is based on a novel and not a play. What is surprising is how Susan Sarandon let herself be harnessed in an impossible role, struggling with a heavy director.

title: Tommy Boy
actors: Chris Farley, David Spade, Brian Dennehy, Bo Derek, Rob Lowe
description: Tommy Callaghan III is a dumb and very obese young man who after college starts working in Sundusky, Ohio, in his father's small company specializing in auto parts. But things go to pieces almost immediately, because the father dies of a heart attack on the day of his wedding with Beverly who gets angry with someone else making him pass for her son, the company falls.
notes: If the movie's best lines travel to the tone of "How's your mother-in-law? Like a stick in the butt!" word of the butcher "and if the most successful gag is the one that sees Tommy rubbing the arbre magique under his armpits to freshen up, imagine the rest.

title: Halloween III: Season of the Witch
actors: Tom Atkins, Stacy Nelkin, Dan O'Herlihy, Michael Currie
description: Dr. Daniel Challis is in full family crisis. One day when he is on duty in the emergency room of his hospital he has to help a man, reduced to death by strange individuals who attacked him. The wounded man, who utters disjointed sentences, is attacked again and dies during the night. Daniel and Ellie Grimbridge want to discover the killers and set out on the trail of an ambiguous mask factory that is touted obsessively on television.
notes: The third episode is better than the others, thanks to the screenplay by Nigel Kneale (uncredited), the creator of Quatermass.

title: Carnal Knowledge
actors: Jack Nicholson, Candice Bergen, Art Garfunkel, Ann-Margret
description: Sandy and Jonathan are two college students who live in the same bedroom and are used to exchanging confidences regarding their sexual experiences. Sandy meets Susan at a party with a girl he has a relationship with. Jonathan, betraying his friend's trust, in turn manages to have a short fling with the girl. Time passes and Sandy, a medical graduate, marries Susan, while Jonathan begins living with Bobbie. But soon the two couples enter into crisis.
notes: Nichols brings to the big screen a text for the theater written by Jules Feiffer, the famous American cartoonist and maintains all its characteristics both in terms of language and behavior of the characters. A very bitter and disenchanted comedy about the relations between the sexes in America in the 70s.

title: Face/Off
actors: John Travolta, Nicolas Cage, Joan Allen, Gina Gershon, Dominique Swain, Alessandro Nivola, Nick Cassavetes, Harve Presnell, Colm Feore, John Carroll Lynch, CCH Pounder, Robert Wisdom, Margaret Cho, James Denton
description: Sean Archer is an FBI agent who is confronted by Castor Troy during a police action, a dangerous terrorist in possession of a deadly bomb, and who in a previous action killed his son. One day an accident sends the terrorist into a coma and this allows Sean, thanks to a surgery, to take the form of him to try to neutralize the bomb. The criminal, however, comes out of the coma and makes the pair by settling in Archer's office ...
notes: In reality, "Face / Off" is a horror melo that uses the charm of action, the contrast between slow motion and sudden explosions of the editing, to explode all internal anger and tension. The faces split: Travolta-Archer takes that of Cage-Troy and vice versa, the life (of others) is a trap to master or a revenge to savor. Woo has an energy and strength in action that are now rare. Comparable only to what Peckinpah had thirty years ago.

title: Ta'm e guilass
actors: Homayon Ershadi, Abdolrahman Bagheri, Safar-Ali Moradi
description: A man in a car drives around the outskirts of Tehran. He loads a Kurdish soldier, then an Afghan seminarian, and finally an old man who works at the Natural History Museum. His path, his dialogues at the beginning are unsettling; then they become more and more distressing. The man is looking for someone who is willing to help him commit suicide, who the next morning, goes to an agreed place, near a pit already dug, calls him and, if he does not answer, fills the pit with earth.
notes: Beautiful journey without story (that of the protagonist took place all before) and without ending, the film has the elegance, intelligence, depth without presumption of the best Kiarostami. The hollowed out yellow hills almost become a reminder of the earth; the dialogues, even philosophical, have the naturalness of real life. And in the end, after dawn, everything becomes cinema again, with the crew and the director on the shooting locations. Or, perhaps, all cinema becomes an everyday experience.

title: All Dogs Go to Heaven 2
description: With the usual air of a dandy and the incurable passion for dogs, Charlie, helped by his faithful Itchy, this time must work hard to prevent Gabriel's Trumpet from falling into the hands of that devil of a cat called Red and return it to canine paradise. from which it was subtracted from the ugly Carface. Heaven is too quiet and peaceful for Charlie who has never forgotten busy old San Francisco.
notes: MGM tries to revive the glories of its glorious "cartoon department", fielding a lot of voice actors for the original edition of the film (including Charlie Sheen, Dom De Luise and Sheena Easton) and taking inspiration from Tex Avery, one of the his great masters animators of the past, and in fact the character of Carface is a clear homage to Spike Averian.

title: Western
actors: Sergi López, Sacha Bourdo, Elisabeth Vitali
description: Paco, a Catalan transplanted to France, is a traveling salesman and Nino, an indifferent wanderer, of uncertain Italian-Russian origin, meet. They are two people who apparently have nothing in common, apart from the fact that they are both foreigners and carry out "professions" that find their essence in the journey. After the first meeting during which Nino steals Paco's car, their lives will never be the same. The music of chance brings them back together, creating an indissoluble bond day after day.
notes: Grand Jury Prize at the Cannes Film Festival, "Western" is a film that has divided the critics, but whose sweet and melancholy irony that pervades surreal Brittany is striking, with some moments of indisputable humor.

title: G.I. Jane
actors: Demi Moore, Viggo Mortensen, Anne Bancroft, Jason Beghe
description: Jordan O'Neil, who despite her name is a woman, at one point in her life enlisted in the Navy raiders. But he must immediately deal with John Urgayle, his terrible instructor officer. Nobody believes the girl can withstand the grueling training.
notes: A dizzy film (at least a couple of endings lined up), hysterical, "titanic". Many have crushed it. But underneath an "equal opportunity" story is Scott's gigantism and his sense of space and rhythm.

title: Banzai
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Francesco De Rosa, Francesca Romana Coluzzi
description: Sergio Colombo, an official of an insurance company, is at the airport leaving for Canada, but due to a misunderstanding he boards a plane leaving for Tokyo. To complicate matters, his suitcase is exchanged for another containing a large batch of drugs. Of course, on his trail there are the usual bad guys who do everything to recover the precious goods. Upon arrival in Japan, Colombo is involved in all kinds of adventures.
notes: After "I no spik inglish", the Vanzina brothers decided to indulge in an exotic holiday in Bangkok and Japan. The result is absolutely ignoble, irrecoverable even for any trash aesthetic. Because it has no aesthetics and no dignity, not even artisanal. Pure slovenliness (and you never laugh). An insult to Villaggio and the public. As Fantozzi of the "Potemkin" said: she is a crazy boiata.

title: C'è un sentiero nel cielo
actors: Claudio Villa, Ivana Kislinger, Carlo Campanini
description: Manuela and Claudio love each other passionately. But she is called back to her homeland (she is Spanish) where an evil aunt plots in the shadows to steal an inheritance from her and make her marry her son. Claudio joins her and marries her. For the couple the abyss of misery opens up, but luckily there is a will that can make Manuela rich ...
notes: A narrative pretext from an appendix to make the "reuccio" of the song unfold the golden uvula. From neurodelirio both the interpretation and the direction of Marino Girolami. Recommended (so to speak) only for those nostalgic for Claudio Villa and bel canto. Carlo Campanini does the shoulder, as always.

title: Otello
actors: Placido Domingo, Katia Ricciarelli, Justino Díaz, Urbano Barberini
description: Returning to Cyprus after a victorious war, the Moor, instigated by the perfidious Iago, betrays his friendship with the faithful Cassius and arrives at the auxoricide out of jealousy. In turn, he commits suicide on Desdemona's corpse.
notes: In this production by Zeffirelli, it is worth noting the usual scenographic care of the Florentine director which is reflected in the usual pneumatic void in terms of narrative solidity. Even the choice of the cast, made up of opera stars but also actors (voiced by singers), does not respond to a dramaturgical intent, but rather to a clever commercial need to "sell" the beautiful packaging.

title: The Anderson Tapes
actors: Sean Connery, Dyan Cannon, Martin Balsam, Christopher Walken
description: William Anderson, known as Duke, returns to freedom after ten years in prison and decides to secure a peaceful future by robbing a mansion. Having installed himself in the apartment of a former friend, Duke recruits a group of accomplices including Kid and Pop, two ex-convicts, Tommy Eskins, a homosexual antiquarian expert in precious, Jim, Spencer and the killer Barelli, imposed on him by the mafioso Pat Angel. Accepted the terms of the latter, Anderson starts his detailed plan.
notes: The eclectic Lumet directs with ease a nice and light hit-movie. Quincy Jones soundtrack. Debut for Christopher Walken.

title: Harold and Maude
actors: Ruth Gordon, Bud Cort, Vivian Pickles, Cyril Baldwin, Cyril Cusack
description: In a sumptuous villa in the American provinces lives Harold, a mindless and troubled teenager. The young man enjoys simulating - as he will tell his psychoanalyst - fifteen suicides to shake his mother, a handsome and foolish young man, who can no longer bear him. In addition to suicide attempts, Harold cultivates necrophilic tendencies: he does not miss a funeral which he goes to with a funeral home car. On one of these visits he makes friends with Maude, an old woman who is thrilled with life despite being close to her eightieth year of age.
notes: Very 70s autumn tale in which Ashby tells a sort of love story between two marginal and eccentric. Beautiful the soundtrack of Cat Stevens.

title: Naplò apàmnak, anyàmnak
actors: Zsuzsa Czinkóczi, Jan Nowicki, Mari Töröcsik, Anna Polony
description: We are running out of 1956, when the Hungarian socialist "spring" has already been suffocated. Budapest is in terror and New Year is a very sad party. The head of the democratic government Nagy was undermined by Kadar who asked for and obtained the military intervention of Big Brother Soviet. Juli, the protagonist, no longer finds Jànos, who was arrested for his libertarian ideas and who will end up on the gallows. Evil and good still are not distinct from two distinct parts, but ambiguity, compromises, fears and basses with which people are now used to living together make everything even more confused.
notes: It is the third chapter of the Hungarian director's trilogy on "feelings". Perhaps the least successful of the three, but only because a lot of things "have already been said" in the previous films and because the events are blended and not sleeves, and therefore more risky. However, these are always high -level cinema and great courage.

title: Captain Lightfoot
actors: Rock Hudson, Barbara Rusch, Jeff Morrow, Kathleen Ryan
description: Ireland 1815: John Faherty, leader of the rebels, runs a gambling house to finance the autonomist struggle. With him is Mike, the aide to whom John, injured in a clash with the police, entrusts the task of directing the movement until his recovery. But Faherty's refuge is discovered and while John manages to escape, Mike is imprisoned. At the urging of his girlfriend, the plan is triggered to free him.
notes: Ireland is going strong in this period, cinematically speaking. But it was also a tasty dish in 1955, the year of this film seasoned by Sirk, the cook of melodramas, with skill and knowledge of twists.

title: Real Men
actors: James Belushi, John Ritter, Barbara Barrie, Bill Morey
description: One of the two main characters in this story is an insurer and certainly does not shine with his courage. On the other hand, his is a job that does not involve this talent. The other is a secret agent of the CIA and therefore danger is his job. For a series of circumstances they find themselves together and together they will have to face an impossible mission: to save the world in just five days.
notes: The Hollywood firmament is full of missions as impossible as they are predictable. Here there is at least a bit of irony to save a foregone conclusion. And the Belushi-Ritter couple have fun at times.

title: La Cité de la peur
actors: Alain Chabat, Dominique Farrugia, Chantal Lauby, Gérard Darmon
description: Odile arrives in Cannes where her latest film will be presented, a mediocre horror film that arouses no interest on the Croisette. In the meantime, however, a serial killer begins to cause panic, killing one after another the projectionists in charge of showing Odile's film. The fact is that murder kills with the same tools used in the film, namely a hammer and sickle.
notes: A gracious work that has had some success in France and that makes use of the transforming skills of its performers. In addition to a very fashionable trick: contaminating genres with some metalinguistic flirtatiousness

title: Serving in Silence: The Margarethe Cammermeyer Story
actors: Glenn Close, Jan Rubes, Judy Davis, Wendy Makkena, Susan Barnes
description: Margarethe was a valuable nurse during the Vietnam War. Enough to deserve a medal of valor for his dedication. Back in the States, however, she is expelled from the army because she has publicly declared her homosexuality. However, she does not give up and denounces the US Army for discrimination. In court, the judges can only give you reason. But this is not the end of the troubles for her.
notes: TV movie inspired by a true story, "Forced to silence" has the value of a tautology right from the title. Glenn Close certainly did better.

title: Mrs. Dalloway
actors: Vanessa Redgrave, Natascha McElhone, Rupert Graves, Lena Headey
description: In June 1923 Clarissa Dalloway strolls through the streets of London looking for decorations for the party she will give in the evening. Along the way she thinks about her life and her role as an impeccable lady of good society. The arrival of an ancient suitor allows her memory to bring her back to the summer of 1890.
notes: From the novel, considered one of the masterpieces of Virginia Woolf, the director Marleen Gorris, Oscar winner for "The Tree of Antonia", traces with a feminist and feminist eye a fresco of British society at the turn of the nineteenth and twentieth centuries. In the role of the two Mrs. Dalloway (the seasoned one and the carefree one) the good Redgrave and McElhone. The firmly grounded Dutchman Gorris limits himself to clearly Ivoryan calligraphy. Which has a lot to do with boredom.

title: Fuochi d'artificio
actors: Leonardo Pieraccioni, Vanessa Lorenzo, Massimo Ceccherini, Barbara Enrichi, Bud Spencer
description: The thirty-year-old Ottone meets a psychoanalyst in the Maldives and begins to pester him with pressing questions. Why do you choose one girl over another? Why is it that when it is presented to others, their consent is sought in every way? Ottone will tell his story with the hope that the psychoanalyst will help him understand why he made certain decisions.
notes: One of the two flaws of "Fireworks" is that everything seems to take place in a closed courtyard inhabited by four or five friends, and even the Maldives seem only the transparency of a tourist landscape. It seems a bit 'to be in Duckburg. There would be nothing wrong if the script worked hard on this microcosm. But here's the second (very dangerous) flaw: the script. Pieraccioni starts with a slender cue, aligns more or less well-chosen characters, throws the bet "with whom will Ottone leave for the Maldives?", And stops there.

title: One Night Stand
actors: Wesley Snipes, Nastassja Kinski, Ming-Na Wen, Robert Downey jr., Kyle MacLachlan
description: Max Carlyle is happily married, has two beautiful children and a great job as a commercial director, in short, he has a happy life, at least it seems so. But one night, while on a trip to New York, Max has an affair with Karen, a seductive and very married woman. Back home, he slowly begins to move away from the people closest to him, while his wife struggles to understand why her husband's sudden change.
notes: Stylistically, an ugly glossy commercial run by beautiful, well-dressed and photogenic people (the Venetian award to Wesley Snipes is ridiculous). "Politically correct" on the surface (with inter-racial couples and homosexual solidarity), underneath exploits every cliché with an irritating respectability; he never has the courage of true passion and true tragedy. Demme could denounce him, for plagiarism of "Philadelphia". But it wouldn't be worth it.

title: Father's Day
actors: Robin Williams, Billy Crystal, Nastassja Kinski, Charlie Hofheimer
description: Jack is a Los Angeles attorney who has had everything he wanted from life. Dale, on the other hand, an aspiring writer, lives in San Francisco and can barely make ends meet. The two question themselves as they try to find a runaway teenager who they both believe is their own child.
notes: The screenplay (based on Francis Veber's "Les compères") burns the guiding idea in ten minutes. The alchemy between Crystal's petulant neurosis and Williams' devastating clumsiness doesn't snap. Laughter is scarce and thin, the gags are slow, many opportunities wasted. Reitman has lost a lot of luster since the "Ghostbusters" years.

title: Il figlio di Bakunin
actors: Fausto Siddi, Renato Carpentieri, Laura Del Sol, Massimo Bonetti, Paolo Bonacelli
description: Tullio Saba is the son of the anarchist cobbler Antonio, known as Bakunin. First miner, then anti-fascist, finally activist of the Communist Party and leader of the people, he is an almost legendary character in Sardinia between the 1940s and 1950s. In his own way, an adventurer, loved and hated by women, carabinieri and mine strikers.
notes: It starts with a nice sequence shot that presupposes a progressive sliding into the past. Less televised than the average of films of the genre, it has Giuseppe Tornatore as artistic godfather and discreetly renders the complex narrative plot. But don't shake off one of the most annoying flaws of Italian cinema, which, struggling with strong regional cultures, expires in oleography. The beginning of Maria's flashback, for example, is like a postcard.

title: Cold Comfort Farm
actors: Kate Beckinsale, Eileen Atkins, Sheila Burrel, Stephen Fry
description: We are in the thirties. Flora Poste, an orphaned town girl, is welcomed to a shabby and chaotic farm in the remote English countryside of Sussex. The young, cultured, refined and particularly enterprising, will have to deal with the rough and weird relatives who host her. Eventually he will know how to impose his ideas and improve everyone's lives.
notes: The Jane Austen revival continues. Not just films based on, but quotes, paraphrases, indirect homages. Like this hilarious costumed comedy surprisingly directed by John Schlesinger, an English director who was already an exponent of "Free Cinema" but has long been part of Hollywood's gears ("Il maratoneta", "A stranger at the door"). Here "Babe" atmospheres meet Isadora Duncan's utopias. Classy, ??glamorous actors and a young actress, Kate Beckinsale (discovered by Branagh).

title: Clueless
actors: Alicia Silverstone, Stacey Dash, Brittany Murphy, Paul Rudd, Elisa Donovan, Justin Walker, Donald Faison, Breckin Meyer, Jeremy Sisto, Dan Hedaya, Wallace Shawn, Twink Caplan
description: In Beverly Hills, it's not about being white (like Cher Horowitz is) and it's not about being black (like Dionne, her best friend). What matters instead is to be rich and above all beautiful. Cher is absolutely convinced that she has clear ideas about shopping and her life. She goes to great lengths to turn Tai, who is a scribble, into at least a presentable girl. But Cher is different from what she would like to make it seem, in fact she falls in love with Christian without realizing that he is a homosexual.
notes: Behind the hilarious disguise of a silly afternoon show, the film remains an honest product that investigates what lies behind the appearances. There is a sometimes too morbid complacency in showing these teenagers. Alicia Silvestone, batgirl in "Batman & Robin", shows all her unripe beauty.

title: Lilies of the Field
actors: Sidney Poitier, Lilia Skala, Lisa Mann, Isa Crino, Francesca Jarvis
description: Homer Smith, while traveling to Arizona, comes across five refugee nuns from East Germany working a barren patch of land on the edge of the desert. The man offers to help by repairing the roof of the house, but when he presents the bill in response, the mother superior invites him to share their meager dinner and to spend the night on an uncomfortable pallet in their "guesthouse". The next morning the superior asks Homer to stay with them to build a chapel.
notes: Small well-acted comedy based on a novel by William E. Barrett. Oscar in Poitier for Best Actor in a Leading Role.

title: Sarafina!
actors: Whoopi Goldberg, Leleti Khumalo, Miriam Makeba
description: In Soweto in 1976 the situation is immobile: on the one hand the privileged whites, on the other the blacks, who work for the first and are subjected to a regime of inequality. A context in which knowing the history of South Africa becomes an occasion for conscience: at least this happens to Sarafina, who will find herself organizing a recital to ask for Mandela's release.
notes: The theme is not new, just as the use of semi-documentary inserts is not entirely original. As usual, good intentions are appreciated.

title: Our Son, the Matchmaker
actors: Ann Jillian, Ellen Burstyn, David Andrews, Drew Ebersole
description: In her youth Julia Lowell had a baby with Steve, but since the two could not marry the families prevented their relationship from continuing and forced Julia to give the baby up for adoption. 23 years pass. By chance Julia meets a boy who turns out to be her son who is on the eve of his wedding. Before getting married, however, the boy asks his mother to also know his biological father. What happened to Steve? Will Julia be able to find him?
notes: Rather anomalous theme for the "usual" TV movie with an ethical background from the "usual" fact that really happened. A good group of convincing actors will save the shack.

title: Vamp
actors: Grace Jones, Chris Makepeace, Sandy Baron, Robert Rusler
description: Two guys, to join their college association, undertake to get a stripper for the next student party. How to find it? Of course by going to one of the clubs where the girls perform. And obviously entering the wrong one, run by vampires, and ending up in the "clutches" of a beautiful woman accustomed to sucking the blood of her clients. So one of the two students disappears and the research begins ...
notes: The trend is the one inaugurated by John Landis, with his "An American werewolf in London". Here is Grace Jones, who actually doesn't work very well as a sexy horror vamp.

title: The Milagro Beanfield War
actors: Chick Vennera, Chick Vennera, Sonia Braga, Sonia Braga, Christopher Walken, Christopher Walken, Melanie Griffith, Melanie Griffith, Richard Bradford, Richard Bradford
description: When the bulldozers of a wealthy industrialist arrive in Milagro who want to transform the charming New Mexico village into a residential area, Joe Mondragon refuses the American's "generous" offer. And it begins a real war with no holds barred that gradually involves all the inhabitants determined to save the integrity of their town. Of course, their commitment is rewarded.
notes: It is perhaps the most conventional film by director Redford, despite the suggestive setting.

title: The Lost Continent
actors: Eric Porter, Hildegard Knef, Tony Beckley
description: Two ships meet in the Sargasso Sea. On the first: prostitutes, thugs and explosives. On the second: the descendants of the Spanish conquistadors who still consider the court of the Inquisition current. Well acted and quite insane, an adventurous gothic by a Hammer director.

title: Hana-Bi
actors: Takeshi Kitano, Kayoko Kishimoto, Ren Osugi, Susumu Terajiama
description: Detective Nishi visits his hospitalized wife and does not accompany his colleague Horibe on a surveillance mission. When he arrives at the hospital he learns that his wife's condition is more serious than expected and that Horibe has been hit. A few weeks pass and Nishi goes to visit Horibe, who is immobilized in a wheelchair following the shooting and lives alone by the sea. Nishi does his best not to be disheartened by the plight of his dying wife and his friend, who left the police for him.
notes: "Hana-Bi" does not fascinate us just because it plunges us into the despair and sophistication of Japanese life and culture, just because it is "unusual". "Hana-Bi" is a painful and furious film, crossed by an extraordinary image quality, by a rigorous and shocking idea of ??cinema. And it is the masterpiece, rightly awarded in Venice in 1997, of a lonely man, written, directed, interpreted, edited by Takeshi Kitano (who is also the author of the lush drawings), first a comic actor, then author of highly stylized thrillers. It brings to mind the crazy and rough Godard of the sixties ("Weekend" and "Pierrot le Fou"), even if Kitano, always sardonic and hasty, says he doesn't know his films. But, as Godard had, he has the makings of the great conscious destroyer.

title: Conspiracy Theory
actors: Mel Gibson, Julia Roberts, Patrick Stewart, Cylk Cozart, Stephen Kahan
description: Jerry Fletcher (Gibson) spends his life in fear of a past he cannot remember. Now he drives a cab through the streets of New York, talking obsessively about the plots he thinks he sees behind everything. But he's not quite as crazy as he seems. So frightening memories emerge from his memory that they cannot fail to have really happened. One day Jerry meets Alice (Roberts), attorney for the New York Department of Justice, who is also in the throes of more than one obsession, but who shows sympathy for him.
notes: The film starts like a rocket, punctuated by the insane speeches and wandering of Mel Gibson who, as always, gives his best in the crazy parts. A successful cross between thriller and comedy, Richard Donner's film fades a bit in the second part, when he has to pull the strings of the plot, but overall he doesn't regret the verve of the "Lethal Weapon" series.

title: Mojo
actors: Ian Hart, Ewen Bremner, Aidan Gillen, Martin Gwynn Jones, Harold Pinter
description: Soho, summer 1958, inside the Atlantic Club two hundred girls are delirious in front of the new rock star Silver Johnny. Johnny's success has left Ezra, the owner of the place, in an uproar, who has a morbid attachment to him. Not to mention the guys who work for Johnny, excited by the idea of ??becoming rich and famous. Only the son of the boss, he maintains the arrogant attitude he always has.
notes: The first work of 28-year-old Butterworth, who wrote the text for the theater, begins immersed in a vague nostalgia underlined by the slightly soft colors. The theatrical matrix is ??felt, especially in certain exchanges in the second part, and eases the tension a little. But it is the only defect of the film (together with a poor and doll-like Italian dubbing), which redeems itself in the sour story of a male microcosm closed on its own violence.

title: Mallrats
actors: Shannen Doherty, Jeremy London, Claire Forlani, Jason Lee, Ben Affleck, Joey Lauren Adams, Renee Humphrey, Jason Mewes, Kevin Smith, Ethan Suplee, Stan Lee, Priscilla Barnes, Michael Rooker, Brian O'Halloran, Scott Mosier, Walter Flanagan
description: The original title can literally be translated as "Department Store Rats". The protagonists of the film are in fact two young people, without art or part, who, inside a megastore of those where you can find everything, from the supermarket to the cinema to the hotel, find themselves embroiled in a series of misadventures.
notes: From the director of "Clerks" one would have expected something more. Unfortunately Kevin Smith confirmed the axiom that a sparkling debut feature, full of vivacity and inventions, is followed by a floppettino.

title: Sudden Death
actors: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Powers Boothe, Raymond J. Barry
description: Darren McCord is a fire officer separated from his wife and with a trauma related to a mission a few years ago. Now he is assigned to the civic arena, where a hockey match is about to take place which will also be attended by the vice president of the United States. Joshua Foss is instead a criminal who intends to kidnap the vice president to obtain a large ransom. When Foss manages to put his plan into action, McCord immediately takes action.
notes: Haven't we seen each other before? The protagonist with a trauma in the past who today can redeem himself from the accusation of cowardice. The villain who was once part of the state apparatus. Bombs placed in a stadium during the final. The hero's daughter who remains in the hands of the villain, while the police do nothing because she is made up of incapable or corrupt. Yes, we had already met.

title: Virtuosity
actors: Denzel Washington, Russell Crowe, Kelly Lynch, Stephen Spinella
description: We are in the future and Sid 6.7 is a unit made up of two hundred different personalities of dangerous criminals, mixed together, used to train police officers. However Sid, tired of bits and bytes, decides to leave cyberspace to devote himself to the murder of men in flesh and blood. The only one who seems to be able to face and defeat him is Parker Barnes, a former cop who ended up in jail for executing the killer of his wife and daughter.
notes: Usual clash between Good and Evil against the backdrop of a late millennium Los Angeles (we are in fact in 1999). The director is Brett Leonard who had directed "Il taglaierbe" with Pierce Brosnan.

title: Assault on Dome 4
actors: Bruce Campbell, Joseph Culp, Jocelyn Seagrave, Brion Jones
description: Life flows quietly on a small artificial planet used as a scientific laboratory and positioned in the most unknown and mysterious space. The plant is equipped with the most sophisticated equipment, but this does not prevent a group of criminals, taking advantage of the poor defensive systems, from being able to penetrate. It will be the agent Morran, who happened to be on the planet by chance, to try to save the situation.
notes: Evocative and realistic scenarios are the backdrop to this science fiction film signed by Gilbert Po. In the cast Bruce Campbell, actor favorite of Sam Raimi, and Joseph Culp seen in "Glow in the dark".

title: La gatta da pelare
actors: Pippo Franco, Janet Agren, Daniela Poggi, Orso Maria Guerrini
description: Mara, a journalist in search of success, and Stefano, a cartoonist, live together, but between the two things are pretty bad. Mara thinks of solving her problem by going to Professor Maraldi, a well-known psychoanalyst, their neighbor. Stefano, jealous of the latter, threatens him and takes revenge on him by killing him in the comics he draws.
notes: Pippo Franco directs this silly yellow-pink comedy. Giancarlo Magalli, then sketch author, collaborated on the subject.

title: A Lawless Street
actors: Randolph Scott, Angela Lansbury, Jean Parker, Wallace Ford
description: In a country of the Deep West some men, rich and unscrupulous, try in every way to impose their dominance, but their aims are vigorously opposed by the sheriff, a man of goodness, but with an excellent aim. To eliminate him, a certain Dingo Brion is hired, who tries to take him out while he is at the barber shop. But the sheriff manages to get away with killing the hitman. In the meantime Town, the manager of the theater, has got in touch with a company of attotes and dancers that he intends to debut as soon as possible.
notes: From one of the masters of the American B series, a minor film pulled away even if with excellent actors. For enthusiasts only.

title: Dirty Little Billy
actors: Michael J. Pollard, Lee Purcell, Charles Aidman, Richard Evans
description: Billy the Kid, the young bandit who terrorized the Far West at the end of the nineteenth century, is at the center of this unusual biography shot almost entirely in the mud.
notes: Yet another and very tired variation on the biography of the famous bandit.

title: Easy Living
actors: Victor Mature, Lucille Ball, Lizabeth Scott, Sonny Tufts, Lloyd Nolan
description: Steve, an American football player, on the threshold of a bright and lucrative career discovers he has a congenital disease that prevents him from continuing. His anguish is exacerbated by the fact that Lizy, his wife, ambitious, vain and jealous of her husband's successes, thinks only of herself and does not participate in his drama. Steve, fearing that the woman will abandon him, decides to engage in a decisive match for his team.
notes: Good Hollywood product that was about an Irvin Shaw story. Excellent performance by Lucille Ball.

title: Glory Daze
actors: Ben Affleck, Alyssa Milano, French Stewart, Sam Rockwell
description: College is about to end and for Jack, Rob, Mickey, Dennis and Josh, the prospect of a not-so-exciting existence becomes real. Nobody would like things to change and the big party that the five organize by renting a gigantic room is useless. The situation worsens when Jack's girlfriend leaves him and a real obsession begins for him: how to get back together with her and how to keep the group together for another year?
notes: Cinema is accumulating a fairly long series of films about the difficulty of growing up. He has rarely been able to add anything to a generic and melancholy "college syndrome"

title: Scandalosa Gilda
actors: Monica Guerritore, Gabriele Lavia, Pina Cei, Jasmine Maimone
description: She surprised her husband in her lover's arms and this is enough to push her to leave Rome by car. Along the way he meets a cartoonist and begins an erotic and psychologically complex tour de force with him. Twenty-four hours of humiliation, confessions and sex, at the end of which a car accident takes the young man's life. She then asks for a ride to another, determined to return to the capital.
notes: Narcissism of couples with psychological pretensions, which sinks into ridicule and boredom. On the other hand, the porn cartoon inserted in the film by the Genoese designer Francesco Maurizio Guido, aka Gibba, is beautiful.

title: Davandeh
actors: Abbas Nazeri, Maijid Niroumand, Mousa Torkizadeh
description: Amir is an Iranian boy who lost his home during the war with Iraq. Amir spends his days making do with precarious jobs to make ends meet as best he can. At a certain point, however, he realizes that to realize his dreams it is better to study. At school he soon comes into conflict with his classmates, but a rather unusual competition sets things right.
notes: Less famous than his compatriot Kiarostami, but no less talented, Naderi uses, as often happens in Iranian cinema, the pure gaze of childhood to give us a concrete, tragic but not pessimistic reading of life and its hardships.

title: White Fang II - Myth of the aWhite Wolf
actors: Scott Bairstow, Charmaine Craig, Al Harrington, Victoria Racimo
description: Henry Casey arrives in an unexplored location on the Pacific coast to take care of a friend's property in New Tork. Arriving in front of the house, in the company of the inseparable White Fang, Henry sees someone walking away from the house. From there, several adventures begin, in which the young man is always in the company of his faithful four-legged friend.
notes: Loosely based on the novel by Jack London, a product without great qualities, especially enlivened by the performance of the dog. This is what Disney guarantees.

title: Badlands
actors: Martin Sheen, Sissy Spacek, Warren Oates, Ramon Bieri, Alan Vint
description: Holly, a restless girl, finds in Kit, a poor and abusive young man, that affection that she lacks in the family. When Holly's father (mother is dead) opposes their relationship quite energetically, Kit kills him. The two young men then flee together in an attempt to expatriate. Behind them, meanwhile, the trail of corpses lengthens ...
notes: Cult film of the 70s and one of the most lucid, disenchanted and anti-mimic of the period. The American dream is now gone and the director, lost in the endless "Badlands" of the original title, does nothing to resurrect it. Malick was on his debut and promised very well. Too bad that in his career (and especially in the first thirty years, when in addition to this he made only two other - wonderful - films) he was so sparing.

title: Co-ed Call Girl
actors: Tori Spelling, Susan Blakely, Scott Plank, Carmen Agrenziano
description: Joanna is an overly naive and insecure college student. Reason? As a young girl, her mother Teri, too busy making a career, hadn't given her confidence in her own means. To make fun of Joanna, some college friends respond on her behalf to an ad from an agency looking for casual girls for parties or conventions. Despite everything Joanna manages to pass the test, but ...
notes: Trivial in the narrative assumption, conventional in the realization, predictable and obvious in the development of the plot. Second choice actors, but what does it really matter if the destination of the product is an Italian generalist television network?

title: The Black Scorpion
actors: Richard Denning, Carlos Rivas, Mara Corday
description: During a violent earthquake, a fearful phenomenon is produced in a desolate region of Mexico: from the voracins of the soil, giant scorpions emerge that sow terror and death. Two geologists, Hank Scott and Arturo Ramos, in collaboration with the military authorities, prepare a plan to stop them. The two drop into the chasm and try to jump with the dynamite.
notes: Classic Serie B film of the 1950s, with more than one debt towards "Assault on Earth" by Gordon Douglas. Unknown interpreters and very little special effects.

title: Cleopatra Jones
actors: Tamara Dobson, Bernie Casey, Brenda Sykes, Antonio Fargas
description: Cleopatra Jones is a beautiful mulatto, special agent in the service of the president of the United States. He must fight against Mamie, who runs a drug trade. The woman, fresh from Turkey, where she had an opium poppy plantation destroyed, lands in New York and immediately finds herself facing her bitter enemy. But our special agent also has to contend with Purdy, a dishonest cop.
notes: Action and chases in this "all black" film of absolute routine. The following year there was also a sequel entitled "Operation Golden Casino".

title: Follow Me
actors: Mia Farrow, Michael Jayston, Topol, Margaret Rawlings
description: Charles Sidley, one of the most famous tax consultants in England, marries Belinda, a young American. After the wedding, however, the woman realizes that her husband is no longer the same and that their marriage is slipping into a gray routine. Charles proves jealous and Belinda's frequent delays, inexplicable absences, lead him to suspect betrayal. To find out if this is actually the case, the man hires private detective Julian Christophorou.
notes: Based on the play "The Public Eye" by Peter Shaffer, despite the direction and the good cast does not rise from a routine of manner.

title: There's Girl in My Soup
actors: Peter Sellers, Goldie Hawn, Tony Brutton, Nicky Henson
description: Robert Danvers is an established host of British television, but what matters is that he is rich and above all a bachelor. It is normal for women to contend for him and the magazines to try to investigate his private life. During a party, Robert meets the young Marion, a 19-year-old American, who appears to be on a break with her boyfriend Jimmy. For a charming man like Robert it is easy to persuade the girl to follow him to France, where he has to go for business reasons. As soon as they return home, however, Marion decides to go back to her beloved Jimmy.

title: Jasagaju po Moskve
actors: Nikita Mikhalkov, Aleksey Loktëv, Galina Polskich, Eugenij Steblov
description: Kolia, a worker on the Moscow metro, and Velodia, a Ukrainian mechanic with writer's ambitions, make friends and spend an entire day together during which Kolia's girlfriend, Aljona, has the opportunity to fall in love with Velodia. Kolia doesn't get jealous, but accepts the situation with serenity, leaving the field free to his friend.
notes: A sentimental Soviet comedy, full of Kruscio optimism and hope, but also sharp and biting towards the society and cinema of those years. The future director Nikita Michalkov is the protagonist.

title: Cop Land
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Robert De Niro, Ray Liotta, Harvey Keitel, Annabella Sciorra
description: There is not only rottenness among the Los Angeles cops. Even the East Coast people don't joke: in Garrison, New Jersey, just across the New York Bridge, there are a lot of cops who control their dirty business from here. But the town sheriff, Freddy, half deaf, rebels.
notes: "Cop Land" is a great detective story. An articulated plot, a direction that takes care above all of the nuances, cares little for the spectacular action and closely follows the characters. Stallone moves painfully in his inadequate body, pines listening to Springsteen's "Stolen Car" or thinking about Annabella Sciorra's stolen kisses.

title: Un air de famille
actors: Jean-Pierre Bacri, Agnès Jaoui, Jean-Pierre Darroussin
description: The Menard family, every Friday, meets in Henri's bar (the "younger" brother considered "stupid" by his mother), before going to dinner. However, the classic "Black Friday" arrives, despite the fact that Yolande's birthday (the wife of the "older" brother) is to be celebrated. One of those evenings where the knots come to a head, the poison of the snake relatives flows in rivers and hatreds, grudges and dust come out of the carpets. Only Betty and her boyfriend will come out with their heads held high.
notes: Bitter and mocking chamber comedy. Singular "family group in an interior" where we laugh ... so as not to cry.

title: L.A. Confidential
actors: Kevin Spacey, Kim Basinger, Russell Crowe, Guy Pearce, Danny DeVito, James Cromwell, Ron Rifkin, David Strathairn
description: Los Angeles, 1950s. Jack, a very popular cop in the city, is appointed consultant for a TV show intended to promote the image of the police district. For this reason he organizes spectacular arrests of stars on behalf of Sid Hudgeons, editor of the gossip magazine "Hush-Hush". One day at the "Nite Owl", a nightclub in the city, a horrific massacre occurs.
notes: From a great novel by James Ellroy, a detective story that does not leave you stunned but recovers the best suggestions of the genre. The "thug" Russell Crowe ("Insider", "The Gladiator") already reveals himself for what he is: more than a man, a bull. Oscar to the screenplay and to Kim Basinger, who makes a believable Veronika Lake lookalike.

title: Laggiù nella giungla
actors: Robert Powell, Tony Vogel, Andréa Ferréol, Van Johnson
description: Rome-L'Aquila motorway: a puncture blocks a bus on a viaduct. At the moment of leaving there are nine people missing, but the vehicle sets off again. The group of the "missing" is on the steep banks of a river, under the viaduct. In an attempt to trace the nine, they get lost in a tropical forest. To the dismay are added hunger, risks and fear.
notes: The story unfolds between the fantastic story and the adventure not knowing which path to take.

title: The Sweet Hereafter
actors: Ian Holm, Maury Chaykin, Peter Donaldson, Bruce Greenwood
description: A small town in Canada loses almost all of its children in a car accident. A well-known lawyer from the city incites the population to look for a culprit. A young woman is committed to recovering her dignity and reconciling the members of the community.
notes: The seventh feature film by Canadian Atom Egoyan is the intertwined story of the innumerable "massacres of innocents" that our civilization continues to perpetrate: literal massacres, like the flight into the abyss of a school bus, but also the suffocated and individual massacres. Immersed in the snow and in the green and blue of the Canadian landscape, is crossed by the soul in pain Ian Holm, an actor who makes you sick with his sad eyes and who touches the long close-up of a heartbreaking phone call with his daughter. A dutiful and painful film, supported in its continuous temporal intertwining by the impeccable, sinuous and never self-satisfied direction of Egoyan, who demonstrates that he knows how to pass from his personal obsessions to the suggestion of a universal tragedy, on the edge of one of the most chilling "fairy tales" of world, "The Pied Piper of Hamelin". The Cannes Grand Jury Prize is well deserved.

title: Ice Storm
actors: Kevin Kline, Joan Allen, Christina Ricci, Tobey Maguire, Sigourney Weaver
description: It is November 1973 and in New Canaan, Connecticut, the Hood family is sliding down a road of no return. Ben, the head of the family, takes his neighbor to bed, but she shows little interest. The wife is too busy reading _The Jonathan Livingston Seagull_ and treatises on sexual psychology. The very young Wendy, for her part, experiments with new erotic games ...
notes: Through a mélange of New Age atmospheres and Chinese stylistic features, Ang Lee stages the desolation of a tangle of human relationships overwhelmed by social conventions. Manicheo only in appearance, freezes the heart and the spirit of a family bourgeoisie that remains standing, despite everything.

title: Henry: Portrait of a Serial Killer
actors: Michael Rooker, Tracy Arnold, Tom Towles, David Katz
