description: Henry had a difficult and traumatic childhood. Now he is an introverted and mild-mannered young man. In reality he is a sexophobic serial killer who scatters the city with corpses. With Henry lives Otis, his former fellow prisoner who, learning of Henry's "activity" begins to emulate him in an even more ferocious way, if possible. The two are soon joined by Becky, Otis's sister, who soon falls in love with Henry. When Otis, drunk and excited, tries to rape her, Henry kills him and, with the usual ritual, dissects the corpse and throws it into the river. At this point Henry and Becky leave together, but ...
notes: Film variously evaluated by critics (exalted and crushed) has become a small classic despite Nanni Moretti explicitly targeting it in "Caro diario". Very hard and disturbing.

title: Le cinquième element
actors: Bruce Willis, Gary Oldman, Milla Jovovich, Ian Holm, Luke Perry, Chris Tucker, Brion James, Tom Lister jr., Lee Evans, Charlie Creed-Miles, Tricky, John Neville, John Bluthal, Mathieu Kassovitz, Christopher Fairbank
description: Korben Dallas with his flying car is a taxi driver in New York in 2259 and finds himself having to recover four ancient stones, which symbolize the four natural elements (air, water, earth and fire), whose union creates the fifth element: the life. In addition to Korben, however, the forces of Evil, led by the evil Zorg, are also willing to take possession of the precious stones.
notes: Visually fascinating, funny, but with moments of tiredness. The most evocative scene is that of the space show, pure Gaultier-Besson. The best line, "Are you German?" pronounced by the archaeologist towards the giant metal aliens. An expensive toy.

title: The Comic
actors: Dick Van Dyke, Michele Lee, Mickey Rooney, Cornel Wilde
description: The protagonist of this story is a comic actor of the Muto era. In his company we relive the magical moments in which the first filmmakers tried to emotionally involve the spectators making them cry and laugh and, at the same time, looking for and created a new language. The actor is particularly paid in the so -called "comic" all based on the rhythm, on the pursuit of the policemen and on the cakes in the face. A middle ground between Chaplin and Buster Keaton.
notes: It will not be "silence is gold" by Clair, but the work has its own grace and excellent interpreters. Small film for DOC cinephiles (moreover, the director will make fifteen years after an even more cinephile film, "The mystery of the disappeared quarry").

title: I maniaci
actors: Enrico Maria Salerno, Raimondo Vianello, Vittorio Caprioli, Walter Chiari, Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Barbara Steele, Gaia Germani, Aroldo Tieri, Franca Valeri, Lisa Gastoni, Franco Fabrizi, Sandra Mondaini, Margaret Lee
description: Episode films - some of which are very short-lived, almost simple sketches - in which fashions, tics, the most widespread manias in Italian society of the time are targeted. We are in 1964 and therefore in full economic boom: here are those who have made money and try to set a tone by becoming passionate about antiques and who, following the first, shy, freedom of costumes, rushes to striptease shows. But there are also bills (another great national "passion") and the political undergrowth of the old DC ...
notes: A poker of aces (the actors) for an operation that, decades later, shows all its shortness of breath.

title: Hidden in America
actors: Beau Bridges, Bruce Davison, Shelton Dane, Jena Malone, Alice Krige
description: Michael, a wealthy doctor, meets Willa, a friend of his daughter in the hospital. Soon the doctor discovers that Willa's family pays in desperate economic conditions. Bill, the father, lost his job, sold everything he possessed to treat his sick wife and now has nothing more with whom to feed his children. Michael would like to help them, but clashes with Bill's proud character, which he refuses. After numerous failed attempts Bill finally finds a job, but his troubles are not over yet.
notes: For the series "Women at the crossroads", a TV movie who, once so much, enters, albeit without the necessary scalpel, in the social plagues of the so -called "American Way of Life".

title: Ballando ballando
actors: Marc Berman, Jean-Claude Peuchenat, Chantal Capron, Liliane Leotard
description: A dance hall of the Parisian belt is the background, but also the protagonist, to fifty years of French history. The costumes, the furnishings and, of course, the dances change, but the desire of ordinary people to meet on Saturday night or the party to escape a little from the greyness, to dream, to even love, remains and always, while the course of the time absorbs and fades everything inexorably into the folds of memory.
notes: Scola makes a risky stylistic choice, almost like an "École des Annales", and metabolizes History (with a capital initial) through everyday life that cannot be more daily. Avoid using dialogues by leaving the soundtrack almost entirely to the music. Some portraits are correct, others too forced. The complex is successful, but a few smudges here and there annoys a little. Best Director at the Berlin Film Festival, three Césars, Oscar nomination for best foreign film.

title: Il cekista
actors: Igor Sergeev, Aleksej Polujan, Michail Vasserbaum
description: The film tells the existential parable of a "Cheekist", that is one of the policemen of the Soviet special forces active in the mass murder during the era of the Stalinist "purges".
notes: Faithfully based on the short story "The Splinter" by Zazubrin, the film covers the entire path of the revolution and therefore alludes to its "ferocious nature" from the very beginning rather than to a repressive drift of the last period. Shot (abroad), one year before the fall of the Berlin Wall.

title: Oktjabr'
actors: Vladimir Popov, Boris Livanov
description: On the tenth anniversary of the Boshevik Revolution, the Soviet government entrusts the director Ejzenstein - 29 years old, but already an undisputed master - the re-enactment of the "ten days that shook the world". Applying his own innovative theories on film editing, Ejzenstejn composes a grandiose fresco that his contemporaries did not fully understand.
notes: To celebrate the tenth anniversary of the Soviet revolution. Eisenstein composes an absolutely experimental visual poem that displeased the regime. unforgettable mass scenes (the taking of the Winter Palace) which are accompanied by stunning daring editing.

title: Blackwater Trail
actors: Judd Nelson, Dee Smart, Peter Phelps, Mark Lee, Gabrielle Fitzpatrick
description: A policeman is found dead in his apartment. The official verdict is: suicide. The man's sister is not convinced of the official version and instead believes that it is a cleverly disguised crime. To prove her thesis, a parallel investigation begins, aided in this by her ex-boyfriend. The two find in the policeman's apartment some audio cassettes concerning the killing and disappearance of some students of the city never found again. But someone has begun to spy on their movements and is waiting for the right moment to get them out of the way ...
notes: Not a very original idea developed with a good sense of rhythm and the right amount of suspense.

title: Ed McBain's 87th Precint: Heatwave
actors: Dale Midkiff, Erika Eleniak, Paul Johanson
description: A serial killer is terrorizing a city in the United States. Agent Carella, from the local police, would be willing to make any sacrifice to frame him, but to fight a sick mind, if not another madman, at least a plan definitely out of the canons of murder investigations. Agent Eileen Burke, a colleague of Carella's particularly ambitious and ready to do anything to make a career, has a decisive but very dangerous idea: she will act as bait for the extremely dangerous murderer. After all, Eileen wants to demonstrate with her gesture, not only to herself, but to the entire community, that a woman is more determined and skilled than her male colleagues for this type of investigation. But challenging a sick mind can be very dangerous and the killer has a really nasty surprise in store for Eileen ...

title: Les bidasses s'en vont en guerre
actors: Les Charlots, Jacques Seiler, Marisa Merlini, Paolo Stoppa
description: A group of nice guys are doing military service in their own way in a barracks commanded by a rather confusing colonel. Sergeant Bellec is no less than his superior and in fact never misses an opportunity to demonstrate all his attachment to the military forces, despite being a real bungler. The boys, precisely because of the sergeant, constantly end up in the barracks prison and take their revenge by committing atrocious jokes.
notes: Les Charlots, for some years, also enjoyed success in Italy. But their comedy, linked to rather vulgar gags, soon made them fall into oblivion.

title: Oggetti smarriti
actors: Mariangela Melato, Bruno Ganz, Renato Salvatori, Laura Morante
description: Marta, having received the news from her mother-in-law that her daughter Daniela is making her grandmother despair in Rome, decides to leave. Arriving at the airport she is forced to give up her flight because her husband is the victim of a collapse. He then goes to the Central Station and gets on a train on which his impetuous lover Carlo has also taken a seat. The woman meets Werner, a boy from Zurich, and, carried away by memories and his charm, she ends up missing one train after another ...
notes: Bertolucci chooses to shoot in Milan Central Station and the choice gives a depth of greater authenticity to the drama. music by jazz trumpeter Enrico Rava. Debut of Laura Morante.

title: Scusa se è poco
actors: Monica Vitti, Ugo Tognazzi, Diego Abatantuono, Orazio Orlando
description: Two-episode film. "The last five minutes": two divorced spouses, one without the knowledge of the other, are looking for a rented apartment in the city. Of course they end up renting the same, arguing and getting their hands on each other. Meanwhile, the secretaries of the spouses begin to familiarize ... "Thirty minutes of love": the wife of an esteemed dentist writes a pornographic book under a false name that becomes a very successful best seller. A short-sighted detective sets out on his trail and is run over by the equally short-sighted author.
notes: Really slow pace and humor at an all-time low. In the adaptation of two very old comedies by Aldo De Benedetti, the focus is on sganassones and leaves room for some old number of actors.

title: Career Girl
actors: Katrin Cartlidge, Lynda Steadman, Mark Benton
description: Annie and Hannah, two young career women meet after a long time and end up rediscovering the same intense friendship that bound them a few years earlier when, at university, they shared the same apartment. During the weekend that marks their new meeting, the women come into contact with numerous people who studied with them in London in the 1980s. Let's find out how the two girls have changed and how the world has changed.
notes: Leigh's sensational turn, from the tones of heartfelt reconciliation of "Secrets and lies" to the pessimism of a world marked by loneliness: a comedy where laughing hurts more than crying.

title: The Peacemaker
actors: George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Marcel Iures, Alexander Baluev
description: In a remote region of Russia, two trains are about to collide: the first carries passengers, the other nuclear weapons destined to be deactivated. Following the accident, the surrounding countryside was devastated by a nuclear explosion. Dr Julia Kelly, a nuclear physicist, is the first to understand that this was not an accident.
notes: First production signed by Dreamworks, the major founded by Spielberg and billionaire partners. The occasion required pomp and stars to match. The director, Mimi Leder, is one of the lucky team "E. R.": that's why Clooney is Clooney and the pace of the film is agile and fast.

title: The Boys in the Band
actors: Kenneth Nelson, Frederick Combs, Cliff Gorman, Laurence Luckinbill, Keith Prentice, Peter White, Reuben Greene, Robert La Tourneaux, Leonard Frey
description: Michael, to celebrate his friend Harold's birthday, has prepared a small gay party attended by Hank, a married math professor, and his unfaithful partner, Larry; a black salesman, Bernard; Emory an extravagant gas station attendant and, finally, Donald who is being treated, with poor results, by a psychoanalyst. Alan, a former college friend of Michael's who is going through a marital crisis, joins the meeting of homosexuals, even though he has not been invited. The presence of the man upsets everyone, including Michael ...
notes: The film is based on a play by Mart Crowley that raged on Broadway in the late 1960s, causing much debate due to the roughness of the subject. Friedkin faithfully retraces the text, dramatically increasing the sense of tension and chooses an almost Hitchcockian point of view (black humor and suspense) to deal with the psychological dynamics of the group. The film was both loved and criticized by the American gay community, which it will wear on Friedkin on the occasion of the release of "Cruising".

title: Welcome to Sarajevo
actors: Stephen Dillane, Woody Harrelson, Marisa Tomei, Emira Nusevic
description: Journalist Michael Anderson has made a career as a war correspondent, but nothing he has seen around the world compares to hell in Sarajevo. We are in 1992, the year in which the siege of the Bosnian city begins. Nobody feels safe, much less the journalists on the front line. Michael and his crew traverse the city in search of strong images. One day they meet a little girl ...
notes: Lower than the other films of the director. it's not as engaging as "Go Now" and "Family"; it's not dark like the second part of "Jude". Yet "Welcome to Sarajevo" (sharply ironic from the title) has a bitter vigor and courage that certainly deserve respect.

title: La morte non conta i dollari
actors: Mark Damon, Luciana Gilli, Pamela Tudor, Alan Collins, Pedro Sanchez
description: Lawrence Wright returns to the town of Owel Rock where his father died, reportedly killed by Doc Lester. The man finds his sister Jane who pushes him to avenge the death of his parent, but Lawrence is hesitant.
notes: Freda uses the pseudonym of George Lincoln to direct this spaghetti western, but it shows that he has little enthusiasm.

title: Loved
actors: William Hurt, Robin Wright, Sean Penn, Amy Madigan, Joanna Cassidy
description: A man is accused of having sexually and psychologically abused three women: one is dead, another is confined to a wheelchair, while the third, a promise of competitive swimming, is deeply shaken on a psychophysical level. But what actually happened? All three women have been victims of unclear road accidents and a doubt arises: did they want to commit suicide or were they blinded by love for the same man?
notes: Love and death, primordial impulses that unscrupulous individuals can handle with devastating results and with respect to which the other is only a twig at the mercy of the elements, are staged in an excessively subdued way, evaporating any dramatic potential, with a William Hurt more limp and expressionless than ever.

title: Illegal
actors: Edward G. Robinson, Nina Foch, Hugh Marlowe, Jayne Mansfield
description: Victor Scott, district attorney famous for the relentless ability with which he is able to support the accusation, has a man accused of murder sentenced to death, although the defendant pleads innocent. It happens, however, that on the day of the execution Scott is informed that a suicide, before expiring, has confessed to being the perpetrator of the crime. The prosecutor tries in every way to have the execution suspended, but his order comes too late. Distraught, the man resigns and seeks comfort in alcohol.
notes: The great skill of the actors holds up a decent genre film. Remake of "The Mouthpiece" by Elliott Nugent.

title: Journey of the Heart
actors: Cybill Shepherd, Stephen Lang, Blake Heron, Cassidy Rae
description: Janice is a strong and stubborn woman who, abandoned by her husband, gets by as best she can with two children. The first, Ray is a handsome kid, easy-going and passionate about baseball. The other is Tony and he has many problems, in fact he is autistic. Because of this diversity, the people of the village, who also love Janice, try in every way to avoid it. One day Tony accidentally hears a tune and instinctively keeps repeating it on the piano. From that moment, thanks to music, he begins to articulate a few words ...
notes: Cybill Sheperd, after Bogdanovic's "The Last Show", had a moment of popularity with the television series "Moonlighting" alongside Bruce Willis. Now hardly anyone remembers her, perhaps because she specializes in television movies like this one.

title: Pete Kelly's Blues
actors: Jack Webb, Janet Leigh, Edmond O'Brien, Peggy Lee, Andy Devine
description: Pete Kelly conducts a jazz orchestra in a fourth-rate club, always hoping for the right opportunity to make the leap in quality. When this shows up, the party is ruined by the bandit McCarg who asks Kelly for a "lace" on every contract of the band. After long reflections Kelly refuses, also supported by Joey, the drummer who is killed for revenge.
notes: Very genre film made when the great season of the gangster movie was on the decline. Janet Leigh gives it a touch of class.

title: Nick's Movie - Lighthing over Water
actors: Nicholas Ray, Wim Wenders, Susan Ray, Tim Ray
description: In April 1979, the German director Wim Wenders pays a visit to the American colleague he considers his master: Nicholas Ray. He is now old, suffering from terminal cancer and inactive for some time. Wenders films the last days of Ray's life which are also a lesson on cinema and cinema. Eventually a Chinese junk leaves New York Harbor with Ray's urn on board.
notes: From one of the masters of the "New German cinema", a tribute to one of the fathers of modern cinema which is also a reflection on the language and the "ontological value" of the film.

title: If These Walls Could Talk
actors: Demi Moore, Cher, Sissy Spacek, Anne Heche
description: Three American stories on the subject of abortion. In the first, set when the termination of pregnancy was illegal, a young widow (Moore), after a fleeting love encounter, realizes she is expecting a baby. Second episode: in the seventies a forty-year-old career (Spacek) sacrificed her job to have four children. Now that she would like to resume her business she finds herself pregnant again. Last story today. A doctor (Cher) works in a clinic where legal abortions are practiced. The hospital is manned by extremist groups that contest the law.
notes: The theme is treated with seriousness and without preconceptions. The three situations, linked to different historical moments, help to better understand the evolution of the debate. First-rate (as well as prima donnas) the cast.

title: Our Man in Havana
actors: Alec Guinness, Ernie Kovacs, Maureen O'Hara, Noël Coward, Burl Ives, Ralph Richardson, Jo Morrow
description: James Wormold, a modest representative of a Havana-based vacuum cleaner company, is offered to take on the duties of secret agent in Cuba on behalf of Her British Majesty. Since it is a well-paid job, Wormold accepts the offer. James needs to build a network of whistleblowers and be able to relay interesting news to the Secret Service. But no matter how hard he tries, he doesn't get over anything. He then decides to invent a fictitious network.
notes: Good cinematographic reduction of the famous novel by Graham Greene, between comedy and moral thriller. Alec Guinness is priceless.

title: The Brave
actors: Johnny Depp, Marlon Brando, Elpidia Carrillo
description: Rafael, an angry and landless young man is the last hero of the frontier. Morgantown, the city where he lives with Rita and their two children, is a place where there is no justice and where Red Indians spend their lives sitting drinking on the fringes of civilization. Suddenly, fearsome as a devil, McCarthy arrives. It will be he who will offer Rafael 30 thousand dollars to shoot one of those films in which the actors really die.
notes: It is not bad, badly directed or badly acted, but it is a jumble of typical places so overflowing that they become commonplaces, with an uncontrolled desire for Mito alla Cimino. The first direction by Johnny Depp (also interpreter and co-author of the screenplay), is one of those films that leave you speechless for the obvious clash between the passion and intensity of the project and the naivety of the realization. And, above all, there is Marlon Brando in a wheelchair, towering key figure, who unfortunately, more and more than the crazy gunslinger of "Missouri", looks more and more like an old aunt. A film that fails to be "cursed", but only naive.

title: Odio per odio
actors: Antonio Sabato, John Ireland, Mirko Ellis, Nadia Marconi
description: Miguel is a young Mexican who collects gold on behalf of Coyote, a lawyer who uses it to advance the good cause of Mexico. Meanwhile Miguel goes to New York to collect all his savings: his ambition is to become a famous sculptor. But just as he is withdrawing his money, two bandits storm the bank. The young man is arrested together with one of the two criminals.
notes: Paolella made this film in the middle of the spaghetti western era, not using a pseudonym, as was the case then.

title: La casa 3 - Ghosthouse
actors: Lara Wendel, Greg Scott, Ron Houck, Mary Sellers, Donald O'Brian
description: Six young people investigate the hidden mysteries of an old villa abandoned for over twenty years. The whole family (father, mother and a little girl) who lived there had been exterminated in the villa and no one had ever managed to identify and arrest the culprit. The sextet enters the house in search of clues, but strange supernatural presences begin to manifest themselves ...
notes: Someone recently tried to re-evaluate the so-called "Italian horror". Cause lost at the start. Seeing is believing.

title: The Leather Boys
actors: Rita Tushingham, Colin Campbell, Dudley Sutton, Gladys Henson
description: Relationship problems for a woman married to a mechanic who has a passion for motorcycles. They share not a few problems and the environment that surrounds them certainly does not help them.
notes: Troubled film management: shot in 1963 in the United States, it was only released in 1966. Good performance by Rita Tushingham.

title: The Story of Dr. Wassell
actors: Gary Cooper, Laraine Day, Signe Hasso, Dennis O'Keefe
description: A brave US Navy doctor is in China where he is carrying out scientific experiments on a microorganism that has caused a terrible epidemic. Helps him Madeline, a Red Cross nurse he is in love with. Thanks to the woman, however, a rival doctor of Wassell manages to make the discovery of his colleague believe his own. Believing Madeline's betrayal, Wassell abruptly leaves her and embarks on board. Meanwhile, the war has broken out and the Japanese troops are setting fire to the whole Far East.
notes: Without giving up some of his most cherished themes, for example that of the uncanny woman, the "Hollywood tamer" makes an effective war propaganda film.

title: Queen of Outher Space
actors: Zsa Zsa Gabor, Eric Fleming, Dave Willock, Laurie Mitchell
description: Some astronauts end up on the planet Venus which is inhabited only by women and ruled by a despotic tyrant with a disfigured face. The queen harbors a senseless hatred for mankind, convinced that the earthlings are the cause of her deformity. The astronauts are therefore sentenced to death while a terrible space machine is set up to destroy the Earth. A woman of the court, however, allies herself with the astronauts and ...
notes: Science fiction of the Z-Z series, in the sense that the film is calibrated on the graces of Zsa Zsa Gabor, at the time in great shape and at the fourth or fifth marriage (as many will follow). Unpredictable, even with the indulgence of hindsight.

title: The Choirboys
actors: Charles Durning, Louis Gossett jr., Perry King, Randy Quaid
description: Despite appearances - many of them fought in Vietnam - are psychologically fragile and insecure. Their escape valve is the city park where they meet to party, also because in the barracks they are harassed by a sadistic lieutenant. Its purpose? Train them to the hard work of the policeman. But not all resist the violent "therapy".
notes: Aldrich, increasingly crepuscular, digs into the rottenness of an institution devoted to order. And he follows his "boys" in the night, who have left all heroism in the relentless folds of the great American nothingness. Fundamental film of the dark sensibility of post-Vietnam and post-Watergate America.

title: Koridorius
actors: Attori non professionisti
description: The daily life of the tenants of a "barracks" on the outskirts of a Lithuanian city. The Soviet empire has now dissolved, but the achieved independence has not improved the conditions of life. A drunk returning from a party, hasty encounters, poor and frightened inhabitants, children playing in rough courtyards, are the silent witnesses of a degradation that now seems inevitable.

title: From Hell to Texas
actors: Don Murray, Diana Varsi, Chill Wills, Dennis Hopper
description: Young Lohman is unjustly accused by Hunter Boyd of killing one of his sons. To escape his revenge the boy runs away; but Hunter, with a host of men in tow, pursues him. Aided by a fellow Bradley and then by other people, Lohman is forced to kill for real. The showdown takes place during a fire in which another of Boyd's children is about to die. Lohman will be the one to throw himself into the flames to save him ...
notes: From such a master, a large fresco on the primordial impulses of man. The scenario is the fantastic one of the border.

title: El viaje
actors: Walter Quiroz, Dominique Sanda, Ricardo Bartis, Marc Berman
description: Martin, a 17-year-old with still uncertain choices, lives in Tierra del Fuego and precisely in Ushuaia, the southernmost town in the country. His mother and stepfather live with him. The young man attends a high school with dilapidated structures with a dictator overseer and an equally despotic director. Martin is distressed by the absence of his real father, who has been away from home for too long.
notes: Between jungles and open-air gold mines the film misses the grotesque target despite the beautiful music of Solanas himself, Egberto Gismonti and the great Astor Piazzolla. Censored at home, where Solanas also suffered an attack.

title: The Fiendish Plot of Dr. Fu Manchu
actors: Peter Sellers, Helen Mirren, Sid Cesar, Simon Williams, Steve Franken
description: In the Tibetan empire of Saipan, the 168th birthday of Fu Manchu is being celebrated, when, due to the carelessness of an attendant, the elixir of life that the emperor absolutely needs is thrown away. His emissaries immediately leave for Washington where, with ease, they steal the "Star of Leningrad", a large straw-colored diamond. In London, with similar ease, they steal a mummy from the British Museum. To complete the ingredients of the elixir, another twin diamond of the previous one is missing, the "George V", guarded with the Crown Jewels.
notes: Parody without many ideas of the character invented by Sax Rohmer. Peter Sellers demonstrates his acting prowess by playing Dr. Fu Manchu and the Scotland Yard police inspector.

title: Boys Town
actors: Spencer Tracy, Mickey Rooney, Henry Hull, Gene Reynolds
description: Father Flanagan decides to consecrate his apostolate to the assistance of abandoned children. With the help of a friend he formed a small group in Nebraska, but soon realized that the turnout was so great that he was convinced to create a center that was called "The City of Boys". The immense community is fully organized and is governed by the children themselves in total autonomy. However, Father Flanagan's work is hampered by a young hooligan.
notes: Tracy won the Academy Award for Best Actor for the second consecutive time (the first was for "Captains Brave").

title: Carne trémula
actors: Francesca Neri, Liberto Rabal, Javier Bardem, Angela Molina, Penélope Cruz
description: Victor Plaza was born on one of the darkest days of the Franco regime, on a bus that was taking his mother, a prostitute, to the hospital. One night, he meets Elena and it is with her that he has his first sexual relationship. All he has left of that meeting is a napkin with the girl's phone number and address. When Victor goes to Elena's house, she is waiting for a dealer who, however, does not show up. Victor's arrival precipitates events ...
notes: "Carne tremula" has the sanguine and robust vigor of melos, the dry speed of the detective story, the shameless simplicity of the photo novel. An Almodòvar in splendid shape.

title: Donnie Brasco
actors: Al Pacino, Johnny Depp, Michael Madsen, Bruno Kirby, James Russo
description: He wears a hat with a turned-up brim, a slightly short plaid coat with a fur collar and teardrop glasses. He is almost old with a hint of a stomach, and his physiognomy merges with those of the other mafia minions crowding around the bosses. It is Lefty Ruggiero, known as Lefty Gun, Lefty Two Guns, Cock, Half Cock, a mafioso hooked by the young FBI agent Joe Pistone, who, under the false identity of the jeweler Donnie Brasco, tries to infiltrate the mafia.
notes: Another sort of "good guys", in 1978, in New York, taken from the true memories of Joe Pistone, an FBI special agent who infiltrated the mafia. Directed by Mike Newell (an Englishman who has nothing to do with the Italian-American imaginary), "Donnie Brasco" is not yet another "Scorsese-style" film: marked by Peter Sova's photography, all in brown and sepia tones , it really seems a sort of anthropological treatise on the rituals, life and dramas of a circumscribed tribe, characterized by a pyramidal scale and a rigid "regulation", where Scorsese's dramatic pathos has been replaced by a daily mediocrity. Mafia and FBI mirror each other. A film of evolving psychologies, of dynamic relationships, of people and not of stereotypes.

title: Chinese Box
actors: Jeremy Irons, Gong Li, Maggie Cheung, Michael Hui, Rubén Blades
description: John, a British journalist, discovers that he is only a few months old due to a blood disease. He has lived in Hong Kong for fifteen years and is always secretly in love with Vivian, who has a background as a prostitute. The girl, for her part, is distressed by her not too idyllic relationship with Chang, who does not decide to marry her due to his past. John and Vivian end up falling in love. All this while Hong Kong is about to return to China.
notes: Wayne Wang, director of "Smoke", does not benefit from the passage from Paul Auster to the too precious wishes of Jean-Claude Carrière (a screenwriter who is dangerous without Buñuel). Filmed in Hong Kong before the passage of the city from Great Britain to China, it is perhaps too melodious for a director who has more intimate strings and who here fails to merge the historical event with the existential crisis of the protagonist. Some segments of the film don't blend with others, Gong Li is ridiculous when he wants to mimic Dietrich. Irons is good, romantic, emaciated; but maybe he shouldn't be sick anymore.

title: Rien ne va plus
actors: Isabelle Huppert, Michel Serrault, François Cluzet, Jean-François Balmer
description: A very heterogeneous couple, Victor and Betty, are forced to live by tricks and small scams. He is a man in his sixties. The two travel through France and neighboring nations in a camper, hunting for professional conventions in the provinces, where Betty has the task of trapping esteemed professionals. A snag in one of their scams leads them to money laundering.
notes: Comedy à la Lubitsch hidden behind an almost detective story. "Montecarlo", (1930), or "Competent Mancha" ('32) comes to mind: between casinos and jet set from the vulgar era like today. In a film that apparently navigates between old ways and old cinephile tastes, Chabrol lightly conveys all the sympathy for his characters. To the point of not wanting to solve the riddle: are they father and daughter, husband and wife, friends, accomplices, lovers? Fiftieth direction and first prize at the San Sebastian Film Festival.

title: The House of Yes
actors: Parker Posey, Josh Hamilton, Tori Spelling, Freddie Prinze jr, Geneviève Bujold
description: Marty decides to take Leslie, his fiancée, to Washington for the first time at the home of his parents. In truth, he hasn't told her much about her mother, her twin Jackie O, and her younger brother Anthony. Bad weather forces everyone to stay at home, making even the plan of a formal lunch vanish. But it doesn't take long before Leslie learns what lies in the soul of her beloved Marty.
notes: Debut of the independent Mark Waters, who plays a game of the massacre typical of so much American theater. Macabre comedy, with a lashing dialogue.

title: Marquise
actors: Sophie Marceau, Bernard Giraudeau, Patrick Timsit, Lambert Wilson
description: In a country market in the province of Lyon, a young dancer of incomparable grace performs half-naked to attract the customers of her trading parents. One day, however, Jean-Baptiste Poquelin, known by all as Molière, passes by and right there, in the middle of the mud and the beasts, that an actor of her company, René du Parc, called Gros-René, will fall in love with her . Having become Marquise du Parc she dreams of becoming an actress, ends up being relegated to the role of dancer and despite this, she will be noticed by Monsieur, brother of Louis XIV.
notes: Historical-theatrical meatloaf like the French like to do. Worse than expected, despite Marceau.

title: Nothing to Lose
actors: Tim Robbins, Martin Lawrence, John C. McGilnley, Giancarlo Esposito
description: Things couldn't get any worse for advertiser Nick Beam, upset that he just caught his wife Ann in flagrant home adultery with her boss. Stuck at a traffic light in confusion, Nick is brought back to reality by the raid on by T. Paul, an easy-talking robber who jumps with a gun in his face.
notes: An indigestible comedy, obvious and approximated by default. When shooting for ... home video, the back rows are more than enough.

title: Dishonored
actors: Marlene Dietrich, Victor McLaglen, Lew Cody, Gustav von Seyffertitz
description: During the First World War a Viennese prostitute agrees to become a spy on behalf of Austria and to take the name of X-27. In his new capacity he manages to expose a traitorous general, but ends up falling in love with the Russian officer H-14 who passes himself off as Lieutenant Kranau.
notes: Von Sternberg's portrait of the fatal woman is memorable in spite of (or thanks to?) Numerous improbabilities. Superb Marlene.

title: To Each His Own
actors: Olivia de Havilland, John Lund, Mary Anderson, Roland Culver
description: During the First World War Julia had a fleeting relationship with an aviator who, however, was killed in a dangerous action of war in the sky of France. From their relationship a son was born that Julie, targeted by evil tongues, cannot keep with her. After many difficulties she manages to get him to be welcomed into the house by a friend, recently married, who ends up taking him away from poor Julie.
notes: With this film, de Havilland won the Academy Award for Best Actress. Leisen, however, rejected the first draft of the story written by Charles Brackett.

title: The General Died at Down
actors: Gary Cooper, Madeleine Carroll, Akim Tamiroff, Dudley Digges
description: We are in China, in 1926. The Chinese patriots who fight against General Yang's military gangs entrust O'Hara, an American mercenary, with the task of bringing to Shanghai a large sum of money which must be used to buy weapons. But Yang's agents, with the help of Perris and his daughter July, manage to lure O'Hara into a trap, and he is taken prisoner.
notes: Based on a short story by John O'Hara, an exotic and fascinating adventure film. Madeleine Carroll plays here one of the most famous roles of her career.

title: Slattery's Hurricane
actors: Richard Widmark, Linda Darnell, Veronica Lake, John Russell
description: Slattery was a valiant aviator during the war, but now he is in Milne's service and is in charge of flying his own private plane. He is about to marry Dolores, his boss's secretary, and he is unaware that he is trafficking in drugs. One day, while on a flight, Milne suddenly dies and Slattery remains tied to the smuggling gang. Leaving all scruples, he also tries to seduce Aggie, an old flame of his, wife of his former comrade Holson.
notes: An unoriginal story that confronts a brunette and a blonde who in the Hollywood of the fifties were respectively the symbol of the good girl and the perverse woman.

title: Tarzan and the Great River
actors: Mike Henry, Jan Murray, Manuela Padilla jr., Diana Millady
description: Barcuna, leader of the Leopard Men, procures slaves to be used in the diamond mines of his tribe by sacking and destroying entire villages. Tarzan rushes in with the intention of bringing Barcuna to justice, but the difficulties he encounters prove to exceed his expectations.
notes: Filmed in Brazil when the ape man was now an antiques character.

title: X, Y & Zee
actors: Elizabeth Taylor, Michael Caine, Susannah York, Margaret Leighton
description: Robert Blakely, an established architect, occasionally indulges in some sentimental adventures, which his wife Zi, although certainly not enthusiastic about them, nevertheless does not dramatize. But when the man becomes the lover of the young widow Stella, Zi, realizing that this time her rival can steal her husband forever, reacts energetically.
notes: Edna O'Brian's screenplay for a film that, in part, falls short of expectations. Elizabeth Taylor sinks with the film.

title: The People Next Door
actors: Faye Dunaway, Nicolette Sheridan, Michael O'Keefe
description: Running away from her abusive husband, maid Anna Morse (Sheridan) is determined to start a new life with her three daughters, Billie, Laura and Sally. Anna settles into a modest house and soon ends up asking for help from a couple of neighbors: Garrett (O'Keefe) and Donna James. The couple covers the girls with gifts and makes sure that they have adequate accommodation, but all this attention hides an ulterior motive ...
notes: Good performance by screen veteran Faye Dunaway and also by Nicolette Sheridan. The direction is not all that anonymous.

title: Causa di divorzio
actors: Lino Toffolo, Catherine Spaak, Senta Berger, Enrico Montesano
description: After his military service, Silvestro, a Roman, decides to stay in Carpi. In the Emilian town he finds work, in a wool mill, and a wife, Ernesta. In Carpi everyone makes sweaters and even Ernesta embarks on this adventure by buying a frame. Soon she lets herself be totally taken up by this new occupation and neglects both the house and her husband to pursue income. Meanwhile, Silvestro meets Enrica. The latter, in crisis with her husband, unlike Ernesta, devotes herself body and soul to the kitchen. After a while the two decide to get married and here the problems arise. If Enrica, who got married in the Church, manages to have the marriage annulled by the Sacra Rota, Silvestro, who got married in the town hall, has more than one difficulty, since divorce is not yet law. Comedy of non-genial costume and also rather dated, with good actors and hints of social criticism.

title: Anni ribelli
actors: Massimo Dapporto, Alessandra Acciai, Adriana Russo, Inda Ledesma, Leticia Bredice
description: Buenos Aires, 1955. Francesco is an Italian immigrant of Sicilian origin who has chosen Argentina to look for that safety of life and that well -being that the motherland does not guarantee him. Not everything is gold what glitters and in fact Francesco, who is a tailor, has never fully integrated into the new chosen country. His daughter Laura lives with him who, unlike the parent, instead settled very well and is interested in art and politics. By attending a painting school, Laura falls in love with her teacher. Happiness seems around the corner, but bad news disturbs the young woman: her father gets seriously ill ...
notes: Not yet king of the first television evening with his stratuppalacrime stories with episodes, Massimo Dapporto plays with the usual dignity this meatloaf applied more to telenovelas than in the cinema.

title: Ruby
actors: Danny Aiello, Sherilyn Fenn, Arliss Howard, David Duchovny
description: Everyone knows, or remembers, how President Kennedy died and everyone knows that the mystery is still dense around that crime. Here we want to shed light on that mystery through the figure of the murderer of the murderer, that is that Jack Ruby, an ambiguous individual from the mafia past and the present of trust with the police who, a few days after the crime killed Lee Harvey Oswald, the alleged JFK killer.
notes: The basic choice of the film is to press on the pedal of intrigue and conspiracy. According to the writers, from the Bay of Pigs to the alcove of the White House the ineffable Ruby would have practically always shadowed the president. Unlikely, but Aiello reigns supreme.

title: Dastforush
actors: Zohrah Sarmadi, Morteza Zarrabi, Behzad Behzadpur
description: Film in three episodes. In the first, a couple tries to get rid of their fourth child, so as not to condemn him to be disabled for malnutrition. In the second, a mentally retarded young man assisting an elderly woman suffers a car accident; when he returns from the hospital he will find her dead. In the third, a peddler who collaborates with a gang of smugglers is threatened because he is suspected of having betrayed them.

title: L'odeur de la papaye verte
actors: Tràn Nu Yén Khé, Lu Man San, Truong Thi Loc, Nguyen Anh Hoa, Wuong Hoa Hoi
description: Mui, a ten-year-old farmer, leaves her loved ones to go to the city, where she begins to work as a maid with a family. He soon discovers, thanks to the old maid Ti, the drama of the family he works for. But just as old Ti tells this story to Mui, the father abandons his family again, taking away the family's savings. Repressing her despair, her mother courageously provides for the sustenance of her three children, Trung, Lam and Tin.
notes: From the Far East here is another work of great sensitivity and great poetry. The budget is microscopic and this makes us appreciate it even more. Caméra d'or for the best first film in Cannes.

title: A Canterbury Tale
actors: John Sweet, Eric Portman, Sheila Sim, Dennis Price, Esmond Knight
description: In a village near Canterbury there is a maniac who usually smears all the girls' hair with glue. In the country they meet a sergeant who is part of the American army and who has not received letters from his girlfriend for some time. Besides him there is also an English sergeant who dreamed of playing the organ and has been reduced to playing in cinemas and a girl who is convinced that she has lost her boyfriend in the war.
notes: The war was ending and the Powell / Pressburger duo made a joke about the coexistence between the British and the Americans. Curious, unbalanced and light.

title: Regalo di Natale
actors: Carlo Delle Piane, Diego Abatantuono, Gianni Cavina, Alessandro Haber, George Eastman, Kristina Sevieri, Gianna Piaz
description: On Christmas Eve, Lele, Ugo, Stefano and Franco, old friends, secretly decide from their respective families to get together in a villa to play poker. A mysterious and wealthy industrialist, the lawyer Antonio Santelia, was invited to the game. Lele is a born loser; Ugo, separated from a wife he never sees, as well as his four children, is an unfortunate seller of household items; Stefano is a gymnastics instructor suspected of homosexuality; Franco is oppressed by creditors. We immediately begin to play large sums: immediately the two real antagonists emerge, the lawyer Santelia and Franco.
notes: One of Avati's best films that here skilfully draws the profile of all the characters, with an unusual cruelty. The director relaunched Abatantuono, and Carlo Delle Piane won the prize in Venice for best actor.

title: L'argine
actors: Luisa Ferida, Gino Cervi, Guglielmo Sinaz, Rubi Dalma, Olga Capri
description: The "passatore" (ferryman) from Romagna Zvani is attracted to an unknown woman who, following a road accident, was hosted for a night in his house. He leaves the country, his mother and the girl with whom he had a child, to follow the woman to Rome. He sees her again, but also realizes that for her that night was just a whim to quickly forget. Zvani then decides to return to the country.
notes: Luisa Ferida and Gino Cervi were two of the few film actors to attract attention with their mere presence on a film bill (the others were Assia Noris, Vittorio De Sica and Amedeo Nazzari). This is enough to justify an unlikely and badly scripted story.

title: Amore mio non farmi male
actors: Walter Chiari, Valentina Cortese, Luciano Salce, Macha Meril
description: Anna and Marcello are two wealthy high school students. She is the daughter of an airplane pilot, he of a lawyer. The two, madly in love with each other, would like to crown their dream of love in bed, but encounter many difficulties. Getting away in a quiet place is not easy and above all there are perplexities on the part of Anna's father and Marcello's mother. In fact the former is obsessed with the idea that his daughter can be threatened by a "monster", while the second is bigoted and possessive ...
notes: The sexual maturation of boys as seen by Vittorio Sindoni, which is saying something. Comedy tones are out of place for such a serious subject.

title: Bean
actors: Rowan Atkinson, Peter MacNicol, Burt Reynolds, John Mills
description: A day like many others for Mr. Bean, attendant of the National Gallery in London. In reality, the director of the museum intends to entrust him with a prestigious task: to accompany overseas, as a great expert, a precious painting by Whistler. To welcome him there is David Langley whose our hero upsets the quiet, at least until then, family life. In short, disasters are lurking.
notes: Often a comedian's transition from television to the big screen is disappointing. On the other hand, the cheeky, spiteful, sometimes disgusting English "common man" works beautifully there too.

title: Dobermann
actors: Vincent Cassel, Monica Bellucci, Tchéky Karyo, Antoine Basler
description: Destiny marked from the cradle for the charismatic Dobermann, a gypsy of the mala surrounded by a gang of psychopaths. Fortunately for him that the beautiful - albeit deaf-mute - Nat, a sensitive and sensitive creature who is enough and advances to offer a reason to live and one to die, gravitates alongside. At the heels of the gang is Inspector Christini, a hound just as alienated, but not very awake.
notes: Kounen, a talented videographer, spares nothing or anyone. Take it or leave it, reject it or let yourself go in the furious whirlwind of a film with an evident comic inspiration.

title: The Golden Voyage of Sinbad
actors: John Phillip Law, Caroline Munro, Tom Baker, Douglas Wilmer
description: Captain Sinbad accidentally comes into possession of the third of an amulet which, completed, would be able to guarantee supreme power in the city to the Grand Vizier of Marabia, who holds the second third. The two decide to head with Sinbad's ship to the mysterious island of Lemuria. Their opponent is the magician, as well as Prince Kouras, a shady individual who manages to dominate the evil forces in his favor. The man, sure of being able to regain his youth by arriving first at the magic fountain, spies on the moves of his opponents with the help of a fairy bat. Rather pleasant retro operation, which resurrects the colorful fantasy of a few decades earlier. Delicious tricks from veteran ray Harryhausen.

title: Anaconda
actors: Jennifer Lopez, Ice Cube, Jon Voight, Eric Stoltz, Jonathan Hyde
description: A film crew, armed with cameras and recorders, penetrates the Amazon rainforest to make a documentary on the Shirishama Indians. Along the way, they come across Paul Sarone (Jon Voight), who is stuck aboard an unmanned boat. A solitary man, but full of charisma and completely at ease in the forest, Paul wins their friendship and does everything to persuade them to go down the river. The adventurer is engaged in his own personal and dark mission: to hunt down a fearsome twelve-meter long anaconda.
notes: It's embarrassing to see what cinema can be capable of at its worst and "Anaconda" is one of them. Conceived as a herpetological version of Spielberg's shark, "Anaconda" soon moves away from it, increasingly resembling the false documentary film of "Cannibal Holocaust" by Ruggero Deodato. The film therefore fluctuates between ridicule and boredom and it is useless to try to ennoble it with the citation of Herzog's "Fitzcarraldo", with the expedition boat accompanied on its journey on the river of the notes of Verdi's "Don Carlos".

title: Speed 2: Cruise Control
actors: Sandra Bullock, Jason Patric, Willem Dafoe
description: Annie Porter, the passenger who, fresh from her license, took possession of the bus that always had to travel at least fifty miles an hour, is back. She is now involved in a relationship with Alex, a reassuring-looking Venice Beach police officer. One day Annie learns that the man is part of the Swat, an anti-crime section. To be forgiven Alex all that remains is to invite her on a cruise. He never did.
notes: Flat sequel in the dialogues, in the narrative succession, in the characterization of the characters. And to say that it had seemed, with "Twister", that De Bont himself had to reinvent the catastrophic. Instead this is cinema decerebrated by television, with a script to make you shiver, endless, capable of throwing away even Dafoe. At least, in the old catastrophes, occasionally someone died.

title: Facciamo fiesta
actors: Alessandro Gassmann, Gian Marco Tognazzi, Lorena Forteza, Blas Roca Rey
description: Sandro and Marco have reached the age of thirty: the first is a cameraman who works for private TV, while the second earns his living with editorial collaborations of the lowest order. Marco has a girlfriend, who is a "real" journalist, but things are not going too well between them. One day he is contacted by a tourist agency who offers him to leave for Cuba to make an advertising video. On the Caribbean island she meets Sandro. For the two begins an adventure between sea, sun and beautiful women.
notes: The long wave caused by Pieraccioni's "Cyclone" reaches the Cuban coast. The little film, shot as a video holiday by Angelo Longoni, is all about the shoulders of the now experienced couple Tognazzi & Gassman junior version. The audience seems to like it, while the soundtrack sobs a "cyclonic" leitmotif; but the perfidy, the healthy cynicism, the crude ... unreality of Ugo & Vittorio where did they go?

title: Head
actors: The Monkees, Teri Garr, Frank Zappa, Jack Nicholson
description: It is the first film shot by Bob Rafelson and focuses on the adventures of the musical group "The Monkeys", which Rafelson himself had directed in a famous television series.
notes: In minor roles also the musician Frank Zappa and a very young, as well as scalp Jack Nicholson. Sixty-eight is in the air and it shows!

title: Tarzan and the Jungle Boy
actors: Mike Henry, Rafer Johnson, Aliza Gur, Steve Bond, Ronald Gans
description: Erik Brunik, a seven-year-old son of a geologist, disappears into the waters of a river and is left for dead. Six years later, word gets out that Erik is alive and in Zagunda territory. An intrepid journalist, Mirna Clodell, and one of her collaborators decide to turn to Tarzan.
notes: Usual fights against the natives and nothing more in this routine film.

title: Last Summer
actors: Richard Thomas, Barbara Hershey, Bruce Davison, Catherine Burns, Ernesto González
description: Friendship, sexuality, violence between two girls and two boys, during a summer by the sea. Sandy is the most enterprising of the group and soon manages to impose her will on the two males. The other girl will instead be humiliated and will also suffer violence.
notes: A bitter and unpleasant portrait of America in the years of hardship, from a short story by Evan Hunter / Ed McBain, Last Summer.

title: Games
actors: Simone Signoret, James Caan, Katharine Ross, Ken Smith, Don Stroud
description: An American collector intends to get rid of his wife in order to take possession of her large fortune. Thus he architects a series of terrifying pitfalls so that the woman is pushed into an insane gesture or literally dies of fear. To carry out his plan he avails himself of the collaboration of an old adventurer. The crime machine is set in motion, but the first to pay the price is a boy and his wife ...
notes: The cast is one of those that make you dream, but the script and the direction are very weak so that even the actors cannot do much to save the shack.

title: Non chiamatemi papà
actors: Jerry Calà, Umberto Smaila, Nini Salerno, Marina Suma, Naima Perry, Gilda Postiglione
description: Vera, tired of the extravagances of her husband Rocco, a guitarist and pub entertainer, throws him out of the house. After knocking in vain on the doors of friends in search of accommodation, Rocco finally arrives at the home of Ugo, his old schoolmate at the conservatory and now a serious orchestra professor. The characters of the two friends, absolutely antithetical, give life to a series of tragicomic misadventures in which also Mara, a mysterious girl whom Rocco meets at the pub and falls in love with ...
notes: Reconstituted for three quarters the cheerful brigade of the "Gatti di vicolo Miracoli", Salerno, Smaila and Calà give life to a light comedy based on the most abused ingredients, verbal gags, oppositions of characters and a pinch of pink "touch" ". To guarantee the latter the emerging Guild Postiglione.

title: A Different Kind of Christmas
actors: Shelley Long, Barry Bostwick, Bruce Kirby, Nathan Lawrence
description: Elizabeth, a single with a ten -year -old son, is about to become mayor but in his life there is a small secret: his father chose himself as a job to interpret the role of Santa Claus and this has created embarrassments not to end up in the course of his adolescence. One day, however, the man, after a long absence, reappears in the middle of the election campaign. The chain misunderstandings are born, so much so that the daughter is forced to arrest the exuberant parent ...
notes: Comedy who superficially tries to reflect on the role-child's role: with the first carefree and pure hearts, the second arrival and "managers".

title: Killer Fish
actors: Lee Majors, Karen Black, Margaux Hemingway, Marisa Berenson
description: A group of criminals, after having burned the fuel deposits and electrical systems of a large mining plant, reach the safe from which they take a huge amount of precious stones. The leader of the gang and creator of the company is Paul Diller, who, among other things, had the support of a friend of his Kate Neville. To safeguard the loot, Paul dipped it in a lake with 50 piraña, but ...

title: Nick of Time
actors: Johnny Depp, Christopher Walken, Marsha Mason, Charles S. Dutton, Peter Strauss, Roma Maffia
description: A young man with his little daughter has just returned from his ex-wife's funeral when, at the train station, he is approached by a plainclothes police officer. The latter forces him to commit a murder in exchange for the life of his little girl. The dazed man discovers that his target will be the newly elected governor and has only one hour and a half of time.
notes: Coming immediately after the all too photocopied "Murder in the Void", Badham's film is a pleasant surprise. The director chose to shoot almost the entire film with the hand-held camera, even for the very close-ups, creating a particular rhythm. Perfect Johnny Depp.

title: Balto
description: At the turn of the century, a diphtheria epidemic broke out in Nome, an Alaskan city, of which children were the main victims. The stocks of medicines essential to eradicate the disease are however in Mercy and no means of mechanical transport can connect the two cities due to snow. A sled pulled by dogs (whose leader is the arrogant Steele) then leaves but gets lost. It will be the half wolf and half dog Balto to find the expedition.
notes: Produced by Steven Spielberg, a gripping story, action, suspense, an unpleasant villain to hate and a good (to love) who must regain self-confidence to win. This being the case, it is not clear why it was a flop in the United States.

title: The Land Before Time IV: The Journey Through the Mists
description: Piedino and his inseparable friends, Triki, Ducky, Petrie and Spike this time have to face a dangerous climatic variation that gives rise to an uncontrollable migration to safer areas. It so happens that all the inhabitants are forced to leave their beloved valley. Furthermore, Piedino's grandfather, feeling the effects of the change in climate, becomes seriously ill. There is only one thing that can save them, and that is the Night Flower that grows exclusively in the terrifying Valley of the Mists.
notes: Fourth adventure for our five friends who show no signs of fatigue. There are new characters and the setting changes too.

title: Don Bluth's Thumbelina
description: A childless woman turns to a witch who gives her a grain of barley. Planted in a pot, it produces a flower from which a tiny girl, as tall as a thumb, comes out and is called Thumbelina. Hearing her sing, the fairy prince, Cornelius, tall like her, but with transparent wings, falls in love with her, but the girl is kidnapped by a family of singing toads.
notes: It is not one of the best things about Don Bluth who has done better in cartoons (for example two of the series "The enchanted valley"). Even the main character is not perfectly suited, poised between childish naivety and a slight sexy touch.

title: Trick or Treat
actors: Marc Price, Tony Fields, Lisa Orgolin, Doug Savant, Ozzy Osbourne
description: Sammi Curr, an American rock star, dies during a fire. Eddie, who nurtures a real cult for the deceased singer, receives from a friend of his, the director of a private radio station, the matrix of the last album recorded by the rock star that will be broadcast on Halloween night. Eddie takes it home slowly spins it backwards and discovers that the tape is hiding a message that Sammi left him. For the boy begins a series of hallucinating adventures.
notes: Directorial debut for Charles Martin Smith (actor in "American Graffiti") who mixes, without too much originality, horror, comedy and music.

title: Bengal Brigade
actors: Rock Hudson, Arlene Dahl, Dan O'Herlihy, Ursula Thiess
description: A battalion of English soldiers falls into the ambush that is set by the rebels. The Court-Martial blames the defeat on Captain Claybourne, who is demoted. Though innocent, Claybourne breaks off his engagement with Vivian, the daughter of Colonel Morrow, and decides to stay in India as a bourgeois. When he discovers that Rajah Karam is plotting against the British, he tries to thwart the plans of the conspirators.
notes: Rock Hudson appears awkward in a pompous and almost ridiculous film. He directs with little conviction Laszlo Benedek author, in the same year, of "The wild".

title: The Return of Jafar
description: From the desert sand surrounding Agrabah emerges the parrot Iago, tired of being locked in the lamp in the company of the evil Jafar. Back in the city, the bird manages to make himself liked by Aladdin, always struggling with the cutthroat Abis Mal. Back at the palace, Iago and Aladdin find the Genius, who has also returned to his old friends. But when, in the desert, Abis Mal, finds an old lamp and decides to rub it, trouble begins: Jafar is back.
notes: It is the continuation of "Aladdin" made directly for the home video market, the first feature film produced for this purpose by the Burbank house. Gigi Proietti is still dubbing the genius The pleasant songs given by the various characters are inevitable. Enjoyable moments and very high professionalism.

title: The Little Colonel
actors: Shirley Temple, Lionel Barrymore, Evelyn Venable, John Lodge
description: We are in the years of the Civil War. Little Shirley is the daughter of a Northern soldier, but the granddaughter of a senior Southern officer. Even before the war, the two hated each other cordially to the point that the old man had denied consent to his daughter's marriage to the soldier. The ongoing war (and the little intriguing one) will be able to ensure that the two find a possibility of understanding.

title: Cousin Bobby
actors: Robert Demme
description: The protagonist of this singular documentary is Reverend Robert Demme, cousin of the director and owner of a Baptist parish in Harlem, New York. Characteristic of the character of the pastor is the combativeness in favor of the civil rights of minorities until, in the sixties, he was known as chaplain of the "Black Panthers", the extremist black group.
notes: Curious family digression by the author of the "Silence of the Lambs".

title: Susannah of the Mounties
actors: Shirley Temple, Randolph Scott, Margaret Lockwood
description: Susanna is an orphan girl who is adopted by the sergeant of the Red Jackets, the Canadian mounted troops, who saved her from the massacre of her family by the Blackfeet Indians. The warlike tribe is still on a war footing and when the sergeant falls into an ambush he risks big, but the child has a thousand resources ...
notes: Yet another variation on the theme "exploitation of minors" in the sense of commercial exploitation of the child prodigy Temple. Not even the best in the series.

title: Der Scharlachrote Buchstabe
actors: Senta Berger, Lou Castel, Hans Christian Blech
description: The famous novel by Nathaniel Hawtorne according to Wenders. In early 17th century America a woman, guilty of adultery, is forced by the community in which she lives to always wear a large red letter "A" sewn on her clothes.
notes: Nothing to do, from any point of view, with the recent version of Joffé, with Demi Moore. And that's all said!

title: La veritàààà
actors: Cesare Zavattini, Pietro Barreca, Vittorio Amendola, Piero Zardini, Bombolo
description: An eighty-year-old man escapes from the asylum in which he is locked up without even getting rid of his white shirt. Dressed like that, he begins to go around people and talk to everyone about what is wrong with the world. He even talks about it to the pope and sends his message on TV, but no one is willing to listen to the ravings of an old madman. He therefore decides to "commit suicide" by holding his breath.
notes: After a whole life spent for cinema as a screenwriter, Zavattini arrives as director with this lunar and impossible "truth" of his like all utopias. Atypical film unfairly snubbed by critics and audiences.

title: K 2
actors: Michael Biehn, Matt Craven, Hiroshi Fujioka, Annie Grindlay
description: Taylor and Harold are great climbers and great friends. During an expedition, they meet a man whose intent is to reach the summit of K2, the second highest peak in the world but the first for climbing difficulties. The two join him and face the most difficult undertaking of their life. However, both aspire to the lead role, and a deep rivalry will develop between them, which will jeopardize the success of the expedition.
notes: Inconsistent as an intertwining and unsatisfactory as an environmental yield.

title: Fortini/Cani
actors: Franco Fortini, Luciana Nissim, Adriano Aprà
description: Cinematic meditation on the words of Franco Fortini, who passed away a few years ago, who reads his book "The dogs of Sinai" dedicated to the problem of the formation of the state of Israel. Fortini was of Jewish origin (his real surname was in fact Lattes).
notes: Once Rai even produced Straub's films, difficult, intellectualistic and experimental like this one.

title: King Richard and the Crusaders
actors: Rex Harrison, George Sanders, Virginia Mayo, Laurence Harvey
description: King Richard is in the East for the Crusade. Following him are some English nobles and his cousin, Lady Edith. Among the courtiers, however, someone meditates on betrayal and Riccardo falls into an ambush and would die if he were not saved by a Muslim who claims to be the sultan's doctor. At the court of the latter, the traitors will be exposed and the good will be rewarded.
notes: Old fashioned swashbuckler with great glitz and slow pace.

title: Tom & Jerry - The Movie
description: As usual, the cat Tom and the mouse Jerry are at loggerheads, but an event is about to change their lives: the owners are about to move and their house will be demolished. Due to the bickering, the two are unable to get on the moving truck so they find themselves alone and without a roof over their heads.
notes: Wanted by CNN boss Ted Turner, set to music by Henry Mancini, it does not keep what it promises. In fact, the characters lose their characterization and are therefore different from how we are used to seeing them. In addition they speak.

title: Run Wild, Run Free
actors: John Mills, Sylvia Sims, Bernard Miles, Mark Lester, Gordon Jackson
description: Little Philip Ramsome spends his days on the west coast of England. Suddenly mute at the age of five, the child prefers the company of a white horse grazing on the moor to that of his parents. A retired colonel, a good friend of Philip, manages to capture him and teaches the boy to ride. Having become an expert, the boy embarks on long rides with his friend Diana.
notes: There were all the prerequisites for a honeyed story about misunderstood childhood, but Sarafian, with a good sense of rhythm, at times manages to breathe an atmosphere of freedom.

title: Borrowed Hearts
actors: Roma Downey, Eric McCormack, Hector Elizondo, Shawn Thompson
description: Christmas is approaching. A young "single" mother dreams of earning enough money to buy a house. To this end, she agrees to play, alongside her seven-year-old daughter, the part of the "happy mother" by pretending to be married to her boss, an unrepentant bachelor who, through this staging, wishes to impress a very traditionalist Mexican industrialist, interested in make a big deal with him.
notes: Lambiccato in the starting point, naive in the realization, disappointing to see. Too bad because Kotcheff is not a rookie.

title: Next Stop: Greenwich Village
actors: Lenny Baker, Shelley Winters, Ellen Greene, Lois Smith
description: 24-year-old Larry Lapinski, the son of Polish Jews who plans to pursue an acting career, leaves his parents and moves from Brooklyn to Greenwich Village. In the famous artists' quarter he starts attending an acting school and finds a girl, Sarah. Finding a job as a clerk at some sort of vegetarian restaurant, Larry bonds with a colorful group of friends.
notes: Surely one of Mazursky's films (also author of the screenplay) most successful. Happy is the reconstruction of the environment of Greenwich Village with its somewhat crazy artists. Winters brings to life the good characterization of Lenny's possessive mother.

title: The Muppet Christmas Carol
actors: Michael Caine, Raymond Coulthard, Meredith Braun, Steve Mackintosh
description: Ebenezer Scrooge (Caine) is an old miser, morbidly attached to money. A different Christmas than usual is being prepared for him, in fact in the magical night three spirits appear to him: that of the past, the present and the future. His life after these apparitions will change radically.
notes: Music version of the famous Dickens tale with all the characters of the Muppets. Brian who took over from his father Jim in the animation company manages to keep the emotion and irony of his characters intact.

title: Beastmasters 2: Through the Portal of Time
actors: Marc Singer, Kari Wuhrer, Sarah Douglas, Wings Hauser
description: Dar returns to battle a new devil summoned by an act of witchcraft. This time, thanks to the wizard Douglas, our hero is catapulted into the traffic-clogged streets of modern-day Los Angeles. At first bewildered, then he will have to fight against everything that modernity has been able to create.
notes: The subject is obvious and you immediately see that the film was shot with few means.

title: The Bugs Bunny/Road Runner Movie
description: Bugs Bunny is one of the protagonists of this feature film that combines the cute rabbit with some characters from the Warner factory. There's Duffy Duck and the unfortunate Wile E. Coyote always on the hunt for Road Runner. From adventure to adventure, all these characters will arrive in the fabulous and magical East ...

title: Baby Take a Bow
actors: Shirley Temple, James Dunn, Claire Trevor, Alan Dinehart
description: A criminal who has stolen a precious pearl necklace finds no better way to hide the stolen goods than to give it to a little girl. The latter, as a joke, hides it in the pockets of her father who works as a driver, coincidentally, in the family where the theft took place. Of course he is suspected by a detective who won't leave him alone for a minute.
notes: One of the first great successes of Temple, today it appears unwatchable.

title: Die unendliche Geschichte III
actors: Jason James Richter, Melody Kay, Freddie Jones, Jack Black
description: Bastian has moved to another city. His father Berney has remarried to Jane, a divorced woman who has a daughter, Nicole, and who doesn't get along too well with him. At school a group of repetitors, led by the cruel Slip, begins to torment him: they lock him up in the boilers, force him to take refuge in the library where he finds Mr. Koreander. However, he brought with him the magical book "The Neverending Story". Thus new adventures begin.
notes: The film is very economical, the fantastic part is reduced to a minimum and the result is deadly boredom.

title: Damnation Alley
actors: Jan-Michael Vincent, George Peppard, Dominique Sanda
description: The outbreak of World War III, triggered by a sudden launch of missiles with nuclear warheads against the largest cities in the United States, had dire consequences. The Earth, largely radioactive, has shifted from its axis and has become semi-desert and now uninhabitable. Among the few survivors of the catastrophe are Air Force Major Sam Denton and three of his men who, leaving the bunker where they are locked up, go in search of other potential survivors.
notes: The script is too thin despite a respectable international cast.

title: White Feather
actors: Robert Wagner, Debra Paget, John Lund, Jeffrey Hunter
description: The Washington government begins negotiations with the leaders of the Indian tribes occupying the territory of the state of Wyoming to induce them to evacuate. The intention of the government is to sell it to the gold diggers and, for this purpose, a young surveyor is sent. While the chiefs of most tribes would prefer war to accepting a treaty, Old Cheyenne leader Broken Hand proves against it. Routine Western, with a cast of well-known faces.

title: Pagemaster
actors: Macaulay Culkin, Christopher Lloyd, Ed Begley jr., Mel Harris
description: Richard Tyler is a little boy who is afraid of everything, he is also afraid to go up to the little house that dad Alan built for him on the tree in the garden. Surprised by a violent storm while on his way to buy nails with his super-equipped bicycle, to avoid trouble he enters a huge library. Here the librarian, Mr. Dewey, gives him a card that ends up turning him into a cartoon. In this new state he meets Pagemaster, lord of the library, who invites him to face three tests, to get out of it.
notes: Joe Johnston ("Jumanji") directs the part with real actors, while Maurice Hunt is reserved to direct the cartoon film. The result, however, is weak on both fronts.

title: Bashù, gharibeh kuchak
actors: Sussan Taslimi, Adnan Afravian, Parviz Purhosseini
description: During the Iran-Iraq war, Bashu, an eight-year-old Iranian boy escapes from his bombed village and, after various adventures, reaches a safe location in the north of the country. Here, however, his dark skin is poorly tolerated by the population. But a young mother takes care of him ...

title: L'ubov Vtrojom
actors: Nikolaj Batalov, Ljudmila Semjonova
description: We are in the years of NEP, Lenin's New Economic Policy. A young man of good hopes arrives in Moscow from the province and takes up residence in the house of a young couple. A relationship between the three soon begins which becomes terribly complicated when the woman discovers she is expecting a baby.

title: Uvlecheniya
actors: Svetlana Kolenda, Renata Litvinova
description: Violetta, a circus artist, meets the jockey Sacha in the hospital. Sasha injured himself when he fell off his horse during a race, but hopes to return to racing soon. For her part, Violetta dreams of performing in a new and difficult acrobatic number.
notes: The new Russian reality through the eyes of a "Gelsomina" of today in an all-female story.

title: Christmas in my Hometown
actors: Melissa Gilbert, Tim Matheson, Travis Tritt
description: It is shortly before the start of the long-awaited Christmas holidays. Jake, a manager of an industrial group, is sent to a town in Nebraska whose population mostly works in the local branch of the firm. Its task, however, is to make cuts in staff. At first, Jake pretends to be on site to place a large order for new machinery. The man meets and falls madly in love with Emma, ??a young mother who works at the branch and who is already engaged to the local sheriff. With her help, Jake will radically change her life.
notes: The winning duo of the film consists of Tim Matheson and Melissa Gilbert.

title: IP5 - L'ile aux paschdermes
actors: Yves Montand, Olivier Martinez, Sekkoou Sall, Géraldine Pailhas
description: The graffiti artist Tony on his way to the city of Grenoble in the company of his Senegalese friend Jockey decides to abandon the load of garden lamps in the shape of dwarves that they are carrying. Tony wants to visit a nurse he fell in love with. To do so, they steal a car, but in the back seat the two find old Léon ...
notes: Last film starring Montand, who died during the shooting (it is said for the excessive efforts to which Beineix had subjected him). Pseudo-poetic and exhibitionist hoax.

title: Die angst des tormanns beim elfmeter
actors: Arthur Brauss, Kai Fischer, Erika Pluhar
description: From the novel of the same name by Peter Handke, the story of Josef Bloch, goalkeeper in a football team, and his expulsion from the sports group.
notes: Great metaphor of Wenders, in a very slow and anti-narrative film, all immersed in the post-'68 atmosphere and in the comparison with the poetics of the writer Peter Handke.

title: Mortal Fear
actors: Gregory Harrison, Joanna Kerns, Max Gail, Katherine La Nasa
description: Jennifer Kessler works as a doctor in a major hospital in an American metropolis. One of his patients, a middle-aged man who is apparently in excellent health, dies of mysterious causes. The fact is that this is the latest in a series of unexplained deaths that have occurred recently in Dr. Kessler's ward. At this point, it is logical that you take action to see us more clearly. His investigations, starting from the corridors of a research laboratory lead to ... the background of a private club.
notes: To shoot these "digestive" TV movies (in the sense that they go on air after dinner), one does not hesitate to resort to the most extravagant subjects. More in the vicinity of the soap opera than the cinema.

title: Le chat
actors: Jean Gabin, Simone Signoret, Annie Cordy, Jacques Rispal
description: An old couple lives in an old house destined for demolition: Julien, a retired printer, and Clémence, a former circus acrobat. Their relationship is now dead. The two have no children and Julien ends up becoming fond of a cat picked up on the street. Clémence is so jealous that she kills the animal. The man then decides to go to a small hotel where, in the past, he consumed squalid adulterers. The mistress, Nelly, constantly urges him to go home, where his wife is very ill.
notes: Big, old cinema as it could have been between the two wars. The fact that it was shot in 1973 doesn't really matter.

title: Gratta e vinci
actors: Stefano Masciarelli, Sergio Vastano, Mario De Candia, Manuela Arcuri, Wendy Windham
description: Sergio, Maurizio and Andrea, three idlers who live in an Italian provincial town, have some goals in life: to work as little as possible, to live off tricks to the detriment of others, to have fun at all costs and to woo all the girls. But fate has other left-handed shots in store.
notes: If some things on television (faces, "shapes", gags, etc.) can work, in the cinema it's a different matter. From the idea (so original!) Of the small bulls of the province, to the verbal catchphrases, to the pseudo spicy curtains, this is the triumph of pecoreccio.

title: Cronaca di una morte annunciata
actors: Rupert Everett, Ornella Muti, Gian Maria Volonté, Irene Papas
description: Doctor Cristof Bedoya gets off the boat that has brought him back along the river to a remote village in Colombia where, in the past, he had been called to run the hospital. Suddenly the memories of his youth assail him, when the twenty-one year old Santiago Nasar, scion of a wealthy family, was stabbed to death by the Vicario brothers. With that criminal action they intended to avenge the honor of their sister Angela, who, repudiated immediately after the wedding by her husband, had let slip the name of her lover.
notes: Despite the splendid novel from which it is based and the screenplay signed by Rosi himself and by Tonino Guerra, the film does not convey the atmosphere of the story well. Also harms the presence of a Rupert Everett, too English to give life to a South American prsonage.

title: The Fan
actors: Jeanne Crain, Madeleine Carroll, George Sanders, Richard Greene
description: Mrs. Erlynne is a beautiful woman who is banned from London's aristocratic society for her way of life. One day, in a fan shop, Lord Windermere, who has gone there to buy one for his wife, learns that the woman knows his wife's secrets. A few days pass and Lord Windermere finally discovers why ...
notes: Preminger stages a comedy of misunderstandings taken from Oscar Wilde's "Windermere Fan" and which was already brought to the screen by Lubitsch in 1925.

title: Les portes de la nuit
actors: Yves Montand, Nathalie Nattier, Serge Reggiani, Pierre Brasseur
description: Diego dined with Raimondo's daughter, his fellow prisoner during the war, and is about to spend the night in the house. To satisfy the desire of Raimondo's son who wants to go down to the courtyard to play, he meets a beautiful woman. The girl is called Malou and recently separated from her greedy and selfish husband Georges. The spark of passion strikes between the two and they soon end up making love. Meanwhile, Malou's father and his brother Guy arrive in the nearby restaurant ...
notes: Classic exploit of Carnè and the screenwriter Jacques Prévert, who from poetic realism come to a dark vision of history. Paris is rebuilt in the studio. The soundtrack contains the famous "Les feuilles mortes" set to music by Joseph Kosma.

title: The Prince Who Was a Thief
actors: Tony Curtis, Piper Laurie, Everett Sloane, Donald Randolph, Jeff Corey
