description: Mustafà, Prince Regent of Tangier, entrusts Yusseff, a thief famous throughout the city, with the task of kidnapping and killing little Hussein, his nephew and heir to the throne. Instead of following the order, Yousseff kidnaps the baby and raises him as if he were his own son. Growing up, Hussein, whom everyone knows as Julna, surpassed the same putative father in skill. One night, after having entered the sultan's palace, he sees the beautiful Jasmin, daughter of Mustafà and therefore his first cousin ...
notes: Adventures in exotic sauce for a typical swashbuckling film of the 1950s. The result is lively and pleasant, and the director often throws it into comedy.

title: L'arme à gauche
actors: Lino Ventura, Sylva Koscina, Leo Gordon, Alberto De Mendoza
description: A young and wealthy American widow who has arrived in the Caribbean to take possession of a yacht left to her by her husband, on arrival learns with surprise that the boat has been stolen. Together with the sea captain he had hired for a voyage, he sets out in search of the boat. The two find him stranded on a sandbar, but when they get on board they have the unwelcome surprise of finding him occupied by a gang of adventurers dedicated to arms smuggling.
notes: Sautet, who later turned to more intimate films, started out as an action director. Here he manages to combine suspense quite well with the subtle investigation of the relationships between characters.

title: The Second Civil War
actors: Beau Bridges, James Earl Jones, James Coburn, Kevin Dunn
description: In the not too distant future, legal and illegal immigrants in the United States have reached one billion. To defend against this invasion, the governor of Idaho declares the borders of the state closed to immigrants. Meanwhile, in the White House, the president, advised by influential public relations guru Jack Buchan, sets a 67-hour ultimatum. The governor will have to lift the block by then. Meanwhile, other ethnic groups are trying to take control of their territories. Shot for cable TV and distributed in Italy in theaters, a biting paradox by Joe Dante, conducted at a fast pace and a hilarious description of the stupidity of power.

title: Murder at 1600
actors: Wesley Snipes, Diane Lane, Alan Alda
description: There is something rotten in the White House: a splendid twenty-five-year-old woman was brutally murdered after a consummate embrace in an elegant ravine of the most famous of the residential houses. One of those rooms where the walls are filled with portraits of former presidents and where the cameras of the security services reach even the most hidden corners. An inspector of the homicide squad is called to investigate: and immediately he smells like cheating.
notes: The plot, as well as being tinged with blood red, is yellow and so we stop here. It must be said, however, that after Eastwood's "Absolute Power" it is almost impossible to digest a film that is almost an involuntary parody. And if in the old Clint's masterpiece it was, for once in a while, the President himself who made the figure of the ugly pig, here the ending has neither the strength nor the courage to redeem the "intrigues in Washinton", frequented especially by JFK in then. As for the cast, we are on coordinates of ordinary administration: only the sweet Diane Lane stands out, a Coppolian presence that we would like to see more often.

title: The Revengers' Comedies
actors: Sam Neill, Helena Bonham Carter, Kristin Scott Thomas
description: London, rain, outside at night: Karen threw herself into the Thames, but got caught on the ledge of Tower Bridge; Henry is about to jump, but the woman's screams save him just in time. Both have a good reason to think about leaving prematurely: she has lost her fiery lover, he has lost his job to a sneaky colleague. Thirsty for revenge, they will end up exchanging roles: to mislead their motives and, unwittingly, even themselves.
notes: "A comedy between Hitchcock's" The Other Man "," Throw Mommy from the Train "and" A Fish Named Wanda "" confesses director Malcolm Mowbray. But the source is a play by Alan Ayckbourn that lasted five hours in the theater. The problem lies in the handle (where is the verve of "Royal Lunch", dear Malcolm?), Since the usual excellent actors all of the English school can not really ask for more than what they have given.

title: Promised Land
actors: Jason Gedrick, Kiefer Sutherland, Tracy Pollan, Meg Ryan
description: Two seventeen-year-olds leave an American citizen looking for work: David, a basketball ace looking for a professional engagement, and Danny, known by all by the nickname of "Senator" (since his father, elderly and run-down, dreams of him a role in active politics). David, who has left his girlfriend Mary, returns after two years disappointed and dissatisfied and joins the police.
notes: The film is among the first to bear the mark of Sundance, the festival directed by Robert Redford. With all the merits (independence from the majors) and the demerits (do-goodness, verbiage) that this entails.

title: The Pursuit of Happiness
actors: Michael Sarrazin, Barbara Hershey, Robert Klein
description: A young man is arrested for a futile reason and ends up in court. His behavior in court, however, is not marked by the austerity that is due to the place, so much so that, once the initial charge has been dropped, proceedings are taken against him for insulting the court. The young man ends up in jail, but it doesn't end there.
notes: Extravagant comedy by Robert Mulligan on a subject considered taboo.

title: Persons Unknown
actors: Joe Mantegna, Kelly Lynch, Naomi Watts, J.T. Walsh, Xander Berkeley
description: After leaving the uniform, a former policeman currently works as a security systems designer. The professional clinical eye, however, has remained so that when he finds himself to be an involuntary witness to a robbery he immediately understands where the criminals who have disappeared with a decent nest egg will go. Set aside all scruples, the former policeman takes possession of the loot, convinced that he has made a good shot. However, two corpses remained on the scene of the robbery and, what is worse, the money belonged to a big drug trafficker ... Bel noir released only on TV, with a strong tension and very human characters.

title: Shout!
actors: John Travolta, Linda Fiorentino, James Walters, Heather Graham
description: A fugitive, actively pursued by the American police, is hired as a music teacher at a rowdy school in Texas. The beauty is that we take so much pleasure in the new job to the point that ...
notes: The film directed by Jeffrey Hornaday the choreographer of "Flashdance", here in his debut, is far below the best expectations.

title: Night Must Fall
actors: Robert Montgomery, Rosalind Russell, Dame May Whitty
description: Mrs. Chalbrook, a wealthy old lady and, as in most cases, a shrew, spends her days in a mansion in the woods with two women who serve her and her niece Olivia. One of the two girls is called Dora and is seduced by Danny, a bellboy in a large hotel, but, in reality, a little good. Despite everything Dora begs her mistress to persuade Danny to marry her. Passed to the service of Mrs. Chalbrook, Danny, by dint of kindness, manages to win her benevolence. In Olivia's soul, however, Danny arouses a mixture of love and hate.
notes: Richard Thorpe directs his best film, a drama with good doses of terror, based on a play by Emlyn Williams. In 1964 Karel Reisz signed the remake entitled "The Double Life of Dan Craig".

title: The Long Kiss Goodnight
actors: Geena Davis, Samuel L. Jackson, Brian Cox
description: Athletics Charly lives quietly in a village where Christmas is upon us, trying to remember a past with long shadows. The woman, in fact, does not remember anything of her years spent dangerously in the employ of the American secret services. Which, among other things, think it is definitely dead and buried. But a local television resumes his parade in the role of Santa Claus, while a thief is on his trail for quite different reasons.
notes: Better late than never: one of the best action movies of recent times comes to us a year late. Harlin, who in the meantime has separated from Geena Davis, knows exactly where to position the camera and knows the rhythms and cadences of the action movie. Davis shows up in great shape.

title: The Devil's Advocate
actors: Al Pacino, Keanu Reeves, Charlize Theron
description: At the end of the second millennium, the devil is still healthy, he loves attending the courtrooms and does not hesitate to reenact the life of Faust. Mephistopheles is John Milton, boss of the most important forensic firm in New York, while the role of Faust belongs to Kevin Lomax, a young and promising provincial lawyer. Preceded by a solid reputation as a winner, Lomax is called to New York by Milton, soon reaching a prominent position in the studio.
notes: It is a very earthly demon, that of immoderate ambition, of the materialism of vanity, played by an adorably over the top Al Pacino and supported by Keanu Reeves and Charlize Theron who revive the cinematic glories of the provincial couple (John Cassavetes / Mia Farrow) of "Rosemary's Baby".

title: La frontiera
actors: Raoul Bova, Marco Leonardi, Omero Antonutti, Vesna Tominac
description: 1916: Emidio Orlich, a young officer of the Austro-Hungarian army of Dalmatian origin, after a dramatic crisis of conscience decides to desert and join the Italian ranks. He will end up on trial. 1941: Franco Velich, a fascist officer also born in Dalmatia, spends a period of convalescence on the island where he was born, during which he becomes aware of the violence inflicted by Axis troops on the occupied populations.
notes: Giraldi puts Franco Vegliani's novel into images and proposes a reflection on the historical causes of the conflicts in a frontier land. Unfortunately, however, the good intentions remain on paper.

title: La vita è bella
actors: Roberto Benigni, Nicoletta Braschi, Giorgio Cantarini, Giustino Durano
description: Goldsmith Guido, waiter and then bookseller in Italy in the twenties, married a rich teacher, and is Jewish. Just like her old uncle, and like the Goldsmith Giosué, her child. Like all Jews, the three were loaded onto a truck, then onto a train, and taken to a concentration camp. Where Guido, with the courage of a lion, invents a game, so that Giosué does not get scared and, perhaps, manages to survive.
notes: The tone chosen by Benigni becomes a bet equivalent to that of its protagonist: an undertone that makes us guess the horrors without showing them to us. Benigni wins the gamble of the tragicomic, with an elaborate and subtle script, with a long opening littered with disturbing signals. Jury Prize in Cannes and three Oscars: best foreign film, best male interpretation and soundtrack.

title: Roswell
actors: Kyle MacLachlan, Martin Sheen, Dwight Yoakam, Kim Griest, Peter MacNichol
description: In 1947, an unidentified flying object with two extraterrestrials on board fell in a field near the town of Roswell, New Mexico. While the American government tries to hide the truth from the world, an American army officer, Jesse Marcel, tries in every way possible to spread the news. Despite all attempts, the officer has to deal with his superiors willing to cover everything.
notes: Kopit wrote and scripted this intriguing television movie inspired by the painstaking book published in 1991 entitled "Ufo Crash at Roswell". Designed for cable television.

title: Histoire milosne
actors: Jerzy Stuhr, Katarzyna Figura, Dominika Ostalowska, Irina Alfiorowa
description: Film in four episodes. In the first Ewa falls in love with her professor and offers him her love. Embarrassed, the man refuses and ends up causing the girl's expulsion from the University. In the second, a priest discovers that he has a teenage daughter, Magda, who desperately needs him. In the third story, a colonel who lives with his wife even though their marriage is over, receives a visit from Tamara, a Russian who had been his great love. In the last episode, a prisoner and his woman accuse each other of serious crimes, blackmail each other, but understand that they love each other.
notes: Dedicated to Kieslowski, it takes up his spirit, narrative coherence, morality: almost a small "Decalogue". Stuhr plays the protagonists (plus one) of the four intertwined stories and outlines a different psychology just by changing clothes. Refined, fun, intelligent.

title: Wilde
actors: Stephen Fry, Jude Law, Vanessa Redgrave, Jennifer Ehle
description: Story of the brief tumultuous, provocative, eccentric, inimitable life of Oscar Wilde, poet and playwright and, above all, esthete and free spirit. Adopted by good London society, he ended up undergoing a sensational trial that publicly revealed his homosexuality, considered not only reprehensible, but also illegal. After a trial, Wilde ended up in forced labor at Reading Jail.
notes: Counterpointed with the sad tale of the Selfish Giant, the life of Oscar Wilde unfolds, a magnificent Irishman who in the last decades of the last century had all the good London society at first at his feet and then totally hostile.

title: Auguri professore
actors: Silvio Orlando, Claudia Pandolfi, Duilio Del Prete, Flavio Pistilli
description: We are in the "Luciano Bianciardi" technical institute (on the Tiburtina in Rome), and Professor Lipari is in an existential crisis. Over the years he has lost faith in himself and in the possibility of changing the world and is just trying to survive. In the Lipari school he meets a former pupil of his, who has now become a colleague, who constantly reproaches him for this attitude. Between the impossible love for her, the memory of the authoritarian childhood school with the game of silence and D'Annunzio by heart, the professor faces the teacher's thousands of daily problems with anger and indolence.
notes: Riccardo Milani, former assistant of Monicelli, Luchetti and Moretti, made his directorial debut with an iron script by Rulli and Petraglia. An example of how to make an Italian genre cinema, a second part that is not inferior to the original; and Silvio Orlando really very good.

title: Seven Years in Tibet
actors: Brad Pitt, David Thewlis, Dorjee Tsering, Jamyang Jamtsho Wangchuk
description: The climber Harrer, of pro-Nazi sympathies, in 1939 abandoned his pregnant wife to go to Tibet with the intention of climbing one of the peaks of the Himalayas, but was taken prisoner by the British. After a few years of imprisonment he manages to escape, and climbing the Himalayas he arrives in Tibet. The Dalai Lama wants to meet the blond Austrian, and the two begin a friendship.
notes: Sumptuous and spectacular, Annaud's film gives the curious sensation of an instant movie, made in a hurry to beat a long-awaited colossus (Scorsese's "Kundun"). In fact, even if it is based on Harrer's book, the script seems poor, a succession of barely sketched clichés, uncertain between the shameless Hollywood game and brooding European pretensions. The attention is lost among the beautiful mountain landscapes, the aerial shots (always the same) of the pilgrim caravans, the close-ups of Brad Pitt's blond hair.

title: Volcano
actors: Tommy Lee Jones, Anne Heche, Don Cheadle, Keith David
description: In the middle of Los Angeles an underground volcano suddenly explodes causing destruction and death in Hollywood. Mike Roark (Jones) must coordinate the effort of the firefighters and national guard to prevent the massive lava flow engulfing the city. Helping him is Amy Barnes (Heche), a seismology engineer.
notes: Sure, the special effects are amazing and pyrotechnic, Jones has grit and in a couple of scenes the tension builds. Still, "Vulcan" doesn't work all the way. Probably the fault of a dilated action that lacks real strengths and, certainly, of a script that develops (once again) on the slender physiognomies and on the repetitive rhythms typical of the show.

title: Inferno
actors: Robert Ryan, Rhonda Fleming, William Lundigan, Henry Hull
description: Millionaire Donald Carson travels with his wife and mutual friend John Duncan to a mountainous and desert region to examine metalliferous terrain that the man intends to exploit. When he is about to start his return journey, Carson suffers a terrible accident that makes him paralyzed. The wife continues the journey with Duncan and promises her husband to return to pick him up with a plane. But the woman, who is Duncan's lover, agrees with him to eliminate her husband. But not everything goes according to plan ...
notes: Modest thriller, it was 20th Century Fox's first 3D film. In 1973 Lee H. Hatzin made a remake for television, unreleased in Italy.

title: The Best Things in Life Are Free
actors: Gordon MacRae, Dan Dailey, Ernest Borgnine, Sheree North
description: Ray Henderson decides to go to Atlantic City to find his sister-in-law Kitty Kane who is about to go on stage as a showgirl in a magazine. Finding himself on stage, Ray has the opportunity to play some of his songs. In the audience there are two successful composers. The two are so impressed by Ray's songs that they propose to the author to collaborate with them.
notes: Some pieces of music are noteworthy, but the story is predictable.

title: Shy People
actors: Barbara Hershey, Jill Clayburgh, Martha Plimpton, Merrit Butrick
description: A photographer from Manhattan (Clayburgh) goes to the swamps of Louisiana to do a shoot. Here she meets a distant relative (Hershey) and is forced to confront her wild world and its secrets. Palme d'Or for the interpretation of Hershey.

title: The Blackout
actors: Matthew Modine, Dennis Hopper, Béatrice Dalle, Claudia Schiffer
description: In the memory of Marty, an international star, there is a hole about an orgy at a friend's eccentric nightclub in Miami. Eighteen months later, in New York, Matty attends anonymous alcoholics, has a new girlfriend and lives quietly: however, the nightmares associated with that night remain obsessive and inexplicable. To solve them, he must return to Miami and force Micky to reveal the truth to him. Which can be worse than the nightmare.
notes: Without the narrative and suggestive perfection of the construction by genres that illuminates his masterpieces, and without the obsessive rigor of the screenwriter Nicolas St. Johns (almost a "co-author"), Ferrara indulges in a sort of merciless excavation of the world and of the craft of cinema. In the film, reality and fiction, memories and nightmares are constantly mixed, canceling any sense of measure and humanity, staggering perceptions and dimensions. And, as happened in "Occhi di serpente", here too Ferrara indulges a little to a "desire for an author", almost as if he had to use formal charms to prove that he is a "serious" filmmaker.

title: Y'aura-t-il de la neige à Noël?
actors: Dominique Reymond, Daniel Duval, Jessica Martinez, Alexandre Roger
description: In a farmhouse in the south of France lives a woman who lovingly dedicates her life to a narrow and violent man and to the seven children born of this relationship. But the man is married; therefore she lives in the shadows and the children in fear. But a wonderful Christmas event helps to redeem them from that miserable reality.
notes: It is an ancient flavor that leaves the vision of Sandrine Veysset's first work, and that recalls that of fairy tales. And after all, the film is nothing more than a tale of the end of the millennium, with its ogre, its fairy, the magical event and the bitter aftertaste present in every self-respecting fairy tale. A story marked by the alternation of the seasons and the duties that the earth imposes, conducted with a happy hand by the newcomer Veysset who never allows his characters to lapse into patheticism.

title: Tre uomini e una gamba
directors: Aldo Baglio, Giovanni Storti, Massimo Venier
actors: Aldo Baglio, Giovanni Storti, Giacomo Poretti, Marina Massironi, Carlo Croccolo
description: Aldo and Giovanni, married to two sisters, daughters of the owner of a hardware store, "Il paradiso della brugola", decide to accompany their brother Giacomo, self-styled intellectual of the group, to Puglia, who is to marry their third sister. To accompany them on the journey there is an artistic object, a wooden leg, destined for the terrible father-in-law and which will acquire value only in the event of the sculptor's death.
notes: Three are enough to make a couple, they used to say in an old American film. For the debut on the big screen, Aldo, Giovanni and Giacomo instead ask the "foreigner of the cup" Massimo Venier for comfort and lean on the "leg" Marina Massironi. We laugh, also because many gags are those of their classic theatrical repertoire.

title: Walker, Texas Ranger: One Riot, One Ranger
actors: Chuck Norris, Clarence Gilyard, Floyd 'Red Crow' Westerman
description: Cordell Walker, the son of a Cherokee Indian and a white woman and raised by his maternal uncle Ray, is the most famous ranger in the entire state of Texas. Always ready to help everyone, he proves tenacious and ruthless with the criminals. When Mobley, a colleague of Walker's, is killed in an attempt to foil a robbery, the ranger vows to avenge his friend's death.
notes: Pilot of the television series _Walker, Texas Ranger_ is a real treat for the assiduous viewers of the show, but, unfortunately, for the others there is little to have fun.

title: The Sun, the Moon and the Stars
actors: Angie Dickinson, Elaine Cassidy, Jason Donovan, Gina Moxley
description: Monica O'Brien, a woman separated from her husband and with two daughters, leaves for the longed-for vacation embittered for various reasons. First of all, she lost her job in the bank, her ex-husband, despite everything, does not stop bothering her and, finally, Shelley, the eldest daughter, has a bad relationship with her. Monica, who also has a bad temper, is passionate about magic and believes in witches. During the holiday Monica meets and makes friends with Abbie, a former actress who has decided to devote herself to oyster farming. But their relationship is thwarted by Shelley, who has joined her mother in the meantime.

title: Belli e brutti ridono tutti
actors: Walter Chiari, Luciano Salce, Olga Karlatos, Cochi Ponzoni
description: An adulterous husband receives a nasty surprise, an industrialist in love is blackmailed by a waiter, a betrayed wife decides to take revenge and a dishonest notary takes advantage of the rich widow of a noble.
notes: Low-level goliardic comedy for four episodes that are nothing more than long jokes.

title: My Best Friend's Wedding
actors: Julia Roberts, Cameron Diaz, Rupert Everett, Dermot Mulroney
description: Julienne and Michael are childhood friends, but when he calls her and announces his imminent marriage to a charming young heiress Kimmy, Julienne discovers she is terribly jealous and more seriously terribly in love. What do you have left to do? Of course groped to mess up the wedding with the complicity of a gay friend.
notes: Julia Roberts is back in "Pretty Woman Zone", in that corner of romantic cinema relaunched by "Four Weddings and a Funeral". Sophisticated comedy that Australian P.J. Hogan dusts off with skill and a pinch of cynicism subtracted from the previous "The wedding of Muriel". Also thanks to a self-deprecating Rupert Everett.

title: A spasso nel tempo - L'avventura continua
actors: Massimo Boldi, Christian De Sica, Marco Messeri, Mariangela D'Abbraccio
description: Prince Ascanio Colonna and the merchant Walter Colombo are thrown into the world of comics and have to deal with the prehistoric world of the Flintstones. They end up once again in the Florence of the fifteenth century face to face with Lorenzo the Magnificent, in the Las Vegas of the sixties, in the wild West, in the wild Scotland of Braveheart and in the Sorrento of "Pane, amore e ...".
notes: It is likely that not a little material from this second chapter of "A Spasso nel tempo" comes from waste material from the first. Pure barracks joke that makes the verse to the "Reckless Life" of Vasco Rossi, to the Ambrose of the famous peckish, to Wyatt Earp and the Flintstones. There are a couple of enjoyable moments: De Sica junior who pays homage to father Vittorio with a re-enactment of "Bread, love and ..."; and Boldi who takes back the drummer's sticks to replace Ringo Starr and play with the Beatles. For those who are satisfied ...

title: Tess
actors: Nastassja Kinski, Peter Firth, Leigh Lawson, John Collin, Tony Church
description: A poor nineteenth-century English girl discovers that she is descended from a noble family. However, her transition to the upper middle class is not painless and ends with an extramarital pregnancy. According to the morality of the time, there is no longer a place for her, neither among the bourgeois nor among the proletarians. His misadventures, however, are only at the beginning.
notes: In adapting Thomas Hardy's masterpiece "Tess dei d'Urbevilles", Polanski manages to reconcile his ability as an illustrator (and landscape painter!) With sanguine moments and a sincere adherence to the text. Oscar in photography, costumes and set design.

title: Tomorrow Never Dies
actors: Pierce Brosnan, Jonathan Pryce, Michelle Yeoh, Teri Hatcher
description: The agent in the service of Her British Majesty this time has to contend with Elliot Carver, ruthless owner of communications satellites and of the daily Tomorrow which rolls one hundred million copies. His intention is to manipulate events and, in order to film it with his televisions, he does everything to trigger the Third World War. James Bond tries everything to try to foil Carver's dark plots. Action and gadgets, with a partner who comes from martial arts cinema (the excellent Michelle Yeoh). Directed by Spottiswoode supported.

title: Hercules
description: Hercules, half man and half god, is kidnapped by the evil Hades and sent from Olympus to Earth to prove to the other gods that he has the right to stay with the other deities. He will have to face the usual twelve tests (including descent into the Underworld) and will understand firsthand how difficult it is to live with his humanity and that part of immortality that is in him. In his rehearsals he is helped by Pegasus, the winged horse and seduced by Megara, fatalona on duty, called Meg.
notes: A kind of musical initiation comedy, where Disney makes fun of itself (the round forest animals into which the two mischievous devils in the service of Hades are transformed) and the American myth of success (Athens like New York and all the merchandising that is unleashed around the hero, from sandals, to drinks, to caps). Less "black" than the _Hunchback of Notre Dame_, however _Hercules_ manages to overwhelm with his vitality, his spirit, the music that mixes blues, gospel, rock and disco and with the angular cut of the figures, taken in weight by the geometric compositions of the Greek tableware.

title: The Assignment
actors: Aidan Quinn, Donald Sutherland, Ben Kingsley, Claudia Ferri, Liliana Komorowska
description: Annibal Ramirez, a US naval officer, is arrested in Jerusalem by the Mossad, the Israeli secret service, because he is extraordinarily similar to the terrorist Carlos, nicknamed "the jackal". Hannibal is thus forced by the CIA and Mossad to play the part of the terrorist to make the Russians believe that "the jackal" is the protagonist of a double game.
notes: Within a planetary set, Christian Duguay stages a spy story with good rhythm and a fair amount of showmanship and which finds Donald Sutherland and Ben Kinsley (who play the leaders of the CIA and Mossad) in good shape. If a note can be moved to the film, it is that of not having had the courage to move away a little from the news and from the action, to better develop the complex exchange of personalities between the terrorist and the officer (both played by Aidan Quinn) and conflicts that affect the life of the latter.

title: Fever Pitch
actors: Colin Firth, Ruth Gemmell, Stephen Rea, Mark Strong, Lorraine Ashbourne
description: Paul, a quiet professor of literature in a school, is torn between his passion for Arsenal and his passion for cold Sarah. His passion for the London team (which in that year is experiencing a heart-pounding end of the championship) ends up tarnishing his relations with women, including Sarah.
notes: Nick Hornby is a remarkable writer, excited, with a bitter humor, very good at telling the affective disasters and disasters of our days. Unfortunately, little of his tension, frustration and irony reaches the screen in _Febbre a 90º_, which seems like a homework in the line of the reborn British realism, correct but televised. Colin Firth, with his chard air, works. But comedy devours obsession.

title: Le cadeau
actors: Pierre Mondy, Claudia Cardinale, Clio Goldsmith, Renzo Montagnani, Jacques François
description: A poor banker, Grégoire, frustrated by the routine of the workplace, seizes the early retirement opportunity offered by the bank. With the money received he decides to go on a trip and thus give a shock to his gray life. Unbeknownst to him, his work friends give him a surprising gift: they find a call girl, Barbara, who accompanies him on his trip to Venice.
notes: Funny French comedy based on the comedy "Even bankers have a soul" by Terzoli and Vaime.

title: I Know Where I'm Going
actors: Wendy Hiller, Roger Livesey, George Carney, Pamela Brown
description: A 25-year-old, Joan Webster, who has never had any hesitation in her life, ends up getting really angry when bad weather prevents her from reaching an island in the Hebridean archipelago. On that island the girl should get married to an elderly and above all rich industrialist just, not for her. It is no coincidence that during this stop the girl meets the charming Torquil.
notes: Powell and Pressbuger transform the thin story into a veritable demonstration of predestination. Pay attention to the opening credits and the sequence of the protagonist's dream.

title: Rappresaglia
actors: Richard Burton, Marcello Mastroianni, Leo McKern, Renzo Montagnani
description: In March 1944, Rome is under the dominion of the Germans and controlled by the merciless SS. While attempts are made to save the artistic heritage threatened by the Nazis, an attack on a company of the SS is being organized. The plan goes well. and in via Rasella about thirty German soldiers remain on the ground. Commander Maelzer, after informing his superiors, is ordered to retaliate. Ten Italians will have to be killed for every dead German. General Kappler is put in charge of the execution.
notes: The massacre of the Fosse Ardeatine is reconstructed starting from the book "Death in Rome" by Robert Katz, co-writer of the film. But despite the stellar cast, the operation is coarse and sensational.

title: The Crooked Way
actors: John Payne, Ellen Drew, Sonny Tufts, Rhys Williams
description: A soldier who distinguished himself on the battlefields lost his memory due to a shrapnel that got stuck in his head. All we know about him is that his name is Edgar and that he is from Los Angeles. After several attempts to make him remember something, the doctors at the military hospital advise him to go to Los Angeles where they hope he can find himself. In California Edgar is approached by a woman for whom he is Edgar Ronald, an affiliate of the underworld.
notes: A sense of oppression and paranoia dominates the film which is a good example of B-grade cinema.

title: Fatal Deception: Mrs Lee Harvey Oswald
actors: Helena Bonham Carter, Robert Picardo, Frank Whaley
description: Marina Harvey Oswald recalls for a writer some episodes that are behind the scenes of the assassination of President Kennedy, which took place in 1963. Marina tells the life of her husband: how she met him, how she lived for years next to a man of a thousand faces . The political choices and events that dot the life of Lee Oswald, the man accused of the crime and in turn killed before the trial, have never been clear to her or, much less, to the various investigators who have dealt with the case. because it is suspected that more than one person fired. Perhaps Oswald was just a scapegoat destined to cover very large responsibilities. Marina talks about her anxieties, fears and difficulties, for her and her daughters, due to that surname that has become too cumbersome.

title: The Ultimate Lie
actors: Blair Brown, Kristin Davis, Michael Murphy, George Eads
description: Portrait of an American family in a bourgeois interior. Father, mother and two children. He is an esteemed lawyer, his wife, a former lawyer, has left the profession to devote herself entirely to home and children: a young man, a university law student, and a girl, the rebel of the family. Such bourgeois respectability, however, hides small secrets and great perversions. The apparently upright father is in fact used to frequent high-class ringers. To find out is his daughter, who ...
notes: Predictable and predictable, it is one of the many TV movies of the lowest league smuggled by Italian broadcasters under the pretext of parlor chatter (such as "Donne al bivio" or "Verissimo").

title: Awake to Danger
actors: Tori Spelling, Michael Gross, John Getz, Reed Diamond
description: In the night following her 18th birthday, Aimee Mc Adams discovers that her mother has been murdered. In the meantime, the girl is attacked by the same mysterious murder that makes her fall down the stairs thus causing her to go into a coma. Two years pass and Aimee, returned to a normal life, has to face the reality of a father dominated by severe depression. It is precisely then that Aimee is haunted by strange nightmares and as many strange and threatening assaults. All he can do is try to remember what really happened that awful night. Piece by piece the truth will finally come out.

title: Se io fossi onesto
actors: Vittorio De Sica, Paolo Stoppa, Sergio Tofano, Maria Mercader
description: The grandson of a rich and noble gentleman was sentenced to three months in prison for putting a false signature on a check. At the time of serving his sentence, the man decides to be replaced by a poor man who in exchange for a few lira agrees to go to jail. After serving his sentence, the latter is welcomed by the uncle of the gentleman who truly believes him to be his nephew.
notes: Given today the comedy by Carlo Ludovico Bragaglia, who passed away in 1997 at the age of 103, it is a bit too obvious. But De Sica young actor (here with his lady) is always nice.

title: Cromwell
actors: Richard Harris, Alec Guinness, Robert Morley, Timothy Dalton
description: In 1642, King Charles I Stuart was militarily occupying the English parliament which refused him the granting of funds necessary for the war against Scotland. It is the classic spark that ignites the civil war that sees, on one side the army loyal to the king and the one hastily set up by the supporters of the parliament. After the uncertain outcome of the first clashes, the parliamentary army, led by Commander Oliver Cromwell defeats the troops of Charles I.
notes: Pedantic and boring historical film, with unnecessarily accurate reconstructions (Oscar to the sets by Vittorio Nino Novarese), trombone music and actors forced to declaim monumental dialogues.

title: Presentimento
actors: Gino Latilla, Rosario Borelli, Rita Rubirosa, Carlo Giuffrè
description: Massimo, engaged to the daughter of the Marquise De Angelis, falls in love with Mariella, a teacher who belongs to a modest family and who proves to reciprocate his love. The marquise, informed of the relationship that Massimo has with the girl, induces him to return to Salerno to marry his daughter. From the marriage a little girl is born who is called Mariellina. Seven years pass and Mariella is also transferred to Salerno.Armando Fizzarotti mimics Matarazzo, in a classic example of a third-time movie.

title: The Winter Guest
actors: Emma Thompson, Phyllida Law, Gary Hollywood, Arlene Cockburn
description: Winter has arrived in a seaside town in Scotland. Frances is a recently widowed photographer; to keep her company is her elderly mother. Frances lets her 16-year-old son Alex take care of both of them. The boy is struck by Nina, his neighbor who is also one step away from adulthood. Elspeth, Frances's mother, for her part is determined to regain her daughter's trust.
notes: Drowned in the snow of the Scottish winter, blocked by the cold of unexploded feelings and "transit" age (adolescence, youth, old age), Rickman's film relies perhaps too much on the Thompson-Law couple, mother and daughter even in real life , but with actresses like that it's a minor flaw.

title: The One That Got Away
actors: Hardy Krüger, Colin Gordon, Alec McCowen, Terry Alexander
description: During the Second World War, the German aviator officer Von Werra, during a mission in the skies of England, is forced to make a crash landing and is taken prisoner. Subjected to repeated interrogations, he maintains an attitude of defiance and superiority in front of the British military. The officer boldly bets with an equal English rank to be able to escape from the prison camp within six months.
notes: Roy Ward Baker reverses the classic theme of escaping a prison camp, this time the Nazi officer has to escape. Discreet direction based on the true story of Von Werra.

title: Copper Mountain
actors: Jim Carrey, Jean-Claude Killy
description: Snow adventures involving Jim Carrey, future Ace Ventura, and Jean-Claude Killy, a French skier who was the only one to win three gold medals in the three alpine skiing specialties during the 1968 Grenoble Winter Olympics.

title: Twilight for the Gods
actors: Rock Hudson, Cyd Charisse, Arthur Kennedy, Leif Erickson
description: David Bell is the owner of an old vessel that has to sail from Suva to Mexico. The boat, however, is in poor condition, which makes navigation dangerous. Despite everything, Bell welcomes on board some passengers bound for Mexico. Among them is Charlotte who impresses the first officer. Meanwhile, with the passing of the days the conditions of the ship seem more and more serious and Bell is forced to change course heading towards Hawaii.
notes: Adventure film with humorous touches. In the end, the story turns out to be long-winded even though Pevney knows how to skillfully direct his actors. Ernest K. Gann, author of the novel, collaborated on the screenplay.

title: The Secret Invasion
actors: Stewart Granger, Raf Vallone, Mickey Rooney, Edd Byrnes, Henry Silva, Mia Massini
description: During the Second World War, five common inmates, in prison for different crimes, agree to carry out a very dangerous mission. Each of them is a highly skilled specialist in their respective "criminal" field of expertise. In exchange for their professional performance they will receive freedom. The task is very delicate, the fate of the war could depend on its outcome. The plan, studied by the British counter-intelligence, provides for the release of the commander of the Italian occupation forces, imprisoned by the Nazis in the Croatian prison of Dubrovnik.
notes: Classic Corman: low cost, fast-paced action, narrative effectiveness, great cast.

title: Il deserto dei tartari
actors: Jacques Perrin, Vittorio Gassman, Philippe Noiret, Francisco Rabal
description: A young officer, Lieutenant Drogo, is sent to serve in a fortress on the edge of the desert. Here he waits, together with his companions, to be able to measure himself against the enemies, the Tartars. But the days go by without anything happening. Meanwhile, the lieutenant sees his dreams of glory shattered: he falls seriously ill without being able to fight.
notes: Adaptation of the successful novel by Dino Buzzati. Directed by Valerio Zurlini in 1976, long and almost "painful", it is a film that may lack didacticism, but it is also intense and fascinating.

title: The Snapper
actors: Tina Kellegher, Colm Meaney, Ruth McCabe, Colm O'Byrne
description: In Barrytown, in the Catholic and somewhat odd family of the Irish painter Dessie Curley, everything is proceeding as usual, that is, in a somewhat confusing way. To keep a minimum of domestic order is the wife Kay who, in order to govern properly the six children and the same husband, must do everything. The substantial cheerfulness and noisy warmth that reigns in the house are undermined by a revelation: the eldest daughter Sharon, unmarried, is expecting a brat ("snapper" in jargon) and does not want to reveal her father's name to anyone.
notes: The first of two films from Roddy Doyle's "Barrytown Trilogy" directed by Stephen Frears on a very happy Hollywood budget "vacation". Brilliant dialogue, rhythm, direction. Great Colm Meaney.

title: No Greater Love
actors: Simon MacCorkindale, Chris Sarandon, Kelly Rutheford, Nicholas Campbell
description: In the spring of 1912, during the maiden voyage, the famous Titanic, the jewel of Great Britain's civil naval technology, sank. In the tragic sinking of the ocean liner, Edwina's parents and fiancé perish, who is saved by a miracle. Back in Boston, the girl overcomes her despair by dedicating her life to her younger siblings who have been orphaned. She then meets a married man, who helps her rebuild her life, and then a wealthy film producer who offers her love and serenity. The Titanioc is in the background, in this boring television comic coeval with Cameron's film.

title: Men of Respect
actors: John Turturro, Katherine Borowitz, Dennis Farina, Peter Boyle, Stanley Tucci, Rod Steiger
description: IN a shootout, some bigwigs of Cosa Nostra are killed by a group of boys led by Charlie D'Amico under the orders of the boss Mike Battaglia. The tough and stalwart young leader is rewarded with initiation as a "man of honor" and promoted to "regime leader". Ruthie Battaglia, wife of the godfather, is very amnbitious. Her husband's success is never enough for her.
notes: The Shakespearean "Macbeth" in a modern and mafia style, with good actors and faces cut with a hatchet. Not as black and obsessed as he could have been, he risks being less modern than Polanski's "Macbeth".

title: Adrenalin
actors: Til Shweiger, Geno Lechner, Ralph Herforth
description: A policeman from the counter-terrorism squad is arrested. The man avenged his wife's death by killing her killer. Due to the arrest, the policeman also loses the protection of his daughter, the person to whom he feels most attached. After serving his sentence and once the man is released, who hoped to be reunited with his daughter, he experiences another drama: he begins to receive a series of mysterious phone calls that prelude to the kidnapping of the girl. The policeman is thus forced to get back on track with the searches ...
notes: There are no words to define this film.

title: The Horsemen
actors: Omar Sharif, Leigh Taylor-Young, Jack Palance, Peter Jeffrey
description: The best horsemen of Afghanistan arrive in Kabul to take part in the "Royal Burkask", a traditional competition that consists of fighting, on horseback and armed with a whip, the carcass of a kid. Take part in the race Uraz, son of the chieftain Tursen, determined to emulate the exploits of his father, multiple winner of the competition. But the young man falls badly and breaks his leg. To redeem himself in the eyes of his father, Uraz decides to return to his tribe through a rough road. Based on a screenplay by Dalton Trumbo, it is a curious hard and melancholy adventure film, very 70s.

title: Triumph of the Spirit
actors: Willem Dafoe, Robert Loggia, Edward James Olmos, Wendy Gazelle
description: A Jewish boxer is deported to Auschwitz with his entire family. To survive he agrees to fight for the amusement of the German officers in desperate encounters in which the loser is killed.
notes: Eidelman's soundtrack is good and Willem Dafoe's interpretation is also good.

title: Pushover
actors: Fred MacMurray, Kim Novak, Phil Carey, Dorothy Malone
description: Two bandits rob a bank, but in the course of the robbery an agent is killed. The police, having discovered that one of the kidnappers is Willers, have his girlfriend, Lone, followed. The task is entrusted to Paul, an agent who ends up being charmed by the beautiful blonde. She takes the opportunity to induce Paul to kill Willers in order to get hold of the booty, but ...
notes: A good cast for a film that, years later, would inspire Badham's "Special Watch".

title: Trust
actors: Adrienne Shelly, Martin Donovan, Merritt Nelson, Edie Falco
description: Seventeen-year-old Maria suddenly declares in her family that she has become pregnant and gets a loud slap from her father. The girl does not think twice and returns it, but this causes the death of her father from a heart attack. Her mother can do nothing but throw her out of the house, especially since Maria is not even sure that the parent of the unborn child is her "official" boyfriend: a young rugby player. Hartley's weird minimalism has its own writing grace in this film, and the interlacing game works perfectly.

title: La caza
actors: Ismael Merlo, Alfredo Mayo, José Maria Prada, Emilio Gutierrez
description: For a group of former Spanish civil war fighters, a quiet day of rabbit hunting turns into a sort of tight surrender of existential and political accounts.
notes: Obvious Buñuelian influences in this film by Saura, which marked the rebirth of Spanish cinema and which won the Silver Bear at the Berlin Film Festival.

title: The Killing of a Chinese Bookie
actors: Ben Gazzara, Timothy Carey, Seymour Cassel, Robert Philips
description: Cosmo Vitelli, founder, director and, consequently, owner of the "Crazy Horse West", is happy because he has finished paying the last installment to the loan sharks who have lent him the money to make his dream come true. Accompanied by three of his girls, he goes to a gambling house where, during an unfortunate game, he loses $ 23,000. The man is convinced that he will be able to pay the debt with the income of the club. But Cosmo doesn't know he ended up in the hands of a gang headed by boss John ...
notes: Based on a detective story, Cassavetes plays to deconstruct cinema with image slowdowns, grains and hand shots in the purest "informal" style.

title: Last of the Comanches
actors: Broderick Crawford, Barbara Hale, Lloyd Bridges, Martin Milner
description: A squadron of cavalry is attacked and almost completely destroyed by the Black Cloud Indians. The only survivors are Sergeant Trainer and six soldiers. The only way of salvation is the one that leads to the nearest fort. To reach it, however, one has to travel, by forced march, a hundred miles of desert.
notes: De Toth shoots a tired and frayed western inspired by Zoltan Korda's "Sahara".

title: The Ambassador's Daughter
actors: Olivia de Havilland, John Forsyte, Myrna Loy, Adolphe Menjou
description: Immediately after the war, Europe is teeming with American troops. The commanding general of the U.S. Army wants to ban the city of Paris to soldiers with stars and stripes for fear of unpleasant consequences given the freedom of customs of the "Ville Lumière". The daughter of the American ambassador tries to oppose the project, but when two handsome G-Men, mistaking her for a common model, begin to court her, she agrees to play along to see if the general is right or not.
notes: The narrative pretext is rather unusual; very conventional development. The great cast works.

title: Yaneura no samposha
actors: Attori non professionisti
description: GODA has a particular vice. Striscia under the roofs and like a voyeur spies on women from the floors. When he meets a exhibitionist nymphomaniac, the classic love at first sight starts. The morbid relationship between the two will even lead them to the murder.
notes: The film is inspired by a story by Edogawa Ranpo and has the same setting as the cult-musovie "The Empire of the senses". Also known with the title "The man who walked on the floors".

title: Border Shootout/Law at Randado
actors: Michael Ansara, Glenn Ford, Cody Glenn, Charlene Tilton
description: John Danaher, a sheriff in a small town in Arizona, is now of a certain age and not very popular with his fellow citizens. One day his superiors entrust him with a delicate task: to transfer a dangerous criminal to a federal prison. John reluctantly leaves the command in the hands of his deputy, Kirby Frye. Convinced that sincerity is a good policy, the sheriff is not well equipped to deal with the gangs of cattle robbers who find themselves in the path.
notes: McIntyre directs a western at best, taking advantage of the fame of the now elderly Glenn Ford, here at his latest interpretation. Also in the cast Charlene Tilton, one of the protagonists of the soap opera "Dallas".

title: Runaway Car
actors: Judge Reinhold, Nina Stemaszko, Brian Hooks
description: Ed, Jenny and a black guy who was about to be hit by Jenny's car find themselves together in the same car along America's great "Freeways". However, it happens that the car begins to give some problems: first the accelerator pedal stops when it is at full speed then, immediately after, the brakes fail. What's more, the petrol tank is overflowing. Thus begins a mad race along the most diverse roads followed live by a radio and television station and a brave policeman who tries in every way to save the boys and prevent the crazy car from causing any accidents.

title: Marius et Jeannette
actors: Ariane Ascaride, Gérard Meylan, Pascale Roberts
description: A district of Marseille, l'Estaque, where a small port has grown around the factories of the beginning of the century and, within this, a courtyard where a small neighborhood exchanges affection, irony and solidarity in unhappy moments. Jeannette, a cashier, alone with two children, lives in the familiar safety of the courtyard; Marius, a big, big proletarian always tucked into his red overalls, lives instead in the huge disused factory of which he is the guardian. They meet, like each other, both a little grumpy and stubborn collide, until they can trust each other.
notes: Solar film, warm, "tasty" like the environment it describes.

title: The Serpent Kiss
actors: Ewan McGregor, Pete Postlethwaite, Richard E. Grant, Greta Scacchi
description: At the end of the 17th century, in England, a wealthy landowner commissioned a young designer to create a garden that honors the beauty of his sensual, worldly and bored wife. The gardener begins his work, amid the ambiguities and tensions of the family, also made up of the couple's rebellious daughter, an intriguing doctor and a penniless cousin. Mysteries, intrigues and, perhaps, a murder.
notes: Put a draftsman in the gardener's place and you'll get Greenaway's "Mysteries of Compton House Garden". "The kiss of the snake" is in fact a calligraphic transcription (Rousselot is director of photography) of that film.

title: In & Out
actors: Kevin Kline, Tom Selleck, Joan Cusack, Debbie Reynolds, Glenn Close
description: Actor Cameron Drake, while he is receiving the Academy Award, thinks of thanking a former teacher of his and, in the speech, he does not hesitate to allude to the teacher's homosexuality. Nothing serious except that the imminent marriage that the professor is about to celebrate with a colleague is awaited by his mother (in abstinence from a wedding march) with impatience.
notes: Frank Oz (creator of the Muppets with Jim Henson and then director of various comedies) does the assumption in a comedy tone "a la Jack Lemmon" (to which Kevin Kline seems to resemble more and more, physically and in skill). Perfect actors, but not always helped by the script. Already "cult" the scene in which Kline, to prove he is a macho, must refrain from dancing "I Will Survive".

title: Titanic
actors: Kate Winslet, Leonardo DiCaprio, Billy Zane, Kathy Bates, Gloria Stuart, Frances Fisher, Bill Paxton, Danny Nucci, Victor Garber, Bernard Hill
description: A crew tries to recover a diamond from the wreck of the Titanic, and goes to the only survivor. Flashback. Rose is a young aristocrat who travels in the first class of the Titanic, while Jack is a handsome, penniless painter who sails crammed into third class. The two will no longer be able to leave and challenge social conventions to the last. Meanwhile the Titanic sinks.
notes: Blue and red mark a heartfelt and majestic film that reaches the spirit (of time, of people, of ambitions) through an unbridled love for physicality. Cameron has a rightfully mythical sense of tragedy and a deeply human sense of his times. The last 90 minutes are built with a magnificent, underground surge of tension. The love story that acts as a leitmotif (the most fragile link in the film) reflects the social and human tensions that were the background to the tragedy. And Kate Winslet's character dominates, dubious, sensual and absolute protagonist.

title: Viola bacia tutti
actors: Asia Argento, Massimo Ceccherini, Valerio Mastandrea, Rocco Papaleo
description: Three friends, Max, Nicola and Samuele take a camper and set off on a road trip in search of sex and laughter. But they meet Viola, a young robber chased by the police who manages to sneak into their vehicle.
notes: Conceived while he was writing "Fireworks", launched as a film a la Pieraccioni to enhance the presence of Ceccherini, "Viola kisses all" collapses on itself right from the start precisely because it wants to be the most cultured and refined version of the phenomenon. Pieraccioni. Wasted the actors, especially Asia Argento. The film doesn't make you laugh, it doesn't even make you cry: it's just disheartening, opinionated, stretched.

title: Event Horizon
actors: Laurence Fishburne, Sam Neill, Kathleen Quinlan, Joely Richardson
description: The "Event Horizon" spaceship, which functions like a black hole, generating a powerful space-time deformation with its propeller, disappears during the maiden voyage, only to reappear seven years later near Neptune. However, there is no longer any sign of life, and the crew of the "Lewis & Clark" must investigate what happened in there. The spaceship, in its journey through the dark side of the universe, has become an organism capable of materializing the most atrocious fears and nightmares.
notes: A story that plays with dèjà vu themes and atmospheres from "The Shining" and "Alien" (in addition to the "Forbidden Planet" and "Solaris"), and when it fails to keep up the suspense, Richard's masterful visual effects come to the rescue. Yuricich.

title: Io uccido, tu uccidi
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Margaret Lee, Tomas Milian
description: Episode movies. Alfio and Turiddu, after killing their respective wives, decide to leave for Paris and there they start a new life. To hasten the death of his rich uncle, the nephew hires a girl of easy virtue. A mature teacher who is in love with a boy accused of murder gets killed by the real killer. Forced to abstain from tobacco for health reasons, an inveterate smoker endures the tyrannical surveillance of his brother-in-law, until ... Comedy scollacciata. The episode of the killer children is curious.

title: Le jouet
actors: Pierre Richard, Michel Bouquet, Fabrice Gréco, Suzy Dyson
description: François Perrin, a journalist looking for a long-time permanent job and professional achievement, is sent for a report at a toy department store. As he wanders around the place looking for ideas for his article, he is noticed by Eric, the capricious son of Pierre, the billionaire who owns the weekly that François works for. The brat demands the journalist as a personal gift, who is then packed and sent to the family villa.
notes: Remade in 1982 with the title of "Toy by the hour" with Richard Pryor, it is a little comedy based on the comedian Richard.

title: La giacca verde
actors: Jean-Pierre Cassel, Renzo Montagnani, Senta Berger, Vittorio Sanipoli
description: A young and already successful conductor, Walter Salvini, interrupts the rehearsals of Giuseppe Verdi's "Otello" which he is conducting in 1946. The boy recognized the timpanist Romualdi among the orchestras, who had shared with him a refuge in a mountain village. At the time, the timpanist passed for an important conductor and this had allowed the young man to enjoy the graces of a former diva of the regime.
notes: Montagnani has never acted as well as in this film by Giraldi based on the beautiful story of the same name by Mario Soldati.

title: I coltelli del vendicatore
actors: Cameron Mitchell, Fausto Tozzi, Jack Rossi Stuart, Luciano Polletin
description: Arald, at the head of a tribe of Vikings, for three years traveling with his warriors, is struck in the dearest affections (his wife and son) by Aghen, an adventurer of few scruples. His kidnapping attempts are, however, frustrated by Rurik, a mysterious stranger. He is, in reality, the noble prince of a tribe who, years earlier, to avenge the death of his father and wife, had attacked the presumed guilty tribe of Arald.

title: Big Fish
actors: Stuart Townsend, Dan Futterman, Kate Beckinsale, Ralph Ineson
description: Jez and Dylan, one American, the other English, both had a childhood marked by the lack of a home and the desire to redeem themselves from their orphaned condition. This is why they grew up and met each other, thanks to an advertisement, they agree to scam rich people to finally have a stately home. They are aided in their gleefully criminal endeavors by Georgina, who instead is struggling to ensure that a foundation for children with Down syndrome is not closed.
notes: Sparkling first part, where there is also a mockery of Andrew Lloyd Webber's musical comedies, second a bit mushy.

title: An American Werewolf in Paris
actors: Julie Delpy, Tom Everett Scott, Pierre Cosso
description: Andie, a rather clumsy young American student, one day manages to save Serafine, an aspiring suicide who is about to throw herself from the Eiffel Tower. The girl, in reality, is a werewolf who, in addition to falling in love, infects our unfortunate hero with a bite. Andie also comes into contact with a gang of skinhead wolfweres who want to clean up the world and wreak havoc on the Paris subway cars.

title: Spice World
actors: Mel B, Mel C, Geri, Victoria, Emma, Richard E. Grant
description: A bus painted with the Union Jack runs through the streets of London taking the five spiced girls to their concert. The girls have time to argue with reporters who want the scoop and find ways to make a close encounter of the third kind with the aliens.
notes: Everything is intertwined with the plot of a nosy reporter, the misadventures of a troupe that should make a documentary, the appearances of colleagues in the flesh and with the attempt of two directors to make the film (coincidentally!) On them. . But unfortunately the film already exists, rambling and lacking even in terms of music reduced to the bone and which does not even convey the emotions of a video clip.

title: Deadlier than the Male
actors: Richard Johnson, Elke Sommer, Sylva Koscina, Nigel Green
description: An American oilman is traveling on his private plane in the company of two beautiful girls. Sexy evening in sight? No: murder in progress. The two "girls" in fact kill the tycoon, but they don't stop there: in their sights there is in fact another big shot of the same industry. A third body is later found at the end of a stormy business meeting.
notes: The film is clearly built on the seduction of two divas who at the time were at the top of the forbidden dreams of the male people of half the world.

title: Hell Bent for Leather
actors: Audie Murphy, Felicia Farr, Stephen McNally, Robert Middleton
description: Clay Santell, who works as a broker for the sale of livestock, is attacked in the desert by a man who takes away his horse. In the course of the struggle, Clay managed to steal the rifle from his attacker and with it he set out for the town of Sutterville. Here he is mistaken for Trevers, an outlaw actively sought by Deckett, the federal sheriff. He arrests him and intends to subject him to a regular trial. When the two are left alone Deckett confesses to Clay that he knows very well that he is not Trevers, but that he only arrested him to appease the crowd in search of a culprit ...

title: The Pick-up Artist
actors: Robert Downey jr., Molly Ringwald, Dennis Hopper, Danny Aiello, Harvey Keitel, Lorraine Bracco
description: Downey jr. here he plays the part of an inveterate Don Juan perennially on the hunt for gallant adventures. It is logical that for him the woman is only an instrument of pleasure and that he would never bind to someone in a serious and lasting way. When he least expects it, however, he really falls in love with a girl full of many qualities, but with only one major flaw: she is the daughter of a professional player who, for this activity, has filled himself with debts and ended up in the hands. of the underworld.
notes: If the initial idea could also be interesting, the development of the story wastes it badly. Downey jr. who five years later will play "Chaplin", perhaps already remembers the great comedian in the opening scene when he plays with mirrors as Charlot in the famous "Circus" sequence.

title: Il soldato ignoto
actors: Giovanni Guidelli, Angelo Orlando, Aldo Sambrell, Leonardo Treviglio
description: In the autumn of 1943, a group of Allied and Italian soldiers is trapped inside an abandoned villa. But soon all of them realize that they are dead and that the villa is nothing more than the starting point for their entry and subsequent journey into the afterlife. After the initial understandable bewilderment they begin to tell their stories and so they realize that they have died unjustly, sent to slaughter in a useless war. The youngest, whose wife is expecting a baby, is lucky enough to be able to temporarily return to the living to bring a message of peace.

title: Echo
actors: Jack Wagner, Clare Carey, Kin Shriner, Laurie Holden, Alexandra Paul
description: An entire family is decimated in a car accident. Only two children of a few years survive, two twins: Max and Steven. While the former is unharmed, the latter is seriously injured. Thirty years pass. Max is now happily married to Olivia after being raised by uncles Lean and Ruth who, for economic reasons, have instead neglected Steven, in need of very expensive care. The latter, however, has grown up in the meantime, but has become a dangerous psychopath. In the throes of madness, Steven kills his uncles and kidnaps Max with the intent of taking his place. For a while the attempt succeeds, but then Olivia begins to suspect something ...

title: Mother Knows Best
actors: Joanna Kerns, Grant Show, Christine Elise, David Spielberg
description: A wealthy lady, an overly possessive and abusive mother, has always planned her daughter's life in every detail from an early age. Now that her daughter has grown up, the woman takes it upon herself to give her a husband, indeed she finds him ready and ready. Naturally, the girl is careful not to indulge her parent's tales and, indeed, marries a man of modest conditions, arousing the ire of her mother for this. Not even the birth of a child calms the old woman who, feeling more and more excluded from her daughter's life, even goes so far as to commission the murder of her son-in-law ...
notes: Why doesn't the early evening of Monday return, as it once did, to host some good old films of great appeal?

title: Anonimo veneziano
actors: Florinda Bolkan, Tony Musante, Toti Dal Monte, Alessandro Grinfan
description: Enrico, an oboe player of the Phoenix who had always dreamed of becoming an orchestra conductor, knows he is condemned by a terrible disease. Divided by his wife Valeria, who has rebuilt another life in another city, he invites her to Venice. At first the woman is wary of her ex-husband, but soon she changes her mind and finds herself with Enrico wandering around the lagoon city and remembering their love.
notes: The musical theme at the time ended up on everyone's lips. The film is a sort of Italian "Love Story" in which all the most common places of tear-jerking melodrama are inserted.

title: Une dimanche à la campagne
actors: Louis Ducreux, Sabine Azéma, Michel Aumont, Geneviève Mnich
description: Ladmiral, an elderly painter who never achieved stardom, lives, we are in 1912, with a housekeeper in his country house not far from Paris. It's Sunday and their son Gonzague, daughter-in-law and their three children arrive by train. They will spend the whole day with their father, between an excellent lunch and a walk waiting for Irene, the painter's youngest daughter.

title: Le Mans
actors: Steve McQueen, Elga Andersen, Siegfried Rauch, Ronald Leigh-Hunt
description: Michael arrives in Le Mans to participate in the 24 Hours, one of the most treacherous and grueling car races. His desire to compete in a good race is held back by the fact that Belgetti's widow is in the audience, a driver who died the previous year on the same track following an accident in which he was involved. The race begins and Delaney immediately takes the lead, but another accident seems to compromise his race.
notes: More than a drama, it is a documentary on the legendary endurance race (a real plot is missing). McQueen liked it a lot, because it allowed him to drive.

title: The Revengers
actors: William Holden, Ernest Borgnine, Woody Strode, Susan Hayward
description: John Benedict, former captain of the northern army, is determined to avenge the death of his wife and four children killed by Tarp, a ferocious bandit. The outlaw with a group of whites and comaches hides in Pueblo Plata, a ruined city in the mountains of Mexico. To carry out his revenge John with the excuse of offering them a job, he takes from a prison, you are among the most cruel and heinous criminals. The seven men attack Tarp's gang, but Tarp manages to escape.
notes: Daniel Mann wastes an excellent cast with sloppy directing. With this film Susan Hayward bids farewell to the scenes.

title: Aniki-Bobò
actors: Attori non professionisti
description: We are in the Portuguese city of Oporto, in the 1940s. Here, at the extreme edges of Europe but as happens all over the world, two groups of boys, classmates, give life to numerous gangs, a bit like in the novel "The boys of the Paal street". Here, too, the gangs face each other, clash and put their rivalry on the line. So the kids grow up and learn the law of life.
notes: Film about childhood, but also about the meaning of life, which takes its title from a formula used by children in their games. It is the film with which the Portuguese director Manoel de Oliveira made his debut behind the camera and is considered an excellent example of poetic realism.

title: Fight for Justice
actors: John Ritter, Tess Harper, Anna Chlumsky, Sarah Chalke
description: A malignant tumor forces a sixteen-year-old girl - Missy, an excellent sportswoman and brilliant student - to have a leg amputated. Despite the chemotherapy she is subjected to, Missy is doomed: the disease has now invaded her lungs, thus marking her fate. During the course of the excruciating illness, the father is forced to undergo dismissal due to his numerous absences: among other things, the insurance doubles his premium for ever higher hospital costs. The Clinton government will intervene and guarantee the parent the job.
notes: Almost an electoral scourge disguised as a film.

title: The Rainmaker
actors: Danny DeVito, Matt Damon, Claire Danes, Jon Voight, Mickey Rourke
description: Rudy Baylor, a young law graduate, aspires to become a "rain man", that is, a man destined to enrich the law firm that will be lucky enough to hire him. The lawyer thus comes into contact with people of dubious fame. One day he will find himself having to challenge a powerful and corrupt insurance company that, through a million-dollar insurance scam, has enriched itself to the detriment of workers.
notes: One of the usual Grishams takes flight to a representation of the world that goes beyond the conflict between a corrupt legal-judicial system and the common people who get entangled in it. Helped by a cast of great actors capable of the undertone (De Vito, and even the unrecognizable Rourke) and by a very young man who knows not to overdo it (Damon), Coppola gives us yet another, heartbreaking portrait of the "people of the rain" (" The Rain People "was the original title of his fourth feature film," I'm Not Coming Home Tonight ").

title: The Jackal
actors: Bruce Willis, Richard Gere, Sidney Poitier, Diane Venora
description: A criminal organization hires a killer to eliminate the American First Lady.
notes: "What's her name?" Richard Gere asks Diane Venora. "Koslova". "And in name?" «Major ...»: the best line of the film, a remake (certainly inferior) of _The day of the jackal_ by Fred Zinnemann.

title: Monella
actors: Anna Ammirati, Patrick Mower, Mario Parodi, Susana Martinkova, Serena Grandi
description: We are between the 1950s and 1960s between Mantua, Parma and Modena and the teenager Lola and boyfriend Masetto fall in love, quarrel, separate and love each other. Everything is complicated by the morbid attraction that Lola feeds towards André, the fifty -year -old lover of his mother Zaira.
notes: More than a film, it looks like a commercial of bikes and underpants. Opened by the endless sequence by bicycle, counterpointed by musical scenes that shave dementia ("Mambo Italiana", Elvis, "Let's Twist Again" danced without underwear), is dotted with characters, jokes and find "erotic" that seem to have come out of a barracks joke.

title: Voglio una donnaaa!
actors: Rocco Barbaro, Stefania Rocca, Massimo Olcese, Antonella Elia, Ana Valeria Dini
description: Mario Becchi, arrested and sentenced to eight months in prison for obscene acts in a public place, tells his story to a psychologist who assists the inmates. Since he was a child, his life has been studded with tragicomic episodes. Like the time he found his father in inappropriate attitudes with his elementary school teacher, all without his mother's knowledge. Then one day Mario goes into a coma and wakes up adult and alone.
notes: The second film by the Mazzieri seems to suffer from a slightly higher budget and a more substantial narrative structure. "I want a donnaaa!" it has the slightly hopping and episodic trend of cabaret-television films (three of the protagonists are Rocco Barbaro, Massimo Olcese and Antonella Elia). The risk is that the "poetry of the little one" and a certain cuteness diminish that sense of rarefaction that represented the most original trait of "The virtual".

title: Deconstructing Harry
actors: Woody Allen, Kirstie Alley, Billy Crystal, Elisabeth Shue, Demi Moore, Robin Williams
description: Harry Block, a writer born Jewish and raised atheist, who reached middle age and who, after six psychoanalysts, three wives, an indefinite number of girlfriends, lovers and casual relationships, went into spiritual bankruptcy. Harry has put art into his work and not into his life (as his longtime friend tells him who steals his fan-student-lover to marry her).
notes: Allen knows how to tell the great crises that affect everyone (not only New York filmmakers full of idiosyncrasies), the crises of identity and moral and intellectual honesty, with a millimeter sense of sensations and characters, and knows how to mix, in the canonical hour and a half , the psychological dilations and daily frenzies. He manages to "flesh out" without forgetting to laugh at the great themes, at universal crises and at himself. The Robin Williams episode that literally goes out of focus is one of the most sophisticated and authentic tributes in recent years to the extraordinary ability of cinema to "reflect" (technically and theoretically) the human condition.

title: I Went Down
actors: Brendan Gleeson, Peter McDonald, Peter Caffrey, Tony Doyle
description: They drive in a stolen car in a flat, as far as the eye can see, almost swampy Irish landscape. They go around almost in circles with a kidnapped gangster, to hand him over to another gangster who wants to take him out. They are two little thugs: Git, young and at the very beginning, dragged into this bad business for trying to save a friend, and the older Bunny, who apparently has the tough skin of a hardened criminal, but, underneath, is he too a poor devil.
notes: "The Amateurs" is the Irish debut film Breathnach awarded at the San Sebastian Film Festival. By combining road movies and gangster films, the director gives his film an ever-changing rhythm and mood; when it seems that it is about to take a foregone path, it veers towards an unexpected tone. Exemplary is the combination of comedy (the catchphrase of the saw) and violence, and the extent to which the protagonists' daily disasters are suggested. How to make a genre film without forgetting the real world.

title: As Good As It Gets
actors: Jack Nicholson, Helen Hunt, Greg Kinnear, Shirley Knight
description: Once upon a time, there was a misogynist, obsessed with an infinite series of complexes and delusions and endowed with a poisoned tongue. But after meeting a dog and a beautiful waitress, something changes; and the ogre turns out to be a curmudgeonly benefit.
notes: The film knows how to reconcile good feelings and bitterness in the "War of the Roses" style, and stages inflated characters like a "bad" writer, a gay painter and a waitress full of problems, with a human depth and perfectly recognizable shots, rudeness, weakness . Well done Kinnear, Hunt and mom Shirley Knight. Extraordinary Nicholson and Jill, the dog protagonist, who contends for close-ups and applause.

title: Home Alone 3
actors: Alex D. Linz, Kevin Kilner, Olek Krupa, Rya Kihlstedt, Lenny Von Dohlen
description: In bed with measles, little Alex is wanted by a super-technological gang who wants to get hold of a very precious chip, accidentally ended up in one of his toys. Left alone in the house, the child transforms the house into a perfect mousetrap, where the bad guys are martyred by traps and traps ...
notes: Little pests ... they don't grow up and the saga continues. After the era of Macaulay Culkin, now a grown-up, Hollywood tries to revive the trend (almost a sub-genre) by relying on new but no less pestiferous faces. Nothing new under the sun, but in some moments the direction of Raja Gosnell is frenetic and worthy of the best "slapstick comedy".

title: Stolen Women, Captured Hearts
actors: Janine Turner, Jean-Louisa Kelly, Patrick Bergin, William Shockley
description: Anna Brewster is a beautiful young woman who is traveling to a village in the West to meet the man she has to marry and has never met. His carriage is attacked by a Sioux tribe and their leader Mi-To-Wan is about to kill Anna, when he realizes that the woman in front of him is the living image of that seen in a dream. The proud warrior spares Anna's life and allows her to drive the carriage to Fort Hays. However, Anna's vicissitudes are not over ...
notes: In the "politically correct" era, even a film about Indians must comply with certain rules. Politically incorrect John Ford was much better, however.

title: Due mogli sono troppe
actors: Lea Padovani, Griffith Jones, Kieron Moore, Sally Ann Howes
description: David Fry, an English citizen, who participated in the Second World War in Italy with the rank of sergeant, decides to visit Venice and Rome with his young wife. After a trip, which the ex-soldier contributed to make uncomfortable and which forced them to give up in Venice, the couple arrive in the capital. David and his wife are on the train to Cassino and arrive in Poppi del Sangro, a small town that the former soldier had freed. Here he meets the Maggini family who, during the conflict, had welcomed him into their home.
notes: Camerini exploits as he can a subject by Suso Cecchi D'Amico and Antonio Pietrangeli for a correct and sciapa Italian-English co-production. There is also a little part for Roger Moore, still light years away from James Bond.

title: Serenate per sedici bionde
actors: Claudio Villa, Carletto Sposito, Riccardo Billi, Mario Riva, Liliana Feldmann
description: A boy, who has inherited an old castle in Lazio, goes there with four friends to take possession of it. But when he arrives he finds him in a state of complete abandonment. During the night sixteen French students are forced by a violent storm to take refuge in the manor. The night raid of the group causes confusion and misunderstandings.
notes: Claudio Villa, once again sings and seduces in an unpretentious film that anticipated the "musicarelli" of the Sixties by a few years.

title: The Enchanted Cottage
actors: Dorothy McGuire, Robert Young, Herbert Marshall, Mildred Natwick
description: A WWII veteran, disfigured following a military action, finds the love of a girl not too glamorous thanks to the mediation of a pianist, all in a New England cottage.
notes: From a play by Arthur Pinero, Cromwell draws a bizarre and quite visionary film with above average performers.

title: The Wrong Arm of the Law
actors: Peter Sellers, Lionel Jeffries, Bernard Cribbins, Nanette Newman
description: The activities of the London underworld are disturbed by the unexpected intrusion of a trio of foreign criminals who score their blows against them, using police uniforms. Paino, who chairs the criminal union, to stem unfair competition, comes to a form of strange alliance with Inspector Parker of Scotland Yard. The truce, of course, will have to last until the three intruders are captured. Enjoyable satirical film with a good Peter Sellers.

title: Kafka
actors: Jeremy Irons, Theresa Russell, Joel Grey, Ian Holm, Armin Mueller-Stahl
description: In the Prague of the twenties, dominated by the mysterious Castle in which the Power resides, the writer Franz Kafka, still almost unknown, is employed in a large insurance company. The future writer, shy and frustrated as he is, is bullied by the ambiguous Burgel. Going to the morgue to identify the body of his friend Eduard, found in the river, Kafka learns from Commissioner Grubach that the police give credence to the suicide hypothesis. The lover of the dead, on the other hand, is certain that he was killed.
notes: Soderbergh directs in the magnificent panorama of Prague and gets help in the script by Lem Dobbs. The photography instead is entrusted to the hand of Walt Lloyd.

title: Brain Donors
actors: John Turturro, Bob Nelson, Mel Smith, Nancy Marchand
description: Roland T. Flakfizer is a young lawyer with a loose gab and remarkable moral ease. Perpetually looking for clients, Roland manages to be appointed patron by the old and very rich widow Oglethorpe for the execution of her husband's last wishes. To carry out his mandate, Roland recruits two other characters even more deranged than him: the lazy lawnmower Jacques and the driverless taxi driver Rocco. Together they have to cope with the far more legal savvy of the deceased.
notes: It is one of the first starring films for John Turturro to display first-rate comic talent. High school zany cinema, with an eye to the classic slapstick.

title: Frank and Jesse
actors: Dana Wheeler Nicholson, Rob Lowe, Bill Paxton, Randy Travis, Maria Pitillo
description: Back home after the terrible experience of the civil war, brothers Frank and Jessie James see their younger brother killed by a railroad agent who had been paid for the sale of the family land. Faced with the indifference of the Northerners, who support the interests of the via ferrata, Jessie decides to do justice for herself.
