Together with Frank and the Younger brothers, he forms a band of rebels who oppose the atrocities committed by Union soldiers. Their assaults provoke the harsh reaction of the Nordists, who hire the private investigator Pinkerton to track them down. The hunt for the latter will turn into a deadly war.

title: The Miracle Woman
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, David Manners, Sam Hardy, Beryl Mercer
description: A preacher is stirred up by an unscrupulous manager who intends to exploit her oratory skills for her own not entirely exemplary purposes. In fact, the manager wants to obtain favors that are not completely disinterested from the woman's faithful. But one day the woman finds love.
notes: Flop at the box office for one of the first great Goat, tough and controversial.

title: Greed
actors: Gibson Gowland, Jean Hersholt, Chester Conklyn
description: A self-styled doctors and his wife win a large sum in the lottery. That's enough to ruin what little remains of their marriage. The woman, in order not to affect the nest egg, prefers to continue living in misery and thus ends up being killed by her husband who in turn ...
notes: Stroheim masterpiece massacred by production. A fresco on human greed, taken from a naturalist novel by Frank Norris, which starts from a never-before-seen realism (with lots of boils exploding in the foreground) to reach visionary moments (the famous ending set in the Valley of Death) . Initially it lasted nine hours, then reduced to three. There was only a 100-minute version put up by producer Irvin Tahlberg, until in 1999 it was possible to see a sort of restored 4-hour schedule that was also based on surviving stills and stills. But "Greed" remains irreparably a lost and cursed film.

title: Kvinnors väntan
actors: Anita Bjoerk, Eva Dahlbeck, Maj-Britt Nilsson, Gunnar Björnstrand
description: The wives of four brothers find themselves together in the family's country villa, waiting for their respective husbands, temporarily distant. The occasion lends itself to confidences and confessions that the four women make, naturally speaking above all of their married life. Thus betrayals, misunderstandings, hypocrisies emerge, but also some flashes of happiness. In the villa there is also the younger sister of one of the four, in love with the eldest's son. In the end, the two young people decide to flee together.
notes: Once again the great Swedish master stages female characters in the round and psychoanalyses them mercilessly.

title: Nuda proprietà vendesi
actors: Lino Banfi, Annie Girardot, Alessandro Gassmann, Charlotte Kady, Dario Vergassola, Paola Tiziana Cruciani
description: An Italian-French couple is looking for a house in Rome where she works at the transalpine embassy in Piazza Farnese. A short distance from there Domenico and Costanza, an elderly married couple without children, live in an ancient patrician palace, inherited from the noblewoman whose servants they were. Accomplice of the concierge, the two couples sign a contract for the sale of "bare ownership" of the building, but there is a catch: to entice young people to do business, they are led to believe that the owners are decrepit and sick. But the surprises are not over ...
notes: Produces the Lux by Ettore Bernabei, that of the television "Bible".

title: Deadly Family Secrets
actors: Greg Evigan, Loni Anderson, Gigi Rice, Barry Corbin, William Converse-Roberts
description: Martha, while she is with her sister Linda, whom she has not seen for fifteen years, witnesses, without being seen, the murder of a certain Larson. The one who had come to look for an old friend of his, Archie perished in the fire of his house which he himself had set on fire. Martha shocked by the scene she witnessed, she would like to tell the police everything, but she realizes that the murderer is none other than ... A conflict arises in her between the duty to report the murderer and the emotional bond with a loved one. But soon Martha also realizes that she is threatened with death and so ...
notes: Well thought out and with solidly trained interpreters.

title: Tashunga
actors: James Caan, Christopher Lambert, Catherine McCormack
description: We are at the end of the last century. Half-breed Hudson (Lambert) lives in an Alaskan Eskimo tribe according to primeval rhythms. In a cave sacred to the tribe, a gold vein is discovered which immediately unleashes the aims of McLennon (Canna), a ruthless businessman. He wants to get his hands on the precious metal at any cost, even if it is the extermination of the entire community of natives. At this point the clash between Hudson and McLennon is as inevitable as it is bloody.
notes: Sorry that a great actor like Caan ends up embarking on similar productions. Lambert (producer, as well as protagonist) plans to remake Highlander, but he lacks ... the tartan (the fabric).

title: Canzone proibita
actors: Claudio Villa, Fiorella Mari, Franco Silva, Dante Maggio
description: Roberto Aloisi, who is doing his military service, would like to marry the teacher Bianca with whom he has fallen madly in love. The girl, however, loves Paolo, who, among other things, is betrothed. War breaks out, we are in 1940, and Roberto and Paolo are called up and sent to the Russian front. In the course of an attack, Roberto is wounded, while Paolo's traces are lost. At the hospital the first meets Bianca who has joined the army as a Red Cross nurse and they also learn that Paolo is dead. In the meantime Roberto's old love has rekindled and Paola this time gives in to the insistence of man.

title: Il mistero di Oberwald
actors: Luigi Diberti, Monica Vitti, Franco Branciaroli, Paolo Bonacelli
description: A young queen was widowed on her wedding day and has lived in seclusion since that day, often changing abode and showing herself with her face covered with a black veil. Sebastian, a young anarchist poet, sneaks into the queen's apartment to suppress her. The resemblance between the bomber and the dead king is striking.
notes: Antonioni agrees to shoot for television in full and for the first time with cameras, "The Two-headed Eagle", a drama by Jean Cocteau. The Maestro wants to experiment on form and color (for example the purple aura that surrounds the bad characters, which, moreover, you cannot see on TV). But it is not hard to understand that he is not very interested in the story, and the interpretation of the two protagonists leads to the threshold of ridicule.

title: Larmar och goer sig till
actors: Anita Bjoerk, Börie Ahlstedt, Marie Richardson, Erland Josephson, Pernilla August, Peter Stormare
description: The 54-year-old inventor Karl Akerblom, the face like that of a child and a great admirer of Schubert, is a patient in the psychiatric ward of the Upsala University Hospital. Reason? He beaten his girlfriend Pauline for no apparent reason. Another hospital patient is Professor Osvald Vogler. The two men become friends and together they plan to make a film that will be called _The joy of the joyful girl_.
notes: Parable about life and death, united by a single Great Madness, as only the great master of the North can do. Of course there is no lack of autobiographical references and the usual, declared great love for cinema despite the voluntary abandonment of fifteen years earlier (this film is shot for TV). The title is taken from a quotation from the fifth act, fifth scene of Macbeth.

title: Starlight Hotel
actors: Peter Phelps, Greer Robson, Bruce Phillips, Marshal Napier
description: We are in New Zealand in 1930. Things are not going too well for Dave Marshall, a widower with a child, who leaves the child with relatives and goes elsewhere in search of fortune. The child, however, is ill to the point that, one day, she decides to leave to join her parent. Of course he wouldn't be able to do it if he didn't meet a young tramp wanted by the police on the way. The man understands that the child can be his "passport".
notes: Fresh and disenchanted, the story runs off at a good pace and excellent ideas. The adult-child relationship is viewed with sympathy, but also with sincerity and without indulgences.

title: Mercenary
actors: Olivier Gruner, John Ritter, Robert Culp, Ed Lauter, Michael Zelniker
description: To settle the score with Vassili Borfchenko, an international terrorist who accidentally killed his wife in an attack, the wealthy businessman Jonas Ambler hires the mercenary Carl Hawk May, former captain of the special assault troops. The wanted man is a former Red Army officer who, after the collapse of the USSR, gathered the men of his squad of elite soldiers, transforming the latter into a combat unit in the service of the highest bidder. His lair is located in a Middle Eastern country: and it is that Ambler and May disembark here, determined to break into the Borfchenko base by any means ...

title: Destry
actors: Audie Murphy, Maru Blanchard, Thomas Mitchell
description: Joe Bailey is the sheriff of a typical village in the West. One bad day Joe is killed in Decker's saloon, the village boss. In place of Bailey the drunkard Ray Barnaby is appointed who appoints the young Tom Destry as his deputy, reluctant to use weapons. Decker has his eye on Shinner's farm. By cheating him in the game, Decker seizes his lands, but when Shinner locks himself in his house weapons in hand, Destry must intervene.
notes: Quite anomalous for the times, this discreet western focuses its cards on the contrast between legality and brute violence.

title: Doctor Detroit
actors: Dan Aykroyd, Howard Hesseman, George Furth, Donna Dixon, Lynn Whitfield, Lydia Lei, Fran Drescher
description: A naive teacher who teaches in his father's college, lives a quiet family life in Chicago between home, work and sports. To upset his serene existence come four gorgeous call girls: Monica, Karen, Jasmine and Thelma. The only problem is that with them there is also the protector, who has problems with the boss of the city, and a certain Mom, with rather hasty methods. To get out of the way, the professor invents an elusive cruel and unscrupulous character ...
notes: A bit too banal story redeemed by Dan Aykroyd's interpretation. The Canadian actor will soon marry Donna Dixon who has a small part here.

title: Letti selvaggi
actors: Ursula Andress, Laura Antonelli, Sylvia Kristel, Monica Vitti, Michele Placido, Orazio Orlando, Roberto Benigni
description: Episode movies. 1. A fake carpet seller gets in trouble for a crime committed by another. 2. A faithful wife and an unbelieving husband: an innocent passer-by pays the price. 3. A fresh widow lays down her weeds to pose for a photographer. 4. A prostitute playfully replaces the mother of a rowdy brat, then the game gets serious. 5. An elderly teacher has a young wife. Too young. 6. He thief and she thief. Competition is fierce for a jewel. 7. To secure the job, some body builders "hire" a stripper. 8. An orchestra conductor forgets his commitments to a woman. Rather vulgar and obvious episodic film.

title: La maman et la putain
actors: Jean-Pierre Léaud, Bernadette Lafont, Francoise Lebrun, Isabelle Weingarten
description: The sentimental education of the young Parisian Alexandre divided between two girls: Veronika, a nurse in a hospital, and Marie, the owner of a small boutique. Wanderings, sleepless nights, walks in the Latin Quarter, conversations between the philosophical and the banal in cafes, tenderness and anguish in the bedroom ...
notes: Jean Eustache, a promise of French cinema who committed suicide in 1981, threw the typical stone into the pond with this film. Because she saw in her generation that glimmer of disillusionment and disengagement that led her to experience the end of the Contest in disarray. Cinematically powerful.

title: The Night Caller - Listener
actors: Shanna Reed, Tracy Nelsen, Mary Crosby
description: Lindsay Rolands is an established psychologist. In addition to his professional activity, he also curates a psychology column for a local radio station through which he comes into contact with numerous listeners and their problems. Suddenly Lindsay is next to a woman, she was an admirer, who, with great outreaches of friendship, begins to creep into his life in an increasingly cumbersome way until almost every other relationship is eliminated. In short Lindsay realizes that she is dealing with a psychopath who tends to take total control of her personality. Will he be able to get rid of the dangerous inconvenience?
notes: Is it possible that Father Freud turned in his grave?

title: Monastero di Santa Chiara
actors: Edda Albertini, Massimo Serato, Nino Manfredi, Nyta Dover
description: Ester di Veroli is a Jewish woman who works as a singer by profession and has two tenacious and fanatical admirers: Enrico, a Neapolitan and Rudolf, captain of the SS. The latter is engaged to a German who proves to be very jealous of the woman and does everything to get her under arrest. But Rudolf instead of taking her to prison, entrusts her to the nuns of the Monastery of Santa Chiara.
notes: Bitter mix of neoralism and drama. The whole story is told by the master Sadun to the writer Alberto Moravia (in the part of himself). Debut of Nino Manfredi. <>

title: American Madness
actors: Walter Huston, Constance Cummings, Kay Johnson
description: Thomas Dickson, president of a bank, fears for his future and ends up neglecting his wife who accepts the chief accountant's court. The suitor favors a theft that threatens to bankrupt the bank. But the unexpected help of a former convict and a secretary will sort things out.
notes: The terrible Frank overturns the convention of conventional "good" and "bad" because the world, according to him, is made right ... upside down.

title: Ladies in Retirement
actors: Ida Lupino, Louis Hayward, Isobel Elsom, Edith Barrett, Elsa Lanchester
description: Elena, who comes from a very wealthy but now decayed family, is left alone with two crazy sisters in charge. The madness of poor women leads them to be harassing, so much so that no one is able to endure them for long. But Elena categorically refuses to admit them to a psychiatric hospital, and indeed kills the landlady. Meanwhile, a fugitive from the police arrives at the house. Noir of women of the 40s, with a dreamlike and oppressive atmosphere and a story full of ambiguity. A little classic.

title: Deliria
actors: David Brandon, Barbara Cupisti, G. L. Radice
description: Before going to the theater for rehearsals, a dancer goes to a hospital to find someone. Here she meets a strange patient with an even stranger look that remains impressed on her. At the end of the rehearsals, the people inside the theater can no longer leave because someone has barred the doors and stolen the keys. Someone who starts killing the dancers one by one. Someone with a strange look.
notes: Debut by Michele Soavi ("Dellamorte Dellamore"): one of the best recent Italian horror films. Produced by Joe D'Amato, made with humility and imagination, essential in dispensing suspense. The Italian version does not coincide with the one desired by the director (and distributed only in England), but it is beautiful all the same.

title: La canzone del destino
actors: Claudio Villa, Milly Vitale, Marco Guglielmi, Carlo Campanini
description: Claudio and Cesare, two half-brothers, are both in love with Elena who, of the two, prefers Claudio, the more extroverted and exuberant. At the outbreak of the Great War, the two young men are enlisted but, while Cesare ends up on the front line, Claudio goes into hiding. Elena also volunteers as a Red Cross nurse. Taken by remorse, Claudio gets to go to the front where he finds Cesare and Elena. Long-hidden feelings come to the surface and the war takes it upon itself to "fix" things.
notes: Scipito script at the service of the "reuccio" and his singing skills.

title: Tecumseh: the Last Warrior
actors: Lawrence Bayne, Jesse Borrego, Lorne Cardinal, Tantoo Cardinal
description: We are in 1812 when the pioneers try to remove more and more land from the territories of the red indians. Tecumseh, who is the head of the Shawnee tribe, tries to oppose in any way the expropriation of the lands belonging to his nation. The Indian chief has in mind to create a great Indian state, and to do so, he tries to win the American colonizers.
notes: It is not the first time that the cinema tells the story of the Red Indians and their strenuous struggles. But this time the good intentions are wrecked. Produced by Francis Ford Coppola.

title: Etat de siège
actors: Yves Montand, Renato Salvatori, O.E. Hasse, Jacques Weber
description: We are in Montevideo, the capital of Uruguay, in 1970. The country is governed by a military junta and the Tupamaros guerrillas operate in the cities. A group of the latter kidnaps two foreign nationals: the Brazilian consul Fernando Campos and the American of South American origin Philip Santore, director of a para-government agency, but perhaps a CIA agent. During lengthy interrogations, the guerrillas try to induce Santore to confess his misdeeds while public opinion is shaken by the audacity of the guerrillas. But the police ...
notes: In the seventies the Greek-born director Costa Gavras enjoyed the sympathies of a lot of critics for his films of political denunciation (the first was "Z - The orgy of power" on Greek colonels). Today the judgment would be much more cautious.

title: Shades of Gray
actors: Tom Reilly, Kelly Burns, Kathy Shower, Doug Jeffery, Johnnie Johnson
description: A woman helps the police frame a dangerous serial killer, but then - haunted by the nightmares of that experience - she decides to leave the city. In the new house, life seems to resume normally, so much so that after a few months the girl meets a kind and caring man who begins to woo her. In short, the two get married, but the couple's serenity is soon disturbed by a mysterious killer. From the few clues available, the police try to reconstruct the identikit of the ferocious murderer who, coincidentally, coincides with the physiognomy of her consort ...
notes: Thriller of little weight, but which - despite its obvious shortcomings - can keep the tension high.

title: Magic in the Water
actors: Mark Harmon, Joshua Jackson, Harley Jane Kozak, Sarah Wayne
description: Did you know that Nessie, the very famous Scottish Loch Ness monster, has a relative in America? If the answer is no "Magic in the lake" shows you that you are ignorant because a Canadian village on the shores of a lake is making a fortune with Orky, a species of water dragon that everyone talks about, but that no one has ever seen and that in any case attracts crowded area of ??tuiristi. What nobody has been able to do, on the other hand, happens to a family in Seattle, a father and two children, who are temporarily in an emotional crisis. Precisely the encounter with the good aquatic snake will give all the right stimuli to see reality under another aspect.
notes: For simple souls, but with good special effects.

title: Il carabiniere
actors: Fabio Testi, Massimo Ranieri, Valeria Valeri, Enrico Maria Salerno
description: The brothers Francesco and Paolo Palumbo live with their widowed mother on a farm that they run with great sacrifices. Paolo loves, in return, Angela, the daughter of a landowner who has set her sights on the farm land for speculation. To achieve his goals, angela's father does not hesitate to trample the feelings of the two lovers and, when Paolo, to better defend his interests, enlisted in the carabinieri, he even resorted to crime.
notes: In the absence of the "king" of the Mario Merola drama, here is the former "scugnizzo" of the song Massimo Ranieri. But the film is equally poor.

title: Pour la peau d'un flic
actors: Alain Delon, Anne Parillaud, Daniel Ceccaldi, Jean-Pierre Darras, Michel Auclair, Xavier Depraz
description: A former police officer who has started a private detective business is hired by a wealthy lady to track down her daughter, who has mysteriously disappeared. Investigating, the "hound" discovers a very large round complicated even more by the killing of his client. The detective, however, does not give up and collects other evidence.
notes: The handsome Alain's attempt to pass behind the camera fails. The actor prevails over the director, the screenplay is full of clichés.

title: Ai no borei
actors: Kazuko Yoshiyuki, Tatsua Fuji, Takahiro Tamura, Takuzo Kawatani
description: We are in 1896, in Japan in full industrial transformation. In an inland area, apparently still tied to rural rhythms and customs, the young Seki, married to a farmer, still a beautiful and ambitious woman, meets and falls in love with Tokoji, a former soldier. Together they plan and carry out the murder of her husband and then hide the body in an abandoned well. The crime goes unpunished for years until the ghost of the dead appears in the village. The two killers, haunted by the ghost, begin to behave suspiciously and so do the police ...
notes: After the controversy of the previous "Here is the empire of the senses" Oshima retreats a few positions and creates a less successful work.

title: Amantes
actors: Victoria Abril, Jorge Sanz, Maribel Verdú, Enrique Cerro
description: We are in Madrid in 1950, in full Franco regime. At the end of the military stop Francisco, known as Paco, a young man of country origin, is discharged. His commander gets him a job, but he wants to make money fast and marry Trini, his longtime girlfriend. Paco finds lodging with Luisa, a widow older than him, but still attractive. The woman does not need much to seduce the young man and involve him more and more closely in unclear rounds. Meanwhile, Trini ...
notes: More ambitions than results in this film by an author often struggling with Franco's censorship but who exploited the new climate of freedom only on a voyeuristic level. Victoria Abril was surprisingly awarded Best Actress at the Berlin Film Festival.

title: When He Didn't Come Home
actors: Patty Duke, Kelly Rowan, Robert Floyd, Rosemary Dunsmore
description: Timmy Dolan, who moved to New York for work, meets and ends up falling in love with Carolyn. The two decide to live together and their story, at least at the beginning, proceeds in an idyllic way. Then the girl begins to reveal a rather irascible and violent character that leads her to lead her hands at the first opportunity. So their relationship turns into a real nightmare so much that Timmy decides to drop everything and go back to being single. A few weeks go by but all traces of him have been lost, so much so that his family decides to report his disappearance to the police. Unfortunately, Timmy is found dead inside his truck.

title: Retroactive
actors: James Belushi, Kylie Travis, Frank Whaley, M. Emmet Walsh
description: Karen Warren, stranded on a Texas highway in the middle of the desert, accepts a ride from a motorist, Frank Lloyd, a coarse and vulgar guy who travels in the company of his wife Rayanna, an apprehensive and fearful woman. In the short space of a few hours, Frank's latent anger explodes in all its violence with deadly consequences. Even for Karen it would be the end if she fails to escape into the desert where she reaches a semi-abandoned laboratory where a young man is carrying out experiments on time displacement without authorization. Karen asks the young man to be sent back to the past so that he can avoid the unpleasant encounter, but ...

title: The Little Mermaid
description: The beautiful little mermaid Ariel, the youngest daughter of the king of the sea, is used to disobeying her father's orders, who, among other things, has forbidden her to go back to the surface and have contact with humans. During a raid, Ariel rescues the young prince Eric, who is about to drown in a shipwreck. The little mermaid is, however, forced to abandon him. Fascinated by the memory of Ariel and her singing, Eric decides to find her again ...
notes: The 28th Disney feature film inaugurated a magical decade for Uncle Walt's grandchildren in 1989: two decades of global success in the company of new proto-feminist heroines. The musical won, among other things, two Oscars: for the song _In fondo al mar_ and the soundtrack.

title: The Postman
actors: Kevin Costner, Will Patton, Olivia Williams, James Russo
description: In 2013 the world is an arid expanse due to a nuclear war. The survivors live barricaded inside the forts, because outside there is an army of brutal warriors (the Holnists) led by a former yuppie self-proclaimed dictator. Fortunately, there is also a lonely wanderer around who first turns into "hero by chance".
notes: Western sceneries from the new frontier, horses galloping in the prairies, open skies like John Ford and bad Scespirians. The anthem, bordering on anarchy, had all the credentials to please Americans above all. Instead, Costner's moralism, still in debt for "Waterworld", is hackneyed and the adventure is never engaging. He wanted to go against the grain, but ends up being conventional, bland and pathetic.

title: Orphée
actors: François Périer, Jean Marais, Maria Casarès, Marie Déa, Juliette Gréco
description: The poet Orpheus, in the Paris of the fifties, loses his beloved wife Eurydice. To have her once again with him he agrees to enter the mirror that leads to the superhuman kingdom of the Princess. On one condition: that on the return journey, Orpheus does not turn to look at her, but curiosity is difficult to keep at bay.
notes: Good cinematographic transcription of a play by Cocteau himself, today it is almost above all a period document. Also in the cast is singer Juliette Gréco.

title: Corto circuito
actors: Vivi Gioi, Umberto Melnati, Lauro Gazzolo, Bianca Doria, Guido Notari
description: The police are trying to shed light on the mysterious death of two doctors, which occurred in similar circumstances. A mystery writer provides investigators with some clues that clarify the modalities and circumstances that formed the background of the two crimes. All these elements the writer deduces them from one of his highly successful detective stories. The police become suspicious and start investigating the writer.

title: Yao a yao yao dao wai pe qiao
actors: Li Baotian, Gong Li, Wang Xiao Xiao, Sun Chun, Li Xui Jian
description: Tang Suisheng arrives in Shanghai to be part of the triad (or the mafia organization) linked to the Tang family and is put at the service of Xiao Jinbao, a cabaret singer who has been a lover of the head of the family for some years. The two hide on a small island to allow the boss to recover after an attack and to unmask the bomber, but ...
notes: The film is affected by the tensions that led to the separation between the director and the beautiful Gong Li, companions of art and life. Furthermore, Yimou is a little too influenced by Western models and loses his most genuine vocation.

title: Simpatici & antipatici
actors: Christian De Sica, Gianfranco Funari, Simona Izzo, Leo Gullotta, Marco Messeri, Paolo Conticini
description: In the Tiber sports club we find Alberto a ruthless builder, the cynical surgeon of thirty million with an operated prostate, the actor exhausted by failure and the failed representative who sells caviar at a discount and tries to remedy continuous overdrafts in the bank. Do not miss the starlet with a Venetian accent and the hateful scion with Ferrari, the waiter who dreams of being the scion and the jeweler who loses his home, wife and wealth due to the Spanish caliente.
notes: A festival of trivial and very obvious obviousness. What is vulgar is not so much the language, the pre (vi) ti jokes and the apparently denigrated and in reality coveted reference models, but also - if not only - the paucity and superficiality of the authors (Vanzina Brothers and director) who they pass off as cinema a critique of the habits and malpractice of half of the Italians (in this case the "right" ones) good, however, for TV passages.

title: Mad City
actors: John Travolta, Dustin Hoffman, Mia Kirshner, Alan Alda
description: The TV reporter Max Brackett, whose career is now in decline, is sent from his editorial office to a small town in the American province to follow a news story of little importance. While visiting the natural history museum, he unwittingly witnesses the protest of security guard Sam Baily, who - to protest his sudden dismissal - shows up armed at the museum with the intention of being summoned ...
notes: It looks like Billy Wilder's _Ace in the Hole_, but only in intentions. Narrative tension at a minimum and flat denunciation: Costa-Gavras has definitely lost the shine of the best times (remember _Z_ and _Missing_?).

title: Il testimone dello sposo
actors: Ines Sastre, Diego Abatantuono, Cinzia Mascoli, Valeria D'Obici
description: On December 31, 1899, preparations were being made for Francesca Babini's wedding in a house in a small town in Emilia Romagna. The girl must marry a wealthy and elderly man who with his money is called to pay off the debts of the family. Everyone is waiting for Angelo, the best man who has emigrated to America, and Francesca understands that he can be her lifeline.
notes: In the film, the symbols accumulate: the date is "historic" because it is a wedding celebrated on the last day of the nineteenth century. Too much, perhaps, for Avati's polite minimalism.

title: Kiss the Girls
actors: Morgan Freeman, Ashley Judd, Cary Elwes, Tony Goldwyn, Jay O. Sanders
description: Alex Cross, a policeman with a passion for psychology, has mysteriously disappeared a niece. In a short time, Alex discovers that this is not an isolated case, given that other girls have been kidnapped: the only thing that unites them is the fact that each of them has a particular talent that makes her excel in different disciplines ...
notes: Mixed in the memories and suggestions of _Seven_, caught between the extraordinary mimicry in undertone of Morgan Freeman and the grumpy obstinacy of Ashley Judd, that of Fleder (_What to do in Denver when you're dead_, _Don't Say a Word_, _The jury_) is a well thought out and compelling thriller.

title: Alien Resurrection
actors: Sigourney Weaver, Winona Ryder, Dominique Pinon, Brad Dourif
description: Two hundred years have passed and a difficult cloning experiment is being successfully completed on the spaceship Auriga. Clone 8, or the new Ripley, is not only alive and kicking, but in the operation she had an abortion that separated her from the alien fetus she carried inside. But there's something weird Ripley doesn't remember anything from her past and she's gotten worse and there's a scientist conducting weird experiments.
notes: Jeunet, although openly disinterested in the action part of the film (which is in fact the weakest), found himself at home in the technological-crumbling tunnels of the Auriga space base, among the unsuccessful clones, the laboratory monsters, in the alien nursery "implanted" in humans. The film is marked by its very black sense of the grotesque and, of course, by the dominant presence of Sigourney Weaver, a heroine returned from the realm of the dead, now "changed", withered and gloomy, capable of an almost carnal relationship with the alien (who, after all, it is flesh of his flesh). Her obstinacy to protect humanity (she who is no longer human) almost consigns her to tragedy.

title: You Hua Hao Hao Shuo
actors: Jiang Wen, Li Baotian, Qu Ying, Ge You
description: Xiao Shuai, an awkward boy who lives in Beijing and who is a book seller, has just been dumped by the beautiful An Hong who is crossing the city on his bicycle, but who is open to the news of Western consumerism. In the meantime, the girl has become engaged to a rich owner of a night club with a flashy Mercedes and Xiao is unable to give up.
notes: Skyscrapers and cell phones, designer glasses and trendy T-shirts, girls in miniskirts and streets clogged with cars. The first surprising fact of this work by Zhang Yimou is precisely this: a different and "modern" China as never happened to see.

title: Relic
actors: Penelope Ann Miller, Tom Sizemore, Linda Hunt
description: In the meanders of the Chicago Museum of Natural History, a frightening creature from Brazil wanders, the result of magical rituals and genetic experiments that feeds on human hypothalamus. The multiform monster manifests itself in all its voracity during a party given inside the Museum during a black out. But an enterprising scientist and a portly, superstitious, animal-rights policeman take matters into their own hands.
notes: It is halfway between "The X Files" and the catastrophic, but it has neither the enveloping atmosphere of the former, nor the devastating spectacle of the latter. On the other hand, it is cunning and simplistic enough not to irritate anyone. Penelope Ann Miller and Tom Sizemore are nice, normal, and hasty enough to keep up a story without mystery. Director Peter Hyams did better, and worse.

title: To Wong Foo, Thanks for Everything! Julie Newmar
actors: Patrick Swayze, Wesley Snipes, John Leguizamo, Stockard Channing, Chris Penn
description: Miss Vida Boheme lives with two "companions", very close friends. When they enter a beauty pageant they win hands down. To continue in the climb to success they have to move from New York to Los Angeles and so they get "on the road" in a flaming 1967 Cadillac. Halfway, however, precisely in the town of Snyderville, Nebraska, the car breaks down so that Vida and the others are forced to stop. The backward inhabitants of the city, however, do not seem to like the presence of the three "girls" very much, especially when they realize that they are ... transvestites.
notes: A rather atypical "road movie" with three "machi" par excellence constrained in rhinestones and sequins.

title: Bonjour tristesse!
actors: Deborah Kerr, David Niven, Jean Seberg, Mylène Demongeot
description: Beautiful world of rich and idle Brits on the Cote d'Azur. Here Raymond and his daughter Cecilia are spending a vacation with Elsa, Raymond's lover. Anna also arrives, a friend of Cecilia's deceased mother, who tries to put some order in the girl's life. A rivalry arises between the two that ...
notes: From a best seller of the time (by Françoise Sagan) and with an equally famous song, a film that is above all a test of actors.

title: 3 hommes à abattre
actors: Alain Delon, Dalila Di Lazzaro, Michel Auclair, Christian Barbier, Pierre Dux, Simone Renant
description: Gambler Michel Gerfaud finds himself in the sights of some ruthless killers for having rescued the leader of a missile industry hit by the lead of the hitmen. After asking for help from a policeman friend, who for this leaves us his skin, Michel finds himself having to fight alone, aided only by his partner, against the mysterious killers.
notes: With the typical trappings of French "noir", Deray composes a high-tension puzzle on what, before the fall of the walls, was a classic theme.

title: Sink the Bismark
actors: Kenneth Moore, Dana Wynter, Karel Stepanek, Carl Mohner
description: The categorical order given by Winston Churchill to the English fleet, already decimated by the German U-Boats, after the most terrible warship ever built appeared in the North Seas.
notes: War film that replaces the expenditure of the show with a masterly construction of tension.

title: The Saint of Fort Washington
actors: Matt Dillon, Danny Glover, Rick Aviles, Nina Siemaszko
description: Matthew, a photographer left homeless by building speculators, is forced to survive on the streets of his hometown and frequent homeless shelters. A black veteran who fought in Vietnam comes to his aid. The support that Matthew receives will be rewarded through the pranotherapist skills that the young photographer discovers he has.
notes: The Fort Washington of the title is the homeless refuge in which Matthew finds himself forced to live. The portrait of the homeless that the film gives us is impressive, thanks to the screenplay by Lyle Kessler which, however, mixes too many genres and too many themes.

title: A Mother's Prayer
actors: Bruce Dern, Kate Nelligan, Noah Fleiss, Linda Hamilton
description: Rosemary, the mother of little T. J. of just eight years, is abandoned by her husband, but the news that upsets her the most is to discover that her life partner has contracted AIDS and of course she too has been infected. The woman faces her own destiny as a sick person with extreme courage, but she also realizes that T. J. will soon be alone. After explaining the consequences of the terrible disease to the child, Rosemary decides to make her case public with the sole purpose of finding a new family for the child. Good actors and good feelings in an average TV product.

title: Sky Riders
actors: James Coburn, Susannah York, Robert Culp, Charles Aznavour
description: A group of terrorists kidnap the wife of an American industrialist and her two children in Athens. The place where the abductees are hidden is an abandoned monastery, built on top of a mountain and heavily guarded. The only way to reach it without making noise is to use hang gliders. Action movie from the era of the "Wild Goose" and "Where Eagles Dare". Fracassone, macho and so far-fetched as to seem ironic.

title: Drive
actors: Kadeem Hardison, Mark Dacascos, John Pyper-Ferguson
description: San Francisco: on an unspecified day in the not too distant future, the mysterious Toby Wong disembarks from a ship coming from Hong Kong. Toby is escaping from the emissaries of the powerful Leung Corporation and, as soon as he disembarks, he is immediately followed by a group of thugs led by the icy Vic Madison. Involved, despite himself, in the chase, the drunkard Malik finds himself inextricably linked to Wong. With him she will have to try to defend herself from Madison's violence and from the obscure maneuvers hatched by Mr. Lu, head of the Leung Corporation. Malik will not be long in discovering the reason for so much fury towards Toby.

title: 23 Pages to Baker Street
actors: Van Johnson, Vera Miles, Cecil Parker, Patricia Laffan, Maurice Denham
description: An American writer is in London on business. The man is blind and casually, in a bar, catches excerpts from a conversation between two other people that allude to an imminent kidnapping for the purpose of extortion. One of the two is a woman, whose perfume the writer also catches. She seems reluctant, but the other person seems capable of blackmailing her. With these clues alone, the writer throws himself a dead weight into the investigation during which he also runs some big risks.
notes: Good idea and even better the realization. Rhythm, good acting and always high suspense are the ingredients.

title: Starship Troopers
actors: Casper Van Dien, Denise Richards, Michael Ironside, Dina Meyer
description: In the not too distant future, our planet will fight a terrible battle against an alien race of giant insects. But let's take a step back, when the war had not yet broken out and Johnny Rico, out of high school, decided to enlist in the space infantry. Just on the eve of the invasion of the astromonsters ...
notes: Fifties Hollywood science fiction revisited by Paul Verhoeven, this time more ironic than usual. Cast consisting of Big Jim and Barbie-like actors, all treated with considerable acidity. The fake news programs are memorable, a symptom of "American" idiocy destined to dominate the world.

title: The End of the Violence
actors: Bill Pullman, Andie MacDowell, Gabriel Byrne, Traci Lind, Rosalind Chao
description: Two criminals were tasked with killing Mike Max, a producer who has based his career on particularly violent action films. The killers manage to kidnap him, but the next day their beheaded bodies are found in that no man's land, as the highway junction is called. The police come to the conclusion that someone freed Max and cut off the heads of the two thugs. Ray Berling, a former NASA scientist, instead saw something, by chance, on his surveillance screen of the super secret laboratory that he installed on behalf of the government in the Griffith Park Observatory.
notes: Despite the cuts (about twenty minutes) compared to the version presented at Cannes '97, the film remains confused and lost. The dialogues are sometimes involuntarily comical, and the simplistic polemic against the wear and tear of violent life thwarts the beautiful presences (from MacDowell to the last of the great Sam Fuller) and the suggestive shots.

title: The Great Sioux Massacre
actors: Joseph Cotten, Darren McGavin, Philip Carey, Julie Sommars
description: Cavalry Major Reno is facing a US Army court-martial. We are at the end of the nineteenth century and the officer must respond in cowardice for not having brought his men to the rescue of Colonel Custer during the battle of Little Big Horn, which ended in the carnage of the "blue jackets". Reno excuses himself by narrating the background of Custer's behavior, mainly dictated by his political aims and presumption.
notes: It was not yet the time of the "good Indians" for which the film, although laudable attempt to demythologize the figure of Custer, stops right where it should give the most embarrassing answers. Salkow's direction is flat.

title: U-Turn
actors: Sean Penn, Jennifer Lopez, Nick Nolte, Powers Boothe, Billy Bob Thornton
description: For a car breakdown, Bobby Cooper is forced to stop in Superior, a nearly abandoned mining town. Pushing the car towards the only gas station in the place, Bobby slips into an abyss where everything that appears normal turns into bizarre and dangerous. Here he meets the wrong woman, who is also married to the wrong man ...
notes: In the years following _Natural Born Killers_, Oliver Stone had a great desire for the grotesque. Too bad that here there is a lack of sense of proportion (and self-irony), it abounds in quotes (too many, for a single film) and ultimately transforms the film into a kind of "El Mariachi in Twin Peaks".

title: Magnificent of Obsession
actors: Irene Dunne, Robert Taylor, Charles Butterworth, Betty Furness
description: Two lives linked to a thread: that of a young scapegrated young millionaire and that of a famous doctor. Both risk death by drowning, but only one can be saved because the rescuers have only one equipment for artificial breathing. Salvation is up to the millionaire who, once restored, falls in love with the doctor's widow. Her superficial nature causes a misfortune to the woman. Only now he understands his mistakes and works to amend them.
notes: Lambiccato in moralizing intent, the film is supported by the sure talent of Stahl, a small master of the melodrama, in a staging that is not afraid to go over the top. Excellent work on the actors. The film was a success, but today the color Verisone shot by Douglas Sirk is more known in 1954 ("The magnificent obsession").

title: The Set-Up
actors: Robert Ryan, Audrey Totter, George Tobias, Wallace Ford
description: The boxer Stocker has more defeats than victories in his career which has now embarked on its downward path. The boxer is, however, always looking for the good fight in which to excel while his manager, a man of few scruples, and some bandits, his allies, have made money with clandestine bets on his defeats. When Stocker, disobeying the manager's orders, stands up and manages to obtain the desired victory, he will be brutally beaten to the point that he can no longer enter a ring.
notes: Among the best films of the boxing environment, with perfect rhythm and an excellent sense of suspense, it is shot in real time, locked in the ring and in the seventy minutes of the action.

title: Madri pericolose
actors: Delia Scala, Mina, Riccardo Garrone, Evi Maltagliati, Ave Ninchi
description: The sons, you know, "I know 'piezz' e core" and the daughters even more. Thus four mothers of various backgrounds, from the high-ranking and very rich Countess Improta, to the concierge of a public palace, to the fallen noble and without a penny, try to "settle" as many girls with interesting marriages or with less than precarious careers in the world of the spectacle. Of course, nothing will go according to the plans of the ladies, except that, twenty years later, the intolerant girls have themselves become "dangerous mothers".
notes: Rather silly and predictable comedy with two stars of the song and magazine of the time. For nostalgics and lovers of modernism.

title: Tango
actors: Miou-Miou, Philippe Noiret, Richard Bohringer, Thierry Lhermitte, Carole Bouquet
description: The protagonist of the film, married and very much in love with his wife, however, fails to be faithful to her for more than a week. When the woman discovers yet another betrayal, she first gives him tit for tat and then plants him on the spot. Like other times on similar occasions, the poor man goes to seek advice from an uncle, a bachelor, but very expert in matrimonial matters. The answer is only one: to kill the woman.
notes: The grotesque register shifts the story to the apologue. French touch, a little cutesy and boring.

title: Babylon
actors: Paolo Lorimer, Valeria Milillo, Bill Sage, Andrea Prodan
description: Francesco and Carla met at university and got married. While she decided to make a career and became an assistant in the same university, he, for ideological reasons, preferred to be a worker in order not to compromise with ideas that he does not share. This situation, however, creates some imbalance in the couple, especially when she, during a business trip to New York, has a brief relationship with a detective. Francesco, an extremist as always, then contemplates killing Carla ...
notes: After the good ideological-resistance thriller "The Martello case", Chiesa turns to a story of love complicated by ideology, but the result is less convincing. Excellent soundtrack with Italian ragamuffin 'and American punk rock.

title: J W Coop
actors: Cliff Robertson, Geraldine Page, Cristina Ferrare, R. G. Armstrong
description: The world of the American Rodeo leaves little room for improvisation and the champions who try to become such, usually, have a solid preparation. An adrift person who does not have too brilliant a character, however, is the protagonist of this film. His attempts to become a star of the Rodeo American circuit break against his character weaknesses. But gradually the boy proves capable of overcoming his problems and becoming a perfect cowboy.
notes: Good film, which despite the typically "western" topic, turns towards the comedy. Robertson directed, written and given the face to the main character.

title: The Happy Thieves
actors: Rex Harrison, Rita Hayworth, Joseph Wiseman, Gregoire Aslan, Alida Valli
description: Jim Bourne and Eva Lewis specialize in the theft of works of art which they manage to replace with cleverly counterfeit copies. While they are carrying out yet another blow, they realize that they have, in turn, been robbed by more enterprising thieves. They then decide to get in touch with them to design a sensational heist: stealing a painting by Goya kept in the Prado Museum in Madrid. To divert attention from the blow, which is scheduled for Sunday afternoon, the group plans to kill a famous bullfighter who is about to enter the plaza de toros.
notes: At times enjoyable, but a bit weak this film by George Marshall, shot entirely in Spain.

title: Great Expectations
actors: Ethan Hawke, Gwyneth Paltrow, Anne Bancroft, Hank Azaria, Robert De Niro
description: Finn Bell is eight years old and lives in a small town overlooking the Gulf of Florida with his sister Maggie and "uncle" Joe. Life is full of obstacles and difficulties, in short, it is hard, but little Finn, who dreams of becoming a successful painter, is happy with the simple life he leads. The boy spends all his time painting the splendid colors of the gulf. Finn's journey to maturity begins in a traumatic way with the sudden and shocking appearance of a dangerous fugitive who asks him to help him escape.
notes: Yet another version of Dickens' "Great Expectations" (remember Lena's version of '46), which was not felt the need. Paltrow is pretty and brave in one of her first important roles. Gigione and in Cape Fear version, the "character actor" De Niro.

title: L'appartement
actors: Monica Bellucci, Vincent Cassel, Romane Bohringer
description: Max is captured by a memory that does not let him sleep soundly. He is about to get married and one day he thinks he recognizes the voice of Lisa, a girl he had loved a few years before and decides to go in search of her. At one point, even five characters come into play and turn Max's adventure into too dangerous a game.
notes: Bellocci, a luxury emigrant now at home in Paris, as soon as she opens her mouth she collapses the film with strokes of amateur acting, thrilling diction and the transport of an awkward rookie. Luckily, here at his side are the sons of art Romane Bohringer (an Alice quivering with passion) and the life partner of the Italian actress Vincent (a slightly distracted Max, but still purebred). As for the director Mimouni, it is clear that he studied cinema: his history frequents old masters such as Hitchcock (the very much used "Window on the courtyard") and points of reference such as Bernardo Bertolucci (the cult "Last tango"), even if hired and development hijack (probably unwittingly) on the Cinema of Chance à la Claude Lelouch.

title: Thirty Door Key
actors: Iain Glen, Crispin Glover, Robert Stephens
description: The protagonist enters, at different times, in three societies: the school, the middle class and the aristocracy. Every time he leaves one of these social classes to move to another he leaves behind him a huge confusion, with people fighting and fighting. In short: a real little revolution. From a Polish classic of the '990s (by Witold Gombrowicz) Skolimowski draws an anarchic and sarcastic film, less overwhelming than his 60s films but still admirable.

title: The Boston Strangler
actors: Tony Curtis, Henry Fonda, George Kennedy, Mike Kellin
description: The city of Boston is terrified of a sex maniac who strangles mostly elderly, single women. On behalf of the Attorney General, John Bottomly takes over the direction of the investigations, which, however, lead to nothing. Following a false move, the alleged murderer finally ends up in the hands of the police, who despite having no definite evidence, have reason to hold him responsible for the crimes. It turns out that the man, Albert De Salvo, suffers from split personality and is convinced that he is innocent, because he does not remember what he did.
notes: Fleischer films his impressive story with absolute realism, making an innovative and exciting film. Tony Curtis's performance in counter-role was really good.

title: Mörderische Zwillinge
actors: Claudia Michelsen, Horst-Günther Marx, Thomas Balou Martin
description: Theresa and Michelle are two monozygotic twins linked by a strange interdependence relationship: exploiting the incredible similarity often and willingly exchange men without these, of course, they notice it. But one of the boyfriends dies from misfortune. The two girls, terrified, decide not to warn the police and get rid of the corpse by stageing an accident. But when Theresa meets Arnold, successful architect, and falls in love with him, Michelle loses her head and in an access of jealousy kills him. Revenge, which is not long in coming, drags the two sisters towards an increasingly frenetic vortex of blood.

title: The Little Rascals
actors: Travis Tedford, Bug Hall, Brittany Ashton Holmes, Whoopi Goldberg
description: Spanky and Alfalfa are two brats who are close friends who founded the Club of the Bitches Hatters. Their creed, however, is about to be shattered as Alfalfa courts the very young Darla. Spanky and associates are worried about him who must, among other things, drive their futuristic car in the annual go kart race. So they think of boycotting the romantic dinner with Darla by even setting fire to the place.
notes: Children transformed into monsters who pose as adults or, worse, teenagers. This mixture of languor and mischief, declined in the American way, unravels among the already worn-out days of Rintintin, appearances by Mel Brooks and humor of coarse grain. Dubbing exacerbates the film's flaws with bad timing.

title: Man of her Dreams
actors: William R. Moses, Lysette Anthony
description: Faith suspects her husband is cheating on her with another woman. So she decides to take revenge by sleeping with Walter, a client with whom, for some time, she had had a working relationship and who was secretly in love with her. But he soon realizes that he has made a mistake: in fact Walter does not want to abandon her, on the contrary he insists on continuing the relationship despite his constant refusals. Then, accidentally, or so it seems, Walter kills the neighbor, then the best friend and finally the husband of the woman, who had understood everything. Not content, he kidnaps Faith and leads her to a hidden and inaccessible place

title: Brassed Off
actors: Pete Postlethwaite, Tara Fitzgerald, Ewan McGregor, Jim Carter
description: A small community of miners tries to survive the crisis that is threatening the mining plants ...
notes: The film is a (dramatic) comedy that blends emotion and realism. The director and screenwriter Mark Herman is neither Mike Leigh nor Ken Loach, but that is the "school".

title: Good Will Hunting
actors: Robin Williams, Matt Damon, Stellan Skarsgård, Minnie Driver, Ben Affleck
description: Will is an orphan who has a difficult life of violence behind him, earns his living as a kitchen boy at MIT and is discovered solving complicated mathematical theorems. In fact, he has a prodigious memory and a brilliant propensity for mathematics, so Professor Lambeau decides to entrust him to the care of Sean McGuire, a psychologist friend.
notes: Abandoned the dark stories and the "borderline" characters that had characterized the beginnings, Van Sant after "To die" continues to climb along the easiest ridges of the comedy. This time it stages the story written by the two young protagonists Damon and Affleck in 1992, when they were students at Harvard. The final result of the story will be a compromise with a happy ending, as in the best Hollywood tradition, but certain moments of the confrontation between the analyst and the young patient touch the notes of emotion.

title: Midnight in the Garden of Good and Evil
actors: John Cusack, Kevin Spacey, Jude Law, Lady Chablis, Jack Thompson
description: In Savannah, in the state of Georgia, there is a painting, rather precious, but it is an overlay and its owner does not want to know what is underneath. There is a refined gentleman, with Fabergé eggs and ancient weapons, but in reality he is only a "rich new". There is a black servant who walks a dog that has been dead for years, and a white farmer who walks his flies (plus a bottle of poison that threatens to spill into the aqueduct). There's a black tramp doing voodoo around midnight in the cemetery. Then, one day, a shot sounds and there is a journalist, who is on the spot to do a report, who begins to investigate ...
notes: "Truth is like art: it is in the eye of the beholder," says one of the protagonists. Eastwood's film is also in the eye of the beholder: perhaps a thriller, perhaps (more likely) a devastating, underground ballad about the southern province: as the journalist who arrives there for a report and decides to stay there says, Savannah is " like _Via con vento_ mescaline ». The first part of the environment, of characters, of sinuous, questioning stalking of the camera is very beautiful. Unfortunately, the second is more tired: perhaps because we can't stand trial films anymore, but even Eastwood does not seem to care too much about the judicial aspect. Spacey's interpretation is chameleonic, while Cusack's is discreet and "functional". In the film there is a very funny gag: that of the ex-black waiter who walks a dog that is not there.

title: Al Massir
actors: Nour El Cherif, Laila Eloui, Mahmoud Hemeida, Safia El Emary
description: Cordoba, twelfth century. To meet the demands of the fundamentalist groups, Caliph Al Mansour orders that all the works of Averroes, a man of vast culture and commentator of Aristotle, be set on fire. His disciples, aided by the relatives of the great philosopher, decide to copy the manuscripts to take them safely out of Andalusia.
notes: It is the first film by Youssef Chahine, one of the most important filmmakers of our time, to have decent distribution in Italy: better late than never. And if it had to happen sooner or later, it's nice that it happened for "Al Massir" (awarded at Cannes '97 with a Palme d'Or for the career of the great Egyptian director), an anthem against all forms of fundamentalism and ideology and religious led by the extraordinary figure of the philosopher Averroè, a free thinker betrayed by his Caliph. But "Destiny" is not a film to be seen only for the things it says: in a whirlwind carousel of music and ballets that refer to Minnelli, Chahine draws his wonderful characters as his beloved Duvivier would have done. And, not satisfied, he immerses them in atmospheres between the western and the feuilleton.

title: The Boxer
actors: Daniel Day-Lewis, Emily Watson, Brian Cox, Daragh Donnelly
description: Danny and Maggie know what it's like to grow up in a city dominated by violence. The two, in fact, spent their adolescence and even fell in love in Belfast. They heard bullets whistling and bombs exploding in crowded pubs. It is only natural that Danny joined the Wrath and the same natural is that he was in prison. But fourteen years have passed since then and Danny has returned to his neighborhood. Maggie, however, in the meantime forgot about him, got married and had a child with her best friend. But Danny is back with a very specific purpose, to set up a gym where the boys learn to vent their hatred by fighting in the ring.
notes: It is honest, pacifist, rough and dubious as only a film about Ireland can be today (like about the former Yugoslavia, about Algeria, about the thousand wars of religion, race, culture that besiege the world). "The Boxer" is not about good anger and bad English, nor about good and bad anger, but about the exhaustion of a now "infinite" war. Jim Sheridan, in his third collaboration with Daniel Day-Lewis (who is really very good in a proletarian part, in subdued and not so fascinating), rightly mutes this story of people trying to start living again muted. The caution, unfortunately, extinguishes a little the cinematic force, despite the intensity of all the performers and the truly extraordinary and razor-sharp photography of Chris Menges.

title: Gambit
actors: Shirley MacLaine, Michael Caine, Herbert Lom, Roger C. Carmel
description: Harry Dean, an adventurer, and Emile Fournier, a sculptor, for a reward of five thousand dollars, manage to get the collaboration of Nicole Chang, an entraîneuse, who looks strikingly like the deceased wife of the billionaire Shahbandar, to score a blow. The plan, studied in detail, consists in stealing a precious Chinese ceramic statue that is kept in the billionaire's apartment. Thanks to the help of Nicole who ensnares Shahbandar the theft succeeds and the three friends find themselves in Emile's studio in Hong Kong, but ...
notes: Guaranteed fun for a film that immediately turns into yellow-pink comedy tones. The three main actors are delightful.

title: Spawn
actors: Melinda Clark, Martin Sheen, Theresa Randle, Michael Jai White, John Leguizamo
description: Five years after being murdered by American intelligence colleagues, Al Simmons makes a pact with the devil to return to earth and see Wanda, the woman of his life. Al is resurrected in the guise of Spawn, a knight of darkness with a disfigured face with the task of leading the devil's army in the destruction of the human race.
notes: Based on the comic of the same name designed by Todd McFarlane, the frilm vaguely resembles "The Crow", a cult film also derived from a comic strip. But it completely lacks that dark atmosphere that was the winning feature of "The Crow", replaced by a riot of digital effects. Among the performers, a Martin Sheen has become a caricature of himself.

title: Il macellaio
actors: Alba Parietti, Miki Manojlovic, Lorenzo Majnoni, Rosa Pianeta, Giulio Base
description: Alina is a brilliant and full of initiative woman who directs an aviation art gallery in Palermo. Her husband Daniele, established conductor, cultured and intelligent, is not a fixed presence. One day, in accompanying Daniele to the airport, Alina warns a sense of emptiness. He will try to fill him with an always playful and prodigal butcher of erotic allusions that arouses a strong attraction in her.
notes: In listening to the brazen declarations of Parietti and Grimaldi ("ours is an author nude ... psychological" and away delighting) remains a strong sense of sadness. Is this Italian cinema to defend?.

title: The True Story of Jesse James
actors: Robert Wagner, Jeffrey Hunter, Hope Lange, Agnes Moorehead
description: Jess James' gang storms Northfield's bank, but only Jess, his brother Frank and another outlaw are saved from the group. Frank has a quarrel with his brother, whom he complains of having lost the ideals that had inspired his action in previous years. In the aftermath of the Civil War, the two James brothers, who fought with the Southerners, find themselves in misery. Together with other men from the South, they decide to give life to a new gang that attacks the banks overflowing with northern money.
notes: Nicholas Ray signs the remake of Henry King's 1938 "Jesse James". As in "Scorched Youth" and his other films of those years, there is a strong generational charge coupled with a strongly expressive style. Particularly the use of color in a symbolic sense, Ray was however discarded during the assembly.

title: Sins of Silence
actors: Lindsay Wagner, Holly Marie Combs, Sea, McCann, Victor Argo
description: Sophie, sixteen, lives alone with her widowed father. At night he sneaks out of the house and goes to have fun in out-of-the-way bars where he meets and flirts with many guys. Once she meets Tommy Bickley, a scion of the richest and most powerful family in town. The two start spinning, but when he asks her to have sex she refuses. At the exit of the club Tommy follows and rapes her. For fear of her father, the girl does not give her personal details to the police, but luckily in the hospital she meets Molly, a former nun who runs a center for rape victims. The prosecutor accuses the boy, but his defenders, highly prestigious lawyers, with a technicality get Molly's imprisonment for reticence. At that point Sophie, to save the only person who helped her, agrees to appear in court with her real name and to undergo a trial full of traps.

title: Twisted Desire
actors: Melissa Joan Hart, Daniel Baldwin, Jeremy Jordan, Isabella Hoffman
description: Jennifer Stanton is a beautiful girl, a true "star" of the school she attends. With her boyfriend Brad, captain of the institute's football team, she forms a perfect couple, admired and undivided by all. However, Jennifer's parents are too apprehensive and obsessive with the girl: they never lose sight of her, they control her every move and hinder the relationship with Brad. Tired of the situation, the latter leaves Jenny who thus enters a depressive crisis. To distract her from disappointment comes Nick, a little good. When Jenny's father discovers this new bond, it's in pain. The girl and her boyfriend thus decide to get rid of her parents once and for all ...

title: The Story of Esther Costello
actors: Joan Crawford, Rossano Brazzi, Heather Sears, Estelle Brody
description: Following the accidental explosion of a bomb, a girl loses sight, hearing and speech. Five years pass and the girl is adopted by Margaret, a wealthy lady from Boston. To alleviate the unhappiness of her protégé, the woman enrolls her at the Atlantic Institute, where Esther learns to express herself with the sign language of the deaf and dumb, to read and write. His case, disclosed in the press, moves America. Drammone works the lines of little interest, with a Crawford out of the way.

title: Reunion
actors: Jason Robards, Christien Anholt, Samuel West, Françoise Fabian
description: Henry Strauss, a naturalized American Jew, travels from New York to Germany to look after some assets inherited from the family, but above all to find out what happened after 1933 to his schoolmate and friend Konradin. A nobleman from a German family and an advocate of National Socialism, Konradin lost track of him, just at the moment when Henry - whose real name was Hans - was sent to the United States to escape racial persecution. Memories of yesteryear emerge with arrogance in his memory.
notes: Based on one of the three books that make up Fred Uhlman's trilogy, Jerry Schatzberg's film is moving. Good script by Harold Pinter.

title: Keoma
actors: Franco Nero, Olga Karlatos, Woody Strode, William Berger
description: After the Civil War, the half-breed Keoma, the son of a white and a red man, returns to Skidoo City, his hometown that he finds plagued by the plague and prey to the men of Captain Caldwell, including his three half-brothers: Butch , Sam and Lenny who hate him like Caldwell himself, who has prevented him from confining a young pregnant widow among the plague victims. On her side she has only her father and George, a black childhood friend.
notes: Conventional like most of Castellari's films. Keoma does not stray from the usual avengers who have crowded the Italian westerns.

title: Perdonami
actors: Raf Vallone, Antonella Lualdi, Tamara Lees
description: Stefano, misled by bad companies, participates in a theft in a warehouse located in the port of Genoa. Caught in the act by the police, the thieves flee but one of them shoots and kills the caretaker. To escape capture, Stefano flees to Venezuela, also because his mother and his young sister Anna are convinced that he was the one who shot. Marco, the brother of the slain guardian, arrives in Genoa with the intention of avenging him, but falls in love with Anna.
notes: In the year in which Raffaello Matarazzo was shooting "Giuseppe Verdi", Mario Costa, an honest craftsman, follows in his footsteps by offering the public a melò in his own way.

title: Mother Teresa: In the Name of God's Poor
actors: Geraldine Chaplin, Keene Curtis, Helena Carroll, David Byrd
description: In a Catholic convent in post-war Calcutta, Mother Teresa, a thirty-six-year-old nun of Albanian origin, is the governess of some middle-class boys. These are the turbulent months of independence from English rule and the fierce clashes between Hindus and Muslims. When the convent is short of food, with a sister she goes out in search of food and here she comes into contact with the terrible reality of the very poor who are dying of hunger on the street. Returning to the convent walls, Mother Teresa is no longer the same. She left the order she belonged to and founded another one: the Missionaries of Charity. It is the beginning of a life entirely dedicated to the last of the Earth that culminated with the Nobel Peace Prize and death in the odor of sanctity.
notes: Mild and superficial Santino made for TV.

title: Figli di Annibale
actors: Silvio Orlando, Diego Abatantuono, Valentina Cervi, Ugo Conti, Elena Giove, Flavio Insinna, Gianluca Gobbi, Enrico Salimbeni, Pietro Ghislandi, Caterina Sylos Labini
description: The unemployed Domenico (Orlando) as an accomplice for a robbery had chosen a cat, but abandoned the feline in front of the cashier, when he has to leave the bank he is forced to take a hostage and runs into Tommaso (Abatantuono), an entrepreneur who does not see the time to change your life. And that drags him, in fact, to Puglia instead of Switzerland.
notes: Built on a screenplay (by Ferrario and Abatantuono) that has the strength to sacrifice both comic and introspective excesses, it is above all a film of bodies in spaces, in landscapes that we no longer know, illuminated by lights and colors that escape folklore to rediscover a mental suggestion, fantastic. If "All Down to Earth" referred in some arabesque way to Lindsay Anderson and her anger, this is reminiscent of the melancholy and popular swagger of John Ford's comedy.

title: Le Coeur fantôme
actors: Luis Rego, Aurelia Alcais, Maurice Garrel, Evelyne Didi, Roschdy Zem, Camille Chain, Lucie Rego, Véronique Silver, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Johanna Ter Steege
description: Philippe is a Parisian painter who leads what is called a "bourgeois life" with his family of three other people: his wife and two children. One day Philippe discovers that his wife is cheating on him and the two separate. He soon meets a young woman with whom he could rebuild a life, but he feels guilty for abandoning his children and this anguish prevents him from working. He talks about it with his father, unconsciously driven by the desire to discover the reason that led his parents to separate when he was a child.

title: Transformation
actors: Anthony Barnao, Michael C. Hennessy, Lisa Langlois, Patrick Macnee
description: An intergalactic pilot tries to block the spread of a deadly virus that could lead to the destruction of all life in the Universe.
notes: Jay Kamen's film belongs more to that kind of films than to the science fiction genre that mix the least worst science fiction and horror. It is better not to talk about the actors, as well as the direction. Real cinema is, fortunately, something else.

title: Anche gli angeli tirano di destro
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Ricky Bruch, Laura Becherelli, Dominic Barto
description: Sunny, young and broke, dreams of becoming a fearsome gangster able to force the bosses of the underworld to give him part of their shady business. As fate would have it, Sunny gets her hands on four fake passports intended, in reality, for Joe the Tiger and his men who have escaped from prison. Posing as the person who has to deliver them, Sunny gets, as a reward, control of a street in New York, Mulberry Street, which also overlooks a boxing gym.
notes: Ricky Bruch makes Bud Spencer, star of the first film in the series, regret, and Enzo Barboni, aka E. B. Clucher, makes you regret directing. Usual soundtrack by Guido and Maurizio De Angelis.

title: Fra Diavolo
actors: Stan Laurel, Oliver Hardy, Dennis King, Thelma Todd, James Finlayson
description: Laurel and Hardy are forced to turn into fearsome bandits to try to recover the money that was stolen from them. On their way, however, they find Fra 'Diavolo (King), a fierce delinquent leader of a band of brigands, who will save their lives only if he helps them rob Lord Rockburg (Finlayson).
notes: One of the couple's most famous feature films which, however, keeps the brilliant duo a bit in the background to follow the thread of Aubert's comic opera to which it is inspired. Famous is the scene of irrepressible laughter and the skill game with the hands that Ollio cannot learn.

title: Il bigamo
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Vittorio De Sica, Franca Valeri, Memmo Carotenuto
description: The life of Mario De Santis, sales representative, husband of Valeria and father of a child, is turned upside down by the accusation of bigamy. In fact, the police station shows that a few years earlier he married a certain Isolina in Forlimpopoli. Confronted with Mario, the woman recognizes him as her legitimate spouse. Faced with this situation, the man loses his head and, in anger, becomes aggressive, loses control and ends up under arrest.
notes: A more bluntly comic Emmer than usual. The interpretation of Mastroianni and that of Memmo Carotenuto are unforgettable, the number of De Sica lawyer hilarious. Appearances of Salvo Randone and Gianni Minervini, future producer.

title: Titanic
actors: Clifton Webb, Barbara Stanwyck, Audrey Dalton, Robert Wagner, Richard Basehart
description: Under the pretext of taking a vacation, Giulia embarks with her children Annette and Norman on the ocean liner Titanic departing from the port of Southampton for her maiden voyage. In reality, her aim is to save the two children from the influence of her husband Richard. The man, however, realizing the situation manages to find a place on the ship. Giulia tells her husband that Norman is not her son, but the result of an occasional adventure. Meanwhile, the cursed night of April 14 (and the iceberg) is approaching.
notes: The dramatic event remains in the background overwhelmed by good feelings. However the film an Oscar for screenplay took him home.

title: Calibro 38
actors: Robert Hossein, Claude Mann, Claudine Coster, Lily Bistrattyn
description: On Christmas Eve, two hit men break into the home of a wealthy businessman and kill him together with his secretary. A few days pass and a stewardess is murdered in the same way. The police chief instructs the young Lieutenant Claude who works on the Homicide Squad to investigate. Penetrated into a night club at the center of suspicions, Claude is insulted and beaten. Following this episode, Claude takes the opportunity to have two of the men who attacked him arrested. When he is about to question them, the lawyer Bianchini, one of the celebrities of the Parisian court, intervenes and threatens the lieutenant to cause a scandal.

title: Totò che visse due volte
actors: Marcello Miranda, Salvatore Gattuso, Carlo Giordano, Pietro Arcidiacono
description: Paletta is a man made fun of by everyone and perpetually humiliated who tries, unsuccessfully, to give vent to his insatiable sexual desire. The arrival of the prostitute Tremmotori pushes him to the theft of the votive shrine of the Ecce Homo. He'll have to deal with the neighborhood boss. Around the deathbed of a middle-aged homosexual: the mother waits for Fefé, the elderly lover of her son, to show up. Lazzaro, a mobster belonging to a losing clan is dissolved in acid by Don Totò. In the meantime, an old Messiah is wandering around and it is to him that Lazarus' family members turn to for the resurrection.
notes: Divided into three episodes that intertwine places and characters, constructed through images of absolute compositional cleanliness, "Totò" is the exact opposite of all the cheap merchandise that image supermarkets offer every day. Strictly auteur films (of those that one still needs to have the courage to make, to produce and to go and see), caught between the abysmal pain of Pasolini and the rending ferocity of Buñuel, it has a hard certainty of framing, fading and editing. which brings to mind Scorsese. Tried for outrage against religion, the film's authors were acquitted in 2001.

title: Flubber
actors: Robin Williams, Marcia Gay Harden, Clancy Brown
description: Philip Brainard is such a distracted professor that he forgot, twice, to show up at the altar to marry his fiancée. Assisted by an overprotective robot named Weebo, the professor is working on a substance that could become a new source of energy. On the day of Brainard's third marriage attempt, the attempts finally seem to materialize into a green, rubbery substance.
notes: Nineties version of "A Professor in the Clouds" from 1961, with Robin Williams in the role of Fred MacMurray. The good feelings and the funny gimmick of the robot that speaks with the images of old films, however, are not enough to sustain a mild rhythm (and too verbose dialogues), to which the plastic cartoon comedy of the Flubber (green and similar to a blob), who in the second part becomes a full-fledged character.

title: Eve's Bayou
actors: Jurnee Smollett, Samuel L. Jackson, Meagan Good, Debbi Morgan, Lynn Whitfield, Diahann Carroll
description: Eve Batiste is ten years old and lives with her family near Eve's Bayou, a country town in the middle of the forest that covers the state of Louisiana. The little girl has a great admiration for her father Louis, the highly respected doctor of the city, but the admiration gives way to a feeling of hatred when she discovers that Louis has extramarital affairs with his patients. Hatred drives her to the point of turning to a priestess who practices voodoo rites.
notes: Black ambient film characterized by a great search for formal elegance that in the long run can seem cloying.

title: The Bachelor Party
actors: E. G. Marshall, Don Murray, Jack Warden, Philip Abbott, Larry Blyden, Carolyn Jones, Patricia Smith
description: Five friends, who work as accountants for a large firm, decide to celebrate the bachelor party of one of them. The evening's program is developed by Eddie, a staunch bachelor, who has a reputation for being an expert in nightclubs and carefree nights out. The group wants to have fun, but melancholy and anxiety soon take over. It is Arnold, the birthday boy, who is worried about the idea of ??the next wedding. Classic teleplay written by Paddy Chayefsky, realistic and psychologically sharp, but a little wordy.

title: Yield to the Night
actors: Diana Dors, Yvonne Mitchell, Michael Craig, Marie Ney
description: Mary, saleswoman in a perfume shop, married to a man of a certain age he does not like, meets Jim, a pianist. The love was born between the two who, at first procures to the two lovers serene hours, but when Jim falls in love with Lucy, things begin to get hurt. For Mary then the pain is more atrocious because Lucy does not correspond to Jim's passion. From the true story of the last woman condemned to death in England, an intense and sober drama, held by Diana Dors.

title: On connaît la chanson
actors: Pierre Arditi, Sabine Azéma, André Dussollier, Agnès Jaoui, Jean-Pierre Bacri
description: Simon secretly loves Camille. Due to a misunderstanding, Camille falls in love with Marc, a charming real estate agent and Simon's boss, who tries to sell an apartment to Odile, Camille's sister. Odile decided to buy the apartment despite the mute disapproval of her husband, Claude.
notes: Resnais (born in 1922), captures its greatest commercial success. Two million admissions at home, 7 César, Louis Delluc award for best film of the year and Silver Bear in Berlin '98. In the kaleidoscope of love, men and women chase each other, quarrel, reconcile and, hilariously, sing in recorded playback of thirty-six French songs, ironic counterpoints a la Demy that break abruptly and sweetly emphasize the romantic and sentimental dialogues. All this is also thanks to the couple of actors and screenwriters Agnès Jaoui (Camille) and Jean-Pierre Bacri (Nicolas), former accomplices of Resnais "Smoking / No Smoking".

title: The Game
actors: Michael Douglas, Sean Penn, Deborah Kara Unger, Armin Mueller-Stahl
description: Nicholas Van Horton is a very successful businessman who is used to keeping every aspect of his investments in check. His life, all too tidy, suddenly changes course when his brother Conrad, on the occasion of his birthday, organizes a surprise for him, a real role-playing game. As soon as he enters the game, Nicholas realizes that the risks are very high and discovers that he is being kept under control, even inside his home, by unknown conspirators who want to annihilate him.
notes: The idea would be: an almost "simulation" game, but from the real thing. A fatal, possibly deadly game, in which you don't know where the simulation ends and where reality begins. There would also be talent: director David Fincher has shown that he can master beautiful atmospheres suspended between fantasy and perversion, in "Alien 3" and "Seven"; Sean Penn is perfect in those ambiguous characters, who you never know which side to place, and Deborah Unger ("Crash") is certainly enigmatic.
