Yet "The Game" doesn't work; from a certain point on we don't care that much to know if it is fiction or reality and, all in all, the story takes the pace of the usual "action" succession. The problem of the film is the star: Michael Douglas, constantly kept in the foreground to "simulate" (he does) arrogance, then doubt, insecurity, perhaps terror. With only one expression, the usual one in which his jaw contracts. Too much uncertainty for one man.

title: Amistad
actors: Matthew McConaughey, Morgan Freeman, Dijmon Hounsou, Anthony Hopkins, Nigel Hawthorne, David Paymer, Pete Postlethwaite, Stellan Skarsgård, Peter Firth, Jeremy Northam, Arliss Howard, Anna Paquin, Razaaq Adoti, Abu Bakaar Fofanah, Darren Burrows, Tomas Milian, Michael Massee, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Allan Rich, Paul Guilfoyle
description: A group of slaves from the Mendi tribe of Sierra Leone reached Havana aboard a Portuguese ship. On the Caribbean island they are bought by the Spaniards, then boarded on the Amistad headed for Puerto Principe. But the slaves rebel, triggering a diplomatic crisis
notes: The first part of Spielberg's film is tense and partially dialogue-free. But the suggestion of slowly learned languages, of the contradictions between a "natural" value system and one codified by law, does not blend well with the historical apparatus. The explanations and the process weigh down the dramatic force of the film.

title: The Full Monty
actors: Robert Carlyle, Tom Wilkinson, Mark Addy, Paul Barber
description: In spite of the difficulties and thanks to a boundless determination, six proletarian losers find themselves preparing a number of stripteases.
notes: Certainly the film is superficial and playful, its end captivating, its comic development too engaging. In short, the film appears too studied to leave room for other considerations and insights. Yet it is one of those films that our cinema today can only envy to English cinema: above all because, without missing a joke, it manages to tell a story without pretensions, but linked to real environments and crises. A film not so much of direction (Cattaneo has worked mainly on TV), but of script (impeccable) and performers (enthralling).

title: Gattaca
actors: Ethan Hawke, Uma Thurman, Jude Law, Gore Vidal, Xander Berkeley, Jayne Brook, Elias Koteas, Maya Rudolph, Una Damon, Elizabeth Dennehy, Blair Underwood, Mason Gamble, Vincent Nielson, Chad Christ, William Lee Scott
description: In the near future, Vincent is determined to rebel against his genetic fate which condemns him to a bleak and dreamless life. Since he was a child he discovered that he was different, from the day he learned that the world he lives in is dominated by beings conceived in test tubes. This species also includes his brother Anton who possesses the genes of success and an iron health. Quite the opposite of Vincent which is the typical example of genetic inferiority.
notes: The fascinating film written and directed by the young Niccol plays on the differences between "valid" and "invalid", with Ethan Hawke who dreams of impossible astral shores and social emancipations that can only be reached through "fiscal" fraud and psychophysical mutations. The icy and Hitchcokian Uma Thurman discovers the trick, but decides to love the boy anyway, also because passion really broke out on the convict set.

title: Coppia omicida
actors: Raoul Bova, Raz Degan, Laura Morante, Francesca Schiavo
description: Dario and Luciana, recently married, are childless and lead a quiet life. One day they meet Carla and Domenico, affectionate petty bourgeois during the day, crazy killers at night, ready to carry out a carnage in the center to eliminate a witness. The first impulse is to call the police, but Dario and Luciana slowly become involved in the game run by a third character, cold and sensual.
notes: The Bonnie and Clyde model, moved to present-day Italy and with many close-ups to enhance Bova and Degan. Fragasso (who comes from the school of Italian action movies) creates the action sequences with a ballistic precision that has nothing to envy to the Americans. Unfortunately, however, to see this skill wasted by a crude screenplay, banal dialogues and the bad use of an actress like Laura Morante.

title: Das Versprechen
actors: Meret Becker, Corinna Harfouch, Eva Mattes, Susanne Ugé
description: A few months after the erection of the Berlin Wall, the young Sophie and a group of friends manage to pass West through the sewers. Konrad, Sophie's boyfriend, however, slips and does not have time to slip into the manhole that saves all the others. The story unfolds throughout the Cold War, hinting at the Prague Spring and the subsequent restoration. Konrad and Sophie still manage to meet again a few times, and even conceive a child. The three will finally be able to reunite, thirty years after the flight, when Germany reunites.
notes: Always sensitive to the calls of great history, Von Trotta creates yet another micro-history in the female, heavy and confused.

title: Il terrore dell'Oklahoma
actors: Maurizio Arena, Delia Scala, Alberto Bonucci, Valeria Moriconi, Mario Carotenuto
description: The border village called Rio Placido has its name in mind, such is the quiet life of its inhabitants. However, such peace is upset by the arrival of some outlaws, attracted by a rich gold mine located nearby. With the usual violent methods, the bandits try to induce the peaceful villagers to leave the place: but they do not intend to give in to blackmail and hire a skilled and determined gunslinger known as "The terror of Oklahoma" ...
notes: Self-sufficient Western a few years ahead of the "spaghetti" trend. Some beautiful names of the brilliant Italian theater show themselves for purely "food" reasons.

title: His Kind of Woman
actors: Robert Mitchum, Jane Russell, Vincent Price, Tim Holt, Raymond Burr, Charles McGraw
description: A gangster expelled from the United States takes refuge in Mexico where he assumes the identity of a young man who has been ruined at the green table. The young man meets and falls in love with an adventurer who is in a relationship with an actor. Meanwhile, the gangster ...
notes: Good job, with ironic parody tones of Mitchumian noir like "The chains of the copla", shot by Mia Farrow's father with a princely cast (particularly funny Price) that alone guarantees the result.

title: Aprile
actors: Nanni Moretti, Silvio Orlando, Silvia Nono, Pietro Moretti, Angelo Barbagallo, Daniele Luchetti, Corrado Stajano
description: It has nothing to do with it, but it has to do with it. The leaders of our left, when they were young in the Fgci, stopped everything to watch Fonzie in "Happy Days". What does it have to do with their political formation? It has nothing to do with it. But, says Nanni Moretti with a faint smile, it has something to do with it. It has nothing to do and everything has to do (from the covers of the Espresso to the television), in what we are or have become. Where, for once, a great private victory (becoming parents) can correspond to a hypothesis of public victory.
notes: Film in souplesse, where the doubts, the hesitations, the anxieties of an author-parent-citizen have taken the place of the screamed anger and the dull pain of "Palombella rossa" and "Caro diario".

title: Boogie Nights
actors: Burt Reynolds, Mark Wahlberg, Heather Graham, Julianne Moore, William H. Macy, John C. Reilly, Don Cheadle, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Luis Guzmán, Robert Ridgely, Ricky Kay, Jack Wallace, Nicole Ari Parker, Melora Walters, Philip Baker Hall, Thomas Jane, Alfred Molina, Joanna Gleason
description: Jack Horner runs a stable of porn actors and is convinced that even a hardcore film must have a credible story. But the money he earns ends soon as do the cocaine runs and the glasses of margheridas that his actors consume by his swimming pool. The 1980s will bring Reagan's presidency, the decline of alternative culture and a greater focus on money to be earned now.
notes: Locked up in a decade (starting in 1977 and ending in the mid-1980s) and a handful of parties, "Boogie Nights", written and directed by 27-year-old Anderson, is not a "sex" film and, despite being all set in the porn movie industry that was, it's not even a "sex" movie. It is a film about interpersonal relationships, about extended families that in the 1970s replaced "official" families with their tender tolerance, about the "fall", cynicism and disillusionment, but also about the possibility of "recovery" through solidarity, of that patchy and rambling family. It is a film that tastes of the 70s not only for the setting, but above all for the circulating moods and for the stylistic choice, perfectly consistent with these moods: more Altman than Tarantino.

title: Naja
actors: Enrico Lo Verso, Stefano Accorsi, Francesco Siciliano, Claudia Pandolfi, Lorenzo Amato, Adelmo Togliani
description: Five soldiers were handed over to the barracks for vandalism. Tonino is forced to skip the rendezvous with Bruna, his girlfriend. Franco is the "grandfather". Carmelo is sure of himself. Claudio is mocked for his effeminacy. Luca has serious family problems.
notes: The prolific Longoni relies on one of his plays with a wide consensus and on a group of artistic and / or famous children. It is enough for him to reshape his five characters on the films he has seen and on the clichés.

title: Rosamunde Pilcher: Wilder Thymian
actors: Muriel Baumeister, Michael Roll, Helmut Zierl, Karl Heinz Vosgerau
description: At a fashion show, Victoria meets John, a businessman who begins to court her. But she denies herself because on the same occasion she found Oliver, the one she believes is the true love of her life. Victoria and Oliver leave together but with them there is also Tommy, Oliver's son who is two years old. Upon arriving at a country estate, Victoria discovers that Tommy has been kidnapped from his grandparents' home. Meanwhile John ...

title: Rosamunde Pilcher: Wechselspiel der Liebe
actors: Stephanie Philipp, Gudrun Okras, Ulrike Kriener, Pascal Breuer
description: Wishing to grant the wish of her mother, elderly and sick, who has asked to see him for the last time, Isabel has her nephew Anthony call from London along with Rose, his fiancée. However, Rose does not want to leave because in the country of origin of her fiancé, in Scotland, she had a history that was not exactly clear. When he accidentally meets Flora, who looks strikingly like her, he begins to suspect he has a twin. At this point Rose convinces her to take his place. Flora does not understand where this deception will lead her, but she is pushed to accept because she feels a very strong bond with that mysterious girl who looks so much like her. Although in love with Dr. Hugh Kyle, Flora will still pretend to be Rose, until the doctor discovers her secret. Will he be able to forgive her?
notes: This TV movie is part of the series called "Rosamunde Pilcher Collection" from the name of the famous English writer of romance novels. The British equivalent of our Liala. A name, a guarantee.

title: The Babe
actors: John Goodman, Kelly McGillis, Trini Alvarado, Bruce Boxleitner
description: The film tells the story of American baseball champion Babe Ruth (John Goodman) who was active and hugely popular in the 1920s and 1930s. It was he who brought his sport back to the top of popularity in the US. An abandoned child, a lover of the table and women, he had sometimes quite bitter conflicts with the authorities and his own fans.
notes: Despite the appearances certainly not athletic Goodman makes the character well.

title: Every 9 Seconds
actors: Gail O'Grady, Amy Pietz, Michael Riley, Emily Hampshire, Scott Speedman
description: A journalist who wants to understand the problems of women who suffer violence goes to work as a voluntary operator of a "pink telephone". At one point he receives a call from a woman who, after having recounted the violence suffered repeatedly by her husband, says she wants to take revenge by killing him. The reporter tries to track down the woman to prevent her from committing the crime. When he finally manages to reach her, in her house, her husband, suddenly returned, threatens both women with a weapon ...
notes: The film directed by Kenneth Fink does not differ much from the usual American TV movies. Virtually unknown actors for stories that are useful to open the debate after the screening.

title: Summer City
actors: Mel Gibson, Phillip Avalon, Steven Bisley
description: We are in the "mythical" Sixties, a time of the collapse of taboos and bloodless social (and sexual) revolutions. To the rhythm of the songs of the "Beatles" and the "Rolling Stones", four friends leave for the sea with the intention of taking a holiday full of transgression. However, not everything goes as expected and the tragic fate also puts a hand in it.
notes: A Mel Gibson to the prehistory of his career doesn't do much good for the film.

title: Hero's Island
actors: James Mason, Neville Brand, Kate Manx, Rip Torn
description: A family of former slaves consisting of a father, mother and two children, gets to move to a fishing village to start a new life. With them there is also a friend, willing to help the father in his work. Two brothers also live on the island who want to drive out the newcomers. First they kill the head of the family, but the widow still decides to stay. Then it's the friend's turn, but in the meantime the persecuted family has welcomed a castaway who, at this point, decides to intervene against the evil persecutors.
notes: Dry and robust film, it would let itself be seen more effectively if it weren't for some slowness too much.

title: Where Angels Fear to Tread
actors: Helena Bonham Carter, Judy Davis, Helen Mirren, Giovanni Guidelli, Rupert Graves
description: Widowed, with a nine-year-old girl, the beautiful 33-year-old Lilia Herrington decides to leave England to spend a holiday in Tuscany with her friend Caroline. An overly authoritarian mother-in-law, a spinster sister-in-law and her brother Philip try in vain to make her change her mind. With great scandal of the Lilia family who arrived in Monteriano where she married Gino Carella, an Italian citizen younger than her and, above all, of modest extraction.
notes: Based on a Forster novel, the film is not directed by Ivory, but by the more modest Charles Sturridge, and one feels why the film immediately dies of an excess of elegance.

title: Samba Traoré
actors: Bakary Sangaré, Samba Mariam Kaba, Saratou Komboutri
description: Two men carry out a robbery, but are intercepted by the police. One is killed, the other manages to escape with the money. Back in the village, the bandit finds the girl he loved. The two get back together and get married. But when she has to deliver their baby, she needs a hospital. The husband does not know whether to take his wife to the city and risk being arrested or stay in the village and risk her life. Dry and without rhetoric (not even that of the fairy tale), an African apologue with an eye to European and even American cinema. Credible and exciting, he won the Silver Bear in Berlin.

title: Acto da primavera
actors: Attori non professionisti
description: In the Iberian Peninsula, the rites of Holy Week in almost every city and town take on highly spectacular connotations, often linked to a very ancient heritage.
notes: The director Manoel De Oliveira, the most important master of Portuguese cinema, has "reinterpreted" the Passion of Christ starting from a late medieval sacred drama staged by the population of a village.

title: Tainted Love
actors: Doug Jeffrey, Lee Anne Beaman, Granville Ames
description: A serial killer is in action in the city. With incredible coldness and extraordinary determination he strikes how and when he wants, despite the general alarm having mobilized legions of policemen. In the killer 's sights there are always young and beautiful girls so much so that in the investigative offices it is decided to entrust the most delicate part of the investigation to a young undercover policewoman, able to act as bait. With great courage, the detective sneaks into the circles of the underworld, but in the meantime she meets a rich and unscrupulous businessman. It will be the meeting of life, but not in the sense that you believe ...
notes: If the writers of this film had seen Benigni's "The Monster" ...

title: The Man in the Iron Mask
actors: Leonardo DiCaprio, Jeremy Irons, John Malkovich, Gérard Depardieu, Gabriel Byrne
description: The musketeers are now elderly and fathers of families: D'Artagnan faithfully serves his king, Porthos runs after women, Aramis devotes himself to religion, Athos looks proudly at his son who makes a military career. In the dungeons, meanwhile, a sad and mysterious prisoner languishes, while the young king tyrannizes the people and runs after the skirts. The musketeers lead the revolt, but D'Artagnan (for reasons that should be understood in the end, but immediately understood) is on the other side.
notes: Apparently the pace is wild, but everything is so predictable as to induce numbness. DiCaprio is effectively magnetic in a dual role but never takes off. The luxury invitations of the four musketeers are above all decorative. Moments of involuntary humor during the final acknowledgments. To make a good costume film it takes another hand.

title: O que é isso, companheiro?
actors: Alan Arkin, Pedro Cardoso, Fernanda Torres, Luiz Fernando Guimaraes
description: In September 1969 a group of young Brazilian idealists who are fighting the dictatorship kidnap the American ambassador in exchange for the release of fifteen "comrades" tortured in maximum security prisons. Despite the amateurism, the revolutionaries succeed in their intent: the diplomat is released and the political prisoners sent, as requested, to Mexico.
notes: The true story is derived from the novel "O que è isso, companheiro?" of the journalist Fernando Gabeira, at the time one of the members of the commando author of the sensational abduction. How the Academy Award members managed to nominate this boring, television heavy-footed film for foreign Oscars '98 will remain a mystery. Only one moment of tension, in almost two hours of projection: the ambassador's gaze) towards the jailer.

title: Abbiamo solo fatto l'amore
actors: Daniele Liotti, Valerio Mastandrea, Iaia Forte, Simona Marchini
description: Simone works as a waiter in a dining car and serves the home-made dishes that the chef Rocco prepares. Simone has a rather serious problem, he made love to Silvia in the car, without a condom and now Silvia is expecting a baby. She goes to great lengths not to have an abortion, while he tries to convince her otherwise. Anguished, Simone witnesses the various stories that intertwine on the train.
notes: The second feature film by Fulvio Ottaviano, director of "The artichokes in Mimongo will grow up", "lives" within this old, worn-out and now unbearable frame. The curtains of the various characters take place on the train, because Simone works in the dining car of a pendulum. Actors forced by the script to act over the top in search of a grotesque stunted and unable to give birth to jokes and situations. Minimalism at the "highest" levels, precooked ideas and lost actors. Not even Mastandrea is enough.

title: Mussolini ultimo atto
actors: Rod Steiger, Franco Nero, Lisa Gastoni, Lino Capolicchio, Giuseppe Addobbati
description: With the fall of the Gothic Line in the spring of 1945, the situation in Northern Italy is this: the allies head towards Milan, the partisans spread and the Nazis retreat to Merano. Mussolini, very uncertain about what to do and supported by the hierarchs who remained at his side, refuses the mediation of Cardinal Schuster and from the Lombard capital goes to Valtellina where thousands of black shirts await him.
notes: Diligent, but chilly chronicle. Rod Steiger plays a bit too much. Music by Ennio Morricone.

title: Metropolitan
actors: Carolyn Farina, Edward Clements, Christopher Eigeman, Allison Rutledge-Parisi
description: In New York many young people belonging to the upper middle class usually meet to have fun in friends' houses or in exclusive clubs. Going to one of the usual Sally parties, Jane, Cynthia, Audrey and Nick agree to give Tom a ride in the taxi that hosts them. He is a very shy type, who loves to live isolated from the rest of the world, the son of divorced parents and above all faithful to socialist ideas. The boy immediately impresses Audrey and despite the difference in social class, he immediately merges with the group.
notes: Stillman makes his debut with this film that is halfway between Rohmer's and Woody Allen's cinema. Silver Leopard at the Locarno Film Festival.

title: Le sang à la tête
actors: Jean Gabin, Paul Frankeur, Claude Sylvain, Georgette Anys
description: In La Rochelle, a strict and closed city in Brittany, Mr. Cardinaud has made his way without much scruples and, still young, is a rich man, feared and hated. He spends his life as a well-to-do bourgeois, a lover of order and domestic peace. Taken by business, he does not realize that success and wealth push him to neglect his wife, who slowly moves away from him to go and live with a childhood partner.
notes: The elite of French cinema in a classic "feuilleton" with high dramatic trension, inspired by a novel by Simenon and with a masterly and controlled Gabin.

title: Das Ende eines Sommers
actors: Iris Junik, Diego Wallraff, Ralf Lindermann, Lola Müthel, Inka Calvi
description: Jane, an English girl, after the death of her mother goes to live with her father in California. Everything goes in the best way until two events upset his peaceful existence. In England Jane's grandmother decides to change her will in favor of her grandson Sinclair, as her granddaughter has shown little attachment to her when she left for the United States. The other news is that the father is planning to move in with another woman. This fact pushes Jane to leave the States and return to England.

title: Rosamunde Pilcher: Stürmische Begegnung
actors: Sophie von Kessel, Rolf Hoppe, Horst-Günter Marx, Michael Lesch
description: To indulge her mother's last wish, who recently died of leukemia, Rebecca Bayliss (Sophie von Kessel) leaves Ibiza for Cornwall to meet her grandfather Grenville (Rolf Hoppe) whom she never met. The welcome from the whole family is very warm and Rebecca decides to stay for a few days, also because her grandfather, a famous painter and recovering from a heart attack, intends to paint her a portrait. The family also includes his cousin Eliot (Horst-Günter Marx), who, certain of inheriting Grenville's enormous fortune, sees Rebecca as a hindrance to his plans. To ensure a comfortable and peaceful life, Eliot asks her to marry him, but Rebecca is very perplexed by the proposal received. In Cornwall, the young woman also finds an old friend of hers, Joss Gardner, to whom her grandfather seems particularly fond. Nobody knows the reason for so much attachment. The truth will eventually come to light on a stormy day ...
notes: Yet another film based on a novel by Rosamunde Pilcher.

title: The Enemy Below
actors: Robert Mitchum, Curd Jürgens, Al Hedison, Theodore Bikel
description: The American destroyer Haynes, under the command of Captain Murrel, scours the South Atlantic in search of German submarines. While they are patrolling the area, the second in command Ware reports the presence of a U-121, commanded by Captain Von Stolbeg, a skilled sailor, but tired of the war, which cost him the loss of two children. Murrel is also an experienced and courageous soldier who does not hate the Germans, despite losing his wife following the torpedoing of the ship on which he was traveling. After a night of waiting the destroyer is now close to its target and Murrel decides to launch the attack anyway.
notes: Remake of John Ford's "Rulers of the Sea", a professional war film and nothing more. Oscar for special effects.

title: Kundun
actors: Tenzin Thuthob Tsarong, Tencho Gyalpo, Tenzin Topjar, Tsewang Migyur Khangsar
description: In 1937 in Tibet a child from a modest family is recognized as the fourteenth incarnation of the Dalai Lama. Time passes and we arrive in 1950, the boy is now fifteen years old and becomes a witness to the invasion of his country by the Chinese army led by Mao Tse Tung. Tenzin Gyatso, as the boy is called, launches an appeal which, however, remains unheard in the West. All he has to do is go into exile in India.
notes: Just like "The Last Temptation" and, in their visionary and sobbing way, Scorsese's "Italian-American" sagas, "Kundun" also has the austere and doubtful trend of a predestination, of a maturation. Not shouted and punctuated by fury, but controlled by a majestic and continuous harmony, he is no less visionary for this. Not weaving of appearances (like the one that crushes the protagonists of "The Age of Innocence"), but form as an expression of spirituality, control, transcendence. The figure of the mandala that runs through the film is the most sumptuous and evanescent symbol of this formalized spirit. And the adjustment of the perspective that marks the film is the strongest sign of the protagonist's path.

title: The Domino Principle
actors: Gene Hackman, Candice Bergen, Richard Widmark, Mickey Rooney, Eli Wallach
description: Roy Tucker is in prison for alleged murder and is likely to stay there for a while. However, a powerful and mysterious organization has set its sights on him that makes him escape to use him. Meanwhile, he is disembarked on an island in the Caribbean where he finds his wife Ellie, a beautiful villa and a nice nest egg in the bank. But soon his "masters" show up: Roy has to kill the president of the United States from a helicopter.
notes: Shooting the CIA is like shooting the Red Cross: not even a veteran like Kramer can build an original film. First-rate, but very disappointing, the cast.

title: Drango
actors: Jeff Chandler, Joanne Dru, Julie London, Donald Crisp
description: After the Civil War, a northern major is sent by the military government to a small town in the South, where he fought during the conflict. Its task is to help the population to re-establish, where possible, the bases of civil coexistence. The open hostility and hatred of the citizens, who have not forgotten the suffering inflicted on them, make the major's peace mission extremely difficult. A man, who openly sided with the northerners and killed in self-defense, is lynched, despite promises of a fair trial.

title: Miranda
actors: Serena Grandi, Andrea Occhipinti, Franco Interlenghi, Franco Branciaroli
description: In the Ferrarese countryside in the 1950s Miranda, a handsome and helpful woman, manages an inn awaiting the return of her husband Gino, missing in war. In the meantime, the woman grants numerous escapades: the road haulier Berto, Carlo, a former fascist at confinement, who makes them expensive gifts, Norman, a young American technique of the patronage, and to finish there is Toni, the waiter of the inn that does not however, dare to demonstrate his love. Brass declares to have inspired Goldoni's "innkeeper", but the film is only an erotic splashing in which the too opulent great goes crazy.

title: Ma vie en rose
actors: Georges Du Fresne, Michele Laroque, Jean-Philippe Ecoffey, Marie Bunel, Hélène Vincent, Daniel Hanssens, Laurence Bibot, Jean-François Gallotte, Caroline Baehr, Julien Riviere, Gregory Diallo, Erik Cazals De Fabel, Cristina Barget, Delphine Cadet, Morgane Bruna
description: Ludovic, a seven-year-old boy, is convinced that he is a child. His parents, not without trauma and contrasts, are however ready to accept the bizarre diversity of their son, but the attitude of the neighbors is instead of disapproval. Ludovic, among other things, to legitimize his choice, relies on Pam, the magical heroine of a television series.
notes: Presented in Cannes in '97, in the "Quinzane des Réalisateurs" section, and awarded with the "Golden Globe". The film manages to combine the possible with the improbable, between colorful Tim Burton dreams and a harsh Ken Loach reality. Berliner plays with sexual identity and transvestism through the innocent gaze of Peter Pan who, contrary to legend, has every air of wanting to grow up quickly.

title: Oostende
actors: Marc Andréoni, Jean-Claude Adelin, Isabella Ferrari
description: Jim and Jeannt are two childhood friends who found themselves after a long time. In them there is that fear of growing that characterizes all teenagers. The terror of becoming adults grip their existence, but the two meet Lyota (Isabella Ferrari) during a Weekeend in Ostend. The meeting with the girl will make both of them change to both.
notes: Comedy with sweet and sour tones focused on the maturation process of two teenagers. The idea is not new and the presence of Isabella Ferrari in the cast does not place in favor of the film.

title: Family Honeymoon
actors: Claudette Colbert, Fred MacMurray, Rita Johnson, Gigi Perreau
description: A university professor falls in love and marries a widow who already has three children. After the wedding ceremony, the bride and groom get ready to leave for the long-awaited honeymoon. The only problem is what to do with the three children who, after a brief consultation, are entrusted to a black maid. However, due to a mishap, at the last moment the waitress becomes unavailable so that the professor and the widow are forced to leave with the three brats in tow.
notes: The cast offers the best of themselves, but unfortunately this is not enough to get out of mediocrity. There is also a computer-colored version of the film.

title: Il maestro di violino
actors: Domenico Modugno, Rena Niehaus, Juliette Mayniel, Elisabetta Virgili
description: Commendator Gaudenzi and the Countess of Sansevero commit themselves with their money to make the Moriacchi Conservatory of Perugia prosper. Giovanni Russo teaches violin and attracts the sympathies of his students and the affection of the girls. Agnese, the piano teacher Luciana Taddei and Margherita herself, countess of Sansevero, a widow for some time, aspire to marry him. The countess Laura, for her part, investigates the passaro of the teacher, while Margherita instructs him to follow her daughter during a tour in Israel.
notes: Sugary photo novel de stantìo as it briefly went out of fashion in the 70s, with a Domenico Modugno far below his means.

title: Una notte che piove
actors: Massimo Venturiello, Olga Beaumont, Viola Simoncioni, Giovanni Costa
description: Guido's elderly father dies, a famous lawyer, and so he finds himself with a law firm to run. The parent, however, also left him a beautiful house on the coast of Stintino. Guido is a solicitor, but, unlike his father, he carries out his profession with little enthusiasm. Guido loves playing the saxophone very much, he leads a lonely and strike life. However, Guido is deeply attached to that house because the dreams and memories of almost twenty years of life were born there. Well known plot, well known characters, bad acting. Less than television.

title: Cette nuit là
actors: Mylène Demongeot, Maurice Ronet, Jean Servais
description: Silvia and Jean, two young spouses, are both employed in André's publishing house. He is madly in love with Silvia and does not hide his insane passion so much that he comes to offer the girl a check for two million, pledging to sign it only in case she accepts his court. Informed of this, Jean, in a fit of jealousy, tries to take out André, but by mistake he seriously hits another man. André takes advantage of the situation to blackmail Jean.
notes: Two elements intertwine in the film, the passionate one and the detective one, but the result is not the best. The interpretation of the actors is effective, but unfortunately it is not enough.

title: Betrayal
actors: Jeremy Irons, Patricia Hodge, Ben Kingsley, Avril Elgar, Ray Marioni
description: Emma and Jerry have been lovers for seven years, but they ended their relationship for two. Now Emma has asked Jerry to meet in a bar. The man thus learns from Emma that she has left her husband Robert after he has revealed to her that he has been cheating on her for a long time. In the heat of the fight, Emma revealed her relationship with Jerry to her husband, but Robert had known about it for years. A series of flashbacks takes us back to the years of love between Emma and Jerry.
notes: Taken from a beautiful text by Harold Pinter, it has its strengths in the dialogues and in the interpretation of the actors.

title: La svastica nel ventre
actors: Sirpa Lane, Giancarlo Sisti, Roberto Posse
description: The young Jewish Anna ends up in the brutal hands of the SSs. Waiting to be transferred to a concentration camp, he finds himself in a cottage for military. Here, thanks to its beauty, it has the relative fortune to conquer the interest of an officer, who makes its lover before entrusting her with the direction of a "maison" for high poppies of the militia.
notes: Taking advantage of the success of films such as _porto at night_ and _salon Kitty_, authors like Bruno Mattei and Mario Caiano launched the Nazi-Pornosoft in the seventies, a trucid concentrate of sadistic morbidity. _ The swastika in the belly_ represented the swan singing of the vein, which however had a certain success also abroad.

title: The Touch of Satan
actors: Michael Berry, Emby Melai, Lee Amber
description: Jodie arrives at an isolated villa on the banks of a lake. The villa is inhabited by two sisters one of whom is a real witch. The other risks making a bad end, but Jodie saves her. For this reason, however, the girl had to come to terms with the devil himself.
notes: Blood and gastric juices in profusion ...

title: Souls at Sea
actors: Gary Cooper, George Raft, Frances Dee, Henry Wilcoxon
description: Towards the middle of the nineteenth century, an English sailor fought with all his might against slavery, declared illegal by the British crown, out of a humanitarian spirit. For this he is hired by the secret services who entrust him with the mission of intercepting a large cargo en route to America. On the ship he meets a girl, with whom he falls in love, the sister of an officer involved in traffic. Due to a misunderstanding he ends up on trial, but the happy end is only postponed.
notes: Dear, good old Hollywood, with its stars of perpetual charm, the races on the seas, a rhythm to the story that never misses a beat and many good luxury craftsmen behind the camera.

title: The Bottom of the Bottle
actors: Van Johnson, Joseph Cotten, Ruth Roman, Jack Carson
description: Pat, a bright and well-to-do lawyer, has a brother who is quite the opposite. This one, addicted to drinking, kills a man while he is drunk. Escaped from prison, he takes refuge in his brother's house and asks for help to expatriate to Mexico, where his wife and children have already taken refuge. At first the lawyer refuses and even denies financial aid to his brother's family, then, convinced by his wife, he thinks about it. Melodrama based on a Simenon novel, is rather heavy despite the beautiful setting used by an action director like Hathaway.

title: Squadra antimafia
actors: Tomas Milian, Alberto Farnese, Lilli Carati, Roberto Messina, Bombolo
description: Life (and missions) increasingly difficult for the fearless Commissioner Giraldi, known as "Monnezza" for the sober and elegant style of speaking and dressing. This time he has to infiltrate a mafia gang and for this purpose, naturally under a false name, he gets arrested, escapes from prison and thus puts himself at the service of the boss. Given the previous "enterprises", the latter has no reason to be wary of "Trash" and entrusts him with increasingly delicate tasks ...
notes: It is the fourth episode of the series "Squadra anti ..." something and, of course, the writers, to keep the tension high (since they are now scraping the barrel), they shoot bigger and bigger.

title: Le dritte
actors: Franco Fabrizi, Sandra Mondaini, Bice Valori, Monica Vitti, Memmo Carotenuto
description: Ofelia, Erna and Rina are three friends who usually meet occasionally. Different in temperament and character, however, they nurture the same feelings and, above all, the same aspirations. Ofelia, cerebral and sophisticated, is the owner of a fashion boutique; Erna, simple and with a strong maternal sense, is a nurse; Rina, on the other hand, is a housewife. All three wish to get married and set their sights on Hamlet, Hercules and Lello. But the three are terrified of the idea of ??marriage ...
notes: Made in the wake of the success of Amendola's own "Dritti", a comedy of little interest.

title: Cento serenate
actors: Maria Fiore, Giacomo Rondinella, Gérard Landry
description: Dick Nelson, a rich American industrialist, comes to Italy together with his girlfriend Vivienne to carry out an inspection in a branch of his pasta factory. As he lands, Maria, a pretty seller, tries to offer him flowers that the man refuses roughly. Dick meets the girl again at the factory where an accident takes place that induces the industrialist to fire the warehouse worker Domenico, father of Mary ...

title: Look Back in Anger
actors: Richard Burton, Mary Ure, Claire Bloom, Edith Evans, Gary Raymond
description: Jimmy is not very satisfied with the life he leads also because he continues to fight violently with his wife. The situation worsens day by day until the woman, who is also pregnant, decides to leave. Jimmy's temptation is to seek consolation in the arms of his wife's friend, but then, when he learns that his wife has given birth to a stillborn baby, he thinks about it.

title: The House of Seven Corpses
actors: John Ireland, Faith Domergue, John Carradine, Carol Wells
description: A film crew is shooting a horror movie. For script requirements, the actors, technicians and director move to a particularly gruesome Victorian castle where filming must be completed. The manor, however, is truly bewitched.
notes: Low-cost film, but curious about the gimmick of the film in the film.

title: The People That Time Forgot
actors: Patrick Wayne, Shane Rimmer, Thorley Walters, Doug McClure, Sarah Douglas
description: An expedition made up of Major McBride, his aide Hogan, Dr. Norfolk and a fearless reporter is trying to help a missing aviator who managed to launch a desperate s.o.s. The group enters a rugged volcanic territory. Here they make a shocking discovery: the territory is inhabited by prehistoric animals and there is a tribe of bloodthirsty warriors who keep a primitive population in slavery.
notes: Modest sequel to "The Land Forgotten by Time" from Edgar Rice Burroghs' homonymous story. Starring Patrick Wayne, son of John.

title: Vor
actors: Vladimir Maskov, Ekaterina Rednikova, Misa Filipcuk, Dima Chigarev
description: In 1946, in the Soviet Union, the young Katya gave birth to Sanya, a child conceived with a soldier who died in the war. In an attempt to overcome despair and poverty, six years later, Katya falls in love with Tolyan, a libertine soldier, who poses as Sanya's husband and father in order to get a state home. Tolyan, however, soon shows his true nature and soon reveals himself for the man he is. Violent and unfaithful, he survives by stealing thefts, an activity to which little Sanya also initiates.

title: Mouse Hunt
actors: Nathan Lane, Lee Evans, Vicki Lewis, Christopher Walken
description: Ernie and Lars Smuntz, two brothers who have never loved each other too much, find themselves having to share the legacy of their old father who has just died: several silly objects, a twine factory and a gloomy late 19th century house outside the city. The two, still in their bills, accidentally discover that the house has a great value. They then organize a millionaire auction, but there is the tenant who does not want to dislodge: a mouse. Thus begins a large-scale hunt reminiscent of cartoons and which also involves Catzilla (a big and ferocious cat) and a hyper-technological Mousebusters with disastrous results.
notes: Produced by Dreamworks, the film swings between a dark and decadent Terry Gilliam vibe and cartoon gags. Excellent special effects, directed by Gore Verbinski.

title: Wag the Dog
actors: Dustin Hoffman, Robert De Niro, Anne Heche, Denis Leary, Woody Harrelson, William H. Macy, Kirsten Dunst, Willie Nelson, John Michael Higgins, Andrea Martin
description: When a few days before the elections the scandal broke out of the president's advances to a scout girl visiting the White House, Conrad Brean, the brainy who deals with the image of the president, in a few minutes invents a war on Albania. And to make everyone believe that the war has really broken out, he seeks help from Hollywood producer Stanley Motts.
notes: It's hard to make a funny movie about an overused theme like the political show and all its tricks. But Levinson manages to pack a product that doesn't release tension for its entire 99 minutes. Scripted with dizzying intelligence and rhythm (and sharp nastiness) by David Mamet, "Sex & Power" plays the cards of the priceless duets of the two protagonists, who seem to really enjoy themselves as if they were back in the 70s. A solid average film, and that's not cheap.

title: Anastasia
description: Anastasia, presumed daughter of Tsar Nicholas II, is the only one to have escaped the massacre of the Russian royal family. She, however, does not know it and that is why, driven by a clue, a carillon with the inscription "Together in Paris", leaves for the Ville Lumière to try to discover her true identity. During the journey Anastasia runs into Dimitri, a cheat who protects her from Rasputin's emissaries.
notes: The film is made by some Diseny defectors. Unfortunately, however, the animation was largely made with the computer: and this removes depth from the drawings and makes the cartoons lose the pasty dreamlike dimension that preserves them over time. Either way, Rasputin is destined to enter a hypothetical gallery of fairy tale villains.

title: Sphere
actors: Dustin Hoffman, Sharon Stone, Peter Coyote, Samuel L. Jackson
description: A psychologist, a biologist and a brilliant mathematician are sent to the bottom of the sea to investigate a vessel covered with centenary corals. The boat was responsible for the breaking of a submarine cable that suddenly comes back to the surface. Inside the wreck, which is later discovered to come from an alien planet, an enigmatic sphere is found that exerts an inexplicable attraction on the components of the expedition.
notes: . Sewn together by Crichton's intelligence and scientific plausibility (rewritten by Paul Attanasio) and resting on the shoulders of a group of actors who manage to never lose their sense of proportion, a solid example of sceince-fiction. Its 133 minutes run smoothly, despite the fact that it takes place in a literally "sealed" environment. Beautiful underwater sequences of jellyfish and eggs, "humanistic" ending (which recalls, with an equal and opposite movement, that of "Excalibur").

title: Michele Strogoff
actors: Curd Jürgens, Geneviève Page, Sylva Koscina, Jacques Dacqmine, Gérard Buhr
description: Michele Strogoff is a courier of the Tsar. When the emir of Bukara rebels against the brother of the emperor, Michael embarks on a mission on which the salvation of the empire depends. Adventures follow in which there is no shortage of prison and torture.
notes: Sword and Swashbuckler, from a novel by Jules Verne.

title: Odia il prossimo tuo
actors: Clyde Garner, George Eastman, Nicoletta Machiavelli
description: Gunfighter Garry Stevens, by order of ranchero Chris Malone, kills Bill Dakota and his wife in order to get hold of a gold mine map. Ken, brother of the slain, wants to take revenge and, of course, recover the precious artifact. The map, however, has already ended up in the hands of Ken, himself a bitter enemy of Malone, who manages to have Garry imprisoned. Western Spaghetti series C.

title: Sogno di una notte di mezza sbornia
actors: Eduardo De Filippo, Pupella Maggio, Pietro De Vico
description: Dante Alighieri appeared in a dream to Pasquale Grifone, a poor devil who is forced to live on hardship, and gave him three numbers to play the lottery. The three numbers, however, would also be the date of death of Pasquale himself which, if so, would be imminent. What will Pasquale do since playing (and winning a boatload of money) is equivalent to signing one's death sentence?
notes: Monsieur Cinema and the great Eduardo never got along very well and even this film - based on the comedy _L'agonia di Schizzo_ by Athos Setti, appropriately "Neapolitanized" by Eduardo himself - is no exception.

title: Fantasmi e ladri
actors: Tina Pica, Ugo Tognazzi, Mario Riva, Mario Pisu, Pietro De Vico
description: An avid reader of detective stories, old Mrs. Tina now considers herself an expert on the subject. When she wins a television quiz on the subject, no one stops her anymore. After moving to the city, she goes after a not very sharp private policeman and pretends to teach him the trade, helped in this by a fellow villager, a former shepherd, even more short of brains than the "hound". Tired of Tina's intrusions, the latter stages a complicated story of thefts by ghosts with some actor friends.
notes: Tina Pica tries to direct a film as a protagonist. But the story is thin and twisted.

title: Si ringrazia la regione Puglia per averci fornito i milanesi
actors: Giorgio Porcaro, Massimo Boldi, Teo Teocoli, Eleonora Vallone
description: Benedict is an urbanized "terun" in the northern metropolis who is trying in every way to break through. He works as a waiter for a living but with his friends he gives himself the airs of a grand viveur and chansonnier. With him lives his sister Carmela who, to see her boyfriend, makes him sneak into the house dressed as a woman. After a thousand complications, Benedetto realizes that it is better to pack up again.
notes: It does not make Alvaro Vitali regret, but we are close to it. Porcaro always declared that Abatantuono had stolen the character of the "terrunciello".

title: Escape from New York
actors: Kurt Russell, Lee Van Cleef, Ernest Borgnine, Donald Pleasence, Harry Dean Stanton, Adrienne Barbeau
description: In the very near future the entire city of New York, now ungovernable and prey to metropolitan gangs of bandits, is transformed into a huge prison from which no one can escape. But it happens that the presidential plane, hijacked by a group of terrorists, crashes on the city. Saved by a special capsule, the first citizen of America is taken hostage by the gang of the "Duke" who, in exchange, asks for his freedom. The police then infiltrate Jena Plinski, who must complete her mission in just 24 hours.
notes: From an action film and thriller specialist like Carpenter you expect exactly what the film proposes: breathtaking pace, great emotions, apocalyptic vision. A classic of modern science fiction.

title: Hard Eight
actors: Philip Baker Hall, Gwyneth Paltrow, John C. Reilly, Samuel L. Jackson
description: In Reno, Nevada, everything is as fleeting as the gamblers who win and lose in the casino. When John, a loner, arrives in the city, he has only one purpose: to become invisible. But suddenly he is bothered by Sydney, an elderly man who loads him into a car and deposits him in front of a casino.
notes: Anderson's debut is a decidedly minimalist film, driven by the idea of ??gambling, all from the point of view of an elderly and mysterious man. The film starts and ends very well; It is a pity that in the central part it gets lost, almost as a matter of narration, in situations that are a bit weak. But he puts Philip Baker Hall at the center of the screen, but an excellent theatrical interpreter (great Nixon in Altman's "Secret Honor"), who knows how to speak with his eyes and silently suggest a past.

title: The Quiller Memorandum
actors: George Segal, Alec Guinness, Max Von Sydow, Senta Berger
description: The secret agent Quiller is sent to Berlin with the task of discovering the leaders of a mysterious and equally ruthless neo-Nazi organization whose main purpose is to seize power in Germany. Quiller, well aware of the fact that the agent who had preceded him in the same post has mysteriously disappeared, however decides to act alone and without weapons. On the contrary, he does everything to get noticed and deliberately gets kidnapped and drugged to find himself in the headquarters of the mysterious organization.
notes: Taken from the book "The Berlin Memorandum" by Adam Hall, the film is all in the script by Harold Pinter.

title: Le avventure e gli amori di Scaramouche
actors: Michael Sarrazin, Ursula Andress, Aldo Maccione, Giancarlo Prete
description: While Jacobin France is clamoring for the heads of the nobles and the abolition of ancient privileges, Scaramouche takes the opportunity to continue his amorous adventures. It ends up pissing off all the husbands in Paris. To escape their ire he agrees to pass himself off as a barber employed by Napoleon. Mistaken for an attacker, he is forced, together with his friend Whistle, to volunteer among the soldiers leaving for Italy. Also because of his passion for women he ends up unleashing a war between the Austrian and Russian troops.

title: Grazie di tutto
actors: Nino Manfredi, Massimo Ghini, Nancy Brilli, Giulia Lazzarini
description: He writes detective novels, she has a real passion for Chiantishire. They move to the countryside, buy a farmhouse and savor the joys of Tuscany, but for a short time. The neighbors leave for Africa, where they will then be kidnapped by the guerrillas, and the two transplanted citizens have to look after two in their seventies, a brusque (and somewhat mysterious past) officer and a vanished lady who lives on memories.
notes: Nino Manfredi forgets the wickedness of his sixties characters and becomes an overly good-natured and slightly crazy grandfather, but capable of making Ghini and Nancy Brilli discover altruism. Little story, a clearly familiar film: relationships are exploited to the maximum between fathers, children, ex-husbands, future spouses and future in-laws.

title: George of the Jungle
actors: Brendan Fraser, Leslie Mann, Richard Round, Thomas Haden Church
description: In the cartoon jungle, the king manages to find the love of a beautiful explorer. He lives on a plant and is equipped with an elevator, at his service he has a talking monkey and an elephant that moves like a dog. George is a Tarzan who in his intentions is all to laugh, since he cannot fly on the vines and it is only thanks to luck that he manages to defeat the evil explorers and win the heart of the explorer.
notes: Based on a very successful cartoon, the film was very popular in America: but Italian children may not necessarily feel the same enthusiasm for a film that is more foolish than simple. The only noteworthy thing is the special effects with the computer that also eliminate the old charm of the painted backdrops and the papier-mache jungle; for the rest very little is saved and boredom spreads.

title: Cucciolo
actors: Massimo Boldi, Claudia Koll, Bruno Gambarotta, Gisella Sofio
description: Massimo is forty-two years old, but he has been attending eighth grade for thirty-two, in short, he is a teenager in all respects. In reality Massimo has always refused, on an unconscious level, to grow up and become part of society. Amedeo and Lucia, Massimo's eighty-year-old parents, obviously worried, go to a doctor who explains to them that their son suffers from Peter Pan Syndrome. Only a big shock can bring it back to normal ...
notes: In a few years (the signs are clear) products of this invoice will be seen straight on TV without going through the cinemas. Because the public no longer takes the bait. Despite a Boldi in shape, hit parade songs (Aqua) and the abuse of consumerism that should feed the people of popular-commercial cinema.

title: I miei più cari amici
actors: Alessandro Benvenuti, Eva Robin's, Athina Cenci, Alessandro Gassmann
description: A group of actors on the brink of bankruptcy receives a letter that appears to be the result of a benevolent fate. The letter contains an invitation to spend a period of time in a castle belonging to the dukes of Camerario: the occasion is the birthday of Martha, an actress whose recital has been canceled. The person who wrote the letter is Alessio, a globetrotting adventurer, whom everyone has lost sight of for fifteen years. But some strange events begin to unfold after they arrive.
notes: A "Tuscan thriller" crowded with comedians from the Cecchi Gori house, with an air that evokes Pieraccioni. However, Benvenuti's cinema has always been freed from easy fashions. A dip in intelligent comedy between Almodòvar atmospheres (and Eva Robin's would be a perfect icon) and black humor of British style. Only one flaw: hypertrophy. Intertwined textures that don't always melt.

title: Ms. 45
actors: Zoe Tamerlis, Steve Singer, Jack Thibeau, Albert Synkis, Darlene Stuto
description: The very young Thana works as a tailor and is mute. Within a few hours he suffers two rapes. To the second violence he reacts by killing the rapist. At this point the purposes of his life become two: to eliminate the corpse one piece at a time, without attracting attention and to kill off all the males who intimately approach the female gender, and for whom he adopts very provocative attitudes and clothes.
notes: With a budget of one hundred thousand dollars, Ferrara abandons the "trash" décor, hires a ballistics expert for excursions and finds a haughty and incisive protagonist. An elusive B-movie that turns the show of "just revenge" a la Charles Bronson to women.

title: Kidnapping - Ein Vater schlägt zurück
actors: Heinz Hoenig, Luca Zingaretti, Michael Degen, Dalila Di Lazzaro
description: Max Klauser is a tough and unfriendly businessman who takes feelings low. To the point of having paid the mother of her child to make no claim on the child. Years later, during the inauguration of a grandiose tourist settlement in Sardinia, Max's son is kidnapped. The executive has no doubts about who was responsible for the spectacular kidnapping, but declares that he will never pay and does not reveal anything to the police. Rather, he decides to hire a former secret agent from East Germany, who sets out on the trail of the material perpetrators of the kidnapping: a band of Sardinians led by Tonino Sanna ...

title: La zia d'America va a sciare
actors: Tina Pica, Franca Rame, Virgilio Riento, Bice Valori, Isabella Biagini
description: Following a financial crisis, the elderly Tecla Cammarano, who had emigrated to America for some time, returns to Italy with her two granddaughters, pretty marriageable girls. The secret purpose of the trip is to get the girls to marry some rich scion and, to this end, Tecla settles in a ski resort frequented by high bourgeois.
notes: Despite attempts to vary genre with varying "locations", Tina Pica protagonist does not hold up.

title: It Takes Two
actors: Kirstie Alley, Steve Guttenberg, Ashley Olsen, Mary-Kate Olsen
description: Amanda, a girl abandoned by her parents, is very fond of Diane, the social worker who took care of her and would like so much to be adopted, but there is a problem: Diane is not married and therefore cannot become the " mom "from Amanda. Quick change of scene: Alyssa is the daughter of an industry tycoon who just can't stand her dad's new girlfriend who, as the girl rightly thinks, aims only for money. When Alyssia runs away from home she meets Amanda who, incredible to say, looks like her like a drop of water. Said and done, the two exchange roles with results that are easy to imagine and that are already well announced by the title.

title: The Naked Edge
actors: Gary Cooper, Deborah Kerr, Eric Portman, Diane Cilento
description: The accountant of an industry is murdered and Donald Heath is accused of the murder who, for the deposition of a colleague of the accountant, is sentenced to thirty years in prison. Some time later the super-witness has set up an industry that is booming, but one day his wife receives an anonymous letter in which her husband is accused of the old crime.
notes: Old-fashioned yellow film with an unusual subject and a good script. It was Gary Cooper's last performance.

title: L'ultima donna
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Ornella Muti, Michel Piccoli, Renato Salvatori
description: Jean, an engineer separated from his wife and with a child in tow, finds himself on compulsory holidays because his company has few orders. At the boy's kindergarten he meets Valeria who leaves her boyfriend for him. The two go to be together, but after the euphoria (even sensual) of the first moment, the relationship breaks down even without a specific reason. Things get complicated when Jean's ex-wife and a new flame reappear. Tortured by (psychological) powerlessness to manage his love life, Jean castrates himself.
notes: Rightly "scandalous" at its release, Ferreri's film is one of the most successful things of the Milanese director who finds in Depardieu and Muti more accomplices than interpreters.

title: The Wilby Conspiracy
actors: Sidney Poitier, Michael Caine, Rutger Hauer, Prunella Gee
description: Lawyer Rina Van Niekirk agrees to defend black activist Shak Twala, accused of belonging to the Candestine Africa National Congress, in court in Cape Town. We are in apartheid South Africa and for Rina this amounts to self-exclusion from the white "clan". Thanks to her, however, Shak gets his freedom, but is forced to flee abroad. A terrible racist policeman, however, hunts him and does not hesitate to go over the border.
notes: The major limitation of the film is the indecision between civil denunciation and adventure and the mixture does not benefit either one or the other.

title: Go, Johnny, Go!
actors: Alan Freed, Jimmy Clanton, Sandy Stewart, Adriano Celentano
description: Johnny, a boy who did not know his parents and was raised in an orphanage, decides to become a singer with the hope of reaching stardom as soon as possible. At his own expense he records a record and sends it to Alan, organizer of musical performances. After having listened to the song, he is convinced that the boy has the right stuff to break into the world of rock. But just at the moment when everything seems to be going well, a mishap prevents the two from getting in touch. Meanwhile, Christmas is approaching and Johnny, disappointed and embittered, gets to the point of committing a theft in order to give his girlfriend a gift.

title: Delitto a Porta Romana
actors: Tomas Milian, Olimpia Di Nardo, Nerina Montagnani, Bombolo
description: In Milan, the thief Franco, known as "Venticello", steals the house keys from Mr. Tassinelli and enters his apartment. The sudden return of the man, in sweet company, forces "Venticello" to hide under the bed: from that position, he notices that Tassinelli flaunts a conspicuous scar on his foot. When the landlord leaves, the thief finds himself in front of the corpse of a woman, who later turns out to be that of Elena Tassinelli: "Venticello" escapes but is arrested, while the investigation is entrusted to Commissioner Nico Giraldi , called "Trash" ...
notes: Perhaps one of the weakest films of the Bombolo-Milian duo.

title: Charlie Chan in Shanghai
actors: Warner Oland, Keye Luke, Irene Harvey, Jon Hall, Russell Hicks
description: Charlie Chan is called to Shanghai by the British consul to defeat a gang of opium smugglers. As soon as he sets foot in the city he is immediately threatened by a group of criminals intent on making him pay dearly. The English consul is killed and the clues weigh on his private secretary, who among other things, is engaged to the niece of the murdered. Chan begins the investigation and following his nose manages to discover the lair of the bandits and have them arrested. Their boss also ends up in the hands of justice, who pretended to be the American consul and pretended to help Chan in the investigation.

title: Esther
actors: Mohammed Bakri, Simone Benyamini, Juliano Mer-Khamis, Zare Vartanian, David Cohen, Shmuel Wolf, Sara Cohen
description: Esther is the biblical heroine mentioned in the homonymous book of the Old Testament. Became queen of Persia under the great king Xerxes, she foiled a palace conspiracy, hatched by the minister Aman, thus preventing the extermination of her people. Even today the episode is remembered by the Jews on the feast of Purim.
notes: In this film, the director Amos Gitai reinterprets the myth of heroin as a political metaphor of Jewish identity. The fact that, among all the biblical characters, he chooses this "great little woman" who lived at the time of exile is symptomatic of the pluralist and pacifist orientation of the work.

title: An Occasional Hell
actors: Kari Salin, Tom Berenger, Stephen Lang, Valeria Golino, Trent McDevitt
description: Accused of killing her husband and making his mistress disappear, Jeri Gillen turns to Dr. Dewal, a former policeman who has been disabled, to help her prove her innocence. Dewal refuses at first, but is later convinced also because he feels involved in the case. The investigation also allows him to deal with the ghosts that shake his past.
notes: The film opens with a hot sex scene and a murder that looks promising, but as you progress you realize you are facing a sweaty thriller. We see that Valerio Golino happened to be there by chance

title: Las edades de Lulù
actors: Francesca Neri, Oscar Ladoire, Maria Barranco, Fernando C. Cuervo, Javier Bardem, Rosana Pastor, Juan Graell, Rodrigo Valverde, Pilar Bardem, Marta May, Gloria Rodriquez, Àngel Jové, Ainara Pérez
description: Since adolescence, the beautiful Lulu has been troubled by issues concerning sex. When she marries Pablo, a much more mature man than her, the love practiced becomes a real obsession to be indulged at any cost and in every way. Soon the relationship expands to Ely, a transvestite, but the girl wants more and stronger experiences. In agreement with her husband, one evening, Lulu accepts the court of a stranger with whom she makes love while keeping her face masked. When she takes off the blindfold, Lulu discovers that the new adventure has taken place with her brother, who has always been in love with her. The shock is terrible, but it is certainly not enough to curb the girl's desires. Erotic cartoon taken from Almudena Grandes bestseller. Bigas Luna softens the provocations and adapts to a "European" patination; Neri does what she can.

title: Exception to the Rule
actors: Kim Cattrall, Sean Young, Eric McCormack, William Devane
description: The marriage of Timothy and Angela Bayer was born under the best auspices and for the moment things seem to be going well. Tim has a great job, he's employed by his father-in-law, Lawrence Kellerman a skilled and shrewd diamond dealer. In addition, the two are waiting to become parents for the first time. But their world falls apart when Timothy spends the night in the arms of Carla, a charming and very sexy woman. The next morning Timothy gives the welcome to the woman who does not give up easily and has a videotape with very compromising content delivered to her home. For Timothy begins a spiral that soon will lead him to have to fight against the aggressive woman.

title: Sharky's Machine
actors: Burt Reynolds, Vittorio Gassman, William Dehl, Charles Durning
description: Tom Sharky, a policeman who is part of the drug squad, is engaged in complex and dangerous investigations. One day, after patient stalking, he manages to get in touch with the leader of the drug traffickers, but the mistake of a colleague forces him to shoot. In the shooting, a passerby is injured and Tom, as punishment, is transferred to the vice squad.
notes: Reynolds naturally has the right face to play the role of the policeman all in one piece, rocky, not very malleable and with a very personal sense of justice. As a director, however, he is very dull. Almost comic detail for Vittorio Gassman.

title: Go West
actors: Groucho Marx, Harpo Marx, Chico Marx, John Carroll, Diana Lewis, Walter Woolf King
description: The two Panella brothers go to the Far West to try to enrich themselves by participating in the gold rush. Arriving at their destination, they buy from old Dan, for a few dollars, an arid and worthless piece of land called "The Valley of Death". However, the seller and the buyers are unaware that a railway line will cross that wasteland that will cause the value of the land to skyrocket. Who does not ignore it is a shady businessman who manages to deceive the Panella brothers by having the deed of ownership of the land delivered, but ...

title: A Life Less Ordinary
actors: Cameron Diaz, Ewan McGregor, Holly Hunter, Delroy Lindo
description: Robert works as a custodian of a large company, he is a loser by nature and dreams of something over the top. Meanwhile he works on what, at least he hopes, can become a successful trash novel. The beautiful Celine, on the other hand, daughter of Robert's boss, Naville, has never lacked anything and the biggest mishap is to be refused her credit card. But the angels O'Reilly and Jackson are tasked with a delicate mission to make the two fall in love.
notes: A classic "boy meets girl" with all its paradoxical incompatibilities, with which Boyle attempts a sortie from "black" territory. But the mix of sophisticated comedy and dark humor doesn't work as it should.

title: The Last Time I Commited Suicide
actors: Thomas Jane, Keanu Reeves, Claire Forlani
description: Neal Cassady was one of the most famous representatives of the Beat Generation in the late 1940s. Torn between his love for Jane, fresh from a suicide attempt and the aspiration to be a bourgeois in all respects, Neal ends up making the most "painful" choice: the life of a bar, that is to say friends and billiards.
notes: Starting from epistolary passages and phrases engraved in the Beat memory of an entire generation, the debutante Kay tries to leave a small image of the one who, only posthumously, knew a minimum of glory. An ambitious project which, unfortunately, runs aground almost instantly.

title: Kiss or Kill
actors: Frances O'Connor, Matt Day, Chris Haywood, Andrew S. Gilbert
description: Nikki approaches men in bars, lures them to a hotel room, drugs them, robs them together with her accomplice and lover Al. One day, however, one of the unfortunates accidentally dies and the two are forced to flee. They soon realize that the briefcase they have stolen contains a tape with images of a porn video that the famous football player Zipper Doyle shot with a minor. So the two find themselves on their heels not only the police who accuse them of murder, but also Zipper.
notes: Road movie, with sprinkles of noir and thriller, set in Australia. The director (and screenwriter) has been divided for years between documentary and fiction cinema: in fact, if the editing breaks the rhythm with a style between the latest Oliver Stone and MTV, the direction gives the landscape a leading role . The film gives way in terms of the script, showing several moments of weakness. Good performance by Frances O'Connor and Haywood and S. Gilbert, policemen, protagonists of some tasty comic curtains.

title: Cosmos
directors: Jennifer Alleyn, Manon Briand, Marie-Julie Dallaire, Arto Paragamian, André Turpin, Denis Villeneuve
actors: David La Haye, Audrey Benoit, Marie-Hélène Montpetit
description: In "L'individuo" by Marie Julie Dallaire a serial killer, with an unsuspected appearance, wanders around the city giving flowers to his victims. In "The Launch" by Manon Briand a couple formed by Yannie and Joel wander around the city trying to figure out if it is right or not to know the result of Joel's AIDS test. In Denis Villeneuve's "Le Technetium" a young filmmaker is taken hostage by the hysterical crowd of a talkshow. In "Jules and Fanny" by André Turpin Jules wants to see the breast of his ex at all costs. In "Dawn and Dusk" by Jennifer Alleyn, Aurora swindled by her boyfriend meets an old man who says his name is Twilight. In "Cosmos and Agriculture" by Arto Paragamian, the theft of Cosmos' taxi gives rise to amusing adventures.
notes: Film in six episodes directed by as many young Canadian directors with different styles and rhythms, but all in black and white. An orgy of points of view, skewed shots, parallel paths, alternative itineraries of a group of curious "survivors" who roam the streets of Montreal. A modern mosaic of scenes taken from the urban jungle that bring us into direct contact with human nature. "Cosmos" is the universe as a whole, but also the name of a Greek-born philosopher taxi driver who acts as a glue.

title: Brief Encounter
actors: Sophia Loren, Richard Burton, Jack Hedley, Rosemary Leach
description: Winchester Station witnesses the travels of Anna Jesson, who serves as a social worker at a nearby town, and of Dr. Harvey, a doctor at a local hospital. A chance encounter gives rise to the so-called love at first sight between the two, also because their mutual family situations allow it. In fact, Anna lives in a family with sound principles, but a little too closed, while Dr. Harvey does not have a good relationship with his wife. Harvey takes advantage of Anna's uncertainties and tries to convince her to abandon everything to move with him to Australia.
notes: Pretty bad TV remake of David Lean's film of the same name.

title: Love and Death on Long Island
actors: John Hurt, Jason Priestley, Fiona Loewi, Sheila Hancock, Harvey Atkin
description: A mature English writer so English as to seem fake (and perhaps by now he is really fake, even if some rare specimens may still exist) and a young American actor so naive as to border on naivety. One lives on the outskirts of London, the other on the Long Island coast. One is cultured, refined, so out of this world that even the television is rejected. The other mistakes Rimbaud for Rambo and dreams of emancipating himself from teen movies. A practically impossible encounter, which only the strength of a fantastic love can materialize.
notes: The film, first directed (and screenplayed) by the English Richard Kwietniowski, based on the novel by Gilbert Adair, has measure, elegance and humor. Constantly on stage, the great John Hurt manages to make this passion that crosses the ocean credible, and rivals the most famous romantic heroines, without ever overdoing it. Witty and sometimes excited.

title: Breakdown
actors: Kurt Russell, J.T. Walsh, Kathleen Quinlan, Rex Linn
description: A couple decided to change jobs and move to California in a luxury jeep, which is all they own. In Utah, a gang of robbers led by a truck driver, thinking they are dealing with wealthy people, kidnaps the woman and asks her husband for a hefty ransom.
notes: Thus begins an exciting race against time in which Kurt Russell offers the best of himself as in the days of Jena Plissken. In an unstoppable progression of suspense and action, the film locks the viewer to the chair. Without getting lost in socio-anthropological portraits, former screenwriter Jonathan Mostow sets up the challenge between the hero and the ruthless criminals, in which the law is conspicuous by his absence. A simple and effective mechanism derived from the western but with many cinematographic relationships: from "Duel" to "Frantic", from "A quiet weekend of fear" to "Don't open that door", with a disturbing portrait of the American province of the 90s, violent and archaic.

title: Tarzan's Peril
actors: Lex Barker, Virginia Huston, George Macready, Douglas Fowley
description: Radijeck, a shady slave and arms dealer, is arrested following Tarzan's intervention, but the prisoner, taking advantage of the police commissioner's absence, manages to escape. With a load of weapons Radijeck, with the complicity of two partners, gets in touch with the Yorango tribe who is willing to do business with him.
notes: Tarzan's first adventure filmed in Africa (to be precise in Kenya). Filming took place in the winter and the trained monkeys brought from Hollywood were unable to move due to the cold so the parts about Citah were cut.

title: Ladri si diventa
actors: Maurizio Mattioli, Leo Gullotta, Andrea Roncato, Eva Grimaldi, Pippo Franco
description: Peppe works as an upholsterer and usually plays the card with his friends "Da Luigi", a modest trattoria in the Imperial Forums. The group includes the plumber Bruno, the theater agent Gianni, the Professor who works as a tour guide and Luigi, owner of the restaurant. The five bet on 13 to somehow redeem their gray lives. During a dispute that broke out over a bet, Peppe hits a police officer and ends up in jail. Here he meets "Er Pantera", an old criminal who owns a map that leads to the vault of the Commercial Bank. But one day "Er Pantera" dies of a heart attack.
notes: New and less new comedians on TV remake Totò and Peppino from the "Banda degli honest"

title: Maigret et l'affaire Saint Fiacre
actors: Jean Gabin, Michel Auclair, Valentine Tessier
description: A noblewoman invites Commissioner Maigret, who had once been her sparsimante, to her castle. With great discretion she asks him to investigate some anonymous letters she has received in which she is foretold of death by a predetermined date. The commissioner watches over, but the crime is still committed. Point on the spot, the detective engages in a grueling investigation at the end of which he will discover the unsuspected culprit.
notes: For Gabin and Delannoy this is the second film shot together and which has as its protagonist the famous character created by Simenon, immersed here in the cuope stmosfere of the province. Simenon is another thing, but undoubtedly the intrigue works.

title: Delitto al Blue Gay
actors: Tomas Milian, Bombolo, Olimpia Di Nardo, Paco Fabrini, Anita Kupsch
description: Inspector Giraldi (Tomas Milian), after the birth of his second daughter and the consequent exhaustion of his wife, decides to deal with the murder of a well-known transvestite, star of the Blue Gay. Lying to his wife and announcing a trip to New York, he moves to the house of his friend Venticello (Bombolo) with whom he begins to frequent the club. Between misunderstandings, disguises and suspected beatings, Giraldi goes back to the name of Kurt Linder, a German director present at Blue Gay on the night of the crime.

title: A Streetcar Named Desire
actors: Vivien Leigh, Marlon Brando, Kim Hunter, Karl Malden
description: Since her husband Blanche Dubois died she has not recovered so much that, to drown the pain, she started drinking. This made her lose her job as a teacher and so, alone and without resources, she goes to stay with her sister in New Orleans. The sister is expecting a child from her husband Stanley, a brutal and violent man with whom Blanche does not bond. Mitchell, a friend of Stanley's, has a certain feeling for her, but Stanley laughs at him for this, questioning Blanche's honesty ...
notes: From the famous text by Tennessee Williams of 1947, a cult film of the golden years of Hollywood with three actors who won the Oscar (Leigh protagonist, Hunter and Malden not protagonists) even if the unforgettable interpretation is that of Brando (nominated but beaten by Bogart). Oscar also to the scenographies

title: La parola amore esiste
actors: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Gérard Depardieu, Marina Confalone
description: Angela is thirty years old, she is rich, neurotic and unfriendly and is looking for love that is able to put an end to all her phobias. The mother, a refined upper-class woman, endures the whims of her daughter who seems to have found in Marco, a cellist, the love of her life. The only problem is that he, in his forties, separated and the father of a fifteen-year-old girl, didn't notice anything.
notes: Calopreste's second feature film is courageous, because it distances itself from any "strong" theme and focuses on the evil of living and on the daily expectation of the materialization of the word love. Meticulous, essential, carefully "silent" script.

title: Per tutto il tempo che ci resta
actors: Ennio Fantastichini, Emilio Bonucci, Imma Piro, Isa Danieli
description: Giorgio Nappi is a 50-year-old prosecutor who has decided to retire in retirement. For years he fought against the power of the great families of the Camorra, always remaining defeated. But there is a last case that must be dealt with, in Piano sul Mare, his hometown, twelve-year-old Cristina was raped. The girl accuses a priest, Father Francesco, Giorgio's best friend.
notes: Unfortunately, in the debut of the Neapolitan Terracciano there are not the ambiguities of Capuano and his "Pianese Nunzio", but a desire for linear and simple cinema, where to take sides immediately. Because if the character played by Fantastichini is outlined with abundant nuances (also thanks to the actor's painful participation), that of the parish priest is obvious right from Bonucci's face.

title: Teatro di guerra
actors: Andrea Renzi, Anna Bonaiuto, Iaia Forte, Roberto De Francesco, Marco Baliani, Toni Servillo
description: The war has been going on for three years in the former Yugoslavia and in Naples an actor and director, Leo, begins the rehearsals of a theatrical show, which in his intentions should be staged in Sarajevo. Leo's company works in a small theater in the middle of the narrow streets of the Spanish neighborhoods. The show is "The Seven Against Thebes" which speaks of a fratricidal war.
notes: Seamlessly, with an impeccable narrative balance, Martone emerges from the dark theatrical building into the light and noise of the Neapolitan streets that are well suited to shooting with the hand camera. Determined not to show images of Sarajevo, to "not speak of the other in war, but of ourselves in peace", Martone reaches the Sarajevo-Naples equation (or, as he pointed out, any other European city) to a great extent. A fine anti-rhetorical example of the political function that cinema can still claim.

title: Temptress Moon
actors: Leslie Cheung, Gong Li, Kevin Lin, He Saifei, Lin Lianqun
description: In a provincial city not far from Shanghai stands the magnificent palace of the Pang family. Within its imposing walls extend gardens and covered avenues, a dusty library and an opium den. This drug is slowly poisoning the whole family. Meanwhile (we are in 191) the old regime falls to make way for the Republic.
notes: In reconciling western (alkla Sirk) and eastern melò (a la Zhang Ymou) the film ends up in a mess. Accomplices Gong Li (increasingly self-conscious, pompous and inexpressive), rivers of opium, ambiguous family and sexual relations, gigolo, ritualisms and chinoiserie, the film simultaneously dilutes melodramatic tension and narrative harmony.

title: La stanza dello scirocco
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Tiziana Lodato, Paolo De Vita, Francesco Benigno
description: It is 1936 and the Marquis of Acaquafurata who has lived for years in Paris returns to Sicily to take possession of a building that his cousin left him. But the woman has placed a constraint, the building must become the seat of the Casa del Fascio.
notes: A novel with a fascinating history (by Domenico Campana), a beautiful screenplay (featuring Suso Cecchi D'Amico), music with non-trivial sounds (by Eugenio Bennato) and a Giannini in great shape. But that's not enough to make a good movie. Because the direction of the debutante Sciarra is incapable of transforming elegant collaborations into cinema.
