His gaze is now television, now advertising, so that the film looks more like a Series B Tornatore than a work with original ambitions. Final with a doc quote that feeds regret.

title: To My Daughter with Love
actors: Ricky Schroder, Linda Gray, Joseph Burke, Ashley Malingert
description: Joey got married very young and his wife immediately had a daughter, Emily. But now his wife is dead and Joey is left alone with his little daughter. Man finds it increasingly difficult to take care of the little girl both because he is short of money and because he has little time available. His wife's parents offer to take Emily into foster care and Joey, albeit reluctantly, accepts. The pain of the loss of his wife and the absence of his daughter lead Joey to face adversity with courage until he can take Emily back forever.
notes: Heartbreaking story, but effective in keeping what it promises.

title: Dove vai se il vizietto non ce l'hai?
actors: Renzo Montagnani, Alvaro Vitali, Paola Senatore, Mario Carotenuto
description: To find out if there is another woman in the life of a wealthy businessman, a private detective and his assistant pretend to be a homosexual butler and the second a virgin, God-fearing cook. however, it presents somewhat difficult because one has to resist the insistent court of three unscrupulous women and the other instead has to defend himself from the assaults of a fiery gardener.
notes: Pecoreccia comedy that takes the worst or most of the Italian comedy, Alvaro Vitali in the lead. Paola Senatore would later continue her career as a porn actress.

title: Wide Sargasso Sea
actors: Rachel Ward, Michael York, Karina Lombard, Nathaniel Parker
description: Antoniette, a young landowner in Jamaica in 1840, marries an Englishman to avoid losing her lands. At first everything seems to proceed in the right direction, love triumphs and happiness is not far from being fulfilled. But the woman hides a secret, which concerns her childhood and especially her mother.
notes: Although it has some appeal, John Duigan fails to make a dramatic film of some impact. Taken from "The Great Sea of ??the Sargasso" by Jean Rhys, it is a sort of prequel to "Jane Eyre" by Charlotte Brontë.

title: Der Clown
actors: Sven Martinek, Diana Frank, Volkmar Kleinert, Hanns Zischler
description: Max Zander, an agent of W. I. P. A, the World Intelligence Police Agency, is transferred to the city of Dusseldorf for a year in order to investigate the infiltration of the Russian mafia in Germany. When a close friend blows up, victim of an attack, Max is at first gripped by a feeling of pain and grief, but later decides to avenge his death by taking the guise of an anonymous clown. Thus masked, the former special agent hopes to soon find those responsible for the murder and above all to be able to hit them in the shadows, in silence, before anyone can discover his true identity.
notes: Mid-level television production, made without praise and without infamy. The writers mixed a typical thriller situation with a classic horror presence, the clown (remember Stephen King's "IT"?). The result is acceptable, even if an idea like this, developed for the big screen, would probably have had much more breath.

title: Sweet Bird of Youth
actors: Elizabeth Taylor, Mark Harmon, Rip Torn, Valerie Perrine
description: An old Hollywood star falls in love with an ambitious young man who in addition to never having collected laurels is tormented by an old love. The two go around the city, staying in different hotels until tired of this life, they decide to return to the boy's hometown. Here the boy's father castrates him, while the diva experiences unexpected success. The famous tennessee Williams drama is rewritten by the critic Gavin Lambert, based on the later afterthoughts of the same author. Roeg directs for TV, without much imagination and in the service of Taylor.

title: Il diavolo e l'acquasanta
actors: Tomas Milian, Piero Mazzarella, Savina Gersak, Margherita Fumero
description: A former footballer on the verge of suicide, Manuel Marangoni, is saved by the intervention of a priest, Don Gaetano, who then welcomes him to the rectory together with his girlfriend. The two cause a lot of trouble for the priest. Then Don Gaetano has an intuition: he decides to entrust the country's soccer team to Manuel, engaged in a difficult tournament. Even as a coach, the man combines some good, but then comes the opportunity for redemption.
notes: Corbucci, an experienced craftsman of Italian cinema, cannot even save face here. Neither did Milian.

title: Treasure Island
actors: Wallace Beery, Jackie Cooper, Lewis Stone, Lionel Barrymore
description: Dying Captain Bones gives Jim Hawkins a map with directions to where Captain Flint's treasure is buried. Little Jim leaves with the Hispaniola to reach the remote island, but as soon as he disembarks he has to deal with a group of pirates commanded by Long John Silver.
notes: One of the best transpositions of Robert Louis Stevenson's novel. Great interpretation by Wallace Beery. There is a colorized version.

title: Conquest of Cochise
actors: John Hodiak, Robert Stack, Joy Page, Rico Alaniz, Fortunio Bonanova
description: Cochise, chief of a tribe of Apaches, realizes the futility of the struggles and negotiates with Major Burke, commander of the US troops, to reach the longed-for peace agreement. The nations close to the Comanches, on the other hand, are against any kind of agreement and decide to attack the whites. During the attack, a white woman is killed and her husband takes it into his head to avenge her by shooting at Cochise and his squaw. Series B Wetsern from a horror specialist.

title: Boom!
actors: Elizabeth Taylor, Richard Burton, Noël Coward, Joanna Shimkus
description: Flora is the mistress of an island in the Mediterranean where she lives surrounded by dogs and bodyguards who prevent access to anyone. Very rich, for having inherited the assets of her five husbands, she lives in a solitude that makes her more selfish and cruel every day. While he is dictating his memoirs to the secretary, Chris arrives, a man known in high society both for his troubled life and because every time he shows up in a place he brings death ...
notes: Losey directs by pushing the kitsh pedal, based on a screenplay by Tennessee Williams (from his "The Milk Cart Doesn't Stop Here"). In place of Sean Connery and Simone Signoret, who had taken him to the theater, there are Liz Taylor and Richard Burton, who give it more than ever.

title: I giorni più belli
actors: Emma Gramatica, Antonella Lualdi, Franco Interlenghi, Vittorio De Sica
description: The builder Valentini carefully prepared the plans for the construction of a large building. However, things are not as easy as they seem and a problem immediately arises. The land where Valentini intends to build is occupied by a school where Miss Giannelli teaches. And the teacher, tied to old memories, naturally doesn't want to leave.
notes: A twilight comedy scripted by ten hands (among others Ruggero Maccari and Ettore Scola). A gallery of former stars gives the faces of former schoolchildren.

title: Orson Welles: The One-Man Band
actors: Orson Welles
description: Oja Kodar, the last life partner of Orson Welles, opened the archives of the great director to his compatriot Vassili Silovic who was able to make this unique documentary by assembling together "cuttings from the basket", clips of unfinished projects and scraps of real life by the author of "Fourth power". So here are the trailers of "F for Fake", the few scenes shot of "The deep" and the magic numbers of Welles himself, a tribute to the Vienna of the "Third Man" and a hilarious "virtual" duet with Winston Churchill.
notes: A tribute to the great film author and his boundless talent; and a posthumous lash to those who did not understand it. The film, however, is above all a very gluttonous collection of unpublished works, including "Moby Dick".

title: The Games
actors: Michael Crawford, Ryan O'Neal, Charles Aznavour, Jeremy Kemp, Stanley Baker
description: We are at the Rome Olympics in 1960, indeed: at their conclusion which, as always, includes the dispute of the marathon. The favorite champions are four: the Czechoslovakian Vendek, the English Hayes, the American Reynolds and the Australian Aboriginal Pintubi. Vendek, later in life, runs under the imposition of the authorities of his country, Hayes is trained by a former champion who an accident has made angry with everyone, Reynolds is ambitious and excessively attached to chemical stimulants while Pintubi is the only one who competes with an authentically Olympic spirit.
notes: From the experiences of some real leaders (Zatopek, Bikila) a cinematically soporific and sporty irritating film.

title: Les 400 coups
actors: Jean-Pierre Léaud, Albert Rémy, Claire Maurier
description: Antoine Doinel (the director's alter ego in this and many other films) is a lonely, unwanted and misunderstood boy. To rebel, he skips school and steals here and there. When with his friend René he steals a typewriter to pay for a trip to the beach, they catch him and put him in the reformatory.
notes: Debut in the feature film by 26-year-old Truffaut, it is a hymn to freedom and youth considered one of the founding films of the nouvelle vague. A careful and participatory description of childhood, free of stereotypes and combined with a new idea of ??the world and cinema. "The film of the future will be an act of love", wrote the critic Truffaut shortly before, and this seems to be the implementation of his aspirations. Doinel and Leaud will return in four other films, up to the last "Love flees" in '78. Special Grand Jury Prize in Cannes in 1958.

title: Baisers volés
actors: Jean-Pierre Léaud, Delphine Seyrig, Michael Lonsdale, Claude Jade, Daniel Ceccaldi, Chantal Banlier, Harry Max
description: We are at the third episode of the "Adventures of Antoin Doinel" (this is the title of the book taken from the Truffaut films that have this character as the protagonist). Discharged from military service for instability of character (so it happened to the director himself) Antoine experiments strange jobs and knows love.

title: L'amour en fuite
actors: Jean-Pierre Léaud, Marie-France Pisier, Claude Jade
description: Antoine married Christine, but their relationship is now at an end. The two divorce, but remain good friends. After various adventures (including love affairs) Antoine finds serenity with Sabine, a young saleswoman who seems to be genuinely in love with him.
notes: It is the fifth and final episode linked to the character of Antoine Doinel, also played by Jean-Pierre Léaud, the director's alter ego. The precedents are: "The four hundred blows", "Love at twenty", "Stolen kisses" and "Let's not dramatize ... it's just a matter of horns". Doinel's character has also become the protagonist of a book, also written by Truffaut, which summarizes the entire film saga.

title: Spaced Invaders
actors: Ariana Richards, Douglas Barr, Royal Dano, Gregg Berger
description: Five extraterrestrials are traveling in their spaceship in the depths of space. Their secret destination is the third planet of the star called "sun"; their equally secret mission to conquer the planet. For this purpose, the five "UFOs" land on Earth, right in the vicinity of a quiet town in the United States (who knows why the "Martians" never land in Central Asia or Oceania). Here lives a lively little girl who accidentally comes into contact with the "invaders" who, however, instead of completing the mission, begin to combine all colors. This being the case, the child understands that for our sake (but above all for theirs) it is better to send them back to the sender.

title: Pay or Die
actors: Ernest Borgnine, Zohra Lampert, Alan Austin, Robert Simon
description: We are at the beginning of the century in New York's Little Italy. The mafia organization called "The Black Hand" dictates the law on everything and everyone by extorting shopkeepers by exaggerating poor people. Police lieutenant Joseph Petrosino is called to fight the criminals and soon discovers the secret leaders of the criminal organization: the banker Zarillo and the lawyer Di Sarno. Petrosino thus embarks for Italy.
notes: A true story fictionalized enough to fall within the canons of the Hollywood gangster movie. Aside from Borgnine, the cast is a bit subdued.

title: Buffalo Bill
actors: Joel McCrea, Maureen O'Hara, Linda Darnell, Anthony Quinn
description: In the firmament of the heroes of the American Westerrn epic, a prominent place undoubtedly belongs to William Frederick Cody, better known as Buffalo Bill for his well-known skills in hunting bison. With modern eyes, his massacres of large cattle appear to be useless slaughters that have put the species at risk of extinction, but at the time (late nineteenth century) ecology was still to be invented. Here then is the blond and scalp Cody to guide the army in the Indian wars and then organize a big circus with a western theme. In private life here is his turbulent relations with his wife (who always forgives him) and with President Grant who instead sends him to ruin.

title: Le streghe
directors: Luchino Visconti, Mauro Bolognini, Pier Paolo Pasolini, Vittorio De Sica
actors: Silvana Mangano, Annie Girardot, Francisco Rabal, Alberto Sordi, Clint Eastwood, Totò, Massimo Girotti, Véronique Vendell, Elsa Albani, Clara Calamai, Marilù Tolo, Nora Ricci, Dino Mele
description: Five episodes for as many directors with Silvana Mangano (then married to producer De Laurentiis) protagonist. 1: An actress tries to overcome her hypochondria with some friends. 2: A woman picks up a wounded man to ... make the love date first. 3: A widower with a half-foolish son "invents" a strange creature. 4: To make her lover jealous, a woman pretends to have another lover, but he reacts very badly. 5: Tired of a passionless relationship, a woman dreams of a fiery husband.
notes: Among the episodes, the two most relevant are naturally those due to Visconti ("The witch burned alive") and Pasolini ("The Earth seen from the Moon").

title: Banditi
actors: Ben Gazzara, Lino Troisi, Renato Mori, Marco Leonardi
description: Three men have been linked in the past by common militancy in a clandestine extra-parliamentary formation that has also carried out some terrorist actions. Now the three live in a foreign country where, however, violence is rampant and where corrupt politicians are the masters, quietly ignoring the laws. Mindful of their past (and their illegal actions) the three put their experience to good use no longer for ideological reasons, but only to improve their living conditions. Thus they carry out the kidnapping of an important minister and, after hiding him ...
notes: Variation on the theme "years of lead", but to digest it is really heavy ... like lead.

title: Ambush Bay
actors: Hugh O'Brian, Mickey Rooney, James Mitchum, Pete Masterson
description: The US fleet under General McArthur is underway for a major landing action that should mark the beginning of the Japanese defeat. We are in October 1944 and a patrol of marines lands on an island that is strategically located on the route of the American fleet. Soldiers must make contact with an informant and neutralize any mines that may obstruct navigation. The first contact with the enemy, however, is disastrous and only a few men are saved. Will they succeed in their enterprise?
notes: Classic fashion movie with all the ingredients of the genre. A little boring, but fairly well made.

title: A Fine Madness
actors: Sean Connery, Joanne Woodward, Jean Seberg, Patrick O'Neal
description: Samson is a poet always about to publish a great book of verses, but in the meantime he has to make a living with Rita, his companion who works as a waitress. To raise some money, Samson agrees to speak at a feminist cultural event where his speech however unleashes a pandemonium.
notes: The likeable scoundrel Connery is still betting all his cards on sensual appeal and so few realized he was also a good actor.

title: Il gobbo
actors: Gérard Blain, Anna Maria Ferrero, Bernard Blier, Ivo Garrani
description: In the last phase of the Second World War, Alvaro, a young man from the Roman suburbs, nicknamed "Il gobbo", gained fame by carrying out attacks against the Germans and the fascists. His main opponent is Police Commissioner Poletti who, in revenge, sees his daughter Nina raped. From that moment on, destiny unites the fate of the two young people. Alvaro is wounded by the Germans and thinks of taking refuge in Nina's house who, despite what has happened, falls in love with him.
notes: Raw post-resistance film among the best of Lizzani, he also had trouble with censorship. Pier Paolo Pasolini plays the part of the "one-armed".

title: Sparkling Cyanide
actors: Anthony Andrews, Pamela Bellwood, Deborah Raffin, Harry Morgan
description: A party is taking place in a villa to celebrate a wedding anniversary, but what was supposed to be a party turns into tragedy. The champagne that is served is poisoned and causes a disturbing series of murders that seem to have no end. A skilled detective comes into play as he tries to get to the bottom of the tangle.

title: Febbre di vivere
actors: Massimo Serato, Marina Berti, Anna Maria Ferrero, Marcello Mastroianni
description: Massimo lives by expedients and heads a group of young people who define themselves as existentialists, but who are actually vicious and amoral. Engaged to Elena, who loves her passionately, he has no qualms about betraying her, but when Daniele, a friend of his, gets out of prison, he asks him about his behavior. Massimo does not know what to answer to his friend also because Elena is pregnant and a big scam is discovered in the racing room of which he is responsible. So to appease Daniele, Massimo puts him in contact with his ex Lucia, who, however, does not want to know about him. In times of declining neorealism, one of the earliest and most ferocious portraits of the Italian bourgeoisie. Gora, actor and director, is an author to be discovered.

title: Spettri
actors: John Pepper, Katrine Michelsen, Donald Pleasence, Massimo De Rossi
description: During the excavations for the Rome underground, a wall collapses and a breach is opened on a necropolis. Four archaeologists Lasky, Barbara, Marcus and Andrea in search of an unidentified tomb of Domiziana, make the hypothesis that it may be part of the necropolis which came to light by chance. At the end of adventurous searches, a tomb is finally found, but while the investigations of the case are underway, strange phenomena occur.
notes: Marcello Avallone directs with an eye to Dario Argento, but neither the rather banal plot nor the effects of Sergio Stivaletti support him.

title: La disubbidienza
actors: Stefania Sandrelli, Teresa Ann Savoy, Mario Adorf, Marie Jose Nat, Karl Diemunch
description: Venice, end of the Second World War. Luca is seventeen years old and is in contrast with the bourgeois and fascist family and actively participates in the partisan struggle with the hope of building, after the victory, a better world. But Luca's expectations are destined to be shattered because the world doesn't want to change its rules. Everything is as before, even worse than before and Luca, suffering from pneumonia, wants to die. But the intervention of a governess and, later, a nurse make him change his mind.
notes: Based on a short novel by Moravia and written by Barbara Alberti and Amedeo Pagani, a mediocre softcore in an ultra-luxury package (music by Morricone, photography by Spinotti).

title: Le caporal épinglé
actors: Jean-Pierre Cassel, Claude Brasseur, O. E. Hasse, Claude Rich
description: In June 1940 in a Nazi prison camp, Corporal Dupont with his inseparable Dede and his friend Ballochet decide to flee. The project fails because the latter is forced to stop to look for the lost glasses. The corporal does not resign and with the trusted Dede gives life to a series of attempts, but luck does not assist them and each time they are caught again. One day Dupont meets a girl who is willing to help him by providing him with civilian clothes. Little senile Renoir, who returns with levity to themes and environments dear to him (see "The great illusion"); minor, but delicious.

title: Cannon for Cordoba
actors: George Peppard, Giovanna Ralli, Raf Vallone, Pete Duel
description: Hector Cordoba, a Mexican bandit who usually raids the border towns between Mexico and the United States, is actively sought by the police of both countries. After all attempts to bring him to justice have failed, the Americans instruct Captain Red Douglas to storm the base where the outlaw is hiding. The officer gets help from three soldiers, a Mexican lieutenant and Leonora, a former lover of Cordoba. But once they arrive at their destination, the girl betrays the Americans and informs Cordoba of their intentions ...
notes: An anomalous Western with a detective twist, not of excellent stature but of good strength.

title: DNA
actors: Jürgen Prochnow, Mark Dacascos, Claire Sommers, Robin McKee
description: A group of scientists on an expedition to Borneo finds the remains of a mysterious creature and decides to bring it back to life through DNA. One of them has in fact developed a system that allows you to derive the code through what remains of the bones. The experiment is successful and the scientist who developed the system decides to sell the creature to those who can offer more.
notes: Even a bad film can always maintain its dignity when it tries to tell something; but when we see a movie like this, embarrassing "Predator" rip-off, with a sprinkle of "Jurassic Park" and a wink at Indiana Jones, that shred of dignity has evaporated. Even the special effects, edited by the esteemed professionals of KNB EFX, are wrecked together with a plot already seen and the actors.

title: The Grotesque
actors: Alan Bates, Sting, Theresa Russell, Trudie Styler
description: In a dilapidated castle immersed in the English countryside, Sir Hugo, an eccentric aristocrat, is conducting research on dinosaurs. He is so immersed in his work that he does not realize that he is neglecting his American wife that, given the situation, he wants someone to console her. The arrival of a new pair of butlers ends up turning into a real nightmare.
notes: There is a fantastic irreverent grotesque streak that runs through English cinema, a streak that has produced masterpieces, such as those of Michael Powell, Losey, Russell, Greenaway. "Grotesque", directed by director and television producer Davidson, accumulates all the elements of this vein: it is grotesque and perverse, obsessed with the decay of environments and souls, with inexplicable murders, with sex and classes, but it is also so messed up and didactic to leave no room for either methodical perfidy or fantastic explosion. The actors have the grandiloquent inexpressiveness of caricatures and the overall atmosphere ends up becoming laughable rather than grotesque.

title: Gadjo Dilo
actors: Romain Duris, Rona Hartner, Izidor Serban, Ovidiu Balan
description: A Parisian from a beautiful family in an existential crisis crosses Romania, a land of nomads, in search of an unknown singer, Nora Luca, much loved and listened to by her father before dying. Walking amidst cold and hardship, the young man accidentally meets Izidor, an old gypsy drunk and sad because of the arrest of his son. The two spend a crazy night between songs and vodka, a prelude to a friendship that will lead the French to meet the woman of his life.
notes: Gatlif has always been attracted to the Roma universe: he has dedicated intense and poignant works to the microcosm of the "happy gypsies". "Gadjo dilo" confirms his talent and consistent commitment. Gisely awarded in Locarno in 1997 with the "Silver Leopard" and played by the extraordinary Romanian actress Rona Hartner (best actress, also in Locarno) and by the incredible, very nice non-actor Izidor Serban.

title: Mercury Rising
actors: Bruce Willis, Alec Baldwin, Miko Hughes, Chi McBride, Kim Dickens
description: An autistic child decodes a top-secret code from the Ministry of Defense in a puzzle newspaper. He never did: his parents are killed and he saves himself by hiding in the toy house. Left only to saddle Art Jeffries, an FBI agent as usual at war with superiors, then ...
notes: Thiller sewn ad hoc on the policeman's size of the monochord Bruce Willis, increasingly worried about how to invest his now enormous wealth and less and less credible and involved if not in general mediocrity, including that of Harold Becker who, when he can, does not throw himself away ("Taps", "Cocaine", "Dangerous Seduction", "City Hall"). It is better to be silent about the bolso and expressionless Alec Baldwin (in the role of the very bad and cynical Kudrow).

title: La mirada del otro
actors: Laura Morante, Miguel Bosé, José Coronado
description: Black sheep of a high-class Madrid family, bored by psychoanalysts and in search of her Mr. Goodbar, Begonia falls in love with "Owl", a Japanese devilry that records images and sounds instantly reprogramming them in a written word.
notes: Laura Morante gives herself soul and (above all) body. Participating in orgies and devouring penises, talking with their own nakedness from unthinkable perspectives, inviting a group of pimps to violence. A gynecologist of spirituality, Aranda slips into ridicule, but searches every flap of Begonia skin with natural morbidity.

title: Mangiati vivi!
actors: Ivan Rassimov, Janet Agren, Paola Senatore, Robert Kerman, Me Me Lai, Fiamma Maglione, Franco Fantasia, Franco Coduti
description: Sheila Morris is looking for her sister Diana, who has left New York to follow Melvyn Jonas, the leader of a sect that preaches a return to nature as the only means of escaping the poisons of civilization. Jonas and his followers have built an inaccessible refuge in New Guinea in an area infested with cannibals. Sheila is joined by Mark, a defector from the Vietnam War enticed by the promise of receiving eighty thousand dollars. The two overcoming enormous difficulties manage to find Diana and convince her to return to the civilized world. But the cannibals are lurking ...
notes: Umberto Lenzi directs this film for fans of the genre at the least worst possible way.

title: Pursuit of Honor
actors: Don Johnson, Craig Sheffer, Gabrielle Anwar, Rod Steiger
description: In the mid-thirties the United States was oppressed by a serious economic crisis and the armed forces were also affected by the economic problems that afflict the country. General McArthur in the mood to cut the excessive costs burdening his unit decides to have the excess horses killed. Lieutenant Marsh and Major Libbey disagree and begin an escape across Montana to try and rescue the herd. A TV movie in the classic rural tradition, it is partly saved for the good cast.

title: L'albero degli zoccoli
actors: Francesca Moriggi, Luigi Ornaghi, Antonio Ferrari, Carmelo Silva
description: Between the autumn of 1897 and the summer of 1898 four families apparently spent their life in a farmhouse in the Bergamo countryside in a quiet way. There is a deep bond between the members of this community that leads them to live together the good and bad things that life has in store for them. When it comes to paying the stern Mesagiù, the owner of the farm, two-thirds of the agricultural products everyone tries to cheat to earn a few pounds of flour. Together they kill the pig, separate the contenders and take part in village festivals and religious functions. One day in Menek a hoof breaks and in order to repair it, Papa Batistì is forced to cut a plant belonging to the owner without asking for permission.
notes: Ermanno Olmi constructs a subject where poetry and everyday life go hand in hand. Made with non-professional actors taken from the Bergamo countryside, the film is striking for its strength and the transparency with which it describes the peasant world. Carmelo Silva, famous Italian football designer plays the priest. Palme d'Or at the Cannes Film Festival in 1978.

title: Crime et châtiment
actors: Jean Gabin, Marina Vlady, Ulle Jacobson, Bernard Blier, Robert Hossein
description: René is a student who feels deep pity for the sufferings of the dispossessed and hates society. One day in a tavern René meets Pierre an alcoholic who, with his addiction which he cannot give up, has led his family to misery. René takes pity on him and leaves him 20,000 francs which he has just received from his mother and pawns the watch. When Pierre accidentally dies, René goes in search of his daughter who is a prostitute. Fairly faithful, but inevitably dull transposition of Dostoevsky's "Crime and Punishment".

title: Gli ultimi giorni di Pompei
actors: Steve Reeves, Christine Kaufmann, Fernando Rey, Barbara Carroll
description: The centurion Glaucus Cesonio returning from Palestine to his birthplace Pompeii finds the city in shock due to the criminal enterprises of a gang of thugs and looters who murder the members of the richest families. In this way the family of Glauco was exterminated and in the grip of a feeling of revenge goes to the Ascanio building. But the latter is maneuvered by his wife Giulia Lavinia and by the high priest of Isis. All while the rumbling of Vesuvius becomes more and more threatening ...
notes: Bankruptcy production based on the novel by Edward George Bulwer-Lytton. The film was terminated by Sergio Leone due to Mario Bonnard's illness.

title: Tenderly
actors: Virna Lisi, George Segal, Lila Kedrova, Paola Pitagora, Luciano Mondolfo
description: Iolanda and Franco, two old childhood friends, meet by chance at the Bologna station. After a brief interview, they discover that neither of them has married. While Franco is a doctor with a brilliant career behind him, she only works when she needs the money. Love is born from the encounter, but also a series of misunderstandings due to the different mentality that divides them.
notes: Brusati directs an unprecedented Segal / Lisi duo in a light comedy but with satirical cues.

title: Briganti, amore e libertà
actors: Claudio Amendola, Monica Bellucci, Benedetto Fanna, Pinuccio Ardia
description: In 1838 in the Kingdom of Naples and the two Sicilies, in a remote area of ??the South, the brigand Giuseppe Caruso was killed by Malacarne, gamekeeper of the Sangermano della Foresta barons. Nine months after his wife Maria gives birth to Giovanni, Costanza is born in the house of the barons, but her mother dies in childbirth. A wet nurse is needed to feed the child and destiny wants Mary to be the only one available.

title: Shooting Elizabeth
actors: Jeff Goldblum, Mimi Rogers, Juan Echanove, Simon Andreu
description: Harold Pîgeon (Jeff Goldblum) works as a director of a mineral water company and decides to kill his wife Elizabeth (Mimi Rogers). Will the man be able to complete his project without being indicted?
notes: Usual thriller with a Spanish cast except the two protagonists, produced by the United States together with France.

title: The Pawnbroker
actors: Rod Steiger, Geraldine Fitzgerald, Brock Peters, Jaime Sanchez
description: Sol Nazerman is a New York Jew who works as a money lender in Harlem for a pimp. A former deported to the Nazi concentration camps, that experience haunts him to the point of pushing him into inhuman behavior and full of resentment towards all humanity. But the death in his arms of the shop assistant, who took a bullet in his place during a robbery, plunges him into a deep crisis.
notes: When it came out, the film was overwhelmed by controversy for the somewhat confused theses it supported. Between melodrama and denunciation, there is a lot of meat in the fire: racial problems, anti-Semitism, marginalization, the relationship between victim and executioner, guilt and salvation. Steiger is intense and baroque, minimalist and theatrical.

title: Angst essen Seele auf
actors: El Hedi Ben Salem, Brigitte Mira, Irm Hermann, Barbara Valentin, Elma Karlowa, Anita Bucher, Gusti Kreissl, Doris Mattes, Margit Symo, Katharina Herberg, Lilo Pempeit, Peter Gauhe, Marquard Bohm, Walter Sedlmayr, Hannes Gromball, Hark Bohm, Rudolf Waldemar Brem, Karl Scheydt
description: Emmi, a widowed cleaning woman in her fifties, falls in love with the Moroccan Ali who is twenty years her junior and marries him. His decision throws his children and co-workers into turmoil.
notes: Remake of Douglas Sirk's "Second Love", directed by Fassbinder in his most prolific period. A beautiful melodrama, cruel and masochistic, about the relations of class, sex, race, power.

title: In the Shadow of Evil
actors: Treat Williams, Margaret Colin, Joe Morton, William H. Macy
description: Due to a car accident, a detective loses his memory just as he is hunting down a dangerous serial killer. The police psychologist who helps him find his identity and, consequently, his memory, suddenly finds himself in mortal danger when ...
notes: A serial killer, a policeman and a psychologist, raise your hand if you have not seen a film that offers these elements in no particular order. Despite all this film is dignified. Treat Williams is doing well and so are the other performers. Good pace and good tension.

title: The Seventh Victim
actors: Tom Conway, Kim Hunter, Jean Brooks, Evelyn Brent, Isabel Jewell
description: A girl who has just arrived in New York from the province in search of her sister who has long since emigrated to the Big Apple makes a terrible discovery. The woman has fallen into the hands of a sect of devil worshipers who want to push her to suicide. Freeing her from that heavy yoke is not easy also because the members of the sect do not allow anyone to leave their coven. The struggle undertaken by the girl to try to get out will be huge, but she can count on the help of her tenacious sister.
notes: One of the horror classics produced in the 1940s by Val Lewton for RKO. One of the most indicative of an absolutely realistic way to the fantastic, which in many ways will inspire films like "Rosemary's Baby" (but also the shower scene from "Psyco").

title: Laura non c'è
actors: Nicholas Rogers, Gigliola Aragozzini, Anna Maria Petrova
description: Lorenzo works in a comic book publishing house and one day he accidentally saves a girl who is about to be attacked by a group of criminals. He would like to know a little more about her private life, and a fortuitous circumstance reveals her address: the girl lives in the building opposite. Some time passes and Laura, this is her name, knocks on Lorenzo's door.
notes: Anyone who thinks they are facing the 90s version of the "musicarelli", with Morandi, Al Bano and Little Tony, will be disappointed. The film has two faces: ambitious from the point of view of structure and direction, but terribly unsolved in the dialogues and characters, often involved in the endless repetition of banal lines. Nor can the appearances nothing popòdimenoche by Amadeus, Federica Panicucci and Marta Flavi manage to cheer up.

title: Le faremo tanto male
actors: Stefania Sandrelli, Pino Quartullo, Ricky Memphis, Rocco Barbaro
description: The brothers Marco and Ruggero, the first park ranger, the second gas station attendant, live in a large green reserve in Abruzzo and dedicate their time to protecting nature. Federica Biki, former Italian film star, hosts the program "Occhio al pelo!" on a private broadcaster. The broadcast is a masked teleshopping sponsored by a major fur brand. The two decide to kidnap her and as a ransom they ask for the closure of the lager factory and the release of the animals still alive. But no one believes in the kidnapping, because Federica, to keep the attention on her character alive, has invented scandals, false kidnappings and accidents.
notes: Quartullo's fourth "autoractorial" feature film is taken, as always, from one of his plays, originally conceived for Sandra Milo. Which ran away a few days after the debut, allowing Stefania Sandrelli to take over. Rarely has there been such sloppiness and vulgarity, such wrong measures, parochial tones. Quartullo, in addition to quitting acting, should go to directing school.

title: The Big Lebowski
actors: Jeff Bridges, John Goodman, Julianne Moore, Steve Buscemi, Philip Seymour Hoffman, David Huddleston, Tara Reid, Philip Moon, Mark Pellegrino, Peter Stormare, Michael Balzary (Flea), John Turturro, Jimmie Dale Gilmor
description: Two hitmen break into Jeff Lebowski's apartment believing they are dealing with the famous billionaire of the same name, too bad that Dude, as his friends call him, is unemployed, thoughtless and totally immersed in the myth of the seventies. The first mistake Dude makes is to visit his homonymous rich man in hopes of getting the carpet that the killers have stained to be replaced.
notes: Extraordinary surreal tale, where everything ends up appearing grotesque, where there are no traumas or past stories for which it is worth fretting. Beautiful visionary shuffling (from the rolling subjective of a bowling ball to a musical dream between Busby Berkeley and Ken Russell, to the cameo of a legendary Turturro), not only demonstrates how good the Coens are, but also how immersed in today's reality, where after all, living in a quiet amazement could be the formula for survival (at least for the "survivors").

title: Double Team
actors: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Dennis Rodman, Paul Freeman, Mickey Rourke
description: Jack is one of the best counterintelligence agents, but he is tired of his profession and has decided to retire to lead a more peaceful existence. In the course of his last mission he misses the mark and in a moment all his certainties suddenly collapse. As punishment he is sent to the Colony, a kind of special team made up of people too dangerous to move and too precious to be killed.
notes: Like John Woo and Ringo Lam, Tsui Hark, a first-rate director and producer, also comes to Hollywood. The subject sways between the seductions of the 1960s TV series "The prisoner" in the first part and those of "Chen's scream terrifies even the West" in the second; but Tsui's directing emphasis fails to sustain a decidedly poor and predictable script.

title: My Son the Fanatic
actors: Om Puri, Gopi Desai, Akbar Kurtha, Sarah-Jane Potts, Judi Jones
description: Parvez is an Indian taxi driver who is perfectly integrated in England, while Farid the son suddenly begins to surprise his parents with strange behavior (he leaves his girlfriend, he sells his goods). Behind, there is the religious choice of fundamentalism, to which the son becomes a slave, a fanatic to the point of confining his mother in the kitchen and attacking the prostitutes of the city.
notes: Born from a short story published in the "New Yorker" by Hanif Kureishi (who then turned it into a screenplay), the film knows how to calibrate the tones of comedy with the hallucinated psychology of fundamentalism; he knows how to question himself on the absurdity of an ideology that denies elementary rights, but also of a bourgeois life lived according to others.

title: Nil by Mouth
actors: Ray Winstone, Kathy Burke, Charlie Creed-Miles, Edna Dore
description: East End, in the extreme south of London, Ray lives with his wife Valerie in a shabby block of flats. His brother-in-law Billy foolish and drugged does nothing but plan robberies and to look for drugs is also willing to beg.
notes: Very hard, unpleasant, yet deeply affectionate and "right": the first film directed by Oldman (who does not appear in the cast), winner at the 1997 Cannes Film Festival of a well-deserved award to actress Kathy Burke (but also Ray Winstone, who plays the husband, he's very good). Inspired by his adolescence in the suburbs of London, accompanied by the music of Eric Clapton, he goes at the characters with a hand machine that returns a devastated and bewildering reality. And that also, towards the end, having reached the pinnacle of suffering, manages to rediscover a solidarity and a sense of all British roots.

title: Deep Impact
actors: Robert Duvall, Téa Leoni, Morgan Freeman, Elijah Wood, Vanessa Redgrave
description: Leo has recently joined his high school astronomers club when he makes a dramatic discovery with his small telescope: a comet is on a collision course with Earth. When Jenny, an ambitious journalist, is confronted with the embarrassed responses of a former minister, she believes she has unearthed a pink scandal. But he soon realizes that life on Earth is running out of time.
notes: Between "Independence Day" and "The Day After", the second feature film of Kathryn Bigelow's "granddaughter", Mimi Leder (sponsored by Spielberg), adds nothing to the doomsday scenarios that Hollywood has unleashed in the turn-of-the-millennium.

title: Deep Rising
actors: Treat Williams, Famke Janssen, Anthony Heald, Kevin J. O'Connor, Wes Studi
description: From the unfathomable depths of the South China Sea, hideous creatures emerge that attack and feed on the passengers of the Argonautica, a luxury cruise ship. The voracious sea snakes have besieged every deck, every chamber and transformed the ship into a floating chamber of horrors. To help the ship threatened by a group of terrorists, there is the Saipan. When they dock their boat at the Argonautica and get on board they discover that the boat has become a ghost boat.
notes: After "Titanic" and "Sfera" here are the horrors of "Deep Rising", at low cost and with a lot of open ending.

title: Mr. Magoo
actors: Leslie Nielsen, Kelly Lynch, Matt Keeslar, Stephen Tobolowsky, Malcolm McDowell
description: The billionaire Quincy Magoo, who comes into possession of a stolen precious gem, becomes the target of a plot organized by the perpetrators of the theft, to recover the stone. Magoo manages to escape their attempts every time, indeed, he has the bad guys arrested aided by his nephew Waldo and the faithful bulldog Angus.
notes: To return the involuntary madness of the myopic billionaire protagonist of a famous cartoon, it would have taken the John Landis of the best of times. Or the Blake Edwards of the Pink Panther. Instead they called the Hongkonger Stanley Tong, the trusted director of Jackie Chan ("Earthquake in the Bronx" ...), too unsophisticated for the subject. Thin plot (there is a diamond to be recovered), money wasted and Leslie Nielsen exaggeratedly stupefied.

title: Blues Brothers 2000
actors: Dan Aykroyd, John Goodman, Joe Morton, J. Evan Bonifant
description: Elwood Blues gets out of jail and discovers that many things have changed: his brother Jake is dead, the band has broken up and the orphanage where he grew up has been destroyed. Even Curtis, the keeper of the institution who had been a father to them, has passed away. He is left with only a sort of half-brother, Cabel, natural son of Curtis. Going to his former teacher, he finds her struggling with Buster, a ten-year-old orphan. Elwood realizes he has to get the band back together to get the kid back on track.
notes: The Blues Brothers 18 years later, without Belushi and Cab Calloway (to whom the film is dedicated, together with John Candy). For all those who are in love with the original number two is very disappointing. The energy is still in the music (for which Landis has been able to count on the best of the blues); but it is no longer in the cinema. There are a couple of scenes worthy of old Landis (the bluegrass concert and the evangelical meeting); yet these are also affected by the "staging", while in 1980 the delirium seemed to flow naturally from the camera. All a bit pathetic, like a reunion of former schoolmates.

title: Backfire
actors: Virginia Mayo, Viveca Lindfors, Edmond O'Brien, Dane Clark
description: Bob is in the hospital for an operation. Still numb from anesthesia, he learns that his friend Steve is dying following an accident. Bob later also learns that Steve is accused of the death of Solly, his gambling partner in a gambling den. Bob then decides to go out of his way to help his friend and finds the help of Sally, a nurse in love with him.
notes: Good genre product with a respectable cast and scrupulous direction: high craftsmanship routines as they used to in Hollywood.

title: Make Them Die Slowly
actors: John Morghen, Lorraine De Selle, Brian Redford, Zora Kerova, Robert Kerman
description: Three young American students decide to go to the Amazon rainforest for a degree research on the non-existence of the practice of cannibalism among indigenous peoples. The boys soon get lost in the jungle, where they meet two compatriots fleeing a nearby village. The two are wounded and tell of being the victim of a terrible attack by the natives of the place, who are also said to be ferocious cannibals. The initial story slowly crumbles once the group of Americans reach the village again and come into contact with the natives.
notes: Last film in the “cannibal” trilogy by Umberto Lenzi (“The country of wild sex” -1972, “Eaten alive” -1980).

title: La loi
actors: Gina Lollobrigida, Pierre Brasseur, Marcello Mastroianni, Yves Montand
description: The law of the title is the unwritten one, but to which everyone is subject, which governs the life of the small community of a Corsican village. The head of the village is Don Cesare, who lives in a large house surrounded by women. Among these, Marietta, daughter and granddaughter of servants of Don Cesare's house, stands out for her beauty, but also for the independence of her character. An agronomist from the continent falls in love with her, but other eyes have also rested on her ...
notes: Vigorous in the staging, suggestive in the images, well supported by a bombproof cast, Dassin's film is an apologue on the absence of codes in a world governed by an archaic code.

title: A Soldier's Story
actors: Howard E. Rollins jr., Adolph Caesar, Art Evans, Denzel Washington, David Alan Grier
description: We are in 1944 in the state of Louisiana in a military training camp, where the men are preparing to be sent to the front. In a company made up exclusively of black men, Sergeant Waters, also black, is hated for his aggressive character. One night when he got a terrific hangover in a club, the sergeant is found killed in the bushes of a suburban street.
notes: Based on the play by Charles Fuller, author of the screenplay and starring the Negro Ensemble Company, it's a robust if not genius film. Music by Herbie Hancock.

title: Sei jellato amico, hai incontrato Sacramento
actors: Ty Hardin, Christian Hay, Jenny Atkins, Giacomo Rossi Stuart
description: Jack Thompson, known to all as Sacramento, is a boxer out of a spirit of exhibitionism, has been in his forties for some time and owns a farm. He has two children, Jim and Evelyn, and many servants, including Hike in love with Evelyn. Tom, who lost a lot of money to Jack in boxing match bets, captures Sacramento. But just when he is about to hang him, his children arrive to save him. But Tom doesn't give up and storms the bank where Sacramento has deposited all his savings.
notes: Modest example of an Italian western with Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Kim's father.

title: L'amore nasce a Roma
actors: Claudio Villa, Antonio Cifariello, Valeria Moriconi, Rossella Como
description: Lello and Mario arrived from their hometown in Rome in search of fortune. One is a painter, the other is a singer. The beginnings are not encouraging, because neither one nor the other show any particular artistic skills. The two young people meet Doretta and Silvia, two pretty florists in Piazza di Spagna and immediately fall in love with them, however reciprocated. One day, by chance, it turns out that Lello has a good voice and from a painter he ends up turning into a singer. Out of spite, Mario grabs his brushes and paints some pictures, which immediately find buyers.
notes: Usual film born on the singing talents of Claudio Villa, in short, a mere pretext to listen to some (beautiful) songs.

title: Mr. Baseball
actors: Tom Selleck, Ken Takakura, Aya Takanashi, Dennis Haysbert
description: Tom Selleck is a dying baseball champion who gets a tempting gig in Japan, where baseball has become hugely popular. In his new team, the "Chiunichi Dragons", however, he finds a fanatic coach with a very rigid mentality who pays more attention to discipline than dialogue.
notes: Tom "Magnum P.I." Selleck continues his career on the comic-brilliant side; for Ken Takakura, on the other hand, there is another clash (naturally lost) with the Yankee "civilization" after "Black Rain".

title: Problem Child 3: Junior in Love
actors: William Katt, Justin Chapman, Gilbert Gottfried, Jack Warden
description: Junior fell in love with Tiffany, the most popular girl in his school. Not giving up on the overwhelming girl, Junior terrifies everyone he meets on the street, including his cantankerous grandfather. What's more, his dentist is keen to put braces on him.
notes: Arrived at the third episode of the series "Little Plague" few are convinced that it is still funny. And then there is no longer John Ritter who with his bewildered faces guaranteed a few more laughs. In its place is William Katt, ex "Ralph Supermaxieroe".

title: Kill me Again
actors: Val Kilmer, Joanne Whalley, Michael Madsen, Jonathan Gries, Michael Greene, Bibi Besch
description: A private investigator who has an office in the city center and who does not have a large clientele gets carried away when a woman asks him to make everyone believe that she has passed away. But things go badly when everything is discovered and for the "private eye" and the woman everything gets damned complicated.
notes: Predictable and obvious television film for which it is not worth spending an hour and a half in front of the TV set, despite the presence of Val Kilmer and Joanna Whalley. The two actors, at the time of the making of the film, were also a constant couple in life.

title: Dama s sobachoj
actors: Iya Savvina, Aleksei Batalov, Nina Alisova
description: Mr. Gurov, married without too much enthusiasm, leads a gray life. When, during a vacation in the Crimea, he meets a young lady, who is also on vacation and alone, the two fall madly in love. Back in Moscow, Gurov is unable to get the woman out of his mind and thus reaches her village, determined to take her away. Social conventions are stronger than love and she makes him leave with the promise of seeing each other, from time to time, in a hotel in the capital.
notes: From the eponymous story by Anton Cechov, a portrait of a gray bourgeoisie in an interior and an exterior. A film made up of gestures, silences, expectations, trepidations. Very well photographed by Andrej Moskvin and Dmitri Mesiev and written by the director himself with meticulous attention to the moral rigor of the reference play. One of the best translations of Chekhov on screen.

title: Misbegotten
actors: Kevin Dillon, Lysette Anthony, Nick Mancuso, Stefan Arngrim
description: Billy, a schizophrenic serial killer, kills Conan, an almost unknown music composer and assumes his identity. Meanwhile, Paul and Caitlan have been trying for a long time to have a child and after much hesitation they finally decide to resort to artificial insemination. For a tragic combination, the clinic where the couple should have the operation calls for a sperm donation Billy and it will be his semen to fertilize the woman. Fascinated by the idea of ??procreation, the killer tries in every way to discover the identity of the woman who received his seed and to do this he does not hesitate to kill.

title: L'ultimo sapore dell'aria
actors: Carlo Lupo, Maurizio Rossi, Angela Goodwin, Jacques Sernas
description: Diego is a boy with some problems. Harassed at school, the family does not find a better atmosphere oppressed as it is by his mother and stepfather who put his younger half-brothers before him. Tired of the situation, Diego decides to leave and finds a job at a sporting club where he can train secretly in swimming, his great sporting passion. Here he also finds a couple of affectionate friends, older than him, who adopt him almost like a child. But fate has a bitter sentence in store.
notes: Much indebted to the famous "Love story", he gets lost in tourist illustrations and melodramatic sketches. Negligible.

title: Tra noi due tutto è finito
actors: Elena Sofia Ricci, Richard Berry, Lucio Allocca, Alessandra Casella
description: Daniele Fornari is a journalist by trade. He works in an important Roman newspaper and is very much in his career. Daniele is married to Gabriella, but he is not what is called a faithful husband as he has always been an incurable womanizer. Tired of her husband's constant infidelities, Gabriella, to make him jealous, confesses that she also has a lover. Of course this is a lie, but that is enough for the incurable Don Juan to enter a crisis. Bitten by doubt, Daniele suddenly stops his habits to improvise detective and discover, without his wife's knowledge, the name, surname and address of the elusive rival. And he almost succeeds ...

title: Escoriandoli
actors: Valentina Cervi, Isabella Ferrari, Claudia Gerini, Valeria Golino, Antonio Rezza
description: Episode movies. In the first, an exquisite corpse lets out some aphrodisiac words, while in the second episode a gravedigger is struck by fulminating senescence. It continues with a Community Against which tries to neutralize those who cannot be integrated into the sentiment of good taste. A poet is overwhelmed by guilt for having stepped on the foot of a fat man. A presidentialist experiences a traumatic conflict with his body that does not want to know that it is obeying him.
notes: After having filled up with prizes in various editions of the Bellaria Independent Film Festival, the couple Rezza / Mastrella throws themselves into the feature film carrying out a project that - attending the dictates of the theater of the absurd - gives birth to a very original corporal and linguistic surrealism.

title: The Macomber Affair
actors: Gregory Peck, Joan Bennett, Robert Preston, Reginald Denny
description: A young American married couple arrives in Africa to take part in a safari. On the spot the two engage the best local hunter and with him begin their adventure. The husband wishes to redeem himself with an act of courage in the eyes of his wife, who does not consider him manly enough.
notes: Taken from the first of Hemingway's "49 tales", the film diverges from the plot of the book in the ending, which is less bitter here. Although not very original, it is a fairly direct and interpreted work.

title: Metroland
actors: Christian Bale, Lee Ross, Emily Watson, Elsa Zylberstein
description: London suburbs of the 60s, conformists, petty bourgeois, still far from the explosion of fashions, rhythms and follies that would soon spread all over the world. Suffocated in Metroland, a district of London, two friends decide to escape: Toni gets lost along the routes of Africa, while Chris lets himself be enchanted by Paris ...
notes: It is a pity that the direction of Philip Saville (a good director, especially television director, almost unknown in Italy), fails to fully reproduce the acute contrast of cultures that animates Julian Barnes's book. The film remains just a somewhat flat example of "nostalgia".

title: Mimic
actors: Mira Sorvino, Jeremy Northam, Alexander Goodwin, Giancarlo Giannini, Josh Brolin
description: An old urban legend told of an albino alligator in the sewer and ravines of the New York subway. Exactly what happens, this time seriously, in the subway that is filled with gigantic insects created by a genetic experiment. The responsible is a scientist (Mira Sorvino) who, with a variously assorted "heroic patrol" has to fight with the ravenous cockroaches, whose main power is that of mimicry.
notes: If the "denied" motherhood of the protagonist (she "gave birth" to the beasts in the laboratory and, almost as a retaliation, she cannot have children) makes so much Aliens (but with less intensity), most of the twists are a bit obvious . but the atmosphere works. And then Guillermo Del Toro uses Rob Bottin's sickening monsters to fill the scene.

title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
actors: Jennifer Love Hewitt, Sarah Michelle Gellar, Ryan Phillippe, Freddie Prinze Jr.
description: Two couples of high school students on the night of the New Year's party run over a man with their car. Terrified of the possible negative consequences for their lives, the boys decide to throw his body into the water and not reveal what happened to anyone. After a year, the four, who in the meantime had lost touch, are blackmailed and threatened by someone who knows their secret.
notes: After the success of "Scream", screenwriter Kevin Williamson tries to exploit the favorable moment by churning out "Scream 2", "Scream 3" and this "I know what you did", which seem to be molded from the same mold. Fully oiled in every part and full of quotes, the film destroys precisely because of its mechanical perfection. And this does not spare even the accident that sets the film in motion and which turns out to be a gigantic misunderstanding, a "macguffin" with a typically Hitchcockian flavor.

title: Natura contro
actors: May Deseligny, Marco Merlo, Fabrizio Merlo, Pier Maria Federici
description: A journalist is looking for Professor Korenz, who was reported missing in the wilds of the Amazon. Three of her friends accompany her on the journey: a biologist, a pilot and a lover of adventure and danger. Korenz disappeared during his last expedition which aimed to discover the civilization of the Imas, a mythical people left untouched by the white civilization.
notes: Antonio Climati had directed "Last screams from the savannah" in 1975, a mediocre example of adventurous cinema made in Italy. Unfortunately it seems that time has not passed for him.

title: Cheyenne Warrior
actors: Kelly Preston, Bo Hopkins, Dan Haggerty, Clint Howard, Rick Dean
description: In the land of the border sometimes it happens that pale and the redssembly faces mix their destinies until they confuse them. A young white woman and a Cheyenne warrior fall in love, but the cultural difference is very large and, above all, insurmountable are the prejudices of the respective communities of belonging. They will have to choose between the love that unites them and the psychological conflict that divides them.
notes: A little more than a show, also as duration. Deliberately reappears to the minority vein of American cinema of the so -called "good Indian" (whose best -known specimen is "dances with the wolves") with the addition, in homage to the time, of a splash of (demagogic) anthropologism. The (good) intentions, however, are not enough to save the shaky shack.

title: Simbad e il califfo di Bagdad
actors: Roberto Malcom, Sonia Wilson, Gigi Bonos, Spartaco Conversi
description: Tired of sailing the seas, Simbad returns home, but finds himself poor in the barrel because of two swindlers. Thus he finds himself on a ship on which also travels the beautiful Sherazade, betrothed to the cruel caliph of Baghdad. After a fantastic journey on a balloon, Simbad finds himself in the city of a thousand and one nights where the love of Sherazade awaits him.
notes: Italic imitation of fantasy a la Harryhausen, directed by an old trader now out of shape, and with two lire.

title: U.S. Marshals
actors: Tommy Lee Jones, Wesley Snipes, Robert Downey jr., Joe Pantoliano, Kate Nelligan
description: A homicide wanted man injured in a car accident must be transferred from the civilian hospital to the New York prison hospital. During the transfer trip the plane crashes and Mark escapes.
notes: Second cinematic episode of the adventures of Samuel Gerard, the federal agent who in 1993 chased Harrison Ford in "The Fugitive". Same hard and lined face as Tommy Lee Jones, same sardonic sense of humor, same spectacular catastrophes, same fast and broken rhythm from the show. It is a pity, however, that in "U. S. Marshals" the tension and action fade away after the first half hour, that the intrigue is largely predictable, that the good face really corresponds to the good and the vaguely annoying the real bad. What's more, Snipes has an expressive range that goes from zero to one at best.

title: Artemisia
actors: Valentina Cervi, Michel Serrault, Miki Manojlovic, Luca Zingaretti
description: In the 17th century, in Italy, the adolescent Artemisia Gentileschi, daughter of the painter Orazio, discovered the pleasures of life, of the flesh and of the brushes thanks to Agostino Tassi, a stalwart collaborator of her father. Artemisia, after being discovered in intimacy with the man, is called to testify against him. "Whose are those male nudes?" the Court asks, scandalized. Try to guess who they belong to.
notes: Other times? In short ...: in the United States they have forbidden it to minors under 17 ... Agnès Merlet, who had made her debut in 1993 with "Le fils du requin", a beautiful work still unpublished in Italy, is a little overwhelmed by responsibility of the co-production on a medium-high budget but, in any case, here has the merit of leaving space for Italian actors of charisma such as Luca Zingaretti and especially Valentina Cervi, a talented doe of art that allows the film to reflect the colors of an instinctive painting and passionate as the character dictates.

title: Niagara Niagara
actors: Robin Tunney, Henry Thomas, Michael Parks, Stephen Lang
description: Marcy, a girl suffering from Tourette's syndrome, a rare mental illness that causes irrepressible and obsessive behavior, meets Seth who lives on petty theft. The girl is desperate for a doll that is found only around Toronto and convinces Seth to accompany her to Canada. However, Seth is unaware of Marcy's illness.
notes: At the Venice Film Festival Robin Tunney with this film earned the award for interpretation. Overrated, in a part all tics and moves, worthy of a very obvious film. In fact, "Niagara Niagara" is just yet another youthful-psychotic road movie, without enough determination to risk the paper of the genre film, and with the presumption of keeping us entangled by recycling fifty years of American cinema. Cloaked in intellectualism, it is presumptuous and predictable.

title: Separate Tables
actors: Deborah Kerr, David Niven, Rita Hayworth, Burt Lancaster
description: The tables in the title are those of an English pension where some regulars live. Among them is John Malcolm, a long-time divorced American writer who, despite having an affair with the owner of the hotel, has never forgotten his first wife. Another customer is the shy and inhibited Pollock, self-styled officer, in love with the equally shy Sibyl, dominated by an intrusive and possessive mother.
notes: The theatrical origin of the film is all too open, but the cast is truly breathtaking.

title: The Razor's Edge
actors: Bill Murray, Theresa Russell, Catherine Hicks, Denholm Elliott, James Keach
description: Larry Darrell (Murray) is an American veteran of the Great War that the conflict has profoundly changed the soul. At the end of the hostilities he would like to resume normal life where his fiancée, the upcoming wedding and a safe and quiet workplace are waiting for him. The young man, however, first of all wants to rediscover himself and the profound reasons for his life and so he leaves everything and everyone and leaves for the inaccessible regions of the Himalayas.
notes: Adaptation of the novel of the same name by W.S. Maugham, the film was very strongly wanted by Bill Murray, fresh from the success of the first "Ghostbuster". The film was a failure, and in fact it is rather confused and discontinuous.

title: Polvere di Napoli
actors: Silvio Orlando, Lola Pagnani, Tonino Taiuti, Teresa Saponangelo
description: Film in five episodes. In "Fucking at seven" we return to the "Gold of Naples" palace where the Marquis was challenged by Scopa by the goalkeeper's son. The son of the Marquis has an asphyxiating wife and to escape them he does everything to organize a fucking game with the goalkeeper of the building. "The wedding": Teresa, 24 years old Sbita against Gigino, 27 years old. The two, who are married but do not live under the same roof for economic problems, do nothing but fight. "Fred": a couple of Argentine tourists on a honeymoon falls to Pompeii on the only day of strike. "Richard Gere": an aspiring actor desperately seeks the three hundred thousand lire who, together with the photos, serve him to participate in a television show. "Ciarlie and Gerri" are two forty -year -olds, Charlie Parker and Ornette Coleman dream of Macarene and Affini, but one day during a wedding they make up and play a jazz piece.
notes: Capuano, with painful irony, draws his personal map of Naples, depicting characters who sway from a desperate realism to a graceful surreal madness that flows into a grotesque cannibalism, kept together by the suffocating heat of the sirocco and the dust that brings with it.

title: Mrs. Brown
actors: Judi Dench, Billy Connolly, Geoffrey Palmer, Anthony Sher
description: She, Queen Victoria was one of the most powerful women on earth, he, John Brown was a humble Scottish stable boy. Yet a relationship was born between the two that scandalized the entire nation and risked shaking the monarchy.
notes: When Brown catches four journalists spying on the royal group on an outing, we see how the British tabloid press has long been interested in the royal family. But if the film is exquisite from a formal point of view, it fails to read what lies behind the faces of the two protagonists, as if stiffened by the conventions of the Victorian era.

title: Menace II Society
actors: Tyrin Turner, Jada Pinkett Smith, Larenz Tate, Arnold Johnson
description: The black neighborhood of Watts, in Los Angeles, is, as happens in all American metropolises, the place where scum rages, thanks to the degradation and poverty of the population and the inaction of the institutions. When the shadows of the evening fall, violence, robberies, drug dealing and bloody clashes between rival gangs are the order of the day.
notes: Many films have been made about black ghettos, their people, their problems and their future. This is among the worst.

title: Body Chemistry 3
actors: Morgan Fairchild, Andrew Stevens
description: A charming psychologist seems haunted by a strange curse: the men with whom she forms romantic relationships all have a bad end and they do it in a particularly theatrical way. This is what happened to the two boyfriends the woman who is now called by a television network to make her story the subject of a television movie. This materializes and the film is put into production. The executive producer, that is the one who follows the various stages of filming and editing, at a certain point, however, is no longer able to distinguish fiction from reality and is involved in a deadly game.
notes: Second sequel to the movie "Fatal Passion". With Morgan Fairchild, the queen of "Flamingo Road".

title: Il giorno di San Sebastiano
actors: Silvana Prinzivalli, Franco Scaldati, Vincenzo Albanese
description: The subject of the film is based on a historical fact that really happened in the countryside of the Sicilian village of Caltavuturo, in the last years of the nineteenth century. Here, during the feast of the patron saint San Sebastiano, the peasants take advantage of the presence of the whole town to claim ownership of the land they work. A platoon of Bersaglieri, sent to suppress the demonstration with the connivance of the local mafia, fired on the crowd. Fifteen dead remain on the ground.
notes: Presented in Venice in '94, it was not reported beyond the commendable commitment to recall an episode that is still convenient to ignore today. Music by Franco Battiato.

title: Viaggio di nozze all'italiana
actors: Conchita Velasco, Toni Ucci, Ferruccio Amendola, Luigi De Filippo, Renzo Montagnani
description: Four couples on their honeymoon arrive at the Flora hotel in Sorrento. Camillo and Gina, who have won their stay in a competition, go wild but don't have a penny to pay for the extras. Andrea and Rosetta got married for convenience. Filippo married Maria Cristina, much older than him, only for the huge dowry. Consider killing her at the earliest opportunity. Nicola and Pasquale are two thieves who arrive at the hotel disguised as newlyweds.
notes: From a plot little more consistent than jokes (written by the director himself), a repertoire of banalities for interpreters not always up to par. In the cast also Montagnani and Luigi De Filippo at the beginners.

title: Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves
actors: Maria Montez, Jon Hall, Turhan Bey, Andy Devine, Kurt Katch
description: The legitimate heir to the throne of Baghdad is overthrown by a treacherous adviser who, with the help of the Mongolian army, killed his father and enslaved the country's population. However, the young man finds refuge and protection among a band of thieves of which he soon becomes the leader ... One of the little kitsch jewels of the exotic vein in technicolor with Maria Montez, which Universal churned out in large numbers in the 40s.

title: Graziella
actors: Maria Fiore, Jean-Pierre Mocky, Tina Pica, Franco Nicotra, Elisa Cegani
description: We are in 1821. The French nobleman Alphonse de Lamartine is in Naples as a guest of his uncle. Here he meets two commoners, fishermen from the island of Procida with whom he often goes out by boat. For a storm he lands on the island of the Gulf, at the home of one of the two fishermen where he meets Graziella, daughter of his friend and betrothed to a cousin. Alphonse falls in love, reciprocated by the girl, but fate holds a future of separation and amorous torments in store.
notes: Giorgio Bianchi is much more at ease in comedy. When he lets himself be tempted by literature (the film is based on Lamartine's memoirs), the dazzling Maria Fiore of "Two soldi of hope" fails.

title: Tawk al hamama al mafqud
actors: Navin Chowdhry, Walid Arakji, Ninar Esber
description: The story narrated in the film is set in the Arab kingdom of El Andalus, in the 11th century, that is, in the Arabized Spain of the Caliphate of Cordoba over which the wise and powerful Al Mansur reigns. It is the most advanced and enlightened kingdom in contemporary Europe, home to doctors, philosophers and scientists such as Avicenna and Averroè. Here also lives a young calligrapher inflamed by the thirst for knowledge, and by the love for a girl of the same age. Mysterious events are looming on the horizon of the two young people.
notes: The setting is the same as in "The Destiny" by the Egyptian Chahine, a sign that the example of tolerance and pluralism represented by that historical experience persists in the Arab world.

title: Corps à coeur
actors: Hélène Surgere, Nicolas Silberg, Madeleine Robinson
description: A car mechanic with the makings of a seducer falls in love with an older pharmacist. What seems like an easy conquest turns out to be a tough nut to crack for our Don Juan who is forced into a long courtship. She finally agrees to spend three weeks in Provence with him, but fate has a bitter surprise in store.
notes: As in many other films by Vecchiali, also in this cinephile melodrama (with an atmosphere, at times, of 1930s péoetic realism) the feelings are filmed with cruelty, in an over the top staging, all lowered into the bodies of the talented actors. and with a hyper-realistic photography.

title: Rose Hill
actors: Jennifer Garner, Tristan Tait, Zak Orth, Jennifer D. Sams, Justin Chambers
description: In pioneer America, four orphaned brothers form a gang that thrives on wits. One day they steal a wagon to rob it, but inside they find a baby in swaddling clothes. Adam, the eldest, would like to get rid of the tender bundle as he dreams of going West in search of fortune, but the others manage to change his mind.
notes: Even if the Disney brand is missing we are not far from it. Good workmanship, good pace, high professionalism and ... little substance.

title: Rich in Love
actors: Albert Finney, Jill Clayburgh, Kyle MacLachlan, Kathryn Erbe, Suzy Amis, Piper Laurie, Ethan Hawke, Alfre Woodard
description: Lucille is a seventeen year old full of ideas and initiatives: a real volcano of girl, nice and generous. When her father falls into a depressive crisis for separation from her wife Lucille she tries in every way to help him. In doing so, however, he does not realize that he is about to fall in love with his sister's husband's husband. What a blanket!
notes: Bruce Beresford is known above all for "A walk with Daisy", the beautiful comedy beautifully interpreted by the unforgettable Jessica Tandy. Although he tried again here, that result remains unparalleled for him too despite the beautiful couple of interpreters chosen for this comedito with vaguely allean echoes.

title: Figaro qua... Figaro là
actors: Totò, Gianni Agus, Isa Barzizza, Renato Rascel, Franca Marzi, Nuto Navarrini
description: We are in Seville, in 1759. The Count of Almaviva (Agus) is in love with Rosina (Barzizza), the daughter of the governor of the city. The latter, however, decided that the young woman marries Don Alonzo (Rascel), the head of the guards. Almaviva then asked for help from the barber Figaro (Totò), known throughout the city and master of intrigues. Together they decide to kidnap Rosina, but not everything goes as planned ...
notes: Exploiting the lines of Rossini's work, a costumed farce directed by Bragaglia with brio, but with Totò less protagonist than usual.

title: Babes on Broadway
actors: Mickey Rooney, Judy Garland, Fay Bainter, Richard Quine, Donna Reed
description: After the success of their first "home-made" show, the two sons of variety actors are ready for the big leap to the Broadway stage. However, not everything is as dazzling as it seems and some disappointments must be taken into account.
notes: Sequel to "Boys Actors" has a little less liveliness and bite than that. Assistant director: Vincente Minnelli, future husband of Garland.

title: Ursus nella terra di fuoco
actors: Ed Fury, Claudia Mori, Luciana Gilli, Adriano Micantoni
description: Ursus is the "guarantor of freedom" of a peaceful and hard-working people on which the perfidious Amilcare has expansionist aims. At the first good opportunity Hamilcar neutralizes Ursus, kills the king and invades the country. The hero, however, is not dead and at the tournament called to celebrate the victory he takes the field and defeats the opposing champions. His (mis) adventures are not over, however, also because Diana, daughter of the legitimate ruler, is a prisoner of the usurper ...
notes: One of the most popular products of the mythological muscular genre in vogue in the sixties. With Ed Fury, a second-rate "muscle man", and not yet Mrs. Celentano Claudia Mori.

title: La grande bouffe
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Philippe Noiret, Michel Piccoli, Ugo Tognazzi, Andréa Ferréol
description: Four friends from different social backgrounds, but united by a common love for good food, meet in the dilapidated villa with the garden of one of them to spend an entire weekend eating and drinking. Three prostitutes brought in to revive the gastronomic marathon soon tire of the erotic indifference of the hosts, all taken by the dishes, and leave.
notes: Ferreri's masterpiece and his greatest commercial success. A merciless metaphor on the consumerism of the well-being society inexorably devoted to self-destruction. After Bunuel, before Pasolini, in any case a "cult".

title: Take Me to Town
actors: Ann Sheridan, Sterling Hayden, Philip Reed, Lee Patrick, Lee Aaker
description: The shepherd of a remote village of rough woodcutters has a wife and a large brood of children. When the woman dies he realizes that he has to give the children a new mother and, after laborious research, the choice falls on a nice and energetic young lady who is however a saloon dancer with an ambiguous past.
notes: Western comedy with the typical characterizations of the films on the Frontier, but definitely turned pink by a Sirk on vacation from his melos. As a corollary of a cast with all the trimmings.

title: Rosa la Rose fille publique
actors: Marianne Basler, Jean Sorel, Pierre Cosso
description: Rosa is a young prostitute who works in the Parisian district of Les Halles. He has a protector, colleagues with whom he gets along fairly well; when he meets a young painter he believes he can change his life. But it's not that simple: the links with the past and with the surrounding environment are very strong.
notes: Vecchiali can be considered an expert in contemporary melodramas. Non-trivial works through which he often manages to illuminate with precise precision the many tensions that cross individuals. In this case he frescoes a past (the amtosphere of the 1940s) and a neighborhood (Les Halles) that no longer exist.

title: Muriel ou le temps d'un retour
actors: Delphine Seyrig, Jean Pierre Kérjen, Nita Klein
description: In the peaceful existence of Hélène, who lives and works in Boulogne, a former lover from many years ago unexpectedly returns. Hélène is under the illusion that the bond can somehow restart, but when she goes to pick up her ex at the station she realizes that it is not possible: he has arrived with another, a young woman. Who befriends Bernard, Hélène's stepson. Between personal memories and the Algerian war, time passes.
notes: Contemporary bourgeois kammerspiel, set in an anonymous city, centered on the ordinary and merciless banality of everyday life and on the ambiguities of memory. Special award and to the best actress in Venice.

title: Out of the Past
actors: Robert Mitchum, Kirk Douglas, Rhonda Fleming, Jane Greer
description: A private detective believes he is closing a phase of his existence by going to live in a rather suburban town. But his is a real illusion, destined to collapse when the former head of the detective and his current wife, who years before had been a lover of private-eyes, make their appearance in the small town.
notes: Tourneur builds one of his most tense and tragic noirs, which is perhaps influenced by the example of Gilda, created by Charles Vidor the previous year.

title: Gone in the Night
actors: Shannen Doherty, Kevin Dillon, Dixie Carter
description: David and Cindy are husband and wife. They lead a peaceful life until one day their little girl Jaclyn is kidnapped and killed. The police and the FBI come to the conclusion that the child killers are the parents of the child. A sensational mistake that goes as far as David's sentence of forty-five years in prison. Luckily an elderly private investigator manages to uncover the truth.
notes: Violence against minors is unfortunately a very topical issue. In this film, the classic narrative mechanism of the condemnation of the innocent is superimposed on such a distressing theme. Suspense and twists are part of the recipe for this film

title: A Prayer for the Dying
actors: Mickey Rourke, Bob Hoskins, Alan Bates, Sammi Davis
description: Martin Fallon, an IRA affiliate, failed the latest attack, killing a group of children traveling on a school bus. For this reason he is sought after by the police and by his own comrades, who want to get him out of the way. Disgusted by too much blood, he would like to leave hiding and flee to the United States. But a treacherous gangster, who is supposed to provide him with passport and money, blackmails him, forcing him to kill an enemy for him.
