notes: Too many clichés about Irish terrorism divided between the armed struggle and the Catholic faith, with a rather evanescent Mickey Rourke.

title: The Hole
actors: Lee Kang-sheng, Yang Kuei-Mei, Miao Tien, Tong Hsiang-Chu
description: It rains continuously in Taiwan, seven days before the end of 1999. Thundering and pounding rain creates an almost insurmountable barrier for the rare inhabitants who have not left the city. A mysterious epidemic decimates people. A man and a woman are unpredictably "connected" by a hole in her ceiling (and his floor).
notes: Able to keep you glued to the screen with a dialogue reduced to the bone, Tsai Ming-liang knows how to tell neurosis, tenderness, first approaches, domestic and collective disasters with an anti-rhetorical measure, a sense of rhythm, an extraordinary rigor of the shot.

title: Lost Highway
actors: Bill Pullman, Patricia Arquette, Balthazar Getty, Robert Blake, Robert Loggia, Natasha Gregson Wagner, Gary Busey, Lucy Butler, Michael Massee, Giovanni Ribisi, Richard Pryor
description: Saxophonist Fred and his wife Renée receive a video of them at home, even when she is being massacred by him. Fred doesn't remember, but ends up in jail sentenced to death. And one day, in his place in the cell, the guards find Pete, a mechanic. Who in turn meets the blonde Alice, a boss's pupa.
notes: Perhaps Lynch's is pure cinema. The "writing of the movement" that most of all comes close to delirium. Without a story to tell, opening chasms on the unconscious and its anarchic world. And what is it, in this undecipherable world? Man, with all his contradictions. Closer and closer to Francis Bacon.

title: Oscar and Lucinda
actors: Ralph Fiennes, Cate Blanchett, Ciarán Hinds, Tom Wilkinson
description: Oscar and Lucinda are two young people who met in the Australian region of New South Wales during the second half of the last century. He, the son of an austere English preacher, becomes an Anglican pastor; she, heiress of wealthy farmers, is the owner of the Sydney glassworks. The two have in common an unstoppable passion for the game, on which a deep friendship and then a great love is born.
notes: And precisely the description of their insane passion for the game is the strong point of the film. But the effect ending overflows in a limp mello that is wrong to depart from the beautiful book by Peter Carey.

title: Tiré à part
actors: Terence Stamp, Maria De Medeiros, Daniel Mesguich, Jean-Claude Dreyfus
description: A London publisher lived in Tunis for a certain period of his life and there he met a girl who then committed suicide. Years later, when the man moved to London, he receives a manuscript edited by a French author of action novels, from which we understand why the girl had taken her own life: revenge will be complicated and terrible .
notes: Revenge is the only interesting point in the film. For the rest, everything is taken for granted: unlikely characters who fail to be surreal, serious script contradictions, confused and highly disappointing ending. For Terence Stamp's return to the cinema, something more was expected.

title: Excess Baggage
actors: Alicia Silvestone, Benicio Del Toro, Christopher Walken
description: Emily is a terrible girl who to capture the attention of a rich and dishonest father, stages his kidnapping and hides in the trunk of his car, binding and gagging to make the discovery plausible. But the intervention of the car thief Vincent, who steals the car in which the girl is hiding changes the story.
notes: Silverstone, Batgirl in "Batman & Robin" and Benicio Del Toro, one of the most interesting young actors of the moment, are the protagonists of this foray into Marco Brambilla's comedy. If the two protagonists are credible in the love story that arises after the involuntary kidnapping, not everything that revolves around it, with the exception of Christopher Walken in the role of the disturbingly funny "uncle" of Emily.

title: La vie de Jésus
actors: David Douche, Marjorie Cottreel, Geneviève Cottreel, Kader Chaatouf
description: Life without hope for the young people of a small town in Flanders. A boy desperately loves a girl: for him, love is capable of going beyond any social convention, of ignoring the intimately racist and xenophobic nature of the French province. But it is so only for him: and, in the end, this diversity of his backfires.
notes: Presented in 1997 in Cannes, awarded in many other festivals including Taormina, "The restless age" is certainly one of the most interesting beginnings of recent years. The story seems to flow as dormant as everyday life, but the sudden scraps that the director manages to create can amaze and fascinate. Young people are empty and violent, but the world they inherit is even worse, as evidenced by the news reported by the frequent television news. Dumont said that it is a film about the moral collapse that can precede redemption. This is why such an intense and spiritual original title, badly trivialized by the Italian translation. All non-professional actors, and for this very good.

title: A Clockwork Orange
actors: Malcolm McDowell, Patrick Magee, Michael Bates, Warren Clarke, John Clive, Adrienne Corri, Carl Duering, Paul Farrell, Clive Francis, Michael Gover, Miriam Karlin, James Marcus, Aubrey Morris, Godfrey Quigley, Sheila Raynor
description: London, in the indefinite future: Alex, a passionate lover of Beethoven's music, is the leader of a quartet of young thugs accustomed to committing violence of all kinds. In the long run, exasperated by his despotic attitude, his comrades stun him and leave him in the hands of the police. Condemned and imprisoned, Alex is offered a chance for freedom: in exchange, he will have to undergo an experimental therapy called "Ludovico cure" ...
notes: Starting from Anthony Burgess's novel, Kubrick draws a fresco without redemption of a futuristic but very close society, standardized and kitsch, controlled by a devious and omnipresent power.

title: Arizona Dream - American Dreamers
actors: Johnny Depp, Jerry Lewis, Faye Dunaway, Vincent Gallo, Paulina Porizkova
description: Alex is brought back by Paul by his rich uncle Leo who is about to marry a girl from the East much younger than him and who would like him to be his natural heir in work and in life. But Alex is more interested in the mature Elaine and stepdaughter Grace, while Paul, who dreams of cinema, improvises himself as a movie star.
notes: After "The time of the gypsies", Kusturica went to the United States with French money (it was 1992) to make a film called "The waltz of the arrowfish". In February 1993, with the definitive title of "Arizona Dream", he showed up at the Berlin Film Festival where he was awarded the Silver Bear. It remains one of the most unusual titles in his filmography.

title: Jackie Brown
actors: Pam Grier, Samuel L. Jackson, Robert Forster, Bridget Fonda, Robert De Niro
description: Jackie Brown is a stewardess who works in a small company that connects the northern United States with California. The woman gets acquainted with a not-so-right-headed arms dealer, Ordell Robbie. The two set out on the trail of a suitcase containing half a million dollars together with Louis Gara, Ordell's partner. But also the policeman Ray and Max peeps out, an equally strange guy who sells the bail that can guarantee bail.
notes: With this film, Quentin Tarantino proves to be a very intelligent director, capable of not getting lost in the indefinite exploitation of the elements of his sudden success and of asking for time to evolve as an author. Of course, in _Jackie Brown_ there are still his typical traits, but, on the other hand, there is also the obstinacy to keep his sudden outbursts of violence out of scope and to expand the space granted to the characters, often filmed in almost fixed, while they chat and chat, up to paradoxical limits. And his ability to "mistcast" celebrity actors reaches its peak here, with De Niro's taciturn, buzzed and smoked ex-inmate and vapid blonde late flower daughter Bridget Fonda. But of course the film is all by Pam Grier, mature and combative, on whose imposing profile the camera is fixed in the opening sequence, very long and virtually immobile. A beginning that is almost an invitation to "slow down", for a film whose importance will be evaluated, as Tarantino says, among other three or four films.

title: La femme de chambre du Titanic
actors: Aitana Sánchez-Gijón, Olivier Martinez, Romane Bohringer, Giorgio Gobbi, Aldo Maccione
description: A so-called stroke of luck happens to Horty, a worker in a sad Lorraine foundry, he wins an invitation to participate in the party organized in Southampton on the occasion of the departure of the Titanic. On that occasion, Horty meets Marie, a young waitress who is about to board the ship.
notes: Forget "Doll": Bigas Luna is an intelligent director capable of evoking veiled erotic suggestions. Quality that in this film shines again, between a wink at the Titanic that sinks into the background of the story and a great affection for the storytelling of the image. Bravissimo Aldo Maccione in the part of the actor.

title: A King in New York
actors: Charles Chaplin, Dawn Addams, Michael Chaplin
description: Deposited by a Marxist revolution, a European sovereign goes into exile in the United States, the homeland of democracy and freedom. Here, however, he soon finds himself colliding with the intrusive reality of advertising to end up in the network of the Commission for anti-American activities. Eventually the king realizes that America isn't all that attractive.
notes: After being "exiled" from the United States precisely because of McCarthyism (and its alleged Communist militancy), Chaplin takes a good revenge on American society in the manner with the caustic humor of satire. Perhaps underestimated, it is a satire at times acute and that does not deny the slapstick tradition.

title: Across the Bridges
actors: Rod Steiger, David Knight, Maria Landi, Noel Willman, Bernard Lee
description: The financier Schaffner, hunted by the British police who discovered his scams, decides to leave New York to try to reach Mexico, where he has secured a large sum of money. During the long train ride he meets a certain Scarff who proves to have a predilection for alcohol. When he, due to his habit, loses consciousness Schaffner steals his passport and throws him off the train. But the financier discovers with surprise that Scarff is wanted by the Mexican police for killing the President of the Republic ...
notes: Loosely based on a short story by Graham Greene, with its classic themes of guilt and redemption set in an adventurous context, the film has its own strength and credibility, thanks also to the powerful interpretation of by Rod Steiger.

title: Deep Family Secrets
actors: Richard Crenna, Angie Dickinson, Molly Gross, Kristian Hans Horn
description: Father, mother and three children. A typical American family. A wealthy American family, stained with dark secrets. Under the semblance of quiet bourgeois normality there are unspeakable and murky secrets concerning both the heritage and the origin of some members of the family. The accumulated wealth in fact comes from questionable trafficking and two of the three children have been adopted. The two boys are unaware of the drama behind their birth, but when they discover that ...
notes: Sorry to see two old glories like Crenna and, even more, Dickinson drag their waning career into poor TV movies like this.

title: The Tarnished Angels
actors: Rock Hudson, Dorothy Malone, Robert Stack, Jack Carson
description: Burke, who is a journalist, comes into contact with a highly decorated First World War pilot and his family. By associating with the pilot (who earns his living doing aerial racing) and his wife, Burke falls in love with the woman and at the same time discovers the true nature of the relationship between the spouses. When the pilot dies, during yet another reckless flight, Burke will not hesitate to intervene to protect his beloved.
notes: From "Oggi si volo" by Faulkner (who considered it the best adattem, tno of one of his novels), one of the most sober, but also darkest melodramas, directed by the master Sirk. Losing characters in marginal environments, with a lesson in directing.

title: Ursus nella valle dei leoni
actors: Ed Fury, Moira Orfei, Alberto Lupo, Mary Marlon, Giacomo Furia
description: Ursus is the son of a king, but his father was ousted by a usurper when he was very young and was raised by the beasts of the Title Valley. Growing up, he has become very strong and can therefore claim the paternal throne which, once regained, he shares with his sweet partner Anja.
notes: From one of the most prolific artisans of Italian cinema who passed with ease through almost all film genres, a modest peplum.

title: La compagna di banco
actors: Lilli Carati, Gianfranco D'Angelo, Alvaro Vitali, Francesca Romana Coluzzi
description: A new student has arrived at the "Mamiani" high school in Trani: beautiful and rich. Naturally, everyone loses their minds for her, but Mario D'Olivo has the greatest chances, a true Don Juan of III B, who has already broken more than one female heart. The other girls, however, more out of envy than altruism, warn the new arrival from the class cock, but between the two, during the school party for the fifteen years of teaching of prof. Cacioppo ...
notes: By-product of the Italian comedy with sexy implications and debut by Lilli Carati. The usual suspects for side roles.

title: Gambler from Natchez
actors: Dale Robertson, Debra Paget, Thomas Gomez
description: Vance Colby and arrives in New Orleans where a friend awaits him who should lead him to his father, a famous player. But too many things happen on the way and when Vance arrives at the hotel, he finds his father dead. He begins to carry out investigations that are very tiring.
notes: This film is a real pearl necklace, thanks to which Levin puts the interminable adventures of this character one after the other.

title: Walking Target
actors: Joan Evans, Ronald Foster, Merry Anders
description: After five years of jail for armed robbery, Nick finally crosses the prison threshold. Outside finds Susan and Dave, his old accomplices that they would like to find out where he hid the loot never found by the police after the last blow. In particular, the woman tries to rekindle the old love that Nick had towards him and then extorted to him the secret. But the former galleys ends up understanding the game and succeeds, also thanks to the intervention of a policeman friend, to sow the two who are actually in league with the henchmen of a dangerous gangster. The epilogue, with the duel among all the characters, will be at the end.
notes: In comparison with the protagonist of "A bullet for Roy", played by Humphrey Bogart and directed by Raoul Walsh, many former prisoners of the following cinema seem very conventional and not very convincing. This too does not escape comparison. The script, written by the specialist Carl Foreman, is based on a story that really happened.

title: Gorilla at Large
actors: Anne Bancroft, Cameron Mitchell, Lee J. Cobb, Raymond Burr
description: A Luna Park officer, just fired by the Impresario, is found dead in the cage of a gorilla. Just that gorilla that is involved in one of the greatest numbers of the show, given that laverne, a young acrobat wife of the entrepreneurship, turns with the trapeze on her cage without protection. The suspicions are initially concentrated on a student who earns a living being a grip.
notes: The fascinating Ann Bancroft is here in the role of a young acrobat. The atmosphere surrounding the traveling show is well made. Nonetheless the film does not convince. Shot in 3D.

title: Freeway
actors: Reese Witherspoon, Kiefer Sutherland, Amanda Plummer, Brooke Shields
description: Vanessa's parents often end up in prison and the girl is therefore given in foster care to another family. But Vanessa runs away to visit her grandmother. On the highway he asks a driver for a ride. A luxurious sedan driven by a child psychiatrist who is interested in the young woman's case stops. Too bad that the doctor is a serial killer who always acts on the highway, unnecessarily sought after by the police ...
notes: Matthew Bright's debut film awarded at the Cognac Police Film Festival. A nice surprise partially ruined by the modest presence of Kiefer Sutherland.

title: Private Parts
actors: Howard Stern, Mary McCormack, Alison Stern, Richard Portnow
description: Cinebiography of America's most irreverent, provocative and famous disc-jockey, Howard Stern, lanky guru and almost double of Claudio Cecchetto capable of challenging the giants of the media circle with lightning-fast jokes ("My father was a sincere democrat: he sent to college, model of integration: six thousand blacks and me ") and highly scabrous situations as when he invited an all-sex blonde to a radio studio with the serious intention of involving her in a carnal relationship with microphones on. From the sixties to the present day, a lashing, hilarious and graceful career, without a moment of respite or boredom.

title: Critical Care
actors: James Spader, Kyra Sedgwick, Helen Mirren, Anne Bancroft
description: Werner is a doctor who is finishing his internship in one of the major American hospitals in the intensive care unit. Felicia, the daughter of one of the patients struggling with death, puts him in trouble. The girl is at war with her sister Connie to decide her father's fate. Felicia insists that her father never wanted an extended life from machines. On the contrary Connie claims to communicate with him and is convinced that she wants to continue living.
notes: Thirty years ago, with a subject like this, Lumet would have created an aggressive and cruel film. Today, not helped by a sententious and predictable script, he gives us a didactic and soporific film, played between the trance (by Spader) and the caricature (by Kyra Sedgwick and Brooks), predictable (except for the appearances of Wallace Shawn and Anne Bancroft messengers of Hell and Heaven, frankly ridiculous). Lumet calls it a "dark comedy"; in reality it looks like a TV movie still awaiting editing.

title: The Charge of the Light Brigade
actors: Trevor Howard, Vanessa Redgrave, John Gielgud, David Hemmings, Harry Andrews
description: In 1854, England and France fought against Russia in the Crimean War. Six hundred legendary English cavalrymen go to the massacre in the plain of Balaklava, in an act of absurd heroism.
notes: Tony Richardson reinterprets a myth of his national history in a polemical and anti-imperialist key, emphasizing the ballet of political and military power. The satire is fierce, the cast remarkable. To be compared with the heroic "The charge of the 600 by Curtiz" (1936).

title: The Island on Bird Street
actors: Patrick Bergin, Jordan Kiziuk, Jack Warden, Stefan Sauk, James Bolam
description: Eleven-year-old Alex is, so to speak, born with a shirt, at least according to what his father Stefan tells him. We are in fact in troubled Poland during the Second World War and living in the ghetto is not exactly lucky, but Alex knows where to hide during the round-ups of the Nazis. When the order comes to completely evacuate the ghetto, Alex and his family are unable to escape capture. While the prisoners are about to be led away, Alex with the complicity of his uncle Boruch manages to escape deportation.
notes: Intense, touching, painful as a male version of the "Diary of Anne Frank" could be, it is a film that stuns and moves. In the true story of Alex, a Jewish boy from the Warsaw ghetto and taken from the novel by Uri Orlev, there is all the pain that comes from one of the darkest pages of humanity, that of the Holocaust. Poetic, but a thousand miles away from the almost playful vision of "La vita è bella", the film describes the life of a child who, after the mass deportation, remains the only survivor in the maze of ruins of the ghetto that looks like a vision of Piranesi.

title: Do Me a Favor
actors: Rosanna Arquette, Devon Gummersall, Cuba Gooding jr., George Dzundza
description: Lincoln, a shy and insecure high school student, does not have the courage to face the bullies of his school who involve him, in spite of himself, in their nocturnal raids. At home, his parents constantly harass him and all they do is talk about the exams that the boy must take to enter a prestigious university. But one evening the beautiful Alex drags him into the world of crime.
notes: Sondra Locke (star of Clint Eastwood's films between the '70s and' 80s) has, for women, a sense of the world and of life not too distant from that of her old partner. The stories he directed ("Ratboy" and "Double Identity") start from daily losers, like this road trip of a sad and quiet boy who has just finished high school and of a sexy forty-year-old woman who is tried by the life she recalls " A 20 gauge for the specialist ". But it is no longer the time for heroes and the adventure is calibrated to the familiar-everyday. Ambience ideas and interesting characters (the mother who prepares Christmas all year round), style and essential dialogues. Too bad the story is a little known.

title: Sogno d'amore
actors: Nicole Amar, Ron Cobert
description: Donna is a twenty-two-year-old girl who lives in a North Carolina village and who works in a bar with a very specific purpose: to get the necessary money to pay for her studies. One day, thanks to the help of an extravagant patron of the place, he participates in a television contest and wins a stay in Miami. As soon as she arrived at the airport in the city of Florida, she met by chance a boy who, despite his young age, is the president of a multinational company. The two start dating but Michael, as the boy is called, goes to great lengths not to reveal his social status to Donna to see if she loves him for who he is and not for his money. The girl falls in love totally ignoring what "good match" has happened to her and thus continuing to live for the day ...
notes: Italian sentimental comedy but mostly shot in the United States. Little known but equally good the two young interpreters. De Angelis (who often signs himself Larry Ludman) is the director of "The boy with the golden kimono").

title: Duello nella Sila
actors: Fernando Lamas, Liana Orfei, Lisa Gastoni, Vincenzo Musolino
description: Lucania, 1850: the brutal and ruthless Rocco Gravina heads a band of brigands who dominate the Lagonegro area. One day, after attacking a carriage and robbing passengers, he kills a woman. The brother of the unfortunate, Antonio, having learned of the incident, leaves for those lands with the intention of discovering the murderers and killing them. The meeting with Maruzza, a local girl, allows him to join the gang, but it will be thanks to an English journalist who ...
notes: Lenzi before horror and war films, in a rough, effective and listlessly acted brigandage film.

title: A House of Secrets and Lies
actors: Connie Sellecca, Kevin Dobson, Grace Howerton, Georgann Howerton
description: Susan and Jack are a beautiful young professional career couple. She is a journalist who often appears on television, alternating her profession with that of a TV presenter. Instead, he is a solicitor dealing with important trials. Both in love, at least in everyone's eyes, they are the example of the perfect couple. But the reality is quite different. Between lies and truth, Susan finds herself dealing not only with the present, but also, rather painfully, with the past. Above all, he must desperately try to question his life.
notes: Rather twisted in the plot, it is saved with a sober direction and discreet rehearsals by the interpreters.

title: The Roman Spring of Mrs. Stone
actors: Vivien Leigh, Warren Beatty, Coral Browne, Lotte Lenya
description: Karen Stone, an actress who has given everything to her profession and who, unfortunately, does nothing but collect failures, decides to go to Italy to spend a rest period. During the journey her husband, who has decided to accompany her, dies. Arrived in the capital and quickly overcome the pain, she falls in love with a gigolo. But the young man, after trying to exploit her, abandons her to go on new adventures.
notes: Quintero, thanks to the screenplay by critic Gavin Lambert, directs a routine film based on an opera by Tennessee Williams, which is based on Leigh's end-of-career performance.

title: La tempesta
actors: Silvana Mangano, Van Heflin, Viveca Lindfors, Geoffrey Horne
description: Empress Catherine of Russia, offended by the behavior of the cadet Piotr Grinjeff, severely punishes him by exiling him in the fortress of Oremburg located on the extreme border of the empire. During the journey, Piotr, who is accompanied by the faithful Savelic, saves the life of a half-sided Cossack. Piotr realizes that his punishment is excessive, but his bitterness is redeemed by the love of Masha, daughter of the captain of the fortress.
notes: Lattuada packs a blockbuster taken from Pushkin's "The daughter of the cpaitano" with a great taste for action and refined attention to detail. Aldo Tonti's cast and color photography are extraordinary.

title: The Wings of the Dove
actors: Helena Bonham Carter, Linus Roache, Alison Elliott, Charlotte Rampling
description: Kate is a London girl, determined to fully enjoy, we are in 1910, the taste of independence and freedom. Secretly from her aunt Maude, who is supposed to be watching over her, she is having a passionate romance with Merton, a brilliant but far from wealthy journalist. By accompanying her aunt to a wedding, Kate draws the attention of a family friend, Lord Mark. Seeing the possibility of a good marriage, Aunt Maude encourages friendship between the two.
notes: On paper, one of the many literary-aesthetic reductions in fashion in the 90s in English cinema. In reality, Softley attempts an almost noir reading of Henry James' novel, where the sadomasochism of erotic relationships is reflected in the hypocritical rigor of elegant society. Too bad that in some points (the Venetian part), an insistent elegance takes over.

title: Nightwatch
actors: Ewan McGregor, Nick Nolte, Patricia Arquette, Josh Brolin
description: To make ends meet, young law student Martin takes a part-time job as a night watchman in a morgue. But, unfortunately for him, he chose the wrong moment: in fact a serial killer is terrorizing the city; and even more frightening are the clues that continually lead back to him ...
notes: In 1994, the Danish Bornedal directed the same film (in Italy: The Night Watchman) and had an exaggerated notoriety, winning some festival specialized in horror-thrillers. Despite Miramax's money and Steven Soderbergh's collaboration on the script, this remake is a faded photocopy of it.

title: Enskilda Samtal
actors: Pernilla August, Max Von Sydow, Samuel Fröler, Thomas Hanzon
description: In 1925 Anna Bergman was thirty-six, with three children and a lover. This situation is the subject of a long chat between her and Jacob, the priest she had known as a child also because Anna's husband is a Protestant pastor. Jacob advises her to tell her husband everything, but Anna will not do it and other conversations will follow in other eras, through which we will know the background and the unfolding of the situation in which Anna lives.
notes: Liv Ullmann, Bergmanian actress par excellence, shows that she wants to refer to the work of her teacher who is also a screenwriter here. The actors (including Von Sydow) are those who in various eras have given face to the stories of the Swedish director. Atmosphere of a manner, rather predictable and devoid of the extra gear that the old master guaranteed. A decent film, but nothing more.

title: The Replacement Killers
actors: Mira Sorvino, Chow Yun-fat, Michael Rooker, Jürgen Prochnow
description: John Lee, a killer in spite of himself, has to work for Wei, the powerful boss of the Sino-American mafia, who holds his family hostage in China. But faced with the task of killing a policeman's son, John stops and goes against his patron. To get revenge, Wei kills all of his best friends and sets off a giant manhunt involving Meg, a skilled forger who was supposed to provide John with a fake passport.
notes: Action, violence and love involve an excellent cast with Hong Kong movie star Chow Yun-Fat in his first American film. Michael "Henry rain of blood" Rooker and sinologist Mira Sorvino (very good) are his travel companions. Directed by Antoine Fuqua, an appreciated video clip director, under the supervision of a very special executive producer: John Woo.

title: Buffalo '66
actors: Vincent Gallo, Christina Ricci, Anjelica Huston, Ben Gazzara
description: In Buffalo it snows the day Billy gets out of jail after five years. The boy has a very particular character, he can't stand being touched by another human being and can go from good manners to uncontrolled violence in the blink of an eye. Goon is the only person who knows that Billy has been in prison due to the debt he has amassed with a shady bookie. Even his parents don't know he was in jail, Billy told him he was doing important work for the government.
notes: The title indicates the date of birth of Billy Brown, alter ego - on the screen - of the actor and painter and poet and musician and now also director Vincent Gallo, a talented multimedia artist, but insane and annoying narcissism. The film opens as "Blues Brothers 2", with ours coming out of jail, proceeding like a Big Lebowski postscript, and ending with an unusual happy ending. Too bad for the shade: because if Gallo moved, we would be able to see the film.

title: Mesmerized
actors: Jodie Foster, John Lithgow, Michael Murphy
description: A young orphan, not too intelligent and in need of a guide, meets a man older than her, stern and a bit gruff, and decides to marry him. But the years of separation are many and between the two opens a chasm of incommunicability. To aggravate the whole environment: the story is set in the late nineteenth century, in New Zealand.
notes: Director Laughlin himself wrote the screenplay, drawing it from a story by Jerzy Skolimowski, which unfortunately he does not direct.

title: Stagecoach
actors: Ann-Margret, Bing Crosby, Van Heflin
description: A stagecoach, crowded with an extravagant and heterogeneous fauna, crosses Wyoming and is attacked by the Indians. Of course ours are doing badly, but of course something will happen ...
notes: Boring and useless remake of "Red Shadows", John Ford's masterpiece, updated to the cruelest times. Not only is it not even comparable to Ford's film, but it is not Douglas's best western either. The actors (including Crosby in his latest film) aren't exactly bad though.

title: Poison Ivy 2: Lily
actors: Alyssa Milano, Xander Berkeley, Jonathan Schaech
description: Lily is a young painter eager to achieve success. Maybe too eager. Ambition even makes her forget the obligations of the image. In fact, while playing the part of a student who stumbles upon Ivy's diary, Alyssa lets herself be carried away and indulges, on the basis of the diary, in an exploration of her sexual desires.
notes: The situation derives from the first film made by Gourdaud, who from there takes up the "ghostly" character of Ivy. The fiction - reality game is quite interesting, while it affects the search for authenticity, also through rather strong language and images.

title: On the Line
actors: Linda Hamilton, Jeff Fahey, Jay Acovone, Marcia del Mar
description: Jean Martin is a female police officer who, after many years in the department investigating sexual abuse, is faced with her own personal problems. So he's asking for a transfer to the robbery department. Her request is granted, but as she prepares to conclude the investigation she becomes involved in a case of baby robbers ...
notes: Policewomen also have a soul and a sensitivity. Did you doubt it? To remind us, here is this film which is actually rather predictable and built on the classic places of police cinema centered on the crisis of the "policer officer".

title: Rosmunda e Alboino
actors: Jack Palance, Eleonora Rossi Drago, Guy Madison
description: Alboin has just defeated the Gepids, who are now soliciting an agreement with him to march against Rome. Alboin, leader of the Lombards, does not trust him and therefore asks for his wife Rosmunda, daughter of the defeated king. The latter, despite being Amalchi's morganatic wife, accepts the proposal for the good of her people.
notes: Twists, betrayals and demonstrations of energetic vitalism. Campogalliani has never been a great director, even if the film possesses its own spectacularity, especially in mass scenes.

title: Proteus
actors: Craig Fairbrass, Toni Barry, William Marsh, Jennifer Calvert
description: A group of drug dealers is shipwrecked. There is no other way out than the oil platform which they fortunately manage to get to. But even here salvation is in danger, given that on the platform there is a vital form, the Proteus, which has enormous powers and an aggressive and destructive will. Only at the end of long attempts, the survivors manage to neutralize this powerful and mysterious being.
notes: Halfway between the seafaring adventure and the war with unidentifiable beings, this film does not seem to close the circle. Indeed, with an ambiguous ending it leaves open the possibility of a sequel.

title: Big Man - Polizza droga
actors: Bud Spencer, Ursula Andress, Raymond Pellegrin
description: The vice president of International Lloyd's, Winterbotton, intimidated by the rumor that the FBI has collected that the mafia has managed to secure drug shipments, calls Jack Clementi, former police commissioner, now a private detective, to solve the case. The man, due to his imposing size, is known as Big Man, but he also has another nickname, The Professor. Jack thus begins his investigation in the capital, making use of information from Inspector Caruso.

title: La storia di Kitty
actors: Veronica Hamel, Kevin Dobson
description: Kitty Dodds is serving a long sentence for uxoricide: the fact that her husband has subjected her and her children to constant harassment and violence for years did not move the jury. Realizing that she has no hope, Kitty plans and implements her escape from prison. During the inaction she meets a man, who shows her a lot of attention and with whom she ends up falling in love. The two decide to get married and live happy moments, even if the lack of children makes the woman terribly suffer. One day, the police, who have never stopped looking for her, track her down, capture her and take her back to prison.

title: Mare largo
actors: Claudio Amendola, Isabella Ferrari, Rade Serbedzija, Liberto Rabal, Catherine Wilkening
description: Edoardo, a long-time captain, returns to Apricale, a town perched between stones and olive trees on the border with France. Waiting for him is Clara who hopes the time has finally come to start a life together. But Edoardo is unable to face a dark past and is looking for another boarding. He is offered a trip that hides more than one risk. A load of weapons must be transported from Toulon to the Yugoslav coasts (we are in the days of the war in Bosnia).
notes: The film freely based on the novel by Francesco Biamonti, "Attesa sul mare" (Einaudi), is Vicentini Orgnani's first work. But the story is a pretext: in reality what interests the director are the men and women who live in the film; there are, in fact, also the sweet Isabella Ferrari, sad and fascinating as usual; the shipowner François (Serbedzija of "Before the rain"); his partner Annik, vulnerable and vulnerable (the erotic Wilkening); and the young Manuel (Liberto Rabal, grandson of Francisco). You got it: essentially an actor's film.

title: Red Corner
actors: Richard Gere, Bai Ling, Bradley Whitford, Peter Donat, Tsai Chin
description: A brilliant lawyer, Jack Moore, a consultant for a large group operating in the entertainment industry and a large business broker, travels to China to finalize negotiations on satellite communications. After spending the night in the company of an exotic beauty, the next morning Jack finds the girl in a pool of blood. Arrested for a murder he didn't commit and abandoned by his American colleagues, Jack has to deal with China's absurd judicial system.
notes: There is an air of Grisham, but there is also an air of Crichton, at least in the very first part, when Gere is accompanied around Beijing "by night", and then in the frantic attempt of the script to penetrate the very subtle differences between systems Eastern and Western judicial and moral. But Crichton has other subtleties than the screenwriter Robert King and the director Jon Avnet, who, a little uncertain between the trial tension, the action and the sentimental story, are unable to maintain the narrative balance.

title: Funny Games
actors: Ulrich Muehe, Susanne Lothar, Arno Frisch, Stefan Clapczynski
description: For the summer holidays Anna, Georg and their son Georgie reach their charming house by the lake. As father and son fumble on the refurbished sailboat and Anna is preparing dinner, she suddenly finds Peter, a decent-looking boy, a guest of the neighbors, asking her for eggs on Eva's behalf. From serenity we soon pass to terror ...
notes: Haneke is an Austrian filmmaker who got noticed by festival goers with "Benny's Video" and "71 fragments of a case history". This film is still an "exercise in cruelty" and demonstrates its ability to crucify the characters and the viewer. After a beginning in which the tension grows through the accumulation of apparently insignificant elements, when the two "maniacs" settle in the house of the protagonists, Haneke moves on to a development worthy of "Don't open that door". With one difference: the violence, which is great and terrible (physical and psychological torture, rape and murder), is always on the off screen.

title: Firelight
actors: Sophie Marceau, Stephen Dillane, Kevin Anderson, Lia Williams
description: We are in 1837. In London, a Swiss governess accepts, to save her debt-ridden father, to give a son to an English nobleman she has never met and with the commitment to never see her father or son again. Eight years later, the girl takes up service in an English villa, where naturally the man (with whom she had fallen in love anyway) and the child, the fruit of the relationship, live. Skirmishes, blackmail, proof of love, misunderstandings, disappointments and hopes follow.
notes: Making his directorial debut, screenwriter Nicholson chooses a story that is predictable from every point of view and realizes it using all the clichés of directing (beautiful images, licked photography, rhetorical devices). Perhaps some simple soul will also be moved: for all the others, "Firelight" will remain an example of the worst calligraphy and of a direction without inventions and without flashes.

title: 'til There Was You
actors: Jeanne Tripplehorn, Dylan McDermott, Sarah Jessica Parker, Jennifer Aniston
description: Gwen and Nick ignore him, but their destiny is to fall in love. She is a shadow writer who writes books signed by others, while he is an architect with a brilliant career in front of him; Their grandparents were engaged to Lithuania, they instead touch each other several times during childhood and adolescence, attend the same people and the same trendy clubs, they find themselves without knowing him to fight against each other for one eviction , but it will only be the case to make them fall in love.
notes: To the precision of the script, the intertwining between the characters and the attempt to represent in chiaroscuro a generation grown in front of horrible television serials, recalls the altman of "America today". But the Altmanian malice here is only a pale memory; The only thing that really matters is that the beautiful Triplehorn does not remain unmarried and knows love, for the right relief of the viewer.

title: Feeling Minnesota
actors: Keanu Reeves, Vincent D'Onofrio, Cameron Diaz, Dan Aykroyd
description: For an aubergine-colored house near Las Vegas, the miserable Sam, accountant for the shady Red, cleverly works out cash shortfalls that he blames the beautiful Freddie. As a reward, the principal gives him the woman, who, however, on the day of the wedding has sex with Jack, Sam's handsome brother with whom he runs away at night.
notes: A strange movie, the original title of which is that of a Soundgarden song. With a prominent cast it demolishes what remains of the American dream, with characters very similar to freaks, with catatonic acting and slapstick comedy dominated by the tics and stammering of Sam and the figure of the detective Costikyan (a loser Marlowe), with unlikely twists, changes of pace and outbursts of violence.

title: Fire
actors: Shabana Azmi, Nandita Das, Kulbushan Kharbanda, Ranjit Chowdri
description: Radha splits her time between the diner run by her husband Ashok, who has taken a vow of chastity, and their second-floor apartment, where Ashok's old mother Biji and her brother Jatin also live. To swell the number of family members comes the young wife of Jatin, Sita, who is immediately at ease and who gladly accepts to help Radha in the kitchen. But soon it turns out that the traditions on which the family rests are worn out and everything is not as good as it seems. Love is born between Radha and Sita, continually betrayed by her husband.
notes: A decidedly subversive subject of "Fire", so much so that, as one of the two protagonists states, "there is not a word in our language to define what we are" and that ridicules the machismo of Indian society. But this merciless portrait soon turns to the conciliatory comedy of manners.

title: The Informant
actors: Anthony Brophy, Timothy Dalton, Cary Elwes, Maria Lennon
description: Released from Long Kesh prison, Gingy, a former IRA terrorist, has retreated to southern Ireland, far from the areas where the conflict is taking place. But his old comrades think it well to go and find him because he is the only person capable of operating a rocket launcher with which the terrorists intend to kill a magistrate. Threatened with retaliation against his wife and children, Gingy cannot say no, but once the action is completed he is identified and arrested.
notes: Timothy Dalton (the worst James Bond on screen) goes through "The Informant" with a built voice, and without much interpretative delicacy. On the other hand, the whole film is marked by, if not improbability, confusion: ideological (almost inevitable in a film about IRA), narrative, stylistic. Jim McBride knows how to direct, especially action scenes, long tracking shots on Irish roads, car escapes, and he knows how to underline the rhythm of the beautiful music of the Pogues. But the impression is that neither McBride nor screenwriter Nicholas Meyer has any real tension towards the subject. And "The Informant" ends up looking like an unsolved jumble of talents that don't merge.

title: Marie Baie des Anges
actors: Vahina Giocante, Frédéric Malgras, Nicolas Welbers, Amira Casar
description: Orso, a fifteen-year-old boy who works as a pickpocket on the night trains leading to Italy, dreams of possessing a weapon that allows him to make a career in the underworld. With him there is Goran, companion of adventures, who with the promise of supplying him with that damned gun, steals all his money and then disappears into thin air. And then there is the fourteen-year-old Marie, the queen of the Bay of Angels, who happily flirts with the sailors and that fate will put on the road to Bear.
notes: With this film, the Frenchman Manuel Pradal invents a personal geography of the soul. The Bay of Angels of the title is reconstructed by mixing different places: the surroundings of Nice, a piece of Liguria, even the Olympic Stadium in Rome, which ideally hosts the Marseille team. Blinding colors and fascinating staging are the strengths of this strange love story. The film releases a strong visual energy; pity that the script tends to shipwreck. The last 15 minutes were chaotic, unfortunately the epilogue granted. Vahina Giocante in the part of Marie is still unforgettable.

title: Out to Sea
actors: Jack Lemmon, Walter Matthau, Dyan Cannon, Gloria DeHaven, Donald O'Connor
description: Charlie's passion for horse racing led him to squander his resources. Try to get brother-in-law Herb to join him on a luxurious vacation aboard a cruise ship in the Caribbean. But Charlie failed to warn Herb that their cabins are located in the deepest bowels of the ship.
notes: The colors and the crossings of various humanity are from Love Boat, the scenarios go under the Caribbean sun, with long Mexican stops. The criticism of manners would like to make fun of the Third Age, but the aim (first and last) is to present the two matadors on the front page, assisted by a Dyan Cannon who is not afraid to make fun of her wrinkles.

title: Beaumarchais
actors: Fabrice Luchini, Sandrine Kiberlain, Manuel Blanc, Jacques Weber, Michel Piccoli
description: Son of a watchmaker, unscrupulous businessman, forerunner of ideas and styles, great lover and superfine playwright, Beaumarchais (1732-1799) was one of the most intriguing personalities of the years immediately preceding and following the French Revolution. He is the author, just to forbid us, of the "Barber of Seville" and "The Marriage of Figaro" (later taken up by Rossini and Mozart for their famous works) and did not hesitate to end up in jail for the irreverence of his jokes against the aristocracy and rampant corruption at the time of Louis XV.
notes: The director of "Vizietto" (but also of "A cena con diavolo", which constitutes the ideal first part of "L'insolente") develops the rich individuality of the impertinent genius, leaning on an unpublished play by Sacha Guitry and a cast where a phenomenal Fabrice Luchini stands out (actor still too little known outside France). Condiments of a popular, simple cinema that manages to be informative and pleasant, pragmatic and never superficial at the same time.

title: La fanciulla che ride
actors: Bud Spencer, Ursula Andress, Mylène Demongeot, Raimund Harmstorf
description: Jack Clementi by chance reading an article in "Time" discovers that there is a fake, a perfect copy of the precious masterpiece of Etruscan goldsmithing, known as "La fanciulla che ride". The reporter attributes ownership of the piece to the Houston Museum which received it as a gift from the late Texas billionaire and collector Jim Carson. To Jack, the statuette is owned by the feudal lords of Roccaferro, who have kept it in their castle for two centuries, with an insurance coverage of 800 thousand pounds ...

title: No Man of Her Own
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, John Lund, Jane Cowl, Phyllis Thaxter, Lyle Bettger
description: A woman, abandoned by her lover because she is pregnant, meets a young bride on the train, also expecting a child, who is traveling to San Francisco accompanied by her husband to meet her in-laws. The train derails, the couple lose their life and their traveling companion finds herself in a hospital bed, already a mother. Due to a series of misunderstandings, the woman is mistaken for her traveling companion who died in the train accident.
notes: An anguished feminine noir, based on a novel by Cornell Woolrich. Good performance by Barbara Stanwyck, and this is nothing new, but the other performers are no less.

title: Gli zitelloni
actors: Vittorio De Sica, Walter Chiari, Maria Luz Gallicia, Mario Riva, Mario Carotenuto
description: Marcello, an apprentice in a grocery store, is circled by the landlady who wants him to marry her daughter Gina. The meeting with a professor friend of his, skeptical of marriage and prone to sentimental adventures, convinces him not to let himself be trapped. During the night Marcello has a long dream during which it seems to him that he has already taken a wife and that he must give an account before a court of the accusation of murder, a consequence of the hard married life.
notes: There is no shortage of clichés and often the film is based on a type of dated comedy. Excellent character actors, but little laughs.

title: Subway
actors: Christopher Lambert, Isabelle Adjani, Richard Bohringer, Michel Galabru
description: In Paris, the extravagant Fred, after being invited to a birthday party by Helena, the beautiful and dissatisfied wife of a rich politician, steals some documents from the safe at home. Pursued by cops called by Helena's husband, Fred takes refuge in the subway. Here he meets various strange characters.
notes: Besson's talent can already be seen. Certain schizoid deviations of the plot, however, leave us quite perplexed.

title: Simpatico mascalzone
actors: Maurizio Arena, Carlo Campanini, Cathia Caro, Virgilio Riento, Amelia Perrella
description: On the outskirts of Rome, a company of traveling comedians is setting up the booth where the show will be set up. The company is the only actress, the young daughter of the old manager. A group of youngsters disturbs the actors and the leader of the band, an unrepentant Don Juan, promises to win over the attractive young actress. Since his attempts are unsuccessful, the boy decides to be hired by the manager as an aspiring actor. Little funny comedy, with the "poor but beautiful" Arena that can't do it alone.

title: Tutto Totò - Il tuttofare
actors: Totò, Lauretta Masiero, Mario Castellani, Antonella Steni, Gisella Sofio
description: In the multiform artistic activity of the prince of laughter, in addition to theater and cinema, a little television also appears. Poor, but tasty, as it could not be otherwise. "The handyman" is one of these short films for TV made by Totò shortly before his death, in the first months of 1967 and aired in May of the same year. "The handyman" takes up the theatrical sketch "The hairdresser for lady" included in the magazine "Bada che ti mangio" written by Totò himself and Michele Galdieri. In the television version, alongside the Neapolitan comedian appear some famous television news of the time: Lauretta Masiero and Antonella Steni as well as the inevitable historical shoulder Mario Castellani.

title: Casa Ricordi
actors: Paolo Stoppa, Gabriele Ferzetti, Myriam Bru, Nadia Gray
description: The film tells the family saga of the famous Milanese music publishing house born in the Napoleonic era by a modest printer who, in exchange for a commission from the military garrison, obtained the old scores lying in the warehouse of the "Alla Scala" theater. Through the saga of Memories, the film also traces the history of Italian opera in the nineteenth and early twentieth centuries, from Rossini to Verdi, from Donizetti to Puccini ...
notes: Gallone had previously shot some films taken from famous operas and biographies of musicians. Here the result is better because the music and the authors make up the milieu of an era and a society told with nostalgia and irony.

title: End of Eden
actors: Jennie Garth, Rob Estes, Polly Holliday, Mike Doyle, Michael Milhoan, Anne Sward
description: Templeton, a small town not far from Salt Lake City, in the Mormon state of Utah, 1920s. Erik is an established pianist, who returns to the closed and sectarian province of origin, where he meets Chel, betrothed to one of his brothers: Jess. Erik has resentments towards his brothers, children of the first bed of his father's first wife. The young man is not helped at all to overcome his hostile feelings by the hatred that Ivor, the elder brother, has towards him. But love is lurking in the role of Chel, the betrothed, who attracted to Erik ...
notes: Sentimental intertwining with a surprise ending. Jennie Garth was Kelly in the TV series "Beverly Hills 90210".

title: Fluffy
actors: Tony Randall, Shirley Jones, Edward Andrews, Howard Morris
description: To escape persecution by not too understanding police officers, Professor Daniel Potter and his lion, Fluffy, educated as the most docile of dogs, arrive at the Claridge Hotel, taking advantage of the absence of the head of the family, his wife and daughter Janice. While the king of the forest sows panic and confusion among the numerous guests, the Claridges, owners of the hotel, return home ...
notes: Comedy with light tones that manages to be fun by exploiting all the typical elements of comedy. Tony Randall is perfect in his part and the other actors are no less.

title: La petite apocalypse
actors: Jiri Menzel, Pierre Arditi, André Dussollier, Chiara Caselli, Anna Romantowska
description: A party is taking place in Barbara's and Henri's house, during which the couple's friends and former petitioners who have shared the years of protest meet. The most intimate of the couple is Jacques, known to all by the nickname of Jack, then one of the busiest, while today he is undoubtedly the most nostalgic. Between one course and the next, Stan, a Polish emigrant, Barbara's first husband, mistakenly considered by all to be an aspiring suicide, also appears.
notes: Written together with Jean-Claude Carriere while Costa Gavras was beginning to shoot "Music Box", the film is an irreverent portrait of the generation of '68 who had to deal with the failure of their ideals. Wordy, confused, pretentious.

title: Cuori solitari
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Senta Berger, Gianna Serra, Silvano Tranquilli
description: Two middle-class couples discover they no longer have expectations from their relationship and believe they have experienced every experience. Hence the idea of ??trying the boldest form of transgression: the exchange of spouses. What is the most obvious risk? That someone falls in love with the wrong partner. So back all the way, but once you get started, the feeling machine doesn't stop so easily ...
notes: There was a time when everything that had to do with interiority seemed within the reach of all directors. Giraldi, however, was never Antonioni and this comedy of his frescoes very little. Luckily there are Tognazzi and Senta Berger.

title: Of Mice and Men
actors: John Malkovich, Gary Sinise, Casey Siemaszko
description: Lennie and George are two friends and travel through 1930s California. But the first is a mentally handicapped person, endowed with great physical strength. Natural therefore the attitude of his friend George who tries to protect him and defend him from life. Even at the cost of not recognizing the emotions, his own and that of the other.
notes: The subject of this film derives from the short novel of the same name by John Steinbeck. The transposition (by screenwriter Horton Foote) is a bit static. But the direction (by actor Gary Sinise) manages to convey the atmosphere of the Depression. Very good interpreters, starting with Malkovich, for once not in the role of the evil seducer.

title: Air Bud
actors: Kevin Zegers, Wendy Makkena, Michael Jeter, Bill Cobbs
description: After his father's disappearance, Josh moves to Fernfield with his mom Jackie. Due to his sad and taciturn nature, the boy finds it difficult to enter school and even basketball no longer interests him as it once did. The chance encounter with Buddy, a stray dog, makes him regain his good humor so that, having overcome the resistance of his mother, he manages to bring him into the family. The results did not take long to be seen especially in basketball: the team continued to win and in a short time Josh became its mascot. But one day the old owner of the puppy shows up and takes it back with him.

title: Rainbow
actors: Bob Hoskins, Dan Aykroyd, Willie Lavendahl, Saul Rubinek, Jacob Tierney
description: Mike, a kid from Washington, thinks he can climb the rainbow like a bridge. After a storm he convinces two of his friends to follow him in an attempt to make his dream come true. Chasing the magical reverberation, the three find themselves far from home where, however, finally, one of them manages to take some gold pieces from the rainbow. From that moment on, however, the colors of nature begin to fade ...
notes: Beautiful fairy tale for young and old with two old comedy foxes who have a lot of fun putting on the clever story. The special effects are good and well functional for the purpose.

title: Jason Goes to Hell: The Final Friday
actors: Steven Williams, John D. LeMay, Kari Keegan, Steven Culp, Erin Gray
description: Jason Voorhees still prowls around Crystal Lake, but he has acquired a new, deadly ability: he transmigrates into the bodies he comes in contact with as he passes from one tram to another. Always covered by the unmistakable hockey mask, the massacre begins, tailed by Creighton Duke, the only man who knows the secret to neutralize him ...
notes: The longest-running serial killer in the history of cinema returns to the scene for the ninth time in what should be the final chapter of the "Friday the 13th" saga (but how many "final chapters" have already been shot?). For statisticians, this time Jason reaches the hefty figure of 83 corpses.

title: China 9, Liberty 37
actors: Fabio Testi, Warren Oates, Jenny Agutter, Isabel Mestres
description: Moments before his hanging, gunfighter Clayton Drumm is released. But in exchange for his freedom (and a hefty dollar fee) he has to kill farmer Matthew, who doesn't want to sell his land to the railroad.
notes: Usual spaghetti western that Monte Hellman signs with the pseudonym of Antonio Brandt.

title: Fallen
actors: Denzel Washington, Donald Sutherland, John Goodman
description: In suburban, nondescript Philadelphia, Detective John Hobbes finds himself facing the devil. It all begins with the execution of Edgard Reese, a serial killer arrested by Hobbes, but in his body actually lives Azazel, a demon able to move freely from one body to another. Having abandoned the now useless body of Reese, the devil mocks Hobbes to the sound of murders and riddles and through a dizzying journey of bodily possessions, haunts him in the deepest affections and tries to discredit him in the eyes of the people.

title: Bliss
actors: Craig Sheffer, Sheryl Lee, Terence Stamp, Casey Siemaszko
description: A young couple, a successful marriage. But the surprises are not long in coming, when the husband becomes suspicious about how his wife spends her afternoons and realizes that the explanation lies in the relationship that the woman has with an eccentric sexologist. Having ascertained the new situation, the relationship is enriched with unexpected passages.
notes: Boudoir philosophy that exploits the ambiguous charm of Sheryl Lee (that of "Twin Peaks") and the maturity of Terence Stamp, who was an ambiguous symbol of the cinema of the sixties. The actors give it their all, but the story never gets off the ground and the glossy sex is very reminiscent of the very boring "Emanuelle", with a taste for pleasure and scandal that very often slips into ridicule. Lance Young, a successful producer at Paramount and Warner, perhaps shouldn't have devoted himself to directing.

title: Adrenalin: Fear the Rush
actors: Christopher Lambert, Natasha Henstridge, Norbert Weisser
description: In the Boston of 2007 there is a company divided in two; on the one hand the healthy, on the other the sick, emigrants from Eastern countries who have contracted diseases caused by chemical weapons leaking from the communist military arsenals. From this world of darkness, those who can try to escape, and to prevent this there is an autonomous police force. In this context, a monster infected with a contagious virus appears, which in the ruins of a prison massacres anyone who comes within range.
notes: Unfortunately not even the shadow of adrenaline in this story that describes a dark near future. And so, flat and claustrophobic, between the tunnels and the rooms of a vaguely Piranesian prison, the film boringly reaches its useless epilogue.

title: The Real Blonde
actors: Matthew Modine, Catherine Keener, Daryl Hannah, Maxwell Caulfield
description: Two actor friends disappointed by the world of cinema make ends meet as waiters: Joe is waiting for the big opportunity, while Bob manages to make his debut in a successful soap. The two share an unsatisfactory love life; the first faithful to a woman who experiences the relationship with the male in a conflictual way, the other in search of a natural blonde with whom to have sex.
notes: In his fourth film, Tom DiCillo stays true to gentle comedy. Leave the wooded lands of "Box of Moonlight", return to the lost souls of Manhattan, as in the days of "Turning to Manhattan". And so he faces the ruthless and vacuous world of aspiring actors and models, taunts shrinks and gurus, but never risks a pinch of healthy cynicism and malice.

title: Animals with the Tollkeeper
actors: Tim Roth, Mili Avital, Rod Steiger, Mickey Rooney, John Turturro
description: In New York, a disillusioned taxi driver is persuaded by three odd passengers to embark on a mysterious journey. He has to go to a country town on the edge of the forest. Here the taxi driver meets a special woman, and together they discover how difficult it is to make their dreams come true.
notes: Cloying New Age fantasy that invites characters and spectators to "look inside" and to overcome the trifles of everyday life. From the series: don't give a camera to an American who wants to be a European. And to think that the Los Angeles Times called the film "a rarity". Perhaps the meaning was not meant to be entirely positive.

title: L'arma
actors: Stefano Satta Flores, Claudia Cardinale, Benedetta Fantioli, Dario Ghirardi
description: A petty bourgeois leads a less than mediocre existence between a cheating wife and a rebellious daughter. Although he knows about marital infidelities, he doesn't care that much, but one day this gray and conformist man is struck by a bloody fact. During a police operation he sees an officer cynically shoot an unarmed young man. So the man buys himself a gun and carries it around, cuddles it, almost, until ...
notes: In the "years of lead" even the conservative Squitieri had the ambitions of a moralist, but what would be an intellectual metaphor on the evils of Italy ends up being simply a wrong film.

title: The Landlady
actors: Talia Shire, Jack Coleman, Bruce Weitz, Melissa Behr, Bette Ford
description: After eliminating her husband, a violent man, Melanie Dade inherits a mansion in Los Angeles where she plans to move. Here she falls in love with Patrick, one of her tenants. Obsessed with the morbid feeling she has for him, Melanie commits a series of murders to eliminate all the people who, according to her, can cause obstacles to her relationship with the unsuspecting Patrick who, at some point, ends up in turn kidnapped by the unleashed. (and crazy) Melanie ...
notes: Films about female serial killers are definitely a minority of their genre. This certainly does not make us regret the fact, despite the commitment of Talia Shire.

title: The Babysitter's Seduction
actors: Keri Russell, Stephen Collins, Phylicia Rashad, John D'Aquino
description: Michelle is babysitting at the Bertrands, a couple with two children who lead a bright and comfortable life. One morning Michelle finds Sallie, Mrs Bertrand, lifeless. At first it seems like a suicide, albeit inexplicable, but the investigations bring to light the victim's extramarital affair and then one begins to think of a murder. But who could have had an interest in killing Sallie? Jealous of the bond that now binds Sallie more and more to the children and to Mr. Bertrand, some friends accuse the babysitter of being the killer. The girl thus finds herself at the top of the list of suspects and just when there seems to be no escape for her ...

title: Charlie Chan's Secret
actors: Warner Oland, Rosina Lawrence
description: After spending many years abroad, a very rich young man returns to his homeland. A short time later the man was found dead. At this point the famous investigator intervenes and is charged with identifying the culprit. He begins his investigation from the house where the relatives of the slain gather to hold séances. Hence gradually the solution.
notes: The narrative mechanism is always the same, already codified in the Thirties, even if in this case the subject is original (written by Joseph Hoffman). Charlie Chan (played by Warner Oland) although shrewd and intuitive, however, seems less brilliant than usual.

title: Quelli del casco
actors: Francesco Bonelli, Sonia De Gaudenz, Carmen Di Pietro, Renzo Montagnani
description: A young high school student falls in love with a girl who sees on an advertising manifesto. But in the photograph the beautiful model has the face uncovered. Therefore the student "must" start a small investigation. To face which he gets help from a schoolmate. Of course, it will be discovered that the woman of her dreams is nothing more than her partner.
notes: Salce his latest film is without ideas or resources. The script does not help him do not help the interpreters. Made quickly, with two lire, it puts a lot of sadness.

title: Vent d'est
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, Anne Wiazemsky, Cristiana Tullio Altan
description: A political debate interspersed with images of a workers' demonstration and an assembly of the trooupe that made them (the director and Daniel Cohn-Bendit also appear). This is the first part of the film. In the second, a self-critical analysis of the first part takes place.
notes: The film is made by Godard shortly after joining the Dziga Vertov collective. Extremely politicized and worried about grasping the (true) relationship between reality and images, Godard, in this essay through images, basically carries out the same analysis that he conducted elsewhere, for example "Weekend, a man and a woman from the mess to Sunday" .

title: Flood: A River's Rampage
actors: Richard Thomas, Kate Vernon, Gabriel Hogan, Mairon Bennett
description: Pat Malloy is a woman who works as an engineer within what we Italians would call civil protection mainly dealing with the trend of Mississippi. After months of continuous rains, all the cities that arise on the banks of the great rivers are in alert and the Civil Protection works incessantly to strengthen the banks to make them safer. Pat is sent to Bellfield, his hometown, where with the support of his ex -boyfriend he manages to convince citizens to roll up his sleeves and create the necessary containment works.
notes: Bruce Pitman exploits the fashion of catastrophic films with cunning.

title: Her Costly Affair
actors: Bonnie Bedelia, Brian Austin Green, Roma Maffia, Gina Philips
description: Diane is a university professor who is going through a difficult time. Could the solution be that student who courts her and ultimately seduces her? Yes at least for one night, she thinks. Otherwise the boy gets stuck and begins to persecute her and comes to rape her. After some time he reappears in Diane's life, having become the boyfriend of her daughter Tess. At this point Diane can only confide her betrayal to her husband ...
notes: On the relationship between teachers and students, very few films have managed to avoid the morbid sides and illuminate what could also be an interesting theme. This is not the case with this film designed and produced for television.

title: Little Giants
actors: Rick Moranis, Ed O'Neill, Shawna Waldron, Devon Sawa, Todd Bosley
description: Danny O'Shea lived all his youth in the shadow of his brother Kevin, a football champion. When, past the time, he has a daughter named Becky, an unexpected event happens: she too wins a certain sporting notoriety and convinces her parent to ...
notes: After all, a pleasant comedy that tries to combine two themes that have always been quite effective in cinematic terms: sport, with the tensions and sacrifices it requires, and youth that can sometimes be more mature than the previous generation. The film features some authentic champions of the caliber of Tim Brown, Bruce Brown and Steve Emtman, of course playing themselves.

title: The Miracle
actors: Beverly D'Angelo, Donald McCann, Nyall Byrne, Lorraine Pilkington
description: We are in the town of Bray, Ireland, and Jimmy and Rose are friends and spend their days fantasizing about the tourists who flock to the seaside town. The first who is motherless and has an alcoholic father falls in love with Renée, a mature American actress. The second tries, instead, to seduce a tamer of the circus. One day Jimmy discovers that Renée knows her father all too well and suspicions begin to arise in him.
notes: The film represents Jordan's return home after his unfortunate Hollywood break ("We are not angels).

title: Amor de hombre
directors: Yolanda Garcia Serrano, Juan Luis Iborra
actors: Loles Leon, Andrea Occhipinti, Pedro Mari Sanchez, Armando del Río
description: Esperanza, a forty-year-old kindergarten teacher disappointed by men, surrounds herself with homosexual friends with whom she frolics in the Madrid nights and to whom she guarantees solid complicity; in short, she is a typical 'fag hag' (untranslatable into Italian) who prefers the company of gays. His favorite is Ramon, a young Italian-Spanish lawyer with whom he has an extraordinary harmony. When Ramon gets engaged to a colleague despite his disapproval, Esperanza walks away.
notes: Is love or friendship more important? In search of a satisfying answer, "Amor de hombre" ventures into the homosexual milieu of Madrid. The film seems to solve the question in favor of friendship, winking at "The wedding of my best friend", displaying a bittersweet tone and a decidedly inspired Andrea Occhipinti.

title: Hercule & Sherlock
actors: Christopher Lambert, Richard Anconina, Philippine Leroy-Beaulieu
description: Their names are Hercule and Sherlock, they are a bobtail and a fox terrier, and they have been trained by their owner, a customs officer in Marseille, to sniff out counterfeit money, which they unerringly retrieve on the airport conveyor belt. They are nice, not insensitive to the charm of a petulant poodle and so good-natured that they become attached to the two down-and-out gangsters who kidnap them.
notes: In "8 legs of trouble", a childish-canine comedy so weak and banal that it does not do justice to the intelligence of either children or dogs, there is no original idea, the jokes are not worth those of a film with Banfi, the rhythm is non-existent, the gags (if they can be called that) are all over the phone.

title: Totò a Napoli
actors: Totò, Luisella Boni, Miranda Martino, Peppino Di Capri, Gloria Christian
description: An unauthorized guide struggling with a group of tourists who would like to know Naples. The exceptional guide is Totò, who in this "special" aired on Rai shortly before the death of the great actor, who on this occasion also reads some of his poems.

title: Emanuelle in America
actors: Laura Gemser, Gabriele Tinti, Roger Browne, Riccardo Salvino
description: Emanuelle is a photojournalist continuously traveling between the Caribbean and America. Her work soon leads her to deal with a difficult police case. It is about the mysterious disappearance of a prostitute. Immersing herself in the same environment as the woman, Emanuelle investigates and finds her traces. He will also come across a small film in which prostitutes are tortured and killed.
notes: The mythical Aristide again on the attack with his apocryphal Emanuelle. This time there are also inserts of a rape and torture film passed off as real. Only the director's proverbial irony does not make it unbearable.

title: Le signore
actors: Nadia Gray, Bice Valori, Enrico Maria Salerno, Paolo Ferrari
description: A crowd of women, husbands and especially lovers gravitate around a hairdresser named René and his beauty salon. The situations that arise and the dynamics in which René offers his generous collaboration are predictable.
notes: Farcical and vulgar comedy of the Italy of the boom. Side dish of Italian and foreign beauties, with a little pepper.

title: Caccia alla volpe
actors: Peter Sellers, Victor Mature, Britt Ekland, Paolo Stoppa
description: La Volpe is actually a famous thief, Aldo Vannucci, suspected by Interpol of being responsible for the theft of a huge amount of gold, despite being in prison. Once he escapes, to keep his sister Gina in check, who has been hired as an extra in a movie, the Fox manages to organize the transport of the gold.
notes: A film of the second, twilight part of De Sica's filmography. Do not miss a few laughs, thanks also to an all-star cast. Written by Neil Simon and Cesare Zavattini.

title: Someone's Watching Me!
actors: Lauren Hutton, David Birney, Adrienne Barbeau
description: She is a career woman who at some point becomes obsessed with someone following her. It is useless to go to the police: she will have to face the insistent stalker alone.
notes: It is John Carpenter's first TV movie, who also writes the screenplay. Here the director constructs a structured story on a rather everyday initial situation, to capture the viewer in the vortex of fear and obsession.

title: Rece do gory
actors: Jerzy Skolimowski, Joanna Szcerbic, Tadeus Lomnicki
description: Some friends who went to college together reunite after many years. It is an opportunity to take stock of one's life and to ask oneself to what extent one's career counts. Especially Andrzej (played by Skolimowski himself) presses for the meeting to go in this direction, so much so that he invites his ex-comrades, now drunk, on an allusive train to go in search of another friend.
notes: Skolimowski (a contemporary of Polanski) creates a restless and strongly metaphorical work.

title: Venus im Pelz
actors: Laura Antonelli, Rex Duval, Renate Kasche, Mady Rahl, Werner Pochath
description: Savier, a wealthy young man meets a very unscrupulous girl at Lake Geneva Wanda. The two get together. He covers her with gifts and takes her to live with him, coming to act as a driver. During an orgy, however, another young man is killed and the suspicions inevitably fall on Savier ...
notes: There is no need to add anything else. Except that the porn-Soft was then at the beginning and tried in some way to get a license of acceptability. Savier who acts as a driver in Wanda not remind you Erich von Stroheim in "Viale del sunset"? But Antonelli has never been Gloria Swanson.

title: Howling V: The Rebirth
actors: Victoria Catlin, Mark Sivertsen, William Shockley, Elizabeth Shé
description: A group of people housed in a picturesque castle are, day after day, decimated by a mysterious werewolf who is actually part of the merry gang. No chance of discovering his true identity until the next full moon night.
notes: Surprise ending for this film that recycles the main idea from Agatha Christie's "Ten Little Indians". This is not new, just as the idea of ??the werewolf and the rituals to defeat him is not very new. Fifth episode of a series born with Joe Dante's masterpiece ("The howling") and continued with a series of titles almost all unpublished in Italy.

title: Upworld
actors: Anthony Michael Hall, Jerry Orbach, Claudia Christian, Eli Danker
description: It is difficult to imagine that a gnome, with supernatural powers and who hates criminals and the violent, cares about how things are in the human world. However, it happens to a nice policeman who receives more than valid help from the gnome to solve a difficult case. But when he reveals the truth, no one believes him.
notes: A comedy with a fairly original plot that has the merit, if nothing else, of telling, with grace and sympathy, a fairy tale with an ancient flavor placing it in our times.

title: e Dio disse a Caino...
actors: Klaus Kinski, Perter Carsten, Marcella Michelangeli, Lee Burton
description: Gary Hamilton is a Northern Army officer who, following Acombar's false accusations, is convicted of a robbery and murder. After ten years, Gary obtains a pardon and returns to his country, however determined to take revenge on his accuser, who in the meantime has become very rich.
notes: Beyond the interpretation of Kinski, the film does not convince neither for the narrative structure nor for the rhythm of the action.

title: Zio Adolfo in arte Führer
actors: Adriano Celentano, Anna Gardini, Amanda Lear, Filippo Costanzo
description: With an electoral fraud, Hitler manages to come to power and prepares to invade Europe, with the complicity of the SS fanatics, in which the magician Hermann plays, who soon becomes a colonel. He has a twin brother, an anarchist, who is called Gustav and intends to kill Hitler. He therefore prepares a series, failures, of attacks.
notes: On the very distant model of the "Great Dictator", a pretext for the faces of Molleilato. Amanda Lear remakes Marlene!

title: L'aldilà! E tu vivrai nel terrore
actors: Catriona MacColl, David Warbeck, Sarah Keller, Antoine Saint John, Veronica Lazar
description: Year 1927: in a cursed hotel because it was built over one of the seven gates of hell, an angry mob kills a painter accused of witchcraft. 1981: Liza, fashion designer, inherits that same New York hotel. Despite being warned by a blind woman, Lise settles in the building thinking about how to renovate it. But his optimism is good and good ...
notes: Already from the plot you can understand the narrative schematism of this film, centered on this macabre hotel, taken up by Fulci with a pleased taste for horror. It strikes here and there, but without being able to fully involve.

title: Mr. Stitch
actors: Rutger Hauer, Will Wheaton, Romland Wafford, Nia Peeples
description: Dr. Archibald Rus is the head of a government science agency. His work consists in the experimentation of a surgical system capable of recreating a man made up of parts of eighty different bodies. Lazarus, this is the creature's name, should have neither a will nor a memory; instead he is shocked every night by the horrendous images of the deaths suffered by the owners of the bodies used in his creation.
notes: Second film as director of Roger Avary, screenwriter with Quentin Tarantino of "Pulp Fiction". A television horror, which cannot therefore exceed too much, however well directed.

title: Tutto Totò - Il grande maestro
actors: Totò, Ernesto Calindri, Giusi Raspani Dandolo, Mario Castellani
description: Mordecai Stonatelli, music teacher, tries in every way to establish himself in the artistic field: a little for musical vein, a little to make ends meet ...
notes: A reduction made specifically for the small screen (a more unique than rare case at the time, especially in the filmography of the Prince), an adaptation of the well-known Neapolitan farce _La camera rent a tre_. The subject and the screenplay are by Totò himself and by Bruno Corbucci. The march of the bersaglieri that you hear at the end was the air with which the Neapolitan comedian loved to close his magazines. It first aired on TV on May 13, 1967.

title: Fate largo ai moschettieri
actors: Yvonne Sanson, Gino Cervi, Steve Barclay, Georges Marchal
description: The very young D'Artagnan goes to Paris in the hope of being admitted among the musketeers of King Louis XIII. Arriving in the French capital, he introduces himself to Monsieur de Treville and is welcomed into the body as a cadet. Having carelessly bumped into three gentlemen on the street, he is challenged to a duel by them at different hours. Only at the end will D'Artagnan discover that the three are ...

title: Emanuelle nera
actors: Laura Gemser, Karin Schubert, Angelo Infanti, Paola Senatore, Gabriele Tinti
description: Emanuelle, a beautiful color girl, goes to Nairobi for a photo shoot.
