Hosted by two rich white spouses, he participates in the safaris and parties who regularly take place in their villa. Soon the man is involved by the sensuality of Emanuelle and ends up going to bed. But the girl can no longer feel continually hunted by men and decides to leave Africa.
notes: Laura Geser appears here for the first time in an Italian film inspired by the first "Emmanuelle" (1973). The soundtrack is by Nico Fidenco.

title: Il giorno più corto
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Virna Lisi, Nino Taranto
description: Two Sicilians unwittingly contribute to victory in the First World War by blowing up an enemy ship by accident.
notes: Franco and Ciccio in the First World War. In the year of "Il Giorno più Lungo", almost all the Italian comedians were mobilized to support the two comedians.

title: Ed ora... raccomanda l'anima a Dio!
actors: Jeff Cameron, Fabio Testi, Virginia Darval, Anthony Stevens, Mohamad Ali Fardin, Cristina Penz, Calisto Calisti, Amerigo Castrighella, Ettore Manni
description: During the journey to Denver City, the stagecoach on which, among others, Stanley are found, a man determined to return to his city to recover the inheritance usurped by a relative and Steve, eager to find the gold fruit of his work , stolen from him by a gang of thugs, is attacked by a group of outlaws. Sanders comes to their rescue and takes them out of the hindrance and makes a strong friendship with the two. After many adventures Sanders manages to track down and punish the members of the gang.

title: Paradise Alley
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Lee Canalito, Armand Assante, Frank McRae
description: New York, 1946. The three Carboni brothers live in the infamous neighborhood of Hell's Kitchen: Cosmo, Lenny, and Victor. But the economic situation of the three is not brilliant and then Cosmo comes up with the idea of ??opening the Taverna Paradiso, a gym where wrestling matches take place and where you can bet.
notes: For his debut behind the camera Stallone wanted to do too much: protagonist, author of the story and script and director and the film suffers.

title: Midnight in St. Petersburg
actors: Michael Caine, Jason Connery, Tanya Jackson, Michelle Burke
description: Agent Harry Palmer carries out a mission in Beijing against the Russian mafia on behalf of former enemies of the Russian secret service. So he has the idea of ??settling in Moscow, where he decides to open a detective agency, specializing in investigations against corruption and the mafia. He also takes a partner, the young Nick who, having an affair with Tatiana, a dancer, is thinking of opening a branch in St. Petersburg. Tatiana is kidnapped: Harry and Nick do everything to free her.
notes: Situations are classic and Harry Palmer is an experienced investigator. Sequel to "In pursuit of the red death".

title: Amityville: Dollhouse
actors: Rachel Duncan, Jarrett Lennon, Clayton Murray, Allen Cutler
description: Imagine a family whose existence apparently flows in the quietest of ways. No clue and vice versa, so much normality. Well it is in the closets of a house like this that the worst skeletons are hidden.
notes: This according to a somewhat schematic conception, ça va sans dire ... Obviously there is no lack of scenes of sexual violence. How do you say today? A must"

title: Promesse di marinaio
actors: Antonio Cifariello, Inge Schoener, Renato Salvatori, Alberto Bonucci
description: Some sailors of the torpedo boat "Audace" are linked by a deep friendship and when they go out on a free ride they participate in all sorts of sentimental adventures. Tireless suitors, they find themselves involved in the adventure of one of them who has fallen madly in love with the director of a music store. With great effort, the five sailors manage to remove all the obstacles that prevent the two from fulfilling their dream of love.
notes: Film from the "Pink Neorealism" trend. Light tone film, with well-characterized characters.

title: The Lady Gambles
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, Robert Preston, Stephen McNally, Tony Curtis
description: Joan, wife of a successful journalist, suffers from a monotonous and flat existence that does not reserve any kind of emotion. She therefore thinks of giving a thrill to her existence and of devoting herself to gambling and so while her husband is away for work, he frequents more and more gambling dens. For Joan, however, it becomes a real disease, which threatens to ruin her marriage.
notes: Noir melodrama with strong colors. Barbara Stanwyck is really good at giving life to a weak but not too weak female figure. Small part for Tony Curtis.

title: The World of Henry Orient
actors: Peter Sellers, Tippie Walker, Merrie Spaeth, Angela Lansbury
description: Henry Orient is an accomplished pianist. His charm is strong enough to "push" two girls to try in every way to involve him in their existence. An idolatry that soon turns into real persecution and ruins his career.
notes: It's not a great comedy: situations that are too repetitive and too exasperated. Luckily there is Sellers and his brilliant characterization.

title: Sphinx
actors: Lesley-Anne Down, Frank Langella, John Gielgud, Maurice Ronet
description: An archaeologist manages, after long searches, to discover the classic secret of an Egyptian tomb. Naturally his activity attracts the attention of looters who intervene with their greed. The situation heats up, but fate lurks for everyone.
notes: Yellow with horror ambitions, all played on the mysterious charm of sphinxes and pyramids. In this era of rediscovery of the myth of "The Mummy" the film is even more modest and not very original. It is not clear how the great Gielgud ended up in here.

title: Uomini e no
actors: Flavio Bucci, Monica Guerritore, Ivana Monti, Renato Scarpa
description: Milan, winter 1944: a destroyed and sorrowful city, still in the hands of the Nazis and fascist squads. Against this state of affairs some men, gathered in the Gaps, try to oppose, preparing attacks, placing bombs and trying to prevent the enemies from reorganizing. Not an easy task, of course. Especially since these men and women have their own private life that can sometimes collide with their collective commitment.
notes: Drawing it from the novel by Elio Vittorini, the director Valentino Orsini, once a friend of Taviani, makes a film that is perhaps inhomogeneous but interesting and participatory.

title: Tutto Totò - Don Giovannino
actors: Totò, Mario Castellani, Gianni Agus, Franco Volpi, Antonella Lualdi, Gloria Paul
description: Totò is persecuted by a jealous husband, and to escape him he sneaks into the artists' entrance of a fourth-rate theater. Her husband follows him there too, threatening him with death: Totò then disguises himself as a puppet and goes on stage ...
notes: The episode is the replica of the sketch already proposed at the theater by Totò in the magazine _ Once upon a time in the world_.

title: Lo scudo umano
actors: Michael Dudikoff, Grazia Theresa Morris
description: An American soldier is used by the Iraqi army as a "human shield" in a military installation. The prisoner, however, has the woody face and the steel muscles of Michael Dudikoff so that, despite the torture suffered, the shield soon turns into an inexorable striker ...
notes: Nothing but a pure excuse for not too exciting action scenes.

title: Il tuo piacere è il mio
actors: Ewa Aulin, Femi Benussi, Barbara Bouchet, Sylva Koscina, Lionel Stander, Leopoldo Trieste
description: A Florentine noble of the '500 offers a banquet to some illustrious guests. During the dinner some stories are told: A naïve marquise allows herself to a lustful abbot convinced that she is imitating the pious works of some saints in this; A cardinal deliberately entertains his guests at the table under the effect of a powerful purgative; a dyer has an affair with a friar; Francis I of France, although a prisoner of the Spaniards, consoles himself with two Iberian beauties; A prostitute risks disrupting the council of Constance; a nobleman cheats on his (unfaithful) wife with a prostitute. From Balzac's "Contes drolatiques", a scollacciato episodic film in sixteenth-century costume in the decamerotic vein.

title: Un militare e mezzo
actors: Renato Rascel, Aldo Fabrizi, Virna Lisi, Terence Hill, Robert Alda, Lella Fabrizi
description: An emigrant returns to Italy after thirty years. His joy does not last long because the inexorable Italian bureaucracy discovers that in his youth he had not served in the military. Since "it's never too late" here is the fifty-year-old wearing the stars and marching among the recruits under the orders of a surly marshal.
notes: Those were the years in which militaristic farces were depopulated. This film adds nothing to the already poor trend, even the natural comic predisposition of the performers seems subdued. One of the first films by Mario Girotti (alias Terence Hill), here in the role of Lieutenant Strazzonelli.

title: Come quando fuori piove
actors: Enzo Iacchetti, Vanessa Gravina, Nadia Rinaldi, Matteo Dondi, Carlo Croccolo
description: Alfredo is an inveterate player. After taking almost all of his money, however, the moment of the big shot arrives, but, at the moment of cashing out, a mysterious woman blows him all. Hunted by loan sharks, Alfredo ends up right at the house of the "thief". Her name is Anita, she is a romantic dreamer devoid of any practical sense and, moreover, she has a son, an authentic little genius boy visibly looking for a father. The demon of the game returns to make itself felt and Alfredo risks losing, in addition to money, also Anita's love, but the boy has developed an infallible mathematical method to break the green table and so ...

title: Le planète sauvage
description: A world upside down in this beautiful animated film. On a remote planet, men, divided into "domestic" and "wild", are subjected to the will of the Draag, a much more evolved population. Among the "servants", however, there is a child who is able to access the knowledge of the Draag. Science fiction film among the most distressing and black in the history of cinema, it is a masterpiece of European animation, dreamlike and metaphorical.

title: Incident a Phantom Hill
actors: Robert Fuller, Jocelyn Lane, Dan Duryea, Noah Berry, Linden Chiles, Claude Akins
description: Towards the end of the Civil War, some Union soldiers carry a load of gold. During the journey they are attacked, massacred and the treasure disappears. Months later, at the end of the hostilities, the brother of the officer who commanded the expedition is charged with recovering the loot. To this end, he puts together a small team of men, soon joined by an adventurer. In the group there is a traitor whose actions, combined with the ambushes of the Indians, risk disrupting the enterprise, but ...
notes: Well calibrated on the rhythms and conventions of the genre, the film lacks a bit of obviousness. Good cast.

title: Two Came Back
actors: Melissa Joan Hart, Jon Pennell, Jonathan Brandis, David Gail
description: Susan Clarkson is a twenty-one year old American who, as an expert in sailing boats, decides to change her life. She therefore accepts the skipper assignment that is offered to her: she has to take a boat with five passengers from San Diego to Vancouver. But a miscalculation pushes the boat into the middle of a storm of extraordinary proportions. The crew, the neurotic captain and the passengers run the risk of dying ...
notes: The film is based on a true story, but this of course does not give any guarantee of film quality. Exploiting disasters for cinematic purposes is a hit that very few have succeeded.

title: Shadow Run
actors: Michael Caine, James Fox, Kenneth Colley, Leslie Grantham
description: We are in London in the 90s. A criminal alliance is forged between the ruthless Haskell and what is called the "lord of bandits": Higgins. The two plan to rob the State Mint van. They try the shot for the first time, but it fails. The tenacious Haskell investigates to find out who was the mole: tracking down the informant, he kills him. At this point you can try again ...
notes: The so-called "robberies of the century" have always been highly effective narrative material. Michael Caine, then, is also excellent as a "villain".

title: Blast
actors: Rutger Hauer, Linden Ashby, Andrew Divoff, Kimberly Warren
description: In the London headquarters of the United Nations, some terrorists have captured hostages. While the special team led by Colonel Max Leo tried to save them, an explosion occurred which allowed the commando leader to escape. Obviously there are many victims and among them also Colonel Leo. The attack in Atlanta was similar, during the celebration for the start of the Olympic Games.
notes: Terrorism, especially if international, seems to have solved some problems for US screenwriters. With the cold war over, an enemy continued to serve ... Rutger Hauer, in the role of the colonel, is less convincing than usual.

title: Topless Women Talk About Their Lives
actors: Danielle Cormack, Ian Hughes, Joel Tobeck, Willa O'Neill
description: Ant, a schizophrenic with a boob complex is writing a terrible movie about topless women. More sunny is his sister Prue who falls in love with Mike, handsome Maori and who is determined to take him to the altar without thinking for a moment. Liz, on the other hand, is pregnant and due to an oversight she skips the appointment with the doctor who has to have her abortion. Now she has to decide whether to cultivate motherhood alone, with the "sower" or with Geoff, a lying lover.
notes: First work from New Zealand: it has the gift of simplicity and freshness, of Sundance-style "poverty", but without complacency and snobbery. Shot in six months making the most of weekends, it shows with disarming frankness a truer than life birth scene (the actress Danielle Cormack was really pregnant): one of the most original in the history of cinema.

title: The Object of My Affection
actors: Paul Rudd, Jennifer Aniston, Tim Daly, John Pankow
description: During a party, George learns from a complete stranger that the person he lives with is planning to dump him. Luckily Nina, as the girl is called, offers the seduced and abandoned to move in with her. And so when George's handsome boyfriend, a university professor, admits that everything is over between them, the man has no choice but to move in with Nina. A warm friendship is born between the two, which alarms the girl's boyfriend.
notes: This was to be expected; after "My Best Friend's Wedding", Hollywood insists on the ambiguity of friendship between a woman and a homosexual. Comedy based on the novel by Stephen McCauley who, winking at the last Allen, wanders uncertain between fashions and ideas, but ends up reuniting traditional values.

title: Totò premio Nobel
actors: Totò, Mario Castellani, Sandra Milo, Corrado Mantoni
description: The magazine "Once upon a time in the world", by Michele Galdieri, was an authentic workhorse of Totò in the theater. Among the most famous and successful sketches of this show was the very famous one of the sleeping car played by Totò in a duet with his most trusted and habitual "shoulder": Mario Castellani. In the sketch Totò is an intrusive curmudgeon who is in the same railway compartment with the Hon. Cosimo Trombetta, distinguished and meek gentleman who undergoes the inevitable propotencies of the other. At a certain point, a woman enters between the two of them who, by pretending to be persecuted, ends up relieving them both of the wallet.

title: Un amour de sorcière - Witch Way Love
actors: Vanessa Paradis, Jean Reno, Jeanne Moreau, Gil Bellows, Dabney Coleman
description: In the autumn of witchcraft there are only six sorcerers left on earth. Five of them serve Good, while only one, Molok, is at the service of Evil. The problem that arises is that Molok has no heirs and that Morgane, a witch who sided with Good, is the mother of a delightful eleven-month-old baby named Arthur. At six in the morning of June 14th Arthur will be one year old and as tradition dictates, his anniversary will have to be celebrated by the attribution of a godfather.
notes: First film with Mrs. Depp to be distributed in Italy and the reasons escape us: why this dull fairy tale and not the penultimate "Elisa" (with Depardieu singing Dalla's "Caruso" drunk in the rain)? Market mysteries. The operina in question, involve (power of the Franks) actors of the caliber of Jeanne Moreau and Jean Reno.

title: The Man Who Knew a Little
actors: Bill Murray, Peter Gallagher, Joanne Whalley, Alfred Molina
description: Wallace, the naive clerk at an Iowa videotape shop, flew to London to celebrate his birthday with his brother James. He, completely unaware of his arrival, has organized a dinner with some very important customers that could bring him very high earnings. Hoping to keep Wallace busy during the evening, James runs to buy him a ticket to attend "The Theater of Life", a theatrical experience that directly engages the audience.
notes: Between the Hitchcock and 007 parody, the misunderstanding game and the script are well crafted, based on the Cold War nostalgia of a couple of old British and Russian intelligence officers and Bill Murray's disarming sympathy, but the pace is uncertain and you do not always find them up to par.

title: Half Baked
actors: Dave Chapelle, Guillermo Diaz, Jim Breuer, Harland Williams
description: When a friend of theirs is arrested for killing a NYPD-owned horse with junk food, Scarface, Brian and Thurgood, his three closest friends, have to scramble to find the bail money. Their idea is to steal marijuana from a pharmaceutical lab and then sell it home. The plan turns out to be too risky, but the three are ready to do anything to help their friend.
notes: This comedy by Tamra Davis is a crazy collection of politically incorrect situations. Goofy and messed up, the film has as its soundtrack a continuous reworking of famous themes, such as that of the television series "Batman". And from "Batman" he also takes up the graphic interlude that separates the various situations, only at the end of the spiral animation, instead of appearing the silhouette of the famous bat that of the marijuana leaf appears. Cast of actors from "Saturday Night Live", directed by a student of the Corman stable.

title: Quando tramonta il sole
actors: Carlo Giuffrè, Maria Fiore, Abbe Lane, Giacomo Rondinella, Alberto Rabagliati
description: Two Neapolitan workers are particularly gifted for music. One of the two composes songs which he then gets transcribed by an old teacher whose niece he falls in love with. To find some money, he takes part in a musical contest under a false name, but the old master unmasks him. The worker therefore moves to the North where he has an affair with a singer for whom he composes songs.
notes: Musical film by an expert of the genre, Brignone, which however has only one merit: Abbe Lane.

title: La mazurka del barone, della santa e del fico fiorone
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Paolo Villaggio, Delia Boccardo, Gianni Cavina, Lucio Dalla, Patrizia De Clara
description: The Romagna baron Anteo Pellacane owns a large estate inside which stands a fig tree considered miraculous. The tree is linked to the cult of Saint Jerome to whom the local populations are devoted. The baron, however, is an atheist and disbeliever and tries in every way to get rid of the fig. When a couple of prostitutes deceive them into believing in a miracle of Saint Jerome, the baron is converted and becomes a bigot.
notes: A good attempt at an Italian grotesque, directed by the most authentic Avati.

title: Our Little Girl
actors: Shirley Temple, Joel McCrea, Rosemary Ames, Lye Talbot
description: A green lawn next to a stream is little Shirley's "corner of paradise" where she often goes with mum and dad. When her parents are about to divorce Shirley runs away from home and goes to her corner. The anguish of his disappearance, the anxiety of the searches make the two parents come to his senses who rush to his search, finding themselves, in this way, united as in the past. It takes them a moment to realize they can get back together.
notes: Among the most dull and pathetic of the American child prodigy. There is also a colorized version which certainly does not improve the quality of the film.

title: Kitchen
actors: Ayako Kawahara, Kenji Matsuda, Naoki Goto, Akiko Urao
description: The young Mikage, passionate about cooking and aspiring cook, lives with her old grandmother in a modest house. On the death of his grandmother, Mikage is left with the only company of the large refrigerator that keeps the "raw materials" of his business. One day Yuichi appears, a young man very attached to his grandmother who asks Mikage to move in with him. Yuichi's house is a dream for the girl, especially for the large and beautiful kitchen and the very spacious refrigerator it contains.
notes: The film is based on Banana Yoshimoto's planetary bestseller and shows a youthful and westernized Japan.

title: Romy and Michele's High School Reunion
actors: Mira Sorvino, Lisa Kudrow, Janeane Garofalo, Alan Cumming
description: The girls of the title are two schoolmates linked since childhood by a great friendship. At the news of the upcoming meeting with old school friends, which takes place every ten years, the two friends take advantage of it to review the time spent. However, they discover that they have very little to brag about and so, to hide the mediocrity of their lives, they decide to tell their old comrades an elaborate series of lies.
notes: David Mirkin's film (which is well written and manages, in the end, to avoid too much goodness) lacks grit and nastiness. Pleasant, but a bit static.

title: Two Moon Junction
actors: Sherilyn Fenn, Richard Tyson, Louise Fletcher, Burl Ives, Kristy McNichol
description: An aristocratic girl leaves the village to become a model. After a long absence he returns to his hometown and meets a young man with whom he begins a relationship that soon leads to the decision to marry. Shortly before the wedding, however, the girl meets a sculptor, a heavy drinker and unrepentant womanizer, to whom she feels strongly attracted. For him she leaves her future husband right at the threshold of the altar and begins with the other a passionate and turbulent love story.
notes: From the director of the following "Wild Orchid" and "Il delta di Venere" there is nothing more to expect than a meatloaf of little sauce seasoned mostly with scenes of alluring soft voyeurism.

title: Into the Badlands
actors: Bruce Dern, Mariel Hemingway, Helen Hunt, Andrew Robinson, Dylan McDermott
description: Barston is a bounty hunter who hunts down the unstoppable criminal Red Roundtree. In the course of his search Barston comes across McComas, another thug hunted by Sheriff Starett. Barston lets McComas go and hides in a small border town where he meets and falls in love with Blossom, the saloon girl. The two, both alone and desperate, live a short season of love, but then ...

title: Assassin(s)
actors: Mathieu Kassovitz, Michel Serrault, Mehdi Benoufa, Robert Gendreu
description: Wagner is a professional killer, aged and tired, who begins to make mistakes in his work and therefore decides to pass on the secrets of the trade to a younger "pupil". When he meets Max, an unemployed 25-year-old, Wagner thinks he has found his successor.
notes: The first part is tense, cruel, narratively compact and suggestive. It was roughly the story of a short film with the same title that Kassovitz made in 1992. But the problem with "Assassin (s)" is the vain pursuit of a story that, after the initial twenty minutes, turns into a self-satisfied and self-satisfied free provocation.

title: First Strike
actors: Jackie Chan, Jackson Lou, Chen Chun Wu, Bill Tung
description: Jackie is a Hong Kong policeman who is hired by the CIA and a Russian spy organization to track down a stolen nuclear warhead in Ukraine. Our hero thus finds himself having to follow the trail of a corrupt CIA agent and it will be because of him that he will end up in jail on a murder charge. At this point to save his skin he must show all his skills as a fighter.
notes: Even if his name is changed in the Italian and foreign versions, it is still him: the policeman of the successful Hong Kong saga "Police Story", now in its fourth chapter (in Italy we have only seen the third: "Supercop"). He is, of course, Jackie Chan, a strange cross between Terence Hill and Bruce Lee, in the breach for almost thirty years, an Asian star who does not like Hollywood, prefers to direct himself or be directed by the trusted Stanley Tong, strictly without a stunt double (not to be lose, once again, the credits with the wrong takes). A fun Bondian variation, to be enjoyed with tons of popcorn.

title: Steal Big, Steal Little
actors: Andy Garcia, Alan Arkin, Rachel Ticotin, Joe Pantoliano, Ally Walker
description: On the lush hills of Beverly Hills live Ruben and Robert, two Mexican twins adopted by a rich and eccentric heiress. The first is as fragile and disinterested as the other is cynical and unscrupulous. But it happens that their foster mother on the verge of death decides to leave her substantial possessions to Ruben. Robert, who has meanwhile become a ruthless businessman, does not think about giving up ranches, land, villas, money and bonds. Thus begins a fight with sheriffs and corrupt judges.
notes: Fooling the rich to redistribute the booty among the poor, possibly Chicanos: this is the moral of the tale in which the missing Zorro (it must have been Garcia to wear the cloak that went to Banderas) takes revenge. With the help of the faithful Alan Arkin and the beautiful brunette Rachel Ticotin.

title: Johnny Skidmarks
actors: Peter Gallagher, Frances McDormand, John Lithgow, Jack Black
description: After the death of his beloved wife, Frank has locked himself up in armored cynicism and his favorite entertainment is watching Cronenberg's "The Demon Under the Skin" tape during photographic development, or going to the Burger Clown for dinner. To supplement his salary, he works as a paparazzo for a small gang that catches unsuspecting people during their clandestine encounters with a prostitute. But one day all the members of the gang are horribly massacred: in the end only he remains, terrified.
notes: The film begins with "Magic Moments" played by Sinatra, but it soon becomes clear that this is a red herring. The film from the beginning offers a bestiary of the most repulsive horrors. Directed by a former collaborator of the Coen brothers, the film offers an unconvincing casting and wastes an interesting subject. But the illusion only lasts as long as a photo shoot.

title: Bulletproof
actors: Damon Wayans, Adam Sandler, James Caan, Jeep Swenson
description: Moses is a petty car thief who has decided to supplement his income by working for a major drug dealer. When the chance of a lifetime presents itself, he doesn't hesitate to involve Keats, his best friend. But in the midst of buying and selling a large load, it turns out that Keats is an undercover police officer. In the ensuing shooting, Moses unintentionally hits his accomplice ...
notes: If you shoot at random in an action film, _Bulletproof_ hits the mark: a meaningless story, striking for the jumble of scattered genres: comedy, adventure, even a ridiculous attempt to rattle off pearls about friendship.

title: The Command
actors: Guy Madison, Joan Weldon, James Whitmore
description: A U.S. Army cavalry regiment must escort a convoy of pioneers to the inhospitable Indian-dominated lands of Wyoming. When the commander falls ill, the responsibility for the operation passes to the medical officer who, in addition to the hostility and ambushes of the Indians, must face an epidemic of smallpox. As he works among the settlers' wagons he meets the orphan Martha, with whom he falls in love. The decisive confrontation with the Indians, however, is imminent ...
notes: When the Native Americans were still ugly, dirty and bad it took very little to create a story of the old Froniera made up of men all in one piece, heroic orphans and a beautiful "ours come" in the finale!

title: Moj drogi Ivan Lapscin
actors: Attori non professionisti
description: We are in a provincial town in "deep Russia" in the 1930s. It is therefore the era of Stalin, the little father of the Soviet Union, and it is the era of the five-year plans, of forced industrialization, of cohabitation, but, above all, of the great "purges", of informing, of suspicion the walls of the house.
notes: It is one of the first Soviet films in which there is "bad talk" of Stalin and his period, preceding the epochal turning point of Gorbachev and also preceding "Krustaliov, ma voiture" which Guerman presented at Cannes in '99.

title: The Mighty Ducks
actors: Emilio Estevez, Michael Tucker, Jan Rubes, Kathryn Erbe, Garette Ratliff Henson
description: The Mighty Ducks are a hockey team, led by Gordon Bombay. In Los Angeles during the junior world championships of this tough and violent sport, the coach who should support his players, is instead distracted by the offers of a professional team with the foreseeable consequences for the Mighty.
notes: In the beginning it was a film called "Fabric of Champions", of which this is the sequel. Here only ethical-sporting banalities remained. This did not prevent the third stage, "A team at full ice", from being completed.

title: Sprizneni volbou
actors: Alexander Dubcek, Antonín Novotný, Ludvík Svoboda, Pavel Kohout, Marta Kubisová
description: Czechoslovakia, March 14-30, 1968: following the resignation of President Antonin Novotny, the reformist general Ludvik Svoboda is elected. Of this complex period, Vachek captures the emotions, the reflections, the debates, shooting with his camera and documenting that lightning and uncertain season of freedom. Among others, Alexander Dubcek and Josif Smrkovski appear.
notes: Filmed with the typical stylistic features of the "cinéma verité", it has long been forbidden. It now re-emerges from the archives.

title: Konkurs
actors: Vaclav Blumenfeld, Vladimir Pucholt, Vera Kresadlova, Jirí Slitr
description: Two-part film. A competition for aspiring actresses: the beautiful ones who gather at the Semafor theater in Prague and all that follows in terms of expectations and disappointments. In the second part, here is another race, this time of motorcycles, punctuated by the musical commentary of an amateur band.
notes: It is the debut of Milos Forman, who as a young man looked at humanity with irony and a sense of the grotesque. Soon he would make his best work of the period, "The loves of a blonde".

title: Capitali culturali d'Europa: Praga cuore agitato d'Europa
description: Made for the "Cultural Capitals of Europe" series, produced by Rai, the film by Vera Chytilova, a leading exponent of the Czech "New wave" of the 1960s, is a portrait of the city through its dramatic history and, at the same time, a kaleidoscope with multiple perspectives on Prague's cultural identity. Made in the difficult period of normalization following the repression of Dubcek's "Spring".

title: A Face to Die for
actors: James Wilder, Yasmine Bleeth, Richard Beymer, Chandra West
description: Emily had a serious accident and her face was disfigured. This does not prevent her from having a normal life: she works in an antique shop and designs costumes for a theater company. Her existence changes when she meets Alec he starts courting her, actually wanting only to rob the shop where she works. He persuades her and together they carry out the robbery. But something goes wrong and the girl is arrested. In prison a doctor takes care of her and tries to help her ...
notes: The dramaturgical construction of this television film is as linear as a string of pearls: just string the facts, one after the other. Taking care to accumulate serious facts, one more than the other.

title: Slim
actors: Margaret Lindsay, Pat O'Brien, Henry Fonda, J. Farrell MacDonald
description: A young man has the ambition to become a wire puller in an electrical company. He manages to be hired as an apprentice and to enter the good graces of one of the best specialized workers. In the meantime he meets a young woman who would like to marry him. But he doesn't feel like it: he doesn't want to give up his job, however dangerous.
notes: What follows is a script: an accident and common sense is back.

title: Capriccio all'italiana
directors: Steno, Mauro Bolognini, Pier Paolo Pasolini, Mario Monicelli, Pino Zac, F. Rossi
actors: Totò, Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Laura Betti, Silvana Mangano, Walter Chiari
description: In the 1960s, the episodic film was quite fashionable. In this series there are six episodes grouped together, each by a different director. In Pasolini's, entitled "What are the clouds", Totò is a puppet painted green. In Steno's, "The Sunday Monster", the "prince of laughter" is busy cutting the hair of the young beats. In no particular order the others: a motorist, instigated by his partner, beat up another road user. To prevent them from reading the comics, a governess tells her children fairy tales, but the effect is worse. A jealous woman unnecessarily torments her husband. One episode is cartoon.
notes: The episode of Pasolini, with the suburban "Otello" and Modugno singing while placing Totò and Ninetto in the trash, is a masterpiece. The others are negligible.

title: Hear No Evil
actors: Marlee Matlin, D.B. Sweeney, Martin Sheen
description: A young man kills a guard in the Portland museum to get hold of a precious gold coin. The investigations start, conducted not only by the police, but also by Mickey, a journalist who manages to get in touch with the murderer and get the coin. He also discovers who commissioned the murder and is scared of it: the organizer is in fact a corrupt police lieutenant. An endless series of misadventures ensues.
notes: One of the main characteristics of the thriller, Lang and Hitchcock teach it, is its relentlessness. If the latter fails, it is easy to get lost in the maze of the script.

title: Rules of Obsession
actors: Scott Bakula, John Getz, Chelsea Field
description: Between David, a successful psychoanalyst, and Jerry, an incurable playboy, there is a love-hate relationship. Which explodes when Jerry introduces David to the woman he just married, Diana. Beyond the surprise, for David there is a great embarrassment, as Diana shows him an excessive interest. The relationship between Diana and Jerry, however, does not go well: in fact, in the woman's past there are too many secrets, including an attempted murder of her previous husband with a stab. When Jerry is found dead, killed with a knife ...
notes: Final with surprise. Despite this, however, the film is more complicated than intriguing.

title: Hombre
actors: Paul Newman, Fredric March, Richard Boone, Diane Cilento
description: A white man who grew up among the Indians finds himself traveling with other characters, including a federal agent with his wife and a bandit. The latter, intent on robbing the agent with the complicity of other outlaws, is however defeated by the white Indian. Taking the agent's wife hostage, the bandits try to force the passengers to leave the shack where they found refuge after the attempted robbery. Nobody feels like facing them openly, but ...
notes: Western pro-Indian director and liberal actor. Brave Newman, Ritt puts on a beautiful screenplay by the noir writer Elmore Leonard with great skill.

title: Real Genius
actors: Val Kilmer, Gabriel Jarret, Michelle Meyrink, William Atherton
description: A 15-year-old is admitted to a school for geniuses, thanks to his particularly high IQ. Everything could be for the best: he is passionate about studying and follows the lessons of Professor Hathaway. Until a strong depressive crisis attacks her that threatens to compromise every effort. Fortunately, a companion decides to help the unfortunate young man: together they will foil a secret plan of the professor.
notes: It's hard to get hooked on the dramas of these budding Einsteins. Coolidge is waiting to become a full-blown "author", and is fit to direct a vague follow-up to the "Police School" series (the writers are the same).

title: Oscar Wilde
actors: Robert Morley, Ralph Richardson, Phyllis Calvert, John Neville
description: Oscar Wilde has a very close friendship with Douglas Queensbury. They have lunch together, they go out together and, perhaps, they do something else together. The boy's father is persuaded of this and arrives to send an insulting note to the writer. Wilde, pushed by Douglas, sues him but finds himself in fact in the dock. He will be sentenced to two years of forced labor for homosexuality.
notes: Well acted, the film is a bit slow but basically it's a pretty persuasive melò. To find another episode about the poet's life on the screen, we had to wait for Brian Gilbert's "Wilde".

title: I due pompieri
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Monica Pardo, Dante Maggio
description: Two firefighters are in love with the same girl. One of them makes her believe that the other is already engaged and, even, is about to get married. After the usual misunderstandings, a second girl balances the fate of the two friends-rivals. Orange blossom for four on the way.

title: Diary of a Mad Housewife
actors: Richard Benjamin, Frank Langella, Lorraine Cullen, Carrie Snodgress, Frannie Michel, Lee Addoms, Peter Dohanos, Katherine Meskill, Alice Cooper
description: Tired of the detachment and selfishness always shown by her husband Jonathan, a young and prominent lawyer, Tina decides to have an adulterous relationship with a writer she met at a party. When he discovers that the latter is also quite arid and unable to love, the woman leaves him just as her husband, in turn returning from an extramarital affair, is overwhelmed by some financial problems.
notes: Not excellent Meldrama in which there is, however, no lack of good psychological notations. The choice of an unskilled cast probably did not help the cause.

title: The Sandlot
actors: Tom Guiry, Karen Allen, James Earl Jones, Chauncey Leopardi
description: Scotty Smalls, a teenager just enrolled in high school, moves with his mother and stepfather to a new neighborhood. He does not know his peers, he has big problems with his mother's new husband but luckily he cultivates a passion: baseball. He follows the league, he knows all the players but above all he is an excellent player himself. By approaching a group of schoolmates who play baseball, Scotty manages to fit in and befriends the area's sports idol, Rodriguez. The two become inseparable on and off the diamond. Together they will experience incredible adventures in the name of sport.

title: Un sorriso, uno schiaffo, un bacio in bocca
actors: Renato Pozzetto
description: Titanus is a historic Italian production house, very active especially in the twenty years following the Second World War. Like the Hollywood majors, Titanus has also made editing films with clips of its most famous titles from the golden age. The comic star of the time was the presenter: Renato Pozzetto. At the slow motion the well-known press agent Enrico Lucherini.
notes: Interesting documentary work that illustrates the production history of the only true Italian "major". Pozzetto has to do with vintage pieces such as cabbages as a snack but the operation is generally rigorous.

title: W Totò
actors: Totò, Mario Castellani, Peppino De Filippo, Aldo Fabrizi
description: Five years after the death of the "prince of laughter" they wanted to put together an anthology of his most famous cinematographic scenes: a fashion that would later spread. Here then is Totò grappling with the "men" and the "corporals", with the faithful sidekick Mario Castellani in many famous gags and in passages used then even by the posthumous advertising of this or that product.

title: La violenza: quinto potere
actors: Enrico Maria Salerno, Gastone Moschin, Riccardo Cucciolla, Mariangela Melato, Mario Adorf, Ciccio Ingrassia, Aldo Giuffré, Michele Abruzzo, Ferruccio De Ceresa, Turi Ferro, Guido Leontini, Elio Zamuto, Julien Guiomar, Georges Wilson, Mico Cundari
description: The construction of a dam in Sicily triggers unconfessable interests and appetites that find immediate repercussions in a feud between two mafia gangs who support two different power groups. After a long series of crimes of which not only some members of the rival gangs are the victims, but also many innocent ones, we arrive at the trial that sees the accused representatives of major and minor prominent members of the two clans. The skill of the lawyers and the retractions, the silences, the silence mean that, in the end, only two picciotti pay for everyone.
notes: Heavy and direct, it is taken from a text by Giuseppe Fava. Italian political cinema, for better or for worse. Very good actors, especially Ingrassia in a dramatic part.

title: Gunfight in Abilene
actors: Bobby Darin, Emily Banks, Leslie Nielsen, Don Galloway
description: Abilene, Kansas, would be a quiet town if it weren't for the long-standing dispute between farmers and ranchers. The latter, led by the shady Grant Everest, have taken over much of the land with the connivance of the corrupt Sheriff Slade. At one point, Kale Wayne returns to town, a veteran of the Civil War, a former friend of Grant who stole the girl from him.
notes: The classic ingredients are dosed with a sense of rhythm. The western, however, has already passed its golden age and this too can be felt in a certain mechanical nature of the staging.

title: Calcinacci
actors: Luigi Lucci, Carmine Russo, Fabio Lucci, Valerio Salemme
description: Pozzuoli, emblem of a modern condition: a city that struggles to continue its centuries-old existence. As happens to his children: the children of this documentary walk among the debris, increasingly abandoned to themselves.

title: Contract for Murder
actors: Cybill Shepherd, Ken Olin, Christopher McDonald, G.D. Spradlin
description: Faith is beautiful and charming, but her husband Terry cheats on her every now and then. The last flame of the playboy is a young divorced woman who is found dead one day: of course the suspicions are pinned not only on the deceased's ex consort, but also on Terry. Detective Jenzen leads the investigation and discovers that the instigator of the crime is Faith, who in turn has a lover. The woman flees to Acapulco and could get away with it, were it not for a tourist who ...
notes: Extreme passions, extreme sex, extreme solutions. But what planet do these screenwriters live on? The interpreters are quite persuasive, dealing with slender characters.

title: Legion of Fire: Killer Ants!
actors: Eric Lutes, Julia Campbell, Mitch Pileggi, Jeremy Foley, Bill Osborn
description: After a long period of inactivity and due to an abnormal subsurface heating, a volcano in Alaska resumes its activity. This allows a particular species of killer ants to grow out of all proportion, threatening the city at the foot of the volcano and claiming victims. James Conrad, entomologist, and Laura, a charming school teacher, are looking for a solution, but the queen ant is saved ...
notes: Mixing ecological sensitivity, thriller and catastrophism is contamination that has become so common that it does not surprise anyone. If anything, one wonders if today new films are being made thinking about sequels, or if sequels are being made to old films.

title: Swearing Allegiance
actors: Holly Marie Combs, David Lipper, Cassidy Rae
description: David and Diane are two young men madly in love with each other, but their romance is seriously compromised when David, in a moment of weakness, has a fleeting fling with Adrienne, a very cute and full of life girl. David, feeling terribly guilty, confesses the betrayal to Diane, who is desperate until she finds the scapegoat: the fault is not David's but Adrienne's, who at this point has to pay. And the two boyfriends by mutual agreement kill her. The detectives investigating the murder are groping in the dark until they accuse Bryan, an old friend of the victim suffering from depressive attacks, of the murder. Meanwhile David and Diane swear eternal love and enlist, he in the air force, she in the navy. Diane, oppressed by guilt, decides to confess the atrocious crime committed to two comrades. She is thus reported to the authorities but tries in every way to save David. The boy, however, now hunted by the police, is forced to flee ...

title: Journey Into Fear
actors: Orson Welles, Joseph Cotten, Dolores Del Rio, Agnes Moorehead, Ruth Warrick, Jack Durant, Everett Sloane, Eustace Wyatt, Frank Readick, Edgar Barrier, Jack Moss, Stefan Schnabel, Hans Conried, Richard Bennett
description: An American secret agent goes to Turkey to transmit data of vital importance to the allies. Here he is targeted by German spies who try in every way to kill him. Fortunately for him, the ambiguous Colonel Haki comes to his aid.
notes: After the success of "Fourth Estate" and while he was already taking care of the "Pride of the Ambersons", Welles began making this film which he left halfway on his departure for South America. The producers had it completed by Foster, distorting the original project. From the anthology the final scene, on the ledge in the rain.

title: Olivia
actors: Suzanna Love, Robert Walker, Bibbe Hansen, Ulli Lommel, Nicholas Love
description: Olivia, a young Londoner, has been suffering from mental disorders since she witnessed the brutal murder of her mother fifteen years earlier. Married to a callous and violent man, Olivia finds an outlet in despair by wandering through the night in the slums. The meeting with a young American she falls in love with seems to make her reborn and even the nightmares of the past vanish, but the happiness is short-lived ...

title: Vampire at Midnight
actors: Jason Williams, Lesley Milne, Robert Random
description: A famous psychiatrist, specialist in treatment with the hypnosis method, has gone so far in his research that, through the trance system on patients, he has committed a now numerous series of heinous crimes. He would continue to kill undisturbed were it not that a policeman, directly involved in a murder, begins to have suspicions about him ...
notes: The actualization of the vampire theme hardly works.

title: Come ti rapisco il pupo
actors: Walter Chiari, Stefania Casini, Umberto Smaila, Teo Teocoli, Massimo Boldi, Franca Valeri
description: A disheveled gang of criminals prepares a kidnapping plan for Jimmmy, a wealthy scion who lives with his family in a villa near Milan. They capture him and manage to get the hefty sum (even for then) of a million dollars delivered. But they are just inexperienced and do not even notice that the police have placed a bug in the suitcase. The good Jimmy who in the meantime has made friends with them will think about it.
notes: The old marpione Walter Chiari, experienced star of the Italian comedy, baptizes some lively young men and perky girls (Smaila, Teocoli, Casini) destined for future careers.

title: La voce - Infanzia e giovinezza di Madre Teresa di Calcutta
actors: Marisa Belli, Bekim Fehmiu, Margaret Mazzantini, Rossano Brazzi
description: Teresa, aka Agnese Gonxha of Bjoaxhiu, was born in 1910 and lived through one of the most dramatic eras in the history of humanity, passing through the First World War, which barely touched her, and then above all for the subsequent great world catastrophe. After moving to Calcutta, she dedicated herself to assisting the sick and the marginalized.
notes: Brunello Rondi's film tells the beginning of the existence of Teresa, Nobel Peace Prize winner in 1979. No better than the erotic films shot by the director in the same period.

title: Phenomena
actors: Jennifer Connelly, Donald Pleasence, Daria Nicolodi, Dalila Di Lazzaro, Patrick Bauchau, Fiore Argento, Federica Mastroianni
description: An American teenager named Jennifer is entrusted to a Swiss boarding school and some misadventures related to her sleepwalking but also to a mysterious murderer of missing girls near the boarding school begin. She is helped by an elderly entomologist who gives her the "sarcophagus fly" in a cage that should help her find the murderer.
notes: Panarormal thriller among the director's thesis and visionaries, suspended between a taste for craftsmanship and the pleasure of cinema. Connelly is beautiful and disturbing.

title: Cinderella Liberty
actors: James Caan, Marsha Mason, Eli Wallach, Burt Young
description: He is a sailor with not exactly reliable promises, she is certainly not a very faithful prostitute. Moreover, she, who is white, has a son, black, the result of a previous relationship. Together they still manage to spend a piece of life together, between ups and downs, difficulties and peaceful moments.
notes: Scripted by Darryl Ponicsan, who took the subject from one of his novellas, the film tells a simple story for psychologically normal people, mixing the realistic register with the fictional one. The fruit is still quite interesting even if probably the twenty and more years that separate us from its realization are felt.

title: The Curse of the Werewolf
actors: Clifford Evans, Oliver Reed, Yvonne Romain, Catherine Feller
description: A young woman and a beggar live as strays in 18th-century Spain. The girl, who has suffered violence and is pregnant, is taken into the house by a pitiful teacher but dies in giving birth to the child. The professor takes care of the newborn who, however, shows worrying signs of bestiality. Over time he transforms into a werewolf.
notes: Fisher is the one who revived the genre in the early 1960s.

title: The Iroquis Trail
actors: George Montgomery, Brenda Marshall, Glenn Langan
description: In the mid-18th century, the British and French waged a no-holds-barred war in the North American colony. Tom, a young English sergeant, is the victim of this incorrect fight, who is killed by two Indians who are actually French spies and who accuse Tom of treason.
notes: Mediocre drama with a "historical" background.

title: Ludwig
actors: Helmut Berger, Romy Schneider, Silvana Mangano, Umberto Orsini, Trevor Howard, Helmut Griem, Nora Ricci, Gert Fröbe
description: The young Ludwig, King of Bavaria, has an ambitious project: to be, for his subjects, an enlightened monarch on the model of the Renaissance rulers. It hosts Richard Wagner, has a theater built to represent his music, that dream of a "total work of art" of the now unscrupulous musician. Ludwig, marginalized by the government and disillusioned by Wagner's betrayal, begins a life as a decadent esthete, drug addict in love with beauty and a lover of his waiters.
notes: Visconti completes his "German trilogy" (the others are "The fall of the gods" and "Death in Venice") with a work with a relaxed rhythm and extraordinary visual strength. The filmmaker's relationship with both the character and the world that Ludwig represents is restless, doubtful, problematic.

title: Sincopation
actors: Adolphe Menjou, Jackie Cooper, Bonita Grenville, George Bancroft
description: Kit, a girl, lives with her father, widower, and the color "mamy" that has instilled her passion for the syncopated music of her people. Raised, she kits she gets engaged to Paul, son of a business partner of her father who, however, appreciates classical music. Johnny meets a kit party: the latter, who shares his musical passion, falls in love with her. The war will take care of removing the now cumbersome Paul.
notes: Light light film imported into Italy in the post -war period and which is based, as per the original title, especially on the apology of "syncopation", of African American music and jazz.

title: Les bonnes femmes
actors: Bernadette Lafont, Clotilde Joano, Stéphane Audran, Lucile Saint-Simon
description: Four young salespeople work with half-closed eyes and looking at their dreams. One would like to become a singer, another doesn't know whether to accept a marriage proposal; the third lives for the day and easily becomes attached to men, the last naively relies on a boyfriend who seems sincere, but who ...
notes: An emotional analysis on the female citizen world. The touch is delicate, the formal intuitions of the young Chabrol are good.

title: Public Enemies
actors: Eric Roberts, Theresa Russell, Alyssa Milano, Chip Heller, Richard Eden
description: They have been living in hiding for a long time, occasionally making shots that allow them to live well ... until the next crime. They are members of the Baker family, very experienced in escaping FBI searches. Now the Bakers have decided to take the big shot by kidnapping the son of the richest man in Illinois. But they did not take into account the fact that aiming so high would have meant arousing the ire of the cops.
notes: Film shot away with a couple of protagonists in search of charisma. Lester conducts without style.

title: The Challenge
actors: Scott Glenn, Toshiro Mifune, Shoge Shimada, Donna Kei Benz, Calvin Young
description: Two Japanese brothers are fighting each other to the death because each claims possession of the family's sacred swords, which belonged to their ancestor, a famous samurai. At one point, an American adventurer is involved in their conflict who ...
notes: Frankenheimer has certainly done better. This is one of the anonymous films he directed, with some zest for action, when he was in low luck. Among the writers, director John Sayles.

title: Leave It to Beaver
actors: Christopher McDonald, Janine Turner, Cameron Finley, Erik von Detten
description: Beaver's family is made up of the wise Ward who, besides being an understanding father, is also a friend; then there is June, the perfect wife and mother, and Wally the elder brother, well-liked, athletic and brilliant. But Theodore, known by all by the nickname of Beaver that is beaver, despite being a kid like everyone else and despite trying to keep out of trouble, always ends up in it.
notes: 234 episodes, from 1957 to 1963, the first series; and 105 episodes, from 1983 to 1989, the second: with these television credentials, one of the most beloved American serials, "Leave It to Beaver", lands on the big screen. Beaver tries in every way to win the esteem of a father subjugated by his eldest son Wally. Behind the facade, in short, there is the stress of those children forced to pursue a cumbersome paternal model; and the updates from the series aren't quite as radical as the authors claim. Sociologically incorrect.

title: Photographing Fairies
actors: Frances Barber, Toby Stephens, Philip Davis, Ben Kingsley
description: 1920s, in the English countryside. A photographer, already shocked by the accidental death of his wife during the honeymoon, after having dedicated himself to the photograph of soldiers who died in the war, decides to follow the trail of a mysterious lady who showed him photos of her little girl in the company of a tiny fairy.
notes: The theme is fascinating, suspended between the strong Anglo-Saxon pantheist tradition and the mystical vagaries of the intellectual circles of the time. Too bad the realization is almost embarrassing, undecided between a polite "Ivorian" illustration and sanguine melodramatic starts. Kingsley touches the speck.

title: Kiss Me, Guido
actors: Nick Scotti, Anthony Barrile, Anthony DeSando, Molly Price
description: Frank Zito, pizza chef like the whole family, loves a girl and aspires to become an actor, like his idols, Pacino, De Niro, Pesci and Stallone, whose most famous jokes he repeatedly quotes. The problem is that his girlfriend sleeps with his brother and when Frank finds out he decides to leave home and move to Manhattan to start his acting career. Finding an apartment is a problem everywhere, even in Manhattan and so Frank, educated according to the typical Italian-American sexist culture, starts sharing a house with a gay actor who introduces him to the entertainment world and makes him change his mind about homosexuals.
notes: Between the double and triple senses typical of the comedy of misunderstandings, Vitale unveils a series of low-profile characters and jokes that plunder the repertoire of clichés about Italian Americans and homosexuals.

actors: Samuel L. Jackson, John Heard, Kelly Rowan, Clifton Collins jr., Tony Plana, Karina Arroyave
description: Trevor, a high school teacher in Broolkyn, still believes in the value of his profession. But he must change his mind when he risks being killed inside the school, transformed into a battlefield, where he teaches. Also because there are two sides: a minority that shows they want to study and the majority that is hostile to the world around them.
notes: Kevin Reynolds, fresh from the dampness of the futurist blockbuster "Waterworld", returns to his contemporaries driven by humanitarian intentions, so to speak. An arduous undertaking from a purely cinematic point of view, since getting out of the stereotype is difficult for anyone. To make sense of the operation, however, there is a very talented Sidney Poitier and that is the excellent Samuel L. Jackson.

title: The Pallbearer
actors: David Schwimmer, Gwyneth Paltrow, Michael Rapaport, Toni Collette
description: Fresh out of boarding school, Tom can't find a job worthy of the name, a girlfriend and a way to leave his mother's home in Brooklyn. Until one day he finds himself having to pronounce the funeral oration of a suicidal schoolmate, of which he absolutely cannot remember. And if he asks in church, in front of relatives and friends gathered, climbing on the mirrors so as not to disappoint them.
notes: The twenty minutes of opening are flawless and overwhelming, but the film presented at Cannes in 1996 and titled in the original "The Pallbearer" (which means "the one who carries the coffin"), has nothing to do with "Four weddings and a funeral. "that the Italian title tries to evoke. The director wanted to make a sort of "Laureato" from the 90s (with Hershey in the part that was Anne Bancroft), but precisely in the citation of the model he loses his grit. And the transition from black to pink brings us back to predictable situations.

title: Tri istorii
actors: Sergej Makovetskij, Leonid Kushnir, Renata Litvinova, Jan Daniel, Oleg Tabakov
description: Film in three episodes. In the first, an actor, in an evident catatonic state, goes to an old friend who works as a stoker. He brings with him a trunk in which he carries the body of the neighbor he has just killed and asks his friend to cremate her. In the second Ophelia, a beautiful nurse, decides to vote her life in order to become the person in charge of the secret archives of the hospital, to find out the name of the mother who abandoned her in swaddling clothes and take revenge. The last story sees a little girl poisoning her paralyzed old grandfather, who has now lost all faith in the world.
notes: There is a painful feeling of lucid madness that comes from Muratova's works. Cynical and merciless, "Three Little Murders", set in a severe Odessa, describes a world that has become a circle of hell, inhabited by characters who are no longer able to feel and who can no longer manage their evil of living. All wrapped up in an extraordinary pictorial vision that creates an Arcimboldo-like world.

title: Abre los ojos
actors: Eduardo Noriega, Penélope Cruz, Chete Lera, Fele Martinez
description: He is handsome, attractive, rich, orphaned and never spends two evenings with the same woman. His name is César and nothing seems to happen to him. Instead. In a cell in the psychiatric section of a prison, a man covered by a mask talks with difficulty about the alleged murder that he is accused of and of which he remembers nothing.
notes: The images of the ambitious second film by Alejandro Amenàbar (25 at the time) are mixed with unsettling time jumps and apparently incomprehensible flashbacks. It is impossible to report more, unless we reveal the ambiguous final which, in the parts of Madrid (where he beat "Titanic"!), Has been much discussed.

title: Mat' i syn
actors: Gudrun Geyer, Aleksej Ananishnov
description: In a country town on the edge of the world there are two left: a sick and consumed mother one step away from the end and a son who takes care of her and takes care of her, combs her and lifts her in her arms, taking her out into the open air, leaning her against a tree, laying her down on a bench. The only external signal: the smoke of a locomotive, which the man observes from afar, hoping to reach it. The silence all around is deafening. Nature is hostile. And the inexorable evil. "Is there anyone up there?" the woman agonized as the pain persisted. And his "guardian angel": "No, there is no one".
notes: The Russian Sokurov, one of the most rigorous filmmakers of the Tarkovsky school, for years opposed by censorship, composes an elegy under the sign of death by constructing images like a painter with his paintings (clear the influence of German romanticism and, in particular , by Caspar David Friedrich); and returning the suffered, sometimes atrocious, moods, with alienating optical effects. As delicate as a baby's skin. Cruel as a stab in the back. And sincere "like a tile on the head".

title: Mr. Nice Guy
actors: Jackie Chan, Richard Norton, Gabrielle Fitzpatrick, Miki Lee
description: Jackie is a chef who conducts a television column for an Australian broadcaster. The poor man finds himself at the center of an intricate affair in which two gangs of criminals, who initially fight relentlessly, end up joining forces in an attempt to retrieve a videotape. The disputed recording contains material that a journalist intends to use to publicly report the wrongdoers.
notes: A film where action and comedy marry beautifully and Jackie Chan, Hong Kong movie star and great martial arts tightrope walker, confirms a natural familiarity with comic roles. Of note are the credits, with the discarded stunts of the acrobatic action scenes.

title: Locusts
actors: Kate Capshaw, Ashley Judd, Vince Vaughn, Jeremy Davies
description: Deep Kansas, around 1960. Someone comes: a handsome young man who says he wants to go to California. Remarkable muscles, dry fist, tender look Clay, a drifter with a mysterious past stops at a small town bar. Here he touches the fight because his presence ends up inflaming the soul of a drunk farmhand. She then stops at Delilah's ranch, a widow with many suitors who harass her and to whom the woman does not say no. A sexual tension is immediately established between the two.
notes: Kelley makes his debut with an old-fashioned, warm and murky film with Tennessee Williams atmospheres and with two worlds inside: that of the past and the young and new one of the Sixties, announced by the pop music of the radio. It is the new world that makes it, laboriously and painfully.

title: Hellraiser: Bloodline
actors: Bruce Ramsay, Valentina Vargas, Doug Bradley, Charlotte Chatton
description: In 2127 Philip Marchant, descendant of the creator of the magical and evil cube, is preparing for the final confrontation with Pinehead, the leader of the Supplizianti, inside an orbital station. At this point we go back in time and we are shown the creation of the cube and how it was a cause of misfortune for the Marchant family.
notes: The "Lament Configuration Box", that is the cube born from the imagination of Clive Barker, returns for the fourth time to breathe life into the infernal Supplizianti. But the result is suffocating so much that the director himself, the talented Kevin Yagher, appreciated author of special effects, has well thought of removing his signature from the credits by replacing it with the fictional name of Alan Smithee. In fact, the studio has twisted the original script, turning it into a boring journey through four centuries.

title: Species II
actors: Michael Madsen, Natasha Henstridge, George Dzundza
description: Eve is a clone of Sil, the human part and the biomechanical alien part protagonist of the first episode, manipulated in order to mitigate her alien personality. The danger comes from two of the three crew members of the Excursion that conquered Mars, infected with the same alien organisms that designed Sil. Biologist Baker and Press Lennox must prevent the alien male from creating offspring.
notes: Contrary to what happens for the sequels, this time the result is more flattering than the previous one, by virtue of an irony that makes fun of the United States and its "grandeur" already in the first sequence where the spaceship Excursion is covered by advertising writings. But our heart beats for Eve, not only for the grace of her human forms (thanks to Natasha Henstridge), but even more for the painful role of guinea pig battered by merciless humans.

title: Kull The Conqueror
actors: Kevin Sorbo, Tia Carrere, Thomas Ian Griffith, Litefoot, Roy Brocksmith
description: The brave Kull is a former slave who becomes king of the kingdom of Valusia, winning the affection of the people, the slaves and the beautiful Zareta, slave and fortune teller. But those who aspired to succeed the old king unite against him and do not hesitate to summon the feared and fascinating witch Akivasha from the underworld.
notes: This film curiously fits (fifteen years later) into the groove traced by "Conan the Barbarian" with which it shares creator Robert E. Howard. For lovers of the genre, a dignified film, with a vaguely seductive medieval staging.

title: For Richer or Poorer
actors: Kirstie Alley, Tim Allen, Jay O. Sanders, Michael Lerner
description: Brad is a successful building owner, but he made the mistake of trusting his accountant. His collaborator's tax fraud costs him the attention of tax inspectors who pursue him mercilessly. Brad and his wife find themselves forced to flee New York and find nothing better than hiding in an Amish community, posing as distant cousins ??of the Yoder family.
notes: The film makes a mockery of the emptiness of a life chasing only fame and money; moral and politically correct comedy, however, it leaves some doubts about the sincerity of the message.

title: Tutti a squola
actors: Pippo Franco, Oreste Lionello, Gianfranco D'Angelo, Lino Banfi, Laura Troschel, Isabella Biagini, Bombolo, Jack La Cayenne
description: Professor Pippo Bettini who received an old-fashioned education finds himself teaching at the Edmondo De Amicis institute where P38, drugs and feminist extremism reign. He, fish out of water, happens to be blackmailed by a couple of drug dealers, who threatens to kill the son of a colleague of his. In exchange for peace of mind Pippo is forced to sell drugs among the students of the institute.
notes: Vulgar and indifferent cinematic exploit of the tremendous Bagaglino group.

title: Il pescatore di Posillipo - Piscatore 'e Pusilleco
actors: Giacomo Rondinella, Cristina Grado, Otello Toso, Beniamino Maggio
description: Salvatore is a young and honest fisherman with a pleasant voice. When Commendatore Morelli has the fishermen's boats confiscated to claim a debt, Salvatore, who is unemployed, is hired by a magazine company as a singer. In the meantime, Maria too, harassed by her sister's lover, is forced to abandon her birthplace.
notes: Close relatives of the drama and direct ancestors of the "musicarelli", these films of the fifties now have only (modest) value as historical testimony.

title: Le fils
actors: Yves Montand, Lea Massari, Marcel Bozzuffi, Germaine Delbat
description: Angel, a gangster of Corsican origin, is reached in New York by the news that his mother is seriously ill with the heart. Back in his hometown, which he has been missing for ten years, he feels the old feeling for his ex-girlfriend Maria is reborn. Little by little he discovers that his father's death was not accidental and that a conflict of interest hides behind his disappearance. Meanwhile, two hit men are waiting for the right moment to kill him ...

title: The Land Girls
actors: Catherine McCormack, Rachel Weisz, Anna Friel, Steve Mackintosh
description: Three British girls in 1941 joined the Women's Territorial Army, an organization created to replace the men working on the front in the camps. The girls' lives are intertwined with that of the Lawrences and their son Joe, on a farm in Dorset. The boy begins sexually with Pru and Ag, but falls in love with Stella in return. but war is lurking and upsets dreams and feelings.
notes: The Second World War, the tears and blood shed by the British in those years, are a source of inspiration for British cinema. And David Leland, after portraying the rebellious youth of "Wish You Were Here", returns with this film. Delicate and nostalgic, Leland's work describes the end of that sort of age of innocence and happiness that existed before the war, because the conflict inevitably changed the world, even that of the victors.

title: Double Dragon
actors: Mark Dacascos, Scott Wolf, Robert Patrick, Julia Nickson-Soul, Alyssa Milano
description: The Los Angeles of 2027 destroyed by a tsunami and partially submerged by the waters, is at the mercy of criminal gangs. The most aggressive is that of Koga Shuko, who in order to conquer absolute power must recover part of a medallion, owned by Satori. The latter is the protector of Billy and Jimmy Lee, martial arts champions, the only ones able to counter the project.
notes: From a famous video game James Yukich, a director specializing in video clips, has made an action movie that mixes martial arts with a disaster film. In an apocalyptic landscape shaken by a hostile nature, between agnitions of tragedy and continuous fighting, the eternal struggle between good and evil with a politically correct outline; guess who will win?

title: Darkman II: The Return of Durant
actors: Arnold Vosloo, Kim Delaney, Larry Drake, Renée O'Connor
description: Defeated in the previous adventure, the evil Durant did not understand the lesson and now he tries again. Equipped with sophisticated unconventional weapons, he makes his way to the sound of murders among the underworld to take control of the drug dealing. On his way, however, he still finds Darkman, aka Professor Peyton Westlake, determined to stop him from doing any more damage.
notes: Larry Drake still plays the role of the brutal Durant and this time the scene is all for him. In fact, Raimi's masked hero remains little more than a gnashing puppet without thickness, also because the sweet Frances McDormand is no longer at his side.

title: Campfire Tales
directors: David Semel, Martin Kunert, Matt Cooper
actors: Jimmy Marsden, Amy Smart, Jay R. Ferguson, Jennifer MacDonald
description: To kill time and above all the fear caused by a serial killer called Willy The Hook who is sowing panic in the area, the presumed survivors, to take courage, take turns telling stories which in turn are read in the newspapers or heard by some guy. . And so there is the couple on their honeymoon who, on the desert road to Las Vegas, run into a herd of hungry and angry werewolves. Then it is the turn of Amanda, a girl who is about to turn twelve, intercepted via the Internet by a pedophile and threateningly in danger. Finally he stumbles upon a broken-down motorcyclist who has stopped in the classic "last house on the left" inhabited by a pack shocked by a brutal act of blood that took place in the house a long time ago.
notes: From the parts of "Scream" and "I know what you did" (but the film is dated 1996) and assembled by three directors, the obvious redeems itself in a surprisingly "Kieslowskian" ending. Note the names of Jennifer MacDonald and Jimmy Marsden in the notebook.

title: The Tic Code
actors: Gregory Hines, Christopher George Marquette, Polly Draper, Carol Kane
description: Miles, a little genius of the piano, is afflicted with Tourette's syndrome. The boy lives with his seamstress mother who was abandoned by her husband, a well-known musician, due to Miles' illness who, when he is hit by the crisis, loses control of his body. Abandoned by his father, mocked by his classmates, opposed by the teacher who tries to prevent him from playing with outstretched fingers, Miles finds in Tyrone, a saxophonist who suffers from the same disorder, his reference figure.
notes: Good feelings and good music therefore, for a film that sometimes risks turning into a dangerous molasses. Excellent jazz soundtrack.

title: An Alan Smithee Film
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Whoopi Goldberg, Jackie Chan, Ryan O'Neal, Eric Idle
description: The film tells the story of a blockbuster, entitled "Trio", and starring Sylvester Stallone, Jackie Chan and Whoopi Goldberg, but not loved by its director, who takes it away from the hateful producers five days before its release in 7000 theaters. The reason? He couldn't take his name off because his name was Alan Smithee ... The director ends up in an asylum, the producers try to get the money back, the actors think about the role, the critics get bought with two bucks.
notes: Ramshackle, sometimes even boring, but with some brilliant passages and with a nastiness that affects all of Hollywood, the establishment, but also the fake alternative black directors. Curious that the real director of this film, Arthur Hiller, signed this film as Alan Smithee for contrasts with the production.

title: Savior
actors: Dennis Quaid, Nastassja Kinski, Stellan Skarsgård, Natasa Ninkovic
description: The wife and son of the American Joshua Rose are killed in an attack in a Paris cafe by Islamic terrorists and he retaliates by entering a mosque and making a massacre. Forced to flee, he goes to Montenegro and fights in the Serbian army against the Bosnian Muslims and against the Croats. The encounter with a woman raped by the Bosnians will change his life again and will leave him a child to take care of.
notes: The film, produced by Oliver Stone, is politically incorrect, but it does not leave insensitive, despite easy solutions and questionable cast choices.

title: Captiva Island
actors: Ernest Borgnine, Jesse Zeigler, Amy Bush
description: Jeremy, a shy boy, snatches permission from his authoritative father to spend a Florida vacation alone. Here he meets and makes friends with some elderly gentlemen who, despite their age, have a great desire to have fun. Soon Jeremy also meets Amy, George's 15-year-old niece, the gang's most jokey. It will truly be an unforgettable vacation!

title: Yankee. L'americano
actors: Philippe Leroy, Adolfo Celi, Jacques Herlin, Tomas Torres
description: In a remote area, on the border between Mexico and the United States, robbing and killing dominates the gang of the Great Concho. One day, however, in a village, Yankee arrives, a skilled gunslinger who, sensing the possibility of making money with their bounties, introduces himself to Concho and offers him to get involved. The Concho thinks he is dealing with a madman and, after putting him in the hat, attempts to kill him. Pop-spaghetti-western by Brass, with a vertiginous editing and many inventions. Today, however, it is very dated, and the game on stereotypes in the long run tired.

title: Conversa acabada
actors: Cabral Martins, André Gomes, Manoel de Oliveira, Juliet Berto
description: The film compares two great Portuguese writers of this century, namely Fernando Pessoa and Mario de Sa 'Carneiro, all through their correspondence. Different the path of the two, the first focuses entirely on writing, while the second will die in Paris very young.
notes: Complex but beautiful film by Joao Botelho that reflects on the one hand on the literary tradition of his country (through the portrait of Pessoa) and on the other on the loss of the anthropocentrism typical of the 20th century. In a tasty part the dean of Portuguese cinema Manoel de Oliveira.

title: Petrified Garden
actors: Hanna Schygulla, Jerome Koenig, Samuel Fuller
description: Daniel, who is the director of an art gallery in Paris, lives in Tel Aviv. Here he receives a telegram informing him of a conspicuous inheritance: his distant relatives, dying, have left him an art collection, which also includes a sculpture of the Golem.
notes: Gitai's films are often, and even in this case, opportunities to rethink the theme of cultural roots and to re-analyze existential values.

title: La ville des pirates
actors: Anne Alvaro, Melvil Poupaud, Hugues Quester
description: An impossible love is born between a servant and a child who has committed a murder. Meanwhile, on the island where this dark story unfolds, a mysterious character wanders, probable "alter ego" of the child.
notes: An untold film, because the director himself claims to have assembled it following the suggestions of his daily dreams, without a script project. The result is fascinating but also uncertain. Famous is the shot of a mouth, "from inside", the paradoxical symbol of a film that belongs too much to the "interiority" of its author.

title: Fighting Mad
actors: Peter Fonda, Lynn Lowry, Philip Carey, Scott Glenn
description: A group of speculators decides to seize the lands of some peasants. One of them (Fonda), saddened by the death of a friend of his killed by businessmen, rebels and takes up a bow and arrow. The result is a massacre involving both speculators and other farmers.
notes: Smooth, unscrupulous and complex: on one side the good guys, on the other the bastards. In addition to Corman, producer, there is the hand of the model Charles Bronson. A rather violent film that uses all means to keep the viewer's attention awake. Demme seems to enjoy going over the top and tries to delve into the psychologies of the characters in the precipitate of events.

title: Jimmy the Gent
actors: James Cagney, Bette Davis, Alice White, Allen Jenkins, Philip Reed
description: Jimmy Corrigan, cynical and slimy, by trade tracks lost heiresses. But if he doesn't find them, it doesn't take long to invent them. To impress a woman, he will try to improve his character. Hilarious and very bad comedy directed by a master of adventure cinema, here on vacation from the genre. Unpublished in Italy, it only appeared on TV.

title: A Day of Fury
actors: Dale Robertson, Jock Mahoney, Mara Corday, Carl Benton Reid
description: Even though Jagade saved the sheriff who had to celebrate a wedding on that day, the town is worried about his presence. Judge Mac Lean intervenes and asks the sheriff to expel the gunman from the town. But the sheriff's gratitude prevents him from carrying out the judge's order. A lot of trouble ensues.
notes: Late serial western. Almost a relic.

title: The Defiant Ones
actors: Tony Curtis, Sidney Poitier, Theodore Bikel, Lon Chaney jr.
description: Two convicts manage to escape during a transfer. The first is white, the second is black: they are tied to the wrists by a chain and cannot be separated, despite a very strong rivalry. Gradually the relationship between the fugitives changes.
notes: A classic Kramer-esque film: a blend of melodrama, civic commitment and solid actor direction. Oscar for screenplay and photography.

title: Tidal Wave no Escape
actors: Corbin Bernsen, Julianne Phillps, Gregg Henry
description: Suddenly the coasts of various countries bordering the Pacific Ocean are devastated by immense tidal waves that obviously sow destruction and death. John Ward, a young scientist who has retired to live on the Caliphonia coast, is consulted. Disturbing his hypothesis: the waves would be caused by underground nuclear explosions.
