notes: Terror comes from the sea again this time, obviously with the help of man. Even in this case, however, reality has dangerously surpassed fantasy. And that doesn't speak in favor of the film.

title: Hard Rain
actors: Morgan Freeman, Christian Slater, Minnie Driver, Ed Asner
description: In a remote town in the United States it has been raining for days and the nearby river has already broken its banks. However, new and heavier developments are expected and so two security guards are entrusted with the task of raking up the money from the banks in the area before it becomes waste paper. The rumors run: a gang of robbers wants those damned three million dollars, whatever the cost. Meanwhile, the water rises and the armored van runs aground.
notes: Carpenter's humid and discreetly amoral action movie would become something of a remake of "District 13," but honest Salomon is at the helm and so you swim within fairly conventional perimeters. The news is mostly about the script (Freeman, for example, being the "bad guy"). Curiosity is a sequence reminiscent of the "Titanic" in which Kate Winslet breaks the handcuffs around DiCaprio's wrists with an ax: here the roles are reversed and the weapon of salvation is a gun.

title: The Patriot
actors: L. Q. Jones, Steven Seagal, Gailard Sartain, Camilla Belle, Whitney Yellow Robe
description: On a farm in the mountains of Montana, Floyd Chilsom set up a pro-Nazi militia. Dr. Wesley, an epidemiologist who had worked for the government, is a neighbor of his who preferred to be a medical doctor. When Chilsom and his people, surrounded by the FBI, pretending to surrender, infect the region with a deadly virus stolen from a government laboratory, the doctor must return to his old business to eradicate the epidemic. Surrounded by majestic nature, the character played by Steven Seagal develops an interesting political position: in favor of the American Indians.
notes: Surrounded by majestic nature, the character played by Steven Seagal develops an interesting political position: in favor of the American Indians.

title: Ground Control
actors: Kiefer Sutherland, Kelly McGillis, Kristy Swanson, Robert Sean Leonard, Henry Winkler
description: A routine flight turns into a nightmare for young flight controller Jack Harris because the electronic sensors have gone mad, he will do his best to prevent the plane crash, and the last words of the crashing pilot will also become a nightmare for years to come. Sometime later the control system goes haywire again due to a cold winter, and Jack has to deal with it.
notes: The closed space and the general emergency climate guarantee the spectacularity of the scenes. It is a pity that the situations inside the control tower are more banal than usual and that the interpreters don't seem to believe them all the way through. But a few moments of tension justify the vision.

title: Dream with the Fishes
actors: David Arquette, Brad Hunt, Cathy Moriarty, Kathryn Erbe
description: San Francisco Bay. Terry is jumping off the bridge, declaring himself the recent widower of a beloved wife; then Nick shows up, proposing a deal to the would-be suicide: Terry's watch in exchange for a sweeter death. But that's not really the case: it's Nick who is dying of an incurable disease and Terry is the one pretending.
notes: Twenty-six days of shooting for a directorial debut that at first seems to have the tics of independent New York cinema, but which over the minutes reveals its original aesthetic forms and its non-trivial narrative tricks. Arquette (brother of the more famous Patricia and Rosanna) co-produces and casually masks his semblance of a good boy. Hunt has the right face for the role. And we see again, with pleasure, the Cathy Moriarty of "Raging Bull", a blonde who has painted on her face the inevitability of the registry office.

title: The Players Club
actors: Lisa Raye, Dick Anthony Williams, Judy Ann Elder, Ice Cube
description: Diana is a young black girl who aspires to become a television journalist, but is thwarted by her father who wants to see her in a nice white college. Out of spite, pride and stubbornness, he leaves the house and finds a job in a bad place where they put dollars in bras and panties.
notes: Black cinema in series and "in series". In this case, rapper Ice Cube makes his debut behind the camera. The women of the reputable first feature will learn a lot. A little less spectators (read: déjà vu). Just to remember the following and textual moral: "Make money for it, but don't become its slave." Well said.

title: Truth or Consequences N. M.
actors: Vincent Gallo, Kiefer Sutherland, Mykelti Williamson, Rod Steiger
description: Ray ends up in jail for a crime he didn't commit, and his only desire is to travel to Mexico to live honestly with his girlfriend Addy. But to make his dream come true, he desperately needs money. So when, once free, he is contacted by Curtis, a fellow prisoner who offers him to participate in a coup, he ends up accepting. But things immediately go wrong ...
notes: Story of an impossible redemption, the directorial debut on the big screen (for cable TV he had directed _Last Night_ in 1993) of the son of art Sutherland does not shine in originality. However, you don't yawn, and that's already a lot. Purebred cameo signed Rod Steiger.

title: Annaré
actors: Gigi D'Alessio, Maria Monsé, Loredana Romito, Fabio Testi, Amedeo Goria
description: Gigi D'Alessio, sentimental Neapolitan singer is engaged to Mara, a lady who lives by inheritance and loan sharking, but also flirts with Anna, a young stupid who believes in the tales of the womanizer (Mara would be nothing but an affectionate sister). But Gigi has another serious problem: paying off his father's debts.
notes: Let's clear the field of a misunderstanding: the scream "Gigi D'Alessio is the Neapolitan Di Caprio" is just a clever publicity stunt, given that the protagonist of this insane film remembers from afar Massimo Ranieri at the time of "Canzonissima". The incredible "operetta" does not have the swagger of a skit, Mario Merola is far away and voices and reciting faces (including the journalist Amedeo Goria dubbed in Piedmontese !!) are simply scandalous.

title: Business for Pleasure
actors: Caron Bernstein, Jeroen Krabbe, Joanna Pacula, Gary Stretch
description: Isabel, beautiful, rich, casual, slight economic defect, travels without the possibility of salvation towards financial bankruptcy, searches and finds (finally!) A praisan and wealthy businessman. The duty to be paid to save yourself with elegance, of course, is prostitution, albeit in the kind of luxury. The pleasure that derives from it is the unveiling of intense erotic desires that have always remained unconfessted.
notes: A hoax like this has the deadline not exactly highlighted: it is from '96, the year of the exit - in a cassette and in preview "defined" world - in the deep foreign country, Finland (!); While since November '97 it has been available in the Italic Videoteche complete with Mondace's shrimp: "A film by Zalman King". The forgetable author of "nine and a half weeks" and of another half a dozen softcore clones, on the other hand, produces and signing screenplay and subject. For those who manage to endure it, "The best erotic film of the year" (word of "penthouse").

title: Dead Men Walk
actors: George Zucco, Mary Carlisle, Nedrick Young, Dwight Frye
description: Between the two Clayton brothers there has never been good blood also because one is an esteemed doctor while the other is a perverse man dedicated to studies and practices of black magic. One day the first, exasperated by the wickedness of the second, gets rid of it by killing him. But when he goes to his study with the intent of destroying his manuscripts and his books, he sees with terror the ghost of his brother rises before him and reveals to him that he is a vampire. C-series horror, a blast for fans of funny junk.

title: Tormento d'amore
actors: Marta Toren, Massimo Serato, Otello Toso, José Nieto
description: Sara and Pietro meet in Barcelona and immediately a friendship is born between the two that does not struggle to turn into love. The girl would like to reveal to Pietro a previous love affair with Roberto, but she doesn't have the courage to do so. Sara grants a last date to her old love and confides that everything is over between them. It so happens that Pietro also ends up in the room where the meeting takes place.
notes: Classic melodrama of which the critics of the time praised the directing measure, the photography and the rehearsal of the interpreters. Conventional but not unpleasant.

title: Uomini sul fondo
actors: Attori non professionisti
description: During a navy exercise, a submarine hits a cargo ship in the port of La Spezia and sinks. It will take the courage of a sailor and a new technical trick to be able to save the crew.
notes: Film produced by the Navy (De Robertis was official), the film established itself as one of the best wars of the period, due to the absence of rhetoric, tension and semi-documentary style, which seemed to anticipate neoralism.

title: The King's Pirate
actors: Doug McClure, Jill St. John, Guy Stockwell, Mary Ann Mobley
description: The officer of route Brian Fleming, a little to obey the orders of his British Majesty and, above all, for his personal profit, he is about to hunt the pirates of Madagascar, who settled in the stronghold of Diego Suarez. By pretending to be a deserter of an English merchant ship, he manages to penetrate with the help of acrobat thieves in the aggressive lair of pirates commanded by Jessica. After dealing with terrible adventures and having measured himself in deadly duels, he manages to conquer the sympathy of the beautiful Jessica and to deliver the port to the fleet of his British Majesty.
notes: Adventures for children. Remake of "against all the flags" with Eroll Flynn.

title: Paranoiac
actors: Janette Scott, Oliver Reed, Sheila Burrell, Maurice Denham, Alexander Davion
description: Three young people, Eleanor, Simon and Tony, have lost their parents. Out of desperation Tony commits suicide and Eleanor would do the same if a young man didn't save her. The latter claims to be Tony, who ran away from home by believing his own death, but in reality he is an impostor in league with the curator of the inheritance.
notes: Realization that looks for the effect at any cost, but the idea is interesting.

title: The Man in the Iron Mask
actors: Louis Hayward, Joan Bennett, Warren William, Joseph Schildkraut
description: Louis XIII presents the heir to the throne to the people of Paris. Meanwhile, a twin of the Dauphin is born in the queen's room. Reason of state advises the king to make the second heir disappear. Entrusted to D'Artagnan, little Filippo, as the child is called, grows up in the fiefdom that his father gave him. The thing, however, is discovered by the honest minister Colbert, but also by the intriguing Fouquet. When Louis XIV ascends to the throne, he thinks well of having him arrested while D'Artagnan and the other musketeers try to get rid of the other brother.
notes: Whale professionally directs a film based on the famous Dumas novel.

title: Unwed Father
actors: Brian Austin Green, Nicholle Tom, Alan Rachins, Faye Grant
description: Jason is a handsome guy who plays in a band and is the idol of girls. When he meets Melanie, he gets mad at her and manages to win her over. But the girl becomes pregnant after their only intercourse. Jason doesn't want to take any responsibility, his dream is to break into show business and he leaves the girl to her fate. Melanie gives birth anyway, but in a moment of despair she decides to leave the baby in swaddling clothes on the threshold of the young man's house. Who at this point will have to make a radical decision ... Nicholle Tom (Melanie) is a famous television actress in America. The film is sad in every sense.

title: Decision at Sundown
actors: Randolph Scott, John Carroll, Karen Steele, Noah Beery, Valerie French
description: For several years Bart has been hunting Tate, a shady individual who has made his wife lose her mind until she dies of a broken heart. Bart wants to avenge his life partner and does everything to find out where the man is hiding. Quite by chance he learns that the man is hiding in the small town of Sundown and that thanks to his friends he has become a prominent character. There is nothing left for Bart to do but face it ... A cheap, bitter and disenchanted Western, the third in the legendary "Ranown" series.

title: La Marseillaise
actors: Pierre Renoir, Louis Jouvet, Maurice Escande, Aimé Clariond
description: French Revolution: a bricklayer and a customs officer, who escaped a court of nobles, decide to join a group of fellow citizens who, singing what would become the French anthem, are marching towards Paris.
notes: Jean Renoir following the spirit of the Popular Front creates a film in which everyday life collides with history with a capital letter. A newsreel on the 1989 Revolution, according to Truffaut.

title: Zarak
actors: Victor Mature, Michael Wilding, Anita Ekberg, Bernard Miles
description: Zarak, the son of a chieftain in northern India, is whipped by his father and exiled because he is found guilty of having an affair with a woman from the harem. Abandoned by everyone, Zarak leads a group of outlaws who rob passers-by on the street. The raids of the bandits worry the British government who decides to send Major Ingram, who begins a fight without quarter. Fairly anonymous adventure film, directed by Young before the 007 series.

title: L'amore si fa così
actors: Enrico Viarisio, Jacqueline Prévot, Luigi Almirante, Paolo Stoppa
description: The designer Max Dupont is engaged to a pattern maker in a large tailor's shop. To get the vacant post of general manager of the fashion house, where his girlfriend works, he pretends to be an important stylist, Narciso Mimosa. Having obtained the post, he facilitates the career of his beloved and also manages to improve the company's business.
notes: Achille Campanile's good script helps an otherwise fairly obvious film.

title: Whore
actors: Theresa Russell, Antonio Fargas, Benjamin Mouton, Elizabeth Morehead
description: The young prostitute Liz strolls on the sidewalk, looking for customers, in a poor neighborhood inhabited by poor people. He's out of his usual zone, running away from his violent protector, Blake, who collects half of his earnings. Liz is terrified, because she knows he is looking for her to punish her harshly, so as soon as she spots her red car, she hides. Finally, safely, he begins to lure customers and re-enact his story.
notes: Ken Russell draws from David Hines' play a film not up to par with his best. Theresa Russell remains a very good and supporting actors at her height. Pornstar Ginger Lyn is a stabbed prostitute.

title: Cran d'arrêt
actors: Bruno Cremer, Renaud Verley, Marianne Comtell, Raffaella Carrà
description: After spending a night of love with Alberta, a girl approached on the street, Davide - a young Milanese from a good family - is determined to take his leave. However, she tries in every way to persuade him not to leave her alone, because she was chased by a photographer for whom she had posed for sado-maso shots, which she had stolen. The following day, in a suburban meadow, Alberta is actually found dead, even if everything suggests that it was a suicide. Seized by remorse for not having helped her, Davide turns to alcohol. The doctor who is treating him will make some discoveries intended to reopen the case.
notes: The film is based on Private Venus, a detective novel by Giorgio Scerbanenco. Too bad that Yves Boisset's direction trivializes the subject. Excellent Bruno Cremer in the role of the investigating doctor.

title: Legend of the Hell House
actors: Pamela Franklin, Roddy McDowall, Clive Revill, Gayle Hunnicutt
description: A villa on the outskirts of the city called Inferno House is haunted by the spirit of Emmery Belasco, a devilish, perverted and suicidal being. Two attempts to disinfect it have already had disastrous results and now it is the turn of Doctor Barret who is accompanied by his wife and two mediums: Fisher, a man already expert in these enterprises and Florence Tanner. But conflicts immediately arise between the two and the doctor: the former are convinced that spirits exist, while the latter is decidedly skeptical. But he will have plenty of time to change his mind ...
notes: Typical seventies horror based on the novel "Hell House" by Richard Matheson, with considerable suspense.

title: Car Wash
actors: Richard Pryor, Franklin Ayaje, Sully Boyar
description: People who go, people who come. Anything can happen to a gas station. And this is demonstrated by this film in which a series of more or less comic misadventures, more or less brilliant, happen one after the other. Almost normal or completely exceptional situations that are told without major script concerns.
notes: Which, moreover, is one of the main limitations of this film. Clever, very attentive to the composition of the probable black audience, Richard Pryor and screenwriter Joel Schumacher pack a film very quickly and it shows. To accompany the scenes at least of discreet soul music.

title: 8 Heads in a Duffel Bag
actors: Joe Pesci, Andy Comeau, Dyan Cannon, Kristy Swanson, Todd Louiso
description: Tommy all his life worked in the service of underworld gangs and never had the strength to rebel. This time he has to carry the severed heads of eight victims in a bag to prove that the sentences have been carried out. Charlie, a young student leaving for Mexico with his girlfriend and future in-laws, has the same scholarship; and of course, the two men swap suitcases at the airport.
notes: Typical comedy of misunderstandings, without any new found, but also without excessive lapses in tone. Two appearances above all: Joe Pesci, as usual intense and likeable, and Dyan Cannon, a sixty year old lift who shows with great irony the amazing effects of plastic surgery. A few heartfelt laughter and a nice timeless atmosphere.

title: Sliding Doors
actors: Gwyneth Paltrow, John Lynch, John Hannah, Jeanne Tripplehorn
description: Classic ugly quarter of an hour for Helen: arriving late, she is fired on the spot; back home, she catches her man in bed with someone else. Bad day for Helen: kicked from work on suspicion of stealing a set of vodka bottles, she goes down the subway and finally falls home: her man is in the shower, while her lover has recently left. ..
notes: Two films for the price of one, two parallel stories with the same characters, two path hypotheses to underline that life is strange, hanging by a thread, cadenced (as the title suggests) by the number of turns of the "sliding doors" never equal. . A Kieslwoskian game for popular palates.

title: Wild Things
actors: Matt Dillon, Neve Campbell, Denise Richards, Kevin Bacon, Theresa Russell
description: A handsome young teacher is brazenly circled by a pupil daughter of an old mistress. After a home approach, the girl denounces him as the perpetrator of attempted violence; and another young woman also joins the prosecution. The story goes on to show that everyone has something to hide.
notes: McNaughton faces a complex plot beyond belief, having fun producing continuous twists that displace the viewer, to the point of making the story unreal, making fun of the subtleties of the script that are so fashionable. What interests him is instead to describe the various perversions that push the protagonists to lie and to plot: and a turbid scene of threesomes is in fact the fundamental (but not the decisive) passage of the film. The quartet of actors is excellent.

title: Viola
actors: Stefania Rocca, Stefano Rota, Rossana Mortara, Rolando Ravello
description: Marta works for a Milanese company, has just returned from a love affair that ended badly, lives with the dog Oliver and an increasingly pronounced rejection of what surrounds her. During a particularly anxious night, she dives into the electronic universe of her computer by choosing the code name Viol @. A man who calls himself Mittler (after the romantic hero protagonist of Goethe's "Elective Affinities") answers her: the voice is that of a mature man, sure of himself, who immediately imposes extreme conditions and hard games.
notes: The first Italian film that dares to surf the Internet chooses the "sex" segment. A courageous debut, with an elegant staging, and with a very generous Stefania Rocca. But everything else is us @.

title: Men with Guns
actors: Federico Luppi, Damian Delgado Domingo, Dan Rivera Gonzales
description: Doctor Fuentes is a Latin American of impeccable Spanish origin, a well-to-do bourgeois, who one day almost by chance sets out in search of his former students, young doctors he has trained and who have gone to work in the Indian villages. One by one, he chases their tracks and, moving into rural areas and up into the mountains, he discovers that, one by one, they are dead, murdered by the military and the government.
notes: Sayles demonstrates an increasingly rare militant rigor, strength and suffering; makes a film that is a general indictment (this is why the country is not identified), a gesture against guilty ignorance (of Fuentes and of all of us), an act of painful humanity.

title: Dr. Dolittle
actors: Eddie Murphy, Ossie Davis, Oliver Platt, Peter Boyle, Richard Schiff
description: Doctor Dolittle lives in San Francisco, has a nice house, a wife and two girls. Due to a blow reported in an accident, the infantile propensity to communicate with every fauna species reappears in him. Pigs, mice, tigers, birds will queue in his waiting room.
notes: If the '67 musical (Richard Fleischer's "The Fabulous Doctor Dolittle") rested on the circus atmosphere of Victorian England and on a Rex Harrison returning from "My Fair Lady", the odd remake focuses on the verve of Eddie Murphy and on '90s style stress anxiety and marginalization. But despite the brevity the film is boring, appearing as a tired trailer of itself, which never manages to unfold into film. Pitiful veil, then on the Italian dubbing composed of dialect voices. Parish.

title: Moebius
actors: Guillermo Angelelli, Roberto Carnaghi, Annabella Levy, Jorge Petraglia
description: A young surveyor is called by the authorities of the Buenos Aires subway to try to unravel an incredible mystery: train 86, carrying about thirty people, has disappeared, vanished in over two hundred kilometers of line. The research led him to the studies carried out by an old university teacher of his; and a strange hypothesis of his that has to do with the theory of the Moebius strip.
notes: The curious work is the result of the first collaboration between teachers and students of the Film School of the Argentine capital: it has the defect of being a little didactic and naive, but it has a rhythm that fascinates; and it is a metaphor, among other things, of the drama of the disappeared.

title: Dio c'è (il film anche)
actors: Riccardo Rossi, Chiara Noschese, Wanna Marchi, Maurizio Santilli, Daniele Formica
description: Emilio is one of those young men who should work, but can't and (maybe ...) don't want to. He lives with his future wife, Chiara and with a whimsical almost mother-in-law who spends time in front of the television. In the usual Rome of our days, he spends his time dreaming of making a change in his life, perhaps with the clerk of the bookshop under his house.
notes: Constructed as a long flashback, the little film swerves all over the place: it is not a comedy, but not even a glimpse of the "burnt" youth of the Nineties; it starts with "theological" ambitions and ends up not even resembling a photocopy of Father Brown. A chore that even on TV would create disturbances. Boredom at will and a "morettismo" of series Z due to the actor Riccardo Rossi.

title: Trial & Error
actors: Jeff Daniels, Charlize Theron, Michael Richards, Jessica Steen
description: Charles Tuttle is a lawyer on the eve of the wedding who is sent to a small town to pursue a lawsuit that seems easy to solve. It happens, however, that the man gets drunk the night before the hearing because of an actor friend and an unclaimed "bachelor party". On the morning of the trial Charles is shattered and his part is "played" by his drinking partner.
notes: Do not listen to the Italian "translation" of the original title "Trial & Error": it is just a clever ploy to make you believe that the terrible comedy in question has something to do with "Scemo & + scemo", a film from '94 that turned out to be sanely demented thanks to the rhythms imposed by the Farrely brothers (script and direction) and the irrepressible verve of Jim Carrey. If it weren't for Charlize Theron who, at some point, intervenes in the story, it would be the case to get up and leave after ten minutes. As tasteless as a plate of pasta eaten in the barracks.

title: P. S. I Luv U
actors: Connie Sellecca, Greg Evigan, Jayne Frazer, Anthony Hamilton
description: Two sympathetic and messy private detectives find themselves together, despite themselves, facing dangerous investigations under the sun and palm trees of Palm Spring. Pursuits and shootings make the already hot atmosphere of the place even more torrid. Our heroes are doing well anyway.
notes: With the star of the teenagers Greg Evigan also passed behind the camera and the specialist in television fiction Connie Sellecca, diva of the series "Hotel" and protagonist of many films for television. The film is a pilot of a successful television series in the United States, but quite unknown to us.

title: Jack's Wife - Hungry Wives - Season of Witch
actors: Jan White, Ray Laine, Anne Muffly
description: A housewife would like to kill her husband. To do this, he resorts to the practices of witchcraft, which he does not practice sufficiently. Eventually he will no longer be able to distinguish between dream and reality ...
notes: Unfortunate and curious film by Romero, four years after "The night of the living dead". Suggestions to Patricia Highsmith, a narrative imploded in an attempt at European art films.

title: To Brave Alaska
actors: Winston Rekert, Alyssa Milano, Cameron Bancroft, Paul Dignard
description: Denise and Roger dream of a bright future and a life of comfort, but also of risky adventures. The right opportunity arises when an entrepreneur, named Wylie Bennett, offers them a business as dangerous as, he says, profitable: to track down an old mine within which an inexhaustible vein of gold is hidden. The two get to work immediately, but, as expected, the matter is not without risks due both to the difficult environmental conditions in which the two find themselves operating, but above all from the ruthless hunting of which, at a certain point, they are made. object by some mysterious individuals determined for everything.

title: Knock Off
actors: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Rob Schneider, Lela Rochon, Michael Wong
description: From Moscow a ruthless terrorist group swoops into Hong Kong and is ready to blackmail the world with microbombs inserted into dolls and jeans buttons. There is, of course, the FBI, under the guise of a partner in a counterfeiter of Western products and a beautiful black woman who passes herself off as a finance steward.
notes: Okay, Tsui Hark is one of the most important living filmmakers, he launched a whole generation of masters, he gave away masterpieces like "Once upon a time in China" and "The blade", but this film is just modest. You save a couple of spectacular sequences directed with the skill that everyone knows.

title: Tarzan and the Lost City
actors: Casper Van Dien, Jane March, Steven Waddington, Winston Ntshona
description: Tarzan now integrated into English civilization and assumed the title of Lord Greystoke, is about to celebrate his wedding with Jane. But his tranquility is disturbed by a terrifying vision: the destruction of his home in the jungle. The Ape Man decides to leave the city to return home to fight a group of mercenaries ready to plunder the legendary city of Opar.
notes: In the role of the ape-man, the young Casper Van Dien, made famous by a TV series and, in the cinema, by the lead role in "Starship Troopers". The inevitable bland touch of ecology and the insistent use of computerized effects are the sign that not even Tarzan is able to escape the obligations of "politically correct".

title: Paulie
actors: Hallie Kate Eisenberg, Gena Rowlands, Tony Shalhoub, Cheech Marin
description: Misha Vilyenkov (Tony Shalhoub) works in an animal testing laboratory. Here he runs into a parrot who really talks (and not "parrot") named Paulie, imprisoned in a cage, with whom he befriends and tells him his troubled story. In fact, Paulie reveals that he misses his mistress Marie, a stuttering girl, from whom he had been taken many years before and who he had tried to find, but almost always ended up in the wrong hands. However, Misha is so moved by his misadventures that he decides to free him and help him reunite with Marie.
notes: "Paulie" is much less shrewd, disillusioned and intelligent than "Babe": despite the skill of the 14 parrots employed, it is all built on the side of men with the times of the edifying fable.

title: Armageddon
actors: Bruce Willis, Liv Tyler, Ben Affleck, Billy Bob Thornton, Will Patton
description: An asteroid the size of the state of Texas is heading towards Earth at the speed of 22,000 miles per hour. NASA director Dan Truman has no choice: he must set up and send a crew into space to try to thwart the threat. The mission is entrusted to Harry S. Stamper, who together with his men must land on the asteroid, pierce its surface and place a nuclear bomb.
notes: A bad film, not so much for its cinematic inconsistency and total lack of irony, but because it sums up the philosophy of the latest blockbusters: accumulation of action scenes and that's it. Result: boredom.

title: L'albero delle pere
actors: Valeria Golino, Sergio Rubini, Stefano Dionisi, Niccolò Senni, Francesca Di Giovanni
description: Fourteen-year-old Siddhartha lives with sweet, vague and elusive mother Silvia in Rome. She does not work, but makes an effort to cultivate elusive relationships. Her father Massimo, from whom Silvia is separated, is a kind of experimental director who is making a documentary about himself. Silvia also lived with Roberto from whom she had Domitilla. The little girl rummaging in her mother's bag pricks herself with an infected syringe and the drama begins for Siddhartha.
notes: Ambitious film played on a series of characters who fidgeting in the midst of a thousand existential metaphors inevitably end up appearing bogus.

title: Hansel e Gretel
actors: Lucia Prato, Lisa Linsky, Renzo Robertazzi, George Greenwoog
description: Two little brothers, like the characters in the fairy tale that gives the film its title, got lost in the metropolitan jungle. Instead of in the witch's pot they end up in the clutches of an evil pedophile. Contrary to what happens in the fairy tale, the two children succumb. Once killed, however, they come back to life to take revenge.
notes: Self-sufficient product of very vile coinage with interpreters far below the average. The direction certainly does not help a story that would have deserved more vigor and more blood. Too bad because showing the horror side of fairy tales in some cases has produced interesting results.

title: Soft Air - Aria compressa
actors: Massimo Franchi, Manuel Scorcia, Alessandro Mistichelli, Johnny Messana
description: A group of friends, overcome by boredom and eager to have fun in a different way than usual, participate in a Sunday war game. All goes well until they discover that the opposing team is using real weapons. Thus begins for them a struggle for survival that will lead them to discover unknown sides of their personality.
notes: For this "A quiet weekend of fear" at the Castelli Romani, involuntarily comical, a veil of silence should be spread. The much-maligned crime film of the 1970s was at least made by professionals who had a dignified sense of action and characters worthy of the name. Direction and editing that ignore the sense of words as synthesis and rhythm, an unlikely story, a screenplay that looks like a Bignamino on stupidity and good actors for the Christmas performance of an amateur drama mistreat the viewer for almost ninety minutes.

title: Une chance sur deux
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Alain Delon, Vanessa Paradis, Eric Defosse
description: Twenty-year-old Alice has never had a father, her mother died recently and left her a cassette in which he reveals the truth: twenty years earlier, she had loved two men and one of them had made her pregnant, but she never knew who the "culprit" was ...
notes: After 28 years, the couple of friends-enemies Delon-Belmondo are reformed, in their fifth film, this time directed by Leconte. The operation, however, made no effort to go beyond the presence of the stars, aided by the (at the time) star of the transalpine teen-agers Vanessa Paradis, now Mrs Depp. The only note of some importance is the affectionate quote by _Borsalino_ evoked by the hint of the soundtrack.

title: Lethal Weapon 4
actors: Mel Gibson, Danny Glover, Rene Russo, Joe Pesci, Jet Li, Chris Rock
description: A freighter filled with Chinese crammed like beasts in the hold of a ship gives Murtaugh the opportunity to free the slaves that the Chinese mafia smuggled into the United States. Agent Riggs, who is about to become a father, helps him in his business.
notes: As the launch slogan says: "The team is complete". In fact, you don't change. Or almost: since 1987 (year of the first "Lethal Weapon"), the only difference is the greater space given to almost sit-com characters. The only flagship is the great Jet Li (Li Lin Jie), Hong Kong actor five times Wu Shu champion who eats the "lethal weapon" and his partner in one bite.

title: Little City
actors: Jon Bon Jovi, Penelope Ann Miller, Annabella Sciorra
description: Former alcoholic Kevin works in a bar and has a hobby: women. Adam is a taxi driver, he is engaged to Nina, but he still has Kate in his head and to relax he paints unwatchable pictures. Rebecca is beautiful, she is Kevin's counter mate, she is single and desperately looking for a man. Anne is a lesbian visual arts teacher and has a congenital vice, using young women and dumping them when love comes.
notes: First work full of verve and references to sophisticated comedy. Excellent rocker Jon Bon Jovi as an actor, while Annabella Sciorra is confirmed as the best "Italian" actress after Magnani.

title: Switchback
actors: Dennis Quaid, Danny Glover, Jared Leto, Ian Nelson, Brent Hinkley
description: Frank is in Texas investigating the case of a dangerous multiple homicide that terrifies all citizens. Investigations, which at first seem easier than expected, soon turn into a complex intrigue that requires extraordinary skills.
notes: Quaid is good, but the glory days of "The Big Easy" are far away. Relentless routine even for the inhabitants of the small village where much of the action takes place: types and characters have already been seen many more times, and trivia is just around the corner.

title: Breaking Up
actors: Salma Hayek, Russell Crowe, Abraham Alvarez
description: Advertising photographer Steve and Monica, elementary school teacher, are a couple committed to understanding if the word love still has a meaning today. Between constant abandonment, quarrels and reconciliations and marriages sent to the ground, the two, with the intervention of a priest, understand that love is something difficult to define completely.
notes: The thesis is demonstrated with grueling repetition compulsion by the two characters (Crowe and Salma Hayek) who do their best to keep afloat a script that has rarely treasured illustrious precedents (Cassavetes and Allen).

title: Gunfight at Comanche Creek
actors: Audie Murphy, Ben Cooper, Colleen Miller, Jan Merlin
description: The Comanche Creek Sheriff is in league with a band of ferocious bandits. A federal agent pretends to be an outlaw and gets arrested for vanquishing the gang while a colleague of his keeps an eye on him from afar. Unfortunately, however, the latter is killed.
notes: Although it has no particular attractions, the film can be seen as a good genre product.

title: Delitto a Posillipo - Londra chiama Napoli
actors: Pupetta Maresca, Giancarlo Del Duca, Franco Ressel, Dina De Santis
description: Roberto, Pupetta's husband, to supplement his salary, becomes the administrator of Liz's night club, of which he becomes the lover. When Liz is killed by her old partner, Pupetta is accused of the crime. Convinced that Roberto was the one to kill her rival, she does not excuse herself and is condemned. Roberto though ...
notes: Bad drama. The curiosity is that Pupetta Maresca, at the center of a famous crime story (masterfully told in a book by Hans Magnus Enzensberger), plays a role that remotely recalls her true story.

title: Witness to Murder
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, George Sanders, Gary Merrill, Jesse White
description: Cheryl accidentally witnesses, one night, from the window of her house, a tragic scene: in the apartment opposite her a man strangles a woman. Cheryl calls the police and Lt. Mathews and a sergeant rush in. The two enter the apartment, but, to their surprise, they find no trace of murder.
notes: Noir of series B. but with a good suspense and a charming and good Stanwyck.

title: Prince of Foxes
actors: Tyrone Power, Orson Welles, Wanda Hendrix, Everett Sloane
description: Cesare Borgia sends Andrea Orsini, one of his most trusted men, to Ferrara to negotiate the marriage of his widowed sister Lucrezia with Duke Alfonso d'Este. The union between the two will open the way to Padua and Venice to Valentino's troops. The mission was successful and Andrea was appointed Este ambassador of Città del Monte. However, according to the instructions received from Cesare Borgia, Andrea should cause the death of the governor. The beautiful photography is by Leon Shamroy, the direction of King is a little tarnished, and then there is Orson Welle sche fa Cesare Borgia ...

title: Sfrattato cerca casa equo canone
actors: Pippo Franco, Anna Mazzamauro, Gigi Reder, Oreste Lionello, Marisa Merlini, Bombolo
description: Among the many Italian-style hoaxes, at the beginning of the Eighties there was also the law on fair rent, duly disregarded from the very moment of its promulgation. Starting from this idea, and with a title based on the classified ads of the newspapers, Pingitore & C. bases a farce on the character of a cassintegrato, deprived of accommodation, who is reduced to living with his family in some small garbage houses.
notes: To the historical group of "Bagaglino" are added some aficionados of Fantozzi's films (Reder, Mazzamauro) and the result does not improve. Too bad for a really witty actress with a glorious past like Merlini.

title: Drum Beat
actors: Alan Ladd, Audrey Dalton, Robert Keithk, Charles Bronson
description: The young but experienced Johnny MacKay is entrusted with a difficult negotiation with a rebellious Indian tribe. On the diligence that takes him to the West, he deepens his knowledge of Nancy, with whom he falls in love. A renegade white, who has put himself at the head of a gang of Indian raiders, makes it difficult to negotiate and Johnny even risks dying. Then, finally, he comes face to face with the rebel leader ...
notes: After "The Indian Lover", another Daves film to critically tackle the problem of the natives. Breathtaking direction, as always, and an almost melancholy pathos.

title: Jacquot de Nantes
actors: Philippe Maron, Edouard Joubeaud, Laurent Monnier, Brigitte de Villepoix
description: Nantes, 1930s. Despite the Nazi occupation, Jacquot has an adventurous and happy childhood: forced by his father to study mechanics, he dreams of dedicating himself to cinema and after the war he manages to go to Paris, where his desire finally becomes reality.
notes: Touched homage to Jacques Demy, who passed away a few years earlier, by his wife who alternates black and white with color. The director now appears aged in the final shot.

title: Dead Innocent
actors: Geneviève Bujold, Nancy Beatty, Graham Greene, Lynne Adams
description: Suzanne St. Laurent, a successful lawyer, is separated from her husband and lives with her daughter Nicole. The routine of her busy life is abruptly interrupted by a dramatic event: returning home she discovers that the babysitter has been killed and her daughter kidnapped. As she tries to call the police, a hypnotic voice, spread through the walls of the house, blocks her. The person holding her baby captive controls Suzanne through the eyes of wireless cameras placed throughout the apartment. The diabolical pact that the voice imposes on her is that Suzanne will have to kill herself at a set time. Will Suzanne be able to avoid a bad end and find her daughter again?

title: Donor
actors: Jack Scalia, Melissa Gilbert, Pernell Roberts, Wendy Hughes
description: A very renowned hospital, a murder case involving a doctor from the hospital. A colleague of the victim discovers that several mistakes are made in the hospital in treating patients and suspects that in some wards genetic experiments are being carried out using human guinea pigs. Perhaps the murdered doctor had understood everything, but now she too knows too many things to not enter the crosshairs of the mysterious killer in a white coat ...
notes: Star of some television productions Jack Scalia seems to have no cinematic ambitions. Better for us that we only have to syrup it on the small screen.

title: Murder in New Hampshire
actors: Helen Hunt, Chad Allen
description: A young teacher, married but dissatisfied with family life, seduces one of her fifteen-year-old students. Since the boy is really infatuated, she convinces him to kill her husband, which happens regularly. Arrested, the teenager is accused of first degree murder and the woman discharges all the blame on him by claiming to have been the victim of his morbid attentions ...

title: Runaway Home
actors: Talia Shire, Paul Mark Gosselaar, Gina Philips
description: Holly can't stand the strict and strict rules imposed on her by her mother, an anxious woman who is extremely protective of her daughter. Exasperated by this attitude, she runs away from home with Chris, the boy she lost her mind for. The two arrive in Los Angeles where they collide with the harsh realities of everyday life. Chris also risks losing his life and only at that moment Holly realizes that her mother has always acted for her good ...

title: Doktor Crippen lebt
actors: Peter Van Eyck, Elisabeth Müller, Fritz Tillman, Inge Meysel
description: In London, Dr. Crippen is sentenced to death for the murder of two well-known scholars, the Blanchards, who have discovered the antidote to a poison. Before being executed, the condemned man confesses that he is not the real Crippen: he, under a false name, works to get hold of the dossier that contains the precious formula. German detective series B without great attractions.

title: 7 cadaveri per Scotland Yard
actors: Paul Naschy, Patricia Loran, Renzo Marignano, Orchidea De Santis
description: Five murders of young women are committed in London and Commissioner Henry Campbell suspects that former trapeze artist Peter is responsible. Although innocent, he takes refuge in the house of a friend, Katie. Convinced of his guilt, the woman tries to hand him over to the police and calls three boys who fail. Meanwhile, the number of murdered women rises to seven ...
notes: Typical seventies film halfway between thriller and detective. Unfortunately, there is an excessive complacency over Grand Guignolesque effects. Music by Piero Piccioni.

title: La chiave
actors: Stefania Sandrelli, Frank Finlay, Maria Grazia Bon, Franco Branciaroli
description: Venice, the eve of the declaration of the Second World War. An elderly English professor, director of the art biennial is married to Teresa. Both are looking for novelties in their sexual relationship. One day the husband independently leaves the key to the floor of her study that opens the drawer in which she keeps the diary hidden where she tells her most secret erotic fantasies. Teresa finds the key, opens the drawer and begins to read avidly.
notes: The subject is taken away from Tanizaki's beautiful novel. The film raised Brass's quotations, back from the controversy of "I, Caligola" and relaunched Sandrelli in erotic version and created an ephemeral Italian erotic-literary vein. Within which it remains one of the least ugly films.

title: No Name on the Bullet
actors: Audie Murphy, Charles Drake, Joan Evans, Virginia Grey
description: John Grant (Murphy), a killer arrives in a small town in the West and sows panic among ordinary people who have more than one thing to hide. His target, in reality, is an old paralytic judge who, in the past, unjustly condemned a man who now wants to avenge himself thanks to him.
notes: One of the best westerns of the period, ambiguous and complex, adult like Anthony Mann's films.

title: The Las Vegas Story
actors: Jane Russell, Victor Mature, Vincent Price, Hoagy Carmichael, Brad Dexter
description: A singer returns to the city of Las Vegas with her husband and finds a cop with whom she had had a love affair. When his partner becomes involved in a murder, the agent who manages to clear him must intervene, not without having saved his former flame.
notes: A nice rhythm saves this little film. Jane Russell's sex appeal remains intact even today.

title: Fifteen and Pregnant
actors: Kirsten Dunst, David Andrews, Margot Demeter, Karen Trumbo
description: Tina, a fifteen-year-old girl, suffers from the separation of her parents. In an identity crisis, she thinks she finds great love in Ray, a peer of the same age. However, he leaves her after a brief flirtation, but Tina soon realizes that she is pregnant. The news further undermines his parents who react differently. However, Tina decides to keep the baby. Ray, informed in turn, makes Tina believe that he is still in love with her, but in the meantime he does not leave his new girlfriend. Tina, greatly matured by the experience, manages to get her parents back together and carries on the pregnancy.

title: The Gun Hawk
actors: Rory Calhoun, Rod Cameron, Ruta Lee, John Litel
description: Wanted by the sheriff and mortally wounded, the outlaw Madden does not want to die in a bed so he forces a friend, who owes him his life, to fight in a duel with him. Only in this way - he says - will he feel like dying like a real man. The friend though ...
notes: Unusual subject for a twilight and melancholy western.

title: Pickup on South Street
actors: Richard Widmark, Jean Peters, Thelma Ritter, Richard Kiley, Roger Moore (II)
description: Candy, employed in Joy's office, a self-styled lawyer, who is actually part of a gang of spies, is entrusted with the delicate task of delivering a microfilm, containing secret atomic formulas. The girl naturally ignores the contents of the document entrusted to her. Unfortunately for her, the purse with the precious microfilm is stolen from her in the subway by a mugger.
notes: Wonderful cold war detective film (even if in the Italian version the Communists become drug traffickers) which received a highly contested prize at the Venice Film Festival. Nervous and visionary, among the masterpieces of its author, with memorable action scenes.

title: The Yearling
actors: Gregory Peck, Jane Wyman, Forrest Tucker, Claude Jarman
description: A pioneer family lives on a farm in the Florida forests. The only child (the other three died of disease) is very fond of a baby deer who is his only friend. But the animal grows and begins to damage crops. The family decides to shoot him down and the boy gets the thankless task. He will perform it after realizing that the family's survival is at stake and the test will make him a man ready to become a pioneer himself.
notes: Weepy film based on a novel by M.K. Rawlings (more cruel in showing the harshness of an American countryside education). Good feelings, flawless staging, and gorgeous (Oscar-winning) technicolor by Charles Rosher.

title: Double Edge
actors: Robert Urich, Susan Lucci, Virginia Madsen
description: Maggie, an FBI agent, is on the trail of her twin sister Carmen, suspected of killing a famous billionaire for money. Between the two women, identical in appearance but completely opposite in nature, a no holds barred battle is waged that ends only when ...

title: Dark City
actors: Rufus Sewell, William Hurt, Jennifer Connelly, Kiefer Sutherland
description: Every night, at 24 o'clock (but it could be 12 o'clock), while all humans freeze in a kind of forgetful unconsciousness, the city begins to change, buildings rise, fall, move, obliterating roads and opening others . It is the dizzying effect of "tuning", the ability to alter physical reality through the joint effort of many psychic wills, a gift that only "foreigners" possess, sharp, pale and wrapped in Nosferatu overcoats, who manipulate destinies. some men.
notes: More ambitious than "The Crow" and therefore, perhaps, a little more cumbersome, the new film by Alex Proyas is a fascinating noir immersed in fantasy-horror suggestions. A little too many quotes (along with "Nosferatu" and "Metropolis", also "Blade Runner", "Invasion of the body snatchers", "The lady of Shanghai" and many noir), which risk making it elegantly scholastic.

title: 24 7: Twentyfourseven
actors: Bob Hoskins, Danny Nussbaum, James Hooton, Darren O. Campbell
description: Tim finds a comatose bum. He is about to leave, but then realizes that the man is Alan Darcy, so he decides to take him home and as he puts him to bed he finds that he has a diary with him. The writing dates back five years and tells of Alan's attempts to equip the neighborhood with a boxing gym to try to get the boys off the street.
notes: Directed by a young British author, a black and white film reminiscent of Free Cinema, in the homages to "I am a champion", but above all in the frank representation of the proletarian community.

title: Erotique
directors: Lizzie Borden, Monika Treut, Clara Law
actors: Kamala Lopez Dawson, Bryan Cranston, Priscilla Barnes, Camilla Soeberg, Teddy Robin Kwan
description: Los Angeles: Rosie, aspiring actress who dreams of abandoning herself to perverse transgressions to land the Lunario works in a chat line. Tired of telling his fantasies by phone, he decides to live them seriously. Hamburg: two girls looking for adventures are wandering for the city nightclubs, they are looking for a lover for Julia. But at some point, the man finds herself flals jealousy. Hong Kong: Adrian, an Australian of Chinese origin meets Ann an old love of the school's times and to conquer it he must rediscover the ancient Chinese love rites.
notes: In spite of the title, do not even expect a hot shiver from the film, since there is more eroticism in thirty seconds of a martini spot than in novelty minutes. The film is a triptych designed by the producer Brandon Chasey, who in 1994 commissioned three directors (Borden, Treut and Law) a reading of female eroticism, but the result proves to be weak and sometimes borders on the ridiculous.

title: La ballata dei lavavetri
actors: Kim Rossi Stuart, Agata Buzek, Olek Mincer, Eljana Nikolova Popova
description: At the end of the 1980s, a Polish family from Radom landed in Rome waiting to obtain a visa for Canada. At the beginning, all the members of the family work to make ends meet: Janusz, the head of the family washes the windows of the cars at a traffic light together with his brother Zygmunt and Rafal, while Helena, his new partner and daughter Justyna are hired as a maid. But one day Janusz disappears and Pope Woityla appears to Zygmunt, now desperate.
notes: After the appearance of the pontiff, we begin to expect the worst. Which regularly arrives: (metaphorical?) Birds fluttering in the bathroom; a pursuit of the true Pope with consequent and justified arrest; girls who run and stumble and die; the spirit of a girl flying over Castel Sant'Angelo. You understand that the film must have something (that doesn't work: it would like to denounce the inhuman condition of Polish window cleaners, and the audience laughs.

title: Tu ridi
actors: Antonio Albanese, Sabrina Ferilli, Turi Ferro, Lello Arena, Steve Spedicato, Ludovico Caldarera
description: Rome, 1930s. Felice is a former baritone who lives frustrated as an accountant at the Opera House and laughs at night in his sleep without knowing why and above all without remembering the dream that makes him laugh so much. When he finally remembers it ... Sicily today. A twelve-year-old boy is kidnapped and guarded by a jailer in a strange and mountain desert. Right on the top of that mountain, one hundred years earlier, another kidnapping took place.
notes: Over the years, the Taviani cinema has turned into an elegant and mannered exercise: you breathe a tired air and an imagery of auteur television survives. Among the interpreters, a mention for Turi Ferro: eduardianamente essential.

title: L'estate di Davide
actors: Stefano Campi, Patrizia Piccinini, Tony Bertorelli, Semsudin Mujic
description: Davide is an eighteen year old like many others who lives in his brother's house in Turin and who, to scrape together a few lira, goes to wash the cars in a large car wash every Saturday. Behind him he has a disastrous family, a hardly reached maturity, a certain introversion and in front of him the decision to spend the holidays with his uncles in the Polesine. Here Davide lives his initiation rites to life; he knows love and his pains with a local girl and makes a close friendship with a young Bosnian who supports himself by being a bartender and selling drugs. The two rip off the girl's rich lover of a huge amount of drugs that they hope to resell in Puglia, but things never work as they should and Davide will find himself in front of his usual life, but now he is ready to face it.
notes: It is not a comic cinema (of feelings or not), it does not impart moral lessons, it does not trust in epic tones, yet that of Mazzacurati never disappoints. Essential stories that stage ordinary characters in contact with the margin, with the frontier and where the happy ending is never guaranteed, all handled by a safe and fluid cinematographic technique.

title: Hope Floats
actors: Sandra Bullock, Harry Connick jr., Gena Rowlands, Mae Whitman
description: Birdee is a former beauty queen who discovers her husband's betrayal with her best friend during the live broadcast of a talk show. The woman doesn't think twice, and with her daughter and baggage she goes back to her parents' home in Smithville. Days pass between squabbles and family reconciliations, but the sudden death of her mother puts Birdee in front of her responsibilities.
notes: Whitaker confirms his preference for a sentimental comedy that overflows with molasses, even if this time he does not give up spraying a pinch of vitriol on TV and the degeneration of the American dream.

title: I piccoli maestri
actors: Stefano Accorsi, Stefania Montorsi, Marco Paolini, Giorgio Pasotti
description: Autumn 1943: a group of university students leaves for the Asiago plateau to fight against the Nazis. The group is joined by a worker, a sailor, a professor who cultivates an anti-fascist sentiment and a young Alpine non-commissioned officer. At the first round-up the boys realize that war is a serious matter.
notes: The Resistance seen by no one knows who. Certainly not by Luigi Meneghello, author of the beautiful (and distorted) novel from which the film is based. The horribly executed battle sequence in the center of Padua shows that Luchetti will be good at making commercials but he'd better leave the cinema to others. Heavy didactic script by Rulli, Petraglia and Starnone.

title: Serenata a Maria
actors: Maria Fiore, Sergio Bruni, Pietro De Vico, Marisa Belli, Leda Gloria
description: When Stefano Apicella, after completing his studies at the conservatory with the help of an uncle, returns to the town, he finds the creditors who are impounding his relative's boats. Fortunately, a friend of Stefano's, the painter Pasqualino, with a brilliant trick, manages to resolve the situation. In the village Stefano meets Maria, for whom he had a tender feeling in his youth. Suddenly, love still breaks out between the two. The overwhelming protagonist of "Two money of hope" and one of the greatest Neapolitan singers of all time in a conventional film as much as you want, but now almost a document.

title: Wishmaster
actors: Tammy Lauren, Andrew Divoff, Tony Todd, Kane Hodder, Robert Englund
description: A legend tells that during the creation of the world fear and terror were incarnated in a creature called Djin, a demon capable of transforming human beings into the worst forms of life and to fulfill the most hidden desires. Today: in a city port a worker drops a crate and the Djin comes to life again.
notes: Despite the presence of Wes Craven as executive producer, the film has little to do with the master of horror. The visual and narrative references rather make one think of Clive Barker's nightmares: everything works, without great flights, for two thirds of the film, but the ending plunges into an insult to the intelligence of the spectators.

title: L'odore della notte
actors: Valerio Mastandrea, Alessia Fugardi, Giorgio Tirabassi, Francesca D'Aloja
description: A group of robbers from the far outskirts of Rome specializes in assaulting uptown neighborhoods. The boss is Remo, a policeman stationed in Turin, totally identified in his role by having developed an effective criminal technique: he follows his victims on the street by following them in the car, and then having the doors of their home open ...
notes: The film is unbelievable: loosely based on a book that tells a news story, modestly titled _The Nights of the Clockwork Orange_ (with _Heart mad_ instead of Beethoven and a suburban shack instead of the Korova Milk Bar), it is a typical example of involuntary parody.

title: City of Angels
actors: Nicolas Cage, Meg Ryan, Andre Braugher, Colm Feore, Dennis Franz
description: Seth is a restless angel on duty in Los Angeles, where he meets Dr. Maggie Rice, distraught after the death of a patient. Although Seth is there to assist the dying man, he feels drawn to Maggie and works hard to help her overcome her crisis. But he falls in love with her.
notes: New Age & Millennialism: everything contributes to the (re) call to arms of the guardian angels. Hollywood makes its contribution by re-reading one of the cult of European cinephiles, "The sky above Berlin" by Wim Wenders. As in "Ghost", suggestive scenes alternate with falls into the void and ridicule. But the film has its own intangible atmosphere.

title: Scream 2
actors: Jada Pinkett Smith, Neve Campbell, Elise Neal, Liev Schreiber, Courteney Cox
description: Sid to forget the murders that had upset the town of Woodsboro moves to Windsor college. But just when the film "Stab", based on the story of the Woodsboro serial killer, is about to be screened, the murders start again.
notes: Craven and Kevin Williamson create another saraband in which "Scream", "Scream 2" and "Stab" (the film about the film within the film) are mixed in a precise self-referential mechanism. To avoid the usual question about the quality of the sequels, a tasty opportunity for debate even among the students on campus, they decided to favor irony rather than the discourse on gender and perception that gave substance to "Scream", without however giving up the parade. of stars and stars borrowed from television serials.

title: I giardini dell'Eden
actors: Kim Rossi Stuart, Said Taghmaoui, Massimo Ghini, Boris Terral, Lorenzo Cherubini
description: Jeoshua, after having completed his apprenticeship as a carpenter, sets out on a journey around the world. Arriving in Jerusalem, he comes into contact with the arrogance of the rich and that of the Roman invasion and does everything to fight it. Leaving the worldly sphere, he comes into contact with the Essene community in which property and money are abolished and receives their precious teachings. Meanwhile Jochannah, recognizing him as the Messiah who is to come, stimulates him to begin preaching.
notes: Kitsch and rhetoric abound: redundant socio-political updating, a desert from which Lawrence (of Arabia) is expected to emerge, omens, flashbacks and flashbacks in the flashback. Kim Rossi Stuart who combines the blue gaze of Jeffrey Hunter in the "King of kings" with the astonished inexpressiveness of Robert Powell in "Jesus of Nazareth", Ghini who plays Richard Burton in the "Tunic", a touch of Good ("Salomé" ), a memory of Scorsese (the devil in the circle of fire) and lots of television. The holy cards come alive with curls, rags and overacting a la "Jesus Christ Superstar"; Jerusalem looks like the Big Apple; the Gospel winks at the New Age.

title: In Love and War
actors: Sandra Bullock, Chris O'Donnell, Mackenzie Astin, Ingrid Lacey
description: Eighteen year old Ernest Hemingway has enlisted as a volunteer and is fighting on the Italian front during the First World War. Wounded in a war action, he is treated by the 26-year-old nurse Agnes von Kurowsky. A tender feeling is born between the two, which soon turns into an overwhelming love. The writer will recall the episode in his great novel "A Farewell to Arms".
notes: The unbearable heaviness of Art: stiff British "arty" director (Richard Attenborough, who proclaims himself a craftsman but does not shy away from absolute themes) faces a vigorous Great American Writer, in the midst of the Great War, with the mediation of Villard's biography and Nagel inspired by the diaries of nurse Agnes von Kurowsky, with whom the young Hemingway fell in love. From the first soft shot of the trenches, "Amare per semper" has an unbearable illustrative aestheticism. Interpreters don't help: O'Donnell is enthusiastically embarrassing, Bullock is charmingly mannered. Kitsch, coarse and boring.

title: Del perduto amore
actors: Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Rocco Papaleo, Enrico Lo Verso
description: Don Gerardo, parish priest in a small southern town, is fifty years old and goes back to his adolescence. He sees himself as a fourteen-year-old boy again, in the second half of the 1950s, when full of sincere religious enthusiasm, but also overwhelmed by the first sexual disturbances, he is expelled from boarding school for an alleged episode of homosexuality. Back in the country he is increasingly attracted to Liliana, a communist militant.
notes: Here is an average Mr. film like they don't make it anymore and like they used to do it once. Strong, emotionally swollen, with all the requisites in the right place: above all a precise direction that thinks about doing and not overdoing it

title: Godzilla
actors: Matthew Broderick, Jean Reno, Maria Pitillo, Hank Azaria, Kevin Dunn
description: A beast of enormous size, awakened by nuclear tests, heads to the island of Manhattan with the intention of destroying it. A scientist, a reporter, a cameraman and an enigmatic agent of the French secret services take the field. Chirac's nuclear experiments have indeed awakened none other than Godzilla.
notes: Restyling of a 50s myth, _Godzilla_, a giant lizard born from the horrors of Hiroshima in 1954. _Gojira_ was naive, he moved in jerks, but he responded to genuine and pressing fears. Emmerich completely loses this authenticity and makes a boring movie.

title: The Silence of Adultery
actors: Kate Jackson, Art Hindle, Patricia Gage, Kristin Fairlie, Tori McPetrie
description: Dr. Rachel Lindsey lovingly dedicates herself to the rehabilitation of autistic children using hippotherapy. Day after day, he realizes that his marriage is going into crisis: so, when he meets Trey - a man abandoned by his wife and in turn the father of a "difficult" child - he doesn't think twice about joining him ...
notes: Typical television film of the "basic cable TV" Lifetime, specializing in products that, in order to tear a tear, do not stop in front of any handicap, disease or addiction. All shot without flair and (as in this case) made in Canada to save a little.

title: Stéphane - Une femme infidèle
actors: Stéphane Audran, Michel Bouquet, Maurice Ronet, Jean-Marie Arnoux
description: Stephane is married to Charles and cheats on him with Victor. When Charles discovers the affair he kills Victor and makes his body disappear. Some time later the police uncover the crime and interrogate all those who have had to do with the murdered, including Stephane. When the woman finds a picture of Victor in Charles's pocket, she understands everything and does nothing to avoid his arrest.
notes: A first-rate Chabrol, hard and straightforward. Between realism and allegory, a thin film that grows slowly.

title: Betty
actors: Marie Trintignant, Stéphane Audran, Jean-François Garreaud, Yves Lambrecht, Christiane Minazzoli, Pierre Vernier, Nathalie Kousnetzoff
description: Betty, an unrepentant adulteress and alcoholic, is thrown out of her family. He would end up in disarray were it not for Laure, an older woman with philanthropic leanings. Too philanthropic, to the point that Betty ends up turning into a real disaster for the meek Laure.

title: L'accompagnatrice
actors: Richard Bohringer, Elena Sofonova, Romane Bohringer
description: In 1942 Sophie Vasseur, a young unemployed pianist, lives in German-occupied Paris. He has a strained relationship with his mother who is a piano teacher. One day she meets the beautiful and successful singer Irène Brice who hires her as an accompanist on the piano of her concerts.
notes: Loosely based on the novel of the same name by Nina Berberova, the film continues the attempt to analyze minor female characters. Claude Miller, assistant director to François Truffaut, has the defect of having a style that is a little too cold and the film suffers in the end. Elena Sofonova is voiced in the parts sung by Laurence Monteryol.

title: In Old Chicago
actors: Alice Faye, Tyrone Power, Don Ameche, Alice Brady, Andy Devine
description: In 1870 much of what would become one of the American metropolises was still an agglomeration of wooden huts. In the most infamous neighborhood of the city, a young man of Irish descent has become the owner of a large gambling house from which he pulls the strings of other shady deals. However, the young man's brother is determined to change his life and when, from a spark, some shacks catch fire ...
notes: The film belongs by right to the catastrophic genre that was beginning to assert itself in those years. The fire scenes shot by Bruce Humberstone are still striking today. Alice Brady received the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress.

title: Yentl
actors: Barbra Streisand, Mandy Patinkin, Amy Irving, Nehemiah Persoff
description: Yentl is an intelligent and thirsty Jewish girl who lives with her people in a village in eastern Poland in the early 1900s. According to the ancient Jewish traditions, the study is reserved for men, while women are destined for the hearth and children, in a rigid division of tasks that means the exclusive male principle and the female principle of life. But Yentl, supported by her father, an elderly and wise rabbi, rebels against the common rule and studies the Talmud.
notes: Taken from a short story by Isaac B. Singer contained in "Gimpel the idiot", it is a musical strongly desired by Streisand, who keeps it up for almost the entire two and a quarter hours of duration. Oscar to the soundtrack.

title: La battaglia del deserto
actors: Robert Hossein, George Hilton, Frank Wolff, Rick Battaglia, Ivano Staccioli, Evely Stewart
description: A captain and some English soldiers are sent into the desert to place mines on the roads that the German armored troops will travel: but a tank attack decimates the squad and forces the survivors to flee ...
notes: A classic B movie cast for a "war" not even very poor, but completely predictable.

title: The Truman Show
actors: Jim Carrey, Laura Linney, Ed Harris, Noah Emmerich, Natascha McElhone
description: Unbeknownst to him, every second of every day that passes Truman is the star of the longest and most watched documentary soap opera on television. Seaheaven, the town where Truman lives is actually a gigantic sound stage where friends and family are all paid actors playing their part. It all goes on until the day Truman begins to suspect something.
notes: A synthesis of some of the most evocative socio-apocalyptic-post-industrial hypotheses of science fiction cinema and literature (or almost), from Sheckley to Wellman's "The Magic City" to Capra's bitter anti-utopias. Weir and screenwriter Andrew Niccol construct a beautiful and rich apologue, which escapes the traps of rhetoric, transforming déjà-vu into a disturbing mirror of our imagination. A very solid film full of ideas, self-irony, awareness, where Jim Carrey finds the confused embarrassment of James Stewart.

title: The Swan Princess III
description: This time Prince Derek and Princess Odette are grappling with the preparations for the great holiday that is celebrated every year in the kingdom. Whoever wins the obstacle race will receive the chance to be prince for a day as a prize. But for Zelda, a sorceress who remained hidden in her cave for a long time, the celebrations represent instead an opportunity to get hold of the late Rothbart's formula of the Forbidden Arts. Too late, Derek realizes how reckless it was to have kept such dangerous papers.
notes: Third episode (the first is from '94, the second from '97) of the adventures of Derek and Odette. Directed by Richard Rich, for fourteen years one of the key components of the animation department of the Disney studios. For children (and) in the norm.

title: Giro di lune tra terra e mare
actors: Aldo Bufi Landi, Olimpia Carlisi, Tina Femiano, Salvatore Grasso
description: Story of the Gioia fishing family, forced to constantly change house (in the seventies) due to the moon turns of a land devoured by natural bradyseisms and spiritual earthquakes. And the story of a city, Pozzuoli, a place full of antiquity, where - among others - Artema (Christian martyr) lived and died tragically; where the oracles of the Cumaean Sibyl and the matricide of Agrippina by Nero were consummated.
notes: In an extraordinary interlocking development, Gaudino bravely ventures between old and new paths, trying to reveal the mysteries of a decay that overwhelms everything and everyone. Released in the 98/99 season with 25 minutes of cuts compared to the first presentation in Venice '97 and thanks to an impressive collection of international awards. Avant-garde cinema that runs through rough roads but paved with panting fascination. A very modern film that draws energy from ancestral and mysterious worlds, full of forgotten symbols.

title: Sposami papà
actors: Alberto Sordi, Valeria Marini, Franca Faldini, Enrico Bertolino
description: Armando is an almost eighty-year-old Roman engineer with a long and thriving career behind him. Federica is a beautiful thirty year old girl who works as a nurse in the geriatric ward. While he is at Termini Station, Armando is approached by Federica who mistakes him, from afar, for his father. The two end up in the same carriage and later in the same hotel room for a series of misunderstandings that will lead them to make friends.
notes: So bad as to overcome the barrier of sound (not surprisingly the "out of sync" rages) and of light, which, in the "topical" moments, disappears, because sins are always and in any case made in the dark. Unfortunately, Sordi stopped being Deaf in 1977, from the last sequence of "Un borghese piccolo piccolo": struck by his own myth, harnessed in his famous but worn-out tics, impoverished by his pseudo-staging, where the camera is now , just a superstition.

title: Wild Man Blues
actors: Woody Allen, Letty Aronson, Dan Barrett, Greg Cohen, Soon-Yi
description: Woody Allen travels Europe with his group to propose his impure and "rough" New Orleans style jazz and the public can not help but appreciate. His sister and Soon Yi accompany him on this tour. First one day in Paris, then Madrid, Geneva, Venice and many other cities. In Venice the concert is for the destroyed La Fenice. Woody rides a gondola with Soon Yi through a deserted calle and is afraid that the gondolier will cut their throats, fears that tourists will throw cameras at him from the bridges.
notes: Barbara Kopple is a two-time Oscar-winning documentary maker for "Harlan County Usa" and "American Dream" who had the great idea of ??making a documentary about Woody Allen's European tour. The director gives us a beautiful portrait from life and in private of an Allen who is just as he is, in terms of neurosis, tics and Woody jokes of the films.

title: Così ridevano
actors: Enrico Lo Verso, Francesco Giuffrida, Fabrizio Gifuni, Rosaria Danzé
description: Giovanni and Pietro are two Sicilian brothers who emigrated to Turin in the late 1950s in search of that job that was lacking in the South. Giovanni, the elder brother, cultivates an ambitious project, apparently beyond his strength: he illiterate wants his brother Pietro to become an elementary teacher, graduating from the master's.
notes: "Thus they laughed" is a film very far from any suspicion of hagiography, from easy neorealistic quotations, from desires of historical-popular reconciliations. It is a film that starts from known data of the national imagination to force us to rethink them, in the frame of a dried up and circular melodrama. The driving force behind this film, awarded at the Venice Film Festival 1998 with the Golden Lion, is the very lucid bitterness with respect to an irrecoverable past and present, the ability to follow, without giving in to naturalism and rhetoric, a dramatic theorem. Amelio made the most "Scorsesian" film (not in the traced ways, but in the black and implacable soul) ever to come out of our cinema.

title: Conte d'automne
actors: Marie Rivière, Béatrice Romand, Alain Libolt, Didier Sandre, Alexia Portal
description: Magali is a 45-year-old winemaker who feels lonely. This feeling is growing every day since her son and daughter moved to live elsewhere. Unbeknownst to her, one of her friends, Isabelle, is looking for a husband for her by placing an ad in a newspaper. Rosine, her son's girlfriend, also wants to introduce her to her philosophy professor Etienne.
notes: Rohmer told us about the adolescent courtships of summer, the unpredictable coincidences of youth, the amorous deceptions intertwined by different ages. And now he stages the candid cynicism of mature age with great skill.

title: Danielle Steel's Secrets
actors: Christopher Plummer, Linda Purl, Gary Collins, Ben Browder
description: When Mel Wexler, a powerful Hollywood producer, puts together the cast for a new television series called "Manhattan," he is writing a group of people whose lives are more intriguing than those of any fiction. Wexler, although tried by the recent, untimely death of his wife and children, reconnects with Sabina Quarles, star of "Manhattan" and his old flame. In turn, Jane Adams, by accepting a role in the series, sparked a strong reaction in her husband, due to his jealousy. Well-founded jealousy after all since the fake love story on the set between Zack Taylor and Jane Adams will eventually turn into a real feeling.

title: Poltergeist II: The Other Side
actors: JoBeth Williams, Geraldine Fitzgerald, Julian Beck, Will Sampson
description: Freed from the spirits that had "swallowed" her through the cathode ray tube, little Carol Anne this time enters the crosshairs of the evil Kane, a kind of zombie who has put himself at the head of a bloodthirsty sect, intent on kidnapping her for her shady rites. To neutralize it, however, the dwarf medium of the previous film is not enough, but an Indian shaman is also needed.
notes: Shot in the wake of the prototype's unpredictable success, this sequel lacks the direction of Hooper and the production of Spielberg. Julian Beck, founder of the Living Theater, is in his last film appearance.

title: The Yellow Mountain
actors: Lex Barker, Mala Powers
description: Andy Martin, recently arrived in the town of Goldfield, and Pete Menlo, owner of a saloon and a mine, are friends despite previous disagreements. They both fall in love with Silvana.
notes: Western without infamy and without praise as they did in the fifties, when the genre was still in vogue and all directors, sooner or later, tried their hand at it.

title: Altered States
actors: William Hurt, Blair Brown, Bob Balaban, Charles Haid, Drew Barrymore
description: Eddie, a young scientist, helped by two colleagues studies the results of a test which some students have been subjected to. They immersed themselves alone and in the dark in a tub full of salt water until they lost consciousness. Their hope is to recover sensations belonging to the beginnings of human life; Eddie feels the need to experiment on himself with the test.
notes: The film, based on a Paddy Chayefsky novel, was started by Arthur Penn and finished by Ken Russell. In the final version, special effects are rampant and some visionary surges redeem the didactic assumption.

title: Il sole negli occhi
actors: Irene Galter, Gabriele Ferzetti, Paolo Stoppa, Pina Bottin
description: Celestina, daughter of peasants, from the moment she was orphaned she moved to Rome to work as a housekeeper by the hour. Very young, ignorant and above all naive, she finds herself lost in the big city and her discomfort increases when her two brothers, whom she asked for help, decide to leave for Australia. But Celestina does not give up, she gets engaged to the plumber Fernando and with the help of the parish priest she finds work with two pensioners who promise to leave her a field. In this way Celestina arouses the ire of the relatives of the two old men and has to move again ...
notes: Good debut behind the camera of Pietrangeli who manages to give a complex and credible female portrait.

title: L'assassino è ancora tra noi
actors: Mariangela D'Abbraccio, Giovanni Visentin, Riccardo Perrotti
description: A mysterious and elusive serial killer tortures and kills couples who imprudently exchange affection while in the car. Cristiana, a girl with a passion for criminology, is doing a thesis on this subject with her teacher. On the occasion of the umpteenth crime, the woman meets Alex, a doctor who at the Institute of Forensic Medicine is in charge of carrying out the autopsies. Despite being dissuaded by the police and by Alex himself, Cristiana begins to investigate.
notes: Low budget thriller inspired by the story of the "Monster of Florence". Also distributed with the title: "Florence! The murderer is still among us".

title: The Devil Is a Woman
actors: Marlene Dietrich, Lionel Atwill, Cesar Romero, Edward Everett
description: The cigar maker Conchita attracts with her perverse charm all the men who come across her, makes them slaves to steal money from them and make fun of them in the most cynical and brazen way. A mature officer, already ruined through her fault, tries to dissuade a young friend of hers from approaching her. Despite repeated warnings, he accepts the woman's invitation and, having gone with her to a masked ball, finds her friend.
