notes: The film is based on the novel "The woman and the puppet" by Pierre Louÿs which also Luis Buñuel was inspired by for his "Quell'oscuro object of desire". The co-writing of this film is by John Dos Passos. Great Marlene in one of the monuments erected by her pygmalion Sternberg.

title: The Old Maid
actors: Bette Davis, Miriam Hopkins, George Brent, Jane Bryan, Donald Crisp
description: Delia has promised herself to Clem who is leaving and for two years no longer gives news of herself. Believing herself abandoned, the girl promises herself to a rich young man, but on her wedding day she learns that Clem is about to return with the intention of marrying her. Frightened Delia decides to send her cousin Carlotta to explain what happened to him. The woman moved to compassion for the man and seeing that she is about to leave for the Secession war ends up falling in love with him.
notes: The plot, based on a novel by Edith Wharton, is a bit pretext. Luckily there are the two female protagonists who give the best of themselves and make everything credible.

title: La Luciana
actors: Rita Rosa, Corrado D'Alba, Elli Parvo, Achille Togliani
description: In Naples, Maria wins a beauty contest and is elected queen of the neighborhood with the name of Luciana. His success is not very well received by Don Gennaro, his father. The girl, romantically linked to Alberto, a young man studying music at the Conservatory, considers herself his betrothed. But Alberto's brother, Vincenzino opposes the relationship and prevents Maria from seeing his brother.
notes: The film is a sort of forerunner of the musicians who were fashionable a few years ago. In place of the various Little Tony and Rita Pavone, there are Achille Togliani and Rita Rosa. Music aside, a real heartbreak.

title: College Kickboxers - Trained to Fight
actors: Matthew Ray Cohen, Mark Williams, Tang Tak Wing
description: A college freshman training in martial arts is beaten to death by a racist gang. A friend of his, a Chinese cook, defends him and begins to teach him all the most secret moves of kung fu. When a competition is called, the teacher reveals to the freshman that he does not want hard for everything he taught him. So when the same gang beats the student's best friend, he puts into practice what his teacher taught him.
notes: But what can you expect from films of this genre? The athletic actors give their best, as usual.

title: Breathing Fire
actors: Jonathan Ke Quan, Jerry Trimble, Bolo Yeung, Eddie Saavedra, Ed Neil, Laura Hamilton, Wendell C. Whitaker, Allen Tackett, Jacqueline Pulliam, Drake Diamond
description: Two very close brothers spend a quiet life in a quiet town. Both busy working out in the gym, while they are little, they know little about their father always traveling around the world doing business. At least, this is what they are led to believe, in reality the man is a delinquent. Time passes and the two grown-up boys find themselves having to fight against their parent, the mind of a sensational bank robbery.
notes: We are always around the kickboxing movie, and obviously, the athletic performances of the actors are subordinated to the athletic performances. After all, you cannot ask for more.

title: The Surrogate
actors: Connie Sellecca, David Dukes, Vincent Ventresca, Polly Bergen
description: Joan and her husband Stewart rent their cottage to Amy, a student engaged to a professor. Amy is indebted to the couple so that when they ask her to lend herself to a "rented" pregnancy because Joan cannot have children, she willingly accepts. During the gestation Amy discovers that Joan has already had a child who died under mysterious circumstances. When the baby Amy is born she is convinced that Joan can harm the baby and so she takes her away. What terrible truth does Amy's gesture hide?
notes: Until when the thorniest problems of bioethics end up being trivialized by rhetorical television dramas that mix strong themes with thriller events?

title: Inside Daisy Clover
actors: Natalie Wood, Christopher Plummer, Robert Redford, Roddy McDowall
description: Fifteen-year-old Daisy Clover gets a film writing almost by accident. Meanwhile, the brother-in-law has the girl's mother locked up in an asylum, who, disoriented, despite the great success of the first film, accepts an actor's marriage proposal. It will be a very unhappy experience, and more will follow before Daisy finds the strength to rebuild a new life.
notes: The film seems to be inspired by the famous "A star is born", without however possessing all the merits but with bright tones that have made it a cult in the following years. The environmental reconstruction of the Thirties is accurate and convincing.

title: The Split
actors: Jim Brown, Diahann Carroll, Julie Harris, Gene Hackman, Jack Klugman
description: On the occasion of an important game of American football, Mac Lane, on the proposal of Gladys who will have the role of financier, organizes a robbery at the stadium cash desk and also chooses four accomplices: Martin, Klinger, Keefke and Neville. On the day of the meeting, everything goes well and the half million dollars resulting from the robbery is hidden in the home of Elly, Mac Lane's wife. But the woman is killed by the owner of the apartment who intends to take possession of the booty.
notes: Towel with sporty subplot for a classic one-shot movie. Great actors in particular of the side.

title: Hot Blood
actors: Jane Russell, Cornel Wilde, Luther Adler, Joseph Calleia
description: Marc Torino, head of a tribe of gypsies, holds his people together in the hope of giving them the promised land, but since he is sick with tuberculosis he would like to leave the command to his young and reckless brother Stephen. Marc longs for Stephen to put his head right by marrying Ann, a young gypsy who belongs to his tribe. Stephan, who at first does not want to know, finally agrees only when he discovers that Anna's father allows the wedding only to collect the agreed sum, according to the gypsy custom.

title: The Outcast of the Islands
actors: Ralph Richardson, Trevor Howard, Robert Morley, Wendy Hiller, Frederick Valk, Kerima, George Coulouris
description: Peter Willems has to leave Singapore where he has legal accounts to settle. To persuade Captain Lingard, his protector, to take him away with him, he threatens to kill himself. Abandoned by his wife, Peter embarks on the captain's ship which, following a secret route, takes him to a landing place particularly suitable for trade with the indigenous Malaysians. Captain Lingard forces his partner Almayer to host Peter who falls in love with his wife.
notes: Taken from "An Outcast of the Isles", Reed's film is one of the most interesting transpositions by Joseph Conrad.

title: L'ultima violenza
actors: Yvonne Sanson, Dario Michaelis, Lorella De Luca, Alberto Lupo, Riccardo Garrone
description: Andrea, the town's new doctor, falls in love with Lisa, daughter of the engineer Carani, a wealthy landowner in the area. Lisa has an older sister, Anna, and a brother, Giorgio, who lives in the city instead. The dissipated life that Giorgio leads and his cynical and unscrupulous attitude pain the engineer, negatively affecting his poor health. One day, Giorgio reveals to Anna that he has discovered that Lisa is not their blood sister and that he is determined to cause a real scandal ...
notes: Matarazziano drama without Nazzari (but always with Sanson), without memorable moments and too verbose: one of the less significant titles of the master of Italian popular melos.

title: Emanuelle. Perché violenza alle donne?
actors: Laura Gemser, Ivan Rassimov, Karin Schubert, Don Powell
description: Emanuelle, famous photojournalist of a magazine for men only, unmasks a guru who says he can have infinite coitus. Of course, he experiences his talents for himself. Then he goes to several cities to unmask the international organization of white trafficking. Vanquished, the gang moves to New York, where a scandal breaks out that overwhelms important personalities implicated in episodes of rape.
notes: Joe D'Amato capitalized on the success of the original "Emmanuelle" (with two "m" s) with a series of films that slid into pornography. The Gemser is worth the ticket price.

title: Six Days, Seven Nights
actors: Harrison Ford, Anne Heche, David Schwimmer, Temuera Morrison
description: Quinn is a grumpy pilot who lives an all-too-quiet life in a tropical archipelago carrying cargo on an old airplane. One day she meets Robin, a fussy editor of a New York magazine who is on vacation with her boyfriend. Having to go to Tahiti, Robin asks Quinn to accompany her. But during the journey, the two are forced to make a crash landing on a desert island.
notes: The two characters are similar to those of the Bogart / Hepburn duo in "Queen of Africa", but unfortunately Reitman is not Huston (and has lost the humor and verve of "Ghostbusters" and "Dave"). The screenplay is a feeble ape of brilliant comedy, and Anne Heche lines an embarrassing string of amateur drama moves and habits. And Indiana, alas, is no longer him. Let's enjoy the views, asleep in rampant boredom.

title: Hush
actors: Jessica Lange, Gwyneth Paltrow, Johnathon Schaech, Nina Foch
description: Helen met Jackson, the man of her dreams. When Jackson takes her on vacation to the fabulous estate in Kilronan, Kentucky, where her mother Martha raises thoroughbred horses, Helen is amazed. Martha has dedicated her entire life to her son and now that she sees him being taken away she reacts violently.
notes: Mediocre film ready to be broadcast within the cycle "Women at the crossroads" and which in the original reads "Hush" (to silence), but in Italy it is distributed under the title "Obsession" because, first of all, there is to sponsor a perfume of the same name (!!). Good performers, beautiful photography: as you would say if the film were not such.

title: Kitty Foyle
actors: Ginger Rogers, Dennis Morgan, James Craig
description: A poor but honest girl marries the rich scion of a middle-class family who is a journalist. Driven by his parents, who do not accept a plebeian daughter-in-law, he leaves her, but then thinks about it. In the meantime, however, another suitor has come forward: an esteemed doctor.
notes: Scripted by Dalton Trumbo, it earned Rogers the only Oscar of her career.

title: Lola rennt
actors: Franka Potente, Moritz Bleibtreu, Herbert Knaup, Armin Rohde
description: A girl with purplish red hair runs through the streets of Berlin. It hits the passers-by, who live their whole life in a lightning succession of frames. She falls into the office of her father who, intent on a definitive interview with his lover, throws her at the door telling her that she is illegitimate. She arrives at the date with her boyfriend in trouble (serious trouble), makes a robbery in a supermarket and dies. But he doesn't want to die, the story starts all over again and so Lola runs two more times.
notes: Expected German revelation at the 55th Venice Film Festival, the film actually contains three commercials in one and is too insistent a trick. It's a little too much to mix Tarantino, animation, video, black and white, color, acceleration, split screen and slow motion. Director Tom Tykwer has pace and style to spare; it's a pity that his only idea is to transform the fatal chance of Kieslowski into a videogame, plundered by the young European cinema (see "Sliding Doors").

title: Il signor Quindicipalle
actors: Francesco Nuti, Sabrina Ferilli, Novello Novelli, Antonio Petrocelli
description: From an early age Francesco knows that he will have to become a world champion in billiards also because it is his father who wants him. But one day while he is walking in a cemetery he meets the most shocking encounter of his life, he meets Sissi, a high-profile prostitute. The woman ends up completely changing his life.
notes: After the hypertrophic and monstrous "OcchioPinocchio", Nuti, instead of humbly returning to his beginnings, perseveres with presumption. He believes himself to be an important director, he writes his own stories, he does not realize that he is more ridiculous than comical. Ferilli fails to save the film from total embarrassment.

title: Vampires
actors: James Woods, Daniel Baldwin, Sheryl Lee, Thomas Ian Griffith
description: Team Crow has been commissioned by the Vatican to destroy a vampire nest allegedly lurking inside the building. As Crow and Tony break in, the silence is torn apart by the shrill screams of a female vampire. One by one all the vampires are reduced to ashes. But the vampire lord is missing.
notes: Carpenter's vampires do not live in isolated castles, do not sleep in coffins, nor do they suffer from the smell of garlic and the sight of the cross; they fear only the light and the pegs stuck in the heart. Carpenter, while not exercising his profession to the best of his ability, produces a horror with intense suspense and cutting irony in which we find the obsessions that have made his cinema great, first of all that of the western. Because "Vampires" can be read as yet another masked western directed by the director, who has never actually directed one.

title: Prisoner of Zenda
actors: William Shatner, Jonathan Jackson
description: A painful event, the death of the father, forces the fourteen year old Rudy, which everyone considers an early genius of information technology, to take the reins of the family business, Zenda incorporation. However, this pushes Uncle Michael to hire three offenders to kidnap his nephew and thus prevent him from participating in the annual meeting with shareholders. Luckily there is Oliver, a boy who will take Rudy's place, since he looks a lot like him. William Shatner is very good at being bad but his film fate is marked: forever Kirk commander of "Star Trek".

title: The Trouble With Spies
actors: Donald Sutherland, Ned Beatty, Ruth Gordon, Lucy Gutteridge
description: It is not difficult to fire on spies, especially if they are incompetent and unable to do their intelligence work. Just like in this case: Agent Porter, with his British colleagues, and the Soviet spies are made a fool out of their incapacity.
notes: Comedy that clearly teases the James Bond 007 myth, some time before Austin Powers arrived. Pleasant, well packaged, but without revolutionary gags. Of course the cast raises the level of the film a lot. The excellent performance by Donald Sutherland and the "Altmanian" Ned Beatty is worth noting.

title: Babysitterin - Die Schreie aus dem Kinderzimmer
actors: Francis Fulton-Smith, Catherine H. Flemming, Dorkas Kiefer, Ralph Herforth
description: Little Jennifer dies following a serious accident in her room. Christina, the girl who took care of the child is accused by her parents and the police of having set fire to the house. Tamara, a young and inexperienced legal expert, takes charge of her defense, who eventually manages to convince the court of her client's innocence by calling attention to her older brother Michael. Returned to freedom, Christina, grateful, takes care of Tamara's little daughter, but the lawyer notices something unusual in her attitude and a terrible suspicion arises in her ...

title: Le piacevoli notti
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Vittorio Gassman, Gina Lollobrigida, Adolfo Celi, Eros Pagni
description: Three Boccaccio episodes set in the Renaissance. In the first a noble libertine becomes the lover of a married woman; in the second, a false pope encourages a girl's erotic dreams; in the third Lucrezia Borgia is caught in flagrant adultery by her husband.
notes: A great cast for a slightly spicy farce.

title: Halls of Montezuma
actors: Richard Widmark, Jack Palance, Reginald Gardiner, Robert Wagner
description: Carl Anderson, a young chemistry professor who became a lieutenant in the marines during the war with Japan, lands with his platoon on the island of Okinawa. The advance seems to be proceeding in the best way, but is blocked by a shower of fire that causes heavy losses in the American army.
notes: Milestone, famous for "Nothing New on the Western Front", then slipped into trombone and conventional war films like this one.

title: Across 110th Street
actors: Anthony Quinn, Yaphet Kotto, Paul Benjamin, Ed Bernard
description: Three black men organize a robbery of a criminal organization operating in the Harlem area. Naturally the boss, irritated by the insult, sends his son-in-law on the trail of the robbers to give them exemplary punishment. The three are in the meantime also wanted by the police. The first to identify and reach them is the son-in-law of the boss who in a firefight manages to kill two of the three robbers.
notes: Gangster story all action without great pretensions, but with nice urban glimpses.

title: The Last Married Couple in America
actors: George Segal, Natalie Wood, Richard Benjamin, Valerie Harper
description: After many years not exciting marriage, Jeff and Mary Thompson begin to convince themselves that their life is even bankruptcy. So they decide to try the separation: an clumsy attempt conducted and that it will last little since, in short, Jeff returns home. Persuaded by a venereal disease and the nostalgia for a stable bond.
notes: There is no need to add more: late compared to the age of the so -called "sexual revolution" and very superficially Cates tries to ironze on those who live lightly the marriage. But it is useless to shoot on characters who have never received even a little vital breath.

title: Coming Home
actors: Jane Fonda, Jon Voight, Bruce Dern, Robert Carradine, Robert Ginty
description: Captain Bob, after taking leave of his wife Sally, leaves for the Vietnam War together with his friend Sergeant Dink Mobley. Sally, a restless woman unable to wait in golden solitude for her man to return, offers herself as a volunteer nurse in a hospital for veterans. Here she meets Luke, a young man paralyzed in the legs and in a short time she falls in love with him. But meanwhile, injured in a stupid accident and frustrated at not having become a hero, he returns to his homeland.
notes: Ashby's film won three Academy Awards: for Best Actor, Actress and for Screenplay. It is a sincere reflection on Vietnam (one of the first), directed and interpreted with sobriety (both Voight and Fonda won the Oscar for best protagonist). Oscar also for the screenplay.

title: Amazon Women on the Moon
directors: Joe Dante, Carl Gottlieb, Peter Horton, John Landis, Robert K. Weiss
actors: Lou Jacobi, Steve Guttenberg, Rosanna Arquette, Griffin Dunne
description: Twenty episodes, some of which last only a few minutes, for a burst of parody of everything that is on show with a trash tendency: B-movies, commercials, hardcore and so on.
notes: The title is in turn based on a science fiction film from the 1950s _ (Cat-Women of the Moon) _, which was shot using the 3D method and directed in 1954 by Arthur Hilton. Rather discontinuous, due to too many directors involved, and not always up to the mark. Edited by John Landis with a taste for zapping, it marks the director's return to the criticism of television he had already experienced in _Laughing to laugh_.

title: Matti da slegare
directors: Marco Bellocchio, Silvano Agosti, Stefano Rulli, Sandro Petraglia
description: Documentary made inside and outside the asylum of Colorno (Parma) on behalf of the local Emilia in view of the implementation of the Basaglia law on the abolition of prisoners for the mentally ill. In front of the camera, patients tell their experiences and their lives without any intervention by the filmmakers.
notes: Example of "militant" cinema as it is no longer done, made by four directors (Marco Bellocchio, Silvano Agosti, Stefano Rulli and Sandro Petraglia) united in a cooperative.

title: Anna
actors: Anna, Massimo Sarchielli, Vincenzo Mazza
description: Docu-fiction that has as its object, or protagonist, Anna, an underage girl, drug addict, expecting a child. Her partner, the baby's father, recently died of an overdose. In short, the small community of marginalized people who hang out in Piazza Navona gathers around her and the camera that frames her and captures her moods, tensions and life.
notes: The film is one of the most daring film-truth experiments: for the intertwining of reality and fiction, for the ambiguity of the spectator-director-character relationship. The protagonist met a tragic end shortly thereafter.

title: Never Steal Anything Small
actors: Horace McMahon, James Cagney, Shirley Jones, Nehemiah Persoff
description: A port that wishes to be elected to the head of its union uses not too lawful means. Once Cacrica is obtained, he realizes that life has enormously complicated for him.
notes: The film is based on a theatrical text by Maxwell Anderson and the director Rouben Mamoulian. The skill of James Cagna thinks about everything. There is no lack of some nice side dish. Not very nice the Italian title with which it was distributed.

title: I'm No Angel
actors: Mae West, Cary Grant, Edward Arnold, Gertrude Michael
description: She is Tira, the sublime queen of the circus. He is Jack, the only man for several miles who doesn't succumb to the lure of his charm. To seduce him, failing to do so with her tried and tested weapons, she doesn't hesitate to even sue him in court.
notes: One of the anthology films of the sensual, intelligent, transgressive Mae West. Her erotic-kitsch outfits, great rhythm, are unforgettable.

title: The Swordsman
actors: Lorenzo Lamas, Claire Stansfield, Michael Champion, Nicholas Pasco
description: Police officer and expert swordsman Andrew is assigned by his superiors to the protection program of Julie Wilkins, an archaeologist and curator of a prestigious museum, the only witness to the theft of the legendary sword that belonged to Alexander the Great. Andrew is haunted by a recurring dream: two men who are dueling in a historic place. In the place where he trains he meets Stratos, the creator of a fencing competition that predicts the death of one of the contenders. Man seems to be the key to both the visions and the disappearance of the great leader's sword.
notes: Lorenzo Lamas highlights all his athletic skills in this film of not great value.

title: Washington Square
actors: Jennifer Jason Leigh, Ben Chaplin, Albert Finney, Maggie Smith
description: Catherine, the daughter of an established doctor, lives in mid-nineteenth-century New York and is always the target of her father's criticism. He, an insensitive man, reproaches her for not possessing any of her mother's gifts, namely: beauty, charm and refinement. Catherine is destined to remain a spinster, until a young adventurer appears in her life.
notes: Camellias, lace, umbrellas, gardens, children in white and girls in bloom. Agnieszka Holland (relapse, the unpresentable "Poets from Hell" was hers) retries the nineteenth-century setting with an adaptation by Henry James which seems to be a by-product of the worst James Ivory.

title: Small Soldiers
actors: Kirsten Dunst, Denis Leary, Dick Miller, David Cross, Jay Mohr
description: The Gorgonites were once warriors. Today they are pacifist toys threatened by the Elite Commandos, convinced militarist puppets, especially now that a microchip stolen from some Army software has transformed them into perfect war machines. It happens, therefore, that the life of an Ohio town is turned upside down by the arrival of a batch of toys that should revolutionize the market.
notes: Spielberg's Dreamworks and Universal joined forces for this film. Not that the result is to be counted among the best, but the metaphor of the anthropomorphic puppets offers a couple of memorable sequences: the quote of the helicopters from "Apocalypse Now" and the disturbing moment of the disfigured Barbie. Between Disney's neo-myths ("Toy Story") and literary legends ("Gulliver"), "Small Soldiers" tries to renew the imagination: it doesn't have the strength of a Spielberg, yet it moves.

title: A Perfect Murder
actors: Michael Douglas, Gwyneth Paltrow, Viggo Mortensen, David Suchet
description: Financier Steven Taylor has everything but the thing he wants most: the love and fidelity of his wife Emily. Emily, for her part, wants more than a decorative role alongside her husband. So does a lover, David. When Steven, having found out everything, contemplates hitting the perfect murder, he summons the unwitting David.
notes: In the hands of cheeky Michael Douglas (director Andrew Davis is a salaried one), who considers Uncle Alfred's classic "a minor film," the script neutralizes the geometry, suspense and rhythm of the Hitchcockian model. No memorable moments.

title: Blood Frenzy
actors: Wendy Macdonald, Lisa Loring, John Clark, Hank Garrett, John Montero
description: Seven close friends decide to take a vacation, but even before realizing where they are, the group falls into terror. In fact, a mysterious serial killer sows slaughtered corpses everywhere and soon the seven protagonists have to fight for their lives.
notes: Discounted horror film that turns eerily towards the splatter side. Only for strong palates.

title: Gallo cedrone
actors: Carlo Verdone, Regina Orioli, Paolo Triestino, Ines Nobili
description: Armando Feroci, an Italian who left as a volunteer for the Red Cross in an Arab country, was taken prisoner and sentenced to death by an Islamic group. Television investigates his life. That of a man who loves to pick up women on the street, who thinks he's the natural son of Elvis Presley and who has changed his hair often. In short, a man without definition.
notes: Verdone returns to do the "tout-court" forced in this film full of funny ideas but disappointing in terms of originality. Slave to "his" clichés, Verdone risks not wanting to grow up anymore.

title: There's Something About Mary
actors: Cameron Diaz, Matt Dillon, Ben Stiller, Lee Evans, Chris Elliott
description: At seventeen, Ted had met Mary, the dream girl and had managed to invite her to the prom in Rhode Island, but her jewels in the zipper of his pants had ended up ruining everything. But there's something about Mary that keeps Ted tied up with some kind of spell and so Ted hires a private detective.
notes: The film is shameless, wild and "politically" incorrect, it makes fun of pimply kids, fat and elderly women, dogs, paraplegics, in a demented and exhibited fiction. Hilarious beginning, where Ben closes his penis in the zipper, and they, without hesitation, show "the object" in the foreground.

title: Avventura in città. Paisanella
actors: Luisella Boni, Nick Pagano, Daniela Calvino, Giacomo Furia
description: Pietro is a good boy, but the circumstances of his life have put him in contact with a gang of criminals, led by Enrico, a dangerous French outlaw. One day Pietro, in charge of collecting the plans for a theft in a bank, absent-mindedly exchanges the bag that contains them with that of a high school girl, Mariuccia. Enrico forces Pietro to work hard to retrieve the precious folder and to try to find out if Mariuccia has discovered something. But, once the girl has been retraced, Pietro falls in love with her and encounters an unexpected obstacle in Vanda, Enrico's friend, who in turn is crushed by Pietro.
notes: Definitely negligible product with Giacomo Furia, former shoulder of Totò then grandfather from "Mulino bianco".

title: Night of the Warrior
actors: Lorenzo Lamas, Robin Antin, Mike Ballew, Andre Rosey Brown
description: Miles paid his dues to justice for setting up in the back of the dancing club that runs a ring where illegal kickboxing matches are held. When he gets out of prison he refuses to cooperate with some unscrupulous people who are trying to organize the illegal fighting. But the mafia forces him to continue, threatening his mother, killing his ex girlfriend Joy and taking his new girlfriend hostage. Miles is forced to fight to protect himself and those close to him.
notes: Lorenzo Lamas gives the face and above all the body to the usual character who has to try to get by against the usual bad guys.

title: Denchu kozo no boken
actors: Nobu Kanaoka, Shinya Tsukamoto, Kei Fujiwara, Tomorowo Taguchi
description: A rather introverted boy is thrown without his knowledge in the near future. He soon realizes that the world to come is dominated by evil forces that immediately try to neutralize it. The young man is therefore forced to fight to survive but also to neutralize them. Despite the disparity of forces, he manages to open a glimmer of hope.
notes: The film can be considered a dress rehearsal carried out by Tsukamoto for his next "Tetsuo", shot in 1992. The theme is identical and, more free-range, the production technique. The metaphor is less extreme.

title: Seeds of Doubt
actors: Peter Coyote, Joe Lando, Alberta Watson
description: Following the case of a murder of a beautiful young model, journalist Jennifer Kingsley begins to believe that Raymond Crawford, who is serving his prison sentence for a similar crime, is innocent. The woman begins to be obsessed with the case also because she deals with it every day by writing fiery articles in The Examiner, the newspaper for which she works. His secret hope is that the case can be reopened. One day, Jennifer turns to police lieutenant Henry Dexter who offers to help him out and slowly the truth begins to come out.

title: Thieves' Highway
actors: Richard Conte, Valentina Cortese, Lee J. Cobb, Barbara Lawrence
description: War veteran Nick returns home to find that his father is no longer able to drive the truck following a road accident that made him disabled. Responsible for the incident is Mike, a wholesale fruit trader. So to improve the fortunes of the family, Nick invests his mobilization prize in a batch of apples that he intends to sell in San Francisco. Here he manages to sell the cargo to Mike, who has no qualms about cheating it, also thanks to the help of a complacent girl.
notes: Urban noir with a realist structure as they often did in those years, the last chapter of an ideal trilogy that includes "Brute Force" and "The Naked City".

title: Le volpi della notte
actors: Viola Valentino, Fabrizia Carminati, Pamela Prati, Enzo Cannavale, Gianfranco Manfredi
description: The foxes of the title are a special police squad made up of three women: Miryam, Anna and Elena. The first has a child and is married to a naive writer who always has dazzling ideas for novels that ... already exist. In addition to the gun, Anna has the weapon of seduction. Dynamic and sporty, on the other hand, is Elena. The investigation into the murder of a model and the mysterious disappearance of her beauty case is entrusted to the three foxes. To discover the killer, the three girls improvise as models.
notes: The Italian answer to "Charlie 'Angels". Too bad that Carminati and Fawcett have only hair color in common. The others not even that.

title: Character
actors: Fedia van Huet, Jan Decleir, Tamar van den Dop, Betty Schuurman
description: We are in the 1920s in the city of Rotterdam. Unsuspecting people pass by a dilapidated house next to a canal. Inside is the body of a murdered man, in the hall there is a bloody young man who can hardly breathe. In a panic, he runs away, but, once recognized, he is arrested by the police. The detective who is called to follow the case is intrigued by what happened and by the knowledge between the suspect and the victim.
notes: Slowly the film by Mike Van Diem, Oscar winner for best foreign film in 1997, removes the veil from the past and thus appears the spectacle of the troubled relationship between a father with a heart of stone and an irreproachable son who pays for the obstinate refusal on himself. maternal to marry the father. From the story by Ferdinand Bordewijk, the forty-year-old Van Diem has staged an anguished dream inside the claustrophobic halls of the commercial company - the film's privileged set - demonstrating the mastery of a veteran.

title: Elizabeth
actors: Cate Blanchett, Geoffrey Rush, Christopher Eccleston, Joseph Fiennes
description: England 1554 When Queen Mary dies, the young Elizabeth I Tudor ascends the throne and as a first move she brings the man she loved since childhood, Robert Dudley, back from exile. Sir William Cecil, the head of the Secretariat, advises her to marry to strengthen the country. Although Elizabeth only loves Dudley, she understands that if she is to survive she must exercise her authority vigorously.
notes: The Indian director's film is above all a story of massacres, assassinations, religious wars led by women. A big film of packaging that could have been more cruel (the initial executions promise a lot), but which manages not to sweeten the Baroque tension despite the political-didactic intentions.

title: Il Pap'occhio
actors: Renzo Arbore, Roberto Benigni, Andy Luotto, Diego Abatantuono, Mario Marenco
description: Worried about the advance of Buddhists and the boom among young people in discos and drugs, the Pope decides to inaugurate Vatican Television with a worldwide variety show. The direction was entrusted to Martin Scorsese who consulted the company of Renzo Arbore.
notes: More than a film, a surreal, self-deprecating joke and a mockery of Pope Wojtyla (elected in 1978), a great sportsman and "communicator". Some gags are hilarious: that of "Lord be with you" referring to Marenco, Benigni's monologue on the Last Judgment, the song "Don't run dad", "Azzurro" interpreted by the chorus with closed mouth and pernacchie, Abatantuono explaining the Dante's Inferno, the theme song for Vatican television to the notes of the International of Workers. But seen today, the film communicates a rather tarnished sense of provisional inventiveness. Parts for Scorsese, Isabella Rossellini, Michel Pergolani, Mariangela Melato and so on.

title: Radiofreccia
actors: Stefano Accorsi, Luciano Federico, Francesco Guccini, Alessio Modica
description: In the Correggio of the 70s, Bruno opens in the attic of the house with a 5 watt transmitter, the turntable and his records, Radio Raptus. The radio thus becomes his second home, the first is the Laika bar and it is there that Ivan called Freccia takes refuge following a furious quarrel with his mother's arrogant lover. One day Freccia meets a drug addict and starts getting fucked with her.
notes:
Apart from some naivety (that biglia symbol of lost innocence ...), some length and some interpreters not up to par, the film is an interesting debut. Merit also of the technical cast: the Liga means little of shots and plans-sequence. But he has the humility to rely on a co -director (Antonio Grimaldi) and a director of non -weapon photography (Arnaldo Catinari). A light movie, but in the best dress.

title: The Horse Whisperer
actors: Robert Redford, Scarlett Johansson, Kristin Scott Thomas, Sam Neill
description: Fourteen-year-old Grace suffers an accident while riding Pilgrim. Deep physical and psychological wounds remain. The horse's condition is also severe to the point that a veterinarian recommends putting it down. Realizing the deep bond between the two, Annie, Grace's mother, decides to launch a campaign to find a "whisperer" able to heal him.
notes: Almost a western, perhaps the last western possible. Almost a love story. A classic film, which accepts all the risks of the impossibility of classic cinema, and which is built on the balance of classic plans. Redford's direction accompanies the subtlety of the script by Richard LaGravenese, a master of detail, able to purge the sensationalism of mediocre bestsellers, like this one and like the book at the origin of "The Bridges of Madison County".

title: Nerolio
actors: Marco Cavicchioli, Vincenzo Crivello, Lucia Sardo, Piera Degli Esposti
description: A famous Italian poet and director is traveling on a second class train from Messina to Syracuse. He visits the beauties of the city and reaches a popular neighborhood where he finds a group of boys who will get into his car that same evening one by one. In Rome the poet receives Valerio who asks for assistance for a thesis on him, but Valerio's objectives are different. Night: the poet wanders the streets, picks up a boy, invites him to dinner, then they go to a dark clearing where the first approaches begin.
notes: Almost at the same time as the posthumous release of "Petrolio" Grimaldi made this film which, from the title itself, recalls the work of Pasolini. Grimaldi's "crime" is that of having offended Pasolini's "holiness" in the description of the poet's last days, focusing attention on his homosexuality. To put it this way it would seem a work with a blatantly voyeuristic flavor, in reality the film delivers an all-round portrait of Pasolini struggling with a desperate need for love, in the extraordinary black and white of Maurizio Calvesi.

title: Quest for Camelot
description: Kayley, a lady in King Arthur's court, aspires to become a member of the Knights of the Round Table. So when Ruber, the villain on duty, steals the legendary Excalibur, the girl goes in search of it.
notes: Failed the attempt to relaunch the "Looney tunes" series, Warner has preferred to revisit the saga of the Knights of the Round Table in a feminine way. The story shows no particular brilliance except for some secondary characters such as the silly griffin or Corny and Devon, the two-headed dragon singer and dancer. In the original edition famous actors and singers lend their voices to the characters, in the Italian one it is Gigi Proietti who dubbed the Siamese dragon.

title: Scorticateli vivi
actors: Bryan Rostrom, Anthony Freeman, Thomas Kerr, Pierluigi Giorgio
description: Overburdened by debt, beaten and threatened by creditors, the adventurer Rudy gets a million lire from his prostitute friend, Evelyn, to then join his brother Frank who is fighting as a mercenary in an African country. Rudy's intention is not to enlist but to get hold of a portion of the diamonds.
notes: The screenplay is a pretext to show violent scenes, massacres, rapes and horrors of all kinds.

title: Dawn of the Dead
actors: David Emge, Ken Foree, Scott Reiniger, Gaylen Ross, Tom Savini
description: The undead have invaded the United States and terror is rampant. Four brave, two soldiers, one white and one black, two officials of a television network, a woman and a man, are trying to escape in a helicopter. The shortage of fuel, however, forces them to land on the roof of a huge supermarket, unaware that zombies are hiding there too. While the living dead, who eat human flesh, try to overwhelm them, the four manage to create a refuge inside the supermarket. Will it be enough?
notes: The film, an ideal follow-up to "Night of the Living Dead", is a hallucinatory political metaphor with some touches of macabre humor. Produced by Dario Argento, the Italian edition is very different from the American one. Tricks by Tom Savini.

title: Napoli è sempre Napoli
actors: Lea Padovani, Renato Baldini, Achille Togliani, Carlo Ninchi, Tina Pica
description: Carmela is in love with Pietro, owner of a fishing boat, who reciprocates her love, but does not decide to declare it to him, also because he is held back by the unjust rumors that circulate about the woman. The Tunisian intends to take advantage of this state of affairs, a dishonest man who tries to steal from Pietro Carmela. But the girl has promised the Madonna di Montevergine that she will give up her career as a singer in exchange for Pietro's love.
notes: Songs, intrigues, feelings. Almost a relic.

title: The Crush
actors: Cary Elwes, Alicia Silverstone, Jennifer Rubin, Amber Benson
description: Nick Eliot is looking for a place where he can write his novel in peace. After placing an ad in the newspaper, he receives a response from a married couple who offers to host him; However, the family also includes Darian, a beautiful and sensual fourteen-year-old who begins to cultivate an insane passion for men and does everything to be close to him. But the ambiguous situation ends up haunting Nick, who feels a feeling of anger towards the teenager growing in him.
notes: TV variation on Lolithic themes: luckily in the cast is Alicia Silverstone, at the time the most desired teenager in the United States.

title: Desert Fury
actors: John Hodiak, Lizabeth Scott, Burt Lancaster, Mary Astor
description: A stunning blonde with a stormy past has opened a gambling house in a desert area of ??the United States that she successfully manages. The woman has a daughter who, after leaving the boarding school where she was locked up, returns to live with her. Unaccustomed to the outside world, the girl gives in to the court of an ex-cowboy who is now a policeman. But another man with a troubled past slowly drags her into passion and above all makes her insensitive to her mother's advice. Despite the latter's recommendations, the girl runs away with her friend. The tragedy suddenly erupts during the journey ...
notes: Intense film noir scripted by Robert Rossen with a certain psychological subtlety.

title: Shag
actors: Tyrone Power jr., Phoebe Cates, Scott Coffey, Bridget Fonda
description: #We are in 1963 in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina. A group of wild friends decides to celebrate in the best way one of them who is about to get married. A bachelorette party is then organized which will have to leave its mark and which will have nothing to envy to what the boys do on similar occasions. Myrtle Beach will therefore be the scene of a rather eventful weekend.
notes: Television film in the wake of the Sixties revival, with Romina's brother and Tyrone Power's son, and Henry Fonda's granddaughter.

title: The Rose of Washington Square
actors: Tyrone Power, Alice Faye, Al Jolson, William Frawley, Joyce Compton
description: Bart Clinton, an elegant young man who lives by gimmicks, meets Rose, a singer from a café concert and falls in love with her at first sight. The girl decides to get together with him. Their relationship, however, lasts the space of a morning, because Bart, wanted by the police, is forced to flee. Rose comforted by a friend, who loves her secretly, does not feel like giving up her career. One evening, however, she meets Bart again, who apologizes and declares his love again. Very solid musical, but without brilliant surges. There's old Al Jolson in some nice numbers.

title: The Thirty Nine Steps
actors: Robert Powell, David Warner, Eric Porter, Karen Dotrice, John Mills
description: It is 1914, the eve of the First World War. European capitals are swarming with spies intent on stealing secrets to benefit their countries in the impending conflict. The young mining engineer Richard Hannay, who has returned to England from South Africa, unwittingly finds himself involved in an intrigue over having hosted an Intelligence Service colonel hunted by Prussian spies in his home. All this movement of spies is the prelude to the attack on the Greek Prime Minister Karolidis on a visit to London.
notes: Third film version of John Buchan's short story, the most famous of which is due to Hitchcock. Although inferior (obviously) to the model, the film has a strong suspense

title: Comanche
actors: Dana Andrews, Kent Smith, Linda Cristal, Nestor Paiva
description: In 1875 the Comanches tribe encamped along the border between Mexico and the United States, under the leadership of the Indian chief Quanah Parker, stormed Cerro Tello, a small Mexican town. Having entered the village, they kill all the inhabitants and take their women hostage. Among them is Margherita, who saw her parents, rich Spanish aristocrats, killed. On returning to the camp, the Indians encounter a detachment of cavalrymen.
notes: Discreet western with spectacular mass scenes, directed by a non-genius specialist.

title: Dogs in Space
actors: Michael Hutchence, Saskia Post, Nique Needles, Deanna Bond
description: Noisy film that tries to illustrate the punk era that destabilized the history of music in the seventies and which, however, ends up being a portrait of the youth of all times.
notes: The title refers to the first Soviet space missions in which dogs were sent to space instead of astronauts. In the cast Michael Hutchence, leader of the Inxs musical group, who committed suicide some time ago.

title: Bigger Than Life
actors: James Mason, Barbara Rush, Christopher Olsen, Walter Matthau
description: Ed Avery is a humble teacher who, unbeknownst to his wife, works in an auto company office to make ends meet. Excessive fatigue, however, is fatal to humans who fall ill with a rare and severe form of inflammation of the arteries. To save him, the doctors subject him to a cortisone treatment which has a miraculous effect. He can thus leave the hospital, but in order to be safe, he must never stop taking the drug that cured him. In the long run, however, the medicine causes him effects similar to those of a drug.
notes: Disturbing cross-section of the American petty bourgeoisie taken from an article published in the "New Yorker". Ray's use of color is extraordinary, more baroque than ever, and a Guiagantic James Mason.

title: Ultimo tango a Parigi
actors: Marlon Brando, Maria Schneider, Maria Michi, Jean-Pierre Léaud
description: In a rented apartment, Paul meets Jeanne and forces her to have the first of a series of sexual intercourse. Despite the pact, expressly wanted by him, not to even tell each other the name, in subsequent meetings the two analyze each other. Paul, a 45-year-old American son of alcoholics, has returned from failed experiences, while Jeannie is torn by the feeling of attraction and repulsion for her mature lover.
notes: An impossible and desperate love story. A heartbreaking cry from the bourgeoisie. A challenge, distilled in the elegance and knowledge of cinema, to the accommodating conventions of the cinema of the fathers. Between Jean-Pierre Léaud, an icon of the Nouvelle Vague, and the carnal and mysterious object represented by Maria Schneider. The film was seized and the copies burned (except one), at the end of a lawsuit for obscenities. Music by Gato Barbieri, beautiful photography by Vittorio Storaro.

title: A Dandy in Aspic
actors: Laurence Harvey, Mia Farrow, Tom Courtenay, Lionel Stander
description: Agent Eberlin is part of the British secret services and is mainly active in Germany. Eberlin, however, is also on the payroll of the KGB, to which he passes information on Western services. When two of his colleagues who are on a mission with him are killed, Eberlin realizes his days are numbered. At this point the Intelligence Service entrusts him with an assignment: to go to Berlin and kill the Russian agent Krasnevin or ... himself since the phantom opposing agent is nothing more than his cover identity.
notes: The latest film by a master of the western, it is a dark adult spy film with a compelling story.

title: Il triangolo delle Bermude
actors: John Huston, Gloria Guida, Marina Vlady, Andrés García
description: An elderly archaeologist with his family is traveling aboard a yacht to the Sargasso Sea to do some studies. Entering the sea mirror that the title of the film the boat and its occupants begin to experience adventures to the limits of the paranormal that promptly end with terrible misfortunes. When at the bottom of the sea the archaeologist discovers the remains of an unknown city ...
notes: From a specialist in Z-movies, a somewhat ragged international production, with Huston ending up there by accident.

title: Sette uomini d'oro
actors: Rossana Podestà, Philippe Leroy, Gastone Moschin, Gabriele Tinti
description: Six men, disguised as workers, stop with a fire engine and other equipment in front of the Swiss National Bank in the busy center of Geneva. Led by Alberto, an imperturbable English professor who communicates with them via a radio system, the group penetrates the basement of the bank. Arriving in the vault, they take seven tons of gold bars and load them inside the fire engine.
notes: Enormous success for an almost unique example of successful Italian Giallorossi, which has nothing to envy to the Americans and which created a small vein.

title: The Last Word
actors: Timothy Hutton, Joe Pantoliano, Michelle Burke, Chazz Palminteri
description: Martin Dellios is a journalist who became famous for his book set in the world of prostitution. Martin's marriage recently ended with the separation from his wife as he fell in love with a stripper with whom he began a somewhat tormented relationship. Meanwhile, a film producer read the book and invited Martin to Hollywood to turn it into a movie script. When Martin discovers that his girlfriend has been a prostitute in the past, he leaves her but writes a script based on the true story of the woman he loved.
notes: It is clear that we are on the side of "Showgils" and "Strip tease". The result is discreet. Small parts for Richard Dreyfuss, Cybill Shepherd and Chazz Palminteri.

title: Captive
actors: Michael Ironside, Erika Eleniak, Catherine Colvey, Adrienne Ironside
description: Sal, a wealthy industrialist who works in the fashion world, marries Samantha, a charming and beautiful designer. Before leaving for the long-awaited honeymoon, the girl realizes that she has left the plane tickets at the office and asks Sal to come back to get them. On the way back, the man is killed in cold blood by a killer. Upon hearing the terrible news, Samantha tries to take her own life. Sal's brother Joel, a lawyer, admits her to a rehabilitation center run by Dr. Kxim. But Joel and the doctor are lovers and they try to take her out ...

title: She Woke Up Pregnant
actors: Michele Greene, William R. Moses, Lynda Carter, Theresa Saldana
description: A rather scruffy-looking dentist rapes his patient while she is heavily sedated. The woman realizes that she has become pregnant and, since her husband had had a vasectomy, she realizes that she has suffered violence without her knowledge. He thus decides to wage a legal battle against the doctor who, seeing himself discovered, defends himself by claiming to have had a relationship with the woman who is now accusing him. But the woman struggles with all her might to prove that she hasn't invented anything. An actress with a hard past who has suffered the same violence from the dentist is considered an unreliable witness. It is therefore necessary that ...

title: Jack the Bear
actors: Danny DeVito, Robert J. Steinmiller jr., Miko Hughes, Gary Sinise
description: California 1972: John Leary, irreverent host of a B-series television program, which broadcasts horror films at night, occupies a large house in the Oakland neighborhood. Having lost his wife prematurely, John alone raises two sons, three-year-old Dylan and 12-year-old Jack, known to everyone in the family as "Jack the Bear". The man will soon have to deal with a racist and psychopathic neighbor.
notes: Television director Marshall Herskovitz makes his big screen debut with this small and intriguing film. In the United States it was a resounding flop.

title: Avalon
actors: Armin Mueller-Stahl, Elizabeth Perkins, Joan Plowright
description: In 1914 Sam Krichinsky, a young Jew, emigrated to America from his native Poland and settled in the city of Baltimore. He settles in the Avalon neighborhood and starts working as an upholsterer. America for him and for all emigrants like him appears as the promised land. Meanwhile, the years pass and Sam leaves Avalon to land in a suburb to live with his son Jules, daughter-in-law Anna and grandson Michael. Meanwhile, the traditional Thanksgiving party arrives, now also for them ...
notes: The film is based on the director's autobiographical memories. Beautiful soundtrack by Randy Newman.

title: Teresa Raquin
actors: Simone Signoret, Raf Vallone, Roland Lesaffre, Jacques Duby
description: Teresa married her cousin Camillo, a weak and sickly man, without love. When she meets the truck driver Lorenzo, Teresa falls in love with him, but is reluctant to abandon Camillo. Lorenzo reveals the adultery to Teresa's husband who asks his wife to spend three days with him in Paris. On the train, where Lorenzo has secretly followed the couple, the two men argue, and Lorenzo ...
notes: Carné sets Zola's novel among his contemporaries with the collaboration of Charles Spaak and transforms it into a tragedy of destiny. Production designer Paul Bertrand reconstructed the city of Lyon in the studio. The film won the Silver Lion at the Venice Film Festival.

title: High Velocity
actors: Ben Gazzara, Britt Ekland, Paul Winfield, Keenan Wynn
description: While attending a polo match, William Anderson, director of a multinational that financially dominates the East, is kidnapped by a group of Filipino guerrillas belonging to Group 45. The vice president of the company, instead of resorting to the ambiguous police of Manila, asks the help of Clifford Baumgartner, aka Bummer, who fought in Vietnam with the rank of captain. The latter, after having secured the collaboration of two of his comrades, decides to attack the guerrillas. Meanwhile, Anderson held captive on a farm is forced to reveal the secrets of his company. Normal action movie with a good cast.

title: Cover Girls
actors: Giorgia Moll, Claudio Gora, Maria Grazia Buccella, Carol Walker
description: Interviewed by a journalist, Filippo, a professional photographer, tells the story of some girls who have become famous fashion models under different circumstances. Ulla is a Swedish girl whom Philip casually meets and accompanies around the city. But faced with requests for special services, the girl refuses. Carlotta, a second-rate divetta, has to face the suicide of the director who hired her, who, however, helps to launch her into the world of cinema. Mara, presenter of a collection of models, is kidnapped by a rival, but despite everything she manages to get the same publicity.

title: La mafia mi fa un baffo
actors: Renato Cecilia, Femi Benussi, Yvonne Harlow, Tiberio Murgia
notes: If a few moving images are enough to give life to a film, this is the case of Riccardo Garrone's work.

title: He Got Game
actors: Denzel Washington, Ray Allen, Milla Jovovich, Rosario Dawson
description: High school basketball phenomenon Jesus Shuttlesworth could quickly become a professional basketball ace or scholarship student. Jesus is highly contested, all the agents want to grab him, every state of America is ready for any sacrifice. Also at the prospect of freeing Jake, Jesus' father, in prison for accidentally killing his wife. That's what the owner Governor of the Big State plans: if in a week Jake convinces his son to play for the team of the state that "owns" him, he will have the sentence commuted. The trouble is that Jesus hates his father; and pride blocks Jake's path.
notes: The best of Spike Lee's film lies precisely in the family and generational clash: a test of maturity in which the director throws himself generously, without fear of skidding. Spike Lee is a great basketball fan, Denzel Washington would look good on a team, Ray Allen is the star of the Milwaukee Bucks, Jim Brown was one of the best athletes in the NFL.

title: La leggenda del pianista sull'Oceano
actors: Tim Roth, Pruitt Taylor Vince, Bill Nunn, Clarence Williams III
description: They found him as soon as he was born in a hidden basket aboard the Virginian and he never got off from there. The Virginian is a steamer that crosses the ocean on the route from Europe to America and back. It is the trumpet player, his longtime friend, Max Tooney, who tells us his story. The ship for the twentieth century represents everything. Self-taught he learned to play the piano and allows himself the luxury of challenging the famous jazz player Jelly Roll Morton.
notes: Taken from the monologue "Novecento" (40 pages) by Alessandro Baricco, the film (2 hours and 45) is sumptuously wrong: too much cinema, trolleys, zooms, dollies, which end up canceling each other out; too much incessant visual emotion, which inevitably flattens any romantic opening; too much desire for poetry, for the "sublime", as if the author were trying to remedy the meager script with "the great moments". Redundancy cancels the pathos. Roth's evanescent strangeness is lost in grotesque touches that are out of tune in the best cases, in the worst specchiest ones. And Morricone's music does not resonate with mysterious genius, it is just film music (and this is unforgivable).

title: Mia eoniotita ke mia mera
actors: Bruno Ganz, Isabelle Renauld, Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Achileas Skevis
description: It is Sunday and the rain on Thessaloniki is the color of twilight. Alessandro prepares to leave his house on the sea where he has always lived forever. Wandering around the house, he finds a letter from his wife, Anna, who tells him about a summer day thirty years ago. Then, for him, a strange journey begins in the course of which past and present mingle.
notes: Once upon a time there was a great author, who in the seventies, with the sinuous and painful poetry of his sequence shots, changed cinema. "La recita", "The days of '36", "Reconstruction of a crime" were perfect theorems on the possibility of representing history by pursuing an ideal of absolute, disruptive formal purity. Then the great author had doubts, hesitated, re-emerged with the pain of the "Gaze of Ulysses". But the balance had cracked; words and symbols began to devour his cinema. This film won at Cannes, but it seems the parody of the great Angelopulos: Tonino Guerra's dialogues touch the absurd and the metaphors grotesque.

title: Primary Colors
actors: John Travolta, Emma Thompson, Kathy Bates, Andrian Lester
description: The son of a leader who fought for the civil rights of black people, Henry Burton is a young idealist looking for a cause. He joins the presidential campaign of Jack Stanton, a progressive governor of a small state in the southern United States where his ancestors had been slaves. In this way Henry gets to know his new political family: the brilliant strategist Richard, the enterprising Libby and Daisy, a young and seductive mass media scientist. But above all he discovers Jack and Susan Stanton, their charisma and their weaknesses.
notes: The film was made in 1997 (when the Sexgate Overseas was already in the air), the script is the sharp Elaine May, the actors are a perfect Travolta (who in the original literally "mimics" the voice of Bill Clinton) and an impeccable Thompson in the role of the first lady. Yet, Mike Nichols (who also proved to be fierce) directed the film with rather flat predictability, without bringing out the artisan grit demonstrated, for example, by Barry Levinson in "Sex & Power" (another story on the subject) .

title: Matrimoni
actors: Diego Abatantuono, Francesca Neri, Stefania Sandrelli, Cecilia Dazzi
description: While the city is preparing for the most beautiful night of the year Giulia sees Fausto, a lover of her from Trani. Suddenly she realizes that she has given up an important part of herself to build that perfect marriage that everyone envies her. So while he is at the station to receive relatives, he gets on a departing train triggering chain reactions.
notes: Nice Italian film that wants to entertain the public without making use of specks. Poised between the utopia of the perfect marriage and the inevitable desire for transgression, Cristina Comencini goes on the trail of the best Italian comedy.

title: X-Files The Movie
actors: Gillian Anderson, David Duchovny, John Neville, Martin Landau
description: Thirty-five thousand years ago a group of stonemen awakened a bloodthirsty creature imprisoned in a cave surrounded by ice with the heat of their torches. Today in the same cave disappears first a boy, then four firefighters who have been called. As the authorities try to hide what happened, Dana Scully and Fox Mulder begin their investigation.
notes: Directed by Rob Bowman, who has 23 episodes of the television serial to his credit, the film is a big-screen puntatona, with one of the most blatantly open endings in the history of cinema. Soundtrack that Sting and Bjork, Noel Gallagher and the Cure can afford, but which - despite the theme (among other old men) - finds it hard to infect, to thicken arcane and enigmas. Only for teleaficionados.

title: Crna macka, beli macor
actors: Srdjan Todorovic, Florijan Ajdini, Bajram Severdzan, Sabri Sulejman
description: Grga Pitic, gypsy godfather and landfill tycoon, and Zarije, owner of a cement factory, are great old friends despite not seeing each other for over 25 years. The latter's son, Matko is a wimp unable to ask his father for help. For this he turns to Grga to borrow money to close a deal on the black market. To secure the necessary amount of money, Matko tells Grga that his father is dead.
notes: After all, history is of little interest. The constant noise, the overwhelming music, the discoveries and the characters by the dozen, the unpredictable situations count. In addition to the men, the animals count: geese in flocks, the white kitten and the black one, a pig that during the film has time to eat an entire car. Certain unlikely objects also count, such as a rocking bed or an accessorized scooter. Kusturica continues to have an eye for small things, for quick, freshly sketched portraits that pop up all the time and crowd every shot.

title: Arrapaho
actors: Alfredo Cerruti, Daniele Pace, Totò Savio, Giancarlo Bigazzi, Tinì Cansino
description: The Arrapahos tribe and the Froceyennes tribe live on the same territory, but coexistence between them is not easy. The great boss Arrapaho would like to marry Armpit Piebald, but the squaw was betrothed to Crazy Horse by his father Palla Pesante. The latter is very busy invoking the rain gods and doing crazy soliloquies with a rocking horse. But one day Armpit Piebald runs away with his love and on Cavallo Pazzo all that remains is to take refuge in the arms of one of the members of the Froceyennes tribe.
notes: The comedy is at a minimum. After all, translating the Squallor album of the same name into images must have been a titanic undertaking.

title: The Night of the Living Dead
actors: Duane Jones, Judith O'Dea, Russell Streiner, Karl Hardman, Judith Riley
description: In the state of Pennsylvania, as a result of the radiation from a space probe that has returned from the planet Venus, the dead not yet buried come back to life hungry for human flesh. In an isolated cottage on the edge of the woods, Ben and Barbara, an engaged couple, and a couple find themselves surrounded by a group of hideous creatures.
notes: A classic of horror cinema, which reformed the genre by deeply affecting the subsequent imagery. <Shot in black and white at very low cost, it was a huge success and still today impresses with its hallucinatory rhythm and apocalyptic tones. I>

title: Non sparate sui bambini - Squadra antisequestro
actors: Giancarlo Prete, Italo Gasperini, Antonella Lualdi, Giampiero Albertini
description: The Settimi family has long been plagued by bad luck. The head of the family, a widower in his fifties, is affected by silicosis and takes care of the house as best he can. The eldest son, Dino, is the only support of the family, but one day he is fired on the spot and gets involved in a robbery. The blow, however, goes badly and the members of the gang take a school group hostage.
notes: Film with claims of social denunciation that however only has the purpose of tickling the strings of emotion.

title: Inspector Clouseau
actors: Alan Arkin, Frank Finlay, Delia Boccardo, Patrick Cargill, Anthony Ainley
description: The confusing title inspector is called in by Scotland Yard to prevent a robbery. Of course Clouseau, although he does not prevent it, makes it easier, but then, but always by chance, to put things back in order.
notes: It is the third episode of the "Pink Panther" series, the first not played by Peter Sellers. And it shows. The cunning of the producers was at the time also pointed out by the spectators at the box office.

title: Il grande colpo dei sette uomini d'oro
actors: Rossana Podestà, Philippe Leroy, Gastone Moschin, Gabriele Tinti
description: Caught red-handed during a robbery in Rome, the seven golden men and the Professor, their leader, instead of being punished by the Great Power in whose net they have ended up, are charged with carrying out a delicate political mission. Our men intend, however, to exploit the situation to steal 7,000 tons of gold. So with an atomic submarine and the most modern electronic devices, the seven brilliantly solve the task entrusted to them and at the same time seize the gold. Sequel to the "Seven Golden Men", more blatantly comic and less fortunate. The rhythm with respect to the first epidose has dropped vertically.

title: Out on a Limb
actors: Matthew Broderick, Jeffrey Jones, Heidi Kling, John C. Reilly
description: A yuppie, you know, is practically inseparable from his "24 hours" briefcase. What happens if he happens to suffer a robbery whose stolen property consists of the precious bag? The fact is that the criminals, in addition to the little money in cash, do not know that the real treasure they have stolen is a telephone number so important as to be worth ... 160 million dollars. Naturally, the yuppie does not give up and, after several adventures and after desperately looking for him a bit everywhere, he finds that number ... where he least expected it.
notes: Little laughs despite the skill of Francis Veber fleeing from French cinema where he directed decent comic films.

title: Gli inaffidabili
actors: Jerry Calà, Gigi Sabani, Leo Gullotta, Serena Grandi, Anna Kanakis, Gian, Nini Salerno, Novello Novelli
description: Like every year, a group of friends gathers in a large villa-hotel to spend Easter Monday. This time what appears to be a simple reunion turns into something more serious. Renato, the landlord, would like to free himself from his wife Cinzia and his father-in-law who are the real owners of everything. Michele, separated, arrives with his Russian friend and his 18-year-old daughter. Nino TV presenter is haunted by the doubt that he has AIDS. For their part, Fulvio and Diego play jokes on everyone and mingle with other characters who animate the party. Eventually everyone leaves without having done anything.
notes: Parade of second-rate TV stars, with claims to costume criticism. But why does Calà persist in being a director?

title: Alta tension
actors: Marisa Mell, Gabriele Ferzetti, Juan Luis Gallardo, Patrizia Adiutori
description: José, a young mechanic from the village of Avila, arrives in Madrid, after having withdrawn all his savings, with the intention of gaining a leading position. Deceived by Felipe, who makes him lose a lot of money, he finds consolation in the arms of Elisa, a photographer with whom he begins to live together. One day he meets the spouses Pablo and Laura, counts of Moncada, becomes the woman's lover and commits a murder. His troubles are just beginning ...

title: Le voleur des crîmes
actors: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Robert Hossein, Florinda Bolkan, Giorgia Moll
description: Jean Girod, married and father of two children, is a deeply bored man and when chance makes him witness the strange suicide of a woman he thinks he is taking the blame and sends an anonymous letter to the newspapers. Jean is not satisfied with a single letter, he sends others and enjoys the interest that the case arouses among his friends. All of a sudden, however, public opinion and the press, advised by the police, stop dealing with the case. Later he meets Florinda, a model lover of a painter friend of his, with her in the car he returns to the place of suicide and suddenly feels overcome by a strange desire ...

title: La terrazza
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Vittorio Gassman, Jean-Louis Trintignant, Stefania Sandrelli
description: We are in Rome on a terrace where a group of friends and acquaintances, all belonging to the bourgeoisie, gathers to spend the summer evenings. There is Enrico, a screenwriter in crisis, Amedeo, a film producer who made himself from scratch, absolutely devoid of culture. Then there is Galeazzo, who returned from Venezuela to find friends and a job, and Mario, a deputy from the Communist Party.
notes: Scola's film, a merciless and misogynistic self-critical portrait of the left bourgeoisie, remains one of the director's best today. A bitter and final comedy, with an acute screenplay by Age and Scarpelli.

title: Le tonnerre de Dieu
actors: Jean Gabin, Michèle Mercier, Robert Hossein, Lilli Palmer
description: The veterinarian Leandro lives in his castle with his wife Marie, whom he neglects to devote himself to dogs and horses. The man, who is used to returning home after heavy drinking full of strays, beggars and beggars, one evening introduces a young prostitute, Simone, to his resigned wife. The girl accepts the hospitality offered by the couple and gives herself to her soul to defend it from the protector who demands her "restitution".
notes: Well written comedy, with a self-deprecating old Gabin and the magnificent Mercier.

title: The Phantom of the Opera
actors: Edward de Souza, Herbert Lom, Heather Sears, Thorley Walters
description: In the opera house, a mysterious ghost goes to great lengths to try to prevent the performance of Lord d'Arcy's "Joan of Arc". He is not exactly a saint's shin because he has repeatedly shown himself to be cowardly and cruel to his employees to the point of firing a young singer who dared to resist him and the entrepreneur who defended her. The latter two love each other, but one day suddenly the singer disappears. At this point the entrepreneur begins the research that leads him to discover that ...
notes: Scripted by John Elder based on Lubin's version, it displeased Terence Fisher fans at the time.

title: Caccia all'uomo
actors: Eleonora Rossi Drago, Yvonne Furneaux, Umberto Orsini, Andrea Checchi
description: After killing a notary and kidnapping a girl, the Sicilian bandit Mazzarò went into hiding. Inspector Nardelli hunts him, helped in the investigation by the nose of Dox, a magnificent police dog. Just Dox is decisive in finding the Mazzarò refuge and in freeing the kidnapped child. The dog is thus awarded a medal. The adventures of Dox and Nardelli are not over: back in Rome, the two have to contend with a gang of drug traffickers.
notes: Decades ahead of Commissioner Rex but lagging behind Rin Tin Tin, Italy too had its champion dog of justice. Negligible food film by a master of Italian genre cinema.

title: Il ragazzo dal kimono d'oro - Il ritorno di Joe Carson
actors: Christopher Alan, Richard Goon, Larry Jones
description: Miami, Florida. Larry Jones is celebrating with his friends the victory of his last fight. Meanwhile, his eternal enemy, Joe Carson comes out of reform school and introduces himself to Larry to challenge him to a kung fu match. Larry turns to the Japanese master Masura to prepare him for this latest challenge. Sixth episode of the series, as bad as everyone else.

title: Gritos en la noche
actors: Conrad San Martin, Julie Hamilton, John Sullivan, Dyana Lorys
description: Dr. Orloff, a former physician and talented scientist who worked in state prisons, wants to save Melissa, his daughter, horribly disfigured by an explosion in his research laboratory. In his desperate attempt, Orloff does not hesitate to commit gruesome crimes using Morpho, a murderous maniac.
notes: Frankenstein, Mabuse, Mister Hyde and above all "The Hyena" by Robert Wise. Jesus Franco, according to legend the most prolific director in the world, is a kind of shredder of the horror imaginary. Here he "spits out" a story that is a delusion. Don't look for consistency because there isn't. But at least you have fun.

title: Cartas boca arriba
actors: Eddie Constantine, Françoise Brion, Fernando Rey, Mara Kelly
description: A mysterious criminal organization that intends to conquer the world transforms some individuals with a very rare blood type into authentic killer automatons. The crimes, which follow one another at an incessant pace, affect illustrious political figures from various countries. Interpol, given vain attempts to identify the base of the organization, decides to entrust the investigation to James Clint, an agent who has long retired. All the stereotypes of the spy, and even of the silent "serials", in a film directed with humor, and a few more lira than usual, by a master of the Z series. The demented ending discovers, in fact, the cards.

title: La venganza del Dottor Mabuse
actors: Fred Williams, Ewa Stronberg, Jack Taylor, Roberto Camardiel
description: Doctor Farkas, as he now calls himself Doctor Mabuse, and his friend Hermann, steal moonstones necessary for the construction of a beam that has the power to remotely control a human being. The experiments involve young and cute strippers kidnapped by the monster Andros. Inspector Thomas will have to step in to resolve the case.
notes: What might the great Fritz Lang think when he knew that his creature, Dr. Mabuse, ended up in the hands of the director of "Karzan against women with naked breasts"? But let's not shoot on Jess Franco, who has always been a talent, albeit from the Z series!

title: La noche de los asesinos
actors: Alberto Dalbes, Evelyn Scott, William Berger, Maribel Hidalgo
description: Everything revolves around the death of Lord Archibald Percival, killed by a masked assassin. His conspicuous inheritance is at stake, to which various relatives aspire, most of whom, however, die in the course of the investigation. The dead man is not actually the real Lord, who instead is taking revenge on his snake relatives. Low-cost thriller with truly delusional moments, it's a classic example of Franco's trashy surrealism.

title: Le cri du couer
actors: Richard Bohringer, Saïd Diarra, Félicité Wouassi, Alex Descas
description: Little Moctar must leave his Mali village to reach, together with his mother, his father who has been emigrating for some time in France and finally able to keep them. Once arrived, he cannot settle in the new country. He has a recurring nightmare: a hyena that hunts him.
notes: Born in Burkina Faso (ex high vault) with a chair of cinema at the Sorbona in Paris, the highly awarded director Ouédraogo creates a poetic work, traveled by tenderness of gaze, also in the unprecedented and frenetic urban setting, and by cleaning of style.

title: Perfect Prey
actors: D. W. Moffett, Kelly McGillis, Bruce Dern, David Keith
description: Audrey MacLeah (McGillis) is a police investigator who specializes in sexually motivated murder cases. She herself was the victim of a rape when she attended university many years earlier and has not yet overcome the trauma. Her direct superior, Captain Swaggert (Dern), entrusts her with a delicate investigation into the deaths of some women, victims of sexual violence. Paratelevisivo without infamy and without praise, with actors once more famous.

title: Waxwork 2: Lost in Time
actors: Zach Galligan, Monika Schnarre, Martin Kemp, Bruce Campbell
description: A couple is chased by a dismembered hand that killed the girl's father and for which she was accused. The lawyers don't believe the incredible story the woman told them. So the girl and her boyfriend go to Sir Wilfred's house to look for clues. Instead, the two find a film that Sir Wilfred has prepared and which does not clear them. The two then take over the time machine to try to find out the truth but end up getting into even bigger trouble ...
notes: Negligible horror film with Bruce Campbell seen in Sam Raimi's "Army of Darkness".

title: The Big Picture
actors: Kevin Bacon, J.T. Walsh, Michael McKean, Teri Hatcher
description: Nick is a young man of high hopes, fresh out of university, infected by the sacred fire of cinema. Cleverly capitalizing on Nick's aspirations, a shrewd, middle-of-the-road producer offers to finance a project for him. Nick's script is a dark drama set in a freezing winter. Little by little the producer, with skilful deceptions, convinces the young man to transform the story into a laughing farce of a seaside setting.
notes: Directorial debut for the actor Christopher Guest who puts the vices of Hollywood and its undergrowth to shame. The parodic intent tends rather to farce. Parts for various stars (Elliott Gould, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Martin Short, John Cleese).

title: Halloween: the Curse of Michael Myers
actors: Donald Pleasence, Paul Rudd, Marianne Hagan, Mitch Ryan
description: In Haddonfield, a quiet American town, Halloween has long been the deadliest day of the year, since a six-year-old boy, Michael Myers, began killing all members of his family in 1978. Escaped from the asylum in which he was locked up at the time of the first massacre, the bloodthirsty maniac promptly returns to the town of Haddonfield to thin out his family tree. It's been six years since the last time and everyone thinks Michael died in a fire, but that's not the case.
notes: At the sixth episode they are all tired, and no one knows what to pull out to revive the saga.

title: Nemesis
actors: Stuart Damon, Alexandra Bastedo, William Gaunt, Felly Aylmer
description: The NATO command has been on the alert for some time because mysterious rays seem to emanate from a remote island in the South Atlantic, which trigger the atomic safety devices of the great powers. After several attempts to invade the island have failed, the assignment is given to three agents, two men and a woman, who, during a mission in Tibet, have received extrasensory powers. Fantasy adventure movie, without quality.

title: Prostituzione
actors: Maria Fiore, Elio Zamuto, Krista Nell, Orchidea De Santis
description: Giselle is found killed in a grove near a place where prostitutes gather. Commissioner Macaluso, in charge of the investigation, questions all the "professionals" of the area and learns that the girl was a high -edge ring. In the meantime, he discovers that Benedetta, raped by some young people, is avenged by his protectors, who Immaculate always embarments in customers with particular tastes. After long investigations and taking advantage of the help of Dr. Rossi, mature and unsuspected guard, the commissioner identifies the culprit. The yellow structure is a pretext for exhibiting the beauty of the cast. Only for Patiti of the Italian Trash of the 1970s.

title: Apt Pupil
actors: Brad Renfro, Ian McKellen, Bruce Davison, David Schwimmer, Joshua Jackson, Mickey Cottrell, Michael Reid MacKey, Ann Dowd, Bruce Davison, James Karen, Marjorie Lovett, David Cooley, Blake Anthony Tibbetts, Heather McComb, Katherine Malone, Grace Sinden
description: Todd, a sixteen-year-old boy, is dangerously passionate about Nazi history. During the search he accidentally recognizes a man on a bus who, at the time of the Holocaust, was an SS officer. The young man, driven by a morbid curiosity, shows up at the old man's house and begins to blackmail him; in exchange for the gruesome stories and memories of the terrible disasters caused in the concentration camps, he will not report him to the authorities.
notes: Based on Stephen King's "A Smart Boy", the film is developed along conventional lines. From the director of "The usual suspects" we certainly expected more, also because the theme of "evil" was certainly congenial to him.

title: Più leggero non basta
actors: Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Stefano Accorsi, Lorenza Indovina
description: Marco, a young architect, works with his girlfriend Claudia in a recently opened studio when he receives the precept card for the civil service.
