The next day he takes up service at a body that deals with the defense of people suffering from muscular dystrophy. He soon meets the person to whom he will have to dedicate his assistance, Elena, a girl who, although struck by the disease, is active within the organization.

title: Un nero per casa
actors: Gigi Proietti, Sandra Collodel, Eliana Miglio, Nicola Pistoia, Gisella Sofio
description: Lorenzo is an architect who cultivates the dream of creating a multi-ethnic cultural center in a degraded area of ??his city. His project stems from the fact that he lived there in that neighborhood and in the buildings that were partially destroyed. But when Lorenzo learns that his daughter has fallen in love with a black non-EU citizen, everything seems to collapse on him. His militancy in left-wing parties and his known tolerance towards black people also changes radically. And his project, to which he has dedicated so much effort, ends up taking a back seat to the "black in the house".

title: Romeo and Juliet
actors: Margot Fonteyn, Rudolph Nureyev, David Blair, Desmond Doyle
description: In the market square of Verona, Tebaldo dei Capuleti and Romeo dei Montecchi face off in a duel but the arrival of the prince manages to make them give up. Juliet, daughter of Messer Capuleti, was betrothed to Paris but during a party she meets Romeo and falls in love with him. In the meantime Romeo, who has secretly married Juliet with the help of Friar Lorenzo, is thinking of avenging the killing of his friend Mercutio.
notes: Great and memorable interpreters of the Royal Ballet of London in MacMillan's staging of the famous ballet by Prokofiev-Lavrovskij staged the year before in the English capital. Direction adds nothing to ballet, and is also a bit boring for non-fans.

title: The Wind Cannot Read
actors: Dirk Borgade, Yoko Tani, Ronald Lewis, John Fraser, Anthony Bishell
description: During the war in the Far East, two British officers, Michael and Peter, miraculously escaped capture by the Japanese. Back at the base, they are offered to take a Japanese language course. The course, of course, is very difficult and Michael discouraged, tries in every way to distract himself. One day he enters a bar and is hit by a beautiful oriental girl. The next day he learns that it is the new teacher Sabby. The two end up becoming friends, lovers and eventually spouses, but the girl is afflicted with a terrible disease.
notes: Drammone with an excellent Bogarde, but today it is very dated. > I>

title: Labbra rosse
actors: Gabriele Ferzetti, Jeanne Valerie, Christine Kaufman, Giorgio Albertazzi
description: The teenage daughter of a serious family man goes missing on a trip. The parent starts looking for her in the youth circles frequented by the girl. It is a world absolutely unknown to him made of unscrupulousness and even a pinch of madness. Accompanying him in what for him is a real "descent into hell" is a friend of his daughter whose man ends up falling in love ...
notes: Even a few years before sixty-eight certain themes were naturally already in the air. Bennati sniffs them properly, but draws a poorly constructed pastiche from them. Even the grotesque of the situation is felt only at times.

title: Barriera
actors: Jan Nowicki, Joanna Szczerbic, Tadeusz Lomnicki, Maria Malicka
description: In Warsaw, in the sixties, on the evening before Easter, a young high school student leaves his past behind and goes around the streets of the city carrying a suitcase with everything that belongs to him. . In his nocturnal wanderings he meets a girl who drives a tram with which he will try to start believing in love again.
notes: Between the cynicism and indifference of the fathers who made a great contribution to the birth of socialist Poland, Skolimowski, still light years away from his "flight" to the West, shows us the crisis of a generation. At the time, the film was not very successful. Music by jazzman Krszysztof Koumeda.

title: Rysopis
actors: Jerzy Skolimowski, Elszbeta Czyzawska
description: Andrzej has to leave for military service and decides to spend the last day of freedom before the call to arms walking half-heartedly through the streets of Warsaw. The possibility of starting a new life and meeting a girl upset his life.
notes: Debut of one of the main Polish directors and masterpiece of the Nouvelle Vague made in Warsaw, who, before going behind the camera, had even been a boxer (and has always remained a bit "quarrelsome"). It remains one of his most beautiful works, because it makes us perceive the breath of freedom that somehow animated it.

title: No Recourse
actors: Rachel Ward, Terry O'Quinn, Joshua Morrow, Mark Joy, Al Wiggins
description: Caitlin, a nurse, marries Eric Cory, a rich and charismatic man much older than her. A few months after the wedding, the woman becomes involved in a love story with Richard, Eric's first bed son, a young man as ambitious and powerful as his father. The woman is torn between the two until an accident precipitates the situation. Now Caitlin will have to choose.
notes: Can you condense a soap opera into 88 minutes? Almost impossible, you will say, yet there is always someone who tries or, at least, who mixes the same ingredients of the soap opera and concentrates them in a single episode. Seeing is believing.

title: L'ultimo giorno di scuola prima delle vacanze di Natale
actors: Luca Bonicalzi, Riccardo Cucciolla, Delia Boccardo, Lino Capolicchio
description: Emilia Romagna, 1944. A group of women and Athos a poor student from a working class took their seats on board a rickety bus, reduced to a wreck that puffs at every bend on the Apennine roads. The bus is stopped by the republicans, two men and a woman, unleashed fascists, collaborators of the Germans. All the members of the group are killed, including Athos who is found abandoned and naked on the banks of a stream.
notes: The film reconstructs with documentary technique a historical period discussed and full of violence. The episode didn't really happen but it was invented from scratch by the director and the writers.

title: Zoya
actors: Melissa Gilbert, Cameron Brancroft, Bruce Boxleitner, Tom Laughlin
description: Zoya is a beautiful young Russian aristocrat related to the Tsar. During the 1917 revolution, Zoya lost both parents and was orphaned. He manages to leave St. Petersburg, thus escaping the horrors of the war and the consequences (dire for a girl of the nobility left alone) of the revolution, and moves to Paris. In the French capital, she meets an American who marries her and takes her with him to New York. But he too dies leaving her with two children to raise. But the strength of despair will lead her, with great difficulty, to become a successful business woman. Only after having also thought about the future of her grandchildren, will the poignant desire to see her homeland again after decades of being away.
notes: An American fable full of dramatic situations resolved superficially and with narrative solutions often marked by an improbability dictated by optimism at any cost.

title: Last Dance
actors: Sharon Stone, Rob Morrow, Randy Quaid, Peter Gallagher
description: Inmate Cindy Liggett, found guilty of a horrendous crime, has been locked up on death row for twelve years awaiting execution. Now, after a long series of unnerving postponements and false hopes, the woman feels ready to face the gallows. Faced with the rush of time and the inexorable decrease of the days, the only thing that finds her unprepared is the report that Rick, a young official, spreads out. From these investigations, a series of errors emerged that led to an unjust sentence. Rick thus takes on the task of re-examining the Liggett case and attempting to have the process repeated. Rather crude judicial drama, with the sole merit of offering Sharon Stone a "busy" role.

title: Critters 2: The Main Course
actors: Terence Mann, Don Keith Opper, Cynthia Garris, Scott Grimes
description: An entire brood of Critter's unopened eggs are mistaken for Easter eggs by the townspeople of Grover's Bend. Once hatched, the eggs give life to the terrible creatures that wreak havoc on all the inhabitants. The intervention of some willing people who try in every way to stop them is worth nothing.
notes: If the first episode was weak let alone this one. The bites, the town and the ruminating of teeth is always the same as well as the boredom of the spectators. The cast is absolutely anonymous and the direction adapts to it without problems. Only visible for enthusiasts or teenagers.

title: Jericho Fever
actors: Perry King, Stephanie Zimbalist, Alan Scarfe, Andrew Brye
description: We are in the New Mexico desert, where military secret laboratories have isolated terrible viruses useful for the so-called biological warfare. In an attempt to get hold of such a "weapon" a group of terrorists storm the laboratory, but something goes wrong and the criminals are all contaminated. Lost for lost they decide to become authentic "human bombs" and to spread the epidemic among the population. An FBI agent and two doctors, however, get on their heels and manage to eliminate them all before they do any damage. All but one, their ferocious leader, the only one, however, in possession of the antibodies capable of definitively warding off the infection.

title: Viaggio con Anita
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Goldie Hawn, Claudine Auger, Laura Betti, Renzo Montagnani
description: Guido, a Roman bank manager, is informed by his sister Oriana that his father Armando is seriously ill. He immediately leaves his wife Elisa and with their son he drives to reach Rosignano Solvay, his hometown. Determined to make the journey in sweet company, he goes to Jennifer's apartment, his mistress whom he hasn't seen for months. But the woman doesn't want to know. In its place comes Anita, a 27-year-old American who is in Italy to try to track down an Italian architect she met in Chicago. Monicelli signs an uncertain and interlocutory film, with a couple of actors not well matched.

title: Koroshi
actors: Patrick McGoohan, Yoko Tani, Amanda Barrie, Ronald Howard
description: The United Nations learns of the existence of a dangerous organization that is spreading terror and panic in Japan. The K3B agent is charged with the case, under whose guise Ako Nakamura is hiding but the girl is killed. In his place agent Dick Carter is called who with the precious help of Rosemarie manages to find out who is hiding behind the murderous sect.
notes: Along the lines of the James Bond films that were raging at the time, the merger of two episodes of the British TV series "Secret Agent".

title: Barbara
actors: Valerio Mastandrea, Marco Giallini, Jacqueline Lustig, Giorgio Molino
description: Aldo and Pino decide to try something perverse, but they end up getting involved in a shocking misadventure. At Barbara's house, a friend of one of the two with bdsm tendencies, they are chained to the bed and left there for a whole night. Is this a strange joke? An unexpected event? The wait for the return of the woman becomes more and more spasmodic and triggers between the two conflicts that never subsided ...
notes: As a good stage-goer, Orlando prefers the unity of place, time and space, ending up moving in forty square meters of an Italy seen through a keyhole. High ambitions, still immature direction.

title: What Dreams May Come
actors: Robin Williams, Cuba Gooding jr., Annabella Sciorra, Max Von Sydow
description: Chris and Annie have a beautiful home, two jobs that satisfy them, a son and a daughter. In short, everything seems to be going well. Then a chain of tragedies ensues: both boys die in a car accident, Annie commits suicide, Chris can't rest. The man in turn loses his life in an accident and finds himself in Paradise, where he would like to track down his children and his wife ...
notes: Without a doubt, one of the worst films of the end of the millennium. A concentrate of New Age molasses with suffocating special effects. Too bad for Annabella Sciorra, who didn't deserve to be involved in such stuff.

title: The Negotiator
actors: Samuel L. Jackson, Kevin Spacey, David Morse, J.T. Walsh
description: Danny Roman works for the Chicago PD, with the delicate task of negotiating with kidnappers and freaks. Speaking of the latter, one just happened to him threatening to kill his own daughter if he didn't get to see his wife again, who had rightly left him. But even on this occasion, Danny dealt with the situation coldly and hit the mark: his colleagues esteem and envy him, and his wife loves him deeply. But then things change quickly: his best friend and colleague Nathan is murdered, and he himself finds himself stuck in a dirty game of corruption. Obviously it has nothing to do with it, but how to convince the former "allies"? The solution is paradoxical, but it is the only feasible one: reversing the parts, turning into (apparent) crazy. For once, therefore, it will not be he who has to negotiate, but an outsider, a policeman from another district who will have to do everything to ensure a minimum of serene objectivity. It is Danny himself who points out his name: Chris Sabian.
notes: Perhaps too long, the director's film of the underrated "Set It Off" is an action thriller of livid sheen, with above-average acting performances. Dedicated to the great character actor J.T. Walsh, who suffered a heart attack immediately after filming.

title: The Big Hit
actors: Mark Wahlberg, Lou Diamond Phillips, Christina Applegate, Avery Brooks
description: Melvin is young, sensitive, cute, orphaned and in need of affection. His job is thankless, in fact he is a serial killer for the Paris boss and has a solid reputation for efficiency. But his two girlfriends are increasingly in need of money, so he has to take an extra job from colleague Cisco which involves kidnapping the daughter of a Japanese industrialist. For Melvin "angel face" serious troubles begin ...
notes: The Hong Kong diaspora continues and after John Woo and Jackie Chan this time it's up to Che-Kirk Wong to show us his mastery, on which Wesley Snipes (producer) and John Woo (executive producer) have also bet. Action, thriller and sentimental comedy are intertwined in a blending of genres conducted at supersonic speed The film can be remembered even for a couple of moments of comedy and offers cinephiles a tasty series of imitations.

title: La seconda moglie
actors: Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Giorgio Noé, Lazar Ristovski, Jessica Auriemma
description: In the very hot summer of 1957, in Tuscany, the truck driver Fosco returns to the country with his single mother Anna, found in Sicily and chosen as second wife after an early widowhood. Both Fosco is sanguine and visceral, as Anna is shy. Because Fosco is jealous and Livio, the son of the first bed, is inexorably attracted to the woman.
notes: The playwright Chiti likes acting cinema with flawless narrative mechanisms. A "perfection" that allows you to restore the vintage atmosphere but that surrounds the film in a space that is too closed. Ristovski ("Underground") is credible in the role of the toscanaccio; but the Cucinotta is denied.

title: Jolly Blu
actors: Max Pezzali, Alessia Merz, Sabrina Salerno, Kimberly Ann Greene
description: A group of friends usually meet at Jolly Blu, a bar that is a point of reference for all young people in the area. But their usual haunt is about to be closed, a furrier should rise in its place. The boys work hard to prevent this and confess their love stories, disappointments and failures to the confessor bartender.
notes: Videoclippone created by the handyman DJ Claudio Cecchetto, directed by Stefano Salvati, a specialist in songs unfolded in images. The operation is declared, humble and simple and the promises - seasoned with cameos by Jovanotti, Saturnino, Natalia Estrada and Sabrina Salerno - are kept.

title: The Myth of Fingerprints
actors: Julianne Moore, Arija Bareikis, Blythe Danner, Roy Scheider
description: Four siblings return to their parents' home in New England to participate in the Thanksgiving celebrations after three long years of absence. During the weekend, very intense moments alternate with funny moments and the four boys accompanied by their respective companions learn firsthand that sometimes family relationships have more to do with loss than with love.
notes: A debut that comes from the challenge of trying to write three different sex scenes (which later, in the film, will have their own well-defined metaphorical place), which starts from Pinter's inspirations (especially "Betrayals", played in the theater by the couple Roy Scheider / Blythe Danner, present here in the roles of the parents), which develops following an idea of ??intimate and independent cinema, where nuances count much more than easy appearances. The film, through the story of a family that gathers around the inevitable turkey for the most important day in the Yankee tradition, is the paradigm of what we can define a "genre" born from the experience of Robert Redford's Sundance Film Festival: an "interiors" cinema (and Woody Allen's work of '78 is another essential point of reference), in which Hollywood does not live.

title: Out of Sight
actors: George Clooney, Jennifer Lopez, Ving Rhames, Don Cheadle
description: Forty-year-old Jack, a Florida penitentiary, has two decades of bank robbery behind him without ever using guns over the course of his career, but often got caught red-handed. He is currently serving a sentence of thirty years but he does not think about staying in prison. As he is about to escape he runs into Karen, a policewoman with a passion for daredevils, and takes her hostage.
notes: Okay that he debuted in 1989 with "Sex, lies and videotape" and won at Cannes. After that, however, he did not guess one. This time he ran under the protective wings of a genre film and an Elmore Leonard novel. If you look closely, there is a bit of everything you need to make a good film noir. There is everything but the direction, the timing, and the whole does not rise; it staggers forward and we cling to our desires. Especially to see Jennifer Lopez properly.

title: La vie rêvée des anges
actors: Elodie Bouchez, Natacha Régnier, Grégoire Colin, Agnes Godart
description: Isa is twenty years old, a backpacker and a very fatalistic cheerful philosophy. She arrives in Lille after other stops in search of a job to help her make ends meet. In a tailor's shop she meets Marie, twenty years old too, alone, hypersensitive and closed in her revolt against everything and everyone. A friendship is born that resembles a mutual adoption and that leads them to make new friends and pursue new loves.
notes: A well-deserved award, the Palme d'Or in Cannes for the best female interpretation awarded to the brunette Bouchez and the blonde Régnier. A somewhat old-fashioned story, written (with Roger Bohbot) and directed by the newcomer Zonca, who however knows how to use images of modernity and which, coherently, ends with a decisive message. It does not disdain the emotion button, but, at the moment of the tragedy, it can be dry, sudden, unappealable.

title: The Opposite of Sex
actors: Christina Ricci, Martin Donovan, Lisa Kudrow, Lyle Lovett
description: DeDee at sixteen knows life well perhaps too much. She left her home in Louisiana to go to her stepbrother Bill to turn his life upside down. A hardworking English teacher, Bill is gay. He lives in a small town in Indiana, is left alone and rich after his lover died of AIDS and is trying to rebuild a life with Matt. DeDee irresistibly attracted to Matt decides to take him away from his brother.
notes: Good, this film by Don Roos, New Yorker, born in 1955, screenwriter and new director. As a good storyteller, Roos knows how to set up and move characters, relationships, situations; he also knows how to write flavorful dialogue with lines after lines.

title: Ever After A Cinderella Story
actors: Drew Barrymore, Anjelica Huston, Dougray Scott, Patrick Godfrey
description: Danielle is a sixteenth century girl who has a passion for books and easily quotes Thomas More's Utopia. She has enough charm and energy to make a prince invaghire after getting his attention by hitting him with an apple. Danielle does not wait for the prince to come to her rescue but offers to guide him and save his life.
notes: Played by a dynamic Drew Barrymore, Cinderella is a woman who is more in step with our times than with the sixteenth-century ones of the film. Carefully made, the film does not take itself seriously and is appreciated for a pleasant irony that has its samples in the perfidious but nice stepmother Rodmilla (Anjelica Huston) and in Leonardo da Vinci, genius inventor, true "deus ex machina" of the film .

title: The Red Violin
actors: Carlo Cecchi, Jean-Luc Bideau, Jason Flemyng, Sylvia Chang, Samuel L. Jackson
description: Cremona, 1600. Waiting for the birth of his first son, the master luthier Nicolò Bussotti begins the construction of his masterpiece, the best violin that has ever seen the light. But when the wife dies during childbirth, what was supposed to be her homage to the new born becomes a true obsession that will cross the centuries, arousing passion and obsession in every existence she comes into contact with.
notes: From the director of "32 small films about Glenn Gould", a fake international superproduction, which suffocates under the continuous passages from the seventeenth century, to the years of the French Revolution, to the Chinese Cultural Revolution, to the present day. For those who are satisfied, there is Greta Scacchi without veils in a frankly ridiculous scene of sexual-artistic passion.

title: The Miracle of Our Lady of Fatima
actors: Gilbert Roland, Angela Clarke, Frank Silvera, Susan Whitney, Sherry Jackson, Sammy Ogg
description: The film re-proposes the story of the Marial apparitions in Fatima, Portugal. We are in 1917 and the country has recently become a republic. The secular government begins a work of persecution of the church and its ministers although the majority of the population is still strongly linked to the Catholic tradition. Here, in a desolate place, Mary of Nazareth appears to three little shepherds promising to return every month. Although the authorities try to discourage the faithful from rushing in, a multitude soon follows the visionaries until ...
notes: Classic hagiographic film in the purest Hollywood style (see "Bernadette" from nine years earlier). Today unwatchable, even if they serve it every 13 May.

title: Saving Private Ryan
actors: Tom Hanks, Matt Damon, Tom Sizemore, Edward Burns, Barry Pepper
description: On June 6, 1944, the American soldiers commanded by Captain John Miller are preparing for the landing in Normandy. During the landing, Captain Miller is ordered to take his squad of soldiers across enemy lines to find and rescue Private Ryan, the only survivor of four brothers.
notes: There are many war films, developed one inside the other to render fear, hatred, brotherhood, nothingness: Fuller's laconic hardness, Aldrich's bloody baroque, Kubrick's mocking ferocity, Ford. It is not the triumphalism of the "Longest Day", erased by fear and doubt. But the dirty work of the private must be done. Five Academy Awards: direction, photography (Janusz Kaminski), editing (Michael Kahn), sound and sound effects.

title: Snake Eyes
actors: Nicolas Cage, Gary Sinise, John Heard, Carla Gugino, Stan Shaw
description: During a boxing match, valid for the conquest of the heavyweight title, the American Minister of Defense is assassinated. Suddenly the fourteen thousand spectators all become potential witnesses and potential killers. Kevin, the naval officer in charge of his protection, and Rick, a friend of his, a police officer involved in a corruption incident, begin the investigation.
notes: A visually enveloping and shocking puzzle, opened by a 20-minute sequence shot experienced by Nicolas Cage, then dismantled and denied piece by piece by the flashbacks of other subjective (sometimes lying) and by the television slow motion. Unpredictably, it is the camera that, through the sparkle of a ruby ??revealed by a very slow moving forward (attention, it reaches the end of the credits), for once proves to be sharper than any camera.

title: Il fantasma dell'Opera
actors: Asia Argento, Julian Sands, Andrea Di Stefano, Coralina Cataldi Tassoni
description: A newborn abandoned in the Seine is saved by two mice. Paris 1877, in the great theater a mysterious presence sows terror. A kind of cruel but romantic "ghost" who falls in love with soprano Christine.
notes: Without wishing to bring up the original ghost (the legendary Lon Chaney), certainly the choice of Julian Sands does not help this mask of horror despair. Argento is not sure which path to take, perhaps confused by too personal delusions. Anything that works visually (the love between mice and Sands, for example) is blown away by amateurish acting and an awkward script.

title: Look Alike
actors: Melissa Gilbert Brinkman, Diane Ladd
description: After the death of her daughter and, above all, after a year of psychotherapy, Gina begins to face life again but the encounter with a girl identical to her daughter plunges her back into a whirlwind of fear and anguish. Fear turns to terror when he realizes that the girl's mother is her perfect copy. In a short time Gina returns to fight against madness and against the past which, overbearing and relentless, returns.
notes: Usual television movie that strives to be original at least in the plot. Too bad that the acting is never up to par and the direction adapts to it without too many scruples.

title: The Mating Season
actors: Jan Sterling, Thelma Ritter, Gene Tierney
description: Val and Maggie are newly weds, so fresh that Maggie has never met her mother-in-law Ellen. When this happens at the home of the lovebirds, for a misunderstanding the daughter-in-law believes that she is the new cook sent by the agency. Ellen plays along and convinces her son to go along with her, convinced that she can better keep the young Kalinger at bay, the son of Val's employer and in love with Maggie. Soon the situation degenerates, but the happy ending (with surprise) is just around the corner.
notes: Polite comedy played on the following of misunderstandings. Caustic and irreverent, with a very respectable cast who believe in what they do (Thelma Ritter irresistible).

title: When Justice Fails
actors: Jeff Fahey, Marlee Matlin, Chuck Shamata, Victoria Barkoff
description: Detective Frank Whaley's life isn't as peaceful as it may seem at first glance. Frank is coming out of a fairly dark period from a sentimental point of view. Now there is a killer in town who is sowing panic. In fact, the police discovered the dismembered body of a man who was serving in a hotel. A pair of scissors are found at the scene of the crime. A closer examination reveals the presence of a tuft of hair, the traces of a sedative, the Seconal, and it is learned that the victim had suffered a rape. Will these elements be enough to discover the culprit?

title: A Midnight Clear
actors: Ethan Hawke, Peter Berg, Kevin Dillon, Gary Sinise, Arye Gross
description: We are at the end of the Second World War, on the Ardennes front. The Reich is now on the verge of collapse, but its soldiers, instigated by a pounding propagation, still oppose a strenuous resistance to the advance of the allies. Among these there is also the patrol under the command of Sergeant Knott. Here, however, the enemies do not show up, perhaps because now, despite everything, they have lost the desire to fight.
notes: Keith Gordon traces an episode of the Second World War in a correct and somewhat wordy film. Hawke back from "The fleeting moment" is always good.

title: Figures in a Landscape
actors: Robert Shaw, Malcolm McDowell, Henry Woolf, Christopher Malcolm
description: Ansell and Meg, escaped from prison, try to reach the border of a neighboring state. While the younger Ansell is opposed to violence, the older Meg is animated by a fierce hatred towards those who have imprisoned him. During the escape, however, Ansell is forced to resort to violence.

title: Gulliver's Travels
description: Glese sailor Gulliver, visiting the kingdom of Lilliput, meddles in the war between the country's microscopic king and an equally tiny adversary. It will be thanks to his intervention if the dispute ends and if the sons of the two sovereigns will get married.
notes: Cartoon version of the famous novel by Jonathan Swift. Lanny Ross and Jessica Dragonette sing the songs. But Fleischer could not beat Disney and his film, while ingenious and at times admirable, is today more of an artifact than anything else.

title: Robin Hood Dies
actors: Charly Bravo, Maria Reniu, Luis Induni, Fernando Rubio, Emma Cohen
description: Robin Hood, who has been ambushed by the Nottingham sheriff's men, is wounded but manages to escape. To carry out his exploits in favor of the poor people mercilessly harassed by Giovanni Senza Terra, he pretends to be buried. Once healed, he is joined in the new lair by Friar Tuck, the Giant, the minstrel and his other faithful. Informed of the secrets of the castle by the Buffon Dwarf, he organizes its escape. Iberian version of the adventures of Robin Hood, so unlikely and ragged as to be nice.

title: L'incanto della foresta
description: The teddy bear Pichissò one day decides to leave his family and go for a stroll through the forest. He goes to the wise owl who advises him to look for the poppy that will allow him to become an adult. In his wandering he can thus admire the struggle of the praying mantises, the spider that weaves its web, the dragonfly that gets rid of its shell and the industrious ants busy at work. Then a thunderous storm breaks out and ...

title: Iqbal
actors: Mohamed Rizlan, Rajindra Jayasinghe, Ravindra Randeniya, Roshan Seth
description: Iqbal is only ten years old and is forced to work twelve hours a day chained to a loom in a 32-degree shady room. Iqbal is good and when his working day ends his "master" Master Gi The Baba rewards him by taking him to watch the elephant race. But one day Iqbal decides to rebel ...
notes: Torrini, inspired by the dramatic story of Iqbal Masih, the little Pakistani boy killed by his tormentors because he had denounced the scourge of child labor to the world, shows us the atrocities that afflict nearly seven million Pakistani children.

title: Ecco fatto
actors: Giorgio Pasotti, Barbora Bobulova, Claudio Santamaria, Enrico Silvestrin
description: Matteo is a steady couple with Piterone: friends in life and among school desks. Matteo, one day, meets Margherita, a woman too beautiful to be true and, above all, his. But love is strange and Margherita falls in love, while Matteo goes crazy. To hell with school and Piterone, dad's house and everyday problems: the two go to live together. Love is strange, but jealousy is no joke either.
notes: Final with variations for a work that follows light trails ("Lola runs", "Il charger") and deceptive reflections ("The artichokes will grow in Mimongo"). The faces are right, and Muccino tries to get out of minimalism with a staging here and there "isterika".

title: Donne in bianco
actors: Susana Werner, Barbara Enrichi, Claire Keim, Francesca Antonelli
description: Francesca, Nancy and Sabrina: the first eats men for breakfast, lunch and dinner, the second would also like them for dessert, the third would like to marry them. They are in their thirties, they share the same apartment, they dedicate themselves to big hunting on weekends and they have many dreams that systematically break between parties and discos. They spend the day in parks frequented by divorcees with dogs and in supermarkets crowded with singles. The external life? Only a less fortunate peer who works for the garbage collection gets drunk on Saturday nights.
notes: A feminine "Fireworks" that goes limp after the first half hour. Bravine, fortunately, the interpreters. Susana Werner is Ronaldo's girlfriend.

title: The Mighty
actors: Kieran Culkin, Elden Hanson, Sharon Stone, Gena Rowlands, Harry Dean Stanton, Gillian Anderson
description: Kevin is afflicted with a congenital malformation that forces him to walk on crutches. Maxwell, on the other hand, is just fat but very awkward and mocked by his school friends. Maxwell carries Kevin on his shoulders to face the "bad guys": the two boys join forces and become one, one body, like those knights of the Round Table.
notes: Produced and interpreted by Sharon Stone (Kevin's mother), "Just look at the sky" does not emphasize an obligatory story within edifying coordinates: on the contrary, it has the courage to take new and unsettling paths. Beautiful soundtrack composed, among others, by Sting and Zucchero.

title: The Sands of the Kalahari
actors: Stanley Baker, Stuart Whitman, Susannah York, Harry Andrews
description: While a group of passengers on a private plane is flying over the Kalahari Desert, a cloud of locusts hits it, forcing the pilot to make a crash landing. From the burning aircraft all passengers manage to escape find themselves in the desert. Sturdevant, pilot and owner of the aircraft, leads the survivors to a cave. But the worst is yet to come.
notes: Harmless adventure film made in England with good performers and breathtaking setting.

title: Angels in the Outfield
actors: Danny Glover, Tony Danza, Brenda Fricker, Christopher Lloyd
description: All baseball teams traditionally have a nickname that distinguishes them. Normally the names of ferocious animals, monsters or infernal powers swarm. The "Angels" team goes against the trend. In every sense, even and above all in the ranking. In the crucial moment of the championship, on the eve of the decisive match, the chosen name plays a good role: in fact, a host of real angels descends from the sky and makes a fundamental contribution to victory.
notes: The role of the good-natured and wise "dad", or the updated version of Uncle Tom, suits Danny Glover, the black actor who became famous alongside Mel Gibson in the series "Lethal Weapon".

title: Walkower
actors: Jerzy Skolimowski, Aleksandra Zawieruszanka, Krzysztof Chamiec
description: Andrzej, a young homeless man, expelled from university, a boxer in his spare time, arrives in a provincial town where he meets a former schoolmate, a careerist who is about to be hired among the managers of the local industrial complex. In the meantime, a puglistic tournament is organized inside the factory which sees Andrzej himself among the participants.
notes: In the 1960s Skolimowski's film was the Polish equivalent of Godard's "A bout de souffle". Today some stylistic solutions may appear dated, but it is difficult not to be infected by the enthusiasm and sense of rebellion of the story.

title: Sayat Nova
actors: Sofiko Caureli, Melkop Alekjan, Vilen Galustjan, Onnik Minassian
description: Sayat Nova, who lived in the 17th century during the Armenian Renaissance, spends most of his life in Tiflis, the ancient name of today's Tbilisi as a court troubadour. The poet falls in love with the queen of Georgia. He is aware of the risks he runs and is convinced to take the path of spiritual confinement in a convent. But the film has no real plot: it proceeds by allusions, symbols and visual assonances, often drawing on Armenian folklore and history. Strongly suggestive, with unforgettable images, the film had serious problems with Soviet censorship (Paradzanov, moreover, was also jailed for a long time under charges of homosexuality and trafficking of icons).

title: Ucrainskaja rapsodija
actors: O. Petrenko, E. Kochman, Y. Guliaiev, N. Oujvii
description: A girl from the Ukrainian countryside wins an important competition in Paris and becomes a famous singer: but in her heart she always has her beloved Anton, who went to war and now a prisoner of the Germans ...
notes: Youthful film by the great Paradzanov, still linked to narrative modules of socialist realism but with moments of great poetry.

title: Pervyi paren
actors: G. Karpov, L. Sossioura, Y. Saratov, V. Kovalenko
description: Juska, naive and ardent country boy, falls in love with Odarka, who is courted by all the villagers. In the village there is no man who does not have a passion for sport and this pushes Juska to become a good footballer. In reality he wants to make himself beautiful in the eyes of Odarka and in this way groped to conquer her. To escape the comments of the villagers, he begins to train in complete solitude. Paradzanov's youthful film, still far from its mature style, but already full of rural and fairytale atmospheres.

title: Cvetok komne
actors: B. Dmokhorovskij, G. Karpov, L. Cerepanova, I. Kiriljuk
description: In a hospital room, a man seriously injured in the head slowly begins to regain his memory: he remembers the mining center in whose construction he participated in the first person, the wells he worked in and the friendly atmosphere that had been created between classmates. But little by little, the problems related to the infiltration into the mine of a religious sect that had caused discord also come to the surface ...
notes: The theme is the division that undermines the solidarity fabric of the Soviet proletariat. A son of his time, ideologized but rich from an aesthetic point of view. Paradzanov proves to be a master in the use of editing.

title: Andriesh
actors: Konstantin Russu, N. Chachik, Lyudmila Sokolova, K. Chtirbou
description: The young shepherd Andries leaves his village to lead the flock to graze on an isolated prairie. Suddenly Vainovan appears, the leader of the shepherds, who is moved by the boy's kindness and candor and decides to give him a magic flute. Andries learns to play the instrument quickly and is so good that his melodies enchant anyone who listens to them.

title: Angels in the Attic
actors: Clayton Taylor, Dalin Christiansen, Steven Losak
description: Two boys find a bag full of money in an abandoned attic but are unaware that they are the result of a robbery. The boys also discover that the money was hidden there by a neighbor of theirs. After recovering from the initial shock they decide to distribute gifts and money to their neighbors most in need. But when the thief returns to take the stolen goods and does not find it for the two boys, who have exposed themselves too much with their behavior, trouble begins.
notes: A nice plot for a comedy with a yellow twist that alternates thrills and good-luck in the right amount. Unknown but good actors.

title: Christmas Holiday
actors: Deanna Durbin, Richard Whorf, Gene Kelly, Gale Sondergaard
description: A woman obsessed with her mother-in-law and the fact that her husband is rotting in prison on a murder charge tries to atone for her sins by being an entraîneuse. She will have to deal with her husband who in the meantime has escaped from prison. Uncertain film of Siodmak's early years in America. Herman Mankiewicz's script adapts a Somerset Maugham novel.

title: Leap of Faith
actors: Steve Martin, Debra Winger, Liam Neeson, Lolita Davidovich, Lukas Haas
description: Every evening the fake Reverend Nightengale gives pseudo-spiritualistic sermons, seasoned with elements of parapsychology, during a sparkling traveling show. His assistant helps him by going into the audience and cunningly obtaining confessions from some spectators, which will then be used by his "boss" to make the impression of the seer when she dictates them to him via earphone from a van. But the barker is exposed by a young sheriff who is having an affair with the girl.
notes: If it weren't for the interpretation of Steve Martin, who strongly believes in his character, the film would hold up little. Because he's smart and busy, but a bit far-fetched. In short, he lacks the soul.

title: Entusiazm
description: At the end of the 1920s the Soviet government launched the great campaign of the Five Year Plans of the so-called NEP, the New Economic Policy of the USSR. The aim is to modernize the country in forced stages, to recover the technological and production gap with the other major countries of the world.
notes: The director Dziga Vertov, inventor of "Cineocchio", that is, of total documentarism, shoots this film in the coal mines, among the miners who have decided to increase production to meet the new needs of the country.

title: Christmas Every Day
actors: Robert Hays, Bess Armstrong, Erik von Detten, Yvonne Zima
description: Despite having an unhappy Christmas with his family, Billy is forced by his sister to ask Santa that "it's Christmas every day". Billy doesn't actually believe in the existence of Santa Clause, but in the days that follow he and his family relive the holiday season cyclically. Billy is the only one who realizes what is happening and strives to transform the negative events of the day, but to no avail. Eventually he realizes that the only way to change the course of events is to behave according to the dictates of love. Once the true meaning of Christmas is understood, the spell is broken ...

title: Hey There, It's Yogi Bear
description: Due to a villain, the cute little bear Cindy is kidnapped by the peace of Jellystone park and ends up in a zoo in the city. The friendly Yogi and the little Bubu immediately set out on his trail and soon become involved in a series of very funny adventures in the environment, hostile for them, of the big city. Between songs and jokes, in the end everything works out.

title: The Man Called Flintstone
description: Fred's adventure begins when he is mistaken for the famous secret agent Rock Slag, of whom he is the perfect double. Since Rock was injured on a mission, Fred is persuaded to take his place. Becoming a James Bond without having neither the intelligence nor the preparation, our hero makes one mistake after another causing absolutely delusional situations. But luck plays on his side ...

title: La prima notte di quiete
actors: Alain Delon, Giancarlo Giannini, Sonia Petrova, Renato Salvatori, Lea Massari, Adalberto Maria Merli
description: Daniele is a young professor of literature, who is doing a substitute in a high school in Rimini. Author of a book of poems dedicated to a girl who died at the age of sixteen, he now lives with Monica. Daniele is indifferent to the dispute that slowly takes hold in his class. Without an authentic vocation for teaching, and with a keen propensity for play, the professor falls in love with Vanina, one of his students.
notes: Rimini, yes, but very far from Fellini. Zurlini composes the crepuscular portrait of a disillusioned man, set in a paradoxically autumnal context. Perhaps the best proof of Delon. An underestimated film.

title: The Gumball Rally
actors: Michael Sarrazin, Raul Julia, Joanne Nail, Tim McIntire, Steven Keats
description: A group of friends make an appointment to repeat the Gumball Rally, in which they have already measured the previous year. It is an illegal, no-holds-barred, no-holds-barred car race that runs across the United States. The group of competitors includes a German, an Englishman, an Italian, two women and two policemen. They are joined by José, who collects a model, aspiring actress on the street. Policeman Roscow tries hard to stop them but his efforts are in vain. Comedy with stuntmen, smashing and predictable, but not boring.

title: Frankenstein Unbound
actors: John Hurt, Raul Julia, Bridget Fonda, Nick Brimble, Catherine Corman
description: We are in Los Angeles in 2013 and during an experiment on the implosion of matter, an American scientist finds himself in Switzerland in 1817 where he meets Dr. Frankenstein. Later he meets Mary Shelley who reveals to him that the facts told in her book are based on real events.
notes: Corman, an expert in low-budget horror and fantastic cinema, after almost twenty years of absence from the set returns to the myth of the Creature of Frankenstein based on the novel "Frankenstein Unbound" by Brian Aldiss. Refined, complex, "theoretical".

title: Tarzàn y el misterio de la selva
actors: Richard Yestaran, Didi Sherman, Cesar Burner, Marina Ferri
description: In an African country, a group of criminals has set up an arms smuggling with the aim of arming the natives and making them rise up. An agent disguised as a missionary leaves from London accompanied by four collaborators disguised as nuns specialized in martial arts. Meanwhile, in the jungle, Tarzan has already discovered the shady trade.
notes: Nothing is missing in this Spanish film: even the Nazis. Poor Tarzan!

title: My Name Is Joe
actors: Peter Mullan, Louise Goodall, Gary Lewis, Lorraine Mcintosh
description: Joe is a smiling proletarian who came out of his addiction to alcohol in order not to despise himself. Joe busies himself with inexhaustible energy for the down-and-out football team he trains in Glasgow's most wretched neighborhood. Life seems to get sweeter when Joe meets Sarah, a social worker just a hair above him on the social ladder.
notes: Loach handles this sentimental comedy with the same lightness with which he built the love story between the bus driver and Carla in "Carla's Song" (scripted, like this one, by Paul Laverty). And the comedy moves towards a black of devastating social clarity, while Loach's pessimism becomes more and more disconsolate.

title: Un bugiardo in Paradiso
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Gabriele Cirilli, Flavio Insinna, Antonella Attili
description: The homeless Gino with his adoptive godson Tino had the good idea of ??making himself believe that he had never known and for years stubbornly sought after by a young and wealthy entrepreneur. For Gino it is a way to escape forever from an ordinary life of hardship and full of difficulties of all kinds, but then he becomes so passionate about the role of father and grandfather and does not feel like continuing to lie anymore.
notes: Fracchia is dead, Fantozzi, as we saw in the recent Christmas holidays, is no longer very well. Village also demonstrates in this stretched comedy that he no longer knows which audience to turn to. Bravo Insinna.

title: Out of Control
actors: Sean Young, Tom Conti, Bob Lujan, Larry Day, Jack Langedijk
description: Lena Fisher previously worked for Nick Morelli, a criminal, and has now fled carrying a bag containing a million dollars. Morelli sends Charlie, a man of hers, after her, and she is forced to take refuge in a gas station where she meets Eddie, a person with a stormy past. Meanwhile, Charlie has identified where the girl is hiding. The film is quite ordinary but the actors come from good cinema.

title: Il giovane Toscanini
actors: C. Thomas Howell, Sophie Ward, John Rhys-Davies, Elizabeth Taylor
description: Little Arturo Toscanini happens to listen to singer Nadia Bulicioff at the age of eight with his father at La Scala in a superb interpretation of Aida. Passionate about music since childhood, at eighteen he already knows the scores of the greatest masters by heart. But when he introduces himself as cellist at La Scala for a competition, he lets himself be overwhelmed by his impulsive and arrogant temperament, he insults the jury and leaves without getting the job. Taking advantage of the situation, a provincial theater manager convinces him to go on a tour in Brazil.
notes: Surely one of the worst films by Zeffirelli who also knows about melodramas. Cult is the scene in which he interrupts the concert for a humanitarian tirade. And the Taylor disoriented.

title: The Great Impostor
actors: Tony Curtis, Karl Malden, Edmond O'Brien, Arthur O'Connell
description: Called to arms, Ferdinand Waldo Demara falsifies his credentials in order to attend non-commissioned officers' school. However, when he realizes that the trick is about to be discovered, he pretends to be dead in a car accident and takes refuge in a monastery. He soon realizes that he is not suitable for monastic life and returns to bourgeois life but is immediately discovered and arrested. Ferdinand, however, does not lose heart and gets a job in the penitentiary.

title: L'executrice
actors: Brigitte Lahaie, Pierre Odry, Michel Modo
description: A policewoman, following a thorough investigation, sends an affiliate of the Parisian mafia to prison. The son of the latter decides to take revenge and kidnaps the sister of the police officer, asking in exchange for the release of his mother. At this point the policewoman tries a coup but her sister dies. The policewoman's anger will lead to a massacre of the mafia clan.
notes: A reactionary message softened (so to speak) by the graces of the protagonist.

title: The Last Days of Disco
actors: Chloë Sevigny, Kate Beckinsale, Chris Eigeman, Matt Keeslar
description: Alice and Charlotte have just gotten out of Hampshire College and live on the meager salary that a publishing house passes them on. The two girls are forced to share with another girl, Holly, a small apartment overlooking the railroad in Yorkville, Manhattan. Charlotte comforts Alice that she didn't have an affair while in college. They both have a way to make up for two interesting guys they met at a club party. Only later do they come across Alice's two true objects of desire, Jimmy and Tom.
notes: The rise and fall of disco music, represented by a New York club that, from 1979 to 1983, attracted the attention of thousands and thousands of men and women of entertainment (and not) and underground culture. What is called "local" in the film is none other than the legendary Studio 54, at the time a favorite destination for supermodels, novice yuppies and people like Andy Warhol and Truman Capote. Stillman says he has closed a trilogy - which began with "Metropolitan" ('90) and continued with "Barcelona" - focused on the discomfort of those young people who found themselves, in the early 1980s, living with the weight of the end of the General Contest . Kate Beckinsale and Chloe Sevigny are two actresses to watch closely. Soundtrack full of now "cult" pieces such as "Everybody Dance", "Le Freak", "More, More, More". And a verbiage not always justified.

title: Eight Men Out
actors: John Cusack, Clifton James, Michael Lerner, Christopher Lloyd
description: The White Sox baseball team is playing in the finals of the tournament that could lead them to conquer the longed-for American national title, naturally the most important in the world of this sport. We are in 1919 and, given the situation in the standings, some of the members of the team think it well to sell some games in order to pocket a large percentage on illegal bets.
notes: John Sayles' film accurately reconstructs an episode that caused quite a stir at the time. The director plays the role of a famous sports reporter of the time, Rick Lardner.

title: Track 29
actors: Theresa Russell, Gary Oldman, Christopher Lloyd, Colleen Camp
description: A couple from the English provinces, he a fanatic of electric trains (Lloyd), she (Russell) who suffered violence as a girl, are troubled by the arrival of a young man who claims to be the son (Oldman) she believed she had lost. .
notes: Oedipal intrigues and transitions between dream and reality weaken this film directed by Nicolas Roeg. Dennis Pott's script certainly doesn't help. Interesting and intriguing is the theme of the stranger who sneaks into a family and throws everyone into turmoil. Gary Oldman also plays the role of the stranger.

title: Un soir, un train
actors: Yves Montand, Anouk Aimée, Adriana Bogdan, Hector Camerlinck
description: Mathias, a professor at a Belgian university, has been living for some time with a Frenchwoman named Anne and with her he is working on the theatrical adaptation of a Flemish opera that has as its subject the role of man in society. After a brief and banal quarrel, the professor finds himself in a place beyond life and death.
notes: The Belgian Delvaux directs one of his most celebrated films, based on a short story by Johan Daisne. The director tries to grasp the mystery behind everyday appearances and to investigate the meaning of death.

title: The Call of the Wild: Dog of the Yukon
actors: Rutger Hauer, Bronwen Booth, Robert Pierre Cote, Charles Powell
description: Buck is a dog who is stolen from his owners, who live in California, to be thrown into the cold of the Yukon. The poor beast is mistreated by a man who, on behalf of a mining company, is looking for the right land to dig a new mine. The dog tries with all his might to escape and when he comes into contact with other wild animals he finally finds the right one to take refuge in the forest.
notes: Modest TV version of the London classic but with good settings and excellent cast.

title: Tempo di uccidere
actors: Nicolas Cage, Ricky Tognazzi, Giancarlo Giannini, Robert Liensol
description: We are in 1936 during the Italo-Ethiopian conflict. One night the Italian lieutenant Enrico Silvestri, afflicted with a terrible toothache, does not wait for the dawn to leave in the column with his ward and is taken by truck to the nearest field hospital. The truck, however, collides with a rock and forces the officer to continue the road in the bush. Dazzled by a beautiful Ethiopian girl, he rapes her and kills her. Arriving at the camp, an overwhelming sense of guilt begins to arise in him ...
notes: Montaldo, supported by good interpreters, depicts a beautiful novel by Ennio Flaiano. But his illustration is bloodless and hardly ever fascinates.

title: Ernest Goes to Camp
actors: Jim Varney, Victoria Racimo, John Vernon
description: A hateful and rather stupid boy decides he wants to become the group leader of a summer camp for boys at any cost. In the end, despite everything, he succeeds.
notes: Comedy made in the USA with absolutely unknown performers. The direction is below the sufficiency. With 4 sequels.

title: Tokyo-ken
actors: Kojii Tsukamoto, Shinya Tsukamoto, Kahori Fujii, Naomasa Musaka
description: Tsuda is a brilliant insurance agent from Tokyo and lives with his girlfriend Hizuru. One day he catches a glimpse of Takuji, an old friend from high school, now a professional boxer, at a boxing match and does everything he can to avoid it. Back at work, he finds himself in front of his old partner and is struck by the familiarity that he shows to have with his girlfriend. Relationships between the characters soon precipitate. As the director of "Tetsuo", an eccentric and out-of-genre film, but without the imaginative shot of the previous one.

title: The Emperor Waltz
actors: Bing Crosby, Joan Fontaine, Roland Culver, Lucile Watson
description: Virgil Smith, an American traveling salesman, would like to be admitted to the presence of Emperor Franz Joseph to sell him a gramophone. Virgil, however, is taken for a terrorist and put out of the door. Later he meets Countess Joanna, a young widow who owns a thoroughbred dog and is also eager to meet the emperor. So the two follow him to Tyrol where Francesco Giuseppe is doing a hunting party. Film-operetta with a few touches by the great Wilder. But, between Crosby's songs and sentimental moments, it's one of the director's least interesting films.

title: Il quarto re
actors: Raoul Bova, Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Daniel Ceccaldi, Joachim Fuchsberger
description: Alazhar is a passionate beekeeper peasant and finds himself involved in the journey that the Three Magi have undertaken leaving their land to celebrate the coming of the Savior. It is a journey that hides pitfalls, dangers and traps but in the end it turns out to be a wonderful discovery of the meaning of life. Alazhar leaves his home as a boy and returns as a man who has learned and learned from what he has seen. The three Magi know that without the help of the young man, who has abandoned his beautiful wife Izhira, they will never be able to reach their intended goal.

title: L'amore in città
directors: Michelangelo Antonioni, Federico Fellini, Alberto Lattuada, Carlo Lizzani, Francesco Maselli, Dino Risi, Cesare Zavattini
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Valeria Moriconi, Giovanna Ralli, Raimondo Vianello
description: An episodic film, directed by some of the main directors of Italian neorealism. In the first, Love that you pay, Lizzani interviews some prostitutes. In Pararadiso for four hours, Risi describes the ballrooms of the Italians. In Attempted Suicide Antonioni talks about the people who tried to take their own life. Fellini, on the other hand, shows the events of a marriage agency. Maselli and Zavattini ask Caterina to tell about her life. Finally, in Italians they turn around, Lattuada records the attitude of Italians towards beautiful sex.

title: Rock-a-doodle
description: The Chanticleer rooster is highly regarded on his Tennessee farm because he is considered capable of making the sun rise every morning with his "magical" cock. One day, however, Chanticleer did not sing and the sun rose anyway. Mocked by everyone, the offended rooster flees to the city. But from that moment the sun no longer appears bright. A para-traditional story made by a disney fugitive who went on his own twenty years ago and who makes more Disney-like films than Disney.

title: The Shadow of the Cat
actors: Barbara Shelley, André Morell, William Lucas, Richard Warner
description: Walter, who has long hated his wife, the very rich Ella, decides to suppress her after having forcibly signed a will that names him his universal heir. Accomplices the butler and the cook Walter commits the crime. The only witness to the murder is a cat. Old-fashioned English thriller, asai enjoyable in its "chamber" game.

title: Lancer Spy
actors: Dolores Del Rio, George Sanders, Peter Lorre, Joseph Schildkraut
description: During the First World War an aristocratic lieutenant of the German Imperial Guard is taken prisoner by the Anglo-Americans. The Allied Command sets out in search of a lieutenant's double. After a long search, a British Navy lieutenant is found who looks strikingly like the prisoner. Variation on the theme of the double, with a good cast and the charm of the old genre cinema.

title: Gentleman's Agreement
actors: Gregory Peck, Dorothy McGuire, John Garfield, Celeste Holm
description: Philip Greca, a well-known and successful journalist, travels to New York to write a series of articles that are part of an investigation into anti-Semitism for a magazine. In the house of the editor of the weekly he meets his niece Kathy, who suggested the subject of the investigation to her uncle. Friendship suddenly blossoms between Philip and Kathy. To give more credit to his investigation, Philip comes up with the idea of ??pretending to be Jewish but will have to deal with the creeping racism that lurks in American society.
notes: At the time, the film suffered a boycott by the Hollywood Jewish community. Today it is far too dated.

title: Fratelli d'Italia
actors: Ettore Manni, Mario Feliciani, Olga Solbelli, Paul Miller
description: In Koper in 1915 the patriots are in agitation because they are eager for Italy to enter the war: Nazario Sauro, one of the most ardent supporters of the intervention, decides to flee to Venice to escape arrest. When Italy declares war, Sauro enlisted as a volunteer and obtained to be embarked as an officer on a submarine. His perfect knowledge of the Istrian coasts allows him to be very useful to the crew. During a reconnaissance, the submarine approaches an Austrian boat but in the operation a very young boy, devoted to Sauro, loses his life.

title: Ostia
actors: Laurent Terzieff, Franco Citti, Anita Sanders, Ninetto Davoli, Lamberto Maggiorani
description: The brothers Rabbi and Bandiera, returning home after attempting to commit a theft, catch a glimpse of a girl who is sleeping on a meadow. So they decide to take her to their home and here they confide in her that they have killed their father, an always drunk anarchist who had driven his wife to madness. For her part, the girl tells the two that she was raped by her father. Once in prison they receive visits from the girl but jealousy sets them against each other.
notes: A brutal and poetic film at the same time, originally written by Pasolini and dedicated to him by his collaborator Citti. Lamberto Maggiorani, actor of "Bicycle Thieves", is the rapist father. From the series: Neorealist morality no longer lives here.

title: The Night Has a Thousand Eyes
actors: Edward G. Robinson, John Lund, Gail Russell, Virginia Bruce
description: At a station a woman tries to kill herself by throwing herself under a train, but at the last moment she is saved by a boy. In the restaurant where she is taken, there is a man with a bewildered face who gives the young man some suspicions. Everyone thinks he was the one who pushed her to suicide. The man is reported but the accusation is unfounded. In reality, man is an illusionist capable of predicting the future. Tense and mysterious Noir from a novel by Cornell Woolrich. Great Robinson.

title: Son contento
actors: Francesco Nuti, Barbara De Rossi, Carlo Giuffrè, Novello Novelli
description: A young cabaret artist and dance entertainer, all taken by the passion for the show, is left by his girlfriend Paola, who had lived with him for four years. A period of brutalization begins for him, during which, due to his unpredictable behavior, he loses all contracts. One day he finally decides to wake up from his torpor and shows up in public with a whole new show that brings him success.
notes: The clichés of the actor who, taken by his passion for theater, must give up love are not lacking in the third and last film by the couple Maurizio Ponzi-Francesco Nuti.

title: Miracles in the Woods
actors: Della Reese, Meredith Baxter, Patricia Heaton, Anna Chlumsky
description: Wanda and Sarah, two sisters, meet after a few years on the occasion of their mother's funeral. During the reading of the will, the two women discover that they have inherited a wooded land and by visiting it they discover that inside it there is a shed where Cooper, an elderly black woman a little vanished, lives. After having "welcomed" Wanda with a gun, Sarah and her daughter Gina establishes a beautiful friendship with the three women. So Cooper begins to tell her story to her new friends. Very young she married Henry who forced her to smuggle wishey and from whom she had Henry jr. Abused by her husband, Cooper found the strength to report him.

title: A Promise to Carolyn
actors: Delta Burke, Shirley Knight, Grace Zabriskie
description: Kay and Debra are two sisters, but theirs is not a normal life. Still shaken by the memory of the tragic death of their little sister Carolyn, and continually harassed by her stepmother, the perfidious Jolene. Accomplice, of course, the indifference of the father and the inaction of Francie, the birth mother. After forty years, the need for redemption and justice pushes them to reopen the dossier of the child's death, ultimately having Jolene sentenced.
notes: A film that describes the absurdly violent condition of a "normal" family, trying, perhaps with an excess of didactic zeal, to illuminate the darkest areas of everyday life.

title: Eat a Bowl of Tea
actors: Cora Miao, Russell Wong, Victor Wong, Eric Tsang
description: For a long time, American laws forbade emigrants from China to be joined by their wives and children in the United States. After the Second World War these bans fell and so in 1949 two elderly friends, Wah Gay and Lee Gong decide to arrange the marriage of their children, Ben Loy and Mei Oi. The two mothers meet the young people who, immediately in love, get married and reach New York. As grandparents begin to obsessively insist on having a grandchild as soon as possible, Ben Loy grapples with impotence problems.
notes: Accurate period reconstruction with flashes of black humor.

title: The Enemy Within
actors: Jason Robards, Forest Whitaker, Sam Waterston, Dana Delany, Josef Sommer, George Dzundza, Isabel Glasser, Dakin Matthews, William O'Leary
description: General Lloyd (Jason Robards) is not what he usually calls a loyal officer: he is organizing, with the men under his command, a coup. The target is even the president of the United States. Only a colonel (Forest Whitaker) tries to thwart General Lloyd's criminal plan.
notes: TV remake of "Seven days in May", tight and above the average of products for the small screen. Great cast.

title: Tango
actors: Miguel Angel Sola, Cecilia Narova, Mia Maestro, Juan Carlos Copes
description: Mario Sutrez is an established director in midlife crisis, also because his wife has abandoned him. To cut the past, he decides to leave his apartment to settle on the set set up on the outskirts of Buenos Aires where the shooting of a film about tango is about to begin.
notes: An ambitious work that shifts the center of gravity to the parts of Buenos Aires, on the thread of Gardelian nostalgia. Aided by the yellow and bright atmospheres created by Vittorio Storaro (awarded at Cannes in 1998), the film often flies high, imprisoning those who love to let themselves go into the drift of melancholy.

title: Waking Ned
actors: Susan Lynch, Fionnula Flanagan, Ian Bannen, David Kelly, Fionnula Flanagan, Susan Lynch
description: When Jackie discovers that someone in her village has won the lottery, she suggests that her friend Michael find the lucky owner of the winning ticket. After several attempts they find Ned dead with the winning ticket in his hands and a smile on his face. Jackie and Michael decide to take Ned's place and collect the money.
notes: Newcomer Kirk Jones comes from editing and commercials, but has in mind the corrosive classics of British comedy, from Scottish drunks and the unlikely bandits of Ealing '40s and' 50s to the stubborn traditionalism of "Local Hero". Great actors (including the Shakespearean myth Ian Bannen), exemplary script, perfidious ending.

title: Festen
actors: Ulrich Thomsen, Henning Moritzen, Thomas Bo Larsen, Paprika Steen
description: Denmark, preparations are underway on the country estate for the great party for the sixtieth birthday of Helge, the proud patriarch of the family. All the invitations have been sent out and cars crowd the castle courtyard. Helge asks Christian to give a speech in memory of his twin sister Linda who committed suicide the year before. Evening falls and Christian prepares to deliver the speech, and what a speech!
notes: Dogma 1: that is, a family portrait in the interior of a princely country estate. But, from the very first shots of a hand-held car that runs chasing the characters room by room, we have the feeling that not everything is as orderly and "benevolent" as it wants to appear. Without departing from the cold rigor of the Scandinavian cinematographic tradition, Thomas Vinterberg develops a perfidious comedy and a vigorous example of the "dogmas" developed by the group headed by Von Trier. Cruel and realistic, sour and shameless.

title: The Avengers
actors: Ralph Fiennes, Uma Thurman, Sean Connery, Jim Broadbent
description: London, 1990s. Someone is changing the climate and bringing the country and the world to its knees. Who could have come up with a similar plan that aims to blackmail humanity in exchange for a few hours of sunshine? All suspicions are directed at Sir August De Wynter, a very rich and extravagant man. John Steed and Emma Peel intervene to try to resolve the situation.
notes: It is very difficult to recall the sophisticated and naive spirit of the series "The Avengers" (which in Italy we have seen under the title "Special Agent"). The passage on the big screen is not even modern, but a transcription flattened by too many special effects and too much "Bondian" action (while the series was the rarefaction of 007) and slowed down by the cinematic length. Two embalmed actors remain and Sean Connery making fun of his youth.

title: Sokout
actors: Tahmineh Normatova, Nadereh Abdelahyeva, Goibibi Ziadolahyeva
description: Korshid is a ten-year-old blind boy with exceptional hearing who lives alone with his mother in a small village in Tajikistan. Every day little Nadereh looks for him at the bus stop to take him to the luthier where he works. The girl is his gaze on the world while Korshid is attentive to every little sound he can perceive. It will be the music of the world around him that will make life known.
notes: The film left the director's admirers perplexed. The director knows how to compose images of blinding beauty, he knows how to return the pulsations of colors and sounds, he knows how to fascinate with vision. But a vision that seems abstractly suspended in a universe in which we are unable to penetrate. Perhaps "Silence" is a private dream.

title: Mortal Kombat: Annihilation
actors: Robin Shou, Talisa Soto, Sandra Hess, Lynn Red Williams, James Remar, Brian Thompson
description: A band of fearless fighters have defeated the evil warlords from Outworld in a life-and-death tournament called Mortal Kombat. But just as the heroes are about to enjoy their triumphant victory, the portals overlooking Outworld are destroyed by a giant, death-faced figure declaring that the fight has just begun.
notes: There was no need for a second episode of a saga that takes its cue from a famous video game and the bewildered Christopher Lambert has also disappeared from the cast. And only boredom remained mortal, which unfortunately is all for the viewer.

title: The Mask of Zorro
actors: Antonio Banderas, Anthony Hopkins, Catherine Zeta-Jones
description: Twenty years have passed since Don Diego De La Vega under the pseudonym of Zorro fought in Mexico against Spanish oppression. Now, after a long time in prison, he must choose a successor to fight Don Rafael Montero, the powerful former Spanish governor who caused Don Diego to lose his freedom. When the bandit Alejandro Murrieta appears on the horizon, Don Diego realizes that he can be the avenger he has been waiting for.
notes: The film was to be directed by Spielberg himself (who, however, produces) with Andy Garcia as the "fox"; and Robert Rodriguez had started shooting it, escaped (or kicked out?) from the set after a few days. It ended up in the hands of Bondian Martin Campbell ("Goldeneye") who, humbly, made himself available to a very athletic Banderas and the usual immense Hopkins. Swarms, sexy moods, slivers of western spaghetti and the bright colors of Mexico.

title: Mulan
description: At the far reaches of China, the ferocious Hun leader Shan-Yu is moving his troops to invade the country. The alarmed emperor issues a proclamation asking each family to send a man to fight. Mulan, takes the place of the elderly father in the call to arms.
notes: Built on a Chinese legend, the film defies rules and social roles, shuffles the cards of sexual perceptions, does not indulge in the tenderness that almost always dilutes the darkest Disney horrors. The stroke is rounded and decisive, inspired by the stylization of classical Chinese iconography, no downtime and just a hint of the inevitable idyll. The most beautiful scenes are those of Mulan's double dressing (first as a woman, immediately after as a soldier), the military training, the battle on the mountain, the quarrelsome family spirits.

title: Così è la vita
directors: Aldo Baglio, Giovanni Storti, Massimo Venier
actors: Aldo Baglio, Giovanni Storti, Giacomo Poretti, Marina Massironi
description: Aldo is a middle-class inmate who wouldn't hurt even a fly but who escapes by taking hostage a policeman who hates guns and a toy inventor. The three fleeing half of Italy are chased by the police until they meet Clara, the most beautiful and mysterious girl they have ever seen. Little by little the group will discover the meaning and value of friendship.
notes: Aldo, Giovanni and Giacomo have a taste for paradox and that of cinematic quotation. They like cinema, and it shows in the good will with which they try to "build" a true story. But, dilated to almost two hours, everything is diluted and diluted, completely losing the scan of the cinematic times and unfortunately also of the comic ones.

title: La gabbianella e il gatto
description: Cats are a group of old friends weighed down by years and too many treats; the mice, on the other hand, are expanding their power by taking advantage of the gentrification of cats. On the other hand, seagulls suffer the consequences of man-made pollution more than any other animal; a dying seagull therefore leaves a cat with its first egg, which will also be the last. The cats will raise the seagull that will soon be born, the mice will try in every way to eat it.
notes: Luis Sepúlveda's story is adapted by Umberto Marino. Beautiful music, famous voices, comic moments and other moving ones. Compared to "La freccia azzurra", D'Alò's first feature film, the drawing style is different, but it succeeds in making the cats heroes without imitating the Disney Aristocats. The action scenes are better than the sentimental ones, also because the kitten is a little too cute. Sepúlveda carves out the role of a human who tries to differentiate himself from his fellow men and also retains his voice for the role.

title: Il mio West
actors: Leonardo Pieraccioni, Harvey Keitel, David Bowie, Alessia Marcuzzi
description: On the border with Canada lies Basin Field, a quiet village nestled in the countryside. There is a saloon run by the seductive Mary, the post office, shops and stables. And there is Doc, a nonviolent doctor by nature, with his wife and son. The tranquility of the village is upset by the arrival of Jack Sikora, a bloodthirsty gunfighter who tries to fight his arch rival, Johnny Lowen.
notes: Between chatter and chatter (in the genre that has been the most laconic of cinema), among the unbearable trolleys and dollies that Veronesi has received and which therefore thinks well to use as much as possible, all the clichés of the western are ringed. The most embarrassing looting is that perpetrated against John Ford, reenacted in the nursery of the cinema.

title: The Confession
actors: Ben Kingsley, Amy Irving, Alec Baldwin, Ryan Marsini
description: Roy Bleakie is a bright young attorney vying for district attorney appointment. It is a cynic willing to do anything for his career, until he meets Harry Fertig, a self-confessed guilty of three murders. The man killed three doctors and paramedics who with their neglect had caused the death of their son. But Fertig is also the one who keeps the financial secrets of Renoble, a businessman and great protector of Roy who has every interest in having the murderer acquitted.
notes: Sandwiched between the rigid Jewish fundamentalism of Fertig (played by an intense Ben Kingsley), who, although not repenting of his act, wants to atone, and Renoble's order to have him released for inability to understand and want, Roy finds himself making the you have a morality that he had forgotten for too long. A conflict between ethics and career that becomes dramatic when Roy discovers that the story covers shady deals that endanger everyone's life, with a convincing Baldwin in the part and that with this film he makes his debut as a producer.

title: La cena
actors: Fanny Ardant, Stefania Sandrelli, Vittorio Gassman, Giancarlo Giannini
description: In the Antico Grottino, a Roman restaurant, the events of the usual patrons take place. There is the owner of the club who decides not to leave with her great love, a mother who discovers her daughter's vocation, a girl who makes an appointment with four boyfriends together, a professor who forces her very young lover to leave him and a charlatan who turns into an authentic magician.
notes: Scola's film looks like a collage of recycled ideas from many previous films: too many crises for a single night. None of the characters are interesting, but only destined to walk the path of their own "joke". Almost to revive the sleepiness of the whole, towards the end Scola unveils an embarrassing series of "director's whims": the sequence shot that searches for all the patrons calmed by the harps concert (power of art?), The subjective of the old lady who closes her eyes, it gets dark in the room, but then immediately reopens them (death of the cinema?), the Polaroid of the oriental child who photographs the magic (fantasy at work?).

title: Lautrec
actors: Régis Royer, Elsa Zylberstein, Anémone, Claude Rich
description: Henri Lautrec belongs to the high aristocracy of the French province and is the direct heir of the counts of Toulouse who participated in the Crusades. The environment in which the young Henri hangs out is that of the painters of Montmartre and the Moulin Rouge with its dancers. And so Henri, drawing inspiration from both environments, becomes the greatest painter of his time always fighting with his mother, a very devoted and kind-hearted woman, and with his father, a generous and extravagant man.
notes: In feuilleton version the biography of one of the most inspired brushes of the Belle Epoque. The reconstruction of the rooms is interesting, with the famous "Chat Noir" transformed into a walkway for street walkers and entraîneuses. But the character is not there. The theatrical actor Régis Royer, forced to act on his knees (Lautrec was a dwarf), does what he can to make captivating a figure that the script empties of thickness.

title: Illuminata
actors: Susan Sarandon, John Turturro, Katherine Borowitz, Christopher Walken
description: The ambitious playwright Tuccio runs a small company of actors in early 1900s New York. Tuccio is eager to finish his new play written for the woman he loves, Rachel. But the sacred monster of the scenes Célimène tries in every way to convince him to change his mind.
notes: Second direction by Turturro, presented (and unfairly with little luck) in Cannes. Between lightning-fast jokes ("Do you think masturbation is a sin?". "It depends on what the other hand is doing"), character actors (a memorable Christopher Walken, Beverly D'Angelo, Rufus Sewell, Ben Gazzara) and trustworthy relatives (his sister Aida, his son Amedeo and his wife Katherine), an amiable film all on the side of the theater, all against the critics of the city.

title: Panic in The Streets
actors: Richard Widmark, Paul Douglas, Barbara Bel Geddes, Jack Palance
description: The Armenian Kolack, who arrived illegally in New Orleans, is killed during the night by three thugs to whom he has won money at the game. The autopsy of the corpse reveals that the man was suffering from the plague. The authorities, terrified by the fear of the epidemic, give the police and the health office the task of tracking down the people who have had contact with the killed and put them in quarantine. But the searches immediately turn out to be very difficult ...
notes: The director (of Armenian origin) Elia Kazan puts his melodramatic and adventurous repertoire to work to create a product with a fast pace and unstoppable progression.

title: Dark Adapted Eye
actors: Helena Bonham Carter, Celia Imrie, Sophie Ward, Steven Mackintosh
description: A girl of the English middle class, Faith had been sent to the countryside by her father's sisters, Aunt Vera and Aunt Eden, to avoid the risk of bombing London. Aunt Vera, a woman of sound principles, wanted to educate Faith and her son Francis with the same moral rigor. Such severity, however, had not benefited Francis' education, very rebellious and tragressive. Unrefined drama, with an out-of-the-ordinary Bonham Carter.

title: 10 Rillington Place
actors: Richard Attenborough, Judy Geeson, John Hurt, Pat Heywood
description: John Reginald Christie, a middle-aged man who lives with his wife in a miserable London suburb, hides a tremendous murderous madness under a mild and calm aspect.
