In 1944, pretending to be a doctor, he lured a woman into his home, killed her and buried her body in the garden. A few years later, after the end of the world conflict, Christie rents a part of her house to a married couple, continuing her criminal enterprises.
notes: Between Jack the Ripper and Monsieur Landru, the film chooses a middle ground that combines horror and psychologism in equal parts. However, Hitchcock's lesson is not well assimilated.

title: Benito Mussolini: anatomia di un dittatore
description: The film is based on a choice made by the two directors who set out to reconstruct the profile of Benito Mussolini, among the numerous archive and repertoire material at their disposal. They range from the founding of fascism to the March on Rome, from Italy's entry into the war to Liberation.
notes: The film is harmed by a sketchy historical perspective and a satirical intent that is not very respectful of the people who lived through that controversial period. For the public at the time, some images were absolutely unpublished, today, after Nicola Caracciolo's documentaries, they are no longer so.

title: Making Love
actors: Michael Ontkean, Kate Jackson, Harry Hamlin, Wendy Hiller
description: Zack, a young doctor, and Claire, program manager for a television network, have been married for eight years and theirs is a happy marriage. There is only one child left to complete their union and Claire has almost decided that the right time has come. But his surprise is enormous when he learns that Zack has fallen in love with another man, Bart. This is a gay writer who, partly out of cynicism and partly out of actual interest, encourages Zack to bring his latent homosexuality to light.
notes: The film tackles a rough subject with too much superficiality. After all, the director had signed "Love Story".

title: Lord of the Flies
actors: Paul Balthazar, Chris Furrh, Daniel Pipoly, Gary Rule, Badge Dale
description: The plane on which there are about twenty American cadets between the ages of seven and twelve crashes into the ocean. The kids survive the accident but are left to fend for themselves on a tropical island. Castaways in an enchanting place, however, they must organize themselves to survive. They elect wise and strong-willed Ralph as their leader. The latter, aided by Piggy, a fat boy with a loser disposition, begins to behave like a true despot. The group splits in two and the escalation of violence will be terrifying.
notes: From the famous novel by Nobel Prize winner William Golding, it is the remake of Peter Brook's 1963 film. Schematic like the book, but still quite effective.

title: The Seven-Ups
actors: Tony Lo Bianco, Victor Arnold, Roy Scheider, Bill Hickman
description: Buddy is a brusque and violent investigator, deprecated by his colleague Larry but accepted by his superiors who put him in charge of a special team made up of rather determined policemen. Thanks to information provided by Vito, a former schoolmate and childhood friend, Buddy arrests the members of a gang of counterfeit banknote dealers.
notes: The "Violent Arm of the Law" producer is directing this unofficial sequel to William Friedkin's film.

title: Deal of the Century
actors: Chevy Chase, Sigourney Weaver, Gregory Hines, Vince Edwards
description: Two arms dealers are hoping to do gold deals by placing their "goods" halfway around the world, naturally on the black market. However, they did not deal with a terrible "internal enemy": their confusing disorganization of which they soon became victims, with disastrous consequences from all points of view.
notes: The comedy does not suit William Friedkin ("The violent arm of the law", "The Exorcist", "To live and die in Los Angeles", "Jade") much more comfortable with horror and noir. However the proverbial rhythm of his writing makes it more than a fully enjoyable moment.

title: The Clown at Midnight
actors: Christopher Plummer, Margot Kidder, Tatyana Ali, Sarah Lassez, James Duval
description: Kate, adopted at an early age, discovers that her mother, a young soprano on the rise, has been the victim of what appears to be a classic crime of passion. Working with a group of students on the recovery of the theater, where the murder took place, and with the help of George, a companion with a passion for special effects, Kate will come to discover the true story and the real culprit. of that and other heinous crimes.
notes: Good story with good performers. Great suspense which, however, does not remove this film for television from conventionality.

title: Silent Cradle
actors: Lorraine Bracco, John Heard, Jason Gedrick, Margot Kidder
description: Despite being in an advanced state of pregnancy, Helen, a journalist, continues to do her crime reporting job which, moreover, fascinates her a lot. While he is following a story he falls into ruin. Taken to the hospital, only minor injuries are found, but she is also told that she has lost the baby and, what is worse, that she will no longer be able to have any. Once she is discharged, Helen therefore turns to an agency that deals with adoptions and here she discovers that some procedures can be very easy and quick. Delving into things Helen discovers that ...
notes: And go with bioethics, an authentic St. Patrick's well for screenwriters short of ideas.

title: Chain Lightning
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Eleanor Parker, Raymond Massey, Richard Whorf
description: Mat Brennan, considered by all to be an ace in US aviation, one day meets by chance the aeronautical designer Troxell whom he got to know during the Second World War. Mat isn't sailing gold and the designer, who appreciates his qualities as a driver, introduces him to builder Willis. He hires him as a test driver for a new jet aircraft, the Iota A3, built to a design by Troxell himself who tragically dies while he is testing a plane. So Mat successfully experiments with an ejection seat.
notes: Propaganda film that Bogart is unable to revive.

title: Marked Woman
actors: Bette Davis, Humphrey Bogart, Lola Lane, Isabel Jewell
description: The dangerous gangster, Johnny Vanning, organizes the systematic exploitation of all New York nightclubs, including the Intime Club in which five girls work. One evening four people enter the restaurant who, after having consumed abundantly alcohol, are reluctant to pay the bill. One of them pays for it and is shot down by a gangster employed by Johnny. Mary is arrested along with her workmates on charges of complicity in the murder.
notes: Excellent performance by Bette Davis. The film, one of Warner's most realistic and "topical" products, also had problems with censorship.

title: Risate all'italiana
actors: Totò, Walter Chiari, Ugo Tognazzi, Raimondo Vianello, Peppino De Filippo
description: Anthological film that collects some famous sequences taken from the films that have made the history of Italian comic cinema. It starts from the legendary Totò to arrive at the duo Vianello and Tognazzi who had a good television success with the program "Un, due, tre". Do not miss Walter Chiari with his subtle humor.
notes: Fun is guaranteed and the cast is there to prove it, through thick and thin.

title: Ferdinando I, re di Napoli
actors: Peppino De Filippo, Eduardo De Filippo, Titina De Filippo
description: Ferdinand I, whom the Neapolitans don't affectionately call "king lazzarone", tries in vain to win the favor of the people. In Naples and throughout the kingdom, misery is rampant and poor economic conditions, as well as favoring the spread of discontent, inevitably lead to the desire for political change. Ferdinando does not care too much about the delicate situation and loves wandering through the alleys of the city in search of adventures. But the Neapolitan people rise up and force them to flee ...
notes: Comedy a little too weak but raised by a trio of performers, the De Filippo (with Peppino-Ferdinando and Eduardo doing Pulcinella), truly exceptional.

title: L'ultimo treno della notte
actors: Flavio Bucci, Macha Meril, Enrico Maria Salerno, Franco Fabrizi, Gianfranco De Grassi, Marina Berti, Irene Miracle, Laura D'Angelo
description: On the occasion of the Christmas holidays, Elisa Stradi, the sixteen-year-old daughter of a surgeon, leaves Germany to travel to Italy with her cousin Margareth. In Austria, due to an attack, the two traveling companions are forced to change trains. On a semi-deserted convoy bound for Verona they become victims of two young delinquents and a middle-class lady. Thrown from the moving train, Margareth dies. The three get rid of Elisa in the same way. When they get off the train, they run into their father who takes his revenge.
notes: Aldo Lado makes a twilight and hopeless "rape & revenge" movie.

title: La prima volta, sull'erba - Danza d'amore sotto gli olmi
actors: Anne Heywood, Claudio Cassinelli, Mark Lester, Monica Guerritore
description: At the beginning of the century, three families met in a pension in Tyrol: the neurologist Hans and his son Franz, the painter Margherita, his daughter Lotte and Hella, an aspiring actress girl with vanished parents. Both Hans and Margherita have very liberal ideas and encourage their respective children to have an uninhibited relationship. Franz and Lotte, however, are unable to give free rein to their instincts because in the meantime the neurologist and the painter have become lovers. Their block is overcome as soon as the two decide to separate.
notes: Trashone for ultra-amateurs, with a delirious international cast, directed by the director of "Appassionata".

title: Le trou
actors: Michel Constantin, Jean Kennedy, Philippe Leroy, Raymond Meunier
description: Mahu, Roland, Geo, Vasselin and Gaspard, held for common crimes, decide to evade trial by trying to escape. After making a hole in the floor of their cell, the five dig a tunnel that allows them to go outside. From a novel by José Giovani, Becker's latest film, shot with absolute economy of means of expression (the noise of tools digging the hole) and an unsustainable tension from beginning to end. With its interplay of relationships and looks that recall Bresson and anticipate Jean-Pierre Melville, the film is transformed, by virtue of thematic coherence and rigorous staging, into a desperate song of freedom.

title: Magic
actors: Anthony Hopkins, Ann-Margret, Burgess Meredith, Ed Lauter
description: A ventriloquist in great demand in all New York nightclubs, on the eve of a new important contract, runs away and makes his tracks disappear. He takes refuge in his native country where, however, he begins to manifest a severe form of schizophrenia that leads him to become succubus ... of his puppet.
notes: Strongly desired by Sir Richard Attenborough, it is a singular Gothic (especially for the director's strings) but a little disappointing. Without rhythm, one appreciates the performance of a young Hopkins.

title: Il compagno
actors: Lucio Zagaria, Stefania Sandrelli, Slvia De Santis, Nunzia Greco
description: We are in Turin in 1939. Pablo is handsome and young and loves playing the guitar and for this reason he is highly sought after by all boys and girls. He is not interested in social problems or politics. Through his friend Aurelio, who has been paralyzed in the legs due to an accident, he meets the beautiful Linda and falls in love with her. After the first meetings Linda suddenly disappears. Pablo, in love, looks for her and finds her with a man: Carletto, a handsome actor with a hump. For a while the two lovers continue to meet each other by attending a club, "Il Mascherino" where prostitutes and magicians work. Television version of a classic Cesare Pavese novel, the film oscillates between aestheticizing moments and other didactic moments, without lifting from an average television package.

title: L'amico del cuore
actors: Vincenzo Salemme, Carlo Buccirosso, Maurizio Casagrande, Eva Herzigova
description: Roberto, a village doctor, is in danger of life because he is seriously ill with his heart. He must leave for the United States where he will have to undergo a delicate surgery which, however, leaves him with little hope of survival. Before leaving he asks his best friend Michele to fulfill his last wish: to allow him to make love with Frida, his beautiful Swedish wife.
notes: Neighborhood comedy in the classic Neapolitan tradition (a la De Filippo, Eduardo, Peppino and Luca, with whom the author has collaborated for a long time), the film is one of those small beginnings that give hope a little in Italian cinema. Vincenzo Salemme, who wrote the play in 1997, signs the subject, the screenplay, directs and plays the role of the best friend. Some theatrical slowness, but the actors are good.

title: You've Got Mail
actors: Meg Ryan, Tom Hanks, Parker Posey, Greg Kinnear, Jean Stapleton
description: John and Kathleen live and work a few blocks away on New York's Upper West Side. The shops they frequent are the same and walk the same streets. He is the owner of Manhattan's largest bookstore chain while she has set up a small children's bookstore right next to the bookstore. In short, the two cordially hate each other, but one day, by pure coincidence, they meet in cyberspace where they travel while maintaining anonymity.
notes: We have already seen it: he and she, born to be together, know each other only by talking via radio, telephone or Internet and meet in person without knowing that the other is "the pen pal". Yet, even if we have already seen a virtually identical film (not "Write me mail" by Lubitsch, on which "There is mail for you" is based, but "Insomnia d'amore", which Nora Ephron built in 1993 along the lines of McCarey's "A Splendid Love"), the mechanism is oiled and not unpleasant. Impeccable script, well-chosen side performers, a customary (and perhaps obsolete) air that gives security, captivating musical choices. Sure, on the whole it seems a bit of a recycling of the classic Woody Allen, but the intuition of the "Godfather" as I Ching redeems part of the déjà vu.

title: Giubbe rosse
actors: Fabio Testi, Guido Mannari, Lynne Frederick, Lionel Stander, Renato Cestié
description: Caribou marries Elizabeth, the famous singer, and uses her to pay for his ruinous poker games and his solemn hangover. Bill Cormack, a sergeant of the Red Coats saves him from the crowd who would like to lynch him since he became the protagonist of the killing of two playmates. Caribou, however, manages to lose track and decides to give himself to the life of the outlaw. So, with other accomplices, he attacks the postal courier and steals the gold. Adventurous drama professionally directed by Aristide Massaccesi, known mostly as an erotic director (the apocryphal "Emanuelle" series) and porn.

title: Il caso difficile del commissario Maigret
actors: Heinz Rühmann, Françoise Prevost, Günther Stoll, Günther Strack
description: In a Parisian art gallery, a thief steals a precious Van Gogh painting after killing the keeper who was trying to oppose the theft. Inspector Maigret is in charge of the investigations who, having gathered the first clues, begins to follow Holoway, a well-known collector of paintings. The latter, having moved to Lausanne, is found mysteriously killed in his hotel room after a night spent in a night club.

title: Central do Brasil
actors: Fernanda Montenegro, Vinicius De Oliveira, Marilia Pêra
description: At the Rio station table, the former teacher Dora rounds off her pension by writing letters for the others. Among his clients are Ana and her son Josué, who is nine years old and who has a great desire: to meet his father. The following day Ana is the victim of an accident and so Josué asks Dora to accompany him in search of his parent.
notes: Walter Salles' road movie is beautiful, because it manages to slip the political theme between the lines, losing our gaze in the landscapes, in the rhythms and in the variety of encounters. And he manages to make us accept the extravagant solidarity that is established between the two protagonists without ever pushing on the pedal of pathetism. Golden Bear in Berlin.

title: The Prince of Egypt
directors: Brenda Chapman, Steve Hickner, Simon Wells
description: The Jew Moses, foundling abandoned to the fury of the waters of the Nile, is picked up and adopted by the pharaoh. Raised as a prince inside the palace, the boy becomes the inseparable friend of Ramses, the heir to the throne. But Moses discovers his origins and is forced into a confrontation with his one-time friend. The struggle will become bloody when Moses is chosen by God to free the Jewish people from the slavery of Egypt.
notes: This first animated feature film by Katzenberg, Spielberg and Geffen's Dreamworks is not intended to be a "normal" cartoon or a children's film. The story is epic in the action scenes (the chariot race of the two brothers, the passage of the Red Sea), disturbing in the passage of scourges and curses, almost never comic. The desire to abolish every "Disney" element is evident; which means, however, that the film often collapses, trapped by a vague didactic boredom.

title: Paparazzi
actors: Christian De Sica, Massimo Boldi, Diego Abatantuono, Nino D'Angelo, Roberto Brunetti
description: Five photojournalists try to find the scoop of their lives by chasing the most popular international celebrities of the moment.
notes: Among the more or less imaginative finds there is a large group of real VIPs who play at being themselves with narcissism. Sgarbi, Fede, l'Estrada, algida Parietti, the Junoesque Falchi and Casalegno and an endless legion of other beautiful names, confirm the saying that "advertising is the soul of commerce" even if insipid, and softened only in a small way starts from the nice Nino D'Angelo.

title: Sib
actors: Ghorbanali Naderi, Massoumeh Naderi, Zahra Naderi, Azizeh Mohamadi
description: In a poor neighborhood of Tehran, a man conditioned by an immutable cultural reality, and his wife, have kept their two daughters segregated at home since their birth. Thanks to the intervention of the social worker, the girls gradually come out of their isolation and open themselves to the conquest of a hitherto unknown world.
notes: Small "feminine" film where the curious and amazed gazes of two twelve-year-old girls wander in the glimpses of an "outside" that has just opened up for them, fascinated by an apple hanging by a thread. Shot with a "magical" rigor.

title: Ronin
actors: Robert De Niro, Natascha McElhone, Jean Reno, Skipp Sudduth
description: After the fall of the Berlin Wall, spies from all over the world are out and about and make do as best they can. Five of them find themselves in Paris and are hired by two New Ira terrorists. They have to steal a suitcase protected by sophisticated security systems.
notes: Solid action movie, veiled by a subtle crepuscularity. The first part (let's say until the arrival in Arles) has a couple of anthology sequences, made by Frankenheimer with an icy look. Then, in the end, the usual chaos of an American policeman, but the most is done. Stunning locations, breathtaking chases, memories of the two "Violent Arm of the Law", the intense face of Natasha McElhone, a cameo of the "con man" Lonsdale and a new action couple, the "professional" De Niro and the "Mediterranean" Reno. Cut with the ax of classic cinema, spectacular, essential, relaxing.

title: Antz
description: In the anthill life goes on without great emotions. The tasks are equally distributed: there are those who work on consolidation and those who must defend that precarious balance from the onslaught of hostile insects. Z, an ant imbued with doubts, becomes a hero: he learns that the warrior ant general has planned the destruction of the anthill to make only the fighting ants survive, and he will fight to foil the design ...
notes: Captivating computer animation for a new example of a cartoon also intended for an adult audience and voiced in the original by famous voices: the protagonist speaks with the voice of Woody Allen.

title: Enemy of the State
actors: Will Smith, Gene Hackman, Jon Voight, Lisa Bonet, Regina King, Stuart Wilson, Laura Cayouette, Loren Dean, Barry Pepper, Jake Busey, Gabriel Byrne, James LeGros, Tom Sizemore
description: The secret services have to hide the murder of a politician who opposed a law that effectively allows the privacy of all American citizens to be violated. A recording made by chance could nail them, and for this reason a death squad decides to intervene: but a young and promising black lawyer accidentally comes into possession of the burning document. At his side is the man who a few years earlier had worked for the services and had managed to get rid of his tracks.
notes: Scott takes up the themes and the actor from Coppola's "The Conversation". But that 1974 film was so painful and intense as it is noisy today: so many special effects, sophisticated techniques and shooting virtuosity that leave a sense of emptiness at the end of the vision, accentuated by a foregone conclusion for the story. Very good Hackman, but we already knew that.

title: Martha Meet Frank, Daniel & Laurence
actors: Monica Potter, Tom Hollander, Joseph Fiennes, Rufus Sewell
description: The beautiful and blonde Martha, escaped from the ugliness of the United States, falls in London semi-desperate. Destiny does not allow itself to be repeated twice and already at the airport what normally does not happen (in life) happens: that Daniel, a young executive of a record company, is thunderstruck to the point of going crazy and immediately involving his two best friends , Frank and Laurence.
notes: We are once again in "Kieslowski territory", as has already happened for "Sliding Doors" and the stories (in fact) must necessarily multiply. Fortunately, the director knows his stuff and finds the balance necessary to entertain.

title: Celebrity
actors: Kenneth Branagh, Melanie Griffith, Winona Ryder, Judy Davis, Leonardo DiCaprio
description: A reporter divorces his wife, gets engaged to a new partner, and can't stop himself from chasing dazzling models and intriguing waitresses. He would like to start writing a novel that he too often had to abandon and tries to make it to Hollywood as a screenwriter. He ends up in the room of a Hollywood star who offers him a close encounter with some uninhibited starlets.
notes: In a punctuated and somewhat saddened black and white, Woody Allen returns to tell a New York story of couples, neuroses and crises. Small film, written and directed with the tip of a pen, which risks the manner a bit.

title: Unhook the Stars
actors: Gena Rowlands, Marisa Tomei, Gérard Depardieu, Jake Lloyd
description: Mildred is a widow, with a married son and a daughter who suddenly decides to leave home and suddenly finds herself facing an unknown loneliness. Unintentionally, a neighbor comes to her aid, first asking her to "take a look" at her six-year-old son and then introducing her to a truck driver friend, who shyly begins to court the woman. Thanks to these events, Mildred's life seems to start all over again, even if she will again find herself faced with the need to make a choice.
notes: It is the directorial debut of Nick Cassavetes, son of John. The director (a career that began as an actor) who is also a screenwriter of the film has built a story (played by his mother Gena Rowlands) that revolves around the life of a middle-aged woman. Not a new role for Rowlands, that of a mother of a family ("A wife" directed by Cassavetes), certainly with autobiographical implications, especially given the "family environment" of the film; alongside him Marisa Tomei and Gérard Depardieu (whose HPGD company has distributed many John Cassavetes films in France) who is also among the producers of the film.

title: L'albero di Guernica
actors: Mariangela Melato, Ron Faber, Cosimo Cinieri, Franco Ressel
description: While in Villa Ramiro, a Spanish town former fiefdom of the Counts of Cerraibo, the people are celebrating the carnival and the end of hunger and oppression, a group of generals rebel against republican power and unleash civil war. A young peasant woman, Vandal, and Goya son of the Count of Cerraibo, who met by chance in Guernica, renounce their intention to reach France to take sides with the republican forces.
notes: The title of Fernando Arrabal's film refers to the mythical tree that survived the fierce bombing of the city of Guernica and became the symbol of freedom.

title: Ricordati di Napoli
actors: Aurelio Fierro, Giulia Rubini, Alberto Lionello, Dolores Palumbo
description: Lucia, a Neapolitan girl, meets Johnny, an Italian-American singer, during her stay in Naples. The two like each other and have a relationship. Some time after Johnny's departure, Lucia gives birth to a baby boy. The singer, who is unaware of everything, forgets Lucia and courts a rich American that he intends to marry. One day, however, he receives a letter from Lucia's friend announcing the happy event.
notes: Modest film that takes advantage of Aurelio Fierro's talent as an actor and singer. Without the courage of the Merola drama and still too little "musicarello" to convince.

title: The Magic Christian
actors: Peter Sellers, Ringo Starr, Richard Attenborough, Christopher Lee
description: Sir Guy Grand, a very rich English industrialist, having no direct descendants, adopts Archibald, a young tramp met by chance. But soon Sir Guy is essentially concerned with demonstrating to his godson the corrupting power of money. All through concrete examples: he falsifies a public auction, reduces the traditional rowing challenge between Oxford and Cambridge to a brawl, and subjects cruise participants to a series of ferocious jokes. Will Archibald be able to understand the lesson?
notes: The film consists of a series of sketches taken from a satirical book by Terry Southern. Great, as usual, Peter Sellers.

title: Siamo tutti pomicioni
actors: Mario Carotenuto, Raimondo Vianello, Sandra Mondaini, Alberto Bonucci
description: Episode movies. Ennio, a tankman corporal, manages to strike up a relationship with the wife of an English NATO colonel. Mario runs into an adventurer whose mistress he would like to become, but at the most beautiful his mother gets in the way. Ciccio and Salvatore, two Sicilians who came to Rome with their wives for a pilgrimage, escape the surveillance of their wives, but they get into trouble. Floro is surprised by his wife in the company of her lover.
notes: Harmless seaside movie with a crazy title. The cast is quite rich.

title: Broadway Melody of 1940
actors: Fred Astaire, George Murphy, Eleanor Powell, Frank Morgan
description: Two dancers perpetually looking for a job make ends meet by dedicating themselves to whatever activity comes their way. A great impresario notices them while they are in a public place and calls one of them for a show on Broadway. By mistake, the less good of the two signs the contract and suddenly the friendship falls apart. But success goes to the head of the boy who forgets how much he owes to his partner.
notes: Big musical numbers in this rather underrated musical. Fred Astaire and Eleanor Parker duet on the notes of "Beguin the Beguin". Excellent music by Cole Porter.

title: The Wanderers
actors: Ken Wahl, John Friederich, Karen Allen, Alan Rosenberg
description: In 1963 the Wanderers gang, led by Richie, is the absolute master of 52nd street in the North Bronx. One evening he comes into conflict with the Pelati and would have the worst if a stranger did not intervene, Perry who takes the defense of Joey, Richie's inseparable companion. At school, things do not go better and the Wanderers clash with the Bombers using an American football match as a pretext.
notes: Kaufman offers us a series of sketches not all successful, but directed with energy. Richard Price wrote the novel from which the film is based, which has very little to do with "The Warriors of the Night".

title: Lucky Luciano
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, Vincent Gardenia, Silverio Blasi, Rod Steiger, Jacques Monod
description: Salvatore Lucania, aka Lucky Luciano, has been the undisputed leader of the American underworld since 1931, when he took power thanks to the elimination of about forty opponents. In 1946 the governor Thomas E. Denwey, who years earlier, in the role of judge, had condemned Luciano, sent him to Italy as undesirable. From that day Lucky took up residence in Naples and lived a quiet life. Yet increasingly insistent rumors point to him as the inspirer of international drug trafficking.
notes: Good film directed by Rosi, who for the first time combines his typical realism with the gangster cut of American cinema.

title: Jalsaghar
actors: Chhabi Biswas, Kali Sarkar, Tulsi Lahiri, Gangapada Bose
description: India, 1920s. The zamindar (feudal lord) Biswambhar Roy has fallen into the darkest depression after falling apart for the sake of music and, above all, after losing his wife and child. The desire to give a lesson to a vulgar rich man pushes him to reopen the music room to give a last and extraordinary concert. For this he asks for the help of the dancer Krishna Bai.
notes: Ray, through the character of the feudal lord, offers us a painful and disturbing portrait of caste pride. A great historical novel based on a short story by Tarasankar Banerjee. The musical numbers are splendid.

title: Black Light
actors: Michael Ironside, Tahnee Welch, Currie Graham, Anne Marie Loder
description: Sharon is a woman who has received the gift of foresight. She is contacted by the police who are investigating the case of a kidnapped child. Sharon cannot locate where the child is hidden and is found dead. Pressed by journalists who accuse her of the death of the little boy, Sharon runs away in a car and is involved in a serious car accident. Sharon, who has recovered in the meantime, realizes she has lost her power and attempts suicide by drowning. Just then she has a vision of another kidnapped child and rushes to Inspector Schumann who hastily liquidates her, until the body of a murdered girl is found ...

title: Kickboxer 4: the Aggression
actors: Nicholas Anthony, Burton Richardson, Deborah Mansy, Derek Cravin
description: Sasha Mitchell prepares his return to the ring under the alias David Sloan, but this time he must fight not for his survival but for his beautiful wife. The woman has become the sex slave of the hateful world champion Tong Po. Sasha, or rather David, is in prison but manages to escape. Once out, he tries to penetrate the impenetrable refuge of Tong Po, a fortress located in Mexico and protected by bodyguards and slaves. Sadly David agrees to participate in a tournament that would allow him to save his wife and gain power.
notes: Usual film based on a banal story and lots of fights.

title: The Finest Hour
actors: Rob Lowe, Gale Hansen, Tracy Griffith, Eb Lottimer, Baruch Dror
description: Mazzoli and Hammer, two soldiers enlisted in the navy, end up becoming good friends during the (very hard) training course they have to undergo to become part of the Navy Seals special corps. But a woman stands between the two of them and tries to divide them. The outbreak of the Gulf War will find them side by side again.
notes: The film attempts to glorify the "Desert Storm" operation. Unfortunately, the action scenes that should represent the juice of films of this genre are missing.

title: Casta diva
actors: Antonella Lualdi, Nadia Gray, Maurice Ronet, Paola Borboni
description: Vincenzo Bellini, who has just completed his studies at the Naples Conservatory of Music, has the opportunity to meet Maddalena. One of his poems entitled "Casta diva" arouses the girl's attention. Great is his surprise when he discovers that Maddalena has already been promised by her father to Ernesto Tosi a rich Neapolitan industrialist. When he discovers that Ernesto is flirting with the famous opera singer Giuditta Pasta, he proposes to Maddalena to flee with him to Sicily.
notes: Color remake of a (much better) film by Gallone himself, dated 1935. The music is directed by Renzo Rossellini.

title: Lost in Space
actors: William Hurt, Mimi Rogers, Gary Oldman, Matt LeBlanc, Heather Graham, Lacey Chabert, Jack Johnson
description: The spaceship Jupiter 2, under the command of Major Don West, leaves for Alpha Prime, the only planet capable of hosting human beings in the entire galaxy. During the voyage, the spacecraft is sabotaged by Dr. Zacharias Smith, intent on making the project fail. When the Jupiter deviates from her course, the Robinson family, housed on board, must work as a team to save the day.
notes: In September 1965, CBS aired the first episode of "Lost in Space", a fun science fiction sitcom. The film version fails to recover the wholesome madness of the TV model.

title: Gingerbread Man
actors: Kenneth Branagh, Embeth Davidtz, Robert Downey jr., Daryl Hannah, Robert Duvall
description: Rick, a successful lawyer, while in the town of Savannah, spends a night of love with Mallory, a beautiful waitress who ends up involving him in his private life. The girl is chased by her father, Dixon, a mad fundamentalist who persecutes her. Rick gets admitted to Dixon's psychiatric hospital, but when the latter escapes, Rick must defend his ex-wife's children from the man's threats.
notes: Altman takes a story by Grisham (one of the usual, procedural and narcissistic) and transforms it into a puzzle that combines the disenchantment of "America today" (confused families and permanent anguish), the mysteries and suspended sensuality of "The protagonists ", the dizzying impossibility of reconstructing a coherent image of the world (and of a cinematographic genre) of" The long goodbye ". Altman's film is uncomfortable, fascinating, underground. The direction leaves nothing to chance, not even the slightest detail found at the edge of a shot.

title: Velvet Goldmine
actors: Jonathan Rhys Meyers, Ewan McGregor, Christian Bale, Toni Collette
description: Seventies. The Glam Rock phenomenon explodes on the English music scene. Brian Slade, a leading exponent of the movement, and his friend Curt Wild, upset sleepy Britain. From that moment on, crowds of young people put on make-up and dress like them. Slade, however, makes the mistake of taking the path of self-destruction and, a prisoner of his character, stages his own murder.
notes: Haynes retraces the years of Glam Rock with an investigation taken on an equal footing from Orson Welles' "Fourth Estate" (but she is not injured majesty), with an irrepressible energy and nostalgia.

title: Idioterne
actors: Jens Albinus, Bodil Jørgensen, Anne Louise Hassing, Troels Lyby
description: A group of young people find themselves in a suburban house to try to practice absolute idiocy, to give up control not according to the "rules of madness", but according to the unpresentability of fools. Idiots disturb in restaurants, scandalize the neighborhood and social workers, run naked on the street, indulge in the crowds.
notes: Dogma says: don't use built sets, movie music, camera mounts, tricks or filters; it shoots in color, in 35 mm and live; and, above all, don't sign, don't be an artist. Lars von Trier thrives on contradictions but is the only one who wants to re-establish the (lost) innocence of cinema.

title: Amarti è il mio peccato
actors: Jacques Sernas, Luisa Rossi, Elisa Cegani, Alba Arnova, Gino Bramieri
description: Doctor Monti, Countess Danieli's dishonest administrator, killed himself in shame when his administrative flaws came to the surface. Completely alone, Elena, her illegitimate daughter, asks for help from Sergio, a handsome young man, son of the noblewoman who was deceived by suicide. Despite his mother's opposition, Sergio hires Elena as his secretary and, of course, falls in love with her. Meanwhile the Second World War broke out and Sergio joined the air force. During an action he falls into the sea and is considered missing. At first, Elena is desperate, but discovers that she has become pregnant. For the love of the unborn child she decides to continue living even if she realizes that she risks giving birth to an unfortunate being like her.
notes: Movie already stale when it came out. The play is completely conventional; curious is the presence of a comedian like Bramieri.

title: Hollywood-Monster
actors: Jason Lively, Tim McDaniel, Leonard Lansink, Jill Whitlow
description: Three close friends, two boys and a girl, have always cultivated a great dream: to be able to shoot a horror film. A famous Hollywood producer agrees to meet them. The treacherous gentleman pretends to snub the proposed idea by calling it ridiculous and unachievable. In reality, his intention is quite different: finding it very good, he appropriates it to turn it into a film without having to shell out a penny. The three boys, having discovered the deception, will make him pay dearly, combining it with all the colors.

title: Panni sporchi
actors: Michele Placido, Paolo Bonacelli, Mariangela Melato, Gigi Proietti, Ornella Muti
description: The Razzi family has been producing Cialda for two generations, a digestive candy made from chicory. At the helm of the company there is now Furio Cimin, the founder's son-in-law, who has been dismissed but who would like, through a nephew, to take back the command of the company. Quarrels, intrigues, rash investments between the sons and relatives of the progenitor, are bringing the company to the brink of bankruptcy.
notes: Story of family horrors set in the small "fat" province, it exudes the vulgarity of its subjects without being able to make a fool of it, but allowing itself to be harnessed, due to an excess of faith in one's own "professionalism" and its actors. Monicelli mentions himself, but never recaptures certain insights, or at least the cure, of some of his films from the past.

title: Baci e abbracci
actors: Francesco Paolantoni, Paola Tiziana Cruciani, Edoardo Gabbriellini
description: Christmas in a Tuscan farmhouse. There is Mario, uprooted from Salerno, owner of a restaurant that is about to close and with a marriage in the process of bankruptcy. There are three former workers from Livorno who, with the help of their families, have set up an ostrich farm in a half-abandoned farmhouse. The problem is that Mario is mistaken for a kind of "savior of the homeland".
notes: Paolo Virzì keeps the comedy subdued, without ever forcing possible dramatic developments. Be careful not to turn the characters into specks and to catch certain silent and disturbing nuances. The whole is spontaneous, vital, measured.

title: I fobici
actors: Sabrina Ferilli, Luca Laurenti, Daniele Liotti, Gian Marco Tognazzi
description: Four episodes. "Night shift": a man runs all night giving information, even if not requested, on the timetables of the night buses. "All a tic": Andrea has many tics but is happy. When he decides to cure himself because he is in love, his life becomes hell. "Have I turned off the gas?": A doubt assails Carlo already out of the house before a trip and forces him to return. "Forbidden Fruit": Alvaro loves curvy women and cars. When he is forced to choose between the two ...
notes: The Italian comedy is back and with it, also the practice of "episodic films" which, in the Sixties, had its best moment. Giancarlo Scarchilli after the very timid "Do me a favor", tries to raise the bar, to pull out a pair of nails, to revive the (cynical) glories that were. The results are four stories crossed by well-known and disturbing faces of the embarrassing contemporary TV (this is the case of Luca Laurenti, in the first chapter), by beautiful without soul (Daniele Liotti devastated by tics), by children of art (Gianmarco always more "ugotognazzi") and as sex symbols not recommended by cardiologists (the brilliant Ferilli). Precisely the irrepressible Sabrina is at the center of "Forbidden Fruit", the episode that closes (well) the still awkward and (still too much) little casual comedy. immediately the pasta it advertises. To be consumed strictly, by the end of the (ing) year.

title: Happiness
actors: Jane Adams, Elizabeth Ashley, Lara Flynn Boyle, Ben Gazzara, Cynthia Stevenson, Philip Seymour Hoffman
description: At thirty Joy still lives in her parents' house. The girl lives in hopes of finding the man of her life. Joy's two sisters, Helen and Trish, pity her but they too are struggling with sentimental problems. Helen starts flirting with an anonymous phone offender. Trish's husband is instead attracted to minors.
notes: A very successful comedy with acid tones that shows us a peaceful landscape with figures. Which on closer inspection are all monstrous. It didn't go through censorship unscathed but it is one of the most genuinely bad American films made in America in the 1990s. Amazing cast, particularly funny Ben Gazzara.

title: La spada della vendetta
actors: Frank Latimore, Patricia Luz, Gian Luigi Marianini, Franco Trompeo
description: While the governor of Milan, Don Gonzalo de Cordova, is besieging the city of Casale, the deputy governor tyrannizes the people to win the sympathy of the Spanish rulers. Since Diana, a noble girl, will come into possession of a huge fortune at the time of the wedding, the deputy governor plans to marry her with the help of the noble's sister, Elizabeth. But Diana is in love with Marco, a soldier of fortune so when the deputy governor plans to kidnap her she will have to deal with the military ...
notes: Para-Blasettian Sword and Sword Series Z and out of time

title: Assalto al tesoro di Stato
actors: Roger Browne, Anita Sanders, Franco Ressel, Sandro Dori
description: The Arab state of Goggiam declares to the American Record Oil Company that it intends to take over the oil concession with 20 million dollars and nationalize it. Prime Minister Ben Aiscia informs Dr Kauffman, director of the oil company, that the money needed for the operation will be sent to him by means of an armored van. Determined to stop the operation, Kauffman hires four thugs to assault the van. Everything is going according to plan and for the four of them getting their hands on the money turns out to be easier than expected. At some point, however, things go wrong: Kauffman loses his skin and the money disappears. Where have you been?

title: She's the One
actors: Jennifer Aniston, Maxine Bahns, Edward Burns, Cameron Diaz
description: Francis and Mickey are two brothers haunted by problems with women. The father gives them some advice: Francis puts them into practice and Mickey does the opposite, but ... the result does not change.
notes: Pleasant and sparkling comedy of the parts with the sex symbol of the moment Cameron Diaz, object of desire of the two perky young men.

title: Rawhide - Desperate Siege
actors: Tyrone Power, Susan Hayward, Hugh Marlowe, Dean Jagger
description: The city of San Francisco is connected to Saint Louis by an important stagecoach service. Of all the stations scattered along the route, Rawhide is under the responsibility of a grumpy old head of service. One day a stagecoach arrives in the village carrying Winnie, a beautiful girl accompanied by her grandson. At the moment of leaving, the rumor spreads that the notorious bandit Zimmerman has been spotted in the area, who is trying to put the city to fire and sword.
notes: Hathaway, on his debut as a western director, shoots the remake of a 1935 gangster film entitled "Exterminate them without mercy".

title: Selena
actors: Jennifer Lopez, Edward James Olmos, Jacob Vargas, Rebecca Lee Meeza, Jon Seda
description: Selena Quintanilla (Lopez) is a young and charming Tejano singer. Everything is going well: she has the affection of her father and her sister and she also knows a boy who will soon become her husband: the affectionate Chris. Her music conquers the markets but the success attracts the attention of a mysterious murderer who kills her. Without being clear why.
notes: A not extraordinary film, strongly desired by Selena's father, Abraham Quintanilla. Bronx Puerto Rican diva Jennifer Lopez (not yet a tedious pop star) has fallen well into the character of the hapless musician.

title: Canadian Pacific
actors: Randolph Scott, Jane Wyatt, J. Carrol Naish, Robert Barrat
description: On behalf of the builders of the great North American railway, Tom Andrews explores a virgin territory inhabited by red Indians and studies its terrain. If on the one hand the construction of the railway will be very useful to the inhabitants of the region, on the other hand it will reduce the hefty earnings of the speculators who hold the monopoly of trade. One of them, Dick, benefiting from the ignorance of the Indians tries to boycott the construction of the railway. Tom, warned in time by an Indian in love with him, manages to foil a first attack, but, later on treacherously attacked, he is wounded.

title: Shake Hands with the Devil
actors: James Cagney, Don Murray, Dana Wynter, Glynis Johns
description: We are in Ireland in 1921, in the period of the most intense conflict between Irish irredentists and British occupation troops. Kerry O'Shea is a young man of Irish origin but with an American passport who, for this reason, prefers to keep out of the fight. But Kerry loves a girl who is very active in resistance. When he sees her dying in his arms, he realizes that it is no longer time to be neutral and so takes his place in the ranks of the revolt.
notes: The rebellion of Ireland seen, forty years later, by a refined and sensitive English author. Plus a James Cagney in great shape.

title: State of The Union
actors: Spencer Tracy, Katharine Hepburn, Angela Lansbury, Van Johnson
description: The owner of a powerful publishing group, old and sick, kills himself. Management passes to his daughter who finds herself having to lead the battle to support the group's trustee, Grant Matthews as president of the United States. The two are in love, but Grant has to deal with his wife who is aware of her husband's betrayal. When Grant's success seems assured, the opposing groups, who know his family situation in detail, exploit it to destabilize his candidacy.
notes: Frank Capra draws the film's subject from a Pulitzer-winning work by Howard Lindsay and Russel Crouse. He no longer has the verve of the past, and he has grown a bit gloomy, but certain flashes (and the underlying moral) are unmistakable.

title: A Time to Love and a Time to Die
actors: John Gavin, Liselotte Pulver, Keenan Wynn, Jim Hutton
description: During the Second World War, Ernst Graeber, a German soldier, returns home on leave. The city is half-destroyed by Allied bombing and a sense of imminent defeat looms everywhere. Ernst decides to use the few days he has available to fulfill an old dream: marrying Elisabeth, an old school friend, with whom he has been in love for a long time.
notes: Melodrama by Douglas Sirk, based on the novel of the same name by Eric Maria Remarque, which admirably combines a delicate love story with the historical framework of the tragic conflict. Remarque himself and a very young Klaus Kinski are recognizable in two parts.

title: Sons and Lovers
actors: Dean Stockwell, Trevor Howard, Wendy Hiller, Mary Ure
description: The Morel family lives in Nottingham: the father, a miner is a violent man and addicted to alcohol, the mother loves her children morbidly. Paul, the second son, is a sensitive, temperamental boy who demonstrates an aptitude for painting, while Arthur is forced to work in the mine. When the latter dies as a result of an accident at work, the mother falls into depression. To distract her, Paul accompanies her to a painting exhibition where one of her works is also exhibited. A wealthy gentleman, well impressed by Paul's painting invites him to go to London to study at the Academy of Fine Arts in the capital Paul meets Clara ...

title: Viskiningar och rop
actors: Harriet Andersson, Ingrid Thulin, Liv Ullmann, Kari Sylwan, Anders Ek, Inga Gill, Erland Josephson, Henning Moritzen, Georg Årlin, Ingrid Bergman
description: In a villa immersed in the autumn colors of a park on the outskirts of Stockholm, the forty-year-old Agnes is dying of cancer. Her sisters Karin and Maria rushed to her bed, who had not been in contact with her for some time. Married to a man older than her, Karin is a merciless woman who hates others and has a strong distaste for physical contact.
notes: Bergman's masterpiece, one of his crudest and most chilling films. The use of color and the rigorous temporal scanning are famous.

title: All Quiet on the Western Front
actors: Richard Thomas, Ernest Borgnine, Donald Pleasence, Ian Holm
description: A group of German students at the outbreak of the First World War enlisted and volunteers leave. Going through terrifying experiences, from brutal exercises to contact with the violent death of companions, from the search for food to survive, to the chilling spectacle of the destruction of a generation of men. Years go by and the group gets thinner and thinner.
notes: Remake of the film directed in 1929 by Lewis Milestone rests on the direction of a television drama. Too bad because Mann had a great cast at his disposal.

title: Blood Red
actors: Eric Roberts, Giancarlo Giannini, Dennis Hopper, Burt Young
description: California, 1890. A man who emigrated from Sicily must defend the land he conquered with great sacrifices from the interference of an Irishman who decided to use it to build the railway. Of course, the emigrant is not there and a relentless struggle ensues.
notes: Masterson's film marked Julia Roberts' debut. To keep her company is her brother Eric who has not been very successful and Giannini who seems to have subscribed to the role of southern emigrant.

title: Passe from Hell
actors: Audie Murphy, John Saxon
description: Paradise, as the word itself says, is a quiet town in the West where harmony and tranquility reign. But one day a gang of outlaws just escaped from the penitentiary arrives, made up of four bandits already sentenced to death for an endless series of crimes. In short, the outlaws rob the bank, kill the sheriff, kill some other citizens and, not yet happy, kidnap a girl to cover her escape.
notes: Absolutely routine, predictable and professional Western.

title: Time to Say Goodbye?
actors: Richard Kiley, Eva Marie Saint, Margaret Colin, Tracey Hoyt
description: Doctor Gerald Klooster, at the age of sixty-nine, discovers that he is suffering from Alzheimer's disease, the same disease that led to his mother's death. Gerald is terrified of ending his days in a completely dazed nursing home so he asks his wife, when the time comes, to help him die. At first Ruth refuses, but then accepts her husband's will and informs the children of her intentions. Chip, one of the sons, considering what Ruth should do as an unacceptable fact, kidnaps her father and takes him to the state of Michigan, where he lives. But it doesn't stop there because he denounces his mother for inducing suicide and attempted murder and sues the rest of the family in court. At the same time he asks the Michigan court for custody of his father. Her sister Kristen appeals, however, asking that Gerald be entrusted to her instead. After a difficult dispute between the Michigan and California courts, where the rest of the Klooster family resides, a sort of compromise is reached. Gerald is entrusted to Kristen with the proviso that her daughter does not abandon him or her mother for a single moment.

title: Major Payne
actors: Damon Wayans, Karyn Parson, Michael Ironside, Albert Hall
description: Major Benson Payne joined the army well aware that he would never be engaged in a war action. Fixed with discipline and a rigid military mentality, he is the bugbear of the whole army. When a group of recruits arrive at the barracks, Benson can't wait to fix them up by putting his teachings into practice ...
notes: This comedy was produced and co-scripted by Damon Wayans, who decided to bring to the screen _ Major Benson's Private War_, directed by Jerry Hopper in 1955: it cannot be said that the attempt was fully successful.

title: Sette winchester per un massacro
actors: Guy Madison, Edd Byrnes, Louise Barrett, Rick Boyd, Alfred Aysanoa
description: At the end of the Secession War, Southern Colonel Thomas Blake at the head of a gang of thugs spread terror in the border regions between the United States and Mexico. Blake's main purpose is to recover a chest containing two hundred thousand dollars, hidden by the Southern general Beauregard. One day the colonel introduces himself to a certain Stewart who claims to know the place where the treasure is hidden. After the initial distrust Blake agrees to follow the man.
notes: Spaghetti western without infamy and without praise directed by Enzo Girolami who here uses the pseudonym E.G. Rowland, but which is better known by the stage name of Enzo G. Castellari. Here, unfortunately for him, he does not have actors of that level and the results, unfortunately, can be seen.

title: La morte sull'alta collina
actors: Peter Lee Lawrence, Louis Dawson, Tano Cimarosa, Agnès Spaak
description: The young Loring Van der Velt and Parker, a mysterious individual, after allowing the Mexican Valiente and his gang to rob the bank of Two Arrow, manage to seize the loot and hide it waiting to be able to share it. Braddock, who commissioned the robbery, instructs Valiente to track down Loring.
notes: Western spaghetti not despicable, but without great interest.

title: Friday the 13th Part 3: 3D
actors: Dana Kimmell, Paul Kratka, Richard Brooker, Jeffrey Rogers
description: A group of young people decide to spend the weekend in a country cabin which, two years earlier, had been the scene of a bloody story. A maniac in a hockey goalie mask had attacked a girl and the mistress of the house. She thought she had killed him, but the killer is still alive and wandering nearby. The members of the group of adolescents are killed in the most unexpected and ferocious ways as well as a group of unfortunate thugs. Third episode of the "Friday 13" saga, it does not rise from mediocrity even with the direction of a valid specialist like Miner.

title: Child's Play 3
actors: Andrew Robinson, Dakin Matthews, Justin Whalin, Perrey Reeves
description: It's been eight years since Andy was terrified of Chucky, the harmless doll unfortunately possessed by the soul of serial killer, Charles Lee Ray. Now the boy who was placed in a foster family has grown up, he is sixteen and is attending a military school. Meanwhile, the Play Pals Toy Company decides to put Chucky back into production again. For the new model, the company decided to use the materials of which the previous doll was made. On the trail of Andy, Chucky ends up in the hands of a little boy and that's where the soul of Charles Lee Ray decides to hide ...

title: Van Gogh
actors: Jacques Dutronc, Alexandra London, Gérard Séty, Bernard Lecoq, Elsa Zylberstein
description: The dramatic existence of the Dutch painter, who committed suicide in 1890, is told through the various phases of his artistic research. From the author of "Under the Sun of Satan", a biopic too controlled and without great flights.

title: The Spanish Prisoner
actors: Ben Gazzara, Campbell Scott, Rebecca Pidgeon, Steve Martin
description: Joe has made a mysterious invention that could make him very rich. But he feels his superiors are deceiving him. The people around him, even his friends, seem to be acting obscure. Susan, his secretary in love with him, offers to help him as an FBI agent, but for this Joe finds himself trapped in a dangerous web between truth and fiction.
notes: Here and there nihilistic and strewn with elegant lines, the new invention of playwright David Mamet falls into the usual game of Chinese boxes; out of a desire for displacement, he is no longer able to surprise, since the "games houses" are now in the domain of cinephiles.

title: Ospiti
actors: Julian Sota, Llazar Sota, Pasqualino Mura, Corrado Sassi
description: Gheni and Gherti, are two Albanian boys who live in today's Rome. One is open and sunny and one is closed and with little desire to talk. They work in a restaurant run by an owner who tries to find accommodation for them; they end up in the house of a son of the bourgeoisie, a photographer more out of boredom than out of conviction and unwittingly good at disintegrating distances especially with Gheni, who would like to have a mechanical workshop all to himself.
notes: Garrone coherently proceeds with his personal research into the frightening social problems of our very last time: after "Middle Earth", a triptych on the human and material degradation of immigrants and their makeshift posts, he tries to make contact with those who are looking for emigration to overcome it. Small budget cinema, but very full of the best intentions.

title: ¡Que viva Mexico!
actors: Attori non professionisti
description: The original project of his film included some episodes enclosed between a prologue and an epilogue. Dominant reasons: death and the eternal feminine. In the prologue the faces of the peons are compared with the pre-Columbian sculptures and underline the continuity of the story. The first episode is set in a sort of primeval Eden where men and nature coexist peacefully. In another chapter, the director shows the rural world of the turn of the century under the dictatorship of Porfirio Díaz. A peasant is brutally murdered by the fazenderos for wanting to rebel against an outrage made to his woman. Also famous is the epilogue with the macabre dance of the day of the dead and people covered in skull-shaped masks ...
notes: Ejzenstejn shot thousands of meters of film which he then failed to edit. The material ended up with its financiers who made a much simpler and shorter story out of it but still of great formal suggestion.

title: The Hireling
actors: Robert Shaw, Sarah Miles, Peter Egan
description: Hellen Fraklyn, wife of an English aristocrat, falls prey to deep depression after her husband died while she was at a social party. When she leaves the clinic, still a little ill, she meets a polite young man, albeit from a lower class than her own, who works as a car rental driver. At first out of necessity, then also for pleasure, the two often go out together so much that the man falls in love with the lady. In the meantime, however, she got engaged to an officer ...
notes: Very staid and very, very English, this sentimental comedy has its strong point in the cast. The rest is a little too fluffy.

title: The Wolf Man
actors: Lon Chaney jr., Evelyn Ankers, Claude Rains, Maria Ouspenskaya
description: A young gentleman meets a girl to whom he feels irresistibly attracted. While they are conversing amiably their talk falls on werewolves and the strange disease called lycanthropy. One evening the young man, the girl and a friend of theirs decide to go to a nomad camp to have the future predicted. At one point the friend disappears and at the same time the two hear a scream coming from the woods. A werewolf is terrorizing the city ...
notes: A classic horror film written by Curt Siodmak and produced by the legendary Universal. Lon Chaney Jr., son of art, will remain forever linked to this role.

title: Piedino il questurino
actors: Franco Franchi, Irina Maleeva, Rosita Pisano, Geppino Anatrelli
description: Brigadier Petralia, a Neapolitan policeman, usually gets his direct superior, Commissioner Pappacoda, into trouble because of the unlikely investigations he conducts. One day, while he is investigating a case, he meets Maria, a girl involved in cigarette smuggling and belonging to the family of Ferdinand the Baron. The visits that the sergeant makes to the new friend are exploited by Ferdinand.
notes: Franchi, here without Ingrassia, in a parody of "Piedone lo sbrirro". The final sequence based on a kilometric brawl based on vegetables that recalls other B series films is famous.

title: Pierino torna a scuola
actors: Alvaro Vitali, Nadia Bengala, Bruno Minniti, Alfonso Tomas
description: The terrible Pierino, now close to his majority, has long since left elementary school, without being able to get his license. After working in a racing dog farm as a mechanical hare, try to be a hairdresser apprentice, pharmacy clerk, and waiter. Having become convinced that work is not for him, he decides to go back to school.
notes: An almost sad film: an attempt to revive the glorious years of trash when Bagaglino reigns. Heartbreaking.

title: Bushwacked
actors: Daniel Stern, Corey Carrier, Max Goldblatt, Blake Bashoff
description: Max Grabelski, a friendly and good-natured young man, a delivery boy, has to deliver a large parcel in a day and at a specific time to a shady businessman, a certain Bragdon. When he arrives at the appointed time, in the middle of the night, he finds the building at the indicated address enveloped in flames and the recipient of the enormous envelope perhaps burned in the stake. Surprised Max drops the package which breaks, spilling a river of dollars onto the street. In a panic, he runs away leaving all that luck there. Casually arriving in a scout camp, he is taken for the guide that the boys were waiting for. So he is forced to that spartan and healthy life, full of excursions and natural obstacles of all kinds, without being able to return to the longed-for life of before ...
notes: Production for families of paratelevision.

title: La Sicilia rivisitata
description: The film, originally divided into four episodes, is produced by Rai. Although presented without interruption, the scan impressed on the work by the author remains, which returns after more than twenty years from the first film dedicated to the island. The first part concerns swordfish fishing, from new techniques to indiscriminate hunting. Then he moves to the Aeolian Islands devastated by mass tourism and building speculation. The third stage is divided into two: on one side the sulfur mines, in the past a source of livelihood for thousands of Sicilians and today almost completely closed; on the other hand, today's Easter celebrations contrasted with the ceremonies of the 1950s. The fourth episode closes this moving and austere, dismayed and rigorous reconnaissance, with the rite of wheat harvesting and tuna fishing in Favignana.
notes: Present and past no longer recognize each other, separated by the objective passing of time, but above all by unbridgeable "interior" distances

title: Hong Kong città di profughi
description: Three episodes commissioned at the time by Rai from Vittorio De Seta. At the beginning of the Eighties, the great Palermo documentary maker went with his crew to the then British possession of Hong Kong, where huge and difficult to control masses of refugees fleeing the disasters of history, politics and society were concentrated: yes they numbered hundreds of thousands of Chinese emigrants who fled post-Maoist People's China and at least 60,000 Vietnamese. De Seta's camera essentially focuses on the toil of living: small apartments, a few square meters barely enough to contain a family crammed with people, the swarming army of researchers of a black job, the only proposal and the only resource of life. for this horde of derelicts. "I thought I was facing a new problem and I found an ancient problem, the disease of Asia: a great South", explained the director at the time. The Hong Kong equation equal to Turin, refugees from the West equal to emigrants from the South from De Seta is soon done.

title: Meet Joe Black
actors: Brad Pitt, Anthony Hopkins, Claire Forlani, Jake Weber, Marcia Gay Harden
description: William Parrish is a television tycoon who has managed to conquer success but who sees his life turned upside down by the unexpected arrival of Joe Black. The mysterious young man falls in love with Susan, William's beautiful daughter. For the Parrish family, the consequences of this falling in love turn out to be more dramatic than expected since Joe Black is actually the angel of Death.
notes: Live and die in New York. This is what can happen, according to Martin Brest, if death, which has the intense and astonished face and hair in perfect disorder of Brad Pitt, a clone of a Robert Redford of thirty years ago, decides, out of curiosity, to take a vacation before to bring media mogul Anthony Hopkins to the beyond. The philosophical density of Ingmar Bergman's "The Seventh Seal" and the livid humor of Mitchell Leisen's "Death on Vacation", 1934, are watered down in the unmotivated eternity (three hours) of a slow and repetitive remake. The gloomy and melancholy angel can fall in love with William Parrish's daughter, the beautiful Claire Forlani, he can be moved and wear, impeccable, the tuxedo, but he cannot redeem a film whose script and direction have the liveliness and originality of a new age soap.

title: Train de vie
actors: Lionel Abelanski, Rufus, Clement Harari, Michel Muller, Johan Leysen
description: To escape the Nazis who are raiding the Jewish villages of Romania, some Jews, led by the country's idiot, decide to stage a trick. They build a train, stick swastikas on it and then disguise themselves: some as a tormentor of the SS, some as a prisoner. Destination (false) Auschwitz ...
notes: Together with Benigni (indeed, just before him) the Romanian Mihaileanu also tries, with a story halfway between tragedy and a funny fairy tale. Music by Goran Bregovic, Italian lyrics by Moni Ovadia. Fun, exciting, right.

title: Stepmom
actors: Julia Roberts, Susan Sarandon, Ed Harris, Jena Malone, Liam Aiken
description: Isabel is a career-minded fashion photographer who has to look after the children of her new partner Luke: 12 year old Anna and seven year old Ben. Both Isabel and the two children love Luke wholeheartedly, but relations between them are not idyllic. Isabel also has to deal with Jackie, the birth mother, considered by the two children unsurpassed in everything. The woman obviously has resentment towards Isabel who "stole" her children. But one day Jackie discovers she has cancer.
notes: Domestic scenarios, lively and restless children, marriage warfare, school worries: Columbus is a specialist, at least that's what the unaware Italian translation of his "mothers" films wants. In this insincere film, tailor-made for the two protagonists, (who are also executive producers) the maternal figure is doubled.

title: Practical Magic
actors: Sandra Bullock, Nicole Kidman, Dianne Wiest, Stockard Channing
description: Sally and Gillian have always felt different from other girls, accustomed as they were to practicing the magical arts they learned from witch aunts. Watching them, the quieter Sally realizes that she will never be able to find the man of her life. On the contrary, the more restless Gillian, thrilled by the fascination she exerts on men, accepts her powers and leaves behind a trail of broken hearts. Gillian's encounter with Jimmy, an evil and homeless man, leads Sally to a meeting with police officer Gary.
notes: The sugary, despite the profuse acids, the second film by the almost ex-actor Griffin Dunne rests its sterile interest in the performers: Nicole Kidman proves once again to be talented and capable of bearing the weights of a mediocre script; Sandra Bullock, on the other hand, can't get out of the image of a Julia Roberts carryover.

title: Urban Legend
actors: Jared Leto, Alicia Witt, Rebecca Gayheart, Brad Dourif, Joshua Jackson
description: A girl, on her way back to college after a short vacation, is beheaded in her car. It is only the beginning of a long series of chilling murders of a psychopath who enjoys putting into practice the hottest urban legends, thus decimating the population of the university campus.
notes: Typical "slasher" born and raised along the lines of the much more successful "Scream". Tame scares, dutiful appearances (Robert Englund "is" Freddy Krueger) and too many familiar moments. Only the first sequence gives a good shot of suspense ... The rest is déjà vu.

title: The Siege
actors: Bruce Willis, Denzel Washington, Annette Bening, Graeme Revell
description: A bus explodes in Brooklyn: thus begins the campaign of terror that Islamic fundamentalists have declared to the Americans. Coping with escalating violence are Anthony 'Hub' Hubbard, head of the FBI's Counterterrorism Task Force, and General William Devereaux, a cautious and thoughtful military man who knows how to deal with the enemy. The two can count on the help of Elise, a CIA agent who has infiltrated the Arab-American community.
notes: The political-geographical assumption of the film is that Brooklyn could become a neighborhood of Beirut and the United States the battleground of the fringes of Arab terrorism. The attacks on the World Trade Center and Oklahoma City forever undermined the idea of ??national invulnerability and shaped a new enemy after the Cold War was over. Crafted with skill, but discontinuous and predictable, the film gives way and flattens out after the first forty minutes.

title: The Go-Between
actors: Julie Christie, Alan Bates, Margareth Leighton, Michael Redgrave
description: England, summer of 1900. Leo, a thirteen-year-old boy, spends his holidays at a friend's country estate. Here the aristocrat Marian (Julie Christie) has a love affair with the factor Ted (Alan Bates) and the two lovers use him to exchange dates and passionate letters. The conformism and hypocrisy of society will however prevail and even Leo's personality will be irremediably marked.
notes: Included in a single flashback, the film presents itself as a memory of Leo who, now old and withered, looks back on that distant season with nostalgia and anger. Under an exhausted and "Visconti" appearance, a cruel investigation of class relations. Screenplay by Harold Pinter from the novel "The Uncertain Age" by Leslie Poles Hartley. Palme d'Or in Cannes.

title: Les rendez-vous de Paris
actors: Clara Bellar, Antoine Basler, Aurore Rauscher, Michael Kraft
description: Three episodes of love, abandonment, jealousy and rip-offs in the somewhat dreamy Paris of artists, teachers and university students. In the first, the suspicion of an unlikely triangle leads to the discovery of a much more ambiguous, but ironic, "quadrangle". In the second, the hesitation of a young woman tired of her current partner, but worried not to hurt his feelings, vanish when ... In the third, a painter, in pursuit of a chimera, lets a much more concrete sentimental opportunity slip away.
notes: The usual, light and polite Rohmer able to enter the soul of his characters with the geometric precision of a Cartesian philosopher.

title: Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas
actors: Johnny Depp, Benicio Del Toro, Christina Ricci, Tobey Maguire, Ellen Barkin
description: United States of America, 1971. Journalist Raoul Duke and his imposing lawyer, Dr. Gonzo decide to leave in a dark red convertible for the city of Las Vegas. In the luggage, pharmaceuticals and drinks that can drive anyone out of their minds.
notes: "Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas" by Hunter S. Thompson was born as a reportage of an off-road race to Las Vegas for the magazine "Sport Illustrated", but it turned "on the road" into a journey into hallucination and America of the dream that was falling apart. For more than 15 years the book has bounced off the desks of Hollywood directors and producers; but it is so extreme and insane that no one has the courage to carry out the project. Gilliam accepts the risk. Certainly it is not a masterpiece like "Brazil", but almost a paradoxical return to the tragic-grotesque fragments that the director composed for the "Flying Circus".

title: In punta di piedi. Streetdance
actors: Lara Naszinski, Elio Cesari, Valeria Ciangottini
description: Two young people are divided by everything: social class, wealth and career prospects. But one thing unites them and it is one of those passions that leave little room for anything else: modern dance. When they are on the platform, the two forget everything and seem more united than ever. In fact, the harmony is perfect and together they are unrivaled. But the music does not last forever and, once back in their respective "normality" ...
notes: Does a plot like this remind you of something? Yup? Can you think of a title like "Flashdance"? Well done, seven more. But the realization here is something else. Far worse of course.

title: Alien Nation
actors: James Caan, Mandy Patinkin, Terence Stamp, Kevin Major, Brian Thompson, Peter Jason, Leslie Bevis, Conrad Dunn, Jeff Kober, Brian Thompson
description: A large number of aliens capable of adapting to human life have been transported from another planet to Earth in a large spaceship. Equipped with special qualities, they do not struggle to fit into the daily life of humans even if some are viewed with much contempt by earthlings. One night, during a robbery, police sergeant Matthew Sykes sees his closest friend killed by aliens. To find out the perpetrators of the murder and, above all, the motive, he begins the investigation, naturally with the help of another alien.
notes: Unusual film capable of mixing thriller and science fiction, with clear intentions of allegory of the melting pot. Two TV series of the same title have been made from it.

title: Fatto di sangue fra due uomini per causa di una vedova...
actors: Sophia Loren, Marcello Mastroianni, Giancarlo Giannini, Turi Ferro
description: We are in Sicily in 1922: Concetta, known as Titina, was left a widow following an act of blood; but although everyone in the village knows who the murderer of her husband is, no one speaks so that the trial ends with a stalemate. The lawyer Spallone saves Titina from an attempted violence by the man who made her a widow. Later, the lawyer and Titina become lovers. However, Nick Sanmichele, smuggler and multiple murderer, also arrives in town, to whom Titina soon gives in ...
notes: The usual triangle in Sicilian sauce, with the deceased laughing blissfully from the household medallion. The grotesque is the heavy one that Wertmüller likes.

title: A Bold Affair
actors: Jeff Trachta, Shae Harrison, Sandra Ferguson, Howard Mungo
description: Through the Internet, Michael Anderson meets Eva, a charming girl. Michael is married to Emily, who is also expecting a child, but decides to overshadow his marital relationship to start another with the young woman from whom he feels understood and listened to. For the man this relationship has the same weight as a pastime, while for her part Eve is gradually taken by the loving obsession. When Michael begins to feel guilty towards his wife, he tries to sever the adulterous bond but now it is not so easy.
notes: After "Fatal Attraction" the theme of seduction and amorous madness really seems to be on the agenda as if it were a completely daily experience. Which is obviously legitimate to doubt. So this film is not very convincing, built with a melodramatic crescendo of situations and reactions.

title: Titanic
actors: Peter Gallagher, George C. Scott, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Tim Curry
description: Isabella Paradine and Wynn Park are two of the many passengers on the Titanic, the colossal and unsinkable ship that was shipwrecked in 1912 during the maiden voyage. The film begins with the launch and the joy of the first part of the journey. Everything seems to be going very well and nobody notices the gloomy atmosphere that hangs over this traveling company. This TV-movie burned Cameron's giant over time, but nobody noticed it. Made in a hurry, it is an unwatchable meatloaf.

title: A Bug's Life
description: Even the ants in their small way do their best. Harassed by a swarm of boastful grasshoppers, led by the contemptuous Hopper, who periodically demand part of the supplies collected with effort and patience from the colony that inhabits the island of ants, the small insects decide to defend themselves and rebel. The brilliant and bungling Flick, the inventor misunderstood and derided by the entire anthill, becomes the involuntary hero of the rescue by offering to go and find invincible warriors.
notes: Director John Lasseter ("Toys Story") and his team of digital cartoonists demonstrate, with this beautiful, full of quotes, colorful and ironic tale, that the computer can enhance the poetry and fantasy of animation. Don't miss the credits.

title: Meeting Venus
actors: Glenn Close, Niels Arestrup, Macha Meril, Erland Josephson
description: During the rehearsals of Wagner's "Tannahäuser" the conductor and the soprano find themselves in love. Their connection sharpens the artistic quality of the staging, which is hampered by an infinite series of inconveniences due to trade union and bureaucratic problems. When the director's wife understands the nature of the bond with the singer she throws him out of the house and the passion between the two lovers goes into crisis.
notes: Szabo works on the double register of filmic and musical history (the soprano, in life, identifies with his character). But this copyright co-production is indigestible, starting with the cast and the very kitsh idea of ??art.

title: This Island Earth
actors: Jeff Morrow, Rex Reason, Faith Domergue, Russell Johnson
description: The scientist Cal Meachan comes into contact in a completely mysterious way with some unknown colleagues who invite him to go to an equally unknown research center where he works in secret on enriched uranium. Here, the scientist and his colleague Ruth, who followed him on the journey, meet Exeter, envoy of the supreme government of Metaluna, a planet with serious energy supply problems due to a struggle with the inhabitants of another planet. The two attempt to escape but are blocked by the Exeter spaceship.
notes: Science fiction as it was fashionable in the 1950s, with an extra tragic streak and a tension that never subsides. A classic of the genre.

title: The Fiercest Heart
actors: Stuart Whitman, Juliet Prowse, Ken Scott, Raymond Massey
description: A British garrison soldier stationed in South Africa is flogged for disrespecting a superior's wife. Under the cover of darkness he manages to escape from prison together with his two cellmates. Taking refuge in a hut in the open countryside, the three attend a meeting of Boers, who are about to leave the territory under English rule. The Boers, albeit reluctant, agree to welcome in their ranks the three fugitives who will prove to be good fighters.
notes: George Sherman, who specializes in westerns, transposes the themes dear to the genre to Africa with little success.

title: Puppet on a Chain
actors: Sven-Bertil Taube, Barbara Parkins, Alexander Knox, Patrick Allen
description: After a series of killings among the drug traffickers of the city of Amsterdam, Paul arrives, an American Narcotic Bureau officer (the goddess) with his colleague Maggie. Both with the task of shedding light on the murders. Paul draws valuable indications from a notebook of which he came into possession thanks to the killing of the killer who was put on his heels.
notes: Only a chase aboard a motorboat (taken from "Amsterdamned") directed by Don Sharp saves the film from a complete disaster.

title: Thank God, It's Friday
actors: Donna Summer, Jeff Goldblum, Andrea Howard, Mark Lonow
description: In the trendy disco The Zoo owned by Tony De Marco, disc jockey Bobby Speed ??makes his debut. The evening is a memorable one because the Commodores have to perform and a dance competition has to take place. Attracted by the race come Jeannie and Franne, Sue and Dave, bored spouses, and two boys looking for adventure. Meanwhile, the delay of the Commodores keeps the DJ anxious. and all the audience in the room ...
