notes: The Motown Record sponsored film was shot in an attempt to capitalize on the success of "Saturday Night Fever". Despite the presence of Lionel Richie and Donna Summer (who won the Oscar for Best Song) it is not a memorable work.

title: Der bewegte mann
actors: Til Schweiger, Katja Riemann, Joachim Krol, Rufus Beck, Armin Rohde
description: Doro takes Axel, her boyfriend, in intimacy with another woman. It is certainly not the first time this has happened, but this time Doro is no longer playing the game and decides to end the relationship. In this way Axel is forced to leave the apartment that the two have rented together. The boy is convinced that it will not take long to find another accommodation with one of his mistresses. But he is wrong because there are those who, in the meantime, have fallen in love with another, who has it to death with him. So he is forced to accept the invitation of Walter, an asphyxiating homosexual friend.
notes: The film is based on a comic by Ralf König, quite well known to us too. The fit is smooth and flightless.

title: Atto di accusa
actors: Lea Padovani, Marcello Mastroianni, Carl Ludwig Diehl, Andrea Checchi
description: Renato, having returned from Russia where he was a prisoner for a long time, learns that his beloved Irene has married, without being really in love with him, Professor Ruska, a man already advanced in years. After a brief meeting, the two young men realize that they are still in love with each other, but Irene confesses that she will never be his. Meanwhile, Professor Ruska, who had them stalked, tries to surprise them in equivocal attitudes in the house of a seamstress where they have taken refuge. During a fight ...
notes: Quite obvious ending for a film that is yellow for one third but melodrama for two thirds.

title: I Wanna Hold Your Hand
actors: Nancy Allen, Bobby Di Cicco, Marc McClure, Susan Kendall Newman
description: Three girls from New Jersey in February 1964 leave their hometown to go to New York to attend the show that will star the Beatles on their first American tour. The three girls, one in love with Paul McCartney, another budding photographer and the third who let herself be persuaded to follow the concert, meet three boys. Once in New York, the six try to enter the hotel that hosts the English quartet but the attempt fails except for the least interested who manages to ...
notes: First film directed by Robert Zemeckis, already skilled and breezy. Spielberg is the executive producer.

title: Queste pazze, pazze donne
actors: Raimondo Vianello, Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Enrico Maria Salerno
description: Episode movies. "La garçonierre": an industrialist with his amente and his secretary with their respective mistress captain, by a strange coincidence, in the same apartment. Misunderstandings to no end. "Gentil sex": a young Roman in the company of a foreigner is threatened by the brothers of his ex not to be seen again in their neighborhood. He will be defended by the girl's friends, wrestlers. "Few but good": due to a car accident, a moralist is forced to stay in an apartment frequented by girls in skimpy clothes. "Siciliani a Milano": Two Sicilian wine merchants ask their wives to be nice to their customers, but ... Super cast wasted in a series of jokes not even sexual. Thus began the decline of the Italian comedy.

title: All Night Long
actors: Gene Hackman, Barbra Streisand, Diane Ladd, Dennis Quaid
description: A married man struggling with some unexpected events. The place he works for, a drugstore in the center of the city, has suddenly gone into crisis and he can no longer exercise his profession with confidence. Furthermore, he meets his neighbor's wife: will love be born between the two or will the feeling of friendship prevail?
notes: Barbra Streisand tried to be more convincing on screen (here she took over from Lisa Eichhorn who dropped out of the role after filming began), while Gene Hackman proves to be charming and cute. Frenchman Jean-Claude Tramont on a trip to the United States tries to instill doses of grace in a tender film.

title: Random Encounter
actors: Elizabeth Berkley, Joel Wyner, Frank Schorpion, Barry Flatman
description: Alice “Allie” Brayman is a career woman who has been able to achieve success by earning a good reputation for her financial intuition. At a party, however, she meets a mysterious man who fascinates her and introduces her to an unpredictable and dangerous situation ...
notes: Do you need to add anything else? It is well known that the irruption of the unexpected into normality is an obvious ingredient of the classic thriller recipe. It does not seem that this film adds anything even in the representation of the world of finance, within which the action takes place. Elizabeth Berkley's interpretation is discreet.

title: Them!
actors: James Whitmore, Edmund Gwenn, Joan Welden, James Arness
description: Due to an atomic explosion, a colony of ants was subjected to very strong and deadly radiation. The consequence is an incredible transformation: the insects become gigantic and begin to sow panic first in New Mexico and then in Los Angeles. Here the decisive battle takes place, set in an oppressive scenario: the metropolitan sewers.
notes: One of the science fiction classics of the 1950s, based on a compelling and tight script. In that period the danger always came from other worlds (or from other political systems); Douglas has the merit of imagining that the risks come from within and, therefore, from the depths of the Earth.

title: Una questione d'onore
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Nicoletta Rangoni, Bernard Blier, Franco Fabrizi
description: Efisio Mulas is a Sardinian shepherd who, before consummating the marriage, is forced to leave the island with his young bride. He returns there to commit a crime, but at the last moment he changes his mind and chooses to spend the night in bed with his wife. In the meantime, however, someone commits the murder and Efisio, unable to admit that he has made his wife pregnant, is forced to kill her.
notes: Last heartbeats for the Italian comedy. Tognazzi is Sardinian is just a speck. Efisio Mulas will be, decades later, the name of a radio personality in the cinephile show "Hollywood Party".

title: Maestro i Margarita
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Mimsy Farmer, Tasko Nacic, Pavle Vujisic, Ljuba Tadic
description: In 1925 the last rehearsals of Nicholas Maksudov's play "Pontius Pilate" are taking place in Moscow. Frightened by some sentences contained in the text, according to which all power is against freedom, the director of the theater turns to the president of the Proletarian Writers' Association to block the show. In the story, Satan appears in the role of Woland, master of black magic, assisted by Azazillo and Koroviev. Not even the devil, however, manages to prevent the suspension of the exhibition. Not even better for Margherita, wife of a policeman in love with Nicolaj.
notes: Staging Bulgakov's masterpiece is truly a feat. Petrovic's film is awkward and plastered, despite the actors and an attempt to update the themes.

title: Vuoti a perdere
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Silvia De Santis, Vincenzo Peluso, Gianni Garofalo
description: In Genoa, for the policeman Cesena, the nights at the police station never pass. Fabrizio and Simonetta become a real diversion for him. The long interrogation must reveal, before dawn arrives, what the policeman pretends to know about them. Between a threat and a flattery, the two describe thefts, petty violence, occasional paid sex performances.
notes: From an office to a squalid canteen, from a horrid night to an overpass, from a parking lot to the narrow streets of the historic center: the obvious repertoire of petty crime also has its obvious backdrop. The film has the lean measure and colorless language of television and the actors, with the exception of Giannini, are never up to par.

title: Payback
actors: Mel Gibson, Gregg Henry, Maria Bello, Bill Duke, Deborah Kara Unger, Lucy Liu, David Paymer
description: Porter, a professional thief with a pragmatic philosophy, is on the hunt for those seventy thousand dollars that his ex-wife and a cheating partner stole from him after a robbery against a group of Chinese. But the habit of cheating the neighbor is not even scratched by a terrible ambush from which Porter comes out with his head held high.
notes: The charm of this other remake (the originals, from the famous story "The Hunter" by Richard Stark, are called "Without a moment of respite" and "The last contract") lies in its ironic and resigned air, not surprisingly crossed by a strange Mel Gibson who pays homage to Steve McQueen. Debut in the direction of the screenwriter, among others, of "L. A. Confidential".

title: Gloria
actors: Sharon Stone, Jean-Luke Figueroa, George C. Scott, Cathy Moriarty
description: A little Puerto Rican boy whose entire family was killed has a disk that contains compromising data. Gloria, just out of prison, disowned by her former lover, finds herself having to look after and, above all, have to defend the brat. The meeting between the two solitudes will perhaps give birth to unsuspected forces.
notes: Beyond the Hollywood crisis of ideas, we regret to see involved in this involuntary parody a "director" like Lumet, an actor like George C. Scott and even Stone brave to compete with the Gena Rowlands of the original, but forced to a acting over the top that contradicts her icy nature as a femme fatale.

title: Liar
actors: Tim Roth, Chris Penn, Renée Zellweger, Rosanna Arquette
description: The beautiful Elizabeth (Renee Zellweger), when she is not lying behind the glass of a peep-show, walks, alone and at night, in the park. She will end up murdered, cut in two and abandoned in two different places in the shady and sleepy town. The alleged murderer is John (Tim Roth), a scion of a family of textile industrialists. Rich, spoiled, epileptic, graduated in psychology and with an IQ clearly superior to the two agents who subject him to repeated sessions with the lie detector. Sensors trace on paper the irregular course of lies, provisional detections and hidden certainties. A winding river of ink and words.
notes: A verbose and convoluted collective conspiracy of provincial sinners adorned with clandestine bets, gambling debts, bottles of absinthe, dangerous booze and perverse jealousies. The camera of the two directors, the Pate twins, who exhibit an annoying knowledge of the vices of "modern" cinema, twists, sways, displaces the spectator and itself.

title: Monster on the Campus
actors: Arthur Franz, Joanna Moore, Judson Pratt, Troy Donahue, Nancy Walters
description: Donald Blake, a professor at Dunsfield University, injures his hand in careless handling of a prehistoric fish. Struck by a strange malaise, he transforms into a violent primal man who causes the death of his assistant. After the sudden crisis and returned to normal Donald has absolutely nothing of what he did.
notes: Fantahorror of a specialist of the genre. Less imaginative and "sociological" than other films by the director, but advisable for camp aficionados.

title: Tua per la vita
actors: Gaby André, Ettore Manni, Gérard Landry, Pina Bottin, Maria Grazia Monaci
description: Marisa, director of a high fashion atelier, secretly falls in love with Marco, who works as a model designer in the same company. The woman, while hoping for the future, does not let her feelings shine through. But Marco fell in love with Marisa's sister, Diana, with a libertine life. And Diana just got pregnant with Giorgio. Typical melodrama of the time, set in the world of fashion, with photo-novel features but also a robust direction of actors.

title: Hideous Kinki
actors: Kate Winslet, Said Taghmaoui, Bela Rizza, Carrie Mullan
description: The beautiful 25-year-old single Julia and mother of eight-year-old Bea and six-year-old Lucy has left sad and gloomy London and brought her daughters to Marrakesh. Her intention is to give the two girls a different education from the one they received. It is Christmas and in a café in the square of the Medina and the girls are impatient to open the presents their father has sent them from London. In the town square, the two girls watch the show of Bilal, an acrobat who lives by tricks and an elderly man who entertains the crowd. Lucy is mesmerized by Bilal and introduces him to her mom. The attraction between the two is immediate ...
notes: The film is a sixty-eight mess that would like to involve us in Julia's inner journey against the backdrop of an Africa that, after Bertolucci, is difficult for anyone to grasp. Moralist, cartolinesque, uncertain on the way to follow, banal in the contrast between Europe and the Rest of the World, "Ideus Kinky" (pun against the boredom of Julia's daughters), is notable only for gossip: the beautiful and talented Kate Winslet has met the love of his life on set, assistant director Jim Threapleton.

title: Force majeure
actors: Patrick Bruel, François Cluzet, Alan Bates, Kristin Scott Thomas, Sabine Haudepin, Thom Hoffman, Lucienne Hamon
description: Three young people, two French and a Dutchman who left their respective countries to take a holiday in the East know each other there. After spending wonderful days together, the two transalpines decide to return home. The same thing does not happen to the Dutch who instead opts for a longer stay. Once they return home, the two boys learn that their friend has been sentenced to death for drug possession. The boys are torn. Certainly their intervention could save his life, but this attitude could cost both of them their freedom.
notes: The script poses the dilemma well, and the direction favors the excellent actors. Remade in the USA in 1998 with the title "Time to decide".

title: Bagnomaria
actors: Giorgio Panariello, Manuela Arcuri, Andrea Cambi, Ugo Pagliai
description: It is a September morning in Versilia. Thus begins a special day for four people. On the day of his return from the summer camp Simone runs into a beautiful donut seller. The lifeguard Mario has to deal with Bagno 2000 which is about to swallow the small and romantic Bain marie. Drunk Merigo with his inseparable bicycle has to contend with yet another joke. The mayor's son, by profession p.r. of a disco, upsets the end-of-season party organized by his father.
notes: Intimidated and lost, the cocoons of the characters created by Panariello float limply in the dull shots.

title: Living out Loud
actors: Danny DeVito, Holly Hunter, Queen Latifah, Martin Donovan
description: Judith Nelson, a wealthy Fifth Avenue flat, wife of an accomplished doctor, is betrayed with a younger girl. The woman is forced to resign herself to the idea and to get used to the silence of the luxurious condominium in which she lives. Her isolation is interrupted by a brief friendship that opens her eyes to everyday reality. All this happens when Judith befriends Pat, an elevator man in the condominium, and discovers that he too has a life full of dreams and disappointments.
notes: Wordy film and silences, glances and sudden shots, reversals of roles, "Kiss" confirms the talent of an artist who heats and cools melodrama, who updates Cassavetes with the modern visual language, who directs the actresses like a caring, romantic, sensually active lover.

title: Maximum Risk
actors: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Natasha Henstridge, Jean-Hugues Anglade, Stéphane Audran
description: Alain is a private detective living in Nice. Michail a Russian who emigrated to New York who works for the mafia. When the latter ends his existence riddled with blows on the pavement of a road in the Midi, the former rushes to the place and discovers that he is his twin brother, a twin whose existence he was totally unaware of. At this point Alain takes the first plane to the States. Will he be able to reconstruct his brother's past (and therefore also his own)? Above all, will he be able to escape the assassins who want him to end up like Michail?
notes: Van Damme had already exploited the theme of the double in "Double impact" and will take it up again in the next film also directed by poor Ringo Lam (one of the masters of Hong Kong action, wasted here), "The Replicant".

title: Vredens Dag
actors: Lisbeth Movin, Thorkild Roose, Sigrid Neiiendam
description: We are in 1623, in northern Europe. Marthe, accused of witchcraft and hunted down by the crowd, takes refuge in the village rectory with Anna, the shepherd's young wife, married in a second marriage. Marthe is however captured, tortured and burned alive after the trial presided over by Absalon, Anna's husband. Martin, the son of Absalon's first bed, Anna's age, now arrives at the rectory. Love is born between the two young people. When Absalon suddenly dies, his mother Merethe accuses Anna of witchcraft ...
notes: Dreyer's masterpiece, based on the criticism of prejudice and freedom (especially of thought) in contrast with social rules. But the film is a refined prodigy of ambiguity, which avoids any schematism, and an extraordinary figurative exploit, in which the whites and the blacks and the sets fit the characters

title: Ordet
actors: Preben Lendorff Rye, Henrik Malberg, Birgitte Federspiel, Ann Elisabeth Rud
description: On a farm in Jutland lives old Borgen with his three children: Mikkel, married to Inger, expecting their second child, Johannes, who has gone mad because of his theology studies, and Anders, the younger, in love with the tailor's daughter. village. The tragedy strikes on the farm: Inger dies in childbirth, Johannes disappears and the tailor denies consent to the wedding due to religious differences with Borgen.
notes: While respecting its letter, Dreyer transforms the drama of the Protestant pastor Kaj Munk, aimed at the exaltation of the divine word, into a secular poem of affirmation of "life" in all its meanings, including the deepest mystery. The finale is a sublime peak of the representation of the sacred in cinema. Golden Lion in Venice.

title: Gertrud
actors: Nina Pens Rode, Bendt Rothe, Ebbe Rode, Baard Owe
description: Gertrud, a former middle-aged singer, falls in love with the young musician Erland and tells her husband that she intends to leave him. The relationship between the spouses is now in a dead end, but he is opposed to divorce thinking about his career (he is running for the post of minister). However, Gertrud decides to continue with Erland, who however turns out to be selfish and mean. The woman then chooses solitude ...
notes: It looks like the plot of a mélo d'accatto and instead it is an extraordinary film, the last one by the Danish master. At the time it was not understood and was considered static and wordy, but its essentiality and introspective strength are pure cinema.

title: Lifebreath
actors: Luke Perry, Francie Swift
description: Chrystie Devoe is happily married. Her husband Martin, in fact, surrounds her with attention and affection. Their serenity is abruptly interrupted by an emergency hospitalization: the doctors diagnose Chrystie with a very serious illness. To save her it would be necessary to have an organ transplant. But there are no donors available and Chrystie is in real danger of dying. Martin, who can't stand the idea of ??losing the woman of his life, comes up with a plan: to seduce a girl, Gale Pullman, with the intent of killing her and removing the organ his wife needs.
notes: Riding the theme of the moment like in surf, Posner settled down to such an extent that in the end he almost drowned in a sea of ??tears.

title: Dancing at Lughnasa
actors: Meryl Streep, Michael Gambon, Catherine McCormack, Kathy Burke
description: The Irish Mundies family consists of five unmarried sisters and one brother, Jack, a Catholic priest. The family group also includes Michael, son of Christina, the youngest of the sisters. To turn their lives upside down comes Michael's father, a Welsh traveling salesman who is about to go to Spain to fight for Franco.
notes: Sad European cinema for 95 minutes that seems to last twice as long. In the last two minutes, voice off with final bulletin on what's going to happen to everyone. Direction, acting, editing, music: as prescribed in the manual of the perfect author. Yawns, boredom, refreshing naps for us innocent spectators.

title: The Thin Red Line
actors: Jim Caviezel, Sean Penn, Woody Harrelson, Nick Nolte, George Clooney, John Travolta, John Cusack, John Savage, Adrien Brody, John C. Reilly, Nick Stahl, Miranda Otto, Tim Blake Nelson, Jared Leto, Elias Koteas, Thomas Jane, Arie Verveen, Ben Chaplin, Kirk Acevedo, Paul Gleeson, Don Harvey
description: A group of riflemen on the Pacific front in Guadalcanal.
notes: Magnificent symphony on the horror of war and on the archaic and immutable ecstasy of nature. Voiceovers become a jumble of inner voices, a range of emotions and knowledge, wisdom and convictions.

title: Rounders
actors: Matt Damon, John Malkovich, Edward Norton, Gretchen Mol
description: Mike McDermott is a professional poker player who takes advantage of gambling to try to make a new life for himself. Mike is in law school and spends his free time with his girlfriend and fellow student Jo. Becoming a lawyer is the legal way for Mike to succeed, but the game has too much appeal for him. But when an old friend gets out of jail, Mike is faced with the dilemma: to go back to playing for his friend's sake or to let it go?
notes: The film starts from premises similar to the "Spaccone" and focuses on the same suggestions. It doesn't start badly, but it goes on worse, with an unbearable narrating voice, "judicial" interludes, narrative impasse. Bravi Turturro and Matt Damon; the direction is flat; dead times, many and uncontrollable.

title: The Proposition
actors: Kenneth Branagh, Madeleine Stowe, William Hurt, Blythe Danner
description: Despite his immense wealth, his enormous influence on others and his position of prestige in the society of Bacon Hill, the richest neighborhood in Boston, Arthur is unable to give Eleanor what she wants most: a child. The two concoct a plan, unthinkable for those times (1935), to solve the problem: conceiving a child with the help of another person. Arthur's partner, Hannibal, proposes the unusual chore to a young law student. He agrees with trepidation, but soon falls in love with Eleanor. When the dead escapes, the spouses' attempts to take control of the situation become increasingly difficult.
notes: Hurt is sad, Stowe is penalized by the role, and Branagh wastes his talent as well as the resources not exploited by the crew.

title: Breakfast of Champions
actors: Bruce Willis, Nick Nolte, Albert Finney, Lukas Haas, Barbara Hershey
description: Dwaye Hoover, Midland City's most famous and most respected businessman, is on the verge of a nervous breakdown, despite everything going well. Meanwhile Kilgore Trout, a misunderstood writer who has seen his works published only in pornographic magazines, is traveling to the town to attend the first Art Festival. The meeting between the two is so explosive as to change the lives of both of them and to upset Midland City, forever.
notes: Rudolph, a pupil recommended by Altman, after having cultivated for twenty years the idea of ??transposing one of the cult novels of the American counterculture, is shipwrecked like the characters invented by the author of the book, Kurt Vonnegut, men and women mixed with the filtered American Dream through the mirages of television. Willis produces and stars in this highly ambitious independent film by mimicking himself of "Death Makes You Beautiful".

title: Terminus Paradis
actors: Dorina Chiriac, Costel Cascaval, Gheorghe Visu
description: Mitu works as a pig keeper in Bucharest. Meet Norica who is a waitress. They get drunk together, they make love. But: Norica is Gili's woman and Mitu has to leave for military service. Against everyone and everything, Mitu wants Norica, destroys Gili's bar with a tank, ends up in a free-kick camp, runs off to get Norica back.
notes: In Pintilie's film, everything is told with exemplary dryness and the painful awareness that one cannot escape. Nothing new in the East: you keep looking for paradise and find the police with guns.

title: Face
actors: Robert Carlyle, Ray Winstone, Steven Waddington, Damon Albarn
description: A gang of petty thugs with no history sets up a robbery. For Ray and Dave this is a job like any other, while Julian hopes to make enough money to change his life. Stevie, do what Ray tells him, while Jason is embarrassed because he is a novice. When the gang is left with less money than expected, one of them turns into a ruthless murderer to steal the others' loot.
notes: An angry and proletarian thriller, a little rough and violent, suspended between noir and dry realism. Antonia Bird, albeit with a style that oscillates a bit between the video clip and the TV movie, is attentive to the psychologies of the characters and manages to mix the genre with the notations of the environment and with glimpses of the past life of the protagonist (who as a young he was nicknamed "Red Ray" for the political commitment he shared with a fighting mother). Carlyle and Winstone are two well-known faces of Loach's cinema, and at one point you can see the poster for "Hidden Agenda".

title: Mad Love
actors: Chris O'Donnell, Drew Barrymore, Matthew Lillard, Richard Chaim
description: Matt and Casey are overwhelmed by a passionate love story. The first is a staid young man preparing to go to university. He suffers the charm of the second, of a completely different temperament. Arriving at the crossroads of a radical choice, Matt is so immersed in this feeling that he decides to abandon everything he has worked for up to that moment and run away with the girl. But Matt soon realizes that Casey is not that sweet and tender woman he had known. Eventually he will be forced to ...
notes: Antonia Bird, author of the beautiful "Face", directed this comedy with Touchstone money.

title: Kagemusha
actors: Tatsuya Nakadai, Tsutomo Yamazaki, Kenichi Hagiwara
description: In the Japanese Middle Ages (16th century), the valiant Prince Shinge Takeda is about to die. Fearing the revenge of his rivals, he asks his closest relatives and all the generals of the clan to hide his death for as long as possible. When his brother discovers that a thief whose life he has saved looks strikingly like Shinge, he convinces everyone to pass him off as the deceased. Over time the double (kagemusha in Japanese) comes to a total identification with the prince to the point of assuming his value and courage in the face of death.
notes: Palme d'Or at Cannes in 1982, it marked the director's return to his homeland after a long artistic exile.

title: Baoh
description: Ikuro is a young man to whom something truly extraordinary has happened. A mutant parasite has been inoculated in his body, Baoh is his name, which is able to generate monstrous beings with immense powers. Ikuro's existence is obviously upset in a perhaps definitive way.
notes: Fast pace, very lively and aggressive animation, are the stylitic elements that also characterize this work. As for the theme, it should be remembered that the manipulation, in particular that of the body, by occult powers is a recurring motif in Japanese animation. And it is also understandable why: after more than 50 years from the tragedy of the atomic bomb, the anguish linked to genetic mutations has remained.

title: Shakespeare in Love
actors: Joseph Fiennes, Gwyneth Paltrow, Geoffrey Rush, Judi Dench, Colin Firth, Ben Affleck
description: Summer of 1593. William Shakespeare is a young star on the rise of the Elizabethan theater, but he is realizing that his creative streak is running out. No matter how hard he tries, he fails to start his new and highly anticipated opera "Romeo and Ethel, the Pirate's Daughter". Will feels the need for an inspirational muse and finds her in Viola determined to become an actress despite being a career off-limits to women.
notes: Colorful, witty, intelligent. The film is an operation built around the table with infinite, winking cunning. Which doesn't mean it's bad or unpleasant. Rather. Triumph for Gwyneth Paltrow, and seven Oscars: best film, original screenplay, lead actress (obviously Paltrow) and not (Dench), production design, costumes and soundtrack for comedy.

title: Tomahawk
actors: Yvonne De Carlo, Van Heflin, Preston Foster, Jack Oakie, Rock Hudson
description: The explorer Jim participates in a meeting between some Sioux leaders and representatives of the USA. The man explains to the commander of the troops the reasons of the natives, who are not satisfied with the construction of a fort nearby, but among the Indians there are the killers of his brother.
notes: Discreet western with good actors.

title: Resurrection
actors: Ellen Burstyn, Sam Shepard, Richard Farnsworth, Roberts Blossom
description: A woman given up for dead by doctors suddenly comes back to life with exceptional healing powers that she uses to do good to people. The surprise in the scientific world is so great that the woman is besieged by newspapers and televisions all over the world.
notes: An underrated film that knows how to use a delicate story with grace and that knows how to fully exploit the qualities of Ellen Burstyn. Next to her is the playwright and actor Sam Shepard. The subject is taken from a book by Lewis John Carlino, writer and director.

title: Un caso di coscienza
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Françoise Prevost, Saro Urzì, Turi Ferro
description: Salvatore Vaccagnino, a young lawyer from Maddà, reads in a female rotogravure, in the correspondence column kept by a priest, the naturally anonymous letter of a fellow citizen who confesses to having betrayed her husband. Confident of his wife Rita's fidelity, Salvatore summons Maddà's most respectable cooks, amusing himself by arousing in them all sorts of doubts about the fidelity of their respective wives. While Salvatore continues his investigations, driven by an insatiable curiosity, he is convinced, thanks to another anonymous letter, that his wife could also be among the possible adulterers.
notes: Usual, incorrigible old-fashioned Buzzanca in Sicilian sauce.

title: Amanti
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Faye Dunaway, Enrico Simonetti, Caroline Mortimer
description: After a first, casual meeting at an airport, the Italian engineer Valerio, and a beautiful American lady, Julie, meet and spend a few days together in a villa in Cortina. Valerio is unaware that the woman is about to die of an incurable disease. The sudden revelation comes to him from a friend of Julie's, who came to get her to induce her to have an operation ...
notes: What could have been a dramatic story due to the presence of death in the relationship between the two lovers, has instead been transformed into a tearful and sentimental story. A half injury for the great De Sica. Based on a comedy by Brunello Rondi.

title: The Girl Next Door
actors: Gary Busey, Henry Czerny, Robin Gammell, Janet-Laine Green
description: A writer is looking for an accommodation where he can write his novel in peace. After placing an ad in the newspaper, a married couple replies and offers to host him in their home. The family includes a beautiful and sensual fourteen year old. The teenager begins to cultivate an insane passion for the man and does everything to be close to him. But the ambiguous situation ends up haunting the man who begins to cultivate a feeling of anger towards the girl.
notes: Fortunately, the film features Alicia Silverstone, the most desired teenager in the United States at the time.

title: Crisis
actors: Cary Grant, José Ferrer, Ramon Novarro, Paul Raymond
description: The famous neurosurgeon Ferguson is trapped, during his honeymoon, in an insurrectionary movement against the dictator Ferrago. He would like to flee immediately, but a squad of soldiers prevented him from crossing the border. Received at the palace, Ferguson is forced to undergo an operation Ferrago suffering from a brain tumor. But Gonzales, leader of the rebels, writes him a letter threatening the doctor to kill his wife, in the meantime kidnapped by his men, if he does not kill the dictator under his knife. A very traditional melò for Brooks' directorial debut, destined for better rehearsals.

title: La pacifista
actors: Monica Vitti, Pierre Clementi, Peter Pasetti, Piero Faggioni
description: Barbara, a politically disengaged television journalist who professes to be a pacifist, carries out her work in a city in turmoil due to youth protest and the violence of extremists on the other. The woman is the victim of a gang of motorcyclists who, during a service, snatch the recorder from her hand and burn her car. But Barbara is troubled by the mysterious and dark presence of a young man who follows her everywhere, suddenly appearing and disappearing.
notes: Injury to Jancsó who finds himself looking for an unlikely synthesis between his linguistic research and the cinema of civil commitment.

title: A Ticket to Tomahawk
actors: Dan Dailey, Anne Baxter, Rory Calhoun, Walter Brennan, Marilyn Monroe
description: The Colorado stagecoach company goes to great lengths to boycott the inauguration of the new railroad with the help of a gang of thugs. Meanwhile, Sheriff Kit Dodge scrambles to find someone to take a seat on the train that has Tomahawk Station as its final destination. Kit recruits Johnny, a strange traveling salesman who accepts in order to repel the gang's assaults. Humorous (and musical) Western by a modest director who was also a "pulp" writer.

title: It Happened in Brooklyn
actors: Frank Sinatra, Kathryn Grayson, Jimmy Durante, Peter Lawford
description: During the war, an American soldier met a young composer in England, the grandson of a lord. Discharged and returned to Brooklyn, the boy is unable to enter the world of work and must accept the hospitality of the old janitor of the school where he studied. Here he meets a music teacher with whom he begins a romantic relationship. Meanwhile, the English friend arrives in the United States and the ex-soldier fears that a lord's nephew might notice his condition. Thanks to the help of the janitor ...
notes: Lots of good songs and a wild Jimmy Durante.

title: Guinevere
actors: Sheryl Lee, Noah Wyle, Sean Patrick Flanery, Brid Brennan
description: Queen Geneva is torn between her passion for the young and heroic Lancelot and her devotion to King Arthur, her legitimate husband and sovereign. He saved Camelot, the queen's homeland, from the dark plots of the priestess and sorceress Morgana. Guinevere finds herself forced to repress her feelings towards Lancelot and to work together with the wizard Merlin to try to bring peace to his kingdom. But Morgana is always lurking ...
notes: The saga of King Arthur reduced to films for American television is really ridiculous, if then even the performers are of a poor level, the omelette is done.

title: Race for Your Life, Charlie Brown
description: Charlie Brown and his party take a bus to take them to a remote village in the West where the company of friends will spend their vacation on a campsite. For Charlie, this adventure will prove to be a truly instructive experience: he will learn the art of command and his patience will be severely tested by his unruly friends. There will be no shortage of misfortunes, as well as the proverbial misfortune of Charlie Brown.
notes: Bill Melendez had already directed a Peanuts gang adventure in 1970 called "Here Comes Charlie Brown". Here he confirms his skill.

title: Young Einstein
actors: Yahoo Serious, Odile Le Clezio, John Howard, Pee Wee Wilson
description: He is not well known, but in his small way he has many inventions to his credit. From Australia, in fact, Albert Einstein invents the beer with bubbles (for which everyone is grateful) and the guitar. This last idea, however, will even lead him to an asylum. But not all evil comes to harm: he will be able to crown his dream of love with Marie Curie.
notes: Unusual the debut of this filmmaker who calls himself Yahoo Serious, a name that is a program. Made in 1985, the film, of which Serious is also a screenwriter, actor, producer and editor, had to wait three years to be successful in theaters.

title: Tosca
actors: Michel Simon, Imperio Argentina, Rossano Brazzi, Massimo Girotti
description: The singer Floria Tosca pretends to give herself to Baron Scarpia, head of the papal police, to obtain the freedom of her man. But then he kills him. His sacrifice will be of no use and when the woman discovers it, she throws herself from the stands of Castel Sant'Angelo in Rome, killing herself.
notes: A film that had a very complex preparation. Designed by Jean Renoir, who had to abandon the set for the outbreak of the war, the film was directed by an assistant to the French master. Assistant director was Luchino Visconti who later chose Massimo Girotti for his "Obsession". Curious, but today it has only a historical interest. Based on Victorien Sardou's play (and not on Puccini's opera).

title: Fatima
actors: Vanessa Staiss, Felipe Carvalho, Vanessa Antunes, Joaquim De Almeida, Omero Antonutti
description: Fatima is a remote Portuguese village. Here, on May 13, 1917, three children, three shepherds, see a beautiful "Lady" in heaven who invites them to pray and to return to the same place every day 13 of the following six months. Believed to be liars and visionaries by all, even by their own parents, children suffer intimidation and threats, but their faith in the "Lady" ultimately prevails. The love story between a fado singer and a young man from a good family is grafted onto this story, well known to all Christians and non-Christians.
notes: Pre-Vatican II style hagiography, plus the worst of television aesthetics. Wasted actors.

title: Gods and Monsters
actors: Ian McKellen, Brendan Fraser, Lynn Redgrave, Lolita Davidovich
description: Muscular young Clayton Boone works as a gardener at former director James Whale's mansion. The big boy does not know that the elderly gentleman is the inventor of the legendary Frankestein of 1931 and, above all, does not know its clear diversity. Whale, in addition to being on sunset boulevard and living secluded with housekeeper Hanna, is ill, and would spend the rest of his days for just one moment of sex with Boone.
notes: If the actor's exploits of the giants McKellen and Redgrave are obvious, the most surprising is the passionate script by Bill Condon who, starting from the beautiful book "Father of Frankenstein" by Christopher Bram, is pleasantly lost among poignant evocations of monstrous cinematic shadows and solitudes with unbearable time.

title: Arlington Road
actors: Jeff Bridges, Tim Robbins, Joan Cusack, Hope Davis, Robert Gossett
description: Michael Faraday, a recently widowed history professor, lives with his son Grant in the residential Arlington Road neighborhood. The two get to know Oliver and Cheryl Lang, the new neighbors. The two families are increasingly united, even as Michael begins to have doubts about the very sociable Oliver. Indeed, the professor discovers that the affable neighbor is a terrorist.
notes: The truth in this solid and engaging thriller - inlayed with affection, family tenderness, and political cruelty - has a menacing duplicity. The criminal ambiguity of the "ordinary man", the nihilism of a hopeless ending. Did the body snatchers win?

title: Babe Pig in the City
actors: Magda Szubanski, James Cromwell, Mary Stein, Mickey Rooney
description: An accident forces Hoggett to bed. Now that the man cannot do the farm work and the bank threatens to collect the mortgage, Ms. Hoggett's only hope of saving the property is to accept the offer to exhibit the pig for a fee at a fair. . So Babe gets to know the city for the first time ...
notes: "Babe goes to town", the second episode of the shepherd pig's adventures, cannot count on the surprise effect of the first. Overall, however, George Miller keeps the tone of the film high and invents an imaginative urban setting. Nice operation.

title: A Murder of Crows
actors: Cuba Gooding jr., Tom Berenger, Marianne Jean-Baptiste, Eric Stoltz
description: The position of Lawson Russell, a prominent and brilliant New Orleans attorney, changes radically when he agrees to follow the case of a wealthy fixer guilty of murder. When the lawyer can no longer agree to defend such a man, he interrogates him illegitimately and is disbarred from the order. Lawson retires and begins writing a book and becomes friends with Christopher Marlowe, who is writing the thriller "A Murder of Crows". When he is found dead Lawson decides to present his friend's book to the publishing house as if it were his own. But there is a problem: the murders described in the thriller are not fictional, they all actually took place.
notes: Grisham-inspired judicial thriller, the film struggles between free twists and a far-fetched solution. The first to seem unconvinced is the protagonist, who should be a Hitchcock-like character involved in a plot against his will but who looks like the parody of Eddie Murphy. Tom Berenger, a one-piece policeman, denounces the passing of the years. A lot of sophisticated suspense, but not very engaging.

title: Sitcom
actors: Evelyne Dandry, François Marthouret, Marina de Van, Adrien de Van
description: A classic middle-class family: father an engineer, a mother who spends her time between sessions of psychoanalysis and gymnastics classes, a very serious son who studies law, a daughter an artist and a Spanish cleaning lady a bit crazy. Then one day the father brings a white mouse into the house and all the family balances collapse miserably. And so the landlady turns out to be a lesbian and ends up paired with the black maid who had cheated on her husband. The son confesses to be gay and goes to "unjust marriage" with the maid's ex.
notes: After a tried and tested experience in short films, Ozon made his feature film debut with a black comedy cousin of "Happiness" and second degree relative of "Festen". A handful of shots open and close this grotesque, harsh and moralistic "Beautiful", where the actors live in apnea, in a backdrop that is as colorful as it is toxic.

title: A Soldier's Daughter Never Cries
actors: Kris Kristofferson, Barbara Hershey, Leelee Sobieski, Jane Birkin
description: American World War II veteran Bill Willis haunted by memories of his experiences in the Pacific has decided to expatriate to Paris. The wife Marcella who followed him is an outgoing and affectionate woman who does everything to welcome her adopted son Benoît in the best possible way. The child must suffer the jealousy of the new sister Channe. Children grow up against the backdrop of endless poker games and parties.
notes: Ivory's film is inspired by the Parisian life of James Jones, the author of "From Here to Eternity". Illustration, environments, flawless characters, correct packaging, few dolls. Unfortunately, however, there is not even a thrill, an image that was felt the need. The impression is that not even Ivory felt the need to make this film, where he finds himself (who knows why) citing films and authors far away from him (Ford, Eastwood, Cimino).

title: Lucignolo
actors: Massimo Ceccherini, Claudia Gerini, Alessandro Paci, Carlo Monni, Flavio Bucci
description: Lucio and Pino are old friends who in a day spent in front of the television or at the bar are looking for a job, without giving themselves much to do. Lucio agrees to replace his sister in her job as a nurse at the "Life is infinitely beautiful" nursing home, but instead of taking an interest in the sick he is struck by the graces of Fatima. When the beautiful and sexy nurse decides to organize a play from "Pinocchio" she immediately thinks of Lucio, who involves his friend Pino. But he is not an actor and for fear of being discovered he refuses to participate in this scam.
notes: Red wig, strong nose, mad grin, Ceccherini boldly faces the exam from character actor to protagonist and improvises himself as a director. Our cinema does not miss another precious opportunity to treat itself to kitsch anthology images.

title: Hard Contract
actors: James Coburn, Lee Remick, Lilli Palmer, Burgess Meredith
description: Jonathan Cunningham, a professional hitman, is commissioned by the futurologist Ramsey Williams to kill three people: the first in Spain, in Torremolinos; the second in Brussels; the third in a place that will be communicated to him in due course. Reaching the first destination, Jonathan meets and falls in love with a multi-divorced billionaire, Sheila MacColt, who is traveling the world with a small group of friends. After committing the first murder, Jonathan goes to Brussels where he receives a phone call from Ramsey, who tells him that he must go to Madrid for the third assignment. Meanwhile, Sheila has discovered her profession and ...
notes: Nothing special, but professionalism is not lacking.

title: Copkiller - L'assassino dei poliziotti
actors: Harvey Keitel, Nicole Garcia, Leonard Mann, Sylvia Sydney
description: In New York, six policemen from the narcotics section are killed by a mysterious killer who uses a kitchen knife as a weapon. While the police begin their investigations and try to put order in the scarce clues in their possession, the press accuses the top of the police of corruption and correctness. In fact, Fred O'Connor, in charge of the investigations, has a strange personality: he considers the weak and drug addicts as criminals who must be severely punished and therefore feels no remorse for taking advantage of them and being bribed. One day a mythomaniac who claims to be the copkiller comes to his house ...

title: Figaro, il barbiere di Siviglia
actors: Tito Gobbi, Cesco Baseggio, Irene Genna, Armando Francioli
description: The Count of Almaviva, in love with Rosina, follows the young woman to Seville, introducing himself to her in the guise of Lindoro. Rosina is jealously guarded in the house by her old guardian Bartolo who would like to marry her and for this reason he does not give her respite. With the help of the barber Figaro, former servant of the Count, Almaviva manages to enter Bartolo's house disguised, exchanging furtive glances, sighs and notes with Rosina. The Count's next step is to kidnap the beautiful Rosina.
notes: Cinematic version (in color) of Rossini's famous opera, shot without any verve. For the musical parts Camillo Mastrocinque has resorted to opera singers who dub the actors, except for Gobbi who doubles himself. .

title: Money Train
actors: Wesley Snipes, Woody Harrelson, Jennifer Lopez, Robert Blake
description: The money train circulates in the bowels of the New York subway: it is a small armored convoy, protected by special agents that goes around the various ticket offices, taking the day's proceeds. The desire to take over the convoy with all its contents is the fixed idea of ??Charlie, an inveterate and rather unfortunate player who has contracted a debt with a gang. Charlie is an agent assigned to act as decoy at the stations to stop any thugs. But when Charlie is fired the idea of ??stopping that train becomes a real obsession for him. A not too breathtaking thriller, with gritty performers.

title: Ambushed
actors: Courtney B. Vance, Virginia Madsen, David Keith, William Forsythe
description: Jerry Robinson is a good black cop and has never had a career problem, in any sense. Recently, however, he has been entrusted with a difficult murder case following which he must begin to fear for his life. The risks are linked to the identity of the dead man: a leading exponent of the Ku Klux Klan, murdered in a southern town. The fact is that someone - most likely his own colleagues - tries to frame Jerry, accusing him of committing the murder and kidnapping the dead man's son ...
notes: Yes, the plot has the retro flavor of the good old movies, but be warned: not all that glitters is gold.

title: L'ennui
actors: Charles Berling, Sophie Guillemin, Arielle Dombasle, Robert Kramer
description: Martin is a professor in the throes of depression after breaking up with his wife. His crisis takes a new turn when he meets Cécilia, a girl who is said to have caused the death of a painter and with whom Martin begins to develop a morbid relationship made only of sex.
notes: It is perhaps the first authentic transposition of the Moravian novel. Cécilia, even in the licenses granted to herself the new adaptation, is absolutely credible: the painter who appears here at the beginning in a sort of handover with the suffering face of the underground director Robert Kramer. Cécilia is the new Sophie Guillemin.

title: L'assedio
actors: David Thewlis, Thandie Newton, Claudio Santamaria, John C. Ojwang
description: An ancient mansion in the heart of Rome, an island where two lonelinesses have been shipwrecked: he is English, white and a little crazy, while she is African, black and full of problems. Mr. Kinky, barricaded behind his piano, spends his time attending Bach, Mozart and Grieg. Shandurai comes from afar and has found in Mr. Kinky's house a suitable accommodation for her refugee status: she cleans the house in exchange for a room, while studying medicine at the university. Their lives are intertwined in a game of attractions, waste and secrets.
notes: With the dialogues reduced to the bone, Bertolucci makes bodies, faces, objects, the glimpse of a staircase speak, with connections of images that refer directly to the avant-gardes, with free associations, with an instinctive and sensual adhesion to the story he is telling. And he finds a compositional freedom, a wealth of extraordinary "unspoken", and the ability to blend a love story with an underground story of "elsewhere".

title: Fuori dal mondo
actors: Margherita Buy, Silvio Orlando, Carolina Freschi, Giuliana Lojodice
description: Caterina is a young nun waiting to take her final vows, Ernesto is the owner of a laundry. Teresa is very young and wanders around Milan looking for a place to sleep, Gabriele is a polite policeman. The lives of these people will be linked and upset by a child who Caterina finds abandoned in a park in Milan wrapped in a sweater. The newborn will change their way of seeing the world and will be the trait d'union between their lives.
notes: The former minimalist Piccioni aims high, and not only because he seeks a close encounter with spirituality. It speaks of nuns waiting for perpetual vows, starting with the proud Catherine, but also of women who go all the way. The film has the courage to let Ernesto (a measured Silvio Orlando) take the tram: a Zvattinian metaphor at the service of a cinema that wants to get out of too narrow boundaries.

title: La fame e la sete
actors: Antonio Albanese, Lorenza Indovina, Aisha Cerami, Rosa Pianeta
description: An elderly person dies in a remote Sicilian town. At the bedside his son Alex, his wife Mara, cousins, nephews and brothers-in-law. In those days Alex must attend a photographic exhibition organized by the councilor for culture of the municipality. The funeral looms and Alex telephones his twin brother Salvatore, who has long since emigrated to the North to tell him the sad news. But unexpectedly the third Pacific twin appears out of nowhere that everyone had forgotten about.
notes: There is no need for famous writers and musicians (Cerami and Piovani), if beyond the camera there is not a real director, able to intuit the rhythms and dictate the times. The film commits a mortal sin: it is not funny. Albanese wastes his talent for a mania of still immature greatness.

title: Hurlyburly
actors: Sean Penn, Kevin Spacey, Chazz Palminteri, Robin Wright, Meg Ryan
description: Eddie, Mickey and Phil work in Hollywood, even if we never see them in the office: they spend time in their homes unloading themselves - all together - cynicism, anger, abuse, old and new stories. The craziest is Eddie, who snorts from morning to night and keeps talking. Mickey is treacherous and far too subtle, while Phil is the only one who tries to put himself in the picture ...
notes: Drazan's direction counts less than David Rabe's screenplay and play on which the film is based. Actors in high spirits, with Spacey and Penn in the lead. Don't stay behind the bars: the pace never slows down and you end up stunned.

title: Best of the Badmen
actors: Robert Ryan, Claire Trevor, Robert Preston, Jack Buetel, Walter Brennan
description: After the civil war, some groups of Confederates went into hiding by joining the outlaws. To cleanse the country of these gangs, the federal government sends army units against them. One of these is commanded by Major Jeff Clanton who, after hunting down the infamous Quantrell gang for some time, manages to force it to surrender. The major promises captured outlaws to let them free, as long as they swear to respect the new constitution. But this vMatthew Fowler would like to have the outlaws convicted for cashing in on the hefty bounty. Quasi-B-series Western, with good actors and more dialogue than action.

title: Un modo di essere donna
actors: Marisa Berenson, Venantino Venantini, Riccardo Salvino
description: Francesca and Sibilla, two students from Pisa, living together for economic reasons, are great friends and tell each other everything. Their concerns about sex are totally different, while Sibilla, a proud and passionate feminist, wants to establish relationships with the other sex based on maximum independence, Francesca aims to find the man of her life. Years pass and Sibilla, now a journalist and famous writer, is always looking for a man who makes her happy. Laughable uninhibited-with-ideas drama. Waste of a decade.

title: Le dernier saut
actors: Maurice Ronet, Michel Bouquet, Caty Rosier, Eric Penet
description: George Garal, a rude paratrooper sergeant and former combatant in Algeria, kills his unfaithful wife and obtains an iron alibi. The police, convinced of his innocence, arrest the woman's young lover as an alleged murderer. Commissioner Jaurin, an introverted man who has just been transferred from Marseille to the province as punishment, is leading the investigation. When Jaurin, who had no doubts about Garal's innocence, fears he will have to change his mind on the basis of some clues that have emerged in the course of the investigation ...
notes: Mediocre thriller that does not rise even with the good interpretation of the actors.

title: Lenny
actors: Dustin Hoffman, Valerie Perrine, Jan Miner, Stanley Beck
description: At the end of the sixties, the American comedian Lenny Bruce scandalized the right-thinking with a type of heavy and aggressive comedy, made of vulgarity but also of mockery to power and the establishment. Married to the stripper Honey Harlowe, even in private life he behaves no less stormy.
notes: Excessive and overflowing Bob Fosse (emulating the models he wore on the screen) traces the profile of an American out of the ordinary. Once again Fosse chooses the world of "show biz" as a metaphor and compendium of "life". One of the most overwhelming interpretations of Dustin Hoffman.

title: True Stories
actors: John Goodman, Annie McEnroe, David Byrne, Swoosie Kurtz
description: Big party for the birthday of the town of Virgil in Texas: 150 years of its foundation are celebrated. The narrator explains what has happened since that mythical 1836: the invasion of the Spaniards who arrived from Mexico, the wars with the Indians, the birth of the first urban agglomerations up to the present situation. He then takes us into a local electronics industry where employees expose their more or less outlandish theories about love.
notes: Film conceived, conceived, interpreted and directed by the mind of the now disbanded Talking Heads. An ingenious musical fresco on the heart of America, one of the few true "political" films of the decade. John Goodman carves out the role of a lonely heart in search of a soul mate.

title: Não, ou vã gloria de mandar
actors: Luis Miguel Cintra, Diego Doria
description: While on his way to die in the forests of Mozambique, during the colonial war, a Portuguese lieutenant tells his soldiers several episodes in the history of Portugal. The officer recalls the episode concerning the failed attempt of King Sebastian, which took place in 1578, to conquer North Africa by removing it from the Moors. The king died together with his soldiers, in the battle of Alcacer Khibir, in Morocco at the age of only 21. His body, however, was never found and hence the legend, very important in the Portuguese collective imagination and taken up by the great writer Fernando Pessoa in his esoteric poem, "The Message", that he is still alive and that one day he will return for regain possession of the throne of Portugal.
notes: De Oliveira traces the travails of recent Portuguese history through the history of the colonial conquest. Hypnotic, with moments of great intensity.

title: Illegally Yours
actors: Harry Carey jr., Rob Lowe, Colleen Camp, Kenneth Mars
description: A member of a jury called to judge a defendant is in great difficulty. The girl is none other than an old flame of hers and professional problems end up overlapping with sentimental ones. In the end, after many ups and downs, ours manages to prove his innocence.
notes: Peter Bodganovich directs this yellow-hued comedy with discreet professionalism. As a perfect nostalgic cinephile, the director knows the game well, but fails to be truly convincing. The presence of Harry Carey jr. (character actor of John Ford's westerns, who is an idol of Bogdanovic) and L.B. Stratten, sister of Dorothy Statten (the model who had an affair with Bogdanovich and was killed by her husband) are embarrassing winks.

title: LeVampire de Düsseldorf
actors: Robert Hossein, Marie-France Pisier, Colette Régis, Roger Dutoit
description: Düsseldorf, 1930s. The city lives under the nightmare of a mysterious maniac who, at night, savagely attacks and kills the prostitutes who practice their profession along the boulevards. The unsuspected perpetrator of the crimes is the worker Peter Kunsten, with a shy and modest appearance, who in committing the crimes unloads his own inferiority complex. Peter falls in love with a nightclub dancer who ends up succumbing to his assiduous but discreet court. It will be the dancer who will discover who is hiding in the guise of shy Peter.
notes: Distantly inspired by Lang's "M" (and by the news story that inspired it) an attempt at a sociological thriller, in depth.

title: Conquest
actors: Greta Garbo, Charles Boyer, Reginald Owen, Alan Marshal
description: Napoleon Bonaparte meets Countess Maria Walewska in Warsaw who begs him to grant the Polish people independence. The emperor's infatuated woman abandons her husband to follow him with the hope of getting what she wants. Napoleon is not indifferent to his graces and agrees that the woman is by his side in his exploits. After the defeat suffered in the battle of Leipzig, Maria goes to visit him with her son on the island of Elba where he is confined with the intention of convincing him to give up political life.
notes: Historical drama that plays all its cards on a respectable cast in which the divine Greta Garbo stands out.

title: Two-Faced Woman
actors: Greta Garbo, Melvyn Douglas, Constance Bennett, Roland Young
description: The editor of a major American magazine falls in love with a ski instructor and decides to marry her. But his work commitments call him back to New York and so the man is forced to leave his new wife in the village. His wife, tired of waiting for him, goes to town, pretends to be the bride's twin sister and regains his love.
notes: At the time the film was a complete fiasco and it seems that it was one of the causes of the withdrawal of the Garbo, here in her last interpretation. In fact, she struggles a bit to settle in, but the film has a lightness worthy of the director, and the self-irony of the Divine is worth the vision.

title: Paperhouse
actors: Ben Cross, Charlotte Burke, Jane Bertish, Samantha Cahill
description: Anna is about to lose herself in the solitude of her own world when she discovers that she can come into contact with another. The house he designed and planned is inhabited by a disabled boy. The woman soon discovers that there is not much difference between the world she has only imagined and reality. The boy in fact proves to be sweet and understanding towards him, but soon things start to go wrong because the young man's kindness turns into obsession and Anna enters a nightmare from which she will have a hard time getting out.
notes: Usual film for eminently televised destination without infamy and without praise.

title: Aftermath: A Test of Love
actors: Richard Chamberlain, Michael Learned, Denis Hearnes, Zeliko Ivanek
description: A family is attacked in the night by a ferocious gang of robbers. The final balance after the assault is particularly serious since on the ground remains a dead and a seriously injured person. The upset family unit struggles to recover completely.
notes: Good test for Richard Chamberlain even if the plot is quite obvious. Denis Hearnes instead lets himself go and his acting is reduced to a series of rather broken screams and shouts. The screenplay strives to be original but the subject does not help it. It comes to the end with a good dose of suspense which, however, cannot revive the film that remains an average production for television.

title: Avventura a Capri
actors: Maurizio Arena, Alessandra Panaro, Nino Taranto, Leopoldo Trieste
description: Time for holidays and Capri, even in the 1950s, was a destination of great prestige. On the beautiful island, Yvonne and Mario, Renato and Sandra meet. The four go out together, have fun, but around the corner here are the first misunderstandings, the misunderstandings that get bigger and bigger. In the end, inevitable, the departure. But all is not lost: at the Naples station love will be able to recompose itself and, obviously, triumph.
notes: Giuseppe Lipartiti is not a well known director. This is his first film and only two will follow: "Gli discenti" and "Via Veneto". Three fruits that are not exciting for an arid white season, one might say ...

title: Hitler - ein Film aus Deutschland
actors: Harry Baer, Johannes Buzalski, Alfred Edel, André Heller, Peter Kern
description: The rise to power of a former house painter, who became an obscure corporal and, after a few years, elected Chancellor: Adolf Hitler. How things will turn out is a known story. But this is not the usual historical or biographical narrative.
notes: The author of this "film-river", with extended times and rich in metaphors and symbolisms, is Hans-Jurgen Syberberg, one of the most visionary and eccentric filmmakers in the history of German cinema, also author of an emblematic biography of Ludwig di Bavaria. In this film, Hitler is also taken on as a historical figure, but above all he is transformed into a symbol, full of references to the sexual and cultural sphere.

title: Prigionieri della guerra 1914 - 1918
description: The Great War was not only a world conflict: it was also the first modern war that caused a very high number of deaths and enormous destruction. Everywhere. Also in Trentino, to which this document is dedicated, which through some unpublished films reconstructs the various vicissitudes of the tragedy of the Trentino people. The visual evidence comes from some of the main European archives and, for the first time, from the Russian ones.
notes: A modern historiographic method, which starts from concrete experiences lived in precise and delimited areas of analysis and which draws some general conclusions from there.

title: Mighty Joe Young
actors: Charlize Theron, Bill Paxton, Peter Firth, David Paymer, Regina King
description: For many, the gorilla Joe is a true myth, especially for African villagers who see him as a guardian and defender. For Jill, his only friend, he is a guardian angel and a companion on adventures. When zoologist Gregg encounters the giant gorilla and realizes that the animal is in danger, to save it from ferocious predators, he and Jill decide to take it to safety in an animal shelter in California. But his arrival in the city alerts an old hunter who can't wait to catch him so he can resell him.
notes: Between remakes and reductions for serial-TV cinema, the fracassona Hollywood flounders. It's up to the most famous ape to end up in the big binge of the obvious: "The great Joe", in fact, is the remake of "The King of Africa" ??('49), which was already a pale clone of the legendary "King Kong" of '33. Once the murky "subtexts" of the immortal attraction between Beauty (poor Charlize Theron) and the Beast have been cleared, practically nothing remains.

title: The Deep End of Ocean
actors: Michelle Pfeiffer, Treat Williams, Whoopi Goldberg, Jonathan Jackson, Cory Buck, Ryan Merriman, Alexa PenaVega, Michael McGrady, Brenda Strong, Tony Musante
description: A thirteen-year-old boy knocks on the Cappadora door without realizing that his family is inside the house. He had been kidnapped, he was four years old, and he doesn't remember anything; he lives at the end of the avenue, in another house, with another family in which he is not at all bad. So Beth, the alleged mother, Pat, daughter Kerry and their troubled teenage son Vincent along with a police officer try to investigate.
notes: In spite of genetics, biology, blood ties and the ethical-scientific delirium unleashed in recent times, the melodrama in question suggests a change of perspective, with a family enlargement that comes from the same little protagonist. The old Grosbard dries, cuts, proceeds by ellipses and defends a man against a star who plays all-court. Leaving, only here and there, space for teammates.

title: The Rugrats Movie
description: Dylan, the last born, has arrived in the Pickles family. The child wasted no time in sneaking into the territory of the Rugrats gang formed by his brother Tommy and his friends Chuckie, Phil, and Lil. While his parents are busy solving the problems of the growing family, Dylan must fight for a place in the Rugrats gang.
notes: Transgressive with tenderness, sadistic with affection, irreverent by nature, the Rugrats are the protagonists of a television series, created by Gabor Csupo and Arlene Klasky, which gathers 23 million viewers in the United States every week. Ugly, nice, uncertain with the vocabulary, bunglers, they do not resemble the "flou" childhood of snacks. They are funny and true and their world of reference, in the film, is "Raiders of the Lost Ark".

title: Il cielo in una stanza
actors: Ricky Tognazzi, Elio Germano, Gabriele Mainetti, Francesco Venditti
description: It is a typical Saturday evening at the end of the millennium and for Marco, a seventeen-year-old Roman, everything goes wrong: the girl left him, the scooter was stolen under his nose, it is three in the morning and his father is waiting for him to lecture him. He reproaches him for the lack of responsibility, while Marco can no longer bear his severity. By magic, the two meet again in the sixties and so Marco's father has the opportunity to show his son that he too was young.
notes: Carlo and Enrico Vanzina, after a series of films unwatchable even by their audience, try again the "nostalgia operation" that they had succeeded in 1983 with "Sapore di sale". Direction complex towards the "American enemies" but a script that all in all holds up to the poverty of technical and creative means. Lived everyday life, a little like Nando Cicero and a little like Sordi, in a Rome less traveled by cars but already crowded with wasps and wasps. Nothing exciting, but some face and characterization of an old Italian comedy.

title: Dangerous Beauty
actors: Catherine McCormack, Rufus Sewell, Oliver Platt, Moira Kelly
description: Veronica Franco is a brilliant and gifted woman, but Marco Venier, the aristocrat she fell in love with, cannot marry her, because she is poor and belongs to a family of questionable origins. Her mother sees fit to introduce her to the art of courtesans. Veronica thus ends up becoming the most famous and successful courtesan of 16th century Venice. Although married women carefully avoid her and men who can't get her favors oppose her, Veronica makes brilliant use of her intelligence to master her destiny.
notes: The blockbuster that reinvents the famous lagoon city between Cinecittà and computers, is so kitschy as to be even likeable: the cardinals pay for sound "episcopates" (the quote is literal) and the "sorcerer" apprentices learn fellatio like Davis in "Celebrity ".

title: Patch Adams
actors: Robin Williams, Daniel London, Monica Potter, Philip Seymour Hoffman
description: After a parenthesis in a mental institution where he had been hospitalized as a teenager because he was depressed, Hunter "Patch" Adams, even though his vocation was to be a clown, decides to take on the role of a doctor with a human face and found therapy. of the smile. So after graduating in medicine he decided to found the Gesundheit Institute where the smile was the dominant therapy.
notes: Good feelings, easy tears and the distressed joy of aging clowns. There is also an involuntary parody of "The fleeting moment". Williams is never credible, by birth, in the role of the protagonist.

title: Very Bad Things
actors: Christian Slater, Cameron Diaz, Daniel Stern, Jeanne Tripplehorn, Leland Orser
description: A girl has been harboring a dream for twenty-seven years: showing up, fully dressed, in the classic wedding aisle surrounded by relatives, friends and (possibly) a few troubles. But, on the eve of the wedding, boyfriend and fellow students rush to Las Vegas for the inevitable bachelor party. Sure to get drunk and, at best, to attend some striptease, they get involved in a bad business that will unleash many others, horrible, at the antipodes of any morality.
notes: The film, the perfect cynical antithesis of "The wedding of my best friend", is directed with fury by the actor Peter Berg, who does not hide that he has fun in dismantling the totems of the middle class (wasp tendency) with healthy wickedness, and who surrounds himself of a pack of actors-wolves in close-knit and excited dusting. Extraordinary for the sadist in charge of make-up. Not recommended for the pure in spirit and for those who are impressed.

title: Muzungu
actors: Giobbe Covatta, Paolo Maria Veronica, Felice Andreasi, Vincenzo Salemme
description: Freddy and Dodò are two forty-year-old animators of tourist villages. Their Africa is made up of disguises, games, jokes, postcard views and, above all, of that anthropological species formed by "vacationers". When they fall in a small plane among the dunes of a desert they discover the Africa of sacrifice, solidarity, suffering.
notes: The short circuit between the white man (muzungu) and the black continent has the intelligence and sensitivity of a story supported by good actors, which does not need the gimmicks of the television variety.

title: Message in the Bottle
actors: Kevin Costner, Robin Wright, Paul Newman, Illeana Douglas, John Savage, Robbie Coltrane, Jessie James, Bethel Leslie
description: A journalist, divorced and mother of a child, is on vacation on Cape Cod when, on the beach, she finds a bottle with a letter from a man in love. The poetry and the depth of the message strike the woman, who sets out in search of the man. The investigation takes her to North Carolina, where she discovers that the man she seeks is a sailboat builder with a painful past.
notes: After _Waterworld_, Costner plunges back into a story where the sea plays a primary role and in which he is involved as an actor and producer. This time no foray into the world of the future but into that of loved ones, with a skilful operation directed by Luis Mandoki.

title: Un tè con Mussolini
actors: Cher, Judi Dench, Joan Plowright, Maggie Smith, Lily Tomlin, Massimo Ghini, Claudio Spadaro, Charlie Lucas, Baird Wallace, Paolo Seganti
description: Florence; 1934: A group of English ladies is found at Elizabeth Barrett Browning's grave for the annual tribute to the poet. At the gathering of "the Scorpios", so called for their pungent humor, only Mary is missing, who arrives holding a child by the hand. This is Luca, the natural son of a textile merchant for whom Mary works: the man refused to recognize little Luca, who was later adopted by the "Scorpios" ...
notes: The director - drawing inspiration from his autobiography _Zeffirelli_, published by Weindenfeld and Nicolson - softly indulges in the free reconstruction of his adolescence.

title: Ronnie & Julie
actors: Joshua Jackson, Margot Finley, Tom Butler, Teri Garr, Alexandra Purvis
description: The dynamic and energetic Elizabeth Monroe is running for the post of mayor of the city of Spokane. His political opponent is Arthur Cappell and, as we know, in politics we don't look so much for the subtle in order to beat the competitor. To complicate matters between Elizabeth and Arthur, love breaks out suddenly between Ronnie, her son, and Julie, his daughter. The mayoral candidates try to keep the love story hidden.
notes: A film destined for the thematic channels of American TV, it is a medium-sized product with good actors and a captivating story. Typical product of the Hollywood cinema "delicatessen".

title: The Great McGinty
actors: Brian Donlevy, Muriel Angelus, Akim Tamiroff, Allyn Joslyn
description: A tramp (Donlevy) manages to become mayor of Chicago and then governor of the state thanks to the support of a gangster for whom he works. But when the man tries to behave honestly by rejecting the proposals his friends make, he is arrested for old crimes. After a few unsuccessful attempts he manages to escape from prison and take refuge on an island in the tropics where he earns his living as a barman.
notes: Directorial debut for Preston Sturges who dusted off a screenplay he had in his drawer for seven years and which was awarded an Oscar.

title: Whirlpool
actors: Gene Tierney, Richard Conte, José Ferrer, Charles Bickford
description: Anna, the wife of Dr. William, a famous psychoanalyst, suffers from kleptomania. One day she is caught stealing in a department store. On that occasion she meets David Korvo, who, thanks to his intervention, saves her from the consequences of the theft. David confides to her that he is a hypnotist and promises to heal her by causing her to hide what has happened to her from her husband. During an absence of her husband, Anna goes to Korvo to be hypnotized, but unfortunately she is unaware that he is nothing but an impostor.
notes: Undoubtedly a good film noir that adapts Guy Endore's novel very well. Iron script by Ben Hecht and great chiaroscuro by cinematographer Arthur Miller.

title: A Month in the Country
actors: Colin Firth, Kenneth Branagh, Natasha Richardson, Patrick Malahide
description: Yorkshire, 1920. Birkin, a Londoner returning from the First World War and separated from his wife, settles in a small house in the middle of the green. It is there because it was called by the vicar Keack to bring to light an ancient fresco. Introverted, as well as traumatized by the war experience, he adapts to living inside the bell tower. His commitment to recovering the work does not prevent him from falling in love with the vicar's wife. At the same time, in the meadow in front of the small church Moon, another veteran with a passion for archeology, is recovering an ancient tomb.
notes: Typical English film that indulges in fashion decoration in the Eighties.

title: I magnifici Brutos del West
actors: I Brutos, Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Emma Penella, Darry Cowl
description: The Brutos, four sons of the West, inherit a started funeral home. Their first client requests that they take care of transporting the body of a relative to another location. In reality, instead of the corpse, there is a treasure of inestimable value. During the journey, our four heroes are attacked by the Indians and are captured. The chief of the Indians intends to give them in husband to his four very ugly daughters. After countless vicissitudes, the Brutos thwart the criminal plan of the fake funeral and, full of glory, return as heroes to their country.
notes: Made with the sole purpose of exploiting the fame of the comic quartet, those of the Gray wax advertisement.

title: Melodie immortali - Mascagni
actors: Pierre Cressoy, Carla Del Poggio, Vera Molnar, Mario Del Monaco
description: While Pietro Mascagni is composing "Guglielmo Ratcliff" he neglects the lessons and is expelled from the Milan Conservatory. Driven by necessity, he accepted the position of director of the Maresca operetta company with which he began a tour. In Genoa he falls in love with Lina, who will be destined to become his woman and his inspiring muse. A year passes: Mascagni is in Cerignola and, tired of the stray life to which his wife is subjecting, he decides to accept the direction of the town's philharmonic. Meanwhile, Lina, who is expecting a baby, gives birth to a frail boy who needs constant care. the story obviously leads to the composition of the "Cavalleria rusticana". Correct and enjoyable hagiography directed by a specialist.

title: Woyzeck
actors: Klaus Kinski, Eva Mattes, Wolfgang Reichman
description: Woyzeck is a German soldier who serves in a garrison located in a small town. His life is burdened, as well as by duty, by the harassment of his captain and by the experiments to which the medical officer subjects him. The tragedy erupts when Woyzeck is revealed that his woman is cheating on him. The reaction of the desperate soldier will be terrible ...
notes: Extraordinary reflection on the human condition and on the opposition between civilization and nature, conducted by a Herzog in great shape and interpreted by the always good Kinski. The radical pessimism stems from Georg Büchner's drama, with which the German filmmaker is in tune.

title: Voyage of the Damned
actors: Faye Dunaway, Max Von Sydow, Orson Welles, Lee Grant, Sam Wanamaker
description: On May 13, 1939 the German transatlantic St. Louis, commanded by Captain Schroeder, sails from Hamburg with 937 Jews on board to reach Cuba. When the ship arrives in Havana, the Batista government does not allow the landing and the ship begins a long odyssey. Modest remake of Stanley Kramer's "Ship of Fools", with an all-star cast but very boring.

title: Mossafer
actors: Hassan Darabi, Sahar Zandbegleh, Masud Zandbegleh
description: Ghassem, a schoolboy from a provincial city, has a big dream: to go to Tehran to attend an important match of the national football team. To achieve his goal he does not hesitate to steal, cheat and do other things not exactly commendable. Once he has collected the necessary sum and arrived in the capital, near the stadium fate has a joke in store for him. Kiarostami's first feature film, with a very clean look at reality and a rhythm that springs from dead times. The ending is beautiful.

title: Thick as Thieves
actors: Alec Baldwin, Rebecca De Mornay, Andre Braugher, Michael Jai White
description: Mackin, a professional thief who works on commission, receives an all-too-simple chore from mobster Frank Riles: to break into a print shop and steal $ 25,000 worth of government food stamps. Scored the heist and received the $ 20,000 compensation, Mackin is about to reach the airport. On the road, he miraculously escapes an ambush by two plainclothes agents put on his trail by a tip from Frank's emissary. Mackin intends not to let him get away with it ...
