notes: It is a curious film, which in style and graphic inserts recalls the genre films of the seventies, unfortunately ramshackle in the script, with characters left to themselves and an end without backbone. A film without too many pretensions that amuses only for the way in which it portrays the two protagonists, each prey to crazy idiosyncrasies.

title: The Borrowers
actors: John Goodman, Jim Broadbent, Celia Imrie, Flora Newbigin
description: The rubacchiotti live, discreet, tireless and industrious, inside the walls or under the floorboards of the houses and borrow from humans everything that can be useful for their micro-existence. The peaceful and pleasant cohabitation between the Clock minifamily and their guests, the Lenders, is endangered by an unscrupulous lawyer, Ocius Potter who wants to demolish their home.
notes: The rubacchiotti, in the original language The Borrowers, were born 45 years ago from the imagination of the children's writer Mary Norton. It took more than twenty years to bring them to the big screen and director Hewitt has skillfully and visually orchestrated a story where sets, costumes and special effects are as prominent characters as the actors.

title: Cookie's Fortune
actors: Glenn Close, Julianne Moore, Liv Tyler, Chris O'Donnell
description: Cookie is a weird old lady who, in sweat suits and flashy jewelry, lives in her home in Holly Springs, a lazy Mississippi town, sandwiched between a jazz club and the church. Cookie lives alone, with the black caretaker, mourns her dead husband. One morning she puts on her most beautiful necklace, puts a pillow on her face and shoots herself. Thus begins a game of intrigue woven by her niece Camille and solved in two days of lazy investigations.
notes: Altman works on Anne Rapp's text with a relaxed and complicit irony. A small film illuminated by the piercing smile of the great Patricia Neal, by the genuine grace of Liv Tyler, by the excited tone of Glenn Close and by the motionless astonishment of Julianne Moore: the zoom of Altman goes, accompanied by the blues, discovers characters, connects them, he follows them, he forgets them, suspended in the time of the south, of his home. Altman still manages to make films with the freedom of spirit of an eternal independent.

title: Hilary and Jackie
actors: Emily Watson, Rachel Griffiths, James Frain, David Morissey
description: Jackie and Hilary Du Pré are two inseparable little sisters who share their world of music and joy. Every morning, when they wake up, they find on their bed a new piece of music written for them by their mother. Of the two girls, Hilary is the musician prodigy Jackie is studying to be up to her sister. Years pass and the two sisters have become famous concert performers, but one bad day Jackie finds herself sick with multiple sclerosis ...
notes: Five minutes are enough to be struck by the cinematic rudeness of the film: two girls on a beach, a woman against the light looking at them, the girls hug each other, the music grows and the camera begins to whirl around them. Only the first of the interminable series of writing excesses, ragged dolls, blatant winks that characterize a really bad film (despite this, the two leading actresses were nominated for an Oscar, Watson as protagonist and Griffiths as a supporting character).

title: Divorcing Jack
actors: David Thewlis, Robert Lindsay, Rachel Griffiths, Jason Isaacs
description: Don Starkey is a Belfast journalist with a caustic pen. His arrows are directed towards the Protestant extremists and the future premier (former activist of the IRA) who behind the facade of a fervent pacifist hides various "sins" of youth. But the poor reporter has the misfortune of having an affair with a girl who is killed. Don is the first of the suspects and the police hunt him down as well as some shady individuals who want an audio cassette that the woman gave him before she died.
notes: Comedy wanders between political fiction and thriller, with a humor too tied to Irish reality and numerous narrative uncertainties. To remember some cinephile quotes (the nun with a gun from "The Angel of Revenge") and the acting of a willing David Thewlis.

title: Just the Ticket
actors: Andy Garcia, Andie MacDowell, Richard Bradford, Louis Mustillo
description: Gary is a charming and rather reckless scalper from New York who falls madly in love with Linda, a promising student who is taking a cooking class. The girl who reciprocates his sentiment would like him to be engaged in something more serious. Gary, not only does he not have a Social Security card, nor an identity card, but he also doesn't have a birth certificate. Tired of unfulfilled promises, Linda dumps him and finds a new boyfriend just as Gary is getting his hands on a big deal involving the Pope's visit to the Big Apple.
notes: Andy Garcia produced and edited the music for the film and is the only one - and it shows - to believe in the project, directed as an "independent" schoolboy by Richard Wenk. Special cameo of the great Joe Frazier.

title: The Affliction
actors: Nick Nolte, James Coburn, Sissy Spacek, Willem Dafoe
description: Wade Whitehouse is a policeman from a small New Hampshire town with a complex family situation: his father only knows how to communicate through violence and his life, day after day, falls apart. The mysterious death of a businessman could make him the protagonist again, but murder and conspiracies are the obsession that only drives away the inner demons for a moment.
notes: The inevitability of the drama is all played out within the walls of the house. Paul Schrader wrote and wrote "Affliction", a book by Russel Banks, the same one who wrote the short story from which Atom Egoyan took "Sweet Tomorrow". Ice and snow numb the soul, lies shake small communities in New Hampshire, brutality for fathers and sons turns into a hereditary flaw. The setting acts as a tragic visual counterpoint to the story, but Schrader also renders the exterior sequences as claustrophobic as in a Kammerspiel doomed to massacre. Nolte and Coburn, Oscar winner for supporting actor, are towering.

title: Your Friends and Neighbours
actors: Amy Brenneman, Nastassja Kinski, Aaron Eckhart, Catherine Keener, Jason Patric, Ben Stiller
description: Six characters in search of impossible enjoyment confront each other between apartments, gyms, saunas, hotels and restaurants. The group includes two couples, Barry and Mary, he is a militant onanist, she is indifferent to sex, and Terri and Jerry, she is a lesbian, he is a dongiovanni and impotent. In addition to this mismatched quartet there are Cary, a priest of sex-gymnastics, latent gay and Cheri, a charming gallery owner, practicing homosexual. The intertwining between one couple and the other becomes more and more intense and gives life to a waltz of love and jealousy.
notes: The roundabout without pleasure, framed by a merciless camera and interpreted with strange effectiveness by a cast of good actors, upsets the couples and the emotional disorder dominates the interiors of a melancholy and lonely America at the end of the millennium. Conversations, confessions, unanswered questions undo the beds, thoughts and desires. The poster citing Jean-Luc Godard's "Contempt" reveals the director's predilection for the dialogue rhythm of certain French cinema and suggests the feeling with which to look at this "still life" made not of apples, bottles or game, but of bodies and words.

title: Orphans
actors: Douglas Henshall, Gary Lewis, Stephen McCole, Rosemarie Stevenson
description: Thomas, Michael, Sheila and John find themselves in Glasgow around their mother's coffin at her funeral. A violent storm that hit the city will force the four to spend a long and dark night full of misunderstandings and misunderstandings. Thomas, the most responsible, decides to stay next to his mother's body all night. Michael, seriously injured in a pub quarrel, intends to claim compensation from his company for an injury at work. Sheila who is handicapped breaks her wheelchair in an accident.
notes: From the protagonist of "My Name is Joe" it seemed legitimate to expect a film a la Loach, but one remains displaced, and gradually more intrigued and finally conquered, by the surreal turn that takes the path of the four brothers. Mullan knows where he is going, and fuses with vigorous Scottish personality Leigh, Terence Davies, something (not really) of Loach, with the mocking paradoxes of the Scottish master Alexander Mackendrick and the unrealistic lightness of certain Michael Powell plays.

title: Ferdinando e Carolina
actors: Sergio Assisi, Gabriella Pession, Nicole Grimaudo, Adriano Pantaleo, Elio Pandolfi
description: The old King Ferdinand is assailed by remorse and hallucinations and takes refuge in memory. Thus begins the re-enactment of his youth, his gallant adventures and his marriage to Carolina.
notes: The taste of the story that, however, Lina Wertmüller has always had seems lost, watered down by the unbearable narration in voiceover and by the sumptuous and showy waste of vintage objects. The film is boring, repetitive, episodic, all Neapolitans look like caricatures and the Austrian court speaks like Krantz of Germany. Unbearable when he pretends to open a glimpse of "black" politics, hateful in wide angles, fake from start to finish.

title: A Civil Action
actors: John Travolta, Robert Duvall, Stephen Fry, James Gandolfini
description: Jan Schlichtmann is a successful personal injury lawyer, a man who prides himself on winning lawsuits and takes pride in his Porsche. But his life changes one day when he has to defend eight families in Woburn, Massachusetts, who, due to industrial waste from two companies, have lost their children to leukemia. Most of the lawyers in his college would not have accepted such a case, but Jan decides to get involved Fr.
notes: The story is true, its protagonists "still alive" and, for the record, the civilian in question had quite a few problems. The film, directed with far too much elegance by the screenwriter of "Schindler's List", therefore comes as a good last after countless hearings, a couple of trials and the inevitable best seller. A fine word that contrasts the crude pragmatism of the strong who offer a handful of billions as a brutal amnesty, to an ambitious (and presumptuous) ideal that, instead, first of all asked for a simple forgiveness. The pure in spirit will cheer on the second axiom. Cinephiles for the first time, thanks to a huge Robert Duvall nominated for an Oscar for the awkward role.

title: Milonga
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Claudia Pandolfi, Carlo Cecchi, Vanessa Gravina, Yvonne Sciò
description: A well-known face of television is killed in broad daylight in the streets of Rome. At first glance, it seems that the culprit is a mythomaniac, but in reality a much more complex truth is hidden behind the murder. An apparently irreproachable commissioner takes charge of the investigations, but deeply marked by his gay personality ...
notes: Enveloped by the slow and sensual rhythm of a milonga, Emidio Greco _ (The invention of Morel, Ehrengard) _ measures his pace: not as a dancer, but as a refined and cultured director, in a thriller «not pursued as a project but crossed for case".

title: New Rose Hotel
actors: Willem Dafoe, Asia Argento, Christopher Walken, Yoshitaka Amano
description: In a future dominated by multinationals in constant war with each other, Sandii, a bad girl is hired by the Americans to seduce Hiroshi, a Japanese scientist. The intention is to remove Hiroshi from the family, kidnap him and steal a precious formula from him.
notes: The new film from Ferrara, drips charm and ambiguity in every shot: Walken, Satan in white, leads (or rather thinks he leads) the ballet of souls: Dafoe, the lost angel, is overwhelmed by the ambiguous sensuality of Asia Argento, who has nice clothes but cheap accessories. For once, however, the charm of the images is not enough to complete the film. In "New Rose Hotel" a thesis, an idea, a narrative closure seem to be missing (apart from the "trick" of the final shooting of clips and flashes, as if to build a theory of vision). It seems to be missing "the edge", "the spark" evoked by Walken: the virtue of hitting the mark.

title: GialloParma
actors: Natacha Amal, Robert Hossein, Kaspar Capparoni, Brontis Jodorowsky
description: The beautiful Margot returns to Parma to take revenge for abuse and humiliation, while Judge Bocchi investigates and does everything to keep an ancient desire intact. The intended victim of Margot's orchestrated revenge is Giulio, a disgraced seducer. Carboni is the ambiguous loan shark, while Minotti is the coarse group leader of the corrupt who maneuver in the shadows.
notes: Bevilacqua closes his trilogy on Parma, inaugurated with "La Califfa", and continued with "This kind of love". The characters in this showdown full of meanings, inspired by the director's novel of the same name, are many, and each one has his own stereotype to wear as a paraphrase of crime news and to be expressed with jokes written in the sand of literature. The density of fictional writing generates dull images and a motionless staging.

title: Tokyo Eyes
actors: Shinji Takeda, Ai Takada, Takeshi Kitano, Hinano Yoshikawa
description: Every day a boy, nicknamed Quattrocchi because of his large lenses, goes to the center of Tokyo and, armed with a gun, shoots his victims missing them. The mysterious character intends to scare his targets, found guilty of some reprehensible act.
notes: If you can get through the first ten minutes of a dubbing that desperately runs after the high tones of a modulation a thousand miles away from Western expressions, "Tokio Eyes" can be a fascinating experience. Director Limosin manages to represent a complex reality, mixing fictional scenes with stolen sequences, very different sounds and experimental glimpses that crumble the codes of genre cinema (the film is a sui generis thriller).

title: Gli sbandati
actors: Lucia Bosé, Isa Miranda, Jean-Pierre Mocky, Goliarda Sapienza
description: In 1943 the Countess Luisa, her son Andrea, Carlo, Andrea's cousin and son of a fascist hierarch and Ferruccio, a family friend, found themselves in a villa not far from Milan to escape the bombings. Young people try to spend their time in the best possible way. Of the three only Carlo is aware of the social travail of the moment. The arrival of a displaced worker and a group of disbanded soldiers snatch Andrea from his reckless light-heartedness.
notes: Maselli makes a refined but slightly bloodless psychological film about the ruling classes on 8 September. Fine direction of the actors and (as they say) beautiful photography. Small parts for Mario Girotti (future Terence Hill) and Dori Ghezzi as a child.

title: Cantami 'Buongiorno tristezza'
actors: Giacomo Rondinella, Arnoldo Foà, Milly Vitale
description: Giovanna, a beautiful girl, employed in a medicine factory, is engaged to Sergio, her workmate. Marco, son of the owner of the company, who fell in love with her, simulates the theft of a quantity of morphine and causes Sergio to be accused. Marco induces Giovanna to leave her boyfriend and she accepts with difficulty, convinced in this way to save the man she loves. Meanwhile Sergio, who has a passion for theater and who has been fired, accepts the writing offered him by an impresario who saw him perform at the corporate Cral. When Marco's father realizes that Giovanna is pregnant, he forces his son to marry her.

title: Voci nel tempo
actors: Attori non professionisti
description: The passing of the seasons in the Mantuan town of Castellaro follow the seasons of the life of its inhabitants. So alongside the games of childhood, the first disappointments, the dances in the barnyard, the thwarted loves, the happy wedding and the nostalgia for the receding youth, life is always the same with television as the only companion. The arrival of autumn with its unexpected rains changes the lives of the people of the town as the river flows inexorably. The first snow of winter whitens the roofs of the houses and invites children to play on the frozen lake.
notes: An essay film that rejects the narrative form to indulge only in poetry, exploiting forgotten pieces of the Italian province and listening (without soundtrack) to the passage of time.

title: The Jerk
actors: Steve Martin, Bernadette Peters, Catlin Adams, Mabel King, Richard Ward
description: The adopted son of two black farmers, Navin leaves his beloved family to seek his fortune when he begins to be old enough to face the world. Hired at Harry Hartounian's gas station, Navin is in trouble. But, at the same time, he manages to fix the glasses of a customer who is admired by the technique adopted so much that he decides to adopt it, patent it and launch it on the market. Success is huge. First role for Steve Martin, in a decent comedy film directed by a specialist.

title: Rupan sansei: Rupan ansatsu shirei
description: Zenigata is removed from the "Lupine case" to offer it to Keith, a professional killer. But the inspector is given the special mission of destroying the Shotshell, an organization of arms traffickers. Lupine III has several purposes: to steal the money of the traffickers, destroy the Shotshell on behalf of Zenigata, and thus have the old inspector return the task of the Lupine III case. To be contacted by Shotshell, Lupine III and the others steal a Russian submarine, the Ivanov, with the somewhat forced collaboration of Karen, the scientist who designed it.

title: Baysikelran
actors: Moharram Zeynalsadeh
description: Nassim's wife is hospitalized and needs a very expensive surgery. Following a proposal made to him by a street entertainment organizer, Nassim agrees to ride a bicycle for a whole week, day and night, on a square, in order to attract as many people as possible. The goal is to raise the amount of bets and thus obtain the necessary amount for the intervention.

title: La canzone del cuore
actors: Marisa Merlini, Milly Vitale, Alberto Farnese, Dante Maggio
description: Lucia, widowed, with her little daughter Ornella who is not in good health, sings in a night club to get by. The mother-in-law, always opposed to the wedding, does not want to know about the sister-in-law and granddaughter. One day a theft is committed in the night club, Lucia is blamed and arrested. Sandro, childhood companion of Lucia's deceased husband, who had sought a rapprochement between Lucia and her mother-in-law, takes advantage of his imprisonment to take Ornella to her grandmother.
notes: Weepy drama as it was in fashion in the 1950s, muddled and mellow.

title: Little Men
actors: Mariel Hemingway, Chris Sarandon, Michael Caloz, Ben Cook
description: Jo, the heroine who animated the novel "Little Women", manages to get married with Professor Bhaer and together with him decides to found a small school based in Plumfield, in the house that his young wife inherited from old Aunt March. Nat and Dan, two little boys who spend their lives in the streets of the city, find refuge in the school, where, little by little, they learn to bring out the best side of their character. TV version without polish of one of the sequels to the novel "Little Women".

title: Murphy's Romance
actors: Sally Field, James Garner, Brian Kerwin, Corey Haim
description: She is a 35-year-old who, at some point in her marriage, decides it's over. So he thinks about moving elsewhere together with his little son. He then leaves the city to go and live in a small town in Arizona, where he meets an intolerant, slightly misogynistic widower who runs the village pharmacy. Many misunderstandings will arise, some spite and even misunderstandings. Explain which, of course, what was supposed to happen will happen ...
notes: Pleasant comedy, with a good rhythm. The interpreters are also very good. Above all stands out James Garner received his first Oscar nomination.

title: Spy Hard
actors: Leslie Nielsen, Nicolette Sheridan, Charles Durning
description: To save the life of Agent 3.14 (who is the daughter of the woman he loved), secret agent 0014 Sex De Fer must free her from the evil and terrible Rancor. But his mission is not only, so to speak, humanitarian: he must also be able to prevent Rancor from using a tremendous missile, which could destroy half the planet.
notes: James Bond parody. But, perhaps, it is not enough to put together a handful of cinephile references to have an appreciable product. Anyway, it giggles. A curiosity: in the opening credits, a funny Shirley Bassett appears.

title: Riders of the Purple Sage
actors: Ed Harris, Amy Madigan, Robin Tunney, Norbert Weisser
description: Hard work on the ranch, especially when it is a woman groped to carry on everything, steadfast in command. Among the many difficulties, the environment also has its weight. To complicate the existence, in fact, of the protagonist but also of other characters, a tangle of not exactly orthodox religiosity (and the cult is obviously linked to the figure of the devil) and the presence of a mysterious man who dispenses his justice. Based on a short story by Zane Gray, scripted by Gill Dennis, this cable TV movie is produced by the two lead stars, Ed Harris and Amy Madigan, who are actually husband and wife. Nothing original (it has been since Tom Mix that films have been made from this story) but the packaging is decent.

title: Kanzo Sensei
actors: Akira Emoto, Kumiko Aso, Jyuro Kara, Jacques Gamblin
description: Summer 1945. On the eve of the Japanese defeat, in a climate of growing tension, the fifty-year-old doctor Akagi works as a doctor in the town of Tamano. Due to his excessive zeal, the conscientious doctor soon became the laughing stock of the city and earned the nickname Doctor Liver because he believes all of his patients suffer from liver disease. And indeed most of the population suffers from hepatitis.
notes: The film manages to combine an imposing and disturbing theme such as that of mutation, of disease with the rhythm and surreal tones of comedy. In a world that runs on the edge of the abyss, Dr. Akagi's community has a paradoxical and moving resistance and solidarity. And it is no coincidence that, when the abyss opens up, it happens in poetry.

title: Ormai è fatta!
actors: Stefano Accorsi, Emilio Solfrizzi, Giovanni Esposito, Antonio Catania
description: Horst Fantazzini, a former gentleman robber, on 23 July 1973 attempts to escape from the Fossano prison where he is detained for having carried out an incredible number of robberies with a toy gun. Anarchist, Horst claimed responsibility for robberies by making Brecht's phrase his own: "It is more criminal to found a bank than to rob it".
notes: The screenwriter Monteleone, in his second directorial test, discovered the book written by the same protagonist on a stall, fell in love with this absurd story and brought it, with the usual directional hesitation of "directors by chance", to the screen . The film, all played on a fateful day in July '73, when Fantazzini tried in vain to escape from prison by keeping two security guards in check, would aspire to "That afternoon of a dog's day", but it only makes sense. Bravo, however, Stefano Accorsi.

title: Eight Millimeter
actors: Nicolas Cage, Joaquin Phoenix, James Gandolfini, Peter Stormare
description: Tom Welles is a reliable and efficient private investigator who specializes in stalking cheating wives and husbands, looking forward to the big breakthrough to get his career off the ground. A harmless reel falls into his hand that will make him discover the darkest and most terrifying aspects of the reality that surrounds him. The video shows a girl shot in a "snuff movie", that is a porn film in which the killing of the unwitting protagonist is filmed.
notes: That of the "snuff" in reality is perhaps just a chilling urban legend, but in the film it drags the protagonist into a circle of hell, and in the end he also has to deal with his own demons. Schumacher confirms his reputation as an honest filmmaker, but unfortunately he does not have the keys to the casket of Nicolas Cage's acting art, which apparently only David Lynch and Brian De Palma possess.

title: Bure baruta
actors: Miki Manojlovic, Lazar Ristovski, Mirjana Jokovic, Ana Sofrenovic, Sergej Trifunovic
description: Boris is a boxer who after missing his train roams the city in hopes of returning home. Mane who, as soon as he has landed from abroad, is determined to return to his hometown, Ana who seduces the passengers on the bus he takes every morning. And then there is Kosta, Natalia and all the others who believe they have their lives in their hands, but, in reality, they are all victims.
notes: Paskaljevic knows how to clearly show us his country, the war that is already over, and the one that would come, the one that continues ... An accident is enough to unleash a chain of repercussions that nobody knows how to stop. Everyone has got used to it, no one can stay out of pain, doing it or suffering it. Anthropological curse, anger that comes from afar, small daily resentments. Eventually, the Cabaret Balkan actor drinks, wickedly to our health. A very hard, sarcastic, unsustainable film, right.

title: Voglio stare sotto al letto
actors: Bruno Colella, Rocco Papaleo, Giorgio Pasotti, Michelle Hunziker
description: Leonardo, a young author and theater director, contacts an old comedian to have him interpret one of his plays. The actor accepts and puts him in contact with Calise, a producer he trusts. The producer, after having slept for a good part of the reading of the script, declares himself available. Now it is a question of reaching the comedian and trouble begins for Leonardo.
notes: The canvas that the director, screenwriter and interpreter has pinned on a piece of paper is functional to infuriating fourth-rate Neapolitan farce skits, photocopied on film. After the "camera" film, the wretched Italian cinema performs in the "automobile" film. Actors with the panache of the mannequins in the window. Michelle Hunziker gives herself her superfluous film debut.

title: Sesso e volentieri
actors: Johnny Dorelli, Laura Antonelli, Gloria Guida, Giuliana Calandra
description: Episode movies. "The Princess and the Waiter": after having managed to get into the good graces of a beautiful princess, a waiter is constantly disturbed by his bodyguards. "Lady Jane": A suitor tries to get the wife of a petomaniac minister out of trouble. "Domenica in": many spectators remain with their hands clasped over their heads, a consequence of Giucas Casella's unsuccessful experiment. And then "La nuova Marisa" (who would be a prostitute), "Radio Taxi", "Rasoio all'antica" (a jealous barber), "Weapon and the violinist", "Honeymoon" (a sheik seduces her husband of a young couple).
notes: Dino Risi signs a bleak film, a bad copy of the old "Sessomatto". Enrico Vanzina collaborated on the screenplay.

title: While the City Sleeps
actors: Dana Andrews, Rhonda Fleming, Sally Forest, Thomas Mitchell
description: Amos Kyne, owner of a very famous newspaper, suddenly dies. The son, who inherited his father's company, decides to appoint a general manager. There are three possible candidates: Kritzer, head of photographers, Loving, director of a news agency and Griffith, director of the "New York Sentinel" which is part of the Kyne jr. Chain. The heir, spoiled for choice, decides to offer the position of general manager to whoever of the three will discover the killer of a young woman.
notes: Fritz Lang's penultimate American film is one of his best, it uses the yellow scheme to arrive at an investigation into the nature of man. An absolute pessimism pervades the film, in the investigation of investigators and journalists, to the point of rendering an infernal fresco.

title: Les Misérables
actors: Liam Neeson, Geoffrey Rush, Uma Thurman, Claire Danes
description: After spending nearly twenty years of forced labor for a minor offense, Jean Valjean is released on parole. Embittered by the violence suffered in prison, Jean has become a cheat forced to live by expedients, expecting only cruelty from others. His encounter with the Bishop who treats him as a human being leaves him shocked. But Jean steals his silverware and runs away.
notes: Bille August is the only one to have won, without merit and twice, in Cannes. Victor Hugo's formidable fictional device becomes an old sticker album, drowned in a light with the hallmark of auteur cinema. Expenditure of carriages, extras, costumes, scenographic reworkings (Paris rebuilt in Prague).

title: Mafia
actors: Olympia Dukakis, Lloyd Bridges, Jay Mohr, Billy Burke, Pamela Gidley
description: The young and innocent Vincenzo Cortino is taken from his home in Sicily and forced to swim to the United States to fulfill the role of ruthless patriarch of a powerful mafia family. By now on the threshold of old age, Vincenzo must decide which of his two sons to hand over the reins of power: to the psychopath Joey or to Anthony, a heroic veteran of the Vietnam War.
notes: The noble, epic and bloodthirsty vein celebrated by Francis Coppola (the three chapters of the Godfather) and by Martin Scorsese ("Casino") becomes a repertoire to be mocked in a very fast blend of quotes, casts, delirious or simply stupid jokes. The doting patriarch is Lloyd Bridges, who passed away in 1999, the patriarch's mother is the devastating petomaniac Olympia Dukakis. Decerebrate, physiological and, here and there, fun.

title: L'ultimo mundial
actors: Angelo Orlando, Armando De Razza, Alessandro Haber, Francesca Ponziani
description: Gianantoniomaria Casarotti is a center forward who, in an attempt to put the ball into the net, while trying to watch a beautiful girl passing by on the sidelines, crashed into the goal post. Many tried to wake him up, but only the girl succeeds in the enterprise. Suddenly back to life, the striker begins to tell meaningless stories.
notes: In front of films like this one must raise their hands and declare their inadequacy: surreal, dreamlike or lysergic comedy? Maybe it's just an unlikely comedy. The worlds of '82 and '98, unlikely Spanish and Moroccan lands, pool cards, movie quotes and the songs of Mino Reitano, are intertwined in the delusions told by the boy that really put the spectator's patience to the test.

title: The Hi-Lo Country
actors: Woody Harrelson, Billy Crudup, Patricia Arquette, Penélope Cruz
description: In the town of Hi-Lo in New Mexico, Pete Calder and Big Boy Matson, close friends and comrades in arms in World War II meet again. The two, after the war interlude, return to their usual lifestyle: they raise livestock and work the land. Pete learns that Ramona, the woman he always wanted, is now married to another man. So Pete just has to go back to his girlfriend with whom he was a steady couple before leaving for the front. But when he finds out that Ramona is having a torrid affair with Big Boy, Pete returns to the assault.
notes: Sam Peckinpah has been trying to do it for years: "The Hi-Lo Country", a very late western (it is set in Hi-Lo, New Mexico, just after the Second World War) based on the novel written in 1961 by Max Evans. He died before he was able to acquire the rights, and now, through producers Martin Scorsese and Barbara De Fina, the ball has passed to Stephen Frears, an Englishman capable of working in America and capturing the spirit of certain genres with deaf authenticity. The film is a modern western that takes the mello temptation that has often manifested itself in the genre and that Peckinpah (but also Nicholas Ray, King Vidor and Sam Fuller) explored to its extreme consequences. Western sunset, marked, chromatically by huge red skies, by the rain and snow that decimate the herds of the last cowboys.

title: Voglio bene soltanto a te
actors: Beniamino Gigli, Tino Scotti, Greta Gonda, Luigi Almirante
description: The famous tenor Enzo Curti, returning from a long and triumphal tour outside, returns to Italy where he is hired by a production company that entrusts him with the role of protagonist in a film. Together with him, the young diva Dady Lux and a certain Baldi, secretly in love with her, act. Enzo also makes a merciless court to Dady, who does not disdain the attentions of Baldi and Pasqualino, secretary of the tenor. Film-pretext for Gigli's performances, backed by the garrulous Scotti. Forgetful and naive.

title: Pleasantville
actors: Tobey Maguire, Reese Witherspoon, Joan Allen, William H. Macy, Jeff Daniels, Marley Shelton
description: Two teenagers, brother and sister, from a typical nineties family, break the television and are therefore forced to call a technician. But the technician has magical powers and the two boys end up in their favorite soap opera "Pleasantiville", set in the city of the same name. To the citizens they bring as a gift the imagination of the unexpected and the power of love.
notes: Ross - between "The purple rose of Cairo" and "Back to the future" - reveals the background of the Fonziani "Happy Days", quotes Truffaut from "Fahrenheit 451" and unhinges, without mercy, the golden aura within which the fifties they have undeservedly (re) lived for decades. A lucid revenge on the part of a victim of McCarthyism (the anti-communism fanatics ruined his existence to Ross's father, screenwriter himself) to whom, more than television, frightens - rightly - the conformity of the conversation.

title: Penn & Teller Get Killed
actors: Penn Jillette, Teller, Caitlin Clarke, Jon Cryer
description: Penn Jillette and the Muto Teller are business partners: they live by making shows of truculent illusionism. They also happened to the point of being invited to a television program, during which Penn lets herself go to an unsafe joke. In other words, he says that he would hear a real thrill, only if someone threatened him with death. Forgetting that there is some psychopath between the television audience it is unlikely ...
notes: In truth, the analysis of television as a tool for amplification of reality and as a stupid world in which things lose meaning, is not new. However, Penn manages to add some original touch.

title: Star in the Dust
actors: John Agar, Mamie Van Doren, Richard Boom
description: Sam Hall committed three murders on behalf of a group of cattle ranchers, led by banker George Ballard. For this reason he is imprisoned, tried and sentenced to death. Of course the breeders want to prevent the execution and organize an escape. Which succeeds but fails: Hall is caught and put back in prison by the sheriff. Meanwhile, Hall's evil disposition appears to everyone, including his principals: no one, in any case, will regret his death.
notes: An artisanal product that is memorable only in the appearance, in the role of a cowboy, of a very young Clint Eastwood.

title: L'Année sainte
actors: Jean Gabin, Jean-Claude Brialy, Danielle Darrieux, Nicoletta Machiavelli
description: Two no longer young bandits go to Rome to recover the proceeds of an old coup. But they do not think they are well informed before arriving in the Eternal City, where the celebrations of the Holy Year are taking place. The two, however, know how to turn the situation to the best, wearing religious robes.
notes: A yellow comedy that exploits certain notations of a genre that has had a good following and decent authors in France. The great Jean Gabin would die in a few months.

title: Psycho
actors: Vince Vaughn, Anne Heche, Viggo Mortensen, William H. Macy
description: Marion, employed in a real estate company, flees the city to join her boyfriend with a large sum stolen from a client. Before reaching her boyfriend's house, she has the unfortunate idea of ??staying overnight in a motel run by Norman, a strange guy oppressed by his mother's authoritarian character. While taking a shower she is brutally killed by a mysterious killer who suddenly appears behind the waxed towel of the shower.
notes: A philological operation in the strict sense, that of Gus Van Sant: redoing "Psycho", practically shot by shot, camera movement by camera movement; in fact the visual construction of Hitchcock's terrifying special effects (the broken montage of the shower scene, the zoom plus trolley of Arbogast's fall), made electronically in the new version, is identical. So Anne Heche (always a bit annoyingly first of the class) and Vaughn (good) mimic the interpretations of Leigh and Perkins. As for the color, the choice of Van Sant and director of photography Chris Doyle has correctly fallen on the tones of the Fifties, such as "To Catch a Thief" or "North by Northwest". Precisely because it is identical to the first (except for a couple of inserts and a hint of masturbation), "Psycho" is beautiful and pop.

title: Food of the Gods II
actors: Paul Coufos, Lisa Schrage, Réal Andrews, Stuart Hughes, Karen Hines
description: Dr. Hamilton has created in the laboratory a very particular hormone that could increase the productivity of food crops, but when some guinea pigs eat a tomato subjected to the treatment, he discovers that they suffer an uncontrollable deception process. Some time, some students who staged a protest event against vivisection, break into the laboratory and, inadvertently, free mutant mice. The animals flee the impazzate and find refuge in the sewers of the university campus ... soon, however, they return to the open in search of food ...

title: The Beast from 20000 Fathoms
actors: Paul Hubschmid, Paula Raymond, Cecil Kellaway
description: Following an Arctic nuclear experiment, a carnivorous dinosaur "resurrects" and starts walking, approaching the east coast of North America. Professor Tom Nesbitt, the only one who has seen the dinosaur in person, is not believed, although he is able to specify that it is a "rhedosaururs". However, to support his testimony, a fellow scientist intervenes, the paleontologist Thurgood Elson. In addition, the dinosaur emerges from the sea just in front of the island of Manhattan. One of the founding films of American monster cinema, with the exhortation of the brilliant stop-motion animator Ray Harryhausen.

title: Trackdown
actors: James Mitchum, Karen Lamm, Anne Archer, Erik Estrada
description: From her Montana home, a young girl decides to leave to try her luck in the big city. Thus ends up in Los Angeles, where, of course, he finds himself like a lamb among the wolves. Her older brother, after waiting in vain for her on his ranch, leaves in turn. It won't be easy to find. Moreover, after long searches, when finally because the girl is identified, it will not be easy to bring her back home, since she has stumbled upon a circle of crime and exploitation. Mitchum is the talentless son of MItchum, the story is taken for granted.

title: Wrongfully Accused
actors: Leslie Nielsen, Kelly LeBrock, Richard Crenna
description: Ryan Harrison, violin virtuoso, is involved in a torrid love affair with the fatal and wealthy Lauren Goodhue. The woman's main purpose is to eliminate her husband, a mad criminal, a tycoon of a company that makes mobile phones, who has devised a plan to kill the secretary general of the United Nations. Ryan is charged with murder, jailed and sentenced to death, but manages to escape.
notes: Parody that relentlessly steals gags, phrases and situations from various hits in the history of cinema. From the "Fugitive" he borrows the name (Harrison as Ford) and the skeleton of the plot; from "Mission: Impossible" the secret agent who drops from the ceiling to evade the alarm systems; from "Titanic", the hug on the bow. Nielsen gives the feeling of having a great time, jumping - with surreal levity - from one situation to another and shooting Groucho Marx-worthy jokes. Among the original inventions, an airbag that opens in the instant of an orgasm, a lacing of strings passed as a fellatio and a bra with an elastic that becomes a boomerang.

title: Il guerriero Camillo
actors: Claudio Bigagli, Carlo Croccolo, Marco Messeri, Carlo Monni, Valeria Sabel, Fabrizia Sacchi
description: Camillo is a candid and innocent thirty-year-old who does not speak, sees the world in black and white and lives with two elderly puppeteers who picked him up who knows where. Camillo is a dreamer convinced that he comes from distant worlds, perhaps from the Middle Ages: he likes to wear armor and helmets and go into the woods to fight his very private battles. His best friend is a Down boy, son of the town marshal, the only one who seems to listen to the nonsense of the man who, for many, is just the classic village idiot. But, suddenly, Camillo's adoptive parents die and with them, also the court of friends that gravitated around.
notes: The small town in the Carrarese area where the story unfolds is not Pleasantville, but the madness that pervades it is identical. An Italian debut "elsewhere".

title: Nudo di donna
actors: Nino Manfredi, Eleonora Giorgi, Carlo Bagno, George Wilson
description: After sixteen years of marriage, Sandro is no longer able to reconcile his spontaneous and lively character with that of his wife Laura, a cultured and poised Venetian woman. The umpteenth fight pushes him to leave her and find refuge at the house of a painter friend. Among his many paintings, he sees one depicting a naked woman, with an incredible resemblance to his wife.
notes: Manfredi is looking for the key to open the doors of the female universe through the internal contrasts of the male one, but, in the end, the suspicion arises that he has not found either.

title: Phase IV
actors: Nigel Davenport, Lynne Frederick, Michael Murphy, Helen Horton
description: An invasion of killer ants is bringing death and destruction to Arizona. Trying to counter their advance is a scientist, who, in a futuristic station, tries to study the deadly genetic combination that created them. But the destructive force of nature is unstoppable ...
notes: The "king" of cinematic design Saul Bass (author of the graphics for many opening titles by Hitchcock and Preminger), here in his first feature film, proves he knows how to do it, with a careful direction focused on man's great fear of nature. Do not miss the beautiful documentary inserts signed by Ken Middleton.

title: Il gigante di Metropolis
actors: Gordon Mitchell, Bella Cortez, Roldano Lupi, Liana Orfei
description: In 20,000 BC a caravan of the brave tries to reach the city of Metropolis to stop the madness of the tyrant Yotar. To reach the middle is only Obro, an intrepid young man, who fights to save the inhabitants of the city from the terrible experiments of the king, eager to save his nephew by "grafting" him a new brain. Meanwhile, astronomers and scientists in the city predict a frightening cataclysm.
notes: Mediocre Italian attempt to copy Hollywood science fiction blockbusters. There is very little to save, despite the hints of ironic discourse on science.

title: La ladra
actors: Fausto Tozzi, Carlo D'Angelo, Lise Bourdin, Memmo Carotenuto, Piero Giagnoni
description: Whistle, a little rascal without a family, is entrusted by a dishonest lawyer to Nino, a criminal, who wants to use him for a heist. Something, however, goes wrong: Whistle is injured when he falls from a chimney, while Nino runs away with the rich booty. Anna, Nino's woman, will come to Whistle's aid, pretend to be his mother, and save him from prison. But when the police find all the stolen goods hidden in the woman's house, they will have no hesitation in holding her responsible ...
notes: A small drama well interpreted especially by the young protagonist and with a splendid Lise Bourdin.

title: This Child Is Mine
actors: Lindsay Wagner, Chris Sarandon, Michael Lerner
description: Two successful, happily married professionals want to have a child, but their every attempt is a failure. They decide, after a rather painful decision, to adopt one. After a long bureaucratic process, they manage to be entrusted with a child. Everything seems to be going well, when the baby's birth mother suddenly reappears, claiming custody of her daughter. Thus begins a tough legal battle fought within the cold walls of a courtroom, which will lead everyone to lose sight of the true objective of the issue: the happiness of the child.

title: Dancin' throu the dark
actors: Julian Littman, Ben Murphy, Claire Hackett, Conrad Nelson
description: Linda and Dave are getting married, but first they have an evening of their own, to spend with their respective friends. Two bachelor parties, one for men only, the other for women only, which is consumed in a long, interminable night, spent in the dark alleys of the Liverpool worker. Everything happens, but in the end you have to get back down to earth, open a chapter of your life and close another.
notes: New, free, independent, English cinema. The director, Mike Ockrent, is a rookie who proves to know his stuff, but the strength of the film is the cast, heterogeneous and sensitive to the different facets of the many roles.

title: The Matrix
actors: Keanu Reeves, Laurence Fishburne, Carrie-Anne Moss, Hugo Weaving
description: Neo is convinced that there are two very distinct realities: one represented by the existence we lead every day, the other hidden and not accessible to everyone. Neo intends to uncover the truth about the Matrix - something people don't want to talk about, a mysterious and unknown entity wielding sinister power over its very existence. But what is the Matrix? Neo thinks that the only man who can answer his questions is Morpheus, a strange character whose strange episodes are told. But it will be the meeting with Trinity to reveal the mystery of the Matrix.
notes: The charm of this optical fiber musical is in the ingenious mix of genres and styles, of atmospheres and moods: John Woo, Bruce Lee, a bit of Bruckheimer's Touch, manga comics, Asimov and Gibson, special effects that reset the albeit a recent phantasmagoric past. And above all in the radical, socio-Cartesian doubt that it instills in the viewer: might we not already be all in a "Matrix"?

title: At First Sight
actors: Mira Sorvino, Val Kilmer, Kelly McGillis, Bruce Davison
description: Virgil Adamson is a blind masseur who falls in love with an ecological New York architect. The woman manages to convince him to undergo yet another surgery in the hope of making him regain the sight lost for three years. The operation succeeds, but only halfway: man has just the time to look the things of life in the face, before falling back into darkness.
notes: A real-life story borrowed from Oliver Sacks, former doctor-instigator for "Awakenings". From the series "those who do not see see better and those who have eyes to cry see worse", the semidrammone recalls Colonel Buttiglione: he never stops, not even in the face of evidence. The craving for underlining, for the use and consumption of the distracted television audience, precipitates, after a quarter of an hour, interests: passive and active.

title: Lulu on the Bridge
actors: Harvey Keitel, Mira Sorvino, Willem Dafoe, Gina Gershon
description: Izzy is a saxophonist whose life changed dramatically the day he was hit by a stray bullet during a night out in a New York club. Some time passes and while he is walking in the Manhattan neighborhood he stumbles upon the corpse of a stranger. In the bag he finds next to the body, he finds a handkerchief with a phone number and a box with a mysterious stone. The number leads him to a certain Celia, a young actress ...
notes: First directed by Paul Auster, after the screenplay of "Smoke" and the screenplay and co-direction of "Blue in the Face", the film seems to start with the usual, quiet minimalism of the New York writer. Then, however, the story gets tangled up on itself, putting on flashes of a desired and never reached world, almost an afterlife, arrives in a blue Dublin, between kidnappings and interrogations of a mysterious "angel". The "parapsychological" implication is not original, nor mastered by Auster, who actually thought the story for Wim Wenders.

title: La femme défendue
actors: Isabelle Carré, Philippe Harel, Nathalie Conio, Sophie Niedergang
description: Francois is thirty-nine years old and married, Muriel is twenty-two years old, she is beautiful and has a sly face. She tries in every way to resist the ruthless court that François makes, she evades. Of course it will eventually capitulate.
notes: Hidden from the camera - the whole film is shot in subjective - the male protagonist, played, to make the relationship even more dangerous and theoretically fetishist by Philippe Harel, director and screenwriter of the film, pursues his strategy of courtship and conquest without accompanying characters or sub-texts that can distract from the story of a passion like many others, of an ordinary adultery with its sudden défaillance. Viewers are locked up and forced into unwanted identification in this "first person" syntax.

title: True Crime
actors: Clint Eastwood, James Woods, Isaiah Washington, Bernard Hill, Diane Venora
description: An elderly reporter, womanizer, with a nose for news and dirty games, is detoxifying himself from alcohol. The renewed clarity, together with the death of a young colleague who was on the trail of a colossal judicial error, awakens his sixth sense. There are a few hours left before the execution of a black man sentenced to death for murder; maybe he's not guilty.
notes: In the calibrated montage between the reporter's erratic daily life and the condemned man's last hours, the pace of the film progressively increases, culminating in a priceless dialogue in pure comedy style between the reporter Eastwood and the editor of the newspaper James Woods, it becomes breathless in the last hours and minutes. A minor Eastwood; but more elegant, direct and engaging than many of the similar films. Above all, a certain, lonely melancholy.

title: Russian Roulette
actors: George Segal, Cristina Raines, Bo Brundin, Denholm Elliott
description: On the eve of an official visit to Vancouver by Russian Prime Minister Kosygin, the CIA instructs agent Tim Shaver to remove from the scene for a while the Lithuanian Henke, whose family was exterminated by the Soviets and strongly suspected of wanting to carry out a attack. But someone, the KGB spies, beat Tom on time and kidnap Henke. The American agent, however, discovers that, in reality, the Russian secret services are using Henke to get rid of Kosygin.
notes: Good action scenes and nice Segal. The direction does not shine for originality.

title: Kutabare! Nastradamus
description: Having landed the last, impossible blow, a giant diamond stolen in Rio de Janeiro, Lupine III plans to take possession of Nostradamus' lost prophecies. The book, an ancient manuscript valued at an incredible $ 50 million, is kept at the Douglas Foundation, an inaccessible building. The only one to have violated the security systems is Fifì, the uncle of Lupine III. So our nice hero leaves to reveal the tricks to succeed in the enterprise. Fifì will prove to be quite a tough nut to crack, but don't worry, thanks to the help of his inseparable friends Lupine III will once again be able to mock everyone ...

title: The Craft
actors: Fairuza Balk, Robin Tunney, Neve Campbell, Rachel True
description: Sarah, Nancy, Bonnie and Rochelle are four students from Los Angeles. All grappling with the daily problems typical of their age, they are unleashed when they discover that they possess supernatural powers: they will begin to use them without limits, each to take revenge on those who have done it or are making it suffer and to fulfill wishes kept in the depths of their hearts. . But it won't last long ...
notes: Beyond the four protagonists and a not very original story lies the light and precise direction of Fleming _ (Friends for fun, friends for sex_ and _The girls of the white house) _. It's definitely not enough, but it's still better than nothing.

title: The House
actors: Francisco Nascimiento, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Leos Carax
description: Inside the "house", a boy wanders bewildered from one room to another, meeting old people, young naked women and characters of all kinds. He then arrives in the dining room, where some people are having a meal in a devastated setting. But the corridors of the villa are populated with other strange figures ...
notes: Faithful to his style, the Lithuanian Bartas creates a hypnotic and in his own way rigorous film, but also exhausting for excesses of stylization. Long sequence shots lead the viewer through the meanders of this mysterious but not always hospitable "house-film". Among the diners there is also the French director Leos Carax.

title: Prestami tua moglie
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Janet Agren, Daniela Poggi, Claudine Auger
description: Alex Fortini, a southern transplanted to Milan, separated from his wife Ingrid for five years, lives with Diana, a very wealthy woman who owns an advertising agency. One day, she suddenly comes back to ask for a divorce. Fearing that the woman has some financial claim, Alex pretends to be a poor fellow.
notes: Varied cast with Massimo Boldi and Diego Abatantuono in supporting roles, but the comedy is very well known.

title: À vendre
actors: Sergio Castellitto, Sandrine Kiberlain, Jean-François Stévenin, Aurore Clément, Chiara Mastroianni
description: In front of the church where Lindien's wedding should be celebrated, there are many people curious to see a guy like him get married. But there's a problem. France Robert, betrothed, ran away with a purse containing five hundred thousand francs. What does Lindien know about his future wife? Virtually nothing. The investigator in charge of finding her, Luigi Primo, will have to settle for somewhat fragmentary information: that the woman is an orphan, was born in the Champagne region and has a passion for running ...
notes: The story is made up of puzzles, like an investigative film: little by little we discover why France has flown away; then we understand why the Italian detective no longer wants to eat. Second film - the first was awarded a "César" as "best first film" - for the new couple of French cinema, Masson & Kiberlaine.

title: SLC Punk!
actors: Matthew Lillard, Michael Goorjian, Annabeth Gish, Jennifer Lien
description: Stevo and Bob are two punks from the bigoted Salt Lake City, who, after having brilliantly graduated from high school, are preparing for a future made of parties, sex at will and gang clashes. But all this does not match the expectations of Stevo's father, a former hippie turned successful lawyer. When Mike and Mark prepare to leave town, and Bob loses his mind over Trish, Stevo's world begins to waver.
notes: We see that Merendino talks about things he has experienced. His is a brutally tender portrait, without moralisms and steeped in the self-irony of a period. Soundtrack that devours the repertoire of groups such as the Specials, the Spandau Ballet and the Stooges.

title: Taxi
actors: Samy Naceri, Frédéric Diefenthal, Bernard Farcy, Marion Cotillard
description: Daniel is a guy who, after losing his job, delivered pizzas at home, he is resigned to being a taxi driver and as soon as possible he goes wild in breathtaking rides. Unfortunately, on his way he meets Emilien who has failed his driving test for the eighth time, a police officer who is hunting down a gang of Germans who rob banks in Mercedes.
notes: The script written with admirable gullibility by Luc Besson, while he was waiting for news on the productive fate of "Fifth Element", focuses everything on cars. The director has signed 400 commercials. The shots of the bodywork are neat, but a commercial has the advantage of being resolved in a few seconds. The film has the handbrake on.

title: Still Crazy
actors: Stephen Rea, Billy Connelly, Andy Nichol, Jimmy Nail, Timothy Spall
description: Twenty years later, they are still crazy: Tony (keyboardist who currently sells condoms in Ibiza), Beano (drummer terrified of debt collectors), Ray (the singer who plays the lord in a mansion he can't afford), Les (guitarist who repairs the roofs). That is, those who in 1977 formed the band of "Strange Fruits", who abandoned the music after a furious fight. In 1998, they return to music with a view to a new concert.
notes: Very small film of "still crazy" survivors, still able to recognize themselves in a "non-ideal" of everyday life: directed by Brian Gibson (and it is his best film), written by two greats of English TV (Dick Clement and Ian La Franais), played by Stephen Rea (Neil Jordan's actor), Timothy Spall (Mike Leigh's), Juliet Aubrey (Winterbottom's), and with a dazzling appearance by Bruce Robinson (the director of "Shakespeare at breakfast" ), in the part of Brian, the fifth of the group. Full of humor, unpretentious or self-congratulatory.

title: Virus
actors: Jamie Lee Curtis, William Baldwin, Donald Sutherland
description: Taken by surprise by a terrible typhoon in the South Pacific, the tugboat Sea Star loses its steel cargo and risks sinking. The seven men of the crew manage to lead the now out of use boat to a relatively quiet place. Suddenly they notice a huge Russian research ship, adrift and apparently abandoned. But a terrible alien force is hiding in the Russian ship ...
notes: An inexhaustible déjà vu experience for science fiction lovers. Taken from a mediocre comic book by Chuck Pfarrer and directed by the newcomer Bruno, a special effects technician, the film involves great actors in a shipwreck, but also annoys for the dated portrait reserved for the Russians, treacherous and warmongers as in McCarthyism.

title: Jack Frost
actors: Michael Keaton, Kelly Preston, Mark Addy, Joseph Cross
description: Jack Frost is doing everything to make his life dream come true: to break through after years of hard work in the music business. His passion has a hard counterpart to bear, staying away from his wife Gabby and his son Charlie. Jack to be forgiven by his son decides to build a snowman with him that can keep Charlie company during his many absences. Time passes, Christmas arrives and Jack who is about to go home to his family is the victim of a serious accident and dies. A year passes, Charlie decides to build another snowman, decorates it with his dad's clothes and thanks to a magical harmonic gift from Jack, the snowman comes to life.
notes: The cinema again tackles the theme of life beyond life and set aside reincarnations, ghostly apparitions and digital paradises, this time the deceased returns to the world of the living through a snowman. So expect good feelings in industrial quantities and prepare your handkerchiefs, even if the film manages to avoid overly dull tones: the special effects that make the snowman the real protagonist of a story that in the United States have been a great success at the box office and which was to be directed by Sam Raimi.

title: Love Is the Devil
actors: Derek Jacobi, Daniel Craig, Tilda Swinton, Anne Lambton
description: In 1971 Francis Bacon presided over the opening of the retrospective in his honor at the Grand Palais in Paris. While being hailed by the press and authorities as the greatest living painter, George Dyer, a model year old and Bacon lover, ingests a deadly cocktail of pills and alcohol. By sinking into unconsciousness, the boy relives his encounter with the painter in 1964 and the morbid relationship that had been established between the two day after day.
notes: Reconstruction of a cruel, destructive love, mixed with alcohol, drugs, unhappiness and masochism. In the painter and in his painting lives a monstrous creature that devours feelings, affections and bodies. This is the moral (not very original) that John Maybury, collaborator of Jarman and a painter himself, wants to stage. The direction gives in to some unnecessary aestheticism and pursues the deformed perception of Bacon's painting. Jacobi takes possession of the real Bacon like a body snatcher.

title: Playing by Heart
actors: Sean Connery, Gena Rowlands, Gillian Anderson, Anthony Edwards
description: Hannah and Paul, a happily married couple go into crisis when they decide to set up a television cooking show. Theatrical director Meredith is determined not to get romantically involved despite Trent's passionate court. Hugh is a loner who goes to bars and tells everyone his sad love stories. Meanwhile, Mark spends the last days of his life next to his mother.
notes: "Talking about love is like dancing on architecture" (and "Dancing About Architecture" was the first working title): on this joke, like a Schnitzlerian circle, the game on feelings directed without particular inspiration by producer-screenwriter Carroll . The strength of the film is a slap-up ending and a team of actors who, except for the dull Connery and Quaid, do not spare themselves. And if the televisions Anderson ("The X Files") and Edwards ("E.R.") prove to be able to pass well from TV to cinema, the best are Ryan Philippe and Angelina Jolie.

title: Dove volano i corvi d'argento
actors: Jenny Tamburi, Corrado Pani, Renzo Montagnani
description: Giacinto Fronteddu, a young Sardinian shepherd, is killed because he is an involuntary witness to a kidnapping. His brother Istévene, a metalworker who emigrated to Milan, returns for the funeral and discovers that both his parents and the rest of the country expect a "traditional" blood feud from him. Perplexed and indecisive, Istévene is also pushed towards murder by Giovannangela, an old flame of his, and by his brother Maineddu, a big shot of the Sassari mafia ...
notes: Piero Livi delves deeply into the traditions of a land and its inhabitants, bringing out a raw and realistic film. Even too much.

title: Death Weekend
actors: Brenda Vaccaro, Don Stroud, Chuck Shamata, Richard Ayres
description: Harry, a dentist, and Diane (Vaccaro), a model, are on their way to the former's villa. During a reckless overtaking, they collide with the car of four thugs, who, after being off the road, chase them. The four, who have already proved to be very dangerous, manage to find them, destroy the villa and kill the man. Diane has only one alternative left: to face them ...
notes: The usual story seasoned with a dose of exaggerated violence. The victim, in his revenge, becomes worse than his captors, turning into an unscrupulous killer. Unhealthy.

title: Snitch
actors: Martin Sheen, Denis Leary, Ian Hart, Billy Crudup, Famke Janssen
description: Bobby is a petty thug with a history of theft and assault who is part of a fierce Irish gang. When his boss Jackie kills a close friend of his, the boy is forced to choose between desire for and loyalty to the boss. Soon a real neighborhood war will break out with attacks and shootings that will involve the faction that supports Bobby and the one that defends Jackie.
notes: Action, chases and shootings in this film that makes rhythm its main weapon. Good interpreters.

title: Falling Sky
directors: Russ Brandt, Brian J. De Palma
actors: Karen Allen, Brittany Murphy, Chris Young
description: Emily and her mother Reese arrive in Las Vegas. They have in common the desire for their dreams to come true, the hope in a future that can be better. Those dreams that have been chasing for years passing from city to city ... from man to man. But even in Las Vegas, Reese, who dreams of resuming singing, relives the disappointment of all time, which regularly drowns in alcohol. Emily, however, extraordinarily mature and intelligent, dreams of giving real meaning to her life. Reese, aware that only her daughter can find the strength to survive, commits suicide the day Emily decides to leave.

title: Inventing the Abbots
actors: Liv Tyler, Joaquin Phoenix, Billy Crudup, Jennifer Connelly
description: 1957. In the small province of Haley live three girls from good families and two boys who, on the contrary, have to struggle to get by. But, despite everything and everyone, there is a strong attraction between them that will lead them to live together the cultural revolution that is also reaching their remote community. Elvis' rock, sports cars and "free sex" will deeply mark their youth.
notes: From the director of "Friends", a film about rebellion and love starring a cast of future stars in which Joaquin Phoenix and Liv Tyler stand out.

title: Little White Lies
actors: Tim Matheson, Ann Jillian, Robert Costanzo
description: Harry MacRae (Tim Matheson) is a wealthy doctor who passes himself off as a poor man. The reason? He's looking for the love of his life, but all he wants is to find a woman who is only attracted to his money. Liz (Ann Jillian) is a Philadelphia police detective, tired of always being considered a female cop. For once, she wants to experience the feeling of being a charming lady from the uptowns of the city. Destiny obviously puts them on each other's path, making them fall in love. He because he believes she is very rich, she because she believes him terribly poor ...

title: The Canadians
actors: Robert Ryan, John Dehner, Torin Tatcher
description: The US military managed to push the Sioux across the Canadian border. Their presence is accepted by the Canadian government, provided that no violence occurs. "Savvy Fox", the chief of the tribe, accepts the agreement, knowing that he cannot risk his people being driven back to the United States. The coexistence proceeds quietly, until a small group of outlaws attack a small village of Indians. At this point, the Red Indians feel betrayed by the white man and want revenge ...
notes: Debut of an excellent screenwriter and mediocre director, it is a western with few ambitions, disappointing despite several interesting ideas.

title: Anema e core
actors: Riccardo Billi, Ferruccio Tagliavini, Mario Riva, Nino Manfredi
description: Marco and Riccardo are two thieves always on the hunt for possible targets. One day, during one of their intrusions, they are distracted by the beautiful voice of an electrician who is working in the apartment next to the one they are robbing. They immediately stop and start fantasizing about the big gains they could make by harnessing his talent. They "write" him and convince him to trust them, but every artist needs his muse ...
notes: Despite his great experience, Mario Mattoli has often "stumbled" on films like these.

title: Ride a Crooked Trail
actors: Walter Matthau, Audie Murphy, Gia Scala
description: Joe Maybe, an outlaw, arrives in the town of Little Rock posing as a defender of the law. Its real target, however, is the local bank. After getting hired as a sheriff's assistant, Joe meets Tessa, a Creole girl who knows her true identity, but manages to convince her not to betray him. In return, he will pretend to be her husband. Ruining his plans is the arrival in town of Teeler, a bandit who wants to rob his own bank.
notes: A western like many others, packaged with a certain care and well interpreted. Matthau was not yet cast as a brilliant actor.

title: Death Train
actors: Pierce Brosnan, Alexandra Paul, Patrick Stewart, Christopher Lee
description: A mercenary was hired by a Russian general who defected to transport a nuclear device across Europe and deliver it to the men of Iraqi dictator Saddam. To do this, however, he must first steal a train on which the bomb will be hidden. Trying to stop him will be an epic team of agents chosen from among the best in Europe. Their mission cannot fail ...
notes: One of the classic films with a markedly television cut that have been invading our televisions for some years. Action without backbone.

title: In principio erano le mutande
actors: Monica Scattini, Bebo Storti, Teresa Saponangelo, Stefania Rocca, Bebo Storti, Monica Scattini
description: In a contaminated, mestizo Genoa, halfway between Naples and Marseille, lives Imma, a young woman with a heart waiting for arrows. The girl, inventing a thousand tricks, tries - with her friend Gina - not to be crushed by a present that appears almost marked and by a future that now seems compromised. Imma carries the fire of passion on her and it is no coincidence that it is a fireman who introduces her to true love.
notes: From the homonymous and successful novel by Rossana Campo, the debutante Anna Negri makes a film of a conscious and high femininity, free and free. Negri's talent can be seen in the non-trivial staging, in search of lines and atmospheres that are not very popular. And in a direction of actors where Teresa Saponangelo explodes in all its sanguine Mediterranean character. A sunny and colorful romantic comedy.

title: Beowulf
actors: Christopher Lambert, Rhona Mitra, Oliver Cotton, Charles Robinson
description: In a world out of time, upset by centuries of barbarism, the civilization of man is now in pieces. In this world full of violence and hatred, Beowulf wanders, a cursed man condemned to wander forever because he is the son of a mortal and the devil. To defeat Evil, our hero must face and attempt to defeat his most fearsome opponent, Grendel, a damned creature who hides in the deepest recesses of an inaccessible fortress.
notes: Despite the frenzy of action scenes, Graham Baker's film is not convincing because it fails to make its own the epic atmosphere that also comes from a text like Beowulf, an anonymous 5th-century Anglo-Saxon epic poem. The script clings to Lambert's lost charisma and the special effects make Grendel a poor "Predator" clone, and neither does Rhona Mitra's busty cleavage lift the story.

title: The Nesting
actors: John Carradine, Gloria Grahame, Robin Groves
description: A writer of gothic novels is drawn to a large, apparently uninhabited Victorian-era house. Obviously the house is far from uninhabited. Inside you will find the most imaginative and evil creatures protagonists of his stories.
notes: In the 1980s when splatters and severed heads were the order of the day in horror film scripts, few examples of good cinema were seen (Sam Raimi's "The House" (1983) is one of the few examples). This "La casa de sorcery" is certainly no better than the others.

title: A Thousand Acres
actors: Jessica Lange, Michelle Pfeiffer, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Jason Robards
description: The bossy old head of the family Larry (Robards) announces his intention to divide the land and leave it to Ginny (Lange), Rose (Pfeiffer) and Caroline (Leigh). The partition triggers a destructive mechanism that involves the sisters, husbands and friends-lovers found after a long absence.
notes: The Australian Moorhouse, although helped by the excellent performance of the cast, drowns in the pages of the novel, Pulitzer Prize, from which the film was based. The missed dreams, the incest, the cancer, the quarrels, the legal confrontation, the house removals, the goodbyes, parade, without imagination, on a screen as smooth as the Midwest countryside.

title: Sibirskij tsiryulnik
actors: Julia Ormond, Richard Harris, Oleg Menshikov, Alexey Petrenko
description: We are in 1885 and Jane Callahan, a young American, is on her way to Russia. During the journey, Jane shares her compartment with a group of rowdy cadets. Among them stands Andrey Tolstoi who shares a passion for music with Jane. It doesn't take much and the young officer falls in love with the beautiful girl. Arriving in Moscow, Jane reunites with Douglas McCracken, an eccentric inventor who, in order to obtain funding for his invention, passes her off as his daughter. Jane's job is to seduce General Radlov ...
notes: What remains of Mikhalkov's cinema is only the sumptuous self-awareness of his own manner, which leads him to perform pieces of vain virtuosity, to constantly move masses and carts, to establish an embarrassing parallel between himself and Mozart (and between himself and Tsar Alexander III, who plays a celebratory cameo), to expand a predictable love story for three unsustainable hours; Ormond, blonde as she is, is not Marlene and the cheerful cadets are bordering on ridicule.

title: Plunkett and MacLeane
actors: Robert Carlyle, Jonny Lee Miller, Liv Tyler, Ken Stott, Michael Gambon
description: It is the year 1748 and Will Plunkett is already one of the most sought after in England. Shrewd and unscrupulous, he became the nightmare of Chance, chief of police. Driven by hatred for the social system of the time, he dreams of going to America, but to do so he needs a lot of money. When Plunkett meets MacLeane, a destitute and amoral aristocrat, in Newgate prison, where they are both held, he begins to see the right opportunity.
notes: The literature and painting of the '700 mixes with the soundtrack and the speed of the' 900. Produces Gary Oldman, coordinates the various contaminations Jake Scott, son of Ridley, act, have fun, Liv Tyler, Robert Carlyle, Jonny Lee Miller and Ken Scott. The picaresque western crosses the costume action-movie.

title: The Lost Son
actors: Daniel Auteuil, Nastassja Kinski, Katrin Cartlidge, Marianne Denicourt
description: Xavier Lombard (Auteuil) is a former French policeman who lives in London as a private detective. The man has behind him the tragedy of having lost his wife and daughter in an attack and for having personally retaliated against the principal he was disbarred by the police. A friend gives him an easy job: finding his missing brother-in-law, the scion of a rich family. The research leads Xavier into the hell of pedophilia.
notes: It is a harsh, rough and perhaps politically incorrect film by Menges. A tough film, which advocates the law of retaliation and the "executioner of the night", but which glues the viewer to the screen, also because it is all terribly likely, with Auteuil who does not disfigure in a role that is unpublished for him. Without pretensions or self-pity.

title: La balia
actors: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Maya Sansa, Pier Giorgio Bellocchio
description: Doctor Mori, a silent and isolated neuropsychiatrist, is married to Vittoria. Their existence seems peaceful, but the birth of a child causes the crisis to explode. The newborn refuses the mother's milk and this causes in Vittoria a sort of refusal of the child. Mori is forced to hire Annetta a nurse with an instinctive character who will plunge Vittoria into a deep crisis.
notes: Framed with meticulous cleanliness, traversed by glances, noises, small gestures that escape one another as soon as they are about to intertwine, a film guided by intimate sensations, by nervous doubts and by the angry shots of a tall and pale mother and by the progressive softening of a father who is forced out of his role.

title: Banditi a Orgosolo
actors: Michele Cossu, Peppeddu Cuccu, Vittorina Pisano, Attori non professionisti
description: Michele is looking after a flock in the Sardinian countryside. Three bandits who have stolen some pigs stop in his hut: Michele would like the three to go away, but the carabinieri arrive and have a fire fight with the brigands; a soldier is hit and loses his life. At this point, Michele must escape so as not to be blamed as an accomplice: but an arrest warrant has already been issued against him, and he tries to reach a free zone with the flock ...
notes: De Seta took care of the production, photography, editing and screenplay and obtained the prize for the best first work in Venice.

title: Le voci bianche
actors: Paolo Ferrari, Anouk Aimée, Graziella Granata, Sandra Milo
description: Meo, a young populace of Rome, to try to escape the great misery that afflicts him, decides to become a musician. In reality, the boy, who in the meantime has bought the complicity of a surgeon, can embark on his particular and coveted career, making use exclusively of his singing skills. But his secret is too big to remain so and soon the rumor of the bluff spreads among the ladies of the Roman aristocracy.
notes: The film written by the two directors together with Gigi Magni knows how to mix comedy with the accurate reconstruction of an era. Perhaps the cutest film of Festa Campanile.

title: Fixed Bayonets
actors: Richard Basehart, Gene Evans, Michael O'Shea, Craig Hill
description: During the war in Korea, a platoon of American soldiers is forced to retreat in the face of advancing enemy troops. A rearguard of a few men is left to cover the escape of the regiment. Without officers, with little ammunition and with low morale, the soldiers chosen for the suicide mission are led by a corporal who must overcome the greatest danger: fear.
notes: From the master of war films, the first and foremost existential adventure of a group of desperate men. Fuller tells without an ounce of emphasis the drift of soldiers into anguish and the end of any heroism. James Dean plays a small part.

title: La Collectionneuse
actors: Patrick Bauchau, Haydee Politoff, Daniel Pommereulle
description: A young playboy tired of the hectic city life decides to move to the French Riviera. Here he meets Haydée, a beautiful girl who begins to woo him. The playboy, for once "hunted" and not a hunter, remains indifferent to advances. When he comes forward, Haydée will reject him.
notes: Third chapter of Rohmer's "moral tales", perhaps the oldest. Dialogues not always very happy and construction of the story sometimes tiring. The master's touch is revealed in the meticulous description of the protagonists' daily life. Excellent psychological comparison between the two.

title: Satellite in the Sky
actors: Kieron Moore, Lois Maxwell, Bryan Forbes, Don Wolfit
description: The Stardust spaceship throws an atomic bomb into space during a nuclear test: only that the device, instead of drifting in the cosmos, begins to follow the trajectory of the convoy, endangering the life of the crew and the very safety of the planet. Land. The only way out: to cause the bomb to explode before it's too late ...
notes: Science fiction with discreet use of means. The special effects are handled by Wally Veevars, the same as in Stanley Kubrick's _2001_. Cinemascope (will it be respected in television shows?) Fascinates, but the plot is coarse. Actress Lois Maxwell is the legendary Moneypenny of the 007 films.

title: Stranded
actors: Ione Skye, Joe Morton, Maureen O'Sullivan, Susan Barnes
description: A group of aliens land in an area of ??North Carolina and take a girl and her grandmother hostage. Besieged on their farm together with the disturbing extraterrestrial presences, the two women are rescued by a black sheriff and some local boys, who are not very tolerant of African Americans. But the union will make strength, even if the real danger remains prejudice.
notes: Curious science fiction film that hides an attention to the social reality of the deep South of the United States. Not everything goes smoothly and the presence of aliens is too often reduced to a pretext.

title: Bara no soretsu
actors: Pîtâ, Osamu Ogasawaro, Yoshio Tsuchiya, Emiko Azuma, Shinno Ikehata
description: The transvestite Edi is in every sense the "queen" of the Shinjuku bar frequented by homosexuals. One day Edi kills Leda, concubine of the owner of the restaurant, and takes her place by seducing the man and bending him to his will. They will both have a terrible surprise, because the owner of the bar is actually the father of the lover. He commits suicide and she digs her eyes out with her hands.
notes: Melodrama pushed to the extreme, absolutely courageous for the time it was released. The nocturnal setting is dark.

title: Il potere
actors: Paola Tosi, Massimo Compostrini, Ferruccio Maliga
description: Times change but the cruel form of power management remains unchanged. Starting from this thesis, Augusto Tretti analyzes the control system of power in five different historical moments: the stone age, the Roman empire, the colonization of the West, the birth of fascism, and the modern context.
