Almost a documentary made with few means.
notes: The film inevitably appears dated from a political point of view, however Tretti reveals an indubitable visual talent and manages to make the starting point suggestive.

title: La legge della tromba
actors: Maria Boto, Angelo Paccagnini, Eugenia Tretti
description: Celestino, a clumsy robber, ends up working in a trumpet factory. Once the company is closed, he is forced to look for another job in order not to end up in prison. He is hired by a rocket builder but an explosion will shoot him into orbit.
notes: Surreal debut of Tretti, who began working in the cinema as an assistant to Fellini in the "Bidone". The author's poetic vein is consistent, and the experimental style has some originality, but the realization at times denounces a certain naivety.

title: Flipper
actors: Paul Hogan, Elijah Wood, Isaac Hayes, Chelsea Field
description: Little Sandy (Elijah Wood), on vacation in Florida with his eccentric uncle Porter (Paul Hogan), becomes friends with the dolphin Flipper and a girl of his age. With their help, he will be able to ward off pollution in the bay threatened by an evil industrialist. Ecologist fairytale with the protagonist of "Crocodile Dundee".
notes: The film tries to repeat the extraordinary public success of "Free Willy". Good feelings and a few winks at the sugary "Bredford Family" drama. The monumental Isaac Hayes is a famous soul musician who recycled into the cinema. With a sequel.

title: Lola
actors: Angela Molina, Feodor Atkine, Patrick Bauchau, Assumpta Serna
description: Lola (Molina) moves from Madrid to Barcelona after a violent argument with her partner (Atkin). Here she meets a French businessman (Bauchau) who falls in love with her and leaves his wife and child behind. A few years later the old love returns, asking for money and would like to take her little girl away from Lola.
notes: Unknown work by Bigas Luna, directed before the trash conversion and the drift of "Bambola". More depth in this passionate and hot melodrama. Excellent performance by Angela Molina, the morbid atmosphere of the love scenes succeeded. Eros of an unpublished author in the room.

title: Edogawa rampo ryoki-kan: yaneura no sanpo sha
actors: Renji Ishibashi, Junko Miyashita, Hiroshi Cho, Toshihiko Oda
description: Gouda is a none who has a particular vice: strip under the roofs and gives vent to her voyeurism by secretly looking at women from the floors. When he meets Minako, a exhibitionist nymphomaniac, the classic love at first sight starts: the morbid relationship between the two will even lead them to the murder.
notes: Tanaka's film is inspired by a story by Edogawa Ranpo and has the same setting as the masterpiece of Nagisa Oshima _l'pempero as the senses_. The fatal relationship between Voyeur and Ninfomano recalls the equally unhealthy one of the protagonists of _matador_ by Pedro Almodóvar. Also known by the title _The man who walked on the floors_.

title: Analyze This
actors: Robert De Niro, Billy Crystal, Lisa Kudrow, Joe Viterelli
description: Paul a powerful New York mafioso, and Ben, a moderately successful psychiatrist, slightly bored with his patients and about to be married to a TV host, meet for a savage analysis. On the eve of an important reunion of all the families of the United States, Vitti "falls apart". He has panic attacks, cries for no reason, cannot sleep and no longer has the strength to hit and bar, he needs a psychoanalyst.
notes: Favored and assisted by a service director and above all by a screenplay, written by Peter Tolan and by Ramis himself, who has the shrewdness to weave two strands with a thousand cinematographic layers, De Niro, Crystal, in a state of grace, take turns , amazing pieces of skill.

title: Dolce far niente
actors: François Cluzet, Isabella Ferrari, Giancarlo Giannini, Margherita Buy
description: It is 1807 and the young Henri Beyle, who has not yet taken the name of Stendhal, is on his way. Art, music and love are the three reasons for a literary wanderings that will bring Henry to Terracina, on the border between the Papal State and the Kingdom of Naples. Henri finds hospitality first in the home of Count Nencini, exiled by the Bourbons and then in a post office, where he will meet his idol Gioacchino Rossini. Clumsy and foiled, Henri falls in love, unrequited, both with the capricious and resolute Gabriella, wife of the Count, and with the more melancholy Josephina.
notes: The direction marries the flow, the structure and the comic opera vocals adopted by Frédéric Vitoux in the novel that is at the origin of the film. If Stendhal wrote thinking of Rossini's rhythms, the film pursues the same goal but does not reach it.

title: The Impostors
actors: Stanley Tucci, Oliver Platt, Lily Taylor, Steve Buscemi, Isabella Rossellini
description: Arthur and Maurice are two loser theater actors, chased by the police for threatening a poorly gifted colleague. They find themselves aboard an ocean liner bound for Europe, where each of the passengers is not really what they seem and in the incessant effort to escape the chase of the enraged colleague and the crew, the two manage to foil a bomb attack.
notes: Paired with Oliver Platt, Tucci attempts to revive the surreal farce of the Marx brothers or, alternatively, of Gianni and Pinotto, with a story set in the 1930s. We are at the apotheosis of sexual, political and racial transvestism with a comedy that makes double meaning and slapstick its pillars, undermined however by a sobbing rhythm that often abandons jokes and gags in a pneumatic vacuum. A defect probably accentuated by an Italian version struggling to follow all the nuances. Camei by Woody Allen, Isabella Rossellini and others.

title: Harem suare
actors: Marie Gillain, Alex Descas, Lucia Bosé, Valeria Golino
description: On the eve of the collapse of the Ottoman Empire: in the harem of Sultan Abdulhamit II, the odalisque of Italian origin Safiyè dreams of becoming the first favorite of the sultan. To achieve the goal she has set herself, the girl who gets help from the eunuch Nadir is also willing to kill. But when his dream is finally about to come true his whole world suddenly collapses: the sultan is exiled, the harem is closed and odalisques and eunuchs are left to fend for themselves.
notes: The background of the story is the Istanbul of 1908, which fell in the last flashes of the Ottoman Empire; while the story - set on two narrative levels that "poetically" violate the chronology - develops from the waiting room of a station (in the 1950s), where adult Safiyè tells her story. The problem with the film is that it does not mask poverty and its television setting: which forces long close-ups that deprive the images of breath, of revolutionary wind.

title: Forces of Nature
actors: Sandra Bullock, Ben Affleck, Maura Tierney, Blythe Danner, Ronny Cox
description: Ben is a New York yuppie who is traveling to the small town of Savannah to marry his fiancée. During the journey, the man meets Sarah, a single mother incapable of stable relationships. The two bump into each other at the airport, but jumbos, trains, buses and car rentals go haywire as Ben and Sarah approach them. Meanwhile, a cyclone is coming, the bride-to-be waits in vain and the wedding guests wait.
notes: The story is taken from the classic "It happened one night" with an inverted "on the road" path (there Miami-New York, here New York-Savannah). The director is on his second work, and has a guaranteed future in home-video films. Let's hope that Frank Capra, in heaven, doesn't watch TV.

title: Lettera napoletana
actors: Giacomo Rondinella, Virna Lisi, Otello Toso, Lianella Carell
description: Warehouse keeper Franco is unjustly accused of theft by a shrewd colleague, who also tries to trap him in a round of smuggled cigarettes. Only Franco's girlfriend, Anna, can shed light on the truth by freeing her boyfriend from the shadow of suspicion ...
notes: The melodramatic noir in an italic version: in the end the good guys win. Too edifying and with some basic ingenuity in the plot. The very young Virna Lisi, however, alone is worth the price of the ticket. The director Giorgio Pàstina, very active between the 40s and 50s, is known for the film version of the _Enrico IV_.

title: Ho ritrovato mio figlio
actors: Carlo Campanini, Harry Kusky, Pina Piovani, Ennio Girolami, Carlo Delle Piane, Eduardo de Santis, Mimo Billi, Claudio Ermelli, Amedeo Trilli
description: Marco, the young projectionist of an oratory room, steals the projector but is discovered by his little brother Damiano. Who, to help Marco, also ends up in trouble taking the blame. Whoever does not believe him is the parish priest, who begins a personal investigation into the facts.
notes: The "son" of the title has a pastoral meaning, and in fact the film, a typical example of post-war Catholic production, is an elementary reflection on the concepts of "guilt" and "confession". The film looks all its years, but its strength is the proof of Carletto Delle Piane and Carlo Campanini. Piccon's direction is modest.

title: The Day the Fish Came Out
actors: Tom Courtenay, Candice Bergen, Colin Blakely
description: A surveying plane lets two atomic bombs and a box containing radioactive material precipitates on a Greek island. The bombs are recovered, but the mysterious box ends up in the hands of a man and a woman, the only inhabitants of the island, who after having thrown it into the sea attend the death of all fish.
notes: Malldastrious attempt by the director of "Zorba il Greco" to try his hand with the ecological fairy tale. Politically correct but cinematically presumptuous, with open -aesthetic openings even ridiculous. The film wanted to become a cult and instead passed almost unnoticed.

title: Meatballs
actors: Bill Murray, Harvey Atkin, Kate Lynch, Russ Braham
description: In an isolated summer camp for students, the school's most frenzied kids target the instructors, nicknamed "meatballs," and wear them out with jokes. In their free time, however, they look after the girls ...
notes: Ivan Reitman ("Ghostbusters") and Harold Ramis (screenwriter here) make their debut with a loose comedy that chases the success of "Animal House". The film is modest but has at least two merits: it anticipated the "Porky's" vein and launched some priceless comedians (Murray). With two negligible unpublished sequels in Italy. On the other hand, the success at home was great.

title: Waxwork
actors: Miles O'Keeffe, Zach Galligan, Deborah Foreman, David Warner
description: In his waxwork workshop, a museum craftsman finds a way to revoke the most famous monsters in history from the darkness. He does not realize that in doing so he unleashes an apocalyptic battle between the forces of evil. To save mankind he will have to seek some valid ally among the demons themselves.
notes: Curious tribute to the monsters of Universal (from the Mummy to Frankenstein and Dracula) and to the beautiful films of Erle C. Kenton ("House of Frankenstein", "Island of the lost souls") signed by a son of art. Anthony Hickox's father, Douglas, is in fact the not forgotten director of "Bloody Oscar" with Vincent Price.

title: Il cappotto
actors: Renato Rascel, Yvonne Sanson, Antonella Lualdi, Giulio Stival
description: Carmine, a humble employee, has a secret dream: to buy himself a coat. When he finally manages to buy the garment, after several sacrifices, he is robbed on the street by a thief. Without her new coat anymore, Carmine wanders the city in the middle of the night, struggling with the cold and the dark.
notes: One of Lattuada's best films, based on the homonymous story by Gogol 'and set in Pavia in the 1930s, between bureaucrats and hierarchs. Extraordinary performance by Rascel, a comedian who shows off an unsuspected dramatic talent for the occasion. The film was a great success with the public.

title: Le petit théâtre par Jean Renoir
actors: Jean Renoir, Jeanne Moreau Marguerite Cassan
description: Presented by the director himself, who stages himself with a strong dose of smug and amusing irony, four stories built on the figure of the paradox: the marriage condition that has become too accommodating, the intrusiveness of appliances that transform the house into a dangerous jungle and more. yet.
notes: Renoir, in his latest film, stages himself as a "meneur de jeu" and at the same time as a commentator on the absurd modern condition. The result, however, is by no means nostalgic. Renoir poses problems for his part, with the grace and grace of a great film master.

title: Matter of Trust
actors: C. Thomas Howell, Nick Mancuso, Joan Severance
description: Detective Michael D'Angelo is neglecting his work to the point that, during an action by his team, he fails to intervene in favor of a companion in danger and thus causes his death. This error costs him a suspension from service. But what happened to the good detective? His existence has changed since the love of his life ended: Theresa, his wife, left him to marry a respectable doctor. The two have not met since then. He is now involved by Theresa in the search for her husband, who has been missing for a few days. The suspicions about who masterminded the kidnapping seem to focus on him ...

title: Toy Soldiers
actors: Sean Astin, Will Wheaton, Keith Coogan, Louis Gossett jr.
description: The pupils of a military school live under the strict rules of barracks life. Training is tough for these young cadets, who live a very different life from that of their "middle-class" peers. A group of Colombian terrorists, making a mistake they will not realize in the end, decides to take these little soldiers hostage.
notes: Goofy rambetti movie with an ex- "Goonie" and the inevitable Gossett Jr.

title: Trucks
actors: Timothy Busfield, Brenda Bakke, Brendan Fletcher
description: Ray after the death of his wife killed by a stray bullet, takes refuge with his son Logan and an old friend of his father in Lunar, a remote area of ??the American countryside, a traditional sighting place for extraterrestrials. Here he decides to open a refreshment post and a petrol station where all the passing truck drivers stop. Hope, fresh from a bad marriage experience, runs a motel in the same area and organizes excursions in the surrounding area for tourists. Hope and Ray become good friends and struggle to rebuild a new life. The tranquility of Lunar, however, is upset by the aliens, occult forces and literally crazy trucks that overwhelm everything and everyone.

title: La strategia della maschera
actors: Rocco Mortelliti, Andrea Camilleri, Beatrice Macola, Pino Micol
description: Briano Teo Calvani is the director of the archaeological museum of Camarina, in the province of Ragusa. The discovery of some masks upsets the small town, but the thrill of the discovery does not last long. The discovery of a papyrus that specifies the exact number of masks (thirty and not twenty) leads the archaeologist to hypothesize that some were stolen during the excavations.
notes: Constructed like a thriller, in reality, the film (directed by Rocco Mortelliti who also plays the role of the archaeologist's nephew) is a melancholic comedy in which characters out of time and out of all logic are agitated, unfortunately not supported by the script, approximate and full of nonsense. In the cast also Pino Micol, Mariano Rigillo and Pino Caruso, and the writer Camilleri.

title: L'anniversario
actors: Laura Morante, Luca Zingaretti, Elena Fresco, Cinzia Mascoli
description: In an elegant villa on the outskirts of Rome, Anita desperately tries to reconstruct what happened the previous night. The night before, the woman had celebrated their wedding anniversary with her husband and some friends. For dinner he had invited his usual friends: identical couples, superfacial, too standardized and made sterile by a life that was too easy. The arrival of Daniela, a neighbor, troubled by a furious quarrel with her husband upsets the serenity of the party. The next day a body is found ...
notes: The director, who chooses to return to the same places of the crime of his most famous film "Mamba", is the first to lose his way, suffering the repercussions of some unlikely narrative implication (the neighbor who breaks into the house apparently without explanation) and dazzled by a "Yellow Telephone" style show.

title: Il corpo dell'anima
actors: Roberto Herlitzka, Raffaella Ponzo, Ennio Fantastichini, Sabina Vannucchi
description: The writer Ernesto, a wealthy 64-year-old widower without children, lives alone in a large house in a middle-class neighborhood in Rome. With an introverted character and little inclined to social acquaintances, man experiences his solitude as a conscious choice. Ernesto, who is writing a script about the life of Teresa of Avila, is suddenly abandoned by the Filipino waitress, so he is forced to hire Luana. He soon gets overwhelmed by the girl's exuberance and beauty and loses his head for her.
notes: In the cold melodrama of Salvatore Piscicelli ("Immacolata e Concetta", "The occasions of Rosa", "Regina"), Luana interprets the idea and the image of an unmanageable excess and a perverse involvement. It is the flesh and, perhaps, the reality of love. Around this node the director arranges other discourses that run through the film (the treatment on Teresa of Avila). Cinema in cinema and transparency of the gaze. Ecstatic and baroque abandonment.

title: Bedrooms and Hallways
actors: Kevin McKidd, Hugo Weaving, Julie Graham, Jennifer Ehle
description: Leo is a quiet 30-year-old who, although professionally satisfied, is dying to start a new relationship. Darren, with whom he shares the apartment, and who has a heated affair with real estate agent Jeremy supported by his neighbor Angie, constantly pushes Leo to get out of the house and have fun. When Adam, his boss and friend invites him to join his therapy group, Leo surprises everyone, confessing that he is attracted to Brendan.
notes: The American independent director Rose Troche, after her debut with "Go Fish" which has in the meantime become one of the posters of lesbian cinema, moves to London (the San Francisco of the 90s ...) and realizes what could become one of the posters of homosexual cinema. Sparkling actors of the theatrical school, irony, jokes and "compromising" situations and an atmosphere poised between anarchy and monarchical subjection. A brilliant, fast, irreverent operina, who lives well among contemporary problems and does not take herself too seriously.

title: The Winslow Boy
actors: Rebecca Pidgeon, Nigel Hawthorne, Jeremy Northam, Gemma Jones
description: England, 1912. Arthur Winslow is preparing the marriage of his daughter Catherine to the young John Watherstone, but does not know that he will have to face a very delicate situation. His youngest son, Ronnie is about to be expelled from the Osborne Naval School on the infamous charge of stealing a five shillings money order. But from the moment that the boy professes himself innocent, Arthur begins to investigate to try to bring out the truth. Thus begins a legal battle involving the Crown.
notes: David Mamet resumes a 1948 film, "Tutto m'accusa" by Anthony Asquith, set in England in the 1910s. The film slowly turns into a quarrel about honor, man-woman relationships, the tangles of justice and the "rights that must prevail".

title: Pola X
actors: Guillaume Depardieu, Katerina Golubëva, Catherine Deneuve, Delphine Chuillot
description: Pierre lives with his mother Marie in a Normandy castle. They are beautiful, rich and they love each other. Every morning, Pierre goes with the motorbike inherited from his father to the home of his girlfriend Lucia. One night Marie tells Pierre that she has set the date of marriage with Lucia. And just as Pierre is running to her to give her the happy announcement he meets a girl who says her name is Isabelle and claims to be her sister.
notes: After a montage of war repertoire materials underlined by rock music, we are thrown into the rarefied atmosphere of a very high French bourgeoisie. The colors, the submerged atmospheres, the only intuitive relationships refer to a well-orchestrated reworking of the classic mélo. Too bad that after twenty minutes Carax plunges into the techno-metropolitan exasperation, into the unconsulted gestures of fake-poor young people, in a booming and kitschy scenography.

title: EdTv
actors: Matthew McConaughey, Woody Harrelson, Ellen DeGeneres, Martin Landau, Sally Kirkland
description: The True Tv cable channel has been in a free fall in ratings for about two years. The director of programs has an extraordinary idea: to follow the life of a man in the street 24 hours a day. The choice falls on Ed, a modest videotape salesman who immediately adjusts to the situation. In the space of a week Ed becomes the star of the EdTv, the most loved show by Americans.
notes: We are obviously in the "Truman Show". With some differences: the script does not have the full-bodied solidity and dark background of that of Weir's film, the participants in the show are aware, therefore less inevitably bound by a destiny written from above, the times of the comedy every now and then a series of predictable events. Ron Howard's direct knowledge of the fascination of sitcoms remains. And the skill of the interpreters remains, especially the crazy Harrelson, the stepfather Landau, the mother Sally Kirkland. And even McConaughey functions as a proletarian big boy.

title: Cube
actors: Nicole DeBoer, Nicky Guadagni, David Hewlett, Andrew Miller
description: Six human beings suddenly find themselves locked in a sort of prison formed by a labyrinth of cubic chambers scattered with deadly traps. Little by little the group understands that there is only one possibility of salvation.
notes: We are faced with a little gem that has collected awards in science fiction and fantasy festivals. It is the debut of a son of Italian immigrants born in Detroit but lived in Toronto with his longtime friend Andre Bijelic. Visual inventions manage to overcome the modesty of the means available (the film was shot in less than a month in a single set built in a Toronto house; and in a single 14x14 cube, even if the background of the action changes in continuation).

title: Marechiaro
actors: Silvana Pampanini, Arnoldo Foà, Nada Fiorelli, Augusto Di Giovanni
description: A boy returns to Naples to find his girlfriend and is seduced by his stepmother. At first he gives in overwhelmed, then, faced with the risk of losing his partner, he decides to end the relationship. Except that the stepmother is found dead and the young protagonist ends up suspected of murder.
notes: Melodrama written among others by Mario Monicelli and Anton Giulio Majano. Quite convincing in the plot (the erotic theme is bold for the times) but very listless and conventional in the realization. Giorgio Ferroni will make up for it with the next film, "The mill of stone women".

title: A Perfect Couple
actors: Paul Dooley, Marta Heflin, Titos Vandis
description: Alex Theodopolus (Paul Dooley) is the son of a wealthy family of antique dealers of Greek origin with a passion for cultured music. Shella Shea (Marta Heflin) is a young rock singer who performs at night in the clubs of the city. Nothing in common? Not for the brains of an agency for lonely hearts, which brings them together on a gallant evening. Love will break out between the two and, in addition to uniting their hearts, will also be able to bring their different vision of music closer together.
notes: Even if we are not at the levels of the best Altman, this comedy is pleasant and is appreciated above all for the many musical numbers.

title: Taffin
actors: Pierce Brosnan, Patrick Bergin, Ray McAnally
description: A small village in the Irish countryside sees its survival threatened by a group of entrepreneurs, willing to do anything to see their project: a chemical plant realized. The community protests seem to have no effect, and the law can do nothing to force them to stop work. But among the inhabitants of the village there is Taffin, a man of decisive ways who lives by recovering old credits.
notes: A film with good intentions that he cannot keep. Unbearable Brosnan.

title: Gioventù perduta
actors: Massimo Girotti, Jacques Sernas, Carla Del Poggio
description: A novice police inspector finds himself having to investigate crimes committed by a college student. The boy is the brother of the woman the policeman is in love with, and this creates several complications.
notes: Germi, after "Il testimone", retraces the paths of noir without losing sight of the mysterious charm of the settings and the complexity of the characters involved. The ability to nail the viewer in the face of the ambiguities of the relationship between good and bad, and the lack of consoling intentions, merge with an evident desire to refer to American genre cinema.

title: Gli ultimi cinque minuti
actors: Linda Darnell, Vittorio De Sica, Peppino De Filippo, Sophie Desmarets, Elsa Merlini
description: Renato and Carla meet by chance as they both look for a home. He falls in love with her, the girl seems to reciprocate but does not want to give up her independence. Thus she accepts to marry him on one condition: she must be free in case you meet great love. Carlo accepts, but jealousy gets in the way.
notes: From a comedy by Aldo De Benedetti, an uninspired film that stands out only for some brilliant dialogues and for the good performance of the actors. At the time it went unnoticed, while Darnell (the Clementine of "Infernal Challenge") never managed to establish herself as a star in Italy, even if her passage to Naples was immortalized by Raffaele La Capria in "Wounded to death". De Sica seems to recover a "white telephone" style character.

title: Maestro del terrore
actors: David Brandon, Tomas Arana, Carole André, Ulisse Minervini, Joyce Pitti
description: Horror film director Marc Owen furiously quarrels with his trusted screenwriter who decides to take revenge. The filmmaker and his wife thus begin to receive terrible threats, until the screenwriter, in the company of an accomplice, decides to enter the villa of his former friend and take the whole family hostage. It will have a very bad surprise.
notes: The best horror film directed by Bava Junior for the television series "High voltage", long kept in a drawer due to the excessive violence of the episodes. Excellent cast, in which the "pearl of Labuan" Carole André stands out. Recommended for splatter enthusiasts only.

title: Nico the Unicorn
actors: Kevin Zegers, Anne Archer, Larry Day, Michael Ontkean
description: A sad and lonely child, unable to relate to the surrounding world, invents a magical dimension within which to escape. In this fantastic land, the little protagonist meets a unicorn, who becomes his best friend and gives him back the joy of living.
notes: Discreet fairy tale for television.

title: Un beau monstre
actors: Helmut Berger, Virna Lisi, Charles Aznavour, Françoise Brion
description: The wealthy Alain marries his neighbor Nathalie in second marriage, who had witnessed the suicide of his first wife. The woman does not know that the death was caused precisely by the man's behavior. Alain is afflicted with serious psychic disorders and tries to poison Nathalie, who fortunately notices it.
notes: Dark drama that seems to refer to Hitchcock's "Suspect". Unfortunately the script is faragginosa and Gobbi fails to dominate the suspense like the famous maestro. The attempt to concentrate on the twisted psychology of the "monster" Alain is not completely convincing. Even the cast suffers the superficiality of the subject.

title: Disperatamente l'estate scorsa
actors: Paola Pitagora, Nino Segurini, Mirella Pamphili
description: Lisa, a widow on vacation with her son, meets Alessandro and falls in love. The man is actually a former Communist Germany agent who fled Berlin and was chased by some former colleagues. The love story between Lisa and Alessandro risks turning into a very dangerous game, against the backdrop of the Cold War.
notes: The premise of the film is interesting. But Amadio remains uncertain which way to take: sentimental story, melodrama or adventure? Indecision mainly harms the definition of the characters and the test of the actors. The director of photography is Aristide Massaccesi, for all Joe D'Amato.

title: Tristesse et Beauté
actors: Charlotte Rampling, Andrzej Zulawski, Myriem Roussel
description: Hugo, a successful novelist, tired of the family routine imposed by his wife and his graduate son, seeks new stimuli with ex-lover Lea. But between the two a third woman enters, Prudence, who triggers the jealousy of Lea and his wife. The first, to take revenge for the "betrayal", seduces the son of Hugo.
notes: Quadrangle erotic in the form of a family drama, with a final tragedy ready around the corner. An intellectual and ambitious but quite interesting operation, especially for the morbid climate that is established between the characters.

title: Un posto ideale per uccidere
actors: Irene Papas, Ornella Muti, Ray Lovelock, Sal Borgese
description: Two Danish boys on vacation in Italy are hosted in the villa of an eccentric American. The house is pervaded by a sense of mystery: the woman, in fact, has recently murdered her husband and would like to put the blame on the two unsuspecting tourists.
notes: More thriller than thriller, even if the twists are not spared. Umberto Lenzi has crossed all genres of our cinema with mixed results. Here we are definitely below the average of his productions of the time ("So sweet ... so perverse", "Spasm"). Even the actors' rehearsal suffers from the director's lack of inspiration.

title: L'Histoire d'Adèle H.
actors: Isabelle Adjani, Bruce Robinson, Sylvia Marriott
description: Victor Hugo's daughter Adele falls madly in love with a young English officer. After an initial interest he abandons her and she will begin a long pilgrimage to be close to him in all ways. Faced with the impossibility of love, Adele will go crazy.
notes: Truffaut's melodrama as extraordinary as it is anomalous, one of the highest peaks in his entire cinema. Adele's loving obsession creates an entirely internal contrast and is also experienced by the viewer on an emotional level. In a famous scene the Adjani meets a soldier played by Truffaut himself. Their exchange of glances is memorable.

title: Forever Love
actors: Reba McEntire, Tim Matheson, Bess Armstrong, Heather Stephens
description: Lizzie wakes up after twenty years in a coma. The world she finds no longer belongs to her, and reintegration into the family is also difficult. Her daughter has become a woman, her husband is almost a stranger and moreover he has an affair with her former best friend. Which has not only taken over the role of wife but also that of mother. Destroyed and confused, Lizzie decides it's time to start all over again, no longer thinking of turning the clock of life back two decades for others. It won't be easy, but someone will help.

title: Ator il guerriero di ferro
actors: Miles O'Keefe, Iris Peynado, Tiziana Altieri
description: In a fantastic kingdom lives the great warrior Ator, who carries the magical sign of Thorn on his heart. Ator must fight against the forces of evil and a dark knight known as "the lord of swords". The fate of the world depends on the outcome of their clash.
notes: Trash fantasy recycled from a previous exploit by Joe D'Amato ("Ator the invincible") and here reduced to a minimum in terms of rhythm and inspiration.

title: The Substitute 2: School's Out
actors: Treat Williams, Guru, Susan May Pratt, Christopher Cousins
description: Arrived in Brooklyn to attend the funeral of his brother Randall, a history teacher at Lenthrop High School killed while trying to stop a car theft attributed to a street gang called "Brotherhood", the mercenary Karl Thomasson takes his place by pretending to be. alternate, in order to be able to get in touch with the violent reality that disturbs the institute. Taken under his wing his niece Anya, Randall's daughter, Karl will eventually realize that in reality, behind the recent events, there is a much deeper and more ramified criminal entanglement, and that the threat for him and Anya is much closer than how much he did not suspect.

title: Chiavi in mano
actors: Martufello, Angela Cavagna, Sergio Vastano, Cinzia Roccaforte, Ramona Badescu
description: Baccello da Stimigliano confused crusade with cruise and left for the Holy Land. Back after years he can't wait to hug his wife Ubalda again but of course he has lost the key to his chastity belt. Desperate, he even discovers that his wife is cheating on him with the craftsman who built the belt, and that of course he has spare keys. Crusader pod finds himself horned and meditates revenge.
notes: A "decamerotic" definitely out of time. Things like that were fine years ago, Pippo Franco did them and in any case there was little laugh. With Martufello you have to shoot yourself. Worse than that ...

title: Dangerous Waters
actors: Connie Sellecca, Matt McCoy, Brent Hinkley, Alana Austin, Anthony DeFilippo
description: Sarah, a young widow, organizes a trip on a river in order to introduce her new boyfriend Bob to her two children. Sarah loves rafting and involves her family in the descent of a river: but due to an inconvenience, the group is forced to spend the whole night in the open. Inspecting the area, Sarah's daughter finds an injured man dressed as a prisoner: Sarah and Bob mobilize to hand him over to the authorities, but the fugitive dies. On the other hand, the accomplice comes out, takes the woman's children hostage and forces everyone to help him in the search for the booty abandoned in the area ...

title: Miracle Landing
actors: Connie Sellecca, Wayne Rogers
description: A collection of various humanity travels on an airliner, unaware of the dangers it runs. There are those who fly for work, those who are simply going on vacation and those who reach their boyfriend far away. But a failure forces the plane to attempt a crash landing, to the terror of the passengers.
notes: Inspired by a story that really happened in 1988. The passengers were all saved thanks to the skill of the pilot and the co-pilot, a brave woman. Unfortunately the film tries to dramatize and spectacularize the story, reducing the pathos to a minimum. An escaped true tragedy turns into fiction.

title: Hush... Hush, Sweet Charlotte
actors: Bette Davis, Olivia de Havilland, Joseph Cotten, Agnes Moorehead, Victor Buono
description: Flashback, dance party. Carlotta's boyfriend is not well seen by the girl's family, one of the wealthiest in the south. During the party he is horribly slaughtered with ax blows. Years later, the elderly Carlotta lives in the same house and has not overcome the trauma. A visit from a cousin will not make things better, and indeed will bring forth a horrible plot.
notes: A film halfway between horror and "southern" drama, superbly orchestrated by Aldrich. Made after the success of "What happened to Baby Jane", however, it is not a mere sequel. Davis experienced a true second youth thanks to these two films. Also very good Olivia de Havilland, who replaced Joan Crawford at the last moment.

title: Letters from a Killer
actors: Patrick Swayze, Gia Carides, Roger E. Mosley, Elizabeth Ruscio
description: Race Darnell, unjustly convicted of the murder of his wife, in the seven years spent in prison offers fantasies and romance through various letters and, despite himself, manipulates Lita, Judith, Gloria and Stephanie. This epistolary polygamy is satisfying to everyone. But an exchange of tapes disrupts the harmony of these morbid relationships and Race receives a threatening message from one of the women who wants to take revenge with ferocity for the betrayal.
notes: The discreet subject of this thriller is watered down by a screenplay full of narrative holes with some senseless junctions, and by an uncertain direction.

title: Au c¦ur du mensonge
actors: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Sandrine Bonnaire, Jacques Gamblin
description: In the village of Saint Malo some children find the lifeless body of Eloise, a ten-year-old girl. Frédérique Lasage, a young police commissioner begins the investigation and begins to question René, a drawing professor who seems to have been the last person to have seen the girl alive. Soon the rumors about René and his wife Viviane are wasted and their balance as a couple begins to falter also because of a fascinating writer. A second violent death paralyzes the town.
notes: The old Chabrol continues his "polar" itinerary in the French province. Suspicions, shipwrecked lives, other crimes: the director is especially interested in people, faces, human relationships and (as the original title states) going "to the heart of the lie". A coherent cinema allergic to fashions, where the actors are crucial. Like, for example, Gamblin who (despite the Italian dubbing) emerges with a thousand nuances. And like Sandrine Bonnaire, a child with a woman's body and eyes flooded with melancholy.

title: One True Thing
actors: Meryl Streep, Renée Zellweger, William Hurt, Tom Everett Scott
description: On the threshold of old age, the father and the mother are still those of childhood memories that flow like discolored domestic films. Kate very protective, with a concrete cheerfulness, good in the kitchen, affectionate hostess. George, charming, meticulous professor of literature, author of valuable essays and an unfinished novel. Kate's terminal illness brings Ellen back home and to a reconsideration of past roles and identities.
notes: The plot, based on a Pulitzer Prize-winning Anne Quindlen novel, has no originality, but Streep gives a great virtuosic proof by receiving yet another Oscar nomination. The pre-Bridget Jones Zellwegger was also good.

title: The War Zone
actors: Ray Winstone, Lara Belmont, Tilda Swinton, Freddie Cunliffe
description: The Devon countryside, where the whole family has just moved, is a quiet, lonely place for 15-year-old introverted Tom. Away from his London friends, the boy kills the time of the Easter holidays with his sister Jessie. While their father tries to reorganize his affairs in the countryside and the mother is expecting the third child, Tom continues to be troubled by the attitude of his sister who closes in a moody silence. Until one day he surprises his father in a lonely bunker with his sister ...
notes: Directorial debut by Tim Roth who draws the subject from the beautiful novel by Alexander Stuart. Incest, unhappiness and indifference are the moods and themes that circulate in this first work of an actor-director who above all has respect for his actors and who models a tough film, capable of communicating discomfort.

title: A Simple Plan
actors: Bill Paxton, Billy Bob Thornton, Bridget Fonda, Brent Briscoe
description: The lives of four people are turned upside down by the discovery of a tourist plane in a snowy forest with four million dollars on board. They are money capable of changing their lives; the miserable ones of Lou and Jacob and the fake bourgeois ones of Hank, Jacob's brother, and his wife Sara. It will be the beginning of a circle of paranoia, suspicion and death.
notes: In the blinding whiteness of snowy expanses, Raimi throws away his proverbial irony and grapples with tragedy. A film full of tension, supported by the icy and minimal music of Danny Elfman, in which the human being is transformed into a scary Pandora's box, with the crows as the only spectators of a show of death, the last legacy of an ancient choir.

title: Didier
actors: Jean-Pierre Bacri, Alain Chabat, Isabelle Gelinas, Josiane Balasko
description: Didier is an intelligent and affectionate Labrador who is forced by unspeakable laws to transform himself into a human being. Plunged into the disordered and selfish existence of Jean-Pierre, a football manager of mediocre skills, Didier soon becomes the deus ex machina able to solve his life. Thanks to his help not only does he win back the love of the beautiful Maria, but also saves his career.
notes: A comedy weak in characters and situations, which does not even benefit the friendly participation of Josiane Balasko and Claude Miller.

title: A casa di Irma
actors: Valeria Milillo, Rosalinda Celentano, Angela Ricciardi, Roberto Zibetti
description: Zagor and Paola are two friends who, in a humid and foggy peripheral Milan, share Irma's apartment. The first is a multi-graduate girl who prefers to work in the flower market rather than being trapped all her life in a job she doesn't like. Paola, despite her slightly flustered air, has a steady job and has no particular problems. One day Laura knocks on their door and, little by little, upsets their lives.
notes: Valeria Milillo is simply amazing; Rosalinda Celentano moves her body and hands like her father and has a look that penetrates the walls; the unprecedented Angela Ricciardi proudly plays her part. We understand that the newcomer Alberto Bader is definitely betting on them. Details for the singer Irene Grandi and the writer Matteo Galiazzo.

title: In Dreams
actors: Annette Bening, Aidan Quinn, Robert Downey jr., Stephen Rea
description: Pain and horror penetrate the brain and life of Claire, a cartoonist who is telepathically linked to a serial killer who prefers to kill little girls. The woman lives her follies through premonitory dreams, but at first she is unable to decode their time coordinates, so no one believes her. But the serial killer continues his work of death by striking closer and closer to her, until he decides to find and eliminate him. To do this, Claire must let herself be dominated by the other, through the painful vortex of madness.
notes: While it lacks the density of "The Evil Lord" or the splatter dimension of the "Nightmare" series, the film skillfully handles the dangerous crossroads between reality and dream. The glimpses of the future and the past are images full of charm and dizzying mystery, which however lose consistency when the two are fatally confronted, in an ending open to a possible sequel.

title: Goodbye Lover
actors: Patricia Arquette, Dermot Mulroney, Mary-Louise Parker
description: A public relations guru takes out eight million dollar life insurance. After the unnatural death of the man, brother, sister-in-law and newly married, they find themselves involved in a grueling game of parts, in which alliances and betrayals follow one another relentlessly, all guarded by a strange pair of detectives. He is a dumb Mormon, she is a sort of Callaghan in a skirt, cynical and brisk.
notes: A film that looks like a modern rewrite of Agatha Christie's short stories, with an unpredictable but decidedly weak ending, which does not even retain the aroma of those of the writer from Devon. Worth noting is the reappearance of the revived Don Johnson and the sensual presence of Patricia Arquette, who actually seems convinced that she is still on the set of "Lost Roads".

title: Romance
actors: Caroline Ducey, Sagamore Stévenin, Rocco Siffredi, François Berléand
description: Marie loves Paul but he hasn't wanted to make love with her for six months, claiming that it is normal lack of sexual appetite. Then Marie goes to Paul, who does not love, and ends us in bed; Then he goes to the principal of the school where he teaches and makes himself used as (apparent) object of desire; Finally he returns to Paul, gets pregnant and gives birth.
notes: Among the supporting actors of this talked about the "Italian stallion" Rocco Siffredi appears, better known by his fans as "Mr. 26 cm". But the film is a feminist manifesto, where sex is shown without hypocrisy and one wonders about femininity, couple, love, motherhood. It is the film that Breillat would have liked to make in the seventies, after seeing "the Empire of the senses". And it is a film in which the actors (from the Ducey to Siffredi to Sagamore Stévenin, son of the Truffautiano Jean-François) they dive with courage.

title: Bulworth
actors: Warren Beatty, Halle Berry, Oliver Platt, Paul Sorvino, Jack Warden
description: We are on the threshold of a new millennium, pompously proclaims the attack of the election speeches of Senator Jay Bullworth who, on the eve of the 1996 primary in California, is holding back Clinton's possible rivals. Jay is a typical American politician: a Kenyan generation, ex-handsome, as casual as a star in offering himself to the public, to television, to journalists. Except that tiredness, overwork, insomnia and, deep down, a life that he doesn't like at all, they blow the balance of the senator who, after taking out a billionaire insurance in favor of his daughter, pays a killer because, during the election campaign kill him. And, finally free, he begins to tell the truth to the beat of rap.
notes: The film is a bit confused, overexcited, stitched together by the broken thread of rap. But it is also a film that manages to rediscover that restless vitality and that self-defeating irony that characterized the imperfect examples of American cinema of the Seventies. For someone like Beatty, who was McCabe, John Reed and the hairdresser of "Shampoo", "Bullworth" feels like a homecoming.

title: Darkman III: Die Darkman Die
actors: Arnold Vosloo, Jeff Fahey, Darlanne Fluegel, Roxann Dawson
description: They want to clone poor Darkman. The character created by Sam Raimi is in fact seduced by the diabolical lover of a scientist who would like to isolate the monster's steroids and then duplicate and sell them. But she and the doctor haven't considered all the risks ...
notes: Executive production still in the hands of Raimi, but the level of his first episode (with Liam Neeson) is now far away. Typical B series operation destined for the home video market that exploits a successful cinematic model. Discreet special effects, which do not skimp on brutality. Under the mask of Darkman the handsome Jeff Fahey.

title: Address Unknown
actors: Kyle Howard, Johna Stewart-Bowden, Corbin Allred, Frank Gerrish
description: A very valuable postage stamp becomes the trigger for the murder of two men. Ten years later, Matt son of the murdered, decides to see clearly, starting from the clue of a letter that his father had sent to his mother before being killed.
notes: Philatelic thriller that lacks tension and rhythm.

title: Camp Nowhere
actors: John Putch, Jonathan Jackson, Christopher Lloyd, Peter Scolari
description: What to do when parents try to impose "their" vacation? Morris gets around the problem by organizing a fake camp site for a school trip. All his classmates play in favor of cheating, but he would lack the support of a teacher. And at that point just a professor ...
notes: Very thin comedy designed especially for an audience of children. The ideas are few, you find them even fewer comical. Christopher Lloyd is now specializing in similar productions.

title: Bittersweet
actors: Angie Everhart, James Russo, Eric Roberts, Brian Wimmer, Joe Penny
description: A truly dangerous triangle: Angie Everhart is a killer woman, Sam, an American clone of Nikita, beautiful and fatal. His mission is revenge: he has long been on the trail of Jed, an unscrupulous criminal. Among them the third wheel, the policeman Massa who would like to stop them both. Sam's overwhelming beauty will be the trap and the tool to defuse the two enemies once and for all. Not everything, of course, goes smoothly ... Action TV-movie slightly above average. The Italian-American native Bercovici mocks Tarantino and the Hong Kong detective, but the strong point is in the cast.

title: Gramps
actors: John Ritter, Andy Griffith, Mary-Margaret Humes
description: After a long search, successful lawyer Clarke MacGruder manages to find her father Jack, whom she initially believed dead and then pursued for years. At first, father and son seem happy to have found each other, and to be able to rebuild their broken family. During a hunting party, however, Jack shows a violent temper. TV movie with no particular pretensions, already broadcast under the title of "Lethal Intent". John Ritter, the protagonist, is the famous character of "Three Hearts for Rent" but also of "Skin deep" by Blake Edwards. Usually comfortable with brilliant roles, this time he tries his hand at a thriller.

title: With a Vengeance
actors: Melissa Gilbert, Michael Gross, Jack Scalia, Matthew Lawrence
description: Frank, a meek and quiet man, in a moment of madness due to a raptus kills his wife and children. Valeria, Frank's eldest daughter, is the only one to escape the massacre. Unfortunately, however, she has time to witness the massacre and flees in terror. Frank chases her, but to no avail. After a few years we find Valeria who suffers from amnesia, calls herself Gena and has rebuilt a new life. She is a babysitter and tries to remove even the most rarefied memories of that terrible night. It seems that for her it is over but it is not so: her father has not given up looking for her and it happens that the two meet ...

title: Perfect Body
actors: Amy Jo Johnson, Wendie Malick, Brett Cullen, Ray Baker
description: Andie Burton is a girl who is fully satisfied with her life: she is surrounded by friends, she is engaged to the most popular boy in school and has an excellent academic performance. Only one thing makes her different from her peers: Andie is an excellent gymnast and could easily compete in the Olympics. Discovered by a talent scout, the girl is offered to train to participate in the games. Supported by her mother, the new athlete is preparing to face this new adventure. Coach Brooks believes Andie needs to lose weight to improve performance. But the girl's diet soon leads to anorexia. The obsessive destruction of her own body causes Andie to withdraw into herself, losing friends and boyfriend. The film aims to reflect on one of the most common problems among adolescents (especially girls): anorexia. And it also has a "moral of the story": is a gold medal (but also a fashion show, or a film audition) worth life?

title: Trilogy of Terror II
actors: Lysette Anthony, Matt Clark, Geraint Wyn Davies, Geoffrey Lewis
description: Three horror stories: in the first a woman and her lover are killed by her husband. In the second, an elderly mother makes a pact with the devil to resurrect her dead son. In the last one, a Zuni fetish is awakened from its sleep and begins to sow death. Second chapter of a trilogy directed by Curtis in 1975. The hallmark of this series B horror is the Zuni puppet, which in the first episode ended up in the oven. Compared to the model, the performers are anonymous and there is a more televised atmosphere.

title: Voyage of Terror
actors: Lindsay Wagner, Michael Ironside, Brian Dennehy, Martin Sheen
description: A new and deadly virus epidemic breaks out on board the cruise ship Orion Star. Stephanie Tauber, a scientist, is among the passengers along with her daughter. The President of the United States, after ordering the ship's quarantine, instructs Stephanie to take control of the situation. The ship becomes the laboratory where the woman searches for the vaccine to defeat the epidemic. Meanwhile, the infected passengers begin to die. The President's advisor, however, by playing a double game exploits the misfortune to put the boss in a bad light and hinder his re-election.

title: The Scout
actors: Albert Brooks, Brendan Fraser, Michael Rapaport
description: Al Percolo, talent scout for the New York Yankees baseball team, casually sees young Steve playing in a city field. The boy is a real phenomenon, both as a hitter and as a catcher. Al's eyes shine: in fact Steve is a real champion, but also a person with serious mental problems ...
notes: Inspired by a true story, taken from an article by the famous sports reporter Roger Angell. Actor Albert Brooks (co-writer, with Andrew Bergman and Monica Mcgowan Johnson) fell in love with the story and took a personal interest in turning it into a film. There are many professional baseball players who appear in the role of themselves.

title: Hostile Intent
actors: Rob Lowe, John Savage, Sofia Shinas, Saul Rubinek, James Kidnie
description: Mike Cleary and his team of programmers invented the software of the century: the "Guardian system", a multiple system capable of resisting any type of computer virus. To celebrate, the team decides to take a weekend away by participating in the simulated war, the one with weapons that shoot paint bullets. The antagonist team is led by Cleary's former boss. You bet that at some point the harmless guns toyed with will start spitting lead right? Bet won. The enemy is in the shadows, determined not to let anyone return from that tragic weekend.

title: Tales from the Crypt
directors: Walter Hill, Robert Zemeckis, Richard Do
actors: William Sadler, Larry Drake, Joe Pantoliano
description: Three episodes inspired by the horror comics of the E.C. Comics. In the first, an unemployed executioner decides to continue self-employment. In the second, a serial killer disguises himself as Santa Claus and celebrates by sowing death. In the third, a man has a feline gland transplanted and acquires nine lives.
notes: Television product (also released on the screens) that continues in the contamination between comics and cinema started by George Romero with "Creepshow", also taken from the glorious comics of William Gaines. The limits of the format do not mortify the aesthetic result but the special effects are inferior to those of Tom Savini. Not to be confused with "Tales from the Crypt", also taken from the gaines comics and directed twenty years earlier by Freddie Francis.

title: Torino Boys
actors: Juliet Omoniji, Paul Anthony Anderson, Luca Laurenti
description: Two groups of Nigerians who emigrated to Italy. The first lives in Turin, the other in Rome. One of the "Torino Boys" meets and falls in love with one of the girls from Rome. On the occasion of a football match, he organizes a trip to the capital with all his friends. Meanwhile, another young Nigerian, Ifueko, who has just arrived in the city, is helped by an Italian.
notes: The film is part of a series entitled "Another country in my eyes" which Marco Bellocchio collaborated on. His son Pier Giorgio is behind the scenes as a producer. The music is by rapper Neffa.

title: Happy Gilmore
actors: Adam Sandler, Christopher McDonald, Julie Bowen, Frances Bay
description: Happy Gilmore despite having an immoderate passion for ice hockey does not know how to skate. Equipped with a deadly "blow" he devotes himself to golf. A little for fun and a little by chance he begins his adventure on the golf courses. In spite of the pompous snobs of the clubs who would like to remove him, Happy conquers green in bursts and becomes a champion.
notes: Comedy without praise and without infamy that tells of an ordinary man dropped in the middle of a haughty and aristocratic environment. The protagonist would be mimicking Jimmy Stewart.

title: Il bagno turco. Hamam
actors: Alessandro Gassmann, Francesca D'Aloja, Francesca D'Aloja, Mehmet Gunsur, Mehmet Gunsur, Halil Ergün, Halil Ergün, Serif Sezer, Serif Sezer, Basak Köklükaya, Basak Köklükaya, Alberto Molinari, Alberto Molinari, Carlo Cecchi, Carlo Cecchi, Zerrin Arbas, Zerrin Arbas
description: A rampant architect married to a cheating career woman inherits a Turkish bath in Istanbul from his aunt. He leaves Rome a little annoyed with the intention of quickly selling the whole hut. But the Turkish family that guards the hamam and a particular love story will make him change his mind.
notes: Interesting debut of the Turkish, but Italian by adoption, Ferzan Ozpetek. The subject does not have much that is new, however the director returns the enveloping atmosphere of the exotic path with its mixture of seduction and violence. Unfortunately, the proof of the main actors is not excellent.

title: The Mephisto Waltz
actors: Alan Alda, Jacqueline Bisset, Curt Jurgens
description: A mediocre pianist finds the easiest way to success and increase his talent. A nice pact with Satan through his emissary Roxanne, daughter of a great musician who recently passed away. The pianist's wife senses that something evil is happening to her husband and goes to counterattack.
notes: The plot is incredibly confusing. At a certain point it is no longer clear who is embodied in whom and how many characters decide to sacrifice themselves to the devil. Which is, as is known, a woman. Wendkos, however, does not hold back in terms of scares and at least the atmosphere is the right one. Gorgeous Jacqueline Bisset.

title: Diamondbacks
actors: Miles O'Keefe, Eb Lottimer, Chris Mitchum
description: Missoula in Montana is a famous city for two reasons: David Lynch was born there and nothing ever happens there. But one bad day a far-right militia calling itself "the diamondbacks" decides to come out after years of practicing in secret. The militia attacks a federal center and takes an aeronautical engineer hostage working on a major telecommunications-related project. The terrorist leader forces the technician to take control of a space satellite that is about to be launched into orbit. The first to be in danger are the crew members at this point.

title: Wanda Nevada
actors: Peter Fonda, Brooke Shields, Fiona Lewis
description: Nevada is still wild, but a couple of adventurous poker players still decide to brave the hostile environment in order to reach the Grand Canyon. Because there, between the rapids and inlets of the river, there is gold.
notes: The film is actually modest. However, he is the only one that Fonda father and Fonda son have filmed together. Since they haven't spoken to each other for years (Henry didn't forgive Peter for being "left"), _Wanda Nevada_ thus represents a moment of reconciliation between the old lion and the offspring of _Easy Rider_. Fonda Jr. as a director did better in '71 with _The Return of Harry Collings_.

title: Il matrimonio
actors: Alberto Sordi, Vittorio De Sica, Silvana Pampanini, Renato Rascel
description: The landowner Lomov goes to his doctor to ask for his daughter in marriage. On the way he meets a friend who begins to illustrate all the negative sides of marriage. Lomov is convinced and decides not to marry again, also because as soon as he sees his beloved, he quarrels.
notes: An appreciated documentarian, Petrucci ventures into fiction by reducing three single acts by Céchov and keeping the characters' names and characters intact. His direction does not have particular impetus, however the overall picture convinces. Especially thanks to the cast, which avoids throwing everything into farce. Vittorio De Sica stands out above all.

title: Riavanti... marsh!
actors: Carlo Giuffrè, Alberto Lionello, Renzo Montagnani, Aldo Maccione
description: Five professionals now close to the "door", are called to arms. At the beginning it is a tragedy, then the mature stoners will rediscover the complicity and the desire to laugh at youth. A backward leap that will be abruptly interrupted by the return to their respective responsibilities.
notes: One of the worst films by Salce, which even lacks the courage to be completely a "butt and sword" scollacciato. Despite the presence of the kings of the genre Renzo Montagnani and Anna Maria Rizzoli.

title: Te sto aspettanno
actors: Beniamino Maggio, Maria Paris
description: Alfredo, the young owner of Officine Squillace, is not very fond of work and always looking for gallant adventures. The smooth running of the company is ensured by Piero, the foreman, and his nephew Carlo, engaged to the beautiful Maria. So beautiful that Alfredo begins to take an interest in her. His goal is to get Carlo away from the factory.
notes: Melodrammone of those who were made in the 50s for a mainly female audience. Fizzarotti sr. it is limited to ordinary administration.

title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
actors: Christopher Lloyd, Jason Robards, Richard Farnsworth, Klinton Spilsbury
description: Young ranger John Ried is the only survivor of a massacre organized by the bandit Cabendich who dictates the law in Texas. Seriously injured, the boy is rescued by a comanche, Tonto, who helps him to recover. John Ried vows revenge and turns into the "Lone Ranger" to fight the bad guys.
notes: The origins of Lone Ranger, popular hero of the American tradition already protagonist of a successful TV series. A kind of Masked Man in the Far West, complete with a mask and legendary silver bullets. Farnsworth stars in David Lynch's "The Straight Story".

title: Rear Window
actors: Christopher Reeve, Daryl Hannah, Robert Forster, Ruben Santiago-Hudson
description: Jason Kemp is a brilliant architect who has had everything from life. However, a terrible car accident forces him to live forever in a wheelchair. Waiting for an operation that could possibly save him, Jason kills time by spying on his neighbors from the window. And one day, in the apartment opposite, he seems to see a murder. Kemp talks about his suspicions to Claudia, his faithful friend, and to Detective Moore, who he thinks is all the result of a dream.
notes: Television remake of the famous Hitchcock film. The film marks the return of Christopher Reeve to the scene after the incident that rendered him invalid.

title: Stroszek
actors: Bruno S., Eva Mattes, Clemens Sheitz
description: Naive Stroszek is released after a period of detention and befriends a prostitute. She is persecuted by the protector and to escape the evil once and for all she decides to run away with her new friend to the United States. For the couple, however, life overseas will be anything but easy.
notes: Portrait of an inner and outer hell with non-professional actors (apart from Eva Mattes). Herzog draws with a clear and merciless gaze the boundaries of the earth "of possibilities" which however rejects the marginalized. A desperate film but with a pure heart, like that of the poor protagonist.

title: Hit and Run
actors: Margaret Colin, Lisa Vidal, Drew Pillsbury, Chris Boscia, Paul Brewster
description: No event can affect the life of meticulous Joanna. That is until the day he runs into an eight-year-old girl who is violently thrown in front of her car. As she prays for the child to be saved, Joanna thinks back on her peaceful life as a wife and mother. Hers is only an apparent happiness, because in reality the woman realizes that she is a victim of futility and lies. Days go by, investigators look for the person who hit the child, Joanna feels the earth crumble under her feet. He can no longer live as before, the same family begins to be overwhelming.

title: Kiss and Tell
actors: Cheryl Ladd, Peter Howitt, John Terry, Gillian Bevan, Danny Worters
description: Jean McAvoy, a wealthy travel agency owner, is married to Eric, a man who apparently loves her madly. But one day a mysterious girl, Kelly Krieger, comes to upset Jean's peaceful and peaceful life. Kelly, Eric's longtime lover, claims that the man hired a killer to kill his wife. The young woman does not want to be involved in the murder and for this she warns her rival, who asks for help from Dan, a policeman friend. Unfortunately, after a first false alarm, no one seems to take the woman seriously anymore, now on the verge of a nervous breakdown.

title: Man of Miracles
actors: John Ritter, Linda Purl, Meredith Baxter, David Tom, Kayla Campbell
description: Joe Cass is the country pastor of St. Florian's Episcopal Church. The man lives a quiet and rather monotonous life with his wife Anne and their three children. The only concern is the parishioners, who desert Sunday services. One day a fire breaks out in the Mexican slum. Joe throws himself into the flames in a desperate attempt to save a child, Ezequiel. When everything seems lost for the parish priest and the child, a firefighter miraculously appears and guides them out of the hellfire. The whole country cries out for a miracle and faith seems to be becoming very popular again ...

title: Closer and Closer
actors: Kim Delaney, Scott York
description: An invalid writer begins receiving disturbing emails immediately after the publication of her latest novel. The maniac identifies with one of the characters invented by the writer.

title: Gabriela
actors: Sonia Braga, Marcello Mastroianni, Antonio Cantafora
description: A restaurant owner hires a beautiful, free-spirited girl as a cook and waitress. He falls in love with her and becomes her lover, but discovers that the woman continues to have relationships with others as well. This is why he hunts her after a furious quarrel, only to discover that he cannot be without her.
notes: From Jorge Amado's novel "Gabriela, carnation and cinnamon" an entire soap opera was also taken. Which probably also influences this modest film by Bruno Barreto, completely devoid of sensual bite, only partially redeemed by the test of Mastroianni and della Braga.

title: Love, Cheat & Steal
actors: John Lithgow, Eric Roberts, Mädchen Amick
description: Betrayed by Lauren, his partner and accomplice in many robberies, Reno's only goal is to get out of prison to get revenge. Lauren has meanwhile married Harrington, a wealthy businessman who has been given the task of reorganizing a credit institution. Thanks to a ruse, Reno and his cellmate manage to escape and reach the Harrington's luxurious home. Reno introduces himself as Lauren's brother, who, in order not to reveal her troubled past to her husband, decides to play along. At this point Reno turns the situation to his advantage and forces the woman to help him in a robbery.

title: La nottata
actors: Sara Sperati, Susanna Javicoli, Giorgio Albertazzi
description: Two unscrupulous Milanese girls met by chance in a toilet where they found a very precious jewel. They would like to sell it and for this they rely on a taxi driver who accompanies them in the slums in search of a fence. But the buyer is found dead.
notes: Interesting experiment (and also unscrupulous for the time) to tell the night odyssey of two women grappling with the pitfalls of "Milan by night". Unfortunately, the operation is not supported by a convincing staging. The "documentary" tone of a sexy dossier is cloying and superficial.

title: L'appartamento
actors: Konya Rousseva Stefanova, Emad Ibrahim, Anita Laurenzi
description: Mamud is a pizza chef in a Roman restaurant and, one day, after getting a permit, he goes to kidnap a very young girl. The child is particularly dear to him, since the man fills her with affection and attention. At this point Mamud is desperately looking for a place to go, but despite his best efforts he cannot find it and is therefore forced to break into an apartment vacated by a couple on vacation. Meanwhile Layla, who comes from the desolate outskirts of the East and who works as a cleaning lady to make a living, goes to the apartment where Mamud has taken refuge.
notes: First work by Francesca Pirani who has collaborated with Marco Bellocchio since 1987.

title: Milo
actors: Asher Metchik, Vincent Schiavelli, Jennifer Jostyn, Antonio Fargas
description: In a small provincial town, four girls witness the ferocious murder of a girl of the same age by Milo, a young man who disappears immediately after the crime. They find him on the bank of a river and his father Jeeder, coroner of the community, certifies his death. Sixteen years later the four girls have not been able to forget the experience, they live with nightmares and continue to see the girl torn apart by Milo. But the nightmare is about to turn into reality, because the killer comes out of nowhere to hit the protagonists. He begins to torture them psychologically then moves on to de facto ways. But is the resurrected serial killer a ghost or a man of flesh and blood?
notes: Horror night with guaranteed scares. The genre is the "slasher", a sub-theme of the thriller style "Friday the 13th" and "Scream", with homicidal maniac at work and terrified girls from start to finish. One of the protagonists, Antonio Fargas, is the unforgettable Huggy Bear from the telefilm "Starsky & Hutch".

title: Le bossu
actors: Daniel Auteuil, Marie Gillain, Vincent Perez, Fabrice Luchini, Philippe Noiret
description: In 17th-century France, the foundling Lagardere meets the rich world of royal nobility. Having become a friend and bodyguard to the Duke of Nevers for his skill with the sword, Lagardere finds himself at the center of a family intrigue hatched by Count Gonzaga, the Duke's cousin. Unjustly accused of the Duke's death, Lagardere manages to save his little daughter, while the Duchess, mad with grief, is guarded by the perfidious Gonzaga.
notes: An exhausting story in which chivalrous themes are mixed with ante litteram stock market considerations and non-conformist loves. And a sumptuous cast enriches a staging that is pleasantly reminiscent of American swashbuckling classics.

title: The Theory of Flight
actors: Helena Bonham Carter, Kenneth Branagh, Gemma Jones
description: Jane is a disabled person nailed to a wheelchair by a neurological disease. Grumpy and cynical, Jane finds serenity only when the failed painter Richard falls into her life, due to his passion for flying. Prostrated by an existential crisis, the man threw himself from the roof of a London museum with a hang glider made with his canvases. Sentenced to one year of civilian service, abandoned town and girlfriend, Richard devotes himself to a passion for flying and, obliged by law, to Jane's assistance.
notes: Despite obvious black holes in the script and a blatantly televised matrix, Branagah and Bonham Carter manage to make plausible the relationship between two creatures in desperate need of normality.

title: The Parent Trap
actors: Lindsay Lohan, Dennis Quaid, Natasha Richardson
description: In a summer camp, two girls discover that they are twins, separated in the cradle by the aberrant and selfish decision of their parents to leave and divide the girls. The two girls decide to switch roles to meet the parent they never had and plan their reunion. Frantic phone calls chase each other between London and California and the father's unexpected upcoming marriage seems to undermine the plan, but the twins have many arrows in their bows.
notes: For some years, Disney has chosen the policy of re-editing its most successful films of the past. "Parents in the trap", a 1990s remake of "The cowboy with the bridal veil" (1960), a dull comedy based on a reckless sense of filial possession, cannot escape this logic. Success is therefore guaranteed for a sophisticated, cunning comedy that faithfully adheres to a highly successful original, and which is also lucky enough to count on the happy discovery of Lindsay Lohan in the role of the twins, worthy heir not only to Hayley Mills (star of " The cowboy with the bridal veil "), but above all of the now adult Christina Ricci.

title: Legionnaire
actors: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje
description: Alain is a boxer who has to flee Marseille for stalking the wife of the local boss and for refusing to sell a match. We are in the 1920s, and his only chance of escape is recruiting into the Foreign Legion; in Morocco between the harsh discipline of the legion and the bloody attacks of the Berber tribes, Alain finally comes to terms with his past.
notes: For once Van Damme abandons the worn out clothes of the kickboxeur at any cost and the result is definitely positive. Peter MacDonald's film proves to be a little surprise. In this story of action, passion and betrayal, what is most striking is the high directorial class of MacDonald, who masters the sequence shot with almost Altmanian mastery and who demonstrates a great ease even with the spectacular war scenes. Surrounded by all this luxury, even the aton Van Damme manages to make a good figure, without giving up on his hands, an activity that still remains his best virtue.

title: Culastrisce nobile veneziano
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Claudia Mori, Lino Toffolo
description: During a terrible storm, the Marquis Luca Maria Sbrisson sees his wife Luisa disappear from under his eyes. Perhaps in the grip of madness, the marquis acts as if nothing had happened, talking and listening to his wife's "ghost". A musician friend of the Marquis, faced with an attempt by some nobles to have the man interned, recruits a prostitute to take the place of the missing woman.
notes: From the series "the woman is better to dream of her than to have her next to her". A comedy written by Maurizio Costanzo and conceived as a fairy tale. There are many falls in tone, but the skill of the actors ensures a certain quality.

title: The Corruptor
actors: Chow Yun-fat, Mark Wahlberg, Rick Young, Brian Cox
description: Chinatown is a world apart. It has its own laws, its own masters, even its own cops. Unscrupulous people like Chen who use the same methods as criminals to fight the emerging mafia. At the same time he is careful not to disturb too much the real boss of the neighborhood who dispenses dollars and prostitutes as if they were lottery tickets. The cop's new partner has Irish origins, he adapts badly to the Chinese milieu, he is honest but basically corruptible like the others.
notes: After some opaque rehearsals, the independent James Foley returns to the levels of his best exploits ("At Close Range", "Americans"), without getting too involved in the Hong Kong crime fad. "The Corruptor - Investigation in Chinatown" actually looks like a movie from the seventies, when the violent arm of the law was really disrespectful of the rules. A backward dive that even coincides with the linguistic rediscovery of the much-maligned zoom and which offers the star Chow Yun-Fat the first important role of his new American career. The confrontation between Wahlberg and his disgraced father is memorable in its theatricality.

title: Star Trek. Insurrection
actors: Patrick Stewart, Jonathan Frakes, Brent Spiner, LeVar Burton
description: During an exploratory mission to the peaceful planet of the Ba'ku, Lieutenant Commander Data shows signs of rebellion. The Enterprire comes to the rescue and discovers the true cause of the android insurrection: the Son'a people are trying to steal from the Ba'ku, with the complicity of an admiral, the fountain of eternal youth ...
notes: Despite having reached its ninth episode, the "old fashion" atmosphere and rhythm of the saga still remain intact. The dialogues, pseudoscientific, are irresistible. A precious chapter to understand the Trekkian philosophy on men and machines. The direction is entrusted, as often happens in films taken from _The next generation_ to "number one" Jonathan Freaks.

title: The Fear Inside
actors: Christine Lahti, Dylan McDermott, Jennifer Rubin, David Ackroyd
description: Bad thing agoraphobia. A woman illustrating children's books is so terrified of open spaces that she can't even leave the house. Invite a female student to her apartment for some company. The two are joined by the young woman's brother, who was left homeless. With the two boys in the house, strange sensations begin to assail the woman.
notes: Television film made with an old classic with Olivia De Havilland in mind, "A Day of Terror".

title: The Woman on the Beach
actors: Joan Bennett, Robert Ryan, Charles Bickford
description: An American naval officer meets the wife of a famous blind painter. The woman is linked to her husband only by the observance of the family bond, in reality she has not felt anything for him for years. Also for this reason he reciprocates the attraction of the officer by establishing a sensual and dangerous bond with him.
notes: A glaring case of a failed masterpiece. Not because of the director, but because of the nefarious influence of the producers who in defiance of Renoir massacred the film. The ending, for example, is not what the director wanted.

title: Room Service
actors: Groucho Marx, Harpo Marx, Chico Marx, Lucille Ball
description: The members of the theater company housed in the hotel are one worse than the other. Producer Miller (Groucho), director Binelli (Chico) and manager Faker (Harpo). They don't have a penny but still manage to convince Miller's brother-in-law to give a substantial loan. In return, they promise to stage a show and split the proceeds.
notes: It is perhaps not the best production of the Marx Bros. company but it guarantees a concentrate of gags. Excellent idea of ??carrying out the action in two rooms, which with the Marx closed inside are transformed into atomic bombs.

title: Il mistero dei tre continenti
actors: Martha Hyer, Carlos Thompson, Micheline Presle, Gino Cervi
description: Professor Johansen, an eminent Swedish scientist has discovered a nuclear reaction equal to that of all power plants around the world. An experiment causes the destruction of the laboratory and the temporary paralysis of all the plants in Stockholm. The authorities decide to transfer the scientist and his Indian aide to a secret location. However, this does not prevent the two from being kidnapped.
notes: Good adventure film by William Dieterle, in European co-production.

title: Behind Enemy Lines
actors: Thomas Ian Griffith, Chris Mulkey, Mark Carlton
description: In an Israeli prison, Palestinian Issam and Israeli Uri fight together against the abuses of the prison regime and a corrupt guard. Between rawness and emotion, a remarkable Israeli production, significant above all from the civil point of view, but also directed with a sure hand.

title: Taxi girl
actors: Edwige Fenech, Aldo Maccione, George Hilton, Enzo Cannavale
description: The young and beautiful Marcella inherited a taxi, the relative license and the vocation from her father. The girl is romantically linked to Ramon who, unbeknownst to Marcella, is already married to the old and racchia Ornella. Barely escaping a sheikh's dollars, the taxi driver must defend herself from the court of a drug dealer.
notes: Low level of comedy and verisimilitude. The Fenech, however, is always a beautiful sight.

title: Undercurrent
actors: Lorenzo Lamas, Frank Vincent, Brenda Strong, Philip Anthony
description: The anguish and problems, even family ones, of the pilot colonel Paul Tibbets who, at the end of the Second World War, was charged with the material execution of the secret project that led to the launch of the first atomic bomb on the Japanese city of Hiroshima. The bombing caused a real massacre and forced the Japanese to surrender, but in the foreground in the film is the conscience drama of Tibbets.
notes: Trivial drama in which it seems that the only victim of the Hiroshima tragedy is the American officer who is the protagonist of the film.

title: How Stella Got Her Groove
actors: Angela Bassett, Whoopi Goldberg, Taye Diggs
description: Stella is forty, an aggressive stockbroker, separated, has one son, two petulant sisters, lives in San Francisco, is beautiful, black and lonely. The son joins his father for a vacation and she leaves with an old friend for Jamaica. The two ex-girls are looking for relaxation and some adventure. Stella meets a 20-year-old and in a few hours, after some perplexity, she is sex and feeling, nostalgia and molasses.
notes: The lines slip from the philosophical, "God lives here", to the boorish, easygoing, "That boy left another movement in your ass." Terry McMillan's script is ramshackle, it masks the substantial vulgarity of the story with location; customs and professions that should be sleek and modern. Goldberg's character appears and disappears randomly from the plot. The mediocre direction is inspired by photo novels.
