title: I misteri della giungla nera
actors: Guy Madison, Inge Schoner, Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Ivan Desny
description: For fifteen years Captain MacPerson searched, in vain, for his daughter kidnapped at the age of three by the Tughs. The opportunity to continue the investigation presents itself to the officer when the English Command calls him back to service to lead an expedition against the rebels. While the men commanded by MacPerson are about to disembark in the place where the Tughs are supposed to have taken refuge, Tremal-Naik also arrives on the trail of the rebel tribe.
notes: Ragged and frayed version of the classic by Emilio Salgari.

title: Fiddler on the Roof
actors: Topol, Norma Crane, Leonard Frey, Rosalind Harris
description: In a Ukrainian village at the turn of the century, a Jewish milkman finds himself involved in the regime's first persecutions against his race. To escape the pogroms he decides to emigrate to the United States and his journey turns into a real odyssey.
notes: The title refers to a Hebrew saying: the musician forced to play in impossible conditions (on a roof) is like the Jew forced to live on a razor's edge. Jewison's film is based on Jospeh Stein's successful musical, itself inspired by the stories of Scholem Alecheim and has some good moments, but also a few drops of rhythm. John Williams, author of the Spielberg soundtracks, won the Oscar for music, cops as cinematographer Oswald Morris. On the violin Isaac Stern.

title: Secret Ceremony
actors: Elizabeth Taylor, Mia Farrow, Robert Mitchum
description: A rich heiress, orphaned and subjected to the excessively morbid attention of her stepfather, hires a prostitute to "play" her mother's part. The prostitute accepts for the money but later takes her new role too seriously, completely upsetting the already difficult family balance.
notes: The author of "The Servant" tries to extricate himself from a narrative skein that casually mixes psychoanalysis and melodrama. Despite his unquestionable skill, the film is in some parts tiring. The choice of famous American actors certainly does not help: Robert Mitchum's stepfather, for example, is not very credible.

title: Her Own Rules
actors: Melissa Gilbert, Jean Simmons, Jerry Sheffield, Lorraine Pilkington
description: Meredith is a charming, intelligent and successful woman; his life, bright and comfortable, is enviable. Apparently happy and satisfied, Meredith is actually restless: an unpleasant episode linked to her childhood and of which she remembers nothing disturbs her existence. Terrible nightmares ruin his nights. The occasion of a trip to her hometown gives Meredith the opportunity to investigate her past and uncover her dark secret. The meeting with Lucas, a fascinating architect, opens Meredith's heart, but she realizes that she has to solve all her problems before she can really love ...

title: Fall Into Darkness
actors: Jonathan Brandis, Sean Murray, Charlotte Ross, Danielle Nicolet
description: In an American town, everything happens with boring regularity. The boys get together to try to have fun. Jerry meets Sharon and together they go to a party where she meets Ann, Jerry's sister. A tragedy upsets the party: Jerry dies under a train and his sister, believing it to be Sharon's fault, decides to take revenge by concocting a fake murder and then making her suspicious. Just when everything is going as the girl had foreseen, suddenly Ann really disappears. Sharon, who had been arrested, is released and the police begin their investigation.

title: The Leopard Man
actors: Dennis O'Keefe, Margo, Jean Brooks, Isabel Jewell, James Bell
description: A cabaret singer comes out on stage with a leopard on a leash. The feline escapes and assaults a girl. From that moment on, two other brutal attacks take place, but the protagonist and her manager do not believe at all to be the fault of the beast.
notes: Third and last film made by the couple Lewton-Tourneur after "The kiss of the panther" and "I walked with a zombie". Another atmospheric horror that ranges in metaphysical fear and places men in front of the phobia of their dark (and bestial) side. Loosely inspired by the novel "Black Alibi" by Cornell Woolrich. A jewel of tension.

title: In Dark Places
actors: Joan Severance, Bryan Kestner, Walter Olkewicz, John Vargas
description: Chapelle Donaldi was estranged from her father many years earlier because she was guilty of involving her brother in an incestuous relationship. After the death of his father, Chaz became heir to the entire family estate, leaving his sister penniless. Chapelle has returned from Italy after years of being away to regain possession of what she is entitled to, and also something more ... To achieve this goal she is determined to use all the weapons she has at her disposal, even the most sneaky. With the brother / ex-lover it is now open war.
notes: Burke's film ran into serious problems with censorship when it aired on American cable television. More for the abstract subject (incest remains a taboo) than for real rough scenes. The cast is completely anonymous. The director is just a namesake of the great hard boiled novelist James Lee Burke.

title: Road Ends
actors: Dennis Hopper, Peter Coyote, Mariel Hemingway, Chris Sarandon
description: A provincial sheriff finds himself in the city the highly sought-after drug trafficker Maceda, once a precious informant of the FBI. On his trail there is a real mastiff, a tough FBI who chases him to take him as a witness in a trial against the old commander of the Orosco bureau, heavily suspected of being the head of a drug trafficking. There is nowhere to go and Maceda decides to resist the hunt as long as he can, knowing that he may not arrive alive to testify. The sheriff gets involved in a game bigger than him ...
notes: Television detective story enhanced by the cast.

title: Jerry & Tom
actors: Joe Mantegna, Sam Rockwell, Ted Danson, Charles Durning, William H. Macy
description: Jerry and Tom are two colleagues who work in a used car shop, but in their spare time they carry out the profession of unscrupulous killer, with Tom in the role of the teacher and Jerry in that of the apprentice. Their clients are the owners of the salon, two fat guys, elderly and with the smell of the mafia. During the activity between the two a deep sense of friendship arises, but everything is always subordinated to higher orders and often affection and duty do not go together.
notes: A surprising film, which starts slowly and then acquires inexorably rhythm, supported by an excellent cast and convincing direction, which has its best quality in the surprising transitions of time and place without interruption.

title: Tom's Midnight Garden
actors: Greta Scacchi, James Wilby, Joan Plowright, David Bradley
description: The old mansion has been divided into apartments and of the ancient splendor only a clock fixed to the wall remains. It will be the bizarre chimes (thirteen to midnight) to reveal to little Tom, a guest of his uncles, that time can be a swing. In fact, to break the boredom of days that are all the same, punctually at the stroke of midnight, the house rediscovers the paintings, mirrors, luxury and its old inhabitants of another era. The closed door of the waste yard opens onto a beautiful garden.
notes: The fascination of the temporal paradox is not enough to redeem a cutesy, boring, repetitive, fake elegant film. The chosen set would look great in a snack commercial.

title: Il moralista
actors: Alberto Sordi, Vittorio De Sica, Franco Fabrizi, Maria Perschy
description: Augustine, the upright secretary of the International Office of Morality, is known by all for the relentless struggle he wages every day in favor of the common sense of modesty. In reality, the man is the head of a gang that "imports" night dancers by placing them on the prostitution market.
notes: Small revenge against the censorship regime that persecuted the cinema of the 1950s. The satire isn't very sharp, but Sordi is hilarious.

title: Die! Die! My Darling
actors: Tallulah Bankhead, Stefanie Powers, Peter Vaughan, Maurice Kaufmann
description: Young Pat Carroll visits the mother of her first boyfriend, who died under tragic circumstances. The woman, who lives with the two servants Harry and Anna, immediately appears visibly upset. She decides to stop for the night and leave the next day, but she doesn't know that a spiral of violence and terror awaits her, unleashed by the sick mind of her mother-in-law.
notes: Narrizzano is a good director, but the script is a mess of impossible situations and characters so excessive as to be meaningless.

title: Twin Sitters
actors: Peter Paul, David Paul, Christian Cousins, Joseph Cousins
description: Entrepreneur Frank Hillhurst is involved in shady deals. When he decides to collaborate with the police, he fears the revenge of his ancient allies, and especially fears for the life of his two nephews, the twins Bradley and Steven, entrusted to him after the death of their parents. He then hires twin bodybuilders Peter and David Falcone as bodyguards and babysitters. But the two never expected to have to look after such pestiferous children. Unstable between drama and comedy, the TV movie is an innocent pastime for viewers in need of moderate escapism.

title: La prima notte
actors: Martine Carol, Jacques Sernas, Vittorio De Sica
description: Isabella, a young adventurer on vacation in Venice, passes herself off as a wealthy billionaire: in reality, her aim is to frame a handsome rich man to take to the altar. Attracted by her incredible jewelry collection, swindler Alfredo and the painter Gérard hatch a plan to rob her. Everything works perfectly, except that Gérard loses his head for the girl and retraces his steps. Not so Alfredo, who wants to score the blow of his life ...
notes: Weak yellow-pink comedy that not even the direction of Cavalcanti and a good group of actors are able to lift from a narrow sufficiency.

title: Emanuelle nera. Orient reportage
actors: Laura Gemser, Gabriele Tinti, Ivan Rassimov, Giacomo Rossi Stuart
description: Emanuelle has become a journalist. And her New York newspaper sent her to Bangkok to report on the habits and customs of the population. Here the black Venus meets Prince Sanit, the emperor's cousin, who introduces her to the erotic joys of Thailand.
notes: Joe D'Amato (aka Aristide Massaccesi) is a respected craftsman, who in his long career has dedicated himself to the most disparate genres (western included). The erotic should be her prime ground but in this case she struggles through the clichés of soft porn. Too many images seem fake. However, the exotic beauty of the Gemser remains.

title: Frankenstein's Daughter
actors: John Ashley, Sandra Knight, Donald Murphy, Felix Locher, Sally Todd
description: A contemporary descendant of Baron Frankenstein believes he also inherited madness from his infamous ancestor. In fact, he would like to transform a murdered girl into a new creature. When the experiment fails, he thinks well to try again with his niece.
notes: Silly horror with a parody vein. Those were the years in which kids monsters proliferated (among other things, "I was a teen-age Frankenstein" is always from '58), chasing the fashion of the various "burnt youth". Only the inevitable clash between demons and gods raises the level of tension to a minimum. Still very poor.

title: I magnifici tre
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Walter Chiari, Raimondo Vianello, Aroldo Tieri
description: To defend the population of Nonduras from the abuses of the dictator Bonarios, who has the hobby of kidnapping the young brides, the three daughters of the deceased sheriff, they propose to the exasperated population to hire some courageous pistoleros. Unfortunately, the three girls find Pablo, Domingo and José, all believed to be skilled gunslingers. In reality, the three are the most obtuse bandits in the region, so much so that they are sentenced to death and take home the skin only thanks to the intervention of the three girls.
notes: Not too apt parody of a classic of western cinema, released the year before. Some Tognazzi gags are the funniest thing.

title: Progeny
actors: Arnold Vosloo, Jillian McWikther, Brad Dourif
description: Sherry is unable to have children and her husband Craig becomes convinced that she is sterile. One day, however, the girl discovers she is pregnant. For the couple it is joy again, but something in the ultrasound scans is not working. The fetus looks misshapen, and Sherry remembers having a terrifying nightmare in which she was fertilized by aliens.
notes: Latest film by Brian Yuzna, director of "Society" and "Re-Animator 2". A sort of "Rosemary's Baby" in a science fiction version (aliens instead of the devil), which plays on the terror caused by gynecological practices and the "pain" of birth. For horror lovers, a film not to be missed.

title: Barb Wire
actors: Pamela Anderson, Xander Berkeley, Udo Kier, Temuera Morrison, Steve Railsback, Victoria Rowell
description: In an oppressive near future, heroine Barb Wire rescues a girl who holds the antidote to AIDS. Moscia science fiction based on an American comic, with the Baywatch lifeguard.

title: Chasing Secrets
actors: Ossie Davis, Della Reese, Madeline Zima, Crystal Bernard
description: Life is tough in 1950s Tennessee. Jo Ann Foley is a little girl with a difficult story: fatherless, hated by her grandfather Hank and ignored by her young mother, who supports herself by approaching young soldiers passing by and then stealing from them. All with the complicity of his grandfather, the true criminal mind of the family. The only ones who care about little Jo's fate are Honey and Spilungo, a couple of black elderly people who live near her. Having grown up, Jo Ann is pushed by Hank on her mother's path. The govane can do nothing to oppose the will of her grandfather, and so she too ends up on the street. His first victim is Paul, a young soldier. But the two fall in love at first sight, Hank's plan fails and Jo runs away with her "prince charming". Only many years later, Jo Ann, who is now a woman, returns to her old home to permanently erase from her mind a past that continues to haunt her ....

title: La sai l'ultima su... i matti?
actors: Anna Maria Rizzoli, Bombolo, Enzo Cannavale, Giorgio Porcaro
description: In a clinic for the mentally ill, a new patient arrives, named Caciotta, who tears off the panties of all the women he meets. It is August, and the head physician of the clinic is leaving for vacation. To replace him comes the beautiful doctor Lelli, who immediately becomes the object of the attentions of Caciotta and the rest of the patients.
notes: After the carabinieri, the madmen. Rarely have films of this genre managed to reach such a low level. Tremendous.

title: Angelo nero
actors: Massimo Ranieri, Giuliana De Sio, Pino Ammendola, Maria Michela Mari
description: Jack Altieri, a young Italian-American restorer, gives up his long-awaited holidays to go to Vesta: here a 16th century “crust” awaits him, portraying the face of Medea Carpi, a noblewoman accused of witchcraft. As soon as he arrives on the spot, a girl is brutally murdered, and the suspicions of Inspector Gianzi fall inexplicably on the painter. Two women, Iris and Silvia, advise Jack not to finish the restoration of the work, which brings with it a terrible curse. The restorer does not seem to give much weight to the warnings: but when the cultural heritage councilor is found killed, he must begin to worry ...

title: Time Served
actors: Catherine Oxenberg, Bo Hopkins, Larry Manetti, Jeff Fahey
description: Sarah McKinney, a nurse, lives with Bob and their son Jason, had by another man. The problem is that Bob is violent and drinks a lot: after a furious fight, Jason kills his stepfather and Sarah takes the blame for the crime. In court, Sarah is defended by a lawyer who doesn't take the case too much to heart and ends up having her sentenced to eight years in prison. While Jason is hospitalized in a state of shock, Sarah suffers all kinds of abuses in prison, and with the complicity of the prison guards she is even forced into prostitution ...
notes: Certainly not an exceptional product, with some rough scenes.

title: Freefall
actors: Jaclyn Smith, Bruce Boixleitner, Scott Wentworth
description: Renée Brennan, chief investigator for national transportation security, is about to begin a lengthy investigation into a disaster involving a large commercial aircraft. Mark Ettinger, a Federal Aviation agent, and Scott Wallace, an FBI agent are also interested in the case. One day, Renée receives a mysterious phone call that challenges her to avert the destruction of another plane. The woman realizes that the mysterious saboteur is challenging her in a perverse game and decides to strengthen security measures. But the request is not taken into consideration and the woman has nothing to do but fight with all her might ...

title: Wish Upon a Star
actors: Danielle Harris, Katherine Heigl, Don Jeffcoat, Scott Wilkinson
description: Alexia and Hayley Wheaton are sisters but there is no good blood between them. Alexia, the eldest, has a steady boyfriend who she loves madly. His only concern is to dress in fashion and to follow all the news that the stylists propose at each fashion show. Hayley, the youngest, on the other hand is very good at studying and doesn't seem too interested in boys. However, Hayley happens to envy Alexia's ease when it comes to boys, her frivolity and her lightheartedness. One night Hayley sees a shooting star and makes a wish, take on her sister's shoes for a day. The next morning his wish comes true ...

title: Place Vendôme
actors: Catherine Deneuve, Emmanuelle Seigner, Jean-Pierre Bacri
description: Vincent, ruined by debts, committed suicide and when his wife discovers six magnificent diamonds in a secret box, it is not possible to explain the reasons for the tragic gesture. The jewels are tempting to many and despite the pressure from mysterious sources Marianne does not intend to deprive herself of them.
notes: In the film there is the good (a chiaroscuro portrait of a woman trying to get back on track) and the less good (a uniform atmosphere that envelops the film in a spiral of monotony). There would be opportunities to give a shock, also because the story is wrapped up and the cards are revealed little by little: it is Garcia who does not know how to take advantage of it.

title: Lifeboat
actors: Tallulah Bankhead, John Hodiak, Walter Slezak, Mary Anderson, John Hodiak, Henry Hull, Heather Angel, Hume Cronyn, Canada Lee
description: During the Second World War a passenger ship was hit and sunk in the open ocean. A group of survivors find themselves on a lifeboat in the company of a German soldier. The isolation and the presence of an "enemy" will unleash the protagonists' nervousness.
notes: From a story written by John Steinbeck, a story of "men" forced once again to survive like "rats", hunted by the Nazis and with little chance of salvation. Masterful use of space (paradoxically claustrophobic) and objects, quite disturbing. The rehearsal of the actors is highly effective.

title: The Well
actors: Pamela Rabe, Miranda Otto, Paul Chubb
description: Hester's life has never been the same since the day she decides to take Katherine to the isolated farm where she lives with her father, a man with a difficult character. Soon Hester, who is initially hired as a waitress, discovers the pleasures of friendship and feels something she has long repressed within her. Upon the death of Katherine's father, Hester takes over management of the farm and income. When Katherine hits a man with her car, Hester comes up with the idea of ??hiding the body at the bottom of a well.
notes: When it premiered in competition in 1997 at the Cannes Film Festival, Australian director Samantha Lang's first feature whispered provocative wonders. Sudden and burning disappointment. After just twenty minutes, after some suggestions of the Australian landscape and an initial curiosity for the two protagonists, the film reveals itself in all its fragility. Boring and pretentious, illuminated only by the rosy beauty of Miranda Otto.

title: Fall Time
actors: Mickey Rourke, Sheryl Lee, Stephen Baldwin, Jason London
description: American Midwest: Three friends in the mood for jokes organize a fake bank robbery, just to see the effect it has. It goes wrong, because a gang of real robbers chose the same day and time to storm the same bank. The three boys are thus taken as hostages by the fleeing criminals.
notes: Film of the ephemeral "pulp" trend, the one born and spread after Tarantino's first successes. Torture scenes a la "Mister Blonde", surreal dialogues and an unmade Mickey Rourke and already the lord of forced labor. For those who love action cinema (even if at times grotesque), there is still fun.

title: Zanna Bianca
actors: Franco Nero, Virna Lisi, Fernando Rey, John Steiner, Daniel Martin
description: Government commissioner and writer, Scott travels to Dawson City with his brother Kurt to research the gold miners in the Klondyke. He is accompanied by an Indian guide, Charlie, who brings his son Mitsah and the wolf White Fang with him. All the interests and affairs of the city are the hand of the shady Beauty Smith who, among other things, has her eye on White Fang.
notes: Fulci is inspired by Jack London and directs a fairly naive film and only for children.

title: La ragazza fuoristrada
actors: Zeudi Araya, Luc Merenda, Martine Brochard, Giacomo Rossi Stuart
description: Giorgio, an advertiser in a large agency, during a stay in Nubia to advertise a car brand, meets Maryam with whom he falls madly in love. He takes her with him to the city where he lives and, fighting with his parents against the wedding, marries her. The simplicity of her character and her sincerity clash with the hypocrisy of the hypocritical and racist province that immediately judges her badly. Maryam is targeted by two of Giorgio's friends and by a former mistress of her husband who does everything to get her away from the man she once loved.
notes: The film is based almost exclusively on the bitter beauty of Zeudi Araya. For the rest, feigned indignation and itching.

title: Safe Men
actors: Sam Rockwell, Steve Zahn, Paul Giamatti, Michael Schmidt
description: Sam and Eddie are two mediocre singers who make ends meet by performing in ceremonies and who are victims of a sensational mistake. Big Fat Bernie Gayle, the fat head of the local Jewish mafia, believes the two are the perpetrators of the robbery of his safe, so he blackmails them into robbing for him until the debt is paid off. From bad singers they turn into Safe Men, skilled burglars at the center of situations in which the real robbers continually graze.
notes: Comedy of misunderstandings with a cartoon violence that draws heavily from the genre of the criminal film but that does not spare the mockery of bosses with a tender heart and attached to the sacred traditions of the Jewish religion.

title: Shattered Image
actors: Anne Parillaud, William Baldwin, Graham Greene, Lisianne Falk
description: From the corner of the crowded bar where Jessie is standing, her eyes are fixed on an attractive young man. When he leaves the table to go to the bathroom Jessie follows him, points a gun at him and kills him with three shots in the chest. At the same moment Jessie wakes with a start on a jet bound for the Virgin Islands, catching the man next to her by surprise. The two Jessies are completely different from each other even if in reality ...
notes: Once again the master Ruiz is measured with the fascination of the double and the unhinging of the space / time coordinates, but donuts do not always succeed with the hole. The film falls heavily into the boredom of repetition, without even a disturbing Anne Parrillaud being able to do anything to revive it.

title: I contrabbandieri di Santa Lucia
actors: Mario Merola, Antonio Sabato, Gianni Garko
description: After the coup d'etat in Iran, a large quantity of drugs from the country of the dismissed Shah passed from hand to hand until reaching Naples. An FBI agent seeks help from an organization of "honest" smugglers to track down the cargo and vanquish the traffickers.
notes: A "trust" of brains to create this C-series policeman. Alfonso Brescia as director and Ciro Ippolito as screenplay. The result is disappointing, despite a variety of locations worthy of a James Bond film. Apart from Mario Merola, the rest of the cast depopulated in "western-spaghetti".

title: Children of the Corn
actors: Linda Hamilton, Peter Horton, John Franklin, R. G. Armstrong
description: A doctor traveling with his girlfriend gets lost in a distant Midwestern countryside and reaches a country inhabited only by teenagers. Soon the two unfortunates discover why there are no adults: they have all been massacred and sacrificed to the god of wheat.
notes: Based on a good story by Stephen King but trivialized by the "horror serial" aesthetics that concede little to the violence and macabre suspense, so disliked by the American censors. The written text is much scarier but some moments of the film still convey the sense of uneasiness evoked by the writer from Maine.

title: Trois hommes et un couffin
actors: Roland Giraud, Michel Boujenah, André Dussollier, Annick Alane
description: Unity is strength. To maximize the benefits of single life, three rampant Parisian bachelors share the same apartment. Jacques is a steward, and he doesn't even know he's a boy-father. When his mother arrives in town to nail him to his responsibilities, he doesn't find him and leaves the little girl, Marie, with her two friends, Pierre and Michel, who actually don't take her very well.
notes: Bubbly French comedy of great success, also remade in America but much more limply. Here, on the other hand, the rhythm and the lines leave no respite, and the discussion of the thirty (...) year old crisis beats any Italian film. In fact, even in Italy the film went very well.

title: Yom Yom
actors: Moshe Ivgi, Hanna Maron, Yussef Abu Warda, Gassan Abbas
description: The son of an Israeli Arab and a Jewess, the hypochondriac Moshe has lived from birth a tragicomic sense of not belonging: his father calls him Moussa, his mother Moshe and someone else Mosh. The man leads a wavering life between a wife, the splendid lover Grisha who shares, unbeknownst to him, with his best friend Jule and the job of a baker. Around him it is imperative to ignore a difficult political situation, in which the peaceful coexistence between Arabs and Israelis is still a chimera.
notes: Presented in Venice in 1998, the film, the second episode of a trilogy on Israeli society today, attempts to mix a typically American family film narrative with a European outlook.

title: Varsity Blues
actors: James Van Der Beek, Jon Voight, Paul Walker, Amy Smart
description: Texas province, last frontier. To escape from the grip of their doom, in these parts boys and girls have only one chance: the first become aces of football, the second lovers of the champions hired by the colleges of the North. The eighteen-year-old Mox succeeds but realizes that the oval ball, in life, is not everything.
notes: Teenage movie cut with a hatchet to please censors and parents. Two or three "moral of the story" and all one-way: the smart girl is the one who thinks in advance about the name to give to her son and not the one who sells herself to the star of the moment. More than a film, it is a spot from the Advertisement.

title: Simoom: A Passion in the Desert
actors: Michel Piccoli, Ben Daniels, Paul Meston, Kenneth Collard, Nadi Odeh
description: During the Egyptian campaign of 1798, the Napoleonic officer Augustin, who was estranged from the rest of the platoon due to a sandstorm, survives by forming a relationship of extraordinary intensity with a female leopard. After a few months, the lieutenant decides to return, but the animal mad with jealousy ...
notes: The film is Augustin's flashback on the months spent in the desert and in the relationship between man and animal we perceive a certain nineteenth-century literature that identified the archetype of the "dark lady" in the female leopard. Transported from the dark atmospheres of noir to the daytime ones of the desert, the charm of the archetype keeps its strength on a man who finds himself seduced by a hostile nature, dominated by the wind of Simoom, in a ruthless dialectic between nature and culture.

title: Buena Vista Social Club
actors: Ry Cooder, Ibrahim Ferrer, Compay Segundo, Omara Portuondo
description: A few years ago, Cooder recorded a record in Cuba called "Buena Vista Social Club", along with old glories of local music, mostly forgotten. The record was a worldwide success and won a Grammy Award. In 1998 it was the turn of the album with solo voice by Ibrahim Ferrer: together with Cooder, Wim Wenders and a small troupe also left for Cuba, who followed and reprized the Super-Abuelos in concerts in Amsterdam and Carnegie Hall in New York.
notes: In reality, "Buena Vista Social Club" is not a concert film, but an act of love for something that is being lost, perhaps a generation with its sounds, perhaps a country, perhaps a dream. When the camera turns around Ibrahim Ferrer and Omara Portuondo who record in the recording room and then, on the chorus, detaches, and frames them in concert, almost with tears in their eyes, cinema, music, the history of many lives are one.

title: Vigo - Passion for Life
actors: James Frain, Romane Bohringer, Jim Carter, Diane Quick
description: Jean Vigo, after finishing college, finds himself catapulted into a sanatorium on the Pîrenei to cure himself of tuberculosis. Rebellious spirit immediately clashes with the director of the clinic. Lydu Lozinska is hospitalized in the same hospital, who has been there for two years without anyone taking care of her. Jean immediately feels attracted to her and between the two begins a friendship that will soon turn into love. The two run away from the sanatorium. Meanwhile, Jean begins to work for the cinema.
notes: Short but very intense life, of Jean Vigo, son of the anarchist (who committed suicide in prison) Miguel Almereyda, and the first great independent director in the history of cinema. Temple fails to fully exploit the potential of a highly emotional story. However, the two protagonists are superb.

title: Intrigo a Los Angeles
actors: Luciano Marin, Mary Luger, Carol Walker
description: David and Thelma, FBI agents, are assigned to search for Professor Weiss, who disappeared after the discovery of a formula against atomic radiation. Following a faint clue, the death of two dancers, the two agents do research on George, their manager, and discover that he is holding the professor prisoner. George intends to sell the precious formula to a foreign power.
notes: Virtually unknown actors for a predictable thriller in the plot and in the realization.

title: La grande notte di Ringo
actors: William Berger, Adriana Ambesi, Edoardo Fajardo, Walter Maestosi
description: In a cell in Carson City, they find Broken Arm and Jack. The second would like to know where are the two hundred thousand dollars that, according to Judge Elian, Broken Arm would have hidden after a bloody robbery. Jack escapes and travels to Tombstone disguising himself as a federal agent. In the town he meets one by one all the other members of the Braccio Rotto gang and risks his life several times.
notes: Twists and shootings are not lacking, but they fail to hide the platitudes and forcing of the script. William Berger is still a good character actor.

title: Da Berlino l'apocalisse
actors: Roger Hanin, Margaret Lee, Peter Carsten, Claude Dauphin
description: While the secret agent Julien Saint Dominique has an interview on a boat in a canal in Berlin, with his colleague Felix, someone fires a shotgun. Felix falls into the water and his body is swept away by the current. The searches begin but no trace of him is found and the French secret services think that the killing of the man marks the beginning of some big operation in the German city. Colonel Lassalle of the French counter-intelligence gives Julien full powers so that he can begin the investigation.
notes: Two fundamental ingredients are missing for this type of film: the rhythm and the suspense.

title: Ray Master, l'inafferrabile
actors: Felix Marten, Liana Orfei, Gastone Moschin, Alan Collins
description: Ray Master, a famous international thief is "professionally" interested in the "Mountain of Light", a fabulous diamond that the Siamese princess Thay has kept in the National Museum of Bangkok. After stealing the copy of the precious jewel, just to create an alibi, the thief goes to Bangkok and organizes the theft of the real gem. Having diverted the television surveillance circuit, so that the cameras frame the false "Mountain", Ray gets his hands on the precious.
notes: The film, as a whole, is also enjoyable because it manages to mix different elements (comic, adventurous and parody).

title: Lonelyhearts
actors: Montgomery Clift, Robert Ryan, Myrna Loy, Dolores Hart
description: Adam, a journalist looking for work, induces Florence, the wife of a newspaper editor, to introduce him to her husband, who entrusts Adam with the "Lonely Hearts" column. The journalist, full of understanding for the problems affecting readers, is busy giving advice and immediately disagrees with the editor. He does not believe in the sincerity of the letters in the address book. So one day, to convince him of the bad faith of the readers, he organizes a meeting between Adam and a reader.
notes: It is actually the adaptation of a masterpiece of American literature of the twentieth century, "Signorina Cuorinfranti" by Nathanael West. A wasted opportunity, despite Montgomery Clift being the ideal interpreter. Debut film for Stapleton.

title: Afyon oppio
actors: Ben Gazzara, Silvia Monti, Fausto Tozzi, Luciano Catenacci
description: An Italian American, Joseph Coppola, manages to get in touch with a big heroin trafficker in Turkey and persuade him to sell him fifty kilos. To receive the goods, Joseph goes to Sicily where he is subjected to a kind of examination by Don Calogero's mafia gang. After passing the test, Joseph risks being killed by the hit men of a mob boss in Marseille who wants to get his hands on drugs. Don Calogero saves him who ...
notes: Suggestive setting for an absolutely mediocre film that exploited the fame of Ben Gazzara.

title: La colomba non deve volare
actors: Horst Buchholz, Sylva Koscina, William Berger, Riccardo Garrone
description: In July 1943, one hundred thousand Italian and German soldiers were encircled in Sicily by the Anglo-Americans. To make their situation less desperate, there is only one means: to interrupt the supply of fuel to the allied forces, destroying the oil wells on the island of Bahrain. The task is entrusted to the air squadron of Major Ridolfi, who moves to the island of Cyprus. Since the planes need to be refueled in the middle of the desert, the major finds a valuable help in Pablo ...
notes: The director of "Django the bastard" nasty the "war movie spaghetti" but does not rise from the media.

title: La ragazza dalla pelle di luna
actors: Ugo Pagliai, Beba Loncar, Zeudi Araya, Giacomo Rossi Stuart
description: A young married couple, the Italian Alberto and the English Helen, fashion photographer, allow themselves, during a business trip, an unexpected holiday in the Seychelles. "The last paradise", which should resolve the marriage crisis of the two, ends up aggravating it when Alberto falls in love with Simon, a splendid local girl. Bitten by the worm of jealousy, Helen seeks solace in the arms of a failed writer.
notes: The film is based only on the breathtaking beauty of Zeudi Araya, who for years was called "the girl with the moon skin". Next to her the blonde Beba Loncar.

title: Le roi du village
actors: Henry Tisot, Luisa Mattioli, Catherine Rouvel, Anna Maria Pace
description: Moses, a foundling, is raised by the villagers and grows up good and strong, especially popular with everyone. The little boy, growing up, attracts the sympathies of Agnese, a girl in her same condition. One day four girls from Paris arrive in the village for a short vacation and with their frenzied behavior shock Moses and the villagers. The inhabitants of the town, not at all accustomed to city excesses, do everything to make the girls escape who, terrified, return to the City of Light. Moses, deceived by their kindness, decides to follow them, much to Agnes' chagrin. Thus he will find himself in Paris, a great city full of pitfalls, unsuitable for a pure heart like his.
notes: Comedy with popular tones but told as if it were a fairytale. The comparison between the vulgarity of the big city and the authenticity of the village is a bit obvious but not rhetorical. Misleading the Italian title.

title: Un mandarino per Teo
actors: Walter Chiari, Sandra Mondaini, Ave Ninchi, Riccardo Billi
description: Teo, an extra, is invited by two unknown individuals to press a button that allows him to become rich. There is only one small detail if he makes that simple gesture in China a mandarin will die. After many hesitations, Teo finally decides to press the button. A few days pass and a notary appears at Teo who tells him that a mandarin has died in China and has left him a huge inheritance. The remorse begins on the part of Teo who is convinced by Rosanella that it is just a pure coincidence. The girl offers to go find the two individuals ...
notes: Reduction for the cinema of a famous musical comedy signed (for the music) by Gorni Kramer. It is the one of "Money, money, money".

title: Mes nuits sont plus belles que vos jours
actors: Sophie Marceau, Jacques Dutronc, Valerie Lagrange, Myriam Mézières
description: Lucas, a scientist of a certain age, is diagnosed with an incurable disease that will inexorably lead to his death. Man has invented a method for communicating through lexical images. He falls in love with Blanche, a girl he met in a Paris café, and follows her to Biarritz. The childhood of the two was not very peaceful, especially for Lucas who witnessed the tragic death of his mother drowned out of jealousy by his father. It is no less Blanche who still suffers from the traumas she suffered as a child.
notes: Based on a novel by Raphaëlle Billetdoux, who rejected the film in bitter disagreement with the director, the film is all deliberately over the top but in the long run it is boring.

title: Un éléphant, ça trompe énormément
actors: Jean Rochefort, Claude Brasseur, Guy Bedos, Victor Lanoux
description: Etienne, Bouly, Simon and Daniel are four friends from Paris who have a habit of meeting up at tennis or parties from time to time. When Bouly, a hardened Don Juan, is abandoned by his exasperated wife, friends come to his aid until the armistice is signed. Simon, tyrannized by a possessive mother, is also helped by friends and the same thing happens to the rest of the group, in a sort of mutual aid. Daniel, on the other hand, loses his head for a stranger and leaves the marital roof for her.
notes: Pleasant French original from a film later remade by Gene Wilder. The title? "The Lady in Red".

title: Dead Ringer
actors: Bette Davis, Karl Malden, Peter Lawford, Philip Carey, Jean Hagen
description: After many years, two twins meet at the funeral of the husband of one of the two. Edith does not forgive her sister Margaret for deceiving the man she loved to marry him. Now that the man is dead Edith is pondering revenge. After luring his sister into the house, he kills her and takes her place. Nobody notices the replacement, not even Sergeant Hobbson who has long been in love with Edith. In the role of her sister, she discovers that Margaret had a lover: Tony.
notes: Noir drenched in mélo, shot in the 60s but reminiscent of the 40s. Great Davis. Paul Henreid was the Laszlo of _Casablanca_.

title: I Died a Thousand Times
actors: Jack Palance, Shelley Winters, Lee Marvin
description: As soon as he is released from jail, Roy immediately organizes a new robbery together with his old gang, to which new accomplices have been added. She is part of the Marie group, a former dancer who falls in love with Roy. On the night of the robbery, something goes wrong and the two protagonists are forced to flee.
notes: Unusual noir with sentimental implications, remake of "A bullet for Roy" by Walsh. Despite the determination of the male performers, the love story even touches strings of unprecedented tenderness. The authors are forgiven for some drift in the pathetic and improbable, also because with a similar cast you go to a wedding anyway. All Lee Marvin fans please take a seat.

title: My Favourite Martian
actors: Christopher Lloyd, Jeff Daniels, Elizabeth Hurley, Daryl Hannah
description: Ambitious TV reporter Tim O'Hara runs into a Martian who accidentally crashed on planet Earth with his spaceship. Convinced that he has the scoop of life in hand, Tim absolutely wants to make the news known. But the alien, who in the meantime has assumed human form and who pretends to be Tim's uncle, has quite different intentions, including that of not being discovered.
notes: The film is a clone of the 1963 television series "My Favorite Martian". Special effects used profusely (in Martin's transformations and the wild dances of his animated spacesuit) for this halfway raid. between comedy and science fiction, a mirror reading of the Burtonian "Mars Attacks!", reassuring, politically correct and even a little boring. But a cast featuring two beauties of the caliber of Elizabeth Hurley and Daryl Hannah, guaranteed the film a great success at the US box office.

title: Soleil
actors: Sophia Loren, Philippe Noiret, Marianne Sägebrecht, Michel Creton
description: Maman Titine has five children, three girls and two boys and lives her life of misery in the Jewish quarter of Algiers. We are in 1940, the Jews are victims of the racial laws of the Vichy government and Titine does everything to save her family. Her husband has been stuck in France and can do nothing for them at the moment. All the hopes of the family are pinned on Meyer the coir of Maman Titine.
notes: A calm narration, the homage to the mother figure, the noisy and sunny life of a multiethnic Algiers that no longer exists, however, are not enough to support the serious weaknesses of the film. First of all, the disconnect between the story in the present, with Meyer, an elderly surgeon, and the rest of the film, an endless flashback; then a mannered direction that cannot count on Noiret's puppy face and Sophia Loren's tired and stereotyped smile, once again in the role of mother courage.

title: Wing Commander
actors: Freddie Prinze jr, Saffron Burrows, Tchéky Karyo, Matt Lillard
description: In 2654 the Kilrathi launch a powerful attack on the Terrestrial Confederation and manage to destroy the Pegasus outpost by seizing a sophisticated hyperspace navigation system. The spaceship Tiger Claw and its commander, the son of a pilot and a Pilgrim, descendant of galactic explorers with incredible powers, must slow down the march of the terrible Kilrathi to allow the Earth to organize its defenses.
notes: Love, action, spy story and the flavor of a literary science fiction reminiscent of Asimov and Henlein, make "Wing Commander" an enjoyable film that focuses more on humans than on invading aliens. Inside the Tiger Claw the viewer recognizes themes and atmospheres that lead him from "Star Trek" to "Starship Troopers", especially as regards life on board with its camaraderie, jealousies and love stories.

title: Ayneh
actors: Aida Mohammadkhani, Kazem Mojdehi, M. Shirzad, Naser Omuni
description: Mina is an Iranian girl who after a tiring school day does not find anyone waiting for her to bring her home. The little girl who has a strong-willed character and ventures through the city seething with traffic and lazily focused on the game against South Korea. Mina in the meantime has been lost. But on the bus that should finally take her home, Mina looks straight into the camera and demolishes the illusion of cinema by saying, "I don't want to be an actress anymore."
notes: With the set unveiled, Panahi complies with the wishes of her young actress, but cynically leaves her wearing the wireless microphone on and the film starts all over again, transforming itself into the shadow of Mina in her real homecoming. Once again, Iranian cinema proposes the collapse of the borderline between cinema and life, with a shadowing of reality that passes through Zavattini's parts. But the fear is that all of this is turning into cliché.

title: Rosie, sa vie est dans sa tête
actors: Aranka Coppens, Sara de Roo, Dirk Roofthooft
description: A 13-year-old girl is very attached to a too young and restless mother, who pretends to be her older sister and doesn't want to be called a mother. This unresolved and complicated love pushes Rosie to build an imaginary world.
notes: The experience as a documentary filmmaker for TV of Patrice Toye, 32, a Belgian on his feature film debut, is evident in his ability to film the empty streets, the sad blocks of flats, the bare lawns, the modest interiors of the houses, the old scaffolding on the which Rosie isolates herself by reading. A search for happiness without many desires explored with delicacy, grace and a few drops of rhythm with the camera aimed at the flexible face of the very young Coppens.

title: The Odd Couple II
actors: Jack Lemmon, Walter Matthau, Christine Baranski, Bernard Hughes
description: Felix and Oscar who once barely shared the same apartment, now find themselves together again, this time confined to the same rented car. Neither old man would have chosen the other as a travel companion, but they have to cross California together to go to the same wedding.
notes: The old age of the two great actors moves, gives laughter and smiles even if the script of this new chapter, also written by Neil Simon, respects the metabolism and the electrocardiogram of the two protagonists. Director Deutch, who had previously directed Lemmon and Matthau in "That's Amore", frames them with the respect with which one looks at a father who is no longer young.

title: Inquiétude
actors: Leonor Silveira, José Pinto, Irene Papas, Luis Miguel Cintra
description: The octogenarian father finds himself arguing with his 60-year-old son: is it better to survive despite old age and all the ailments or to die sooner? Porto in the Thirties. Two girls meet a strange and charming playboy who falls in love with one of them. A girl thinks that a witch is able to ensure her immortality.
notes: Slow and dreamy pace, with sudden brilliant accelerations and an unattainable grotesque tone. For de Oliveira, old age is not a drama or even a joy, but a category of the spirit, to be faced with the imperturbable lightness that the director himself demonstrates by appearing in the dance scene. Literary references, visual inventions, originality of approach: a film in which it is not important to understand the meaning of all the symbols but to be carried away by the magic of the images. The same magic that fascinates the girl from the third episode, the most beautiful and original.

title: Spasmo
actors: Robert Hoffman, Suzy Kendall, Ivan Rassimov
description: The entrepreneur Bauman, after following a mysterious girl found unconscious on the beach, is attacked by a hitman but manages to kill him. Except that the corpse mysteriously disappears. Bauman then goes to a villa where he escapes a new attack. He becomes convinced that his brother wants to kill him.
notes: Umberto Lenzi tries to measure himself with a difficult and complex script. Not everything is in line, the plot is a bit cerebral but there are some good twists. The film also had regular distribution in the United States.

title: Dating the Enemy
actors: Claudia Karvan, Guy Pearce, Matt Day, Lisa Hensley, Pippa Grandison
description: Mark and Tania are completely different but they meet at a party they fall in love and immediately go to live together. He leads a successful program, she is a science journalist. After two years the differences become substantial and the two are close to breaking up. Tania, as a challenge, tells Mark that she should try to dress in his shoes for a while. No sooner said than done.
notes: A not very original comedy but with some interesting moments. Guy Pearce ("L.A. Confidential") and Matt Day ("Kiss or kill") are the new "Mel Gibson" of Australian cinema.

title: Le vacanze del sor Clemente
actors: Alberto Talegalli, Virgilio Riento, Fiorenzo Fiorentini
description: Sor Clemente, who married an authoritarian countess, pretends to be ill in order not to take part in an underwater fishing trip with his wife's friends. Left alone in the villa he gives himself to mad joy in the company of a friend and a butler. Unfortunately he is deceived by a couple of swindlers who make him squander the little money left by his wife. Eventually he is forced to rent the villa to a self-styled commission, which, in reality, is a gang of adventurers. And finally, mistaken for a criminal he is arrested.
notes: The main character of the film had had some success on the radio. When brought to the screen, it loses its incisiveness and comedy.

title: Ciao marziano
actors: Pippo Franco, Silvia Dionisio, Isabella Biagini, Bombolo, Aldo Giuffré
description: Sure that the Earth has only fifty years of life left, the inhabitants of the distant planet Gemello send the extraterrestrial Bix to Rome. Its task is to transport twelve earthlings to the planet so that we can find out if they are fit to live there. Bix, who is distinguished from earthlings only because he has a green face, also has supernatural powers that allow him to right the wrongs done to him. On the eve of his departure for Gemello, with the twelve earthlings, a trap is set for him ...
notes: There are no words to define this foolish little science fiction movie. Appearance of the make-up artist Gil Cagné.

title: La preda
actors: Zeudi Araya, Renzo Montagnani, Franco Gasparri
description: A couple now in crisis lives in Colombia: Daniel falls in love with a local girl, Nagaina, while Betsy is now a chronic alcoholic. Daniel wants to run away with his new lover, and to get the money he steals some jewels from a money lender. He gets help from a prisoner who, in turn, falls in love with Nagaina.
notes: A film made to measure for the beautiful Zeudi Araya; Paolella, director of peplums and comedies, also signs the subject and the script. The exoticism is carried over, but the melodramatic tension is genuine. Finally Montagnani in a dignified role.

title: Ringo e Gringo contro tutti
actors: Raimondo Vianello, Lando Buzzanca, Maria Martinez
description: Stumpy soldiers Ringo and Gringo meet two girls.
notes: A rose water comedy, with some farcical intent but without big ideas behind it. Corbucci hoped that Buzzanca and Vianello would raise the fate of a non-existent script, but in fact the couple is not particularly close-knit.

title: UHF
actors: Weird Al Yankovic, Kevin McCarthy, Victoria Jackson
description: The program manager of a small and shabby television station challenges the giants of the air by inventing crazy programming. Absurdly absurd films, commercials and sit-coms begin to invade the schedule attracting more and more spectators. The television programs quickly become small objects of worship and for the odd director it is a triumph.
notes: Yankovic, known as Weird Al, (Al the bizarre), is the madman who in the 80s re-made songs and videos of the big names ("Bad" by Michael Jackson transformed into "Fat"). The few good ideas in the film are recycled from the editing work of John Landis and Joe Dante.

title: Arsenal
actors: SemÃ«n Svasenko, Sergej Petrov, Nikolaj Kucinskij
description: A Ukrainian farmer who has returned from World War I goes to work in the Kiev arsenal and takes part in the popular strike that devastated the city in 1918. During the clashes with the soldiers he is mortally wounded but, as invincible, he manages to get up and face the officer who orders the massacre.
notes: Beyond a certain militant emphasis, Dovzenko's film remains a formal masterpiece in which the realism of the reconstructions, the ideology of the assumptions and the most fantastic aspect of the Soviet popular tradition alternate. In a perfect symbiosis between man and mask, the protagonist Svasenko, at the time, became a symbol of the Revolution.

title: Galgameth
actors: Stephen Macht, Johna Stewart-Bowden, Devin Oatway, Time Winters
description: Prince Davin mourns the death of his father killed by his most evil enemy El El. The young man's copious tears fall on a statuette given to him by his parent. Suddenly, as if by magic, the simulacrum comes to life and turns into a faithful and excellent friend. Galgameth, this is the name that the young prince gives to his friend, he feeds on metal and grows dramatically day after day. But things in Prince Davin's reign are not going well: assassinations, coup attempts and a fierce band of usurpers try to drive the new ruler out of his lands. Fortunately, Davin has Galgameth on his side who soon becomes his new ally. Thanks to his generous and, above all, precious help Davin will be able to drive out he hates him and to regain the throne that has been usurped from him.
notes: Children's film that exploits multiple legends and relies on the sense of adventure that so fascinates kids all over the world. The theme of friendship and fraternal collaboration is at the center of the film starring unknown actors.

title: Dog's Best Friend
actors: Adam Zolotin, Shirley Jones, Richard Mulligan, James Belushi, John Ratzenberger, Bobcat Goldthwait, Valerie Harper
description: A little boy discovers that he has a particular gift: that of being able to talk to animals and make himself understood by them. So when his grandparents are in danger of being kicked out of their property, his beloved grandson brings his extraordinary gifts into play. The farm animals will solve the complex situation. Those who combine trouble in series will discourage the new owners from chasing the sprightly old men.
notes: In the cast stands out the presence of James Belushi, John's affirmed brother, and particularly at ease in acting alongside the dogs ("Four-legged policeman").

title: Nightmare
actors: David Knight, Moira Redmond, Brenda Bruce, John Welsh
description: Janet, who has experienced the tragedy of parental madness firsthand, continually suffers from nightmares. The most common one concerns the mother, now closed in an asylum, and whom she sees again while she is about to kill her husband. During the holidays, the girl is hosted in Mary's house, an assistant from the boarding school where she lives. Here he meets Grace, a nurse her guardian Henry sent to assist Janet. New nightmares assail the girl who, recognizing in Henry's wife the ghost of his obsessions, kills her. Grace, Henry's lover, is actually hiding behind the murder ...
notes: A thriller by Hammer almost exclusively played on atmospheres, suspense and horror sensations. Freddie Francis, the leading name of the English production house, despite his no longer very young age continues to work as a director of photography with superb results. His most recent film is David Lynch's "The Straight Story", which premiered at the latest Cannes Film Festival.

title: Les bonnes causes
actors: Bourvil, Marina Vlady, Virna Lisi, Pierre Brasseur, Umberto Orsini
description: Catherine Dupré murdered her husband, substituting one vial for another in a medicine box. All the evidence, however, nails Gina, the nurse. Compounding her position is the fact that the woman was Paul Dupré's mistress and is now the universal heir of his possessions based on the false will rewritten by Catherine. The lawyer Cassidi, who defends the interests of the latter, manages to convict the nurse. The only person to whom doubts arise is Judge Gaudet ...
notes: Based on the novel by Jean Laborde, the film that made the French discover Virna Lisi, who have always been enthusiastic about the Italian actress ever since.

title: Wes Craven's Movie of Fear: Don't Look Down
actors: Megan Ward, Billy Burke
description: Carla, her husband Mark and her sister Rachel go on a trip to the mountains. Unfortunately, a terrible tragedy disrupts their lives: Rachel falls into a ravine. For this Carla develops an uncontrolled fear of heights and turns to Dr. Sadowski, a psychologist who specializes in treating phobic patients. Except that most of his clients die suddenly and under mysterious circumstances. This is why Mark accuses Sadowski of being a murderer.
notes: The original title is clear: Wes Craven, author of "Scream", sponsors the operation but his name, in this case, is not synonymous with originality.

title: Il santo patrono
actors: Lucio Dalla, Alberto Sorrentino, Tony Ucci, Gennaro Masini
description: The patron saint of Ponteparadiso has always been San Satiro Vedovo, but a sensational decision by the bishop changes the cards. From now on, the citizens of the town will have to celebrate the feast of San Silvestro, whose statue is immediately put in place of that of the "predecessor". The population, together with the parish priest Don Arcadio, rebels.
notes: Bitto Albertini is the author of goodies such as "Put your devil in my hell": that he likes "religious" parodies? However, "The patron saint" presents a series of light and predictable but fun situations. Lucio Dalla also signs the soundtrack (together with Ruggero Cini).

title: Tanto va la gatta al lardo...
actors: Luciano Salce, Franca Valeri, Walter Chiari, Stefano Satta Flores
description: Four episodes: three sisters indulge in a false traveling salesman. Maria makes her husband escape from the carabinieri barracks but in the end she ends up in prison. Two Bolognese spouses do not realize that the civil war has broken out while they are arguing. A Napoli fan scandalizes a compartment of "good" people.
notes: Embarrassing comedy that exploits striking news stories of the time (Kappler's escape) and lends itself to the most sinister occult advertising (there are famous brands scattered all over the place). Too bad for the cast of all respect.

title: Target
actors: Gene Hackman, Matt Dillon, Gayle Hunnicutt, Victoria Fyodorova
description: Cheerful little family on holiday in France. One bad day the mother mysteriously disappears and the son discovers that the quiet daddy was actually a CIA agent. They all end up in the trap hatched by a former spy behind the curtain who has some unfinished business with his American rival. After the initial surprise, the boy will work with his father to save his mother in danger.
notes: Spying thriller tinged with irony but shot by Penn without conviction, leaving Dillon, the "rebel" of those years, free rein.

title: Il corpo
actors: Zeudi Araya, Enrico Maria Salerno, Leonard Mann, Carroll Baker, Luigi Antonio Guerra
description: Adventurer Antoine arrives in Trinidad and begins a love story with the beautiful Princesse, a black woman. His wife, however, leaves him and goes to live in the city. Antoine meets Alain, welcomes him into the house but he falls in love with Princesse. Together they decide to kill the protagonist and escape.
notes: Beyond the exotic scenarios, the real protagonist of this film is Zeudi Araya's "body", a splendid "object of desire" in a film with a certain sensuality. Nothing unforgettable, but with some thrills under the skin.

title: In the Line of Duty: Manhunt in the Dakotas
actors: Rod Steiger, Michael Gross, Gary Basaraba, Christopher Rich
description: In the North Dakota a group of federal agents awaits the moves of Gordon Khal, leader of the regional revolutionary movement: the Posse Committee. Gordon incites the revolt, so the policemen decide to arrest the leader to appease the spirits, but the tension is too high and what was to be a normal routine action leads to tragedy. In a violent shooting two agents are killed by Khal's men. After the tragedy, a ruthless hunt begins to the manager, Gordon, who manages to remain in the shadows becoming a kind of legend for his followers. The agent at the head of the investigations must unmask him.

title: Piccoli orrori
actors: Iaia Forte, Anna Bonaiuto, Roberto De Francesco
description: Collage of different stories that tell extreme moments of some existences, from a reflection on Ophelia starting from a flooded kitchen to a ballerina confined to a wheelchair, from Maria portraying herself in front of the angel to a mute woman of her own choice.
notes: Halfway between film-fresco and variations on a theme, it is an exploration of the extraordinary side hidden in everyday life directed by a veteran of the Italian underground cionema, who for the first time saw one of his films arrive in theaters. Not all episodes are memorable, but the film has some very strong moments and a gallery of great actresses.

title: You Are My Destiny
actors: Giulietta De Bernardi, Antonella Boschetto, Veronica De Bernardi
description: "That's life". In the name of an American song sung in the night, which becomes a sort of leitmotif, contrast and conjunction between lines, now distant, now close. The heroines - once called Amazons - slipped from this to the past and vice versa, while not far or far from them, others repeat gestures that already fathers and mothers did. Pentessilea launches his call, while Abulfo goes to meet his secret brother and Giovanna continues his blind journey: each to his own destiny. We are looking for a more hidden music that is late to be felt. "You are My Destiny", the song, echoes in vain in the night and continuous research. Second part: "The previous life - forgive me". The characters live their double secret life, different from the one that has been seen in the first part of the film. Carmela, Salvatore, Nunziata and Rita cross their destinies, by pure and not, to the rhythm of a song that returns.
notes: Impossible to force De Bernardi to the scheme of a plot. Only emotions that are discussed, music, cinema.

title: Pi
actors: Sean Gullette, Mark Margolis, Pamela Hart, Ben Shenkman
description: Max Cohen is a mathematical genius who is trying to unravel the numerical law that can predict the developments of the stock market. A voracious Wall Street society and a sect of Orthodox Jews are also interested in his studies, who hunt him relentlessly. The magic number he is looking for is the one lost during the Roman destruction of Jerusalem and which contained the essence of God, his true name. But for Max and his computer, determining that number brings a new level of consciousness.
notes: Sundance winner, shot in dense black and white and a stunning hand-held camera, a fascinating story rooted in the idea that the Torah obeys a mathematical pattern. Mathematics turns out to be a fascinating protagonist, transporting the viewer into a world that resembles in a way those described by Philip K. Dick.

title: Sex and Zen III
actors: Karen Yeung, Xu Jin Jian, Jane Chung, Dong Yi, Shao Chuan Yong
description: In the China of the Sung dynasty, three girls are sold to the mistress of a brothel from their very poor and unfortunate families. The Postaccio is in the hands of an ex prostitute, sister Kau, who invests in the girls in flowers (possibly virgins) teaching them the high arts of love.
notes: The boring and unwatchable film, the third after that of '91 directed by Michael Mark and that of Chin Mane-Ki '95 offers a rich catalog: torture, castration, mass rapes, fouls, frogs in the canonical orifices and a challenging ending : two of the three unfortunate enter the convent. "The extreme limit of erotic madness" reads the launch slogan. Remove us "erotic".

title: Limbo
actors: David Strathairn, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Kris Kristofferson
description: Lives that intertwine at the borders of civilization, up in Alaska, where petty-bourgeois rites and even those of men with guns must at some point give way to the strength of a superhuman nature. They meet in the fishing town: Joe, a former fisherman traumatized by an ancient accident, and Donna, a singer with a teenage daughter. But then, it is in the desert of the island where a wrong adventure drags them that the three discover the profound dimension of their life.
notes: An underground film darkened by the silences of the soul, "Limbo" by John Sayles is painful and, at times, as tiring as the inner journey of its protagonists. Strange film, to be written by its author, and strangely wrong: in fact Sayles until now has been a perfect screenwriter (for himself and for others), while here he seems to drag the first introductory part, postponing the tormenting intensity of the second. , the most beautiful, where the strength of "solitary star" is finally found.

title: Return of the Living Dead 3
actors: J. Trevor Edmond, Sarah Douglas, Mindy Clarke
description: The mysterious gas invented by the military and capable of resurrecting the dead, already dangerously used in the first two episodes, is this time discovered by a young man who mourns his deceased girlfriend. She turns into zombies, but theirs will still be a love story.
notes: Brian Yuzna resurrects (it should be said) a series conceived as a plagiarism of the Romero trilogy and created by Dan O'Bannon and John Russo, former traitorous partner of the director of "Night of the Living Dead". The assumptions are modest but Yuzna is a true genius of horror and makes this "third part" the only one that cannot be renounced.

title: The Promise
actors: Tracy Nelson, Isabella Hoffmann, Neil Maffin, Seth Adkin
description: Joanne, a charming girl from the American province has a younger sister Lisa, who is married to Bill. The couple has three children and, seen from the outside, it seems to be similar to couples all over the world. Shopping, household worries, the effort to make it to the end of the month and the joy of seeing the children grow up. But, in reality things don't go that way, because Bill subjects poor Lisa to all sorts of mistreatments. Witness of the continuing violence is his elder sister Joanne. Following his advice, Lisa runs away from home and tries to rebuild a life away from the domestic violence she is forced to endure every day. But Bill does not give up and looks for her in every corner of the United States, until one day he finds her and kills her in a fit of anger. The man chased by the police who knows his background well immediately sets out on his trail. Joanne, on the other hand, has no choice but to try to find her lost serenity next to her three grandchildren, innocent victims of her father's deviant mind.

title: Sleeping with the Devil
actors: Tim Matheson, Shannen Doherty, Bonnie Bartlet, David Bowe
description: Rebecca Dubrovich, a beautiful girl of humble origins, falls in love with Dick Strang, a man who became a billionaire after the success of his chain of gyms and fitness centers. Rebecca, despite the contrary opinion of her family, succumbs to Dick's flattery and decides to move with him to Houston. At first it seems that everything is going well: the happiness of the couple is short-lived, however, because soon the young woman discovers that Dick has a double personality.
notes: A story far from original, practically the same as "In bed with the enemy". Tim Matheson was part of the "Animal House" gang.

title: Contagious
actors: Tom Wopat, Lindsay Wagner, Ken Pogue
description: Fresh from an unpleasant experience in Africa, Dr. Hanna Cole is preparing to start a new life alongside her husband Sam, a widower and father of two children. One day the lifeless body of a man is found outside the door of the doctor's surgery. The autopsy shows that the victim had contracted cholera. Hanna informs the authorities who declare the state of quarantine. Meanwhile, the infection spreads rapidly and, in a few hours, other cases of cholera were reported. While the doctor rescues the infected, an attempt is made to discover the origin of the epidemic.

title: Per amore di Cesarina
actors: Walter Chiari, Gino Bramieri, Cinzia Monreale, Valeria Moriconi
description: Davide is the owner of the family-run pension Tornerai which he runs together with his wife Elvira and daughter Carletta. One day while he is in the countryside, Davide meets Cesarina and falls madly in love with him.
notes: An almost retro air, and the professionalism of the two old foxes. We laugh, despite everything.

title: Storia di una monaca di clausura
actors: Catherine Spaak, Suzy Kendall, Eleonora Giorgi, Martine Brochard
description: Carmela refuses her forced boyfriend and is locked up in a convent. Pregnant after a furtive encounter with the man she loves (and who will be murdered), she is helped by the nuns to defend her son from the demands of ecclesiastical authority.
notes: Seventeenth-century itches in elegantly defenseless packaging.

title: Saved by the Light
actors: Eric Robets, Lynette Walden, Don McManus
description: A young "rebel without cause" is the victim of a strange accident. He is struck by a flash of light that leaves him clinically dead for about an hour. The doctor who visits him after the "love at first sight" (literal, this time), is already ordering the autopsy when the protagonist recovers. Feeling miraculous, he looks back on his whole life and tries to change.
notes: The original title says "saved from the light". Lewis Teague, the director, is known for fantastic and horror films, but with films like this he has fallen into anonymity.

title: Papà pacifico
actors: Antonella Lualdi, Bice Valori, Frank Latimore
description: Luisella Ceccacci, works as a cashier in a rotisserie, and Carlo Torquati, a craftsman with the hobby of inventing gadgets and writing songs, meet by chance on a trolley bus and it is love between them. When Luisella's father, Augusto, inherits a lot of money from a murdered usurer aunt, the girl begins to be a grand lady so much that a decayed marquis makes her the thread. In the meantime, Carlo writes the song _Papà Pacifico_ which turns out to be a success.
notes: Guido Brignone may not say anything to many but he has made more than fifty films. This one, inspired by the song that gives the title to the film, in its dated naivety can be nice.

title: Pole Pole
actors: Fabio Fazio, Luciano Manzalini, Julliet Akinyi
description: Fabio, a TV presenter, agrees to participate in Africa in the creation of a commercial in favor of AMRF, the African association for medicine and research ...
notes: Film made to help the Amrf. Unfortunately, the authors have not made much effort to make it appear different from the commercial that the protagonist should make, in fiction.

title: American History X
actors: Edward Norton, Edward Furlong, Beverly D'Angelo, Fairuza Balk
description: Driven by the desire to find something to unload his anger on, Derek becomes the leader of a racist movement that advocates white supremacy. His group's punitive expeditions and constant brawls culminate in a brutal murder. In prison he repents, but his brother Danny is waiting for him at the exit, who sees him as a model to imitate ...
notes: Kaye avoids the conventions of sociological reportage and the television imperatives of the investigation and the documentary. Long experience in advertising influences his visual style. As in a successful commercial, everything acquires a value and a sense that overrides the rhetoric of the topic.

title: Vénus beauté (Institut)
actors: Nathalie Baye, Mathilde Seigner, Bulle Ogier, Samuel Le Bihan, Audrey Tautou
description: Angela is a beautician who likes to make people feel good. She is single, has a stormy past behind her: now she meets men and consumes them in one evening. He did not reckon, however, with Antoine, a stubborn sculptor determined to blow up his engagement with a twenty-year-old just to share the future with the mature woman. In the background, the "Vénus beauté" beauty center.
notes: The fourth feature film by French filmmaker Tonie Marshall is an act of love towards Nathalie Baye, actress of the middle generation, who has always lived a secluded career made up of 70s films (here we are on the side of a minor Tavernier). Among the supporting roles, new and ancient glories emerge, from Seigner (Emmanuelle's sister) to Audrey Tautou, from Micheline Presle to Hossein.

title: Office Space
actors: Ron Livingston, Jennifer Aniston, Ajay Naidu, David Herman
description: The spiritual father of the lazy Initech computer programmers is Milton. Short-sighted, obese, shy, frustrated, dirty and crumpled shirt, squeezed between the panels of the open space and surrounded by boxes, he was confined to the basement of the office. In the dark. He has been fired for many years, but no one has warned him and he continues to receive regular salary.
notes: The main character in this film starred in an animated short film made by Mike Judge in 1991, before the director created Beavis and Butt-Head (known to MTV viewers). Around these telematic heirs of the unforgettable Bristow, the director has built this feature film with actors. The characters, the situations, the jokes, the gags preserve the space-time scan of the cartoons. The quarrels, anxieties and physiognomies of the white-collar universe are drawn with a pleasant and restrained grotesque vein.

title: En plein coeur
actors: Gérard Lanvin, Virginie Ledoyen, Carole Bouquet, Guillaume Canet
description: Michel, a brilliant lawyer married to the charming gallery owner Viviane, finds himself defending Cécile, a young drifter who makes ends meet by carrying out petty thefts. The lawyer soon finds himself involved in the most classic and devouring of love triangles, competing with Vincent, Cécile's boyfriend.
notes: The film, a thousand miles away from Autant-Lara's "The girl of sin" with Gabin and Bardot based on the same novel, trivializes the destructive passion that binds the three protagonists with predictable dialogues. Virginie Ledoyen, a young star of quality French cinema, this time seems to have an empty joke; distracted and listless in the part of the seductive Cécile, she clearly loses the comparison with the always beautiful Carole Bouquet.

title: A Night at the Roxbury
actors: Chris Kattan, Will Ferrell, Dan Hedaya, Molly Shannon, Richard Grieco
description: The Roxbury is a local in Los Angeles, a popular destination for the Butabi brothers, sons of fathers, slackers and clumsy. Not appearing in the list of VIPs, they are regularly rejected, until the day in which the most classic of lucky breaks happens.
notes: The film is a concentrate of zany comedy that comes from "Saturday Night Live", the television program that launched Will Ferrell and Chris Kattan. Dance music, not excellent comedy but very well supported by the two comedians. In the cast, uncredited, is Chazz Palminteri as the owner of the Roxbury.

title: Alice et Martin
actors: Juliette Binoche, Alexis Loret, Carmen Maura, Mathieu Amalric
description: The young Martin, illegitimate son of the squire of a French citizen, runs away from home and finds himself in Paris, a guest of his half-brother Benjamin. Here he meets Alice, a somewhat disbanded violinist who is always on the verge of a nervous breakdown. Between the two it is love, not at first sight but still devouring. Except that Martin hides a terrible secret, which inexorably works his already difficult psychophysical equilibrium on his hips.
notes: André Téchiné returns, after the interesting noir parenthesis of "Les Vouleurs", to one of his favorite topics: existential fragility unleashed by feelings. But it does so through a heavy and not always inspired script.

title: Tom Dollar
actors: Maurice Poli, Erika Blanc, Giorgia Moll, Jacques Herlin, Franco Ressel
description: CIA agent Tom Dollar is tasked with watching the back of the beautiful Iranian princess Sania, just as the country of the shah is making a major deal with the United States. There are naturally many who want to see the girl dead.
notes: The film directed by Coirciolini under a pseudonym is inspired by a photo novel of the same name (!) And written by a guy who calls himself John Connery (!!!). Luckily, spies live "only" twice ... So trashy as to invoke indulgence. The only authentic thing is the beautiful Erika Blanc.

title: La donna è una cosa meravigliosa
actors: Vittorio Caprioli, Sandra Milo, Tinto Brass, Arnaldo Fabrizio
description: Episode film: in the first, "A sweet sweet woman", a lady who would like to have children decides to treat her husband as a child to grow up, overturning her maternal instinct on him. In the second, "The White Whale", a dwarf falls in love with a dwarf but has a big problem with his wife: the cannon woman.
notes: Bolognini's bizarre operation that sees even Goffredo Parise engaged among the screenwriters of the first episode. Perhaps the assumptions were intended to be innovative (there is even a cartoon prologue by Pino Zac), but the result is not convincing at all. Even the grotesque needs balance.

title: Frou-Frou del Tabarin
actors: Martine Brochard, Fabrizio Moroni, Carmen Scarpitta
description: At the height of the "Belle Epoque", the "tabarin", a cabaret theater of the avant-garde and of the naked women, is very popular. In front of an audience made up of nobles with a great desire to escape and characters of the rising bourgeoisie, grotesque characters perform: tenors, baritones and sopranos with operetta arias.
notes: From the operetta "La Duchessa del Tabarin" Gianni Grimaldi, also a screenwriter, has drawn this strange comedy that even presents itself as a cross-section of an era. A lot of clichés and a few funny numbers leave the film gasping.

title: L'inafferrabile 12
actors: Walter Chiari, Isa Barzizza, Silvana Pampanini, Carlo Campanini, Aroldo Tieri
description: A woman, already a mother of eleven children, gives birth to twins. The superstitious husband decides to get rid of the thirteenth child and entrusts him to an orphanage. When he grows up, the foundling unintentionally guesses a five in the lottery, triggering a whole series of misunderstandings and personal exchanges that also involve "number 12", or his twin, who is even the power of Juventus!
notes: Mario Mattoli saves a comedy at times faragginosa with his job. The highly respected cast gives him a hand: Walter Chiari "duplicates" himself, Pampanini is as usual handsome and the good Carlo Campanini comes out in great shape from the group of character actors.

title: 2 Männer, 2 Frauen - 4 Probleme!?
actors: Aglaia Szyszkowitz, Heino Ferch, Gedeon Burkhard
description: Eva is a very lively woman but very stressed by everyday problems. She is unable to dedicate herself as she would like to her husband Luis, a painter in abstinence from success. And her two children, Florian and Rosa, are also neglected. One day, Eva discovers that her husband has gone on a sly with his mistress Charlotte for a romantic trip to Venice. At this point, the woman forces Charlotte's husband, Nick, to accompany her to the Lagoon. But during the journey, the protagonists face a series of misadventures that will change their lives forever.
notes: Pleasant German comedy filmed for television.

title: Le monache di Sant'Arcangelo
actors: Anne Heywood, Luc Merenda, Ornella Muti, Martine Brochard
description: The cloistered monastery of Sant'Arcangelo in Irpinia hosts numerous nuns forced into monastic life by their respective illustrious families.
