The death of the abbess puts in competition the elderly mother Lavinia, mother Giulia di Mondragone and mother Carmela. To achieve power, Mother Giulia (who has an affair with Sister Chiara) accepts the help of a local squire.
notes: Manzoni and his Nun of Monza have nothing to do with it, in case Paolella says he was inspired by Stendhal. The film, however, does not even have the courage to be completely transgressive, and eroticism is fashionable (and seen today, modest).

title: Chiedo asilo
actors: Roberto Benigni, Dominique Laffin, Francesca De Sapio
description: Roberto, the teacher of a kindergarten, chooses to involve his very young students trying to be as much as possible like them. A symbiosis is born between him and the children that continues even outside the walls of the institute, for example at the sea, on vacation. But not everyone shares his method.
notes: Ferreri and Benigni, a fantastic match. The director chooses the actor to recover the childish innocence that an alienated world is killing. The toscanaccio acts under the lines as it rarely happened to do, and gives the teacher a unique character, a purity that clashes with the arrogance of adults.

title: Love Letter
actors: Jennifer Jason Leigh, Campbell Scott, David Dukes
description: Scotty Corrigan buys an old writing desk from an antique dealer. Cleaning it, he finds a love letter dating back to the Civil War, written by an unhappy woman. Passionate about the content of the letter, she begins to carry out research on the story of the girl, who has been dead for more than a century. Her story hides a painful secret, and Scotty gives a radical twist to her investigation ...
notes: Great cast for a story that touches the boundaries of the fantastic. Jennifer Jason Leigh as the girl of yesteryear is definitely perfect.

title: Action
actors: Luc Merenda, Adriana Asti, Paola Senatore, Susanna Javicoli, Alberto Sorrentino, John Steiner, Alberto Lupo, Franco Fabrizi, Gianfranco Bullo, Luigi D'Ecclesia, Giancarlo Badessi, Edoardo Florio, Alina De Simone, Beatrice Brass
description: They had promised him an unstoppable career, a sure success in committed cinema, a collaboration with the best colleagues of the Seventh Art, instead the former actor imagined by the irrepressible Tinto was reduced to making porn films. After a fight with the director, he goes around the city with his last set partner and therefore also in bed.
notes: Tinto Brass inveighs against busy cinema, as usual. He tries to play with the noir but he manages to mischief, he would like to pass off Adriana Asti for the typical bourgeois with irrepressible desires but this is also bad for him.

title: Ravenous
actors: Robert Carlyle, Guy Pearce, David Arquette, Jeremy Davies
description: Captain Boyd is a coward. After the Civil War, his superiors beat him into an outpost of lost men, in the mountains, in the midst of outcast soldiers like him. One bad day the military receives a visit from a missing person named Colqhoun who claims to be a Scotsman who traveled with a group of settlers. His traveling companions, according to his account, were stopped by the snow. But Colqhoun is actually a cannibal who, day after day, turns them into his menu.
notes: Antonia Bird from the Royal Court Theater in London to horror, passing through the BBC. Like (almost) all British films of the latest generation, often sponsored directly by TV, this film too is engulfed by television aesthetics. No visionary explosion, which is compensated for by the iconographic accumulation: make up splatter by Kurtzman-Nicotero-Berger ("From sunset to dawn") to shed blood on a production that does not dispense emotions. Shot in the Czech Republic, on savings. The soundtrack was unbearable.

title: 10 Things I Hate About You
actors: Heath Ledger, Julia Stiles, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Larisa Oleynik
description: Bianca and Kat are sisters but they couldn't be more different: the first is sweet and prefers pastel colors; the other is antisocial and passionate about feminist rock. The girls' father, subjected to repeated viewing of pregnant teenagers for work, has banned Bianca from going out with the boys until Kat does the same.
notes: Break free from the impossible comparison with Shakespearean _The Taming of the Shrew_ and enjoy Heath Ledger's improvised singing performance, the unmistakable facial mimicry of underwear model Joey, the "belly torture" imposed by the girls' father for preventive use. No snobbery, it's not another stupid American comedy.

title: Universal Soldier: The Return
actors: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Michael Jai White, Bill Goldberg
description: Luc was awarded a contract to work as a technician on a special government project. The main purpose is to prepare a new and more sophisticated generation of combat cyborgs, made from the corps of soldiers who fell in battle. Seth, the supercomputer that commands this very special force, develops an autonomous will and rebels.
notes: Universal Soldiers had already seen themselves at work in Roland Emmerich's New Heroes (1992). We are in the middle of forced cinema, but made with a certain honesty and a modicum of style. An unpretentious B movie, part of a conspicuous series between big screen and straight to video.

title: The Peacekeeper
actors: Dolph Lundgren, Roy Scheider, Montel Williams
description: Douglas Murphy, a mercenary often used by the CIA for the most dangerous missions, is abandoned by his superiors to his fate. But the soldier is saved, returns to America and decides to hit Washington with a nuclear warhead. However, he did not deal with "the peacemaker", another mercenary, however, lined up on the right side.
notes: It's really a shame to see Roy Scheider employed (badly) in such boorish productions. A very low-level film, in which irony and an adventurous spirit disappear.

title: Hamilton
actors: Peter Stormare, Lena Olin, Mark Hamill, Mats Långbacka
description: Swedish secret agent Carl Hamilton and his colleague Åke are on the trail of a gang of criminals from the former USSR who have chosen Sweden as their personal gun supermarket. The bandits are in fact negotiating the purchase of a nuclear device capable of transforming Paris, Washington or New York to ashes. They deal with an American mobster, but they reckoned without Hamilton.
notes: Miracle, a nice TV movie! We needed the Swedes ... Hamilton is a sort of Scandinavian 007 protagonist of books and television series. Great "home" stars Stormare (Bergman school ...) and Olin; Hamill, twenty years ago, had been Luke Skywalker.

title: À la place du coeur
actors: Ariane Ascaride, Jean-Pierre Darroussin, Gérard Meylan
description: Clim goes to see Bebé in prison, unjustly imprisoned by a racist policeman (Bebé is black), to tell him that she is pregnant. The two have always known each other and family members are also at home. The background is Marseille, with its alleys and its hanging clothes, its races and its strong contradictions. It will be the girl's mother who will find the witness "invited" to recognize Bebé and then fled to Sarajevo, her homeland.
notes: The moral seems to suggest the following axiom: the only answer to the bastard world is children. But the author's militancy goes further, with the good ones clearly on one side and the bad ones on the other, without fear of exaggerating. The team of actors is close-knit: Ariane Ascaride is the director's wife (as well as the protagonist of all his films), Meylan is his best friend (as well as the interpreter of all his films), Lare Raoust is a sweet and determined Clim, Alexandre Ogou the sculptor in love with Bebé. Léo Ferré is evoked (through "Avec le temps") and the fists are closed like in a Ken Loach film.

title: Shadow of Doubt
actors: Melanie Griffith, Tom Berenger, John Ritter, Wade Dominguez
description: A beautiful girl is killed in a pool in which everyone would like to dive and the murder is accused of a successful rapper, Bobby Medina, for once of Hispanic origin and not black. The best lawyer of the moment intervenes to defend him - under high remuneration and pushed by "democratic" ferments, who will have to fight a former prosecutor, now in the shirts of a senator who aspires to the White House.
notes: It has nothing to do with Hitchcock's classic of '43: it is a conventional legal thriller that has the sole purpose of spending an hour and a half between courtrooms that so much resemble those of Matlock or Perry Mason and residences. fairytale located in the Los Angeles neighborhood.

title: Il branco
actors: Giampiero Lisarelli, Ricky Memphis, Salvatore Spada, Luca Zingaretti
description: In the Roman province, a group of boys accepts Sola's proposal to rape two German tourists on vacation in Italy held prisoner in a shed of a junkyard. Of the group the only one who pulls back is Raniero, the others gladly accept to follow him. Slowly the news of the two imprisoned tourists spreads like wildfire and attracts all the males in the area.
notes: Marco Risi draws the story from the novel of the same name by Andrea Carraro and tells it with a realistic style that ends up exasperating its tones up to free effects. Presented in Venice with endless controversies.

title: In God's Hands
actors: Patrick Shane Dorian, Matt George, Matty Liu, Shaun Tomson
description: Mickey, Shane and Keoni want at all costs to become one with the sea, in a sort of ritual mating with nature. To be able to meet waves never ridden by anyone and experience the ecstasy of conquest, they embark on a ship bound for the coasts of Madagascar, Mexico, Bali and Hawaii.
notes: The references of the film by Zalman King, author of "Wild Orchid" and "The Delta of Venus", are clear: "Big Wednesday", "Point Break" ... But King's new exploit has incredible ambitions, to starting from the original title, "In the hands of God", involuntarily comic if you try to follow the philosophical and religious remnants of the screenplay. The result is a grueling new age video clip similar to an exotic moving postcard.

title: The Mummy
actors: Brendan Fraser, Rachel Weisz, John Hannah, Arnold Vosloo
description: In 1719 a. C. in Thebes in Egypt a forbidden love is born between the high priest Imhotep and the pharaoh's lover. The girl kills herself out of desperation and the priest lets himself go to desperate gestures, arousing the wrath of the gods. The deities inflict a terrible sentence on him: being buried alive in the city of Hamunaptra. 1923: Rick O'Connell, a young legionnaire, Evelyn, a librarian, and Jonathan, her brother, are in search of Imhotep's fabulous treasure. They arouse the Mummy's wrath by causing her to awaken.
notes: More adventure than horror, more smiles than shivers, with lots of winks, not only to the Spielberg saga and Raimi, but also to the exotic cinematic adventures of the Thirties, to the dynamism of Errol Flynn.

title: The Thirteenth Floor
actors: Vincent D'Onofrio, Gretchen Mol, Armin Mueller-Stahl, Craig Bierko
description: On the thirteenth floor of a skyscraper where a large corporation is based, Douglas and Hannon pushed virtual technology to the maximum by rebuilding Los Angeles in 1937. When Douglas wakes up in a daze, he discovers a bloody shirt and Hannon's corpse in the back room. of a pub. Called to recognize the body in the coroner's 'morgue', the suspicions fall on him. But is he the real culprit and, above all, why doesn't he remember anything?
notes: The Emmerich brothers (producers-creators) enjoy disrupting what is allowed and inserting traps as if they were "driving on a playstation": if you are at the video (game) you can also have fun trying to understand at what "level" you are. has arrived.

title: Halloween: H20: Twenty Years Later
actors: Jamie Lee Curtis, Adam Arkin, Josh Hartnett, Michelle Williams
description: Twenty years have passed since the "night of the witches": Laurie Strode lives under an assumed name in a small village with her 17-year-old son John and works as a director of a private school. His only confidant is Will, the school counselor. But Michael Myers suddenly returns with the intention of taking revenge.
notes: The director of "Friday the 13th - The murderer sits next to you" gets his hands on John Carpenter's creature and continues the logic of serialization. In truth this "Halloween 20 years later", which celebrates the twentieth anniversary of the first episode, was strongly desired by Kevin Williamson, screenwriter of "Scream", here producer. Miner added little to the typical slasher storyline, those horror stories in which only the gore dynamics of the murders matter. The slaughter is assured but the twists and turns are well known. The 95-minute "uncut" version was seen, for some reason, only in Spain.

title: Wild Wild West
actors: Kevin Kline, Will Smith, Kenneth Branagh, Salma Hayek
description: Special government agents James and Artemus are sent on the trail of the evil Dr. Arliss Loveless. He is devising a plan to assassinate the President of the United States with the help of a monstrously sized armed vehicle called the Tarantula.
notes: The film is an emblematic example of what marketing dictates reads more than the will of authors and performers (the film has been reassembled, cut and sweetened). "Theft" against a television series (which lasted in the USA from '65 to '70: 122 episodes here condensed as a gigantic promo) has no narrative to support it, and it clings exclusively to Will Smith's verve. Kline mimics Jack Lemmon's "Some Like It Hot" (once again), Salma Hayek is sacrificed, and Branagh wanders around in a hellish machine (entirely computer created) without conviction.

title: Idle Hands
actors: Devon Sawa, Seth Green, Elden Henson, Jessica Alba, Steve Van Wormer
description: On the morning of October 31st Anton wakes up, does a bit of zapping, rummages through the refrigerator and discovers that his parents have been reduced to two headless puppets. Stolen a few coins he leaves the house to visit his worthy companions, Mick and Pnub. Once reunited with them, Anton, who shuns the news, however, learns of the murders that have upset the town of Bolan. When the three friends try to piece together the clues, Anton doubts that he is the one responsible for the heinous crimes. In reality it is his right hand, animated by an independent will, to commit the murders.
notes: Rodman Flender's short film steals how and where it can (from Oliver Stone to the "Addams Family") and attempts a goliardic parody of the "horror & collegiate" sub-genre starring four teenage divas.

title: Entrapment
actors: Sean Connery, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Ving Rhames, Will Patton
description: Robert "Mac" Mac Douglas is widely regarded as one of the best thieves in the world, so when a Rembrandt is stolen, suspicions focus on him. Insurance investigator Virginia "Gin" sets out on Mac's trail. Gin thinks she already has a plan to frame him, but the thief is skilled enough not to fall into the trap.
notes: With its international sets, "Entrapment" looks a bit like a movie of yesteryear, between James Bond and the golden hits of the Sixties. Directed professionally by a director with no particular personality, the film plays above all on the fascinating alchemy that takes place between the two interpreters.

title: La vespa e la regina
actors: Claudia Gerini, Pere Ponce, Ana Risueño, Luigi Petrucci, Cosimo Cinieri, Armando De Razza, Paolo Sassanelli
description: Renato is a young man who directs a homosexual culture magazine and who has made diversity a pride and a profession. But he is forced to promise his dying grandmother that at least once in his life he will try to go with a woman. The boy thus undertakes to conquer a provocative blonde, Ginevra, who, surprise !, is an irreducible lesbian, leader of the rock group the Fuckin 'Girls.
notes: The newcomer De Leo throws it into the fairy tale, trying to use the stylistic features of Hollywood cinema (like "In & Out"). Unfortunately he is also attracted to Nando Cicero and so the "jokes" are wasted, the "double meanings" abound and moralism breaks through in an ending that wants to put things right.

title: Autunno
actors: Nina di Majo, Moni Ovadia, Giovanni Bruno, Francesca Caracciolo
description: Matteo is a teenager raised in a high bourgeois environment, who has to struggle with a neurotic jailer mother and an indifferent and trafficking father. Constance is twenty-five years old and is terrified of a future without a job, crushed by the expectations of her parents, with a passion for writing. Betta, 40, Costanza's aunt is on the run from a man who betrays her.
notes: It is the stubborn, "unpleasant" first work of a young woman, born in 1975. A film that narrates and shows people and places that the girl knows (and "analyzes") very well.

title: Entre las piernas
actors: Victoria Abril, Javier Bardem, Carmelo Gomez, Juan Diego, Sergi López
description: Two sex addicts attend a detoxification course. He is a screenwriter stuck in a lustful and mysterious story; she works in a radio and lives an inhibited sexuality, but only with her policeman husband. Their clandestine relationship is intertwined with the murder investigation conducted by her spouse.
notes: With the exception of the promising opening titles made in pure Saul Bass style, the good Gomez Pereira more than Hitchcock apes Bigas Luna to the maximum, without possessing the irony and carnality. A game of joints that involves characters who could have a very different vitality in a useless farce; like Miranda, played by a seductive Abril, who gives us great tenderness with her styling as a housewife from Voghera.

title: Nemesis
actors: Olivier Gruner, Brion James, Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa, Tim Thomerson
description: Usual near future, usual futuristic metropolis gutted by crime and chaos. A group of terrorists decides to exploit the situation to subvert the social order. But he hasn't come to terms with Alex, the LAPD's best "man", half human, half cyborg.
notes: Albert Pyun is a prolific author of B movies in this case committed to remaking "Robocop". Modest means, some good action sequences but terrifying staging. Actor Brion James, a level character actor (the unforgettable Leon from "Blade Runner"), passed away just a few weeks ago.

title: Cousin Bette
actors: Jessica Lange, Elisabeth Shue, Bob Hoskins, Hugh Laurie, Geraldine Chaplin
description: We are in the years preceding the February Revolution of 1848 and which see the affirmation of the fat bourgeoisie over the decaying nobility. At that time Bette tries to win a place in the aristocratic family of her newly deceased cousin. The only role that is granted to her is that of housekeeper and revenge, on the baron, her cousin and her children, Bette carries out by means of the cocotte Jenny and the young painter Venceslas, who reduce them to the pavement.
notes: The original sin of the film lies in not having supported the particular Balzacian realism, transforming it into an insipid speck. A change of tone frustrates the good cast on the pitch, with Jessica Lange looking like a psychopathic old maid as Bette and Elizabeth Shue clearly uncomfortable as the cocotte. To save what can be saved there is Hoskins, an extraordinary actor able to immerse himself in any role, here perfect in the role of the mayor of Paris, a rich and vulgar bourgeois.

title: Li chiamarono... briganti
actors: Claudia Cardinale, Enrico Lo Verso, Roberta Armani, Lina Sastri
description: We are in Italy in 1861. The political and military alignments, having broken up the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies, compete for the South: land of "peasants", inhabited by a "barbaric and violent" people. A land to invade and colonize, a land where the brigands, Fra 'Diavolo, Crocco and many others dominate. A land divided between more than eighty bands made up of 7000 men.
notes: Squitieri reinterprets, with his usual grit, the convulsive birth of a nation, siding with the peasant culture and those lost heroes who are called brigands. Idealism, utopias, rebelliousness, delinquency and revolutionary subversion coexist and merge in the adventure of these pawns of a game greater than themselves. The director reconstructs, with a disheveled energy, with apodictic and pedagogical dialogues, with an unpleasant dubbing, many close-ups and slow-motion scenes, the events of Crocco and his gang.

title: Los amantes del Círculo Polar
actors: Fele Martinez, Najwa Nimri, Nancho Novo, Maru Valdivielso
description: Ana and Otto fall in love as children and end up becoming step-siblings (their parents marry each other), but their love has to go through a myriad of tests. In fact, the two separated by Chance and the strength of Destiny begin a clandestine relationship, separate and seek each other desperately. All between Madrid and Finland, linked by the common dream of the sun at midnight that illuminates the Polar Circle.
notes: What would like to be a passionate love story is instead resolved with the coldness of a calligraphic exercise. Medem (who after the debut, "Vacas" has always disappointed) combines cumbersome script, aesthetic writing, no real madness, zero passion and an insistent mischief. It is not the displacement but the boredom that spreads after a couple of reels.

title: Susan's Plan
actors: Nastassja Kinski, Billy Zane, Rob Schneider, Lara Flynn Boyle, Dan Aykroyd
description: The plan Susan has in mind is to take out her ex-husband and thus be able to collect the substantial insurance premium. Unfortunately, the accomplices are more unfortunate than the other and for Susan things get complicated. Also because Susan's husband is such a strong man that he never dies. But when the dead escape us ...
notes: Filmed, it seems, in less than twenty days, it is a little cinematic "joke" of priceless elegance. Relaxed, ironic, comical "inside", in its very structure, as can only be the reflection of a world that exploded many years ago (since 1978, at the time of "Animal House") and which now can only continue tumbling on itself. Dreams (or rather nightmares) are populated by sharks, zombies, splatters and, above all, by "tarantinati" killers. On all the paradoxical protagonists, an overflowing and giant Dan Aykroyd, with bandana, jacket and a black tear tattooed on his face.

title: Un amore
actors: Lorenza Indovina, Fabrizio Gifuni, Luciano Federico, Roberta Lena
description: Marco and Sara met in 1982 in a nightclub and continued to see each other, albeit occasionally, for the rest of their lives. The love between the two, which broke out in those years, is made up of quarrels, encounters and sudden attacks. Marco and Sara meet again on December 31st 1999.
notes: An authentic challenge was launched by the Turin-based Tavarelli with his second feature film (after the beautiful and underrated "Portami via" of '94): twelve paintings shot in sequence (and in 14 days!) Bound together by thirty-second animated curtains each (by Laura Federici). The small movements of the camera go hand in hand with the small movements of the protagonists' hearts. That I am the tender, raven Lorenza Indovina; and the splendid absent-minded Fabrizio Gifuni. Produced and distributed by Pablo di Gianluca Arcopinto (who appears in the only lame episode of the film).

title: Femmina incatenata
actors: Gianni Agus, Franca Tamantini, Lori Randi, Manuel Roero, Jacqueline Plessis
description: Manuel, a famous sculptor and professor at the Academy of Fine Arts, has been cultivating for years the project of a statue capable of expressing the suffering of the soul, anxious to free himself from the constraints of matter. But the chain remains only a project in Manuel's mind that fails to give an adequate plastic expression of the idea. When the sculptor leaves Rome to follow his mistress Jacqueline, one of his pupils stays in the studio and, based on the master's drawings, he marvelously carves the Chained. Upon his return, Manuel is shocked to see his idea done so well that ...
notes: Classic melodrama as it was fashionable in the 1950s.

title: Giarrettiera Colt
actors: Nicoletta Machiavelli, Claudio Camaso, Marisa Solinas, Yorgo Voyagis
description: On the border with Mexico, during Maximilian's revolution against the French, a stagecoach carrying a woman and a French soldier who escaped the revolutionaries is attacked by a bandit known as "Il Rosso". The woman manages to put him on the run. Arriving in the village, a Mexican who was about to be hanged frees and takes up residence in the village hotel. Meanwhile, "Il Rosso", who is trafficking in arms with the revolutionaries, is opposed by a French soldier disguised as a Mexican and by the girl.
notes: A rather confusing and best-played adventure film.

title: The Care and Handling of Roses
actors: Ann Jillian, Lee Horsley, Garrett M. Brown, Sheila McCarthy, Allison Mack
description: Jean and Tom, both movie buffs, get to know each other in a screening room while they are watching old movies. A friendship is born between them which soon turns into love and passion. When they decide to meet in a hotel, Jean, who is a married woman, has deep remorse towards her husband, with whom, despite everything, she is in love. So from one day to the next she decides to break off the newly born relationship, to go back to her husband and never see Tom again. But even if the force of love and feelings is sometimes stronger than life itself, Jean forces a return to the bosom of the family, stifling her attraction for Tom.

title: Perdutamente tuo... mi firmo Macaluso Carmelo fu Giuseppe
actors: Stefano Satta Flores, Macha Meril, Luciano Salce, Umberto Orsini
description: After working in Germany for many years, Carmelo Macaluso manages to put away the money to return to his country, Sicily, long dreamed of as the ideal place to rebuild a life. When he arrives in the village, he will find that many things are not quite as he remembered, and all the hard-earned money will only serve him to avoid jail.
notes: Teasing the narrow-mindedness of the "province". The grotesque tones used by Sindoni do not always avoid the speck, but the operation sufficiently ferocious.

title: L'ultimo cacciatore
actors: David Warbeck, Tisa Farrow, Bobby Rhodes, John Steiner, Tony King, Margie Newton, Massimo Vanni, Luciano Pigozzi, Dino Conti
description: Captain Morris, while on leave, is in a Saigon brothel with his friend Steve and the black soldier Washington. Steve is desperate for the disappearance of Carol, the girl he is in love with. In a moment of madness he kills a man and then shoots himself. Morris soon after sets off on a suicide mission beyond enemy lines. He has to find a traitor.
notes: Weak clone of "The Hunter" with a couple of cloned ideas to "Apocalypse Now". Margheriti, otherwise skilled craftsman of the Italian genres, doesn't seem very inspired this time. To underline the good performance of Rhodes, the only "Afro-Italian" actor.

title: Nowhere
actors: James Duval, Rachel True, Nathan Bexton, Chiara Mastroianni, Debi Mazar, Kathleen Robertson, Jordan Ladd, Christina Applegate, Sarah Lassez, Guillermo Diaz, Jeremy Jordan, Jaason Simmons, Ryan Phillippe, Alan Boyce, Traci Lords, Shannen Doherty, Rose McGowan, Beverly D'Angelo, Heather Graham, Mena Suvari
description: Dark Smith is a gorgeous and alienated eighteen-year-old boy obsessed with the end of the world and desperate for true love. The one who makes him despair is Mel also because the girl wastes her time with Dark and his girlfriend Lucifer, busty and addicted to acid. Montgomery joins the group and the four find themselves at "Il Buco", a café. Their stories are intertwined with showers, masturbation and violence.
notes: The original title of the film is "Nowhere" and was premiered at the Sundance Film Festival in 1997. With this film, Gregg Araki, cult director of gay culture closes a trilogy on "teen apocalypse" - after "Totally Fucked Up" and "Doom Generation "- and claims to be inspired by the choral structures of Altmanian cinema. The film, with a hyperactive montage, with saturated and explosive colors, reinterprets MTV, "America today" and above all the television series like "Beverly Hills 90210" and "Melrose Place".

title: Altro enigma
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Alessandro Gassmann, Fanny Ardant, Annie Girardot
description: A middle-aged man, an expert in the world and the reality of life, desperately tries and by all means at his disposal to destroy his son's virility. The boy is also struggling with an increasingly blinding death instinct. His enterprise will fail miserably and his father, having lost all his certainties, will end up as a wanderer and alone to give a fabulous testimony of the key to the anguish that afflicts the world.
notes: Cast of all respect for an attempt at reinterpretation between Sophocles and Pasolini of the myth of jealousy between father and son, played respectively by Vittorio and Alessandro Gassman.

title: Boyz'n the Hood
actors: Ice Cube, Cuba Gooding jr., Morris Chestnut, Laurence Fishburne
description: Anything can happen in the streets of the black ghetto of Los Angeles: even when children come home from school, they stumble upon a corpse abandoned there and not yet removed. Violence is at home and gang fights are commonplace. Tre is only seventeen and has two brothers for friends: Doug, a violent drug dealer and a veteran of jail, and Ricky, who would like to escape from the ghetto soon. When Ricky is shot for fun, the fight breaks out ...
notes: A bit too moralizing melodrama shot by an angry black director. Among the performers the rapper Ice Cube.

title: The Colony
actors: John Ritter, Mary Page Keller, Hal Linden
description: The Knowltons move to a community called "The Colony" with the hope of escaping once and for all from the stresses of the metropolis and modern life. But "The colony" has its rules, apparently harmless, really dictatorial. So the Knowltons find themselves in a real lager where you are punished if you move a vase on the terrace or paint the veranda in an "inappropriate" color. Eventually they will try to resist.
notes: The film is quite interesting, and for the originality of the subject it is a kind of exception.

title: Tirez sur le pianiste
actors: Charles Aznavour, Marie Dubois, Albert Rémy, Nicole Berger
description: Humble bistro pianist Charlie accidentally gets caught up in a gangster showdown and is forced to flee. He decides to figgire with his friend Lena but fate is lurking.
notes: Second film by Truffaut after the exploit of "The four hundred hits". It did not go as well and attracted malicious comments from critics; instead it remains a beautiful story that chooses to tackle a genre (noir) with originality but without intellectual pride. Based on a novel by David Goodis, author of the astonishing "Dark Passage", who said he was very satisfied with the truffautian version.

title: Vivement dimanche!
actors: Philippe Lauden Bach, Fanny Ardant, Jean-Louis Trintignant
description: While participating in a hunting trip in a swamp, Claude is killed by a shotgun. Police suspect Julien, the owner of a real estate agency who was in the swamp at the time of the murder. A few days pass and Claude's wife is also found dead. Julien is made the subject of anonymous phone calls which become more and more threatening and which force him to take refuge in his office. To get rid of his anguish, his secretary starts the investigation ...
notes: Truffaut's latest film that recovers cadences and yellow and yellow themes of Hollywood origin, but with his superfine touch.

title: The Base
actors: Mark Dacascos, Tim Abel, Paula Trickey, Noah Blake, Dwayne Macopson
description: An officer is wounded while in Fort Tilman. For this reason, the Pentagon, in an attempt to clarify the subject, sends a military man to investigate. The lucky one who is assigned the task is Major John Murphy who enters the fort by taking the name of John Dalton. During an inspection Murphy / Dalton discovers a shipment of drugs hidden in a truck. Investigations begin ...
notes: Mark L. Lester ("Commando") directs an all-action film that spares no scenes of violence. Mark Dacascos and the beautiful and sensual Paula Trickey thinks about saving the shack: keep an eye on her.

title: Tango blu
actors: Roberto De Marchi, Gigi Sammarchi, Andrea Roncato, Franco Franchi, Maurizio Merli
description: In the Milanese nightclub "Tango blu", the manager calls a bunch of bizarre characters because he is convinced that a highly sought-after serial killer is hiding among them.
notes: Grotesque comedy that would like to touch surreal strings and which instead ends up in a great mess. Sorry for the cast (Franco Franchi and Maurizio Merli in great dust), engaged in unsolvable parts. Bevilacqua insists on believing that he is a director.

title: The Return of the Fly
actors: Vincent Price, Brett Halsey, Danielle De Metz
description: The humanoid fly that caused so much fear in the public at the time of the legendary "Dr. K's experiment" is back. This time the son of the scientist from the first episode tries to follow in his father's footsteps and contaminates himself with the body of a fly. Predictable outcome.
notes: The surprise resulting from the special effects belongs entirely to the first film, however this sequel is enjoyable, thanks also to the always splendid performance of Vincent Price. The third chapter, "Curse of the Fly" by Don Sharp, has only passed on TV.

title: Mio caro assassino
actors: George Hilton, Salvo Randone, Marilù Tolo, William Berger
description: Umberto Paradisi is found by the police with his head severed. Everything points to an accident in which the operator of a digger is thought to be guilty. In truth, the tragic event hides more than one crime and the kidnapping of a child. Commissioner Luca Peretti investigates but the murders continue unabated.
notes: Truly disturbing thriller directed with a sure hand by Sergio Leone's favorite pupil. Valerii, assisted by an excellent cast, sips the suspense and combines thriller scares with literary enigma plots. Too long underestimated.

title: Indiscreet
actors: Luke Perry, Adam Baldwin, Peter Coyote, Gloria Reuben
description: Michael Nash is a former cop now a private investigator for a legal department and is tasked with stalking Eva Dodds, wife of the firm's president. Her husband Zachariah believes she is cheating on him, but instead the woman spends a lot of time with her sick mother and only has the habit of drinking a little too much and diving naked into the ocean. Eva, who has signs of physical abuse on her, seems determined to drown herself by diving into the sea after taking pills. Nash saves her life, the two fall in love and try to keep the relationship hidden. But when Eva's husband is found killed everyone begins to suspect Nash.

title: I Was a Teenage Frankenstein
actors: Whit Bissell, Phyllis Coates, Robert Burton
description: A mentally disturbed scientist decides to retrieve Dr. Frankenstein's theories to bring the corpses back to life. He chooses a boy who has just died in an accident as the guinea pig for his nefarious experiment. But the soul of the predestined, during the transport to England, rebels against the torturer.
notes: Typical product destined for Drive in, one of those series B horror that tried to recruit teenagers by promising scares and cheap blood. The film is enjoyable, also because it is accompanied by an atmosphere of sincere nostalgia.

title: Bride of Frankenstein
actors: Boris Karloff, Elsa Lanchester, Colin Clive, Valerie Hobson, Ernest Thesiger
description: Lord Byron, Percy and Mary Shelley discuss the continuation of "Frankenstein". And together they decide to imagine the creature still alive, ended up in the hands of another mad doctor, Pretorius, who makes him a kind of companion. The living dead girl does not like the monster's court and unleashes a new ruckus.
notes: Perhaps Whale's masterpiece: a concentrate of irony and gothic touches that manages to renew the Frankenstein myth, never so painful. The Lancaster with the white streaks is an icon of the camp, the scene of his resurrection a mythical moment. Shrunken homunculi are one of the most fanciful gimmicks in 1930s cinema. Recently honored in the film "Demons and Gods", director's biography.

title: Dagli Appennini alle Ande
actors: Cesare Barbetti, Leda Gloria, Nino Pavese, Cesco Baseggio
description: Little Marco clandestinely embarks on a steamer in Genoa to reach his mother in Argentina, since he hasn't heard from her for years. The brave boy faces difficulties that are not light, often helped by generous compatriots, but bad luck makes his searches fruitless. After having crossed all of Argentina, Marco finally arrives at the house where his mother is in very serious conditions: but the meeting with the child is healthy for the woman ...
notes: Honest reduction of a story contained in _Cuore_ by Edmondo De Amicis. Folco Quilici made a remake of it in 1959.

title: Le Dernier Métro
actors: Catherine Deneuve, Gérard Depardieu, Heinz Bennent, Jean Poiret
description: During the Nazi occupation of Paris, Marion Steiner - who manages the Montmartre theater - tried not to interrupt the reruns of the shows and to continue the work of Lucas, her Jewish husband, who was forced to remain hidden. A new actor arrives, Bernard Granger, who helps to successfully relaunch the image of the theater but ends up falling in love with Marion ...
notes: A dramatic comedy (written by Truffaut himself and Suzanne Schiffman) endowed with that lightness of style that only greats have. Class (of François) is not water. The film had a good success with the public and ten Césars.

title: In My Sister's Shadow
actors: Janet Leigh, Nancy McKeon, Tomas McCarthy
description: Joan is a young owner of a flower shop. Oppressed by feelings of guilt, triggered by the fact of feeling responsible for the disappearance of her father, who committed suicide when she was a child, the woman is always ready to run to the aid of everyone, especially her sister, Laurie, a charming girl who after a long convic with Michael, she decides to marry Mark. Michael is a charming, but poorly balanced man. Laurie's abandonment triggers a kind of violent madness in him: the only person he trusts is Joan. On the other hand, she feels for Michael something that goes beyond simple friendship.

title: Capone
actors: Ben Gazzara, John Cassavetes, Harry Guardino
description: America is ready to experience the most tragic apotheosis of crime. Prohibition proliferates clandestine alcohol smuggling organizations. In this context, the unstoppable rise of Alfredo Capone, who manages to defeat the competition of the Irish mafia by establishing a climate of terror that leads to the notorious Valentine's Day massacre.
notes: Biography of the famous gangster, well served by Gazzara's "mimetic" test. The film is produced by Roger Corman, some sequences of the massacre are taken from his film "The Valentine's Day Massacre". In the role of Nitti a very young Sly Stallone.

title: Voulez-vous danser avec moi?
actors: Brigitte Bardot, Henri Vidal, Philippe Nicaud, Dario Moreno
description: Virginie, scion of a rich family, marries a dentist against the will of her father Hervé. But the young man remains involved in the affair with another woman, Anita, who has him photographed in order to be able to blackmail him. The next day Hervé returns to the place where he met Anita and finds her killed. Virginie discovers him with the murder weapon in hand, but the young groom proclaims himself innocent ...
notes: Not exceptional pink yellow, but embellished by the dazzling presence of Brigitte Bardot. Directing by profession.

title: Yellow Sky
actors: Richard Widmark, Anne Baxter, Gregory Peck
description: A group of former soldiers turned bandits arrive in a mining village where they are greeted by the only two inhabitants, an old gold digger and his grandson. The "ghost" country is the scene of the clash between the two leaders of the group, Dude and James, who have very different ideas on how to continue (and especially "if" to continue) the criminal activity.
notes: Understated western inspired by Shakespeare's "Tempest". A tragic explosion that lends itself well to the classic iconography of the western. Widmark's test is truly superb, while Peck's is more tarnished. Remade in '66 by Robert Webb, with the title of "Six guns for six carrion".

title: Scapricciatiello
actors: Fulvia Franco, Elena Altieri, Gabriele Tinti, Dante Maggio, Tecla Scarano
description: The young Gennarino, the son of wealthy landowners, studied law in Naples. His student room is located in a popular neighborhood; from his balcony Gennaro, called by the people "scapricciatello", spies on the beautiful Carmela, the water seller of the neighborhood. The young man, of course, falls in love with the girl, who is however disputed by Pasquale, the guappo of the district. When Gennarino sees him come out of her house at night, he threatens to make a mistake.
notes: A rather cheap story that cannot count, for reasons of registry office, not even on the "transport" of Mario Merola. Nothing new under Vesuvius.

title: Zulu Dawn
actors: Burt Lancaster, Peter O'Toole, Simon Ward, Denholm Elliott
description: Year of grace 1878: the English soldiers, regimented and loyal to formal discipline, in order not to break ranks sprawling, let themselves be massacred in an ambush set by the warriors of the Zulu tribe, backward in terms of strategy but certainly more alert in tactics. The massacre creates complications for the settlement operations of the colonizers.
notes: The title seems to be that of a horror: instead Hickox's film tells, pompously, a fact that really happened. Exoticism for families in the panoramic vision of Africa, with a very high-sounding cast. Ideal prequel to Cy Enfield's _Zulu_ (1964).

title: Mr. Hobbs Takes a Vacation
actors: James Stewart, Maureen O'Hara, John McGiver, John Saxon
description: Hobbs, a moderately successful businessman, has long aspired to a peaceful seafaring holiday in the company of his wife Peggy. The latter, on the other hand, has well thought of gathering the entire family on the beach: a host of children, siblings and grandchildren. So for poor Hobbs the dream turns into a nightmare. He will see some good ones, ahilui ...
notes: Mr. Hobbs’s holidays are certainly not up to par with those of the magnificent Monsieur Hulot di Tati, but we are still having fun. James Stewart dazed is a hoot, director Koster is the same as _Harvey_; and this other film is right in the balance between _Mr. Smith goes to Washington_ and the famous story of the invisible rabbit.

title: Mark il poliziotto
actors: Franco Gasparri, Lee J. Cobb, Sara Sperati
description: A young commissioner of the Milan police almost casually begins to investigate a very prominent businessman. The policeman is hindered in every way because the notable, close to powerful and politicians, is in reality a drug kingpin.
notes: A good example of an Italian detective story, directed with a sure hand by a specialist, Stelvio Massi, who later got slightly lost. "Mark the policeman" remains one of those few Italian action movies of an almost American brand in terms of pace and professionalism. Bravo the protagonist, Franco Gasparri: were it not for a tragic fate, he would have become a star.

title: Airspeed
actors: Elisha Cuthbert, Joe Mantegna, Lynne Adams, Jason Cavalier
description: A 13-year-old girl, the daughter of a very wealthy American businessman, leaves on her father's private plane. During a storm, lightning strikes the plane, killing the pilot and injuring the rest of the crew. The girl, terrified, finds herself alone to face the dramatic situation. It will attempt a crash landing, piloted from the ground by the control tower.
notes: TV movie anything but original but at least with a right dose of suspense. Those who suffer from air sickness should abstain. Recommended, however, for those who, as a child, wanted to be a pilot or astronaut.

title: Come Fly With Me
actors: Dolores Hart, Hugh O'Brian, Pamela Tiffin, Karlheinz Böhm, Dawn Addams
description: Three stewardesses and their life aboard large airliners and their relationships with crew members and passengers. Relationships that generate a situation where the three girls will end up in prison. But everything will be resolved with the most classic happy ending.
notes: Brilliant "American-style" comedy conducted with an agile hand despite inconsistencies and naiveté. The screenplay is well supported by the group of leading actors, in which Pamela Tiffin, starlets of the time, stands out. Henry Levin is one of the most prolific American "professional" directors, with a hundred titles to his credit.

title: 5 bambole per la luna d'agosto
actors: Edwige Fenech, Howard Ross, Justine Gall
description: A scientist who has just invented a formula whose secret many would like to steal, is invited to a villa by a strange rich man, along with other people. Inside the gloomy building someone is having fun with a macabre game: he kills the guests. Everyone seems to be victims, no one seems to be the culprit.
notes: The true master of the Italian thriller, Mario Bava, enjoys directing a horror variation of Agatha Christie's "Ten Little Indians". Not everything shines like in his best gothic films, but some things are very classy, ??starting with the title. Fright, blood and good cinema ...

title: A domani
actors: Stefania Rivi, Andrea Corneti, Wilson Saba, Paolo Sassarelli
description: Andrea is fifteen years old, he lives in Vignola and his life runs smoothly until he begins to wonder where the buses go when they leave the station. Torn between delusions of omnipotence and everyday reality, he doesn't quite know which path to take. Until one day he discovers that his sister Stefania, a little older than him, is secretly preparing a romantic getaway with her boyfriend in Bologna. Andrea understands that he has no time left, he has to find a girl right away, get engaged and leave ...
notes: Zanasi is good at directing and controlling the vitality of his non-professional actors, in building hilarious and never boring dialogues, in filming scenes that seem to feed on an autonomous energy internal to situations, in governing a film that has the weight of a feather. .

title: With or Without You
actors: Christopher Eccleston, Dervla Kirwan, Yvan Attal
description: Tossed from one analytical laboratory to another, a Northern Irish couple experiences the anguish of not being able to have children. For Vincent and Rosie, sexual performance and test reading become an obsession and the love between the two falters. He allows himself an adventure, while Rosie consoles herself with an old French friend who is cultured, ironic and has always been in love with her.
notes: Light without being superficial, the film tackles one of the most burning problems for the modern couple with a typically television language and narration. The cast supports the director's commitment with skill, who demonstrates mastery in mixing dramatic and ironic situations and who is not ashamed of loving his characters.

title: Bad ma ra khahad bord
actors: Behzad Dourani e gli abitanti del villaggio di Siah Dareh
description: Slowly the jeep crosses the majestic landscape of the Kurdistan countryside. The white road wraps with its curves the trees, the expanses of wheat, the soft peaks, the clouds, the meadows, the stones, the few peasants, almost lost, in the empty and solemn space. A group of men arrive in a car from Tehran who are looking for an isolated village. They tell a child who accompanies them to their destination, lying, that they are looking for a treasure in the cemetery, at the top of the hill.
notes: The director, in his tenth feature film, purifies his cinema, resets the plot, dilates time and fixes the stones, the wrinkles, the ears, the leaves. He exalts his contemplative vein and his photographic taste. Not his masterpiece, and with a hint of mannerism. Grand Jury Prize at the Venice Film Festival.

title: Crazy in Alabama
actors: Melanie Griffith, David Morse, Rod Steiger, Meat Loaf
description: In the summer of '65, in Alabama, Lucille killed her grim husband and set out to conquer Hollywood, taking her severed head with her in a hatbox. In California she immediately clashes with success, becoming the heroine of the soap "My wife is a witch". Recognized, she is brought back to the small southern village and tried.
notes: Banderas made his debut behind the lens and above, below, alongside his wife Melanie Griffith. The story, taken from the book by Mark Childress (who scripts), is told from the point of view of Peejoe, Lucille's favorite nephew and champion - in the meantime - of the black case against a racist cop (the effective and unrecognizable Meat Loaf) who killed a black boy. Rod Steiger's Oscar-winning cameo.

title: Protagonists
actors: Tilda Swinton, Fabrizia Sacchi, Laura Betti, Michelle Hunziker
description: In the mid-90s, two London boys decide to commit, for pure pleasure, a perfect crime. Kill someone and then disappear. Return to the shadows, cancel oneself in an arrogant and maniacal anonymity. The victim is a passing motorist. The same fascination for an absurd murder leads to a new director and a famous actress being found on the set.
notes: The director wants to deconstruct and interpret the fact, the well-known face (Swinton) is the guide of the Italian troupe, in London to film places, movements, motives, dynamics of the crime, investigation and memories. Metropolitan geography, TV investigation, fiction and testimonies are intertwined.

title: Getting to Know You
actors: Heather Matarazzo, Michael Weston, Bebe Neuwirth
description: We grow up fast in the American provinces and adolescence is often stolen from a life that dictates its laws relentless. It is what happens to brothers Judith and Wesley and to the same age Jimmy, who find themselves in a bare and anonymous bus station in a small town in the most remote province, to invent the lives of the strangers around them, in order to actually be able to talk. about themselves and their personal problems. The game is started by the braggart Jimmy, who talks the younger and naïve Judith and pisses off her brother of the same age. But the station gradually transforms into a sort of psychoanalyst's bed from which emerges the desperation of children who feel betrayed by the world of adults.
notes: A film that sometimes gets lost a little too much behind the stories told by the three young protagonists, but their intensity is strong and often clings to the viewer.

title: Libero Burro
actors: Sergio Castellitto, Margaret Mazzantini, Michel Piccoli, Chiara Mastroianni
description: Libero, a former central-southern hoarder disguised as a northern manager, in Turin he grabbed "La Cavallerizza", a building in the center of a thousand square meters to be put back in place. So on summer evenings in the bar on the banks of the Po Libero he tells his brick dream that must come true to his friend Tony. To do things right Libero, at the age of forty he started studying to get a surveyor's diploma. However, there is someone who does not forgive him and has to contend with an entrepreneur who hides the brand of the criminal under the grisaille.
notes: Castellitto, in addition to directing, is also the main protagonist of this film, with some imbalances in the second part, but which reveals a director's point of view worthy of attention.

title: A Price Above Rubies
actors: Renée Zellweger, Christopher Eccleston, Julianna Margulies
description: Sonia, daughter of a goldsmith who lives in the Jewish quarter of New York, is a gemstone expert married to a promising rabbi, who finds herself having to work with her brother-in-law. If the husband is a pious man who mortifies her femininity, the brother-in-law is a narrow-minded being, with no ideals other than that of profit; the new job and the attentions of her brother-in-law lead her to a new self-awareness.
notes: The film, produced by Miramax owners Bob and Harvey Weinstein, weakened by a useless fantasy involving Sonia and her little brother demonstrates how religious fanaticism destroys human relationships; but this is not a "game", contrary to the false promises of the Italian title.

title: The Hanging Garden
actors: Chris Leavins, Kerry Fox, Seanna McKenna
description: On the occasion of his sister's wedding, William returns home after ten years of absence. It has changed a lot since then; he is no longer obese but has become a handsome and lean boy, finally aware of his homosexuality. The garden, however, is always the same, with its plants and flowers, as well as the family, a den of paranoia and perversions that are just waiting for him to get back into action.
notes: Winner of the '97 Toronto Film Festival, the Canadian film, however, is a missed opportunity, in which a good idea is squandered by a superficial script that abandons its characters.

title: Prima del tramonto
actors: Said Taghmaoui, Vincenzo Peluso, Simona Cavallari, Ninni Bruschetta, Gigi Savoia
description: Ali, a young and charming Moroccan, is preparing to marry the daughter of his master, Nicetra, an elderly boss of the local underworld. But at the last moment he deserted the ceremony and took refuge in a fourth-rate hotel room with Assia, his splendid countryman, madly in love with him. They make love waiting for evening to reach the airport and escape far away.
notes: An even more deconstructed "Mediterranean Pulp Fiction". A mature test that casts a lucid glance on the mirages of a disbanded (southern) Italy, consumerist-addicted, with no more identity and no reference points to cling to. In the cast stand out an incisive Said Taghmaoui (revealed in "L'odio" by Kassovitz), Ninni Bruschetta and Simona Cavallari.

title: Instinct
actors: Cuba Gooding jr., Anthony Hopkins, Donald Sutherland, George Dzundza, Maura Tierney
description: Dr. Ethan Powell is a primate scholar who spent years in the African jungle with gorillas. Assaulted with animals, he killed two men to defend the herd and was captured and locked up in a criminal asylum at home. Refuses to speak: pulled by the hair, reacts violently to prison violence, always guided by an instinctive sense of justice ...
notes: The film never touches horror even by chance, but develops according to the traditional logic of prison film seasoned with tons of psychology and African flashbacks en plein air. Too long and boring to thrill.

title: The Parasite Murders/Shivers
actors: Barbara Steele, Paul Hampton, Joe Silver, Lynn Lowry, Allan Kolman, Susan Petrie
description: Strange things happen in a new residential complex: some tenants, in the grip of sexual frenzies, attack their neighbors. The behaviors seem contagious, and mysterious organisms similar to large leeches begin to move inside the condominium contaminating the inhabitants ... Cronenberg's first feature film is a compendium of his obsessions to come: contagions, mutations, visionary delusions of the flesh. All in a building that is already a "body" in itself. An intellectual horror that however embraces the aesthetics of the B series, giving the queen of the genre, Barbara Steele, a participation that is difficult to forget.

title: The Out-of-Towners
actors: Steve Martin, Goldie Hawn, John Cleese, Mark McKinney
description: Henry and Nancy are a couple whose passion seems to have been consumed between the payments for the mortgage on the home for their children 'university. When Henry has to go to New York for a job interview, the Clarks know what awaits them: a prodigious career for him and the rediscovery of the spark that had made them fall in love. But what appears to be a mundane business trip will turn into a series of incredible Central Park adventures.
notes: It was 1970 when Jack Lemmon and Sandy Dennis in "A Provincial in New York", based on the script by Neil Simon, had to adapt their prejudices and their affections to the metropolitan rhythm. In this remake it is Martin and Hawn, away from Ohio, who are sucked into the Big Apple. This new version, albeit with the inevitable adjustments, demonstrates the strength of a textbook script and writing that no longer exists.

title: The Thirty-Nine Steps
actors: Robert Donat, Madeleine Carroll, Godfrey Tearle, Lucie Mannheim
description: In London on business Richard Hanney is involved, in spite of himself, in an espionage affair. On the verge of death, a woman entrusted him with confidential information concerning a professor. The police, holding him responsible for the woman's death, pursue him. Twice arrested he manages to escape, but is hunted down by members of the secret organization "The Thirty-nine Steps" who want him dead.
notes: Based on John Buchan's novel "The Thirty-Nine Steps", the film is told with comedy tones and a perfect rhythm. One of the best Hitchcocks of the English period (and one of the director's favorite films). Remade in 1959 by Ralph Thomas and in 1978 by Don Sharp.

title: I vampiri
actors: Gianna Maria Canale, Paul Müller, Dario Michaelis
description: A Parisian noblewoman is convinced that the secret of eternal youth is hidden in human blood. For this he bleeds some girls: a journalist becomes suspicious and manages to discover the horrible ritual ...
notes: A film born almost as a bet, with Freda who challenges the producers and says he is convinced he can make a fantastic film with four lire. The result is the first Italian horror, a cult that can count on the extraordinary special effects of Mario Bava (also director of photography) and on the typical gothic touch of Freda. The false happy ending was imposed by the production: Freda wanted it to end in massacre.

title: I marziani hanno 12 mani
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Paolo Panelli, Magali Noël
description: Yes, there are other forms of more or less intelligent life in the universe. When the Martians decide it's time to pay a little visit to Earth, they choose to take a sightseeing tour in Rome. We are in the 60s, Fellini and Paparazzi are depopulated, the Anitona is a diva, and the Martians, in contact with the Dolce Vita of the capital, decide that perhaps it is appropriate to move permanently to the city.
notes: A slender comedy written and directed by Castellano and Pipolo, who later became the protagonists of Italian comedy in the 1980s. The comedy of Franchi and Ingrassia is coarse as usual. Morricone's soundtrack, shortly before the Italian westerns.

title: The Amazons
actors: Alena Johnstone, Sabine Sun, Angelo Infanti, Luciana Paluzzi
description: Antiope, by eliminating one by one all the candidates of a primitive decathlon, including her sister Oreteia, earns the title of queen of the Amazons. Taken in this way, power decides to establish the ancient warlike discipline by imposing a rigidly feminist indoctrination. But there are those who try to make her fall into an ambush: it is Theseus, king of the Greeks. But Antiope, having overcome a palace conspiracy led by his sister, manages to win it.
notes: Parody of feminism that takes its cue from the fantasy adventures of the Amazons. Terence Young sways between comics and adventure cinema.

title: Hard Bounty
actors: Matt McCoy, Kelly LeBrock, Rochelle Swanson, John Terlesky
description: After spending quiet years, Martin Kanning decides to get into trouble by buying the most important saloon in the city; over time, he realizes that the girls of the restaurant (one of whom, Donnie, strikes him for his attractiveness) have a relationship with customers that goes beyond the usual welcome. Soon the man will have to come to terms with the unscrupulous owner of a railway that is being built in the area: but when he kills one of his employees, Martin - who in the meantime has joined with Donnie - tries to do justice ...
notes: Mediocre attempt to "revive" the western with sexy injections.

title: An Annapolis Story
actors: John Derek, Diana Lynn, Kevin McCarthy, Pat Conway
description: Tony and his cousin Jim, cadets of the Annapolis Military Academy are distinguished by their brilliant skills and the enthusiasm that animates them. Jim is madly in love with Peggy and proves very jealous. During a long absence due to a sudden illness, Tony thinks well to take the woman away from him. Which happens on time. When the Korean War breaks out, Tony and Jim are sent to fight at the front. Things get worse when Jim learns that Peggy is Tony's official girlfriend.
notes: The sentimental stories of two cousins ??are an excuse for a propaganda film directed by Siegel with his left hand.

title: Topio stin omichli
actors: Tania Palaiologou, Michalis Zeke, Stratos Georgioglou, Eva Kotamanidou
description: Eleven-year-old Voula and her five-year-old brother Alexandros move away from their home, located in a popular neighborhood in the city of Athens. Their aim is to reach their father who emigrated to Germany. Secretly boarded a train and made to get off almost immediately by the staff, the two brothers find themselves on foot to continue their journey in the rain, snow and wind. On their wanderings they meet the young Oreste, a member of a troupe of actors who travels around Greece on a dilapidated bus.
notes: The Greek director portrays a sumptuous metaphor about the initiation into life of brother and sister. Guided by Tonino Guerra, he won the Silver Lion at the Venice Film Festival. The troupe that Voula and Alexandros meet is the one that had starred in "La recita".

title: Rupan sansei - Bai Bai Ribatii Kiki Ippatsu!
description: In order to have a free hand in view of a sensational blow, and to be able to act undisturbed on the international scene, Lupine III tries to permanently erase the documentation concerning him from the Interpol computers. He decides to get help from Virus Beta, a kid considered the best hacker on the market.
notes: Third film dedicated to Lupine III. All the characters of the series are lined up in plain sight: Zenigata, Gemon, Giggen and Fujiko, who a reckless Italian dubbing has transformed into Margot. One of the most successful "anime" (animated "manga") in the history of Japanese animation.

title: Il dolce rumore della vita
actors: Francesca Neri, Rade Serbedzija, Niccolò Senni, Rosalinda Celentano
description: Sofia falls in love with her acting teacher, a 35-year-old of Slavic origin with an irresistible charm. Sofia, who is twenty years old and who believes in this story with all her might, is shocked when she learns that Bruno is homosexual. The setback is so strong that he decides to run away. On the train that is supposed to take her far away, she will happen to have to take care of a child abandoned in the toilet.
notes: The film floats in a liquid full of banal chatter and second-hand thoughts. The lyrical drift of an otherwise excellent author drags and annihilates actors and words, emotions and essences.

title: Guardami
actors: Elisabetta Cavallotti, Stefania Orsola Garello, Flavio Insinna, Gianluca Gobbi
description: Nina chooses to be a porn actress without problems and without illusions, partly because she likes sex and partly out of curiosity. The life of Nina, romantically linked with Cristiana, an editor of a hard magazine, changes radically, one bad day, when she discovers she has cancer. Thus the body that has always served her to work, to be admired and to please, turns against her.
notes: A dense film, poorly written but shot with the heart, wrongly acted but emotionally violent. A film that is not ashamed to turn on its dizzying red lights.

title: The Thomas Crown Affair
actors: Rene Russo, Pierce Brosnan, Denis Leary, Frankie R. Faison, Faye Dunaway
description: Thomas Crown is a self-made billionaire who can safely buy anything he wants. Women fall at his feet, but there are things money can't buy and Thomas is running out of challenges. When the alarm of a large museum goes off and someone runs off with a priceless Monet, no one thinks it could be Thomas. But there is someone who is suspicious: Catherine Banning.
notes: Pierce Brosnan and Rene Russo walk through the film with a stainless aplomb and a slight indelible smile. Steve McQueen, in the "Thomas Crown Case" (of which this is a remake) was snappy and nervous, and Faye Dunaway looked mangled and spoiled (here her appearance makes your skin crawl). Everything that was fashionable there, here is an icy display of bon ton. Not at all bound by a slow and boring direction, we all end up feeling fatally fat and inelegant.

title: Todo sobre mi madre
actors: Cecilia Roth, Marisa Paredes, Candela Peña, Antonia San Juan, Penélope Cruz
description: Manuela lives alone with her teenage son Esteban who has never met his father. For Esteban's birthday Manuela takes him to the theater where "A tram called desire" is being performed. The two are united by admiration for the actress Huma Rojo and at the end of the show to chase her Esteban is hit by a car. Manuela escapes from Madrid and goes to Barcelona in search of Esteban's father, who walks the pavements with the name of Lola.
notes: Almodóvar with this film gives life in its purest form to mélo and blends it with the intelligence of comedy. And in the continuous oscillation between laughter and tears, in this unshakable emotional tension, Almodóvar captures and weaves the juice of the feminine moods that have always animated his films.

title: E allora mambo!
actors: Luca Bizzarri, Luciana Littizzetto, Paolo Kessisoglu, Maddalena Maggi
description: One life is not enough for Stefano. Suffocated by the daily wear and tear of a "normal" existence (wife, daughter, mortgage and nervous work), he wants to invent a second chance that is more pleasant, free, gratifying. Accomplices of this project, an accounting misunderstanding (inexplicably six billion ended up on his account) and a nice lawyer friend, scoundrel, mambo addict.
notes: Sweet misunderstandings and funny deceptions, smiling melancholies and funny lies. This first film by Fabio Bonifaci (screenwriter) and Lucio Pellegrini is surprising for the tightness of the story. Away from TV and close to a rich vein of Italian comedy.

title: La donna lupo
actors: Loredana Cannata, Arturo Paglia, Pascal Persiano, Francesco Di Leva
description: Giulia calls herself with different names (Viviana and Alessandra) but her true identity is that of Woman Lupo. He has exceeded anxieties and inhibitions to fully accept his desires. If during the day he has a normal life, at night he turns the city in search of his prey. To the males I catch asks and only wants sex. When he meets Valerio, the youngest and most naive of his victims, he understands that it will not be like this.
notes: Grimaldi goes beyond the limits of the soft imposed by Parietti in the "butcher" and takes advantage of the availability of Loredana Cannata - who, after all, does not disfigure - to unleash himself in a "Magic America" ​​catalog. Pasolinian ambitions, a perversity that are now bought at the supermarket passed through extreme transgressions and a boredom not related to Moravia.

title: Cruel Intentions
actors: Ryan Phillippe, Sarah Michelle Gellar, Reese Witherspoon, Selma Blair, Joshua Jackson, Sean Patrick Thomas, Christine Baranski, Swoosie Kurtz, Louise Fletcher, Eric Mabius, Chris O'Connell
description: At the beginning of the summer holidays, Court leaves Kathrin and becomes engaged to the innocent Cecile. To take revenge on Court, Kathrin urges her stepbrother Sebastian to court Cecile with the intention of making her lose her virginity. Sebastian accepts the challenge, but deeming it too easy, he shifts his sights to the new headmaster's daughter, Annette. The girl, author of an article in which she declares that she intends to remain a virgin until marriage, tickles Sebastian's curiosity who tries to make her fall into temptation.
notes: "Dangerous Liaisons" by Laclos, transformed into a novel for the twenties of 2000. The film by Kumble (former theatrical producer) does not take place in France at the end of the 1700s but in today's Manhattan. Eroticism thus becomes a mobile phone commercial and the soundtrack follows the dominant trends. Patinated and aesthetic, it has two aces up its sleeve: Sarah Michelle Gellar and Ryan Philippe, "bodies" that exude an authentic sensuality.

title: Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace
actors: Liam Neeson, Ewan McGregor, Natalie Portman, Pernilla August
description: An incident places Palpatine, an influential politician, at the center of a conflict between the giant Trade Federation and the peaceful planet Naboo. Thus the young queen of Naboo finds herself having to choose whether to sacrifice her ideals when the war engulfs her people. Jedi Master, Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi, a young and exuberant knight, arrive to negotiate the peace agreement.
notes: The film is all a gigantic special effect, played by real actors, where any narrative tension, any "human" emotion (which also existed in the first trilogy), is engulfed by the splendor of the image and the broken times of the video game. There is not a sequence (except that of the race of the shells, which in fact is the most exciting) that is not continuously interrupted and interspersed with others. It is as if Lucas, immersed in his dream for too long, had lost the enthusiasm and, unfortunately, the instinctive capacity of the story.

title: U2: Rattle and Hum
actors: Bono, Dave 'The Edge' Evans, Adam Clayton, Larry Mullen jr
description: The film documents the trip to the United States made by the members of the most famous Irish group for the promotion of the album of the same name. Interviews, live concerts in various locations in the United States and performances in the heart of Harlem see the quartet as protagonists in an increasingly engaging crescendo. During their journey U2 meet and duet with B. B. King, but have no qualms about coming into contact with street artists who are unlikely to achieve success. To crown their trip a visit to Graceland, the home museum of Elvis Presley, a musical icon of this century. Joanou, a specialist in music videos, directs with a refinement that is even too exquisite, in delicious black and white.

title: Un ladro in paradiso
actors: Nino Taranto, Geppa, Hélène Remy, Enzo Turco, Marisa Fimiani, Filippo Scelzo
description: Vincenzo and Gennarino live on tricks and petty thefts in Naples. On Christmas Eve, the former steals a set of glasses and gives it to his girlfriend Nannarella, a poor and honest seamstress. Unfortunately, the thing is discovered, and Vincenzo arrested. While recommending himself to St. Joseph, it seems to him that the latter demonstrates his benevolence to him with a gesture. Released from prison after three months full of good intentions, he obtains Nannarella's pardon and resumes contact with Gennarino. Since they can't find an honest job, the two are forced to steal again ...
notes: Discreet comedy with a really fit Nino Taranto.

title: Bloody Kids
actors: Derrick O'Connor, Gary Holton, Caroline Embling
description: Two restless youngsters who live in the working class area south of London decide to spend a slightly "different" Saturday and reach the city center. Their first goal is of course to pick up the girls: but it's not that easy, and after a series of refusals they decide to fall back on another type of pastime. The evening thus turns into a real raid and the two young protagonists, inebriated by the ultraviolence, also end up killing.
notes: One of the first films by the English director Stephen Frears, who also adapted a text originally intended for the stage. The references to previous works of course are wasted. "A Clockwork Orange" is the starting point, but compared to Kubrick's abstract and sublime version, Frears prefers the social cross-section and the harsh gaze on the London suburbs and its inhabitants. In England "Bloody Kids" was produced for television but then found regular theatrical distribution. In Italy, the film never came out in theaters.

title: Cold Dog Soup
actors: Randy Quaid, Seymour Cassel, Christine Harnos
description: Michael Latchmer is the typical man next door with no particular qualities and no ambitions. His life could be defined as "a long quiet river", where everything happens according to preordained patterns. But one night Michael finds a strange dog and to fix it he makes an appointment with a woman who turns out to be full of surprises.
notes: Black comedy excellently played by Randy Quaid, Dennis's lesser-known brother. The story is not particularly original.

title: Thunder in Paradise
actors: Hulk Hogan, Carol Alt, Felicity Waterman, Sam J. Jones, Chris Lemmon
description: Megan, the beautiful girl who owns the Paradise Beach Hotel has two days to find a husband. The woman inherited the hotel from her father, but according to a will clause, if within a year of her parent's death she does not marry, her uncle Edward will become the rightful owner of the hotel. Meanwhile, Spence, burdened by debt, does not know how to cope with the dire situation. Although the two hate each other to death, they decide to arrange a marriage of convenience to try to solve each other's problems. But to jeopardize their plan, David Kilmer, a dangerous criminal, gets in the way.

title: Il seme dell'uomo
actors: Marco Margine, Anne Wiazemsky, Annie Girardot, Rada Rassimov, Marco Ferreri
description: Cino and Dora are leaving for the summer holidays but are stopped by the apocalypse: on the road a patrol of soldiers, busy piling up and burning corpses, advises them to find a safe place to take refuge. Cities are destroyed, a disease attacks the population, the Pope asks for forgiveness, meanwhile Cino and Dora find shelter in a house by the sea, adapting to the new lifestyle ...
notes: Pessimism that dissolves into a mocking humor. Ferreri in full allegory, like a lot of cinema back then, but his anger and lucidity make the film a ferocious portrait of male selfishness and consumer society, valid even today. Indeed, even prophetic.

title: Le Franc
actors: Dieye Ma Dieye, Aminta Fall, Demba Bâ
description: A somewhat eccentric character, half clown and half poet, to make ends meet, he lives for the day by giving alms and playing his congoma on the streets of the city. One day luck smiles at him. He wins a large sum in the lottery but paradoxically cannot collect anything, because his winning ticket has been attached to the door so well that he cannot detach it without risking tearing it. So the man takes the door on his shoulders and starts walking around the city. He crosses a Dakar choked with garbage and debris to reach the sea, where he hopes to be able to dissolve the glue with salt water.
notes: A grotesque comedy that touches the light style of the fairy tale but hits hard in portraying the sad situation of one of the African megalopolises. A light breath of poetry crosses neighborhoods where poverty and desolation dominate unchallenged.

title: Kalte Küsse
actors: Marie Bäumer, Karoline Eichhorn, Matthias Fuchs
description: Hamburg policewoman Beate Stein is an experienced woman and has overcome everything but the murder of programmer Klaus Pape. His dissected body was found packed in the refrigerator. The victim's wife, Silke, went missing with her six-year-old daughter and the police immediately began to suspect her. Silke is found just as she is about to commit suicide. To avoid arrest, in fact, he decided to resort to this extreme gesture. Beate Stein strongly doubts her guilt. There is also a place in Silke's life for the Wessels family. Dr. Wessels is a lawyer who broke ties with Klaus. The case grows darker, as Stein discovers that Klaus was abusing her daughter. At this point the doubt arises: could Silke have killed her husband to protect the child? Dr. Wessels goes to great lengths to put Silke on a psychiatric treatment program to avoid jail. The case seems closed, but not for Detective Stein.

title: Inferno
actors: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Pat Morita, Danny Trejo, Gabrielle Fitzpatrick
description: Matt, Jesse, and Petey Ryker are no quiet people running a counterfeit organization in a maximum security area in Hell City. When they run into a truck in the Nevada desert, they meet Eddie Lomax, they beat him and rob him of his motorcycle and gun. Eddie is found by Jubal, an eccentric character who takes him to his shack, takes care of him and urges him to take revenge for the insult.
notes: The film is a meatloaf that combines a typical situation of the Italian western, a surreal comedy, and the action guaranteed by Van Damme.

title: Come te nessuno mai
actors: Silvio Muccino, Giulia Steigerwalt, Luca De Filippo, Anna Galiena
description: Silvio and Ponzi are friends and classmates in a high school in Rome. They decide to participate in a student collective in which they will decide whether to occupy the school again. But more than the occupation of the school, the two are interested in impressing the prettiest girl in the assembly. Finally he takes care and in the confusion Silvio finds himself hand in hand with Valentina who, in reality, is with Martino. The worst thing is that between the two there is also a kiss ...
notes: Dialogues intoned and cloned on the slang of young high school students who came from families of the left neo-bourgeoisie. At home you read the right newspapers, you have a past to defend and the neuroses can count on the help of the specialist. The actors faithfully stage their image and their idea of ??sentimental education. The camera is fluid, the pace light.

title: La niña de tus ojos
actors: Penélope Cruz, Antonio Resines, Neus Asensi, Jesús Bonilla
description: Spain, 1938. The civil war is in full swing. In an attempt to strengthen the collaboration between Franco and Hitler, Germany invites a group of Spanish producers, close to the new regime, to shoot the two versions of "The girl of your dreams" (one in German and one in Spanish) in Ufa studios. of Berlin. But the hospitality of the propaganda minister Goebbels has to do with the charm of the leading actress, Macareña Granada.
notes: The film, illuminated by the presence of Penélope Cruz, focuses on the loves, envy, whims and neuroses of cinema people, capable of making fun of Goebbels to save a deportee. The direction flattens the action into a series of theatrical pictures.

title: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels
actors: Sting, Jason Fleming, Dexter Fletcher, Nick Moran, Jason Statham
description: Eddy, a young slacker with a passion for gambling convinces his friends, Bacon, Tom and Soap to pay him 25,000 pounds each in order to allow him to sit at the green table with Hatchet Harry, a well-known gangster in the area. He has an unfinished business with Eddy's father, the only one to have beaten him at the game, taking away enough money to open a bar. With the help of his faithful follower Barry known as Il Battista, the gangster fixes the game, wins and blackmails Eddy.
notes: The film goes at breakneck speed like "Trainspotting" (which he quotes almost literally at the beginning), makes fun of itself, deriding its sought after "tarantinism", treasures the tradition (little known to us) of English hard boiled. Ritchie conducts with incessant rhythm (comes from the video clips). Sting, seraphic and impenetrable, oversees behind the bar, while Vinnie Jones, the footballer, comes straight from the school of tough guys with a soft side.

title: La guerra degli Antò
actors: Flavio Pistilli, Paolo Setta, Regina Orioli, Danilo Mastracci
