description: The Antò are four twenty-year-old punks who live in Montesilvano, they are all called Antonio and to distinguish themselves they have chosen nicknames: Antò lu Zombi who is a postman, Antò lu Malatu who is a nurse, Antò lu Zorru who is a journalist in a local newspaper and Antò lu Purk, the largest of the group. The four spend their days at the Zagreb bar or trying to ruin the parties given by the Treves twins in their villa. Then one day Antò lu Purk decides to go to Bologna to register for Dams, then to Amsterdam.
notes: Written by Domenico Starnone and Sandro Petraglia, the film, taken from Silvia Ballestra's book "Il disastro degli Antò", ventures the Virzì path, but does not have the compactness or fluidity of "Ovosodo". However, the characters are romantically sympathetic, the music of Avion Travel envelop as befits a story with bitter implications and the anarchism that pervades the work is sympathetic.

title: Un uomo perbene
actors: Michele Placido, Mariangela Melato, Giovanna Mezzogiorno
description: June 1983, Enzo Tortora receives a phone call announcing an Ansa news of the following day: "They will arrest Enzo Tortora". Friday, June 17, at a quarter past four, at the Plaza hotel where the presenter is staying, a car arrives from which the carabinieri get out and ask about him: the accusation? Criminal and drug association. A judicial and human ordeal begins that takes Tortora from prison to prison in an attempt to prove his innocence.
notes: The "Tortora case" is one of the shames of our post-war period. Zaccaro - in complicity with the presenter's daughter, Silvia Tortora, and Umberto Contarello - has chosen the path of puzzle narration, as if to underline the chaotic delirium of the incredible misadventure. Placido, although somatically very different from Tortora, reaches a (true) amazing similarity.

title: Judy Berlin
actors: Edie Falco, Aaron Harnick, Madeline Kahn, Julie Kavner
description: It is the second day of school in the town of Babylon, Long Island, New York. The inhabitants, dissatisfied housewives, embittered teachers, aspiring actresses and idle boys, are witnesses of the arrival of autumn. David, returning to his parents' home after failing to make it as a director in Hollywood, meets an old classmate, Judy Berlin, still outgoing and charismatic, and still convinced that she can become a movie star. Dave and Judy while the town is in the dark due to an eclipse of the sun try to relive their memories and all that could have been.
notes: The suspension is the narrative key of the remarkable directorial debut of Woody Allen's assistant costume designer who entrusts the interpretation of an ambiguous suburban existentialism to talented actors, taken from TV.

title: Proof
actors: Hugo Weaving, Geneviève Picot, Russell Crowe, Frankie J. Holden
description: Blind from birth, Martin grew up harboring a grudge against his mother, thinking that she was describing an altered visual reality to him to punish him. Now in his thirties and orphan, the young man has to live with a housekeeper of his own age, Celia, in love with him but unrequited. One day Martin meets Andy, a scullery boy with a passion for the camera who will open a window to the world.
notes: First film by the Australian Jocelyn Moorhouse (producer of "The Wedding of Muriel"), not too ambitious and not vulgar.

title: Bitter Victory
actors: Richard Burton, Curd Jürgens, Raymond Pellegrin
description: During the Second World War two British officers, the cowardly Brand and the valiant Leith, are entrusted with a dangerous mission in Benghazi. During the return, Brand does everything to eliminate the other, of whom he is also jealous. He succeeds, but does not dare pin the medal that is recognized to his chest.
notes: Based on the book by René Hardy (also co-writer), "Vittoria amara" is a wartime melodrama directed with class by the most modern of classic American directors. Beautiful settings, partly created in the Victorine studios in Nice (those of "Effetto notte") Among the enthusiasts of the film is a certain Jean-Luc Godard.

title: Rupan sansei - Towairaito Jemini no Himitsu
description: Lupine III, rushed to Dolune's bedside, receives a large diamond as a gift from his friend, the key to a fabulous fortune. The treasure belonged to the Gelts, an ancient tribe now subjugated by the ferocious Igo, ruled by Gundam. Accompanied by Jigen, Lupine III arrives in Morocco. But Inspector Zenigata and Gundam set a trap for him ...

title: Scar City
actors: Stephen Baldwin, Chazz Palminteri, Tia Carrere, Michael Rispoli
description: John Track is a young and enterprising policeman, who is transferred to a special corps. The agent soon realizes that his new unit is made up of unscrupulous policemen. During a raid on a gangster's home, John's team kills everyone in the house. John finds Candy, one of the callers, and runs away with her. Pulled off and very predictable action movie.

title: A Walk on the Moon
actors: Diane Lane, Viggo Mortensen, Anna Paquin, Liev Schreiber
description: Summer of 1969. The Apollo mission is leaving for Luna, the Vietnam War and the protest of the hippie communities is at its peak. Yet life hasn't changed at all for Pearl, a housewife who is not even touched by these important historical events. Pearl is about to leave for Dr. Fogler's Bungalows, a place where kosher cuisine triumphs and Sinatra is the most listened to singer. She is accompanied by her restless teenage daughter Alison and her meddling grandmother. One day Pearl who left her husband at home meets Walker Jerome, a quiet and charming hippie who makes her dream. The film exudes an old-fashioned air, from a minor film of the 70s, with a sudden idea of ??freedom, of opportunities and aspirations lost on the street, which bursts in to stimulate emotions, uproot characters, alter relationships. Supported by an accurate reconstruction of environmental, physical and psychological details, in the first part he succeeds in drawing a beautiful portrait of the environment, where the dominoes, the quick fruits of the tales between women clash with the bewitching smile of the blouse seller Viggo Mortensen, a late hippie icon who conquers even old ladies with his kindness. But, once the period atmosphere is exhausted, when he has to deal with history, Goldwyn gets lost.

title: Playing to Win: A Moment of Truth Movie
actors: Shelley Fabares, Lisa Dean Ryan, Malcolm Stewart, David Lasher
description: Dana is a cute, nice and dynamic twenty-one year old girl who goes to high school and plays on the school's soccer team. The father has been away from home for a few years. Also for this reason Dana is forced to make a few more sacrifices than her friends to be able to afford college enrollment. In this very particular moment of her life, Dana meets Marshall, a boy from a good family with a gambling addiction. Marshall's passion soon becomes Dana's obsession. Full of debt, the girl is forced to sell everything she owns, steal money from her mother and steal.

title: Free Money
actors: Marlon Brando, Mira Sorvino, Donald Sutherland, Charlie Sheen
description: A very bad director of a prison in the American province prefers to kill and torment inmates rather than start a serious plan for reintegration into society. He does not feel any sense of pity, on the contrary he uses the same systems with the two inexperienced genres who have decided to carry out a train robbery.
notes: Canadian Yves Simoneau struggling with a terrible script and a cast of actors to shake your wrists. What to say? Sloppy sequences, very rare laughter, non-existent gags and a farcical presence of Marlon Brando truly incomprehensible. The cinema certainly does not live here.

title: Avventura nell'arcipelago
actors: Diego Pozzetto, Piero Giagnoni, Paola Avolio
description: Some children, while fishing among the rocks, meet Professor Bellini, a scientist considered a bit crazy who has been studying flight without an engine for years. Children become his first enthusiastic admirers and collaborators. They provide him with silk for his wings, torn by a previous unsuccessful attempt to fly, assist him in the assembly of the futuristic airplane, and when the illustrious inventor is unjustly imprisoned for a theft of watches, it is still the children who discover the real culprit . However, Professor Bellini, inconvenient to the local authorities, is forced to return to his city of residence on the mainland. But while he is on the ferry he sees his plane fly, piloted by one of the children of the archipelago.
notes: Adventure film for kids with a vaguely Disney flavor, even if made with an all too obvious lack of means. However, for the time, an interesting operation. The interpreters are little known, but some children leave their mark.

title: The Addams Halloween
actors: John Astin, Carolyn Jones
description: The extravagant Addams family returns to the TV screens for the Halloween party. Gomez and Morticia get their whole family together and throw the All Saints' Day party. Officially invited witches and evil spirits. Pancho, Gomez's brother, also participates in the party but takes it into his head to blow the beautiful Morticia from him. Bread, horror and jealousy ...
notes: One of the best series on American television. A refined and merciless way to make fun of the US family, setting them as a model for a "clan" of monstrous beings. Uncle Fester is Jackie Coogan, the mythical "brat" of Chaplin.

title: Rupan sansei - Harimao no Zaiho wo oe!!
description: Lupine III is on the trail of Arimao's treasure, hidden by a gang of thieves who have committed thefts across the islands of Southeast Asia. With the help of the inseparable Fujiko (and not Margot!), Jigen and Gemon, Lupine sets out to look for the statues of the bear, eagle and monkey, considered important as access keys to the treasure room. The thief meets an English adventurer, Sir Archer, who with his niece Diana follows the same trail as Lupine.
notes: One of the masterpieces of Japanese animation. The film was released on videotape and in cinemas (in Japan) under the title "The treasure of Arimao".

title: Forgotten Silver
description: Documentary biography of Colin McKenzie, a Scot who emigrated to New Zealand who was a misunderstood pioneer of the Seventh Art. Famous people praise him as an absolute genius but forgotten by all the stories of cinema: inventor of sound as early as 1908 and user of color since 1911, the director was abandoned to his madness and misery.
notes: Attention: superfine documentary reconstruction, convincing testimonies, finds that even seem dusty, portraits without a shadow of a doubt authentic. Maybe. But surprise: Colin McKenzie never existed! Peter Jackson ("Bad Taste", "Splatter") abandons horror for fifty-six minutes but does not give up doing what he wants with the viewer. Turlupinate but happy, because in these parts, however, there is an air of cinema.

title: House of Secrets
actors: Melissa Gilbert, Bruce Boxleitner, Kate Vernon, Cicely Tyson
description: Marion Ravinel hatches a diabolical plan to take out her husband. He teams up with his wife's ex-lover and sets his trap. Then, convinced that everything is spun as she wanted, she enjoys the apparent freedom and the dollars of the inheritance. But something strange happens, the woman begins to be tormented by strange presences, until she is convinced that her husband, from beyond, is meditating for revenge.
notes: Psychological thriller with final twist. Certainly above the average of TV movies also thanks to the contribution of director Mimi Leder, the same as "E.R. - Medici in front line" and "The Peacemaker".

title: Lovers
actors: Elodie Bouchez, Sergei Trifunovic, Geneviève Page, Dragan Nicolic
description: Paris. Dragan, a twenty-five-year-old Yugoslav painter and Jeanne a French girl of the same age meet. But after the first night of love, Jeanne discovers that Dragan has illegally immigrated to France and, more seriously, without a residence permit. Thus a love story that could have lasted a lifetime runs the risk of being abruptly interrupted. In order to stay together Dragan and Jeanne decide to go against the law by living in a condition of semi-clandestine.
notes: Written and directed by Jean-Marc Barr, actor of Besson and von Trier, the film, despite Bouchez and Trifunovic, soon turns into a "Green Card" with no happy ending, far from the stories and strong characters of the other films. that follow the dictates of the Dogma. Too bad, because in history there were ideas and the possibility of telling a story about the desire and the difficulty of being European citizens in the third millennium.

title: Addio mamma!
actors: Miranda Martino, Albert Farley, Margaret Rose Keil, Elio Pandolfi
description: Patrizia civilly married to Franco, a man sentenced to life imprisonment for committing a robbery aggravated by a double murder, has an affair with the unsuspecting Paolo. The birth of a son, Bruno, seems to crown Paolo and Patrizia's dream of love until Franco, escaped from prison, tries to blackmail his wife. Abandoned by her lover and embittered by the death of a singer friend of hers, Patrizia takes refuge in a convent in Abruzzo where she becomes a nun. But, this time, Paolo with the child is lurking ...
notes: Weeping drama that Mario Amendola signs with a pseudonym.

title: The Rising of the Moon
actors: Noel Purcell, Cyril Cusack, Jimmy O'Dea, Edward Lexy
description: Three stories: in the first, a policeman visits a farmer, possibly implicated in terrorism cases. In the second, a train that was supposed to stop for a minute gets stuck for hours. In the third, two young Americans of Irish descent flee Dublin during the 1921 uprising.
notes: The great American director pays homage to his homeland by adapting the stories of Sean O'Casey. The third episode has several autobiographical elements (Ford was in Dublin before filming "Traitor" and someone accused him of sympathizing with the IRA).

title: La vera madre
actors: Carlotta Natoli, Stefania Orsola Garello, Marco Bonini, Giulia Petito, Leonardo Mirabilia
description: Chiara, a woman in Trentino is the mother of two children, Claudio and Giovanna. Over the years, due to the health of the smallest of the two, Claudio, the girl was forced to spend a lot of time in the hospital. Di Giovanna, inevitably left alone, has dealt with her father and Eleonora, a dentist who lives in the same condominium. The woman is very happy to take care of the girl, because, not being able to have children, she manages, in this way to satisfy her desire for motherhood. When Claudio is finally discharged from the hospital and Chiara tries to resume control of her family life, she realizes that Eleonora has now completely replaced.

title: The Hallyday Brand
actors: Joseph Cotten, Viveca Lindfors, Betsy Blair, Ward Bond
description: Daniel, Dan's eldest son, a despotic cattle owner and sheriff, does not get along with his father's authoritarian and despotic methods. In the family environment, the atmosphere becomes even more tense when Dan discovers that Marta, Daniel's sister, has fallen in love with a half-caste who reciprocates his love. The man, opposed to the relationship, does not want a black man to enter his family and does everything to prevent the union between the two.
notes: Small B series masterpiece directed by a top class director. A western almost entirely shot indoors, full of visual metaphors and nuances.

title: La petite vendeuse du soleil
actors: Lissa Baléra, Tairou M'Baye, Oumy Samb
description: From time immemorial the sale of newspapers on the streets of Dakar has been in the hands of very young newsboys, children of the many unemployed in the popular neighborhoods. Sili is a twelve-year-old girl, forced to walk with the help of crutches. She and her friends beg and sell magazines and newspapers to passers-by, but one day they are "ousted" by a group of boys. Pushed, Sili falls to the ground. She feels humiliated, laughed at, but she doesn't give up. And the next day she makes the decision: she alone will sell the newspapers on that street corner.
notes: Mambety, who recently passed away, was considered one of the main authors of the Senegalese new wave of cinema. Of Western training (he also attended Pasolini, and it shows) he managed with "Il franco" and with this film to tell the life of the slums of Dakar with a poetic and neorealistic attitude, naturally taking the point of view of children and marginalized people. .

title: Rupan sansei - Warusa P38
description: Lupine III is framed by the ferocious "gang of assassins", financed and backed by the governments of the most powerful states in the world. Their aim is to blame Lupine III for the murder of an important politician and to lure him to the island where the gang's lair is based. Lupine III is captured: in order to obey the assassins, he is injected with a poison with a delayed effect.
notes: All the characters of the series are lined up in plain sight: Zenigata, Gemon, Giggen and Fujiko, who a reckless Italian dubbing has transformed into Margot.

title: Juha
actors: Sakari Kuosmanen, Kati Outinen, André Wilms, Esko Nikkari
description: After a long courtship, Juha convinces Marja to join a just and sad marriage. Together, they go to live on a farm on the outskirts of the city, fighting poverty every day. One day Shemeikka arrives, a rich and unscrupulous man, who stopped at the farm because he broke down with his car. The man is attracted to Marja, and at the first opportunity he takes her away with him.
notes: It is the fourth transposition of Juhani Aho's novel "The foam of the rapids", the "Manzoni of Helsinki", set in the 18th century: Kaurismäki readjusts it in his own way, infiltrating it with numerous literary and cinematographic citations (from Kafka to Sam Fuller). Silent and strictly black and white, magical without the need for fireworks, ancient without being retro. And played by magnificent actors of the Nordic (dry) school including the faithful Outinen (the never forgotten "match girl"), Kuosmanen, Elina Salo and Wilms. The film is dedicated to Matti Pellonpää (friend and workmate of the director who died prematurely).

title: Cyborg
actors: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Deborah Richter, Vincent Klyn
description: The Earth has just emerged from a nuclear apocalypse and gangs of thugs roam everywhere trying to get hold of everything they need to survive. A fierce cyborg fights against these fearsome gangs who kill, steal and enjoy raging on the weakest people. The guerrilla soon becomes without quarter and will see our hero engaged in a close battle. Who will be able to win?
notes: Albert Pyun is a cult director for the new generations and Van Damme, here in the lead role, brings his entire repertoire as a consummate actor into play. The result is not exactly excellent, but the film still has a certain tension.

title: Three Came Home
actors: Claudette Colbert, Patric Knowles, Florence Desmond, Sessue Hayakawa
description: Just before Peal Harbor, an English official, who lives in Borneo with his family, begs his wife to return to England with her little son to escape the dangers of war. But Agnes, who is American, has no intention of leaving her husband. When the war broke out, the island was occupied by the Japanese who locked men, women and children in concentration camps. One day Agnes has to defend herself from a Japanese soldier, who tries to rape her. Just as the woman is about to report the fact, Colonel Suga, field inspector on behalf of the Japanese army, arrives.
notes: Choral film based on the autobiographical novel by Agnes Newton Keith. Scripted by Nunnaly Johnson.

title: Il gatto dagli occhi di giada
actors: Corrado Pani, Paola Tedesco, Franco Citti, Fernando Cerulli
description: Mara, a young actress from carbaret, while on her way to the pharmacist Biagio, witnesses his murder and glimpses the culprit. The woman is threatened by the stranger and scared to death decides to turn to Lukas, to whom another man who feels persecuted by mysterious individuals turns to him. Meanwhile, a harmless teacher who had no enemies is also killed. Lukas investigating discovers that the two victims had been part of the popular jury that had condemned an innocent. Lukas discovers that the man has escaped from prison and communicates his suspicions to the judge who conducted the trial.
notes: Thriller à la Dario Argento directed with a sure hand by Antonio Bido.

title: Mal
actors: Pauline Cadell, Rui Morrison, Alexandre Pinto, Maria Santos
description: Thousands of stories intertwine at the same time in the city. Like that of Cathy and Pedro who are separated by everything but intense love. Like Daniel, a petty thug and his black friend always looking for some peace under the stars. Like a couple of jewelers who live together out of necessity torn by a cruel hatred. Like the grandfather who arrives in Lisbon in search of his granddaughter who ran away from home. Like a child, a creature abandoned by god who has come to announce the end of the world.
notes: The director's open intention is to build a mosaic narrative where the destinies of different existences unravel and at the same time intersect. The result is an apocalyptic vision, which finds its crowning point in the desperate ending. Beautiful and hopeless.

title: A Terrible Beauty - Night Fighters
actors: Robert Mitchum, Anne Heywood, Dan O'Herlihy, Cyril Cusack, Richard Harris
description: In 1940, while England was engaged in the world conflict with Germany, the Irish Republicans vigorously resume the struggle for the annexation of Northern Ireland. In the small town of Duncrana, the patriots are led by McGinnis who tries to get the cooperation of a local boy. Dermott, however, has no desire to make war on the English also because the young man would like to marry Neeve and move with her to England. But Dermott is forced to participate, despite himself, in an attack on an ammunition depot.
notes: Tay Garnett's latest major film, it is a quite gripping and nuanced political drama with a good proof by Mitchum.

title: Frankenstein Created Woman
actors: Peter Cushing, Susan Denberg, Robert Morris, Barry Warren
description: Young Hans, doctor Frankenstein's attendant, loves Cristina, the limp and disfigured daughter of the host Klove. When three drunken youngsters insult her for her sad condition, Hans intervenes in her defense. Having entered the tavern at night to drink, the three are surprised by Klove who is killed. To take revenge on Hans, they blame him and in so doing condemn him to death. The boy, in fact, is guillotined and Cristina, devastated by grief, kills herself by drowning. Doctor Frankenstein, having recovered the remains of both, transplants Hans's soul into Christina's body.
notes: Fisher finds new ideas and new stimuli to revive the genre. "Destroy Frankenstein!" of 1969 is the sequel.

title: Felicia's Journey
actors: Bob Hoskins, Elaine Cassidy, Arsinée Khanjian, Peter McDonald
description: In a large house in Birmingham, Joseph, a burly bachelor, is following a videotape of an old cooking show. Step by step Joseph follows the recipe and then sits down to eat. A girl arrives on the ferry from Ireland who travels carrying only her backpack. Felicia is looking for Johnny, the boy she is in love with, who emigrated to England to work as a worker, so she thinks. At the end of his working day, as he exits the parking lot, Joseph spots the girl and gives her some indication of where she can find her boyfriend.
notes: Hitchcock's quotations are disseminated by Egoyan in a film of subtle and tormented ambiguity, constructed with painstaking pain. "Felicia's Journey" is not a mangled scream like "Sweet Tomorrow", but a constant and stifled sob, a journey into repressed unhappiness, into the past that never dies.

title: Grey Owl
actors: Pierce Brosnan, Annie Galipeau, Graham Greene, Nathaniel Arcand
description: Archie, an English trapper born in Hastings and transplanted to Canada, is a man of the woods who lives by hunting fur animals and selling beaver skins. One day he has a shock: the animals are the children of Manitou, why kill them? The man converts to the environmental cause, is mistaken for an Indian, since he calls himself Gray Owl, and begins to preach respect for nature in front of Western tourists.
notes: Richard Attenborough's film is really a film for tourists, a brochure full of beautiful new age expressions and radical chic environmentalism. Cinema not even talking about it: even the incredible scenarios of Canada are mortified by a pompous but never vibrant direction.

title: La bomba
actors: Alessandro Gassmann, Rocco Papaleo, Chiara Muti, Vittorio Gassman, Shelley Winters
description: Nino and Sergio have always dreamed of becoming actors. Together they decide to go to New York for an audition at the Actor's Studio. Here they meet Gaetano, also an aspiring actor, who works in a restaurant as a waiter. Nino and Gaetano pass the audition while Sergio, rejected, takes the place of Gaetano at the restaurant in order to keep his friends at the Actor's Studio. At the Sergio restaurant he has to deal with the Chinese owner every day. So one evening, Nino and Gaetano decide to make a joke: they call the restaurant pretending to be mafia.
notes: If the parody is unattainable, the farce is at hand. The amused and exaggerated Gassman and Winters affectionately bless.

title: Notting Hill
actors: Julia Roberts, Hugh Grant, Hugh Bonneville, Emma Chambers, Rhys Ifans, Gina McKee, Mischa Barton, James Dreyfus, Richard McCabe, Dylan Moran, Tim McInnerny
description: William lives in the multi-ethnic London borough of Notting Hill, is divorced and spends his time running a travel book shop on Portobello Road. One day Anna, the most famous movie star in the world, enters the bookstore, exchanges a few words with him, buys a book and leaves. William finds Anna around the corner and thanks to an accident, he manages to invite her to his house. Thus begins a love story.
notes: Written by Richard Curtis (as "Four Weddings and a Funeral"), at least at the American and British box office, it hit the spot again. But the mixture of British cynicism and Hollywood glamor that characterized Newell's film does not do so well. In the second part, the comedy is diluted, forgets all evil, turns on itself, in search of an unlikely happy ending.

title: The Acid House
actors: Ewen Bremner, Kevin McKidd, Martin Clunes, Jemma Redgrave
description: Three episodes set in the seediest neighborhoods of a British city In "The Granton Star Cause", Boab believes he has it all, a right girlfriend, a job, a comfortable life with his parents and a place on the local football team. But one day, thanks to a hangover, everything collapses ruinously on his shoulders and God turns him into a fly. In "A Soft Touch", Johnny and Catriona, a couple living in the working-class neighborhoods, face the meddling in their life from Larry, the upstairs tenant. In "The Acid House," Coco addicted to acid and raves in a stormy night regresses to prenatal condition and her adult mind ends up in the body of the baby of two neighbors.
notes: The film is a real disappointment. The only inventions that director Paul McGuigan allows himself are some accelerations of the skies. Although enlivened by the musical column, the dialogues struggle and the features of the characters never leave the commonplace. Not even that of Ewen Bremner, protagonist of the last episode, who is also one of the most promising faces of young British cinema.

title: The Last Days
actors: Bill Bash, Martin Bash, Randolph Braham, Alice Lok Cahana
description: Produced by the Shoah Visual History Foundation with Steven Spielberg as executive producer, the documentary (Oscar in 1999) uses the testimony of five Jewish Holocaust survivors of Hungarian origin. We start with the disbelief of their community towards the stories of refugees from Poland, who first described the Nazi atrocities. Then the invasion of Hungary in 1944 and the survivors tell of their pain at the moment of deportation, due to the hatred of the "Aryan" compatriots who until the day before were courteous neighbors and friends. But the most touching moments are those that describe life in the concentration camps and the scientific nature of the "final solution".
notes: Each of the survivors leaves us a moment of great emotion but also of despair. "The last days" is first of all a strong warning not to forget.

title: A vent'anni è sempre festa
actors: Nunzio Gallo, Luisa Rivelli, Memmo Carotenuto, Adriana Benetti
description: At the end of the school year, the pupils of an agricultural school decide to set up a variety show. Mr. Anastasi, secretary of the school, offers his collaboration, among other things, with a beautiful voice. The entertainer of the show is the young Lauro who also proposes himself as an impresario and offers his work colleagues the opportunity to take a tour.
notes: Vittorio Duse directs a low-level film despite a good cast, in which Memmo Carotenuto, Mario's brother, and Adriana Benetti, co-star of "Four steps in the clouds" stand out. Harmless fun.

title: Un homme est mort
actors: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Ann-Margret, Roy Scheider, Angie Dickinson
description: Lucien, known to everyone by the false name of Roger, arrives from Paris to Los Angeles to kill the old and very rich underworld boss Victor Kovacs. Man does not find it difficult to carry out his mission. The perpetrators of the crime are Victor's son Alex and stepmother Jacky. Despite the success of the operation, Lucien is robbed of his documents and persecuted by a killer, so he decides to stay in Los Angeles to shed light on the mysterious episodes he was a victim of.
notes: Deray knows his stuff, he fully demonstrates it in this "polar" made away from home.

title: Janice Beard: 45 Word Per Minute
actors: Eileen Walsh, Rhys Ifans, Patsy Kensit, Sandra Voe, David O'Hara
description: When Janice is born, in a house like a thousand others in a London neighborhood, her father dies. Her mother is shocked by a double post-partum and post-mortem depression, which leads her to acute agoraphobia and forces her to shut herself up at home in front of the television. Janice grows up awkward, naive, badly dressed. But he decides to challenge the metropolis, to go to work in a large office, facing a thousand daily disasters.
notes: The film has the postmodern, glittering colors and the insinuating nastiness of the companies in which the protagonist moves, less and less awkwardly. Debut in the "long" by director Clare Kilner, the film refers to certain vitriolic portraits of recent English cinema. The production is tiny, but the Kilner has an interesting visual impact. Some slowness in the central part.

title: Phörpa
actors: Orgyen Tobgyal, Neten Chokling, Jamyang Lodro, Lama Chonjor
description: In a monastery in northern India, life is marked by the rituals of prayer and the constant arrivals from Tibet of young people who try to escape Chinese rule. Here the fever of the 1998 world championship seduces the young people who, every night, sneak away to watch the matches in a village bar. The boys are discovered, but the leaders of the monastery, indulgent, welcome the idea of ??the more enterprising young man to rent a satellite dish to see all together the final between France and Brazil.
notes: If we forget the gleaming football in our home, we discover that the ball also has thaumaturgical qualities. As this film would like to demonstrate, the curious and naive first work of the director-monk Khyentse Norbu, who in football sees a shred of normality for a persecuted community.

title: La fille sur le pont
actors: Vanessa Paradis, Daniel Auteuil, Luc Palun, Demetre Georgalas
description: At night on a bridge overlooking the Seine a girl, Adèle, is about to throw herself, but Gabor, a knife thrower, who is passing by by chance, convinces her to give up. The man proposes to the girl to make a steady couple with him and the union of these two desperate destinies will unpredictably become a winning choice. The two tour the circuses in the area with their number and seem to have a good success. But luck will be with them only as long as they are together.
notes: Shot in panoramic format and in black and white, the film slips away between high moments and ruinous falls, like almost all the works of the director of "The hairdresser's husband" (his only completed work). Fortunately, there is Auteuil, "the Mastroianni of French cinema". Fellinism does not (never) make Fellini.

title: Amore a prima vista
actors: Vincenzo Salemme, Mandala Tayde, Carlo Buccirosso, Maurizio Casagrande
description: Bruno, a Neapolitan criminal son of Natale Garramone, known by everyone in the Camorra as Nat, is engaged to Roberta, the beautiful daughter of the Sicilian boss Don Antonio. Everything goes smoothly until the day when Bruno, who literally goes crazy for women, has to undergo a cornea transplant. The donor is Nina, wife of Fortunato Cipolletta, major of the carabinieri, who died in a car accident. The operation succeeds perfectly, except that Bruno finds himself in love with Fortunato; Could it be the fault of the transplant?
notes: After the happy outcome of "The friend of the heart", the artist from Campania - identified the formula: comedians of race and school, precisely, "Neapolitan"; pochade situations; calibrated and "returning" beats - try to march and broaden your breath. The result falls short of expectations, with lapses into the gratuitous vernacular and a stylistic unity that does not always manage to "film" the "theater". But it is purely actor's comedy, which basically wants to (entertain). Music by Pino Daniele, quotes from "Some like it hot", "Never say never" and "Thelma & Louise".

title: Sicilia!
actors: Gianni Buscarino, Angela Nugara, Vittorio Vigneri, Giovanni Interlandi
description: After fifteen years of absence, Silvestro returns to Sicily to seek a purer reality than the one in which he lives. During this journey Silvestro meets several people: "The Great Lombard", a man in search of new tasks that can be conceived as new values, Ezechiele and Calogero the grinder who repeat that they suffer not for themselves but for the pain of offended world.
notes: Loosely based on "Conversazioni in Sicilia" by Elio Vittorini, the film is a fascinating and intense portrait made by two rigorous filmmakers. Monologues and dialogues follow each other in four episodes, weaving a rhythm that is that of the Greek theater. It is an anomalous cinema where the actors are taken from the street, which clashes loudly with the commercial cinema that surrounds it and which finds its center of gravity in the power of an almost sacred image and in Vittorini's poetry.

title: Equus
actors: Richard Burton, Peter Firth, Colin Blakely, Joan Plowright, Harry Andrews
description: Alan, who works in a stable on weekends, blinds the seven horses he idolized for no apparent reason. Hospitalized in a clinic, he soon ends up being treated by a psychoanalyst, Dr. Martin Dysart. To trace the boy's mental illness, the doctor summons his parents, the owner of the stable and Alan himself. After numerous reticence, the patient explains the reasons for the insane gesture, perhaps due to a disappointment in love ...
notes: Lumet brings to the screen a text written for the theater by Peter Shaffer (that of Amadeus). The result is not very convincing, despite the skill of the interpreters.

title: Agguato sul Bosforo
actors: John Braun, Alfredo Rizzo, David Allen, Eleonora Vargas
description: A well-known geologist, Professor Hutton, has found a diamond of unusual proportions, so much so that the thirty-six fragments derived from the processing of the main stone, used for a ring, alone constitute a collection of inestimable value. The dark disappearance of the professor unleashes a battle between the international underworld to recover the ring, take possession of the diamond fragments and find the microfilm on which the geologist has fixed the elements for the identification of the exceptional deposit from which the stone comes. Three private investigators are tasked with unraveling the mystery of Hutton's disappearance.
notes: Very mediocre adventure film signed by Luigi Batzella under a pseudonym. The author only remembers the earlier "Three francs of piety" (1967), equally modest.

title: Doctor Dolittle
actors: Rex Harrison, Anthony Newley, Samantha Eggar, Richard Attenborough
description: Doctor Dolittle, tired of treating men, devotes himself to animals, whose language he knows thoroughly because he is properly instructed by the Polynesian parrot. One day his friend Pennalunga sends the doctor from Tibet a fabulous two-headed animal that Dolittle intends to show in a circus. With the money earned, the doctor wants to arm a ship and set out in search of the mythical Gastropodone. For helping the seal Sofia to reach her husband, Dolittle ends up in court where he is mistaken for insane.
notes: A fairy tale with singing interludes, ruined, as usual, by dubbing. Oscar for best song and visual effects.

title: Pressure Point
actors: Sidney Poitier, Bobby Darin, Peter Falk, Carl Benton Reid, Mary Munday
description: In 1942 an American soldier of German origin was arrested for sedition and sent to a military prison. The black psychiatrist, charged with remedying his antisocial tendencies that lead him to seek the fight, discovers that the man is, in fact, a psychopath. The military is convinced that to get to power it is necessary to use black and Jewish scapegoats. When the military authorities dismiss him, not respecting the psychiatrist's instructions, the latter resigns.
notes: Taken from a clinical case reported by Dr. Robert M. Linder. Good interpretation by Sidney Poitier. One of the best "social" films played by Poitier in the period.

title: Watchers
actors: Corey Haim, Barbara Williams, Lala, Duncan Fraser, Michael Ironside
description: After the explosion of a biogenetic research laboratory, an explosion occurred in mysterious circumstances, Oxon, a cyborg created to be the perfect killer, sets out in search of a dog, the only other survivor of the attack. What secret does the animal hide?
notes: Serial B movie with special effects from the show and very few twists. The writers of the screenplay sometimes hope to recall Cronenbergian arguments (flesh and metal) but they navigate superficially on sight. The film, however, testifies to Canada's renewed interest in fantasy production. With an unprecedented following in Italy.

title: Il terrorista
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, Philippe Leroy, Giulio Bosetti
description: In Venice in 1943, Renato Braschi, an exponent of the Action Party at the head of the partisans, chooses to continue his sabotage actions against the fascists despite the invitations of his superiors to be cautious and to suspend the attacks. But even among the most trusted companions, traitors can hide.
notes: Interesting attempt to analyze the various souls of the Resistance, the more diplomatic and the radical. De Bosio's film sins of didacticism, however the rigor of the staging and the absolute strangeness of political cinema make it a unique case in the cinema of those years. Produced by the critic Tullio Kezich, co-written by Luigi Squarzina.

title: Charly
actors: Cliff Robertson, Claire Bloom, Lilia Skala, Leon Janney, Ruth White
description: Charlie is mentally disabled: in all the intelligence tests he is passed by the little mouse Algernon. But one day a scientist believes he can intervene on the young man's brain to get out of his condition. The experiment succeeds, Charlie becomes a luminary himself but Algernon mysteriously begins to perish.
notes: A film between the grotesque and the chilling, bitter parable about the human condition and the "dominating" intellect, based on a little science fiction jewel, the short story "Flowers for Algernon" by Daniel Keyes. At the time it caused a lot of discussion (year of grace 1968) but today it appears quite dated. Cliff Robertson won the Oscar as a leading actor. Beautiful but somewhat incongruous music by Ravi Shankar.

title: In the Gloaming
actors: Glenn Close, Bridget Fonda, Whoopi Goldberg, Robert Sean Leonard
description: Danny, a homosexual with AIDS returns to his family to die. Janet and Martin, her parents and her sister Anne prove unable to face Danny's drama serenely. The boy, aware of the short time left, tries in every way to reach a deeper relationship with his mother. Slowly, the past resurfaces and the feelings of guilt are dissolved in the tender embrace between mother and child. TV drama directed by the ex-Superman, with a great cast. And nothing more.

title: Le Gang
actors: Alain Delon, Raymond Bussières, Laura Betti, Xavier Depraz
description: After the Second World War, the son of a famous gangster from the 1930s decides to follow in his father's footsteps. Recruit some trusted accomplice and set up a gang specializing in robberies. "The gang" has a characteristic: it steals but with kindness, without unnecessary bloodshed, following the code of honor of the underworld of the past. In any case, the police are hardly moved ...
notes: Polar specialist Deray builds a tailor-made film for Delon, who rages as the gentleman gangster. Fun enough, without too many pretensions.

title: Final Voyage
actors: Ice T, Dylan Walsh, Erika Eleniak, Claudia Christian, Rick Ducommun
description: A newly restored British cruise ship embarks on a cruise on the Atlantic. Once in the open sea, a gang of criminals takes possession of the ship, subduing the captain and crew. Only Aaron, Gloria's bodyguard, a movie starlet, manages to escape the control of the criminals. Cut off from the other passengers taken hostage, and with no possibility of communicating with the mainland, the man is forced to act alone to avoid the disaster. The bandits want to sink the ship after sacking it.
notes: Silly action thriller.

title: Tony Arzenta
actors: Alain Delon, Richard Conte, Carla Gravina, Anton Diffring, Marc Porel
description: Tony Arzenta is the best hitman in the mafia. But after the last contract he would like to leave the "profession" once and for all. Except that the bosses, trying to dissuade him violently, kill his wife and son, unleashing his relentless revenge.
notes: A memorable beginning, a tight central part, a disappointing ending. Here is a summary of this _Tony Arzenta_, Tessari's foray into the Italian detective story. Filmed between night-time Milan, France and Denmark, a gangster movie with an excellent cast, which unfortunately does not know how to make a sometimes obvious plot original. The action sequences, however, are very respectable.

title: Bogus
actors: Haley Joel Osment, Whoopi Goldberg, Gérard Depardieu
description: Albert is a seven year old boy. He didn't have an easy childhood but he managed to save himself from trouble thanks to his vivid imagination. The fantastic world that has created around him, for example, made him bravely face the loss of his mother, who died in a car accident. Albert is placed in the care of an aunt, Harriet, a deranged and shrewish woman from New Jersey played with the usual verve by Whoopi Goldberg. Albert is unable to become friends with the woman, and calls to the rescue a fictional character, Bogus, who will help him overcome the most difficult moments. When Harriet notices the phantom "intruder", she will try to get help in turn to solve some small ... problem.
notes: Canadian Norman Jewison, director, among other things, of "Bewitched by the Moon", tackles this curious subject with a light touch, but fails to get the comedy off the ground, too heavy with sugary atmospheres. However, the decidedly anomalous Goldberg-Depardieu tandem works perfectly. A pleasant little film that plays above all on the presence of the little Haley Joel Hosment, then star of "The Sixth Sense".

title: Nihon no Yoru to Kiri
actors: Fumio Watanabe, Miyuki Kuwano, Toru Ajioka
description: Autumn 1960: the journalist Nozawa, former exponent of Zengakuren (the student movement affiliated with the Japanese Communist Party), marries Reiko, a militant of the same movement now on more radical positions. But the union between the two, instead of facilitating a reconciliation between generations divided by events, brings out rancor and old ghosts linked to the history of the party.
notes: Oshima devotes himself to the political apologue, and the film, although dated, retains an energy that would be sought in vain in today's beginners.

title: Les Caprices d'un Fleuve
actors: Anna Galiena, Bernard Giraudeau, Richard Bohringer
description: An eighteenth-century French aristocrat, Jean Francois de la Plaine, decides to take a trip to the West African desert. After an agreement with a tribal chief, he receives "as a gift" a young ten-year-old slave whom he begins to raise as a daughter. But after a few years the girl, Amelie, stops being just a child but is captured by a hostile tribe of natives who would like to force her into slavery again.
notes: Ambitious work of the French Giraudeau, former author of "L'autre - L'altra", who chooses to link the choral nature of the story with the opulence of African scenarios. A respectable cast in which Galiena stands out. Some weakness of direction and an excess of presumption often wreck the story.

title: Revenge of the Nerds
actors: Robert Carradine, Anthony Edwards, Timothy Busfield, Andrew Cassese, Julia Montgomery, Brian Tochi, John Goodman, Larry B. Scott
description: A group of particularly crazy freshmen break into an Arizona college just in time to be bullied by fellow hunks from the Alpha Beta group. After the typical harassment reserved all over the world for freshmen, the nerds move on to the counterattack: cunning and intelligence instead of brute strength and physical prowess. They will eventually get the better of them, even with the girls.
notes: "Nerds": only possible translation "losers". They can be seen in many films, but none will ever rival those of Landis' "Animal House". This is a silly comedy by Kanew, but it has met with great success in the US.

title: Ossos
actors: Vanda Duarte, Nuno Vaz, Maria Lipkina
description: Estrela, slum creaola on the outskirts of Lisbon. A child born only a few days is about to escape many deaths. Tina, the young mother, takes him in her arms and opens the gas. Saved by his father, the little boy will sleep on the streets of the city and feed on begged milk. Twice he will risk being sold, out of desperation, out of love, for nothing ...
notes: Life and death filtered through the realistic eye of the new Portuguese cinema, one of the least homologated in the world. Pedro Costa films with Bressonian rigor a stabbing, beautiful story, with a "stripped-down" structure as the title suggests, "bones".

title: Evil Dead 2
actors: Bruce Campbell, Sarah Berry, Dan Hicks, Kassie DePaiva
description: A group of boys decide to spend the weekend in a remote cottage in the forest. Within the walls of the house they find the ancient book of the dead: by reciting a magic formula they awaken an ancient demon who, of course, is not very happy. Carnage ensues, at the speed of light.
notes: A sequel produced by Dino De Laurentiis of "La casa", the film with which Sam Raimi made his debut. The handcrafted aspect of the model is replaced by special effects, always at the service of the author's unbridled imagination. More than a horror, a splatter cartoon that constantly mentions the masters of animation: from Tex Avery to Chuck Jones.

title: Fled
actors: Laurence Fishburne, Stephen Baldwin, Salma Hayek
description: Two prisoners who have never loved each other madly manage to escape and go into hiding in the countryside of Georgia. One is white and one is black, one is a hacker, the other a pusher. They would like to take different paths but they cannot, because a chain binds them together. On their trail half a body of state police and also the Cuban mafia. It will not be a pleasure trip.
notes: Remake of "Mud Wall", Stanley Kramer's beautiful film all about creeping racism. In this case, we do not go beyond a modest packaging, which winks at the younger audience, winking at a thousand other films of the genre.

title: The Sixth Sense
actors: Haley Joel Osment, Bruce Willis, Mischa Barton, Toni Collette, Olivia Williams
description: Nine-year-old Cole Sear has a life of sudden shocks, pains and horrors. In fact, he possesses a sort of "glitter" that makes him see the hanged men executed two hundred years earlier in what has become his school and makes him see a woman with half of her face torn. The dead ask him for justice, truth, they ask him to be freed from a limbo of earthly unhappiness. And the psychologist, still traumatized by the assault suffered a year earlier by an ancient patient of his who was unable to help, begins to believe him.
notes: It is a curious, disturbing and insinuating horror this written and directed by M. Night Shyamalan, a young author of Indian origin who studied in New York and who has very clear ideas on the construction and "holding" of suspense. More than horror, it is pain and loneliness that flow in Shyamalan's film. A shiver of cold runs throughout the film.

title: Adieu, plancher des vaches
actors: Nico Tarielashvili, Lily Lavina, Philippe Bas, Stéphane Hainque
description: Nicolas, the eldest son in his twenties of a rich family ruled by a terrible business woman, instead of cultivating his privileged future, spends his days in Paris, working hard in the humblest professions. Meanwhile, in the parents' villa, interclass riots undermine the certainties of the monster mother, the drunkard father, of the guests at the icy party parties. One night, however, Nicolas follows a gang on a riskier adventure than usual and ends up in prison with his friend Pierre.
notes: "Farewell to the mainland" (in original "Adieu, plancher des vaches" which is the slang salute of the sailors when they set out to sea) could be considered a continuation of Buñuel's "Indiscreet charm of the bourgeoisie". The film is accompanied by clear and very lucid images, by a fragmented rhythm, by a laconic style that gives an almost silent work. In addition to directing it, Iosseliani edits him and plays him (he is the alcoholic father who loves to play with electric trains): authorial without being pedantic.

title: Never Been Kissed
actors: Drew Barrymore, David Arquette, Leelee Sobieski, Jeremy Jordan
description: What do the eternal students think, want and do? An unanswered question, however, worthy of an investigation by the "Chicago Sun Times" which asks the clumsier and more insecure editor, Josie, to dress up as a high school student and go back to class. The horrors and humiliations of the journalist's school past return indelible nightmares, as she observes, camouflages herself, films with a hidden camera the life and language of a generation with a lively appearance, but crystallized in the corridor, party, sports field rituals .
notes: School, in contemporary American cinema, never closes. End of year dances, idols and outcasts, nerds and fools, "first time" anxieties, quotes and lessons from Shakespeare: for teen viewers it's always recreation. Between "Porky's" and "Animal House", the aesthetic of "Happy Days" triumphs. No less is this film directed by the director of "Mom I caught measles".

title: Hak hap
actors: Lau Ching Wan, Jet Li, Françoise Yip, Karen Mok, Anthony Wong Chau-Sang
description: In the role of a shy librarian, a superhero who is insensitive to pain and also (in part) to feelings after a brain operation is hiding. He fights evil in the company of a "dark and hard" cop. The man will discover that his colleagues are not as good as they would like to make it seem, and that the beautiful Yeuklan is also involved in drug trafficking.
notes: A concentrate of action, choreographed with ineffable elegance by Yuen Wo Ping (the same as "Matrix"). Jet Li is an authentic war machine with an uncommon dramatic talent. Plot reduced to the bone but interesting dramaturgical implications. The virile friendship between the two protagonists, a theme dear to Tsui Hark, lends itself to the most extreme irony (the Black Mask is believed to be gay ...). Jet Li and Françoise C. J. Yip fight each other with the grace and intensity of two lovers.

title: Besame mucho
actors: Toni Bertorelli, Antonio Catania, Giuseppe Cederna, Giuliana De Sio
description: Naples. Don Tommaso is a generous widower who has decided to adopt a young non-EU citizen before he obtains a residence permit. Lucia is worried and anxious about her unemployed brother who is about to get into trouble. Giulia is an actress who would like to stage Oscar Wilde's "An Ideal Husband" with a group of prisoners. A surgeon defies the rules of the hospital where he works to save the life of a drug addict. An emigrant struggles to find the woman who had made him shudder in his youth.
notes: Maurizio Ponzi and his collaborators have chosen and rewritten some stories encountered in two books, "Besame mucho" and "Bella ciao", by the journalist Enrico Deaglio. Today's reality lends itself to a choral staging (good actors) and the various characters with their experiences touch each other, linked by a light and resistant thread. Italian cinema usually flounders when it has to frame the present, but in this context perhaps a little less than elsewhere.

title: Branchie
actors: Gianluca Grignani, Valentina Cervi, Paola Quattrini, Nandana Sen
description: Marco is used to traveling with his mind, but he never really left. He had to go to India to build the largest aquarium in Delhi, but the cough that rips through his lungs immobilizes him. Only his mother knows that he is ill because Marco has not told anyone, not even Maria, his girlfriend and not even his colleagues at the aquarium where he works. Yet many of them will follow him in his dream on his fantastic journey to India. And here between a gang of bonzes chasing him and a group of musicians in search of pure sound, Marco will meet Livia ...
notes: Based on the novel by Niccolò Ammaniti, directed by Francesco Ranieri Martinotti, who wrote it with Fulvio Ottaviano, the film is short of a family joke, leavened for some reason at a budget that allows 15 weeks of shooting between Italy and India. Confused, paroxysmal, unrealistic, often suspended on a ridicule that one cannot understand if it is voluntary or involuntary.

title: World Without End
actors: Hugh Marlowe, Rod Taylor, Nancy Gates
description: A spaceship leaves the Earth heading for Mars but at a certain point finds itself with the engine in failure. Adrift in Space, it breaks through the barrier of time and ends up on the Earth of the future, in 2058. The astronauts must defend themselves from the inhabitants, whom terrible radiations have transformed into monsters. In fact, the Earth looks like a near-coming Middle Ages, upset by the atomic war.
notes: Serie B science fiction without particular attractions but ahead of its time as regards the underlying theme. Despite some ingenuity, a pioneering film after all.

title: L'homme pressé
actors: Alain Delon, Mireille Darc, Monica Guerritore, Marie Déa, Christian Barbier, Michel Duchaussoy
description: A possession-obsessed Parisian antiquarian is about to finally become a father but neglects his pregnant wife in pursuit of a rare piece of an art collection. Morbidly driven by having the object of desire at all costs, he challenges fate and tragically loses his game.
notes: The director of "Il vizietto" tells a rambling allegory of possession and greed that is resolved in a series of metaphors (possible redemption through paternity) that are decidedly false. One of the less convincing proofs of Delon and (then) consort Mireille Darc. Positive debut for Monica Guerritore.

title: Communion
actors: Christopher Walken, Lindsay Crouse, Holly Fields
description: Whitley Strieber goes with her family and some friends on vacation to her forest home. One night the various members of the party realize that something strange is happening above them, and an idea begins to flash in their minds in Whitley and his companions: if they were in the presence of "close proximity of the third kind" phenomena? Curiosity killed the cat, and Whitley finds herself in up to neck trouble with the aliens.
notes: A start to the "X-Files" for this very well done Tv movie. Great Walken and also decent "low budget" special effects. Don't expect "Star Wars" spaceships, however ...

title: Dead Men Don't Wear Plaid
actors: Steve Martin, Rachel Ward, Carl Reiner, Reni Santoni, George Gaynes
description: Detective Rigby is commissioned by Julie to shed light on the accidental death of her father, a well-known cheese taster.
notes: A film that is almost a bet: thanks to the editing, the protagonists act alongside actors from the past (Humphrey Bogart, Bette Davis, James Cagney, etc.) who are ironically re-dubbed. The black and white, the music, the sets make the curious experiment flawless. For cinephiles.

title: A Cab to Canada
actors: Maureen O'Hara, Efrem Zimbalist jr., Dennis Howard, Jason Beghe
description: Katherine Eure is a wealthy, refined-tasted seventy-year-old lady who, after losing her one and great love during the Korean War, never wanted to get married again. Returning from a friend's funeral, Katherine takes a taxi home and asks Mike, the taxi driver, to take her to the beach. Then, on impulse, he involves Mike on a journey that, between funny situations and some misadventures, will take them to Canada. The two who have a different character, at the beginning do nothing but quarrel divided as they are by the difference in age, but at the end of the journey they will make friends.

title: Zeus and Roxanne
actors: Steve Guttenberg, Kathleen Quinlan, Arnold Vosloo
description: Roxanne is a female dolphin, Zeus a dog. He belongs to a single musician, she belongs to a marine biologist who is waiting for a soul mate. Between the two animals there is immediately friendship and complicity. Their beautiful relationship naturally also favors the meeting between the masters. And they all lived happily ever after.
notes: Modern fable directed, and here is the curiosity, by the author of the truculent saga of Mad Max. The icing on the cake is the presence of Arnold Vosloo, who in the latest version of "The Mummy" terrifies the protagonists among bandages and cockroaches. Moderately fun.

title: Il peccato degli anni verdi
actors: Alida Valli, Marie Versini, Corrado Pani, Maurice Ronet, Raffaella Pelloni
description: A rich playboy seduces a high school girl on vacation and cynically abandons her. Except that she is pregnant, and decides to ask the unrepentant seducer a sum as "compensation" for physical and moral damages. He is startled, then thinks about it again, maybe he really falls in love, maybe it's too late ...
notes: A curious melody directed by an important actor of our cinema. Unripe in form, tiring in the development of some narrative knots, but unconventional in the figure of the protagonist. Detail for Raffaella Pelloni not yet Carrà.

title: Invisible Child
actors: Rita Wilson, Victor Garber, Mae Whitman, Tushka Bergen, David Dorfman
description: A woman, happily married and mother of two children, believes she has a third "missing" daughter, of whom only she has heard. Her husband and eldest daughter support her in an attempt to save her psychic balance and the stability of the family. The life of the four goes on in a relatively normal way until the day a new babysitter arrives. The girl, realizing the situation and fearing that the climate of fiction could harm the growth of the girl and her younger brother, decides to notify the social services. The couple will thus be accused of mistreatment ...

title: Miracle Mile
actors: Anthony Edwards, Mare Winningham, John Agar, Brian Thompson
description: A musician meets a beautiful waitress and decides to spend time with her. The woman works in one of those places where it is possible to call the girls of the staff or the other patrons through the "table" phones. Trying to call his partner, the protagonist intercepts a phone call: a soldier, with a voice broken by emotion, warns someone else that a nuclear warhead is about to explode and that there are only 70 minutes to go until the end of the world.
notes: Oscar of the series "okay you tried" to the inventor of this story, who trying to be original at all costs gets lost in the difficult streets of the incredible.

title: Cristallo di rocca
actors: Virna Lisi, Tobias Moretti, Omero Antonutti, Leo Gullotta
description: It is Christmas Eve and three climbers, while hiking on a glacier, discover the perfectly preserved body of a man. The mountain rescue helicopter takes the body back to Gschaid, a small mountain village now almost uninhabited, for identification. An elderly woman Sanna and her brother Corrado recognize it: it is Martin, who passed away on Christmas sixty years earlier. Back in the village, Sanna tells her grandchildren the mysterious story of the man found in the ice. And grandmother Sanna begins to tell them the story of her parents, the cobbler Joseph and her mother Gerda.
notes: Freely based on the novel of the same name by Adalbert Stifter.

title: Meglio tardi che mai
actors: Nancy Brilli, Nino Manfredi, Bruno Wolkowitch, Ilaria Occhini
description: Chiara is a beautiful young woman belonging to a rich Roman family. Both the father, Antonio, and her husband Lorenzo, work in the family business, a construction company managed, with an overly managerial and authoritarian attitude, by his mother Emma. One day in Chiara's life, who flows lazily between so many comforts and a thousand conventions, a sudden change takes place: her father fled to Cuba taking with him, by way of liquidation, three hundred million. To help the woman in the research is Jean Martini, a nice Frenchman who has lived in Cuba for years, together with Pepé, a Cuban child whom the man has adopted.

title: Come, quando, perché
actors: Philippe Leroy, Horst Buchholz, Danielle Gaubert, Elsa Albani
description: During a reception in his home in Turin, Paola, wife of Marco, a young and rich industrialist, meets Alberto, a friend of her husband, who emigrated to Argentina. He spends a few days and Alberto declares his love to Paola, but she, offended him rejects him and to escape him he anticipates his holidays in Sardinia. But Alberto does not give up and reaches her on the island convinced that the woman will end up selling sooner or later. And so; It happens, also because Paola, in the meantime, has learned of Marco's continuous betrayals.
notes: Last film by Pietrangeli, who died during the filming. His work was completed by Valerio Zurlini. It is not among the director's milgiaries.

title: Solamente nero
actors: Lino Capolicchio, Stefania Casini, Craig Hill, Massimo Serato, Juliette Mayniel, Laura Nucci, Attilio Duse, Gianfranco Bullo
description: A newly appointed professor visits his brother priest, hoping to spend a period of rest in his rectory. But the priest is particularly restless: for some time he has been receiving strange threatening letters, the content of which is closely linked with a series of inexplicable crimes. The professor is involved in the mystery in spite of himself ...
notes: Antonio Bido recovers the atmospheres, the themes and the protagonist Capolicchio of Avati's rural thriller _The house with laughing windows_ by varying the setting. From sunny and peripheral Emilia Romagna we move into a twilight Venice. The yellow plot works, but the scares are slow to hit.

title: The Wrong Girl
actors: Jonathan Scarfe, Zoe McLellan, Barbara Mandrell, Barry Flatman
description: Steven is apparently a boy like many others. He has only one problem: he drinks. He is trying with all his might to get out of the alcoholism tunnel. One day he casually meets Kelly, and a troubled love affair begins with her. The girl, in fact, is extremely possessive, jealous of everyone, and with a stratagem she manages to marry Steve, with whom the relationship becomes more and more morbid. The boy's mother begins to sense that Kelly is hiding some mysterious secret, tries to warn her son but doesn't arrive in time to avoid the worst. Steven is in fact found dead in the lake. Apparently it seems a clear case of drowning, but the police decide not to dismiss the case and start investigating the girl ...
notes: Quite energetic TV movie but with all the flaws of the case in place. Flat TV direction, anonymous performers, ax-cut psychologies, harmless suspense, sweetened tones, never disturbing lights. Small screen productions are like this: take it or leave it.

title: The Duke
actors: James Doohan, Courtnee Draper, Sophie Heyman, Judy Geeson
description: The duke of an English county, on the verge of death, aware of the greed of his nephews, bequeaths his title and all his huge properties to the loyal dog. The animal takes the new role of noble very seriously: it is looked after by many servants and revered and respected by all the inhabitants of the county. Organize parties and receptions even inviting Queen Elizabeth. Of course the nephews of the late duke will do everything to prevent him from keeping the title (and above all, to keep the money ...) but thanks to the providential help of a girl and a dog in love with him, everything will settle down.
notes: Entertaining comedy all played on the skill of the protagonist dog. If the Germans have deployed a four-legged commissioner, the British opt for a "duke". The story, although fantastic, is inspired by a fact that really happened. A rich man who left everything to his faithful Irish setter.

title: Moby Dick
actors: Patrick Stewart, Gregory Peck, Henry Thomas
description: Ismael, a young man seeking adventure, arrives in Nantucket to find work on a whaling ship. Ismael becomes friends with a Polynesian harpooner, and together they embark on the Pequod, the boat of the legendary Captain Ahab. Little is known about the latter, but a terrible white whale is said to have stolen his leg.
notes: Based on the novel by Melville, with a cameo by Gregory Peck, star of the great John Huston film, it is a very modest version for TV.

title: Riot
actors: Gary Daniels, Sugar Ray Leonard, Paige Rowland, Patrick Kilpatrick
description: December 24, 1999. It is Christmas Eve, the last of the millennium. The city is in turmoil. Gang of criminals wreak havoc. The situation explodes when the daughter of a British ambassador is kidnapped by a gang of thugs. The task is entrusted to Special Agent Shane Alcott. To find it, he puts the city to fire and sword, while the tension in the ghetto neighborhoods rises more and more dangerously.
notes: Sugar Ray Leonard is the famous boxer who hung up his gloves. Wasted Gary Daniels on such a poor production. The echoes of riot that dot the film (and the original title, "Riot", means "riot") would obviously remind us of the 1992 Los Angeles riots, which broke out after the Rodney King case.

title: Into the Arms of Danger
actors: Morgan Fairchild, Chandra West, Ricky Paull Goldin, Michael Woods
description: Carly is a carefree teenager like many others, until her mother decides to remarry with a creepy character. The future stepfather, even before getting married, begins to undermine the girl, so much so as to force her to run away from home. Traveling from Seattle to Los Angeles, Carly meets a young photographer. It could be the beginning of an overwhelming love story, and instead ...
notes: To poor Carly the Oscar for bad luck. It seems that the worst men on the face of the earth haunt her! Morgan Fairchild, almost needless to mention, has been a soap opera star for at least ten years.

title: Random Hearts
actors: Harrison Ford, Kristin Scott Thomas, Bonnie Hunt, Charles S. Dutton, Dennis Haysbert, Sydney Pollack, Richard Jenkins, Paul Guilfoyle, Susanna Thompson, Peter Coyote, Dylan Baker, Lynne Thigpen, Susan Floyd, Bill Cobbs
description: The plane on which Dutch's wife, from the Department of Internal Affairs, and Kay's husband, MP, crashes. The investigations bring to light disconcerting information: during the journey Peyton and Cullen sat next to each other and were registered as husband and wife.
notes: The first part of the film, with a day that unfolds like all the others, leading the protagonists to the plane crash that has been on the news for hours, is built with an incisive scan, centered on Harrison Ford's face. And the short overnight trip to Miami, with the speechless return and the nervous explosion in the car, has an obsessive and cruel credibility. Too bad that, in the second part, Kurt Luedtke's screenplay gets watered down and gets lost in too many words.

title: The Fly
actors: Vincent Price, Patricia Owens, Herbert Marshall, Al Hedison
description: A Canadian scientist is killed by his wife under a mechanical press. His brother and a policeman investigate the causes of the mysterious murder, immediately confessed by the woman. And they discover that the doctor, during a molecular transfer experiment, was contaminated by a fly and transformed into a monster.
notes: A horror classic recently remade by David Cronenberg ("The Fly"). Moments of authentic suspense when the woman discovers the chilling metamorphosis of her beloved husband. Naive but no less frightening special effects. The scream of desperation of the human fly imprisoned in the web leaves its mark.

title: Heidi
actors: Noley Thornton, Jane Seymour, Jason Robards, Lexi Randall, Benjamin Brazier, Patricia Neal
description: Still in infants, Heidi loses her parents and is entrusted to her grumpy grandfather, who has retired to the mountains. Immediately Heidi befriends Peter, the young goat keeper, and her blind grandmother. The orphan begins to settle in her grandfather's house and get excited about life in the mountains. But the old man's hard temper is worsening and therefore cousin Dete returns to take the child back to take her to Frankfurt, to the Sesemann family. Here he will have to keep company with Klara, a girl confined to a wheelchair. Heidi's arrival in the Sesemann house is greeted with enthusiasm by Klara and with disappointment by the housekeeper, Miss Rottermeier.

title: Dragonheart
actors: Dennis Quaid, Dina Meyer, David Thewlis, Julie Christie, Pete Postlethwaite, Brian Thompson, Jason Isaacs, Lee Oakes
description: A knight of fortune, specialized in the fight against dragons and the like, puts himself at the service of the highest bidder in England in the year one thousand. The usual tyrant sows death and destruction, and fears the last dragon who survived the slaughters of yesteryear. Our knight sets out on the trail of the fire-breathing beast with unfriendly intentions, then becomes his friend and ally. Together they will try to defeat the despot.
notes: Imaginative adventure film embellished with special effects, which allow the dragon to "live" seriously. In the original version his voice is by Sean Connery, in Italian by Gigi Proietti.

title: Ebbie
actors: Susan Lucci, Wendy Crewson, Ron Lea, Molly Parker, Lorena Gale
description: Ebbie is the greedy and unscrupulous owner of a department store. But on the eve of the most beautiful day of the year, strange nightmare figures push her to face a journey into the Christmas of the past, present and future. The fantastic journey finally forces her to look in the mirror and discover that greed and being unscrupulous do not always pay off. Aware of the aridity of his existence, Ebbie will be able to remedy it, carrying within himself the spirit that lights up Christmas day and makes it the most beautiful night of the year.
notes: Television film based on the famous short story by Charles Dickens.

title: The Christmas List
actors: Mimi Rogers, Rob Stewart, Bill Switzer, Tanja Reichert, Tim Bissett, Enuka Okuma, Jano Frandsen, Madison Graie
description: Melody Parris is a thirty-five year old woman, a dreamer, careless and not particularly lucky. She works as a clerk at Cairn's department store employed by a younger boss and is waiting for her fiancé George to marry her. On the occasion of Christmas, Melody writes the list of gifts she would like to receive and posts it in Santa's mailbox. Melody's wishes are very simple: flowers, make-up, a dinner in the luxurious restaurant "La stanza del cielo". Great is the woman's surprise when she sees all her dreams come true. The creator of all this is a boy named Danny, met at the department stores.

title: The Pebble and the Penguin
description: As is known, penguins live in the South Pole. Indeed, the South Pole is home to penguins. And among them there is an ancient tradition according to which on a certain day of the year each penguin must give a stone to the penguin he is in love with. The penguin, in turn, will decide whether or not to go along with the companion's court depending on the color of the stone given. The day set for the consummation of the rite is getting closer and closer, and the young Hubie has in mind the penguin he would like to send his gift to. The problem is another: Hubie has not yet found the stone with which to be sure of the fateful "yes".
notes: Very wild Don Bluth, former writer and draftsman of Walt Disney who one day saw fit to leave the shack and puppets to go on his own. Now there is Spielberg's Dreamworks ("The Prince of Egypt"), but ten years ago challenging the Disney giant with cartoons seemed crazy. Honor to the merit therefore: the old Don was the first to scratch the Great Empire.

title: Faustina
actors: Vonetta McGee, Enzo Cerusico, Renzo Montagnani, Franco Acampora
description: Faustina is a mulatto girl, the daughter of a black soldier and a Roman woman, who lives with her husband Quirino, a grave robber by profession always looking for the blow that makes him rich. One day he met Enea, a young man who plays the guitar in restaurants and who, now, having lost his instrument in the course of a fight, lives in misery dreaming of the help promised to him by a count. His shyness and his education conquer the girl, who, tired of the quarrels with her husband, offers him to run away with her. After playing them to her husband with good reason, Faustina prepares to escape ...
notes: The all too thin and folkloric story manages to amuse, thanks above all to the comic verve of Enzo Cerusico.

title: The Visitors
actors: Steve Railsback, James Woods, Patricia Joyce, Chico Martínez, Patrick McVey
description: Two US Army soldiers come out of prison. They served two years later for the rape and murder of a girl committed in the war in Vietnam. The two go to visit the fellow soldier who had reported them and who lives with his wife, daughter and father-in-law. Between the four men it will be a slow surfacing of tension.
notes: Drama to the death, which almost directly stages the false conscience and nightmares of Vietnam, directed with a reduced crew by a veteran and written by his son Chris. The episode underlying the subject will also inspire De Palma for "War Victims". The theme of physical and psychological violence was perfectly developed. James Woods debut.

title: Une belle fille comme moi
actors: Bernadette Lafont, André Dussollier, Claude Brasseur
description: Criminologist with high professional hopes, but certainly not very awake in dealing with women, he has a new "object" of study: a refined killer. Of course, dealing with a "femme fatale" of such proportions, any man would succumb to the lure of passion. The criminologist is no exception, he falls in love with the murderer and ignores a not exactly secondary detail: he is the next victim of his beloved ...
notes: Black Comedy by the always great Truffaut. This time not everything shines as usual, and some situations are slightly known. But the characters are spot on, and the figure of the woman splendidly truffautiana.

title: Mouchette
actors: Nadine Nortier, Jean-Claude Guilbert, Marie Cardinal
description: Mouchette is fourteen years old, she is very poor and abused by her father. As if her situation wasn't desperate enough, a poacher rapes her. She is a victim, but for the people of the village the episode represents shame and everyone indulges in the most sinister gossip. Mouchette approaches the river, which welcomes it in its waters.
notes: Taken from a story by Georges Bernanos, another parable about human suffering and indifference. Bresson's vision is not secular but very spiritual, even if the divine plans are contemplated with a certain dismay. The "Magnificat" of the musical commentary is relentless.

title: Les dames du bois de Boulogne
actors: Maria Casarès, Paul Bernard, Elena Labourdette, Lucienne Bogaert, Jean Marchat, Yvette Etiévant, Marcel Rouzé
description: A rich bourgeois, Hélène, makes her ex-lover fall in love with a girl who makes "life" just to be able to support her old mother. The former lover, Jean, falls seriously in love with the young woman and Hélène, who feels doubly betrayed, decides to reveal the woman's "profession" to him. Despite this, the relationship between the two does not change.
notes: One of Bresson's most underrated films, and already one of his masterpieces. The starting point is melodrama, but the director, through an ascetic staging, eliminates the elements of fiction.

title: Desert Hawk
actors: Yvonne De Carlo, Richard Greene, George Macready
description: The Desert Eagle is an undercover adventurer very similar to Zorro. Except that in reality his name is Omar and he lives in the Middle East, precisely in Tehran. The caliph of the city extinguishes the people until they are reduced to poverty, and the Eagle decides to blackmail them by kidnapping Sherazade, his betrothed. However, he discovers that the girl is by no means an accomplice of the despot, and indeed takes sides in the adventurer's struggle. Together with her, the Eagle manages to defeat the caliph and avert war with Baghdad.
notes: Adventurous melodrama that respects all the clichés of the "swashbuckling" genre. Excellent De Carlo in one of his most ... exotic roles.

title: Studio 54
actors: Ryan Phillippe, Salma Hayek, Sela Ward, Mike Myers, Breckin Meyer
description: In Jersey City, just after the bridge, 19-year-old Shane managed to enter the legendary Studio 54 created by entrepreneur Steve Rubell towards the end of the 1970s. Inside the disco the boy finds a job and new friends: Greg, a janitor who dreams of making money as a barman, his wife Anita, a dresser who aspires to break into discomusic and Julie, a soap opera diva who embodies the girl of his dreams.
notes: To understand the seventies and the transition to the next decade, the rise and fall of an overwhelming and ephemeral "fever", you have to cross the river that separates New Jersey from Manhattan and spend the nights (ten is enough for Mark's film Christopher) in "Studio 54", at the court of Steve Rubell (the very good Mike Myers).

title: Rose e pistole
actors: Anna Ammirati, Duccio Giordano, Cristina Donadio, Luigi Petrucci
description: Campi Flegrei. Rosa and Angelo, a couple in their twenties, she is pregnant and does not know it yet, they are on the run because they are chased by her ex-husband, the rich butcher Pappalardo, who has hired a killer, Bosnia, to kill the boy. Looking for easy money to leave the city, Angelo gets involved in a strange robbery, while Rosa, after a failed attempt at drug dealing, reaches the office of an erotic phone where he worked in the past.
