notes: Debut by Carla Apuzzo, produced and co-written by Salvatore Piscicelli, the film offers an unprecedented portrait of the city. Provincial talkshows, hotlines, the hinterland of Campi Flegrei, are the set in which characters move above and below the lines. A too fragmented plot and the desire to tarantine weigh down the curious "music of chance" that the newcomer Apuzzo had tried to create.

title: Onegin
actors: Ralph Fiennes, Liv Tyler, Martin Donovan, Toby Stephens, Lena Headey
description: A young dandy lives in the beautiful world of Petersburg. Forced to move to the countryside, the man has time to burn the heart of the young and beautiful Tatiana who, without thinking for a moment, writes a poignant and passionate letter that the lucky one is not worthy of a look. After some time, however, finding her in the arms of a cousin, he realizes the impulsive choice and begins to fry him this time.
notes: The melodrama, based on Pushkin, marks the directorial debut of Ralph Fiennes' sister and musician Magnus Fiennes, author of the romantic score. Familism is elegant and does not bother and the step is from a Bolchian script.

title: Eyes Wide Shut
actors: Tom Cruise, Nicole Kidman, Sydney Pollack, Leelee Sobieski, Rade Serbedzija, Madison Eginton, Jackie Sawiris, Leslie Lowe, Peter Benson, Todd Field, Michael Doven, Sky du Mont, Louise J. Taylor, Stewart Thorndike, Randall Paul, Julienne Davis, Lisa Leone
description: Bill, a doctor without any qualities, goes into crisis when his wife Alice tells him about her dreams of betrayal and when one of his patients confesses her love to him in front of her father's corpse. Bill will be tempted by a prostitute, he will participate in an orgiastic party where he will be discovered and so to speak saved by a mysterious woman. Is it the same one whose corpse in the morgue looks troubled and perturbed?
notes: Alice and Bill are taken hostage by the persuasive plot of Arthur Schnitzler's text, "Double Dream" and watched by the eyes of Kubrick and by his desire to tell about sexuality, illness and the hibernation of passions. The apparent central theme of the film, as always in Kubrick's dazzling filmography, is late and early. In a pre-Christmas New York, artificial and gloomy, despite the colored and very white lights, Bill will understand, perhaps, that sex is a charade, a staging, a chilling ceremony like certain horror films of the fifties and sixties.

title: American Pie
actors: Jason Biggs, Shannon Elizabeth, Alyson Hannigan, Thomas Ian Nicholas
description: Jim is the typical big virgin and desperate boy on eternal testosterone overdose. Since his parents discovered him in unmistakable attitudes in front of an erotic channel, his father has decided to instruct him in sex. After a disastrous experience with a foreign student, Nadia, Jim follows the advice of a friend, he will launch into an intrepid embrace with a hot and fragrant apple pie, the thing that comes closest to the female sex. Eventually he decides to play his last card with Michelle, the flute player of the school band.
notes: The film is a high-school comedy, pimply and dirty (but attentive to "equal opportunities": girls are no less wild than boys) directed by brothers Chris and Paul Weitz, who did not care at all about directing (the film is very sloppy ), but which still manage to make an authentic vitality explode. Less refined and more shameless than the Farrelly brothers.

title: Le Clan des siciliens
actors: Alain Delon, Jean Gabin, Lino Ventura, Irina Demick, Amedeo Nazzari, Sidney Chaplin, Edward Meeks
description: Roger Sartet, a dangerous multiple-murderous robber, proposes an unprecedented blow to the old Vittorio Manalese, a Sicilian who lives in Paris and hides his shady activities from his family: to seize the jewels of a traveling exhibition. Tony Nicosia, an Italian-American mafioso, also participates in the robbery. Everything seems to be going perfectly and Inspector Le Goff, in charge of the case, is groping in the dark. But within the group something is cracking ...
notes: Gabin + Ventura + Delon, skilfully blended by a Serie B professional like Verneuil. The result is good: gritty cinema, noir atmospheres, subdued characters. The participation of Amedeo Nazzari leaves its mark.

title: Le Bride sur le cou
actors: Brigitte Bardot, Michel Subor, Jacques Riberolles, Joséphine James
description: The model Sofia is madly in love with her photographer Filippo who, after deceiving her, has seen fit to woo a rich American. The two are so in love that they have decided to get married. In the meantime, Sofia has met a young surgeon, Aldo, and decides to use him to make Filippo jealous. When the two lovebirds leave for the mountain, Sofia, mad with jealousy, convinces Aldo to follow her.
notes: A film with the most beautiful woman in the world definitely deserves to be seen and reviewed. Even if the woman in question is not an excellent actress and the director, her husband, is not really a Godard ...

title: The Pope of Greenwich Village
actors: Eric Roberts, Daryl Hannah, Mickey Rourke, Geraldine Page
description: Two middle-class thieves are hired by an Irish criminal for a seemingly simple theft. In truth, the money they sweep is that of a dangerous mafia boss. Of course, all three burglars end up in trouble as big as mountains.
notes: Rosenberg is a shrewd professional who knows how to handle gender stereotypes. Here he recreates the atmosphere of a criminal saga, veering them decisively towards comedy. The actors are convincing, especially Geraldine Page.

title: Johnny 2.0
actors: Jeff Fahey, Michael Ironside, Tahnee Welch, John Neville, Michael Rhoades
description: In a futuristic world (year of grace 2013) Johnny 2.0, clone of a brilliant scientist, is sent back in time to try to capture his creator. With the help of Nikki, a terrorist, the cyborg will instead discover the dark and disconcerting truth behind her creation.
notes: Cybermovie with an existential aftertaste, a little old-fashioned (between the replicants of "Blade Runner" and "Terminator") and not excellent workmanship. The production denounces the limits of the television film, but the B movie faces of the protagonists are quite convincing. Gorgeous Tahnee Welch and excellent Ironside in the habitual role of the villain.

title: Amor nello specchio
actors: Anna Galiena, Peter Stormare, Simona Cavallari, Alessandra Borgia
description: Duchy of Mantua, 1619. Giovanni Battista Andreini is a brilliant representative of an illustrious family of actors. Wrestling with the writing of the comedy "Love in the mirror", he experiences a creative fury in which art and life are indissolubly intertwined, remaining prey to a loving and sensual vortex in which his wife actress Virginia Ramponi and the young and exuberant Lidia are involved.
notes: Rich and fascinating in its theatrical productions, the film by Salvatore Maira, a scholar of the Baroque age, however, is lost in an excessive formal self-satisfaction focusing on the bodies and the sets, rather than on the characters, which strike above all for modernity.

title: Big Daddy
actors: Adam Sandler, Joey Lauren Adams, Jon Stewart, Cole Sprouse
description: Reckless and unreliable, 32-year-old new lawyer Sonny is dumped by his girlfriend. To show her his love and reliability, the young man pretends to be the natural father of five-year-old Julian, "adopted" after his mother's death. However, his plan fails and the lawyer with the "Peter Pan syndrome", definitively left by the girl, finds himself having to really be a father.
notes: Fast-growing actor Adam Sandler plays Sonny and is also the film's co-writer, but his face and signature aren't enough to keep him standing. The director Dugan is that of _Piccola peste_.

title: Wonderland
actors: Ian Hart, Gina McKee, Kika Markham, Molly Parker, Shirley Henderson
description: London, Bonfire Night weekend, the night in which the anniversary of the attack on Parliament is celebrated with bonfires and fireworks. A mother and father, traumatized by the absence of their son Darren, are prisoners of a loveless marriage. Debbie, Nadia and Molly are Darren's three sisters and the first has a nine-year-old son and a great desire to have fun, the second lives alone and hopes to meet the man of her life, while the third is about to become a mother. for the first time.
notes: Winterbottom's new work is almost Altmanian, intent on stalking (as in "America today") loneliness and encounters of family members. Less desperate than other films by the English director, he focuses above all on the city, isolating moments of great figurative tension, in which the modern soul of "greater London" is linked to certain Free Cinema documentaries. A film suspended between the realism of live shooting and psychological investigation.

title: Uomini contro
actors: Alain Cuny, Gian Maria Volonté, Mark Frechette, Franco Graziosi, Giampiero Albertini
description: World War I, in the trenches. A sadistic general does not care about common sense and sends his soldiers into disarray, making them uselessly massacred by enemy fire. In the chaos, two non-commissioned officers will become aware of the war aberrations.
notes: A brooding film, anti-militarist and ideologically committed, but also too subjected to its symbolic interpretations. A bit of Marxism emerges together with the sincere pacifism of the author, who among other things was inspired for the screenplay (written together with Tonino Guerra and Raffaele La Capria) from the book "A year on the plateau" by Emilio Lussu.

title: Urban Safari
actors: David Naughton, Linda Kash, Andrea Nemeth, Donnelly Rhodes
description: When all of your friends go on vacation, it's hard to admit that you're forced to stay home because household finances don't allow anything else. This is why a nice little family invents a "pretend" holiday: after informing relatives, friends and acquaintances that they are about to travel to a phantom exotic island, they seal doors and windows and move to the garden.
notes: A film produced for Swiss television based on a not very original but funny idea. But the pace drops, the gags are discounted and the cast, of complete strangers, can't keep the tension high.

title: Terra bruciata
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Raoul Bova, Michele Placido, Francesco Paolantoni, Bianca Guaccero
description: Francesco, who emigrated to the United States in search of work (he is a stuntman), returns to his country of origin after ten years for the funeral of his parents. Here he discovers that his parents have been killed by Macrì, a boss of the area and by the clan of his childhood friends with the complicity of the village friar. With the help of a girl, Maria, Francesco takes his revenge by unleashing a feud between the group of young criminals of the country and the Macrì clan.
notes: Fabio Segatori's feature film debut winks at Tarantino and "Dobermann" without having their technical and cinematic background. A wasteful, screamed, violent film that throws away a cameo by Peppino Di Capri and the over-the-top characterizations of a Giannini in the Wertmuller area.

title: Being John Malkovich
actors: Cameron Diaz, John Cusack, John Malkovich, Catherine Keener
description: Craig is a failed puppeteer. His wife, Lotte, works in a pet shop. Husband and wife look filthy. Sloppy, messy, unresolved and likeable, they float in the provisional. Craig finds a job in the filing of a strange office where a small door, hidden behind a filing cabinet, is actually a secret passage in John Malkovich's head. Which, after fifteen minutes, throws you up in New Jersey, in a meadow near the highway.
notes: The first forty minutes of Spike Jonze's debut are dazzling. The paradox is tinged with metaphysics, psychoanalysis and brilliant comedy. Then the pace drops, and the invention becomes a bit repetitive.

title: Une liaison pornographique
actors: Nathalie Baye, Sergi López, Jacques Viala, Paul Pavel
description: A man and a woman, with no name, no identity, no past. A bar where they meet every Thursday. Chat, coffee, cognac. They are the faint signs of a pornographic relationship, upset and canceled by an unexpected and uninvited love. The ghost that brings them together remains unclear, secret, even when the relationship is over. Only the memory of an unlived love remains. The characters confess to a witness (a journalist, the director himself?). With silences, inaccuracies, amazements, sadness they rework the banal exceptionality of their adventure of senses, feelings and too many words.
notes: Frédéric Fonteyne, in the second film, only gathers the title, the cast and some scenes (the chase in the metro, the illness of the neighbor). Coppa Volpi to the good Nathalie Baye.

title: Eye of the Beholder
actors: Ewan McGregor, Ashley Judd, Geneviève Bujold, Jason Priestley
description: "The Eye", a British intelligence spy expert, is entrusted with a case involving Joanna Eris, a woman suspected of blackmailing a senator's son. During one of his stalking, "The Eye" witnesses the woman's first murder. But when he is about to inform the operations center of the incident, "The Eye", examining some photographs, discovers that the woman looks strikingly like her daughter who mysteriously disappeared many years ago.
notes: This remake of "Mortelle randoneé" (in Italy "Mia dolce assassina") by Claude Miller, with Isabelle Adjani and Michelle Serrault, is almost like a Hitchcokian filtered De Palma, replaced by a talented Ashley Judd and a functional Ewan McGregor. A curious Anglo-Canadian co-production that immediately turns into a noir frozen by the snow imprisoned in the typical glass packages for tourist use that the protagonist, a British secret service agent, buys everywhere where the object of his research - the phantom Joanna Eris - carries him and leads him. Two fates trapped in an online communication, wrapped in the sweet "Que reste-t-il des nos amours?" by Trenet sung by Chrissie Hinde, leader of the Pretenders.

title: Way of a Gaucho
actors: Rory Calhoun, Gene Tierney, Richard Bone, Hugh Marlowe
description: Argentina, late last century, Martin is a proud gaucho who grew up with Miguel. One day Martin kills a man who had dared to offend his friend and is arrested for this. The murderer, following Miguel's advice, enlisted in the army, but intolerant of discipline, deserted. Surprised by a squad of guards, he is led back to his battalion where he is subjected to inhuman punishment.

title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
actors: Treat Williams, Jeremy London, Bryan Brown, Tushka Bergen
description: The geologist Thedore Lytton and his nephew Jones, followers of the Darwinian theory of evilution, have big problems of credibility in public opinion. For their research, the two scientists decided to organize an important expedition. During the journey, the three come across a mysterious underground beach that will lead them to the center of the Earth. TV version not unworthy of Verne's classic. But how can we not prefer the old and naive version with James mason?

title: Gulliver's Travel
actors: Ted Danson, Omar Sharif, Peter O'Toole, Edward Fox, Mary Steenburgen
description: Confused and excited, Gulliver returns to London and tells his fellow citizens the incredible story of his travels. Everyone refuses to believe his words. Considered mad, he is locked up in an asylum by Dr. Bates, the man who in his absence had taken over his house and his profession and who, for several years, had tried to convince Gulliver's wife that he was dead in order to induce her to marry him. Gulliver, tries in every way to overcome the disbelief and skepticism of his family and friends. Decent television adaptation in two episodes, with the effects of the firm Henson (that of the Muppett) and Isabelle Huppert dubbing a horse with a French accent.

title: Il ritorno del piccolo Lord
actors: Mario Adorf, Catherine Spaak, Francesco De Pasquale, Antonella Ponziani
description: A few years have passed since Karl, a German industrialist, found Christian, his grandson whose existence he did not know, on the island of Ponza. The boy grew up, and after spending the winter in Germany at his grandfather's house, he returned to the island where his mother Gioia runs a medical institute. During the holiday Karl meets Veronica, a woman he feels attracted to and who begins to weave a skilful web to keep the loved ones away from the financier. In reality, the woman is an industrial spy who a multinational has put in the ribs of Karl. Man will find an unexpected ally in Christian.

title: Canzoni in... bikini
actors: Maria Grazia Buccella, Tino Scotti, Tiberio Murgia
description: Simone and Ulderico are at the head of two advertising agencies, the flourishing Televedo and the Telecanto always on the verge of bankruptcy. Both compete to win the production of a TV commercial. To complicate things is Salvatore, an employee of Simone who falls madly in love with Guendalina, an employee of Telecanto. But an unexpected twist shatters the engagement. Salvatore, in fact, is forced under the threat of a shotgun to marry the daughter of a mafia boss, while Guendalina will find true love.
notes: Sometimes two mid-level comedians and a showgirl aren't enough to make a movie.

title: Muppet Treasure Island
actors: Kevin Bishop, Tim Curry, Billy Connolly, Jennifer Saunders
description: Having received the treasure map from a mysterious sailor, young Jim Hawkins embarks with his friends Gonzo and Rizzo on a journey that should lead them to an island where the elusive treasure is found. They are "joined" by the gentleman Squire Trelawney, the reckless Captain Smollett and the rebellious Long John Silver. It's up to Captain Smollett and his men to rescue Jim when Silver and his crew take him hostage and take over the map. But who will think of saving the Captain and his faithful men from the local tribe of warthogs led by Miss Piggy.
notes: Brian Henson revises and corrects Jim Hawkins' adventures with comedy. Perfectly successful undertaking.

title: Man of the House
actors: Chevy Chase, Farrah Fawcett, JonathanTaylor Thomas, George Wendt
description: 11-year-old Ben Archer is a smart kid struggling with a big problem: getting rid of Jack, a harassed prosecutor, boyfriend of his mother Sandy and unprepared for the role of stepfather. Over the past five years, Ben and his mother have done just fine on their own, and he's convinced he doesn't need anyone else in the house, much less a lawyer who thinks he's learning to be a parent. Instigated by his friend Monroe, Ben devises a series of tricks to keep Jack away, but it won't be easy ...
notes: More than a film, a situation comedy with few ideas signed by Disney.

title: The Love Bug
actors: Bruce Campbell, John Hannah, Alexandra Wentworth, Dean Jones
description: Herbie miraculously escaped scrapping and now has a new owner, but things have absolutely not changed for him. In fact, the beetle must once again participate in a reckless rally across the desert. The enemy to defeat this time is the rich and snobbish Simon Moore III who has developed a hellish machine called Horace. The fight to finish first will be very tough and the race will test the tenacity of Herbie and her new owner.
notes: Herbie's adventures are always a source of fun. Dean Jones, the old Beetle driver, also peeps out in this new episode.

title: Storm
actors: Luke Perry, Martin Sheen, Robert Knott, David Moses, Marc McClure
description: A secret experiment, aimed at creating a deadly new weapon, causes an accident that changes the weather conditions over Los Angeles. A large cyclone threatens the Californian megalopolis. Alarmed, the inhabitants prepare to flee, while confusion reigns supreme. Fortunately, a meteorologist tries by all means to save the city with the help of a brave jet pilot.
notes: Classic B-series movie with mid-level special effects. Renée Estevez is Martin Sheen's granddaughter.

title: L'assassino è quello con le scarpe gialle
actors: Pino Insegno, Roberto Ciufoli, Francesca Draghetti, Tiziana Foschi
description: Roberto decides to stage "Hamlet" in a theater where as a child he had seen a murder committed. He has almost completely removed the particular event, he remembers only one detail: the murderer was wearing strange canary yellow shoes. Except that at some point the killer of that time comes back to show up.
notes: Comic film that has the flavor of farce and remains firmly anchored to television aesthetic modules. The four protagonists, that is the comedy group "The award-winning company" back from the good success of the show "As long as there is firm there is hope" had thus made his debut at the cinema without surprising.

title: Martin's Day
actors: Richard Harris, Justin Henry, James Coburn, Karen Black
description: Martin Steckert is the typical fugitive who, hunted by half the world, astutely chooses to take a hostage. The "lucky one" chosen is another Martin, a boy with whom he escapes to an isolated area in the mountains, by the lake. A fairy place where Martin (the fugitive) spent happy moments as a child. On the trail of the two Martins, a policeman who doesn't give up and the ex-girlfriend of the fugitive ...
notes: It may be a TV movie, but damn what a cast! The development of the relationship between the two Martins is interesting (the fugitive is Richard Harris, the man called horse). Brilliant cameos by John Ireland and Saul Rubinek.

title: Anything for Love
actors: Corey Haim, Nicole Eggert, Cameron Bancroft
description: Typical American college. Typical group of boys and girls divided into typologies (nerds, belloni, bellocci, bulletti). Typical forest for nothing obscure of cheerleaders, the pom pom girls who accompany the course of sporting events with their evolutions. But what happens if the most coveted school cheerleader is actually a male?
notes: Definitely horrible plot, but inserted in the usual teen-aage movie context ("American Pie" style) which has more than an admirer. The latter are captured, all the others abstain. One of the songs, "Cool!" It is sung by the then teenager and unknown Alanis Morrissette.

title: Happy, Texas
actors: Jeremy Northam, Steve Zahn, William H. Macy, Illeana Douglas
description: In the town of Happy in Texas, the event of the year is the national competition for the title of Little Miss Fresh-Squeezed, to which the elementary school girls compete. To get to the challenge, the citizens turned to David and Steven, two experts in setting up shows and ballets. But in their place come two homosexual escapees who are more interested in the bank than in the glories of the girls. To prepare for the coup it is necessary not to arouse suspicion and meet the expectations of the inhabitants of Happy.
notes: A fruit worthy of "Arizona Junior", albeit extended with sweeteners that the brilliant American authors - bitter lovers - would never use, is Mark Illsley's debut, presented in 1999 at the Sundance Film Festival where he won the Special Jury Prize for "Best Comedy Performance" by Steve Zahn. The feminine landscape is embellished by the polite presence of the blonde Walker and the brunette Douglas. The gay universe, on the other hand, is inhabited by one of the Coens' favorite actors, William H. Macy, a sheriff Chappy, who creates the atmosphere, a "scandalous" tenderness.

title: The Love Letter
actors: Kate Capshaw, Tom Selleck, Tom Everett Scott, Blythe Danner
description: In the all too quiet town of Loblolly by the Sea, the arrival of a mysterious letter causes a real revolution. Those who read it end up wondering who wrote it and for whom. Determined to discover the author or author of the letter, Helen begins a search that will lead her to meet George, an old friend from the past, and Johnny.
notes: Mrs. Spielberg, Kate Capshaw, co-produces and plays her neo-romantic theater in which Selleck is disguised as a firefighter, Ellen Degeneres plays the witty and the other actors stare or sulk. The only insight is the reduction of a modest successful book. Direction is non-existent.

title: Agnes Browne
actors: Anjelica Huston, Marion O'Dwyer, Niall O'Shea, Ciaran Owens
description: 1967, Ireland. The Browne family live in a turbulent neighborhood in central Dublin. When Agnes's husband dies leaving her alone with seven children, Agnes starts selling fruit and vegetables at the market supported by her best friend, Marion, to make a living. When the French baker takes an interest in her, Agnes realizes she still has a life ahead of her.
notes: The daughter of the unforgettable John, in addition to showing a confident attitude behind the camera (already the first work "Bastard Out of Carolina", unreleased in Italy, was a work of considerable depth), draws an Oscar-winning Agnes Browne. The film is based on a very successful Irish novel, "The Mammy", by Brendan O'Carroll, from 1994. The interpretation of Marion O'Dwyer, a friend of the heart, was also awarded.

title: Sei donne per l'assassino
actors: Eva Bartok, Cameron Mitchell, Thomas Reiner, Arianna Gorini
description: In the park of the Christian atelier, Isabelle, a beautiful model, is strangled by a masked killer. Inspector Silvestri, in charge of the investigation, soon realizes how poisoned the climate in the fashion house is. He discovers that Isabella was a lover of an antique dealer, and that he had written a compromising diary for all the employees of the atelier. Nicole, a friend of the dead woman, has hidden the diary, but the killer kills her. Other gruesome crimes follow one another.
notes: A classic of the Italian thriller, the progenitor of the genre. The screenplay can always seem inconsistent, but Bava once again proves to be a "painter of the frame", and chooses anti-naturalistic and violent color palettes. The film, in this sense, is a visionary masterpiece. The subjective views of the murderer, the executions and the disturbing atmosphere will influence Dario Argento, especially for his first films.

title: Escape From Zahrain
actors: Yul Brynner, Sal Mineo, Madlyn Rhue, Jack Warden, James Mason
description: In a Middle Eastern state, tyrannized by a sultan, the resistance is led by the energetic Sharif, who is currently in jail awaiting the death sentence. The news of his possible transfer to another prison alerts his faithful who, thanks to a lightning-fast action, manage to free him. Houston, an American adventurer, who is on the side of the rebels and who plans a plan to expatriate Sharif, is also involved in the shooting. Having seized an ambulance from an oil company, he manages to escape with Sharif into the desert.
notes: Modest adventure film with a first-rate cast.

title: La belva
actors: Klaus Kinski, Gabriella Giorgelli, Steven Tedd, Paul Sullivan
description: John Laster, an unscrupulous individual, attempts to carry out a robbery against Powers, a wealthy landowner. When Powers reveals to John that the entire sum raised from the deal is deposited in the bank, the angry bandit kills him. Later, with the help of two bandits, he kidnaps Powers' niece.
notes: A mediocre and predictable spaghetti western. However great Klaus Kinski.

title: The Illustrated Man
actors: Rod Steiger, Claire Bloom, Robert Drivas, Don Dubbins, Jason Evers
description: Will, a boy who wants to go to California by means of luck, meets Karl, a guy who forces him to listen to his story. Clown in a circus, the man got tattooed by a woman, who had completely subjugated him, some strange figures all over his body. Will also feels attracted to those incomprehensible figures and without realizing it, dwelling on some of them, he finds himself transported to a distant and terrifying future.
notes: Jack Smight takes the subject from a Ray Bradbury story and manages to pack a convincing film, which never lets the tension go down.

title: The Terminal Man
actors: George Segal, Joan Hackett, Richard A. Dysart, Jill Clayburgh
description: Benson, electronic technician, enthusiastic robot builder, is struck by a brain disease that leads him to attack those around him. In a short time the man attacks his wife and kills two people. He then undergoes a delicate brain surgery to reduce these violent attacks. But instead Benson turns into a kind of cybernetic, violent and murderous Frankenstein.
notes: Good reduction of a Michael Crichton novel and good example of a sci-fi thriller.

title: Grizzly Falls
actors: Bryan Brown, Daniel Clark, Richard Harris, Oliver Tobias
description: Tyrone is a hunter who has got his hands on a brood of teddy bears. The man, however, did not take into account the obstinacy of the mother bear who decided to bring her cubs back to the forest. The animal wanders around his home and, in revenge, kidnaps Tyrone's son. Fearing the worst, the hunter sets out on the trail of the bear, determined to take revenge for the insult he has suffered. The animal, on the other hand, proved to be a capable and loving companion towards the boy.
notes: Shot on the outskirts of Vancouver for economic reasons, the film does not stray from the usual television movies. It certainly makes use of a breathtaking landscape and the sympathy of the interpreters.

title: Il grido
actors: Steve Cochran, Alida Valli, Betsy Blair, Dorian Gray, Gabriella Pallotta
description: Aldo who works as a worker in a sugar factory has lived with Irma for seven years. From their union a little girl was born. Irma's husband has emigrated for many years and the arrival of the news of his death opens up the prospect of marriage for Aldo. Irma, however, does not want to know more about the man and confesses that she does not love him anymore. For Aldo and the little girl a journey begins in the Po Valley, desperately looking for a woman who can take care of him and his little girl.
notes: The individualistic key that permeates all of Antonioni's cinema is tackled starting from the troubled story of Aldo.

title: Das Callgirl
actors: Floriane Daniel, Isabella Parkinson, André Hennicke, Leonard Lansink
description: Karin Schmidt, a medical student, remains to the studies doing, without the knowledge of the parents, the girl ringing in a small apartment. The "specialty" of her are the mature men that Karin Acclappia on the streets of the city. One evening it happens that Helmut Bann, one of its customers, dies poisoned with strybe during a love encounter. Karin, panic, steals the briefcase that the man had with him. Only later the woman discovers that inside there are one million brands and a floppy disk. Bann has removed the money from a powerful criminal organization that is resorting to all means, including the murder, to re -enter it. The girl is approached by a man who begins to ask her questions about that fateful evening. Day after day Karin discovers that the man is a police commissioner who is on his heels for investigations. This is what she thinks, in reality, the man truly belongs to the police, but is also part of the gang that wants to get his hands out of million brands and on the equally precious floppy disk. When Karin learns of the truth he decides to start a dangerous game on his own against the Band of criminals.

title: The Greatest
actors: Muhammed Ali, Ernest Borgnine, Robert Duvall
description: Inspired by the autobiography of boxing champion Cassius Clay (later converted to Islam and then named Muhammed Ali), Tom Gries tells the life of the man and the sportsman, using many archive images and a cast of great actors as support. in fictional scenes. Ernest Borgnine plays the role of the much talked about manager Angelo Dindee.
notes: Perhaps the screenplay is too complex, which aims to describe Ali's winning parable in one fell swoop and give a socio-political cross-section of the African-American community. Director Gries died during filming, editing was supervised by screenwriter Ring Lardner Jr.

title: The Outsiders
actors: C. Thomas Howell, Matt Dillon, Ralph Macchio, Diane Lane, Patrick Swayze, Rob Lowe, Tom Cruise, Glenn Withrow, Emilio Estevez, Darren Dalton, Michelle Meyrink, Tom Waits, Gallard Sartain
description: The myths of the boys on 56th Street, those who come from the working class area of ??the city, are rock'n'roll, girls and urban violence. Their sworn enemies are the "social", children of the "good" bourgeoisie, stiff but no less violent, and always ready for confrontation. A knife fight and a church fire will trigger the tragedy.
notes: And it is a tragedy: a Coppolian reduction of a novel by H.E. Hinton (the same author of "Rusty the Savage"), a film that does not want to be at all an insight into youthful malaise but an urban melodrama a la Nick Ray (that of "Burnt Youth"). Moving soundtrack, cast of young actors who will be famous. Particular also for Tom Waits.

title: Tornado!
actors: L. Q. Jones, Shannon Sturges, Ernie Hudson, Bruce Campbell
description: Samantha Callen is invited by the National Accounting Office in Byron, Texas to challenge Dr. Branson's research project, engaged in the study of tornadoes. The scientist has created Patti, a machine capable of detecting all useful information on tornadoes and allowing him to prevent the enormous disasters caused by them. Samantha is determined to follow orders, but examining Dr. Branson's work she realizes its usefulness, especially when a tornado strikes Byron. During his mission he meets Jake, passionate about these natural phenomena and falls in love with them.

title: See Jane Run
actors: Joanna Kerns, John Shea, Katy Boyer, Kurt Fuller, Blaire Baron
description: Jane Ravenson is in the grip of a chilling nightmare: but a few moments after awakening, she is seized by the most total amnesia. The tragedy is that she no longer recognizes herself, the world that runs next to her and that surrounds her. Not even the man next to her represents anything for her anymore: indeed, she doesn't even remember why she is there, who he is and what he is talking about. Between anxieties and fears, little and little in Jane's mind a door opens, a window towards new and terrifying revelations ...
notes: A TV movie that manages to maintain a good dose of suspense. Good actors, even if purely television.

title: Newsies
actors: Bill Pullman, Robert Duval, Ann-Margret, Christian Bale
description: The film tells us about the struggles of the newsboys in the America of the Great Depression who try not to be strangled by the large distribution and the great press tycoons. The kids are determined not to let anyone put their feet on their heads and try, in every way, to rebel against those who would like to bully them.
notes: Produced by Disney, a childish musical starring Robert Duvall who puts the face of Pulitzer. The soundtrack is signed by Allan Menken, that of "The Little Mermaid", "Alladin" and "Beauty and the Beast".

title: Tarzan
description: A newborn who has lost his parents is lovingly raised in the heart of the African jungle by a group of monkeys. Tarzan's peaceful world, as the boy is called, is shocked by the arrival of an expedition of human beings and the discovery that he belongs to their race. But along with the bad humans comes the beautiful Jane.
notes: It was Edgar Rice Burroughs himself, Tarzan's "father", who predicted that the perfect dimension for his creature was that of animation and after 47 adaptations he was satisfied. The Disney Tarzan is a big boy who moves in lush nature, like a surfer, but who seeks his own place in the world. It is an "adult" film, in the direction of "Mulan", complete with an ecological message. Technically perfect and plausible in the backgrounds with the nature of Ugandan reserves.

title: Topsy Turvy
actors: Allan Corduner, Jim Broadbent, Lesley Manville, Dorothy Atkinson
description: In Victorian London of 1880, playwright William Gilbert and composer Arthur Sullivan are famous operetta composers. The two went into crisis for lack of ideas. Sullivan, discouraged by the failure, would like to leave the world of operetta to devote himself to classical music. In London, in the meantime, the passion for oriental art and costumes has exploded, and Gilbert gets the inspiration for a new work, which he will give the title of "Mikado".
notes: A surprising, delightful and witty film. The surprise arises from the fact that, compared to the author's previous films, here personal anxieties are hidden and disguised by costumes and by subtle and perfidious verbal skirmishes. The delight comes from the reconstruction, all inside, of a precious chapter in the history of the show. The wit comes from the ability to give creativity and inspiration the sound concreteness of work.

title: Mifunes sidste sang
actors: Iben Hjejle, Anders W. Berthelsen, Sofie Gråbøl, Emil Tarding, Anders Hove
description: During the wedding night Kresten is awakened by the news of his father's death. Leaving his wife in bed, he leaves for the dilapidated farm in the countryside where his father lived. There he has to deal not only with the funeral, but also with the retarded brother whose existence no one knows. Unable to make a decision, Kresten arranges for his wife to stay in Copenhagen and hires a waitress. The woman is actually a luxury prostitute fleeing the city.
notes: The rigid rules of Dogma 95, the aesthetic manifesto inspired by Lars von Trier, induce the director to put the camera up to the soul of his characters. The arrival, the whore and the handicapped are not, fortunately, entangled and victims of their narrative clichés. An impalpable breeze of truth passes through the bodies, looks, melancholies and sober joys of the protagonists.

title: End of Days
actors: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Gabriel Byrne, Kevin Pollak, Robin Tunney
description: For ex-cop Jericho Cane, his work alongside fellow Chicago is a dull routine of monotonous patrols and surveillance. One day, however, he is dragged, in spite of himself, into a dangerous game with a woman: Christine, a young predestined and haunted by recurring nightmares. The woman is the unconscious object of desire of a man who apparently appears to be a normal person, but, in reality, is the supreme force of Evil and who would like to mate with her to generate the Antichrist.
notes: Anthology dialogues of the perfect shameless screenwriter, a visionary priest who has the burden of calling himself Thomas Aquinas, the most powerful peeing devil of the super, Schwarzy crucified. Need to add more?

title: Deep Blue Sea
actors: Saffron Burrows, Thomas Jane, LL Cool J, Jacqueline McKenzie
description: Dr. Susan McAlester's experiments are about to change the history of medicine. But to achieve her goal, discovering the key to regenerating human brain tissue, the scientist has violated the code of ethics by intervening at the genetic level on the DNA of mako sharks. It made them smarter. But Susan has to contend with the members of her study group and the fact that the project's funders are ready to cut funding on the eve of a key test.
notes: Faithful to the philosophy of the (pre) seen, the Finnish Renny Harlin, after the excellent exploit of the previous "Spy", regroups in the ranks of the directors of the second units, those who only deal with the explosions on the set. Plot reduced to the bone, a foregone conclusion, like everything else.

title: Inspector Gadget
actors: Matthew Broderick, Rupert Everett, Joely Fisher, Andy Dick
description: Although not accepted into the police academy, John Brown is determined to fight crime. Certainly his job as a security officer at a Research Center did not help develop his skills. But one night the evil Scolex sneaks into the Center to steal the robotics research of the scientist Artemus. When John discovers that Artemus has been killed during the heist, he runs after Scolex, who blows up his car. John is dying and the only hope is to rely on the care of Artemus's daughter who is planning a bionic policeman.
notes: The producer of the film has three good ideas: he sets his sights on a European cartoon and decides to turn it into a film with actors; he chooses a director of commercials on some of the most popular "objects" of this turn of the century; he decides that the protagonist, kind and not very quick with his head and hands, should have James Stewart's ingenuity to please the American public. The license of excess, typical of cartoons or comedians, would need creative virtuosity. Writers, producer and director, on the other hand, seem neither virtuous nor creative.

title: I fetentoni
actors: Giuseppe Fiorello, Anna Ammirati, Aldo Maccione, Oreste Lionello
description: Life goes on apparently quiet in a corrupt southern town, fed and suffocated by subsidies and extraordinary interventions. Bribes are everywhere and allow everyone to do everything. Power is in the hands of two complementary bosses: Saro Lodato and Cosò Raffati, the most influential man in the city and the largest voting package in the province. Ninni, a banker, son of the former mayor, lives in the city, far from politics; and it is precisely of him that Lodato and Raffati think of as front names.
notes: The project was to revive the glories of the acid comedy of manners. And in part he succeeded, thanks to the inspiration from the book "La città dolente" by Agatino Licandro and Aldo Varano; and above all to a team of actors in which Maccione overwhelms everyone. Fiorello recalls the Giannini of "Sex matto". Robilant chases too much the Wertmüller he once was and the Sicilian Germi. Too much meat on the fire, but a few scratches leave their mark. On the title it is better to spread a pitiful veil.

title: Tutti gli uomini del deficiente
actors: Claudia Gerini, Paolo Hendel, Gigio Alberti, Arnoldo Foà, Aldo Baglio, Giovanni Storti, Giacomo Poretti
description: Leone Stella is seventy years old and has had a life full of excesses and genius. But now he is tired of working, he has designed a video game about his life, he has launched a competition to leave everything to a person who is called like him. A group of "Leone Stella" (or "Stella Leone") starts the race: a kind of "treasure hunt" radio-guided by three speakers ...
notes: An ambitious operation for Gialappa's. Which had to overcome, with the debut in the cinema, the difficult television prejudice. Did they succeed? Unfortunately not. Not so much for a directing problem as for the script, excessively devoted to the accumulation of characters and situations.

title: Il pesce innamorato
actors: Leonardo Pieraccioni, Yamila Diaz, Paolo Hendel, Gabriella Pession
description: Arturo has been writing short stories for children since he was ten. Now, at the age of thirty, he meets the daughter of a publisher who decides to publish "The Fish in Love", a story he had written as a child. Success comes lightning fast and for Arturo nothing is the same as before. In a luxurious hotel he meets Matilde and love at first sight is immediate.
notes: Everything is strange: not only the thin narrative trace, but also every slightest change in the register, every joke by Paolo Hendel, every wish fulfilled by mum and dad who have become rich, every colorful color, every creeper, every performance by Pieraccioni adoring camera. You do not laugh, you are not enchanted by the fairy tale, but only embarrassed.

title: Fantozzi 2000. La clonazione
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Milena Vukotic, Anna Mazzamauro, Paolo Paoloni
description: On the threshold of the third millennium, the employees of Megaditta no longer have that healthy awe towards the bosses and so the Council of Ten Absent on the recommendation of the Megapresident proposes the cloning of the accountant Fantozzi. Returning to his old repertoire of blandishments and pandering, our hero earns a prestigious job: looking after the black sheep of the family, the last degenerate son of the Megapresident, Abalberto Maria Balabam.
notes: The creative miseries of Italian cinema generate another unfolding chapter, the tenth, of the resistible adventures of accountant Ugo Fantozzi. The packaging is flat, the photograph is faded and distracted, the jokes don't make you smile. At least let the comedians rest in peace.

title: Forbrydelsens element
actors: Michael Elphick, Esmond Knight, Me Me Lei
description: Detective Fisher, fresh from a trip to a twilight Europe, dominated by disorder, chaos and death, confesses to a psychoanalyst in Cairo. Fisher, who returned to Egypt traumatized from Europe where he conducted an investigation into a series of murders, confides in his psychotherapist and tells him about his meeting with Osborne, his old professor, author of the book "The element of crime "where it was theorized that a policeman must identify with the criminal to unravel the mystery of his conduct.
notes: A film under hypnosis the one with which the Danish Lars Von Trier made his debut in 1984. A surprising "heart of glass" that manipulates the visual and psychological materials of noir and thriller (from Orson Wells' "Confidential Report" to "M" by Fritz Lang, passing through Tarkovskij) by taking language to extremes (cinemascope, hand machine, impudent baroque). The film is part of a trilogy that also includes the subsequent "Epidemic" (1987) and "Europa" (1991). Von Trier allows himself sublime "temporal and geographical alienations", describes chaos from within, evokes the horror of history and coldly contemplates the impasse of culture.

title: Kirikou et la sorcière
description: Little Kirikù was born in an African village which bears the terrible spell of a witch named Karabà. Spring has disappeared, the villagers are subjected to every harassment by the witch, who has devoured some of the villagers. As soon as he comes out of his mother's womb, Kirikù decides to free the village from the curse of Karabà, a splendid and cruel woman, surrounded by servile fetishes. The journey that Kiriku takes will take him to the Forbidden Mountain, where the Sage of the Mountain, who knows how to defeat the witch, is waiting for him.
notes: The little one succeeds where all the other men in the village have failed, because he knows how to listen and understand the reasons of the other. A fairy tale that invites tolerance but also, in the character of Kirikù, a metaphor on initiation into adult life. For his verve, Kirikù recalls the pygmy protagonist of "Half-Pint Pygmy" by Tex Avery, while for the places, colors and shapes of the idols, Ocelot was inspired by Rousseau the customs officer and "black art". An engaging film for young and old, with a captivating design to which the music of Youssou N'Dour gives charm.

title: East Is East
actors: Om Puri, Linda Bassett, Jordan Routledge, Archie Panjabi
description: George Khan, or rather Genghis as his boys call him, is proud to be Pakistani and to own a small fry shop. He is very hard on his seven children and would like to make them good Pakistanis. But his family lives in Salford, in the north of England and we are in 1971. Just as the displaced flows are about to arrive there as well within the walls of a family composed mostly of young people who have no intention of following the traditions of family.
notes: The first surprise of the English debut feature Damien O'Donnell (presented at the Cannes "Quinzane" in 1999) is that it is funny: Khan's misadventures are narrated as Frears or Kureishi would have done in the early 1980s. The second surprise is the actor Om Puri, who looms like a grotesque Will, like an "outdated" Gassman, like a king in front of his subjects. There is something already seen, but the fun is guaranteed.

title: The General's Daughter
actors: John Travolta, Madeleine Stowe, James Cromwell, Timothy Hutton, James Woods
description: Petty Officer Paul Brenner is tasked with investigating the murder of Captain Elisabeth Campbell. Paul, who has the power to arrest any military of any rank anywhere in the world, is bent on shedding light on the murder. And he won't stop even if all the clues impeach his myth, General "Fighting Joe" Campbell, known for his skills as a leader.
notes: Director Simon West ("Conair") adapts a bestseller about the classic hero of steadfast principles who unmasks corruption and violence. Omertà, Oedipus, masochism, rape, honor and machismo, discipline, lies, videophilia, fidelity, unspoken loves. The whole thematic repertoire of the "bitter and bloody stars" genre is pitted with zeal and with the necessary adjustments. The cast is interesting, but misused and the direction is more casual in the action scenes than in the spoken ones.

title: The Loss of Sexual Innocence
actors: Julian Sands, Saffron Burrows, Stefano Dionisi, Kelly Macdonald
description: Nic has to go through a lot of hardships starting at the age of five. As a teenager, things don't improve. It all affects him, a mature man. Its history is intertwined with the events of Adam and Eve and their expulsion from the earthly paradise.
notes: Figgis is a politically correct paradise, with a black Adam and a white Eve: the logo of the sweaters is missing but it does the same. There is also a chilling "double dream" that has thrown the graves of Freud and Schnitzler into turmoil.

title: What Becomes of the Broken Hearted?
actors: Temuera Morrison, Julian Arahanga, Clint Eruera, Nancy Brunning, Rena Owen, Edna Stirling, Rudolph Alford
description: Ever since Beth left him in hopes of finally making a new life, the brawler Jake has turned his back on the family. He has found in Rita, a new partner, but continues to live by his wits and to frequent McClutchy's bar. Here, between one drink and another, he discovers that his son Nig has been killed in a fight between gangs.
notes: After the success of "Once Were Warriors", a sequel was to be expected. What's up? Nothing that is not known already. The story is cumbersome and the film without quality.

title: Blade
actors: Wesley Snipes, Stephen Dorff, Kris Kristofferson, N'Bushe Wright
description: Unbeknownst to everyone, vampires have slowly introduced themselves to various levels of society and act in finance and politics. Together Blade and Abraham embark on a bloody crusade to defeat them and free the city from their creepy grip. With the help of Abraham, Blade, half man, half vampire, uncovers the diabolical secret of their leader, Deacon Frost, who is preparing for the day when he will take over all vampires to take over the world.
notes: Based on the comic by Mark Wolfman, very well written by David S. Goyer ("Dark City"), embellished with make-up by Greg Cannom ("Dracula" by Coppola), produced / performed by Wesley Snipes, notable martial artist, " Blade "tries to create, through the outbursts of" blaxploitation ", a B series of" reformist "fantasy cinema in the" Matrix "style. With more honesty towards the genre and less theoretical resourcefulness. But the director does not grasp the ideas offered by the script, does not value the characters and "runs away" on the fights by cheating with the viewer. Technique is not enough if the plastic sense of form and action is completely missing.

title: Jakob the Liar
actors: Robin Williams, Alan Arkin, Armin Mueller-Stahl, Bob Balaban
description: Jakob lives in the Jewish ghetto of Nazi-occupied Poland. Many members of the community have already been sent to concentration camps. One evening, unjustly accused of violating the curfew, he is taken to the office of the Gestapo commander. Here he happens to hear a banned radio broadcast, announcing the successes of the Red Army over the German forces. Avoiding arrest, Jakob is released from the Command with the first news about the war after years of silence. Since that day he has invented bulletins and dispatches to keep the community's morale high.
notes: The tragicomic strand on the Holocaust ("Life is beautiful" and "Train de vie") is enriched with another chapter. This time it is Robin Williams who reinterprets, in a light way, the days, the folklore, the difficulties in a Jewish ghetto in occupied Poland.

title: October Sky
actors: Jake Gyllenhaal, Chris Cooper, Laura Dern, William Scott Lee, Chris Owen, Natalie Canerday, Chad Lindberg, Kailie Hollister
description: In Coalwood, West Virginia, all the boys are destined to become miners. Too short to get a scholarship for sporting merit, Homer seems to have no chance of escaping his fate. Until one day the Soviet satellite Sputnik crosses the October sky and changes things. So, with the help of three friends, the boy decides to build a rocket and launch it into space.
notes: Incredible but true: this is a story that really happened. Homer Hickman is now an astronaut trainer specializing in Shuttle missions. Johnston's film is a moving, loving tribute to all the utopians in history. Between "Stand by Me" and Cronin-Majano ("And the stars are watching"). And a Tuckerian soul that will make Coppola cry too. Because it is the dream that counts.

title: L'humanité
actors: Emmanuel Schotté, Severine Caneele, Philippe Tullier, Ginette Allegre
description: Pharaon De Winter, a police lieutenant, is a humble and simple man who is used to taking the suffering of others upon himself. Pharaon speaks to a few people and does not address anyone. A bachelor, in his thirties, he lives with his mother in the town of Bailleul. He becomes friends with Domino, a 23-year-old worker, and soon falls in love with her. But Domino has a partner, Joseph. It is with the two of them that Pharaon unleashes his melancholy. Also because he has to investigate the murder of a child ...
notes: Dumont's film, a Special Jury Prize at Cannes, begins with the unbearable image of a ruptured infantile pubis. Dumont is a "filmmaker of the shot", in the sense that his representation superbly privileges the relationship between bodies and spaces. But the fragments of Bressonian rigor have no "breath", in the sense that editing fails to transform the moral tension of the paintings into a narrative discourse. Emanuel Scotté was awarded as best actor, with great scandal.

title: Vacanze di Natale 2000
actors: Massimo Boldi, Christian De Sica, Megan Gale, Nino D'Angelo
description: Christmas, Cortina d'Ampezzo. There is the nice Roman lawyer, Giovanni Covelli, who comes to the mountain resort with his family of women, to take possession of the new chalet that has just been built. In fact, he plans to organize a big party for New Year's Eve in his villa. Despite himself, Ettore Colombo, a real Milanese, is invited to the party with his son who is engaged to Covelli's daughter.
notes: Second-hand cinema, made with the left hand and seasoned with the beauties of the season: miss spot Megan Gale and the "Cuban Cubist" Carmen Electra. This time there is also a concession to philological trash: "Er Cipolla", a miserable clone of "Er Patata".

title: Runaway Bride
actors: Julia Roberts, Richard Gere, Joan Cusack, Hector Elizondo
description: Ike, a reporter from New York, has only an hour to deliver his piece and hears about Maggie, a girl from Maryland who is terrified of a wedding and who runs away in front of the altar. Intrigued, Ike writes an article about Maggie, triggering a chain reaction that leads him to Hale, Maggie's town.
notes: Alchemy, ten years after "Pretty Woman", still works: Richard Gere, a little aged, with wrinkles and gray hair, and Julia Roberts, bundled up in worker's overalls. And the story could work too, despite the predictability. What has been lost is the "mathematical" quality of the packaging, the timing, the iron logic of the script. It seems that in Hollywood it has become enough to put two stars back together on screen, sketch a story, cast character actors, and let things run.

title: Tifosi
actors: Christian De Sica, Diego Abatantuono, Enzo Iacchetti, Nino D'Angelo, Massimo Boldi
description: A Milanese taxi driver is forced to choose between winning his team or a billionaire win at the Totocalcio. A Neapolitan thief is saved by Maradona himself And then there is the fanatic Juventus, and future consuoceri divided by their football faith.
notes: The ancient comedy was made by fighters, widowers, bachelors, seducers, harassed and other social and professional categories, the modern one, signed by Neri Parenti and De Laurentiis, has transversal figures of metropolitan animals, rogues and clowns as protagonists . It is mandatory, in the name of a box office level playing field, to mix dialects, well-known faces from the big and small screen, hypothetical income brackets (doctor, airplane pilot, taxi driver, thief), misunderstandings and strong-flavored dialogues (swear words, jokes fulminating and amusing, distortions of the vocabulary), acting over the top.

title: Kikujiro no natsu
actors: Takeshi Kitano, Yusuke Sekiguchi, Kayoko Kishimoto, Kazuko Yoshiyuki
description: It's summer and Masao is getting bored. The boy lives in Tokyo with his grandmother who works all day. His friends have gone on vacation and the football pitch where he plays with his friends is deserted. Thanks to a friend of his grandmother, Masao meets Kikujiro, a tough fifty-year-old with whom he goes in search of the mother he does not know and who lives near the sea. Kikujiro has some flaws and he is certainly not the right person to accompany Masao on the journey, but he cannot say no to him.
notes: With an eye on Chaplin's "Il monello", revised through the modern tradition of road movie with children, Kitano combines his extraordinary sense of color with his taste for demented comedy and with that melancholy of violence and the loss of the Japanese soul that always meanders in his films. The fable, which is basically not good, but saddened by the image of a mother who has rebuilt a "regular" life, reconciles, at least, the possibility of solidarity between characters who, apparently, should have nothing to do with it. share. Formally blinding, it is capable of visual wonders with the suggestions and flashes generated by the infantile unconscious and by the bizarre one of an adult who lives beyond the threshold of eccentricity.

title: Asini
actors: Claudio Bisio, Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Arnoldo Foà, Fabio De Luigi
description: Italo is a forty year old from Milan who has not grown up and is not in line with the times. Without a steady job, he still lives at home with his mother and aunt and has a girlfriend who is a dog sitter. Fanatic of rugby, he conceives his life only in relation to the team and his teammates; forced to the bench for having reached age limits, he accepts an unlikely position as a teacher of physical education. Thus he finds himself in Romagna in a Franciscan community that collects donkeys.
notes: Between goliardic appearances (Elio, Rocco Tanica, Mastandrea, Catania ...), ironic quotes from "Rocky", "Tex" t-shirts and an ecologism in the wake of "Celentano-Gluck" and "Pozzetto-Saxofone", the film wants to be different: the beautiful screenplay (signed by Bisio with Roberto Traverso and Giorgio Terruzzi) is paired with a brood of comedians, from the tender Giovanna Mezzogiorno to the Ligabuiano (in the sense of the painter) Fabio De Luigi, and to the gruff Ivano Marescotti.

title: The Iron Giant
description: Little Hogart is a little boy who lives in Maine and one day makes the acquaintance of a giant that comes directly from space. The child, after the initial fear, becomes a friend and teacher of the giant with amazing powers. Hogart knows perfectly well that the dull world around him is not ready to welcome his strange friend, and therefore goes to great lengths to keep him safe from prying eyes.
notes: In October 1957, Sputnik flew through its skies, the USSR had the bomb and the Cold War was upon us. This is the scenario of the short story "The Iron Mask" by the English poet Ted Hughes written in 1968 and from which Pete Townshend drew his eponymous rock work in 1993. Townshend's love for Hughes' text has remained unchanged, so much so that it has become the producer of this animated film. From Hughes' tale, director Brad Bird has made a delightful and moving film, beautifully designed with realistic backgrounds, harnessing the power of CGI computer graphics animation, and launches viewers a heartfelt invitation to tolerance.

title: Le jeu avec le feu
actors: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Philippe Noiret, Anicée Alvina, Sylvia Kristel
description: The banker De Saxe, blackmailed for the not yet kidnapping of his daughter Caroline, listens to the advice of a member of the gang and hides her in a luxury pension. Wandering through the halls, the girl discovers that she is a prisoner of a luxury rendezvous house where young kidnapped women are locked up. Meanwhile, the banker gets in touch with Commissioner Laurent to set a trap for the kidnappers.
notes: The inventor of the "nouveau roman" and founder of the "ècole du regard" gives us a minor work with all the trappings of his school. Too bad that the gaze turns, in this case, into voyeurism.

title: The Intruder
actors: John Hannah, Charlotte Gainsbourg, Charles Powell, Nastassja Kinski
description: In a police station room, Catherine prepares to tell officers how, the previous night, she killed her husband's first wife, Stella. A woman who, according to the police, was also dead two years earlier. It all took place in an isolated building located in the richest districts of the city, where, among other things, Badge a successful antiques dealer, Charlie, a well-known mathematician, and Daisy, who becomes Catherine's confidant. Charlie who has his own theory about the past and the present which, according to him, can coexist simultaneously.
notes: Triumphs of calle in the foreground, a heap of wild jazz, shameless wide-angles. Everything is white, empty, useless; the banal story, with an annoying wink to quantum mechanics. Why does David Bailey have to obscure his history as a photographer by directing a film like this?

title: The Ninth Gate
actors: Johnny Depp, Frank Langella, Lena Olin, Emmanuelle Seigner
description: Dean Corso, a hunter of antique books for collectors, is hired by the famous bibliophile Boris Balkan. His mission is to find the last three copies of a legendary satanic invocation manual and find out which one is the real one. Dean accepts the challenge protected by an angelic creature.
notes: Horror of the most classic this film that Polanski based on the novel "The Dumas Club" by Arturo Perez-Reverte, and which leads through the first two hours as a disturbing and threatening investigation. Then the much criticized ending, where everything explodes: the ritual, the excess. Ridiculous? Maybe: but Polanski has good reason to detest and ridicule any sect.

title: La portiera nuda
actors: Irene Miracle, Erika Blanc, Francesca Romana Coluzzi, Mario Carotenuto
description: Since her mother, a concierge in a Roman building, was injured, the very young Gianna came to temporarily take her place from the province. The tenants of the building represent a real sample of various humanity. They range from the braggart film producer and up to his neck in debt, to the crazy psychoanalyst and the shy and clumsy Mr. Virgili.
notes: An erotic comedy without quality, directed by an author more at ease with horror and not used to frivolity. Erika Blanc in the "lesbian" version and Carotenuto in perennial bill.

title: Popsy Pop
actors: Claudia Cardinale, Stanley Baker, Gaetano Imbrò, George Aminel
description: A young adventurer, Popsy Pop, arrives accompanied by three shady individuals in a Venezuelan village to strike a blow against a diamond company. By circumventing Inspector Silva, Popsy puts his three accomplices in a position to carry out the theft. The adventurer, once in possession of the booty, escapes with her friend Freddie, while her accomplices are attacked by the workers of the company. Popsy reaches Tahiti to place the goods, but someone chases her ....
notes: An unbalanced and slow-paced film, but with a Claudia Cardinale in splendid shape.

title: Maternal Instincts
actors: Malcolm Stewart, Beth Broderick, Delta Burke, Tom Mason
description: Tracy Phillips, a volunteer guard at a hospital nursery, wants to get pregnant. So she begs Stan Phillips, her husband, to take her to Eva Warden, a specialist in infertility. Visiting Tracy, Eva discovers that the woman has a tumor. Stan and Sabrina, Eva's best friend, ask Eva to perform a histerctomy to save Tracy's life. Tracy after the operation, while recovering in her mountain cabin with her husband, discovers that there was an alternative to the operation. A tremendous argument arises between the two and Tracy, in a fit of anger, accidentally kills Stan. Meanwhile, Eva, who has had numerous miscarriages, also attempts to have a baby from her husband, the unemployed architect Gary Warden. Seeking revenge, Tracy breaks into Eva's home and replaces her medicine with cooking oil. Fortunately, Eva discovers the death trap in time, but the resources of the vengeful Tracy don't end there ...

title: Prisoner of Love
actors: Naomi Campbell, Eric Thal, Paul Eves, James Gallanders, Robert Hannah
description: Traci, a girl who works as a bartender, gets an appointment from one of her regular customers. While she is waiting for him, she sees a murder committed. The next day, to his enormous surprise, he finds his photo in all the newspapers. Traci, in fact, is the only witness to what happened. The boss who commissioned the murder orders the killer to eliminate her. But the man, struck by her beauty, can't pull the trigger and so he decides to kidnap her, hoping, in this way, to save her life. The man would like the murder to be soon forgotten and thinks he can rebuild a life alongside Traci.

title: The Gate II: The Trespassers
actors: Louis Tripp, Pamela Segall, James Villemaire, Neil Munro, Simon Reynolds
description: The little boy who in the past had managed to find the (ninth) door of Hell, decides to reopen it and embark on a journey into the other dimension. In fact, he would like to make a pact with the devil: his father is unemployed and alcoholic, and the protagonist asks Satan to heal him and find him a job.
notes: Modest sequel to an equally modest B-grade horror, "The Gate". The plot, however, is curious: a way like any other to solve the problem of unemployment. The Italian title alludes to Tobe Hooper's cult "Don't open that door".

title: Malina
actors: Isabelle Huppert, Mathieu Carrière, Can Togay, Peter Kern, Lisa Kreuzer, Isolde Barth, Fritz Schediwy, Libgart Schwarz, Elisabeth Krejcir, Lolita Chammah, Wiebke Frost
description: A neurotic writer (Huppert) has problems with her husband (Carrière) who she is completely under. So she tries to indulge in numerous extramarital affairs and comes to dream or to set fire to (?) The apartment in which she lives with the man.
notes: Werner Schroeter does not do the text by Ingeborg Bachman a good service even if in the episode of the real or alleged fire of the apartment he shows that he has a good visionary flair. The screenplay is signed by Elfriede Jelinek and abounds with high-sounding phrases. In a manner of speaking, the interpretation of Isabelle Huppert in the role of his wife.

title: Top Sensation
actors: Edwige Fenech, Rosalba Neri, Eva Thulin, Maud de Bellereche
description: A very rich woman first believes that her beloved son has some sexual disorder, then she even discovers that he is a probable serial killer. Before anyone begins to suspect the young man, the rich woman decides to stage a perfect crime aboard a yacht full of girls ...
notes: Cult object for a whole generation of lovers of the erotic made in Italy. A scene of Sapphic love between Edwige Fenech and Rosalba Neri greatly impressed the sixty-eight people who were more interested in "butt and sword" than in "commitment" films. But the TV version is sadly cut (nine very hot minutes less!).

title: Peccati in famiglia
actors: Michele Placido, Jenny Tamburi, Renzo Montagnani, Simonetta Stefanelli
description: A young Sicilian arrives in Piacenza to visit his uncle. He immediately settles very well at home by reviewing (not only spiritually) all the girls who live around his uncle. Who, in order not to remain "beak" at all costs, decides to show his nephew that he too, despite his maturity, is bubbling with ardor.
notes: A great success of the time, despite Bruno Gaburro being a "de fear" director. A sort of cult-movie for lovers of comedy scollacciata, which also launched Renzo Montagnani as king of the genre. Photograph of the inevitable Massaccesi / Joe D'Amato.

title: Passion of Mind
actors: Stellan Skarsgård, Demi Moore, Sinead Cusack, Matthew Beisner
description: Marty is a charming New York literary agent, single, childless who can't fall in love; Marie is a literary critic, lives in a small village near Menton in France, is a widow with two little girls and is no longer able to see a man. Finally Marty and Marie fall in love but they have a problem: they are the same person and their lives that take shape during the dream, both seem terribly real.
notes: Co-produced by Moore herself, the film is tailored to her and often the director gives up even the reverse shots to stay glued to her face, which is beginning to show some signs of aging. Too bad that the same dedication was not used for the script, lost in the paths of his existence.

title: The Astronaut's Wife
actors: Johnny Depp, Charlize Theron, Nick Cassavetes, Joe Morton, Clea DuVall, Donna Murphy, Samantha Eggar, Gary Grubbs, Blair Brown, Tom Noonan, Tom O'Brien, Lucy Lin, Michael Crider
description: While participating in a space mission defined by his routine superiors, Spencer loses consciousness and miraculously returns home alive. As the nation and the American president celebrate his return, his wife Jillian realizes that there is something different about him. Though deeply in love with him, Jillian can't stop wondering what happened in space. The situation worsens when Spencer's mission partner and his wife lose their lives in a freak accident.
notes: It was probably since the glitzy days of Mickey Rourke's free fall into soft-kitsch cinema that you haven't seen such a bad film: triumphantly banal, shot with voluptuous redundancy, played with embarrassing (but not embarrassed) amateurism.

title: Bowfinger
actors: Eddie Murphy, Steve Martin, Heather Graham, Christine Baranski
description: Bowfinger is a failed director-producer. Kit, on the other hand, is an action star, billionaire, paranoid, affiliated with a sect that should enlighten the mind and ensure - at a high price - serenity. Jiff is the shy brother of the star. When the filmmaker, who has never made it to Hollywood, reads the script for the film "Stubborn Rain", he decides to invest his life savings, film the star without his knowledge and hire his brother to produce his masterpiece. .
notes: This new chapter of metacinema has its own tangled and unfinished pleasantness thanks to actors in a state of grace and lines like "even Tom Cruise didn't know he was in that vampire movie."

title: Bringing Out the Dead
actors: Nicolas Cage, Patricia Arquette, John Goodman, Tom Sizemore
description: New York, early nineties, an ambulance whizzes through the streets of the city with loud sirens. On board is Frank Pierce, a paramedic of the EMS (Emergency Medical Service) who, together with his colleagues, is forced to face the "spectacle" of death every night. Always surrounded by dead and wounded, Frank lives in the nocturnal universe of the metropolis, crushed by the weight of so many years spent saving lives or watching people die. It is the ghosts of the people he failed to save that disturb Frank and appear to him from time to time.
notes: The film, raw and visionary at the same time, is a perennial hallucination, but built with the most concrete human materials. Scorsese indulges in guilt, absorbs it, lets it explode outside with a helpless fury. He too (with the screenwriter Paul Schrader) seems a soul in the balance, also suspended, like Frank, on the New York sky, supporting a drug dealer stuck in a gate, while the scythes of the blowtorch become fireworks.

title: Ça commence aujourd'hui
actors: Philippe Torreton, Maria Pitarresi, Nadia Kaci, Françoise Bette
description: Daniel, a man in his fifties, is a teacher and runs the Hernaing kindergarten near Valenciennes. The town's population is made up of former miners. Daniel loves his job, but feels trapped by the hierarchy. He has to limit himself to teaching the basic disciplines, while his pupils arrive in the classroom hungry and in tattered clothes. But Daniel, the son of a miner, decides to rebel against this state of affairs.
notes: Tavernier manages to frame sections of the social fabric with a mobile, restless but never nervous camera. The cinema machine, the professional actors (above all Philippe Torreton), the conventions of fiction react, chemically, with probable events of difficult children and parents, good for the canteen, slowness of public assistance, family suicides, alcoholism, didactic tenderness , miserable homes, school parties. Without rhetoric.

title: Resurrection
actors: Christopher Lambert, Robert Joy, David Cronenberg, James Kidnie
description: Detective John Prudhomme is investigating a terrible murder case. The victim is a man whose arm was amputated by the killer at shoulder level. Despite the sadness and hardships of his private life, he lost his young son in an accident and is in a crisis with his wife, John dedicates himself body and soul to the case. Meanwhile, the murderer killed another man and buried him under the turf of the botanical garden.
notes: Mulcahy loves to build epic images. Unfortunately for him "Resurrection" is not the right opportunity to come back, because the script is weak and implausible. Cronenberg's cameo as a priest.

title: Last Night
actors: Don McKellar, David Cronenberg, Geneviève Bujold, Sandra Oh
description: There are only a few hours to the end of the world, but humanity doesn't seem to be too upset. Also because two months have now passed since the day the news was announced and the population has gradually absorbed the shock. Now the last evening has arrived and Patrick is trying to escape a family dinner that his parents have organized to spend a last Christmas as it should be. Craig has a long line of sexual fantasies to enact before the world disappears.
notes: "Last Night" is the Canadian episode of the "2000 vu par ..." series produced by the French. The director, screenwriter, protagonist, is a well-known actor in his homeland at his directorial debut. Iconographically convincing, linguistically not very vibrant, without real jolts of the heart. Perhaps the modest budget limited the visionary potential, perhaps the author was interested in this alienated approach. However, there is talent, especially in writing.

title: eXistenZ
actors: Jennifer Jason Leigh, Ian Holm, Jude Law, Don McKellar
description: eXistenZ, a game based on advanced technologies created by the executives of Antenna Research, has been a great success with the public. Behind the game lies the ingenuity of Allegra Geller, a determined and attractive woman. What makes eXistenZ so real is the fact that the device that drives it, the game pod, plugs directly into the player's nervous system via a spinal connector. But anti-eXistenZ forces, who have put a bounty on Allegra's head, sabotage the game.
notes: As in "Crash", we are in a no man's land, one step beyond the daily perception. Everyone plays, in an increasingly dizzying interlocking of Chinese boxes, and drags the viewer into an identical sensation of indeterminacy. Inside and outside the film, outside and inside the neighboring realities that refer to the parallel worlds of Philiph Dick, to the art of storytelling itself.

title: Summer of Sam
actors: Ben Gazzara, John Leguizamo, Adrien Brody, Mira Sorvino
description: Sam's summer is that of New York in 1977, when a scorching heat tore the nervous system and the character of the inhabitants of the city. During a blackout, thieves and looters plunder the city. But the real terror spreads when a mysterious psychopath wanders the night streets killing at random with a .44 caliber.
notes: Lee puts "the son of Sam" (as the killer was nicknamed) at the center of a complex story, a hard and stringent analysis of the relationships between men and women, between groups of friends and relatives. Guided by music, sunk in the opaque darkness of the night, with a keen eye on colors, gestures, slang, Spike Lee constructs a clear (and very topical) portrait of the run-up to intolerance.

title: Astérix et Obélix contre César
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Christian Clavier, Roberto Benigni, Laetitia Casta
description: Lucius Detritus, Caesar's right hand man and governor of Gaul is carrying out all sorts of infamy in the region. Why so much agitation? Lucius is doing his best to get his hands on the magic potion that has the power to make Asterix and his companions invincible. After replacing none other than Caesar, Lucius has the druid Panoramix kidnapped, the only custodian of the magic formula. But when he tastes the potion prepared by the druid he will have a bitter surprise.
notes: Thirty albums, 280 million copies sold in 77 countries: these are the numbers of the strips of "Asterix", a creature of the Uderzo-Goscinny couple that finally lands on the big screen in flesh and blood (with animated drawings it is already finished). The result of the direct transposition by the solid craftsman Zidi and produced by the actor-director Claude Berri is not exciting, also because translating comic illusions into "real" images is almost impossible. There remain some faces of Benigni, the tenderness of Obelix-Depardieu, the attractiveness of the Casta, the horror tricks of Giannetto De Rossi (Fulci school) and a bit of that sixty-eight atmosphere that reigns in the Gallic village besieged by the Romans, between free love and free will.

title: Vacanze sulla neve
actors: Attilio Fontana, Laura Chiatti, Alessia Merz, Mario Parodi, Guido Nicheli, Melina Molinari
description: In a hotel in Courmayeur, guests of various types and from various social backgrounds meet. Among them stands an aged scammer who tries to pretend to be a countess. A girl accompanies her who is none other than her daughter. The group is joined by two singers with high hopes who are trying to break into the world of pop music.
notes: After a few years of silence Mariano Laurenti reappears with a comedy that remembers the legendary "musicarelli" from afar, in a sort of return to the past for someone who has worked with Nino D'Angelo, Bobby Solo and Caterina Caselli. A film where even the snow is rotten and tastes of old.

title: Night Ride Home
actors: Rebecca De Mornay, Keith Carradine, Ellen Burstyn, Thora Birch, Jordan Brower
description: Nora and Neal live on a beautiful farm with their two children, Simon and Clea. Everyone in the family, with the exception of Neal, has a passion for horses. Unfortunately for Simon the love of horses will prove fatal. The boy, in fact, during a ride falls ruinously and dies. Of course, the void left by Simon in his family is unbridgeable.
notes: Good cast for a tear-jerking movie.

title: Austin Powers: The Spy Who Shagged Me
actors: Mike Myers, Heather Graham, Elizabeth Hurley, Michael York, Robert Wagner, Rob Lowe, Seth Green, Verne Troyer, Mindy Sterling
description: While, in 1999, he is spending his honeymoon, Austin discovers that Doctor Evil has been catapulted into the fabulous sixties. Its main purpose is to take possession of its powerful sexual charge. Austin goes back to the past to try to save his mojo. To his aid runs the sensual CIA agent, Felicity Ladà.
