notes: Austin Powers, in the second and wild chapter of his cinematic life, confirms his extraordinary nature as an "idiot". A temporal paradox, a vertigo of meditated vulgarity in which Sellers dances with the Marx brothers, John Belushi's physiological and verbal incontinence marries Richard Lester's figurative poetics.

title: The 13th Warrior
actors: Antonio Banderas, Vladimir Kulich, Dennis Storhøi, Daniel Southern
description: Ahmed Ibn Fahdlan was born in the city of Baghdad which, in 922, represents the cradle of civilization. The courtier falls in love with the sultan's woman and as punishment is sent along with his mentor Melchisidek as an emissary to the Viking population. Here he discovers that they are seriously threatened by a tribe of cannibals and that he is the elusive thirteenth warrior the Vikings are waiting for.
notes: From Michael Crichton's book "Death Eaters" McTiernan and Crichton himself (producer) have made a film that is sometimes funny but not very exciting. It seems that on the set the director clashed with the novelist-producer. Smothered by a deluxe Hollywood packaging and a fashion "mud" aesthetic, the film never finds its way to the barbaric heart of cinema.

title: Fight Club
actors: Brad Pitt, Edward Norton, Helena Bonham Carter, Jared Leto, Meat Loaf, Zach Grenier, Rachel Singer, Thom Gossom Jr., Peter Iacangelo, Christina Cabot, David Andrews, Richmond Arquette
description: A boy can no longer sleep. What to do? Attending all the anti-disease therapeutic courses: there a cry is always remedied. Then, in his life, Marla and Tyler stumble, a woman and a man adrift, she looking for someone or something to move her, he organizer of a Fight Club where he can beat himself up to feel alive and important.
notes: Surprising and become a cult even among the very young (back then), Fight Club introduces Fincher and Norton to the general public and consecrates Brad Pitt as not only physical but also mental stars. There are those who find it disappointing due to the narrative mess, but it is impossible for anyone not to remember the fights and the surprise for a truly new Bonham Carter.

title: The Baby Maker
actors: Barbara Hershey, Colin Wilcox-Horne, Sam Groom, Scott Glenn
description: Jay and Suzanne, two wealthy spouses, deeply in love with each other, would like to crown their marriage with the birth of an heir. Unfortunately, Suzanne is sterile and the couple is opposed to adoption. The two mutually decide to "use" a girl willing to mate with Jay. Thanks to the help of an intermediary, they meet Tish who has already had a child from whom, however, she immediately got rid of.
notes: Disappointing first feature by James Bridges that focuses on the burning nature of the story. In fact, the film caused quite a stir, but it left no traces.

title: The Mississippi Gambler
actors: Tyrone Power, Piper Laurie, Julie Adams, John McIntire, Dennis Weaver
description: Mark is an avid gambler who, aboard a boat on the Mississippi wins a large sum against Laurent, brother of the beautiful Angelique. The girl's father would be very happy to have Mark as his son-in-law. It happens, however, that Laurent falls in love, unrequited with Anna, protected by Mark. In retaliation, Laurent pits his sister against Mark and challenges him to a duel, but in the fight he behaves like a coward, provoking the reaction of his father who throws him out of the house.
notes: Usual ingredients of an adventure film. Tyrone Power certainly had better roles. Discreet made spectacular.

title: Rififi ad Amsterdam
actors: Roger Browne, Aida Power, Umberto Raho, Frank Liston, Michael Rivers
description: In Amsterdam, a company that deals with the sale of diamonds suffers a theft by a gang. When the criminals, who acted on commission, show up to deliver the diamonds and receive the agreed fee, they are eliminated. Of the group only Rex saves who sets out in search of the perpetrators of the massacre. He is approached by a certain Waldco who instructs him to bring the box full of diamonds to Spain.
notes: Despite a good start, Grieco's film, who goes by the name of Terence Hathaway, gets lost along the way wanting to accumulate too many ingredients.

title: Les feux de la chandeleur
actors: Annie Girardot, Bernard Fresson, Gabriella Boccadoro, Claude Jade
description: Marie Louise and Alexandre tell their children Laura and Jean-Paul that they want to separate. The main cause of the serious disagreements lies in the activity in the Communist Party of the woman which hinders both the education of the children and the activity of the husband's notary. Ten years pass and Alexandre, having obtained a divorce, has remarried, while Marie Louise has given up political activity. The woman lives in the hope of returning to her ex-husband with whom she is still deeply in love.
notes: Intimate drama in which they emerge with a good Girardot. Good music by Michel Legrand.

title: La Passion Béatrice
actors: Bernard-Pierre Donnadieu, Julie Delpy, Niels Tavernier, Monique Chaumette
description: In the early 1300s a French gentleman left his castle to go to war. Little François doesn't have time to greet the parent who catches his mother in bed with her lover. The kid doesn't think twice and kills the man. Grown up, François goes to war, accompanied by his son Arnaud, leaving his wife and daughter Beatrice at home. The two, after four years of imprisonment, return home and François, who falls in love with his daughter, rapes her.
notes: Inspired by the "Beatrice Cenci" of Riccardo Freda, then a friend of Tavernier, a complex but fascinating melodrama. The medieval setting is rigorous, based on the son of Jacques Le Goff.

title: Son tornate a fiorire le rose
actors: Walter Chiari, Valentina Cortese, Luciano Salce, Macha Meril
description: The birth of a nephew upsets the life of Paolo and Carlo who, unable to age, try to prove that they are lively. Paul gives himself up to adultery, while Carlo asks for help from the latest discoveries of science.
notes: Comedy that would like to be customary but ends in farce without having anything transgressive.

title: Haunting
actors: Liam Neeson, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Lili Taylor, Owen Wilson
description: Doctor Marrow, fascinated by what is said about Hill House, under the pretext of conducting scientific research on sleep disorders, gathers three young people in the house. Theo, an apparently self-confident researcher, Nell who proves to have particular psychic skills and the cynical Luke who does not believe in the experiments that the doctor is conducting. When ghosts begin to peep, terror spares no one.
notes: This film by Jan De Bont owes a lot to Roger Corman (which owes very little to Robert Wise's beautiful "Gli possati", if not the subject, inspired by the same novel). But Corman worked with stylization and profound irony and a disturbing vision of the subterranean things of the world in his films. Instead, De Bont works with spectacular emphasis and deep silky ghosts, footprints of bloody feet and a huge evil presence that seems to come out of "Fantasia". The special effects eat the soul of the film and turn it into a dizzying bandwagon.

title: Mio padre monsignore
actors: Lino Capolicchio, Giancarlo Giannini, Barbara Bach, Marisa Merlini
description: In 1870 Orlando, a commoner, presumed the son of a monsignor and a prostitute, befriends Carlo Alberto, a Piedmontese bersagliere who claims to be the son of the king of Italy and of a peasant woman. The friendship between the two threatens to crack when Carlo Alberto is surprised by Orlando in the company of his sister Chiara. Since Carlo Alberto no longer gives news of himself and since he took part in the battle for the conquest of Rome he is believed dead by Chiara and Orlando.
notes: Typical example of popular Roman comedy with grotesque and caricature tones. However not to be thrown away.

title: Gardenia il giustiziere della mala
actors: Franco Califano, Martin Balsam, Robert Webber, Eleonora Vallone
description: The boss of the Roman bad Gardenia, owner of a well-known restaurant and manager of clandestine gambling dens, maintains a certain old-fashioned code of honor. And it does not accept drugs being traded on its territory. The mafiosi of the capital, for this, declare war without quarter.
notes: Franco Califano mimicking Bogart is really worth seeing. Other than the Piotta, other than the Verdone of the good times: the singer remains the only ruler of the DOC coatti. Among the side starlets a bewildered Lory Del Santo and a much more convincing Eleonora Vallone.

title: Fiori del destino - Sorrisi asmatici parte 1
actors: Lucas Belvaux, Ines De Medeiros, Lou Castel, Ivano Marescotti
description: De Bernardi offers us the first part of a film about travelers arriving from the water with the exception of Lou Vent. All the characters are driven by the desire for mutation and, unaware of the places they visit, cross the earth and transform themselves at the same time. These strange creatures, a sort of sirens and sirens, slowly turn into human persons.
notes: Tonino De Bernardi's film, an appreciated avant-garde author, competing in the Venice exhibition in 1999 with "Appassionate", is the first part of the trilogy that the Piedmontese author has enigmatically titled "Asthmatic smiles".

title: Io amo Andrea
actors: Francesco Nuti, Francesca Neri, Agathe De La Fontaine, Novello Novelli, Simona Caparrini, Francesca De Rose, Giulia Weber, Giorgio Francesco Palombi, Novello Novelli, Pinuccia Alfieri
description: Dado is a forty-year-old veterinarian, divorced and with a love life to fix. When he lets himself be seduced by a very young girl who drags him into a passionate love story, he has a bitter surprise. The girl is engaged to another woman and Dado is forced to deal not with a rival, but with a rival. The vet, at this point, finds himself reluctantly having to review his views on the female world.
notes: In the film the psychological progression is zeroed, the emotional level of the characters is pre-adolescent, the narrative material was enough for half an hour, unnecessarily dilated by showy carts and embarrassing performances by Nuti (who dances "Singin 'in the Rain").

title: Anna and the King
actors: Jodie Foster, Chow Yun-fat, Bai Ling, Tom Felton
description: Anna, a young English teacher, widow for almost two years, arrives at the court of King Mongkut: fifty-eight children to be educated together with their legitimate wives and about twenty concubines. But, day after day Anna will be able to start the modernization of Siam and open a small breach in the heart of the king.
notes: For half a century, Hollywood and the theatrical scenes have felt a fatal attraction for a plot scented with platonic love and spiced with the luxury of the East (this Victorian fairy tale already had three different versions). Markets, temples, palaces, gardens, rivers, banquets, waltzes, National Geographic photographic style, glossy folklore are the sumptuous and cumbersome frame of a personal relationship in which the frictions between two civilizations, the brutality of colonialism and the nostalgic foreboding of a world that starts at sunset. Jodie Foster is not in shape and communicates an unusual chill and from Chow Yun-Fat the viewer waits in vain for an energetic gesture.

title: Jeanne d'Arc
actors: Milla Jovovich, Dustin Hoffman, John Malkovich, Faye Dunaway
description: In the village of Domrémy, 13-year-old Joan of Arc has strange visions and hears a voice urging her to save France and help Charles VII. He therefore decides to go before the heir to the throne. His arrival and his claim to speak in the name of God cause a sensation. Charles VII himself, fascinated by the prospect of success, puts her at the head of an army with which he besieges Orleans.
notes: A truly "Luc Besson-like" film, with the "Klauskinsian" Milla Jovovich as an accomplice, who has the immoderate ambition to compete with frankly bulky models of the past (from Dreyer to Rivette, from Ingrid Bergman to Sandrine Bonnaire) without hesitation and fear. Some sequences refer to "Braveheart", Kurosawa and the Herzog of "Aguirre", accompanied by the epic and emphatic music of Eric Serra and, in the end, thanks - very "jet set" - to Madonna, Sting and wife, Kassovitz and Kounen. An "d'Arc de Triomphe" always poised between research and fashion.

title: The Alibi
actors: Tori Spelling, Jason Brooks, Kevin Smith, Laurie Holden, Ken Camroux
description: Marti Gerrard is a ski champion who, due to a bad fall, is confined to bed with a fractured leg. During one of the boring days he has to spend at home, he gets a call from Connor O'Neill who, in reality, has the wrong number and is looking for another person. Marti feels lonely and begins to make friends with the stranger. The phone calls continue at an incessant pace and the friendship between the two soon turns into something more intimate. But the situation is completely turned upside down when Connor's wife and business partner is murdered and the first suspicions fall on him.

title: Comedian Harmonists
actors: Ben Becker, Heino Ferch, Ulrich Noethen, Heinrich Schafmeister
description: In 1927 the young Harry Frommerman had a dream: to create a musical group in old Germany in the style of the famous American "The Revellers". An ad in the newspaper and Harry's adventure begins and he immediately finds five companions willing to embark on a risky adventure with him. In the years of the great German crisis, which decreed the advent of Nazism, the group with its sound that merged classical music with popular, met a resounding success. But it will be precisely the advent of Nazism to decree the end of the group, because three of the six members were Jews.
notes: A light but never banal film that underlines the colossal error of evaluation of civil society, even of the Jews themselves who thought they were protected by their patriotism, which allowed Hitler to come to power undisturbed.

title: Yi ge dou bu neng shao
actors: Wei Minzhi, Zhang Huike, Tian Zhenda, Gao Enman, Sun Zhimei
description: Master Gao who teaches at Shuiquan elementary school is forced to take a month's leave to assist his sick mother. The village mayor chooses Wei to replace him during his absence. Wei, however, is only thirteen years old and does not collect the confidence of the teacher because she is considered unable to keep the overly turbulent class at bay. Gao, given the need in which he finds himself, is forced to accept the situation. So all he has to do is warn Wei: no pupil entrusted to him must withdraw.
notes: The tender story of Wei Minzhi reveals the gap, the distance between two realities. The teacher with the red chalk behaves and moves as if she were in another era and does not give up. The film won the Golden Lion in Venice in 1999.

title: Garage Olimpo
actors: Antonella Costa, Carlos Echeverria, Chiara Caselli, Dominique Sanda
description: Maria, a nineteen-year-old militant teacher lives with her mother Diane in a slum. Economic difficulties led the woman to rent some rooms in the house. One is occupied by Félix, a shy boy in love with Maria. The girl who works in an organization that opposes the Argentine dictatorship will be betrayed by Félix and will be taken to the "Garage Olimpo", a frightening place where prisoners are tortured by any means before being sent to their deaths.
notes: Of Italian nationality, Bechis was born in Santiago de Chile and lived a few years in Argentina, where he really experienced the terrible experiences narrated in this second (after "Alambrado", in 1987) and dry film. An exemplary and necessary work, which manages - despite the serious and suffocating theme - to catch rivulets of poetry (the dramatic final sequence), to present an actress that we would like to see again (Antonella Costa) and another who has made us pleasure to meet again (Dominique Sanda).

title: I 4 monaci
actors: Peppino De Filippo, Aldo Fabrizi, Nino Taranto, Erminio Macario
description: Two criminals find a way to make ends meet: they hire two other cronies and, disguised as monks, they show up in a convent. Fra Giocondo, Fra Martino, Fra Domenico and Fra Peppino, protected by a much feared gangster in the area (in reality he is one of the three who disguised himself as an Italian-American mafia) are given away by the inhabitants of the town every good thing. he also scored a blackmail, threatening to involve the family of a well-known baron in the village in a scandal.
notes: Comedian with a predictable canvas, which gives some appreciable numbers (Nino Taranto speaking in Sicilian, Macario eating an imaginary Agnolotti dish). The best is Peppino.

title: Le quattro verità
directors: Luis Garcia Berlanga, René Clair, Hervé Bromberger, Alessandro Blasetti
actors: Hardy Krüger, Charles Aznavour, Michel Serrault, Monica Vitti
description: "Death and the executioner": a musician who works on street corners, tired of life, tries to commit suicide. A woman and a man intervene and make him change his mind. "The two pigeons": love breaks out between a man and a woman who were closed by pure chance in an apartment. "The crow and the fox": a man jealous of his wife enters into business with those who would like to take her away from him. "The hare and the game": a woman undergoes various vicissitudes in order to win back her unfaithful husband.
notes: The various episodes, inspired by La Fontaine's fables, are wrong in not retaining the strength of the moral apologue.

title: Fischia il sesso
actors: Rita Tushingham, Aldo Maccione, Leopoldo Trieste, Mario De Vecchi
description: Carol, a girl with poor physical abilities, is looking for a soul mate in New York who appreciates her moral qualities. After various and desperate unsuccessful attempts, Carol seems to find a solution to her problems thanks to the help of the Lewis agency: she is proposed to marry Gavino, a Sardinian clandestine, who with the marriage certificate in hand could obtain citizenship American. When the immigration office intervenes declaring the marriage null and void, Carol - who has now fallen in love with Gavino - does everything to avoid his repatriation ...
notes: Comedy with good actors, but rather fragile.

title: L'isola delle svedesi
actors: Catherine Diamant, Ewa Green, Nino Segurini, Wolfgang Hillinger
description: Manuela, abandoned her boyfriend Maurizio after a hard quarrel, reaches Eleonora, a divorced friend, on a wild island of meditarreaneo. Between the two women a morbid feeling was born that not even Maurizio's arrival, who came to recover his wife, seems capable of interrupting. Fought among the attraction for the friend and love for Maurizio, Manuela seems to decide to follow her husband, but Eleonora is not willing to yield.
notes: Among the first lesbian theme films of Italian genre cinema. Quite pushed for the time, and therefore inevitably cut for his television passage.

title: Friday the 13th, Part V: A New Beginning
actors: John Shepherd, Melanie Kinnaman, Shavar Ross, Richard Young
description: Jason was torn apart in Joseph Zito's "Friday the 13th: Final Chapter" which, evidently, was not the final chapter at all. In fact, the murders start again as before, but this time under the infamous hockey mask there could be another madman.
notes: Fifth episode of the series, particularly flat and effective.

title: Les couloirs du temps - Les visiteurs 2
actors: Christian Clavier, Jean Reno, Muriel Robin, Marie-Anne Chazel
description: Goffredo, Count of Montmirail, prepares to celebrate his wedding with Fremebonda di Pouille when the Duke, his father, interrupts the preparations for the ceremony. Someone has stolen his jewels, and worse, the precious relic of Santa Rolanda, which ensures fertility for the women of the house. The "booty" remained in the present with Jeancoion, squire of Goffredo and Ginette. The fact prevents the corridors of time from closing.
notes: A blockbuster in France, the film unsurprisingly retraces the structure of the first film. The ultracommercial cinema across the Alps is a scoundrel like ours, but at least it doesn't choose to mimic the TV. Of course the Italian dubbing mortifies the jokes (but Stefano Masciarelli-Clavier is very good), some stereotypes (gay ...) are to be barracks and the refrain of the stove "stink of feet". The young Marie Guillard (Philippine) is splendid.

title: Appassionate
actors: Anna Bonaiuto, Ines De Medeiros, Iaia Forte, Galatea Ranzi
description: Naples 1929: Michele discovers that his wife Gilda is cheating on him with her best friend and kills her in a movie theater. Spanish Quarters, nowadays: Rosa's sister, Caterina, kills her beloved Oreste with a pistol when she discovers that he is about to marry Teresa.
notes: The Turin-born De Bernardi seems to think of her as the protagonists of the film "tragic love" which serves as a prologue set at the end of the 1920s: "There is no life without love!". But "love" is always threatened: by betrayal, by "matters of honor", by inevitable developments that men and women cannot manage. The Naples of "Appassionate" - a melò that reinvents Pasolini, Truffaut and "theatrical cinema" - is experienced and shown as a prison of the soul, in turn a prisoner of a tradition. With twenty-three great songs from / in the purest Neapolitan tradition.

title: Dance Me to My Song
actors: Heather Rose, Joey Kennedy, Rena Owen, John Brumpton
description: The center of courage is Julia, a spastic girl condemned by the disease to have to depend on others and in particular on Madaleine, her social worker. Madeleine, however, a victim of her inconsistent love affairs and unable to feel any feelings, is a psychotic only able to unload her frustrations on the weakest. Julia, on the contrary, despite communicating only through a sophisticated vocal computer, transmits an extraordinary desire for life and love to others.
notes: On the relationship between Julia and Madeleine, Rolf De Heer, former director of "Bud Boy Bubby", sets up a sophisticated lesson on the concept of normality. Written and starring the revelation Heather Rose, the film doesn't make her a freak or an object of pity, but a dramatic character who talks about her daily needs and pain, with a dignity that gives her a captivating charm. characters and spectators.

title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
actors: Kevin Kline, Michelle Pfeiffer, Rupert Everett, Stanley Tucci
description: Hermia is in love with Lysander, but her father would like her to marry Demetrius who, instead, loves his friend Elena. To mix everything with magic filters and other devilry is the elf Puck who also makes Titania, the queen of the fairies fall in love with Bottom, the craftsman who has magically sprouted a donkey's head.
notes: Since 1935, no one had dared to try, apart from Bergman, Allen and Salvatores, the adaptation of the Shakespearean fable par excellence, that "A Midsummer Night's Dream" populated by fairies and elves, transformations and quarrels of lovers. Then a genius of the Mittle European theater did it, Max Reinhardt, today in the new all star version everyone is limited to acting, but no one seems to believe in fairy tales anymore.

title: Bye Bye, Love
actors: Paul Reiser, Janeane Garofalo, Matthew Modine, Randy Quaid, Janeane Garofalo, Paul Reiser, Eliza Dushku
description: Three close friends find themselves at some point all divorced. Their misadventures begin between ex-wives and especially children. Dave becomes an avid womanizer. Donny is unable to accept the new situation and continues to think about his ex-wife. Vic, on the other hand, declares an all-out war on his ex-wife and her new boyfriend.
notes: A slender comedy that trivializes some aspects of life as a single that are quite significant. Despite the truth of certain social insights, cinematic consistency is lacking. In a minor but tasty role (the radio host), director Rob Reiner.

title: Black & White
actors: Gina Gershon, Alison Eastwood, Ron Silver, Rory Cochrane
description: A rookie and an experienced cop. Indeed, to be precise, an experienced "policewoman". Together they investigate the crimes of a serial killer who strikes relentlessly, in the shadows, disguised as a public security officer. All the suspects arrested, once released, are found killed. And the suspicions of murder fall right on our expert "cop" ...
notes: A television thriller starring Alison, daughter of Clint, in a co-starring role. The production is what it is, the suspense as well, but Gina Gershon 105 minutes in front of the small screen is worth it from first to last.

title: Simone e Matteo, un gioco da ragazzi
actors: Paul Smith, Michael Coby, Dominic Barto, Giuliana Calandra
description: Burly Simone and thin Matteo, lost chicken thieves, absolute enemies of work and wary of policemen, albeit reluctant, agree to bring a load of insecticide canisters to Marseille. In reality the load is of weapons and the two realize it only when they are targeted by Frou Frou's gang.
notes: Taking advantage of the success of the Hill / Spencer couple, Carmineo enlists two strangers and attempts the clone. Uselessly.

title: Ciakmull
actors: Leonard Mann, Woody Strode, Peter Martell, Luca Montefiori
description: Ciakmull, a man who does not remember anything of his past life, escapes from the nursing home where he is hospitalized and heads to the city of Osaka, to which he feels bound by vague memories. Here he is recognized by Udo who recognizes in him the traits of his brother and who pushes him to kill Caldwell, an elderly head of a rival family. Before he can carry out the crime, Ciakmull discovers that the predestined victim is, in reality, his father and that Udo, taking advantage of his amnesia, has put in place a plan to eliminate Caldwell.
notes: Spaghetti western directed by E. B. Clucher who became famous thanks to the films of Terence Hill and Bud Spencer.

title: Bisturi, la mafia bianca
actors: Gabriele Ferzetti, Enrico Maria Salerno, Senta Berger
description: The head of a specialized clinic, instead of keeping the Hippocratic oath, speculates cruelly about the (bad) health of patients. An honest colleague tries to reveal the professor's double face but ends up stuck in the "dome" of the white coats. But one day, the very powerful doctor discovers that he is himself sick and that he needs health care ...
notes: An ideal sequel, as well as a sort of dark and morbid reworking of _The doctor of the mutual society_. Zampa does all he can in this very harsh indictment against the medical system, at times even raising the tone and the shot excessively.

title: Ride Lonesome
actors: Randolph Scott, Karen Steele, Lee Van Cleef, James Coburn
description: An unscrupulous outlaw kills a former sheriff's wife. Which does not remain idle and kidnaps the brother of the bandit, hoping to be able to use him as bait. During his journey, the former sheriff meets a widow and two fugitives who want to bring the prisoner to justice in order to obtain an amnesty.
notes: Splendid B-series western, dusty and rough like the expressionless face of the monolithic Randolph Scott. In its own way, a masterpiece of the genre for its dry style of script (by Burt Kennedy). And as if that weren't good enough on its own, "The Tree of Vengeance" also marks the debut of James Coburn.

title: Westbound
actors: Randolph Scott, Virginia Mayo, Karen Steele
description: As the Civil War ensues, a northern officer is given a particularly dangerous assignment. He must cross enemy lines to transport a shipment of California gold to his headquarters. Of course, the Confederates won't make his life easy.
notes: Western all action by the great Budd Boetticher. Without his usual screenwriter Burt Kennedy, the director skims the plot more as a function of the adventure. In addition to fetish actor Randolph Scott, Karen Scott, who is also the filmmaker's wife, also returns. But the real surprise is Virginia Mayo!

title: El precio de un hombre
actors: Richard Wyler, Tomas Milian, Ella Karin, Hugo Blanco, Mario Brega
description: Eden manages to get the bloodthirsty outlaw José Faradin to escape, while he is about to be taken to prison. Luke, a bounty hunter who is stalking Eden, is on the trail of José, convinced that the outlaw is hiding in her house. His intuitions are true, but when the bounty killer is about to get his hands on José, the local population intervenes and manages to reverse the situation.
notes: First spaghetti western starring Tomas Milian, also entitled "Death follows you ... but in no hurry". Not as nice as "If you're alive shoot", a little later, but quite original.

title: Catch-22
actors: Alan Arkin, Martin Balsam, Richard Benjamin, Art Garfunkel
description: During the Second World War, the American air force captain Yossarian, obsessed with the idea of ??being able to lose his life in the course of one of the many flight missions, tries to pass himself off for crazy. But, unfortunately for him, he is not believed and is forced to see all the absurdities that war inevitably leaves behind: the useless massacres, blind obedience and orders without logic.
notes: Nichols' film, inspired by Jospeh Heller's beautiful novel, is one of the most ferocious and destructive satires of militarism, full of the spirit of the Vietnam years. Orson Welles is a splendid militaristic general and exquisitely smut.

title: Il futuro è donna
actors: Ornella Muti, Hanna Schygulla, Niels P. Arestrup, Maurizio Donadoni
description: In a crowded nightclub, Malvina, a pregnant girl, is harassed and harassed by a group of drifters. Anna, who is there, rescues her and decides to take her home where she and Gordon host her for a night. Malvina proves to be too intrusive and ends up being chased by the two, even if it is Anna herself who asks her home. A strange relationship of mutual attraction begins to develop between the three.
notes: The crisis of the couple is analyzed by Marco Ferreri with the usual pungent spirit, thanks to the subject of Dacia Maraini. But "The future is a woman" is not one of his most successful works.

title: Play It to the Bone
actors: Antonio Banderas, Woody Harrelson, Lolita Davidovich, Lucy Liu, Tom Sizemore
description: Two penniless boxer friends are presented with the opportunity of a lifetime: to fight in Las Vegas during a match on the side of Tyson's fight and be seen all over the world. The journey is tiring on board the car of an enterprising girl who has been engaged to both of them and becomes a cause for quarrels, reconciliation and comic curtains. But a grueling encounter awaits them in Las Vegas.
notes: The film promises a lot with a prominent cast that lines up Banderas, Davidovich, Harrelson, Sizemore in alphabetical order and Costner, Curtis, Tyson, Woods and Snipes to surround it. The problem is that the film cannot choose between the comic-romantic and the boxing dimension.

title: Kiss Me
actors: Freddie Prinze jr, Rachael Leigh Cook, Matthew Lillard, Anna Paquin
description: Laney, is an inconspicuous girl, the daughter of a pool cleaner with whom the excellent student Zac, rich and handsome, falls in love as a bet. Their story should be crowned during the great prom, but a friend of Zac tries to steal his prey, which in the meantime has turned into a splendid Cinderella.
notes: Tuttifrutti comedy for all tastes produced by Bob and Harvey Weinstein, or the Miramax gentlemen, which recalls the story of Otello. But in this world of "Dawson's Creek" and "Beverly Hills 90120", where even the most unlucky has a villa with a view and swimming pool, and Otello is the color of mother-of-pearl, there is no escape from the iron laws of comedy with a happy ending.

title: La vita è un gioco
actors: Bebo Storti, Sabina Began, Niki Giustini, Graziano Salvadori
description: Bartolomeo is a Florentine marquis who has now fallen with the family vice of gambling. Never, however, before him had lost the entire heritage, including the historic villa. Colonnino, Ciotolino and Postcard are three young people of today, Bartolomeo's three friends playing, betting, betting and roulette companions. Coordinated by Bartolomeo, determined to reclaim his villa, they collect the necessary money and try their luck at the Casino of San Vincent.
notes: Amateur filming, provincial cabaret actors. The regret of having underestimated (at the time) "Horse fever" grows out of all proportion.

title: Rush Hour
actors: Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker, Tom Wilkinson, Tzi Ma, Ken Leung, Chris Penn
description: Lee, an unyielding and busy officer, is the pride of the Royal Hong Kong Police Force. His favorite pupil is the eleven-year-old daughter of the Chinese consul, but the girl, traveling to the United States, is kidnapped. So the consul sends him there to try to get his hands on the thugs. The FBI, with little intentions of investigative meddling, assigns the case to Detective James Carter who, when he finds out what his role is to keep Lee away from the case, goes on a rampage.
notes: The best is always expected from an action movie with Jackie Chan. And instead the director can't even keep up with "Lethal Weapon 4", the representation is so dull.

title: Calabuig
actors: Edmund Gwenn, Franco Fabrizi, Valentina Cortese, Juan Calvo
description: George, an atomic scientist, is preparing to reach a secret base in the Mediterranean, but, having arrived in Barcelona, ??tired and disappointed, he decides to drop everything. He then goes to the village of Calabuig, where he hopes to permanently lose all traces of himself. Here he tells everyone his name is Jorge and, since the seaside village is full of smugglers, he is mistaken for one of them. Little by little, everyone takes him in favor for his skills as a helpful man and when it comes to organizing the village party Jorge offers to lend a hand. It will be this willingness to betray him ...
notes: The film, scripted by Flaiano, won the Ocic prize in Venice. It is a bizarre and clear moral tale about the moral dilemmas of science in the atomic age.

title: Jamaica Run
actors: Ray Milland, Arlene Dahl, Wendell Corey, Patric Knowles, Laura Elliott
description: The Dilling family, a mother and two grown-up children, live in Villa Alta, an extensive landed property on the coast of Jamaica. The estate belonged to their ancestor John who put it up for sale, but the documents proving it ended up in the bottom of the sea with him. An unscrupulous businessman contacts Jenny and Robert, two descendants of the alleged buyer, and convinces them to do some research to find the cash box with the documents. But one day Robert is found dead and Jenny risks drowning in a cave ...
notes: The subject and the direction are not very convincing and the presence of Ray Milland fails to revive the film.

title: Hello, She Lied/Miami Hustle
actors: Kathy Ireland, John Enos III, Audie England, Richard C. Sarafian
description: A girl is blackmailed by her rich employer and is therefore forced, exploiting her beauty, to organize scams against jewelers and banks. But the police are watching her, and things are starting to go wrong ...
notes: Modest television film directed by a specialist in the genre, based on the remarkable graces but modest acting talents of the protagonist Kathy Ireland. The nostalgics of the "anti-Hollywood" cinema of the seventies can console themselves with the presence in the cast of Richard C. Sarafian, director of small cults of the time such as "Point zero" and "The man who loved the dancing cat".

title: Marquis De Sade: Justine
actors: Romina Power, Jack Palance, Sylva Koscina, Rosalba Neri
description: Two sisters, Justine and Juliette, who remained orphaned, must decide what to do with their lives. While the second, unscrupulous and cynical, enters a cunning, the first, shy and naive, is forced to defend himself from unscrupulous people. Unjustly accused of theft is imprisoned but manages to escape.
notes: One of the most famous titles of Jesus Franco, with Romina Power naked (but never fully). Some clips were used by Joe D'Amato for his "Justine". Kinski plays in the role of De Sade, a writer to whom Franco has (very) vaguely inspired.

title: La fine della notte
actors: Claudio Bigagli, Dario Parisini, John Sayles
description: Two friends who live in neighboring towns in the Lombardy province, quarrel with a farmer and decide to make him pay. A good night begins for them, made up of crimes, chases, thefts and oppressions.
notes: Happy debut of Davide Ferrario ("Look at me") in his most "American" film in terms of the rhythm of the story and relationship with the scenarios. A story that has really beautiful moments, embellished by the (perhaps symbolic) presence of John Sayles, a wise independent filmmaker who has never treated genres snobbishly (Corman school ...).

title: Kill or Be Killed
actors: James Ryan, Charlotte Michelle, Norman Coombes, Daniel DuPlessis
description: A former Nazi hierarch decides to found an organization of professional assassins to be unleashed against a Japanese rival, a great expert in martial arts. He recruits a good number of ninja and kung-fu fighters and among them Chen Hung, a true champion. Who, when he discovers the Nazi's aims, decides to abandon him.
notes: Terrible martial arts film in which the Bruce Lee on duty (so to speak ...) is played by the unknown James Ryan (mah!). Fight choreography like not even in Filipino action films, known for their trashy "thickness". Also not recommended for enthusiasts.

title: Inner Sanctum 2
actors: Michael Nouri, Jennifer Reed, Margaux Hemingway
description: After killing her husband in an excess of self-defense, a woman lives in the throes of the worst nightmares. The deceased returns from the afterlife to kill her, or at least she believes she can. Meanwhile, the protagonist's relatives try to make her look crazy ...
notes: The film is a disaster, but it may well find its admirers. Because there are authentically cult moments: the protagonist in a cemetery dancing with her dead husband, as well as scenes of necrophilia in large quantities (probably reduced by the television version). If this is a "number 2", let's imagine _Inner Sanctum_ 1!

title: Dennis the Menace Strikes Again
actors: Don Rickles, Justin Cooper, George Kennedy, Betthy White
description: Dennis is a nice and overly lively boy who adores Mr. Wilson, the neighbor. But there is a problem: Wilson hates him. All this because Dennis often and unintentionally makes a lot of trouble and it is always Mr. Wilson who pays the price. This is a matter of discussion between Mr. Wilson and Dennis's grandfather. The neighbor of the little blonde-crested plague will be able to appreciate it when he foils a big scam ...
notes: Second episode of "Dennis the Menace", based on a famous comic by Hank Ketchman.

title: Fort Worth
actors: Randolph Scott, David Brian, Phyllis Thaxter, Helena Carter
description: Ned Britt, a former gunfighter who turned to journalism, travels with his partner Ben to Texas to start a newspaper. During the journey Ned meets Flora who convinces him to go to Forth Worth, where Blair, Ned's old friend and old boyfriend of the girl, lives. In Fort Worth, however, the gang of the outlaw Claranger rages and the protagonist is asked to stay to protect the peaceful inhabitants.
notes: Western of series B with the idol of the "lower" part of the vein. Nothing special, but an interesting atmosphere and a remarkable storytelling speed.

title: Long xiao ye
actors: Jackie Chan, Chan Wai-man, Mars (Feng-sing)
description: The young Dragon, the spoiled son of a local squire, should train to become a kung fu champion and instead prefers to run after girls in the company of his Cowboy cousin. Playing with a kite that lands above a tree, Dragon accidentally discovers a gang of thugs smuggling in ancient Chinese items. He decides to challenge them to stop the foul trade.
notes: Third direction of the prodigy Jackie Chan. An action comedy with many burlesque moments and of course great choreography (by Yuen Kwai). The final fight in the haystack is memorable.

title: Mark colpisce ancora
actors: Franco Gasparri, John Saxon, Marcella Michelangeli
description: Commissioner Mark perhaps has his eye on the big tour, in the sense that he has identified an international terrorist center based in Germany and Austria. In order to ruin the plans of the subversive, Mark passes himself off as a flower child and goes away to Vienna.
notes: Third episode of the adventures of the cop created by Stelvio Massi and played by Franco Gasparri after "Mark the policeman" and "Mark the policeman shoots first". However, the level is lower, and even the openness to topical issues (the German RAF, the connections with transnational terrorism) does not help the story.

title: It
actors: Tim Curry, John Ritter, Annette O'Toole, Tim Reid, Richard Masur
description: Derry, Maine. The town is devastated by strange deaths and disappearances. A group of friends decide to form a gang to eradicate the reason for so much evil, a black monster who lives in the sewers. But there is another monster that stagnates in the country, it is the one "evoked" by the wickedness and meanness of men.
notes: Stephen King's river novel, perhaps his literary masterpiece, with the great invention of the clown. The TV version certainly doesn't hold its own, but Tommy Lee Wallace, a former Carpenter's collaborator, still made a decent drama.

title: Curtain Call
actors: James Spader, Michael Caine, Maggie Smith, Polly Walker
description: A New York publisher is in crisis because his publishing house is about to be absorbed by a large corporation. His life is pleasantly turned upside down by the ghosts of Max and Lily, two actors of the thirties. The two ectoplasms try to help Spencer solve his professional and sentimental problems.

title: Lake Consequence
actors: Billy Zane, Joan Severance, May Karasun, Whip Hubley, Courtland Mead
description: Irene is thirty years old, she is married, bored and of course looking for a lover. It finds it in the gardener, who also has a morbid relationship with another, and therefore proposes itself for the most classic triangle. Since this is not a porn, but an "author" soft, a psychological trauma that has been ruining poor Irene has been raising out.
notes: Very scourse film written and produced by Zalman King (that of "Wild orchid"). An eroticism to the tinto brass, as a confessional, with the perversions family format as they were written on a manual (the triangle, the gardener ...). The package is unbearably patinated. Terrible.

title: An Ideal Husband
actors: Cate Blanchett, Rupert Everett, Jeremy Northam, Minnie Driver, Julianne Moore
description: London, 1895. Sir Robert Chiltern, the ideal husband married to Lady Gertrude, about to embark on a promising political career is blackmailed by the perfidious Mrs. Chevely, an unscrupulous business man who knows the less than noble origin of man's fortune. Meanwhile, the golden bachelor Lord Goring falls in love, reciprocated, with Miss Mabel, the sister of Sir Robert ...
notes: Brilliant transposition of Oscar Wilde's perfect play, brought to the screen for the first time by Alexander Korda in 1948. Jokes that amuse and remain, an impeccable reconstruction of the period, perhaps a little too "daddy's cinema", but ninety-seven minutes that fly by accompanied by a group of actors who fight to raise their hand, in the most shameless competition that recent cinema remembers. The comedy, set in nineteenth-century atmospheres and costumes, looks like another "Best Friend's Wedding". Indeed it is.

title: Samoa, regina della giungla
actors: Edwige Fenech, Roger Browne, Ivy Holzer, Femi Benussi
description: In Hong Kong, an expedition is organized to an island in Malaysia, in search of a diamond deposit. The group is made up of Clint, Professor Dawson, Doctor Schwarz, Stark, Nancy, Moreau, Muller and Alain. Arriving on the island, our men are attacked by head-cutters and, when they are preparing for another assault, Samoa, a girl with long black hair, leads them through secret passages in her village.
notes: Irrelevant exotic filmaccio, which is remembered for a very young Fenech.

title: La sbandata
actors: Domenico Modugno, Eleonora Giorgi, Pippo Franco, Luciana Paluzzi
description: After thirty years of hard work as a cobbler and shoe, the elderly Salvatore leaves the United States to return to Sicily. Full of money and with a desire to find a woman who can satisfy her senile crafts. To offer him hospitality I am his brother Raffaele and his wife Rosa, but Salvatore's instincts awaken is the bursting Mariuccia. Tacitly agree with the mother, the girl adapts to indulge the uncle's erotic games, with the aim of pushing him a lot of money.
notes: At the time the film was welcomed by heavy criticism. Samperi, who signs the script, offers instead a mischievous portrait of the Italian province. In the context of erotic comedy, one of the least infamous examples. From the novel "The flyer" by Pietro Buttitta. Modugno also signs the soundtrack.

title: Saluti e baci
actors: Catherine Erard, Arturo Bragaglia, Philippe Lemaire, Ginacarlo Nicotra, Louis Armstrong, Nilla Pizzi, Django Reinhardt, Juliette Gréco
description: Carlo, a presenter who hosts the Voci Nuove broadcast on the radio, to give his program a greater impulse, goes to a mountain village, where he organizes an evening of amateurs in the fray. The evening is not going very well, but, just as Carlo is about to leave, Marina takes possession of the microphone and invites people to send picture postcards to Tonino, a poor orphaned schoolboy.
notes: History is a pretext to present musical numbers of singers in vogue at the time.

title: Le masque de fer
actors: Jean Marais, Jean-François Poron, Sylva Koscina, Jean Rochefort
description: Louis XIV is too ill to take the throne, and is forced to turn to his twin brother imprisoned on an island. Henri, as the twin is called, has a mask on his face that prevents anyone from recognizing him. To secure a king for France, D'Artagnan (Jean Marais) frees him from his captivity. When the king's health begins to improve, Henri, who in the meantime has fallen in love with Isabella, becomes unavailable, disappearing into anonymity.
notes: Swashbuckle film that attempts to mix the events of King Louis XIV, by D'Artagnan with those of Angelica. The result leaves something to be desired.

title: The Curse
actors: Wil Wheaton, Claude Akins, Malcolm Danare, Cooper Huckabee
description: Nathan tries to run his farm as best he can. A real estate agent is trying to buy most of the farms in the area, including the Hayes, in hopes that the Tennessee authorities will choose the city as the location for the new playground. One night, during a terrible storm, an unidentified shiny object strikes down on the Hayes' farm and brings with it a terrible curse for the members of the entire community. The object is a meteorite which, after dissolving in the ground, contaminates it. Soon fruit and livestock fill with larvae and some members of the family become bloated, drooling mutants. But two of the farmer's sons who avoided meteor contamination seek help.
notes: Based on a short story by H. P. Lovecraft, the film is shot flat and leaves no room for imagination.

title: Double Jeopardy
actors: Ashley Judd, Tommy Lee Jones, Benjamin Weir, Bruce Greenwood, Jay Brazeau, John McLaren, Ed Evanko, Annabeth Gish, Davenia McFadden, Roma Maffia
description: Libby has a rich, handsome husband she's in love with, a son they both adore, and a beautiful home. But when her husband disappears overboard during a romantic weekend on a boat, Libby is accused of killing him and sentenced. From prison she begs her best friend to adopt her son. The woman accepts and then disappears with the child. Six years pass, Libby is granted semi-release and is entrusted to Travis, an uncompromising man. When Libby runs away ...
notes: The protagonist, an Ashley Judd who has the elegance and diaphanous beauty of a modern and relentless "dark babe", is animated by hatred and maternal love. Even the angel Tommy Lee Jones, who skilfully exploits all the wrinkles of similar characters already played in other films, has not seen his daughter for some time. The emotional component of the thriller, directed with a sure hand and some very effective twists by Bruce Beresford, is supported by this parallelism that guides and brings the protagonists closer.

title: Bicentennial Man
actors: Robin Williams, Sam Neill, Oliver Platt, Hallie Kate Eisenberg
description: Richard Martin decides to give himself a gift: a brand new NDR-114 robot that his youngest daughter, who mistook him for an android, renames Andrew. But Andrew is not an android, but a robot bought to perform the humblest tasks: cooking, cleaning, looking after children and playing with them. But an accident caused by Richard's youngest daughter prompts the whole family to treat him like a human being. And for his part, Andrew also begins to have almost human feelings.
notes: Based on the story of the same name and the novel "The Positronic Man", it tells the 200 years of life of a robot who learns to think and feel like a man. But 200 years is too long even for filmmakers.

title: Fucking Åmål
actors: Alexandra Dahlström, Rebecka Liljeberg, Erica Carlsson, Mathias Rust
description: The whole world is a country and the harsh law of the obvious does not escape even Åmal, a sad Swedish town where Jessica and Elin live, two teenage sisters without a father and a mother who is a nurse at night. Elin, the object of desire of all the boys in the school, has within her a restlessness and an extraordinary sensitivity. At the wrong party he meets Agnes, the daughter of a middle-class family where parent-child communication doesn't work. The two girls fall in love and decide to live their story on their own skin.
notes: Directed by a newcomer, it is a foray into the emotional chaos of adolescence; sad, cheerful, intense, shot with a realistic style a la Cassavetes and a reversible film that gives the film a grainy aspect, like that of the life of Åmal.

title: Boys Don't Cry
actors: Hilary Swank, Chloë Sevigny, Peter Sarsgaard, Brendan Sexton III
description: In Falls City, Nebraska, Brandon Teena, a young man just arrived in town and thinking only of building his future, immediately won over the inhabitants of that small town community. Women adore him and everyone is won over by his tenderness and innocence. In Lincoln, Brandon was completely different, he was a boy who had always been in an existential crisis. He'd made mistakes that cost him dearly, and when he got between Lana and her boyfriend, the surprise generated violence.
notes: The story is true and is told in a deliberately sloppy style to emphasize the realism of the environment. Maybe that's why it seems like a story and a film that has already been seen so many other times.

title: Angela's Ashes
actors: Emily Watson, Robert Carlyle, Michael Legge, Joe Breen, Ciaran Owens, Ronnie Masterson
description: In 1935 in Brooklyn, Margaret Mary McCourt, daughter of a family of Irish immigrants recently in the United States, was born in a small room in a council house. The father, Malachy, is beside himself with joy, while his wife Angela is recovering from childbirth. When, however, after seven weeks the girl dies Malachy disappears from circulation, leaves the four children to Angela to give herself to alcohol. All that remains for the woman is to return to Limerick, Ireland, guided by the hope of solving her problems.
notes: This time we almost hoped Parker would make a good movie. After all, one of his most successful titles is "The Commitments", but again we were wrong.

title: Toy Story 2
description: At McWhiggin, a maniacal manic collector and owner of a huge toy shop, he decided to kidnap Woody. At the house of Al, the cowboy discovers that she was created for a television show of the 1950s, "Woody's RoundP", and therefore became a rare collector's piece. In the meantime Buzz and the others are organizing the rescue.
notes: Sequel of Toy Story (1996). History apparently repeats itself, but "Toy Story 2" has new Atouts. First of all, a psychoanalytic structure, which is based on the rediscovery of a past removed from Woody and on the theme of the double (Buzz replaced by a clone). And precisely in the cinematographic quote, the least small will find a safe enjoyment: from "The window on the courtyard" to "Jurassic Park", passing through "Star Wars". The saga then divided into two other episodes -Toy Story 3. The Great Escape (2010) and Toy Story 4 (2019) - In addition to the spinoff dedicated by the character of astronaut Buzz, Lightyear - The true story of Buzz (2022)

title: The Straight Story
actors: Richard Farnsworth, Sissy Spacek, Harry Dean Stanton
description: Old Alvin Straight has seen so many, in the years he spent on the street and in the years he spent on his lawn and in the drugstore around the corner. One day he takes the lawnmower and sets off, crossing streets, cornfields, skies, the Mississippi at a snail's pace to reconcile with his brother he hasn't seen for too long.
notes: There is indeed the horror, in "A true story"; but there is also the wisdom that, more or less, makes us go on and grow old; there is the excruciating sadness on the face of Sissy Spacek who looks out the window and always sees a child on the lawn. It's beautiful. Elementary (in the highest sense of the word). Extraordinary Richard Fansworth, scandalously not awarded at Cannes and committed suicide a year after the release of the film.

title: Liberate i pesci
actors: Laura Morante, Francesco Paolantoni, Michele Placido, Emilio Solfrizzi, Lunetta Savino
description: In Lecce we expect the "premiere" in the square of the "Aida", set up by a company from Moscow. Patron of the event is the boss Michele. Lunetta, a former soprano and Michele's former lover, is the entertainment manager. The woman belongs to a family of aristocrats with a passion for opera, like her brother Sergio, a journalist who has fled the city.
notes: After "Matrimoni" Cristina Comencini resumes and enriches the ranks of a story, solid and modulated and continues her pleasant recognition of the feelings, emotions, languages ??and moods of a chorus of characters played by a cast of excellent actors . The ironic and, in many scenes, affectionately sarcastic style does not judge, does not censor, does not reproach.

title: The Fourth Floor
actors: Shelley Duvall, William Hurt, Juliette Lewis, Artie Lange
description: A young professional designer takes possession of an apartment left vacant after the "suspicious" death of an aunt. Her boyfriend does not agree very much, because the girl has decided to go there and live alone. In the new building you will find many surprises.
notes: It's a sort of remake of Polanski's "The Tenant on the Third Floor". There the action took place in an old Paris house, here in an elegant New York building. The differences, of course, are not just spectacular. Brava the newfound Juliette Lewis.

title: The Proud Ones
actors: Robert Ryan, Virginia Mayo, Jeffrey Hunter, Robert Middleton
description: Cass, expelled from Keyton for killing a certain Enderson, is appointed sheriff of Cattle, a town in the West in full expansion. There he meets Ted, son of the man he killed long ago. Trusting certain rumors, the boy believes that his father was killed by treason and does not give credit to the words of Cass who claims otherwise. But Ted can't help but intervene when the sheriff is threatened with death while in the gambling den set up by Barret.
notes: The film is appreciated for its good action scenes. Ryan gives a nice characterization of his character.

title: La peccatrice
actors: Zeudi Araya, Franco Gasparri, Ettore Manni, Clara Calamai, Francisco Rabal
description: Sicily, 1950s. The owner of a zolfatara harasses the employees in every way and especially Turi. His intention is to take away Debora, his beautiful black wife (whom the beguines of the city consider a witch).
notes: Pavoni seems to be looking (with myopic eyes) at Matarazzo, amusing himself with the body of Araya, in its maximum splendor.

title: Gran bollito
actors: Shelley Winters, Max Von Sydow, Renato Pozzetto, Alberto Lionello, Laura Antonelli
description: Lea, a mature Neapolitan woman who runs a lottery bank in a northern city, had thirteen children, but all but one died from abortion or after a few months of life. Lea devotes herself to Michele, the only survivor, with morbid affection, convinced that she has saved him from death by negotiating with her. So when Michele gets engaged to a pretty dance teacher, his mother sacrifices three of her spinster friends to death to keep him still close to her.
notes: Black-toned fable inspired by the story of Leonarda Cianciulli, the soap maker from Correggio always hovering between the grotesque (Pozzetto, Lionello and von Sydow play women's clothes) and the macabre.

title: L'Ordinateur des pompes funèbres
actors: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Lea Massari, Mireille Darc, Bernadette Lafont
description: Fred Malon, employed in an insurance company, is married to the arrogant and matriarchal Gloria. Exasperated by the situation, he decides to make a mistress and finds her in Charlotte, his secretary, and to take out his wife by organizing an accidental death in the bathroom. In the meantime he meets Louise, wife of his colleague Pierre and, also falling in love with her, he decides to kill her husband. Thus a ménage a trois is created and Fred is forced to double his salary and does not hesitate to get rid of his office manager.
notes: Black comedy based on a William Kempley novel. Trintignant supports the game, as do the supporting actors.

title: La polizia è sconfitta
actors: Marcel Bozzuffi, Riccardo Salvino, Claudia Giannotti, Vittorio Mezzogiorno
description: A cruel band of looters makes life impossible for the traders of Bologna. Valli, one of the bandits, turns out to be the most ruthless and meanest of the bunch. Valli does not hesitate to take out a Tunisian who would also like to join the circle. Thanks to the precious collaboration of investigator Grifi, the police set up a special team and go into action. The gang leader is eventually caught mingling with bus travelers.
notes: Typical seventies film with a very bad Vittorio Mezzogiorno and an Ivana Novak in her latest interpretation.

title: Appassionata
actors: Gabriele Ferzetti, Valentina Cortese, Ornella Muti, Eleonora Giorgi
description: Dr. Emilio Rutelli is a mature but beautiful -looking dentist, married to a pianist who has given up a promising career for him. Emilio has a sixteen -year -old daughter, Eugenia, who loves him morbidly, while he detested, out of jealousy, his mother. The girl has a friend Nicola, unscrupulous and helpful who, one day, pretending to be under the effect of anesthesia, offers himself to Emilio in his clinic. Eugenia caresses the idea of ​​replacing her friend. So one night the enterprising Eugenia ...
notes: First film in which Ornella Muti is completely naked. At the time he made a scandal and made it hope that Calderone could become a new Samperi.

title: Fly Away Home
actors: Jeff Daniels, Anna Paquin, Dana Delany, Terry Kinney, Holter Graham
description: Amy is a 13-year-old girl with an unbridled passion for animals. To drive from Canada to Florida, a flock of ducklings learns to drive a flying toy that their father built for them. The cute birds were left without a mother and took little Amy to heart. The journey will present considerable difficulties but Amy, gifted with remarkable courage, will do all she can to complete the feat.
notes: Adventures for kids based on Bill Lishman's autobiography and shot by Carroll Ballard ("Black Stallion" and "Wind"). In Italy the film was sponsored by Legambiente.

title: Ulterior Motives
actors: Thomas Ian Griffith, Craig Shugart, David Efron, Mary Page Keller
description: Jack, a reporter who is conducting a very sensitive investigation, discovers that a US aerospace engineer discovers that the man is in contact with a Japanese spy agent. The American who is working on a very secret project and to the journalist it seems strange that the two could be in contact. But the surprises did not end so much that by investigating, investigating the man he discovered the economic interests behind the dangerous working relationship of the American and the Japanese.
notes: A television film based on a story created by the director and Thomas Ian Griffith. Action and suspense.

title: Summit
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, Mireille Darc, Giampiero Albertini, Erika Blanc
description: Paolo, a 40-year-old journalist, special correspondent for a left-wing newspaper, goes to Paris where he meets his ex-lover, Annie, from whom he had separated a few months earlier. The woman, tied to Ulrich, to test her feelings, agrees to follow Paolo on a business trip in the two Germanys and in Poland.
notes: Love and politics, with a thousand vintage charms. Very dated.

title: Si tous le gars du monde...
actors: Hélène Pedrière, Claude Sylvain, Jean-Louis Trintignant
description: The crew of a motor trawler is the victim of a collective poisoning caused by spoiled food that forces men to station in the North Sea. The desperate distress message is picked up by a radio amateur who immediately gets in touch with a doctor. The latter, after making a diagnosis, communicates that to save men from certain death it is necessary to administer a serum within a period of twelve hours. Following the intervention of two other radio amateurs, the serum is made available. The problem is to go and recover it in East Berlin.
notes: Christian-Jaque makes a dramatic but harmless film.

title: Requiem for a Heavyweight
actors: Anthony Quinn, Jackie Gleason, Mickey Rooney, Julie Harris
description: A boxer no longer very young belonging to the heavyweight category loses a match. The possibility of continuing his career is thus completely nullified. To survive, he is forced to agree to play wrestling matches, disguised in the most unthinkable ways. The athlete will thus see all his dreams of glory vanish.
notes: Dramatic portrayal of the world of boxing in Ralph Nelson's debut film, written by Rod Sterling. The actors, including the protagonist himself, Anthony Quinn, play a little too much, but the pace is remarkable. Mythical cameo by Cassius Clay.

title: La proprietà non è più un furto
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Flavio Bucci, Daria Nicolodi, Mario Scaccia
description: Total, a young bank employee, is allergic to money, it disgusts him to touch it and despises those who own it. Convinced that the world is made up of thieves, those who profess themselves as such and those who enrich themselves behind the backs of others, he believes he has identified a member of the second category in a butcher who is a client of the bank he works for. He decides to target him.
notes: Grotesque and Brechtian apologue, frontally political but not as schematic as it appears, written by Petri with the collaboration of Ugo Pirro. Rabbioso and verboso, breaded and very cupissimo, ramshackle and out of tune, apocalyptic and honestly out of the party's patterns. Generally seen as a failure. Soundtrack by Ennio Morricone.

title: I Saw What You Did
actors: Andi Garrett, Sara Lane, John Ireland, Joan Crawford, Leif Erickson
description: Libby, a little girl left at home alone by her parents with her little sister and a friend, enjoys playing phone pranks by pestering random people from the phone book. The sentence that the girl repeats is "I have seen what you have done and I know who you are". The game seems to go on quietly, until Steve gets the call and killed his wife.
notes: A very remarkable and unknown thriller directed by a cult director, that William Castle who put the electric charges in the seats of the cinema to make the spectators jump (!). Maybe not a genius, but certainly a great funny guy.

title: Black Widow Murders: The Blanche Taylor Moore Story
actors: Elizabeth Montgomery, David Clennon, John Jackson, Grace Zabriskie
description: Blanche Taylor Moore, a mature woman and widow represents a model of virtue in the closed society of the town where she lives. In reality, the woman, who had an unhappy childhood and bad relationships with her father, has always had numerous problems towards the male world. The "problems" started with their husband and later with the new boyfriend. The first dead from reasons is not known how natural and the second found dead with a dose of poison in the body, they make a detective suspicious that begins to investigate. The investigations immediately present themselves difficult because the woman is elusive and too smart even for the police.

title: Little Laura & Big John
actors: Fabian Forte, Karen Black, Kenny Miller, Paul Gleason, Ivy Thayer
description: John, a childhood friend and in love with Laura, is accused of killing an Indian, his business partner. Wanted by the county sheriff, he finds refuge in the forest, despite his brother Bob inducing him to turn himself in. John, however, ends up accepting the advice and is arrested. Some time passes and Bob helps him escape. This time John gets into serious trouble because he lands a bank robbery in which Bob loses his life. Arrested once again, he once again escapes from prison and together with Laura settles in the forests of North America.
notes: Modest adventure film set in Roaring Twenties America.

title: Thrashin'
actors: Sherilyn Fenn, Josh Brolin, Beau Brown, Michael Balzary (Flea)
description: A group of boys, known by everyone as the Valley Boys and who roam the neighborhood with skateboards, collide with a punk gang. Leading the former is Corey Webster, while Tommy Hook leads the latter. The two groups compete for the supremacy of the territory. The real problems begin when Corey falls in love with Tommy's sister, who has arrived from Indiana. The decisive battle between the two gangs takes place on a hill used by skaters for their evolutions and called L.A. Massacre.
notes: Youthful film not the worst, supported by the music and the rhythm of the direction. Among the performers Michael Balzary, better known as Flea, bassist of the Red Hot Chili Peppers.

title: Sitting Ducks
actors: Michael Emil, Zack Norman, Patrice Townsend, Irene Forrest
description: A rather shy and clumsy accountant and an outgoing and gritty colleague of his, decide to retire. But they have the bad idea of ??doing it after they have stolen some money by way of additional liquidation. Except that the money they flee with belongs to a mafia family whose interests the two look after. Their destination is Costa Rica, instead the two become "sitting ducks" (literally, "sitting ducks"), that is to say two "easy targets".
notes: Slightly talkative but funny comedy. The starting idea (money stolen from the mafia, impossible escape) is now abused but the verve holds.

title: Stamping Ground
actors: Pink Floyd, Jefferson Airplaine, Canned Heat, Santana, The Byrds
description: The end of the 1960s and the beginning of the seventies was characterized by megacucerts who contributed to making music the soundtrack of an era. The documentary directed by Jason Pohland, in collaboration with George Sluizer, shows us one of these shows, held only one year after the legendary Woodstock gathering. The protagonists are the Pink Floyd, psychedelic rock champions, who had already published "Atom Heart Mother" in 1970 and were about to publish "Relics". Other protagonists Carlos Santana who had participated in the Megaraduno of Woodstock and the Canned Heat, a blues soul of the movement.

title: High Tide
actors: Judy Davis, Colin Friels, John Clayton, Jan Adele, David Attrill
description: A singer who performs in piano bars and impersonates Elvis Presley is forced to relive his past when he begins to tour. During a concert he finds his daughter camping in a trailer. For the Elvis double begins a close confrontation with the girl he hadn't seen for some years.
notes: For this operation Armstrong ("Little Women") called Judy Davis, who she had helped launch with her first film "My Brilliant Career". "High Tide" means "high tide".

title: Es pecado... pero me gusta
actors: Carmen Villani, Carlo Giuffrè, Aldo Maccione, Simon André
description: Fabrizio, a pharmaceutical industrialist, wants to get approval from the health authorities for his latest product, Fegatin. In agreement with his wife Gabriella, he hires a prostitute to obtain the long-awaited concession from the Honorable Aristotle, Undersecretary of Health. During a party in the Furia's house, Fabrizio and Lola put their plan to fruition.
notes: Carmen Villani sexy heroine of a lot of B series cinema is here the prostitute Lola. In Spain the film was released with the title "Es pecado ... pero me gusta".

title: The Corporate Ladder
actors: Anthony John Denison, Talisa Soto, Kathleen Kinmont
description: Matt is the executive of an advertising agency who is looking for a new assistant. All the candidates fail to convince him, he is looking for someone who knows how to combine competence with beauty. Nicole, the perfect secretary, finally comes forward. Tall, blonde, heart-stopping, ambitious, alert and creative. Of course Matt ends up in bed and the "fatal attraction" syndrome occurs. Lover and so much trouble. Nicole knows exactly where she wants to go and stops at nothing, not even in the face of murder.
notes: Former Bond girl Talisa Soto is a pretty sight. The TV movie not so much.

title: Twentieth Century
actors: Carole Lombard, John Barrymore, Roscoe Karnes
description: The Twentieth Century is a luxury supertrain where Oscar Jaffe, an impresario now on the avenue of the sunset, travels. In a compartment, Oscar accidentally meets Lilly Garland, his ex-wife whom he himself helped to become a star of the first magnitude. Oscar goes out of his way to cast her again ...
notes: One of the sacred texts of the Screwball Comedy. Devilish rhythm, visual knowledge that was even innovative for the times, actors in a state of grace and a great success with the public. Screenplay by Ben Hecht and Charles MacArthur. Broadway made a musical out of it.

title: Ridendo e scherzando
actors: Luciano Salce, Macha Meril, Stefano Satta Flores, Gino Bramieri
description: Episode movies. "Silver wedding": the notary Sartoni, on the occasion of his twenty-fifth anniversary, finds a package with a playboy bunny. "Please kill my husband": a rich American married to an Italian industrialist, induces the servant to kill him. "Separate bodies": Michele Sintona would like to attend Napoli-Juventus, but is mistaken for the banker. "Cost what it costs": the doorman of a building suspects that a tenant is a cover girl. "Melodrama of jealousy": an extremely jealous banker pays an actor who pretends to be an adulterer on the run to have relations with his wife.
notes: Comedy at zero level and well-known gags for a film that is a bit of a follow-up to "Ride bene ... chi laughs last" but which did not have much success with the public.

title: Sweet'N'Short
actors: Casper Devries, Joanna Weinberg
description: South Africa 1989: Apartheid is still in effect and Sweet is a good rugby player albeit "politically incorrect". His favorite pastimes? The barfly (or going from one bar to another with friends getting drunk at the last stage and maybe beating some blacks) and a deluge of blows to his girlfriend. Sweet has significant money problems and on the very day he could win a huge sum he gets a ball and falls to the ground. The boy goes into a coma and stays there for three years. Doctors despair of being able to save him, his life hangs by a thread, yet miraculously he comes to his senses. When he finally wakes up, Sweet discovers that Mandela has become president, De Klerk sits on the opposition benches, apartheid has been abolished. But the most incredible thing is that he, a racist, owes the return to life to Alfred Short, a black boy who is helping him.
notes: Sweet'n'Short, as the original title states. Feel good story with interesting implications.

title: 8 1/2 Women
actors: John Standing, Toni Collette, Natacha Amal, Manna Fujiwara, Vivian Wu, Annie Shizuka Inoh, Barbara Sarafian, Kirina Mano, Amanda Plummer, Polly Walker, Elizabeth Berrington, Myriam Muller, Don Warrington, Claire Johnston
description: A father and son, so rich that they can delight in idleness and sex, in their Geneva villa transformed into a sort of private brothel. And, of course, eight and a half women, which summarize vaguely outdated prototypes of the male sexual imaginary: an Oriental, a former nun, a virago in an Amazonian outfit, a faithful servant, a prostitute who recalls Louise Brooks, a dwarf who will come renamed Juliet after a vision of "La strada".
notes: Greenaway's homage to Fellini is explicit right from the title. But "8 women and 1/2" certainly does not have the joy and passion for the female universe of (albeit misogynist) Fellini. If anything, try the metaphorical closure of "La grande buffata", without rediscovering its ferocious humor and self-critical discipline. It seems that Greenaway, this time, in his cage and pigeonhole, has completely privileged the mechanism to the metaphor, the self-contemplation to even the slightest self-irony.

title: Salsa
actors: Vincent Lecoeur, Christianne Gout, Catherine Samie, Michel Aumont
description: Rémi Bonnet, a young concert artist from Toulon, son of the good bourgeoisie, leaves his family and career behind and moves to Paris. Here the sweet Rémi, discovers that no band that plays salsa wants it because it is white. So he dyes his skin black and reinvents his life as a Cuban musician and dancer under the paternal guidance of the great Chucho Barreto, taking the exotic name of Mongo.
notes: Love, music and unsustainable twists are intertwined in Joyce Sherman Buñuel's film, which boasts vague relations with its namesake Luis. A sauce that is more suited to a boiled meat than a movie, and the soundtrack, compared to that of "Buena Vista Social Club", seems little more than a diligent homework.

title: Mystery, Alaska
actors: Russell Crowe, Mary McCormack, Burt Reynolds, Hank Azaria
description: In the small town of Mystery, Alaska, the local ice hockey team is the only opportunity for fun and chat. The youngsters have always competed for a place on the team for the Saturday game, so when the New York Rangers team launch a challenge, the citizens of Mystery are forced to prove their worth on the pitch.
notes: How it ends, you understand immediately and no one - director, screenwriters or the luxurious cast on vacation - does anything to deviate, let's not say a narrative path, but at least a disk.

title: The Insider
actors: Al Pacino, Russell Crowe, Christopher Plummer, Diane Venora, Philip Baker Hall, Lindsay Crouse, Debi Mazar, Stephen Tobolowsky, Colm Feore, Bruce McGill, Gina Gershon, Michael Gambon, Rip Thorn, Lynne Thigpen, Hallie Kate Eisenberg
description: Lowell Bergman's world is the fast-paced world of assault information: "60 minutes", CBS flagship program, famous for its topical interviews. Jeffrey Wigand's, on the other hand, is a private world, marked by the daily rhythms of the family, upset by his sudden dismissal from the tobacco multinational for which he is a manager. Wigand is a scientist, his morality can no longer tolerate what he sees. Bergman marks him tight and convinces him to report. But his world isn't right either.
notes: As in "Heat", Michael Mann still works on two different physiognomies to make them slowly overlap. Intentions almost never match results. It is not enough to have photos of Allen Ginsberg and Martin Luther King hung in the office to be at peace with one's past. It is not enough to have studied with Marcuse. Nor is it enough to simply go away in silence. Both, in some subtle and insinuating way, betrayed who they were. And both of them find it again: "What has changed?". "You mean from this morning?". "No, I mean forever. To hell with it, let's go to court." "The Insider" is not a pamphlet, it is not the usual social film: it is a rare example of great moral cinema, of atrocious digging into what we were and what we have become. There are no alibis: as Al Pacino's wife says: "You have to know what you want to do before you do it."

title: The End of the Affair
actors: Julianne Moore, Ralph Fiennes, Stephen Rea, Ian Hart, Jason Isaacs
description: Great Britain, World War II. The novelist Maurice and Sarah, Henry's unhappy wife, love each other with abandon as London crumbles. The writer obsessively asks the woman not to be left, to be loved even every tomorrow of her life. But an unexpected rival, God, will push her away, due to a vote ...
notes: Taken from one of Graham Greene's masterpieces, "The End of the Adventure", played by a magnificent cast and perfect in all roles, an exciting and very dense melodrama. Love impossibility, existential unhappiness, moral philosophy and religious torment are some of the ghosts staged by Neil Jordan with impeccable style.

title: Simon Magus
actors: Ian Holm, Noah Taylor, Rutger Hauer, Stuart Townsend, Sean McGinley
description: Simon Magus, the son of a Jew and a gentile, lives in nineteenth-century Silesia. Simon and his land have something in common, they both live in a borderland. Silesia always ready to change masters and Simon, who lives a bestial existence in a shack on a hill, fails to regulate his two ethnic and religious natures. He would like to be a good Jew and instead risk involving his community in a shady commercial affair that could spell his end.
notes: Simon, like Simon the magician who offered Peter money to become the thirteenth apostle, would do anything to be accepted, even sell his soul to a devil who has the creepy features of Ian Holm. A dark, nocturnal, fascinating film, with an intellectual soul that is embodied in the poet count Albrecht (the revived Rutger Hauer), and in Sara, a young Jewish woman converted to poetry.

title: La vita cambia
actors: Isabella Ferrari, Mariangela Melato, Urbano Barberini, Antonello Fassari
description: Anna was released after a dramatic six-month kidnapping. Her husband Luca managed to pay the ransom and save her despite Viola, the deputy prosecutor, having imposed a freeze on assets. During the interrogations she is subjected to, Anna shows that she is confused and too often falls into contradiction. Viola, who has had to deal with many kidnappings, puts her under pressure with the belief that the woman is hiding something. Luca, for his part, is unable to accept that their life is no longer the same as it was before and Anna is tormented by a horrible secret that does not allow her to live peacefully.

title: Nude calde e pure
description: The film deals with the theme of the relationship that different populations and, in particular, Scandinavian and Polynesian populations face the theme of sexuality. In order to demonstrate their position, the duo of directors edited clips of films of various genres with lack of professionalism. Naturally and given the subject, female nudes abound and the alleged investigation stops at a voyeuristic level. The example that the two directors follow is that of documentary making at Iacopetti.

title: O.K. Nerone
actors: Walter Chiari, Carlo Campanini, Silvana Pampanini, Jackie Frost
