description: John and Jimmy, two American sailors in Rome as tourists, visit the Colosseum where they are attacked by a gang of thugs. Passed out from the blows and transported to the world of dreams, they believe they are in ancient Rome, at the time of Nero.
notes: A food Soldiers supported by a nice group of screenwriters.

title: Messalina, Venere imperatrice
actors: Belinda Lee, Spiros Focas, Giancarlo Sbragia, Carlo Giustini
description: Claudius, elected emperor by the praetorians who liquidated Caligula, is betrothed to Valeria Messalina, a priestess who belongs to the Vestals. The election as empress of Messalina is opposed by a group of nobles headed by Silio who are also opposed to their marriage. Silio's followers hire Marcello to kill Messalina, but the assassin is killed. The same fate touches all those who try to stop it. Meanwhile, Lucio Massimo arrives, Messalina's ex-lover.
notes: Belinda Lee, who tragically passed away a few years later, was very popular then. The film pleased the French very much.

title: El viento se llevó lo qué
actors: Vera Fogwill, Angela Molina, Fabian Vena, Jean Rochefort
description: Seventies: leaving Buenos Aires, Soledad arrives almost by chance in a Patagonian village where time seems to have stopped. As soon as she arrives on the spot, the woman meets the projectionist Pedro and begins to deal with his oddities: the boy in fact expresses himself by quoting phrases from films. But Pedro is not the only bizarre character in the country: there is also an actor full of nostalgia, who lives far from the world ...
notes: Tornatore's _Nuovo Cinema Paradiso_ can be reinvented by deconstructing the plot, like the projectionist of the small Patagonian cinema at the center of this surprising film.

title: Un poliziotto scomodo
actors: Maurizio Merli, Olga Karlatos, Massimo Serato
description: Commissioner Olmi, involved in a firefight outside his home, accidentally kills an innocent man. For this he was transferred to Civitanova Marche, in the province. He tries to rebuild his life by abandoning the brutal methods. Unfortunately, his girlfriend becomes involved in a kidnapping together with an entire school group and Olmi returns to the attack.
notes: Variation on the "executioner of the night" theme, even if Massi and Merli try to outline a tormented character. But the sociological implications matter to a certain extent, it is on the "action" that rotates the film. Maurizio Merli without stunt even in the reckless sequences.

title: The Bone Collector
actors: Denzel Washington, Angelina Jolie, Michael Rooker, Mike McGlone
description: In an unusual gothic New York, yet another heinous show of a serial killer takes place. Fierce and enigmatic, the killer puts a strain on the homicide team, forced to turn to Rhyme, his brilliant retired agent, nailed to bed by a quadriplegia caused four years earlier by a bullet. With the single finger of one hand endowed with sensitivity, the man uses a computer that keeps him alive and in contact with the world. Rhyme listlessly participates in the investigation until he connects with a young agent who becomes his operative arm. The film drags itself with difficulty to an ending that is neither plausible nor compelling. What's good is Angelina Jolie, more and more convincing and mature. His character drags us with great tension between the infernal mazes and the ruins of the fascinating industrial and port archeology of New York at the beginning of the century.

title: Blast from the Past
actors: Brendan Fraser, Alicia Silverstone, Christopher Walken, Sissy Spacek, Dave Foley
description: One evening in 1962, as a plane crashes into their single-family cottage with a garden, the Webbers, a brilliant and obsessed husband and a pregnant wife similar to TV housewives, lock themselves up in a spacious bunker and remain with their baby Adam, imprisoned for thirty-five. years. A fragment of US culture and society becomes an archaeological find as Los Angeles, on the surface, changes and decays. The day comes when young Adam will have to leave the shelter to meet his Eve.
notes: The headlines scroll over the black and white photos of America in the 60s, terrified by the atomic bomb. Past and present trigger a less explosive chain reaction than the narrative premises. The romantic aspect of the film is very mundane. The cast is very interesting.

title: Est-Ouest
actors: Sandrine Bonnaire, Oleg Menchikov, Catherine Deneuve
description: June 1946 Stalin launches extensive propaganda aimed at Russian emigrants, mostly political refugees, living in the West. In exchange for a return home, he promises them amnesty, a Soviet passport and the opportunity to participate in the reconstruction of the Soviet Union. Alexei, a doctor who has fled to France, responds to the appeal of his homeland and takes his wife, Marie and their son with him. Upon their arrival in the city of Odessa, they find that many of their traveling companions are executed or deported to labor camps.
notes: The camera and the decorative and traditional imagination of Régis Wargnier build on the faces of Alexei (a measured Oleg Menchikov) and Marie (a Sandrine Bonnaire very good in some mother scenes) a political melodrama in a familiar interior.

title: La carbonara
actors: Lucrezia Lante Della Rovere, Valerio Mastandrea, Nino Manfredi
description: In the old inn "La carbonara" they eat traditional Roman dishes, sing, play politics, love, watch history (we are in 1825, on the northern border of the States of the Church). There are the real and inexperienced carbonari, the repentant former carbonaro who has become a friar, the brigands led by Lupone with a necklace of chillies, the cardinal and the priests. And there is the beautiful owner of the inn, Cecilia, whom everyone desires and calls, with quivering imagination, as the symbol dish.
notes: Flavors, characters, figures, moods, dialectal inflections, misunderstandings and twists are those to which Magni has accustomed us for at least thirty years. Why do good Italian directors spoil the past behind them?

title: West Beyrouth
actors: Rami Doueiri, Mohamad Chamas, Rola Al Amin, Carmen Lebbos
description: Beirut 1975. Omar and Tarek, both Muslims, are witnesses of the unprecedented horrors of the civil war and cannot understand the reasons for such intolerance. Perhaps because they live in the Des Oliviers district where Muslims and Christians seem to live without problems. Perhaps because both are in love with their Christian friend, May. Among the rubble of the city divided the two kids, always looking for a laboratory where you can develop the film they are shooting, they will learn about the slight movements of the heart.
notes: Convincing work before Aunted Douiriri, entirely financed with European capitals.

title: Mother, May I Sleep with Danger?
actors: Tori Spelling, Ivan Sergei, Todd Caldecott, Lisa Banes
description: Billy Owens is so obsessed with jealousy of his girlfriend that he kills her. He is convinced that, in this way, no one can take it away from him. To try to escape the inevitable questions of the police, Billy decides to change his identity, take the name of Kevin and start a new life in college. Laurel is a model student who has the misfortune to fall in love with Kevin. The love story between the two is going well, but Jessica, Laurel's mother, becomes suspicious decides to investigate Kevin's past and discovers that he is not the person he wants to believe he is.

title: Picture Perfect
actors: Jennifer Aniston, Kevin Bacon, Jay Mohr, Illeana Douglas
description: Kate is single, has a fair amount of talent and is highly regarded by her colleagues in the advertising agency where she works. But her boss, considering her too independent and free from ties, refuses her the promotion that, instead, she deserves. Even his mother would like him engaged and Kate, exasperated and on the advice of her colleague Darcy, invents a boyfriend, gives him a name, Nick and, as a precaution, places him in another city. Fake engagement gives coupons.
notes: Jennifer Aniston, Brad Pitt's eternal girlfriend (waiting for the wedding), is the protagonist of this tender and funny comedy.

title: Il profumo della signora in nero
actors: Mimsy Farmer, Maurizio Bonuglia, Mario Scaccia, Orazio Orlando, Aldo Valletti, Jho Jenkins, Nike Arrighi, Lara Wendel, Aleka Paizi, Renata Zamengo, Ugo Carboni, Carla Mancini, Luigi Antonio Guerra
description: Silvia, director of a chemistry laboratory, killed her mother as a child. The crime, which remained buried in the woman's unconscious for years, is revoked by the sect of a Senegalese scholar who practices black magic. The purpose of the sect, which also includes Silvia's boyfriend, is to transplant some cannibalistic practices to Rome. The adepts drive Silvia to madness to induce her to commit suicide and thus be able to feed on her body.
notes: Atmospheric Italian horror, built by combining Polanski-like suspense and Dario Argento-style glimpses of violence. The Roman setting (al Coppedè) is to scream in every sense.

title: Baby the Rain Must Fall
actors: Steve McQueen, Lee Remick, Don Murray, Paul Fix, Josephine Hutchinson
description: While Henry, accused of murder, is about to be released from prison, his wife Georgette with her daughter reaches a small village in Texas. Henry, meanwhile released from prison, has rented a house to devote himself to his passion, music. As a young man he had set up an orchestra with which he had performed in jazz clubs. But today as then he is hindered by Mrs. Kate, to whom he was entrusted at an early age. When Kate dies, Henry, who also tries to keep himself faithful to his family, hopes to be able to cultivate his passion.
notes: An unusual drama involving McQueen and Lee Remick. Great soundtrack.

title: I masnadieri
actors: Daniela Rocca, Antonio Cifariello, Salvo Randone, Folco Lulli
description: The Duke of Bolsena, Fabrizio Frangipane, after having the prince of Portoreale arrested, a rival in the succession to the Vatican throne, kidnaps his daughter Alba. In an attempt to rescue the princess, Brother Silenzio and the Sienese nobleman Leonardetto Ardenghi fall, in turn, into the hands of the duke. Thanks to the intervention of a group of thugs, the two escape from prison and free Alba. Since an edict of Sixtus V, who succeeded Gregory XIII, prohibits the use of weapons, the duke resorts to a ruse to capture Alba again.
notes: Costume adventure film faithful to the usual gimmicks of the genre. Bonnard was already an actor in the silent era.

title: Les Félins
actors: Alain Delon, Jane Fonda, Lola Albright, Sorrell Booke, André Oumansky
description: Marc, a fraudster and cheater by profession, is chased by the hit men of an American gangster. To escape his killers, Marc takes refuge in the villa of two beautiful and rich Americans, Barbara and Melinda. The man realizes that someone else is hiding in the villa. It is Vincent, Barbara's lover and also forced into hiding. Vincent killed Barbara's husband and now the police are looking for him. Passion breaks out between Barbara and Marc and this arouses Vincent's jealousy.
notes: I play the massacre indoors: the structure is not new but Clément always finds the right way to create tension.

title: Seduction in a Small Town
actors: Melissa Gilbert, Brian McNamara, Joely Fisher, Donna Larson
description: Paul and Sarah, a young couple with two children, chose to leave the city and move to the countryside. A difficult choice, because it is not easy to fit into the life of a small town especially when you come from a big city. During a picnic the couple meet Sandy, apparently a good girl, actually a person with a very disturbed personality. When Paul and Sarah deny her a loan, she reports them to social assistance for mistreating their children. Sarah's protests are worthless, public opinion is all against her, thanks also to Sandy's false testimony.

title: Sleepy Hollow
actors: Johnny Depp, Christina Ricci, Christopher Walken, Miranda Richardson, Michael Gambon, Casper Van Dien, Ian McDiarmid, Michael Gough
description: Ichabod Crane, an investigator in 1799 New York, is sent to the small town of Sleepy Hollow. Here is a headless horseman who, at night, comes out of hell and goes around cutting off the heads of citizens. In his hunt for the knight Ichabod he can count on the help of Katrina and the young Masbeth, fatherless.
notes: From a short story by Washington Irving, Tim Burton constructs his eerie and ironic horror. A horror that follows Hammer's iconography and narrative scraps. Over everything dominates the fairytale sense of Burton, who knows how to joke with his nightmares but also build thrilling scenes, such as the one in which the knight comes out of the bowels of the earth through the trunk of the tree that has taken root on his grave.

title: American Beauty
actors: Kevin Spacey, Annette Bening, Mena Suvari, Thora Birch, Wes Bentley, Chris Cooper, Peter Gallager, Allison Janney, Scott Bakula, Sam Robards, Barry Del Sherman, Ara Celi
description: The highlight of Lester Burnham's day is daily masturbation in the shower. For the rest, his life always flows the same with a job he hates, a wife and daughter who hate him and who consider him only a loser. But one day he meets Angela, his daughter's schoolmate, and is struck by her sensuality. From that moment his life changes: he quits, gets a good liquidation and begins to live for real. His friendship with new neighbor Ricky, a marijuana dealer obsessed with his neo-Nazi father, makes Lester realize that life is worth living to the full.
notes: Sam Mendes (newcomer in the cinema, but a glory of the scene, after the productions of "Cabaret" and "The Blue Room") owes a lot to the cruelty of David Lynch. Kevin Spacey walks through the film disheartened and sly. The healthiest is the boy who shoots everything with the camera and falls in love with the grumpy and discontented girl. A classic film, which faces Baroque death with the grin of noir.

title: Resources humaines
actors: Jalil Lespert, Jean-Claude Vallod, Chantal Barré
description: In a small factory in Gaillon in Normandy, where the recent graduate Frank works. The boy, who has just arrived from Paris, is the son of a factory worker, who sees his own social revenge in him. Frank is hired to work on solving the 35-hour clash in the factory, but management uses his work to arrange a drastic reduction in staff, which also includes the dismissal of his father.
notes: The debut film Cantet is the first attempt by European cinema to reflect on the theme of reducing working hours. Fiction and documentary marry with balance in this film where the utopia for a better future clashes hard with the interest and cynicism of capital, also provoking profound family conflicts.

title: C'era una volta questo pazzo pazzo West
actors: Vincent Scott, Gordon Mitchell, Denis Colt, Malisa Longo
description: Joe and Rico, instead of looking after the interests of the farm where they live with their missing mother, do nothing but give her a good reason inside and outside the house. Not taking them anymore, their mother sends them to Stranger City where their brother, Michael, more or less honestly runs the saloon. Hostilities temporarily suspended Joe and Rico enjoy the unexpected well-being. In Stranger City Rico meets and falls in love with Floe, the bartender's daughter, while Joe loses his mind to Dolores, one of the saloon prostitutes. But arriving in Stranger City is the mother of three ...
notes: Western environments obtained, and we see, in Lazio, and interpreters below any acting possibility.

title: Pot-Bouille
actors: Gérard Philipe, Dany Carrel, Danielle Darrieux, Anouk Aimée
description: Ottavio leaves the province to settle in Paris. He finds accommodation and employment in the fabric shop of Mrs. Edouard. Ottavio undertakes to work, but his main concern is to court the beautiful women. By adding various pretexts he manages to abandon all the married women who live in his palace. Del Dongovanni falls in love Berta, a girl that the mother wants to see married to Augustus. Ottavio tries to drop the mistress of the shop in his trap, but fails and is forced to fire. To see Berta he must accept a job from Augustus.
notes: Duvivier's film, despite the presence of Gérad Philipe, is a little too far -cured. The screenplay by Henri Jeanson (from a text by Zola) has chips of liveliness.

title: Enigma
actors: Martin Sheen, Brigitte Fossey, Sam Neill, Derek Jacobi, Michael Lonsdale
description: We are in the midst of the Cold War, and the KGB is on the trail of five Soviet dissidents who have taken refuge in the West. The killers sent by the Kremlin are about to reach their goal, that is, they are about to eliminate them. An American secret service agent and a friend of hers come to their aid: the two try in every way to protect them and save them from certain death, but it won't be easy because the killers have no schoolchildren and go straight to their goal .. .
notes: Szwarc is the director of _Bug Bug_fire_ and _The Story of Santa_, and in this television movie he does not properly exploit a theme full of ideas like the Cold War.

title: The Beach
actors: Leonardo DiCaprio, Virginie Ledoyen, Robert Carlyle, Guillaume Canet
description: Richard, a young American tourist, arrives in Thailand with a backpack and a head full of adventures. In the Bangkok hotel where he is staying he meets a French couple, Etienne and the beautiful Françoise. He also meets Daffy, a traveler with years of wandering, sun and drugs behind him. It is Daffy who tells Richard an unlikely story about the existence of a secret island, a veritable paradise on earth. The next day Richard finds a map pinned to his bedroom door.
notes: This time the trio of "Trainspotting" screenwriters, namely John Hodge, Andrew Macdonald and Danny Boyle are shipwrecked in a postcard view that seems straight out of "Blue Lagoon", where a hippy, gifted community apparently lives in peace. despite the isolation, of an immense wardrobe, very chic and very ironed. Even Zalman King wrinkles his characters a bit more. And it doesn't help much the inevitable hell that, before the end, cracks heaven, confused as it is between "Lord of the Flies" and, again, the Kurtzian horror. DiCaprio struggles with a shark, always wears his pants dangerously low in the groin, makes many faces. Maybe he doesn't even know what it is. Overall effect: New Age tourist brochure.

title: Flavia la monaca musulmana
actors: Florinda Bolkan, Maria Casarès, Claudio Cassinelli, Anthony Higgins, Spiros Focas, Diego Michelotti, Raika Juri, Jill Pratt, Franca Grey, Laura De Marchi, Eduardo Filipone, Ciro Ippolito, Carla Mancini, Luigi Antonio Guerra
description: Flavia Gaetani lives in Puglia of the end of the fifteenth century and for imposition it had to take the votes. In response, after the horrid massacre of Otranto, he begins to hatch an unstoppable hatred for Christians and strong admiration for Muslims.
notes: While demonstrating a certain ambition, the film by Gianfranco Mingozzi in the end is a kind of soft porn only more brutal than the average. Violent scenes of sweetened impalance and escort for the TV passage. Only for fans.

title: Scansati... a Trinità arriva Eldorado
actors: Stan Cooper, Craig Hill, Gordon Mitchell, Lucky McMurray
description: Duke lives by cheating and selling fake long life elixirs. He is discovered and then escapes to Trinity. The village ras, Eldorado, lives like a god among his servants, and to rob him Duke asks Ringo and Juanita for help.
notes: Ringo, Eldorado, Trinità (which is a country!): Let's forget the plot. Wrongly attributed to Demofilo Fidani (instead only producer), signed by Diego Spataro, it is actually the real debut of Aristide Massaccesi (Joe D'Amato). He shot it in just over four days, using recycled (bad, by the way) action scenes. The film goes beyond the definition of ugly. Highly recommended for trashofili.

title: Colpita da improvviso benessere
actors: Giovanna Ralli, Stefano Satta Flores, Glauco Onorato, Renato Scarpa
description: Betty who works as a fishmonger in the general markets of Rome lives with the anarchist Luiso, an enemy not only of the bourgeoisie and luxury, but, above all, an enemy of work. Betty, for her part, strives to conquer those goods that Luiso despises. He gets into debt, bribes city officials with generous bribes, scams his work colleagues and sells fish that is not exactly fresh. In this way she manages to conquer what for her is a status symbol: the carpet. Then suddenly things get bad ...
notes: > Comedy that attempts an anarchoid critique of bourgeois society, without great wing strokes but with a brilliant Ralli and some successful sketches.

title: Child of Rage
actors: Mel Harris, Dwight Schultz, Ashley Peldon, Rosanna DeSoto
description: A couple who are unable to have children and who have undergone all kinds of care, mature the decision to adopt twins. The problems for the two begin when they meet the kids they should welcome into their home. Both male and female come from a terrible family experience that does not help them accept their new condition. The child is too taciturn and has an attitude that is too succubus towards adults, while the child is aggressive and unable to believe in the affection of the new parents.
notes: The subject of the film is based on a true story.

title: Rabid
actors: Marilyn Chambers, Frank Moore, Joe Silver
description: A medical center specializing in skin transplants and plastic surgery is built in Canada. A girl, victim of a terrible accident, ends up under the knife for the resettlement of the skin but something goes wrong. Begins to develop a new organ in the armpit that feeds on the blood ... of others. And that, moreover, it is infected.
notes: After "The demon under the skin", Cronenberg adds a second piece to his "epic of the new flesh", the visionary reflection on the body as a container of horrors and beauty. Extreme and not for everyone, but with memorable moments. Marilyn Chambers was a famous porn star.

title: The Edge
actors: Anthony Hopkins, Elle Macpherson, Alec Baldwin
description: A billionaire accompanies his splendid wife and the photographer who must immortalize her to Alaska. The latter is the woman's lover, the husband knows this and meditates revenge. But fate decides otherwise: the two men, in fact, are victims of a plane crash and are lost in the forest. Their presence is not to the liking of the rightful owner, the Grizzly bear.
notes: Tamahori, author of "Once Were Warriors", and playwright David Mamet, screenwriter here, manage to put together one of the most banal and boring films of recent times. Union does not always make strength.

title: Baciamo le mani
actors: Arthur Kennedy, John Saxon, Agostina Belli, Pino Colizzi
description: Stefano, son of the mafia member Angelino Ferrante, is killed by Gaspare Ardizzone because he refused to sell him land. Old Ferrante sends for Santino Billeci from America, from whom he hopes to be helped in revenge. But Gaspare, meanwhile, is becoming the most powerful and ruthless boss in the area.
notes: A very respectable cast for a very violent film but also scollacciato and with too much meat (in every sense) on fire. The director abounds in erotic scenes and represents his story with a boorish style. However, it has admirers. Probable cuts for the TV passage.

title: Blackjack
actors: Dolph Lundgren, Kate Vernon, Phillip MacKenzie, Kam Heskin, Padraigin Murphy
description: A strongman who makes his living as a bodyguard finds himself with a strange phobia: he is afraid of white. The thing is not that it matters much in the economy of history. Our bodyguard, in short, sees his best friend die (killed) and welcomes his daughter as if she were his. Meanwhile, a madman kills the models and the plot twists.
notes: From a John Woo film ("Face / Off") we do not expect narrative coherence because he is a master of cinema, not of literature. But this time he hit the bottom of a glorious career. Apart from the final sequence in a kind of theater, the rest is embarrassing. Involuntary humor.

title: Insel der Furcht
actors: Diana Frank, Arthur Brauss, Sunnyi Melles, Siemen Rühaak
description: Laura Decker is the scion of one of the wealthiest and most powerful families in the country. Family that she, of course, hates with all her might. After the death of her father, new perspectives open up for Laura: she can finally escape. After some time, the youngest of the Deckers is found dead under mysterious circumstances and Laura, for the first time since her father's disappearance, is forced to return to her family's mansion. She immediately becomes involved in two strange accidents whose victims are her two relatives in charge of taking care of the house affairs. Suspecting the intervention of an outsider, perhaps a killer, Laura begins to investigate but soon realizes that she has run into a difficult and particularly formidable opponent. His identity will end up being the most striking surprise of the story.
notes: German TV movie made with some attention to the construction of suspense. Some things don't turn out very well but ultimately watching it is not a waste of time.

title: Femina ridens
actors: Philippe Leroy, Dagmar Lassander, Lorenza Guerrieri, Varo Soleri
description: Dr. Sayer, director of a philanthropic institute, following a childhood trauma grew with the terror of sexual intercourse. He fears that the woman, in certain situations, behaves like the scorpion female who kills the male with whom he has mate. Its complex has transformed him into a paid girl toy torture.
notes: Put highly pursued by the censorship of that time, the film by Piero Schivazappa ("The lady of the night") mask behind psychoanalyties a fairly messy plot. However, in his excesses, the film reveals a certain visionary thickness. Only for fans.

title: I prosseneti
actors: Alain Cuny, Juliette Mayniel, Luciano Salce, Stefania Casini, Ilona Staller
description: The elderly Davide and his wife, Countess Gilda have transformed their splendid villa into a dating house. Odile, daughter of a woman tortured by mercenaries, meets one of the torturers in the villa and wishes to relive the sufferings suffered by her mother on her body. An ambassador abandoned by his partner, he imposes on his new partner to take his place. An unscrupulous eighteen year old sticks an orgy.
notes: Brunello Rondi seeks intellectual justifications to his morbid images, and gets an opposite result to the intentions. Without even the courage to be trash to the end.

title: La strada dei giganti
actors: Don Magowan, Chelo Alonso, Hildegarde Neff, Ivo Garrani
description: In 1860 the Grand Duchess of Parma, Maria Luisa, wanted to equip her small state with a railway, despite the handling of Count Muller and some courtiers. The noble brings the engineer Farrel with whom she falls in love from America. The governor of Milan also put a spoke in the wheel. The handsome engineer is forced to suffer acts of sabotage by a group of men hired by Muller.
notes: Risorgimento in an almost western sauce. Hazardous historical references and implausible faces. But the story is so anomalous that it is amusing.

title: Mademoiselle
actors: Jeanne Moreau, Ettore Manni, Umberto Orsini, Keith Skinner
description: Manou, a recently widowed Italian woodcutter, arrives in a French village in the company of his son Bruno and his friend Antonio. The work of the two men is disturbed by an atmosphere of open hostility, because Manou exercises a fatal and inevitable attraction on the local women. Mademoiselle, teacher, spinster, full of complexes, is also attracted to the Italian worker.
notes: The film uses a screenplay by Jean Genet and the English Richardson (a leading exponent of Free Cinema) wanted Marlon Brando for the main part. Ettore Manni, although good, is not exactly the same thing.

title: Mia moglie torna a scuola
actors: Carmen Russo, Renzo Montagnani, Enzo Robutti, Tony Ucci
description: Following a group of tourists visiting the monuments of the capital, Valentina feels the need to get a culture and decides to go back to school. Aristide, who owns a delicatessen and thinks only of money and his beautiful and prosperous wife, is opposed to the idea. The college chosen by Valentina seems to be one of the most strict in terms of discipline, but the reality is quite different. Meanwhile, Aristide, unable to stay away from his wife, devises various expedients to approach her, without ever succeeding in the enterprise
notes: Montagnani "customs clearance" Carmen Russo in a Pierinesque genre that has already had its day. Everything already seen.

title: H2S
actors: Lionel Stander, Dennis Gilmore, Carole André, Paolo Poli
description: Tommaso, having boarded a futuristic train, arrives in a big city and is immediately lost and alien. Accepting an individual's invitation, he is housed in a large building where some teachers are subjecting students to an incessant pounding of slogans to make them obedient. When Bea tries to rebel, through a trap, she is captured and put to death. Tommaso decides to escape.
notes: Faenza plays the card of political metaphor and tells of a tomorrow that has the defects of today. But the portrait is dated. As for the title, it is the formula of hydrogen sulphide.

title: Tedeum
actors: Jack Palance, Timothy Brent, Lionel Stander, Francesca Romana Coluzzi
description: In a squalid shack, father, mother, Tedeum and grandfather insult each other, beat each other furiously, but, in their own way, they love each other. The four have a document of ownership of a mine rich in gold deposits, in an area that is teeming with swindlers and false documents. But there are those who want to take away this source of income from them.
notes: One of Castellari's lesser-known titles ("Keoma") is a confused and belated western. The soundtrack of the Oliver Onions (Guido and Maurizio De Angelis).

title: Back in Business
actors: Brian Bosworth, Joe Torry, Dara Tomanovich, Brion Jones, Alan Scarfe
description: Joe Elkhart, engaged in a secret operation on behalf of the FBI, was a policeman before being set up and having his badge collected. The official purpose of the mission he is taking part in is to defeat a drug trafficking organization. In reality, the real target of the action is a group of corrupt cops. Among them there are also those who had framed him and therefore Joe will be forced to sell his life dearly.
notes: To be an action movie there is very little. If you then add a Brian Bosworth to the limit of his acting possibilities, you understand what film it is.

title: Il fiore dai petali d'acciaio
actors: Carroll Baker, Gianni Garko, Pilar Velazquez, Paola Senatore
description: During a terrible fight, the surgeon Andrea accidentally kills Daniela by making her fall on a flower-shaped ornament with steel petals. The doctor tears the body apart and turns it into mush. Daniela's half-sister, Evelyn, worried about the woman's absence and knowing that she used to attend the doctor accuses Andrea of ??her disappearance. Thanks to Inspector Garrano, we learn that Andrea is married and has hospitalized his nymphomaniac wife in a clinic.
notes: Thrilleraccio worthy of memory only for the morbidity of some characters. The director was a famous producer.

title: Ansikte mot ansikte
actors: Liv Ullmann, Erland Josephson, Aino Taube, Gunnar Björnstrand
description: Jenny is a psychiatrist. She waits for her husband and children to go away to go back to her grandparents' house, perhaps in search of herself. What she finds instead is a distressing world, where the ghosts of existence come to haunt her. Jenny confides in a colleague but that doesn't seem to give her any relief either. Until, a horrible dream ...
notes: Bergman had passed off the film as a psychological thriller. Obviously he was joking. Or maybe not, because outside the clichés of the genre, this is a thriller of the psyche, capable of evoking nightmare images. Lena Olin's debut in a small part.

title: Luna Papa
actors: Chulpan Khamatova, Moritz Bleibtreu, Ato Mukhamedshanov
description: In a small central Asian village lives the eccentric Bekmouradova family made up of Mamlakat, his father Safar and his brother Nasreddin, psychologically disturbed by the war in Afghanistan. Mamlakat who dreams of becoming an actress and is a regular visitor to the local theater is seduced by a guy who tells her he is an actor. The next morning Mamlakat realizes she is pregnant and goes to town to have an abortion. But in the course of the operation the doctor dies. When Mamlakat confesses to Safar that she is expecting a baby, he sets out on a journey in search of his father. The trio, Mamlakat, Safar and Nasreddin, beat all the theaters in the area to the ground and encounter a series of extravagant adventures. Meanwhile, the girl's belly begins to swell ...
notes: Everything moves with joy and speed in Bakhtiar Khudojanazarov's third feature: vehicles, characters, words. The history and the landscape are shaken by an impulse, a fantasy and a humor borrowed from the tradition of folk tales. Between Chagall, Kusturica and pink neorealism.

title: The Green Mile
actors: Tom Hanks, Michael Clarke Duncan, James Cromwell, David Morse, Doug Hutchison, Bonnie Hunt, Michael Jeter, Graham Greene, Sam Rockwell, Barry Pepper, Jeffrey DeMunn, Patricia Clarkson, Harry Dean Stanton, Eve Brent
description: Paul Edgecomb was the superintendent of death row in Cold Mountain prison and now, now an elderly man, he tells a friend of a very special encounter that took place in "The Green Mile", the wing of the prison where those sentenced to death are held. in 1935, upon the arrival of the gigantic black prisoner John Coffey, accused of killing children.
notes: After "The Wings of Freedom", Darabont still uses a prison tale by Stephen King, in which the writer mixes "tales of memory" with his memorable forays into the supernatural. It is an interminable mile in its 188 minutes of classic cinema and characters of great humanity, but it does not have the grace of "The Wings of Freedom", with a narrative without great waste.

title: The Cider House Rules
actors: Michael Caine, Tobey Maguire, Charlize Theron, Delroy Lindo
description: Homer grew up in the St. Cloud orphanage under the tutelage of Dr. Larch, a staunch abortionist. When he meets a wealthy young couple, Homer joins them and finally manages to break away from the orphanage environment. So he realizes that the rules that have governed his life until then are of no help, especially when he discovers love.
notes: Apple picking and lobster fishing. Dr. Larch's irony and the tenderness of his greeting to the sad-eyed orphans. An American writer, John Irving and a Swedish filmmaker. The unmistakable touch of the Miramax, the emotional core of this correct, elegant, glossy, lackluster adaptation, is a passage from Dickens.

title: Three Kings
actors: George Clooney, Mark Wahlberg, Ice Cube, Spike Jonze
description: A patrol of three soldiers decides to get their hands on a treasure well hidden by the Iraqis. This is the mythical gold that Saddam Hussein stole from Kuwait and which is now hidden in who knows what corner of the country. The frantic hunt allows them to discover the less glorious sides of Operation "Storm in the Desert".
notes: Almost an essay on the evolution of cinematic syntax after the sunset of slow motion editing. Fast, fun and well acted: lovers of the genre will not be disappointed. Instead, it is very ambiguous in the message. Harnessed in the mesh of "politically correct", Russell pretends to point the finger at the dirty war and the army, then makes it clear that the Americans may well be scoundrels but remain the only defenders of freedom.

title: Cavalleria rusticana
actors: Isa Pola, Doris Duranti, Carlo Ninchi, Leonardo Cortese
description: Turiddu returns home after spending a few years in the army and finds his Lola married to a carter. The boy does not give up so easily also because Lola resumes luring him. Meanwhile Turiddu has set his sights on Santuzza, the daughter of a wealthy farmer with whom he found a job, but the love he feels for Lola is stronger than everything. On Easter day Santuzza warns Lola's husband ...
notes: Palermi uses Verga's places and literary text in an almost pre-Neorealist direction. Mascagni's work has nothing to do with it.

title: The Fast Sword
actors: Chang Yi, Han Hsiang Chund, Miao Tin, Wong Lai, Ko Ming
description: After twelve years of grueling waiting, a boy decides to avenge his father killed by an evil individual. To complete his mission he learns to use the sword and gets help from his sister and mother. The first is an ace with a whip, while the mother, although blind, is able to exterminate legions of opponents using a bamboo cane.
notes: “Wuxia pian” as they did then in Hong Kong, distributed in the West in the wake of the popularity of Bruce Lee's films (From China with furore is from 1972). It is not among the high points of the genre, but "only" an honest B-movie.

title: A Bill of Divorcement
actors: John Barrymore, Katharine Hepburn, Billie Burke, Henry Stephenson
description: The old musician Hilary Fairfield, after spending many years in an asylum, regains his reason and is discharged. He returns home with the express purpose of rebuilding a new life. But as soon as he arrives at his destination, he finds himself rejected by his wife, who obtained a divorce during his absence. Fortunately for her, she finds in her daughter, never known before, all that love and understanding that she is anxiously seeking.
notes: The film, based on a play by Clemence Dane, is the debut of Katharine Hepburn, who gives a superb performance here as she stands up to old Barrymore. It was remade in 1940 by John Farrow.

title: Swept from the Sea
actors: Vincent Perez, Rachel Weisz, Ian McKellen, Joss Ackland
description: Amy is a girl who collects the gifts that the sea brings to shore. One day, the ocean offers her the most beautiful gift. Yanko, a reckless adventurer who left his native Ukraine to seek his fortune in the New World. When a storm throws him on the Cornish coast, Yanko realizes he has arrived in a hostile place.
notes: Kidron is inspired by a story by Conrad for a discreet film that has its strong point in the cast.

title: The Deadly Trackers
actors: Richard Harris, Rod Taylor, Al Lettieri, Neville Brand, William Smith
description: Frank Brend and his gang land a heist in the Santa Rosa village bank and to escape capture by local sheriff John Riata, they kill his wife and son. John, a man who hates to use weapons, this time takes it into his head to look for the killers. But the feds are also on their trail. Meanwhile, one after another, the members of the gang are knocked out.
notes: Very modest work that does not rise even with the angry interpretation of Richard Harris.

title: Quella villa accanto al cimitero
actors: Catriona MacColl, Paolo Malco, Giovanni Frezza, Ania Pieroni
description: A young history scholar, Professor Norman Boyle, is commissioned to carry out some research initiated by his colleague Petersen. Norman also has to find out why the colleague killed himself after killing his assistant. The sad story took place in Oak Mansion, a villa that the man had rented and which belonged to Dr. Freudstein, known for his macabre experiments on the human body.
notes: This film by Fulci much loved by overseas "pulp" authors (Tarantino in the lead) is really scary. Ultra splatter special effects by the always great Giannetto De Rossi. To abstain from a weak stomach.

title: Legge violenta della squadra anticrimine
actors: John Saxon, Lee J. Cobb, Renzo Palmer, Rosanna Fratello
description: Commissioner Jacovella tries to make a scorched earth around Antonio Biasi, a robber who killed a carabiniere and then escaped in the car of a boss of the Sacra Corona, Ragusa. Even the men of the underworld throw themselves in pursuit of the young man who in the meantime, frightened by the ferocity of the assassins, decides to turn himself in to Jacovella.
notes: Stelvio Massi, skilled action film professional, with an interesting international cast. Bitter in the mouth for the sociological trappings (the criticism of the media system, the usual spiel about the violent cop), decidedly dated.

title: Les tripes au soleil
actors: Jacques Richard, Toto Bissainthe, Douta Seck, Gregoire Aslan
description: Bob and Bessy are among the guests at a party. He is white, but she has African origins. Seeing them together, other white guests begin to lose their temper: they don't take it out on Bessy but catch Bob and beat him to death. Meanwhile, the blacks are organizing to try to wash the offense with blood. Bob's father and Bessy's father also end up at loggerheads, which various circumstances bring together in the middle of the desert, where however the two men become friends, return to the city and decide to leave with their families a world in which they do not recognize each other. more.
notes: In the year of the birth of the Nouvelle Vague, Bernard-Aubert makes us sip an ideological meatloaf stuffed with metaphors that are anything but subtle.

title: Diaboliquement vôtre
actors: Alain Delon, Senta Berger, Sergio Fantoni, Albert Augier, Peter Mosbacher
description: A soldier who was injured and in a coma for fifteen days wakes up without remembering anything. Beside him, a caring woman claims to be his wife, although she seems completely unknown to him. At first he becomes convinced that he has a huge cuco in his memory, then he begins to suspect that something is wrong. And the mystery deepens ...
notes: Psychological thriller with lightning atmospheres, with the anguish that exudes from the representation rather than from tense situations. Excellent Alain Delon and Senta Berger. Last film by Julien Duvivier ("Don Camillo"), who died in an accident shortly after filming.

title: Behind the Mask
actors: Donald Sutherland, Matthew Fox, Brad Withford III
description: Dr. Shushan has been working for thirty-seven years in a rehabilitation center that employs mentally disabled people in work. He has dedicated his whole life to work, neglecting his family and especially his son Brian, with whom he has a detached relationship. Robert has a heart attack. It will be an opportunity to establish a deep friendship with James, a disabled person from the center, who appears as a savage with no possibility of recovery. He will discover that behind James's rough appearance hides a world of sensitivity.
notes: An indecent TV movie, with Sutherland in disarray.

title: The Butcher Boy
actors: Stephen Rea, Fiona Shaw, Eamonn Owens, Sinead O'Connor
description: France Brady has a failed alcoholic musician father and a psychotic mother. After her mother's suicide she ends up in a religious boarding school, then in a reformatory and finally in an asylum, because according to some, madness is a hereditary defect ...
notes: Neil Jordan is a rather discontinuous director who nevertheless in this fierce fairy tale guesses a poetic vein of great depth, mixing high literary references (Dickens, Twain, "The boys of the Pal street"). Sinead O'Connor appears as the Madonna, sings the title song and enriches the whole. Unpublished in Italy: yet it won a silver bear for best director and Berlin.

title: Bolidi sull'asfalto. A tutta birra!
actors: Giacomo Agostini, Daniela Giordano, Gianfranco D'Angelo
description: A young mechanic, Mino, would like to be a motorcycle racer but does not have enough means to make the dream come true. A friend decides to help him: so Mino begins to have some competition among the amateurs. The real stroke of luck, however, comes when he meets Giò, a rich girl who gives him the opportunity to join a great team. The podium is no longer just a mirage ...
notes: The great motorcycling champion Giacomo Agostini (8 world championships in 500, seven in 350) in a dull little film that only rears up when he gets on the track. It is only valid because it is anomalous, among the titles of the time.

title: Zio Tom. Addio zio Tom
description: From the "Africa Addio" series, this time, however, dedicated to slavery in the United States. A pseudo-documentary made by two authors who have long been devoted to the genre, endowed with means and undoubted technical skills, definitely badly spent. Jacopetti and Prosperi have a morbid gaze, and their production pays a pledge to a latent racism (the title does not help, with the reference to the stereotype of Uncle Tom) and alarming. "Goodbye Uncle Tom" (later re-edited without farewell) was made in Haiti. The dictator Papa Doc himself would have favored the difficult processing among the hundreds of native extras.

title: Touche pas à la femme blanche
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Catherine Deneuve, Ugo Tognazzi, Philippe Noiret, Michel Piccoli, Serge Reggiani, Alain Cuny, Darry Cowl, Monique Chaumette, Daniele Dublino, Henri Piccoli, Franco Fabrizi, Paolo Villaggio, Laurente Vedres, Franca Bettoia
description: Bulldozers demolish the popular district of Les Halles in Paris. The pit that remains is transformed into a kind of Little Big Horn, the mythical place on the American plain where General Custer was besieged, defeated and finally slaughtered by Sitting Bull's Sioux. Even in the heart of Paris, the Seventh Cavalry seems to be cornered.
notes: Marco Ferreri, in one of his less brilliant works, creates an all-French (and slightly cerebral) allegory by recovering the legend of General Custer, with the metropolitan marginalized transformed into Indians. Pesantuccio, with some flashes of genius.

title: The Impossible Object
actors: Alan Bates, Dominique Sanda, Lea Massari, Michel Auclair
description: Harry, writer and father of three children, meets Nathalie, also married and mother, in a museum. After some initial perplexity, a feeling arises between the two that turns into love. But while Harry is convinced of the theory that two people can be loved at the same time, Nathalie is of the opposite opinion. So when she becomes pregnant she abandons her husband, convinces the writer to abandon his wife and move to Morocco. But an accident happens to their little girl.
notes: From a tearful script by Nicholas Mosley. Frankenheimer ("Ronin") is not comfortable with comedy and it shows.

title: Arriva Durango, paga o muori
actors: Brad Harris, José Torres, Roberto Messina, Gisela Hahn
description: Durango is a gunslinger who specializes in debt collection. One day he happens in the town of Tucson where Fergusson, a shady businessman, dominates. Durango, who prides himself on his skill with the gun, manages to foil a robbery engineered by El Tuerto, a picturesque and unfortunate bandit. When Durango goes to Fergusson to collect the reward, he refuses it. Indeed, on charges of murder and robbery, he has him arrested. But Durango does not lose heart and with the help of El Tuerto escapes from prison.
notes: Unlikely spaghetti western that nothing adds to a genre already on the avenue of the sunset.

title: Les Misérables
actors: Jean Gabin, Danièle Delorme, Serge Reggiani, Bernard Blier
description: Jean Valjean, sentenced to life in prison for stealing bread, is unexpectedly released. He comes out of prison embittered and brutalized, but chance puts him in contact with Bishop Myriel who offers to host him. Although Jean has stolen his silverware, the religious saves him from another stay in prison by giving him what he had stolen. Indeed, it does more, it enables him to start a new life that allows him to be elected mayor of the city where he has chosen to live. Nobody, except Javert, suspects who the mayor really is.
notes: Academic direction despite a respectable cast and the waste of resources. In France it came out in two parts and was a huge success.

title: L'amant magnifique
actors: Isabel Otero, Robin Renucci, Didier Agostini
description: A beautiful woman who loves horses ends up falling in love with a stable boy. For the sake of his new partner, he leaves his comfortable life and agrees to run away with him who lives like a gypsy on the edge of the city. At the beginning things go well also because the woman madly in love with her new partner does not realize the great difficulties that this type of relationship can entail in the long run. The woman to follow her new love has decided to abandon the lover who has lived with her for years. But soon the coexistence ends up diminishing the wild passion at the origin of their new relationship. Eventually the woman is forced to leave the stable boy and at the same time refuses to return with her former lover who awaits her with open arms.
notes: French film with completely unknown performers and director. The subject is not entirely new, on the contrary it tastes of old. Everything seems obvious and the film turns into a tearful drama. Only good for audiences who love soap and soap operas.

title: Il tallone d'Achille
actors: Tino Scotti, Tamara Lees, Paolo Stoppa, Tecla Scarano
description: The knight Achille Rosso is about to commit suicide. The intervention of a shady businessman, Serafino, leads him to momentarily give up his plans for death. Serafino makes a proposal to the knight: Achille will sign an insurance policy in his favor and will live happily for a week, only to kill himself once the time expires. Achilles, however, after having spent seven days in the midst of revelries, no longer wants to die.
notes: Comedy pulled away. Tino Scotti wears the clothes that are more usual to him: those of the braggart and fearless knight.

title: Insignificance
actors: Michael Emil, Theresa Russell, Tony Curtis, Gary Busey
description: New York, 1954. A film is being made under the room occupied by a scientist. Who is blackmailed by a sinister senator close to the positions of McCarthy, the Republican inquisitor of the "witch hunt". The protagonist of the film is an actress married to a well-known baseball player. The actress and the scientist find themselves discussing the theory of relativity as humanity looms the threat of a nuclear explosion.
notes: A grotesque comedy that plays with some myths of the past century (Marilyn, Joe Di Maggio, Einstein) and manages to amuse as much as it is anomalous and curious. The Italian title is absurd.

title: Lake Placid
actors: Bridget Fonda, Bill Pullman, Oliver Platt, Brendan Gleeson
description: A group of investigators arrive on the shores of a Maine lake to investigate clues relating to a mysterious incident. A paleontologist is involved in the research, following the discovery of a gigantic tooth that seems to be of prehistoric origin. Rich and eccentric mythology expert Professor Cyr convinces the team of scientists to capture and study whatever life forms they find.
notes: Characters almost from comics try their hand at the creature of the abyss, but basically everyone has an ecological soul and despite the danger they want the monster's salvation. It's an unassuming film with the flavor of old B-grade cinema, the one loved by American teenagers in the 1950s and 1960s matinees. A little naïve it is more reminiscent of "The Monster of the Black Lagoon" than "The Shark", even if the reptile is the work of Stan Winston, creator of the dinosaurs of "Jurassic Park" and "The Lost World".

title: Mickey Blue Eyes
actors: Hugh Grant, Jeanne Tripplehorn, James Caan, Burt Young
description: When Michael, an English auctioneer who lives and works in New York asks his girlfriend Gina Vitale to marry him, he provokes a reaction that is anything but encouraging in the woman. Gina refuses the offer and runs away in tears from the restaurant. The mystery is revealed the next day when Michael meets Gina's father. Charming Frank is a member of the Graziosi mafia family in sight in the city and does not allow his daughter to marry a man who is not part of his gangster circle.
notes: At the origin of the film is the megasuccess of the serial "The Sopranos" produced and broadcast by cable TV Hbo, but also "National Lampoon's - The Don's Anlyst". Hugh Grant's blue eyes stand out, James Caan is very wasted.

title: Canone inverso. Making Love
actors: Hans Matheson, Melanie Thierry, Gabriel Byrne, Lee Williams, Ricky Tognazzi, Peter Vaughan, Domiziana Giordano, Nia Roberts, Andrea Prodan, Adriano Pappalardo, Rachel Shelley, Andy Luotto, Mattia Sbragia
description: On a night in August 1968 on the shore of the Moldava the violinist Jeno and together with Costanza retrace fragments of his existence. Jeno tells of when he was still a child and played the violin without knowing the music, consoling the pigs that went to the slaughterhouse. Jeno remembers the beautiful Sophie, a famous pianist, who years later she will conquer with her music. He then remembers the Collegium Musicum which he has the privilege of attending thanks to the scholarship and where his friendship with David was born.
notes: Ricky Tognazzi with "Reverse Canon" leaves the Chronicle to enter History, and does so without neglecting a single touch of kitsch: from the motionless Gabriel Byrne down to the intersection of different eras in the same shot.

title: Verginità
actors: Eleonora Rossi Drago, Leonardo Cortese, Otello Toso, Arnoldo Foà
description: Gianna, an assiduous country girl devouring photo novels, decides to participate in a beauty contest without letting her father know anything. When he realizes that he will never pass the qualifying rounds, he gets discouraged, thus becoming an easy prey for unscrupulous people.
notes: Direction barely passable, the plot rather conventional, the cast interesting.

title: C'era un cinese in coma
actors: Carlo Verdone, Giuseppe Fiorello, Marit Nissen, Anna Safroncik, Nanni Tamma, Lucio Caizzi, Giorgia Bongianni, Antonia Liskova, Mary Asiride, Raffaele Buranelli
description: In a seaside resort where a beauty contest is taking place, a violent storm suddenly breaks out that puts a strain on the nerves of Hercules, patron of the evening and impresario of actresses and fantasists. In the stable of Ercole, among others, there is also Rudy Sciacca, a very popular comedian in the suburbs. When Rudy does not arrive in time for the show due to an accident, Ercole sends Nicola, a young Sicilian driver whose sense of humor he has always appreciated.
notes: Between the desire to outline an "undergrowth" with points of acid Sordian irony and the need not to disappoint his large audience with a good mouth, the Roman director opts for the proverbial blows to the barrel and the hoop. If the author's generosity leaves room for a surprising Beppe Fiorello, the somewhat sloppy direction is distracted - perhaps - by the comedian's gigionism.

title: Human Traffic
actors: John Simm, Lorraine Pilkington, Shaun Parkers, Nicola Reynolds
description: Lulu, Jip, Koop, Nina and Moff are looking forward to their long, highly anticipated and wild weekend. Jip and Lulu have some relationship problems, the former worried that his sexual failures, due to excessive doses of drugs, are a sign of permanent impotence. Koop and Nina have been together for a long time and their relationship does not present any particular problems apart from the fact that Koop is convinced that Nina sleeps with anyone who happens to be in range. For his part, Moff spends his time kneading ...
notes: The debut film Justin Kerrigan is one of the sons of "Trainspotting": five boys in a daily life that flows only in anticipation of the weekend, in the disco, between music and a buzz. In England it had a good success: perhaps it reflects the fashions and idioms of the moment, perhaps it makes a lot of rebellion without real rebellion. Here it seems a little hysterical and a little repetitive.

title: The Passion of Darkly Noon
actors: Brendan Fraser, Ashley Judd, Viggo Mortensen
description: Darkly Noon is a boy who has always led a private life and far from the many temptations that big cities can offer. When his parents die he is found in the middle of a forest in a daze by Jamie. The girl helps him and immediately takes him to the home of a friend, Callie, who offers to host and take care of him. For the first time Darkly Noon comes into contact with the so-called civilized world and, above all, with the female world. His attraction for Callie soon turns into a real sexual obsession, born from her too rigid upbringing. The director of "Riflkessi sulla pelle" settles on pure craft, in a story that is not lacking in suspense.

title: Smoking
actors: Sabine Azéma, Pierre Arditi
description: The fate of the inhabitants of a small town in Yorkshire changes according to whether Celia stops or does not stop and smoke a cigarette in the garden. Celia, wife of the drunken headmaster Toby, decides to access a cigarette and thinks of going into business with Lionel, who is secretly in love with her. Or Lionel, left by Celia, accepts the declaration of love from Miles, her husband's best friend.
notes: Alain Resnais is inspired by Alan Ayckbourn's series of comedies "Intimate Exchanges", using only two actors to play nine roles. Thus he gives birth to twin films that can be seen in any order. Maybe just a game, but very classy.

title: No smoking
actors: Sabine Azéma, Pierre Arditi
description: Celia decides not to smoke and is in a position to accept the court and Miles' declaration of love. The man is not happily married to Rowena, who, for his part, doesn't think twice about cheating on him with all the males in the country. The two can reconcile or continue deciding to be separated on a golf course. Or he can freely woo the maid Sylvie; or even leave with her for an excursion in the fog.
notes: Resnais does not depart from the theater and also for the exteriors he turns on the tables of the stage using only Sabine Azéma and Pierre Arditi. "No smoking" is more "lively" than "Smokig".

title: Du gehörst mir
actors: Peter Van Eyck, Barbara Rütting, Kay Fisher, Erika Remberg
description: Monica and Dieter have a stable of racehorses and are a happy couple. The arrival of Schwering, Monica's former college friend, disturbs the harmony of their married life. The man is a shady individual who thrives on cheating and clandestine gambling. In spite of her unpleasantness and her character, Schwering exerts a fascination on Monica that the woman is unable to resist. Dieter certainly can't stand by and the quarrel between the two suddenly breaks out. The next day, Schwering's body is found and the police suspect Dieter.
notes: Weak direction, as well as acting.

title: La ragazza di nome Giulio
actors: Silvia Dionisio, Gianni Macchia, Anna Moffo, Esmeralda Ruspoli
description: A girl who in memory of her dead father bears the name Giulio lives in Venice with her rich and not very understanding mother. As a teenager she had a homosexual experience with the housekeeper Lia, who taught her to hate men. Over time, the girl manages to escape the relationship with her lover and becomes engaged to Lorenzo. But Giulio is convinced that she does not know how to love.
notes: The homosexual theme and the sensuality of Silvia Dionisio and Anna Moffo caused a certain sensation at the time. Revised today, the film appears dated but not without a certain courage. The director of photography is action movie expert Stelvio Massi.

title: La sfida degli implacabili
actors: George Martin, Audrey Amber, Katya Loritz, John McDouglas
description: The terrible and ferocious Gringos brothers, known throughout the West by the nickname "Relentless", are determined to kill the hated Joe as soon as he is released from prison. The rivalry between the prisoner and the Gringos brothers gives rise to bloody struggles for supremacy in the city. Joe, one way or another, always manages to get away with it and take the skin home.
notes: Spaghetti westerns of little value with modest performers. The outsiders clearly denounce that we are not in the West, but in some Mediterranean location. Mediocre direction and banal subject.

title: L'isola del tesoro
actors: Jack Palance, Patrick Bergin, Kevin Zegers, Christopher Benjamin
description: Captain Bones leaves, thanks to a fortuitous conclusion to a young English boy Jim, the map of an immense treasure hidden on an island. Those who hid it is Captain Flint with the belief of being able to recover it some time later. On the trail of the treasure there is also Long John Silver and his crew of pirate fierce. After so many vicissitudes Jim will also find two important friends in addition to the treasure and will understand that, Avolte, the width is worth more than a treasure.
notes: Yet another version, this time television, of the famous novel by Robert Louis Stevenson with a good cast.

title: Sarah, Plain and Tall: Winter's End
actors: Christopher Walken, Glenn Close, Lexi Randall, Jack Palance
description: John Witting, now at the end of his life, decides to return to die in his old house that he had abandoned many years ago, when his son Jacob was still small. After so many years he finds his son, still full of rancor, his second wife, mother of his third daughter, Cassie and the two sons of his first wife, now deceased, Anna and Caleb. Grandpa's charm affects the whole family, the only one who proves hostile is Jacob. Produced for TV above average only for the stellar cast, especially the duets between Walken and Palance.

title: Forty Pounds of Trouble
actors: Tony Curtis, Phil Silver, Suzanne Pleshette, Larry Storch
description: A casino manager who cannot enter the state of California because he refuses to pay alimony to his divorced wife risks being arrested. Determined to please the daughter of a deceased friend, he takes her to visit Disneyland, thus challenging the police. After various adventures the man ends up in jail, manages to find love and get married again. All under the eyes of the little girl, desperate for two parents.
notes: Sentimental comedy with an unleashed Curtis. Remake of "Come I became a father", in turn remade in 1980 as "And I play the girl".

title: La malavita attacca... la polizia risponde!
actors: Leonard Mann, John Steiner, Maria Rosaria Omaggio, Ettore Manni
description: Returning from Switzerland to Rome, the boss Salviati, known to all by the nickname of "the prince", finds the square ruined by Rudy, a local bandit full of presumption and men with easy assassinations. Between the two litigants enters the commissioner Baldi, who avails himself of the help of Rampelli, a former colleague. Thanks to his collaboration, Baldi reopens the case of the killing of three gang bosses found dead in the house of Mario Olivieri, who in turn disappeared into thin air.
notes: Police series C written among others by Arrigo Petacco. A particle for Jimmy the Phenomenon (Origen Suffering).

title: Una donna di notte
actors: Lorraine De Selle, Otello Belardi, Daniele Vargas, Ajita Wilson
description: Aldo, separated from his wife, to pay food and keep his daughter writes novels. Like all writers aspiring to write thick books, but pressed by his publisher, he is forced to give himself to pornography. The hunt for inspiration and finding it very little in the prostitute who comes to visit him, he keeps an eye on an opposite one who always returns home late at night. With her, Aldo finds inspiration.
notes: Little known erotic film by Nello Rossati that some lover could remember with the title of "The pornogiochs of a woman at night". Certainly cut for the television passage.

title: Maria Maddalena
actors: Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Manolo Arias, Roberta Armani, Ismail Ben Brahim
description: A young and beautiful Jewish peasant, Mary Magdalene, due to her sterility, is repudiated by her husband Amos, a merchant from Magdala. Deeply saddened, the woman is forced to leave her husband the rich dowry she had brought as a gift for the wedding. The arrival of the Roman prefect Silvano offers her the opportunity to take revenge, she is seduced by Silvano and runs away with him. While in the city of Tiberias, Mary is strongly struck by the encounter with John the Baptist, who preaches the coming of a prophet greater than himself in the desert. Silvano, convinced that Giovanni is a rebel, asks for information about him ...

title: The Boondock Saints
actors: Willem Dafoe, Sean Patrick Flanery, Norman Reedus, Billy Connolly
description: A church in Boston, St. Patrick's Day, morning mass. As the priest dispenses the blessing, the two Irish brothers, Connor and Murphy, are walking towards the altar to kiss the feet of the Redeemer. Shortly after, the two return to the factory and, once the work is finished, they relax in a pub in the evening. The next morning, FBI detective Smeker is called to the murder scene of two Russian mobsters, Vladdy and Chekhov. Meanwhile Connor and Murphy are in the hospital seeking treatment for their gunfight wounds.
notes: The slaughter increases minute by minute between the waste of scene blood and confused Latin litanies. The director starts with a good idea but resolves it quickly.

title: Beautiful People
actors: Charlotte Coleman, Charles Kay, Rosalind Ayres, Roger Sloman
description: 1994 World Football Championships: England suffered qualification after the exceptional performance of Holland. The events of men and women revolve around the sporting event in a London that looks like a Balkan province. A hooligan ends up catapulted into Bosnia, in the midst of real war. A Serb and a Croatian meet on the bus. A woman pleads for the death of the son of ethnic rape, a conservative family sharpens the words for the electoral campaign ...
notes: British fresco by a director of Bosnian origin, a little uncertain about the true path to take and didactic in the metaphors. Curious, sometimes funny, almost never moving.

title: Um copo de cólera
actors: Alexandre Borges, Julia Lemmertz, Lineu Dias, Ruth de Souza
description: He is in his early thirties and has locked himself up in a fazenda on the outskirts of San Paolo as a gardener. She is a beautiful and sensual journalist. One evening while he is returning home she sees him and approaches and without saying too many words they find themselves in each other's arms making love. The next morning the man notices that the ants have broken through the hedge of the garden he is tending. This episode is enough to make him unleash anger and fury.
notes: Preceded by a reputation as a small "case" of independent Brazilian production that has grossed mind-boggling figures, the film collapses in wanting to do "Last Tango in Paris" in a Brazilian fazenda. Explicit sex, but unnecessarily calligraphic.

title: L'uomo della fortuna
actors: Sergio Assisi, Giovanni Esposito, Burt Young, Tony Sperandeo
description: Every morning Antonio interprets the dreams for the numerous patrons of a lottery shop, where he works, in the popular district of Naples. One night he saves the life of a mysterious old man who is about to be run over by a van. The man to repay him gives him the numbers written on a piece of paper. In numbers they come out and get Nicola, lucky player, chronically unemployed and friend of Antonio, a win of five billion. From this moment the life of the two undergoes a sharp turn.
notes: An honest attempt to laugh at the mafia and non-working misfortunes by literally giving the numbers, playing with the stereotypes of the drama with funny madness. A debut full of defects that let themselves slip away.

title: Metronotte
actors: Diego Abatantuono, Simona Caramelli, Anna Safroncik, Flavio Insinna, Marco Messeri
description: Paolo, a night watchman for twenty years in Lucca, after a violent quarrel with his colleague Alcide, looks for him to make peace and finds him in a pool of blood, hit by a bullet in the abdomen inside the area of ??a shoe factory. A place that Paolo knows well because the owner Oscar lives in the same complex with his beautiful Russian wife Nadia. The girl, secretly desired and spied on by Paolo, in a chance encounter tells him about her brother Dimitri, who has ended up in jail for a robbery.
notes: Francesco Calogero is a director capable of surprising who, however, inexplicably stops too early in his lyrical journey. The film is intense and the second part exciting, but the director's struggle with the character-Abatantuono is not always won.

title: Quelli della calibro 38
actors: Marcel Bozzuffi, Carole André, Ivan Rassimov, Riccardo Salvino
description: Commissioner Vanni of the Turin police has an open account with the Marseillaise who killed his wife. The resurgence of the underworld in the city pushes the commissioner to set up a special team made up of four policemen who are particularly skilled in handling guns. While one of the members of the gang manages to track down Sandra, Guido's girlfriend, right-hand man of the Marseillaise, he comes into possession of seventy kilos of dynamite.
notes: Dallamano's latest film, an underestimated genre director ("What did you do to Solange?"). A curiosity: Marcel Bozzuffi, who is really from Marseilles, plays the part of the commissioner.

title: Il manoscritto del Principe
actors: Michel Bouquet, Jeanne Moreau, Laurent Terzieff, Leopoldo Trieste
description: Guido, an aristocratic intellectual of sixty, wants to meet Marco, a friend he hasn't seen for forty years, to give him back something that belongs to him. Marco appears hesitant and despite the commitment he has made, he does not show up for the meeting. Their story crosses in flashbacks that of Giuseppe Tomasi di Lampedusa, and the manuscript of his most famous work, "Il gattopardo". Marco and Guido were two frequenters of the aristocrat's salon in the Palermo of the fifties.
notes: Under the aegis of Giuseppe Tornatore, Andò tackles the story with a certain passion, cradles the viewer's attention with the portentous over voices of Antonutti and Herlitzka, but the film is without bite. Leopoldo Trieste is the poet Lucio Piccolo.

title: For Love of the Game
actors: Kevin Costner, Kelly Preston, John C. Reilly, Brian Cox, Jena Malone
description: Billy, a not very young champion of the Detroit Tigers baseball team, is about to be sold and has just been left by the woman he loves; it all happened just before he took the field against the New York Yankees. And it all happens again, the passion of baseball instilled by his father, the first meeting with Jane and the progress of their story, there, in the middle of the field, in the center of that "diamond" that fills his life alone, in the minutes that pass. between one launch and another.
notes: The narrative cue of the film is very nice. It is a pity, however, that this time is diluted in flashbacks that are too long, dissolving the conciseness of the rhythm in a repetitive script.

title: The Million Dollar Hotel
actors: Mel Gibson, Milla Jovovich, Jeremy Davies, Jimmy Smits
description: Los Angeles, 2001. Movers and vagrants have made their home at the "Million Dollar Hotel" where, among others, also lives Tom Tom who fell in love with Eloise; a street angel. Izzy, a drug addict in the "hotel", falls from the roof or rather someone pushed him. The investigation is entrusted to Detective Skinner.
notes: Wenders knows how to create beautiful images, he knows how to evoke the sky of the metropolis, he knows how to fly the camera in harmony with the music. "The Million Dollar Hotel" would be a good movie if it were silent. Unfortunately, kitsch is rampant after 5 minutes.

title: Guo nian hui jia
actors: Liu Lin, Li Bingbing, Li Yeding, Li Yaping, Liang Song, Li Jun
description: Tao Lan ended up in prison because in an excess of anger she killed her stepsister with a beating. It's been seventeen years and now the girl, released from prison, returns on premium leave (it's New Year's Eve), home to her parents. A prison guard accompanies her who does not feel like leaving her alone, since no one has come to pick her up outside the prison gate. The trip makes her discover that China is no longer the same and that the house where she lived with her family has been demolished.
notes: Yesterday and today. Past and present. Society and family. State and individual. These are the knots and clichés of Chinese cinema. The director mixes, with measure, the sentimental economy of the melodrama with the figurative immediacy of the documentary.

title: Hurricane
actors: Denzel Washington, John Hannah, Deborah Kara Unger, Vicellous Reon Shannon
description: Locked in his cell, Rubin "Hurricane" Carter wants to turn his body into a weapon. A warrior student who punches his opponents, overwhelms them in the ring, comes one step away from the world middleweight boxing crown. But the "sixteenth round", the one that gives his autobiography its title, is the most dramatic of his career. He fights in prison where he is locked up for two decades, sentenced to three life sentences for the murder of three people in a Paterson bar. Fortunately, there is a student who has read his autobiography and who has decided to help him.
notes: Norman Jewison draws on the resources of a craft developed and never refined in the 1970s and on the robust interpretation of Washington.

title: A Thin Line Between Love and Hate
actors: Martin Lawrence, Lynn Whitfield, Regina King
description: Darnell Wright wants to prove to a friend of his that he is a true playboy by seducing the most unattainable of women.
notes: Film for the home video market produced, directed and starring by an American television entertainer.

title: Preferisco il rumore del mare
actors: Silvio Orlando, Mimmo Calopresti, Andrea Occhipinti, Michele Raso, Paolo Cirio
description: Two strangers of fourteen years old and very different from each other, Rosario, born and raised in a Calabrian family at the center of a feud and Matteo, the son of a young Calabrian with a good professional position, live one in Calabria and the other in Turin. When Rosario, thanks to the interest of Matteo's father, Luigi, and, with the help of Don Lorenzo, arrives in Turin.
notes: The director touches, with sensitivity and intelligence, the tormented material of his films, sets the scenes with the self-control he asks of his good actors.

title: Suyanda Koroleva
description: Gerda and Kai are two children who love each other as brothers. During a snowstorm it happens that due to a curse operated by the Snow Queen, a sliver of ice penetrates Kai's eye and another into his heart. The little boy becomes numb and mean in this way. Kidnapped by the Queen, he is taken to his ice palace. Gerda, who loves him very much, decides to leave to try to save him.
notes: Animated film based on a fairy tale by Andersen and directed by a director who knows all the secrets of animation. The atmosphere of the fairy tale is fully respected

title: To Face Her Past
actors: Gabrielle Carteris, James Brolin, Patty Duke, Tracey Gold
description: Beth at a young age meets Greg, falls in love with him and marries him. From their union a daughter is born, Megan. Greg's father, intent on destroying their marriage, takes the niece from his daughter-in-law. Separating from her daughter is excruciating pain for Beth, but she can't help but leave the scene. At this point Beth remarries Ken which makes her a mother for the second time. A beautiful little girl is born who is given her name, Lori. Unfortunately, the girl falls ill with leukemia and so Beth goes in search of Megan to ask her to donate the bone marrow. But the surprises are not over, because following medical tests it turns out that ...

title: A Troll in Central Park
description: Stanley is a troll, a fantastic creature who has spent his entire life in the forest, his undisputed kingdom. An evil queen, who has always hindered him, decides to exile him to a gray and flowerless world: the city of New York. Initially confused, Stanley seeks an ideal place to escape the metropolitan chaos. Eventually he finds peace and tranquility within the great green lung of the Big Apple: Central Park.
notes: Don Bluth and Gary Goldman, to whom we owe the successful "Fievel" series, make another professional animated film more Disney-like than Disney.

title: Tiffany Memorandum
actors: Ken Clark, Irina Demick, Luigi Vannucchi, Loredana Nusciak
description: Dick, a Paris correspondent for a major New York newspaper, unwittingly witnesses the killing of a South American politician. Out of curiosity, he begins stalking the victim's driver, who he believes was involved in the murder. The driver dies in the derailment of a train on which Dick is also, who, when collected unconscious, is mistaken for the dead.
notes: From the director creator of "007 nostrano" (or 077) a spy film made with the left hand. Less than the classics of our local B series ("Agent 077 operation Bloody Mary" ...).

title: Flucht in die Dolomiten
actors: Yvonne Sanson, Luis Trenker, Marianne Hold, Robert Freitag
description: Giovanni lives with his wife Teresa and two children in a town on the shores of Lake Garda, and runs a boatyard. Full of debt, he goes to his brother Enzo to get a loan. But Enzo threatens him with a knife. Giovanni manages to get hold of the knife and kills it. Then he escapes to the mountains.
notes: The mountain setting (the Dolomites) is very fascinating, as always in the films of the specialist Trenker. A little less the story.

title: Tall Man Riding
actors: Randolph Scott, Dorothy Malone, Peggie Castle, John Dehner
description: After a long absence Larry Madden decides to return to his native village determined to take revenge on the father of his girlfriend Corinna, who has always opposed their union. Meanwhile, the girl got married and Larry, without knowing it, saves her husband's life and kills one of the attackers. Corinna's husband is blamed for the murder of the bandit, who cannot even count on Larry's testimony, at the mercy of the bandits.
notes: Western series B of the 50s with the absolute star of the trend and a breathtaking female presence, Dorothy Malone.

title: Fear Is the Key
actors: Barry Newman, Suzy Kendall, John Vernon, Ben Kingsley
description: Conducted for numerous crimes before the court of a Lousian country, John runs away from the classroom killing a policeman and bringing Sarah as hostage, the daughter of a oil tycoon. Since the escape, John is arrested by a former policeman, who behind the payment of a cash amount to Sarah's mother is arrested. The oil tanker promises John not to have it arrested if he helps him to recover a treasure kept aboard a plane finished at the bottom of the sea.
notes: Discreet adventurous film that combines the prison drama with the "underwater" vein. A young man kingsley in the spotlight.

title: Five Days from Home
actors: George Peppard, Neville Brand, Savannah Smith, Sherry Boucher
description: A former policeman is sentenced to six years in prison for killing his wife's lover. Just five days before the end of his sentence, he escapes from Southern Penitentiary and travels to Los Angeles to visit his seriously injured son. On his trail there is the usual inspector who tries to take him back to prison. Eventually the two find themselves face to face in a hospital corridor ...
notes: The story of the film's making is certainly more interesting than the plot. Peppard went into debt to complete the film and the failure at the theatrical release caused him to fall into the habit of alcohol for some time.

title: Mayday 40.000 Feet
actors: David Janssen, Don Meredith, Christopher George, Ray Milland
description: Due to bad weather, a plane flying from Los Angeles to New York after a stopover in Salt Lake City to board an inmate is forced to head to Chicago.
