Taking advantage of a sudden illness of the inspector who is accompanying him, the prisoner takes possession of his gun and puts out of order the controls of the plane.
notes: Butler takes advantage of the fashion of disaster films set on an airplane ("Airport" is from 1974) to make a film inspired by that genre. Average results.

title: Roma ore 11
actors: Carla Del Poggio, Lucia Bosé, Delia Scala, Lea Padovani, Maria Grazia Francia
description: Several hundred girls respond to a job advertisement: a company is looking for a typist. Thus, young women from all over Rome flock to the company headquarters waiting to be admitted to the interview. The pressure of the crowd and the attempt of an aspiring typist to pass in front of the others causes a tragic collapse.
notes: From a news story, the starting point to describe the female situation in the early years of the "boom". One of the best films by De Santis, an inspired and very tense fresco that harmonizes the paradocumentary investigation with moments of intense emotional participation. Elio Petri, then a journalist, who had followed the case for "L'Unità" also collaborated with De Santis. Genina's "Three Forbidden Stories" was also drawn from the same case.

title: Free Willy 3: The Rescue
actors: Jason James Richter, August Schellenberg, Annie Corley, Patrick Kilpatrick
description: Jesse has grown up, is now seventeen and is struggling with a gang of poachers who are decimating West Coast whales. Meanwhile, the orca Willy has started a family and she too is forced to fight against those who intend to harm her and her young. Luckily Jesse won't leave her alone to fight unscrupulous fishermen.
notes: The orca saga has reached its third episode wearily, Jesse is now seventeen and frankly he has had enough of his adventures. Last year Keiko, as Willy is actually called, bought her freedom in the icy waters of Iceland.

title: Silvia e l'amore
actors: Angelo Infanti, Anna Maria Rosati, Ugo Adinolfi, Nicola Giarmoleo
description: A young married couple, Silvia and Pierre, she a nurse who works in a gynecological research center, he a journalist author of investigations on sexual issues, is followed by the director at any time of the day. It starts with the engagement and the first sexual experiences and ends with marriage and the birth of children. All accompanied by inquiries on sexual issues, interviews with illustrious doctors and an illustration of biological processes.
notes: Bergonzelli signs a kind of fake investigation into sex and thus celebrates "the beginning of the Italian-style sexymelodrama" (Buttafava).

title: Tizio, Caio e Sempronio
actors: Nino Taranto, Virgilio Riento, Aroldo Tieri, Franca Marzi
description: During a walk on the Appian Way, two lovers notice an ancient statue representing an imposing-looking Roman. When asked by the girl, the boy replies that he is a Roman citizen of no importance. Once the two have left, the statue descends from the pedestal and recalls his political career. Returning with the legions from Syria, Tizio, this is the name of the character, a follower of Pompey and in love with Livia, learns that Pompey is dead and that Caesar has seized power.
notes: Political satire signed by the duo Metz / Marchesi, principles of nonsense comedy and skilled screenwriters. We laugh thanks to Taranto.

title: True Crime
actors: Kevin Dillon, Alicia Silverstone, Bill Nunn, Michael Bowen
description: The young student Mary Giordano is torn between love and thirst for justice. Aspiring detective and secretly in love with Tony Campbell, a police student, she is put to the test. While he is investigating the criminal deeds of a serial killer who terrorizes the city, he is in fact embarrassed to discover that the greatest suspect in the horrendous crimes is Tony himself.
notes: A cheap thriller, with a script written with the left hand but a composite and interesting cast. Although Alicia Silverstone as the student detective is definitely unlikely ...

title: The Tall Texan
actors: Lee J. Cobb, Lloyd Bridges, Marie Windsor, Luther Adler
description: A wagon carrying six people is attacked by a gang of Indians on the trail of a runaway Indian accused of murder by his tribe. The six repel the attack, but remain without their means of transport. In the meantime, they learn that a rich gold deposit exists near an Indian cemetery and, helped by the sought-after fugitive, they manage to locate it. The place, however, is controlled by the Indians with whom it is necessary to come to terms.
notes: Definitely good starting point although the characters are sketchy and unlikely. Lloyd Bridges as Jeff's father.

title: Charlie Bravo
actors: Bruno Pradal, Jean-François Poron
description: A commando of thirteen paratroopers is launched into the heart of the forests of Vietnam. Their mission: to free an important politician held prisoner. In the field where the thirteen land there is no longer any trace of the man, but only the remains of a massacre. The only survivor of the massacre is a French nurse. In retaliation, the commando receives the radio order to massacre all the inhabitants of the neighboring village. Their action arouses the feeling of vengeance of the Vietcong who hunt them down to get them out of the way.
notes: The wound of Vietnam burns badly to the French. Which, it is worth remembering, was "reconquered" by the Vietnamese in 1954 after a historic battle, Dien Bien Phu, and after nine very bloody years of occupation. In this televised war film, Bernard Tranbaree (who signs himself with a pseudonym) revolves around the "wound" but never confronts it. Little incisive action scenes, little contribution of the actors.

title: You and Me
actors: David Carradine, Chipper Chadbourne, Barbara Hershey, Keith Carradine
description: A violent brawl breaks out between customers in a tavern. The one who loses his life is Johnny, a boy who only asked to continue his game of billiards in peace. The killer immediately escapes along with the two motorcyclists who accompanied him. After a few kilometers, however, the three split up so as not to arouse too many suspicions. One of the three, Zeto, completely unrelated to the crime, picks up Jimmy on the street, a boy on the run from his mother and desperate for a father. A tender friendship is born between the two ...
notes: David Carradine, interpreter and director, proves that he does not know which path to take.

title: Una donna da guardare
actors: Pamela Prati, Mauro Vestri, Georges Ardisson, Elisabetta Focardi
description: Gianni is a middle-aged man who has become helpless. He consulted a sexologist who, however, was unable to find the right drug treatment to solve the problem. So she advises him to try to seduce all the women he meets in the hope that someone can unblock the situation. But once again it will be love, that of a beautiful and prosperous psychologist to whom he turned, to make him still capable of loving deeply.
notes: The forms of Pamela Prati, former sexy star of the Bagaglino recycled in generalist TV, dominate the entire film. It is useless to talk about directing and even less about interpretation.

title: The Blair Witch Project
actors: Heather Donahue, Michael Williams, Joshua Leonard, Bob Griffith
description: Maryland, October 1994, three students, Heather, Joshua and Michael, walk into the Black Hills Forest to shoot a documentary about a local legend: that of the Blair witch. The three disappeared without a trace. A year later their video was found, a teasing diary of those five days spent in the woods.
notes: Leaving aside the "custom" phenomena, one could say of the film that it is a bit like those works of art defined as hyper-realistic. Truer than true, therefore false. Once the field of illusions is cleared, the juice remains, at this point reduced to little thing. The assumption is interesting but it was fine for a short, half hour at the most.

title: Il tempo dell'amore
actors: Ignazio Oliva, Natacha Régnier, Juliet Aubrey, Natalia Piatti
description: Love comes as unexpected as spring in the lonely life of Martha, an English woman living in turn-of-the-century colonial Africa. The spark breaks out one day when Martha is on her way to the front to find her brother and an unknown English soldier saves her life. A feeling of frustration builds inside Claire. Something broke between her and Gabriel and quarrels are the order of the day. Giuseppe is in a coma due to an accident. Summer is coming and those who usually went to see him leave, all except Naty.
notes: Campiotti, at the difficult test of the third feature film, fails to treasure past experience and suffocates his light touch in the heaviness of lyrical complacency.

title: Girl, Interrupted
actors: Winona Ryder, Angelina Jolie, Jared Leto, Clea DuVall, Brittany Murphy
description: Susanna notes in a diary the reflections, the episodes, the judgments on her days at Claymoore Hospital. Thoughts and words hold together the fragments of two past years, from 1967 to 1969, in a psychiatric hospital in the midst of other sick creatures. Difficult girls, imploded, and adult women, affectionate and tough. Lisa, the sociopathic leader of the group, Daisy, a voracious consumer of roast chickens and laxatives. Polly, an elephant-girl with a burned face.
notes: The tradition of the asylum set, with its album stickers, medicines, crises, escapes, death that takes away the weakest, care, normality and madness is respected by the director, without inventions and without energy. Jolie took home the Oscar for the role of Lisa.

title: The Limey
actors: Terence Stamp, Peter Fonda, Lesley Ann Warren, Luis Guzmán
description: A jailbird arrives from London to Los Angeles to try to understand what happened to his beautiful daughter who died under mysterious circumstances. Turn the City of Angels upside down like a glove until it stalks a criminal former flower child. Like a ferocious beast, the Englishman makes a clean sweep. He speaks cockney (the dialect of the London slums) and everyone laughs in his face, but he doesn't lose heart, collects and then answers with lead.
notes: "The English" would have been a beautiful noir if there hadn't been someone like Steven Soderbergh behind the camera. Believing himself to be Orson Welles, he breaks up the story in useless flashforwards. So, just to make you believe you are good.

title: If... Dog... Rabbit
actors: Matthew Modine, John Hurt, Lisa Marie, Kevin O'Connor
description: Johnny, released from prison, reconnects relations with his brother and father, who participated in the unfortunate blow that cost him his arrest. That episode cast a shadow over their relationship, because the relatives abandoned him at the time of the escape. Johnny wants to cut a life of gimmicks, but the "family" complicates his plans and finds himself fleeing to Mexico kneading tortillas, waiting for another hit.
notes: Having abandoned the original title, explained in the post-final, the film never goes beyond the limits, but reveals them, in particular those of direction. Especially in the finale, with the overlap of multiple temporal planes, and which, entrusted to someone like Oliver Stone, would have sparked.

title: Tyson
actors: George C. Scott, Paul Winfield, Michael Jai White, James Sikking
description: The film tells the true story of Mike Tyson, who from a petty neighborhood thug went on to become one of the most talked about and strongest boxers on the pro boxing circuit. The first police lecture comes in 1978, when 12-year-old Mike snatches a woman. For him the doors of the reformatory open where he meets Cus D'Amato, the man destined to change his life.
notes: The biography is flat and obviously "tame", with poor Scott doing what he can.

title: Amityville II: the Possession
actors: Burt Young, Rutanya Alda, James Olson
description: A family lives in the little house in Amityville without knowing that the devil himself is treacherous among those rooms. He gradually takes possession of the bodies, and pushes the young Sonny and Patricia, brother and sister, to have incestuous relationships with each other. He then plans to have fun in the face of the inter-family massacre. Meanwhile, an exorcist rushes to the scene, but it may be too late by now ...
notes: The second part of the _Amityville_ series is curiously directed by the Italian Damiani, who, however, fails to lift the fate. Several debts towards _The exorcist_ and very well known scares. The incestuous aspect is interesting.

title: Mr. Lucky
actors: Cary Grant, Laraine Day, Charles Bickford, Gladys Cooper
description: Joe, an officer in the merchant navy and a spare time gambler, finds himself ashore without a penny, nor the slightest hope of an imminent embarkation. On the way to depression, while wandering the streets in search of fortune, he meets Dorothy, a wealthy heiress, president of a committee that coordinates war aid. The woman invites Joe to go to a dance. The man, reluctant at first, accepts on condition that during the evening he can gamble. For him, real life begins again, but defeats and failure are just around the corner ...
notes: Quick and witty comedy, partly ruined by the embarrassing Italian dubbing.

title: Amityville 1992: It's About Time
actors: Stephen Macht, Shawn Weatherly, Megan Ward
description: Jacob Sterling, a real estate agent, buys a grandfather clock on Long Island and, upon returning to California, hangs it on one of the walls of his home. After a short time, strange events begin to manifest themselves and an evil influence descends on the inhabitants of the house, led to gruesome phenomena and violent behavior for no apparent reason. The only one who knows the origin of so much evil is Iris, an occultist neighbor who, however, dies in a strange accident.
notes: Adaptation of a series of novels by John G. Jones.

title: Jungle 2 Jungle
actors: Tim Allen, Sam Huntington, JoBeth Williams, Lolita Davidovich
description: A stockbroker goes to the Amazon to get his wife to sign the paperwork that allows him to ask for a divorce. Arriving there he discovers that he has a teenage son who grew up like a savage in the middle of the jungle. Although reluctant, he is forced to take it with him to the Big Apple. The boy at first bewildered, slowly gets used to living with the frenzy of modern life.
notes: There is someone in Hollywood who has thought of doing the literal remake of "An Indian in the city". Wasted effort, because the French film was already bad. Imagine this!

title: Kadosh
actors: Yaël Abecassis, Yoram Hattab, Meital Barda, Uri Ran Klauzner
description: Blessed Lord for not having made me a woman. It is one of the first litanies recited by Meir, a thirty-year-old student of the Torah; the man has been married to Rikva for ten years, but the couple has no children even if the woman is not sterile. This is a problem for the community and the rabbi tries to force Meir to repudiate his partner. Rivka's sister Melka is forced to marry Meir's narrow-minded Yossef, while she is in love with a young lay musician.
notes: Last act of a three-part reflection on life in the great cities of Israel, after "Devarim" and "Yom Yom". Women are the true protagonists of the film, experiencing firsthand the contradictions of the community that sacrifices every aspect of everyday life to ritual and commandments, including sex. Gitai, who for many years lived far from Israel for his ideas on the Palestinian question, offers us a lucid and painful document on the relationship between the individual and the community.

title: Cornetti al miele
actors: Antonio Catania, Alessia Merz, Lando Buzzanca, Carla Signoris
description: Giorgio lives in anguish for the responsibilities he has towards his family: Roberta the wife, Francesco and Alessia the children, Daniela (best friend of Roberta) ... the lover. Between all five, stories of misunderstandings, anxieties, harsh realities are triggered ... For example: Emiliano, Roberta's old flame (never extinguished), jumps out and Alessia becomes pregnant. The only hope for Giorgio is to follow the enlightened advice of his friend Marino, a sixty-year-old Don Juan who knows women (and horns). Sergio Martino tries (right from the title) to revive the "glories" of his comedies of the 70s for TV, but remains below even the standards of the time. The cast (and the operation) reeks of televised rinse a mile away.

title: Pokémon The First Movie
description: MewTwo is a Pokémon (Pocket Monster) with prodigious psychic powers resulting from a genetic cloning, obtained by manipulating the genes of a fossil hair of the legendary Pokémon Mew. Escaped from its creators, MewTwo wants to take revenge on the world by capturing all Pokémon and enslaving them. Then organize a race on an inaccessible island.
notes: The Pokémon, little animals full of childhood sweetness, were born in 1996 as a Nintendo video game and, soon, they have conquered a role in the world of television animation. In recent years they have become 151 and the most famous of them is the tender Pikachu, which looks like a cross between a hamster and a rabbit. For their film debut, the authors have plundered the cinema of the greats: from "Jurassic Park" to "Species" via "Alien".

title: The Next Best Thing
actors: Rupert Everett, Madonna, Benjamin Bratt, Illeana Douglas, Michel Vartan
description: A gay gardener, handsome and perfect, and a single yoga teacher and subscriber, like every transgressive ex-virgin, to runaway men and wrong stories, are friends for life. They play witty, they console and tease each other with very correct humor, from a political point of view. On a night of euphoria and drinks, they make love and she gets pregnant. They raise and raise their son as in the glossy magazine surveys of new families and modern sexual and sentimental disorder.
notes: The two protagonists studied the skirmishes of historical couples of the classic black and white comedy. But Everett will never be Cary Grant and Madonna, Katharine Hepburn.

title: Escape to Athena
actors: Roger Moore, Elliott Gould, Telly Savalas
description: Island of Rhodes, 1945. While the Allies are ready to land on the shores of the Aegean sea, the Nazis are preparing to welcome them with a super-powerful missile. But the Greek partisans come to the aid of the Anglo-Americans, destroying the base from which the powerful bomb should be launched.
notes: George Pan Cosmatos, of Greek origin, revisits in the worst way a glorious page in the history of his homeland. The only curious thing is the choice of actors. The Nazi played by Roger Moore, completely unlikely, is in the end, and paradoxically, the most successful character.

title: Almost Dead
actors: Shannen Doherty, Costas Mandylor, John Diehl, William R. Moses
description: A beautiful and above all good psychologist is haunted by the visions of his dead mother. Exasperated by the situation, the doctor decides to return to the country where he grew up to try to conduct a serious investigation. On the spot he finds a policeman willing to collaborate with him. The investigations quickly turned out to be very complicated.
notes: The film makes use of the uncomfortable presence of Shanne Doherty, who had debuted in the television series "Beverly Hills 90210" and had given "the best" of herself in "Sex blindfolded". Here too the results are not very comforting. As for the rest of the direction, which amply demonstrates all its flaws.

title: La badessa di Castro
actors: Barbara Bouchet, Pier Paolo Capponi, Evelyn Stewart, Antonio Cantafora, Mara Venier
description: In 1600 Elena, it sucks, brought her repressions into the convent of Castro making use of the authority that her position gives her. Becoming abbess, he manages to subtract a friar surprised in unequivocal attitudes with a nun from punishment. The abbess offers to help them in escape, but cannot prevent the two, surrounded by the bishop's forces, take their lives. Sister Elena waiting for a child from the bishop, is put under investigation by the inquisition and tortured to death.
notes: Seal eroticism with one eye on Manzoni and the other in Stendhal. Small part for Mara Venier.

title: Gungala la vergine della giungla
actors: Kitty Swan, Linda Veras, Poldo Bendandi, Conrad Loth, Archie Savage
description: Wolff, an adventurer of few scruples, wants to regain possession of a large diamond stolen from the Basoko tribe. The precious is now found on the neck of a white-skinned savage known as Gungala. Having been hired as a guide by two uranium seekers, Wolff, after various adventures, manages to find the girl. But when he is about to get hold of the diamond, he is attacked by a panther. Gungala is actually the daughter of Wolff's accomplice ...
notes: An Italian-style "adventurous-erotic" with the presence of Kitty Swan, a generous Dutch actress. With a sequel, "Gungala the naked panther", directed by Ruggero Deodato.

title: La rivale
actors: Gérard Landry, Anna Maria Ferrero, Maria Mauban, Roberto Risso
description: The Marquis Roberto, major of the cavalry, returns to Italy after a long stay abroad. In the past the officer made a close court to Agnes, a married lady. The woman, after the first hesitation, had ended up giving in. When the woman becomes a widow, Roberto would be ready to marry her, except that he knows Barbara, a girl courted by all her colleagues, in particular by Ugo.
notes: Majano, an expert in screenplays for television, proves to be able to direct actors well. That's enough for this little memorable film.

title: Judgement Day
actors: Ice T, Suzy Amis, Mario Van Peebles, Coolio, Linden Ashby
description: A huge meteorite is about to breach Earth's atmosphere and wreak havoc and destruction on planet Earth. The only person who can stop him is Payne. Too bad that the man is not available. Two agents are alerted who with great effort set out on his trail. But the nightmare of the bomb from space has already stirred public opinion.
notes: John Terlesky for the role of the hero Payne thought Mario Van Peebles, son of Melvin, who unfortunately is not in full shape. In the cast, the two rappers Ice-T, also director, and Coolio stand out.

title: How to Get Ahead in Adversiting
actors: Richard E. Grant, Rachel Ward, Richard Wilson, Jacqueline Tong
description: The accumulated stress of launching a new type of ice cream leads Dennis, a good and prepared advertising agent, to freak out. One day the ice cream he should launch on the market begins to talk to him and show an unusual aggression towards him.
notes: Bruce Robinson uses the metaphor of talking ice cream to criticize the world of advertising, which sometimes "ruins" not only the public, but also those who think about building advertising campaigns. Richard E. Grant, a good character actor, returns to collaborate with Robinson who had already directed him in "Shakespeare at breakfast.

title: The Land Before Time V: The Mysterious Island
description: The locusts have taken that destroyed all the fields of green grass that allowed Pedino and his family to feed. The valley, which was once a real paradise for all animals, resembles a desert. Fortunately, beyond the enchanted valley there is a wonderful island shrouded in the thickest of mysteries. Piedino's family in full force decide to leave to discover the secrets of the mysterious island. Here they will find new animals with which they will befriend.
notes: The saga of Piedino arrived, unfortunately, in the fifth episode shows all its narrative fatigue.

title: The Spiral Road
actors: Rock Hudson, Gena Rowlands, Burl Ives, Geoffrey Keen
description: A young Belgian doctor decides to leave with his wife for the island of Java. As soon as he arrived on the spot he notices the painful hygienic conditions in which the population lives. The doctor is convinced that the only religion that can save man is science. So when a tropical epidemic breaks out first and then leprosy, he goes to great lengths to help the sick. However, when a sorcerer openly challenges him, he is forced to change his mind.
notes: The film, a little too verbose, is based on a novel by Jan de Hartog. Gena Rowlands, at the beginning of her career, is already proving good.

title: Earth vs. the Spider - The Spider
actors: Ed Kemmer, June Kenny, Geene Persson, Gene Roth, Hal Torrey
description: In an American town, a man is the victim of a car accident. The daughter Carol, accompanied by her friend Mike, goes in search of her father. The two, after having scoured the state road meter after meter, arrive at the entrance to a cave. Here they find the car on which the man was traveling and his corpse not far away. Having entered the cavity, they come across a giant-sized spider. Back in the city they tell everything to the sheriff who organizes a joke to kill the animal.
notes: The film is not that great, but it is part of that very lighthearted horror genre, typical of the 50s, funny and naive. It deserves indulgence.

title: Pensione amore servizio completo
actors: Christian Borromeo, Lory Del Santo, Marina D'Aunia, Clara Colosimo
description: Germano is surprised by his father in bed with the maid. As punishment he is sent on vacation by his grandmother who runs a "hotel". In reality it is a dating house where the young man, gifted, has the opportunity to go wild with the generous guests. Suddenly the hotel becomes famous thanks to his exploits, but this "doing everything" leads him to impotence.
notes: You touch the hard, but on television most of the offending scenes are cut. Lory Del Santo still called herself Loredana.

title: La notte dei dannati
actors: Pierre Brice, Patrizia Viotti, Angela De Leo, Mario Carra
description: Jean, a journalist known for his skill in solving puzzles, receives a message from his friend Guillame of Saint-Lambert. The prince makes him understand that he is in danger. Going to the noble's castle, he learns that Guillame, dying and assisted by his wife, is hit by a curse. All members of his family died at the age of 35. Searching through his papers, Jean discovers that three centuries earlier a Saint-Lambert had sent a witch to the stake.
notes: Interesting horror, a rare piece of Italian history of the genre. Too bad for the low thickness of the cast.

title: Nouvelle Vague
actors: Alain Delon, Domiziana Giordano, Jacques Dacqmine, Christophe Odent, Roland Amstutz, Laurence Cote
description: A countess, dynamic and rich business woman, picks up a stranger with a submissive character on the street, takes him to her villa, feeds him, and makes him her lover. After getting tired of him she stuns him, takes the speedboat and lets him drown in the lake. A few days pass and another man appears at the villa who appears to be the twin of the one thrown into the water. His character, however, is very different ...
notes: If Godard's latest films are heavy and cerebral, with "Nouvelle Vague" the director still manages to blend poetics and reflection on language. Alain Delon's work on his "double" character is remarkable.

title: Fever Lake
actors: Corey Haim, Stan Adams, Cynthia Baker, Lindsey Brooke
description: Summer of 1966, the schools are over and a group of young people on vacation travels around the United States in search of a place to spend the long-awaited holidays in peace. After wandering around for a long time, and not being able to find a quiet place, they decide to head to Fever Lake. Arriving there they have the bad idea of ??renting an old Victorian house. Within the walls there are tremendous supernatural forces. A truly unforgettable holiday begins for them.
notes: Nothing new in this television movie, non-existent directing and below average actors.

title: Sugar Colt
actors: Hunt Powers, Soledad Miranda, Julian Rafferty, Jeanne Oak
description: Returning from the war, a unit of Northern soldiers mysteriously disappears. Several hypotheses are made and an investigation is also opened that does not yield any results. Two years pass and the family of one of the disappeared receives a letter reopening the case. The detective agency entrusted with the case instructs Sugar Colt to investigate.
notes: Spaghetti western shot with a sure hand by Franco Giraldi, avoids the vulgarity of the genre and stands out for the care of the staging.

title: Continuavano a chiamarli i due piloti più matti del mondo
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Lino Banfi, Isabelle Marshall
description: Franco Franchini and Ciccio Ingrassetti, civilian pilots, are forced to hijack their plane twice in two different countries. The double hijacking is the work of the sons of a billionaire industrialist, Tancredi Torricelli. The man can't stand that the two boys are engaged to lower class girls. Meanwhile Franco and Ciccio have fallen madly in love with two hostesses and are planning an escape to the Bahamas.
notes: Laurenti's film allows the couple of Sicilian comedians to perform in the usual gags. There are also some singing performances and Pasquale Zagaria, alias Lino Banfi, sharpens the weapons of his future comedy.

title: Nosfertau, Phantom der Nacht
actors: Klaus Kinski, Isabelle Adjani, Bruno Ganz, Jacques Dufilho
description: Jonathan Harker, in charge of negotiating the purchase of an old house in Wismar, leaves Holland and reaches Transylvania. Only his wife Lucy, who has sinister nightmares at night, proves opposed to his departure. Arriving on the spot, Jonathan is advised against continuing by the gypsies encamped near the castle, but nothing can overcome his stubbornness. He will soon understand what threatens the region.
notes: Painful remake of Murnau's masterpiece of the same name. Kinski expresses the desperation of those who live in eternity, in monstrous solitude. Herzog mentions the Flemish painters and composes "a picture" of intense beauty.

title: Ballad of the Sad Cafe
actors: Vanessa Redgrave, Keith Carradine, Cork Hubbert
description: United States, Great Depression. Amelia is respected by the whole village, which she supplies with alcohol and medicine. One day Lymon, who claims to be her cousin, introduces herself to her, and she, to everyone's surprise, decides to host him. He regrets it when Lymon joins the woman's husband, who suddenly returned to town after being released from prison.
notes: Simon Callow is a sensitive actor (and also a good writer). Carson McCullers is also a good writer. But the film based on his short story, Callow's directorial debut, is twisted and smoky. Aesthetizing grotesque, on the abyss of ridicule.

title: The Muse
actors: Sharon Stone, Andie MacDowell, Jeff Bridges, Albert Brooks
description: Her name is Sarah. Wear low-cut, silky dresses. She is chatty, sometimes hasty, other times distracted. And it has very expensive tastes. When she enters into confidence, she whispers that she is actually the daughter of Jupiter and Mnemosine (the goddess of memory). She works as a Muse and most directors turn to her if she goes into a crisis of inspiration. His job is to help a famous screenwriter put on the doorstep of a Hollywood studio.
notes: Not a great comedy and not even unpredictable; but one of those comedies that in classic Hollywood circulated in a continuous stream, built on an iron script, jokes at full speed, well-chosen characters. Brooks and MacDowell take second place behind the muse's sunny whimsy. And in the third line is Jeff Bridges, the star, and in the fourth or in "cameos" Martin Scorsese, Rob Reiner, James Cameron, Jennifer Tilly.

title: Do Not Disturb
actors: William Hurt, Jennifer Tilly, Francesca Brown, Denis Leary
description: Melissa, a lively ten-year-old American girl, arrives in Amsterdam on a freezing autumn day. Due to a disease contracted in childhood he is unable to speak, but he hears, and communicates with sign language. Together with her are her father and mother. Once at the hotel, Melissa goes away for a moment to go to the bathroom and on her return she discovers that she is lost. After walking around for a while Melissa finds herself in a dimly lit courtyard, where she witnesses a murder. When the killers become aware of her presence, all she has to do is escape.
notes: Maas, the Dutch director who a few years ago made the remarkable thriller "Amsterdamned", succeeded in having William Hurt act, also staging a night thriller with an unstoppable progression in which he exploits an unusual set like Amsterdam.

title: Magnolia
actors: Tom Cruise, Julianne Moore, John C. Reilly, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Jason Robards, William H. Macy, Melora Walters, Jeremy Blackman, Philip Baker Hall, Melinda Dillon, Luis Guzmán, Henry Gibson, Alfred Molina, Neil Flynn, Michael Murphy, Michael Bowen
description: An ordinary day in the life of nine people. Linda Partridge who married Earl just out of interest realizes she loves him right now that he's dying. Meanwhile, his nurse, Phil Parma, to fulfill his last wish sets out on the trail of Earl's son, Frank, the sex guru. Policeman Jim Kurring meets and falls in love with the drug addict daughter of a presenter who has just discovered she has cancer during a regular patrol duty. Donnie Smith, a former television child prodigy, discovers he has a lot of love to give but doesn't know who to give it to. Rick morbidly attached to the genius of his son, who does not want to be considered a child prodigy, is incapable of a single gesture of love.
notes: The most ambitious and insane narrative of recent years unfolds around two sinful patriarchs, who have arrived at the report of a terminal illness: ambitious because it does not focus, like "Boogie Nights", on a linear representation, but mixes the moment, the here and now, of each one, trying to extract the crux of it; insane because it does not take into account rules, times and rhythms, habits and consistency, in order to send us back this overall image, desperately analytical, daily and yet totally exceptional, intimate and yet shareable.

title: Legion
actors: Parker Stevenson, Terry Farrell, Corey Feldman, Rick Springfield
description: In the not too distant future, General Fleming, who commands a group of special forces, needs a suicide squad to assault a distant enemy base. The choice falls on a group of former life prisoners led by Lieutenant Aldrich and Officer Doyle, a woman who has been given a last chance at redemption. The legion includes Seigal, an electronic wizard, Poe, a beast always ready to fight, Karlsson, a celibate engineer, Ryan, an explosives expert, an unpredictable drug addict Cutter, Goodie, a taciturn killer and Jones, a doctor who blindly believes in mission.

title: L'ombra del gigante
actors: Margherita Buy, Arnaud Arbessier, Marisa Solinas
description: An isolated fortress, a mysterious prisoner, a sparse guard, the commander and his family. Here there is no expectation of an attack from the outside but that of the death of the prisoner that no one has ever seen in the face, locked up in an insurmountable cell. Through the sound of his violin, the man establishes an unstoppable empathy with the commander's wife who begins to duet with him on the piano, but everyone in the fortress is ensnared by the mystery of this Pied Piper of Hamelin.
notes: A film with a calligraphic style that manages to build an appreciable atmosphere of tension and mystery, it is a pity that it has given up on developing a gothic side that the set and the story itself suggested.

title: Stir of Echoes
actors: Kevin Bacon, Zachary D. Cope, Illeana Douglas
description: The life of Tom, a husband and father like so many others, is transformed by the irrefutable proof that paranormal forces really exist. Tom sees his quiet, middle-class life in Chicago change after being hypnotized at a party and after discovering that his son is also in contact with paranormal forces. Tom is increasingly obsessed with the evidence that someone else lives in his home. This lacerating experience brings man to the brink of madness, until he discovers he has a mission to accomplish.
notes: An engaging film in which the "house" plays a prominent role, a normal house in a working-class neighborhood, which hides a terrible secret inside and which casts a disturbing light on the world of the living that surrounds it.

title: The Only Thrill
actors: Sam Shepard, Diane Keaton, Diane Lane, Sam Shepard, Robert Patrick
description: The friendship between Reece and Carol is something special, it's one of those things that happens to very few people. Reece, a well-known Texas town trader who lives on an estate with his teenage son, met Carol, a widow with a teenage daughter, in the 1960s. The two are in love, but Reece who has respect for his wife is afraid to give himself totally. 1970s: Reece and Carol have become friends and nostalgically witness their children's love story.
notes: Pulled between jokes like "who is the love of your life?" and unbearable cinematic quiz sessions, the story wastes thirty years of the characters' lives to slowly drag itself to a deadly ending.

title: Le temps retrouvé
actors: Marcello Mazzarella, John Malkovich, Catherine Deneuve, Emmanuelle Béart, Vincent Perez, Chiara Mastroianni
description: On his deathbed, in 1922, Marcel Proust is looking at some photographs and retraces his life with his memory. But the characters of reality end up mixing with those of fiction. As if projected by a stereoscope on the walls of his room, the characters in his book begin to populate his memories and come to life in the closed world of his small apartment in rue Hamelin.
notes: Fascinating, highly cultured and melancholy interpretation of the last Proustian volume. According to Ruiz, Proust's "Recherche" is a cinematographic work that uses words and not images to swing among the unstable waves of memory. The Chilean director chooses soft and light camera swings. An incessant and irregular flow of figures and thoughts embodied by an excellent cast: above all Malkovich, Marcello Mazzarella and Emmanuelle Béart.

title: Katja's Adventure/Falkehjerte
actors: Fanny Bernth, Lucio Barbazza, Alessandro Haber, Lina Sastri
description: Katia is one of the many little girls neglected by parents today. Some of her peers take refuge in illness, others in stuttering, some in grumpy and wounded isolation. For Katia, the relationship with the world coincides with observation and love for birds. One day, during a storm, Katia saves a hawk, Skreek, and the two "puppies". After an adventurous journey that takes them from a suburb of Copenhagen to Italy, they will get lost to find themselves thanks to other children. In the land of sun and joy, the hawk and Katia will learn to survive, to face dangers and to make new friends.
notes: Fairy tale "on the road" quite successful. Built to be on television.

title: T come Tigro
description: Tigger is a nice, noisy and jujube tiger who feels lonely and would love to jump to the Hundred Acre Forest, where Winnie the Pooh lives, like the other tigers. His frustrated desire throws him into a tiger obsession, hunting his fellow humans and his family tree for the woods. The friends, with the small and affectionate kangaroo Roo in the head, do everything to help him but make the situation worse.
notes: Tender and uplifting, the tale of Winnie and her friends still manages to charm the little spectators to whom it is dedicated, thanks also to a high-level animation and very realistic backgrounds.

title: Bello come un arcangelo
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Orazio Orlando, Stella Carnacina, Paola Borboni
description: Gaetano Avallone, a sales representative proud of his virility, conquers the sixteen-year-old Mariangela, daughter of the lawyer Totonno Fortis Pantaleo. In order to continue to frequent it, he pretends to be a childhood friend of his father who welcomes him willingly. His hope is that Gaetano will free him from his decrepit mother and that he will not decide to die forcing her to exhausting nights of love. Meanwhile, Gaetano is forced into a real sexual tour de force by Mariangela, by Totonno's sister and by a busty servant.
notes: Lando Buzzanca is the master in this film where Paola Borboni was also involved.

title: Parents
actors: Randy Quaid, Mary Beth Hurt, Bryan Madorsky
description: America 1950: in a residential suburb that is very reminiscent of the context of "American Beauty", the young Michael Laemle discovers that his parents love meat more and more. They only eat that. And they prefer it human, if that's possible. Michael talks about it to his school psychologist, who of course takes him for mad. Then he decides to see clearly: is that normal family really cannibals?
notes: Horror comedy that attempts cruel satire towards the American middle class. The idea is more or less the same as Brian Yuzna's "Society". But the results are very different.

title: Lover Come Back
actors: Rock Hudson, Doris Day, Tony Randall, Jack Oakie
description: Jerry, director of an advertising agency, shoots some promotional messages of a non-existent product to please his little friend. As the shorts are about to air on television, Jerry is forced to come up with a product. Carol, an ad belonging to a competing agency, decides to steal the "client" from Jerry. From this moment on, endless misunderstandings and assorted adventures arise involving Carol and Jerry.
notes: Quite apt satire on the world of advertising. The dialogues are biting, Doris Day and Rock Hudson compete in bickering.

title: Au Pair
actors: Gregory Harrison, Heidi Lenhart, Jake Dinwiddie, Katie Volding
description: To raise some money, a student looks for a job. After several unsuccessful appointments she finally manages to find a job as a babysitter. The task is not easy because the girl has to look after the two very spoiled and terribly capricious children of Oliver Caldwell, a wealthy businessman. For the babysitter, the problems increase because she is forced to deal with the young girlfriend of the father of the children.
notes: Not bad this TV movie shot on the streets of Budapest. Little Jake Dinwiddie got a nomination for Best Young Television Actor.

title: Madron
actors: Richard Boone, Leslie Caron, Paul Smith, Gabi Amrani
description: Fortunately surviving the assault of the Comanches tribe, while she was heading to Santa Fé with a sister to found a mission, Sister Maria Elena runs into Madron. The man is hunted by Sam Red, because, to avenge his family, he killed his wife. Madrov, pitied by Sister Maria Elena, who risks becoming a victim of the Indians or some bandit, offers to accompany her. On the way Madrov meets Angel, an old friend of his, who is forced to sacrifice to save his skin and that of the nun.
notes: There is no shortage of adventures and shootings in this Jerry Hopper film.

title: Togli le gambe dal parabrezza
actors: Alberto Lionello, Carole André, Leopoldo Trieste
description: Alberto, an engineer who is over forty, on his return from an inspection, takes Silvie, a French student, into his car. Alberto offers to accompany her to Rome with the secret hope of having an adventure with her. By keeping him slyly suspended between provocation and rejection, Silvie makes sure that nothing happens during the journey.
notes: Franciosa is inspired by the short story "The girl goes to Calabria" by Giuseppe Berto who also collaborated on the screenplay. But it is a dull and polite comedy.

title: Voci dal profondo
actors: Duilio Del Prete, Karina Huff, Pascal Persiano, Lucio Fulci
description: While he is having his favorite drink, a rich man falls to the ground dead as a doornail. The police rushed to the scene and discovered that glass had been pulverized in the ice cubes, which the millionaire used to add to his drink. The daughter does not give up, on the contrary she tries to find out who could have concocted such a diabolical plan. Fortunately, the ghost of the man thinks to direct her in the investigation.
notes: Based on a story by Lucio Fulci himself (who plays the role of the anatomopathologist), the film, admitted by the director himself, was shot with little means and has bad music.

title: La morte bussa due volte
actors: Dean Reed, Fabio Testi, Riccardo Garrone, Adolfo Celi, Anita Ekberg
description: Hidden in the dark, far from each other, two men watch, unseen, a man's attempt to suffocate a woman. The murder attempt was made on the beach overlooking the night club "Estrella". One of the two witnesses is the keeper of the restaurant, Riccardo; the other is Amato, one of the owners. The next day the woman is found dead and her husband has nothing left but to call the police. Bob is called on the spot and begins to investigate Francesco's complex personality.
notes: Misty and rambling yellow.

title: Vola Sciusciù
actors: Lino Banfi, Karin Proia, Rocco Papaleo, Antonino Iuorio
description: In an Apulian village upset by the events of 8 September 1943 lives Sciusciù, fifty years old with the soul and mind of a child. Sciusciù is very fond of Annamaria, a very beautiful and very courted woman; the most insistent suitor is Pompeo, the mayor of the town. One night, Sciusciù witnesses an event that may appear a bit strange to him: three paratroopers from the allied forces - Morgan, Jason and the Italian-American Tony - land near the town. After the first moment of bewilderment, Sciusciù decides to accompany them to Annamaria's cottage who, although upset, offers them protection ...

title: Terra nova
actors: Antonio Banderas, Marisa Laurito, Massimo Bonetti
description: 1950s: following the migratory flow, some Italians choose to settle in Venezuela. Among the first to land in the "new world", a small family who finds themselves disoriented in the face of the harshness of nature and, above all, the "oddities" of the natives. Between misunderstandings and "cultural" divergences, the two peoples will seek the path of a peaceful coexistence.
notes: Calogero Salvo, a naturalized American but originally from Venezuela, tries his hand at this fictional film after a few documentaries always set in his native land. Here he chooses the tones of the comedy, and the unlikely pair Laurito and Banderas (!), To tackle the usual social issue.

title: Love and a .45
actors: Renée Zellweger, Gil Bellows, Rory Cochrane, Peter Fonda
description: Watty and Starlene are two in love with the hobby of robbery. Everything goes smoothly until they are forced to use weapons: two corpses are enough to put the police and the underworld on their trail. As if that weren't enough, the media exploit their fame by turning them into two heroes ...
notes: Have you heard this story before? Is it identical to that of "Natural Born Killers"? You're not completely wrong, but if you are a pulp lover, wait until you change the channel. Rhythm and tension are right, Renée Zellweger deserves a peek and a delirious Peter Fonda camero as a doting hippie will leave you speechless.

title: Night Watch
actors: Pierce Brosnan, Alexandra Paul, William Devane, Michael Shannon
description: A special police team has been created, including Mike and Sabrina. Their task? End the thefts commissioned by the greatest antique dealers in the world. The latest hit is the theft of Rembrandt's "The Night Watch". The thieves stole it from a museum in Amsterdam and took refuge in Hong Kong where they try to place it on the market.
notes: Pierce Brosnan, who has a certain familiarity with auteur paintings ("Gioco a due"), plays with his usual class in this film directed with agile hand by David S. Jackson. At his side is Alexandra Paul, whom we saw in the "Baywatch" series, set on the sunny beaches of California.

title: The Time Shifters
actors: Casper Van Dien, Catherine Oxenberg, Martin Sheen
description: Tom Merrick, a journalist who won a major award, has now found a job in a newspaper. The reporter is always looking for a scoop to take him one step further in his new job. One day, while he is preparing an article, he discovers that in all the great disasters of the twentieth century, from the sinking of the Titanic to the explosion of the Hindenburg, the same man has always been around. The next morning while he is waiting to board an airliner he thinks he recognizes the man among the passengers. Tom also notices that two strange agents who appear to have traveled through time are following him.

actors: Giuseppe Gulino, Aida Bellia, Maria Denis, Gianfranco Giacchetti
description: The Sicilian patriots have withdrawn to the mountains awaiting the arrival, given as imminent, of the liberator, Garibaldi. The wait is becoming more and more dramatic every hour because the soldiers of the Bourbon army, strong in their numerical superiority, do not leave a moment of respite to the insurgents. The patriot Carmeliddu is sent to solicit the intervention of the Thousand. After much delay, the expedition that will free Sicily and Italy from the oppressors leaves Quarto.
notes: The hero of the two worlds never appears, but is evoked by the speeches of his soldiers. A classic of Italian cinema under fascism, with non-professional actors.

title: In Enemy Country
actors: Anthony Franciosa, Anjanette Comer, Guy Stockwell, Paul Hubschmid
description: During the Second World War, Denise, the daughter of a French general marries a German colonel. The girl, however, actively collaborates with the French resistance and helps a group of transalpine spoilers to destroy the secret factory where the Nazis are developing a new type of torpedo.
notes: Keller's film has a completely inconsistent plot and is completely unlikely. The deepening of the characters is also scarce.

title: Valeria dentro e fuori
actors: Barbara Bouchet, Pier Paolo Capponi, Erna Schurer, Umberto Raho
description: Valeria, a young Swede transplanted to Italy and married to a famous musician, is treated by her husband David as a luxury erotic object. The woman who suffered sexual trauma as a child would like to have a child. The misunderstanding and quarrels with David instead lead her to fall prey to sexual raptus that also involve her brother-in-law. David has her locked up in a psychiatric clinic. But the brutality of the treatment methods and the hell surrounding her aggravate her condition.
notes: Bouchet tries to act despite being almost always naked, Rondi seeks the film of denunciation in the folds of the erotic bass. On the edge of trash.

title: Mélo
actors: Pierre Arditi, Sabine Azéma, André Dussollier, Fanny Ardant
description: Paris, 1929: Marcel and Pierre, two former conservatoire violinists, meet again after many years. The former, a bachelor, became an instrument virtuoso sought after at home and abroad. The second, married to Romaine, known as Maniche, is only first violin in a famous orchestra in the capital. Marcel, invited to dinner by Pierre, is immediately struck by the bursting vitality of Maniche. Marcel who is suffering from a disappointment in love is gladly consoled by his friend's wife.
notes: Resnais brings to the screen the theatrical text of an author, Henry Bernstein, out of fashion and creates a harmonious work, a refined game of excellent actors.

title: Les dialogues des Carmélites
actors: Jeanne Moreau, Alida Valli, Madeleine Renaud, Pascale Audret
description: Bianca della Forza with a very sensitive character and belonging to an aristocratic family, she suffers from the weakness of her character. The girl hopes to strengthen him by entering the Carmelite convent of Compiègne. But his weakness, which often translates into unstoppable fear in the face of danger, manifested itself dramatically during the French Revolution. When the nuns are expelled from the convent, Bianca, although she has devoted herself to martyrdom, lets herself be overcome by fear and returns home.
notes: The film is affected by its theatrical origin (a text by Bernanos), but manages to revive the persecution of the clergy in the period of the Terror. Agostini was Bresson's director of photography.

title: Sodoma's Ghost
actors: Robert Egon, Teresa Razzanti, Alan Johnson, Al Cliver
description: Some guys looking for strong emotions decide to spend the night in a house full of ghosts. The ectoplasms belong to a group of Nazis who died in 1943 during an orgy. The house where the boys are now was used by German soldiers as a rendezvous house. But the explosion of a bomb had put an end to their perversions.
notes: The film was interrupted mid-production due to the bankruptcy of the production company, Alpha Cinematografica, which with Fulci had made "When Alice broke the mirror". At the shooting Cliver he only remembers being dressed as a Nazi and astride a curly red-haired girl.

title: A Woman's Secret
actors: Maureen O'Hara, Melvyn Douglas, Gloria Grahame
description: Susan, a radio singer who enjoys good public success, suffers an attempted murder. Marion, a friend of the woman and also a famous singer, confesses to the police that she is the culprit. Luke, a pianist who knows both women well, cannot believe Marion's confession. The two women are in fact very close and Susan owes her splendid career to Marion's courage. His strong doubts and perplexities lead him to investigate the case and discover the truth.
notes: Second film directed by Nicholas Ray which owes a lot to the good interpretation of the O'Hara / Grahame couple.

title: Matchless
actors: Patrick O'Neal, Ira Fürstenberg, Donald Pleasence
description: An American journalist who came to China to look for a scoop that could change his career, is accused of being a spy and sentenced to death. In prison he receives a ring from an old Chinese man capable of making him invisible for twenty minutes every ten hours. Escaped from being shot and returned to his homeland, Matchless, as he now calls himself, becomes an international spy.
notes: The film was conceived by De Laurentiis and Lattuada to launch Princess Fürstenberg on the big screen. Too bad she lacked acting skills altogether. The film is saved in part for a crazy pop air and for Donald Pleasance in Blofeld version.

title: Never Say Goodbye
actors: Rock Hudson, Cornell Borchers, George Sanders, Shelley Fabares
description: Mike, who was in Vienna in 1945 as a medical officer for the American occupation troops, knows Lisa. The girl performs in a club with Victor. A friendship is established between them which turns into love. The two get married and have a daughter. Some time passes and financial straits force Lisa to look for a job. Unbeknownst to her husband, the woman agrees to give piano lessons. Her absences make Mike suspicious, who, fearing she is still with Victor, leaves home taking the child with him.
notes: Reworking of a Dieterle film based on a Pirandello play

title: Pete and Tillie
actors: Walter Matthau, Carol Burnett, Geraldine Page
description: Spurred on by her friend Gertrude, the thirty-nine-year-old Tillie attends the not very young Pete, a great Don Juan. Despite being aware of his shortcomings, she marries him and gives him a son, Robbie. But Pete can't resist the urge to conquer ...
notes: Half brilliant and half sentimental comedy. Martin Ritt has made better films, and Matthau plays the throw.

title: Schlafender Tiger
actors: Hans-Jürgen Schatz, Stephan Schwartz, Inka Victoria Groetschel, Andrea L'Arronge, Fernando Gómez Rovira, Marcela Musso
description: Roodney Ackland certainly could not have imagined, giving his girlfriend Selina the latest George Dyer's best seller, to unleash a real hunt for the author in her. The woman, in fact, is convinced that Dyer is her father given up for dead during the Second World War. George, who claims to be just a distant cousin of Selina's father, leads a quiet existence in a town on the Spanish coast. The man is lovingly cared for by the housekeeper Juanita and a dear friend, Frances. Selina, who is a guest of George's house, develops the conviction that the writer does not want to tell her the truth. So when Frances tries to get rid of her, she pretends to have lost her passport so as not to have to leave. Not even Rodney's arrival can distract her from her thoughts. When the whole country realizes how things really are, George is forced to admit that ...
notes: The film is part of the "Rosemunde Pilcher Collection", a series of television films based on the writer's short stories.

title: The Neighbor
actors: Rod Steiger, Linda Kozlowski, Ron Lea, Benjamin Shirinian
description: Myron Hatch, now about to retire, has put up a house for sale. Interested in the purchase is a young couple expecting their first child. Everything seems to go smoothly, but Myron hides a terrible secret: his mother had died in childbirth giving birth to a child, and he (at the time he was ten) had killed his little brother in revenge. Now that impending motherhood awakens homicidal instincts in him ...
notes: A new portrait of a psychopath that adds nothing to the many stories already seen on the subject.

title: Twilight
actors: Paul Newman, Susan Sarandon, Gene Hackman
description: Harry Ross is a former alcoholic ex-private detective who without a job is forced to be the handyman of Jack and Catherine, a couple of Hollywood stars. There is no shortage of problems in the family because Jack, who is dying of cancer, wants to close some unfinished business. The wife, on the other hand, spends all her time looking for new lovers. Harry soon finds himself at the center of an intrigue with many corpses.
notes: A classic noir directed by Benton, Oscar winner for "Kramer vs. Kramer", who wrote the screenplay with Richard Russo. The film was released only on videotape, and actually it is not very successful, but it differs from the average of productions for the small screen.

title: Spetters
actors: Hans van Tongeren, Renée Soutendijk, Rutger Hauer
description: Three guys living in a small Dutch town have a great aspiration to become motocross champions. Training and competitions alternate with their respective sentimental events. All three boys fall in love with a blonde who runs a rotisserie with her brother. But one bad day, the most skilled of the three, suffers a very serious accident, is paralyzed and kills himself.
notes: The film does not spare us scenes of sex and violence, it is not adequately supported by a solid script and suffers from the lack of a narrative balance. Rutger Hauer has carved out the role of a motocross champion.

title: Bikini Witness
actors: Robert Howard, Katjia Sandberg, Tonya Qualls, Lisa Comshaw
description: Three beautiful girls, Tonya, Venessa and Debbie decide to participate in a beauty contest that takes place on a Californian beach. The evening before the competition, the three friends are invited to a party held in a house by the sea. During the party they witness, helpless, a murder.

title: Splendori e miserie di Madame Royale
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Maurice Ronet, Vittorio Caprioli, Jenny Tamburi, Felice Musazzi
description: Alessio, a homosexual who in the past has trod the boards of the stage and now has been reduced to being a framer, raised Mimmina as a daughter, abandoned by her father at an early age. But his commitment to making the girl an honest woman collapses miserably when Mimmina is arrested. Alessio to try to remove her from this embarrassing situation agrees to become an informer on behalf of the police. Thanks to his precious confidences, the agents manage to thwart drug trafficking, fake paintings and pornographic photos. But Alessio soon sees himself abandoned by everyone ...
notes: A bitter and grotesque comedy, with tragic implications, admirably directed by a great Tognazzi.

title: It's My Party
actors: Margaret Cho, Bruce Davison, Lee Grant, Davon Gummersall, Eric Roberts, Marlee Matlin, George Segal, Gregory Harrison, Olivia Newton-John, Roddy McDowall, Bronson Pinchot, Paul Regina, Steve Antin, Christopher Atkins
description: Brandon and Nick are a gay couple who have been living together for many years. Suddenly, a crisis erupts between the two, leading them to an unexpected separation. A few years pass and Brandon makes the chilling discovery that Nick has contracted AIDS. Struck by the news, he tries in every way to get closer to him. Nick, who knows he doesn't have much to live anymore, decides to organize a farewell party: so he gathers his family and all his closest friends, and for two days entertains them with jokes and jokes ...
notes: _Grease_'s Kleiser (also writer) orchestrates a moving but not blackmailing drama, supported by a good cast.

title: The Big Mouth
actors: Jerry Lewis, Harold J. Stone, Susan Bay
description: Gerald, a bank employee on vacation in San Diego, while fishing on the dock is approached by a diver who gives him a strange map. The mysterious man is Kid Valentine, a thug who has hidden a lot of diamonds in a secret place with the intention of selling it to the highest bidder. But there is one thing that will make Gerald's life very eventful: he doesn't know he's Valentine's double and when he realizes it ...
notes: Almost a theoretical text on the theme of the double gag and the comedian's mask. Jerry Lewis goes at a hundred an hour and builds one of his most beautiful and captivating films.

title: La presidentessa
actors: Johnny Dorelli, Mariangela Melato, Vittorio Caprioli, Gianrico Tedeschi
description: Yvette, an avant-garde dancer, is mistaken for the wife of a severe and irreproachable judge by the Minister of Grace and Justice on a visit to Vicenza. Falling in love with the dancer, the honorable member does not notice how she turns it to her advantage. Between one favor and another, Yvette will even make her debut at La Scala, with results that are nothing short of disastrous.
notes: Remake of the 1952 film of the same name directed by Pietro Germi with Silvana Pampanini. Luciano Salce does not renounce his proverbial sarcasm, but Dorelli and Melato still play the part of the lions. Really go wild.

title: A Mother's Justice
actors: G. W. Bailey, Meredith Baxter
description: Lilah Comminger is a mother who puts her life in danger to capture the man who abused her daughter, who was traumatized by the dramatic adventure.
notes: A television film inspired by a sadly true story that ended with a popular adhesion to the "executioner" woman.

title: El Macho
actors: Carlos Monzon, George Hilton, Malisa Longo
description: El Macho, an unscrupulous adventurer and cheater, resembles El Buitre, a fearsome bandit in the service of Hildalgo. To try to frame him, El Macho agrees to take his place.
notes: Argentine boxer Carlos Monzon even plays the two roles. Sammy Barbot sings the soundtrack. Need to add more?

title: Murder at My Door
actors: Johnny Galecki, Laura Harris, Judith Light
description: Ed and Irene lost a son, Joey, in a fire from which his twin Teddy, a very problematic and obsessive 18-year-old, was saved. Teddy is unable to manage his life and hold a job for more than a month. Not only that, but Teddy, since the day of the tragedy, has big problems relating to Ed and Irene. Relations between them are always very tense and there is no dialogue. The young man begins to frequent a group of friends assiduously, when at a certain moment someone begins to mysteriously die ...
notes: Tv movie thriller format for lovers of the genre.

title: Le italiane e l'amore
directors: Nelo Risi, Lorenza Mazzetti, Piero Nelli, Francesco Maselli, Giulio Questi, Gianfranco Mingozzi, Marco Ferreri, Florestano Vancini, Carlo Musso, Giulio Macchi, Gian Vittorio Baldi, Gian Vittorio Baldi
actors: Attori non professionisti
description: The film consists of eleven episodes inspired by real events and taken from some letters sent to the column of the small post of the weeklies. The intent of the directors, among others, Marco Ferreri, Dino Risi and Vancini, was to testify to the condition of women in the years of the economic boom.

title: One Desire
actors: Rock Hudson, Anne Baxter, Julie Adams, Natalie Wood
description: Tracey, a former dancer, is the co-owner of a gambling house. In love with Clint, a gambler who frequents the place, she decides to abandon everything and follow him. The woman has to act as a mother to the younger brother of the man she loves. Clint's problem is that he doesn't want to have a fixed sentimental bond also because he often loves to change partners. Arriving at his destination, it does not take long to attract the attention of Judith, the daughter of a banker. Determined to have it all to herself, Judith denounces Tracey to the authorities by dusting off her misunderstanding past.
notes: Sentimental-dramatic tale in western sauce.

title: Lo sceriffo che non spara
actors: Mickey Hargitay, Aïché Nana, Dan Clark
description: Jim, an infallible gunslinger, has decided to put his pistol in its scabbard forever. The reason for this choice? He unintentionally killed his father in a gunfight. However, he cannot refuse the job of sheriff that is proposed to him by the inhabitants of a village constantly threatened by a fearsome band of outlaws. To rule the town, the thugs use the support of the banker who helped get Jim elected. But there is more, because the gang leader is the banker's brother, who among other things must keep his brother's daughter secretly in love with him at bay. While the sheriff is trying to restore order and calm to the country, a clash arises between the bandits over the division of the loot resulting from the latest robbery. One after another the members of the gang are killed ...
notes: Western of little value confused in the narrative and full of inconsistencies. Anonymous the cast.

title: L'esercito più pazzo del mondo
actors: Felice Andreasi, Massimo Boldi, Andy Luotto, Giorgio Ariani, Leo Gullotta
description: The adventures of a group of newly enlisted soldiers take place in the barracks of an unspecified town. It begins with a clumsy flag-raising and an equally clumsy attempted kidnapping by a conscientious objector and a friend of his. The two ask to be able to escape to the Caribbean, but, once they have the necessary money, they will in turn be mocked.
notes: A jumble of well-known gags and comic situations of little value. The subject (?) Is signed by Andrea Brambilla and Nino Formicola, better known as Zuzzurro and Gaspare. First film for Giorgio Ariani.

title: La venganza de Clark Harrison
actors: Jim Reed, Martha Dovan, Pat Greenhill, Charles Otter
description: A cowboy, accused of killing the owner of a gold mine, is found guilty on the basis of some false testimony and sentenced to hard labor. After serving his sentence, the man decides to return to his country to find out who he wanted to frame him. Here a real gang of outlaws are in charge of the murder for which the cowboy was convicted.
notes: José L. Madrid shoots a confused spaghetti western, technically poor, with almost unknown actors.

title: A Taste of Honey
actors: Dora Bryan, Rita Tushingham, Murray Melvin, Robert Stephens, Paul Danquah, Michael Bilton, Eunice Black, David Boliver, Margo Cunningham, Veronica Howard, Moira Kaye, Valerie Scarden
description: Jo and her mother Helen are forced to flee the apartment they occupy for financial reasons. Even in the new house, the situation does not change for Jo, who feels more and more alone. Then one day he meets Jimmy, a black boy who is a sailor. But the time has come for Jimmy to leave too. Jo has nothing to do but try to find a job. Except she's expecting a baby from Jimmy.
notes: Accurate psychological study of the characters. A film that is fully part of the "Free Cinema" season, with the typical vitality and the discovery of reality. From a play by Shelagh Delaney. Award for the best male and female interpretation (Melvin and Tushingham) in Cannes.

title: Il momento più bello
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Giovanna Ralli, Marisa Merlini, Bice Valori
description: Doctor Pietro Valeri is a young doctor who enthusiastically dedicated himself to experimenting with new theories on painless childbirth. Pietro is engaged to Luisa, a nurse who works in his own hospital. On his return from Paris he discovers that his partner is expecting a baby. At this point the doctor panics; but it will be Luisa who will carry out Pietro's experiments on her own skin.
notes: Emmer unwillingly directs a comedy tinged with pink, which aims to promote "painless childbirth". Certainly the author's least interesting film.

title: Stranger's Kiss
actors: Peter Coyote, Victoria Tennant, Blaine Novak
description: Fifties. A director of series B films, to give authenticity to the story that is about to shoot, encourages his two protagonists to fall in love for real. The true lover of the woman, a producer who hides a gangster soul, literally goes mad with jealousy and tries to take out his "rival".

title: Assassinio made in Italy
actors: Hugh O'Brian, Cyd Charisse, Mario Feliciani, Eleonora Rossi Drago, Memmo Carotenuto, Alberto Closas
description: Dick, an American journalist living in Rome, investigates the disappearance of Bill, a tourist, and tries to solve the case of a corpse found with heroin in his pocket. Thanks to the invaluable help of a colleague, she discovers that Bill had contacts with Charlie Graziano, a former gangster. Dick would like to contact him, but Charlie is found dead.
notes: Yellow full of clichés. In the cast Cyd Charisse, star of the musical.

title: Tokyo monogatari
actors: Chishu Ryu, Chiyeko Higashiyama, Sô Yamamura
description: Two elderly parents leave the Japanese countryside to visit their married children living in Tokyo. The two have found their way in the capital, one is a doctor and the other a hairdresser. The arrival of mum and dad throws their respective families into turmoil who, with difficulty, bear their presence. Under a pretext they send them to a tourist resort to spend the weekend. Eventually they will be forced to make the return journey home.
notes: In one of the masterpieces of his maturity, with an abstract and essential style, Ozu offers us the bitter portrait of a country that was changing and that ignored the values ??of tradition. But above all a song about the passage of time, about death and about life.

title: La pretora
actors: Edwige Fenech, Gianni Agus, Giancarlo Dettori
description: The inflexible magistrate of a Venetian city is hated by lawyers regularly defeated in court. To knock her out, the rivals invite her twin sister, who is a porn star. And as a coup de grace they decide to have their rude twin photographed and to show the photographs to everyone. Faced with the fraud, the magistrate reacts decisively.
notes: Cultissimo of Italian comedy with Edwige and his first full nude. And speaking of beginnings, "La pretora" is also Marina Frajese's first naked appearance in an Italian film. Lucio Fulci certainly did not go for the subtle with erotic scenes, having a lot of fun.

title: Maigret voit rouge
actors: Jean Gabin, Françoise Fabian, Vittorio Sanipoli
description: Inspector Lognon, while in the Montmartre district, witnesses a shooting. A man is shot to death and his body is picked up by a car which disappears quickly. Commissioner Maigret, in charge of the investigation, thinks it is a showdown between American gangsters traveling to Paris. But Maigret, who wants to see the story clearly, contacts the American embassy in search of information. But a young diplomat advises him to drop the investigation.
notes: Great Jean Gabin who, for the last time, gives his face to the famous commissioner. But the film is flat, and out of time.

title: The Spy Who Came In from the Cold
actors: Richard Burton, Claire Bloom, Oskar Werner, Peter Van Eyck
description: Alec, a British secret agent on a mission to Berlin, returns to London following the death of one of his informants at the hands of the former Nazi Mundt, head of East German counter-intelligence. Alec after making contact with his boss, Control who orders him to capture him, pretends to be an outcast alcoholic to get in touch with Mundt. Sent to prison due to an argument, Alec is approached by a German spy emissary. Released from prison, he comes into contact with Friedler ...
notes: Film full of psychological notation and moments of tension. Ritt adapts John Le Carré's fine novel into a melancholy black and white, and runs a game with no winners or losers.

title: La spia che viene dal mare
actors: John Elliot, Simone Mitchell, Hector Ribott, Jeanine Raynaud
description: While a conference is taking place in Geneva, the American counter-intelligence suspects that an organization is taking advantage of it to carry out an attack. The intended victim is the atomic scientist Lindstrom. Special Agent 027 is sent to investigate.
notes: Rather confused and devoid of any point of interest.

title: Figurine
actors: Giulio Scarpati, Eliana Miglio, Piero Natoli, Enzo Jannacci
description: Genoa, late 1960s. Alberto, son of Carla, a discontented housewife and Italo, a gray official, is nine years old. His favorite hobby is completing the album of the soccer cards with his grandfather, an elderly Communist. The boy only needs one to finish the long-awaited collection. Meanwhile at school her teacher fell ill and, to replace her, they called Luigi, a young substitute teacher from 1968. One day, Italo in an excess of anger, discovered Carla's adultery, snatches the album of stickers from Alberto.
notes: A small independent film well shot and, above all, well written.

title: La viaccia
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Claudia Cardinale, Romolo Valli
description: Amerigo, Stefano's son, goes to Florence to work in his uncle Nando's shop. In a rendezvous house he meets and falls in love with Bianca. To raise the money needed to continue seeing her, Amerigo has no qualms about stealing money from his uncle. The boy, caught in the act, is thrown out of the house and is forced to return home. But the father does not want to hear reasons and takes him back to Florence. Once again chased by his uncle, Amerigo, who continues to see Bianca, is stabbed by a friend of the woman.
notes: Bolognini is inspired by the novel by Mario Pratesi. The film won two Silver Ribbons in 1962. One of the finest outcomes of his talent as an illustrator.

title: When Secrets Kill
actors: Gregory Harrison, Roxanne Hart, Lacey Chabert, Timothy Busfield
description: A mother has had a daughter taken away. The sentence issued by the juvenile court was a real blow to the heart for her. Now the girl has found a new family and is slowly adapting to the new situation. But the woman does not give up and, above all, does not accept the bitter decision of the judges. Through personal investigations, she gets to know the place where her daughter was taken and the name of the family she was entrusted to. For the Newhalls, the situation immediately becomes critical because they are threatened with death. Then, one day, the woman's body is found and the police suspect Greg Newhall, the head of the family.

title: Pane e tulipani
actors: Licia Maglietta, Bruno Ganz, Marina Massironi, Giuseppe Battiston
description: Rosalba, a housewife from Pescara, is on a trip with the whole family to Paestum. Due to a mishap she is forgotten in a motorway restaurant. She is upset and, instead of waiting for the return of her husband and children, she decides to go home alone. But when he finds himself in a car bound for Venice, he gives in to the charm of an unexpected holiday. Mimmo, her husband, enraged, hires a plumber who is passionate about detective stories, to try to find her.
notes: Soldini discovers an unexpected creative streak when one thinks of his previous cinema. Comedy: sometimes on tiptoe, light, sometimes overwhelming. Stellar cast and various sequences that draw applause (the dance hall with Don Backy, Ganz's declaration of love, the gags with the improvised investigator, Andreasi anarchist florist). Devilish music by Giovanni Venosta. Huge success with the public and a shower of silver ribbons and david di Donatello.

title: Simpatico
actors: Nick Nolte, Jeff Bridges, Sharon Stone, Albert Finney, Catherine Keener
description: Vinnie and Carter participated in a horse racing scam twenty years ago that brought in a hefty sum. That rigged win spelled the end of their friendship, but also the relationship between Vinnie and Rosie. Now Carter has become a wealthy racehorse breeder, is married to Rosie and has become a mainstay of the Lexington community. Vinnie, on the other hand, has spent the last twenty years being consumed by the memory of Carter's alleged betrayal. When he meets Cecilia, his life changes once again ...
notes: The consolidated and qualified experience of Shakespeare and the British stages of director Matthew Warchus dictates the few limits and the many merits of the film which showcases a cast of absolute rivielo.

title: Brokedown Palace
actors: Claire Danes, Kate Beckinsale, Bill Pullman
description: Alice and Darlene, two schoolgirls, fresh out of high school, pretend to leave for Hawaii and land in a hotel with cockroaches, for six dollars a night, in teeming, hot and exotic Bangkok. Tourists by chance and unconscious by nature make an affectionate friendship with a blonde Australian rogue, they agree to join him in Hong Kong and at the airport are arrested: in the backpack of the two unwary there would be 13 pounds of pure heroin. Hard prison, punishments, latrines, torture and oriental deceptions, summary trial and very heavy sentence.
notes: Jonathan Kaplan shoots, without flickers and with all possible clichés, this little film, illuminated here and there by the faces of Claire Danes and Kate Beckinsale.

title: Trick
actors: Christian Campbell, Brad Beyer, Tori Spelling, John Paul Pitoc
description: Gabriel is a young aspiring musical writer who dreams of success on Broadway and shares an apartment with Katherine, a friend who is attempting a career as an actress. Gabriel is a bit confused, even in his sexuality, but one night he meets an athletic go-go boy who wins him over. Gabriel is excited by this adventure and looks forward to a good night, but everything conspires against him and finding a free bed becomes a challenge.
notes: A romantic, delicate and funny comedy, which gracefully stages the anxieties of a love encounter. The film is a fun parody of Scorsese's "Out of Hours".

title: Le petit voleur
actors: Nicolas Duvauchelle, Yann Trégouët, Martial Bezot
description: The life of S., 18 years old from Orléans, is elsewhere: it does not include the bakery where the young man kneads baguettes as an apprentice baker. Those interior nights between the oven and a desolate bar in which to drink a beer are no longer enough for him. He wants to escape, to have a lot of money at his disposal, to escape the humiliation of any love when he steals the salary of a girl who has hosted him. His life goes on in the warm light of Marseille in a world of apartment thieves.
notes: The protagonist's new existence is dominated by other repetitive mechanisms that the camera observes with a clear and captivating gaze full of realism and emotion.

title: Les enfants du Marais
actors: Jacques Villeret, André Dussollier, Michel Serrault
description: Cri Cri, now elderly, relives the season of her five years and the meeting with Pierrot, her first and only love. Around her, in the swamp on the banks of the Loire, the memory brings to life "the children of the Marais": Riton, the grouchy and slacker father, her dear friend Garris, the shy intellectual Amédée, the rude boxer Jo and the old Pepè , rich and illiterate industrialist born in the swamp. The hunting of frogs, the collection of lily of the valley, the thousand jobs of Garris and Riton, good wine and the sacred value of friendship, mark the days spent in that corner of rural France.
