notes: A film of memory signed by the revived Jean Becker, son of the great Jacques, never dull and played by an excellent cast.

title: Snow Falling on Cedars
actors: Ethan Hawke, Youki Kudoh, Max Von Sydow, Rick Yune, James Cromwell, Richard Jenkins, Sam Shepard, James Rebhorn
description: A thick fog covers the bay of San Pedro: the next morning, the sky will clear again but the fishing village will never be the same, because one man has been killed and another - a childhood friend - is accused of the crime. The trial follows, one of the blackest pages in American history of the 1950s. A journalist had a love affair with the defendant's wife: he is aware of decisive evidence that could exonerate the accused ...
notes: Weak proof of the Australian Hicks, who had revealed himself to the general public with the tender and dramatic _Shine_: cumbersome and without rhythm, even if with a good reconstruction of the environment.

title: Stuart Little
actors: Geena Davis, Hugh Laurie, Jonathan Lipnicki
description: Stuart is a rat trying to satisfy his need for belonging. So one day she comes across the Little family home looking for some affection. Mom, dad and son adopt him and Stuart soon becomes part of the family. Finally he feels loved and pampered by everyone. The only problem he has to face is living with Fiocco di Neve, the house cat, who feels overshadowed.
notes: The film is fun and well constructed, staged with Goat-like optimism. The duets between Stuart and the house cat are enchanting, while the real actors (a revived Geena Davis and a Hugh Laurie pre _Dr. House) _ manage not to disfigure.

title: Il grande botto
actors: Carlo Buccirosso, Emilio Solfrizzi, Alessandro Di Carlo
description: Ostuni, Puglia. It's Saturday and Michele, the owner of a bar, is listening to the lottery draws in front of an old TV. For weeks he, Emilio, Mario, Giuseppe and Antonio have been playing the same numbers with the hope of making a big bang. This time luck knocks on their door and the five take home eighty-six billion. After the understandable initial shock Michele wonders who is holding the matrix. Antonio has it, the only one of the five who is currently unavailable.
notes: He had already shown that Pompucci likes the grotesque in the past, but the area is risky and a delicate hand is needed. And the director proves he doesn't have it.

title: The Bachelor
actors: Chris O'Donnell, Renée Zellweger, James Cromwell, Artie Lange
description: On the streets of San Francisco, Jimmie - an unrepentant bachelor - has only 24 hours to find a wife, a necessary and sufficient condition to get hold of the $ 100 million inherited from his grandfather. Jimmie would be in love with his girlfriend, but he just can't tell her properly, so she dumps him. The boy, with a priest always with him, tries to reconcile with his ex, but they all refuse him. The last chance he has left is that of an ad in the newspaper ...
notes: The Englishman Sinyor makes an enjoyable remake of Buster Keaton's _The Seven Odds_. A solid cast revolves around O'Donnell.

title: L'escluso
actors: Kevin Isola, Franco Nero, Vanessa Redgrave, Eli Wallach
description: Tony Grasso is a poor and marginalized boy, obsessed, all his life, by his impossible love for his schoolmate, Patricia Karver. The years pass, the little girl of the snack times grows up, gets married and has two children. When Patricia and her family are brutally murdered, Tony is charged with the murder. Lawyer Ralph Barolo will shoulder the burden of defense.
notes: At the cinema with mom and dad. It is understandable that a newcomer, Carlo Gabriel Nero, graduated from the Experimental Center, chooses a thriller as his debut film. Too bad the result is completely disappointing.

title: Company Man
actors: Anthony LaPaglia, Sigourney Weaver, Douglas McGrath, John Turturro
description: His wife would like the fur coat and then the very unlucky and petulant grammar teacher Allan Quimp invents himself a top secret agent of the CIA (higher salary). The trouble is that we are at the end of the Fifties, in the middle of the Cold War: some Russians are asking for political asylum from the United States and many spies are prowling around Cuba, because a certain Fidel Castro would be about to blow up President Batista ...
notes: The only interest in this boring "satirical" film should be Woody Allen's (uncredited) cameo. An Allen who had to return McGrath's favor with the "Bullets on Broadway" script.

title: Vägen ut
actors: Björn Kjellman, Viveka Seldahl, Peter Haber, Thomas Hanzon
description: Reine is a brilliant young actor who, in controversy with the producer of his show, resigns to accept the less prestigious and profitable position of prison animator. Reine clashes with the harsh prison laws, but in the end her project kicks off because the inmates see the possibility of acting in a real theater, a convenient way out.
notes: With this film we discover that in civilized Sweden they basically have the same problems, and the prison institution is very wary of projects aimed at the recovery of the condemned. The film's ending will find a reasonable compromise between the desire to escape and to be protagonists for a night.

title: Possessed by the Night
actors: Shannon Tweed, Ted Prior, Sandahl Bergman, Henry Silva
description: Howard is a horror writer who is trying to get over a creative block. One day while he is walking through Chinatown he is lured by a strange shop. Intrigued Howard enters and buys a jar containing a small monster. Suddenly the writer begins to feel the influence of the strange creature. Not only does Howard find the creative streak but he also becomes sexually aggressive. The change upsets the overly reserved wife. The situation becomes complex when the writer meets his new secretary, a stunning blonde.
notes: The worst director in the world makes an interesting and unhealthy film.

title: I Dreamed of Africa
actors: Kim Basinger, Vincent Perez, Eva Marie Saint, Connie Chiume
description: As a child they had described the magic that emanated from the black continent. But not even in her worst nightmares could she have imagined the pain that Africa would cause her. Kuki, who moved to Kenya in the 1970s, immediately realizes that life in rural Africa is not as romantic as it is said. After losing her husband and child, Kuki starts a nature conservation foundation.
notes: Hudson pays the toll of the "great international operation": an actress in love with the project, an actor who happened to be on the set by chance and a book written by Gullman herself on the tracks of "My Africa".

title: Il cielo cade
actors: Isabella Rossellini, Jeroen Krabbe, Barbara Enrichi, Gianna Giachetti
description: Summer of 1944, Tuscany. Penny and her sister Baby, orphaned of their father and mother, who died in a car accident, live with aunt Nina and her husband Wilhelm Einstein, Albert's cousin. Through Penny's eyes we get to know the strange world that populates the villa and the strange guests who live there. The girl is a witness to the ambiguities of fascist Italy and the horrors of war that also reach the villa nestled in the Florentine hills.
notes: The narrative, fluid and calibrated in each character, recalls that of the television originals of the past.

title: Mondo Grúa
actors: Luis Margani, Adriana Aizemberg, Daniel Valenzuela
description: Rulo is fifty years old and works as a crane operator, but in the 1970s he called himself Paco Camorra and was a famous bass player for a pop group. The former musician has continuous difficulties at work, over the years he has grown heavy and has to support his mother and son who would also like to start a rock group. Then one day he loses his job and finds another 2000 kilometers from Buenos Aires.
notes: The young Trapero, who belongs to the "post-proletariat" generation, avoids demagogy as long as he can and follows the misfortunes of his protagonist with respect as an Italian of the 1950s.

title: Scarlet Diva
actors: Asia Argento, Jean Shepard, Daria Nicolodi, Vera Gemma, Fabio Camilli
description: Anna Battista is a successful young actress besieged and admired by fans. However, her profession drags her from the solitude of her apartment to frantic public appearances, auditions, meetings and travels. But Anna feels more and more alone and does not help much trying to get to know the famous Dutch writer Aaron Ulrich, a man consumed in body and soul by heroin. After all, his relationships are always polluted, even today, by drugs.
notes: It is a bad film, uneducated, tangled, unpleasant, unresolved, but it has more blood and courage than many Italian films of today, asphyxiated and polite.

title: South Park: Bigger, Longer & Uncut
description: The four demons of South Park put their charming little town on fire. The occasion is the screening in the city cinema of "Asses of Fire", a Canadian film forbidden to minors, which the little pests do not want to give up. Stan, Cartman, Kyle and Kenny manage to sneak into the room and enjoy the performances of their idols churning out dirty songs and obscene jokes, but their action causes a chain reaction that brings Canada and the United States one step away from the war.
notes: The caustic comedy of Trey Parker and Matt Stone - the authors of "South Park" - leaves no escape for any of the values ??of the American middle class family. "South Park" is the polar opposite of Disneyland, but its crude design and abusive cynicism offer the public a more real world than that of ducks, mice and fairy castles.

title: Gojitmal
actors: Lee Sang Hyun, Kim Tae Yeon, Jeon Hye Jin, Choi Hyun Joo
description: A forty-year-old Korean sculptor with a wife in Paris and a high school girl who hasn't had sex yet, having met through a chat line, have extreme sex locked in an apartment. Their history is interspersed with walks and short underground rides. But in the end they always return to that apartment where she is the first to undergo bdsm practices, until the roles are reversed.
notes: The key to the film is to tell a love story, to give a sense of the death impulses that run through it, not to stop the camera in front of nothing. Even the nightmares hidden by the apparent daily normality.

title: Molokh
actors: Elena Rufanova, Leonid Mozgovoj, Leonid Sokol, Yelena Spiridonova
description: A sinister fortress perched on top of a mountain. A naked woman strolls on the terraces of the castle, wanders around the führer's study. When her beloved Adi arrives, Eva is greeted as any one of her entourage. The dictator awaits his guests: the most faithful Martin Bormann and the powerful propaganda minister Joseph Goebbels.
notes: On the top of an unmade but fascinating Olympus, an external, presupposed tragedy takes place, which everyone knows before it begins. With Eva murmuring «Caro, about Auschwitz ...» and Adolf replying «Ausche?». The opacity of the scenario refers to post expressionist cinema. But it reinvented it, stripping it of its metaphorical meaning (propaganda, beauty according to the Reich). In the end, even Hitler lies fleshless. A funny little man.

title: Mononoke Hime
description: Japan, was Muromachi (1392-1573). In a remote village in the mountains, Ashitaka, the last warrior of the nearly extinct Emishi clan, is forced to kill a monster to protect his village. He discovers, too late, that that creature in the form of a boar is actually a demon. By killing him, Ashitaka has attracted a curse symbolized by a scar on his right forearm that slowly expands. So the young man sets out on a journey to discover the mystery of the curse. During the journey he meets Mononoke San, a wild girl raised by wolves who helps him fulfill his mission.
notes: Hayao Miyazaki, one of the most important authors of Japanese animation, after a work that lasted three years, has made an adult film that draws inspiration from the history of Japan itself. Ashitaka finds herself having to mediate between the world of the forest, with its divinities and its spirits, and that of humans, divided within it and which in the name of civilization does not hesitate to upset the ecosystem that surrounds it. An epic film that combines the best fantasy cinema with animation of great depth and which, through a rereading of distant pages of history, launches a strong invitation to tolerance and respect for the world around us.

title: Partner
actors: Pierre Clementi, Tina Aumont, Sergio Tofano, Giulio Cesare Castello
description: The dazed Jacob, long hair, unkempt beard, enters a house and kills a boy who is playing the piano. That same Jacob, or another with the same name, middle-class clothes, short hair, teaches in an acting school and is in love, unrequited, with a girl. The two Jacob's meet and decide to live in the same house. But, in reality, they already live within each other, they are already partners of each other.
notes: Protest film based on Dostoevsky's "The Double". Theoretical, but deeply unsolved, it is one of Bernardo Bertolucci's less beautiful works.

title: Le seminariste
actors: Gabriele Di Giulio, Daniela Doria, Gisela Hahn, Raf Baldassarre
description: The marquis Daniela is sent by her father to her hometown, in the Lecce area, to participate in a seminar in which twenty-four boys take part. While the boys try to evade the surveillance of their assistants, the town's notables struggle to secure the miraculous water of the patron saint. Their intention is to use it for spas and to produce a liqueur. Daniela is the first to notice the intricacies linked to her family and that of her uncle deputy mayor.
notes: Depressing comedy with a stammering script.

title: The Blue Gardenia
actors: Anne Baxter, Raymond Burr, Richard Conte, Ann Sothern
description: Nora, a young telephonist from Los Angeles, abandoned by her boyfriend, accepts a designer's invitation to dinner. During the evening he drinks a few glasses too many, loses consciousness and when he wakes up he is in the artist's house. Here he undergoes an attempted rape and passes out. Returning to herself, she sees the lifeless body of the man lying on the ground. The police follow the obvious lead, but an enterprising reporter begins to guess the truth.
notes: A noir classic shot by Fritz Lang immediately after his indictment for "anti-American activities" (on the blacklist of McCarthyism). Brief appearance of Nat King Cole as himself.

title: Home Coming
actors: Anne Bancroft, Bonnie Bedelia, Kimberlee Peterson
description: Dicey, James, Maybeth and Sammy, traveling with their mother to the home of a relative, find themselves alone: ??their mother in fact disappears during a stop. Without losing heart, the four set off on his desperate search. They will try to get help from their grandmother, but the woman shows hostility towards them.

title: Mister Dynamit - morgen küsst Euch der Tod
actors: Lex Barker, Maria Perschy, Amedeo Nazzari, José Suarez, Ullrich Haupt
description: An introverted and megalomaniac Italian financial operator devises a diabolical plan to extort a billion dollars from the United States. He bribes the American general in charge of the atomic sector, making him alter the cargo cards and claims to be in possession of an atomic bomb. After buying a DC8 and having kidnapped one of the best civil aviation pilots, he blackmails the Pentagon by threatening to drop the bomb on Washington.
notes: Rather loose and confused film that traces all the stereotypes of the spy genre.

title: Le rouge et le noir
actors: Gérard Philipe, Danielle Darrieux, Antonella Lualdi, Jean Mercure
description: The protection of Abbot Chelan opens the doors of the house of Rénal to the young Julien Sorel, the son of a carpenter, where he enters as a tutor. Despite his humble origins, Julien, animated by an inordinate ambition, arrives to woo the romantic Madame de Rénal. An anonymous letter denounces the affair to her husband and Julien is forced to leave the house. At this point the boy is undecided whether to join the army or the seminary. Julien is convinced that the best thing is to enter the seminary, but he will stay there for a short time.
notes: Honest reduction from the novel "Il rosso e il nero" by Stendhal.

title: Nel nome del padre
actors: Yves Beneyton, Renato Scarpa, Laura Betti
description: School year '58 -'59. Angelo was locked up in a luxury boarding school for kicking and slapping his father. Even within the institution, the boy remains consistent with his behavior: he exploits his friends and induces a companion to kill his hysterical and annoying mother. With a dog mask he wanders around the rooms carrying the corpse of a priest, Professor Matematicus, on his shoulder. Angelo also manages to set up a blasphemous show that disgusts the teachers.
notes: Bellocchio's third film too full of symbols and metaphors, but with moments of great passion derived from autobiographical inspiration.

title: O bandido da luz vermelha
actors: Paulo Villaca, Helena Ignez, Luiz Linhares, Pagano Sobrinho
description: Jorge, an outcast from the city of Sao Paulo, after having upset the entire population, and especially after having challenged the police with his "exploits", becomes famous as "the bandit of the red light". The nickname derives from the particular technique with which he scores the thefts.
notes: One of the best Brazilian "cinema novo" films.

title: Early Edition
actors: Kyle Chandler, Shanesia Davis-Williams, Fisher Stevens
description: The next day's newspaper reports curious news: the dog of the mayor of the city of Chicago has been kidnapped. Chuck discovers that the eccentric thief is his distant uncle, Phil, who is considered by everyone to be a bit crazy. Phil wants to avenge the death of his dog, hit by a garbage truck. Gary, who is able to know the events before they happen, manages to anticipate. Prevent Gary's crazy uncle from committing the absurd kidnapping, but in return he will be able to expose some corrupt local administrators. Taking advantage of the fact that he knows in advance what will happen in the future, the boy buys the winning lottery ticket. But when Gary is about to collect the prize, he loses his ticket. A nun finds him who donates the huge sum to charity.
notes: The starting point for the pilot of this television series, as you may have guessed, is the film "It Happened Tomorrow" by Rene Clair. In short, nothing new under the sun of American screenwriters.

title: The Ticket
actors: James Marshall, Shannen Doherty, Heidi Swedberg
description: The marriage between Keith and Cee Cee Riker, married with a son, Eric, is in crisis. The main reason for their disagreement is the lack of money. In fact, Keith has just lost his job and Cee Cee, exasperated by the situation that has arisen, thinks of ruining the marriage and starting a new life with her son. But everything changes when Keith discovers he has won $ 23 million in the lottery. The man, however, cannot keep the news to himself and communicates it to Chuck and Rita, his former employers who concoct a plan to kill him and take possession of the immense fortune.

title: La pelicula del Rey
actors: Ulisse Dumon, Julio Chavez, Villanueva Cosse
description: A director wants to bring to the screen the story of a man who in 1700 was proclaimed king of Patagonia by the Indians. As the man approaches the south of Argentina with the crew he remains alone. The producer steps away and with him the money. The filmmaker is thus forced to continue alone. Abandoned by everyone, even by the actors, he is forced to shoot in impossible conditions. In the end he plays the part of the adventurer himself, surrounded by mannequins who take the place of the actors.
notes: The film won a Golden Lion for Best First Feature. Very Herzogian in the setting, but not always resolved.

title: Nadie dijo nada
actors: Carlos Solanos, Jaime Vadeil, Luis Vilches, Luis Alarcon
description: A group of friends, deluded and disillusioned intellectuals find themselves arguing with each other in the city squares. Two of them, locked in their dreams of glory, have to deal with the harsh reality of the province in which they spend their days. They loiter from bar and restaurant to restaurant and spend hours arguing and. Between artistic debates and grueling cultural diatribes, they realize that in the end no one has said anything.
notes: Bitter portrait of a generation signed by Ruiz, who suffers a little from the verbiage of his targets.

title: Desert Bloom
actors: Jon Voight, JoBeth Williams, Ellen Barkin
description: 1950s, United States. Jack Chismore is a WWII veteran shaken by his terrifying experience and with a lot of family problems. Jack realizes that something threatening is happening to him and his family in the Nevada desert near Las Vegas. Right there, near his home, the United States is carrying out the first atomic tests. When the smoke of the atomic explosion rises in the sky one morning, Jack realizes that personal tensions are small.
notes: Commendable film that suffers from excessive slowness. Sundance-funded debut feature.

title: Post Mortem- Der Nuttenmörder
actors: Thomas Rühmann, Stefan Witschi, Friederich von Thun
description: Nadja, the daughter of the city's coroner, is brutally murdered. At first it seems that this is the third murder committed by a serial killer, who is being hunted by the police. But Dr. Bender, employed in the coroner's office, is convinced that the truth is different. So he decides to conduct the investigation on his own.

title: Detour
actors: Jeff Fahey, James Russo, Gary Busey, Michael Madsen
description: Danny is involved by his friend Ziggy Rotella in an attempted theft. The two want to enter the home of a powerful underworld boss, Gianni Grasso, to steal a million dollars hidden somewhere. While preparing for the heist, Danny realizes that the whole plan is a trap hatched by Mo Lasker, a slimy informant.
notes: Beautiful faces ruined by B-movie in this action film made by John Travolta's brother for TV. The title refers to one of the noir masterpieces ("Detour" by Edgar G. Ulmer) but the combination is naturally impossible.

title: Kiss of a Stranger
actors: Mariel Hemingway, Diane Cannon, David Carradine
description: The life of Nova Clarke, daughter of two famous singers, is turned upside down when she meets a stranger. Nathan doesn't take long to seduce her and just as quickly disappears leaving her name, address and phone number. But when Nova tries to get in touch with him she realizes that all the contact details are non-existent. Shocked by this first discovery, the girl - who hosts a program on a local television - falls into depression when she realizes she is pregnant and learns that her father is dead. Then one day Nathan reappears to avenge an ancient wrong ...
notes: Usual television film without infamy and without praise.

title: Beverly Hills Ninja
actors: Chris Farley, Nicolette Sheridan, Chris Rock, Robin Shou, Nathaniel Parker
description: Haru has a dream in her life to be part of a group of fierce and fearsome ninjas. Unfortunately for him, he does not have the athletic skills necessary to make him a fearsome fighter. In short, he is too clumsy in his movements. But, after having overcome considerable difficulties, he manages to be admitted to the fateful group and during a mission in Los Angeles, he finally manages to show everyone what he is made of.
notes: Adventure film, interspersed with comic skits. Chris Farley, who we had already seen in "Tommy Boy", is here at his last acting test. He will die at the age of thirty-three.

title: Metropolis
actors: Gustav Fröhlich, Brigitte Helm, Rudolf Klein-Rogge, Alfred Abel, Fritz Rasp, Theodor Loos, Erwin Biswanger, Heinrich George
description: 21st century. A metropolis tyrannized by Frederson, a man who enslaves the workers by forcing them to live underground. The proletarians are guided in the rescue by Maria, with whom the unsuspecting son of the dictator falls in love. Frederson, to control the workers, has a scientist build a cyborg look-alike of Maria.
notes: Masterpiece by Fritz Lang, model of all the science fiction of the future, starting with "Blade Runner". Ideologically it is affected by the ideas of screenwriter Thea von Harbou (wife of the director at the time), but Lang's cinematic touch, simply sublime, surpasses any controversy. Expressionist, but already launched in modernity. A cult.

title: Venere creola
actors: Calvin Lockhart, Helen Williams, Isa Arnal, Berenice Figuera
description: Two countries on an island in the Caribbean enter into conflict every time the community party approaches, which ends with a furious cockfight. The champion rooster of one of the two villages is killed by a dog, and the beautiful daughter of the mayor, Dolores, decides to make a collection to buy a new bird. But the money collected by the girl will have a bad end, because of the naive young Melchior, with whom she is in love ...
notes: The story is actually a mere pretext to illustrate the habits and customs of the Caribbean populations. Terribly dated, the film turns out to be a cloying tourist spot.

title: Phoenix
actors: Anthony La Paglia, Ray Liotta, Anjelica Huston, Daniel Baldwin
description: Collins is a policeman but has a very bad habit: he plays. Bet on everything. And it loses. Together with a few colleagues fed up with cop wages, Collins arranges a heist at a loan shark. But the dead man escapes, and as if that weren't enough someone steals the loot. Colleagues believe it was Collins, and they hunt him down. Only a woman could save him.
notes: One of the best noirs of recent years, incredibly underestimated. The director of "Young Americans" retraces some stereotypes with intelligence and turns one over. Anjelica Huston, the face of a dark lady, unexpectedly transforms into a splendid "redemptive woman".

title: Policarpo, ufficiale di scrittura
actors: Renato Rascel, Carla Gravina, Peppino De Filippo, Renato Salvatori
description: Policarpo De Tappetti is a modest ministerial employee of Rome in the early twentieth century. Diligent in his work and excessively zealous, he attracted the antipathies of his office manager, Cavalier Pancarano. A chance meeting of the two families at the Pincio so that Gegé, son of Pancarano, falls in love with Celeste, daughter of Polycarp. The girl, however, reluctantly accepts the court of the son of her father's boss. The family seduced by the mirage of a brilliant marriage insists that Celeste be engaged to him.
notes: Polite film based on a humorous tale by Gandolin. Soldiers mixes humor and sentimentality well.

title: Down Will Come Baby
actors: Evan Rachel Wood, Meredith Baxter, Diana Scarwid
description: During a camping holiday, a little girl loses her life by drowning in a lake. Her friend, Robin, witnesses the tragedy helpless and distraught. Robin goes into a deep crisis also because he is responsible for the horrible accident. The parents try to help her but because of their work commitments they spend a lot of time away from their daughter, who feels more and more alone and abandoned. One day Robin meets a woman, Dorothy, in a park. The two girls begin dating assiduously. But Dorothy's behavior, really strange, makes Robin's mother suspicious ...

title: Su le mani, cadavere! Sei in arresto
actors: Peter Lee Lawrence, Espartaco Santoni, Helga Liné
description: The town of Springfield is bullied by a former Northern officer. The daughter of an owner of the area, Eleonor, tired of the harassment to which the family is subjected, calls the ranger Sando Kid for help.
notes: Peter Lee Lawrence still has the right physique for such roles. The other supporting actors are fairly anonymous. The film was shot in Almeria.

title: Il ritorno del gladiatore più forte del mondo
actors: Brad Harris, John Barracuda, Maria Pia Conte
description: Rome is experiencing its own decline in a traumatic way. The emperor fears conspiracies and palace plots, the Senate seems to want to pursue an autonomous policy, the legions have now conquered everything that could be conquered. But the hordes of barbarians have reorganized and are pushing to conquer the eternal city. To resolve the matter, a former gladiator intervenes who defeats the Roman traitor in league with the enemies.
notes: One of the last examples of Italic peplum made by Bitto Albertini, a prolific craftsman from Cinecittà. Beyond the ironic touches and references to the spaghetti-western, little thing.

title: Da Corleone a Brooklyn
actors: Maurizio Merli, Mario Merola, Laura Belli, Van Johnson
description: A commissioner from Palermo is charged with escorting a super-protected witness to New York, through whom he wants to frame the boss Barresi and then extradite him to Italy. Of course, organized crime gets on the track so as not to make the trip very pleasant.
notes: Notable detective story that exploits the shapes and clichés of the road movie. Lenzì shot a good part of it in New York, where Luca Barbareschi, in one of his first performances, can be seen among the policemen in the Serpico version. For some critics, Merola's was his best performance ever. To be re-evaluated.

title: Move Over, Darling
actors: Doris Day, James Garner, Polly Bergen, Thelma Ritter, Fred Clark
description: Typical American playboy: widower, handsome, seductive, wealthy. To tell the truth, he is not at all aware that he is the "object of desire" of women, on the contrary he thinks about remarrying, rebuilding a family and a normal life. Also find the new soul mate. But one day the first wife (who was thought to be dead) returns, more alive than ever. And they are pains ...
notes: Conventional but very funny comedy, favored by the irrepressible verve of James Garner and Doris Day. A bit of bitterness considering that the role of "wife" must have been of Marilyn Monroe, before her suicide.

title: It Came from the Sky
actors: John Ritter, Christopher Lloyd, JoBeth Williams, Yasmine Bleeth, Kevin Zegers
description: Donald and Alice's relationship goes into crisis when Andy, the couple's teenage son, risks drowning in the pool due to parental distraction. The accident compromised the boy's development. Alice refuses to take Andy to a psychiatric center. One day a strange accident further disrupts the family's life. A plane falls on the roof of the house. Unscathed the two passengers, Jarvis and Donald, who are greeted by Donald and Alice and hosted in the house.
notes: Brand new TV movie that renews the question: but how many films does John Ritter play each year?

title: The Spiral Staircase
actors: Nicolette Sheridan, Judd Nelson, Alex McArthur, Debbe Dunning
description: Some women were killed in the city; all had some physical defect. The killer could be a young professor who lives with his ailing stepmother and a younger brother. The stepmother is assisted by a dumb girl, while the man has a young secretary at his service. The stepmother is suspicious and decides to fire her lady-in-waiting.
notes: Television remake of a great Robert Siodmak film. The packaging is glossy and the protagonists are committed as they can. Clearly, any comparison with the model is out of place. But there was no need for this version.

title: Bordello of Blood
actors: Chris Sarandon, Dennis Miller, Erika Eleniak, Angie Everhart
description: The preacher Jimmy Current is a really nice guy. He has found a way to control vampires, monsters and other damned souls and has seen fit to build a real "brothel" for all sinners. But inside the macabre palace, Katherine's brother also disappears, who does not give up and leaves together with Rafe Guttman on the trail of the priest.
notes: "Bordello of Blood" is part of the HBO horror series "Tales from the Crypt". Fun is guaranteed, but the parodic tones dilute the suspense. Whoopi Goldberg appears in an uncredited cameo.

title: Shark Attack
actors: Casper Van Dien, Ernie Hudson, Jenny McShane, Cordell McQueen
description: An American professor of marine biology, suspicious of the death of one of his researchers and the increase in attacks on humans by sharks, leaves for Africa to investigate. The sister of the deceased accompanies him. Together, they discover the plot of a pharmaceutical company that breeds terrible sharks as guinea pigs for a drug.
notes: Quite spectacular film definitely inspired by the blockbuster "Deep Blue", which told a similar story. A curiosity: there are really many who argue that from the adrenaline of the sharks it is possible to obtain a useful medicine for cells affected by cancer.

title: Storm Catcher
actors: Dolph Lundgren, Robert Miano, Jon Pennell, Mystro Clark
description: Jack Holloway, a pilot of the American Air Force, is unjustly accused of the theft of the prototype of a military plane and then imprisoned. Jack, determined to recover the aircraft and rehabilitate his name, escapes from prison. Aided by his friend, Lieutenant Spark, the only one who believes in Jack's innocence, Holloway investigates and not only identifies those who framed him, but also learns of a conspiratorial organization plotting against the interest of the country.
notes: Definitely cheap film, supported by the powerful shoulders of Dolph Lundgren who perhaps should have been a bodybuilder instead of an actor.

title: The Stars Are Singing
actors: Rosemary Clooney, Anna Maria Alberghetti, Lauritz Melchoir
description: Katy, a Polish refugee, arrives clandestinely in the United States. The police, determined to repatriate her, hunt her down. But a group of artists, challenging the authorities, helps her in every way, allowing her to escape capture. The girl has a beautiful voice and her friends count on leveraging this gift of hers to pity public opinion. They make her go to television and make her record records in order to draw attention to her. Musical with few pretensions and that takes its cue from a laughable subject.

title: Il mio corpo con rabbia
actors: Peter Lee Lawrence, Antonia Santilli, Silvano Tranquilli, Massimo Girotti
description: Silvia, raised in a wealthy family, has a deep grudge against her parents, and seeks "comfort" in drugs. The girl is hospitalized in a psychiatric clinic, but, despite the treatment she is subjected to, Silvia continues to hate her father and mother. Then one day he meets Paul, who has some unfinished business with justice.
notes: Monotonous film with no points of interest, despite a good subject.

title: Money
actors: Eric Stoltz, Maryam D'Abo, Bruno Cremer
description: A boy tries to take revenge on the man who stole a large sum of money from his father. To achieve his goal, he is forced to seek help from a French private investigator and a Turk of immense wealth. Will he succeed in his enterprise?
notes: Good cast for an absolutely mediocre film.

title: The Man from Colorado
actors: Glenn Ford, William Holden, Ellen Drew
description: A former colonel who distinguished himself during the Civil War has now been elected judge by his former soldiers who are now miners. But as a result of the conflict, the officer got nervous and is now behaving tyrannically. Soon the man loses his reason. It will cause a fire in the town where he lives. Series Western directed by a prolific specialist.

title: La venganza del Zorro
actors: Frank Latimore, Mary Anderson, Ralph Marsch
description: The man behind whose mask Diego de La Vega is hiding, this time is called to restore peace and justice in a territory occupied by the Yankees. The difficulties he encounters are many but his courage and resourcefulness will allow him to fight to the death. Will he succeed in his enterprise?

title: René la Canne
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Michel Piccoli, Sylvia Kristel
description: In 1942 in Paris, René Bordier, known as René la Canne, was arrested for the theft of jewels. Pretending to be mad, the man is interned in an asylum from which he escapes, just when, fleeing from his German colleagues, the police officer, Fernand Marchand, tries to hide. The two, immediately arrested, are sent to Germany to work as workers. René and Fernand, intolerant of the strict German discipline, find a way to have a good time with the local girls. Then, one day, Krista, René's woman, joins the trio.
notes: Depardieu gigioneggia and is no less small. The comedy is shouted but taken for granted.

title: The Land Unknown
actors: Jock Mahoney, Shawn Smith, Henry Brandon, William Reynolds
description: A group of American scientists while exploring Antarctica aboard a helicopter is forced by a storm to land in a foggy area. Alan, the leader of the expedition, ascertains that the terrain is volcanic in nature and that the area is inhabited by prehistoric monsters. Using the helicopter's engine, the explorers are able to keep away the monsters that attack them and manage to land. A journalist who is part of the group is kidnapped by a man dressed in furs.
notes: Small, fascinating example of 1950s American science fiction. Great professionalism, naive but fun special effects.

title: It Came From Outer Space
actors: Richard Carlson, Barbara Rush, Charles Drake, Russell Johnson
description: A failed alien spaceship is forced to land in a desert area in the American Southwest. A young scientist spots the unidentified object and tries to establish a relationship with the extraterrestrials. But the locals, led by a racist sheriff, see guests as a threat and react accordingly.
notes: Fundamental science fiction film, the first in the history of cinema in which the extraterrestrial is not anthropomorphic. Under the lines, Jack Arnold and Ray Bradbury (screenwriter) describe America's illiberal and snarling "witch hunt".

title: Five Aces
actors: Charlie Sheen, Christopher McDonald, David Sherrill
description: Chris is about to get married and his best friends invite him to celebrate the bachelor party in the small town where they were born. What the locals called the "five aces" come together once again. Of course, friends want to dissuade the betrothed from taking the plunge ...
notes: David O'Neill's film, despite the excessively televised style, starts from intelligent assumptions: investigating the painful complexity of some characters by digging behind their apparent superficiality and lightheartedness. Chris's bachelor party is the litmus test for never-ending dramas.

title: Village of the Damned
actors: Christopher Reeve, Kirstie Alley, Linda Kozlowski
description: Dr. Chaffee, a doctor from a Midwestern town, observes a strange phenomenon: nine months after an alleged collective narcolepsy crisis, some women find themselves pregnant at the same time. They give birth to perfect children: in reality it is a genie of aliens who want to colonize the Earth ...
notes: John Carpenter is interested in reflecting on the mechanism of staging suspense. The restlessness is pervasive, because all the cinematographic components (the sound is splendid) contribute to provoking it. One of the most theoretical films of the American director, remake of _The village of the damned_ by Wolf Rilla (1960).

title: Paper Bullets
actors: James Russo, William McNamara, Jeff Wincott
description: John Rourke was one of the best cops in town. But ever since a witness to a crime he was supposed to protect was killed by a killer, he has fallen out of favor for all to see. During a police meeting, a mysterious Chinese killer kills some of Rourke's colleagues, who decides to get back into action for the occasion. With his partner Dickerson he investigates the Chinatown gangs milieu but realizes that the leaders of his own district are putting a spanner in the works. Behind, in fact, there is a bad story of corruption.
notes: Addictive thriller, with beautiful B movie faces.

title: A Table for One
actors: Rebecca De Mornay, Michael Rooker, Mark Rolston
description: Her husband neglects her, also because he hides a double identity and a double family. A neighbor, attracted to her, ends up being embroiled in a strange situation. His fault? Accepting an invitation to dinner at the woman's house.
notes: Usual television movie with a good Rebecca DeMornay.

title: Du skal ære din hustru
actors: Johannes Meyer, Astrid Holm, Karin Nellemose, Mathilde Nielsen
description: A woman is forced to fight against her husband, a true domestic tyrant. On the verge of nervous breakdown, she decides on the advice of her husband's old nurse to leave the house for some time. It will be the maid, in his absence, who will take the reins of family life.
notes: An almost metaphysical drama, but also a cruel social and psychological investigation, for one of Dreyer's first major films.

title: Cy-warrior
actors: Brandon Hammond, Henry Silva, Frank Zagarino, Sherrie Rose
description: The US military authorities have built a cyborg who could become the "perfect soldier". But the android develops an intelligence of its own and escapes the control of the guardians. The ruthless Colonel Hammer sets out on his trail.
notes: Italian B Series as usual inspired by American models. In this case "Universal Soldier".

title: Round Midnight
actors: Dexter Gordon, François Cluzet, Gabrielle Haker
description: Paris, 1959. A passionate jazz illustrator, Borier, meets an alcoholic and wandering saxophonist, Dale Turner. She decides to host him at home and to help him, but living together turns out to be very difficult. Eventually Dale chooses to return to the United States.
notes: Inspired by a true fact (the friendship between Frenchman Francis Paudras and the great musician Bud Powell), "Round Midnight" is above all a heartfelt and intense tribute to Be-bop. Some musical moments are memorable, and among the folds of the story appear characters of the caliber of Wayne Shorter, John McLaughlin, Martin Scorsese, and Herbie Hanccock, author of the soundtrack (which won the Oscar). One of the best cinema tributes to jazz.

title: Final Descent
actors: Robert Urich, Annette O'Toole, Jim Byrnes
description: A passenger plane is involved in a mid-flight collision just after take off. The damage suffered forces the aircraft to continue at high altitude, where there is a risk that the aircraft will break in two. Engaged in a desperate attempt to bring the plane and passengers back to the ground, the commander must at the same time deal with the flight controller, who has a personal grudge against him. And with the co-pilot, a girl to whom he is romantically linked, as well as with the manufacturer of the aircraft, whose indications on the behavior to be followed in an emergency situation are not ethically justifiable ...

title: The Vivero Letter
actors: Chiara Caselli, Fred Ward, Robert Patrick
description: A man, in possession of two precious dishes from the Mayan era, is found murdered dead. His brother begins the investigation with the help of a charming Italian archaeologist. She has long been on the trail of the dishes, which she would like to give to a museum. But some criminals think they can recover the treasure for less noble purposes. The two protagonists are thus forced to face an enemy in the shadows ...
notes: The plot is chock full of things already seen and already heard ad nauseam. But Chiara Caselli, on an American trip, is very good, and her character gives a little flavor to the story. Also excellent Fred Ward and Robert Patrick.

title: The Car
actors: James Brolin, Kathleen Lloyd, Ronny Cox
description: In the quiet Californian countryside, a black out-of-production model is spotted one day, apparently without a driver and of an unknown brand. The car whizzes through the streets of the cities and kills anyone who comes within range. Someone tries to stop her, but the mechanical monster turns out to be animated by a demonic entity.
notes: A theme that already fascinated the writer Richard Matheson (and that Stephen King will passionate about), that of the murderous mechanical means. Not surprisingly, Silverstein's film mentions "Duel", which was based precisely on a story by Matheson. Professional packaging but suspense to look for with the lantern.

title: Al límite
actors: Lydia Bosch, Bud Spencer, Juanjo Puigcorbe, Béatrice Dalle
description: A journalist, while conducting a radio show, receives a phone call from a serial killer who tells her about a murder live. What the maniac describes happens in earnest, and the police, who have long been tracking down the mysterious killer, begin to fear for the woman's safety. To his aid, an inspector with several years of experience and a psychiatrist ...
notes: A well done thriller, despite the television bill. Spencer defends himself well while away from Spain, and there is no shortage of scares after all. In the version presented at the Cannes market in '98 there were several nude scenes. So, cut in sight!

title: Silence of the Heart
actors: Chad Lowe, Mariette Hartley, Dana Hill, Charlie Sheen
description: A seventeen-year-old boy is fatally injured in a car accident. All his family members are terribly upset by the incident and the father, in panic, refuses to think about the hypothesis put forward by the police: that of an inexplicable suicide of the boy. But it is above all his best friend who is tormented: he believes he is indirectly responsible for the tragedy.
notes: Dramatic film that delves into a hot theme with the lightness of an elephant in a crystal shop. The tension is also poorly served by the performers and by an opaque direction.

title: Heavy metal
description: A green meteorite emanating particular radiation hits New York in 2031. The soul of this object is a terrifying voice that is revealed to a little girl whose father died after finding the mysterious green stone. The voice describes to the girl the evils of the world that derive from the desire for power and from humanity's unstoppable thirst for success.
notes: The film, inspired by a famous French-Canadian comic, is affected by the hand of several artists and despite some notable moments it is a bit weak. However, the soundtrack signed by Elmer Bernstein and accompanied by hard rock classics is good.

title: Il terzo occhio
actors: Franco Nero, Gioia Pascal, Diana Sullivan, Marina Morgan
description: Mino lives with his mother in a castle. Guest of the manor is Daniela, Mino's girlfriend who, however, arouses the jealousies of the boy's mother and of Marta, the housekeeper secretly in love with him. Given the situation Daniela decides to run away but ends up straight into the lake because someone sabotaged her car brakes. While Mino, who followed the woman is carrying the body home, he witnesses the murder of his mother.
notes: At the time, Guerrini was a promising director. The film, based on a short story by Gilles De Reys, seen today, is very small.

title: Terza liceo
actors: Isabella Redi, Giulia Rubini, Anna Maria Sandri, Valeria Moriconi
description: The last school year in a mixed class of a Roman high school. Misunderstandings between students and professors are on the agenda, as are the subterfuges to avoid being questioned. Of course, loves are born and ended between classmates. Then comes the time of the long-awaited and awaited final exams with the inevitable envy and jealousy among the students.
notes: Emmer's film is a small, lighthearted, delightful description of a youth out of the war, and before the boom. Beautiful screenplay signed, among others, by Vasco Pratolini, photography by Mario Bava. Small parts for Paola Borboni and Giuliano Montaldo.

title: Zambo, il dominatore della foresta
actors: Raf Baldassarre, Enrico Cappafreddo, Mario Dionisi
description: George, wrongly accused of murder, is serving his sentence in prison. But one day he escapes and takes refuge in the jungle. Welcomed with full honors by the natives, he was elected head and given the name of Zambo. An expedition, which includes an archaeologist and his niece, approaches him because they are convinced that man can lead them to the discovery of a buried city. But among the participants in the expedition there are also those who would like to collect the bounty placed on Zambo's head.
notes: Exotic film made with two lire. For some shots the director, unable to shoot in a Tanzanian park, put the camera on the terrace of his hotel.

title: Il trionfo di Maciste
actors: Ljuba Bodine, Aldo Bufi Landi, Calisto Calisti, Carla Calò
description: Tenefi, after having usurped the throne of Memphis, reigns over the city using violent and inhuman methods. His aim is to use terror to better govern the city. Citizens, tired of the constant harassment they are subjected to, turn to Maciste.
notes: Modesto peplum with anonymous protagonists, directed by what is considered "the worst director in the history of Italian cinema".

title: Carmen di Trastevere
actors: Giovanna Ralli, Jacques Charrier, Lino Ventura, Carlo Romano
description: Carmen, Vincenzo's wife, detained for theft, chooses Antonio as a friend and confidant. When the husband comes out of prison, albeit reluctantly, he accepts the relationship between the two and continues to use his wife to carry out his shady business. The attempt to rob an American drug dealer, carried out with the complicity of the woman, fails miserably. During the robbery Vincenzo is seriously injured and dies. At this point Carmen chooses another friend, Luca, a motorcyclist.
notes: Carmine Gallone brings to the screen the Roman-style version of Mérimée's Carmen.

title: The Last Outpost
actors: Ronald Reagan, Rhonda Fleming, Bruce Bennett
description: After the Civil War, some small units of the Southern army refuse to surrender and continue to fight with guerrilla actions. One of these gangs, commanded by Major Dick, operates in the vicinity of Fort Point keeping the population on constant alert. Dawson, a wealthy merchant in the area, proposes to the colonel who commands inside the fort, that he try to make a deal with the Indians against the rebels. Dawson, who in the meantime has received a sharp no from the colonel, writes to Washington for satisfaction.
notes: Noticeable war scenes and a Ronald Reagan from the heyday.

title: Il conquistatore di Corinto
actors: Jacques Sernas, Geneviève Grad, Carlo Tamberlani, Gianni Santuccio, Gianna Maria Canale
description: Messengers sent from Rome arrive in Corinth to ask the senate of that city to leave the Achaean league to establish relations with the Eternal City. The request is not only denied, but the members of the mission are attacked by the crowd in the main square of the city. The centurion Caio Vinicio, wounded in the fray, manages to take refuge in the house of Callicrato, head of the pro-Roman party. Here he meets Ebe, daughter of the strategist Critolao and falls in love with her. But Artemis, wife of Callicrato, also fell in love with the centurion.
notes: Modest realization for a peplum of little interest.

title: Warlock
actors: Julian Sands, Lori Singer, Richard E. Grant
description: A powerful and evil sorcerer who raged in 1600s New England is resurrected by an evil force in Los Angeles in the 1980s. The "warlock" must discover where "the witches' bible" is hidden, an arcane text that holds the secret of the name of the Almighty. A hunter on a mission on behalf of God arrives on his trail from the sixteenth century ...
notes: Horror, fantasy and more than a wink to _Highlander_ in this film from the director of _Lake Placid_. The bill is televised, the story is not bad, but Julian Sands in the role of the sorcerer is (as he often happens) ridiculous ...

title: Fly Boy
actors: Gregory Itzin, James Karen, Miko Hughes, Kathleen Lloyd
description: Joe, a ten-year-old boy spends a lot of time with his grandfather, a former airplane pilot. Their passion is building remote controlled appliances. When Joe discovers that his parents want to put the old man in a hospice, together with his little sister he decides to fulfill his grandfather's last dream. Return at least once to fly.

title: Onassis: The Richest Man in the World
actors: Anthony Quinn, Raul Julia, Dimitra Arliss, Richard Chaves
description: The film tells the life of the most famous shipowner and oilman of the sixties. Aristotle Onassis, from a young age begins to have problems with his father for his behavior with the Turks in the 1920s. Then begins the conquest of the world that matters. In fact, he manages to become rich with the tobacco trade in Argentina. And it is on this basis that Onassis will be able to give birth to his empire.
notes: Extra-luxury script made with a certain craft.

title: Lost Treasure of the Amazon - Jivaro
actors: Fernando Lamas, Rhonda Fleming, Brian Keith
description: In a small village, on the banks of the tributary of the Amazon, there is a small colony of whites. The group includes a certain Rio who has opened a commercial office and is also the owner of a steamboat. One day he happens to board Alice, a beautiful American girl who has come to look for her boyfriend, Jerry. Which makes her believe she is on the trail of a fabulous treasure.
notes: Modest adventure film.

title: Trapeze
actors: Burt Lancaster, Tony Curtis, Gina Lollobrigida, Katy Jurado, Thomas Gomez, Gérard Landry, Minor Watson, John Puleo
description: Mike, who works for the Paris circus, was one of the greatest trapeze artists, one of the few who was able to perform the triple somersault. But an accident left him lame and dejected in morale. Tino, the son of another famous flying man, begs him to teach him the secret of the number that made him famous in the world. Eventually Mike gives in to the boy's insistence and agrees to perform with him. Also part of the circus is Lola, a girl without talent, who would like to perform with Tino and Mike.
notes: Minor work by Carol Reed, with Lancaster almost always without a double. Filmed at the Cirque d'Hiver in Paris.

title: Mr. Rorret ad altezza d'uomo
actors: Lou Castel, Anna Galiena, Massimo Venturiello, Patrizia Punzo, Rossana Coggiola, Claudia Giannotti, Fabrizio Temperini, Enrica Rosso
description: A man, the mister Rorret of the title, is the owner of a cinema where only horror films are shown. But his passion for terror is so authentic that he "enjoys" scaring to death the spectators (especially the spectators) who attend his cinema. His madness leads him to kill one by one those who show they are most afraid.
notes: A very interesting horror. Inspired by Bogdanovich's "Targets" he builds a beautiful story. Unfortunately, he does not always manage to transform the constraints of low budget into Corman insights.

title: Aftershock: Earthquake in New York
actors: Tom Skerritt, Sharon Lawrence, Charles S. Dutton, Lisa Nicole Carson
description: New York. Light earthquakes shake the city but no one notices. Evie, the mayor's daughter, is busy rescuing her client, Joshua, from life in prison. Dori, on the other hand, is busy not wrecking her marriage and trying to live with her feelings of guilt. In this context, a terrible earthquake suddenly explodes which brings the city to its knees. Ahearn, chief of the fire brigade, takes matters into his own hands, leaving aside the strong disagreements he has with the mayor. Also because Evie was trapped in a subway tunnel along with the few survivors of a derailed convoy.

title: Testa t'ammazzo, croce... sei morto, mi chiamano Alleluja
actors: George Hilton, Charles Southwood, Paolo Gozlino, Robert Camardiel
description: In Mexico during the empire of Maximilian, the gunslinger Alleluja took back the task of the revolutionary general Ramirez to take possession of a bag of jewels. Alleluja sets out on the enterprise with the intention of keeping the booty all to himself. But there is someone else interested in jewelry and precisely Krantz, a self-styled Russian prince and a nun who is, in reality, a secret agent.
notes: We are in full western parody; nothing exceptional.

title: Voltati... ti uccido
actors: Richard Wyler, Fernando Sancho, Eleonora Bianchi
description: Ted, an unscrupulous adventurer, has managed to seize, with the help of the outlaw El Bicho and his gang, almost all of the gold mines in New Mexico. Sam, an old pioneer who owns a mine, hires Bill, a gunslinger, to try to resist Ted's pressure. He decides to pit Ted and El Bicho against each other.
notes: Few ideas in this film directed by Brescia under the pseudonym of Al Bradley.

title: Sweet Deception
actors: Kate Jackson, Joanna Pacula, Joan Collins, Jack Scalia, Rob Stewart
description: Young Risa Gallagher is accused of her husband's murder. While being transported to prison, the woman manages to escape. Inspector Malloy hunts her, but after carrying out some investigations he begins to doubt the woman's guilt. Having tracked down the fugitive, he offers her his collaboration, also with the hope of being able to steal information from her that can lead to the truth. Risa realizes the reliability of the travel companion and together with him begins to get an idea of ??the identity of the killer. The true one.
notes: Conventional TV movie but basically well done. History isn't too bad.

title: Il sorriso del grande tentatore
actors: Glenda Jackson, Claudio Cassinelli, Lisa Harrow, Adolfo Celi
description: The writer Roberto was sent by Monsignor Badenski to a convent to write a book on the relationship between the Church and Nazism. However, Roberto realizes that he has arrived in a strange place: in fact, the guests of the institute have particular personalities and for this reason they have been confined here by the Vatican. Father Moraldi is a worker priest who took part in the strikes, Monsignor Marcos supported Fidel Castro, while Monsignor Badenski himself is accused of having sided with the Nazis ...
notes: A curious but unsolved film, with enigmatic implications and some references to the metaphysical thriller.

title: Heavyweights
actors: Ben Stiller, David Goldman, Tom McGowan, Aaron Schwartz
description: A group of children with severe weight problems arrive at Camp Hope to spend the long-awaited summer vacation. Unfortunately for them in the field adjacent to theirs there are some thin and muscular children. At the beginning the latter, thanks to their agility, make fun of their rivals to make them feel, in some way, inferior to them. Then as the fat and thin get acquainted they discover that it's not worth making fun of. They will start doing contests and tournaments to try to establish the supremacy of one group over the other.
notes: Funny film directed by the assistant director of "Postcards from hell".

title: Buried Secrets
actors: Tiffani Thiessen, Erika Flores, Tim Matheson, Melinda Culea
description: Laura and her daughter Annelise return to their hometown after many years. Laura's husband died in an accident in Mexico while exploring a cave. The two women settle in an old secluded house near the White Cliffs Lighthouse. The house is owned by an old school friend of Laura, who abandoned it after his first wife died falling off the cliff with her daughter Mary. Soon Laura and Annelise realize that the house is not as uninhabited as it seems. Little by little, Mary's ghost gets in touch with Annelise.

title: Superfly
actors: Ron O'Neal, Carl Lee, Sheila Frazier, Julius Harris, Charles McGregor
description: A Harlem drug dealer called Superfly, and his partner Eddie, are fed up with the "street" life they lead. This is why they decide to engineer the bang that can fix them forever. Unfortunately, the corrupt cops of the black quarter don't stand by the window and watch ...
notes: Stracult of blaxploitation, the B series made to measure for African Americans. Directed by the son of the director of "Shaft", set to music by the genius Curtis Mayfield, a small classic of its kind. The newspapers of the time criticized him a lot for the profession of the hero, drug dealer without remorse.

title: Driftwood
actors: James Spader, Anne Brochet, Barry McGovern, Anna Massey
description: Sarah is a sculptor who lives and works in a house equipped as a studio near the wild Irish coast. One day, while he is walking on the beach, he glimpses the silhouette of a man who has been beaten by the stormy sea on the shoreline. The man despite having a fractured leg is alive. Sarah takes him to her cottage and lovingly cares for him. He soon discovers that the man is suffering from a severe form of amnesia. The sculptress makes him believe that there are only the two of them on the island. The man begins to trust her and passion arises between the two. But when the castaway wants to leave the island he meets the woman's hostility.

title: Icebreaker
actors: Sean Astin, Bruce Campbell, Stacy Keach, Suzanne Turner
description: A serious threat looms over Killington ski resort, one of the most renowned in the United States. The evil Greig, leader of a group of terrorists, takes some tourists hostage and hides them in a secret place. To keep them company, a not very nice nuclear warhead stolen from an army arsenal. On the trail of the terrorists, a mountain rescue officer, Matt Foster. Who engages in a fight against time also to free his girlfriend, locked up with the other hostages.
notes: A high-adrenalin-fueled TV movie that has its strong point in the mountain setting.

title: Another 9 1/2 Weeks
actors: Mickey Rourke, Angie Everhart, Agathe De La Fontaine
description: John Gray, who loved Elizabeth fiery, is upset by the news of the woman's death. The mourning does not last long: John knows the sister of the former lover, Lea, and decides to start his erotic adventure again again. Despite the sexual charge of the girl, however, the rough Casanova cannot shake off his existential apathy.
notes: A film for which there are no words, and if they are there it is better not to tell them. Mickey Rourke at the lowest point of his career, Angie Everhart burned even before taking off.

title: Giallo alla regola
actors: Remo Girone, Daniela Poggi, Paolo Malco
description: A runaway criminal abandons a briefcase full of dollars, the result of a blow he has just landed. An official of the Chamber of Deputies, who has noticed the scene, decides to change his life by picking it up. Then he hides the money and goes on a vacation. Unfortunately for him this act of greed will complicate his life terribly.
notes: First film directed by Stefano Roncoroni, former film critic and theater author. Despite the commitment and skill of the actors, the thriller has little bite, even if from a stylistic point of view it has some interesting moments.

title: Contagious
actors: Lindsay Wagner, Ken Poque, Brendan Fletcher, Tom Wopat
description: Fresh from an unpleasant experience in Africa, Dr. Hanna Cole is preparing to start a new life next to her husband Sam, widower and father of two wonderful children. One bad day a man's body is found outside the door of the doctor's surgery. The autopsy shows that the victim contracted cholera. Hanna informs the authorities who declare the state of quarantine. Meanwhile, the infection spreads rapidly and, in a few hours, other cases of the disease are reported. While the doctor is preparing to help people infected with the disease, we try to discover the origin of the epidemic ...

title: A Woman Scorned: The Betty Broderick Story
actors: Meredith Baxter, Stephen Collins, Michelle Johnson, Kelli Williams
description: Betty Broderick, an extremely vindictive wife and mother, indicted for murder, is supported in her actions by some feminists, who see in her act of revenge an expression of her great suffering as a woman. The woman, in fact, was discharged by her ambitious husband, after having supported him for years during the economic hardships that the family had had to suffer. Eventually even her supporters discover her ambiguous personality. It is true that Betty has made sacrifices for years, allowing her husband to build a brilliant career as a lawyer, but she did not hesitate for a moment to take revenge on him when she was betrayed.

title: Her Final Fury: Betty Broderick, the Last Chapter
actors: Meredith Baxter, Judith Ivey, Ray Baker, Kelli Williams
description: Betty Broderick is accused of the murder of her ex-husband and his young lover Michelle. Despite everything, feminists and public opinion support her, but when the trial confronts the woman with her guilt, few will have the courage to support her.

title: Death Machine
actors: Brad Dourif, Ely Pouget, William Hootkins, John Sharian
description: Jack has invented a fighting machine with destructive functions and which hides a human component. The realization of his project involved the killing of many people. The death machine soon springs into action and sows death and destruction among the enemies of the perfidious inventor.

title: Man's Best Friend
actors: Ally Sheedy, Lance Henriksen, Robert Costanzo, John Cassini
description: On the surface, Max looks like a big dog like the others, perhaps even more affectionate. In reality he has undergone a genetic experiment and one day he transforms: from "man's best friend", he becomes his worst nightmare and tears apart everything that moves. Other than Beethoven: Max's idol is called Cujo!
notes: In fact, the film closely resembles that of Lewis Teague, based on the story by Stephen King (_Cujo_, in fact). Lafia, a serial horror craftsman (_The murderer doll 2_), makes a film that keeps what it promises but never goes into the unexpected. However great Lance Henriksen.

title: A Return to Salem's Lot
actors: Michael Moriarty, Ricky Addison Reed, Samuel Fuller
description: An anthropologist travels to infamous Salem, New England, to investigate the actual existence of vampires. Here he discovers that everyone in town is bloodsucking, but integrated. They live by their own rules and do not like external annoyances. One of whom is an elderly Nazi hunter, determined to make a clean sweep of monsters.
notes: Sam Fuller's presence is ironic and the description of the vampire caste is interesting, similar to the monstrous "community" of Yuzna's "Society". But Cohen's staging is televised, and that spoils everything a bit. The film was re-titled for TV: it was originally called "The Vampires of Salem Lot".

title: Big Top Pee-wee
actors: Pee Wee Herman (Paul Reubens), Penelope Ann Miller, Kris Kristofferson, Valeria Golino
description: Pee Wee lives on a farm and has a talking pig as a companion. To keep him company is Vance who grows strange plants with him. The strange guy is engaged to Winnie, whom he loves very much and is barely tolerated by the host community. He will work to save a circus that is about to close because a storm has engulfed the tent.
notes: Despite the good cast, the film falls short of expectations. Compared to the film directed by Tim Burton in 1985 the results are much lower. The character of Pee Wee, very well known in the United States is totally unknown to us.

title: Billy Madison
actors: Adam Sandler, Darren McGavin, Bridgette Wilson, Bradley Whitford
description: Billy Madison is twenty-eight and the son of Bryan, a wealthy man who owns a chain of hotels. The boy is not a model, he gets serious because he spends all his time drinking beer and reading glossy magazines. To take possession of his father's empire, Billy is forced to return to school.
notes: Unleashed farce with Adam Sandler.

title: Agency
actors: Robert Micthum, Lee Majors, Valerie Perrine, Alexandra Stewart
description: Strange things happen in the advertising agency that Ted runs. Secret meetings are held that are not attended by the two managers of advertising launches: Morgan and his friend Sam. The best elements are fired for no reason. Sam begins to suspect the agency is hiding something shady and begins to investigate Ted's private life. But ours does not have time to conduct his investigation because he is killed. Morgan who found the body does not see clearly and does not believe the hypothesis that it is a suicide.
notes: Good suspense for a film that is weak in the development of the background.

title: Summer of the Monkey's
actors: Michael Ontkean, Leslie Hope, Wilford Brimley, Corey Sevier
description: Jay, a boy who lives on a ranch in the North American prairies, has a big dream to fulfill: buy himself a pony. But to get it he needs money and finding work is not an easy task for a kid who is not familiar with the world of work. But luck comes to the aid of Jay, who, wandering around, runs into four monkeys who have escaped from a circus that is on tour. When Jay discovers that there is a $ 85 reward for returning them, he doesn't think twice and returns the animals to their rightful owner. Will he be able to make his dream come true?

title: Anima persa
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Catherine Deneuve, Danilo Mattei
description: Nineteen-year-old Tino, an aspiring painter, is in Venice as a guest of his uncle Fabio, engineer of the gas company, proud of his Habsburg origins and of his wife Elisa. One evening Tino hears strange and inexplicable noises coming from an attic of the ancient palace. The truth is revealed to him by the elderly maid who has lived in that house for years. Fabio's brother is confined in the attic, maddened by having caused the death of his granddaughter Beba, daughter of Elisa's first bed. But no one knows where the girl's grave is.
notes: Dino Risi brings Giovanni Arpino's novel of the same name to the screen.

title: Le marginal
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Henry Silva, Pierre Vernier, Maurice Barrier
description: Commissioner Jordan has arrived in Marseille from Paris to wipe out a powerful gang of drug traffickers. Jordan, known in the world as "le marginal" for his unorthodox but very effective methods, points towards the head of the organization, the unreachable and super protected Mecacci. The commissioner, however, is removed from office and is sent to a suburb of Paris. But there he will be able to capture valuable elements that will help him capture the dangerous boss.
notes: Remarkable polar (the French detective) with the athletic Belmondo who, at the age of fifty, enriches his character with a certain literary indolence.

title: T'ammazzo!... Raccomandati a Dio
actors: George Hamilton, John Ireland, Sandra Milo, Piero Vida
description: In a small cemetery a priest is blessing the coffin of Ray, a bandit on whose head the price of a thousand dollars hung. From the top of a hill a man spies the ceremony through the lenses of a pair of binoculars. Satisfied, the individual goes away reaching a house where "The Portuguese" lives, who owes him $ 200,000 from a robbery. But "The Portuguese" makes him believe that the money was in Ray's hands.
notes: From the director of "Ric and Gian to the conquest of the West" we could not have known a great "spaghetti". And indeed ... Sandra Milo at the lowest levels.

title: Maciste contro i mostri
actors: Reg Lewis, Margaret Lee, Luciano Marin, Andrea Aureli
description: The nomadic tribe of Aidar have recently arrived in the fertile Valley of the Sun. Disturbing their peaceful existence is a fearsome dinosaur. Maciste comes to their rescue, kills the monster and temporarily frees them from any other kind of threat. But the word tranquility for the tribe of Aidar is an unknown word, because they are attacked by the Drutes, a lineage that inhabits caves. After kidnapping their women, the Drutes put out the eternal fire that allows the opposing tribe to continue living. Maciste intervenes.
notes: Another adventure, this time rather weak, of the strongest hero in the world.

title: Exquisite Tenderness
actors: Isabel Glasser, James Remar, Peter Boyle
description: A little boy decides to assist his brother, who is hospitalized awaiting a delicate operation in the hospital. Instead of being in a place like "ER", he ends up in a kind of horror clinic and watches helplessly as his brother dies under the surgeon's knife. Of course that death is anything but accidental ...

title: Executive Target
actors: Michael Madsen, Roy Scheider, Angie Everhart
description: The president of the United States wants to reduce defense spending and create new jobs. General Moore, on the other hand, instructs the criminal Lamar to kidnap the number one of the White House. In turn, Lamar kidnaps Nick, a stuntman convicted of a drug story, to organize the risky operation ...

title: Verführt - Eine gefährliche Affäre
actors: Katja Woywood, Peter Sattmann, Benjamin Sadler, Zsolt Bacs
description: The non-return from a business trip of Karin, a career woman, is greeted with a sigh of relief from her sister Sonia. The "hottest" track leads to an erotic chat frequented by the disappearance with the nickname "Demi Moore", but soon the biggest suspicions fall on Sonia herself and on Josef, a computer expert ...

title: Les insoumis
actors: Antonella Ponziani, Lou Castel, Feodor Atkine, Bernard Verley
description: Despite his manager Soriano's connivance with the mafia, young boxer Mat Prades refuses to be beaten during a match. Ten years later, in Coronado, a small Caribbean village, where Mat has rebuilt his life, the man sees Soriano disembark, accompanied by his girlfriend, Marisa. Soriano tries to convince Mat to help him buy the bay overlooked by the village, to build a luxury tourist complex. Mat is torn between the desire to help his old friend and the desire to protect the place he loves and its inhabitants, who have been close to him in a difficult time.

title: The Beautician and the Beast
actors: Fran Drescher, Timothy Dalton, Ian McNeice, Patrick Malahide
description: In its field it is considered among the best in America. Joy Miller is a cosmetics expert, fought over by all the best firms in the country. His fame also crosses borders, but it gets distorted in someone's ears. Boris Pochenko, seductive but fearsome dictator of a former USSR state, is convinced that Joy is a luminary of science, disputed by universities. Boris thus thinks of inviting the beautiful woman to become the guardian of his children. Only his children?
notes: The original title, which sounds a bit like "the beautician and the beast", gives the joyful tone of this comedy that seems to have been designed for TV.

title: The Trigger Effect
actors: Kyle MacLachlan, Elisabeth Shue, Dermot Mulroney
description: What if the electricity goes out on a bad day? Immersed in the dark, Matt and Annie discover how easy it is for their fellows to revert to the predatory animals they originally were. They shut themselves up at home, besieged by fear, but menacing figures approach. And even running away is of little use.
notes: Original thriller that has a truly excellent cast on its side.

title: La via degli angeli
actors: Valentina Cervi, Gianni Cavina, Carlo Delle Piane, Eliana Miglio
description: We are in rural Italy in the years of fascism, when the arrival of spring on the Bolognese Apennines was an event. On the first Saturday of the season, the dances began in Castel del Vescovo, in Edgardo Osti's dance hall: starting from that day, men and women began to dream of the meeting of their life. Ines also goes there, hoping to find the one who could change her existence forever. The girl falls in love with the son of an antiquarian ...
notes: With the usual skill and with the unmistakable features of his taste for storytelling, Avati talks, evokes, invents, frames his and others' memories, listens to the voices lost in time.

title: Vegas Vacation
actors: Chevy Chase, Beverly D'Angelo, Randy Quaid, Ethan Embry
description: Clark Wilhelm Griswold jr. and his family have decided to organize an unforgettable vacation. They take their bags and bags and leave for the gambling capital. There they will meet odd characters. In short, it will be a holiday that they will not easily forget.
notes: Grungy comedy with Chevy Chase.

title: Spontaneous Combustion
actors: Brad Dourif, Cynthia Bain, Jon Cypher, William Prince
description: Sam discovers that his parents were used in an atomic weapons experiment shortly before he was born and that the results of this had unexpected effects on him.
notes: The film was cut short on its release as the only failure of the "Poltergeist" director. Luckily Dourif is always good.

title: Napoli sole mio
actors: Titina De Filippo, Tina Pica, Virgilio Riento, Lorella De Luca
description: Donna Matilde, owner of a farm, lives with her daughter Lorella in a town near Naples. Having gone to the capital to visit her uncles, the girl meets Michele, a valet, and falls in love with him. The boy does not dare to reveal to Lorella what his occupation is. Lorella, back home, confides everything to her mother, who, however, wants to see clearly.
notes: A sort of Neapolitan "Poor but beautiful". The film is not without some pleasant ideas, but it is all moved on the sentimental side rather than on the comic one.

title: Non sono più guaglione
actors: Sylva Koscina, Gabriele Tinti, Yvonne Monlaur, Tina Pica
description: A mechanic falls in love with a girl who works as a tailor, but who aspires to become a diva. Entirely taken by her ambition, the girl despises the attention of the mechanic, while accepting the courtship of a shady individual who has promised her to win a beauty contest. To run after the girl, the mechanic abandons his job and to raise some money he agrees to rent a large-displacement car to the shady individual. The boy, however, is unaware that the car will be used to transport drugs ...
notes: Songs, panoramic views of Naples and two beautiful actors, Koscina and Tinti, but it's all stale.

title: Cuore matto... matto da legare
actors: Little Tony, Eleonora Brown, Ferruccio Amendola, Lucio Flauto
description: After spending five months in the United States, without achieving the hoped-for success, Tony returns to Rome where he finds his friends Marco and Sandro, more penniless than when he left. To be able to raise some money, the two try to form a band, taking advantage of Tony's beautiful voice. But there is a small detail: to buy the instruments you need one hundred thousand lire and it is not easy to find them. To further complicate matters, there is also the fact that Tony is offered the rich and ugly Erminia as his girlfriend, just as he fell in love with Carla.
notes: Rather weak musicarello with little humor.

title: Whatever It Takes
actors: Don 'The Dragon' Wilson, Fred Williamson
description: Neil De Marco and his partner Dave try to boycott the illegal steroid trade. They work undercover in the world of body building and gyms. To try to make contact with the man they believe is responsible for the traffic, Dave and Neil must prove their worth by facing more than one deadly danger.

title: Switched at Birth
actors: Melissa Gilbert, Rosanna Arquette
description: Two women learn with bewilderment, a few years after giving birth, that their respective children had been swapped at the time of birth. However, both decide to keep the same child they have raised with so much love, so as to safeguard the relationship established. But the truth, sooner or later, will still have to come out.

title: Cadaveri eccellenti
actors: Lino Ventura, Tino Carraro, Marcel Bozzuffi, Max Von Sydow
description: A police inspector, investigating the murder of three judges, finds a trail that leads him to Rome, among the palaces of power. Here he discovers a subversive plan organized by some politicians with the collaboration of state officials. He manages to communicate with the PCI secretary, but someone stops him before he does justice.
notes: Rosi's bitter apologue on the end of the ethical conception of politics. With the same determination as "Le mani sulla città" but with a new and more conscious disillusionment. In full "years of lead" the director has something for everyone, right and left, majority and opposition.

title: The Avenging Angel
actors: Tom Berenger, Charlton Heston, James Coburn, Kevin Tighe
