description: Utah, 1850. The "Mormon" state is experiencing a moment of profound crisis. Mormons and "Gentiles" (ie Christians) have long been at loggerheads over the division of land. One of the leaders of the religious community, considered a kind of prophet, preaches peaceful coexistence, but a gang of murderers condemns him to death. In his defense, however, a very skilled gunslinger.
notes: A curious western for television directed by a usually vulgar director (he made _An unconventional weapon_), which perhaps finds a congenial dimension on the small screen. Cast of old glories of the Frontier imagination.

title: La compagna di viaggio
actors: Marina Frajese, Anna Maria Rizzoli, Gastone Moschin
description: A fallen noble decides to organize a theft on the Rome-Paris train. Instead of hiring a robber he gets help from a busty actress who is supposed to distract the victims thanks to her ... thanks. Unexpected events coming up.
notes: More than the pecoreccio trend, Baldi's film plays the soft porn card, with all the consequences of the case (just to name one: you will see it censored). The director is a neophyte of the genre, and it shows. The same cannot be said of actresses, who do not spare themselves. In the cast, in addition to Marina Lothar and Annamaria Rizzoli, also Marisa Mell and a young Moana Pozzi.

title: Eternal Revenge
actors: Alexandra Paul, Michelle Johnson, Allen Altman
description: A female police officer, Laura Underwood, is on the trail of a ruthless serial killer who is killing some men guilty of raping her years ago. But to stop her he has to hurry, because from a series of clues artfully disseminated by the killer Laura discovers that the next victim could be her ex-boyfriend. The hunt for the killer is on, and it will be no holds barred.
notes: A discreetly made Tv Movie, curious above all for the "feminine" dimension of the action. Alexandra Paul is a star of American television, here engaged in an interesting role.

title: Best Men
actors: Dean Cain, Andy Dick, Sean Patrick Flanery, Mitchell Whitfield
description: It is hot in a small town in the southern United States and a lazy election campaign for the post of mayor does not attract much interest. But when five handsome young men and formal dresses arrive, the atmosphere comes alive. They reunited after three years apart for the wedding of one of them just out of prison, but they quickly find themselves embroiled in a bank robbery organized by Billy.
notes: Bizarre characters above and below the lines intersect in Tamra Davis' film, giving rise to a spurious comedy, which in some moments also leaves room for melodrama and tragedy.

title: Lola Colt
actors: Lola Falana, Peter Martell, German Cobas, Tom Felleghy
description: A dance troupe is forced to stop in a village in the West because a dancer is struck by a severe malarial fever. The village is terrified by a ferocious bandit, El Diablo, who holds some inhabitants hostage. Only a medical student is determined to do something to free the imprisoned citizens. In his enterprise he is helped by Lola, one of the girls of the corps de ballet.
notes: Mediocre and rather naive musical western made by a director very active in Rai in the seventies and eighties. Lola Falana sings "One like you" and "Write your name on my hand".

title: La noia
actors: Catherine Spaak, Horst Buchholz, Bette Davis, Isa Miranda
description: Dino, having discovered his inability to communicate with people, indulges in complete idleness in the company of Cecilia, a model for whom he feels only sexual attraction. This relationship, too, could lead to boredom if Dino did not learn that the girl is cheating on him. In order to keep the woman tied to him, Dino asks her to marry him. Shocked by the girl's refusal, he attempts suicide.
notes: Damiani draws his film from Moravia's novel of the same name and gets help in the script by Tonino Guerra and Ugo Liberatore. Not entirely successful, and with a silly cast, but with a certain underlying atmosphere.

title: Soldati e capelloni
actors: Peppino De Filippo, Lia Zoppelli, Gianni Agus, Valeria Fabrizi
description: Peppino Pica, a penniless impresario, intends to launch a musical group that opposes the prevailing fashion of the beat. The failure of the first audition causes him to hastily retrace his steps. After a year of waiting, the time it takes to get the boys to regrow their hair, and the group returns to the scene with a resounding success. This allows Peppino to sign a profitable contract. But from that moment on, things get pretty bad ...
notes: Insulting musicarello. One of the later examples of a genre that didn't have much to say anymore.

title: A Zed and Two Noughts
actors: Joss Ackland, Andréa Ferréol, Frances Barber, Agnes Brulet, Ken Campbell, Brian Deacon, Eric Deacon, Guusje van Tilborgh, Gerard Thoolen, Ken Campbell, Wolf Kahler
description: An accident, caused by a swan hitting the windshield of a car, kills two women and injures Alba, who is forced to have her leg amputated. The operation is finished by a surgeon-painter who also amputates the other one so that the woman becomes a living copy of his extravagant paintings. The incident leaves two former Siamese twin entomologists widowed to work for a zoo filming the times and stages of decay of dead animals. The two turn their hatred towards the survivor into passion.
notes: Film full of rebus, charades and riddles (which are lost in the dubbing). Among the best in Greenaway

title: Celtic Pride
actors: Damon Wayans, Daniel Stern, Dan Aykroyd, Gail O'Grady
description: Two passionate basketball fans, willing to do anything to win their favorite team, the Boston Celtics, decide to kidnap the best player of the opposing team. But unfortunately for them the kidnapped turns out to be good even bound and gagged.

title: The Return of the Soldier
actors: Glenda Jackson, Julie Christie, Ann-Margret, Alan Bates
description: A young British officer seriously injured during the First World War returns home in the throes of a severe crisis of amnesia. There are three women waiting for him and, above all, trying to make his memory come back: his wife, his cousin and his first love. But getting back to normal won't be easy ...

title: The Paradine Case
actors: Gregory Peck, Alida Valli, Charles Laughton, Ann Todd
description: Colonel Paradine, a valiant and wealthy officer, is found dead in his bed. The widow is the first to be accused: in the course of repeated talks with the defendant, the defense lawyer falls in love with her, neglecting his young wife. Studying the case, the lawyer comes across a strange character, the colonel's waiter, who had remained in the shadows until then ...
notes: A film strongly wanted by the producer Selznick and that Hitch directed reluctantly: since the class is not water, the result is still excellent. So-so Gregory Peck, convincing La Valli, amazing Laughton.

title: Simon Sez
actors: Dennis Rodman, Dane Cook, Ricky Harris, John Pinette
description: Simon is a handsome Interpol agent who loves to roam around on his motorcycle wrapped in an impeccable yellow and black overalls, engaged in breathtaking shadowing conducted thanks to the technological devilry of the Micro and Macro faithful (who operate, always dressed as friars, in a central camouflaged inside a convent). When an old colleague asks him to help him in a kidnapping case linked to an arms trafficking concocted by the evil Ashton, Simon does not hold back ...
notes: Tedious to death: in the rare moments of smashing action, the poor slumbering spectator risks waking up. Picturesque Rodman is a former NBA champion.

title: Phantoms
actors: Ben Affleck, Peter O'Toole, Rose McGowan, Joanna Going
description: The inhabitants of a mountain village all disappear one bad day, sucked into a demonic entity known as "the ancient enemy", Chaos. A sheriff and a journalist, a former Oxford professor considered somewhat heretical by the academic world) seek a painless way to save humanity from the end (with the help of the army and two unfortunate maidens).
notes: Directed by serial horror craftsman Joe Chappelle, "Phantoms" is actually a film by Dean R. Koontz, the poor man's Stephen King. A bad story and a bad film with little suspense, a routine staging and a certain sloppiness of the performers.

title: Polish Wedding
actors: Claire Danes, Jon Bradford, Lena Olin, Gabriel Byrne
description: The very Catholic Polish Pszoniak family, consisting of a father, mother, four sons, a daughter, a daughter-in-law and a grandson, lives in the suburbs of Detroit. For a "strange" family tradition, all the women got married pregnant, and this is also what is going to happen to Hala, the only daughter of the Pszoniak. The problem is that the girl was chosen to play the role of the virgin crowning the statue of the redeemer during the Procession of the Virgin.
notes: Theresa Connelly's first film, "Love & Secrets" is a comedy that attempts to weave both the praise and criticism of the family at the same time, but the script is sobbing and the film never manages to pick up an acceptable pace.

title: Erin Brockovich
actors: Julia Roberts, Albert Finney, Aaron Eckhart, David Brisbin, Dawn Didawick, Valente Rodriguez, Conchata Ferrell, George Rocky Sullivan, Pat Skipper, Jack Gill, Irene Olga López
description: Erin Brockovich is an intelligent, purposeful, beautiful and flashy single mom. Instead of looking for another husband, look for a job; runs into a fat, rough but good-hearted lawyer and gets hired by him. It will be thanks to this new job of his that, with resourcefulness and a sense of justice, he will begin to investigate the Pacific Gas and Electric Company, which has contaminated the aquifers of a Californian town, causing cancer to residents.
notes: A Soderbergh committed to the wave of civil cinema that was. Oscar to Julia Roberts.

title: Love's Labour's Lost
actors: Kenneth Branagh, Richard Briers, Nathan Lane, Adrian Lester
description: The king of Navarre, his three companions, who have sworn to study for three years, avoiding any female company, the princess of France and her three bridesmaids meet in a castle. Here, despite the promises made, they immediately trigger the game of seduction.
notes: Rehabilitated in the 1930s, the comedy has become a musical, unfolding through songs by Porter, Gershwin, Berlin and the other greats of musical comedy. Unfortunately, none of the protagonists, except Adrian Lester, are quite comfortable dancing and singing. There remains, underground, a spell from walkers like "In the middle of a cold winter" and a great ending.

title: Down to You
actors: Freddie Prinze jr, Julia Stiles, Shawn Hatosy, Selma Blair, Zach Orth
description: Al wants to be a chef like her father and Imogen is passionate about painting and has a sweet tooth. They study at the same college, they meet, love each other, break up and (who would have thought?) They find each other.
notes: To try, with a touch of desperation, to involve the adolescent spectators, the two protagonists look towards the camera and narrate, without neglecting any comma of stracon conventions, their resistible lovemaking. Freddie Prinze jr and Julia Stiles, weighed down by "Kiss Me" and "10 Things I Hate About You", mimic a youth less likely than that of "Happy Days".

title: Stigmata
actors: Patricia Arquette, Gabriel Byrne, Jonathan Pryce
description: A young atheist hairdresser from Pittsburgh discovers with terror and pain that she has the stigmata, a divine sign of holiness reserved for a select few. The signs of the passion of Christ on her body are caused by an ancient rosary gift from the mother, and attract the attention of an investigating priest sent by the Vatican, who ascertains that the woman is the terminal of an entity that dictates to her in Aramaic a gospel already known and destined by the Church to oblivion, because it completely rewrites its history.
notes: Exciting and engaging, Wainwright's film recovers a tension of the apocalyptic clash between "sacred" and "demonic" reminiscent of "The Exorcist" and "The Omen".

title: Caddyshack
actors: Chevy Chase, Bill Murray, Rodney Dangerfield, Michael O'Keefe
description: Exclusive golf club. All members must have fifteen zero current accounts. Danny is a caddy of humble origins who lends himself to "picking up balls" to raise some money for college. Balances and conventions of snobbish members are literally upset when a slob takes aim at the club.
notes: Funny and misunderstood comedy by Harold Ramis at the beginning as a director. DOC demented comedy and great comedic performances by the actors. In particular, don't lose sight of Rodney Dangerfield (Al).

title: Prima la musica poi le parole
actors: Anna Bonaiuto, Andrej Chalimon, Barbara Enrichi, Gigio Alberti
description: A child is kept out of the world for a few years. When his father who lives apart dies, the boy wanders the Tuscan countryside in search of someone who can love him. The fact is, no one understands his strange language. Fortunately, on his way he meets a psychologist who wants to penetrate her secret. So against everyone's opinion he takes it away ...
notes: The subject is linguistically original; just as punctually proud is Anna Bonaiuto's intense interpretation. Nice and concentrated the test of the little Andrej Chalimon (already seen in "Kolya"). The script is less convincing.

title: Tiburzi
actors: Pio Giannelli, Marcello Bartolomei, Stefano Bambini, Roberto Valenti
description: The brigand Tiburzi known by all by the nickname of "king of the Maremma" reappears after five years of inaction in France. The captain of the carabinieri, the Piedmontese Giacheri, discovers that his opponent has become a lame and defenseless old man.
notes: "Realist" portrait of a legendary brigand, directed with masterful rigor by the director of "Confortorio". The film is also a reflection on the objectivity of cinema and its origins, halfway between the Lumière brothers and the Alinari brothers.

title: Les experiences erotiques de Frankenstein
actors: Dennis Price, Howard Vernon, Anne Libert
description: Cagliostro, with the help of Melissa, half rapacious half woman, and the monstrous Morpho, kills Baron Frankenstein and takes possession of his creature. His plan is simple: he would like to create other similar "creatures" with which to march to conquer the world. Frankenstein's daughter tries to stop him.
notes: Morbid, but don't expect strongly erotic things. It is more than anything else a delirium of our Z series (already the plot), messed up and with visionary wing strokes, by a master of trash like the Spanish Franco.

title: King Cobra
actors: Pat Morita, Scott Brandon, Erik Estrada, Casey Fallo, Hoyt Axton
description: Seth, a snake of the "king cobra" race, considered particularly dangerous and lethal, is genetically altered to become gigantic. He targets a group of teenagers and yokels with the intention of making them his daily hearty meal.
notes: Typical "straight to video" product, ie intended for the cassette market. Ultra hidden situations, a photocopy of the soundtrack of "The Jaws", a low budget production with some special special effects. Funny the appearance of Erik Estrada in a version at least ... extravagant. Anyway, cheering for the snake.

title: Quando gli uomini armarono la clava e... con le donne fecero din-don
actors: Antonio Sabato, Aldo Giuffré, Vittorio Caprioli, Nadia Cassini, Elio Pandolfi
description: Two tribes of the prehistoric era, the Cavemen who live on the mainland and the Acquamanni who live on stilts, are almost always fighting each other. During a momentary period of peace, the young Ari, chief of the first tribe thanks to a fight, wins Lystra one of the virgins of the Acquamanni. But the tranquility does not last long because the two tribes still declare war on each other and Lystra, tired of conflicts, proclaims a sex strike together with the other women. The gimmick, at least initially, is successful.
notes: Bruno Corbucci "adapts" Aristophanes, but the result is depressing.

title: Murder, She Wrote: South by Southwest
actors: Angela Lansbury, Mel Harris, Ray Baker
description: On the train bound for El Paso, Jessica Fletcher, a famous mystery writer, meets Sarah, an eyewitness in a murder case. At one point the young woman disappears from the train: Jessica can't find her anywhere despite the fact that the train never stopped. The mystery deepens.
notes: A Tv Movie loosely inspired by Hitchcock's "The Lady Disappears".

title: Doomsday Rock/Cosmic Shock
actors: William Devane, Connie Sellecca, Ed Marinaro, Jessica Walter
description: An American scientist predicted the impact of the asteroid Nemesis with the Earth. His appeal to the Pentagon gone unheeded, the scientist takes control of a nuclear missile base with the intention of crushing the meteorite with an atomic rocket. The scientist's daughter tries to avert a retaliatory action against her father ...

title: The Iron Girl
actors: Nathalie Hendrix, Jerry Pacific, Richard Goon
description: Susan, a girl from an American college, following the example of her friend Billy, a very good Cino -American with martial arts, learns Kung Fu. She will be useful to deal with the band of the usual bullying bullying.
notes: Following the scheme of his "boys with a gold kimono", De Angelis repeats the clichés of the subgenre.

title: L'uomo più velenoso del cobra
actors: Georges Ardisson, Erika Blanc, Alberto De Mendoza
description: The brother of a criminal who has decided to change his life is found dead. The gangster is convinced that the perpetrator is his brother's partner, and organizes a fake Safari in Kenya with the intention of killing him by pretending to be an accident. At some point it turns out that the killer could be someone else.
notes: Unknown (and somewhat dated) Italian yellow.

title: Don Giovanni in Sicilia
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Katia Moguy, Rossana Martini
description: Don Giovanni is a calf from Catania accustomed to living as a great seducer. One day he decides to go to Milan in search of adventures, but in the metropolis he is sucked into work. His wife moves away from him, and the gallant successes are no longer what they used to be. Eventually the call of Sicily will make itself felt again.
notes: Despite the happy directorial hand of Alberto Lattuada, the film reveals a certain moralism. But post-Boom Milan is portrayed with well-chosen sarcasm, and Lando Buzzanca's interpretation is still spot-on. One of the lesser known films of the filmmaker.

title: Uomini e nobiluomini
actors: Vittorio De Sica, Antonio Cifariello, Mario Carotenuto, Silvia Pinal, Raffaele Pisu, Alberto Talegalli, Elke Sommer, Marco Tulli, Maria Grazia Spina, Tiberio Murgia
description: A penniless noble "Count Max" style cultivates a dream: to marry his daughter to an aristocrat and thus regain the ancient lineage. Too bad that the daughter does not want to know, and is well determined to get married with a penniless. When the nobleman discovers the truth, he makes up for it in another way. He marries a rich lady.
notes: Unfortunately, the magical combination Giorgio Bianchi-Vittorio De Sica ("The Count Max") does not perform as one would expect. The interpreter is somewhat of a slave to his character, and the director limits himself to the minimum necessary. Nourished the cast of character actors.

title: Défense de savoir
actors: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Charles Denner, Michel Bouquet
description: During a fiery election campaign, an honest carrier dies mysteriously, perhaps because he wanted to report some filth of his boss. A Parisian lawyer decides to investigate the case, but is faced with a dense network of connivance and silence.
notes: Interesting French detective story that describes the world of politics as that of crime.

title: L'uomo venuto per uccidere
actors: Richard Wyler, Femi Benussi, William Spolt
description: A terrible bandit hunted by a sheriff decides to move on to the counterattack. Instead of continuing to be chased, he moves on to strong ways and organizes himself to kill the man of the law. But on the way he meets his old teacher, who manages to convince him to abandon crime. The bandit meets the sheriff, not to kill him but to help him in a difficult business.
notes: Curious Italian western with a psychological background. Unfortunately, the realization does not convince, and the actors are too anonymous for the parties. At the time, however, it passed practically unnoticed.

title: Forever Mosketeers
actors: Michael Dudikoff, L. Mayhrs
description: The "American warrior" recycles himself this time in the shoes of an unlikely modern musketeer. Together with him, three nice Gascons who, in addition to knowing how to use steel perfectly, know the rudiments of kung-fu by finger.
notes: Nothing to do with Dumas, despite allusions. A curious operation, thwarted by the television staging.

title: Un condé
actors: Gianni Garko, Adolfo Celi, Michel Bouquet
description: During a police operation against some drug dealers, a young officer dies. His colleague, disillusioned inspector of the criminal section, decides to avenge him without taking legal action. He clears the gang and then resigns in front of the stunned superiors.
notes: Taken from a famous polar of the literary Série Noire, "La mort d'un condé" by Vial Lesov, this French detective discreetly doses times and rhythms anticipating some narrative tendencies typical of American cinema (like Callaghan). The tests by Garko and Celi are interesting. Boisset is a solid artisan of French noir.

title: Doucement les basses
actors: Alain Delon, Nathalie Delon, Paul Meurisse, Julien Guiomar
description: The parish priest Simon took his vows after the death of his beautiful wife, who drowned and then disappeared in the waters. But one day his wife turns up more alive than ever, and he naturally regrets having chosen the cloister. He asks for the cancellation of his vows and discovers that his wife has become a nun in the meantime. All that remains is to kidnap her.
notes: Curious comedy by professional Jacques Deray (usually more comfortable with noir). Not always spot on in the timing, but enhanced by the performance of the actors (great Meurisse). The two Delons, however, were separating in earnest.

title: The Dark Side of the Moon
actors: Joe Turkel, Will Bledsoe, John Diehl
description: Logbook, stardate 2022. A mysterious turbulence forces a spaceship to land on the dark side of the Moon, where technical problems begin to occur. Fuel and oxygen quickly run out, condemning the crew to certain death. The only source of salvation, boarding a NASA spacecraft floating adrift in the cosmos. But when the men from the distressed spaceship reach the wreck and enter, they are possessed and then killed by a mysterious force. Commander Paxton, among the few survivors, discovers that there is a relationship of evil force between the dark side of the Moon and the Bermuda Triangle on Earth. In practice, these would be the favorite locations of the ... devil.
notes: Low budget science fiction, made for video and TV. Nothing transcendental, but the plot is curious, and the developments of the story exciting. Unfortunately, Pink Floyd is not on the score.

title: Come Back, Little Sheba
actors: Burt Lancaster, Terry Moore, Shirley Booth, Philip Ober, Edwin Max
description: Doc Delaney, a mature gentleman who is experiencing his marriage crisis dramatically, thinks regretfully of little Sheba, the dog he raised with his wife, Lola. One day the couple decides to rent a room in the house to a girl, to feel less alone and to see if it is possible to find a harmonious coexistence. Mary responds to their appeal, whose vitality Doc is immediately conquered.
notes: Non-trivial drama (even if a little dated) represented with a sure hand by the specialist Daniel Mann. Excellent Lancaster as her frustrated, drunkard husband. Shirly Booth won the Academy Award for Supporting Actress.

title: Granada addio
actors: Claudio Villa, Raimondo Vianello, Susanna Martin
description: The "Reuccio" of the Italian cnzone finally manages to fulfill his dream. In fact, his manager organizes a tour in Spain for him. It is the triumph. But in the hottest land of Europe, the singer falls in love with a beautiful Andalusian, Consuelo. And to conquer it he uses the melodies of his poignant repertoire.
notes: A more serious musician than the average, also because in place of the various Little Tony and Bobby Solo there is Claudio Villa, who has a greater dramatic appeal. But directing today would be called television, and the story is just a pretext to hear the Reuccio shouting "Grenada" at the top of his voice.

title: Odio en la frontera
actors: Robert Wood, Fernando Sancho, Loredana Nusciak
description: Two Americans escaped from a security prison cross the border and go to safety in Mexico. Here they are hired by the owner of a silver mine who would like to use them as a killer against the peons. The Americans, on the other hand, decide to play a double game and help the campesinos.
notes: Grim "western paella" without too many qualities.

title: La polizia chiede aiuto
actors: Giovanna Ralli, Claudio Cassinelli, Mario Adorf, Franco Fabrizi
description: Silvia, a girl in desperation, is found hanged in the attic behind an anonymous report. At first it seems that the girl committed suicide, but some elements in the hands of Commissioner Valentini and his colleague Silvestri make the investigation take another turn. Silvia was induced to do so by her exploiters who ran a ring in which the daughter of Commissioner Valentini also seems to be involved. At the head of the organization there seems to be Professor Beltrame ...
notes: Remarkable detective story by Massimo Dallamano, who manages to combine the dramatic tones of yellow with action.

title: Girls! Girls! Girls!
actors: Elvis Presley, Stella Stevens, Jeremy Slate, Laurel Goodwin, Benson Fong
description: Ross is a sailor with a gift and a dream. The gift is the splendid voice, the dream is to buy a beautiful boat in order to become an "owner" on his own. To make his dream come true he decides to take advantage of the gift. So every evening he gives singing performances in a club. But Ross also has another problem, his girlfriend. Which is a nice "peperino" ...
notes: Despite Jerry Lewis' trusted director Norman Taurog, "A Hundred Girls and a Sailor" is a slim comedy. Moreover, from two wild characters like Elvis and Stevens, there was just more to be expected.

title: Demoni 2... L'incubo ritorna
actors: Nancy Brilli, David Edwin Knight, Bobby Rhodes, Asia Argento
description: In an ultramodern skyscraper, the life of the condominiums runs smoothly. Until, of course, someone begins to undergo terrifying physical mutations, turning into a repellent and bloodthirsty monster. In a sort of chain contagion, the characters become "demons". It turns out that televisions have some responsibility ...
notes: Pretty well done splatter effects (by Sergio Stivaletti), screenplay (written by Dario Argento among others) elementary, heavy debts towards Romero's Zombies. For a while we also have fun, but then the massacre becomes repetitive ...

title: Unforgettable
actors: Linda Fiorentino, Ray Liotta, Peter Coyote, Christopher McDonald
description: Dr. Krane has been acquitted of murdering his wife, but continues to be uneasy. He meets a colleague, Martha Briggs, who is experimenting with a system for transferring memory from one brain to another. He decides to offer himself as a "guinea pig" and asks that the memories of his dead wife and her alleged killers be grafted onto him. Thus he hopes to discover the real culprit.
notes: Definitely fascinating subject, which John Dahl ("Red Rock West") does not always manage to make the most of. Too many flashbacks and too cumbersome the narrative structure. Excellent Linda Fiorentino.

title: Striking Poses
actors: Shannen Doherty, Sean Hewitt, Colm Feore, Joseph Griffin
description: Gage Sullivan, a famous photographer who collaborates with some tabloid magazines, is targeted by a gang of scammers. By exploiting Gage's distrust of people and his lack of affection, the scammers manage to extort a lot of money from the young woman. At one point, Gage notices the scam and decides to react vigorously ...

title: My Very Best Friend
actors: Jaclyn Smith, Jill Eikenberry, Beverly Elliott, Tom Irwin, Robert Lewis (II)
description: Former model Dana is an extremely charming woman. She had a life full of satisfactions that allowed her to fulfill her every wish. But things have changed. Dana is no longer on the crest of the wave and needs money. So she marries a rich man, but Dana's best friend, Barbara, discovers that something insidious lies behind that marriage ...

title: Up the Creek
actors: Tim Matheson, John Hillerman, Jennifer Runyon
description: Some American and Canadian colleges decide to challenge each other in single combat: a rafting race through the rapids of a winding river. During the competition the boys combine all the colors and also have time to think about the girls.
notes: Collective comedy with one of the protagonists of "Animal House". No relationship with the cult of Landis, but the stunts in the water are not bad.

title: La bella Lola
actors: Sara Montiel, Antonio Cifariello, Luisa Mattioli, German Cobos
description: Antonio, an aristocrat with a stench under his nose, is betting with his friends that he will be able to seduce Lola, a singer in a café chantant in Madrid. Love is born between the two and Antonio, despite the strong opposition of his mother and the environment, announces his engagement with the girl. Antonio tries to introduce her to society where, however, she is coldly received. At this point the aristocrat's mother intervenes and tries to persuade Lola to abandon her son. The singer can't stand the pressure and ends up giving herself to alcohol.
notes: Spanish melodrama not particularly inspired.

title: Mr. Wrong
actors: Bill Pullman, Ellen DeGeneres, Joan Cusack, Dean Stockwell
description: Martha is a single now no longer very young who works in a television talk show. After her younger sister's wedding, friends and relatives begin to wonder if and when her turn will come; and in fact one day, much to the general surprise, Martha begins dating Whitman, a brilliant stranger she has fallen in love with (moreover reciprocated). But the character is at least bizarre, and the woman discovers it at her own expense: breaking up with him therefore becomes an increasingly pressing imperative, whatever the cost ...
notes: Peppery comedy with an adequate cast. Ellen DeGeneres is a star of the small screen with stars and stripes.

title: Midnight Man
actors: Lorenzo Lamas, James Lew, Mako, Eric Pierpoint, James Shigeta
description: John Kang, a quiet and respected policeman with no particular crickets in his head, accidentally finds himself at the center of a case that other colleagues are following. In reality, someone, who considers him naive and "passive", is trying to skillfully frame him. But Kang does not let himself be taken aback and will have the opportunity to prove that he is a mastiff ...
notes: What does Lorenzo Lamas have in common with Van Damme? A certain propensity for martial arts and absolute inexpressiveness. The first, then, particularly loves to wander around on a motorcycle ... Action TV movie without particular qualities. Those who love the genre, however, take a seat.

title: Un gatto nel cervello
actors: Lucio Fulci, Brett Halsey, Malisa Longo, Ria De Simone, Paola Cozzo
description: Lucio Fulci, a horror film director, is obsessed with the images of death that he himself created. For this he turns to a psychologist. Even the doctor is not in such good shape, however, since he is actually a serial killer.
notes: This is certainly an interesting operation by Fulci, who plays himself in a film made with little means, shot in 16 mm. and made by assembling waste material from his other works. But the director pushes his thinking too far, the story becomes cerebral and the result is too sloppy to be truly experimental. However, for fans of the filmmaker, an unmissable gem.

title: House Arrest
actors: Jamie Lee Curtis, Kevin Pollak, Jennifer Love Hewitt, Wallace Shawn
description: High school student Grover Beindorf and his younger sister Stacy, when their parents, Janet and Ned, decide to divorce after eighteen years of marriage, they find that mom and dad are behaving childishly and so they think it best to lock them up. in the basement. There the two spouses in crisis will remain prisoners until they are able to solve their problems and reconcile. Following Grover and Stacy's example, some of their schoolmates decide to do the same with their parents to help them solve their respective family problems.
notes: Fun comedy with a decent cast.

title: Kids Return
actors: Masanobu Ando, Ken Kaneko, Hatsuo Yamaya
description: Shinji and Masaru are the typical bad boys, always ready to skip school or extort yen from weaker classmates. In reality they too are looking for some form of redemption: the first by training hard and dreaming of making it into the world of boxing, the second by cultivating another desire: he would like to join the yakuza, the powerful Japanese mafia. They soon realize that there isn't that much difference between a high school teacher and a mafia boss.
notes: Written and directed by Kitano after the terrible motorcycle accident that almost cost him his life (and still bears the scars on his face). As often happens to particularly "heartfelt" films, here too not everything runs smoothly as in the other works of the author. Here, like an entomologist, Kitano tells without moralizing the end of adolescence in a world steeped in hatred and wickedness. Not to be missed anyway, in principle.

title: Nobat-e-asheghi
actors: Shiva Gered, Abdolrahman Palay, Aken Tunj, Menderes Samancilar
description: First version. While recording birdsong in a cemetery, an elderly individual overhears the conversation between a blond shoeshine and his mistress. The elderly individual reports everything to her husband who kills his rival and hands himself over to the police ... Second version. The blond man is Gazale's husband ... Third version. The two men give up Gazale fighting ...

title: Minna yatteruka
actors: Dankan, Tokie Hiddari, Shoji Kobayashi
description: Asao has a purpose in life: women. Asao has a characteristic: he is a failure. Asao tries everything to make himself beautiful: he sells his grandfather's organs (this he does for the money), he rob banks, he is an actor, even a killer. There's nothing to do. Perhaps its fate is that of the giant fly ...
notes: Kitano shows off his primary streak, the comic one. The result is flawless and surreal.

title: Disturbing Behaviour
actors: James Marsden, Katie Holmes, Nick Stahl, Steve Railsback
description: Steve moves with his family from Chicago to a seaside town following the tragic death of his older brother. At the local high school he makes friends with Gavin and discovers that the rigid social hierarchy, at the top of which are the Blue Ribbons, model children but prone to violence. Gavin reveals his hypothesis to Steve: the model kids are the result of an experiment by the school doctor.
notes: A classic horror school setting that draws heavily from the stereotypes of the genre. The evident resistance of the performers to their job does not help the film to take off.

title: Pane e cioccolata
actors: Nino Manfredi, Paolo Turco, Ugo D'Alessio, Tano Cimarosa, Johnny Dorelli, Anna Karina, Gianfranco Barra, Giacomo Rizzo, Geoffrey Copleston, Max Delys, Umberto Raho
description: Nino, who emigrated to Switzerland, manages to get a quarterly contract as a waiter in a restaurant, but is fired and deprived of his residence permit. Nino instead of returning to Italy takes refuge in Elena's house, a Greek exile. Expatriate like him but for fiscal reasons, an Italian industrialist hires him in his service. He, abandoned by his wife and in the midst of the financial crisis, kills himself after having stolen all his savings from Nino. At this point, the former waiter joins a group of Neapolitans who slaughter chickens for a living and live in a chicken coop.
notes: Certainly one of the best films by Nino Manfredi. A very dark reflection on Italian emigration abroad is conducted on an Italian comedy plot. An intelligent film, with an ending that goes against every stereotype (even if it is difficult not to cheer with Manfredi when Italy scores against Switzerland).

title: Atomic Dog
actors: Cindy Pickett, Isabella Hoffmann, Daniel Hugh Kelly
description: An entire community is threatened by a dog born inside a factory where radioactive waste is treated. The animal has gone mad due to the radiation it was exposed to and poses a threat to the peaceful population of the town where the plant is located.

title: Crowned and Dangerous
actors: Yasmine Bleeth, Jill Clayburgh, Cassidy Rae, Gates McFadden
description: A girl who has successfully entered a beauty pageant is killed in mysterious circumstances. The police who started the investigation begin to draw up a list of the main suspects. The list includes the girl's ex-boyfriend, a rival and the mother of the beauty queen.

title: Little Girls in Pretty Boxes
actors: Swoozie Kurtz, Philip Casnoff, Linda Hart, Jim Metzler
description: A promising athlete from the US national team is training to participate in the selections that open the doors of the Olympics. The girl is pushed by her coach to give her all with tragic consequences ...
notes: Directed by a TV veteran, it doesn't give any surprises.

title: Zerschmetterte Träume
actors: Mark Keller, Sophie Schütt, Nicolas König, Hardy Krüger jr.
description: Fortuna smiles at the young Jan Evers. Former basketball sample, he renews his success in sport making the instructor. And even private life is swollen: the beautiful Sandra is about to become his wife. The evening before the long -awaited wedding night the disaster happens. Dancing during the celebrations, Jan is the victim of a bad fall and gets a permanent back injury. He will have to spend the rest of his days in a wheelchair. And with the passage of time things end up taking a bad turn. Sandra, inevitably, leaves him, the work is missing, the general situation throws him in despair. The only spark of hope, the friendship of Nick, disabled like him, and the attempt that his former students are making to decease his life a little easier ... films for the German television of the last generation, than those thought for programs with debate. Beyond a certain pathetism, the film does not present particular elements of novelty.

title: Paradise, Hawaiian Style
actors: Elvis Presley, Suzanna Leigh, James Shigeta, Donna Butterworth
description: Hawaii, pilot Rick, who has been unemployed for the umpteenth time due to his enterprising sentimental initiatives, convinces his friend Danny to found a company that takes tourists by helicopters from one place to another on the island. One day Rick, who is transporting dogs to a competition, due to their restlessness, loses control of the aircraft and ends up causing a car accident. Unfortunately for him in the car there is a civil aviation officer who withdraws his permit to fly. The company risks bankruptcy, but ...
notes: The film is a pretext to combine Elvis' singing performances.

title: Logan's War: Bound by Honor
actors: R. D. Call, Chuck Norris, Eddie Cibrian, Joe Spano, Jeff Kober
description: Logan Fallon, a ten-year-old boy, unwittingly witnesses the murder of his family by a group of men in the service of a mafia boss. After the massacre he is entrusted to his wealthy uncle, landowner and martial arts lover. The desire for revenge that Logan carries within him never leaves him. After becoming a skilled fighter and an expert karateka, with the help of his uncle he will manage to infiltrate the mafia organization under a false name. Its aim is to eliminate one by one those responsible for the horrendous massacre.

title: Mercy
actors: Ellen Barkin, Julian Sands, Peta Wilson, Karen Young, Wendy Crewson
description: Detective Catherine Palmer is involved in the investigation into the killing of some young women. Their bodies always lie stretched out on a bed, their hands joined and showing horrible signs of violence and their lids cut off. The detective follows a lead that leads to a friend of one of the victims, and discovers that they are all involved in a round of lesbian BDSM sex. Palmer, who is trying to overcome the failure of her marriage, feels particularly involved in the investigation, which reveals several surprises.
notes: Barkin does what she can to keep the shack up, which finally collapses when psychoanalyst Broussard comes into play.

title: Supernova
actors: Angela Bassett, James Spader, Robert Forster, Lou Diamond Philips
description: On Nightingale 229, a rescue vessel on a mission, a request for help arrives from a planet that is beyond the great space-time leap. The spaceship on its way finds a wreck containing an alien artifact with evil powers and the body of a survivor. The object and the missing person, once in the passenger compartment, create situations of tension.
notes: Walter Hill, who signs himself as Thomas Lee for a disagreement with the production, loves to contaminate genres: in this case mélo, science fiction and pure thriller. The direction is functional to a story that metabolizes (with intelligence) fragments of "Alien" "Solaris" and "2001: a space odyssey". Unfortunately, the problems during the editing phase (with Francis Coppola taking over as supervisor) made some of the dialogues disconnected and the visual effects not entirely completed (the film was finished in a hurry, with evident listlessness). blockbuster from the icy packaging, the impurities of "Supernova" end up shining with their own light.

title: Anatomie
actors: Franka Potente, Benno Fürmann, Sebastian Blomberg, Anna Loos
description: Determined to follow in the footsteps of her father and grandfather, Paula won the admission competition to the prestigious anatomy summer course at the University of Heidelberg. Nothing should distract her from studying, not even love. But soon his path crosses that of the AAA! Sect, a secret lodge of anti-Hippocratic doctors born in the eighteenth century and reborn during the Nazis, which pursues research on people not yet dead ...
notes: The adrenaline-pumping Franka Potente is that of _Lola corre_: and she is forced to run here as well, in an attempt to escape the menacing followers of the sect in this modest film with a clear television matrix.

title: Dudley Do-Right
actors: Brendan Fraser, Sarah Jessica Parker, Alfred Molina, Eric Idle
description: In the cheery and quiet community of Semi-Happy Valley, the red-coated Dudley horseback riding must enforce order. An easy task until the perfidious Snidely Whiplash arrives, who with a subterfuge, gets poor Dudley fired and even gives a shit about his girlfriend. Snidely deliberately unleashes a gigantic hunt for gold, to do business with tourists and gold prospectors who have landed in droves, and becomes the undisputed master of the town. But poor Dudley won't give up ...
notes: The film is yet another "live action" transposition of the animated characters born from the imagination of the late Jay Ward. Wilson doesn't shine his characters in a useless film.

title: Heaven
actors: Danny Edwards, Martin Donovan, Joanna Going, Patrick Malahide
description: The gift of premonitions is that possessed by Heaven, a transsexual who works as a dancer, ironically, at Paradise. In Heaven's brain there are shreds of the future that cause her excruciating pain, and they are visions of amazing precision that involve people familiar to her. First, Robert, an architect in crisis and Stanner, her pygmalion, the man who took her off the street to turn her into a dancer.
notes: "Heaven" is an ambitious, eventful film built around a complicated interlocking mechanism of flashbacks and flashforwards. But unfortunately the film often yields under the weight of an excessive load.

title: Detroit Rock City
actors: Edward Furlong, James DeBello, Sam Huntington, The Kiss
description: We are in Cleveland, Ohio, in 1978 and four guys who make up the Mystery group dream of becoming Kiss's shoulder group and have four tickets for the legendary concert of their favorites in Detroit. But Jem's mother is very angry with them and burns their precious notes. The four boys do not lose heart and begin a merciless and tiring ticket hunt.
notes: Taking a cue from the glam rock of Kiss, the film actually stages a sweetened teenage comedy, with its themes and rites of passage, first of all the sentimental sexual one. Of the roaring 1970s, Rifkin's film reveals very little.

title: La vérité si je mens!
actors: Richard Bohringer, Amira Casar, Richard Anconina, Anthony Delon
description: Edouard Vuibert, a man without work and without a family, is "adopted" by a wealthy Jewish merchant who mistakenly mistook him for a "brother". The young man soon became the first right hand man, then the owner of the hut, also because he aims to marry the daughter of his naive pygmalion.
notes: Among the thousand annoyances of a film that burns an actor like Richard Bohringer in a quarter of an hour, there is also the brutal message on the presumed inevitability of money, which today makes so much globalization. The sweetened Italian "translation" of the original title is aimed at the sentimental audience. And to think that Gilou, in '95, won in Locarno with "Raï", a film on the banlieu in rap time.

title: House on Haunted Hill
actors: Geoffrey Rush, Famke Janssen, Taye Diggs, Peter Gallagher
description: A joker and cinephile billionaire, Steven Price, for the birthday of his cruel wife, invites a group of hapless people to spend the night in a former asylum haunted by the remains of dead people ... and perhaps resurrected. Whoever sees the sunrise will leave with a million dollars.
notes: The film is a remake of a William Castle classic ("The Haunted House"), produced by Robert Zemeckis and Joel Silver and directed by the young Willam Malone. Black humor, Terry Gilliam aesthetics and Howard Berger make-up to scream. The ending is ugly, but the rest is a blast.

title: Ano natsu ichiban shizukana umi
actors: Kurodo Maki, Sabu Kawahara, Hiroko Oshima
description: Shigeru is a garbage man. And one day he finds a thrown away and badly tanned surfboard. He decides to fix it and learn to ride the waves. His friends are a little surprised, his girlfriend worried. Also because Shigeru has a problem: he is deaf and dumb.
notes: Takeshi Kitano struggling with the recurring "image" of his films: the sea. Placid and impetuous, a symbol of harmony and violence. Which in the poetics (and aesthetics) of the Japanese filmmaker represent the intimate idea of ??beauty. Also a tender reflection on the theme of death, a few years before "Hana-bi". An extraordinary film;

title: I briganti di Zabut
actors: Vincenzo Albanese, Tonino Russo, Giuseppe Fiasconaro
description: A farmhand sent to confinement during fascism for defending a beggar, returns to his country after the armistice. He finds him in the throes of peasant revolts and soon ends up at the head of a gang sought by both the carabinieri and the mafia.
notes: Intense and dramatic film by an Italian independent who has a lot of talent. Based on a true story.

title: The Land Before Time VI: The Secret of Saurus Rock
description: The cute baby dinosaur Little Foot and his friends Cera, Spike, Petrie and Ducky are passionate about the legend of a lonely dinosaur that appears in times of difficulty, and after having lent his help disappears without a trace. Littlefoot and his companions, intrigued and fascinated by the magnanimous prehistoric animal, decide to follow in his footsteps. They will all live an incredible and unforgettable adventure together.
notes: Sixth episode of a cartoon series that has had great success in its television shows. The idea is not very original, but the rhythm and the sympathy of the characters make the film enjoyable.

title: The Darklings
actors: Martin Sheen, Suzanne Somers, Timothy Bushfield, Tippi Hedren
description: Near the home of C.J., a teenage baseball fan, is a house that has been put up for sale. The new owners respond to the name of Clayton Shepard and Emily. Bedridden by an annoying flu and driven by irrepressible curiosity, C.J. spies on the neighbor's movements. The boy seems to see the Shepards commit murder. He went to the local police station to report the fact and receives screen laughter. Thus C.J. deeply humiliated by this attitude of the police he decides to investigate on his own.

title: Tais toi quand tu parles
actors: Aldo Maccione, Edwige Fenech, Jacques François, Philippe Clair
description: Giacomo, a quiet and shy man, lives a double life only in his dreams. Imagine that you are James Bidon an unbeatable and charming secret agent who knows no rivals. But one day the dream becomes reality and the unsuspecting Giacomo finds himself involved in a dangerous mission. Thinking he is dreaming, Giacomo wakes up in Tunisia where everyone calls him James Borromeo.
notes: Funny French comedy with the Italian-French couple Maccione / Fenech.

title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
actors: Forest Whitaker, John Tormey, Victor Argo, Isaach De Bankolé, Henry Silva
description: Ghost Dog with his beloved pigeons lives in a hut on top of a building. His day is marked by the observance of the rules of honor of an ancient samurai code and by the fulfillment of his job as a paid killer in the service of the mobster Louie. His technique is simple Ghost Dog arrives, executes and then sends Louie a pigeon to inform him of the work done. For a series of misunderstandings it happens that a task is not respected and Ghost Dog becomes the target of a manhunt.
notes: Between "Rashomon" and "Frank Costello" by Melville, the film maintains a jazzy trend from start to finish, with high-class soloists. Excellent soundtrack.

title: Lancelot du Lac
actors: Luc Simon, Laura Duke Condominas, Humbert Balsam, Vladimir Antolek
description: After two years of searching for the Holy Grail, costing many victims, Lancelot of the Lake, the bravest of the Knights of the Round Table, and his companions returned defeated to the Court of King Arthur. Convinced that the failure of the enterprise is a divine punishment, for his relationship with Guinevere, wife of King Arthur, Lancelot tries to break that bond. Forced into forced idleness, the Knights indulge in rivalry and enmities. One of them Mordred hostile to Lancelot reveals to the king the secret of his former comrade in arms.
notes: Bresson's film is a severe metaphor about the unhappiness of the man who, because of his sins, ended up losing grace.

title: Agente 077 dall'Oriente con furore
actors: Ken Clark, Margaret Lee, Fabienne Dali, Vittorio Sanipoli
description: A scientist is the victim of an attack just when he was able to develop a beta-ray weapon capable of disintegrating matter. Some elements of the counterintelligence, convinced that it is a staging, instruct agent 077 to start an investigation. During the investigation, hindered in every way by an organization employed by a superpower, our agent, aided by a beautiful girl, manages to get his hands on an envelope containing the plans of the deadly weapon. The action moves to Istanbul where the two agents locate the hideout where the scientist is kept.
notes: Sequel to "Agent 077 Bloody Mary mission".

title: Agente 077 missione Bloody Mary
actors: Ken Clark, Helga Liné, Philippe Hersent, Mitsouko
description: Among the wreckage of a P 26 bomber, which crashed under mysterious circumstances, the remains of a crewman and the Bloody Mary, a latest generation nuclear warhead, are missing. The agent 077 is entrusted with the investigation for the discovery of the secret weapon and in Paris, according to the instructions received, he contacts Dr. Elsa. The woman works for the CIA in the clinic of Dr. Batz, a specialist in plastic surgery. The doctor turns out to be at the head of the fearsome gang of the "Black Lily" involved in the affair.
notes: Among the first and luckiest 007 filmed in Italy.

title: Blue Hawaii
actors: Elvis Presley, Joan Blackman, Nancy Walters, Angela Lansbury
description: Chad Gates, employed in a Honolulu tourist agency, takes a group of four girls to visit the island with their teacher Abigail. Among the four girls, the extravagant Ellie stands out in particular, who immediately approaches the handsome employee. Abigail is also no exception and Chad is forced to defend himself even from her assaults. In reality, the teacher aims to impress another boy who is a mutual friend of the two. Chad's new admirers put his girlfriend in crisis, who pouts him in protest.
notes: The film is an excuse to see the timeless Elvis at work surrounded by beautiful girls.

title: Family Album
actors: Jaclyn Smith, Michael Ontkean, Joe Flanigan, Kristin Minter
description: Ward, the son of an important shipowner, marries Faye, a young actress. The couple has four children: Greg, Valerie, Lionel and Annie. Ward, irresponsible and a lover of the good life, soon finds himself on the verge of bankruptcy. Faye, who gave up her career as a director for her family, starts going back to the sets and in a short time manages to direct a film. Ward chooses to produce his wife's films. At some point their marriage goes into crisis and the two decide to separate for a short time. Their relationship, however, instead of breaking down is strengthened more and more when bad luck hits the family.

title: School Ties
actors: Brendan Fraser, Matt Damon, Ben Affleck, Chris O'Donnell
description: America, 1950. David Green is an excellent football player, and precisely this quality facilitates his entry into one of the most prestigious schools in the country. A school of rich offspring of high society, but also an excellent institution to become "somebody". However, David comes from the working class and is Jewish: for fear of being rejected by his new friends, he hides the truth about his origins.
notes: Not a great movie. Clearly the reasons for interest are all in the cast: the first important role for Brendan Fraser. And his friends are Matt Damon and Ben Affleck.

title: Wo Die grünen Ameisen träumen
actors: Bruce Spence, Wandjuk Marika, Norman Kaye
description: A group of Aboriginal people from Australia risk their lives to defend a place considered sacred. A mining company is in search of uranium and is expected to disrupt the ground where locals have lived for years cultivating myths and traditions. The Aborigines try to oppose the bullies of Western civilization, but they are too weak to win. A geologist, at first skeptical of their behavior, will eventually change his mind and fight for their cause.
notes: Herzog, always in search of extreme events, flies to Australia and realizes this modern fable against the false myth of progress.

title: Fatalità
actors: Nino D'Angelo, Nina Soldano, Francesco Paolantoni, Veronica Bartoli
description: Nino Santoro is alone and poor. He left his family seven years earlier for an adventurer who deluded him and then abandoned him. Among the various hardships he had to undergo there was also an arrest and a "stay" in prison. Released from prison, he is helped by an actor who is struggling to find a part and then by an owner who offers to hire Nino and the actor as servants. Nino attending the house discovers that his benefactor is married to his ex-wife and that the little Antonella who lives with them is his daughter.
notes: In this Grassia film there are all the typical ingredients of Nino D'Angelo films.

title: The Producers
actors: Gene Wilder, Zero Mostel, Estelle Winwood, Christopher Hewett
description: Max's latest show was a total fiasco. Unluckily, Léon came to rummage through his accounts, a tax employee as shy and awkward as he wants but still determined to carry out his duty. Léon discovers that there is an easy way to defraud the taxman and that is to stage a play that is destined to fail. Grasping the idea of ??the employee, Max does not think twice and, after having tried, sets up a show. After a long search, the choice falls on "Hitler's Spring", one of the most horrendous scripts in the history of the show.
notes: Original satire of the entertainment world.

title: Romance
actors: Luca Barbareschi, Walter Chiari, Julia Hiebaum, Patrizia Fachini
description: Giulio, feeling death approaching, takes refuge in a mountain hut to reflect on his life, on his mistakes and on the family he no longer has. He calls his son Andrea to him, now a grown man whom he has not seen for several years. The man is not very happy with his father's call, but he reaches him anyway. The meeting between the two is embarrassing, but slowly the atmosphere begins to heat up. The two men open up and finally confide in everything they have been hiding for years.
notes: The trump card of Mazzucco's second work, all too minimalist and intimate, is an extraordinary Walter Chiari in his latest interpretation, all in undertone. Barbareschi is not at his level, but he gets along.

title: Conte de printemps
actors: Anne Teyssedre, Florence Darel, Hughes Quester, Eloise Bennett
description: Jeanne, a young philosophy teacher engaged to the mathematician Mathieu currently away for study reasons, after meeting Natacha at a party, sympathizes with her and moves to her house. The two girls become friends and share their problems. The former is worried about her relationship with Mathieu, while the pianist feels neglected by William, hates her mother and her father's lover. The hatred towards the latter stems from the fact that Natacha is convinced that he has stolen a family jewel.
notes: The first film in the cycle "Tales of the four seasons" that follows the "Moral tales" and "Comedies and proverbs", Rohmer is a particularly successful one, especially in the en plein air scenes and in the atmosphere of the countryside. Beautiful soundtrack of romantic songs.

title: Jawbreaker
actors: Rose McGowan, Rebecca Gayheart, Julie Benz, Judy Greer
description: Marcie, Courtney and Julie jokingly kidnap their high school friend Elizabeth. As a joke they lock her in a trunk and she really dies. Courtney convinces her friends not to reveal the incident and put the body back in the room by staging a fake rape that ended in murder. But Julie gets caught up in guilt complexes ...
notes: Stein continually winks at young viewers with a montage from video clips, sunburns, slow motion and accentuated pop colors, and shoots a song by Friggs, Shampoos or Donnas, to remind him that this stuff is made for them, and he owes them pleasure.

title: City of Hope
actors: Vincent Spano, Tony Lo Bianco, Stephen Mendillo, Joe Morton
description: Joe Riccardi is a powerful builder from Hudson City, a decadent metropolis of New Jersey. He is unscrupulous and tied to the corrupt administrators of the city. With them he is studying a big speculation project. His son Nick, oppressed by the cumbersome father figure, wants to rebel and takes refuge in alcohol and drugs, to escape the system. At the same time, a black city councilor, Wynn, tries to oppose the maneuvers of the politicians, but unleashes a wave of violence.
notes: One of the most ambitious projects made by the talented independent director: fifteen characters in a choral story that becomes a ruthless social denunciation.

title: Bats
actors: Lou Diamond Philips, Dina Meyer, Carlos Jacott
description: In Gallup, Texas, a doctor and her aide try to find out what happened to the bats in that area. They come at night, screaming, to strike and kill human beings. Harmless creatures are transformed into ruthless killers due to a demented genetic experiment and in a dramatic race against time their lair must be found.
notes: With "Bats" bats are once again the protagonists, but here we are on the side of splatter and (discreet) special effects, in a trend that recalls that of the genetic degeneration of animal species, which from the 1950s onwards has never ceased. to have a small but significant success.

title: Shanghai Noon
actors: Jackie Chan, Owen Wilson, Lucy Liu, Brandon Merrill, Roger Yuan
description: Pei Pei, a Chinese princess, was kidnapped, taken to the Wild West and hidden in a quarry. To free her, the kidnappers ask for a chest full of gold. Chon Wang joins the men in charge of bringing the princess home and the earthquake shakes villages and prairies.
notes: After twenty years of successes and whirlwinds, Chan shows the weight of the years and arthritis, still likeable and clownish, but less agile and snappy, he goes crazy and amazes with his strokes and with some jokes worthy of Sergio Leone's films . Good B series craftsmanship

title: Crime and Punishment in Suburbia
actors: Monica Keena, Ellen Barkin, Michael Ironside, James DeBello
description: The lonely young Vincent observes the life of the girl he has fallen in love with, the beautiful and helpful Rosanne, and tells us about all the squalor of her life: the failed and drunkard father, the mother who goes to pick up men in bars. But when the situation escalates, the stepfather rapes his daughter, and she convinces the good-boy-sports boyfriend to take him out, no doubts remain.
notes: The film is an imitation of "American Beauty" put up in a hurry, a trick written by an old craftsman (Larry Gross, author of screenplays for Walter Hill and Eastwood, as well as dozens of television scripts) that mimics the juvenile or presumed sensitivity.

title: Final Destination
actors: Devon Sawa, Ali Larter, Kerr Smith, Kristen Cloke, Daniel Roebuck
description: New York Airport. After having grasped more and more dire omens, the young Alex, leaving for Paris with the school, "sees" even the plane crash in which everyone will die. He hurries off the departing plane and saves himself together with the five people who, for various reasons, have remained on the ground with him. But this is nothing: because the survivors begin to die in increasingly twisted and brutal accidents.
notes: Moving in the vicinity of the "Sixth Sense", one of the directors of "The X Files" and "Millennium" has grafted the myth of Cassandra on the narrative logic of the slasher, for which the question is no longer: "Who is the killer?" but "How will the next one die?"

title: El coronel no tiene quien le escriba
actors: Marisa Paredes, Fernando Lujàn, Salma Hayek, Rafael Inclán
description: Every Friday, attached to the now worn dignity of his good suit, the colonel goes to wait for the letter that finally announces the arrival of a pension promised for many years and never paid. Everyone knows that he will never receive it, all the inhabitants of the village and his thin wife, who keeps wondering "What are we going to eat?".
notes: Based on the novel by Gabriel Garcia Marquez, Ripstein's film is as obstinate and laconic as its protagonist, a film made up of shades, crumbling interiors, the unmade face of Marisa Paredes and the sunny face of Salma Hayek.

title: Bride of Chucky
actors: Jennifer Tilly, Alexis Arquette, Nick Stabile
description: Tiffany, the ex-girlfriend of Charles Lee Ray who moved, thanks to black magic, into a Chucky (a doll), after ten years finds the remains of the doll and thanks to magic, brings it back to life. Tiffany hopes that Chucky wants to marry her, but the doll kills her and transfers her soul into a doll dressed as a bride. Despite the quarrels and betrayals, the two lovers have a common purpose: to find two bodies to welcome them and the amulet capable of carrying out reincarnation.
notes: Directed by Hong Kong director Ronny Yu for his first American film, the Chucky saga shows some cracks, despite an appreciable irony and a swooning Meg Tilly.

title: Alegría
actors: Rene Bazinet, Julie Cox, Frank Langella, Heathcote Williams
description: The melancholy mime Frac is in love with the singer and circus artist Juliet. It is a relationship thwarted by the girl's father, who is also the director of the circus where they work. The two lovers decide to escape and on the way they meet Momo, an eleven-year-old vagabond boy. But their life is in the circus, where in the end they can't help but return.
notes: Directed by Franco Dragone, animator of "Cirque du Soleil" since 1985, the film is inspired by "Alegria", the most famous show produced by the circus and written by Dragone himself. A mélo deeply inspired by the special circus universe of the "Cirque du Soleil", a circus that does not use animals.

title: 100 Girls
actors: Jonathan Tucker, Larisa Oleynik, Marissa Ribisi, Jaime Pressly
description: We are in the 21st century, and Cinderella no longer loses the proverbial slipper, but a banal panty, while Matthew, the charming prince has the features of a good studious boy, with skilful hands and protruding ears. The two find themselves in a college elevator during an electrical blackout. Time passes and the two have sex, but in the dark they can't see each other's face. When Matthew wakes up, he finds himself alone with the stranger's panties and a great desire to find her.
notes: The film is a somewhat obvious "teen comedy", with a slight sexy peckish and ultimately politically correct, which renews the myth of Cinderella, but perhaps its greatest merit is in showcasing a good number of rising young stars .

title: Maybe Baby
actors: Hugh Laurie, Joely Richardson, Rowan Atkinson, Emma Thompson
description: Sam and Lucy are happily married, smart, young, rich and beautiful; he evaluates scripts for the BBC, she works in a casting agency. The only problem, which grows to invade their entire life, is that they are unable to have children. Sam wants to start writing again but suspects that "writer's block is God's way of telling you you're not a writer." Then, the idea: to tell about one's marriage and sterility. His wife is indignant, but now the temptation is too strong, and Sam even takes a cue secretly from her diary.
notes: The subject is not new, but the whole initial part with the description of the couple and above all of the English TV is fun. Then everything gets complicated and the epilogue is false.

title: Return to Me
actors: David Duchovny, Minnie Driver, Bonnie Hunt, Carroll O'Connor, James Belushi, Robert Loggia, David Alan Grier, Joely Richardson, Eddie Jones, Marianne Muellerleile, William Bronder
description: The beloved wife of a Chicago architect, a zoo ethologist, dies in a car accident and her heart is transplanted to a young Italian American waitress who lives and works with her grandfather. After a year, guess who the architect falls in love with?
notes: Written and - let's say - directed by Bonnie Hunt who also carves out an important role, the film, after a promising start with a breathtaking plongé that discovers Duchovny on the roof of a building under construction, loses its orientation and turns into a useless bignami about feeling. The film has a juicy stop in Rome where you will discover that Italy is no longer the country of pizza, but that of the clothes hanging on the street.

title: Hammers Over the Anvil
actors: Charlotte Rampling, Russell Crowe, Alexander Outhred
description: Alan Marshall is a disabled young man who befriends East Driscoll a horse trainer. The boy witnesses the birth of the love story between his new friend and Grace McAllister, an English aristocrat. The situation inevitably becomes complicated when East decides to force his new partner to abandon her husband to run away with him.
notes: Unlikely rampling / Crowe love story, enriched by various pathetisms.

title: Beloved
actors: Oprah Winfrey, Danny Glover, Thandie Newton
description: Freed from slavery, Sethe believes she has found freedom and peace. But a ghost is around the house and haunts his family. Not even the old companion, who has returned after a long journey, can get the better of the entity. But it disappears when a girl, Beloved, who behaves like a child, breaks into the house. It actually hides a tragic secret.
notes: Based on the novel of the same name by Toni Morrison, recent Nobel Prize for literature, "Beloved" is a kind of "Medea" of African American culture. A beautiful and snubbed film at its release, told by Demme with a rare dramatic sense.

title: Defenders: The Payback
actors: E. G. Marshall, Beau Bridges, Martha Plimpton, John Larroquette
description: Bishop has just returned home to his wife and his son. He hears the bell ring, goes to open and is in front of a man who calls him by name. They pass a few seconds and is invested by a charge of shots. Once he completed his mission, Lane, the killer, sits and waits for the arrival of the police. The district prosecutor proposes the defense of man to the Preston law firm. When Don Preston shows up in prison, Lane explains to him the reason for that effective crime: four years earlier Bishop had barbarously raped his nine -year -old girl and had obtained the minimum of the sentence.

title: Verfolgt! - Mädchenjagd auf der Autobahn
actors: Liane Forestieri, Tim Bergmann, Mariella Ahrens, Daniel Fehlow
description: Anna has constant nightmares and her precarious psychological state affects her relationship as a couple. Left by the boy, she sets off to reach the paternal house where her elder sister's wedding will take place. Her nightmare will begin on the highway when the woman is chased by a maniac who wants to throw her off the road.

title: Mondo pazzo, gente matta
actors: Silvana Pampanini, Alberto Bonucci, Franca Polesello, Franco Latini
description: The film tells the story of five young jazz musicians who have invented a new dance. Soon the notes of this new dance spread and everyone was infected by the irresistible rhythm. They have a sudden and deserved success, but they are not taken seriously by the record industry.
notes: Little known film directed by Polselli known for having directed in 1960 "The lover of the vampire". Good cast; which he sees in the role of the prima donna Pampanini, diva of cinema and variety of the fifties.

title: Dillinger è morto
actors: Michel Piccoli, Anita Pallenberg, Gigi Lavagetto, Annie Girardot
description: On a hot summer evening, Glauco, an industrial designer in his forties, returns home from work and finds his wife in bed with a slight indisposition. An uninviting cold dinner awaits him in the dining room. With the help of a cookbook, the man decides to prepare a dish to his taste. While looking for the necessary ingredients from a cupboard, a package wrapped in old newspapers turns up. A rusty drum gun comes out of the casing. The man oils it, paints it red and loads it, then goes to the room where his wife is and ...
notes: Ferreri's Best Film delves into the horror and neurosis of everyday life.

title: Casablanca Express
actors: Jason Connery, Francesco Quinn, Donald Pleasence, Glenn Ford
description: In November 1942, the Allied command presented a difficult task in Algiers to ensure that the British Prime Minister Winston Churchill continued unscathed for Casablanca. While the premier is on his way to reach his destination, Agent Cooper discovers that a German officer is in the convoy where Churchill has taken his place. Luckily Cooper makes it to the train. He will try to save the prime minister's life by not knowing that ...
notes: The story told by the film directed by Sergio Martino is not new. Too bad because the cast, despite the age of some actors, is really good.

title: Shootfighter: Fight to the Death
actors: Bolo Yeung, Maryam D'Abo, William Zabka, Michael Bernardo
description: Two rival young martial arts masters engage in a no-holds-barred fight. They collide inside a construction that prevents them from escaping. There is no rule that governs the fight and the two rivals give each other a good reason.
notes: Violent film with some acceptable scenes.

title: L'appat
actors: Marie Gillain, Olivier Sitruk, Bruno Putzulu, Richard Berry
description: Nathalie works as a shop assistant in a boutique and often happens to go to places frequented by professionals. The girl is looking for relationships that propel her higher on her social ladder. Then one day Eric, her boyfriend, like her from a wealthy background, introduces her to her friend Bruno and decides to use her to rob the rich professionals she gets to know every day. A hallucinating and clumsy hunt for the intended victim begins. Helped by another girl, she lures Laurent, but at the last moment things go wrong.
notes: Tavernier manages to make a psychological analysis of a generation without values. Golden Bear at the 1995 Berlin Film Festival.

title: The Curve
actors: Matthew Lillard, Michael Vartan, Randall Batinkoff, Keri Russell
description: Tim and Chris are not doing well in school, they have such low grades that they are unlikely to be admitted to the next year. The two boys, however, are aware of a particular rule: if one of their classmates commits suicide, the Commission gives the class full marks to compensate for the psychological trauma. Tim and Chris come up with a plan that seems perfect to them: they "commit suicide" Rand the hooligan on duty after getting him drunk.
notes: After a quick start, the director loses all rhythm in a vain attempt to show himself more intelligent than his hideous characters. Which, for their part, are the most dull and fluffy one can imagine.

title: The Flintstones in Viva Rock Vegas
actors: Mark Addy, Stephen Baldwin, Kirsten Johnston, Jane Krakowski
description: Fred and his best friend Barney are elated because they just graduated from Bronto Crane Academy and landed a job at the Bedrock quarry. Wilma's father and mother have planned her future, including the wedding. The girl is expected to marry the super-reliable Chip Rockefeller. In order not to submit to the impositions of her parents, Wilma runs away from home. She still doesn't know that Fred is waiting for her on her way, just as her friend Betty still doesn't know that she will fall in love with Barney.
notes: Between cameos of old glories, such as Joan Collins, and the teasing of the Rolling Stones, this time the Flintstones are showing their breath and they do not even need the inclusion in the "cast" of the alien Gazu.

title: Jesus' Son
actors: Billy Crudup, Samantha Morton, Dennis Hopper, Holly Hunter, Denis Leary
description: Fuckhead is a 20-year-old who spends his days under the influence of drugs. To get it, he steals and does odd jobs. Fh, as everyone knows, nurtures a devouring and destructive passion for the beautiful Michelle. But redemption is there waiting for him behind the door. Everything happens imperceptibly thanks to the life lessons learned from a kneaded nurse and a semi-paralyzed woman.
notes: The film directed by New Zealand director Alison Mc Lean is a livid, light-hearted and out of tune portrait of a generation of false phenomena.

title: Goya
actors: Francisco Rabal, José Coronado, Eulalia Ramon
description: The old Francisco Goya, deaf and sick, tells his very young daughter episodes of his life, while he questions the meaning of his art and thinks about his only love, the Duchess of Alba.
notes: In a staging that is influenced by Jarman's biographical films, Goya's paintings are relived on the screen, from court portraits to the extreme masterpieces of the "Quinta del Deaf". The caption of the biopic is thus balanced by a genuine and visionary kitsch. Vittorio Storaro's work on the lights is central. Carlos Saura thus avoids the academicism of his latest works and rediscovers an original cinema naivety.

title: Vatel
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Uma Thurman, Tim Roth, Julian Sands
description: François Vatel is the loyal and devoted attentive and cook of the proud Prince of Condé. The nobleman needs to win the favor of Louis XIV and hopes to receive the command of a new military companion against Holland. Condé places himself and the welfare of his castle in the hands of Vatel by assigning him the difficult task of receiving the Court of Versailles at the castle of Chantilly. To ensure the success of the enterprise, Vatel has at his disposal an army of servants to amaze and satisfy the king.
notes: Dominated by the sanguine protagonist (the cook), it is a bloodless film; path of amorous and political passions, it is strangely cold. The alchemy between Depardieu and Thurman doesn't snap.

title: The Patriot
actors: Mel Gibson, Heath Ledger, Joely Richardson, Jason Isaacs, Chris Cooper, Tchéky Karyo, Lisa Brenner, René Auberjonois
description: South Carolina, 1776. Benjamin Martin, a veteran of the conflict between the French and the Indians, gave up war forever to devote himself to his family. Although he was once a shrewd and ferocious soldier, after marrying and having seven children, he buried his own violent past and is now a farmer. But there is another conflict on the horizon, this time with England. Benjamin, recently widowed, does not have the slightest desire to dive back into the fray. The son instead ...
notes: Emmerich has evidently seen and reviewed "The Last of the Mohicans" by Michael Mann (Gibson, among other things, he fights with a dagger and tomahawk like Magua) but he didn't understand anything. He did not understand that grandiloquence does not mean epic, indeed he proves the opposite.

title: Una storia italiana
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Raoul Bova, Sabrina Ferilli, Ennio Coltorti
description: The film tells the story of the Abbagnale brothers who, starting from the South and animated by a great willpower and a spirit of sacrifice, managed to become rowing Olympians and to collect victories after victories. XXXNERO The second part airs tomorrow at the same time.XXXNERO

title: The Ugly Dachshund
actors: Dean Jones, Suzanne Pleshette, Charles Ruggles, Charles Lane
description: Five dogs live in the home of Mark and Francis Carrison: a Dane and four dachshunds. While Francis takes care of the four dachshunds without any problem, he has no qualms about showing his intolerance towards the bulky Dane. The frequent accidents caused by the five animals are a source of constant squabbles between the two spouses. When Francis decides to present one of the dachshunds to a dog show, Mark also enters the Dane in the competition.
notes: Pleasant and easygoing comedy produced by Disney. Suitable for the little ones, but adults also have fun.

title: Safe House
actors: Patrick Stewart, Kimberly Williams, Hector Elizondo, Joy Kilpatrick
description: Mace Sowell, a former Intelligence Service agent, is in possession of secret information bound by an electronic code. If what Mace is aware of becomes public, it could crush the political career of a very popular candidate, running for the presidency of the United States. But one day, suddenly, Mace comes face to face with a terrible reality: he learns that he is suffering from the first symptoms of Alzheimer's syndrome. The former government spy thus begins to fight for life, trying to counter the debilitating effects of the terrible disease ...

title: The Ambulance
actors: Eric Roberts, James Earl Jones, Megan Gallagher, Red Buttons
description: Cartoonist Josh Baker one day meets a very special woman, Cheryl, on the street. But suddenly Cheryl collapses and is hospitalized in an ambulance. When Josh visits her at the hospital, however, the records show that she has never been hospitalized there.
