Josh decides to follow Cheryl's roommate who also mysteriously disappears after a ride on the same ambulance. What secret will be hidden behind the strange vehicle?
notes: Halfway between thriller and comedy, the film leaves the time it finds. Note however in the part of himself the Marvel publisher Stan Lee.

title: Capitan Fantasma
actors: Frank Latimore, Anna Maria Sandri, Paola Barbara, Tino Buazzelli
description: We are in 1808, during the war between France and Spain. Captain Miguel de Cubanil is expelled from the Artillery Academy for killing a man in a duel. Thanks to the help of a singer he is able to embark as a sailor on the Asuncion, a ship that transports the gold of the Spanish crown. During the journey the boat meets Anita Lopez. The daughter of the governor of Havana and her housekeeper Soledad are transferred on board. Miguel will try to foil a colossal scam.
notes: Modest adventure film directed by Primo Zeglio, modest craftsman of Italian cinema.

title: Gold Diggers: The Secret of Bear Mountain
actors: Christina Ricci, Anna Chlumsky, Polly Draper, Brian Kerwin
description: Beth is a girl from Los Angeles forced, after the death of her father, to move with her mother to the countryside. The young woman hates the countryside but then meets Jody and befriends her. Jody doesn't have much of a reputation in town, plus he has to deal with the shame of having an alcoholic mother. One day the two, adventurous spirits, decide to go and explore the quarries of Bear Mountain, to find out if the legend is true that in one of these there is a gold mine.
notes: Apology of friendship between teenagers, this film can please those who have not yet passed eighteen or those who have a weakness for Ricci>

title: Ed
actors: Matt LeBlanc, Jayne Brook, Jack Warden, Bill Cobbs, Doren Fein
description: Jack "Deuce" Cooper is a baseball player who fills the role of hitter. In the world he is well known for the great talent he can express when he takes the field. The sporting environment he frequents puts so much pressure on him that Jack is forced to play in a mid-ranking team. To his surprise, he discovers that his new companion is a chimpanzee nicknamed Ed Sullivan. Jack realizes that the new partner is not exactly a gentleman.
notes: Matt LeBlanc, star of the hit television series "Friends", is the star of this comedy.

title: Il sergente Klems
actors: Peter Strauss, Tina Aumont, Pier Paolo Capponi, Howard Ross
description: In 1918, at the end of the battle of Artois, a young German officer, who had escaped the carnage, exchanged his uniform with that of a Frenchman who died in the trenches. Taken prisoner and deemed a spy, he is sentenced to be shot. He was saved by a former legionnaire, a deserter, destined for the same fate. Taking the name of Otto Klems, the German is sent to Morocco in the Foreign Legion. Impatient with the abuses of an officer, he deserted and was captured by the rebels.
notes: One of the best films by Sergio Grieco, a craftsman with a very long and dark career, thanks also to the beautiful photography by Stelvio Massi. Good actors.

title: Sling Blade
actors: Billy Bob Thornton, Dwight Yoakam, J.T. Walsh, John Ritter
description: Karl Childers spent his adolescence and most of his adulthood in an asylum for killing her mother and mistress as a child. Released from the asylum, he finds himself dealing with the hostility of his fellow citizens. But friendship with a child, amused by his funny accent, restores serenity and confidence. However, when his young friend introduces him to his mother, the woman's abusive and alcoholic lover begins to persecute Karl with insults and provocations.
notes: The film is a curious work that seems to come from the American cinema of the seventies and that is liked for its irresistible productive and aesthetic inactivity.

title: Il romanzo della mia vita
actors: Luciano Tajoli, Antonella Lualdi, Giulietta Masina, Vittorio Sanipoli
description: Following polio contracted as a child, Luciano Tajoli remains physically handicapped. From an early age Luciano was noted for his beautiful voice. He is now a young man when he successfully participates in an amateur competition. His condition forbids him to attend the stage. He is forced to sing on the radio. Luciano achieves success and economic stability, but is not happy because of his condition. Then one day he meets Maria and love is born between the two.
notes: Prolific film that retraces, in part, the life story of the famous melodic singer played by himself.

title: The Two Faces of Dr. Jekyll
actors: Paul Massie, Dawn Addams, Christopher Lee, David Kossoff
description: After long studies and patient research, Dr. Jekyll succeeds in separating the two personalities that make up the human soul. Chosen himself as the test subject, Dr. Jekyll transforms into a handsome but amoral individual: Mr. Hyde. Under the new guise he discovers that his wife is cheating on him with another man. In an attempt to win back the woman, mr. Hyde will start a series of heinous murders.
notes: Not one of the best films directed by Terence Fisher. There is a brief appearance of Oliver Reed.

title: The Wedding Night
actors: Anna Sten, Gary Cooper, Miami Alvarez, Agnes Anderson, Violet Axzelle
description: A writer looking for inspiration retires to the country house he inherited. The wife who has decided to follow him regrets the life of the city and after some time decides to escape. Meanwhile, the writer, left alone, draws inspiration from a girl who has come to live near him. Spurred on by her he writes a new novel. The wife, alarmed by her husband's voluntary exile, returns to him and discovers that love is born between the two. But the father of the immigrant girl from Poland along with her family forces her to marry a compatriot.
notes: The film, directed by Vidor on commission but with great style, was to launch Sten as a diva. It wasn't like that.

title: Space Cowboys
actors: Clint Eastwood, Tommy Lee Jones, Donald Sutherland, James Garner
description: The birth of NASA in 1958 excludes four brilliant and reckless test pilots of the Dedalus team from the new space programs. But time is never lost. The failure of a Russian satellite, Ikon, and the need to put an expert team back together to put it back in the correct geostational orbit, find them grappling with the trifles of the present.
notes: Eastwood directs with a light and affectionate hand, plays sideways with the other three performers, svisions on a solid model of narrative composure. His is a cinema that does not need to metabolize video games or advertisements. The poignant "Fly Me to the Moon" is worth at least a hundred raps and a "mature movie" can have the same freshness as a "teen movie".

title: Rosa e Cornelia
actors: Stefania Rocca, Chiara Muti, Athina Cenci, Daria Nicolodi
description: In the Veneto of the 1700s, a rich and spoiled daughter of almost decayed nobles was unexpectedly pregnant. As a punishment, but above all to hide the "shame" from the beautiful society and above all from the future husband, the young woman is locked up in the country house, under the watchful eye of the nurse Piera, a stable boy and an unfortunate woman also in sweet waiting that, in exchange for money, at the end of the pregnancies will have to fulfill the inevitable.
notes: Interesting themes that in the hands of a film director could turn into "something left" and above all truly sinister. And instead we are the usual: television flatness, stereotypes, lack of ideas.

title: I cento passi
actors: Luigi Lo Cascio, Tony Sperandeo, Ninni Bruschetta, Claudio Gioè
description: In the seventies, anyone who founded a private radio and made fun of the strong powers risked a police raid in Milan or Rome. In Cinisi, Sicily, the stakes were different: it was death. Peppino Impastato plays his bet all the way: the son of a small-time Mafioso, he denies his father's system of values ??and refuses to walk "the hundred steps" that separate his house from that of Tano Badalamenti, the boss who can decide his destiny.
notes: Giordana recalls her story with all the love she always had for the rebels as a director. As already in "Pasolini" he tells an "Italian crime": that someone - there, public opinion; here, the police - they want to pass for suicide.

title: I giudici
actors: Chazz Palminteri, Andy Luotto, F. Murray Abraham, Anna Galiena
description: Two months after retirement, the chief prosecutor, a friend of Falcone, is murdered in a street in Palermo. The tragic episode forces Falcone to hire a bodyguard, Mario. Despite leading a risky life, the judge falls in love with a magistrate of the Court of Appeal, Francesca Morvillo, whom he meets at a dinner with Borsellino and his wife. The fight of the two judges against the mafia octopus will be interrupted by two violent attacks in which they will lose their lives.
notes: We knew that Tognazzi has an agile and quick hand. What is certain is that the result looks more like a cheat sheet, a synthesis that looks like the trailer of a miniseries.

title: Following
actors: Jeremy Theobald, Alex Haw, John Nolan, Lucy Russell
description: Twenty-five-year-old aspiring writer, actually unemployed, finds a new source of inspiration by stalking people and trying to get into their lives. He chooses the wrong subject, a thief, who sets him up and transforms him into a robber and murderer. The disturbing action of a dark lady is fundamental ...
notes: Almost experimental English Noir, in black and white, at first close in aesthetics to Von Trier's Dogma. There are formally interesting things and Christopher Nolan, born in 1970, confirms that he is an ace in the use of the handycam (he is also an operator). Unfortunately, those who hang out with the genre with a certain frequency do not get caught off guard and guess everything after fifteen minutes.

title: Volavérunt
actors: Aitana Sánchez-Gijón, Penélope Cruz, Jorge Perugorría, Stefania Sandrelli
description: Francisco Goya is looking for a model to paint what will be the famous Maya desnuda. The painter takes advantage of the complacency of two ladies: Pepita Tudò, the minister's lover, who is in turn the Queen's lover and the Queen's rival, the Duchess D'Alba, in a very dangerous depressive crisis due to the passage of time. The face of one and the "taboo" parts of the other.
notes: Bigas Luna goes to the Tinto Brass area, with less aesthetic sense but with greater modesty. The passage, in the initial part, is from an antediluvian script. Then, thanks to the investigation into the death of the Duchess, something stands out, the Rashomon Syndrome.

title: Dorme
actors: Federico Calisti, Cristiano Callegaro, Alessio Muzi, Anna Bastoni
description: A boy is abandoned by the girl because he is too short and does not resign himself to loneliness. He looks for her, calls her, challenges the kicks and punches of a suburban hooligan with a bandana, suffering from a ridiculous split of personality, takes a pill and ends up in a dream where two atrocious figurines await him and put him in front of a television screen mirror. .
notes: Eros Puglielli enjoys a reputation as a talented courier, not very provincial, with a fantastic streak of some importance. "Dorme", a feature film shot seven years ago and set in the Roman suburbs, raises some legitimate doubts about these microcults of young directors, thriving in the rubble of Italian cinema.

title: The Five Senses
actors: Gabrielle Rose, Philippe Volter, Pascale Bussières, Mary-Louise Parker
description: The disappearance of a three-year-old girl in a Toronto park involves five characters in existential crisis who live in the same condominium. Each of them is confronted with one of the five senses: smell for a cleaning man, taste for her best friend, hearing for an ophthalmologist, touch for a masseuse.
notes: Jeremy Podeswa, in his second film, translates into a reticular and well-orchestrated narrative by focusing the consequences of apparently random acts in the world of human relations, in an almost spiritual dimension, which calls into play Kieslowsky's “chance”.

title: Blue Streak
actors: Martin Lawrence, Luke Wilson, David Chapelle, Peter Greene
description: Miles Logan, professional thief hides a diamond in a construction site before being "burned" by the greedy buddy. After two years, when he is released from prison, he finds that the house under construction has become the police headquarters. All he has to do is pretend to be a policeman to break into the building and retrieve the loot. But his purpose is continually postponed, because Miles reluctantly solves one case after another.
notes: The film is exactly what it looks like from the poster: an out-of-time imitation of "Beverly Hill Cop", just as Martin Lawrence is a dull impersonator of Eddie Murphy. A more childish than annoying film.

title: Up at The Villa
actors: Kristin Scott Thomas, Sean Penn, Anne Bancroft, James Fox
description: In Florence, at the end of the Thirties, a community of Anglo-Americans experienced the arrival of the war amid parties and gossip. Among them is Mary Panton, a beautiful widow whom her husband left in poverty, a guest of the princess of San Ferdinando. The woman is joined by her mature suitor, but the encounter with an American playboy and a night of love with an Austrian refugee change her plans.
notes: Inspired by a Somerset Maugham novel, Haas is seduced by literature and a text that often sheds skin. Comedy, mélo, and thriller chase each other in a "Decameron" community waiting for the plague, but Haas, perhaps intimidated by Ivorian and Zeffirellian precedents, gives a watered-down vision of Florence and those years.

title: Scream 3
actors: Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox, Parker Posey, David Arquette
description: Hollywood. After the first ritual murder, so as not to lose the habit we find ourselves on the set of the film in the movie "Stab 3", which should tell the real events (?) That happened in the first "Scream". Except that the usual crazy killer, following the suggestions of the script, kills the actors one by one, even if his aim is once again to get to Sidney.
notes: Without Kevin Williamson (who wrote the first two films), Craven has a free hand and insists much less on references to the classics; moreover, he "frees" Sidney, himself and the spectator from the monster in a finally original way.

title: Fire Down Below
actors: Steven Seagal, Marg Helgenberger, Stephen Lang, Brad Hunt
description: Incredible amounts of toxic substances are buried in the hilly areas of Kentucky. Responsible for this havoc is the unscrupulous opportunist Orin Hammer. The shady individual is the head of a real criminal organization. Environmentalist Jack Taggart declares war on him. Hammer and his gang are also suspected of murder. They were in fact responsible for the murder of a former colleague of Jack. If no one tries to stop them, the entire natural heritage of the American state will be completely destroyed.
notes: Steven Seagal as the environmentalist is really ridiculous.

title: The Hunted
actors: Harry Hamlin, Mädchen Amick, Hannes Jaenicke
description: British Columbia, Canada: A small light plane is flying over a dense forest. Suddenly he begins to lose altitude, the crash is terrible. The aircraft was insured for a large sum and the company, suspicious of the mystery surrounding the accident, does not want to pay until the case is brought to light. In charge of carrying out the investigations is an experienced detective, released from the police to serve the highest bidder. Arriving at the crash site, however, he has a bitter surprise: there are no bodies among the wreckage. Those on board managed to escape somehow ...

title: Stealth Fighter
actors: Ice T, Costas Mandylor, Erika Eleniak, Ernie Hudson
description: Owen Turner, a US Army pilot, fakes his own death and goes into business with an arms dealer from South America who has managed to get his hands on a nuclear-powered submarine. Arriving in the Philippines, he steals a fighter from a naval base with which he intends to destroy various military posts located around the globe. Ryan Mitchell, a former colleague of Turner's, knows him well enough to predict his next moves and is recruited to thwart his plans ...
notes: The filmography of Tracy Marrow known as Ice-T, now more actor than rapper, is literally stuffed with "action" like this, shot in photocopy.

title: Pecker
actors: Edward Furlong, Christina Ricci, Lili Taylor, Patricia Hearst, Martha Plimpton, Bess Armstrong, Mark Joy, Mary Kay Place, Brendan Sexton III, Mink Stole
description: Pecker is a not particularly smart 18-year-old who works in a Baltimore sandwich shop and who delights in taking pictures of his lovable but unique family and friends. One day his photos are "discovered" by a clever New York art dealer, Rorey Wheeler. The woman's efforts to make Pecker an exceptional artistic event threaten to ruin her lifestyle. Day after day the teenager begins to feel the weight of the celebrity.
notes: "Pecker" is in the line of John Waters' last normal films: common sense, perhaps a little rough, against presumptions and snobbery (of class and culture), a good-natured mockery of the tricks and poses of certain categories.

title: Fortress 2: Re-Entry
actors: Christopher Lambert, Pam Grier, Aidan Rea, David Roberson
description: Ten years have passed: the director of Men-Tel, Teller, is on the trail of Brennick and his family who have found refuge in the countryside. Captured once again, John Brennick is locked up in a new escape-proof prison called Skycell from which escape is difficult, almost impossible.
notes: This very modest sequel starts from the same assumptions as the first but succeeds in the very difficult task of disregarding them one by one. The most chilling thing is the direction of Geoff Murphy, who also directed a fair fanta-movie like "The Silent Land". For the "Fortezza 2", however, he seems to have been inspired by the series "Supercar".

title: Ratcatcher
actors: William Eadie, Tommy Flanagan, Mandy Matthews, Michelle Stewart
description: James is a child who involuntarily causes the death of a peer. The tragic event marks even more his painful childhood for him who has an alcoholic father and who can only allow him a life of suffering. The taciturn James plays with rats among the garbage bags and shows little interest in his peers. The only person who manages to give James some serenity is Ellen, a little girl who shares a delicate intimacy with him.
notes: Strong and visceral themes such as the coexistence of men and mice, the adult-child relationship and the cruelty of childhood, clash with the analytical coldness, if not the detachment, demonstrated by Ramsay, who however has the cruelty of the real director.

title: 28 Days
actors: Sandra Bullock, Viggo Mortensen, Dominic West, Steve Buscemi
description: Gwen, a journalist with high hopes, has a sad childhood behind her. The girl goes into crisis after ruining her sister's wedding ceremony and destroying a garden house while driving a limousine drunk. The 28 days of forced hospitalization reshape her life and help her drive away her beloved boyfriend Jasper, who is ready to tempt her with his spells and drugs.
notes: In the real world, things are different: but this is a film, indeed a comedy, and therefore everything is allowed. Too bad that, even as a comedy, things are not going so much better, with a monotonous and not very credible Bullock.

title: Una vita non violenta
actors: Adriana Asti, Yari Gagliucci, Ninetto Davoli
description: Gianluca, a loser by vocation already from football fans ("Neapolitan by birth, Romanist by adoption"), dreams of becoming a forest ranger. Instead, he finds himself dealing with the harsh reality of an eviction that leaves him and his mother in the middle of a street. Only thanks to the help of a fisherman, who lives by making do more or less honestly, they find refuge in a shack along the coast of Ostia.
notes: David Emmer, son of art, gives us through the sight of Gianluca the Portuguese, the portrait of a country that has lost values ??and anger and which lives on dreams and expedients. A small film full of poetry and utopia, in which we find with pleasure Ninetto Davoli and a talented Adriana Asti.

title: Three to Tango
actors: Matthew Perry, Oliver Platt, Neve Campbell, Dylan McDermott, Cylk Cozart, John McGinley, Bob Balaban, Deborah Rush, Kelly Rowan, Rick Gomez, Patrick Van Horn, David Ramsey, Kent Staines, Ho Chow, Michael Proudfoot
description: Amy is a young sculptor who loves a hateful billionaire who wants to turn an old Chicago building into his foundation. Oscar and Peter, friends and architects, compete for the contract but the competition is fierce. Things get complicated when the billionaire, jealous of his mistress, believing Oscar to be gay, asks him to supervise her. A strong sympathy arises between the two and Oscar is tormented between the need to obtain the contract and love for Amy.
notes: Echoes of a cinema of the first magnitude, such as Wilder's, are perceived here and there in a story that excites more than a laugh, shot with an appreciable rhythm.

title: Life
actors: Eddie Murphy, Martin Lawrence, Obba Babatundé, Nick Cassavetes
description: Ray and Claude hate each other but are forced to travel together from New York to Mississippi to load contraband whiskey, but a carrion white sheriff frames them in a murder and they are sentenced to life in prison. It is 1932 and in the 8th wing of the State Penitentiary, there is room only for blacks and Ray and Claude sit there, after 65 years, between continuous bickering and reconciliation while many things happen in the world, the two, aged, yes finally take a well-deserved revenge.
notes: "Life" slowly gains altitude but when it finds its rhythm, the vicissitudes and the fading of the characters are pleasantly followed over time, forced to fly with the imagination so as not to die inside.

title: Günese Yolculuk
actors: Newroz Baz, Nazmi Quirix, Mizgin Kapazan, Nigar Aktar
description: The young Mehmet who emigrated to Istanbul experiences the racism against the Kurds first-hand, because his facial features are reminiscent of those of a Kurd. His desire for honest work and sweet love is frustrated by overwhelming racial hatred and the images of blood-red Xs painted on Kurdish doors and military checkpoints take Mehmet into a nightmare.
notes: If one were to judge the film by its writing, the judgment would be invalidated, but the film has a power of image and content that alone makes us forget the obvious lack of script.

title: A carta/La lettre
actors: Chiara Mastroianni, Pedro Abrunhosa, Leonor Silveira, Antoine Chappey
description: Mademoiselle de Chartres, now wife of Cléves, confides to her sister friend: "We can control our feelings, not avoid them." For her, only the flight to Africa, in a war zone, as she tells in a letter, is the certainty of being safe from her one and only true love.
notes: The novel "The Princess of Cléves" written with a light hand by Madame de La Fayette in 1678 is reinterpreted, in a magnificent way by Manoel de Oliveira, one of the few active authors whose talent is not blurred by age. The Portuguese director moves this story to the present day, but deletes many contemporary references.

title: Mystery Men
actors: Claire Forlani, Ben Stiller, Janeane Garofalo, Lena Olin
description: Lo Spalatore, Furioso and Blue Raja are three losers who want to overdo it in Champion City. Unfortunately for them, the sponsored and efficient Captain Amazing is already in town, but the absence of evildoers threatens to drop his popularity and end the sponsorship of Pepsi, so Amazing decides to free Casanova Frankenstein, an ancient rival. . The fool Amazing soon finds himself his prisoner and here comes the Mystery Man.
notes: Kinka Usher, the acclaimed commercial director, has put up a fairground sideshow with a prominent cast, who mimics Batman.

title: Little Voice
actors: Michael Caine, Brenda Blethyn, Ewan McGregor, Jane Horrocks
description: Laura, called "Little Voice", is a shy teenager bordering on autism. He lives in a proletarian neighborhood of Scarborough with a boozy and maddened mother. To dialogue with his father's ghost, he listens to old records by Judy Garland, Marilyn or Shirley Bassey, and reinterprets them to perfection. The occasional companion of her mother, a fourth-rate manager, notices this, who will go so far as to commit everything to organize a show for her in grand style.
notes: The director abounds in haphazardly carts and dollies; the actors would be perfect if they weren't forced into specks: Jane Horrocks really mimics the great singing stars of the past and the supporting actors all do their best.

title: Mansfield Park
actors: Embeth Davidtz, Jonny Lee Miller, Frances O'Connor
description: At the age of ten, Fanny Price was sent to live with relatives in Northamptonshire, leaving her poor family in Portsmouth. Although she grew up in Mansfield Park, with the privileged Bertram family, Fanny has always felt indebted to her aunt, Lady Bertram and her uncle, Sir Thomas. Her aunt Norris always treated her like a servant and her vain cousins, Maria and Julia, never missed the opportunity to remind her of her humble origins. The only one who proves to be friends with her is Edmund, the youngest son of the Bertrams.
notes: Unfortunately, Austen and cinema remain entities that are little and badly reconciled, and the film, with its aesthetic hypertrophy, confirms all doubts.

title: Dick
actors: Kirsten Dunst, Michelle Williams, Dan Hedaya, Jim Breuer
description: These are the colorful and vulgar days of 1973 and two enterprising and cheeky fifteen-year-olds, Betsy and Arlene, on a school trip within the white walls of power, are hired as secret advisors and dog sitter for the President's dog. The "Hello Dolly" are homemade cookies, with illegal additives, and everyone loves them: Nixon, Kissinger, Leonid Brezhnev himself.
notes: The Watergate scandal is reinvented with wit and a healthy demented streak by a film, adored by American critics, that doses news, costume, parody and pop delirium. The adults all look like fools.

title: One Tough Cop
actors: Chris Penn, Stephen Baldwin, Gina Gershon, Mike McGlone
description: Bo Dietl is a cop who goes into more trouble because his best friend sits (or rather, sat) almost to the right of John Gotti. And it's not good for a cop to hang out with certain characters.
notes: Thanks to a very frayed screenplay by Jeremy Iacone, the Brazilian Bruno Barreto demonstrates with a certain ostentation that he does not understand anything of the police force: he misses the timing of the mother scenes, he slips into the most trite stereotypes, he does not realize that he has a bomb like Gina on his hands Gershon and, what is much more serious, makes sure that the spectators do not notice. Disastrous all the performers, including the otherwise great Chris Penn.

title: Here on Earth
actors: Chris Klein, Leelee Sobieski, Josh Hartnett, Michael Rooker
description: Hicksville, New York: The rich young Kelley, who attends a prestigious college in the area, competes with Jasper, a local boy. After a car duel, the two destroy the family restaurant of Samantha, Jasper's girlfriend, and are doomed to rebuild it. The coexistence between the two is explosive and becomes even more so when Samantha, convicting a poem by Robert Frost, falls in love with Kelley ...
notes: Directed by a TV professional, the film plays out all the clichés of romantic comedy with a dramatic background, but never finds a real moment of inspiration.

title: Pushing Tin
actors: John Cusack, Billy Bob Thornton, Angelina Jolie, Jake Weber
description: Long Island's "Tracon" air traffic control center handles 7,000 flights arriving at three New York airports every day. Being a flight controller is a grueling job and one small mistake endangers hundreds of lives. The best is Nick Falzone, handsome, Italian-American and with a beautiful family consisting of a devoted wife and two children. The arrival of a rival, taciturn with Indian blood, puts his perfect world in crisis.
notes: Inspired by an article published in the "New York Times", Newell's film offers some moments of strong dramatic density in the confrontation between the two protagonists, too bad that little by little in those turbulence of lives and flights, it loses its path.

title: Le nain rouge
actors: Jean Yves Thual, Dyna Gauzy, Anita Ekberg, Carlo Colombaioni
description: Lucien L'Otte is a dwarf in Trentino. He is an employee in charge of drawing up the letters of insults in cases of divorce of a law firm. Not being able to dream of the marriage, he dedicates himself with vindictive ardor to destroy that of others. But one day, in a very hot afternoon, encouraged by the voluptuous lyric singer Paola Bendoni, she will dare those long -suffocated gestures of love.
notes: We are in "Freaks area", complete with a "epochal" sequence (we do not reveal it for the weakest of stomach) and Leopardian cosmic pessimism. A "beautiful" and soul film.

title: Poodle Springs
actors: James Caan, Dina Meyer, Tob Bower, David Keith, Joe Don Baker
description: Laura is a lawyer, a wealthy heiress and is also deeply in love with Marlowe. Their approaches are interrupted by a phone call from another private investigator, Paul Krauss, who is in trouble and needs help. Two shots are heard in the middle of the call, Marlowe calls the police and reaches the crime scene. Krauss is found dead and police arrest Marlowe as a suspect.
notes: Flamboyant HBO (American cable TV) production directed by a veteran. The ingredients are there, the recipe is expertly assembled by screenwriter Tom Stoppard, who adapted a story by the noir writer completed after his death by colleague Robert Parker. The film is embellished with the restrained acting of old Caan. The television matrix is ??intuitive, but it is not serious. In the end what matters is the romance of the detective.

title: Bossa Nova
actors: Amy Irving, Pedro Cardoso, Drica Moraes, Alexandre Borges
description: The stories of some characters intertwine around Miss Simpson, widow and English teacher in Rio de Janeiro. There is the girl who met an artist via the Internet pretending to be the Ipanema girl; the successful lawyer, the son of an old tailor with a passion for French songs and married to the owner of a travel agency; the brother of the lawyer, in love with the freaked-out solicitor; the female-wasting footballer leaving for London.
notes: Although the film is constantly looking for sophisticated comedy atmospheres of yesteryear, it has an air of tropical white telephones.

title: Gros Câlin
actors: Jean Carmet, Francis Perrin, Alvaro Vitali, Nino Manfredi
description: Elder Cousin, employed in a multinational company, is a man without a wife or friends, because he is absolutely unable to communicate and, apparently, for others it is as if he does not exist. He is accompanied by a python which he has collected in the garbage, which he has brought home and which he has named Cocco mio. One day Cousin finds the woman of his life, a prostitute who conceives her work as a social service. The employee convinces her to go and live with him, but the presence of the snake frightens the woman. Cohabitation becomes difficult ...
notes: Negligible film with Alvaro Vitali and Nino Manfredi.

title: Malìa (vergine e di nome Maria)
actors: Turi Ferro, Andréa Ferréol, Marino Masé, Clelia Matania
description: In a slum neighborhood on the outskirts of Turin, 14-year-old Maria, orphan of a bricklayer who died on the job, finds herself pregnant without having had sex. Soon the rumor spread that it was the Holy Spirit who impregnated the girl. Don Vito refuses to believe in the miracle and discourages the expectation of a new redeemer.
notes: Not really a "conventual" sub-film. Nasca was in fact attempting the sociological-Pasolinian key in this proletarian version of the Immaculate Conception. The film is very dated, but at the time it caused a sensation. The young lust, Cinzia De Carolis, then turned to porn.

title: La vena d'oro
actors: Terence Hill, Bianca Maria Ferrari, Marta Toren, Richard Basehart
description: Maria lives with her sixteen year old son Corrado in a villa near Rome. Widowed at a young age, she dedicated her entire life to her son and leads a retired life. One day Corrado meets the engineer Manfredi, an archelogue who is following excavations in the vicinity of the villa. The two make friends and Corrado takes the opportunity to invite him to his house. Love is born between Maria and the archaeologist. This new feeling ends up making the widow's son jealous, who runs away from home on New Year's Eve.
notes: Bolognini is inspired by the comedy of the same name by Guglielmo Zorzi for a tear-jerking film directed with a certain sobriety

title: Les biches
actors: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Jacqueline Sassard, Stéphane Audran
description: Following a chance meeting, a morbid friendship arises between the young Why, who earns a living by painting fawns on the sidewalks of Paris, and Frederique, a rich and bored shipyard owner. Her guest in a splendid villa in Saint Tropez, Why meets Paul, an architect with whom she falls in love. Frederique, jealous of her friend's new conquest, manages to become Paul's lover. Why, however, takes it in the best way by serenely accepting to love both of them.
notes: Chabrol's direction is, as usual, precise and punctual. But the film doesn't affect that much.

title: Domicile conjugal
actors: Jean-Pierre Léaud, Claude Jade, Silvana Blasi, Hiroko Berghauer
description: Antoine and Christine Doinel are expecting the birth of their first child. Their life passes quietly between a violin lesson (she receives students at home) and a sprinkle of fake flower paint (he takes care of coloring the plastic flowers). Then one day Antoine succumbs to Kyoko's exotic charm.
notes: Fourth chapter of the Doinel saga that began with the eternal "The four hundred blows". A sparkling first part and a second in a minor key. But the underlying bitterness and tenderness are magical nonetheless.

title: Muppets from Space
actors: Jeffrey Tambor, F. Murray Abraham, Ray Liotta, Andie MacDowell
description: Gonzo's identity crisis is resolved when some signs convince him that he belongs to an alien lineage. Kidnapped by government spies, Gonzo will be contacted by extraterrestrials and it will be up to the other Muppets to lead him to the close encounter.
notes: After the first overwhelming ten minutes with waking up at the Muppet house, the film flows pleasantly and without surprises. Cameo by Ray Liotta and Andie MacDowell, dance music as it is right in a film aimed perhaps at nostalgics rather than at children.

title: Christina's House
actors: Brad Rowe, Brendan Fehr, Allison Lange, John Savage
description: Terrible things happen to 17-year-old Cristina. Three girls disappear near his house where he lives with a pain in the ass little brother, only good at playing with the playstation and a father with a maniacal face who seems to suffer like crazy in front of the first flirtations of the teenager. The mother has been hospitalized for years in an asylum and strange things begin to happen in the house: noises are heard and objects disappear.
notes: In this Canadian horror film there is very little and there is not even the pleasure of discovering the culprit, who from the very beginning of the film tries desperately to attract the attention of the viewer.

title: Alex l'ariete
actors: Alberto Tomba, Michelle Hunziker, Ramona Badescu, Orso Maria Guerrini
description: Alessandro is a carabiniere who belongs to the GIS and who must be available round the clock. His specialty during raids is to break down doors like a ram and that's why he earned the nickname Alex the ram. In the course of an action, his colleague Roberto is injured due to Alex's excessive impetuosity. So the carabiniere is transferred to a remote village. But it so happens that Alex is entrusted with a new mission ...
notes: The film is ugly, bungled, written by real illiterates or fake illiterates, played by poorly organized unemployed.

title: 200 Cigarettes
actors: Ben Affleck, David Chapelle, Martha Plimpton, Catherine Kellner, Christina Ricci
description: New Years Eve 1981 in the East Village of New York. The party is organized by Monica and her friend of the moment Hillary. Convinced that organizing a party where no one shows up is a real tragedy, Monica is desperate because no one rings her door. Hillary on the verge of leaving the party is convinced to stay and snatches a promise from Monica: to have top priority over her ex-boyfriend, Eric. But he won't be able to use the opportunity because he shows up with Bridget.
notes: The soundtrack, dialogue and costumes try to grab the confused spirit of the time. He produces MTV and directs, with little verve and imagination, the debutante Risa Bramon Garcia.

title: Under Suspicion
actors: Monica Bellucci, Gene Hackman, Morgan Freeman, Thomas Jane
description: A manhunt is underway in the port of San Juan in Puerto Rico. Victor Benezet, a senior police captain is trying to get his hands on a depraved killer who raped and killed two little girls. The distinguished and wealthy Henry Hearst, a leading exponent of the island, is invited by Victor to the police station to give some clarifications on the discovery of one of the two victims. A close duel begins between the two.
notes: The curse and pessimism that seemed to hang over "Guardato a vista", of which this film is the useless remake, have disappeared, canceled by a plot that ends up seeming banal.

title: Sono positivo
actors: Giovanni Esposito, Paolo Sassanelli, Cristina Liberati, Manrico Gammarota
description: A southern family discovers that all of its members are HIV positive. But who started the infection? The suspicions end up uncovering an intertwining of infidelity and confused sexual identities between the hypochondriac husband who owns a health care shop, the frustrated wife, the wife's gay brother and the freeloading family friend. Paradoxically, the disease will become an opportunity for everyone to rediscover and accept their own nature.
notes: The director, author of shorts, producer of good TV programs has always shown talent. In this second feature, his previous experiences do not assist him.

title: Mi sei entrata nel cuore come un colpo di coltello
actors: Gaia De Laurentiis, Gianni Ippoliti, Frédéric Deban, Luisa De Santis
description: Virginia, is a young contrabass player who, after five years of a tormented relationship with Fioravante, a well-known television journalist, is unable to end a relationship that is now winding down. After several attempts, the musician realizes that it is easier for her to be left than to leave and so she changes her strategy. She confesses to Fioravante that she has another man. To give credibility to her lie, Virgina is forced to hire an unemployed actor.
notes: A banal and uninspired little film that recycles two well-known faces from the small screen. Directs (?) Cecilia Calvi honest director of television drama.

title: Beefcake
actors: Daniel MacIvor, Josh Peace, Carroll Godsman
description: They called it, jokingly, the Metro Goldwyn Mizer: for the record and for the story it was instead the Amg, the Athletic Model Guide, a factory of models that, in the 1950s, posed in "naive" nudes in the garden of Bob Mizer, photographer homosexual who lived between a "protective" mother and a studio of youngsters who, from the provinces, landed in the neighborhood of Hollywood in search of cinematic fortune.
notes: Thom Fitzgerald's film has the merit of returning the memory of that period with an amused, ironic style, halfway between fiction and period document, which leaves nothing to the imagination and much to the skin.

title: Where the Money Is
actors: Paul Newman, Linda Fiorentino, Dermot Mulroney, Susan Barnes
description: Carol is fed up and bored with work, she is a nursing home in a nursing home and married to Wayne for marriage. The last time she really enjoyed herself was several years earlier, when she was elected prom queen. The story of Henry, an elderly crime artist who has snuck into the hospice where she works arouses her curiosity. The old thug will teach the two all the tricks of the trade and so the unlikely trio arranges a heist.
notes: The advertising director Kanievska doesn't put much of his own into it, but he has the virtue of letting the two leading actors loose, the real raison d'etre of this outdated film, very seventies.

title: Romeo Must Die
actors: Jet Li, Delroy Lindo, Aaliyah, Russell Wong, Isaiah Washington
description: Two traditionally enemy families, one of Asians and one of Italian Americans, compete in a no-holds-barred war for control of the Port of Oakland. But when Po, the son of the Asian warlord, is killed, the confrontation becomes far more dangerous than anyone could have imagined. Po's older brother Han, a former cop, sets out in search of the truth.
notes: If you forget certain chilling scenes (x-rays of breaking bones) and let yourself be carried away by the Jet Li phenomenon, the 115 minutes of the show go by in a flash. Certainly a more prudent use of the Chinese star would not hurt US action cinema.

title: Mumford
actors: Loren Dean, Hope Davis, Jason Lee, Alfre Woodard, Pruitt Taylor Vince
description: Dr. Mumford has a great gift, knowing how to listen to others. Having arrived in the city only four months ago, he has already become the best-known psychologist in the area. He listens to his patients' problems, gets involved in their lives and helps them in the most unusual ways. But he, who knows everyone's secrets, keeps the biggest secret.
notes: Kasdan enjoys making fun of psychoanalysis, but he does so with respect and modesty, loving - as is his habit - his "interlocutors". Actors in a magical light, under the direction of a director-screenwriter who writes dialogues like few others.

title: Simply Irresistible
actors: Sarah Michelle Gellar, Sean Patrick Flanery, Patricia Clarkson
description: Amanda Shelton, an attractive woman who is not afraid to live out her emotions, is the owner of a delicious restaurant that she inherited from her mother. Tom is the important manager of a large department store. Love?
notes: Fable with a pink candy background with some esoteric-gastronomic implications.

title: Circus
actors: John Hannah, Famke Janssen, Peter Stormare, Fred Ward, Eddie Izzard
description: Leo is a gambler living in London. He has a charming wife, but there is a boss who wants to cheat him, a loan shark who wants to kill him and an American killer who is on his trail. But it does not end here because there is also a two-quintal black man who dreams of medieval torture for him, an accountant perhaps complicit, perhaps hostile. In short, Leo is very popular ...
notes: The new wave of the British gangster movie is a phenomenon to be pleased with, but Rob Walker's film reveals its pimp face. The more the intrigue gets complicated, the more predictable it becomes, moreover with a heavily involved staging.

title: Where the Heart Is
actors: Ashley Judd, Natalie Portman, Stockard Channing, Sally Field
description: Navalle Nation is about to give birth. She is in the car with her man, one of those who are waiting to escape at the first opportunity. Which, punctually, is presented to him when the young woman stops in a service area to pee. Days pass, Navalee raises her beautiful baby with the help of an elderly couple, a nurse who becomes almost an older sister, a neighbor who falls in love with her.
notes: One of those scripts that actresses like so much, but viewers a little less. You risk falling asleep right from the start. And the cameos of Sally Field, Joan Cusack and Stockard Channing are not enough.

title: Titanic, mille e una storia
description: Southampton, 10th April 1912: the Titanic is ready to sail when a Daimler comes trumpeting at full speed. Corynthia gets out, announcing her entry into first class with her two clumsy grandchildren Kirk and Dirk. She is known to be a great scammer kept under close surveillance by the police. But on the ship there is also Angelica, the illegitimate daughter of a wealthy London businessman and his housekeeper: a handsome prince falls in love with her ...
notes: The result of the film is technically acceptable, even if the backdrops are sometimes a bit static: but originality is certainly not the trump card of the film.

title: Takhté siah
actors: Saïd Mohamadi, Bahman Ghobadi, Behnaz Jafari
description: A group of school teachers are climbing up the trails. Each one carries his blackboard on their shoulders. They are unemployed and go in search of pupils in some remote village. The sound of a helicopter. Everyone tries to hide, they scatter. Two masters remain: one meets smuggler boys, bent by their loads; the other joins the old Kurds, laden with years, who are trying to return to the bombed village.
notes: Rugged landscape, cruel stories, carved faces, lost countries and languages. A noble film with strong (and captivating?) Images, crushed like its characters by too many metaphors.

title: Center Stage
actors: Amanda Schull, Zoë Saldana, Peter Gallagher, Susan May Pratt
description: American Ballett School, New York. Young people in search of glory meet, solidarity, compete in view of the "first" from which the future stars of dance will emerge. There are the rebellious black, the very good heartless, the clumsy who gets strength. The aspiring etoiles have to deal with the two choreographers, one good and the other cruel, even from a sentimental point of view.
notes: The plot is still an excuse to show high-level numbers and choreography, filmed without errors and without ideas by Nicholas Hytner. The problem is that classical ballet is absolutely anticinematographic and is filmed here like tennis matches.

title: The Virgin Suicides
actors: Danny DeVito, James Woods, Kirsten Dunst, Kathleen Turner, Josh Hartnett
description: The five sisters Lisbon, Cecilia, Lux, Bonnie, Mary and Teresa have transformed into sublime creatures on the verge of becoming beautiful women. Fascinated by these beautiful nymphs, the neighborhood boys spy on them in an attempt to penetrate their hearts. When the youngest daughter Cecilia kills herself, the attraction in the boys intensifies, turning into perverse curiosity.
notes: A story (which really happened) raw and bitter, with a tragic ending (which we do not reveal), which the newcomer Sofia Coppola embeds in a "dreamlike dimension" precisely to bring out the harsh contradictions and dramatic consequences. The best of the girls is Kirsten Dunst: her look is one of those that pierce.

title: Qui non è il Paradiso
actors: Fabrizio Gifuni, Erika Bernardi, Antonio Catania, Ugo Conti
description: A perfect shot. An armored van of the Post Office is emptied without anyone noticing, without weapons, or shootings. An investigation begins and a suspect is immediately identified. This is Renato, the driver of the van. He is not at home but he has left an alarm clock stabbed by a knife on the wall which means goodbye routine. The hunt is on and Inspector Lucidi sets out on the trail of Renato's best friend, who has also mysteriously disappeared.
notes: The third feature by the Turin-based Tavrelli is uncertain whether to push in the direction of genre film or to stay within the boundaries of authorial cinema.

title: O fantasma
actors: Ricardo Meneses, Beatriz Torcato, André Barbosa, Eurico Vieira
description: Sergio has built a tailor-made world. Tormented by an insatiable desire, he plays to win. Indifferent to everything, he spends his days between renting a room in a low-cost guesthouse, having sex with other men and picking up trash in northern Lisbon. When night falls he wears a black latex jumpsuit and a rubber mask and goes around the city looking for no one knows what in an unhealthy, fantastic and surreal universe.
notes: Strange not very nice film "The ghost": its diversity is, for once, really such, explicit in the images and, in the contents, incommunicable like a ghost.

title: A Perfect Stranger
actors: Robert Urich, Darren McGavin, Susan Sullivan, Marion Ross, Holly Marie Combs, Stacy Haiduk, Ron Gabriel, Tamara Gorski, George R. Robertson
description: Raphaella is the young wife of the billionaire John Henry Philips. Despite the age difference, the two form a very close -knit couple. Unfortunately, during the party of their fifth marriage anniversary, John has a bad heart attack that will force him to live in a wheelchair. Raphaella takes care of her husband with a lot of love, giving up her private life. One day, however, he meets Alex, son of the writer Charlotte Brandon, divorced and father of Amanda, rebellious teenager. The woman tries to fight against her feelings, rejecting Alex's court, but love is born between the two ...

title: Schneesturm im Frühling
actors: Fiona Schwartz, Patrick Winczewski, Julius Plass, Claudine Wilde
description: Fresh from an unhappy love story, Caroline Cliburn travels to London, after accepting Hugh Rashley's marriage proposal. What are the reasons why Caroline decided to marry Hugh? Is it simply gratitude to her boyfriend who supported her at a very difficult time in her life? Or because the man is able to ensure her a safe and peaceful married life? The only thing Caroline is certain of is that only by marrying Hugh will she be able to leave her painful past behind before it's too late. Caroline, however, decides to go first to Scotland with her brother Jody, to find Angus, another brother who hasn't given any news from her for some time. Caroline does not imagine, however, that this trip will completely upset her projects and her planned programs with absolute precision ...
notes: Sentimental film produced in Germany and based on one of the many books written by Rosamunde Pilcher for the use and consumption of soft-hearted readers.

title: The Apostle
actors: Robert Duvall, Farrah Fawcett, Miranda Richardson, Todd Allen
description: All of a sudden, the life of Sonny, a precider who lives in Texas with his family, changes abruptly. The man discovers that his wife is cheating on him with the younger pastor Horace and that she has succeeded in trying to wrest control of the Church from him. In a fit of jealousy Sonny smashes Horace's head with a baseball bat, runs away, changes identity and name, calls himself the apostle and begins preaching in Louisiana.
notes: A robust story of individual overexcitation and collective hypnosis as Aldrich could tell it in the sixties, lost in a taste of gothic and American country typical of the following decade.

title: Gossip
actors: James Marsden, Lena Headey, Kate Hudson, Norman Reedus, Joshua Jackson
description: On an American campus, slowly, something unbearable is spreading. Three students choose the link between news and gossip as the topic of a seminar. However, the situation gets out of hand and what began as a game turns into a dangerous situation. Someone absolutely needs to get everything back to normal, but it won't be an easy task.
notes: More than a film, a "pilot" of a hypothetical series a la "Dawson Creek", where the faces and bodies of James Marsden and Joshua Jackson try to fill the pneumatic void of a story that interests just the X generations totally sheltered from ideas , ideologies, facts and misdeeds of humanity.

title: Splendor
actors: Kathleen Robertson, Johnathon Schaech, Matt Keeslar, Dan Gatto
description: Abel is a music critic and has a passion for writing, while Zed is the drummer of a punk band. The two have only one thing that unites them: the love for the aspiring actress Veronica. For her part, the girl loves both of them equally. After quarrels, abandonments and reconciliations, the three, challenging all the rules of social life, set up a house together. But after six months of trying to correct the two's flaws, Veronica realizes it's time to grow up and leave the complex threesome.
notes: Araki proves to have a certain sensitivity to the verbal and psychological jargon of its protagonists. Shot in twenty-eight days in 1998, this last chapter of the thousand lights of L.A., is orchestrated by the confessions (look into the room to question the spectators) of Veronica, in love with Abel and Zed.

title: B. Monkey
actors: Asia Argento, Jared Harris, Rupert Everett, Jonathan Rhys Meyers
description: Alan has a double life. During the day he is an elementary school teacher, while at night he plays disc jokey in a hospital. Beatrice, known to everyone by the nickname of B. Monkey, has just arrived in London from Italy and is robbing jewelers. The two spend the night together and the next morning decide to leave for Paris. Upon their return, Beatrice finds the house she shares with Paul, a friend of hers, upside down. Responsible for the raid is Frank, the boss the girl works for.
notes: After "Il postino", the Englishman Michael Radford thought it best to change register to show that he knew how to do something else. Unfortunately the result is this film that doesn't have the courage to go through with it.

title: La CapaGira
actors: Dino Abbrescia, Paolo Sassanelli, Mimmo Mancini, Teodosio Barresi
description: A gang of little thugs who roam the alleys of old Bari are looking for a precious package sent from the Balkans. Their base of operations is the home of the recreation club which has secret entrances and rigged video poker. What does the mysterious package contain?
notes: Piva's film is made with parsimony of means but it is definitely interesting both as a testimony of the social fabric and as a language. A story that takes its cue from everyday life, shot with a happy hand and recited in dialect (subtitles essential). A small miracle of the box office that has grossed over 250 million in Bari.

title: Medley
actors: Ulisse Lendaro, Ario Allegranzi, Sandro Bedin, Gaia Cardiollo
description: A mime enters the scene and dusts off a camera which subsequently enters a school building. An inspector sent by the ministry, walking through the corridors, collects bullets from the ground. Then, one after the other, the doors of the classrooms open and we see a student shooting the teacher and a professor who, while assigning a task, is killed in an attempt to take a briefcase.
notes: The film is little more than an amateur video, good for entertaining writers and various attendees in their next class reunions. In a riot of bloodshed, authors and schoolchildren quote and recite fragments of horror cinema, but reduced to empty simulacra.

title: Salaam cinema
actors: Shaghayeh Djodat, Feizola Gashghai, Maryam Keyhan, Mohsen Makhmalbaf
description: A world-famous Iranian director wants to make a film that worthily celebrates the centenary of cinema. This is why the auditions of the aspiring actors begin. But at the audition they show up in the thousands, creating endless problems. Each aspirant has a different idea of ??the Seventh Art.
notes: From one of the masters of Iranian cinema, Mohsen Makhmalbaf, an intense and original film, shot once again with a "theoretical" mix of documentary and fiction.

title: La vita è una sola
directors: Eugenio Cappuccio, Massimo Gaudioso, Fabio Nunziata
actors: Eugenio Cappuccio, Massimo Gaudioso, Fabio Nunziata
description: The trio of filmmakers Eugenio, Massimo and Fabio succeeds in making a low-cost film, entitled _Il masatore _...
notes: The thin and unoriginal story of the three directors in search of films is a false post-Moretto movement. Life as a unique and fraudulent event deserves magazines full of film and ideas.

title: Rosetta
actors: Emilie Dequenne, Fabrizio Rongione, Anne Yernaux, Olivier Gourmet
description: The young Rosetta is fired and her reaction to this decision is useless. The girl has nothing left but to go back to the campsite on the outskirts where she lives with her mother, a weak and alcoholic woman. To raise some money, Rosetta sells clothes until she finds another job. When the mother runs away, her daughter takes refuge from Rigaud who works with her. The next day at the Rosetta bakery he loses his job.
notes: The camera and the direction of the Dardenne brothers follow Rosetta (the amazing Emilie Duquenne), hunt her down, catch her breath, count her steps, explore her grit, anger and controlled despair. A social film, a political film, a religious, Bressonian film. Palme d'Or in Cannes in 1999.

title: The Skulls
actors: Joshua Jackson, Paul Walker, Hill Harper, Leslie Bibb, Steve Harris
description: In the exclusive New Haven college, young Luke McNamara, orphaned of a single mother, works hard to support himself in law studies, in an exclusive environment and with the scions of America's best families. When he gets the call of the "Skulls", America's most exclusive secret society that has had three presidents among its adepts, Luke sees power and wealth at his fingertips.
notes: If the first part of the film is convincing, the second is predictable and altogether banal.

title: A Cool, Dry Place
actors: Vince Vaughn, Monica Potter, Joey Lauren Adams, Devon Sawa
description: Abandoned without an explanation by his wife, Russ has had to leave a lucrative job in a Chicago studio to look after Calvin, his lively and dangerously on the move son. The condition of mammo after all suits the young lawyer, who in his spare time is also the basketball coach: but the meeting with the sister of one of his players and the unexpected return of his wife cause a great confusion in his life .. .
notes: Directed by a certain John N. Smith, the film does not completely convince from the point of view of the script: the story of the relationship between the two ex-spouses, in fact, has several holes.

title: Clay Pigeons
actors: Joaquin Phoenix, Vince Vaughn, David Dobkin, Georgina Cates
description: In Mercer, Montana, 1536 souls live. A bar with billiards, flowing beer, Sundays spent shooting at empty bottles, a cinema that shows "The ruthless" and beautiful young women available. One of them, Amanda, gets her lover, Clay, a mechanic in one of the gas stations of the town, handsome, fragile and influential, into trouble. The blood begins to flow when Amanda's husband kills himself to send Clay to prison.
notes: The thriller, made in 1998, looks uncomplicated to the B series, is pleasant, with a good cast and well directed by newcomer David Dobkin, lovingly assisted by producers Ridley Scott and Tony Scott.

title: The North Star
actors: Dana Andrews, Anne Baxter, Walter Huston, Erich Von Stroheim
description: In June 1941, Nazi troops invade the Soviet Union. A medical colonel from the Wermacht orders the children of a Ukrainian village to donate blood. Meanwhile the village is set on fire.
notes: One of the solid and honest war films Milestone specialized in after "Nothing New in the West." The film had three Academy Award nominations for screenplay, music and photography.

title: The World Is Not Enough
actors: Pierce Brosnan, Sophie Marceau, Robert Carlyle, Judi Dench
description: James Bond 007 recovers the money paid by an English billionaire for the ransom of his daughter Electra. The girl, orphaned after the violent death of her father, still seems threatened by her tormentor, an anarchist terrorist called Renard (in French "fox"). In fact, she is at the center of an international intrigue destined to subvert the world economic order.
notes: Third adventure with Pierce Brosnan as Bond, a bit messed up in the script (the story and situations are confused). There is no shortage of suspenseful moments and the action scenes are as usual thrilling. But the 007 formula begins to repeat itself.

title: Fuori di me
actors: Paolo Sassanelli, Lorenzo Viaconzi, Marit Nissen, Lilian Sassanelli
description: Gianni, Paolo and Lorenzo are in Bari to present their film "Nella mele". The three are in a neighborhood forgotten by all, the Cep, where there is only one cinema and where projecting a film is a real event. The three take little to become stars. And even the director just has to accept the game and take advantage of people's desire to dream.
notes: It seems like a film made of nothing, but it is as dense as an evening with accomplices friends. A more conciliated Moretti, an even more jovial and likeable De Sica.

title: Tutto l'amore che c'è
actors: Margherita Buy, Francesco Cannito, Gérard Depardieu, Sergio Rubini
description: Mid-seventies in a small town in Puglia. Carlo, sixteen, would like to grow up quickly and has chosen his older friends as teachers of life. He plays in a band and loves a schoolmate from whom he eagerly waits for a yes. But everything changes with the arrival of three girls from the north, Tea, Gaia and Lea, daughters of an engineer from Monza sent to Puglia to take care of one of the many cathedrals in the southern desert. The girls seem, for Carlo, to belong to a another world.
notes: Small and graceful chapter of a young coming-of-age novel: inevitable similarities and assonances with the narrative constants of a cinematographic genre that is struggling to renew itself.

title: Tra(sgre)dire
actors: Yuliya Mayarchuk, Jarno Berardi, Francesca Nunzi, Vittorio Attene
description: The Venetian Carla, twenty years old, enters a real estate agency in London. The girl is looking for an apartment to rent for Matteo who is about to reach her in the English capital. Moira, owner of the agency, affected by Carla's adventure, invites her to her home. Carla says nothing to Matteo that he took from doubts and the worm of jealousy renounces to reach London. For Scalas, the young woman accepts the court of Mario, ex -husband of Moira during a very particular party.
notes: Terrified of ending up in the hard network, the director who from luster wastes his talent behind beautiful but already seen sends, has only the courage to "interact", in a sequence cloned by his other ten films, with his fat fingers .

title: Road Trip
actors: Breckin Meyer, Seann William Scott, Amy Smart, Paulo Costanzo
description: Josh and Tiffany love each other. He betrays her and films the memory of that night; the videotape is sent to Tiffany by mistake. Josh therefore embarks on a crazy drive from Ithaca, N.Y. in Austin, Texas to get hold of the tape before his beloved arrives. Three friends accompany him.
notes: We immediately lose interest in the developments of the story, we do not laugh and, although the authors wink at the Farrelly brothers, we regret "Porky's". The characters would like to be nice scoundrels, instead they are just annoying: being cynical is an art. The actors have faces so anonymous that we wouldn't recognize them even if we met them.

title: Me Myself I
actors: Rachel Griffiths, David Roberts, Sandy Winton, Yael Stone
description: Pamela is an established journalist, but she misses a man next to her and thinks of that distant love that she left without knowing why. And suddenly she finds herself in the role of the other, with an absent husband and three rude children.
notes: After "Sliding Doors", another comedy that with its parallel existences enters the world of new physics. Fun and clever comedy that fits like a glove to delightful Rachel Griffiths.

title: Sud Side Stori
actors: Forstine Ehobor, Bobo Rondelli, Amaka Jinder, Kemi Toyin
description: Toni Giulietto is a shabby singer of street parties and Romea a Nigerian prostitute who practices her profession on the seafront of Palermo. Destiny makes Romea go to live in a low building under Juliet's balcony. It is love and war immediately between Toni's terrible aunts who do not want to leave their nephew in the clutches of Romea and her friends.
notes: The narrator of Roberta Torre's second film tries to put together a puzzle that is less surprising than the debut film and that appears more disrupted and less happy.

title: Le diner de cons
actors: Jacques Villeret, Thierry Lhermitte, Francis Huster, Catherine Frot
description: Every Wednesday a group of serious professionals belonging to the upper middle class of Paris must show up for a dinner with a person who can be described as a perfect idiot. Publisher Pierre Brochant believes he identified the victim as François, an accountant at the finance ministry. But on the day of dinner Pierre gets stuck. From the moment François sets foot in the Brochant house, all sorts of things happen.
notes: It lasts ninety minutes and takes place almost completely in the apartment of one of the protagonists. Not that the footage and the action scene are necessarily unnatural ingredients for success, but it is certainly curious how one can counteract Hollywood's overwhelming power with a simple idea. The film won six Césars (the Oscars of transalpine cinema) and attracted ten million admissions.

title: Tierra del fuego
actors: Ornella Muti, Jorge Perugorría, Claudio Santamaria, Tamara Acosta
description: Julius who claims to be a Romanian engineer arrives in Patagonia and claims to be there to take possession of Tierra del Fuego in the name of Carmen Sylba, Queen of Romania. We are in 1860 and a few years ago the gold rush began in the region. Julius is accompanied by the Italian adventurer Spiro, by the mercenary Schaeffer, by the Austrian sergeant Novak and by Silveira. To keep them company there is Armenia, a beautiful prostitute and Elisa. Popper would like to establish freedom but the natives defend themselves.
notes: There are combinations that, already on paper, are almost inevitably doomed to failure. This is the case of this film in which Luis Sepùlveda and Tonino Guerra collaborated with the director Littin. Poetry galore and author trombonate.

title: Holy Smoke
actors: Kate Winslet, Harvey Keitel, Pam Grier, Julie Hamilton, Tim Robertson
description: Ruth got "lost" in India, fascinated by spirituality, by culture, by a guru, by a vague and tenacious idea of ??the absolute, by the possibility of attaining enlightenment. PJ is commissioned by Ruth's family to psychologically "bring her back" to the West, to her alleged habits and affections. PJ is an expert in detoxification and reprogramming of people caught in the web of cults. Ruth's is the one hundred and ninetyth case of her career, the most difficult.
notes: Sex, passion, loss of self, fury from which no one is saved pulsate in this generous and dissipated film, intense and messed up, well shot, well acted and confused.

title: La lingua del Santo
actors: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Antonio Albanese, Isabella Ferrari
description: Willy, called Alain Delon, looks at the lagoon, the only place where his mind becomes clearer. He, a former representative of luxury stationery, separated from Patrizia, the only woman in his life with whom he lived for 23 years and three months, has slipped to the bottom and can no longer go up. He shares his destiny as a forty-year-old in retreat with Antonio, a rugby player, now only good at shooting set pieces. Together they hang out in a seedy bar and form a clean, clumsy pair of thieves. When, by chance, they find a relic of Saint Anthony in their hands, their life seems destined to change thanks to a billionaire ransom.
notes: The usual unknown, so inadequate for the rhetoric of the prosperous Northeast, wander the countryside on foot or by bicycle, among villas and late hippies, eat mushrooms, eggs and poisoned salami. Bentivoglio and Albanese are perfect in the role of the two tender and melancholy vagabonds in the Venetian nights. A beautiful and bitter comedy about hunger, failure, landscape, flying witches, friendship and saints. Meanwhile, things change and inside everyone remains the same as themselves.

title: The Adventures of Elmo in Grouchland
actors: Mandy Patinkin, Vanessa Williams, Sonia Manzano, Roscoe Orman
description: Elmo and his friends find themselves in Brontolandia, a fantastic place which is accessed through a magical passage, to recover the soft blanket from which he never separates and which has been stolen from him. Elmo's naive sweetness also conquers the world unlike Grumpyland, where filth and stench reign supreme and order is maintained by the perfidious thief Huxley.
notes: A subtly moral film that does not have the presumption of being unnecessarily moralistic, in which animated puppets and real-life actors naturally coexist.

title: Children of the Corn V: Fields of Terror
actors: David Carradine, Fred Williamson, Alexis Arquette, Ahmet Zappa
description: Six college kids take a wrong turn and end up in a place called Divinity Falls. The atmosphere is very disturbing, and when they are about to leave the children discover that the children of the village are controlled by an evil force.
notes: Do you remember "Blood Red Wheat"? Well, this is the fifth installment of the series, shot for TV. Every now and then he jumps in his chair and the special effects are not despicable; after all, the director comes from the makeup department.

title: Most Wanted
actors: Keenen Ivory Wayans, Jon Voight, Paul Sorvino, Robert Culp
description: War hero Sergeant James Dunn is sentenced to electric chair for killing his superior. While awaiting execution, the emissary of the secret military organization "Black Sheep" offers him freedom in exchange for a favor: the murder of an industrialist at the center of an illegal biological weapons trade. It seems an acceptable exchange and instead the sergeant finds himself at the center of an intrigue that sees him accused of the murder of the First Lady.
notes: Not even the appreciable action and physicality of Keenen Ivory Wayans, this time grappling with a dramatic role, can hide the fragility of a weak and confused script.

title: Deuce Bigalow: Male Gigolo
actors: Rob Schneider, William Forsythe, Eddie Griffin, Arija Bareikis
description: Deuce, a midget in torn T-shirts, over-baggy Bermuda shorts and pool sandals, is fired from the Los Angeles Aquarium. Chance brings him to the home of a famous and sought-after paid love professional, Antoine, a collector of medieval weapons, owner of a very expensive aquarium full of prized fish. When the lionfish gets sick and Antoine has to leave, the clumsy Deuce has to heal the sick, but it causes a fire. To pay back Antoine Deuce is forced to become a gigolo.
notes: None of the many narrative tracks are adequately developed: a series of small jokes played by willing, but modest character actors.

title: Election
actors: Matthew Broderick, Reese Witherspoon, Chris Klein, Jessica Campbell, Phil Reeves, Molly Hagan, Delaney Driscoll, Mark Harelik, Colleen Camp, Frankie Ingrassia
description: Under the eyes and sometimes with the complicity, perhaps unwittingly, of the school's most popular teacher, adolescent students bring out sides of character that would be the envy of the most seasoned politicians. And the school becomes a paradoxical microcosm of the monstrosities and injustices that run beneath the smooth surface of American society. All while the elections for the presidency of the student committee of a provincial school are taking place.
notes: A very bad comedy, this one directed by Alexander Payne American independent one of the most promising, where desperation leads to a deformed laughter.

title: Dr. T & the Women
actors: Richard Gere, Laura Dern, Helen Hunt, Farrah Fawcett, Shelley Long
description: Women who flee into some rare psychological disorder, women who love other women, women who play golf and fly to New Orleans, women who are guardian angels and hope, women who drink and hide behind bulky and exaggerated masquerade dresses, women fighting to give a highway a woman's name. Between them, light, reassuring, convinced of their uniqueness, a gynecologist moves, Dr. Travis.
notes: Robert Altmann, with the help of a script by Anne Rapp, is enchanted by an aspect of Southern femininity. As in "Cookie's Fortune", dominated by Glenn Close's intrigues and obsessions, the director, with an enviable lightness of style, observes with complicity and without contempt or misogyny this female parade within a very precise geographical and sociological frame . It's the Dallas of shopping, the rich and unrefined glamor. It is the city of Kennedy's crime and the serial that has shaped the television drama of the last twenty years. As always in Altman's cinema, the set is a fertile chaos and the text is a network of games and scattered materials. Mrs Miller and all the other women of the Altmanian universe smile in solidarity with these strange and colorful sisters.

title: Mission: Impossible 2
actors: Tom Cruise, Thandie Newton, Ving Rhames, Anthony Hopkins, Dougray Scott, Richard Roxburgh, John Polson, Brendan Gleeson, Rade Serbedzija, William Mapother, Dominic Purcell
description: Agent Ethan Hunt is ready to take the field a second time. With computer genius Luther Stickell at his side and a charming thief at heart, his mission is to stop the spread of a deadly computer virus that threatens to bring the world to its knees.
notes: The film builds on the presence of Tom Cruise; it's not John Woo's masterpiece (inferior to his Hong Kong films and Face / Off), but a John Woo commissioned film, super spectacular action a bit routine. The author seems to enjoy himself above all in the first part, the most romantic part of the meeting in Seville, in which he unleashes his taste for mélo and in the long, dark underground sequence, animated by the sudden flights of doves, of the progressive approach of the two enemies.

title: Gone in 60 Seconds
actors: Nicolas Cage, Angelina Jolie, Giovanni Ribisi, Delroy Lindo, Robert Duvall, Scott Caan, Vinnie Jones, James Duval, Christopher Eccleston, Timothy Olyphant
description: Randall "Memphis" Raines has long since retired as a car thief, but after a disturbing visit from an old friend, he realizes there is not much left for him to do but get back on the road. He has to steal a car to save the life of his brother who has done something wrong. In 40 hours he and his team, including Sara "Sway" Wayland, must steal 50 luxury cars.
notes: Title and story are taken from "Rollercar, 60 seconds and go!", Directed in 1974 by H. B. Halicki, director / stunt who died in 1989 while shooting the sequel to his film. Unlike Halicki, Sena does not take risks and sets up a story that, despite the title, is just a sprawling gymnastic up and down the streets of California.

title: Zora la vampira
actors: Toni Bertorelli, Micaela Ramazzotti, Ivo Garrani, Carlo Verdone
description: Dracula is tired of always drinking the same blood and fascinated by the sequins of Italian television that he receives thanks to a parable placed on the tower of his castle in Transylvania, he lands in our country. Once in Rome they realize that the life of the Rumnenian refugees is very hard. Dracula and his servant find themselves living in a flea house on the outskirts of Rome where the only place open at night is a social center. This is where the count meets Zora ...
notes: The family-run company of the Manetti Bros., with a syncopated and talented eclecticism, mixes materials, sounds and atmospheres of popular culture and modulates a bloody comedy between metropolitan musical and social center horror.

title: The Big Kahuna
actors: Danny DeVito, Kevin Spacey, Peter Facinelli, Paul Dawson
description: Three men and a hotel room in Wichita, for an important convention where "the great Kahuna" should arrive, the chicken to be plucked and with which to end your career in style. The three are traveling salesmen, "Americans" of the white middle class tormented by frustration. There is the cynical Larry who would sell his mother just to land the "big shot"; Phil, the old man who has seen and heard everything, divorced and depressed; and Bob the Younger, clinging to religious faith so as not to sink before his time.
notes: A good script, probably valid on the theatrical scene (where, in fact, it comes from), but on the big screen it gets lost and annoys.

title: La virgen de los sicarios
actors: German Jaramillo, Anderson Ballesteros, Manuel Busquets, Juan David Restrepo
description: After an absence of thirty years, the writer Fernando Vallejo returns to Medellin, the city that has seen him grow. There is not much left of what he had left: his relatives are all dead, a part of the city has been demolished, the Medellin cartel sows terror. In a gay dating house he meets and becomes friends with Alexis, a sixteen-year-old boy who works as a hitman for drug traffickers in a country where human life is worth nothing.
notes: A true writer or a great director could come up with a masterpiece, a big movie of denunciation and success. Which, unfortunately, does not happen. And it remains at the level of pornography.

title: Battlefield Earth
actors: John Travolta, Forest Whitaker, Kim Coates, Barry Pepper
description: In the year 3000 there are no cities or towns on Earth and man is an endangered species. A millennium earlier, the evil Psychlos aliens swooped down from space on our planet and wiped out our entire defense system in nine minutes. Now a handful of humans are enslaved and forced to mine for minerals to survive. One of the most powerful characters in the new Earth is Teri, a Psychlo in charge of the security forces. What he doesn't know is that there is a human who wants to undermine his plan.
notes: The layout, sets, editing, weaving, effects and visual stimuli are as sparkling as a science fiction anthology from Reader's Digest.

title: Sweet and Lowdown
actors: Anthony La Paglia, Sean Penn, Samantha Morton, Gretchen Mol
description: 1930s. Emmet Ray, a low-profile jazz guitarist, travels the length and breadth of the United States with the belief that he is second only to Django Reinhardt. In his life, a mute washerwoman appears who falls in love with him, but there is also room for a writer who is won over by his brusque personality.
notes: Woody Allen - who likes to intersperse his work by intervening in person, full screen - is also a musician, as well as a lover of jazz. His is an affectionate and pungent homage to forgotten artists. "Sweet" like the poignant "Sweet Sue, Just You"; and "ignoble", cynical ("It's my day off: I want one that talks!" Ray yells at his friend after noting that the woman lured for the evening is mute: a Samantha Morton who "has some distinctive characteristics of Harpo Marx "). Accompanied by luxurious cameos (Uma Thurman, Anthony LaPaglia, Gretchen Mol, director John Waters), Allen's newfound verve is consumed between "Broadway Danny Rose" and "Bullets on Broadway", but with even more pronounced autumnal veins.

title: Me, Myself & Irene
actors: Jim Carrey, Renée Zellweger, Chris Cooper, Robert Forster
description: Charlie is a police officer with seventeen years of service in the ranks of the Rhode Island police. He is a far too polite person and is always ready to help others. Charlie has one flaw he is schizophrenic and when he runs out of medication he sinks into his fits and transforms into the hyperaggressive Hank. The two have nothing in common except Irene, a beautiful fugitive who has the police on her back.
notes: The directors of "Dumb & more dumb" and "Tutti pazzi per Mary" are the theorists and aesthetes of contemporary "bad taste", but to look with malice inside their scenes and their frames they find themselves, not hidden, the traces of a glorious comic tradition. In this new film the Farrellys can count on the special effects of Jim Carrey's face as he runs, falls, injures himself, kicks and punches, fights with objects and with his own rubber face.
