A corrosive, funny, rude film. The wonderful lunar man from Forman's film returns to earth and reminds everyone that an unassigned Oscar cannot interrupt the Jim Carrey Show.

title: Dayereh
actors: Fereshteh Sadr Orafai, Nargess Mamizadeh, Elham Saboktakin
description: A woman has just given birth to a baby girl and is unaware that both she and her daughter are unwanted in Iranian society. Three women are released from prison on temporary leave. The need for money leads them to extreme measures. Another woman, without identity documents and a travel companion, has to lie to be able to buy a bus ticket. An unmarried woman escapes from prison to have an abortion.
notes: "The circle" (in the sense of the carousel, of the patrols) is the narrative scheme that binds together different events and characters, all female. It is also the circle of a history within which the possibility of women to achieve a degree of autonomy and independence seems indefinitely blocked. It is of women closed in the circle that Panahi speaks to us, reminding us how terrible oppressions in other parts of the world correspond to the conquests of the Western and the rich. There is talk of political oppression and male oppression, which are the same there; of chador and abortion, of abandonment of children due to the impossibility of raising them and of cigarettes forbidden to women. There is talk of a male regime where the complicity between males is made up of arrogance and timidity. Golden Lion at the 57th Venice Film Festival.

title: Fantasia 2000
description: "Symphony n. 5": there is a great controversy between two groups of objects different in shape and color that represent the eternal struggle of Good against Evil. "The pines of Rome": a group of whales takes flight when a supernova explodes in their natural habitat. "Rhapsody in blue": the intertwining of the lives of various characters in the Manhattan of the golden years of jazz is followed. "The intrepid tin soldier": a toy soldier faces enormous dangers to save a dancer. "Carnival of the Animals": What happens if a flamingo is given a yo yo? "The Sorcerer's Apprentice": Mickey Mouse returns as the sorcerer. "Suite the firebird": Nature is summoned by the king of the forest.
notes: The orchestration of the seven new songs was handled by master James Levine, who takes the place of the legendary Leopold Stokowski. The most successful is the one inspired by "The Carnival of the Animals" by Camille Saint-Saëns. Also curious is the segment of "Rhapsody in blue", set in Manhattan in 1929 designed in a style reminiscent of U.P.A. billboards, or the dance of digital whales to the tune of Respighi's "I pini di Roma". Overall, this is an extremely accurate operation from the manufacturing point of view, but without that primitive charm that survives only in the little Mickey Mouse.

title: Romance of a Horse-Thief
actors: Yul Brynner, Eli Wallach, Serge Gainsbourg, Jane Birkin
description: In the early twentieth century in Malava, a town on the border between Prussian and Russian Poland, a horse thief, Zanvill was damaged by the Tsar's decision to requisition all the horses. When in addition to this decision comes the order to recruit valid young people to fight in the war that is about to break out between Russia and Japan, Zanvill decides, on the advice of his father, to leave Poland clandestinely and leave for America.
notes: After "I Will Kill Willie Kid", the revived Polonsky made this picaresque novel with some notes of subtle humor. A sort of western of the steppes, with tastefully characterized characters.

title: La controfigura
actors: Jean Sorel, Ewa Aulin, Lucia Bosé, Silvano Tranquilli, Sergio Doria
description: Giovanni, a failed architect, married Lucia but during a vacation he seduces his mother-in-law Nora. Both women are attracted to Giovanni, a hippy who is one day found murdered dead.
notes: Guerrieri tries the path of yellow but fails in his intent. The film is predictable.

title: Dolci inganni
actors: Catherine Spaak, Christian Marquand, Jean Sorel, Milly
description: Francesca, who is sixteen, is in love with an architect who is twenty years her senior. At school the girl talks to her friends about her experiences with Enrico. Leaving school, Francesca accompanies her mother to go shopping and meets a boy, a close friend of the family, who takes her to a noblewoman who is in love with him. The evening arrives and the teenager feels the need to see the architect again and joins him at his workplace. Gradually, however, Francesca realizes that she was wrong about her.
notes: The film underwent a seizure in 1960 and was put back into circulation a year later with an eleven-minute cut.

title: The Story of Us
actors: Michelle Pfeiffer, Bruce Willis, Coleen Rennison, Jake Sandvig
description: After fifteen years of marriage, Ben and Katie are grappling with a paradox: how come the qualities that made them fall in love now end up driving them away? So the two decide to attempt a temporary separation while their twelve-year-old sons Josh and ten-year-old Erin are on vacation. During this separation Ben and Katie will have the opportunity to reflect on their life as a couple and to think about whether it is worth getting back together again.
notes: The film, as in a frenetic and uninspired collective family album, piles up images (some funny) and words that make the scenes of any marriage condemned to the happy end joyful or unbearable.

title: The Talented Mr Ripley
actors: Matt Damon, Gwyneth Paltrow, Jude Law, Cate Blanchett, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Jack Davenport, James Rebhorn, Sergio Rubini, Philip Baker Hall, Celia Weston
description: Tom Ripley accepts the job of Dickie's father and goes to look for him in Italy where he seems to have taken refuge. Arriving there Tom meets the boy and his girlfriend Margie and is attracted by their carefree way of life. Soon Tom enters the life of Dickie who, annoyed, chases him away. In anger, Tom kills him and assumes his identity. But a friend and a policeman put on his trail.
notes: With a novel as beautiful and tortuous as that of Patricia Highsmith (from which Clément drew, in 1959, "Murder in the Sun"), it is difficult to go wrong. However, Minghella's model seems to be the Hitchcock of "Murder by Crime" (again from Highsmith), in the Mediterranean setting and in Paltrow / Grace Kelly, but above all in the game of attraction-rejection between Tom and Dickie. Damon is an ideal Ripley; but what escapes Minghella is the loss Ripley has to pay.

title: Any Given Sunday
actors: Al Pacino, Jamie Foxx, Cameron Diaz, Dennis Quaid, James Woods, Jim Brown, Bill Bellamy
description: Tony D'Amato has been successfully leading the Miami Sharks football team for years, but now things are no longer going well: the team has lost their last four games and the helm has passed into the hands of Christina, their daughter. of the recently deceased patron; for her what matters are money and profits, and there is no more room for sentimentality. To complicate the situation there is also the fact that the quarterback is in crisis and suffers the arrival of the young and ambitious Willie Beamen ...
notes: The film confirms a (bad) impression: Oliver Stone now has little to add to everything he has already said / shown. And what little he shouts annoyingly at the top of his voice.

title: Creature of the Black Lagoon
actors: Julie Adams, Ben Chapman, Richard Carlson, Richard Denning
description: An expedition of American biologists in the Amazon is convinced of the existence of a species of fish-man. Following the trail of a "mysterious" creature, the two scientists of the team locate and capture a humanoid covered with gills, practically amphibian. But the "monster manages to escape.
notes: Sci-fi classic from the 1950s, directed by the master of the genre Jack Arnold. "Political" aftertaste of unquestionable depth: in an era in which not even blacks, in the cinema, have the right to the point of view, Arnold is on the side of the "different". And it hits the mark: in 1954 "The monster of the black lagoon" was a blockbuster.

title: Titus
actors: Anthony Hopkins, Jessica Lange, Alan Cumming, Harry Lennix, Jonathan Rhys Meyers, Matthew Rhys
description: After defeating the Goths and taking Queen Tamora, her three children and her lover General Titus Andronicus captive, he returns home. The time has come to sacrifice an enemy to the gods. Then the general has one of Tamora's sons killed, thus provoking the desire for revenge of the queen and her two surviving sons. In the meantime, in Rome, war is open for the emperor's successor.
notes: Julie Taymor, the famous American theater director, takes inspiration from her 1995 Shakespearean adaptation and reconstructs its visual structure, where costumes and sets reflect barbarism through the mixture of ancient and modern. Of course, there are some touches already seen, some memories of "Richard III" by Loncraine. But certain images, which come straight from the theater, acquire just as much cinematic power.

title: Man on the Moon
actors: Danny DeVito, Jim Carrey, Courtney Love, Paul Giamatti
description: Andy Kaufman is a comedian who has crossed America offering surreal comedy. Masterful in deceiving the audience, she managed to cause loud laughter and embarrassing silences with her performances. Whether he proposed a comedy for kids or challenged the ladies in wrestling matches he was a controversial character and beyond all schemes. Even in private life, Andy couldn't get out of his character.
notes: The film, correctly directed by Milos Forman, rightly chooses to remain functional to the human story of the American artist who died at the age of thirty-five. The film can only happily suffer the skill of Jim Carrey and the comedic potential of Andy Kaufman, despite the attempted massacre of the Italian dubbing (which also covers the version of "Volare" sung by the protagonist!). The ability of Formnan and Carrey lies in having re-proposed intact and corrosive the unreconciled talent of Kaufman. The "man on the moon" of the title is that of the song dedicated to Kaufman by R.E.M. (authors of the soundtrack).

title: The Cell
actors: Jennifer Lopez, Vince Vaughn, Vincent D'Onofrio, Marianne Jean-Baptiste
description: Catherine Deane is a psychologist who is experimenting with a new therapy: entering another person's unconscious and living the experiences that take place in his brain. Thanks to this technique, Catherine was able to save a child from a coma and brought him back to life and to his parents. When a serial killer falls into a coma, while one of his victims is imprisoned in a small, hidden cell full of traps, FBI agent Peter Novak turns to her in an attempt to save the life of the predestined victim.
notes: Sample of images and movements and effects of a supreme advertiser, "The Cell" is also a sample of citations, first of all visual but also cinematographic and literary. It refers to "The Silence of the Lambs", but with parapsychology and science fiction to cheat the genre.

title: Tumbleweeds
actors: Janet McTeer, Jay O. Sanders, Kimberly J. Brown, Ashley Buccille
description: Mary Jo is a restless woman who is looking for the right man after having certainly not reassuring experiences. Also for this reason he is always traveling. Her daughter Ava is tired of this situation, she would like to have a permanent home and would like to take root somewhere no matter where.
notes: The film hardly surprises and excites. All aimed at the acceptance of the "values" of the typical American family and at the pacification of a woman still too involved in sex and terrified by the passing of time, the dramatic development turns into a predictable exercise in style.

title: Mission to Mars
actors: Gary Sinise, Tim Robbins, Don Cheadle, Kim Delaney, Elise Neal, Connie Nielsen
description: It is June 19, 2020 and the crew of a spaceship is leaving the earth to reach Mars. When the mission has landed on the red planet, Commander Luke Graham realizes that something threatening is approaching them. The astrononauts have time to send a message and then disappear into thin air. The world space station quickly sets up a rescue mission.
notes: A spectacular film, with special effects, without losing sight of the "common" humanity of its characters, but which "wraps" in a Spielberg-like ending. Great the "whirlpool" on Mars and the approach in space. But above all, a lush greenhouse and a rock without gravity remain in the memory.

title: Le saut de l'ange
actors: Jean Yanne, Senta Berger, Sterling Hayden, Giancarlo Sbragia, Raymond Pellegrin
description: The Orsini clan of Marseille is hindered by an occult and powerful enemy. In fact, in the Provencal city, the business world allies itself with an emerging clan to defeat the "family" that holds power. At stake is a procurement package. Louis Orsini thus finds himself at war while the police are just waiting to collect the corpses.
notes: Tense and convincing French polar ruined by a simply stupid Italian title. Enjoy intrigue, tough faces and environments: as a former policeman from the cité said, "in front of the sea in Marseille, happiness is a simple idea".

title: Hanging Up
actors: Meg Ryan, Diane Keaton, Walter Matthau, Lisa Kudrow
description: Georgia is the editor of a fashion magazine, Eve is a happy mother and Maddy a B movie actress. One day the news arrives that Lou, their wild father is dying. The three sisters who are always overworked will do their utmost to stay in touch and try to be of help to the elderly father.
notes: This film is the quintessence of women's cinema and among women of the American good bourgeoisie. Not even Nora Ephron (screenwriter with her sister Delia), who once wrote sharp lyrics, no longer knows what to invent to revive a model that is now out of print. In the end, Lisa Kudrow is the winner of the clash between divas, precisely because she is less known than the others, more genuine.

title: Jing ke ci qin wang
actors: Gong Li, Zhang Fengyi, Li Xuejian, Chen Kaige, Lu Xiaohe
description: The ambitious king of Quin is obsessed with the idea of ??unifying China divided into seven kingdoms and becoming the First Emperor. Lady Zhao, his childhood mistress, offers to help him and organizes a false plot against the King. This allows the King of Quin to invade the kingdom of Yan, which represents the greatest obstacle to the unification of the country. But a painful discovery about his birth prompts the king to launch a bloody attack.
notes: Ambitious historical drama that, despite the terror and brutality it stages, never reaches the black heart of melodrama, the dark background of the Shakespearean horrors it would like to evoke.

title: High Fidelity
actors: John Cusack, Tim Robbins, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Joan Cusack, Iben Hjejle, Jack Black, Lisa Bonet, Iben Hjejle, Chris Rehmann, Ben Carr, Lili Taylor, Joelle Carter, Natasha Gregson Wagner, Shannon Stillo, Drake Bell
description: Rob is the owner of a vinyl record shop in Chicago. Business is pretty bad, so he and his two employees with an encyclopedic musical culture spend their time drawing up charts of the best five songs in music history. Rob is also forced to reexamine his life in light of the abandonment he has had to endure by his girlfriend Laura.
notes: Stephen Frears, eclectic director, has always had a happy hand with comedy and here he works with intelligence on the manias, slang and "codes" of group and survival of his characters: complicit enough to make them nice, distant enough not to get involved too much and not to lose, therefore, the rhythm and clarity. As for the perplexities aroused by the setting, in the book London Here Chicago, Hornby is right, who said that his book deals with matters much more complex than simple geographical details. And anyway, it is a book (and a film) about a certain lifestyle and metropolitan relationships, shared everywhere. Refined cast, held together by John Cusack and his two employee-friends (Jack Black and Todd Louisio) with Tim Robbins in the ponytail, Bruce Springsteen as "spiritual father" and all the "choir girls"; a dialogue, a narrative time, an insight that never slacken.

title: The Man Who Cried
actors: Christina Ricci, Cate Blanchett, Johnny Depp, Harry Dean Stanton, John Turturro
description: Fegele is a Jewish girl who is abandoned in a Russian village by her father who leaves for the United States in search of work. Shortly after the departure of the man the whole country was razed to the ground, we are in 1927, and Fegele is taken to England. Here she changes her name, calls herself Suzie, attends a Catholic school and learns to sing. Ten years later he moves to German-occupied Paris where he meets a horse-tamer gypsy. Suzie attracted to the man and his stray life joins him and his group of Gypsy musicians.
notes: Potter's film has a serious downside to the inert protagonist, and there are a few horse appearances too many. But the game is played to the end with a bold conscience.

title: Titan A.E.
description: We are in 3028 and the terrestrial survivors of the slaughter begin a painful diaspora in space. Their hope is called Titan, a portentous spaceship capable of creating a new Eden, designed by the father of the young Cale and hidden up there, in some ravine of space, waiting for the predestined Cale to put it into operation.
notes: Veteran Don Bluth and his companion Gary Goldman make a sci-fi animated film that mixes 2-D and computer-generated 3-D animation in just 19 months. A partially won bet, because from the point of view of animation, the result is surprising. But if the animation seduces, the same does not happen for the screenplay, weak, predictable and seasoned with listless dialogues.

title: Segunda Piel
actors: Javier Bardem, Ariadna Gil, Jordi Mollà, Cecilia Roth
description: Elena's marriage to Alberto is in crisis and a son much loved by both of them is not enough to keep him together. But when Elena discovers that her rival is a man, the woman takes a double hit. Alberto, an aeronautical engineer, has a love affair with Diego, a surgeon.
notes: The film that conveys the pain of a fragile man. Bardem seems to be the directors' favorite actor for homosexual roles, but the rest of the cast works too. Only note for the director and his "lacquered" staging.

title: Russkies
actors: Whip Hubley, Joaquin Phoenix, Peter Billingsley, Stefan DeSalle
description: A Russian sailor is shipwrecked on the Florida coast. Three American kids rescue him. Mischa, who has never left the Soviet Union and has a natural distrust of Americans, feels uneasy. But when the ice breaks the three will help him get safe.
notes: Discreet adventure film.

title: Acque di primavera
actors: Timothy Hutton, Nastassja Kinski, Valeria Golino, William Forsythe
description: A Russian traveling to Europe meets, falls in love and marries a German girl of Italian origin. Then he meets a very rich compatriot, but with a troubled past that seduces him and makes him lose his wife. The young man then realizes the mistake made, but it is late.
notes: From a short story by Turghenev, a stupid co-production which is one of the lowest points in the career of an excellent director.

title: Vostochnaya elegiya
description: On the ground lies the corpse of a woman. Next to her there is the son who caresses her and who tries with words of desolation to find a meaning to the suffering.
notes: Sokurov's film is a reflection on guilt and time, and at the same time it is a kind of documentary on the end of the Soviet Union. Almost experimental in conception.

title: Above Suspicion
actors: Christopher Reeve, Joe Mantegna, Kim Cattrall
description: Dempsey, once a respected and skilled police officer, was paralyzed after a tragic incident and leads a dramatic life. From his wheelchair, he cannot help but witness the destruction of his world: friends, work, family. Wife Gail has a lover. And Dempsey decides to organize the perfect crime: counting on the possibility of not being suspected, because he is disabled, the former policeman contemplates killing both Gail and his partner.
notes: The protagonist of the story Christopher Reeve, as he is known, is truly quadriplegic. Writers include actor William H. Macy.

title: Eddie
actors: Whoopi Goldberg, Frank Langella, Dennis Farina
description: Eddie is a fanatic New York limo driver for the local football team, the Knicks. One day he wins some kind of competition and becomes the "honorary coach" of the team. The propaganda maneuver turns out to be a double-edged sword, because Eddie is actually better and more loved than the real coach.
notes: Funny comedy that rests all on Goldberg's shoulders.

title: They Rode West
actors: Robert Francis, Donna Reed, May Wynn, Philip Carey, Onslow Stevens
description: Sward is a friendly doctor of the Red Indians who treats them when a malaria epidemic spreads in their camp. The doctor must also counter Captain Black's policy of ferocious hostility. Between skirmishes with Lauren, the colonel's daughter, Sward tries to persuade the Kiowa tribe not to attack the fort where the Americans are locked up. It will be during a difficult operation carried out on the son of the Indian chief who was injured in a firefight that the Indians will understand that it is not worthwhile to attack.
notes: Modest western that adds nothing new to the genre.

title: Holy Man
actors: Eddie Murphy, Jeff Goldblum, Kelly Preston, Robert Loggia
description: Ricky Hayman has to deal with the poor performance of GBSN, the network specializing in telesales where he works. Together with Kate Newell, a young "media analyst", he comes across G, a guru devoted to soul and good humor. By breaking into the programs, G manages to boost profits, quickly becoming a star.
notes: G is one of those who conquer the audience by upsetting the schedule. He says embarrassing nonsense, such as "go out into the garden and look at the lawn", but the spectators listen to him convinced. And, while they are there, they buy synthetic grass mats. In any case, the TV user is a Boeotian. Sara. Perhaps the makers of this film think the same about their audience.

title: La donna invisibile
actors: Giovanna Ralli, Carla Gravina, Anita Sanders, Silvano Tranquilli
description: Laura, married to Andrea, a professor who has ended up in the crosshairs of the dispute, realizes that her husband no longer loves her and that she has become invisible to him. The woman is still deeply in love with him but he seems more interested in Delfina another woman who lives at home with them. In vain Laura tries to attract his attention by confessing to him a betrayal but all is useless. One day during a hunting trip Andrea accidentally kills her.
notes: Paolo Spinola with the help of Dacia Maraini and Ottavio Jemma reduces the story of the same name by Alberto Moravia for the screen, not knowing whether to choose the fantastic aspect of the story or the realistic one.

title: Chi lavora è perduto
actors: Sady Rebbot, Pascale Audret, Tino Buazzelli, Franco Arcalli
description: Twenty-seven-year-old Bonifacio without a job finds himself around noon wandering the sunny streets of Venice on a summer day. The heat, the need to pass the time and the need to make an important decision like that of work lead him to process a lot of memories and thoughts with his mind. In this way, some family situations and the various phases of his upbringing are relived. In his wanderings he meets Claudio and returns with his thoughts to another friend of his who has never come out of the asylum ...
notes: Tinto Brass' first film has considerable libertarian force. The censorship imposed cuts and a new title, _In capo al mondo_.

title: Madly
actors: Alain Delon, Pascale De Boysson, Valentina Cortese, Jean-Luis Le Goff, Mireille Darc
description: Julien, a young antiquarian who lives in a castle full of real and fake works of art, has a very casual sex life. Unconventional and modern, his wife Adèle doesn't care, on the contrary she humors him knowing that only in that way can she keep the marriage going. One day Madly arrives at the manor, a black girl who by profession is a fashion photographer. It doesn't take Julien to fall in love with the woman, who is accepted by Adèle as his second wife. Initially, things go well, then Adèle decides to leave due to some misunderstandings.
notes: Negligible film that fails to focus on the psychologies of the three characters. Remarkable soundtrack by Francis Lai.

title: Quella chiara notte d'ottobre
actors: Irina Demick, Silvano Tranquilli, Don Backy, Venantino Venantini
description: Woman on the verge of a nervous breakdown. The meeting with a man she had loved before getting married offers her the opportunity to regain that balance that she seemed to have lost forever. A murder that the two lovers witness ends up breaking their romantic adventure. But the woman does not lose heart, and tries to get out of the neurosis that heavily conditions her life.
notes: Massimo Franciosa proves that he does not know how to analyze with due clarity the drama of the woman on the verge of a nervous breakdown. The texture, a little yellow and a little pink, is not convincing. In the cast Don Backy escapes from the Celentano Clan.

title: Catch Me a Spy
actors: Kirk Douglas, Marlène Jobert, Trevor Howard, Tom Courtenay
description: The Parisian Fabienne lives in London as a guest of her uncle Sir Trevor, Minister of State. One day she meets John, falls in love with him, marries him in a short time and leaves with him for Romania on their honeymoon. Arriving at the hotel, an individual hides the microfilm of a rare Russian opera in the woman's suitcase. While John is arrested, Fabienne is drugged and sent to London. Here he learns that John is a useful pawn for the Russians to obtain the release of a spy held captive.
notes: It is not clear whether the film is intended to be a parody of 007 or a serious version of "The Pink Panther". However, some situations are fun.

title: Animal Factory
actors: Willem Dafoe, Edward Furlong, Mickey Rourke, Eddie Bunker
description: Earl was sentenced to twenty-five years in prison and feels himself the master of the prison. He is influential, respected, has excellent relationships with the guards, writes reports, minutes and reports. He's had loves, but when he sets his sights on the newly arrived rookie, Ron, a young man from a good family involved in drug dealing, it's not a sex story. It is a platonic love, the complex relationship between a father and a son, both difficult and intelligent.
notes: The actor and director Steve Buscemi who knows the tradition of classic cinema and independent cinema well, directs an excellent B movie. Around the protagonists, the orderly and violent life behind bars leaves out no rhetorical detail. The direction is safe, the actors are very good and the prison retains its sad photogenicity.

title: Picking Up the Pieces
actors: Woody Allen, Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Sharon Stone, David Schwimmer, Elliott Gould, Alfonso Arau, Mia Maestro
description: Tex, a kosher butcher from New York, is a repentant under the protection of the federal government of Arizona. Tex in a fit of jealousy killed his wife Candy, after discovering that she was cheating on him with the sheriff and tore her to pieces. To try to hide the broken body of his wife Tex, he leaves for Mexico. On the way, however, he loses a hand which is mistaken for a relic capable of working miracles. All because a blind woman stumbled over it and regained her sight. The news spreads and thousands of people flock. It is at this point that Father Carillo intervenes ...
notes: The film is boring and fairly vulgar. The many actors involved should sue the director.

title: The Perfect Storm
actors: George Clooney, Mark Wahlberg, John C. Reilly, Karen Allen, Diane Lane, William Fichtner, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Allen Payne
description: Captain Bill Tyne, aboard the Andrea Gail, sets out on a dangerous fishing trip. The enterprise succeeds, but on the way back the boat remains involved in a hurricane of dramatic proportions.
notes: Recovering somewhat listlessly stereotypes from western "bunch", Petersen recounts the virile friendship between rude men of the sea. What saves "The Perfect Storm" from total shipwreck? Two spectacular sequences, Springsteen on the soundtrack, the presence of Karen Allen and the vaguely outdated breath of adventure.

title: Keeping the Faith
actors: Ben Stiller, Edward Norton, Jenna Elfman, Eli Wallach, Anne Bancroft
description: Rabbi Jake and Catholic priest Brian grew up together; since childhood, they have learned to share everything. After sixteen years, they find a mutual friend they had nicknamed "Anna Banana": affection turns into something more serious, and jealousy emerges between the two ...
notes: An unusual comedy because it takes its time: those of the jokes, of the psychological development of characters and of their respective relationships. The main one is the friendship that binds the trio, progressively "altered" by the love that is born, in different directions, between the three. For Norton, a great directorial debut.

title: Entropy
actors: Stephen Dorff, Judith Godrèche, Bono, Lauren Holly, Hector Elizondo
description: Jake, U2's trusted video clip director, is hired to shoot a singular debut film while filming a documentary about the Irish group: a period thriller with a lot of violence and a taste of sex. The debutante with a confused soul tells the viewer directly the vicissitudes of his first work and the parallel ones of his encounter with a beautiful model.
notes: The sophisticated Soho, the set, the vulgar producers, the lofts, the catwalks, the screen that splits into three or eight small screens, the earthquake editing, the fashion TV shots, the black and white images. A trendy cocktail with randomly mixed ingredients.

title: Cord
actors: Bruce Greenwood, Daryl Hannah, Johanna Black, Vincent Gallo
description: Jack and Ann are a married couple who live a quiet life all around home and work. The two get along well and love each other. Their happiness skyrockets when Ann realizes she is pregnant. The joy doesn't last long because one day Ann is kidnapped and killed. At least that's what Jack is led to believe. In reality, Ann is not dead and the truth is very different. Those responsible for the kidnapping are Emily and Frank, a couple who cannot have children and who by kidnapping Ann are convinced that they finally have a child of their own.
notes: Interpreters of good caliber for this film directed by Sidney J. Furie.

title: Mermaid
actors: Ellen Burstyn, Samantha Mathis, Jodelle Ferland, David Kaye
description: Following the death of her husband, the young Rhonda was forced to face many difficulties, not least the trauma suffered by his daughter Desi. The girl seems to have lost the desire to live and, visibly depressed, she started talking in the third person. Attempts to shake it from this state are completely useless. Desi is dominated by a single thought: trying to communicate with the missing father. All the letters that the little girl writes return irreparably to the sender. Not satisfied, Desi then entrusts a message to bring to the father to a balloon. Transported by the wind the note arrives in the village of Mermaid ...

title: Aladdin and the King of Thieves
description: Aladdin is finally about to marry Princess Jasmine: despite the presence and encouragement of his friends Genio, Tappeto and Abu, he is worried and anxious. What haunts him most is his future role as a father, since he has never known his own. But when the Forty Thieves jeopardize their upcoming nuptials by attempting to steal a magical talisman that turns everything into gold, Aladdin finds himself embroiled in a dangerous adventure to foil their plan that will also lead him on the trail of his long-lost father.
notes: Sequel to Disney's "Aladdin", made directly for the small screen.

title: Notti e nebbie
actors: Umberto Orsini, Laura Morante, Senta Berger
description: Bruno Spada, policeman of the Italian Social Republic, agrees to head the political police office in Milan. His is a strategic position: not only does he have a free hand in the repression of the partisans, but also the possibility of controlling the loyalty of the fascists.
notes: Tv movie originally conceived in two episodes and based on the novel of the same name by Carlo Castellaneta. Giordana faces a difficult film with courage, because it is experienced from the point of view of a republican. And it hits the spot. To date, his best work, which demonstrates how the breath of the script is particularly congenial for the director.

title: It conquered the World
actors: Lee Van Cleef, Peter Graves, Beverly Garland
description: A young American scientist, enthusiastic about his close encounter with aliens, favors their invasion of Earth. In reality he hopes that the Venusian emissary is a bringer of peace, but soon discovers his real intentions. Turn men into slaves.
notes: By-product of the golden age of science fiction, the American one of the 1950s. Definitely naive and naive in special effects, but with its own indisputable charm. Ideal for cinephiles looking for delicacies. It is not the most essential of Roger Corman's films, king of the B series, but it still has its own reason.

title: Fatal Frames - Fotogrammi mortali
actors: Rick Gianasi, Stefania Stella, Ugo Pagliai, David Warbeck
description: Alex is invited to Rome to direct a video clip of the emerging singer Stefania Stella. Upon arriving, however, he finds himself embroiled in a nasty murder story, peppered with snuff video appearances. Someone has set up a scheme to frame the director, the alleged perpetrator of a real murder.
notes: Terrifying Italian-style thriller with a troubled production (lasting years and marked by the defection of some protagonists). But the sloppiness of the staging and the approximation of the actors cannot be justified. The director also signed the soundtrack.

title: The Wrong Man
actors: Rosanna Arquette, Kevin Anderson, John Lithgow
description: Poor Alex Walker would very much like to continue living his quiet life but Mexico, you know, is the land where anything can happen. He is there for work, only he gets involved in a serious crime and the police are convinced that he is the culprit. He will have to escape from the federales, and he will not escape alone ...
notes: Action comedy directed by a veteran like Jim McBride ("At the last breath", "The Informant"), who for the occasion shows all the streotypes of the adventurous road movie.

title: Sister Sister
actors: Eric Stoltz, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Judith Ivey
description: Two sisters live in that motel near the Louisiana swamp and make ends meet by giving travelers food and sleep. One of the two, however, shows signs of imbalance: in the past in fact it has suffered terrible violence, and now some ghosts show up again. But will they be just "ghosts"? Meanwhile, the dead are flocking.
notes: Bill Condon, the director of the second "Candyman" and above all of "Demons & Gods", tries his hand at a B movie not to be thrown away, in evident debt of oxygen with many classics of the genre (Tobe Hooper in primis). For enthusiasts.

title: Film
actors: Laura Morante, Monica Scattini, Maddalena Crippa, Naike Rivelli
description: Mara stopped being an actress to write a film; but her creative endeavors are continually interrupted by troublesome friends who torment her with their sentimental misadventures: the young aspiring actress engaged to a man is perhaps pregnant, the promiscuous goes from one amorazzo to another, Monica has just been dumped by her husband. For Mara, the solution is to tell the four friends.
notes: In theory, an attempt at bad comedy about unsympathetic female characters; in practice, an hour and a half of smug and (badly dubbed) chatter. But the really unforgivable thing is to waste the presence of Laura Morante in this way.

title: La veuve de Saint-Pierre
actors: Juliette Binoche, Daniel Auteuil, Emir Kusturica, Michel Duchaussoy
description: 1848, while in Paris the Republic leads an uncertain life, in a French islet in Canada Neel Auguste kills an old man in a state of drunkenness. Offender I confess, he is sentenced to death, but the guillotine (the "widow" in jargon) does not arrive. The wife of the captain of the garrison sees the signs of goodness in him and "adopts" him. Neel Auguste integrates himself into the community even performing heroic deeds, but unleashing the hatred of notables. When the guillotine arrives, it is a sad day for the whole population, but especially for the captain, who must order the execution.
notes: Leconte, compared to his latest films, recovers a bit of narrative compactness, and seems to move in the footsteps of Truffaut. But the narrative solutions are taken for granted, the dialogues uncertain between tragedy and irony; there is never a moment of abandonment, of delirium, of true melò. Curious actor Kusturica, who puts effort in a role "à la Depardieu". But the only one with some truly nineteenth-century, almost bovaristic, thrill is Juliette Binoche.

title: A Map of the World
actors: Sigourney Weaver, Julianne Moore, David Strathairn, Chloë Sevigny
description: Alice is a city woman who has decided to go to live in the countryside next to her husband, in a village in Wisconsin. The woman is a nurse in an elementary school, outspoken on the verge of dislike and her only friend is neighbor Theresa. A great complicity arises between the two women and often one takes care of the other's children. One day Alice hosts Theresa's daughters; a trivial distraction and little Lizzy drowns in a small body of water. It is the beginning of a descent into the judicial and prison underworld, without any indulgence on the part of the community, but only that suffered by Theresa.
notes: Elliott, a theater-trained director was inspired by the novel of the same name by Jane Hamilton for his film debut. The film maintains its dramatic potential by relying on the performances of Sigourney Weaver and Julianne Moore, accompanied by the music of Pat Metheny. Alice's courage to the limit of unconsciousness and Theresa's fragility find in the two interpreters a painful and supportive balance, thus subverting an imperfect world and film.

title: Liberty Heights
actors: Adrien Brody, Bebe Neuwirth, Joe Mantegna, Ben Foster
description: Liberty Heights is the Jewish quarter of Baltimore, where the Kurtzman family lives; mother housewife, father striptease and clandestine lottery manager, eldest son at university student and Ben, younger high school student. Ben loves Sinatra, we are in 1954, and only in high school discovers that the world is mostly inhabited by "gentiles". Ben falls in love with a black classmate, but soon realizes that there are insurmountable barriers, class and race, in that America.
notes: Loves, friendships, family destinies flow pleasantly, described with a comedy tone crossed by small but deep streaks of bitterness. An "as we were" that reveals the black and intolerant soul of the United States.

title: U-571
actors: Harvey Keitel, Matthew McConaughey, Jon Bon Jovi, Bill Paxton
description: During the World War, a group of American submariners is tasked with recovering the Enigma, a machine in the possession of the armed forces that is used by the Americans to decrypt the confidential information of the German Navy. The members of the US-33 must pretend to be the crew of a German submarine sent to rescue a failed German submarine. But something goes wrong.
notes: Produced by De Laurentiis, the film keeps what it promises: action, suspense, special effects, correct implementation. If you are looking for flashes of direction or find inventiveness, it is better to go elsewhere. The idea was to make a collective film because the real protagonist had to be the submarine rebuilt in Cinecittà, and everyone adapted. Even Keitel, who for the occasion is as good as bread and wears an immaculate uniform: this had never happened before.

title: Mua he chieu thang dung
actors: Tràn Nu Yén Khé, Nguyén Nhù Quynh, Lé Khanh, Ngô Quang Hài
description: Hanoi. Lien is 23 years old and works as a waitress in the bar of Suong, her elder sister, and shares an apartment with her brother Hai who dreams of being an actor. On the occasion of the anniversary of their mother's death, Lien and Hai, together with their younger sister Khanh, meet at Suong's home to celebrate the anniversary. During the day the three sisters let themselves go to confidences. But each hides its own secret from the others.
notes: Tràn Anh Hùng's third film reinforces the belief that his cinema aspires to perfect stillness. Less laconic than the first two chapters on the way back to Vietnam, the director insists on melancholy, sensuality, slowness of gestures and thoughts. Bergmanian people and silences brought from the cold of the North to the heat of the East.

title: I giovani tigri
actors: Helmut Berger, Luca Della Porta, Vanni De Maigret, Ray Lovelock
description: Some young people to escape boredom get together one summer evening in a villa near Milan. Here, in the course of an absurd game, a girl dies. Fosco, Dario and Paride, after having agreed on the version to be given to the authorities, inform the police. The investigation ends quickly, with the belief that it was an involuntary accident. The three, increasingly bored, join Sam and Consuelo and decide to organize a robbery against someone who is not in a position to report them. The choice falls on a thief.
notes: Last film written and directed by Leonviola. Luca Della Porta is the son of Eduardo De Filippo.

title: Lo chiamavano Verità
actors: Mark Damon, Pat Nigro, Pietro Ceccarelli, Franco Garofalo
description: Truth, Yesael, Miserere and Gigante are no good who live on expedients between Sacramento and San Antonio. Taking advantage of the confusion caused by the Civil War, they wear uniforms and pass themselves off as heroes. When the disguise failed, the Southerners were taken prisoner and sentenced to death. Meanwhile, the war is over and the four are released. The penniless and clumsy gunslingers become scullers in the Paquita club from which they learn where an officer has hidden the gold.
notes: Luigi Perelli, director of the Piovra (from 3 to 7), had made his debut with this spaghetti western.

title: Oggi a Berlino
actors: Helmut Griem, Nana Osten, Erina Torelli, Vittorio Pugliese
description: When on August 13, 1961 the border between the two Berlins was closed by the wall, Hans, who has always lived in the East, thanks to the help of a knitter and a former diva of the German theater, flees to the West. His intention is to reunite with Kate, the girl he is in love with. Hans manages to escape, but the fear of being able to harm his family who remained behind the wall leads him to return home where he is sentenced to compulsory labor.
notes: Hans's story is treated by Pietro Vivarelli with little dramatic relief. Although at times it manages to provide a good portrait of the protagonist's sense of provisionality.

title: Salò o le 120 giornate di Sodoma
actors: Paolo Bonacelli, Giorgio Cataldi, Umberto Paolo Quintavalle, Aldo Valletti, Caterina Boratto, Elsa De Giorgi, Hélène Surgere, Sonia Saviange, Sergio Fascetti, Bruno Musso, Antonio Orlando, Claudio Cicchetti, Franco Merli, Umberto Chessari, Lamberto Book
description: A Duke, a Monsignor, a President of the Court of Appeal and the President have some young men of both sexes kidnapped in a villa controlled by Republican soldiers and the SS. Led by four former prostitute hags and stimulated by their tales, they torture them and use them for their own perverse pleasures.
notes: Reflection on the culture of death and oppression that regulates social relations in the contemporary world. A film about power as will, read through Sade, and set in the historical moment in which power had shown its most irrational face (but as a terrible metaphor for the present). Despite the depth of the speech "Salò" keeps away from any "revolutionary" didacticism. It is a painful and almost unsustainable testament. Released after Pasolini's death, he was the subject of an absurd judicial dispute.

title: The Whole Nine Yards
actors: Bruce Willis, Matthew Perry, Rosanna Arquette, Amanda Peet, Michael Clarke Duncan
description: Nicolas Oz is a nice Chicago dentist who lives in Montreal and lives in Canada and his wife, called "la jena" as a curse. His neighbor, Jimmy Tudeski is a wanted killer from the whole gang, who has put a price on his head. Despite the obvious differences, the two have something in common there is someone who is trying to kill them. For Jimmy, avoiding a pair of killers is child's play, for Oz a little less.
notes: Jonathan Lynn, British comedian who directed "Suore on the run", "My cousin Vincenzo" and the series "Yes, Minister", holds up the beautiful script with precision and plays on the well-matched couple Bruce Willis, a sly killer with some dazzling jokes , and Matthew Perry the real protagonist, plump, amazed, neurotic, clumsy.

title: Faccia di Picasso
actors: Massimo Ceccherini, Alessandro Paci, Marco Giallini
description: Massimo Ceccherini and Alessandro Paci are doing their show in the theater and the audience is laughing out loud. From here their adventures begin to try to make their dream come true: to shoot the second film. Finding a producer capable of financing a film is not an easy task but Massimo and Alessandro find him, just as they find a screenwriter and the leading actress. Everything is ready and you can start shooting.
notes: Already with his first work, "Lucignolo", Ceccherini had gone beyond the cabaret style of Pieraccioni, but his "authorial shyness" had slowed him down a bit. Here, free rein in a creative void filled with torn madness, he captures various targets, getting lost in paths that at times border on a genial poetic. The homage dedicated to the painter's father would be enough to recommend "Picasso's Face" (but the working title sounded more provocative "Picasso's Head"). For those who have followed him to the theater it is a relative surprise: Ceccherini is one of the very few tragic masks of the contemporary Italian scene and he is right when, in front of the Roman plaque indicating "via Federico Fellini", he claims that the Rimini master would have taken advantage of it. , and how.

title: Denti
actors: Sergio Rubini, Paolo Villaggio, Anita Caprioli, Fabrizio Bentivoglio
description: Antonio has always had problems with his incisors, huge and impossible to hide. From an early age he tried to break them only managing to chip them. Antonio now grown up will finally find who will break them. It is Mara, a woman for whom he left his wife and children, who will break them with a crystal ashtray. For Antonio begins a real descent into hell to find a dentist able to replace the broken incisors.
notes: The courage to make a film about dental deformations and continuous interventions in the gum area is certainly remarkable. Furthermore, Salvatores conceived the film, based on the homonymous book by Domenico Starnone, as an experimental film, assisted by the excellent work of Italo Petriccione (photography) and Massimo Fiocchi (editing).

title: El pisito
actors: José Luis López Vazquez, Maria Carrillo, Concha López
description: The shy Rodolfo has been engaged for twelve years, but is unable to marry his Petrita due to the lack of housing. Following the advice of his betrothed, Rodolfo impales the eighty-year-old Martina, owner of the pension where he is temporarily staying. Will he be able to marry his beloved Petrita on the day he ...
notes: Brilliant debut behind the camera by Marco Ferreri. Apology of human cynicism written together with the faithful screenwriter Rafael Azcona. There is a pinch of black humor in Rodolfo's adventures. In a small role, that of the landlord, a very young Ferreri appears.

title: Yerma
actors: Edmonda Aldini, Franco Citti, Michele Placido
description: Individual drama of a woman anxious about motherhood. The husband does not think like her, he prefers to take care of other things (work, leisure and above all: money). When she has confirmation that she cannot be a mother, she finds a solution to her anxiety. Strangle her husband.
notes: The bourgeois husband and wife reinterpreted in an exquisitely surreal key. Paradoxical and grotesque, in pure Ferrerrian style. This time, however, the director suffers from a lack of synthesis and the film slips away a bit boring. For all aficionados of the national Marco, however, not to be missed.

title: Terrore nello spazio
actors: Barry Sullivan, Norma Bengell, Evi Marandi, Angel Aranda, Massimo Righi
description: A planet "extinguished" and lost in the galaxy, attracts spaceships to itself like a magnet with iron. A spaceship travels into the unknown to try to uncover the mystery. On the planet, intangible entities kill the astonauts to steal their bodies and take their place.
notes: The story looks like that of a comic. But the concept of science fiction according to Bava is visually powerful and has influenced a bit 'everyone, from Ridley Scott for "Alien" to Tim Burton for his expressionist "dreams". An authentic cult movie symbol of the glory days of our genre cinema.

title: On the Edge of Innocence
actors: Kellie Martin, Karen Young, Terry O'Quinn, James Marsden
description: Jake and Zoe are two tough guys. When both are admitted to a rehabilitation center, they get to know each other and gradually fall in love. Their feelings for each other seem to help them heal faster, but the hostile behavior of the center director exasperates Jake, who decides to run away with Zoe. After getting into trouble, chased by the police, the two boys realize they have made a mistake in escaping, and go back to the center.
notes: The moral of the short film is very ambiguous. The only interesting one is James Marsden, recently headlined for his role in the "X-Men" (he is Cyclops).

title: Sommer am Meer
actors: Kerstin Draeger, Heikko Deutschmann, Ruth-Maria Kubitschek, Kathrin Ackermann, Burkhard Heyl, Claudia Wedekind
description: For Virginia, the time spent more than ten years ago in Cornwall remains the happiest of her life. Young and carefree, she fell in love with Eustace, a simple country boy. Her mother had opposed their relationship by returning her to Germany to marry the wealthy Keile. Now Virginia decides to return to Cornwall to find the love of the past.

title: Cyrano de Bergerac
actors: José Ferrer, Mala Power, William Prince, Morris Carnowsky
description: Cyrano of Bergerac, a Gascon nobleman, swordsman and poet, loves Rossana, his cousin, but has a problem: he has such a big nose that it prevents him from confessing his love. Rossana, unaware of the feeling Cirano feels towards him, chooses him as her confidant. The cousin is madly in love with Cristiano, a cadet from Gascogne, and terrified that something could happen to him, she begs Cyrano to protect him. Cristiano, for his part, fails to impress Rossana and thinks of exploiting Cirano's poetic ability.
notes: Sober and correct film based on the play by Rostand. José Ferrer won the Oscar.

title: The Brides of Dracula
actors: Peter Cushing, Martita Hunt, Yvonne Monlaur, Freda Jackson, Andrée Melly, David Peel
description: Baron Meinster, a young and charming vampire, has been locked up in the family home by his mother and is supplied by her with beautiful prey. When the unsuspecting Marianne, a young teacher in her first experience in Transylvania, frees him from her chains, it's up to the legendary Doctor Van Helsing to hunt him down ...
notes: Fisher's first vampire film after Dracula the Vampire, starring Cushing but without Christopher Lee. In addition to boasting a fine photography and one of the best interpretations of the genre, it is distinguished by the sumptuous staging, the accurate historical research, the tension to the stars. Thrilling ending.

title: They Won't Believe Me
actors: Robert Young, Susan Hayward, Tom Powers, Jane Greer
description: Larry, a stockbroker, married a rich woman who he never loved. The man has been in a relationship with a journalist for some time. The wife, who intends to end the relationship, convinces her husband to leave with her for Los Angeles. But Larry runs away with Vera. During the escape, Vera dies in a car accident. Since his wife is missing, Larry makes everyone believe that she is the victim of the accident.
notes: Very classic noir. Not a masterpiece but quite well thought out.

title: Il vento mi ha cantato una canzone
actors: Laura Solari, Alberto Sordi, Virgilio Riento, Pietro Bigerna
description: A commendatore, owner of a cosmetics factory, has signed a contract with Radio Sibilla for the evening broadcast of a musical program. But the program was not successful with the public and the Commander telephoned the radio to complain. Paul replies, that having to complain he can not help but agree with him. Unfortunately for him, he complains just as he has the radio director behind him, who fires him. At this point Paolo, who is a good musician, tries to be hired as a whole by the commander to revive the fortunes of the broadcast.
notes: Mediocre film-magazine, now forgotten but to be recovered as a document.

title: Ergastolo
actors: Franco Interlenghi, Ignazio Balsamo, Marisa Merlini, Tina Pica
description: Rosa has an illegitimate son, Stefano, who lives with her in Professor Arlotta's house. The boy is twenty years old and is madly in love with Lydia, the professor's niece. Unfortunately the young man has the habit of gambling, and in order to pay off a gambling debt he is forced to accept the court of Jeannette, owner of the place where Stefano goes to play. Jeannette is the lover of Pasquale, a very influential Camorra leader. One day the boss is killed in Jeannette's house and trouble begins for Stefano ...
notes: Strongly colored drama that anticipates the themes of Neapolitan dramas.

title: Griffin and Phoenix: A Story of Love and Death
actors: Peter Falk, Jill Clayburgh, Sally Kirkland, George Chandler
description: Gino is diagnosed with cancer. The doctors only gave him one year to live. After unsuccessfully seeking the understanding of his family, Gino isolates himself and meets Sarah, a woman condemned to die of leukemia. A beautiful friendship is born between the two, so much so that they decide to move in together. They make a mutual promise: when the end comes, the one who remains alive will not have to follow the other either to the hospital or to the cemetery. The first to feel bad is Sarah. Gino is unable to keep his promise and goes to visit her in the hospital.
notes: Weepy drama played well by the Falk / Clayburgh duo.

title: I Married A Comunist
actors: Robert Ryan, Laraine Day, John Agar, Thomas Gomez
description: Paul Laury, a young vice president of the shipowners' union, is working hard to reach an agreement between the owners and the dockers. Paul, recently married to Nancy, has to contend with an ex-lover who is determined to put a spoke in his wheel. It is the revolutionary front, a communist-style organization that Paul joined as a young man, that pushed her to behave in that way. The Communists blackmail Paul into trying to blow up the upcoming deal.
notes: When the Communists ate children, they made films like that in America. Great craft of Robert Stevenson and a colossal Robert Ryan.

title: The Aristocats
description: A very rich Parisian noblewoman leaves all her possessions in her will to the cat Duchess and her puppies Bizet, Matisse and Minou. The treacherous butler Edgar, greedy and rapacious, does all he can to get rid of the animals, but he has done the math without the strays of the neighborhood, who intervene to help the "aristocats".
notes: An animation classic strongly desired by Walt Disney who died before being able to make it in first person. It was a resounding success also thanks to the Jazz soundtrack and the famous song by Maurice Chevalier. An evergreen for all ages.

title: Si fa presto a dire amore
actors: Enrico Brignano, Vittoria Belvedere, Isabel Perez, Samuela Sardo
description: Enrico is a 30 year old chronically unemployed and mother's boyfriend. His world of certainties collapses when he is dumped by his historical girlfriend, Silvana ...
notes: Squeezed between Veronian tics and winks at Pieraccioni, Brignano sets in motion an abused comic mechanism, which tears only a few smiles.

title: The Golden Bowl
actors: Nick Nolte, Uma Thurman, Jeremy Northam, Kate Beckinsale
description: Prince Amerigo on the street is about to marry Maggie, daughter of Adam, an American tycoon who loves to collect art objects. With the excuse of buying a wedding present for Maggie, he sees Charlotte, his ex-lover who is as penniless as he is. The two find a golden cup which they discard because they judge it to be false. By a strange twist of fate, Charlotte marries Adam and consequently the lives of the four are intertwined once again. Bored by the new life full of ease and comfort, the prince and Charlotte resume their old relationship.
notes: More than the deaf resurgence of rancor and impulses, Ivory with this film gives body to the bodies of the four protagonists.

title: Ma petite entreprise
actors: Vincent Lindon, François Berléand, Roschdy Zem, Albert Dray
description: Ivan, who takes pains to run his small carpentry shop. He juggles orders, deals with creditors and directs his employees with commitment. It is not difficult to understand why his wife Nathalie preferred Sami to him and that she moved in with him with their son Christophe. One day the carpentry is destroyed by a fire. To his surprise, Ivan discovers that his insurer Maxime is a disreputable type.
notes: The tone of the film is hilarious and desperate: "La scam degli honest" is a comedy in which no one is honest, and the key line is that of Maxime, when he tells his victim Ivan how complicated it is to buy a dacha near Moscow: "In Russia as soon as you turn around they screw you. I'm Russian. "

title: Sangue vivo
actors: Lamberto Probo, Pino Zimba, Abrhaim, Danilo Andreoli, Antonio Carluccio, Luigi Cazzato
description: Salento, today. Two brothers manage to survive day after day. One gets on with smuggling and unclean traffic between one shore and the other of the Ionian Sea. The other is embroiled in drug stories. The love for music that binds them will be a lifeline for them on the tragic fate that looms over their lives.
notes: Winspeare filters the high tradition and anthropological introspection, in the story of the two Salento brothers opposed in character and reaction to life. Two characters and two actors who invade and crowd the eyes of the spectators with emotions.

title: The Young Poisoner's Handbook
actors: Hugh O'Connor, Antony Sher, Charlotte Coleman, Norman Caro
description: Chain reactions result in a harmless gift given to young Graham. "The Little Chemist", in its English version. Graham, who is a dreamer and doesn't particularly like family, applies a lot to the subject and invents some poisons to administer to friends and patients. They arrest him, he ends up in a criminal asylum for years, but one bad day his old passion returns to him ...
notes: Inspired by a news story that shocked Great Britain in the 1960s, Benjamin Ross's film trades the cruelty of the social portrait of the petty bourgeoisie with grotesque tones that are not always spot on.

title: Il boss
actors: Henry Silva, Richard Conte, Gianni Garko, Vittorio Caprioli
description: The Palermo hitman Lanzetta accepts contracts only if his boss, Don Carrasco, proposes them. The latter has become not only the master of the city, but has now extended his influence as far as Rome, at the top of politics. Once the wind has changed, and forced to make new alliances, Carrasco decides to make a clean sweep of old friends, starting with Lanzetta.
notes: Extremely hard detective story by Fernando Di Leo, the best Italian action director, here grappling with a story that is prophetic in content (the mafia-politics binomial) and extreme in staging (the first sequence is from an anthology). Great protagonists, especially Richard Conte.

title: The Road to El Dorado
directors: Eric 'Bibo' Bergeron, Don Paul, David Silverman, Will Finn
description: Tullio and Miguel are two petty scammers living in 14th century Spain. To avoid the wrath of the cheated, the two hide on the Cortez galleon leaving for America. Discovered and grilled, Tullio and Miguel manage to escape with their faithful Altivo, a war horse. Arrived daringly in the mythical El Dorado, the two are mistaken for divinity by the adoring mass, but not by the shrewd and sensual Chelo, who becomes their irreplaceable guide.
notes: Continuing a winning line of today's animation, the film mixes traditional 2-D animation with 3-D digital animation using software that brings to life the legendary El Dorado, with lush colors and splendid architecture, enhanced by bold movements of machine and music by Elton John.

title: Dancer in the Dark
actors: Björk, Catherine Deneuve, Peter Stormare, David Morse
description: Selma, a young Czechoslovakian who emigrated to America and with a passion for musicals, works as an assembly line worker, lives in a seedy suburb of motorhomes, is going blind and puts away every penny to have her child operated and save him from blindness which he genetically transmitted to him and brought him into the world. Bundled up in cheap clothes, with thick lenses and the lost gaze of someone who hardly sees anymore, Selma struggles and is forced to murder when someone steals all her savings.
notes: Every noise, or chain of noises, the screech of a car, the voices and "entrances" that overlap in a process, the beating of a train on the rails or the deaf and terrified one of a heart, everything serves Selma to create before his and our eyes the dream of a cinematic life, from "All together passionately" (which acts as a "guide" to the film), to "Seven brides for seven brothers", from modernism to Bob Fosse to the vitalism of the musical Soviet 1950s, to the living homage to Jacques Demy and his "demoiselles" which is Catherine Deneuve, a very tender worker, with a clean face, almost rejuvenated. In the film (even the title is a Minnellian quote), there is an enormous pain and love, passionately intertwined in the most impossible, but for some also the most everyday of fictions: dreaming of the perfection of cinema to resist the horror of life.

title: No Code of Conduct
actors: Charlie Sheen, Mark Dacascos, Joe Estevez, Martin Sheen
description: Jacop Peterson and his partner Paul Faraci, two policemen, are on the trail of a huge amount of heroin that has just been transported across the Mexican border. What they don't know is that the drug is not only meant for the American underworld, it must also be shared among some corrupt cops. An undercover DEA agent is secretly investigating the corrupt when two of his men are found brutally murdered.
notes: Series B detective story with the Sheen family in full force. But Marc Dacascos steals the show a bit from everyone. Still not bad (of its kind).

title: Bottle Rocket
actors: Luke Wilson, Owen Wilson, Ned Dowd, Shea Fowler, Haley Miller
description: After getting out of a mental institution, Anthony catches up with his old friend Dignan (another not quite right with his head). With the help of a third sirocco, their neighbor Bob, Anthony and Dignan set out with a specific goal: to rob the former boss of one of them (Dignan), Mister Henry. On their way they meet a beautiful girl named Inez ...
notes: Picking up the plot of "Four fools in freedom", Wes Anderson and his collaborators create a story without too much bite, and above all without sufficiently incisive interpreters to be able to improve it.

title: La figliastra
actors: Sonia Jeanine, Lucretia Love, Bruno Scipioni, Nino Terzo
description: A few decades ago in Sicily there was a custom: to link the collection of a conspicuous inheritance to the demonstrations of virility. This is what happens to a widower, who for this reason risks not getting hold of a large sum of money. The man remarried but cannot have children, even if not because of his fault. It will be thanks to the intervention of his stepdaughter who will solve the situation.
notes: Film of very low value, which is reduced to an anthology of the worst common places related to Sicily. Talking about interpretation is risky. The film was released in France with the title "Veuves Excitées".

title: Lsd
actors: Guy Madison, Franca Polesello, Virginio Gazzolo
description: While tracking a suspicious individual, Officer Scila is killed. Some elements linked to counter-espionage are convinced that the crime is to be connected to the maneuvers of Eco, a criminal organization which aims to annihilate enemy armies with a powerful hallucinogen, LSD. Agent Rex Miller, a friend of Scila, infiltrates the organization with the aim of dismantling it from the inside. Thanks to his skill he manages to win the trust of Corba, one of the leaders.
notes: Low value film, which is part of the made in Italy spy films.

title: Il disordine
actors: Renato Salvatori, Curd Jürgens, Alida Valli, Jean Sorel, Louis Jourdan
description: Looking for a job in the chaotic Milan of the 1960s, the cradle of Italian neocapitalism, Mario tries to establish himself by associating with the people who matter in the upper middle-class circles: an industry tycoon, a capricious lady and a group of tormented snobs.
notes: Detaching himself from the conventions of realism and favoring an elliptical and non-linear narrative, Brusati attempts to represent the moral and social disintegration of the economic boom years in three episodes linked by the figure of the protagonist. The result is an aesthetic and discontinuous film, ambitious but not completely convincing.

title: Kippur
actors: Liron Levo, Tomer Russo, Uri Ran Klauzner, Yoram Hattab
description: It is a quiet sunny day in Haifa. It is October 6, 1973, the holiday of Yom Kippur. Suddenly the sound of a siren pierces the silence. It is war. Amos and Uzi, close friends, find themselves at any moment thrown into a hell of blood and death. The Syrian and Egyptian armed forces declared war on Israel on the day of the holiday. The two have to hurry to the headquarters where, but they still don't know it, they will be assigned to a rescue group.
notes: Amos Gitai participated in that war and shows it to us in a lucid and heartbreaking film, opened and closed by two love scenes with bodies embracing each other on a bed strewn with paint. The colored time of love and the still and infinite time of war. Gitai follows the frantic work of a team of volunteers who by helicopter rescue the wounded and take them to hospitals. Two scenes take your breath away and peace: when rescuers can't pull the stretcher with an injured person out of the mud and when the helicopter hit by a rocket crashes to the ground without the camera stop looking. Gitai forces us to stay inside the war, to watch and keep watching. No comments, no morals, no hints of any superiority over the enemy, no claim to be right. Just a sad and pitiful look on men who try to save others. They seem to know it won't be the last war.

title: Aitanic
actors: Nino D'Angelo, Sabina Began, Giacomo Rizzo, Mauro Di Francesco
description: During a strike in Naples, the family of Gaetano known as Aitano steals a ferry and organizes a replacement service. The fates of various characters converge on the ship: an unemployed man whose ex-wife wants to take the child away; a Milanese who sells expired panettone; a neo-melodic singer with fans and crew in tow.
notes: The film does not deny anything of the past and is indeed a sort of critical reinterpretation of the old films of Mariano Laurenti (which can be seen in a very intelligent cinematic meta flashback). The less convincing parts are, if anything, those in which the model of "Tano da morte" is more evident: the grotesque choreography, certain musical pieces like "Terroni dance". The citations, however, are numerous, and by no means strange: from "Forrest Gump" to "Don Camillo", from "Pretty woman" to "Bicycle thieves"; so much so that the title is both reductive and misleading. The film is not a parody, even if ten minutes from the end a guy passes by who is already selling the pirated cassettes of "Aitanic 2". It is, in its own way, a serious work, with evident lapses in rhythm (buffered in extremis by the editing by Giogiò Franchini) but several irresistible moments, and, despite its naive features, one of the most "postmodern" films ever made in Italy.

title: Les rivières pourpres
actors: Jean Reno, Vincent Cassel, Nadia Farès, Dominique Sanda
description: Haute-Savoie, area of ??Grenoble; the body of a man who died very very badly is found on the wall of a mountain. They mutilated and tortured him, keeping him alive for hours. Meanwhile, in a nearby village, the grave of a girl who died ten years earlier is desecrated. Commissioner Niémans investigates the first case, Kerkérian, the second. Soon the investigations become one, and focus on the nearby university perched in the mountains.
notes: The twists orchestrated by Kassovitz's nervous direction worsen as the film progresses. As often happens in esoteric mystical thrillers, "Rivers of Purple" is fascinating as long as the mystery looms, but falls apart as Kassovitz (following the lead from Jean-Christophe Grangé's novel) begins to explain it. The "Seven" atmosphere still holds up for three quarters of the film, thanks above all to the alpine setting and the alchemy between Reno and Cassel.

title: Controsesso
directors: Franco Rossi, Marco Ferreri, Renato Castellani
actors: Nino Manfredi, Ugo Tognazzi, Anna Maria Ferrero
description: In the second: the disturbances, perversions and terrors of a professor of the magistral. In order not to admit the attraction that his students exert on him, the old professor sets out in search of substitute objects, fetishes, such as the "comfortable" chair, a chair once used for physiological needs, which he buys in an antiques shop and then square in the classroom. It is an episode of the film Controseesso, in which Ferreri, well before Dillinger died, already takes his discourse on the impossibility of communication to its extreme consequences.

title: Nutty Professor II: The Klumps
actors: Eddie Murphy, Janet Jackson, Larry Miller, John Ales, Richard Gant
description: Shy Professor Sherman Klump is getting married and his family is delighted. Girlfriend Denise is thrilled to be his wife. But the presence of Buddy Love, Sherman's alter ego who aims to be independent, looms over the couple's future serenity. The professor was convinced that he had forever locked up Buddy in his unconscious, but he reappears in the least opportune moments.
notes: In this insipid self-celebration and revival of the myth of Jekyll and Mr. Hyde, a note of merit goes to Rick Baker, the brilliant author of special make-up effects.

title: Wonder Boys
country: United States, Great Britain, Japan, Germany
actors: Michael Douglas, Tobey Maguire, Frances McDormand, Robert Downey jr.
description: Grady Tripp is a university professor of English in his fifties and a writer in full creative crisis. Author of a best seller, for years he has been bogged down in the second, infinite novel, still unfinished on page 2611. His private life is not getting any better, quite the contrary. His wife left him and he thought about making a mistress. On his way he meets James Leer, a prodigy boy who will lead him to discover himself and a new love.
notes: A beautiful comedy, where you love the woman of others, divorce and remarry, smoke, make love between men, with the self-destructive irony of real life and the verve and psychological finesse of a great screenplay .

title: Stella Dallas
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, John Boles, Anne Shirley, Alan Hale, Marjorie Main
description: Stella Dallas, a girl from the working class, falls in love with a boy who has lost all his wealth and is reduced to work after his father's financial crash. The two get married and have a daughter. But soon the diversity of their social background begins to make itself felt and to create an ever greater gulf between them. The contrasts become incurable to the point that Stella decides to divorce. The court entrusts the child to her, but Stella realizes that the daughter feels more attached to her father and is forced to make a decision ...
notes: Remake of a 1925 silent film directed by Henry King, it is a social melodrama of which Vidor exalts the passionate side, aided by a splendid Stanwyck.

title: The Great St. Louis Bank Robbery
actors: Steve McQueen, Crahan Denton, David Clarke
description: Four bandits decide to carry out a robbery against a bank. They prepare meticulously to fine-tune the plan. A girl engaged to one of the members of the gang and sister of a criminal tries to dissuade them. Her intervention ends up irritating the gang leader who gets rid of her by killing her. The blow is scored according to the established plans. The police alerted in the meantime, engage in a shooting in which some members of the gang are killed.
notes: Modest film that follows familiar patterns and presents situations that are already abundantly exploited.

title: Things You Can Tell Just by Looking at Her
actors: Glenn Close, Cameron Diaz, Calista Flockhart, Holly Hunter
description: In the still air of the San Ferdinando Valley seven women who cannot be brides and do not seek seven brothers are the protagonists of five moments, of five incipits of new stories that are about to begin or that are already over, lightly intertwined. The seven women, no longer very young, listen from a fortune teller, a homeless woman, a teenager, a dwarf, an eighth woman who silently crosses, before dying, the path of all the others, the grain of the voice of the heart and love.
notes: Rodrigo Garcia, son of Garcia Marquez, assembles, with dry and inspired emotion the intimacy and unhappiness of his female choir, nails the camera on the very close-ups of his characters waiting, in tears, in silence, in error, in solitude. One life is insufficient to describe the discomfort, the pain, the new alienation, the anguish of being in the world. Also because every existence, like a film, is the montage of fragments that belong to others.

title: Al momento giusto
actors: Giorgio Panariello, Kasia Smutniak, Luisa Corna, Giovanni Cacioppo, Carlo Pistarino
description: Livio Perozzi is the nice journalist of a small private broadcaster. He is convinced that he has a special "twist". The results, however, are modest until the day when an exceptional scoop is in his hands: the images of the collapse of the tower of Pisa. Hired by Tg1 with his team, he has a year to get another exclusive.
notes: Panariello, comforted by the proceeds and not very satisfied with the final result of his comic debut with "Bagnomaria", faces with courage (in a lazy and asphyxiated production reality) to interpret and direct a story and not sketches, to put aside (except than in a curtain) his reassuring theatrical and television masks, to compete with a polite story that looks at the high tradition of our past. There are still naivete and structural weaknesses (the theme of the fatal woman is badly resolved, the choral nature of some scenes is only apparent, the Parisian epilogue weakens the closure), but there are also the positive symptoms of a genre cinema.

title: Controvento
actors: Margherita Buy, Valeria Golino, Ennio Fantastichini, Stefano Abbati
description: Clara works as a psychiatrist in a mental health center in Turin. Nina is a tormented actress, constantly moving between cities, affections, desires. They are two sisters. Emotional splitting and lack of affinity (one is controlled, unable to cry, reluctant to indulge in feelings, the other wastes, gets lost, "throws everything away" to get used to the idea of ??nothingness in which human beings pulverize) they have been accepted for an indefinite time, in a family where a bust and diaries remain of the dead father and a mother who has stopped asking her daughters questions. It will be a man, Leonardo who is looking for Nina and will meet Clara to establish a new contact between two split existences, between two dimensions of pain, between two fragments of a single and imperfect identity.
notes: Peter Del Monte has the great quality of knowing how to explore, with a precise direction of the three good actors, the nuances, the whirlpools, the psychological adhesions of the female characters. His direction and his narration do not fear the discomfort and suffering, the unspoken things and the black holes of the soul. Between suspensions and intensity of images.

title: Hua yang nian hua
actors: Tony Leung Chiu Wai, Maggie Cheung, Lai Chen, Rebecca Pan, Paulyn Sun
description: A man and a woman in Hong Kong, in 1963: story of the brief backward encounters between Chow Mo-Wan and Su Li-zhen, neighbors who accidentally discover that their respective spouses are lovers and stage, as in a rehearsal, their respective revelations. They meet, they wonder what the other two are doing, they talk as if they were talking to them, they watch each other go away, and inevitably without ever saying it, they end up loving each other.
notes: "In the Mood of Love" is not only the most beautiful film by Wong Kar-wai (where the two souls of his cinema, the intimate and romantic one and the one that observes meticulous places and environments, merge in filigree), but it is also a a timeless masterpiece of cinema built on the voids, on the blacks that flow between one scene and another, on the expectations, on the ellipses that fill a life. We hear the thoughts and emotions that grow between one meeting and another, the words that the protagonists do not say to each other, the flow of history that erases the world. That Hong Kong is gone, delivered, like every secret that really matters, from Wong Kar-wai to the film, which will forever give us back the evanescent ankles of Maggie Cheung, the subtle passion in Tony Leung's eyes, the warm melancholy of Nat King Cole singing "Quizàs, quizàs, quizàs".

title: Ride with the Devil
actors: Tobey Maguire, Skeet Urich, Jewel, Jeffrey Wright, Jonathan Rhys Meyers
description: Civil War. While fighting at the front, the Bushwhackers, sympathizers of the Confederates who remained in the territories of the Union, participated in a guerrilla war in the northern rear lines along the border between Kansas and Missouri. It is in one of these commandos that Jake Roedel, the son of a poor German emigrant and Jack Bull Chiles, the son of a plantation owner, give their best as gunslingers by carrying out lightning-fast raids against the Northerners. Soon the two mavericks will join Black John's gang.
notes: What a Taiwanese filmmaker does on the set of a western is irrelevant. Ang Lee proves to be a "professional" with a decent craft, with few revolutionary ideas. He is interested in sentimental implications, and also in this film he tries to concentrate on the love games of the young children of the South, stimulated by the lively Jewel. But in Italy the film arrived scissored by about twenty minutes (after the US flop) and probably the torments of the heart were affected. A little better the coté of genre, with rides and shootings.
