Disappointing the performers (with the exception of Jonathan Rhys Meyers), with faces too "clean" to be true. If Wild Bill Hickok (nordist) had met some "irregular" like this, they would have had a bad quarter of an hour. The last one.

title: Tutto suo padre
actors: Enrico Montesano, Marilù Prati, Cristiano Censi, Manfred Freyberger
description: On the death of his mother Adolfo who works in a Roman pizzeria and who, in his spare time works as an extra in Cinecittà, he learns that he is Hitler's natural son. A German multinational that would like to restore the Nazi regime hires him to revive the figure of the dictator. Adolfo, who is educated in neo-neo ideologies, however, rebels with all his might against the crazy project.
notes: The idea of ??bringing the figure of Hitler to the screen in a comic way is not new. To impersonate the son of the dictator this time there is Montesano and the results are disheartening.

title: The Sergeant
actors: Rod Steiger, John Phillip Law, Ludmila Mikael, Frank Latimore
description: Sergeant Callan, a career non-commissioned officer in the US Army and decorated with many medals for his acts of heroism in war, is sent by his superiors to a camp located in France. Having always lived in the army and accustomed to strict military discipline, since his arrival, he imposes strict discipline. Soldiers accustomed to laxity can't stand Callan's rules. Tom, a gentle and shy-looking soldier arouses the particular interest of Callan who has him transferred to his office.
notes: The film is based on a novel by Dennis Murphy. The figure of the repressed homosexual is well rendered by Rod Steiger.

title: Miss Monday
actors: James Hicks, Julie Alannagh-Brighten, Andrea Hart, Alex Giannini
description: An English screenwriter is in a professional crisis because he can't write a decent film story. Among other things, he has big problems focusing on the female character of the plot he is writing, and at night he often has nightmares that do not allow him to work quietly. So the writer goes in search of his Miss Monday, a career woman who would allow him to come out at least temporarily from the crisis of inspiration ...
notes: The proof of the two main interpreters is good, just as the psychological notations are really good, which are never banal.

title: Passi di morte perduti nel buio
actors: Vera Krouska, Antonio Maimone, Leonard Mann, Barbara Seidel
description: A murder is committed in a compartment of the Athens-Thessaloniki express while the convoy was in the tunnel. The travelers did not have time to put a face to the killer because he took steps to eliminate the lighting inside the carriage. What remains in the hands of the police is the woman's body and a letter opener belonging to an Italian photographer, Luciano Morelli. The agents of the Greek police withdraw Luciano's passport, deeming him guilty of the crime. But Luciano does not give up and investigates the people present in the convoy.
notes: Crime film that lacks rhythm and suspense.

title: Meglio vedova
actors: Peter McEnery, Virna Lisi, Gabriele Ferzetti, Lando Buzzanca, Carla Calò
description: Tom, a young Milanese engineer, arrives in a town in Sicily to study the possibility of building an oil refinery. The local mafia immediately appears divided. On the one hand, the faction headed by Baron Misceni tries by all means to hinder the initiate, while the group linked to Don Calogero tries to have the project carried out. But Tom falls in love with Don Calogero's daughter, arousing the ire of Misceni who has her kidnapped. At this point the girl is compromised and must marry the baron. The wedding is celebrated, but on leaving the church ...
notes: Modest comedy that mildly makes fun of some Sicilian costumes.

title: Lettera aperta a un giornale della sera
actors: Nanni Loy, Silverio Blasi, Daniele Dublino, Mariella Palmich
description: At the end of an evening spent in the home of a left-wing publisher, an industrialist whose factory is self-managed by the workers, launches his friends the idea of ??sending a letter to the editor of a left-wing newspaper, asking to participate in the Vietnam war . Contrary to all predictions, the newspaper does not publish it, but the letter still appears on the pages of a weekly. The initiative of the friends of the industrialist expands to obtain adhesions even from abroad even from Hanoi. Not being able to pull back the group of friends is forced to leave.
notes: Francesco Maselli follows his friends caught in long discussions.

title: The Break Up
actors: Bridget Fonda, Penelope Ann Miller, Kiefer Sutherland, Hart Bochner
description: Jimmy, despite her name, is a pretty girl who, to her misfortune, is married to Frankie, a bad guy who not only beats her regularly, but cheats on her. One bad day, her husband sends her to the hospital. Soon after, Frankie is found, charred, in his car, ended up in a ditch. Detective Box does not believe in the girl's guilt and wants to see clearly.
notes: Thriller without infamy and without praise, with a not too original story, slightly stereotypical characters and a fugitive direction. However, the film as a genre work allows itself to be seen. Appearance of Tippi Hedren as Bridget Fonda's mother.

title: X-Men
actors: Patrick Stewart, Ian McKellen, Halle Berry, Rebecca Romijn, Hugh Jackman, Famke Janssen
description: In the not too distant future, mankind has undergone genetic mutations that have given some individuals special powers. The mutants are at Doctor Xavier's school to learn how to measure their strength. But under the orders of the evil Magneto, another group of mutants has decided to fight a fight without quarter.
notes: The "X-Men" created in the 1960s by Stan Lee for Marvel Comics contained many ideas that could be transferred to a post-Blade Runner universe in which superpowered replicants have found a controversial right of citizenship. Singer's film starts well, with a background in a Nazi concentration camp, with the shock of the teenager Rogue and his journey, with the face to face between the Professor and Magneto. But then he focuses on yet another show of special effects. All that remains is to regret Tim Burton's lush and pained fantasy.

title: Coyote Ugly
actors: Piper Perabo, Adam Garcia, John Goodman, Maria Bello, Tyra Banks, Izabella Miko, Bridget Moynahan, Melanie Lynskey, Michael Weston, LeAnn Rimes, Bud Cort
description: Violet has a big dream to fulfill, to become a songwriter. With great patience he goes around all the record companies without even getting an audition. Violet is forced to look for a job in order to pay her rent. One evening while she is in a restaurant she meets a cook who offers to help her. The guy finds her a bartender job at Coyote Ugly where the girls serving at the bar seduce customers in search of excitement. Influenced by the atmosphere of the Violet club, it soon became one of the most requested attractions.
notes: The hormonal energy of the films produced by Jerry Bruckheimer changes sex and focuses, this time, on women. The screenwriters and the director, a rookie, quote and copy with ease, imposing an accelerated and light-hearted pace.

title: Hollow Man
actors: Kevin Bacon, Elisabeth Shue, Josh Brolin, Kim Dickens, William Devane
description: For the United States Army, Dr. Sebastian Cain is doing experiments. His studies are aimed at discovering a serum capable of making invisible. After trying the discovery on animals Sebastian thinks that the time has come to test the effectiveness of the serum on his own person. The results are astounding. The scientist who has become invisible also begins to undergo a dangerous change of character.
notes: Dutchman Paul Verhoeven dusts off a classic science fiction figure. As he continues to be a bit frustrated by his situation as a former author in the service of Hollywood, the good Paul tries the philosophical-intellectual interpretation. But the goal he had set himself completely fails.

title: Placido Rizzotto
actors: Marcello Mazzarella, Vincenzo Albanese, Carmelo Di Mazzarelli
description: Placido Rizzotto observes his bitter Corleone from above. Scan those roofs and those streets and look beyond to a future that will be denied him. From that utopia, from that fight against the mafia and against the feudal rules imposed by the landowners, which, for him, are a duty, an emotion, a will in the form of politics. The secretary of the Chamber of Labor, who fought against the mafia that strangles the peasants, is a tragic hero and goes to death with the awareness of those who know the names of all the dead and all the executioners. He will disappear on the evening of 10 March 1948 and his body will never be found.
notes: A very beautiful film that removes the news and the characters from realism, the television investigation and the tradition of civil cinema. The narrative cadence is that of the fable, of the oral story, of the dramaturgical heritage of storytellers, of an existence enclosed in small paintings, of sequences that do not reveal or explain a life, but represent it, of the barren and majestic landscapes, of the interiors in which two generations (fathers and sons, old and new mafia) face each other without understanding each other, of lacerating scenes and poetic abandonments.

title: The House of Mirth
actors: Gillian Anderson, Dan Aykroyd, Eleanor Bron, Terry Kinney, Anthony La Paglia, Eric Stoltz, Laura Linney, Jodhi May, Elizabeth McGovern, Penny Downie, Pearce Quigley, Helen Coker, Mary MacLeod, Paul Venables, Serena Gordon
description: Lily Barth, in New York at the beginning of the century, cultivates a dream, to become part of the high society. Contested by some wealthy suitor, it does not accept compromises of any kind. To achieve what she wants she does not intend to sell herself and does not stoop to the intrigues of her friends. She needs to bond with an important man. Instead, the man she loves is a penniless lawyer. So full of debt, Lily is forced to ask her best friend's husband for help.
notes: The Englishman Terence Davies is inspired by Edith Wharton's novel "The House of Mirth" for an exercise in flawless but not incisive style. Of course the sequence shots and the relationship between the spaces are interesting, but Scorsese and his "The Age of Innocence" remain an unattainable model for everyone.

title: Before Night Falls
actors: Javier Bardem, Olivier Martinez, Sean Penn, Johnny Depp, Hector Babenco
description: Reynaldo Arenas is a boy of just fourteen when he is taught by the Castro authorities to revolutionary ideas. His dream is to become a great writer. His efforts are rewarded and at the age of twenty he manages to publish his first novel. An outspoken homosexual and anti-Castro will take advantage of Fidel Castro's amnesty which allowed gay, mentally ill and ex-prisoners to leave the island to flee to the United States. But even in the land of freedom he will have problems.
notes: In Schnabel's very flat film, only the exteriority of Arenas's life remains, not his vitality, and not even the functioning of a political-intellectual regime. Why Schnabel wanted this film remains a real mystery: it flattens the character and the writer, flattens politics and history, tragedy and Cuban contradictions. The cameos of Penn and Depp do not redeem him, and neither does the good interpretation of Javier Bardem.

title: Malèna
actors: Monica Bellucci, Giuseppe Sulfaro, Luciano Federico, Daniele Arena
description: Maddalena, known by all as Malèna, with her beauty and sensuality disturbs the inhabitants of a small town in Sicily. We are in the course of the Second World War and Renato Amoroso is a thirteen year old with great imagination. For him Malèna is from time to time the pupa of the gangster, the beautiful little woman who peeps from barber calendars, Jane in search of her Tarzan. Meanwhile, the woman lives the parable of her existence passing from wife to widow to prostitute.
notes: Tornatore's film is nothing more than a prolonged commercial. History is non-existent, Bellucci is static. After 5 good opening minutes, the style wraps between dolly and a total absence of eroticism, with some atrocious scenes (the beating of Malèna).

title: Basil
actors: Christian Slater, Jared Leto, Claire Forlani, Crispin Bonham-Carter
description: Basil falls in love with Julia, a charming woman with a mysterious attitude, but from a low social background. With the help of his friend John, Basil secretly marries Julia, unaware that she holds a terrible secret. When the truth finally comes out, Basil's marriage goes into crisis. The groom, disinherited by his father, is alone and without a penny. At this point Basil realizes that he has been involved in a plan devised by John, determined to take revenge on his family which he holds responsible for the death of his loved ones. One day Julia gives birth to a baby girl ...

title: The Trial of Old Drum
actors: Bobby Edner, Scott Bakula, Troy Evans, Dick Martin, Alexis O'Keefe
description: 11-year-old Charlie Burden, raised on a Missouri farm, spends all his summers helping his father run their farm. The boy is accompanied by Old Drum, a splendid specimen of Labrador, and one day the boy's life is turned upside down by the news that some sheep from the flock of Uncle Lon, the neighboring farmer, have been killed. Man looking for a culprit accuses Old Drum. Charlie will try in every way to prove his dog's innocence, even going so far as to ask for help from one of the most famous lawyers in the city.

title: This Happy Feeling
actors: Curd Jürgens, Debbie Reynolds, Troy Donahue, John Saxon, Alexis Smith
description: Janet, a simple but not stupid girl falls in love with Preston, a former Broadway actor, who, having retired from the stage, now lives on a farm in Connecticut. The girl feels particularly attracted to his personality and his "European" ways. But it happens that Bill, a neighbor of Preston, falls in love with Janet.
notes: The film falls short of Edwards' best performance and served for the American launch of Curd Jürgens.

title: Orions Belte
actors: Helge Jordal, Sverre Anker Ousdal, Hans Ola Sorlie
description: Tom, Larse and Sverre are three Norwegian friends who own a boat rental on an island in the North Sea. Among the "tourists" who want to visit the fjords, however, there is one who behaves in a really strange way. He is a Russian spy that the three manage to locate and try to stop.
notes: Dated adventure film that precedes the fall of the Wall.

title: Paradis perdu
actors: Micheline Presle, Fernand Gravey, André Alerme, Gérard Landry
description: A painter enlisted to fight during the Second World War learns that his wife has died giving birth to a girl. After overcoming the shock, the artist devotes himself with love to the education of the little girl. When the daughter has grown up, she will support her sentimental choices.
notes: One of Abel Gance's most successful films.

title: Escape from Sobibor
actors: Alan Arkin, Joanna Pacula, Rutger Hauer, Hartmut Becker, Jack Shepherd
description: Poland, October 1943. A group of three hundred deportees locked up in the Sobibor concentration camp managed to escape by making fun of the terrible guardians of the SS.
notes: The film, based on an actual episode, is based on a book by Richard Rashke. Exteriors in Yugoslavia with the advice of some survivors.

title: The Palm Beach Story
actors: Mary Astor, Claudette Colbert, Joel McCrea, Rudy Valee
description: Gerry decides to divorce her husband so as not to weigh financially. She then sets off on a trip to the Palm Beach, meeting several people willing to help her: the "king of salamis", the members of the "moose club" and a shy billionaire, even willing to marry her. But then comes her husband, whom she introduces as her brother, and ...
notes: Preston Sturges creates a real pearl of the screwball comedy, aided by the verve of Clauette Colbert. At first glance a funny game designed to make people laugh, but digging results in an unusual and acute satire against the sentimental conventions of Hollywood and an irreverent arrow to shoot, with joy, against the myths of "good America" ??(work and family).

title: Lo zio di Brooklyn
actors: Salvatore Gattuso, Pippo Augusta, Salvatore Schiera, Gaspare Marchione, Francesco Arnao, Antonino Bruno, Rosario Carollo, Pietro Rizzo, Natale Lauria, Luigi Cinà, Bruno Di Benedetto, Salvatore Farina, Umberto Fiorulli, Pietro Giordano, Giovanni Gucciardi
description: The Gemelli family is made up of his father Gaetano, his three children, his paraplegic nephew with some mental problems. The family group lives in a Palermo that seems to have escaped the end of the world. The three children returning from their father's funeral meet two dwarves, bosses of the mafia. The two individuals announce to them that they will have to host a strange individual in the house, the Brooklyn uncle. Gemini cannot refuse hospitality to such a character who, once inside the house, does not eat, speak or sleep.
notes: The authors of Cinico Tv make their debut with an apocalyptic and devastating film. In Luca Bigazzi's black and white, in an abstract and inhuman Palermo, scraps of humanity wander around to mimic a pantomime that alludes to Catholic symbolism. An indigestible and unpleasant film, but also one of the few visionary experiences of Italian cinema at the end of the century.

title: L'ultima chance
actors: Ursula Andress, Fabio Testi, Barbara Bach, Massimo Girotti
description: A jewelry thief happens what he never expected: hiding in a motel after a successful heist, he is in turn robbed by the owner's handsome nephew. A deadly mechanism is therefore triggered that claims numerous victims even among people unrelated to the affair. Yellow all'italiana with an international cast wasted by the direction not to the height

title: La stagione dei sensi
actors: Ugo Adinolfi, Laura Belli, Edda Di Benedetto, Udo Kier, Andreina Paul
description: Summer is ending and four girls and two boys are taking a trip. Running out of petrol, they take refuge in an ancient castle. In the manor lives Luca who has just strangled his lover by throwing her body into a well.
notes: More foolish than psychedelic, a film so dated as to be almost a relic. Music by Morricone.

title: Iron Eagle IV
actors: Louis Gossett jr., Jason Cadieux, Joanne Vannicola, Max Piersig
description: A former pilot who served in the United States Army has now taken his leave and is reduced to being a gas station attendant. Despite his natural distrust, the ex-soldier is persuaded to open a flight school for unsavory people ...
notes: Coming to the fourth episode, the series begins to show the rope.

title: Flowers for Algernon
actors: Matthew Modine, Bonnie Bedelia, Ron Rifkin, Kelli Williams
description: Charlie is a delayed young man whose life, due to his handicap, is certainly not easy. When he does not work in the bakery where he is employed and where he is forced to undergo the cruel jokes of his colleagues, Charlie attends a teaching course held by Alice. Charlie is unable to write or read, but her character inhares Alice, who decides to bring Charlie to Dr. Strauss's clinic to check if there is the possibility of improving her intelligence quotient. The doctor submits Charlie to an experimental surgery that should develop patient learning skills. The operation is successful, but ...

title: The List
actors: Ryan O'Neal, Mädchen Amick, Ben Gazzara, Romano Orzari
description: Judge Richard Miller finds himself in a rather precarious position when he is assigned the presidency of the trial of Gabrielle Michelle, a high-profile prostitute. The latter, who has planned her arrest so that she can blackmail her most well-known and wealthy clients, gives Miller a list and a compromising videotape. The judge is cornered: on the one hand he is required to make information public, thereby destroying the reputation and careers of esteemed colleagues; on the other hand he is tempted to keep the secret, but by doing so he risks being prosecuted ...

title: Deadly Outbreak
actors: Jeff Speakman, Ron Silver, Rochelle Swanson, Jack Adalist
description: A terrorist commando led by Colonel Baron has taken over an Israeli laboratory where biochemical devices are developed. Baron's aim is to get his hands on a new secret weapon designed by Dr. Levin. Dutton Hatfield, of the American Embassy, ??is in charge of backing her up.

title: Circus of Horrors
actors: Anton Diffring, Jane Hylton, Kenneth Griffith, Erika Remberg
description: Doctor Rassiter, specialized in cosmetic surgery, after a failed operation, to escape arrest, flees to France. During the escape he suffers an accident that disfigures his face. Rassiter manages to have an operation and regain a new face. After the operation, he changes his name, calls himself Bernard Schuler and becomes the owner of a famous circus throughout Europe. The artists who perform are people wanted by the police to whom Rassiter has changed his face. At some point in the circus strange incidents occur ...
notes: Disturbing film in which the sadism of Doctor Rassiter emerges to which Anton Diffring gives the face.

title: The Onion Field
actors: James Woods, Franklyn Seales, John Savage, Ted Danson
description: Jimmy, a thief just out of prison, goes to see Billy, a black friend, to ask him for money. He finds him in the company of Greg who offers him to join a new gang. Determined to make a consistent shot Jimmy and Greg, abandoned by Billy who smells of trouble, are wandering through the night when they are stopped for regular inspection by a police patrol. Greg loses his head, points the gun at the ribs of one of the two agents, forces the two to keep the onions in a nearby field. Here a murder takes place ...
notes: The film scripted by the director is based on a true story.

title: The Replacements
actors: Keanu Reeves, Gene Hackman, Jon Favreau, Brooke Langton
description: In Washington D.C., the Sentinels team is paralyzed by the players' strike, so the president calls an old coach into service and instructs him to put together a team of replacements, capable of making it to the playoffs. Sumo wrestlers, former footballers, cops, convicts, bouncers, find themselves together on the pitch, led by former quarterback Shane Falco, surrounded by the affection of the cheerleaders.
notes: Comedy that takes its cue from the strike of professional NFL players in 1987. The fragility of B movie becomes a strong point and with actors like Hackman and Reeves, a flowing comedy, the soft core choreographic pictures of the cheerleaders, a love story between the beautiful Keanu and the revelation Brooke Langton and the rousing music of Gloria Gaynor and the Rolling Stones, the film ensures almost two hours of healthy and vulgar fun.

title: Estate romana
actors: Rossella Or, Monica Nappo, Salvatore Sansone, Victor Cavallo
description: Rome, Esquilino, summer. Rossella returns to Rome after years of absence and returns to her home, rented to her friend the set designer Salvatore. The woman is prey to an obvious depression and wanders around the city that she does not recognize and does not recognize her anymore. People have changed and Rossella can't find anyone able to answer the obsessive question that has been bothering her for some time: "How can I disappear?"
notes: Rossella is a Virgilian guide, who leads us through lives that adapt with difficulty to the wear and tear of modern life and theater is the figure that unites them: Rossella is a former actress, Salvatore lazily builds theatrical sets, and Monica is his assistant. . A gigantic cosmic theatrical scenography, with a large globe in the center, becomes the navel of Salvatore and Monica's world, but the clients do not like the work and a funny tour of the city and the coast begins, with the globe tied on the roof of a 'car. Garrone thus embarks on a fruitful journey into an unknown Rome, where the melting pot is a precarious but possible dimension of everyday life. A special mention for the actors and in particular for the suffered and dreamy Rossella Or who, with the cameo by Victor Cavallo, is a dutiful homage to the legendary "Beat 72".

title: Frequency
actors: Dennis Quaid, Jim Caviezel, Elizabeth Mitchell, Noah Emmerich
description: John would gladly erase the events that occurred on October 12, 1969 when his father, a heroic firefighter, lost his life in the Bruxton fire. Since then, John has dreamed of being able to go back in time and avoid that bad death for his parent. Now thanks to a radio he might be able to get in touch with the past.
notes: "Frequency" has the flavor of those films of yesteryear, fantastic without special effects, with B movie faces, fallen stars (Quaid), eternal promises (Caviezel), and a team game that makes the story solid and pleasant. The epilogue is cloying, but we get over it. Hoblit (director of "Hill Street Day and Night") likes to work on the characters, with the camera at eye level. All things that make him nice to us.

title: Bibo per sempre
actors: Teo Teocoli, Anna Galiena, Luis Sepúlveda, Marco Della Noce
description: Bibo Cedrelli is a television personality, popular for his imitations and disguises. He has a beautiful wife, three daughters, a middle-class house and a gray life as a telepromotion clerk. A star shaped by the aesthetics of TV, by the share, by the listening curve, enriched by advertisers to please and bored by monoscope managers to obey. In the street where Bibo lives, there is also a homeless man. Bibo is in an artistic and existential crisis and for a few days he risks a drift.
notes: The film is ugly and dull. Teocoli continues to miss the appointment with the cinema. The direction is from the fall of sugars, the gags announced more than phone calls.

title: Merci pour le chocolat
actors: Isabelle Huppert, Jacques Dutronc, Anna Mouglalis, Rodolphe Pauly
description: André Polonski, famous and celebrated pianist, and Mika Muller, president of the Muller chocolate industry are getting married for the second time. Years earlier the concert performer had married Lisbeth with whom he had a son Guillame and who had died following a car accident. Jeanne who learns by pure chance that she was exchanged at the moment of birth with a Guillame enters the life of André to discover the truth.
notes: Every so often the miracle of seeing a beautiful, flawless, unassailable film still happens. This honor went to the former enfant terrible of the Nouvelle Vague Claude Chabrol, who puts his cinephile knowledge (Lang, Hitcock and Renoir) on the screen with great elegance and without a minimum of self-satisfaction. The suspense grows minute by minute, the story envelops and intrigues, the actors are extraordinary, the fun is guaranteed. And all without the need for special effects for fools and an exasperated star system: just a few environments, suggestions, atmospheres, imperceptible glances are enough. Only one regret: if Claude Chabrol hadn't been on the jury in Venice in 2000, nobody would have taken the Golden Lion away from him.

title: Bionic Ever After?
actors: Lindsay Wagner, Anne Lockhart, Lee Majors, Richard Anderson, Martin E. Brooks
description: The marriage between Steve Austin and Jaime Sommers is put in serious danger by the fact that the bionic woman has contracted a terrible virus.
notes: The protagonists of the television series "La donna bionica" are back, which aired in America from January 1976 to September 1978, first on the ABC and Nbc television stations.

title: No Alibi
actors: Dean Cain, Eric Roberts, Lexa Doig, Peter Stebbings, Richard Chevolleau
description: Boob has an exceptional nose for business and a great success with women. Unfortunately, he has one flaw: he looks strikingly like Phil, the brother of Vic Haddock, an unscrupulous gangster. Even more serious is that Vic, seeing him, believes that he is really his brother. The boss is desperate for Phil who, among other things, owes him a large amount of money: but the story gets even more complicated when Phil - namely Bob - falls in love with the woman Vic has his eyes on. ...
notes: Thriller for TV discreetly directed by Pittman, director of _Prom Night 2: the return_ and _Do not enter that house 2_.

title: Teste di cocco
actors: Alessandro Gassmann, Gian Marco Tognazzi, Manuela Arcuri, Marco Messeri, Philippe Leroy
description: Will our heroes be able to find their father who has mysteriously disappeared in Asia? This is the doubt that assails the Tiraboschi brothers when they discover that in the coffin of their father, who died twenty years earlier in Malaysia, there is only sand. The two knives brothers thus set out on the trail of the reckless parent, who sowed widows and children, even in Malaysia.
notes: Although the screenplay by De Bernardi and Benvenuti echoes a distant comic cinema, the film sinks into the unnecessarily noisy and cynical comedy of the duo Gassman-Tognazzi.

title: Tandem
actors: Luca Bizzarri, Paolo Kessisoglu, Maddalena Maggi, Fabrizia Sacchi
description: Luca is only twenty-three years old and has an unbridled passion for grunge music. His favorite pastime is playing in a group in a Murazzi club in Turin. Camilla is a girl of good society enrolled in the law and with a secret dream, to become a constitutionalist. One night the two boys meet and, despite being the opposite of the other, they fall in love. Seven years later Luca and Camilla are in crisis. What to do to try to get out of it? Go to a psychologist who suggests therapy for them.
notes: The start is sprint, but shortness of breath does not even reach halfway. The performers are good, but the film doesn't bite like (perhaps) the authors aspired.

title: Quello che le ragazze non dicono
actors: Irene Ferri, Carlotta Miti, Martina Colombari, Vincenzo Peluso
description: Francesca, Alice, Paola and Laura are four girls who live in the hectic Milan. Friends have always had a habit they cannot give up: they see each other every week in a restaurant and confide in each other the little facts about their work, their families and their loves. Then Gigi enters their life, a likeable but penniless musician whom all four will fall in love with.
notes: The film is the metropolitan summary of a sentimental education without the harshness or the ironic and salutary treachery of the Vanzinas. The two brothers show that they have inherited the noble and ancient techniques of the cinematographic craftsmanship of father Steno.

title: Il partigiano Johnny
actors: Stefano Dionisi, Fabrizio Gifuni, Andrea Prodan, Chiara Muti, Claudio Amendola
description: After 8 September Johnny, a student of English literature, returns to Alba. Since he is a deserter he is forced to hide in a small house near the city. Johnny is convinced of the need to fight fascism, he just doesn't know how and, above all, with whom. His Anglophile background does not allow him to join the nascent communist gangs. Johnny leaves alone for the hills of the Langhe and joins the first group he meets. In a short time Johnny learns that the life of the partisan is not all that romantic ...
notes: The Resistance is a place of memory and of the Italian political conflict that suggests a position: praise, denial, demystification? War is too strong and sedimented a subject and special effects, technology have transformed it into a rich and aseptic genre. The director who opened his fictional investigation on those years of Italian history with "Il Case Martello" and did so using the anchor of the present, this time, bringing Beppe Fenoglio's book to the screen, he descends into the flow of those seasons, of those enthusiasms, of those contradictions and wants to escape the legend, make a film that runs as fast as the thoughts of the protagonist and like the legs of his companions when they want to escape death. A courageous and important film, despite the flaws and some falls.

title: Rules of Engagement
actors: Tommy Lee Jones, Samuel L. Jackson, Guy Pearce, Philip Baker Hall
description: Terry Childers, a Marine Colonel who fought in Vietnam, participated in military actions in Beirut and was involved in the war against Iraq, has come under fire. Called to free the American embassy in Yemen to create an opening, he fired on the crowd, killing unarmed civilians. As defense lawyer, the officer chose Colonel Hodges, whose life he had saved during a war action in Vietnam.
notes: For three-quarters of the film Friedkin remains ambiguous, effectively describing the conflict between military logic and political logic. Then, when he marries a thesis, it leads to an ending dripping with nationalism and ideology. Probably the fault of Stephen Graghan's script, too pro-Marines. Much on the cliché Jackson and Jones rehearsals. A film in which the only amazing thing is the direction, well served by the photography of the veteran William Fraker (assisted by the Italian Nicola Pecorini).

title: Benvenuto, onorevole!
actors: Mario Riva, Riccardo Billi, Memmo Carotenuto, Scilla Gabel
description: The inhabitants of the hamlet of Cerchiano complain about the lack of the cemetery. Tanino, also moved by the hope of obtaining an economic advantage, goes to the city to an honorable native of the place to obtain the land. But there is a problem the mortality in the fraction does not reach the minimum prescribed percentage: on balance there is one dead person missing. The disappointed inhabitants are waiting for the death of some octogenarians, but everyone in the village shows that they are in excellent health. Then one day the honorable member arrives in the village for a meeting ...
notes: Although there is no lack of quite successful sequences, the film indulges in an easy and mannered humor.

title: Nada
actors: Fabio Testi, Lou Castel, Mariangela Melato, Michel Duchaussoy
description: Bonaventura Diaz, a Spanish anarchist, together with four comrades, organizes and carries out the kidnapping of the American ambassador in Paris. The ransom requested by the group, ten million, is used to finance the revolution. The kidnappers choose a country house as a refuge. The four do not know that they were filmed by counterintelligence.
notes: Chabrol directs a film that offers a certain dramatic tension. But in the long run, history reveals the artifices and the rhythm gives way. I>

title: I Walk the Line
actors: Gregory Peck, Tuesday Weld, Estelle Parsons, Ralph Meeker
description: Tennessee, deep south of the United States. An uninhibited young woman, the daughter of a smuggler, makes the sheriff of a remote country village lose his head. The man senses the danger of ridicule, but he cannot do without the woman, sly and shrewd, aware of her own attractiveness. The portrait of rural America is good and, for country fans, there are five songs by Johnny Cash.
notes: An autumn Gregory Peck and a Tuesday Weld at the height of beauty. Slow, but as films were "slow" thirty years ago, that is, "introspective", full of silences, edited like life.

title: A Little Princess
actors: Liesel Matthews, Eleanor Bron, Liam Cunningham, Rusty Schwimmer
description: When her father leaves for the front during the First World War, little Sara moves to New York to go to boarding school. Here it clashes with the strict rules imposed by the director Miss Minchin ...
notes: A film created and packaged especially for the younger audience. If you are satisfied, it does not disappoint.

title: Almost Blue
actors: Lorenza Indovina, Andrea Di Stefano, Claudio Santamaria, Dario D'Ambrosio
description: There is a serial killer who also wanders in Bologna, one of the strange ones, who kill, strip naked and contemplate their crimes listening to noisily sinister music through headphones. In spite of the ferocity and the quantity of repeated crimes, only a few hunt him down, even if one of these is an inspector of the Violent Crimes Analysis Unit, a kind of super-police where, among others, he commands a very unpleasant character who speaks as if in a comic without irony.
notes: The first film to be derived from the prolific verve of the crime novelist Carlo Lucarelli is more of a TV pilot than a big screen film.

title: Himalaya - L'enfance d'un chef
actors: Thilen Lhondup, Lhakpa Tsamchoe, Gurgon Kyap, Karma Wangel
description: Among the bold, sublime and bare peaks of Dolpo, in an isolated village, lives a community of peasants who, in order to survive, must undertake a long journey every year to exchange salt for the grain of a village on the plains. Old Tinlé has lost his firstborn and does not want to leave Karma in charge of the caravan.
notes: Flahertyan documentary and ethnographic reportage. Photographic and anthropological investigation on the top of the world. The conflict between father and children and the disobedience that prepares a man to be the future leader. These are some of the narrative and formal figures that innervate the realistic fairy tale filmed by the photographer-explorer Valli.

title: The Watcher
actors: James Spader, Keanu Reeves, Marisa Tomei, Ernie Hudson
description: Joe Campbell is a sleepless, psychoanalyzed ex-cop at fault for the usual unsaved victim. Moving to Chicago, he is targeted by the serial killer he had followed for years. He challenges him, sends him photos of women and gives him 24 hours to identify them, after which he will kill them. Needless to say, detective and murderer are mirrors ...
notes: Pale copy of "Seven", from which it also inherits the idea of ??the metropolis as hell. They bring up the gaze - murder as beautiful art - the panopticon - the blowup - and off with metacinemando, but then it's shot like a drugged show.

title: Giulietta e Romeo
actors: Laurence Harvey, Susan Shentall, Mervyn Jones, Flora Robson
description: Romeo Montecchi and Giulietta Capuleti love each other even though they belong to two families that have always hated each other. Not knowing how to crown their dream of love, the two lovers get married in secret. Tragedy inevitably breaks out when the Capulets want to give a husband to Juliet. To try to resolve the situation, a friar advises the girl to drink a potion capable of giving her an apparent death. Romeo will arrive at the moment of awakening so that he can escape with his sweetheart.
notes: Castellani for his film refers to the pictorial tradition of the Italian fifteenth century. In 1954 he won the Golden Lion at the Venice Film Festival.

title: Where Is Parsifal?
actors: Donald Pleasence, Tony Curtis, Christopher Chaplin, Orson Welles
description: A penniless and hypochondriac inventor Parsifal Katzenellenbogen, he lives with his artist wife who loves to surround himself with eccentric characters. The scientist never suits one. His alleged inventions are unsuccessful and debts begin to besiege him. Until someone realizes that his latest idea seems to work perfectly.
notes: A dizzying pace for a very agitated film. Defining acting confused would be an over-compliment. Needless to say, the most eccentric of all is Orson Welles who died two years later. Tony Curtis is the inventor with an unpronounceable name.

title: O Brother, Where Art Thou?
actors: George Clooney, John Turturro, Tim Blake Nelson, John Goodman, Charles Durning, Michael Badalucco, Holly Hunter, Stephen Root, Chris Thomas King, Wayne Duvall, Daniel von Bargen, Frank Collison, J.R. Horne, Brian Reddy
description: Everett Ulysses McGill escaped from prison because he wants to get his hands on the swag he says he hid. They follow him, or rather, they are forced to follow him because they are linked by a single chain: Pete and Delmar. The America of the Great Depression accompanies the three inmates to a treasure that seems increasingly unlikely ...
notes: Someone said "Brother, where are you?" is a minor film by the Coens. But what is minor or major in their apparently distracted world, where the sloppy Lebowski ends up being more "hero" than the pensive Barton Fink? Here is a sense of the country's "music" (at least, as it was) and the endless "legendary" possibilities of the dumber common man that is priceless. With laughter at the cinema, the Coens pay homage to the great Preston Sturges and "The Forgotten".

title: Loser
actors: Jason Biggs, Mena Suvari, Zak Orth, Greg Kinnear, Thomas Sadoski
description: Paul, a boy from a small provincial town, wins a scholarship to New York. In the crowd of fashionable students of the Big Apple, he immediately feels uneasy. As if that weren't enough, Dora - the girl of his dreams - only has eyes for the professor ...
notes: Romantic comedy about alleged losers who reverses roles.

title: The Art of War
actors: Wesley Snipes, Anne Archer, Maury Chaykin, Donald Sutherland
description: Neil Shaw is an American agent who has the task of uncovering and disrupting an international conspiracy that aims to destroy the United Nations on the eve of the historic summit with China. The murder of some Chinese political refugees for whom Shaw is blamed forces him to go underground.
notes: The late Bondian spy film updates to the new geopolitics in a somewhat confusing way. Anyway, the excuse is good for hybridizing 007 and Hong Kong action and for showing a parade of oriental beauties. The hybridization remains on paper, the construction and staging are a bit unfair, but the film is as smashing and self-deprecating as required. Sutherland is the UN secretary, the final with the barrels is at the UN.

title: Charlie's Angels
actors: Cameron Diaz, Drew Barrymore, Lucy Liu, Bill Murray, Sam Rockwell
description: The founder of Knox Technologies was kidnapped while he was in his office. The computer genius has created an application that can identify the voice. His groundbreaking invention could cause irreparable damage if it ended up in the hands of criminals. The company president uses the only man who can track down the kidnapped and knock out the kidnappers: Charlie and his Angels. Namely Natalie, Dylan and Alex ...
notes: Loosely inspired by the homonymous TV series, shamelessly copied from the Hong Kong cult "Heroic Trio", the film is as cheeky as it is fun. A collage of very cinephile situations, winks at the fans of the series (who recognized the quote from the episode "Angels in chains"?), Kitsch aesthetics flaunted without shame. Superb Drew Barrymore, also producer, irresistible Cameron Diaz, lethal Lucy Liu. Their harmony is total. Unleashed because the screenplay is at grade zero: there is nothing to understand, you have fun abandoning yourself to the nonsense of history. Bill Murray / Bosley trying to start the fire makes the most serious viewers totter.

title: Baise-moi
actors: Raffaëla Anderson, Karen Lancaume, Delphine MacCarthy, Lisa Marshall
description: A group of thugs kidnaps and rapes Manu in a courtyard. On the same day Nadine witnesses the murder of her drug addict boyfriend. They both carry the same feeling of vengeance towards the world and it won't take long to put it into practice.
notes: Directed by writer Despentes and hard core director Coralie Trinh Thi, the operation is interesting. Despentes chooses a participatory point of view (hand machine, dirty images) but at the same time describes the exploits of the two protagonists as mechanical, senseless. The attempt to make a hard image filtered by a female gaze painful does little. "Baise moi" is too smug, "dogmatic" (in Lars von Trier's sense), and even boring after a while. He wanted to be a violent "Thelma & Louise" for the XXX generation, but he lacks the passion (even the cinematic one).

title: Scary Movie
actors: Anna Faris, Shannon Elizabeth, Regina Hall, Lochlyn Munro, Jon Abrahams
description: A beautiful high school student is killed. A group of teenagers must find out if a murderer is hiding among them.
notes: It starts as a literal parody of the first scene of the first "Scream"; moving forward, instead of waning, "Scary Movie" steadily grows, runs, slaughters, cleans up, stumbles, messes up, takes exhausted breaks of smoke and sex. He does not forgive: from Spielberg to "The Blair Witch Project", from "The usual suspects" to the black-pie-college-movie, he grinds everything in the meat grinder of unleashed satire, with a careful eye on the demented of yesteryear ("Animal House" ?) and its relentless rhythms. Incorrect, slob (but perhaps only in appearance: the Wayans run anything but bad), irreverent and healthy.

title: Song Without End
actors: Dirk Bogarde, Lyndon Brook, Capucine, Geneviève Page, Patricia Morison
description: After a sentimental adventure, Liszt always torn between love and faith in God, following the advice of his friends Chopin and George Sand, resumes his activity as a concert performer. During the tour, he falls in love with a Russian princess. But the noble is a married woman who, using false pretexts, manages to obtain the annulment of her marriage. But when the authorities discover the trick, the annulment is lifted and so Liszt, who sees in this the sign of a supernatural intervention, decides to embrace the religious life.
notes: The highlight of the film is of course the music elaborated by Morris Stoloff and Harry Suckman who won the Oscar for their work.

title: A Song to Remember
actors: Ivan Triesault, Paul Muni, Merle Oberon, Cornel Wilde
description: Chopin takes his first steps under the guidance of Joseph Elsner, an old professor who sensed that the boy has a particular predisposition for music. His parents, on the other hand, would like him to devote himself to study. The boy soon came into contact with patriotic organizations fighting for Poland's independence. Called to play in front of the Russian governor Chopin, he refuses and is forced to leave his beloved country. In Paris he gets success and meets George Sand, the writer who will have so much influence on his future.
notes: The film, which was later heavily imitated, had six Oscar nominations.

title: Hollow Point
actors: Tia Carrere, Donald Sutherland, Thomas Ian Griffith, John Lithgow
description: To frame a criminal organization, FBI agent Diane Norwood is paired with Goddess agent Max Parish. The two are joined by a killer, expert in explosives, not very controllable named Garrett Lawton. The bad guys, a strange alliance between the Italian, Russian and Chinese mafia coordinated by the unsuspected Livingston, are about to steal an endless amount of dollars, but ours are ready to strike.
notes: Two down-and-out and very efficient detectives, a plot, an iconography and a series of narrative schemes that derive from comics. In short, a wild and rude film.

title: A Kid in King Arthur's Court
actors: Thomas Ian Nicholas, Joss Ackland, Art Malik, Paloma Baeza
description: The young Calvin Fuller is sent by Merlin to the kingdom of King Arthur with a specific mission: to save Camelot. To accomplish it, Calvin will have to defeat the evil lord Belascoe, train himself to become a valiant knight and rescue Princess Catherine, who is in love with him. Youth adaptation of "A Connecticut Yankee in King Arthur's Court" by Mark Twain, which was released on the sly and then moved on to the home video market.

title: Le septième ciel
actors: Danielle Darrieux, Paul Meurisse, Noël-Noël, Gérard Oury, Alberto Sordi
description: Brigitte, a very rich widow, owner of the famous Three Star Beer industry, lives in a sumptuous castle. Lestrange lives with her, a friend who is very much in love with her. Thanks to her advice, Brigitte dedicates herself to charitable works. To procure the funds she needs to do good, Brigitte invites dishonest financiers to her home, steals huge sums from them and kills them. Portal, a man who is reputed to be rich but actually thrives on his wits, is also targeted by Brigitte.
notes: Film full of black humor and unfairly forgotten. In a small part there is the national Albertone.

title: Le braghe del padrone
actors: Enrico Montesano, Felice Andreasi, Enrico Beruschi, Vanna Brosio
description: Vittorio, a very modest window cleaner, lives without his luck at work and in private life. One day he is hired by "Supreme Edizioni" where the president is forced to hire 2000 employees to optimize production. Lost in the macroscopic company, Vittorio is approached by the Devil himself, who pushes him to take up the social ladder. The young man begins by removing Dr. Verzelli from his golden seat.
notes: Modest film based on the novel by Terzoli and Vaime. Enrico Montesano gave better evidence.

title: Il Casanova di Federico Fellini
actors: Donald Sutherland, Tina Aumont, Cicely Browne, Leda Lojodice, Carmen Scarpitta, Daniel Emilfork Berenstein, Luigi Zerbinati
description: Old and run down, Casanova, librarian in a Bohemian castle, recalls his life full of love and adventures. First, as a young man in Venice, where, imprisoned for his unruly life, he escapes from the Piombi and begins to wander through the European courts leading a life full of love affairs and scams. Over time, success with women begins to wane. Many doors close in his face as the physical and moral degradation increases. Finally, he finds refuge with a Bohemian nobleman who exhibits him as a freak.
notes: Fellini takes possession of the character of Casanova and gives him a portrait between the tender and the horrible. Oscar for costumes by Danilo Donati.

title: Buffalo Bill and the Indians, or Sitting Bull's History Lesson
actors: Paul Newman, Joel Grey, Harvey Keitel, Burt Lancaster, Kevin McCarthy
description: William F. Cody, aka Buffalo Bill, travels around America driving his circus, for which he is always looking for attractions. Recalled from the reserve the old Sioux leader Sitting Bull, he hires him for a grotesque re-enactment of the battle of Little Big Horn, with the intent of ridiculing the myth of the Indian leader: but despite his apparent victory, he will have to learn a lesson in life.
notes: With this film Altman adds a further chapter - albeit more schematic and "Brechtian" than others - to his systematic work of demystifying the bad conscience of the American nation

title: If You Believe
actors: Ally Walker, Tom Amandes, Hayden Panettiere, Meredith Mc Geachie
description: The young Susan Stone works as a director in an important publishing house but is not at all satisfied; work takes up most of the day and she has ended up forgetting the small and big joys that life offers her. One day, returning home, she finds little Suzie waiting for her ... In reality the little girl is Susan herself, who has the task of making the adult woman regain the desire to love, the desire to be together with loved ones and to think again of all that life can still offer you truly beautiful ...
notes: A too-obvious television movie.

title: Reckless
actors: Mia Farrow, Eileen Brennan, Scott Glenn, Mary-Louise Parker
description: It's Christmas Eve, Rachel's most anticipated day of the year. Everything Rachel wishes she already has: a wonderful husband and beautiful children. But the tragedy is lurking. Tom, Rachel's husband, confesses to his wife that he hired a killer to kill her. Rachel is then forced to leave her family and flee. She is welcomed by Lloyd and his wife Pooty, a paraplegic woman. Rachel, with the help of her new friends, tries to put her own existence back together. The following Christmas Tom shows up at Rachel's to ask for her forgiveness. He carries a bottle of champagne he found on the doorstep

title: Jesus
country: Germany, Italy, United States, Czech Republic
actors: Jeremy Sisto, Debra Messing, Jacqueline Bisset, Gary Oldman, Claudio Amendola, G.W. Bailey, Luca Zingaretti, Luca Barbareschi, Christian Kohlund, Elena Sofia Ricci, Stefania Rocca, Maria Cristina Heller, Jeroen Krabbe, Sean Harris, Sebastian Knapp
description: Jesus, a young carpenter, lives in Galilee with his parents Mary and Joseph. After the death of the latter he sets out on a journey, embarking on a path of knowledge that leads him, among other things, to meet his cousin Giovanni and to be baptized by him on the banks of the Jordan River. Determined to spread his word among the people, Jesus undergoes a very hard test by isolating himself in the desert and resisting the repeated temptations of the Devil, after which he performs the first miracles. The number of his followers grows relentlessly, and it is to the most faithful of them - the twelve Apostles - that Jesus will reveal the destiny that awaits him.

title: One Special Night
actors: James Garner, Julie Andrews, Patricia Charbonneau, Stacy Grant
description: Robert (Garner), a mature building contractor, visited his wife in a hospitalization center. Meanwhile, a snowstorm has blocked the streets and Robert can't find a taxi to take him home. Catherine (Andrews), a doctor at the hospital, offers him a ride in her car, but soon the two occasional travel companions, due to the heavy snow, find themselves stranded in their car, forced to spend the night outside. The temporary discomfort turns out to be an opportunity for greater mutual understanding. Sweetish just within the limits of the tolerable, this TV-movie has at least a very respectable cast.

title: A Christmas Memory
actors: Piper Laurie, Patty Duke, Jeffrey DeMunn, Anita Gillette, Julia McIlvaine
description: In a small Alabama town in 1943, Buddy, a seven-year-old boy, lives with his three elderly spinster cousins ??on an old farm. The boy's mother is trying to become an actress and her father is in New Orleans, trying to forget her. Buddy thinks his sixty-year-old cousin Sook is the best friend in the world: she is a guide for him and taught him to appreciate the simplest joys in life. But when cousin Jennie decides it's time to send Buddy to a military boarding school, there is no way for the boy to reply ...

title: Mrs. Santa Claus
actors: Angela Lansbury, Michael Jeter, Terrence Mann, Lynsey Bartilson
description: The Christmas holidays are not a happy time for the wife of Santa Claus: in the frenzy of the preparations for the distribution of gifts to children around the world, her husband neglects her and has no time for her. Stove to alms her attentions of her, Mamma Natale gets on the sled with all the reindeer and flies out to distract a little. Unfortunately Santa Claus, in confusion, forgot to adjust his means of locomotion, and the consort soon finds herself forced to an emergency landing in the chaotic slums of the Manhattan of the early 1900s. After the initial loss, the Christmas Madam does not lose heart and decides to set up a toy factory of its own ...
notes: An unusual role for Angela Lansbury "the lady in yellow" called here by the director to play the role of Mamma Natale. She gets away well, as usual.

title: Kazaam
actors: Shaquille O'Neal, Francis Capra, Ally Walker, James Acheson
description: One day Max, a 12-year-old city boy, while trying to escape a gang of thugs, stumbles upon a box, from which Kazaam, a powerful genius, emerges. Like any good self-respecting genius, Kazaam offers Max the opportunity to express three wishes. At first Max is reluctant, but soon the two become an inseparable couple. The boy's family situation is certainly not enviable. The separated mother is engaged again. For his part, Max seems to feel responsible for his father's abandonment. Luckily to keep him company is Kazaam who, in the meantime, has discovered that he has a great passion for rap music.
notes: Of course Kazaan is Shaquille O'Neal.

title: You Lucky Dog
actors: Kirk Cameron, Chelsea Noble, John de Lancie, James Avery
description: Jack, who is an animal psychoanalyst by trade, is treating Lucky a depressed dog. Depression does not involve the doctor until the death of the owner of the beast, is declared heir with Lucky of a large inheritance. Things get bad when the doctor starts taking on the dog's personality.

title: State buoni... se potete
actors: Johnny Dorelli, Mario Adorf, Philippe Leroy, Angelo Branduardi, Renzo Montagnani
description: The film tells the story of St. Philip Neri, who devoted his entire life to assisting abandoned children in Rome in the 1500s.
notes: The film (produced by TV but also distributed in theaters in a shortened version) is directed with good hands by Luigi Magni who is at ease in describing the Rome of the past, and who this time dampens his anticlericalism in describing a priest against the rules. Soundtrack by Angelo Branduardi, who also plays in a small role.

title: Les miracles n'ont lieu qu'une fois
actors: Alida Valli, Jean Marais, Marcelle Arnold, Dedi Ristori, Nada Fiorelli
description: Claudia, follows medical courses in Paris. The girl has a fellow student, Jerome, to whom she is linked by a feeling of sympathy; only at the moment of parting do the two feel that love has blossomed from sympathy and confess it to each other.
notes: The film marked Alida Valli's return to Europe after the Hollywood interlude. Graceful and a little cutie, but built with finesse.

title: Fairy Tale: A True Story
actors: Peter O'Toole, Harvey Keitel, Florence Hoath, Elizabeth Earl
description: Yorkshire, 1917. Little Frances and Elise are convinced that they have proof of the existence of fairies, having managed to photograph them. The girls find the fact normal, while around them the desire to endorse or refute the photographic evidence is unleashed. Even Sir Arthur Conan Doyle and Henry Houdini will want to check for themselves.
notes: Taken from a true story, the central idea should have been the relationship between science - we are in 1917 - the fairy world of children and the meddling of the mass media. Unfortunately, the theme is lost in a script that puts too much meat on the fire. Don't miss Peter O'Toole and Harvey Keitel as Doyle and Houdini. Cameo also for Mel Gibson.

title: Taken
actors: Dabney Coleman, Linda Smith, Brett Watson, Dennis Boutsikaris, Stewart Bick
description: Ethan Gold is a fashion ace, an entrepreneur who doesn't miss a beat in his field. His total dedication to work has led him to overlook the problems he has in the family, where greedy wife Judy and drug addict stepson Alex plots behind him; and he didn't even notice that someone broke into the office at night, photocopying very important documents. Ethan is kidnapped and the kidnapper demands a huge ransom from the wrong people. Everyone around the businessman seems ready to betray, each driven by different interests. Ethan must act urgently, and the forced solution requires him to ally with ...

title: Lista de espera
actors: Vladimir Cruz, Thaimi Alvariño, Jorge Perugorría, Saturnino García
description: In a station still far from Havana, a bus breaks down for a change. The people who have been waiting for him for hours are forced to "relax", because who knows when the spare part will arrive. The opportunity, however, is exploited by the unfortunate to get to know and get to know each other, to try to convince a woman to leave her boyfriend by chance and give herself to true love, to steal cans of meat with the classic scam of the blind who sees most. of each other and of anyone.
notes: A borderline situation that turns into a clear wonder of a country in difficulty and in any case aided by a team spirit which, at least in the Western world, is today untraceable. The fortune of this fragile film like a transport of crystals but tender and very honest, is given precisely by its Cuban pride; he never gives in to superficial criticism and entrusts himself to the dream, as a translation of a complicated condition, but pervaded by nice and "anti-modern" positive aspects. Dedicated to the late Tomas Gutiérrez Alea, Tabío's director companion for "Strawberries and Chocolate" and "Guantanamera".

title: Is It Fall Yet?
description: Daria and the Lawndale High School students go on vacation. Kevin and Brittany make ends meet by being lifeguards, Quinn feels an attraction to David, Mack drives the ice cream truck, while Jodie continues to volunteer. But Daria and Jane are at loggerheads, the "object" of the dispute is always Tom, boyfriend of the first and ex of the second. To throw water on the fire, the two friends decide to spend the summer in separate places.
notes: Daria, Mack, Jodie, Brittany ... Very popular names for fans of the cartoon "Daria", broadcast for more than four years on MTV. This TV movie respects the clichés of the serial.

title: Beauty and the Beast: The Enchanted Christmas
description: Belle is preparing a nice Christmas party in her castle. The Beast, of course, finds something to complain about, indeed he refuses to celebrate the most beautiful day of the year.
notes: Andy Knight transports the characters of Belle and the Beast into the atmosphere of Christmas, six years after the Disney cartoon directed by Gary Trousdale and Kirk Wise.

title: Pooh's Grand Adventure: The Search for Christopher Robin
description: The bear Winnie the Pooh and his gang set out on a search for Christopher Robin, who they fear has been kidnapped and locked up in the Skull cave. The undertaking is difficult and dangerous, but no obstacle can stop the brave friends, who without any delay set out on the tracks of the unfortunate Christopher ...

title: City Beneath the Sea
actors: Stuart Whitman, Robert Wagner, Robert Colbert, Whit Bissell
description: In the 21st century, a group of settlers settled in a very modern underwater city called Pacifica. This condition of theirs, however, exposes them to considerable psychological pressure, amplifying mutual rivalries. In the cast of this TV movie also some old glories such as Joseph Cotten, Richard Basehart and Edward G. Robinson.

title: Daffy Duck's Movie: Fantastic Island
description: Daffy Duck and Speedy Gonzales come into possession of a treasure map that guides them straight to a magical well, which for the price of a dime guarantees that any wish will come true. Meanwhile, Yosemite Sam and the Tasmanian Devil are on the trail of the thieves who stole their map ...

title: O' Cangaceiro
actors: Tomas Milian, Ugo Pagliai, Eduardo Fajardo, Howard Ross
description: The Certao of the Brazilian region of Agua Branca is the undisputed territory of the Cangaceiro Espedito who calls himself the Redeemer because, at least according to what he says, he is inspired by the gospel. Governor Branco takes advantage of his popularity to declare war on the other Cangaceiros in the area.
notes: Film that follows the western structure.

title: La Principessa e il povero
actors: Mathieu Carrière, Anna Falchi, Nicholas Rogers, Thomas Kretschmann
description: King Hamil and his wife cannot have children; they will be able to get one thanks to the magic of Gamesh, the wizard-child. But the great sorcerer Epos, angry with the apprentice, intervenes and so the King finds himself the father of a little girl, Mirabella, who is actually the daughter of the peasant Sariba, while her son is raised in the house of the two poor farmers. together with another brother. Neither Gamesh nor Epos, however, know which of the two children, Leonardo and Ademarco, is the real son of the King. The lives of the three young people will always be in the hands of the magicians Epos and Gamesh who, while not being able to influence their feelings, nevertheless manage to change the events of their destiny ...

title: The Odyssey
country: Italy, Germany, Malta, Turkey, Great Britain, United States
actors: Armand Assante, Greta Scacchi, Geraldine Chaplin, Christopher Lee, Irene Papas, Bernadette Peters, Eric Roberts, Jeroen Krabbe, Vanessa Williams, Isabella Rossellini
description: Ulysses leaves his wife Penelope and her child to take part in the siege of Troy. The city stoically resists the siege and cannot be taken by force, so much so that the besieging army is gradually losing heart. Ulysses devises an ingenious system and manages to penetrate the city with his army hidden inside a wooden horse. Troy is thus conquered; Ulysses boasts of the fact that the fall of Troy is not the work of the Gods but the result of his cunning and the furious Poseidon, god of the sea, decides to punish him.

title: The Flintstones Meet Rockula and Frankenstone
description: By participating in a television quiz, Fred, Barney, Wilma and Betty win a prize trip to Rocksylvania at the Count Rockula Castle, recently transformed into a luxury hotel. The four also have the opportunity to intervene in the masked ball for the inauguration of the hotel. But on this occasion, after five hundred years, Count Rockula wakes up, who claims the ownership of the castle by making all the guests of the hotel escape. Everyone, except Fred, Barney, Wilma and Betty who, fatigued by the long journey, immediately fell asleep in their rooms without realizing what they happened around them. When Rockula comes across Wilma, she exchanges her for her beloved bride and tries to kidnap her, but Wilma protest claiming to be already married. At this point Rockula decides to eliminate Fred ...
notes: Unleashed cartoon that features the unleashed band of the Flintstones.

title: Homeward Bound II: Lost in San Francisco
actors: Bob Uecker, Tress MacNeille, Jon Polito, Adam Goldberg, Sinbad
description: The Seaver family, father mother and three children, decide to leave for a campground in the Rocky Mountains. Baggage, dogs, cats are gathered but, at the San Francisco airport, the dog Chance comes out of the cage and remains on the ground. Two faithful friends follow him, Shadow and Sassy and, by now the plane has departed, the three just have to start wandering the streets of the big city in search of the right direction to go home. During this difficult undertaking they find themselves involved in numerous and dangerous adventures, they meet bands of stray dogs, other quadrupeds and Chace makes the acquaintance of the beautiful Delilah.
notes: A good sequel to "On the run on all fours".

title: Monster Mash: It's a Graveyard Smash!
description: Frankenstein, Dracula and the Wolf Man are judged too good by the monster court. To avoid being expelled from the club, they must be able to scare a typical American family within 24 hours.
notes: Tasty Italian-American co-production directed by Guido Manuli, one of the masters of Italian animation.

title: Angels in the Endzone
actors: Paul Dooley, Matthew Lawrence, David Gallagher, Christopher Lloyd
description: An angel descends to Earth and settles in a US town. Conquered by a passion for sport, he takes to heart the fate of the local football team, sadly doomed to defeat until then. Meanwhile, the celestial creature changes the lives of two brothers, in crisis due to the loss of their father.

title: On the 2nd Day of Christmas
actors: Mary Stuart Masterson, Mark Ruffalo, Lauren Pratt, David Hewlett, James Purcell, Lawrence Dane, Howard Hesseman
description: Trish and little Patsy, a child under her tutelage, are caught stealing a few days before Christmas in a department store. Given the proximity of the most beautiful party of the year, the security manager decides to turn a blind eye thus avoiding Patsy from spending the holidays in an institution.

title: Yellow Submarine
description: Pepelandia is a happy country: this is a source of envy for the Blue Wicked people who hate beauty, flowers and music. With their weapons they attack the defenseless people by petrifying them after destroying the surrounding nature. Only a sailor is saved by embarking on a yellow submarine on which he makes the four Beatles get on for help.
notes: The starting point is the famous Beatles song, which is performed together with others of the group. Figuratively refined, libertarian, imaginative: a gem not only for Beatles fans. The animations are by H. Edelmann.

title: Drive, He Said
actors: William Tepper, Karen Black, Bruce Dern, June Fairchild, Henry Jaglom
description: Hector is the point guard of the Leopards basketball team, which plays in the university league. His great popularity and prowess may allow him a quick transition to pro, but Hector is subject to highs and lows so frequent that his coach seriously consider excluding him. The reasons are different, starting with the fact that Hector is with Olive, his best friend's wife. Then Gabriel, Hector's roommate, is called up ...
notes: Interesting film written and directed by Jack Nicholson, symptomatic of the disorientation and "loss of center" of a whole generation.

title: Il ricatto di un padre
actors: Vittorio Braschi, Roberto Bruni, Eduardo Cianelli, Barbara Francia
description: The industrialist Guarnieri owes a large sum to a financial firm, owned by Alessandro Arlandi and his partner Serpieri. Guarnieri has issued them some bills, which he cannot pay upon maturity. The industrialist is a sick man; the agitation causes a severe heart attack, to which he succumbs.
notes: Vari is responsible for directing a good number of spaghetti westerns; here he plays a tarnished melodrama and is doing pretty badly.

title: Rapporto Fuller, base Stoccolma
actors: Claudio Biava, Gianni Brezza, Ken Clark, Mirko Ellis, Beba Loncar
description: Svetlana, a Russian ballerina from the Bolshoi, takes refuge in Stockholm waiting for political asylum in the United States. At the same time, Dick Wart, an American motor racing driver who is in Sweden for a race, is accused of the murder of a woman he had met by chance and who was in possession of a secret report on Svetlana. Dick gets in touch with Svetlana to shed some light on the matter.
notes: Spaghetti spy with the beautiful Beba Loncar. Too weak finish. Remarkable spectacular scenes directed for two pennies by an expert craftsman (underrated) like Grieco.

title: Manon '70
actors: Catherine Deneuve, Sami Frey, Elsa Martinelli, Jean-Claude Brialy
description: Manon is a modern and unscrupulous girl, romantically linked to a journalist (who reciprocates) but far from reluctant to ... social relations: in fact, in her circle of acquaintances there are numerous rich and wealthy men, whom she frequents in order to being able to maintain the high standard of living to which she is used
notes: This version of the story narrated by Abbot Prévost - with a contemporary setting and a slightly watered-down happy ending - is almost completely based on the icy charm of the blonde Deneuve, at the time at the top of popularity. The rest of the cast is also good, with Frey, Brialy and Martinelli

title: Moon Zero Two
actors: James Olson, Catherine Von Schell, Warren Mitchell, Adrienne Corri, Ori Levy
description: Moon City, Luna. Two former astronauts are summoned by a rich industrialist - owner of a mining company, whose workers claim better working conditions - which intends to entrust them with a mission to the limits of the impossible: the recovery of an asteroid entirely composed of sapphire.

title: Redhead From Wyoming
actors: Maureen O'Hara, Alexander Scourby, Alex Nicol, Jack Kelly
description: In Wyoming, conflicts between the area's numerous ranchers are commonplace. A speculator tries to take advantage of the situation: but a sheriff thwarts his plots and in the end he will succeed, brilliantly assisted by a saloon dancer already a lover of the shady individual. The film is only for redhead O'Hara. Not to be confused with a film of the same name (in Italian) of ten years earlier with Loretta Young.

title: Omicidio per appuntamento
actors: Georges Ardisson, Ella Karin, Günther Stoll, Hans von Borsody
description: Irving, chased by the exuberant daughter of an American billionaire, arrives in Rome to look for Dwight, an old friend, whom he hasn't seen in a long time. From that moment on, his life will never be the same again.
notes: The film includes Mario Brega and Luigi Visconti aka Fanfulla.

title: 1990 - I guerrieri del Bronx
actors: Vic Borrow, Christopher Connelly, Mark Gregory, Betty Dessy
description: Rival gangs are operating in the Bronx but are trying to strike up peace agreements. It happens, however, that such attempts are thwarted. The hunt for the rival gang is rekindled with exasperated violence. Especially one morning when two young men from the Warriors gang are killed.
notes: First true Italian post-atomic film, directed by an action artisan.

title: La casa delle anime erranti
actors: Joseph Alan Johnson, Stefania Orsola Garello, Matteo Gazzolo
description: A hotel in the Alps is haunted by the usual ghosts that do not leave those who have rented rooms quiet.
notes: Umberto Lenzi's film is part of four films in the series produced by Reteitalia and entitled "Le case maledette". Released only on videotape.

title: Desert Tank
actors: Robert Hossein, George Hilton, Michael Rennie, Enrico Maria Salerno
description: Summer of 1942, Rommel's troops advance into Africa, forcing the British 8th Army to retreat. After Auchinleck, when he managed to block the Germans in front of El Alamein, Montgomery awaits the right moment for the counter-offensive.
notes: Negligible film about one of the most important battles in history.

title: Buon funerale amigos... paga Sartana
actors: Gianni Garko, Federico Boido, Roberto Dell'Acqua, Daniela Giordano
description: The gunslinger Sartana, who witnessed the killing of Benson, a gold digger, goes to Indian Creek to discover the perpetrators of the crime. Some time later, a granddaughter of the dead man, Jasmine, arrives in the town and has inherited a plot of land from him.
notes: Fourth film starring Sartana directed by Carnimeo.

title: La dolce casa degli orrori
actors: Jean-Christophe Brétigniere, Cinzia Monreale, Pascal Persiano
description: Two children decide to avenge their parents' death by killing the gardener who was responsible for the murder. The uncles, however, make a terrible discovery, the children are possessed and call an exorcist.
notes: Distributed only in video and part of the series "Le case maledette".

title: The Private War of Major Benson
actors: Charlton Heston, Julie Adams, William Demarest, Tim Hovey
description: Major Benson is one of those officers for whom discipline and rudeness of methods towards subordinates are an inalienable conviction. This time, however, even his superiors are convinced that he has exaggerated, and they think well of "hijacking" him to be an instructor in an academy attended by cadets little more than teenagers. Obviously he will also martyrize the latter, earning everyone's deep dislike, but the love for a pretty doctor will eventually soften him.
notes: From the series "even the tough have a heart" ... Ordinary, with a Charlton Heston pre-"Ben Hur" with a strictly square jaw.

title: Autumn in New York
actors: Winona Ryder, Richard Gere, Anthony LaPaglia, Elaine Stritch
description: He is forty-eight years old, with squinted eyes, a crewneck sweater and well-coiffed hair, cannot resist being conquered and is not, by definition, "married". She is twenty-two, speaks like a twelve-year-old, has a probably incurable disease, a passion for Emily Dickinson, for beads, butterflies and for dresses of charming kitsch. Love is born between the two.
notes: Joan Chen starts with a wink at Woody Allen, but immediately tumbles into a love story that couldn't be more predictable.

title: Pokémon: The Movie 2000
description: A reckless pokémon collector wants to take possession of three powerful pokémon birds that keep the balance on the terrestrial nature by ruling the fire, light and ice, in order to lure Lugia, the legendary inhabitant of the sea, into his trap. Only the "chosen one", that is Ash, will be able to restore order among the allied forces of Nature.
notes: The film again focuses on an ecological fairy tale. Ash's little adventure companions are always delightful, Pikachu in the lead, but compared to the first film in the series, there is a slightly more confusing story and a certain poverty of cinematic references.

title: Svadba
actors: Marat Basharov, Mariya Mironova, Andrei Panin, Vladimir Simonov
description: Mishka and Tania, friends since school, are getting married. But something is wrong because the girl leaves for Moscow and disappears for a few years. Having vanished the dreams of becoming a model, she decides to return to the country to marry the good Mishka, muscular and solid worker with a clean face, still in love with her. At this point the film tells about the wedding preparations, the ceremony, the dramas and the trafficking that goes through it.
notes: The Russian Pavel Longuine is reminded of the interesting first film "Taxi Blues" from 1990, set in post-Communist Moscow. With "The wedding" the director tells us about Russia between alcohol, violence and capitalism. Too bad the direction is chaotic and exhausting.

title: Small Time Crooks
actors: Woody Allen, Tracey Ullman, Elaine May, Michael Rapaport
description: An unlikely team of petty crime wannabes, led by dishwasher Ray, take the big shot in a bank vault. The "bad guys" rent an old restaurant, turn it into a patisserie that sells only cookies made by Ray's wife Frenchy, a manicurist. In the cellar, the four stunned members of the hole gang dig a tunnel. Upstairs business is fine, while downstairs, Ray, Tommy, Benny just mess around, break through a pipe, go wrong, and end up in a clothing store.
notes: The first forty minutes of the film are overwhelming and crackling. Jokes, gags, sound cinema and silent cinema that shake hands affectionately, comic attention to detail, fast pace, textbook malice, very amusing dialogue passages. Woody's aged face, insensitive to the biological fate that sends comedians into retirement with the arrival of the deepest wrinkles, and the perfect ones, with the out-of-tune expressions, of his magnificent accomplices animate the screen. With the arrival of exaggerated wealth and the need to take life lessons from an art dealer, played by Hugh Grant, the script suddenly changes gears. The supporting actors and the plot disappear, while giving the delicious sequence of the theft of a necklace, it falls apart and gets lazy in a kitsch with too many calories.

title: Bread and Roses
actors: Pilar Padilla, Adrien Brody, Elpidia Carillo, Jack McGee, George Lopez
description: Some immigrants have been recruited by a cleaning company and clean, quietly and almost invisibly, the offices of a Californian block. From Cuernavaca, with other illegal immigrants, Maya arrives, Rosa's younger sister, one of the underpaid, unprotected, exploited, frightened and blackmailed workers by the corporal who supervises the work. Then luckily a trade unionist moves the waters.
notes: Ken Loach goes south and insists, with a stubborn consistency, on practicing a militant cinema, on the left, extraneous to fashions and transformism. It takes as its pretext a slogan that is almost a hundred years old and which demands bread and roses for a better life.

title: How the Grinch Stole Christmas
actors: Jim Carrey, Jeffrey Tambor, Taylor Momsen, Christine Baranski
description: The Grinch is a detestable, lazy, monstrous greenish being, who lives alone in a cave at the top of Mount Crumpit with the resigned little dog Max. The creature has a smaller heart than normal and just can't be loved by the inhabitants of the town of Kinonsò. To spite them she decides to steal next Christmas, but sweet little Cindy Lou takes care of the remedy.
notes: The one undertaken by Ron Howard was a prohibitive undertaking, due to the difficulty in bringing to the screen a text, the fruit of the pen of Theodor Seuss Geisel (Dr. Seuss), almost untranslatable. The tale was first brought to the screen in 1966 by Chuck Jones, in a memorable animated version. Supported by the extraordinary make-up of Rick Baker, Howard has managed to paint a very human and ecological (for his passion for recycling of materials!)
