Grinch, animated by the extraordinary physical and vocal talent of Jim Carrey, in a state of grace. The film won an Oscar for best make up.

title: Chicken Run
description: The hen Gaia tries to shake the apathy of her companions and an old rooster ex RAF pilot, when she discovers that the Tweedys, owners of the chicken coop, are planning a restructuring, which will take them directly from the coops to the Tweedy chicken flans. The decisive help for the great escape from the henhouse-lager comes from the sky, in the guise of the sympathetic braggart Rocky, an American flying rooster who quickly becomes the idol of chicks.
notes: In the film there is the flavor of the epic cinema of "Stalag17" and "The great escape" which, taking its cue from the events of the Second World War, praised the dignity and freedom of man. Nick Park and Peter Lord decided to brush it up for their first feature film and instead of Stalag 17 they put Stia 17. Studio Aardman's stop motion animation technique has reached an extraordinary level that allows directors to dare to take shots and a blockbuster editing. However, the chicken coop is still not worth the genius of the characters of Wallace & Gromit.

title: Reindeer Games
actors: Ben Affleck, Gary Sinise, Charlize Theron, Dennis Farina, James Frain
description: Good Rudy gets out of prison and meets Ashley, his correspondent. The two love each other but her brother, Gabriel, plots in the shadows. He believes Rudy knows the secrets of a casino well and tries to use it for the coup of a lifetime.
notes: In this triple quadruple game it is not hard to see Frankenheimer's hand. But the story of these criminals on the road (or rather, "on the snow") slips on without affecting, staged with a certain listlessness. Affleck is a nice Big Jim but he doesn't fascinate a little, Theron is only diligent, Sinise defines a villain in a manner. As an entertainment film it makes a good impression, but the author of "Diabolical Operation" and "Ronin" was to be expected more.

title: Buck and the Magic Bracelet
actors: Jane Alexander (II), Matt McCoy, Bobby Rhodes, Beatrice Macola
description: Kevin and Buck, his inseparable four-legged friend, live in a Canadian village of the mythical pioneer era. Kevin's father Zeb is a gold hunter who has defied the hostilities of a wild nature and managed to amass great wealth. But the bad guys are lurking: to get hold of Zeb's gold, the ruthless Ma Dalton and her children break into the village, killing all the inhabitants. Gravely wounded, Kevin manages to survive thanks to the care of a mysterious shaman who gives him a bracelet with magical powers.
notes: Loosely based on the stories of Jack London.

title: The Typewriter, the Rifle & the Movie Camera
actors: Samuel Fuller, Tim Robbins, Jim Jarmusch, Martin Scorsese, Quentin Tarantino
description: The life of the great director Samuel Fuller is already profoundly "cinematic" in itself: first reporter and designer in the golden age of American journalism, then sent with his camera to the war front. This documentary reconstructs its profile starting from the testimonies of illustrious friends and admirers.

title: Träumer und das wilde Mädchen
actors: Sven Martinek, Yvonne De Bark, Manfred Lehmann, Marek Wlodarczyk
description: A coup in a customs office involves more or less simultaneously a large group of people. Their goal is a only apparently innocent glass ball ball, given that inside there is a precious microchip. To drive the dance, a rather decisive girl and a former car driver.

title: La svergognata
actors: Philippe Leroy, Leonora Fani, Stefano Amato, Barbara Bouchet
description: Nino, a Milanese industrialist, arrives on the island of Ischia for a holiday with his wife Clara and daughter Ornella. Several people stay in the same hotel, among which Fabio stands out, a writer in a depressive crisis who was already a lover of Mrs. Bernardi five years earlier and now a faithful companion of the actress Silvia. Ornella, also stimulated by her friend Giusi, soon gets tired of the meetings with the boys of their company.
notes: Not very brilliant debut, to tell the truth, by Eleonora Cristofani aka Leonora Fani.

title: Agente 077 - Sfida ai killers
actors: Richard Harrison, Susy Andersen, Wandisa Guida, Marcel Charvey
description: Three scientists are about to make a discovery that could, overnight, make the use of coal and oil useless. Two of them, however, are killed in mysterious circumstances and the third, Coleman, is saved at the last moment by CIA agents. Conducted in Switzerland, in Geneva, Coleman is replaced by Bob Fleming, secret agent 077. Bob goes to Casablanca to try to uncover the mystery surrounding the death of the two scientists. To play his part better, Bob convinces Coleman's wife to cooperate.
notes: The film is also known as "Bob Fleming ... Casablanca Mission".

title: Paura nella città dei morti viventi
actors: Christopher George, Catriona MacColl, Janet Agren, Carlo De Mejo
description: In Dunwich, an American town, built on the site of Salem, the city of witches, Reverend William Thomas kills himself by hanging himself from a tree in the cemetery. At the same time in New York the medium Mary has a vision of the priest's suicide and the terrifying consequences. As soon as she has the vision, Mary falls as if dead and is buried. In reality, Mary is still alive. Thanks to the intervention of a journalist, she is saved. Meanwhile in Dunwich the living dead who have come out of the graves sow terror among the citizens.
notes: It is a horror that has revived the splatter. Much loved by Lucio Fulci.

title: Per 100.000 dollari ti ammazzo
actors: Gianni Garko, Carlo Gaddi, Claudio Camaso, Bruno Corazzari, Claudie Lange
description: Clint, after killing his father in an argument, makes sure that his half-brother John is responsible for the murder. After serving ten years in prison, John sets out on the trail of Clint, who has since become a dangerous outlaw. Managed to track down Clint, John does not kill him but hands him over to the sheriff to collect the bounty that was placed on his head. Escaped from prison, Clint runs into John again. The latter, instead of returning it to the sheriff, agrees to follow him to share with him the spoils of a coup scored in Mexico.
notes: Delirious western directed by Giovanni Fago.

title: Sette orchidee macchiate di rosso
actors: Antonio Sabato, Uschi Glass, Marisa Mell, Rossella Falk, Renato Romano
description: Two women are brutally killed by a killer who leaves a silver crescent as his signature. Giulia, on her honeymoon with her husband Mario, miraculously escapes an attack. While Inspector Vismara begins the investigation, Mario investigating on his own, discovers a curious link between the killings and the attack.
notes: Lenzi was the first not to be satisfied with the result of the film finished under the clutches of the producers.

title: Nel buio del terrore
actors: Sylva Koscina, Stephen Boyd, Marisa Mell, Massimo Serato
description: Carla is a call. During a weekend he meets Luis, a rich industrialist with whom he begins a relationship. At the same time Carla meets Lola, an attractive waitress she falls in love with. One day Alfred kills a thug and injures another. From that moment he is blackmailed by the survivor ...
notes: Strong melodrama with a good cast.

title: Gun Shy
actors: Sandra Bullock, Liam Neeson, Mitch Pileggi, Oliver Platt
description: Charlie Mayo is an undercover narcotics agent who seriously risks his skin in the course of a failed operation. The incident shakes him deeply, to the point of forcing him to attend an analyst in order to be able to bear the stress of the latest, dangerous case that separates him from retirement. But meeting a nurse practicing New Age-inspired therapies will cause her heart to sway.
notes: Poised between comedy, action and sentiment, Blakeney's first feature film (specialist in TV movies) cannot decide which path to take, neutralizing its own - however few - points of interest in a predictable mediocrity.

title: L'amant de cinq jours
actors: Jean Seberg, Micheline Presle, Jean-Pierre Cassel, François Périer
description: Clara, the young wife of an archivist, meets Antonio during a fashion show in the house of her friend Maddalena. It is the classic love at first sight. Their relationship, however, is marked by mutual lies. Clara makes Antonio believe that she is rich and that she is married to a businessman too busy to care for her. Antonio, for his part, confesses that he is a man who has arrived. In reality, the man lives by exploiting the wealth of his lover Magdalene. Having discovered everything Maddalena intends to take revenge.
notes: After the success of the first low-budget films, de Broca obtained a higher budget from the producers. The result was mediocre.

title: Colpo maestro al servizio di Sua Maestà britannica
actors: Richard Harrison, Adolfo Celi, Margaret Lee, Gérard Tichy, Livio Lorenzon
description: Actor Lang is approached by two individuals who offer him a job. The guarantee that the assignment will consist in impersonating Mister Owen pushes the actor to accept the assignment. For Lang, however, the troubles begin ...
notes: Lupo amiably teases movies about big robberies.

title: Mojave Moon
actors: Danny Aiello, Anne Archer, Michael Biehn, Angelina Jolie, Alfred Molina
description: Al, a middle-aged man, agrees to escort the bizarre trio of the young and sexy Ellie, her mother Julie and her boyfriend, the brutal and psychotic Boyd, into the desert. But that's just the beginning of the troubles that await him.
notes: Interesting cast for a curious combination of comedy (with sentimental streaks) and adventure.

title: A ruota libera
actors: Vincenzo Salemme, Sabrina Ferilli, Carlo Buccirosso, Manuela Arcuri
description: Pericles is a man full of life who decides to undergo a delicate herniated disc surgery. His orthopedic friend Mario after trying to dissuade him is convinced to accompany him to France. In the course of the operation, something goes wrong and Pericles wakes up in a wheelchair. Two years pass and in France the trial against the professor who operated Pericles is held.
notes: The comedy does not work: too many narrative passages are free, and the sentimental inspiration (the beautiful nurse Silvia who falls in love with Pericles) does not have a path that makes it credible.

title: Duets
actors: Gwyneth Paltrow, Huey Lewis, Maria Bello, Paul Giamatti, Scott Speedman
description: A waitress from Wheeling who dreams of moving to California to fulfill her dream of becoming a pop star. An ex-con who rejects the rules imposed by society and has a splendid voice. A traveling salesman, a veteran of the karaoke world and a naive Las Vegas soubrette. These characters meet at the karaoka competition that takes place in Omaha and has a prize of 5,000 dollars. Everyone cultivates the dream of being able to win the competition and take home the loot.
notes: Bruce Paltrow is a producer, director and screenwriter of American TV classics. A curriculum that sheds light on how the actors were directed in the film.

title: Dinosaur
description: In the Cretaceous Aladar an iguanodon separated from the herd while still locked in an egg is raised on an island by a group of lemurs. But when a meteor shower throws his world into complete chaos, Aladar seeks and finds refuge on dry land. Here he joins a group of dinosaurs who are fleeing to a safe place. The pack, however, is forced to defend itself from the constant threat of ravenous predators.
notes: Costing over $ 200 million, which looks good on screen, "Dinosaurs" doesn't show as much grace in history. Taking its cue from the events of Tarzan and Moses, the story is only the ornament of a demonstration of astonishing visual richness, in which the epic inspiration of Walon Green's subject (that of the "Wild Bunch") is diluted.

title: Pitch Black
actors: Vin Diesel, Radha Mitchell, Cole Hauser, Keith David, Lewis Fitz-Gerald
description: Carolyn Fry, a spaceship pilot, is forced to attempt a crash landing on an unknown planet. The collision causes the death of part of the crew: Fry, the bounty hunter Johns and his prisoner, the dangerous assassin Riddick, are saved. At sunset, the inhabitants come out to the surface ...
notes: An impeccable genre contraption: suspense builds up, characters are never what they seem and Twohy uses Carpenterian rigor in staging. We are at the apex of Serie B, where to be able to play a championship at high levels you need grit to sell and a perfect vision of things.

title: Chiedimi se sono felice
directors: Aldo Baglio, Giovanni Storti, Massimo Venier
actors: Aldo Baglio, Giovanni Storti, Giacomo Poretti, Marina Massironi, Antonio Catania, Paola Cortellesi, Silvana Fallisi, Augusto Zucchi, Giuseppe Battiston, Max Pisu, Serena Michelotti, Cinzia Massironi, Arturo Brachetti, Valentino Picone, Salvo Ficarra, Giangilberto Monti, Marco Pagani
description: Aldo, Giovanni and Giacomo are three aspiring actors with a secret dream: to stage a performance by Cyrano de Bergerac. For the moment they make ends meet on the fringes of the entertainment world. Aldo is engaged to the suffocating Silvana. Giacomo is a romantic who does not give up and Giovanni is concentrated on work and has no time to think about love, until he falls in love with a hostess. This encounter upsets the trio.
notes: Amidst stand-up comedians anchored to television clichés, Aldo, Giovanni and Giacomo are among the few to work on the big screen. The film is made of little, narratively telephoned and with some known solution (the elliptical montage with extra-diegetic music in the foreground, the basketball game instead of football), but in the end we get involved.

title: Barbary Coast
actors: Miriam Hopkins, Edward G. Robinson, Joel McCrea, Walter Brennan
description: San Francisco, 1849: the blonde and handsome Swan dancer, in love with money and the good life, enters under the wing of a gambler who owns a nightclub. However, driven by jealousy, he comes into conflict with a miner, an amateur poet and reduced almost to the pavement by bad luck at the green table, with whom the woman falls in love.
notes: The mysterious and intriguing atmospheres of the casinos are the backdrop to this melodrama, scripted by one of Hollywood's "strong" couples, Ben Hecht and Charles MacArthur ("The Friday lady"). Although Hawks did not love him that much, a film of great charm and suggestion.

title: Todo modo
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, Franco Citti, Marcello Mastroianni, Mariangela Melato, Ciccio Ingrassia, Cesare Gelli, Tino Scotti, Adriano Amidei Migliano, Giancarlo Badessi, Mario Bartoli, Nino Costa
description: While an epidemic rages in the country, a hundred "notables" from the party that has governed Italy for thirty years meet in a convent hotel to follow a course of spiritual exercises led by a Jesuit, Don Gaetano. In reality, the defendants are only interested in agreeing on a new division of power. Soon, after a sacrilegious theft, the meeting turns into a fight and the dead begin.
notes: Film based on the novel of the same name by Leonardo Sciascia, which, however, saw rather a visualization of the Pasolini metaphor of the "palace". A metaphor of the decadence of the DC, perhaps turned to too grotesque and "metaphysical" tones. Great Will, who imitates Aldo Moro.

title: Italiani! è severamente proibito servirsi...
actors: Franco Acampora, Silvia Dionisio, Patrizia De Clara, Dante Maggio
description: Benito, a university follower of Marx, Mao and Marcuse loves Patrizia, employed in a beauty salon. The student refuses to have any relations with her until the revolution has triumphed. During a party, the girl meets an anarchist, nicknamed Garibaldi, who makes her a proposal: her virginity in exchange for a car. Having failed a last approach with Benito, the girl makes him believe that he has accepted Garibaldi's prosta. In the meantime, Benito is convinced that he is fighting the system from within and lets himself be ensnared by the record industry.
notes: Mediocre satire of the dispute with the beautiful Silvia Dionisio.

title: Crescete e moltiplicatevi
actors: Raymond Pellegrin, Lionel Stander, Rosalba Neri, Francesca Romana Coluzzi
description: Placido lives surrounded by women: his wife, daughter, maid and even a sister-in-law in a convent. Due to a set of circumstances (and by different males, including himself), each of them will end up expecting a baby.
notes: A vaguely libertine comedy, which struggles to take off despite a group of high-level performers.

title: Jing wu men
actors: Bruce Lee, Nora Miao, Jun Arimura, Robert Baker, Fu Ching Chen
description: Shanghai, 1908: two kung fu training centers face each other in the city, one Chinese and the other Japanese. When the Chinese school teacher is killed by his rivals, his disciple Bruce Lee's revenge will be relentless.
notes: First, a real worldwide success of the martial arts legend.

title: Dive Bomber
actors: Errol Flynn, Fred MacMurray, Ralph Bellamy, Alexis Smith
description: Aviation Commander Joe Blake has developed a special system to reduce the effects of pressure at height, but doctors Douglas Lee and Lance Rogers are not entirely convinced of the project. Blake, however, does not give up and experiments on himself, managing to prove its effectiveness while paying a very high price. The sentimental rivalry between Lee and Blake, divided by the common attraction for the same woman, also contributes to complicate the situation.
notes: Shot in some real Californian naval bases and aboard the aircraft carrier "Enterprise", the film boasts some highly spectacular sequences, in addition to the "guarantees" Flynn and MacMurray.

title: Par le sang des autres
actors: Yves Beneyton, Mylène Demongeot, Georges Géret, Francis Blanche, Bernard Blier
description: In a small town, an event that causes a sensation occurs: an individual with an unstable psyche kidnaps two people and threatens to assassinate them; to desist from his crazy purpose, he demands that a girl, the most beautiful in the village, be delivered to him. The latter spontaneously offers him her love and everything seems to be resolved for the best, but the tragedy is in the air: the madman agrees to surrender but his father, shocked by shame, kills him.
notes: Full-bodied drama of madness set in the French province, supported by a cast of respect which also includes the old Charles Vanel and our Mariangela Melato.

title: Timeshare
actors: Nastassja Kinski, Timothy Dalton, Kevin Zegers, Cameron Finley
description: Gwen decides that the best way to introduce her children to her new boyfriend, Russell, is to spend a vacation all together on Nantucket Island. But her new man's work commitments prevent him from leaving. Meanwhile Matt Farragher, a charismatic chef, leaves for Nantucket Island with his two children and shows up in the same house as Gwen. Inexplicably, the seaside villa was rented to both the Wilands and the Farraghers, thus forced into a forced coexistence which at first turns out to be quite disastrous. But things change when ...

title: Jules et Jim
actors: Jeanne Moreau, Oskar Werner, Henri Serre, Marie Dubois
description: The relationship of deep affection that binds two friends, the French Jim and the Austrian Jules, is abruptly upset by the dazzling encounter with Catherine, the woman they both fall in love with. Nevertheless, neither the common passion nor the outbreak of the Great War - which sees them on opposing sides - will be able to divide them ...
notes: Truffaut (and co-writer Jean Gruault) adapt the novel of the same name by Henri-Pierre Roché and make a free and poignant film, in which the work on the figures of the cinematographic language produces, at times, moments of pure emotion (the first appearance of Catherine , the ride on the bridge). Epochal

title: Another Woman's Husband
actors: Lisa Rinna, Gail O'Grady, Dale Midkiff, Donna Hanover
description: Laurel, a brilliant psychologist, has not yet overcome the violent trauma caused, twenty-five years earlier, by having to witness the drowning of her little brother without being able to intervene. Now finally, having made the decision to deal with the phobia of water that has plagued her ever since, Laurel asks for help from Susan, a swimming instructor at the local pool, who for her part feels that environment as the only one able to communicate them. tranquility and security. The psychological situations of the two women, different but complementary, favor the forging of a strong friendship: both, however, love the same man ...

title: Alphaville: une étrange aventure de Lemmy Caution
actors: Eddie Constantine, Anna Karina, Akim Tamiroff, Howard Vernon
description: Agent Lemmy Caution must carry out an investigation in Alphaville, a city of the future dominated by computers where feelings are eliminated and a kind of Newspeak is spoken. Orwellian metaphor on advanced capitalism, but also Godardian fun on popular cinema (Constantine really played the spinistic B-series detective stories). An anti-Bond of refined experimentalism, with an imploded plot, which in its own way has made school.

title: Menglong guojiang
actors: Bruce Lee, Nora Miao, Chuck Norris, Malisa Longo, George Wall
description: Some friends of Yan-Chen, in Rome, are extorted by the men of the Triads, the powerful Chinese mafia. He naturally reacts to the henchmen, and sets the city on fire. The mobsters, in response, unleash three champions of karate and assorted martial arts on him. Yan-Chen will end up knocking them all down like skittles.
notes: The unstoppable Little Dragon in one of his best films. Having become a star, Bruce Lee chooses to direct alone and makes his choreographies even more plastic. The fight with Chuck Norris at the Colosseum remains a cornerstone of action cinema. In a small part, Malisa Longo.

title: Missione speciale Lady Chaplin
actors: Ken Clark, Daniela Bianchi, Jacques Bergerac, Helga Liné, Mabel Karr
description: Special Agent Malloy has a new mission, uncovering the plans of "rival" Arabella Chaplin, known in the spy world as "Lady Chaplin". The woman does not know that she is being threatened by an accomplice, who also does everything to get Malloy out of the way. Between double games and cold war intrigues, the two secret agents will be able to find the right understanding.
notes: In the wake of the James Bond films with Sean Connery, a self-sufficient spy story of a certain interest and with a fundamental presence for the genre: Daniela Bianchi, unforgettable Bond-girl of "A 007 From Russia with love".

title: Nashville
actors: Keith Carradine, Ronee Blakley, Karen Black, Barbara Harris, Geraldine Chaplin, Allen Garfield
description: For five days the city of Nashville becomes the center around which a series of intertwined stories gravitate. In the background, a gathering of pop and country musicians, organized to support the electoral campaign of an ambiguous and populist candidate. Eventually one of the singers will die on stage, amid general indifference.
notes: One of the fundamental works to understand the America (and cinema) of the post-'68 "restoration". No one like Altman has been able to translate into cinematographic form - the editing, the sound, the staging - the sense of total disorientation and "loss of center" that pervaded the society of those years.

title: Una notte al cimitero
actors: Gian Marco Tognazzi, Beatrice Ring, Lino Salemme
description: Five young thugs rob a supermarket and decide to spend the whole night in a makeshift shelter, which is actually a catacomb. They believe that under there is an old treasure of inestimable value and instead they will find only ferocious zombies and vampires of arcane lineage. All guests of the real hostess, Death!
notes: Paratelevisivo horror by Lamberto Bava all built on wandering in the labyrinth. The story, the acting and even the blood are reduced to a minimum. Given the rarity for fans it is a remarkable gem, but to enjoy it you have to be very good-mouthed.

title: La peau douce
actors: Françoise Dorléac, Jean Desailly, Nelly Benedetti
description: A writer falls madly in love with a beautiful hostess. For her he decides to leave his wife and children but the girl, instead of accepting a cohabitation, refuses him. The writer decides to return to his family. His wife, however, blinded by jealousy, causes a tragedy.
notes: François Truffaut stages a plot of classic melodrama in his own way, favoring detachment from the story without letting the viewer be fully involved. It is certainly one of the most unsolved films of the French filmmaker, but with great moments of poetics.

title: La morte ha fatto l'uovo
actors: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Gina Lollobrigida, Ewa Aulin, Giulio Donnini
description: Two wealthy owners of a chicken farm are targeted by the diabolical and awake niece, who wants to eliminate her aunt by putting the blame on her uncle. But the man, trying to disintegrate the woman's corpse in the machine that grinds the ground, ends up in it. Surprise ending.
notes: Cult title of the Italian thriller, made limp by a cerebral script but strong in an exquisitely kitsch staging. Great Lollo in an absolutely unlikely part, but the presence that is remembered most is that of Ewa Aulin (the girl).

title: The Mummy
actors: Christopher Lee, Yvonne Furneaux, Peter Cushing, Eddie Byrne
description: The minister of worship Kharis, mummified in ancient Egypt, comes back to life to avenge the desecration of his own tomb. He wants to exterminate the English archaeological expedition responsible for the excavations, but a doctor of the group, very similar to the Egyptian princess Anaka, tries to avert the curse.
notes: Classic English horror by Hammer, remake of the American one of 1932 and starring a Christopher Lee "dusty" but in great shape. Not one of Terence Fisher's best films, but still remarkable in its mélo implications. Gorgeous Yvonne Furneaux. The last half hour leaves you breathless.

title: Rewind
actors: Raoul Bova, Luca Zingaretti, Maruschka Detmers, Niels Arestrup
description: Paul Mansart serves a life sentence in Berlin. The charge is of murder, terrorism and an armed gang. But his alleged former comrades, still at large, continue in their death actions following a diabolical but very precise pattern. Paul, who has always pleaded innocent, agrees to cooperate with the authorities. So he undergoes an unprecedented, but very dangerous, experiment.
notes: Italian TV-movie of little resonance but with a remarkable cast. Set largely in Berlin, it features a beautiful Maruschka Detmers and the great Luca Zingaretti (Montalbano).

title: Cast Away
actors: Tom Hanks, Helen Hunt, Nick Searcy, Chris Noth, Lari White
description: Chuck Noland is a Federal Express engineer. His task is to solve problems, streamline delivery procedures, facilitate the exchange of objects between a sender and a recipient. And its expertise extends to the entire delivery organization in the world. This is why its existence is held hostage by a very tight and very suffocating mesh. Naturally, Chuck never has enough time for himself, for girlfriend Kelly, for friends, for a life that has even the semblance of normalcy. It is a subjectless appearance of modernity. It lives on particles, it feeds on accelerated communication because the pauses have lost all value and the questions about being in the world are useless philosophical waste. This abnormal simulation of the present crashes and crashes into the ocean, along with a plane, off a desert island. At that point Chuck is alone, without means, forced to silence and to review all those that have been his priorities up to now ...
notes: Hanks and Zemeckis trust, denying the immateriality looming over contemporary fiction, in an anthropocentric cinema, made up of elementary emotions and gestures, of essential questions, of anti-technological perplexities, with the myth of Robinson Crusoe and Ulysses, with the culture of home base as in baseball, of destiny that does not coincide with the freeze-dried one of reality TV, of objects that are tools and not a glossy reflection of consumption, of the paradoxical need for a new prehistory.

title: Tillsammans
actors: Lisa Lindgren, Michael Nyqvist, Gustav Hammarsten, Anja Lundkvist
description: "Franco is dead", the news suddenly arrives and happily upsets the life of the hippy community of Tillsammans. We are in the chaotic, messed up seventies and those young people are looking, in the desire to pool public and private, for a way to fight a society they despise. When Göran's sister, the peacemaker of all tension, arrives unexpectedly with her two children because her husband has beaten her, a slow upheaval of the community begins.
notes: The desire for rebellion is painted by Moodysson in a bittersweet style, too concerned with preventing tensions from exceeding the breaking point and overall it is less convincing than the previous "Fucking Åmål".

title: Red Planet
actors: Val Kilmer, Carrie-Anne Moss, Benjamin Bratt, Tom Sizemore
description: It is the year 2050: the survival of mankind is in grave danger, and a group of scientists is developing a project that plans to use the soil of Mars for the sowing of algae capable of producing oxygen. A crew made up of commander Kate Bowman and five other astronauts leaves for a reconnaissance: as soon as the landing is done, however, the problems begin ...
notes: Directed with orderly style by a rookie who comes from advertising, this example of science fiction "with a human face" is not boring but it is not even able to stimulate. The cast doesn't look well matched, and the best things are the set and the natural scenery.

title: Boiler Room
actors: Giovanni Ribisi, Vin Diesel, Ben Affleck, Nia Long, Nicky Katt
description: Young Seth has a natural knack for money and runs a clandestine gambling den with fellow college mates. He decides to take the plunge and gets hired by a heavily scamming brokerage company. They resell non-existent shares by exploiting the good faith of small savers. Eventually Seth finds out, but the FBI had been watching him for a while.
notes: The indictment that Ben Younger proposes to us with this film is precise and radical, a little less his script, which in the second part becomes predictable and rhetorical. The story of Seth's father-judge, with the good feelings of an American family, takes the edge off a story that deserved more wickedness.

title: Non ho sonno
actors: Max Von Sydow, Stefano Dionisi, Chiara Caselli, Rossella Falk
description: Commissioner Ulisse Moretti has retired after years of capturing ruthless killers and solving complicated cases. In the 1980s Moretti had solved, or at least all public opinion was convinced, the case of the crimes of the dwarf. But the murders have begun again in the same precise manner as in the past. Investigators charged with investigating the new crimes are groping in the dark despite the most up-to-date investigation techniques. Moretti is still needed to solve the case ...
notes: Without the horror side, which gives Argento extreme twists, the film proves even more embarrassing. Yellow presupposes a minimum of logic and respect for the viewer: in these parts, however, the plot is frayed, the situations ridiculous, the acting below guard level.

title: Princes et princesses
description: A boy, a girl and an elderly technician meet in an abandoned cinema in the evening. The three have fun inventing six stories featuring a prince, or would-be one and a princess. Guided by fantasy they will create beautiful stories set from time to time in the Middle Ages, in ancient Egypt, in ancient Japan and in the future. At the end there is also space for a witty episode.
notes: "Principi e princessesse" is a small film, but, in its own way, important, because it confirms the practicability and primacy of an animated cinema that diverges from that proposed by the big studios, which sacrifices the imagination on the altar of a technology that pursues an ever more pronounced likelihood. It is no coincidence, therefore, that in the face of an astonishing and fascinating richness of an image that is truer than truth, the great animated films increasingly show a worried weakness precisely on the side of fantasy, as if the "how" were more important rather that the "what" is told. Michel Ocelot has put together six television short stories produced over ten years ago and is launching his challenge. These are stories made with the two-dimensional technique of shadows. The result is truly grandiose, especially in the episode that borrows the paintings of the great Japanese painter and illustrator Hokusai.

title: Occidente
actors: Agnieszka Czekanska, Corso Salani, Gianluca Arcopinto, Fabio Sabbioni
description: Malvina lives and works in Aviano. Her life is punctuated between her work as a waitress in a pizzeria frequented by the soldiers of the NATO base and a nursing course. But Malvina, who was born in Romania, has an experience behind her that marked her: in 1989 she participated in the revolt against the Ceausescu regime. In Aviano she comes into contact with Alberto, an English teacher who loves her in silence.
notes: "Occidente" is a film about a thousand loneliness, a reticent love story set in a no man's land where politics, memory, feelings are zeroed. A no-man's land called North-East, Italy.

title: Ogni lasciato è perso
actors: Piero Chiambretti, Vanessa Asbert, Antonio Catania, Gretha Gavazzoni
description: Piero C. who has always considered Valeria the most important girl in his life, is dumped from one day to the next for no apparent reason. Piero, TV presenter of a successful program called "That's Amore" falls into a deep depression, so much so that he wants to end it. The intervention of the closest friends avoids the worst, but the road to Piero's sentimental reconstruction will not be an easy undertaking ...
notes: The "postman" gets the wrong address and exchanges a telegram with the letter about the feelings he would like to deliver. The viewer just has to send the package back to the sender.

title: Le gôut des autres
actors: Jean-Pierre Bacri, Agnès Jaoui, Anne Alvaro, Alain Chabat, Brigitte Catillon
description: Castella is a wealthy businessman deeply bored by the monotonous life he leads with his wife, an interior designer. In order to close a deal, he has to take English lessons from a teacher. The lessons and the woman turn out to be too boring, and so Castella decides to quit. But one evening, dragged by force to the theater, he is shocked by an actress and by the lines of Racine's _Bérénice_. Castella is so upset that he takes it into his head to be an actor: and when he discovers that the interpreter who has struck him is none other than his English teacher, he decides to return to attend her ...
notes: Once upon a time there was the Italian comedy. The only one in Europe capable of undermining the hypocrisies of morality and bourgeois customs. A pearl of the French comedy is this first work by the actress and screenwriter Agnès Jaoui, a work and life partner of another very vital personality, Jean-Pierre Bacri. Together they wrote, for example, _Smoking_ and _No Smoking_ for Resnais and _Aria di famiglia_ by Klapisch: three works that the Italians have guilty disregarded. The film is a brilliant metaphor for the richness of diversity. A "patrol" that updates Ophüls and pays homage to Truffaut (that ending at the theater: how can we not go back to _L'ultimo metro_?). Which has the magic of simple things. That devours curiosity and restlessness.

title: Criss Cross
actors: Burt Lancaster, Yvonne De Carlo, Dan Duryea, Stephen McNally
description: Steve Thompson has divorced his wife Anna, but he is still irresistibly attracted to her and is willing to do anything to get her back. Even taking the path of crime. In fact, Anna has remarried to the gangster Slim Dundee, and a plan begins to flash in Steve's mind: join Slim's gang for a heist, seize the stolen goods and escape with the charming and dangerous woman of his life. But fate cannot be escaped.
notes: The thematic repertoire of classic noir - the inexorability of fate, the beautiful and damned "dark lady" ... - finds a perfect synthesis in this exemplary film by Siodmak, one of the absolute masters of the genre.

title: Hell's Kitchen
actors: Angelina Jolie, Rosanna Arquette, William Forsythe, Mekhi Phifer
description: After serving five years in prison for a murder he didn't commit, Johnny returns to Hell's Kitchen, New York's legendary slum. Here he finds his ex-girlfriend waiting for him, who blames him for the death of her brother and intends to kill him. To stay out of trouble Johnny goes to Lou, a former boxer who works as a stable boy.
notes: Cinciripini, of whom it is difficult to say whether he is worse as a director or as a screenwriter, crams his frames with a hundred bungled narrative junctions. He mimics an already old American independent cinema and proves he's a cheeky illiterate.

title: Saturday Night and Sunday Morning
actors: Albert Finney, Shirley Ann Field, Rachel Roberts, Hylda Baker
description: Arthur, a young worker from Nottingham, actually has only one real passion: women. One of his lovers is the wife of a friend of his, but when she becomes pregnant Arthur causes her to have an abortion. It will be a girl of good principles, Doreen, to force him to put his love life in order.
notes: Karel Reisz's debut is also one of the guiding films of the English Free Cinema, of which he announces the founding characteristics: total freedom of expression and a merciless gaze on the contradictions of a changing society. Scripted by Alan Sillitoe, and embellished with the black and white of Freddie Francis and a great Albert Finney.

title: La femme de l'aviateur
actors: Philippe Marlaud, Marie Rivière, Anne-Laure Meury, Mathieu Carrière
description: There is something tender between Anne and the student François; but the latter, who is a little younger than her, has taken it into his head that there is still something between Anne and the "aviator", one of her exes. To find out more, she stalks the man with the complicity of Lucie, a cute and cute teenager. But Anne realizes this and decides to feed François's doubts and jealousy ...
notes: After the "Moral Tales", Rohmer inaugurates with this film a new series, "Comedies and Proverbs". On comedy cadences, the French director continues to fathom the themes he has always loved: the geometries of love, Chance, misunderstandings, coincidences ...

title: Luna Park
actors: Oleg Borisov, Andrei Gutin, Natalia Egorova, Nonna Mordyukova
description: Racism and anti-Semitism do not spare even the new post-communist Russia: Andrei, head of a gang that roams Moscow with the aim of "cleaning" it of Jews, is a perfect example of this. Andrej lives with his mother in an amusement park and has never met his father. But one day all his certainties collapse: he discovers that he himself has Jewish origins, and his life will never be the same again.
notes: After "Taxi blues", Longuine continues his journey in a country that the historical upheavals have made even more confused, ruthless and violent. And the film reproduces, even in its form, the disintegration and despair that shake it.

title: Onore e sangue
actors: Carlo Giuffrè, Lucia Banti, Otello Toso, Nerio Bernardi, Giacomo Furia
description: Ernesto, a bank employee married to a son, leads an apparently peaceful life. His mother's illness imposes heavy unexpected expenses on him, forcing him to contract debts. Giannone, his landlord, who is also the loan shark who was forced to ask for money on loan, orders him to be evicted. Dejected and upset, Ernesto decides to go to him to try to get a respite. Meanwhile Tobia and Arturo, Giannone's nephew and colleague of Ernesto's office, sneak into Giannone's apartment to rob him. There will be a shooting ...
notes: Far too modest film. The actors are barely saved.

title: Le beau mariage
actors: Béatrice Romand, André Dussollier, Feodor Atkine, Arielle Dombasle
description: The unique and all-encompassing aspiration of the student and antiques dealer Sabine is to bring the "right" person to the altar. At first she has to settle for a sporadic relationship with a married man, but at some point she decides to get serious and sets out in search of a full-blown husband. He thinks he has identified him as a young lawyer, but he does not take it for granted. But Sabine is not discouraged, and one day, on the train ...
notes: "Comedies and proverbs", chapter two: Rohmer's dialogues are so dense that they fill every single minute of the film; but the shackles of the "movie theater" are far away, and the reasons of cinema prevail.

title: Lo sgarbo
actors: Leonard Mann, Luis Vito Russo, Karin Schubert, Hélène Chanel
description: The picciotto Salvatore, returning from the United States, where he had some problems with the Cosa Nostra, is sent back to Sicily. He is entrusted to the tutelage of Don Mimì, boss of the Palermo mafia. Despite his handicap, he is forced into a wheelchair, Don Mimì has made himself a mistress. This is Marina, an orphan that the boss adopted at an early age. Salvatore's serious disgrace is that he puts his eyes on him, provoking the ire of Don Mimi. Hunted by his godfather's men, he is forced to flee to London where he becomes the head of the prostitution racket.
notes: Series B film with an Italian American actor who had had a small part in Coppola's "Godfather".

title: Murder on the Orient Express
actors: Albert Finney, Ingrid Bergman, Lauren Bacall, Martin Balsam, Jean-Pierre Cassel
description: A new and intricate case engages investigator Hercule Poirot: on the prestigious and legendary Paris-Istanbul convoy, frequented by a series of very varied and composite characters, a corpse is discovered. And there are really many who have good reasons to rejoice, which certainly does not help the fussy Belgian hound to shed some light on the story ...
notes: Set among the carriages of the real Orient Express, a canonical adaptation of the atmospheres dear to the ineffable Agatha Christie. Nothing more than what one might expect, but in the end the pleasure is right there. Oscar for Best Supporting Actress to Ingrid Bergman.

title: What Lies Beneath
actors: Harrison Ford, Michelle Pfeiffer, Diana Scarwid, James Remar, Miranda Otto
description: Dr. Norman Spencer and Claire are happily married and live in a villa on the lake that is far too isolated. While he works on genetic experiments, she stays at home and feels strange presences. The first suspicion is that the neighbor has killed his wife: he spies on him with binoculars and soon the trail turns out to be false. The fact remains that there is "someone" or something in the house: doors that do not close properly, paintings that fall without anyone touching them and that strange smoke coming out of the bathtub ...
notes: The ghosts of Alfred Hitchcock and Bernard Herrmann are everywhere, during the 130 minutes of the film: Zemeckis quotes in hand, starting from "The window on the courtyard" and arriving at "Rebecca"; Alan Silvestri disseminates orchestral cuts that hit the belt. Everything already seen, but the film works beautifully: it is a damn scary, and it forces you to jump along all the perilous hairpin bends of the script. The first part is the most insinuating, in the end it leads to a more well-known thriller. Hitchcock aside, Zemeckis proves to have read and digested Henry James's "Turn of the Screw": the persuasive way he makes the house bewitched is masterful. For at least 100 minutes the film is pure American Gothic, confirming that the Italian-Lithuanian Zemeckis knows the ghosts of his great country well.

title: What Planet Are You From?
actors: Annette Bening, Greg Kinnear, Garry Shandling, Linda Fiorentino
description: Four solar systems away from Earth, there is a planet whose inhabitants no longer have feelings and no longer know how to procreate. The remedy is to send one of them to Earth, with the task of impregnating an Earth woman with an artificial penis. The chosen one is H144-6, sent to Earth in the guise of Harold, a mortgage banker, who uses airplane toilets as an intergalactic teleportation. In his wandering Harold tries to carry out his mission.
notes: Played (written and produced) by an enigmatic "Larry Sanders Show" TV star Garry Shandling, the film oscillates between a desire to be a retelling of the politically incorrect "Earth Girls Are Easy" or a "Starman" romantic comedy. .

title: Il prezzo
actors: Stefano Dionisi, Chiara Caselli, Alessandro Repossi, Barbara Lerici
description: Romano, a former political militant, a former teacher who no longer wants to teach anyone anything, can't do without the bottle. Eight months after the end of their love story he asks Alba, an emerging photographer, to leave with him. With a broken liver and an uncertain future, Romano decided to go to the other side of the fence, into crime, involving (perhaps for revenge) the girl who hadn't believed in him.
notes: Stefanelli's debut, awarded in the '99 edition of Noir in Festival, has the courage to lean on a story that will never have a happy ending.

title: Memento
actors: Guy Pearce, Carrie-Anne Moss, Joe Pantoliano, Stephen Tobolowsky
description: Leonard Shelby, a professional investigator at an insurance company, is a thirty-year-old who suffers from a rare disease that does not allow him to keep his memories for more than a quarter of an hour. The man is in search of his wife's killer and every day he has to reconstruct what happened or discovered during the previous one. Polaroid photos, notes, tattoos, are the means by which he tries to build a grid of memories, resistant to the ambiguity of the investigation and the volatility of the disease, which allows him, perhaps, to arrive at some truth.
notes: The Nolan brothers (the director Christopher - here at the second work after the interesting _Following_ and not yet ventured with the big budgets of _Insomnia_ and _Batman Begins_ - and the screenwriter Jonathan, who adapts his short story _Memento mori_) force the viewer not to never give up on a baroque construction, full of flashbacks and flashforwards, of sudden changes from color to black and white. So the deep sense of noir is not lost: who does what and to whom! However, beyond sterile disquisitions on the respect or "betrayal" of genre conventions, the real trump card of the film lies in the ability to combine the complexity of the structure (although not exempt, at times, from a pinch of self-satisfaction) with a profound sense of disorientation and inner laceration, with authentic and non-artificial emotions, a commodity now rare in the asphyxiated panorama of contemporary cinema.

title: 102 Dalmatians
actors: Glenn Close, Gérard Depardieu, Alice Evans, Ioan Gruffudd
description: Three years have passed and Cruella De Mon has changed, she has stopped persecuting Dalmatians and has become a champion of the defense of animals. Everyone is in awe of her incredible transformation. However, some are not convinced that Cruella has put her head right. This is Chloe an official, a great lover of dogs, in charge of supervising her. Skepticism escalates when Cruella takes over a dog shelter set to close. The first to become suspicious is the director of the kennel.
notes: Both this film, directed by cartoonist Kevin Lima, and the previous one, by Stephen Herek, are the triumph of Glenn Close's stage presence, his arched eyebrows, his prominent cheekbones, his rampant mouth, his improbable two-tone hair, of the comic time with which he knows how to transform himself into an animated drawing worthy of the cruelty and self-harm of the Warner classics. And of course the triumph of that great costume designer who is Anthony Powell and of another star without restraint and without fear: Gérard Depardieu, who here plays the shoulder of Cruella, the famous furrier Le Pelt, built by Powell as a synthesis of the designers Karl Lagerfeld , John Galliano and Jean-Paul Gaultier. For the rest, the film slips on the usual narrative track, on an astonishing training of the four-legged interpreters, on some ironic rebound, of apt Disney-like self-quotation. Until the final collapse of Cruella the second lady, (after the "fattora" of "Galline in flight") to end up in a pastry dough.

title: Saving Grace
actors: Brenda Blethyn, Craig Ferguson, Martin Clunes, Tchéky Karyo
description: Her husband left Grace, "the best gardener in the world", a big debt. How to find £ 300,000 and outrun creditors, banks and jackals? The solution is suggested - almost involuntarily - by Grace's handyman, a young Scottish man who lives with a beautiful fisherwoman: growing cannabis in the greenhouse of the gardener, reselling it in London, making the necessary and starting from scratch ...
notes: The play is graceful, has roots planted in healthy provocation and makes use of a bevy of actors who contribute greatly to covering the gaps in the script and the directorial obviousness.

title: Taxi 2
actors: Samy Naceri, Frédéric Diefenthal, Marion Cotillard, Emma Sjöberg
description: The adventures of the reckless Marseille taxi driver Daniel, who rides in Zidane's shirt, and of the policeman Émilien continue. This time the two have to save the Japanese president, kidnapped by the yakuza. In addition to the clumsy Marseille police, they are also helped by an androgynous polyglot expert in martial arts, in love with Émilien.
notes: You understand everything about the film after 5 minutes: breathless pursuits, colliding cars, double meanings and forbidden meanings. But the mix is ??not boring, in a kind of cross between Louis de Funès and "Beverly Hills Cop", or rather "Hazzard". In its utter stupidity, between occult advertising at the Peugeot and ending at the Elysée, the film can also entertain.

title: Bodyguards
actors: Christian De Sica, Massimo Boldi, Megan Gale, Cindy Crawford
description: Fabio, Paolo and Ciro are three carabinieri who, in the course of a pursuit of a thief, destroy an ambush of the special forces who were capturing a drug trafficker. The three, disbarred from the weapon, have nothing to do but look for work at a bodyguard agency. But even here they make endless trouble.
notes: Neri Parenti's film is perfect to tell the story of Italy in 2000, perhaps the only country in the world where Megan Gale, Giletti, Marzullo, Anna Falchi and Cristina Parodi can participate in a film as themselves, as if they really existed. , and not just in the television blob / magma.

title: Husbands
actors: Ben Gazzara, Peter Falk, John Cassavetes, Jenny Runacre, Jenny Lee Wright
description: Three forties - Archie, Gus and Harry - meet up for a sad event (the funeral of a dear mutual friend), but then take advantage of the opportunity to party in the streets and clubs of New York, abandoning his wife and children for a couple days in an attempt to forget the anguish and misery of everyday life. They will even go to London, but only one of them will decide to stay there ...
notes: In the hands of John Cassavetes, cinema has been transformed into a real scalpel of the individual and collective conscience. Merciless yes, but also imbued with a boundless humanity. Great actors, but an Italian edition to say the least massacred.

title: Minnie and Moskowitz
actors: Gena Rowlands, Seymour Cassel, Val Avery, Timothy Carey
description: Minnie works at the museum, has a decent family but is not very familiar with men. Moskowitz, on the other hand, works as a valet, has a singular appearance to say the least (mustache and ponytail) and a rather ... instinctive way of doing things. Nobody would be able to think of them together, but that's perhaps why they fall in love.
notes: One of the lightest and most entertaining films by Cassavetes, in which, however, there is no lack of ideas and reflections - albeit in a bittersweet tone - on loneliness and the lack of communication in the contemporary metropolis. Great (but this is not new) Rowlands and Cassel, supported by a perfectly timed batch of supporting actors.

title: It Had to Be You
actors: Michel Vartan, Joelle Carter, David Healy II, Natasha Henstridge
description: Claire, a glamorous career woman, is busy working out the details of her marriage to Charlie. To this end, he plans a weekend to spend at the prestigious Plaza Hotel, but the usual unprovable work commitments make his project skip. Charlie resigns himself to spending a couple of days in solitude; the case has however arranged that Anna Penn also arrives at the Plaza, a teacher who in turn is about to marry her boyfriend David. And given that the latter is also held out of town at the last moment, the conditions for a meeting between Charlie and Anna (and for a new love) are all there ...

title: Det sjunde inseglet
actors: Max Von Sydow, Gunnar Björnstrand, Bengt Ekerot, Bibi Andersson, Nils Poppe
description: Fresh from the Crusades, the knight Antonius Block returns to his homeland, however, finding only misery and dismay. The plague reaped its victims mercilessly, and even on the road to Block, now emptied of all faith, a black figure appears: it is Death himself, who has come to claim his soul. But Block asks for time: he will agree to gamble his life in a game of chess, while meeting a family of street artists gives him hope back.
notes: The metaphysical anxieties of the Swedish master, set in a barbaric medieval scenario, take shape in a clear and blinding black and white, full of references and pictorial suggestions.

title: Efter repetitionen
actors: Erland Josephson, Lena Olin, Ingrid Thulin, Nadja Palmstjerna-Weiss, Bertil Guve
description: After the rehearsal of a staging of Strindberg's "Dream", during an interview between the director Henrik Vogler and an actress of his company, the young Anna, the dimension of reality dissolves in visions and memories. Anna is in turn the daughter of an actress, Rakel, who died some time ago destroyed by the demon of alcohol. But now the ghost of the woman has returned to visit Anna and Henrik, and from the dialogues between the three characters a complex tangle of crossed passions and impulses emerges little by little.
notes: The essentiality of the Bergmanian staging at the service of a suffered and personal "kammerspiel" poised between cinema and theater.

title: Lust for a Vampire
actors: Yutte Stensgaard, Ralph Bates, Barbara Jefford, Suzanna Leigh, Michael Johnson
description: The writer Richard goes to the village near the Karnstein castle to collect material for his new novel. Here he learns of the periodic disappearance of some girls in the country: intrigued, Richard gets hired as a teacher of English literature in the girls' boarding school run by Miss Simpson and falls in love with his colleague Mircalla. Richard is not even impressed by the strange stories Giles tells him about the girl ...
notes: Typical Hammer production: guaranteed terror. The film was supposed to be directed by Terence Fisher, who was injured a few days before filming began.

title: The 6th Day
actors: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Tony Goldwyn, Michael Rapaport, Sarah Wynter
description: In every shopping center it is possible to clone small pets that are no longer there and you can share the joys and laziness at home with a caring and busty virtual girl. Replicants and digital projections sweeten death and loneliness. Only the cloning of human beings, while technically possible, is prohibited by law. But a villain billionaire aided by a scientist, makes illegal experiments in a secret laboratory between urns with cocoons of bodies immersed in a primordial soup. The double of Alan Gibson is born from their workshop, ordinary family man, pilot and owner of some helicopters. Man's identity, affections and life are stolen.
notes: Roger Spottiswoode is engulfed, confused, between action, thriller and science fiction. What would become such a topical subject in the hands of David Cronenberg.

title: Domani
actors: Valerio Mastandrea, Ornella Muti, Niccolò Senni, Ilaria Occhini
description: The earth trembles. In a few, eternal seconds, the cracks tear the walls of houses, churches, schools and those same cracks open deep gashes in the heads and habits of the inhabitants of Cacchiano. Imaginary Umbrian village, known for its garlic salami factory and a fresco by Fra Angelico. Everyone, terrified and screaming, suddenly wakes up in the night. They will be, for an indefinite period, without a roof and without a just law that favors reconstruction.
notes: In the new topography, torn, narrow, uncomfortable, Francesca Archibugi accompanies with a dry style, with some humorous accent and a certain compassion, the many stories of a collective protagonist: normal people. Assuming that ordinary people can still be told in the cinema who do not think they are cast as members of a social rite. His cinematic obsessions (kids), attention to feelings and melancholy optimism are back. The actors are well directed and good at communicating a crumbling that seems unstoppable and the unsatisfied expectation of a future that is little different from the past razed to the ground by the earthquake. The memory of Victor Cavallo is beautiful.

title: Wo de fu qin mu qin
actors: Zhang Ziyi, Zhao Yuelin, Sun Honglei, Zheng Hao, Lin Bin, Chang Guifa
description: A young teacher arrives in a remote village of revolutionary China in 1958. Zhao Di, the most beautiful girl in the village, falls in love with that educated young man at first sight and does everything to win him over. He will have to wait two years and the political rehabilitation of the teacher: then they will marry and live together until 1999, when the death of the man causes the return to the village of his son, now urbanized and overwhelmed by work in pre-Dengian China. The young man thus finds his mother, determined to bury her husband according to tradition: the coffin must be carried behind, so that the dead person does not forget the way home. But where to find the necessary men in the depopulated village?
notes: As before "The story of Qiu Ju" and "No less than one" is the story of a courageous and stubborn woman, as well as a parable about the encounter / clash between modernity and tradition. Zhang Yimou shoots with a virtuoso style, dripping close-ups (almost all dedicated to the young, splendid Zhang Ziyi, also protagonist of "The Tiger and the Dragon") and cross fades. The academy is just a step further, but the intensity and simplicity of the love story are such as to save the film for a corner; and to make it a moving, wonderful homage to the love that triumphs over everything. Even on feudal-Maoist China, and sorry if it is little.

title: The Lemon Sisters
actors: Diane Keaton, Carol Kane, Kathryn Grody, Elliott Gould, Rubén Blades
description: Three women, Eloise, Franki and Nola perform in the magical eighties on the stage of the most famous clubs in Atlantic City. Their repertoire is entirely based on the songs of the bands that had success in the sixties.
notes: Fun comedy with a trio of wild performers.

title: Shadow Warriors II: Hunt for the Death Merchant
actors: Hulk Hogan, Shannon Tweed, Carl Weathers, Martin Kove, Mike White
description: In a previous adventure, the strong-willed Hulk Hogan defeated an opponent who had tried to kill him and his people using chemical-biological weapons. Mistakenly believed dead, he returns to circulation and again threatens Hogan, who reacts to the attack but is infected with a deadly virus that leaves him only 72 hours to live. Naturally the Hulk team goes on the counterattack, nullifying the villain's criminal designs. As for the Hulk ...
notes: What else to expect from former wrestling champion Hogan if not some action and lots and lots of blows? Also participating in the match is Carl Weathers, the Apollo Creed of the first four "Rocky".

title: Commedia sexy
actors: Alessandro Benvenuti, Ricky Tognazzi, Elena Sofia Ricci, Roberto Brunetti
description: A father and a mother, after having accompanied their children on a school trip, approach a girl who turns out to be the lover of their best friend married to Marcella. The dream of an evening of sex and tequila turns into a nightmare.
notes: Title, atmosphere and language of the Italian erotic cinema of the seventies. Of course, Renzo Montagnani and the queens of the mandatory shower are missing, but marital status and income bracket have not changed. The farce of free trade, despite (professionally) gifted actors and the acceleration of dialogues, does not work, does not free itself from triviality and takes refuge in final moralism. These are just jokes.

title: Lost Souls
actors: Winona Ryder, Ben Chaplin, Sarah Wynter, Philip Baker Hall
description: Escaped from a dark and tormented past thanks to her faith and the intervention of Father Lareaux, Maya has been snatched from the clutches of the devil. The priest encouraged her to follow a group of priests who are convinced that Satan will enter the body of a human being. Then one day Maya meets Peter, a best-selling author who is convinced that the Prince of Evil does not exist; their fates are intertwined when they participate in an exorcism authorized by the Church ...
notes: Kaminski's film (Oscar for the photography of _Schindler's List_ and _Save the soldier Ryan_) attempts to rise from genre cinema with a photograph (of course) very well-kept and refined, with excesses of soft focus and slow motion, falling into the opposite defect of mannerism (almost inevitable defect of every new director of photography in direction) Horror becomes less stringent, unraveled in an overflowing and counter-productive elegance.

title: Red River Range
actors: John Wayne, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune, Louise Brooks, Anthony Marsh
description: A mysterious gang steals shipments of gold from a mine. A cowboy, Stony Books, to try to save the fruit of the miners' labor proposes to transport the precious cargo by plane. The bandits do not give up, they seize the airplane. Luckily Stony intervenes ...
notes: Sherman directs 31-year-old John Wayne.

title: Cacciatori di dote
actors: Rossella Como, Fanfulla, Gloria Paul, Riccardo Garrone, Alberto Lionello
description: Manlio, an avant-garde walker, sets his sights on Alba, a former dancer, widow of a South American billionaire. Carlo, a noble without the beak of a penny, has also set his sights on her. But when it is learned that the woman may have killed her sweet and rich half ...
notes: Farce of little interest.

title: Amore mio spogliati che poi ti spiego
actors: Nino Castelnuovo, Enzo Cerusico, Umberto D'Orsi, Silvia Dionisio
description: Doctor Alberto Donati, a state employee, does not in any way encourage the courtship of his secretary Rossana as he is happily engaged to Cristina. Investigator Biancofiore informs him, however, that Cristina is having a good time with Giuliano, Alberto's best friend, interspersing her embraces with those of Benita and Helga. Offended and determined to take revenge, Alberto causes Giuliano's three lovers to meet and fight. So, after making life difficult for the enterprising Don Juan, he leaves Cristina and consoles himself with Rossana.
notes: Scipita rehashing of the clichés of the Italian erotic.

title: One More Train to Rob
actors: George Peppard, Diana Muldaur, John Vernon, France Nuyen
description: Three outlaws land a robbery, but one of them is arrested. Released from jail, he goes in search of his accomplices, who in the meantime have bought a ranch. He claims his share of the loot but is refused, and the use of weapons is inevitable.
notes: Western by order, without infamy and without praise.

title: Tampopo
actors: Tsutomu Yamazaki, Nobuko Miyamoto, Koji Yakusho, Mario Abe
description: Goro is a truck driver who travels many kilometers up and down the Giapppone every day with his second. Hungry, they decide to stop in a small place run by Tampopo, a woman who struggles to make a living with the few regulars. A widow with a child with character problems finds no one to give her a hand. Indeed, there are those who create problems for her: it is her suitor Pisken. Goro, pitying her condition, teaches her to cook a spaghetti soup which, according to the truck driver, cannot fail to meet the appreciation of customers.
notes: Itami tries to ridicule some habits of his compatriots by partially hitting the target.

title: Aus dem Leben der Marionetten
actors: Robert Atzorn, Christine Buchegger, Heinz Bennent, Martin Benrath
description: Peter Egermann is an established professional, he has a beautiful wife, he is surrounded by well-being. Precisely for this reason the crime of which he becomes the protagonist appears even more unmotivated and absurd: the rape and strangulation of a prostitute, which leads him to internment in a criminal asylum. An act for which no one (the magistrate, the psychiatrist, the wife, the mother) is able to come up with a plausible explanation.
notes: Bergman sets a distressing and in some ways unpleasant story in an icy and aseptic scenario, in which he returns to raise the unanswered questions about the human condition that run through his entire filmography.

title: Long de xin
actors: Jackie Chan, Sammo Hung, Mang Hoi, Yuen Wah, Chin Lok Kar
description: A Hong Kong policeman, too busy looking after his mentally disabled brother, falls into the trap of a group of criminals involved in the trafficking of valuables. The bandits kidnap his brother, and force the cop to work for them.
notes: Sammo Hung and Jackie Chan were one of the most famous "comedy" couples in Hong Kong cinema. Together they have created the formula of the Asian "buddy buddy movie", the action comedy that also looks to our Spencer-Hill. "First mission" sanctions the (almost) definitive dissolution of the couple, and a bit of listlessness is evident.

title: Bleeders
actors: Rutger Hauer, Roy Dupuis, Jackie Burroghs, Kristin Lehman
description: John Strauss, along with his wife Kathleen, returns to New England, where his ancestors lived, and discovers that his home country is under the influence of an ancient superstition. Strange little men roam at night, and strange things happen in that villa next to the cemetery. John will discover that one of the local families, the Van Daam, has reproduced itself since ancient times by generating monsters with "pure" blood.
notes: Vaguely inspired by the atmospheres of the great horror writer H.P. Lovecraft, a B-series film destined for the home video market, with some interesting twists. Rutger Hauer, however, is increasingly a victim of his artistic decline.

title: Scusi, facciamo l'amore?
actors: Pierre Clementi, Claudine Auger, Carlo Caprioli, Edwige Feuillère, Beba Loncar, Juliette Mayniel, Tanya Lopert, Valentina Cortese, Massimo Girotti, Martine Malle
description: Lallo di San Marcello arrives in Milan from Naples to attend the funeral of his father, a man who has always lived behind the old ladies of the Lombard bourgeoisie. In reality, Lallo arrived in the capital with the intention of taking the place left vacant by his parent. To begin with, he has an affair with his aunt, then with the woman who hosts him, and finally with a series of respectable and wealthy women. But one day Lallo falls in love with the daughter of his father's friend and would like to marry her, but there are those who oppose the union.
notes: The film tries the custom satire. Screenplay by Caprioli himself with the collaboration of Enrico Medio and Franca Valeri. Soundtrack composed of Ennio Morricone.

title: Rosamunde Pilcher: Dornen im Tal der Blumen
actors: Ursula Karven, Miroslav Nemec, Siemen Rühaak, Vanessa Jung
description: Charlotte, a young art teacher, has recently moved to the countryside in the home of elderly Winfred, after being disappointed by her boyfriend, an art dealer, who has always refused to marry her. Charlotte meets Gerald, an architect, with whom she immediately establishes a deep understanding.

title: The Fox and the Hound
directors: Art Stevens, Ted Berman, Richard Rich
description: Red fox cub and Toby the little dog meet in the woods and become inseparable friends. The hound, however, is trained by his master for hunting, and soon realizes that his friend fox will be among the prey. When Toby is in big trouble (he has fallen into the clutches of a bear), Red does not hesitate to intervene to try to save his life ...
notes: Disney's sixteenth film, costing $ 12 million, is a parable about tolerance and true friendship that, without giving up the happy ending, takes on unusually dark and dramatic tones for a cartoon intended for children. Among the animators figure, albeit uncredited, the great Tim Burton.

title: Friday
actors: Ice Cube, Chris Tucker, Nia Long, Tom Lister jr., John Witherspoon
description: Life in the black ghetto of South Central, Los Angeles, is tough, and Craig Jones has learned it the hard way. But during a Friday further misfortunes seem to be raging on him: at first he loses his job, then he has to unravel it with his petulant girlfriend and with his friend Smokey who gives him torment. For Craig, before night falls, the imperative is to put a patch on the various mess he has run into: not least the confrontation with the grim Don Deebo, the boss of the neighborhood ...
notes: Coarse-grained "black" humor with a hip-hop background, in which slang implications and double meanings are inevitably flattened by dubbing.

title: Le Miroir à deux faces
actors: Michèle Morgan, Bourvil, Ivan Desny, Georgette Anys, Candida
description: Pierre, an elderly high school teacher, meets Marie José, thanks to an advertisement in a newspaper, a woman with a deformed and ridiculous nose. Despite this physical defect Pierre convinces the woman to marry him. Due to a car accident, Pierre is forced to spend a long period in the clinic of Dr. Bosc, a well-known cosmetic surgeon. Unbeknownst to her husband, Marie undergoes the operation. The sudden and unexpected transformation provokes a blind grudge in Pierre. The man no longer wants to live with a woman who is totally different from the one he had chosen and separates.
notes: Good performance by Bourvil and Michèle Morgan.

title: Afraid of the Dark
actors: Ben Keyworth, James Fox, Fanny Ardant, Robert Stephens
description: Little Lucas is terrified that his blinded mother could be the next victim of a serial killer. He himself therefore sets out on the trail of the criminal in an attempt to determine his identity, a task that his father (a policeman) was unable to complete. The fact is that Lucas has a very lively imagination, which inevitably casts a shadow of ambiguity and indeterminacy on the whole affair.
notes: The choice to concentrate the suspense mechanism on the oscillations of the child's psyche allows the film to keep the viewer's attention sufficiently awake. Great cast.

title: Domenica
actors: Claudio Amendola, Domenica Giuliano, Annabella Sciorra, Peppe Servillo
description: Sunday is not a public holiday, but the name of a Neapolitan girl who, during her 11 years of life, has known few parties. Orphan, already shrewd and skilled, she must go with Inspector Sciarra to the morgue to recognize the fool who raped her (and who in the meantime died: perhaps suicidal, perhaps killed by a violent cop) ...
notes: The sad character of the policeman touches the boundaries of the stereotype, but leads Amendola to work under the lines, with class. The debutante Domenica Giuliano is a real "movie animal": instinctive, angry, arrogant, she eats the camera and puts the whole film on her shoulders.

title: L'ultimo bacio
actors: Stefano Accorsi, Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Stefania Sandrelli, Marco Cocci, Giorgio Pasotti
description: Carlo is a thirty year old in full emotional and existential crisis, as are his four friends, Adriano, Paolo, Alberto and Marco. It is true that he is marrying the twenty-seven-year-old and romantic Giulia, but when he meets the eighteen-year-old Francesca he goes into crisis. Anna, Giulia's mother, fifty years old with twenty-nine years of marriage behind her, is afraid of getting old and cannot resign herself to the fact that her youth is over forever.
notes: The film is a fresco of feelings, today, here. Suspended on the edge of comedy, he never sinks into tragedy (not even in the passage - perhaps the best - of his father's death, which recalls _Magnolia_). Gabriele Muccino is anxious to "fix" everyone: those who remain (hooked by the responsibility of an oncoming daughter and the love of a woman) and those who leave on a minibus towards the African desert. The most symptomatic sentence of a rather well written script (for the average Italian) is: "Normality is the real revolution". Maybe that's true, but maybe it needs to be investigated a bit. The problem is twofold. Muccino is very good, perhaps too good, and he knows it; therefore he never stops (with the camera, tireless, with music, omnipresent, with history, infinite - in the sense that it has multiple endings), he performs, he wants to please. But (and this is the second problem), it wants to please so much that it ends up remaining on the volatile surface of things, faces, feelings, relationships.

title: Meet the Parents
actors: Robert De Niro, Ben Stiller, Teri Polo, Blythe Danner, Nicole DeHuff
description: Greg is so in love with Pam that he is ready to ask her parents for the hand of the girl. A phone call announcing the upcoming wedding of Pam's younger sister makes him change his mind. The trip to New York for her sister's wedding thus becomes an opportunity to introduce herself to Pam's parents. Upon arriving, Greg realizes that he will have to work hard to get "permission" to marry Pam.
notes: The film, which had all the characteristics to be a brilliant comedy, in the end is like a dish cooked by a poor or distracted cook, or (as is probable) unable to handle refined and precise (cooking) times like those of comedy.

title: The Family Man
actors: Nicolas Cage, Téa Leoni, Don Cheadle, Jeremy Piven, Saul Rubinek
description: Jack left London thirteen years ago to practice at a prestigious American company. At the time of his departure he had promised his fiancée to Kate that he would only be away from her for a year. On Christmas Eve, Jack is a single with a good lifestyle who works on Wall Street and who no longer remembers what Kate's face is. In the shelter of the home, the man falls asleep and wakes up next to Kate who is thirteen years older.
notes: The performers work hard to spark vitality, but Téa Leoni is all a quirk of overacting, and Nicolas Cage ends up having two expressions: paraphrasing a joke about Eastwood, with the fashionable underpants of a broker and with the boxers of a family man. .

title: Sos laribiancos - I dimenticati
actors: Lucio Salis, Sandro Ghiani, Vanni Fois, Alex Partexano, Anna Maria Petrova
description: Russian front, World War II. A group of poor people from Arasolè, an imaginary town in Sardinia, meet to fight a war in an unknown country that makes their struggle for survival even more difficult. The hunger and misery suffered on the island are nothing compared to the madness of the white front.
notes: The title in Sardinian means "Those with white lips", a slang expression that indicates the poor, the damned of the earth and is also the title of the novel by Francesco Masala which inspired it. The film is a tribute to them, to the forgotten. Piero Livi, a life as a Rai director, has been cradling this project for years. At the time he had talked about it with the great Giuseppe De Santis who had encouraged him, calling him an ideal following of "Italians good people". The film is effective in the parts of the war, marked by a very raw realism (stragglers and hungry, the soldiers go to cannibalism) and by a painful sense of conflict (there is no patriotism in the way, being captured by the Russians is the only hope of salvation). It works less in certain oneiric openings, a bit of a manner and not very resolved on a figurative level.

title: Shadow of the Vampire
actors: John Malkovich, Willem Dafoe, Catherine McCormack, Eddie Izzard
description: Somewhere in Eastern Europe in 1921. A German director Friedrich Wilhelm Murnau is about to start filming "Nosferatu, the Vampire", a vampire film inspired by Bram Stoker's "Dracula". To put the face of Count Orlock under whose guise the undead is hiding, Murnau relies heavily on the interpretation of Max Schreck, a mysterious actor. In the world of cinema it is rumored that Max is truly a vampire ...
notes: Didactic, verbose, unnecessarily slow, the film throws a good opportunity to the wind. Mehrige has a smug and arrogant writing. Impressive the camouflage of Malkovich and Dafoe in their respective characters.

title: Krámpack
actors: Fernando Ramallo, Jordi Vilches, Marieta Orozco, Esther Nubiola
description: It's summer and a seaside town is filled with kids from nearby Barcelona. Sixteen year old Dani and close friend Nico have an erotic ritual (which they call "krámpack") suspended between curiosity and homosexual tendencies. Elena and Berta, two girls of their age, feel attracted to them and try an approach.
notes: Based on a play by Jordi Sánchez, the film tells with simplicity a season of life in which one is suspended, in every sense: a boy who will become homosexual, another perhaps not, for all four the first erotic experiences are intense but not satisfying. The film is struck by the desire to break out of the clichés of recent Spanish cinema: there is no trace of the excesses of Almodóvar, instead there are very measured dialogues and a slight touch of comedy in telling a story without drama, as open as its ending. The girls are much more enterprising than their peers, who live with greater torment a virile friendship that has a profoundly different meaning for them and navigate the world discovering step by step the little secrets of everyday life. Presented at the Giffoni festival, where one of the performers (Fernando Ramallo) even received the Lifetime Achievement Award, "Krámpack" recalls French teenage comedies for certain atmospheres, even if the work is all about the script and not the way of telling.

title: Nowhere Land
actors: Peter Dobson, Dina Meyer, Jon Polito, Francesco Quinn, Martin Kove
description: Dean, a former prisoner, is forced to hide in a remote refuge in the mountains awaiting a trial against organized crime in which he is the key witness. Of course, the underworld does not stand idle, and instructs two killers to silence him forever. But the FBI also takes its countermeasures: Monica, an attractive agent who nevertheless proves to be quite up to the situation, is destined to protect Dean.
notes: Needless to say, the film is the usual heated soup; the only curiosity is the presence in the cast of Jon Polito, a faithful member of the Coen brothers' "factory".

title: Escape From Wildcat Canyon
actors: Dennis Weaver, Michael Caloz, Peter Keleghan, Barbara Radecki
description: Little Pete lives with his family in a quiet, rural area. The little boy loves Grandpa Flint very much and enjoys the life he leads. One day, however, Pete learns that with his family, his grandfather excluded, he will have to move to New York where his father is about to get a job in an important architectural firm. While the father and mother travel to the Big Apple to have a job interview, grandfather and grandson decide to leave for a vacation in the mountains with a small tourist plane.
