The plane breaks down and the pilot manages to make a crash landing in the mountains. Pete and his grandfather abandon the injured pilot and venture into the mountains in search of the rangers station. The two will have several bad encounters with ferocious animals, risking their lives several times ...
notes: Film designed for families. The role of the brave and likeable grandfather Flint has been entrusted to Dennis Weaver who boasts a long career in Hollywood (he also played a small part in "Infernal Quinlan" by Orson Welles).

title: The Last Days of Pompeii
actors: Preston Foster, Basil Rathbone, David Holt, John Wood, Dorothy Wilson
description: After the accidental death of his wife and son, the peaceful blacksmith Marco changes his life and becomes a famous gladiator. During a visit to Judea, he meets the little orphan Flavius ??and takes him under his wing; he also witnesses the Passion of Christ, but this is not enough to stir his soul. The religious awakening of Mark, however, will take place many years later, in Pompeii, when during the destruction of the city submerged by the lava he sacrifices himself for the salvation of Flavius ??- condemned to death as a Christian - and his girlfriend Clodia.
notes: "Colossal" version (for the time) of Bulwer-Lytton's novel of the same name, edited by the director of _King Kong_.

title: Second Honeymoon
actors: Roma Downey, Tim Matheson, Jayce Bartok, Sean Arbuckle
description: On the threshold of twenty years of marriage, a crisis breaks out between George and Diane Weston. However, faced with the prospect of a vacation on a tropical island (an anniversary gift from their two children, Beth and Peter), the couple willingly agrees to leave to avoid disappointment for the boys. The conditions for a reconciliation would be all there, but things go very differently: in fact the maneuvers ... concerned by the factotum who manages the island, Antonio Escobar (favored by the Edenic and "aphrodisiac" nature of the surroundings) multiply disproportionately and contrasts, to the point of inducing the exhausted spouses to a now unpostponable divorce.

title: Thomas est amoureux
actors: Benoît Verhaert, Magali Pinglaut, Aylin Yay, Micheline Hardy
description: The world is a room, just a click away, and travels through a telematic network ready to solve all the problems of Thomas, who for three years has lived there locked up for an acute form of agoraphobia. The insurance allows Thomas to have, through the network, everything he needs, even sex, entrusted to the expert care of Clara, a sensual virtual pin up. An obsessive mother and an intrusive psychoanalyst who enrolls him in a dating club, try to get him out of that stubborn isolation, but in these things only love can work miracles.
notes: It is a curious film, made up of digital sequences of the computer screen, an interminable subjective view of the protagonist. An acute and ironic reflection, on the implications of a real world that technology tends more and more to transfer on the network, but also on the cinema / internet combination that promises great production and distribution innovations.

title: Non mi basta mai
description: Ebe (now physiotherapist), Gianni (fisherman in Sardinia in the "Red Lobster" cooperative), Vincenzo (now working wood), Pasquale (educator in a juvenile prison) and Pietro (creator of foam rubber puppets) apparently have nothing in common, except the fact of living or having lived in Turin. At the end of the sixties the five were the protagonists of the historic dispute, which began in 1969 and ended in the eighties, which saw the workers and Fiat face to face.
notes: The partisan Guido (Chiesa) has been militant for years using sometimes the camera, sometimes the video camera, often reworking archive materials, exploiting avid and slow motion to exhaustion. In total complicity with Daniele Vicari, before throwing himself into Fenoglio's beloved "Johnny", he made this poignant documentary film, starting from the experience of five "little Indians", yesterday Fiat workers, today in the "reserves" of a serene and pacified only in appearance. Whoever wants to understand how we went from "Fordism" to globalization, why homologation triumphs over divergent thoughts and healthy antagonism, why "the march of 40 thousand" marked the end of the struggles of the working class, pursue at the end of the world "It is never enough for me", sincere as the iron fist inflicted by the bosses, the union leaders and the regime press on all the men and women who believed in Utopia.

title: What Women Want
actors: Mel Gibson, Helen Hunt, Marisa Tomei, Lauren Holly, Alan Alda
description: Nick is the typical tomboy who prefers male companies and who loves listening to Frank Sinatra's records. One evening he falls into the bathtub together with a hair dryer and the electricity gives him a paranormal power: to hear what women think, including dogs. The sonic shimmer brings fun and a new sensibility to Nick who soon proves to be a good father to his teenage daughter and the fairer sex's best friend. His new dowry will also help him try to be reinstated in the workplace, as Darcy stole his job as creative director at the agency he worked for. If Cary Grant can dress up as a woman in "I was a bridegroom" and Spencer Tracy can duet and duel, in many films with his beloved enemy, a prototype of the Tough Guy, living sponsor of testosterone like Mel Gibson, can get waxed , putting on the tightsL, fiddling with creams and rimmel (the sequence is from the anthology) to imagine what the other half of the sky desires. Director Nancy Meyers is not very good at amalgamating all the moments of a film that is too long and undecided about the closure to give. Good sequences alternate with flat and lazy sequences. Gibson plays with himself and Hunt plays with her own image of an ugly girl with charm. They are not the couple of the century. The roles of Bette Midler and Marisa Tomei are unfairly liquidated within minutes.

title: Jungfrukällan
actors: Max Von Sydow, Birgitta Petterson, Axel Düberg, Tor Isedal
description: In medieval Sweden, dark and barbaric, a young woman is raped and murdered by three shepherds who then, to escape capture, take refuge with the girl's parents. And when these, unmasked the visitors, do justice, a fountain miraculously begins to gush near the victim's corpse.
notes: Silent, essential, characterized by a study on the sets and on the faces of the characters capable of translating the ethical, religious and cultural demands of the text (taken from a legend of the fourteenth century) with an unprecedented visual power. One of the major Bergmans, ruthless but at the same time open to a glimmer of hope.

title: Pinocchio
description: The carpenter Geppetto discovers with great surprise that the puppet he built is alive and animated. Pinocchio - this is the name of the "creature" - is, however, naughty and disobedient, and contravening the advice of his "stepfather" and the Blue Fairy he starts the school to follow the bandwagon of the wicked Fire Eater. Imprisoned, he manages to escape but finds himself swallowed by a huge whale. In the belly of the animal he meets Geppetto again, whose life he will save during the escape: for his good deed he will be rewarded and transformed into a real child.

title: Baby, It's You
actors: Rosanna Arquette, Vincent Spano, Joanna Merlin, Jack Davidson
description: He, a sanguine Italian American, makes everyone believe, first of all to himself, that he is the new Frank Sinatra. She, an effervescent young girl of Jewish origins, dreams of the limelight in the role of the actress. They meet, they like each other, they live the Sixties as they should have lived, even if the illusions do not always materialize into splendid realities.
notes: One of the first independent films, John Sayles, starts from a Burt Bacharach song - "Baby, It's You", which is also the original title of the film - and builds a young and non-juvenile comedy, fresh and not trendy.

title: Hannibal
actors: Anthony Hopkins, Julianne Moore, Giancarlo Giannini, Ray Liotta, Frankie Faison, Francesca Neri, Zeljko Ivanek, Hazelle Goodman, David Andrews, Francis Guinan, Enrico Lo Verso, Ivano Marescotti, Fabrizio Gifuni, Marco Greco, Boyd Kestner, Peter Shaw, Andrea Piedimonte, Robert Rietty
description: Hannibal Lecter managed to escape the surveillance of the Baltimore asylum and arrived in Florence; during his hiding, he was able to appreciate the pleasures of art. But federal agent Clarice Starling, suspended from office for killing five people in one action, hasn't forgotten about him. Even Mason Verger, who escaped the murderous fury of Hannibal, has not forgotten him: indeed, he soon realizes that to lure him into a trap he must use Clarice himself as bait ...
notes: That the heart of Lecter and Clarice's adventures is their "love story" was clear from Demme's film. Here, however, everything becomes all too explicit: also because at the beginning Scott deceives us, and then instead brings the story back into the tracks (and in the perspective) of the "Cannibal". The fault of the English director is that he limited himself to directing the episode of a series, without taking possession of those elements that could transform the saga based on Thomas Harris' novels into a personal film. He obviously knows his stuff, especially in action scenes; but equally obviously he plays with cunning and beautiful manners, touching the lacquered packaging. The outcome is not scary and even less disturbing; it doesn't give jolts or doubts, and it doesn't even take the risk of gore (and it's not clear why, according to some, it should have been banned). It ends up being an "actor's film", dominated by a consummate and sly Hopkins, who has transformed a monster into a hero of our times.

title: Brother
actors: Takeshi Kitano, Omar Epps, Claude Meki, Masaya Kato, Susumu Terajima
description: Yamamoto, a member of the yakuza, was defeated in a war with a rival family. Abandoned even by his most loyal brother, he goes to the United States to find Ken, his younger brother, who has left home to study in Los Angeles. As soon as he lands in America he runs into Denny. Yamamoto, lost in a country whose language and culture he does not know, has a hard time finding information about Ken. Despite all the difficulties he learns that the boy has become a drug dealer and is friends with that Denny he had met upon his arrival.
notes: With "Brother" Takeshi Kitano puts order in his filmography, synthesizes the constants of a style, makes available an anthology of his noirs on the fury of the yakuza. Rituals, ceremonies, outbursts of violence, humor, wild piles willing to live and, above all, to die. In Tokyo as in America. They are modern Samurai with tattoos as wide as a carpet, with little fingers sliced ??and bellies ripped open by hara-kiri and sake. The shots of the sea and the beach are back, the similarities with the Coppolian "godparents" multiply, the disenchantment of those who are forced to do only the dirty work grows. The actor-director crosses the frame space with his sad clown's crooked legs, with the face of a Clint Eastwood who has taken an electric shock and with the confidence of a lonely anarchist. Oriental version of the outlaw heroes adored by American cinema.

title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
actors: Kim Director, Jeffrey Donovan, Erica Leerhsen, Stephen Barker Turner
description: Five new witch hunters, three women and two men, retrace the steps of the former. They spend a bad night and decide to return to the base, the home of the organizer of the "trip", in the Maryland town where it all started. Here collective psychosis, the witch's evil influences, frustrations and personal tensions begin to mix, in a game of cross-references between reality, magic, madness, between what seems to happen and what the video camera claims has happened.
notes: The ambition of director Joe Berlinger seems to be closer to a _Gli possati_ style atmosphere than Wise. Very high model, on which the reckless five of _BW2_ crash.

title: La Bûche
actors: Sabine Azéma, Emmanuelle Béart, Charlotte Gainsbourg, Claude Rich
description: An all too normal French family. Louba, the older sister, a cabaret singer, has a great gift to make life seem like a fairy tale. For her, Christmas is an opportunity to take a dip in the past and to forget all her troubles. For Sonia, the most beautiful party of the year is a kind of theatrical show which she has been preparing for since October. It's up to her to host the family for the traditional Christmas dinner. Little Mila wants nothing to do with Christmas. The collective hysteria sends her into crisis, but for this year she too will have to deal with family relationships.
notes: Colorful, festive, sparkling in dialogue and rhythm, here is a comedy that Claude Sautet would have liked. He speaks, with lightness and humor, of the "simple things" of life, of illusions and death, of physical illnesses and psychological discomforts. This is a film about women directed by a woman who has been writing scripts for forty years and who makes her debut here behind the camera, having fun taking apart the "Christmas toy" with poisonous jokes, exaggerated turkeys, and a "hostile depression" that forces Emanuelle Béart to use unpleasant manners, Sabine Azéma to sing in Russian, Françoise Fabian to proudly show wrinkles and Charlotte Gainsbourg to express herself like a hooligan. Very good actresses including the young Thompson, son (in life) of the director and co-author of the script; and (in fiction) of a love story lived in amused clandestinity.

title: Sade
actors: Daniel Auteuil, Marianne Denicourt, Jeanne Balibar, Isild Le Besco
description: We are in 1794 during the most violent phase of the French Revolution. Robespierre had the Marquis De Sade arrested again. The noble is fifty years old and has known the Bastille so well and for so long that the former convent of Picpus where the nobles converse, court, are in deep mourning for the death of Louis XVI, does not make much impression on him. If the Marquis, now penniless, is locked up here he owes it to Sensibile, his mistress who has given herself to Fournier, a man close to Robespierre. Then comes a new prey Emilie ...
notes: Film of actors (Auteuil faithful to his standard), of opaque amoral and philosophical dialogues, of close-ups, of costumes.

title: La ville est tranquille
actors: Ariane Ascaride, Gérard Meylan, Pascale Roberts, Alexandre Ogou
description: Marseille. Michèle works in a factory that sells fish to retailers. The work is tiring, but the homecoming is no better because the woman has to fight to get her daughter out of the drug tunnel. Paul betrayed his workmates, he was a longshoreman at the port, to become a taxi driver. Abderramane, transformed out of prison, tries to help his brothers. Viviane can no longer stand her husband and his leftist views. Sarkis has a dream: to have a grand piano.
notes: An infinite panorama, which slowly discovers a port and "squeezes" on mustard-colored buildings with the background of Eric Satie's piano, is the overture of "La ville est tranquille" and the programmatic manifesto of what will be seen in the film. Robert Guédiguian insists with his cinema woven in the port and decadent Marseille, and in particular in the fetish district of Estaque. Characters who meet or touch each other, stage a now familiar story, and the cast of Guédiguian's film resembles one of those theatrical companies that for years have been staging the usual repertoire, exchanging only roles. The political passion of the director, the disappointment over the failure of the left, the drift of the characters struggling with the evil of living, a human solidarity that fades, leave a bad taste in the mouth. The characters are beautiful, often intense and painful, but those who love Guédiguian have the suspicion that it is a slow overview of déjà vu.

title: Per amore di Poppea
actors: María Baxa, Gianfranco D'Angelo, Alberto Lionello, Alvaro Vitali
description: To escape enlistment, Tizio and Caio disguise themselves as women and end up in a slave market where they are bought by Tigellino. He received the assignment from Poppea. Tizia and Caia are hired by the divine who in this way intends to punish Nero's escapades. Meanwhile, the two "women" and find themselves entangled in the palace intrigues hatched by Seneca, Lucano and Pisone. At this point the two are forced to reveal their masculine nature and take sides with Poppea.
notes: The film is intended to be a sort of remake of "Ok Nerone", but none of the performers is up to the role assigned by Mariano Laurenti.

title: Ruby Gentry
actors: Jennifer Jones, Charlton Heston, Karl Malden, Tom Tully, Barney Phillips
description: A rich owner is found killed and the young Ruby, nickname "daughter of the swamp", already talked about for the "interested" marriage, is unjustly accused of his death. Fate, however, does not seem to hold a grudge against her, putting an old love back in her path. But the brother of the latter is a religious who sees sin everywhere: he will also find it in Ruby.
notes: A King Vidor classic punctuated by an obsessive rhythm, by a romanticism that almost flows into mélo, by a cast that believes in fiction. The Jones chat (producer wife) is non-stop erotic.

title: The Last of Sheila
actors: Richard Benjamin, Dyan Cannon, James Coburn, James Mason
description: A Hollywood diva is killed in a suspicious accident. The inconsolable widower then organizes a strange vacation on his yacht, hoping to find some element and focus attention on the likely killers. Result: more innocent blood will flow. The craftsman Herbert Ross has a cast of stars in his hands - from Coburn to Mason, from Welch to Cannon - and a plot (written, among others, by Anthony Perkins) which, on the one hand, is blatantly inspired by Agatha Christie, and on the other hand it tries to evoke the "intrigues in Hollywood". But abundance only gives yawns.

title: The Squeeze
actors: Stacy Keach, Stephen Boyd, Edward Fox, David Hemmings
description: The attraction to the bottle has ruined former policeman and "private eye" Jim Nabot, who now finds himself unemployed and abandoned (with two dependent children) by his wife Jill. Having remarried with the banker Robert Foreman, the woman had another daughter with him, Christine. And just Jill and Christine are kidnapped by the gang of criminal Vic Smith: Jim then returns to the track and sets out on the trail of Smith, but these - threatening Foreman to assassinate his wife and daughter - forces the same banker to kill the former cop. But he doesn't let himself be intimidated ...
notes: Nothing special, this confused and intricate mystery directed by the English Apted.

title: L'assassino ha riservato nove poltrone
actors: Janet Agren, Chris Avram, Gaetano Russo, Paola Senatore, Rosanna Schiaffino, Eva Czemerys
description: Patrick Davenant is a noble and very rich Englishman who, on the occasion of his birthday, organizes an eccentric evening by summoning nine friends and acquaintances to his luxurious palace, and more precisely in the ancient theater that is part of it. An atmosphere of murky mystery hovers over the place, due to the fact that exactly a century earlier an entire family had been locked up and found their deaths there. But as soon as all the guests have entered the room, the doors are barred and a bloody chain of murders begins ...
notes: Cast "dominated" by the presence of some of the most famous sexy divas of the 70s (Agren and Senatore above all).

title: Ice Angel
actors: Aaron Smolinski, Judy Taylor, Thomas Calabro, Alan Thicke
description: Matt Clark, captain of the American hockey team, dies in a game from a mistake made by a distracted angel. To remedy the misdeed, Allan, this is the name of the angel, decides to send Matt back to earth, but in the body of Sarah Bryan, one of the most accredited American athletes for Olympic gold in figure skating, in a coma after beating the head on the ice while trying to perform a difficult exercise. Back on earth and past the initial moment of dismay and discomfort due to his new nature, Matt finds his reason for living in trying to achieve Sarah's goals.

title: Theodore Rex
actors: Whoopi Goldberg, Armin Mueller-Stahl, Juliet Landau, Bud Cort
description: The classic mad scientist and the typical upright policewoman who wants to save the world from the bad intentions of mythomaniacs waiting for tragedies. Luckily for the second, a small but shrewd tyrannosaurus comes to the rescue, with the right tongue and long sight: a perfectly programmed clone ... not to kill.
notes: Here is an example of how you can send a cast to the slaughter that would make any novice director without a billionaire budget happy. It is not enough to evoke a monster from prehistoric times to give birth to grandchildren from "Jurassic Park". We need something else. Above all ideas.

title: Hell and High Water
actors: Richard Widmark, Bella Darvi, Victor Francen, Cameron Mitchell
description: Fearing a nuclear attack by the communist enemies (Russian and Chinese), some private US citizens organize and finance the mission of a submarine destined to garrison an island in the Arctic Sea. It includes an American agent, former naval officer Adam Jones, and two Frenchmen, Professor Montel and his daughter Denise ...
notes: Cold War atmospheres for this mid-level drama, nestled between the much more remarkable _Man dangerous_ and _The bamboo house_. Certainly not the best Fuller, despite some decent underwater shots and the remarkable (for those years) special effects signed by Ray Kellogg.

title: Manila Paloma Blanca
actors: Carlo Colnaghi, Laura Panti, Lou Castel, Alessandra Comerio
description: Once Carlo Carbone was an actor. Now, however, disturbed in his mind and lost contact with the world, he drags himself along like a homeless man, disengaged from a reality that now inexorably eludes him. The meeting with Sara seems to give him back his hope, as well as his commitment to writing a script. But it is all - as always - temporary and temporary.
notes: The cinema of the Turin-based Daniele Segre, always poised between reality and its scenic "double", aims to establish a constantly dialectical, torn, often provocative relationship with the viewer, brought here to the open by the gestures and "irregular" acting of Carlo Colnaghi.

title: Manon
actors: Cécile Aubry, Serge Reggiani, Michel Auclair, Raymond Souplex
description: 1946: on a ship bound for Alexandria in Egypt (but which actually transports a group of Jews to Palestine), a couple of illegal immigrants are discovered, formed by Robert Desgrieux, wanted for murder, and Manon Lescaut. The captain is told their love story, which began two years earlier in Normandy, when Robert was a member of the Free French Forces, fighting the German occupiers.
notes: Golden Lion, amid a thousand controversies, at the Venice Exhibition in 1949. So much so that it was distributed in Italy only in the original version for reasons of censorship.

title: The Invisible Man Returns
actors: Vincent Price, Cedric Hardwicke, John Sutton, Cecil Kellaway
description: The brother of the invisible man from the first film gets hold of his scientific secrets and tests them on a man sentenced to death. The latter, accused of a crime he did not commit, wants to use his invisibility to prove his innocence once and for all. But the side effects of his new condition loom ...
notes: Of course there is no longer the unpublished fascibno of the prototype created by James Whale, however the tension remains high and the special effects, for the time, are amazing. However, Vincent Price bears the full weight of the operation. A classic.

title: Breezy
actors: William Holden, Kay Lenz, Marj Dusay
description: In the life of a mature gentleman, a quiet exponent of the American middle class, a hippy girl bursts into the life and falls in love with him. Obviously reciprocated. The existence of both is completely upset, but it is above all for him that things will change drastically. Their love story will not be easy to live ...
notes: Third film as director of Clint Eastwood, after the remarkable debut of "Thrill in the night" (1971) and "The nameless stranger". This time his reflection on the melon remains uncertain and revolves around somewhat stereotyped characters. However, we can glimpse the stylistic dryness that the filmmaker will demonstrate later in his mature works.

title: La donna che venne dal mare
actors: Sandra Milo, Vittorio De Sica, Peter Lynn, Pedro Gimenez, Juan Calvo
description: Gibraltar, World War II. The Italian secret service considers the fortress a strategic point to be dismantled, but the British have made the whole area impenetrable. To succeed in conquering the British fortress, the Italian military hired a particularly handsome spy, charged with using the deadly weapon of seduction against the enemies.
notes: It might also have been a good idea for this film, especially because the plot is quite compelling. Except that Sandra Milo was chosen for the Roman Mata Hari, already unlikely even if beautiful. A missed opportunity.

title: Nine Hours to Rama
actors: Horst Buchholz, José Ferrer, Diane Baker, Valerie Gearon, Don Borisenko
description: Mahatma Ghandi has now gained immense popularity, and is being hailed all over the world as an important and wise state camp. However, not all India freed from the British yoke seems to be grateful to him, and a tragic fate awaits it.
notes: Historic American meatloaf with western actors dressed up as Indians. Quite disgusting.

title: The Art of Murder
actors: Michael Moriarty, Joanna Pacula, Boyd Kestner
description: Elizabeth is married to Cole, owner of "Mexco", but has an affair with Tony, a young and rampant designer employed in her husband's company. The illusion of keeping this bond secret, however, ceases when the woman is blackmailed by a mysterious individual who threatens to reveal everything to Cole ...

title: The Killer Elite
actors: James Caan, Robert Duvall, Burt Young, Gig Young
description: A killer who works for an agency linked to the CIA is betrayed and made sick by his best friend, who is also a colleague. Animated by a strong desire for revenge, the man faces a difficult physical recovery and restores himself thanks to the application in martial arts. Arrived at the showdown, he will discover that betrayal and lying are now a system.
notes: Usual problems with production for the great Sam Peckinpah. This is not one of his most personal films (Caan loves it a lot though), however the very first part and ending in the boat graveyard are excellent.

title: Demonio
actors: Daliah Lavi, Frank Wolff, Anna María Aveta, Tiziana Casetti
description: A country is haunted by a curse and the superstitious inhabitants believe that the cause of their troubles is a girl, perhaps possessed by the devil. She is uselessly exorcised, then she falls in love with a man who, however, thinks of her like the fellow citizens. After deceiving her about his feelings, he contemplates killing her to free her once and for all from an evil that he considers supernatural and sacrilegious.
notes: From the director of _Valeria inside and out_ and _I Prosseneti_, an Italian gothic without particular quality. The splendid Daliah Lavi, however, is a presence that cannot be forgotten, in fact in those years she was competing with Barbara Steele for the scepter of queen of the genre.

title: Il massacro della foresta nera
actors: Cameron Mitchell, Antonella Lualdi, Beba Loncar
description: In the last years of the Roman Empire's greatness, the barbarians unleash a decisive attack on the heart of Rome. The Germanic troops manage to defeat the legionaries on their own ground and the Emperor Augustus runs for cover by sending reinforcements. The commander of the new troops, Aulo Cecina, has an idea to defeat the opponents, taking them from behind. But the war operations get complicated ...
notes: Muscular work and of a certain breath, despite the scarcity of the means available. In seeing her again today all her naiveties are evident, but with the adventure films that you see today it is good to recover these slightly naive gems.

title: Harriet Craig
actors: Joan Crawford, Wendell Corey, Lucile Watson, Allyn Joslyn, William Bishop, K.T. Stevens
description: A womanizer with an addiction to alcohol abandoned his daughter Ethel at an early age. The woman was forced to learn to defend herself and to fight hard to achieve her independence. The pains she suffered during her childhood and adolescence have exacerbated her character and made her hard in her relationship with others. Ethel has married a serious professional who guarantees her an excellent financial condition. Husband and wife could be really happy if Ethel hadn't created a vacuum around her husband.
notes: The film is the remake of "Craig's Wife" directed by Dorothy Arzner. Great performance by Joan Crawford.

title: Le sette vipere
actors: Vincenzo Cascino, Lisa Gastoni, Umberto D'Orsi, Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Aroldo Tieri, Gloria Paul
description: The Italian industrialist Lorenzo lives in Argentina where he married Erika, of Austrian origin. After some disagreements, the latter - advised by her friends and supported by local law - manages to have her husband's assets seized and to be entrusted with the two children born of the marriage. After trying (in vain) to oppose, Lorenzo returns to Italy taking his children and his affectionate secretary with him, but here too he has to deal with the law. Meanwhile, Erika has also arrived from Argentina and takes her husband to court ...
notes: An attempt is made to joke about the fragility of the family institution and the bureaucratic-legal shackles, but the excess of the grotesque trivializes everything.

title: Scener ur ett äktenskap
actors: Erland Josephson, Liv Ullmann, Bibi Andersson, Gunnel Lindblom
description: Ten years of the marian bond between Marianne and Johann, segmented into six chapters: from initial happiness ("Innocence and panic") to the first signs of crisis ("The art of hiding garbage under the carpet"), from the relationship between Johann and his young lover ("Paola") to separation and divorce ("Valle di lacrime"), from mutual admissions of guilt ("The illiterates") to the serene acknowledgment of an unbridgeable distance but also of a new form of love ("In the middle of the night ...").
notes: Filmed for TV and then reduced for the cinema, a reconnaissance in the couple's universe that caused discussion. Bare, concentrated, linear. In a word, Bergmanian.

title: She's Gotta Have It
actors: Tracy Camilla Johns, Tommy Redmond Hicks, John Canada Terrell, Spike Lee
description: Lola Darling, a beautiful and very lively black girl, leads an absolutely free life from a sentimental point of view in New York. Sexuality is so natural and constant in her that it makes her date three men at the same time: the fatuous Greer, the likeable cyclist Mars and the tender and devoted Jamie. From day to day the situation gets complicated and ends up becoming paradoxical. When Lola, who has finally clarified her feelings, decides to declare herself to Jamie, he, disgusted by her excessive availability, tells her no.
notes: For his debut behind the camera Spike Lee shoots a libertine and black comedy.

title: Flawless
actors: Robert De Niro, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Barry Miller, Christopher Bauer
description: Walt Koontz is a retired cop, medal for valor, a penchant for tango, homophobic. Rusty is a round "girl" in heavy costume jewelery and lamé dresses, the leader of a group of transvestites, extroverts and mischievous, who get ready for the annual contest of "no flaws". Two worlds apart that find a less than perfect harmony. Everything changes when Walt suffers a stroke and has to rely on Rusty's singing lessons.
notes: The film, written and shot in 1999 by Schumacher, is an irritating and boring festival of overacting. One hundred actresses are mentioned and there is not a glimmer of cinema. Nobody believes their character and some scenes are horrible.

title: Chocolat
actors: Juliette Binoche, Johnny Depp, Judi Dench, Lena Olin, Alfred Molina
description: In a timeless French province, the wanderer Vianne arrives in a small village with a dependent daughter. He rents a shop, opens a "chocolate shop" and causes scandal: especially among the count-mayor who dominates the village, but also among the bigoted villagers. Vianne is a magician (of chocolate, and everything else): her pralines awaken in human beings repressed desires, hidden vitalisms, urgent needs. Someone loves her. Many hate it.
notes: Lasse Hallström seems to address actors, objects and landscapes, telling them to make "the poetic face". It must be for this, and for a misunderstood "aura" of an intellectual film, that "Chocolat" is so popular in America.

title: Gostanza da Libbiano
actors: Lucia Poli, Valentino Davanzati, Renzo Cerrato, Paolo Spaziani
description: We are in San Miniato near Pisa, the year is 1594. A trial is underway against Gostanza da Libbiano, an alleged witch. Ecclesiastical power has the face of two old-fashioned inquisitors who would like to send the woman to the stake and of a third subtle and modern inquisitor, Father Costacciaro, who six years later will try Giordano Bruno and who instead wants to deny the woman any identity, especially that , dangerous as a witch, an index of subversive femininity, sexually provocative.
notes: Do you want to make a detour from the parts of pure cinema, conceived shot by shot, staged with the awareness and taste for beauty and passion? "Gostanza da Libbiano", the last act of a trilogy on power that includes "Il bacio di Giuda" and "Confortorio", fourth feature film by Paolo Benvenuti, Special Jury Prize in Locarno, is what it takes. A battle between freedom and fear, a hundred shots worked one by one, a different film from the usual cinema, a witch woman who confesses and stuns you, a journey into witchcraft that is a descent into ourselves. Lucia Poli extraordinary. And a Benvenuti that looks good in comparison with a great, the Dreyer of "Dies Irae", of the witch cinema, with or without a stake.

title: Una lunga, lunga, lunga, notte d'amore
actors: Marie Trintignant, Giancarlo Giannini, Isabelle Pasco, Ornella Muti
description: The night of 21 December is the longest of the year. And in this night many love stories are consumed: there is a man who meets a girl and cannot hold back his emotions, a woman who runs away from herself, two others who verify the love for the partner and that for the generations future.
notes: A cast worn by the clichés of too many appearances (Isabelle Pasco, Ornella Muti, Giancarlo Giannini, the late Marie Trintignant), a style that winks at a modernity of manner, excessive dialogues and music, a tiring and predictable trend : the disappointing return of Luciano Emmer.

title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
country: Hong Kong, China, United States, Taiwan
actors: Chow Yun-fat, Michelle Yeoh, Zhang Ziyi, Chang Chen, Lung Sihung
description: Li Mu Bai, one of the greatest martial arts masters, arrives in the city of Yuan along with his longtime friend Shu Lien. Li instructs Shu to give his mythical sword to Sir Te, a very influential noble. The warrior, who has devoted many years to the art of war, intends to change his life and retire to the monastery of Wudan. Li's purpose is to pay homage to his Jade Fox poisoned master. Arriving at her destination, Shu meets Jen, the governor's beautiful young daughter, and a friendship is born between the two women. Meanwhile, the sword, taken into Sir Te's custody, is stolen by a masked individual, very skilled in fighting.
notes: Were it a western film, we could consider "The Tiger and the Dragon" as (already) classic. In the West, critics and audiences are enthusiastic about a novelty that has been running on screens in Beijing and Hong Kong for over thirty years. Ang Lee is not Tsui Hark and the film is not as good as "The Blade". However, we are faced with a precious work. Because it involves in an exciting staging capable of combining poetry and violence, harmony and beauty, according to a choreography of images typical of the genre (the wu xia pian). "The tiger and the dragon" is therefore a cinematic "elsewhere": a new world where the characters fly while remaining realistic, and where magic is part of things. The film won four Oscars: for photography, scenography, soundtrack and for best foreign film.

title: Billy Elliot
actors: Jamie Bell, Julie Walters, Gary Lewis, Jamie Draven, Jean Heywood
description: There is a mine on strike in a town in Northern England in 1984. There is an uphill glimpse of a road that leads directly into the sea. There are all the houses lined up and the miners on the brink of despair, the cops lined up with shields, the rough fathers and big brothers, stuck to boxing, picket lines, beer. And then there is an eleven-year-old boy who prefers ballet dancer's shoes with reinforced toes to boxing gloves. Son of miners, Billy wants to be a dancer, the white swan of the lake.
notes: A little bit of Loach and, above all, a lot of Mark Herman from _Thank you, Mrs. Thatcher_, where instead of ballet and a little boy's future ("Let's at least give Billy a chance," says his father when he is convinced), the passion for music and the honor of the miners' band: screenwriter Lee Hall (who sowed pieces of his life as a teenager in Newcastle in history) and director Stephen Daldry do not hide their references, even if they work them from the perspective of adolescence and the dream of dance. The ballets improvised by Billy (especially the central one, between the walls, on the roof, on the street) enter with an antirealistic air. The rhetoric of feelings and reconciliations is kept under strict control, so tight, however, that it risks reappearing and appearing more cumbersome. But the mixture works, the rhythm does not slacken, the actors (in the head the great Julie Walters dance teacher) are perfect.

title: Unbreakable
actors: Bruce Willis, Samuel L. Jackson, Robin Wright, Spencer Treat Clark
description: 3.15 pm a train with 118 passengers on board collides with a freight train with six crew members. The crash is terrible. The first carriage breaks into two sections, while the second curls up and is dragged for more than a hundred meters. The only survivor of the disaster is David, a man who has emerged unharmed more than once from several incidents. Elijah, an individual who is forced to live in a wheelchair due to the fragility of his bones, is convinced that David is a superhero.
notes: A strange air circulates in "Unbreakable", an air suspended between the parapsychological and the genre film, which voluntarily disregards the rules of the latter and does not worry too much about the logic and credibility of the "fantastic" plot (and this is probably its biggest flaw). Something is missing from the compelling, unassailable structure of "The sixth sense". It almost seems that the curious and stimulating idea that underlies the film, the contrast between two characters who are at opposite poles of physical efficiency, is stuck in the bud, that the director and screenwriter has not expanded it until the truly torturous depths he could reach. Therefore, the central part of the film ends up turning on itself, with surreal memories of Terry Gilliam (the scene in the station). And slowness, which is one of Shyamalan's strengths, risks becoming a flaw in the narrative structure.

title: Tango della gelosia
actors: Monica Vitti, Diego Abatantuono, Philippe Leroy, Jenny Tamburi
description: Lucia, a neglected wife, really invents them all to insinuate the worm of doubt in her husband: even an unlikely sentimental involvement with a corpulent Apulian hired by his wife as a bodyguard. Finished more or less by chance in the love nest of the "gorilla" with the latter's girlfriend, the protagonists will have to extricate themselves from an inevitable tangle of misunderstandings and personal exchanges.
notes: Tired revival of the classic repertoire of brilliant comedy, based on misunderstandings and false identities. Steno and his son Enrico bet everything on the emerging Abatantuono, but the results leave something to be desired.

title: The President's Man
actors: Chuck Norris, Ralph Waite, Marla Adams, Dylan Neal, Stuart Whitman
description: Joshua McCord is a longtime secret service agent, struggling with the training of a younger element to replace him. However, when the First Lady is kidnapped by a mysterious gang of terrorists, she will have to throw herself headlong into a new and dangerous undertaking.
notes: When Chuck Norris is involved, you can't really go wrong: whether he plays the role of the "Walker Texas Ranger" or - as on this occasion - of an intrepid special agent, the ingredients of the recipe do not vary, to the delight of a public that obviously prefers not to rack their brains too much to distinguish the good from the bad.

title: The Goddess of 1967
actors: Rose Byrne, Rikiya Kurokawa, Nicholas Hope, Elise McCredie
description: The Japanese JM lands in Australia to buy a fetish car - a Citroën from the late 1960s, the legendary DS ("Déesse", or "goddess") - and discovers that the seller, contacted via the Internet, has shot dead his wife and took his own life. At the scene of the crime is BG, a blind girl who drags him, aboard the DS, on a pilgrimage in rural Australia ...
notes: Perhaps, behind the protagonist, there is Clara Law herself, who established herself during the Eighties as one of the most interesting directors in Hong Kong (more "author" and less eclectic than the veteran Ann Hui) and since 1995 she has moved in Melbourne. Its history crosses continents, memories, cultures and is characterized by dazzling images and an irregular rhythm, now suspended now accelerated. A sort of excursion to an alien planet, with unequal but interesting results.

title: Kingu Kongu tai Gojira
actors: Harry Holcombe, Michael Keith, James Yagi, Nadao Kirino
description: Mr. Tako, president of a Japanese pharmaceutical company, learns of the existence of a kind of large berry that grows on the island of Farou and which would have miraculous healing effects. Not only that: it also seems that the natives adore a huge ape called King Kong, who in Tako's perverse mind already appears as the ideal testimonial for his products. Transferred to Tokyo, King Kong will have to contend with the Godzilla monster, accidentally brought back to life by a cataclysm ...
notes: The confrontation between two of the most famous cinematic bogeys of all time is a tasty opportunity in itself, to be enjoyed by suspending any prejudice of a qualitative nature.

title: A Strange Affair
actors: William Russ, Judith Light, Janet Lo, Jay Thomas, Rachel Wilson, Robin Dunne
description: A woman about to divorce her husband decides to return home after learning that her husband has suffered a bad heart attack. The dramatic situation causes in her a state of psychological prostration: she therefore seeks comfort in a friend, with whom she enters into a relationship that soon turns into a real passion. Thus a classic "triangle" is formed, whose protagonists will have to face a complex intertwining of feelings.
notes: Canadian-born director Ted Kotcheff, famous above all for his first "Rambo" and "Weekend with the Dead", confidently directs this standard television product.

title: Queen Bee
actors: Joan Crawford, Barry Sullivan, Fay Wray, John Ireland, Lucy Marlow
description: Eva, an ambitious and cruel self-made woman, deceives and gets married to rich Avery. The bride and groom go to live together in a luxurious villa. The despotic Eve pushes her husband away from herself who ends up giving himself to alcohol. Meanwhile, she consoles herself with John who is about to marry Carol, Avery's sister. In order not to lose her lover, Eva reveals her relationship with John to her sister-in-law. Desperate Carol kills herself. Meanwhile, Jennifer, who cares for the couple's children, tries to pressure Avery to take over the house.
notes: Tense melodrama that highlights the absolute perfidy of Eva, played by a talented Joan Crawford.

title: Una storia d'amore
actors: Anna Moffo, Gianni Macchia, Caterina Boratto, Gigi Ballista, Alicia Brandet
description: Evy, a happily married woman and mother of two children, taking advantage of the absence of her husband in Hong Kong for work, participates in a party with a group of friends. The birthday boy is Franz, a twenty -year -old play boy disputed by all women. Evy, unaware of the fact that he is hidden photographer for blackmail purposes, he grants Franz, completely loses his head and falls in love with it. Day after day Franz realizes for the first time to feel an authentic feeling towards the woman. Evy hit by this attitude tries to kill himself.
notes: One of the few erotic films directed by Michele Lupo. The playboy is Gianni Macchia already seen in "Brucia, boy, burns".

title: Pilgrim/Inferno
actors: Ray Liotta, Gloria Reuben, Armin Mueller-Stahl, Lisa Owen
description: Lost in the desert, Jack wakes up without the slightest knowledge of his identity or of how he got there. In search of a refuge, he wanders aimlessly through the dunes reaching the home of Vicky, an artist who helps him recover fragments of memory. Eventually the man remembers having come into possession of a large sum of money which he has lost track of: in reality Jack is a gangster, and many of his former associates want to see him dead ...
notes: Former "good guy" Ray Liotta finds himself involved in a classic routine operation, flanked by proven professionals such as the German Müller-Stahl.

title: La strana storia di Olga O.
actors: Serena Grandi, Stephane Ferrara, Daniela Poggi, Florinda Bolkan
description: Olga in crisis with her husband Paolo tries to get out of the depression tunnel with the help of Carlo, a psychologist who is a friend of the family. On the advice of Paolo, the woman returns to her hometown and starts dating Sheila and Isabelle, friends of the past. She sets foot at the "Blue Parrot", the place where she performed as a girl. It is in that city that Olga's nightmares re-explode. The woman feels persecuted by Emil, a mysterious character who the storm of anonymous phone calls and slowly precipitates into a tremendous mental confusion. He no longer understands the difference between reality and fiction. Inspector Michael comes to his aid.

title: Concorrenza sleale
actors: Diego Abatantuono, Sergio Castellitto, Gérard Depardieu, Jean-Claude Brialy
description: Rome, 1938: Umberto and Leone are the owners of two fabric shops in the same street, they are both married, have a waitress, children in love and children to pick up from school. The two traders are divided by professional rivalry. Leo, a Roman Jew, with the introduction of the racial laws will realize that his life is no longer what it once was: but unexpectedly he will find the solidarity of Umberto ...
notes: If Scola still knows the fluidity of the camera (and the trolley goes ...), he has instead lost that of the story. Trudging in a televised slumber behind the intrusive voice off of the child narrator.

title: Unabomber: The True Story
actors: Robert Hays, Dean Stockwell, Tobin Bell, Victoria Mallory, Bill Mondy
description: Ben Jeffries is a post office inspector who, abandoning his usual duties, dedicates himself with tenacity and determination to a new, very delicate task: to identify and bring to justice a dangerous criminal who is disseminating the United States with explosive packages, known by the appellation of "Unabomber". In the investigation to unmask the latter - whose real name is David Kaczynski - the same brother of the wanted man, Theodore J. Kaczynski, will play a key role.
notes: In the mid-90s the Unabomber case shocked American public opinion: the film provides the usual, more or less faithful, fictional reconstruction.

title: Una ragazza piuttosto complicata
actors: Catherine Spaak, Jean Sorel, Florinda Bolkan, Gabriella Grimaldi, Gino Lavagetto
description: A man inserts himself into a phone call between two lesbians. Intrigued by the very particular situation, he decides to meet one of the two girls and to become her lover. Problems arise when the other woman tries to break off their relationship.
notes: Taken from Moravia's tale "La marcia verso".

title: Incontro nell'ultimo paradiso
actors: Sabrina Siani, Rodolfo Bigotti, Renato Miracco, Sal Borgese
description: In an uncontaminated tropical paradise, a boy and a girl find themselves, unaware of the joys of love and frightened by loneliness. Together they will try to overcome the difficulties and naturally they will fall in love.
notes: Sort of "Blue Lagoon" (or "Paradise") in the Italian style, thanks to the dazzling beauty of Sabrina Siani, who as an actress, however, leaves much to be desired.

title: Un spécialiste, portrait d'un criminel modern
description: In 1960, after a grueling work of shadowing, the Mossad finally managed to capture the former lieutenant colonel of the SS Adolf Eichmann in Buenos Aires, where he had led a quiet and anonymous existence for years. The subsequent trial, held in Jerusalem, ended in 1962 with the hanging of the accused.
notes: From the more than 500 hours filmed in the classroom by the American Leo T. Hurvitz, Sivan and screenwriter Rony Brauman have drawn this impressive document on the "banality of Evil" (as Hannah Arendt defined it). "I've never killed anyone, I just followed orders," Eichmann defended himself. Any comment is superfluous.

title: The Bandit Queen
actors: Barton McLane, Barbara Britton, Philip Reed, Willard Parker
description: Southern California gold rush is at its peak. A band of cruel seekers kills Montalbo and his wife, strenuous champions of the resistance, in the presence of Lola. The girl, driven by a feeling of vengeance, gathers Mexicans around her and leads the punitive expeditions. Zorro's daughter, as Lola calls herself, becomes the terror of all the bandits in the area.
notes: William A. Berke was an old Hollywood craftsman. He was able to turn out four films a year. As often happens, quantity is not synonymous with quality. Not even this film of his escapes the rule.

title: Password uccidete agente Gordon
actors: Roger Browne, Helga Liné, Rosalba Neri, Franco Ressel
description: Gordon Douglas, a counterintelligence agent, has received a new assignment: he must track down and put an end to the activity of a feared gang of arms smugglers. While in Paris he discovers that the ranks of the organization are in the hands of a theatrical impresario, Mrs. Kastiadis. Gordon also learns from Amalia that a shipment of weapons is about to reach the Far East and the gang is about to move to Madrid, where the expedition will take place. The spy thus moves to the Spanish capital ...
notes: From the main Italian spy director, Sergio Grieco, a film that rips the 007 series, at least managing to make the viewer laugh when they agree to play the game.

title: Model Shop
actors: Anouk Aimée, Gary Lockwood, Alexandra Hay, Carol Cole
description: George, a young architect eager to establish himself in his work, is going through a period of crisis: he is dissatisfied with his business and the relationship with the girl he lives with, and is terrified of being called up for Vietnam. Wandering the streets of Los Angeles in search of money to pay the installment of his car, he meets the mature Lola: intrigued, he follows her and discovers that he works in a studio where pornographic photos are made. The two will spend a night of love together, then ...
notes: Away from America, Demy makes a light but fragile and mannered film, far enough from its best results.

title: Caruso, zero in condotta
actors: Francesco Nuti, Cecilia Dazzi, Giulia Serafini, Lorenzo De Angelis
description: Lorenzo Caruso is a widower who works as a psychoanalyst in a small provincial town. His life passes quietly between one visit and another. Then one day a police gazelle stops in front of his house. All of a sudden he discovers that his daughter Giulia is part of a baby gang. At first Lorenzo tries to justify his daughter's behavior, then he starts spying on her and wondering if it is right to do so.
notes: With this cue you could shoot just five minutes of any film. The rest are smug and racked up, with respect to the gaps and deficiencies of the narrative, camera movements.

title: Girlfight
actors: Michelle Rodriguez, Santiago Douglas, Jaime Tirelli, Paul Calderon
description: Grumpy and quarrelsome Diana is unable to control her anger, but the worst thing is that she doesn't even intend to try. Then one day he discovers the world of boxing. This is how he begins to cross gloves in the ring. From that moment on there is something for everyone, no one excluded. A hook to Sandro, a violent and authoritarian father, a direct to the high-rise blocks of Brooklyn, an uppercut to the school and her companions, a technical knockout for Adrian, the love met in the gym.
notes: The writer-director Karyn Kusama, a debutante, is captivated by the irresistible gaze of her protagonist (some of the most successful shots of the whole film), by the sweat of training and meetings, by the smells of the kitchen and the dishes of the Rodriguez house, by the composed disillusionment of the boxing master, Hector, with missed caresses and closed in a fist. The little coming-of-age novel, with frequent didactic failures, is a tiring training: many laps of the track, struggling around a sack, learning to hit, defend and cash in speed, attack with anger and not remember. The pain of a suicidal mother, the bruises of a match, the need to knock out (the most bogus joint in the plot), the very boy she fell in love with, while the gong counts the rounds of one day like another.

title: The Wedding Planner
actors: Jennifer Lopez, Matthew McConaughey, Bridgette Wilson, Justin Chambers, Judy Greer, Alex Rocco, Kevin Pollak, Joanna Gleason, Charles Kimbrough
description: She is a career woman: she arranges weddings for wealthy couples, and of course she is single. He saves her from an accident and sets off the spark. But she is planning the wedding of the richest girl in San Francisco, and who is he but the betrothed?
notes: What hilarious misunderstandings would old foxes like Lubitsch, Hawks or Wilder have concocted with such an idea? Good times. The script of Pamela Falk and Michael Ellis is a lawsuit. Adam Shankman, his debut choreographer in directing, unleashes a labyrinthine sequence shot at the opening and then drinks his brain: scenes too bad to be true, a "Laureato" ending destroyed by editing errors caused by film illiteracy.

title: Traffic
actors: Catherine Zeta-Jones, Michael Douglas, Benicio Del Toro, Jacob Vargas
description: Javier, a Mexican policeman, works with his colleague Manolo on the border between the United States and Mexico. The two are employed by Salazar, the main exponent of the fight against crime in the Mexican state. The temptations are great and, although Javier tries to resist, he will find himself involved in an unbearable situation. The Supreme Court of the state of Ohio has appointed the new head of the anti-drug section: it is Robert who in his private life has to deal with his daughter's drug addiction. San Diego, a drug trafficker agrees to testify against the infamous Obregon cartel. It will be trouble for him ...
notes: Steven Soderbergh, a shoulder camera, inspired by a 1989 British television miniseries, gets to the loom, chooses the different colors of his fabric and begins to weave the plot. The threads come together, touch each other, trace curves, shadows, designs that remain isolated, according to a rigid economy of the chromatic code. Tijuana light has the yellow-orange hues of a sick sun. The colors of Ohio and Washington's chambers of power are shrouded in an icy blue. The San Diego sky has the neutral, uniform glow of television news and Hollywood docudrama. "Nashville" is the tall model of the staging. American beauty in the face of music, in the despair of a nightmare ("Magnolia"), in a war that cannot be won, needs a story, with long timing and very good actors, which is a puzzle and a network. Without judgments or sermons. The film won four Oscars: Best Director, Supporting Actor, Non-Original Screenplay, and Editing.

title: Amores perros
actors: Emilio Echevarria, Gael García Bernal, Goya Toledo, Alvaro Guerrero
description: Octavio wants to escape with his abusive brother's wife and raises the money for the escape by having his dog fight. Daniel is the editor of a magazine, who leaves his wife and daughters to live with a famous model. El Chivo is a former terrorist, is a killer on commission and lives with a pack of strays.
notes: Hard, at times shocking, the film is a triptych of episodes that takes shape starting from a violent car accident. The center of gravity lies in the problematic nature and absence of the father figure who, together with the love for dogs, marks all the characters. Iñárritu won the Critics' Week Grand Prix in Cannes.

title: Dracula 2000
actors: Gerard Butler, Christopher Plummer, Jonny Lee Miller, Jeri Ryan
description: A gang of super-technological thieves to try to score a sensational blow penetrates the basement where works of inestimable value should be kept. Instead, the thieves find themselves in front of a coffin containing the remains of Count Dracula. Released after a century of imprisonment, the king of the night finds himself catapulted into modern-day New Orleans and grappling with the temptations and, above all, the chaos of the twentieth century.
notes: The executive producer is Wes Craven. The director, Patrick Lussier, former editor of Craven, is a rookie, the music is a mixture of heavy metal and hard rock, the screenwriter, Joel Soisson, is a specialist in the genre and the old scriptwriter, Bram Stoker, is a genius. The professional references of this latest variation on Dracula would seem exemplary. The film is disastrous. The actors hired for this type of film are not usually asked for a particular skill in putting on costumes and making a few grimaces (pain, fear, dismay, ferocity), the willing of "Dracula's Legacy" are inconsistent. The aspiring actresses, rejected by some audition for the centerfold of "Playboy", are bad and the only decent one is Christopher Plummer.

title: Proof of Life
actors: Meg Ryan, Russell Crowe, David Morse, David Caruso
description: Peter Bowman, chief engineer who is directing the construction of a dam in Tecala, is kidnapped by an armed group fighting the central government. When the kidnappers discover his identity, they demand a ransom of three million dollars. Alice, Peter's wife left to herself, must ask Terry for help, a man who negotiates the release of the hostages by trade. With each passing day the situation becomes more and more complex also because Alice discovers that she has feelings for Terry.
notes: Taylor Hackford was born a documentary maker and knows Latin America well. But he obviously didn't know Russell Crowe and Meg Ryan. The love story between the two stars, born on the set, "stole" the film, at least in the eyes of the public: all to see Sally and the gladiator who are serious, and who cares about the harsh denunciation of the role of multinationals Use in the "backyard", as in Washington they call South America? Another ambiguous complaint: why are South Americans all mustachioed, treacherous and sweaty? The sexiest scenes have been cut. But Meg Ryan doesn't take much to ruin everything even as an actress: her close-ups, all grimaces and little faces, are devastating in a drama. Crowe instead has the physique of the role and not surprisingly everything works better when he is on stage alone. Action and adrenaline are guaranteed, except when the two fall in love: the fake one (of the plot) and the real one (of the set).

title: E adesso sesso
actors: Elena Russo, Alessio Modica, Tony Sperandeo, Adolfo Margiotta, Max Giusti, Maria Grazia Schiavo, Youma Diakite, Ciro Esposito, Tiziana Schiavarelli, Anna Longhi, Giulia Weber, Luigi Maria Burruano, Lucianna De Falco, Francesca Nunzi, Virginia Marsan
description: A married woman falls in love with her son's friend and decides to run away with him. The escape does not last long, but the celebrity of the relatives increases day by day. A worker who hates immigrants falls in love with a black prostitute and tries to redeem her. A woman undresses in front of the window, attracting the curiosity of those across the street. A group of housewives make a homemade erotic calendar. A couple contacts swingers. An employee looking out the window of his office notices that two girls are flirting and calls his friends. A wife unbeknownst to her husband works in hardcore films.
notes: An episodic film without matadors and with discreet actors. A six-chapter film that incorporates the agitation and impatience of zapping. Six snapshots of the average Italian's sexual habits. Stripped, expropriated from the TV universe, from the language of quizzes, from the ecstasy of a live life, from the temptations of exchange and the domestic factory of pornography. Mobile phones, the Internet, television networks pollute and disqualify a free-range idea of ??impoverished everyday life. The exaggerated characters of the beautiful episodic films of the Italian comedy are the protagonists and victims of today's black and white news. Any reference to reality is not so casual in this homage by Vanzina to "Sex matto" and "I see naked". In love with the cinema of their father and uncles, Enrico and Carlo describe the present without moralizing and think, quote, are inspired by Risi and Germi. They are the first to know that cinema and Italy are no longer what they used to be.

title: Quills
actors: Geoffrey Rush, Kate Winslet, Joaquin Phoenix, Michael Caine
description: To get rid of an uncomfortable character like D. A. F. de Sade, Napoleon decides to lock him up in the Charenton asylum. His mistress Madeleine often visits him, taking it upon herself to take his latest writings outside those walls; a priest who comes into contact with women thus discovers the subversive force of Sadian ideas.
notes: The director attracted, with discontinuous and sometimes detestable results, by the literature and by the provocative vigor of the written page ("The unbearable lightness of being", "Henry and June") shares with the protagonist of this film, based on a play by Doug Wright, the opinion that it is dangerous to confuse fictional invention with life.

title: The Filth and the Fury
actors: Sid Vicious, Johnny Rotten, Steve Jones, Paul Cook, Glen Matlock
description: England, 1970s. A band is formed in the suburbs of the capital: soon the world will experience the rage and anarchy of the "Sex Guns" ...
notes: Documentary? Sure, but at what level! Julien Temple hadn't made anything so beautiful for many years, at least since, as a promising young man and music lover of excellent tastes, he had signed "The great scam of rock'n'roll" and "Absolute Beginners". Here he returns to the scene of the crime: to be forgiven. If "The Great Scam" was the punk phenomenon told from the point of view of Malcolm McLaren, a super-fine cheater and "inventor" of the phenomenon-Sex Pistols, "Obscenity and Furore" is the rewriting of that epic giving the word to the protagonists. That is, the very Pistols who were cheated, exploited and robbed by McLaren. Only recently, after a long trial, Johnny Rotten and his companions regained possession of the rights to their songs: on that occasion Temple testified in their favor and this caused the rapprochement between the musicians and the director, who had access to hours and hours of vintage footage. The re-enactment of the birth of punk against the backdrop of a poor and already "Thatcherian" England is poignant, while the (unpublished) images of the Pistols' first American tour are simply shocking. Those who loved punk music will love the film; those who dream of making documentaries, in turn, will learn how to do it.

title: The Bat
actors: Vincent Price, Agnes Moorehead, Gavin Gordon, John Sutton, Lenita Lane, Elaine Edwards, John Bryant, Darla Hood
description: Cornelia, accompanied by a group of friends, goes to a lonely country villa as Mark's guest. The woman is not at all worried by the rumors that in the area "the bat" is going around a homicidal madman. One day, Mark's uncle's bank teller discovers a $ 1 million shortfall. While the cashier is arrested, the director of the bank confesses to Dr. Wells, a friend of Cornelia, that he is the author of the theft. Wells kills him, but in turn is killed because he has discovered the true identity of the "bat".
notes: Fourth screen version of a play by Mary Roberts Rinehart.

title: Seminole Uprising
actors: George Montgomery, Karin Booth, William Fawcett
description: Near the Rio Grande the Indians of Black Hawk have come out of their reserve and are spreading terror. Lieutenant Cam Elliot, a half-breed serving in the army, is sent to Fort Clark to mediate with Black Hawk. During the journey, the officer who is accompanied by a friend is attacked by the Red Indians. The two are saved by the providential intervention of a squad of soldiers led by sergeant Zanoba. Cam and Dudley, his rival in love, are given the task of attacking the Indians.
notes: Modest work by Earl Bellamy.

title: Tangshan daxiong
actors: Bruce Lee, Maria Yi, Han Ying Chieh, Tony Liu, Paul Tien, Miao Ker Hsiu
description: Cheng Chao-an, just arrived from his country to the city. He manages to get a job at an ice factory. By chance he discovers that inside the company there are those who are organizing drug trafficking. The executives try to buy his silence, but Cheng rebels.
notes: The film launched Bruce Lee internationally.

title: Anna 6-18
actors: Nikita Mikhalkov, Anna Mikhalkova, Nadezhda Mikhalkova
description: A father, Nikita Mikhalkov, and his daughter Anna: the fundamental questions of existence repeated, year after year, from the parent to a child who gradually transforms into a young woman. The girl's path coincides with one of the crucial periods in the history of the Russian nation, from Brezhnev's obscurantism to the Afghan conflict, from Gorbachev's perestroika to the dissolution of the Soviet empire.
notes: Family diary, private and intimate, of a director who has progressively turned from the classical and literary pace of the years of dissidence to the regime to the nostalgic manner and the cloying bombast of the last works.

title: Wind River
actors: Blake Heron, A Martinez, Joshua Jackson, Russell Means
description: Nick Wilson, a young farmer, is convinced by Moragoni, a warrior belonging to the shoshone, to go and live in the tribe of chief Washakie, as Anuba, the shaman mother, has dreamed that a white boy will save their people. Nick's life among the Shoshone, after initial difficulties, proceeds calmly under the guidance of Moragoni, who helps the boy to enter the world of the Indians. During a battle against the Crow, however, Moragoni dies, and the boy is forced to fend for himself. Meanwhile, Nick's brother Sylvester has set out in search of her.

title: No Way Back
actors: Russell Crowe, Helen Slater, Etsushi Toyokawa, Michael Lerner
description: The life of FBI special agent Zack Grant is turned upside down by his wife's untimely death, caused by the after-effects of childbirth. The tragic experience also negatively affects Zack's career. His superiors, however, offer him one last chance for redemption by entrusting him with an important mission: to vanquish a powerful Japanese mafia organization. Zack instructs one of his agents, a new conscript, to infiltrate, but the situation gets out of hand when he discovers that his underling is collaborating with the Yakuza.
notes: The film stars a Russell Crowe who has not yet reached international fame.

title: La legge della camorra
actors: Jeff Cameron, Raffaele Di Mario, Mariangela Matania, Silvio Noto
description: In New York, the Italian-American underworld clans Liguori and Miceli are fighting each other with no holds barred. The leader of one of the two camps, Gaetano Liguori, is dying, and his attendant visits Carolina Miceli, daughter of the boss Calogero, to reconstruct what happened. Hostile to the drug trafficking advocated by brothers Gaetano and Tony Liguori, Don Calogero had also put in place his political support. But the successful elimination of Gaetano does nothing but fuel a perverse spiral of reprisals ...
notes: Fidani makes the streets of EUR pass through those of Brooklyn and sets up a story of unspeakable paucity.

title: Sweet Smell of Success
actors: Burt Lancaster, Tony Curtis, Susan Harrison
description: Contrary to the idea that his sister is engaged to a penniless artist, a cynical New York journalist forces a collaborator to make believe that the lover is involved in a drug ring. Thanks to the complacency of a detective, the plan goes through. The girl threatens to commit suicide and the journalist discharges any responsibility on her "second". Which at this point rebels.
notes: Mélo in black directed by a Scottish director traveling to Hollywood and embellished by a subtly evil Burt Lancaster (he is the "great" journalist). Jazz soundtrack and great photography by James Wong Howe.

title: The Newton Boys
actors: Matthew McConaughey, Ethan Hawke, Skeet Ulrich, Vincent D'Onofrio, Julianna Margulies, Dwight Yoakam, Chloe Webb
description: At the dawn of the twentieth century, the Newton brothers, greedy for glory and dollars, decided to overcome the myth of the Jesse James gang, the most famous bandit in the South West, by innovating the "robbery & similar" branch. There are four of them, sons of the South, rebels, Gascons and Don Juan. In a short time, over eighty sensational shots scored while dreaming of the grand slam.
notes: From the director of Before Dawn and Waking Life, an action comedy tinged with western twilight but a little uncertain and prolix in its gait. Too farcical the definition of the characters.

title: Dead Cold
actors: Lysette Anthony, Chris Mulkey, Peter Dobson, Michael Champion
description: Romantic getaway for Eric Stevens and his wife Alicia (Lysette Anthony). A mountain chalet is ideal for spending a period away from everything and everyone. Almost immediately, however, a stranger appears at their door, a certain Kale, semi-desirous of the cold and in need of help. Too bad that Kale, in reality, is not a stranger at all. At least for Alicia ... For some strange reason Lysette Anthony ("No Clue", "Dirty Deal") is one who has decided to be a "dark lady". Nothing, neither physique nor talent authorizes such a hypothesis, but she insists and tries again. Also in this movie.

title: Mørkets øy
actors: Sofie Gråbøl, Paul-Ottar Haga, Sina Langfeldt
description: A man goes to an island off the coast of Norway to investigate a woman's disappearance. But there is much more to discover: pagan rites, witchcraft, Umman sacrifices and a disturbing priest who is the master.
notes: A curious remake of the English cult horror movie "The Wicker Man" (unreleased in Italy), directed by Robin Hardy and starring Christopher Lee.

title: A Secret Life
actors: Roma Downey, William Russ, Neblis Francois, Kristina Malota
description: Already traumatized by the very serious plane crash in which her husband Mark is involved, Cassie discovers that the latter was traveling with a woman registered as his wife and was killed in the accident. But that's not all: shortly after a little girl enters the scene, daughter of Mark and his lover. It won't be easy for Cassie to decide which way to behave. Mark asks his wife to let the child live with them, but Cassie, shocked by this series of events, rejects her husband's proposal.
notes: Good proof of Roma Downey who on television gave her face to Jacqueline Kennedy in a drama dedicated to John Fitzgerald's wife.

title: Shidi Chuma
actors: Jackie Chan, Yuen Biao, Sek Kin
description: Expelled from his martial arts and dance school, Ah Long is forced to redeem himself by finding his wandering brother. The regional sheriff, however, mistakes him for a dangerous bandit and hunts him down. Ah Long repeatedly manages to escape, but will eventually be forced to challenge the villain Big Foot to a duel.
notes: "The White Fan", better known as "The Young Master", is one of the highest achievements of Jackie Chan's poetry, who for the first time combines kung fu with slapstick and picaresque adventure with fairy tale. The evolutions of the actor-athlete are all genuine.

title: Red Sun Rising
actors: Don 'The Dragon' Wilson, Mako
description: A Tokyo policeman, despite the contrary opinion of his superiors, decides to temporarily move to Los Angeles. He believes that a hitman from the Yakuza, his mortal enemy who has escaped capture several times, has taken refuge in the City of Angels.
notes: Shameless action movie that curiously shows some of Takeshi Kitano's "Brother" locations.

title: The Collectors
actors: Casper Van Dien, Danielle Brett, Joseph Griffin
description: Sonia, to escape the constant insistence of Taylor, her ex-boyfriend, agrees to drive home with Jim, a boyfriend she has just met. What awaits her, however, is a mad rush on the highway. Taylor, in fact, is in love with Sonia and wants her at all costs.
notes: Canadian Sidney J. Furie directed a cult western in 1966 such as "The Appaloosa" ("The Appaloosa") with Marlon Brando, which even anticipated "spaghetti" themes. Unfortunately he was then lost in the great sea of ??television productions and C-series films, those without infamy and without praise.

title: The Perfect Nanny
actors: Tracy Nelson, Bruce Boxleitner, Dana Barron
description: The real, all-consuming passion of Andrea McBride has always been romance novels, a literary mirror of his sentimental fantasies. Now, however, Andrea is well determined to move on to practice: the ideal target is the handsome doctor James Lewis, widower and with two children, from whom - to begin with - she gets hired as a nanny ...

title: Giuda
actors: Enrico Lo Verso, Danny Quinn, Mathieu Carrière, Aglaia Szyszkowitz, Francesco Pannofino, Pierfrancesco Favino, Mehmet Gunsur, Shel Shapiro, Athina Cenci
description: In Jerusalem, with the Easter feast approaching, a cheering crowd led by the apostles acclaim Jesus of Nazareth "King of the Jews". But the triumphal procession is abruptly dissolved by the Roman legionaries, who rushed to appease the people. One of the apostles stands before Jesus to protect him and exhorts the people not to fear the Romans and to defend the Messiah. This is Judas, the son of a wealthy local merchant. Judas believes in the Master. To follow him he abandoned his wealthy family. But this apostle is also the victim of a great illusion: he is convinced that Christ's mission is to free the people of Israel from the Roman oppressor.

title: A storm in Summer
actors: Peter Falk, Andrew McCarthy, Nastassja Kinski, Aaron Meeks
description: Fairview, 1969. Abel, an elderly grocery store owner, is forced to fight the envy of the neighborhood. The man is in constant conflict with his slacker nephew, Stanley, who works in his shop. Without saying anything to his uncle, Stanley hosts a child of very humble origins, during the summer holidays, thanks to an assistance program for disadvantaged people organized by the rich Gloria. Abel immediately objects, but it is too late. After a first moment of misunderstanding, between little Herman, who lost his brother in Vietnam, and Abel, whose son died tragically, a great friendship will be born ...

title: Le insaziabili/Femmine insaziabili
actors: Robert Hoffman, Dorothy Malone, John Ireland, Romina Power
description: In America, the journalist Paolo meets Giulio, an old friend: the latter's mysterious murder will lead him to start a private investigation, which will lead him to discover details that are anything but edifying about the past of the murdered. Meanwhile, Paolo weaves an ambiguous relationship both with an attractive lady and with her daughter, a teenager eager to forge the stages of her sexual initiation.
notes: For this mediocre yellow with a vague hippy flavor, even some American celebrities such as Ireland and the "Syrkian" Dorothy Malone have bothered. Romina's fans, on the other hand, will have to settle for a few fleeting peeks.

title: Le fate ignoranti
actors: Margherita Buy, Stefano Accorsi, Gabriel Garko, Erika Blanc, Serra Yilmaz, Andrea Renzi, Koray Candemir, Lucrezia Valia, Filippo Nigro, Ivan Bacchi
description: A young couple, obviously well-off, perhaps happy, but with a somewhat flattened harmony in the bon ton. He dies suddenly and Antonia isolates herself in a broken silence until she discovers that he had a mistress. But who turns out to be a lover, a man, Michele, as heartbroken as she is and much more resentful. Antonia comes into contact with the "ignorant fairies", a group of bizarre, different (not only homosexuals), refugees, sick (of AIDS and love), who animate Michele's "family".
notes: It is not perfect, "The ignorant fairies", suspended in a delicate balance between everyday comedy and the subtle suffering that hides behind the smiles and bitter jokes. But even imperfect, even with tones that sometimes touch the soap abyss into which Italian cinema has sunk, it is a living film. He lives from his true love for his characters, from the desire not to justify them but to understand them, from the nuances of the soul he reaches. He has courage, not only the courage to put the "different" at the center of the scene, but above all to take his time: the times of painful and silent pauses, of Margherita Buy's gazes lost in the void, in the river and in memory, the time needed for a refugee to pass from domestic common sense to melancholy, those capable of transforming a terrace into a narrative "place" and of making maturations and changes plausible.

title: This Year's Love
actors: Kathy Burke, Jennifer Ehle, Ian Hart, Catherine McCormack, Dougray Scott, Emily Woof
description: Danny and Hannah live in London's Camden Town neighborhood. She sells clothes in a market stall, he makes designer tattoos. Over the course of the wedding dinner, Danny has evidence of his beloved Hannah's betrayal. Their marriage goes into crisis after just thirty-five minutes. Around the two of them, who have suddenly become single, revolve four other characters, the shy Liam, the cursed artist Cameron, the restless Sophie and the ugly seasoned Marey. Written and directed by the newcomer David Kane (also author of "Born Romantic") who knows how to tell and sets up an excellent cast able to fill a small unpretentious story with sympathy.

title: Fifteen Minutes
actors: Robert De Niro, Edward Burns, Kelsey Grammer, Avery Brooks
description: A man with a digital camera wanders around Manhattan. He is a Czech who loves Frank Capra's cinema and is looking for his fortune with his psychopathic Russian partner. The two are on a "business trip" but are ensnared by the mirage of quick and effortless success and leave a visible trail of fires and corpses in a nocturnal New York marked by swirls of smoke. With the video camera they film their "exploits" and send them to "Top Story", a reality show to be shown on the air.
