The highly decorated Inspector Eddie Flemming and the young detective Jordy Warsaw launch themselves in their tracks. The paths of criminals and policemen cross in an incessant roundabout whose center of gravity is the charming Daphne who was present on the set of the first murder and therefore inconvenient to eliminate and / or protect.
notes: With the excuse of the thriller, Herzfeld makes a credible j'accuse against the unscrupulous media society, willing to do anything for the audience, not renouncing to provide a human, and sometimes even slightly comic, portrait of the character played by De Niro, the true protagonist - in spite of himself - of the show.

title: Digimon: The Movie
description: Tai is the leader of the "digipelti", kids who can manipulate strange digital creatures. With the help of his companions and his digimon Koromon / Agumon, Tai must save the planet from the incursions of Diabormon, an evil digimon who threatens to destroy the network and who convinces a computer to launch missiles from the United States at Japan. Some "digipedelts" therefore move to America to help their friend Wallace and to immunize one of his twin Digimon from a malignant mutation.
notes: There is a lot of meat on the fire in the Digimon world, but the result is a confusing mixture that often indulges in violence for its own sake.

title: Amarsi può darsi
actors: Claudia Gerini, Claudio Santamaria, Paola Cortellesi
description: The night before the hearing of the divorce of Davide from Giulia, the woman of his life, is full of nightmares. The love that a short time before was very great is suddenly revealed to David very little. All the moments of their love story emerge between escapes by a lake on their wedding day, and friends exploded like second-choice tires, endless courtships and betrayals.
notes: The film breathes the unexciting air of little curtains of married life. The expedient of a day in the magistrate's court, weighed down by the tap of the scene of the dream, is the mitigating factor of a narrative sketch.

title: Honolulu Baby
actors: Maurizio Nichetti, Maria De Medeiros, Jean Rochefort, Paulina Gálvez
description: Alberto would be happily married to Margherita. It would be, because the two have no children: it is Margherita who does not want them. Thus, while on a mission for his company in Brazil, Alberto gets six women pregnant. He didn't have much trouble, since there aren't any men where he happened ...
notes: The best thing about the film is the cinephilia: not only the self-quotation (the protagonist is the same as _Ratatataplan_), but also the homage to Laurel and Hardy and the presence of Maria de Medeiros and Jean Rochefort. We would like more ideas and a greater characterization of female characters. The operation, however, inspires sympathy.

title: Born Romantic
actors: Craig Ferguson, Ian Hart, Catherine McCormack, Jane Horrocks
description: Frankie, Eddie and Fergus don't know each other and experience the misfortune of this confused and lonely age. The first dreams of old-time seductions and sings Dean Martin, the second steals here and there and falls in love with Jocelyn, the third is an abandoned rocker on the trail of his ex. Eleanor, Mo and Jocelyn frequent the same Mexican nightclub and are the girls our heroes aim for. To convince them they will have to ... dance.
notes: The lightness with which the director faces the troubles of the protagonists, creating a character, that of the taxi driver, who binds them all together, is exemplary. The film is to be appreciated as a writing film, to which the splendid cast makes a notable contribution.

title: You Can Count on Me
actors: Laura Linney, Amy Ryan, Matthew Broderick, Mark Ruffalo, Rory Culkin
description: An overnight car trip, a terrible accident, a couple of parents lose their lives leaving their two little children Terry and Sammy orphaned. Twenty years have passed since that terrible accident and Terry returns home after years of wandering around the world. The account that life presents to the two boys is salty: Terry is a nomad, confused, charming and self-destructive, Sammy, divorced and with a child, wears the role of the efficient and irreproachable woman that the bigoted community has assigned to her, but in actually has a rebellious and crackling personality. Terry instinctively bonds with his nephew, a smart kid who suffers from the lack of a father, but Sammy is terrified of the troubles his brother can cause and tries to separate them when he can. The days in the ancestral home pass in the realization of the irreducibility between a great affection and insurmountable differences, which lead to a final crisis.
notes: "Count on me" is a small manual on the difficulty of living, on the differences that exist between what we are and what we would like to be; Sammy and Terry are the sides of the same coin, a sort of double personality that strikes us with a subtle and insinuating delicacy, continually fueled by the skill of the two interpreters Mark Ruffalo and Laura Linney.

title: Liam
actors: Ian Hart, Claire Hackett, Anthony Borrows, Anne Reid, Megan Burns
description: Liam is a kid who stumbles a little too often with words. His stuttering makes him shy, but Liam has a very lively intelligence and inspires great sympathy. The family is Catholic of Irish descent; the father works hard to support her, but the effects of the depression are felt and the man is left without a job, so Liam's sister has to go to service with a Jewish family. Difficult times are approaching and the economic crisis leaves dormant religious and political intolerances free to explode.
notes: The prolific Stephen Frears after the success of "High Fidelity", allows himself a film exactly the opposite. A journey into memory set in Liverpool in the thirties, the dark and painful ones of the Great Depression. Produced by the BBC and based on the novel of the same name by Jimmy McGovern, "Liam" is the testimony of the goodness of the twenty-year relationship that exists between Frears and television. But it is also a unique opportunity to stir in an ambiguous period of English history and open a glimpse of his youth to remind him of the years he spent with his mother after the war. A small film which seems to lack the breath of cinema, but shot with a valuable technique and which relies on a solid script. But the real asset of the film is Anthony Borrows, the little Liam happily chosen from hundreds of aspirants.

title: Finding Forrester
actors: Sean Connery, Rob Brown, F. Murray Abraham, Anna Paquin
description: William Forrester is an elderly writer who published a single great novel at the age of 23 and then retired from the world, taking refuge in an anonymous apartment in the Bronx. Jamal, on the other hand, is a poor African-American boy, a small basketball genius, a student in a Manhattan college but above all a budding novelist, who in the mysterious Forrester finds a teacher of literature and a second father. In the background, the institution: the Manhattan college where Jamal is studying, the bitchy professor who persecutes him, the very rich girl who makes him glimpse unknown worlds.
notes: If you've (successfully) directed a film about a rebellious young genius, chances are they offer you other projects about rebellious young geniuses. It's the tough Hollywood law. Gus Van Sant is the author of excellent independent and / or cursed films ("Beautiful and damned", "To die for") but he made a big splash with "Will Hunting", and this explains why Sean Connery, producer and performer, chose him for "Discovering Forrester". But even such Hollywood "packages" can produce good results: the film is not bad, thanks to the always charming Connery and newcomer Rob Brown, truly amazing. A Bildungsroman in which the real protagonist is the "trainer", the teacher. Noble and slightly academic.

title: The Legend of Bagger Vance
actors: Matt Damon, Will Smith, Charlize Theron, Bruce McGill
description: We are in Georgia in the 1930s. Rannulph Junuh, a former World War I wounded golfer, must find his lost swing at all costs. Bagger Vance, a character who appears out of nowhere, takes care of showing the traumatized champion the way forward to become once again an unbeatable champion. Through golf, Rannulph understands what meaning can be given to life.
notes: Will Smith who is a caddy (the one who carries clubs in golf) might seem like a tribute to Tiger Woods, the very first non-white champion in the history of that sport. Of course it is a coincidence. This is not the real reason that prompted Redford to make the film. The star confirms himself as an anomalous and curious director: after having sounded the psyche of the bourgeoisie in _Common People_, he began to stage the fundamental myths of American culture with a style close to magical realism. In _Bagger Vance_ there is a bit of Frank Capra and a bit of _Zen and archery_. The film is elegant, philosophical, nobly boring. Those who do not love golf seriously risk falling asleep, but if you "enter" the story, the ending excites and moves. And paradoxically the whole context (the city of Savannah, Charlize Theron's character) is much less interesting than the competition. The film is based on a short story by Steven Pressfield.

title: Pay It Forward
actors: Kevin Spacey, Helen Hunt, Haley Joel Osment, Jay Mohr, Jim Caviezel
description: The task that Eugene, a social science teacher, gave his middle school students is worthy of a thesis or the Nobel Peace Prize: think of a way to change the world and put it into practice. Trevor tries, a little boy with a family life that is not entirely rosy: his father is far away and his mother, Arlene, has a double job, drinks too much, has hair in eternal disorder. Trevor proposes that each should do three favors to three different people who, in turn, must reciprocate the good deed ...
notes: Leder works as best she can - with the help of a candied fruit novel - to illustrate this fable about solidarity.

title: Amici ahrarara
actors: Max Cavallari, Bruno Arena, Giustino Durano, Sonia Aquino
description: Bruno and Max, two unsuccessful brains, are forced, in order to live, to smell hairy armpits and diapers in their uncle Giannangelo's perfume and cosmetics factory. Their purpose is to get a project funded. But there is a problem: the uncle has such an irascible character that the two have never had the courage to tell him what they think. When the news arrives that the uncle has been hospitalized due to a stroke, the nephews are forced to make up for lost time ...
notes: Years ago, offering a film to the "Prickly pears" might sound like a shrewd intuition: but it is now a sad reality, which has given life to a product like this.

title: Tibia front!
description: Resistance to Nazi aggression gathered the population of the Soviet Union in various regions of its boundless territory. The images collected by Dziga Vertov in this montage film, for example, are striking for the contrast between the silent spaces of Kazakhstan and the violence of the scenes shot on the front.

title: Su tutte le vette è pace
description: The indefatigable Gianikian and Ricci Lucchi return to work on the very rare and precious reels shot by the pioneer Luca Comerio and on the archive materials of both armies involved, giving us the visual testimony of the bloody battles consumed on the Alpine fronts (Pasubio, Adamello) during the first world conflict.

title: Im Schatten des Kreuzes
actors: Heinz Bennent, Pamela Villoresi, Jacques Breuer, Vernon Dobtcheff
description: 1942 Holland is under the Nazi power play. An elderly priest convinced of the incompatibility between Catholicism and Hitler's doctrine tries to defend the freedom of the press strenuously. Betrayed, he will be deported to the Dachau concentration camp.
notes: Interesting television movie.

title: Sabato, domenica e lunedì
actors: Sophia Loren, Luca De Filippo, Alessandra Mussolini, Jerome Anger, Enzo Cannavale
description: Rosa and Peppino Priore's marriage has been going on smoothly for thirty years now. Unrivaled cook, specialized in ragù, she has to endure the shame of being betrayed, gastronomically, by her man. To get revenge, all that remains is to make Peppino jealous, making him believe that Professor Janniello had an affair with her. The tension will be at its peak during Sunday lunch.
notes: Lina Wertmüller draws a decent film from Eduardo De Filippo's comedy of the same name dated 1959. There is also a 200-minute television version. Good actors and in part.

title: Wanted
actors: Giuliano Gemma, German Cobos, Teresa Gimpera, Serge Marquand
description: Newly appointed sheriff, a man is forced to flee to escape an unfair murder charge, artfully crafted by the leader of a gang of outlaws aiming to control the herd trade. But eventually justice will triumph again.
notes: The usual Gemma in a spaghetti western similar to a thousand others.

title: Kiwi Safari
actors: Meg Foster, Andrea Thompson, John Doubleday, Megan Nicol
description: Mary Ann and Sandy are about to make their dream come true: an adventurous expedition through the New Zealand rainforest. In their expectations there are wonderful scenarios and populations that are reputed to be particularly welcoming. It will be a fascinating but also very tiring experience.

title: Mal d'Africa
actors: Richard Hatch, Daniel Greene, Eleonora Brigliadori, David Brandon
description: Tony De Palma fled New York to escape his past and took refuge in Africa. Here he is joined by the gigantic Mirko, emissary of the mafia. The man demands that Tony kill Frank and Garofalo two of his former comrades who were responsible for the death of their old boss. When Mirko kills Nadine, a woman who buried the man who was to become her husband, Tony takes up arms and becomes the ruthless killer who terrorized the streets of the Big Apple. After making a massacre he decides to leave the black continent. But when he remembers Sir, a little boy he saved, he decides to stay.

title: Josh and S.A.M.
actors: Jacob Tierney, Noah Fleiss, Martha Plimpton, Stephen Tobolowsky, Chris Penn
description: Two teenagers, after learning that their parents have decided to divorce, run away. Alone on the road they will experience several adventures.
notes: Good proof of Martha Plimpton that we have seen in "The Goonies" "Mrs Parker and the vicious circle" and "Music from another room" and in some episodes of "ER".

title: Tommaso
actors: Ricky Tognazzi, Hannes Jaenicke, Maria Grazia Cucinotta
description: Thomas, a disciple of Jesus, wants to give a worthy burial to the Messiah. Joseph of Arimatea comes forward and offers the family tomb. The funeral procession, however, is interrupted by a raid by the Zealots, who incite the followers of the Nazarene to revolt: the Romans are therefore forced to hasten the burial. Although the Romans have set up a guard duty at the tomb, Thomas decides to stay, running the risk of being executed. Meanwhile, Caiaphas advises the high priest to allow Jesus' proselytes to take the Master's body back to Galilee. But at this point an event takes place that messes up the plans ...

title: Saboteur
actors: Robert Cummings, Priscilla Lane, Otto Krüger, Alan Baxter
description: We are on the eve of the Second World War. An explosion occurs in an explosives factory in Nevada that costs a worker the life. Another worker is blamed for the outbreak, the result of an act of sabotage, who makes him lose track. The man, hunted by the police, finds hospitality in the home of a musician. Patrizia, the landlord's niece, believing she is facing the wanted man, would like to report him. Then, having convinced herself of his innocence, she offers to help him discover the real perpetrators of the sabotage.
notes: Breathtaking last sequence on the Statue of Liberty.

title: The Beguiled
actors: Clint Eastwood, Geraldine Page, Elizabeth Hartman
description: During the Civil War, a northern corporal, Jonathan McBurney, is wounded and abandoned on enemy territory. The man is picked up by Emily, a little girl who is staying at a girls' boarding school run by a spinster Miss Martha. Jonathan is cared for by the caring women, but he is also aware that, once healed, he will have to be handed over to the Southerners. Jonathan, the only man of the house, did not take long to attract the sympathies of the guests of the boarding school. Martha and Edwina, the French teacher, love him.
notes: Thanks to this film, which was a fiasco at the box office, critics discovered Eastwood as an actor.

title: Pauline à la plage
actors: Amanda Langlet, Arielle Dombasle, Pascal Greggory, Feodor Atkine, Simon de la Brosse, Rosette
description: Thirteen-year-old Pauline is spending the last few days of her vacation with her aunt Marion in a cottage on the beaches of Normandy. While making friends with a partner, the girl witnesses the complex game of feelings of the adults around her. The observed group includes Pierre, who was once crazy in love for Marion and who never stopped loving him. Then there is Henri in playboy who philosophizes with Marion about love and ends up becoming her lover.
notes: Third film in the "Comedies and proverbs" series. As usual, Rohmer offers us some filmed theater with the contribution of the beautiful photography by Nestor Almendros.

title: The Luzhin Defence
actors: John Turturro, Emily Watson, Stuart Wilson, Christopher Thompson
description: Late 1920s. Russian chess champion Alexander Luzhin arrives in Italy, in the Lakes region to play his biggest game. The man has not yet managed to overcome the traumas of his adolescence: the end of the loveless marriage of his parents, the death of his mother. During the match Luzhin meets Natalia, a Russian aristocrat, whom her parents would like to marry a rich man. Love is born between the two.
notes: Madness of love and madness of chess should go hand in hand, but the film ends in an oleographic and bloodless staging. The film, based on Nabokov, would like to be a Visconti, it ends up looking like a mannered Ivory.

title: Gangster No. 1
actors: Malcolm McDowell, Paul Bettany, David Thewlis, Saffron Burrows
description: A boxing match is taking place in a hotel and at one of the Gangster tables he learns that his old boss, Freddie Mays, the Mayfair butcher, is about to get out of prison after serving thirty years for murder. We take a step back and go back to London in the late 1960s. We see Freddie, very elegant and despotic, holding the men of the gang in his hand and Ganster climbing the steps of the underworld by his side. Until because of Karen the rivalry between the two erupts ...
notes: The British variant of the gangster movie, relaunched by Guy Ritchie, in the second feature by Paul McGuigan, former photographer and director of "The Acid House", finds hallucinated violence and macerated gloom in sequences held long to distill all potential emotions. Luxurious and ferocious clothes, tailored shoes and cut throats. Over this sadistic world hangs the perverse obsession of Gangster who, as a neat man, takes off his clothes, remains in his white undershirt and briefs before reducing his enemies to pulp with an ax and machete.

title: Miss Congeniality
actors: Sandra Bullock, William Shatner, Ernie Hudson, Benjamin Bratt
description: Gracie, a rather hasty FBI agent, is the only one cute enough to infiltrate a beauty pageant threatened by Citizen, one of the most dangerous criminals around. The problem is that Gracie has to turn into a lady, and the feat is not as easy as it seems: a dapper old Englishman will take care of instructing her ...
notes: The screenplay is copied by George Bernard Shaw, the direction has a flat encephalogram. The only one doing his duty is the cinematographer László Kovács: every now and then he thinks of Hopper, Scorsese, Bogdanovich, Ashby and Rafelson, and silently sheds a tear.

title: The Faculty
actors: Jordana Brewster, Clea DuVall, Famke Janssen, Piper Laurie
description: In the corridors of Herrington High School there are all kinds of people, loners, top class and athletes. In short, the usual kids who have problems not only with their parents, but also with their teachers. The students soon realize that an alien infection is taking over their teachers. Rebelling will be very hard ...
notes: Typical Williamson-style cinephile concentrate who wrote it: a lot of classic science fiction (from "The Invasion of the Body Snatchers" onwards) and some late reflection on the "body", as in the glorious Eighties of New Horror. Superfine editing by Rodriguez himself ("From sunset to dawn"), very special effects by Kurtzman, Nicotero and Berger, imitators of Tom Savini, always a guarantee. Zero intellectual ambitions, one hundred fun.

title: The Weight of Water
actors: Sean Penn, Catherine McCormack, Elizabeth Hurley, Josh Lucas
description: Thomas accompanies his wife Jean, a photojournalist, to the island of Smuttynose, Maine. The woman has to make a photo shoot about a murder committed in 1873, for which a Prussian fisherman was convicted of killing two women with an ax. The couple is joined by Rich, Thomas's brother, with his beautiful girlfriend Adaline. The events of the past overlap with the present ...
notes: Intertwined stories of fatal attractions, twisted family relationships, destruction and self-destruction. There are two couples on a boat looking for evidence and traces of a massacre that took place almost a century and a half earlier in Smuttynose, an island off the coast of Maine, home to a Scandinavian fishing colony. And there are, in an alternation that is becoming more and more pressing, the protagonists of the ancient "case". Hand in hand, slowly, while Jean continues his photographic reportage, we discover the mysteries and tensions buried under the two parallel stories. Almost obsessed with that drowning moment of _Lezioni di piano_, Kathryn Bigelow's film, is twisted, tiring, and fascinating: darkened in the old part by the barbarism of _Lezioni di piano_, neurotic in the modern one by the beautiful interpretation of Sean Penn, unfortunately fails to completely merge the two registers. Imperfect and contradictory, but also visceral and disturbing.

title: The Life and Death of Colonel Blimp
actors: Roger Livesey, Anton Walbrook, Deborah Kerr, John Laurie
description: In 1902 Berlin, two officers - the British Clive Candy and the Prussian Theo Kretschmar-Schuldorff - compete in a duel originating from love of country and a sense of honor. Neither two world conflicts fought on opposing fronts nor the passion for a single woman will be enough to undermine the deep friendship and mutual respect that will ensue.
notes: On the one hand, the sincere adherence to the absolute values ??that unite human beings; on the other, a visual power and an unscrupulous narrative still astounding today. Result: a film for which, for once, the nickname "masterpiece" does not seem out of place.

title: Perry Rhodan - Sos aus dem Weltall
actors: Lang Jeffries, Essy Persson, Luis Davila, Pinkas Braun
description: Four astronauts on a mission to the Moon meet two inhabitants of a very distant planet. The extraterrestrials, destined to die, ask them for help. The four take them to Earth, where they undergo an attempted kidnapping by a gang of thugs. They would like to use their brains to rule the world: the aliens, however, manage to escape the bad guys and, thanks to the help of a scientist, they return home.
notes: The film is based on a comic series called "Perry Rhodan" which is well known in Germany. Antonio Margheriti was called to sign the tricks, but at a certain point he abandoned production.

title: Space Men - Uomini spaziali
actors: Rik von Nutter, Gaby Farinon, David Montresor, Archie Savage
description: Year 2000. A reporter is sent into space by his newspaper to make some reports on the life of the inhabitants of the satellites. When he arrives at his destination, the journalist is greeted rather coldly: only a girl, employed in the technical services, shows him sympathy. Meanwhile, news arrives that a spaceship is about to crash into Earth. The base commander tries to detonate it with atomic torpedoes, but can't solve anything. The reporter offers his help ...
notes: Margheriti - who here "Anglicizes" his surname by signing himself "Anthony Daisies" - makes the film with a keen eye on contemporary American productions.

title: La leggenda del rubino malese
actors: Christopher Connelly, Lee Van Cleef, Marina Costa, Alan Collins
description: Malaysia. The former Yankee captain has found a way to make money: together with an old friend he accompanies bored and thrill-seeking billionaires in the jungle with his motor boat. Usually the trip ends with a fake assault by the natives for the "joy" of the tourists. One day Warren suggests that he accompany Maria Yanez, director of a Colombian museum, in search of a fabulous ruby ??which, according to legend, has exceptional powers. Yankee agrees, but is soon forced to deal with Da Silva, a shady arms dealer.
notes: Film adored by the fans of Margheriti. Simple but effective special effects.

title: Cleopatra Jones and the Casino of Gold
actors: Tamara Dobson, Stella Stevens, Caro Kenyatta, Norman Fell
description: Cleopatra in the service of American counter-intelligence allies herself with Ci Ling, a Chinese private eye to defeat Bianca, known in the world as the "Black Dragon". The woman is the biggest drug dealer in the Far East.
notes: The rather violent and comic book-inspired film is the sequel to "Cleopatra Jones".

title: Ultimo - La sfida
actors: Raoul Bova, Ricky Memphis, Giorgio Tirabassi
description: Don Antonio and ten men of his gang are gathered in a restaurant to discuss a "certain" business. Ultimo, Solo and Ombra are stationed in the "Balena" van, equipped as a mobile base. Two armed men break into the room and carry out a massacre. The three, stuck inside the van, are unable to intervene. The following day, Ultimo learns from his superiors that his operative group will be dissolved and that he will have to abandon the investigation into the fact of blood. General Trani offers Ultimo another chance: he has to solve the case in thirty days.

title: Mary, Mother of Jesus
actors: Pernilla August, Christian Bale, David Threlfall, Simone Bendix
description: At the age of sixteen, Maria falls in love with Giuseppe, a carpenter whom the Romans recruited to carry out forced labor. The girl is waiting like all other Jews for the arrival of the Messiah who will free the people of Israel. With great surprise he receives a message from the archangel Gabriel. Mary is told that she has been chosen to become the mother of Jesus. Returning home after an absence of five years, he learns the news that Mary is expecting a child. A visit from the Archangel Gabriel makes him understand God's plan for his partner. Joseph and Mary leave for Bethlehem ...

title: 'A' gai waak
actors: Jackie Chan, Sammo Hung, Lau Suen Hak
description: Late 19th century: Hong Kong is ruled by the British, but pirate vessels dictate the seas. The coast guard should try to counter them: nevertheless, corruption is rampant in its ranks. Ma is an exception, determined to restore justice to the waters.
notes: Jackie Chan star performer: writes, directs and performs.

title: The Boy From Oklahoma
actors: Will Rogers jr., Nancy Olson, Lon Chaney jr., Anthony Caruso
description: Tom Brewster, a peaceful cowboy, after taking some correspondence lessons goes to Blue Rock to complete his thesis. The town is celebrating the election of Barney Turlock as mayor. Trusting in Tom's apparent naivety, Barney offers him the post of sheriff left vacant after Brannigan's death. Tom is forced to accept the assignment and begins to investigate the death of his predecessor and discovers that his death was not accidental. Heavy responsibilities fall on Turlock who hires Billy the Kid to take him out.
notes: The film is saved thanks to the strength of the many character actors.

title: Grandeur et décadence d'un petit commerce de cinéma
actors: Jean-Pierre Léaud, Jean-Pierre Mocky, Nathalie Richard, Marie Valera
description: Director Gaspard Bazin is working on a new feature film. For the moment it is still choosing the actors and seeking funding. It is aimed at Jean Almereyda, a once fashionable but now declining producer. He is increasingly struggling to raise the capital needed for his projects and his wife Eurydice dreams of being a movie star. Almereyda wishes to please her and a perverse game arises between the two men, but Bazin's reputation as an incorrigible seducer dissuades him from asking for a part for Eurydice.
notes: One of Jean-Luc Godard's first attempts with the "light" technologies of filming and video editing was this medium-length film in which, applying the usual procedures of deconstruction and narrative fragmentation, the "work in progress" (and in particular the phase of auditions with the actors) relating to the production of a film translates into a ruthless reflection - albeit characterized by strong metaphorical values ​​- on the contemporary status of cinema and its controversial relations with the cultural industry. The starting point (or perhaps it would be better to say "pretext") for the Godardian operation is a novel by the well-known "noir" writer James Hadley Chase.

title: La banda J. & S. Cronaca criminale del Far West
actors: Tomas Milian, Susan George, Telly Savalas, Eduardo Fajardo
description: Jed Trigado is a bandit who only steals from the rich and keeps, with the proceeds of his businesses, his brother and all his gang. He supports Jed in his exploits Sonny, a resourceful girl with an easy gun. The frequent robberies induce Sheriff Franciscus to promise amnesty for all those who manage to capture them dead or alive. Regardless of the unleashed manhunt, Jed and Sonny enter the party organized by Garcia Moreno and his wife Linda and kidnap the woman.
notes: Sergio Corbucci has made many "spaghetti westerns", but this is not one of his best. Ordinary reinterpretation in western sauce, often in strong and violent colors, of the story of Bonnie and Clyde.

title: Private Obsession
actors: Shannon Whirry, Michael Christian, Bo Svenson, Rip Taylor
description: Richard Tate has lost his head for a woman he will never have, Emanuelle, a famous supermodel whose public appearances he follows with maniacal continuity. One day he decides to change his obsession: he kidnaps the girl to have her only for himself. Emanuelle immediately realizes that she has ended up in the hands of a madman, that when she gets tired of the game ...

title: La monaca di Monza
actors: Anne Heywood, Antonio Sabato, Carla Gravina, Tino Carraro, Luigi Pistilli
description: Virginia de Leyva, benefactress and mother superior of a convent in Monza, is persuaded by the chaplain to give refuge to Giampaolo Osio, a young noble famous throughout Lombardy for his arrogance and his amorous adventures. One evening the man breaks into Sister Virginia's cell and rapes her. The nun forgets the rape immediately and becomes Osio's lover. The birth of a child forces the nuns, who are also not exempt from sins of any kind, to elect a new mother superior.
notes: Eriprando Visconti, grandson of the great Luchino, takes up the murky story taken from "I promessi sposi" and makes a morbid and useless film from it.

title: Gohatto
actors: Takeshi Kitano, Ryuhei Matsuda, Shinji Takeda, Tadanobu Asano
description: Japan, 1865, towards the end of the Edo era: in the country on the brink of civil war, samurai loyal to the Shogunates (and therefore to conservation) are formed in schools where they train warriors to oppose revolutionaries and maintain social order . In one of these, the Shinsen-gumi, the young and effeminate cadet Kano is courted by his colleagues and some officers. The boy is perhaps in love with Tashiro, his first comrade in arms. When a superior is found killed, it is Tashiro himself who is suspected of the murder ...
notes: Oshima creates a phantasmagoria that projects its light on history (the Japanese one at the end of the 19th century, one step away from disintegration) and on a closed microcosm, once again of warriors, as in the times of _Furyo_ (1983). Faced with the devastating power of Eros, the first institution to suffer the repercussions of disorder and transgression is precisely the "gohatto", the very strict code of discipline of the samurai. But it is on a personal level that every inhibition turns out to be illusory (great is the sergeant who tries to resist seduction). Accompanied by the hypnotic harmonies of Ryuichi Sakamoto, the Japanese master leads the viewer on an increasingly visionary and now completely internal journey, which finds its showdown - even aesthetic - in the splendid final sequence, when Kitano (the deputy commander) tries to understand which version of events is credible. Without knowing that the truth does not exist: there are only stories.

title: Zamani barayé masti asbha
actors: Nezhad Ekhtiar-dini, Amaneh Ektiar-dini, Ayoub Ahmadi
description: Iranian Kurdistan: a fifteen-year-old boy has to provide for his four little brothers and sisters. One of them suffers from a bone malformation and needs to be operated on. There is war. Children are smugglers, carrying heavy loads up and down the mountains. All adults well ahead of time, all fighting against nature and against men.
notes: A film covered with awards at Cannes: Caméra d'or for best first film (ex aequo with another Iranian film) and Fipresci award from international critics. Kurdish Bahman Ghobadi knows how to tell the stories of his people with cinematic strength and human compassion.

title: Thirteen Days
actors: Kevin Costner, Bruce Greenwood, Steven Culp, Dylan Baker
description: 1962. A spy plane photographs some missile installations on Cuban ground that the Soviets are preparing in a hurry ...
notes: Although this is a well-known story, Donaldson, based on the book _The Kennedy Tapes_, manages to keep the tension high and breathless.

title: La comunidad
actors: Carmen Maura, Eduardo Antuña, Jesús Bonilla, Paca Gabaldón
description: Julia, a real estate agent, accidentally got her hands on a $ 6 billion loot found hidden under a tile in a dead man's apartment. The condominiums, having learned of the fact, are ready for everything, from seduction to murder, as long as Julia does not leave the building with her suitcase full of pesetas.
notes: Alex de la Iglesia directs his most successful film with "La comunidad" proving that he knows how to mix well the lesson of Hitchcock, Polanski from "The Tenant on the Third Floor" and, of course, teasing flashes like Almodóvar. Claustrophobic to the right point, the film becomes a bit numb in the central part, but Carmen Maura, always on the verge of a nervous breakdown, is good enough to keep up the spirit and the irony.

title: The Emperor's New Groove
description: The spoiled and conceited young emperor Kuzco does not hesitate to fire loyal collaborators and expropriate land at his own whim. Transformed into a lama by a potion of the evil councilor Yzma, the young Kuzco soon learns that real life is very different from that of the palace and discovers the value of friendship thanks to the good-natured and gigantic Pacha, from whom he wanted to expropriate the house to build. its new swimming pool. Kuzco's adherence to a new order of values ??is not without obstacles and the emperor often proves comically reluctant to accept his new reality as a lama.
notes: Suspended between innovation and tradition, "The Emperor's Fools" marks a significant departure from the recent Disney production that seemed to be devoted to a supremacy of technique over content, a trend that did not meet the hoped-for success at the box office. The film has undergone several changes during construction, the most substantial was to transform itself from a musical into a comedy, indeed more precisely into a "buddy movie" where the concept of transformation plays, like friendship, a fundamental role. . The happy ending is obvious, but the impression remains that Disney's publishing policy has undergone a small but decisive deviation towards a crackling, noisy comedy and less inclined to a certain "grandeur" of the Studio, which in the past was perhaps the heritage of its competitors. by Warner, in any case, fun is guaranteed.

title: Robinson Crusoe on Mars
actors: Paul Mantee, Victor Lundin, Adam West
description: Kit, along with a companion and a monkey, while flying over Mars aboard a spaceship is forced to abandon it to avoid a collision with a meteorite. Once on the red planet he has to face the problems of survival on an unknown planet. After a few days Kit discovers another living being on which he imposes the name of Friday. The two decide to explore the great polar ice cap of Mars, but their project is hampered by the presence of mysterious flying saucers.
notes: Byon Haskin takes the Robin Crusoe story as a pretext and sets it on the red planet.

title: Afganskiy Izlom
actors: Michele Placido, Tatyana Dogileva, Mikhail Zhigalov, Filipp Yankovsky
description: The end of the Russo-Afghan conflict through the story of a Soviet major and his men, left to fend for themselves and bewildered by the first signs of the collapse of central Moscow power.
notes: A Russian-Italian co-production starring our Michele Placido. Virtually unpublished.

title: Buried Alive 2
actors: Ally Sheedy, Stephen Caffrey, Tracey Needham, Tim Matheson
description: Laura Riskin inherited a fortune. Husband Randy and lover Clint who are not known to be beneficiaries of the fortune plot to kill her and poison her. The problem is that Laura is not dead, but she fell into a deep coma, which is a sort of apparent death. Thus, also due to a mishap that does not allow the embalmer to prepare the corpse properly, the poor woman is buried alive. After the terrible awakening in the coffin, Laura with the strength of desperation manages to free herself from her prison and, once the shock is over, she decides that it is time to take revenge ...

title: Satan's School for Girls
actors: Shannen Doherty, Kate Jackson, Julie Benz, Daniel Cosgrove, Taraji P. Henson
description: Teenager Beth enrolls under a false name at Fallbridge College, a girls' school where she met her sister's death. Officially the accident was filed by the police as a suicide, but Beth, suspicious of some disturbing letters that her sister had sent her before she died, wants to see it clearly. Inside the school, she quickly discovers that there is a sect of Satan worshipers, little witches willing to do anything to expand their power.
notes: On the wave of the success of the television series "Charmed", a Tv Movie built around the protagonist Shenne Doherty.

title: La morte è di moda
actors: Marina Giulia Cavalli, Anthony Franciosa, Theresa Leopard
description: Arriving completely by chance in an isolated villa that has been uninhabited for over twenty years, an attractive model finds herself witnessing a murder. The police are very dubious about his version, which they attribute to the violent shock, but little by little disturbing details emerge.
notes: Suspense rate at the lowest terms.

title: Black Sheep
actors: Chris Farley, Tim Matheson, David Spade, Gary Busey
description: In the middle of the electoral campaign, a candidate for the Washington Senate has to look after his brother Mike, the classic black sheep of the family who, as usual, is in a sea of ??mess ...
notes: Chris Farley (already seen in "Tommy Boy", always paired with Spade, and in "Never Say Ninja") is the slapstick soul of the story. Acrobatics and great work for stunts, for a film that director Penelope Spheeris directs with a propensity for comedians closer to the two episodes of "Fusi di testa" that in the early 1980s ("The boys next door"), in the which investigated the disturbing "decent" violence that shakes the heart of America.

title: Le feu follet
actors: Maurice Ronet, Jeanne Moreau, Lena Skerla, Yvonne Clech
description: Alain, intoxicated by alcohol and tired of his own existence, has only two days left to live. Meetings with friends give him the exact feeling of the absolute strangeness between himself and the rest of the world. Exasperated, Alain takes refuge from his friend Dubourg, who advises him to find someone who can understand his drama. The meeting with Jeanne confirms his inability to live, and not even Solange is able to allay his anguish. At this point Alain is left with only one desperate solution.
notes: Malle draws one of his best films from a novel by Pierre Drieu la Rochelle. Great performance (and amazing monologue) by Maurice Ronet.

title: Berlinguer ti voglio bene
actors: Roberto Benigni, Alida Valli, Carlo Monni, Mario Pachi
description: Mario Cioni is unable to detach himself from the figure of the mother who oppresses him, and is a slave to a society of which he suffers the models of behavior. His rebellions are purely verbal and do not take him away from his inhibitions and frustrations. Even sex - always present in his language and in his fantasies - is a kind of useless revenge. Mario is also a victim of his fellow dance halls, who play a bad joke on him: the only way to free himself from a reality that is close to him is to hope for a revolution led by Enrico Berlinguer ...
notes: Double (and unsolved) debut on the big screen for Bertolucci jr. and Benigni.

title: Cobra Verde
actors: Klaus Kinski, King Ampaw, José Lewgoy, Salvatore Basile
description: Colonel Coutinho calls the bandit Manoel Garcia da Silva, known as "Cobra Verde", to manage his sugar cane plantations. The colonel takes a liking to Manoel because he proves capable of being obeyed by slaves. But the bandit, who entered the officer's house as a guest, seduces and makes all three daughters pregnant. Coutinho, furious, takes revenge by sending him to Africa with the task of giving new impetus to the slave trade, endangered by King Leopard. The colonel hopes that Manoel will never come back from Africa, a victim of the king's hatred towards whites ...
notes: Herzog draws his most spectacular film from a Bruce Chatwin novel.

title: Music From Another Room
actors: Jude Law, Gretchen Mol, Brenda Blethyn, Martha Plimpton
description: Danny is only five years old, but he is convinced that he is marrying Anna, the child he saw born. Twenty-five years pass and the grown-up child meets Anna and her family on his way. The girl is stunning and Danny doesn't feel like he can keep his promise. But there is a small problem Anna is engaged to Eric. But in Danny, fortunately, there is no shortage of suitors: they are the two sisters and Anna's mother.
notes: The screenwriter Charlie Peters ("Seductive Alibi" and "There is a ghost between us"), here in his second work, the first one entitled "Greetings from the dear departed", offers us a good film supported by a good cast.

title: The Opportunists
actors: Cyndi Lauper, Peter McDonald, Christopher Walken, Vera Farmiga
description: Vic is an elderly mechanic with a past as a burglar that he doesn't want to revive. But a couple of young and inexperienced friends convince him to get back on track for the last shot, the one that will fix them. Vic has a lot of debts, a restless daughter, a dependent grandmother: he accepts, and he doesn't care.
notes: Myles Connell had already directed a film in 1993, then it was lost track. It was not so essential to find them eight years later. "The Opportunists" is a film that could have stayed where it was, in America, or go directly to TV, perhaps its initial destination (there is a lot of TV movie air: for the style, the rhythm, the total absence of surges direction).

title: Music of the Heart
actors: Meryl Streep, Aidan Quinn, Angela Bassett, Gloria Estefan
description: Roberta Guaspari, abandoned by her husband, settles in a difficult neighborhood in New York and, as a substitute teacher, teaches the young students of a multi-ethnic school, the joys and pains of the bow, of the chords, of the posture of the feet and of the body, of the exercises, childish melodies. The distrust (of some parents and other teachers) melt and break against Roberta's tenacity, enthusiasm and colorful reproaches.
notes: Cast from a luxury record company (from Gloria Estefan to Isaac Stern, from Mark O'Connor to Itzhak Perlman), sloppy narrative style, linear affectivity and taken from soap, rhythm and shots from solid drama, culinary metaphors.

title: I cavalieri che fecero l'impresa
actors: Raoul Bova, Edward Furlong, Marco Leonardi, F. Murray Abraham
description: In 1271 the seventh Crusade failed. During the retreat, the troops carry the remains of King Louis IX, the Holy King, along the peninsula. A world is over and five boys who have nothing in common set out in search of the place where the Holy Shroud was hidden, stolen by some traitors from the French court. The journey will take them from the Tuscan-Emilian Apennines to Thebes where the Holy relic is hidden.
notes: Pupi Avati, like one of his five young, enthusiastic and somewhat afflicted knights, throws a peaceful gauntlet. To a cinema, the Italian one, not very ambitious and too busy with its abuses and its equilibrium and with itself. He climbs on horseback with his camera, sensitive above all to the disturbances of the soul, gently tied to the roots of a territory, and attempts a fascinating undertaking, in many moments very beautiful and raw, with an excellent work on places and space . He chooses adventure and in the pursuit of action, in the rhetorical and figurative progression of a genre never seen before, in the fear, courage and boldness of clashes, escapes and weapons, in the anxieties of wandering and "seeking "rediscovers the aura of the sacred (the icon / relic of the Shroud is the sacred sheet for which the boys who wanted to be knights work), the profound sense of friendship, the illusions of youth, anagraphic and emotional auroral state, announcement of another season of history.

title: Snatch.
actors: Brad Pitt, Jason Statham, Benicio Del Toro, Vinnie Jones, Dennis Farina, Stephen Graham
description: The thief and courier of precious Franky Quattrodita makes a stop in London. In the English capital he has to place small stones with his boss's cousin Doug "The Pumpkin" and with other jewelers in Hatton Garden. During his stay he is convinced by Boris Lametta to attend an illegal boxing match. Franky doesn't know that Boris has set a trap for him. Meanwhile, the Turco and Tommy are attempting to climb to the top of the organization that manages the clandestine boxing matches.
notes: Double narrative register kept under control by the director / screenwriter whose first take, off-screen, coincides with an original, lively and guessed casting. Brad Pitt relaxes in the role of the Irish gypsy-boxer, with an incomprehensible language. Benicio Del Toro "disguises" himself as a robber and all the others (many come from Ritchie's debut feature) embrace the roles with pride and self-irony. While the director plays with the dialogues and with the shots, his actors, just out of the school of tough, ruthless, crafty, shrewd and childish, throw themselves, like marathon runners, on the track designed for them by a convoluted, overflowing, fractured plot. . Double speed is the unit of measurement of the narrative form. The twist is the norm and not the exception. The patrol of thugs, ferocious and ridiculous, cowards and scoundrels, suddenly accelerates and brakes. Flash back and forth, frame stops, slow motion, swirling cuts tone up a witty and witty visual talent. Frenzy is the cinematic biorhythm that combines neo-pop and the irresistible boldness of cool.

title: Sweet November
actors: Keanu Reeves, Charlize Theron, Jason Isaacs, Greg Germann
description: Nelson is an advertiser who thinks only of his work, completely isolated from the sentimental point of view; then one day he meets Sara, beautiful and self-confident, whose exuberance shatters her little world. Nelson, an orphan from an early age, feels threatened by Chaz, a neighbor of Sara. However, Sara and Nelson soon get together, arousing the jealousy of Vince, a colleague of the girl; around the corner, however, there is a tragic turning point ...
notes: A sloppy remake of a 1968 film, garnished with all the worn-out stereotypes of the comedy-mélo: the flatness of the screenplay and the "supportive" direction leave no way out.

title: Best in Show
actors: Parker Posey, Christopher Guest, Michael Hitchcock, Eugene Levy
description: They came from all over America with one purpose, to participate in the most important event of their life: the Mayflower Dog Show. Their names are Beatrice, Winky, Hubert, Miss Agnes, Tyrone, Rhapsody in White and they are show dogs. If the four-legged are shown calm enough, their owners fight to make them look good.
notes: The film is a very sophisticated comedy, shot with the style of a fake documentary and interpreted, in a regime of total and joyful improvisation, by exceptional actors, not very well known (even if they are all very familiar presences) and with very heterogeneous experiences.

title: Le prime bande
description: Based on the testimonies of Nardo Dunchi, Guido Quazza, Nuto Revelli and numerous other protagonists, the Turin documentary maker Paolo Gobetti reconstructs the birth of the first partisan groups in the period between 8 September 1943 and March 1944, illustrating it with some original films of the time.

title: Dalla Nube alla Resistenza
actors: Olimpia Carlisi, Guido Lombardi, Gino Felici, Lori Pelosini
description: In the sky of Myth, the destinies of humans are subject to the will of the gods: and it is on the themes linked to power that the dialogues of the first part of the film are articulated, especially those between the Cloud and Ixion and between Tiresias and Oedipus. Subsequently, the war stories of the artisan-musician Nuto find an attentive listener in the "Bastardo", who returned from America to his native Langhe after 25 April.
notes: Starting from 6 of the 27 "Dialoghi con Leucò" and from "The moon and the bonfires" by Cesare Pavese (and with the usual expressive intransigence), Straub and Huillet demonstrate once more how cinema can be understood as a place of fruitful aesthetic contamination .

title: Odds Against Tomorrow
actors: Harry Belafonte, Robert Ryan, Shelley Winters, Gloria Grahame
description: Dave, a former police officer, has studied in every detail the plan for a bank robbery. To carry out the blow he needs good men and he finds them. They are Earle Slater (Robert Ryan), an unemployed man who doesn't have the money to marry his girlfriend, and Johnny Ingram (Harry Belafonte), a black singer whose passion for gambling has ruined. Everything seems to be going well, but racial hatred divides Johnny and Earle. The robbery prepared in detail is likely to go awry. The police in fact surprise them and start a firefight.
notes: Robert Wise directs a film full of sharp notes. Good John Lewis jazz soundtrack.

title: Kwai tsan tseh
actors: Jackie Chan, Sammo Hung, Yuen Biao, Benny Urquidez
description: Barcelona: cousins ??Thomas and David, itinerant restaurateurs, team up with their friend Moby, a messed up private detective, to help the beautiful pickpocket Sylvia. After a series of battles, the showdown takes place in the castle-den of the villains.
notes: A go-go adrenaline for the duo Jackie-Sammo, heroes of Hong Kong cinema.

title: La vie est un roman
actors: Fanny Ardant, Vittorio Gassman, Pierre Arditi, Sabine Azéma
description: Forbek, shocked by the horrors of the Great War, gathers all his friends in the castle he had begun to build. His goal is to give them some happiness and to achieve his goal he distributes a potion that can erase memories. In this way everyone will be children again. Livia, Forbek's woman, decides not to drink the potion by rebelling against the crazy project. A group of scholars get together to participate in a seminar on "Education for the imagination". Only four of them will retain their identity.
notes: The topic, happiness and love, is treated by Resnais, with the grace and gentleness of an eighteenth-century writer.

title: America Paese di Dio
description: The film is a kind of journey through America in the late sixties. Luigi Vanzi, assistant director of Antonioni in "Le amici" and "Il grido", shows us modern and depressed urban agglomerations, religious and sporting events, outbursts of racial hatred. The off-screen commentary is entrusted to Italo Calvino.

title: La montaña sagrada/The Holy Mountain
actors: Alejandro Jodorowsky, Valerie Jodorowsky, Ramona Saunders, Horácio Salinas
description: Nine bizarre characters (a young thief and six powerful Lords, each representing a planet of the solar system, plus a mystic and his assistant who act as their guide) undertake the ascent to the Holy Mountain, at the top of which they hope to access the revelation of the secret of immortality by the Nine Sages. But having reached their destination ...
notes: Syncretic explosion of alchemical references, surrealist fragments and religious-sacrilegious imagery, assembled by the South American poet-director-philosopher in his most famous film. Provocative at the time, perhaps dated today, but still wrapped in an aura of fascinating mystery.

title: El Topo
actors: Alejandro Jodorowsky, Mara Lorenzio, Alfonso Arau, David Silva
description: The gunslinger "El Topo" (or "La Talpa") arrives in a remote village in the desert in the company of his very young son, finding there the corpses left by a band of outlaws. Among the survivors he meets a woman, Mara, who leads him on a mission of monks where he will have to prepare to defeat the terrible Four Masters. El Topo leaves his son with the religious and leaves in the company of Mara and a mysterious woman in black; wounded and abandoned, he is picked up by some deformed beings who live in deep caves ...
notes: Symbols in profusion in this delusional and esoteric "surrealist western", fired by the sorcerer Jodorowsky.

title: The Kiss of the Vampire
actors: Clifford Evans, Noel Willman, Edward de Souza, Jennifer Daniel
description: Gerald and Marianne Harcourt, two English spouses on holiday in Germany are crossing the Black Forest. At some point their car begins to have some problems. Husband and wife, forced to stop, still manage to find refuge in a small town and find hospitality in a mysterious castle. Gerald and Marianne are greeted with kindness by Ravna, the owner. The couple do not know, however, that Ravna is the head of a sect of followers of the vampire cult and that he has already set his sights on the beautiful Marianne. To Gerald, the new Van Helsing, the task of defeating the vampire.
notes: Hammer production. The dance sequence is beautiful and surreal.

title: Code inconnu: Récit incomplet de divers voyages
actors: Juliette Binoche, Thierry Neuvic, Josef Bierbichler, Luminita Gheorghiu
description: Juliette is an actress, she hears a little girl screaming in the apartment next to hers, she doesn't pick up the invocation for help and some time later she discovers that the little girl is dead, perhaps beaten by her father. Life goes on. Jean is the brother of Juliette's partner; a restless young man who lives alone with his silent father. One day he runs away and disappears into thin air. Life goes on. Jean angrily threw some paper at a Romanian woman begging for alms. Due to a series of circumstances, the beggar is forced to return home by the police, who treat her like all "sans papiers". Back in the midst of misery. Life goes on. The paintings of history are like small films set together, united by the tragic thread of drift, of incommunicability, of existential ruin, of urban alienation; often punctuated by off-screen where violence explodes, invisible, but present. The moral problem that Haneke, the great Austrian director still misunderstood in Italy despite fundamental titles such as "The sixth continent" and "Benny's Video", poses is precisely this: how life continues in the West (read: Europe) if indifference creates a wall far worse than that of Berlin? "Stories", the original title refers to the lack of a "social" language, is a very hard, ruthless film that places the viewer in front of a mirror in which it is difficult to recognize oneself. But Haneke proves that that reflected image is not deceiving: it is ours.

title: Stregati dalla luna
actors: Pino Ammendola, Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Megan Gale, Nicola Pistoia
description: In a restaurant in Naples, preparations are underway for a great event: the official engagement dinner between Miria, a police officer, and Giuliano, a bewildered carabiniere who is a friend of the managers of the restaurant. Dario and Carlo rely heavily on the success of the party to relaunch the restaurant. But things do not go as expected because Miria confesses to Giuliano that she had a love affair with a colleague from Digos. So the bomb explodes ...
notes: The setting in the world of law enforcement is quite banal and even the surrounding characters wink at the stereotype, like the initial postcard of Vesuvius. And then, do you know what it is? Not funny, damn it!

title: Dangerous Attraction
actors: Linden Ashby, Rae Dawn Chong, Andrea Roth, Ian Tracey
description: Ann Rich is a successful advertising agent. She is currently dating two men, about whom she avoids asking too many questions: at least until she is forced to do so, involved in an unexpected development of the situation. In fact, the discovery of a woman's corpse and the risky conflict of power that ensues lead her to discover new elements on the identity of her companions ...
notes: Yet another routine yellow intertwining, this time Canadian production. The only known name of the cast is the protagonist Rae Dawn Chong, previously seen in Spielberg's "The Color Purple" and in Steve Miner's "Soul Man".

title: Men of Honor
actors: Robert De Niro, Cuba Gooding jr., Charlize Theron, Michael Rapaport
description: Carl Brashear, the son of a Kentucky farmer, doesn't want to give up on his dreams. He leaves home with the hope of a better life. After joining the navy, he writes over a hundred letters to try to be admitted to the diving school program. But there is a problem Carl is black and Billy, the one who will be his instructor, doesn't want to know about him or his ambitions.
notes: Based on the true story of Carl Brashear, it unfolds according to a very traditional system with a slightly stale flavor: classy special effects in underwater shooting, clashes of characters, finally the obligatory trial epilogue, with the main scene of the two stars.

title: Big Mama's House
actors: Martin Lawrence, Nia Long, Paul Giamatti, Jascha Washington
description: Malcolm Turner, an FBI agent is a smart guy who specializes in disguises. The latest case assigned to him takes him to a small town in the southern United States. A dangerous bank robber has escaped and Malcolm must bring him to justice. To study his moves, Malcolm would like to move into the home of Big Mama, a 100-pound matriarch. But a problem arises, the woman has suddenly left the city. So Malcolm decides to take his likeness.
notes: The film is reduced to a listless series of skits in the form of a joke. Some of which are definitely off topic.

title: I recuperanti
actors: Andreino Carli, Antonio Lunardi, Alessandra Micheletto, Oreste Costa
description: 1945: the veteran Gianni, having returned to his native village on the Asiago plateau, finds his girlfriend but not his job. The only job he can find is very dangerous: he must in fact recover metal residues (unexploded bombs) together with the elderly Du.
notes: The film returns the dimension of freedom and adventure of the plateau of the Seven Municipalities, as well as being a reflection on the tragic dementia of war. The screenplay, written by Olmi with Tullio Kezich and Mario Rigoni Stern, is sparse and essential and portrays an almost forgotten rural world. To underline the great interpretation of Toni Lunardi (Du).

title: La cotta
actors: Luciano Piergiovanni, Renata Carniglia, Giovanna Claudia Mongino
description: Andrea, an intelligent fifteen-year-old but a bit listless in his studies, loses his head for Janine. The boy is under the illusion that it is the true and eternal passion: but at the first setback, he is ready to fall in love with another girl, this time however much more mature than him ...
notes: Episode from Tales of Young Love.

title: Il vendicatore mascherato
actors: Guy Madison, Lisa Gastoni, Jean Claudio, Gastone Moschin
description: Venice, 1500. Massimo Tiepolo, brave fighter at the invitation of Luca Badoer, is urged to take part in the conspiracy against the Doge Gradenigo. The man at arms does not feel like supporting the revolt and pulls aside. When the tyrant's thugs capture and torture Luca, Massimo shakes off his indifference and becomes the leader of the conspirators. Elena, Gradenigo's wife, jealous of being rejected by Massimo, denounces him and has him locked up in the Piombi. Following the passionate pleas of Caterina Ziani, the young man's girlfriend, she herself frees him from his cell.
notes: Modest adventure film.

title: Fuk sing go jiu
actors: Jackie Chan, Sammo Hung, Yuen Biao, Sibelle Hu
description: Muscles and Kidstuff, two Hong Kong policemen, travel to Japan to track down and arrest a former colleague who has illegally taken possession of some diamonds of enormous value. After one of the two is taken prisoner by a ninja gang that has taken the thief under their protection, the other works to rally the old gang from the orphanage and rush to his aid.
notes: Between the eighties and nineties the couple Jackie Chan-Sammo Hung (here also in the control room) was furious in an abundant fifteen films, all in the name of the combination of action-stunt-fun. And this too is no exception.

title: Hired to Kill
actors: Brian Thompson, Oliver Reed, Barbara Niven, José Ferrer, George Kennedy, Penelope Reed, Kim Lonsdale
description: A mercenary hired by a political organization recruits some models for a fashion show that will take place in Cyprus. In reality, it is a question of freeing a prisoner, and the "fashion show" - a designer and five models - is only the cover of the operation. The local guerrillas lend a hand and the mission is successful, but at this point it turns out that someone wants to eliminate the members of the group. The idea of ??the fashion show with a completely different purpose is quite original, but it constitutes the greatest value of the film. Which is not badly done, but which offers no other important elements: a decent job and nothing else
notes: Cast of old glories on vacation for the classic product without infamy and without praise.

title: The Long Way Home
actors: Jack Lemmon, Sarah Paulson, Kristin Griffith, Garwin Sanford
description: Widowed, Tom Gerrin decides to move to his son Ken's house and his daughter -in -law Bonnie, the two prove to be very affectionate with him and happy to have him with them, but they end up suffocating him with care and attentions; The presence of him even risks compromising their union. Tom, bored and alone, only waits to die, but a unexpected encounter shakes him: when a traveling circus settles for some time in the city, the man in fact makes the knowledge of Marco and Leanne, who in a short time will make him regain a little of lost serenity. Thanks to these new friends, Tom will decide to take a trip to California ...

title: Non commettere atti impuri
actors: Luciano Salce, Barbara Bouchet, Dado Crostarosa, Simonetta Stefanelli
description: In Assisi live in two apartments, one next to the other, two families. One is made up of Damiano, elderly, atheist and contester, by his son Pino and Nadine, a lover of the latter. The other is bought from three honest and pious women, the seventeen year old Maria Teresa, the mother and grandmother of Costei. Pino, in love with Maria Teresa, in order to approach it, it offers to give it repetitions of Latin. The young man's mother and grandmother willingly accept the presence of Pino. In fact, the two women hope to convert it. And the thing punctually happens. The arrival of an uncle of Maria, however, risks compromising their relationship.
notes: Screenplay by Marco Zavattini, son of Cesare.

title: Le silencieux
actors: Lino Ventura, Lea Massari, Leo Genn, Suzanne Flon, Pierre-Michel Le Conte
description: Haliakof, a member of a Soviet delegation visiting a thermonuclear plant in London, is kidnapped by the British counter-intelligence, which to cover the operation spreads the news of his death in a car accident. The kidnappers, who want to use him to break into the Russian secret services, know everything about his life: his real name is Clement Tibère and he is married to an Italian; he then emigrated to the Soviet Union, where he became a highly regarded researcher ...
notes: Pinoteau, future director of the three episodes of "Il tempo delle mele", tries his hand at a spy-like intrigue, well supported by the usual great Ventura.

title: Ostre sledované vlaky
actors: Václav Neckar, Josef Somr, Nadá Urbanková, Vlastimil Brodsky, Jitka Bendová
description: During the bloody German occupation of Czechoslovakia, the deputy stationmaster Milos must also suffer the consequences of a very unseemly premature ejaculation. Put in contact by a colleague with the partisan gangs, Milos will meet a girl who acts as a relay at his station and who will be able to cure him of the syndrome that afflicts him, but the next day will be the last of his life.
notes: The novel by the caustic Prague humorist Bohumil Hrabal - co-writer with Menzel - gives rise to one of the most significant films of the Czech "nová vlna" of the 1960s: a sharp, vital and anti-rhetorical look at the horrors of war.

title: L'amour à mort
actors: Sabine Azéma, Fanny Ardant, Pierre Arditi, André Dussollier
description: Elisabeth is united by an infinite and all-encompassing feeling to her husband Simon. When the death of the latter, which had already been announced on other occasions, comes final and irrevocable, Elisabeth progressively detaches herself from the world. The comfort of a couple of friends, Protestant pastors, is worth nothing: her only desire is to reunite with Simon through suicide.
notes: Conceived as a musical score punctuated by the strident sounds of Hans Werner Henze, spread over the unfathomable darkness of a series of empty frames, a secular and disturbing film, inexorable but open to a wholly earthly piety, on the absolute dimensions of existence.

title: Harry, un ami qui vous veut du bien
actors: Laurent Lucas, Sergi López, Mathilde Seigner, Sophie Guillemin
description: Michel and Claire with their three daughters, defeated by the heat, travel quickly towards the holidays. In the bathroom of a gas station, Michel meets Harry who claims to be a schoolmate of his. Affectionate, with an iron memory, kind, sure that every problem can be solved, the new-found friend settles down with his girlfriend in the rundown farmhouse where the family will spend the summer. Little by little Harry will show his true nature.
notes: The film directed by Moll, author of six short films and a first film, "Intimité", based on Jean-Paul Sartre, begins as a comedy. The serene and happy atmosphere of the first sequences veers, with skill, towards a pragmatic thriller.

title: Sous le sable
actors: Charlotte Rampling, Bruno Cremer, Jacques Nolot, Alexandra Stewart, Pierre Vernier, Andrée Tainsy
description: Twenty-five years of marriage, middle-class couple, intense looks, few words. A holiday in the Landes, the spartan country house, which needs nothing but their very silent presence. Then, on the beach, the imponderable: he disappears, perhaps swallowed up by the sea, perhaps vanished in a search for anonymity, perhaps suicidal. She is left, incredulous, in shock, who returns to Paris and continues as if nothing had happened, calls her Jean, talks to us at breakfast, lets herself be touched in impossible erotic dreams, evokes him in front of friends. But Jean is really dead, and Marie has to deal with reality.
notes: If the authorial programmaticity does not allow, at the beginning, a real involvement, do not worry: as Marie's elaboration crosses the interpretation of Charlotte (Rampling), Ozon's work takes off, the spirit becomes flesh, the life hangs over the looming deadly halo. A dry, essential, elliptical style (the passage from the Landes to Paris is a real stroke of direction). There isn't, in reality, much to understand: everything is concentrated in the repressed (before) and in the final catharsis (after), when the perfect Bruno Cremer ghost evaporates to leave his Charlotte free to even hate him. Sand-colored lights envelop characters and things. A conscious, beautiful film that has already suffered.

title: Purely Belter
actors: Chris Beattie, Greg McLane, Charlie Hardwick, Jody Baldwin
description: A cup of hot tea with milk and double dose of sugar and an armchair at the stadium to follow all the games of their team, the Newcastle. Gerry and Sewell's desire, a small, quick, perspicacious and thin and the other higher, fat, slower and more incorrect inside a jacket as a football coach, has a price: 1000 pounds for two season tickets.
notes: The nice protagonists are two other teenagers from the love and poor suburbs of a lot of British cinema. Disastrous families (Sewell lives with his grandfather after his father and mother abandoned him, Gerry lives with his sick mother, his drunk father appears, in the various houses where they move helped by social services, only to beat and steal), Disserted schools, misery, marginality and first symptoms of a ninetieth fever. Mark Herman ("Thanks, Mrs. Thatcher") takes a literary text, "The Season Ticket" by Jonathan Tulloch, meditated on the style and on the human and social panorama theorized and institutionalized by Ken Loach and softens the story with rhythms and comedy situations. Some of the most successful and fresh scenes of the film are those in which the funny couple shows off a fair talent in the art of getting by to gather the "sterns".

title: The Mexican
actors: Brad Pitt, Julia Roberts, James Gandolfini, Bob Balaban, J.K. Simmons
description: Jerry is a small fish who works for crime. His boss has given him an assignment: he has to go to Mexico to retrieve "The Mexican" a vintage pistol. Samantha, his girlfriend gave him an ultimatum: stop the thefts and decide to change his life. To control him better, the girl goes to Mexico with him. Once in possession of the weapon, trouble begins. According to the legend in "The Mexican" there is a curse.
notes: Gore Verbinski runs in an effective way, making mistakes worthy of a dante. As for the two actors, a couple of stars, or alleged stars, have never been seen acting so badly.

title: The Kid
actors: Bruce Willis, Spencer Breslin, Lily Tomlin, Emily Mortimer
description: Russ is a sad, neurasthenic and accomplished image consultant. He doesn't have a good relationship with his past and a bad one with others. When Rusty, the boy who was eight years old, enters his house and his life, he has to do that self-analysis and that existential balance that he continues to evade.
notes: The director, Jon Turtletaub, has never been a phenomenon and hasn't gotten better, the screenwriter, Audrey Wells ("George of the Jungle ...?"), For now, is one of the many modest script writers who are putting the world to sleep. American cinema, the performers get away with it.

title: Fast Food, Fast Women
actors: Anna Levine, Jamie Harris, Louise Lasser, Robert Modica, Victor Argo
description: Bella works as a waitress, she easily crosses the threshold of thirty-five but says she feels a hundred. His love life is a disaster, his neuroses are Olympic. An Englishman, Bruno, who is a taxi driver but believes himself a writer, has two children and does not even know what a family is. Paul, a shy and widowed man, cannot calmly face the court of Emily, who is also a widow. Seymour succumbs to the charm of a peep show dancer.
notes: Israeli director Amos Kollek has in mind New York's "great storytellers" and the minimalist touch of intellectual comedy. With a nod to several references, he constructs an actor's film, fun and light, perhaps a little cerebral in proposing itself as a metaphor for one or more existential conditions. Kollek has a truly superb cast on his side, starting with the protagonist Anna Levine, an American actress who, however, has built her fame above all in France (where she is beloved and sought after by the best filmmakers) to finish with Victor Argo, the dear face of Abel Ferrara and to Auster himself, who here defines with the character of Seymour (the irascible old man) a truly unrepeatable mask.

title: Remember the Titans
actors: Denzel Washington, Will Patton, Wood Harris, Ryan Hurst
description: In 1971, in Alexandria, Virginia, the school department decided to merge two high schools attended, separately, by white and black students. Full integration and racial tolerance are two distant and contradictory goals. The mistrust and above all, the alleged differences are lacerating. They involve habits, musical choices, family patterns, illusions, jargon. At the head of the Titans, the mixed football team that was born from the merger of the two high schools, is put the black Herman Boone who with the help of the old coach must work hard to prevent racial clashes.
notes: The film tells the true story of a mixed football team, the Titans, which, thanks to sport and a legendary coach, Herman Boone (Denzel Washington), triumphs in a season not to be forgotten and lives, after contrasts, tensions and hostility ( illustrated with a crescendo without complexes), a parenthesis in which civil rights are realized in the locker room, during training, in free time. Rhetorical and conventional, in the tradition of sports movies, the screenplay is written with a collective "Rocky" and "Winning Shot" in mind. The historical cue and the theme ennoble the vigorous staging and good interpretation.

title: Il gioco
actors: Susan Lynch, Claudia Gerini, Jonathan Pryce, Enrico Silvestrin
description: Mark Walker, a well-known art critic specializing in unmasking and unmasking copyright forgeries, ensnares Michela, a young actress who shares her apartment with photographer Corinna, convincing her to play for him a fascinating female figure named Fiammetta. Mark's break-in into the two girls' lives triggers the reaction of Corinna's boyfriend ...
notes: The project required a firm control of the staging, capable of avoiding the traps of a "chiseled" writing: but the reason of the actors (and that of the spectators) falters, betrayed by a script that appears suffocated by too intelligent readings.

title: Trolösa
actors: Lena Endre, Erland Josephson, Krister Henriksson, Thomas Hanzon
description: Markus, an established conductor, is married to Marianne; the two have a nine-year-old daughter, Isabelle. Markus's best friend, David, whose presence is so familiar that it doesn't cause any concern, visits their home. But one evening the irreparable happens: Marianne looks at David with different eyes ...
notes: Liv Ulmann was the great actress of nine Ingmar Bergman films, of masterpieces such as "Persona", "Whispering and Screaming" and "Scenes from a Wedding". After becoming a director, she directed two films, then Bergman entrusted her with the script of the remarkable "Private Conversations" in 1996. The film begins as a love story (Paris!) And soon becomes an investigation, stormy and terrible, entirely Bergmanian, on how passions lead to the laceration and destruction of the love one was looking for. Feelings of guilt, humiliation, perverse games, fury and sadism, a fatal fate to the point of perdition. And a great direction, tense and lucid, by Ulmann, whose camera seeks its own truth along merciless sequence shots and finally finds it in the close-ups, on the faces of the actors, with a Lena Endre who makes Marianne a painful and heartbreaking in breathtaking scenes from tragic and fatal anime thriller: Flayed.

title: Chimera
actors: Iaia Forte, Tommaso Ragno, Tomas Arana, Franco Nero, Marit Nissen
description: Illusionist Tomas tells his wife Desiré the strange love story between Emma and Sal who go in search of the lost passion thanks to a pretend play. Emma and Sal retrace, reliving them, the episodes and situations that caused the crisis in their relationship.
notes: Pappi Corsicato's film renounces carnality, bright colors and the explicit grotesque of "Libera" and "I holes neri", to work underground in a universe that cannot fail to be aseptic. The movements and words of all the "characters" always sound like "quotes", like phrases and moments in a script.

title: Deadly Surveillance
actors: Michael Ironside, Christopher Bondy, Susan Almgren, David Carradine
description: Two policemen, Michels and Fender, investigate a series of murders whose common denominator appears to be drug trafficking. Heavy suspicions converge on Rachel, the attractive lover of one of the two law enforcement officers, which obviously introduces a further element of tension in the affair.
notes: This explicitly televised Canadian production boasts its main reason for interest in the cast of Michael Ironside, a doc evil grin already seen and appreciated in films such as "Scanners" by his fellow (Toronto) David Cronenberg or - more recently - "Starship Troopers" by Paul Verhoeven.

title: Sins of Desire
actors: Nick Cassavetes, Tanya Roberts, Delia Sheppard, Jay Richardson
description: A doctor and his wife, owners of a clinic in which drug and sex-based therapies are officially applied to patients suffering from particular dysfunctions, exploit the delicate situation in a criminal way. To unmask them, an insurance investigator tries to recover a recording that his wife had hidden before she was murdered: he will combine his efforts with those of a nurse, the sister of another of the victims, who is hired by the health institution in so as to be able to gather overwhelming evidence against the two perverse owners.
notes: Morbid atmospheres and little else in this routine thriller.

title: Game of Death
actors: Bruce Lee, Gig Young, Dean Jagger, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Sammo Hung, Colleen Camp
description: Billy Lo is a kung fu champion who now only performs - albeit for high fees - in front of the camera. But his fiancée, actress Ann, is persecuted by Dr. Land, who demands money in exchange for her protection.
notes: Bruce Lee's latest film, shot in 1973 and reassembled five years later.

title: Il terzo segreto di Fatima
actors: Mandala Tayde, Regina Bianchi, Venantino Venantini, Massimo De Lorenzo, Daniele Cecchi
description: In the monastery of Coimbra, in Portugal, the elderly Sister Lucia has a vision that disturbs her and deeply upsets her; confiding in her confessor, she reveals to him that she has had the premonition of an imminent danger of death that would threaten the Pope. Faced with the skepticism of her interlocutors, the nun gives Sister Isabel, a novice assigned to her assistance, to go to Rome to deliver a letter to a monsignor of the Vatican Secretariat of State in which he implores him to persuade the Pontiff to examine the third secret of Fatima. Only in this way can the leader of Christianity be able to hope to save himself ...

title: The Sterile Cuckoo
actors: Liza Minnelli, Wendell Burton, Tim McIntire
