description: Pookie Adams, a bizarre and somewhat agitated girl, has a particular feeling for Jerry, a shy and reserved peer who at first resists her but then lets herself go. But Pookie holds onto her love too much, and she ends up being alone.
notes: Pakula's debut film, introspective and intimate.

title: 3 Ninjas Kick Back
actors: Victor Wong, Max Elliott Slade, Sean Fox, Evan Bonifant
description: In the midst of a major baseball game, the three ninja brothers learn that their beloved grandfather over there in Japan is having a particularly bad time. Having left in a hurry for the Far East and arrived promptly at their destination, our heroes will have to use all their powers to defend the old man from his eternal enemy, returned to circulation to exact revenge.
notes: The vicissitudes of the protagonists unfold along the well-known lines of the genre without any unforeseen circumstances. A few years later the little Evan Bonifant (here in the role of Tum Tum) will participate in the "return" of the famous Blues brothers.

title: Vita coi figli
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Corinne Cléry, Monica Bellucci, Laura Linguiti
description: Fifty-year-old Adriano is an established Milanese executive who, in a car accident, lost his wife, a strong and faithful woman who raised five children: Maria Luisa, Francesca, Maurizio, Paolo and Toni. Adriano, always busy with work, realizes that he does not know his boys thoroughly. Fortunately, next to the man is Valeria, his mistress who tries to help him. The first abrupt impact with reality occurs when the industrialist discovers that Maria Luisa was the lover of Fabrizio, the family lawyer. The "clarification" of the lawyer ends up in fists. XXXNERO Part 2 airs tomorrow at the same time

title: Omicidio a luci blu
actors: Florence Guérin, Brian Peterson, David Hess, Joseph Misiti
description: Jezabel is a prostitute who manages to satisfy the most absurd requests of her very particular clientele. She is stationed every night on Cannibal Street and is "protected" by Mike, a small and aggressive Irishman who is always ready to lead his hands. Scarlet is a very sought after model in the environment for her professionalism. In reality it is the same person who during the day has chosen the equally profitable modeling activity as a cover. Scarlet is on the trail of the killer, a sex maniac, who killed her brother, at least she believes, after horribly mutilating him.
notes: Fellini and Leone's assistant director directs an obvious thriller.

title: Andy Warhol's Frankenstein
actors: Udo Kier, Joe Dallesandro, Monique van Vooren, Dalila Di Lazzaro, Arno Juerging, Srdjan Zelenovic, Nicoletta Elmi, Marco Liofredi, Liù Bosisio, Fiorella Masselli, Cristina Galoni, Rosita Torosh, Carla Mancini, Imelde Marani
description: Despite the troubled family menage, the ineffable Baron Frankenstein has not given up on his plans. So, after having "manufactured" a female and a male specimen, he has the idea of ??making them mate, thus giving way to a new perfect breed: however, he has not taken into account the unexpected ...
notes: Macabre, grand Guignolesco, poised between horror and parody, is one of the two films shot in Italy by Andy Warhol's "factory". Illustrious participations (among others, Tonino Guerra in the dialogues and Enrico Job in the sets; the tricks are instead of Dawson / Margheriti, to whom the Italian version is also credited), but the outcome remains so.

title: The Calling
actors: Laura Harris, Richard Lintern, Francis Magee, Nick Brimble
description: American Kristie St. Clair has had it all from life: a beautiful marriage in Europe, a famous and charming TV journalist husband, a beautiful home, a rewarding job and finally a handsome and intelligent son. All this goes up in smoke when the beautiful Kristie realizes that these are pieces of a diabolical project that has as its purpose the possession of the world.
notes: The film is a patchwork, in which it is not difficult to see images and situations already seen in the past, and little Dylan becomes more and more the pale imitation of the terrifying Damien, protagonist of the tetralogy that started from "The Omen".

title: One Night at McCool's
actors: Liv Tyler, Matt Dillon, John Goodman, Michael Douglas, Paul Reiser
description: Jewel, red hair, incendiary lipstick, sheer dresses, plunging necklines, she is too mischievous and willing for a bartender with a falling apart house, for a very religious cop, a lawyer and a killer. The contract killer (he should kill the woman of sin for ten thousand dollars), a psychoanalyst and a priest collect the confessions of the three men who met Jewel.
notes: The funny film, produced by Douglas and directed by newcomer Harald Zwart, with perfect actors, is a fine example of comedy-noir in which deception, death, theft and deception are in their place, and, at the same time, elsewhere. Between grotesque and parody, between advertising quotes and lighthearted tributes to the Village People and to "A day of ordinary madness".

title: Animali che attraversano la strada
actors: Enrica Maria Modugno, Francesca Rallo, Salvatore Grasso
description: Martina is only fourteen years old and spends her days alone, her mother works as a prostitute, on the streets of the most degraded Roman suburbs. For fun, together with Sciù they plan and score small hits in department stores, in motorway restaurants and on the bus. One day Martina is pinched by the police and only thanks to the involvement of a social worker can she avoid jail.
notes: A strong film, but not very translated, which breathes like a vintage smoker, which turns on and off like a flashing traffic light. Clear consent, however, to the very young Francesca Rallo, ultra (sincere) of the discomfort.

title: Exit Wounds
actors: Steven Seagal, DMX, Anthony Anderson, Bille Duke, Isaiah Washington
description: We are in Detroit and an overly angry and taciturn cop is punished and sent to a district at risk. Fifty kilos of heroin disappear and the easy-fisted detective suspects that some colleagues are involved in the dirty business. He will fight, beyond the law, to the last move, with the help of Latrell Walker, internet genius and with a brother in jail.
notes: The pirouettes, kicks and blows (this is in a film in which the dialogue scenes are banal connections in a plot built on a frenetic progression of pure "action"), are broken up into deliberately confused images as if to mask the lost Steven Seagal's agility that needs neither asking nor acting.

title: Almost Famous
actors: Patrick Fugit, Billy Crudup, Kate Hudson, Frances McDormand, Fairuza Balk
description: 1973: After attending the concert of his favorite band, Stillwater, 15-year-old William is commissioned by the prestigious "Rolling Stone" magazine to write an article on the tour that the band is carrying out for America. Although harassed at a distance by his apprehensive mother (who has already seen her eldest daughter leave home and often telephones him to advise him not to take drugs), William finds himself "on the road", gets to know the musicians closely and falls in love with the " groupie "Penny Lane ...
notes: Recalling an autobiographical experience, Crowe captures the wonder of an unrepeatable musical moment. A two-hour and two-minute film that runs away with a lightness and a richness that we have forgotten: through the stages of the "Almost Famous Tour '73", stories, sounds and faces are mixed in a "period" fresco that it never expires in the manner. The director grabs a suggestive image (the attack of a concert or a girl dancing alone in an empty hall), frames it, gives it space and immediately abandons it. There is not a wasted meter of film, nor a joke, a smile, a tear. Moving and engaging.

title: Enemy at the Gates
actors: Jude Law, Ed Harris, Joseph Fiennes, Rachel Weisz, Bob Hoskins
description: Stalingrad, 1942. A bitter battle is being fought in the Soviet city. After a series of defeats the Soviet Union is on the verge of collapse and the loss of the city to the invaders would ensure the final victory for the Nazi troops. Stalin sends Khrushchev to watch over Stalingrad. The decisive battle of the Russian front, and fundamental junction of the entire Second World War, is told as a duel between snipers who, in their personalities, summarize the class struggle. The Soviet, Vassili, comes from the Urals and is the son of peasants, the German, König, is noble, dapper, clearly sadistic.
notes: The story is authentic, Vassili Zaitsev was truly an infallible shooter and in the post-war USSR he became a kind of "star". But all around the two "gunslingers" or riflemen, there was a war, an epochal clash in which the Red Army commanded by Zhukov performed acts of heroism (and invented, so to speak, the modern urban guerrilla) to cope with the Von Paulus forces. Annaud instead describes a Soviet operetta army, at the mercy of the propaganda delusions of Khrushchev (Bob Hoskins) and the political commissars. If that had been the case, the Germans would have taken Stalingrad and we, perhaps, would not be here today. "The enemy at the gates" is spectacular in the first part (more choral), exciting and beautifully shot in some central sequences, ridiculous in the "Sergio Leone" finale. Overall a great missed opportunity.

title: Vercingétorix
actors: Christopher Lambert, Klaus Maria Brandauer, Max Von Sydow, Ines Sastre
description: The Romans invade Gaul with the intention of subduing it. The leader of the Arverni, Celtill, refuses to submit and is brutally murdered by his brother Gobannitio and under the eyes of his son, the young Vercigentorix. As a teenager he is initiated into the arts of combat by the Druids, avenges his father by killing Gobanitto and takes the head of the rooster cavalry as they prepare to invade England.
notes: Director Jacques Dorfmann unconsciously launches himself into the epic vein and sings the exploits of Vercingetorix, the legendary hero who dared to challenge the military power of Rome. The film is defeated by a catastrophic interpretation and by battles massacred by the camera and the editing.

title: La rosa rossa
actors: Alain Cuny, Elisa Cegani, Giampiero Albertini, Antonio Battistella
description: After the First World War, General Paolo Balzeri goes to visit Koper with his cousins ??Piero and Ines. Among the fragments that unravel on the thread of memory, the soldier guards with particular affection the memory of the red roses that a mysterious woman used to leave in her room.
notes: A subdued and intimate story, shot with finesse and irony by Giraldi and based on the novel of the same name by Pier Antonio Quarantotti Gambini (1937). Well supported by the soundtrack of Luis Bacalov and the interpretations of a high level cast, the film boasts numerous awards from critics and festival juries.

title: Un anno di scuola
actors: Laura Lenzi, Stefano Patrizi, Juliette Mayniel, Mario Adorf
description: Trieste, 1913: Edda Marty attends the last class in a high school for men in order to enter the university. The school year, marked by crises and disturbances, will end amidst the gloomy omens of the Great War.
notes: From a story by Giani Stuparich, an acute and non-mannered historical reconstruction.

title: Ballad of the Nightingale
actors: Seymour Cassel, Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Philippe Bergeron
description: Alina, a prostitute struggling with a particularly troubled phase of her life, agrees to embark on a crazy adventure that at a certain point - needless to say - leads her to have to deal with none other than the mafia. Which, as you can well imagine, will cause you more than a headache ...
notes: The directorial debut of Greville Morris, until then active as a set designer mainly on television. There is the American away Cucinotta (decorative as always: how can you expect more, on the other hand?), But there is also Cassel, a former icon of Cassavetes cinema. Illustrious appearances for Michael and Virginia Madsen and Harry Dean Stanton.

title: Morgan il pirata
actors: Steve Reeves, Lydia Alfonsi, Chelo Alonso
description: The privateer Henry Morgan, reduced to slavery, is bought by Ynez, daughter of the Governor of Panama, with whom he falls in love. However, this provokes his deportation on a Spanish ship: the consequent revolt of the convicts, led by himself, gives way to a series of daring undertakings including the liberation of Ynez, who had been taken prisoner, and the attack on the stronghold. of Panama, whose riches will eventually fall into his hands. But Morgan's heart always beats for Ynez, whom fate has once again turned away from him ...
notes: Zeglio directs under the "supervision" of André de Toth, but even so the film fails to lift itself from mediocrity.

title: Kingpin
actors: Woody Harrelson, Randy Quaid, Vanessa Angel, Bill Murray
description: Roy Munson is a bowling champion, but his glory soon ends due to a beating in which his magical right hand wins. Seventeen years later we find him bald, semi obese, alcoholic and with a rubber limb. And in the company of a dazed Amish who, potentially, could become an ace of the ball that knocks down the pins.
notes: Second film by the Farrelly Brothers. Between failures, epochal vomits and an extraordinary Bill Murray in the role of a wicked villain, the directors of "All Crazy About Mary" and "Dumb & Dumber" depict a bitter America. A New Hollywood film passed by John Landis in class.

title: Firestorm
actors: Howie Long, Scott Glenn, William Forsythe, Suzy Amis
description: Firefighter Jesse Graves takes on the task of rescuing colleagues stranded in a forest fire. Or at least that's what he believes: in fact, in fact, the alleged firefighters are nothing more than a group of fugitives led by Earl Shaye, a criminal who takes advantage of the flames artfully set by his lawyer to take possession of an enormous sum of money.
notes: Someone called him a perfect example of an involuntary comedian, and there is undoubtedly something true. Certainly Semler's film is not the most significant title in the honored career of Scott Glenn, one of the toughest "tough guys" in American cinema.

title: Blindfold
actors: Rock Hudson, Claudia Cardinale, Jack Warden, Guy Stockwell
description: To treat Arthur Vincent, an atomic scientist, General Pratt, who is in charge of secret protective measures in the army, turns to Dr. Snow, a well-known psychiatrist. The man is convinced that all those around him are traitors. The sick person is treated not only by the doctor, but also by a group of people: Detective Harrigan, a Barker government agent, Davis, medical officer and Fitzpatrick. Dr. Snow will try to find out why so many people are interested in him.
notes: The film, based on a novel by Lucille Fleycher, does not take itself too seriously and leaves a lot of room for irony.

title: La sciantosa
actors: Anna Magnani, Massimo Ranieri, Rosita Pisano, Nico Pepe
description: Early twentieth century. A singer from the café chantant falls in love with a young soldier who is about to leave to fight the First World War.
notes: As usual, a great Anna Magnani who stands out when she sings "O surdato d'amore" in front of an audience of wounded soldiers. Photo by Leonida Barboni.

title: Il padrone sono me!
actors: Myriam Bru, Paolo Stoppa, Pierre Bertin, Andreina Pagnani, Assunta Radico, Albino Cocco
description: Robertino, the American cousin Dolly and Zvanì, the farmer's son, spend their holidays in a country villa. Years pass and love grows between the two cousins ??...
notes: A good visual taste and a careful look at the socio-political dimension make Brusati's debut from Alfredo Panzini's novel a discreet work.

title: Bluebeard's Eighth Wife
actors: Claudette Colbert, Gary Cooper, Edward Everett Horton, David Niven
description: A very rich and young American industrialist, already divorced seven times, meets the daughter of a penniless marquis in Paris, falls in love with her and asks her to marry him. When the girl discovers the marital past of the man she married she thinks of teaching him a lesson. She agrees to go to the altar as long as the industrialist, in case of divorce, pays her the sum of one hundred thousand dollars a year. The day after the wedding, the woman obsesses her husband so much that, in the end, he is forced to file for a divorce.
notes: Lubitsch takes an Alfred Savoir comedy and brings it to the screen with the Cooper / Colbert duo. The film was brought to the screen in 1923.

title: Desire
actors: Marlene Dietrich, Gary Cooper, John Halliday, William Frawley
description: Madeleine de Beaupre, an international thief steals a pearl necklace. To try to escape a normal customs control, he slips it into the pockets of Tom Bradley, an engineer on vacation. The woman lets herself be followed, as they are both going to the same place and being courted by Tony. Madeleine's only purpose is to recover the jewel, but, in the end, she can't resist Tony's charm and falls in love with it. The thief, in view of the wedding, feels the duty to confess everything to Tony who manages to snatch her from the clutches of his accomplices.
notes: Romantic comedy directed by Borzage produced and supervised by Lubitsch.

title: Poulet au vinagre
actors: Jean Poiret, Michel Bouquet, Stéphane Audran, Lucas Belvaux
description: A town in the French province is devastated by a series of crimes linked to a real estate deal. The number one suspect is Louis Cuno, the country's postman. Inspector Lavardin with unorthodox methods arrives in the town to conduct the investigations from the capital and will have his hard work trying to untangle the tangled skein.
notes: Claude Chabrol draws the story from a novel by Dominique Roulet who also signs the screenplay. The figure of Inspector Lavardin played by Jean Poiret will give rise to a series of telefilms. The film retains small and mean characters typical of the French province.

title: The Offence
actors: Sean Connery, Derek Newark, Trevor Howard, Ian Bannen
description: A maniac wanders around a school attacking girls who come home alone from school. Despite the dense safety net organized by Sergeant Johnson, 12-year-old Jane is tortured. At this point, the police, having failed to obtain information from the child, sifted through the area surrounding the school. During the patrols, Kenneth is stopped, a boy who wanders almost deliriously at night through the streets of the city. During the interrogations to which he is subjected Kenneth dies of the beatings received. The accused is Agent Johnson.
notes: The film, based on a John Hopkins play, relies too much on word.

title: Viper
actors: Lorenzo Lamas, Frankie Thorn, Hank Cheyne, Joe Son
description: Travis Blackstone, a former policeman, was sent to prison because he destroyed the evidence of his brother's guilt. Now, he is free again but Rhonda, his ex and currently partner of his brother Franklin, informs him that he is in trouble again because he has a debt of five million dollars. Travis leaves her to try to bring help to his brother. His partner Lindee, jealous, thinking he left her for Rhonda, puts killers on his heels.
notes: Tibor Takács, director of "Don't Open That Gate" and "Don't Open That Gate 2" and "Bats" proves to be at ease even when it comes to shooting action movies.

title: Il mestiere delle armi
actors: Christo Jivkov, Sergio Grammatico, Sandra Ceccarelli, Giancarlo Belelli
description: The fog, the cold, the snow of November 1526. The Lanzichenecchi of Charles V, emperor of the Alemanni, commanded by Zorzo Frundsberg, march towards Rome and Joanni de 'Medici, captain of a papal army, delays the advance and he opposes the enemy with his men in burnished armor - with black bands - to strike better in the dark, suddenly, with audacity and tactical intuition.
notes: War is a job, a profession (money for soldiers allows leaders to have prestige, authority and a fragile form of fidelity), a vocation (the thought of death does not touch the philosophy of existence), an instrument of politics (subterfuge, double game, turnaround and allied lies), a war technique laboratory (from swords, spears, harquebuses to falconets, brand new bombards capable of hitting enemy soldiers with two-pound balls). "The profession of weapons", the magnificent film by Ermanno Olmi, tells the last days of Joanni de 'Medici's life and the epochal transformation of the tragic art of war. In the dazzling shots the rhythms and the majestic scenery of nature, stripped by late autumn, and the columns of men on the march are mixed; mass scenes, filmed with admirable sensitivity for space and movement, and scenes of solitude, waking, reading, waiting, remembrance (of his wife and child) and sadness (love for the noblewoman of Mantua interpreted by Sandra Ceccarelli). The director captures, thanks to a very pure style, one of the secrets of a world and a century, the sixteenth century, in which actions begin to conflict with thoughts and the Renaissance awaits Descartes and trembles for the science of weapons.

title: Intimacy
actors: Mark Rylance, Kerry Fox, Timothy Spall, Alastair Galbraith
description: His name is Jay, she Claire. We meet them in a squalid London apartment: he is at home, she plays the bell, he opens them; They say nothing, they make love. Claire is married and is an amateur actress; Jay is divorced, he is bartender in a place. Both have children, and they are socially "inserted", certainly not dropout. But every Wednesday they have this space of freedom, of intimacy, speechless, in which social rituals give way to an eros without implicit.
notes: It is likely that Patrice Cheéreau has conceived "Intimacy - in intimacy" as the dream of an escape from the social, from a world of artifact relationships. Only the dream, of course. The film stages a not extreme, not sunny sex, almost peacefully "normal": a balance that breaks when the two characters cannot resist the desire to speak. Very intense, very participating, shot with a camera that is on the two actors and becomes the third protagonist. The only flaw could even be a value: it is a "closed" film, obsessive as the story that tells. Mark Rylance and Kerry Fox are extraordinary.

title: Cut
actors: Molly Ringwald, Frank Robert, Kylie Minogue, Geoff Revell
description: A few Australian students decide to finish a horror film that has a curse on it. The director was in fact massacred during the filming, and since then at each screening someone leaves her skin. Not content, the young cinephiles recall the ancient protagonist to the set, who wants to close the accounts with the ghosts of the past.
notes: "Cut" is proof of the damage done by the "Scream" series. Awareness of the genre is fine, but now we are exaggerating, and above all we are sinking into boredom. The only effort of this type of script is to invent new ways to kill with the sword. After a while, however, even this game becomes repetitive.

title: AntiTrust
actors: Ryan Phillippe, Claire Forlani, Tim Robbins, Richard Roundtree, Rachael Leigh Cook
description: IT boss Gary Winston gets into trouble: his empire is becoming a monopoly. Despite the trials, however, he continues to work on Synapse, a new global communication system, aided by young computer geniuses. Some of these die in mysterious circumstances and the best one, Milo, begins to understand.
notes: Interesting screenplay by Howard Franklin, author of the remarkable "Prying Eye" with Joe Pesci. It is not so much the (very conventional) twists that amaze as the subject matter (but the hacking by hard and pure idealists is contradicted by the occult advertisements scattered here and there in the film). Direction is rather banal.

title: These Three
actors: Merle Oberon, Miriam Hopkins, Bonita Granville, Margaret Hamilton
description: After opening a boarding school in a New England town, Martha Dobie and Karen Wright must defend themselves from the scandal caused by the lies of a pupil, the wicked and wealthy 13-year-old Mary Tilford. The puritanism of the community will force the two teachers to close the institute. Wyler makes use of the screenplay that Lilian Hellman drew from a 1934 drama of hers, "The Children's Hour", from which he removed the lesbian references by adding a happy ending which, however, does not erase the text's biting references to the hypocrisy of deep America. . Remade - uncensored - by Wyler himself in 1962 ("Quelle due").

title: Dead End
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Sylvia Sidney, Joel McCrea, Allen Jenkins
description: "Angel Face" Martin is a thug originally from the East Side of New York. Seeking refuge from the police who are hunting him, he returns to "his" slums but is abruptly chased away by his mother. His fame makes him very popular with the new generation of local crime (the "Dead End Kids"); but the architect Dave Connell, unemployed and idealistic, will oppose his arrogance to the extreme.
notes: Rather than in the studio, Wyler would have liked to shoot on real places to emphasize the contrast between the miserable scenarios in which the protagonists live and the adjacent wealthy buildings. Nonetheless, it still remains a great film.

title: A Smile Like Yours
actors: Lauren Holly, Greg Kinnear, Joan Cusack, Jay Thomas
description: Danny and Jennifer Robertson are a happy married couple from San Francisco. Beautiful, charming, rich, in love, professionally affirmed and satisfied, the two are missing only one thing: a child. To tell the truth, Danny is hesitant, but - despite some complications linked to his supposed infertility - he eventually gives in to his wife's desire for motherhood. However, their relationship is put to the test when both Danny and Jennifer have the opportunity to betray each other ...
notes: Moderately pleasant comedy, although penalized by an annoying excess of fuss that can be felt above all in the scenes and dialogues involving the two protagonists.

title: Rancid Aluminium
actors: Rhys Ifans, Joseph Fiennes, Tara Fitzgerald, Sadie Frost, Steven Berkoff
description: Life is a matter of perspective and 30-year-old Welsh Pete Thomas is wrong. Wealthy and handsome, Pete is actually a man without qualities who works in his father's publishing company run by a close friend, but his main occupation is having a child who doesn't arrive. Pete and his girlfriend undergo thorough checks and for Pete to boost his cum becomes something of an obsession.
notes: The film, based on the book of the same name by James Hawes, would like to be many things together: a "black comedy", a thriller and perhaps even a little pulp. In reality it soon turns into a confusing patchwork.

title: All the Pretty Horses
actors: Matt Damon, Henry Thomas, Penélope Cruz, Rubén Blades
description: John Grady Cole is a young ranchero, very skilled with horses, who lives in Texas on the family ranch. When his grandfather dies, his mother decides to sell the property, and with his friend Lacey he crosses the border of the Rio Bravo to seek his fortune in some Mexican hacienda. On the way they meet a teenage cowboy who somehow marks their life and they find work on a large farm where John falls in love with the owner's beautiful daughter. The fate until then propitious, begins to turn against the two boys who will meet again, but only after passing very hard tests.
notes: Taken from the first book of the "Tetralogy of the border" by the celebrated American writer Cormac McCarthy, "Rebel Passion" had all the credentials to renew the success of the western: the end of an era saturated with great events, the power of the relationship between men / nature, the metaphor of initiation into adult life and a great love story. Billy Bob Thornton, in his second direction after the praised "Sharp Blade", had the opportunity to produce a Peckinpah-style reinterpretation of the genre, but he let it go with an anodyne direction that does not create emotion, that lets the seductions of McCarthy's text in the placid waters of the Rio Bravo and which clashes with the aura of "damned" that is painstakingly building in Hollywood.

title: I cosacchi
actors: Edmund Purdom, John Drew Barrymore, Pierre Brice, Massimo Girotti, Giorgia Moll
description: To control the Circassians, submissive but not dominated, the Russians take young Jamal hostage, the son of chief Chamil, and send him to Petersburg where he will attend a school for officer cadets. Jamal swears allegiance to the tsar and will even save his life, which angers his father who in the meantime has decided to resume the guerrilla war. The Russian troops, under the command of Prince Voronzoff, move against the Circassians and Chamil resolves to imprison Jamal himself along with Tatiana, the daughter of Voronzoff with whom he is in love. But the two manage to escape and ...
notes: Historical-sentimental Romanzone in costume and with mass scenes: cinema of the past.

title: Xia ri fu xing
actors: Jackie Chan, Sammo Kam-Bo Hung, Richard Ng, Eric Tsang, Kiu Wai Miu , Stanley Sui-Fan Fung, Fat Chung, Andy Lau, Michelle Yeoh
description: Hong Kong policemen Jackie and Ricky take a beach vacation in Thailand to celebrate the success of their latest venture. Needless to say, however, they must hurry back to base: their new mission is to ... protect the life of a "godfather of drugs".
notes: Sequel to "The gang of the nutters".

title: La faccia violenta di New York
actors: Mimsy Farmer, Sergio Jimenez, Luigi Pistilli, Fernando Rey
description: Sergio, a Mexican boy with a pure soul but out of habit addicted to violence decides to try his luck leaving his city and emigrating to the slums of New York. It soon falls into the hands of the "Brotherhood of Latin America", an organization that exploits illegal immigrants with blackmail and violence. The Mexican falls in love with the boss's slave girl and with her decides to flee to Mexico. The betrayed boss will go after them.
notes: The film directed by Jorge Darnell is a co-production between Italy, Mexico and Spain. An excellent actor like Fernando Rey was also involved in the cast.

title: Liebe ist kälter als der Tod
actors: Ulli Lommel, Hanna Schygulla, Rainer Werner Fassbinder, Ingrid Caven, Kurt Raab, Katrin Schaake, Gisela Otto, Ursula Strätz, Monika Nüchtern, Hans Hirschmüller, Les Olvides, Peer Raben, Howard Gaines, Peter Moland
description: Franz, a cheap pimp, has to contend with Bruno, the gangster put on his tracks by the "union" he refused to join; the two become friends, however, to the point that the former agrees to share even his girlfriend, Joanna, with the other. But soon the latter gets tired of Bruno's attentions and when she learns of his plan (designed in collusion with Franz himself) to rob a bank, she denounces him before he manages to eliminate it. Bruno is killed by the police, while Franz and Joanna manage to escape.
notes: Fassbinder's debut feature, poised between noir influences and Godardian deconstruction.

title: Warum läuft Herr R. Amok?
actors: Kurt Raab, Lilith Ungerer, Amadeus Fengler, Franz Maeon

title: Le corps de mon ennemi
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Marie-France Pisier, Bernard Blier, Daniel Ivernel
description: François Leclerc has spent his last seven years in prison, accused of the murder, which he did not commit, of Cajac and his wife Karine. Now regained his freedom he returns to Cournai, the town from which he was forced to leave. The double murder of which he was accused had as its theater the night that François directed. Aided by Gilberte and his old partner Raphael, the ex-prisoner tries to reconstruct the truth about his case and to track down the culprits. François discovers that he was at the center of a huge and lucrative drug trade in the place he ran.
notes: Modest French film directed by Henri Verneuil. Bravo, as usual, Jean-Paul Belmondo.

title: Die xue jietou
actors: Tony Leung Chiu Wai, Jacky Cheung, Waise Lee, Simon Yam
description: 1967, Hong Kong. Three friends involved in a gangster affair decide to leave the island and move to Saigon, where they hope to make money on the black market. Their adventure becomes an odyssey after being captured by the Viet Cong.
notes: Great John Woo film, his masterpiece along with "The Killer". A story of betrayed friendship that refers to "The hunter" and "The treasure of the Sierra Madre", passing through a tribute to "I want Garcia's head". The performance of the interpreters was impressive and the scene of the concentration camp (the best of its kind) was memorable. There is a director's cut version of 136 minutes.

title: Armas contra la ley
actors: Mara Berni, Maria Luisa Merlo, Moira Orfei, Renato Baldini
description: Marini, a criminal expelled from the United States and head of an international gang, plans a robbery in a Madrid jewelry store with his men. To carry out the blow, study the plan in detail. However, he is forced to get help from two thieves and a student. But everything does not proceed according to the pre-established plans, so much so that the police are immediately able to identify the perpetrators and the principal. Marini, who has taken refuge in a night club, engages in a firefight with the police.
notes: Negligible Italian Spanish co-production. There is also room for Moira Orfei.

title: Bait
actors: Jamie Foxx, David Morse, Kimberly Elise, Doug Hutchison
description: Two thugs - a malicious computer genius and a truck driver - steal $ 42 million in gold bars from the New York Federal Reserve. On the same night, a couple of black thieves bet (more modestly) on the theft of prawns: one of them, Alvin, who aspires to a less reckless life, will be used as bait to capture the ferocious and bloodthirsty computer "wolf" ...
notes: The sophisticated technique, focused on sounds, of Coppoli's masterpiece "Conversation" has become, in many contemporary thrillers, an expedient that moves the plot, fills the sequences, times the rhythm of the story, influences the figurative aspect of the films. Hi-tech applied to cinema breaks through the boundaries of the off-screen and dictates new rules of vision and tension: it is a show model that evolves, regardless of the value of the individual films. Fuqua brings, with a certain skill, his contribution to this sub-genre; but some out of tune engravings - between the romantic and the comic - dilute the action more than necessary.

title: La bella di Mosca
actors: Ralitza Baleva, Igor Kostolevsky, Ivana Monti, Angelo Maresca
description: Irina comes from the countryside, and moves into the Moscow of the communist twilight becoming the lover of a regime intellectual. Her presence causes scandals in high places, and she is indicted, but manages to become a famous supermodel. Among other things, she ends up acting in an underground film in which, dressed in an Olympics tunic, she sets fire to the statue of Lenin.
notes: The film would be hilarious at times (the party at the Cuban embassy, ??the protagonist licking the shin of a kind of Evtuscenko!), If it weren't so boring. Pay attention to the homonyms: the director is not Davide Ferrario, the screenwriter Erofeev is not that of "Moscow on vodka", and the director of photography Sergio Rubini is not an actor.

title: Vipera
actors: Harvey Keitel, Giancarlo Giannini, Elide Melli, Olimpia Carlisi, Goffredo Fofi
description: Viper is the nickname that Leone, a blacksmith in a Sicilian village, gave to his wife who ran away with another man. The war ends: the fascists disguise themselves first as Communists and then as Christian Democrats, and the poor people survive between a dance and a drink. Rosetta, the daughter of Leone, becomes pregnant; Leone dies and the newborn (named Fortunato) is taken away from his very young mother, who ends up in an institution. When she comes of age, Rosetta will find her "witch" mother and her son ...
notes: Mediocre proof of Pasolini's brave ex-partner (returned to directing five years after _I magi randagi_), anything but aided by a cast in a state of disgrace.

title: The FBI Story
actors: James Stewart, Vera Miles, Murray Hamilton, Nick Adams
description: Having reached the final stages of his service at the Federal Bureau of Investigation, Chip Hardesty reviews the most significant episodes of the long career that has seen him protagonist. This is how the representatives of crime in all its forms parade: gangsters, swindlers, members of the Ku Klux Klan, Nazi spies or those belonging to enemy powers (especially during the years of the cold war); ultimately, all those who pose a threat to American social order and institutions.
notes: Who else, if not Jimmy Stewart, could embody the ideal and reassuring face of the bulwark of the "American way of life"?

title: Kurt & Courtney
actors: Kurt Cobain, Courtney Love, El Duce, Krist Novoselic, David Grohl, Pat Smear
description: After Kurt Cobain's suicide (on April 5, 1994), a crew arrives in Seattle to shoot a documentary. Director Nick Broomfield interviews a number of people somehow close to the deceased rock star: the musician's aunt, who shows him home videos and recordings; the father of widow Courtney Love; the nurse of the son of Kurt and Courtney, friends and lovers of both. Despite Love's refusal to collaborate, Broomfield manages to compose a plausible picture of Cobain's complex personality: a shy and reserved boy, tired of constant tours and embarrassed by popularity, enslaved by the heroine demon ...

title: First Daughter
actors: Mariel Hemingway, Doug Savant, Gregory Harrison, Monica Keena
description: Secret agent Alex McGregor is tasked with protecting Jess, the young daughter of US President Hayes, during a Colorado rafting tour led by charming Grant. Everything goes well until the group is intercepted by some terrorist fanatics who, discovering Jess's presence, kidnap her to demand the release of their leader. But the criminals will have to deal with Alex and Grant; the first, a veteran of the service, knows perfectly the code that regulates cases of this kind: no concessions, no negotiations, and the hypothesis of a failure is not even taken into consideration ...

title: The Secret Agent
actors: Bob Hoskins, Patricia Arquette, Gérard Depardieu, Robin Williams
description: London, late 19th century: Verloc plays a double game by passing information to both the Moscow government and Scotland Yard. When the new Russian ambassador cornered him, Verloc did not hesitate to involve his young wife Winnie, his retarded brother Stevie and the "Professor" in his drawings, a character whose fascination with explosives makes him the right individual. organization of an attack.
notes: The second film directed by screenwriter Hampton is as mediocre as the previous "Carrington", and wastes a stellar cast on a useless adaptation of the novel of the same name by Joseph Conrad that already inspired Hitchcock for "Sabotage".

title: A 008 operazione sterminio
actors: Alberto Lupo, Ingrid Schoeller, Dina De Santis, John Heston
description: The British secret services send agent 006 on a mission to Cairo. In collaboration with an American colleague, he will have to get his hands on a new invention: the antiradar. Arrived on the spot, the agent makes contact with A 008, a charming girl. Together, the two become, in a short time, the object of the attacks of the men of the criminal Kemp. After having destroyed the deadly antiradar, A 006 and A 008 take refuge in Switzerland in search of the project, still in the hands of its creator. Even in Zermatt, however, they are preceded by Kemp ...
notes: Italian spy movie. Lenzi has certainly done better.

title: Crimine a due
actors: John Drew Barrymore, Luisa Rivelli, Lisa Gastoni, Umberto D'Orsi
description: In a villa together with the spouses Lugani live their secretary Paolo and the brother of the landlord Carlo. He, paralytic, blind and silent, has a particularity: he is able to predict misfortunes and announce them. The first to die from a heart attack is the landlord Davide followed by Carlo's nurse, killed with a gunshots. The suspicions fall on the widow and Paolo, considered his lover. When the commissioner who is leading the investigations is about to arrest it takes place a twist.
notes: Thriller taken from the novel "The cursed house" written by Elisa Pezzani. Also known with the title "The house on the mushroom". To be re -evaluated.

title: Amore libero - Free Love
actors: Enzo Bottesini, Laura Gemser, Venantino Venantini, Ugo Cardea
description: Francesco, an engineer from Milan, is sent by his bosses to an island in the Seychelles with a dual task: to continue investigations related to the exploitation of a mine and to find out what happened to engineer Maestrelli, his predecessor. Francesco, having arrived on the spot, finds numerous obstacles to overcome. First of all, everyone is busy "making sugar", that is to say, having free relationships with anyone. When Francesco meets the Creole Jeanine, things get terribly complicated.
notes: Enzo Bottesini was a champion of "Rischiatutto". The remarkable Emanuelle (Laura Gemser) needs no introduction.

title: Short Time
actors: Dabney Coleman, Matt Frewer, Teri Garr, Barry Corbin, Joe Pantoliano
description: Burt, police inspector, is a week from retirement: the fact is that he has only two weeks left to live ... Before receiving the dire news he was the classic guy who thought twice before facing a danger. But now that she doesn't have long to live, she undergoes a radical personality change, shocking her workmate Ernie. Burt throws his proverbial caution to the winds and volunteers for riskier missions, hoping his folks can enjoy insurance later.
notes: Gregg Champion makes his directorial debut in this comedy with a sit-com feel: fun in small doses.

title: Le professionel
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Jean Desailly, Robert Hossein, Cyrielle Claire
description: Joss Beaumont, an agent of the French secret services, is entrusted with the task of assassinating Njala, president of an African country. At the last moment, however, the political scenario changes and Joss is handed over by his own superiors to the local authorities, who condemn him to a long prison sentence. But after a successful escape attempt, Joss returns to his homeland and deliberately informs those who betrayed and framed him of his intention to eliminate Njala, who has just arrived in France on an official visit anyway.
notes: Belmondo aside, the real "professional" is Lautner, an honest artisan of the police. Soundtrack by Ennio Morricone.

title: I nostri anni
actors: Virgilio Biei, Piero Franzo, Giuseppe Boccalatte
description: Natalino, a former partisan, replies to young interviewers. Alberto, his old companion, meets another old man, struck by paresis, in a hospice. The images of the present mingle with those of the past, the faces of the old coexist with those of their young and resistant. Then the revelation: the old paralytic is in reality the ferocious republican who had tortured and massacred Natalino's companions. Alberto goes to Natalino: we found him, he says, we have to kill him, even after fifty years.
notes: Gaglianone, one of the best Italian "courtiers", has been moving around the Resistance for years (also through his work at the Gobetti Center). "Our years" is very faithful to its origins: a short circuit between old and young, past and present, montage and sequence shot, bodies and voices, video and film, fiction and documentary. The stunning of the first part, with the search for a thread that binds the fragments of the present, assumes in the second part tones at times epic, at times funny, and gives the complexity of the choices and the past that does not pass, with the sole force of images. And the finale, with the advance of the two partisans, can also move.

title: The Center of the World
actors: Peter Sarsgaard, Molly Parker, Carla Gugino, Mel Gorham, Jason McCabe
description: Richard worked hard for a year, with Reagan's photo on the desk, and now he has a bank account with nine zeros. He deserves a holiday: maybe with Florence (punk drummer during the day, stripper at night), who has been spotted for weeks. For ten thousand dollars, he offers her a weekend: she accepts, however putting a series of stakes between Richard's hunger for sex and his numerous fears.
notes: Despite the scandals announced via the internet and the bigoted overseas censorship, the film almost tenderness. Wang takes it all, but the impossibility of framing penas and pubes - to go in short truly "beyond" - limits it and limits the final result.

title: Chill Factor
actors: Cuba Gooding jr., Skeet Ulrich, Peter Firth, David Paymer, Hudson Leick
description: The military experiences a very powerful defoliant, but the results are catastrophic and the person responsible, Colonel Brynner, is arrested. After serving his sentence, he wants to get his hands on the substance (a blue jelly called "Elvis", which must be kept at -50 degrees) to sell it for war purposes: he will have to deal with two guys who have accidentally come into possession of it .. .
notes: The traps hatched by the writers are many and even imaginative, but more from videogames than from movies. Unbearable the jokes of the two protagonists, who wink, roll their eyes and make "yohoo" giving themselves five per hundred minutes in a row.

title: Fughe da fermo
actors: Marco Cocci, Luciano Federico, Irene Ferri, Marjo Berasategui
description: Fede is a rich young man from Prato, desperately in love, since adolescence, with a girl who does not want him. But in the meantime, in the company of a group of students of the same age, he tries to defeat boredom in various ways: by contacting anarchists to blow up a pylon, by organizing the arrival of a prostitute from the East, or by going to disguise.
notes: We are a bit 'from the parts of "The last kiss" by Muccino, with generational dubious, desire for redemption and various machismo. Of course the characters are deliberately unpleasant, but once transposed on the screen according to the forms of the late Italian comedy, the gaze becomes complicit, cloaked in sentimentality.

title: Valentine
actors: Denise Richards, David Boreanaz, Marley Shelton, Jessica Capshaw
description: During a Valentine's Day party, a shy and ugly boy is rejected by five of his companions and subjected to a water balloon of sangria by the other boys. Thirteen years later, the five girls find themselves on the eve of another Valentine's Day with a masked psychopath threatening their lives. Is it a rejected lover or is it perhaps the posthumous revenge of the peer who was pilloried years earlier?
notes: The script, taken from a book by Tom Savage, is a slender vine on which five "starlets" in search of fortune and a loser in a mask who tries to make a verse to the Luciferian Michael Myers of "Halloween".

title: Town & Country
actors: Warren Beatty, Diane Keaton, Goldie Hawn, Andie MacDowell
description: Porter, struck by the midlife crisis, begins a desperate search for what's wrong with his life. His wife Ellie and a couple of friends Mona and Griffin accompany him on his journey. When Porter, who has cheated on his wife more than once, begins to realize that the only person he wants to live with is Ellie, he realizes it may be too late.
notes: Chelsom pays the toll on large-scale production, the clutter of the likes of Warren Beatty, Goldie Hawn, Diane Keaton, Andie MacDowell. But these are defects that do not affect the final result.

title: Sexy Beast
actors: Ray Winstone, Ben Kingsley, Amanda Redman, Ian McShane
description: Gary, a former inmate, has finished his sentence and is now enjoying his "savings" on the Costa del Sol with Deedee. One day a large boulder fallen on Gary's pool disturbs his tranquility. The bombing is a warning from Don Logan, an old-time friend. Don wants to organize a heist, a bank safe deposit robbery, and he wants Gary to join his gang.
notes: The film, the first cinematographic direction of the television Jonathan Glazer, has an attack that intrigues and that, with all that sun, that toasted skin, transmits an unusual physicality. The story is one of many, but it is conducted well, and in any case it is the atmosphere that matters, which manages to be carnal and brutal.

title: The White River Kid
actors: Antonio Banderas, Bob Hoskins, Ellen Barkin, Beau Bridges
description: Friar Edgar is a fake scam monk who uses the Bible as a lifeline when he finds himself in difficult situations. Morales Pittman, an illegal immigrant, is his partner. The couple, along with killer White River Kid, who committed nine murders and his girlfriend, are hunted down by Sheriff Becker. The man with the star is actually more interested in his re-election than in the capture of the dangerous killer.
notes: The narrative structure is more than vague. The script is a stack of pages filled with little effort and in which everyone (provincial people, farmers, Hispanics) is characterized and drawn with a hatchet. The jokes are said at random and the scenes struggle to stay together.

title: Le parole di mio padre
actors: Fabrizio Rongione, Chiara Mastroianni, Toni Bertorelli, Mimmo Calopresti
description: Young Zeno, who was unable to overcome the trauma of his parent's death, comes into contact with the family of Giovanni, Anna's father, Ada, Alberta and Augusta. Zeno falls in love with Ada, who at first reciprocates his affection but then pushes him away, then gets involved in Alberta's game of seduction. The suicide attempt of the latter induces him to leave: a year later Augusta will reveal her feelings to him.
notes: Comencini is freely inspired by two chapters of "The consciousness of Zeno" by Italo Svevo and listens to the inner voices of its characters. A dense, penetrating reading of a literary masterpiece.

title: The Mummy Returns
actors: Brendan Fraser, Rachel Weisz, John Hannah, Arnold Vosloo, Oded Fehr, Patricia Velasquez, Dwayne Johnson, Freddie Boath
description: Ten years have passed. Rick and Evelyn are married and have Alex, a delightful eight-year-old who inherited a sense of adventure and a fascination for ancient civilizations from his parents. Meanwhile, a new threat is about to emerge in the Sahara desert. The Scorpion King, a proud warrior, is about to be awakened from his eternal slumber. To counter his advent, there are those who think of resurrecting Imhotep, the only one able to counter the Scorpion King. But there are those who recruited Rick and Evelyn to avoid the terrible confrontation.
notes: Pure Cinema Multiplèx, popcorn and chips, thunder and lightning for a good one hundred and twenty minutes, non-existent dialogues, interpersonal relationships as in the times of Michelangelo Antonioni.

title: Super8 Stories
actors: Emir Kusturica, Nejad Jankovic, Stribor Kusturica
description: The title is not accidental: this fake documentary is full of old super8 and homemade VHS, which in fact is a micro-story of the Kusturica family and of all those who play and live in the "No Smoking Orchestra"; and in filigree, from Yugoslavia, a former world to which Kusturica cannot fail to allude (let's review, in a different context, the images of Tito's funeral already used in "Underground").
notes: The music also comes from there: the film underlines with ironic pride that in Tito's Yugoslavia rock was allowed because the regime wanted to distinguish itself from countries like Bulgaria and Romania; several musicians of the "No Smoking" are sons of soldiers and have started playing in parades. Born as a punk group in the late seventies, today they are an "ensemble" of old friends that shamelessly mixes rock, ethnicity, Gypsy violins, Communist-era marches and, if necessary, Boccherini's "Minuetto". Energy prevails over talent, but that's okay. As for the film, it is played by Kusturica with the eclecticism of a tightrope walker: it seems pulled away, but it is hypersophisticated. The Balkan version of Jarmusch's "Year of the Horse" (about Neil Young, also in super8), but with a lot of autobiography, a lot of anger and a lot of poetry.

title: A cena col vampiro
actors: George Hilton, Isabel Russinova, Patrizia Pellegrino, Riccardo Rossi
description: While he is shooting a report on Mesopotamia, a television crew unwittingly awakens a vampire from his eternal sleep. Time passes and the nosferatu becomes a famous and appreciated horror film director always looking for young actors to cast. At the auditions there are four young people who would like to break into the world of cinema. Before filming begins, the director invites them to spend a night at his house. At dinner, the vampire reveals his true identity to his guests. The four aspiring actors have nothing left but to kill him before dawn breaks.

title: Le salaire de la peur
actors: Yves Montand, Charles Vanel, Folco Lulli, Peter Van Eyck, Véra Clouzot, Antonio Centa, William Tubbs, Dario Moreno
description: In an oil field located in a remote Latin American country, the company hires four desperate people - the Corso Mario, the French Jo, the German Bimbo and the Italian Luigi - to transport a cargo of nitroglycerin needed to close a well. on fire. The quartet then divides into two crews driving as many trucks, and the risky journey begins ...
notes: Clouzot reconstructs the jungle in the Camargue and directs an essay specimen of suspense, dry and essential. Remade in 1977 by Friedkin (_The wages of fear_), in a film that - although decent - nevertheless remains below the model.

title: Firetrap
actors: Dean Cain, Mel Harris, Dale Godboldo, Richard Tyson, Vanessa Angel
description: Max Hooper, successful burglar, has decided to change his life but cannot give up one last blow: thanks to his informants, Hooper has in fact learned that a company has developed a new generation chip, whose prototype could be sold at a very high price. Passing off as a firefighter, Hooper attempts to break through the security system of the building where the chip is kept: however, a disappointed and unhappy employee actually sets the building on fire, forcing Hooper to transform into a real firefighter to save their own life and that of other trapped people.

title: Witness Protection
actors: Tom Sizemore, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Shawn Hatosy, Skye McCole Bartusiak, Forest Whitaker, William Sadler
description: Bobby Batton is a multiple criminal in conflict with the mafia and at risk of prosecution for a series of serious crimes. The FBI offers him an exchange, thanks to which he will obtain immunity in exchange for his testimony against old comrades. Bobby will then have to join the federal witness protection program. All this means that he, his wife and their children will be isolated from the rest of the world and at the mercy of enemy raids: a prospect that is anything but tempting ...
notes: The subject is not very original, like its staging. After all, Richard Pearce has often worked for television. There is also room for Forest Whitaker.

title: Omega Doom
actors: Rutger Hauer, Shannon Whirry, Norbert Weisser, Tina Cote
description: After the conquest of Earth by an army of robots, the few surviving humans are forced to live in the bush. The new masters fear a revival of the earthlings, to avoid which a frantic search for a secret weapons depot is underway. One of the androids enters a town where a sort of civil war is taking place between his fellow men, and while trying to restore peace between the two factions he discovers a strange attraction within himself ...
notes: Unfortunately, the "replicant" Rutger Hauer belongs to the club of those who, after a memorable role and little else, have settled on the comfortable shores of the world.

title: Nowhere to Land
actors: Jack Wagner, Christine Elise, Ernie Hudson, James Sikking
description: Chemical engineer Phillip Deacon wants to prevent his ex-wife Claire from establishing future romantic relationships with other men at all costs, and to carry out his plans he is willing to go as far as murder. After learning that the woman is about to board the Sydney-Los Angeles flight, Phillip places a nerve gas bomb ten times more lethal than the one known to date on board the aircraft. Shortly before arriving at their destination, Commander John Prescott is informed of the existence of the bomb and discovers that he has only an hour to defuse it: the lives of over three hundred people are tied to a thread ...

title: All Quiet on the Western Front
actors: Lew Ayres, Slim Summerville, Louis Wolheim, John Wray, Arnold Lucy
description: The war, the first, in the trenches of the Franco-German front is a slaughter that leaves no room for heroism, compliance with imposed duties and the ethics of battle, as a professor had led to believe a handful of students enrolled as volunteers under the pressure 'pedagogical' of the teacher. Nobody will survive.
notes: A classic of pacifist cinema, released in Italy only in the 1950s, it is a raw and pure lesson in the horror of war free from rhetoric and patriotism. Cut from the Universal by 49 minutes compared to the original, (the ban on filming the killing of one of the young people intent on capturing a butterfly is always of the production, then circumvented) it has earned two statuettes for best film and for best direction, a sequel in '37, Road Back, and a makeover in '79, Nothing new on the western front,

title: Der Krieger und die Kaiserin
actors: Franka Potente, Benno Fürmann, Joachim Krol, Marita Breuer
description: Sissi, a nurse in a psyschiatric hospital, is hit by a truck and Bodo, an ex-stricken soldier, saves her life. Healed, she searches for him and finds him and falls in love with him while he is doing a bank robbery. Sissi will offer herself this time as a savior.
notes: The film approaches the laughable outcomes of the latest Wenders, but with more boredom than kitsch. And poor Franka Potente in an angelic comic version, more than an icon of the director she seems to be his victim. Italian reviewers spoke of Teutonic heaviness and gloomy late romanticism. They are commonplaces, of course, but when it takes it it takes.

title: Woman on Top
actors: Penélope Cruz, Murilo Benicio, Harold Perrineau jr., Mark Feuerstein
description: The Brazilian Isabella, suffering from a syndrome that prevents her from using any means of locomotion, is an excellent cook and works in the restaurant she runs with her husband Toninho. When she realizes that he is cheating on her, Isabella takes refuge from Monica, a transvestite childhood friend who lives in San Francisco: here she finds success by hosting a cooking show on TV, but then Toninho joins her and ...
notes: Food, passion, music and black magic intertwine - and sometimes tangle - in this sketch, so slender as to always appear on the verge of collapsing but still capable of giving tasty moments, both for the candid sensuality of Penelope Cruz and for the sympathy and the humor full of subtle double meanings of Monica, played by Harold Perrineau jr. (formerly extraordinary Mercutio in "Romeo & Juliet" by Baz Luhrmann).

title: Pokémon 3: The Movie
description: Ash, the charismatic pokémon trainer, must face Molly, the daughter of a famous archaeologist who has dedicated her life to the search for archaic pokémon, the "unknown". The girl manages to put those strange pokémon into action that are able to change reality according to her wishes. Molly wants to find her parents and her house becomes a sort of enchanted castle where Ash's mother is also locked up, mistaking her for her own.
notes: Suspended between reality and dream, Ash and his friends become ancillary to Molly, a child with a double personality. The short "Pikachu and Pichu" that precedes the film is much better, a delightful adventure in the city of Pikachu.

title: Se fossi in te
actors: Emilio Solfrizzi, Gioele Dix, Paola Cortellesi, Fabio De Luigi
description: An accountant, married with children, who would like to be a comedian, a billionaire businessman with a bad temper, a frustrated DJ and at risk of foreclosure. In a magical night of shooting stars, the most unlikely wishes come true: everyone finds himself in the shoes, in the workplace, in the other's bed.
notes: Giulio Manfredonia's debut, with discreet television actors, is yet another comedy of predictable misunderstandings in which everything doesn't work. The suit does not make the captain of industry or the accountant or the record man if the character remains unchanged and weaknesses of the original life are replicated.

title: About Adam
actors: Stuart Townsend, Frances O'Connor, Charlotte Bradley, Kate Hudson
description: Adam the liar knows what words he must use to win over women and men. It is the lovely mirror in which the three sympathetic Owens sisters, in today's middle-class Dublin, see their expectations of seduction reflected. Lucy is the youngest, works as a singing waitress and goes from flirt to flirt. Laura is a shy and confused student of literature. Alice is the older sister, the only one married. Adam's lies, promises, confidences change, with candor, depending on the situation.
notes: The director is one of Ireland's best writers and playwrights, and his experience as a satirist for radio and television contributes to the freshness of this comedy.

title: The Monkey's Mask
actors: Susie Porter, Kelly McGillis, Marton Csokas, Deborah Mailman
description: Mickey, a student taking a course in poetry and creative writing, disappears after a "reading" in a pub. The parents hire Jill, a detective who pays more attention to her own sexual disorders than to her profession. The investigation runs aground after a few minutes, when Jill falls in love with Diana, Mickey's teacher.
notes: Poets, scoundrels, naive girls, caresses between women, subterfuges and secrets, with the truth more evident than a "stolen letter". Samantha Lang, the modest director of "The Well", fails to give a coherent form to the beautiful verse novel by Dorothy Porter from which the film is based. Love story between Jill and Diana, Mickey's illusions and suffering, remain notes of a potential film burdened with affected dialogues.

title: Bring It On
actors: Kirsten Dunst, Eliza Dushku, Jesse Bradford, Gabrielle Union
description: Torrance, leader of the cheerleaders at Rancho Carne High School in San Diego, wants to win the national championship for the sixth consecutive year, but finds no original choreography for the competition. And this time the opponents are fearsome, like the East Compton cheerleaders, the only black majority team that has its strong point in hip hop ballet and whose colors are those of Jamaica.
notes: Always in the background in the comedies set in college, the cheerleaders, delightful Wasp teenagers, acquire a "well-deserved" close-up with this film. Too bad that in the world of "Girls in the Balloon" there is no place for depth and blondes remain the usual hopping ducklings.

title: Serie 7: The Contenders
actors: Brooke Smith, Michael Kaycheck, Glenn Fitzgerald, Richard Venture
description: In a small town in Connecticut, five competitors are drawn with (bad) luck: they will challenge the champion Dawn, pregnant and deadly, in the seventh series of Contenders, a television game with no escape. Eliminating rivals is physical: no telephone polling with viewers.
notes: The assault documentary maker Daniel Minahan is inspired by the short story "The Seventh Victim" by Robert Sheckley, already turned into a film by Elio Petri ("The tenth victim", 1965). His critique of junk real TV becomes a litmus test for a reflection on the bestial instinct of men, thinking of Hobbes. The closed-circuit cultural dictatorship of "Big Brother" is frightening and the future is now. Oblique look of Minahan, who proceeds with a hand machine, following the radical chic taste of the Sundance Style to which he proudly belongs. But the defects become secondary, because the vision of the ethical ruins of our tele-society is clear, radical, without too many compromises. The final scene in the cinema, with actors replacing the characters, is a stroke of genius. Urgent antibodies against journalistic reconstructions like "Who saw it?" The columnists who threw up on the film from the front pages of our newspapers, either didn't see it or didn't understand anything.

title: Oranges amères
actors: Lilah Dadi, Clara Bellar, Sabrina Ferilli, Bruno Todeschini, Clara Bellar, Lilah Dadi
description: Paco, a boy of Spanish origin, is a baker in Algiers, is married to Alice and has two children, Antoine and Vincent. Alice has a younger sister, Angèle, who works with her at the Bastos factory. Angèle is very attracted to Saïd and assumes provocative attitudes towards him, which disconcert Alice. In the factory, conditions are severe and many abuses are committed, sometimes even of a sexual nature: some workers, including Angèle, have had enough and are trying to find a solution. Meanwhile Alice and Paco have become managers of the bakery ...
notes: Third film by Such, one of the actors of _Bab El-Oued City_ by Merzak Allouache.

title: The Wedding
actors: Halle Berry, Eric Thal, Carl Lumbly, Lynn Whitfield, Michael Warren
description: A wealthy black family, while on vacation on the island of Martha's Vineyard, prepares to celebrate the wedding of daughter Shelby to Meade, a white musician. For Shelby, who until then has lived without problems and has never contrasted the expectations of family members, everything suddenly becomes complicated when she arrives on the island of Lute, a charming black widower, father of three girls. The man begins to make a tight court to her and Shelby's certainties begin to waver, to the point of calling into question his choices and his world ...

title: Assassinio al cimitero etrusco
actors: Elvire Audray, Paolo Malco, Claudio Cassinelli, Marilù Tolo, Van Johnson
description: Joan Mulligan, married to an archaeologist and suffering from metapsychic disorders, during a nightmare has a terrifying vision that actually precedes the violent death of her husband in an Etruscan tomb. Arrived in turn in Tuscany, the woman is involved in a chain of murders linked by a macabre anniversary. Her life is in danger, but secret agent Mike Grant - who in the meantime has fallen in love with her - will arrive in time to unravel the mystery.
notes: What is frightening in this film is above all the neglect that afflicts the narrative junctions and the entire staging. The cast also debates a Van Johnson on an award vacation.

title: In the Navy
actors: Bud Abbott, Lou Costello, Dick Powell, Claire Dodd, Dick Foran
description: A famous singer who works in radio, tired of his job, enlists as a sailor. The soldier who records it is forced to give his real name that no one knows. Dorothy, a contributor to a major newspaper, recognizes him and persecutes him to get him an interview. Two of his comrades, Gianni and Pinotto offer to help both the singer and Dorothy who, disguised as a sailor, is smuggled on board.
notes: The plot is rather mundane and the comic duo Bud Abbott and Lou Costello, renamed by us with the name of Gianni and Pinotto, elicits very few laughs.

title: Die 1000 Augen des dr. Mabuse
actors: Wolfgang Preiss, Dawn Addams, Peter Van Eyck, Gert Fröbe, Andrea Checchi
description: Diabolical: how else to define the plot devised by the blind man (?) Cornelius - or should we perhaps call him Jordan - to get his hands on the legacy of the beautiful Marion? But the unexpected, the unknown that can neutralize the best-designed plans, manifests itself in the form of ...
notes: After having materialized with his films of 1922 and 1933 the nightmares and the uncontrolled madness of an entire era, Lang provides an updated version - animated by a sort of "heir" of the late Mabuse - but no less anguished. The "thousand eyes" of the original title are those of the cameras placed in the hotel rooms where Cornelius acts.

title: The Late Show
actors: Art Carney, Lily Tomlin, Bill Macy, Joanna Cassidy, Eugene Roche
description: The "private eye" of the Italian title is Ira Wells, a sixty-year-old detective and not exactly in top form who receives the task of bringing back to the rightful owner none other than ... a missing cat. Shortly thereafter, however, the traces of the feline are confused with those of Ira's former partner, who died in circumstances that are still unclear.
notes: In full period of critical revision of genres, constantly hybridized and / or compared with the repertoire of his own tradition, the director-screenwriter Benton turns noir to ironically crepuscular tones, well assisted by a Carney capable of extremely refined interpretative chiaroscuro.

title: A fil di spada
actors: Frank Latimore, Pierre Cressoy, Milly Vitale, Franca Marzi
description: The old governor of a Spanish colony in South America is sick. Taking advantage of his conditions and the trust he enjoys, Don Sebastiano commits atrocities of all kinds and even goes so far as to assassinate a noble, whom he believed to be an emissary sent by the king to check his work. To deflect suspicions, it is Don Sebastiano himself who accuses Don Ruy of the murder, a Don Juan adventurer who, however, hides a mysterious identity ...
notes: Age, Leo Benvenuti and Furio Scarpelli script this enjoyable adventurous film, staged with the usual professionalism by the veteran Bragaglia. The interpreters are good and functional.

title: White Wolves III: Cry of the White Wolf
actors: Mick Cain, Mercedes McNab, Rodney A. Grant, Margaret Howell
description: Two teenagers, on their way to a correctional camp for difficult boys, crash a plane into a wilderness area. The seriously injured pilot is unable to launch the Sos. A pack of highly intelligent wolves come to their rescue.
notes: Rodney A. Grant was Wind in the Hair in "Dances with Wolves".

title: La casa con la scala nel buio
actors: Andrea Occhipinti, Michele Soavi, Annie Papa, Valeria Cavalli
description: Bruno, author of soundtracks, is commissioned by a horror film director to compose the music for his new film. To create the right atmosphere, the woman makes him stay in the villa of a mutual friend. Strange murders take place in the house.
notes: Horror shot in 16mm and then inflated to 35.

title: Cold Sweat
actors: Ben Cross, Adam Baldwin, Shannon Tweed, Dave Thomas
description: Mark Cahill has a wife who loves him and two beautiful children, but this exemplary family man happens to make a living as a professional killer. At a certain point he seems determined not to accept new "contracts": despite this, he lets himself be involved in the criminal plan of a businessman who is now up to his neck in debt ...
notes: Second film by Gail Harvey, former scene photographer on the set of _Micide in the mirror_ and _Delict in the White House_. The main role is entrusted to the revived Ben Cross, who after the glories of _Momenti di gloria_ has settled on a mediocrity that is anything but golden.

title: Mean Guns
actors: Christopher Lambert, Ice T, Michael Halsey, Tina Cote
description: A gangster compiles a list of about a hundred people guilty of "out of order" and, instead of eliminating them, he enjoys locking them up in a sort of security prison, letting them slaughter each other. The three survivors will receive a prize of 10 million dollars ...
notes: Nothing new under the "action movie" sun.

title: Arthur's Quest
actors: Arye Gross, Alexandra Paul, Catherine Oxenberg, Zach Galligan
description: The black knights led by the evil sorceress Morgana defeat King Pendragon's army and conquer England. Through a space-time passage, Merlin hides the little Arthur, son of Pendragon and heir to the throne, in modern America ...
notes: A curious "family" adventure.

title: The Grass Harp
actors: Edward Furlong, Piper Laurie, Sissy Spacek, Walter Matthau, Jack Lemmon
description: 1940s, deep south of the United States: after the death of his parents, the young Collin Fenwick spends his adolescence in the company of his aunts Dolly and Verena.
notes: With an ultra-luxury cast, photography by John Alonzo and a screenplay by Stirling Silliphant, Matthau jr. a short story by Truman Capote is adapted for the screen.

title: Mother Night
actors: Nick Nolte, Sheryl Lee, Alan Arkin, Kirsten Dunst, Arye Gross
description: Howard W. Campbell Jr., an American playwright who has long expatriated to Germany, is recruited by the Washington government as a war informant. In reality he becomes a heated "radio" propagandist for the Hitler regime, upon whose fall he retires to private life in the United States with the help of complacent friends. Finally, in 1961, the Israeli secret services will manage to capture him; pending trial, he will write his memoirs.
notes: The film engages with the writing - full of humor and symbolic stratifications - of Kurt Vonnegut, author of the original novel: a courageous but only partially successful attempt.

title: The Golden Spiders: A Nero Wolfe Mystery
actors: Maury Chaykin, Timothy Hutton, Larissa Lapchinski, Gary Reineke
description: The gruff and burly detective Nero Wolfe, a lover of orchids and good food, investigates the mysterious murder of three people. Among the victims there is also a child who had addressed Wolfe shortly before disappearing in a car; according to his testimony, in that same car a woman with golden spider-shaped earrings would have been unnecessarily agitated in search of help. The suspects are numerous and all, for one reason or another, could be the culprits. With the help of insightful assistant Archie Goodwin and his valued collaborators, Nero Wolfe will be able to unravel the intricate mystery.

title: Sgt. Bilko
actors: Steve Martin, Dan Aykroyd, Phil Hartman, Glenne Headly
description: Sergeant Bilko organized the Fort Knox military base in an "alternative" fashion. Within the walls of the fort you can practice the amatory arts, various sports and above all play and bet like in a municipal casino. The godsend is about to end, as stern Colonel Hall is on his way to do an inspection and Bilko is in danger of being moved. The last word has not yet been said.
notes: Enjoyable comedy with a trio of fast-paced comedians, Martin, Aykroyd and Hartman. Certainly the grizzled Steve in the role of Bilko has all his paraphernalia at his disposal, and in fact he is furious.

title: Out of Sync
actors: Gail O'Gready, Kari Wuhrer, Peter Outerbridge, Stewart Bick
description: Entered to become a star in the world of entertainment, Sunni is about to record his first album. One day she knows Roger Deacon, once a big manufacturer but now fallen out of disgrace, who sees her in her still salvation in her to finally be able to return to her. Although the girl already has an agent, Roger decides to take advantage of her talent thanks also to Maggie Stanley, in which he runs one evening into a bar where the public enjoys making the karaoke. Maggie, a housewife with a passion for singing, feels flattered when she is proposed to record her voice on a ribbon: what she is not aware of, however, is that the tape will be used to dub Sunni's voice - a His turn in the dark about everything - for an entire album, which in a short time will scale the leaders of the hit parade. Maggie will try by any means at his disposal to make the truth known to the mass media and to thwart the scam put in place by the unscrupulous Roger ...

title: The Return of the Texas Chainsaw Massacre
actors: Renée Zellweger, Matthew McConaughey, Robert Jacks, Tonie Perensky
description: Vilmer's family is a bit particular: especially because it ranks in the front row the amiable Leatherface, that nice son of the South who cuts human flesh with the electric saw. Jenny and a friend of hers, unaware of the dangers they run, end up right in the arms and jaws of the cannibal family ...
notes: Kim Henkel wrote the first _Don't Open That Door_ with author Tobe Hooper. Nothing remains of the merciless beauty of that film, only the annoying hum of the saw. However, the presence of two future "goddesses" like Renée Zellweger and Matthew McConaughey, here treated like meat for ... slaughter, is curious.

title: È arrivato l'accordatore
actors: Nino Taranto, Alberto Sordi, Virgilio Riento, Antonella Lualdi
description: Achille Scorzella is a poor, always hungry devil who can't find a job. Arrived in the home of a rich family, he is mistaken for a piano tuner. It so happens that Achille, who has been dreaming of having a hearty lunch for days, attends the preparations for the sumptuous lunch set to celebrate the engagement of the host's daughter. A series of amusing setbacks prevents the partner from sitting at the table. Poor Achilles ends up in the hands of some criminals who have mistaken him for another person.
notes: Small part for Sophia Lazzaro, future Loren.

title: As You Desire Me
actors: Greta Garbo, Melvyn Douglas, Erich Von Stroheim, Hedda Hopper
description: Zara is a famous singer, succubus of a perverse novelist, who is a great success in the nightclubs of Budapest. In reality, it is rumored that Zara is the Countess Maria Varelli who mysteriously disappeared during the war. Does the count want her with him to keep the inheritance or because he really loves her?
notes: George Fitzmaurice's deranged film is taken from the famous play by Luigi Pirandello. But very few things remain of the Nobel Prize play. The first part is good, where Erich Von Stroheim and a splendid Greta Garbo, here in a blonde version, are all the rage.

title: Hold Back the Night
actors: Stuart Sinclair Blyth, Christine Tremarco, Sheila Hancock

title: The Tailor of Panama
actors: Pierce Brosnan, Geoffrey Rush, Jamie Lee Curtis, Harold Pinter
description: Harry Pendell is a successful tailor, with a past as an ex-con also hidden from his wife, with some fragility typical of mythomaniacs and a well-established and well-attended tailor's shop in Panama City. It dresses and collects the confidences of the ruling class, politicians, businessmen and criminals. Occasionally converses with the dear departed, Uncle Benny. Andy Osnard is an unscrupulous agent sent to Panama to atone for and keep him out of some bed woes. Its confidential mission is to keep an eye on diplomatic and business movements around the canal, which was ceded by the United States to the Panamanian government in 1999. The agent has no intention of engaging and relies on the tailor's revelations, lies, inventions.
notes: The web of lies widens, between silent opposition, transversal maneuvers, confidential relationships, lashed by black humor, tempted or successful seductions, effective dialogues. John Boorman carefully rereads and stages the intrigue taken from the book by John Le Carré (here as executive producer and co-writer) with a calm and elegant style, of yesteryear. Subtle, ambiguous and ironic.

title: Une affaire de goût
actors: Bernard Giraudeau, Jean-Pierre Lorit, Charles Berling, Jean-Pierre Léaud
description: In prison for who knows why, questioned for who knows what, the young Nicolas challenges the viewer to discover his secret and to follow his story. Hired by the billionaire Delamont as a taster, the boy discovers that he is destined for a very different end, plagiarized by the "guardian" to the point of assuming the same characteristics, even a similar physiognomy. The game of slaughter continues and Nicolas's head goes haywire.
notes: The story obviously lends itself to a thousand interpretations, including political ones, but the most important and interesting is the erotic one, which upsets sequence after sequence heterosexual certainties. Willpower over desires wins but also turns pleasure into vulgarity.
