It is no coincidence that the refinement of the dishes and the banquets wanted by Delamont turns into something pornographic when Nicolas is induced to hate the same vomiting dishes for the boss. The duel between wills is not new and refers, even in an obvious way, to "The Servant" by Joseph Losey, even if brought back to a more marked class perspective (in the classic film with Dirk Bogarde the butler was the dominant figure). Beyond some well-known found, it is also true that the former critic and writer Bernard Rapp, with moments of genuine trepidation. 60% of the success of the film, however, is in the acting of Bernard Giraudeau (Delamont), a superlative and still little celebrated actor on this side of the Alps.

title: The Crow 3: Salvation
actors: Kirsten Dunst, Eric Mabius, Fred Ward, Jodi Lyn O'Keefe
description: Alex Corvis is sentenced to the electric chair on suspicion of murdering his girlfriend. He will return, with his usual supernatural powers, to take revenge for the murder and the wrongful execution.
notes: After Brandon Lee and Vincent Perez, it's up to Eric Mabius ("Cruel Intentions") to embody the dark protagonist of James O'Barr's comics. Three episodes are too many even for more structured films and in the case of "Corvo 3 Salvation" we are at the photocopy of the photocopy. Everything fades, becomes difficult to read and adulterates a little postmodern classic. Actors and characters change, but the "storyline" remains the same. The gothic, dark and romantic atmosphere has lost its enamel, the direction of the English Bharat Nalluri does not discount and the script seems more suitable for an animated film.

title: Así es la vida
actors: Arcelia Ramirez, Luis Felipe Trovar, Ernesto Yañez, Patricia Reyes Spindola
description: Julia, Maga and Mammana, is abandoned by her husband to marry the daughter of Guappo del district. These intimate her to leave the next day, a day set for her wedding, and to leave her children's children. The tragedy will be inveitable.
notes: The film is a sort of Brechtian telenovela, shot in interior. To be compared with Von Trier: also here video and hand -room room, but instead of playing with the musical Ripstein dives into the screenplay, in a large Latin Grant, and it emerges continuously to ask the viewer what he is looking at (you can see the troupe at the Mirror and the actors turn to the camera, while the mariachi leave the television screen with the Scoorn of the MezzoBusi). It is the lesson of the Mexican Buñuel, the one who wanted to put surreal orchestras against the background of "Los Olvidados". In a project that risked intellectualism, Ripstein succeeds by virtue of consistency and radicality (which also means loyalty of the roots), but above all for the love of the characters (which is also respect for the spectators). Even if the first thing that affects the viewer, and ruins the vision of the film to the last, is the excessively cleaned dubbing in the Italian version.

title: Tarzan and the She-Devil
actors: Lex Barker, Monique van Vooren, Joyce Mackenzie, Raymond Burr
description: This time around, the ape man and his inseparable companion have to deal with a woman who leads a group of evil hunters who exterminate elephants. The two jungle dwellers are taken prisoner. The pachyderms will come to their aid.
notes: Lex Barker's latest adventure as Tarzan.

title: The Spaceman and King Arthur
actors: Dennis Dugan, Sheila White, Kenneth Moore, Ron Moody
description: A NASA scientist, after having saved himself from the sinking of his spacecraft, finds himself in the court of King Arthur. The sidereal traveler, accompanied by his robot, has to deal with Merlin.
notes: As for _An American in King Arthur's court_, the starting point is Twain's book of the same name. Disney family product.

title: RKO 281
actors: Liev Schreiber, James Cromwell, Melanie Griffith, John Malkovich
description: When the immense Orson Welles is called to Hollywood by Rko, the director is greeted by the collective skepticism of a conservative apparatus.
notes: The film directed by Benjamin Ross and produced by Hbo, must give faces and words to too many historical figures. There is a lot of fashion and more interest in Hearst than Welles.

title: American Psycho
actors: Reese Witherspoon, Christian Bale, Willem Dafoe, Jared Leto, Reese Witherspoon
description: Patrick Bateman has all the numbers to look perfect; in fact, it tries to conform to the anonymous image of the classic Wall Street yuppie. What really interests him is having designer clothes and branded cars: the lust for blood that leads him to savagely and unscrupulously massacre all those who come into contact with him is linked precisely to the desire for possession.
notes: Contradictory adaptation of the book by Bret Easton Ellis. Too bad that the best moments have to give way to thriller, which Harron does not master: as if, worried, the director had kept the material under strenuous and excessive control.

title: Princesa
country: Italy, Germany, Great Britain, France, Spain
actors: Ingrid de Souza, Cesare Bocci, Mauro Pirovano, Biba Lerhue
description: The dream of Fernanda, a Brazilian transvestite, is to become a full-fledged woman, find a man and lead an absolutely normal life. So he leaves for Milan where he hopes to be able to earn the money to be operated on. She turns into Princesa, a prostitute who earns a lot and who makes numerous friends among both colleagues and clients. One night Fernanda is approached by Gianni and her life changes.
notes: A heterosexual in a marriage crisis who discovers sex, "women" and Plato. A city, Milan, the world capital of androgynous prostitution, ambiguous and asexual and addicted. And a Brazilian director, who has lived for years between London and Milan, who tries to understand why so many of his compatriots have "chosen" fog instead of the sun in Rio and the Amazon rainforest. To find valid answers, Goldman relies on and indulges in melodrama, as if he were a less self-punishing and reconciled Fassbinder who enjoys fluttering with the "urban" Fellini of the much-quoted and unforgettable "Notti di Cabiria". Since these are mestizo and contaminated areas, styles and forms, references and homages are also intertwined, ranging from documentary investigation to comedy of manners. Even the music of the Soldinian Venosta for once let off steam and unfold (the flute and Morriconian voice of Laura Pone is very suggestive), giving the feeling of being in front of a film that is forced to be imperfect and lacerated, but capable of sudden, strong, intense glimpses of true truth.

title: Vou para casa/Je rentre à la maison
actors: Michel Piccoli, Catherine Deneuve, John Malkovich, Leonor Silveira
description: Gilbert is an established theatrical performer. One evening, at the end of the show, tragedy bursts into his life abruptly: his agent informs him that his wife, daughter and son-in-law have died in a car accident. Time passes and existence, despite everything, resumes its course: Gilbert just has to divide himself between his beloved grandson and the stage he never left. When an American director offers him to participate in a film adaptation of Joyce's Ulysses, Gilbert eagerly accepts. But at the time of rehearsals ...
notes: Extraordinarily light, subjected to strict control, without a smudge: with his fixed plans and his taste for details, with distracted and reduced to the essential dialogues, with widespread irony, de Oliveira has made a film without age and without blackmail, witnessing which one has the feeling of sharing the time of maturity, the apathetic resistance, the disarming vulnerability of Gilbert. At the service of the ninety-year-old Lusitanian master, two actors who do not hesitate in front of very long close-ups: the protagonist Michel Piccoli and John Malkovich in the small, unpleasant, perplexed part of the director. And despite the "depth" of the theme and the staging, _Back to home_ is also fun.

title: Bless the Child
actors: Kim Basinger, Holliston Coleman, Christina Ricci, Rufus Sewell, Angela Bettis, Jimmy Smits
description: Maggie is a nurse who works in a New York hospital. His life goes on quietly until temperamental younger sister Jenna shows up on the doorstep with an autistic girl named Cody. Maggie grows fond of the little girl who soon takes the place of the daughter she never could have. Six years pass and Jenna shows up with her husband Eric and takes the baby away.
notes: The struggle between Good and Evil has the tension of a puppet theater. The direction of Chuck Russell ("Nightmare 3: Dream Warriors" and "The Eliminator - Eraser"), is poor and the film fails to place itself in the prestigious category of B movies.

title: Kafka
description: Lost in an infinite theory of rooms and corridors, an individual named K comes across a series of figures and situations from the pages of Franz Kafka.
notes: A recognized master of contemporary video experimentation, the Polish director (commonly known as "Zbig") measures himself against the atmosphere of the great Prague writer.

title: Boom
actors: Piero Natoli, Alessandro Di Carlo, Pier Maria Cecchini, Eliana Miglio
description: Three episodes. In the first, "The son of Pele", a father pours all his aspirations on an unlikely career as a football player of the scion, which however proves to be denied for the ball. In the second, "The son of Villa", a singing waiter dreams of collecting the legacy of the legendary Reuccio. In the third, "The son of Maciste", the young Aurelio does all he can to revive the glories of his parent, interpreter of peplum.
notes: The glorious Age also appears among the writers, which would suggest an attempt to restore the golden age of Italian comedy. Of course, pecoreccio is avoided, but the whole is decidedly weak.

title: Candyman
actors: Virginia Madsen, Tony Todd, Kasi Lemmons, Vanessa Williams
description: Helen, a researcher at a department of the University of Illinois, is surprised to see how deeply rooted the myth of the legendary Candyman, a black man who committed heinous crimes, is in her students. Determined to dispel this legend, the woman goes to Chicago in the company of her assistant. The two find themselves in the infamous area of ​​Cabrini Green in a dilapidated building inhabited by blacks in poverty. It was in this neighborhood that a brilliant black portraitist fell in love with the young woman he was portraying a century earlier.
notes: The film is based on "The Forbidden", a short story by Clive Barker. Enveloping music by Philip Glass.

title: New World Disorder
actors: Rutger Hauer, Andrew McCarthy, Tara Fitzgerald, Hari Dhillon
description: Some Silicon Valley scholars develop a super defense program for computers, but a gang of criminal hackers eliminates them and tries to steal the codes, which end up in the hands of the unscrupulous detective David Marx. He teams up with computer expert Kris Paddock to track down the bandit leader, Kurt Bishop, who hasn't given up on taking over the program. And when Bishop kidnaps Kris, he will experience at his own expense why Marx earned the nickname "The Coroner".
notes: Unfortunately it is the same old story, which the high-tech setting tries in vain to update. For poor Hauer there are no more words.

title: Thunder on the Hill
actors: Claudette Colbert, Ann Blyth, Robert Douglas, Anne Crawford
description: During a storm, the young Valerie Carns - wrongly accused of murder and sentenced to death - finds refuge in a Norfolk convent. Convinced of her innocence, Sister Mary begins a stubborn and reckless investigation in an attempt to bring the real culprit to justice.
notes: A few years before his best known and "flamboyant" melos, Sirk brings to the screen a text originally written for the theater ("Bonaventure" by Charlotte Hastings) and draws from it a tense, engaging and excellently performed thriller. 1951 was a particularly prolific season for the Danish-born director, who directed three other films.

title: Recess: School's Out
description: We are at the end of an elementary school year: the school closes its doors, the professors and the children demobilize and the latter are on their way to the summer camps, except T.J. forced to stay with his parents. It is the beginning of an unforgettable summer, because T.J. he discovers that some individuals inside the school are doing something shady. In the blink of an eye he recalls his friends and the sextet finds himself embroiled in an exhilarating adventure that will lead to the salvation of the summer holidays, or recreation, which a maddened former school principal wanted to abolish, moving the moon and changing the climate. to eliminate the summer.
notes: Rhythm, adventure, nostalgia, references to pop culture and the hilarious clash within the generation of sixty-eight professors, garnish everything and the icing on the cake is a soundtrack that plays Marvin Gaye, Jimi Hendrix and much more. The film is a little gem that manages to captivate even adults.

title: Shrek
description: Shrek, a little ogre with a heart of gold, along with Donkey, his steed tries to regain possession of his swamp occupied by fairy tale characters. They have been imprisoned by the evil Lord Farquaad, tyrant of the land of Duloc. The ogre and the inseparable donkey must work to free a princess who has been subjected to a spell and held captive in a castle, guarded by a dragon.
notes: What distinguishes _Shrek_ from the rest of contemporary animation is not so much the perfection of the musculature, of the fleshy tissue that surrounds the skeleton, the fluidity of the movements of the human characters, but the complex work of parodying. Starting from the imprisonment of the characters of the fairy tales, the film draws a modern "morphology of the fairy tale", that is a formal and substantial compendium of the fairy tale through the parody of its most successful cinematographic versions. A non-intellectual work that draws its energy from the driving force of the gags, starting from the pages of the storybook that the ogre reads at the beginning in the privacy of his toilet, then used as toilet paper. A politically incorrect and decidedly likeable ogre who entertains hilarious verbal duets with Donkey, his quick-witted adventure companion with a particular propensity for psychoanalysis. In short, a film, based on a story published in 1990 by William Steign, truly for everyone and which does not give up throwing a few digs at Disney's rivals-friends. The film won the Oscar for Best Animated Film.

title: L'ultima lezione
actors: Roberto Herlitzka, Ignazio Oliva, Chiara Monti, Paolo De Vita
description: A great economist, Federico Caffè, disappears without leaving a trace. He moves away from his home in Monte Mario in Rome and vanishes into thin air. It is April 14, 1987 and that professor loved by his students, esteemed by many of his university colleagues, an appreciated supporter of a science of economics not separated from ethics, decides to leave the scene. Suicide? Terroristic attack? Retreat to the convent? Federico Caffè's remains a mystery.
notes: The director Fabio Rosi, inspired by the book by Ermanno Rea, correctly reconstructs, with some didactic and compilation concessions, a more complex and suggestive story than a fiction.

title: Dude, Where's My Car?
actors: Ashton Kutcher, Seann William Scott, Jennifer Garner, Marla Sokoloff
description: Jesse and Chester, clumsy students and revelers, one day wake up completely stoned so as not to remember anything from the previous evening. The two are wanted by half of America for stealing suitcases full of dollars, powerful technological devices and their girlfriends for having turned their house upside down.
notes: If the starting idea was to make a parody of the swooning American teen comedies, the intention had something laudable in it, but as often happens in life (and in cinema), theory and practice do not always go hand in hand. Ashton Kutcher and Sean William Scott tackle nearly ninety minutes of weak and painful gags.

title: 27 Missing Kisses
actors: Nino Kukhanidze, Shalva Iashvili, Pierre Richard, Amaliya Mordvinova
description: In a village in late Communist Georgia, the adolescent Sybilla arrives, graceful, almost an elf. Love invades the town in a thousand directions, and Sybilla, courted by the shy Mickey, falls in love with his father instead. With an impeccable rhythm, set in dreamy places, with some sequences to remember (the premiere of "Emmanuelle" in the city cinema), the film is on the edge of fashion, like the music by Bregovic that accompanies it. The cameo of Pierre Richard, a captain who does not find the sea, is affected, but the pansexual summer with wives in search of fertilization and playboy astronomers is funny.

title: I lupi dentro
description: The documentary traces the relations of the naive painter Raffaele Andreassi with Antonio Ligabue and with his places. But Ligabue is just a pretext, in a wandering at the mouth of the Po among farmhouses, artists and madmen: legendary fishermen, river navigators, dozens of naive painters.
notes: Raffaele Andreassi has been a documentary maker for fifty years, as well as the author of a few fictional films that are now invisible ("Flashback") and screenwriter for cinema and television. The characters that populate this documentary are all observed with patience and love. The path thus becomes that of homage and lamentation to a vanished peasant civilization and its poetry. Shot in 16 millimeters, it is an auteur documentary almost from another era.

title: Body Shots
actors: Sean Patrick Flanery, Amanda Peet, Tara Reid, Larry Joshua
description: Four boys and four girls indulge in alcohol, seeking extreme intimacy on an over-the-top night out between a bar and club in Los Angeles. What do they talk about when they linger, with some excess of speech, about sex? Something that should have an analogy with pleasure, loneliness, fears, techniques, foreplay and postcoitus. The night is not tender and for one of the two couples it leads, with the benefit of the doubt, into rape.
notes: Director Michael Cristofer is one to watch, but he falls short of his scripts. Screenwriter David McKenna runs into several mistakes. The cinematographer invents a suitable light and takes notes for his debut as a director.

title: À ma s¦ur!
actors: Anaïs Reboux, Roxane Mesquida, Laura Betti, Libero De Rienzo
description: Anaïs and Elena are two sisters of twelve and sixteen. The first is quite plump and suffers from her condition. The second, on the contrary, is of explosive beauty and is aware of its power of seduction. Over the course of a summer Elena meets an Italian boy who makes her discover the pleasures of physical love. Anaïs is content to follow and secretly observe the two lovers. When the parents notice what is happening they decide to return home. On the way back, the drama breaks out.
notes: That Catherine Breillat's cinema wants to shout its stubborn desire for diversity to the world is demonstrated by the titles of her filmography, often accompanied, initialed, sealed with exclamation points, (from "Parfait amour!" To the latter "A my sister!"). It's still. The red thread of all the stories of the French writer, screenwriter (also for Fellini) and director is, without a doubt, sex: denied, sought, suffered, suffered, brazen. As in "Vergine size 36" (1987), "To my sister" delves into adolescent memories, in the summers consecrated to the first approaches, to the "first times", even if the ending (frankly a bit dark) seems to come out more recently "Baise moi" that from the imaginary, private and filmic, of Breillat, an author who loves long sequence shots, silent dialogues, unconventional optics. And that asks its viewers for tears and blood, patience and active approaches. An original and highly personal "anti-cinema", which concedes nothing, which clings to itself out of cosmic distrust and pragmatic relativism.

title: Réquiem para el gringo
actors: Lang Jeffries, Femi Benussi, Fernando Sancho, Carlo Gaddi
description: Ross, a farm owner, suffers an attempted horse raid by a gang of rancheros. They kill his brother Dan, triggering the violent reaction of Ross who is pondering revenge. A solar eclipse also intervenes to help him.
notes: Very modest Italian-Spanish co-production.

title: Goldrush: A Real Life Alaskan Adventure
actors: Alyssa Milano, William Morgan Sheppard, Stan Cahill, Peter Flemming
description: Bored with the usual life she leads in New York, Frances decides to leave for Alaska and join the gold diggers. After an adventurous journey he reaches the wilderness in the company of his dog and a crew of seven men. But the difficulties she encounters day after day send her into crisis.

title: The Perfect Wife
actors: Shannon Sturges, Perry King, Lesley-Anne Down, William R. Moses
description: Behind the marriage of Leah Tyman and Dr. Steward hides an unspeakable secret: conducted on the verge of madness by despair following the death of her beloved brother Rubin, the woman intends to take revenge by marrying the doctor whom she considers guilty of causing the disappearance of the boy.

title: Candyman: Day of the Dead
actors: Donna D'Errico, Tony Todd, Mark Adair-Rios, Mike Moroff
description: The ghostly serial killer again emerges from the realm of shadows: this time his target is Caroline McKeever, an art dealer from Los Angeles and a distant relative of Candyman himself, who wants to "bring her closer". A series of people close to Caroline thus find a violent death, and the suspicions can only fall on her.

title: Ordinary Decent Criminal
actors: Kevin Spacey, Linda Fiorentino, Peter Mullan, Stephen Dillane
description: Michael Lynch has charm and is skilled at his job. He has all the credentials to be a successful man, but he is a thief of works of art. Michael is the desperation of the Dublin police who follow him day and night to put him in prison. That doesn't stop Ireland's most wanted thief from landing some fantastic shots under their own nose. When Michael decides to get his hands on a Caravaggio, he finds a policeman on his way, determined to do anything to catch him.
notes: In 1998 John Boorman directed "The General" which told the story of Martin Cahill, a famous Dublin gangster who became a legend. The points of contact (apart from the ending) with that film are unmistakable. "A Perfect Criminal" is not as dense as "The General", it has neither its general vision nor its bitter predestination, but it is a tight and ironic film, with a nice rhythm in the description of the shots, the chases and the tricks with which Lynch and his gang get rid of the policemen, just a little slowed down and confused in the central part, but which rises with agility as soon as Caravaggio enters the scene.

title: The Fortune Cookie
actors: Jack Lemmon, Walter Matthau, Ron Rich, Judi West, Cliff Osmond
description: During a football game, cameraman Harry Hinkle is accidentally shot by player Luther "Boom Boom" Jackson. Greedy brother-in-law Willie Gingrich, an unscrupulous lawyer, convinces him to pretend to be paralyzed and organizes an insurance scam. Then Sandy enters the scene, Harry's estranged wife: who accepts in spite of himself, until ...
notes: Wilder's caustic comedy, once again merciless towards parental ties dominated by hypocrisy and material interest. Actors in a state of grace, sublime direction, iron screenplay. Matthau won the Oscar for Best Supporting Actor.

title: Final Descent/Final Ascent
actors: Antonio Sabato jr, Jürgen Prochnow, Heide Noelle Lenhart, Patrick Muldoon
description: A plane with a stolen $ 30 million cargo crashes in the Rocky Mountains due to lack of fuel. The criminals manage to escape while the precious suitcase lands on the north face of the mountain, which is difficult to reach. The head of the criminals, Viggo, is determined to recover the stolen goods at any cost, while federal agent Stillman and the local police set out on his trail downstream. Meanwhile Beth Martin and her boyfriend David are leading some novice climbers. Viggo and his team join the group, but then reveal their identity and force Beth and David to lead them to the summit.

title: The Base II
actors: Antonio Sabato jr, James Remar, Duane Davis, Melissa Lewis
description: Colonel Strauss is an officer who does not allow room for mediation. For him, the US military is a receptacle for slackers. And the military court is a coven of superficial. Thus, he set up his own team, with which he administers his "justice", liquidating the soldiers who escaped the sentences of the military court. He hasn't reckoned with Sergeant John Murphy, tasked with infiltrating the squad to neutralize her. Antonio Sabato jr., Son of one of the tough faces of Italian cinema of the seventies, follows in his father's footsteps. Under the direction of Mark Lester, adrenaline-pumping action movie specialist.

title: Satansbraten
actors: Kurt Raab, Margit Carstensen, Helen Vita, Volker Spengler
description: Unable to keep faith with the libertarian ideals to which he had adhered in the past, the poet Walter Kranz experiences a dissolute conduct that leads him first on the path of crime, then to the parasitism exercised against a wealthy admirer, whose money allows him to put in feet a kind of homosexual conventicola.
notes: In the composite Fassbinderian filmography, this bewildered and deliberately repulsive film succeeds the frozen melodies of "Effi Briest". A satire of bourgeois decadence at times unrealistic and certainly dated, but also further proof of the inexhaustible and unbridled vitalism of its author.

title: Walking Tall Part II
actors: Bo Svenson, Luke Askew, Robert Doqui, Bruce Glover, Richard Jaeckel
description: Tennesse's whiskey smoker smoids have their sworn enemy, it is the sheriff Buford. Miraculously escaped an attack, the Polizitto is ready to resume the struggle. But he will still have to fight a lot to capture the assassins who want him dead.
notes: A series for TV was taken from this film.

title: Malafemmena
actors: Maria Fiore, Nunzio Gallo, Aldo Bufi Landi, Gabriele Tinti, Aldo Giuffré
description: Rosa is a capricious Neapolitan girl who, for fun, seduces men. Her game has tragic consequences on two cousins ??who, falling in love with her, fight in a duel to the death. But Rosa's only real concern is making money fast, so when she is offered a fabulous contract as a dancer, she accepts. The girl does not know that the businessmen who signed her to the contract are involved in the white trade. Then one day a singer who has just arrived in Italy from the United States falls in love with Angelo.
notes: The film is inspired by the song written by Antonio De Curtis.

title: Colpo rovente
actors: Barbara Bouchet, Isa Miranda, Carmelo Bene, David Groh
description: The body of Mac, a wealthy industrialist involved in shady business, is found in a New York street. The victim had long had relations with a powerful organization involved in drug trafficking. The investigation is entrusted to Captain Frank Berin, head of the Narcotic Bureau. To try to solve the intricate affair, Frank just has to infiltrate the drug addict's environment. After escaping numerous attacks, Berin manages to identify the people at the head of the organization. What he fails to find out is the name of the Mac killer.
notes: First film by set designer Pietro Zuffi and last screenplay by Flaiano.

title: Lacrime d'amore
actors: Mal, Silvia Dionisio, Francesco Mulè, Ferruccio Amendola, Carlo Delle Piane
description: Reg, a successful British singer, is married to Paola, but his agent, Barbara Morris, has forced him to keep his marriage a secret. Reg forced to see his wife from time to time due to pressing work commitments becomes convinced that his better half is cheating on him with another. Determined to abandon it, he leaves for England where an important employment contract awaits him. In London Reg, victim of a suitcase exchange, he is arrested for drug trafficking. Paola's father in an attempt to restore peace to the family goes to Great Britain.
notes: The screenplay of this musicarello signed by Mario Amendola and Bruno Corbucci makes water everywhere.

title: Zazie dans le métro
actors: Catherine Demongeot, Philippe Noiret, Vittorio Caprioli, Carla Marlier
description: Zazie's mother, in Paris for two days, entrusts the little girl to her uncle Gabriel, who takes her around the city. The girl would like to see the subway, but the trains are stopped due to a strike; The unexpected does not prevent her from combining trouble throughout the metropolis.

title: Hamlet 2000
actors: Ethan Hawke, Kyle MacLachlan, Diane Venora, Sam Shepard, Bill Murray, Julia Stiles, Liev Schreiber
description: More than forty film versions of Shakespearean Hamlet and still there are those who want to revisit it. Hamlet by Michael Almereyda sets the story among the skyscrapers of Manhattan and adapts it to the era of multinationals: the struggle for power mixes with generational conflicts and the unease of an upper-class youth universe grown up with media, consumption, reproduction and image recycling. Hamlet is a director with no great prospects, always uncomfortable in public circumstances in which his birth mother and stepfather, owners of Denmark Corporation, show off their power and wealth. Hamlet relates to reality through a digital camera, has a virtual and painful approach to the world, dialogues with others and with himself using photographs, extracts from films or clips of his video recordings. The show with which Hamlet unmasks the murdering parents is a short film made with heterogeneous fragments of other films, TV series or documentaries. The famous sequence of the monologue takes place instead in the corridors full of videotapes of one of the many Blockbusters of the Big Apple. The Hamlet crisis translates into a vague paternal nostalgia, which starts from the apparitions of a ghost-father who looks a lot like one of the countless latent and virtual images that populate the boy's loneliness. The traditional father, emblem of a past imposed as a duty that claims a place in Hamlet's inner life and fatal action, claiming to be remembered and therefore avenged, is contrasted by the prospect of an indecipherable future, encoded in numbers, transactions of company shares and in self-promotional ceremonies, which appears to Hamlet as an alienating cage. Along the lines of Scream and The Blair Witch Project, Hamlet is a contemporary youthful metaphor on the power of images, on the tragic global denial and on the cognitive and existential consequences of this pervasive artificial dimension.

title: The Guilty
actors: Bill Pullman, Devon Sawa, Gabrielle Anwar, Joanne Whalley
description: Teenager Nathan is released from prison just in time to find out that his biological father is attorney Callum Crane. Who has a violent relationship with fellow practitioner Sophie, who does not take it well and blackmails him: either he resigns the position of federal judge or she denounces him for rape. Crane, unaware that he is a father, meets Nathan by chance and commissions Sophie's murder to him.
notes: The twists do not stop there, because the screenplay for "The Guilty" (written by William Davies) accepts any risk, even at the cost of bordering on the improbable. Behind the camera, however, a serious professional like Anthony Waller (remember "The witness's eyes"?) Sticks the right patches to the story by choosing a Hitchcockian register. Suspence as if it were raining, alternate montages that deceive (a la Hitch, or a Demme) and a beautiful sequence "on the phone" that recalls "Crime perfect". The devotion to the word and the gaze of the thrill wizard is such that the apparent protagonist leaves the scene halfway through the film, like Janet Leigh. Waller, however, does not weigh the many references, on the contrary, he makes them functional and coherent within a detective story that exploits precisely the lack of coherence to challenge the expectations of the public, not infrequently displaced. The acting of the actors is below the guard level, but when you have your heart in your mouth you don't notice it.

title: Sottovento
actors: Claudio Amendola, Anna Valle, Mariano Rigillo, Francesco Venditti
description: Paolo is a renowned skipper who gave up everything after losing a man in a regatta. But he never stopped dreaming of the sea, and when a billionaire gets his boat back on track, dreams seem to come true. But the test that Paul has to undergo is hard: to embark seven maladjusted young people and re-educate them. Among them is the grandson of the patron. He will have to touch various ports of the Mediterranean under the eye of an austere lawyer and if he fails he will lose the boat.
notes: The American youth-social drama cue works well enough. Claudio Amendola is right for the role, but the poverty of means makes itself felt at times.

title: My Generation
description: Barbara Kopple's indiscreet eye goes through thirty years of American history, under the pretext of comparing the three editions of Woodstock of 1969, 1994 and 1999, the musical event of the twentieth century. The red thread of the documentary is music. From Bob Dylan to Metallica, passing through Janis Joplin, the Who, the Red Hot Chili Peppers and many others, the best of rock parades on the screen. But Kopple's film has value above all as a testimony of the changes in American society; if Woodstock of 1969 was the mirror of a generation, subsequent editions prove to be merchandising events.

title: Le secret
actors: Anne Coesens, Michel Bompoil, Tony Todd, Quentin Rossi
description: A thoughtfully selfish husband and a two-year-old child: this is Marie's world, a woman in the midst of the critical ford between thirty and forty, a door-to-door seller of encyclopedias who loves her work and thinks she pleases the husband making another child. The chance encounter with a man who is where he shouldn't, collapses that castle of false harmony that hides a boring and monotonous family life, punctuated by ritual appointments such as a child's bath or a game of tennis with her husband. The other is an American black dancer who swapped his Parisian apartment with a friend. Storyteller, charming, sexually vigorous, she represents everything that her husband is not or is no longer and Marie gives in, putting her world in jeopardy. An insinuating passion envelops her and leads her to her lover, regardless of the consequences.
notes: Virginie Wagon, with the artistic collaboration of Erick Zonca, weaves a passionate portrait of a young woman who questions her being in the world, following the unfathomable paths of passion. The viewer is deeply involved in this painful path of growth, through which Marie shows her partner her dark side, that bad heart that hurts and leaves you breathless.

title: The Bishop's Wife
actors: Cary Grant, Loretta Young, David Niven, Monty Woolley, Elsa Lanchester
description: Dudley is a guardian angel who receives a delicate task from his ... superiors: to descend among humans and assist Reverend Henry Brougham, a Protestant bishop, in his feverish financing operation for a new temple. But the pitfall is represented by the shepherd's beautiful wife, Julia, to whose charm Dudley is far from insensitive ...
notes: Koster is certainly not a genius; but the champion cast, the pleasant humor of the script and the great work of the master of lights Gregg Toland - the father of depth of field, here in his latest effort - redeem the flatness of the direction. Five nominations and an Oscar (for sound).

title: Aventuras del Oeste
actors: Rik Van Nutter, Adrian Hoven, Gloria Milland, Francisco Sanz, Helga Sommerfeld, Carlos Romero Marchent, Raf Baldassarre
description: Leading a pioneer caravan including Ethel and her uncle, Buffalo Bill arrives in a city harassed by a gang of arms smugglers. They supply the red Indians who infest the area with weapons. The hub for rifles and pistols is the town of Custer and that's where Buffalo and his men go. The Indians have gathered to do battle, but have not reckoned with our hero who evacuated the town of Custer and asked for the intervention of the army.
notes: Mediocre films, conventional characters, flat direction.

title: La casa dell'orco
actors: Virginia Bryant, Sabrina Ferilli, Paolo Malco, Stefania Montorsi
description: Little Cheryl is threatened in a dream by an ogre. Years later Cheryl herself, who became a writer, is working on a horror story: suddenly she realizes that the Italian castle in which she is spending the holidays in the company of her husband and son is the same as her nightmare, monster including ...

title: The Baby-Sitters Club
actors: Schuyler Fisk, Bre Blair, Larisa Oleynik, Rachael Leigh Cook
description: The film tells the story of seven little girls who started a babysitter cooperative. As business is going well, the girls decide to open a summer camp for children. The enterprising girls are disappointed to find that not all adults living nearby are favorable. This experience will teach them what cooperation and responsibility mean. Kristy the leader of the group lives with her mother and stepfather. But one day Kristy's biological father arrives in town. The girl begs him not to tell her mother that she is in town. Stacy has another problem to deal with: she's tall and pretty and she's met a guy she likes. But he believes she is older than she looks and invites her out. First work by Melanie Mayron. Schuyler Fisk is the daughter of Sissy Spacek. Based on characters from a successful book series by Ann M. Martin.

title: The 6th Man
actors: Marlon Wayans, Kadeem Hardison, David Paymer, Saundra McClain
description: Antoine a basketball player dies moments before a very important championship game. His place on the team is taken by his brother Kenny. The deceased does not feel like leaving the relative alone and so returns in the guise of a ghost to help him.
notes: Comedy with fantasy veins.

title: La pirate
actors: Jane Birkin, Philippe Léotard, Maruschka Detmers, Andrew Birkin
description: Torn between love for her husband Andrew and a never-subsided passion for another woman, Carol, Alma oscillates between the two objects of her desire, unable to escape her own suffering. Not even escape seems to remedy it.
notes: Doillon's work on feelings and drives pushes his staging to the limits of hysteria.

title: Wishmaster 2: Evil Never Dies
actors: Andrew Divoff, Paul Johansson, Holly Fields, Bokeem Woodbine
description: Casually freed by the thief Morgana, the evil Djinn voluntarily gets himself incarcerated in order to take possession of the prisoners' soul, in exchange for which he offers them the opportunity to have their wishes fulfilled. But Morgana opposes her plans to conquer the world, aided by a young priest.

title: Indictment: The McMartin Trial
actors: James Woods, Mercedes Ruehl, Lolita Davidovich, Sada Thompson
description: Los Angeles, 1984: Three employees of the prestigious McMartin Nursery School and four members of the same owner family are arrested on the infamous accusation of sexual abuse and harassment of the little guests of the institution. The defense of the accused is assumed by the lawyer Danny Davis, who is initially interested only in the publicity that the sensational case can procure him; later, however, during the investigation phase, he is convinced of the innocence of his clients. As it is obvious to expect, the media do not fail to speculate on what happened, using tones of a real witch hunt. Based on a true story.

title: La ciénaga
actors: Graciela Borges, Mercedes Morán, Juan Cruz Bordeu, Martin Adjemian
description: Mecha's middle-class family, a woman in her fifties addicted to alcohol, spends their holidays in Mandragora on their country estate in northwestern Argentina. The woman has four teenage children and a husband who spends his time drinking and dyeing his hair. The family unit of Tali, Mecha's poor cousin who lives in the city with her husband and four children, goes to the villa to spend the holidays. At the edge of a swimming pool that looks like a quagmire, tables for lunches, siestas and the sallies of the children in the fields and woods follow. Then one day Tali's eldest son arrives from Buenos Aires and has a morbid relationship with one of his cousins.
notes: Films of swamps, provinces, of sticky and wounded bodies, of a humid heat that spares no one, of tangles and family crossroads that macerate in stillness. _La ciénaga_ by Argentine director Lucrecia Martel is one of the most impressive beginnings of Argentine cinema in recent years. Not only for the mastery that the author shows towards the camera (very difficult to stage the movements, movements, dialogues of a group of people in the same room without falling back on the almost fixed camera and, at the same time, without falling into the chaos or in the manner), but above all for the ability to make us perceive, almost physically, everything that happens under the absolutely daily gestures of a summer vacation. Best First Feature Award at the Berlin Film Festival in 2001.

title: À l'attaque!
actors: Ariane Ascaride, Jean-Pierre Darroussin, Jacques Boudet, Pierre Banderet
description: Two screenwriters have to write a political film set in the district of l'Estaque in Marseille. They invent the story of a family of Italian origin who manages a garage with money that is never enough, banks that hound and bosses who do not pay with the trick of "bankruptcy liquidation. The two authors have irony to sell and enough detachment to avoid fall into the pitfalls of Manichaeism that takes itself seriously, and then they throw themselves first into the Jacques Demy musical, then into the cinema of the Popular Front.
notes: Robert Guédiguian explains his cinema. The beloved characters dream and sing ("O bella ciao" at full throttle) and the screen lights up immensely.

title: Dirty Little Secret
actors: Jack Wagner, Tracey Gold, Sean Day Michael
description: Ray and his girlfriend Sarah kidnap Charlie, the adopted son of local sheriff Jack and his wife Ellie. The latter, terrified, wants to inform the FBI, but Jack insists on conducting the investigation on her own. Determined to get Charlie back, Ellie asks her banker father to get her a hundred thousand dollars as soon as possible ...

title: Bridge of Dragons
actors: Dolph Lundgren, Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa, Valerie Chow, Gary Hudson
description: In the course of a violent power war in Japan, the seemingly cold and emotionless killer Warchyld faces a conflict of conscience for the first time and refuses to kill a completely defenseless man. Noting Warchyld's reluctance to carry out the order received, his boss unleashes a no-holds-barred fight.
notes: For those who do not remember, the Swedes Dolph Lundgren is the one who, in the shorts of the grim Soviet boxer Ivan Drago, threatens poor Rocky with the epochal joke "I spie you in two!" in the fourth episode of the series. Here he is again on track in this action movie equal to a thousand others.

title: Eraserhead
actors: Jack Nance, Charlotte Stewart, Jeanne Bates, Judith Anna Roberts
description: Harry Spencer, a typographer by profession, lives in a seedy flat on the outskirts of a big city. Married to Mary who has just given him a child, he turns out to be a kind of monster in all respects.
notes: The film that officially launched David Lynch's career. Beyond a plot that turns out to be almost a pretext, what counts are the surreal sequences, real assorted nightmares, chilling projections of an unhealthy, delusional existence. Beyond the filmic reality, among other things shot in a suggestive black and white, the extra-diegetic one is characterized by the prolific creativity of the filmmaker, a true genius of cinema, an indisputable talent already in the dazzling beginnings.

title: Tarantula
actors: John Agar, Mara Corday, Leo G. Carroll, Nestor Paiva
description: Doctor Gerald Deemer has developed the formula of a special ultra-nutritious food, but has not dealt with the unexpected: in addition to causing irreversible damage in the body and mind of humans, the experiments give rise to the immeasurable growth of a tarantula, which - transformed into a huge and repellent monster - escapes from the laboratory terrorizing the entire state of Arizona ...
notes: Arnold's film, "little master" of low-budget cinema, is the perfect paradigm of the best B-movie: taut, no frills, enriched by handcrafted but successful special effects. In the finale, in a minor role, Clint Eastwood is also seen.

title: Il falco e la colomba
actors: Fabio Testi, Lara Wendel, Simonetta Stefanelli, Danilo Mattei
description: Michele, rampant politician, is stalked by some terrorists. Rescue from the young Viva, drug addict, Michele falls in love with him, leaves his wife and gives up his career. But his former companions, fearing a scandal, try to bring alive in the drug tunnel.
notes: Negligible mix between "social" feeling and ideas.

title: Un marinaio e mezzo
actors: Franco Nero, Santiago Garcia, Francisco Rabal, Galo Ahumada
description: Nick, a navigator who loves to sail the waters alone, is rammed by a ship. After some investigation he discovers that the boat is registered to a company based in Colombia. Nick manages to make friends with the boy heir to the mysterious shipowner.
notes: Television movie suitable for families.

title: Dio non paga il sabato
actors: Robert Mark, Larry Ward, Vivi Gioi, Max Dean, Furio Meniconi
description: A bandit, his woman and two of his men try to defend the spoils of a robbery from the greedy hands of an old woman and a former companion of the outlaw seeking revenge. The undertaking, as usual, will not be easy.
notes: Spaghetti western Italo Spanish shot with few means and almost out of the genre.

title: Il giorno del Cobra
actors: Franco Nero, Sybil Danning, Mario Maranzana, Mickey Knox
description: Larry "Cobra" Staziani, after being disbarred from the police and having spent three years in prison, moved to San Francisco to be a detective. Forced to accept a post from one of his former superiors, he returns to Italy. He will have to bring his sworn enemy to justice.
notes: Screenplay by Aldo Lado, Fabio and Tito Carpi.

title: Get Carter
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Miranda Richardson, Alan Cumming, Rachael Leigh Cook
description: The feared killer Jack Carter returns to Seattle to the places of his youth, after many years of absence to attend his brother's funeral. For Jack, the homecoming is the last chance to make up for the mistakes of the past. It is not difficult for him to reconnect with the past, but when he discovers that his brother has been murdered, his intentions change: he only wants one thing, revenge.
notes: It must be admitted that the short story "Jack's Return Home" by Ted Lewis had a not marginal influence on cinema. It inspired the British cult film "Carter" in 1971, a blaxploitation version by George Armitage in 1972 ("Hit Man") and now "Carter's Revenge", a turn-of-the-millennium reinterpretation, commissioned by Sylvester Stallone who assigned himself the role. of protagonist, impersonating thirty years ago by Michael Caine, who appears here in a small cameo. A discreet pedigree for a film that already from the set - no longer the British Newcastle but the very American Seattle - shows a certain impatience for philology. He is a human and capable of feeling Carter, described by screenwriter David McKenna, despite the increasingly petrified face of the Stallone icon, while the direction of Stephen T. Kay tries to mask a certain poverty, through go-go close-ups. and an almost schizophrenic montage. Notable Mickey Rourke and Alan Cumming in the unsavory roles of "bad boys".

title: Little Nicky
actors: Reese Witherspoon, Adam Sandler, Harvey Keitel, Patricia Arquette
description: Nicky is the devil's son, but he's as good as bread. And when his two little brothers (one black and one gay) take refuge on our planet, he must chase them and bring them back to hell. He is helped by a talking dog, a scowl with glasses and a neighbor who dreams of being an actor.
notes: Seeing hell in the cinema is always fun, but only Tim Burton knows how to film it with imagination; here everything has a dull and televised air. Adam Sandler is not funny; but in the secondary parts there is a real waste of character actors: there is Quentin Tarantino playing a blind preacher, Fonzie covered in bees and Ozzy Osborne.

title: Yi Yi
actors: Issei Ogata, Wu Nien-Jen, Elaine Jin, Kelly Lee, Jonathan Chang
description: Taiwan, today. Father N.J. he works in an IT company and begins to wonder if his life could have been different. Mother Min-Min feels the emptiness of her days and turns to the holy man of a monastery for some answers. Teenage daughter Ting-Ting discovers the first thrills of love. Little Yang-Yang, the philosopher of the house, photographs the back of each person's neck to help him "discover the other side of the truth", the one that no one can see. In his father's life a woman he was in love with reappears after thirty years. The grandmother feels bad and goes into a coma. There is also a crime ...
notes: A few years ago, the French newspaper "Libération" asked some directors a simple question: why do you make films? Edward Yang replied with an equally simple answer: "Because making films allows me to avoid talking." "Yi yi" is a simple and sweet movie. It is as simple as its title which means "one, one" and is equivalent to ours "and one, and two", an expression used by musicians to give the tempo of a song. And one, and two, and on for nearly three hours of a movie Yang would like us to come out of "happy as if we had gone to meet friends". Yang adds: "If viewers, after the film, said instead that they met a director, my film would be a failure." It is true that the direction is not felt, it is not heavy. But you can see it, and how, in the taste of the composition of each shot, in the clarity and naturalness of the gaze.

title: Vengo
actors: Antonio Canales, Orestes Villasan Rodriguez, Antonio Perez Dechent
description: Caco does not rest for the death of his daughter and spends hours in the cemetery. He protects and keeps company with his nephew Diego, a spastic, son of his brother who, after killing a gypsy, lives in hiding abroad. The blood debts will be paid, between a party and a Sufi flamenco.
notes: Gatlif, in his homage to Andalusia, to the Mediterranean sentiment, to a supranational "gipsy social club" lets the "musical numbers", the parties, the performances of the artists blossom on a fragile but dramatic branch of the story. Tony Gatlif, author-pioneer of cinematic neo-nomadism with "Vengo" managed to direct his film on flamenco

title: The Misadventures of Margaret
actors: Parker Posey, Jeremy Northam, Elizabeth McGovern, Brooke Shields
description: American Margaret has been married for seven years to Edward, an English professor. Their orderly and quiet life as a couple goes on without too many jolts. Then one day Margaret is commissioned to adapt a diary written by an 18th century French man of letters known as the Philosopher. The diary tells the story of the Philosopher's seduction of a girl. As Margaret adjusts the diary, she begins to wonder about her marriage.
notes: Cathleen Schine is a writer who has a success inversely proportional to her very modest literary qualities. His little stories, for the cinema, are a real calamity. This film based on one of his novels does not escape the rule.

title: Nicht versöhnt
actors: Heinrich Hargesheimer, Martha Staender, Henning Harmssen
description: A retrospective and non-chronological look at the events of three generations of the Fähmel family, from the First World War to the 1950s.
notes: First medium-length film by the Straub-Huillet duo, freely inspired by a novel by Heinrich Böll: the style and contents of the film are perfectly faithful to the title.

title: La fiancée de Dracula
actors: Cyrille Iste, Brigitte Lahaie, Jacques Régis, Thomas Smith, Jacques Orth
description: A magician and his assistant try to free a castle from the influence of a group of vampires, with poor results. Even if to tell the truth, the appearances of the manor are less macabre than expected, but much more ... attractive.
notes: The last effort of the director of Horror and Hard Core Jean Rollin. Remarkable performance of the Pornstar Brigitte Lahaie.

title: Tart
actors: Dominique Swain, Brad Renfro, Myles Jeffrey, Alberta Watson
description: Cat Storm attends one of the most exclusive and prestigious colleges in New York and tries to earn the friendship of the scions of high society. Life in the family is not exactly the best, the mother Lily is very caring, but too busy with work and financial problems and therefore ends up neglecting Cat and her brother Pete. Cat is in love with Willial but she doesn't want to know about going out with her.
notes: The directorial debut of Christine Wayne, a former "Rolling Stone" journalist who wrote subjects for video clips, directed videos and shot a documentary on the Bush US tour, is cacophonous and poorly acted.

title: Kevin and Perry Go Large
actors: Henry Enfield, Kathy Burke, Rhys Ifans, Laura Fraser, James Fleet
description: Kenny and Perry are two filthy and stupid teenagers who are also frustrated with sex. The desperate two land in Ibiza looking for girls and hoping to establish themselves as a dee-jay, or rather to become the most famous disc jockeys in the world. But there's also a problem Kevin's parents have decided to spend their vacation on the island.
notes: The film would like to focus on vulgarity (the main gag of the film consists of the sudden erections that capture the protagonists at the slightest external stress), but the clean packaging and the winking quotes take away any trash charm. Kevin and Perry look like the goofy goof in A Clockwork Orange and Macario when he dressed up as a kid.

title: Final Run
actors: Robert Urich, Patricia Kalember, John de Lancie, Udo Kier
description: The Grand Royale is a super-technological train equipped with highly sophisticated computerized controls. But when the driver inadvertently pours soda into the circuits, the convoy goes haywire and rushes wildly onto the tracks, reaching insane speeds. The man tries to fix the damage but ends up falling off the train and the only one who can save the two hundred passengers is Lucky Singer. Meanwhile at the station the managers find themselves having to decide whether to send the convoy on an interrupted track that would launch it into the sea, or whether to let the race continue with the risk of a probable collision with a hospital ...

title: Follow the River
actors: Sheryl Lee, Ellen Burstyn, Eric Schweig, Tim Guinee, Renée O'Connor
description: As the war between Red Indians and European settlers rages, a white woman named Mary Ingles is captured by the Shawnee tribe. Led to their camp, Mary meets a companion in misfortune, the Dutch Gretel: together they will try to escape, entering the most dangerous lands of Virginia.

title: La notte dei diavoli
actors: Gianni Garko, Agostina Belli, Mark Roberts, Cinzia De Carolis
description: Nicola discovers what arcane spell transforms the peasants of a rural area into grim living dead. A witch's hand is involved, but no one believes the bizarre truth. Thus Nicola finds himself marginalized by everyone, then locked up in an asylum, where in the grip of delirium he will kill his girlfriend.
notes: Unknown horror by Giorgio Ferroni ("The mill of stone women"), a late Italian Gothic that would have deserved more attention even by fans of the genre. Based on the novel by Tolstoy "I Wurdalak", "The night of the devils" exudes atmospheres like Mario Bava.

title: Diplomatic Siege
actors: Peter Weller, Tom Berenger, Daryl Hannah, Adrian Pintea
description: American agent Steve Mitchell is sent to Bucharest to neutralize a bomb located inside his country's embassy. To his surprise, Steve discovers that he is joined in this position by Erica Long, his former colleague and ex-girlfriend. The risks increase when a commando of Serbian terrorists attacks the embassy and takes the entire staff hostage. While Erica and Steve manage to escape, the man's 14-year-old son remains in the hands of the criminals.
notes: A good cast does not save a film that should make tension its trump card.

title: A Hole in the Head
actors: Frank Sinatra, Edward G. Robinson, Eleanor Parker, Eddie Hodges
description: Tony spends his life in a Miami hotel living with pipe dreams. Mario and his sister-in-law Sophie come from New York with the intention of making him settle down and convince him to entrust his son to them.
notes: Capra's penultimate film is a bitter comedy about the sense of non-belonging and maladjustment. Oscar to the song _High Hopes_.

title: The Pleasure of His Company
actors: Fred Astaire, Debbie Reynolds, Lilli Palmer, Tab Hunter
description: The multi-divorced Biddeford "Pogo" Pool, after twenty years of a reckless and vagrant life, returns to the United States. He learns that Jessica, the daughter he had with his first wife Kate, is about to get married. Pogo is determined to distract her from his project and tries to convince her to follow him on his wanderings around the world. In the course of a lively discussion, Pogo realizes that his daughter is ready to obey him only out of filial piety. Pogo, aware that the time of youthful follies is over, gives up destroying his daughter's future.
notes: Slightly stale comedy backed up by a good cast.

title: Un angelo per Satana
actors: Barbara Steele, Anthony Steffen, Ursula Davis, Aldo Berti, Mario Brega
description: Recently visiting her uncle, the beautiful Countess Harriet begins to show worrying signs of imbalance: influenced by an ancestor (the witch Belinda, who disappeared in a lake and apparently "reincarnated" in a statue), the girl behaves in a more and more provocative and comes to be stained with horrendous crimes. But actually Harriet ...
notes: Despite a disappointing closure, this film by Mastrocinque - Totò's trusted director, here engaged in an unusual foray into the territories of the Gothic - is kept afloat by the charge of perverse attraction emanating from the English Barbara Steele, long undisputed star of the European horror.

title: Con lui cavalca la morte
actors: Mike Marshall, Andrea Bosic, Helen Chanel, Carole André
description: Idaho Kent, agent of a Pony Express company, must reach Sacramento to deliver important documents that try the offenses committed by Bryan Talbot, candidate for the Senate in competition with Stuart Cooper. Having learned of the imminent arrival of Idaho, Talbot makes him tended an ambush from the band led by Kriss, but without success: the courier is saved, and in a subsequent Kriss attack he ends up leaving the skin. More and more on the grips, Talbot hires an even more numerous gang, while his wife Dolores turns to the former lover Luke Preetiss, called the "professional" ...
notes: "Spaghetti" poor in ideas and means.

title: Dong gong xi gong
actors: Han Si, Hu Jun, Vicki Zhao
description: After a night in a park, a young gay writer, A Lan, is detained by police for questioning. Memories of childhood and first experiences reflect the repression of Chinese society, while in the policeman who questions him the feelings of repulsion and fascination alternate, until they lead to explicit attraction.

title: Cléo de 5 à 7
actors: Corinne Marchand, Antoine Bourseiller, José-Luis De Villalonga
description: A singer is waiting for a report, sure she is very ill. Suddenly, in her life as a selfish and spoiled girl, a new emotion creeps in that opens her eyes: the fear of death. That day she also notices a lot of things, which she hadn't paid attention to before.

title: The Lady Eve
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, Henry Fonda, Charles Coburn, Eugene Pallette
description: On an ocean liner, a naive young millionaire falls into the trap set by a professional cheater and his beautiful daughter Jean. But the situation becomes complicated when the girl really falls in love with the victim. When the millionaire discovers the truth, he leaves Jean who transforms into the aristocratic Lady Eve to win him back.

title: Devil in the Flesh
actors: Rose McGowan, Alex McArthur, Peg Shirley, Sherrie Rose
description: High school student Debbie lives with her grandmother after losing her mother and her new partner in a fire. The relationship with the grandmother, bigoted and indifferent, is impossible from the first day. Debbie lives a kind of double life to escape her control, and when her grandmother unmasks her, she doesn't hesitate to kill her.
notes: Inspired by a dramatically true fact, "The Charm of Evil" is a television-based film (but with some decidedly "strong" scenes for the genre) that wisely chooses not to make judgments and not to fall into moralistic rhetoric. The proof of the protagonists is convincing.

title: Cecil B. DeMented
actors: Melanie Griffith, Stephen Dorff, Alicia Witt, Adrian Grenier
description: Cecil B. DeMented is an underground filmmaker who enacts the kidnapping of a spoiled celebrity star while previewing his film in Baltimore. With the help of a handful of cinematographers and actors who defines himself as "expired emulsions", Cecil kidnaps Honey Whitlock and little by little convinces her to participate in his film, a continuous terrorist raid aimed at sabotaging icons and representatives of commercial cinema. even at the cost of life itself.
notes: The "old" John Waters, for years the undisputed master of bad taste, does not stop roaring and stages the metaphor of his activity as a Hollywood terrorist. A reality cinema that fights against the dull and soporific one conveyed by films like "Patch Adams" and "Forrest Gump", sonorously sbertucciati. Funny and with sometimes brilliant jokes, Waters talks about himself and his history as a film guerrilla who, with the help of fellow travelers like Divine, has put a strain on the "way of life" served up by Hollywood. Even if we prefer the "odorama" originals to the metaphor, with their unforgettable and revolting freaks, there is no doubt that Waters remains one of the most caustic talents in Hollywood.

title: Whipped
actors: Amanda Peet, Brian Van Holt, Jonathan Abrahams, Judah Domke
description: Four friends at the bar - three single and one unhappily married - tell each other about their problems with women. The habit drags on wearily until the three bachelors find love: but the object of desire is the girl herself, who, moreover, has concocted the perfidious joke to mortify the narrow male chauvinism of the trio ...
notes: Involved in skits that plague the Farrelly brothers' dementia (like when clumsy Jonathan tries to retrieve a crazed vibrator that ended up in the toilet), the characters tediously venture through the sentimental-sexual stereotypes of a group of teens unable to grow up. Too bad for the cute Amanda Peet.

title: Tesis
actors: Ana Torrent, Fele Martinez, Eduardo Noriega, Rosa Campillo
description: Angela chose the topic of her graduation thesis: violence in cinema. Among the material to be studied there is also a videotape showing the torture suffered by a girl. What if it's not fiction? On the trail of the victim, Angela discovers what a snuff movie is.
notes: It is not a perfect film. Here and there the cinephilia of the young director, in his first work, takes precedence over the rigor of the story. However, there is a healthy passion and the desire to build suspense with the camera and not with the splatter effects. To haunt Angela, more than the murderous videomakers, are the ghosts of the staging.

title: Ready to Rumble
actors: David Arquette, Oliver Platt, Scott Caan, Bill Goldberg, Rose McGowan
description: Jimmy "The Crow" King is a wrestling champion, famous for his "final blow": a true king of the ring, complete with a crown. One day, however, a fight at the prestigious WCW (a kind of world championship) goes wrong, and soon after Jimmy disappears into thin air. Two fans, Gordie and Sean, decide to go on his trail: but when they find him, only a pale memory of the idol they knew remains ...
notes: Poised between comedy and melodrama, the film portrays a world of losers who, however, somehow manage not to succumb completely. Platt is likeable, but definitely out of place in the role of champion.

title: Tomcats
actors: Shannon Elizabeth, Jerry O'Connell, Jake Busey, Horatio Sanz
description: The big cats of the title are five zany Californian bachelors. They bet that the last one to be single will take the money that everyone has been pouring into investment funds for years. The money becomes a nice nest egg, and the contenders are left in two. One, Mike, is in the hands of loan sharks, and to save himself he decides to find a wife for the other, Kyle.
notes: This is yet another attempt at a demented cool-slut following in the footsteps of the Farrelly brothers. Even if the female lead is the same as in "Scary Movie", we are at levels of absolute flatness. The main gag is the chase of a testicle in the corridors of a hospital.

title: Say It Isn't So
actors: Heather Graham, Chris Klein, Orlando Jones, Richard Jenkins, Sally Field
description: Gilly falls madly in love with Jo, who seems to have all the characteristics to be the woman destined to live with him. But there is a surprise lurking: six months pass and Gilly discovers that Jo could be her sister! At this point, Gilly has nothing left but to escape the city to try to escape the incestuous relationship. Some time later, when Gilly learns that Jo is not her sister and that she is getting married, she leaves to try to resolve the complicated situation ...
notes: The film ends up in a kind of episode of any American sitcom, complete with a performance of second-row starlets.

title: Replicant
actors: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Michael Rooker, Ian Robison, Catherine Dent
description: The police are trying to catch a dangerous, violent and ruthless serial killer who is terrorizing the city. Two scientists coordinated by the police come up with an idea: to create a clone to team up with two agents and be able to predict their moves.
notes: Five years after "Maximun Risk", Ringo Lam, one of the masters of the Hong Kong action movie, throws himself back into the clutches of Jean-Claude Van Damme, who gives him an unlikely "vehicle". The film is softer than expected, without even the breathtaking beginning and ending that might be expected. Even the flashback and slow-motion baroque appearances seem like a parody of a style.

title: Urban Legends: Final Cut
actors: Jennifer Morrison, Matthew Davis, Hart Bochner, Loretta Devine
description: A group of students is attending a university course in an institution with questionable architecture, but with a prestigious name: Orson Welles Complex. A competition is held in the school. Whoever makes the best film among the students will win the Alfred Hitchcock award. Amy decides to shoot a film based on some particularly brutal urban legends. It happens that several members of the troupe become victims of a murderer. Amy decides to investigate ...
notes: Jealousies, frustrations, rivalry between Hollywood scions and possible future talents, contract anxiety to shoot two or three films, heinous murders between screams and smiles: the film is undecided between two lines, that of "Scream" and that of of "Scary Movie".

title: Henry Fool
actors: Thomas Jay Ryan, James Urbaniak, Parker Posey, Maria Porter
description: Simon works as a garbage man and lives with several problems. The mother who lives with him is constantly depressed. Simon is a man who has learned to observe from his little corner (his "humble but honest" job) the world and its bewildered, crazy characters who casually or not rotate around his street intellectual glasses. The meeting with Henry, an anarchist intellectual upsets his life. The latter convinces him to pursue a career as a writer.
notes: Hartley likes these games made with people as if they were pawns in an ideal chessboard of destiny, and they often come out well. The irony is very subtle, the direction unbearable (in the good sense) and the performers functional to the transversal paths. To report the incredible similarity of the protagonist, Thomas Jay Ryan, with Silvio Soldini: practically his double. The serene air of independent cinema gives birth without dramas or caesareans.

title: Un delitto impossibile
actors: Carlo Cecchi, Angela Molina, Ivano Marescotti, Lino Capolicchio
description: Piero, magistrate of the court of Palermo, is called to investigate a murder. A judge of the Sassari court died of poisoning after drinking a cup of coffee. The investigations immediately turned out to be very complex. It turns out that the deceased was having an affair with a colleague married to a president of the Court of Appeal. Not only was he very close to a sister who committed suicide and was involved in unclean traffic.
notes: Antonello Grimaldi has always had more passion for the problems of staging than for author's rams. He is more attentive to the mechanisms and joints of the story than to the random temptations of a poetic. A well-constructed storyline is a worldview, while a worldview is not enough to support and justify a storyline. The film, freely based on the novel "Procedure" by Salvatore Mannuzzu, is an excellent confirmation of the director's skills and his idea of ??cinema. The first is the hypercoded and connoted one of the yellow, the second territory touches the biography of Grimaldi who frames his land with his camera, life in a provincial town, the empty enchantment of the island's nature. The procedure of an investigation, even if it eludes the right steps and does not believe in too simple motives, tests the men and women encountered on their path. The truth of a murder strips away other approximate and convenient truths and, often, does not help to understand where one has been. The actors are very good. Times, atmospheres, lights, staging are sober and complete.

title: L'incorrigible
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Geneviève Bujold, Capucine, Andréa Ferréol
description: Fresh out of the jail, the light-hearted Victor Vautier is animated by an uncontrollable energy: always in constant movement, changing his name and appearances and is constitutionally unable to tell the truth. What's more, his fixed idea is to make enough money to build a protective wall around Mont-Saint-Michel! Social worker Marie-Charlotte intrigues him: but when Victor discovers that his parents are the curators of the Senlus museum, the temptation to use her to get hold of a very precious triptych by El Greco is irresistible ...
notes: A film so-so, totally inscribed in the cliché of Bébel- "nice rogue".

title: Vigili e vigilesse
actors: Andy Luotto, Giorgio Bracardi, Stella Carnacina, Raf Luca
description: Police officers from various Italian municipalities arrive in Rome to follow a preparation course for a study trip to London. Various adventures intertwine in the hotel where they are staying. Nieddu would like to take advantage of his stay to meet Ornella Muti, but falls in love with the actress's waiter's sister-in-law. Two Sicilian voyeurs are sent home by a strange commissioner. A Romagna discovers that the woman he is in love with is a transvestite. The beautiful Miryam harassed by her mother by telephone falls in love with a clumsy colleague.
notes: Depressing movie that causes more yawns than laughter.

title: Sonora
actors: George Martin, Gilbert Roland, Jack Elam, Rosalba Neri
description: The gunslinger Sartana and Kirchner a bounty hunter go after Slim's gang. The bandits were responsible for the kidnapping of the girl from Sartana. When the two run into Slim's men they engage in a violent gunfight.
notes: Western with a too obvious subject.

title: The Danger Zone
actors: Jamie Ferreira, Kriss Braxton, Teresa Truesdale, Mickey Elders
description: Heading to Las Vegas to take part in a singing competition, six girls are stranded in their car and are forced to walk towards a city they see in the distance. Obviously they cannot know that there is a gang of motorcyclists and drug traffickers ...
notes: Originality in minimal doses.

title: Octopus
actors: Jay Harrington, Ravil Isyanov, David Beecroft, Carolyn Lowery
description: To reach the place where he will be tried, a terrorist is boarded on a submarine. During the voyage, the vessel must cross the "Devil's Eye", a stretch of sea in which several ships have disappeared: and it is here that the crew is attacked by a prehistoric octopus ...

title: The Plainsman
actors: Don Murray, Guy Stockwell, Abby Dalton, Leslie Nielsen
description: Wild Bill Hickok is attacked by the Red Indians and is saved only thanks to the intervention of his old friend Black Bison. During the attack he realizes that the Indians have firearms recently supplied to the Unionist army.
notes: Weak remake of Cecil B. DeMille's "Conquest of the West".

title: The Last of the Fast Guns
actors: Linda Cristal, Jock Mahoney, Gilbert Roland, Eduard Franz
description: John, a wealthy breeder, entrusts Brad with the task of tracking down his brother, who fled to Mexico years earlier, the only heir to an immense fortune. During the journey Brad meets a rich landowner who offers to help him in the difficult search.
notes: Western trying to escape the usual clichés. Good music.

title: Le due orfanelle
actors: Myriam Bru, Milly Vitale, Franco Interlenghi, André Luguet
description: On the threshold of the Revolution, two Parisian adoptive sisters - Enrichetta and Luisa Girard - have to face the hardships of life. The first is kidnapped by a perfidious noble and jealous of his nephew, the second, blind, is exploited and forced to beg by a slut.
notes: After the great Griffith (1922), Maurice Tourneur (1933) and Carmine Gallone (1942), Gentilomo also tries his hand at one of the most famous teardrop classics of all time, the novel _Le due orfanelle_ by Adolphe-Philippe d'Ennery and Eugène Cormon. The result, even without being up to par with its predecessors, is still decent.

title: The Ranger, the Cook and a Hole in the Sky
actors: Sam Elliott, Jerry O'Connell, Ricky Jay, Molly Parker
description: Mac is a teenager who gets a job with the Montana Forest Service shortly after the end of the First World War. With the help of veteran ranger Bill Bell, Mac begins his journey of knowledge of nature and - more generally - of the world. Based on an autobiographical novel by Norman Maclean.

title: Flaming Creatures
actors: Joel Markman, Mario Montez
description: Among the most secluded filmmakers of the New American Cinema of the 60s and 70s, the eccentric New Yorker Jack Smith must undoubtedly be counted: a figure hardly reducible to schemes and models, "underground" - in the fullest sense of the term - both in art and in life. And this film is one of his most poetic and dazzling works.

title: Mississippi Blues
description: Chronicle of the journey undertaken by the two directors in the heart of the rural South of the United States, in search of the spirit that animates its sounds. Particular attention goes to the legacy of writers such as William Faulkner, the role of churches and pastors, and the vibrant vocal mixes of the gospel.
notes: Bertrand Tavernier's passion for African-American music is well known, especially after the moving _'Round Midnight_. Two years prior to that film, the Lyon director and his senior colleague Robert Parrish had explored the regions where the roots of the blues sink deepest: a slow, melancholy immersion into a past that is still alive.

title: Alcool
description: Alcoholism reaps its victims indiscriminately, in all social strata. On the ridge between documentary and fiction, the director of "The Power" gives depth to all the sarcastic and biting spirit that distinguishes him by describing the consequences - often grotesque - of addiction to this authentic legalized drug.

title: La donzelletta
actors: Costanza Bonarelli, Piero Lipani
description: Anna is a young drug addict who loves reading Leopardi and Homer. Tired of life in a small village on the Madonie, she leaves the village to go and live in Palermo with Pino, a drug dealer. After the latter is arrested and incarcerated, Anna returns to the village and decides to stop shooting herself ...

title: Panni sporchi
description: A winter day at Milan Central Station: the camera captures the words and faces of porters, maneuvers, travelers, stoned, prostitutes ... On the same places as "Lost Objects", Bertolucci jr. he shoots this portrait - involved and detached at the same time - of the various humanity that lives between stairways and waiting rooms.

title: Sand Trap
actors: David John Jones, Brad Koepenick, Elizabeth Morehead, Bob Thompson
description: Nelson Yeager certainly does not imagine that his beloved wife Margo - in collusion with friend Jack Greeley - plots to eliminate him, so that he can then collect the insurance policy. After failing the first attempt, Margo and Jack try again in a remote place outside the city: Rancho Verde, on the edge of the desert.

title: Il ficcanaso
actors: Pippo Franco, Edwige Fenech, Pino Caruso, Luc Merenda, Laura Troschel
description: Luciano is in love with Susanna. The girl returns her feelings because she is convinced that Luciano is able to foresee things before they happen. To the young man who has no powers, from time to time, a Guardian Angel appears who foretells him things that will promptly come true.
notes: Pretty obvious comic thriller.

title: Prince of Central Park
actors: Danny Aiello, Harvey Keitel, Kathleen Turner, Cathy Moriarty
description: A boy decides to track down his mother, who he hasn't heard of for some time. After settling in a tent in the middle of Central Park, he meets a group of very strange and original people that he never imagined meeting ...
notes: The film is really bad. Sorry because the cast is really good.

title: La nave delle donne maledette
actors: Kerima, Ettore Manni, Tania Weber, May Britt, Elvy Lissiak
description: Isabella, the wife of a high dignitary of the kingdom of Spain, was guilty of infanticide. To avoid the scandal, the relatives induce cousin Consuelo to accuse herself of the crime. On the ship that is taking her into exile, there is a lawyer determined to prove her innocence.
notes: Matarazzo's first color film.

title: Nero veneziano
actors: Renato Cestié, Rena Niehaus, Yorgo Voyagis, Fabio Gamma
description: The orphans Christine and the fourteen year old Mark, after the death of their grandmother, find hospitality at the pension that their maternal uncles have on Giudecca. The little boy is subject to visions in the course of which he is sure to see the Devil everywhere. When his maternal uncles, a girlfriend of the boy and the sculptor who married Christine die tragically, Mark is sure that the Prince of Evil has something to do with it. Mark's visions continue unabated and have as their subject Dan, the new guest of the pension. Then inexplicably and curiously Christine becomes pregnant.
notes: Good scenes of the Niehaus courted by the Devil.

title: The Cimarron Kid
actors: Audie Murphy, Yvette Duguay, Beverly Tyler, John Hudson
description: Kid was arrested for helping Dalton gang bandits. Released, the cowboy is unjustly blamed for a robbery committed by Dalton's men. Kid, upon the death of the gang leader, joins the outlaws. Boetticher's first western, master of the B movie. Good performance from Murphy.
