title: Hooper
actors: Burt Reynolds, Jan-Michael Vincent, Brian Keith, Sally Field
description: Sonny Hooper has been the undisputed king of stunt performers who are busy on sets in Hollywood for several years. Sonny has long lived with Gwen, daughter of the elderly stunt Jocko. Ski, a very brave young man is determined to take his place away. For Sonny it's not a great time because, with a sore back, he is forced to undergo medical treatment. Driven by pride, he makes a proposal to Max, his friend and production manager: to fly over a hundred meters with a machine prepared for the occasion.
notes: Hal Needham pays homage to the most dangerous profession in the film world. Brian Keith is Elder Jocko.

title: Un hombre y un colt
actors: Robert Hundar, Fernando Sancho, Gloria Milland, Mirko Ellis, Marta Reves, Jacinto Martín, Paco Morán, Félix Dafauce
description: Gunman Joe Dakota was hired by a landowner to kill a doctor. Before putting his hand to the gun, Joe discovers that the doctor is a fervent supporter of Emiliano Zapata's revolution. The cowboy doesn't take long to go over to the side of the rebels.
notes: Poor Western.

title: Bill il taciturno
actors: George Eastman, Liana Orfei, Peter Hellman, Edwin G. Ross
description: Bill, a cowboy who happened to witness the assault of a caravan of settlers by a gang of Mexicans, manages to rescue a young widow: together the two arrive at the headquarters of Thompson, the murderer of the husband of the woman...
notes: Cheesy spaghetti-western, shot for little money and in just two weeks.

title: Scam
actors: Christopher Walken, Lorraine Bracco, Miguel Ferrer, Martin Donovan
description: Maggie Rohrer has a particular ability to trick and drug men to rob them of all their belongings. The delinquent does not work alone, but is supported by her violent boyfriend. Jack Shanks sets his sights on her and plans to involve her in a big scam.
notes: Enjoyable erotic thriller.

title: Wanted Sabata
actors: Brad Harris, Vassili Karis, Elena Pedemonte, Gino Lavagetto
description: Jim, a bounty killer, kills the owner's brother while on Sabata's ranch. His aim is to get Sabata to blame by taking him out of circulation. The gunman is sentenced to hang. Fortunately, there are those who think of having him escape.
notes: Well-known plot and weak direction, indeed very weak.

title: D3: The Mighty Ducks
actors: Emilio Estevez, Jeffrey Nordling, David Selby, Heidi Kling, Joshua Jackson, Joss Ackland, Elden Henson, Marguerite Moreau, Michael Cudlitz, Garette Ratliff Henson
description: The Ducks, a deranged ice hockey team, have earned their laurels thanks to the tenacity of their coach. Thanks to their skill they have won a scholarship to attend the Eden Hall Academy where they will be challenged by the haughty high school team.
notes: The film gave rise to a TV series.

title: Monkeybone
actors: Brendan Fraser, Bridget Fonda, Chris Kattan, Giancarlo Esposito
description: Stu Miley, a brilliant cartoonist who achieved success creating the character of the monkey Monkeybone, is in love with Julie and is about to marry her when she suffers a trivial accident and goes into a coma. Thus he finds himself trapped in Morfeolandia, a resting place between the world of the living and that of the deceased; but Monkeybone, with a ruse, manages to return to Earth in his place ...
notes: The "Burtonian" Selick is inspired by the comic "Dark Town" and fires an interesting vision of the dream dimension, technically very sophisticated and not without a tasty psycho-sexual subtext (later widely "scissored" by the production).

title: Trixie
actors: Emily Watson, Dermot Mulroney, Nick Nolte, Nathan Lane
description: A bowling ball caught on her head when she was a child messed up Trixie's vocabulary by slowing her reflexes. This does not prevent her from being a security guard, first in a supermarket and then in a provincial casino. The sociopathic world Trixie moves into resembles her fogged, out-of-phase head. You can meet an entertainer out of jail, a temporary love affair with the clumsy factotum of a building speculator, a corrupt senator and an ambiguous bar girl.
notes: The faith in the actors and in the premises of the two "genres" juxtaposed in the plot (the Screwball and the noir) is resolved in an incomplete, lacking film, in pure Rudolph style.

title: Exit in Red
actors: Mickey Rourke, Annabel Schofield, Carré Otis, Anthony Michael Hall
description: Luca is only twenty-three years old and has a passion for grunge music. Camilla is a girl of good society enrolled in the law and with a secret dream, to become a constitutionalist. One night the two boys meet and, despite being the opposite of the other, they fall in love. Seven years later they are in crisis. A psychologist suggests therapy for them.
notes: The start is sprint, but shortness of breath does not even reach halfway. The performers are good, but the film doesn't bite like (perhaps) the authors aspired.

title: Un altr'anno e poi cresco
actors: Federico Di Cicilia, Gabriele Mainetti, Novello Novelli, Paola Cortellesi
description: Faustino is a young unemployed hypochondriac. Since his parents died in the house explosion, he has been stationed in the emergency room to be ready in case of discomfort. He meets a beautiful, independent woman, single with a daughter, and should finally make up her mind to grow up.
notes: As director and screenwriter Federico Di Cicilia orchestrates a couple of other pairs of characters around the central story, but he has no breath to handle even one, and indulges in some awkward surreal interlude and "creative" dubbing hazards. As an actor, he should be holding the film all over his shoulders, but all he does is talk to himself.

title: When Brendan Met Trudy
actors: Peter McDonald, Flora Montgomery, Marie Mullen, Pauline McLynn
description: Brendan, teacher and cinephile, is a loser; with women, then, it is a real catastrophe, at least until the meeting with the uninhibited Trudy changes his life dramatically. For her he will also be forced to quarrel with the very bourgeois family; but later, when it turns out that Trudy - in spite of the Irish economic boom - earns her living as a thief ...
notes: Written and produced by Roddy Doyle (from whose books films like _The Snapper_ and _Commitments_ were taken), a thin but not unpleasant mockery of cinephile manias. The actors are quite effective, but the two narrative plots of the film remain glued to the least worst.

title: The Closer You Get
actors: Ian Hart, Sean McGinley, Niamh Cusack, Britta Smith, Cathleen Bradley
description: While Father Hubert Mallone is giving the usual Sunday sermon, the postman delivers the most important film of the month for the inhabitants of a small town in Donegal: "10" by Blake Edwards. However, the screening is interrupted by Mrs. Duncannon, and the men have nothing to do but take refuge in Pat's bar, also because there are no beautiful women around to woo. Unknowingly, the young Siobhan suggests an idea: to place an ad in the newspaper ...
notes: Ritchie's pleasant and harmless first work belongs to the "micro-genre" that describes the province as a stage for curious adventures, painted in faint shades of pale pink.

title: Evolution
actors: David Duchovny, Orlando Jones, Julianne Moore, Dan Aykroyd
description: A disgraced scientist and a geologist discover in a meteorite the essence that regulated evolution on (and on) Earth. The rock unleashes mutant monsters that alarm the governor of the state and the usual stupid military. A beautiful doctor also enters the scene: she will be the one to help the two men of science in their rescue.
notes: Reitman thinks of 1950s science fiction, but does not realize that the tastes of Generation X (Files) have changed. Fracassone, full of banal, exaggeratedly scatological gimmicks, the film doesn't even manage to disguise its real raison d'etre: to advertise a famous brand of shampoo.

title: Pearl Harbor
actors: Ben Affleck, Josh Hartnett, Kate Beckinsale, Alec Baldwin, Tom Sizemore, Cuba Gooding jr., Jon Voight, Colm Feore, Jennifer Garner, Mako, Sara Rue, Jaime King, Matthew Davis, Ewen Bremner, William Lee Scott, Michael Shannon, Leland Orser
description: December 1941, Admiral Yamamoto's planes launch the deadly attack on ships and armed forces based in Pearl Harbor. Rafe and Danny, two pilots who grew up together and who learned to fly by driving airplanes to irrigate fields, see their solid friendship put to the test. In fact, both are in love with the same woman, a nurse.
notes: The disreputable couple formed by producer Jerry Bruckheimer and coachbuilder director Michael Bay launches a treacherous attack on a fundamental chapter of the American imagination with a pompous, very long film with more devastating jokes than the bombs that rain from computers and with characters without nuances. The film won an Oscar for Best Sound Effects.

title: Leo the Last
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Billie Whitelaw, Calvin Lockhart, Glenna Forster-Jones, Graham Crowden, Gwen Ffrangcon Davies, David de Keyser, Vladek Sheybal, Keefe West
description: Dethroned by a socialist revolution, Leone is sheltered in London. Uprooted and disoriented, the man explores the new environment and little by little he realizes that the building in which he lives is located in the center of a poor neighborhood, inhabited mainly by blacks. Trying to be helpful, Leo makes contact with the people he meets, but they remain wary and, moreover, in the family they begin to doubt his sanity.
notes: Leone scrutinizes his neighbors from afar, with his ornithologist's telescope: ultimately this is the moral of the Boormanian apologue, whose ironic and suspended figure is well supported by the national Marcello.

title: Sous les toits de Paris
actors: Albert Préjean, Pola Illery, Gaston Modot, Edmond T. Gréville
description: Albert, a singer who performs on the street, arrested for a theft he did not commit, gets into a fight with his best friend who took the woman away from him. Eventually she realizes that the man really loves her and decides to let her friend go free.

title: La monaca di Monza
actors: Giovanna Ralli, Gabriele Ferzetti, Lilla Brignone, Elisa Cegani
description: Virginia de Leyva, daughter of the Spanish feudal lord of Monza, is forced to take vows from her father: the nobleman wants the family inheritance to go to the only male offspring. Virginia, who became vicarious nun, proves to be very severe towards her pupils. One day, he surprises a girl in conversation with Gianpaolo Osio and asks the abbess to take action against him. Osio, madly in love with Virginia, begins to court her: after trying in vain to resist, the nun gives in to her offers ...
notes: The events of the famous Manzoni nun are taken from a novel by Giovanni Rosini.

title: A Woman's Vengeance
actors: Charles Boyer, Ann Blyth, Jessica Tandy, Cedric Hardwicke
description: The womanizer Henry is married to Emily, an invalid woman. Their married life is ruined by quarrels. One day Emily is found dead. A few months pass and a nurse files a complaint against Henry: the woman would have been poisoned.
notes: Direction just enough, but the suspense is not lacking.

title: Winchester '73
actors: James Stewart, Shelley Winters, Dan Duryea, Stephen McNally
description: Lonely Lin McAdam arrives in Dodge City to participate in a shooting competition whose stakes are the prized shotgun of the title. His main opponent is Dutch Brown, towards whom Lin has an inexplicable hatred. McAdam wins, but the Winchester is stolen from him and has since gone through different hands. Lin does not give up, however, and in the end it will also shed light on the reasons for the hatred that opposes him to Dutch.
notes: Sparse, essential, full of psychological and even biblical resonances: Mann shoots one of the most innovative and decisive westerns in the history of cinema, embellished with the splendid black and white of William Daniels and a gigantic Stewart.

title: Black Jack
actors: Rik Battaglia, Robert Woods, Lucienne Bridou, Nino Fuscagni
description: Jack Murphy and his men, having landed a bank robbery in Tucson City, reunite to divide up the spoils. But Jack, not wanting to split the money equally with his men, in the company of his sister Estelle and her husband Peter, takes refuge in an abandoned country.
notes: Very little spaghetti western.

title: Taksi-Blyuz
actors: Piotr Mamonov, Piotr Zajtchenko, Vladimir Kashpur, Natalja Koljakanova
description: Ivan is a taxi driver in a Moscow now saturated with post-Wall "Westernizing" flattery: a hard worker, hard on the verge of brutality, already nostalgic for the "certainties" that governed life under the fallen regime. One night on his car mounts Liosha, irresponsible, alcoholic and saxophonist, who leaves him in the lurch without paying: it is the beginning of a relationship steeped in affection, hatred and envy, with unexpected results ...
notes: Lungin makes his debut with a chaotic, vital and uneven film, a faithful mirror of the capital of the former Soviet giant. Stimulating, even if the contrast between old and new Russia is not exempt from schematisms.

title: La gran vida
actors: Carmelo Gomez, Salma Hayek, Fernando Valverde, Alicia Agut
description: For Martin, the thirty -year -old crisis arrives violent: the existence, marked by the alienating rhythm of his work, becomes intolerable to him. To put an end to such an indecorous situation, he decides to commit suicide; Before doing this, however, one million dollars for an unforgettable party lends himself to the stoves. The meeting with Lola, a Mexican waitress, makes him change his mind: now the problem is like returning the money to the usurers ...
notes: Written with sobriety and interpreted by a functional cast, Cuadri's first feature film keeps the viewer on the rope until the last, in a fruitful uncertainty, and then culminated in the inevitable final.

title: Black and White
actors: Oliver 'Power' Grant, Robert Downey jr., Jared Leto, Claudia Schiffer
description: Rich has decided to leave the world of crime behind for good; now he has started producing rap groups, which forces him to clash with whites and their habits for the first time. What Rich ignores is that the NYPD inspector is trying to frame him ...
notes: Toback, an excellent scriptwriter and witty mix of situations, above all wants to make fun of the stereotypes through which whites perceive blacks (and vice versa). The bizarre result is to make them all unsightly. Mike Tyson plays himself, and the scene where Robert Downey jr. he approaches it is from anthology.

title: La faute à Voltaire
actors: Sami Bouajila, Elodie Bouchez, Bruno Lochet, Aure Atika
description: Jallel, a Tunisian illegal immigrant in Paris, passes himself off as an Algerian refugee. He knows a beautiful "beur" which, however, plants him at the altar. Jallel then ends up in a psychiatric clinic where he falls in love with a nymphomaniac with whom he tries to rebuild a life.
notes: Once there was "pink neorealism", but this is even more pink. Perfect skirmishes for a Sautet, only transposed into a marginal environment. The director does not seem to have much gaze, and makes a rather cynical use of the actors. If the Bouchez is sacrificed, the protagonist Bouajila has a nice air, the beur Aure Atika is a short overwhelming presence.

title: Drôle de Félix
actors: Sami Bouajila, Ariane Ascaride, Patachou, Pierre-Loup Rajot, Charly Sergue, Maurice Bénichou, Philippe Graziano
description: One day Félix, unemployed, Arab, HIV-positive and homosexual, decides to realize an old dream: to go to Marseille to meet his father. The boy, who lives in Dieppe, has a romantic conception of life that leads him to choose secondary roads. Félix chooses to reach the city overlooking the Mediterranean by hitchhiking. During the journey, Félix ends up building an ideal family for himself.
notes: The two directors, Ducastel and Martineau, mark the days and the unwritten diary of the journey that may never end and which fortunately is not a false movement with a series of meetings. Natural and human landscapes of this lesser world are integrated while Félix is ??on a journey.

title: Delivering Milo
actors: Albert Finney, Anton Yelchin, Campbell Scott, Bridget Fonda
description: Up there, in the paradise of the unborn, Milo is waiting for his turn to come into the world. The little being, unlike his "colleagues", does not want to leave the comfort of his place to go down to Earth. It will be up to Elmore Dahl, his reluctant guardian angel, to try to convince him that on our planet, after all, life is not that bad.
notes: The good soul of Frank Capra turns in the grave for this sort of plagiarism of _Life is wonderful_ with New Age sprinkles. The vision of the earthly paradise seems to be the dream of a Nazi housewife from Illinois (the children to be born are all clean, healthy and in uniform).

title: Una noche con Sabrina Love
actors: Cecilia Roth, Tomas Fonzi, Giancarlo Giannini, Fabian Vena, Norma Aleandro
description: Daniel is seventeen, lives with his family in a small Argentine town and is bored with a job that doesn't excite him. He spends his free time like all his peers, watching the people passing by in the town square. When he gets home, all Daniel has to do is hang on to the TV and watch the show of Sabrina Love, the porn star of the moment. One night, however, the teenager is drawn to spend a night in Buenos Aires with Sabrina ...
notes: There are very bad moments (the tirade on photography as the bearer of immortality) and at least one cerebral but enjoyable gimmick (the visit to a porn set).

title: La tua vita per mio figlio
actors: Mario Merola, Antonio Sabato, Maria Fiore, Rik Battaglia
description: Former mobster Francesco Accardo left his city to move to Milan where he successfully dedicated himself to trade. The economic tranquility means that Francesco can keep his wife Maria and little son Gennarino without problems. But the serenity in the Accardo house does not last long because the mammasantissima of the family to which Francesco belonged forces him to kill Sante belonging to a rival family. To make the request to Francesco more convincing, Gennarino is kidnapped.
notes: When it comes to Neapolitan drama, Alfonso Brescia knows how to do it. And if there is Mario Merola who helps him!

title: Tarzan and the Amazons
actors: Johnny Weissmuller, Brenda Joyce, Johnny Sheffield, Maria Ouspenskaya
description: Tarzan falls in love with an English girl who has arrived in the heart of Africa following a scientific expedition. The purpose of the mission is to come into contact with tribes unknown to the Western world. The charming scientist and her fellow adventurers are captured by a tribe made up only of women and headed by the queen of the Amazons. The prisoners manage to come to terms with the savages. Men are spared as long as they stay in the jungle forever. Tarzan is forced to intervene.
notes: Johnny Weismuller wears Tarzan for the ninth time. The film had a sequel "Tarzan and the Leopard Woman".

title: Gone Fishin'
actors: Joe Pesci, Danny Glover, Rosanna Arquette, Lynn Whitfield
description: Joe and Gus, close friends and aficionados of lures and reels, are drawn into a Florida fishing trip. During the journey Rita and Angie will join them, and there will be no end of trouble.
notes: Despite the calm atmosphere, one stunt was killed and two others were injured during filming.

title: Clockwatchers
actors: Toni Collette, Parker Posey, Lisa Kudrow, Alanna Ubach
description: Four girls work on a fixed-term contract with Global Credit. Different characters, different aspirations: Margaret is a typical "career girl", but she certainly doesn't kill herself with effort; Paula dreams of Hollywood and poses as a vamp; Iris, more fatalistic, is also well disposed towards newcomers; Jane thinks about marriage and family. But their relationships will change.
notes: Sprecher's debut sums up the characteristics of a certain independent American cinema, capable of maintaining vivacity and expressive freedom without falling into annoying authorial charms. A sparkling comedy about the dullness of office life.

title: White Dog
actors: Kristy McNichol, Paul Winfield, Burl Ives, Jameson Parker
description: Actress Julie Sawyer owns a splendid canine specimen with white fur. What the girl doesn't know is that the animal has been conditioned to turn him into a relentless killer of black people.
notes: Hard and original apologue on racism, written by Fuller and Curtis Hanson on a subject by Romain Gary.

title: Point Blank
actors: Mickey Rourke, Michael Wright, Frederic Forrest, Danny Trejo
description: Seven life sentences sentenced to the gas chamber are loaded onto a bus to be transported to the place where the execution will be held. But they will never reach their destination: in fact, one of the criminals, the insane and ruthless Howard, has prepared a diabolical escape plan. The coup succeeds and the group takes refuge in a shopping center, dictating their requests to the authorities in order to leave the country. Former policeman Rudy Ray, brother of one of Howard's accomplices, finds himself involved in the affair despite himself ...
notes: If Rourke had been given a dollar for every wrong film, he would be a millionaire today.

title: Ground Zero
actors: Janet Gunn, Jack Scalia, Scott Terra, Gloria O'Brien
description: Kimberly, a talented seismologist, moves with her son Justin to the Angeles Forest to study some unusual seismic phenomena more closely. With the help of a mercenary, Michael, he will discover that the earthquakes are caused by the nuclear tests that an arms industry is carrying out in the area ...

title: Attenti a noi due
actors: Nino D'Angelo, Fabrizio Bracconeri, Luigi Attrice, Francesca De Rose
description: Nino left Naples and moved to Rimini, where he took over a pizzeria. The young man is planning to marry Anna. The arrival of Fabrizio, a clumsy investigator, risks ruining the wedding.
notes: D'Angelo is paired with Bracconeri, who achieved popularity with the series _I Ragazzi della III C_.

title: 3 Little Ninjas and the Lost Treasure
actors: Douglas Ivan, Steven Nelson, Jonathan Anzaldo, Alan Godshaw
description: Three little boys passionate about martial arts, find by chance the map of a rich treasure. But the precious parchment is also tempting to other greedy suitors. Our young heroes will be forced to unleash all their magical blows to try and get their hands on the precious loot.
notes: Mediocre Tv movie.

title: Lo chiameremo Andrea
actors: Nino Manfredi, Mariangela Melato, Anna Maria Aragona, Maria Pia Casilio
description: Paolo and Maria, primary school teachers, love each other but are unable to have a child. Tired of being told that it's his fault, Paolo turns to a Swiss specialist. The doctor advises them to lead a healthy and peaceful life, away from stress. Since their home is located near a cement plant, Paolo has an oxygen tent installed in the bedroom and prepares for an exhausting sexual tour de force. Then one day the long-awaited news arrives: Maria is expecting a baby.
notes: De Sica, in the descending parable of his career, depicts a dull subject. The screenplay is written by Zavattini, Benvenuti and De Bernardi.

title: Freddy's Dead: The Final Nightmare
actors: Robert Englund, Lisa Zane, Shon Greenblatt, Lezlie Deane
description: Freddy has returned to inhabit the dreams of his victims. This time it is John who has to defend himself from the insane murderer horribly disfigured and with sharp fingers. The boy in a reform school is busy staying awake by any means to escape Freddy's thirst for blood and revenge. As usual, a psychologist, Maggie, comes to her defense and three other inmates. The woman realizes that if she wants to finally defeat Freddy she will have to face him in the house where it all began.
notes: Penultimate and rather weak episode of the series. Small part for Alice Cooper who plays Freddy's father. Shot in 3D.

title: Guys and Dolls
actors: Marlon Brando, Jean Simmons, Frank Sinatra, Vivian Blaine
description: Nathan, owner of a clandestine gambling hall must find a thousand dollars to set up a gambling den in a garage. To raise the necessary money, he makes a bet with Heaven. The man will have to make the upright Sara, a member of the Salvation Army, fall into his arms. Cielo eventually manages to take Sara on a cruise to Cuba, but at the same time, he discovers that he has fallen in love with her.
notes: Samuel Goldwyn bought the rights to the musical comedy signed by Abe Burrows and Jo Swerling for a million dollars and proposed to Mankiewicz to make a musical. His intent was to give life to a genre. Brando's voice sings "A Woman in Love" in playback.

title: Seconds
actors: Rock Hudson, Salome Jens, John Randolph, Jeff Corey, Murray Hamilton
description: Tony, a wealthy businessman deeply disappointed in his life, is surrounded by a powerful organization which - in exchange for a generous legacy - proposes to him the transformation of his personality. Tony thus becomes a beautiful painter and perfectly inserted in the Californian context of "artists" and "models". Soon, however, the ghosts of the past return ...
notes: Once he accepts the basic unrealism (the ugly and mediocre businessman turns into Rock Hudson!), He plunges into a nightmare with disturbing "political" implications. A great film, which is paired with _Go and kill_ among Frankenheimer's cult. Beautiful black and white photograph by James Wong Howe.

title: La collegiale
actors: Martha Katherin, Nino Castelnuovo, Sofia Dionisio, Femi Benussi
description: Daniela after being locked up in a college for a few years he decided to return to the family. So he discovers that his father worries exclusively about money, his mother thinks only of putting his horns, his aunt is a nymphomaniac and his cousin is a blackma with blackmail. The girl at the beginning is scandalized by the "new" balances within her family. Given the situation to Daniela, all that remains is to go to bed with the gardener and then run away with the new mother's man.
notes: The first work of Gian Antonio Martucci is a curious soft core. In the role of Aunt Ninfomano femi Benussi and there is also Sofia Dionisio, Silvia's sister.

title: Tutto per tutto
actors: Mark Damon, John Ireland, Monica Randall, Armando Calvo
description: Faccia di Rame has stolen four crates full of gold resulting from the assault on the El Paso bank. The Indian, jealous of the relationship between the bandit responsible for the robbery and his squaw, acted in revenge. The desperado and two adventurers set out on his trail.
notes: Good characterization of the characters.

title: Due volte Giuda
actors: Antonio Sabato, Klaus Kinski, Cristina Galbó, Pepe Calvo
description: The gunslinger Luke who has become forgetful following a head wound is given the task of eliminating Dingus, an individual he has never seen. By mistake he kills the principal. Only later does he discover that Dingus had harmed his family.
notes: Good spaghetti western by Nando Cicero.

title: Demolition High
actors: Corey Haim, Alan Thicke, Dick Van Patten, Jeff Kober
description: A group of terrorists, led by the bloodthirsty Luther, takes college students hostage in California. As soon as he arrives from New York, Lenny finds the opportunity to make up for the misunderstandings of teachers and classmates by courageously leading the rescue and helping the authorities to restore order.

title: Melanie Darrow
actors: Delta Burke, Brian Bloom, Christopher Birt, Ralph Small
description: A man is accused of killing his rich wife to inherit the huge fortune. Everyone believes him guilty, even his family, but Melanie Darrrow, an old lawyer friend, convinced of his innocence, wants to prove otherwise.
notes: Actress Delta Burke is the star and producer of the film.

title: Gladiator
actors: Russell Crowe, Joaquin Phoenix, Connie Nielsen, Djimon Hounsou, Oliver Reed
description: Defeated the barbarians in Germany, in 180 AD, the victorious Roman general Maximus is designated by Marcus Aurelius, now old, disappointed and tired, as his successor. But the emperor's son, Commodus, kills his parent and orders Maximus to be eliminated in order to have no rivals in the succession to the imperial throne. Massimo thus becomes the target of a ruthless manhunt that leads to the extermination of his entire family. At first Massimo manages to save himself, but then he is captured and is destined to fight in the arenas as a gladiator. With nothing left to lose, he ends up becoming an invincible warrior.
notes: Scott's film collapses into the black hole of his absent choreographies, stumbles upon the total lack of plastic sense (a crime, with someone like Crowe), confuses the gaze and stuns him with the roar of duels but never involves. The English director is interested in backlighting, curtains, overlays and digital imagery. We have nothing against computer graphics and we don't mind its dark, sci-fi, volume-less Rome. This is serious. But when the camera descends into the arena with Massimo, it is unable to remain implanted in the dust. In the midst of the luminescence of a halogen cinema, however, all the actors stand out: Russell Crowe, Joaquin Phoenix, Connie Nielsen herself. Five Oscars (out of twelve nominations): to the film, the lead actor, the costumes, the sound and the visual effects.

title: Tarzan and the Huntress
actors: Johnny Weissmuller, Brenda Joyce, Johnny Sheffield, Patricia Morison
description: Some hunters go to the jungle to hunt large numbers of wild animals. The indigenous king allows them to capture a male and a female for each species. The poachers are not satisfied and have the old king killed. Tarzan intervenes.
notes: Weissmuller's penultimate appearance as Tarzan.

title: Pillars of the Sky
actors: Jeff Chandler, Dorothy Malone, Ward Bond, Keith Andes
description: The construction of a fort and a road on the territories sacred to the Indians provokes the rebellion of the Indians. Ignoring the advice of Sergeant Emmett, Colonel Stedlow implements the established plans. Waiting for him at the gate was the Indian chief Kamiakin.
notes: Undoubtedly spectacular qualities for a minor western.

title: I due violenti
actors: Alan Scott, George Martin, Susy Andersen, Mary Badmayer
description: Cassidy, accused of murder, escaped from jail. The ranger Logan, a friend of the wanted man, manages to capture him: during the return journey, the two are attacked by a band of cattle thieves. Taking advantage of the confusion, Cassidy makes him lose track ...
notes: An absolutely routine "spaghetti".

title: Lady in White
actors: Lukas Haas, Len Cariou, Katherine Helmond, Alex Rocco
description: Halloween, 1962. Frankie Scarlatti is jokingly locked up by his classmates in the school locker room. Forced to spend all night waiting for help, he has visions. Melissa appears to him, a murdered girl, under mysterious circumstances, a few years earlier.
notes: Good reconstruction of the environment.

title: Vai gorilla
actors: Fabio Testi, Renzo Palmer, Claudia Marsani, Al Lettieri
description: Marco Sartori is hired by the builder Gaetano Sampioni as a shoulder guard. For some time, in fact, Sampioni has been receiving phone calls through which unknown criminals have tried to extort a large sum of money from him, threatening heavy reprisals that regularly occur after yet another refusal by the entrepreneur. The latter, terrified, now seems on the point of giving up: but Sartori takes the initiative and makes an unexpected move ...
notes: Valerii, former collaborator of Sergio Leone, packs a discreet Italian-style detective story, simple in the plot but supported by a good rhythm and a good lyrics.

title: Shark Attack 2
actors: Thorsten Kaye, Nikita Ager, Daniel Alexander, Danny Keogh
description: Hawaii: Marine biologist Nick West discovers that a few white sharks, made particularly ferocious by an experiment, have been missing during a transfer, and he teams up with Australian veteran Roy and beautiful Samantha to restore tranquility to the coasts.
notes: "Jaws" increasingly toothless.

title: The Prophet's Game
actors: Dennis Hopper, Stephanie Zimbalist, Robert Yocum, Sondra Locke
description: Vincent Swan, the "Prophet", is a retired detective with a personal revenge to do, linked to the death of his daughter in a massacre. His method is rather curious: he moves from city to city and asks his unsuspecting interlocutors some questions. And if the answer is wrong ...
notes: Old Hopper takes the lion's share.

title: Experiment Perilous
actors: Hedy Lamarr, George Brent, Paul Lukas
description: United States, 1903: On a train, Dr. Huntington Bailey meets a strange woman and exchanges a few lines with her. Later, in New York, Bailey learns of the mysterious death of his interlocutor and decides to find out more: through a friend he comes into contact with the relatives of the disappearance, the Bederaux, and cannot help but notice their elusive behavior and neurotic. But the beauty of Alida Bederaux irresistibly attracts him, and when the latter is suspected of having murdered her husband, of whom she was terrified ...
notes: Tourneur tackles, and with good results, the classic theme of the family as a nest of vipers.

title: Diana & Me
actors: Dominic West, Toni Collette, Malcolm Kennard
description: Australian Diana Spencer wins the competition held by a women's magazine that offered a trip to London. In the British capital, Diana hopes to meet her namesake Lady D. To sneak into a party where the Princess of Wales is expected to attend, the girl befriends Rob, a paparazzo on the trail of the royal family.
notes: A harmless and sincere comedy that further humanizes the myth of the princess most loved by the Anglo-Saxons (and not only by them). In the cast, the Australian actress Toni Collette, already appreciated in _The wedding of Muriel_, _The sixth sense_ and _About a Boy_.

title: Flash Frame
actors: Andrew Stevens, Ian Ziering, Katherine Kelly Lang
description: An IT company builds a video game which, by acting on the nervous system of those who enter the program, irremediably compromises the brain system. A videogames inventor, sensing the truth, decides to put an end to the deadly pastime.
notes: The director-interpreter is the son of Stella Stevens. The producer is Roger Corman.

title: No Room for the Groom
actors: Tony Curtis, Piper Laurie, Don DeFore
description: As soon as his bride Lee gets stuck, poor Alvah Morell doesn't even have time to enjoy his honeymoon: in fact, Uncle Sam urgently needs him and the young man is sent to Korea, on one of the hottest fronts of the war. As if that were not enough, an even worse conflict awaits him on his return for a leave: the one with his wife's relatives who have settled in his house.
notes: Unrecognized and brilliant comedy by the great Sirk: the sexophobia, moralism and hypocrisy of American society in the far from exciting 1950s fall into its sights. Curtis is going to a wedding (it should be said ...) in a role that seems cut out especially for him.

title: La casa nel tempo
actors: Keith Van Hoven, Paolo Paoloni, Karina Huff
description: Three boys sneak into a house inhabited by two elderly people, kill them and not happy they even take out the gardener. But the three "resurrect" and sow terror.
notes: Horror sparks from television (but which was only distributed in video), a little watered down in the scares and gore effects.

title: Se vincessi cento milioni
actors: Carlo Campanini, Tino Scotti, Milly Vitale, Andrea Checchi, Ugo Tognazzi
description: Five episodes on the Totocalcio: a woman prevents her husband from going to the stadium, but he asks the neighbor to keep him informed; a model finds, thanks to a win, that her man is already married; two employees rely on the coupons to retaliate against the office manager; a guy looks for a poor pensioner friend of his to tell him that he has made thirteen; the owner of a restaurant hopes to win at "Sisal" to solve business and family problems ...
notes: The Sunday ritual of the ticket - now reduced by now - is the starting point for a mediocre and botched comedy. The moral on the money that gives happiness and on how badly those who do not have it are very easy.

title: My Teacher's Wife
actors: Tia Carrere, Chris McDonald, Jason London, Alexondra Lee
description: Aspiring cartoonist and eager to enroll in Harvard, young Todd Boomer turns to his math teacher Roy Mueller. He later meets Vicky, a gorgeous woman who agrees to tutor him. Obviously Todd is far from insensitive to Vicky's charm, but only later does he realize that it is Roy's wife. But both are fearful of starting a full-blown relationship, which would ruin both Vicky and Roy's marriage and Todd's relationship with his girlfriend Kirsten.
notes: Sentimental plot of little interest. Todd's designs are the work of celebrated designer Bill Plympton.

title: Rosencrantz and Guildenstern Are Dead
actors: Tim Roth, Gary Oldman, Richard Dreyfuss
description: While the sad prince of Denmark struggles on the walls of Elsinore castle, two bizarre characters who respond (alternately?) To the names of Rosencrantz and Guildenstern roam the neighborhood, engaging in specious dialectical exercises. And when the manager comes to court to prepare the play devised by Hamlet, both end up losing - almost unconsciously - the neck.
notes: First (and so far unique) work by the playwright former screenwriter of the "Empire of the Sun", who takes possession of the plot and characters of Shakespearean tragedy to transform them into the pawns of a refined - and at times even irritating - metateatral game.

title: The Midas Touch
actors: Trever O'Brien, Ashley Lyn Cafagna
description: A twelve -year -old boy dreams of having enough money to be able to cure his grandmother, suffering from a heart disease. A mysterious character transforms him into a new King Mida, but it is not said that the possibility of transforming everything into gold is really a blessing ...
notes: Fairy tale with vaguely disturbing implications.

title: Soshun
actors: Chikage Awashima, Ryo Ikebe, Takako Fujino, Keiko Kishi
description: The efforts of the couple to relieve themselves from the tragedy that stole their little son, who died in an accident, provoke a series of conflicts and a sense of emptiness to which the husband reacts through an extramarital affair. The essential style and sensitivity of the Japanese master in an exemplary film.

title: Stephen King's Storm of the Century
actors: Tim Daly, Colm Feore, Deborah Farentino
description: A terrible storm strikes on an island in Maine and the inhabitants risk being isolated. Along with the storm, a strange and mysterious character appears on the island and kills an old lady. His name is André Linoge, and after his arrest he proves to know every little detail of the life of the islanders. When questioned he declares: "Give me what I want, and I will go." 230-minute TV movie (divided into three parts) based on Stephen King's novel of the same name.XXXNERO Second part tomorrow at the same time. The third part on Thursday at the same time

title: Sabrina Goes to Rome
actors: Melissa Joan Hart, Eddie Mills, Tara Strong, James Fields
description: Sabrina arrives in Italy from the United States to visit her father. In Rome, together with the faithful cat Salem, he uses his magical powers to help his parent to solve the complicated family affairs. In Rome he will also find love.
notes: But "Roman Holiday", the truly magical one, has nothing to do with it!

title: A Simply Wish
actors: Martin Short, Kathleen Turner, Amanda Plummer, Robert Pastorelli
description: Murray's cane has infallible magical powers, also for this reason the little Anabel, just eight years old, invokes her help to fulfill her "simple wish": she would like to see her father, a taxi driver, finally happy. And for Dad to be happy Broadway has to give him the lead role in a musical. Unfortunately, Murray's magic stick breaks, also because two witches, Claudia and Boots, decide to make little Anabel's "simple wish" fail.
notes: Polite comedy with an excellent cast: the "witches" Kathleeen Turner and Amanda Plummer are priceless.

title: Amico, stammi lontano almeno un palmo
actors: Giuliano Gemma, George Eastman, Marisa Mell, Luciano Catenacci
description: Just out of jail, Ben finds old friend Charlie, a cheap adventurer who makes ends meet by cheating. The two make common cause, but soon the problems begin ...
notes: Clear parodic intentions for this spaghetti western. Eastman signs the subject and screenplay with his real name (Luigi Montefiori).

title: Torna a Sorrento
actors: Gino Bechi, Adriana Benetti, Aroldo Tieri, Camillo Pilotto
description: The traveling salesman Mario Bianchi casually reads a letter addressed to his namesake, in which a girl declares that she wants to get away from her family, in Sorrento, to move to Rome. Embarrassed, Mario decides to track down the young woman at the station to clear up the misunderstanding, offering to be her guide in the capital and to help her find her boyfriend. The latter, however, seems unavailable, while in the meantime the good Mario shows off unsuspected singing skills that will open the doors of the radio to him: needless to say that everything contributes to the formation of a new couple ...
notes: Naive sentimental-singing tale of yesteryear.

title: Operation Dumbo Drop
actors: Danny Glover, Ray Liotta, Denis Leary, Doug E. Doug
description: During the Vietnam War, the Ho Chi Minh army kills in retaliation the sacred elephant of a village used by the Americans as a base of support. But an important party is approaching and so Captain Sam Cahill sets out on a very special mission: to find another elephant and get it to the village in time.
notes: Nice adventure movie.

title: Three Secrets
actors: Jaclyn Smith, Tyne Daly, Nicole Forester, Katy Boyer
description: Three mothers, forced in the past to give their child up for adoption, find themselves among the rescuers of a plane crash. The only survivor of the frightening collision is an eight-year-old boy. From a series of clues, the three women are convinced that the child in question may be their natural child even if, of course, only one of them will turn out to be the real mother ...
notes: Some American stars of the small screen reunited in this slightly watered-down melodrama, with the tones and colors of a family television novel. Those who appreciate this type of story, however, will not be disappointed.

title: Two Thousand and None
actors: John Turturro, Oleg Kisseliov, Katherine Borowitz, Jayne Heitmeyer
description: Benjamin, a successful paleontologist, American of Armenian origin, has just divorced his wife and discovers that he has a very rare disease, the "Talbot syndrome" whereby the mass of his brain expands indefinitely, leading to loss of memory and certain death. There is no cure, nor does the disease bring pain, so the only thing to do is to resign yourself and live the last month of life in the best possible way. Not a small problem, because instead Benjamin's life begins to be populated by the ghosts of the past, which announce themselves with the hum of an old projector and animate the bottoms of the cups or even the walls of entire buildings.
notes: Director Arto Paragamian, almost a debut, is a Canadian Armenian like Egoyan and knows what he's talking about. Culturally, the film is in the wake of the great American Jewish literature, from Philip Roth to the Canadian Mordecai Richler (or, in the cinema, certain dreamlike results of Woody Allen and Paul Mazursky). The script has a few drops of rhythm and intelligent dialogue, the direction is flightless. The film shows itself above all thanks to an amazing Turturro, on which everything is sewn, and who manages to be toneless, painful, funny and finally quiet. It would have been nice to see it in the original, also because the Italian version seems to have some translation oversights.

title: The Gift
actors: Cate Blanchett, Keanu Reeves, Hilary Swank, Giovanni Ribisi
description: In a small town in Georgia lives Annie Wilson, a woman who sees things that many people could never even imagine: usually glimpses of the future, often linked to violent events. The woman, a widow with offspring, does not abuse her own "gift", on the contrary, she is as patient and introspective as a psychologist with clients. One bad day, however, Annie suggests to the police where to find the body of a murdered girl and then indicates the violent Donnie as the alleged murderer, a young man who more than once has reduced his partner, a friend of Annie's, badly. past had threatened her too. Everything seems clearer, but in reality from that moment Annie sinks into a nightmare with no way out.
notes: Cast of the big deals for this supernatural thriller by Sam Raimi. In reality there seems to be little of the director of _Spider Man_, if not the job of someone who can build a minimum of suspense. The plot and some characters are clearly influenced by the screenwriter Billy Bob Thornton, who already in his remarkable _Lama sharp_ was thinking about the angelic figure of a freak (here played by Giovanni Ribisi). _The Gift_ ensures some pleasant moments, especially because Cate Blanchett renders well the disturbances of the protagonist, her fears in contact with the violence of the real world (which fears her because she is a "witch", except to use them when necessary) and of the supernatural one. However, he gets into the right gear too late and in the first half remains uncertain which way to take. More or less intimate, as Raimi would have liked; more or less horror.

title: Final Fantasy: The Spirits Within
description: 2065: the Earth is exhausted due to an alien invasion. The mysterious creatures, arrived on a meteor, are vampires capable of absorbing energy from any living thing. The charming doctor Aki Ross tries to counter them, combining her medical knowledge and the indications that come to her from enigmatic and recurring dreams. But the dull military hierarchies oppose it.
notes: Sakaguchi tries, between one action scene and another, to pursue a dreamlike and spiritual science fiction like Bradbury, but the confused intertwining is not deceiving: you do not get out of new age banalities. The debt to the video game of the same name - by Sakaguchi himself - is purely nominal and the photorealism of the CGI is already very dated.

title: The Way of the Gun
actors: Ryan Phillippe, Benicio Del Toro, James Caan, Juliette Lewis
description: Two evildoers, Parker and Longbaugh, hope to make the leap with the kidnapping of Robin, a girl who has rented her womb to a rich and shady couple. But professionals are not invented, especially if they are chased by a calm and relentless "cleaner" ...
notes: McQuarrie's debut feature (Oscar for the screenplay of "The Usual Suspects") is a good example of a cinema that is both modern and nostalgic, aware of its mechanisms and ironically metanarrative. The encyclopedic filmic knowledge of the new director substantiates many scenes and many lines: westerns, "crime drama", Tarantino and Rodriguez, but above all Hawks and Peckinpah.

title: Spy Kids
actors: Antonio Banderas, Carla Gugino, Daryl Sabara, Alexa PenaVega, Alan Cumming
description: Juni and Carmen are two suburban kids bored with school and with overly self-righteous parents, they suddenly discover that dad and mom are actually two very feared international superspies. Strange thing, the two have been kidnapped by the bad guys and guess who will have to go and save them? While they are there, Juni and Carmen will also save the world from a horrible machination that involves the use of an army of robots that have the features of the children of the powerful of the Earth.
notes: How do a sanguine desecrator like Robert Rodriguez and an unrepentant seducer like Antonio Banderas, with the sulphurous aura of scandal that always surrounds them, make a perfect family film? Transforming the provocation into joyful chaos, making the colors of the story even more brilliant, without abandoning the black side that kids like so much, and making the irony erupt. Rodriguez is a talented man, capable of cooking a success with two lire ("El mariachi") and of mixing Tarantino and Romero without losing his personality ("From sunset to dawn"). Here he is even a director, screenwriter, producer and editor (thank goodness; he rides like a god, without any of those discomforting television downtime of today); and builds the film on his imaginary: robots and mutants come out of an amusement park sideshow, a lopsided and luxuriant fairytale world that refers to the Seventies, to the "Avengers", to the wildest game of the imagination.

title: Bootmen
actors: Adam Garcia, Sam Worthington, Sophie Lee, William Zappa
description: Australia, New South Wales. Here too globalization is doing its damage and the steel mill is about to close its doors. So Sean decides to devote himself to his passion: tip tap. After successfully trying to work in Sydney for a company of professionals, Sean decides to launch his own show with a completely innovative style right in the abandoned premises of the industrial complex. The project is hampered not only by objective economic problems, but also by the complicated relationship with his brother Mitch, with whom he shares and shares his love for the same woman.
notes: Delicious Australian "teen movie", directed and choreographed by the interesting Dein Perry. It's a simple story, with a hint of love and action and an enthralling post-industrial tap dance that makes you want to dance when you leave the cinema. Objects and places are continually reinvented by Perry's talent, to transform into an innovative musical that would not shame the great Fred Astaire, but on the contrary would make him happy because tip tap in the cinema, despite everything, still survives.

title: There's Only One Jimmy Grimble
actors: Robert Carlyle, Ray Winstone, Lewis McKenzie, Gina McKee
description: Little Jimmy cheers for Manchester City, lives with his poor and divorced mother, is harassed by school friends (who all hold for United's Red Devils, it goes without saying) and is only happy when he can play football, alone, in the alley below the house. Thanks to the help of a coach who played seriously in the City, Jimmy will find the strength to take his school to the city final, played in the Maine Road stadium.
notes: Cinematographically, the film is a fairy tale with a happy ending, and it is no coincidence that it won an award at Giffoni. The script is often pulled away, but John Hay's direction is punctual and the actors are sympathetic.

title: Crocodile Dundee in Los Angeles
actors: Paul Hogan, Linda Kozlowski, Jere Burns, Serge Cockburn
description: Michael J. "Crocodile" Dundee, married to an heiress and a child, leaves his wilderness to follow his wife, who has to manage the editorial staff of his father's newspaper. He soon sets out to investigate the death of a reporter, and the investigation soon leads to Hollywood studios.
notes: The mechanism is always the same: the naive Crocodile displaced by the magical world of cinema makes you laugh (?) With his gaffes; but then, since he has seen a lot of TV shows, he discovers the bad guys and brings them to justice. Paul Hogan is elderly and knows it, Linda Kozlowski looks like Alida Chelli and always wears black to slim down. Off, boring, least of all televised, and featuring Mike Tyson.

title: The Fireball
actors: Mickey Rooney, Pat O'Brien, Beverly Tyler, Marilyn Monroe
description: Escaped from Father O'Hara's orphanage, the temperamental and arrogant Johnny Casar becomes a roller skating star with the help of Mary Reeves. His notoriety will attract the attention of several women to him, including the interested Polly.
notes: There is also Marilyn, in this sweet and uplifting film cut on the ex enfant prodige Rooney.

title: One Minute to Zero
actors: Robert Mitchum, Ann Blyth, William Talman, Richard Egan
description: The young and idealist Linda Day, a UN envoy, touches the horrors of war firsthand after falling in love with Colonel Steve Janowski, in charge of the evacuation of civilians from Korea. The hostility of the North Korean military authorities does not facilitate the situation.
notes: Garnett has made other similar films, but here the reasons for the propaganda (grafted onto a canonical mélo canvas) have taken hold of him. Discreet integration of some documentary inserts, which give credibility to the story; the insistence on the theme of the "red danger" however clearly denounces the intentions of the operation, weighing down the smoothness of the plot.

title: Joy of Living
actors: Irene Dunne, Douglas Fairbanks jr., Alice Brady, Jean Dixon
description: Margaret Garrett, a popular Broadway star, had to endure her family's tantrums and hunger for money for many years. The meeting with the young and carefree Dan Webster will open up, for the first time, the horizon of the little great pleasures of life.
notes: Lively and - for the time - unscrupulous story colored in pastel pink.

title: Driven
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Burt Reynolds, Kip Pardue, Estella Warren, Gina Gershon
description: Driver Joe Tanto is recalled by his team leader Carl Henry: he had left the circuits to grow as a man but the smell of petrol in the pits smells of victory, and is irresistible. His job is to wean a budding champion.
notes: Stallone takes care of the script (which cries out for revenge so bad it is) and entrusts the direction to his friend Renny Harlin, the spiritual father of all Hollywood "shooters". The staging of "Driven" tries to hide its inconsistency with speed. There are two "sculptural" situations destined for the anthology of the worst: a race at three hundred per hour in the city center and an accident in the rain with an impossible timing.

title: The Bumblebee Flies Anyway
actors: Elijah Wood, Janeane Garofalo, Rachael Leigh Cook, Eileen Snow, Janet Paparazzo
description: In an oncology ward for children and adolescents, a young man wakes up healthy and without memory. They cannot tell him who he is or why he is there: he has agreed to voluntarily undergo an experiment and will have to recover the memories on his own, starting with the recurring fragment of a car accident ...
notes: These delirious premises are followed by an hour and a half of jokes to effect, "politically correct" pervert, New Age waste and a hint of love story (three walks in all) that should justify the title. Towards the end, however, there is a curious twist in the plot, which shifts everything into science fiction and could herald interesting developments.

title: Bad Day on the Block
actors: Charlie Sheen, Mare Winningham, David Andrews, Noah Fleiss
description: The violent character of Lyle Wilder caused his wife (who had even forced Russian roulette) and his son to leave him. However, he blames the neighbors' influence, which he intends to punish: a complaint against him is not considered, and Lyle can act on his criminal instincts ...
notes: Yet another psychopathic killer at work.

title: Nadja
actors: Elina Löwensohn, Peter Fonda, Suzy Amis, Martin Donovan
description: New York City: On the occasion of their father's wake, members of a family of contemporary and post-modern vampires try to quell the conflicts that divide them. In the meantime, however, Dr. van Helsing and his niece are on their trail ...
notes: Stylized reinterpretation of a myth as ancient as the world; David Lynch is the executive producer.

title: Corbari
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Tina Aumont, Frank Wolff, Spiros Focas
description: Romagna, 1944: the young Silvio Corbari sets up a partisan band. Impatient with any form of organized struggle, he carries out a series of daring actions that transform him into a legendary figure. Destiny will make him a martyr.
notes: In full post-'68, a tale in the form of a popular saga that absorbs the most rebellious moods.

title: El secreto del capitan O'Hara
actors: Johnny Harrison, Angel Ter, German Cobos, Marta Padovan
description: Captain O'Hara rescues the girlfriend of his rival, Captain Rush, from the Indians. The latter is convinced that O'Hara is responsible for the death of his brother, so he has no intention of forgiving him easily.
notes: O'Hara has become Ringo, but this "paella-western" hasn't gained any.

title: Lo chiamavano Tresette... giocava sempre col morto
actors: George Hilton, Chris Huerta, Sal Borgese, Evelyn Stewart
description: On the run from his deadly enemy, Poison, the placid Tresette lands in a village called Mela Bacata. The banker Pearson hires him, along with the false sheriff Bamby, to transfer a shipment of gold to Texas: it is the beginning of a series of daring adventures.
notes: A spaghetti-western "to laugh" (?).

title: The Hole
actors: Thora Birch, Keira Knightley, Desmond Harrington, Embeth Davidtz
description: Liz, an exclusive British college student with a modest look, fails to get noticed by her beloved Mike. Friend Martin finds a way to make their union, spiritual and physical, inevitable, by locking them together with two other friends in a watertight bunker. From which, at the end of it all, only one of the boys will come out alive. The tension is all concentrated between the worried aspects of Liz's psyche, behind a look that portends something inevitably evil. Brava Thora Birch, who after "American Beauty" is reconfirmed as a promising actress. The weaving structure is less convincing.

title: Come si fa un Martini
actors: Adriana Asti, Flavio Bucci, Antonio Catania, Ennio Fantastichini, Ivano Marescotti
description: Milan to drink. In a cool restaurant, unknown to each other, numerous fatuous and hateful characters gather. Two mature couples engaged in horn games, an opera singer who sees his elderly dad swooping between head and neck, a group of yuppies who have arranged an inappropriate blind date for a colleague, a famous writer with his court of lackeys .
notes: Choral portrait of a bourgeoisie in disarray, the film is very ambitious but lacks a solid script and a critical gaze that unifies everything. It would like to be "America today" but it is only "Milan yesterday". Among the actors, some are very good, others really not.

title: Tutta la conoscenza del mondo
actors: Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Marco Bonini, Claudio Guain, Giorgio Albertazzi
description: Claudio - confined to a wheelchair - and Marco are saved by a luminous being similar to an extraterrestrial, who avoids an accident while they are crossing the tracks. After this episode, the existence of the two is irremediably marked: Marco eagerly throws himself on books that deal with the paranormal, while Claudio begins to archive news regarding extrasensory experiences. At the same time we witness the events of Giovanna, in love with her philosophy professor.
notes: The intention to play the card of irony and the grotesque (New Age is in the sights) is evident, but the outcome appears less fluid than Puglielli hoped.

title: Non è giusto
actors: Maddalena Polistina, Daniel Prodomo, Valerio Binasco
description: August, Naples. Two eleven and twelve year old boys, Sofia and Valerio meet by chance. Both, the second lives between Sweden and Italy, the first is the daughter of a second bed, are alone in the deserted city. In reality they are entrusted to their respective fathers (the mothers are absent, far away), forty-year-olds struggling with all sorts of problems. The two men try to give their children some security, even resorting to lies. But Sofia and Valerio feel in danger due to the instability of their families.
notes: Also thanks to the help of digital cameras, De Lillo lightens the atmosphere, but the bitterness remains: with a minimalist touch and an absolute respect for the points of view of its immature protagonists, it enters the world at Ozu height on tiptoe, without forgetting to be a mother before being a director.

title: Palavra e utopia
actors: Lima Duarte, Luis Miguel Cintra, Ricardo Trêpa, Leonor Silveira
description: 1663: Father Antonio Vieira is summoned to Coimbra to appear before the Tribunal of the Holy Office. His fame as a famous preacher, Jesuit and close friend of the late king João IV is threatened by court intrigues. Before the judges, Father Antonio retraces his entire existence, starting with his youth in Brazil and his commitment to the Indians.
notes: The Lusitanian master manages at the same time to recount an era and to rediscover similarities with the present. An elegant but not calligraphic film, with a thoughtful and dreamy rhythm, more innovative and less approved than so much globalized and amorphous cinema.

title: Streghe
actors: Michelle Vannucchi, Gary Kerr, Deanna Lund, Ian Bannen
description: Ed and his sister Carol, orphans and teenagers from New York, go with a group of friends to an inherited country house in the South of the States and never visited before. In reality it is a sort of ruin, which above all turns out to be inhabited by the spirit of an evil witch: more precisely of Helena, who in the Thirties had lived there as the governess of little Rachel and who, after having seduced a young priest, she had been sentenced to the stake for witchcraft. The massacre begins ...
notes: An old house and a curse: does it say anything? Capone ("Men on the verge of a nervous breakdown") is also a screenwriter.

title: Strangeland
actors: Dee Snider, Kevin Gage, Elizabeth Peña, Linda Cardellini, Amal Rhoe
description: Two girls, Genevieve and Tiana spend all their free time in front of the computer. While chatting, they meet Captain Howdy, a high school student eager to meet girls. When Genevieve, invited to a party by the mysterious interlocutor, never returns home, Tiana and Detective Gage begin to have doubts. The girl has stumbled upon a ferocious killer who chooses his victims by chatting on the computer.
notes: Z-series splatter effects, a script that doesn't stand up, are 86 minutes of boredom and the only funny thing is Englund's bacon who, naked as a worm, this time experimenting with the role of victim.

title: Kingdom Come
actors: Whoopi Goldberg, Jada Pinkett Smith, LL Cool J, Vivica A. Fox, Loretta Devine
description: All members of the Slocumb family gather at the funeral of the hateful head of the family. This is how the dreamer and failed Junior come to Raynelle's mother, who sold everything to invest in a car to clean parking lots; Ray Bud, worker with his head on his shoulders; plus Raynelle's sister, bigoted with a son in jail and another idiot. During the funeral, conflicts, rivalries and malice are unleashed.
notes: Portrait of a bourgeoisie in black, but Spike Lee is far away, and the film has the style and timing of the sitcom. Of course, due to the social extraction of a proletarianized petty bourgeoisie, and the wickedness of some situations, it seems more like "Sanford and Son" than "The Robinsons".

title: Beautiful Joe
actors: Sharon Stone, Billy Connolly, Ian Holm, Gil Bellows, Jurnee Smollett
description: Handsome Joe, a poor fellow who lives in the Bronx, is diagnosed with a brain tumor. Before dying, he decides to go on an adventure: having said that, at the races he accidentally meets a crazy woman named Hush and falls in love with her. But Hush owes money to the wrong people, and to defend her Joe gets into trouble with some gangsters: he is therefore forced to flee to Las Vegas with the woman and her two children ...
notes: Metcalfe has two or three notable screenplay stunts, but fails to blend them into a film that makes sense. La Stone just makes a bunch of verses; better Connolly, effective in the role of Joe.

title: Dr. Dolittle 2
actors: Eddie Murphy, Jeffrey Jones, Lil'Zane, Kyla Pratt, Raven-Symoné
description: Some rodents want to save the forest they live in from logging. Unscrupulous builders want to build a residential complex. The cute animals are forced to call on Doctor Dolittle. In fact, the only way to save the trees is to try to mate the very rare bear that inhabits the forest, so that its species becomes, from virtually extinct, a protected species. The only bear available is some sort of clown raised in captivity who is "convinced" by Dr. Dolittle.
notes: The plot does not exist, the ecology is very bogus and the photography of mountain landscapes is not decent either. The coup de grace are the animals dubbed with the various Italian dialects.

title: The Crew
actors: Burt Reynolds, Richard Dreyfuss, Dan Hedaya, Seymour Cassel
description: The old delinquents Bobby, Joey, Mike and Tony try to thwart the maneuvers of the new bosses who intend to take over the residence where they have retired. The corpse of an elderly man, found on the beach in front, becomes the pretext to make people believe that a settling of scores between rival gangs is taking place. The quartet, however, is unaware that the dead man is the father of a big drug dealer, who now wants to take revenge ...
notes: The cast is first-rate but the film leaves a bad taste in the mouth, like after a day spent smoking two packs of cigarettes. The director Dinner, crepuscular since his surname, is of compulsory television origin.

title: Josie and the Pussycats
actors: Tara Reid, Rachael Leigh Cook, Rosario Dawson, Parker Posey
description: Josie, Melody and Val have a dream of becoming pop music stars. In a short time the three, who call themselves "Josie and the Pussycats", manage to climb the peaks of the international rankings. The price to pay for maintaining success is high. Fiona, a record company manager, is using their songs to send subliminal messages to kids around the world.
notes: Products and fashion, frenetic consumption and the manipulation of multinationals, hidden music and advertising, youth targets and tastes are the hot and ambiguous material of the film, written and directed by Deborah Kaplan and Harry Elfont, inspired by a comic and a television series.

title: Drowning Mona
actors: Danny DeVito, Bette Midler, Neve Campbell, Jamie Lee Curtis
description: Mrs. Dearly, mother and unbearable wife, dies in a car accident. Wyatt Rash, the sheriff of the mountain village where the woman lived, is not convinced that it was an unfortunate fate: many are in fact those who had excellent reasons to kill her, and so the tenacious tin star begins to investigate. ..
notes: If the plot and the presence of Midler suggest _Please kill my wife_, the "provincial" setting recalls the most brilliant _Cookie's Luck_, but obviously Gomez is not Altman. In the 70's soundtrack stands out - used in a really bizarre way - the old hit _Popcorn_ by Hot Butter.

title: Shriek If You Know What I Did Last Friday the 13th
actors: Tiffani Thiessen, Julie Benz, Harley Cross, Simon Rex, Coolio
description: Hagitha Utslay is a journalist who has a bad habit, she puts her nose where she shouldn't be sticking herself in complicated situations like this. But there are those who try to help her. This is a cop trying to catch a dangerous killer who is wreaking havoc at Bulimia Falls College.
notes: What's really depressing is the lack of candor in the parody. Abbott and Costello or Franco and Ciccio are a thousand miles away. When it comes to the imitation _ (Shriek) _ of the sequel _ (Scary Movie 2) _ of the parody _ (Scary Movie) _ of a film _ (Scream) _ built entirely of quotations to recent horror, the impression is that beyond there is only the death of the cinema.

title: Jurassic Park III
actors: Sam Neill, William H. Macy, Téa Leoni, Laura Dern, Alessandro Nivola
description: An adventurer and his wife persuade paleontologist Alan Grant, seeking funds to study the intelligence of velociraptors, and four other fellow travelers to take a tour aboard a plane to Isla Sorna. The island, once home to the famous prehistoric park, has been transformed into a perfect environment for the growth and development of dinosaurs. When the seven, victims of an accident, are stranded on the island, Dr. Grant realizes the true intentions of the adventurer and his wife.
notes: Joe Johnston, put behind the wheel by executive producer Steven Spielberg, gets away in less than 90 minutes, clears all the Crichton côté of the saga and churns out pure adventure.

title: Pillole, capsule & supposte
actors: Carlo Verdone
description: A collage of the most entertaining characters, sketches and episodes taken from the over twenty-year career of the Roman actor-director (and Romanist), baptized on television by the innovative programs of the great Enzo Trapani ("Non stop", "Due di tutto" ) and soon achieved success also in the cinematographic field.

title: The Pride of the Yankees
actors: Gary Cooper, Teresa Wright, Babe Ruth, Walter Brennan
description: The life and deeds of Lou Gehrig, a famous baseball professional who was crushed in 1941 (at the age of 38) by a rare form of muscular dystrophy that today bears his name.
notes: The sporting deeds (but with a great deal of space dedicated to private events) of a champion born poor but capable of conquering success as a good "all american hero".

title: The Adventures of Rocky & Bullwinkle
actors: Robert De Niro, Rene Russo, Piper Perabo, Randy Quaid, Jason Alexander
description: Segregated for over 30 years in the world of replicas, Rocky and Bullwinkle, a flying squirrel and a moose, find a world completely changed and at the mercy of a bad TV, good only to lobotomize millions of Americans. But the enemies are always the same, a legacy of the Cold War and relative paranoia, starting with the fearless boss and his henchmen Boris and Natasha, who through the RBTV station want to conquer the world.
notes: Despite the goodwill of screenwriter Kenneth Lonergan and excellent cameos, the film, which incorporates two legendary characters from American TV, gradually begins to spin around in circles and also the mixture between animation and live action leaves something to be desired.

title: The Claim
actors: Milla Jovovich, Peter Mullan, Wes Bentley, Sarah Polley, Nastassja Kinski
description: We are in 1869 in a small village immersed in the snow of the Sierra Nevada. The life of the village is turned upside down by the return of Dillon who, twenty years earlier, had sold his wife Elena and daughter Hope in exchange for a certificate of ownership of a gold mine. Meanwhile, Elena fell in love with Dalglish who was charged with tracing the route of the new railway. The former partner returns to court her.
notes: An operation that is only at times suggestive (the setting is rich), saved in extremis by an intoned acting choir where the Scotsman Mullan gives acting lessons to the young Bentley, and where three women (Kinski, Polley and Jovovich) insure against boredom .

title: I giorni dell'amore e dell'odio
actors: Daniele Liotti, Liberto Rabal, Mandala Tayde, Ricky Tognazzi
description: In Kefalonia, the Acqui Division refused to surrender to the Germans after the armistice of 8 September and was massacred. The hateful act was perpetrated not by the SS but by the Wermacht, the German regular army. Against the background of this bitter war page, the story of Wolfgang and Helberg is told, two South Tyrolean brothers who choose one Italy and the other Germany.
notes: Telling the story was a laudable purpose and also the key chosen by the critic director Salizzato, that of the historical melos, could work. Too bad this is not the case. The poverty of means is incredible and Ricky Tognazzi clarifies the historical situation in a 5-minute phone call. The battle scenes are a sabbath of stuntmen, but the dead blink.

title: Panic
actors: William H. Macy, John Ritter, Neve Campbell, Donald Sutherland
description: Michael was a killer and taught his son Alex the family profession and the secrets of the trade (don't look the victim in the eye, hit, drop the gun, take off your gloves, walk away without running ...). When Alex begins to feel sick, he goes to Dr. Parks for analysis and in the meantime he falls in love with Sarah, a girl full of problems. But the parent disagrees ...
notes: Bromell's directorial debut is imbued with heartbreaking and unsolvable Oedipal echoes, supported by a pair of extraordinary actors like Sutherland and Macy. And even the Neve Campbell of "Scream" has grown: she no longer screams and proves she can also act.

title: L'amore probabilmente
actors: Sonia Bergamasco, Rosalinda Celentano, Fabrizio Gifuni, Teco Celio
description: Sofia, a student of an acting school, is struck by the lecture _The invitation to lie_ that Mariangela Melato addresses to her disciples. According to her, being an actor means lying. Sofia, struck by these words, decides to experience the power of lies in life. He'll get endless trouble out of it. Distraught, Sofia finds herself on a train where she reads the title of an interview with Stefania Sandrelli in which she claims that in front of the camera it is impossible to lie. Sofia decides to always tell the truth, but once again she understands that saying what you think does not pay. All that remains is the illusion, entrusted to Alida Valli and an audition that the aspiring actress must support with a director and which becomes a journey of self-discovery.
notes: Bertolucci dances as at a debutante ball, he whirls, reversing the points of view as if to accompany the old "heavy cinema" out the door with education. Graceful and light, he philosophizes about love, he writes I love you on the screen as if he were holding the caméra stylo of Astruc and Cocteau in his hands. The audiovisual like the poet's pen, like a verse by Giorgio Caproni, like a word heard at home who knows how many times by Papa Attilio. A film that hopes and experiments: it hopes to be born and experiences how impossible it is to tell the truth, to recite the lie, to delude oneself that it is not just a game. Bertolucci confesses that he does not (yet) know what cinema will be, but declares that he has understood what it is no longer. Heroic.

title: I misteri di Roma
description: Driven by the enthusiasm of the unstoppable Cesare Zavattini, as well as armed with a remarkable vis controversy, a handful of seventeen directors (including Giuseppe Ferrara and Lorenza Mazzetti) descend through the streets of the capital to grasp them, in a day like many others, the moods and flavors that animate it.

title: Il flauto magico
description: Prince Tamino loves Pamina, but to enter the Kingdom of Light with her he will have to overcome - with the help of his magic flute - the three tests of silence, water and fire.
notes: One of the historic couples of Italian animation fires an extraordinary adaptation of the score of the great Salzburger, full of magic and wonder.

title: Poirot: Murder in Mesopotamia
actors: David Suchet, Hugh Fraser, Ron Berglas, Barbara Barnes
description: While accompanying his friend on a journey along a dike in Iraq, Poirot finds himself involved in the investigation into the murder of an archaeologist's wife.The victim, Ms. Leidner, had received letters from her first husband who she thought had died in a train accident. Is the man still alive?

title: Lightning: Fire From Sky
actors: John Schneider, Jesse Eisenberg, Stacy Keach, Michele Greene
description: Eric, a budding meteorologist, is convinced that the arrival of the "great storm" awaited and feared by all his fellow citizens is imminent, foretold in his opinion by the unleashing of two particularly violent disturbances. The catastrophic event occurs once a century, and its triggering causes would also be the particular geological nature of the local territory. However, Eric's warnings fall on deaf ears, and not even his father - sheriff of the city - seems to give him credit: relations between the two are very tense, and are still heavily affected by the tragic death of their older brother. But the situation evolves in the way Eric expected ...

title: Per favore occupati di Amelia
actors: Barbara Bouchet, Renzo Montagnani, Mario Carotenuto, Leopoldo Mastelloni
description: Monsignor Florio, archbishop of Rio de Janeiro, rushes to Rome because Marcello, his illegitimate son, has expressed his intention to marry. In reality it is a ploy to try to extort an advance on the inheritance from the parent. Amelia, a high-class socialite supported by her brother Adonis and her adoptive father, holds up Marcello's game: but, as usual, whoever does it must also expect it ...
notes: According to the credits, the inspiration should come from the famous pochade by Georges Feydeau, but the direction and screenplay take it upon themselves to reduce everything to a banal review of obvious and itchy double meanings. Dejecting.

title: Gli scontenti
actors: Renato Speziali, Mara Berni, Mario Carotenuto, Carlo Campanini
description: The discontented with the title are the inhabitants of the village where Bastiano Supino also lives, young and unemployed, hired as a municipal dog catcher after a fortuitous accident bruised the dog of the local noblewoman, the Duchess Luce. Cagnetta galeotta, it is appropriate to say, given that the classic "tender friendship" breaks out between the two: but Luce is already married and Bastiano has a jealous girlfriend, Angelina, who discovers everything and threatens to make the hell out of four. This is enough to scare Bastiano, who runs away freeing the dogs and fatally getting into trouble ...
notes: A decent cast fails to lift the tide of an incurably limp film.

title: Ehi amigo...sei morto!
actors: Wayde Preston, Rik Battaglia, Aldo Berti, Anna Malsson, Alberto Di Grazia
description: Barnett and the eight men of his gang are stationed in a village to attack a stagecoach carrying $ 100,000 in gold. In pursuit of the outlaws a post officer is launched, who manages to penetrate their hiding place. The blood will flow in rivers.
notes: The usual Italian western, indistinguishable from a thousand others.

title: Il gioko
actors: Alessandra Acciai, Jean Herbert, Daria Nicolodi, Viola Simoncioni
description: A middle school teacher realizes that there is something mysterious and disturbing in the psychology of her pupils: her fears are tragically confirmed when a young girl is found raped and killed.
notes: Bava jr. develops the theme of the short circuit between innocence and perversion. Part of the TV series "High Voltage".

title: La danse du scorpion
actors: Kim Coates, Roberta Weiss, Ronald Guttman, Béatrice Benscik
description: Finch Palmer, a musician by profession, is hired by the gangster Edouard de Vito to show himself around with his wife Camille, thus providing him the opportunity to file for a divorce. The trap clicks, but when de Vito is murdered, suspicions inevitably fall on Finch ...

title: Appuntamento col disonore
actors: Adolfo Celi, Margaret Lee, Michael Craig, Klaus Kinski
description: The inhabitants of Cyprus organize resistance against the English army, which has extended the "protectorate" on the island. A British major, who had fought against the Nazis together with the leader of the Cypriot rebels, tries to find an agreement before His Majesty's relentless retaliation is triggered.

title: La dottoressa sotto il lenzuolo
actors: Karin Schubert, Gastone Pescucci, Orchidea De Santis, Eligio Zamara, Alvaro Vitali
description: This time it is a group of university students who go to the "big maneuvers": a prosperous doctor, but very chaste, attracts their hungry attention (we are in Pisa and the tower stands out: is the metaphor clear?).
