As if that were not enough, a nurse played by Orchidea De Santis also gets involved!
notes: Squalid attempt by Gianni Martucci to queue to the series of "doctors" & C. Without Edwige Fenech, and despite the impromptu presence of the national Alvarone, this production ends up being the B series of the Z series. for orphans of "Stracult".

title: Una bara per lo sceriffo
actors: Anthony Steffen, Eduardo Fajardo, Arthur Kent
description: The relatively quiet life of a lawman in the Wild West is turned upside down by the death of his woman. A bandit kidnapped, tortured and then killed her. To take revenge, the sheriff agrees to join, incognito, the band of outlaws who are supposed to join the murderous jackal. He will be discovered, but nothing will stand in the way of his revenge.
notes: Italian Western with veteran Anthony Steffen, without particular merits and shot in an evident lack of means (and money). Mario Caiano better remember the cult Lovers from beyond the grave. Above-average rate of violence.

title: La polizia interviene: ordine di uccidere!
actors: Leonard Mann, James Mason, Enrico Maria Salerno, Antonella Murgia, Janet Agren
description: Faced with the crime of two colleagues, Commissioner Murri wants to see clearly, because the situation is hot. He decides to conduct an investigation parallel to the official one and is convinced that behind the double murder there is a black plot that leads to the strategy of tension. Unbeknownst to him, the fascist organization also involves unsuspected characters.
notes: Usually defined as reactionary, the Italian police in some cases have a progressive guise. But the contents matter little if the story progresses with difficulty. However, the cast is remarkable, which includes the then young Janet Agren.

title: In the Name of People
actors: Amy Madigan, Richard Thomas, Scott Bakula, Kimberley Warnat
description: Locked up in his cell on death row, after having long protested his innocence from the infamous accusation of murdering a teenager, John Burke awaits the day of execution. Now all hope has been laid down, the man's only concern is the fate of his thirteen-year-old daughter Jennifer: his wife has in fact been dead for several years, and the only person who could take care of the girl is a very old grandmother. John then asks the victim's parents to personally take on the burden of Jennifer's education, which - he argues - could partly relieve them of the irreparable loss of their child ...

title: The Others
actors: Nicole Kidman, Fionnula Flanagan, Christopher Eccleston, Alakina Mann, James Bentley, Elaine Cassidy, Eric Sykes, Renée Asherson
description: Grace and her two children, allergic to light, live in an isolated house on an island off the coast of England. Outside, the fog clears the world and, inside, darkness feeds the visions and makes the senses more sensitive, while reading the Bible, thinking about sin and life after death. The "others" are the living, the dead and those who will die. Behind the many closed doors and drawn curtains, everyone must learn to recognize intruders.
notes: For some, the best film by Alejandro Amenábar (_Tesis_ and _Apri glioti_). For someone an episode of the fantastic television series "At the edge of reality". For some, a questionable film more oriented to capturing the consensus of the public than to refining the art applied to the screen. For some, a thematic and formal variation on the atmospheres of _The sixth sense_. Successful or disappointing "genre" films reopen old oppositions. They force us to focus on mechanisms, inventions, stereotypes, on the performance of a score with a rigid harmonic structure. The director makes an excellent film, assisted by a talented Nicole Kidman (paler and more evanescent than a ghost) and by talented supporting actors, he works on the uncanny, on the anxieties of the familiar, on the horror and on all the clues (fog, darkness, night , tombstones, closed doors, voices, noises, looks and sounds) that announce and prepare for fear and anguish. The film auscultates the agitated breath of the classics, experts in haunted houses, in hostile presences, in anguish, in a return from the afterlife.

title: The Unsaid
actors: Andy Garcia, Teri Polo, Linda Cardellini, Sam Bottoms
description: A psychologist is annihilated by the suicide of his son in the care of a colleague. The family, after the boy's death, no longer exists. The wife lives in another house and the other daughter moves away from her father, but associates with his patients. A former pupil of the blamed protagonist, who has become a therapist, asks for help to solve the case of another teenager with a tragic past.
notes: The socially useless category of doctors of the soul does not disprove the malicious Hollywood prejudices. One harasses a patient and kills himself, one lets himself be manipulated like a fool, one speaks inappropriately. The biggest problem with the film is the script.

title: Planet of the Apes
actors: Mark Wahlberg, Helena Bonham Carter, Tim Roth, Michael Clarke Duncan
description: Space 2029. Astronaut Leo Davidson should leave the chimpanzees alone with the task of probing the mysteries of the cosmos. Instead, in full galactic storm, he follows the fate of a primate by throwing himself into the unknown and, sinking in time to a distant future, on an unknown planet, surrounded by intelligent apes and enslaved men. It will be he, with the help of an enlightened chimpanzee, Ari, to organize the Resistance of mankind.
notes: Tim Burton's highly anticipated remake of one of the science fiction classics such as "Planet of the Apes" by Franklin J. Schaffner (1968). Although then, if you think about it, "remake" is a big word. Burton, in fact, takes inspiration from the original novel by Pierre Boule, with the intention of creating a symbolic phantasmagoria congenial to his own poetry. The humanity of animals and the bestiality of men, diversity as a symptom of "other" sensitivity, the planet of the apes as a new world to be imagined and recreated on the screen. Right here the film seems to creak: this "of the monkeys" is a world that is not surprising, it lets itself be absorbed by conventional visions, of a science fiction perhaps out of date (few special effects) but certainly far from the impact that the filmmaker has accustomed us to. The lack of a hypnotic context (not necessarily gothic or cartoonistic: every Burton film, after all, knows how to renew its imagination) makes everything else insipid, because in the end, adventure is exactly as you expect it to be.

title: Un taxi mauve
actors: Philippe Noiret, Charlotte Rampling, Fred Astaire, Agostina Belli
description: Elder Dr Scully drives around Ireland in the mauve cab of the title. During his travels, he visits Philippe Marchal, a 50-year-old French journalist who cannot resign himself to the loss of his son and has retired to an isolated village. Here Scully meets the young and wealthy American Jerry (in crisis due to abandonment by his girlfriend), the charming Sharon and the shadowy Taubelman, married to Anne.
notes: The Irish landscapes still have their own appeal and the cast is undoubtedly first-rate: but the intimist tones of the film do not fully convince, and the interest inexorably wanes.

title: Con la muerte a la espalda
actors: George Martin, Vivi Bach, Rosalba Neri, Daniele Vargas, Gérard Landry
description: Electra, a dangerous psychopath, has a substance capable of dramatically amplifying human aggression; but Professor Roland has developed the antidote formula and is about to hand it over to Americans and Russians, worried about the possible advent of a hostile third power in the East. The meeting is set in a luxurious villa, where however Roland - who went there accompanied by his assistant Monica - is murdered by Electra's assassins: the formula ends up in the hands of Gary, a famous jewel thief, who escapes carrying with self Monica. The two are chased by everyone ...
notes: Conventional weaving, ordinary direction.

title: Un buco in fronte
actors: Robert Hundar, Bruno Cattaneo, Luigi Marturano, Anthony Ghidra
description: A treasure has been hidden in the Sierra Paolo. To get hold of the precious loot you need to gather three playing cards on which the map is drawn. The first card is in the Munguja ha, the second is in the hands of Murienda, the third is in the hands of Garrincha. A tremendous fight breaks out.
notes: Discounted spaghetti western.

title: Luce dei miei occhi
actors: Luigi Lo Cascio, Sandra Ceccarelli, Silvio Orlando, Barbara Valente, Toni Bertorelli
description: Morgan feels he has strayed too far from Earth. It ended up, really, out of this world. He has lost his course, by chance or by choice, and, among the stars, planets and meteors, he reads and thinks. Above all, look tactfully at the invasion of the unhappy body snatchers. Morgan is the alter ego of an imaginary science fiction novel that takes the word and conscience of Antonio, a driver for two years. The boy arrived in a Rome of gray streets and buildings, after brilliant studies and with a slow reversal of the expectations (of the others) for his special future. Meet Maria, mother of a little girl, Lisa, owner of a frozen food shop, shaken by an unhappy passion.
notes: The new universe, in which Antonio / Morgan has landed, shrouded in darkness or just illuminated by a light between blue and the color of ashes, (photography by Arnaldo Catinari) is as if suspended. For this reason, the duration of the images is diluted, sfora, is in counter-time. Giuseppe Piccioni's cinema does not want and does not know how to be cheerful and joyful, it prefers melancholy, half tones, nuances, the incompleteness of the characters, the structure and the dysphoric atmospheres. The film is dragged (a movement towards a non-place that can excite or irritate the viewer) by the bewilderment of Antonio and Maria and their non-identification with a world, a destiny. A center (in the life of the protagonists and in Italian cinema) in which to stop does not exist. And there are no arrival points either. Coppa Volpi at the 58 Venice Film Festival for Luigi Lo Cascio and Sandra Ceccarelli.

title: Heartbreakers
actors: Sigourney Weaver, Gene Hackman, Jennifer Love Hewitt, Ray Liotta
description: The beautiful, sexy and charming Max impalms rich babies; his daughter Page seduces them by forcing them into divorces with substantial compensation. The penultimate husband searches and tracks down the two scoundrels as they try to frame the weird cigarette magnate William B. Tensy; for his part, Page makes the mistake of falling in love with the classic boy next door ...
notes: The film stretches out and uselessly exceeds two hours, with loose vulgarities. What's more, some of the gimmicks are second-hand: a statue losing his penis, Russian accents, a stuck sub-story of love. Excessive acting, casual and stretched humor.

title: Save the Last Dance
actors: Julia Stiles, Sean Patrick Thomas, Terry Kinney, Fredro Starr
description: Sara's loving mother died while racing in her car to not miss her daughter's dance recital. Sara, devastated by guilt, hangs up her shoes. But even to do it on purpose, when she moves to her father's house, a stoned jazz musician, and begins to attend ghetto school, she meets a black boy who dances beautifully the break dance. So Sara gets acquainted with hip hop culture and he comes into conflict with friends from the ghetto.
notes: The "social musical" has a glorious tradition in America, the Warner musicals of the 1930s were "political theater" in all respects. The outcome of a transgressive fake film like this one is therefore all the sadder.

title: Tornando a casa
actors: Salvatore Iaccarino, Aniello Scotto D'Antuono, Giovanni Iaccarino
description: Four fishermen from Pozzuoli cross from Sicily into Tunisian territorial waters, with the constant risk of being captured by the coast guard. Then, one day, the engine fails and the crew returns to Campania, but it will be the beginning of the end.
notes: The film is very intense in the first part, almost documentary, spoken in a brusque dialect and anything but elegiac or folkloric. Then the narration takes over and the clarity of the gaze becomes cloudy a bit; but the newcomer Marra still manages to trace, with an unusual sensitivity in our cinema, the map of a Mediterranean that is both homeland and drift.

title: Diamond Girl
actors: Kevin Otto, Jonathan Cake, Royston Stoffels, Joely Collins
description: Denny and Regan, two brothers both lawyers must make an important decision regarding the corporate merger of the family vineyard. Over the years, their family has given fame to the Napa Hills winery, whose label has become synonymous with a wine of excellent quality. The buyer is a certain Bernier who is more interested in the Napa Hills brand than in the vineyard, from which he hopes to be able to obtain legal coverage for the sale of a lower quality wine that he produces in his vineyards in Algeria. Claire, Denny's lawyer, a pretty, intelligent and very capable girl, becomes the centerpiece of the story as she helps Regan uncover Bernier's hidden intentions.

title: L'uomo in più
actors: Toni Servillo, Andrea Renzi, Angela Goodwin, Nello Mascia
description: Antonio Pisapia, aka Tony, is a Neapolitan “crooner” with a seductive voice, a dance artist fought over by women, pampered by managers and respected by pushers. Antonio Pisapia, on the other hand, is a class stopper and - after a serious injury - an amateur but brilliant coach, inventor of a Sacchi module years before the arrival of the coach from Fusignano. For them it seems to be starting a period of success: but in 1984, the career and the life of both fall apart ...
notes: For his debut feature, Sorrentino chooses an intense stalking, enters the characters, attacks them with a participating gaze and lets them melt into the drama: the thrill of Servillo's monologue on TV.

title: Le pornographe
actors: Jean-Pierre Léaud, Jérémie Rénier, Ovidie, Thibault de Montalembert, Catherine Mouchet, André Marcon, Alice Houri, Laurent Lucas, Ségolène Savoff
description: Jacques, author of more than forty red light films before the decline and retirement, finally agrees to go back behind the camera for economic reasons, in shabby productions. Meanwhile, he has to deal with his own personal life: a son who gets closer but never meets, a wife who loves him but wants to get away from.
notes: Disillusioned, "Le pornographe" by Bertrand Bonello. With a splendid first part which reflects on the staging applied to porn: the work of the director, the actor. Scenes of eroticism that one would like to be "artistic" and which instead by contract must be deprived of any poetry. Through Léaud relives a generation that idolized the caméra stylo, the free and wild camera, when filming (also) sex was a political act. In the middle of the journey of his life, the pornographer finds himself alone, arid, among the remains of what he wanted to be and is not. Bonello's film is beautiful and intense, despite a few too many concessions to authorial self-referentiality (a concept that translates into boredom). Jean-Pierre Léaud, it goes without saying, is a giant of thought.

title: The Trumpet of the Swan
description: Louie is a trumpet-swan born mute, to the desperation of his parents. But thanks to his strong character and the help of a young boy scout, he learns the language of men and becomes a true virtuoso on the trumpet. The instrument is transformed into a means of communication with the world: with his skill, Louie will be able to win the admiration of humans and his fellow men (as well as the love of the beautiful Serena) ...
notes: A classic cut product, whose only ambition is to please children. The beginning is in a minor key, but little by little the rhythm picks up, driven by the rousing performances of Louie in pure New Orleans style.

title: Senza filtro
actors: J. Ax, D.J. Jad, Luciano Federico, Anna Melato, Cochi Ponzoni, Chiara De Bonis, Kay Rush
description: Around Nico and Ray revolves a band of friends who love to have fun making the gray days of the Milanese suburbs colorful. They are convinced that love and friendship are the main ingredients in trying to get out of the slums in which they live. Between raps, Nico and Ray's friends try to survive day by day.
notes: Raimondi's film is one of those products to recommend to students of modern communication: it teaches and demonstrates, in fact, how to build a film without a screenplay, without a cine idea that is one, with zero respect for the audience and a level of narration to make us regret the most obvious and banal fiction of contemporary television.

title: The Triumph of Love
actors: Mira Sorvino, Ben Kingsley, Jay Rodan, Fiona Shaw, Ignazio Oliva
description: The throne on which Princess Leonidas now sits was usurped by her father from King Cleomenes, the parent of Agis. The noble, meeting a feeling of justice, decides to return the throne to Agis. How Leonidas intends to return the kingdom to its rightful owner is quite complicated. His plan is to win the young man's heart and be carried to the altar. But Agis was raised according to Enlightenment principles by his sister and a philosopher. Leonidas and his lady-in-waiting enter the castle disguised as a man.
notes: It is the best of the four films directed by Clare Peploe. Based on Pierre de Marivaux's eighteenth-century play, the film seeks to capture the air and spirit of a century, the model of a theatrical writing, the flagrantness of performance. The staging, with a gentle and brilliant touch, presses and records the slight vertigo of the dialogues in which we pass from seduction to lies, from the strategy of courtship to wit thanks to which a Mira Sorvino of rare effectiveness woos and promises love to a philosopher, his sister and a young prince. In the solar harmony of a stage villa, sexual disguise and the masquerade of conversation determine the primacy of sentiment over reason. The director directs her actors to perfection and directs their skirmishes with their respective characters as in a modern essay on the theory and technique of an interpretation without identification. In addition to Sorvino, Ben Kingsley and Fiona Shaw are exceptional.

title: Adanggaman
country: France, Switzerland, Ivory Coast, Burkina Faso
actors: Rasmane Ouedraogo, Albertine N'Guessan, Ziable Honoré Goore Bi
description: Africa, 17th century: in a village on the "Coast of the slaves", the elderly chief wants his son Ossei to marry the scion of a wealthy family. Ossei, rebellious by nature, thus has to abandon the girl he loves and decides to leave. That same evening, the huts of the village are put to fire and sword by Adanggaman, a cruel and greedy despot ...
notes: The film by the veteran M'Bala is a historical-mythological glimpse, almost an "Amistad" seen from Africa: clashes between fathers and sons, sudden appearances of a group of warriors hunters of men, women and children dragged in chains and sold as slaves. Imperfect, often naive, but courageous.

title: Crazy/Beautiful
actors: Kirsten Dunst, Jay Hernandez, Bruce Davison, Herman Osorio
description: Nicole and Carlos go to the same high school, Pacific High School. They know each other one day on a beach: he's with some Mexican friends and she's picking up trash (it's her punishment for driving drunk). He lives in East Los Angeles and wakes up at dawn to go to school; she lives with her father, a congressman, and grim stepmother in a luxurious glass-walled house. Will it be true love?
notes: The premises are from the primer of the "teen movie" with dramatic ambitions, but the director and the screenwriters strive - while running into numerous problems - to challenge many of the stereotypes of the trend.

title: Cause of Death
actors: Patrick Bergin, Joan Severance, Michael Ironside, Cas Anvar
description: District Attorney Taylor Lewis is in charge of the case of Angela Carter, accused of killing her husband to pocket the insurance premium; however, the victim is also the mayor's cousin, which complicates matters considerably. However, examining the documents, Lewis begins to convince himself of Angela's possible innocence; not only that: the fact of feeling more and more attracted to her leads him to worry about being able to jeopardize his own reputation, already shaken by a previous judicial error. Later, the developments of the investigation will lead the magistrate to shed light on the corruption involving local administrators.

title: Eden
actors: Samantha Morton, Thomas Jane, Luke Holland, Arthur Miller
description: Samantha and Dov, both of American descent, have settled in Palestine. He, a communist architect, consecrates himself to the reconstruction of the country but ends up neglecting his wife, who for her part tries in every way to help him. Kalman, Samantha's brother, also leaves the United States for Palestine with the intention of making a profit by buying some land from the Arabs ...
notes: We do not understand the meaning and the need for "Eden", which comes after two films on strong themes, two necessary films, "Kadosh" and "Kippur". It starts from a novel by Arthur Miller, a not-so-good storyteller and theatrical actor who here plays the part of the old father (in the USA) of a young businessman who thinks of making his fortune in 1940's Palestine. The photography is elegant and discolored, the scenes few and long, and here and there bricklayers are building on the shores of the sea. Little is said and little done, for 90 minutes. And then five minutes from the end, everything happens: the story of her husband who campaigned in Italy about the group rape of a peasant woman, the suicide of the intellectual, the loneliness of the woman in Jerusalem yesterday and today. A respectable, unconvinced or convincing film. Minor.

title: 3 Ninjas: High Noon at Mega Mountain
actors: Victor Wong, Mathew Botuchis, Hulk Hogan, Loni Anderson
description: Rocky, Colt and Tum Tum, martial arts kids, go on a trip with their friend Amanda to the Mega Mountains amusement park. Here Medusa, leader of an army of ninja warriors, is meditating on a ransom kidnapping.
notes: Fourth episode of the Ninja adventures, with the wrestler Hulk Hogan as a guest star.

title: The Phone Call
actors: Michael Sarrazin, Linda Smith, Ron Lea, Lisa Jakub
description: Businessman Michael Andersen has a habit of making "hot" phone calls to sex services: a questionable but basically harmless habit, at least until the girl on the other end of the line turns out to be a psychopathic killer who he will endanger his life and that of his family.

title: Le chemin des écoliers
actors: Françoise Arnoul, Bourvil, Lino Ventura, Alain Delon, Jean-Claude Brialy
description: Paris, 1944: students Antoine and Paul face their first sentimental experiences, at the same time tinkering with the equivocal world of the black market. But while Paul's father is perfectly aware of his son's business, Antoine's parents are in the dark. So when Antoine asks permission to go and spend a few days in Paul's villa (actually with the aim of preparing a shot), his parents raise no objection. At least until the arrival of a disastrous report card raises the first suspicions ...
notes: Properly staged and well acted, a decent film about the controversial period of the occupation.

title: Frine cortigiana d'Oriente
actors: Elena Kleus, Giulio Donnini, Pierre Cressoy, Roldano Lupi
description: Afra after having witnessed the ruin of Thebes, her homeland, is reduced to slavery, taken to Athens and put up for sale. His only desire is to try to accumulate money to rebuild the walls of Thebes. To achieve her goal she agrees to become a courtesan and to change her name, calling herself Phryne. Its beauty quickly made it famous among young Athenians who were willing to throw enormous wealth at its feet. When the money is sufficient, Phryne offers it to the archon to rebuild the walls of Thebes: the archon accepts the gift, but rejects the condition set by Phryne.
notes: Desolate adventure film directed by Mario Bonnard.

title: Gli innocenti pagano
actors: Mariella Lotti, Lida Baarova, Otello Toso, Mino Doro
description: Stefano, returning from the front, found his house empty. His daughter died, his wife ran away with a lover. While wandering from one country to another he runs into Adriana, the fiancée of a friend of his, who died during his imprisonment. The woman was the lover of Massimo Artesi, a landowner, with whom she had a baby girl. Artesi, who in the meantime has remarried to a wealthy heiress, provides for the maintenance of his ex-wife and daughter. The landowner, not trusting Adriana, has Giovanni watched over her. The latter, falling in love with her, pays tribute to her. Stefano will take Adriana's defense.
notes: Drama directed by Luigi Capuano, action film specialist.

title: Bounce
actors: Ben Affleck, Gwyneth Paltrow, Joe Morton, Natasha Henstridge, Jennifer Grey, Tony Goldwyn
description: Buddy aims to get an atomic blonde to bed and then, to buy time, he gives his plane ticket to a guy to take his seat on board. It happens that the aircraft falls and the victim dies: Buddy is destroyed by feelings of guilt, but then he meets the inconsolable widow, Abby, and falls in love with her. Of course, if you knew that their meeting is not accidental ...
notes: "Bounce" means "to bounce" but also, as an adverb, "suddenly". Unfortunately, in Roos' film, there is suddenly nothing at all, starting with the references to "Sliding Doors"; the moralistic background on the remorse of the libertine protagonist is chilling.

title: John Carpenter's Ghosts of Mars
actors: Ice Cube, Natasha Henstridge, Pam Grier, Joanna Cassidy
description: 2176: on Mars, long colonized by terrestrials, an excavation brings to light the traces of a civilization buried for centuries. Abruptly awakened from their slumber, the zombies organize and start a riot: the groups led by policewoman Melanie and the outlaw James "Desolation" Williams are forced to form a common front ...
notes: The "Ghosts from Mars" look like Comanche. Or the Africans of "Zulu" (Cy Endfield's film), with piercings everywhere. This time Carpenter looks at classicism with an oblique gaze, because digital bursts (the "eye" of the Martians) and because the linearity of the story is torn apart by flashbacks, by the polyphony of the voices that echo events in a different way. Who can say that this is not the whole nightmare of a civilization that does not know how to survive except by "mutating", from film to film, in a different tyranny (here matriarchal, in theocratic "Escape from Los Angeles")? Or a lysergic dream of Melanie, high on pills? The theme of drugs, of the protagonist's drug addiction, is not as secondary as it seems: through the chemical alteration, she manages to drive out the Evil that has invaded her. A starting point for a dramatic reflection on the theme of the transfiguration. Very New Horror, very Eighties: the soul and the psyche change into "other than themselves" to highlight the manipulation. You can breathe the hardness and essentiality of the glorious B series but also the passion for those laconic characters, abruptly drawn, fascinating beyond stereotypes.

title: L'anglaise et le duc
actors: Lucy Russell, Jean-Claude Dreyfus, François Marthouret, Léonard Cobiant
description: The diary book of the noblewoman Grace Elliott, mistress of the Prince of Wales, the future King George IV and of Prince Philip, Duke of Orléans, is the chronicle of her days and her life since 1790. Faithful to the king, opposed to the Revolution , moderate, Grace works to save a fugitive, comes and goes from Paris, tries to dissuade the duke from voting in favor of the guillotine for the king, faces searches, sees the angry crowd in the streets and squares, meets Robespierre, comments and he gets excited about the Terror.
notes: Eric Rohmer adheres to his story and gives us an extraordinary technological lesson. He uses the digital to invent, through some tableaux, the scenographic frame of the time and a perspective of the gaze. No present day disguises or traditional studio exteriors. The shooting device is masterfully combined with the theoretical passion for a linear, "frontal" cinema, with a fixed or almost fixed camera, confident in the actors and in the immanence of the (magnificent) images. Sublime example of new Griffithian cinema. The speeches as very long captions. The interiors are like shells to experience the romantic earthquake of history in theatrical composure. Eric Rohmer's third costume film, Lion for Lifetime Achievement at the 58th Venice Film Festival, after "La marchesa von ..." and "Perceval".

title: Session 9
actors: Peter Mullan, David Caruso, Stephen Gevedon, Josh Lucas
description: Human suffering, experiments, the pain of the sick, possession, abuse permeate the air and walls of an old abandoned psychiatric hospital near Boston. A team of five workers from Hazmat Elimination Co. wins the contract for some works (to be completed in a few days), preliminary to the renovation of the asylum. The stress of the deadline, psychological weaknesses and unsolved problems of the five protagonists accentuate the vulnerability of the team and trigger the horror.
notes: Between disturbing architectures and mental labyrinths, Brad Anderson and his cast of actors (Peter Mullan's performance is excellent) build a dense and highly effective suspense, stimulating the emotional and intellectual side of the genre. An excellent example of "old style" horror that handles madness, places and bodies with competence.

title: The Navigators
actors: Joe Duttine, Tom Craig, Dean Andrews, Steve Huison, Venn Tracey
description: A group of Sheffield railroad workers go into crisis when the company they work for is privatized. The union guarantees that had protected them until a few years earlier are no longer valid. Flexibility has become the watchword, the slide (an incentive the azeinda gives you to get out of the way) is an overused word. In the end, even the dead man escapes and not to lose his job ...
notes: The director thinks about his films as he does with a "genre" that has gone through many maintenance coupons and is quite rigid. Ken Loach's films no longer amaze, but they don't mind. The result, this time, is weakened by the absence of more incisive actors.

title: Blow
actors: Johnny Depp, Penélope Cruz, Franka Potente, Rachel Griffiths, Jordi Mollà, Paul Reubens, Ray Liotta
description: A voiceover, which we later discover to be that of George Jung, tells us the story of his life. George is a cheerful consumer and small-time marijuana dealer who spends his time on the California beaches of the 1970s. Then he gets an idea: why not import cocaine directly from Colombia? Said, done: his wife Mirtha and his friend Diego will be his contacts in South America ...
notes: Any reference to "Goodfellas" is not accidental because, at least in the voice off of the protagonist who recounts and comments on his own phantasmagoric ascent and precipitous descent, there is the same flavor of hyperreal naturalness as in Henry Hill's live diary. . Like Scorsese's 1990 film, "Blow" is also based on a book that tells a true story: in place of Nicholas Pileggi there is Bruce Porter, and in place of Scorsese there is Ted Demme, who continues to try but fails to grasp Uncle Jonathan's caustic genius. And to think that, in the first half, the film seems to have hit on the segmented rhythm and caustic spirit that could make it the hilarious and merciless portrait of another "excellent American". Difficult to do Scorsese if you do not have his sense of tragedy and his tight stylistic rigor: so "Blow" ends up flattening out in a narrative that runs towards a foregone conclusion, showing us nothing but a wretch who has had his life ruined ( repeatedly) by an ignoble mother and treacherous friends.

title: The Fast and the Furious
actors: Paul Walker, Vin Diesel, Rick Yune, Jordana Brewster, Michelle Rodriguez, Chad Lindberg
description: By day Dominic is a good mechanic, by night he is the king of drag racing. He manages to cash in at $ 10,000 per race when someone makes up his mind to challenge him. Brian, he looks like a road warrior who isn't just waiting to show off. He is actually an undercover cop tasked with investigating a gang that carries out truck robberies.
notes: In 1955 there was the rabbit race; in 1993 there were the boys who lay down on the median line; today there are those who practice drag racing on the streets of Los Angeles. Only three of the films that tell the challenge with death and with themselves of restless young Americans. If the former is a masterpiece (Nicholas Ray's "Burnt Youth"), the last two (David S. Ward's "The Program" and Rob Cohen's "Fast and Furious") are honest genre films that play on spectacularity. Puritan America is indignant, today as in the days of "The Program", but it does not care too much about delving into the causes of youth discomfort and does not take into account the cathartic effect of these films. In fact, "Fast and Furious" is to be taken as a newly grown B movie in special effects: at breakneck speed, fun, adrenaline pumping. Not surprisingly, the title literally quotes a 1954 film by Roger Corman ("The Fast and the Furious", where John Ireland escaped from prison and joined a group of car racers to reach Mexico) and openly denounces its nature of pure entertainment.

title: The Curse of the Jade Scorpion
actors: Woody Allen, Helen Hunt, Charlize Theron, Dan Aykroyd
description: The Forties. A hypnotizing thief holds CW Briggs, a shrewd and unfortunate investigator of an insurance company, and his colleague, bitter enemy, Betty Ann Fitzgerald, hired to optimize and rationalize the office. Two simple words are enough, Constantinople for him and Madagascar for her, and the two are forced to steal and hide the jewels of the company's customers.
notes: The writer-director pays homage to 1940s cinema with a tried and tested panache, with many funny jokes and with a scaffolding of situations that showcase the artifice of the studio. Actor Allen is almost in better shape than director Allen and gives himself remarkable gags, gestures, faces and verbal turns. The fierce duet clashes between the CW and Betty Ann are inspired, with respect and without presumption, by the extraordinary and sparkling and unsurpassable ones between Spencer Tracy and Katharine Hepburn. Woody Allen and Helen Hunt are much uglier to begin with. The cast, as always, brings together actors who already seem satisfied with having their name in the opening credits, without thinking about the weight of the role (Theron is a bushy secondary appearance). While everywhere the restoration of old copies goes crazy, Woody Allen puts his films to season.

title: Swordfish
actors: John Travolta, Hugh Jackman, Halle Berry, Don Cheadle
description: Released from jail after two years, expert hacker Stanley Jobson finds himself in decidedly bad waters, also separated from his little daughter Holly (in custody of his ex-wife). So when the ambiguous but "patriotic" Gabriel Shear and his gorgeous partner-lover Ginger offer him an astronomical sum to help them carry out a sophisticated computer scam, Stanley can't help but accept ...
notes: Sena and producer-bomb engineer Joel Silver made the film inspired by 1960s adventure cinema, with highly spectacular "explosive" sequences. Captivating Travolta, the Berry fainting.

title: The Last Marshal
actors: Scott Glenn, Constance Marie, Randall Batinkoff, Vincent Castellanos
description: Cole, a Texan sheriff, goes to Miami as soon as he receives the news that an attempt was made on the life of a judge in the metropolis of Florida: it seems that the criminal action was organized by a key figure in the drug trafficking. , which now has a number of agents of the Goddess in its sights.

title: Into Thin Air: Death on Everest
actors: Peter Horton, Christopher McDonald, Pamela Gien
description: In May 1996, Mount Everest is the scene of one of the most infamous tragedies in the history of mountaineering: eight hikers, engaged in the challenge with the highest mountain in the world, are surprised by a snow storm while climbing to the summit . Based on the testimonies of the survivors (and of the journalist Jon Krakauer), we reconstruct the story of an expedition that - due to stupid ambitions, recklessness, irresponsibility, bad weather and bad luck - turned into a death trap. A further demonstration, if still needed, of how much it can cost to human beings to underestimate the power of nature.

title: Galaxy Quest
actors: Sigourney Weaver, Alan Rickman, Tim Allen, Tony Shalhoub, Sam Rockwell, Daryl Mitchell
description: Eighteen years after the television series "Galaxy Quest" ended, the five actors who played it - Jason Nesmith, Gwen DeMarco, Alexander Dane, Tommy Webber and Fred Kwan - continue to appear in public in situations such as science fiction conventions or openings. of shopping centers. The unexciting routine is interrupted when the Termians, extraterrestrials from the Klaatu galaxy, kidnap them and transport them to their planet. The aim: to obtain from the former stars - mistaken for real heroes - a help to defeat the enemy armies, led by the fearsome General Sarris ...
notes: The idea isn't bad, and the cast is luxurious.

title: Mon oncle d'Amerique
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Nicole Garcia, Roger-Pierre, Henri Laborit
description: Three parallel stories end up intertwining: the protagonists are Jean Le Gall, a TV official in marital crisis who would like to write an essay; René Ragueneau, a former farmer who has established himself as a textile technician; Janine Garnier, a stage actress who aspires to change her life.
notes: The rationalist and "theoretical" spirit of Resnais finds adequate support (thanks to the screenplay by Jean Gruault) in the sociobiologist Henri Laborit, who in the course of ad hoc interludes is responsible for enunciating in first person - not without irony - his own deterministic theses on infantile "imprinting". Challenging, but sharp and even fun.

title: Le saint prend l'affût
actors: Jean Marais, Raffaella Carrà, Jess Hahn, Daniel Evenou
description: Although dedicated to unlawful activities, the English adventurer Simon Templar never forgets good manners. His generosity is such as to push him to bail out a friend who is in dire straits and is involved in an intrigue of American and German spies. And the daughter is also involved ...
notes: The French grappling with a British national hero like Simon Templar ... There is a diplomatic incident to be created! The result, however, is tasty precisely because naÏf. Among other things, the cast also includes the two national "usual unknowns" Tiberio Murgia and Carlo Pisacane, as well as the unmissable Raffaella Pelloni aka Carrà.

title: La baby-sitter
actors: Maria Schneider, Sydne Rome, Renato Pozzetto, Nadja Tiller, Clelia Matania
description: Michelle, a girl who moved to Rome to study sculpture, supports herself by babysitting. She ends up involved in the kidnapping of Booth, the son of Franklin, a wealthy industrialist. The plan is orchestrated by the rich man's secretary and implemented by Ann, an actress who had once been the mistress of the captain of industry. Segregated with the kidnapped in a villa, Michelle tries unsuccessfully to escape to warn the police and the searches for her boyfriend are also in vain. But unexpected help will come.
notes: The latest film directed by René Clement is a dull thriller, not very lively and penalized by a freely twisted development.

title: Pit Stop
actors: Richard Davalos, Brian Donlevy, Ellen Burstyn, Sid Haig
description: Grant Willard, ambitious team boss, hires young driver Rick Bowman to help him break through in a new competition called "figure eight". The efforts of the two are thwarted by a fierce and unscrupulous rival, Hawk Sidney.
notes: Typical product of the famous Roger Corman "factory".

title: Basquiat
actors: Jeffrey Wright, David Bowie, Dennis Hopper, Gary Oldman, Michael Wincott, Benicio Del Toro, Christopher Walken, Willem Dafoe, Jean-Claude La Marre, Parker Posey, Elina Löwensohn, Courtney Love, Tatum O'Neal
description: Jean-Michel Basquiat is a young New York street artist. The fortuitous encounter with Andy Warhol suddenly projects him into the sophisticated milieu of the Soho art galleries; but this environment, pervaded with cynicism and opportunism, is not for Jean-Michel: who despite the love of Gina, his girlfriend, falls prey to a depressive state that will worsen with the death of Warhol and will lead him - only 27 years old - to one last, fatal heroin overdose.
notes: The artist Schnabel makes his directorial debut with this "exemplary" parable on the emptiness of human fortunes, visually interesting but weighed down by an excessive propensity for metaphor.

title: The Girl Next Door
actors: Tracey Gold, Tom Irwin, Michael Dorn, Mark Camacho
description: A girl decides to go to a police station to confess to a murder but runs away before she has declared anything. Later the girl confides in Gayle a psychologist. Thanks to a flashback, it is revealed that the woman was having an affair with an agent. The man used her to kill his wife ...

title: Giuseppe di Nazareth
actors: Tobias Moretti, Ennio Fantastichini, Renato Scarpa, Mattia Sbragia, Stefania Rivi
description: Joseph, belonging to the dynasty of David, is a young thirty-year-old carpenter busy working on the gate of the temple in Jerusalem. In the city and in the kingdom, the political situation is very tense: King Herod is considered a tyrant and his sons - Antipater, Aristobulus and Alexander, born of different mothers - are in constant struggle with each other for the throne; in the meantime the zealots, religious extremists, try by every violent means to get rid of the wretched dynasty. And it is precisely at the temple that Joseph, five years after his departure from Nazareth, meets Joachim and Anna, accompanied by their young daughter Maria.

title: When the Bough Breaks
actors: Martin Sheen, Ally Walker, Ron Perlman, Tara Subkoff
description: Houston, Texas: Inspector Audrey MacLeah finds herself a hot dog when, after a heavy downpour, someone finds a plastic bag containing some human hands, each of which has a number tattooed on the palm. A very young telepath will also collaborate in the investigations.
notes: Film "de fear" with paranormal veins.

title: The Lesser Evil
actors: Tony Goldwyn, Colm Feore, Arliss Howard, David Paymer
description: After having made it big to the detriment of two peers, four boys believe they can get away with it. But years later, new evidence emerges, and lumber merchant Derek, attorney George, priest Ivan, and policeman Frank are forced to get together and decide what to do next.
notes: Built in flashbacks, a film with intermittent tension.

title: Cement
actors: Chris Penn, Jeffrey Wright, Sherilyn Fenn, Henry Czerny
description: Cops in Hollywood, in the long run Holt and Nin crossed the threshold and turned into an authentic pair of drug addict gangsters. When Holt surprises his girlfriend Lyndel in the company of Sean, right-hand man of drug kingpin Truman Rickart, Nin does everything he can to prevent his colleague's violent reaction from causing irreparable trouble. Too late...
notes: Echoes of Scorsese, Ferrara and Tarantino in the directorial debut of actor Adrian Pasdar ("The darkness is approaching", "Carlito's Way"). Opened by a long scene of torture and told in flashbacks, a story that is not very original but written and acted with professionalism.

title: Alla rivoluzione sulla due cavalli
actors: Adriano Giannini, Gwenaëlle Simon, Andoni Gracia, Francisco Rabal
description: In the aftermath of the "carnation revolution", the Italian Marco and the Portuguese exile Victor leave Paris on board of two canary-yellow horses to reach Lisbon, which has just greeted the end of the dictatorship. On the way, the two stop in Bordeaux to greet Victor's ex-girlfriend, the French Claire, who will continue the journey with them ...
notes: Confessions, songs, small disagreements, car breakdowns, a liberating bath, physiological stops, tenderness, landscapes, back roads, borders, movie posters, photos, red flags, clenched fists and some archive images. Maurizio Sciarra knows - and proves it - that working on Marco Ferrari's novel of the same name means making a period film about the Seventies that cannot ignore political illusions, musical memories, cinematographic references and some mythologies. The narrative engine is solid and at low speed like that of the car that transports the naive and likeable protagonists. An "on the road" film includes a series of encounters (from Franco's count to Claire's husband, from uncle Francisco Rabal to the poet) and almost all of them enter the lane of the "picturesque".

title: Safar e Ghandehar
actors: Niloufar Pazira, Hassan Tantai, Sadou Teymouri
description: Nafas, an Afghan-born journalist who lives and works in Canada, wants to clandestinely return to her homeland to look for her sister who remained there and who announced her decision to commit suicide during the solar eclipse of 11 August 1999. To Nafar begins the immersion in Afghanistan of the women forced to bury themselves under the impenetrable burqa and of the men who, mutilated by the war, chase artificial legs parachuted from a helicopter.
notes: The film is in favor of a more than just cause: the liberation of a people, especially of its women who, even when they go to the doctor (in this case a black American!), Cannot speak to them directly or - let alone - be examined. . The point is, however, whether the operation can be credible. The impression is that too often, over the tragedy, the postcard atmosphere, the beautiful colors, the beautiful desert and metaphors in handfuls prevail. Commitment, rhetorical temptations, humanitarian causes, decorative virtuosities: an at least ambiguous mixture.

title: Mari del Sud
actors: Diego Abatantuono, Victoria Abril, Giulia Steigerwalt, Chiara Sani
description: The Brogini, a bourgeois family, used to luxury and a boring management of emotional relationships, is preparing to go on vacation to a town in the Tropics, when they discover the existence of poverty. Their financial promoter has run away with their money and the three, father, mother and daughter, must abruptly change their plans and spend two weeks hidden in the cellar in order not to let envious friends and colleagues smell their status as new destitutes. In that financially desperate situation they also rediscover a new economy of affections.
notes: A surreal comedy, with a hint of pathos, "Mari del Sud" offers various moments of comedy that recalls the best Italian comedy of the 70s, due to the presence of the Cannavale icon in the role of a neighbor who is a nuisance with a passion for botany . The story is not exactly brand new, but Marcello Cesena, with the help of a harmonious and guessed cast in which Victoria Abril's lust stands out, with a retouch here and an adjustment there, makes it attractive and those who love the cyclone Abatantuono will be able to appreciate his joys.

title: La rentrée
actors: Francesco Salvi, Livia Bonifazi, Nando Gazzolo, Pasquale Anselmo
description: Among the boys of the Ortica band, the Chiodo, the Denti, the Franchino, Mario Gibellini, known as "Danseur", stands out. He grew up in the gyms of an anonymous hinterland shooting boxing and soon got into trouble with the law. After jail, he tries to rewind the threads of a dream, that of the ring, not to mention that from certain environments it is difficult to leave with intact bones. Too bad, because his wife Teresa loves him, yes, but she is not cracked and has a name that too closely recalls the roughness of the Buscaglione girls.
notes: More than dignified the dramatic debut of Francesco Salvi in ??the cinema. Despite the poverty of the film (low low budget) you can breathe the Milan of the past, that of the songs of the bad. Director Franco Angeli has some beautiful writing ideas (flashbacks, the division of the story into "shots") and it is a pity that the atmospheres of the film are often only hinted at, due to force majeure (mostly productive). Few people know that Nando Gazzolo, excellent here too, was a true boxer in his youth.

title: Pier Paolo Pasolini e la ragione di un sogno
description: An anomalous figure in the context of our culture Pasolini, an anomalous figure Laura Betti, singer, actress, writer and now also a director. And, above all else, curator of the "legacy" of her friend (and teacher) Pasolini, to whom an "author's monograph" is finally dedicated to her care: affectionate and rightly tendentious, passionate and yet very lucid. Because, by editing interviews and excerpts from films, delegating to the great friend of PPP and great poet and writer Paolo Volponi (it is moving to see and listen to Pier Paolo again but it is also moving to see and listen to Paolo Volponi again) the story of the most private and most intimate PPP, choosing and organizing or, at times, disorganizing her materials, Betti goes with a sure hand to the essentials, without indictment, because images and words speak for themselves. Didactic film, conceived above all for those who have no memory of Pasolini, his film is inextricably linked with political aesthetic ethics. In it, PPP appears to us "in the present", because it speaks to us of what it first intuited, understood and explained to the point of death, and of what won and changed us, of the world in which we are and of which we are clearly aware also thanks to films to poems to novels to interviews with essays to reviews to conversations to recitations of the most important and necessary Italian prophet of the twentieth century.

title: A mosca cieca
actors: Carlo Cecchi, Laura Troschel, Joseph Valdambrini, Ciro Moglioni
description: Guided by Chance, an individual finds a revolver in a parked car and decides to use it to strike - equally randomly - an unsuspecting victim chosen from the crowd leaving the stadium.
notes: Experimental in form, inspired by the Camusian "Stranger", rejected by censorship: an unusual and stimulating film.

title: Ravanello pallido
actors: Luciana Littizzetto, Massimo Venturiello, Neri Marcoré
description: Gemma is a woman like many others. Secretary in a talent agency, she turns her life around when she decides to change her hair color ...
notes: The story gets clogged up all the time and never manages to be original or funny. Some of the actors are more interesting than their very mundane characters.

title: Moulin Rouge!
actors: Nicole Kidman, Ewan McGregor, Jim Broadbent, John Leguizamo
description: Christian, a penniless writer, arrives in Paris in 1899 and, having gone to the Moulin Rouge, falls in love with can can and Satine, a beautiful woman, who performs in the club. For a misunderstanding he is mistaken for the Duke of Monroth and finds himself in his room. He is hired to write a show featuring Satine. She will have to deal with the duke, who, in love with Satine, tries to bind her indissolubly to himself.
notes: With "Ballroom" he had done some general rehearsals, in economics and following a more familiar and recognizable imaginary; with "Romeo + Juliet" he had taken the most elementary and passionate of love stories head on, riding with contempt of danger and kitsch in the fashion of Shakespearean transposition; and with "Moulin Rouge" he risks everything and even creates a musical by superimposing various rock classics on the visual phantasmagoria of the late nineteenth century temple of vice. Every visual detail, every verse sung, loses its personal connotation and becomes a harmonic part of the whole: from the songs of Elton John, Bowie, Madonna, to Offenbach's "Can can" which occasionally echoes and, in a number, explodes triumphantly , from Kidman's 1940s dark lady hairstyle. The mixture was already the winning card of "Romeo + Juliet"; here Luhrmann takes it to the extreme, erases the boundaries, throws himself headlong into the optical and musical "places" of popular culture of a century and a half. Rightly, in the service of a love story. The film won two Oscars for scenography and costumes.

title: Commandments
actors: Anthony La Paglia, Aidan Quinn, Courteney Cox, Peter Jacobson
description: After the death of his wife, who disappeared two years earlier in the ocean, Seth Warner's life has turned into hell: a tornado destroyed his house while leaving the rest of the neighborhood intact, his boss fired him and even the dog was struck by lightning. During a hospital stay, poor Seth comes to the conclusion that God himself must be angry with him; and prodded by his brother-in-law Harry's conduct, he decides to challenge the Creator by breaking each of the ten biblical commandments ...
notes: After a promising start, Taplitz loses the thread and ends up partially neutralizing an interesting idea.

title: My Mother Frank
actors: Sinead Cusack, Matthew Newton, Rose Byrne, Nicholas Bishop
description: Frances Kennedy alias "Frank" Ryan, widow and fervent Catholic, with two grown children and some grandchildren, decides to attend an art course at the same university as her son David: her existence and that of her family members will suffer a jolt.
notes: Discreet directorial debut of the screenwriter of _Babe va in città_.

title: La stanza del figlio
actors: Nanni Moretti, Laura Morante, Giuseppe Sanfelice, Jasmine Trinca
description: Giovanni, a psychoanalyst from Ancona, is summoned by the principal of his son Andrea's school, accused of stealing a fossil. At home, the man discusses with his wife Paola about the responsibility of the son, who denies the theft and mends the break with his parents in advance. Some time later Andrea dies during a dive and the life of Giovanni, Paola and the second daughter Irene is shattered.
notes: How affliction is communicated. According to Nanni Moretti through an aesthetic of modesty, the one that makes this film rigorous and beautiful. A moral look at pain capable of not making emotions spectacular.

title: 7 donne d'oro contro due 07
actors: Mickey Hargitay, Maria Vincent, Luciana Paoli, Vincenzo Cascino
description: A mysterious treasure hidden by the Nazis, traceable by means of a map drawn on the back of some paintings attributed to Goya. It is with this mirage that a Roman antiquarian has outwitted a series of unfortunate art lovers. Who, enticed by the mirage, set out to hunt for the phantom booty. But the real luck is another: the treasure exists, but it is not what we expected.
notes: Mild spy-like mess of national production (setting between Rome, Taormina and the castle of Balsorano) by Cascino, improvised director, here also actor in the Armenian part, as in the contemporary _The 7 Chinese gold_.

title: La paura fa 90
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Silvana Pampanini, Franca Marzi, Carlo Croccolo
description: Carlo Maltivoglio, singer in a magazine company, is forced to spend a night in a castle. Carletto does not know that the manor is inhabited by the ghost of the Duke of Boffignac, captain of the king's musketeers, killed by a betrayed husband. The ectoplasm is doomed to roam forever until it avenges its violent death. The comedian of the company, having learned of the story, disguises himself as a ghost and at midnight precisely makes his appearance in the halls of the castle. Unfortunately for her, she runs into the real ghost ...
notes: Third film starring Ugo Tognazzi. Screenplay by Metz, Marchesi, Amendola and Vecchietti.

title: Vajont
actors: Michel Serrault, Daniel Auteuil, Laura Morante, Jorge Perrugorria
description: At 10.39 pm on 9 October 1963, when the match between Real Madrid and Glasgow Rangers is watched in the bars of Longarone, a gigantic landslide of 270 million cubic meters detaches from Mount Toc, falls into the artificial lake of Vajont and raises an immense wave that crosses the dam and crashes into the valley below, sweeping everything away and killing more than two thousand people.
notes: Martinelli wants to combine civil commitment and entertainment, high cost (18 billion) and daily stories, accusations against the powerful of Sade, the ancestor of Enel, and adherence to lives (and to the death of the humble. There are all the arrogant and c 'is the heroine without fear, the journalist Tina Merlin, unfortunately there is no cinema.

title: L'emploi du temps
actors: Aurélien Recoing, Karin Viard, Serge Livrozet, Nicolas Kalsch
description: What do you do in life? "The manager" would answer Vincent, father of a family, wealthy, good person. Yet he lies, because he has been fired for more than three months and now he has to justify his long absences from home. Another job, an international assignment to the UN, but it's all a lie. That sooner or later someone finds out.
notes: Lion of the Year in Venice 2001, the film by Laurent Cantet (which debuted with "Human Resources"). Deserved. A dramaturgical construction conducted with glacial stylistic rigor to underline the only ontological principle of our world: "work therefore I am". What if someone no longer works? Maybe by choice? Vincent's story would only seem exemplary if it weren't inspired by a real fact, which ended in a much more tragic way than the film. Even if on closer inspection the last sequence that Cantet gives to our eyes is chilling and seems to open up to a Michael Haneke-like scenario. "Full time" rewrites (or demonstrates how they have rewritten) the rules of coexistence based on the formal requirements of the "profession". Even in language, in everyday talk, when a "happy communication" is established between colleagues and not a human relationship. After "Full-time" one cannot help but think of the Big Lebowsky as a modern-day hero.

title: Luna rossa
actors: Toni Servillo, Licia Maglietta, Domenico Balsamo, Carlo Cecchi
description: The Cammararo family, linked to the world of the Camorra, has shown an undeniable vocation for dirty business since the early 1970s. Gradually it has spread over the territory and at the same time it is perched in its estate-fort. Now the balance, built on an oppressive hierarchical scale, is falling apart thanks to the last generations. The young people of the family feel, in some way, the weight of a life that no longer belongs to them.
notes: "They heard a song," Luna rossa ", a song about betrayal," says the matron of the Cammararo house. Betrayal and revenge, Aeschylus (but also Shakespeare) and the Camorra. Antonio Capuano reinterprets the Orestiade, locks up the characters in a house, makes the inevitable conflicts explode, following quite faithfully the structure of the classic text. Mélo and noir, mafia and tragedy: these are pairs to which (Italian) American cinema has accustomed us for some time. But to belittle "Red Moon" because Abel Ferrara has already been there makes no sense, it would be like saying that Jean-Claude Izzo is a minor writer because Homer was there centuries ago. In reality this is the (Italian) cinema that we have dreamed of for years; dense and maximalist. Excellent experimentation work on acting and language (from the Neapolitan of the slums to a more courtly form). Excellent all the first part suspended between the claustrophobia of the places, the oppression of the camera and the dramaturgy of a powerful story. Outstanding interpreters.

title: The Score
actors: Robert De Niro, Marlon Brando, Edward Norton, Angela Bassett
description: Nick Wells is a burglar who is contemplating indulging in a normal life, with a beautiful woman beside him and a jazz café to be run with passion, which is offered one last very rich blow. The temptation is strong and the man is not of stone and finds himself managing the blow with an old fence and a young rampant of his profession, with which some "misunderstanding" arises.
notes: Sometimes the cinema seems to function like the world of football where a team full of stars does not always win the championship, especially if the amalgam is missing, which some "rich" president believed was the name of a great player. "The Score" confirms this law and despite putting in the field the best of three generations of actors, Brando, De Niro and Norton, who just by writing them arouses fear, in the end the mountain gives birth to a medium-sized mouse. Frank Oz, an appreciated comedian with a pinch of madness, tries his hand at thriller and, all in all, he's not bad at telling the latest shot of a great burglar, a plot that has made the genre so successful. The rhythm, especially in the last part, is not bad, but the flavor is that of déjà-vu and the inevitable final twist doesn't add much more.

title: Belphégor. Le fantôme du Louvre
actors: Sophie Marceau, Michel Serrault, Frédéric Diefenthal, Julie Christie
description: Lisa, a longtime apple girl complete with a cheeky and nice grandmother, is possessed by Belfagor's black soul. The ectoplasm that took over the rooms of the Louvre came from a mummy endowed with evil powers. Old Inspector Verlac returns to the ancient crime sites to defeat the specter once and for all.
notes: The film is very badly written, pervaded by a vaguely demented spirit, undecided whether to scare or make people smile, chock full of bulky characters (like the keeper who is passionate about Egyptology). The icing on the cake is the "sculpted" sequence of seduction between Verlac / Michel Serrault and Julie Christie. Embarrassing.

title: Harrison's Flowers
actors: Andie MacDowell, David Strathairn, Elias Koteas, Adrien Brody
description: 1991: Harrison, photographer of "Newsweek", is sent to Yugoslavia to closely follow the beginning of a conflict that everyone considers minor; he, who has decided to quit, accepts the job as long as it is the last of his career. His wife Sarah is promised to return for her son's birthday, but Harrison is reported missing in the Osijek region. Sarah's world is shattered.
notes: Chouraqui is concerned with giving a plausible cohesion to the media questions, the sentimental implications and the reconstruction of the numerous fronts of an infernal "theater of war" experienced by the world on television.

title: La verità vi prego sull'Amore
actors: Francesco Apolloni, Carlotta Natoli, Veronika Logan, Pierfrancesco Favino
description: San Valentino, home of Elizabeth and Michelangelo. The two have been together for two years even though their relationship begins to falter. With them are Giulia and Gabriele, an apparently happy couple and then Monica who loves Lorenzo, Lorenzo who loves Olga, Olga who loves Luca ...
notes: We would like to have a group of actors with scarce qualities act (only Carlotta Natoli and Pierfrancesco Favino are saved), and we would like to make people laugh with ideas, situations, jokes from a drawl evening on the terrace. Leading the chorus in the cinema is an ambition worthy of old camera foxes, capable of dosing rhythms and, above all (in this specific case, more than ever), capable of squeezing the best from a comedian, without giving it too much to see. But the authorial mania of the filmmaker Apolloni is shipwrecked.

title: La figlia di Mata Hari
actors: Ludmilla Tchérina, Erno Crisa, Frank Latimore, Milly Vitale
description: Elyne, a talented dancer, performs at the Java Academy. Prince Anak struck by her beauty and sensuality proposes to her to perform in his club. The noble, who is preparing the revolt, does not know that Elyne is the daughter of Mata Hari.
notes: Merusi gets help from Gallone. The result is poor.

title: Saskatchewan
actors: Hugh O'Brian, Alan Ladd, Shelley Winters, Robert Douglas, J. Carroll Naish
description: Returning from a patrol tour in the Canadian mountains, Lieutenant O'Rourke comes across the remains of a burning caravan and Grace Markey, the only survivor of the massacre. The attack is the work of the Sioux, who after the victory over General Custer have crossed over and are about to convince the local Crow tribe to ally with them. O'Rourke, who was raised by the Crow, attempts to blow the deal while protecting Grace from the snares of the shady Sheriff Smith.
notes: As a great professional, Walsh uses Canada's beautiful natural landscapes as the backdrop for a story that enhances the peaceful coexistence of whites and reds.

title: Traversées
actors: Fadhel Jaziri, Julien Negulesco, Eva Derlan, Vincent Gras
description: Rejected by the British authorities while attempting to disembark in Dover, a dissident and penniless Polish worker and an Arab intellectual in possession of an expired visa undergo the same treatment upon arrival on the Belgian shore, finding themselves stranded on the ferry that crosses the English Channel.
notes: Bitter apologue on exile.

title: Last Rites
actors: Randy Quaid, Embeth Davidtz, A Martinez, Tracy Ellis, M.C. Gainey
description: Due to a transformer failure, multiple murderer Jeremy Dillion escapes execution unscathed. His nature, however, appears to have changed radically; not only that: the criminal psychiatrist Lauren Riggs, who deals with the phenomenon, finds in him the development of arcane gifts of foresight ...
notes: Discreet starting point, directing so-so.

title: Fast Times at Ridgemont High
actors: Sean Penn, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Judge Reinhold, Phoebe Cates
description: The vicissitudes of a group of high school students in Southern California. Stacy and Mark are looking for a love affair and are helped by older classmates, Linda and Mike. Jeff, on the other hand, has a passion for surfing and is constantly fighting with Professor Hand, convinced that everyone takes drugs.

title: Psycho-Circus
actors: Christopher Lee, Leo Genn, Eddi Arent, Klaus Kinski, Margaret Lee
description: A group of criminals carries out a daring blow to an armored van right in the middle of London Bridge. During the action, a guard is shot to death while trying to escape: the thread of the investigation leads the men of Scotland Yard to a mysterious circus, in which the main suspects turn out to be a disfigured and masked lion tamer, a vengeful master of ceremonies, an insanely jealous knife thrower and a shady dwarf ironically nicknamed "Mr. Big".
notes: A cast that is a guarantee for this film based on a novel by Edgar Wallace and shot simultaneously in two versions (English and German).

title: Quindici forche per un assassino
actors: Craig Hill, Susy Andersen, Aldo Sombrell, Tomas Blanco, Eleonora Brown
description: Bill and Cassel, leaders of two rival gangs unjustly accused of murdering three women, put aside the hatred that divides them and try to escape the ruthless manhunt unleashed by Steve, the boyfriend of one of the victims.
notes: An all too obvious Western directed by Nunzio Malasomma.

title: McCabe and Mrs. Miller
actors: Julie Christie, Warren Beatty, René Auberjonois
description: McCabe is a braggart without art or part. Constance, on the other hand, is an entertainer of character determined to defend her rendezvous house at all costs, which a mining company would like to have demolished. The two team up to fight together against the announced abuse.

title: Burnt Offerings
actors: Karen Black, Oliver Reed, Burgess Meredith, Bette Davis, Lee Harcourt Montgomery
description: The Rolfs think they had a brilliant idea: to go on vacation to a menacing, "Addams" style house (or worse, Bates motel). They do not know that the gothic mansion ready to welcome them feeds on the tenants to "rejuvenate itself".
notes: Theirs will be a memorable adventure. Horror "all star" which at the time had some success, and is also quite considered by the horror film community. More than twenty years later, however, it demonstrates its limits, especially in conventional staging, even if some nice twist ensures genuine fright.

title: Ch'ing shaonien na cha
actors: Chen Chao-jung, Jen Chang-bin, Lee Kang-sheng, Wang Wen-Yu
description: Challenging her parents, Hsiao Kang moves away from home and moves into the multicolored lights of downtown Taipei. The meeting with the young prostitute Ah Tze gives rise to a painful and thwarted relationship.
notes: With this second feature film, the Taiwanese director has established himself in the international limelight.

title: Primal Force
actors: Ron Perlman, Roxana Zal, Mark Kiely, Julian Sedgwick
description: A small tourism plane falls on an island populated by mutant monkeys. To help the crew components there is a courageous and unscrupulous guide, which begins a ruthless struggle against fearsome records.
notes: Modest film for television with Ron Perlman _ (Happy, Texas "and" The enemy at the gates) _.

title: Sfida al diavolo
actors: Christopher Lee, Bella Cortez, Adriana Ambesi, Eva Gioia
description: To convince a woman to return the documents she stole, a friar tells her the story that led him to conversion. The story narrated sees him as the protagonist of a night of revelry with a group of friends, which ended in a mysterious castle, where an old castellan lives who has sold his soul to the devil.

title: All'ovest di Sacramento
actors: Pierre Perret, Robert Hossein, Silvia Monti, Angelo Infanti
description: The Camorra Rocco settled in the Far West, where he runs a saloon and administers justice with very personal criteria. One day, in the vicinity of the village, a diligence loaded with gold is attacked, which, due to a series of circumstances, ends up in the hands of his niece Cat.
notes: Pretty obvious Western.

title: American Pie 2
actors: Jason Biggs, Eddie Kaye Thomas, Alyson Hannigan, Mena Suvari, Chris Klein
description: It's been twelve months, and Jim, Finch, Stifler, Oz, and Kevin - with their friends and girlfriends - are enjoying their summer vacation after freshman year of college: which wasn't as full of frenzied sexual experiences as it might have predicted the initiation that concluded high school. On the contrary, it was a rather sluggish time, with Oz engaged to Heather, Finch practicing the mantra hoping for a second meeting with Stifler's mom, and Jim caught in the act of winning last day of college from his usual nagging father and accomplice ...
notes: Everything is expected, from the direction of the packaging to the appearance of the girls of the first episode. But the five protagonists together have the right chemistry (and Jason Biggs, Eddie Kaye Thomas and Seann William Scott work great even alone) and several gags are really funny (the arrival of the father at the beginning, the solo of Jim, sortie into the lesbian house, the alternative use of the trumpet and that of the ointment tube). Ultimately, a hit of "healthy" vulgarity.

title: Cats & Dogs
actors: Jeff Goldblum, Elizabeth Perkins, Alexander Pollock, Miriam Margolyes
description: Professor Brody, a brilliant and inattentive scientist, has developed a serum that can eliminate the problem of dog allergy. But the cats, led by the perfidious Persian Mr. Tinkles, try to take possession of the discovery to turn it into a planetary source of hostility towards eternal enemies ...
notes: The story closely resembles those produced by Disney in the 1960s, with the various "mad professors" who invented astonishing inventions in the basements of their houses. Overall, however, it does not seduce that much: what is striking instead is the extraordinary level of CGI animation, capable of transforming quadrupeds into great actors.

title: Jalla! Jalla!
actors: Fares Fares, Torkel Peterson, Laleh Pourkarim, Leonard Terfelt
description: Roro, the son of a Lebanese who emigrated to Stockholm, is well integrated: he does a humble but fun job and has a cute girlfriend who loves him. But one day he discovers that his family has arranged for him a marriage with a compatriot. Roro does not know how to hide the situation from his girlfriend and in the meantime tries to change his parentage ...
notes: The ethnic picture of Europe is constantly changing, and the cinema of the "melting pot" is no longer at home only in England or France. Fares' film (produced by Lukas Moodysson) takes us to Scandinavia, unleashing good verve and tasty skits in which sex often peeps out. The title stands for "Presto, presto!".

title: Le placard
actors: Daniel Auteuil, Gérard Depardieu, Thierry Lhermitte, Michel Aumont, Jean Rochefort
description: François Pignon is a boring accountant who risks losing his job; Félix Santini is the macho colleague who haunts him; Belone is François's neighbor, who gives him the brilliant idea to save himself: pretending to be homosexual. In fact, the company produces condoms, and will never dare to fire a gay ...
notes: The film consciously stages some clichés to see how they work, how they affect interpersonal relationships. All the actors are wonderful, the script is just perfect. And if Veber may seem a little "visual", it is hardly necessary to remember that even people like Hawks and Wilder theorized "invisible" directing.

title: Tre mogli
actors: Francesca D'Aloja, Iaia Forte, Silke, Greg, Loles Leon
description: Three married women, with three different incomes, lifestyles, patterns of marital rhetoric and distracted unhappiness discover that their husbands, employed in the same bank, have disappeared with nine billion. This escape is the best end-of-year toast that Beatrice, Bianca and Billie could wish for. They find themselves together, first with annoyance and then with understanding, melancholy and euphoria, all female on the trail of fugitives in Argentina.
notes: Marco Risi starts again from another New Year, after the misadventures and disappointments of "The last New Year" based on the book by Niccolò Ammaniti. This time it does not look at an ephemeral literary sub-genre. Think of the extraordinary and sparkling tradition of father's cinema (his own and the other historical directors), of the often profound joy of Italian comedy. From Buenos Aires to Patagonia. Journey and enchantment of disorientation (above all classic disconnect between places and comedy characters), lightness and comedy, tango steps and costume notes that alternate with gags, secret homages and healthy malice, tourists by chance and above all wives on the verge of a metamorphosis of characters. All that women can say without wondering what they are doing at the end of the world.

title: Azzurro
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Marie-Christine Barrault, Jean-Luc Bideau
description: After thirty years spent in Geneva as master builder in the Boyer civil engineering enterprise, Giuseppe retires and finally returns to his native Puglia. Here her only granddaughter, Francesca, seven years old, is waiting for a corneal transplant that should restore her sight: to speed up the times, Giuseppe decides to return to Switzerland again to ask his former employer for the money necessary for the intervention...
notes: Between stylized flashbacks in ridicule and contemporary references that put the chills, the first work for the big screen by the Swiss Rabaglia increases the dose and mixes two elements that often cause disasters in the cinema: the elderly and children.

title: The Princess Diaries
actors: Anne Hathaway, Julie Andrews, Hector Elizondo, Heather Matarazzo
description: A college girl, with bushy eyebrows and the ill grace of an undeveloped adolescence, suddenly discovers that she is the Crown Princess of Genovia, a romantic European principality. Father is dead and grandmother Queen Clarissa arrives in San Francisco to provide Mia's quick training for her new role.
notes: Garry Marshall with the collaboration of Scott tries again atmospheres and rhythms to the "Pretty Woman", but is probably conditioned by a too rosy story, for families only. Anne Hathaway has grace and clumsiness, a face that hangs between Judy Garland and Groucho Marx and Audrey Hepburn in "Roman Holiday". Underused Hector Elizondo and Heather Matarazzo.

title: Santa Maradona
actors: Stefano Accorsi, Anita Caprioli, Libero De Rienzo, Mandala Tayde
description: The newly graduated Andrea, from Turin (and Juventus) with a sentimental menage full of surprises, aspires to a full-time job. Meanwhile, he lives a love story with Dolores and a friendship with the exotic Lucia and the nice roommate Bart.
notes: The newcomer Marco Ponti uses a standard canvas of the brilliant comedy (boys and girls without instructions for use; the protagonist is cool and messed up, anarchist and messy best friend) but avoids the traps of the banal by working well on the screenplay. Situations, characters and above all dialogues give the film an engaging rhythm, and the actors are nice. Sorry only for the excessive satisfaction of the gags: the jokes, especially those put in the mouth of Libero De Rienzo, are sometimes false, not very essential for the economy (and fluidity) of the story. However, in today's average Italian cinema, where everyone has disproportionate ambitions, it is positive that there are productions that are proud only of their raison d'etre, that of entertaining with taste. The film is dedicated to Brigitte Bardot, Bud Spencer and Terence Hill. Also to Jean-Luc Godard, but let's ignore it.

title: Party Girl
actors: Parker Posey, Sasha von Scherler, Omar Townsend, Guillermo Diaz
description: After getting into trouble, the young Mary - a bit of a butterfly from New York - has to repay the deposit paid by her godmother, an austere librarian, and agrees to give her a hand: little by little she becomes passionate about both the new job and Mustafa, a Lebanese felafel seller ...
notes: Lively and bright enough.

title: Dunston Checks In
actors: Rupert Everett, Faye Dunaway, Jason Alexander, Graham Sack
description: Robert Grant is the stressed-out manager of the Majestic, a five-star hotel. Her greatest wish would be to be able to spend a well-deserved holiday with her children Kyle and Brian: but when the owner of the Majestic, mrs. Dubrow, learns that the hotel is a candidate for a sixth star from a prestigious international guide, instructs Robert to prepare everything for the imminent arrival (obviously incognito) of the inspector. Could it be Lord Rutledge, who shows up in the company of a baby orangutan named Dunston?
notes: Simple comedy, based on misunderstandings and goofy monkeys.

title: Top Girl
actors: Carla Dujany Solaro, Robert Madison, Sonia Topazio, David D'Ingeo
description: Patricia, an actress in grass, moved to Los Angeles to interpret a soap opera. Arriving at success he must deal with the jealousy of his boyfriend who badly stands the environment in which she works and the court that Mike makes to the girl. Patricia, reluctantly, is forced to retrace his steps, but this will lead to numerous imbalances in his life as a couple.
notes: At the time the film made some fleeting appearance in the room. Operation of devastating ugliness and of useless presence. A sort of sentimental brick seasoned with trivial eroticism and continuous signings (failed) to the author 'hero. Joe D'Amato here does not reach the objectives and stops at the lowest instincts.

title: Rupan sansei: Dead or Alive
description: In the Republic of Zufu, ruled by Colonel Kubikari, the galleys are full of rebels, faithful to the ex-king and aware that they will never leave alive again. One day, the director of the prison carries out an unexpected inspection and picks up all the prisoners accused of espionage and rebellion as if it were time for their execution.
