Amidst the general disbelief, however, these shady characters are made to escape by the director himself, who soon turns out to be the fearless Lupine III in disguise: our hero, in fact, had heard rumors about the existence of a treasure that belonged to the former. -re, and hoped that some of his loyalists would know where he was hidden.

title: Wandafuru raifu
actors: Arata, Erika Oda, Susumu Terajima, Taketoshi Naitô, Kyôko Kagawa
description: Once dead, men and women can carry only one fundamental memory of earthly life into the afterlife. For this reason, at the gates of heaven some counselors help in the choice. One of these, Shiori, falls in love with the recently dead Mochizuki.
notes: Unusual love story in a film of considerable charm.

title: The Prophecy II
actors: Christopher Walken, Jennifer Beals, Brittany Murphy, Russell Wong
description: Did you believe that Heaven would no longer run the risk of becoming hell? Well, you were wrong, because the Archangel Gabriel - envious of God's love for men - is still determined to unleash (and win) his war. So he returns to Earth with a specific will: to kill Valerie, who carries the one who will save mankind in her womb ...
notes: Second episode of the saga on the war of angels (the rebellious ones against those faithful to the Lord) after the remarkable and imaginative _The last prophecy_. Walken plays and has fun, but the story seems too much that of _Terminator_ to reserve any real surprises.

title: Il male oscuro
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Emmanuelle Seigner, Stefania Sandrelli, Vittorio Caprioli, Nestor Garay
description: With the regret of not having been able to give the last farewell to his father, a despotic marshal of the carabinieri, the writer Giuseppe Marchi sadly reached the threshold of middle age. After leaving the French widow Sylvaine, he gets pregnant and marries a girl much younger than him. Professionally very dissatisfied, he suffers from unknown and excruciating pains, he undergoes surgery for a non-existent ulcer and appendicitis and tries in vain to commit suicide ...
notes: Monicelli tackles the novel of the same name by Giuseppe Berto (adapted by Suso Cecchi d'Amico and Tonino Guerra) but fails to fully grasp its complexity, falling back on inappropriate tones of an Italian comedy.

title: Tre passi nel delirio
directors: Roger Vadim, Louis Malle, Federico Fellini
actors: Jane Fonda, Alain Delon, Brigitte Bardot, Terence Stamp
description: M_etzengerstein_: rejected by her cousin, a noblewoman causes a fire that will be fatal to both of them. _William Wilson_: a dishonest officer challenges a double who haunts him to a duel. _Toby Dammit_: a drunk actor, who has just landed in Cinecittà, is haunted by the ghostly figure of a little girl playing ball.
notes: Collective film, as was the custom at the time, in which three very different directors give body to the atmosphere of the great American writer. And if the two Frenchmen disappoint, focusing more on the charm of their stars (Fonda and Delon-Bardot), Fellini unleashes a disturbing, macabre and convincing horror, inspired by Mario Bava.

title: Passing Glory
actors: Andre Braugher, Rip Torn, Ruby Dee, Bill Nunn, Daniel Hugh Kelly
description: An angry young priest, Father Joseph, who works in 1960s New Orleans, collides with his superior, Father Robert. Joseph stands up to have the parish basketball team, made up entirely of black boys of popular extraction, compete with the neighborhood's good school team, obviously made up only of white boys. Indeed, Father Joseph is absolutely convinced that his team is unbeatable.
notes: Slums, a parish priest on the front line and sport, this time basketball, as an element of social redemption. There are all the ingredients for a politically correct film.

title: Original Sin
actors: Antonio Banderas, Angelina Jolie, Thomas Jane, Jack Thompson
description: Bonnie Castle is in prison waiting to be executed and tells of a late nineteenth-century Cuba, festive and fragrant with the aroma of coffee, of how she replaced Julia, Luis's betrothed, and deceived, robbed and entangled in the whirlpools the husband of passion.
notes: Michael Cristofer is more of a screenwriter with a passive imagination than a director. He is anxious to line up the scenes, to baste the story with horizontal logic. The novel that inspired it, "Waltz Into Darkness" by Cornell Woolrich (the same one used by Truffaut for "My Drug Is Called Julie"), is the spice to flavor the whim of putting Banderase Jolie in the same film and in the same bed. .

title: Hedwig and the Angry Inch
actors: John Cameron Mitchell, Michael Pitt, Miriam Shor, Andrea Martin
description: Hänsel grows up in East Berlin with a mother obsessed with the tragedy of the Holocaust and a father who sexually abuses him. Having become a teenager with uncertain sexuality, he has a dream: to become a rock star. Having changed his name to Hedwig, he would like to cross the ocean to try his luck: but it is not easy for him to arrive in America ...
notes: The director-actor-writer-John Cameron Mitchell translates one of his very successful off-Broadway play for the big screen and convinces all American critics (awards and reverences at the Sundance Film Festival) and German critics in one fell swoop (excellent reception in Berlin: Hänsel / Hedwig was born there). We do not share the enthusiasm. In fact, the story would also be intriguing if it did not echo things already seen (_Velvet Goldmine_) and above all already heard (the glam epic). Furthermore, the cinematic consistency leaves something to be desired, as the theatrical structure is so evident. A shame, because as a performer Mitchell is remarkable and chameleonic in taking on the appearance of an imaginary icon that ends up belonging to him skin. _Hedwig - The diva with something more_ (the Italian subtitle in bad taste) owes her best moments to her generosity in front of the camera.

title: Gouttes d'eau sur pierres brûlantes
actors: Bernard Giraudeau, Malik Zidi, Ludivine Sagnier, Anna Levine
description: Léopol and Franz: the first successful and charming German businessman, the second young lover trapped in a web of perverse seduction. Since the bourgeois culture does not admit freedom in love, the sentimental game between the two ends up consuming itself in the violence of a "cage", that of rules and social conventions. With Franz undergoing Léopold's idealistic projection of the "perfect family": he is the housewife who waits for him at home, in the kitchen, and brings him the newspaper while he lies down in an armchair. But it happens that Léopold seduces Franz's ex-girlfriend, Anna, while Vera, a transsexual who was once a lover of the strict businessman, also arrives at the house.
notes: François Ozon, who entered with "Under the sand" (made after "Drops of water") in the gallery of the great, retrieves a theatrical text never performed by Rainer Werner Fassbinder, "Tropfen auf heisse steine" (1964), and " he rewrites "for the screen, indulging his cold and alienated sensitivity. Thinking about the structure of the kammerspiel, "Drops of water" develops in a closed environment (the apartment) that refers to the symbolic prison of a set culture, devoid of any freedom and qualities of life, love and sex. The Fassbinderian mélo becomes a mechanism for revealing a world without a soul, and it is surprising that a director of just thirty-four is able to deal with a text of such beauty and complexity by making it "his" to the core, translating it without a television-like aesthetic. which recalls the moral poverty of a false context. Bernard Giraudeau is an awkwardly skilled actor.

title: Baby Boy
actors: A.J. Johnson, Tyrese Gibson, Taraji P. Henson, Ving Rhames, Omar Gooding
description: Jody, known as "Baby Boy", is a big black boy who is very attached to his mother, despite having a girl and a son settled in another apartment. Jealous of his new "stepfather" Melvin, Jody is torn between belonging to his gang, friendships and interest in neighbors. His life risks getting lost in a thousand streams, while the family (the real one) is in disarray ...
notes: After _Shaft_, Singleton returns home, to the Los Angeles ghetto of _Boyz'n the Hood_, to start looking "from within" the black community. _Baby Boy_ is a film that follows a thesis, stated right from the opening credits: the problem of black Americans is not knowing how to free themselves from a metaphorical Oedipus complex, aimed at the superstructures imposed by whites and passively accepted. Put it this way it seems like a blow: instead this time the director, formerly a declamatory and almost never incisive filmmaker, declares war on stereotypes about blacks with surprising vitality. Singleton does not have the gift of synthesis (the film lasts the classic quarter of an hour too long), but there is no doubt about its sincerity. Jody's story is basically hers too, made up of difficult choices and a maturity that is hard to conquer in the ghetto.

title: Capitan Corelli's Mandolin
actors: Nicolas Cage, Penélope Cruz, John Hurt, Christian Bale
description: When Corelli, the Italian captain of the occupation troops, lands on the island of Kefalonia, he is struck by the beauty of Pelagia, an ambitious girl. Corelli and his men are struck by the charm of the island and the local girls. Soon a tender feeling was born between Corelli and Pelagia. Forced to face the violent reality of war, the officer faces the possibility of leaving Kefalonia and the woman he is in love with.
notes: John Madden is the author and spreads focus and tourist trivia in every shot. Nicolas Cage offers one of his most hilarious performances, especially when he directs the Scala boys choir, the men under his orders.

title: Bedazzled
actors: Brendan Fraser, Elizabeth Hurley, Frances O'Connor, Miriam Shor
description: One day the Devil, hidden in the guise of a charming female, approaches Elliot Richards, a dark travet who loves a girl who has never taken him into consideration, and submits to him the classic Faustian pact. Seven desires at your disposal before selling your soul ...
notes: This time it is not the whims of Time (_Ricomincio da capo_) or the wonders of genetics (_I split in four_) to cause the change in a man inadequate compared to the world around him, but the charms of a devil in a skirt. Brendan Fraser makes up for the shortcomings of a repetitive script, which offers only alternating glimpses of comedy.

title: A Knight's Tale
actors: Heath Ledger, Mark Addy, Rufus Sewell, Shannyn Sossamon, Alan Tudyk
description: Squire William would like to take a step forward and become a knight. The opportunity presents itself to him when he accidentally meets a man who in exchange for clothes and food gives him documents that can make him pass as a noble. So on the death of the knight he serves William takes his place and fights in the tournament for the beautiful Jocelyn.
notes: Armor, knightly tournaments, court banquets, courtly love with various licenses, heirs to the throne, a talented writer, Chaucer, ruined by a passion for the game and noble girls. It would seem the return of a vein, but no one has more faith in the adventure with helmet and armor. The European challenge tour is the romance of old rodeo and the pragmatism of the tennis circus. Brian Helgeland, screenwriter of "LA Confidential" and dull director of "Payback" and "Conspiracy Hypothesis" for his excursion into the Middle Ages is accompanied by a pressing soundtrack (among others, Queen, Eric Clapton and AC / DC) without having the courage or the imagination to twist the plot towards a pop-rock musical, he manipulates, in some scenes, the make-up and costumes as if he wanted to take the characters to the disco and stops at the door. A series of indecisions that are reflected in the unmotivated 132 minutes of a film in which the strong moments (the tournaments) weaken in the repetition of images and the clash of weapons.

title: Fuga dall'arcipelago maledetto
actors: David Warbeck, Annie Belle, Tony King, Giancarlo Badessi
description: Borders of Cambodia. Tiger Joe, an American pilot, is hired by some of his old arms trafficker friends to supply the rebels. During the return to the base the aircraft is knocked down by the regular forces. Tiger is taken prisoner by a rebel patrol led by Kia, the daughter of a doctor who delights in being a nurse. The girl, who has been living with the natives for years, is forced to ask Tiger for help, who joins them. Meanwhile, three of his companions decide to prepare a new mission to go and find him.
notes: On the set of the film, shot in the Philippines during the monsoons, Riccardo Pallottini, director of photography, died.

title: Jack Reed: A Search for Justice
actors: Brian Dennehy, Charles S. Dutton, Susan Ruttan, Joe Grifasi
description: Arlene Reed works in the topless bar of her lover Win Carter, from whom she is expecting a child; the man, however, wants to force her to have an abortion, and in the face of her refusal he decides to kill her. Meanwhile, corruption spreads in the police department: Jack Reed and the new lieutenant Charles Silvera will try to stem it at any cost ...

title: Buckaroo - Il winchester che non perdona
actors: Dean Reed, Monica Brugger, Livio Lorenzon, Ugo Sasso
description: Accompanied by a friend, Lash travels to a village on the border with Mexico to take possession of a mine. Lash, a man of few scruples, takes possession of the Johnny goldfield and in a few years becomes the richest and most powerful owner in the area. Then one day Buckaroo arrives in the village, a horse tamer, who agrees to work on Johnny's behalf: facing many risks, his gang will fight against Lash's men.
notes: Buckaroo is played by singer Dean Reed, who pledged against the intervention of the Americans in Vietnam. Last film directed by Adelchi Bianchi, who died in 1968.

title: Twist of Fate
actors: Bruce Dinsmore, Chris Mulkey, Mädchen Amick, Don Jordan
description: Lennox, a successful photographer, kills young students after conducting them in his studio and portraying them. Despite numerous clues against him, the man is acquitted thanks to the pressures exercised on the members of the jury by the president, the chemist, Professor Carmichael. But the latter hides a second goal, in fact he intends to eliminate his former lover who has been blackmailing him for some years. Carmichael wants to kill the blackma with the fault on Lennox.
notes: Max Fischer directs an acceptable thriller. Mädchen Amick made his debut in 1989 in an episode of "Baywatch".

title: La pianiste
actors: Isabelle Huppert, Annie Girardot, Benoît Magimel, Susanne Lothar
description: In an attempt to escape from her obsessive mother, Erika Kohut - a woody and super-bourgeois piano teacher from Vienna - attends porn halls and peep shows, unleashing a sexuality made of voyeurism and sadomasochistic perversions. Walter, a young and talented student of hers, takes it into her head to seduce her ...
notes: Premise: Michael Haneke is a good director, but he has found a way of himself that makes him recognizable and, perhaps, gives him confidence. In a Haneke film we know that sooner or later we will be pinched. "La pianista", on the other hand, is a programmed pinch, whose unpleasantness appears to be studied at the table. There remains the undeniable strength of a film in which the melodies of Schubert and Beethoven comment on Erika's escapades (from the conservatory to the porn shop) and the superhuman test of Isabelle Huppert, now in office in the empyrean of divas. Two objections: Schubert's Trio (the same as "Barry Lyndon") is now inflated in the cinema, and the Cannes award for the young Benoît Magimel is really an exaggeration.

title: Raye makhfi
actors: Nassim Abdi, Cyrus Abidi, Youssef Habashi, Farrokh Shojaii
description: The sun rises on the island of Kish and a soldier wakes up a colleague of his who is sleeping on a miserable cot. What starts today is a different day than usual, today is election day. From the sky, parachuted from a plane, the urn landed. Soon the person in charge of collecting the votes will arrive. The surprise is great for the soldier because the teller is a woman and asks to be escorted.
notes: "The vote is secret" confirms the rule that good movies are first or second works, and old ones are just that old. It may also follow that young people age immediately, but we are ready to bet on Babak Payami because, as well as a true director, he seems to us an excellent "thinker". What is your film, in fact, with the free ways of an open work and based on a delicate story about the relationship between two different people in the intense round of one-day meetings, if not a political-philosophical treatise on a theme basic? The theme is the relationship between "backwardness" and "modernity", between a traditional (oppressive, military) model of power and state and democracy (a Western invention: what can it become in those contexts)? The film is not a parable, it is not a pamphlet, it is not a treatise, it is a true open story that refers (lightly to one of the greatest dilemmas of our time. And it is a new way of being in Iranian cinema: neither miniatures nor "pieces of real life." The film won the special jury prize in Venice.

title: The Fourth Angel
actors: Jeremy Irons, Forest Whitaker, Charlotte Rampling, Jason Priestley
description: Jack, the editor of a newspaper, decides to surprise his wife and three children and organizes, without their knowledge, a trip to India. However, it happens that the plane on which they are traveling is hijacked by a group of terrorists who brutally kill his wife and one of his daughters. Back in London, Jack tries to make sense of the tragedy, but is mortified when he learns that the terrorists have been released. All that remains is to do justice by yourself.
notes: The film is meant to be glossy and introspective, but it just ends up being deadly boring and not at all credible. To damage him even more a dubbing by complaint.

title: Streghe verso Nord
actors: Teo Mammucari, Paul Sorvino, Daniele Liotti, Emmanuelle Seigner
description: Gallium and Teo are two witch defusers. Their task is to find them and fight them by any means. The second is secretly in love with his sister-in-law Lucilla without knowing that she is a supreme witch. Teo will have to resort to the teachings of Gallium (a warhead, seven steps to the north and a flash of light to forget everything) to try to make it harmless.
notes: The film is, above all in intentions, a mix of two genres. The fantastic aspect is barely verbalized; the comedy should come from the use of a character of television origin. But Teo Mammucari has, at least in this film, neither a character, nor an actor's presence nor eyes.

title: The Pledge
actors: Jack Nicholson, Robin Wright, Aaron Eckhart, Patricia Clarkson
description: Jerry Black is about to leave the Nevada Criminal Police upon reaching the age limit. His colleagues have prepared a farewell party for him, with a trip to Mexico as a gift: but when he learns that two agents from his section are dealing with the rape and murder of a child, he decides to continue investigating .. .
notes: Capable of restoring the abstract desolation of a world invaded by snow or sunburned, the film that Penn based on Dürrenmatt's book is one of those "underground" works to which the cinema, unfortunately, has by now become unaccustomed. Extraordinary Nicholson, pervaded by a lacerating and painful despair.

title: No Man's Land
country: Bosnia and Herzegovina, Italy, France, Great Britain
actors: Branko Djuric, Rene Bitorajac, Georges Siatidis, Katrin Cartlidge
description: Bosnia, 1993: Ciki and Nino, two soldiers, the first Bosnian and the second Serbian, are isolated in the no man's land that divides the enemy lines. As the two try to find a solution to their problem, a French blue helmet arranges to help them by contravening the orders of his superiors. Ciki has one more problem: she has to free a comrade who is lying on a mine. The televisions exploit the situation and make it a media show.
notes: Danis Tanovic is a great director because he knows it can be worse than that. Above all, he has a fundamental gift for looking at the apocalyptic events of the world with a clear eye: irony. A fratricidal war but told with the tones, rhythm and "lightness" of comedy, between sometimes irresistible jokes and moments of dramatic depth. Danis Tanovic's is a perfect screenplay (he won, not surprisingly, La Palma at the Cannes Film Festival) because he manages to manage two opposite and contrasting emotional poles in a balanced way: we laugh and we are moved, without ever feeling embarrassed, always. with eyes wide open in front of the unfortunately "true" representation of an "impossible" situation. It is no coincidence that Tanovic speaks of madness: who could take seriously the skit of two guys, with mutual friends and perhaps even a similar story, forced by events to slaughter each other without a reason like Conrad's "duelists"? "No Man's Land" is a surprising film because it can manage very well (and it is a first feature!) The difficult weapon of satire (the UN and the media come out battered). Above all, he keeps away from the immoral rhetoric of those who consider war according to contingent interests: sometimes "dirty", sometimes "just". The film won the Oscar for best foreign film.

title: Bridget Jones's Diary
actors: Renée Zellweger, Colin Firth, Hugh Grant, Jim Broadbent, Embeth Davidtz, Gemma Jones
description: 32-year-old Bridget Jones, employed in an advertising agency in London, decides to take her life back into her own hands. In order to achieve the goal you have promised yourself, compile a list of good intentions. The first thing to do is to write a personal diary, the second to find the ideal man and then to quit smoking and lose weight. So why not dress sexy to impress Daniel Cleaver, her boss? As for going out with Mark, well, he doesn't even talk, because Mark embodies all the worst in a man.
notes: Sharon Maguire does her job by putting herself at the service of Helen Fielding's book and, above all, of her characters, without showing any particular comic talent. But in this case the material is self-sufficient. The disappointments, the extra pounds, the hectoliters of white wine and the tons of junk food swallowed in solitude or between the neurotic complicity of friends, the silent struggles with a telephone that does not ring and perhaps is broken and in any case it is better to carry it under shower so as not to run the risk of not hearing it, pajamas with sheep and underarm type knickers, if sewn well together, are enough and advance to make a playful and happy comedy about "singleness" and the search for the right man. Especially when there are three actors in a state of grace like the irresistible Renée Zellweger, that bastard Hugh Grant and the "darcyan", Austenian, astonished Colin Firth, who finally reveals his charm to us too.

title: Training Day
actors: Ethan Hawke, Denzel Washington, Scott Glenn, Tom Berenger, Snoop Dogg
description: Jake Hoyt is a new LAPD recruit. To become an inspector, he must undergo a 24-hour internship with Sergeant Alonzo Harris, a veteran of the drug section who has worked for twelve years in the hottest neighborhoods of the city. Alonzo, who considers Jake a naive and inexperienced rookie, takes him with him. Little by little Jake begins to understand what Alonzo is made of: his cynicism that pushes him to get into the most complicated situations.
notes: Almost a metaphor of the career of the director, Antoine Fuqua that his "training day" (the training day) did it first on MTV and with a video clip after ("Forced to kill"). But once he was weaned he took to the skies, on the streets of East L.A., chasing a rookie on the first day of service and a veteran who made the arm of the law even more violent. Ethical principles in comparison, as always in US cinema, civilization on one side and the desert on the other. Indians are metropolitan, niggers and cholos, and the smoke signals they make by hissing crack. "Training Day" has the right rhythm, a cop film that does not forget the lessons of the greats (there are only three: Siegel, Aldrich, Friedkin), with a direction that knows how to be essential. And we like to believe that the bad ending, with the rehabilitation of the "undeserved" badge, is a compromise due to Hollywood's politically correctness. Impossible, then, not to think that Scott Glenn has a face printed with fire in the history of cinema of the tough. Denzel Washington won the Oscar for Best Actor in a Leading Role.

title: Along Came a Spider
actors: Morgan Freeman, Monica Potter, Mika Boorem, Michael Wincott, Penelope Ann Miller
description: This is not a good time for Dr. Alex Cross: his young colleague has died in a chase and retirement is almost upon us. But fate has a new case in store for him: in a Washington pension, little Megan Rose - daughter of a movie star and a senator - has been kidnapped. All the clues seem to point to Gary Soneji, one of his professors. Jezzie, the policewoman who should have supervised the girl, is harshly taken back by her superiors, who are right next to Alex ...
notes: Alex Cross, former protagonist of _The collector_ by Gary Fleder (1998) is back: this time not with a serial killer, but with a megalomaniac kidnapper and exhibitionist who wants to emulate one of the most famous kidnappings of the century (that of the son of Charles Lindberg, the flyer of the Atlantic). Subtracks and counterplots confuse the story a lot and make the atmosphere fluctuating: but this could be a problem in the James Patterson novel from which the film is based, since even _The collector_ suffered from too many twists and turns in the narrative. However, Freeman is so good that his glance is enough to suggest restlessness and implications: his Cross enters by right among the cinematic cops to remember; and the direction of the New Zealander Tamahori is solid, with moments of effective tension (the sequence before the titles, the staging in front of the Russian embassy, ??the race for the delivery of the ransom).

title: A. I.: Artificial Intelligence
actors: Haley Joel Osment, Jude Law, Frances O'Connor, Sam Robards
description: In the distant future, robots, an essential component of daily life, take care of most of the household tasks. Professor Hobby wants to go further and design the first sensitive android. A few days later, David, an 11-year-old robot, enters the home of a couple whose sick child has been cryogenized while awaiting treatment. When the couple's natural child returns home, David has no room left. Thus began his journey to discover the world. Gigolo Joe and Teddy, a toy bear accompany him.
notes: "A. I." is a film with a double personality, divided into three distinct and non-homogeneous acts, with magnificent visual inventions.

title: Scary Movie 2
actors: Shawn Wayans, Marlon Wayans, Anna Faris, Regina Hall
description: A year has passed since the horrific deaths that occurred in the town where Cindy lives. But the killer is still at large. One day, a mad professor forces Cindy and her classmates to visit a haunted house. The kids are seduced by the idea of ??spending a thrilling week away from university. But once they enter the mansion they realize that there are more terrifying things than what they have been used to seeing in old horror movies.
notes: A textbook pretitoli sequence, with two exorcists who take care of a Linda Blair lookalike chained to the bed and compete with her in devilry and crap (and James Wood, the chief exorcist at Max von Sydow, does not make Marlon regret Brando who was supposed to play his part). From here "Scary Movie 2" basically follows the track of "Haunting - Presenze", the bad film of 1999 by Jan De Bont that remake the good film of 1963 by Robert Wise. All, of course, turned upside down in an irreverent, foul-mouthed, pop parody, as the Wayans say. Quotes chase each other, as the brothers like. To list only the most obvious, in addition to "The Exorcist" and "Haunting - Presences", "Poltergeist", "The Hidden Truths", "Mission: Impossible 2", "Hannibal", "The Little Shop of Horrors" and "Charlie's Angels" (in two of the most apt sequences). More "cross" tributes to "The Rocky Horror Picture Show" and "Frankenstein junior". He will also be goliardic, like the first, like the "American Pie", as it was said of the Farrelly brothers and, before that, of John Landis. But it's funny.

title: The Night of the Living Dead
directors: George A. Romero, John A. Russo
actors: Duane Jones, Judith O'Dea, Russell Streiner, Karl Hardman
description: A terrifying phenomenon occurs in one area of ??the Midwest: the dead resurrect and hunt the living for their meat. A white woman, an African American and a family find themselves barricaded on a farm waiting for help, while the zombies become more and more numerous ...
notes: "Night of the Living Dead", made by Romero and his friends in Pittsburgh for just over a hundred thousand dollars, is one of the key films of '68, a suspense masterpiece that "tears apart" the American dream from its foundations. But co-writer John A. Russo saw fit to ruin it, adding new scenes, putting it back together and replacing the music.

title: Un tranquillo posto di campagna
actors: Franco Nero, Vanessa Redgrave, Gabriella Grimaldi, Georges Géret
description: In full creative stagnation, the well-known painter Leonardo Ferri moves to an ancient Venetian villa, on one of whose walls the peeling portrait of a young woman is painted. But the house is also the scene of mysterious and disturbing phenomena: Leonardo, driven to investigate, thus learns the story of Countess Wanda, who once enjoyed the reputation of a "light girl" and had ended up murdered. Those perceived in the villa would therefore be threatening "signs" sent to Flavia, Leonardo's lover, unwelcome to Wanda's ghost ...
notes: Petri, a "political" director, tries his hand here - with relative success - with much darker and more obsessive atmospheres.

title: Alice in Wonderland
actors: Tina Majorino, Robbie Coltrane, Whoopi Goldberg, Martin Short, Ben Kingsley, Gene Wilder, Peter Ustinov, Miranda Richardson
description: Little Alice, humiliated in the presence of her parents and their guests, runs away from home and sneaks into a rabbit hole. Disappeared underground, the little girl will find herself immersed in a magical world, populated by a multitude of curious characters. The little girl swallows a magic potion that makes her smaller. He later changes his height again by eating a strange piece of cake. Between one mysterious drink and another, a slice of special cake and a taste of magical mushrooms, Alice is constantly changing stature. Alice travels through an enchanted world until she arrives at a court where Sir Jack, the Knave of Hearts, accused of theft, is about to be tried.

title: X Change
actors: Stephen Baldwin, Kyle MacLachlan, Kim Coates, Pascale Bussières
description: Near future: a company called "X Change" has an innovative and astounding technology, capable of allowing the immediate transfer of people's minds from one place to another using the body of those who are physically as a "host" structure at the desired destination. But when the psyche of a highly placed character accidentally ends up in the head of a terrorist (and vice versa), a race against time will begin to retrace the process backwards, thus avoiding the possible, catastrophic consequences.
notes: Canadian Moyle's foray into science fiction ("Pump Up the Volume").

title: Y tu mamá también
actors: Diego Luna, Gael García Bernal, Maribel Verdú, Diana Bracho
description: The one for Boca del Cielo is Julio and Tenoch's last trip before the adult season. Different social classes, in full "hormonal" storm, the two boys face with unconscious joy and a moderate alcoholic level the expectation of the return of their respective girlfriends from a holiday in Italy. In their confused and improvised itinerary they involve Luisa, saddened by the umpteenth betrayal of her husband ...
notes: Back in Mexico, Cuarón shoots a good comedy "on the road" with a very bitter aftertaste. Perfect alchemy and understanding between the three protagonists, relaxed and not pleased with the hilarious entertainment on speeches and sex scenes.

title: Nurse Betty
actors: Renée Zellweger, Morgan Freeman, Chris Rock, Greg Kinnear
description: Betty Sizemore, a dreamy and sensitive waitress from Oaks, Kansas, is a staunch fan of the soap opera "A Reason to Love". The woman is married to an ignorant and unfaithful husband whom she loves despite everything. On her birthday, while watching her soap, she witnesses the murder of her husband by two killers. The scene is devastating and in Betty's mind the thin line that separates reality and fantasy has a landslide. Thus the woman begins to mistake the cathode world for real life. Betty moves away from Kansas and arrives in Los Angeles on the soap set, in search of Dr. Ravell who she believes to be her ex-boyfriend, chased by killers and the police.
notes: Life is a dream wrote Calderon de la Barca centuries ago, today this statement could be changed into life is television, or rather a soap. This is what emerges from Neil LaBute's film that betrays his reputation as a cynical and misogynist observer of American society. It is a chameleonic and profoundly cinephile film that recalls the Coens and winks at Tarantino, in which Zellweger, increasingly Doris Day today, offers another proof of great maturity. Hers is a complex character, a bit Dorothy from the "Wizard of Oz", a bit Holly Golightly ("Breakfast at Tiffany's") and Chance ("Beyond the Garden"), who often risks becoming ridiculous and inadequate, but the tenderness of his performance makes him as credible as Truman Burbank, also an actor, despite himself, of a life on the small screen.

title: Le pacte des loups
actors: Monica Bellucci, Vincent Cassel, Samuel Le Bihan, Emilie Dequenne, Mark Dacascos, Jérémie Rénier, Jean Yanne, Jean-François Stévenin, Jacques Perrin
description: The beast of Gevaudan: a legend that still makes one tremble with fear. Louis XV, over whose reign the sun is already setting, sends a knight and his Indian aide to the impervious region of France to solve the riddle. Who is thirsty for the blood of virgins? A man or a devil as the nobles of the Ancien Régime would have us believe?
notes: Gans plunges into pure adventure, cloaks a swashbuckling story in mystery but sometimes lets himself be stunned by his own passions. Each sequence is a tribute to someone, each camera movement, each costume or scenography, refers to the imagination of another, from Sergio Corbucci to Tsui Hark, passing through Bava and Freda. And yet, despite the cinematic game being extremely dangerous, Gans proves to have the right sensitivity for action sequences, thanks to a truly excellent martial actor like Mark Dacascos (a red man in the court of the king of France: the idea is brilliant). The hand-to-hand fights, but also the adventurous scenes shot in the woods, restore all the charm of that epic cinema to which the director looks with deference and a lot of nostalgia. A film not without flaws, therefore, but sincere.

title: Angel Eyes
actors: Jennifer Lopez, Jim Caviezel, Sonia Braga, Jeremy Sisto, Terrence Dashon
description: While agent Sharon Pogue of the Chicago Police Department is chasing a suspicious guy, he risks dying in an ambush. To get her out of the way, a mysterious individual thinks about disarming the killer and saving her life. Sharon thinks of a stroke of luck or a maneuver of fate. But the two have already met once. They are so forced to face the secrets about their past.
notes: The sinking of the film between tears, two monologues, a camera that pitches when it evokes inner lacerations is a responsibility that the actress-singer must share with a "handkerchief director" like Mandoki and an alleged scriptwriter, delivery man of predictability, like Gerlad DiPego .

title: Ça ira mieux demain
actors: Nathalie Baye, Jeanne Balibar, Jean-Pierre Darroussin, Danielle Darrieux
description: Elizabeth is a 30-year-old aspiring writer, single, obsessive and depressed. Sophie is in her forties, married to Xavier, a psychoanalyst, pranotherapist and sexual handle, and quite irritable. Franck, on the other hand, is a bulimic in love with Sophie. These and other characters chase each other and escape each other in the course of their bourgeois lives.
notes: There are many other women (a waitress, a musician, a lively old lady played by Danielle Darrieux) in this digression on the insignificant and abysmal ruffles of characters overwhelmed by an exaggerated metropolitan pessimism. Jeanne Labrune directs her actors well in the wake of a cinema of river chatter.

title: The Wind in the Willows
actors: Steve Coogan, Eric Idle, Terry Jones, John Cleese, Anthony Sher
description: When a group of arrogant weasels acquires the entire lawn from the wealthy Mr. Toad, fascinated by motor vehicles, Mr. Mole is evicted from his underground home and finds refuge with his friend Rat ...
notes: The former Monty Pythons create a cute adaptation of an English fairy tale from 1908.

title: Marcia nuziale
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Catherine Faillot, Gaia Germani, Tecla Scarano, Alexandra Stewart
description: Four satirical episodes about family and marriage. In "First wedding", two dogs with a noble pedigree are made to meet by their respective owners, who have prepared a real thalamus for them; in "Marital Duty", a housewife worn out by household chores denies her graces to her husband; in "Marital Hygiene", an American couple draws up a table to regulate intercourse; in "Happy Family", set in the future, humans have given up on sex and mate with plastic puppets.
notes: Armed with the usual irreverent vis, Ferreri co-wrote and directed four slightly dated but always cutting apologues.

title: All Through the Night
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Conrad Veidt, Kaaren Verne, Jane Darwell
description: Alfred "Gloves" Donahue is a thug who investigates the murder of a friend and discovers that a Nazi organization is involved in the crime.
notes: However, allusions to an FBI involvement in the matter were censored. Propaganda film shot right after the Pearl Harbor attack.

title: Abendland
actors: Wolfgang Michael, Verena Jasch, Isa Hochgerner, Urs Remond
description: Somewhere in the troubled Europe of the end of the millennium. Anton is unemployed, Leni works as an ironer in a laundry: immersed in the darkness of the night, they will try to rebel against the loneliness that afflicts them, crossing their own existence with that of other human beings.
notes: Hard, dark and desperate.

title: Ngo hai sui
actors: Jackie Chan, Michelle Ferre, Mirai Yamamoto, Ron Smerczak
description: A group of men heads to South Africa with the task of kidnapping some scientists, charged with working on new sources of energy. The mission is successful, but one of the principals finds it more convenient to eliminate the entire commando in a plane crash. However, there is a survivor, who is found by an indigenous tribe completely devoid of memory.
notes: Action comedy in the typical style of the Hong Kong star, who tries to recycle a few more gags through the trick of memory loss. It is actually one of Jackie's worst films, the last one made at home before the definitive "American" decline.

title: Come sono buoni i bianchi!
actors: Maruschka Detmers, Michele Placido, Juan Diego, Michel Piccoli, Nicoletta Braschi
description: Animated by the best humanitarian intentions, a group of European volunteers (including three women) arrives in the Sahel with a load of food for the local population. The expedition, however, is extremely disrupted, and in the face of considerable environmental difficulties, even the motivations falter. This is how a caravan made up of five trucks is formed: from this moment on, everything really happens in the sands of the desert ...
notes: Assisted by his old companion Rafael Azcona, Ferreri shows off his most caustic vein to dismantle the bad Western conscience hidden under the "charitable" appearances. Unpleasant, but necessary.

title: La Jument verte
actors: Bourvil, Sandra Milo, Francis Blanche, Yves Robert, Valerie Lagrange
description: 1870: despite the rage of the conflict between France and Prussia, the bitter rivalry that divides the Haudouin and Maloret clans shows no sign of fading. The denunciation of Zéphe Maloret to the enemies will cause a new shame, which fifteen years later Honoré Haudouin will take charge of washing ...
notes: Autant-Lara tells of the feud and its dramatic consequences - even after years - with the attention of an entomologist, aware of the wickedness of men. It is not on anyone's side, not even the victims, and it is a singular expressive choice. Excellent the protagonist Bourvil. Screenplay by the specialists Aurenche and Bost.

title: Martin
actors: John Amplas, Lincoln Maazel, Elayne Nadeau, Christine Forrest
description: Martin joins his cousin Tata Cuda's family in a small town near Pittsburgh. During the train ride he bleeds and kills a girl. Tata welcomes him coldly: he is convinced that his nephew is a vampire. Martin indirectly seeks help, but the desire to kill is stronger than him. Meanwhile, the uncle gears up to kill the alleged nosferatu.
notes: Great film from the director of "Night of the Living Dead". Unfortunately, this is the Italian version, with the fake music of the Goblins and a different montage. The fascination of an apparently horror story remains, demonstrating how real monsters kill with the weapon of prejudice.

title: L'alpagueur
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Bruno Cremer, Patrick Fierry, Jean Negroni
description: The French secret service recruits an experienced hunter to be part of a special anti-drug team. The new cop becomes very skilled, defeats a gang but finds a bloodthirsty criminal on his way. A new hunt begins for him: man ...
notes: Polar action that follows the "muscular" tendency imposed by Belmondo on the authors who worked with (and for) him. Not much, despite some nice sequences; it is however curious to note that the violence of these films was much less criticized than that - not superior - of the contemporary Italian "policemen". Excellent Bruno Cremer in the part of the sadistic killer.

title: Farelavita
actors: Filippo Timi, Giulietta De Bernardi, Walter Ricciarelli, Antonio Rava
description: The young Neapolitan Antonello hits the pavement in Turin under the pseudonym of Rosatigre. Over time he establishes an affectionate relationship with his "colleague" Wanda, a failed teacher: the two exchange confidences and impossible dreams, but the harshness of street life will divide them.
notes: The "poetry of the margins" according to De Bernardi.

title: A, B, C... Manhattan
actors: Lucy Knight, Erin Norris, Sara Paul, Nikolai Volshuk, Rebecca Nelson
description: Colleen wants to be a photographer but has to keep up with her daughter and curb the attraction to alcohol; the bisexual Kacey, who lives with her, is temporarily single and wanders in search of her dog; quasi-singer Kate wants to feel free and dumps her boyfriend ...
notes: The Iranian Naderi masterfully explores the solitudes of the metropolis.

title: Parfait amour!
actors: Isabelle Renauld, Francis Renaud, Laura Saglio, Alain Soral
description: Christophe, twenty-eight-year-old reckless; Frédérique, a thirty-six year old bourgeois: between the two will be born a passion so all-consuming as to lead to murder.
notes: From a real event that happened in Dunkerque, the French director draws inspiration for a new exploration of the "extreme" union between death and eroticism. In any case, not for everyone.

title: A Season for Miracles
actors: Carla Gugino, Kathy Baker, Laura Dern, Patty Duke
description: Emilie never backed down when her sister Berry needed her help. Now Berry is in jail on drug charges and Emilie is desperate to think about the grandchildren that a social worker, Ruth Doyle, intends to foster. Eventually, Emilie decides to load the children into her old car and set sail away from her hometown. Emilie goes out of her way to reassure the children, even if she has no idea what to do. Moreover, it is necessary to find a place to spend the night sheltered from the harsh winter temperatures as soon as possible and Emilie has little money.

title: Little Big League
actors: Luke Edwards, Timothy Busfield, John Ashton, Ashley Crow
description: After the sudden death of the owner of the Minnesota Twins, a baseball team, his place is taken by his grandchild Billy, who despite his tender age (12 years) knows the environment deeply and has developed a real sixth sense for regarding the good of the team. And to begin with, knowing that the players are able to bear the coach, Billy fierce him on the two feet: the general approval, however, turns soon in the bewilderment to the announcement that the next manager will be ... the same boy! Will Billy be able to keep a group of rude and proud athletes at bay?
notes: Tell for families with a sports background.

title: Gruppo di famiglia in un interno
actors: Burt Lancaster, Silvana Mangano, Helmut Berger, Claudia Marsani, Stefano Patrizi, Romolo Valli
description: An elderly American professor lives barricaded in his Roman apartment, full of books and paintings. One day, however, the Marquise Bianca Brumonti, a wealthy exponent of a new and arrogant bourgeoisie, settles upstairs together with her lover Konrad, her daughter Lietta and her boyfriend Stefano: at first annoyed by the "scandalous" intruders, the man attempts an approach, destined however to result in a bitter disillusionment.
notes: Visconti's reflection on the embarrassment of contemporary customs and the loneliness of old age touches the style here and there, but can count on an artistic and technical cast of the highest level.

title: Ebenezer
actors: Jack Palance, Ricky Schroder, Amy Locane, Albert Schultz
description: The very rich and very miserly Ebenezer, landowner and rather prone to the use of the gun and inveterate cheater at the green table, is definitely not a very recommendable subject. But Christmas also comes for a bad guy like him, and when he receives the visit of three spirits who try to sweeten his soul ...

title: The Magical Legend of the Leprechauns
actors: Randy Quaid, Colm Meaney, Whoopi Goldberg, Harriet Walter
description: Jack, a prominent businessman, is on a business trip to Ireland with the aim of buying an entire village to build a retirement home for the rich. The man, after renting a cottage in the countryside, realizes that the house is inhabited by goblins at war with another fairy tribe of archer gnomes.

title: David Copperfield
actors: Hugh Dancy, Paul Bettany, Sally Field, Judy Cornwell
description: David was already born an orphan of his father, but his mother's tenderness made his first years of life pleasant for him. However, that happiness is disturbed when the mother marries the evil Mr. Murdstone who, helped by his sister, manages to remove little David, sending him to boarding school. Trouble begins for him ...

title: A Christmas Carol
actors: Patrick Stewart, Richard E. Grant, Ian McNeice, Joel Grey
description: It's Christmas Eve. Scrooge is alone in his office. He hears a noise and sees the spirit of ex-partner Jacob Marley. Marley blames Scrooge for the pain he caused his neighbor and informs him that three spirits will visit him: "The ghost of Christmas past", "the ghost of Christmas present" and "the ghost of Christmas to come".

title: Honey, We Shrunk Ourselves
actors: Rick Moranis, Eve Gordon, Bug Hall, Stuart Pankin
description: Inventor Wayne Szalinski has developed a machine capable of reducing human size. It happens that some members of his family fall within the range of the device, finding themselves fighting with insects as large as monsters or risking falling into ... the folds of the carpet.
notes: Yet another revival of a successful recipe.

title: Babel
actors: Mitchell David Rothpan, Maria De Medeiros, Tchéky Karyo
description: Humans once happily coexisted with the Babels, a race of strange creatures just over a meter tall. When God, offended by the construction of a very high tower, scattered men to the four corners of the world, the Babels were driven underground. But thousands of years later ...
notes: Fairytale for families.

title: The Apple Dumpling Gang
actors: Bill Bixby, Susan Clark, Don Knotts, Tim Conway, David Wayne, Slim Pickens
description: California, 1878: Gambler Russell Donovan takes care of three orphans by sharing the responsibility with Magnolia, a stagecoach driver. A stroke of luck makes them discover a very rich gold mine belonging to the missing father of the boys, but the bandits do not stand by ...
notes: Disney adventure.

title: The Apple Dumpling Gang Rides Again
actors: Tim Conway, Don Knotts, Tim Matheson, Ruth Buzzi, Robert Pine, Harry Morgan
description: This time Amos and Theodore, the two soft-hearted outlaws who already appeared in the first episode, are promoted to the rank of protagonists: they will intervene in favor of cavalry soldier Jeff Reid, who intends to discover the reason that induces Lieutenant Ravencroft to plot against Major Gaskill ...
notes: Pale sequel, completely unrelated to the original.

title: Pocahontas II: Journey to a New World
description: Accompanied in England by Ambassador John Rolfe and by the faithful Meekko, Flit and Percy, the courageous Indian princess will have to beware of the maneuvers of the shady Ratcliffe, but she will find a character very dear to her ...
notes: The inevitable sequel appears less "complex" than the original, but just as engaging.

title: The Jetsons Meet the Flintstones
description: A device developed by the inventor Ellroy should allow the Jetsons to go even further into the future: but a failure transports them to none other than prehistoric times, to the Flintstone and Rubble garden. The raids over time, however, are not over yet ...
notes: Hilarious adventures for the friendly heroes of Hanna & Barbera.

title: Sofies verden
actors: Silje Storstein, Thomas von Brömsen, Andrine Sæther, Bjørn Floberg
description: After receiving a series of mysterious tickets, Sofia Amundsen - a very curious girl - meets Alberto, a very special "philosophy professor". Alberto will lead Sofia on a journey that will go from Ancient Greece to the present day: and along the way, different stories will intertwine with each other ...

title: Blankman
actors: Damon Wayans, David Alan Grier, Robin Givens, Jon Polito
description: Darryl is now an adult, but along with his childish character he has an extraordinary ability to use waste materials to build the most varied devilry. So, as soon as you devise a method to make your clothing bulletproof, it turns into a superhero ... low budget! Darryl, assuming the identity of Blankman (his brother calls him "blank man", that is "empty head"), sets to work trying to foil a plot against Mayor Harris. After neutralizing the mayor's enemies, Darryl impresses Kimberly, the TV reporter who has followed his exploits.
notes: Demented comedy that stands on Wayans' shoulders.

title: Il cocco di mamma
actors: Maurizio Arena, Ingeborg Schöner, Geronimo Meynier, Franca Rame, Isabella Biagini
description: Aldo has two passions, boxing and courting all girls. Then one day he meets Laura, a serious girl who opposes her gallantry with the coldest indifference. When Aldo, seriously in love, realizes that the girl does not intend to give up, he decides to contact Laura's mother.
notes: Silly Italian comedy.

title: The Dukes of Hazzard: Reunion!
actors: John Schneider, Tom Wopat, Catherine Bach, Denver Pyle, James Best
description: Uncle Jesse's farm is in danger. All the fault of Mama Max who intends to build a theme park on that land. At this point Bo and Luke intervene: their problem is that they have to raise money to redeem the land. It occurs to the two boys to participate in a car race across the region.

title: L'ultimo Capodanno
actors: Monica Bellucci, Marco Giallini, Francesca D'Aloja, Antonella Steni
description: On the night of New Year's Eve, on the Via Cassia, the residential complex "Le isole" is the scene of a series of episodes spiced with sex, drugs, desperation and violence.
notes: The writer Niccolò Ammaniti, recognized leader of the "pulp generation", co-wrote with Risi himself a subject taken from his novel "The last new year of humanity": the declared metaphorical-apocalyptic ambitions on the decadence of contemporary society, however, lead to a sterile parade of false provocations, as shouted and exaggerated as they are blunt and predictable. Almost invisible in the hall, one of the most sensational flops of the Italian cinema of the end of the millennium.

title: Az örvény
description: From 1938 to 1944, the Hungarian Jew György Petö resumed the daily life of his family, progressively upset by the introduction of anti-Semitic laws in the country. This material, edited by Forgács with archive images, provides an extraordinary testimony to one of the most controversial historical moments in Hungary.

title: El Cid
actors: Charlton Heston, Sophia Loren, Raf Vallone, Geneviève Page
description: Spain, 11th century: the young Rodrigo is in love, reciprocated, with the beautiful Jimena, but risks losing her after killing her father in a duel. Accused of treason, he will redeem himself by conquering a city. Years later, Rodrigo - renamed "Cid Campeador" - became a leader famous for his courage: proclaimed lord of Valencia, in repelling an attack by the Moors he was mortally wounded. But the fame of the Cid is such that even his corpse, tied to a steed, is able to panic the enemies ...
notes: A classic of "Hollywood on the Tiber", an all-round show to which Mann still manages to give an epic breath.

title: MVP: Most Valuable Primate
actors: Russell Ferrier, Lomax Study, Kevin Zegers, Jamie Reneé Smith
description: Jack, a highly intelligent chimpanzee, is part of a Pueblo University primate science program led by Professor Kendall. Since his research funding has not been renewed, Kendall decides to send Jack back to his mother, who lives in the El Simian nature reserve. Unfortunately, the professor suddenly dies and Jack finds himself at the mercy of events. Dr. Peabody, chief scientist of Pueblo University, for budgetary reasons, decides to sell Jack to a hepatitis research institute. Darren, Jack's keeper, to save him from such a horrible fate, loads him on a train bound for El Simian ...

title: Méfiez-vous, mesdames!
actors: Paul Meurisse, Michèle Morgan, Sandra Milo, Danielle Darrieux
description: He comes out of the slammer after serving a few months' sentence for a series of bad checks. And outside he decides to change "gender": he publishes marriage announcements in the newspaper hoping to find the rich woman from whom to be supported. But women know how to be more dangerous than cops ...
notes: Unusual casanova role for Paul Meurisse (the commissioner of "All hours wound ... the last kills") well-known face of the French polar. The comedy is still funny and certainly do not mind the girls who revolve around the nice rogue. Sandra Milo was hoping at that time for a French career.

title: The Secret of the Sword
description: Princess Adora has a special destiny: manifesting herself as the liberator She-Ra and saving the nation of Etheria from the evil Horde. But Adora is unaware of what awaits her, and when Prince Adam comes to Etheria ...
notes: The animation is traditional, albeit enriched with numerous visual tricks.

title: Una vergine moderna
actors: May Britt, Gabriele Ferzetti, Vittorio De Sica, Teresa Pellati
description: The young Claudia Bardi aspires to free herself from the narrow family horizon and dedicates herself to the activity of model designer, also thanks to the support of a friend, the wearer Annadora. Uninhibited and uninhibited, Claudia first tries to seduce the director of a newspaper, then that of a bank, then a young Italian-American film producer, without however obtaining the desired results. In the end she will be with an elderly Brazilian millionaire: it will be the intervention of her brother to prevent her from continuing to throw herself away.
notes: Despite Flaiano's screenplay, the film - especially in the finale - fails to "bite" as it would have liked.

title: 2019. Dopo la caduta di New York
actors: Michael Sopkiw, Edmund Purdom, Jacques Stanislawski
description: After the thermonuclear war the Earth is reduced to rubble. Only a few urban agglomerations remain populated by men, but the radiation has made the survivors totally sterile. The army establishes a police regime and identifies the only girl in the slums of New York capable of becoming pregnant. A hero named Parsifal will try to save her.
notes: Bad film by Martino miraculously re-evaluated by Quentin Tarantino (who defines it as a "personal cult") and Steve Della Casa (who presented it with great fanfare at the Turin Film Fest 2001). In reality it is improvised and superficial, inferior to Castellari's post-atomics.

title: Il Principe e il pirata
actors: Leonardo Pieraccioni, Massimo Ceccherini, Luisa Ranieri
description: From Palermo to Saint Vincent. Towards an inheritance, a painting worth 250 million, left by a father, indebted for six billion, who pretends to die to continue living. The quiet teacher Leopoldo, with a flat and monotonous life, discovers that he has a half-brother, Melchiorre, known as Gimondi, a thief and mugger by profession since middle school, a fan of the magician Silvan, detained at the Ucciardone for robbery. The "death" of the father brings the two brothers together by chance and forces them on a journey, with several stops and detours, sudden accidents and dangers, funny encounters.
notes: It is the meetings that dictate the rhythm and atmosphere of the film "on the road": an old love complicit in assaults on banks and post offices with the masks of Ronaldo and Batistuta (a happy gag), a mother who always faints, a lost wife, an old cellmate, a lifeguard who knows all the road drivers in Italy by heart. One can become "brothers" in a few days by uniting the fractured heart of the melancholy teacher with the gypsy heart of the tender criminal. Pieraccioni and Veronesi have in mind the agro and hilarious model of "Il sorpasso" and the character frictions of the "buddy movie". Some sequences are built well, some side figures (Don Capece) are very successful, some lines are funny. The strange couple works and faces the final exam that leads from the masks to the characters, from the naivety of fairy tales to the acceptance of reality.

title: 'R Xmas
actors: Ice T, Drea De Matteo, Lillo Brancato, Lisa Valens, Victor Argo
description: Christmas Eve in New York, 1993, the large decorated tree of the Rockefeller Center, latest purchases, triumphs of toys. It seems a serene and more than wealthy family that is preparing to celebrate the holidays. But the father and mother, handsome and young, elegant, she Puerto Rican, he Dominican, have to go out in the evening. To go to work. Which is the cutting, the packaging, the dealing of heroin.
notes: The first half hour of "Our Christmas" by Abel Ferrara is beautiful: a black, everyday, horrible portrait of a glittering and, apparently, reassuring normality that is built directly on the nightmare. It leaves you breathless the passage from the colored lights of the house eve to the urban squalor in which, without interruption, the father and the mother (for the whole film without a name, like the other characters) enter. And the meticulous, indifferent precision with which they do their job is chilling. However, when the story takes a thriller turn (the husband is kidnapped and the wife has to try to save him), the author's cruelty and rigor end up fading (as happened, unfortunately, in the two previous Ferrara films). It remains an unsettling portrait of the family, the unity that counts, but also the most self-destructive one.

title: Monsoon Wedding
actors: Naseeruddin Shah, Lillette Dubey, Vasundhara Das, Vijay Raaz
description: The betrothed dance, their family members dance, the "wedding planner" (who eats the yellow flowers of the ceremonies, has a mother worried above all about not having a daughter-in-law, grandchildren and stock market titles that rise) dance wife. Dancing and singing in the monsoon rain, the eventful days of preparation for Aditi Verma's wedding come to an end ...
notes: Nair - launched in 1988 by _Salaam Bombay_, which was followed by a not exactly flawless filmography - has always thought more of Hollywood, revised in a "local" key, than of the exceptional tradition of Indian auteur cinema (Satyajit Ray above all ). Interested in intriguing international and non-niche viewers, she practices a more controlled and skilled cinema than the stereotypes and the adventurous and melodramatic dimension of commercial films produced by the film industry of her country, and cooks a "curry-movie" for export: sometimes tasty, pleasant and fun, sometimes fake. In this circumstance, the director insists on a New Delhi painted as a colorful globalized universe, but the street images (testimony of her past as a documentary maker) contradict her statements. The misadventures of relatives, servants, returning emigrants and other guests, in reality, are a skewer - crunchy and spicy - of comedy, soap and musicals. In 2001, the film won the Golden Lion at the Venice Film Festival.

title: Un crime au Paradis
actors: Jacques Villeret, Josiane Balasko, André Dussollier
description: Jojo, a candid farmer from a small French village, lives on a farm called Paradiso in the company of the unpleasant, malevolent and sour Lulu, with whom he is unhappily married. Each of the two thinks of eliminating the other: the company succeeds in Jojo, who has the provident foresight to ensure - by deception - the assistance of a famous criminal lawyer ...
notes: With this film, Becker ("The Murderous Summer", "The Boys of the Marais") pays homage to a certain popular French cinema of the past - including that of his father Jacques - inspired by a masterpiece of black comedy: "I killed my wife "(1951), directed by Sacha Guitry and beautifully performed by Michel Simon. Despite the good intentions, however, the staging is unsurprising: a harmless sketch that recalls the pastel colors and the elementary lines of a Sunday drawing. The director's rural, provincial and naturalist vein sprinkles an obsolete and anachronistic film. Despite the freedom of the remake, Becker makes a faded, unlikely photocopy, with too subdued perfidy. Quite good actors, who do everything to keep the shack up.

title: Lucky Numbers
actors: John Travolta, Lisa Kudrow, Tim Roth
description: Russ is a celebrity in town; he is president of Rotary, signs autographs, and has a hamburger named after him. He reads the weather forecasts by trade, but with a deejay's verve. Still, he managed to get into debt with half the world. Badly advised by the Luciferian Gig, Russ tries the path of illegality with a fake robbery against himself to cheat the insurance, but worsens the situation. All that remains is to rig the television draw of the lottery, with the complicity of the "woman of fortune", who is also his mistress.
notes: For the first half hour, everything runs smoothly: a pace twice as fast as the average American cinema. Then everything settles into the usual mechanisms of the hit film.

title: Ribelli per caso
actors: Antonio Catania, Giovanni Esposito, Franco Javarone, Renato Scarpa
description: In a gastroenterology ward, patients rebel against the hateful head physician giving themselves a "shot of life": an underground dinner prepared on site. The "coup" succeeds, but the diners soon find themselves barricaded (in the dormitory closed from the inside) by doctors, journalists and policemen.
notes: The idea is not much, and it does not hold up. But it is not only the nosocomial setting that makes the film depressing: it is the repetitive flatness of the script, the sloppiness of the direction (bad photography and use of vainly pimping music), the superficiality of the specks: the wise greengrocer, the sad and romantic professor ... The actors are of alternating skill, also because there is not much to do.

title: Huang Feihong zhi Wu long Cheng Jian Ba
actors: Vincent Zhao, Rosamund Kwan, Su Tsui-yu
description: The warrior philosopher Wong Fei-hung fights this time against an evil pirate, who has set his sights on a maiden. At his side two intrepid girls and the usual "court" of friends.
notes: Tsui Hark's saga dedicated to Wong reaches its fifth episode, a character who truly existed and told several times in Chinese popular cinema. Although the first two episodes are unpublished in Italy (this no, who knows why!) We are talking about masterpieces of the kung fu movie, embellished by the superb performance of the original protagonist Jet Li. Behind the camera is Tsui, it is logical to expect great things. But ultimately the operation is repetitive.

title: Khrustalëv, mashynu!
actors: Jurij Zurilo, Nina Ruslanova, Jüri Järvet
description: 1953: A lover of alcohol and other people's women, Jurij Glinski is a general of the Red Army and a surgeon in a Moscow hospital. His fate, however, suddenly changes when the KGB, on Stalin's orders, starts an anti-Semitic plot ...
notes: Remarkable return to the direction of German, fourteen years after "My friend Ivan Lapscin".

title: Il n'y a pas de fumée sans feu
actors: Annie Girardot, Bernard Fresson, Mireille Darc, André Falcon
description: A right-wing mayor decides to block the rise of his now certain successor by involving him in a fake sex scandal. Since the progressive candidate does not give up, the mayor even has him jailed for murder. He reckoned without two women discovering his machinations.
notes: André Cayatte, before going to the cinema, was a lawyer. He will have seen all the colors but this does not justify such an artificial, tiring and didactic story. The film lets itself be seen, but given the excellent performance of the actors (Annie Girardot in the lead), it remains a wasted opportunity.

title: Lucky Break
actors: James Nesbitt, Olivia Williams, Timothy Spall, Christopher Plummer
description: Jimmy and his buddy storm a bank as if they were in a "comedy" that went wrong. Sentenced to many years in prison, they decide to escape and prepare their little escape. To lose their tracks, they decide to take advantage of the staging of a musical about Horace Nelson, written by the director of the penitentiary.
notes: Everything is predictable to the point of spasm: rehearsals, setbacks, love stories, hours of air, solitary confinement, craftsmanship of the skilled evader, arrival of the bad inmate. The direction does not have the flashes of "Full Monty" and the film sits at times. The actors are discreet, but they serve the script with a phlegmatic commitment.

title: Serendipity
actors: John Cusack, Kate Beckinsale, Molly Shannon, Jeremy Piven
description: A man and a woman in a winter New York where you can skate and only snowflakes fall from the sky. Love at first sight in a big city can strike, irreparable and kind, in a department store, at shopping time. Jonathan and Sara are not the first and they will not be the last. But the story of the two lovers has an extra thrill. Sara convinces Jonathan to gamble with fate, he disappears after a few hours and after writing his phone number in a book by Garcia Márquez. It will take years to make the intermittences of the heart coincide with the coincidences of chance and to live happily ever after.
notes: The film gives its best in the first half hour: excellent work on the surrounding characters, some pages - though not all - of Marc Klein's script are brilliant. However the protagonists work, and Beckinsale is a magical presence.

title: The Emperor's New Clothes
actors: Ian Holm, Iben Hjejle, Tim McInnerny, Tom Watson, Nigel Terry
description: Following the defeat at the Battle of Waterloo, Napoleon has lived in exile on the island of St. Helena for six years. His life on that remote island in the Atlantic Ocean is nearly impossible for a proud man like the Impetaror. Bonaparte dreams of returning to his rightful place on the throne of his beloved France. And soon he will do it because, making fun of the English, he will flee the island, leaving a double to replace him.
notes: The project was curious: a double Ian Holm who, on the one hand, must bend Napoleon's temperament and aspirations to a new life, while on the other hand he makes the poor man who has taken his place grow with sudden flashes of authority. The grotesque and madness are one step away; and they are also touched at certain moments, without however ever managing to truly take possession of a story that remains on the surface, an opaque homage to the feelings that matter and to the small pleasures of bourgeois life. The best thing about the film is the performance of Ian Holm; but the direction and the script are not at his height. The film is based on the novel _The Death of Napoleon_ by Simon Leys.

title: Iedereen beroemd!
actors: Josse De Pauw, Eva van der Gucht, Werner de Smedt
description: Jean works in a glass factory. He has a seventeen-year-old daughter, Marvan who wants to be a starlet and who enters competitions for amateurs. The father supports her, even financially, because he is convinced that the girl has talent. Then one day his company closes and Jean, who doesn't dare tell Marva, organizes the kidnapping of a record company. In this way Jean tries to have her daughter record her first CD.
notes: A comedy with the features of a satire of television and dull Flemish nationalism. The story is an expedient to put some dirty laundry in the streets. First of all those of the glittering world of showbiz. Then those of an intimately xenophobic society.

title: Quartetto
actors: Anna Ammirati, Beatrice Fazi, Maddalena Maggi, Raffaella Ponzo
description: Irma is 25 years old and lives alone in a studio apartment. She has recently graduated in anthropology and is going through a moment of uncertainty. One evening the girl, about to leave for Brazil, receives a letter from her mother. Irma, who has never met her father, has a surprise. The woman reveals that her father exists, he is sixty years old and lives in Turin. Three other female stories are intertwined with this.
notes: The cameras follow all the protagonists everywhere: it is the Italian Dogma, ridden by Piscicelli as if it were a novelty. The film is an interesting experiment on paper, but unfortunately it is a failed experiment.

title: Bandits
actors: Bruce Willis, Billy Bob Thornton, Cate Blanchett, Troy Garity
description: The goodnight bandits, the newspapers and television call them, because they go the night before to the house of a bank manager, seize him politely and, the next morning, accompany him to the office where they withdraw all the cash. They escaped, improvising, from the Oregon prison and have as their destination Acapulco, Mexico, where with the money from the robberies, they will open a hotel where they will wander around in a tuxedo drinking margaritas. The two of them are joined by a frustrated rich housewife.
notes: The three protagonists are all in great shape. Willis with the smirk that escapes him when he's not being too tough, Thornton with the anxiety of the quiet man out of the law, Cate Blanchett demonstrating a dazzling talent for comedy.

title: AmorEstremo
actors: Rocco Siffredi, Stefania Bonafede, Pietro Bontempo
description: Ghost, a masochistic policeman, eager for an absolute "little death", is assassinated. Silver gets hunting for the culprit and comes across Xenia, puppy and other animals of the Ronda of pleasure. The computers and vibrators run, the mysterious and allusive ads go, Libido disguises himself with leather skirts, stiletto heels and handcuffs.
notes: The actors and non -actors perform amateur level. Shot with the nervousness and the cuts of an authorial video that intends to escape anatomical fixity and from the performance of pornography gives in to the deutmescence of fantasy.

title: Knockaround Guys
actors: Barry Pepper, Vin Diesel, John Malkovich, Dennis Hopper, Andrew Davoli, Seth Green, Arthur J. Nascarella
description: A gangster's misunderstood son convinces his uncle to get involved in family affairs. Together with a gang of friends, unlikely criminals, the scion loses his classic bag full of dollars in a small town in Montana. A corrupt sheriff who has enough fur on his stomach to deal with budding bandits retrieves it. Until the real ones arrive from the city ...
notes: "Pulp Fiction" producer Lawrence Bender christens "The Player" screenwriters Brian Koppelman and David Levien, making their debut behind the camera. The result is dignified: "Dangerous Companies" is a not particularly innovative gangster movie but certainly well studied in the plot and with a convincing focus on the generational clash between criminals or aspiring criminals. For this reason, defects burn more, first of all the speculated use of Vin Diesel, which the screenplay (or perhaps who knows, the cuts to the editing) has made a secondary figure. Even the ending, almost a less pulpy citation than the shooting of "The hyenas", is hasty, however, if you think about the dramatic potential of the twist that overturns the story.

title: Osmosis Jones
actors: Chris Rock, Laurence Fishburne, Bill Murray, Chris Elliott
description: Frank Detorri, loser janitor at the zoo, lives alone with his daughter and has a habit of swallowing any type of food, even the most lousy. His body is dominated by bacteria and toxins, but frequent stomach cramps don't stop him from swallowing even an egg collected in the dust. To counteract the Thrax virus, which has penetrated into Frank's body, the white blood cell Osmosis Jones and the Drix pill intervene ...
notes: The part inside the human body, described by the original and traditional animation by Piet Kroon and Tom Sito, is paradoxically the only one that recalls the style of the Farrellys. The "city of Frank" reproduces the crazy and frenetic patterns of the outside world, with its teeming shopping malls, TVs churning out news 24 hours a day, always clogged highways and crazy characters. The "live action" segment, on the other hand, is flat, toneless, with a Bill Murray who is only a pale memory of the one who gave us irresistible comic moments in the past; moreover, the fusion with the teeming animated world never has a start, always predictable in a montage that seems to be punctuated by a soulless metronome.

title: Arcipelaghi
actors: Pietrina Menneas, Paolo Lostia, Giancarlo Lostia
description: Court of Nuoro, a boy of just fourteen, is accused of murder. Through submerged memories and nightmares that come to the mind of the teenager, another obscure crime emerges, that of Giosué, the brother of the accused. Left alone in a country house, the child had witnessed a cattle theft and had been the victim of thieves' revenge.
notes: Based on the novel of the same name by Maria Giacobbe, the film opens and lives in a courtroom, where a fourteen-year-old boy is accused. Parallel to the trial, submerged memories, uncomfortable truths, other impossible crimes re-emerge, to which, perhaps, it will be difficult to respond with cold legislative rules. Columbu believes in his film, even if the cut is too little cinematic.

title: ABC Africa
description: March 2000, Kampala, Uganda: Iranian director Abbas Kiarostami and his cameraman Seyfolah Samadian film the faces of children with their digital cameras, the huts that house barber shops, a dry cleaners, a record store; preparations for a wedding in a house without doors and windows; schoolchildren who, outdoors, under the trees, repeat words of English or do the count ...
notes: Invited to participate in a humanitarian project in areas devastated by the AIDS epidemic, Kiarostami uses his digital "pen" to capture the moving and serene, delicate and dramatic moments of an African tragedy.

title: Rock Star
actors: Mark Wahlberg, Jennifer Aniston, Jason Flemyng, Timothy Olyphant, Dominic West, Jason Bonham, Zakk Wylde, Jeff Pilson, Timothy Spall, Blas Ellias, Nick Catanese, Brian Vander Ark, Dagmara Dominczyk, Matthew Glave
description: What happens when a fan encounters their own myth and goes so far as to replace it? This is what happens to Chris Cole, lead singer of Blood Pollution, a shabby heavy metal band specializing in covers of the much more famous Steel Dragon. One day Chris is "killed" by his teammates, but he takes a sensational revenge by becoming part of the Steel Dragon, who in the meantime have lost the front man ...
notes: The most obvious model is _This Is Spinal Tap_, a fictional documentary about a rock band shot in 1984 by Rob Reiner. Herek's film is modest and full of clichés. And music is for aficionados only.

title: Shiqi sui de dan che
actors: Cui Lin, Li Bin, Zhou Xun, Gao Yuanyuan, Li Shuang, Zhao Yiwei
description: Guo is sixteen, he comes from the countryside and finds a job as a delivery boy for a delivery company. To make the deliveries, the boss lends him a mountain bike, with the agreement that he will be able to redeem it as soon as he has earned 600 yuan. After weeks of hard work, Guo's bicycle is stolen and a real odyssey begins for the boy ...
notes: In China today, a bicycle is still a luxury item, a status symbol. Maybe it will make some Westerners smile, but running after a thief over there still makes sense. One of the (many) reasons to go and see this authentic remake of Vittorio De Sica's masterpiece is precisely to be surprised, in being witnesses of a world that, although close to the past, is still distant and mysterious to most people. Wang Xiaoshuai, director (born in 1966) of the "sixth generation", offers a naked and raw gaze of contemporary Beijing, clearly contrasting the "European touch" of authors of the previous generation (such as Zhang Yimou, for example). Wang doesn't like sophisticated colors, elegant angles, the favorite atmospheres of festival goers. He takes the camera and throws himself in the alleys, in the streets, in the meanders of that unofficial China that makes politicians shake the wrists (which in fact did not give him a yuan). A literally independent film, which proudly proclaims its total self-sufficiency. Luckily, in Berlin 2001 they noticed it and gave it a large award (Grand Jury Prize and Silver Bear to the two impressive protagonists).

title: Kiss of the Dragon
actors: Jet Li, Bridget Fonda, Tchéky Karyo, Ric Young, Burt Kwouk
description: Paris: To arrest a corrupt Chinese high dignitary, the French police summon Liu Jian - a Hong Kong intelligence officer with the necessary tact - and join him with the official Jean-Pierre Richard. However, something is wrong, because the target is murdered in front of Liu, who also finds himself accused of the murder: the only person present at the scene of the crime and who could exonerate him is an American prostitute ...
notes: This first chapter of the series is negligible, even irritating for how it is over the top, winking at Nikita and the translucent aesthetic dear to Besson.
