The second _Kiss of the Dragon_ is directed by Corey Yuen, director of the action scenes of the number one, choreographer of the Peking Opera, author of a Hong Kong cult entitled _My Father Is a Hero_ (with the spectacular Anita Mui and, also in that case, Jet Li). Just the great little Jet becomes an imaginative interpreter of the fights invented by Yuen, without giving up the dramatic energy that characterizes him. However, Nahon's film contains several sublime moments of struggle: some slapstick, a bit Jackie Chan (Li walks into a room where cops train and throws them down like skittles); others to take your breath away for precision, speed, genius and power. His fearsome twin opponents, Cyril Raffaelli and Didier Azoulay, are French champions of karate and savate. And when Jet blows them away they make a lot of noise ...

title: Novocaine
actors: Steve Martin, Laura Dern, Helena Bonham Carter, Elias Koteas
description: Frank, owner of an established dental practice, is having a good time: the work is going very well and he is happily engaged to the hygienist Jean. Then, one damned day, Susan enters his perfectly organized life, a seductive new patient who has an unbridled passion for painkillers. In a very short time, Frank's world is crumbling ...
notes: A thriller comedy that revolves around a successful dentist, the drugs he keeps in his office, an overtrained and ambitious girlfriend, a stray brother and a soft-hearted dropout. Unfortunately, the rhythm slows down quickly and the demented and acid vein loses its strength.

title: Malefemmene
actors: Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Angela Molina, Sabina Began, Ana Fernandez
description: Francesca is a successful actress who ends up in prison for a drug affair into which the passion for a wrong man has dragged her. Life in the prison is very hard and Francesca, after the first moments of bewilderment, will try to adapt to the new rhythms of her day and her cellmates.
notes: The reference to Totò's song is intentional in this tale of women in prison. The film, based on the prison story of Gioia Scola who produced and co-wrote it, does not focus on the characters and avoids any dramaturgical conflict. The direction assists devoid of concentration in this little prison picture.

title: Nobel
actors: Hector Alterio, Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Stanislas Merhar
description: An elderly Swiss writer has won the Nobel Prize for literature and decides to go to Stockholm to pick it up not by plane, but with a long drive across Europe in the company of a young journalist who is interviewing him. From here, encounters, long stops and repeated journeys in memory.
notes: In a presentation of "Nobel", Fabio Carpi recalls his second film "Quartetto Basileus", which he directed in 1981, due to the affinity of the themes: denied paternity and comparison between generations. Big themes that if in '81 the director handled with the slight measure of youth, today instead overflows in an incessant "high" dialogue and in the fixity of withered and redundant sequences.

title: Sole negli occhi
actors: Fabrizio Gifuni, Valerio Mastandrea, Delia Boccardo, Gianni Cavina
description: Marco is a boy who has had a life similar to many others in the Northern Italy of wellbeing. However, no one has noticed that in him there is a dangerous fracture kept on the surface by normality: a fracture that leads him to cultivate an inexplicable hatred towards his father. I hate that drives Marco towards patricide.
notes: "Sun in the eyes" (a phrase inherited from Pasolini), despite the formal shyness and (paradoxically, being Cardinals) a script that limps and digs little into the meanders of the characters, is a film that makes you think and creates inner agitation. Merit, there is no doubt, of the actors: from a Fabrizio Gifuni at the test of maturity to the sober and essential Mastandrea, Cavina, the always sweet Delia Boccardo.

title: Atlantis: The Lost Empire
description: Milo, an expert linguist and cartographer, tries to convince his colleagues that he knows the mystery surrounding the end of Atlantis. Milo's source is sadly a lost manuscript, but he soon gets the opportunity to prove his theory.
notes: The plot is a bit convoluted, but Atlantis always retains its charm.

title: Spy Game
actors: Robert Redford, Brad Pitt, Catherine McCormack
description: Year of grace 1991: the Berlin wall has recently fallen but the war is still cold. Especially the Chinese do not take it well when they capture a CIA spy freeing an English prisoner held in Beijing. American intelligence, to avoid diplomatic troubles, thinks of "dumping" the agent. But he didn't deal with a veteran of the "Spy Games".
notes: After 20 minutes at a rocket, tight, effective, Tony Scott instead of giving a free hand to Robert Redford who tries to play all his colleagues and superiors in an interminable meeting, falls into the trap of the flashback. Nor does it give us an ending up to the start. Too bad, because Redford, between the Condor and "All the President's Men", is very good.

title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
actors: Angelina Jolie, Jon Voight, Iain Glen, Noah Taylor, Daniel Craig
description: Lara has inherited from her archaeologist father, Lord Richard Croft, an infinity of jewels and objects, including a magical clock. Years later, the man reveals to his daughter the existence of a secret society, called "the Illuminati": whose members try to get hold of that watch, whose key would allow them to open the doors of time and space. ...
notes: Derived from the video game of the same name, and it shows: zero twists, shamelessly recycled situations, narrative plot thrown there by chance, just to justify an operation that was not felt the need. Over all dominates Angelina Jolie, who rolls her eyes and pokes her lips at every close-up.

title: The Body
actors: Antonio Banderas, Olivia Williams, Derek Jacobi, John Shrapnel
description: In the basement of a shop in Jerusalem, Professor Sharon Golban, a young Israeli archaeologist, finds the body of a man crucified around 33 AD. Evidently, this is a bit suspicious, and the high hierarchies of the Church, together with the Israeli services, are in turmoil. The Vatican sends Jesuit professor Matt Gutierrez to the scene.
notes: The foolish script burns the curious starting point. The antics involve, in addition to poor Banderas, Derek Jacobi in the part of an archaeologist priest, and a venerable cinematographer like Vilmos Zsigmond.

title: Momo alla conquista del tempo
description: The sweet Momo is a creature of indefinite origin who arrives among men to open their eyes, hypnotized by the flattery of the Gray Lords, incorporeal vampires who in order to ensure their existence must steal the time of humans and smoke it in their Time Bank. Momo is a serious threat to them, because no one can lie in front of its purity and simplicity, not even the perverse Gray Lords. Momo is also the mouthpiece of a message of goodness, a concept that cannot but make those wicked creatures shiver. With the help of Mastro Hora, the old Time Administrator, Momo then manages to thwart the smoking threat of the Gray Lords and bring color and smiles back to the world of men.
notes: Enzo D'Alò has drawn from Michael Ende's "layered" story an enchantment of colors, fantasy and poetry. Ende's novel is a difficult text to transfer to film, due to the presence of numerous levels of reading that do not neglect even metaphysics, but D'Alò succeeded in his intent and, for once, we can perhaps say that the film surpasses the book (and what a book!). A film that becomes an extraordinary metaphor for today's world and society in which it is enough to turn on the television for a minute and see crowds of Gray Lords stirring, but also a film that strikes for the naturalness and simplicity with which the director was able to reinterpret the spirit of Ende, helped by the splendid soundtrack signed by Gianna Nannini.

title: South Kensington
actors: Rupert Everett, Elle Macpherson, Judith Godrèche, Enrico Brignano
description: The aristocrat Lord Nicholas "Nick" Brett inherited a mountain of debt from his father. So, to pay the tax, he is forced to rent rooms in his mansion in South Kensington. Nick is particularly happy to host Italian tourists: for example Antonio, a hotelier who has to learn English, and Francesco, an employee at Cedars Bank ...
notes: The Vanzinas aspire to a less vulgar product but remain anchored to the Eighties, to that inexpressiveness of the staging that tastes so much of commercial TV. A reaffirmation of the fact that Italian popular cinema needs "real" directors and screenwriters.

title: Merry Christmas
actors: Massimo Boldi, Christian De Sica, Enzo Salvi, Max Cavallari, Bruno Arena
description: Airline pilot Fabio Trivellone is a man who loves his family so much that he has even had two for 17 years. For the Christmas holidays he makes the mistake of inviting his two wives to Amsterdam. In the Dutch capital there is also Enzo, an industrialist from Milan, who wants to deepen his knowledge with his future son-in-law. Max and Bruno, owners of a funeral home, must deliver to the rich widow the urn containing the ashes of her husband, a billionaire who died in front of their shop.
notes: The vulgarity is coarse and the gags oscillate between the oral and anal phases. The laughs are almost all due to Boldi speaking in Roman dialect with the unwanted son-in-law.

title: Desafinado
actors: Joe Mantegna, Danny Aiello, George Hamilton, Anna Galiena
description: Fabrizio, Armand and Ricardo are three tenors who had enjoyed some success in the nineties. Now, after a voluntary isolation, they find themselves in a large French villa for Armand's wedding with the daughter Ricardo had with his ex-wife, now Fabrizio's partner. Of course they will be misunderstandings to no end ...
notes: The film has no sense of rhythm, offers B-grade pochade situations and a soap visual setup. The musical numbers are anxiously awaited - to laugh at least a little - but they are few and are not worth the involuntary comedy of the first ten minutes, in which the three sing _Guadalajara_ in sombrero in Mexico City.

title: The Man Who Wasn't There
actors: Billy Bob Thornton, Frances McDormand, James Gandolfini, Scarlett Johansson
description: California, 1949: Barber Ed Crane, who suspects his wife Doris' infidelity, meets a traveling salesman who offers him to set up a dry cleaning chain. But it takes a lot of money to get into the deal, and Ed decides to blackmail Doris' lover ...
notes: The Coens model the story narratively and visually on the classics of noir (from the novels of James M. Cain - whose suggestions the Coens were explicitly inspired by - to the films of Fritz Lang and Robert Siodmak), but more than the plot points they are interested in the themes of identity and being - or rather, "not being" - in the world. Restless atmospheres, cuts of light that pierce the rampant dark and gray. The inevitable cadence of destiny is underlined (as in Wilder's _Fiamma del SIN_) by the narrating voice of the protagonist: quiet, dull, resigned. After all, Ed Crane was just looking for "some kind of escape, some kind of peace". Extraordinary Thornton, aged, modest, saddened. An "upbeat" film, very refined and desolate.

title: Mark il poliziotto spara per primo
actors: Franco Gasparri, Lee J. Cobb, Ely Galleani, Nino Benvenuti, Massimo Girotti
description: In Genoa, Commissioner Mark Terzi deals with the crimes signed "La Sfinge", which for some time have been upsetting the Ligurian capital: not least the kidnapping of Benzi, the president of the Banking Consortium who recently entered the political scene small town. Terzi does not have an easy life and wastes his energies for a long time on the trail of second-rate criminals, but little by little the scenario becomes clearer ...
notes: The specialist Massi follows up on the adventures of the agent already protagonist of "Mark the policeman", insisting on the limited dramatic skills of a star of photo novels like Gasparri. Zero surprises.

title: Il grande attacco
actors: Helmut Berger, Samantha Eggar, Giuliano Gemma, Henry Fonda
description: A group of people from different countries met in Berlin during the 1936 Olympics. The men, gathered in an officer's house, toast to a future of peace and brotherhood. Instead they will all find themselves on the front, in a few years, pursuing a tragically similar fate in a different way.
notes: The best film by Umberto Lenzi, also co-author of a screenplay that sometimes seems emphatic but is only written with participation. The director is skilled in staging. Above all, however, he treats war from an anarchist perspective: "nationalities" are ephemeral symbols that divide humanity, and every war is a "civil" war.

title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
actors: Emma Watson, Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, Robbie Coltrane, Maggie Smith, Tom Felton, Richard Harris, Alan Rickman, Fiona Shaw, Julie Walters, Ian Hart, John Hurt, John Cleese
description: The Harry Potter orphan was raised by his uncles, who hate him. One day, the giant Rubeus Hagrid reveals to him that both of his missing parents were two powerful wizards, and that he himself possesses supernatural powers. Harry therefore gladly accepts to attend magic courses at Hogwarts school, where he will live extraordinary experiences ...
notes: Based on the first of J.K. Rowling, a very particular cinematic event because it is the corollary, the refined and popular illustration of a worldwide literary phenomenon. By reading such a rich and closed text, cinema is mortified and exalted. He mortifies himself by yielding to an almost absolute fidelity to the novel, transforming the white screen into an album to glue the stickers and situations memorized by the spectators. It exalts itself with an excellent casting; with a style, an atmosphere, an "all British" grain; with the talent, digital and scenographic, to visualize the inventions of the book. The director, the screenwriter and the actors are a link between the fictional space and the reader-spectators. Oiled bearings of an overwhelming machine of wonders and toys. Likely interpreters of a reverie that runs along the old road that leads from childhood to maturity.

title: Hundstage
actors: Maria Hofstätter, Alfred Mrva, Erich Finsches, Gerti Lehner
description: In an infelix district of Vienna, it is a particularly hot summer weekend. Mr. Hruby, the representative of alarm systems, spends all his time in the car. Surprisingly, he is asked to investigate some acts of vandalism. Anna, who spends all her time in supermarket parking lots, is a born provocateur. Claudia engaged to Mario is forced to endure his jealousy and his outbursts of violence. Engineer Walter plans to celebrate his golden anniversary, but not with his wife. The Greek and his wife live together ignoring each other, until ... A woman's evening ends in excess and violence.
notes: Some of the characters of the six micro-stories that parade side by side and within the frames recall in the dialogues, in the small daily manias, the aesthetics of a cinema catalog, of a cinema fresco to the Hieronymus Bosch of the world. It is not surprising, then, that the director shot eighty hours of material and built the film with a very laborious editing. Neither shameless nor complacent minimalism on a humanity held in check. Every move, every attempt at conversation, every gesture, every punch and every caress are useless: the game, however, is lost. The desperate power relations (theorized by Fassbinder) are no longer about sex, but about anonymous flesh. Fear no longer eats the soul, it pecks at the body. The film won the Grand Jury Prize at the 58th Venice Film Festival.

title: He Died with a Felafel in His Hand
actors: Noah Taylor, Emily Hamilton, Romane Bohringer, Alex Menglet
description: The neurotic Danny has reached his forty-seventh experience of living with complete strangers. The arrival of the charming bisexual Anya and the fact that the hosts do not want to hear about deferred payments contribute to change his mind; therefore Danny moves first to Melbourne and then to Sydney, and at this point he feels the need to find the woman of his life and become a writer.
notes: In the film - based on the novel of the same name by John Birmingham - there is an obsessive search for fun, but also a truly remarkable work on environments and photography. Curious and bizarre, with an unusual flavor.

title: Ocean's Eleven
actors: George Clooney, Julia Roberts, Brad Pitt, Matt Damon, Andy Garcia
description: After spending a few years in a New Jersey prison, Daniel "Danny" Ocean finds his freedom and organizes a plan that seems impossible to carry out: to rob the Bellagio vault, where the proceeds of three Las Vegas casinos flow. Along with the money - $ 160 million - Danny wants to "steal" Harry, the owner of three gambling halls, his ex-wife Tess. To score the blow, Danny needs some professionals and finds them in Dusty, skilled in the game of cards; Linus, an expert pickpocket; Ruben, who knows the security systems of the vault perfectly; Roscoe, expert in explosives; the brothers Malloy, Virgil and Turk, real axes of electronics; Yen, contortionist and acrobat ...
notes: The film, a sort of remake of Lewis Milestone's _Colpo grosso_ (1960), runs smoothly away, despite some implausible details and some slowness in the second part. What matters, after all, is the déjà-vu: an idea of ??cinema in souplesse, where everything is foreseen to the millimeter, perhaps predictable but also enjoyable, dusted off with sparkling dialogues, loose rhythm, actors in tune. Watch out for the boxing match: two of the survivors of the first version appear, Henry Silva and Angie Dickinson. Soderbergh captures the air of a family joke that circulated in the acting of _Colpo grosso_ with the help of George Clooney, the perfect classic Hollywood-style villain icon, Elliott Gould and Carl Reiner.

title: From Hell
actors: Johnny Depp, Heather Graham, Ian Holm, Robbie Coltrane
description: London, 1888: In the streets of Whitechapel, Jack the Ripper wanders at night killing and gutting prostitutes. On his trail, in addition to the entire London police, there is Inspector Frederick George Abberline the only one who immediately understands that the crimes are preceded by a meticulous and scrupulous staging. George observing the crime scene realizes that the killer has an incredible cold blood. The policeman, intuitive and visionary, tries to reconstruct Jack's profile also thanks to the help of the prostitute Mary Kelly.
notes: The visual talent of the brothers Allen and Albert Hughes ("In the Concrete Jungle" and "Dirty Dollars") has refined. Starting from the solid foundation of Eddie Campbell's drawings for Allan Moore's '99 comic story, the Hughes have managed to grasp with robust brutality the imagery of a mobile and turbid era, which is a prelude to ours and, in some respects , represents it: London, the heart of the industrial revolution, in 1888. What the Hughes manage to convey with their film is precisely the popular nature of the legend that grew up around the Ripper. Johnny Depp, as the sad cop Frederick George Abberline, is justifiably emaciated and Heather Graham, as the prostitute Mary Kelly, has Pre-Raphaelite colors. As for the identification they propose of Jack, it is one of the many leads that, in more than a hundred years, have been traveled by policemen, historians, curious people.

title: The Rich Man's Wife
actors: Halle Berry, Christopher McDonald, Frankie Faison, Charles Hallahan
description: After marrying a wealthy and much older man, the beautiful Josie Potenza spends a holiday that ends in failure; to the point that, conversing with a stranger in a bar, she confides in him that she wishes her husband died. But when the latter loses his life in a seemingly random accident, Josie will have to fight hard to ward off the inevitable suspicions.
notes: The screenwriter of "Indecent Proposal" tries her hand at directing, writing a tailor-made story that certainly does not shine for its originality. But when the cast includes a marvel of the caliber of Halle Berry, everything becomes drinkable.

title: Jeanne la Pucelle: Les batailles - Les prisons
actors: Sandrine Bonnaire, André Marcon, Jean-Louis Richard, Philippe Morier-Genoud
description: "The battles": convinced that she has been designated by divine will, the commoner Giovanna asks and obtains from the dauphin of France the troops to defeat the English siege of Orléans. "The prisons": a series of political upheavals causes the capture of the young woman, who will be tried and sentenced to be burned at the stake in Rouen.
notes: Revisited in a thousand different versions (among which those of giants of the caliber of Dreyer, Rossellini and Bresson stand out), the mixture of Myth and History that surrounds the French national heroine is "humanized" and made concrete - also through the scenographic choices , with attention to the smallest details - from the Rivettian reinterpretation.

title: Gangsters '70
actors: Joseph Cotten, Giulio Brogi, Giampiero Albertini, Franca Polesello, Bruno Corazzari, Dennis Kilbane, Jean Louis, Franco Ressel, Linda Sini, Milly Vitale, Cesarino Miceli Picardi
description: Fresh out of jail, the elder Destil organizes the coup that could ensure a comfortable old age. He organizes a gang and tries to get hold of a briefcase full of diamonds, but another group of thugs has smelled his moves ...
notes: Italian genre cinema, not very original but dry and essential.

title: Francesca e Nunziata
actors: Sophia Loren, Claudia Gerini, Giancarlo Giannini, Raoul Bova, Maria Zulima Job, Domenico Orsini, Vanessa Sabet, Giulia Lechi
description: Little Francesca is forced to follow her family, who is about to move to Naples from a small town on the Amalfi coast. The grandfather, in great demand in the city for his ability as a pasta maker, intends to expand his already vast clientele made up of nobles, army officers and sophisticated restaurants. Years pass and the flourishing legacy of the ancestor finally passes into the hands of Francesca. The woman, who has a large family, decides to adopt Nunziata, an orphan: it will be the latter who will be responsible for perpetuating the tradition by continuing to produce pasta of all kinds, with dedication but also with a lot of passion.

title: Gli indifferenti
actors: Liv Ullmann, Laura Antonelli, Peter Fonda, Sophie Ward, Cris Campion
description: Once the Ardengos were part of the good bourgeoisie of the capital. Now, however, they are on the verge of a heavy financial crisis: Leo Merumeci, a cynical and unscrupulous character, has put his hands on a large part of their assets, who does not hesitate to interrupt a relationship with the mature widow Ardengo to become the lover of his daughter Carla. At first the other son Michele tries a reaction, but then withdraws from all intentions; for his part, by marrying Carla, Leo would have the fate of the Ardengo in his own hands ...
notes: Television reduction of the novel by Alberto Moravia, which already inspired the homonymous film by Citto Maselli (1964).

title: Antropophagus
actors: George Eastman (Luigi Montefiori), Vanessa Steiger (Serena Grandi)
description: On the Greek island singing Battisti's songs between sailors and bonfires? Not at all: in the Aegean there is a terrible cannibal almost two meters high who has particular tastes. Ouzo and tourists, souvlaki and flower girls. Gourmets are warned. Carnage in the moonlight.
notes: When horror becomes pornography. Joe D'Amato films the non-filmable and reaches unprecedented heights when the monster tears the fetus from Serena Grandi's belly and eats it. There is no irony, there is no suspense. A phenomenology of splatter made with little money and little imagination. Montefiori-Eastman is also the screenwriter.

title: Diva
actors: Frédéric Andreï, Roland Bertin, Wilhelmenia Wiggins Fernandez
description: During the performance of a famous soprano, a fan manages to record a series of songs. The singer has never made a single album, which is why the material is particularly precious. But the young man's cassette is exchanged for one in which a prostitute accuses a police commissioner of managing the racketeering. Hence, misunderstandings and endless twists.
notes: One of the French cult of the 80s, great success also in Italy. The style (so-called "postmodern") is pimp and a little dated, but the film is equally enjoyable. Richard Bohringer wears a diving mask to cut onions without crying. Brilliant.

title: The Saga of the Viking Women and Their Voyage...
actors: Abby Dalton, Susan Cabot, Bradford Jackson, June Kenney

title: Golden Earrings
actors: Marlene Dietrich, Ray Milland, Murvyn Vye, Dennis Hoey
description: 1939: Before the outbreak of the Second World War, two British officers travel to Germany to contact Professor Otto Krosigk, an anti-Nazi scientist who has discovered an asphyxiating gas. Arrested, they escape: one is killed, the other - Colonel Ralph Denistoun - is helped by the gypsy Lydia to escape with the formula ...
notes: From a novel by Yolanda Fuldes, screenwriters Frank Butler, Helen Deutsch and Abraham Polonsky (who the following year will make his directorial debut with _The forces of evil_), a bizarre war story with Dietrich in a "Wellesian" style (in gypsy clothes , will appear in 1958 in _L'infernale Quinlan_).

title: Vinyl
actors: Tosh Carillo, Gerard Malanga, J.D. McDermott, Ondine
description: Victor, an unscrupulous and violent young hooligan, takes out his impulses on a victim who is anything but reluctant. Arrested by an agent, he will be forced to undergo "forced re-education" therapy.
notes: Two years after Burgess's novel and six years before Kubrick's masterpiece, Warhol provides a personal reading of "A Clockwork Orange".

title: Scorchers
actors: Faye Dunaway, Denholm Elliott, James Earl Jones, Emily Lloyd, Jennifer Tilly, James Wilder
description: In Bayou La Teche, Louisiana, the marriage between Splendid and Dolan is celebrated. But the troubles come during the fateful first night, when Splendid is well determined to keep her innocence; Meanwhile, the girl's cousin discovers that her man has been in bed with Thais, the local prostitute, and does not take her very well ...

title: ¡Viva America!
actors: Jeffrey Hunter, Margaret Lee, William Bogart, Anna Maria Pierangeli
description: Twenties. Frank, having abandoned Sicily, joins his brothers in Chicago. We are in full prohibition and the quick-handed Sicilian, determined to expand business, puts a spoke in the wheel of the local underworld. But the offenders do not allow their business to be hindered.
notes: Latest film by Anna Maria Pierangeli.

title: Tripfall
actors: Eric Roberts, John Ritter, Katy Boyer, Rachel Hunter
description: While on vacation in a California coast resort town, Tom Williams, his wife Gina and their children Michael and Angela are approached by three individuals named Lonnie, Eddie and Frank, apparently motivated by the desire to make friends. But the reality is quite different: they are in fact unscrupulous criminals, who immediately take action by kidnapping the Williams for extortion purposes. With his back to the wall, Tom is forced to stall, waiting for the opportune moment to take advantage of a possible distraction of the criminals and free himself and his loved ones from the nightmare ...

title: Teen Wolf Too
actors: Jason Bateman, Kim Darby, John Astin, Paul Sand, James Hampton
description: Todd, admitted to the first year of university, has become an idol of his peers. The girls fall at his feet and the principal who wants to win the regional boxing championship signs him up for the tournament. But Todd suffers from an anomaly inherited from his parents: he occasionally sprouts wolf hair and claws.
notes: Embarrassing sequel.

title: Mozart è un assassino
actors: Enzo Decaro, Daniela Scarlatti, Augusto Fornari
description: A group of young musicians have to take the year-end recital. The pupils prepared a piece by Mozart. The night before the execution, a girl is brutally killed on the front door of the house. The horrendous murder is followed by others. Arrived at the scene, the police began the investigation.

title: Un Amleto di meno
actors: Carmelo Bene, Lydia Mancinelli, Alfredo Vincenti, Franco Leo, Isabella Russo, Luciana Cante, Luigi Mezzanotte, Giuseppe Tuminelli, Alfiero Vincenti, Sergio Di Giulio
description: Claudius became king after killing his brother, who also took over the marriage bed. But instead of worrying about revenge, bored by Horace's revelations and Ophelia's longings, his nephew Hamlet prefers to plan an escape to Paris with Kate, the "star" of the traveling company that should reproduce the misdeeds that occurred at court on stage.
notes: Inspired by a text (1877) by Jules Laforgue, which already distorted him in a satirical key, Bene sinks his hands into the myth of the "pale prince" contaminating him with the most varied sources - from Freud to Gozzano - and with a chromatic-scenographic taste to to say the least overflowing.

title: To Hell and Back
actors: Audie Murphy, Marshall Thompson, Charles Drake, David Janssen, Susan Kohner
description: First-person account of the life and career of Audie Murphy, the most decorated American soldier of World War II. A native of Texas, he enlisted at the age of 17: a series of heroic acts carried out on the European fronts earned him endless honors, culminating in the prestigious "Medal of Honor".
notes: The character-symbol of courage and dedication to the flag in the role of himself, in an inevitably hagiographic but all in all engaging tale. As an actor, Murphy starred in about fifty films, including John Huston's "Trial by Fire" and Joe Mankiewicz's "A Quiet American".

title: Requiescant
actors: Lou Castel, Mark Damon, Pier Paolo Pasolini
description: A child watches helplessly as his family and the peons of his village are slaughtered. He is saved by a Protestant pastor who teaches him the word of the Lord, but does not hide from him that, at times, it is also useful to listen to that of the Colt. Having grown up, the survivor seeks revenge and redemption for his people.
notes: Spaghetti-western with an explicitly political intent. Naive realization (but the script is not flawless) and unusual co-star role for Pasolini. Carlo Lizzani is hiding under the pseudonym of Lee W. Beaver. From the Revolution to the "reformist" Monarchy: how times change!

title: Nero Wolfe: Champagne for One
actors: Maury Chaykin, Timothy Hutton, Bill Smitrovich, Colin Fox
description: Archie Goodwin is invited to an exclusive party. During the evening, Nero Wolfe's right arm learns that one of the girls, a certain Faith, has cyanide with him with which he plans to take his own life. Archie promises to keep an eye on her, but the girl is still killed by a poisoned cup: the champagne, in fact, contained cyanide. While everyone present is thinking about suicide, Archie begins to investigate, as usual advised by Nero Wolfe ...
notes: The interesting fact of this TV movie is the name of the director-interpreter: Timothy Hutton, a successful actor in the 80s who then fell into oblivion a bit ..

title: Violenza sul lago
actors: Erno Crisa, Lia Amanda, Patrizia Della Rovere, Giacomo Rondinella

title: Pauline en Paulette
actors: Dora van der Groen, Ann Petersen, Rosemarie Bergmans, Idwig Stephane
description: Pauline is 66 years old and has a handicap that makes her similar to a child, in need of everything. Suddenly her sister Martha, who lovingly takes care of her, passes away, arranging in her will that her possessions will go to the one who, between the two surviving sisters, agrees to take care of Pauline. Both Paulette, a vain single entirely devoted to her haberdashery shop and passion for operetta, and Cécile, who lives in Brussels with a narrow-minded and mean man, are very interested in the inheritance but not in taking charge of Pauline, who is thus finds himself the object of a sad dribbling ...
notes: From Belgium comes a story that talks about mental distress and the difficulty in today's society to accept old age. Melancholy and without major jolts, with an ending that more than one critic found excessively good-natured, Debrauwer's film redeems itself abundantly with a descriptive dryness that creates a deep empathy in the viewer and with the touching interpretation of Dora van der Groen.

title: Blek giek
actors: Biagio Izzo, Lillo & Greg, Giovanni Mauriello, Cristiano Callegaro, Pasquale Petrolo
description: Scellone, a small fugitive drug dealer from the Roman coast, is the only one who has a new and powerful drug called "blek giek", capable of causing incredible states of hallucination and inducing those who take it into a state of apparent death. After the stories of his friends, the loser Spider absolutely wants to try the blek giek and begins to tampinate Scellone, who instead has serious health problems and must undergo a heart transplant managed by his dentist, doctor of the disease ...
notes: Draftsman and writer, Caria ("Carogne") gives vent to his comic imagery in this "black comedy" that makes the most of the talents of an unprecedented cast.

title: Life as a House
actors: Kevin Kline, Kristin Scott Thomas, Hayden Christensen, Ian Somerhalder
description: Throughout his existence, the architect George has cherished a desire: to build a house, a refuge perched on a cliff overlooking the sea. Only now - with no more family, no job and with the months numbered: he was in fact diagnosed with an incurable disease - does it seem that his project could become a reality ...
notes: It was all there: a good cast, a glorious cinematographer (Vilmos Zsigmond), a screenwriter (Mark Andrus) who specializes in mixing laughter and emotion, a dignified director. Yet something has gone wrong: unfortunately Winkler proves that he does not know the gift of synthesis, and the result is as flat as a TV movie.

title: Behind Enemy Lines
actors: Owen Wilson, Gene Hackman, Joaquim De Almeida, David Keith
description: A US Navy pilot, Lieutenant Burnett is ready to leave his uniform because he would like to fight and serve his country. The Serb-Bosnian conflict is a political and ethnic puzzle and the young man bites the brake. Admiral Reigart sends the young officer on reconnaissance. The plane goes off course, photographs mass graves and movements of Serbian troops and is shot down. Burnett survives, but is hunted down by soldiers and a predatory sniper.
notes: Wilson does not shake off that supporting role, the writers practice every codicil of improbability, the director is in his debut, after having impressed the producers with a commercial for a SEGA game.

title: Rat Race
actors: John Cleese, Whoopi Goldberg, Cuba Gooding jr., Rowan Atkinson, Jon Lovitz
description: The eccentric billionaire Donald Sinclair, owner of a casino in Las Vegas, has arranged a bet for a small group of his customers. The competitors are six losers, who have found special gold coins in the slot machines that allow them to participate in a race. Up for grabs is a bag containing two million dollars, stored in a locker of a small dusty New Mexico station. Whoever arrives first keeps the loot. The race begins, and the competitors do not hesitate to use every means to get to the end; but the bettors follow them moment by moment, betting on their adventures ...
notes: Sparkling cast (there is also a cameo by the "wicked" Kathy Bates) for a film that offers moments of irresistible comedy, seasoned with unlikely breathtaking chases. Ultimately, "Rat Race" is an inexhaustible series of short sketches that unfolds on a structure that assembles, with shrewdness and skill, some of the masterpieces of comic and exploitation cinema of the sixties and seventies. The most full-bodied reference is "This crazy crazy crazy crazy world", from which it takes the idea of ??the treasure hunt and the setting of Las Vegas and Nevada. But remaining in the field of sources, we cannot forget the action directed by Paul Bartel ("Death Race 2000" and "Cannonball") for Corman, or the later "Armchair for Two" by John Landis. In short: nothing original under the sun, but we laugh often and tastefully.

title: Capitães de Abril
actors: Maria De Medeiros, Stefano Accorsi, Joaquim De Almeida, Frédéric Pierrot
description: Portugal. On the night between 24 and 25 April 1974, the radio broadcasts Grãndola, a forbidden song. This is the agreed signal for the launch of a military coup that will change the face of a country afflicted by decades of dictatorship and the fate of immense territories in Africa. At the sound of the voice of the poet José Alfonso, the troops occupy the barracks: it is the revolution of the Carnations. The recount of those 24 hours is told by taking the point of view of two captains and a girl.
notes: Actress Maria de Medeiros goes behind the camera and talks about the advent of democracy in her country according to today's feel-good fashion. The revolution is a gala dinner to be told with a banal television style.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
actors: Elijah Wood, Ian McKellen, Orlando Bloom, Christopher Lee, Ian Holm, Viggo Mortensen, Liv Tyler, Cate Blanchett, Sean Astin, Billy Boyd, Sean Bean, Noel Appleby, John Rhys-Davies
description: Sauron, the Dark Lord of Mordor, has lost the One in battle - the strongest of the twenty Rings of Power, capable of dominating all the others - and intends to repossess them: therefore he unleashes the forces of Evil against the Company of Nine, who instead he wants to destroy the Ring by throwing it into the Chasm of Fate ...
notes: A titanic undertaking, to adapt the three books of Tolkien's "The Lord of the Rings" without losing their narrative richness and without transforming it into a fairy tale or a treatise on Celtic mythology. That is, by preserving the heart, the passion, the adventure, the horror, the honor, the overflowing sense of the fantastic. But Peter Jackson, at least from what appears from the first film of the trilogy, made it, he won the bet against which the skill of an animator like Ralph Bakshi had also broken, in 1978 with his version of the whole trilogy. Where Bakshi's drawings lost their mystery, Jackson's imagination revives dreams and nightmares buried in childhood memories and gives them flesh and thrills. The film gives back to the cinematic fantasy all the breath that the abuse of special effects seemed to have taken away from it. These special effects are not seen, or at least they do not abuse the perfection achieved, but they seem to seek an instinctive link with the naivety of the effects of the past. In at least two scenes (the underground battle against the Troll and the appearance of the two gigantic statues of the kings of men), Jackson refers directly to Ray Harryhausen. Jackson returns its archetypes to the fairy tale: an insinuating Evil capable of corroding everything and a Good that is difficult to conquer. The film won four Oscars: Best Photography, Best Visual Effects, Best Makeup, and Music.

title: Hearts in Atlantis
actors: Anthony Hopkins, Hope Davis, Anton Yelchin, David Morse
description: Bobby Garfield, a middle-aged photographer, returns to the country where he grew up for the funeral of Sully, a childhood friend. The places and people recall in his mind the memory of the summer of 1960, when with his girlfriend Carol and Sully he enjoyed playing in the park and in his life, for a short time Ted Brautigan, a strange adult who had treated him like friend. Orphaned of a father and with an emotionally "distracted" mother, Bobby had found in Ted a foster father, caring and mysterious, ready to reveal to him the secret to face adult life without fear.
notes: Taken from the collection "Hearts in Atlantis" published by Stephen King in 1999, the film traces the atmosphere and the theme that had made the success of "Stand by Me - Memory of a summer". It is therefore the nostalgic tale of a transition into adulthood that takes place during a summer where the air is full of swirling moods and mysteries. The relationship between the elderly psychic and his young friend, to whom for a moment he gives the opportunity to try his gift, is described by faithfully adhering to the atmosphere created by the writer, who often likes to get away from the usual paths of horror, thus redeeming the timid direction of Scott Hicks.

title: The Glass House
actors: Stellan Skarsgård, Leelee Sobieski, Trevor Morgan, Diane Lane
description: The house of the Glass, Erin and Terry, is a villa which, in order not to betray the surname of the owners, resembles a glass fortress. Left in its modern decor, with windows, doors and a swimming pool that, at any time of day, spreads reflections and shadows. The Glasses become the loving guardians of Ruby and younger brother Rhett when their parents die in a car accident. Ruby, however, does not feel comfortable and soon begins to have growing suspicions about Erin and Terry.
notes: The preparation of the story and the careful casting announce the development and the twists (interlocking, one inside the other) of the classic thriller with stepfathers and stepmothers.

title: L'argent
actors: Christian Patey, Caroline Lang, Sylvie van den Elsen, Michel Briguet, Vincent Risterucci, Béatrice Tabourin, Didier Baussy, Marc Ernest Fourneau, Bruno Lapeyre, Jeanne Aptekman
description: A counterfeit 500-franc note is passed from hand to hand until it reaches Yvon, the fuel delivery man, with devastating consequences on his life.

title: Brucio nel vento
actors: Ivan Franek, Barbara Lukesová, Ctirad Götz, Caroline Baehr
description: Tobias, born in an Eastern European village, lives and works in Switzerland. As a young boy, after discovering that one of the guests in his mother's house - a bit beggar and a bit prostitute - was his father, he stabbed him in the back and fled. Later, haunted by nightmares, he tried to distract himself in writing by building a dream: the arrival of Line, met at school as a child. Then, one day, Line really arrives: it's about Cecilia, her father's daughter ...
notes: Soldini links his author's poetics ("The serene air of the West", "A soul divided in two" and "The acrobats") with the exploration of existential dynamics, already conducted in the form of comedy in "Pane and tulips ". The renunciations, frustrations, pains and unhappiness of the melodrama are, of course, enveloping and heartbreaking, despite a brighter and warmer ending (from East to West and then to South) than that of Agota Kristof's novel "Yesterday". , from which the film is based. The actors (the Czechs Franek and Lukesová) are perfect in letting an irreparable sadness and anxiety vibrate and "burn". The Italian-Swiss director knows how to reach heights of great intensity and density, even if at times his programmatic "coldness" (as well as certain rewinds of the story on itself and the occasional insistence on characters and secondary narrative passages) end up weakening the vehemence of passion.

title: The Doorbell Rang
actors: Maury Chaykin, Timothy Hutton, Bill Smitrovich, Colin Fox
description: The writer Althaus was working on a hot book about the illegal activities of the FBI: it is therefore not strange that the man is found dead in his apartment. The inspector of the homicide squad Cramer informs Archie Goodwin, a precious collaborator of Nero Wolfe, of the incident. For the two famous investigators, the investigations turned out to be rather complex: in fact, no weapon was found at the scene of the crime, and there is not even a trace of the exploded bullets. There is only one witness, who claims to have seen three federal agents leave the victim's apartment the very night of the murder ...

title: Boca a boca
actors: Aitana Sánchez-Gijón, Javier Bardem, Josep Maria Flotats

title: Due once di piombo
actors: Robert Woods, Norman Clark, Lucia Modugno, Peter Carsten
description: The Mexican Pecos Martinez witnesses the assault that Joe Kline and his gang bring to Brack, who nevertheless manages to deliver to Tedder, owner of the local saloon, a barrel containing the stolen goods of a shot. It is the spark that sets the world apart ...
notes: Zero originality: reserved for fans of the genre.

title: Non avere paura della zia Marta
actors: Adriana Russo, Gabriele Tinti, Maurice Poli, Jessica Moore
description: The Clayton family - made up of Fabio, his wife Nora and their children Giorgia and Maurizio - are about to spend the weekend in Aunt Marta's old farmhouse. The visit promises to be quite agitated, since the woman has just left the psychiatric hospital ...
notes: Pretty cheap chills.

title: Le fabuleux destin d'Amélie Poulain
actors: Audrey Tautou, Mathieu Kassovitz, Rufus, Yolande Moreau, Dominique Pinon, Serge Merlin, Jamel Debbouze, Clotilde Mollet, Claire Maurier, Urbain Cancelier, Maurice Bénichou
description: Amélie, a twenty-year-old girl who comes from Montmatre, one day discovers she has a mission to fulfill: to alleviate the pain of others. Even minimal pains and frustrations: the loneliness of the neighbor, left by his partner, or that of the elderly parent who wishes the dwarf of the garden long journeys to exotic countries, the ones he has always dreamed of. At one point Amélie falls in love with someone like her, a guy who fell from the moon who collects fragments of passport photos thrown away. Will prince charming and his fairy live happily ever after?
notes: Welcome to the "fabulous" world of Amélie Poulain, conceived by master Jeunet with the pastel shades of marzipan nativity scenes. A captivating, uplifting, national-popular, captivating, pimp film. But also smart, funny, light, well written, engaging. Mass entertainment cinema as it should be. Beyond a few delays (the fairytale and the girl's sympathy have also taken the hand of the authors) The fabulous world of Amélie accompanies the viewer where good morning really means good morning, in an imaginary Montmartre seen as a fantastic place and very far from reality "red light" of the surroundings. An elsewhere where you don't meet Bob the player but eccentric characters, candy floss figurines, communities in search of hope and contentment. It is true that conflicts are unrealistically dissolved in Amélie's crystalline eyes, but it is equally true that Jeunet does not deceive her choice of aesthetic field. Who does not love the cinema-candy (which has the right to exist) abstain.

title: Birthday Girl
actors: Nicole Kidman, Ben Chaplin, Mathieu Kassovitz, Vincent Cassel
description: John, a mild-mannered bank clerk from the English province, has been waiting for a lifetime to meet the girl of his dreams. Tired of waiting, he "orders" a Russian bride on the Internet. When the enigmatic Nadia sets foot on English territory, problems begin for John: the newlywed has to deal with Yuri and Aleksej, "cousins" of the girl, who have arrived to celebrate her birthday ...
notes: Butterworth's second film (after _Soho_) is a kind of vague remake of _Something overwhelming_. The developments of the film are predictable, the pace slows down, the Cassel-Kassovitz duo doesn't take off and Kidman ends up wasted in the usual naive-perverted role.

title: Ti voglio bene Eugenio
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Giuliana De Sio, Jacques Perrin, Chiara De Bonis
description: Eugenio is a quiet and affable Down boy who spends his life in a splendid house immersed in the green countryside. Eugenio, aware of his own diversity, accepts, at the request of a primary obstetrician friend of the family, to tell his life to a pregnant woman tormented by the uncertainty of whether or not to accept the birth of a child like him. Eugenio is also tormented by the memory of his love for Elena who left the country as a teenager to marry a man who had seduced her.
notes: The intent of Francisco J. Fernandez's film is honorable and his good will is great; pity that his story develops without jerks and, unfortunately, without real suffering.

title: Un amore perfetto
actors: Cesare Cremonini, Martina Stella, Denis Fasolo, Carlo Simoni
description: Celestino, known as Ceghe, the intemperate Berni and Laura are three twenty-year-olds who live in Cervia in a town on the Romagna coast. Like most children, they have problems with work and growth. Ceghe and Berni are used to sharing everything: the disqualifications on the football field, but also the love for the beautiful Laura.
notes: More than a perfect love, we could talk about a perfect film, at least from a marketing point of view: we have the young actress of the moment, an already established icon of young music, an overall well-assorted cast. Of course, those who expected "Jules and Jim" will inevitably be disappointed, because you don't see much of the soul and needs of these confused young people.

title: Volesse il cielo!
actors: Vincenzo Salemme, Tosca D'Aquino, Maurizio Casagrande, Biagio Izzo
description: Inspector Massa while chasing a convict in his car crashes into a waste bin, from which, after the collision, a man comes out. For the blow received, he seems to have lost his memory. The inspector, after taking him to the hospital and the police station, thinks about taking the stranger to his home. She gives him a bed and tries to educate him as if he were her own son. Meanwhile at the police station there is a beautiful policewoman who is about to make a historic decision.
notes: When the script plot slips into the blind alley of fiction in fiction, with saints and infantry, the director-actor-screenwriter makes the goal and signs his worst film.

title: K-Pax
actors: Kevin Spacey, Jeff Bridges, Mary McCormack, Alfre Woodard
description: Did the mysterious and mild Prot fall to Earth from the planet K-Pax, as he insists on repeating, or did he emerge from a traumatic past? That's what psychiatrist Mark Powell would like to find out. Meanwhile, hospitalized in an asylum, Prot proves to have a great influence on other patients and at the same time amazes scientists about his scientific knowledge ...
notes: Two Oscars (_The Usual Suspects_ and _American Beauty_) aren't enough to make an actor indisputable, and Kevin Spacey is no exception. Presence and acting technique need the support of a solid narrative structure: exactly what Softley's film lacks.

title: Forget Me Never
actors: Mia Farrow, Martin Sheen, Colm Feore, Mikey MacGregor
description: Diane McGowin is very busy in her profession as a lawyer and begins to show worrying symptoms of memory loss, especially the recent one. Alarmed, she undergoes a series of clinical tests whose response confirms the most suspicious blacks: it is in fact a case of Alzheimer's. Diane decides to keep her husband Jack and children in the dark about the impending drama, but some setbacks force her to reveal the truth. The friendship with Albert Morelli, a former teacher suffering from an even more serious form of the disease, makes her aware of the terrible prospects she is facing, inducing her to attend a therapeutic group ...

title: Over My Dead Body
actors: Maury Chaykin, Timothy Hutton, Bill Smitrovich, Colin Fox
description: This time the famous investigator is forced to investigate the murder of a man named Percy Ludlow: the fact took place inside the Miltan studio, where two inseparable girls of Montenegrin origin - Neya Tormic and Carla Lovcen - teach the art of fencing . The first, among other things, claims to be the adopted daughter of Wolfe himself: according to his version, the two had separated when, many years ago, the detective had left Yugoslavia. Nero will therefore have to go to the Balkan country to try to solve a case that - as usual - looks very complicated and difficult to solve.

title: Le retour de Casanova
actors: Alain Delon, Fabrice Luchini, Elsa Lunghini, Delia Boccardo, Wadeck Stanczak, Philippine Leroy-Beaulieu, Alain Cuny
description: The years have passed inexorably, and Giacomo Casanova's love career has come to an end: to the ravages of time is added the penalty for exile from Venice, and now only memory remains. But the elderly amateur does not resist the challenge of one last conquest and tries to overcome the resistance of the beautiful and young Marcolina. Casanova still has a few arrows in his bow, and the cunning of age suggests that he should resort to darkness ...
notes: Arthur Schnitzler's bitter novel of the same name is reduced by Carrière and Niermans into a traditional and forgettable comedy of misunderstandings in costume.

title: Gli specialisti
actors: Johnny Hallyday, Gastone Moschin, Françoise Fabian, Sylvie Fennec, Angela Luce, Serge Marquand, Gino Pernice, Mario Castellani, Mario Adorf, Mimmo Poli
description: The brother of a gunslinger without art or part, is savagely lynched because he is accused of a theft which, in reality, he did not commit. To avenge him, he will forge an ambiguous alliance with a wicked Mexican bandit.
notes: We are almost at the end of the happy spaghetti-western season, and it shows. A Sergio Corbucci in minor.

title: Madeline
actors: Frances McDormand, Nigel Hawthorne, Hatty Jones
description: Madeline, a little red-haired orphan, has a sixth sense for trouble but is equally adept at solving the mess she causes. Miss Clavel, who runs Madeline's school, does not approve of the girl's exuberant behavior: however, she will have to change her mind when she receives a decisive hand in thwarting the plans of Lord Covington, the owner of the building where the institute is located. who has decided to dispose of the property.
notes: Fun for kids. The character of the pestiferous girl, who looks a lot like our local Giamburrasca, dates back to the late 1930s and is the fruit of Ludwig Bemelmans' imagination.

title: La leggenda di Fra' Diavolo
actors: Tony Russell, Amedeo Nazzari, Haya Harareet, Mario Adorf
description: Second half of the 18th century: Michele Pezza, known as "Fra 'Diavolo", is a brigand who opposes the French invasion of the kingdom of Naples, ruled by the fearful Ferdinand of Bourbon. Although the latter has appointed him colonel, Fra 'Diavolo must beware of the numerous enemies that plot behind him and returns to the bush; but when Napoleon's troops launch the decisive attack, his valor and courage will not be enough to avoid defeat and death by hanging.
notes: Under the Anglo-Saxon pseudonym, Savona fires a further biography of the legendary Neapolitan folk hero. Pure entertainment.

title: Sinnui yauman
actors: Lau Shi Ming, Leslie Cheung, Wong Tsu-hsien, Wu Ma
description: Arriving in a small town to carry out his thankless task, the debt collector Ning Tsai-shen finds no one willing to welcome him for the night and is forced to take refuge in the temple of Lan Ro, haunted by spirits: here he meets Yen Che-hsia, a monk Taoist and warrior, and the beautiful Nieh Hsiao-tsing, with whom he falls in love. The girl, however, is in turn a ghost, tied for eternity to a frightening tree capable of sucking the vital essence from the unfortunate victims: the undertaking is enormous, but Ning still tries to break the spell ...
notes: The magic and incredible dynamism of the best Hong Kong cinema in a film to be savored.

title: Topâzu
actors: Miho Nikaidoh, Sayoko Amano, Masahiko Shimada, Tenmei Kanou
description: Submissive, compliant, always ready to satisfy the needs of clients (who often unload their perverse and violent impulses on her): Ai is a Sado-maso prostitute, but her apparent renunciation of individual dignity has deep motivations.
notes: Murakami immerses himself in explicit sex, but stages it with a coldness and a distance (the skyscrapers of the megalopolis, the typically Japanese formalism of the characters) that border on existential restlessness. The Italian edition is very well cut, but instead of hard scenes it focuses on the more "impersonal" - and significant - passages of Ai's aimless wanderings.

title: Iris
actors: Arancia Cecilia Grimaldi, Guia Jelo, Salvatore Lazzaro, Beatrice Gallo, Mariano Scalisi, Francesco Di Leva, Maurizio Nicolosi, Luca Badagliaccio, Gino Biscotto Volo, Enrico Tranchina
description: Maria, a seven-year-old girl who lives on the small island of Ustica, after leaving school realizes that she has forgotten her mother's birthday. She understands this because she sees that her brothers, who have come to pick her up after school, have two beautiful bouquets of wildflowers with them. Maria begins a journey in search of irises, her mother's favorite flowers.
notes: The artistic career of the Sicilian Aurelio Grimaldi is frankly bizarre. Screenplays ("Mery per semper", "Ragazzi fuori" ...), a striking debut ("The descent of Aclà to Floristella"), works of suggestive mannerism and nice unpleasantness ("La rebelle" and "Le buttane", "Nerolio"), books, shorts, sincere, committed, militant documentaries; but also incomprehensible falls into trash (among other things not even "theoretical-programmatic") with already "mythical" sculpted films such as "The Butcher" and "The Wolf Woman". Wonder, then, even more this "Iris", practically a remake of "The white balloon" by Panahi, transplanted to the tiny and beautiful island of Ustica, between dialects and narrow alleys, sea that presses and envelops, sun that beats and lights and a little girl who wants, at all costs, to give flowers to her mother on her birthday. The neorealist style is the measure of Grimaldi's courage, who relies on the wonderful and bold face of his real daughter, on the natural strength of the landscape, on characters "taken from the road" to transform real (very low budget) and allegorical "poverty" (Mediterranean isolation as an inverted metaphor of a rediscovered joy of living) in a happy happiness that can now only be found in the southern hemisphere.

title: The Dancer
actors: Mia Frye, Garland Whitt, Rodney Eastman, Josh Lucas, Jarrod Bunch
description: India has a passion for dance and an ambition to dance at Braodway. But the girl has a handicap, she is mute since birth. On Saturday night the dancer performs in a Brooklyn nightclub where she competes with the best DJs in New York. It will be in that place that she will meet a scientist who invents a system that will allow her to express herself and love.
notes: The film, written by Luc Besson, is a mystical-scientific variation on the theme of "Flashdance", naturally updated to "politically correct" (the protagonist is African-American) to the rhythms of today's wildest dance. The only reason to see it is Mia Frye, very beautiful and very good, so wasted.

title: Vanilla Sky
actors: Tom Cruise, Penélope Cruz, Kurt Russell, Cameron Diaz
description: David, a brilliant and successful New York publisher, is very lucky with women; to the point that, when a friend makes the mistake of introducing him to his new partner Sofia, the two end up getting together. Then one day David has a car accident from which he comes out with a horribly disfigured face, and from that moment his life changes: everyone avoids him, including Sofia. But one morning David is awakened by Sofia, who declares her love for her ...
notes: It was not easy to turn a good psycho-fantastic story like that of "Open your eyes" (directed in 1997 by Alejandro Amenábar, also co-writer with Mateo Gil) into a boring film. In absolute terms, it is quite difficult to make a subject that oscillates between dream and reality, thriller and science fiction, regret of what did not happen in real life and unwanted horrors ringed by the dream, tiring - and at least two-thirds tension-free. Yet Crowe did it: his remake unfolds over two hours with very few thrills. Of course, we all keep in our hearts Audrey Hepburn's Sabrina and Bob Dylan's songs, a poster of Godard's "Until the Last Breath" alongside that of Truffaut's "Jules et Jim", an ideal Atticus Finch as a father and the memory of a perfect love that never grew. But these slight traces (which are probably the best suited to Crowe's moods and formation) are not enough. Poetry does not bond with tension, and the impossible never becomes either wonderful or credible.

title: Figli. Hijos
actors: Carlos Echevarría, Julia Sarano, Stefania Sandrelli, Enrique Pineyro
description: Buenos Aires, during the military dictatorship. A disappeared prisoner gives birth to two children, a boy and a girl. She is "saved" by the midwife, he is expropriated by the family of a hierarch. Milan, today. Javier meets Rosa, a girl who comes from Argentina and says she is convinced that she is his sister. They will leave together for Barcelona to take the DNA test and reconnect the blood link with their history and their identity.
notes: Second investigation, tense, dramatic, with a writing that involves and freezes (the emotionality, the emphasis, the possible twists, the plot) on a terrible memory. Marco Bechis, after "Garage Olimpo", with a language and a style consciously different from the previous film, continues to focus on the invisible: the tragedy of the men and women murdered and erased by the Argentine dictatorship. Fathers and mothers tortured and murdered, the military dealt with brutal zeal, the children, just born, the disappeared. "Adopted" and expropriated as goods, objects. A symbolic spoils of war. Between 1976 and 1984, at least five hundred children disappeared and were entrusted to other families. Between Lombardy and Barcelona, ??with an epilogue in Buenos Aires, the elaboration of mourning, of memories, of the past gives Rosa and Javier an atrocious truth in which the laws of blood, violence and politics are the true DNA of a chapter of recent history.

title: Navajo Blues
actors: Steven Bauer, Irene Bedard, Charlotte Lewis, Barry Donaldson
description: Nick, a Las Vegas police officer, is the key witness to a murder committed by the son of the most ruthless local crime boss. The policeman is sent under a false name to Window Rock, a village inhabited by the Navajo tribe. It so happens that Nick has to solve some murder cases there too.

title: Angel Town
actors: Olivier Gruner, Theresa Saldana, Frank Aragon, Mark Dacascos
description: Kickboxer Jacques leaves Paris and finds himself in the suburbs of Los Angeles. He plans to get his engineering degree, but finds himself coaching college team athletes. He will have to face the small local underworld. They will be blows to everyone.
notes: Small role for Mark "Crying Freeman" Dacascos.

title: Who Am I This Time?
actors: Christopher Walken, Susan Sarandon, Robert Ridgely, Dorothy Patterson
description: Telephone employee Helen gets the part of Stella in an amateur production of "A Streetcar Named Desire". In the role of Stanley Kowalski Harry acts, who only on stage manages to overcome his shyness: Helen falls in love with him ...
notes: Tv movie well directed by Demme. From a short story by Kurt Vonnegut.

title: La coda dello scorpione
actors: George Hilton, Anita Strindberg, Evelyn Stewart, Luigi Pistilli
description: Lisa Baumer loses her husband in a mysterious plane crash and receives a large inheritance. The insurance agent assigned to the case is not convinced of the woman's innocence and investigates the affair, but must change his mind when Lisa is also murdered. The agent finds himself involved in spite of himself in the chain of murders that will follow.
notes: Second thriller directed by Sergio Martino after _The strange vice of Mrs. Wardh_, it stands out from the panorama of the time for the sunny setting of the Greek coast. Although the camera dwells for a long time on Strindberg's graces, the erotic component does not affect the construction of the suspense and the tension is not lacking.

title: Buddy
actors: Rene Russo, Robbie Coltrane, Alan Cumming, Irma P. Hall
description: In the New York of the Twenties, the extravagant and wealthy Trudy Lintz cultivates an unbridled passion for animals, to the point of transforming the house in which she lives with her husband into a real zoological garden. It is therefore normal that Buddy, a gorilla cub collected in desperate conditions, will also find a place there; in 1933, now an adult, Buddy is sent to the Chicago World's Fair, but suddenly his behavior becomes uncontrollable ...
notes: Thompson, former writer of Tim Burton, writes and directs a film that oscillates between humor and melancholy, escaping the numerous stereotypes of the "animalist" genre.

title: Hearts of Fire
actors: Bob Dylan, Rupert Everett, Fiona Flanagan, Julian Glover, Suzanne Bertish
description: Former rock star Billy Parker decides to return to perform to lend a hand to Molly, a young singer who aspires to make her way. Billy also involves James Colt, the leading rocker of the moment, in the project: despite the foreseeable difficulties and some misunderstandings, Molly's determination and talent will end up affirming itself.
notes: If you believe in it and fight to the end, your dreams will come true: nothing new in this umpteenth apology for individual success in a rock key. The icon-Dylan will still be enough to attract the fans, even if the real curiosity is an Everett who really gets into it with microphones and guitar.

title: Prisoner's Base
actors: Maury Chaykin, Timothy Hutton, Bill Smitrovich, Colin Fox
description: Goodwin received a strange request from a beautiful and mysterious lady: a week of hospitality (at $ 50 a night) at Nero Wolfe's home, without providing any other explanation. Archie, visibly attracted to the woman, informs the investigator. A few days later Wolfe receives a visit from Perry Helmar, who is looking for his collaborator Priscilla Eads: the latter is in fact about to get hold of a large sum of money, and turns out to be the same person who stays in the Wolfe house. The next day, however, Priscilla is found dead, and the suspicions immediately fall on Goodwin ...

title: Tolérance
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Rupert Everett, Anne Brochet, Marc De Jonge, Laszlo Szabo
description: France, years of the Directory (1795-1799): following her ambitions of spiritual elevation, the young Tolérance convinces her husband, the noble Marmont, to welcome the ambiguous and ascetic Assuerus (aka Horace Walop) into the family. This man, meticulously "educated" to hedonism by the gastronome and gourmet Marmont, will prove to be a snake within.
notes: The last official appearance of the national Ugo coincides with a classic "packaging" film, accurate in the reconstruction and bowed with the tasty dishes prepared by Marmont. And there is not even a "moralistic" subtext, which only makes everything slightly indigestible.

title: Un maresciallo in gondola
actors: Ezio Greggio, Victoria Silvstedt, Sandro Ghiani, Philippe Leroy
description: Cortina, 1959. Carabiniere Colombo didn't take long to become the vip marshal. In the renowned ski resort he met personalities and stars from the world of cinema. But now even those times have passed and the military is a bit bored. The only spurts of life he has them by dating the young widow Zanin with whom he is secretly in love. To free him from the oppressive boredom comes a phone call from the provincial commander who calls him to report in Venice and entrusts him with a delicate task: to supervise Kim Dorak, a famous American actress and to watch over a precious necklace that the starlet has brought with her.

title: Wish You Were Here
actors: Emily Lloyd, Tom Bell, Jesse Birdsall, Clare Clifford, Barbara Durkin

title: El vampiro de la autopista
actors: Val Davis, Bernabe Barta Barri, Joe Campoy, Susan Carvasal
description: Adolf moved from England to Germany to take possession of a castle inherited from a descendant of Baron Winninger, in whose basement the bodies of the noble progenitor and his wife are buried. Joined by his partner Susan, while he is at the manor Adolf sees the police suspicions about a mysterious trail of crimes, which began even before his arrival, directed against him. Obviously the inspector in charge of the case does not want to hear about vampires, but Adolf is of the opposite opinion ...
notes: Cheap gothic thrills, shot with an amateurism that results in involuntary comedy.

title: Black Hawk Down
actors: Josh Hartnett, Ewan McGregor, Tom Sizemore, Eric Bana, William Fichtner, Ewen Bremner, Sam Shepard, Gabriel Casseus, Kim Coates, Hugh Dancy, Ron Eldard, Ioan Gruffudd, Tom Guiry, Charlie Hofheimer, Danny Hoch
description: On October 3, 1993, a group of rangers and specialists from the Delta Force received the order to capture General Aidid's lieutenants gathered in the heart of Mogadishu, inside the area hostile to American troops stationed in Somalia together with the forces of the UN. The mission must last a few minutes; instead it lasts for eighteen hours of iron and fire. Two Black Hawk helicopters are shot down and the survivors are rescued ...
notes: It is not their war (of the Americans), but we know that in the cinema war is war, which is fought above all for the spirit of the body and that the rangers' code commits never to abandon a comrade in the hands of the enemy. Hot material, this episode of recent history; especially if entrusted to a producer like Jerry Buckheimer, who does not have a light hand with militarist rhetoric (and not even with the cinematographic one, on the other hand ...). But Ridley Scott's solid British "militarism" and great spectacular energy save Black Hawk Down. Elementary on the ideological level (but often war films are, or even must be), it has the merit of concentrating for two full and incessant hours on military action: which is hard, frenetic, immersed in blood, dust, danger, in explosions. After a Pearl Harbor in a soap key and the frenzies of Captain Corelli, a war film that does not allow itself breath or alibi. Two technical Oscars have been won, one for editing by Pietro Scalia and one for sound.

title: The Little Vampire
actors: Jonathan Lipnicki, Richard E. Grant, Alice Krige, Pamela Gidley
description: What happens when a child moves with their parents from New York to the green hills of Scotland? Simple: he sees vampires everywhere. The beauty is that the creatures of the night are not the fruit of his imagination but of centuries of Scottish traditions and history. Little bespectacled Tony lives this experience and becomes the laughing stock of his new schoolmates. Then the wonderful happens and one night she meets Rudy, a young vampire with whom a great friendship and supportive mutual assistance is born to solve the small problems of everyday life. Boredom is averted by a rough and stubborn vampire slayer who attempts to exterminate Tony's family.
notes: More than a movie, it seems like a TV movie for kids, full of special effects, a nice panegyric of friendship and some funny gimmicks, like the vampire cows that go away at night flying to load the vampire slayer truck, to the notes of the "Valkyrie's ride". Rudy's parents / vampires are Richard E. Grant and the revived Alice Krige.

title: L'inverno
actors: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Valeria Golino, Fabrizio Gifuni, Yorgo Voyagis
description: Two couples, Leo and Marta, Gustavo and Anna, meet on the edge of a post-industrial metropolis in the north. Leo is a writer in crisis, his partner hides contradictions trying to create an art gallery. Gustavo is an industrialist who has a crude and perverse relationship with his woman. It will be Anna who seduces Leo with her femininity, thus making the problems of the apparently more solid couple re-emerge.
notes: Nina di Majo follows the difficult path of the cold bourgeois drama a la Antonioni. Visually the author knows the path well, unfortunately, it is on the level of the word that the film jams. The dialogues fall into literary banality.

title: The Believer
actors: Ryan Gosling, Billy Zane, Theresa Russell, Summer Phoenix
description: Danny Balint, a young former Old Testament scholar, has become a ferocious anti-Semite. Over the years he has managed to take a leading position within the American neo-Nazi movement. His rise to the top of the organization coincides with the discovery that, despite everything, he continues to be a rabbi who attacks Jews during the day and studies the Torah at night. Over time, Danny will realize that his only desire is to become a living contradiction.
notes: The film, awarded at Sundance 2001 and carefully kept away from American theaters (the old "censorship" of the market continues to work everywhere), tackles, with a dry style, quite original, in some moments very guarded and in others incandescent from the point of dramaturgical view, a cultural contradiction drawn from a true story. Danny Balint (21-year-old Ryan Gosling from "The Taste of Victory") is a neo-Nazi and he is also a Jew. Fighting with its roots, with its faith, with its convictions, with the idea of ??a disease, of a Jewish dysfunction of the world. Between soul and ideology. The boy is intelligent, bright, cultured and is taken under the protective wing (theoretical and political) of a couple formed by Billy Zane and Theresa Russell. Terrorist fanaticism and religious reverence, morbid relationships and confusion, ancient anger and fears. The excellent protagonist plays all the lacerations of the character and ideally confronts Edward Norton of "American History X" and Tim Roth of "Made in Britain". Behind the camera makes his debut Henry Bean, the screenwriter of "Dirty Business" and "Public Enemy".

title: Incantesimo napoletano
actors: Marina Confalone, Gianni Ferreri, Chiara Papa, Serena Improta, Clelia Bernacchi
description: In a family of true Neapolitans, or rather to tell the truth of Neapolitan fundamentalists, an incredible fact happens: a little girl is born who speaks Milanese and who wants to eat risotto and panettone. Imagine the surprise and the efforts that Assuntina's family members make to try to "heal her". And things are bound to get worse when the little girl becomes an adult.
notes: At the origin there is a short, with the same title. But at the origin there is also the Italy of today, which some would like to divide in the name of grotesque ethnic-political projects. At the origin there is an ancient dichotomy that cinema has told many times, and often in an admirable way. Naples against Milan? To see _Neapolitan enchantment_, one would say: Naples & Milan, one inside the other, two metropolises made to challenge each other and to challenge each other, but perhaps more similar than they both suspect. This is why the film works: the surreal idea is in fact accepted, by the characters and by us viewers, in a fluid way. The gimmick is brilliant (there is no other adjective), the rest is the development of the gags, and here we go back to the origin: the short peeps out and prevents the actual film from growing as we would like. After an hour of storytelling, another idea as brilliant as the first was needed. Let's be content: the film is delicious even in this way and the two interpreters, Marina Confalone and Gianni Ferreri, are amazing.

title: The Musketeer
actors: Justin Chambers, Catherine Deneuve, Mena Suvari, Stephen Rea
description: At the age of twenty D'Artagnan decides to leave Gascony to try the adventure in Paris. The boy, agile, smart and courageous, has all the characteristics to become a skilled musketeer. Soon D'Artagnan, after having met Aramis and Porthos and being "instructed" by his mentor Planchet, will begin the fight against the perfidious Cardinal Richelieu.
notes: Having abandoned the more usual territories of science fiction and horror, Hyams allows himself a digression in the history of European literature, quite improbable in substance but which finds its reason for being in an acceptable rhythm and in the dynamic duel scenes. The cast recalls those one-time international mega-productions that lined up well-known names for each of the countries that had contributed to the production. Here we find an ironic Catherine Deneuve who in the role of the queen who cheats at cards and ventures into the sewers of Paris, an increasingly perfidious Tim Roth in those of the thug Febre, a Mena Suvari clearly uncomfortable out of her "Americans" something (Pie, Beauty, Virgin, etc.) and a hieratic Stephen Rea in the role of Richelieu. The almost unknown Justin Chambers as D'Artagnan is as expressive as a statue, but the acrobatic evolutions that Xin Xin Xiong ("Once Upon a Time in China") put him into redeem his character; see the duel of the stairs with Febre to believe.

title: Heist
actors: Gene Hackman, Rebecca Pidgeon, Sam Rockwell, Delroy Lindo, Danny DeVito
description: Joe is a burglary artist, and his latest venture - he emptied a jewelry store - was also crowned with success. Having made contact with Bergman, his fence, Joe manages to place some of the jewels in exchange for a large sum of money, and prepares to enjoy his "retirement". But Bergman disagrees and offers him, in exchange for paying the other part of the booty, a new blow: intercepting a shipment of gold from Switzerland ...
notes: Mamet's characters are fantasists of deception and greed. They never tell the whole truth, because truth is a point of view and points of view are transformed, tarnished, pass from the gaseous to the liquid state and, finally, to the solid one. The formula of delinquency, fraud, deception, the contract between partners and lovers has the consistency of an unstable house of cards. This certainty - combined with the other constants perfected in many theatrical texts and in some of the films written and directed by the American author - is the cornerstone of a more ironic than violent noir. As in Woody Allen's films, one would want to write down the verbal duels, the jokes, the soft reversals of the field, the two-faced scheme of intelligence. A versatile mechanical engineering of the story, supported by the performances of excellent actors engaged, in the space of a shot, to say one thing and conceal another.

title: Da zero a dieci
actors: Massimo Bellinzoni, Elisabetta Cavallotti, Pierfrancesco Favino, Stefania Rivi
description: Giove, Libero, Biccio and Baygon left Correggio commitments, families, problems and responsibilities to continue a weekend interrupted in Rimini in the summer of 1980. The city has certainly changed, but what has remained the same is the Ambra pension and Caterina, Lara, Carmen and Betta, the girls protagonists of that unleashed weekend twenty years earlier.
notes: It is a Romagna Split that does not create atmospheres and wants, with narrative intelligence, good dialogues, some scenes shot with considerable skill (for all, the Russian race-roulette with machines) to free and drain energies on the set as on the stage of a concert rock. Play and sing to establish empathy with the audience and tell a story to communicate, share, confess pieces of life. Four girls also arrive at the weekend appointment: the female figures, however, are much less interesting than the male ones. The band of eight characters celebrates a series of non-birthdays, struggles to grasp the glare of escaped moments, parades for those who want to turn around and look at them and accompanies the fate of those who tragically renounce growing up and those who accept to be ferried over half of the way. Ligabue knows American cinema and films and uses them naturally, has a point of view on the world and reveals it honestly, has a strong sense of the story and has a genuine sense of rhythm. And it's not a question of chords, disagreements, scales and bars.

title: Zil pevcij drozd
actors: Gela Kandelaki, Gogi Ckheidze, Irina Giandieri, Elena Landia
