description: Even the symphony orchestra of Tbilisi, the Georgian capital, has its good timpanist: in this case it is Guja, a young man who has the characteristic of always arriving at the last useful moment to perform the (limited) parts that the scores provide. for his instrument. For the rest, his life unfolds in a perennial wandering: an authentic "irregular", distracted and unreliable like few others ...
notes: It is practically impossible for the regime's censorship not to take it out on a film - and with a director - brazen to the point of following the vicissitudes of a character who is so little "exemplary". Light, sharp, lashing Ioseliani.

title: Palmetto
actors: Woody Harrelson, Elisabeth Shue, Gina Gershon, Rolf Hoppe
description: Fresh from the jail, where he had unjustly done a couple of years for not keeping his mouth shut on a case of corruption among local politicians, former journalist Harry Barber decides that honesty does not pay and takes part in the fake kidnapping of Odette, daughter of millionaire Felix Malroux. The mastermind of the project is Rhea, Malroux's second wife; but on the way, needless to say, the matter gets terribly tangled ...
notes: Usually serious and "busy", in this American trip the Teutonic Schlöndorff tries his hand at Southern noir (the Palmetto of the title is a town in Florida). All already seen, of course, but overall pleasant.

title: Lucrezia giovane
actors: Ettore Manni, Simonetta Stefanelli, Massimo Foschi, Fred Robsham
description: The wedding between Lucrezia Borgia and Giovanni Sforza, nephew of Ludovico il Moro, are canceled thanks to the interest of Cardinal Sisto of Monreale and with the false pretext of the groom's impotence. Behind the intrigue there is the intent to safeguard and enhance the alliances of Pope Alexander VI, father of Lucrezia and Duke Cesare Borgia. But the latter, blinded by love for the beautiful sister, will kill all the men who have had relationships with her: relatives, friends and Alfonso of Aragon himself, who married Lucrezia during his absence ...
notes: Behind the pseudo-historical facade, only cheap eroticism is staged.

title: Ocean Tribe
actors: Vaughn Roberts, Gregg Rainwater, Robert Caso, Troy Fazio
description: Bob once only cared about surfing: now, at just 25 years of age, doctors have diagnosed him with end-stage cancer and are only giving him a few months to survive. The news shakes the lives of some of the boy's adventurers like an earthquake: Schwartz, an undisciplined doctor; Noah, worried about impending fatherhood; Lance, who pursues the mirage of an acting career; Jeb, just released after yet another arrest for drug possession. Together again, the four seize an old station wagon and "free" Bob from the hospital, determined to give him one last raid on the Mexican waves ...

title: Desperate Measures
actors: Michael Keaton, Andy Garcia, Brian Cox, Marcia Gay Harden
description: Detective Frank Connor has little time to find a bone marrow donor who has DNA compatible with that of his seriously ill son. Unfortunately for him, the only one with the necessary genetic requirements is Peter McCabe, a ruthless killer with a clear mind. The criminal accepts, then sets the hospital on fire and tries to escape.
notes: "Author" detective story for Barbet Schroeder, director of the controversial "The virgin of the assassins". The actors' rehearsal is intense and the ambiguity surrounding McCabe's character is intriguing, but the "philosophical" ambitions are exaggerated. The film is enjoyable but quickly archived.

title: Un branco di vigliacchi
actors: Pascale Petit, Roger Moore, Aroldo Tieri, Scilla Gabel
description: Four English prisoners who escaped from a concentration camp on 8 September seek and find refuge in the farmhouse of Giuditta, a beautiful girl who works hard to support her little brother Marcello. Their hiding place is discovered, the four are killed and with them the boy who has rushed to warn them of the imminent danger. A Giuditta, united with a group of people on the run, all that remains is to try to reach that area of ??Italy occupied by the Anglo-Americans. The peasant woman will have to submit to the shameful desires of a Nazi commander.
notes: The story is inspired by a short story by Guy de Maupassant.

title: Una vita violenta
actors: Franco Citti, Serena Vergano, Alfredo Leggi, Enrico Maria Salerno
description: Tommaso, a young man from the township, lives by expedients. One day he meets Irene and falls in love with her: convinced to impress her, he organizes a serenade but gets the opposite result to his aims, namely a fight. The incident takes him to prison; returned to freedom, he fell ill with tuberculosis and was hospitalized in a sanatorium where he met a trade unionist, whom he became attached to. The new friendship convinces him to believe in himself again, to the point of wanting to settle down: but fate does not seem to have any desire to fulfill his wishes ...
notes: Based on Pasolini's book of the same name, the film does not have the strength of the poet's words.

title: The Bank
actors: Anthony La Paglia, David Wenham, Sibylla Budd, Steve Rodgers
description: Jim is a genius who has developed a system that can predict future stock market crashes. The potential in the software ignites the imagination and greed of Simon, CEO of Centabank. The credit institution hires him not imagining that he is raising a snake in his bosom.
notes: As always in these cases, the theoretical and speculative aspect of the film remains incomprehensible to the layman: those who had problems even with the multiplication tables cannot say if the script is credible or gives the numbers here and there. It should save us the tension which, however, hits the mark only at times. There remains the taste of a coldly anti-financial film, in which the hero claims to hate banks (how to blame him?).

title: America's Sweethearts
actors: Julia Roberts, Catherine Zeta-Jones, John Cusack, Billy Crystal
description: Kathleen "Kiki" Harrison is the devoted assistant - and sister - of the fickle and narcissistic movie star Gwen. Living next to her is not easy at all, but the undertaking risks becoming even more difficult; in fact Gwen and her husband, actor Eddie Thomas, are in crisis: it will be up to Kiki to help the two to appear in public again to promote the latest film shot together ...
notes: The Hollywood of tantrums, dirty tricks and lies of stars, producers, agents, journalists, overly creative and deliberately transgressive directors, press officers, promotion junkets, marketing and managers never changes: if cinema is about itself - between sunset avenues, showbiz theory and practice and sparkling backstage - it can count on a very structured repertoire to draw from, in noir or pink version. Roth returns to directing after more than a decade and rethinks - between a smile and a sneer - at his executive chairs at 20th Century Fox and at Disney, where he must have witnessed a "bestiary of vanities" that is anything but indifferent. A "game of four" between Zeta-Jones, sister-assistant Roberts (their duets are textbook), Crystal (who as a screenwriter kept all the most effective lines for himself) as the head of the press office and Cusack in those of Gwen's partner-husband-divorcing. Three canonical acts, between slapstick and romanticism, joyfully within the rules.

title: 3000 Miles To Graceland
actors: Kevin Costner, Kurt Russell, Christian Slater, Courteney Cox
description: Grim Murphy, tough Michael and a gang of other jailbirds decide to rob the Riviera Casino in Las Vegas. To go unnoticed, they dress up as Elvis Presley just as the city is celebrating the week of the double of the king of rock 'n' roll.
notes: The idea is not new, but unlike the eleven of Ocean these make a massacre. Then they screw each other. Or rather: Costner tries to take out the others but he did the math without Jena Plissken. And without the adventurous "family" (Courteney Cox plus a child) that he carries around with his will. Once the awkwardness of the chilling direction has been overcome, here is a nice divertissment that reconciles with second-row cinema, the one that can at best afford decayed or older stars. It's nice to see Costner with bacon and Russell without facelift taking revenge on the star standards accepted by glossy peers. In reverse roles, however: Kevin had to play the good style outlaw "A Perfect World" but at the last moment he asked the director and Kurt that he be left the part of the antagonist. A mad, furious and ferocious son of Elvis, destined for the Lee Marvin-style western baddie gallery. In "The Robbery" you shoot, eat, fuck, run away, hit, steal and listen to the soundtrack Stevie Ray Vaughn and Elvis Aaron, who seem to be good for the pressure. Let us be satisfied.

title: The Shipping News
actors: Kevin Spacey, Julianne Moore, Judi Dench, Cate Blanchett, Pete Postlethwaite
description: Typographer Quoyle spent his bored childhood in good neighborhoods in New York. His life runs smoothly alongside his wife Petal and daughter Bunny. But one bad day, a car accident makes him a widower. At this point Agnis, Quoyle's aunt, comes into play: the woman proposes to her father and daughter to move to Newfoundland in their grandparents' house. There man will try to find a new existential balance.
notes: Lasse Hallström is a director who hasn't taken risks for a long time. He has a very limited cinematic fantasy and his storytelling skills depend on the novels he approaches. His cinema is said more than seen.

title: Mulholland Drive
actors: Naomi Watts, Laura Harring, Justin Theroux, Ann Miller, Dan Hedaya, Melissa George, Laura Harring, Dan Hedaya, Brent Briscoe, Robert Forster, Katharine Towne, Lee Grant, Scott Coffey, Billy Ray Cyrus
description: In Hollywood, Rita loses her memory following an accident on Mulholland Drive. The woman meets Betty Elms, an Australian actress who has just landed in Los Angeles. Thanks to his help, Rita tries to find her memory and her identity. A man is haunted by a monstrous image. A director threatened by the mafia is forced to choose a stranger for his film.
notes: We understand little or nothing about the history of "Mulholland Drive". But don't worry, it has to be like that. First point: David Lynch reiterates the assumption of his most experimental film ("Fire walks with me") and of the one (according to him more unsolved), "Lost Roads". Cinema is the writing of the dream. A window that opens onto a world where it is not logic that regulates cause-effect relationships but delirium. Second point: only through the intimate knowledge of the Order is it possible to describe Chaos to perfection. Put simply: the fact that the story is incomprehensible in the heat of the moment does not of course mean that it does not make "sense". The map to move in delirium is given by the director himself, with his previous cinema (characters who speak upside down) and current (a key to reading ... blue). Try to walk the Mulholland Drive in reverse, to experience it as the love story between the soap and water starlet Diane and the vamp Camilla, and maybe fantasize about the suspension of reality that the theme of amnesia delightfully introduces. Abandonment, drift: with a genius like Lynch you have to know how to accept surrealism and the disillusionment of reality as sun, real, essences of cinema.

title: La casa del sortilegio
actors: Andy J. Forrest, Marina Giulia Cavalli, Sonia Petrovna, Maria Stella
description: To try to escape the nightmares that haunt him, Luca takes refuge in a country house. Here he runs into a blind pianist and his granddaughter. She is a witch who haunts the guests of the villa.
notes: The TV movie is part of the "Le case maledette" series. In the cast Marina Giulia Cavalli, the Ornella of "Un posto al sole".

title: Peligro...! Mujeres en acción
actors: Julio Aleman, Elizabeth Campbell, Barbara Angely, Alma Delia Fuentes
description: An all-female gang has decided to take over the Earth. To achieve their purpose, they introduced poisonous substances into the aqueducts. A CIA agent tries to break into the terrorists' lair to render them harmless.
notes: René Cardona's son directs this silly film.

title: Rosso sangue
actors: George Eastman, Charles Borromel, Annie Belle, Ian Danby
description: A priest arrives in a provincial town to help the inhabitants get rid of a cruel monster, whose blood has the characteristic of coagulating with extraordinary speed. The company, however, presents many problems ...
notes: Hidden behind one of his many aliases, a high hemoglobin Massaccesi.

title: The Outlaw
actors: Jack Beutel, Jane Russell, Thomas Mitchell, Walter Huston
description: Doc Holliday accuses the very young bandit Billy the Kid of stealing his horse, but the sympathy he feels for the boy prevails; and when Billy is injured by killing a man in a fight, he rescues him from arrest by the new sheriff Pat Garrett and finds refuge in his lover's Rio hut. Over time, however, passion breaks out between Billy and the woman ...
notes: Started by Hawks, the film then passed into the hands of billionaire Hughes, who imposed his flame (the increased Russell) as the protagonist. Impossible, in any case, not to notice the obvious - albeit hidden - homosexual implications of the relationship between Doc and Billy.

title: Deux fois cinquante ans de cinéma français
actors: Jean-Luc Godard, Anne-Marie Miéville, Michel Piccoli
description: In a hotel on the banks of a lake, Michel Piccoli discusses the centenary of cinema with Jean-Luc Godard and Anne-Marie Miéville, his partner and collaborator. Controversially, the Swiss-French director (himself) wonders why this anniversary should be celebrated, at a time when no one seems to keep the memory of the films that were.

title: Las trompetas del apocalipsis
actors: Romina Power, Brett Halsey, Marilù Tolo, Fabrizio Moroni
description: Katrin is a girl who left her family for a free and independent life. But too much freedom leads her to suicide. Richard, her brother, convinced that Katrin has been murdered, begins to investigate on his own. Thanks to the help of a friend of her sister, she comes into contact with the environments that Katrin used to frequent. Despite the reluctance of the old circles, Richard ultimately manages to unravel the mystery of his sister's death.
notes: Daughter of its time, 1969, the film today has its only reason of interest in Romina Power who was then beginning to take her first steps in the show.

title: Umorismo in nero
directors: Claude Autant-Lara, José María Forqué, Giancarlo Zagni
actors: Sylvie, Pierre Brasseur, Emma Penella, Leo Anchoriz, Folco Lulli, Alida Valli
description: "The little beast". A rich and miserly old woman, suffering from severe migraines, suspects that her son has stuck an insect in her ear to suppress it. After having unsuccessfully gone to a healer, the woman decides to pretend to be dying. "The mandrilla". An unemployed man finds a job in a circus where he is chosen by a pair of lovers as a scapegoat for a crime. "The crow". Count Altiero wants to marry a rich widow, invites her to his castle and with terror discovers that the woman ...
notes: Episode movies as it was fashionable in the sixties. The first segment from Guy de Maupassant is undoubtedly the best. The other two are a little weaker.

title: L'héritier
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Carla Gravina, Jean Rochefort, Charles Denner
description: Following the mysterious death of his father, Bart suddenly finds himself heir to a mighty industrial complex. Back home from the United States, where he lives with his family, he entrusts a detective with the task of shedding light on the parent's end. Determined to renew the management of the company, Bart realizes that someone is plotting against him: after having escaped various attacks, he discovers that the strings of the plot are pulled by his father-in-law Galeazzi, an exponent of the far right. The investigations, meanwhile, reveal burning truths ...
notes: Classy interpretations and tight editing do not fully redeem the shortcomings of the script.

title: A Beautiful Mind
actors: Russell Crowe, Jennifer Connelly, Ed Harris, Christopher Plummer, Paul Bettany
description: In 1948 John Forbes Nash jr. he was in Princeton with the most coveted of scholarships; but he was not of the classic breed of students who have had the university in their blood and manner for generations. Little bourgeois, a little slob, head in the clouds, very grumpy, not at all accustomed to youth rites, the mathematician who will be marked by schizophrenia elaborates his economic theory of games. According to him the fluctuations in the financial markets can be calculated very precisely. His ideas did not go unnoticed and a representative of the Defense Department comes to him to offer him to cooperate. But his life will also be marked by mental illness.
notes: It is hard to imagine the "gladiator" Russell Crowe in the role of this shady genius and overwhelmed by schizophrenia who arrives at the Nobel Prize in 1994 thanks to his youthful theory. But it is enough to recall the stubborn bourgeois of "Insider" to find on Crowe's face that determined and frowning expression that here makes him turn away, with pain, to the images of his illness. "A Beautiful Mind" is a film with classic and unexpected cadences. Skillfully hides the mysterious implications of the script and with an underground sense of suspense sips doubts and revelations, as if the awareness of the spectators had to go hand in hand with that of the protagonist. He does not hesitate in the face of exasperation and is not ashamed of the emotion. Ron Howard grows more and more as a director and, if he doesn't invent, he certainly loves to tell. The film won four Academy Awards: Best Director, Best Picture, Best Supporting Actress, and Best Non-Original Screenplay.

title: Biuti quin Olivia
actors: Carlina Felline, Elena Bonelli, Eleonora Materazzo, Ottavia Fusco, Gino Santercole
description: The waitress Franca, a woman humiliated and offended by life, is with Salvatore, a violent and vulgar man. The two are the parents of Olivia, a very young daughter and moreover disbanded. The girl, left to herself, hates school, others and the world. Lilli is such a little girl who adores Olivia Newton John and believes in fairy tales. The two end up in the same class and become friends. Lilli will try to wrest Olivia from her destiny of abandonment.
notes: The amateur direction, the wasted music of Andrea Morricone and the talent thrown away by Manrico Gammarola certainly do not help to focus on the film's only reason for interest, Carolina Felline. To the novice author, however, we recommend attending an accelerated remedial course, especially in the "emotions" subject.

title: Il nostro matrimonio è in crisi
actors: Antonio Albanese, Aisha Cerami, Shel Shapiro, Dino Abbrescia
description: On the same day in which he gets married, in the house that should host him and Alice for the rest of their lives, Antonio finds himself rejected by his wife still dressed in white. Packed up, Alice leaves, leaving the newlyweds alone. Antonio has nothing left to do but seek his ego by entrusting himself to the care of the "master" Makerbek.
notes: In this third film, very poorly written, Albanese confirms his extraordinary talents as a lunar soloist who, however, struggles to act. The film, notable in the first quarter of an hour, suffers from the lack of a structure, of an articulated script, closes too many scenes with an annoying approximation, with a lazy absence of comic rhythm and sutures.

title: Sidewalks of New York
actors: Edward Burns, Dennis Farina, Heather Graham, Brittany Murphy
description: Tommy, who grew up in Queens, seems to have everything in life, but would like to have the stability, perhaps a family. Carpo, a tenacious seducer, sees sex as a competition to be won at all costs. Maria, an elementary teacher, has left her man and is about to start an affair with Tommy. Benjamin tries to make peace with Maria, but he soon transfers his attention to Ashley. Arrogant dentist Griffin prides himself on his "European attitude" to love. Annie becomes increasingly wary of her husband.
notes: Sex, lies, betrayals, some vague sense of guilt and repentance in a Manhattan devoted to polygamy and emotional promiscuity. The protagonists come from the various districts of New York (there is also a girl who came to the city from Iowa), they have more or less jagged events behind them, they are single, divorced, in their second marriage, they would like children or can do without them, shy or rapacious. I am a representative, as in an obvious sociological census, of many professions, from the dentist to the doorman, from the waitress to the teacher. New York sidewalks are spacious and windy and are happy to host this circle of love and flirtation. Not all stories, which intersect as per regulation, are stimulating and not all actors (Stanley Tucci and Dennis Farina are the best) know how to express the reasons of the heart and sex.

title: Collateral Damage
actors: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Francesca Neri, Elias Koteas, John Leguizamo
description: Gordon, fire chief, is parking his car in the building where his wife and son are waiting for him. But a tremendous explosion destroys his family. Claudio "Il lupo" Perrini, a ruthless terrorist, is blamed for the attack. Since the authorities have no plans to track down and punish the culprit, Gordon decides to go after him.
notes: Asking respect for bon ton, politically correct or ideologically moderate in certain action-movies is naive. Expecting a more compelling, less predictable plot, interpreted with more incisiveness than a bad comic, on the other hand, is a legitimate claim.

title: Paz!
actors: Claudio Santamaria, Flavio Pistilli, Max Mazzotta, Fabrizia Sacchi
description: Bologna, late 1970s. In a suburban apartment, three individuals live together without meeting: Pentothal, a 20-year-old southerner abandoned by the combative feminist Lucilla, spends her time between reeds and dreams; Enrico Fiabeschi, out of court and out of office, is supported by his girlfriend; Zanardi, a repeating high school student, is accused by the principal of having crucified - together with his friends - the cat Galileo ...
notes: The anti-heroes of Andrea Pazienza resurrected in flesh, bone and celluloid, in a tribute to the great artist and to a generation that perhaps has lost, perhaps not, certainly does not feel too well. The director Renato De Maria, who lived in 1977 in Bologna on his own skin, evokes images of a utopian archeology that is testimony to burning, sometimes even burned, existences. A hymn to life, to youth, done with courage. The choice of digital makes the experiment sincere and removes any temptation for aesthetic pandering. Unfortunately, however, the characters eat the story, and it is no coincidence that the best defined is Fiabeschi, in fact the most marginal in the tables of the Paz. This Bologna suspended between '77 and _Apocalypse Now_ (which is from 1979), relived with happy intuition through a choral gaze (seventy characters with at least one joke), comes to terms with itself only up to a certain point, and De Maria's vision ends up sweetening (where are the heroin, and the wickedness ...?!). Sin.

title: Colpo doppio del camaleonte d'oro
actors: Mark Damon, Magda Konopka, Luisa Baratto, Luciano Pigozzi
description: Vittorio, employed in an insurance agency, is the only witness of an accident in which a thief called "the golden chameleon" loses his life. In the suitcase of the dead Vittorio finds the instructions to make a blow. He decides to take his identity and to create the robbery.
notes: Stegani signs an anonymous film.

title: A Memory in My Heart
actors: Jane Seymour, Bruce Davison, A Martinez, David Keith, Amanda Barfield
description: Rebecca is a woman who leads an apparently happy existence together with her husband despite suffering from a serious form of amnesia. The woman only remembers the last eight years of her existence, starting from the day of her awakening in the hospital. His life is tormented by terrible nightmares who continue to persecute it. One day Rebecca meets a woman who claims to have met her in her previous life and who shows her a photo of her. At this sight Rebecca is convinced to start an investigation into his past life and decides to leave for Santa Barbara.
notes: Television movies with Jane Seymour interpreter of "The lady of the West".

title: Legally Blonde
actors: Reese Witherspoon, Matthew Davis, Selma Blair, Luke Wilson
description: Elle Woods, a natural blonde and hugely popular president of her school's women's club, has never had a problem in life, but she's not spoiled or capricious for that. When one evening Warner, her boyfriend, invites her to dinner, Elle thinks that the time has come for the fateful question: surprisingly, however, Warner tells her that he wants to leave her, claiming that she is ... too blonde and therefore not serious enough. . She will therefore have to prove the opposite ...
notes: Luketic's film, blockbuster of the American summer 2001 (95 million dollars at the box office to which another 36 of the home video market must be added), reworks with moderate profit some generic references to the student comedies of the 40s and ' 50.

title: Hardball
actors: Keanu Reeves, Diane Lane, John Hawkes, D.B. Sweeney
description: Up to his neck in debt, Conor O'Neill is forced to accept a friend's proposal: to teach the basics of baseball to a group of decades. The idea of ??having to deal with those terrible plagues certainly does not put him in a good mood, and the obstacles are many: the new coach can however count on the help of Elizabeth, a teacher from the neighborhood.
notes: Released in the United States a few days after the Manhattan tragedy, the film was quite successful because it embodies the desire for redemption of the Americans. "Hardball" in fact is a dramatic reinterpretation of the 70s family series of "Bears", which plays its best cards on the redemption and redemption of the protagonist through the relationship with children and the desire of the latter to appropriate of a slice of the American dream through baseball. Too bad that the film leaves a good amount of interesting ideas unexpressed and sins of oversimplification in the relationship between adults and children, which represent the real surprise and richness of the film with their disarming naturalness.

title: Gosford Park
actors: Michael Gambon, Kristin Scott Thomas, Jeremy Northam, Maggie Smith, Ryan Phillippe, Clive Owen, Helen Mirren, Emily Watson
description: In Gosford Park, a beautiful country estate, Sir William McCordle and his wife Sylvia organize a party destined to last all weekend. A countess, a hero of the First World War, an idol of the crowds and the American producer of the Charlie Chan films are the guests who flock to the mansion. Everything seems to be going well, until a murder is committed.
notes: Playing on an original screenplay that mimics a play, Altman throws himself among his characters, hooks them, stalks them, forces them to reveal, almost always, the worst of themselves. Closed in the unity of place (the villa) and time (two days), _Gosford Park_ is very reminiscent of _A marriage_, especially in the first part, in its ups and downs around the house, to discover a face, a betrayal, a vice, a sympathy , to weave the web of a universe that seems trapped in itself like that of the Corelli family. For once, only the people of cinema (the star Ivor Novello and the Hollywood producer) seem to have a glimmer of vitality, and perhaps the head waitress Elsie who, however, decides to try to change her life. For others, only the surface play and the deep hatred that govern coexistence between classes and within the same class is valid. Of course, he is not the greatest Altman, a bit ragged especially in the second part; but there are very few authors who know how to guide such a set (36 characters: 14 gentlemen, on the upper floors, 20 servants on the lower floors) with such lightness. Oscar for Best Original Screenplay.

title: Dervis - Il derviscio
actors: Antonio Buil Pueyo, Cezmi Baskin, Ruhi Sari, Basak Köklükaya
description: Ottoman Empire, 19th century: Ahmed Nurettin, head of the civil and religious community of the Mevlevi order, lives in a world of absolute certainty. However, these falter when his younger brother is arrested and sentenced to death without any fault. His clumsy attempts to intervene with the powerful are useless: all his securities collapsed miserably, hatred and the desire for revenge push him to act ...
notes: Shot in Cappadocia and based on the novel _The Dervish and the Death_ by Mesa Selimovic, the film combines Sufi mysticism and meditations on human misery. From time to time the step is tiring, but the attempt is worthy of respect.

title: Amnèsia
actors: Diego Abatantuono, Sergio Rubini, Martina Stella, Ugo Conti
description: Fifty-year-old Sandro, producer and director of pornographic films, conditioned by an atavistic modesty, has never managed to reveal his true profession to his daughter Luce. Now is the time to come to terms with his pressing questions. Police chief Xavier has a strained relationship with his son Jorge. The death of the woman who managed to maintain an armistice between the two of them brings them closer together. Angelino, a small marijuana dealer, would like to settle down economically. A suitcase with four kilos of cocaine seems to make his dreams come true.
notes: Salvatores's new film is a curious mixture of his "two cinemas": the cinema of islands and Mediterranean escapes, now fifty-year-olds who have become a bit emboldened and "settled", who have set aside utopias but have not forgotten them; and the cinema of the uncomfortable and beating nightmare, which disrupts the narration on the rhythm and hardness of the incomprehensible twenty-year-olds. An at times tiring encounter, where the linearity of the first part breaks up in a Tarantino-like narrative air that risks softening rather than accentuating the contrasts. The elders are messed up and unresolved; young people are irritating and unpleasant; but perhaps the most restless sense of the film is contained precisely in this unpleasantness. Salvatores, at least, is an author who continues to question himself on human paths and "legacies".

title: Quore
actors: Michela Noonan, Carla Signoris, Gigio Alberti, Mariella Valentini
description: Paola, a twenty-one-year-old double bass player on the last date of her Italian tour, discovers she is pregnant. But that's not the only problem she is forced to face. The relationship with her parents is problematic: her father is lost in alcohol and the future grandmother is becoming a mother for the second time. Her friends who play with her also complicate things. They just signed a contract for a concert tour in Europe. The only one who has not signed is her ...
notes: Small film very feminine, not despicable, with two flaws: it is very thin and has an excessive dramatic twist in the ending that risks destroying its fragile framework.

title: The Affair of Necklace
actors: Hilary Swank, Simon Baker, Adrien Brody, Jonathan Pryce
description: France, late 18th century: Countess Jeanne de la Motte-Valois tries to regain possession of the rank that was usurped from her. To regain her place in the French aristocracy she is forced to buy noble titles. Jeanne proposes to Cardinal Rohan, excluded from the court, to regain the graces of Marie Antoinette through the purchase of a diamond necklace of inestimable value: she convinces him by showing him some false letters signed by the queen, in which she asks him to buy the jewel at the unbeknownst to the king ...
notes: The engine of the plot is Hilary Swank, who is also convincing in this film "dressed" with class by Milena Canonero.

title: I banchieri di Dio
actors: Omero Antonutti, Giancarlo Giannini, Pamela Villoresi, Rutger Hauer
description: On June 18, 1982, the body of the Italian banker Roberto Calvi, president of Banco Ambrosiano, was found under London's Blackfriars Bridge. It was the epilogue of a financial adventure with still undefined outlines: through obscure plots, Calvi managed to create an empire taking advantage of "friendships" and ties with the P2 Masonic lodge and contacts with the IOR of Monsignor Marcinkus. His figure soon became the hub of organized crime's money laundering.
notes: The narration straddles between a television reportage and a puppet theater, and the whole is of impressive ugliness.

title: Un épais manteau de sang
actors: Valerie Lagrange, Eric Arnal, Katia Bartel, Paul Guers, Hans Meyer
description: Having lost sight of her husband Dionis, who had left for Africa for years, Valeria joins the surgeon Hans but then leaves him for the young fisherman Bernard. Later Dionis suddenly returns and Hans, disappointed, instigates him to kill Bernard: Dionis, however, has completely different plans ...
notes: Unlikely sentimental-erotic mess.

title: Corte marziale
actors: Vassili Karamesinis, Margaret Rose Keil, Salvatore Billa, Tom Felleghy
description: Lieutenant Warren, unjustly accused of high treason and murder, tries to exonerate himself and find out who framed him.
notes: Spaghetti western obtained from the clumsy assembly of some clips of Roberto Mauri's previous films (from the _Spirito Santo_ series), re-doubled for the occasion.

title: How Harry Became a Tree
actors: Colm Meaney, Adrian Dunbar, Cillian Murphy, Kerry Condon
description: Ireland, 1924: Harry's recurring nightmare is that of being a tree to be felled and turned into wood for coffins. Widower and father of Patrick and Gus, he lost the former during the civil war, while he does not have much respect for the latter. One day an idea leaps into his head: why not find an enemy, in order to regain some zest for life? His choice falls on George, the most powerful man in the village ...
notes: An excellent Serbian director, a beautiful story unearthed in a Chinese storybook and an Irish setting for a decidedly transversal film, from a geographical-symbolic point of view. He can do without the iconography of Irish cinema and many of its conventions or use them as fertile ground in which to plant Harry's sturdy legs into roots, and his hands and stubby fingers into mighty, bare branches. The film is resolved in a "duel" (the main plot) to be faced with every weapon (sawed-off shotgun, the cabbages left to rot, the infidelity of the young newborn) and with every stratagem. An enmity mixed with humor and malice. Conducted with great skill.

title: Kate & Leopold
actors: Meg Ryan, Hugh Jackman, Natasha Lyonne, Liev Schreiber
description: Late nineteenth century: on the eve of the announcement of his wedding, Leopold Duke of Albany is intrigued by a strange guy who tampons him since the morning. The nobleman chases him and falls with him into a temporal break that leads him to today's New York: here he will live his unusual adventure with an extraordinary lightness that will allow him to win the heart of Kate, a pretty and neurotic career advertising neurotic.
notes: In physics they are called "wormholes" (more or less "wormholes") and owe this name to J. Archibald Wheeler, inventor among other things of the term "black hole" in 1968. The "wormholes" are bridges that connect contact space-time coordinates otherwise distant from each other and constitute the starting point for this curious film, which properly exploits the possibilities and paradoxes offered by time travel. New physics and romantic comedy go hand in hand again, as has not infrequently happened in recent times, offering a story that connects two eras of irreconcilable rhythms while lightly sliding the clock time. Hugh Jackman definitively established himself as an emerging sex symbol; for her part, outside the usual role of "America's sweetheart", Ryan shows instead an evident fogging.

title: Lundi matin
actors: Jacques Bidou, Anne Kravz-Tarnavsky, Narda Blanchet, Radslav Kinski
description: As with most of his peers, for Vincent - a worker in a chemical factory - Monday morning corresponds to the beginning of the same routine. When he returns from work, things do not change much, because he has to take care of his wife and his elderly mother (once a singer and dancer). In the village the faces are always the same. So, following his father's advice, Vincent gives up everything and runs away to Venice ...
notes: Faithful to a happy custom, the Georgian maestro (Silver Bear for Best Direction at the 2002 Berlin Film Festival) gives us a funny and pungent reflection on the state of our neuroses. Ioseliani confirms his qualities as a great observer of reality, an excellent storyteller in images and a fine humorist, carving out a small but tasty role for himself as always. The gallery of his characters again exhibits human typologies on the border between neurosis and genius, which reveal an evident maladjustment towards a society that tends to homologate everything and everyone. Probably, compared to the previous _Addio terraferma_, the film reveals a less compactness and a certain flaking in the story, which however do not compromise the final outcome.

title: Crush
actors: Andie MacDowell, Kenny Doughty, Imelda Staunton, Anna Chancellor
description: The unmarried and forty-year-old Kate teaches in an English school. Every Monday she meets two friends Molly and Janine to exchange their points of view on their love affairs. But one day Kate happens to meet 25-year-old Jed at a funeral. It is love, indeed sex at first sight. Her friends are upset and slowly they distance themselves.
notes: Nothing new, but the pace and the cliché hold up. Except that suddenly, the comedy takes an even tragic turn. McKay does not keep the new register, the script goes off on its own, everyone seems disoriented and hastily returns to the initial state.

title: Thir13en Ghosts
actors: Tony Shalhoub, Embeth Davidtz, F. Murray Abraham, Matthew Lillard
description: Jean, who died in a tragic accident, left her husband Arthur and children Kathy and Bobby in absolute misery. One day, Arthur inherits a strange house made of glass and steel from his uncle Cyrus. Exploring the various rooms, the new owner and the boys do not believe their eyes: the three do not know that the house hides a dark secret ...
notes: The most sophisticated, popular and thrilling Hollywood cinema (Robert Zemeckis and Joel Silver are among the producers) looks - with affection, admiration and a certain respect - at the workshop of the artisans of the glorious and longed-for B series. to which homage is paid is that of William Castle, director and impresario del terror, producer of _Rosemary's Baby_, already author of a _13 Ghosts_ in 1960. In this first work by Steve Beck, the level of the cast and acting, in which jokes that would like to be witty and those that betray the party game aspect (of terror) work more than fear. The house, with its mechanisms designed on demonic instigation and fed by thirteen Barkerian ghosts, is the true protagonist of the film. A "documentary", at times repetitive, about an expensive scenography and about some non-digital ghosts, more tantalizing than humans in flesh and blood.

title: Le meraviglie di Aladino
actors: Donald O'Connor, Michèle Mercier, Vittorio De Sica, Aldo Fabrizi
description: In fabulous Baghdad, the reckless Aladdin dreams of experiencing the most adventurous vicissitudes, and in the meantime he combines one more than the devil. But when the unsuspecting mother gives him an oil lamp inside which a powerful genius is imprisoned, the boy's life changes: and it will be the new and very powerful friend to get out of his way in a complicated story populated by good, beautiful principles. princesses and wicked viziers.
notes: The fact of seeing Fabrizi and De Sica dressed up as sultan and genius respectively would be worth the vision; the rest is done by the special effects of co-director Bava, which make a show enjoyable without any particular pretensions.

title: Via Paradiso
actors: Michele Placido, Francesco Di Federico, Angela Molina, Guido Celano
description: The Eden cinema in via Paradiso in Chieti is about to fall apart, and Francesco - who owns it together with his grandfather Andrea - has decided to sell it to an American company. Francesco's family ménage is not that great, and the meeting with the former flame Giulia - who disappeared years before without explanation - rekindles dormant passions; Later, however, Francesco discovers not only that Giulia is the lover of the head of the group of buyers, but also that his wife Anna had been no stranger to the sudden departure of the woman from Chieti ...
notes: Odorisio, a native of Abruzzo, stuffs two interminable hours of considerations on cinema, love, nostalgia ...

title: Knightriders
actors: Ed Harris, Gary Lahti, Tom Savini, Amy Ingersoll, Patricia Tallman
description: Following Arthur's example, King Billy travels the United States with a community of contemporary "knights". In place of the trusty steeds there are the Harley Davidson, with which the brave compete to a duel in the squares and at the fairs of the countries. But this "circus" is tempting to someone, and dollars risk corrupting the indomitable soul of some subject ...
notes: Combining two ideological opposites such as traditionalism (nostalgic return to the Myth) and progressivism (the enemy to beat is Reaganian hedonism), Romero makes one of his most "free" and beautiful films. The spectator of the duels eating the sandwich is a certain Stephen King ...

title: Nowhere
actors: Harvey Keitel, Jorge Perugorría, Luigi Maria Burruano
description: The dictator of a Latin American state devises a plan to justify the permanence of the military junta in power: to kidnap a group of opponents. The secret services capture and imprison a student passionate about boxing, a hopeless teacher, a worker and a barber in a desert town called Nowhere. The four plan an escape with the help of a resistance activist and an adventurer.
notes: Luis Sepúlveda, a rookie in directing, collides with a new language and does not dominate its rules. "Nowhere" is a flat tale and a constant risk of ridicule, with a screenplay that is too much chatted and too many suggestions piled up and wasted.

title: Fah talai jone
actors: Chartchai Ngamsan, Stella Malucchi, Supakorn Kitsuwon, Arawat Ruangvuth
description: Rumpoey is the impulsive daughter of rich bourgeois; Dum (known as the "Black Tiger") is a poor and shy country boy who, expelled from university because he fought for Rumpoey, becomes a bandit to avenge his father. Meanwhile, the girl is betrothed to the army officer who has to fight the outlaws ...
notes: The film contains - openly plundered or suggested in filigree - cues to the Lion and street theater, action cinema and hand-painted postcards, comics and cultured quotes, popular fairy tale and mass media shamelessness. More (perhaps too much) irony, between passionate adhesion and humorous distancing.

title: Nati stanchi
actors: Salvo Ficarra, Valentino Picone, Marica Coco, Massimo Olcese
description: The life of Salvo and Valentino, perpetually unemployed, passes between the town square and the bar. Their aim is to enter as many contests as possible and fail. Their philosophy? If everyone goes to work at the bar who goes there? Nobody! Their inactivity is a thoughtful and logical choice, at least that's what they think. But despite their best efforts, an incredible surprise awaits them.
notes: The theme belongs to the roots of comedy: integration into adult society. Public competitions used as an escape from the life of a Sicilian town, from eternal girlfriends, from the bar. A non-script and a non-existent direction to unravel negligent sketches.

title: Vidocq
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Guillaume Canet, André Dussollier, Ines Sastre
description: In the "Ville Lumière" it is the dawn of the Revolution of July 1830: Étienne, journalist and biographer of Vidocq - a thief turned investigator and champion of disguise - tries to unmask the one who killed his teacher. Vidocq disappeared while he was hunting a dangerous and diabolical criminal who calls himself "the Alchemist" ...
notes: The script signed by the director and Jean-Christophe Grangé (former scriptwriter of "I fiumi di porpora") is modest but the visual gimmicks are amusing, even if the suspicion often arises that the authors have played too much at the Playstation. Depardieu is ugly, fat and sublime, Sastre only sublime.

title: Ali
actors: Will Smith, Jamie Foxx, Jon Voight, Mario Van Peebles, Ron Silver, Jeffrey Wright
description: Cassius Marcellus is not a model student and leaves school at a very young age. Street life is hard and the young Cassius notices it immediately. Shocked at having suffered the theft of his bicycle, he turns to a policeman who, in his spare time, is a boxing coach. It is on the square that Cassius discovers he has a natural talent for fighting. 1964 arrives. Cassius confronts Sonny Liston as an Olympic champion and wins. Meanwhile, racial tensions erupt in America and Cassius, fascinated by the theories of Malcolm X, embraces Islam and changes his name becoming Muhammad Ali.
notes: "Ali", which is not a cinebiography as it might appear, while staging the events in the history of Muhammad Alì in the decade '64 -'74 with obsessive adherence to facts, people and places, shocks for the monumentality of the gaze and breath , typically Mannians. Inside "Ali" there is the fear of changes in progress, revolutionary and never finished, of the context and of the personality, such as "Violent Roads" up to "The Insider". And Mann makes us see and feel that fear, attaching himself, as always, to the characters, to their faces, looking into their eyes, with an unmistakable, unique style, made up of blurs, angles, slowdowns. There are moments of unprecedented cinematic form, pure linguistic perfection: the incredible opening ten minutes with a medley of Sam Cooke / David Elliott songs; the first meeting in the ring with Liston; a couple of very light slow motion movements in the final "Rumble in the Jungle" with Foreman, which leave you speechless.

title: Mein liebster Feind - Kinski
actors: Klaus Kinski, Werner Herzog, Eva Mattes
description: Five films (_Aguirre, furore di Dio_, _Nosferatu_, _Woyzeck_, _Fitzcarraldo_, _Cobra Verde_) in fifteen years of joint work intertwined with sudden outbursts of anger and conflicts bordering on physical conflict, but also of mutual esteem and virile complicity. When one thinks of the best Herzogian cinema, the mind immediately rushes to Kinski's wide eyes and satanic grin; perhaps it is no coincidence that after the actor's death (which took place in 1991), the visionary Bavarian author was no longer able to match the peaks reached in his major works. A collection of rare and at times moving documents.

title: Lonesome Cowboys
actors: Viva, Tom Hompert, Louis Waldon, Taylor Mead, Eric Emerson, Joe Dallesandro, Francis Francine, Julian Burroughs, Allen Midgette
description: Ramona and her more than ambiguous "housekeeper" live in a remote hole in the desert, always ready to tease the gang made up of Mickey and his brothers in every way. And the situation becomes more and more strange ...
notes: The colorful "court of miracles" of the Warholian Factory on a trip to the West.

title: Sweepers
actors: Dolph Lundgren, Bruce Payne, Claire Stansfield, Ian Roberts
description: Christian Erickson is the leader of a team of men who specialize in clearing mined areas. After the tragic death of his son, Erickson loses track and returns to war-torn Angola: it is here that he meets Michelle Wyatt, another expert in explosives who hires him for a dangerous mission aimed at vanquishing a group of international terrorists.
notes: It is written Dolph Lundgren but is pronounced Ivan "you in two" Drago, unforgotten (?) Deuteragonist of Sly Stallone in "Rocky IV". His expressiveness is equal to that of a mine, but asking him for more would be useless.

title: Playing God
actors: David Duchovny, Timothy Hutton, Angelina Jolie, Michael Massee
description: Due to his penchant for drugs, Eugene Sands had his license to practice as a surgeon revoked. One night, in a bar, Sands makes a makeshift surgery on a guy shot in a shooting. A few days later, a limousine picks him up and transports him to Malibu, to the villa of the ambiguous Raymond Blossom and his provocative lover Claire: there too must act quickly, to save the life of a seriously injured minion. Sands agrees, but the presence of Claire and the investigation of agent Gage, of the FBI, complicate the situation ...
notes: The atmospheres are torrid, but the outcome is routine.

title: D-Tox
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Charles S. Dutton, Polly Walker, Tom Berenger, Kris Kristofferson, Angela Alvarado, Courtney B. Vance, Robert Patrick
description: Jake Malloy, an FBI agent, has become a shadow of himself. Ever since a serial killer killed his girlfriend, he hasn't been able to give himself up to alcohol. A colleague of his in an attempt to get him out of that dangerous tunnel sends him to a detoxification center called D-Tox located in the mountains of Wyoming. Strange murders take place here and Jake is forced into action.
notes: With a prominent cast, from the book by Howard Swindie, director Jim Gillespie has crafted a thriller full of quotes and stylistically praiseworthy, but not enough to heal the inherent weakness of the characters.

title: Killing Me Softly
actors: Heather Graham, Joseph Fiennes, Natascha McElhone, Ian Hart
description: Alice, an American who works in London, sees the routine of her life break up when, one day, she meets the mysterious Adam by chance: the meeting upsets her to the point that she suddenly realizes that her relationship with her boyfriend Jake no longer works. . She therefore decides to move to Adam's house, about which the owner of the apartment tells her an episode that happened a few years earlier ...
notes: The first film directed in English by Chen Kaige is very disappointing: the eroticism is from the frozen department, the laughable dialogues verbalize what should be morbid, the protagonists are the puppets of a theater of forbidden passion.

title: Tanguy
actors: Eric Berger, André Dussollier, Sabine Azéma, Hélène Duc, Aurore Clément
description: The charming and seductive Tanguy Guetz is a model student. He has a master's in philosophy, studied Japanese and is about to finish a Chinese thesis. Her parents, Paul and Edith, have lost count of their son's female achievements. At Guetz, everything seems to be going well. But there is a problem Tanguy refuses to leave his father's home and does not want to abandon the family's warm nest.
notes: Polite, delicious, sparkling bourgeois comedy about the conflict of affections. More sociological than psychological. More shrewd costume background than snobbish elzeviro. Excellent actors and shrewd direction.

title: Monsters, Inc.
description: The terrible monsters that have always sneaked into the closets of the bedrooms to scare children to death, live in Mostropoli, a universe parallel to ours, fed thanks to the screams of the little ones. Furry giant Sulley is the best at obtaining powerful fuel, aided by Mike Wazowski, a round one-eyed creature. But when the adorable little Boo is imprisoned in their world, life in Mostropolis will change dramatically ...
notes: The sympathy of the monsters, the rhythm of the story and the sweetness of the relationship between Sulley and Boo represent the little treasure of the film. One of the best Pixar ever, Oscar for the song If I Didn’t Have You by Randy Newman.

title: I Am Sam
actors: Sean Penn, Michelle Pfeiffer, Dakota Fanning, Dianne Wiest
description: Sam Dawson, a man with severe mental health problems, was able with the help of his friends to raise his daughter Lucy. The troubles begin when the girl turns seven and proves to have intellectual abilities superior to those of her father. A social worker would like to entrust her to an adoptive family: faced with a lost cause, Sam decides to oppose what he considers an injustice ...
notes: The film follows the legal and emotional hardships of a disabled person who has a pinch of genius and an overflowing amount of love in his body, along the line of the family drama that fascinates today's independent American cinema. He starts well, with the camera following Sam's hands intent on rearranging the various sugar sachets of the diner where he serves at the tables; captivating, like the "all Beatles" soundtrack that accompanies it. And Sean Penn is good, probably a bit penalized by the dubbing. But then Nelson's film gets stuck in the legal skirmish (where the lawyer Michelle Pfeiffer does ... Michelle Pfeiffer), always undecided whether to insist on feelings or follow the indefatigable style of the independents. The snag is all in the direction: too fashionable to give emotions, too insignificant to open real problematic glimpses.

title: Riding in Cars with Boys
actors: Drew Barrymore, Steve Zahn, James Woods, Lorraine Bracco
description: 1965: Beverly, a cheeky and witty teenager, dreams of moving from Connecticut to New York to become a writer. She has no shortage of talent and skills, and her teachers would like her to go to college. Instead, she finds on her way Ray, an eighteen-year-old with a difficult character who has been forced to interrupt his studies: passion breaks out between the two and Beverly becomes pregnant. The problem is how to confess the unexpected pregnancy to parents ...
notes: The script is messy and Marshall confirms herself as a modest director. Here and there some good moments emerge, but it is the organization of the whole that does not work.

title: In the Bedroom
actors: Sissy Spacek, Tom Wilkinson, Nick Stahl, Marisa Tomei
description: Summer, coast of Maine: architecture student Frank, the son of a doctor and a music teacher, works as a lobster fisherman to make some money. The boy is in a relationship with an older woman, a mother of two children and married to a jealous and violent man. He, after learning about the affair, kills Frank. Failing to get justice, the family ponders revenge ...
notes: A film with two souls: the first that describes an apparently quiet family ménage in the American province, the second that sweeps away the junk of appearances by releasing horrible monsters. Great performance of the actors.

title: Pastasciutta nel deserto
actors: Franco Volpi, Venantino Venantini, Giovanna Ralli, Riccardo Billi
description: Second World War. An Italian army corporal stationed in Africa gets permission to return home for a few days. The unleashing of the battle surprises him on African soil. All the military has to do is find someone to validate his license.
notes: Third last Bragaglia film.

title: The Silver Chalice
actors: Virginia Mayo, Paul Newman, Anna Maria Pierangeli, Jack Palance
description: The apostle Luke entrusts the Greek goldsmith Basilio with the task of reproducing the chalice that was used in the Last Supper. The evangelist's aim is to conserve, twenty years later, the blood of Jesus. Debora, daughter of Joseph of Arimathea, seeing Basil working, falls in love with him not knowing that his heart belongs to Helen, assistant of Simon Magician. He would like to take over the artifact to exert influence on the crowd. While the craftsman is on his way to Rome, he is attacked and robbed of the precious chalice by Mijamin, Simon Mago's henchman.
notes: A young Paul Newman, here in his debut, replaced a listless Marlon Brando.

title: Blind Terror
actors: Nastassja Kinski, Stewart Bick, Maxim Roy, Jack Langedijk
description: Two years after her husband's death, Susan is starting to live again. To awaken her from the torpor in which she was caudta after the tragedy, is Kevin, an artist with whom she falls in love and marries after a few weeks in Las Vegas. When she begins to realize that she has acted too impulsively, she discovers she is being followed by a woman, who sends her death threats. What is the relationship between your love life and the psychotic "admirer"?
notes: Yet another TV-movie with stars and stripes in which Nastassja Kinski seems to have remained imprisoned. Predictable in the script and directed with a sure hand from the small screen.

title: Mad Dog Time/Trigger Happy
actors: Richard Dreyfuss, Jeff Goldblum, Diane Lane, Gabriel Byrne
description: Vic, the boss of the underworld, is about to be released after a long stay in a psychiatric institution. Within the gang, Ben, his armed wing, has been concerned with keeping things going. To celebrate the return of the boss, Ben would like to organize a massacre of welcome back. The first name on Ben's list is that of Mickey, guilty of having too much attention towards Grace, Vic's girlfriend.
notes: The director, who carves out the role of killer Nick, creates a noir in which you never stop talking. His father Joey (in the film he plays the character of Mr. Gottlieb) was part of the "Rat Pack".

title: Race Against Time
actors: Eric Roberts, Cas Anwar, Cary Elwes, Diane Venora, Chris Sarandon, Sarah Winter
description: In a hypothetical society of the future, suicide has become a legal practice. Lifecorps is a company that speculates in human organ trafficking, which it obtains by paying sums of money in exchange for a quick death. Jim Gabriel has a seriously ill son, and to save him a very expensive intervention is needed: he therefore offers himself to Lifecorps, but the child dies prematurely. At this point Jim would like to back off, but of course Lifecorps disagrees ...
notes: TV movie produced for the American cable broadcaster TNT: something more (starting from the cast) compared to the cheap star-and-strip cops that invade our schedules.

title: Once Upon a Forest
description: The serenity of a group of animals is disturbed by a cloud of toxic gases, which invests the forest in which they live and reduces the rate to death. A mouse, a mole and a hedgehog set out to find a cure.
notes: Film with an environmental background: co-directed by Grosvenor, director of _In search of the enchanted valley 5_.

title: Land des Schweigens und der Dunkelheit
actors: Fini Straubinger, Heinrich Fleischmann, Vladimir Kokol, Resi Mittermeier
description: Fini, a deaf and blind woman, accompanies the director around Munich to discover the land of silence and darkness. The two visit people who are blind and deaf from birth and some institutions that host them.
notes: The film is also a metaphor for the viewer who must be re-educated for viewing.

title: I'm Not Rappaport
actors: Walter Matthau, Ossie Davis, Amy Irving, Craig T. Nelson
description: Nat and Midge, two in their eighties, spend their grionades on a bench in Central Park, discussing, philosophizing and commenting on what is happening around them.
notes: From a screenplay already successfully performed in Hollywwod (with Judd Hirsch in place of Matthau), a comedy with good ideas that fails to take off.

title: Two in a Crowd
actors: Joan Bennett, Joel McCrea, Henry Armetta, Nat Pendleton
description: He is a boy with little money, but a great wealth: his horse. For him it is more than a passion, so he manages to convince her to bet on the horse the huge sum of a thousand dollars, found by chance on New Year's Eve. The goal of the "two in the crowd", of course, is to collect the conspicuous winnings of a very prestigious race and abandon the essence of penniless to live the good life.
notes: A light romantic comedy with a pleasant touch, which wisely exploits the motif of the ordinary man who suddenly manages to turn his situation around.

title: Good Advice
actors: Charlie Sheen, Barry Newman, Rosanna Arquette, Jon Lovitz
description: Ryan Turner, a stock broker on Wall Street by profession, is all going well: he has a luxurious apartment, a beautiful girlfriend, a full wallet and powerful friends. But one day, due to a deliberately wrong tip, he loses everything and his house of cards collapses miserably: he is fired, the woman leaves him and leaves for Rio, he has to leave the house, the car etc. etc. How will he fare? Charlie Sheen returns to play the role of a broker in a TV movie that winks at Wall Street by Oliver Stone. A (former) actor who is becoming a parody of himself. How sad!

title: Crossroads
actors: Britney Spears, Zoë Saldana, Taryn Manning, Anson Mount
description: After being separated for eight years, childhood friends Lucy, Kit and Mimi rejuvenate their bond during a trip across the United States: with no itinerary and no money, but with suitcases full of dreams, the three girls ask Ben, a friend of Mimi's, a ride in his '73 Buick convertible. Along the way, they will have experiences that will change their lives ...
notes: A festival of banalities, punctuated by clever parentheses that would like to aspire to more serious tones. An extremely negligible vehicle for the pop star Britney Spears, who also drags the director of the interesting _Guncrazy_ into mediocrity.

title: Amore con la S maiuscola
actors: Biagio Izzo, Lunetta Savino, Pasquale Falcone, Ana Cristina De Oliveira
description: The histrionic Gaetano and the quiet Angelo made friends at school in a small town in the South. The second married Isabel, a girl who for his sake gave up her career as a model, and moved to Milan. Gaetano, on the other hand, impregnated Carmela, a woman who was all home and family, and decided to stay where he was born. When Angelo is forced to return home after the bankruptcy of the place he had opened, the couple goes into crisis. But Isabel finds who consoles her: Gaetano. At this point, the betrayed spouses devise a plan to win back the cheated ...
notes: Not that the film is unwatchable, but cinema is something else.

title: Taking Side
actors: Stellan Skarsgård, Harvey Keitel, Birgit Minichmayr, Moritz Bleibtreu
description: The Allies who have occupied Berlin are trying to restore order in the devastated city. They also have another task to track down the former Nazis and their supporters. Major Arnold has been ordered to question German conductor Wilhelm Furtwängler and gather evidence of his privileged relationships with brownshirt leaders. In his investigation he is helped by Emmi, daughter of one of the organizers of the attack against Hitler and by Lieutenant Wills, a Jew who escaped from concentration camps.
notes: Written by Ronald Harwood and based on his play "Taking Sides", in Szabó's film dialogue and acting are the most relevant aspects. Wrong or right collide in arguments more than in sequences.

title: Il Consiglio d'Egitto
actors: Silvio Orlando, Tommaso Ragno, Renato Carpentieri, Marine Delterme
description: In 1782 the ship of Abdallah Mohamed ben Olman, ambassador of Morocco, sank on the Sicilian coast. In Palermo, where he landed, no one can speak Arabic. It is therefore necessary to find an interpreter. Fracappellano Vella comes forward. The friar, a Maltese of humble origins, seizes the opportunity of his life and pretends to be a fine connoisseur of that language. Ambassador Vella left, who became abbot, and a document "The Council of Egypt" was invented from scratch, which would allow the abolition of feudal privileges.
notes: Leonardo Sciascia and Emidio Greco: an osmosis that works in the cinema. After "A simple story" (1991), the director park of "The invention of Morel" and "A case of unconsciousness" (only six works in almost thirty years), is confronted with another novel by the Sicilian writer. Greco has the merit of not being influenced by contemporary styles: its transposition has an antique flavor, and we say it in its best meaning; the sequences choose paths that are not very bumpy from the rhythms to which we are unfortunately accustomed and so his journey in the eighteenth century (but also in the present) allows himself the luxury of stops not booked by fashion, but rather by the urge to quench that desperate thirst the curious, and those who are not satisfied with the official versions. The extraordinary interpretation of Silvio Orlando is all in the happy contradiction of two lines: "Revolution: that raised you that I take it" and "Without the itch to turn the world upside down". An Oscar for sublime minimalism.

title: Iris
actors: Judi Dench, Jim Broadbent, Kate Winslet, Hugh Bonneville
description: Iris Murdoch, an English writer and philosopher, met and married John Bayley in 1956, two years after the publication of her first novel. The relationship between Iris and John, professor and esteemed literary critic, was stormy at first due to the woman's not very malleable character. For years it was she who dictated the rules of their coexistence. When she was diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease in 1997, Iris was forced to become a docile employee of her husband.
notes: Eyre, a very solid theater director who directed _L'ambizione di James Penfield_ for the cinema, reworks the writings of Bayley, adds and invents. Look for the formula of a film that is neither a traditional biopic nor a fiction. And this is not good. He focuses with undeniable fervor on the montage of time, moving between the past and the present with joints, slips, déjà vu. He follows, moved, his four actors (who let themselves be admired, but with whom one does not identify) for two roles: Judi Dench and Kate Winslet for Iris and Jim Broadbent (who won the Oscar as best supporting actor) and Hugh Bonneville for John. A slimy film like the waters in which Iris swims happily.

title: Akai hashi no shita no nurui mizu
actors: Koji Yakusho, Misa Shimizu, Mitsuko Baisho, Mansaku Fuwa
description: The forty-year-old Yosuke, abandoned by his wife and intolerant of his work, follows the advice of an old tramp and goes to a village on the peninsula of Noto, where he finds a welcome in a house from which you can see a red bridge. Here Yosuke hopes to get hold of a wineskin that holds a precious statue of Buddha in solid gold: he will not track down the container but on the other hand, with enormous surprise, he will meet Saeko, a woman with strange abilities ...
notes: Imamura - born in 1926, two Palme d'oro in Cannes with _La ballad di Narayama_ and _L'anguilla_ - has always stood out for his oriental wisdom, yes, but very extravagant. His poetry: "I am interested in the relationship that exists between the lower part of the human body and the lower part of society". Far from conformism and close to those who experience sex with primordial vitality, Imamura attributes a central place and role to the female element. Her ideal heroine has "average height and weight, fair complexion, velvety skin, the face of a woman who loves men, maternal, a warm feeling, good genitals, a rich and lively soul". Such a female is the fate of the protagonist of the film. May the Goddess of Gushing Waters keep us Imamura San for a long time!

title: Two Flags West
actors: Joseph Cotten, Linda Darnell, Jeff Chandler, Noah Beery jr.
description: As the Civil War rages, Lincoln offers the Confederate prisoners freedom. The pact he makes with them is clear, the former inmates have to fight the Indians. Colonel Clay Tucker accepts the proposal and with his men goes to a fort whose command is entrusted to Major Kenniston. Elena, widow of the officer's brother, is a guest of the outpost. Clay falls in love with her but she just wants to get away from the Frontier. When a convoy of wagons, escorted by Tucker, leaves the fort, Elena sneaks in. They will be forced to turn back to face the Indians.
notes: Rather conventional film directed by Robert Wise.

title: Fantasia
directors: James Algar, Samuel Armstrong, Ford Beebe, Norman Ferguson, Jim Handley, Wilfred Jackson, Hamilton Luske, Bill Roberts, Paul Satterfield, Ben Sharpsteen
description: Eight episodes (plus an interlude) that give shape, in a whirlwind succession of shapes and colors, to as many famous classical pieces: Bach's "Toccata and Fugue in D minor", "The Nutcracker" by Tchaikovsky, the "Apprentice sorcerer "by Dukas, Stravinsky's" Spring Festival ", Beethoven's" Pastoral ", Ponchielli's" Dance of the Hours ", Mussorgskij's" Night on the Bald Mountain ", Schubert's" Ave Maria ". Key chapter in the history of animation, a daring and ambitious attempt to develop design and movement starting from musical harmonies, entrusted to the Philadelphia Orchestra conducted by maestro Leopold Stokowski.> I>

title: Fugitive Rage
actors: Wendy Schumacher, Jay Richardson, Shauna O'Brien, Tim Abell
description: Former policewoman Tara McCormick is arrested for the attempted murder of drug kingpin Tommy Stompanato. In prison, the woman befriends an inmate named Josie Williams; shortly thereafter, a government agent offers her a second chance to take out Tommy in exchange for her freedom. Tara accepts, and the hunt begins ...

title: Wicked
actors: Julia Stiles, William R. Moses, Chelsea Field, Vanessa Zima, Michael Parks
description: After the mysterious death of her mother Karen, precocious 14-year-old Ellie Christianson aims to take her place in every sense: in particular alongside her father Ben, whom she tries in every way to seduce. Meanwhile, Detective Boland, who conducts the investigation into Karen's disappearance, dissects the lives of the upper-class Christianson - including his youngest daughter Inger - and a series of individuals from the same community, soon realizing that each of the potential suspects has something to to hide.
notes: Steinberg (former author of the juvenile "Bella la vita che se va") focuses on the ambiguity of the atmosphere and on the graces of the emerging Stiles.

title: Merlin
actors: Sam Neill, Miranda Richardson, Isabella Rossellini, Rutger Hauer, Helena Bonham Carter, John Gielgud
description: Life and phantasmagoria of the famous magician of the Arthurian cycle, from the years of his childhood to the bitter rivalry with the Queen of Evil; without neglecting the love for the beautiful Nimue, kidnapped by the evil Lord Vortigern. And of course, neither the fairy sword Excalibur nor the most prominent characters of the kingdom of Camelot can be missing: King Arthur, Queen Guinevere, Sir Lancelot, Mordred, Morgana ...
notes: "Short" version of the original four-hour TV miniseries, shot in England and Wales and enriched by special effects from London's Framestore and Jim Henson Creature Shop. Super-luxury cast in a classic family show.

title: If These Walls Could Talk 2
directors: Jane Anderson, Martha Coolidge, Anne Heche
actors: Sharon Stone, Anne Heche, Ellen DeGeneres, Vanessa Redgrave
description: Three episodes centered on the political and personal condition of lesbians in the United States. The events, set in the same house, cover a period of about four decades: the first takes place in 1961, the second in 1972 and the last in 2000.
notes: Sequel to "Three Lives in the Mirror" (1996) by Cher and Nancy Savoca.

title: Rollerball
actors: Chris Klein, Jean Reno, LL Cool J, Rebecca Romijn
description: Year of Grace, 2005. Jonathan Cross is the most popular rollerball champion a violent evolution of skating hockey. Together with Marcus Ridley, his childhood friend and the beautiful Aurora, he sets the crowds on fire with passion and earns tons of money. Jonathan realizes too late that Alexi Petrovic, the inventor of the game, makes up matches so that the dead man always escapes. Doing so is sure to spark interest in the public and bettors.
notes: Poor John McTiernan has seen the film upset in post production, so you don't understand anything about characters and situations. The pitiful packaging, with funfair pyrotechnic effects, however, is also his fault.

title: The Time Machine
actors: Guy Pearce, Jeremy Irons, Samantha Mumba, Phyllida Law
description: New York, 1899. Alexander, a brilliant scientist and inventor, falls in love with Emma. One evening while they are in Central Park they are attacked by a thief. During the collusion Emma is fatally wounded and the intervention of the rescuers is of no use. From that day Alexander has been committed to building a time machine that can change the course of events. Thanks to the device, the scientist will find himself catapulted into the future.
notes: The film is nice and funny: an adventure for kids that will not displease the grown-ups, especially those who remember _The man who lived in the future_, 1960 and in general the science fiction of the 50s also mentioned in the exquisitely "retro" digital effects.

title: The Royal Tenenbaums
actors: Gene Hackman, Anjelica Huston, Ben Stiller, Gwyneth Paltrow, Luke Wilson
description: Royal O'Reilly Tenenbaum is the odd parent of a not very ordinary family. He and his wife Ethel broke up for some time, but it is mainly the children who have lost sight of their father for about 17 years. Richie precocious tennis champion; Chas, a financial genius from an early age, and Margot, his adopted daughter, a budding writer. Royal reunites them and runs into a series of troubles.
notes: Wes Anderson on the third film, written with friend Owen Wilson (the Cash, drug addict, writer of critically stricken books, lover of Margot, childhood companion of the three sad child prodigies and with the only desire to be a Tenenbaum) poses the impossibility of so-called normality and alleged exceptionality in a comedy about despair. Being in a reality that resembles a page in a book, a Beatles or Rolling Stones song, a Bob Dylan ballad or a Satie song, an illustration of the "New Yorker", a parade of clumsiness and genius of the ordinary. Anderson designs his characters (the actors are sublime) as the author of a refined, snobbish, stupendous photographic volume on paintings (the geometry and hierarchy in the shots is to be studied and appreciated) of an exhibition in New York. Portraits and self-portrait of an artist, as a young man.

title: Hable con ella
actors: Javier Cámara, Dario Grandinetti, Leonor Watling, Geraldine Chaplin
description: Strange Twists of Fate. Marco and Benigno, two spectators of the play Café Muller touch each other with their eyes, involved in the same emotion. They find themselves a few months later in the clinic where Benigno works as a nurse. Marco is there to look after his girlfriend in a coma ...
notes: Constructed according to a fascinating and risky narrative structure and shot with a refined and disarming adherence to the concreteness of bodies, the film finds its leitmotif in the narrative voices. Love continues to come and go, in the solitary lives that Pedro Almodóvar likes, who has never been so extreme, remote and stubborn as in _Speak to her_.

title: Quasi quasi...
actors: Marina Massironi, Neri Marcoré, Nicola Romano, Fabio De Luigi
description: Paola is ashamed of having been abandoned by her husband for another man and so she tells around that she has become a widow. It doesn't seem true to her ex-wife that she can start a new existence. To earn a living, he goes back to school, takes a beautician's degree and gets a job in a hairdresser's shop. She binds to Ruggero who would like to marry her. One day Paola receives a phone call from which she learns that her husband has disappeared leaving part of their house to Andrea, the man for whom she had left it.

title: 13 Conversation About One Thing
actors: Matthew McConaughey, John Turturro, Alan Arkin, Clea DuVall
description: A man who has reached middle age decides to change his life. A rising lawyer is confronted with a serious problem of conscience. A teacher victim of a crime sees the nature of his relationship with his wife change. A businessman wants to take revenge on a co-worker. A cleaning lady full of optimism expects a miracle.
notes: The director of "Clockwatchers" accompanies her protagonists with meticulous writing punctuality and a subdued visual impact: perhaps without flights, but rightly close, almost like a live confession. A film that is somewhat reminiscent of the stories of Paul Auster, with a cast to match.

title: Lady Frankenstein
actors: Joseph Cotten, Sara Bay, Mickey Hargitay, Paul Müller, Paul Whitman
description: Baron Frankenstein and his aide Dr. Marshall finally complete their crazy experiment: but the "creature" immediately reveals itself to be evil and uncontrollable, sowing death and terror everywhere and choosing its own demiurge as its first victim. At this point Tania, the baron's daughter, persuades Marshall - who has always been in love with her - to repeat the transplant using himself as a "donor" and the body of the strong but demented apprentice Thomas as "host": the idea, however, turns out to be anything but happy ...
notes: Limited and "food" participation of the glorious Cotten in a very low profile sexy-horror.

title: Il nido del ragno
actors: Roland Wybenga, Paola Rinaldi, Stéphane Audran, William Berger
description: Alan Whitmore, a young American researcher, goes to Budapest to visit Professor Roth, with whom he collaborates on a secret project called "Intextus". Arriving in the Hungarian capital, Alan finds Roth who, in a panic, hands him a black book which, according to him, should contain information of the utmost importance; alarmed, Alan tries to contact the professor again, but arrives too late: mysterious killers have already struck. The American thus initiates a personal and dangerous investigation, despite threatening warning signs that lead to fear of the worst ...
notes: Thrills and suspense don't live here - look for them elsewhere.

title: Il braccio violento del Thay-Pan
actors: Bruce Lee, Yeo Ban, Paul Hung, Tommy Wu, Hoi Wong
description: Collection of episodes taken from films shot by Bruce Lee at different times; repertory materials have been added to the various clips.
notes: Overall, a negligible editing film that, taking advantage of the fame of the famous star and the fashion of films on oriental martial arts, tries to scrape the bottom of the barrel.

title: Tir-na-nOg - Into the West
actors: Rúaidhrí Conroy, Ciarán Fitzgerald, Gabriel Byrne, Ellen Barkin
description: The very young gypsies Ossie and Tito have been over the moon since grandfather Ward gave them a splendid horse with a white coat. It happens, however, that a bad breeder gets his hands on the animal: the two boys do not lose heart and return the pair to the dishonest, running away with their newfound friend, but both the policemen and dad go out to chase them. Reilly, accompanied by Kathleen ...
notes: Newell harks back to traditional Irish fiction and makes a "Disney" and vaguely surreal film, but pleasant overall. The Gaelic title corresponds to the name of the foal and stands for "land of eternal youth".

title: Bez konca
actors: Grazyna Szapolowska, Jerzy Radziwilowicz, Maria Pakulnis, Aleksander Bardini
description: Poland, 1982: martial law is in force in the country and Solidarity has been dissolved. Ulla, a translator, suddenly loses her husband Antek: the woman tries in every way to fill the painful void that oppresses her, but the ghost of Antek is always present ...
notes: One of Kieslowski's pre-"Decalogue" masterpieces.

title: Primetime Murder
actors: Marisa Berenson, Sascha Zacharias, Luca Venantini, Ray Lovelock
description: Francesca, aspiring wearer, divides a small apartment with a friend; She noticed by a talent scout, she is offered a contract to parade during the "night of the stars".
