Francesca is in seventh heaven, but does not know that the world of fashion is put in turmoil by a serial killer who kills anyone who has to do with the environment. The police as usual gropes in the dark, and there are those who suspect that Francesca's mother is somehow involved.
notes: This time Capone, director of numerous films with Bud Spencer as well as the mediocre "men on the verge of a nervous crisis", manages to maintain a fair tension.

title: Fiabe metropolitane
actors: Antonella Ponziani, Mariella Valentini, Anna Bonaiuto, Enzo Decaro
description: Five untitled episodes: a businessman goes to prostitutes before returning to his wife; an extra falls asleep at the cinema; a farmhand gets on with an Eastern European bully; a woman foresees the death of her lover; a petty criminal feels the mafia's eyes on him.

title: Race the Sun
actors: Halle Berry, Bill Hunter, James Belushi, Casey Affleck, Eliza Dushku
description: A group of Hawaiian kids with a variety of inconveniences to leave behind are pushed by two teachers to sign up for a solar-powered vehicle race.
notes: Discreet comedy with good feelings, which winks at the ecological cause. With an unknown anchor Halle Berry.

title: Dust
actors: Joseph Fiennes, David Wenham, Adrian Lester, Anne Brochet
description: New York, today: Edge, who has broken into the apartment of the elderly Angela to steal, is forced by her to listen to the story of the brothers Luke and Elijah. The first, embittered at being rejected by Lilith, flees the West to land in Macedonia, where he turns into a ruthless mercenary who fights with local gangs. His life changes when he meets Neda ...
notes: From the director of _ Before the rain_, who evidently had accustomed us too well, an incredible mess that exceeds in involuntary comedy, is confused in the script and has no directing ideas that are not derivative. The references to the western are pretentious.

title: Monster's Ball
actors: Halle Berry, Billy Bob Thornton, Sean Combs, Heath Ledger, Peter Boyle
description: Southern United States: Like his father Buck, Hank Grotowski also works on death row at the local prison. The prison guard learned to be cold unlike his son Sonny, who followed in his footsteps. Both have been charged with the execution of Lawrence Musgrove, a prisoner who loves to make portraits: but when Hank meets Leticia and Tyrell, wife and son of the condemned, his ideas change ...
notes: Surprising film by a Swiss filmmaker who, with a deliberately "alien" gaze, immerses himself in a closed reality - that of a small center in the American South - to rework stereotypes and clichés. Discrimination, narrow-mindedness, the ethics of the "rednecks"; but also the sense of an unconscious evil, handed down from father to son, in front of which the very concept of "guilt" falters. All this in order not to reveal the interweaving of a complicated plot (in a couple of moments too much) and to underline the (Springsteenian) theme of the film: every man, even Johnny 99, has the right to a second chance. Call it God, Halle Berry or Manitou, but rest assured that black and white don't exist if you focus on shades. This is what Forster, born in 1970, does with a style of direction that is kept away from the charms of independent American cinema and of course from the Hollywood mainstream. His is an especially intense film, based on a great intuition: to tell the story of a man who was not there and now, suddenly, there.

title: Enigma
actors: Dougray Scott, Kate Winslet, Saffron Burrows, Jeremy Northam
description: March 1943. Allied military personnel responsible for deciphering the Nazi army codes are faced with the worst of nightmares: from one day to the next the Nazi submarines changed the code through which they communicated between themselves and the command of the brown shirts. A merchant navy convoy is in danger of being attacked. Authorities turn to Tom Jericho, a passionate mathematician who decrypts secret codes.
notes: The film was born from Mick Jagger's passion for Robert Harris's book, which traces the events of the "Enigma code" mixing true and false. The result is not equal to the premises, so the spy intrigue with relative suspense is watered down by the discreet boredom of the psychological and sentimental implications.

title: Domestic Disturbance
actors: Matthew  O'Leary, John Travolta, Vince Vaughn, Steve Buscemi, Teri Polo
description: When Frank Morrison divorces Susan, their 12-year-old son Danny suffers (he has suddenly become rebellious and a liar), even though his parents try hard to maintain a peaceful relationship. The balance is disturbed by the arrival of Rick, Susan's new boyfriend: in fact, Danny begins to tell his father little reassuring stories about him, and Frank doesn't know whether to trust him or not ...
notes: The characters are confused and the film extends the list of bogus thrillers, built for television share. The script is too obvious and predictable and the suspense is extinguished precisely because the story does not start, does not move and does not arrive.

title: Lethal Vows
actors: John Ritter, Marg Helgenberger, Megan Gallagher, Lawrence Dane
description: Apparently, Dr. David Farris responds in all respects to the classic definition of "model husband and father". However, the ménage ends abruptly with the mysterious death of his wife Lorraine, who leaves him alone with his three children Sarah, Graham and Danielle. But that's not all: the nightmare becomes even more terrible when Ellen, his previous wife, accuses him of murdering Lorraine; Ellen's determination in supporting her thesis is such that she does not hesitate even for a moment in front of burning revelations about David's past, which little by little bring out the dark sides of the ex-spouse's character.

title: The Exorcist
actors: Ellen Burstyn, Max Von Sydow, Linda Blair, Jason Miller, Lee J. Cobb
description: Twelve-year-old Regan MacNeil, daughter of the well-known actress Chris, begins to show unusual signs of imbalance: violent noises come from her room, becomes hysterical and is tormented by terrifying dreams. On top of that, a director friend of the family is found dead after being alone with her. The doctors who are treating her declare themselves powerless in the face of the very strange manifestations of Regan, going so far as to hypothesize that the girl is "possessed" by external forces. Her mother is also convinced of this, who calls a priest to visit her: but when the religious becomes a victim of the Evil One who dwells in Regan's body, he must have recourse to a real exorcist, who engages in an epic night of battle with the devil.
notes: Upon its release in 1973, the film immediately became a blockbuster and aroused heated debate: theologically very correct, however, it was criticized for the excessive realism of the sequences of possession, judged extreme by some and ridiculous by others. The story, scripted by William Peter Blatty from one of his novels, is a very strong narrative crescendo, staged according to the typical canons of "detection"; numerous controversies, however, were provoked by the scatological language used by the devil in the course of his "epiphanies". The construction of the suspense is also determined by the musical column, dominated by the disturbing theme taken from "Tubular Bells" by Mike Oldfield. The film had eight nominations, but only won two Oscars (script and sound).

title: Pastorali
actors: Rezo Harkhalashvili, Marina Kartsivadze, Baia Macaberidze
description: For some obscure reasons, a Tbilisi string quartet is sent to spend the summer in a remote rural community. The misunderstanding is mutual: the inhabitants of the place are totally immersed in their activities, the "citizens" have to reinvent themselves in the new context.
notes: A Ioseliani of yesteryear, with an already unmistakable style.

title: Operai, contadini
actors: Angela Nugara, Gianpaolo Cassarino, Enrico Achilli, Angela Durantini
description: Set against the backdrop of natural scenarios, twelve people tell - through a series of monologues taken from Elio Vittorini's "Women of Messina" (1949), accompanied by Bach's notes - the stories of the workers and peasants of the title, refugees in the Italy shaken and devastated after World War II.

title: From Star Wars to Star Wars
actors: George Lucas, Harrison Ford, Ray Harryhausen, Steven Spielberg, James Cameron
description: Introduced and presented by Samuel L. Jackson, a series of interviews dedicated to the ambitious and "colossal" project of Lucas and Spielberg, in particular to the genesis and evolution of the phantasmagoric special effects of Industrial Light & Magic. Of great interest is the testimony of the pioneer of "visual effects", Ray Harryhausen.

title: Convicts
actors: Robert Duvall, James Earl Jones, Lukas Haas, Starletta DuPois
description: Texas, 1902: Soll Gautier, supervisor of a rural penal colony, has now turned into sunset boulevard and is suffering from poor health. Little by little the man is estranged from his family and colleagues, with the exception of a former prisoner assigned to his protection, a couple who manages the local emporium and the very young Horace Robedaux, whose friendship brings to mind the happy years of adolescence.
notes: The screenplay by Horton Foote, based on the comparison between the ages of life, is visually translated into the warm chromatic tones created by the Japanese Toyomichi Kurita ("Cookie's fortune", "Gohatto"). Great Duvall.

title: Attila
actors: Gerard Butler, Powers Boothe, Simmone Mackinnon, Tim Curry, Reg Rogers
description: His childhood was certainly not easy: an orphan at a very young age, Attila had to fight hard to answer the call of a destiny that wanted him to be a great warrior and valiant leader. In his unbridled ambition, the throne of the Huns was only the first step towards the conquest of the world: this dream, however, could not fail to break in the face of the excessive power of the Roman Empire, which Attila threatened in its foundations convinced as his people were entitled to a supremacy sanctioned by divine law. In one sense or another, however, the Hun ruler remains one of the great protagonists of his time.

title: Shallow Hal
actors: Gwyneth Paltrow, Jack Black, Jason Alexander, Rene Kirby
description: Under the hypnotic effect of a guru, Hal becomes convinced that even a not-so-attractive woman can be wonderful. When Rosemary, who has obvious obesity problems, appears on her way, Hal sees only beauty in her: the unexpected has come true. The spell is broken by Hal's friend Mauricio, who awakens him from hypnosis and confronts him with a difficult choice ...
notes: The Farrellys had accustomed us to a petty but still effective comedy _ (All crazy about Mery) _. Here, on the other hand, they manage to make Jack Black, an ugly and chubby guy, obsessed (just him) by the charm of the models. The obese Paltrow, then, is absolutely indigestible.

title: La répétition
actors: Jean Pierre Kalfon, Emmanuelle Béart, Pascale Bussières, Sami Bouajila
description: Louise and Nathalie are two teenagers who live everything in symbiosis: friendship, passions such as acting, life in short. An emotional inattention of Nathalie causes in her friend a great unhappiness which leads to a suicide attempt and causes a detachment that lasts several years. Then by chance they find themselves at the theater, Nathalie as the protagonist on stage while Louise married and became a dental technician, sitting in the armchair admires her and a little envies her. The two women meet again and resume the passionate and neurotic relationship for which Louise throws even her marriage to the winds and after a grueling tiraemolla they will still find themselves divided and unhappy, but this time each has a piece of life that the other would like for herself .
notes: Catherine Corsini exploiting the extraordinary Emmanuelle Béart and Pascale Bussières staged a double obsessive repetition: the sentimental neurotic and the theatrical one, thus exploiting the other sense of répétition which in French also means theatrical rehearsal. The two obsessions cross relentlessly but in the long run the theater takes the breath away from love so Louise's physical and sentimental scars and Nathalie's self-destructive narcissism are lost in a river of theater words, in search of an unlikely heir of Louise "Lulu" Brooks.

title: Dungeons & Dragons
actors: Bruce Payne, Jeremy Irons, Thora Birch, Kristen Wilson
description: If Princess Savina refuses to surrender her scepter to the evil Profion, the mythical empire of Izmer risks plunging into chaos. The only ones who can prevent the impending catastrophe are Snails and Ridley, two thieves who are helped by Marina, a novice of the Congregation of the Magi. To complete their enterprise, the three have to resort to spells and the help of an ancient manuscript. "Dungeons & Dragons" one of the most loved role-playing games has become an insipid movie, clone of TV series like "Xena" and the like. It is a fantasy without mystery what has come up with the newcomer Courtney Solomon who, however, his goodness, has a good reputation as a D&D player and a good humor.

title: As três Marias
actors: Marieta Severo, Julia Lemmertz, Luiza Mariani, Maria Luisa Mendonça
description: The rich landowner Firmino Santos Guerra, widower and father of two thugs, José Tranquillo and Arcanjo, burns with the desire to win back Filomena Capodocio, the rich landowner he had loved thirty years earlier. When the woman, married and with five children, rejects him to Firmino, all that remains is to order the murder of all the males of the Capodocio family. To achieve her revenge Filomena risks her daughters to herself: Maria Francisca, Maria Rosa and Maria Pia.
notes: The curious and unwittingly comic film desperately seeks inspiration in the great cinema of the past. He is saved by a cast that makes what isn't believable.

title: L'amore imperfetto
actors: Enrico Lo Verso, Marta Belaustegui, Federico Scribani, Francesco Carnelutti
description: Sergio works in a shopping center in Genoa. His wife Angela is expecting a child, who will live shortly, due to a brain malformation. They will give birth to him, to donate his organs to other children. Angela, from Spain, believes in the Virgin of Pilar, and hopes for a miracle. Meanwhile, Sergio must make his contribution to an investigation.
notes: The silences on which the director's beautiful debut was built ("This is the garden", first work award in Venice in '99) give way to almost unplayed dialogues, in a moral theater built around the couple Belaustegui / Lo Verso . And even with the classic defects of the second work, it is the film of a real director with a surprising control of the staging, respectful of the characters and the viewer.

title: Il più bel giorno della mia vita
actors: Virna Lisi, Margherita Buy, Sandra Ceccarelli, Luigi Lo Cascio, Marco Baliani, Marco Quaglia, Jean-Hugues Anglade, Ricky Tognazzi, Gaia Conforzi, Francesco Scianna, Francesca Perini, Maria Luisa De Crescenzo, Andrea Sama, Giulio Squillacciotti
description: A family finds itself in a large villa on the outskirts of Rome. Around the head of the family, Irene, various more or less happy experiences of love meet. There is his daughter Sara, widowed and unable to live love again. Rita, on the other hand, is a perfect mother and a frustrated wife. And Claudio, who still doesn't know how to reveal his homosexuality.
notes: The script is accurate, even if at times a bit mechanical: the interpreters work, but everything is cooked with a wealth of information, clarifications, explanations of a marked television type. And Rome is a bit too touristy. And the soap is looming.

title: Senso '45
actors: Anna Galiena, Gabriel Garko, Franco Branciaroli, Antonio Salines
description: Livia, an attractive wife of a high Minculpop official, gets accompanied by Ugo, a lawyer, his suitor and the spy of the husband in Venice. Here the woman has to reach her lover Helmut Schultz, a lieutenant of the notorious SS with whom he is experiencing an incandescent love story. During the journey Livia traces the stages of its sexual drift. But in the lagoon city there is a surprise ...
notes: The film, inspired by the story of Camillo Boito as Visconti's film was, is really disarming. Apart from the tone of "hot" literature style dialogue of the early 1900s, what is surprising is eroticism from the oratory.

title: Dragonfly
actors: Kevin Costner, Susanna Thompson, Joe Morton, Linda Hunt
description: Dr. Joe Darrow, who works in the Chicago hospital, loses his wife Emily, also a doctor, during a mission deep in Venezuela. Joe keeps his promise to the woman, to visit her little patients in the pediatric oncology ward. But the more time passes, the more the man cannot resign himself to the loss and becomes convinced that Emily is trying to contact him from the afterlife.
notes: The dragonfly in the title is the lucky animal of the dead wife, it is an angioma of her skin, it is in a paperweight that falls from a bedside table or comes out of a box for the move, it is the insect that shows up at the window. And it is the symbol of the rough encounter between "Ghost" and "The sixth sense".

title: Don't Say a Word
actors: Michael Douglas, Sean Bean, Brittany Murphy, Guy Torry
description: Nathan Conrad, a successful psychiatrist with a practice on New York's Upper West Side, has an attractive wife and a lovely daughter. His life takes a dramatic turn when a group of thugs kidnap his daughter. The bandits do not demand the classic redemption: instead they want Nathan to penetrate the mind of Elisabeth, one of his patients, and bring to light a six-digit number. The combination will allow the kidnappers to get hold of a jewel, the result of a robbery carried out ten years earlier ...
notes: "Oedipal" thriller with a TV series finale, with too many patchy subtexts and hasty passages.

title: Hotel Dajti
actors: Francesco Giuffrida, Flavio Bucci, Michele Venitucci, Piera Degli Esposti
description: Rome, 1938. Andrea is a magician who earns his living with prestidigitation shows in disreputable clubs. The magician is forced by events to flee to Albania and to work in the rooms of the Dajti hotel, a luxury hotel built by Benito Mussolini in Tirana. The love for an Albanian girl and the shady past will bring him back first to Puglia, precisely to Molfetta, then, after forty years, back to a profoundly changed Albania.
notes: "Hotel Dajti": a story that, written and directed with a firmer hand, could become "the" story of this Italy at the end / beginning of the millennium; but scripted in a delirious way and shot with exaggeratedly poetic ambitions, it falls into the absurd.

title: La vita degli altri
actors: Renato Carpentieri, Teresa Saponangelo, Patrizio Rispo
description: Mariano who has always respected the rules of the Camorra and Luisa, a lonely, exploited and disillusioned girl, are united by a deep sense of defeat. He, betrayed by his parents and rejected by his only daughter, lives in a sort of hermitage on the slopes of Vesuvius; she, a young researcher at the Vesuvian Observatory, hides her loneliness and emotional emptiness in her work. The two come into contact when it appears that the volcano is about to erupt.
notes: De Rinaldo's hand is happy with the actors and with the backgrounds, which denounce worrying cultural crises and almost incurable degradation; a little less with the rhythm, more devoted to the small than to the big screen.

title: Sometimes a Great Notion
actors: Paul Newman, Henry Fonda, Lee Remick, Michael Sarrazin
description: Oregon: an American state three times the size of Italy and inhabited by only three million people. All the rest are trees and forests. And still in the 70s there were many families who lived in contact with nature. For example, the Stamperers, woodcutters for generations, who in the end find themselves more united than before between personal and collective dramas.
notes: Modest film wanted by Paul Newman after reading Ken Kesey's best seller "Sometimes a Great Notion". But his direction hesitates in the face of a harsh script, heavily curtailed of the most dramatic situations. The reconciliation ending also seems fake.

title: The Rage: Carrie 2
actors: Emily Bergl, Jason London, Dylan Bruno, Amy Irving, Mena Suvari, J. Smith-Cameron
description: Over twenty years earlier, Carrie White consumed her revenge against her schoolmates, guilty of cruelly humiliating her. Today Sue Snell, one of the few survivors of that massacre perpetrated by telekinesis, works as a social worker at a high school and is particularly dedicated to Rachel, a "problematic" student. Coincidentally, this young woman also has the ability to move objects at a distance, and that a group of bullies are planning to make fun of her. Rachel and Carrie, however, are more connected than you think ...
notes: Faint semi-sequel to De Palma's film with Sissy Spacek (1976).

title: Paws
actors: Nathan Cavaleri, Emilie François, Joe Petruzzi, Caroline Gillmer, Rachael Blake, Sandy Gore, Norman Kaye, Freyja Meere
description: His name is PC, he is a splendid terrier and for him mice, monitors and keyboards have no secrets thanks to the owner Alex, an authentic budding hacker. Having discovered the location of a huge swag, Alex saves the data and - before the evil Anja kidnaps him - entrusts PC with the task of delivering the disk to his friend Susan ...

title: Dance with Me
actors: Chayanne, Vanessa Williams, Kris Kristofferson, Joan Plowright
description: After his mother's death, young Rafael Infante leaves his native Cuba for Houston, where he meets his real father, John Burnett, for the first time. However, he is unaware of the identity of Rafael, who for his part is embarrassed when it comes to informing him of the truth. Rafael's mother was a singer on cruise ships, and on a trip she met John, who taught dance there. The man owns the Excelsior Dance Studio, and it is here that Rafael finds the beautiful dancer Ruby, whom he fatally falls in love with ...
notes: Haines ("Children of a Lesser God") directs the debut of Latin-pop star Chayanne.

title: Gli ultimi
actors: Attori non professionisti
description: Friuli, 1930s: little Checo is the victim of the ridicule and rejection of his companions, who have nicknamed him "scarecrow". Isolation and fear assail him, but Checo will be able to overcome his obsession with "straw men".
notes: From the autobiographical story "I was not a child" by Father Davide Maria Turoldo.

title: Panic Room
actors: Jodie Foster, Kristen Stewart, Forest Whitaker, Dwight Yoakam, Jared Leto, Ann Magnuson, Ian Buchanan
description: Recently divorced Meg Altman and her daughter Sarah have just moved into their new home. During the night, three individuals enter the house in search of a large sum of money kept in the safe by the previous owner. Mother and daughter hide in a secret chamber, built to serve as an emergency shelter. But that's where the safe is located and the three criminals are ready to do anything to reach it.
notes: Jodie Foster moves with a company called "Mayflowers", the name of the boat that brought the first British colonizers to the new world. It is clear that in that "panic room" there is the whole of America, numb after 9/11 by a phobia that comes from within and without. David Fincher is a talented director and he proves it in the only exceptional sequence: Jodie sees the intruders from the closed circuit screen but reacts only when she "hears" the sound of a ball hit by accident by one of the bad guys. To reiterate a very postmodern assumption: what we see is not necessarily the truth, other senses must help us in disorientation. Unfortunately, the rest of the film navigates on sight, between very predictable twists and stereotypes of stylistic choices.

title: Tosca
actors: Angela Gheorghiu, Roberto Alagna, Ruggero Raimondi
description: Rome, 1800: the painter Mario Cavaradossi is arrested for offering protection to a political prisoner. Police chief Scarpia subjects him to torture, but promises to spare his life as long as the singer Floria Tosca, the artist's lover, grants him her graces. The woman pretends to agree, but only to have a chance to kill him. Mario is equally executed and Tosca commits suicide by throwing herself from the walls of Castel Sant'Angelo.
notes: Jacquot doesn't bother to hide the singers' lip-syncing. Which, however it may be, work: the protagonists but above all Raimondi / Scarpia, a thrilling "infamous".

title: Lantana
actors: Anthony LaPaglia, Geoffrey Rush, Barbara Hershey, Kerry Armstrong
description: Detective Leon Zat, called to investigate the mystery of a woman's disappearance, finds himself having to manage a series of complicated human relationships involving four married couples. A labyrinth made of obsession, love, deceit, sex and death which, of course, not everyone is able to survive. An opportunity for the detective to reflect on his past, on what he has lost and what he must try to win back.
notes: A woman's corpse lies in the grass and shrubs. The camera slowly discovers her and does not show her face. The film immediately presents one of its many puzzles and begins as a thriller in which we would have to identify the victim, find the culprit, establish the motive. That death, like the "lantana", wraps with its parasitic spirals a story in which nothing and no one are exactly as they appear. The thriller is one of the veins of the plot, but the real suspense is actually about the loneliness and unhappiness, with some twisted desires, of the four calibrated, ruined couples that make up the main pieces of an elegant, well-thought-out and very cerebral emotional and psychological mosaic. The director and the screenwriter manage, with the interpretative contribution of an excellent cast of actors, to shape the multi-level structure of the film, to enhance the different identities and to weave the various threads of a story, viscous and overflowing, in which persistence of cinema resists.

title: Showtime
actors: Robert De Niro, Eddie Murphy, Rene Russo, William Shatner
description: Detective Mitch Preston is a man of few words and very little patience who loves working alone. Patrol Officer Trey Sellars is a failed actor and his highest aspiration is to play a policeman on screen. Mitch and Trey are forced to work together as the stars of a reality TV show about police officers.
notes: Tom Dey is a rare example of an American filmmaker from academia and critics and it shows. His is the film of an intellectual who uses the means of the spectacular industry to attempt a critique of costume. An undertaking that is only half successful.

title: Amen.
actors: Ulrich Muehe, Ulrich Tukur, Mathieu Kassovitz, Michel Duchaussoy
description: While dealing with the supply of material to the extermination camps for use in the gas chambers, Kurt Gerstein, a chemist and SS officer, denounces the Nazi crimes to the allies, to Pius XII and to the Germans themselves. Kurt puts his life at risk but the only one to listen to him is the young Jesuit Riccardo, an isolated voice who lashes out against the indifference of the ecclesiastical hierarchies ...
notes: The best thing is the title, with that fixed point: the film does not even reach the rational and analytical distance, the accusatory coldness, the doubt, the anxiety. Formal and didactic like a school book, it makes you regret a wasted opportunity.

title: L'ora di religione
actors: Sergio Castellitto, Jacqueline Lustig, Chiara Conti, Gigio Alberti
description: Ernesto, an accomplished painter, learns that they want to make his mother a saint. Kept in the dark about everything by his family, he is particularly struck because the story contrasts with his world as an artist and as a free and atheist man. The initiatives to take part in the beatification process are becoming more and more pressing, while the memory of the mother opens a chasm that pushes him to rework the past and to live the present differently.
notes: With "L'ora di religion" Marco Bellocchio signs not only his most dense and rigorous film of recent years, but also a clear declaration of moral intentions. How to be and how the world around us (even the closest people) would like us to be; and the incessant need to shake off the temptations of acquiring and common sense, to retrace one's history to the last contradiction, to the last pain. To be able to give it a meaning, which can be the very simple one of accompanying your child to school and perhaps being able to lead him to a place where he is not there and he can finally be free to be alone. With Ernesto, we wander between paradox and disbelief, enveloped in an atmosphere that passes seamlessly from the oppressive spirals of a Vatican nightmare (the party with its slow motion, the sudden appearance and the delirious speeches of the black nobles, the surreal duel at dawn) to the extraordinary cleanliness of the image of everyday life, of the Roman roads taken through the windows of a car, of the elementary school, of the illuminated garden in which the child tries to hide from God.

title: Rue des plaisirs
actors: Laetitia Casta, Vincent Elbaz, Patrick Timsit, Catherine Mouchet
description: 1945, time of Liberation and closure of the brothels. The "Palais Oriental" is one of these and is about to cease its activities: Marion, one of the girls who work at the "Palais", dreams of love and happiness. Petit Louis - the factotum of the house, madly in love with Marion - knows that he can never have her and for this he sets out in search of the man who will be able to make her happy. Thinks to find it in Dimitri Josco, but ...
notes: Leconte signs the direction of a film made up of décor, flashbacks and cinematic nostalgia. The result is redundant with visual effects that oust naturalism and characters that leave one indifferent.

title: Rush Hour 2
actors: Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker, John Lone, Zhang Ziyi, Alan King
description: The long-awaited vacation for Chief Inspector Lee and Detective James Carter has finally arrived. As soon as they arrive in Hong Kong, the two find themselves involved in the most important case of their career: a bomb exploded in the American embassy, ??killing two customs officers who were investigating a round of illicit trafficking. Everything is linked to the discovery of stencils for printing 100 dollar banknotes that ended up in the hands of the Triad, the powerful Chinese mafia. Lee is immediately assigned to the case and Carter is forced, in spite of himself, to follow him ...
notes: The cinema of the Hong Kong "diaspora" continues to flow in a thousand streams towards the welcoming Hollywood riverbed, but those who loved the Jackie Chan in the first way will probably be disappointed once again, even if this sequel to _Rush Hour - Two stray mines_ directed by the same Brett Ratner shows a greater compactness in the script and a much higher pace than the previous one. Action, kung fu fights, lightning-fast jokes, beautiful women and the usual linguistic "melting pot" that is so reminiscent of Monty Python's, have found a right point of mixing, guaranteeing the film a stunning collection at the US box office. The accompanying cast isn't bad either, with revived John Lone, beautiful and talented Zhang Ziyi, comedian Alan King and seductive Roselyn Sanchez.

title: The Medusa Touch
actors: Richard Burton, Lee Remick, Lino Ventura, Marie-Christine Barrault, Derek Jacobi
description: John Morlar, a B-rated writer, is brutally killed and his head is completely mangled. The beauty is that - as the French inspector Brunel, on a business trip to London, discovers - Morlar's brain continues to live and emit signals: subsequently the investigations ascertain that a series of strange recent deaths have affected anyone who has found inconsistent with the writer or caused him wrongdoing. Dr. Zonfeld tries to crack the case, but ...
notes: From a novel by Peter Van Greenaway (sic), a curious and in some ways exciting story with a parapsychological background. Burton the undisputed star.

title: Emmanuelle's Love
actors: Sylvia Kristel, Marcela Walerstein, George Lazenby, Joel Bui
description: Emmanuelle goes to a Tibetan temple where he is administered a potion that returns his youth. Now his desire is to trace Mario, his love of two decades earlier: at first the man is perplexed, but then ...
notes: After the effects of the involuntary comedy, the fans of Arsan (and Kristel) have to have fun.

title: John Q.
actors: Denzel Washington, Kimberly Elise, Anne Heche, James Woods
description: John Q. Archibald is a factory worker and lives for his wife, Denise and little Michael. During a baseball game, his son collapses: he must urgently undergo a heart transplant, which is economically inaccessible to his father's finances. When the man is denied insurance coverage for medical expenses, he decides to do whatever it takes to save his son. He barricades himself inside the emergency room, holding doctors, nurses and patients hostage. Politically correct American meatloaf, the kind made with a stencil. One closes his eyes, counts to three and already imagines what will happen in the next sequence.

title: Fatal Affair
actors: C. Thomas Howell, Maxim Roy, Jay Underwood, Marc Camacho, Louis Di Bianco
description: Mack Maddox is a successful executive who leads a comfortable and peaceful life with his wife Laura and little Daisy. Maddox are used to telling each other everything. At least in appearance: in fact Mack has been careful not to confess to Laura the relationship he had recently with a married woman. His surprise is therefore understandable when, selected to be part of a jury in a murder case, he discovers that the victim is his ex-lover. But that's not all: acquitted for lack of evidence, the accused - who responds to the name of Ezra Tayler - recognizes Mack and begins to torment him, accusing him of the crime ...
notes: All déjà-vu, sure, but honestly.

title: Spara Joe... e così sia!!!
actors: Richard Harrison, José Torres, Franca Polesello, Indio Gonzáles
description: After a robbery, Ted deceives his cronies and hides the swag; he is seriously injured and, at the end of his life, he gives the map to the hunter Joe. Ted's former associates track down Joe and torture him to sing, blinding him; they then put Rosy, the corrupt saloon keeper, after him in order to get the map delivered. Arrived near the hiding place, Ted's former companions take possession of the precious map and put their hands on the loot. They will have to deal with Joe who in the meantime has regained his sight and can't wait to take revenge.
notes: A "spaghetti" of disheartening ignorance.

title: Las vampiras
actors: Soledad Miranda, Ewa Strömberg, Andrés Monales, Dennis Price
description: To satiate her irresistible thirst for a woman's blood, Countess Nadine Carosy, a lesbian vampire, seduces and kills the most beautiful girls. But one of them, Linda, falls in love ...
notes: One of Franco's best films, delusional right from the plot. Very interesting is the work on colors, which anticipates, in an artisanal way, that of Argento in "Suspiria".

title: The Nude Restaurant
actors: Viva, Taylor Mead, Allen Midgette, Ingrid Superstar, Brigid Berlin, Julian Burroughs, Louis Waldron
description: The place is a bar-restaurant, usually not very crowded and with rather limited ambitions. What makes it special is that customers and waiters are without clothes: a habit that eases inhibitions and favors the flow of confessions and confidences.
notes: A transitional film, always static but highly talked about.

title: Semana Santa
actors: Mira Sorvino, Olivier Martinez, Feodor Atkine, Alida Valli
description: In Seville, while preparations for Holy Week are in full swing, Maria Delgado arrives, a detective on the run from a tormented past. Meanwhile, a serial killer wanders around the city eliminating people who, apparently, have nothing in common with banderillas. Assisted by colleagues Quemada and Torillo, Maria tries to solve the mystery ...
notes: Sorvino's presence in this film is presumably justified by the fatal attraction between her and the handsome Martinez. Mira crosses the fascinating Sevillian sets like any American tourist, while the direction of the German Danquart proves to be totally lacking in inventiveness.

title: Delitto sul Po
actors: Antonio Rezza, Paolo Mosca, Lavinia Novara, Elisabetta Sgarbi
description: Police agent Antonio is assassinated by Eli, a girl of few words, Arm, a boy who is experiencing the problems of the 3 -adolescence with difficulty and from the Frenchman, a man of faith and an avid smoker. The commissioner D'Angelo who finds the corpse on the banks of the Po in the absence of certain tests arrests the three alleged murders.

title: Ice Age
description: The story takes place in the middle of the prehistoric age. The melancholy mammoth Manfred, known by the nickname of Manny, the sloth Sid, Diego, a saber-toothed tiger and Scrat, a nerd primitive squirrel are the protagonists of this adventure set in the ice. The group works hard to get Roshan, an abandoned human cub, back home.
notes: Funny, melancholic, suggestive, this journey into prehistory turns out to be a pleasant surprise. Always ready to amaze and amuse is also the Italian edition, with the voices of Leo Gullotta, Pino Insegno and the "bleso" Claudio Bisio.

title: The Scorpion King
actors: Dwayne Johnson, Kelly Hu, Michael Clarke Duncan, Steven Brand, Sherri Howard, Bernard Hill, Grant Heslov, Peter Facinelli
description: Memnon, a tyrant determined to eliminate all the nomadic populations of the desert, holds the city of Gomorrah with an iron fist. The nomadic tribes who escaped the slaughter try to regroup to defeat the hated enemy. To counter him they hire Mathayus who, having entered the enemy camp, finds himself having to fight with Cassandra, a young and charming witch. Unable to kill her, he flees with her into the desert.
notes: Filmed by Chuck Russell, in pure recycling economy, with improvised sets and exteriors, the very modest and very gymnastic film is a bit of a catch of the television era, a bit of "Age of Empires", a bit of a follower of the "sandaloni".

title: Casomai
actors: Fabio Volo, Stefania Rocca, Mino Manni, Sara D'Amario, Evelina Manna
description: Tommaso and Stefania, married for some years, have a happy and fulfilling life as a couple; their union is completed by a beautiful boy named Andrea. In short, everything seems to be going well. But the two are in crisis due to the constant presence of friends, acquaintances and relatives: thus, a beautiful and serene love risks being shipwrecked forever ...
notes: D'Alatri demonstrates that he knows how to place the camera among the treacherous currents of the daily ménage, of affections, frustrations and domestic chatter, but soon the thick ambitions expire in indifference and banality. Manifesto of a generation that would like to be more than it is ... in every sense.

title: A porte chiuse
actors: Anita Ekberg, Fred Clark, Gianni Bonagura, Vittorio Caprioli
description: In Domokos, Greece, the beautiful Olga Duvovich is tried for the murder of her husband, a wealthy financier. Defense and prosecution fail to introduce a decisive turning point in the case, which is why an inspection on the island of Maratis is decided to gather new elements. Once here, the splendid atmosphere of the place and the charm of Olga disturb the prosecutor Xatis, who falls in love with the woman and plans to run away with her after the favorable verdict: the surprises, however, are far from over ...
notes: Anitona in its maximum splendor is always a beautiful sight, even if Risi's film certainly does not shine for its originality.

title: Dead Sleep
actors: Linda Blair, Tony Bonner, Andrew Booth, Christine Amor
description: Maggie Healey, a nurse in a psychiatric hospital, begins to have serious doubts about the nature of the sedative treatments performed by Dr. Jonathan Heckett on patients in a state of coma: her investigations will lead to unexpected developments.
notes: Based on real facts, with Linda Blair from "The Exorcist" in the lead role.

title: Creator
actors: Peter O'Toole, Mariel Hemingway, Vincent Spano, Virginia Madsen, David Ogden Stiers
description: The distinguished biologist Harry Wolper, a professor at a Californian university, has a risky project in mind: to clone his wife Lucy, who disappeared over twenty years earlier. What he needs, however, is a young lady willing to act as a "guest", and for this purpose he rides his bike around the city, covering walls and poles with ad hoc advertisements; thus he meets the lively student Barbara, but Wolper has not foreseen the spark that strikes between the girl and his assistant Boris, just as if the story between him and his deceased wife is repeated.
notes: Passer from Prague directs a bizarre film tinged with melancholy, well supported by a volcanic O'Toole.

title: Bela Donna
actors: Eduardo Moscovis, Natasha Henstridge, Andrew McCarthy, Florinda Bolkan
description: Gorgeous but depressed, Donna has a torrid relationship with Nô, a Brazilian fisherman. The latter later learns that her spouse is working on a project that seriously pollutes the local river; overwhelmed by feelings and contempt, Donna reaches the verge of suicide ...
notes: Between eroticism and involuntary ridicule.

title: Lady Chatterley's Passions 2: Julie's Secret
actors: Solange Cousseau, John Franco, Roberta Fregonese, Gala Orlova
description: After her studies, the young Julie Clifford Chatterley returns to the Magione Avita and is irrepressibly attracted by Melton, the former lover of her mother.
notes: On the film it is better to fly; However, not on the fact that in 1996 Glisenti directed "red light crime", in whose cast there is none other than the Jimmy Ghione of "Striscia" (!!!).

title: Cérémonie d'amour
actors: Marina Pierro, Mathieu Carrière, Claudine Berg, Josy Bernard
description: The young and seductive Miriam spends his free moments by adapting men into the métro stations. Among his "victims" there is Hugo, a middle -aged stylist who approaches and follows it on the streets of the city to a luxurious attic full of exotic plants: here Miriam, a sort of priestess of a mysterious cult, submits him to a sadistic and cruel treatment, which consummated which the nightmare of man will extend on the banks of the Seine ...
notes: The Polish director starts from a novel by André Pieyre de Mandiargues and draws a work imbued with eros and death, suspended between reality and imaginary. Magnetic the presence of Pierro.

title: Mindstorm
actors: Antonio Sabato jr, Emmanuelle Vaugier, Eric Roberts, Clarence Williams III
description: In an extreme attempt to rescue a young boy held captive by a pedophile maniac, private investigator Tracy Wellman can fortunately count on the help of Dan Oliver, an FBI agent. The next case, however, is just as difficult: Tracy has to contend with David Mendez, head of a sect dedicated to a mysterious cult, which holds the daughter of a senator in its clutches. When the going gets tough, Oliver arrives and takes the lead in the delicate operation ...
notes: As if we hadn't had enough of his father, now we have to put up with the inessential cinematic forays of Antonio Sabàto jr.

title: Mel
actors: Jack Scalia, Greg Evigan, Ernest Borgnine, Julie Hagerty, Bug Hall
description: During the summer holidays at their grandfather's ranch, two city kids make friends with Mel, a friendly giant tortoise. One of the old man's neighbors, however, plans to open a theme park and has thought of Mel as the official mascot ...
notes: Discreet children's film directed by the brother of the better known John.

title: Love Letters
actors: Laura Linney, Steven Weber, Kirsten Storms, Tim Redwine
description: Andrew and Melissa, who fell in love at school but separated from life, maintain an epistolary contact. Years later they meet again and intertwine a relationship, but in the meantime he - who has become a rampant politician - has married and for Melissa, who is now a painter, accepting the situation is impossible ...

title: As bodas de Deus
actors: João César Monteiro, Rita Durão, Luis Miguel Cintra, Joana Azevedo, Manuela de Freitas, Jean Douchet
description: Wandering and cold on a park bench, wearing only Ronaldo's yellow-green shirt, João de Deus seems to have reached the end of the line. Suddenly a messenger from God approaches him and gives him a box full of money: for João it is the beginning of a series of new and bizarre encounters, especially for women ...
notes: Crossing the film with his slim figure, lanky and perennially attracted to young girls in bloom, Monteiro follows up on "La comedia di Dio", remaining in the balance between bewildered tragicomedy and philosophical reflection. A different, and / static and mocking cinema, not for everyone but authentically "other".

title: Il figlio dello sceicco
actors: Gordon Scott, Cristina Gajoni, Alberto Farnese, Moira Orfei
description: Egypt, 19th century. The tyrant Omar uses an iron fist against the inhabitants of the province of which he is governor. Kerim, son of the sheikh, takes care of defending the interests of the weakest. Omar tries in every way to respond to the attacks of the champion of justice.
notes: Disappointing adventure movie.

title: Italiensk for begyndere
actors: Anders W. Berthelsen, Anette Støvelbæk, Peter Gantzler, Ann Eleonora Jørgensen
description: On the outskirts of Copenhagen, a group of people meet for the weekly Italian lesson. Among the students, an eccentric Protestant pastor, a man and a woman blocked by shyness, two ladies who discover that they are sisters and other specimens of various humanity.
notes: The twelfth Dogma film is a curious example of linguistic mixing, which fortunately the distribution has not altered by choosing to subtitle the dialogues in Danish. In addition to thrilling and entertaining gracefully, it offers us an opportunity to see ourselves reflected in a special cineantropological mirror and smile a little at ourselves. Silver bear in Berlin.

title: The Count of Montecristo
actors: Jim Caviezel, Guy Pearce, Dagmara Dominczyk, Richard Harris
description: The young Edmond Dantès is accused of high treason and locked up in the maximum security prison on the island of Château d'If. He is innocent: against him evidence built by his best friend Fernand, in love with Mercedes, Dantès' girlfriend, and therefore driven by jealousy to shameful machination. But Dantès manages to escape, transforms himself into the Count of Monte Cristo and carries out his relentless plan of revenge ...
notes: Extra-long (131 minutes), the film suffers from excessive slowness and, above all, from the weak charisma of the two protagonists (Jim Caviezel and Dagmara Dominczyk), who have that slightly dazed air of TV stars. Too bad, because Guy Pearce has the right determination as a neurotic villain and Richard Harris seems to have a lot of fun playing under Abbot Faria's beard and rags.

title: Liberty Stands Still
actors: Wesley Snipes, Linda Fiorentino, Oliver Platt, Martin Cummins
description: Liberty, daughter and wife of an arms dealer, is in Los Angeles for an extramarital affair. A sniper who on the phone identifies as Joe forces her to handcuff herself to a hot dog stand. Joe will detonate a bomb when the woman's cell phone runs out. The man wants to avenge the death of his daughter, killed by a classmate with a weapon produced by the woman.
notes: The film would like to address the Second Amendment of the Constitution. A confused and unrealistic patchwork emerges. On the other hand, the enveloping direction and the skill of the two protagonists create a stylistic redemption that should not be underestimated.

title: Saving Silverman
actors: Jason Biggs, Steve Zahn, Jack Black, Amanda Peet, Amanda Detmer
description: Darren, Wayne and J.D. they have been friends since, as children, they attended the same class: ever since, the three have always been inseparable. Judith, a psychiatrist who is as beautiful as she is rational and determined, is throwing havoc in their lives. The woman sets her sights on Darren, sending a friendship into crisis that until then seemed solid. The only way to save Darren - or so Wayne and J.D. - is to kidnap Judith ...
notes: The film brings together three new generation comic talents, defends stupidity, losers, and boldly handles gags, jokes and paradoxes. But many of the intentions do not reach the strategic goal.

title: Bloody Sunday
actors: James Nesbitt, Tim Pigott-Smith, Nicholas Farrell, Gerard Crossan
description: On January 30, 1972, in a Londonderry cinema there was a double program: _The magnificent seven_ and _Domenica, cursed Domenica_. And it was really cursed and bloody on the Sunday of the 10,000 Irish who took to the streets for civil rights: the demonstration, banned by the English authorities, took place thanks to the commitment of activist Ivan Cooper, but it cost the lives of 27 people ...
notes: The Greengrass film tells, in the chronicle of one day, how thin the border is between the free expression of dissent and war. The nervousness breaks every shot, interrupts it in a matter of seconds, makes it shaky, while the phones ring incessantly in homes, headquarters, hospitals. Made by Irish and British, the film does not hide the enormous responsibilities of the military, caught in the spiral of tension and the need for an "exemplary act", nor the differences, moral and political, that agitate the two sides. Hard and drawn like a war movie, _Bloody Sunday_ photographs the exact moment when the war breaks out; and it could not have broken out, at least that day, at least in Londonderry (not even the names of the cities are the same for Irish and English), in front to those 13 free victims. Golden Bear in Berlin 2002.

title: Sur mes lèvres
actors: Vincent Cassel, Emmanuelle Devos, Olivier Gourmet, Serge Boutleroff
description: Carla, a 35-year-old with some hearing problems, works as a secretary in a real estate agency. Sour and suffering from the behavior of her colleagues, the woman sees her life take a different turn when Paul Angeli, a rather rough and hasty ex-convict is hired ...
notes: Audiard, son of the well-known screenwriter Michel, bases the mechanism of this remarkable thriller on the reversal of the handicap, finding adequate support in a wonderfully "ugly" actress like Devos and in Cassel, who seems born to play bad boys out of jail. A melodrama with a built-in big shot, surprising and unsettling.

title: Mademoiselle
actors: Sandrine Bonnaire, Jacques Gamblin, Isabelle Candelier, Zinedine Soualem, Gilbert Frémont
description: Claire, married with two children, is a pharmaceutical sales representative. Pierre runs acting workshops with two friends, Alice and Karim. It is in Lyon that the two meet and discover they like each other. Claire discovers a world hitherto very distant from her. He will learn to get involved and improvise not only on stage but also in life.
notes: Soft and light like a sweet memory that comes back to memory, Lioret's film stages the events of the case that can sometimes change an existence or turn into small regrets. Claire accepts the consequences of a choice without drama, but keeps in her heart the magic of a brief but intense encounter.

directors: G. Robbiano, L. Vignolo, M. Zingirian
actors: Ed Bishop, Andrea Bruschi, Massimo Olcese, Veronika Logan
description: A meeting of religious leaders from all over the world is underway in La Spezia. The TV preacher Jones who finds himself, not by chance, in the city hires Omega, an infallible killer, to eliminate the Pope who hinders his project: to become the new messiah of humanity. Omega has only one flaw: he is so good that he is forced to create new difficulties for himself. A journalist sniffs the scoop, borrows her father's Cinqueceno and leaves with her boyfriend for the Ligurian city.
notes: The goliardic operina signed by six hands and with "helzapoppinstiche" intentions, was the case in 2001 in the city of the lantern. A sort of Ligurian "LaCapagira", complete with queues at the box office and local press reviews.

title: Queen of the Damned
actors: Aaliyah, Stuart Townsend, Marguerite Moreau, Vincent Perez, Lena Olin
description: Asleep for six thousand years, Akasha - queen of the damned and mother of all vampires - has awakened, and with her the darkest forces of Evil awaken. It will be up to the "undead" Lestat, who fascinates mere mortals in the guise of a rock star, to try to fight and oppose the creatures under Akasha's orders. At stake is the survival of the whole of humanity. The thrust against the look and the nonsense of certain music is one of the strengths of the film, in which the only ones having a good time are the actors. From a film with vampires, however, one expects a full-blown horror or - alternatively - a comedy / parody, not a bloodless exercise like this.

title: A doppia faccia
actors: Klaus Kinski, Annabella Incontrera, Kristiane Krüger, Margaret Lee
description: Suspected of murder, John Alexander, widower of a rich lady with particular sexual tastes, thinks he is seeing his (allegedly) dead wife in a porn movie. Behind the scenes, two individuals pull the strings of a lethal trap.
notes: Overrated thriller by Riccardo Freda based on a story by the mystery writer Edgar Wallace to which some pleasant morbidity has been grafted. It seems that at the time of distribution the film had been censored of some nudes, however the perverse theme, to see it again today, appears pretext. Co-written by Lucio Fulci, who didn't speak well of it. Only for aficionados.

title: Sette baschi rossi
actors: Ivan Rassimov, Sieghardt Rupp, Kirk Morris, Pamela Tudor, Dale Cummings, Serge Nubret, Arthur Brauss, Wilbert Gurley, Ugo Adinolfi, Carla Calò
description: A journalist is captured by the rebels who, during the Simba revolt, set fire to an area of ??the Congo. To try to save the reporter, a battalion of mercenaries known as the "Red Basques" is sent to the scene. During the expedition, the guide Alain and the only doctor who practices in the area join the group. The operation is successful, but the return journey is much more difficult than the outward journey.
notes: Mediocre Italian-German co-production. Kirk Morris, a Venetian bodybuilder (Adriano Bellini is the real name) for once does not wear the clothes of Maciste or Samson.

title: Aida degli alberi
description: Aida, daughter of the king of Arborea, is taken prisoner by the troops of Petra and there reduced to slavery. Arborea, a luxuriant kingdom, and Petra, a kingdom of large stone constructions and dedicated to the cult of the underworld god Satam, face each other harshly. The fight between the two powers becomes more bloody day by day and involves Kak, son of the High Priest and playmate of Radames, princess Amneris and her father, Diaspron king of Petra. Only the pure love between Radames, the reckless son of the general of the army of Petra and Aida, the brave daughter of the king of Arborea, can defeat the hatred between the two powers.
notes: Giuseppe Verdi's music disappears to make way for that of maestro Ennio Morricone and the happy ending is well suited to a cartoon released during the Christmas holidays. Overall, Guido Manuli achieves a good compromise between auteur and industrial cinema. Very interesting are the fantasy settings created by Victor Togliani and a pinch of comedy introduced by the character of Kak, the peaceful and playful son of the High Priest of the god Satam, perfidious orchestrator of intrigues behind the two young lovers, does not hurt. From a technical point of view, one cannot fail to note the good level of 3D animation and special effects which, despite not comparable budgets, do not make the mega productions of the majors regret too much.

title: 40 Days and 40 Nights
actors: Josh Hartnett, Vinessa Shaw, Shannyn Sossamon, Adam Trese
description: Matt, unrepentant casanova, has just been left by his girlfriend Nicole. Still in shock, he confides in his brother priest and decides, coinciding with Lent, to abstain from any sexual activity for forty days. Meanwhile, Nicole has joined up with someone else, her colleagues are betting on how it will end and as it happens, Matt's dream girl comes to undermine his purpose of chastity ...
notes: Although the idea is not fulminating, it lends itself to the invention of various gags and connection situations; but above all it serves to position Josh Hartnett on the romantic-brilliant side, testing his status as a sex symbol for the next decades.

title: The Anniversary Party
actors: Kevin Kline, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Parker Posey, Gwyneth Paltrow
description: Actress Sally and writer Joe have been together for six years. To celebrate the event they decide to give a reception in their sumptuous Hollywood house. All their friends answer the invitation: Gina and Levi, Judy and Sophia, Cal, Jerry, Mac, Clair. What was announced as a party, in a short time, is transformed into an awareness of the problems of life.
notes: Pleasant and funny the first part that exploits a fresh spontaneity of the cast tearing more than a smile, but when in the second part the two directors / actors try to mix drama with comedy, the film stutters and slowly turns into an anonymous TV movie.

title: Va savoir!
actors: Jeanne Balibar, Sergio Castellitto, Marianne Basler, Hélène de Fougerolles
description: Camille and Ugo are respectively the actress and director of an Italian theater company that is staging Luigi Pirandello's "Come tu mi hai" in Paris. Camille is the only French actress in the company, and has been missing from Paris since she painfully separated from Pierre. For Ugo, on the other hand, the stay in the city is an opportunity to verify if there really exists an unpublished manuscript by Carlo Goldoni, an undertaking that will lead him to meet Dominique. Past and present, theater and life merge, fate shuffles the cards.
notes: Jacques Rivette (born in 1928), director who was part of the great wave of the Nouvelle Vague together with Chabrol, Godard Resnais, Rohmer, Truffaut, takes us for a walk through the performances of life, the stage and the set. Rivette is little known in our country. We have only released some of his many films (the most recent "La bella grontrosa", 1991 and "Giovanna d'Arco", 1994). In his beautiful film the circles of love intertwine, Pirandello mixes with Goldoni, the pleasure of theater meets the sharp gaze of cinema and Rivette performs in an exercise of high acrobatics between rigor and naturalness, calculated clarity and unpredictable surprises. Light and sophisticated cinema, comic energy and pauses for reflection, vaudeville and melodrama, yellow intrigue (there's a stolen ring) and screwball comedy. Delicious the last half hour when all the intrigues melt: obviously on a stage.

title: Ultimo stadio
actors: Valerio Mastandrea, Stefano Santospago, Ivano De Matteo, Lia Tanzi, Manrico Gammarota, Federico Galante, Rolando Ravello, Victoria Larchenko
description: Rome, Olympic stadium, 31 May 2001, Champions Cup final: in the stands many men and many women, each with their own story, with their own little corner of the world made of happiness and unhappiness. Joy and despair overlap from moment to moment. Simone, ten years old, wishes he could make the dreams of a failed father come true. Sixteen-year-old Alice has a beautiful home and a beautiful family, but she's playing with fire. Pietro has mediocrity as a companion and has been depressed for too long ...
notes: De Matteo's first feature film is reduced to a set of scruffy notes, taken on the fly and in pencil, on an ugly, dirty and evil humanity.

title: Una bellezza che non lascia scampo
actors: Thekla Reuten, Federico Scribani, Luca Citarella
description: The young musician Tony, romantically linked to Alberto, professor of paleontology at the university, is about to graduate in composition. The meeting with Vittorio, a longtime friend of the teacher, risks bringing out the depression that is harboring in his soul. In fact, while Alberto, always sweet and helpful, reveals his relentless rational and lucid nature, in Vittorio, selective in his relationship with others, a world of affection and sweetness unexpectedly emerges. Tony who fell in love with Vittorio goes into a depressive crisis.
notes: It is very difficult to transship and then chase the wandering mines of the psyche in a film, and this fatigued and exaggeratedly "cinephile" debut (Antonioni, Bresson, Tarkovskij and Bellochio of which Pirani was assistant) confirm this once again. The path of the author, who also signs the screenplay based on an essay by the famous Fagioli read in the magazine with the Bellocchiano title "The dream of the butterfly", takes on the dimension of the muffled reality that she cannot see because it is debased and broken by inner mists, without being able, however, to unfold it, to make it soar as the presumed final "rebellion" would have us believe. The feeling, in essence, is that Pirani used the camera as a form of antidepressant therapy. But what results and "feels" is an analgesic rather than analogue cinema, which can serve the patient author but little or nothing to the impatient spectator. Thekla Reuten is beautiful, but she leaves no way out.

title: Best
actors: John Lynch, Ian Bannen, Linus Roache, Ian Hart, Jerome Flynn
description: George Best arrives with a former teammate in Belfast to take part in a show in a pub that is also home to an official Manchester United club. After the show, Best falls asleep and relives in a dream the good old days: the beginnings, the reckless life, the golden ball won in 1968 ...
notes: Even with a low budget, on the life of George Best, Manchester United footballer, nicknamed El Beatle after his team blew the 1968 European Cup at Benfica, considered one of the five best footballers in the world, a film could have been made full of rhythm, ideas, signs of the time. Best's time was in fact the British Sixties and Seventies, with London at the center of the map of fashions, music, even cinema. Years of acceleration and experimentation, of apparent eternal youth, which Best represented well with his success, his Beatle cut, his passion for girls, parties and alcohol. In fact, Mary McGuckian's film starts off well, lightly, imitating a bit Lester and a bit of the news. But then he flattens himself into a too simple and redundant moralism and lets the rhythm be set by the vintage music column, which is the best thing in the film. But that's not enough.

title: Texas '46
actors: Luca Zingaretti, Roy Scheider, Vincent Riotta, Sue Cremin
description: During the Second World War, fifty thousand Italian POWs were shipped to the United States. During the trip they learned that the Mussolini government had fallen and that King Vittorio Emanuele had signed an armistice with the allied forces. A problem presented itself. What to do with these prisoners of war? Should they be considered allies or enemies? To resolve the situation, they were offered to join the Italian Service Units. Luigi, who does not want to accept the situation, chooses the way to escape.
notes: Between echoes of the worst Tornatore and found at Renzo Martinelli, the film ends up in the cauldron of our confused and unhappy cinema.

title: Wasabi
actors: Jean Reno, Ryoko Hirosue, Michel Muller, Carole Bouquet
description: Hubert, a soft-hearted but brusque police inspector, has been temporarily suspended for changing the connotations of the prefect's son. Learning that Miko, the woman of his life who has been missing for about twenty years, has died under mysterious circumstances, he leaves for Japan. He discovers that Miko has not forgotten him, on the contrary he has left him a daughter.
notes: French cinema does not disdain to produce comedies in which cultural frictions should lead to entertaining visual and verbal gags. Unfortunately, this is not the case with Gérard Krawczyk's film, which results in an already belated follow-up of certain stylistic features and situations à la Luc Besson.

title: Une hirondelle a fait le printemps
actors: Mathilde Seigner, Michel Serrault, Jean-Paul Roussillon, Frédéric Pierrot
description: Sandrine tries to escape the stress of city life and her job as a computer expert. Her dream is to become a farmer and take possession of a farm in Vercos. Adrien, an old farmer, is determined to sell his property, but not to pass on everything he has learned to Sandrine, much less to give him a hand. Despite the initial difficulties between the two, a deep feeling of friendship will break out.
notes: French version of "Escape from the city" that renounces the comic in favor of a placid rhythm, a smooth writing and without big gaps, supported by the acting grace of Michel Serrault and Mathilde Seigner that leaves one admiring for the naturalness and emotion they manage to convey .

title: Voci
actors: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Gabriella Pession, Miki Manojlovic
description: Michela, a journalist with a shy and introverted character, hides from herself her true nature as a woman full of projects and a lover of life. Angela is the exact opposite, sunny, vital, irrepressible. The two women who live in the same building could become friends. But Angela is brutally murdered. Investigating those responsible is the only gesture of love that Michela can make towards her missing friend.
notes: Giraldi starts from Maraini's novel and resolutely moves away from it. The tense and mysterious atmosphere of the first part, the ambiguity of the relationships between the characters and some reversals are convincing in a thriller that does not know how to be reticent and elliptical in some bad scenes.

title: The Majestic
actors: Jim Carrey, Martin Landau, Laurie Holden, Allen Garfield
description: To Peter Appleton, a successful screenwriter, everything seems to be going well: his latest film, Raiders of the Sahara, is breaking the bank, and the esteem that people in Hollywood have for him is unconditional. But one bad day (we are in full McCarthyism), he is accused of being a communist: his life changes to the point of forcing him to flee. Victim of an accident, he wakes up in Lawson, an unknown country where everyone mistakes him for Luke, a war hero who disappeared eight years earlier ...
notes: Darabont is not an irresistible director: in addition to being incurably "old style", his cinema - suffering from the syndrome of the former screenwriter who finally does not have to undergo script manipulation - always rests on overflowing times: _The wings of freedom_ lasted 140 minutes , _The green mile_ 188, two and a half hours this film on the darkest years of Hollywood history, between "witch hunts" and trials of beliefs - true or presumed - of filmmakers considered to be communists. Darabont pays an all too sentimental and nostalgic homage to Frank Capra (who takes his revenge) and his inflexible optimistic characters. Very good - and deliberately monotonous - Carrey.

title: Gaudi Afternoon
actors: Lili Taylor, Marcia Gay Harden, Judy Davis, Juliette Lewis
description: The far too quiet life of Cassandra, a translator of Latin American short stories, turns into hell when she meets Frankie, a drag queen waiting to change her gender. Frankie offers the woman money to track down Ben, a friend of hers who ran off with April, an eccentric hippie. The translator accepts the offer and leaves for Spain where the two have taken refuge.
notes: The subject is a bit 'already seen, but it is very nice that Seidelman remains loyal lightly to a happy and curious (post-) feminism. Against the backdrop of an all-Gaudi Barcelona, ??very touristy, but photogenic like only certain cities in our South.

title: Soul Survivors
actors: Casey Affleck, Wes Bentley, Melissa Sagemiller, Angela Featherstone, Eliza Dushku
description: Cassie, Sean and their friends Matt and Annabel are having a fight in the car. A moment of distraction is enough to cause an accident. Of the four he has the worst Sean who dies instantly. Matt, still shaken by the tragedy, gives up entering Harvard because he somehow feels guilty of his friend's death. Cassie is also very upset about what happened. The situation worsens when Sean begins to appear to him.
notes: Situations are often on the edge of ridicule, especially those that should focus more on suspense or even on metaphysical symbolism. And the coup de grace is the ending that provides the stupidest possible explanation for the mysteries that underpin the film.

title: The One
actors: Jet Li, Carla Gugino, Delroy Lindo, Jason Statham, Dylan Bruno
description: Police officer Yulaw is forced to engage in a truly relentless fight against another himself who lives in a parallel dimension. The policeman is determined to eliminate his double in order to take possession of his forces as well and thus become the absolute being. In fact, it is enough to interrupt the flow between the various doubles to assume a superhuman strength. Agents Roedecker and Funsch try to prevent this from happening.
notes: Directed by James Wong, director of "Final destination", here is a bland science fiction film starring Jet Li, a Chinese star who is sadly wasting his talent. The film does not even ensure the fun of the action scenes.

title: Supercolpo da 7 miliardi
actors: Brad Harris, Dana Andrews, Elina De Witt, Franco Andrei
description: Billionaire Kimmins hires Robert Colman, his trusted man, to transport a large diamond in the rough from Johannesburg to Europe. The man, however, is the victim of a fatal accident. In reality it is all a staging devised by Robert to get hold of the gem.
notes: Mediocre adventure film. Music by Nico Fidenco.

title: Comédie de l'innocence
actors: Isabelle Huppert, Nils Hugon, Jeanne Balibar, Charles Berling
description: While celebrating his nine years, Camille shows her parents the video camera images that Uncle Serge had given him the year before: a cat, a window, some shells, a slightly veiled female face ... park, his mother Ariane finds him strangely upset: now he says he wants to return to his "real home", to his "real mom" ...
notes: After having experimented with Proust, Ruiz adapts (with François Dumas) another novel of the early twentieth century, the one of the same name by Massimo Bontempelli: the theme, dear to the Chilean director, of the split identity finds a fascinating development, supported by a cast of great class.

title: È tornato Sabata... hai chiuso un'altra volta!
actors: Lee Van Cleef, Reiner Schone, Giampiero Albertini, Pedro Sanchez
description: The honest but naive citizens of Hobsonville had to swallow a big toad at the news that Joel McIntosh, the crafty Scotsman to whom they had entrusted their savings to rebuild the village, got away with the whole swag (one million dollars). in gold). But Sabata, already a major in the Southern army, is determined to seize the money and to this end he joins his former comrade, Lieutenant Clive McGregor, also relying on the help of a circus barker and two very skilled thieves ...
notes: Second film centered on the character of the gunslinger played by Van Cleef: useless to expect flashes of originality.

title: Lebenszeichen
actors: Peter Brogle, Wolfgang Reichmann, Athina Zacharopoulou
description: In 1942, the Cretan partisans attacked the German garrison: in the course of the action the soldier Stroszek was also wounded, who married the Greek Nora in the hospital. Time passes, and little by little the symptoms of insanity begin to manifest themselves in Stroszek ...
notes: Herzog's surprising feature debut.

title: Dog Star Man
description: Divided into a prologue and four parts, one of the countless "abstract / concrete" cinema essays made by the most reckless and incorruptible among the explorers of the Seventh Art. By Brakhage himself is the short that opens today's nocturnal film of "Fuoritempo": "The Act of Seeing with One's Own Eyes", shot in a morgue.

title: The Other Sister
actors: Juliette Lewis, Diane Keaton, Tom Skerritt, Giovanni Ribisi
description: Carla is a girl who has to deal with a slight mental retardation. Thanks to her enormous efforts and assiduous attendance at a specialized school she was able to learn to become more autonomous. His mother Elizabeth, who continues to have an overprotective attitude towards him, cannot accept that Carla has fallen in love with Danny, a boy afflicted with a mild mental handicap. Carla wants to prove to her mother that despite appearances she is confident enough to become a responsible adult.
notes: The director of "Pretty Woman" this time fails to be credible. Diane Keaton steals the show from Juliette Lewis.

title: L'attentatuni
actors: Veronica Pivetti, Massimo Popolizio, Tony Sperandeo, Claudio Amendola
description: Two officials (Anna Granata and Angelo Branca) and six agents (Orso, Sarno, Riccio, Lotto, Chiesa and Noce): these are the names of the members of the team that the commissioner Cardine, director of the newly established Dia, formed to penetrate the the heart of organized crime and bringing to justice the principals and perpetrators of the Capaci massacre of 23 May 1992, in which Judge Falcone with his wife and three members of the escort had lost his life. From now on, the six men will dedicate themselves exclusively, 24 hours a day, to their mission: and the results - despite a new blow: the attack on Borsellino - will not be long in coming ...

title: Chopper
actors: Eric Bana, Simon Lyndon, David Field, Vince Colosimo, Kate Beahan
description: From his earliest childhood, Australian Mark "Chopper" Read has dreamed of becoming a real tough guy, one of those whose feats fill the pages of "black" newspapers. Just sixteen, Mark attentive to the life of a judge, who comes out unharmed; locked up in a maximum security prison, despite his young age he soon assumed a dominant role among fellow prisoners.
notes: Inspired by real facts, it is the successful directorial debut of Andrew Dominik, future author of _The murder of Jesse James by the coward Robert Ford_.

title: Star Wars: Episode II - Attack of the Clones
actors: Ewan McGregor, Natalie Portman, Hayden Christensen
description: The Republic governed by Chancellor Palpatine entered a crisis due to the blockade in place on the planet Naboo by the Federation; a group of dissidents led by the Jedi Count Dooku express discontent with what is happening. Some members of the Senate demand that the Republic be provided with an army capable of dealing with the situation. Meanwhile, Amidala - who became a Senator and threatened by separatists - has escaped an attack: her protection is entrusted to Anakin Skywalker. In an attempt to discover the creators of the plot, Obi-Wan Kenobi learns of the existence of a mysterious army of clones ...
notes: For twenty-five years Lucas has been composing and retouching, narrating and integrating a saga that continues to transform the imaginary of viewers (even the most rebellious) with the most advanced research on production methods and technique, summarizing a common morphological heritage of fairy tales and the ancients stories with the seriality of the cinema of the origins and with the temporal explosion of television soaps, and then combining it all with the videogames and role-playing games that it helped to generate. The visual device does not crush psychologies. In a saga - it has been ascertained - psychology is behaviorist and not cognitivist, and the most devoted spectators look after the symphonic development of the story and the novelistic sutures.

title: Big Trouble
actors: Tim Allen, Omar Epps, Dennis Farina, Ben Foster, Janeane Garofalo, Tom Sizemore, Johnny Knoxville, Rene Russo, Stanley Tucci, Jack Kehler
description: Two New Jersey hitmen arrive in Miami to take out businessman Arthur Herk. As it happens, the teenager Matt is also headed to their victim's house while playing a school game that involves the "elimination" of Arthur's daughter. The situation becomes complicated when Matt's father, a former journalist, Arthur's bored wife, two very confused policemen also appear at the scene. Everything revolves around a stolen briefcase that contains a nuclear device.
notes: Comedy with too many pseudo-characters, farcical situations that are disconnected and poorly recorded, reckless plot accelerations and not very funny inconsistencies.

title: Sei come sei
actors: Ennio Fantastichini, Luca Zingaretti, Lucia Poli, Ivano Marescotti
description: The six episodes of this film are the result of the winning scripts of a competition, organized by Cinecittà international, for digital short films. The events are ironic and paradoxical, with an inclination to the fantastic: a thief is mistaken for a soul mate by the girl he is supposed to rob; a man makes up terrible stories about a house to dissuade a buyer; a death row inmate invents a time machine; a woman prostitutes herself while her man waits outside. Choosing the projects on the basis of the script it was perhaps inevitable that six jokes would come out: a short is more often governed by a visual idea than by a narrative. But the meaning of the operation was more technical-promotional (experimenting with the possibilities of new technologies) than aesthetic (the discovery of new talents, which cannot be glimpsed here). The digital, seen in the cinema, has a surprising yield (the film is almost entirely indoors, often very dark). Among various talkative, predictable episodes, with actors without reins, the best is perhaps "Diana's smile", in which at least Anita Caprioli's body is observed with a certain sensuality, an impossible object of the desire of a spider wandering around the room. to the sound of Bennato.

title: La fidélité
actors: Sophie Marceau, Pascal Greggory, Guillaume Canet, Magali Noël
description: To renew the image of his publishing group, Lucien Macroi, the great Canadian magnate of tabloid newspapers, hires Clelia, a young and capable photographer. Clève, an honest editor who pays attention to the literary quality of her editions, falls in love with her. The woman, attracted by his way of doing, agrees to marry him. But one day Clelia meets Nemo, a photographer, who attracts her attention.
notes: The film, based on "La princesse de Clèves", is constantly on the verge of getting lost in chaos. Zulawski chases the ghost of his first cinema, is enticed by exaggerations, irritates, convinces, loses the thread. He intends to uncover something about the shadows and the body of his wife-actress and makes her uncomfortable.

title: Die Stille nach dem Schuss
actors: Bibiana Beglau, Nadja Uhl, Alexander Beyer, Harald Schrott
description: When Rita, a terrorist belonging to the RAF, realizes the failure of the armed struggle, she is forced to go underground. The woman takes refuge in East Germany where the Stasi gives her a new identity. From now on she will be known by all as the worker Susanna Schmidt. From this moment on, a troubled period of continuous changes of residence and identity will begin for the former terrorist.
notes: The director does not assign himself the role of judge, but through a true-fictional story he shows the crumbling of a blood-red utopia and the profound contradictions of those who helped to create it.
