The taste that remains in the viewer is the bitter one of discovering that all that remains of those events is a pile of lives thrown in the garbage; first of all those of the victims of terrorism and then also those of the executioners, lives in disarray exploited by the secret services of half the world and deep down they too imbued them with that bourgeois and imperialist morality against which they believed they were fighting. It is an intense and disarming film, with the leaden color of those years and which draws a distressing portrait of life in the East where suspicion and betrayal were the daily bread of a gray life in which the maximum fun was a trip out of town with a Trabant. A film embellished by the quality of the cast that obtained the Silver Bear in Berlin in 2000, awarded ex aequo to Bibiana Beglau and Nadja Uhl.

title: Death to Smoochy
actors: Danny DeVito, Robin Williams, Edward Norton, Catherine Keener
description: In the merciless world of "Rainbow" children's television, Randolph, a corrupt star of a popular children's program, is fired due to a scandal and replaced by Sheldon. He plays Smoochy, a plump puppet who looks like a pink rhino. When Smoochy reaches fame and conquers his former flame, Randolph tries in every way to take revenge on him to win back his audience.
notes: It is a film that is out of the chorus, insane and bad, which makes fun of the world of "Children's TV", where monsters greedy for money and power can hide behind the consoling and good faces of the conductors.

title: Edges of the Lord
actors: Haley Joel Osment, Willem Dafoe, Liam Hess, Richard Banel
description: In Nazi-occupied Poland, 12-year-old Jewish Romek takes refuge with a Catholic family to escape persecution. The boy meets an eccentric but understanding priest who leads the community of Jewish children through a series of events that are sometimes comical and sometimes dramatic. When someone begins to suspect him, it will be the priest who will teach him a little catechism while respecting his religious diversity.
notes: Six decades have passed since the horror of the war in the heart of Europe and the horror of the Holocaust, and cinema in recent years has shown that it does not want to forget. "Life is beautiful", "Train de vie" and the underrated "The island in the street of the birds" are now joined by "The last train", a film directed by Yurek Bogayevic who returned to his Poland from Hollywood to make this testimony against horror. The terror of being discovered, the trains loaded with deportees sent to the extermination camps, the misunderstandings between Catholics and Jews, the cruelties of the Nazi invader, life in the countryside, the relationship with a Catholic priest and children of his age, are events filtered through Romek's eye, interpreted by Haley Joel Osment, which gives the viewer emotion and pain.

title: The Face of Fu Manchu
actors: James Robertson Justice, Christopher Lee, Nigel Green, Tsai Chin
description: Despite witnessing the execution of Fu Manchu, head of the infamous Tiger Sect, former Scotland Yard inspector Sir Nayland Smith is convinced that the dangerous criminal is still alive and well. In fact, Fu Manchu escaped death by being replaced by a double and relocated his headquarters on the Thames. He kidnaps Professor Müller, a biochemist, and forces him to distil a powerful poison from the black poppy. It will be up to Sir Nayland to try to prevent the almond-eyed thug from bringing London to its knees.
notes: Of the films in which Lee plays Fu Manchu, this is certainly the best.

title: L'erba proibita
description: In the subtitle, the numerous accomplices of this incredible editing work train (i) anus before shooting all the rods in the world: "Everything you ever wanted to know about hemp and they never told you". Well said. Why: did you know that in the States in the 1930s they were showing insane propaganda films against the use of marijuana? And that, after the end of the second conflict, the seven sisters of oil declared war on hemp used as an ecological fuel? And that Italy, until the 1950s, was the second country in the world in the cultivation of the same? And that, again with hemp, ropes, nets, paper and various oils are obtained? These and other answers are delightfully reported in the fun, very upbeat, punctual, political and scientifically "tested" docufilm.

title: Abuso di potere
actors: Frederick Stafford, Umberto Orsini, Claudio Gora, Franco Fabrizi
description: The journalist Enrico Gagliardi is murdered in Palermo; Luca Miceli, a commissioner accustomed to using brisk manners, is called to conduct the investigation. Twenty-four hours after the deadly ambush, thanks to an anonymous phone call, Miceli finds the alleged murderer in his hands: his confession and the motive for the crime, however, do not fully convince Luca, who decides to continue the investigations. Pretending to play the game of Lola, an acquaintance of Gagliardi, Miceli manages to discover the culprit.
notes: Full-blown Serie B, fourth direction by the cinematographer of "Speriamo che è female" and "Cuori al verde".

title: Raw Wind in Eden
actors: Esther Williams, Jeff Chandler, Rossana Podestà, Eduardo De Filippo
description: The model Laura and her boyfriend Wally, US citizens, are forced to land with their small airplane on an islet on the Sardinian coast. Here they meet three strange characters: the beautiful Costanza Varno, her father Urbano and Moore, another American, betrothed to Costanza. Needless to say, the presence of the two guests from overseas triggers a series of sentimental triangles ...
notes: Williams, diva of aquatic cinema, is the star of this certainly not memorable film, full of that exoticism so dear to the Yankee public. The Podestà was dazzling, Eduardo's participation was absolutely routine.

title: Switching Goals
actors: Mary-Kate Olsen, Ashley Olsen, Eric Lutes, Kathryn Greenwood
description: Despite being virtually indistinguishable, Sam and Emma Stanton couldn't be more different: the former is the classic "super athlete", while the latter thinks nothing but fashion. But dad Jerry's football passion will soon involve them (together with their mum Denise) in a challenge based on goals and ... identity exchanges.

title: L'età di Cosimo de' Medici
actors: Marcello Di Falco, John Stacy, Mario Erpichini, Virginio Gazzolo
description: There are three stages that Roberto Rossellini identifies as fundamental in the representation of an age full of cognitive anxieties and crossed by even contradictory thrusts. The first, which corresponds to the first episode of the long work made for Italian television, is entitled _L'exilio di Cosimo_. The second, _The power of Cosimo_, describes the coming to power of the Florentine nobleman Medici and the beginning of a new era, flourishing also from a cultural and artistic point of view. The third, _Leon Battista Alberti_, analyzes the role of the artist and intellectual against the historical background dominated by the figure of Cosimo.
notes: Rossellini continues his research which is both cognitive and experimental.

title: Cartesius
actors: Renato Montalbano, Claude Berthy, Ugo Cardea, Anne Pouchie
description: Another history lesson from the director of "Paisà". In 1614, René Descartes finished his mathematics studies and on those models he laid the foundations of a speculative method - both philosophical and scientific - capable of rationally justifying the presence of man in the world, through the "ontological" demonstration of existence of God.

title: K-911
actors: James Belushi, Christine Tucci, James Handy, Wade Williams
description: After ten years of service, it is time for four-legged cop Jerry Lee to retire. A decision that is not convinced by his "partner" Dooly, who tries to keep him in service. after an action gone wrong, however, Dooly realizes that the dog is no longer awake as it used to be and risks endangering his life and that of other policemen. Things don't change much when she finds out that her new partner is a young Doberman, who will also have to take the time to train. But after the first few days, a great harmony arises between the two ...

title: Il mio viaggio in Italia
description: Scorsese pays homage to a cinematography that, since his adolescence, he has learned to love and to know. Watching Italian films on television with his grandparents, parents and brother, the young Martin has elaborated a good part of the imagery that will characterize his future works. The film - which opens and closes with images of "Paisà" - reviews about 130 titles including, among others, milestones such as "Cabiria", "1860", "La corona di ferro", "Ossessione", "Senso", "Italian divorce" and many other unforgettable masterpieces.
notes: Presented out of competition at the Venice exhibition in 1999.

title: Wild Bill
actors: Jeff Bridges, Ellen Barkin, David Arquette, John Hurt, Diane Lane, Keith Carradine
description: The famous James Butler Hickok, known throughout the West as "Wild Bill", has to face an unexpected cat to peel: in fact, the young Jack McCall, who has sworn to kill him to wash the shame suffered, has set himself on his trail by his mother Susannah. The woman's life had been destroyed after Bill's abandonment, and Jack intends to do justice: the hero's descending parable and his passion for opium could facilitate the aspiring avenger's task ...
notes: After "Geronimo", Hill remains close to the myths of the Frontier addressing them with a vaguely "seventies" look, abounding in flashbacks and nostalgic notations.

title: Not Another Teen Movie
actors: Chyler Leigh, Chris Evans, Jaime Pressly, Mia Kirshner, Randy Quaid
description: Janey Briggs is an aspiring artist who is marginalized by her classmates only because she wears glasses and because she insists on wearing her eternally stained dungarees. Jake Wyler on the other hand is an athletic and beloved student from all over the college. The trouble begins when Jake takes a wager to make the unpopular Janey prom queen.
notes: As is usually the case in this genre of films, if there are not a couple of exquisite cameos, the director is not happy. This time it happens to Mr. T and Molly Ringwald "Bella in rosa", who is entrusted with the punchline. "Porky's" in memory assumes Lübitschian statute.

title: Waking Life
actors: Wiley Wiggins, Ethan Hawke, Julie Delpy, Steven Soderbergh
description: Arriving in a city that could be Austin, Wiley comes into contact with various people who tackle issues related to life, poetry and freedom together with him. The boy doubts that the world he is dealing with is not real and that it is only a dream. The question therefore arises: "Are we the ones wandering asleep in our waking state, or do we go through our dreams while awake?" ...
notes: According to Linklater, historically his would be the first animated feature film made in the United States by an independent production. Perhaps it is true, perhaps not: in any case, once the undeniable defects have been corrected, the use of an unusual and poor technique appears to be very interesting, which preserves the humanity of the characters rather than pushing it to the extreme "realistic" consequences of the virtual. An "adult" cartoon, but also a horizontal overview of individuals and cultural stereotypes.

title: The Quickie
actors: Vladimir Mashkov, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Jsu Garcia, Dean Stockwell
description: Oleg boss of the Russian mafia keeps his family and friends with his shady business even if his financial situation worsens day by day. During a party in a Malibu villa, he announces to everyone that he has made the decision to change his life. The next day, at the head of a pest control team, Lisa arrives, a seductive girl who makes him a proposal.

title: The Mothman Prophecies
actors: Richard Gere, Laura Linney, Will Patton, Alan Bates, Lucinda Jenney
description: To John Klein, reporter for the "Washington Post", his wife Mary confesses on her deathbed that she has seen a strange being. Two years later, the same creature appears to some residents of Port Pleasant, Virginia, who lose their lives due to the horrific experience. In a short time the visions follow one another and the corpses increase. Before dying, the victims describe the characteristics of the specter: it has a chilling gaze and huge wings. Helped by a police officer, John begins to investigate ...
notes: The Arlington Road director directs this good supernatural thriller, inspired by real events that took place in 1967 and culminated in a catastrophe.

title: Mean Machine
actors: Vinnie Jones, David Hemmings, Jason Statham, Danny Dyer
description: Danny, an old footballing glory known to all by the nickname "Mean Machine", is in prison for selling a game. Unable to give up the sport that had given him sporting glory, he is forced by the prison director to coach a football team. His men will have to be able to face the fierce team of guards.
notes: The film has very little to do with _The Dirty Last Half_ of which it is the remake. We are rather from the parts of certain English cinema from export packaging. Even the script and the actors, who usually make the strength of these films, are less and less effective.

title: The Third Wheel
actors: Denise Richards, Luke Wilson, Ben Affleck, Matt Damon, Jay Lacopo
description: After three years of not dating a girl, Stanley seems to have lost even his last hope. Then one day his friend Michael cheers him up by introducing Diana: beautiful, intelligent and recently single again. Stanley hesitates a lot, but then throws himself in and gets a date. The fateful evening, however, an unexpected happens: Stanley runs over Phil, a homeless man who, having emerged without damage from the impact, insinuates himself into the menage between the two ...
notes: Brady's film mixes tasty gags with far more boring moments. Wilson is not convincing as in _The Tenenbaums_, Affleck and Damon only make an appearance; on the other hand Denise Richards is always a pretty sight.

title: Respiro
actors: Valeria Golino, Vincenzo Amato, Francesco Casisa, Veronica D'Agostino, Filippo Pucillo, Elio Germano
description: Lampedusa Island. Pasquale, known as Boccanera, is a thirteen year old who loves to spend time hunting birds with a sling, clashing with rival gangs and wheeling his Vespa to impress girls. Boccanera has only one person to whom he must be accountable: his father Pietro. Yes, because his mother Grazia is the shame of the family, a woman considered by all to be an extravagant girl. When Pietro wants to have her hospitalized in Milan, Boccanera decides to hide her in a cave, making everyone believe that she is dead.
notes: Emanuele Crialese's second feature film, awarded in the Semaine de la critique at the Cannes Film Festival, struggles with the aesthetics of Tornatore and Aurelio Grimaldi and with the incommunicability of Antonioni from _L'avventura_ without inferiority complexes. His pride is all Sicilian. So that the strength of his intense, at times beautiful film, seems to come precisely from that sea where, in the end, the protagonists of his story go to dive and take refuge.

title: Irréversible
actors: Monica Bellucci, Vincent Cassel, Albert Dupontel, Philippe Nahon
description: Alex is raped and beaten to death by a stranger in a subway underpass. His current partner Marcus and his former friend Pierre decide to take revenge on the man responsible for the barbarism suffered by the woman.
notes: The director is obsessed with the violence and horror of life and portrays them with unconscious cruelty: his camera searches through the most "private" ravines, it does not stand still, always in search of the "non-showable". But if the crudeness bordering on immorality of his first film (_Seul contre tous_) was justified by the objective cruelty of the protagonist's life, the violence of Irréversible seems an end in itself.

title: Angela
actors: Donatella Finocchiaro, Andrea Di Stefano, Mario Pupella, Erasmo Lobello
description: Angela was born in Ballarò, the market district of Palermo. At the age of twenty she married Saro and shared with him a life of illicit trafficking (drugs) and far too easy income. One day she meets Masino, whom she believes to be a cop and over time has become Saro's right arm: it is the beginning of an impulsive and risky love ...
notes: Tinted with noir, romantically torn in his desire to reveal what, probably, it is not possible (re) to bring to light the inimitable sun of Sicily, the third film of the Tower accompanies the spectators in claustrophobic corners and spaces, in silent meanders and yet burning with passion.

title: N'Gopp
actors: Luigi Biondi, Elena Russo, Duccio Giordano, Giovanni Allocca
description: Jerry is a disk-jockey who works in a Neapolitan radio. There is a fact that shocks him: Shawndra his girlfriend has decided that he will do anything to get married. Jerry just doesn't want to know about getting married and ends up being left. The two ex-boyfriends with their respective new companions meet again at the opening party of a jewelry store. But Shawndra's new boyfriend has agreed to accompany her to prepare for a big shot.
notes: Sort of "wedding video" that doesn't even deserve a proper review. Unbearable or ridiculous characters and plot below guard level. Do you need to add anything else?

title: Postmortem
actors: Charlie Sheen, Michael Halsey, Ivana Milicevic, Stephen McCole
description: The only thing James wants to do is stay away from Scotland. But one day he receives a fax from that place showing the image of a corpse. The next day the man is charged with murder and placed under arrest. Proving one's innocence will be a difficult undertaking.

title: Beat the Devil
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Gina Lollobrigida, Jennifer Jones, Edward Underwood
description: While waiting to embark for Africa to get their hands on a uranium field, Billy Dannreuther and his wife Maria meet Harry and Gwendolyn Chelm. During the crossing some quarrels break out between Billy's men and Harry who, having learned of their criminal plans, threatens to report them; the decision does not change despite Maria, who fell in love with him, tries to dissuade him ...
notes: The film, improvised day after day according to what Huston himself claimed, had an unhappy commercial destiny. There is no shortage, however, full of subtle humor. The dialogues are by Truman Capote.

title: Little Boy Blue
actors: Ryan Phillippe, Nastassja Kinski, John Savage, Shirley Knight
description: Returning from Vietnam with a troubled psyche, Ray West forces the entire family, who lives in a small rural village in Texas, to bear the consequences: the younger children Mikey and Mark are terrified, while his wife Kate has to bend over - as well as to brutalizations and beatings - to humiliating incestuous relationships with the eldest son, the nearly 20-year-old Jimmy. The latter, fearing that the situation could degenerate, also gives up attending college in the city; the mysterious death of a stranger, however, will precipitate events ...
notes: Third directorial test of the Italian Tibaldi, a little over the top but saved by a discreet cast.

title: Signore & signori
actors: Virna Lisi, Gastone Moschin, Nora Ricci, Alberto Lionello, Olga Villi
description: Divided into three episodes. Four bullocks are accused of having pregnant a minor: the process will be silenced with the help of the religious authorities of the country. At a party, a man manages to seduce a friend's wife into believing he is suffering from impotence. The clandestine love between a married man and a young cashier will be cut off to safeguard the marital union.
notes: Germi tells the life of a small town in the Venetian province from the point of view of the "square" where the provincial community, mean, hypocritical and Catholic, keeps under surveillance anyone who dares to go against the unspoken rules of the right-thinking people. Really bad and lashing Italian comedy: one of Germi's best films. Screenplay by Vincenzoni, Age, Scarpelli and Flaiano.

title: Navigating the Heart
actors: Jaclyn Smith, Tim Matheson, David Andrews, Tantoo Cardinal
description: Edith Iglauer, a sophisticated journalist from New York, reaches the coasts of British Columbia in order to write an article on fishing. Arriving on the spot she meets John Daly, a silent and lonely fisherman: the two discover that they are in love when they manage to escape a dangerous situation.

title: Passport to Paris
actors: Mary-Kate Olsen, Ashley Olsen, Peter White, Matt Winston
description: Little Melanie and Allyson Porter visit their grandfather Edward, the American ambassador to the Ville Lumière. The elderly official, who does not have much time to devote to his restless granddaughters, decides to organize a tour of the city: a young employee of the embassy is ready to accompany them, acting as their guide ...

title: Lilo & Stitch
description: Lilo, a Hawaiian girl, and an unidentified (has no origin or species) space animal meet: the creature - which has the name "Experiment 626", but everyone calls Stitch - is wanted for having escaped the Galactic Federation , it is programmed not to express emotions, it is endowed with an extraordinary strength and power and it has the mission to bring chaos wherever it is. Despite this, Lilo finds in him the ideal friend: the two will join forces to defend themselves from the evil of space ...
notes: Disney gives a jolt to the "sugary" vein and recovers the simple and defined graphic idea of ??_Bambi_ and _Dumbo_, that is, of the original season. The characters are no longer completely good or bad, they have character flaws and even family complications. In Lilo's naive and repetitive clinging to "ohana", a word that expresses the all-Hawaiian concept of a family in which no one is abandoned or left behind, there is a need to return to a world of affections that is able to take care of people as only a mother can do. When Stitch, tamed by Lilo's candor and the warmth of his family, says to those who are hunting him to bring him back to his planet: "This is my family ... it's small and wretched but beautiful, very beautiful", the miracle it is done. Perhaps the secret meaning of the film lies in this choice of love, enriched by Elvis' songs and a cloud of quotes that will make cinephiles happy.

title: State and Main
actors: Philip Seymour Hoffman, Alec Baldwin, Sarah Jessica Parker
description: A film crew leaves New Hampshire and moves to Waterford, a pretty town in Vermont. Reason: to make a film inspired by the story of an old mill. Too bad the building no longer exists, the director encounters all sorts of problems with the actors, the locals interfere with the work and the screenwriter has lost his typewriter ...
notes: Seventh film by Mamet (shot before _The shot_), declared satire of the entertainment world. As always, the director-playwright is better at writing than behind the camera. Here he tries to remake none other than Preston Sturges: you feel like ...

title: Lost and Delirious
actors: Mischa Barton, Piper Perabo, Jessica Paré, Jackie Burroughs
description: Mouse arrives at the Perkins girls' boarding school, where he shares a room with Pauline and Tori. All three share a complex relationship with the maternal figure: Mouse's mother is dead, Pauline - who has been adopted - is looking for her parent and Tori is distressed by the expectations of her own. When the relationship between Pauline and Tori comes to the surface, the reactions of their families put their friendship in crisis ...
notes: The fear of growing up and the sense of inadequacy for family expectations find a fair representation in this "feminine" film, stifled, however, by an excessive tendency to fashion.

title: Benzina
actors: Regina Orioli, Maya Sansa, Mariella Valentini, Pietro Ragusa
description: A special day for Eleonora called Lenni, a little disturbed, and Stella, a lesbian attendant. The mother of the first, having no news of her daughter, decides to visit her. It surprises them together, and the unpredictable happens. Thus began a nocturnal pilgrimage of love, landfills and motorway restaurants.
notes: Monica's debut Lisa Stambrini does not sting, does not download the violence and truth of Elena Stancanelli's book from which it is based. They do not convince Stella and Lenni as short stories Thelma and Louise - and the ending, which we obviously do not reveal, (does) say a lot ... -, nor do the urgencies that unleash hell seem credible.

title: Joy Ride
actors: Paul Walker, Leelee Sobieski, Steve Zahn, Jessica Bowman
description: During the summer vacation, student Lewis Thomas decides to drive from Colorado to New Jersey to see Venna, the girl of his dreams. But his older brother Fuller joins him, messing up his plans. A well-known pain in the ass, Fuller forces Lewis into a game: radio communication with an unidentified truck driver, who will soon turn out to be a serial killer ...
notes: A naked and raw "suspenser", which he takes with both hands from "The Hitcher" and "Duel" recovering an essential entertainment, far from vulgarities and offenses to reason and good taste. At the same time avoiding cracks in the rhythm and imbalances of tones.

title: Human Nature
actors: Patricia Arquette, Rhys Ifans, Tim Robbins, Stanley DeSantis
description: A somewhat odd scientist and a natural biologist make the discovery of the year: in a forest, a guy, more like a monkey than a man, comes into contact with Puff. The two lock him up in a laboratory and try to make him a civilized man. The feat is difficult to complete.
notes: Apparently thesis film, paradoxical, grotesque, conceived by Charlie Kaufman, screenwriter of _Essere John Malkovich_, who, after Spike Jonze, baptizes another big video clip director: Michel Gondry. A fascinating, albeit decidedly discontinuous, contemporary parable. The Kaufman-Gondry duo will do much better with the next _If you leave me I will cancel you_.

title: Someone Like You
actors: Ashley Judd, Greg Kinnear, Hugh Jackman, Marisa Tomei
description: To understand the reason for the crisis in her relationship with her boyfriend Ray, Jane accepts the court of Eddie, a fellow womanizer who invites her to share an apartment with him. Referring to the behavior of cows and bulls, the girl would like to study the lifestyle of the roommate to "psychoanalyze" the partner ...
notes: At the origin of this usual "boy meets girl" genre intertwining is a bizarre and amusing novel by Laura Zigman, which assimilates the love-sexual behavior of humans to that of cattle. The theory of the old cow is the pretext for curtains and an investigation-test on seduction in the third millennium.

title: Hart's War
actors: Bruce Willis, Colin Farrell, Cole Hauser, Linus Roache, Terrence DaShon Howard
description: 1945: Tommy W. Hart, a young lieutenant son of a father, arrives in a prison camp with the shame of having revealed to the Germans, under torture, the location of some important weapons depots in the Ardennes. After the murder of a cynical and racist American soldier, of whom the only black soldier in the camp is blamed, Hart gets a fair trial: his soon becomes a fight against the prejudices of his comrades and above all against the colonel McNamara, president of the impromptu court martial. However, Hart soon discovers that things are not that simple, and that the trial (the outcome of which seems obvious from the start, with the conviction of the black soldier) only serves to hide a collective evasion project ...
notes: The nicest thing about the film - taken from a novel by John Katzenbach - is that there are no "good guys": or rather, the only good ones are the principles of American heroism, which come out unscathed and corroborated by the dirty events of the war. The story is as tense as it is full of approximations and improbabilities, and after the first half hour of an exciting war movie, while not boring the public, the film follows the usual judicial lines, with rhetorical dialogues and telephone twists.

title: Charlotte Gray
actors: Cate Blanchett, Billy Crudup, Michael Gambon, Rupert Penry-Jones
description: During the Second World War, Charlotte Gray from Scotland moved to occupied France to join the Resistance. Her aim is to find her boyfriend, a RAF aviator, shot down and missing in Normandy ...
notes: The Australian director directs a war-themed mélo, based on a successful novel by Sebastian Faulks.

title: Kissing Jessica Stein
actors: Jennifer Westfeldt, Heather Juergensen, Tovah Feldshuh, Esther Wurmfeld
description: Jessica, a career girl, is a victim of that typically New York saying that affordable men are either married or gay. For this reason, despite the concerns of the very strict family, he enthusiastically throws himself into an affair with a woman, Helen ...
notes: Tenderness, embarrassments, long preliminary kisses, micro-catastrophes elaborated with lighthearted chatter and trendy caustics, the Jewish background: all ingredients present in Herman-Wurmfeld's film. Written for the theater by the two protagonists Jennifer Westfeldt and Heather Juergensen, on the big screen the script has found a chamber comedy panache.

title: The Salton Sea
actors: Val Kilmer, Peter Sarsgaard, Vincent D'Onofrio, Luis Guzmán
description: To discover his wife's murderer, jazz trumpeter Tom Van Allen decides to conduct an investigation into the city's slums alone. Change his identity, befriend a small underworld fish, Jimmy the Finn, and attract the attention of two cops who want to clean up the neighborhood.
notes: From a director pupil and collaborator of John Badham, an interesting thriller that draws here and there in the trendy cinema of the 90s. Among others he produces Frank Darabont (_The wings of freedom_, _The green mile_, _The Majestic_). Subject by Tony Gayton (_Formula per un delitto_).

title: Get Well Soon
actors: Courteney Cox, Vincent Gallo, Jeffrey Tambor, Max Weinberg
description: Bobby Bishop is the noisy star of a talk show of the night. He is very successful, he lives the life of a playboy, but he is clearly in a sentimental crisis. For this reason, at one point he freaks out and decides to return to New York. With the conviction that trying to recover the relationship with his ex, as well as what he considers the woman of his life, will bring him back to balance.
notes: A romantic comedy dragged by the stage presence of Vincent Gallo.

title: Drei Sterne
actors: Martina Gedeck, Sergio Castellitto, Maxime Foerste, August Zirner
description: A woman in one piece, Martha is in charge of a restaurant in Hamburg. His professional life is framed and smooth, like his private life. But one bad day his sister dies in an accident leaving an eight-year-old daughter to look after. And a new colleague, the Italian Mario, delivers the final blow to the sudden disorder that has taken over his existence.
notes: The newcomer Sandra Nettelbeck enters the "cooking and feelings" trend in a polite way and without flashes of originality. In the film the nostalgic smell of a Mediterranean sauté hovers and food is the usual raw material of seduction and melancholy.

title: Long Time Dead
actors: Lara Belmont, Lukas Haas, Joe Absolom, Melanie Gutteridge
description: A group of London students, during a kind of séance, evoke a demon from the past that manifests itself in the most classic of ways ("if you are there, beat it ..."). But the extrasensory adventure does not stop there: the demon, in fact, remains imprisoned in our world.
notes: The director, Marcus Adams, is making his debut, after having directed three short films and numerous commercials and video clips and demonstrates in each sequence that he has reviewed, on tape or DVD, the films of his colleagues. He studied ballet, but in this metaphysical horror there are no appreciable choreographic trajectories.

title: Repli-Kate
actors: James Roday, Ali Landry, Eugene Levy, Ryan Alosio, Todd Robert Anderson
description: Max, an established geneticist, has managed to create the first machine capable of cloning humans. To the scientist, who has always had big problems with women, it doesn't seem true that he accidentally reproduced Kate, a science journalist he is in love with. His dream of creating a woman who behaves like a man has finally come true: together with a friend of his, he begins to "educate" Kate to appreciate pizza, sport and beer. Soon, however, Max realizes that having a female at his side who mimics males is not exactly the best ...
notes: The film mixes old stuff with total superficiality.

title: Daddy and Them
actors: Billy Bob Thornton, Laura Dern, Kelly Preston, Diane Ladd
description: Claude and Ruby are one of those couples who are always in the balance between constant quarrel and passionate love. When news arrives that Uncle Hazel has been arrested, the two travel to the relative's residence in Little Rock to bring comfort to the relatives. Soon Claude and Ruby realize that everyone in the family says what they think and anything can happen.
notes: The reason why this messed up film is loved in spite of everything, is to find some of the merits of Thornton actor and character: the attention for a loser America, the painful sensuality and the cynical mask, in short, the lost Hemingway roots of the stars one time.

title: Corky Romano
actors: Chris Kattan, Vinessa Shaw, Peter Falk, Peter Berg, Chris Penn
description: The Romano mafia family is in trouble; the head of the family suffered a heart attack, and the FBI collected extensive evidence of their criminal activities. The only one is to infiltrate an undercover mole. And the only face unknown to the police is that of the family's black sheep, Corky, a clumsy veterinarian, who accepts only for the sake of his father. Poor Corky builds a reputation as a great detective against his will and gets involved in the investigation of a ferocious drug trafficker.
notes: The story is built with a series of little episodes stuck together, the latita rhythm, the gags and the jokes are stale to say the least. But the real crime is wasting people like Peter Falk and Chris Penn on blatant specks.

title: Socrate
actors: Jean Sylvère, Anne Caprile, Ricardo Palacios, Beppe Mannaiuolo
description: Lived between 469 and 399 BC, the Athenian philosopher (of whose thought there are no written testimonies) studied in particular the ethical and didactic dimension, passing through a human story - culminating in the trial for "corruption of youth" and the episode hemlock - which the film describes clearly and effectively.

title: Agostino d'Ippona
actors: Dary Berkani, Virgilio Gazzolo, Cesare Barbetti, Bruno Cattaneo
description: Born in modern-day Tunisia, Augustine (354-430) became bishop of Hippo in 395. Previously, after teaching rhetoric in Tagaste and Carthage, he was in Rome and Milan, where he converted to Christianity. In his works (especially in the "Confessions") a theological-philosophical reflection of exceptional analytical acuity takes shape.

title: Blaise Pascal
actors: Pierre Arditi, Giuseppe Addobbati, Rita Forzano, Anne Caprile
description: If the invention of the first calculating machine was dictated to Blaise Pascal (1623-1662) by the desire to help his father, his subsequent developments in mathematical and scientific studies alternated with philosophical and religious speculation, which resulted in a tormented adhesion to Jansenism and in the drafting of the famous "Thoughts".

title: Black Dog
actors: Patrick Swayze, Randy Travis, Meat Loaf, Gabriel Casseus
description: Truck driver Jack Crews, jailed for dozing off at the wheel and causing an accident, has returned home, but is so much in debt that he has to agree to drive an articulated truck again. When the truck is attacked by the men of Red's gang, Jack realizes he is carrying a load of weapons: to force him to deliver it, Red kidnaps his wife and daughter ...
notes: The title refers to a legend in vogue among American truck drivers: that of a black dog that causes disasters with its appearance. Chases and punches are wasted, but those looking for something more would be disappointed.

title: A Burning Passion: The Margaret Mitchell Story
actors: Shannen Doherty, Dale Midkiff, Matt Mulhern, John Clark Gable
description: The tormented life of writer Margaret Mitchell, raised in Atlanta by her grandmother who told her about the civil war from a southern perspective. After a brief stay in college, the woman returns home and begins a "scandalous" relationship with a petty thug. However, it will be her second husband to encourage her to write something more substantial than the articles for the "Atlanta Journal": the best-seller _Via con Vento_ which in 1937 won her the Pulitzer Prize. Two years later the eponymous and legendary film was made, produced by David O. Selznick and directed by Victor Fleming. Small role for John Clark Gable, son of the star.

title: Tuesdays with Morrie
actors: Jack Lemmon, Hank Azaria, Wendy Moniz, Caroline Aaron
description: Mitch Albom, a famous and fast-paced sports journalist, discovers that Morrie Schwartz, an old university professor of his, is suffering from an incurable disease. He decides to reconnect with the relationships interrupted for years and by going to see him every Tuesday he receives lessons from him on the meaning of life.

title: I colpevoli
actors: Isa Miranda, Carlo Ninchi, Vittorio De Sica, Sandro Ninchi
description: The attitude of Judge Valerio Rossello and his wife Lucia towards their only child Maurizio is very different: the father is inflexible, the mother more permissive. But when Maurizio finds himself in trouble with the law ...
notes: The theatrical matrix (the play "On the streets of the night" by Renato Lelli) is fully respected.

title: Die verlorene Ehre der Katharina Blum
actors: Angela Winkler, Dieter Laser, Mario Adorf, Heinz Bennent, Margarethe Von Trotta
description: The young waitress Katharina meets Ludwig, with whom she triggers a mutual and fulminating attraction. But in the aftermath of a night spent together, the police break into her apartment in search of the man accused of terrorism. Not finding him, the agents arrest Katharina and humiliate her mercilessly; as if that weren't enough, a reporter will drag her further into the mud. The girl's reaction will be both lucid and desperate.
notes: The two directors, married at the time, adapt Heinrich Böll's novel by exposing the bad petty-bourgeois conscience and the tabloid vampirism of the media in "pacified" social democratic Germany.

title: Billboard Dad
actors: Mary-Kate Olsen, Ashley Olsen, Tom Amandes, Jessica Tuck
description: Twelve-year-old twins Tess and Emily Tyler are convinced that, a few years after their mother's death, the time has come for their beloved father Maxwell, a successful artist, to meet a new person. To help him they place an ad, which soon goes to fruition; but Maxwell's agent has something against it ...

title: Ruby Bridges
actors: Chaz Monet, Penelope Ann Miller, Kevin Pollak, Michael Beach
description: While the Beatles drove London crazy in New Orleans, Ruby Bridges fought her own fight against racism. For two years the little girl waited for her white companions to resume their places at her side in the classroom.
notes: The director continues her fight against all kinds of discrimination.

title: My Life So Far
actors: Rosemary Harris, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Colin Firth, Malcolm McDowell, Irène Jacob, Robert Norman
description: Scotland, 1920s: at Harewood House, a castle in the Highlands, lives the matriarch Gamma with her daughter Moira, her son-in-law Edward (an eccentric inventor who trades with prototypes of cars and planes) and her grandchildren Fraser and Elspeth. One day Morris, Moira's brother, comes to visit the manor, accompanied by the beautiful and sophisticated French girlfriend Heloise. The charm of the newcomer will not fail to leave its mark, disturbing Fraser's imagination, Edward's heart and family harmony.
notes: Based on the childhood memories of Denis Forman, one of the pioneers of British TV, who in the film is "represented" by little Fraser.

title: Atti degli apostoli
actors: Edoardo Torricella, Renzo Rossi, Jacques Dumur
description: Six-part program, produced by Rai. First the figure of Peter emerges, who after the death of the Messiah takes it upon himself to give cohesion to the nascent Christian community; it is then the turn of Paul, with the episodes of conversion and baptism, of the Council of Jerusalem and of the journeys through which he will carry out his evangelizing mission.

title: Kedma
actors: Andrei Kashkar, Helena Yaralova, Moni Moshonov, Yaël Abecassis
description: May 1948 on the eve of the creation of the state of Israel. Fights between Jews and Arabs have raged in Plalestina for several months. An old rusted cargo ship, the Kedma, sails on the open sea. There are hundreds of Holocaust survivors on board. Between fragments of memories and murmured songs the boat approaches the coast. Refugees are preparing to experience enormous difficulties.
notes: The author's intent is lucid; pity that the geometry of the assumption makes the narrative structure a bit mechanical. "Kedma" is a film that proclaims itself "author" from the first scene, which exhibits its own metaphor and message, at the expense of the heat that circulated in "Kippur" and "Kadosh".

title: Samsara
actors: Shawn Ku, Sherab Sangey, Christy Chung, Tenzin Tashi
description: A caravan of llamas led by Apo, an old and wise monk accompanied by a younger monk Sonam makes a journey through the mountains in search of Tashi, a brilliant disciple. The boy is about to complete a three-year solitary meditation. Awakened from a long trance, the aspiring monk finds himself experiencing a surprising and intense sexual awakening.
notes: Filmed in Ladakh, on the heights of the Himalayas, one of the most isolated regions of India, this first feature film by Pan Nalin, starring non-professional actors, mesmerizes the gaze with the intensity of flagrance. Of the interpreters and the landscape. Tashi's moral parable, undecided between the transcendental rigor and the confusion of the immanent, has the true and domesticated scent of the cinematic elsewhere. The chromatic purity of the shots, the intense and ecstatic feeling of the fields, streams, mountains, wind, clouds, clothes hung out to dry and pagan costumes pledge to the past in the documentary (Bbc, Discovery, National Geografic ) of the director. The film moves, with some mannered slowness and some drop in rhythm, between the aestheticism of a "blue planet" and the Zen spiritualism version of the new age: Nalin rightly defined his style as "Zenematography". Asking oneself, while watching the beautiful love scenes, whether it is more right to run after thousands of desires or to conquer one and only one, is a dilemma shared with those who live in the faded metropolis.

title: Spider-Man
actors: Tobey Maguire, Willem Dafoe, Kirsten Dunst, James Franco
description: Orphaned at an early age, shy (especially with Mary Jane Watson, the beautiful neighbor he had a soft spot for as a child) and a little messed up, Peter Parker grew up in Queens with Aunt May and Uncle Ben, who they want a world of good and to which he is very attached. One day, while witnessing a scientific demonstration on arachnids with his class, Peter is bitten by a genetically modified spider. He soon realizes that he has acquired strange powers that will transform him into Spider-Man, executioner-mutant: initially he uses his new appearance to sell the exclusive photos of the exploits of the "Wall Climb" to the local newspaper; then engages in a no-holds-barred battle with the evil Green Goblin aka Norman Osborn, scientist, businessman and father of his best friend Harry. And the belief in his mission is strengthened when Uncle Ben dies at the hands of a thug who had managed to escape him ...
notes: In the dialectical axis (superheroes with super problems) dear to Stan Lee, the creator - together with Steve Ditko - of Spider-Man, screenwriter David Koepp and Raimi insist on the revenge of the "nerd" Peter Parker and on his "castrating" feelings of guilt ". Although involved in a multi-million-dollar superproduction with a high rate of special effects, the director of _La casa_, _Ready to die_, Darkman_ and _Soldi dirty_ retains a "touch" and originality that confirm him as one of the most interesting authors expressed by American cinema in the last decades.

title: Quello che cerchi
actors: Marcello Mazzarella, Antal Nagy, Stefania Orsola Garello
description: A private detective finds himself having to investigate a teenager who spends his time between one community center and another. Davide, as the boy is called, could be the result of a relationship that the investigator had with a former flame. Only Michèle, Davide's mother could shed light on the question and on Impero's desire for paternity.
notes: Despite having won prizes in Courmayeur, Lecce, and Los Angeles, the film is a pretentious operina, shot in a video clip style, which cannot redeem itself even through the acting of its protagonist. The director tries to mess up the cards a bit to hide an obvious bewilderment.

title: Out Cold
actors: Jason London, Flex Alexander, Derek  Hamilton, Zach Galifianakis
description: Bull Mountain, Alaska: Rick, Luke, Anthony and Pig Pen's life is all about the ski board. But something is upsetting their dreams: Ted Muntz, owner of a snowboard park, plans to sell everything to John Majors, a businessman from Colorado. He intends to transform the area into an immense and well-equipped ski slope: the gang will try to hinder his project ...
notes: Impossible loves, possible loves, daughters in first and second bed, quotes from famous idiotic classics, try to enrich a boring story, which is not much more useful than the acrobatic snowboard scenes.

title: No desearás al vecino del quinto
actors: Jean Sorel, Ira Fürstenberg, Annabella Incontrera, Alfredo Landa
description: The charming Piero carries out his profession as a gynecologist with difficulty in that of Toledo, as, due to his charm, the male fellow citizens do not trust him to entrust their wives to him. A completely different fate for the tailor Sergej considered by all to be a homosexual. In reality the man is an exuberant Don Juan who uses his fame as a cover and thus has a free field with women.
notes: A very low profile "fair of ambiguities" to which the dialogues in Italian, with dialectal inflections, by co-screenwriter Sandro Continenza also contribute: Jean Sorel is given a Milanese accent and the Fürstenberg one from Rome. Piero Umiliani's music remains in the background.

title: Cabiria
actors: Umbero Mozzato, Lydia Quaranta, Bartolomeo Pagano, Italia Almirante Manzini
description: Little Cabiria, daughter of a rich Roman from Catania, escapes the eruption of Etna but is taken prisoner by Phoenician pirates and taken to Carthage, where she is destined to be immolated to the god Moloch along with one hundred other children. Saved by Maciste, slave of the noble Fulvio Axilla, she ends up in the court of Queen Sofonisba: however, she will experience new dangers and adventures, crossing her personal story with that of ancient Rome.
notes: Considered as the second Kolossal in history after Quo vadis ?, it was made with great display of means and with innovative technical solutions, being the first to succeed in the aim of bringing together the spectacular needs of popular cinema with the narrative needs of the highest culture. He saw the participation in the screenplay by Gabriele d'Annunzio, who composed the courtly captions that intersperse the film: a presence that further contributed to clearing the early cinema as an art form among the elites.

title: Paris s'éveille
actors: Judith Godrèche, Jean-Pierre Léaud, Thomas Langmann, Antoine Basler
description: Adrien, a 19-year-old in disarray, returned to Paris is received by the reproaches of his father Clement, who has just come out of a quarrel with his mistress Louise, a capricious and stubborn eighteen-year-old. At first indifferent, Adrien is soon seized by a strong passion for the same age.
notes: Assayas has a dangerous project, that of representing emblematic figures of a bewildered post-adolescent generation. Dangerous because it risks schematisms and clichés. On his side, however, he has a "critical" participation. He never winks at the viewer but manages to make the vision, and its history, always problematic.

title: Dangerous Child
actors: Delta Burke, Ryan Merriman, Marc Donato, Barclay Hope
description: Divorced from her husband, and consequently left alone to face the arduous task of raising her two children, Sally Cambridge encounters the greatest difficulties with Jack, the eldest, with whom she clashes several times. In fact, in the boy there is a charge of repressed violence that makes it almost impossible to communicate with him. One day, however, a serious event occurs: the younger brother is rushed to hospital after being beaten, and the investigations lead at first to suspect Sally herself, in what has all the appearances of a classic. case of domestic violence. But the reality is another ...

title: Daughters
actors: Roxanne Hart, Holly Marie Combs, James Wilder, Sarah Chalke
description: Anne is left a widow, the only heir to an immense fortune. She is beautiful, rich, and alone. It doesn't take long to find herself surrounded by suitors. She falls in love with the younger, a charming but shady boy who pretends to be interested in her and instead plans to marry her and then kill her.
notes: Television film inspired by the chronicle of the Anne Scripps Douglas case, heiress killed by her second husband.

title: Trapped: Beneath the Snow
actors: Gabrielle Carteris, Janet Borgman, Jack Wagner, John J. Fleming
description: In a quiet mountain town, a tremendous roar announces the sudden fall of a huge avalanche. An entire family finds themselves buried alive under the snow. Could the courage of two parents save everyone before it's too late?
notes: Disaster-movie that takes up the suggestions of a classic of the catastrophic ("Avalanche") and develops them without originality.

title: Girl from Rio
actors: Hugh Laurie, Lia Williams, Patrick Barlow, Vanessa Nunes
description: Christmas' Eve. Raymond, a banker with a passion for samba, discovers that his wife is cheating on him with his stern office manager. Left alone in the office he decides to take revenge. He robs the bank he works for and takes the first plane to Rio. In Brazil he hopes to find the woman of his dreams, the beautiful dancer who appeared on the cover of "Samba Monthly". And coincidentally, he meets her in Rio, but from that moment on, trouble starts for him.
notes: "La ragazza di Rio" is a film that betrays, has a good start, makes alluring promises, then sadly declines at the most beautiful. The Brazilian part offered extraordinary ideas, but all this was not collected, preferring to move towards a sterile sketch.

title: Ni neibian jidian
actors: Lee Kang-sheng, Chen Shiang-chyi, Jean-Pierre Léaud, Tien Miao
description: Hsiao-kang sells watches on the streets of Taipei. A few days after his father's death he meets the young Shiang-chyi, who is about to leave for Paris; Hsiao-kang, obsessed with his mother waiting for the return of her husband's spirit, lives in the memory of the girl and consequently adjusts all her watches to the time of the French capital. Meanwhile, in Europe, Shiang-chyi seems to be experiencing facts mysteriously connected to Hsiao-kang ...
notes: The film is a transversal homage to "The four hundred shots" said the author (who in fact has the protagonist buy a cassette of Truffaut's film, who watches it at night, and then, in Paris, makes Jean meet the girl -Pierre Léaud) and is a pointed and sympathetic description of a youth that is anything but disbanded, but certainly afflicted. Laconic as always, Tsai Ming-liang crosses the solitudes of his characters without ever letting them communicate, outlining minimal (and very credible) existences more through the details of surreal behaviors than through strong moments. The traumatic event has already happened, what remains are the absurd palliatives that fill the void. Built on a linear and impeccable time, on the flat succession of moments only apparently always the same, where the high pitches of solitary suffering gush out like a natural flow, "What time is it over there?" he is illuminated by an instinctive humor and an affectionate understanding for a world that appears to be made up of separate entities, but where Paris and Taipei are much closer than they seem.

title: La regina degli scacchi
actors: Barbora Bobulova, Ettore Bassi, Toni Bertorelli, Massimo De Rossi
description: Maria Adele, a talented young chess player who lives in Ancona with her father, has recently lost her mother in an accident. During a chess match she meets Emilio sports reporter who asks her for an interview. While rummaging in a trunk to look for a photo to give to the journalist, Maria discovers a letter addressed to her mother, in which the father says he is willing to adopt a son. The thought of having been adopted makes its way into the mind of the girl who begins to investigate.
notes: The third work by Claudia Florio has the soporific rhythms and the mechanical direction of a film for TV and the luxury packaging fails to revive the operation, sunk by a listless direction of actors.

title: 24 Hour Party People
actors: Shirley Henderson, Steve Coogan, Lennie James, Paddy Considine
description: Manchester, 1976: a Granada Television presenter, inspired by the Sex Pistols, decides to found a record company and dance club with some friends. Thus were born Factory Records, which write Joy Division and James and the Happy Mondays, and The Hacienda, one of the most famous clubs in the world.
notes: True history and music, shot with a documentary and over-excited attitude. As befits the city which for 15 years was renamed Mad-chester.

title: All or Nothing
actors: Timothy Spall, Lesley Manville, Alison Garland, James Corden, Ruth Sheen, Alison Garland, Russell Mabey, Paul Jesson, Gary McDonald, Diveen Henry, Leo Bill, James Corden, Sally Hawkins
description: London, a popular neighborhood. Penny's love for her partner, the taxi driver Phil, has now faded. The woman works as a cashier in a supermarket, her daughter Rachel does the cleaning in a retirement home while her son Rory is unemployed. It will be a sudden tragedy to reunite Penny and Phil again.
notes: There is nothing "fascinating" about what the camera frames: not the violent rancor of young people, nor their clothes (from cheap department stores and not from "street style"), nor their faces already shrunken on themselves, nor their poses that would like to be provocative; not the silent existential crisis of adults, which does not open glimpses of "heroic" provocation (despite the black leather jacket, Timothy Spall's Phil is anything but a cinematic "taxi driver"), but only makes the math, day by day, with relationships withered by misery, consumed in years of daily squalor; not the environment, which is not realistic, but real, and denies any imaginary suggestion to the writings that disfigure the walls as in the evenings at the pub. Yet, in those faces of actors who seem taken from the street and instead are all extraordinary professionals (including the two bulimic boys), in those grumpy dialogues and in those painful silences, there is a shocking humanity, the one that, to paraphrase Phil , if she already knew what awaits her when she wakes up in the morning, she wouldn't even get up. Park of camera movements (Mike Leigh is one who still knows how to give the indispensable moral weight to a trolley or a zoom and uses them only in the rare moments when it goes straight into the hearts of the characters), _All or nothing_ calls us into question, it makes us feel our distraction and our privileges.

title: Bowling for Columbine
description: The unstoppable and burly author of _Roger & Me_ and _The Big One_ tries to answer the question: "Are we a nation of gun addicts, or are we just plain crazy?". The starting point is the massacre at Columbine High School, where in 1999 two students killed twelve classmates and a teacher before shooting themselves. Unpublished and astonishing images: from the closed-circuit recordings of the interior of the canteen on the morning of the massacre, to the accusations of seriously injured students who take it out on big industries guilty of selling weapons too easily, to the questions posed to Charlton Heston (president of the National Rifle Association) at his mansion in Beverly Hills.
notes: Awarded at Cannes 2002, Moore's documentary is a lucid analysis of the uniquely American obsession with firearms; as well as an indictment of the NRA, the National Rifle Association, or the lobby of arms manufacturers that controls important sectors of the economy and public opinion. As always, Moore says extremely serious things with a biting, fast, hilarious style here and there: seeing him in action, with his bulky bulk and eternal baseball cap, is in its own way comical; but the "message" that arrives is always a stab for conscience. The raid on the home of Charlton Heston, who has always been a sponsor and spokesperson for the NRA, was memorable; but also the interview with Marilyn Manson is from the anthology. _Bowling a Columbine_ is - fortunately - the triumph of the politically incorrect.

title: Demonlover
actors: Connie Nielsen, Chloë Sevigny, Charles Berling, Gina Gershon
description: Welcome to the murky world of hentaï, manga porn. Diane De Monx works for a multinational and knows that TokyoAnime's new 3D design is hot material. For this she is approached by the Mangatronix, at war with her rival Demonlover. Sex and copyright, Internet and cyberthriller French auteur cinema and William Gibson suggestions. Assayas crosses into science fiction territory with an amazing cast of girls.

title: Yadon ilaheyya
actors: Elia Suleiman, Amer Daher, Jamel Daher, Naeif Daher, George Ibrahim
description: Es, a Palestinian living in Jerusalem, is in love with a compatriot of his who lives in Ramallah. Man is divided between love and the need to provide for his father. Due to the complex political situation, the two lovers can only be seen near the checkpoint that divides the two cities. Their meetings take place in an adjacent parking lot.
notes: Shot in Nazareth where Suleiman was born, constructed by sewing together quick sketches with the thread of a comic situation reminiscent of Keaton and Tati, the film is divided between reality and utopia. Surprising, militant and anti-militarist, openly comical, wildly utopian, bitterly realist.

title: Chihwaseon
actors: Yu Ho-jeong, Choi Min-sik, Ahn Sung-kee, Kim Yejin, Son Ye-jin
description: The film tells the story of the life of the great painter Jang Seung-up born in 1843 and died without leaving a trace in 1897.
notes: Im Kwon-taek tells us about a country and a culture that gradually see their specificity erased: China and Japan, both "infiltrators", threaten their identity. Jang, at first a master in copying Chinese paintings, feels he has to make himself independent. But it is very difficult, because creation is a process that cannot be separated from History: when this is crumbled into anxieties and uncertainties, Art can only suffer the consequences. A rigorous and engaging film.

title: L'adversaire
actors: Daniel Auteuil, Géraldine Pailhas, François Cluzet, Emmanuelle Devos, Bernard Fresson
description: 1993: On a gray January morning, Jean-Marc Faure exterminates his wife, children and parents. Motive: his family members had understood that, for over twenty years, he had invented a non-existent professional life ...
notes: This terrible story of "invisibility" has so shocked French public opinion that it has given rise to two films within a few months. The first was _A full time_ (2001), by Laurent Cantet. The second, directed by the now former actress Garcia, focuses decisively on the interpretation of Daniel Auteuil, the historic "heart in winter" of transalpine cinema. The result is interesting, but not entirely convincing.

title: Mies vailla menneisyyttä
actors: Markku Peltola, Kati Outinen, Annikki Tähti, Juhani Niemelä
description: M, as soon as he arrives in Helsinki in search of work, is attacked at the station by a group of thugs, whose beating makes him lose his memory. He has to start from scratch: he doesn't have a house, he doesn't have a job, he doesn't have a past. But start living again and find love too ...
notes: Among the great authors of today, Kaurismäki has a lot to tell us about the human condition, about love and solidarity, about the social and economic situations of this turn of the century. In his minimalist stories, he never forgets the social fabric that generates them. However, he does not believe that many words are needed to tell them, but rather understanding, cleanliness and a thread of hope. More than minimalism, his is thriftiness, modesty: of form, never of feeling. In his long silences, sudden phrases such as "Does a birch cry if a leaf falls?" Echo, loves are kindled at first sight, the solidarity between poor people shines. Self-irony is his weapon and his screen, but his heart always jumps out, in the dogs that go through his films (here is the "ferocious" Hannibal) and in the photos of the fetish-actor Matti Pellonpää who - since disappeared - always stand out in a shot. The film won the Jury's Grand Prix and Kati Outinen won the Best Actress award at the 2002 Cannes Film Festival.

title: Le fils
actors: Olivier Gourmet, Morgan Marinne, Isabella Soupart
description: In an institute for the recovery of children who have come out of the reformatory, the educator Olivier anxiously welcomes sixteen-year-old Francis, assigned to the carpentry. The man spies on him, establishes a close relationship with him, then talks about it to his ex-wife and everything becomes dramatically clear ...
notes: The greatness of the film lies in never showing off Olivier's intentions, in (re) constructing the consequences of a tragedy and the expectations of revenge, between silence and imploded suffering. With a direction that interprets but at the same time remains modest (hand-held camera, but less radical than in _Rosetta_), the Dardenne stage a moral tale in which arguments of absolute depth are compared. Evil, redemption, guilt, the impossibility of mourning and even a sort of Schraderian (and therefore Bressonian) transcendence, despite the fact that the gaze on the history of Olivier and Francis, in its rigor, is secular. But let's go back to the "father": the uniqueness of the film lies in its starting point, which by the Dardenne's own admission is not a narratively accomplished subject nor a character. It is the actor himself who plays him, Olivier Gourmet (that the Belgian brothers-directors had already used both in _La promesse_ and in _Rosetta_): "His bulk, his nape, his face, his eyes lost behind his glasses ". Cinema thus re-appropriates bodies, and through a process of subtraction it digs into behaviors to the point of baring the soul.

title: O princípio da incerteza
actors: Leonor Baldaque, Leonor Silveira, Ricardo Trêpa, Ivo Canelas, Isabel Ruth
description: Antonio and José, the servant's children, have always shared everything, since their childhood. Once they grow up, the two boys find themselves in love with the same girl: Camilla. Of the two Antonio manages to marry her. Antonio's lover is Vanessa who shares unspeakable secrets with him. The devil will take care of shuffling the cards in their relationships.
notes: A plot of a family saga that Oliveira mixes up deliciously to confuse us because what, as usual, interests him is the (not very sacred) representation of the uncertainties and illusions of the heart. Dense dialogues, sometimes ferocious humor and hieratic moments in a small church-refuge where the statue of a Joan of Arc sleeps covered in cobwebs.

title: Marie-Jo et ses deux amours
actors: Ariane Ascaride, Jean-Pierre Darroussin, Gérard Meylan
description: Marie-Jo nurtures two passions at the same time: one is her husband Daniel, the other is her lover Marco. However, she herself realizes the difficulty of the situation; naturally the story takes place in Marseille, against the backdrop of echoes and reminiscences ...
notes: Less focused on the social and almost completely turned on the private, in this film Guédiguian focuses on a tearing dilemma: what to do if you love your husband or wife, but also fall in love with someone else? Nothing to complain about the general layout of the film: what is perplexing is the final part, uncertain about the development of the plot.

title: Punch-Drunk Love
actors: Adam Sandler, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Emily Watson
description: Barry Egan spent his childhood and adolescence with seven sisters who never allowed him to live a quiet life or fall in love. Then, one day, he runs into a mysterious girl and a harmonium ...
notes: As in Magnolia, Anderson starts from the inexplicability of the world, but this time he doesn't take the path of drama. He enters, with an unexpected move, the colorful and bizarre path of paroxysm, of a desperate and humorous nonsense that leads to a hopelessly romantic love, under the Hawaiian moon. A disconcerting and postmodern film, jazz and pop, syncopated and multicolored, kinetic and abstract, virtuosic and dissatisfied.

title: Russkij kovceg
actors: Sergej Dontsov, Mariya Kuznetsova, Leonid Mozgovoj, Anna Aleksakhina
description: In the nineteenth century, in St. Petersburg, a Frenchman is preparing to visit the Hermitage, the most famous palace / museum in the country. Suddenly, among the magnificent rooms of the building, the protagonists of two hundred years of Russian history come to life like ghosts ...
notes: An important, discussed, demanding filmmaker for a seductive, irritating, surprising film. An exercise in directing, a journey into art, a reportage from history. All watched "live", without cuts, in a single subjective shot-sequence that lasts as long as the film. Nostalgia, dream, memory, oblivion, distance, memory, melancholy: magical Sokurov.

title: Spider
actors: Ralph Fiennes, Gabriel Byrne, Miranda Richardson, Lynn Redgrave
description: Dennis Cleg, known as Spider, lives in a time of his own, in which past and present, reality and hallucination, overlap incessantly. Spider is schizophrenic, and his life outside the nursing home spans an indefinite mess. Spider looks for the right images, the key to the skein that has been woven around him like a spider's web, his mother's face in the faces of all the women he meets ...
notes: It would have been impossible to find a more suitable director than Cronenberg to narrate Spider's solitary journey into the nightmare, to be able to make the imperceptible boundaries between his worlds, to make him relive as a spectator what he already experienced as a child (or maybe not. ..). The Canadian author is a master in the materialization of an atmosphere that becomes a story, inner wandering, and in the concentric shattering of points of view, so much so that we are drowned in the same uncertainty of perspective as the protagonist (an extraordinary Fiennes, whose performance can be fully evaluated only in the original version), in his memory and consciousness derailed. Based on the novel of the same name by Patrick McGrath (who writes in the first person), _Spider_ is a film of "perception" rather than "narration"; based not on a plot, but on a plot that seems to have been modeled by Escher. Hear Spider's mumbling, guess the scribbles traced in his notebooks, smell the air he sniffs. Nothing makes sense except the suffocating smell of gas, the lost mother, a devastated childhood, an existence marked forever.

title: Sweet Sixteen
actors: Martin Compston, William Ruane, Annmarie Fulton, Michelle Abercromby
description: Liam is about to turn sixteen. His mother Jean will be released from prison in time to celebrate his birthday, and he decides to turn to crime in order to find the money to buy a house to live in with his mother and sister ...
notes: A classic Loach that in Sweet Sixteen flies very high, because the screenplay - steeped in ethical sense - of the usual Paul Laverty goes hand in hand with faces that speak for themselves, with situations of social degradation that, as authentic and unrecognized, they need to find a voice through the cinema. Truffautiano grand finale and a curiosity: in the US it came out with subtitles due to the peculiarity of the slang.

title: Ten
actors: Mania Akbari, Roya Arabshahi, Amin Maher, Mandana Sharbaf
description: Ten encounters in a car moving through Tehran traffic. A woman driving, a passenger in the next seat. The woman has left her husband, she lives with another man, she is independent, she knows what she wants. Next to her, in succession: her son, an annoying little boy well on his way to becoming an arrogant adult; the sister worried about her nephew's temper; a very religious old woman who has lost a child; a prostitute who knows men well; a sensitive and restless girl because her boyfriend is not convinced of their relationship.
notes: Ascetic exercise of a cinematic fundamentalist Kiarostami who pursues the disappearance of the staging to bring out faces and words.

title: The Pianist
actors: Adrien Brody, Thomas Kretschmann, Emilia Fox, Ed Stoppard
description: During the Second World War, Wladyslaw Szpilman - a famous Polish Jewish pianist - manages to escape deportation. Thus he finds himself in the Warsaw ghetto, within which he shares the sufferings and heroic struggles of the inhabitants. A Nazi officer who loves his music decides to help him and allows him to continue living ...
notes: History shows its worst face in the first part, and Polanski picks up the crescendo of incredulity, uncertainty, collaborationism, despair; his eye captures, often from a distance, moments of horror (only one really comes close: the child stuck in the hole in the wall that separates the ghetto from the city) and surreal figurines of a humanity that nevertheless wants to survive. Only rarely does a wide-ranging car movement start, to give us back the - tremendous - dimension of the event (the bridge over the road that crosses the ghetto, the bags of the Jews abandoned in the street, the dolly that accompanies Wladyslaw over the wall and shows Warsaw destroyed). The nightmare, increasingly lonely and horrifying, begins when the protagonist closes the hatch of the coffee platform behind him. There begins the journey of a new tenant on the third floor: hunted, spied on, betrayed, in a personal hell, where not even the passage of time matters anymore. The second part of the film is beautiful and shocking; but the first is to get us there with the awareness that all this really happened.

title: And Now... Ladies & Gentlemen
actors: Jeremy Irons, Patricia Kaas, Thierry Lhermitte, Alessandra Martines
description: Enveloping plot made up of encounters, coincidences, parallel divergences. The relationship between a jewelry thief husband and a wife goes into crisis. He goes on a journey and meets a jazz singer. She has another love story too. Men, women, scoundrels: instructions for use.
notes: After countless raids in the heart, Lelouch gets lost in introspection, in landscapes, in (sopral) places, remaining a privileged spectator behind his beloved lens (he is one of the few who still insists on staying nailed to the camera). The staging is therefore once more enveloping and original, supported by a sui generis director of photography (another director who loves wide spaces and panoramic views, Pierre-William Glenn), by a bilingualism that accentuates the bewilderment , from intoned notes (_Que reste-t-il de nos amours_, _La mer _...) and strange and strange actors and performances. We would not say, in fact, that Jeremy Irons and the unprecedented Patricia Kaas shine with their own light. As can be clearly seen the holiday cameos of Claudia Cardinale, Yvan Attal, Thierry Lhermitte and Amidou. Yet, under the elegant aegis of the passionate film camera, the fabulous world of Lelouch re-explodes in all its grandiloquent splendor. As we hear in the film, "lies are dreams caught in the act". Keep it going...

title: Ararat
actors: Arsinée Khanjian, Christopher Plummer, Charles Aznavour, Eric Bogosian
description: A young filmmaker and an elderly documentary maker share problems, anxieties, emotional and cultural lacerations. Above all they share the effects and aftermath of a past full of pain, a legacy of the genocide committed by the Turks against the Armenians in 1915.
notes: An incredibly complicated script forms the backdrop to Egoyan's most personal and painful film. A million deaths always denied by the Ankara government, a tragedy that is clearly present in the eyes of the survivors and their descendants: among them Eric Bogosian (who on his website defines himself as "underground Armenian-American phenomenon") and Charles Aznavour, at the registry office Chahnour Aznavourian. The company was one to make your wrists tremble: the passion for the subject exudes from every image, even if a greater detachment from the subject would have helped.

title: Carlo Giuliani, ragazzo
description: Genoa, July 20, 2001. At 5:20 pm, in Piazza Alimonda, a pistol shot kills Carlo Giuliani, aged 23, from a carabinieri truck. Friends rename the place "Piazza Carlo Giuliani, boy". The film tells the story of Carlo on 20 July and, at the same time, that of the "white overalls" procession. Point of connection and memory: the face and the words of Heidi, Carlo's mother.
notes: From the films made by the authors of the project "A different world is possible", coordinated by Citto Maselli, Francesca Comencini (who availed herself of Luca Bigazzi's complicity) has extracted yet another world. Heidi, the mother of Carlo Giuliani, the boy killed in the tragic clashes in Genoa on 20 July 2001, reconstructs her son's last day with impressive clarity. And the author who, together with Linda Taylor, has passed through three hundred hours of material, returns with passionate detachment the meaning of that day parallel to the meaning and madness of a broken life. The impressive research work then gave his family and all of us four or five images of Carlo, who (re) appears as a ghostly angel a few minutes before his death, in that sea of ??"cinema" shot and made by twenty thousand lenses. bet on history. And if it is true that we are history and that we are the ones who write the letters (like those of Carlo, recited by Carlo Orlando, which open and close the painful work), that every fragment stolen from the memory of 20 July imposes, first of all , to think again.

title: Femme fatale
actors: Rebecca Romijn, Antonio Banderas, Peter Coyote
description: Laura Ash is a jewelry thief and a very skilled manipulator. Seven years after a sensational theft, she returns to France, to Cannes, chased by the old accomplices she has deceived and who track her down through a photo of a paparazzo ...
notes: The insistent, exciting, erotic, very original opening throws the film into our eyes, even before it into our hearts. Nothing is forbidden to the camera of a director who perhaps, at times, exceeds in virtuosity, but whose gaze is always able to reflect on its own production, doubling and tripling among mirrors, split-screens, cameras, video cameras and video cameras.

title: Hollywood Ending
actors: Woody Allen, Téa Leoni, George Hamilton, Mark Rydell, Treat Williams, Debra Messing, Marian Seldes, Mark Webber, Tiffani Thiessen
description: Val Waxman, a neurotic director in crisis and decline, was left by his wife Ellie, who is married to Hollywood producer Hal Jaeger. Now Val lives making commercials, and when Hal (under pressure from Ellie) offers him to return to the set, he is happy to accept: but a sudden blindness of a psychosomatic nature hits him, making the process very complicated ...
notes: You know, Allen's timing - both in front of and behind the camera - are perfect: the scenes in which he "views" the dailies or shoots sequences in the dark are irresistible. The construction is exemplary, yet one gets the impression that the "click" of other occasions is missing.

title: Murder by Numbers
actors: Sandra Bullock, Ben Chaplin, Ryan Gosling, Michael Pitt, Chris Penn
description: The body of a young woman is found in the woods of a coastal California town. The investigation is entrusted to Detective Cassie and her new partner Sam. The first clues suggest a casual act of violence. The protagonist wants to dig deeper. And finally it comes to two young men, Richard and Justin, convinced that the perfect crime can be committed.
notes: _Formula per un delitto_ is therefore the typical honest film, "average" but not mediocre, unfortunately not helped by the protagonist-producer Sandra Bullock. Which has two expressions: one with slit eyes (the intense one) and one with wide eyes (the ones for normal occasions).

title: Spirit: Stallion of the Cimarron
description: Spirit, a mustang that lives free and wild along the American frontier, befriends Little River - a young warrior from the Lakota tribe - and the filly Rain. The animal will become one of the greatest unrecognized heroes of the Old West.
notes: In the splendor of breathtaking panoramas enhanced by the CinemaScope format, DreamWorks marks an important milestone in the "tradigital", or rather in the mixture between traditional 2D and digital three-dimensional animation. The staff has completed an absolutely extraordinary job in restoring the movements and expressions of horses, the animals that are perhaps the most difficult to animate: also because Spirit and his peers do not speak, but their expressiveness is worth more than any speech. Music by Hans Zimmer; in the Italian version, the songs of Bryan Adams are performed by Zucchero.

title: Justice Express
actors: David Jalil, Jean LeClerc, Dominique Briand, Claudine Chatel

title: Metropolis
description: In Metropolis, the city of the future, humans coexist with robots. Inside the immense Ziggurat skyscraper live the upper classes, while the poor and mechanical men spend their sad existence in the basement. Detective Shunsaku Ban and his assistant Kenichi are on the trail of Dr. Laughton, a rebellious scientist who gave birth to Tima, a new type of android. It will be Tima, who in the meantime has changed and begins to destroy humans, to become king of Ziggurat ...
notes: In 1949 Osamu Tezuka, without ever having seen Lang's film, decided to turn _Metropolis_ into a manga. After more than fifty years, his pupil Rin Tarô closes the circle and turns the manga into a movie. The operation promised to be arduous, but Rin Tarô cunningly turned to cinema and literature, plundering them with both hands. His Metropolis is very suggestive, whose proximity to New York is underlined by a Dixieland jazz soundtrack, while an unexpected _I Can't Stop Loving You_ by Ray Charles highlights the beginning of the destruction and the Ziggurat has a crash that recalls that of the Twin Towers. Smart but fascinating film, much closer to _Final Fantasy_ than you think.

title: Tigerland
