actors: Colin Farrell, Matthew Davis, Clifton Collins jr., Tom Guiry, Shea Whigham, Cole Hauser, Neil Brown Jr., Tory Kittles, Michael Shannon, Nick Searcy, Matt Gerald, James MacDonald, Afemo Omilami
description: The long night of soldier Bozz, who at the end of the Vietnam War is sent to the worst training camp in the States: precisely among the "swamp", the swamps of the Cajuns of Louisiana (called in code "Tigerland"), very similar to the jungle Indochinese. Bozz joins a group of fellow soldiers and finds a way to dismiss various friends: those who are fragile, those who "keep a family" ...
notes: Schumacher makes amends for some bad recent evidence with a film that is not a war-movie in the strict sense, but a comedy along the lines of "Frenzies ... military". There are two possible interpretations: one reactionary and one progressive.

title: Death on the Nile
actors: Peter Ustinov, Jane Birkin, Bette Davis, Mia Farrow, Lois Chiles, David Niven, Jon Finch, Olivia Hussey, Angela Lansbury, Simon MacCorkindale, Maggie Smith, Jack Warden, Harry Andrews
description: During a Nile cruise, a young heiress is killed. Hercule Poirot investigates, but among the vacationers there are many who have a plausible motive: things get easier when the list of possible culprits begins to shorten ...
notes: Good debut for Ustinov as the Belgian detective. Oscar for Anthony Powell's costumes, breathtaking scenery and a parade of stars for a superproduction that keeps what it promises: old-fashioned entertainment, very respectful of the atmosphere of the "made in Britain" thrill lady. Screenplay by Anthony Shaffer, photography by Jack Cardiff, music by Nino Rota.

title: The Blood of Fu Manchu
country: Spain, United States, Great Britain, Germany
actors: Christopher Lee, Richard Greene, Howard Marion-Crawford
description: New plans of conquest for the eastern devil. This time his secret weapon is a special poison, lethal only for males: used as a lipstick by ten beautiful women, it will cause the death of as many powerful people on Earth ...
notes: Franco "enriches" the fourth film in the series with generous doses of sex and violence.

title: Smart House
actors: Ryan Merriman, Katey Sagal, Kevin Kilner, Jessica Steen
description: By participating in a competition, 13-year-old Ben wins a computerized house whose gadgets include Pat, a cyborg waitress. With someone taking care of the house now, Ben hopes that his estranged father Nick decides never to remarry. Needless to say, Nick falls in love with the girl who set up the program ...

title: The Last Frontier
actors: Victor Mature, Guy Madison, Robert Preston, Anne Bancroft
description: Assaulted by Red Indians and robbed of everything, Jed Cooper and his two fur-hunters buddies enlist as guides at a remote outpost in the Oregon forests. Determined to take a less dangerous life, Jed sets his sights on Corinna, the beautiful wife of Colonel Marston, commander of one of the forts in the area.

title: Jay and Silent Bob Strike Back
actors: Jason Mewes, Kevin Smith, Ben Affleck, Jason Lee, Will Ferrell
description: Banky Edwards, longtime friend of Jay and Silent Bob, has moved to Hollywood to produce a film based on a comic book inspired by the couple's two alter egos, Bluntman & Chronic (a sort of Batman and Robin all to laugh) . To put the face of this spoof, Banky called in two Hollywood actors. The real Jay and Silent Bob, upset, decide to go to Hollywood to put a spoke in the wheel for the crew ...
notes: Kevin Smith (literally) throws shovels of excrement on the characters in his debut film, the delightful and original _Clerks_, turning him into a bad _American Pie_ clone.

title: Loin
actors: Stéphane Rideau, Lubna Azabal, Mohamed Hamaïdi, Yasmina Reza
description: Truck driver Serge commutes between France and Morocco carrying rolls of cloth and luxury clothes. With his truck he stops in Tangier where his mistress Sarah and friend Saïd await him. This time the Moroccan stage will last three days during which something will happen that will change his life. Serge agrees to hide a shipment of drugs in his truck. He will also have to try to win back Sarah who doesn't want to know about him anymore.
notes: Téchiné concentrates the story in three days, crushing his characters on an urgent need to escape, to transit, no one knows where far away. It gives the impression of direct access, but even more of simultaneity: it is not history but geographies, geographies in which to orient oneself without compasses or maps. The project is courageous, the stylistic awareness absolute, the love for the characters sincere, the very tall models ("The River" by Renoir, quoted explicitly). But if Renoir consciously risked the drift by letting himself really pervade the world, Téchiné never renounces a certain intellectualism and paradoxically, while looking for the open work, he risks the theorem. Not all the elements of the fresco are equally in focus: for example, the parenthesis with intellectuals in permanent tourism is ultimately dispersive. The road, however, was the right one; Téchiné, having reached full maturity, raised the bar, got involved and offered us an important job, coming one step away from making a great film, on a Mediterranean that is a historical and geographical hub, but also a comprehensive metaphor of our present. .

title: The Forsaken
actors: Kerr Smith, Brendan Fehr, Izabella Miko, Johnathon Schaech
description: Sean, a trailer editor for a production company specializing in horror movie parodies, is catching up with his sister who is getting married in Florida. During the journey he takes two hitchhikers aboard his luxury car: Nick and Megan, a girl in shock who wanders non-stop. Nick confesses to Sean that the area is infested with vampires and that Megan is their victim. Our two heroes will have to fight against the creatures of the night.
notes: Nothing new under the sun. A horror so-so, that you drink it all in one gulp without making a lot of noise: it does not irritate, it also amuses you, but it is not marked on the notebook.

title: Every Mother's Worst Fear
actors: Cheryl Ladd, Jordan Ladd, Robert Wisden, Tom Butler, Blu Mankuma
description: Recently divorced, Connie has a job that forces her to work late hours. To overcome boredom, the sixteen-year-old daughter Martha decides to sign up for a chat line and, thanks to the intervention of a shady individual, she is put in contact with 34-year-old Drew, the classic individual who does not disdain little girls. Martha is flattered by the many messages she receives from Drew and agrees to go to her apartment without realizing what risks she exposes herself to. When Jeff, Martha's father, passes by the house to visit his daughter and finds no trace, the drama begins for him and for Connie.

title: Hsimeng rensheng
actors: Lim Giong, Vicky Wei, Li Ten-lu, Hwang Chin-ru
description: During the Japanese domination of the future nationalist China, the young Li Tien-lu joins a traveling theater and over time becomes one of the most important masters of the country in the art of puppets. During the Second World War, the occupants used this aspect of the Chinese cultural tradition for propaganda purposes: only after 1945 did street performances return to unfold freely.
notes: The plot does not do justice to the complexity of Hou Hsiao-hsien's film, which combines realism and metaphor in a parable about the thousand possible intertwining of history and personal experiences. Grand Jury Prize in Cannes.

title: Gli innamorati
actors: Antonella Lualdi, Franco Interlenghi, Nino Manfredi, Gino Cervi, Valeria Moriconi, Sergio Raimondi, Alessandra Panaro, Cosetta Greco
description: Nando, Franco and Otello live in the same neighborhood and have always been friends. Nando is a mechanic but "rounds out" by appearing in photo novels, which arouses the jealousy of his girlfriend Marisa; for his part, the barber Otello is hopelessly in love with Adriana, Nando's sister and Franco's betrothed. Nearby stands the restaurant of Sor Annibale and his restless wife Ines, still young and attracted by the boys of the district; and when Ines "tries" with Franco, the familiar-sentimental balances of the whole group seriously risk falling apart ...
notes: Typical example of pink neorealism, well written, directed and interpreted., Well written, directed and interpreted.

title: Great Guns
actors: Stan Laurel, Oliver Hardy, Sheila Ryan, Mae Marsh, Dick Nelson
description: Laurel and Hardy become tutors of a millionaire scion (in dollars ...). But in order to cope with the situation they are even forced to follow him into the army ...
notes: The originality of the astonishing pair of comedians is starting to slow down, after years of bursting inventions. "Hello friends!" is among their least successful films.

title: Zorro contro Maciste
actors: Pierre Brice, Alan Steel, Moira Orfei, Grazia Maria Spina, Massimo Serato
description: Malva and Isabella, heirs of Philip II, unleash the war of succession in Spain, competing for power. Having both powerful armies, they decide to win the support and complicity of the two heroes of the moment, Zorro and Maciste. Which at first fight each other, then instead ...
notes: Bruttarello this peplum by Umberto Lenzi, despite a certain commitment in the reconstruction of the context (beautiful costumes). The screenplay is by the Gallaratese Guido Malatesta, historical name of the "sandaloni", who does what he can to make credible a challenge, that between Zorro and Maciste, by definition incredible.

title: Judas Kiss
actors: Carla Gugino, Alan Rickman, Emma Thompson, Simon Baker-Denney
description: Young Coco and her lover Junior, two middle-of-the-road thugs, make ends meet until they decide to take the big shot with the kidnapping of Ben Dyson, owner of a computer industry. The couple hires Lizard Browning, a technology wizard, and the muscular Ruben Rubenbauer, who has a penchant for Russian roulette: but things don't go exactly as planned, especially since the wife of the powerful Senator Hornbeck is killed during the operation. .
notes: Gutierrez's debut is impregnated with cinephile and post-Tarantinian moods, all in all well played, contrary to other similar operations.

title: Il medico... la studentessa
actors: Gloria Guida, Jacques Dufilho, Pino Colizzi, Susan Scott
description: As a reward for the promotion, high school student Claudia Raselli gets permission from her father, Colonel Oreste, to go to London with friends. But when the stepmother Luisa induces the parent to revoke the consent, Claudia discovers that the woman is plotting to better cornify her husband with her lover, Doctor Filippo Cinti, and - with the help of her friend Daniela - she meditates revenge. ..
notes: Typical 70s soft-core, directed and co-scripted by specialist Amadio (fresh from _La minorenne_ and _Quella aged maliziosa_, both from 1974 and both played by Gloria Guida). Magazines today, those "scandalous" films almost make you smile.

title: Turbulence 3: Heavy Metal
actors: Zak Alam, Sharon Alexander, Gabrielle Anwar, Rutger Hauer
description: Rock star Slade Craven has decided to hold his farewell concert aboard a Jumbo 747 flying between Los Angeles and Toronto: but a troublemaker manages to hijack the aircraft, and the millions of fans who follow the event on the Internet they remain for hours with bated breath ...
notes: When you say "scratch the bottom of the barrel".

title: The Spring
actors: Kyle MacLachlan, Alison Eastwood, George Eads, Joseph Cross
description: While rafting on a river with his son Nick, Dennis Conway accidentally discovers a spring with magical powers, a veritable "fountain of eternal youth". Obviously, the inhabitants of the place are anything but inclined to share the prodigy they have with the rest of the world, and in fact, on the spot they try to get rid of the intruder: but later - convinced by doctor Sophie Weston, who fell in love with (reciprocated) Dennis - they offer him a profitable opportunity to say the least. The strange community, however, hides other secrets, a dark and evil side that concerns its older members ...

title: Flying Virus
actors: Rutger Hauer, Gabrielle Anwar, Mark Adair-Rios
description: Inside the Amazon rainforest, inscrutable secrets are hidden. Dr. Stephen North has devoted more than ten years of his life to discovering them. In the course of his research, North has developed medicines that cause terrible mutations in insects ...
notes: Catastrophic old fashioned, however, made with television style.

title: Virtual Sexuality
actors: Laura Fraser, Rupert Penry-Jones, Luke de Lacey, Kieran O'Brien, Natasha Bell
description: By now Justine despairs of meeting the perfect man, but visiting a fair in the company of her friend Chas she discovers that modern technologies are able to create a "facsimile" suitable for the need. Suddenly, however, a voltage surge generates a really complicated mess ...
notes: Childish and frankly inessential.

title: The Phantom
actors: Billy Zane, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Treat Williams, Kristy Swanson
description: Phantom is an immortal hero (in the sense that his myth has been handed down for generations) whose mission is to fight against all forms of human cruelty and injustice. Thus he finds himself having to prevent a criminal from taking possession of the legendary skulls of Touganda, capable of giving superhuman strength. To fight against the supervillain, the masked executioner leaves his native Africa to go to New York.
notes: From the famous comic created by Lee Falk (Mandrake's father), an underrated adventure film, perhaps naive but funny. After the flop in the States it was never released in theaters in Italy. Among the executive producers, also Joe Dante.

title: Windtalkers
actors: Nicolas Cage, Adam Beach, Christian Slater, Peter Stormare
description: For the transmission of secret information, the US military decides to use Navajo soldiers, codenamed "windtalker". Joe Enders, a Marine Sergeant already tested in the battle of the Solomon Islands, is entrusted with the protection of a young Navajo, Ben Yahzee. The Indian does not know, but Enders - like the other "bodyguards" of the coders - has orders to kill him should he fall into enemy hands ...
notes: Reason, passion and good feelings: starting from a bad screenplay (by John Rice and Joe Batteer), full of patriotic platitudes, Woo celebrates the swan song of his cinema with this film.

title: Sugar & Spice
actors: Mena Suvari, James Mardsen, Marla Sokoloff, Alexandra Holden, Marley Shelton, Rachel Blanchard
description: For Diane, Kansas, Lisa, Fern and Hannah, five cheerleaders life has never been happier. They have everything they want. When Diane, engaged to Jack, quarterback of the football team, becomes pregnant, the situation worsens. The money is no longer enough and Diane convinces her four friends to land a bank robbery.
notes: The only idea is to adapt the group ethics and the candid enthusiasm of the cheerleaders to a more shady environment. Mild rhythm, pop atmospheres that are now daily bread on every advertising break. The only curiosity of this fool is a hint of an undeclared parody of O. Henry's tale "The Gift of the Magi".

title: Scooby-Doo
actors: Rowan Atkinson, Linda Cardellini, Sarah Michelle Gellar, Freddie Prinze jr, Matthew Lillard
description: Scooby-Doo and his friends Fred, Daphne, Shaggy, and Velma have for two years decided to break up their monster-catching business. The ramshackle company is forced to return to the track to discover the cause of the accidents that occur in the immense Spring Break playground. Emile Mondavarious, the eccentric owner of the amusement park, thinks the place is haunted by ghosts. For Scooby-Doo and companions the challenge has just begun ...
notes: The adventure is neither more extravagant nor more elaborate nor more compelling than a normal TV episode. The actors resemble their drawn models like wax figures. Lines without thickness.

title: Impostor
actors: Tim Guinee, Tony Shalhoub, Madeleine Stowe, Vincent D'Onofrio, Gary Sinise
description: 2075. Terrestrial colonies that have settled in space are constantly attacked by extraterrestrials. A government agent is working to develop a weapon that can defeat them. At the head of the project is the scientist Spencer who from one day to the next finds himself imprisoned with the accusation of being an alien who has taken the physical appearance of a human being.
notes: Gary Fleder is a decent filmmaker and manages to draw a pretty convincing visual grid. Instead, his staging of this Dick story is very indecisive, deficient, confused. Throughout the film, he does not find a point of view (right or wrong, but clear).

title: Get Real
actors: Ben Silverstone, Brad Gorton, Charlotte Brittain, Stacy Hart
description: Steven, like all boys of his age, lives his life indulging his passions: music, photography, sport and friends. Steven's love is hard to confess. She falls in love with another boy who, however, does not want to know about him. Torn between truth and lies, Steven will have to decide whether to make his passion public or not to tell anyone.
notes: A film in the style of average British cinema, diligently written, with just the right mélange of comedy and drama, but in this case the difference is made by the actors of an anonymous cast but they work perfectly. In 1998 the film won the Audience Award at the Edinburgh Film Festival.

title: Gli occhi dell'amore
actors: Giulio Base, Anna Falchi, Micaela Ramazzotti, Renzo Rinaldi
description: Growing up following the teachings of Jones, a gay who acted as his adoptive father, Arturo developed an open and tolerant mentality, free from prejudices and prejudices. Still, the idea that she might be interested in a man had never occurred to her mind. For her part, following a series of circumstances, Miki was forced to pretend to be a boy. The paths of the two cross when Arturo, who is going through a period of crisis with his wife Elena, hires Miki as a waiter and, in a short time, begins to feel irresistibly attracted to what he believes to be a member of his own sex. .

title: Seunlau ngaklau
actors: Nicholas Tse, Wu Bai, Candy Lo, Cathy Tsui, Anthony Wong Chau-Sang
description: Tyler, a young bungler from Hong Kong, gets a girl pregnant and is forced to go straight. He finds a job in a bodyguard company and immediately demonstrates a certain "intuitive" talent. One day he becomes friends with Jack, a mercenary who wants to change his life. Destiny holds for them ... explosive surprises.
notes: After a very weak American period Tsui Hark, demiurge of the new wave action of Hong Kong cinema, returns in every sense "home". We are not at the level of his cult movies of the past, but still worth more "Time and Tide" than any American action blockbuster.

title: Custody of the Heart
actors: Lorraine Bracco, Martin Donovan, Dennis Boutsikaris, John Neville
description: Claire Raphael is the classic career woman who splits her time between work and family. Everything seems to be going well, so much so that the business woman is about to collect the "woman of the year" award. But unfortunately the drama awaits him around the corner. Her husband Johhny, dissatisfied with their married life, gets to ask for a divorce and tries in every way to get custody of the children assigned by the judges. From this moment on, a tough legal battle begins.
notes: Film directed by that David Jones author of "Jacknife" and "84 Charing Cross Road" among others.

title: Shiner
actors: Michael Caine, Martin Landau, Frances Barber, Matthew Marsden
description: In the London underworld and in the clandestine boxing match they call him Diamante. But Billy Simpson has the problem of remaining a diamond in the rough. Not cut by expert hands. Rough and brutal, naive and ruthless. A bundle of reactions and mediocre behaviors. He never managed to become a respected entrepreneur, he never managed to be a prominent gangster, and his authoritarianism didn't take hold of his family. Everything falls apart when his boxer son loses the match of his life and Billy believes there is a trick underneath.
notes: "Shiner" is a discontinuous and singular film. It breaks free from certain schemes, but cannot break free from them. Valuable is the deaf despair of the characters.

title: 37°2 le matin
actors: Jean-Hugues Anglade, Béatrice Dalle, Vincent Lindon
description: Zorg, a young man with literary ambitions, works as a factotum in a seaside village. His life is turned upside down by the encounter with the unpredictable Betty who introduces him to the passion. The man regains confidence in himself and also begins to believe in his talent as a writer. But an unfinished pregnancy triggers Betty madness.
notes: Based on the novel by Philippe Djian, the film marks Béatrice Dalle's big screen debut.

title: The Substance of Fire
actors: Ron Rifkin, Tony Goldwyn, Benjamin Ungar, Timothy Hutton
description: Isaac Geldhart is a Holocaust survivor who, overwhelmed by grief over his wife's recent death, seems committed to breaking down his publishing house by ordering the publication of books that have no hope of success. His son Aaron, who works with him, is frustrated by his father's emotional decline and tries in every way to take command of the publishing house. The ensuing crisis also affects Isaac's other two children, Sarah and the dying Martin.
notes: The meager and at times insufficient narrative construction of the characters is balanced by a good interpretation by the whole cast. All for a classic and "committed" drama.

title: Kimberly
actors: Gabrielle Anwar, Jason Lewis, Chris Rydell, Sean Astin, Robert Mailhouse
description: Advertising Scott, architect Michael, stockbroker Bob and teacher Walter, who form a rowing team in their spare time, meet Kimberly, the daughter of an Olympic champion of their sport. The girl - needless to say - is very attractive, and for the good of the crew the quartet makes a solemn vow to avoid emotional involvement; but being the weakest flesh of the spirit, sooner or later everyone falls for it. The real trouble starts, however, when Kimberly finds herself pregnant, without being able to accurately identify the "responsible" ...
notes: Nothing special, but not unworthy either: and Anwar is always super cute.

title: Sérieux comme le plaisir
actors: Jane Birkin, Richard Leduc, Georges Mansart, Andréa Ferréol
description: Two boys and a girl live in Paris sharing the small space of an apartment. One day they leave for an impromptu trip to French land, exposing themselves to the cheerful randomness of unexpected encounters, to the light intertwining of frivolous sentimental bonds, and to the joy of a youth marked by non-conformism.
notes: A sincere and light-hearted "on the road", played by an excellent cast.

title: Lonesome
actors: Barbara Kent, Glenn Tryon, Fay Holderness, Eddie Phillips
description: Based on a Mann Page story, the film was released in a silent version with sound accompaniment, but originally featured some spoken scenes. The love story between a worker and a telephone operator who meet during a trip, fall in love, leave each other only to discover that they are neighbors, is a lyrical homage to the life of simple people and a painful awareness of a system of values ??that crush people's lives.

title: Pimpernel Smith
actors: Leslie Howard, Mary Morris, Francis L. Sullivan
description: World War II: The young Cambridge professor Horatio Smith is in Germany to oversee some archaeological excavations. He is actually on a mission to free some prisoners in the Nazi camps.
notes: Except for a certain emphasis and a few rhetorical lapses, the dry and controlled direction is all at the service of a beautiful character (the director himself appears as the protagonist) and of a compelling story, undecided between comedy and unexpected dramatic ignitions.

title: Inventario balcanico
description: Inexhaustible explorers of archives and film libraries, this time Gianikian and Ricci Lucchi have dedicated their analytical-philological efforts to materials dated between the 20s and 40s and shot by various and anonymous operators in the countries of the Balkan area: a touching and moving " minimal diary ", which re-elaborates a memory that is now more necessary than ever.

title: Die Austernprinzessin
actors: Ossi Oswalda, Victor Jansen, Harry Liedtke
description: Lubitsch's fourth film, shot before his departure for the United States. Ossi, the spoiled and capricious daughter of the oyster king, decides to get married to spite her father. But the betrothed Nucki sends the secretary Josef to the altar in his place.
notes: Irresistible comedy of misunderstandings, where the choreographic wisdom of the German director intertwines lives and destinies with the usual intelligence. The rhythm is the frenzied one of brilliant comedy, the sequences constructed with the precision of mechanical ballets.

title: Privilege
actors: Paul Jones, Jean Shrimpton, Mark London, Max Bacon
description: Rise and fall of a young pop singer, who manages to become an idol of the masses thanks to the maneuvers and intrigues of skilled managers. When he falls in love with an idealistic painter, he tries to rebel against her character's mask and to rediscover a lost authenticity.
notes: Beautiful scenes shot during the concerts, which return an atmosphere of collective hysteria. The film limps on the other hand when Watkins tries to make simplistic morals about the mechanisms of the star-system.

title: The Stunt Man
actors: Peter O'Toole, Steve Railsback, Barbara Hershey, Chuck Bail
description: A singular metacinematographic reflection, a small movie classic in the cinema: a runaway thief ends up on a film set, where a director on the verge of paranoia (O'Toole) hires him as a double.
notes: Frantic editing and directorial pulse as in the most classic of action films, but shaken by unpredictable changes of register and by continuous confusions between fiction and reality. Surprising and certainly original.

title: The Black Room
actors: Boris Karloff, Marian Marsh, Robert Allen, Thurston Hall
description: Extraordinary interpretation of Boris Karloff here in the double part of two twin brothers who live in a castle, upon which the danger of a millennial curse lies. Among dense fogs, twisted trees, disturbing apparitions, rooms and corridors of a manor that hides a terrible secret, the film unfolds all the paraphernalia of the best 1930s gothic.

title: The Deep Blue Sea
actors: Vivien Leigh, Kenneth More, Eric Portman, Emlyn Williams
description: The wife of a magistrate (Vivine Leigh) falls in love with an unreliable and inconclusive former RAF driver who undermines his bourgeois value system. Based on a play by Terence Rattigan, the film turns in vain on the existential torments of the protagonist and is unable to go anywhere. Despite the paucity of the arguments, Leigh's intense interpretation emerges as a winner.

title: Robinson Crusoe
actors: Pierce Brosnan, Sean Brosnan, Ian Hart, William Takaku
description: Robinson Crusoe, an English sailor en route to the South Seas, is shipwrecked on a desert island. The first moments are particularly hard, but the years pass and the adaptability of the lone castaway improves.
notes: Discreet and faithful transposition of Defoe's story, with a bearded Pierce "007" Brosnan and Ian Hart as the writer.

title: Il trafficone
actors: Carlo Giuffrè, Marilù Tolo, Tina Aumont, Lino Banfi, Enzo Cannavale
description: The Neapolitan knitter Vincenzo Lo Russo, married to Angelina and father of three children, from one day to the next becomes a doctor and expert guide for couples in difficulty. Assuming a new identity, he calls himself Doctor Gaetano D'Angelo, "assisted" by his friend Gennaro, Vincenzo quickly meets an extraordinary success. Now he doesn't lack money or women, but overwork forces him to neglect his wife. To solve her problems, Angelina is persuaded by a friend to contact Dr. D'Angelo ...
notes: An extremely negligible film by Bruno Corbucci, who tries to recover the lost charm of Carlo Giuffrè.

title: Atomic Twister
actors: Mark Paul Gosselaar, Paul Barrett, Corbin Bersen, Johnny Blick
description: A series of tornadoes hit a nuclear power plant in the state of Tennessee. Of course it is Saturday and the staff has been reduced for the weekend. Only Corinne Maguire, the shift chief, remained to guard. The situation is rapidly deteriorating, so much so that the generator and many control instruments no longer respond to commands. Corinne is forced to declare a state of alarm.
notes: Tv movie directed with television hand by Bill Corcoran. It goes without saying that Mark-Paul Gosselaar is detective John Clark jr. in the TV show "New York Police Departement".

title: Eva
actors: Jeanne Moreau, Stanley Baker, Virna Lisi, Giorgio Albertazzi, James Villiers, Riccardo Garrone, Lisa Gastoni, Checco Rissone, Enzo Fiermonte, Nona Medici, Alex Revidis, Peggy Guggenheim, Evi Rigano
description: A writer becomes infatuated with the prostitute he recently met. For her, he leaves his girlfriend and begins to squander the money he has, not realizing that he is simply being used. Returning to his girlfriend, he marries her but soon reconnects with the other. When the wife discovers the betrayal, she commits suicide, leaving the man to go into a dangerous obsessive drift.

title: Lucky Luke Daisy Town
description: In the small town of Daisy Town, Lucky Luke maintains law and order, who is unparalleled in terms of speed and accuracy with the gun. A new threat comes from the fearsome Dalton brothers, who convince the Indians to attack the settlers: however, they have not reckoned with Luke and his faithful horse Jolly Jumper ...

title: What's the Worst That Could Happen?
actors: Danny DeVito, Martin Lawrence, John Leguizamo, Glenne Headly
description: Kevin is a professional thief who likes classy items. Max, on the other hand, is a ruthless businessman used to always getting what he wants. When the thief enters the businessman's house, which he believes to be empty, he finds the police as well as the owner waiting for him. Max takes revenge by snatching his lucky ring from the thief's fingers: Kevin will do everything to try to recover it ...
notes: The film offers moments of great comedy, with hilarious gags that work on the basis of simple action / reaction mechanisms. Danny DeVito offers an irresistible interpretation, Lawrence gets away with it. Screenplay by Donald E. Westlake.

title: Looking for Alibrandi
actors: Anthony La Paglia, Greta Scacchi, Pia Miranda, Elena Cotta, Kerry Walker
description: 17-year-old Josie Alibrandi is a smart girl who is about to start attending an exclusive Catholic college in Sydney as a fellow. The year that is about to begin will upset his life: he will meet his father for the first time, who left before his birth, will fall in love with the wrong boy and will have to deal with suffering for the first time ...
notes: A training story made with extreme sensitivity. The film, at times happy despite some of the intuitions being worn, faces a crucial year in the maturation of a young woman. And while she grows up, driven by the script and the direction, between two or three cinematic streams, she empathizes and moves away. Alternate

title: Abril despedaçado
actors: Rodrigo Santoro, Ravi Ramos Lacerda, José Dumont, Rita Assemany
description: Brazil, April 1910 in the Inhamuns area. Tonho, second son of the Breves family, is forced by his father to avenge the death of his older brother, the victim of a feud between rival families. The boy knows that if he follows the order he will be killed. Distressed by this prospect and instigated by his younger brother Pacu, he decides to put an end to the barbaric traditions of the crimes committed to safeguard the honor of the family.
notes: Loosely based on the book _Aprile spezzato_ by Ismail Kadaré, the film transfers the atrocious ritual of the feud, from the Albanian context to the Brazilian sertão. Diploma in the predictability of direction and installation. Cottony, phony, gooey.

title: Lovely Rita
actors: Barbara Osika, Christoph Bauer, Peter Fiala, Wolfgang Kostal, Karina Brandlmayer
description: Rita is a restless teenager who cannot adapt to the world around her: her classmates find her indifferent, the professors can't stand her, her parents lock her up in the room to punish her. Then Rita discovers sex thanks to her neighbor and an overly elderly bus driver. But these experiences end up isolating her even more, until the day Rita breaks her limits.
notes: The Austria narrated by the rookie Hausner is halfway between that of "Canicola" and "La pianista", but Rita does not even have the trension to the off-screen and to the metaphysical of Dardenne's Rosetta.

title: Polissons et galipettes
description: It is a dozen short films of the 10s and 20s, intended for private projections or tastings such as Hors-d'Oeuvre in the antechals of brothels.
notes: No artistic claim, and okay. But also (and this is clear) no mediation of the anthology compilers, who leave the viewer without holds to contextualize what they see. Not that the Boudoir of the Avi, for heaven's sake, must be historicized at any cost; But it would have been more sensible, I believe, to know more than the production of these films. For the record we point out a certain predominance of lesbian scenes and violence, a gay butterfly and a dog that is busy with both sexes.

title: The Invisible Circus
actors: Cameron Diaz, Jordana Brewster, Christopher Eccleston, Blythe Danner
description: San Francisco, 1977. Phoebe is about to enroll at university, but feels isolated from everything around her and develops a growing obsession with Faith, her sister who committed suicide six years earlier in Portugal who had joined the Rote Armee Fraktion. The circumstances of the death of Faith, a charismatic creature, are unknown to all. So Phoebe, against her mother's wishes, decides to leave to discover the truth about her tragic end.
notes: Imagine "Years of Lead" crossed with the dossier films of "Donne al bivio". Add a particular vulgarity in bringing up recent history with "artistic" slow motion and tourist pedantry.

title: Resident Evil
actors: Milla Jovovich, Michelle Rodriguez, Eric Mabius, Martin Crewes
description: Something terrible lurks inside the Hive, a vast underground laboratory run by the Umbrella Corporation. Someone has introduced a deadly virus inside that has caused the Red Queen, supercomputer that controls the Hive, to seal the entire structure. Inside it, technicians and researchers remain so trapped that they have turned into zombies. Alice and Rain are tasked with isolating the virus before it threatens Earth.
notes: Those of the writer-director Paul Anderson are only residual and derivative ideas ("Cube - The cube", Carpenter, SF comics, video games) but at least they are ideas. There remains the regret for the snatching suffered by George A. Romero, first consulted by the producers of the film.

title: The Internecine Project
actors: James Coburn, Lee Grant, Harry Andrews, Ian Hendry
description: Robert Eliot, a leading economist at Harvard, secretly spies in London on behalf of an influential American politician, president of an oil company. The latter offers him an important position, as long as he manages to identify and destroy an organization of industrial spies made up of four people who do not know each other. With a brilliant plan, Robert will pit them against each other and enjoy playing the double game ...
notes: Film that owes a lot to the presence of Coburn, glacial and passionate at the same time. Direction at the service of history and guaranteed suspense.

title: Forbidden
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, Adolphe Menjou, Ralph Bellamy, Doroty Peterson
description: Melodrama not completely resolved, with which Capra later declared himself dissatisfied. Lulu (Barbara Stanwych) is a simple provincial girl who marries a journalist in order not to compromise the political career of the man she is in love with. But when her husband declares he wants to go public with some embarrassing secrets about Grover, she kills him.
notes: However, Capra's directorial wisdom manages to make us forget some unhappy moments.

title: Psycho IV: The Begining
actors: Anthony Perkins, Olivia Hussey, Henry Thomas, Warren Frost
description: After three sequels to the famous Hitchcock film, screenwriter Joseph Stefano decides to shoot a presequel, to give Norman Bates a childhood and explain the origins of his murderous madness: the harassment of an authoritarian and suffocating mother leads the child to have mental disorders.
notes: Despite the repetition of overused motifs and themes, the film has a naïve charm of its own.

title: Everything Put Together
actors: Alan Ruck, Justin Louis, Radha Mitchell, Megan Mullally, Catherine Lloyd Burns
description: Angie and Russ have everything they want: they have a nice home, they know several people who are able to help them if they are in trouble and above all they are expecting a baby. But their fulfilling and peaceful existence is shattered by the white death of their creature.
notes: Forster exaggerates a little with the rhetoric of the digital and the hand-held camera, and to avoid the film dossier he ends up in the grand guignol, not retreating in front of any bad effect. But the film has its own unfriendly and not phony roughness, and really stifling moments (like the ending, far from comforting).

title: The Kennel Murder Case
actors: William Powell, Mary Astor, Ralph Morgan, Jack La Rue
description: Detective Philo Vance, released from the detective novels of the writer S.S. Van Dine, finds himself investigating the murder of a mysterious oriental art collector.
notes: The last of the four films in which William Powell plays the famous detective, he is the best of the series: tense and intriguing, supported by the flawless direction of Michael Curtiz.

title: La pupa del gangster
actors: Sophia Loren, Marcello Mastroianni, Aldo Maccione, Dalila Di Lazzaro
description: Giorgio Capitani, known in the milanese world as "Charlie Colletto", is the boss of the "Anonima mignottari", assisted by his accomplice Chopin. Accidentally met one of his "employees", Charlie - infatuated with Rita Hayworth - sees in her a strong resemblance to the diva and elects her to his Pupa, but at the same time he betrays her with Anna: and at the accidental death of the latter, the things get complicated ...
notes: The screenplay is full of clichés, the interpreters make a fool of themselves, the direction has nothing to add to a repetitive parade of curtains. The sympathy of an ironic and sly Mastroianni remains: but it is not enough.

title: Cotton Comes to Harlem
actors: Godfrey Cambridge, Raymond St. Jacques, Calvin Lockart, Judy Pace
description: Deadbeat Jones and Bara Johnson are a pair of black cops with a hothead reputation. The two are on the trail of Deke O'Mailey, a reverend swindler who, with the mirage of a better life in Africa, extorts money from people of color and then hides it in a bale of cotton. When the latter is first stolen and then lost by a gang of thugs, Deadbeat, Bara and the Reverend turn the streets of Harlem upside down in order to find it ...
notes: Entirely shot in Harlem, the film fits into the glorious tradition of American blaxploitation: that is, second-class cinema, devoid of artistic ambitions, but energetic and vital. Based on a novel by mystery writer Chester Himes.

title: Q - The Winged Serpent
actors: Michael Moriarty, Candy Clark, David Carradine, James Dixon
description: New York: a winged snake has made a nest on top of a skyscraper and spends time flitting between buildings, looking for human flesh to feed its young. By chance a runaway thief discovers the nest, but hesitates to declare it to the police.
notes: Shot on a low budget, gory enough, grungy and amused. With a higher than average dose of irony, it's an enjoyable horror with some interesting ideas.

title: Qianxi manbo
actors: Shu Qi, Jack Kao, Tuan Chun-hao, Chen Yi-Hsuan, Takeuchi Jun
description: Taipei: young Vicky works in a nightclub and is split between two men in love with her, Hao-Hao and Jack. The suffocating attention of the first pushes her to escape and take refuge from the more mature Jack, who finds himself in great economic difficulties and out of the blue part for Japan ...
notes: Two environments, a lot of music (no mambi, just techno), a world of plastic and neon lights, the camera close to the characters in long sequence shots, ephemeral sensations, asphyxiation, inertia. And also a hint - not always pleasant - of nervous aestheticism. Widely foreshortened the version circulated in Italian cinemas.

title: Quadrophenia
actors: Phil Daniels, Mark Wingett, Philip Davis, Leslie Ash, Sting
description: London, 1965. Jimmy Cooper, a bellboy in an advertising agency, follows the concerts of his favorites, participates in the furious brawls between Rockers and Mods, is initiated into the drug experience and seeks redemption in music for a life without prospects.
notes: A rock musical that in its best moments (especially the first half) lives on the anger of the British cinema of the Sixties and its realism without concessions. The title is borrowed from a Who album dated 1973 and which is the soundtrack to the film produced by the English group. Promising big screen debut for Sting.

title: Where Love Has Gone
actors: Susan Hayward, Bette Davis, Joey Heatherton, Jane Greer, Michael Connors, Anne Seymour
description: The young Danielle Miller takes revenge for the wickedness with which she is treated by her divorced mother Valerie, by stabbing her lover.
notes: A tense family drama (inspired by the true story of Lana Turner and her lover Johnny Stompanato), dominated by Bette Davis as the sarcastic and ferocious granny.

title: Quando le donne persero la coda
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Senta Berger, Renzo Montagnani, Lino Toffolo
description: Follow-up to "When women had a tail", written by Lina Wertmuller and directed without any conviction yet by Pasquale Festa Campanile. Set in a comic book prehistory, a tribe of cavemen decide to prostitute their women in the hope of financial gain.
notes: Discouraging chronic infantilism.

title: When the Legends Die
actors: Richard Widmark, Frederic Forrest, Luana Anders, Vito Scotti
description: A rodeo champion on the avenue of sunset befriends a red man who is forced to come to terms with the world of whites in spite of himself. Two lives that deal with their own failure and a film that tells the epic of the vanquished with participation, singing the end of the western legend.
notes: The director, producer of "Piccolo grande uomo", films the life of the cowboy, recounting its most squalid aspects and its pathetic aspects.

title: When the Wind Blows
description: Cartoon based on the lucky illustrated book by Raymond Briggs, born from the desire to make healthy black humor on nuclear phobias born in the climate of the cold war: at the outbreak of the third world war a couple of old people try to save themselves from a probable atomic explosion following government instructions.
notes: Acid and surreal, experimental in the style of the drawings, a rare case of a "busy" cartoon.

title: Un singe en hiver
actors: Jean Gabin, Jean-Paul Belmondo, Suzanne Flon, Paul Frankeur
description: Albert Quentin, a mature retired officer, spends his time getting bored in a small town on the French coast: the sudden arrival of the young, reckless and restless Gabriel Fouquet, on the trail of his daughter to be recovered in boarding school, gives him a jolt of vitality and l last chance before finally surrendering to old age.
notes: Modest and without great ambitions, a film only partially redeemed by the presence of great actors: the contrast between the acting styles of Gabin and Belmondo is the only reason of interest. Verneuil (_Noi gangster_, _Il clan dei siciliani_, _Il serpent_) directed without flickers.

title: Riot Gun
actors: Pierre-Loup Rajot, Consuelo De Haviland, Jean-Pierre Sentier
description: Brisson is an innocent man who finds himself in his hand, during a lively workers' protest, a "riot gun", that is, a shotgun with which a trade unionist was killed. Obviously, in a very short time, he becomes the main suspect of the police ...
notes: From a novel by the French writer Gérard Delteil.

title: ...se incontri Sartana prega per la tua morte
actors: Gianni Garko, Gianni Rizzo, Fernando Sancho, Klaus Kinski
description: Tampico and his men attack a stagecoach full of gold, but are eliminated by the men led by Lasky. The latter, in turn freed from his cronies, instead of the loot he finds only stones; meanwhile Sartana observes him in secret, operating his carillon clock ...
notes: First appearance of the spaghetti-executioner par excellence.

title: Letjat zuravli
actors: Tat'jana Samojlova, Aleksej Balalov, Vasilij Merkur'ev
description: Veronika and Boris are two young Muscovites who fall in love with each other just before the outbreak of World War II. Boris must leave for the front and Veronika, left alone, to cope with the economic difficulties of her family, agrees to marry her rich cousin, even though she does not love him. At the end of the war, she will wait for Boris to return from the front, in the vain hope of being able to embrace him again.
notes: One of the first films that lifted the veil of misery and the real condition of women in Russia, in the aftermath of a war that has thrown the country into chaos. The great story and that of the little men, both told without any rhetorical emphasis and with a measure of tone. Palme d'Or in Cannes.

title: Quanto è bello lu morire acciso
actors: Stefano Satta Flores, Giulio Brogi, Alessandro Haber, Angela Goodwin
description: Starting from Ponza with three hundred men, Carlo Pisacane tried to organize a peasant revolution in the South: in Sapri his enterprise was drowned in blood by the Bourbon army.
notes: The narrative development of the film, rather episodic, does not restore the right breath to the historical story. David di Donatello for the director.

title: Sorok pervyi
actors: Oleg Strizenov, Izol'da Uzvickaja, Nikolaj Krjuckov
description: Set during the Russian Revolution, the film revolves around the figure of a Bolshevik soldier who, thanks to her infallible aim, manages to kill the considerable number of forty Tsarist officers. One day he falls in love with an enemy lieutenant he has taken prisoner. When the boy escapes her control to reach a white post, the girl takes up the rifle to make the forty-first victim.
notes: Example of the thaw of Soviet cinema. Between melodrama and realism, the film tells with romantic passion the painful clash between political passion and private feelings. Special Jury Prize in Cannes.

title: Quartet
actors: Isabelle Adjani, Maggie Smith, Alan Bates, Anthony Higgins
description: Ivory works on the novel of the same name by Jean Rhys, drawing from it a cold melodrama; perfect in the rendering of the environment, impeccable in the scenography, effective in the direction of the actors. We are in Paris, in the late 1920s: when her husband is arrested for theft, his wife Marya is hosted by a married couple, soon becoming her guest's lover.
notes: The coldness with which Ivory is often accused here is perfect for a story of cold sentimental mechanisms.

title: Quartetto Basileus
actors: Hector Alterio, Omero Antonutti, Pierre Malet, Gabriele Ferzetti
description: Edoardo is a young musician who joins the three elderly survivors of the Basileus string quartet, who have lost the enthusiasm to play for years. The new member of the group will give new life to their music, but at the same time will undermine the relations between the three musicians much older than him.
notes: Calm reflection on the damage caused by the passing of time and on the sufferings of a defeated generation. Melancholy.

title: Quatermass Conclusion
actors: John Mills, Simon MacCorkindale, Barbara Kellerman
description: The film is the fourth episode of an open television series from "Dr. Quatermass's Atomic Spaceship": a space beam from another galaxy targets teenagers. Professor Quatermass (Mills), an expert in astrophysics, will have to save the kids from extinction.
notes: Rundown science fiction, produced for two pennies: it's always a pleasure.

title: Nous sommes tous des assassins
actors: Marcel Mouloudji, Raymond Pellegrin, Claude Laydu, Louis Seigner
description: A dull and ignorant soldier who survived the Second World War continues to kill once the war is over. When he causes the death of a guard, he is sentenced to the guillotine. His advocate will bring out the social responsibilities of his deviant behavior during the trial.
notes: Cayatte, journalist and lawyer, tackles his favorite theme in the 13th film: the film is a passionate indictment against the death penalty. Sometimes a little didactic, but overall a compelling work. Written by the director with Charles Spaak. Special Jury Prize in Cannes.

title: Wild in the Street
actors: Christopher Jones, Shelley Winters, Diane Varsi, Hal Holbrook
description: A very young singer, an idol of adolescents, wants to become President of the United States: after lowering the minimum age for voting to fourteen, he unleashes a no holds barred war on all people guilty of having become "adults".
notes: Cheap satire, raw workmanship, some original ideas.

title: Sibiriada
actors: Vladimir Sajmolov, Nikita Mikhalkov, Natalja Andrejcenko, Vitalji Solomin
description: Two rival families face off in the small village of Elan in eastern Siberia. The Ustazanin are proletarians, the Solomin, rich landowners. Not even the younger generation can calm the spiral of hatred. Divided into two parts in turn divided into six episodes, a family saga with an epic breath. Special Jury Prize in Cannes in 1979.

title: The Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse
actors: Rodolfo Valentino, Alice Terry, Pomeroy Cannon, Alan Hale
description: The Argentine landowner Madariaga is the progenitor of a large family. Upon his death, the two genders move to Europe with their respective families. At the outbreak of the First World War, Madariaga's favorite nephew, Julio Desnoyers, joins the French army and is confronted by his cousin, who instead militates among the German troops ...
notes: Produced with waste of means by Metro Pictures Corp. (the future Metro Goldwyn Mayer), based on the novel _Los cuatros jinetes del Apocalipsis_ by Vicente Blasco-Ibáñez, scripted by June Mathis, a grandiose fresco of love and war that launched Valentino as a star international.

title: Four Daughters
actors: Claude Rains, Rosemary Lane, Lola Lane, Gale Page
description: A conservatory professor lives with his four daughters: one day one of them falls in love with Mickey, a restless and unstable young man (Garfield), for which a composer who is a friend of his father abandons his betrothed - on the altar. But it will be Mickey himself to convince her to retrace her steps: and to completely disappear from her life, she commits suicide.
notes: Based on a novel by Fannie Hurst, and scripted by Julius Epstein, the film is a dense mixture of comedy, drama and melodrama. Visually very rich, filled with the "physicality" of the protagonists, one of Curtiz's most underrated films.

title: Sierra Maestra
actors: Antonio Salines, Fabian Cevallos, Carla Gravina, Giacomo Piperno
description: The first fictional work by documentary maker Giannarelli is a study of the Latin American guerrillas and the role of intellectuals in Third World revolutionary movements: an Italian journalist is arrested by the military in Venezuela, accused of complicity with the rebels. His ambiguous behavior towards authority will save his life. Sometimes unrealistic and verbose, the best parts are those in which the clear and tense gaze of the documentarian emerges.

title: Quattro mosche di velluto grigio
actors: Michael Brandon, Mimsy Farmer, Jean-Pierre Marielle, Stefano Satta Flores, Bud Spencer, Oreste Lionello, Tom Felleghy
description: The young musician Roberto Tobias is obsessed with guilt for unintentionally taking a person's life. His psychological situation collapses when those closest to him begin to be killed in mysterious circumstances by a faceless killer. Tobias finds himself involved in investigations that threaten to jeopardize his safety ...
notes: In his third direction, Argento constructs a thriller of undoubted charm: overloaded, powerfully ambiguous, seductive in its representation of Evil, so engaging as to really scare. Holes in the script and naivety in the dialogues fail to defuse the visionary charge.

title: The Lord of the Rings
description: The little hobbit Frodo Baggins is commissioned by the magician Gandalf to destroy the evil ring that gives strength and power to the Lord of Evil: to get to the place where the ring will be thrown into the fire, he will have to go through a thousand dangers, accompanied by a varied company of fantastic creatures.
notes: Based on Tolkien's famous novel (but only from the first book that makes up the trilogy), an experimental cartoon that attempts to trace photographic realism. Often confused and boring, it misses the mark: too complex for a childish audience and unsuitable for adult viewing.

title: The Meanest Men in the West
actors: Charles Bronson, Lee Marvin, Lee J. Cobb, Sara Lane
description: The black sheep of the family, the evil Martin (Marvin), first kills his father to speculate on his properties and then tries to frame his brother Harge (Bronson) by setting a trap for him. But Harge will know how to take revenge.
notes: The two directors recover and reassemble some old TV series from the "Il virginiano" series, shot years earlier. The re-edition skilfully exploits the fame of the two protagonists, making the most of their tough attitude.

title: Lord of the Flies
actors: James Aubrey, Tom Chapin, Hugh Edwards, Roger Elwin, Tom Gaman, Roger Allan, David Brunjes, Peter Davy, Kent Fletcher, Nicholas Hammond, Christopher Harris, Alan Heaps, Jonathan Heaps, Burnes Hollyman, Andrew Horne
description: A plane crashes in the middle of the Pacific Ocean: about twenty English children, survivors of the shipwreck, try to organize their life on a desert island. However, the group soon split into two rival gangs and slowly the rationalist order with which the children had tried to solve everyday problems is set up by uncontrollable wild instincts.
notes: Bringing William Golding's novel of the same name to the screen, the theater director Brook undertakes the arduous task of evoking the evil and sick universe of the English writer: he is not always up to the task.

title: That Cold Day in the Park
actors: Sandy Dennis, Michael Burns, Susanne Benton, Luana Anders
description: Frances is a mature spinster who lives alone in an apartment near the park. One day he offers shelter from the rain to a man who looks like a homeless wanderer. Gradually her attentions to the man become more and more pressing, revealing an ill-concealed sexual interest and discovering a world of bourgeois repression and hypocrisy.
notes: Altman in his critique of costumes goes all the way: merciless and uncompromising. When the style of a great director is enough to take on the pain of a world.

title: Blame It on Rio
actors: Michael Caine, Joseph Bologna, Valerie Harper, Michelle Johnson, Demi Moore
description: In crisis with his wife, 50-year-old Matthew takes a vacation by going to Rio with his best friend Victor, who brings his beautiful young daughter Jennifer with him. Between the latter and Matthew there is a spark: the two try to keep the secret; but when Victor learns that a "mature man" has entered Jennifer's life, he asks for help from Matthew, who obviously finds himself in a somewhat embarrassing position ...
notes: Listless is the direction of the glorious Donen in this short-lived comedy with predictable developments, weak and boring despite the sympathy of Caine. Remake of _Un moment d'égarement_ (1977) by Claude Berri.

title: A Lady Takes a Chance
actors: Jean Arthur, John Wayne, Charles Winninger, Phil Silvers, Mary Field
description: A decent young lady who works as a typist in New York takes a vacation in Oregon. The meeting with a brusque and impetuous cowboy will upset her life and make her discover love.
notes: Comedy all played on the clash between opposite characters, which relies on the quarrels and squabbles of the two protagonists. A John Wayne in great shape.

title: Star Spangled Rhythm
actors: Betty Hutton, Bing Crosby, Eddie Bracken, Victor Moore, Ray Milland
description: The girlfriend of a sailor who is returning home does not want to disappoint his expectations and with the complicity of his father makes the boy believe that he has an important role in a large film production company.
notes: In the musical numbers that parade side by side, the major stars of the Paramount stable make their appearance: silly, useless and sparkling.

title: Il signor Robinson. Mostruosa storia d'amore e d'avventure
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Zeudi Araya, Anna Nogara, Percy Hogan
description: Roberto is married to Magda: when the two decide to take a vacation they end up arguing. Roberto would like to go by plane but Magda opts for a cruise, despite her husband hating sea travel. One night the alarm sounds on board but Roberto, convinced that it is an exercise, does not abandon the ship and ends up shipwrecked on a desert island. There he meets a beautiful native, but Magda is on her trail.
notes: A Fantozzian reinterpretation of the myth of Robinson Crusoe. It was born as a parody of the films of Lina Wertmüller but it is nothing more than a weak film, predictable and full of clichés, tailor-made for Paolo Villaggio's comic comic.

title: Czend és kiáltás
actors: Jozsef Madaras, Mari Töröcsik, Andrea Drahota, András Kozák
description: Hungary, 1919: the Republic of Béla Kun falls and the country is shaken by the repression of the army under the command of Admiral Miklós Horthy von Nagybánya. A revolutionary sought for subversion hides in the house of a humble farmer and attracts the sympathies of his wife and sister-in-law: the relationships between the characters will spiral into a spiral of jealousy, suspicion and masochism.
notes: Jancsó's third film, where style, cold and rarefied, reaches its maximum expression. Screenplay by Gyula Hernádi and Miklós Jancsó himself.

title: The Liberation of L.B. Jones
actors: Lee J. Cobb, Lee Majors, Barbara Hershey, Roscoe Lee Browne
description: In a small town in the southern United States, a lawyer defends the arguments of a black man in dispute with his wife who is cheating on him with a white policeman.
notes: Bitter ending for the farewell to the cinema of a great director: the world does not compensate for hopes and illusions. Based on the novel by Jesse Hill Ford. Wyler's latest film.

title: Siluri umani
actors: Raf Vallone, Franco Fabrizi, Andrea Checchi, Ettore Manni
description: War film that reconstructs the attack by a group of soldiers of the Italian Navy on the Port of Suda, on the Aegean Sea. Misunderstandings between the troop and the superiors, difficult maneuvers, moments of tension: the goal will be conquered after many misadventures. With an above-average showmanship rate for Italian cinema, a film that is still struggling to take off. The screenplay is written by Ennio De Concini, Gian Giacomo Cossa and Marc'Antonio Bragadin.

title: Simón del desierto
actors: Claudio Brook, Silvia Pinal, Hortensia Santovena, Jésus Fernández
description: The monk Simone (Brook), after spending six years of his life meditating on top of a column in the Syrian desert, is tempted by the Devil (Pinal) who eventually transports him to the 20th century aboard a jet and abandons him in a New York nightclub. Unfinished due to the misunderstandings with the producer Gustavo Alatriste (who later tried in vain to end it by proposing the thing to directors such as Bellocchio, Rocha, Truffaut, Kubrick) a blasphemous and deeply religious film at the same time. Beautiful figure of the devil in ambiguous female clothes. Despite the incomprehensible ending due to the difficult workmanship, he wins the special jury prize in Venice.

title: Run, Simon, Run
actors: Burt Reynolds, Inger Stevens, James Best, Royal Dano, Rodolfo Acosta
description: An Indian accused unjustly of having killed his brother he gets ten years in prison: when he is put in freedom he returns to his tribe looking for revenge. Shot for TV, a good product with an impeccable packaging. Burt Reynolds enjoys in the part of the Reddosa: the vision is valid only for him.

title: Frühlingssinfonie
actors: Nastassja Kinski, Herbert-Arthur Grönemeyer, Rolf Hoppe
description: The life of the musician Robert Schumann told from the point of view of his tragic love for the beautiful Clara Josephine Wieck, hampered by his father's tenacious attachment to the girl. Two different conceptions of music and life collide on the possession of Clara. The sensuality of the very young Kinski dominates everything, engaging in red-hot love scenes with the handsome musician.

title: The Wedding March
actors: Erich Von Stroheim, Fay Wray, Zasu Pitts, Maude George
description: Prince Nicki von Wildeliebe-Rauffenburg falls in love with Mitzi, the poor daughter of an innkeeper, but her parents, noble on the brink of financial ruin, hope for a wedding with the rich and ugly Cecilia. The butcher, also a pretender to Mitzi's hand, devises a plan to kill the prince in the churchyard where the wedding is celebrated, but the girl manages to make him change his mind.
notes: Uncontainable, overwhelming indictment against the ruling classes, which exercise their petty power over a world on the verge of gambling. The film, in Stroheim's intentions, was to have a second part: but the director managed to prevent its release because it was reworked from the production.

title: Symphonie pour un massacre
actors: Charles Vanel, Claude Dauphin, Michel Auclair, Jean Rochefort, Michèle Mercier, Daniela Rocca, José Giovanni
description: A gang of gangsters devises a plan to steal a drug lot fought over by two drug gangs: the five scammers will face bigger problems than themselves.
notes: Set in Marseille, the film fails to fully exploit the noir atmosphere of the city. Tension is at a minimum, despite the high rate of violence. Screenplay by Claude Sautet and Josè Giovanni. Based on a novel by Alain Reynaud-Fourton.

title: Sauve qui peut (la vie)
actors: Jacques Dutronc, Nathalie Baye, Isabelle Huppert, Anna Baldaccini
description: After eight years of video experimentation, Godard returns to the cinema: divided into five tempos like a musical symphony, in the film the stories of three characters intertwine: an intellectual (Dutronc), his mistress (Baye) and a prostitute (Huppert) - who struggle to find meaning and a center in bourgeois and capitalist society.
notes: Ideal sequel to This is my life, a tired, narcissistic, lucid and disenchanted work. Godard still plays with images and with the paradoxes of the imagination. In Italy it came out with the ban on minors under 18 only in 1984.

title: Situation Hopeless... But Not Serious
actors: Alec Guinness, Michael Connors, Robert Redford, Anita Hoefer
description: Towards the end of the Second World War, the American military sergeant Lucky Finder and Captain Hank Wilson land with a parachute at the home of the Germanic Wilhelm Frick, who welcomes them and hides them in the cellar. When the hostilities end, however, Frick does not warn them and the two continue to remain locked in the basement ...
notes: Some lingering, alternating with some good comic moments, for this film based on the novel _The Hiding Place_ by Robert Shaw and directed by the son of the great German theater director Max Reinhardt. In the cast, an impeccable Guinness and a 28-year-old Redford, here in his second appearance on the big screen.

title: Skidoo
actors: Jackie Gleason, Carol Channing, Frankie Avalon, Groucho Marx
description: A mob boss (Marx) sends a retired gangster (Gleason) to jail with the task of killing another prisoner who is about to give the names of the organization to the authorities. But the chosen one escapes in a hot air balloon and once outside ends up in a community of hippies with the help of which he distracts the boss from his criminal intentions.
notes: Wacky comedy that wobbles at every moment; but sometimes satire works. Screenplay by Doran William Cannon. To be remembered as Groucho's last film appearance.

title: Schlock
actors: Saul Kahan, Joseph Piantadosi, Eliza Roberts, John Landis
description: A prehistoric ape awakens from a sleep that lasted millennia and finds himself in a contemporary city. Pursued by the police, he finds refuge with a blind girl he falls in love with.
notes: Directorial debut by John Landis, who enjoys parodying series B horror films. Under the mask of the monkey created by Rick Baker, there is Landis himself who, with a paltry budget and in thirteen days of shooting, revolted with joyful irony and desecration all childish, clichés and cinematic stereotypes, starting with the myth of King Konk. The term shlock means "garbage" in slang.

title: Smog
actors: Enrico Maria Salerno, Annie Girardot, Renato Salvatori, Casey Adams
description: An Italian lawyer (Enrico Maria Salerno) lands in Los Angeles for work; he spent twenty-four hours there before leaving for Italy. Impressions, small events, bizarre encounters: the alienation and madness of the American city is filtered by the apathetic and amazed gaze of someone who has lost all points of reference.
notes: The director manages to restore the sense of a loneliness that becomes existential and the disorientation of the provincial unable to adapt to the ferocity of human relationships in which only success and competition counts. The screenplay is by Festa Campanile, Franciosa and Ugo Guerra.

title: Okraina
actors: Sergej Komarov, Elena Kuz'mina, Nikolaj Bogoljubov, Hans Klering
description: Two brothers, Nikolaj and Sen'Ka, leave the small industrial town of Tsarist Russia where they grew up and leave for the front at the outbreak of World War II. One voluntary, the other in compulsory military service. During their absence, the situation in the village changes: German prisoners arrive and one of them falls in love with a Russian girl. The outbreak of the October revolution will end up upsetting the destinies of the whole community.
notes: Film viewed with suspicion by the Soviet authorities at the time of its release, but one of Barnet's best known. Dramatic, tragic and funny at the same time, a great fresco that manages to keep under control the complexity of historical dynamics and the truth of the existence of "common people".

title: Sudden Fear
actors: Joan Crawford, Jack Palance, Gloria Grahame, Bruce Bennett
description: San Francisco: A rich and famous playwright marries an actor. By chance she discovers that her husband is working out a plan to kill her and inherit her fortune, in complicity with his young mistress. She decides to devise a plan to trap the evil lovers, but something will go wrong.
notes: Well-made, well-constructed, and best-acted Noir: the actors are all busy bringing up rot, ambiguity and devastating neurosis. Oscar nominations for Joan Crawford and Jack Palance.

title: Le souffle au coeur
actors: Benoît Ferreux, Lea Massari, Daniel Gélin, Michael Lonsdale
description: Dijon, 1954: Laurent Chevalier, a 15-year-old from a good family, is initiated into sex by his mother Clara and experiences a series of experiences that abruptly propel him into adulthood.
notes: Regardless of the noise it aroused, Malle's film demonstrates how a theme (incest), traditionally treated in a tragic and punitive key, can be faced with the unusual tones of comedy. Lightness, disenchantment, zeroing of the usual dialectic between guilt and damnation: these are undoubtedly the most interesting sides of the film, even if the refinement of style ends up transcending here and there in the manner.

title: Kvinnodröm
actors: Eva Dahlbeck, Harriet Andersson, Gunnar Björnstrand, Ulf Palme
description: Two stories run parallel, finding points of contact between them: the director of a photographic studio and one of her models leave Stockholm for a business trip. Both will meet men with whom they can have fleeting affairs without consequences.
notes: The lowest common denominator between the two events is the underlying meanness of the male gender. Andersson brings a playful note to Bergman's filmography.

title: Passionate Friends
actors: Ann Todd, Trevor Howard, Claude Rains, Betty-Ann Davies
description: Mary, married to the banker Howard Justine - a rich man and much older than her - accidentally meets an old lover during a stay in Switzerland. Thinking of a betrayal, the husband asks for a divorce. The girl, desperate, tries to throw herself under the subway, but Howard manages to save her life.
notes: Modest. Based on a novel by H.G. Wells and written by Eric Ambler.

title: Sogno di una notte d'estate
actors: Alberto Lionello, Erika Blanc, Gianna Nannini, Flavio Bucci
description: From Shakespeare's play, Salvatores had already drawn a theatrical performance which in 1982 had been very successful at the Teatro dell'Elfo in Milan. In transferring to the screen the story of Theseus and Hippolyta in the world of Spirits and Elves, the changes are many and not all effective, but the film remains an interesting example of experimental cinema, where dance, music and theater find new ways of coexist and contaminate each other. The African setting for the fantasy world of Oberon and Titania is original

title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
actors: James Cagney, Olivia de Havilland, Dick Powell, Jean Muir
description: The very famous play by Shakespeare where the encounter of Theseus with the fantastic world of Oberon, king of the Elves and Titania, queen of the Spirits is narrated - is evoked by Reinhardt through the choreography of William Dieterle: perhaps a slightly plastered reconstruction, too much linked to the theatrical staging that the director himself had staged a few years earlier in Germany and the United States. Reinhardt's only sound film. Two Oscars: for photography by Hal Mohr and editing by Ralph Dawson.

title: Un aller simple
actors: Jean Claude Bouillon, Nicoletta, Maurice Garrel, Paola Pitagora, Giancarlo Giannini
description: After being involved in the murder of a policeman, Marty a robber expert in illegal gambling dens, worked as a croupier in the underground gambling den of La Balafre in Antwerp, manages to escape to help Tina the girl he loves, who has also ended up in trouble with the law.
notes: Fourth film by José Giovanni, an excellent connoisseur of criminal mechanisms, former dialogue writer and screenwriter: attention to detail and excellent reconstruction of the environment, but overall the film does not live up to the intentions even if it allows the director to address the issues that they are more expensive. Based on a novel by Henry Edward Helseth.

title: Esa mujer
actors: Sara Montiel, Ivan Rassimov, Candida Losada, Mariela Yurfa
description: Soledad Romero Fuentes is a missionary nun who becomes pregnant after being raped. It does not end here. Destiny rages on the poor girl and she will be subjected to increasingly terrible tests: her daughter will be taken away, she will be abandoned by the man she loves and to conclude with a flourish - accused of murder. When it is too much it is too much.

title: Soleil rouge
actors: Charles Bronson, Ursula Andress, Toshiro Mifune, Alain Delon, Capucine
description: Arizona 1870. The Japanese ambassador travels to the Wild West to meet the President of the United States, accompanied by his bodyguard and an ancient sword to bring as a gift. But the train is robbed by a gang of dangerous bandits who also steal the heirloom. The bodyguard will go after them with the help of an outlaw ...
notes: The idea of ??clashing the samurai ethics with the ideology of the Wild West, two immortal icons of classic cinema, is of great strength. The invisible direction of Terence Young, then, is at the service of history. The assembly of the cast is brilliant: seeing Charles Bronson, Alain Delon and Toshiro Mifune together is a great show.

title: Innocent Bystanders
actors: Stanley Baker, Geraldine Chaplin, Donald Pleasence, Dana Andrews, Sue Lloyd, Derren Nesbitt, Vladek Sheybal, Warren Mitchell, Cec Linder
description: A secret agent on his way to retirement manages to track down a Soviet scientist who has escaped from Siberia. Once caught, he attempts to blackmail his superiors, who are suspected of playing a double game.
notes: Not particularly original intrigue for a film that is forgotten in the blink of an eye. Inspired by a short story by James Munro.

title: Il sole sorge ancora
actors: Vittorio Duse, Elli Parvo, Lea Padovani, Massimo Serato, Checcho Rissone
description: One of the few films that attempts a lucid, thorough and scrupulous analysis of the Italian liberation movement. Produced by the National Association of Partisans of Italy, the film starts the day after 8 September. The lives of those who choose the clandestine fight against Nazi-Fascism and the events of those who will soon adapt to a changed historical situation to safeguard their interests, are told with the merciless methods of the historical-social investigation.

title: The Sun Also Rises
actors: Tyrone Power, Ava Gardner, Errol Flynn, Eddie Albert, Mel Ferrer
description: Paris, 1925: an American journalist, a war veteran, leaves for Spain with a group of friends and falls in love with a beautiful, life-hungry compatriot.
notes: Based on the novel "Fiesta" by Hernest Hemingway. Little remains of the American writer's novel, but the excellent cast gives body and passion to an otherwise conventional film.

title: The Sun Shines Bright
actors: Charles Winninger, Arleen Whelan, John Russell, Stepin Fetchit
description: In a small Kentucky town, Judge Priest lives a quiet existence, torn between his job, the town's political life and friends. His sense of duty and justice saves a black man from being lynched, he fights to give a worthy burial to a prostitute - they expose him to community reproaches and the risk of not being re-elected to the city board of directors.
notes: The film that Ford regarded as his favorite. A sum of the Fordian "creed". Based on a short story by Irvin S. Cobb, screenplay by Laurence Stallings.

title: Alone in the Dark
actors: Jack Palance, Donald Pleasence, Martin Landau, Deborah Hedwall
description: A group of crazy people manage to escape from the asylum in which they are hospitalized and once they have gained their freedom they roam around combining all the colors and using their madness as an alibi to not give themselves any limits.
notes: Directorial debut for Sholder, who adds a pinch of drama and the lightness of comedy to an adventure film.

title: Crackers
actors: Donald Sutherland, Jack Warden, Sean Penn, Wallace Shawn, Christine Baranski
description: In San Francisco, Weslake's shabby and clueless gang of thieves tries to hit the pawnshop owned by Garvey. Obviously something will go wrong, and everyone will be left with a fistful of flies in hand.
notes: Malle's fourth American film (after "Pretty Baby", "Atlantic City, USA" and "My Dinner with André") is a real smash. This improvised stars and stripes remake of Monicelli's masterpiece is in fact as colorless and meaningless as ever: a mistaken operation by Universal, despite the fame of the director, the high-sounding cast and the contribution of the great László Kovács to the direction of the photography.

title: Only When I Laugh
actors: Marsha Mason, Kristy McNichol, Joan Hackett, James Coco
description: An actress who is no longer young has some problems with alcohol. After six months in a detox clinic, he faces what's left of his life: a disastrous career and a relationship with a teenage daughter he hasn't seen in years.
notes: Dramatic themes treated with the poisonous disenchantment of comedy. Oscar nominations for Mason, Hackett and Coco. Inspired by the comedy _The Gingerbread Lady_ by Neil Simon.

title: Lonely Are the Brave
actors: Kirk Douglas, Gena Rowlands, Walter Matthau, Carroll O'Connor
description: Misadventures of a cowboy who does not accept the social changes taking place, with the consequent decline of the myth of the frontier and of the ideals of Old America. Anachronistic and maladjusted, the man wanders aimlessly until he ends up in prison. Managed to escape, he took refuge in Mexico. A sad parable about the end of a world and a bitter reflection on the decline of the figure of the cowboy. You can read in filigree the story of the screenwriter Dalton Trumbo, who ended up on the blacklist for his political ideas. Based on Edward Abbey's novel The Brave Cowboy.

title: Sylvie et le fantôme
actors: Odette Joyeux, Pierre Larquey, François Périer, Jacques Tati
description: The ghost (Tati) of an old lover of her grandmother appears to a teenager lost in her world of youthful reveries. Killed in a duel, for the girl he is the embodiment of romantic love. Slowly the girl will return to the real world, ready to meet true love.
notes: A delicate, enchanting fairy tale kissed by the smile of lightness and the gift of intelligence. From a play by Alfred Adam, adapted by Jean Aurenche.

title: Hong Gaoliang
actors: Gong Li, Jiang Wen, Teng Rujun, Liu Ji, Qian Ming
description: A young woman, the daughter of very poor peasants, marries an old and sick landowner against her will. When he dies in mysterious circumstances, he marries one of his employees: together with him he will carry on the traditional manufacture of sake and will have to face the Japanese armies that invade and plunder Manchuria in the 1930s.
notes: The red color slowly invades the film, up to the violent and bloody epilogue: refined colors, poetic inserts and sudden outbursts of violence. Historical fresco and rural saga. First film directed by Yimou and the Golden Bear at the 1988 Berlin Film Festival.

title: Smile
actors: Bruce Dern, Barbara Feldon, Michael Kidd, Geoffrey Lewis
description: In California, small-town girls are agitated by the approach of the date on which they will parade on the catwalk: with a loose and fast structure, the camera investigates their dreams, illusions, vanities and hysteria.
notes: Successful satire on the world of beauty contests, a real obsession of American society. With a good dose of malice, a hint of sarcasm and some momentum of sympathy.

title: Ragazzo di borgata
actors: Stefano Arquilla, Ennio Panosetti, Rita Tushingham, Beba Loncar, Danika La Loggia
description: The sixteen-year-old Ettore Colantuoni, the son of an asphalt worker, has already started the activity of mugger with friends from the neighborhood. He soon becomes convinced that the only purpose of life is to accumulate money by all means, even dishonest ones, and it will be his father who will give him a hand in the "job" ...
notes: Between sketches and Pasolini references.

title: Prima di sera
actors: Paolo Stoppa, Lyla Rocco, Giovanna Ralli, Gaby André, Gianni Cavalieri
