description: After a sleepless night, the resigned insurer Paolo buys a tranquilizer, but in the pharmacy they are wrong and they give him a deadly poison: the alarm goes off and everyone tries to track down the tapino, who however thinks they have discovered a prank of his and hides ...
notes: Pleasant, with a Stoppa in great shape.

title: Armaguedon
actors: Alain Delon, Jean Yanne, Renato Salvatori, Michel Duchaussoy
description: Alain Delon is here in the role of a psychiatrist who puts his professional experience at the service of police commissioner Vivien (Duchaussoy), following in the footsteps of a psychopath who takes inspiration from some verses of the Apocalypse: his targets are some famous people.
notes: Without infamy and without praise, a thriller that lets itself be watched.

title: Il trionfo dei dieci gladiatori
actors: Dan Vadis, Helga Liné, Stanley Kent, Sal Borgese, Gianni Rizzo
description: The Roman proconsul of a region of Asia Minor subject to the Empire orders ten gladiators to kidnap the queen of a rival nation. Behind the mission, however, lies a trap devised by the prime minister for shady purposes of betrayal and power ...
notes: Typical '60s peplum, shot with two pennies and zero ideas.

title: The Abominable Dr. Phibes
actors: Vincent Price, Joseph Cotten, Hugh Griffith, Terry-Thomas
description: Doctor Phibes (Vincent Price) turned into a man with an abominable face following a terrible car accident where his wife lost her life. Escaped but disfigured in the face he takes revenge on all those who did not do everything possible to save his wife, inflicting on them atrocious pains inspired by the ten plagues of Egypt.
notes: Horror antecedent of David Fincher's 'Seven', filmed years later in the film 'Frustazione' enjoys the excellent interpretation of Price in an excessive and theatrical atmosphere.

title: Where the Spies Are
actors: David Niven, Françoise Dorléac, Cyril Cusack
description: The British secret service hires an awkward doctor, Jason Love (David Niven), to solve the case of the disappearance of a secret agent in Lebanon. Rich in his inadequacy, he succeeds with the help of a model who plays the double game.
notes: Pink-tinted spy story in times of 'cold fear' and international conspiracies It succeeds as long as it does not enter the mechanism of the genus.

title: Acciaio
actors: Isa Pola, Piero Pastore, Vittorio Bellaccini, Alfredo Polveroni
description: A worker, employed at the Terni steelworks, is the victim of an accident at work. The companions suspect the guilt of one of his friends, guilty of loving the same woman.
notes: The film is a small case in the history of cinema of the twenty years. Commissioned the subject by Mussolini's political emissaries to the writer Pirandello and, for the execution, to the director, important according to expectations, Ruttmann, the film undergoes slowdowns during the production due to problems of all kinds: from misunderstandings between Pirandello and Ruttmann, to the delusions of grandeur of the playwright's companion, Marta Abba who demands the first part. Despite the obstacles and the bad box office result, the film has its own dignity which lies in being a document of the industrial activity of the Terni steel mills.

title: A che punto è la notte
country: Italy, France, Great Britain, Germany, Sweden
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Max Von Sydow, Angela Finocchiaro
description: A priest during the celebration of the mass dies from the explosion of a candle. The carabiniere in charge of following the case is also murdered. The ball passes into the hand of a detective who has to solve the puzzle.
notes: Few have understood that Mastroianni had the right face to play the part of the commissioner, perhaps existentialist. Here Nanni Loy senses it and, twenty years earlier, Comencini with La donna della Domenica which, among other things, takes place in an identical Turin, under the writing of the same Fruttero and Lucentini, from whose books the films are inspired, and with the same type of plot, crimes to be solved. Loy needs two episodes of more than 100 minutes to solve the problem; but they are movies for television.

title: The Deep Six
actors: Alan Ladd, Dianne Foster, William Bendix, Keenan Wynn
description: During the Second World War, a Quaker naval officer tries to compensate for a past inactivity by leading dangerous missions.
notes: Based on a novel by Martin Dibner, it is one of the last rehearsals directed by Matè who decides to stage the crisis of conscience. Performed with the collaboration of the American Navy.

title: Dark Waters
actors: Merle Oberon, Franchot Tone, Thomas Mitchell, Fay Bainter
description: The uncles with whom a young girl goes to live, orphan of both parents who died tragically, are criminals who, kidnapped and hidden, the two real parents replace them as copies. Discovered the deception, the young woman thinks she is going crazy, but there is always a good doctor who helps if necessary.
notes: A modest thriller in search of an official license from genre cinema: not granted.

title: Actas de Marusia
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, Diana Bracho, Salvador Sanchez
description: A group of striking miners suffers the harsh and violent repression of the military forces, we are at the beginning of the century.
notes: Revolutionary epic and political criticism of the Chilean exile Miguel Littin (dramatic art student and television and theater director) active in Chile until 1973 forced to flee from the Pinochet coup, returned clandestinely with Garcia Marquez who immortalized his journey with agile book 'Miguel Littin, illegal immigrant in Chile'. The film is a clear political denunciation of military tyranny made without emphasis and with adherence to reality.

title: The Night They Raided Minsky's
actors: Jason Robards, Britt Ekland, Norman Wisdom, Elliott Gould
description: One fine day, Rachel Elizabeth Schpitendavel escapes from the protective and suffocating bed of the Amish community in which she lives and lands in chaotic New York. Here she intends to propose herself as a dancer of "biblical" inspiration, but she finds herself - needless to say - in the wrong place: Minsky's, where she is announced as the Parisian "Madame Fifi". Meanwhile, her father Jacob has swooped into town, determined to bring her home ...
notes: Set in the 1920s, a swirling and glowing fresco of the world of burlesque. While struggling with tones unusual for him, Friedkin conducts his amusing, unsettling and irreverent circus with a steady hand from start to finish.

title: Ådalen '31
actors: Peter Schildt, Kerstin Tidelius, Roland Hedlund, Jonas Bergström
description: The Swedish city of Adalen in 1931 was the scene of violent clashes between the striking workers and the police, on the one hand, and the strike-breakers on the other, waiting for a solution, which did not come from the trade unionists and the bosses.
notes: Awarded the special jury prize at Cannes, the film is a close historical reconstruction that yields nothing to the muses of rhetoric.

title: The Dirty Dozen: Next Mission
actors: Lee Marvin, Ernest Borgnine, Richard Jaeckel, Ken Wahl
description: A sequel to one of the great classics of war cinema: this time the convicts recruited to save France from Nazism are called on a mission to kill the Führer.
notes: No surprise for a film born for TV: flat and conventional, still trailing the success of the original. Lee Marvin, eighteen years later, is still the protagonist.

title: That Uncertain Feeling
actors: Merle Oberon, Melvyn Douglas, Burgess Meredith, Alan Mowbray
description: A slightly tarnished remake of an earlier 1925 Lubitch film: _Kiss Me Again_. Neglected by her husband, the beautiful Jill falls in love with a young pianist in return: her spouse, realizing the deception, will in turn make her jealous. Will it turn out well?
notes: Based on the comedy _Divorcons_ by Victorien Sardou and Emile de Najac.

title: Addio fratello crudele
actors: Charlotte Rampling, Oliver Tobias, Fabio Testi, Antonio Falsi
description: Giovanni (Tobias) and Annabella (Rampling) love each other, but they face an insurmountable obstacle for Mantua in 1500: they are half-brothers.
notes: Grand competition of signatures and professionals (Storaro for photography, Morricone for music, Ceroli for scenography) for the adaptation of an Elizabethan drama by John Ford, 'Peccato che è una squaldrina', which does not fly high above the murky of a story of incest.

title: Susana - Demonio y carne
actors: Rosita Quintana, Fernando Soler, Victor Manuel Mendoza, Maria Gentil
description: In a night of lightning and thunder, Susana invokes, locked in the cell of the reformatory, the 'god of the desperate' to give him freedom from prison. Shortly after, the railing comes off and Susana escapes into the stormy night. He reaches a ranch where he is welcomed and hosted by lying about his origin and provenance. Blonde and provocative, with the vertigo of her neckline, she upsets the equilibrium of the ranch until she is arrested by the gendarmes.
notes: The original title 'Susana', a symbolic name of chastity for the Bible, and the subtitle 'demonio y carne' already clearly express the elements of ambiguity surrounding Buñuel in his fourth Mexican film. Credited to the genre of 'rachero melodrama', with a final imposed by the production, it is indeed a sarcastic apology of the bourgeois and moralistic world.

title: Death Trap
actors: Neville Brand, Mel Ferrer, Stuart Whitman, William Finley, Carolyn Jones, Marilyn Burns, Roberta Collins, Kyle Richards, Robert Englund, Crystin Sinclaire, Janus Blythe, Betty Cole
description: Judd is an old psychopath who lives in Louisiana near a swamp. He owns a dilapidated motel and has a passion for blood: to kill his victims he pushes them into the jaws of a crocodile.
notes: Cultured and aware horror, behind which many of the neuroses and phobias of America in the late 1970s can be read in filigree. Nocturnal and claustrophobic, with some really nice sequences.

title: Tap Roots
actors: Van Heflin, Susan Hayward, Boris Karloff, Julie London
description: The Civil War is raging, but the Dabneys want to stay away from it and continue their quiet life. But the fiancé (Heflin) of the eldest daughter (Hayward) enlists and leaves as a soldier alongside the Confederates. On his return to the city, he will bring with him the memory of the war to those who did not want to see it.
notes: A "Gone with the Wind" in a minor key.

title: Querelle
actors: Brad Davis, Franco Nero, Jeanne Moreau, Laurent Malet, Hanno Pöschl, Günther Kaufmann, Burkhard Driest, Roger Fritz, Dieter Schidor, Natja Brunckhorst, Robert Van Ackeren, Werner Asam, Isolde Berth, Axel Bauer, Neil Bell
description: The ship on which Querelle is embarked docks in Brest. In the corner of the city, the sailor weaves a series of clandestine relationships: he reports the murderer Gil, with whom he is in love, to the police; then he seduces his brother's lover and lets himself be possessed by the owner of the port restaurant, while the ship's captain has a secret passion for him ...
notes: Completely set in the studio, mannerist and theatrical, emphatic and shamelessly sincere, cold as death: inspired by the novel of the same name by Jean Genet, the extreme, pessimistic (and posthumous) reflection of the unforgettable Bavarian author on a humanity devoted to sadism and unhappiness.

title: Woman in a Dressing Grown
actors: Yvonne Mitchell, Anthony Quayle, Sylvia Syms, Andrew Ray
description: A middle -aged man seeks comfort, from the grayness of twenty years of marriage and from the scarce attractions of his twenty years of wife, in the seductive and young colleague of office.
notes: Lindsay Anderson defined this film, scripted by the hated Ted Willis the most prolific television screenwriter of the decade, a British exponent of the vein of the small proletarian realism introduced in America by Paddy Chayefsky, as a "neo-aged realistic" film: a small suburban story with one inappropriate enamel ". The character played by Yvonne Mitchell guaranteed him a prize at the Berlin Festival.

title: Night Watch
actors: Elizabeth Taylor, Laurence Harvey, Billie Whitelaw
description: A widowed woman (Taylor) under the effects of a severe nervous breakdown suffers, during the long sleepless nights, from hallucinations and macabre nightmares. The comfort of loved ones is useless, not even that of the ex-husband, who show ulterior motives and little interest.
notes: Made to measure for Liz Taylor, from dresses to history. We could have done without it.

title: A Family Affair
actors: Mickey Rooney, Lionel Barrymore, Cecilia Parker, Spring Byington
description: Mr. Hardy is the honest and blameless judge of a fictional Illinois town, Calver. The intransigence of his work will lead him to prevent the construction of an aqueduct, a decision that will lead to the hostility of the citizens of the town of Calver and also that of his own family.
notes: The judge's son is Micky Rooney who took the film and the character he portrayed to such levels of popularity that he persuaded the producers to multiply him in a series of fifteen films all centered around the life and adventures of the Hardy family. Cinema to scale for an anthem of American middle values.

title: Rage at Dawn
actors: Randolph Scott, Forrest Tucker, J. Carrol Naish, Mala Powers
description: Two secret agents to unmask the wrongdoings of a gang of criminals who operate undisturbed, under the cover of sheriffs and corrupt magistrates, in Indiana, organize the assault on a train. Captured, they are imprisoned and executed without the possibility of defense.
notes: Western produced by Rko based on a McCoy book. The elements of the detective story redeem him from the genre he attends badly.

title: Robert et Robert
actors: Charles Denner, Jacques Villeret, Macha Meril, Jean-Claude Brialy
description: Taxi driver Robert Goldman and wannabe traffic cop Robert Villiers both face the same problem: a possessive mother who prevents them from finding true love. To dissolve the psychological block, but above all to find a wife, they turn - separately - to the same marriage agency, the one directed by the unscrupulous Jacques Millet: here they will cross their destinies but they will not find the woman of their dreams, but a sincere friend .. .
notes: Could it be an undeclared "gay movie"? In any case (and in spite of the verve lavished by Denner and Villeret), Lelouch has certainly done better.

title: The Trap
actors: Richard Widmark, Lee J. Cobb, Tina Louise, Earl Holliman, Lorne Greene
description: On behalf of a criminal boss, lawyer Ralph Anderson arrives in Tula, a remote location in the heart of the Californian desert where his father (the local sheriff), brother Tippy and Linda, a former flame of his now married to Tippy himself, live. . The tension mounts ...
notes: Strange melodrama tainted with suspense.

title: Dakota Incident
actors: Linda Darnell, Dale Robertson, John Lund, Ward Bond
description: Assault on the stagecoach. Indians shoot showers of arrows at a mismatched group of white civilians in the shelter of a stagecoach: a woman with an unclear past, a bank robber and a politician.
notes: Clone films, but not very convinced, of the western genre, of the _Ombre rossa_ series. It always works.

title: L'Agnese va a morire
actors: Ingrid Thulin, Stefano Satta Flores, Massimo Girotti, Michele Placido, Aurore Clément, Ninetto Davoli, William Berger, Flavio Bucci, Rosalino Cellamare, Alfredo Pea, Bruno Zanin, Eleonora Giorgi, Johnny Dorelli, Dina Sassoli, Gabriella Giorgelli
description: Agnese, an illiterate washerwoman from the Comacchio valleys, lavishes her affection and her care on her husband Paolo, a convinced Marxist who, despite the handicap from which she suffers (is almost paralyzed), carries out clandestine political activities. When Paolo is deported and killed by the Germans, Agnes reacts by joining a group of partisans as a relay ...
notes: For the first (and only) time, an episode of the Resistance focuses on a female protagonist, played by an intense Thulin. Adapting the novel of the same name by Renata Viganò, released in 1949, Montaldo pushes the pedal of emotion but manages to keep the emphasis sufficiently in check.

title: Agostino - La perdita dell'innocenza
actors: Ingrid Thulin, Paolo Colombo, John Saxon, Mario Bartoletti
description: The young Agostino (Colombo) lives a morbid relationship with his mother to the point of being shocked by the story that the widowed woman has with a man much younger than her.
notes: The film delves, not without recklessness, into the murky atmospheres of a teenager's loss of innocence. Taken from a novel by Moravia and brought to the screen thanks to the translation into a screenplay by Bolognini himself and Goffredo Parise, he received accusations but was defended by the author of the book.

title: Taxi zum Klo
actors: Frank Ripploh, Bernd Broaderup, Orpha Termin, Peter Fahrni
description: Frank and Bern are a gay couple. The former works during the day, as a teacher, and goes out at night for sexual adventures; the second, Bern, devoted to home life, suffers from the excessive vitalism of his partner.
notes: AIDS had not yet arrived to definitively censor this gay-pride movie which in unsuspecting times (today the trend is intense) tells the other side of the world with irony and fun.

title: A nos amours
actors: Sandrine Bonnaire, Maurice Pialat, Evelyne Ker, Dominique Besnehard
description: A wealthy young woman looks for new emotions and casually switches from one love to another. The fifteen-year-old on a break with her family decides to leave for America with one of her boyfriends.
notes: Pialat gives an extraordinary character to an extraordinary Sandrine Bonnaire, here in her first role in the cinema. The analysis of adolescent anxieties reaches important heights with this film.

title: Aiutami a sognare
actors: Mariangela Melato, Anthony Franciosa, Orazio Orlando, Alexandra Stewart
description: Forced to take refuge with her children in the mountains to escape the Germans, a young widowed woman finds a moment of sweet love with an American pilot forced to make an emergency landing.
notes: Pupi Avati signs a romantic story filling it with ballads and sings. He also makes a version for television that takes three hours to be believable.

title: Help!
actors: John Lennon, Paul McCartney, George Harrison, Ringo Starr
description: The Beatles are chased across seas and mountains by a dangerous oriental sect and two mad scientists. The reason? Ringo Star, the legendary drummer of the group, has come into possession of a ring considered sacred by the members of the sect.

title: Aladdin
description: A little street thief, Aladdin, madly in love with Princess Jasmine, finds a lamp that he discovers to be magical. It holds captive a genius whose destiny is to grant three wishes to the owner of the lamp. The road seems clear but the lamp is stolen by the evil Jafar. It will be necessary the intervention of the genius who will receive freedom as a reward.
notes: Film homage to Arab culture, despite the incident of a song with an anti-Arab spirit soon canceled, while another, A Whole New World, will receive the Oscar. Disney's Spielberg film has invasive special effects capable of transforming the icon of the genius into a genius of transformation that from Ed Sullivan becomes a slot machine. The Italian voice is from Proietti which has nothing to do with the protean voice of Robin Williams.

title: The Strange Door
actors: Charles Laughton, Boris Karloff, Michael Pate
description: Alan is a mad count who has kept his brother locked up in a castle cell for twenty years, guilty of marrying the woman he was in love with. Not content with the torture made to suffer his brother, the count forces the niece daughter of that brother to marry a little good, to imprison them in turn. The servant takes over to resolve the situation, freeing everyone.
notes: From Stevenson with terror, a horror in the hands of a novice Pevney.

title: Great Day in the Morning
actors: Robert Stack, Virginia Mayo, Ruth Roman, Raymond Burr
description: Gold fever doesn't spare the Colorado Civil War either, where groups of Northern and Southern partisans clash with gold seekers, while a man suffers from lovesickness for a woman.
notes: A good cast and good photography come to this late western that compensates for action with introspection.

title: The Ox-Bow Incident
actors: Henry Fonda, Dana Andrews, Anthony Quinn, Henry Morgan
description: In a small Nevada village, three men are wrongly accused of stealing cows. Without giving them the opportunity to defend themselves and despite the opposition of two cowboys, the three alleged thieves are executed on the gallows. The next day it turns out that they were innocent.
notes: In 1943 Wellman created the neo-western in one fell swoop by sewing the stylistic codes of what would be defined as the realist western around a story of intolerance. Based on a short story by Walter Van Tilburg, scripted by Lamar Trotti, with the exteriors shot in the studio due to production cuts, this film is a relentless and cruel account of the Umanian psychology on the borders of the frontier.

title: Hôtel du Nord
actors: Annabella, Jean-Pierre Aumont, Arletty, Louis Jouvet, André Brunot
description: Pierre and Renée, two young lovers fleeing from family members who want to divide them, take refuge in a hotel on the Saint-Martin canal. They decide to commit suicide: Pierre shoots his girlfriend but only wounds her, and then does not find the courage to turn the weapon against himself. He constitutes himself while she, healed, gets hired as a waitress in the same hotel. They will meet again during the feast of July 14, renewing the promise of death ...
notes: In his fourth film, Carné proves that he knows how to combine romanticism and cynicism. Screenplay by Jean Aurenche and Henri Jeanson, scenography by Alexandre Trauner, music by Maurice Jaubert.

title: L'albero dalle foglie rosa
actors: Renato Cestié, John Richardson, Carmen Scarpitta, Angela Goodwin
description: Little Marco is traumatized by the news of the separation of his parents. One day when he leaves the house he will be hit by a car.
notes: Directorial debut of the former director of photography Armando Nannuzzi who moves the threads of a delicate but mellow story.

title: Drewo Shelanija
actors: Lika Kawtaradse, Sosso Ciaschwliani, Tamina Tuajewa, Sofiko Ciaureli
description: In a Caucasian village of the early twentieth century, life is told starting from a dramatic event: the death of a couple of young people.
notes: The film by the Georgian director Abuladze, based on the novel by the writer Inanischwili, is an evocative example of a cinema of poetry that uses painting as a high place for a reinterpreted figuration in the service of the seventh art. Between idealism and realism: the world according to Abuladze.

title: Al di là del bene e del male
actors: Dominique Sanda, Erland Josephson, Robert Powell, Virna Lisi
description: A woman and two men try to build a sentimental triangle in late 19th century Rome. But the joined sides soon separate in sketched straight lines: one becomes homosexual, the other goes mad, and the woman who is the real engine of the story becomes a proto-feminist virginity.
notes: Inspired by the real story between Nietszche, Paul Rée and Lou Von Salomé, scripted together with Italo Moscati is a film weighed down by high intentions and scenographic pomp, without considering the simplism of some solutions.

title: Alfa Tau!
actors: Attori non professionisti
description: An Italian submarine sets sail in the aftermath of the license granted to its sailors. At sea a submarine rams causing it to sink.
notes: A commissioned film, the third and last production of the Centro Cinematografico della Marina ("Men on the bottom" and "The white ship") enjoys its own documentary dignity that does not break down the doors of military and fascist rhetoric.

title: Horí, má panenko
actors: Václav Stökel, Josef Svet, Jan Vostrcil, Josef Sebánek, Karel Valnoha
description: A group of firefighters from a Bohemian town decide to celebrate their 80-year-old commander. But good intentions fail when lottery prizes are stolen and a neighborhood house burned down.
notes: Forman, in his latest film in his native land, takes a shot at Czechoslovak society by earning the censorship of the then president Novotny and the fiery protest of the firefighters. Produced by Carlo Ponti, the original title, far more evocative than this sad translation, sounds in the verse of a song contained in the film, "Burn my girl".

title: Wings
actors: Charles Rogers, Richard Arlen, Clara Bow, Jobyna Ralston
description: The war of '15 -'18 sees two friends fighting on the same side who in private were vying for love for the same woman. The war will bring the tragic solution: Jack will accidentally kill his friend David who had taken possession of an enemy plane.
notes: Oscar for best film, the first in the history of cinema, to a Wellman who by hand manages to restore the spectacularity of the fights with a casual and effective direction.

title: Beyond a Reasonable Doubt
actors: Dana Andrews, Joan Fontaine, Barbara Nichols
description: A newspaper owner wants to campaign against the death penalty. To demonstrate the injustice and immorality of the criminal solution, he convinces his future son-in-law to accuse himself of the murder of a dancer who was left without guilty, in order to demonstrate, by bringing proof of the writer's extraneousness, the fallibility of human judgment. Once in prison, the writer's son-in-law will remain there because whoever had to clear him dies.
notes: Tense and perfect parable of the master Lang at the last test in America. Underestimated by the criticism of the time, it slips into a perfect mechanism that undermines the security of those who believe in the existence of a single truth.

title: Two Way Stretch
actors: Peter Sellers, Wilfrid Hyde-White, Lionel Jeffries
description: A handful of convicts about to leave for the end of detention organize a diabolical coup: they try to escape, without being noticed, the time necessary to carry out a coup and return to prison immediately after, with an iron alibi.
notes: Robert Day, draw this strange 'jailmovie' between one Tarzan and another. But Peter Sellers is still Peter Sellers.

title: Alice's Restaurant
actors: Arlo Guthrie., Patricia Quinn, James Broderick, Pete Seeger
description: A deconsecrated church is the place chosen by Alice and Ray to form an alternative community that gathers the orphaned children of the late sixties. Among them is Arlo, a young rocker who comes to the community after being kicked out of the college where he enrolled at the age of 18 to avoid military service. The community life experience ends for Arlo when he has to go home to his ailing father. On his return he will find that everything has changed.
notes: In the midst of the 1968 revolution, Arthr Penn signs his tribute, ironic and dramatic at the same time, dedicated to the new 'beat' generation and to the dreamy and lost generation emerging from the American scenario. Based on an autobiographical talking-blues by Arlo Guthrie, son of the more famous Woody (also honored in a moving scene), the soundtrack is a classic from Mitchell to Sherman.

title: The Jolson Story
actors: Larry Parks, Evelyn Keyes, William Demarest
description: Cantor Al Jolson lives for singing and exercises this passion of his at the Washington synagogue. The father who at first hinders his son is subsequently convinced by his tenacity and supports him in the success of a dazzling career.
notes: Biographical film on the life of Asa Yoeson, aka Al Jolson (1886-1950) who was awarded the Oscar for the best arrangements.

title: The Dark Past
actors: William Holden, Nina Foch, Lee J. Cobb, Adele Jergens
description: Al Walker escapes from prison after murdering the warden he was holding hostage. Taking refuge in a villa inhabited by a psychoanalyst and his friends, he is, in spite of himself, subjected to a night of psychological excavation and psychoanalytic therapies that will lead him to become constituted with the help of all the guests, including intellectuals.
notes: One of the first examples of a correct application of psychoanalytic theories, which would now make us smile for naivety, is a pedagogical noir, with incisive use of black and white, taken from a play by James Warwick, in turn already translated into films by Charles Vidor with the title "Blind alley".

title: Alla mia cara mamma nel giorno del suo compleanno
actors: Paolo Villaggio, Lila Kedrova, Eleonora Giorgi, Antonino Faà Di Bruno
description: The thirty-year-old Federico still lives in cotton wool thanks to the possessive care of his mother countess. She distracts herself with rubber dolls and obscene photos until the handsome maid Angela arrives. The mother will not let him go with her.
notes: Based on a Spanish comedy by Rafael Azcona and Luis Berlanga, it is the further manifestation of dirty and gigantic Italian cinema.

title: All'armi siam fascisti
directors: Lino Del Fra, Cecilia Mangini, Lino Micciché
description: Documentary film that reconstructs, with an evident but useful particular vision, the events that gave Italy the twenty years of fascism, in a montage that connects causes and effects, from the support of agricultural and industrial capitalism to the connivance of foreign states. Carried out by Franco Fortini's commentary with voice off, it remains the best of the three editing films released between '61 and '62.

title: 10:30 P. M. Summer
actors: Melina Mercouri, Romy Schneider, Peter Finch, Julian Mateos, Isabel Maria Perez
description: Father, mother, daughter and friend travel through Spain. The parents are in crisis and the presence of the charming friend does not help the attempts of his wife who, disheartened, watches the strange game of attraction of her seduced husband. During the journey Maria, his wife, discovers the refuge of a murderer who promises to help but the next day finds him suicidal. Yet another disappointment plays a bad trick and Maria disappears.
notes: Jules Dassin seeks a world of images for Marguerite Duras' fifth screenplay, based on a short novel. The effort to turn the story is evident, so overexcited by literary intellectualisms that little play with cinema.

title: Our Relations
actors: Stan Laurel, Oliver Hardy, James Finlayson, Alan Hale, Sidney Toler
description: Laurel and Hardy live their middle-class life happily between parties and work until, by chance, they meet their respective twin brothers, two sailors on a franchise with a mission: to deliver a package containing a diamond ring.
notes: It is the first film produced by Stan Laurel that recalls the classic farcical of the meeting of the twins. At times irresistible.

title: The Smiling Lieutenant
actors: Maurice Chevalier, Claudette Colbert, Miriam Hopkins, George Barbier
description: A slightly too cheerful lieutenant mistakenly addresses an affectionate wink to the daughter of the king of Flausenthurm and is therefore forced to marry her, betraying his true love for his lover Frizi. The disappointment is so strong that the poor lieutenant is unable to pay off his marriage debts were it not for the amatory lessons given by the skilled, and now also generous, lover Frizi to the unwary princess.
notes: Classical Viennese operetta set in the mountains in the company of kings, princesses and lieutenants from "Dreams of a waltz" (1907) by Leopold Jacobson and Felix Dormann and from Hans Muller's novel "Nuxs, der Prinzertraum" and set to music by Oscar Strauss . All elements that play with Lubitsch's skill and his power of visual invention which is also valid when, as in this case, the mechanisms of the comedy become rigid. The musical inserts are the background to a Europe erected in papier-mâché.

title: Hallelujah!
actors: Daniel L. Haynes, Nina Mae McKinney, William E. Fountaine
description: The young black boy Zeke, in town to sell his crops, ventures into a gambling den and there he falls victim to a trap set by the beautiful Chiki and the swindling owner. Unleash a fight to react to the ambush where the brother who came to rescue him is killed. The pain is such as to transform Zeke into a preacher and a man of good will, a will that goes so far as to forgive the beautiful Chiki and convert her, he believes, but this is not the case because the fatal woman resumes contact with the swindling master. Zeke discovers them and kills him earning him a year in jail from which he will come out and return to the plantation.
notes: Vidor's first sound film that actually plays with the musical in an almost absence of dialogue. Shot entirely on location on Southern plantations, it features non-professional black actors. Oscar nominee for directing.

title: Nära livet
actors: Eva Dahlbeck, Ingrid Thulin, Bibi Andersson, Max Von Sydow
description: Three women are in the same room of a gynecological clinic: the first following an abortion, the other two, one happily married, the other single mother, about to give birth. Dynamics of solidarity are established between the three female comrades in the dormitory, especially after the death of one of the unborn children.
notes: Almost a film commissioned by the Swedish government in full campaign against the indiscriminate use of abortion, based on two short stories by the writer Ulla Isaksson, shot by Bergman with a light hand compared to the much heavier one of the previous "The place of strawberries" and "The Seventh Seal". Award for best direction in Cannes and ex aequo to the four actresses.

title: La rupture
actors: Stéphane Audran, Jean-Pierre Cassel, Michel Bouquet
description: An unscrupulous businessman hires a rogue scoundrel to tarnish the reputation of his daughter-in-law and thus prevent her from divorcing her husband, the son of the industrialist and a writer of little fame ...
notes: A subdued Chabrol: his final appearance does not save this portrait of a bourgeois family, subtle and refined but not very incisive.

title: Alphabet City
actors: Vincent Spano, Kate Vernon, Michael Winslow
description: All in one night. Johnny meets up with his friend Lippy, a weird cocaine dealer. The two organize the fire of an apartment building, commissioned by the local underworld. It seems clear that Johnny must be the one to start the fire before dawns. Too bad that the boy's mother and sister live in the building in question. The young man tries to call himself out, but the noose of the mafia is tightly tied to his neck: someone, in fact, has taken his girlfriend and their newborn son hostage ...
notes: Amos Poe, independent director, succeeds in the attempt to elaborate a difficult noir, tense and dry, indebted to a long tradition. Nile Rodgers of Chic signs the soundtrack.

title: You Can't Win'Em All
actors: Tony Curtis, Charles Bronson, Michèle Mercier, Patrick Magee
description: Turkey, 1920s: while a tough war rages between revolutionaries and the sultan's faithful, two Americans try to sell weapons while living a conflicted friendship ...
notes: Minor film for the Curtis-Bronson couple, which thanks to the combination of two very different types could give more surprises.

title: Les malheurs d'Alfred
actors: Pierre Richard, Anny Duperey, Jean Carmet
description: At the moment of the final act, an would-be suicide meets a woman who promises him another life: that of television. But the bad star has not set.
notes: Pierre Richard directs himself and does it with skillful amusement. The sociological criticism of the television system does not belong to him, in fact the best are the simple and effective gags.

title: Le grand blond avec une chaussure noire
actors: Pierre Richard, Bernard Blier, Jean Rochefort, Mireille Darc
description: A violinist one day unexpectedly wears two different types of shoes, something that does not escape the espionage that makes him the object of a fight between two French bigwigs.
notes: The film will be worth Pierre Richard's international accreditation for its comic qualities and for the irresistible gags it stages and which in this case save an otherwise unattractive film.

title: L'altra donna
actors: Francesca De Sapio, Fantu Mengasha, Marisa Merlini, Edmund Purdom
description: Regina, an Ethiopian girl who emigrated to Rome (where she works as a waitress), meets Olga, a lonely and insecure bourgeois: a friendship is born between them, veiled by differences and influenced by their respective destinies ...
notes: Del Monte sharpens his style and his poetics, in a difficult balance between rhetoric and chamber realism.

title: Another Part of the Forest
actors: Fredric March, Ann Blyth, Edmond O'Brien
description: The Hubbard family discounts, in the intestine struggle between father and son, the illegitimate accumulation of wealth. The son will blackmail his father and daughter Regina will abandon the roof of the house.
notes: This is a prequel of colorless "small foxes" and not very gifted. The artisan system and a sober direction, however, guarantee goodness, thanks also to level characteristics.

title: Un autre homme, une autre chance
actors: James Caan, Geneviève Bujold, Francis Huster, Jennifer Warren
description: What do a Parisian photographer back from the commune and an American veterinarian do in the Wild West of 1878?
notes: American sequel to _Un uomo, una donna_, which Lelouch himself had brought to success on European soil. This Americanized version is laconic.

title: Love Me Tonight
actors: Jeannette MacDonald, Maurice Chevalier, Charles Ruggles, Myrna Loy
description: A tailor with high hopes, as well as good looks, has the chance of a lifetime: presented as a baron by Viscount de Varèze - who would like to be paid for his services - he is introduced to high society, where he arouses the love of the princess ...
notes: A classic of the musical, credited as a masterpiece just three years after the advent of sound. Mamoulian starts from the musical score of Richard Rodgers and Lorenz Hart. The screenplay by Hoffenstein, Young and Marion jr. in turn is inspired by the play by Paul Armont and Leopold Marshand, weaving a film that perfectly harmonizes music and choreography.

title: Bullfighter and the Lady
actors: Katy Jurado, Robert Stack, Joy Page, Gilbert Roland
description: The inflamed and black eyes of Chelo Estrada conquer the heart of an American sportsman who suffers the charm of women and her passion for bullfights so much that he is introduced into the art of "matar los toros" by his champion friend.
notes: The master of the western Budd Boetticher struggling with a subject produced and controlled by the master father John Wayne who cuts half an hour in the editing phase. Cuts that do not obscure Boetticher's art of shooting that are enough for all bullfighting scenes.

title: L'amante di Gramigna
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, Stefania Sandrelli, Ivo Garrani
description: In Sicily in the second half of the nineteenth century, a farmer, who turned into a bandit to relieve himself of the conditions which the abuses forced him, died under the fire of the Piedmontese armies.
notes: Carlo Lizzani, writing a novel by Giovanni Verga with Ugo Pirro, attempts a socio-political reading of the present through the facts of the past. But the system does not hold up and the habits of this kind prevail over the requests.

title: L'amant de Lady Chatterley
actors: Danielle Darrieux, Leo Genn, Erno Crisa, Berthe Tissen
description: Lady Chatterley, wife of an English nobleman unable to satisfy her because it is crippled, vents her sexual craving with the Guardian until it is pregnant. Her husband, aware, closes an eye, but reopens him when his wife asks that her lover recognize her unborn child ...
notes: Taken from the novel by H.D. Lawrence, the version of Allégret does not enhance the iconoclastic of the subject so much so that it transforms it into a common love and betrayal story.

title: Chikamatsu Monogatari
actors: Kazuo Hasegawa, Yoko Minamida, Eitaro Shindo, Kyôko Kagawa
description: In Kyoto in the seventeenth century a woman and a man, unjustly accused of being the protagonists of adultery, run away together and the flight soon turns into a love flight whose power does not censor them in public, earning them, according to the medieval laws that punish adultery with death, crucifixion. The forgiveness of her husband and the help of his father will not help.
notes: Presented at the Cannes Film Festival in 1955 and recognized as one of the best films by maestro Mizoguchi, it is a hymn to the freedom of love against the rules of rigid Japanese society. The original subject is based on a drama 'bunraku', 'puppet theater', which is resolved by Mizoguchi in the form of a legendary story according to the tradition of the Japanese 'monogatari'.

title: Cela s'appelle l'aurore
actors: Georges Marchal, Lucia Bosé, Gianni Esposito, Julien Bertheau
description: A young idealist doctor goes against social and bourgeois conventions by carrying out a series of acts of disobedience that excommunicate him from the community of the port town where he practices: he hides in his house a worker friend guilty of killing the boss who had unjustly fired him; hinders the wife's dream of happiness and betrays the expectations of the father-in-law; crown her dream of love by joining her beloved friend.
notes: Buñuel returns to Europe after decades of Mexican cinema and adapts an anti-bourgeois story from the novel by Emmanuel Roblés. The original title 'Cela s'appelle l'Aurore' is taken from the finale of Giraudoux's "Elettra", later taken up by Godard in "Prénom Carmen". The release in theaters caused not a few scandals and protests from all circles, including Claudel's daughter because Buñuel frames the book of the Academician of France with a pair of handcuffs on it.

title: Les amants
actors: José-Luis De Villalonga, Jeanne Moreau, Jean-Marc Bory, Alain Cuny
description: Jeanne Tournier, rich and bored lady of the provincial bourgeoisie, undergoes and provokes the charm of the Parisian dandy Bernard, to the point of questioning the ease and certainties of married life.
notes: Malle's third film provoked indignant reactions from right-thinking people and the official Vatican press, when in 1959 it was presented in Venice in the edition awarded with the Silver Lion. What was particularly disturbing was the nocturnal love scene, with the two protagonists illuminated by the moon, which aroused - among others - the enthusiasm of François Truffaut. To be reviewed, despite the fact that the impact has faded a little over the years.

title: House of Strangers
actors: Edward G. Robinson, Luther Adler, Debra Paget
description: An Italian who emigrated to America successfully attempts the social ladder of barber and banker, not without colluding with the offense. Struck by a scandal, one of the three sons immolates himself by taking on the sins and ending up in jail for this. Only later will he discover that the spy left the family home and the voice of one of the three brothers. Revenge is the only answer.
notes: Joseph L. Mankiewicz stages a solid family drama with one eye on Shakespeare and another on the grim reality of emigration and his underwater world. Awarded at Cannes in 1950, he inspired the western "The Lance that Kills" of '54.

title: The Bitter Tea of the General Yen
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, Nils Asther, Gavin Gordon, Toshia Mori
description: In Shanghai, an American lay missionary, unwillingly detained by a Chinese general, reluctantly suffers the fascination of the military. The ending is unforgiving.
notes: Unusual Goat film made in the wake of the success of "Shanghai Express" based on the novel by Grace Zaring Stone and the screenplay by Edward E. Paramore jr.

title: Payment on Demand
actors: Bette Davis, Barry Sullivan, Peggie Castle
description: A lawyer's wife tries in every way, even unorthodox ones, to help her husband in his career. He succeeds but loses the esteem of his spouse and his love which is recovered in extremis.
notes: Bette Davis is the true soul of this family melodrama centered on the marriage relationship.

title: A nous la liberté
actors: Raymond Cordy, Henri Marchand, Paul Olivier, Rolla France
description: Emilie helps Louis escape from prison by sacrificing himself. Some time later, both of them are free to find the first worker the second master but once again in difficulty. They decide to drop everything and go wandering.
notes: The original title had us as its term, but the Italian censorship distribution at the time replaced it with 'a me' to avoid the emphasis of social criticism. Claire's has become a 1930s classic on the theme of friendship and the dehumanization of work.

title: America
actors: Neil Hamilton, Carole Dempster, Lionel Barrymore, Erville Alderson
description: The American war of independence lived through the clash of two pairs of protagonists: Montagne and Holden, the rebel settlers and Butler and Hare, the evil loyalists.
notes: David Wark Griffith, grappling with a salient moment in American history, weaves an epic film but not very incisive in the dynamics of the clash and the reasons (in this, it is said, the director's Anglophile influence has influenced). Some scenes will remain in history such as the resumption of the battle of Bunker Hill made with the cavalry troops provided by the "War Department of Washington".

title: Medium Cool
actors: Robert Forster, Verna Bloom, Peter Bonerz, Peter Boyle
description: The Democrats' convention in Chicago in 1968 was the scene of clashes with the police and scenes of violent protest. A cameramen sent follows and resumes the events while remaining involved.
notes: Cinema-truth (the shots are authentic) for a documentary essay made entirely by Haskell Wexler.

title: Algiers
actors: Charles Boyer, Hedy Lamarr, Sigrid Gurie, Gene Lockhart
description: In the Casbah of Algiers, the ras of the local underworld falls in love with a French tourist: a mistake that should not be made ...
notes: Cromwell tries to replicate on American soil the success achieved a year earlier by Duvivier with the same film. But instead of Gabin here is Charles Boyer, and the result is not the same.

title: Four Friends
actors: Craig Wasson, Jodi Thelen, Jim Metzler, Michael Huddleston
description: In the United States of the late 1950s and throughout the 1960s, David, Tom, Danilo and the beautiful Georgia grew up in the difficulty of integrating and making the American dream their own.
notes: The story is a piece of stars and stripes history seen through the eyes of Danilo, the son of Yugoslav immigrants (the Italian title is really stupid, compared to the original _Four Friends_). Excellently scripted by Steve Tesich, who was inspired by his own personal experience, it remains one of Penn's most beautiful films, which manages - in a not easy mix of levels and tones - to convey the end of an idea of ??America.

title: The Silent Partner
actors: Elliott Gould, Susannah York, Christopher Plummer, Michael Kirby
description: Sometimes the cashier of a bank is more agile than the robber who goes to visit it: he steals the loot by taking advantage of the robbery. The thief does not fit in and wants the stolen goods returned.
notes: Scripted by Curtis Hanson, future director of "L.A. Confidential", it's a violent thriller with a good script idea.

title: Svoj sredi cuzich, sredi svoich
actors: Jurij Bogatyrëv, Anatolij Solonicyn, Sergej Sakurnov, Nikita Mikhalkov
description: The Red Army accuses one of its soldiers of being a spy and thus favoring the assailants of a train loaded with gold. The little sodato armed with good will will truly enter the gang and unmask the culprit with reparation for the damage.
notes: From the future director of the cinematographic Oblomov to his first experience behind the camera in a genre film between the red western and the bandit adventure.

title: Gamlet
actors: Innokentj Smoktunovskij, Anastasija Vertiuskaja, Michail Nazvanov
description: The drama of the son, believed to have gone mad, visited by the revealing specter of truth of his father and author of a final and mortal justice, finds, in this Russian version, translated by Pasternak, an exquisitely more political and denouncing reading that clearly differentiates it from the famous adaptation by Laurence Olivier.

title: Hamlet llike maailmassa
actors: Pirkka-Pekka Petelius, Kati Outinen, Elina Salo, Esko Salminen
description: The young and swashbuckling Hamlet is a financial climber who gets hold of 51 percent of a company. Her mother Gertrude has a lover named Klaus: he, after poisoning her husband, general manager of the company, marries Gertrude with the aim of "reconverting" the business towards the production of plastic ducks. At this point, Hamlet ...
notes: Following the imprint of a script written day by day during filming, Kaurismäki sets the story in today's Finland and fires a grotesque, brilliant and iconoclastic version of the Shakespearean drama, reinventing the anti-capitalist update of the tragedy of possession.

title: The Flame of New Orleans
actors: Marlene Dietrich, Bruce Cabot, Roland Young, Mischa Auer
description: New Orleans, 1841: pretending to be noble, the charming Claire Ledoux manages to contract a rich marriage with the banker Charles Giraud. In extremis, however, the man he has always loved reappears, the sailor Robert Latour.
notes: Written by the director with Norman Krasna and photographed by Rudolph Maté, the first (but not the best) of Clair's four American films, too conditioned by the presence of the divine Marlene. In fact, although inserted in a complicated and not always fluid intertwining of misunderstandings and double identities, the Teutonic star emanates such a charisma as to literally erase the male protagonists from the scene.

title: Amo non amo
actors: Jacqueline Bisset, Maximilian Schell, Terence Stamp, Monica Guerritore
description: The intricate and confusing story of a bourgeois love lived on the shores of fregene in a well-to-do villa inhabited by an intellectual in crisis and a feminist in search of identity who seek new emotions by betraying each other, she with a fisherman, he with a girl unscrupulous.
notes: First work by Armenia Balducci helped in the script by Ennio De Concini, in the photography by Carlo Di Palma and for the costumes by Maria Paola Maino for this bourgeois group photo by the sea.

title: Szerelem
actors: Lili Darvas, Mari Töröcsik, Iván Darvas, Erzsi Orsolya
description: In the Budapest of the 1950s, a man is imprisoned for political reasons. The mother is convinced by her daughter-in-law that her son has left for the United States where he works successfully in the world of cinema.
notes: A poignant kammerspiel for Károly Makk inspired by two stories by Tibor Déry.

title: Amore amaro
actors: Lisa Gastoni, Leonard Mann, Niro Dal Fabbro, Maurizio Fiori
description: In the Ferrara of 193 an attempted impossible love story between a young student, with his anti-fascist father in prison, a thirty-five year old widow and with children. Differences between classes of political tendencies will definitively oppose the relationship.
notes: Taken from the short story "For unspecified causes" by Carlo Bernari, scripted by Susi Cecchi D'Amico and Vancini, it is the unsuccessful attempt to photograph public and private of a love story that starts weak since the notes of the original text.

title: The Three Ages
actors: Buster Keaton, Margaret Leahy, Wallace Beery, Joe Roberts
description: The film tells the same episode, the loving chase launched by a man against a woman promised to another man, set in three different ages: the stone age, ancient Rome, the twentieth century. Only at the end will the protagonist get the object of desire.
notes: First film to combine animated drawing and live shooting for a sequence that sees Keaton riding a dinosaur. First medium film directed by Keaton. It's fun that parodies Griffith and genre movies.

title: Le plus vieux métier du monde
actors: Michèle Mercier, Enrico Maria Salerno, Gabriele Tinti, Elsa Martinelli
description: Six episodes develop the theme of love in all eras, starting from the Stone Age to get to the future, passing naturally through the "Belle Époque".
notes: Unsuccessful project to combine the work of different directors committed to love. The episode of Godard is saved, which included dominant colors in each scene but the yellow change imposed by the Italian distribution remained of everything.

title: L'amour à vingt'ans
actors: Jean-Pierre Léaud, Marie-France Pisier, Barbara Lass, Zbigniew Cybulski
description: Five cities, Rome, Paris, Munich, Warsaw, Tokyo, for five episodes directed by five directors to explore the love of twenty-year-olds lived on both sides of the world.
notes: To remember, among the best, that of Truffaut who is part of the Doinel saga and the Polish episode directed by Wajda.

title: Mauvaise graine
actors: Danielle Darrieux, Pierre Mingand, Jean Wall, Gaby Yéritier
description: Henri, the son of a Parisian surgeon, gets involved in the local mala and car theft. He falls in love with Jeanette, the sister of an accomplice not unrelated to the gang's activities. The gang leader doesn't like Henri's resourcefulness and tries to get him out with an ambush in Marseille. The two, realizing that they are in danger, decide to leave for America with the help of the young man's father.
notes: The only time in France for Billy Wilder, who in turn will embark for the United States together with the main performers. Low-budget and not completely successful, _Amore che redime_ anticipates some brilliant ideas of the director's future American career.

title: Antoine et Antoinette
actors: Roger Pigaut, Claire Maffei, Noël Roquevert, Pierre Trabaud
description: A worker and a saleswoman in Paris live their daily life as young penniless marriage, until a winning lottery ticket changes the cards on the table.
notes: In Cannes he received the Grand Prix of the Psychological and Love Film for the characterization of a story focused on the characters.

title: Les visiteurs du soir
actors: Arletty, Alain Cuny, Marie Déa, Jules Berry, Fernand Ledoux
description: In a castle perched on the mountains in a fantastic Middle Ages, the betrothal celebrations of Anna, daughter of Baron Ugo, with the noble Renaud are underway. But too much love annoys the devil who sends two of his emissaries, disguised as musicians, to sow hatred and malice. Love wins everything but the devil is vengeful makes statues of the two young lovers.
notes: Prévert and Carné, in times of war and scarce freedom, invent a story of fantastic love to talk about Evil and Good.

title: Amore e rabbia
directors: Marco Bellocchio, Bernardo Bertolucci, Jean-Luc Godard, Carlo Lizzani, Pier Paolo Pasolini, Elda Tattoli
actors: Julian Beck, Ninetto Davoli, Nino Castelnuovo, Christine Gueho, Jim Anderson, Judith Malina, Giulio Cesare Castello, Adriano Aprà, Fernaldo Di Giammatteo, Petra Vogt, Rochelle Barbini, Aldo Puglisi, Marco Bellocchio, Romano Costa, Milena Vukotic, Paolo Pozzesi, Catherine Jourdan
description: Various authors intent on rereading the parables of the Gospel. Bernardo Bertolucci uses the avant-garde theater of the Living Theater in the episode "L'agonia"; in "Indifference" Carlo Lizzani makes a good Neorealist Samaritan; Pier Paolo Pasolini uses Ninetto Davoli's innocence in "The paper flower sequence"; in "L'amore" Jean-Luc Godard makes the prodigal son become a Brechtian; in "Let's discuss, let's discuss ..." Marco Bellocchio and the university students invent an improvisation on the theme of the protest.

title: L'amore necessario
actors: Ben Kingsley, Marie-Christine Barrault, Ann-Gisel Glass
description: Two long-time spouses remain afloat, peppering the marriage with tolerated betrayals, until they make the acquaintance of a young couple in love. The vision of that perfection leads them to devise a malicious plan to pollute its purity which turns into a boomerang.
notes: Jean-Paul Sartre and Simon de Beauvoir are the biographical references that inspired this unsuccessful psychoanalytic film on the crisis of the couple.

title: El amor brujo
actors: Antonio Gades, Cristina Hoyos, Laura Del Sol, Juan Antonio Jiménez
description: Carmelo's love for Candela has a promise first and a ghost later as obstacles. Only the power of an exorcism will free the lovers.
notes: Inspired by the ballet set to music by Manuel De Falla in 1915 with libretto by Gregorio Martinez Sierra is a love flou to the rhythm of flamenco.

title: Amore tossico
actors: Cesare Ferretti, Michela Mioni, Enzo Di Benedetto, Loredana Ferrara
description: In Ostia, a group of drug addicts drag their existence to the day, with the sole purpose of obtaining the daily dose through all possible means: begging, mugging, robbery, prostitution. Among them there are also Cesare and Michela, who perceive themselves to be on the edge of an abyss and are desperately trying to get out of the loop ...
notes: Pure cinema-truth, which differs from documentary tones only in the dramatic (albeit predictable) epilogue. Played by authentic "junkies", a willing attempt to read the social tragedy of marginalized and underclass. Best First Feature Award in Venice.

title: Love Among the Ruins
actors: Katharine Hepburn, Laurence Olivier, Colin Blakely, Richard Pearson
description: The elderly actress Jessica Medlicott, summoned by her boyfriend for failing to fulfill a promise of marriage, calls on the lawyer Arthur Glanville-Jones, her old friend and - apparently without her knowledge - who has always been in love with her to defend her. After studying the case, the lawyer realizes that the only way to win and protect his client's interests is to destroy her reputation.
notes: At the first television commission, 76-year-old Cukor churns out a perfect comedy that brings together two sacred monsters of the caliber of Olivier and Hepburn. Three Emmys (the TV Oscars): to the protagonists and the director.

title: The Loves of Carmen
actors: Rita Hayworth, Glenn Ford, Ron Randell, Luther Adler
description: The corporal of the Dragons of Seville, Don José, as proof of love for the gypsy Carmen kills a superior and flees to the woods. There still a trial awaits him, the killing of Carmen's husband who, however, must have been unhappy with the evidence because she thinks well of betraying him with a bullfighter.
notes: From the novella by Prosper Merimeé, but without the music of Bizet, a Vidor not at its best, despite the parterre of actors.

title: Lásky jedné plavovlásky
actors: Hana Brejchova, Vladimir Pucholt, Vladimir Mensik, Ivan Kheil
description: In Zruce, a mountain village not far from Prague, two thousand girls work in a shoe factory, but are forced to spend their free time in a boarding school that looks like a beehive. The lack of men has meant that many employees have left the factory; the expedients of the old director, who brought in a group of elderly reservists, were useless. Then one day Milda, a young pianist from the capital, appears, and Andula, one of the workers, seduces him ...
notes: In the era of "new waves", the Czech one (the "nová vlna") knew how to produce films like these, bittersweet satire of society in Prague and its surroundings.

title: Tengoku to jigoku
actors: Toshiro Mifune, Tatsuya Mihashi, Kyôko Kagawa, Tsutomu Yamazaki
description: The son of a driver is kidnapped, but it is the result of a personal mistake. The real object of desire for the leading student was the son of an industrialist. The police commissioner investigates in search of the kidnapper and will enter the circles of a hell with no way out.
notes: The Japanese master Kurosawa uses an American noir novel to embark on a journey into the world of evil and a reflection on human destinies.

title: Brewster McCloud
actors: Bud Cort, Sally Kellerman, Shelley Duvall, Michael Murphy, René Auberjonois, Stacy Keach
description: An experienced Icarus of contemporary America, who took refuge in an old air-raid shelter in Huston to practice his flying lesson, contradicts the golden rule imposed on him by his teacher and falls in love with disastrous consequences.
notes: A 1970 Altman who signs his apology on the movementism of the time with an anarchist lesson on freedom.

title: Hangmen Also Die
actors: Brian Donlevy, Walter Brennan, Anna Lee, Dennis O'Keefe
description: In Nazi-occupied Prague, the "Reichsprotektor", Reinhard Heydrich is killed: to avoid repression, the Resistance identifies a collaborator as a guinea pig and converges the evidence on him ...
notes: When the news of the attack on the hated hierarch Heydrich appeared in 1942, Lang proposed the idea to his neighbor Bertolt Brecht, whom he himself had helped to take refuge in the USA. The cuts imposed by the production however caused the disagreement between the Viennese director and the Berlin author (who had been joined by the American Wexley), who withdrew the signature from the titles. However, according to Lang, this remains a 90 percent Brechtian film.

title: The Hospital
actors: George C. Scott, Diana Rigg, Barnard Hughes, Stockard Channing
description: Dr. Herbert Block, chief surgeon in a New York hospital, is in a profound professional and family crisis. The idea of ??suicide begins to flash in his mind, also because deaths among patients multiply due to incorrect treatments received in the ward. The atmosphere becomes more and more neurotic, but Block will be able to overcome every obstacle.
notes: Funny satire on the management of public affairs, directed by Hiller the year after the triumphs of "Love Story". In addition to the great Scott, Rigg, the former Emma Peel of "Special Agent", stands out in the cast. Oscar for Best Original Screenplay to Paddy Chayefsky.

title: Together Again
actors: Irene Dunne, Charles Boyer, Charles Coburn, Mona Freeman
description: The mayor of a provincial town died and the laborious widow calls a sculptor to make a statue in his honor. The sculptor is a fascinating New York.
notes: Still together, for the third time, the two protagonists, as the only important note for a comedy like many others.

title: J'irai comme un cheval fou
actors: Hachemi Marzouk, Nuria Espert, George Shannon, Anouk Farjac
description: Matricide of a grown son who will go to atone in the desert where he meets a strange holy man who will devour him for his sake.
notes: Arrabal makes a bloody allegory against the consumer society and the bourgeois well-being it represents. Deliberately annoying, he becomes the victim of his delirium.

title: Hell's Angels
actors: Ben Lyon, James Hall, Jean Harlow, John Darlow, Lucien Prival, Frank Clarke, Roy Wilson, Douglas Gilmore
description: The First World War calls to arms two brothers who are both enlisted as pilots in the 'Royal Fighting Corps', although one wanted it and the other did not, although one was brave and the other a coward. On the front they will find the same woman they both loved and an equal death brought by different honors.
notes: Produced by billionaire Hughes, an aircraft pilot, it remains in history as a colossal worth (million dollars and as the film with one of the most impressive shots in history, 560 hours. The rest, apart from the spectacular flight scenes, does not will remain in history.

title: La bête humaine
actors: Jean Gabin, Simone Simon, Fernand Ledoux, Julien Carette
description: Jacques Lantier works in the railways and is suffering from a hereditary disease, acholism which negatively affects his psyche. This vulnerability makes use of Séverine who tries to persuade him to eliminate her husband. But the acolist turns his violence right towards her.
notes: Based on the novel of the same name by Zola, which also provided the basis for Fritz Lang's "The Human Beast", it is a solid drama in which Renoir develops the theme of the death of love as the end of politics as a possibility of change. In the annals the initial subjective sequence that takes up the Paris-Le Havre section from the head of the locomotive.

title: Fallen Angel
actors: Dana Andrews, Alice Faye, Linda Darnell, Charles Bickford
description: Eric Stanton lands in a provincial town and falls in love with the cashier of a club, the object of admiration of several men. In order to actually have her, Stanton marries another woman, a wealthy orphan. When on the same day of the wedding he goes to the cashier, he finds her with someone else. The next morning she died. Accused Stanton will have to piece together the truth.
notes: Otto Preminger photographs a dark noir based on the novel by Marty Holland and scripted by Harry Kleiner.

title: El angel exterminador
actors: Silvia Pinal, Enrique Rambal, Jacqueline Andère, Claudio Brook
description: After the party is over, a group of guests at a dinner cannot leave the villa that hosted them, something indefinite and inexplicable prevents them from crossing the threshold of the dining room, while friends, relatives and friends gather outside. police. After hours of panic someone will take the step.
notes: Absolute masterpiece of cinema of all times in an apology, typically Buñuelian, on the absurd sense of the religious and on the action of free will in a society of bourgeois conformism. The dynamics that are established between the hostages are perfect photography and metaphor of the prevailing society.

title: Yoidore tenshi
actors: Takashi Shimura, Toshiro Mifune, Reisaburo Yamamoto
description: Tokyo in the immediate postwar period is the set of a strange friendship story between a yakuza, a terminally ill tuberculosis, and a doctor crushed by alcoholism who decides to take care of it, in vain, because the yakuza dies a 'natural' death: a rival killer.
notes: Kurosawa in 1948 took his photograph on the existential entropy that followed the great and devastating war with the help of two great interpreters, Mifune and Shimura, who became the icons of Kurosawa.

title: Angi Vera
actors: Veronika Papp, Erszi Pásztor, Tamás Dunai
description: The career of a nurse in Stalinist Hungary of 1948, calculating and opportunist, who unmasks and denounces the political tendencies of the man she has been with.
notes: From a novel by Endre Vészi, the reconstruction of the gloomy atmosphere of the years of Russian Hungary brought to the face of a woman and her portrait.

title: L'animal
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Raquel Welch, Aldo Maccione
description: The strange conquest of love of a stuntman who is called to act as a stunt double for an actor, his double, so tough in the fiction of the cinematographic part, as so feminine in real life ...
notes: The film is entirely in the hands of Belmondo, who covers both copy and original roles. France applauded him at the box office.

title: Annie Get Your Gun
actors: Betty Hutton, Howard Keel, Edward Arnold, Keenan Wynn
description: A woman demonstrates her circus skills in the practice of shooting. His skill is such as to defeat the defending champion Butler who decides to leave the company for another. The owner of the circus, Buffalo Bill, for reasons of financial difficulties will have to make an agreement with the circus where Butler has landed. The two, truly in love, will collide again, but this time Anna will give way to not lose her beloved by striking her self-love.
notes: Hugely successful musical, based on the 1946 musical comedy of the same name by Herbert and Dorothy Fields, which gave singer and actress Betty Hutton the chance of a lifetime.

title: Anni difficili
actors: Umberto Spadaro, Ave Ninchi, Massimo Girotti, Delia Scala, Enzo Biliotti, Ernesto Almirante, Aldo Silvani, Miro Zonda, Milly Vitale, Giovanni Grasso, Olinto Cristina, Agostino Salvietti, Rainero De Cenzo, Carlo Sposito, Giuseppe Nicolosi
description: In 1935 an employee is forced, in contravention of his political rule, to take the fascist card. Immediately after the war, at the time of the accounts, he will be accused of having been a fascist and for this he will be fired.
notes: Moral and political parable, the first part of a trilogy, written by Vitaliano Brancati (who in turn translates his novel "The old man with boots" for the cinema) which at the time, close to the facts narrated, aroused scandals and controversies.

title: Term of Trial
actors: Laurence Olivier, Sarah Miles, Simone Signoret, Terence Stamp
description: A distinguished and mature professor is accused by a student of sexual harassment. His wife, who had made him in the war for custody in the divorce, is the only one who believes him but this will not be worth the acquittal. Even when the accuser retracts.
notes: The goodness itself of the film is clouded, like the judgment, by the presence of actors of the caliber of Laurence Oliviere and Terrence Stamp, engaged in a dark and theatrical melodrama.

title: Death Race 2000
actors: David Carradine, Sylvester Stallone, Simone Griffeth, Mary Woronov
description: In the futuristic and dystopian America of the 2000s, a coast-to-coast race is organized in which the winner is whoever has hit the largest number of passers-by.
notes: Cult movie of fantasy-sociology cinema conditioned by the 'cold' climate of those years, produced by Roger Corman, with a sequel I gladiators of the year 3000.

title: Antinea, l'amante della città sepolta
actors: Haya Harareet, Jean-Louis Trintignant, Red Fulton, Georges Rivière
description: The kingdom of Atlantis lies luxuriantly beneath the Sahara desert, beautifully ruled by the ruler Aintinea. Three French technicians from a nuclear power plant who escaped a helicopter accident pay us a forced visit.
notes: A screenplay by Remigio Del Grosso, Ugo Liberatore, André Tabet from the novel of the same name by Pierre Benoît directed by Ulmer, replacing Borzage. A colorful and kitsch cartoon.

title: This Land Is Mine
actors: Charles Laughton, Kent Smith, Maureen O'Hara, George Sanders
description: Second World War: in occupied France a professor (Charles Laughton) is arrested and killed by the Germans for having propagated the values ??of resistance to his students. But before he dies, in a last heroic gesture he will be able to read the declaration of human rights to the class.
notes: Renoir's atypical film, because it was produced and shot with a specific political intent: to explain to the American public the reasons for the US intervention in Europe. The reasons for some schematism and too many simplifications are to be found in the historical and production conditions in which the project was born.

title: O Dragão da Maldade contra o Santo Guerreiro
actors: Mauricio Do Valle, Odette Lara, Othon Bastos, Hugo Carvana, Joffre Soares, Lorival Pariz, Rosa Maria Penna, Emmanuel Cavalcanti, Vinícius Salvatori, Mário Gusmão
description: After the political and ideological conversion, the ruthless killer Antonio das Mortes - hired by the old Colonel Horácio to eliminate the last "cangaçeiros", the brigands favored by the people - takes sides with the dispossessed. By updating the deeds of the "holy warrior" San Giorgio, he will identify new evil dragons to kill ...
notes: Leading exponent of the Brazilian "Cinema Nôvo", at the same time a theorist and militant filmmaker, Rocha (who died prematurely in 1981, at the age of 43) signs with his fourth feature a ferocious and delirious apologue about his own land and a farewell before exile . Best Director Award at Cannes '69.

title: Questi fantasmi
actors: Renato Rascel, Maria Frau, Erno Crisa, Franca Valeri, Ugo D'Alessio
description: From the homonymous comedy by Eduardo De Filippo: Pasquale and Maria live in a dilapidated Neapolitan palace, according to the legend inhabited by ghosts. The adulterous Maria, discovered by her husband, manages to make him believe that her lover is none other than one of the ghosts. Pasquale wants to believe in deception, even against any evidence to the contrary.
notes: Bittersweet comedy, conducted with grace and supported by the sympathy of the performers.

title: Aparajito
actors: Pinaki Sen Gupta, Smaran Ghosai, Kanura Banerjee, Kanu Bandonopadhaya
description: The young Apu has a dream, he wants to become a priest. To make it happen, he leaves his native house and, thanks to the sacrifices of his widowed mother, he studies at the University of Calcutta where, among many practical difficulties, he succeeds in the difficult aim of obtaining a degree. When the sick mother is close to death, she will try to return to the village in time for the final farewell.
notes: The master Satyajit Ray recreates with the trilogy, of which this is the second part, Indian cinema based on the influences of Italian neorealism. Based on the novel "Pather Panchali" by the Bengali writer Banerjee. Winner of the Golden Lion at the 1957 Venice Film Festival.

title: My Foolish Heart
actors: Dana Andrews, Susan Hayward, Kent Smith, Lois Wheeler
description: The man from whom she is expecting a child dies in an accident while in the army. She marries a suitor, making him believe the son is hers, but the marriage is soon wrecked. She will be left alone to raise her daughter.
notes: All shot in a female key, the film runs alongside melodrama, without ever having the courage to sink completely into the incendiary passions of melò. With a gorgeous Susan Hayward.

title: Qui comincia l'avventura
actors: Monica Vitti, Claudia Cardinale, Ninetto Davoli, Guido Leontini
description: The quiet life of an ironer (Cardinal) who lives in a small village in Puglia is upset by the arrival in the village of a confident motorcyclist (Vitti): fascinated by the lifestyle of the newcomer, she decides to change her life and follow her to Milan .
notes: The Italian comedy is updated: it tries to take advantage of the new auteur cinema (Antonioni and Fellini) and to absorb the centrifugal thrusts of the 1970s movements. The results are fluctuating: of a carefree comedy, which sometimes succumbs under the weight of ambitions.

title: Apollon, una fabbrica occupata
description: Documentary film that resumes, with the support of a group of technicians and intellectuals, the extreme union defense of a group of workers from the typography of Rome Apollon. On the side of the oppressed, who interpret themselves, the main managers are of fictional intellectuals and leaders of the PCI. Example of political cinema of militancy.

title: The Suspect
actors: Charles Laughton, Henry Daniell, Ella Raines, Dean Harens
description: Harmless Philip (Laughton) is married to a domineering and oppressive wife (Ivan) and is secretly in love with the beautiful and sweet secretary (Raines). One day his wife, an obstacle to all his dreams of love, dies falling down the stairs. It looks like an accident, but the police inspector isn't convinced.
notes: Representation of the angel face of evil and cold reflection on the applications of murder. Laughton, great.

title: Un apprezzato professionista di sicuro avvenire
actors: Lino Capolicchio, Riccardo Cucciolla, Femi Benussi, Yvonne Sanson
description: A priest, in spite of the vows of chastity, is persuaded by a fraudulent lawyer friend, who recently married to a rich woman discovers that he is impotent, to have relations with his wife. The priest takes his hand and the lawyer gets irritated causing his death.
notes: De Santis greets his career as a director, after six years away, with a yellow-colored comic film.

title: Ugetsu Monogatari
actors: Machiko Kyo, Masayuki Mori, Kinuyo Tanaka, Sakae Ozawa
description: Based on the short stories "The hotel" by Asaji and "The lubricity of the snake" by Akinari, a masterpiece of the history of cinema. In 16th-century Japan, a farmer (Ozawa) and a potter (Mori) abandon their jobs and their families to meet glory. As the imperial armies collide, one is seduced by an evil and beautiful princess, the other aspires to the heroic stature of the samurai. When they return home, all illusions will fall.
notes: Film "world", all-encompassing of Mizoguchi's poetics: art and life, truth and beauty, lie and appearance. Scripted by Matsutaro Kawaguchi and Yoshikata Yoda. Silver Lion at the Venice Film Festival, together with Fellini's "I vitelloni".

title: Aufzeichnungen zu Kleidern und Städten
actors: Yohji Yamamoto
description: Journey to the end of the world of fashion made on commission from the Pompidou center by Wenders who tests one of his qualities, now perhaps the only one, as a documentary narrator. Here the Japanese designer tailor Yamamoto is laid bare by the German director's sociological comments on fashion as a communication vehicle.

title: Racconti di giovani amori
actors: Luciano Piergiovanni, Renata Carniglia, Graziella Menichelli, Caterina Barbero
description: Episode film, with the leading theme of love. The crush stages a boy's love for a woman much older than him. The queen tells of the troubled relationship of an aspiring actress with a boy who does not understand her ambitions. In "Gigliola's Boy", the protagonist discovers that her boyfriend is accused of theft, but despite this she does not stop loving him.
notes: At the first episode, produced for television, Olmi decided to add two more to put the film on the cinema circuit. Small stories, but told with style.

title: För att inte tala om alla dessa kvinnor
actors: Jarl Kulle, Bibi Andersson, Eva Dahlbeck, Georg Funkquist
description: Music critic Cornelius is writing a biography about a famous cellist, and to get an interview he visits his home for a few days. Unable to approach the musician, Cornelius converses with the numerous women who live with him, learning about several "intimate" rumors that he will decide to use to enact a strange revenge ...
notes: Measuring himself with the tones - unusual for him - of irony and the grotesque, Bergman (also screenwriter, with Erland Josephson) explores the female planet, also allowing himself an amused revenge against a certain bluster and obtuse film criticism.

title: The Incredible Shrinking Man
actors: Grant Williams, Randy Stuart, April Kent, Paul Langton
description: From the author of the "Monster of the black lagoon" series, a cult of the science fiction of the 50s. A man, victim of mysterious radiation of obscure origin, begins to shrink more and more. The home garden becomes an impenetrable forest, giant monster insects and his wife's cat a deadly danger.
notes: The sequence of the fight with the spider is very famous. When science fiction becomes a vision of our deepest fears and a mirror of social neurosis. Amazing special effects.

title: Aquila Nera
actors: Rossano Brazzi, Irasema Dillian, Gino Cervi, Rina Morelli
description: At the time of the Tsars in the Caucasus an officer passes over to the other side and becomes a brigand at the head of peasants in revolt against the landowners.
notes: In 1946 he was a box office champion and in contention there was Lattuada with "Il bandito". But Freda plays on popular cinema and earns a sequel "Black Eagle's Revenge".

title: The Roots of Heaven
actors: Trevor Howard, Juliette Gréco, Errol Flynn, Eddie Albert
description: Huston attempts the ecological apologue: a man in Africa carries on his battle to save a herd of elephants from extinction and clashes with the power of poachers and economic interests that will make his mission fail.
