notes: A rambling project, in which Huston pours out a rash energy. But the things that work the most remain on the sidelines: Welles' appearances, Flynn's interpretation. Based on a novel by Romain Gary, who also collaborates on the screenplay.

title: Raffles
actors: Olivia de Havilland, David Niven, Dame May Witty, Douglas Walton
description: London, 1930s: Raffles is a gentleman thief; A cricketer with a penchant for beautiful women, he steals a famous painting from the British Museum to give it to a singer. As Scotland Yard hunts him, he repents and changes his life out of love.
notes: From the novel by Ernest William Hornung, screenplay by John Van Druten and Sidney Howard. Classic cops and robbers movie, with a classy David Niven.

title: Dites-lui que je l'aime
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Miou-Miou, Dominique Laffin, Jacques Danis
description: Life flows quietly for a provincial French employee. But behind the mask of the ordinary man there is a past and a Torbiba passion that transform him under the pressure of a double life.
notes: Miller portrays the drama of the Amaur Fou 'making himself playing on the contrast between the setting and the psychological drama.

title: The Plough and the Stars
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, Preston Foster, Barry Fitzgerald, Una O'Connor
description: Dublin, 1916: a newly married man marries the cause and leaves his wife to participate in the urban warfare against the British ...
notes: Unlucky return to Ireland for Ford who, starting from an important starting point, fails in the attempt to intersect documented history and theatrical system. Based on a play by Sean O'Casey.

title: La femme aux bottes rouges
actors: Catherine Deneuve, Fernando Rey, Laura Betti, Jacques Weber, Emma Cohen, Adalberto Maria Merli, José Sacristan
description: The millionaire Perrot, a fake patron and enemy of art, hosts some artists in his villa, with the secret purpose of sowing discord and pitting them against each other. One day he accidentally meets Françoise Leroi, young author of the literary essay "Secrets" and invites her to his villa to write her autobiography. The woman, already torn between the love she feels for the painter Richard and the publisher Marc, enters the heart of the battle when she sees them appear in front of her. But Perrot will have the worst ...
notes: We witness the somewhat pathetic attempts of Buñuel's son to emulate his father.

title: Test Pilot
actors: Clark Gable, Myrna Loy, Spencer Tracy, Lionel Barrymore
description: Ann accidentally meets Jim, an aircraft test driver, falls in love with him and marries him. But the dangerous job of her man, who every day risks his life in the most daring stunts, keeps her in constant anxiety. She would like to find a moment of peace, but realizes that it is not possible to ask Jim to leave the business he loves. Will his patient and heroic perseverance be rewarded in the end?
notes: Filmed by Fleming before _The Wizard of Oz_ and _Via con vento_, a not particularly heartfelt melodrama, which finds its strength in aerial shots and in the interpretations of the actors. At the time it had a good success with the public.

title: Ariel
actors: Turo Pajala, Susanna Haavisto, Matti Pellonpää, Eethu Hilkamo
description: Fired from the mine where he was employed, Taisto Kasurinen finds himself involved in a series of extravagant events: robbed of the liquidation by some criminals, he injures one and ends up in prison, where he dreams of escape and a better existence. Escaped with the murderer Mikkonen, he takes it into his head to board the ship Ariel, leaving for Mexico ...
notes: Chapter of the "losers trilogy" together with _Ombre in paradiso_ and _La fiammiferaia_ (to which _Nuvole in viaggio_ is added, a sort of completion,), a further example of the anarchic and "adrift" cinema of the Finnish director, always with an eye on the ocean and escape lines.

title: Girl with Green Eyes
actors: Rita Tushingham, Peter Finch, Lynn Redgrave, Maire Kean, Arthur O'Sullivan
description: Dublin, 1960: Young Kate Brady falls in love with Eugene Gaillard, a married writer. To convince the latter to leave his wife, Kate escapes to London, where she hopes to be joined; but then...
notes: Davis' debut feature is an unhappy love story grafted into the Free Cinema climate starting with the cast, Tushingham in the lead.

title: La ragazza dal pigiama giallo
actors: Ray Milland, Dalida Di Lazzaro, Michele Placido, Mel Ferrer
description: A married woman (Di Lazzaro) is divided between two lovers: a doctor and a worker. Determined to leave her husband, she is rejected by the doctor and beaten by her spouse. She then falls back on the worker, by whom she is eventually killed. It will be up to the police to shed some light on the case.
notes: A sentimental and vulgar thriller. Nothing to save.

title: Deep End
actors: John Moulder-Brown, Jane Asher, Diana Dors, Erica Beer
description: Mike, a 15-year-old who works in a public toilet in London, falls in love with Susan, an older and sexually uninhibited girl, who attracts and repels him. He will be able to conquer her, but the ending will be heartbreaking.
notes: Third film shot in the West (the second in Great Britain) by Skolimowski, self-exiled from Communist Poland. An adolescent love dropped into the depressing squalor of the London suburbs: innocence and youth will not survive the cruelty of the environment (and of Chance). Tender and ruthless. Music by the German group Can; the song _But I Might Die Tonight_ is signed by Cat Stevens.

title: Csillagosok, katonák
actors: Tatijana Konjiuchova, Krystyna Mikolajewska, Michail Kozakov
description: The reds and the whites clash in the civil war that bloodied Russia in 1918. They were the armies of the tsarists and the Bolsheviks to which the Hungarian prisoners were added, conquered by the proletarian idea.
notes: Jancsó closes the second episode of the story trilogy, the first was "The desperate" and the third "Silence and scream", with a film that renounces the classic dynamics of narration with its psychologisms and character identifications. Also known with the title "The reds and the whites" or also as "Starry, soldiers" or with the two words that begin the Internationale in the Hungarian language.

title: La vie de château
actors: Philippe Noiret, Catherine Deneuve, Pierre Brasseur, mary Marquet
description: The wife of a well-off and comfortable husband lives in a castle in Normandy not spared, in 1944, from the visit of Nazis and partisans. The wife believes her husband is disinterested in the political events of the war and for this reason she is interested in the sentimental ones of the leaders of the opposing factions. Until the American Salvation Army parachutes from the sky and will give her husband the opportunity to redeem himself with heroic gestures.
notes: It is the first film by Jean-Paul Rappeneau who on this occasion enjoys the collaboration in the script phase of Alain Cavalier, Claude Sautet and Daniel Boulanger and the interpretation of Deneuve and Noiret. A winning cocktail.

title: Biruma no tategoto
actors: Shoji Yasui, Rentaro Mikuni, Jun Hamamura, Tatsuya Mihashi
description: At the end of the Second World War, the Japanese soldier Mizushima decides not to repatriate to devote himself to the cult of the dead in the Burmese jungle. He becomes a bonze and remembers the bloodiest page of his experience in war, when his superior exterminated all his troops in order not to deliver them alive to the enemy.
notes: Admittedly anti-militarist film based on a novel by Michio Takeyama: presented at the Venice Film Festival, it was a great success with the public, despite the unjustly missed Golden Lion, according to many. Ichikawa himself made a remake of it in 1984.

title: The Russian Are Coming! The Russian Are Coming!
actors: Carl Reiner, Eva Marie Saint, Alan Arkin, John Phillip Law
description: A Russian-flagged submarine runs aground on an American pier. The crew seeks help in the citizenry, creating confusion and surprise. An event of immediate and "concrete" danger will bring the solution.
notes: This farce, based on the novel _The Off-Islander_ by Nathaniel Benchley, had a good success with the public at the time.

title: Artisten in der Zirkuskuppel: ratlos
actors: Hannelore Hoger, Siegfried Graue, Alfred Edel, Curd Jürgens
description: The attempt to reform the circus show inherited from her father led the trapeze artist Peickert to adopt new methods. But the changes collide with reality, with its ancient ideals, to the point of attacking what Peickert loved about the circus. So she suspends the inauguration of her project and is hired on television. He discovers that small and concrete steps are needed to change the system.
notes: With this apology for the state of the art in the face of the advent and domination of capitalism, Kluge earned the Golden Lion at the 1968 Venice edition. The author is one of the founding fathers of the New German Cinema, the equivalent of the nouvelle vague.

title: Murders in the Rue Morgue
actors: Rebecca De Mornay, George C. Scott, Ian McShane
description: In Paris, life in the nineteenth century can be dangerous for a Grand Guignol actor. Violent death seizes him and the same affects other unfortunates.
notes: Based on a short story by Edgar Allan Poe, which has been repeated several times, it enjoys, for its success, the interpretation of George C. Scott.

title: Murder by Contract
actors: Vince Edwards, Philip Pine, Herschel Bernardi, Caprice Toriel
description: Economic difficulties force an employee to agree to become an expert in another profession: the killer. He succeeds and even well until the murder order falls on a woman. His hesitation will be fatal to him.
notes: Thriller of particular workmanship that thrilled the criticism of the time but which yields to the verification of time.

title: Murder by Decree
actors: Christopher Plummer, James Mason, Donald Sutherland, Geneviève Bujold
description: The most prestigious investigator in England is called upon to solve the thorniest case for 19th-century London and royal England. Discover and unmask the infamous Jack the Ripper. The investigations lead to the doors of the Royal House, but the bell is silent.
notes: Assassination on Commission is based on Ellery Queen's book "A Study in Black", here supported by the John Hopkins script; an original specimen with a sociological flavor comes out.

title: Night Visitor
actors: Max Von Sydow, Liv Ullmann, Trevor Howard, Per Oscarsson
description: A homicide witness is locked up in a psychiatric clinic in order to invalidate the testimony that would nail the perpetrator. But the witness manages to escape and take revenge on those who tried to ruin him.
notes: English-Swedish co-production that would like to reconstruct the plots of the detective story but remains a victim of the gloomy climate of the setting.

title: Cerny Petr
actors: Ladislav Jakim, Paula Martinkova, Jan Vostrcil
description: The job education of an apathetic boy full of problems by his father who introduces him to a supermarket environment.
notes: Forman's debut arrives in Locarno and receives a good reception, above all it marks him as a new and promising exponent of Czechoslovakian cinema.

title: Assunta Spina
actors: Anna Magnani, Eduardo De Filippo, Titina De Filippo, Antonio Centa
description: The drama of jealousy experienced by Michele who, locked up in prison, sees his woman, Assunta Spina, blown by another man. At his exit he will settle the accounts, but Assunta will sacrifice herself by being condemned in her place.
notes: Neapolitan melodrama based on the work of Salvatore Di Giacomo, already twice brought to the screen. Exceptional interpretations for this neorelist version.

title: Die Herrin von Atlantis
actors: Brigitte Helm, Gustav Diessl, Heinz Klingernberg, Tela Tschaî
description: The story is the note of the two officers who, lost in the desert, discover Atlantis and Queen Antea with whom they fall in love.
notes: Georg Wilhelm Pabst, draws the story from the book by Pierre Benoît and makes it a less successful expressionist version. The sets are by Ernö Metzner, photography by Eugen Schüfftan and Ernst Körner.

title: Warnung von einer heiligen Nutte
actors: Lou Castel, Eddie Constantine, Hanna Schygulla, Rainer Werner Fassbinder, Ulli Lommel, Margarethe Von Trotta
description: The undertaking of completing a film - the set of which is installed on the Campania coast, near Sorrento - appears very difficult: to the thousand practical and financial problems that haunt the production, in fact, there are added the rams and second thoughts of the neurotic director. Jeff. Meanwhile, jealousies, attractions and cross desperations take hold of the actors and crew ...
notes: To aspire to holiness and prostitution (as the title implies), to accept everything in order to "come to light" is the cinema itself, caught here in the spurious and contrasted process of its genesis. Messy, autobiographical and intense Fassbinder.

title: The Actress
actors: Spencer Tracy, Jean Simmons, Teresa Wright, Anthony Perkins
description: A provincial actress dreams of becoming a star, but life, in the role of a sick father, hinders her. Instead, the father, and life, will help her by giving something precious.
notes: Taken from Ruth Gordon's autobiographical comedy entitled "Years Aug" Cukor makes Anthony Perkins debut painting a portrait of a woman in America of the ten years.

title: Stay Hungry
actors: R. G. Armstrong, Jeff Bridges, Sally Field, Arnold Schwarzenegger
description: A young man turns into a financial speculator to invest the large sum of money he received from an inheritance. To do this he wants to take over a body building gym.
notes: Among the bodybuilders there is the future actor Schawarzenegger, but this does not make the film a gem but rather relegates it to failed attempts.

title: Don't Look Now
actors: Julie Christie, Donald Sutherland, Hilary Manson, Clelia Matania
description: After the death of their daughter, the restorer John Baxter and his wife Laura feel the need for a change of scenery and move to Venice: here a blind seer comes into contact with the spirit of her daughter and warns the couple with omens of future bloody events. .. intended to occur.
notes: Dramatic thriller for an inspired Roeg, which moves the actors with a certain skill and reconstructs the dark and sensual atmospheres of a voluptuous Venice. The construction - between flashbacks, dreams and premonitions - is intricate, but full of subtle echoes. From a novel by Daphne du Maurier, with the first soundtrack by Pino Donaggio.

title: It's Love I'm After
actors: Bette Davis, Leslie Howard, Olivia de Havilland, Patrick Knowles
description: Crossing of couples and exchange of couples for an actress who prefers to her boyfriend an actor who in turn undergoes the revenge of his girlfriend in a circus of quarrels and skits.
notes: Pleasant comedy of misunderstandings that, at times, recalls "twentieth century" by Hawks. Screenplay by Casey Robinson.

title: The Rescuers
directors: Wolfgang Reitherman, John Lounsbery, Art Stevens
description: The mice Bianca and Bernie, two mice on a mission for the Rescue Company, must find little Penny, who has disappeared from an orphanage. Jellyfish.
notes: Disney animation with all the elements that distinguish its style and poetics: clarity and linearity in a world of inventions. Good public success and a sequel, _Bianca and Bernie in the land of kangaroos_ (1990). Unforgettable is the albatross Orville, which offers a passage to the two protagonists.

title: Davy Crockett, King of the Wild Frontier
actors: Fess Parker, Buddy Ebsen, Basil Ruysdael, Hans Conried
description: With his hunter's fur hat, Davy Crockett defends and protects the interests of the Indian community and pioneers from corrupt businessmen. The next leap is politics, which, however, disappoints him too much ...
notes: Concentrated version of three episodes born for TV, which were very successful in the United States.

title: Le avventure di Giacomo Casanova
actors: Gabriele Ferzetti, Marina Vlady, Corinne Calvet, Nadia Gray
description: The incurable passion for the women of the greatest seducer in history relived by him when, arrested by the Spanish inquisitors, he is forced to remain in prison. As soon as he comes out contrite, he will soon resume the habit.
notes: Mario Bava's Eastmancolor photography gives color to this funny and amused pink comedy.

title: The Adventures of Marco Polo
actors: Gary Cooper, Sigrid Gurie, Basil Rathbone, Binnie Barnes
description: Marco Polo embarks on the journey that will take him to the court of Genghis Kahn in Beijing where he meets and falls in love with the princess as a dowry to the king of Persia.
notes: The adventures of Marco Polo are those of Gary Cooper whose lines were scripted by Robert E. Sherwood with a more comic than adventurous streak. First appearance of 17-year-old Lana Turner.

title: Peter Pan
directors: Clyde Geronimi, Hamilton Luske, Wilfred Jackson
description: The three London brothers Wendy, Gianni and Michele, make friends with Peter Pan, half boy and half elf, who, one evening, suddenly appears in their room accompanied by a tiny luminous fairy: Tinker Bell. The creature, who can fly and doesn't want to get big, convinces the three to follow him to Neverland. Here they will face Captain Hook and his pirates, archenemies of Peter Pan.
notes: The three directors take the text by J.M. Barrie and give an interpretation that gives more importance to the themes of escape into the fantastic to those of the child who does not want to know about becoming an adult. Skillful mixing of genres: western, adventure and musical.

title: Minority Report
actors: Tom Cruise, Colin Farrell, Samantha Morton, Max Von Sydow, Kathryn Morris, Patrick Kilpatrick, Jessica Capshaw, Richard Coca, Keith Campbell, Kirk B.R. Woller, Klea Scott, Frank Grillo, Anna Maria Horsford, Sarah Simmons
description: Washington, 2054. Applying a new technology, the murder has been eliminated: in fact the police (thanks to three young visionaries considered infallible called "Pre-Cogs", who are able to see images that reveal the time, place and other details of the crimes that are about to happen) can foresee the future and punish the guilty before the crimes are committed. Commander John Anderton is part of the intervention department in charge of arresting potential criminals: but when the arrest order is triggered for him too (to prevent him from killing a complete stranger in the next 36 hours), he is forced to prove his innocence and escape his own department led by his eternal rival Danny Witwer, who wants to eliminate him. Sneaking under the radar of the most technologically advanced city, where every individual is monitored 24/7, John must prove that the Pre-Cogs can be wrong ...
notes: A bizarre mix of ancient and near future, between the "things to come" that probably already exist in the research laboratories and the sinuous gardens of the witches where flowers surround you or the aseptic "amniotic" pool in which the Pre-Cogs dream. But the most subtle contrast woven by the film is that between the explicit narration in the key of a sci-fi thriller and a painful and almost "suicidal" reflection on the theme of vision. Screenplay by Scott Frank and Jon Cohen, based on the short story of the same name by Philip K. Dick, published in 1956.

title: Signs
actors: Mel Gibson, Joaquin Phoenix, Rory Culkin, Abigail Breslin, Cherry Jones, M. Night Shyamalan
description: Pastor Graham Hess lost his faith after his wife died. With his two children Bo and Morgan and his younger brother Merrill, he lives on a farm in Pennsylvania located in the middle of a vast cornfield. Suddenly gigantic and disturbing circles (the so-called "crop circles") appear on the ground, which push Hess to look for what really lies behind the inexplicable phenomenon ...
notes: Shyamalan's fifth feature film is a composite and eccentric film, in which the author seems to follow his own paths of maturation, research and evolution rather than worrying about offering us a linear interpretation of the story. In fact, taking only as a starting point (by his explicit admission) the strong suggestion of crop circles, Shyamalan crosses backwards through the territory of science fiction: from the mystical-poetic impact of the encounter with the aliens of Spielberg's _Close Encounters of the Third Kind_ to violent tension in Romero's films, up to Siegel's _The Invasion of the Body Snatchers_ and other examples from the 1950s. Perhaps it is Siegel's film (and perhaps Hitchcock's _The Birds_) that has deeply influenced the Indian-born director the most. In the end, under the many levels of interpretation (often contradictory, sometimes simplistic), a remarkable fresco of "American Gothic" emerges: a mixture of Calvinism, pop ingenuity, isolationism and "social disease" nowadays difficult to find in a film admittedly of kind.

title: Road to Perdition
actors: Tom Hanks, Paul Newman, Jude Law, Tyler Hoechlin, Stanley Tucci, Jennifer Jason Leigh
description: Chicago, 1930s: Michael Sullivan, known to all as "the Angel of Death", is a ruthless hitman of the Irish gang headed by godfather John Rooney; but he is also a caring husband, a loving father of two children. When his wife and youngest son are killed, Sullivan - thirsty for revenge - does not hesitate to involve his other son, hitherto unaware of his profession, dragging him with him on a journey in search of the killer ...
notes: Luxurious and icy, a film that talks about guts, death, blood ties, in an America extrapolated from comic strips and filtered by Hopper's cinema and painting.

title: Men in Black II
actors: Tommy Lee Jones, Will Smith, Rosario Dawson, Lara Flynn Boyle
description: The strange couple of federal agents who fight alien and illegal immigration to Earth return. Unfortunately one of the two, Kay (Jones) has lost his memory, a not insignificant inconvenience since he was the one who held information crucial for the safety of the planet.
notes: The sequel to "Men in Black" is a very blunt space halberd, with no decent idea to be one, with a TV show duration (less than an hour and a half). Barry Sonnenfeld masks widespread embarrassment by mocking Tim Burton (Danny Elfman's score helps him) but "Mars Attacks!" it was really something else entirely.

title: S1mØne
actors: Al Pacino, Rachel Roberts (I), Catherine Keener, Winona Ryder, Jay Mohr
description: Abandoned by the bizarre lead actress of his new film, producer Viktor Taransky decides to replace her with S1mØne (aka "Simulation One"): a virtual interpreter, the result of an invention that a misunderstood genius had entrusted to him before he died. The film comes out, it is a resounding success and the protagonist - who everyone believes is real - becomes a star ...
notes: Supported by an extraordinary Pacino, Niccol (also - and above all - screenwriter) orchestrates a "bad" apologue that at a certain point pretends to become good, familiar and consoling, but then fortunately turns upside down again. Between false appearances, real needs and oddities of the audience.

title: Santa sangre
actors: Axel Jodorowsky, Blanca Guerra, Guy Stockwell, Adan Jodorowsky, Thelma Tixou, Sabrina Dennison, Faviola Elenka Tapia, Jesús Juárez, Brontis Jodorowsky
description: Traumatized by a truculent childhood (his mother castrated his father, who killed himself after tearing her arms), Fenix ??is ??hospitalized in a clinic where he remains for twenty years. She manages to escape and finds work in a circus, where together with her mother she sets up a curious number of cabarets in which he lends her his limbs. In the meantime, however, he is slaughtering young girls ...
notes: Blood flows freely in Jodorowsky's sixth film, a distorted and baroque melodrama. For strong palates: it is not everyday stuff to see Fellini resurrected in the madness of a perverse horror. Written by the director with Roberto Leoni and Claudio Argento.

title: Il sasso in bocca
actors: Giuseppe Di Bella, Accursio Di Leo, Franca Asciutto, Carlo Hintermann
description: Attempt to reconstruct the connivance between the Sicilian mafia and the Italian political power through a collage that assembles archive material, repertoire pieces, reconstructed sequences and film clips.
notes: A thesis documentary, an interesting experiment: weak parts where the news is reconstructed for the occasion.

title: Cry of Banshee
actors: Vincent Price, Elisabeth Berger, Essy Persson, Patrick Mowen
description: A woman is tried for witchcraft and burned alive at the stake. But her spirit is incarnated again to take revenge on the judge who sentenced her.
notes: Renaissance setting and gothic atmospheres for a conventional horror. The theme of demonic possession is conducted without pathos and the Italian title suggests erotic thrills that are not there.

title: The Satanic Rites of Dracula
actors: Christopher Lee, Peter Cushing, Michael Coles, William Franklyn
description: The bloodthirsty count this time is a famous scientist who invented a virus capable of destroying the whole of humanity. Meanwhile, it rages in the high-ranking London salons, where it chooses its victims among the noble women of the city.
notes: One of the latest products from the famous London house Hammer, specialized in B series horror.

title: Sayonara
actors: Marlon Brando, Miiko Taka, Patricia Owens, Miyoshi Umeki, Red Buttons, Ricardo Montalban, Martha Scott, James Garner
description: Korean War. The American airman Kelly, belonging to the department commanded by Major Lloyd Gruver, falls in love with a Japanese and marries her despite opposition from the American authorities. Meanwhile, the officer meets a Japanese dancer and he too falls into her arms. One of the two love stories will have dramatic results.
notes: Based on the James Michener novel, the original screenplay was written by Brando himself, then reworked by Paul Osborn. A solid melodrama with impeccable packaging. Nine Oscar nominations, he won four: best scenography, best photography, and the award for two supporting actors.

title: K-19: The Widowmaker
country: United States, Great Britain, Germany, Canada
actors: Harrison Ford, Liam Neeson, Peter Sarsgaard, Joss Ackland
description: We are in 1961, north of the Atlantic Ocean, in the midst of the Cold War. One of the reactors of the first Soviet nuclear submarine, the K-19, is broken: it could explode, endangering not only the life of the crew, but sparking a war between the super powers. Captain Alexei Vostrikov must decide whether to follow the Kremlin's orders or save the lives of his men.
notes: Is "K-19" a phoned and predictable movie? Not really because there is everything we know will be there but there is also a good narrative tension from start to finish. Thus, the (naive?) Viewer finally absolves himself: what more do you want to expect more from a submarine film?

title: Columbo: Double Exposure
actors: Peter Falk, Richard Basehart, Honor Blackman, John Williams
description: Lieutenant Colombo (Falk), on a trip to Scotland Yard, finds himself investigating the murder of an entrepreneur. Suspicions fall on an actress who was having an affair with the man. Lieutenant Colombo, with his usual phlegm, will try to solve the case.
notes: One cannot expect more from an episode of the famous television series.

title: De Wisselwachter
actors: Jim van der Woude, Stéphane Excoffier, John Kraaykamp
description: A train stops in the middle of a wasteland. In the semi-abandoned station a lady goes down and ends up spending the whole winter as a guest of the swinger, an eccentric individual of few words. Little by little something is born between the two, but the story will have a tragic ending.
notes: A rarefied film, full of long silences and languid glances. Suspended between grotesque and fabulous intentions, it lacks exasperated symbolism.

title: A Royal Scandal
actors: Tallulah Bankhead, Charles Coburn, William Eythe, Anne Baxter
description: The story is that of Catherine of Russia, a woman with a firm character and many lovers. He also seduces the captain of the guards Chernoff, arousing the scandal of the court and the ire of a general who plots behind the scenes.
notes: During production, Lubitsch, struck by a heart attack, made Otto Preminger finish the film: perhaps for this reason, the film is discontinuous, incongruous and works on alternating current. Based on the comedy "La Zarina" by Lajos Biro and Melchior Lengyel, which Lubitsch had already been inspired by for "Forbidden Paradise" (1924).

title: The Bourne Identity
actors: Matt Damon, Franka Potente, Chris Cooper, Clive Owen, Brian Cox
description: Jason Bourne is rescued from death by the timely intervention of an Italian fishing boat in the Mediterranean. The man suffering from amnesia tries to reclaim his past that has left the marks of two bullets stuck in his back, a propensity for beatings and foreign languages, some killers on his heels. In his search he is joined by a mysterious young woman.
notes: Based on one of the novels in the trilogy dedicated to agent Jason Bourne by Robert Ludlum, _The Bourne Identity_ is yet another sluggish thriller that Hollywood offers us. Director Doug Liman who comes from indie cinema, messes and doesn't control his material.

title: Scandal in Paris
actors: George Sanders, Signe Hasso, Carole Landis, Akim Tamiroff
description: After his escape from prison, François scores a series of robberies committed in complicity with his friend Vernet. But at the end of his career he reaches the post of chief of the Paris police.
notes: Sirk fancies the story of a charming personality: bright and funny, a sympathetically amoral film. The biography of the famous thief François Vidocq (Sanders), taken from the "Memoirs" of François-Eugène Vidocq.

title: The Man in the White Suit
actors: Alec Guinness, Joan Greenwood, Cecil Parker, Michael Gough
description: A chemist invents a fabric that can change the destiny of industry and the economic structure of society: it is a fiber that can neither be destroyed nor soiled.
notes: A hilarious and subtle satire of capitalism, caught in its moments of irrational hysteria. The comedy, based on a work by Roger McDougall (who also wrote the screenplay with the director and John Dighton), does not grant extenuating circumstances to anyone.

title: Uno scandalo perbene
actors: Ben Gazzara, Giuliana De Sio, Valeria D'Obici, Vittorio Caprioli
description: In the Turin of the 1920s, the wife of a soldier missing in the war thinks she recognizes her husband in a patient hospitalized in an asylum because he has no memory. At the same time, the police insinuate the suspicion that the patient is instead an offender who has escaped justice. Although the trial will indicate the man as the wanted criminal, the woman will abandon everything to flee with him to Brazil.
notes: Skillful reconstruction on the edge of ambiguity: but much of the effectiveness of the film is due to the actors, Ben Gazzara above all. Last film by Pasquale Festa Campanile, inspired by a news story.

title: xXx
actors: Vin Diesel, Samuel L. Jackson, Asia Argento, Marton Csokas
description: Xander Cage, a young specialist in extreme sports, is recruited by the US government for a special mission. His job is to gather information about an organization that is planning the destruction of the world, under the leadership of the fearsome Yorgi.
notes: The most truzzo film of recent years is all built on the physicality of Vin Diesel who has a fundamental characteristic in order not to be detested: irony. Rob Cohen has a lot of work and in the unbearable pounding of the decibels he manages to insert some pretty good action sequences (above all, avalanche snowboarding). He would be a great candidate for directing a 007.

title: Mr. Deeds
actors: Adam Sandler, Winona Ryder, John Turturro, Steve Buscemi
description: After inheriting a fortune from his uncle, the telecommunications magnate, the naïve Longfellow Deeds, owner of a pizzeria in the village of Mandrake Falls, puts himself at the head of the empire inspired by the positive values ??he believes in. A journalist is sent to the town in search of gossip, in order to create a report that portrays Deeds as an incompetent: but the spark strikes between the two ...
notes: Good feelings to the bitter end and the apology for an idyllic and provincial America in this pale remake of Frank Capra's Happiness Is Coming (1936), which trivializes the sincere idealism of the great Italian-American director.

title: The Sum of All Fears
actors: Ben Affleck, Morgan Freeman, James Cromwell, Liev Schreiber, Bridget Moynahan
description: 28-year-old Jack Ryan, who has just joined the CIA, faces a group of terrorists who intend to detonate a nuclear bomb in a Baltimore stadium in order to provoke a conflict between the United States and Russia ...
notes: Robinson's direction is very weak: he decides to move some action after a good hour of film, but he dismisses it quickly. Wasted good actors: Freeman, Cromwell, Bates, playing presidents, CIA bosses, paranoid bad guys. On the other hand, Affleck, an inexpressive doll who even manages to make Alec Baldwin, known "actor by chance", regret it. Based on the fourth novel by Tom Clancy.

title: Street Scene
actors: Sylvia Sidney, William Collier jr., Estelle Taylor, David Landau
description: A film in which the events of small people intertwine: the frenetic activity of the street, some dramatic event that interrupts the daily routine.
notes: An essay of skill applied to a humble subject. Vidor starts from a mediocre play by Elmer Rice from 1929, to go and film the daily life of a working-class neighborhood in New York.

title: Jagdszenen aus Niederbayern
actors: Martin Sperr, Angela Winkler, Else Obnecke, Michael Strixner
description: Abram lives in a Bavarian village, where people avoid him because they think he's homosexual. In a fit of anger, he causes the death of the only person who has ever shown sympathy: Hannelore, the burgomaster's domestic chat.
notes: From the homonymous drama by Martin Sperr (who also wrote the screenplay, in addition to playing the protagonist), a dry and hard work on the hypocrisy of "people" and on the closed, obtuse and backward character of the country mentality. Film shot in Bavaria, not widely distributed at home, but which had some success abroad and which contributed to the birth of the New German Cinema.

title: Schiava del peccato
actors: Silvana Pampanini, Marcello Mastroianni, Franco Fabrizi, Irene Genna
description: The only survivors in a train accident are a girl and a prostitute. The woman, in trying to obtain adoption, redeems herself and changes her life, but the past does not forgive and an old protector prevents the realization of her dream.
notes: Melodrama without a happy ending, a concentration of Matarazzo's themes and obsessions, where once again the female figure has something to be forgiven.

title: Of Human Bondage
actors: Leslie Howard, Bette Davis, Frances Dee, Kay Johnson
description: A lame medical student falls in love with the maid Mildred, who seduces him to be able to exploit him in times of difficulty ...
notes: Cromwell portrays well the climate of anguish that distinguishes William Somerset Maugham's novel. This is the first film in which Bette Davis appears in the role of the unscrupulous witch, a mask that conditioned her career in the years to come.

title: The Late George Apley
actors: Ronald Colman, Peggy Cummins, Vanessa Brown, Richard Haydn
description: George Apley, a wealthy and powerful Boston businessman, has no sympathy for his daughter's sweetheart and tries to force her into an arranged marriage. But the girl, rebellious and stubborn like her father, manages to marry the man she loves.
notes: Good-natured and enjoyable comedy inspired by the novel by John P. Marquand.

title: L'écoume des jours
actors: Jacques Perrin, Marie-France Pisier, Sami Frey, Alexandra Stewart
description: A young man tries in friends the help to save his (Pisier) his sick wife of an incurable evil in the lungs. But he finds himself abandoned by everyone.
notes: Film of refined sensitivity, told with a nostalgic eye to the French cinema of the 1930s. Opera first of Belmond, who also signs the screenplay together Pierre Pelegri and Philippe Dumarçay. Taken from a novel by Boris Vian.

title: The Prowler
actors: Van Heflin, Evelyn Keyes, John Maxwell, Katharine Warren
description: A policeman in love with a sick love for a married woman kills her husband.
notes: In telling the story of a criminal and obsessive policeman, Losey signs one of his masterpieces: between the objectivity of a dry and ruthless gaze and the ambiguous participation in the character's disturbed personality, the film finds its tragic dimension. Dalton Trumbo also collaborated on the script signed by Hugo Butler, absent in the opening credits because he was under investigation by the investigating commission on anti-American activities.

title: Panic
actors: Kristanna Loken, Sanyogita Bhave, John Bishop, Boti Ann Bliss
description: Three plane crashes in a few days on the eve of July 4th: the United States flew in the panic of another attack, behind which Pakistani terrorists would hide. The only one who disagrees is Neil McCabe, a computer expert who is convinced that it is technological terrorism: the person responsible would be a computer wizard ...

title: Gale Force
actors: Treat Williams, Michael Dudikoff, Paul Logan, Renee Ridgeley
description: Sam, a Los Angeles detective, takes part in a reality TV show: along with three other contestants he must hunt for a treasure (10 million dollars in cash) hidden on a wild island. to spoil the show is Jared, at the head of a militia armed to the teeth, who lands on the island to get his hands on the loot. An easy task, but only apparently: because the timid Sam and his improvised comrades in arms manage to prevent the group from leaving the island with the treasure, and then nature gets involved, unleashing a hurricane that risks making a square clean of all.

title: L'aîné de Fercheaux
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Charles Vanel, Michèle Mercier, Stefania Sandrelli
description: A late-career boxer, Mandet, and a financier, Ferchaux, with unfinished business with bankruptcy justice, leave France together to try to rebuild a life in the United States. The difficult friendship between two desperate people will not stand up to the final test.
notes: One of Melville's most underrated films, which deserves a more careful reading. The novel from which it is based is entitled _L'aîné de Fercheaux_ (_The firstborn of the Ferchaux_) by Georges Simenon. In a small part (that of the hitchhiker) there is a young Stefania Sandrelli.

title: Alias Nick Beal
actors: Ray Milland, Thomas Mitchell, Audrey Totter, George Macready
description: An attorney general battling a gang of criminals enlisted the help of a criminal with a mysterious identity to win the trial. The appearance of a beautiful woman helps him win the case. The success obtained opens the way to a political career. It will be his wife who will save him from complete moral corruption.
notes: Interesting reinterpretation of the myth of Faust, imbued with the atmosphere of the American gangster-movie.

title: The Unknown
actors: Lon Chaney, Norman Kerry, Joan Crawford, Nick De Ruiz
description: Alonzo, a thief pursued by the police, takes refuge in a Spanish circus and pretends to be armless to deflect suspicions. Here he meets Nanon a girl who can't stand being hugged by men and falls in love with her. To be accepted by the one he loves, he forces a surgeon to cut off his arms. But when he returns to the circus after the operation, he discovers that Nanon is engaged to another.
notes: Browing's masterpiece, born from the director's collaboration with Lon Chaney, without whose prodigious ability to bend the body in incredible transformations this film would never have seen the light. A delusional melodrama about the terrible wonder of human passions, which crosses - with an audacity inconceivable today - the boundaries between beauty and monstrosity.

title: Frightened City
actors: Sean Connery, Herbert Lom, John Gregson, Alfred Marks, Yvonne Romain
description: The famous London homicide section is engaged in the fight against a criminal organization that terrorizes an entire district of the city by blackmailing traders.
notes: The usual rhetoric on the "nose" of British investigators, for a gangster-movie that does not reserve any surprises.

title: Good Neighbor Sam
actors: Jack Lemmon, Romy Schneider, Edward G. Robinson, Dorothy Provine, Michael Connors, Neil Hamilton, Edward Andrews
description: A happily married advertiser pretends to be her husband to help a neighbor collect an inheritance. When it becomes public knowledge, family relationships become complicated and he inevitably ends up in trouble.
notes: Lemmon in the role of the respectable gentleman who ended up in a situation he can no longer control is always a spectacle, even in a not particularly lively film.

title: If I Had A Million
directors: James Cruze, H. Bruce Humberstone, Ernst Lubitsch, Norman Z. McLeod, Stephen Roberts, William A. Seiter, Norman Taurog, Lothar Mendes
actors: W. C. Fields, Charles Laughton, May Robson, Gary Cooper
description: An old millionaire does not resign himself to leaving the inheritance to his greedy relatives: chosen at random eight names from the telephone book, he gives each stranger a check for a million dollars.
notes: The film, divided into eight episodes plus a prologue, follows the misadventures of the lucky chosen ones (a salesman, a false, a prostitute, two comic actors, a prisoner, an employee, a soldier and a bitter old woman). Taurog, responsible for the project, is the author of the prologue and the episode with Laughton, a humble employee who, becoming rich, takes revenge on its director. Intelligent and amused kaleidoscope of a humanity blinded by the myth of wealth.

title: Sebastian
actors: Dirk Bogarde, Susannah York, John Gielgud, Lilli Palmer, Nigel Davenport
description: Mr. Sebastian, a maths professor from Oxford, gets involved with British intelligence, interested in using his ability to crack encrypted codes to unmask the activity of a spy network. As a result, the teacher's quiet and ordinary life is suddenly turned upside down by a series of adventures. And there is also time for a complicated relationship with colleague Rebecca Howard ...
notes: The plot is confused, but the film (written by Gerald Vaughan-Hughes from a story by Leo Marks, former screenwriter of _The eye that kills_, Michael Powell's masterpiece) can boast some good moments of suspense.

title: Sebastiane
actors: Leonardo Treviglio, Barney James, Neil Kennedy, Richard Warwick, Lindsay Kemp, Donald Dunham, Daevid Finbar, Ken Hicks, Stefano Massari, Janusz Romanov
description: 3rd century AD: the Roman soldier Sebastiano da Narbona is confined to an island with eight companions dedicated to the pleasures of the body. The platoon commander falls in love with him, but Sebastiano heroically resists the temptations of the flesh.
notes: The martyrdom of arrows is transformed into an exhausting psychoanalytic session, made up of masochistic enjoyment and homosexual drives. Jarman's first feature film: tiring and intellectualistic, starting with the choice to let the actors speak in Latin (crippled, it goes without saying, by a heavy English cadence). Nor does Brian Eno's music column contribute to making the whole less indigestible.

title: Les séducteurs
directors: Dino Risi, Edouard Molinaro, Bryan Forbes, Gene Wilder
actors: Roger Moore, Lynn Redgrave, Denholm Elliott, Lino Ventura
description: Four stories based on sentimental misunderstandings and silly amorous quarrels, set in four different cities, which also give the title to the various episodes: London, Paris, Los Angeles and Rome. The main reason: the sexual itches of middle-aged men who are frustrated in their daily lives.
notes: None of the episodes stands out above the others.

title: Born to Be Bad
actors: Joan Fontaine, Robert Ryan, Zachary Scott, Joan Leslie, Mel Ferrer
description: Isabella, envious and intriguing, manages to marry the rich publisher Charlie, with whom her aunt is in love. Gained wealth and an enviable social position, he tries to seduce even the charming writer Jake; the latter, despite being anything but insensitive to her graces, seems to be the only one capable of looking beyond appearances. But Charlie's money is too much for Isabella ...
notes: Directed without much conviction, a minor film in the career of the author of _Gio bruciata_, supported only (but not a little) by the enchanting perfidy of the protagonist, by a high-level supporting cast and by Nicholas Musuraca's black and white.

title: La ragazza di latta
actors: Sydne Rome, Roberto Antonelli, Elena Persiani, Simone Mattioli
description: An employee of a large industry falls in love with a colleague who seems to share dreams and ideals with him. But he'll soon be disappointed in her conformism, who just wants to settle down.
notes: Petty-bourgeois drama shot without any conviction and only anxious to confirm stereotypes and prejudices.

title: Goodbye, Columbus
actors: Richard Benjamin, Ali MacGraw, Jack Klugman, Nan Martin, Michael Meyers
description: A boy of modest prospects falls in love with a young woman belonging to the circle of wealthy New York Jews. Her family tries to convince him to leave her, or at least to marry her, finding a profitable job ...
notes: Taken from Philip Roth, a fascinating portrait of the Jewish upper middle class. The cast was flawless.

title: Zoolander
actors: Ben Stiller, Owen Wilson, Christine Taylor, Will Ferrell, Milla Jovovich, David Duchovny, Jerry Stiller
description: Model Derek Zoolander is at the height of his career. She received the "Top Model of the Year" award for the third time in a row and is about to win her fourth title. But one day, after meeting Hansel, a young and ambitious model, she decides to abandon everything and go back to her family in Pennsylvania. From here his agent and the stylist Jacobim Mugatu draws him. The two plan to brainwash Derek so he can obey their orders and assassinate the president of Malaysia.
notes: Ben Stiller drives the camera following a mediocre script and hopes that the actors' performance will guide the staging.

title: Hjælp, jeg er en fisk
description: Stella, Fly and their cousin Charles, taking advantage of the absence of their parents and the distraction of Aunt Anna who should be watching them, set out in the middle of the ocean for a fishing trip. By chance, the three brats discover Professor MacKrill's laboratory who has invented a potion capable of transforming humans into fish. Due to a reckless mistake, the three drink the mixture and become creatures of the sea. It will not be easy for them to become children again.
notes: A certain ecological spirit, adventure and a simple design make this film a valid counter-proposal to the overwhelming fantasy of the overseas "monters" and to the fascinating new age catastrophism that comes from Japan.

title: Los sin nombre
actors: Emma Vilarasau, Karra Elejalde, Tristán Ulloa, Pep Tosar, Jordi Dauder
description: Claudia now resigned to the loss of her daughter Angela, murdered five years earlier, receives a phone call that plunges her back into a nightmare that she believed was over forever. The voice he hears through the handset sounds like his daughter's. Angela begs her to come and get her. Shocked Claudia asks for help from a former policeman and a journalist expert in supernatural phenomena. But unraveling the problem will not be easy.

title: Yamakasi - Les samouraïs des temps modernes
actors: Guylain N'Guba Boyeke, Châu Belle Dinh, Williams Belle, Malik Diouf, Yannn H'Nautra
description: The Yamakasi are a group of athletes who have made unprotected jumping their reason for living. The band includes Baseball, Araignée, Belette, Zicmu, Rocket, Sitting Bull and Tango. The seven are idols for the neighborhood kids who try to imitate them. But an accident happens to put the Yamakasi in difficulty: the little Djamel who wants to imitate them falls, gets hurt and has to be operated on. The gang is busy finding the money they need.
notes: The Yamakasi (the word in Bantu means strong spirit) are rooftop artists who run and jump. Besson hires them for _Taxi 2_ and in 2000 for this silly short film of which he is, alas, the screenwriter.

title: Stardom
actors: Robert Lepage, Charles Berling, Dan Aykroyd, Jessica Paré, Camilla Rutherford
description: The young and charming Tina is contacted by a fashion photographer who refers her to a mannequins agency. From that day on, her life changed radically: Tina no longer had a free moment and soon became Bruce Taylor's favorite subject and a "media object". Little by little, she becomes engaged to Barry, an up-and-coming restorer. The press won't leave you alone for a moment. Things take a good turn when Tina meets a UN ambassador.

title: Texas Rangers
actors: Jordan Brower, Rachael Leigh Cook, James Van Der Beek, Dylan McDermott, Alfred Molina
description: Second half of the nineteenth century: the law is an opinion for the inhabitants of the state of Texas. To ensure order and justice, a special body is created, the Texas Rangers. At the head of the armed group is Leander McNelly, a brave man who fights to put an end to the abuses of John King and his gang of outlaws.
notes: That of the Texan rangers is a western myth very popular in American cinema (a film for everyone: King Vidor's The Knights of Texas_, from 1936). Last good comes Miner with a history of super good rangers and super villain bandits. Nothing infamous, centuries ago the Monogram or the Republic would have produced it.

title: Une fille et des fusils
actors: Jean Pierre Kalfon, Pierre Barouh, Amidou, Jacques Portet
description: Four men, tired of the worker's wretched life, improvise as gangsters and kidnap a novice actress, thinking of a lavish ransom. But the production of the film in which she is acting uses the situation to advertise the film. Eventually the girl will be freed and the "four machine guns" will return to a normal life.
notes: A gangster film, a sentimental comedy, a thriller: all mixed with a certain irony. Third film by Lelouch.

title: Abschied von gestern - (Anita G.)
actors: Alexandra Kluge, Hans Korte, Edit Kuntze-Peloggio, Palma Flack
description: A young Jewish girl escapes from socialist Germany to live in the capitalist one of the West: she lives on tricks, precarious jobs, petty thefts, unfortunate encounters.
notes: With the blessing of Godard, the film is one of the first exponents of the New German Cinema of the 70s. Experimental, realistic and bitter. Silver Lion at the Venice Film Festival. Photograph by Edgar Reitz. Kluge's first film, based on his own story.

title: Ragazze da marito
actors: Eduardo De Filippo, Peppino De Filippo, Titina De Filippo, Anna Maria Ferrero, Delia Scala, Carlo Campanini, Carlo Croccolo
description: An employee in financial straits does not know how to send his family on vacation. Find the money by getting a bribe. Everything happens at the sea: one daughter falls in love with a poor young man, another gets pregnant, the third decides to get married. Meanwhile, the head of the family is fired because his scam has been discovered.
notes: Melancholy comedy, with a great Eduardo.

title: Mädchen in Uniform
actors: Hertha Thiele, Dorothea Wieck, Emilie Unda, Hedwig Schlichter
description: Germany: in a strict and traditionalist boarding school for girls, a girl prey to the fumes of alcohol lets her governess escape that she is in love with her. She is punished. The girl can't stand humiliation and pain and kills herself.
notes: Shot two years before Hitler's rise to power, a prophetic film: the theme of female homosexuality, the description of a German militarism already hysterical in its manifestations of power, the damages of an inhuman education. At the advent of Nazism, Léontine Sagan left Germany, along with her collaborators. From the play "Yesterday and Today" by Christa Winsloe.

title: Mädchen in Uniform
actors: Romy Schneider, Lilli Palmer, Thérèse Giehse, Blandine Ebinger, Adelheid Seeck, Gina Albert, Sabine Sinjen, Christine Kaufmann, Ginette Pigeon, Danik Patisson
description: An orphan in a boarding school suspiciously bonds with an educator. A scandal breaks out: while the woman loses her job, the girl attempts suicide. The superiors, impressed by his gesture, will be lenient.
notes: Re-creation of the film shot by Léontine Sagan in 1931, cleansed of any overly explicit reference to homosexuality and cleansed of any situation that is too crude.

title: No Greater Glory
actors: George Breakston, Jimmy Butler, Jackie Searl, Julius Molnar
description: In the Budapest of the 30s, two groups of children fight for the possession of a small piece of land, the scene of all their games and passions. While a small and ferocious "war of buttons" rages, the most frail and delicate of them falls ill. His death will mark the end of childhood for everyone.
notes: Poetic and cruel, as the book can be. Rightly awarded as best foreign film at the 1935 Venice Film Festival. Based on the novel of the same name by Ferenc Molnár.

title: Inside Moves
actors: John Savage, David Morse, Diana Scarwid, Amy Wright, Harold Russell
description: A boy from Los Angeles, following a suicide attempt, is left handicapped. Rediscover the will to live and self-confidence by attending a bar whose clientele is made up largely of disabled people like him.
notes: Despite some surreal and ironic sequences, the film fails to avoid a certain irritating sentimentality and slips into the pathetic. Based on the novel by Todd Walton. Screenplay by Valerie Curtin and Barry Levinson.

title: The Small Back Room
actors: David Farrar, Kathleen Byron, Jack Hawkins, Robert Morley
description: London: During the Second World War, a scientific researcher in decline because of alcoholism and physically handicapped, is called to defuse a mine on the beach. In completing the mission, he finds confidence in himself and in his partner.
notes: Nice description of post-war London. The final sequence is thrilling. Based on a novel by Nigel Balchin.

title: Ragazzi fuori
actors: Francesco Benigno, Alessandro Di Sanzo, Roberto Mariano
description: The boys from the Malaspina prison in Palermo have come out and have to rebuild their lives. The homosexual Mery prostitutes himself in the alleys of the city, Antonio tries to sell potatoes on the street, but is arrested because he does not have a license. Natale begins to frequent bad company again, Cin Ciong dies following a robbery and Claudio, who tries to change his life, is killed for old grudges.
notes: Risi finds inspiration in neorealism to make a film perhaps not completely resolved in the narrative structure, but vibrant with a sincere love for the lost lives that he pursues through the streets of the city. Based on a book by Aurelio Grimaldi, also a screenwriter. Sequel to "Mery forever".

title: A Boy Named Charlie Brown
description: The clumsy and shy Charlie Brown after yet another baseball defeat, participates in the school competition of difficult words. Of course it will be another failure.
notes: Attempt to bring the famous characters created by the designer Shultz to the screen. The operation is conducted with dignity. Anyway, much better stripes.

title: La raison d'état
actors: Jean Yanne, Monica Vitti, Michel Bouquet, François Périer, Jean-Claude Bouillon
description: A French biologist discovers that a prominent government member is involved in international arms trafficking. He would like to report him, but he gets out of the way first. His battle is completed by an Italian friend who discovers the truth about his death.
notes: Direction sloppy, nothing interesting.

title: The Frog Men
actors: Richard Widmark, Dana Andrews, Gary Merrill, Jeffrey Hunter
description: The commander of a navy diving team drowns during a mission. To replace him is called the soldier John Lawrence, a man in one piece who does not forgive anything to others and himself. He will pay dearly for his mistake in action.
notes: War film conducted on the seabed. Without infamy and without praise.

title: Par un beau matin d'été
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Sophie Daumier, Gabriele Ferzetti, Adolfo Celi
description: Francis, a boy who lives with his sister Monique often resorting to gimmicks, joins Kramer and Max, two crime professionals, with the intent of kidnapping the young daughter of a billionaire. After kidnapping, the gang takes refuge with the hostage in the house of a painter involved, despite himself in the plan. The strain of waiting for the ransom blows Francis's nerves and, during an altercation, kills Max, who in turn injures Monique. Kramer gets the better of him and tries to escape when he gets the money.
notes: Well packaged, but too sophisticated to be truly creepy. Taken from James Hadley Chase.

title: Confidential Report
actors: Orson Welles, Paola Mori, Robert Arden, Patricia Medina, Michael Redgrave
description: Van Stratten, an ambiguous seducer, approaches the daughter of the very rich Arkadin, with the aim of reaching his father and blackmailing him with false accusations. Arkadin decides to use it. He claims he does not remember anything of his youth and does not know the origins of his billionaire fortune: he instructs Van Stratten to investigate his past and meanwhile keeps an eye on him in his investigations around the world. In his plan, however, he is hampered by exclusive love for his daughter.
notes: A film crushed by the immense figure of Welles, who impresses his baroque and funeral genius on every shot and on every face. Forced, as usual, to run with very few means, after the economic failure of "Quarto power". Welles seventh film.

title: Fingers
actors: Harvey Keitel, Jim Brown, Tisa Farrow, Michael V. Gazzo
description: Jimmy Fingers is a concert that feeds artistic hopes. He is placed by his father in the infernal circle of betting and prostitution. His descent into a spiral of fury and violence takes him further and further away from the "pure" world of music.
notes: Harvey Keitel is already preparing for the role of "The Bad Lieutenant". Unusual and unsettling. Toback's first work, strongly influenced at the time by Scorsese's poetics.

title: Rashômon
actors: Toshiro Mifune, Masayuki Mori, Machiko Kyo, Takashi Shimura
description: A lumberjack, a monk and a passerby tell the story of a bandit accused of killing a samurai and raping his wife. Each of them gives the story a different version. Each of them accuses himself of the crime, but blames the others for the real responsibility for what happened.
notes: The unknowability of reality and at the same time a very high love for truth: a masterpiece of world cinema. Based on Akutagawa's short stories, Golden Lion at the Venice Film Festival and Oscar for best foreign film. The film that introduced Kurosawa cinema to the West.

title: Ratboy
actors: Sondra Locke, Robert Townsend, Christopher Hewett, Larry Hankin
description: Los Angeles: a windowist finds a bizarre being in his shop, a cross between a boy and a mouse. At first she exploits him as a slum phenomenon, then she decides to leave him free.
notes: Directed debut of Sondra Locke, then Clint Eastwood's partner. Dear and surreal fairy tale on the value of diversity. Robert E. Thompson script.

title: Razorback
actors: Gregory Harrison, Arkie Whiteley, Bill Kerr, Chris Haywood
description: An unnaturally sized wild boar roams the Australian deserts. A hunter is accused of the death of his grandson, but it turns out that the bloody animal is responsible ...
notes: In the footsteps of the glorious tradition of man's struggle against wild and uncontrollable nature, a quite energetic horror, with some authentically disturbing scenes.

title: Re-Animator
actors: Jeffrey Combs, Bruce Abbott, Barbara Crampton, Robert Sampson
description: A medical student invents a serum to resurrect the dead. But the corpses come back to life for the purpose of killing.
notes: Gordon's directorial debut, who began his film career with one of the most violent and revolting films of the 1980s, with no regard for anyone: a worthy heir to Romero. A joy. From a story by H.P. Lovecraft. Considered a cult movie by fans of the horror genre.

title: La cave se rebiffe
actors: Jean Gabin, Martine Carol, Frank Villard, Françoise Rosay, Bernard Blier
description: An improvised gang tries the big shot: to implement it, it avails itself of the help of Ferdinand, known as the "King of counterfeiters", who leaves on purpose from Montevideo for Paris. But this one ...
notes: From a novel by Albert Simonin (also screenwriter, with Grangier and Michel Audiard). Verve and always intelligent dialogues, and an irresistible Gabin.

title: The King of Marvin Gardens
actors: Jack Nicholson, Bruce Dern, Ellen Burstyn, Julia Anne Robinson
description: Jason Staebler, unreliable and braggart, convinces his brother David, a serious and irreproachable radio program speaker, to participate in an unclear deal involving real estate speculation. Things will end very badly ...
notes: Disturbing family dynamics and two worldviews in comparison. Rafelson, here in his third stage as a director, continues the journey he began two years earlier with _Five pieces easy_: nervous editing, broken narration, sensitivity for the landscape (the decadent Atlantic City). The title refers to a box in the American Monopoly. One of the posters of the then New Hollywood, among the few undated.

title: The Benny Goodman Story
actors: Steve Allen, Donna Reed, Herbert Anderson, Sammy Davis sr.
description: Biography of the famous jazz clarinetist Benny Goodman: his youth in Chicago, the apprenticeship, the first orchestra, love, the arrival of success.
notes: Shot at Goodman's moment of greatest notoriety, Davies can't distance himself from the character and the film can't lift himself from a supine reenactment of the facts.

title: Regina
actors: Ida Di Benedetto, Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Giuliana Calandra, Mariano Rigillo
description: An actress engaged in the staging of Racine's Phaedra, begins a relationship with an unreliable and self-centered man, who works secretly as a porn actor. The outcome of the meeting will be disastrous: tragic ending.
notes: Inspired by the work of Douglas Sirk, a rare example of Italian cinema that is not afraid of melodrama and of staging the extremes of passion. Beautiful photography by Tonino Nardi.

title: Anne of The Indies
actors: Jean Peters, Debra Paget, Louis Jourdan, Herbert Marshall
description: Anna, to avenge her brother's death, embarks on a pirate ship. Nicknamed Captain Providence, she falls in love with a French pirate paid by the British to hand her over to the authorities.
notes: Duels and battles, love triumphs in the end: classic adventure film made with craftsmanship.

title: Reign of Terror
actors: Robert Cummings, Arlene Dahl, Richard Hart, Richard Basehart
description: Set during the terror days of the French Revolution: Robespierre rules the nation with an iron fist. He compiles a black book in which he writes the names of the people he thinks are plotting against him and who must die on the guillotine. D'Aubigny arrives in Paris in the service of Barras: he foments the revolt against Robespierre, manages to get hold of the cursed book. Robespierre is guillotined.
notes: Excellent historical drama that always keeps the viewer on the edge of suspense.

title: La règle du jeu
actors: Marcel Dalio, Nora Grégor, Roland Toutain, Jean Renoir, Gaston Modot
description: A rich marquis leaves his lover to win back his wife, whom many men pay court to. The merry-go-round of the masters' loves are countered by those of the servants. All filmed in the country estate of the Marquis, where a group of nobles gathers for the rite of hunting the hare.
notes: Drama that begins cheerfully, but with a tragic ending. Commercial failure on its release, it was later rediscovered by the exponents of the Nouvelle Vague. Renoir plays a secondary role. Considered to be Renoir's masterpiece.

title: Quatre aventures de Reinette et Mirabelle
actors: Philippe Lauden Bach, Joëlle Miquel, Jessica Forde, Fabrice Luchini
description: Divided into four sections (_L'ora blu_, _Il waiter del caffè_, _The beggar, the kleptomaniac, the trickster_, _The sale of the painting_), the story of the friendship between a country girl and a city girl. The two could not be more different, but their characters and their digressions on freedom and morality are intertwined in a lively and paradoxical symphony.
notes: A less verbose Rohmer than usual in the first film of the "Comedies and Proverbs" cycle. A collage of coincidences, discards, misunderstandings, minimal ideas taken from everyday life, composed with a variety of tones ranging from amused to subdued, from amazed to elegiac.

title: Les liaisons dangereuses
actors: Gérard Philipe, Jeanne Moreau, Annette Vadim, Jean-Louis Trintignant
description: In late eighteenth-century France, the gentleman Valmont married the Marquise Merteuil. Later he seduces the virgin Cécile, betrothed to his wife's lover. The game of deceit and seduction staged by the cynical libertine will cause victims.
notes: Vadim misses the tragic aspect of the novel and reduces it to a series of (somewhat modest) erotic skits independent of each other. From the famous epistolary novel by Pierre Choderlos de Laclos.

title: Korol' Lir
actors: Jurij Jarvet, Elsa Radzin Szolkonis, Valentina Scendrikova, Galina Volchek
description: The King divides his kingdom between his three daughters. Having grown old, he is chased away by them and will die mad, abandoned by everyone.
notes: Interesting transposition of the famous tragedy, where the solemn tone of the matter is treated with a feverish and nervous energy. Adaptation of Shakespeare's tragedy in the translation by Boris Pasternak.

title: King Lear
actors: Paul Scofield, Annelise Gabold, Irene Worth, Alan Webb, Robert Lloyd
description: Old King Lear divides his kingdom among his daughters, who drive him out of the lands that have become theirs.
notes: Intellectual and complex adaptation of the Shakespearean tragedy, set in Denmark. Suggestions from avant-garde theater (the film is based on a play by Brook himself) and contemporary art for an experimental and visually fascinating film.

title: The Lion King
description: Simba is a lion cub living in the African savannah. Feeling accused of the death of his father Mafusa leaves his pack to inflict voluntary exile. Having grown up, he returns to his family, ready to face the evil Scar, the real responsible for his father's death.
notes: An animated drawing that returns to tradition - compact, dry and rounded - for this reinterpretation of the tragedy of Hamlet. Thirty-first Disney feature film, after "Aladdin". Mafusa's voice is from Vittorio Gassman.

title: Rendez-vous
actors: Juliette Binoche, Lambert Wilson, Wadeck Stanczak, Jean-Louis Trintignant
description: Paris: A young actress arrives from the provinces in search of work and finds herself involved in sentimental tangles with three different men, which in the end will leave her alone and desperate.
notes: Despite a certain unrealistic intellectualism, some moments are of sincere cynicism: then genuine pain emerges. Best Director the Cannes Film Festival.

title: Repulsion
actors: Catherine Deneuve, John Fraser, Patrick Wymark, Yvonne Furneaux
description: Belgian Carole lives with her sister in London, where she works as a manicurist. Cold and not very expansive, she reacts with increasing discomfort to men's advances. Until, left alone in the apartment, madness explodes: first she kills a suitor and then the landlord ...
notes: Polanski, the first film made outside of Poland, brings an internal psychological delirium to the surface of things and transforms normality into a horror film. The banality of everyday life becomes hell of the soul. Catatonia, cruelty and tenderness compete for the face of Deneuve. Silver Bear at the Berlin Film Festival.

title: We Live Again
actors: Ann Sten, Fredric March, Sam Jaffe, C. Aubrey Smith, Jane Baxter
description: Katyuscia, a Russian peasant woman is tried for prostitution. A noble present at the trial recognizes her as the girl he had seduced years earlier and then abandoned once she became an adult. Full of remorse, he gives his goods to the poor and follows her to Siberia.
notes: Adaptation without infamy and without praise. Based on the latest novel by Lev Tolstoy, screenplay by Preston Sturges, Maxwell Anderson and Leonard Praskins. Uncredited include Paul Green and Thornton Wilder. Photograph by Gregg Toland.

title: La red
actors: Rossana Podestà, Armand Silvestre, Crox Alvarado, Giullermo Cramer
description: Antonio and José are two outlaws. After a robbery they take refuge on an abandoned Mexican beach with José's girlfriend with whom Antonio falls in love. When Josè notices jealousy, things precipitate: Antonio kills the woman and then is killed by the police. Josè drowns with the corpse of his beloved in his arms.
notes: The seduction of bodies (the beautiful Podestà), set in the setting of a wild nature: an aesthetic and styleless melodrama.

title: Reuben, Reuben
actors: Tom Conti, Kelly McGillis, Roberts Blossom, Cynthia Harris
description: Gowan, a penniless, alcohol-addicted poet is maintained by his fans in New England. He finds true love in Geneva, a student who lives near him. But the poet, who has set his sights on a dentist's wife, soon becomes his victim. Reuben is the name of a dog that plays a decisive role in the story.
notes: A work of clear theatrical derivation, with a sustained rhythm. Excellent actors, on which Conti's histrionics stands out. Based on a novel by Peter de Vries and written by Julius J. Epstein.

title: None But the Lonely Heart
actors: Cary Grant, Ethel Barrymore, Barry Fitzgerald, Jane Wyatt, June Duprez
description: Ernie, a piano tuner son of a fallen of the Great War, lives in London with his seriously ill mother. To find a way out of a precarious economic situation, he lets gangster Jim get involved in a robbery. The son and mother, also implicated in the coup, will end up in prison.
notes: Melancholic urban drama, not without its originality. Ethel Barrymore giving her sick mother's face won the Oscar for Best Supporting Actress. The directorial debut of the screenwriter Clifford Odets who draws the story from a novel by Richard Llewellyn. The soundtrack is by Hanns Eisler, Brecht's collaborator, at the time in exile in Hollywood.

title: America, America
actors: Stathis Giallelis, Frank Wolff, Harry Davis, Elena Karam, Estelle Hemsley
description: In late 19th century Turkey, the Turkish government oppresses the Greek and Armenian minorities. The young Stavros lives in Constantinople, but dreams of going to America, against the advice of the family. Eventually, after many adventures, he manages to embark for New York.
notes: Lyrical and passionate picaresque saga. Kazan at its best. Sixteenth film by Kazan, based on a novel inspired by the life of an uncle.

title: L'insoumis
actors: Alain Delon, Lea Massari, Maurice Garrel, Georges Géret, Viviane Attia, Robert Castel
description: A lawyer who sympathizes with the Algerian cause is kidnapped in Algiers on behalf of the OAS by a deserter from the Foreign Legion who falls in love with her and frees her.
notes: Alain Delon, beautiful, creates a romantic and intense character and carries the whole film on his shoulders. First work by Cavalier, who wrote a drama on the OAS avoiding simplifications and rhetoric.

title: Kidnapped
actors: Michael Caine, Trevor Howard, Jack Hawkins, Donald Pleasence
description: Great Britain, 1746: the rebellion of the Jacobins, who support the monarchy of the deposed James II Stuart, is silenced by the battle of Culloden. As unrest rages, a treacherous uncle sells his nephew David as a slave to a ship leaving for the West Indies. Aided by a sailor, he returns to his homeland and joins the rebels.
notes: From the novels _The Kidnapped Boy_ and _Catriona_ by Robert Louis Stevenson. Pleasant and colorless adventure film, where everything is normal.

title: The Jokers
actors: Michael Crawfordd, Oliver Reed, Gabriella Lucidi, Harry Andrews
description: Two rich and spoiled brothers decide to steal the crown jewels from the Tower of London just to prove themselves and challenge the institutions.
notes: Comedy conducted with brio, at times pleasantly funny, which returns the brilliant atmosphere of Swinging London. Too bad for the closing not up to the rest.

title: Rich and Strange
actors: Henry Kendall, Joan Barry, Betty Amann, Percy Marmont
description: A stroke of luck turns a modest employee Fred into a wealthy gentleman: he leaves his normal life and embarks with his wife for a cruise in the South Seas. But during the crossing she falls in love with a shady individual, and he takes a crush on a princess who turns out to be an adventurer. The ship sinks and they will be rescued by a Chinese pirate boat.
notes: Unusual film by Hitchcock, without crime and without murderers: rather the story of an awareness, told brilliantly passing from expressionism to satire. The screenplay is written by Alma Reville, Hitchcock's wife along with Val Valentine.

title: Call of the Wild
country: Great Britain, Germany, Spain, France, Italy
actors: Charlton Heston, Michèle Mercier, Maria Rohm, Rik Battaglia
description: A hunter and his dog Buck (son of a dog and a wolf) wander in search of adventure and gold in the forests of the Klondike. When the master dies, Buck returns to his wild pack.
notes: Film quite faithful to the novel of the same name by Jack London, but without a shred of its tension and its truth. Silly.

title: Remember the Night
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, Fred MacMurray, Beulah Bondi, Elizabeth Patterson
description: A young thief awaiting trial is invited by the prosecutor to spend the Christmas holidays at her home. They fall in love with each other and she decides to confess her guilt.
notes: Pleasant sentimental comedy, always in danger of falling into the weepy.

title: Anaparastasi
actors: Thula Stathopulu, Yannis Totsikas, Michalis Photopulos, Petros Choidas
description: An emigrant returns from Germany to his village in the mountains of Epirus, where he will be killed by his wife in complicity with his lover. The press and the judiciary investigate: the mystery will be solved. Poverty and economic backwardness are the background to a story of love and death.
notes: Hard, rough and suspended, it strikes above all for the description of the mountain community, whose inhabitants live like beasts. First feature film by Angelopoulos.

title: The Kentucky Fried Movie
actors: Evan Kim, Bill Bixby, Donald Sutherland, George Lazenby
description: John Landis puts in a series of irresistible sketches, with the intent of parodying the American television schedule: TV series, news programs, debates, fiction all in the name of cheeky humor and without any regard.
notes: Vulgar and childish, intelligent and hilarious. The screenplay is written by future directors Jim Abrahams, David and Jerry Zucker who make brief appearances in the film.

title: Du Rififi chex les hommes
actors: Carl Moehner, Jean Servais, Robert Manuel, Magali Noël
description: A thief gets out of jail. Left by his woman, he organizes a coup deemed impossible to reassert his prestige in the environment of the mala.
notes: Rhythms and themes of American cinema applied to traditional French noir: a successful combination. Based on a novel by Auguste Le Breton.

title: Renaldo and Clara
actors: Bob Dylan, Sarah Dylan, Joan Baez, Ronnie Hawkins, Sam Shepard
description: Bob Dylan uses the material shot during the poetic-musical tour "The Rolling Thunder Reviewz of 1976 to make an audiovisual poem about his music, his life, his poetics.
notes: Shot in the style of 1960s underground cinema, frenetic hand-held camera, dirty images, schizoid editing Dylan stages rehearsals, the life of the band, the audience, travels from coast to coast, building a commemorative monument to his figure. River film difficult to enjoy.

title: Rio Grande
actors: Claude Jarman jr, John Wayne, Maureen O'Hara, Ben Johnson
description: Colonel Kirby Yorke, at war with the Indians, is joined at the camp by his wife who did not leave him many years earlier and also finds his son, a recruit who has just arrived at the camp, at his feet.
notes: Concluding chapter of the military cavalry trilogy that began with "The Massacre at Fort Apache" and "The Knights of the North West". Minor work by Ford, light and unambitious.

title: Le repos du guerrier
actors: Brigitte Bardot, Robert Hossein, Macha Meril, James Robertson Justice
description: A wealthy young lady, bored by her high-ranking environment, scandalizes the decent family by becoming the mistress of an alcoholic drifter with suicidal impulses. Will the woman be able to save him from his attempts to take his own life?
notes: A film that programmatically seeks scandal, but Vadim only manages to pack a ridiculous meatloaf, which not even the presence of Brigitte Bardot, his muse and ex-wife at the time, can save. Based on the novel of the same name by Christiane Rochefort (1958) which at the time did not give many jolts to the French right-thinking society. At the time, however, it was forbidden to minors under sixteen.

title: Postriziny
actors: Jirí Schmitzer, Magda Vasaryová, Jaromír Hanzlík, Rudolf Hrusinsky
description: Czechoslovakia, 1920s: the director of a beer factory turns by bicycle for the villages looking for customers, while the submissive wife Maryska waits for him at home. The arrival of the irreverent and unconventional brother -in -law dismantles the couple's daily life and insinuates the suspicion that there is a more fun way of living in Maryska.
notes: An ironic and thin hymn to joy, with moments of pure comedy. First chapter of an rheal trilogy inspired by the novels of Bohumil Hrabal, who together with the director signs the script.

title: Riten
actors: Ingrid Thulin, Anders Ek, Gunnar Björnstrand, Erik Hell
description: Three actors: a man, his wife and lover, end up in front of a judge, accused of obscenities for their show. The judge repeats the offending scene: shocked and excited, he rapes the actress and dies of a heart attack.
notes: Filmed for Swedish television, it is a drama on the value of art, of which it seeks to recover the original, sacred and Dionysian value, but also on the limits of morality. Extreme cinema, psychoanalytic, cold but also with didactic excesses. All shot in the claustrophobic space of a courtroom and entrusted to four great actors. The shadow of a confessor can be glimpsed: it is that of Ingmar Bergman himself.

title: Retour à la vie
directors: Georges Lampin, Henri-Georges Clouzot, Jean Dréville, André Cayatte
actors: François Périer, Patricia Roc, Tania Chandler, Louis Jouvet
