description: Four directors film four different stories of returning to civilian life after the war. _The return of Antonio_: the protagonist, who has returned from Germany, resumes working as a barman. _The return of Jean_: a man by chance finds in a pension a German officer, a former torturer in a concentration camp. _The return of René_: a veteran returns home, but his wife has left him. Find love again with a widow. _The return of Aunt Emma_: an elderly lady escaped from the lager discovers that her nephews were counting on her death to share the inheritance.
notes: The best is _The Return of Jean_ by Clouzot, but the average level is high.

title: The Hired Hand
actors: Peter Fonda, Warren Oates, Verna Bloom, Robert Pratt, Severn Darden
description: After seven years of traveling the West, Harry Collings returns to the family farm in California. His intention is to stay, but his wife Hannah sees him leave with his friend Arch to avenge young Dan, killed by McVey's gang ...
notes: Peter "Captain America" ??Fonda's first direction is an anomalous (and perhaps too ambitious) western that, at least in spirit, traces the themes and atmospheres of _Easy Rider_, from two years earlier: the search for freedom, the sense of travel, the love of adventure. The photography by Vilmos Zsigmond is splendid; the film was restored and redistributed in 2001, thirty years after its release.

title: Le retour de Martin Guerre
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Nathalie Baye, Roger Planchon, Bernard-Pierre Donnadieu
description: In a small village in the France of the sixteenth century, the farmer Martin disappears after getting married very young. After many years, an individual shows up at his wife's house claiming to be Martin and shortly thereafter another man arrives saying the same thing. The story ends in court, where the woman is convinced of the sincerity of one of the two.
notes: Disturbing drama about the mysteries of identity: tense and gripping, with a Depardieu in top form.

title: Yuki fujn ezu
actors: Michiyo Kogure, Koshiko Kuga, Ken Uehara, Eijiro Yanagi
description: Ms. Yuki, coming from a noble family, is the unhappy wife of a man who offends her by bringing her concubines into the house. Desperate, she finds a lover who, however, does not satisfy her sexually. Unable to find a way out of his existential condition ...
notes: Commented from the point of view of the protagonist's servant, a moving and cruel story about the contradictions of a Japan suspended between the old world and new tensions. The perfection of the staging anticipates the great masterpieces of the master of Japanese cinema. Based on a novel by Sejichi Funabashi.

title: El río y la muerte
actors: Columba Dominguez, Miguel Torruco, Joaquín Cordero, Jaime Fernandez
description: In the rural village of Santa Bibiana, the feud between the Anguiano and Menchaca families has raged for decades, and dates back to when Felipe Anguiano killed Filogonio Menchaca for reasons of jealousy. It will be Gerardo Anguiano who will put an end to the bloody rivalry by not responding to the offense made to him by the last descendant of the Menchaca.
notes: Buñuel works on one of the classic genres of the Mexican tradition - the rural drama with a civilizing background - but his imprint is relatively evident. In his work, a minor film. Commissioned work that dates back to Buñuel's early Mexican period.

title: Riot
actors: Jim Brown, Gene Hackman, Ben Carruthers, Mike Kellin
description: Some inmates locked up in the isolation cells of the Arizona state prison, led by Red Fraker, develop an escape plan in which the ex-black boxer Cully is also involved. Once the ward guards have been kidnapped and held hostage, the prisoners begin to dig a tunnel that will lead them beyond the boundary wall; to buy time, Red tries to make the uprising appear as a request to management for better living conditions for the inmates. But the situation worsened ...
notes: Dry, tense and violent; beautifully acted and directed with a steady hand by a "professional" like Kulik.

title: Le mur
actors: Tuncel Kurtiz, Ayce Emel Mesci, Malik Berrichi, Nicolas Hossein
description: Turkey: in Ankara prison some inmates rebel against the terrible conditions of prison life, with the aim of being transferred to a more humane prison. Their hopes will be disappointed: the life of the prisoners is not worth more than that of the beasts.
notes: The director is Kurdish and tells a partly autobiographical story, as he was actually incarcerated for some time in a Turkish prison. Raw and violent; pain and injustice are told in a dry style, without concessions. Brave film of denunciation, starring non-professional actors.

title: Riot in Cell Block 11
actors: Neville Brand, Emile Meyer, Frank Faylen, Leo Gordon
description: In a penitentiary, the rebellion of a group of inmates, led by Dunn pushes the director to accept some of the inmates' requests and to introduce reforms in security measures.
notes: Documentary style for a dark and claustrophobic action-movie that leaves no room for false hopes. Written by Richard Collins. Don Siegel's first major film, created with the intention of denouncing the inhuman conditions of life in American prisons.

title: La rivolta dei gladiatori
actors: Gianna Maria Canale, Ettore Manni, Mara Cruz, Georges Marchal
description: The tribune Marco Numidio is sent to Armenia to defeat the perfidious Amira who plots against Rome and organizes a revolt for the independence of his country.
notes: The mass scenes are well choreographed and the war clashes. Romance adaptation of a historical episode for the debut of Cottafavi to the mythological genre.

title: Apache Drums
actors: Stephen McNally, Coleen Gray, Willard Parker, James Griffith
description: In a village in the west, at the end of the nineteenth century, the professional player Sam Leeds is chased away by the sheriff because he is accused of moral disorder. When Sam returns to the village he tries to warn the population that the Apaches are preparing to launch an attack, but no one pays him any attention. The Indians will descend on the plain and the clash will be bloody.
notes: Flamboyant western that marks the high point in Fregonese's career.

title: Revenge of the Stepford Wives
actors: Sharon Gless, Julie Kavner, Audra Lindley
description: A journalist investigates the American town of Stepford, famous for being the American town with the lowest crime and divorce rate. Suspicious of the strange behavior of the Stepford women, she discovers a disturbing secret.
notes: Tv movie, sequel to Bryan Forbes' "The Wives Factory". Feminist variation of "Invasion of the Body Snatchers". From a novel by Ira Levin.

title: Zorro marchese di Navarra
actors: Nino Vingelli, Daniele Vargas, Maria Luisa Longo, Loris Gizzi
description: In the Spanish regions oppressed by the French yoke, movements of revolt spread with little success. Only the garrison under the orders of Colonel Brizard, which presides over the city of Pamplona, ??is put in ambush by the rebel bands led by a mysterious masked individual. He manages to free some condemned to be shot under the eyes of the same senior officer. Naturally, Zorro hides under the role of the avenger and arouses the sympathy of Carmen, the niece of the city alcalde.
notes: Of the many Zorresque versions, this is certainly one of the worst.

title: Testimone oculare
actors: Barbara Cupisti, Stefano Davanzati, Alessio Orano, Giuseppe Panviti
description: Elisa and Karl have broken into a department store, have been waiting for closing time and are about to steal a shirt. While hidden in the dark, Elisa witnesses the murder of a woman; Commissioner Marra could start from her testimony to conduct the investigations, but there is a problem: Elisa is blind ...

title: Da jeg traff Jesus... med sprettert
actors: Fredrik Stenberg, Gard B. Eidsvold, Gjertrud L. Jynge, Martin Eidissen
description: Late 1930s. Little Oddemann grows up in a small town in Norway where some colorful characters live. Their attitudes affect the little boy who grows up in the belief that becoming an adult isn't all that beautiful.
notes: Based on the memoirs of the Norwegian poet and composer Odd Børretzen.

title: The Lady in Question
actors: Brian Aherne, Rita Hayworth, Glenn Ford, Irene Rich, George Coulouris, William Castle
description: A father of a family is selected as a juror in a trial where the case of a woman accused of murder is discussed. The man is convinced of the innocence of the accused and votes for absolution. When the woman begins to frequent his home and unleash disturbing mechanisms within the family, he begins to see her with different eyes.
notes: Good judicial drama, remake of _The case of the juror Morestan0 by Marc Allégret. Rita Hayworth, not yet famous at the time, reveals her dark side.

title: De två saliga
actors: Harriet Andersson, Per Myrberg, Christina Schollin, Lasse Poysti
description: A man and a woman meet in church, and discover they have the same existential experiences marked by the arduous search for God. They end up getting married, but soon their marriage degenerates into a hell of doubt and suspicion: her obsessive jealousy is aggravated. hallucinatory psychic disturbances push her husband to increasingly extreme gestures.
notes: Compendium of the director's themes and past experiences. The summa of Bergmanian poetics, reached radical conclusions. Bergman's second film directed for television, based on a novel by Ulla Isaksson, shot for television and co-produced by Raidue.

title: The Sign of Four
actors: Ian Richardson, David Healy, Cherie Lunghi, Thorley Walters
description: The famous detective Sherlock Holmes is this time on the trail of the director of a prison who killed a prisoner to take possession of his stolen goods.
notes: Based on the novel of the same name by Conan Doyle, the film is part of a television series shot for British TV. First prize at the Mysfest of Cattolica 1983.

title: The Sign of the Cross
actors: Fredric March, Elissa Landi, Charles Laughton, Claudette Colbert
description: In the decadent imperial Rome, the prefect Marco Superbo falls in love with the beautiful Marcia, persecuted by the cruel Nero because of the Christian faith. And when the girl is sentenced to martyrdom ...
notes: De Mille shoots a seductive, grandiloquent and monumental blockbuster, which at the time caused a sensation. Unforgettable is the Poppea by Claudette Colbert.

title: The Mark of Zorro
actors: Douglas Fairbanks, Marguerite De La Motte, Noah Beery, Robert McKim
description: Behind the respectable face of Don Diego de la Vega hides a masked avenger, who takes action to defend the reasons of the weak: the powerful governor Alvarado tyrannizes California, harassing the poor people. Zorro, a skilled swordsman, defeats his henchmen, wins the applause of the people and wins the beauty of the country.
notes: First version, rather modest, of the novel by Johnston McCulley, scripted by Fairbanks himself under a pseudonym.

title: Le secret
actors: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Marlène Jobert, Philippe Noiret, Jean-François Adam
description: A madman escaped from the criminal asylum attempts to escape the mountains and finds refuge in a hut where he stays a married couple. The intertwining runs on the edge of ambiguity: what is the true history of man?
notes: The wooded landscape manages well to embody the shadows and lights of the protagonists. Perhaps, too much anxiety to explain everything. From a novel by Francis Rick.

title: La mort dans ce jardin
actors: Simone Signoret, Georges Marchal, Charles Vanel, Michel Piccoli
description: A Brazilian citizen wages a fight against the mining company that wants to nationalize the fields. A priest, a prostitute, an adventurer and a miner take refuge in the jungle to escape the police. Violence between the members of the group explodes uncontrolled: they will kill each other.
notes: Buñuel's ruthless gaze rests without moralizing on the misery of the human condition: no one will be saved. Based on a modest adventure novel; but the screenplay is by Raymond Queneau and Luis Alcoriza.

title: Wildwechsel
actors: Eva Mattes, Harry Baer, Jörg von Liebenfels, Ruth Drexel, Kurt Raab, El Hedi Ben Salem, Irm Hermann, Hanna Schygulla, Rudolf Waldemar Brem
description: The minor Hanni has an affair with the 22-year-old worker Franz. When the girl's father finds out about her pregnancy, he denounces the boy for bribing a minor. The two young men devise a plan to kill their father and will end up in prison for murder.
notes: The sadistic instincts of the German petty bourgeoisie and the masochism that pollutes every love relationship: ninth film in four years, based on a play by Franz Xaver Kroetz (who wanted to eliminate some sequences), the most lucid work of the period .

title: Senilità
actors: Anthony Franciosa, Claudia Cardinale, Philippe Leroy, Betsy Blair
description: In gray Trieste, Emilio, a writer in creative crisis, seeks a hope for change in his love for the beautiful Angiolina, while his mature sister tries to get married by a penniless and worldly artist.
notes: A dignified transposition of Svevo's novel, with some too much simplism. But sometimes a heartfelt melancholy emerges, especially in the relationship between the characters marked by loneliness and a city closed in its oppressive atmospheres.

title: Portnoy's Complaint
actors: Richard Benjamin, Karen Black, Lee Grant, Jack Somack, Jill Clayburgh
description: Oppressed by a very rigid and sexophobic upbringing, Alexander - an American of Jewish descent - is unable to solve his problems with sex and overcome the complexes towards women.
notes: Unfortunate transposition of the novel "Portnoy's Lament" by Philip Roth: the irreverent irony of the book has been completely lost here.

title: The Trail of the Lonesome Pine
actors: Henry Fonda, Sylvia Sidney, Fred MacMurray, Fred Stone, Fuzzy Knight
description: Engineer Jack Hale is sent by a railway company to the mountains of Kentucky, with the task of buying land and finds himself in the middle of a bloody struggle between two families of mountaineers who are disputing for possession of some land.
notes: Based on a novel by John William Fox, it is the first Technicolor film shot on location. Landscapes of unlikely colors, heroic deeds, ferocious hatred and actors in a state of grace: a proper melodrama.

title: Ben ividetelei
actors: Irina Kuptchenko, Michie Ulianov
description: A man and a woman, divorced for several years, begin to see each other again. But love is now ashes and their attempt to re-establish a broken relationship fails.
notes: Bergmanian film for the Russian Mikhalkov, who locks his protagonists in a room and delves into the melancholy and introspective crisis of the couple.

title: Sans toit ni loi
actors: Sandrine Bonnaire, Macha Meril, Stéphane Freiss
description: The corpse of a girl is found abandoned in the countryside: it is that of Monà, a young wanderer in search of an existence free from any social imposition. The film reconstructs the last days of his life: the many temporary jobs, the hitchhiking, the meeting with a Tunisian boy, the friendship with an elderly lady.
notes: Documentary style, but the gaze of the film fails to enter the skin of the protagonist, remaining on the surface of good feelings. Golden Lion in Venice.

title: Das indische Grabmal
actors: Debra Paget, Paul Hubschmidt, Walter Reyer, Claus Holm, Sabine Bethmann
description: To be able to marry the German engineer Harald Berger, the beautiful dancer Seetha must escape from the evil Prince Chandra, who wants to prevent the wedding because he is madly in love with her ...
notes: Based on a story written by Lang himself and his wife Thea von Harbou in 1921, the film is the sequel to _The Tiger of Eschnapur_, in which the first part of Seetha's adventures were told. The talent and compositional taste of the Viennese genius (now almost seventy years old) unfold above all in the beautiful ending, capable of illuminating with new light what is apparently a very normal exotic-adventurous intertwining.

title: Gumshoe
actors: Albert Finney, Billie Whitelaw, Frank Finlay, Janice Rule
description: Eddie Ginley, stand-up comedian and bingo announcer, decides to try the path of his literary myth: private detective Philip Marlowe. His brother and his ex try to get him to give up, but he places an announcement and soon finds himself hired by a mysterious fat guy. He falls into a terribly complex intrigue between Liverpool and London, involving drug and arms traffickers and even African politicians.
notes: Homage and at the same time a parody of noir, Frears' first and interesting feature film for the big screen, produced by Albert Finney's company, was a box office fiasco.

title: Tribute
actors: Jack Lemmon, Lee Remick, Robby Benson, Colleen Dewhurst
description: Scottie Templeton works as a press agent on Broadway. The divorce from Maggie knocked him down, but that doesn't stop him from living carefree, joking about everything and everyone without taking anything seriously. At least until the moment he discovers he is seriously ill. At that point the only desire he has left is to reconnect with Jud, the son he had by Maggie: a serious boy, doctoral and absolutely far from him and his lifestyle ...
notes: Tears are always lurking, and it is the film that is sick with blackmailing sentimentality. But Lemmon's proof (who got a nomination for this role which is almost written for him and which he had already successfully brought to the stage) at times really manages to go further and touch the heart.

title: At War with the Army
actors: Dean Martin, Jerry Lewis, Polly Bergen, Angela Greene, Mike Kellin
description: Two friends of opposite character are called to do military service. Sergeant Vic Puccinelli is looking for action and adventure, the other soldier Alvin Korwin, shy and ungainly, hopes only for licenses. The graduate uses the simple soldier to avoid work and have a good time.
notes: Farce of military life, based on a comedy for the theater by James B. Allardice (his are the series _I monsri_ and _Strega per amore_), which focuses entirely on the "body" of the two protagonists. Jerry Lewis and Dean Martin work together for the first time and already show their potential. Famous the gag of the soda bottle.

title: West of Zanzibar
actors: Lon Chaney, Lionel Barrymore, Mary Nolan, Warner Baxter
description: The evil Crane blows his wife to the magician Phroso, after reducing him to a crippled being condemned to a wheelchair. Phroso, on the trail of the fugitives, becomes king of a Congo tribe, who believe him a sorcerer by virtue of his magician's tricks. When he discovers the girl he believes to be his rival's daughter in a brothel in Zanzibar, he reduces her to an alcoholic in order to take revenge, but later discovers she is his daughter.
notes: Faced with an unlikely screenplay taken from Chester de Vonde's novel "Kongo", Browning crosses exotic adventure with melodrama, cooking everything in the mad fire of grand guignol. Thanks to the amazing malleability of Chaney's mask, a film close to delirium.

title: The Dresser
actors: Albert Finney, Tom Courtenay, Eileen Atkins, Edward Fox, Zena Walker, Michael Gough, Cathryn Harrison, Betty Marsden, Sheila Reid, Lockwood West, Donald Eccles, Llewellyn Rees, Guy Manning, Anne Blackman, Kevin Stoney
description: England, 1940s. A company is rehearsing the two hundred and twenty-seventh replica of "King Lear": Sir, an actor on the avenue of the sunset, now almost completely depends on the faithful homosexual "dresser" Norman, who has always been used to living his life in the shadow of the successes of the grumpy star. .
notes: Based on a play by Ronald Harwood and modeled on the biography of actor Donald Wolfit, yet another digression on the reciprocal and symbiotic relationship between art and life. Packaging canonically and impeccably "British" and a great proof of the duo Finney-Courtenay, symbol actors (here well directed by Yates) of the Free Cinema of the 60s.

title: Honno
actors: Hideo Kanze, Nobuko Otowa, Eijiro Tohno, Yoshinobu Ogawa
description: An actor is convinced that he has become impotent due to the atomic radiation of Hiroshima. When a waitress falls in love with him, they will try to solve the problem together.
notes: Shindo, a pupil of Mizoguchi, returns to explore sexuality and its neuroses, in a funeral and slow film, directed with staid precision.

title: Les bidasses en folie
actors: Les Charlots, Jacques Dufilho, Marion Game, Jacques Seiler
description: The five jokey and long-haired friends take part in a music contest and, thanks to the help of their friend Crème, they win it. Just on the eve of the national finals, however, the fateful postcard-precept arrives: they will reluctantly wear the uniform, but will not give up the great opportunity ...
notes: The French "out of sorts" are back.

title: Les Miserables
actors: Anthony Perkins, John Gielgud, Ian Holm, Richard Jordan, Caroline Langrishe, Christopher Guard
description: Paris, 1815. Jean Valjean is released from prison. Inspector Javert pursues him, while he wants to rebuild his life. First he will have to face the whirlwind personal entanglements in the lives of other wretches, and the revolutionary uprisings of 1832.
notes: English version embellished by Anthony Perkins, John Gielgud, Ian Holm.

title: Fire on the Amazon
actors: Sandra Bullock, Craig Sheffer, Juan Fernandez, Eduardo Cesti
description: In Bolivia, landowners are destroying the rainforest. And Santos, a supporter of the alliance with the natives to protest, is murdered. An American photojournalist investigates with Alyssa, a collaborator of Santos, also involving the Indios.
notes: Sandra Bullock in environmental version pre "Speed".

title: Törst
actors: Eva Henning, Birger Malmstein, Birgit Tengroth, Mimi Nelson
description: Bertil and Rut are a couple in crisis who, during a long train journey from Germany to Sweden, find reasons to be together. All shot in the narrow spaces of a train, a drama focused on the inner torments of the protagonists, conditioned by their past experiences and unable to forgive themselves and others.
notes: Based on some short stories by Birgit Tengroth and scripted by Herbert Grevenius, a film where Bergman's direction acquires a more mature awareness. Entire sequences were removed by censorship.

title: Seven Men From Now
actors: Randolph Scott, Gail Russell, Lee Marvin, Walter Reed, John Larch
description: Sheriff Stride seeks revenge: seven knights have robbed his country and killed his wife. He sets out on the trail of the fugitives until in the desert, after escaping an Indian attack, he comes face to face with the leader of the criminals.
notes: A great western, perhaps one of Boetticher's best: masterful use of bodies and spaces, the tragic core of western mythology. Screenplay by Burt Kennedy.

title: I sette dell'Orsa maggiore
actors: Pierre Cressoy, Eleonora Rossi Drago, Tino Carraro, Paolo Panelli
description: On 19 December 1941, a group of navy soldiers, under the leadership of officer Silvani, with their submarines managed to break through the defenses of the port of Alexandria and held up against the British battleships Valiant and Queen Elizabeth, winning the battle.
notes: War film adhering to the historical fact, without too much rhetoric and without pretensions. Screenplay by Ennio De Concini, Marc'Antonio Bragadin, Giuseppe Berto and Francesco De Robertis.

title: The Constant Husband
actors: Rex Harrison, Kay Kendall, Margaret Leighton, Cecil Parker
description: A man tried for scam slowly recover his memory lost in an accident: he discovers that he had seven wives, married more for money than for love. The defense is entrusted to a woman, who manages to make it almost fulfill.
notes: Based on the very fast and brilliant bickering of the two protagonists, a classic English comedy that stages the man-woman conflict with an enviable verve and acumen.

title: Les septe pechés capitaux
actors: Paolo Stoppa, Isa Miranda, Michèle Morgan, Françoise Rosay, Louis De Funès, Gérard Philipe
description: Film divided into six episodes on the theme of biblical sins. In Eduardo De Filippo's _Avarizia e ira_, a miser sees his money thrown out of the window by his wife. In _Pride_ by Claude Autant-Lara, fallen nobles participate in a party where they will be pointed out as poor people. In _Gola_ by Carlo Rim, a peasant girl is rejected by a man who prefers the pleasures of the table. In _Lussuria_ by Yves Allégret a young woman is envious of the beauty of her teenage daughter. In _Invidia_ by Roberto Rossellini, the wife of a painter is jealous of the attention that the man reserves for the cat. In _Laziness_ by Jean Dréville, the director of Paradise imposes laziness on human beings and the results are disastrous.
notes: None of the episodes go beyond a weak sketch.

title: Shichi-nin no Samurai
actors: Takashi Shimura, Toshiro Mifune, Yoshio Inaba, Seiji Miyaguchi
description: In the Japan of the sixteenth century, some peasants, to defend themselves from the brigands who raid the country torn by civil wars, invest their humble savings and send one of them to the city to hire some samurai to defend their lands. Soldiers and peasants will have to overcome the differences of class and find a common ideal. Four samurai and many peasants will die in battle.
notes: The themes dear to Kurosawa find an epic yet calm expression: the clash between two cultures, the collective dream of solidarity, the morality of combat and the humanitarian hope for a better world. Remade in Hollywood in western and sci-fi style.

title: Seventh Heaven
actors: Charles Farrell, Janet Gaynor, Ben Bard, David Butler, Marie Mosquini
description: In Paris lives the street sweeper Chico, atheist, unbeliever and proud. One day he welcomes into his home Diane, a girl who has been thrown out of the house by her sister. He falls in love with him, but confesses it to him only shortly before leaving for the front. Believed by all to be dead, he will return home blind and converted to faith in God.
notes: Borzage has the great strength not to be afraid of the pathetic and presses the pedal of melodrama mixing drama and comic curtains, until the final acknowledgment. At the Oscars (in their first edition) the director, the leading actress (Janet Gaynor) and the screenwriter Benjamin Glazer were awarded.

title: The Boogeyman
actors: Suzanna Love, Ron James, John Carradine, Nicholas Love, Raymond Boyden
description: Sixties: brother and sister plan the murder of their mother's lover, but their secret is caught in a mirror. Twenty years later, the two are haunted by the ghosts of the past: he has remained mute, she suffers from terrifying nightmares . But evil frees itself from the mirror, and goes in search of revenge.

title: Street of No Return
actors: Keith Carradine, Valentina Vargas, Bill Duke, Andréa Ferréol
description: Michael was once a famous and very rich rock singer. Then he made a fatal mistake - falling in love, reciprocated, with Celia, the woman of a powerful boss - and paid a very high price: now he finds himself with his vocal cords cut and wandering aimlessly through the streets, alone and desperate. The opportunity for rematch will come, sudden and unexpected.
notes: The 78-year-old Fuller takes a novel by David Goodis and draws an excessive, dark and cursed melody from it, setting it in the streets of a Lisbon never so nocturnal and also carving out the minor role of the commissioner. When the age is directly proportional to the desire to reinvent cinema.

title: Marlene Dietrich: Her Own Song
actors: Marlene Dietrich, Maria Riva, Nicholas von Sternberg, Volker Schlöndorff
description: Full-fledged portrait of the German diva from her debut in cinema to her death and the funeral in Berlin. The grandson David Riva, son of Maria, through unpublished documents inherited from his grandmother traces the artistic and human story of Marlene. The result is a portrait of a woman in love, sensitive, a good actress and even a good mother. For the first time there is talk of his determination to fight against Nazism. The diva is followed step by step in the Berlin of the twenties and thirties. Particularly touching the video that shows us Maria Magdalena, this was her real name, singing in German, for the first time since the end of the war, on a stage in Tel Aviv.

title: On the Line
actors: James Lance Bass, Joey Fatone, Emmanuelle Chriqui, Gregory Qaiyum
description: Kevin, a young employee, on the train carriage he takes to go to work every morning, one day meets a girl by chance: Abbey. For too much emotion, however, he does not ask her what her name is or her telephone number. The boy, desperate, thinks, with the help of his friends, to put posters all over Chigaco, thus attracting her attention.
notes: The actors have faces so anonymous that it would not be possible to provide the identikit. The film is crammed with not so hidden advertisements from multinationals, from McDonald's to Reebok (which indeed plays the role of the traditional deus ex machina several times, good-naturedly meddling in the affairs of humans).

title: Seventh Heaven
actors: James Stewart, Simone Simon, Jean Hersholt, Gregory Ratoff
description: A garbage man falls in love with an orphan, but their lives are separated by the Great War. He left as a soldier and returned wounded and profoundly changed.
notes: First time as a protagonist for James Stewart. Deliberately tearful and inferior to the original. Remake of the homonymous film by Borzage from ten years earlier.

title: Le septième juré
actors: Bernard Blier, Francis Blanche, Jacques Riberolles, Jacques Monod
description: A man responsible for the murder of a prostitute finds himself on the jury of a trial that discusses a similar case to his own. Shocked by pangs of conscience, he will lose control of the situation.
notes: Film that nurtures moral apologue ambitions: after a promising start, it gets lost in a second part that borders on the absurd.

title: Rou pu tuan zhi tou qing bao jian
actors: Lawrence Ng, Amy Yip, Isabella Chow, Kent Cheng, Lo Lieh
description: A young man dedicated to the pleasures of sex is transplanted the member of a horse to experience more and more extreme erotic games with a host of available concubines.
notes: The bodies connected in imaginative sexual practices fly and dart as in the most traditional of the hoods and swords baked by Hong Kong: a very funny sex, without any taste of sin. Chinese "common sense of modesty" save, shadows and veils and veils.

title: Yojimbo
actors: Toshiro Mifune, Eijiri Tono, Kamatari Fujiwara, Tatsuya Nakadai
description: The masterless samurai Sanjuro arrives in a country devastated by the struggles between two local landowners: he decides to exploit the situation to his advantage and - through a clever game of balancing act, now supporting one now the other lord - manages to restore peace in those bloody lands.
notes: Violent, ironic, formally splendid. The action sequences will later be plundered by Western cinema, which owes Kurosawa more than he is willing to admit. Scripted by the director together with Ryuzo Kikushima, the plot subsequently inspired several Western directors, all of them Sergio Leone (_For a fistful of dollars_).

title: Original Gangstas
actors: Fred Williamson, Jim Brown, Pam Grier, Paul Winfield, Isabel Sanford
description: Former football champion John Bookman returns to his hometown of Gary in Indiana and discovers that the gang he once belonged to is now made up of a younger generation devoted to violence and drug dealing. With the help of his old companions he will wage a fight against the criminals who have attempted the life of his father.
notes: Reflection on identity, even cinematographic, entirely internal to African American culture, which comes to terms with its past and tries to retrace the glories of blaxploitation. Great Pam Grier, the unforgettable queen of black genre cinema.

title: Ivy
actors: Joan Fontaine, Patric Knowles, Herbert Marshall, Richard Ney
description: A woman brought for the crime poisons her husband and tries to put the blame on her lover, to have free rein and marry a billionaire. Of course, his plan will be exposed and his ferocity will be punished.
notes: Good thriller that runs on the edge of tension and one of the few villain roles for Joan Fontaine.

title: Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band
actors: Peter Frampton, Bee Gees, George Burns, Steve Martin, Donald Pleasence
description: A staunch pacifist organizes a rock band to take his message of peace across America. But in the end he puts down his guitar to fight with the bad guys.
notes: The film doesn't keep its promises: it was supposed to be a crazy, wild and irreverent rock comedy. She only manages to be vaguely "pretty". For the first time Steve Martin on screen. The soundtrack is from the Beatles album of the same name.

title: The Gorgon
actors: Peter Cushing, Christopher Lee, Barbara Shelley, Richard Pasco
description: A terrifying mystery lurks in a German forest. Some people are found transformed into statues. While the investigations begin, there are also those who try to hinder them. Meanwhile, ancient legends emerge.
notes: Improvised, ramshackle, with a script bordering on ridicule. Hammer product among the most artisanal and clumsy. Pure trash.

title: Looks and Smiles
actors: Graham Greene, Carolyn Nicholson, Tony Pitts, Roy Haywood
description: Two workers in 1960s Sheffield lead a life of hardship. Having lost hope of seeing their economic condition improved, they enlist in the English army stationed in Northern Ireland.
notes: Loach delves into the consciousness of the English proletariat, to expose its contradictions, fragility and pain. Excellent actors, all non-professionals.

title: Embassy
actors: Marie Jose Nat, Richard Roundtree, Chuck Connors, Ray Milland
description: A KGB agent always on the hunt for spies and enemies of US freedom is on the trail of a Soviet diplomat taking refuge in the American embassy in Beirut. The fight will be tougher than expected and the victory will come too late.
notes: An adventure without suspense for a detective who plays (unnecessarily) to Hitchcock.

title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
actors: Basil Rathbone, Nigel Bruce, Richard Greene, Wendy Barrie
description: Sherlock Holmes, along with his faithful assistant Watson, is called by the nobleman Sir Baskerville to investigate the ghost of a mastiff that rages in his castle terrorizing the owners.
notes: Wonderful the couple Rathbone-Bruce, in a film faithful to the letter of the novel. First film in a series of about twenty titles and the debut of Basil Rathbone as the famous investigator invented by the writer Conan Doyle

title: Shock
actors: Daria Nicolodi, David Collin jr., John Steiner, Ivan Rassimov
description: A child, after the mysterious death of his father, begins to suffer from increasingly violent hallucinatory fits. The mother suspects that the child is possessed by her husband's spirit.
notes: A classic horror for Bava, who manages well to outline a sick mother-child relationship within the stereotypes of the genre. It scares us.

title: Shock Treatment
actors: Jessica Harper, Cliff De Young, Richard O'Brien, Patricia Quinn
description: A newlywed couple ends up in the clutches of a delusional TV presenter, who locks them up on her TV show, gets rid of her husband, and entices her with promises of a future in the show.
notes: Second and last film by Sharman who returns to the places of "The Rocky Horror Picture Show", trying to parody it. Less successful than the previous, very famous film, but interesting the irreverent operation of the cult movie by its creator himself.

title: Ti kniver i hjertet
actors: Martin Dahl Garfalk, Jan Devo Kornstad, Trond Halbo, Kjersti Holmen
description: Oslo, early 1960s. A little boy, Otto, loves football, but most of the time his peers keep him out of the game. Otto's dangerous rite of passage into adulthood is determined by meeting Frank, an older boy.
notes: A good fresco of the Scandinavian society of the sixties.

title: Steel
actors: Shaquille O'Neal, Annabeth Gish, Richard Roundtree, Judd Nelson
description: John Henry Irons designs weapons. He works on a hypothesis that knocks out enemies harmlessly, but is sabotaged. Irons, disgusted, quits his job and decides to use his knowledge to stop the criminals from using the weapons of his creation.
notes: New proof of actor (?) For "Shaq", ace of the NBA.

title: The Rookie
actors: Dennis Quaid, Rachel Griffiths, Jay Hernandez, Brian Cox, Beth Grant
description: Jimmy Morris, a former baseball player who retired in an accident, splits his time between chemistry classrooms and the fields where his boys train. The teacher makes a bet with his team: if his players manage to win the regional championship, he will commit to returning to play in a professional team. To his surprise, his students win and force him to keep his promise.
notes: The direction is rhetorical but shows an engaging pathos for the losers, the suburbs and the wastelands; John Lee Hancock had written _A Perfect World_ for Clint Eastwood.

title: Shaft
actors: Samuel L. Jackson, Christian Bale, Jeffrey Wright, Vanessa Williams, Busta Rhymes, Dan Hedaya, Toni Collette, Richard Roundtree, Pat Hingle, Gloria Reuben
description: Shaft, a black inspector with unorthodox methods, is called in to investigate an assault suffered by black student Trey Howard. Bartender Diane, an eyewitness, reveals the culprit's name to Shaft: Walter Wade jr. The latter invokes self-defense; Shaft still arrests him, but his lawyer gets immediate release ...
notes: Beyond the eternal music of Isaac Hayes, the references to one of the icons of the "blaxploitation" (embodied by Richard Roundtree in three films between '71 and '73) are specious, given that Jackson's character could have been called in any way without history changing one iota.

title: The Last Castle
actors: Clifton Collins jr., Delroy Lindo, Mark Ruffalo, James Gandolfini, Robert Redford
description: General Eugene Irwin, unjustly accused of the death of eight soldiers, is locked up in a maximum security military prison called "The Castle", inside which Colonel Winter maintains strict discipline. Deprived of any privileges and treated like a common prisoner, Irwin - supported by fellow inmates who do not share Winter's methods - tries to organize a riot ...
notes: Lurie is a former film critic who served in the army for four years. The staging exudes rhetoric and disciplinary maneuvers, but the Redford-Gandolfini duel is worth the film.

title: Ikíngut
actors: Hjalti Rúnar Jónson, Hans Tittus Nakinge, Pálmi Gestsson
description: Ikíngut, an Eskimo boy, arrives in a remote Icelandic settlement. The locals consider him an evil spirit, they would like to imprison and kill him. To defend him there is only Boas, a boy who saved from an avalanche. From Iceland, a film for children on the theme of welcoming the different.

title: Every Girl Should Be Married
actors: Cary Grant, Betsy Drake, Franchot Tone, Diana Lynn, Alan Mowbray
description: Anabel works in a department store and has no boyfriend. With the help of her best friend and her employer, she pursues by all means the goal that is primary for her: to conquer Madison Brown, a bachelor pediatrician who proves difficult to frame. To complete the mission, he investigates the tastes of the young doctor. Light comedy starring Cary Grant and Betsy Drake, making her big screen debut, who got married after filming ended

title: Presque rien
actors: Dominique Reymond, Marie Matheron, Stéphane Rideau, Jérémy Elkaïm, Laetitia Legrix
description: Eighteen-year-old Mathieu is spending the summer holidays with his mother and sister in a seaside resort. Joining them is Annick who looks after the shocked woman after the death of her youngest son. On the water's edge, Mathieu makes friends with Cédric, a boy who is his age. Between the two begins a friendship that becomes more and more intense day by day.
notes: The film is a melodrama that manages to enter the burning and very risky folds of the evil of living, without a single failure; who manipulates gay stereotypes as few know how to do today; that does not escape in the face of sex, excruciating and often inexplicable pain.

title: Les fous du stade
actors: Les Charlots, Paul Préboist, Martine Kelly, Gérard Croce
description: A group of friends goes on vacation to a location that is about to host the passage of the Olympic torch. Here they meet the daughter of the shopkeeper Lafougasse, Delizia, who runs away with the torchbearer. They chase her by bike, eventually becoming cycling champions.
notes: "Sports" episode of the comedy group Les Charlots.

title: Salut l'artiste
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Françoise Fabian, Jean Rochefort, Carla Gravina
description: The actor Nicola, separated from his wife Elisabeth to whom the judge has entrusted his children Ludovico and Louis, lives in Paris. To raise some money he makes do by accepting a few days' work together with his friend Clément, also an actor. Nicola, who is satisfied with dubbing or acting in cabaret, seems to have found a compromise between Peggy, her new partner and the family that, despite everything, continues to see. But the balance slowly crumbles. All that remains for Nicola is to return to Elizabeth who, due to an occasional relationship, became pregnant.
notes: Comedy that skilfully mixes funny and bitter moments.

title: Scooby-Doo on Zombie Island
directors: Hiroshi Aoyama, Kazumi Fukushima, Jim Stenstrum
description: Fred, Daphne, Velma, the bungler Shaggy and the voracious dog Scooby-Doo find themselves in Louisiana looking for new cases to solve; on the advice of Lena, a girl met by chance, they go to the island of Crescent which, by all accounts, is infested with zombies. The band is hosted in the splendid but equally sinister home of Simone, a woman who loves to surround herself with cats. The investigations turn out to be more complex than expected: threatening writings appear on the walls of Simone's house and strange presences terrify Scooby and Shaggy ...
notes: The animated series continues with an episode made for the video market.

title: Mesto na zemle
actors: Anna Chernova, Vitali Khayev, Nonna Grishayeva, Inna Verbitskaya
description: A half-ruined house in the center of Moscow is the seat of the "Temple of Love", a community in which the most unfortunate and marginalized humanity of the metropolis finds refuge.
notes: Aristakisjan himself experienced life in the commune he talks about firsthand. Soundtrack by the great English musician Robert Wyatt.

title: Silent Predators
actors: Harry Hamlin, Jack Scalia, Shannon Sturges, David Spielberg
description: The new fire chief of San Catalano, a Californian desert town near San Diego, is Vic Rondelli, who meets builder Max Farrington and his business partner Mandy during the inauguration ceremony. Some time later, Vic learns that the place is literally infested with very poisonous snakes awakened by the explosions caused by the construction sites of Max, who is busy building a new residential center. Despite Mandy's insistence, Max shows that he has no intention of suspending the project ...
notes: Cheap, predictable and discounted scares.

title: Jill Rips
actors: Dolph Lundgren, Danielle Brett, Richard Fitzpatrick, Kristi Angus
description: Matt Sorenson (Dolph Lundgren) infiltrates the world of hardcore undercover to find out who is responsible for his brother's death and thus be able to take revenge ...

title: E.A.M. - Estranei alla massa
description: Seven Neapolitan boys from different social backgrounds, Ale, Max, Giotto, Flavio, Pino, Marco and Gianni, have one thing in common: belonging to one of the oldest groups of Neapolitan supporters, the Fedayn EAM Napoli 1979. Vincenzo's documentary. Marra follows a typical day of theirs, highlighting their dreams, their passions, their hopes and their difficulties. The director's electronic eye follows them during a trip to Treviso and gives us the portrait of seven boys who share a love for their favorite team and the difficulties of living in a city like Naples.
notes: Marra's surprise is the proximity to people who observe a respect that is also respect for the beholder. But without renouncing a tight construction, and with a true director's gaze (the boy's comments on the wedding, while the photo shoot turns behind him; the gesture of the fan who makes room for his friend on the tarp).

title: Kung Pow! Enter the Fist
actors: Steve Oedekerk, Philip Tan, Tse Ling Ling, Tad Horino, Lung Fai
description: The Chosen One who as a child was already able to amaze everyone with his kung fu moves, is determined to avenge the death of his parents. Responsible for the murder is Master Pain, namely Betty. The fight to defeat the fearsome enemy will be tough and will see the Chosen One engaged in absurd battles. Master Tang and Whoa, queen of kung fu, will help him.
notes: Oedekerk, mixing old films and new footage, aspired to make an old and poor film and has risen, in the worst sense, to give substance to both expectations. Character with a varied curriculum is also stolen the show by a spotted cow.

title: The Martins
actors: Lee Evans, Kathy Burke, Linda Bassett, Eric Byrne, Terri Dumont
description: Hatfield, North London: Robert Martin, an unemployed dreamer, spends his life trying to win a prize contest that allows him to give his wife Angie and children Katie and Little Boy everything they deserve. Instead Angie would like Robert to stop fantasizing and face reality. Realizing that he has not won the coveted vacation, Robert decides to "steal" one ...
notes: The story is pleasant, but the director does not know how to choose the right chords for the story: comedy, tragicomedy, satire of a malpractice, cheerful version of a certain realism typical of British cinema, an average late evening product?

title: Get Over It
actors: Melissa Sagemiller, Ben Foster, Kirsten Dunst, Mila Kunis, Carmen Electra
description: Allison, the prettiest girl in school, has agreed to date Berke. But the dream turns out to be short-lived. Allison in fact starts with Striker, the most coveted boy by all the girls in school. At this point Berke does not give up and tries in every way to recover ground: he abandons the basketball team and decides to participate in the school representation of "A Midsummer Night's Dream" where Allison plays the leading role.
notes: This stunned youthful film sells two stories for the price of one. He listens to the Shakespearean forays of other more or less recent teen-movies and pursues laughter with vulgarity listed under the heading "organic drives and functions".

title: Marilyn Monroe: The Final Days
actors: Marilyn Monroe, Susan Strasberg, Cyd Charisse, Evelyn Moriarty
description: The film tells the last months of the diva's life not forgetting her addiction to drugs and alcohol and the deep depression that led to her suicide four months after being fired from the set of "Something's Got to Give". Patty Ivins has put together many interviews of people who have worked with her.

title: Prince Valiant
actors: Stephen Moyer, Katherine Heigl, Ron Perlman, Joanna Lumley
description: In the course of the annual tournament, Prince Valiant takes the place of his wounded lord and defeats Prince Arn. In the excitement of the tournament, among other things, the sword of King Arthur is stolen who, accusing the Scots, calls the war council.
notes: Taken from the famous Hal Foster strips.

title: Shadow Hours
actors: Balthazar Getty, Peter Weller, Rebecca Gayheart, Peter Greene
description: Michael Holloway, fresh out of alcoholism and drug addiction, is ready to start a new life with his wife Chloe, expecting a baby. During the night shift as a gas station attendant at a Los Angeles gas station, elegant and mysterious Stuart Chappell approaches him and invites him for a nightclub tour in search of 'material' for his next novel. An innocent journey will turn into a descent into hell through the city's most infamous clandestine nightclubs, with rather shocking live performances. Michael is put to the test by Stuart who challenges him to hit bottom in order to get back up and is increasingly obsessed with the dark forces he tries to resist. "The explicit and raw scenes" referred to in the critic's quote in the newspaper ads for this movie definitely do not refer to anything erotic or sexual. No, sexuality is far to complex and difficult a subject for boy directors, so they always revert to the tried and true - extreme bloody violence. Nice performances by Getty and Weller, but what they had to say was laughable, and overwhelmed by flashy camera work and an ending so outrageous it was almost worth sitting through the dreadful array of sadomasochism scenes to get to the ending which was worth a good laugh at the ineptness on display. Just how far should an audience be required to go to suspend disbelief? The Russian roulette scene would have been laughable itself had it not already been done to death so many times before. Now it's just tired and predictable. Unfortunately boy-wonder auteurs have no life experience on which to base their work so their "films" are nothing more than a collection of scenes recycled from other movies, some better, some worse, but never original. And one last thing, movies about recovering addicts in a 12-step program should have a warning label so that innocent people won't be suckered into seeing yet another movie about some loser trying to clean up. Seen it. Seen it. Seen it.

title: Emmanuelle
actors: Sylvia Kristel, Alain Cuny, Marika Green, Daniel Sarry, Christine Boisson
description: The beautiful model Emmanuelle lives in Bangkok with her husband Jean, much older than her. Between the two, the tolerance on sex and extramarital relationships is remarkable: for this reason Jean quietly accepts that the young Marie -Ange turns his attention - moreover very explicit - towards the available Emmanuelle; which, however, shows that he preferred the most mature Bee, who accompanies an excursion in the jungle ...
notes: The first chapter of the saga taken from the autobiographical novel of Emmanuelle Arsan: the mixture of Eros and exoticism (combined with the charm of Kristel) in his own way made era, and was later very imitated and exploited.

title: Nessuno torna indietro
actors: Elisa Cegani, Valentina Cortese, Maria Denis, Doris Duranti
description: 1939: Seven girls finish their studies in a boarding house run by nuns and face life on their own for the first time. For the future, each of them feeds illusions, with which reality will not always prove generous.
notes: Begun in '43 and hampered by the war, a discreet foray by Blasetti into the female universe.

title: Les Charlots font l'Espagne
actors: Les Charlots, Gérard Croce, Jacques Legras, Yves Barsacq
description: The long-awaited summer holidays have arrived. A group of friends leave Paris and join a group that is about to take a tour of Spain. After running out of money and adapting to any kind of job, they will become bullfighters by accident.
notes: Comedy at an all-time low.

title: Road Rage
actors: Yasmine Bleeth, Jere Burns, John Wesley Shipp, Alana Austin
description: While on a business trip driving her own car, the young Ellen Carson casually approaches the car of Eddie, a man whose psychic balance has been seriously compromised by a series of dramatic family vicissitudes. For Ellen and her loved ones, this is the beginning of a nightmare ...

title: Top Dog
actors: Chuck Norris, Carmine Caridi, Michele Lamar Richards, Clyde Kusatsu
description: Jake Wilder, a tough cop, wants to shed light on the death of his old friend and colleague Lou Swanson, who was killed while investigating some explosive attacks on a San Diego residential complex. To assist Jake there is a somewhat particular partner: a German shepherd named Reno ...
notes: Strictly for Norris fans.

title: Liebe in Schatten des Drachen
actors: Jürgen Prochnow, Sarah Lam, Burt Kwouk, Christine Reinhart
description: Having traveled to China for work, photographer Paul falls in love with the young guide Wang Li-yun, who, however, is kidnapped by the bad guys to force him into illegal traffic. Back in Cologne, Paul is forced to collaborate with the local Chinese mafia, which threatens him to do nothing to free the girl ...
notes: By-product "made in Germany".

title: San Quentin
actors: Lawrence Tierney, Barton McLane, Raymond Burr, Harry T. Shannon
description: Jim Roland is one of the founding members of a rehabilitation group for San Quentin prison inmates. Jim is the living example of the possibility of amending one's crimes and rebuilding a life; the same cannot be said of Nick Taylor, who runs away and returns to crime ...
notes: "Prison" B-movie with a sincere social vocation.

title: Marilyn: Something's Got to Give
actors: Marilyn Monroe, Dean Martin, Cyd Charisse
description: Dean Martin and Cyd Charisse retrace the last months of Marilyn's life through interviews recorded at the time. The two actors were his filming companions on "Something's Got to Give" the film that was never completed. A month after her dismissal from the set, the actress committed suicide.

title: The Tale of Sweeney Todd
actors: Ben Kingsley, Joanna Lumley, Campbell Scott, Selina Boyack
description: In London, second half of the 1700s. Sweeney Todd's rustic pies have a strange flavor. Maybe because the filling is made with the meat of his customers and his mistress. A girl and an inspector try to unmask him.
notes: The same story inspired a 1936 film directed by George King.

title: I baccanali di Tiberio
actors: Walter Chiari, Ugo Tognazzi, Abbe Lane, Tino Buazzelli, Aroldo Tieri
description: A young man escapes from a psychiatric hospital and believes he will find generous hospitality with the extravagant Delmabre family. But it is only an illusion: he ends up involved in the relentless attempts of the Delambre family to make the famous matter transfer machine work.
notes: Second sequel to Neumann's "Dr. K's Experiment" (1958). The make-up today is obviously inadequate and the script is not exactly excellent. But the atmosphere is very engaging and, after more than thirty years, it continues to be quite effective.

title: Il fidanzato di mia moglie
actors: Vera Carmi, Eduardo De Filippo, Leonardo Cortese, Aroldo Tieri, Sergio Tofano
description: On the eve of the wedding, the young Renata Sarti discovers from the certificate of marital status that she has already been married. The anger of her fiancé and relatives lead her to go to her native country to clear up the misunderstanding. To her great surprise, the girl meets a man who is in the same condition as her: the matter begins to get more and more intricate ...
notes: Written by Bragaglia himself (who passed away in 1998 at the ripe old age of 103) with the collaboration of Aldo De Benedetti, a funny and spirited comedy supported by a first-rate cast. In particular, among others, Eduardo's excellent performance deserves a mention.

title: Una storia qualunque
actors: Nino Manfredi, Bruno Wolkowitch, Tano Cimarosa, Carlo Croccolo
description: Released from prison after the twenty-eight years inflicted on him for the murder of his wife, Michele La Torre lives in a condition so lonely and confused that it makes him want to go back to prison. Helping him is Mirko, a young idealistic lawyer, whom Michele also asks to help him find the children he has lost track of since his sentence. Having recovered his son's address, Michele goes there but is mistaken for the new gardener, finding himself living incognito together with his own relatives. Meanwhile Mirko, studying the proceedings of Michele's trial, begins to suspect a surprising truth ...

title: Due amici
actors: Spiro Scimone, Francesco Sframeli, Felice Andreasi, Teresa Saponangelo
description: Outskirts of a large northern city: the Sicilians Pino and Nunzio live in the same house but communicate little with each other. Or rather, the relationship is marked by Nunzio's pressing and paradoxical questions, followed by Pino's dry answers. The work in a paint factory gradually undermines the health of Nunzio, hopelessly in love with Maria: the worsening of the disease pushes the two men to get closer ...
notes: The film (based on _Nunzio_, a successful play by Scimone) suggests a solid and safe idea of ??cinema. What is less convincing is Sframeli's interpretation, at times decidedly "baroque" and over the top.

title: Un honnête commerçant
actors: Benoît Verhaert, Philippe Noiret, Yolande Moreau, Frédéric Bodson
description: In a Brussels police station, Hubert Verkamen is subjected to a harsh interrogation: he is under investigation for the brutal murder of an entire family. The policemen are convinced that the man is a drug trafficker who has often escaped capture: Verkamen initially denies, but then decides to play along and identifies with the criminal that others want him to be. Thus begins a sophisticated game of massacre that leads to an unexpected epilogue.
notes: In the script and in the direction of Philippe Blasband a bit of fashion peeps out here and there, and it occurs to us that the days when the detective stories à la français were always beautiful are really long gone. But faced with an interrogation like that of the honest merchant, who questions the boundaries between good and evil, true and false, at least you have fun. And in lean times, for those who are passionate about the genre, it is already something.

title: Roger Dodger
actors: Campbell Scott, Jesse Eisenberg, Isabella Rossellini, Elizabeth Berkley, Jennifer Beals
description: Roger Swanson, a successful commercial in Manhattan, spends his evenings going from party to party. His life changes radically when his seventeen-year-old nephew Nick, shy and awkward, comes to him to get to know him better. Roger takes him under his protective wing, trying to initiate him to the joys of seduction and sex: a special night ensues, destined to end with a severe awareness for the established New Yorker.
notes: Campbell Scott subscribes to productions and roles of the genre, the cameos are luxurious (Isabella Rossellini and Jennifer Beals). However, the style of the newcomer Kidd, all dark and blurred close-ups, is less pleasant: it conveys a gloom that balances the unbridled logorrhea of ??the characters, but does not cancel the idea of ??a certain superficiality. After all, what does a successful episode of the much appreciated _Friends_ or _Sex and the City_ have less?

title: The Irrefutable Truth About Demons
actors: Karl Urban, Katie Wolfe, Jonathon Hendry, Tony MacIver, Sally Stockwell
description: Anthropologist Harry Ballard is skeptical of religious cults and is determined to point out their falsehood. But he will have to change his mind, of course, when his girlfriend is killed by a sect of demons and the streets of the city begin to swarm with voracious black figures.
notes: The uncompromising and absolute title hides somewhat rotten stereotypes, between dark, punk and hard music, for a conventional vision of the shadowy meanders of a metropolis. "Curiosity Killed the Cat", but we are very careful not to hurt anyone, neither with violence nor with sex. And the darkness of the night does not worry, but makes the eyelids lower: boredom comes immediately.

title: Air Bud: Seventh Inning Fetch
actors: Caitlin Wachs, Kevin Zegers, Cynthia Stevenson, Chantal Strand
description: Josh is in his freshman year of college while quadruped Buddy has stayed home with Josh's little sister Andrea and the rest of the family. To be accepted by her classmates, the girl decides to join the baseball team: she discovers that Buddy is a talented player. But then...

title: Premier mai
actors: Yves Montand, Bernadette Lange, Yves Noël, Aldo Fabrizi, Georges Chamarat
description: Teresa, Jean's wife, is about to give birth to her second child at home. To avoid a shock to his eldest son Francesco asks her husband to take him to the game. But an unexpected event brings home the boy who notices his mother's strange "malaise".
notes: Polite film directed with a sure hand by the director.

title: ... e di Shaul e dei sicari sulle vie da Damasco
actors: Georges Wilson, Alessandro Haber, Brizio Montinaro, Anna Odessa
description: In conversation with young people, St. Paul recalls the story of his life. Having become, from an avid persecutor of Christians, a follower of Christ, he traveled thousands of kilometers converting many people. The saint became the victim of an attack organized by the Jews.
notes: Flat re-enactment of the life of the apostle.

title: Il giorno dell'Assunta
actors: Tino Schirinzi, Leopoldo Trieste
description: It is August 15th and two urbanized southerners walk the deserted streets of Rome: every now and then they stop to discuss, consult topographical maps, listen to passages engraved on magnetic tapes, cite Campanella and Carlo Levi. In their wanderings they arrive in Cinecittà.
notes: Interesting debut by Nino Russo.

title: Ali G Indahouse
actors: Sacha Baron Cohen, Michael Gambon, Charles Dance, Kellie Bright
description: Ali G, leader of a rap group, is chosen by the Chancellor as a pawn to overthrow the British Prime Minister. But instead of carrying out the diabolical plan, Ali G becomes the voice of the young, making the premier and his government more popular than ever ...
notes: Ali G was Sacha Baron Cohen's first popular character and the first to move to cinema. Unlike the later Borat and Brüno, the new medium still does not suit him: the jokes, between vulgarity and insane goliardia, do not yet have depth and rhythm. The acting is over the top, and the Italian dubbing - very “creative” - doesn't help. The scent is that of a commercial operation, just to exploit a TV success: and you can hear it.

title: Bend It Like Beckham
actors: Parminder Nagra, Keira Knightley, Jonathan Rhys Meyers, Shaznay Lewis
description: Hopes and frustrations of Jes and Jules, two London girls eager to break into the world of football. Unfortunately they have to clash with their respective families, who oppose them harshly: Jes' mother, originally from Punjab, would prefer that the aspiring center-forward learn the recipe for making chapati, the traditional Indian bread, while Jules's mother would like her daughter to wear more feminine clothes and marry ...
notes: Delicious puzzle that mixes the passion for football and ethnic comedy to _East Is East_, finding a balanced and never banal mix, in which you can perceive an ethics of sport that no longer exists here.

title: Corto Maltese - La cour secrète des arcanes
description: 1918. In pursuit of a train transformed into a walking fortress, Corto Maltese crosses Siberia and Manchuria. To seize his cargo of gold, the brave adventurer will have to face the last representatives of the Russian aristocracy, the mysterious Chinese triads and a mad general who commands a handful of marauders.
notes: The film is inspired by the adventures of the famous character created by Hugo Pratt contained in _Corto Maltese in Siberia_. Although the animation is rather static and "woody", the drawings manage to discreetly convey the trait of the great Venetian cartoonist and the magical atmosphere of his stories.

title: Dead or Alive 2: Tôbôsha
actors: Riki Takeuchi, Show Aikawa, Edison Chen, Kenichi Endo, Masato
description: Killer Mizuki must kill a yakuza. However, he is anticipated by a mysterious man in black. Mizuki, however, takes credit and runs away with the reward. He returns to the island where he grew up and there he meets his colleague Shuichi. The two discover they are childhood friends and decide to go into business.
notes: The middle episode of Miike's bizarre trilogy - in which the only points of contact are the two protagonists, the title and the director - abandons the amphetamine-like blood tides of the first chapter (before venturing into the science fiction of the third) for launch into nostalgic atmospheres, in a sweet (though never accommodating) narration of the birth of two killers.

title: L'idole
actors: Leelee Sobieski, James Hong, Jalil Lespert, Jean-Paul Roussillon
description: An elderly and refined Chinese cook and a young Australian actress meet in an old Parisian building. The day the girl confesses to the elderly gentleman that she wants to commit suicide because of a love disappointment, he tries to dissuade her by proposing a pact: he will cook for her every day until the fateful date. Thus an ambiguous friendship is born, looked upon with suspicion by the other inhabitants of the building.
notes: The film by Australian director Samantha Lang is the adaptation of Michelle Tourneur's novel _A l'heure dite_.

title: The Importance of Being Earnest
actors: Reese Witherspoon, Judi Dench, Colin Firth, Rupert Everett, Frances O'Connor, Tom Wilkinson
description: England, late 19th century. Two rich bachelors unknowingly use the same pseudonym: "Earnest", which in English means "serious, sincere, honest". Everything goes well until they fall in love with two women whose only ideal of love is to marry a man named Earnest because it guarantees tranquility due to its assonance with the adjective. Misunderstandings, identity exchanges are now on the agenda.
notes: Actors matter, and a lot, because they're the best thing about the film, all used to throwing Wilde's lines there with impassive nonchalance. But probably the "wit", the dazzling joke is not enough to restore Wilde's social relevance.

title: Insomnia
actors: Al Pacino, Robin Williams, Hilary Swank, Martin Donovan, Maura Tierney
description: Will Dormer, a Los Angeles detective, travels to an Alaskan town with colleague Hap to investigate a murder. During a search for the killer, he accidentally kills Hap, with whom he had quarreled the night before. Will, out of fear, says that it was the murderer on the run who fired. The latter, however, has seen everything, and blackmails him. Helping Will, devoured by insomnia and guilt, is detective Ellie.
notes: Seeing this policeman tormented by doubts about the ethics of his work immediately comes to mind the novels of the Factory by Derek Raymond, where the protagonists and the victims really dripping blood and pain.

title: My Little Eye
actors: Sean CW Johnson, Laura Regan, Kris Lemche, stephen O'Reilly
description: Five boys agree to be barricaded in a house for six months while the cameras film their every single movement. Only if no one leaves before the deadline, the five will be able to pocket the prize pool of one million dollars each. But the television experience is not as simple as it seems: they do not know that they are mere pawns in a cruel and heinous game.
notes: The film, with blurring and zooming in on the events and the set, carries out the attempt to reproduce fear through images. It is as if the cameras and the bright eyes of the infrared-filtered characters are constantly searching for the "real" terror. But they fail: because fear, very human, cannot be identified, and it always acts. Pure cinema, and therefore reconstruction, fiction, a genre that questions its own endemic strength and the possibility of focusing death at work. The sound is important, which dubbing risks muffling.

title: Novo
actors: Eduardo Noriega, Anna Mouglalis, Nathalie Richard, Paz Vega
description: Due to an accident, the Spaniard Pablo is suffering from amnesia or rather a loss of short -term memory. It is enough a few minutes to forget what happened or those who met. He works in Paris in an art gallery, surrounded by a protective climate, but, in reality, the owner does not hesitate to use it sexually. The man begins to take note of everything that happens to him to understand who has to do with.
notes: The film reveals between the lines the main defect of the French author's cinema, the ostentatious intellectualism that ends up making the story turn empty. The two main interpreters of considerable impact.

title: Possession
actors: Gwyneth Paltrow, Aaron Eckhart, Jennifer Ehle, Jeremy Northam
description: Maud Bailey and Roland Michell are two students, the first English and the second American, engaged in a unique literary research focused on the sentimental relationship of Randolph Henry Ash, poet of the Victorian age. The two, retracing Roland's love story with the poet Christabel LaMotte, find themselves entangled in an intricate passion.
notes: LaBute is not the most qualified filmmaker to describe this sentimental journey to the edge of time and the enchantment of a melancholy and anachronistic passion. Paltrow and Eckhart have an understanding of two strangers who accidentally find themselves in the library. Based on the novel by Antonia S. Byatt.

title: Le grand bazar
actors: Les Charlots, Michel Galabru, Michel Serrault, Gérard Rinaldi
description: After being fired from a mechanical mower factory, our heroes plan to help Émile, a small shop owner, save himself from competition from a nearby supermarket. Of course they will combine all the colors.
notes: Grungy French farce. A role also for Coluche.

title: L'inquilina del piano di sopra
actors: Lino Toffolo, Silvia Dionisio, Pippo Franco, Enzo Cannavale, Liana Trouché, Mario Maranzana, Maria Antonietta Beluzzi, Pino Ferrara, Loredana Martínez, Teo Teocoli
description: Professor Arturo is instructed by the tenants of the building in which he lives to deliver an ultimatum to the rough Aurora. The woman will have to make a choice: stop "disturbing" or leave. Arturo, on the other hand, takes a liking to her and offers to fuck her with Pygmalion.
notes: Sort of "My Fair Lady" in pecoreccia version.

title: Gerry
actors: Casey Affleck, Matt Damon
description: Two young men who are both named Gerry begin to walk in a pine forest to find themselves progressively marching in the desert. They are friends, they talk, they argue, they come to hate each other as they go further and further on a journey that seems to have the most authentic depth of the human soul as its final destination.
notes: The film was written by Gus Van Sant and the two performers, Matt Damon and Casey Affleck.

title: Blue Moon
actors: Josef Hader, Viktoria Malektorovych, Detlev W. Buck, Ivan Laca
description: Johnny Pichler smuggles currency between Austria and Slovakia. One day he meets Shirley, a mysterious woman he spends a couple of days with and falls in love with. When she goes missing, he searches for her and runs into her twin who works as a taxi driver in Lviv, Ukraine. Other boundaries and other bizarre encounters will lead the protagonist to understand how things really are ...
notes: The film, a metaphor for the relations between East and West of a reunified continent yet still alien to itself, was presented in competition at the 55th Locarno Film Festival.

title: Oltre il confine
actors: Anna Galiena, Senad Basic, Giuliano Persico, Arnaldo Ninchi
description: Due to her father's serious health problems, Agnes is summoned to the retirement home for ex-combatants where her parent is hospitalized. Not seeing her arrive, the attending physician asks Reuf, a Bosnian illegal immigrant, to watch over the man during the night. The following morning, the director of the institute surprises Reuf and realizes that he is undocumented, has him arrested. Once aware of the incident, Agnes feels compelled to help the unfortunate, guilty only of a gesture of human solidarity and finds herself involved in an adventure that leads her to war-torn Bosnia.
notes: The characters undergo sudden awareness, and the whole film is weighed down by atrocious slowdowns and flashbacks of the little girl Galiena.

title: Secretary
actors: James Spader, Maggie Gyllenhaal, Jeremy Davies, Lesley Ann Warren
description: Fresh out of a psychiatric institution, the young Lee Holloway, suffering from self-destructive delusions, responds to the announcement of a lawyer looking for a secretary. Once she gets the job, she realizes that she has found the ideal man in the sadist E. Edward Gray - who scolds her violently and spanks her. Two eccentric personalities who compensate wonderfully ...
notes: The direction has timing and style, and Spader acts as an effective shoulder to an amazing Gyllenhaal, funny and sexy in her own way: the looks between the two are like a classy comic couple. Small revelation of Sundance 2002, where John Waters has invented a tailor-made award to report it.

title: Tan de repente
actors: Tatiana Saphir, Carla Crespo, Veronica Hassan, Beatriz Thibaudin
description: Arrived from the countryside in Buenos Aires, Marcia, a modest and lonely young saleswoman, lives immersed in an apathetic routine. One day she is followed on the street by Mao and Lenin, two very young lesbopunks who declare themselves in love with her and involve her in a trip to the sea that turns into an initiatory journey whose end is constantly postponed by unforeseen events.
notes: Film debut for the Argentine Diego Lerman.

title: Personal Velocity: Three Portraits
actors: Kyra Sedgwick, Parker Posey, Fairuza Balk, David Warshofsky
description: Delia, Greta and Paula are about to start a new life: the first is on the run with her three children from an abusive husband, the second rediscovers her ambition after spending years with a too modest man, the third expecting a child from a black man trying to help an abused boy.
notes: Rebecca Miller's second feature film, based on her book of short stories of the same name, is a film about actresses, voiceovers, whispers and inner thunders. The digital camera adheres to the faces of the characters, tries to penetrate their eyes, their heads, their thoughts and embraces the talented performers (Kyra Sedgwick, Parker Posey and Fairuza Balk).

title: Al primo soffio di vento
actors: Primo Gaburri, Mariella Fabbris, Ida Carnevali
description: On a muggy August afternoon, a group of seasonal workers mainly from Africa harvest wheat and make hay. Their movements are punctuated by the sun and the sounds of nature. Antonio observes them from the garden of the main house.
notes: The Po Valley author is perhaps the only one to let silence speak and not to suffer the rhythms established by the economy (he took two years for this _A first breath of wind_, from a verse of the third book of the _Argonautiche_), to compose films familists (the country house is his home, relatives and friends among the extras), to represent the countryside as a response to the wear and tear of modern life. Another wonderful elegy of nature that experiences its discomfort a bit paradoxically, given the messages it sends in contact with humans and with an unnatural word. And it is no coincidence that it is the lines written on a computer that marry better with the surrounding habitat. In short, the feeling is that Piavoli, as he did in his masterpiece, The Blue Planet, is more at ease with "silent" cinema. Where to say are things, trees and not people.

title: One Hour Photo
actors: Robin Williams, Connie Nielsen, Michael Vartan, Dylan Smith, Eriq La Salle
description: Sy Parrish works in a supermarket in the photo development department. Thus he knows everyone's images and secrets. In particular he is fascinated by the Yorkins: their happiness has become his, the photos of the couple cover the walls of his apartment. When problems arise in the family, Parrish feels compelled to intervene to defend his ideal image of happiness.
notes: Romanek who wrote the screenplay (there are some inconsistencies and not all the characters are well constructed) has shot many music videos before this first work, but of that effusive and "false glamor" style he has erased all smudges.

title: For All Time
actors: Mark Harmon, Mary McDonnell, Catherine Hicks, Philip Casnoff
description: Charles is a married and successful manager whose desire for a simpler and more peaceful life is fulfilled when, during a train journey, he is magically transported through time (the late nineteenth century) and space (in the town of Somerville). Here Charles meets Laura, a widow who heads the local newspaper ...

title: Pavilion of Women
actors: Willem Dafoe, Luo Yan, Sau Shek, John Cho, Yi Ding, Koh Chieng Mun
description: China, late 1930s. Ailian Wu, the wife of an aristocrat, tries to free herself from the yoke of family and traditions. On her fortieth birthday, in defiance of the rules of society, she pushes a concubine into her husband's arms. Her thirst for freedom leads her to befriend Father Andre, an educated and progressive American priest. In a short time, a strange relationship will arise between the two.
notes: The film is the oriental version of certain European products with the patina, smells and atmospheres of local cultures to be sold on the global market. Direction cannot stem the boring smudges and the light from modern antiques film.

title: Le vacances de Monsieur Hulot
actors: Jacques Tati, Louis Perrault, Nathalie Pascaud, Michèle Rolla
description: On board his old car, Hulot leaves for the longed-for Brittany seaside holiday; regardless of the comments of the people he meets on the street, he finally arrives at his destination. The family-run pension is full of clients (a girl who kills hearts, a businessman who can't help but think about work, children playing, an army commander who thinks he is dealing with his subordinates). Despite himself, Hulot puts everyone in an uproar.
notes: Dazed comedy "mute" for the second feature film by Tati, with absolutely brilliant moments (one for all: the announcements of the loudspeaker at the station).

title: Tender Comrade
actors: Ginger Rogers, Robert Ryan, Ruth Hussey, Patricia Collinge
description: Pregnant and with a husband at the front, Jo gets a job in an aviation industry and shares a house with some colleagues. The small community is a true example of democracy, but the bad news is on the way ...
notes: The film's noble "collectivist" ideals caused trouble for Dmytryk and screenwriter Dalton Trumbo, both "blacklisted".

title: The Whip Hand
actors: Raymond Burr, Olive Carey, Edgar Barrier, Otto Waldis
description: Arriving in a small town during a fishing vacation, reporter Steve Loomis finds that all the fish in the area have mysteriously died. Suspicious of the restlessness and hostility of the inhabitants, he decides to investigate some strange "scientists" who have recently settled in the vicinity ...
notes: Good proof of a master of the B-movie.

title: A qualcuna piace calvo
actors: Magali Noël, Antonio Cifariello, Roberto Risso, Gisella Sofio
description: Marcella has taken an infatuation with a movie actor who has a bald head as a particular sign. The star needs a person to help him deal with the correspondence of the numerous admirers. Marcella doesn't think twice and disguises herself as a man and gets hired as help from her secretary.
notes: Negligible farce.

title: La banda del buco
actors: Claudio Villa, Maria Pia Casilio, Elio Crovetto, Mario Carotenuto
description: One day in Morbidone, the leader of a gang of rogues, a strange guy appears who claims to be his guardian angel. He begins to make speeches that are unusual for him: he speaks to him of honesty and righteousness. In short, he proposes to redeem him. Will he succeed?
notes: The film mixes songs, humor (little) and feelings.

title: First Yank Into Tokyo
actors: Tom Neal, Barbara Hale, Marc Cramer, Richard Loo, Keye Luke
