description: Commissioned to retrieve information on nuclear bombs from a scientist prisoner in Japan, the American pilot Ross returns to the country where he spent his childhood. The risk does not scare Ross, whose facial features are "orientalized" by a surgical operation ...
notes: First film to feel the post-Hiroshima shock.

title: Giovanni dalle Bande Nere
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Anna Maria Ferrero, Philippe Hersent, Gérard Landry
description: XVI century: Giovanni de 'Medici, a daring mercenary captain called "dalle Bande Nere", strenuously opposes both the French and the lansquenec troops, but the opposed love for the beautiful Anna will distract him from the call of arms.
notes: The historical events are a pure pretext for a mélo of little interest.

title: Zorro il cavaliere della vendetta
actors: Charles Quiney, Malisa Longo, Fernando Hilbeck, Maria Mahor
description: An adventurer, in early 19th century California, recruits henchmen to wage his own war with the Indians. No pioneering intentions: man, in fact, is looking for a precious talisman that the redskins consider sacred. To stop him, and avert a bloodbath, Zorro intervenes.
notes: The signature of "this" Zorro soon fades thanks to a film that has its strong point in dialogues that are too terrible to be true and in Hispanic landscapes that are all too picturesque. And then it takes a good fantasy to put the masked avenger against the redsters.

title: The Perfect Tenant
actors: Linda Purl, Maxwell Caulfield, Stacy Hogue, Melissa Behr, Earl Holliman
description: In financial difficulties and separated from her husband Arthur, Jessica Michaels is forced to rent the cottage adjacent to the large and splendid Victorian mansion in which she lives with her sixteen-year-old daughter Laura. One day the ad is picked up by Brian Hartwell, who at first glance presents himself as the ideal tenant: handsome, intelligent, charming and helpful. But behind the surface hides a completely different individual who has some unfinished business with Jessica and intends to retaliate against her and her family ...
notes: The plot does not overflow with originality, but overall - also thanks to the discreet cast - the film lets itself be seen.

title: Night of the Ghouls
actors: Kenne Duncan, Duke Moore, Tor Johnson, Valda Hansen, Johnny Carpenter, Paul Marco, Don Nagel, Bud Osborne, Jeannie Stevens, Harvey B. Dunn
description: Dr. Acula tries to dupe fools by organizing false séances in a "cursed" house. Unfortunately for him, the tenants of the house are real ghosts, who will take their revenge by making them take a one-way tour of the underworld ...
notes: This _Bride of the Monster_ pseudo-sequel (but according to some it is a derivation of _Plan 9_) reveals Ed Wood's total lack of talent. So why is it a must-see film? Because Ed - aka "the worst director in history" - believed himself to be a genius with disarming sincerity, and because his films are so unwittingly ridiculous that they entertain a lot.

title: Les 4 Charlots mousquetaires
actors: Les Charlots, Josephine Chaplin
description: The writer Dumas decides to tell a dark episode of the legend of the "musketeers". D'Artagnan, Porto, Aramis and Atos, in fact, had four doubles which they often replaced. Too bad that the four doubles were as bungling as the ... Charlots!
notes: Buffonesco swashbuckling with the famous French comic group

title: Invasion of Privacy
actors: Mili Avital, Johnathon Schaech, Naomi Campbell, Charlotte Rampling, David Keith
description: Young Theresa Barnes meets charming ex model Josh and begins a relationship with him. She is convinced that she has finally found the man of her dreams, but Josh's violent reaction to the announcement of her motherhood will make her change her mind ...
notes: Written by Larry Cohen, a story on the moral dilemmas related to abortion.

title: Racing with the Moon
actors: Sean Penn, Nicolas Cage, Elizabeth McGovern, Carol Kane, Rutanya Alda, John Karlen
description: 1942: Two friends, Henry and Nicky, are about to leave California to join the Marines. To win the pretty Caddy, Henry makes her believe he is rich.
notes: Benjamin, a specialist in bittersweet comedies, directs a script by Steven Kloves (future director of "The Fabulous Bakers" and screenwriter of "Harry Potter").

title: The Master Race
actors: Lloyd Bridges, Nancy Gates, George Coulouris, Paul Guilfoyle
description: Belgium, 1944: liberated the town of Kolar, the Allies give relief to the population and start the reconstruction. But the evil Nazi colonel von Beck has infiltrated the survivors: the family of Ferdinand, the man whose identity the German has assumed, is too afraid to act, while von Beck contributes to the mounting of intolerance towards foreigners . He also encourages a rich and greedy citizen to take control of the mill with his business: according to capitalist logic, he will refuse to help the peasants ...
notes: Solid drama shot - a conflict still ongoing - by one of the "Ten of Hollywood".

title: A Song Is Born
actors: Danny Kaye, Virginia Mayo, Hugh Herbert, Steve Cochran
description: The gangster boyfriend is in trouble and Honey takes refuge in a music institute, turning him upside down and making his shy director's head spin ...
notes: Hawks remakes his "Love at first sight" (1941) in a musical key: Kaye-Mayo are not Cooper-Stanwyck, but the jazz soundtrack (with Armstrong, Hampton, Dorsey and Goodman) is well worth the candle.

title: Bear's Kiss
actors: Sergei Bodrov jr, Rebecka Liljeberg, Keith Allen, Silvio Orlando
description: Thirteen-year-old Lola travels Europe with a circus performing with her mother as a trapeze artist and with a clown in magic numbers. Lola does not bond with the other children: the only friend she has is Leo, a bear cub that her stepfather gave her and from which she never separates. One day, Lola's mother disappears, leaving her only a farewell note. The girl feels alone and abandoned, until her love transforms Leo into a young man with whom she begins a new life.
notes: The film is an unspeakable mess, starting from the script, to continue with the interpretation, the narrative succession and the settings.

title: The Hours
actors: Nicole Kidman, Julianne Moore, Meryl Streep, Allison Janney, Ed Harris, Claire Danes, Toni Collette
description: 1949: Laura Brown, pregnant housewife, wants to prepare a party for her husband, but cannot take her eyes off the novel she is reading, _Mrs. Dalloway_. Nowadays: Clarissa Vaughn plans to throw a party to celebrate her friend Richard, a famous writer who is dying of AIDS. These two stories are deeply linked to that of another woman, Virginia Woolf, intent on writing _Mrs. Dalloway _...
notes: Daldry (_Billy Elliot_) stages - thanks to the excellent script by David Hare and the excellent performance of the actresses - the beautiful novel _The Hours_ by Michael Cunningham, giving a cinematographic form to the grafts, refractions, echoes, repetitions, assonance, visual, emotional and verbal doubling: a very risky operation, which starts from a sophisticated novel structure and could turn into an annoying example of the "illustrated books" category. A novel haunted by literature and a film "possessed" by writing, by the hypnosis of returns and memories, by past and future vanished and wasted. Low-cut identities, incomplete subjects, sudden stalemates of being, told by the glances, the faded and dull smiles of the three protagonists and the accompanying female choir. The intersections and multiple identifications are "written" by a fourth woman, a paper woman, a literary character. Kidman Oscar for Best Actress in a Leading Role.

title: The Tracker
actors: David Gulpilil, Gary Sweet, Damon Gameau, Grant Page, Noel Wilton
description: 1922. Three mounted policemen - the Fanatic, the Hound, the Veteran - led by an aboriginal (the Guide), set out in pursuit of a black accused of murder (the Fugitive) in a wild Australian land. The tension rises; between massacres and murders, the group's disagreements and questions about who's in charge begin.
notes: De Heer's western lacks the eerie richness and complexity of Hellman's film. Its desired and sought-after essentiality, almost primal, very intertwined with a classic universe that has been lost, backfires a little: at times you feel "the school", a certain boring didacticism that takes events away from the hearts of the spectators.

title: The Magdalene Sisters
actors: Geraldine McEwan, Anne-Marie Duff, Nora-Jane Noone, Dorothy Duffy, Eileen Walsh
description: Three girls are locked up in a convent run by the Sisters of Mercy ...
notes: Institutional barbarism, with the complicity of bigoted families, broadens its shadows on the "civilized" Western culture. Based on incredibly true stories. Mullan knows how to treat realism with antirealistic rawness.

title: Velocità massima
actors: Valerio Mastandrea, Cristiano Morroni, Alessia Barela, Ivano De Matteo, Ennio Girolami
description: Seventeen year old Claudio wants to be a mechanic in his life. The father would prefer him to take his place in the car wrecking company he owns. The conflict between the two is more and more violent until the father lets himself be convinced by Stefano, owner of a workshop in Ostia, and sends his son to be an apprentice. Here the boy demonstrates his talent in repairing and modifying engines, skills that Stefano tries to make the most of to win in clandestine races.
notes: The film suffers from some length in the central part, and does not fully exploit the crescendo of the final challenge. But the design of the two protagonists is effective, to whom Cristiano Morroni and Mastandrea give a beautiful, intense spontaneity.

title: Lovers Lane
actors: Diedre Kilgore, Carter Roy, Brian Allemand
description: A scandal breaks out in a provincial town when the relationship between the sheriff's wife and the husband of a nurse comes to the surface. Shortly after, the two are murdered: ten years later, local teenagers - including the children of the victims - are terrified by a maniac armed with a hook ...
notes: A mid-level "slasher".

title: Le Tour, prends garde!
actors: Eleonora Rossi Drago, Jean Marais
description: During the kingdom of the weak Louis XV the war against Austria burst out. An actor who has distinguished himself for acts of heroism is appointed knight of the king. But a court conspiracy put him as a murderer of a nobleman. The man is forced to escape.
notes: Adventurous hood and sword with Jean Marais, French star of the time.

title: Captain Kidd
actors: Charles Laughton, Randolph Scott, Reginald Owen, John Carradine
description: Fictional story of Captain Kidd, called to escort a cargo of gold to England. The officer chooses to mutiny and declares war on the royal navy, with all the consequences of the case.
notes: Adventurous swashbuckling film shot in natural locations and with considerable use of means.

title: Far from Heaven
actors: Julianne Moore, Dennis Quaid, Dennis Haysbert, James Rebhorn, Patricia Clarkson
description: Apparently Cathy and Frank Whitaker have it all: a solid marriage, two beautiful children, a beautiful home. But when she discovers her husband being intimate with another man, everything falls apart. Cathy finds some comfort in her friendship with Raymond, a cultured and sensitive black gardener, attracting the contempt of friends and acquaintances. Thus opens a new chapter - more painful, but also more sincere - in their respective lives.
notes: Haynes dedicates a rarefied and passionate homage to Douglas Sirk and his flamboyant melodramas (in particular _Secondo amore_, 1955). The chromatics of the "emotional" photography signed by Ed Lachman are exceptional.

title: Demon Knight
actors: William Sadler, Billy Zane, John Kassir, Jada Pinkett Smith, CCH Pounder
description: Brayker possesses the last of seven ancient keys (which guarded the blood of Christ) which enables him to stop the advance of the forces of Evil. The prodigious object is coveted by many: among these is the perfidious "Collector" who, in order to obtain it and thus be able to make the universe fall into chaos, accuses Brayker of having stolen his key and reports him to the police. I don't pay, he summons a host of corpses from the Hereafter ...
notes: Third film (co) directed by former cinematographer Spike Lee, based on a successful series of splatter comics. Discreet balance between funny and terrifying moments.

title: Contagion
actors: Bruce Boxleitner, Megan Gallagher, Lin Shaye, Dan Lauria
description: Wounded in the neck during an attack, US President Martin Howard discovers that he was hit by a capsule containing a lethal virus. The very delicate case is entrusted to the prestigious virologist Diane Landis, but time is running out ...
notes: A very discounted attempt to exhume a disused sub-genre.

title: Nerone 71
actors: Gino Bramieri, Maria Grazia Buccella, Memmo Carotenuto
description: "Nero 71" is the title of a blockbuster that Cinecittà is about to begin. The auditions for the parties come from all over Italy. A provincial family also goes to Rome with the hope that their daughter will be chosen. But from the moment she is rejected, the little family combines everything to right the wrong.
notes: Gino Bramieri star performer!

title: Cosi
actors: Ben Mendelsohn, Barry Otto, Toni Collette, Rachel Griffiths, Colin Friels
description: Sydney: Young Louis, director of an amateur theater company, is offered a collaboration at an institute for the rehabilitation of the mentally ill. Here he finds Roy, who dreams of staging Mozart's "Cosi fan tutti": the only obstacle is that none of the "artists" can sing, much less in Italian ...
notes: Nice and original.

title: Viale della speranza
actors: Cosetta Greco, Liliana Bonfatti, Maria Pia Casilio, Piera Simoni, Marcello Mastroianni
description: The avenue of hope leads to Cinecittà, Hollywood on the Tiber. And a group of girls full of dreams want to walk it with their heads held high. The world of cinema attracts them, but only one of them will "break through".
notes: Unrecognized comedy by Dino Risi, who casts his caustic gaze here and there on the "Italian Dream" of the boom years.

title: Gridlock'd
actors: Vondie Curtis Hall, Tim Roth, Tupac Shakur, Thandie Newton
description: Spoon and Stretch, two crazy musicians and heroin addicts, decide it's time to change their lives and undergo a detox program. The intent is admirable, but their efforts are quickly frustrated by the state bureaucracy and a series of misadventures: both the cops and the gangster D-Reper will be found on their heels, to whom they have stolen a can ...
notes: Tour de force by Curtis-Hall, who writes, directs and plays the role of D-Reper; here and there the satirical air hits the mark, with Roth playing on his side. Last film starring rapper Shakur, killed in September '96 in Las Vegas.

title: Citizen Ruth
actors: Laura Dern, Swoosie Kurtz, Kurtwood Smith, Mary Kay Place, Burt Reynolds, Tippi Hedren
description: Thirty-year-old Ruth Stoops is so ruined by drugs that she is reduced to snorting glue and paint, and what's more, now she has to face an imminent, umpteenth motherhood (she has four other interrupted pregnancies behind her). But when the judge decrees her inability to fulfill parental obligations, the girl is co-opted by Gail Stoney, wife of the president of an anti-abortion committee: obviously the supporters of free will intervene, and poor Ruth becomes the center in spite of herself. of a strenuous quarrel between opposing factions.
notes: Before "Election," Payne fires another corrosive comedy about America's contradictions.

title: We Were Soldiers
actors: Mel Gibson, Madeleine Stowe, Greg Kinnear, Sam Elliott, Chris Klein
description: On November 14, 1965, Lieutenant Colonel Hal Moore and his soldiers (about 400, all very young) arrived in Vietnam, in the Valley of Death. Here the first battalion of the 7th Cavalry - the same regiment of General Custer - soon discovers that it is surrounded by over 4000 Vietcong, but Moore decides to launch the attack anyway. Thus begins one of the wildest battles in the history of the United States military.
notes: The best-selling film _We Were Soldiers Once ... and Young_ is shot and edited in an unacceptable way. The dialogue is grumpy and grumpy, Gibson is out of the question and Stowe is scarred from the facelift.

title: Blade II
actors: Wesley Snipes, Kris Kristofferson, Ron Perlman, Leonor Varela
description: Blade, a half-vampire man, is forced to side with a team of very powerful vampires to defeat a new type of super-vampire that none of them have ever faced before. It is the only possibility to prevent the elimination of the human race and that of the vampires.
notes: After the departure of Stephen Norrington, director of the first episode, the camera passed to Del Toro who was able to enhance the dark components of the character. Tense, excellently choreographed in the fights (and Wesley Snipes as a martial artist is always better), "Blade II" represents a beautiful glimpse of nocturnal cinema in the increasingly homologated panorama of the Hollywood action movie.

title: Orange County
actors: Colin Hanks, Jack Black, Catherine O'Hara, Schuyler Fisk, John Lithgow
description: Shaun, a senior high school student, hopes to be able to enroll at Stanford University, but a difficult family background and a mistake by his tutor risk shattering his plans. With the help of his brother and girlfriend, he will have 24 hours to try to remedy the situation ...
notes: Small and pleasant, with a moralistic but sincere ending, not original but well written and direct; of the gallery of secondary stickers, several are spot on. The directorial debut of Lawrence Kasdan's daughter sees the friendly participation of Chevy Chase, Kevin Kline, Harold Ramis, Lily Tomlin and Garry Marshall, among others.

title: Les Charlots contre Dracula
actors: Les Charlots, Amélie Prévost, Andréas Voutsinas, Gérard Jugnot, Vincent Martin, Dora Doll
description: A spell, formulated by the deceased mother, prevents Dracula jr. to emulate the famous parent. A double of the woman is needed to break the spell, and to find her the count hires the detective Gaston, who kidnaps Ariane at the flea market and takes her to Transylvania: but her boyfriend Phil and friends Jean and Gérard run into his rescue ...
notes: The five madmen of the Italian title are the members of the French pop musical group Les Charlots, which in the seventies, in addition to a discreet musical career at home and an appearance in San Remo in 1974, collected over fifteen comedy films, which however did not they certainly shine for their intelligence.

title: Rosa Funzeca
actors: Ida Di Benedetto, Ennio Fantastichini, Aldo Giuffré, Primo Reggiani, Lalla Esposito
description: Naples. Rosa Funzeca has been a prostitute for more than twenty years: she managed to save some money and close with the past. He bought a "sweets and fruit" stall in a suburban market and decided to take back his son Fernando, who grew up in a priest's institution. He signed many bills of exchange for the purchase of the stall and an apartment in a council house. Her former protector leverages her financial difficulties to convince her to return to the sidewalk part-time.
notes: The film is less insane and sympathetically foolish than others by Grimaldi, and the black and white fails to disguise a substantially television direction.

title: Blood Work
actors: Clint Eastwood, Wanda De Jesus, Jeff Daniels, Anjelica Huston, Tina Lifford
description: Los Angeles: Federal agent Terry McCaleb lives on a small boat docked in the port of San Pedro after retiring due to severe heart problems that forced him to undergo a transplant. When he discovers that the donor of his heart is a young Hispanic woman who has been the victim of the serial killer whom McCaleb has been hunting for years, he decides to go back to the criminal's trail ...
notes: In over thirty years of directing, Eastwood has never let himself be distracted by presumptions and quirks, he has never posed as an "author", preferring to follow the honest path of the great Hollywood craftsmanship. And in doing so, he has elaborated one of the most personal and recognizable poetic and psychological universes of contemporary cinema. The protagonist of his first film (_Brivido nella notte_, 1971) was a disc-jockey persecuted by a psychopathic admirer; then came Callaghan's various companions and adversaries, as well as the prostitutes and little girls who force her lonely cowboys to get back to work. And today finally Eastwood, the tough guy full of respect and admiration for women, takes on the feminine element (the heart), the tears in front of the soap-operas and the discontent "once a month" (as the serial killer of this film). _Blood Debt_, based on the novel by Michael Connelly (written by Brian Helgeland), is not only a good thriller, full of regrets: it is also an exemplary declaration of poetics.

title: The Dancer Upstairs
actors: Javier Bardem, Abel Folk, Juan Diego Botto, Laura Morante, Elvira Mínguez
description: Policeman Agustín Rejas is instructed to capture the famous guerrilla Ezequiel Durán, the leader of a revolution that intends to overthrow the government. Faced with the brutal intimidation techniques used by Ezequiel's followers, the policeman decides to respond by force, creating an atmosphere of collective panic. But one day he meets Yolanda, his daughter's charming dance teacher ...
notes: The film, based on a novel by Nicholas Shakespeare (also author of the screenplay), is the story of the character who captured Abimael Guzmán, the leader of the Peruvian guerrillas of "Sendero Bright". John Malkovich, a newcomer behind the camera, has a wrist, an eye, and intelligence. He can build suspense.

title: Between Strangers
actors: Sophia Loren, Mira Sorvino, Deborah Kara Unger, Malcolm McDowell, Klaus Maria Brandauer, Gérard Depardieu
description: Three women who do not know each other are grappling with curiously intertwined dreams, desires and choices, the consequences of which heavily affect their lives. Olivia is obsessed with a recurring dream that takes her away from her husband, who is confined to a wheelchair, and brings her back to her daughter, who was born at a very young age and then abandoned. Photojournalist Natalia has just gotten her first cover in a prestigious magazine, but the need to know what happened to the Angolan woman she portrays prevents her from feeling gratified. Catherine, a successful cellist, leaves her family to meet her father and avenge her mother's death ...
notes: Medium product with a stellar cast, due to the connections of the director who - in case you didn't know - is the son of Carlo Ponti and Sophia Loren. Sorvino and Unger are to all intents and purposes co-stars. Loren seems to have come out of _A special day_, but she is not the only living quote from the film: there is also McDowell, which allows Ponti a bold memory of _Arancia mechanica_.

title: Porca miseria!
actors: Carlo Croccolo, Francesco Golisano, Isa Barzizza, Mario Riva, Carlo Campanini, Tina Pica
description: Carletto and Giacomino, unemployed and penniless, could participate in a variety show on condition that they get a girl with the right legs. They finally find her in poor and beautiful roommate Lilly, but trouble has yet to begin ...
notes: Free and insipid remake of "Quei due" by Gennaro Righelli (1935), with the De Filippo brothers.

title: I ragazzi dell'Hully Gully
actors: Alicia Brandet, Claudio Privitera, Ave Ninchi, Angela Luce, Carlo Pisacane, Carlo Delle Piane, Carlo Dapporto
description: The legacy of Maurice, a degenerate descendant of a noble lineage enriched by composing light music, entices the scandalized but shabby relationship. To get your hands on the heritage, however, you have to submit to a condition set by the deceased: guess which song will win the national grand prix ...
notes: Laughable and unlikely.

title: My Hustler
actors: Paul America, Joseph Campbell, Geneviève Charbon, Ed Hood
description: Looking for a young man to spend the weekend with, a middle-aged intellectual hires Paul, to whom a more experienced colleague reveals the tricks of the trade.
notes: A "two reel" shot on Fire Island, whose programmatic "sloppiness" - conforming to Warhol's idea of ??cinema - is counterbalanced by the irony of the dialogues.

title: Normal Love
actors: Diana Baccus, Mario Montez, Francis Francine, Andy Warhol
description: The same year of "Flaming Creatures", Smith developed a color version (always under the banner of androgyny and sexual "indefiniteness"), within which a series of pictorial references - Veronese and Watteau in primis - freely mix with mythological quotes and allusions to the Hollywood universe.

title: La forza del passato
actors: Sergio Rubini, Bruno Ganz, Sandra Ceccarelli, Mariangela D'Abbraccio, Valeria Moriconi, Sebastiano Moise, Giuseppe Battiston
description: Forty-year-old Gianni Orzan is satisfied with the world he has built for himself. He lives with his wife Anna, a very sweet woman, and with their son Francesco. The meeting with a strange stranger who says he knows things about his father, a fascist soldier, puts Gianni's balance in crisis forcing him to make a lucid analysis of what he is and what he wanted to become.
notes: Based on the novel by Sandro Veronesi, the film by Piergiorgio Gay, which had debuted with the remarkable "Three stories", is frankly and unfortunately a disappointment. In addition to Rubini and Bruno Ganz there are also a more depressed Ceccarelli than usual and an anonymous Trieste background.

title: Un uomo, una città
actors: Enrico Maria Salerno, Luciano Salce, Tino Scotti
description: Scenes of the daily fight against crime of a Turin commissioner. Michele Parrino investigates gangs of young bourgeois who sow terror between robberies and drug dealing, and a gang of suburban criminals who killed a jeweler.
notes: A very interesting detective story. Romolo Guerrieri (brother of Marino Girolami), looks at the French polar in the definition of the "sad" cop played by Salerno. The screenplay unfortunately stumbles upon some parody obstacle, but the "left" commissioner is much less didactic than the one sketched by Pistilli in the excellent "Milan caliber 9".

title: Venomous
actors: Treat Williams, Mary Page Keller, Hannes Jaenicke, Anthony John Denison
description: In a secret laboratory in the desert, a United States Army science unit is developing a new species of snake that carries a deadly venom. A gang of terrorists, in an attempt to get hold of the new weapon, destroys the structure and ends up freeing the reptiles, but without being able to take it. Many years later, an earthquake brings to light the descendants of those snakes, which in the meantime have evolved and become even more lethal. The creatures swoop en masse on a town and the victims are not counted so much that to stop the invasion the military plans a carpet bombing.

title: Un viaggio chiamato amore
actors: Laura Morante, Stefano Accorsi, Alessandro Haber, Galatea Ranzi, Diego Ribon
description: The human and sentimental story of the narrator and poetess Sibilla Aleramo, from adolescence to maturity: in particular in the two-year period 1916-'18, the period in which the woman binds herself in a passionate relationship with the poet Dino Campana. After an initial exchange of letters, the two decide to meet: it is the beginning of their tormented relationship ...
notes: Placido risks a lot, he finds something, something escapes him. Find a music that knows how to change register, a light that loses colors and aura; what he seems unable to grasp are two actors capable of bearing the weight of such heavy tasks. Nevertheless, Coppa Volpi goes to Stefano Accorsi.

title: Dolls
actors: Miho Kanno, Hidetoshi Nishijima, Tatsuya Mihashi, Kyoko Fukada
description: First story: Matsumoto and Sawako were a happy couple, who seemed destined for marriage; but parental pressures and success forced the man to make a choice. The two will find themselves united, in search of something they have forgotten. Second story: Yakuza boss Hiro is respected and feared, but he is alone and his health is failing him. Thirty years later he returns to the park where he used to meet, when he was still a poor worker, with his girlfriend. Third story: Haruna spends most of her time on an isolated beach, watching the sea; her beautiful face is half covered with bandages. Before the accident, she was a beloved TV star: Nukui is perhaps the only fan to have remained faithful to her ...
notes: Kitano starts from Chikamatsu, the "Japanese Shakespeare", to develop a profound and universal theme: love as a total, definitive, extreme act. Against which reason is a glass prison, easy to shatter under the weight of madness. Against the background of the storms of passion, and without forgetting the selfishness of those who provoke it (out of interest or ambition), death seals the rediscovered balance of feelings as a "pure" event. While extraordinary, _Dolls_ is a film of great complexity and with many cryptic reading levels. But there is a transparent one: the sacredness of the landscape, the ontological cruelty of its beauty, the hyper-realism of its poetic transfiguration, emerge from the work in a definitive way.

title: Oasis
actors: Sol Kyung-gu, Moon So-ri, Ahn Nae-sang, Ryoo Seung-wan
description: Released from prison, Jong-du starts working in the warehouse of a factory; here he undertakes to behave in the best way, but he cannot help but create problems: there is something inside him that he cannot control. One day, while visiting the home of one of his victims, he meets the daughter of the man he killed: it is Gong-ju, a girl suffering from a stroke that forced her to live in a wheelchair. Between the two arises a relationship opposed by all ...
notes: Removing any conciliation, Lee strips the story of any sentimental connection, drawing from it a harrowing and very painful work.

title: Dirty Pretty Things
actors: Audrey Tautou, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Sergi López, Sophie Okonedo, Benedict Wong
description: Okwe, a Nigerian immigrant legally in London, does everything he can to make ends meet: in the evening he is a taxi driver and at night he is a receptionist in a notorious hotel. The man shares a seedy apartment with Senay, a shy Turkish without a residence permit who works in the same hotel. One night, Okwe realizes that the hotel is run by a ruthless criminal organization that exploits the desperate and discovers that Senay is in the gang's sights. Thus begins a race against time to save the girl ...
notes: Frears has the gift of a light hand and knows how to draw characters with few strokes (the Chinese who works at the corpse incinerator, the black prostitute who spends her nights at the "Baltic", the owner of the minicab company who got gonorrhea ). He also knows how to make films on the low budget of the BBC: real films, not TV movies. _Little Dirty Business_ is well written, well directed, well acted, beautifully photographed by Chris Menges: and that's no small feat.

title: Afrodite, dea dell'amore
actors: Isabelle Corey, Irene Tunc, Antonio De Teffé, Clara Calamai, Emma Baron
description: The governor of Corinth is a fan of Nero. He does not manage to set fire to his city, devoted to the cult of Aphrodite, the goddess of love, but when a plague epidemic breaks out, he finds nothing better than to accuse the Christian citizens. And if it were the Olympic divinity, dedicated to love, who helped the poor Christians, creating a great turmoil in the house of Jupiter?
notes: When the "pepla" or "sandaloni" raged in Cinecittà, all the directors dedicated themselves to it with enthusiasm. Even Mario Bonnard, a craftsman more at ease with "pink" comedies. However, an exotic and enjoyable film.

title: Jimmy Neutron: Boy Genius
description: Jimmy Neutron, a little boy who lives with his parents in Retroville, is a little genius; nevertheless, he eagerly awaits - like his other peers - the opening of Retroland, a fantastic playground. Of course, Mom and Dad prevent him from leaving the house, and so Jimmy decides to go to the carnival anyway. Upon his return, he discovers that all the adults of Retroville have been kidnapped by the Yokians, sticky extraterrestrials ...
notes: The film sports a remarkable visual richness, especially when the amusement park is transformed into a space convoy, but compared to other cartoons the script suffers from several shortcomings.

title: Skoot hansawwar/Silence... on tourne
actors: Latifa, Ahmed Bedeir, Ahmed Wafik, Rubi, Magda Al Khattib
description: Malak, rich and famous singer and actress, would like to be loved for who she is and not for having a lot of money and being famous. Wounded by her recent divorce, Malak falls prey to Lamei, an unscrupulous social climber who only thinks about money. Her closest associates try to separate her from the shady individual who could jeopardize her career. So they make Lamei believe that Malak's legacy will go to his daughter Paula.
notes: Chahine wanders with glee in the world of entertainment, moves without hindrance between social classes and freely loads his film of effects and excesses, makes popular cinema and passes, always in a hurry, to sequences of refined staging.

title: Roberto Succo
actors: Isild Le Besco, Stefano Cassetti, Patrick Dell'Isola, Vincent Dénériaz, Aymeric Chauffert
description: Roberto is a 20 year old loner. On vacation he meets Lèa and falls in love. Every weekend he visits her and during the many comings and goings he leaves behind an inexplicable amount of murders, rapes and assaults ...
notes: The film is honest and bitterly lucid, like the Ellroy books that Kahn likes so much.

title: Lagaan: Once Upon a Time in India
actors: Aamir Khan, Gracy Singh, Rachel Rachel Shelley, Paul Blackthorne, Suhasini Mulay
description: We are in 1893 in the village of Champaner, in the center of India. The peasants wait in vain for the monsoons to arrive. To humiliate them, Captain Russell, head of the British garrison, doubles the lagaan, the tax on cereals. Blavan sees Russell propose a bet: if the Indians beat the British in a cricket match, they will be exempt from lagaan for three years, if they lose they will have to pay a triple tax. Bluvan agrees, but doesn't have enough men to form a team.
notes: Two hundred and twenty minutes of chromatic delirium, provocatively unrolled against the haste of American cinema and western rhythms: director Gowariker and Aamir Khan (star of Indian cinema, protagonist and producer of the fluvial film) take all their time telling and explaining, falling in love and hating , throwing himself into "that stupid game" which is called cricket in spite of the British and compatriots themselves. That Bombay residents have gone mad for this film is not surprising. But that a Western spectator, accustomed to the hour and a half, is able to get excited (after 120 minutes already full and dizzying) to a second part that proposes a cricket competition that certainly does not have the appeal of a football final gives the measure of mastery (and cunning) of an operation that has the breath of the blockbuster and the inspiration of the "immoral" apologue. Almost four hours of colorful emotions to say, in essence, that it is the Dream that counts. More than a movie. An experience.

title: The New Guy
actors: DJ Qualls, Eliza Dushku, Zooey Deschanel, Lyle Lovett, Jerod Mixon
description: In East Highland high school, new student Gil Harris tops the popularity rating chart among the female population. Mysterious and charming, Gil makes all the girls fall at his feet, causing trouble with the gangsters that are on his heels. The whole school is in his hands, but no one knows that Gil is hiding a secret.
notes: The protagonist is a skimpy blond already seen (and forgotten) in "Road Trip". And the cameo? Summoned throughout the film, the "mystery guest" is only revealed at the end. It's David Hasselhoff, the muscular star of "Supercar" and "Baywatch". Mouth-watering.

title: Das Experiment
actors: Moritz Bleibtreu, Christian Berkel, Olivier Stokowski, Wotan Wilke Möhring
description: Tarek is reading the papers sitting in his taxi. An advertisement caught his attention: participants wanted for a scientific test, 2000 euros for 14 days, experiment in a fake penitentiary. Convinced that he has a scoop on his hands, Tarek phones the newspaper he worked for in the past to propose a service. Tarek agrees to participate in the experiment involving a simulation of roles in a fake penitentiary. Install a micro camera in the frame of the glasses and mix with the competitors.
notes: The film seems to throw the stone and then immediately remove your hand: it does not sink, it does not scratch. The best thing remains the ending.

title: Jeepers Creepers
actors: Gina Philips, Justin Long, Jonathan Breck, Patricia Belcher
description: Trish and her brother Darry are on their way home from college. The journey seems, apparently, to calm him, but the danger is lurking. Along the way, the two meet The Creeper, a disturbing demonic creature who returns to earth every 23 years to feed non-stop for 23 days, of human beings in order to regenerate. A psychic comes to their aid.
notes: Director Victor Salva, from the Coppola stable (executive producer), has created the most serious and successful horror film in recent years. The coordinates are the classic ones, for which each fantastic tale is the reworking of a fairy-tale archetype.

title: Undisputed
actors: Fisher Stevens, Jon Seda, Peter Falk, Wesley Snipes, Ving Rhames
description: George, heavyweight champion known as "Iceman", is jailed - according to him unfairly - on rape charges: he does not accept that he cannot defend the crown and his record of victories. In the penitentiary where he is transferred he meets Monroe, a light heavyweight who wonders if one day he will be able to fight him in the ring ...
notes: Contrary to Hill's debut film _The Hero of the Road_, the context is no longer that of America in search of hope, but a closed world where the outcasts survive. In the midst of this disarrayed humanity rapping _God Bless America_, the camera moves frantically, amplifying the tensions.

title: El Bola
actors: Juan José Ballesta, Pablo Galán, Alberto Jiménez, Manuel Morón
description: El Bola is a twelve-year-old boy who grew up in a violent and sordid atmosphere. His family situation, which he is ashamed of, makes him unable to have relationships with his peers. But the arrival of Alfredo, a new classmate and the discovery of a family where love and understanding prevails, will give him the strength to accept himself and hope for a better future.
notes: Achero Mañas has the advantage of drying, subtracting, removing, trusting his little heroes. And the courage to sketch another father, that of Alfredo, who redeems the world of the "grown-ups" by changing their skin with tattoos.

title: Brat 2
actors: Sergei Bodrov jr, Victor Sukhorukov, Irina Saltykova, Kirill Pirogov
description: Danila, invited to a television program, finds his comrades in arms who had fought with him in the war against the Chechens. One of them tells him that his brother Viktor, an ice hockey player, called The Tartar, emigrated to the United States. On hearing the news of his death, Danila gathers a group of former comrades in arms and goes to America with the intention of taking revenge.
notes: Aleksei Balabanov shoots the sequel to _Brother_ 1996 using the same actors for the lead actors. Following Danila to St. Petersburg, Moscow and the United States, he makes us understand that there is little difference between the two countries. Russia has taken its worst sides from America.

title: Brat
actors: Sergei Bodrov jr, Viktor Sukhoroukov, Svetlana Pismichenko, Mariya Zhukova, Yuri Kuznetsov
description: Danila returns home after serving in the Russian army. Since life in the country is without prospects, his elderly mother convinces him to go to St. Petersburg to see his brother Viktor. In fact, it seems that he has made a fortune. Danila soon realizes that Viktor is a killer in the pay of the mafia and immediately takes sides with him. Especially when he learns that his brother is in the crosshairs of a boss who would like to eliminate him.
notes: Balabanov made a dark, gloomy and distressing film. Awarded in Cannes in the "Un certain regard" section, he received the special jury prize in Turin. In 2000, the director shot the sequel: _The Big Brother_.

title: La captive
actors: Sylvie Testud, Stanislas Merhar, Olivia Bonamy, Aurore Clément, Liliane Rovère
description: The beautiful Ariane lives with the young and wealthy Simon in a large Paris apartment. The man is so obsessed with her that he subjects her to incessant questions, constantly checks her, makes her accompany him when he decides to go out. But Ariane leads - even sexually - a double life, which only exacerbates Simon's pain and desire ...
notes: After the parenthesis of _A sofa in New York_ (comedy, large production and famous protagonists: all conditions unusual for her), the Belgian filmmaker asks for guidance from none other than Marcel Proust and his _Prisoner_, drawing from it an exhausted meditation on love and possession.

title: Christy: The Movie
actors: Lauren Lee Smith, Diane Ladd, James Waterston, Stewart Finlay-McLennan
description: We are in 1912: Christy Huddleston, a girl full of ideals, abandons her quiet life to accept a job as a teacher in a small school in Cutter Gap, a town located in the mountains of Tennessee ...
notes: An honest TV movie, based on Catherine Marshall's best-seller of the same name.

title: Tatiana, la muñeca rusa
actors: Ornella Muti, Karra Elejalde, Stefania Sandrelli, Hector Alterio, Laura Del Sol
description: Joaquin, manager of a prestigious company working in the food sector, goes to Russia to set up new branches. He meets and falls in love with Tatiana, a beautiful interpreter.
notes: Tatiana has the face and body of Ornella Muti, who was in her forties at the time. The director, in Italy, is a complete stranger.

title: Crazy Horse
actors: Michael Greyeyes, Peter Horton, Nathaniel Arcand, August Schellenberg
description: Crazy Horse was a key figure in Native American history. Sioux leader Oglala allied himself with the Cheyenne after marrying a squaw of that tribe. Its role is important in the resistance of the Indians to the expansion of the whites. He was responsible for Custer's death at the Battle of Little Big Horn.
notes: Tv movie shot in South Dakota.

title: L'anima gemella
actors: Valentina Cervi, Violante Placido, Michele Venitucci, Sergio Rubini, Dino Abbrescia
description: In a small village in southern Italy, Tonino and Maddalena love each other with a pure and unconditional love. Magdalene's beauty, however, arouses the envy of Teresa, her cousin, daughter of a powerful man who got rich from the fish trade. The girl tries by all means to steal Tonino from Maddalena, even resorting to the charms of an old village witch. The son of the latter, a fraudulent barber, will be able to unravel, in spite of himself, the dense network of intrigues hatched by Teresa.
notes: Sergio Rubini's cinema reflects a singular Southern sentiment. Towards the roots and the landscapes, towards the dialect and towards the light, towards the alterations of consciousness and imagination. This cinematic feeling is complex and never folkloric and around this cultural knot Rubini, with his films as a director, has a fluctuating movement. It approaches and moves away, leaves and returns as happens to those who made their debut with a film that is a program of departures and returns: _The station_. The Apulian cinema - like the Neapolitan, the Milanese, the Tuscan or the Roman - does not exist. Slang and environments do not shape a narrative orientation. With this seventh direction Rubini (he carves out the role of a bungling and irresistible barber) enjoys staging a drunken and magical comedy, pervaded with eroticism and punctuated by rituals of domestic witchcraft. A pleasant grotesque proposal, rare in our cinema. The script has some problems and the two actresses, in love with the same man and victims of metamorphosis, are good and support the whirlwind of the characters.

title: La virgen de la lujuria
actors: Ariadna Gil, Luis Felipe Tovar, Patricia Reyes Spindola, Juan Diego, Julian Pastor
description: Mexico, 1940s. "El Mikado" is a taciturn and lonely waiter. He spends his days between Caffé Ofelia and its collection of pornographic photos. His life changes dramatically when he meets Lola, a sweet, unpredictable and self-destructive Spanish prostitute. A sadomasochistic relationship is established between the two, but "El Mikado" is capable of anything to win the love of the woman.

title: Rokugatsu no hebi
actors: Asuka Kurosawa, Yuji Koutari, Shinya Tsukamoto, Mansaku Fuwa
description: Thirty-year-old Rinko Tatsumi works as a telephone consultant on an emergency line of a mental health center, her husband Shigehiko is a prominent businessman. Even if the two have not had sexual relations for a long time and do not share the same bed, their life as a couple proceeds quietly: at least until Rinko is blackmailed by a mysterious individual, who sends her photos that portray her dedicated to acts of onanism and reveals that he knows secret episodes from his past. Meanwhile, the same blackmailer drags Shigehiko into a porn show club. Who is the man who entered their relationship?
notes: A film about human disease and the corresponding cancer of modernity, but above all a surgical and sincere invitation to take possession of one's own flesh: understood as awareness, awareness of bodies (and existences) marked by scars, deficiencies and destruction; indeed, more for this reason. That's why _A Snake of June_ is a love film: not so much for the tragic and almost catastrophic feelings that run between the three characters, as for Tsukamoto's propensity for an expression capable of finding a glimmer of survival in cosmic pessimism, perhaps through sexual and gaze obsession.

title: Ken Park
actors: James Ransone, Tiffany Limos, Stephen Jasso, James Bullard, Amanda Plummer
description: We are in Visalia, California, a remote city located halfway between Los Angeles and Fresno. Four families are told through the eyes of four children. There is no escape, everything is brought to light: the rise of violence, morbid sexuality, the obsessive obsessions of adults.
notes: Of all Larry Clark's films, Ken Park is the most suffered, measured, even tender, in the desperate emptiness and instrumental cruelty he describes. Even the voyeurism to which the author has perhaps too often abandoned himself in the past has a precise reason for existing here, and goes beyond complacency to become existential description. And the scene, towards the end, in which three of the boys make love together and talk about a paradise in which to live alone, has the quiet sadness of an unattainable dream. Ed Lachman is also the director of photography of Todd Haynes's Syrkian Far from Paradise (presented as Ken Park at the last Venice Film Festival): it will be just a coincidence, but the two films, in their stylistic distance, seem the two faces of the same world with no escape.

title: Full Frontal
actors: Julia Roberts, David Duchovny, Blair Underwood, Catherine Keener, Mary McCormack
description: Los Angeles: seven friends try to manage in the best way the delicate relationships that unite them. Linda is worried that she hasn't found the right man yet; Carl loves his wife Lee, but she is unhappy because she would like to be loved by Calvin, the star of a very successful television series; on his fortieth birthday, Gus realizes he only loves himself ...
notes: In no uncertain terms, a very disappointing, predictable and convoluted film. Soderbergh is a director who gives himself the freedom to jump from one cornice to another of the Hollywood industry and often falls into the void (of meaning and entertainment).

title: Vendredi soir
actors: Vincent Lindon, Valérie Lemercier, Florence Loiret, Grégoire Colin
description: Friday is the last night Laure spends at her home. The next day he will go to live with François. Not feeling like being alone in her apartment, she accepts an invitation to dinner. Unfortunately she will never get to the restaurant because she gets stuck in traffic: Paris has plunged into chaos due to a strike. Everyone gets excited and nervous, except for a man in a leather jacket who, for a few minutes, has been staring at Laure ...

title: The Little Foxes
actors: Bette Davis, Herbert Marshall, Teresa Wright, Richard Carlson, Dan Duryea
description: Louisiana, early 1900s: Regina, married to a wealthy and sick banker, receives a request for funding from her brothers, aspiring cotton industrialists. The rapacious Queen will do anything to turn the situation to her advantage, but ...
notes: From the play of the same name by Lillian Hellman (who scripts), a fundamental mello by Wyler.

title: Un homme sans l'Occident
actors: Ali Hamit, Wodji Ouardougou
description: Shot in northeastern Chad, the film tells the story of one of the last nomadic peoples of the desert, the Toubou (the only colored nomads in the desert). The protagonist Sid Ahmed, abandoned in the desert as a child and welcomed by the nomads of whom he becomes one of the leaders, is terrified by the modernization that is affecting his country.
notes: The film is inspired by the novel of the same name written by Diego Brosset in 1935.

title: Lilja 4-ever
actors: Oksana Akinshina, Artiom Bogucharskij, Ljubov Agapova, Elina Benenson
description: Lilja is a restless teenager. Of Russian origin, the girl has to contend with the contradictions of Swedish society.

title: Johan Padan a la descoverta de le Americhe
description: Beginning of the 16th century. Johan Padan, a young man from Bergamo, escapes from a Lanzichenecchi military training camp. Johan is sweet and nice, but also selfish, smart and ready to do anything to survive. After a series of fantastic adventures and magical encounters, he finds himself in Seville where he embarks on a ship bound for the new world. Arriving in Florida, he immediately wins the trust of the natives: he teaches the Indians how to rebel against the violence of the Spanish soldiers and learns from them how to become a better man.
notes: The film is not entirely convincing, oscillating too much between the attempt to free oneself from historical hagiography on the discovery of America and a nineteenth-century reading of "the other", seen as Rousseau's "good savage".

title: My Name Is Tanino
actors: Corrado Fortuna, Rachel McAdams, Frank Crudele, Jessica De Marco, Mary Long
description: Tanino - born and raised in Castelluzzo del Golfo, in the province of Trapani - is a naïve, who is enthusiastic about everything. He loses his head for Sally, an American on vacation, and when she leaves, he dreams of joining her. He would like to change his life: he cannot take exams at the university and should go to the military. One day, however, a mysterious man offers him the opportunity to really leave: he has a plane ticket ready for him to Boston and some luggage to be delivered to some of his relatives who live there ...
notes: Virzì directs his fifth film with a very light, shrewd and only apparently distracted hand. He is the true heir, the son - attentive, funny, competent and respectful - of a cinematographic tradition that knows how to write dialogues, going down or up in tone and lexical complexity, in the space of a few seconds; can make you smile or laugh with a joke or situation; makes the staging transparent so that the characters fill the screen. There are some indecisions and fragilities and they could depend on the production vicissitudes of the film. The director seems to be sitting next to Tanino and, taking him by the hand, supports him in his post-deaf discovery of the transition from carefree, confused and disheveled youth to adult society.

title: Proximity
actors: Rob Lowe, James Coburn, Jonathan Banks, Kelly Rowan, Joe Santos
description: William Conroy is serving his sentence for manslaughter after causing a drunk car accident. Suddenly, however, he finds himself in a nightmare: a violent inmate tries to kill him during a transport; and when he manages to escape, he discovers that a peaceful association that should ensure that convicted murderers pay their debt to justice acts as a go-between with a killer agency, which gets paid by the victims' families to avenge the deaths of their loved ones. ...
notes: The plot evokes burning themes of the American news, but the staging is flat like that of a television film-dossier.

title: Naqoyqatsi
description: After _Koyaanisqatsi_ (1983) and _Powaqqatsi_ (1988), Reggio proposes this third series of cinemusical notes, produced by Steven Soderbergh and again accompanied by the hypnotic soundtrack of Philip Glass. Waves and syntagms of virtual reality, marching soldiers and smiling men, children and sheep, cloning and the internet, real geography and computer graphics, human beings and creatures modeled by bit and sim-worlds, meteor showers and new worlds, towers of Babel and buildings emptied by time and abandonment, athletic gestures and slowed-down images. The recipe is the same, but this time didacticism and easy moralisms are the masters.

title: 11'09''01 - September 11
directors: Youssef Chahine, Amos Gitai, Alejandro González Iñárritu, Shohei Imamura, Claude Lelouch, Ken Loach, Samira Makhmalbaf, Mira Nair, Idrissa Ouedraogo, Sean Penn, Danis Tanovic
actors: Ernest Borgnine, Dzana Pinjo, Taleb Adlah, Kumiro Aso, Akira Emoto, Jake Bern, George W. Bush, Nell Mooney, Anil Baral
description: A collective film of universal significance: eleven different points of view on the tragic events of 11 September 2001. The directors who have grappled with this tragedy are: Youssef Chahine, Amos Gitai, Shohei Imamura, Alejandro Gonzáles Iñárritu, Claude Lelouch, Ken Loach , Samira Makhmalbaf, Mira Nair, Idrissa Ouedraogo, Sean Penn and Danis Tanovic.
notes: Some of the small films are obvious: that of Makhmalbaf, which seems to be yet another, minimalist Iranian exercise with children; that of Lelouch, a little too simplistic; that of Chahine, didactic and far too narcissistic; that of Nair, which does not redeem its elementary apologue. Tanovic works to effect and manages to unleash the applause of the audience; Israeli Gitai does a nice piece of hysterical cinema in sequence shot, but it doesn't convince; the Mexican Iñárritu has a very intense but perhaps too rarefied idea in such an emotional context. The four best segments remain: Ouedraogo works with irony; Loach reminds us with angry memory, through the words and music of a Chilean exile in London, that there was another September 11 - also a Tuesday - in 1973: the day President Allende's palace was attacked; Penn with disenchantment and awareness, like a true American intellectual, signs the most radical piece, where an old loner (Ernest Borgnine) sees the light reappear and the myth's "garden" flourish again when the towers fall. Finally Imamura tells us how bad it is now to belong to the human race: the final, sacrosanct epigraph is hers: "Holy wars do not exist".

title: Clown in' Kabul
actors: Patch Adams, Gino Strada
description: The documentary follows the mission in favor of Afghan children that took place last February. A group of clown doctors departed from Pisa airport to Kabul with the aim of bringing peace, color and joy to places of suffering. Led by Dr. Hunter "Patch" Adams, 23 clown doctors from all over the world traveled through Afghanistan for about three weeks, visiting hospitals, schools, refugee camps and leprosy centers.

title: Ten Minutes Older: The Cello
directors: Bernardo Bertolucci, Claire Denis, Mike Figgis, Jean-Luc Godard, Jiri Menzel, Michael Radford, Volker Schlöndorff, István Szabó
actors: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Mark Long, Jean-Luc Nancy, Bibiana Beglau, Daniel Craig
description: Collective film made up of short films lasting ten minutes each. Bernardo Bertolucci was inspired by an Indian parable; Mike Figgis explores the past and the future through the present; Jirí Menzel studies the life of a movie star through the images of his main films; István Szabó tells the story of a woman whose life changes radically in ten minutes; Claire Denis resumes the conversation on the train between a philosopher and his pupil; Michael Radford tells of the aftermath of an interstellar journey on a pilot. The short films by Volker Schlöndorff and Jean-Luc Godard conclude the work.

title: Ripley's Game
actors: John Malkovich, Dougray Scott, Ray Winstone, Lena Headey, Chiara Caselli
description: Adventurer Tom Ripley convinces honest and quiet Jonathan Trevanny, a leukemia patient, to commit a murder for a large sum of money. However, the situation gets out of hand, and Jonathan finds himself embroiled in a spiral of violence and murder that leads to a war between rival gangs led by dangerous gangsters.
notes: Taking up Patricia Highsmith's novel a quarter of a century after Wenders' beautiful _The American Friend_, Cavani slips into the flat calm of the TV movie, despite Malkovich's mannerist repertoire of winks, tics and little voices. Photography by Alfio Contini, music by Ennio Morricone.

title: Frida
actors: Salma Hayek, Alfred Molina, Geoffrey Rush, Ashley Judd, Edward Norton, Antonio Banderas, Valeria Golino, Mia Maestro
description: The troubled life of the Mexican painter Frida Kahlo (1907-1954): the artistic success, the complex relationship with her husband (the mural painter Diego Rivera), the controversial relationship with Lev Trotsky, the provocative unions with numerous women, the precarious conditions of health, the many surgeries ...
notes: Detailed, meticulous in the evocation of Frida's paintings, much - too - spoken, the second work (after _Titus_) by the American theater director drags on quite painfully. Many dialogues are bordering on ridiculous, not to mention the appearance of Trotsky and his adventure with Frida: pure kitsch!

title: Dom durakov
actors: Julia Vysotskij, Eugenj Mironov, Sultan Islamov, Bryan Adams
description: Chechnya, 1996. Fragile Janna lives in a psychiatric hospital on the Russian border. When it turns out that all the staff have left the hospital, chaos breaks out among the patients who must learn to organize themselves without anyone's help. Some of them decide to leave, but the deafening noises of the first Chechen war block their way. In the course of the siege by a group of Chechen rebels, Janna is tied up with a soldier, Ahmed. The arrival of the Russians will wreak havoc and the war will spread to the hospital.
notes: Koncalovskij attempted the Chekhov-like apologue on the crumbling of his homeland: but Chekhov worked on subtraction, he only adds, of everything. Screams, shouts, boozy chatter and Bryan Adams songs.

title: L'homme du train
actors: Jean Rochefort, Johnny Hallyday, Edith Scob, Jean-François Stévenin
description: A stranger arrives in a small town in the Ardèche department in southern France. Over time, the stranger makes friends with a local: in reality the first is a bandit who is about to rob a bank, the second an elderly professor who has to undergo surgery. Day after day, their relationship becomes closer and closer ...
notes: Leconte and the writer and screenwriter Patrick Cauvin use a typical plot of the "polar" (a genre drama with psychologies in the wild) to create an exemplary story, a pretext for a passionate reflection on old age whose common assumption is reversed: not it is the season of life on which night falls, but the one that marks the dawn of a new day. Leconte signs his best work, choosing the risky path of an "experimental" (digital reversed) staging to make it even more evident that the only thing that matters is the soul, not the form. Behind every dialogue, a world; behind every "mask", a truth. But the film wouldn't be so good without its two leads. Jean Rochefort, the retired professor, plays on the register of (self) irony; Johnny Hallyday, rock star noir, on that of demystification ("You have read too many polar", he says to his friend). And it wouldn't be so nice if Leconte hadn't chosen to drop the rarefied context between echoes and reminiscences of old noir with Serge Reggiani and Lino Ventura or old westerns with Gary Cooper and Henry Fonda.

title: Genova senza risposte
directors: Federico Micali, Teresa Paoli, Stefano Lorenzi
description: The documentary by Federico Micali, Teresa Paoli and Stefano Lorenzi, the result of a laborious editing job, tries to chronologically follow the events that brought Genoa to its knees in the hot days of the G8. The film shows not only the clashes, but also the meetings, debates and people in the square.
notes: The issues that the film poses are clear-cut: the violence of the police, the free field left to the black bloc, the use of tear gas which are real chemical weapons (and whose effects will continue to unfold over time). Strange things, but seriously ordered. Maybe to reflect on how Genoa was also a revenge of information.

title: Aprimi il cuore
actors: Giada Colagrande, Natalie Cristiani, Claudio Botosso, Andrea Fogli
description: The prostitute Maria lives a morbid relationship with her younger sister Caterina: she is her mother, sister and lover and never lets her leave the house except to send her to dance school. Caterina returns Maria's love and accepts her "imprisonment" peacefully until she falls in love with Giovanni, the keeper of the dance school. When Maria discovers the relationship, she reacts in the worst way.
notes: A film that tries hard to film the immovable and that gives itself a pictorial form in the illusion of stopping, with the synthesis, the moments, love, and what can give birth to it. A passion that reveals, in every moment, its weaknesses and its energies.

title: Addio del passato
description: Bellocchio follows La Traviata step by step and at the same time tells us about Piacenza; the dialect assumes the same musical cadences as the arias; the protagonists and the sets follow one another and intertwine. There is Eleonora, a girl who has learned to sing the whole opera by ear, listening to the CDs; then Valeria Ferri who plays Violetta for the Amici della lirica, and Giovanna Beretta at Palazzo Anguissola, Elena Rossi at the Municipal Theater, Daniela Pilli who plays the "Toast" in a trattoria with the choristers. There is the voice of Callas who plays Goodbye from the past, and a photograph of her, on which she goes to squeeze the camera.

title: Last Stand at Saber River
actors: Tom Selleck, Suzy Amis, Haley Joel Osment, Rachel Duncan
description: Confederate Paul, who returned home at the end of the American Civil War, discovers that his lands have been occupied by rebel pioneers and sympathizers of the Unionist forces. He is forced to fight for the only thing worth fighting for: his family.
notes: The film is based on a novel by Elmore Leonard.

title: Requiem
actors: Patrick Dell'Isola, Moussa Maaskri, Jo Prestia, Marc Chapiteau, Jean-Louis Loca
description: Four life prisoners, Marcus, Poupousse, Gippé and Rafik, escape from a maximum security prison. Hunted by the police, for a series of circumstances they end up in a monastery, the only place where they are sure not to be intercepted. They soon become the nightmare of the monks taken hostage. But everything may not be as it seems ... maybe someone has been running the game from the start.

title: Frailty
actors: Blake King , Matthew  O'Leary, Powers Boothe, Matthew McConaughey, Bill Paxton
description: The state of Texas is experiencing a period of genuine terror due to the bloody deeds of a serial killer who calls himself "The Hand of God". One evening, a certain Fenton Meiks introduces himself to the FBI claiming to know the identity of the criminal: it would be his brother Adam, who is about to commit suicide. As the federal agents go to the "Rose Garden", Fenton tells them how it all began, more than twenty years ago ...
notes: A soundly ambiguous, complex film, susceptible to multiple interpretations, even contrasting ones, but always suggestive. Thanks to a script (by Brent Hanley) that is not perfect but layered, never rigid or one-sided.

title: Astérix & Obélix. Mission Cléopâtre
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Christian Clavier, Monica Bellucci, Claude Rich
description: Challenging the Roman emperor Julius Caesar, the queen of Egypt Cleopatra decides to build a sumptuous palace in the middle of the desert in just three months: in this way, Caesar will be forced to admit that the Egyptians are the largest people on Earth. To carry out the work, the sovereign calls Numerobis, an avant-garde architect who involves Panoramix, the druid friend of Asterix and Obelix: the three then set off on a journey to Egypt ...
notes: Funny enough, a sequel that denies the cliché that the "second chapters" are less fresh than the originals. And the cast does not make us regret the bulky Benigni of the prototype.

title: Paradise
actors: Willie Aames, Phoebe Cates, Tuvia Tavi, Richard Curnock, Aviva Marks
description: Mid-19th century: a fourteen-year-old Englishwoman finds herself alone in Baghdad. She is "adopted" by a slimy slave trader and murderer, but on the way to Damascus she runs into an American of the same age, with whom she will find, after overcoming several misadventures, the happiness of the spirit (and of the senses).
notes: In the wake of "Blue Lagoon" (1980), a film that follows all the themes, trying to repeat its success with the public. But everything is already seen and reviewed, the settings are from a tourist village and Phoebe Cates, with all due respect, is not worth a nail of the teenager Brooke Shields.

title: Dead in a Heartbeat
actors: Judge Reinhold, Penelope Ann Miller, Timothy Busfield, Fulvio Cecere
description: After the death of his son, Zachary accuses the doctor who was treating him. In a fit of madness, he begins to install microbombs inside the pacemakers intended for his patients. Discovered, he kills himself, but not before having ignited the last two bombs ...

title: Stuart Little 2
actors: Geena Davis, Hugh Laurie, Jonathan Lipnicki, Steve Zahn
description: Two years have passed since Stuart's arrival in the Little family: the little mouse has grown up, goes to school with his own car and builds model airplanes. He finds himself wonderfully with George and his little sister Martha, and also has a good relationship with Fiocco di Neve: in short, he is perfectly integrated into the family unit. But Stuart feels the need to have a friend: one day, returning home, he sees an injured bird fall from the sky and land on the seat next to his ...
notes: Accompanied by a splendid soundtrack, the film travels in a different direction from that of the first episode. Stuart has finally "grown up" and can fend for himself.

title: Encantado
actors: Linda Battista, Enrico Mutti, Kaspar Capparoni, Alberto Pujol
description: Havana. A police commissioner is investigating an airplane explosion near Cojimar where Nicola and his pilot are presumed to have died. His brother Andrea arrives in Cuba to try to find out the truth about his disappearance and discovers that it was not an accident. Someone killed his brother and the pilot is still alive.

title: Avenging Angelo
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Madeleine Stowe, Raoul Bova, Anthony Quinn
description: The life of Jennifer who lives in the good neighborhoods of Los Angeles is turned upside down when, one night, an injured stranger knocks on her door to tell her that she is not the daughter of a middle-class couple, but of the recently murdered famous mafia boss Angelo Alleghieri. The stranger is Frankie, Angelo's bodyguard, who now offers her his protection.
notes: The comedy, frankly insipid, shamelessly throws itself into the trend of the "mafia to laugh" (a la "Soprano"), but what remains are only the last moments of Anthony Quinn, who disappeared shortly after the end of filming (and to whom the film is dedicated).

title: Eight Legged Freaks
actors: David Arquette, Kari Wuhrer, Scott Terra, Scarlett Johansson
description: Small spiders contaminated with toxic products grow out of all proportion and soon spread terror in a small mining town. Resistance against eight-legged invaders is entrusted to engineer Chris McCormick and Sheriff Sam Parker.
notes: Suspended between tension and humor, the film rather than the classics of science fiction of yesteryear would like to recall the spirit, already cinephile itself, of the first Joe Dante. But without pretensions, without sociological imagination. The funniest part are the spiders chasing the motorcycles in the desert, like in a hybrid between various strands of the former B series.

title: A Walk to Remember
actors: Mandy Moore, Shane West, Peter Coyote, Daryl Hannah, Lauren German
description: Beaufort, North Carolina: Landon is a teenager from a good family, quite lively and restless. Her specialty is making terrible jokes: chance makes her hang out with Jamie, the pastor's daughter, a simple girl who volunteers in her spare time. Jamie is full of candor, introverted, in short, quite the opposite of Landon: but if it is true that opposite poles attract each other, the two are destined to be together ...
notes: At the first available corner, the film throws itself in the direction of sentiment and becomes a substitute for _Love Story_. The two protagonists hold up well, and prevent the story from becoming unbearably sweet.

title: Last Resort
actors: Dina Korzun, Paddy Considine, Artyom Strelnikov, Lindsey Honey
description: Tanya arrives in Gatwick from Russia with her ten-year-old son. At the airport she should find her boyfriend who instead has seen fit to unload her. Confused and desperate and above all without any knowledge she is forced to seek asylum. The girl and the child are transferred to a gray building near the sea where she will have to wait months before her practice is taken into consideration. To survive Tanya, who in the meantime has met Alfie who works in a carnival, agrees to pose for pornographic sites.
notes: The camera is often glued to the close-ups of the suffering faces of "losers", characters that smell of real life, for a sensitive and sincere television film that marks the debut in the feature film of the documentarian Pavlikovsky.

title: I due pezzi da 90
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Enzo Andronico, Franco Balducci
description: Franco and Ciccio, butchers in trouble with the taxman, must close their shop. The two are forced to accept the invitation of Nico, godfather of the first who, without their knowledge, turns them into drug couriers. A rival gang sets out on their trail.
notes: One of 11 films made by the comedy duo in 1971.

title: My Brother the Pig
actors: Scarlett Johansson, Nick Fuoco, Eva Mendes, Alex D. Linz
description: Husband and wife go on vacation, leaving their children, George and Kathy with a babysitter. Exasperated by George's behavior, she turns him into a pig. Start a trip to Mexico where there is the only person who can break the spell.
notes: We saw Johansson in "The Man Who Wasn't There".

title: Les suspects
actors: Mimsy Farmer, Michael Lonsdale, Bruno Cremer, Jacques Fabbri
description: Candice, an American who moved to the Côte d'Azur, is found lifeless on a road in the south of France. The investigations are entrusted to Commissioners Bonetti and Bretonnet. The main suspect is Matteo, a vagabond found near the body.
notes: Wyn directs a film that is a little too distracting.

title: Taking Off
actors: Lynn Carlin, Buck Henry, Linnea Heacock, Audra Lindley, Paul Benedict
description: Since their daughter Jeannie hasn't returned home yet, her parents Larry and Lynn ask their friends for help. The girl, who has voluntarily returned home after attending a hippie gathering, leaves still exasperated by her parents' interrogations. At this point Larry and Lynn turn to the Runaway Parents Society whose members induce them to smoke marijuana to better understand the mentality of the hippie youth. Not happy they organize strip poker at their home.
notes: Milos Forman, here in his first American film, offers a merciless and biting portrait of American society grappling with youth protest.

title: About a Boy
actors: Hugh Grant, Nicholas Hoult, Rachel Weisz, Toni Collette, Victoria Smurfit, Sharon Small, Madison Cook
description: 38-year-old Will is rich, single, and used to dating a different girl every night. Realizing that it is easier to approach women - single or divorced - with children, he pretends to be a boy-father and joins a club for single parents. Here he makes friends with Marcus, a difficult and lonely 12-year-old who will open his eyes to a different reality ...
notes: The Weitz brothers' film, based on the novel _A Boy_ by Nick Hornby, belongs above all to Hugh Grant: an actor who seems to be born for the part of Will, much more suited to this single wrinkled and minimalist at heart than to _Notting Hill_ bookseller. .

title: A Time for Dancing
actors: Larysa Oleynik, Shiri Appleby, Peter Coyote, Patricia Kalember, Amy Madigan
description: Sam, the only child of a single mother, has a rather gloomy outlook on life: despite being an excellent dancer, she is forced to work in a fast food restaurant after school to get by. Jules, on the other hand, is a girl full of life whose only desire is to finish high school to enroll in Julliard and study dance. The two have been best friends since they were six. But their relationship falls apart when Jules begins to devote all of her time preparing for the audition and is diagnosed with a bad illness.
notes: If the film pushed on some pedal (mélo, comedy, dementia, drama) it could also be swallowed. But it is so tasteless that it seems washed in starch.

title: Exposure
actors: Ron Silver, Alexandra Paul, Susan Pari, Paul Gittins, Elizabeth Hawthorne
description: Former war correspondent Gary is the acclaimed photographer for a men's-only magazine. He is first suspected of the murder of Elaine, one of his models, then becomes the target of a serial killer.
notes: Barely passable thriller starring Alexandra Paul, the Stephanie Holden of "Baywatch".

title: The Miracle on the Mountain: Kincaid Family Story
actors: William Devane, Patty Duke, Elisabeth Rosen, Kaj-Erik Eriksen
description: Tom and Anne Kincaid are traveling with their children, Carla, Rick and Susan, to their cabin in the mountains to celebrate their wedding anniversary. Of the two parents, Tom is the one with the so-called iron wrist, while the mother tries to mediate her husband's rigidity in the relationship with her children. Tom, used to commanding at home and at work, is forced to ask his wife and his three children for help when the small plane they are flying on is forced to make a crash landing on a snowy clearing and he is the only one to get seriously injured.

title: Le diable au corps
actors: Gérard Philipe, Micheline Presle, Jean Debucourt, Jacques Tati
description: WWI. While her husband is fighting at the front, Marthe, a nurse in a military hospital, meets and falls in love with François a much younger student than her. The two, defying all social conventions, become lovers. Their only concern is to be happy and to live their passion freely. Then one day Marthe realizes she is expecting a baby.
notes: Already at the release of Raymond Radiguet's novel of the same name in 1923, controversy raged. Controversies that also accompanied the release of the film. The story is told all in flashback. The Presle / Philipe couple is memorable. Very small role for Jacques Tati.

title: Return to Never Land
description: The world is always that of the Lost Children, of which the green elf with wings is still the undisputed leader. But complicating matters is Captain Hook, who kidnaps Jane, Wendy's 12-year-old daughter, and takes her hostage taking her to Neverland ... needless to say who will run to her rescue ...

title: Beatrice Cenci
actors: Gino Cervi, Micheline Presle, Fausto Tozzi, Frank Villard
description: The noble Cenci family is dominated by the figure of their father Francesco, feared and respected for his cruelty. He hunts from the castle Olimpo, the lover of his daughter Beatrice, while the son, Giacomo, has an affair with his stepmother. Discovering the affair, Francesco tries to kill Giacomo, fails and ends up being killed himself. In Rome they want a culprit, even if there is no evidence. The stepmother Lucrezia, Giacomo, Beatrice, Olimpo: who will be executed?
notes: A film with impeccable historical rigor, a melodrama with forbidden loves, murders in the shadows and a magnificently tragic destiny.

title: Gargantua
actors: Adam Baldwin, Emile Hirsch, Julie Carmen, Bobby Hosea, Doug Penty
description: Jack Ellway, a marine biologist, leaves with his son Brandon for the Pacific island of Malau. Here he will have to study the effects of an earthquake on the different forms of life in that area. A series of drowning misterises occur during his research, and when Brandon encounters an extraordinarily large baby amphibian of an unknown species, it is clear that there is a new species of marine "giants". When their presence becomes numerically important, the army is on time with its "strategists". Their plan? A nice seafood salad ...

title: The Search for One-eye Jimmy
actors: Holt McCallany, Michael Badalucco, Steve Buscemi, Anne Meara
description: After graduating, Les makes his first documentary investigating the disappearance of a boy from his neighborhood. In front of his camera pass the FBI, members of the Church, representatives of the underworld ...
notes: The starting point is interesting, the staging less successful, which never fully convinces.

title: Bad Company
actors: Anthony Hopkins, Chris Rock, Matthew Marsh, Kerry Washington
description: The two CIA agents, Oakes and Kevin, are on a mission to Prague to prevent a nuclear device from falling into the wrong hands. When the second, fundamental "contact" with a Russian arms dealer, is killed, the first has to "recruit" Jake, the boastful and rowdy twin.
notes: The product has a very short breath, just for a sprint: at the first corner it goes limp, boring and copying. And the two lines, two and a single comic situation, written on the clone Chris Rock will certainly not be enough to justify even a vision. Produced by Jerry Bruckheimer.

title: Cuore napoletano
actors: Jimmy Roselli, Jerry Vale, Rita Berti, John Gentile, Peppe Barra, Mirna Doris
description: Paolo Santoni made a trip to some states of the USA and to Naples and its surroundings to look for significant traces of the classic Neapolitan song. The director tries to understand if the feelings that inspired her are still present in the hearts of the Neapolitans. Vintage images revive characters like Jimmy Roselli, Rita Berti. Next to them are called into question Peppe Barra, Mirna Doris, Tony Esposito and Enzo Gragnaniello. There are heart, sun and love, but Paolo Santoni keeps away from stereotypes. There are pizzas and mandolins, but the cut is anthropological, not folkloric.

title: L'imbalsamatore
actors: Ernesto Mahieux, Valerio Foglia Manzillo, Elisabetta Rocchetti
description: Peppino is of very small stature and is a taxidermist in a locality on the coast of Caserta.
