When he meets the young Valerio, he does everything to take him to work with him, forming an increasingly ambiguous relationship with him. The balance between the two is broken by Deborah, a girl fired from a mechanical workshop ...
notes: For this film, more than Lynch, Fassbinder and his ambiguous pains come back to mind. Those pains, those discards, that obvious misunderstanding that prevent the three protagonists - a sort of castaways in search of a love that can justify their evil of living - from interacting and relating if not in a violent way.

title: Sin noticias de Dios
actors: Penélope Cruz, Victoria Abril, Demián Bichir, Fanny Ardant
description: The executives of Heaven are very worried because the souls who have managed to pass the exams are very few. But when the latter, depressed and afflicted, have lost all hope, an unexpected prayer comes: a woman asks them to save the soul of her son, a boxer with a turbulent past. The high celestial spheres send one of the best angels to Earth, Lola Nevado: to counter her, evil Carmen swoops from Hell ...
notes: The assumption and the narrative development lack "coherence of the absurd": a certain confusion prevails, and there is more insistence than necessary on the coming and going from this world to the post-mortem one.

title: Callas Forever
actors: Fanny Ardant, Jeremy Irons, Joan Plowright, Angela Molina, Jean Dalric
description: Maria Callas receives a visit from Larry Kelly, an impresario who has organized her tours in the past. The man wants to convince the diva, who seems to have lost her legendary voice, to return to the stage. She accepts at first, then thinks about it ...
notes: Zeffirelli "knew it well", but this does not simplify the attempt to tell an idea of ??the opera, a legend that - according to a usual existential schedule - wants to disappear from the world. There are some side characters placed there as filler, many of the dialogues are clumsy and the mother scenes - used as "romances" - rather than thrilling they are uncomfortable. A _Fedora_ with playback.

title: La felicità non costa niente
actors: Mimmo Calopresti, Francesca Neri, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Vincent Perez
description: To upset the life of Sergio, a married architect, with a lover and many friends, is a car accident. It is the trigger that makes him question his life. Sergio abandons all his certainties and embarks on a lonely wandering in which he meets Sara. A deceptive and fleeting encounter that will leave him alone again. At this point it will be Gianni, an old employee of his, to guide him towards the conquest of happiness.
notes: The film has the rare merit of staging the crisis of a man intolerant of hypocrisy and consumerism, closed in the darkness of a journey into vertigo and then re-projected into the dream of an existence that has that "Wonderful World" at its center. ska, surrounded by child men who do not yet know what a wonderful world is and who therefore manifest themselves for what they are: involuntarily pure.

title: I due della Formula 1 alla corsa più pazza...
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Marisa Traversi, Umberto D'Orsi
description: The builder Ambrogio Barillà is on the verge of suicide because the pilot Pepito has been kidnapped. To help him intervene Franco perfect double of the runner and his partner Ciccio. It is the latter who proposes to Barillà to use Franco in the Monza Grand Prix.
notes: Frayed script and few laughs.

title: La Mandarine
actors: Philippe Noiret, Annie Girardot, Madeleine Renaud, Jean-Claude Dauphin, Marie-Hélène Breillat, Murray Head
description: Séverine and Georges, happily married, run a luxury hotel with an ancient tradition on the rue de Rivoli, in the heart of Paris. It is owned by mémé Boulle, an old lady who had adopted orphaned triplets - Séverine herself, her brother Alain and her sister Baba - and then educated them to an unconventional vision of life. To upset the tranquility of the hotel comes Tony, a young rich and somewhat hippy English writer met by Alain and Baba during one of their travels ...
notes: The director of "Il rompiballe" and of the two "Vizietti" directs a group of high-class performers in a story with acidulous tones.

title: Era di venerdì 17
actors: Fernandel, Giulia Rubini, Alberto Sordi, Tina Pica, Leda Gloria
description: Paolo, a middle-aged traveling salesman, during one of his trips meets Maria, a sad and worried girl. Intrigued, the man asks her the reason for so much despair. Maria is returning home to her parents after living in the city for some time. Abandoned by her boyfriend and moreover pregnant she does not have the courage to introduce herself to her parents. So she asks Paolo to accompany her home and pretend to be her husband.
notes: Sort of remake, to tell the truth not very successful, of "Four steps in the clouds". In place of Gino Cervi, Fernandel, in place of Adriana Benetti, Giulia Rubini. At the time, the proceeds were also scarce.

title: Le ragazze di Miss Italia
actors: Gabriele Ferzetti, Christiane Filangeri, Simona Marchini, Nadia Bengala, Gianfranco D'Angelo
description: While he is spending a holiday at the luxurious Grand Hotel Terme, a professor over seventy is witnessing the vicissitudes that animate the hectic days of the two hundred aspirants to the title of queen: the make-up, acting, dance and catwalk tests alternate with friendships and sympathies, envies and jealousies, anxieties, dreams, illusions, loves that break, families in crisis, spite, recommendations ... Little by little, the elderly teacher becomes a sort of confidant of the participants; but in addition to the guests in the hotel there is also Rosa, the owner, and it will be with her that the fateful spark will strike.

title: Basta con la guerra... facciamo l'amore
actors: Jacques Dufilho, Dagmar Lassander, Vincenzo Cudia, Dada Gallotti, Mario Brega, Lucio Flauto
description: The seminarian Francesco is on vacation with his uncle, Colonel Gustavo. The latter, convinced that the rigid religious education has traumatized his young nephew, sets out to awaken his sexual appetites by using the graces of the maid and his wife ...
notes: Modest soft-core for the future Buttiglione.

title: Divorzio alla siciliana
actors: Tiberio Murgia, Nino Terzo, Moira Orfei, Gina Rovere, Paolo Carlini, Johnny Dorelli
description: The Sicilian baronet Fifì is devoured by the worm of jealousy. Helped by the mafia, he has the two wives killed who have shown that they prefer other men. Fifì goes to look for his third wife in Rome and finds her in a dancer who solves the situation to her own advantage.
notes: Ramshackle parody of Germi's film.

title: The Brotherhood
actors: Josh Hammond, Nathan Watkins, Bradley Stryker, Elizabeth Bruderman
description: Dan and Chris, freshmen and roommates at a small California college, make friends. The idea of ??joining one of the university brotherhoods does not appeal to them very much: especially when it comes to the "Doma", a group of rather sinister-looking young men led by the bloodless Devin. But then the beautiful Megan invites them to a party and ...

title: Armored Car Robbery
actors: William Talman, Charles McGraw, Adele Jergens, Don McGuire
description: Dave Purvis, known in the underworld as an expert robbery "planner", boasts that he has always gotten away with it. But the day comes when a shot, which he has perfected in the smallest details, fails: a policeman and two of Purvis's three accomplices lose their lives. Lieutenant Jim Cordell, a friend of the slain agent, pursues the survivors, while Purvis hides carrying the loot: his escape project seems to work, but has some small flaws ...
notes: The prolific and eclectic filmmaker of _Le iene di Chicago_, _Frenesia del delitto_ and _Viaggio hallucinante_ orchestrates this noir example, tense, effective and concise.

title: Silicon Towers
actors: Jonathan Quint, Brian Dennehy, Daniel Baldwin, Robert Guillaume, Brad Dourif
description: One day Charlie Cook, recently promoted to executive level in the corporation where he works, Silicon Towers, receives an anonymous e-mail that terrifies him: the letter reveals that the company is involved in highly illegal maneuvers concerning cyber espionage against some banks. This would have been possible thanks to a new generation secret chip, developed and installed by Silicon itself: for Charlie the worst promises, since the top management of the company - realizing the danger it represents - entrusts the internal "security" with delete it.
notes: The story is routine, but the cast holds its own.

title: No quarto da Vanda
actors: Vanda Duarte
description: Three years later, Costa returns to stalk the life of the young drug addict who was already the protagonist of "Ossos", while on the off-screen the African ghetto of Lisbon is demolished and "reclaimed" by the authorities.
notes: Over twelve months of shooting within four walls for a fluvial and radical film experience of almost unbearable intensity.

title: Borderline
actors: Michel Rocher, Urbano Barberini, Barbara Lutzemberg, Sara Melissa Forti
description: Gabriel, a director by profession, is looking for the stardom he never achieved. The frustrations he is forced to undergo make him psychologically unstable. A terrible secret will upset Gabriel's life when his daughter Giulia, who has been living in Paris with her mother for some time, reappears.

title: I cadetti di Guascogna
actors: Walter Chiari, Ugo Tognazzi, Fulvia Mammi, Carlo Croccolo, Mario Riva, Riccardo Billi
description: Walter and Ugo have a weakness for the beautiful Vittoria, but their father doesn't want to know either of them and sends the girl to Bracciano, to visit an aunt. It happens, however, that both suitors receive the postcard-precept that destined them right on the shores of the Lazio lake: met Vittoria, they agree to go to the cinema together, but neither of them can show up for the appointment because it was delivered to the barracks. They therefore send Nino, a fellow soldier, with whom Vittoria falls in love: misunderstandings (and a variety show) in sight ...
notes: Typical vehicle for the comic skills of the protagonists. Tognazzi's film debut.

title: Moderato cantabile
actors: Jeanne Moreau, Jean-Paul Belmondo, Pascale De Boysson, Didier Haudepin
description: Anne, wife of an industrialist, is oppressed by the boredom that invades her comfortable existence. One day, while he is waiting for his son to finish his music lesson, he hears a woman scream coming from a nearby bistro. Curiosity leads Anne to return to the neighborhood: here she meets one of her husband's employees, also a witness to the crime, and while conversing with him she feels a feeling arise within her ...
notes: Second film by Brook, an illustrious theater director, based on the novel of the same name by Marguerite Duras and scripted by the French writer herself, who fully instills her own intimate atmospheres bordering on rarefaction.

title: Gunfighter
actors: Robert Carradine, Martin Sheen, Will Hutchins, Chris Lybbert, Louis Schwiebert
description: The down-and-out singer known as "Kid" enters an apparently abandoned saloon at night, where he meets a mysterious character who calls himself "the Stranger". Intrigued by the latter's unusual black leather gloves, the Kid asks to know more: thus begins the story of Hopalong Cassidy, one of the fastest guns in the West, and his arch rival, the shadowy and black-clad Tex. .
notes: The surname is one of the important ones: Chris is in fact descended from one of the noblest Hollywood lineages, grandson of Francis Ford and brother of Nicolas Cage. Here he retraces Leonian traces, with not exactly memorable results.

title: Rupan sansei. Babiron no ogon densetsu
description: For centuries and centuries the subsoil of today's Manhattan has kept some mysterious tablets in which the enigma of the fabulous golden tower of the Babylonian treasure is contained. Lupine III tries to recover them, but Interpol inspector Zenigata does not give him respite; and the Polish mafia is also involved ...
notes: For fans of Japanese "souls".

title: Incognito
actors: Jason Patric, Irène Jacob, Rod Steiger, Ian Richardson, Paul Brennen
description: New York: the notorious forger Harry Donovan agrees to reproduce a Rembrandt worth half a million dollars on behalf of some British merchants. Having left for Europe, Harry first goes to Paris, where he meets the student Marieke and has a fleeting relationship with her; then, having reached Amsterdam, he rents an attic and gets to work. Once the work is finished, however, he discovers that his clients will not pay him until they are sure they have passed the examination of the experts: and it is at this point that the beautiful Marieke re-enters the scene ...
notes: Unresolved, at times even irritating. Of suspense, of course, not even talking about it.

title: The Scooby-Doo Project
directors: Chris 'Casper' Kelly, Larry Morris, Steve Patrick
description: Scooby-Doo, Scrappy and their friends Shaggy, Daphne, Fred and Velma arrive in a forest where completely inexplicable events have recently occurred. They will have to deal with none other than an evil witch ...
notes: Parody of "Blair Witch Project", originally broadcast in installments.

title: Le petit Poucet
actors: Catherine Deneuve, Romane Bohringer, Nils Hugon, Pierre Berriau, Dominique Hulin
description: War broke out in the town where Tom Thumb lives with his family. His parents abandon him with his brothers in a forest. It will not be easy for them to find their way home also because the little ones are forced to suffer from hunger, to fight ravenous wolves and to escape from the Orc devouring children. Tom Thumb will resort to a ruse to help him and his brothers find a way out of the pitfalls of the woods.
notes: Apart from small variations, Dahan faithfully follows Perrault's text, enriching it with a scenography and a photography of great impact. The film cannot be said to be unsuccessful, but it is too wavering between fairytale and horror.

title: Juana la loca
actors: Pilar López de Ayala, Eloy Azorín, Daniele Liotti, Manuela Arcuri
description: Second half of 1400. Joan of Castile, daughter of Catholic kings, is destined to marry Philip of Habsburg, son of Maximilian of Austria. On the death of her parents, Giovanna inherits the crown of Spain and becomes queen of Castile. Her greatest desire is to become a good wife and a good mother, but the worm of jealousy takes hold of her and drives her to madness. She soon becomes a victim of her husband's ambitions, who has always been unfaithful to her, and of political conspiracies.
notes: The only noteworthy interpretation is that of Pilar López de Ayala. The Italian actors are ready for the parodies of the costume classics of the television varieties.

title: Nemmeno in un sogno
actors: Ahmet Ugurlu, Roberto De Francesco, Giuseppe Battiston, Martina Stella
description: Pursuing the dream of settling in Italy (the country of Bengodi, at least according to what the TV says), the pastor Ahmet picks up all his things and leaves the plateau of the remote Asian region where he lives. After having landed on the Apulian coast and having received a mysterious suitcase from the smugglers, Ahmet lives his first day in our country. Ahmet's wisdom conquers blonde Vale, but two thugs ...
notes: The film starts off quite well and seems to have an interesting ironic potential, but some errors in the distribution of the roles and the weak articulation of the script make Gianluca Greco's first work weak.

title: O
actors: Martin Sheen, Julia Stiles, Josh Hartnett, Mekhi Phifer, Rain Phoenix
description: The black boy Odin, an excellent basketball player, managed in a short time to attract the sympathies of all his university friends. He got into the good graces of his coach and won the heart of Desi, a wealthy student of the white bourgeoisie. Everything proceeds in the best way, until one day Hugo, the son of the coach, appears on the scene. Jealousy takes possession of Odin also because Desi has changed his attitude towards him.
notes: That the director doesn't know how to shoot can be seen right from the basketball game. Julia Stiles manages not to be sexy even dressed as a college girl.

title: Wild Seed
actors: Michael Parks, Celia Kaye, Ross Elliott, Woody Chambliss
description: After learning (by reading some letters kept by her mother) that her biological father had had to separate from her before she was born, 17-year-old Daffy runs away from home and heads to Los Angeles from the east coast, where she will finally be able to meet her parent. Accompanying and protecting the girl on the streets of America is Fargo, a free spirit she met while traveling.
notes: Hutton ("Where Eagles Dare") begins with a delicate and intimate "on the road", well written and well acted. Remarkable sensitivity for outdoors and landscapes, photographed in dazzling black and white by a master like Conrad Hall.

title: Facing the Enemy
actors: Linden Ashby, Alexandra Paul, Cynthia Preston, Maxwell Caulfield
description: A year after the tragic death of his son, relations between agent Griff McCleary and his wife Olivia have come to an end. Griff begins to deal with a case that has the appearance of murder-suicide: his investigations lead him to rule out the second hypothesis and to run into the fragile and vulnerable Nikki. A relationship is established between the two, but as soon as the girl discovers Griff's profession and purposes, her nerves jump and push her to take her own life. Griff is suspended by the police, but ignores that Harlan, Nikki's lover, plans to retaliate against Olivia ...
notes: Complicated yellow approach with a psychological background.

title: La prova generale
actors: Lou Castel, Frank Wolff, Maria Monti, Leopoldo Trieste, Carlo Cecchi
description: Two years later _A mosca cieca_, in which he re-elaborated some ideas taken from Camus's _The stranger_ in a modernly jagged style, Scavolini ventured into this collective and "untold" film, in which life and acting - as the title suggests - intertwine and blend seamlessly.

title: Trapianto, consunzione e morte di Franco Brocani
actors: Franco Brocani
description: Using it as an ideal complement to his pictorial and plastic researches, Schifano - an essential figure of Italian twentieth century art - has also left his own personal imprint in the film field. This "domestic" film, dedicated to an "absolute outsider who lived cinema as an illness", is an essay.

title: Rupan sansei - Fûma ichizoku no inbô
description: The criminal organization headed by the Fuma family kidnaps Murasaki, Goemon's betrothed. The bandits intend to blackmail the girl's family to get to a key that can open the doors of a golden temple. Lupine III intervenes.
notes: Official film of the first animated series.

title: Scooby-Doo and the Alien Invaders
description: Arriving in a deserted city, Scooby-Doo and his friends Shaggy, Daphne, Fred and Velma are dragged aboard an alien spaceship. Our friends will have to try to save themselves and at the same time solve the mystery of the extraterrestrial presence on our planet. It won't be an easy task ...

title: Joseph: King of Dreams
description: Giuseppe, the last child of a large family, knows how to predict the future by interpreting dreams. The parents decide to send him to school, but the jealous brothers simulate his disappearance to sell him as a slave. He will land at the court of the pharaoh, will enter into his good graces.
notes: DreamWorks produces.

title: Kissing a Fool
actors: David Schwimmer, Jason Lee, Mili Avital, Bonnie Hunt, Vanessa Angel
description: Max, a popular sports commentator on a local TV, is about to marry the beautiful Samantha, known as Sam: the girl was introduced to him only two weeks ago by his friend Jay, who for years has been in shock at being abandoned by his girlfriend Natasha. Shortly before the big step, however, doubts assail Max and lead him to propose to Jay to seduce his future wife: in case of failure, Max will know that the trust in Sam is well placed, otherwise ...
notes: Pink comedy for Schwimmer (also executive producer), the Ross of _Friends_. In the role of Sam is Israeli Avital, formerly in Jarmusch's _Dead Man_ and Wenders's _Invisible Crimes_.

title: Heaven or Vegas
actors: Yasmine Bleeth, Richard Grieco, Andy Romano, Monica Potter
description: A part-time telephonist in the "gaming capital," Rachel falls in love with Navy, a kind of high-profile gigolo bent on rebuilding a life in Montana. The two leave together, but along the way they have the unfortunate idea of ??making a stop at the house that Rachel had abandoned six years ago: here Navy takes a crush on Lilli, the attractive and "virginal" half-sister of the former call girl. When the latter, having discovered the situation, runs away with a broken heart, the too enterprising Navy does not take long to understand that she is the right girl and rushes in search of her ...
notes: Bleeth was one of the "Baywatch" lifeguards.

title: La vita come viene
actors: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Lorenza Indovina, Alessandro Haber, Stefania Rocca, Stefania Sandrelli
description: A dentist who spends his weekends participating in simulated fights provokes his partner's reaction. Exasperated, the woman slips a real gun into her bag. To cover gambling debts, two elderly people improvise as child kidnappers. A librarian finds the courage to confess her love to the mother of the kidnapped children. A professor charms his students by discussing what is important in life, but then he finds no one to spend his birthday with.
notes: A work that should have unmasked the hypocrisies and that instead fails to shake off the wax of "déjà vu".

title: Laissez-passer
actors: Marie Gillain, Charlotte Kady, Jacques Gamblin, Denis Podalydès
description: Paris, spring 1942. Jean Devaivre, assistant director, hides his clandestine activities in favor of the Resistance by working for Continental, a German production company directed by Dr. Greven which has been producing French films since 1940. Jean Aurenche, a poet screenwriter, refuses to work for the Germans, on the contrary he engages in a heroic struggle against the Nazi invader.
notes: The film does not want to be a declaimed historical pamphlet but a choral fresco that finds its strength in cinema (as a language). Tavernier mixes drama and comedy and makes us participate in the adventure of those who fought (and struggled) for the supreme good. Life, and nothing else.

title: Tmavomodry svet
country: Czech Republic, Great Britain, Germany, Denmark, Italy
actors: Charles Dance, Tara Fitzgerald, Ondrej Vetchy, Krystof Hádek, Oldrich Kaiser
description: 1950, Czechoslovakia, communist regime. Frantisek, a fighter pilot, is locked up in a labor camp, accused of being an enemy of the people: in 1939, under the Nazi occupation, he fled with Karel, his young friend, also a pilot, they reached England and they enlisted in the Royal Air Force. They waged war together, fell in love with the same woman, and their friendship was on the verge of breaking up.
notes: Adventures in the skies and in the hearts, chivalrous challenges and heroic deaths. Above all, the patina of a distant time and of a romantic cinema like no more.

title: Le Grand Bleu
actors: Paul Shenar, Jean Bouise, Rosanna Arquette, Jean Reno, Jean-Marc Barr
description: Jacques and Enzo spent their childhood diving in the Mediterranean. The death of Jacques' father, an expert diver, ends their friendship. Years pass: Jacques, following an expedition to Peru, agrees to immerse himself in the waters of a frozen lake to allow scientists to collect data on his physical condition; for his part, Enzo has become a champion of freediving. Soon the paths of the two will cross again ...
notes: With the inevitable "grandeur" that distinguishes him, the future director of _Nikita_ and _Léon_ tells of a clash - the one between Mayol and Mallorca - that made history.

title: Monsieur Batignole
actors: Alexia Portal, Gérard Jugnot, Jules Sitruk, Michèle Garcia, Jean-Paul Rouve
description: We are in Paris in 1942, France is occupied by Nazi troops. The rotisserie and butcher Edmond Batignole tries to survive like all other citizens. He could, if he wanted to, get caught up in cowardice and collaborate with the Germans, as do a good part of the people around him. Instead he chooses to fight to save the life of Simon, a Jewish boy.
notes: In the film there are predictable misunderstandings and real moments of suspense, up to the rhetorical highlight in which Batignole makes a tirade declaring himself a Jew. Excellent packaging, actors of impeccable joviality. But the film is absolute and schematic.

title: À la folie... pas du tout
actors: Sophie Guillemin, Isabelle Carré, Samuel Le Bihan, Audrey Tautou, Clément Sibony
description: Angelica, a student at the academy of fine arts, to earn some money works as a bartender in a club. Met by chance Loïc, an appreciated cardiologist, he falls in love with her. She doesn't care much that the man is married and that his wife is expecting a baby. Angelica storms him with messages and sends him gifts that make him nervous. The girl continues to imagine a happy life with him.
notes: The film accentuates the paranoid side of "Amélie". If so many references come to mind, it is no coincidence: Laetitia Colombani is good, but like a diligent schoolgirl. And his film has a sinister aftertaste: in the time of the Muccinos and Jeunets, amor fou no longer has anything anarchic about it, and appears as a pathology.

title: La bande à Bonnot
actors: Bruno Cremer, Jacques Brel, Annie Girardot, Anne Wiazemsky
description: 1911: Paris is turned upside down by a handful of anarchists led by Jules Bonnot, who leads them in a series of car robberies. But the fate of Bonnot and his people (including his partner Maria-la-Belge, the poet Octave Garnier and the "philosopher" Raymond-la-Science) will be tragic.
notes: The newcomer Fourastié - who had made his bones as an assistant to Godard (_Pierrot le fou_), Chabrol (Marie Chantal against Dr. Kha_) and Rivette (_Susanna Simonin, the nun_) - restores well the restless atmospheres of the time and effectively directs an excellent cast, in which the Belgian chansonnier Jacques Brel also makes a great impression.

title: Greenwich Village
actors: Carmen Miranda, Don Ameche, William Bendix, Viviane Blaine
description: New York, 1922: Kenneth Harvey, a young composer who came from Kansas in search of his fortune, associates with Danny O'Mara, the owner of a club he wants to put on a Broadway show, and falls in love with singer Bonnie Watson. But then O'Mara makes it dirty, and Ken ...
notes: Go-go music and songs.

title: Il capitano nero
actors: Steve Barclay, Marina Berti, Mario Ferrari, Marisa Merlini
description: XVI century: Giuliano raped Luisa, with whom he pretended to be in love. The woman's brothers swear to clean up the offense but the rapist kills them, certain of enjoying impunity thanks to the support of the Duke of Corvara. The only survivor is Marco, who is pondering revenge ...
notes: Adventures with a historical background, as modest as ever.

title: U.S. Seals II
actors: Michael Worth, Damian Chapa, Kate Connor, Karen Kim
description: In addition to being close friends, Casey Sheppard and Frank Ratliff both serve in the famous Navy Seals corps. Their disposition, however, is very different: if Sheppard is loyal and disciplined, the same cannot be said for Ratliff, who after a dramatic accident disappears to re-emerge years later in the pay of international terrorism ...

title: In His Life: The John Lennon Story
actors: Philip McQuillan, Daniel McGowan, Mark Rice-Oxley, Christine Kavanagh, Blair Brown
description: Liverpool, 1950s: intolerant of the educational methods in vogue in British schools, the young John Lennon cultivates his passion for the incipient rock 'n' roll phenomenon by forming a series of bands; one of which, assuming the name of Beatles, attracts the attention of the far-sighted manager Brian Epstein ...

title: The Beach Boys: An American Family
actors: Kevin Dunn, Fred Weller, Ryan Northcott, Nick Stabile, Alley Mills
description: 1960: the brothers Brian, Dennis and Carl Wilson, sons of the well-known musician Murry, together with two cousins ??form the musical group of the Beach Boys. Success comes soon, accompanied, however, by the stressful rhythms of frequent tours: Brian is affected above all, who leaves the band and ends up falling into the drug tunnel ...

title: Le départ
actors: Jean-Pierre Léaud, Catherine Duport, Jacqueline Bir, Paul Roland
description: Marc, an aspiring hairdresser crazy for speed, tries them all to be able to drive a racing car: the night before the race, however, the beautiful Michèle will make him understand that love also exists.
notes: After her debut in Poland, Skolimowski shoots one of her most inspired works in Belgium, happily infected by the need for freedom that shook the cinema of the time. A frenetic and irrepressible Léaud goes wild in a funny and bittersweet parable about the "fear of growing up", punctuated by the memorable notes of the great (and prematurely deceased) Krzysztof Komeda. The film was released in Italy under the horrendous title "The Virgin".

title: O rio do ouro
actors: Isabel Ruth, Lima Duarte, Joana Bárcia, João Cardoso
description: The elderly António, master of a draga, marries the peer Carolina, custodian of a level crossing. The woman has a nephew, Mélita, to which Over time António attacks herself more and more, while Carolina becomes the lover of the gypsy Zé Dos Ouros ...
notes: A magical and visionary story from the most "Japanese" of the Lusitan directors.

title: Lautary
actors: Sergej Lunkevic, Dimitrij Chebeschesku, Olga Kympianu, Dimitrij Mocanu
description: When the tsars reigned in Russia, Moldavia was still called Bessarabia: it is among those lands that Toma Alistar, a nomadic violinist, spends his life desperately looking for the beloved Lyanka, destined by the family for a wedding of interest.
notes: Almost a ballad, narrated by Lotjanu with the timeless tones of the fable.

title: Tabor ukhodit v nebo
actors: Svetlana Toma, Grigore Grigoriu, Pavel Andrejchenko, Sergiu Finiti
description: At the beginning of the twentieth century, in a Europe not yet devastated by the First World War, the border area between the Austro-Hungarian Empire and the Tsarist one is the theater of the tragic history of the beautiful Rada and its lover Zobar.
notes: A romantic and libertarian film, which challenged the censorship of regime in the gray Breznevian years.

title: Una casa sotto il cielo
actors: Gino Lavagetto, William Bradford Borden, Fausto Siddi, Emanuela Cau
description: 1950s: in search of ideas for a book, the American writer Eugene Carter meets a certain Gaetano Piras, who three decades earlier - still a child - had followed his father and his flocks to the Nuorese mountains. His parent then sold him to Count Casula as a "shepherd servant" ...
notes: Rugged and severe like the Sardinian landscape.

title: The Boy Who Cried Werewolf
actors: Susan Foster, Jack Lucas, Kerwin Mathews, Elaine Devry
description: The little Richie, whose parents are divorced, spends a weekend in his father's mountain refuge. When the latter suffers the attack of a strange "creature" in which Richie recognizes a werewolf, the child is convinced that his dad also turned into a monster ...
notes: Variation on one of the classic horror themes.

title: The Dangerous Lives of Altar Boys
actors: Jena Malone, Vincent D'Onofrio, Kieran Culkin, Jodie Foster, Emile Hirsch, Tyler Long
description: Tim and Francis, students of a Catholic school in the United States in the mid-1970s, became convinced that the universe is divided into good and bad and that it is easy to distinguish the fine line between Good and Evil. For the two boys, the authoritarian Sister Assunta, who prevents them from having fun, represents the enemy to fight: thus they invent a biting comic strip, in which the nun is an evil motorcyclist fighting with their animated alter egos ...
notes: With a light hand, Care and the screenwriters Stockwell and Petroni tackle the typical adolescent problems, revealing the ugliness of the world without too many frills.

title: Changing Lanes
actors: William Hurt, Sydney Pollack, Toni Collette, Samuel L. Jackson, Ben Affleck
description: For Gavin and Doyle it is not a morning like any other: the first, a young lawyer, is on his way to court for a cause of the utmost importance; the second, an insurance agent awaiting a divorce, is preparing to find out if he will be entrusted with the children. Their cars collide and Gavin, in order not to waste time, refuses the friendly statement, leaves Doyle a blank check and leaves him to his fate. The insurer, furious, tries to take revenge ...
notes: Michell's direction, the interpretation of the two main actors and the editing by Christopher Tellefsen articulate the story, compressed into a single day.

title: Heaven
country: United States, Great Britain, France, Italy, Germany
actors: Giovanni Ribisi, Cate Blanchett, James Lloyd, Remo Girone, Max Giusti
description: Philippa, a twenty-nine-year-old English teacher, resides in quiet Turin. One day her husband dies of an overdose. Seeing as the police fail to catch the drug dealer who sold the deadly dose to the man, Philippa decides to take her own justice. He will find himself in jail for killing four innocents. When she meets Philip, the son of the captain of the carabinieri who soon succumbs to his charm, Philippa will have found her guardian angel.
notes: The suspensions, the ethical stalemate, the painful perception of existence remain intentions in a film performed robotically by Giovanni Ribisi. From a subject by Kieslowski.

title: People I Know
actors: Richard Schiff, Téa Leoni, Kim Basinger, Ryan O'Neal, Al Pacino
description: Throughout his career, brilliant PR, Eli Wurman has handled public life figures with ease. His latest client is the famous actor Cary Launer. He needs a lot of help to get Jill out of the way, a starlet who has caused him a lot of trouble. A seemingly easy task for Eli, but the situation becomes complicated as Jill is murdered.
notes: Daniel Algrant (he directed some episodes of the _Sex and the City_ series) and screenwriter Jon Robin Baitz draw on two films, one by Bob Rafelson _The King of Marvin's Gardens_ and one by Alan J. Pakula _Because a murder_ whose posters stand out on a wall.

title: Sénéchal le magnifique
actors: Fernandel, Nadia Gray, George Chamarat, Madeleine Barbulée, Jane Aubert
description: Sénéchal, an actor who plays in provincial theaters, is fired along with the whole company by the theater administrator. Sénéchal, dressed as captain of the Foreign Legion - he has only those left - finds himself on the streets of Paris. He will experience several misunderstandings.
notes: Unpretentious comic film.

title: Pinocchio
actors: Roberto Benigni, Nicoletta Braschi, Carlo Giuffrè, Kim Rossi Stuart, Corrado Pani
description: A piece of wood knocks on the door of the carpenter Geppetto who decides to use it to make a puppet. Thus was born Pinocchio who, thanks to the intervention of the Blue Fairy, becomes a real child. Disobedient and naughty by nature, Pinocchio will have to face a thousand ups and downs marked by as many fundamental encounters before becoming a "respectable kid".
notes: Director Benigni lets the immense spectacular machine from "Pinocchio" work on its own. The scenographies of Danilo Donati, the nocturnal arrival of the carriage of the Fairy, the land of toys, the puppet theater, have a life of their own, excellently served by the photography by Dante Spinotti and the editing by Simona Paggi. But they lack "the breath", what would make them live in the unique whole of a film. So, they eat the film. But what hurts the heart the most is the actor, who is no longer Benigni, but an actor who plays Pinocchio out of time. Pinocchio, a puppet who died as a child, has any age, as long as he is abstract, read, interpreted; he is the age of Benigni in a jacket and glasses, with a black frame, the age of Cioni Mario and the lunar Salvini. But he's not the age of this sad, hopping clown. Only the shadow of Pinocchio remains, which moves away indomitable in the last scene, the only truly, interiorly, poetic one, which makes us regret the film it could have been.

title: The Settlement
actors: John C. Reilly, William Fichtner, Kelly McGillis, David Rasche
description: Pat and Jerry get terminally ill policies. Their purpose is to have the holders anticipate a quarter of the indemnity and then collect the rest after death. Suddenly the "business" goes wrong because of Barbara, a scammer looking for chickens.
notes: Bittersweet comedy.

title: Enzo, domani a Palermo!
actors: Enzo Castagna
description: Enzo Castagna, almost 35 years of genuine passion for cinema: owner of an agency of extras and "discoverer of talents", but also organizer of street parties and owner of a funeral home. Today, however, Enzo is under house arrest, accused of having taken part in a mafia robbery at the Palermo post office ...

title: The Big Knife
actors: Jack Palance, Ida Lupino, Rod Steiger, Shelley Winters, Wendell Corey
description: Charles Castle is a famous Hollywood actor who tends to drown the anxieties of his marital crisis in alcohol. But when a cynical producer discovers a secret from his past and starts blackmailing him, Castle falls into despair: he will have to make critical decisions about his life, and career, and above all question his morality ...
notes: Taken from the play by Clifford Odets, Aldrich's film is striking for its radical denunciation of Hollywood's hypocrisy and morality, as well as its literally corrosive effects on artists. But Steiger and Winters are too over the top to convince.

title: Sex, Lies & Obsession
actors: Harry Hamlin, Lisa Rinna, Kevin Zegers, Rebecca Jenkins, Karl Pruner
description: By day Cameron Thomas is a respectable, loving and caring doctor with his wife Joanna and son Josh. But at night he is a totally different individual, obsessed with everything related to sex: prostitutes, pornography, casual sex, visits to the red light districts of the city ...

title: Xingfu shiguang
actors: Dong Jie, Zhao Benshan, Li Xuejian, Dong Lihua, Fu Biao
description: In the course of his life, Zhao, a poor retiree, has never had much luck with women. Then one day he meets a widow who attracts his attention. In order not to be left behind again he makes her believe he is rich. But the problems come up when the woman starts talking about marriage. At the usual request for money, all of Zhao's friends run away. Instead, Li comes up with an idea: to refurbish an old bus, rename it "The Inn of Happiness" and host couples looking for intimacy for a fee.
notes: Zhang Yimou makes a fairly traditional film, with some allegorical cues.

title: Lo vedi come sei?!
actors: Erminio Macario, Augusto Di Giovanni, Guglielmo Barnabò, Franca Cioeta, Carlo Campanini
description: Due to a will imposed by the extravagant Uncle Sofia, two very miserly cousins ??have to spend all the inherited assets if they want to get hold of two hundred million dollars locked in a safe. The two try to waste as much money as possible, but it is not easy because for each sum spent it produces a new unexpected gain. When the two cousins, reduced to poverty, open the chest, they find a roll of film reproducing the deceased uncle, whose voice from the screen makes fun of them for the trick he played them.
notes: The subject of the film is reminiscent of Walter Hill's "Who Spends More ... Earns More".

title: Spacehunter: Adventures in the Forbidden Zone
actors: Peter Strauss, Ernie Hudson, Molly Ringwald, Michael Ironside
description: Pilot Wolff and his fellow travelers land on planet Earth Eleven. Thanks to Niki, a survivor of a previous mission, they reach the Forbidden Zone where Overdog, a former scientist, holds three girls prisoner. It will be hard to save them.
notes: Pretty boring. It was a great success in the US.

title: Two for Texas
actors: Kris Kristofferson, Scott Bairstow, Irene Bedard, Tom Skerritt, Peter Coyote
description: 1836: Two prisoners, Hugh Allison and Son Holland, escape from a Louisiana penal colony after killing a ferocious Cajun tormentor. Followed by the dead man's brother, Hugh and Son arrive in Texas, where they enlist as volunteers in the army of the "irregular" who fight against the Mexicans of General Santa Anna ...
notes: A reinterpretation of the siege of the Alamo and the birth of an American nation through an epic novel by James Lee Burke, _Two for Texas_, published in Italy by Meridiano Zero. This television translation is not to be despised, especially for the intense presence of Kris Kristofferson.

title: Bamboozled
actors: Damon Wayans, Michael Rapaport, Savion Glover, Jada Pinkett Smith, Tommy Davidson
description: Pierre, a young writer who graduated from Harvard, is the only black person to work as a creator of television programs on a network. His boss Thomas, not at all satisfied with his productions, throws him an ultimatum: either he invents something different from the usual or he will be fired. Pierre invents the most outrageous farce that traces the worst stereotypes about blacks.
notes: The most interesting parts of the film are where Spike Lee has less ideological control. But the film is nonetheless of a political and aesthetic intelligence infinitely superior to the American average today.

title: Nas vek
description: A stranger to narrative cinema, Armenian Pelesjan has focused his efforts on an incessant linguistic research. Here his method of "editing at a distance" (with which the basic shots are disjointed, reiterated and connected as in a poem) is applied to a meditation on the conquest of the cosmos.

title: Flying Leathernecks
actors: John Wayne, Robert Ryan, Don Taylor, Janis Carter, Jay C. Flippen
description: Second World War. Dan Kirby, US Air Force major, is transferred to Hawaii to take command of a bomber squadron. His appointment is not to the liking of either Captain Griffin, who hoped to take command of the operations himself, or his subordinates who fear his reputation as a stern man. After a period of training, the military is sent to Guadalcanal. It is on the island that Dan will be able to adopt a new combat tactic and make himself loved by the troop.
notes: Nicholas Ray made this film, his first in color, on commission from Rko. It is clear that the subject was not to his liking.

title: Daun di atas bantal
actors: Christine Hakim, Sugeng Kabri Wali, Deni Christanta, Sarah Azhari
description: Three boys live on the streets of Yogjakarta - the capital of the Javanese royal tradition - begging, taking drugs and doing odd jobs. They dream of escaping their sad reality by chasing Asih's love, but tragedy lurks ...
notes: A merciless portrait of contemporary Indonesian youth.

title: Divine Secrets of the Ya-Ya Sisterhood
actors: Sandra Bullock, Ellen Burstyn, Maggie Smith, Fionnula Flanagan, Shirley Knight
description: Sidda, a young and brilliant playwright, made a career in New York far from Louisiana where her mother Vivi, an eccentric woman, lives. Interviewed by a journalist from "Time Magazine" Sidda indulges in criticism of her parent. At this point, Vivi's three close friends, Caro, Necie and Teensy, intervene. The three women create the Ya-Ya Sisters clan, kidnap Sidda to let her know the true face of her mother.
notes: Callie Khouri's staging does not control either the choral nature of the story or the many eras in which the story develops. The overall tone is mushy. The actresses save some written and directed scenes without a plug

title: 8 femmes
actors: Virginie Ledoyen, Fanny Ardant, Emmanuelle Béart, Isabelle Huppert, Catherine Deneuve, Danielle Darrieux, Ludivine Sagnier, Firmine Richard
description: 1950s: in a large bourgeois mansion in the French countryside, we are preparing to celebrate Christmas. The situation worsens when the head of the family is found dead. The murderer hides among the eight women who regularly attended the victim: a day of quarrels, betrayals and revelations begins.
notes: Ozon's play is extremely refined and hyper-cinematic: behind it, there is the aborted project of a remake of Cukor's _Donne_, later transformed into the adaptation of a theatrical text by Robert Thomas. But, in the long run, everything - although enjoyable - turns a bit 'in vain. The cast remains, bringing together the best of three generations of transalpine actresses.

title: I predoni della steppa
actors: Kirk Morris, Moira Orfei, Ombretta Colli, Giulio Donnini
description: In order to obtain a large ransom, Sandar, leader of a tribe of marauders, kidnaps Samira, daughter of Yessen and betrothed to the powerful Altan. But falling in love with the girl, he ends up returning her to his parent with the hope of being forgiven.
notes: The film proceeds without finding further narrative ideas.

title: Mr. Jealousy
actors: Eric Stoltz, Annabella Sciorra, Chris Eigeman, Marie-Jean Baptiste
description: Lester is a tremendously jealous precarious substitute teacher. She suspects her partner Ramona's ex-boyfriend, the writer Dashiell. Lester joins Dashiell's own therapy group under a false name to find out if Dashiell still has feelings for Ramona.
notes: Funny romantic comedy.

title: Il diario di Matilde Manzoni
actors: Ludovica Andò, Lea Gramsdorff, Urbano Barberini, Corinne Cléry
description: The existence of Matilde Manzoni, daughter of Alessandro, was consumed in the indifference of the great writer. Her short life as a consumptive was consumed in the unrequited desire for paternal love, of which some letters and a diary covering a few months attest. The story of Vittoria, the writer's other daughter, is also intertwined with her story.
notes: The film, although directed with a certain elegance, pays for a disrupted direction of the actors (curious by a director who is primarily an actor). Especially in the supporting roles: Barberini seducer with favorites is implausible, Cléry monotonously flirtatious, Betti does her usual number in the guise of Teresa Stampa.

title: La vie, l'amour, la mort
actors: Amidou, Caroline Cellier, Marcel Bozzuffi, Janine Magnan, Lisette Bersey, Nathalie Durrand
description: François Toledo, happily married and loving family man, is a model worker in an automobile factory. However, his past is weighed down by a very heavy shadow: the murder of three prostitutes, two in Paris and one in Nîmes. Soon, thanks also to an identikit drawn on the basis of the testimony of the friend of one of the victims, the circle of the police tightens around François, who is arrested, tried and sentenced ...
notes: A film ascribable to the "committed" side of the director of "A man, a woman", openly - and somewhat didactically - against the death penalty. But unfortunately there is no lack of imbalances and ambiguities.

title: Rumble Fish
actors: Matt Dillon, Mickey Rourke, Diane Lane, Dennis Hopper, Nicolas Cage, Chris Penn, Vincent Spano, Diana Scarwid, Laurence Fishburne, William Smith, Michael Higgins, Glenn Withrow, Tom Waits
description: 60's. Sixteen-year-old Rusty lives with his father, a former alcoholic lawyer, dreaming of becoming like his older brother, once a leader of the neighborhood gangs who now rides around California on his motorcycle. Having got into trouble for a fight, Rusty is saved by the providential arrival of his brother who is killed by a policeman.
notes: An ideal sequel to "The Boys of 56th Street", the film is based on the novel of the same name by Susan Eloise Hinton. The original title refers to "thunder fish", a species that attacks its own kind and that Rusty's brother would like to free from a shop aquarium "because they wouldn't fight if they were in the river, if they had more space". They are the only color elements of the film.

title: La chambre verte
actors: François Truffaut, Nathalie Baye, Jean Dasté, Jean-Pierre Moulin, Antoine Vitez
description: 1930s, French province. A widowed journalist refuses to accept the death of his wife and restores an old ruined chapel to honor the memory of the woman and all her deceased friends. Not even the love of a young woman will be able to distract him from his obsession.
notes: The film is loosely based on three short stories by Henry James: "Altar of the Dead", "Friends of Friends" and "Tiger in the Jungle". Regarding the issues addressed, Truffaut declared: "I am against oblivion which is an enormous frivolity, the frivolity of current events is something I can't stand .. The power of memory, fidelity and fixed ideas is more powerful. I refuse to forget ".

title: Brotherhood of Murder
actors: William Baldwin, Peter Gallagher, Kelly Lynch, Joel S. Keller
description: Tom Martinez, a young father of a family, feels overwhelmed by responsibilities and can no longer be calm when he returns home in the evening. The relationship with his wife is deteriorating, the children are increasingly distant and he begins to spend more and more time on his own. Under these conditions, he gradually lets himself be involved in a sect of fanatics, convinced of the superiority of the white race. When the going gets tough, though, Tom wakes up ...
notes: Tv movie based on a true story, with one of the (too many) Baldwins in circulation.

title: Red Dragon
actors: Anthony Hopkins, Edward Norton, Ralph Fiennes, Harvey Keitel
description: Will Graham, who had captured Hannibal Lecter three years earlier, now lives with his wife and child in Florida; the physical and psychological wounds inflicted on him by the dangerous criminal are not completely healed, to the point of forcing him to withdraw from the FBI. However, he is still needed, as a serial killer nicknamed "Werewolf" is wreaking havoc and corpses into the city. To better understand the movements and the mindset of the new opponent, Will can not help but get back in touch with Hannibal ...
notes: Ratner's film is based on the same novel by Thomas Harris (_Red Dragon_, in fact, re-titled in Italy with a much more banal _The crimes of the third moon_) which in 1986 had inspired the magnificent _Manhunter_ by Michael Mann. However, the settings and the dynamics between the characters traced by the excellent screenplay by Ted Tally (the same of _The Silence of the Lambs_), which always lead back to Lecter and his cultured blood red universe, refer more to Demme's masterpiece. Out of all the performers Edward Norton stands out, the policeman who - squeezed between the black maniacs Anthony Hopkins and Ralph Fiennes - has the less flashy and more intimate part. The fear we feel is hers, the eyes with which we see and perceive are mostly hers, in the awareness of a monstrosity that could capture us all if we didn't keep it at bay. _Red Dragon_ does not bore, does not abuse blood, does not pretend: it is "honest", and for today's cinema it is no small thing.

title: No Good Deed
actors: Stellan Skarsgård, Samuel L. Jackson, Milla Jovovich, Doug Hutchison
description: Jack, a police officer who usually deals with car theft, is contacted by a friend to find his daughter who has run away from home. The man, an amateur and diabetic cellist, accepts even if he is about to leave for a music festival. To do a kindness to an old woman, he finds himself kidnapped by a gang of criminals who are organizing a colossal scam against a bank.
notes: The director takes delight in filtering decades of cinematic tradition in this adaptation of a short story by Dashiell Hammett. There are forcing and fraying in this film library experiment (between the chamber thriller and the road-movie) with a disturbing Milla Jovovich.

title: Pesi leggeri
actors: Carmine Recano, Vanni Fois, Anna Scaglione, Claudio Montanari
description: Two boys are training in a gym on the outskirts of Cagliari, promises of boxing dillettantistica. Nino is a good talent, Giuseppe is indeed a gifted boy, but he has a closed and violent character. Between the two boxers, trained by Melis, former European champion, a rivalry is born also fomented by Maddi, Nino's girlfriend. The latter in revenge against her boyfriend is courted by Giuseppe.
notes: Some dialogue sticks, but the actors have almost all the right faces, the result is credible, intense and free of rhetoric, thanks to the good quality of the staging (editing by Carlotta Cristiani, music by Giovanni Venosta).

title: Miele di donna
actors: Clio Goldsmith, Fernando Rey, Luc Merenda, Catherine Spaak
description: During a hot summer day, a writer sneaks into a publisher's house and, threatening him with a weapon, forces him to read one of her manuscripts: the story of a naive girl named Annie and her stay at the Desiderio pension ...
notes: Despite the pretensions, Goldsmith's nudity and nothing else.

title: Critters 4
actors: Don Keith Opper, Anders Hove, Angela Bassett, Paul Whitthorne
description: Shortly before destroying the last two Critters eggs, Charlie learns that the extinction of the breed is considered illegal. Then, due to a misunderstanding, Charlie gets lost in space, and only after several years is he found by Rick and his men. Intrigued, Rick opens the egg box: there is new work for Charlie ...

title: Critical Mass
actors: Treat Williams, Lori Loughlin, Udo Kier, Blake Clark, Jack Betts
description: Officer Mike Jeffers must escort a truck loaded with toxic materials to a secret location in the Mojave Desert. But what looks like a routine task ends up getting damned complicated after the onslaught of the terrorist commando headed by the mysterious Sampson ...
notes: Trivia in its pure state.

title: The Neighbor's Wife
actors: Kari Wuhrer, Barbara Crampton, Melissa Stone, Seth Adam Jones
description: When her husband Chris kills himself after losing his job, Ann swears revenge against the man who fired him and the woman who got her man's desired vice presidency. Ann quickly gets rid of the owner of the company but takes it easy with the new vice president, Nicole Garrett. She does not have a very peaceful personal and family situation: she is sick with diabetes, she has married a man who drinks too much and has two problematic children of school age. Will the Garrett be able to stand up to Ann before her revenge is complete?
notes: Thriller with rhythm and discreet tension.

title: Haonan haonu
actors: Annie Shizuka Inoh, Lim Giong, Jack Kao, King Jieh-wen
description: Young actress Liang Ching is haunted by a stranger who storms silent phone calls. Meanwhile, the girl is busy rehearsing a film set in the 40s and centered on the true story of a couple ...
notes: Last chapter of Hou's trilogy on the history of Taiwan in the late twentieth century.

title: Nanguo Zaijan, nanguo
actors: Jack Kao, Hsu Kuei-Ying, Lim Giong, Annie Shizuka Inoh
description: Criminals Kao and Flathead and their girlfriends Ying and Pretzel would like to take the "quantum leap". At one point the idea would be to open a nightclub in Shanghai, but the matter turns out to be more problematic than expected ...
notes: After numerous films dedicated to the history of his country, Hou shifts the focus to the present.

title: Tini zabutych predkov
actors: Tatiana Bestayeva, Larisa Kadochnikova, Ivan Mikolajchuk
description: Ivan tragically loses his beloved Marichka, daughter of his father's murderer. After a long bereavement, the boy marries Palagna: his heart, however, always belongs to Marichka, and to win it back Palagna decides to turn to a witch ...
notes: Between myth and nature, Paradzanov creates an extraordinary essay of "visual poetry".

title: Halbe Treppe
actors: Thorsten Merten, Gabriela Maria Schmeide, Axel Prahl, Steffi Kühnert
description: Frankfurt on the Oder, today. Uwe who works day and night at his hot dog stand and his wife Ellen are best friends with Katrin and Chris, another married couple. Ellen and Chris both in crisis with their respective mates end up getting closer and closer and falling in love with each other. They will decide to move in together.
notes: If the intention was to create a kind of "Festen" in a lighter key, then one had to have the courage to connote and accompany characters and backgrounds with less "catastrophic" jokes and situations. Instead ... The film incredibly won the Silver Bear in Berlin and the Special Jury Grand Prix.

title: Embrassez qui vous voudrez
actors: Karin Viard, Sami Bouajila, Charlotte Rampling, Jacques Dutronc, Carole Bouquet, Lou Doillon
description: In Paris Bertrand and Elisabeth, rich and bourgeois, on the eve of their departure for the summer holidays, give a dinner for their neighbors: a couple of friends who will spend the whole summer with them in the same seaside resort. There the four will meet Jean-Pierre and Lulu and Maxime, a professional Don Juan. Everyone will return changed from this experience.
notes: Many of the roles are distributed quite well and this is essential in a film that relies mostly on actors and quick dialogue and in three or four funny scenes. The director's hand is not perceived and it is not necessarily a preordained option. Based on the novel "Summer Things" by Joseph Connolly.

title: Snow Dogs
actors: Cuba Gooding jr., James Coburn, Sisqo, M. Emmet Walsh, Joanna Bacalso
description: Ted, a dentist with a well established practice in Miami, inherits eight magnificent sled dogs. He is therefore forced to leave the warm city of Florida to travel to Alaska where the lively animals await him. He will be engaged in a competition in which he will have to contend with Thunder Jack, a quick-tempered mountaineer who will do everything to send him home.
notes: Cuba Gooding jr. he does everything he can to best interpret the cool citizen catapulted into an environment on the verge of livable. The problem is that overall the story proceeds in tears and the surrounding characters rarely manage to back up its comedy.

title: The Four Feathers
actors: Heath Ledger, Wes Bentley, Kate Hudson, Djimon Hounsou
description: England, 1884. On the eve of his departure for Sudan where he should fight the Madhi rebels, Harry, an officer of the British Empire, leaves the army and returns home. His father deserates him and three of his friends, including Lieutenant Jack Durrance and his fiancée Ethne Eustace send him four white feathers that symbolize cowardice. When Harry receives the news that Jack and his regiment have fallen into the hands of the rebels, he leaves to join his friends.
notes: Shekhar Kapur (author with an intense and not restrained style) brings to the surface the condemnation of colonialism, the legitimacy of the irreconcilable philosophies to which peoples and cultures refer.

title: La legge dei gangsters
actors: Klaus Kinski, Franco Citti, Hélène Chanel, Maurice Poli, Nello Pazzafini
description: The former convict Rino organizes with the help of a fence, two jewel thieves and an unemployed man, a five hundred million lire heist. Once the coup is over, Rino and the others have to contend with Renier, the financier of the robbery who would like half the loot.
notes: Police of manner.

title: Fortezza Bastiani
actors: Duccio Giordano, Cinzia Veronesi, Denis Fasolo, Giuseppe Gandini
description: A group of students from Bologna share an apartment in the city center. This refuge, nicknamed Bastiani Fortress as the fort of "The Tartar Desert", soon became the crossroads of unrest and false starts. The inhabitants of the house experience the malaise of a generation that has lost faith in institutions.
notes: The film is divided into five acts and a love interlude and describes with impressionistic style the handouts of a stripped-down life, wrapped in Bolognese wadding, all arcades and without sky, which dozes off and cradles in a youth that is not a spring of gaiety.

title: Febbre da cavallo. La mandrakata
actors: Gigi Proietti, Nancy Brilli, Rodolfo Laganà, Carlo Buccirosso, Enrico Montesano, Andrea Ascolese, Emanuela Grimalda
description: Bruno Fioretti alias Mandrake, who appeared at Cinecittà, has not lost his "horse fever". He has sworn to his new partner, Lauretta, a bar owner, that he has put his head right, but it's impossible to keep the demon of the game in check. Replaced Er Pomata - chased by the anger of the many Tor di Valle players to whom he owed money - with Micione and two other unfortunates, Mandrake started playing horses again. Or rather, to lose. One day, however, the "supermandrakata" happens which should solve its problems ...
notes: The Vanzina churn out an example of a "hyper-philological" sequel: practically identical to the father Steno's progenitor, thanks to the atmosphere and the essential musical theme of Bixio-Frizzi-Tempera, even if Montesano (Er Pomata) appears only in the last half hour and around Proietti / Mandrake there are new arrivals such as Laganà, Ascolese, Brilli and Carlo Buccirosso (the funniest). Old glories like Mario Carotenuto and Adolfo Celi have not been replaced, nor can they be replaced: and obviously the "frame" of the trial, which was of great comic and narrative effectiveness, is missing. For this reason, the sequel is by a zinzino inferior to the first chapter, even if we laugh a lot and Proietti is the only and convincing protagonist (memorable, among the many, is the gag of the fiction _The Return of Padre Pio_, in which Mandrake plays a friar and in the middle of the psalms he receives, via mobile phone, the chronicle of the umpteenth lost race). And finally, the most amazing gag: Nancy Brilli's dresses are by Roberto Cavalli!

title: Bone Daddy
actors: Rutger Hauer, Barbara Williams, R.H. Thomson, Joseph Kell
description: After leaving the medical profession, Dr. William H. Palmer wrote a novel based on fact in which a dangerous maniac is brought to justice. In reality, however, the criminal who inspired Palmer's pages is still at large, and the day after the book's release does not fail to show up: the former pathologist receives in fact a macabre present, which immediately triggers the police alarm ...
notes: In its indescribable banality, the Italian title gives a perfect idea of ??what to expect from this effort by the Maltese Azzopardi. On Rutger Hauer, unfortunately, it is useless to repeat ourselves.

title: Rupan sansei - Heminguuei peepaa no nazo
description: Hemingway, in some notes, left a treasure map. These notes are in a box that can only be opened with a gold key in the possession of a certain Mengel. Marcess, an arms dealer whose secretary is Fujico, hires a mercenary to kill Mengel. In the meantime, Lupine tries to anticipate Marcess.

title: The Hidden 2
actors: Raphael Sbarge, Michael Welden, Kate Hodge
description: An alien disguised as a government agent lands on earth to investigate a companion who had previously arrived on planet Earth and mysteriously disappeared. He will discover that an ancient alien civilization, hibernating for millennia, is finally awakening and threatening to destroy the cosmos.
notes: Z series science fiction.

title: Nel silenzio della notte
actors: Stella Carnacina, Lorenza Guerrieri, Silvano Tranquilli
description: Two crimes, one investigation. The murders of two women, apparently disconnected from each other, are perhaps the work of the same killer. This is the opinion of a young detective who follows a dangerous trail that takes you back to the distant past.
notes: From Mario Caiano, "historical" director of Italian popular cinema.

title: Barbie As Rapunzel
description: A long time ago, a seventeen-year-old girl named Rapunzel lived in a distant place, with splendid blond hair and enchanting beauty. But one day the evil and envious witch Gothel decided, through a spell, to imprison her between four crystal walls guarded by a huge and hideous dragon and lost in a dense forest. However, thanks to a magical painting, Rapunzel discovered a fairy world in which peace and harmony reigned: in love with the brave Prince Stefan, the young woman - assisted by the cute little dragon Penelope - tried at all costs to win his heart and regain his freedom. ..

title: Il mare, non c'è paragone
actors: Eduardo Tartaglia, Sabrina Impacciatore, Gigi Savoia, Veronica Mazza
description: The sudden fishing crisis throws Liuciano into despair as he tries to get out of the impasse by going to work in the fishmonger run by his mother. The results are disastrous. The man urged by the insistence of his wife Maria gives himself to the transport of illegal immigrants from Albania. An awkward and tragic shipwreck puts him in a coma. What appears to be a drama could turn out to be lucky if Luciano wakes up during the connection of the "Superenaletto" show combined with the "Sveglia & Vinci" lottery.
notes: Among the misunderstandings, there is that of having launched this comedy with autumn implications, as a sort of umpteenth comic episode of the Neapolitan tradition.

title: A cavallo della tigre
actors: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Paola Cortellesi, Tuncel Kurtiz, Manrico Gammarota
description: Guido idle forty full of debt organizes a robbery together with his partner Antonella, TV dancer. While the man is caught by the police Antonella manages to escape with the entire booty. A few years pass and Guido, who is about to get out of prison, is involved in an escape by two convicts. The man has nothing left to do but track down his old partner who is now a journalist.
notes: Visually full of suggestions, the film is less compact and harmonic than other works by the director. Shaken by alternating currents the script and the staging, suffer some characters that are not well modeled and some not very functional connections.

title: Ghost World
actors: Illeana Douglas, Brad Renfro, Steve Buscemi, Scarlett Johansson, Thora Birch
description: After high school, Enid and Rebecca must decide what to do with their future. Not very in tune with the immature peers, they plan to take a house together: Rebecca, more practical and concrete, immediately finds a job as a waitress, while the perpetually dissatisfied Enid invests her desire for affection by establishing a strange relationship with Seymour, disillusioned forty. ..
notes: A sharp and sarcastic "teen movie", with fierce but also bitter accents, very different from the banal juvenile sitcoms we are used to. Screenplay by Zwigoff and Daniel Clowes (from an underground comic book by the latter, very popular in the US).

title: The Deep End
actors: Raymond J. Barry, Peter Donat, Jonathan Tucker, Tilda Swinton, Goran Visnjic
description: Margaret, a quiet housewife, married to a naval officer who, because of her profession is always away from home, is forced to manage the problems of everyday life alone. When Beau's lover, his homosexual eldest son, drowns in the lake in front of his house, he hides the corpse to protect his son. Then one day Alek appears out of nowhere, a boy who seems to be aware of several things.
notes: Swinton is the center of gravity of the plot, the engine of an intelligent and engaging thriller. Staging and photography envelop the spectators and the characters in an aquatic universe, like a placenta, even when the action unfolds on land.

title: El Alamein - La linea del fuoco
actors: Paolo Briguglia, Pierfrancesco Favino, Luciano Scarpa, Emilio Solfrizzi
description: World War II: enrolled as a volunteer, the university student Serra is sent to the front of the Egyptian desert. The department to which he is assigned is the "Pavia", set up a step away from the El Qattara depression but far from the center of hostilities. The young man, who will be "adopted" by his fellow soldiers, will participate in the battle of El Alamein.
notes: Monteleone lets himself be carried away by the need to tell the characters (perhaps to justify their humanity) and by a solemn trend, a bit like a TV movie. However, the result is an essential, tense and heartfelt film, belonging to a genre that is not very popular in contemporary Italian cinema.

title: Paid to Kill
actors: Dane Clark, Cecile Chevreau, Paul Carpentier, Anthony Forwood
description: A businessman who thinks he is on the brink hires a killer to kill him, hoping to get his wife to collect the insurance premium. When the situation improves, the businessman tries to cancel the contract with the killer, but ...
notes: Acceptable English thriller.

title: Lola
actors: Barbara Sukowa, Mario Adorf, Armin Mueller-Stahl, Mathias Fuchs

title: Wishful Thinking
actors: James LeGros, Jennifer Beals, Eric Thal, Drew Barrymore, Mel Gorham
description: Max and Elizabeth live together; but when she proposes marriage, Max refuses and the relationship goes into crisis. The girl, disappointed, makes an innocent friendship with Jack, which, however, is enough to make Max jealous; then Lena, who has always been in love with Max, gets in the way and the matter gets complicated ...
notes: Sentimental comings and goings of routine.

title: L'invincibile cavaliere mascherato
actors: Daniele Vargas, Pierre Brice, Massimo Serato, Hélène Chanel
description: Second half of the 17th century. To escape the plague, the usurper Don Luis, after killing the legitimate representative of the government, takes refuge in his castle. At the same time, a masked knight appears in the village intent on protecting the weak.
notes: Mediocre film by a multifaceted director.

title: The Lost Empire
actors: Thomas Gibson, Ling Bai, Russell Wong, Ric Young, Kabir Bedi
description: American journalist Nick Orton sets out in search of an ancient Chinese manuscript, long lost. During the journey he is accompanied by bizarre and fascinating characters, including a former cannibal, a young and beautiful divinity - sent by the Terracotta Warriors - and a being half man and half animal ...
notes: Based on _Viaggio in Occidente_, a classic of Chinese literature of the sixteenth century, an adventurous and engaging film. MacDonald is a famous director of "second units": among the other titles he signed as director, there are the certainly not memorable _Rambo 3_ and _The Legionary - Fuga dall'inferno_.

title: Rupan sansei - Roshia yori ai wo komete
description: Lupine reads, in an old book, a very interesting story about a certain Yurovski, an imperial guard at the time of Tsar Nicholas II. Who, according to this mysterious testimony, was saved from execution by Yurovski. To reward him, the tsar gave him 500 tons of gold, which have since been lost ...

title: An American Tail III: The Treasure of Manhattan Island
description: Fievel and his inseparable friend Tony Toponi find a map of a mysterious treasure hidden somewhere under the island of Manhattan in New York. The searches begin and the two are quickly found near the place indicated as the point to dig. To block them, but only "momentarily", is the encounter with a large community of "native American" mice, forced to live underground since the immigrant mice from Europe put their paws on the Big Apple. Fievel, pushed by Tony, would like to continue his research, but we have never seen a great, or small, hero abandon someone in difficulty.

title: The Millionairess
actors: Sophia Loren, Peter Sellers, Vittorio De Sica, Alastair Sim
description: Feeling the lack of a spouse, wealthy heiress Epiphany Parerga, an Italian living in London, falls in love with Ahmed el Kabir, a humble and ascetic Indian doctor. Before joining in marriage, however, the two establish an agreement, consisting in mutually overcoming a test: within a fixed period of three months, she will have to manage to survive on 500 miserable rupees, while for her part he will undertake to transform the sum. of 500 pounds in 15,000 ...
notes: The play of the same name by the cutting edge George Bernard Shaw is adapted with sufficient verve by Asquith and his screenwriters Riccardo Aragro and Wolf Mankowitz.

title: Emma sono io
actors: Cecilia Dazzi, Elda Alvigini, Pierfrancesco Favino, Marco Giallini
description: During the summer holidays, due to a trivial misunderstanding, Emma decides to stop the treatment that controls her unstable mood. With her gust of energy she wreaks havoc among the people around her. It will undermine everyone's certainties, including the imminent marriage of Marta who has entrusted the organization of her wedding party to her.
notes: "Emma sono io is a classic comedy of misunderstandings which, however, has the pace of a TV drama and the now proverbial fear of going further, exceeding, stepping on the accelerator pedal. Why not give it to Monicelli?

title: Le peuple migrateur
description: In spring, from the northern hemisphere, migratory birds take flight to the Arctic lands, to reproduce in the same places where they were born. Some fly non-stop, night and day, while others arrive at their destination stop after stop. How the flocks manage to reach precise locations thousands of kilometers away remains a mystery ...
notes: The splendor and primeval wonder of the animal world are the raw material of this ornithological fresco, at times weighted down by too elegiac music. A flying epic in which documentary sensationalism is blunted, "migrating" from the ethological essay to fiction.

title: The Old Man Who Read Love Stories
actors: Hugo Weaving, Timothy Spall, Cathy Tyson, Richard Dreyfuss, Victor Bottenbley
description: In El Idilio, a village on the edge of a river in the Amazon rainforest, lives as a recluse Antonio Bolívar whom everyone calls "The Old Man". One day Antonio starts reading the love books that the traveling dentist Rubicondo Loachamin brings him to pass the time. He shares this occupation with a beautiful local girl, waitress and prostitute, named Josefina, whom he finsice to fall in love with. But not everything goes smoothly because Antonio is forced to participate in a hunting trip.
notes: Rolf de Heer films the thoughts of the "old" with iterative slowness and arid geometry. Taken from the book by Luis Sepúlveda.

title: Bimba
actors: Sabina Guzzanti, Francesco Paolantoni, Neri Marcoré, Adriana Asti, Antonio Catania
description: Child, a capricious and untalented starlet, one day discovers that she is not a human being, but a clone. And precisely the copy of an American actress quickly forgotten by everyone. Infuriated by the experiment, she takes it out on Dr. Salti, a businessman who turns out to be responsible for the cloning. Determined, despite everything, to pursue her dream of glory she throws herself into the world of entertainment.
notes: The film only works when Guzzanti is on stage: the secondary characters are spooky and bring out the worst in actors, such as Francesco Paolantoni and Neri Marcorè, who once more confirm that they do not pass the screen.

title: Dzieje grzechu
actors: Grázyna Dlugolecka, Jerzy Zelnik, Olgierd Lukaszewicz
description: In early 20th century Poland, the young Ewa falls in love with the writer Lukasz and becomes pregnant. After being abandoned and killing the newborn, she is circumvented by two men and begins a descent into the underworld of prostitution and crime.

title: The Girl with the Hungry Eyes
actors: Christina Fulton, Isaac Turner, Leon Herbert, Bret Carr, Susan Rhodes
description: 1937: the beautiful model Louise commits suicide after discovering the infidelities of her boyfriend (and photographer). The decades pass, but Louise does not give up taking the coveted revenge on the entire male sex ...
notes: In this film, based on a short story by Fritz Leiber, it is not only the budget that is low: so is the level.

title: The Contaminated Man
actors: William Hurt, Natascha McElhone, Peter Weller, Katja Woywood
description: David, a chemist who lost his wife and child to a bizarre accident, attempts to rebuild his life. While doing a search, he uncovers a series of mysterious deaths that appear to be attributable to Joseph, a quiet individual who works as a security guard. The fact is that Joseph's body came into contact with a substance that made him the carrier of a terrible contagion. David will have to play the executioner and try to eliminate Joseph before he can cause more deaths. Whitman will discover things he never even imagined.
notes: Weak action movie.

title: Arabian Nights
actors: Mili Avital, Dougray Scott, Alan Bates, John Leguizamo, Tchéky Karyo
description: Schariar, Sultan of Bagdad, hates women. Solved to not get married anymore, he changes his mind when he meets so that there: however, although enchanted by the beauty of her young woman, he decides to kill her immediately after the first wedding night. To postpone her execution, the girl thus starts to tell extraordinary stories ...

title: Rupan sansei - Naporeon no isho wo ubae
description: The world economy is on its knees because of the money spent on the Gulf War. Earth's mighty have no choice but to get their hands on the Lupine family's treasure. The key to the loot is hidden in Napoleon's dictionary.
notes: Also known as "The treasure of the ancestors".

title: The Land Before Time VIII: The Big Freeze
description: Little Foot and his friends go in search of a stone of fire that would fall from the sky in the night. Piedino's uncle offers his help because he is convinced that the object is prodigious. His aim is to use it to his advantage, but the little dinosaur's friends will understand the deception just in time.

title: À corps et à cris
actors: Martin Lamotte, Zabou, Jean-Pierre Bisson, Bernard Freyd
description: Journalist Bernard Terrier is transferred from Paris to Bordeaux for having caused the suicide of a banker in an article of his own. On his first evening in Bordeaux, he finds himself embroiled in the murder of a bar pianist. With the help of a radio announcer he decides to investigate, but discovers that several strong powers are hidden behind the murder.
notes: Dayan, one of the best-known French TV fiction directors and refined screenwriter, is also involved in social matters (she directed parts of the documentary _Another world is possible_).

title: La rosa di Bagdad
description: Princess Zeila, daughter of Caliph Oman III, is about to review the nobles who aspire to his hand. The sinister prince Jafar plots in the shadows: the young musician Amin will think about making love triumph, with the help of the Genius of the lamp ...
notes: Seven years of workmanship and "artisanal" techniques to give life to the first Italian animated feature film (released together with Gavioli's "The Dinamite Brothers"), a prototype also in the use of Technicolor. In its own way a milestone of undeniable historical value, in whose evaluation both the naïf taste of the narrative and the evident debts to Disney aesthetics pass in the alternative.

title: Fai seung dat yin
actors: Lau Ching Wan, Simon Yam, Ruby Wong
description: A team of police from the Organized Crime Department is tasked with tracking down members of a gang of robbers who landed a hit after taking a bloodbath. The hunt is on, except that the gang has "disturbed" another group of bandits with its reckless enterprise. To make the investigation even more difficult, the "private" problems of individual agents.
notes: Expect the unexpected, as the title says. The ending of the film, in fact, is incredible and extraordinary. The rest falls within the very high requirements of the action movie made in Hong Kong. Produces Johnnie To.

title: The Sweetest Thing
actors: Cameron Diaz, Christina Applegate, Selma Blair, Thomas Jane, Jason Bateman, Parker Posey
description: Christina has set very specific rules for men: she does not want to find what is right for her, she simply focuses her attention on what is right now.
