Until he meets the charming Peter who disappears the following day. Christina thus decides to break her own rules and set out on the trail of the handsome Peter. In the company of Courtney, her best friend, he sets off on a journey full of daring adventures.
notes: Romantic comedy with interludes from musicals, road movies and slapstick. More than envy, a parody of the penis, in spite of poor Freud. In the disco you can meet the charming prince. There is also the marriage-sketch ritual.

title: Elling
actors: Per Christian Ellefsen, Sven Nordin, Per Christensen, Jørgen Langhelle, Marit Pia Jacobsen
description: After spending two years in a psychiatric clinic, Elling prepares to return to the so-called "real world". Norwegian social assistance allows him and Kjell, his roommate, to live together in an apartment in Oslo, with the obligation to take care of themselves: their new life will prove to be full of tests to overcome, because they have to learn to do things that are completely normal for others, like walking into a restaurant or answering the phone. Kjell's encounter with a woman and Elling's discovery of Norwegian poetry mark the beginning of a new course, which will force the two to go all out to win their personal challenge.
notes: All that you would no longer have wanted to see in a story a thousand times narrated, which slyly "fans" the cards at stake, seasoning the gloomy Nordic atmospheres with a pinch of _Someone flew over the cuckoo's nest_ and a rind of _Idiots_ (but sweetened and cleaned up of Vontrierian unpleasantness). That it caused a crisis of laughter can be explained in the measure in which there is an audience with a very good mouth, immaculate and virgin, who still believes in the good all on one side and the bad all over there, where the sun does not shine.

title: Reign of Fire
actors: Christian Bale, Matthew McConaughey, Izabella Scorupco, Gerard Butler, Scott James Moutter
description: While visiting the London subway yard where his mother works, 12-year-old Quinn Abercromby inadvertently awakens a huge dragon that destroys everything in its path. Twenty years later, much of the world is controlled by the monster and its offspring. Quinn, who has become chief of the fire brigade, must fight the winged creatures with his friend Creedy: one day, the American "dragon slayer" Denton Van Zan arrives to help them, a former soldier who does not have all the wheels in place. ...
notes: The immediate future is imagined (it is a structured convention by now) as a post-medieval regression. Quinn's community of humans thrives on hardship, grows tomatoes, and mimes _Star Wars_ for children. One day the Americans headed by Van Zan (McConaughey with shaved head and _xXx_ tattoos) will arrive (history repeats itself), with a blonde helicopter pilot and brave "archangels" who use nets to capture dragons. The battle for the Earth can begin. The production is of Disney origin (the film is branded Touchstone) and the operation is clearly aimed at a teenage audience: in this key, the show can also be considered passable, even if the "metaphorical" readings developed by the screenwriters Gregg Chabot, Kevin Peterka and Matt Greenberg are so simplified and didactic that they appear childish. In the control room, Bowman (the one from _Rollerblades - On the wings of the wind_ and _X-Files - The film_) does what he can.

title: Il trasformista
actors: Luca Barbareschi, Rocco Papaleo, Luigi Maria Burruano, Catherine Wilkening, Raffaele Pisu
description: A flood devastates the North. The flooding of the Po causes damage, exasperates the souls of ordinary citizens and uncovered a toxic waste pit. Viganò, an environmentalist with a more or less functional family, blocks the train on which the minister on duty travels to verify the extent of the damage. A television crew is also present at the lively confrontation. His face and his grit appear telegenic and someone notices it. He gets him contacted, nominates him, gets him elected to Parliament. In the Rome of the messengers, flanked by the councilor Lanzetta, he learns the rituals of the powerful and of the commissioned peons.
notes: Fierce and disillusioned indictment against politicians.

title: Nid de guêpes
actors: Benoît Magimel, Nadia Farès, Samy Naceri, Valerio Mastandrea, Pascal Greggory
description: Strasbourg: while the parade for the July 14 party is underway, the special forces agent Hélène Laborie has the task of escorting a big shot of the Albanian mafia to prison, accused of leading a vast prostitution ring. The man must be tried soon: the security measures are at the highest level, but the mafia's henchmen do not allow themselves to be intimidated and take action to free him. Following an ambush, the agent Laborie, the thug and a few other survivors take refuge in an abandoned shed where they come face to face with a band of thieves in action, while from the outside the enemies continue the assault. .
notes: Metaphysical thriller, directed with a sense of proportion and rhythm, with a taste for characters that American films have lost along the way. Bravo Mastandrea, who demonstrates how in Italy there are actors suitable for action cinema (see Amendola and Asia Argento). Too bad there is no action cinema here!

title: Rabbit-Proof Fence
actors: Everlyn Sampi, Tianna Sansbury, Laura Monaghan, Kenneth Branagh, David Gulpilil, Ningali Lawford
description: Australia, 1931: Three black girls - Molly, her little sister and cousin - are snatched from their mother's arms and transported 1,500km away to a government camp where they will be trained as domestic workers for white families. They will attempt a brave escape home, following the containment fence for the rabbits.
notes: Linear, dramatic, fueled by a civil fervor that moves without sentimentality or vulgar failure, Noyce's film (temporarily returned home from Hollywood) is a vigorous act of denunciation of an episode that stains recent history in Australia.

title: The Safety of Objects
actors: Glenn Close, Dermot Mulroney, Jessica Campbell, Patricia Clarkson, Joshua Jackson
description: The lives of the members of four neighboring families become intertwined when some of them discover that, in order to establish sincere human relationships, they must emerge from the isolation that comes from the "security of objects". There are the Golds, with Esther who for a year has been taking care of her son in a coma assisting him day and night, and for this reason she has moved away from her husband and teenage daughter. Not far away, Annette Jennings is getting a divorce. At Train, the head of the family Jim realizes that his wife and children live very well even without him. Finally, Helen Christianson is an unhappy and dissatisfied wife who struggles to admit it ...
notes: Glenn Close is good, and even the other performers (Dermot Mulroney, Jessica Campbell, Mary Kay Place) hold the comparison. If a similarity can be ventured, it is with Todd Solondz's films: Troche is less bizarre and visionary, ultimately less good, but just as restless.

title: Un Aldo qualunque
actors: Fabio De Luigi, Michele Bottini, Giuseppe Battiston, Silvana Fallisi, Manuela Ungaro, Neri Marcoré
description: 1978: Aldo Chimenti, originally from a small town in the province of Bari, has just moved to Turin with his policewoman wife. His life is divided between working as an accountant and rehearsing with the parish rock choir. The meeting with Biagio, a former Communist and nothing, and with Caimano, a naive who lives out of time, is destined to upset Aldo's habits. The three discover that they have in common the dream of making money, and to make it come true they are willing to do anything ...
notes: It operates too "moral", which often gives the impression of wanting to fly and which instead ends up remaining on the ground, with deflated wheels.

title: Werckmeister harmóniák
actors: Lars Rudolph, Peter Fitz, Hanna Schygulla, Mihály Kormos
description: A provincial village, a musical theory that recalls an idea of ??absolute purity and harmony, a bandwagon inside which a tiny "prince of Evil" and a monstrous cetacean are hiding ...
notes: Tarr paints a new black and white fresco on the abyss of vulgarity and violence that threaten the world.

title: Enough
actors: Jennifer Lopez, Billy Campbell, Juliette Lewis, Fred Ward, Bill Cobbs
description: The waitress Slim deludes herself that she has found the ideal man in Mitch, a rich and charming businessman. At first it seems like an idyll: but after the birth of his daughter Grace, Slim discovers that her husband has a double personality and is capable of doing a lot of harm to the people who are close to him. To protect Grace, Slim leaves him, changes his appearance and identity, but he continues to haunt her. Neither friends nor the police can do much to help her, so Slim decides to act alone ...
notes: The script jumps here and there, messes with the narrative time, inserts uninteresting minor figures. Lopez is nailed to her standard as a very modest actress.

title: Austin Powers in Goldmember
actors: Mike Myers, Michael Caine, Beyoncé Knowles, Michael York, Seth Green, Robert Wagner
description: Doctor Male and his accomplice Mini-Me have escaped from a maximum security prison. Together with the mysterious Goldmember, the diabolical doctor is planning a journey through time to take over the world: the plan involves the kidnapping of Nigel Powers, Austin's beloved father. The most famous spy in England is therefore forced into action: back in 1975, Austin finds Foxxy Cleopatra, his former flame and detective, who joins him to save Nigel and stop the evil plot ...
notes: After hilarious opening titles full of excellent appearances (Cruise, Paltrow, Spielberg, Spacey, De Vito, Quincy Jones, much mentioned in the soundtrack), the usual musical-psychedelic-scatological pastiche is renewed, where girls, songs and quotes (Godzilla and Hannibal Lecter, Darth Vader and Foxy Brown ...). This time Myer even goes the extra mile, and adds the nutty and gleaming Goldmember to the regular Austin, Male and Ciccio Bastardo. All already known, of course, but the saga has rhythm, humor to spare and no shame. It is not clear why it is not successful in Italy; but let's not forget that not even the Monty Pythons, at the time, made a lira.

title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
actors: Nia Vardalos, John Corbett, Michael Constantine, Lainie Kazan, Bess Maisler, Andrea Martin
description: Everyone in the Portokalos family is worried about Toula, because she is still single at thirty. The girl helps out in her parents' Greek restaurant, and her life is pretty flat. To the proposal of the family who would like to send her to Greece to find a husband, Toula decides to react: first of all she changes her look, she enrolls in a computer school - despite the paternal opposition - and starts working in the travel agency run by her aunt. Here she meets the charming teacher Ian Miller, who asks her for a date. The two begin dating and fall in love: but when he proposes the wedding, he will have to contend with his parents, uncles, aunts, grandmother and 27 cousins ??...
notes: The winning idea of ??the film is not to distort its spontaneity by entrusting the role of the protagonist to a Hollywood diva, leaving it to the communicative strength and sympathy of Vardalos (who had already led her to success in the theater). Nice rhythm and a great desire (perhaps too much) for everyone to live happily ever after, without even a shadow of a doubt or a push for modernity. By comparison, _Four weddings and a funeral_ and _My best friend's wedding_ are thorny and unconventional ...

title: The King and I
description: The king of the backward state of Siam knows well that it is necessary for his country to open up to the spread of Western civilization: for this reason he decides to entrust the education of his children to Anna Leonowens, a widow who seeks new life in the East. Despite the difference in character, the king and Anna end up appreciating each other to the point that the woman becomes the king's adviser ...
notes: Cartoon version of the famous story of the King of Siam, which has already "become a film" on a couple of other occasions. Funny script, some openness to politically correct (the meeting of cultures), but an animation that is not always up to par.

title: The Santa Clause 2
actors: Judge Reinhold, Elizabeth Mitchell, Spencer Breslin, Tim Allen, David Krumholtz
description: Scott Calvin has been Santa Clause for eight years. But his life becomes a real hell when he discovers that, if he does not get married by Christmas Eve, he will no longer play the role of Santa Clause: a clause of his contract in fact provides that he will be joined by a Lady Clause. Also, Scott learns that his son Charlie made it onto the villain list of the year ...
notes: The most pleasant parts, as usual, are those at the North Pole, with wooden scenographies and special effects with a slightly handcrafted flavor. But then most of the film takes place on Earth and unravels a "politically correct" suspect in its tedious development.

title: Pantaleón y las visitadoras
actors: Salvador del Solar, Angie Cepeda, Mónica Sánchez, Pilar Bardem
description: Pantaleón Pantoya, an uncompromising captain in the Peruvian army and an exemplary husband, has to carry out a very delicate mission: to organize an itinerant service of "visitors" to try to satisfy the sexual needs of the soldiers located in the most isolated areas of the Amazon. One of them will break into his heart.
notes: Between a highly inspired Nando Cicero and a Franco & Ciccio barracks air of the good old days, Lombardi popularizes the literary ideas (by Mario Vargas Llosa) and the insidious sexy energies lavished by the platoon of "visitors", called to arms ( and to ... the arts) by the upright Pantaleón.

title: Come se fosse amore
actors: Michelangelo Pulci, Chiara Muti, Claudio Nocera, Filippo Lamberti, Alessandro Bianchi
description: Aurelio, an electrical engineer by profession, has developed an invention that could, at least according to him, win over Chiara, a candidate for the post of mayor of Genoa. This is the Dreamer, a contraption that, by penetrating into people's sleep, would have the power to change them. The car is tested on Giotto, Gilberto and Costantino, three neurotic taxi drivers.
notes: Watermelons, taxi drivers, aspiring mayors and firefighters dance and sing. The film brings together a group of actors, I Cavalli Marci, with theatrical and television experiences of some notoriety and an actress, Chiara Muti, known for completely different roles.

title: WiseGirls
actors: Mira Sorvino, Mariah Carey, Melora Walters, Arthur J. Nascarella
description: Meg, a former medical student, works as a waitress in an Italian restaurant frequented by mobsters, who use her as a cover for their shady dealings. The girl, who is going through a rather difficult time, finds solace in the friendship of the bubbly Rachel and the shy Kate, both waitresses of the same place.
notes: Anspaugh juggles between comedy and thriller, based on a not inconsiderable script by John Meadows. The three actresses are doing well and amaze the progress (ephemeral?) Of Mariah Carey. Especially considering the previous _Glitter_.

title: La morte ha sorriso all'assassino
actors: Ewa Aulin, Klaus Kinski, Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Angela Bo
description: At the beginning of the 1900s, Greta, a young woman with no memory due to an accident with her carriage, was hosted by a couple in their villa. The couple, Walter and Eva, are drawn to the mysterious woman, whose past is murky and mysterious. Eva, jealous, walls Greta alive in a dungeon of the villa, presumably causing her to die. But Greta returns, even if at times with a monstrous face, and kills. The experiments on the life and death of Dr. Sturges seem to have something to do with the strange situation.

title: Edison the Man
actors: Spencer Tracy, Rita Johnson, Lynne Overman, Charles Coburn
description: 1929: 82-year-old Thomas Alva Edison tells his own story. Born in an Ohio town and raised in Michigan, in his early twenties he made it to New York ...
notes: At the same time as "Young Tom Edison" (by Norman Taurog, with Mickey Rooney), Metro produced this correct and fairly faithful "biopic", with a good Tracy.

title: The Powerpuff Girl
description: Professor Utonium, a brilliant scientist who wants to create the perfect little girl creates three little pests. His work, however, is sabotaged by Gio Gio, his monkey assistant who adds the mysterious Chemical X to the professor's concoctions. The mixture has an unexpected reaction that generates the three girls with superpowers. Even though it is their intention to help the humans, the three pests mess up Townsville residents.
notes: The result of a curious attempt to combine Japanese animation with the American tradition of the UPA, the Powerpuff Girls overturn the trend of television cartoons in difficulty when they land on the big screen and do not betray their fans.

title: San Giovanni. L'Apocalisse
actors: Richard Harris, Vittoria Belvedere, Benjamin Sadler, Paolo Villaggio, Bruce Payne
description: Year 90 d. C .: terrified by the ultimatum promulgated by Domitian, according to which Roman citizens who do not recognize the emperor as the only god will be executed, the Christian communities of Asia Minor regain courage after learning that the apostle John, for some time believed dead, he is still alive. In Rome, the news is reported to Domitian by the young Valerio, who is commissioned to go to the island of Patmos under the guise of a Christian to find out from the old prisoner Theophilus where the apostle is and then kill him. But Valerio ignores that Teofilo and Giovanni are actually the same person ...

title: Juwanna Mann
actors: Miguel A. Nuñez jr., Vivica A. Fox, Kevin Pollak, Tommy Davidson, Kim Wayans, Ginuwine, Lil'Kim
description: Jamal Jeffries, a basketball player with a rather particular character, is kicked out of his team that plays the NBA championship. With the help of her agent, she tries to make it to the women's basketball league playing the role of Juwanna Mann, a female basketball player.

title: The Adventures of Pluto Nash
actors: Eddie Murphy, Joe Pantoliano, Randy Quaid, Rosario Dawson
description: 2087. Pluto Nash, former smuggler and owner of a bar on the moon that bears his own name, tries to resist Mogan's offers. He, a sort of space mobster who is helping the mysterious Rex to conquer the Moon, tries to blow his bar. Point on Pluto Nash, who does not want to sell the place, will become the leader of an independence movement.
notes: Apart from the rare comedic cues of a discouraged Eddie Murphy and the waste of the cast, the meaning of this sci-fi comedy is not clear. A sloppy script and a dull comedy bore even the most willing of spectators.

title: Marie Chantal contre Dr. Kha
actors: Marie Laforêt, Akim Tamiroff, Francisco Rabal, Serge Reggiani, Charles Denner
description: While on vacation, the beautiful and sophisticated Marie Chantal runs into a dude who engages her in an international intrigue centered around a (fake) diamond to be delivered to Morocco. But the diabolical dr. Kha is not watching ...
notes: Curious Chabrolian divertissement, which parodies the "topoi" of the spy genre.

title: The Spreading Ground
actors: Dennis Hopper, Leslie Hope, Frederic Forrest, Tom McCamus
description: The murder of some children causes the mayor of Burman City to turn to detective Ed Delongpre. Without clues, Delongpre and his men get to work; in the meantime, however, the mayor has also asked for help from a powerful local criminal ...
notes: Hopper does its best in a pure routine product.

title: Água e sal
actors: Galatea Ranzi, Joaquim De Almeida, Alexandre Pinto, Clara Jost
description: Ana lives with her husband and daughter in a small seaside town. When the man decides to leave, Ana is presented with the opportunity to complete a long pending job. But his concentration is seriously threatened when he starts walking on the beach: he will have to save a stranger from drowning, he will meet Alexandre and Emilia and welcome Vera, a friend who suddenly shows up at his house ...
notes: As the minutes pass, the film does not keep its promises, becomes schematic and shows an unforgivable absence of curiosity. Villaverde does not have the breath to hold up its project to the end.

title: Plots with a View
actors: Naomi Watts, Christopher Walken, Brenda Blethyn, Alfred Molina
description: In a small town in the English countryside, the rivalry between two owners of funeral homes, Frank and Boris, is heated. The first would like to introduce the fashion of themed funerals, while the second, more tied to traditions, boasts of being able to make the faces of the dead brighter. But Boris' real passions are dancing and Betty, a girl he would like to conquer.
notes: The product is packaged properly, with no loss of pace, with a lovely Brenda Blethyn. You really laugh, however, only with Christopher Walken's Yankee pecker who seems to come out of "Dear extinct".

title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
actors: Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, Emma Watson, Richard Harris, Kenneth Branagh, Tom Felton, Richard Griffiths, Fiona Shaw, Harry Melling, James Phelps, Maggie Smith, Jason Isaacs, Toby Jones
description: Harry does not listen to the advice of the elf Dobby and, aboard his flying machine, goes with his friend Ron to the school of wizardry at Hogwarts. When he arrives at the institute, he discovers that not everything is going the right way: in fact, the chamber of secrets has been reopened, allowing a monstrous creature to wreak havoc. Its victims are in fact turned to stone, and the help of the popular Professor Gilderoy Lockhart is not needed to thwart the threat. Harry will have to intervene to save the situation ...
notes: The most relevant "new entries" of this second episode are those of Gilderoy Lockhart, the vain and paradoxical Defense Against the Dark Arts professor, the evil Lucius Malfoy (father of Harry's enemy, Draco) and the very nice house elf Dobby. The horror and dark components of J.K. Rowling exalt themselves through terrifying spiders, a hideous basilisk that resembles a dragon, a thumping plane tree that uses branches as glowing arms, a blank-page diary, some petrified children and the fastest and most dangerous Quidditch (the sport of choice for wizards) of a "rollerball". Columbus takes his leave of the series with a film more refined in special effects and photography, more dynamic in the staging, less pressured by the need to illustrate the novel and more homogeneous in interpretation: the natural gap between the cast of adults and children is less clear-cut and the digital characters do not break up the shots.

title: Blood Link
actors: Michael Moriarty, Cameron Mitchell, Sarah Langenfeld, Penelope Milford, Geraldine Fitzgerald
description: Terrified by nightmares in which he commits bloody crimes, Craig realizes that the visions are actually about Keith, his Siamese brother. Having located the diabolical joint - who possesses his own telepathic powers - in Hamburg, Craig joins him but soon finds himself stuck ...
notes: A lot of violence, little suspense.

title: Drei tolle Mädels
actors: Carola Höhn, Else von Möllendorff, Theodor Danegger, Hermann Speelmans, Lucie Englisch, Johannes Riemann, Grethe Weiser
description: Retired to a castle with his son, an elderly baron recalls his own past as a libertine. One of her old conquests is now the companion of a trio of dancers who, having learned of the thing, visit the noble by pretending to be his daughters ...
notes: Comedy of the past, directed by the future director of "Sissi".

title: Requiem for a Dream
actors: Ellen Burstyn, Jared Leto, Jennifer Connelly, Marlon Wayans
description: A woman obsessed with weight and the desire to appear on TV poisons herself with weight loss pills. His son sinks with his girlfriend into the drug tunnel, undergoes horrors, oppressions and mutilations to the point of total degradation.
notes: The dream that deserves a requiem is the American one, where appearing counts more than being. To prove the theorem Aronofsky plays accumulation with the non-filmable, hits hard and plunges the viewer into the same abyss as the protagonists. But the fury is only emphatic, the rhetorical staging, the smug violence. Oscar nomination for Ellen Burstyn.

title: Wagons East
actors: John Candy, Richard Lewis, Ellen Greene, John C. McGinley
description: The lack of prospects pushes the inhabitants of Prosperity, a village in the heart of the United States, to abandon their homes: it will be the foreigner James H. Harlow to convince them - unlike all the other pioneers - to head east.
notes: Last, far from memorable film starring John Candy.

title: Yogi's First Christmas
description: Yogi and Bubu awaken after a period of hibernation and join their friends in the Jellystone park. The most beautiful holidays of the year are imminent and our friends are preparing to celebrate them, but there are those who intend to ruin their plans.
notes: Acceptable animated film with the heroes of Hanna & Barbera.

title: A Bullet Is Waiting
actors: Jean Simmons, Rory Calhoun, Stephen McNally, Brian Aherne
description: Survivors of a plane crash, Sheriff Munson and inmate Ed Stone are rescued by young Cally Canham, who lives on a nearby ranch with her father David. Ed's proclamations of innocence convince the girl, who falls in love with him; but the "man of the law" disagrees ...
notes: Solid and well interpreted.

title: Kevin of the North
actors: Skeet Ulrich, Natasha Henstridge, Leslie Nielsen, Rik Mayall
description: Young Kevin Manely discovers that he has inherited from his grandfather a property located in distant and cold Alaska. Attracted by the prospect of changing his life, he lands in Anchorage and immediately realizes that there is a condition involved: taking part in a tough endurance race for dog sleds ...
notes: From the same director of _Operazione gatto_ and _Spice Girls_ a film we certainly didn't miss. Not even the majesty of the snow-covered landscapes (and the presence of the beautiful Henstridge) manages to revive the fortunes of an obvious and all too predictable film. Filming was done in Canada.

title: La leggenda di Al, John e Jack
directors: Aldo Baglio, Giovanni Storti, Giacomo Poretti, Massimo Venier
actors: Aldo Baglio, Giovanni Storti, Giacomo Poretti, Aldo Maccione, Antonio Catania, Ivano Marescotti
description: New York, 1959. A famous boss commissions three decidedly atypical gangsters to kill a certain Frankie. The three miss the mark and find themselves in a dramatic situation: they must face the wrath of the boss who entrusts their fate to the dice. Thanks to a good dose of luck, the three manage to escape, but to save their lives they must complete a new delicate mission: to protect a person very dear to the boss. It goes without saying that once again the three unlikely bodyguards, following a "trivial" accident, put their lives in danger again.
notes: The film is nothing transcendental, but those who love the style of their performances will be quite satisfied. However, abstracting ourselves from the specificity of the gags and individual moments, and focusing on the whole, the film compared to the previous "Ask me if I'm happy" is disappointing. First of all, the three gangsters, no matter how ramshackle and funny, are not characters capable of holding up one hundred and five minutes of film alone. Secondly, the cinematic ambitions and the sumptuousness of the context risk crushing the evidence of the gags. Dolly on the Brooklyn Bridge, highly sought-after (and somewhat glossy) photography, hundreds of extras, an unnecessarily complicated screenplay, a somewhat long story ... We appreciate the return of Aldo Maccione, giant of Italian comedy for years " exiled "to France.

title: I Saw Mommy Kissing Santa Claus
actors: Cole Sprouse, Dylan Sprouse, Connie Sellecca, Corbin Bernsen, Eric Jacobs
description: Justin sees his mom Stephanie kissing Santa. To prevent the old man dressed in red from being kissed by his mother, Justin turns into a pest. The boy is convinced that if he becomes bad Santa Claus will go away and never come back.
notes: Nice comedy with fantastic implications.

title: Casper's Haunted Christmas
description: The ghost Casper and his three terrible uncles are sent as punishment by the terrible Kibosh to ruin Christmas in the village of Kriss Mass. The refusal would lead to exile in the endless night for the four ectoplasms. Casper with the help of his friend Agrifoglia tries to foil the plan.

title: Belle's Magical World
description: Film divided into three segments. "The Magic Word": A misunderstanding between Belle and the Beast is an opportunity for a lesson on forgiveness. "An unforgettable evening": a romantic walk in the snow goes up in smoke due to an accident. "The Broken Wing": Belle attempts to convince the Beast to free a singing bird.

title: I'll Be Home for Christmas
actors: JonathanTaylor Thomas, Jessica Biel, Adam Lavorgna, Gary Cole
description: Absent for a few years, this time Jake can't miss the traditional family party appointment in New York. But now, for a variety of reasons, poor Jake finds himself in the middle of the Californian desert, dressed as Santa Claus and without a dollar. And the Big Apple is far, far away ...
notes: Negligible little film for teen-agers.

title: Addams Family Reunion
actors: Tim Curry, Daryl Hannah, Kevin McCarthy, Estelle Harris, Jerry Messing, Nicole Fugere, Carel Struycken
description: Senility comes to everyone, and even grandfather and grandmother Addams have to deal with the ailments of age. The fact is that, being characters a bit ... particular, their troubles are too: in short, they are returning to "normal"! Of course Gomez and Morticia are alarmed, and reunite the family to solve the problem ...

title: Star Trek. Nemesis
actors: Patrick Stewart, Jonathan Frakes, Brent Spiner, LeVar Burton, Michael Dorn
description: As the crew of the Enterprise prepares to celebrate the wedding of Deanna Troi and William Riker, a sudden call from Starfleet forces the ship to go to Romulus for an unexpected diplomatic mission: in fact, after a long enmity, the Romulans they have decided to open peace negotiations. Upon reaching their destination, however, Picard and his men are faced with a threat that could lead to the destruction of the Earth ...
notes: The special effects alternate plausible sequences with not too sophisticated videogame effects: yet, the consolidated skill of the cast manages to not wreck the film in the black hole of indifference.

title: Empire
description: The quintessential example of a cinema that denies its own narrative vocation by becoming a paradox, a provocation, a pure conceptual operation. By maximizing the length of the film (originally around 8 hours) and reducing it to a single fixed shot, Warhol emphasizes the very nature of the viewer-screen relationship.

title: In girum imus nocte et consumimur igni
description: Guy Debord, prophet of situationism and author of a fundamental text of the "alternative" culture of the twentieth century (_La society of the spectacle_), constructs an unprecedented and stimulating digression on the themes of water and fire, thematized both in the succession of images and in the voices "poetic" commentary.

title: The Life & Adventures of Santa Claus
description: Little Santa Claus, orphan of both parents, finds himself spending his childhood in the woods. A group of goblins takes the trouble to educate him. Having become an adult, Santa sets out to bring joy and serenity to the homes of mere mortals.
notes: From a book by L. Frank Baum, author of "The Wizard of Oz".

title: Special Delivery
actors: David Lewis, Megan Leitch, Andy Dick, Jodelle Ferland, Nels Lennarson
description: Jack and Robin Beck, after giving birth to Samantha, discover they cannot have more children. They decide to adopt one, relying on an adoption agency. In charge of the "delivery" is the orphan Lloyd. He will make a lot of trouble for the Becks, but, in the end, he will manage to win their sympathy.

title: Bartok the Magnificent
description: Bartok the magnificent, fearful and boastful bat, accomplice of Anastasia's adventures, roams the streets of Moscow combining pranks. But when the evil witch Baba Yaga, emissary of the evil Ludmilla, kidnaps Prince Ivan, Bartok does not hold back.
notes: Spin of by "Anastasia".

title: The Indian in the Cupboard
actors: Hal Scardino, Rishi Bhat, David Keith, Lindsay Crouse, Litefoot
description: For his birthday, the very young Omri receives three gifts: a wooden casket, a bunch of antique keys and a small plastic Indian. When Omri unites the objects, the whole magically comes to life, dragging him on a strange adventure ...
notes: Discreet and lively fairy tale directed by Oz ("The Muppets", "In & Out").

title: Natale sul Nilo
actors: Massimo Boldi, Christian De Sica, Biagio Izzo, Max Cavallari, Bruno Arena, Enzo Salvi, Paolo Conticini, Lucrezia Piaggio, Nuria de la Fuente, Mabel Lozano, Maria De Filippi
description: During a cruise on the Nile, the adventures of a widower general of the Carabinieri intertwine, struggling with a family "drama" (the fifteen-year-old daughter wants to become a "letter" and marry a footballer) and the lawyer Ciulla, tormented since childhood from a curious inconvenience: women find it irresistible. After yet another betrayal, his wife decided to leave him forever and left for Egypt where her archaeologist son lives. Ciulla follows her down there, determined to win her back, but does not know that his latest conquest is also aboard the ship. To complicate everything there is a couple of tourists in possession of two ancient rings: one brings good luck and the other bad luck. The result is that what was supposed to be a peaceful vacation turns into an alternation of misfortunes and fortunes ...
notes: The two stars of the (award-winning?) Company Parenti & De Laurentiis always work, but the film is nothing short of a catastrophe: and above all it is impressive how badly all the other members of the cast, especially the female ones, play. The truth is that the formula shows the rope: Boldi and De Sica still have excellent chemistry, but the narrative structure of this genre of films (at least from _Bodyguards_ onwards) requires that each carry out their own story, crossing the other. more and more infrequently. Add the sketch of the Prickly Pears, really painful, and you will get a discontinuous little film, grungy, shot, edited and dubbed with patches.

title: Un mondo d'amore
actors: Arturo Paglia, Guia Jelo, Fernando Pannullo, Teresa Pescarelli
description: Winter of 1949. The teacher Pier Paolo Pasolini is indicted by the carabinieri for bribery of minors and obscene acts. During a village party in Ramuscello, in the Friulian countryside, he had convinced some kids to go away with him. The military of the weapon proceeded according to some rumors. Pier Paolo's world collapsed, starting with his father, Carlo Alberto, who fell into a destructive depression. The poet will only have to leave with his mother for Rome.
notes: Cinema of flesh and bodies, that of Grimaldi, always aimed at life, whether bad or good, never closed in on itself. And even when imperfect or unbalanced, he manages to dig into faces and souls with a deep and dry look that is not easy to find in our films. Moreover, he knows how to cut and subtract, even from his talented performers. He even has the courage to allow himself to dream and illusion (as in the splendid opening sequence): knowing the reality, it is a great stroke of inner richness.

title: Treasure Planet
description: Jim, a fifteen-year-old boy, lives with his mother in a port city. One day he stumbles upon Bill Bones, a seriously injured man whom Jim cannot save from death, but who entrusts him with an orb containing a treasure map. Doctor Doppler organizes an expedition aboard the Rls Legacy, a fantastic space galleon. Thanks to the cyborg Silver, steward of the spaceship, Jim becomes an experienced pilot. However, the boy soon discovers that Silver is a pirate contemplating a mutiny ...
notes: The redundancy and complexity of _Atlantis_ give way to the fluidity and extraordinary vision of this film, which gradually transports the viewer to a fascinating world where the future mixes with a typically eighteenth-century décor. The adventure always remains one of the cornerstones of the story, but between the pirate (depicted as a cyborg) and Jim the father-son relationship grows strong and quickly steals the show from everything else. The cast is curious, in which Morph, a mutant being who takes the place of the Stevensonian parrot, and B.E.N., an extravagant robot reminiscent of those of _Stellar Wars_ stand out.

title: 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea
actors: Michael Caine, Patrick Dempsey, Bryan Brown, Mia Sara
description: Second half of the 19th century. Pierre, assistant professor of the Natural History Museum in Paris, travels to the United States to submit his theories to the Academy of Sciences. In recent times, some ships have been attacked by a mysterious entity and Pierre is convinced that it is a sea monster.

title: Sorellina e il principe del sogno
actors: Nicole Grimaudo, Christopher Lee, Rudolph Oliver, Valeria Marini
description: Her name is Alisea, but for her five siblings she is only Little Sister, and alone she provides for the sick mother. One day he knocks on the door of their house Azaret, an old wizard who expects the girl to be his servant. Little sister refuses and Azaret kidnaps her little brothers. Luckily she meets Prince Demian.

title: Federal Hill
actors: Anthony DeSando, Nicholas Turturro, Frank Vincent, Libby Langdon
description: Nicky comes from a predominantly Italian-American neighborhood of Providence, Rhode Island, where one survives only by building a future as a criminal. Thus begins to sell drugs, but when he falls in love with Wendy, an archeology student, Nicky is ready to abandon his old life to follow her. He does not know, however, that his best friend Ralphie (who gets away with robbing rich apartments and hiding his attraction to him more and more with difficulty) is certain that Wendy is just looking for a hobby and wants to dissuade Nicky from attending her .. .
notes: There is the determination of the young cast and a script worthy of the name: all in all, it lets itself be seen.

title: Love Me Tender
actors: Richard Egan, Debra Paget, Elvis Presley, Robert Middleton
description: The southern brothers Reno, not knowing that the Secession war is over, attack a northern convoy. Having become aware of the situation and not knowing who to deliver the loot to, they decide to divide it up. They will get into a lot of trouble.
notes: Beautiful songs sung by Elvis ("Love Me Tender" and "Poor Boy").

title: The Viking Saga
actors: Ralph Moeller, Hinrik Olafson, Ingibjörg Stefánsdóttir, Sven-Ole Thorsen
description: Kjartan is the last of the Viking heroes: after the killing of his father, he forms a group of fearless warriors to take revenge, vanquishing the handful of bloodthirsty barbarians in the pay of the ferocious Ketil ...
notes: Unpresentable feature film inspired by the adventures of Nordic myths. The protagonist Ralph Moeller has won the title of Mister Universe.

title: Ministry of Fear
actors: Ray Milland, Marjorie Reynolds, Carl Esmond, Dan Duryea
description: Unjustly convicted, Stephen Neale is released after two years of imprisonment. Still shaken by the experience, during his return to London the man remains involved in a dangerous and mysterious spy plot ...
notes: Inspired by Graham Greene's "Fifth Column", one of the most abstract and distressing films of the American Lang.

title: Legami di famiglia
actors: Claudio Bigagli, Massimo Ranieri, Isa Danieli, Giovanna Carcasci
description: Neapolitan bourgeoisie today: Lucia's children rush to her bedside together with her husband Vincenzo, a conformist and bigot businessman, who had first repressed and then repudiated her (at the time the abandonment of the marital roof was a crime). And it is precisely the children, today, who bear the profound signs of that domestic hell: not only the dissolute Luca and the neurotic Paola, but also the one who would seem most similar to their father, Marco.
notes: Even without any moment of real invention, and with somewhat too schematic conflicts between overly stereotyped characters, the film lets itself be watched and has an acrid look on the family that is truly unusual among Italian directors. Crivelli's muisca is effective.

title: Un dono semplice
actors: F. Murray Abraham, Virna Lisi, Valeria D'Obici, Regula Grauwiller
description: Thomas, a cynical executive of a multinational company, leaves for India to give his daughter Beatrice the news of his mother's death. Thomas will meet Sister Beth who runs the mission where the girl volunteers. In contact with the shocking reality of that country, he will rethink the market strategies of his company.

title: The Lost World
actors: Patrick Bergin, Jayne Heitmeyer, Julian Casey, David Nerman
description: 1930s. After a tumultuous reunion, the Royal Geografic Society sends four adventurers in search of the lost world: a mythical hidden region where the long-extinct dinosaurs are said to be. Our heroes will face mythical adventures.
notes: Yet another version of Arthur Conan Doyle's novel.

title: Johnny Dangerously
actors: Danny DeVito, Michael Keaton, Dom DeLuise, Joe Piscopo
description: Cornered by the need to pay for some expensive medical care for his mother, Johnny does not hesitate to place himself under the wing of Dundee, a benevolent old-fashioned "godfather". Thus begins his career in the world of crime ...
notes: Sort of parody of the "gangster movie", with a luxurious cast but short of breath.

title: La notte di Pasquino
actors: Nino Manfredi, Fiorenzo Fiorentini, Giovanni Lombardo Radice, Giacomo Piperno, Antonia Liskova, Giacomo Gonnella
description: In Rome, in September 1870, the statues "speak": to give them a voice, addressing pungent anticlerical rhymes addressed in particular to the powerful Cardinal Renzi and his henchmen, is the mysterious epigrammist Pasquino. In the turn of the same night, Pasquino will be involved both in the search for a child kidnapped from the Jewish ghetto and in the rescue of the young revolutionary Andrea. This will put him in conflict with none other than Prince Galeazzo della Gensola, Renzi's cousin and instigator of the kid's kidnapping: with the help of Andrea and Jenny, an American painter already a lover of Galeazzo, Pasquino will try to get out of the way. .

title: Unfaithful
actors: Diane Lane, Richard Gere, Olivier Martinez, Erik Per Sullivan, Chad Lowe
description: Edward and Connie are a happy middle-aged couple who lead an enviable life in the suburban neighborhoods of New York. Their union, so strong up to this point, is upset by Connie's chance and chance encounter with a stranger in the streets of Soho. The woman begins an adulterous relationship which soon turns into an obsession. When Edward finds out that his wife lied to him, he wants to know all the details of his infidelity and to confront his rival.
notes: The remake of "Stéphane, an unfaithful wife" is boiled, monotonous, interminable. In the script there is Alvin Sargent, formerly an excellent screenwriter ("Vigilato Speciale", "Common people"): unrecognizable.

title: The Lost World
actors: Bob Hoskins, James Fox, Tom Ward, Matthew Rhys, Elaine Cassidy
description: Professor Challenger, a representative of the Royal Society of London, is convinced that he has found a group of dinosaurs that survived extinction in a remote plateau of the Amazon. The scientist returns to his homeland to organize the expedition: once on the spot, he will have to confront the natives and ...

title: The Prince and the Pauper
actors: Jonathan Timmins, Robert Timmins, Alan Bates, Aidan Quinn, Jonathan Hyde, Ben O'Brien
description: Edward, Prince of Wales, son of Henry VIII, takes the place of Tom Canty as a joke, a medicant who resembles him in an incredible way. In this way the noble becomes aware of the conditions in which his subjects live. He will be able to put his experience to good use once he becomes king.

title: Král sokolu
actors: Brano Holicek, Juraj Kukura, Klára Jandová, Waldemar Kownacki
description: Middle Ages. Tomás, fatherless and expert in deciphering the language of animals, goes with the old herdsman to the castle in search of work. Despite himself, Tomás will be involved in Iver's plot against his rival, the old falconer Vagan.
notes: Mediocre Czech adventure film.

title: Kárhozat
actors: János Derzsi, Gyula Pauer, György Cserhalmi, Hédi Temessy
description: Karrer's days unfold all the same, in a wandering punctuated by the noise of a cableway or the beating of the rain. Attempting to involve other people in one's existence will fail, and Karrer will be left with nothing but hatred and loneliness ...
notes: Another exemplary and inexorable parable by the great Hungarian author.

title: Riget II
actors: Ernst-Hugo Järegård, Peter Mygind, Kirsten Rolffes, Søren Pilmark
description: At the "Il Regno" hospital in Copenhagen, the chain of strange and disturbing events seems to never end: the apparitions of the ghost ambulance, the evil presences identified in the basements by Mrs. Drusse, and much more ...
notes: Second tranche of the bizarre, demonic and mocking Vontrierian saga.

title: Bo Ba Bu
actors: Abdrashid Abdrakhmanov, Arielle Dombasle, Djavakhir Zakhirov
description: The brothers Bo and Bu live with their flocks in the boundless Uzbek steppes. Upon encountering a slender blonde European woman who is apparently mute and forgetful, the two take her with them, renaming her "Ba". Almost resigned to her fate, Ba accepts it without rebelling ...
notes: Unusual and "lunar" Eurasian film.

title: Zits
actors: Danielle Duclos, Janson Kristofer, Cameron Johann
description: Determined to lend a hand to a blind teacher, the gang of Hoggy and Oskar look for a way to get the money they need. At a certain point, the right idea comes up, even if a little crazy: to get hold of some state secrets and sell them at a high price! Just like in the cinema ...
notes: Ramshackle but fun enough.

title: Hondo
actors: John Wayne, Geraldine Page, Ward Bond, Michael Pate, James Arness
description: New Mexico, 1874: Hondo Lane, a tough-skinned cavalry courier, takes the fate of Angie Lowe and her son Johnny to heart. One day, near the Lowe ranch, Lane is attacked by Angie's ex-husband and is forced to kill him ...
notes: Solid and "democratic" enough, with an intense Wayne.

title: El bosque animado
directors: Ángel de la Cruz, Manolo Gómez
description: The rich Signor D'Abondo and his servant Rosendo are crossing the mysterious wood of Cecebre, when all of a sudden they have the sensation that the trees and the whole forest are alive. It's not just a sensation because as soon as the travelers have departed, Mother Nature herself comes out and reveals herself in all her glory. The trees open their eyes, the Oak is chatting amiably with its friends Elm, Pine and Eucalyptus. But the peaceful life of the forest is disturbed by new dangers.
notes: Spoiled by the technical perfection achieved by Pixar, the animation of this film is in some moments really irritating in its coarseness.

title: Tattoo
actors: August Diehl, Christian Redl, Monika Bleibtreu, Nadeshda Brennicke
description: Marc, fresh out of the police academy, is attending a rave. The final surprise of the party ends with the arrival of the police who carry out a raid. Marc manages to escape, but makes the mistake of forgetting his jacket which is found along with some pills that are hidden there. Detective Minks, who has been looking for news about his daughter who has been missing for two years, blackmails Marc and forces him into contact with the world of illegal parties. The two will come into contact with a serial killer.

title: Sex Is Comedy
actors: Grégoire Colin, Roxane Mesquida, Anne Parillaud, Ashley Wanninger
description: While making a feature film entitled _Scene Intime_, director Jeanne finds herself filming a difficult erotic scene between the protagonists and having to manage their feelings to put them in a position to perform at their best. But the young lead man refuses to show his erection ...
notes: Breillat stages her work with irritating self-satisfaction (the scene in question is the central one of _A mia Sister_, and the actress is also the same): the fiction-reality game is moldy, the transgression cloying and the self-loading of the The despotic director played by Parillaud is unintentionally ridiculous.

title: The Big Noise
actors: Stan Laurel, Oliver Hardy, Doris Merrick, Arthur Space, Veda Ann Borg
description: Despite being the simple doormen of the building where an investigation agency is based, Laurel and Hardy are in turn mistaken for detectives and hired to supervise an inventor busy making a new bomb. Catastrophe announced ...
notes: Title not among the most memorable of the famous duo.

title: Angel and the Badman
actors: John Wayne, Gail Russell, Harry Carey, Bruce Cabot, Irene Rich
description: The Worth Quaker family welcomes gunfighter Quirt, who was wounded in a shooting. During his stay he falls in love with the rescuers' daughter. He will be forced to choose whether to return to life as an outlaw and take revenge on those who tried to kill him, or live with his beloved woman by accepting the rules of his world.
notes: "Psychological" Western to be re-evaluated for several reasons: the first is the intense test of the Duke, also a producer. The second is for the theme of "non-violence", an almost impracticable lifestyle choice in a still barbaric world like that of the Far West. Had it been directed by Boetticher or Anthony Mann, it would have been a masterpiece.

title: Redemption
actors: Don 'The Dragon' Wilson, Chris Penn, James Russo, Sam J. Jones
description: Officer John Sato, leader of a Los Angeles police assault team, is held responsible for the death of a colleague in the course of an action. Expelled from the body and disgraced, John goes to the employ of the gangster Tony Leggio ...
notes: "For fans only": the others carefully keep away.

title: La palestra
actors: Valeria Marini, Andrea Roncato, Pamela Prati, Jean-Michel Danquin, Francesca Nunzi
description: The Beautiful Center is a sports center equipped with every comfort: gym, swimming pool, sauna and turkish bath. Between the treadmills and an aerobics class takes place the story of the actress Angela who has an affair with her producer Bonetti, Liuba's husband. The woman, in turn, has an affair with her aerobics instructor, Michel who is engaged to Valentina, the beautiful Latin American dance teacher. All under the eyes of Maurizio, manager of the club and of his nephew Luca who has literally lost his mind to an unreachable star.
notes: The film in full Bagaglino style marked the peace between Marini and Prati.

title: The Panic in Needle Park
actors: Al Pacino, Kitty Winn, Richard Bright, Adam Vint, Kiel Martin
description: Bobby, a drug addict who peddles at Needle Park, knows the prostitute Helen. The girl becomes a drug addict and finds Bobby her pimp, her dealer and her lover. The two try with all their might to leave that world behind.
notes: First starring role for Al Pacino.

title: Sweet Home Alabama
actors: Reese Witherspoon, Josh Lucas, Patrick Dempsey, Candice Bergen
description: Melanie, a designer on the conquest of New York, makes the golden bachelor of the city fall in love with her and asks her to marry him. But in Alabama there is his past, the soundtrack of his youth, a modest family, a married husband in high school, simple friends. Before she gets stuck again, she has to divorce her first husband and his personal history ...
notes: The film speaks more to the heart and sensitivity of the American viewer than to the European one, and is built on the likeable Reese Witherspoon: an actress who, if we were in the 1950s, would be little more than a good character actor.

title: Cinderella
actors: Marcella Plunkett, Kathleen Turner, David Warner, Katrin Cartlidge
description: Yet another television version of Perrault's fairy tale, who this time lives in England in the mid-1950s: having lost her mother, Cinderella has to deal with her father's new girlfriend, a stepmother who also isolates her from her father's affection. and with the "prince charming" on duty, a bored rocker.
notes: Produced by the British of Channel 4, a television operation above the usual standards for the small screen. Excellent cast, which "regenerates" Kathleen Turner with a bad role. Directs Beeban Kidron, director of the funny "To Wong Foo, thanks for everything! Julie Newmar".

title: A Damsel in Distress
actors: Fred Astaire, George Burns, Gracie Allen, Joan Fontaine, Reginald Gardiner
description: Jerry an American dancer traveling to London falls in love with Alice, a noble heiress. Man will find himself at the center of a tasty misunderstanding.
notes: Fred Astaire after seven films shot with Ginger Rogers changes partner (Joan Fontaine). Wonderful music by Gershwin and Oscar to Hermes Pan for the choreography.

title: Vivacious Lady
actors: Ginger Rogers, James Stewart, Charles Coburn, Beulah Bondi
description: Peter, a serious botany professor, falls in love with Francey, a dancer he met in a night club, and marries her. Fearing paternal anger, he makes her pass for his student. But soon the deception will come to light.
notes: Comedy of misunderstandings based on a story by I.A.R. Wylie. Good the Rogers / Stewart couple.

title: The Minion
actors: Dolph Lundgren, Roc LaFortune, Françoise Robertson, David Nerman
description: Every thousand years Lucifer has a chance to free himself from the infernal exile, escaping a group of knights who are supposed to guard the gateway to the earthly world. To the bravest of them, Lucas, the task of stopping him before his anger strikes the people of New York.
notes: Canadian Jean-Marc Piché tries his hand at a real film after a long (and successful) television and advertising career. However, a scriptwriter (Matt Roe) is not very incisive and an actor capable only of menar his hands (Dolph Lundgren). Deferred to future (and hopefully more inspired) works.

title: Storia di karate, pugni e fagioli
actors: Sal Borgese, Pino Ferrara, Dean Read, Cris Huerta, Alfredo Mayo
description: First they try to get their hands on a precious relic, then they end up forming a ramshackle gang to save the daughter of a banker, a prisoner of the brigand Espartero: Sam and Piccolo are about to get into trouble.
notes: A western, a comedy or a martial arts film? More of everything, but only for lovers of the "genre".

title: Harte Männer heisse Liebe
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Isabelle Corey, Jester Caefe, Peter Carsten
description: Marina, an orphan and with two dependent brothers, loses her boat in a storm. To save her is the young Piero. To get by, the girl ends up working in a salt pan, where however the supervisor Alberto, a violent and dishonest man, one evening tries to take advantage of her. She manages to escape, while Piero, who cannot forget her, decides to join her. Marina initially does not want to know about him, but when Alberto's arrogance leads to tragedy ...
notes: Co-production entrusted to the Czechoslovakian director Franz Cap: the result is a stylistically flawless melodrama, which is rarely seen on TV.

title: Tony Rome
actors: Frank Sinatra, Jill St. John, Gena Rowlands, Richard Conte
description: The "private eye" Tony Rome, a tough guy who lives in a houseboat in Miami, is hired by Rudy Kosterman, a local rich man, to recover a precious pin stolen from his daughter: he will discover an intrigue made up of murders, lies and betrayals ...
notes: Great Sinatra, perfectly at ease in the noir atmospheres of a film built on an iron screenplay (by Richard L. Breen, based on the novel _Miami Mayhem_ by Marvin H. Albert). The direction of photography bears the prestigious signature of veteran Joseph F. Biroc. Tony Rome's character returns - again played by "The Voice" - in _La Signora nel cement_ (1968).

title: The Long Night
actors: Henry Fonda, Barbara Bel Geddes, Vincent Price, Ann Dvorak
description: A worker and a no longer very young magician compete for the love of a young woman. The second arrives at the most shameless lies to eliminate the rival, who kills him in a fit of anger. Then he locks himself in a hotel room, besieged by the police ...
notes: Hollywood remake of Marcel Carné's "Tragic Dawn", starring Henry Fonda in place of Jean Gabin. The original is a masterpiece, this "only" a film that, without disappointing, never manages to touch the intimacy of a script that harks back to that of Jacques Prevert. Also because here the dawn is not so tragic ...

title: Delta of Venus
actors: Audie England, Costas Mandylor, Eric Da Silva, Emma Louise Moore
description: In the Paris of the 1930s, a young American became a lover of a writer and then discover that the true passion of his "boyfriend" are the brothels of Montparnasse. It will thus end up writing pornographic stories ...
notes: Yet another "erotic" mess by Zalman King, who is inspired by an Anais Nin novel here.

title: Ma che colpa abbiamo noi
actors: Carlo Verdone, Margherita Buy, Anita Caprioli, Stefano Pesce, Lucia Sardo, Antonio Catania, Max Amato, Raquel Sueiro, Luciano Gubinelli, Lorenzo Balducci, Sergio Graziani
description: During the weekly session with the elderly psychoanalyst Lojacono, Gegé, Luca, Gabriella, Ernesto, Alfredo, Marco, Chiara and Flavia are so busy with their own problems that they do not realize that the woman has died in front of them. For the eight patients, all that remains is to continue group therapy alone ...
notes: Between the paws of an old Italian comedy and homages (unconscious or deliberate?) To the first Moretti, Verdone confirms his tragicomic streak and the will to search for stories to tell. Unfortunately, the comedic times of yesteryear have vanished. The central part is then verbose and seems to demonstrate how much the Roman author did not have the heart to cut off his beloved interpreters.

title: Spy Kids 2: Island of Lost Dreams
actors: Antonio Banderas, Carla Gugino, Alexa PenaVega, Daryl Sabara
description: Carmen and Juni, children of Gregorio and Ingrid Cortez, after saving their parents from kidnapping, have grown up and are now ready to face their first mission. The Cortez family must protect the world from a mad scientist who lives on a volcanic island populated by fantastic creatures: since none of their tools work there, the four will have to rely only on their own strength ...
notes: A more hilarious sequel than the first episode: the attention of underage viewers is constantly kept alive. From a narrative point of view, the mysterious island resembles certain playstation places and the paratechnological sets of the real 007.

title: Hatuna meuheret
actors: Lior Ashkenazi, Ronit Elkabetz, Moni Moshonov, Lili Koshashvili
description: Georgian Zaza, who is studying for a doctorate in philosophy, is forced to indulge his mother Lili and father Yasha. The two drag their son to meet teenage virgins from good families who could turn out to be suitable brides for him. The problem is that he has a serious relationship with the thirty-four-year-old Moroccan divorcee Judith, mother of a six-year-old Madona.
notes: The film, while not delving into its characters much, provides true portraits. The grotesque of the film might seem excessive at times: but it is clear however that the evil portrayed by the film is not Jewish traditionalism, but the petty bourgeoisie, horrendous in Israel as everywhere.

title: Darkness
actors: Lena Olin, Anna Paquin, Iain Glen, Giancarlo Giannini, Fele Martinez
description: Regina and her family have moved into a new home. Since taking over the house, his parents have been behaving abnormally and his little brother appears to be at the mercy of a dark force called Darkness. Will Regina be able to discover the truth and defeat what threatens them?
notes: Balagueró, who uses American money (from Dimension, the horror arm of Miramax), wants to be an author but is too lame; on the other hand, he can't even get down to pure gender, because it's as if he's afraid of getting dirty. And then it remains in the void: as in any TV miniseries.

title: Gli insoliti ignoti
actors: Valerio Mastandrea, Marco Giallini, Pierfrancesco Favino, Carlotta Natoli, Paolo Ferrari, Alberto Gimignani, Ines Nobili, Marco Puglia
description: The Roman electrician Cosimo, married to Marisa and with a dependent child, is a victim of consumerism that periodically leads him to go into debt. To supplement his finances, he "helps" his friend Ruggero to carry out some thefts against tourists visiting the capital. One day, the two thieves have a big chance: Cosimo learns that the Marquis Caspani would like to get back into possession of a Van Gogh which, due to an intricate history, is now owned by a museum. The plan requires the complicity of Marisa, who provides security service in the art gallery where the painting is kept. The three get to work ...

title: Winning London
actors: Mary-Kate Olsen, Ashley Olsen, Eric Jungmann, Brandon Tyler
description: Arrived in the British capital to represent the United States at a student reunion, the twins Chloe and Riley Lawrence do not spare themselves: in addition to successfully practicing polo, dedicating themselves to shopping and exploring the most romantic corners of the city, they have some experiences that they will mature ...

title: Dark Blue
actors: Kurt Russell, Scott Speedman, Brendan Gleeson, Michael Michele
description: Los Angeles, 1992. The city lives in anticipation of the verdict relating to the beating of Rodney King by the police. In this red-hot climate, Sergeant Eldon and recruit Bobby investigate a brutal murder that took place in a liquor store. The investigations bring to light the climate of intimidation and corruption widespread among the police.
notes: Ron Shelton, screenwriter David Ayer (_Training Day_) and especially James Ellroy (his subject), wallow in the violence of the metropolis and say non-trivial things about the ambiguity of its "legal" use (how far a cop can go) and on the limits of its representability. Too bad for the conciliatory ending.

title: I Remember Mama
actors: Irene Dunne, Barbara Bel Geddes, Oskar Homolka, Edgar Bergen
description: San Francisco, 1910: The life of the Hansen, immigrants from Norway, revolves around their tenacious and energetic mother and her efforts to make ends meet. Joys and pains, aspirations and daily problems of that time are recalled with affection by his daughter Katrin, who became a writer ...
notes: Great cast and engaging storytelling.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
actors: Elijah Wood, Sean Astin, Viggo Mortensen, Orlando Bloom, Ian McKellen, Christopher Lee, Billy Boyd, Liv Tyler, Cate Blanchett, John Rhys-Davies, Bernard Hill, Hugo Weaving, Miranda Otto, David Wenham, Andy Serkis
description: After Boromir's death and Gandalf's disappearance, the Community split into three. Frodo and Sam, lost in the hills of Emyn Muil, discover that they are being chased by Gollum, a creature corrupted by the Ring. He promises the Hobbits to lead them to the Black Gate of Mordor; through Middle-earth, Aragorn, Legolas and Gimli set course for Rohan, the kingdom under siege by Theoden. This great ruler, manipulated by Saruman's spy, the sinister Serpent's Tongue, has now fallen under the influence of the evil Wizard. Meanwhile, the Hobbits Merry and Pippin, prisoners of the Uruk-hai, have escaped and discovered in Fangorn Forest an unexpected ally, the guardian of the trees and member of an ancient plant people. Frodo and Sam, to storm the tower of Orthanc and escape the onslaught of the Black Knights, will ask for their help ...
notes: Behind the sumptuous special effects, a very precise and passionate iconographic culture shines through, which never makes us regret the flights of the imagination evoked by Tolkien's pages. Jackson - who, despite all the gore he did at the beginning of his career (or perhaps he did it in the key of exorcism), must be a great romantic - manages to reconcile his passion for horror with transport of the adventure and the lightness of the fairy tale, bringing out to the surface of the latter roots that are always and in any case horrifying, painful, more than human.

title: Dragonheart: A New Beginning
actors: Christopher Masterson, Harry Van Gorkum, Rona Figueroa
description: More than a sequel, a remake that uses his name: Geoff, a young stable boy, cultivates the dream of becoming a knight. He is brave and bold, but he misses the opportunity to prove it. To put him on the right path is Drake, the last dragon still alive, who becomes his comrade in arms. Together they become two heroes, but then ...

title: Navigators of the Space
actors: Jesse Dann, Ieanna Belle, Gregory Badgewell, Christine Keegan
description: Navigated on Earth aboard an alien spaceship, the Android Jay7 is helped to return to his planet by the twelve year old Bob. But when the boy returns to our world, he discovers that in the meantime five years have passed ...
notes: Fifth film by Teti, also known with the pseudonyms "Mark Davis" and "A. Maker".

title: Twister
actors: Harry Dean Stanton, Lois Chiles, Suzy Amis, Jenny Wright, Crispin Glover
description: The arrival of a storm traps the bizarre parentado of the old Cleveland in his farm in Kansas. The patriarch has a relationship with Virginia, a television evangelist; The sons Maureen and Howdy, the latter's girlfriend and a colored housekeeper, also live on the place ...
notes: Not to be confused with the homonymous film by Jan de Bont.

title: Tadpole
actors: Aaron Stanford, Sigourney Weaver, Bebe Neuwirth, John Ritter
description: Oscar is sensitive, speaks French perfectly, is passionate about classical literature, knows everything about Voltaire and is able to discover in the blink of an eye everything a woman might be interested in. The fact is, Oscar is only 15 years old! When a beautiful forty-year-old friend of her parents' family realizes the boy's infatuation with her, things start to get complicated ...
notes: Between savory and learned quotes that intersperse the placid story, this _Tadpole_ (which means "tadpole" in the sense of the frog) has all the air of a remake of the truffautian _Baci rubati_, immersed in the autumn New York of a Woody Allen without the anxiety of the joke.

title: Catch Me If You Can
actors: Leonardo DiCaprio, Tom Hanks, Christopher Walken, Martin Sheen, Nathalie Baye
description: Frank W. Abagnale is a skilled scammer. Although he is not yet twenty-one, he has already taken on a thousand different identities: doctor, lawyer, airline pilot, history teacher, assistant to the Attorney General ... Thanks to his extraordinary ability as a forger, he has saved up a fortune: over six Millions of dollars. On his trail is agent Carl Hanratty, intent on capturing the one who entered the FBI lists as the youngest criminal of all time ...
notes: Spielberg avoids vintage charms and keeps nostalgic quotationism under strict control: television series and cinema heroes come into play because they are functional to the narrative, because Dr. Kildare, Perry Mason and James Bond serve Frank as models for his successive personifications. Thus, the story of Frank Abagnale (which is, in both reality and fiction, "a happy ending") becomes an ideal American parable. It begins with the merciless collapse of the Dream (the failure of Frank's father - a great Christopher Walken - weighs on the whole film with his bewildered bitterness and his disarmed desire to start over), continues with the unconscious thrill of the scam (of the opportunity to become anyone you want, to obtain degrees with only three weeks of study, to jump to the top of the social ladder: but wasn't this the real dream?) and ends with the mockery of the passage to the Law, which has a desperate need of scammers to grab others.

title: Gangs of New York
country: United States, Germany, Italy, Great Britain, Netherlands
actors: Leonardo DiCaprio, Daniel Day-Lewis, Cameron Diaz, Jim Broadbent, John C. Reilly, Henry Thomas, Liam Neeson, Brendan Gleeson, Eddie Marsan, David Hemmings
description: New York, second half of the 19th century: Americans and Irish immigrants are fighting to divide up the territory and the management of illicit affairs. In particular, the challenge is between the "Dead Rabbits", led by the young Amsterdam Vallon, and the "Natives", led by the ruthless Bill Poole known as "the Butcher". The clash is getting more and more ferocious, because Amsterdam is driven by the desire to avenge the death of his father, who was murdered by Poole some time ago. In turn, Poole wants to kill the young Vallon to definitively assert his dominance over the city ...
notes: Barbaric, extreme and dizzying, the film is based on a mathematical clarity of purpose: the history of peoples and races (all) is made with blood, with quarters of a pound torn from the body of the vanquished enemies, with revenge that shakes the generations, with blind hatred towards an "other" (any one). Each blow exhibits or hides its wounds, each race counts its dead and each city its craters and cemeteries. Among the characters of Scorsese (and of the screenwriters Jay Cocks, Steven Zaillian and Kenneth Lonergan, from a book by Herbert Asbury) there is not one who is totally bad: even Bill the Butcher has chivalrous heights and tragic moments of intimacy and doubt. ; while Amsterdam does not hesitate for a moment to appropriate the weapons and obscene fury of enemies and predecessors. And when everything stops for a moment, smoke, rubble, silence and dust remain; and civilizations rise on the tombstones. Yesterday like today.

title: Les morsures de l'aube
actors: Guillaume Canet, Asia Argento, Gérard Lanvin, Vincent Perez, Orazio Massaro
description: Antoine, a handsome squatter, lives at night trying to latch into the clubs and boasting important friendships: like the one with Jordan Charlier, dark lord of darkness. Cornered, the young man is forced to find Jordan and his sister Violaine to settle some bills ...
notes: Based on a short story by Tonino Benacquista, de Caunes' first feature film is an unsolved horror / noir that handles (badly) burning materials: incest, the fascination of violence, marginality. The sequence in which Violaine makes love with Antoine would like to be a tribute to Coppola's _Dracula_, but ends up being just grotesque.

title: Prendimi l'anima
actors: Iain Glen, Emilia Fox, Craig Ferguson, Caroline Ducey
description: Sabina Spielrein, a Jewish girl of Russian origin suffering from a severe form of hysteria, was successfully treated in Zurich by the young Carl Gustav Jung. During the therapy Sabina found herself madly in love with her analyst. Freud was also involved in the affair, at the time Jung's "godfather", who sided with his "elective son", leaving Sabina helpless.
notes: Dotted with spinning carts, flashbacks, soft focus images, free associations (the fawn / the woman, the pack of dogs / the Nazis), _Catch me my soul_ belongs to the category of old cinema that passes off kitsch as art and culture.

title: Giovani
actors: Davide Pasti, Gallianne Palayret, Davide Zaccaro, Lina Sastri
description: Matteo and Juliette are both twenty years old. Both of them find themselves having to face very difficult choices on a human level. The first would like to avoid further suffering to the seriously ill mother. The second, a French student in Italy, faces probable motherhood, the result of her love affair with her professor, a married man with whom she is in love.
notes: The Mazzieri brothers give their sorrowful (partly autobiographical) film a sincerity that is difficult to find on the screens and among today's authors. There is an air of "Before the Revolution", with a leaden and severe Parma that, on more than one occasion, lights up with courageous (in) suffering. There Looker and the fists are out of his pocket, ready to take a piece of life.

title: Ticket to Jerusalem
actors: Ghassan Abbas, Areen Omari, Imad Farageen, George Ibrahim, Reem Ilo
description: Jaber and Sanah, a Palestinian couple, spend their lives in a refugee camp near Ramallah. He shoots the West Side with a kind of mobile cinema, while she serves as a volunteer in the emergency services of the Red Crescent Society. One day Jaber is invited by a teacher, Rabab, to show a film in the old part of Gersulamme. To cope with the risks, start by examining the many difficulties for eventual projection. He will find himself involved in the problems of Rabab's old mother.

title: S*p*Y*S*
actors: Elliott Gould, Donald Sutherland, Zouzou, Joss Ackland, Shane Rimmer
description: Two American agents in the service of the CIA, Griff and Bruland, traveling to Paris after a heated meeting, agree to play the triple game against the Americans, the Russians and the Chinese themselves.
notes: Clumsy attempt to revive the Gould-Sutherland couple, seen four years earlier in M.A.S.H.

title: Papà per una notte
actors: Clelia Matania, Sergio Tofano, Carlo Romano, Leonardo Cortese
description: To obtain permission to marry with her father's secretary, the daughter of an industrialist makes her parent believe that she has had a child with her suitor. The situation becomes complicated when the real father of the child turns up.
notes: Spenta pochade from Jean de Létraz's "Bichon", a classic of vaudeville.

title: Senjo no Merii Kurisumasu
actors: David Bowie, Ryuichi Sakamoto, Tom Conti, Takeshi Kitano
description: Java, 1942: British Major Jack Celliers arrives at the Japanese prison camp commanded by the young Captain Yonoi. The latter, who firmly believes in the principles of discipline, honor and glory, considers the inmates to be enemies of cowards who have preferred surrender to suicide: little by little, a complex relationship is established between the two officers, tinged with sexual attraction. ..
notes: From the novel by Sir Laurence van der Post, Oshima and Paul Mayersberg extract a story poised between homoerotic dynamics and meeting / clash between cultures. Functional the two rock stars protagonists, extraordinary Kitano in the role of Sergeant Hara.

title: Hotel
actors: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Valentina Cervi, Valeria Golino, Rhys Ifans, Mia Maestro
description: The most varied characters meet in a luxurious nineteenth-century hotel on the Lido of Venice: a corrupt politician from Eastern Europe deals with some shady deals; Sophie, a high-profile prostitute, has her "office" in one of the suites; a film crew shoots with great difficulty; Magic, a professional killer, cultivates bizarre sexual habits; former actor Quintus is now a tour guide, but hides a secret. And then there is a particularly curious waitress ...
notes: Figgis continues the research inaugurated in 2000 with "Timecode": a screen divided into four parts, with different stories that unfold simultaneously.

title: Pasazerka
actors: Aleksandra Slaska, Anna Ciepielewska, Jan Kreczmar, Marek Walczewski
description: Seeing Marta on a ship bound for Canada, Liza thinks she recognizes her as one of the Jewish prisoners she had been overseer at Auschwitz. Lise describes her to her husband as his protégé, but things had gone differently ...
notes: Masterpiece left unfinished by Munk, who died in a car accident in '61.

title: The Spanish Main
actors: Paul Henreid, Maureen O'Hara, Walter Slezak, Binnie Barnes
description: Shipwrecked on the Spanish island of Cartagena, the Dutch captain van Horn and his crew are condemned to the gallows, but they manage to escape and commit themselves to piracy by capturing Francisca, girlfriend of the corrupt governor Don Alvarado ...
notes: Great public success for the (not exceptional) first Rko film shot in Technicolor.

title: The Land Before Time VII: The Stone of Cold Fire
description: Finding a "stone of cold fire" that fell from the sky at night: this is the aim of the research undertaken by Piedino and his friends. Even Pterano, Piedino's uncle, says he wants to participate in the expedition, but his secret hope is another: to take possession of the stone, which he believes has magical powers ...

title: Desiderio 'e sole
actors: Virna Lisi, Giacomo Rondinella, Otello Toso, Rosalia Maggio, Lianella Carell, John Kitzmiller
description: Laura, rich and orphan, and her cousin Luciano, who studies engineering but is forced by poverty to work as a worker, love each other. Their sentiment is opposed by the malevolent Aunt Clara, Laura's guardian. Dismissed, Luciano finds a job in England ...
notes: Pàstina re-proposes the traditional patterns of the popular melon, but the outcome does not rise from banality.

title: Il cuore altrove
actors: Neri Marcoré, Vanessa Incontrada, Nino D'Angelo, Giancarlo Giannini, Giulio Bosetti
description: Rome, 1920s. The thirty-five-year-old Nello Balocchi is a shy and awkward man who is sent by his father to teach in a high school in Bologna with the hope that he will finally find a wife, guaranteeing the descent to the family. In Bologna, Nello shares a room in a boarding house with a Neapolitan barber who successfully initiates him into sex. One day he ends up in an institution for the blind and meets a beautiful and unscrupulous girl with whom he falls madly in love. It is the beginning of a love story between two "different" ones.
notes: Pupi Avati has the gift of framing the whiteness of the soul of some character-creatures and the minute, subtle, suffused poetry of everyday life.

title: Tortilla Soup
actors: Hector Elizondo, Elizabeth Peña, Jacqueline Obradors, Tamara Mello, Raquel Welch
description: The three young sisters Carmen, Maribel and Leticia try to get along with their father Martin, a Mexican immigrant with his family in the United States who imposes a single rule on them: to be all home for Sunday night dinner. No excuse is valid for missing the appointment which is also the moment when discussions and conflicts come to the surface.
notes: "Spanglish" comedy, with idiomatic intertwining, sentimental spice and ethnic sit-ups. The rather anonymous direction and the slightly too limp script are redeemed by a good group of interpreters.

title: L'auberge espagnole
actors: Romain Duris, Judith Godrèche, Audrey Tautou, Cécile De France
description: Thanks to the Erasmus project, the young Frenchman Xavier moved to Barcelona to continue his economics studies. Here she shares an apartment with an Italian, an Englishwoman, an Andalusian, a German and a Belgian: at first she struggles not a little to integrate and feels a strong desire to go home, but over time she will get to know her roommates and the different cultures to which they belong. It will be an opportunity to question certainties and to embrace precariousness as a rule of life ...
notes: Klapisch has a streak of agreeable mediocrity, and his plays - including this one - gracefully cheer without touching universal ambitions.

title: Morte di un amico
actors: Gianni Garko, Spiros Focas, Didi Perego, Angela Luce, Fanfulla
description: Bruno, orphan and lazy, is supported by his partner, the prostitute Franca.
