His friend Aldo instead lives with his mother and siblings; his laziness, however, prevents him from finding work and settling down, so that - following Bruno's bad advice - he ends up tying up with Lea, a "colleague" of Franca's. The bad end of the latter leads Aldo to abandon Lea for the honest and simple Adriana, but fate has tragic developments in store ...
notes: Echoes of "violent lives" in a film that in fact takes its cue from a subject signed - among others - by Pasolini and Giuseppe Berto. In spite of this, the results are not entirely faithful to the premises.

title: Honogurai mizu no soko kara
actors: Hitomi Kuroki, Rio Kanno, Asami Mizukawa, Mirei Oguchi
description: Yoshimi and her little daughter, disputed by her ex-husband, move into the apartment of a cold building. Due to an infiltration, drops of water begin to fall into the house from the ceiling. What's more, Yoshimi is terrified of strange apparitions, ghostly presences linked to the story of a little girl killed a couple of years earlier in that building ...
notes: From the author of the cult movie Ring, a new horror that enters the head straight like a knife. Twenty-four carat fright and original views on gender and its stereotypes (such as water, the "deadly" element). Not a masterpiece, but having us ...

title: La vie est un long fleuve tranquille
actors: Benoît Magimel, Valérie Lalande, Tara Romer, Daniel Gélin, Emmanuel Grendrier
description: The life of 12-year-olds Momo Groseille and Bernadette Le Quesnoy changes dramatically when it is discovered that all this time they have been raised and raised ... by the wrong family! The fact is that the Groseille and Le Quesnoy have very different social backgrounds: the former proletarian and coarse, the latter wealthy and refined. The two clans agree (economically) for Bernadette to stay with her adoptive parents, but for both her and Momo the new situation is somewhat unsettling ...
notes: The film was a great success at home, but the ambitions of social satire are rose water and the starting point is short of breath.

title: White Oleander
actors: Alison Lohman, Michelle Pfeiffer, Robin Wright, Renée Zellweger
description: At the age of 15, Astrid witnesses the arrest of her mother Ingrid, a fascinating woman who in a fit of anger killed her unfaithful lover. Thus began for the girl the odyssey between a series of families who welcome her into foster care. Starr, the first foster mother, is an ex-topless bar dancer and ex-alcoholic who discovered Christianity and convinces Astrid to get baptized. After this first experience ends tragically, Astrid is entrusted to Claire, a tender and vulnerable woman who bonds deeply with the girl. But to gain her autonomy, Astrid will have to break free from the past and discover the value of independence and forgiveness.
notes: The Janet Fitch book from which Peter Kosminsky made the film was sponsored by the powerful American television star Ophra Winfrey and became a best seller. Characters, plot, ulcerated wounds, "out of control" psychologies are more of a soap opera than a classic novel. This means a conventional and not unpredictable story. But the film is well done and well acted.

title: Il segreto del successo
actors: Paolo Maria Veronica, Roberto Malandrino, Antonio Catania, Enzo Iacchetti
description: Cico and Bob are two friends who act as actors for a living, but without success. One day they are given up for dead in the fire of their home. Enzo Iacchetti, a longtime friend, gives the news of their tragic death during "Striscia la storia". This is enough to spark media attention: suddenly the national press begins to take an interest in their works, lamenting the untimely death of two unfortunate as well as extraordinary actors. Cico and Bob are naturally alive and well and above all in the dark about everything. It is their manager who sees the possibility of exploiting the misunderstanding by turning it into a gold mine.
notes: The "true" (some filmed documents and some testimonies) and very fictionalized story of the two protagonists allows the director to shoot a bitter and unusual comedy about the cialtroneria of the television paratext.

title: Da wan
actors: Donald Sutherland, Ge You, Rosamund Kwan, Paul Mazursky, Ying Da
description: While filming inside the Forbidden City in Beijing, with hundreds of costumed extras, the well-known director Don Tyler is seized by a creative block, aggravated by a sudden illness. The producer decides to suspend filming, which throws Tyler into a depressive state. Only friendship with the operator YoYo seems to alleviate his pains, and it is to him that the director turns to see his last wish fulfilled: an extravagant and very expensive funeral ceremony ...
notes: The story twists into secondary episodes until it reaches a sticky conclusion, between winks of cinephile and the cunning of an exhibitionist direction.

title: Moonlight Mile
actors: Dustin Hoffman, Susan Sarandon, Holly Hunter, Jake Gyllenhaal, Ellen Pompeo, Dabney Coleman
description: New England, 1973. Joe Nast is about to get married, but unexpectedly his future wife dies. The young man believes it is his duty to remain tied to his girlfriend's parents (especially since the girl's father, a real estate agent, wants him to join the family business), but against his best intentions he ends up falling in love with another woman. Joe is torn between his role as a grieving husband and perfect son-in-law and the voice of his heart.
notes: The ostentation of the committed subtexts ("the private is political", as it was said at the time) and the didactic proof of the actors (especially Sarandon and Hoffman) end up mortifying the underlying intellectual honesty.

title: About Schmidt
actors: Jack Nicholson, Kathy Bates, Hope Davis, Dermot Mulroney, June Squibb
description: Omaha, Nebraska: After spending most of his working life in a large insurance company, time for retirement has come for Warren Schmidt. The man is in a delicate phase, especially as his only daughter - who lives and works in Denver - is about to marry a waterbed salesman whom he deeply despises. Suddenly his wife Helen dies, leaving him only after 42 years of marriage: finding himself drawing an existential balance, Warren realizes that probably there will be no trace of his passage on Earth and decides to take action, trying to convince his daughter. not to marry an inept ...
notes: Payne's cross-section clashes with the forced optimism of the Bush era: boredom governs the days of the inhabitants of the only surviving imperialist power, the "last dinners" of the company celebrated before taking the avenue of sunset. Stunned by the "well-being", sad and lonely, nuclearized in favor-houses in which the flaps are an obligation and the transgressions are tiles that hide mines, citizens like Warren Schmidt are ghosts of virtual cities (civilizations). In addition to having at his disposal the controlled gigionism of a Nicholson (who can now afford every move and every tic), Payne writes lucid and compassionate pages on a still and immobile country, in which a long-distance adoption in an Africa evoked and far away can neutralize - at least in part - strong feelings of guilt.

title: Possessed
actors: Timothy Dalton, Henry Czerny, Christopher Plummer, Piper Laurie
description: 1949: the war traumas deeply affected Father Bowdern, a Jesuit and veteran of the Second World War. While administering his pastoral activity in a parish in St. Louis, the priest is struck by the case concerning the young Robbie, who in addition to bearing some strange and mysterious signs on his body appears under the influence of a spirit of otherworldly origin. Robbie's family believes that the boy is possessed by the devil: an opinion shared by Father Bowdern himself, who after having asked and obtained the consent of the competent authorities in the Vatican, undertakes the long and painful process of exorcizing the Evil One.

title: L'amoureuse
actors: Charlotte Gainsbourg, Yvan Attal, Thomas Langmann
description: Marie and Antoine live together, are in love, but she wants to have a child and he doesn't feel ready at all. Marie meets Paul and after a first resistance he falls in love with him. He remains pregnant and the doubts arrive with the child: will he be the son of Antoine or Paul? Gorgeous test by Charlotte Gainsbourg, daughter of the great Serge. But the film suffers too much the intimate minimalism of its author, exponent of the French poetic that vaguely self -referential (and "umbilical") who opens up to considerable moments of cinema and then closes on verbosity and reflexivity at all costs.XXXV.O.S.T. XXX

title: L'uomo della valle maledetta
actors: Ty Hardin, Iran Eory, Peter Larry, José Nieto
description: Despite her father's ban, Gwen marries the Indian Torito and follows him to his camp. When the latter is attacked by an enemy tribe, the girl is kidnapped: however, she manages to escape and is saved by Johnny, a lonely cowboy ...
notes: Extended and "static" times for an intimist western.

title: Code 11 - 14
actors: David James Elliott, Terry Farrell, Stephen Lang, Nancy Chambers
description: Two women killed, found with their hands tied and with their photos cut out next to the bodies: these are the cases federal agent Novak is working on. When a third murder takes place - in the same way - on the plane that is bringing him home from Sydney, Novak realizes that the killer is among the passengers (or among the crew) ...

title: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
description: The evil Queen has a little stepdaughter, the kind Snow White, but she treats her with contempt. Years later, interrogating the magic mirror, he learns that the fairest girl in the realm is precisely the girl; rose with envy, the sovereign orders her to be suppressed. Moved by Snow White's grace, the assassin sets her free in the woods, where she is rescued by animals and hosted by the Seven Dwarfs. But the cruel Queen, having discovered the truth, gives up her magical arts and devises a spell ...
notes: What to say? The first, very famous (and technically revolutionary) fully animated feature film ever, the perfect synthesis of the Disney style.

title: Ricordati di me
actors: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Laura Morante, Nicoletta Romanoff, Silvio Muccino, Monica Bellucci, Gabriele Lavia, Enrico Silvestrin, Silvia Cohen, Alberto Gimignani, Andrea Sama, Amanda Sandrelli
description: Giulia is a teacher in high school, but her dream as a girl was to become an actress. Her husband Carlo is an employee of a financial company, but her aspiration was to write. The two were forced to put aside their dreams for the arrival of their children, now teenagers. And while Valentina, the youngest, is determined to pursue a career as a television showgirl, Carlo has an encounter that awakens dormant desires in him ...
notes: Muccino tries to stage a sort of snapshot of Italy today, between families in crisis and "cathodic" flattery, but the result lacks excessive superficiality and Manichaean didacticism.

title: Chicago
actors: Renée Zellweger, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Richard Gere, Queen Latifah, Taye Diggs, John C. Reilly
description: 1920s: Roxie Hart aspires to escape from a monotonous life by following in the footsteps of Velma Kelly, a vaudeville artist. His dream comes true when the two women end up in the same cell, accused of two different murders. Thanks to the help of "Mama" Morton, the matron of the prison, the legendary lawyer Billy Flynn agrees to defend Roxie and has her exonerated: at this point the girl's career explodes, but ...
notes: Coming from the theater, newcomer Marshall prepares sumptuous numbers and cruelly cuts them on editing, often using oblique angles that give the whole a distorting anguish. Someone thought of comparing this film to _Moulin Rouge_ (perhaps due to the absence of total fields in the numbers and their uninterrupted editing), while the only justified - even necessary - comparison should be made with _Cabaret_, the film with which in the 1972 also exploded on the screen the innovative talent of Bob Fosse. There, too, in Germany at the dawn of Nazism, the songs of Sally Bowles and the master of ceremonies were continually "cut" by street images, Nazi thugs, swastika flags, "Groszian" faces, and in any case they were almost never filmed according to a total perspective. If he had not died prematurely, in all probability Fosse would have traveled a path in the cinema that led in the direction of _Chicago_, which after three decades does not seem to betray its neurotic and "jazzy" universe at all.

title: The Man Who Haunted Himself
actors: Roger Moore, Anton Rodgers, Hildegard Neil, Alastair Mackenzie
description: Following a car accident, industrial executive Harold Pelham is hospitalized in the recovery room in desperate conditions. Suddenly regaining consciousness, the man spends a period of convalescence and then returns to his family: from this moment, however, he has the distinct feeling that a double is taking over for him, undermining both his professional and private life. The situation progressively deteriorates, until a dramatic final confrontation on the banks of the Thames ...
notes: Discreet suspense for the latest film by a veteran of English cinema, active since the 40s with the glorious production house Ealing.

title: Digging to China
actors: Evan Rachel Wood, Kevin Bacon, Cathy Moriarty, Mary Stuart Masterson
description: Harriet, a ten-year-old girl can't wait to escape home and family environment. When the woman dies Harriet, who in the meantime has met Ricky, a thirty-year-old who remained in the infant stage, runs away with him.
notes: First film directed by Timothy Hutton.

title: Der Himmel über Berlin
actors: Bruno Ganz, Otto Sander, Peter Falk, Solveig Dommartin
description: Damiel and Cassiel, two angels, roam the streets of Berlin with the mission of listening to the happy or sad thoughts of the people who live in the city. Damiel, who shows himself more involved in the anxieties of human beings, sees Marion, a trapeze artist fired from the circus for which he works and falls in love. The girl is marked by impending loneliness and dark omens of death. An actor, a former angel, who has renounced his true nature and who is making a film about Nazi Germany, will notice his discreet presence.
notes: Wim Wenders tells a modern fairy tale touching on the academicism that will mark some of his later films.

title: Être et avoir
actors: Georges Lopez, gli allievi di Saint-Etienne sur Usson
description: A school with a single class (from kindergarten to fifth grade), in a remote village in the Auvergne mountains. And a single teacher, Georges Lopez, on the verge of retirement.
notes: It is still a very widespread reality in France, and this is perhaps one of the reasons for the enormous success that the film has achieved at home: over two million viewers have seen it, and enthusiastic reviews have put critics and audiences in agreement. . Philibert chose to start from the places and the characters (the teacher and his pupils, some very young), telling with wisdom and lightness an experience - that of the director and, by extension, ours - to the discovery of a world that, in its authenticity, retains something fairytale. The fantasies and doubts of younger children and those of older children, at the first important step in life (from elementary to middle school); the relationship with adults, with the teacher, with teaching and playing, with the same camera, which never hides and yet manages to capture emotions and moods with reserve and modesty. Ultimately, the director realizes a utopia: that of a cinema as a moral act through which to "grow". Having a lot of fun.

title: I Spy
actors: Eddie Murphy, Owen Wilson, Famke Janssen, Malcolm McDowell
description: Special Agent Alex Scott and world middleweight champion form an unlikely alliance to accomplish a highly risky mission: recover the Switchblade, the latest and most sophisticated reconnaissance aircraft created by American scientists. An unscrupulous arms dealer has in fact taken possession of the prototype of the plane and is determined to sell it to the highest bidder, in this case a ruthless terrorist. The strange couple on a special mission fly to Budapest to try to resolve the dramatic situation ...
notes: A comic film without lines and an action film without rhythm: what's worse?

title: Analyze That
actors: Robert De Niro, Billy Crystal, Lisa Kudrow, Joe Viterelli
description: The mafia boss Paul Vitt is about to leave Sing Sing and the FBI agents are baffled: day after day they see the most famous gangster in New York wandering around the cell in a catatonic state and suddenly starting to sing the songs of "West Side Story. ". Not knowing if this is a real breakdown or if he is pretending to speed up his release, the FBI decides to release him on parole and put him in the custody of the analyst who has looked after him in the past, Ben Sobel. The latter would not like to allow man to enter his life again, but he has no choice.
notes: The actors are in good shape, Ramis knows how to direct them, but the pace and the fun weaken almost immediately.

title: La fleur du mal
actors: Bernard Lecoq, Nathalie Baye, Benoît Magimel, Suzanne Flon, Mélanie Doutey
description: A woman is acquitted, despite her guilt, at the end of the Second World War: this is the starting point for following the vicissitudes of the Charpin-Vasseur, leading exponents of the Bordeaux bourgeoisie. Their history is marked by a series of mysterious deaths, as if the guilt were a hereditary defect that is transmitted from generation to generation. A crime committed in the past, and not atoned for, can therefore have repercussions on the descendants ...
notes: Quiet, polite and chilling, Chabrol's film is the stylized, dry, serenely and atrociously pessimistic version of many other stories of families, destinies and provinces told by the French master. There is no longer a need for external intrusions to disturb unhealthy balances, nor for disinherited people who disrupt bourgeois harmonies. The anonymous "crows" are those who have been raised in the bosom: five characters are enough that summarize three generations, and that prophetic time that is always repeated the same as itself and that unfolds without interruption before the eyes of the dean aunt Line (the real protagonist of the film: the slender, very sweet and strong-willed Suzanne Flon, a great interpreter of the past). Chabrol reached the heart of his world and his style: no low blows, malaise is woven into the home upholstery and the "bon ton" clothes of the Charpin-Vasseurs; it takes shape from the manicured garden and the clear air, closed in the stainless awareness of Line's eyes.

title: Sogni d'oro
actors: Nanni Moretti, Piera Degli Esposti, Laura Morante, Alessandro Haber, Remo Remotti
description: Michele Apicella is a young filmmaker who has had success with his films and is continuously requested as a guest for interviews and conferences. He is currently working on a new script entitled "Freud's Mother", but he has to deal with a whole series of obstacles: competition from some colleagues, the insistence of two individuals who want to learn the trade at any cost, and especially the unrequited love for Silvia, a former schoolmate who appears to him in his dreams every night. In the end the film comes out and the welcome is favorable, but Michele's dreams get worse ...
notes: Moretti continues his merciless reconnaissance of the tics and clichés of a generation, showing at the same time the importance that cinema can play in terms of moral choice. Pushing on the pedal of grotesque deformation, he treats demanding issues with irony and follows this path in a period in which Italian cinema is struggling in a particularly serious creative crisis. In the target of the Roman director ends up above all the television, of which the vulgarity of his quiz shows is stigmatized (and we are only in 1981!), Ridiculed during a memorable sequence. A film - as they say - of transition, made after the first sensational successes ("Io sono un autarchico" and "Ecce bombo") and before the transition to a more painful and melancholy creative vein ("Bianca", "La Messa è over ").

title: Solaris
actors: George Clooney, Natascha McElhone, Jeremy Davies
description: Psychologist Chris Kelvin must investigate what happened to the Prometheus space station, orbiting the planet Solaris, which for six months has cut off all communication with the Earth. Upon arriving, Kelvin discovers that the commander has mysteriously died and that the crew is prey to unexplained events ...
notes: While, in 1971, Tarkovsky - with his dilated times and his infinite terrestrial, spatial and mental landscapes - was able to make us penetrate into the coils of Solaris, immersing us in the amniotic fluid of our past and future, Soderbergh succeeds at best in mimic a sense of guilt, to languish on a memory.

title: Confessions of a Dangerous Mind
actors: Sam Rockwell, George Clooney, Drew Barrymore, Julia Roberts, Rutger Hauer
description: Chuck Barris has a double life: during the day he is a famous TV show host, creator of the "reality show" (author of programs such as "The Dating Game", also known in Italy as "The game of couples"); at night he transforms into a ruthless CIA agent, with a predilection for heinous murders. But when love enters her life, the situation is bound to change ...
notes: An iron script (by Charlie Kaufman, author of Being John Malkovich and The Orchid Thief), a protagonist (Sam Rockwell) who printed the young Hoffman / Pacino / Nicholson in his head, a staging that is certainly reminiscent of Lenny , Carnal Knowledge and Marvin's King of the Gardens. Clooney's directorial debut is an ambitious and imperfect film (some too much preciousness, some excess of writing and finishing) which, however, has the enormous advantage of being pessimistic, non-conciliatory, unpleasant and "unfinished".

title: Adaptation.
actors: Nicolas Cage, Tilda Swinton, Meryl Streep, Chris Cooper
description: Screenwriter Charlie Kaufman is adapting The Orchid Thief, a seemingly impenetrable text for the big screen. The novel - written by Susan Orlean, journalist for the "New Yorker" - centers on her meeting with John Laroche, who trades in rare orchids: he clones them and sells them to collectors. Pushed by his twin brother Donald, Charlie tries to get out of his creative crisis, but discovers strange truths about Susan and John ...
notes: Jonze's film is an extremely dangerous spiral game, which not infrequently goes haywire but which undoubtedly, at least for three quarters, involves and intrigues, displaces and (not) makes you think.

title: The Life of David Gale
actors: Kevin Spacey, Kate Winslet, Laura Linney, Gabriel Mann
description: David Gale, a professor at Texas University and a lawyer fighting for the abolition of the death penalty, is unjustly sentenced to death for raping and killing an activist. To prove his innocence, he decides to give an interview to journalist Bitsey Bloom ...
notes: The plot reconstructs Gale's life in a series of tight flashbacks, edited with solid and intense rhythm: Parker's high professionalism emerges forcefully, and the film is powerful if highly questionable. For the series: We have no answers, only questions. And the extreme, agonizing question is contained in the very last shot.

title: 25th Hour
actors: Edward Norton, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Barry Pepper, Rosario Dawson, Anna Paquin
description: Last day of freedom for Monty Brogan, who is about to be jailed: he has to serve seven years for drug dealing. 24 hours to reflect on himself (he would have liked to be a firefighter), on his own destiny (he opted for easy money), recover the bond with his father, take leave of his girlfriend (who is perhaps responsible for the tip), his two best friends, Jacob and Francis, to come to the realization that he has to pay for what he did.
notes: A film about Time: and not so much because it works on the unity of a day, on those twenty-four hours during which Monty puts together the dismembered and neglected pieces of his life as a ferocious, shady and elegant dispenser of despair and death, which he never asked himself so many questions and never tried to answer his rare whys. Lee compresses and dilates time, "cuts" it and slows it down: but it is not a question of stasis or dead time, since the film has a very complex editing and a limited number of scenes. Time becomes space, architecture, topography, metropolitan map in two anthology sequences that corrode, violate and bite the soul of the characters and spectators. In the first, Monty, in front of a bathroom mirror, declaims with rage and helplessness a rap-invective against people, the stories of his beloved hated New York. In the second, Jacob and Francis chat in front of a window while the camera frames their bodies from above and shows what (not) remains of the World Trade Center.

title: Io non ho paura
actors: Giuseppe Bocchino, Aitana Sánchez-Gijón, Giuseppe Cristiano, Mattia Di Pierro, Diego Abatantuono, Dino Abbrescia, Giulia Matturo
description: 1978: A hot summer, with the highest temperatures of the century. In Acque Traverse, a small village in the South, people fight the heat by staying indoors. Only a group of kids roam the streets in the surrounding countryside. Among them is Michele, who during a raid in an abandoned house discovers a terrible secret: the adults of the village keep a peer of his age segregated in a well. Michele talks more and more often with him and brings him food until ...
notes: The film "sees" with the eyes of the two children, feels with their sensibilities, understands on the fly - as all children understand - much more than adults believe. It has their loyalty, their fragility (a big secret in exchange for a toy car, the same secret in exchange for a real driving lesson), their unconscious generosity. The great merit of Salvatores, who drew the story from the novel of the same name by Niccolò Ammanniti and scripted it with the same writer and Francesca Marciano, is to have made a film "at child's height", to have left the great (all the greats) the space they deserve: threatening orcs, or stupid, or - almost always - cowards. While children have not yet learned what cowardice is.

title: En kort en lang
actors: Mads Mikkelsen, Troels Lyby, Charlotte Munck, Jesper Lohmann
description: Jacob is a boy used to getting everything he wants out of life. She has been having a homosexual relationship with Jørgen for some time. Just when the latter asks him to marry him, Jacob falls in love with a girl. But this is not a girl like any other because the lucky one is called Caroline and is married to Jørgen's younger brother.
notes: The operetta - a debut by actress Hella Joof - is cute and pretty, sweetened just enough to please. However, the invoice remains: halfway between comedy and drama, joy and depression, the film feeds on professional actors and is guided by correct direction. Too much too.

title: In This World
actors: Jamal Udin Torabi, Enayatullah, Imran Paracha, Hiddayatullah
description: Jamal and Enayatullah are two young Afghan refugees seeking asylum in England. They had to make a journey full of difficulties and dangers through Iran, Turkey, Italy and France before reaching their destination ...
notes: The film by the director of _Butterfly Kiss_, _Welcome to Sarajevo_ and _The White Traces of Life_ is a _Sciuscià_ reportage already seen a thousand times, complete with voiceover, a false truth reworked in astute and reit (in) erante fiction. His "effort" does not move, does not excite, does not cause jolts, does not trigger controversy. It won the Golden Bear in Berlin, but it is - as they say in Milan - a package.

title: Son frère
actors: Bruno Todeschini, Eric Caravaca, Nathalie Boutefeu, Maurice Garrel, Catherine Ferran, Antoinette Moya, Sylvain Jacques, Fred Ulysse, Robinson Stévenin, Claudine Benichou
description: The brothers Thomas and Luc have not spoken or seen each other for ten years. When Thomas falls ill with a serious illness, Luc runs to his bedside: it's time for both of them to come to terms with the past.
notes: A game of mirrors that Chéreau - inspired by the beautiful book of the same name by Philippe Besson - reconstructs with the pieces of a painful puzzle, observing with compassion, rigor, without tears, like an anthropologist of the flesh, a lighthouse keeper, a lord of the plan of above who already knows the epilogue. No one cries Thomas, everyone processes mourning in his own way: here too Chéreau is interested in the evolution of reactions, in the resistance to the unsustainability of things (Thomas's girlfriend who can't hold up, the parents who continue to argue how in the living room). Luc (the good Eric Caravaca) is the director's alter ego, while the great old Maurice Garrel is a sort of Charon: he accompanies Thomas to his sealed destiny. Anatomy of Hell. Silver Bear in Berlin 2003.

title: Alex
actors: Lauren Jackson, Josh Picker, Chris Haywood, Catherine Godbold
description: The very young New Zealander Alex Archer trains hard to qualify for the Rome Olympics in the 100m freestyle. But in addition to school commitments, she will also have to face the tragic death of her boyfriend ...
notes: From the antipodes, an uplifting and well-meaning story with a sporting background.

title: Ying xiong
actors: Tony Leung Chiu Wai, Jet Li, Zhang Ziyi, Maggie Cheung, Donnie Yen
description: Qin Shihuang, the first emperor of China, unified the country by subduing six states to war and imposing a regime that provided for the execution of anyone suspected of infidelity. Four heroes (three men - the nameless assassin, Broken Sword and Sky - and one woman - Flying Snow) attempt to assassinate him.
notes: Hero is the scholastic layout of a feeling and a vision. We end up in the new age, which is the furthest away from the philosophy, even stylistic, of the genre. You never hear a heartbeat, because romance, like the rest, turns out to be wrapping paper. We haven't seen The Forest of Flying Daggers, but if the way to renew the glories of a history of cinema is this ...

title: Sono yo no tsuma
actors: Tokihiko Okada, Emiko Yagumo
description: In an extreme attempt to save the life of his seriously ill child, a man commits a crime. A policeman starts looking for him, but he will have to deal with the moral dilemmas involved in the situation.
notes: The style is far from that of the mature Ozu, but there is no shortage of reasons for interest.

title: Rakudai wa shita keredo
actors: Tomio Aoki, Kaoru Futaba, Tatsuo Saito, Kinuyo Tanaka
description: In the run-up to a particularly difficult exam, some students devise a ruse aimed at copying. The outcome, however, will be disastrous ...
notes: School-based comedies were popular in Japanese silent cinema. This, lively and fun, was shot by Ozu in about ten days.

title: Shukujo wa nani o wasuretaka
actors: Sumiko Kurishima, Tatsuo Saito, Tomio Aoki, Masao Hayama
description: In Tokyo, in a beautiful mansion located in the residential district of Kojimachi, lives a rich and austere professor in the company of his frivolous and idle wife. She would have gladly submitted her husband to her will, but ...
notes: The rise / fall in the social ladder is the theme of Ozu's 37th film.

title: Un dollaro per sette vigliacchi
actors: Dustin Hoffman, Elsa Martinelli, Cesar Romero, Gustavo Rojo
description: After the brutal murder, which took place in Rome, of the gangster Tony Madigan, of Italian origin but expelled from the US as undesirable, the US tax authorities mandate agent Frank Putzu to recover the substantial sum (one million dollars) robbed and subsequently hidden by the Madigan himself. Putzu - who is not a lightning bolt of war - encounters many difficulties in collaborating with the local police and does not have an easy life even with the band of the "Baron", which in turn is on the trail of the loot ...
notes: The presence of a very young Hoffman is the only reason for interest in an otherwise very mediocre film. Martinelli is always beautiful.

title: Target Earth
actors: Christopher Meloni, Marcia Cross, John C. McGinley, Melinda Culea
description: Detective Sam is not resigned to the disappearance of his wife Beth four years ago. Tammy, a six-year-old daughter of Karen, a single mother, also disappears while playing in the backyard. Sam accidentally finds her unconscious. The little girl writes incomprehensible symbols and letters.

title: Svitati
actors: Ezio Greggio, Mel Brooks, Gianfranco Barra, Randi Ingerman
description: Bernardo, the bungling son and troublemaker of the industrialist Guido, angers his father to the point of causing him a heart attack. On his deathbed, Guido asks the boy to do him a favor: to track down an American soldier who had saved his life during the last conflict. Bernardo leaves for the United States and, after long searches, manages to track him down. The man's name is Jack and he has been hospitalized for thirty years in an asylum. Guido's son, determined to carry out his mission, makes him escape. At their heels comes Barbara, the doctor who is treating him.
notes: Messy and sloppy comic mess.

title: Sicario 77 vivo o morto
actors: Robert Mark, Alicia Brandet, José Bodalo, Monica Randall, John Stacy
description: The agent of the English counterintelligence Lester, known in the environment with the nickname of End because it always brings each mission to be completed, comes from the American counterintelligence. They would like to neutralize Mr. Heep a criminal who intends to bomb the atomic arsenals of superpowers. Mister Heep wants to know the keyword from the agent to operate the Black Bird, a long -autonomous English plane he thinks he steals to implement his criminal plans.
notes: The film ends up becoming a parody of the espionage films that were fashionable in the sixties.

title: Il mantenuto
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Ilaria Occhini, Grete Rabsham, Pinuccia Nava
description: The honest employee Stefano Gardelli becomes, despite himself and without realizing it, the friend and protector of a girl of easy virtue. The man is targeted by the real exploiters of the woman and placed under police surveillance. The agents were alarmed by Stefano's participation in a union meeting attended by some girls from the company where Gardelli works. Even the president of the company Stefano works for falls into the misunderstanding and fires him. Meanwhile, the former employee ends up in the clutches of a widow.
notes: Disappointing debut of Ugo Tognazzi behind the camera.

title: 8 mile
actors: Eminem, Kim Basinger, Brittany Murphy, Mekhi Phifer
description: Detroit, 1995. Decay has taken hold of the city: the once affluent neighborhoods have been abandoned by its inhabitants, partly due to one of the most violent riots in US history. 8 Mile Road is the road that divides the city from the suburbs, whites from blacks. Behind this difficult condition, however, there is a long tradition of creativity that has found expression above all in music. Even now, hip hop remains the only way for many to still feel alive. This is the case of Jimmy Smith jr. who with his friends Future, Sol, Dj Iz and Cheddar Bob - who make up his alternative family - has created a group, the Three One Third with whom he hopes to change his life.
notes: You could read _8 Mile_ as a "gang-movie", an opera about an alternative metropolitan battle: instead of punches, knives and bullets, a barrage of jokes (often no less painful and bloody). The other side of _The warriors of the night_: then yes it would become a good movie. Unfortunately, it looks more like a macho _Flashdance_.

title: Hypercube. Cube 2
actors: Geraint Wyn Davies, Kari Matchett, Neil Crone, Matthew Ferguson
description: Eight strangers (four men and four women) awaken in a labyrinth without knowing how, when or why they were trapped in this four-dimensional construction (the hypercube). To survive, they must move through an infinite series of interconnected rooms, anticipating and predicting the phenomena that can suddenly occur and disintegrate anyone who gets trapped. The eight prisoners together must face this unknown environment as well as their secrets, their fears and themselves.
notes: The obstacles, the panels, the optical games, the countdowns are standard, and as such, odorless and tasteless. Just like the interpreters.

title: The Ring
actors: Naomi Watts, Martin Henderson, David Dorfman, Brian Cox
description: It looks like one of the usual urban legends: the projection of a videotape containing nightmare images is followed by a phone call announcing the viewer's death seven days after the vision. Journalist Rachel Keller is rather skeptical of the story, until four teenagers die under mysterious circumstances exactly a week after seeing the tape in question. To investigate what happened, Rachel does everything to get hold of the video and watches it: at this point only her friend Noah can help her discover the mystery ...
notes: Screenwriter Ehren Krueger has succeeded in that very difficult task that should be the main purpose of any self-respecting remake: adaptation. Because if it is true that the American _Ring_ is very similar to the Japanese prototype signed in 1998 by Hideo Nakata (at the base there is always the novel by Koji Suzuki), it is at the same time also very different, beyond the real additions or subtractions . The initial sequence confirms this: identical situation in both, but different environmental and "cultural" context. For Krueger and Verbinski, the incipit therefore serves to identify a horror imaginary that during the film, backwards, will touch many stages, even touching the gothic, with the history of the murderous videotape digging into the heart of a form and a genre. _The Ring_ then becomes a deeply American horror, which investigates the soul above all of a people and a land.

title: Stealing Harvard
actors: Tom Green, Jason Lee, Leslie Mann, Dennis Farina, Chris Penn
description: John is about to fulfill his life's dream: he has set aside the $ 30,000 he needs as a down payment for his dream home where he can live with Elaine. But the man seems to have forgotten the promise made some time ago to his niece Noreen to pay her university fees. The girl managed to pass her Harvard entrance exams, but she needs $ 29,879 to pay her tuition. In the meantime, however, Elaine has paid the deposit for the purchase of the house. Poor John just has to rely on his friend Duff ...
notes: With catastrophic results. Jason Lee, cast by Cameron Crowe in Almost Famous and Vanilla Sky, finds himself at the center of a predictable and childish intrigue.

title: The Hulk
actors: Eric Bana, Jennifer Connelly, Sam Elliott, Josh Lucas, Nick Nolte
description: During an experiment, physicist Bruce Banner is struck by deadly gamma rays that modify his genetic tissue, transforming him, whenever he gets angry, into a green monster. From this moment on he is forced to flee as the army is on his trail that would like to use him as a weapon. Men, for their part, reject him as he is a mutant who cannot control his fits of anger. Only the daughter of the general who is after him (already in love with Dr. Banner) seems to care about the poor outcast.
notes: Ang Lee's filmography does not admit similarities and similarities between one film and another and this tiger and dragon agility allows him to tell the story of the Hulk and his alter ego, Bruce Banner (Eric Bana). A multiplication of points of view that reproduces the geometries of comic albums and digs deep and theoretical furrows on the problem of transposition. Hulk is a double film that suffers from some length precisely because of this double track along which it runs in the footsteps of the melancholy Hulk and stops to underline the anguish and the "lack" that hides behind the superpowers of a man of science, rational and primitive, brutal and full of tenderness, like a sentimental jade-green King Kong, for his colleague (a wonderful Jennifer Connelly, very good in the original version). A monster that shrinks out of love.

title: Johnny English
actors: Rowan Atkinson, John Malkovich, Natalie Imbruglia, Ben Miller
description: The best British spies were killed during the funeral of a colleague and Johnny English, a modest secret agent who never shone in skill, unexpectedly finds himself with a delicate mission to accomplish: he must find the crown jewels, stolen from the Tower of London.
notes: Director Howitt focuses, with enthusiasm and with a limited reserve of ideas, on the umpteenth parody of the Bond myth with the codes of comics. Atkinson's comedic strength seems more suited to tempos other than the feature film though, and Johnny English is a few steps down from other fusion agents like Austin Powers or Frank Drebin.

title: The Tuxedo
actors: Jackie Chan, Jennifer Love Hewitt, Jason Isaacs, Debi Mazar
description: Former taxi driver Jimmy Tong, who has become the driver of billionaire Clark Devlin, knows that the only rule not to break when working for the rich playboy is not to touch his precious tuxedo. But one day Jimmy cannot resist the temptation to wear the magnificent evening dress and finds himself involved in a dangerous spy affair that turns him into an unwitting, but very elegant, secret agent.
notes: The film continues boringly until the usual "chaniani" credits with wrong takes that are better than the real ones. The result, however, does not seem up to par with the recent Jackie Chan films.

title: The Good Girl
actors: Jennifer Aniston, Jake Gyllenhaal, John Carroll Lynch, Tim Blake Nelson
description: Employed in a Texas discount store, 30-year-old Justine is happily married, but rather dissatisfied. His existence takes a turn for the worse when he falls madly in love with the storekeeper, a drifter who believes he is the reincarnation of the young Holden. When she discovers she is pregnant, the situation becomes even more complicated ...
notes: Too bad that the context is so trite, because Arteta knows how to maintain the balance between humor and tragedy and confirms that he has a keen eye on the characters. Though Holden is a truly irritating figure, in his smug, frustrated adolescent isolation the world gives nothing to.

title: The Wild Thornberrys Movie
description: Nigel and Marianne Thornberry have come to Africa with their little children: the enterprising Eliza, the rebellious Debbie and the pestiferous Donnie. They want to make a documentary about a phenomenon that, according to a legend, happens only once in the span of centuries: to film thousands of elephants that emerge from the forest during the solar eclipse to admire the show. But a terrible threat looms: the evil poachers Sloan and Bree Blackburn have set up an ambush to get the ivory tusks. It will be up to Eliza, who has the gift of communicating with animals, to try to save the pachyderms.
notes: Based on a successful Nickelodeon TV series, in contrast with the recent animation, the film aims exclusively at a child target. The stroke is elementary, the rhythm is sufficiently cheerful and supported by a great soundtrack (Paul Simon's song received an Oscar nomination) and good feelings abound in this revised and corrected animated version of _Nata libero_.

title: The Matrix Reloaded
actors: Keanu Reeves, Laurence Fishburne, Carrie-Anne Moss, Hugo Weaving, Monica Bellucci, Lambert Wilson
description: Neo and the rebel leaders have approximately 72 hours before 250,000 probes discover Zion and destroy it along with its inhabitants. Meanwhile, Neo must decide how to save Trinity from a dark fate that he continues to see in his dreams ...
notes: The second chapter of the saga re-proposes the usual mixture of Japanese martial arts and "anime" - with a dressing of mysticism, apocalyptic millennialism, sci-fi narrative suggestions - and a very "à la page" visual approach (who would not want to wear black tunics or minimalist leather rompers or the poor or ethnic fake rags of the inhabitants of Zion?). In reality, _Matrix_ must be taken for what it is: a very well-made and equally fashionable toy, which at a narrative and visual level takes hold of all the pre-existing literary and cinematographic science fiction, recomposing it and reassembling it with a great sense of rhythm and extraordinary action sequences (the one on the highway, for example, or Neo's dream about Trinity). If we accept the fact that Matrix is ??not the Bible for the third millennium, which won't help us make our choices, we will also accept its very rare human thrills and the vaguely "plasticized" effect of the whole. As an entertainment, it is a top notch product.

title: Kill Bill: vol. 1
actors: Uma Thurman, David Carradine, Daryl Hannah, Michael Madsen, Lucy Liu, Vivica A. Fox, Julie Dreyfus, Chiaki Kuriyama, Shin'ichi Chiba, Chia-hui Liu, Michael Parks, Michael Bowen, Jun Kunimura
description: The gang of Bill, a boss of the mala, raids the church where the wedding of the ruthless killer Black Mamba is being celebrated, who is expecting a child and is determined to retire from the profession. The toll of the ambush is four victims, with the bride - hit in the head by a bullet - dying at the foot of the altar. Coming out of a coma after five years, Black Mamba simply becomes "the Bride" and is willing to do anything to take revenge. Wearing Bruce Lee's legendary yellow jumpsuit and armed with katanas, she sets out in search of Bill and his assassins, three women and a man who call themselves "Deadly Viper Assassination Squad" ...
notes: There is a philosophical depth in the dynamics of bodies, in the recovery of a lost plasticity that is grafted into a representation where space is fundamental, and within which are the androgynous female figures (mothers-daughters-brides-lovers-children) a enclose man and woman, I and Id, Yin and Yang: mixed and transversal like the forms of the hundred genres that then come together in one, that of a cinema that is possible only if it is accepted as writing chaos (at least in appearance). The woman as genesis and conflict, life and death: only in volume 2 will we be able to realize if the evolution of the "Bride" will go in one direction rather than another.

title: L'as des as
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Frank Hoffman, Marie-France Pisier
description: Jo and Gunther, after having fought during the First World War, become close friends and meet a few years later in Berlin during the 1936 Olympics. In the meantime, Jo, having become a famous boxer, is induced, in spite of himself, to protect a child. Jew, whose grandparents are persecuted by the Nazis. His friendship with Gunther, who became general of the Reich, will help him protect the boy and his family. Thanks to the officer's help, the braggart Jo manages to bring everyone to the border between Austria and Switzerland. But an unexpected risk of messing everything up.
notes: The film, a veritable whirlwind of gimmicks, was a box office hit in France.

title: The Dish
actors: Patrick Warburton, Sam Neill, Kevin Harrington, Tom Long, Genevieve Mooy
description: In July 1969, the Apollo 11 crew is about to set foot on the moon. In Australia, the radio telescope in the village of Parkes - the largest in the Southern Hemisphere - is in charge of transmitting images of the moon landing all over the world: but something is wrong, and Cliff and his collaborators end up in the center of the moon. worldwide attention ...
notes: The film settles in the nostalgia zone, with rock'n'roll and Hendrix omens, and plays without originality on the affectionate conflict between Americans and locals. All bland, all already seen, like the characters sketched on stereotypes, the narrative turns and the chock full of screenplay.

title: Bakushu
actors: Chishu Ryu, Setsuko Hara, Chikage Awashima, Kuniko Miyake, Ichirô Sugai
description: The life of a Tokyo family would flow serenely and calmly if it were not for the refusal of her daughter Noriko to marry a forty-year-old bachelor, "sponsored" by her employer ...
notes: Behind Ozu's typical "minimal stories", women's emancipation in a rapidly changing society.

title: N.P. - Il segreto
actors: Francisco Rabal, Ingrid Thulin, Irene Papas, Edy Biagetti
description: Edible garbage: it is the miracle of the "Butterfly", the complicated device developed by the engineer N.P .. The invention is requisitioned by the government and its creator is deprived of memory and speech. The man is welcomed by one of the many unemployed families to whom the state grants a generous subsidy. The perception of the social malaise surrounding their fake well-being restores clarity to N.P., who tries to understand what happened to his "Butterfly" ...
notes: Fantasy-socio-political apologue of one of the most committed directors of Italian cinema, aimed at mocking the brutal repressive nature of a power born of bourgeois capitalist culture.

title: Two Weeks Notice
actors: Sandra Bullock, Hugh Grant, David Haig, Alicia Witt, Dana Ivey
description: Millionaire George Wade, head of one of New York's largest real estate companies, needs a new lawyer. The best candidate is Lucy Kelson, a Harvard graduate environmentalist, who actually wants to prevent the Wade Corporation from demolishing the Community Center to build a series of condos. Reassured in this sense, Lucy accepts the job: but in a short time she decides to quit, because George treats her more as his personal assistant than as head of legal affairs. The distance will make both of them understand their true feelings ...
notes: Trusting her trusted screenwriter Marc Lawrence (_Miss Detective_ and _Piovuta dal cielo_), Bullock makes his directorial debut with a story that, unable to add anything to the tradition of the genre, rewrites the underlying coordinates with a certain freshness and panache. of the lightning strike with delayed burst (the spectators know before entering the cinema and before the two protagonists what the happy ending will be). The theme of the attraction of opposites, of the "who despises buys" revolves around the successful new film couple: Grant, with his trickster kit of easy falling in love, and Bullock, who insists on the stereotype of the chrysalis about to become a butterfly. He, superficial, plays chess and thinks of women; she, more mature, eats too much and believes in civil battles. They are not made for each other, but - as you know - in the cinema the improbable can be entertainment.

title: Intacto
actors: Antonio Dechent, Eusebio Poncela, Leonardo Sbaraglia, Max Von Sydow, Mónica López
description: Federico saved himself from an earthquake and discovered he had the power to steal the luck of others with a simple touch ...
notes: Discreet tension and a sequence to be memorized: the race in the woods, blindfolded, where the winner is the one who does not crash into the trees.

title: Wanda la peccatrice
actors: Yvonne Sanson, Frank Villard, Giulietta Masina, Enzo Fiermonte
description: A naval officer is informed by the secret services that his wife, of foreign origin, transmits drawings and projects to a foreign power that she manages to steal from him by deception. In order not to fall into the hands of her husband, the woman, trying to escape, ends up killing herself. The soldier accused of murder and acquitted for lack of evidence, is forced to resign. After the war, the ex-soldier, returning from a concentration camp, accepts money from Wanda, a socialite he met by chance. The man, thanks to that sum, will try to rehabilitate himself.
notes: Mediocre drama based on a work by Aldo De Benedetti.

title: Cowboys and Angels
actors: Adam Trese, Radha Mitchell, Mia Kirshner, Hamilton von Watts
description: Danny, a 30-year-old lawyer, still cradles childhood dreams (he wishes to become a cowboy): then his girlfriend leaves him on the eve of the wedding, bringing him back to harsh reality. But, luckily for him, he finds two women ready to console him: the bubbly Jo Jo and the sensible Candace. Which of them will win?
notes: The intent of Haynes (also writer) was to revive the glories of the classic "romantic comedy" of the thirties: an excessive ambition for his means. However, the female cast is interesting, with the Australian blonde Mitchell (_Pitch Black_, _In line with the murderer_) and the Canadian brunette Kirshner (_Exotica_, _Mad City_).

title: Freebie and the Bean
actors: Alan Arkin, James Caan, Loretta Swit, Valerie Harper, Jack Kruschen
description: Chico, a sergeant of the San Francisco police, and agent Flipper are determined to expose Red, an old boss of the underworld. The two, after a long and patient work, manage to recover the evidence to indict him, but learn from their informant that Red's life is threatened by some hitmen. To try to capture him Chico and Flipper are forced to save his life.
notes: The film attempts the path of contamination between two genres widely practiced by American cinema: the detective and the comedy. Rush is guilty of accumulating too many elements and ends up getting little from the actors and the subject.

title: The Lost Voyage
actors: Judd Nelson, Janet Gunn, Lance Henriksen, Scarlet Chorvat
description: Aaron's parents mysteriously disappeared during a cruise aboard the Corona Queen in September 1972. The ship went missing while it was in the Bermuda Triangle. Thirty years have passed and Aaron, who has become a marine researcher, is contacted by Dana, a television journalist who, having learned that the ship has reappeared in the middle of the Atlantic, wants to make a scoop. But the Corona Queen did not return alone, it brings with it a terrible mystery. The recovery mission includes a practitioner with high hopes, Aaron, Dana and David an expert on abandoned wrecks.

title: Vendetta for the Saint
actors: Aimi Mac Donald, Roger Moore, Ian Hendry, Rosemary Dexter
description: While sipping a drink in a bar in Naples, Simon Templar notices the conversation of two patrons, the first of whom seems to have mistaken the other for an old colleague. The next morning, while reading the newspaper, Templar learns that one of the two has been killed, and his suspicions grow: by conducting the investigation, however, he will find himself struggling with none other than the Sicilian mafia ...
notes: Initially broadcast in two parts by the BBC (January 1969), it then also had a theatrical distribution throughout Europe, where it met with great success. Moore confirms himself as the ideal interpreter of the character created in 1928 by Leslie Charteris.

title: Child's Play
actors: Catherine Hicks, Chris Sarandon, Alex Vincent, Brad Dourif
description: Mortally wounded during a firefight with the police, serial killer Charles Lee Ray uses a voodoo spell to transfer his soul into a doll named Chucky: which, given to little Andy Barclay for his birthday, immediately begins to kill. . However, Charles's spirit has no intention of being trapped forever in the body of the new host: the only way out is to transmigrate into the first human being to whom he will reveal his true identity, which - as you can imagine - puts Andy in mortal danger.
notes: Discreet "pilot" of a series that reached its fifth chapter in 1998.

title: An American Tail: The Mystery of the Night Monster
description: Reports of a ferocious rat-catching monster terrify the rodent world of Manhattan and haunt poor Fievel's dreams. To calm his fears, Mama encourages him to follow Tanya to work at the Daily Nibbler newspaper to find out more. There the two mice meet a reporter who is looking for this mysterious creature.

title: Ma femme est une actrice
actors: Yvan Attal, Charlotte Gainsbourg, Ludivine Sagnier, Terence Stamp
description: Yvan, who has been living with the successful actress Charlotte for some years, realizes how difficult it is to be with a woman who has made acting her profession. In fact, Yvan begins to feel jealous towards the actors who share the stage with her. Driven by the desire to clarify the situation, he goes to London where Charlotte is shooting a film, but she confesses that she is not willing to sacrifice her career for his absurd jealousy. All that remains for Yvan is to enroll in a theater course to try to understand the actors ...
notes: The idea could be enough for a short film at most. But the packaging is of a good standard.

title: Die Another Day
actors: Pierce Brosnan, Halle Berry, Rick Yune, Toby Stephens, Rosamund Pike
description: James Bond is in charge of a secret operation in North Korea, compromised (with dramatic results) by an unknown "mole". Captured and transported to a military prison, 007 is however suddenly released from prison: everyone thinks that, under torture, he has revealed the names of undercover agents, which causes the suspension of his "license to kill". To rehabilitate himself, Bond will have to track down who he cheated on ...
notes: The script (by Neal Purvis and Robert Wade) recycles in some ways _A cascade of diamonds_, between jewels and satellites capable of causing unimaginable catastrophes, without knowing where to go to cover its two abundant hours of duration. On balance, however, _Die Another Day_ (which is good to mention with the original title, beautiful, while the Italian one softens its strength, if not cancels it) amuses enough: the Korean pre-title sequence on giant rubber dinghies is excellent; not bad the swordsman battle, between Scaramouche and a primitive fury; adrenalinic the "slippery" car chase towards the end. Furthermore, the idea of ??setting the second part - the most exciting - among the boundless icy lands of Iceland and in the magnificent ice palace turns out to be apt and visually engaging (the sets are by the trusted Peter Lamont). Also like Madonna's song (and the accompanying video, an authentic miniature Bond movie, is simply fantastic).

title: Rupan sansei: Honô no kioku Tokyo Crisis
description: Lupine, convinced that the secret of a fantastic treasure is hidden on two old photographic plates, tries to steal them from the rightful owner, the tycoon Michael Suzaku. To prevent him from committing the theft, he finds, as always, the inspector Zenigata who, due to Lupine's fault, is suspended from service. When the sympathetic thief discovers that the tycoon is actually a shady character who intends to use genetic engineering to create super soldiers, Zenigata allies himself with his historical enemy and together, they frame the evil Suzaku. But the unlikely alliance does not last long and, as soon as the case is solved, the inspector sets out on Lupine's trail.

title: Sursis pour un vivant
actors: Henri Vidal, Dawn Addams, Lino Ventura, Lauretta Masiero
description: The novelist Jean Monnier, victim of a car accident, is hospitalized for tests. The writer is known to be an avid experimenter of strong feelings, so much so that many think that he has attempted suicide. One day he receives a visit from an individual who offers him to stay at the Edelweiss pension, where it would seem that many guests are suicidal. Could it be true? Jean is intrigued, but ...
notes: The thriller system and the good cast make this genre short film interesting. The intentions, however, remain on paper and despite the overturning of the suspense and the presence of Ventura and Masiero, the result remains questionable.

title: Das Totenschiff
actors: Horst Buchholz, Mario Adorf, Hellmut Schmid, Elke Sommer
description: A sailor's boarding documents are stolen which would allow him to find work on a ship. On his way to Marseille where he is headed, he falls in love with a girl. With difficulty he manages to find a boarding, but the ship sinks. He will drift with the photo of his beloved in his hands.
notes: Mediocre co-production.

title: Enrico IV
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Claudia Cardinale, Leopoldo Trieste, Paolo Bonacelli
description: During a masquerade party, Baron Belcredi causes the fall of his rival in love, who goes mad thinking he is Henry IV, the German emperor excommunicated in 1076 by Gregory VII. The man locks himself up in a castle, deciding - disappointed and embittered by the fictions and hypocrisies of the world - to continue playing the part of the madman even after having regained his sanity. Twenty years later, while the party group is visiting the castle, the drama comes to light ...
notes: Always interested in the ridge that separates normality and madness, Bellocchio reinterprets (and partially modifies) Pirandello's text. Arguable perhaps, but never anodyne.

title: Unconditional Love
actors: Kathy Bates, Rupert Everett, Jonathan Pryce, Dan Aykroyd, Lynn Redgrave
description: Grace Beasley is the typical American housewife, habitual and not inclined to adventure, who has spent her life dedicating herself to her husband Max and worshiping singer Victor Fox. When they both abandon her (Max files for divorce and Victor is murdered by a serial killer), her universe crumbles. It is an opportunity to react: Grace decides to go to England to attend the funeral of her idol. Here he discovers that the star revered by women all over the world was actually gay: he also knows his boyfriend, the hateful and unfriendly Dirk Simpson, and a friendship is born between the two ...
notes: Left the tones of the most exquisitely commercial comedy he had experienced with _My Best Friend's Wedding_, P.J. Hogan returns to scratch on the side of the freaks, of the marginalized, as he had done in _The wedding of Muriel_. His characters are out of sync with the world around them and the comic situations he creates are very close to those created by the trio ZAZ (and it seems no coincidence that Jerry Zucker is the producer of the film). There is not even a flash of thriller that sprinkles the head with irreducibly melancholy, almost catatonic characters, but on the whole the result appears uneven. The cast is stellar, with an excellent Kathy Bates surrounded by the "usual" Rupert Everett, an unsuspectingly singing uvula Jonathan Pryce and an unpleasant Dan Aykroyd.

title: The Quiet American
actors: Michael Caine, Brendan Fraser, Do Thi Hai Yen, Rade Serbedzija, Tzi Ma, Robert Stanton
description: A young American, Alden Pyle, arrives in Saigon in the fall of 1952, at the height of the struggle for independence from France. He is an idealist who has great hopes for the success of the mission that led him there and wants to know all the secrets of a world so different from his own. This is also why he makes friends with the correspondent of the _Times_ in London and falls in love with his mysterious Vietnamese lover. The three become the protagonists of a passionate love triangle that soon turns black.
notes: The script and the direction do not enhance the emotional and political strength of the story or the gnarled roots of the apocalypse. Remake of _A Quiet American_ by Joseph L. Mankiewicz.

title: La finestra di fronte
actors: Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Raoul Bova, Massimo Girotti, Filippo Nigro
description: Giovanna and Filippo have been married for eight years and have two children. She is the true driving force of the family and this forced her to harden in emotional relationships and give up her dreams. He allows himself only a small secret habit: spying on a young man who lives in the building opposite his. One day, by chance, the two meet and become accomplices in trying to unravel the mystery of the identity of a very old man who no longer remembers anything ...
notes: Özpetek would like to tell, as usual, the secrets of those who ignore a lot of themselves and others: as usual, good intentions remain such. Of note is the extraordinary interpretation (the last) by Girotti.

title: Daredevil
actors: Ben Affleck, Jennifer Garner, Michael Clarke Duncan, Colin Farrell, Jon Favreau, Joe Pantoliano
description: To save a blind man who is about to be hit by a truck, Matt Murdock is struck by the radioactive material transported by the vehicle and loses his sight. Suddenly, however, he realizes that his other senses are overdeveloped and discovers that he has an incredible radar sense that makes him perceive the surrounding shapes. When his father, a boxer, is killed because he refused to sell a fight, Matt decides to wear Daredevil's scarlet costume to avenge him. But he also has the task of defending the entire city of New York from the king of crime Kingpin, aided in his task by the beautiful Elektra, a ruthless murderer who converted to good.
notes: The director-screenwriter Mark Steven Johnson trivializes every aspect of the comic, does not exploit the moral contradictions of the character and throws it decisively on entertainment.

title: Les terres froides
actors: Yasmine Belmadi, Bernard Verley, Valérie Donzelli, Sébastien Charles
description: A Djamel, fired on the spot, all that remains is to leave Paris to move to Grenoble. Here he finds a job and a home. His introverted character leads him to withdraw more and more. Day after day Djamel begins to feel a strange attraction to the boss, to the point of spying on him all the way into the house.

title: Ukikusa monogatari
actors: Takeshi Sakamoto, Hideo Mitsui, Tomio Aoki, Choko Iida, Reiko Tani
description: Kihachi directs a company of traveling actors. This prevents him from having a stable home, and even his emotional life suffers: when he meets the child born of a past bond, for example ...
notes: Silent but originally shot in sound, the film is characterized by a strong melodramatic vocation.

title: Python
actors: Robert Englund, Casper Van Dien, Frayne Rosanoff, William Zabka
description: John returns to New Haven to help his mother run the metalworking factory. Meanwhile, a military truck in which snakes were traveling, has an accident near the town. The reptiles, escaped from the vehicle and come into contact with the factory's acids, sow death.

title: Seven Days to Live
actors: Nick Brimble, Amanda Plummer, Sean Pertwee, Gina Bellman
description: England, 1976: the body of a woman is found next to her husband in a confused state in an out-of-the-way house. 1999: the writer Martin and his American wife Ellen now live in the same mansion, who settled there after the tragic death of their son. Strange events in sight ...
notes: A "mystery story" with a vague metaphysical flavor.

title: Sleep, My Love
actors: Claudette Colbert, Don Ameche, Robert Cummings, Rita Johnson
description: Alison Courtland, a well-to-do New York lady, wakes up frantic in a sleeping car. Since she does not remember anything and cannot explain how it got there, the elderly Mrs. Tomlinson helps her to contact her husband Richard, according to whom the woman disappeared after slightly wounding him with a revolver shot. In fact, Alison, very frightened, finds the weapon in her purse, without however suspecting that she is the victim of a diabolical maneuver hatched by her husband, her lover Daphne and the shady "psychiatrist" Vernay ...
notes: A few years before his famous melos, Sirk directs this noir with a touch of comedy with superfine class.

title: Runaway Jane
actors: Teri Hatcher, Trevor Blumas, Rob Lowe, David Hemblen, Alex Karzis
description: As a security officer, Jane has access to the computer systems of the gun industry she works for, which is why someone kidnaps her teenage son Michael, forcing her to download secret files in order to make the evidence of a murder disappear. which she herself will find herself accused ...

title: Slums of Beverly Hills
actors: David Krumholtz, Alan Arkin, Marisa Tomei, Natasha Lyonne, Eli Marienthal, Carl Reiner
description: In Los Angeles in 1976, the Abramowitzes - somewhat messed up and without a dollar bill - move relentlessly from one miserable apartment to another. Murray, the father, is forced to rely on the money sent to him by his brother Mickey and is left alone to look after the three children: the boys Rickey and Ben and the teenager Vivian, already well-built and quite curious about sex. One day, then, a further complication arises with the arrival of the restless cousin Rita, daughter of Mickey, who asks for hospitality, declaring that she is pregnant ...
notes: Jenkins (also a screenwriter) creates a lively and pleasant family tale.

title: Satin Rouge
actors: Hiyam Abbas, Hend El Fahem, Maher Kamoun, Faouzia Badr, Nadra Lamloun
description: Tunis. Lilia is a caring mother, worried about her daughter Salma's possible relationship with Chokri, a musician who performs at the _Satin Rouge_ cabaret. To save her from what she considers a dangerous relationship, Lilia goes to the cabaret where she discovers the world of the night - made up of dances, prostitutes and men looking for pleasure - which at the same time attracts and scares her. From this moment on, he can't help but return every evening: through dance, he rediscovers the suffocated desires in a life characterized by obligations. And without realizing it, she finds herself involved in a relationship with Chokri.
notes: Finally an African film that is not very "African", which makes a mockery of the cinefolklorism that we Westerners like so much bundled up with feelings of guilt. Through the story of Lilia, the newcomer Raja Amari moves his camera in a rare and almost unprecedented Tunis, where the movements from the protagonist's spartan apartment to the cabaret _Satin Rouge_, provoke fatal short circuits, unleashing emancipations and new identifications. The film, a real case at the Berlinale Forum 2002, also won first prize at the Turin Film Festival in the same year.

title: Capo Nord
actors: Emanuele Valenti, Francesco Vitiello, Alberto 'Polo' Cretara, Luca Riemma
description: Four young Neapolitans arrive in Germany full of hope, but they see the dream of the coup that could fix their lives vanish. Convinced that it is impossible to retrace their steps, they choose the path of adventure and board a train bound for Norway. Here, the first goal is to make ends meet, but no one has the basis for exercising a profession and no one has ever done much for himself. They carry out a series of thefts, but after the arrest of one of the group they understand that it is time to start taking on the real responsibilities.
notes: Carlo Luglio tells the story with a taste for ethnographic detail and a sense of the landscape, but does not guess the protagonists.

title: El crimen del padre Amaro
actors: Gael García Bernal, Sancho Gracia, Ana Claudia Talancón, Angélica Aragón
description: Eager to change the world, young Amaro takes his vows. Before leaving for Rome where his theological studies await him, on the advice of the bishop - his great friend - he goes to the church of Los Reyes to acquire the necessary preparation under the supervision of Father Benito. Here he meets Amelia, a very devoted and extremely sensual girl, and little by little he falls in love with her, challenging the fate that would impose celibacy. Even the girl, fascinated by the kind ways of the priest, ends up feeling attracted to him.
notes: The director drops the banal script in a quite "exotic and typical" Mexico.

title: A Hard Day's Night
actors: John Lennon, Paul McCartney, George Harrison, Ringo Starr, Wilfrid Brambell
description: Obsessed with the rampaging fans who haunt them all the time, John, Paul, George and Ringo think it best to beat the TV studios where they should try a show. Obviously the four will combine one more than the devil: in particular Ringo, who disappears wandering around the city ...
notes: To worthily celebrate the Beatles phenomenon, Lester gives free rein to the bold inventiveness and expressive freedom that made him famous, experimenting with bizarre formal solutions - especially in editing - in the spirit of Free Cinema. And then the songs, nothing short of epochal: _A Hard Day's Night_, _Can't Buy Me Love_, _She Loves You _...

title: Fuga da Kayenta
actors: Antonio Sabato Jr., Teresa Leopardi, Lou Castel, Franco Diogene
description: The leader of an Arizona gang of thugs tries to kidnap a girl, but is thwarted by a mining engineer and a federal sheriff.
notes: Bad direction by Larry Ludman, alias Fabrizio De Angelis _ (The boy with the golden kimono) _. Kayenta is located in Navajo territory.

title: Décalage horaire
actors: Juliette Binoche, Jean Reno, Sergi López, Scali Delpeyrat
description: A man and a woman at the antipodes spend a whole day together at the airport. Rose, outgoing and chatty, is running away from a man she no longer wants to love. Félix, taciturn and lonely, is chasing a woman he thinks he still loves. She has a ticket to Mexico City, he has a ticket for the New York - Munich flight. Félix is ??on the verge of a nervous breakdown but does not want to admit it, Rose realizes for the first time that her life is a total failure.
notes: Held in the golden measure of 90 minutes, the film works, but it could work better if the script were more rigorous: instead it proceeds in jumps, and only the sympathy and charm of the two actors acts as a tie.

title: Real Women Have Curves
actors: America Ferrera, Lupe Ontiveros, George Lopez, Ingrid Oliu, Brian Sites
description: 18-year-old Ana would like to go to college, but is hampered by her modest environment in the Los Angeles suburbs and her attachment to family. When in the clothes factory where Estela, the older sister, suddenly increases the workload, Ana is persuaded to help make some elegant clothes. During the long hours spent in the factory, Ana reconnects with Estela and makes friends with her colleagues, teaching them to love every curve of their body and to appreciate what makes them unique. When it comes time to leave, Ana is finally ready to find out what the future really holds.
notes: The assumption of the graceful and polite film by Colombian Cardoso (but has lived in the United States for fourteen years) is deliberately thin. What counts, in this emancipatory comedy, are the characters, the environments, the adiposities beautifully displayed (but not for horny males, but for proud feminist pride), the slow rhythm of an everyday life that collides with the voracious dynamism North American. Without neglecting the conflictual relationship between Ana and her mother, a woman of the past who convinces herself that she is pregnant in order not to accept menopause. What is perplexing, in short, are not the final results, but the behind-the-scenes, clever marketing operation. A little sin redeemed by the air you breathe and the smile, huge like her breasts, by America Ferrera.

title: Trapped
actors: Charlize Theron, Courtney Love, Stuart Townsend, Kevin Bacon
description: Anesthetist Will and his wife Karen, an up-and-coming fashion designer, live with their six-year-old daughter, Abby, in Portland. The child is kidnapped. The two have 24 hours to react to the attack.
notes: Basically boring film, devoid of peaks of interest despite the subject matter.

title: Pater Familias
actors: Luigi Iacuzio, Federica Bonavolontà, Francesco Pirozzi, Francesco Di Leva
description: Matteo, in his thirties, returns after ten years of absence to Giugliano, near Naples. Sudden and continuous visions of the psato mix with those of the present. A way to reconstruct the stories of friends who are no longer there: among them, Antimo, killed by the carabinieri after a robbery gone bad; Michele, massacred by some thugs for defending a girl; Geggé who takes his own life after discovering that his father has stolen his savings; Anna, the girl he was engaged to, raped by his brother out of jealousy and revenge and Rosa, the victim of a violent husband. Matteo has actually returned to close the unfinished business and above all to help Rosa escape from her husband.
notes: Struck by the novel _Pater Familias_ by Massimo Cacciapuoti, the newcomer Francesco Patierno moves away (even literally) from commonplaces and, unlike a lot of demagogic and declamatory "cinema of denunciation", focuses decisively on staging, poised between two floors time (the past and the present) crystallized by unusual chromatic solutions and by almost imperceptible movements of an always hidden camera (incredible: even to the actors themselves), which robs the raw realism of the streets and interiors with an architectural gaze that manages to be lucid and passionate, rational and impulsive. A very thick debut.

title: Eccomi qua
actors: Andrea Sartoretti, Valerio Aprea, Massimo De Lorenzo, Carlo de Ruggeri, Maddalena Maggi
description: Matteo is a boy like many who gets around between odd jobs, friends, bars, money problems, identity problems and with his parents. When Stefania, his girlfriend, gets pregnant, they decide by mutual agreement not to keep the baby and to break up. Three years later, Matteo discovers that the baby has actually come to light and is called David. The relationship with his son, a new job and the attempt to start a family lead Matteo to discover that he is a different person from what he had always believed he was.
notes: Giacomo Ciarrapico (who with the short _Inside and out_ won, coincidentally, a Sacher d'oro) and his breezy, ironic, disenchanted band (Andrea Sartoretti, Valerio Aprea, Massimo de Lorenzo, and Carlo de Ruggeri) start again from where Moretti and his burdens had left us. We laugh a lot, listen to Nada and the music of Giuliano Taviani (nephew of the most famous brothers), look at the eyes and bodies of Maddalena Maggi and Angelica di Majo (cousin of the director Nina), someone identifies. Fatal exorcisms ...

title: L'avvocato De Gregorio
actors: Giorgio Albertazzi, Ciro Capano, Gabriele Ferzetti, Anna Tognetti
description: The lawyer De Gregorio, elderly and unkempt, lives on the top floor of a dilapidated condominium in the Spaccanapoli district. On the walls of his only room there are only three yellowed photos that depict him as a young man, then in a lawyer's gown and then together with his wife. Next to the photos is a newspaper clipping accusing him of fraud. In fact, thirty years earlier De Gregorio had swindled a client to treat his sick son. Now try to get back on top ...
notes: Singer of gratuitously wicked images, Squitieri does not resist the temptation of morbidity and the populist sentence, he writes badly outlines and corollaries and directs worse, with the listlessness of the superficial.

title: Faithful
actors: Cher, Chazz Palminteri, Ryan O'Neal, Paul Mazursky, Amber Smith
description: As the twentieth anniversary dawns, Margaret's disappointment over her marriage to Jack has come to a head; but just as she is about to commit suicide, the woman receives an unexpected visit from Tony, a hired assassin Jack hired to get her out of the way. While waiting for the agreed signal, in addition to bombarding his psychoanalyst with calls, the restless killer starts chatting with the intended victim, who gradually regains the desire to live. How will it end?
notes: Mazursky (who appears as Dr. Susskind) draws the film from a play written and adapted by Palminteri himself, but those expecting wing strokes will be disappointed.

title: Poco più di un anno fa
actors: Marco Filiberti, Urbano Barberini, Alessandra Acciai, Erika Blanc, Rosalinda Celentano
description: 2014: a television crew is making a documentary on Riccardo Soldani, aka Ricki Kandinsky, a famous gay porn star of the 90s, who passed away fifteen years earlier. The production tracked down the star's older brother and other witnesses to reconstruct Ricki's life as faithfully as possible including the accident that the two brothers witnessed by chance and which cost the life of a young woman.
