After this tragic event between little Pietro, the woman's son, and Ricki a relationship of deep friendship is established.
notes: Rained from the sky, Marco Filiberti accompanies his actors in a state of grace that we never - for example - would have thought of seeing in the eyes of Urbano Barberini and Alessandra Acciai. And he photographs the truth of a (non) actress like Rosalinda Celentano with sculptural precision. Filiberti also amazes in the role of Ricki Kandisky (whose parable cannot fail to recall the unforgettable Moana): manipulating frontier narrative materials with exquisite lightness; and revealing fragility and body, including twenty-four centimeters of proud vanity.

title: Bersaglio sull'autostrada
actors: Ernest Borgnine, Linda Blair, Stuart Whitman, Gabriella Giorgelli
description: Kim received from her boyfriend the key to a safety deposit box that holds the swag. A motorcyclist who does not hesitate to kill anyone who gets in his way, a journalist and a photographer, chase the girl. On their trail the police captain Morrison.
notes: Totally negligible.

title: Fun in Acapulco
actors: Elvis Presley, Ursula Andress, Paul Lukas, Alejandro Rey
description: Mike Windgreen, sailor of a pleasure boat, arrives in the luxurious Mexican port of Acapulco. As soon as he sets foot on the ground, he attracts the attention of a beautiful bullfighter, but ends up falling in love with Maggie: for her he will even challenge his own dizziness, venturing into a reckless dive from the cliff overlooking the city ...
notes: Let's face it: Elvis movies are all a little alike. This is not among the best, despite "The King" showing off his usual singing skills; the film shot six years earlier by the Presley-Thorpe duo had a very different impact: the epoch-making _Jailhouse Rock_ (Italian version, _Il delinquente del Rock & Roll_).

title: Chichi ariki
actors: Chishu Ryu, Shuji Sano, Shinichi Himori, Mitsuko Mito, Masayoshi Otsuka
description: Widowed, Professor Horikawa must provide for his son Ryohei. But the misfortunes are not over yet: during a school trip, one of his pupils dies in an accident, causing him an enormous sense of guilt ...
notes: Ozu's 39th film is also one of the greatest ever, dry and poignant.

title: El hombre che mató a Billy el Niño
actors: Peter Lee Lawrence, Fausto Tozzi, Dyanik Zurakowska, Francisco Sanz
description: William H. Bonney to defend his mother from an attack is forced to kill, thus becoming the famous Billy the Kid. When an amnesty is granted to all the bandits as long as they surrender their weapons, Billy goes to the sheriff, but ...
notes: Modest version of the story of the legendary outlaw.

title: Oxygen
actors: Maura Tierney, Adrien Brody, Terry Kinney, Laila Robins, James Naughton
description: Madeline, a police officer with masochistic tendencies, finds herself involved in the hunt for an individual nicknamed "Harry" (in homage to Harry Houdini): he has in fact kidnapped Frances, wife of the powerful businessman Clark Hannon, and keeps her prisoner underground somewhere in Manhattan. Time is running out: if Harry's ransom demand is not met within 24 hours, the woman will be abandoned, facing certain death. It's a cat and mouse game, with Madeline in the latter, uncomfortable situation ...
notes: Conventional in the plot, the film is based on a good cast in which Adrien Brody, Polanski's future pianist, stands out.

title: Disonorata senza colpa
actors: Milly Vitale, Marina Berti, Elisa Cegani, Alberto Farnese, Giacomo Rondinella
description: Amedeo, a naval officer, leaves for the Second World War, unaware of the fact that his pregnant girlfriend has been jailed for espionage. After the war, the woman convinced that the child she gave birth to is dead and Amedeo has fallen, enters the convent. But the sailor ...
notes: Negligible drama.

title: Le secret d'Hélène Marimon
actors: Isa Miranda, Frank Villard, Carla Del Poggio, Jean Debucourt, Louis De Funès
description: Hélène, married to a soldier, cheats on her husband with one of his comrades. Their relationship is so short that Hélène will be seized with remorse for the rest of her life. A few years pass: the woman meets her former lover again and the flame is rekindled ...
notes: Mediocre Italian-French co-production.

title: Los lunes al sol
actors: Javier Bardem, Luis Tosar, José Ángel Egido, Nieve de Medina, Enrique Villén
description: Gijón is a city on the northern coast of Spain, which has grown out of all proportion due to industrial development but is now struggling with immigration and unemployment. Here some men walk uphill roads every day, looking for a way out, constantly hanging in the balance due to increasingly precarious work. And in the meantime they chat about their things and laugh at everything and nothing in particular, full of hope, calmly, on a sunny Monday morning.
notes: In León de Aranoa (avalanche prizes for each work made, whether short, long or documentary), preferred at home and at the Oscars to the Almodóvar of _Parla con lei_, the little big dirt that creeps into the cavities of post Western societies is interested. -industrial (but it makes you want to say, given the ugliness, post-atomic), so much so that the "facts" are either off-screen (Amador's suicide, Lino's talks ...) or have already happened (the layoffs, the more than likely love story between Ana and a colleague). They are interested in the capacity of human resistance, the ethical value of unity. With a traditional but thin language, which avoids rhetoric, he thus makes a militant and ideological film without the language of militancy and ideology. More than Ken Loach's angry brother, one thinks of Guédiguian and his Marseille (but also of the forgotten film by Pozzessere, _Father and son_). _Volare_ di Modugno is sung, some notes by Tom Waits and Trenet are intercepted and the matches are watched at the straforo stadium. Sapid metaphor: only one goal, the one in which Sporting Gijón (which in the meantime also finished in Serie B) never scores.

title: Dentro il cuore
actors: Isabelle Pasco, Marco Bonini, Ida Di Benedetto, Nuccio Sano
description: The beautiful Phaedra, a thirty-year-old police officer, has a weakness for her stepson, a boy named Ippolito; who, neo-Nazi and racist, is also coveted by one of his fellow raids ...
notes: Returning to directing eight years later _Ferdinando, man of love_, Perlini puts together a presumptuous and irritating mess.

title: Gia
actors: Angelina Jolie, Faye Dunaway, Elizabeth Mitchell, Mercedes Ruehl, Eric Michael Cole
description: Landed in New York from her native Philadelphia with the firm desire to break into the world of fashion, the beautiful Gia Carangi catches the attention of Wilhelmina Cooper, an agent well-established in the circles that matter. Gia's unscrupulousness and her willingness to pose naked soon make her a star, but the problems come rather from the sentimental sphere: in fact, the girl starts a relationship with the make-up artist Linda, whose conflicted relationship with her bisexuality provokes a addiction to hard drugs that will lead to her death from AIDS, which occurred in 1986 due to infection with an infected syringe.

title: Todake no kyodai
actors: Shin Shaburi, Mieko Takamino, Hideo Fujino, Ayako Katsuragi
description: Mr. Toda suddenly dies of a heart attack. After the funeral, the discovery of a past debt forces the widow and youngest daughter to sell their ancestral home, while the youngest of the brothers leaves for China ...
notes: In his typical style, Ozu describes the social retreat of an average well-off family unit.

title: Ophélia
actors: Juliette Mayniel, Claude Cerval, Alida Valli, Andre Jocelyn, Robert Burnier
description: His father is dead, his mother has remarried to his uncle: for Yvan there is enough to progressively identify himself with the figure of the "pale prince", setting himself up as judge of his family and his girlfriend Lucia, the new Ophelia ...
notes: Curious reinterpretation of the Shakespearean story, one of the lesser known films of the French author.

title: My Giant
actors: Billy Crystal, Gheorghe Muresan, Kathleen Quinlan, Joanna Pacula
description: Penniless film agent Sam Kamin believes he can get out of his professional crisis by signing Max, a kind-hearted giant he found in a Romanian monastery. But things are not going well.
notes: Clamorous misstep by Billy Crystal, producer and co-author of the story.

title: City by the Sea
actors: Robert De Niro, Frances McDormand, James Franco, William Forsythe, Patti LuPone, Eliza Dushku
description: Detective Vincent LaMarca is the son of a murderer convicted of infanticide following a failed kidnapping attempt. When his partner is brutally murdered, the clues fall on Joey, who is none other than the son that Vincent left behind with his first wife. Joey, desperate for money to secure a future for the baby he just had, got involved in the murder of a notorious drug dealer ...
notes: De Niro has the mannered confidence of an actor who doesn't need much to draw a role, and together with McDormand he redeems a film that is not unforgettable, but not even despicable.

title: Chaos
actors: Catherine Frot, Rachida Brakni, Vincent Lindon, Line Renaud
description: Malika, a young prostitute, is beaten by some thugs in the street, under the eyes of Paul and Hélène. Taken by remorse, Hélène visits the girl in the hospital and decides to take care of her, abandoning her husband and son. But her exploiters have no intention of letting her free and soon Hélène, who wants to free Malika from the clutches of these ruthless executioners, finds herself involved in a story bigger than her.
notes: A film with a powerful controversial impact on female solidarity, and against patriarchy, _Chaos_ is the most hallucinating and amusing portrait of the clash between two worlds: rich & poor, men & women, West & Islam.

title: Going My Way
actors: Bing Crosby, Barry Fitzgerald, Frank McHugh, James Brown, Jean Heather
description: New York. Father O'Malley has to leave Saint Louis because he has just been assigned to a new parish. Here he struggled not a little to win the approval and friendship of the gruff parish priest, the elderly Father Fitzgibbon. He will succeed after a fire destroys the church and the young priest, thanks to his musical talent, risked the economic fortunes of the parish ...
notes: Oscar for best film in 1944, this discreet musical is the demonstration of the insane success of the genre between the 30s and 50s. Above average the interpretations of Bing Crosby and Barry Fitzgerald, which give life to two protagonists who interact well. Followed by _The bells of Santa Maria_.

title: The Broadway Melody
description: Vaudeville actresses Harriet and Queenie Mahoney arrive on Broadway, where their friend Eddie Kerns has called them to dial a number on Francis Zanfield's show. Eddie loved Harriet, but when he meets Queenie, he falls in love with her. However, the girl is already courted by Jock Warriner, a member of New York high society. It will take some time for Queenie to realize she is just a toy for Jock and for Harriet to realize that Eddie loves Queenie.

title: Gli invasori
actors: Cameron Mitchell, Georges Ardisson, Folco Lulli, Andrea Checchi
description: Harald, king of the Vikings, is killed in a fight against the Britons. The king had two sons: Erich is brought to safety, while Iron is "adopted" by the queen of the Britons. For the first, the years pass in the obsessive desire for revenge, which fate will satisfy in the cruellest way: by opposing his brother, bitter opponent during a battle ...
notes: After _The mask of the devil_ and _Ercole at the center of the Earth_, Bava (also director of photography) directs a dignified film completely conforming to one of the trends in vogue at the time. In the cast, none other than the Kessler twins.

title: Les parias de la gloire
actors: Curd Jürgens, Maurice Ronet, Folco Lulli, German Cobos
description: Alsace, 1944: André witnesses the death of his half-brother Jacques at the hands of a Nazi officer. A few years later, on duty in a French post during the Indochina campaign, André sees a small, broken-down plane landed, piloted by a German farmer named Lud. Still animated by the thirst for revenge, André immediately proves hostile towards the newcomer: the discovery that he is the murderer of Jacques rekindles the hatred towards him, but in the meantime the two find themselves facing a common danger .. .
notes: Decoin, a polar specialist, does not master the war genre properly, and this film proves it.

title: Christmas in July
actors: Dick Powell, Ellen Drew, Raymond Walburn, Alexander Carr
description: Hoping to earn the sum that would allow him to take his beloved Betty to the altar, accountant Jimmy MacDonald regularly tries his luck in all available contests and lotteries. Knowing his weakness, three colleagues send him a false telegram stating that he would be awarded a prize of as much as $ 25,000. Obviously Jimmy is no longer in the skin: he buys gifts for everyone and makes the fateful proposal to Betty. But when the truth comes out ...
notes: By reworking an unpublished piece entitled _A Cup of Coffee_, Sturges unfolds the proverbial irony and fluidity of style that have made him famous.

title: Élisa
actors: Vanessa Paradis, Gérard Depardieu, Clotilde Courau, Sekkou Sall
description: A ghost haunts Marie, it is that of Elisa, her mother, who committed suicide. After his disappearance, the girl, abandoned by her father, was sent to an orphanage. Now she is dating a Parisian half-up criminal and in the meantime looks for her parent, whom she believes responsible for Elisa's suicide.
notes: Hard psychological drama directed by the son of one of the leading French directors, Jacques Becker (_Grisbì_, _Il buco_). The story is there, the performers as well (Vanessa is also good), the setting and the soundtrack fascinate. Yet the plot is too cumbersome to completely convince.

title: Gang in Blue
directors: Mario Van Peebles, Melvin Van Peebles
actors: Mario Van Peebles, Stephen Lang, Melvin Van Peebles
description: Agent Rhodes is bothered by the growing violence of blacks against whites and vice versa. But the thing that bothers him most is the fact that the perpetrators of the attacks are his own police colleagues.
notes: Low budget movie that cannot give up moments of authentic anger.

title: The Recruit
actors: Al Pacino, Colin Farrell, Bridget Moynahan, Gabriel Macht, Mike Realba
description: Walter Burke offers the extremely gifted student James Clayton a position in the CIA. The boy sees the assignment as a tempting alternative to everyday monotony, but before becoming an officer he must undergo the Agency's tough secret training that turns recruits into veteran experts. Under Burke's guidance, James soon learns the rules of the game. When he begins to question his strange relationship with his superior, he assigns him a special mission: to find a mole.
notes: For the more experienced thriller lovers, the scans and misdirections of the film are mathematically predictable, but the duets between the Luciferian Al Pacino and an increasingly convincing Colin Farrell are truly enjoyable.

title: Piovono mucche
actors: Alessandro Tiberi, Massimo De Lorenzo, Luca Amorosino, Andrea Sartoretti, Mattia Torre
description: A community of disabled people on the outskirts of Rome. Some kids are sent here to do the civil service. For them it is the beginning of a new life marked by shifts, duties and directives and an opportunity to deal with a completely different world. Some, having already experience in volunteering, know how to deal with emergency situations, others, like Matteo, at first reject this reality only to identify completely with the problems of the disabled.
notes: We see that the newcomer (in the long run) Luca Vendruscolo spent a year in the company of his "actors". The screenplay won the Solinas Award in 1996.

title: Passato prossimo
actors: Paola Cortellesi, Valentina Cervi, Claudio Santamaria, Ignazio Oliva
description: Claudia, Andrea, Edoardo, Carola and Gianmaria have known and dated each other for years. One day, Claudia summons everyone to her country villa, a place full of memories. Images of the present and the past overlap, and so do the dreams, expectations and problems of everyday life ...
notes: In her first feature film, the daughter of the great Ugo (also a screenwriter, with Daniele Prato) could not - probably - not photograph what she knows best in real life (ie the one with the "boring parts"). Not surprisingly, several characters in the film play actors; and not surprisingly, the best part of the work is their performances.

title: Violenza segreta
actors: Giorgio Albertazzi, Enrico Maria Salerno, Vittorio Sanipoli
description: In 1958 a young Italian explorer, animated by high hopes and full of ideals, decides to make a journey through Somalia, where the interests of our country are still substantial. He will face a world dominated by degradation, behind the scenes of which white speculators are ready to do shady deals.
notes: Civil commitment only on the surface. The film exhausts its moral charge in rhetorical discourse. He does not focus on the objectives of the story told and consequently fails to scratch to the end. Interesting part for Enrico Maria Salerno.

title: Fighting Man of the Plains
actors: Randolph Scott, Bill Williams, Jane Nigh, Victor Jory
description: Immediately after the civil war, while the Jesse James gang rages in Missouri, a man finds himself having to fight the phenomenon of banditry. His brother was killed in a firefight, he looks for the culprit, believes he has found him, kills him and then discovers he has the wrong person. From that moment on he went to the wrong side and was hunted down by the police and the Northern soldiers. He is forced to change his identity and ironically he is elected sheriff.
notes: Enjoyable western series B. Statuario and, as usual, the great Randolph Scott is essential in acting.

title: Die Todesstrahlen des Dr. Mabuse
actors: Yvonne Furneaux, Wolfgang Preiss, Peter Van Eyck
description: The diabolical doctor Mabuse has returned to strike: reincarnated as a scientist (obviously "mad"), he invents a very powerful destructive ray with which to keep the world in check. He transfers shack and puppets onto a submarine, then blackmails humanity. Who will be able to react?
notes: Forget Fritz Lang, author in 1922 of the first _Mabuse_ (later revived in 1933 in _The testament of Dr. Mabuse_ and in 1960 in _Il diabolico dottor Mabuse_). In the 1960s, "herr Doktor" is heavily influenced by James Bond films and the "low" aesthetic of Italian genres. Dated, naive, childish, but with a charm all of its own.

title: Hommelette for Hamlet
description: Taken from an unspeakable Operetta by Jules Laforgue with Shakespearean influences that include new characters who move in a marble environment.

title: Ilaria Alpi. Il più crudele dei giorni
actors: Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Rade Serbedzija, Erika Blanc, Angelo Infanti
description: On March 20, 1994, the RAI journalist Ilaria Alpi and her cameraman Miran Hrovatin were killed in an ambush in Mogadishu. To date, no full light has been shed on the story, and the instigators of the double murder are still at large. For some time Ilaria had been investigating the trafficking of weapons and toxic waste in Somalia, and probably ended up touching "untouchable" interests.
notes: Initially the film, more than complex, is complicated: the narrative structure starts from the murder and proceeds backwards, unraveling with some difficulty. Then, as he moves towards the finale, he manages to "lie down" and become addicting.

title: Rachida
actors: Ibtissème Djouadi, Bahia Rachedi, Rachida Messaoui En, Zaki Boulenafed
description: Twenty-year-old Rachida works as a teacher in a popular neighborhood in Algiers. One morning she is approached by four young people including her former student Sofiane, who orders her to plant a bomb in the school. She refuses and the quartet sets a deadly ambush for her, but the girl survives and takes refuge with her mother in a village where she believes she is safe from violence ...
notes: System and packaging are from film-dossier, with some didactic slips. Any investigation into more complex causes and dynamics is removed to the advantage of the protagonist's psychological reactions, of which the director manages to convey anxiety, fear and loneliness.

title: F.B.I. «Operazione Baalbeck»
actors: Rossana Podestà, Jacques Sernas, George Sanders, Yoko Tani
description: A Lebanese drug trafficking organization is holding the FBI in check. A federal, actually a girl, infiltrates the gang by pretending to be involved in the shady trafficking. The woman who fell in love with the leader of the gang does everything she can to not have him arrested.
notes: Second and last film by Giannini.

title: Ringu
actors: Nanako Matsushima, Hiroyuki Sanada, Miki Nakatani, Hitomi Sato
description: After her cousin's mysterious death, Reiko, a journalist, learns of a mysterious videotape that the victim allegedly watched a week before he died. According to an urban legend, anyone who sees the video is frightened within seven days. Having overcome the initial skepticism, the reporter begins to investigate, aided by her ex-husband.
notes: Authentic Japanese cult movie, as well as tip of the iceberg of that vein dedicated to ghosts that is the most popular in the Mikado. In a traditional culture that combines everything with a spirit (the "shin"), the one relating to Evil could not be missing. Remade by the Americans, and successfully.

title: I Normanni
actors: Cameron Mitchell, Franca Bettoja, Ettore Manni, Geneviève Grad
description: During the ninth century, some Norman tribes decide to abandon the raids on the seas; eager for a truce, they are welcomed by the English king Dagobert. But Vilfredo, baron of Saxon, aims to seize the throne and kidnap the king, accusing the new guests of killing him ...
notes: Modest low-cost film made by Galatea Film specialists, inspired by Mario Bava's _The invaders_ and indistinguishable from other similar contemporary productions. The only curiosity, two members of the technical cast destined for a brilliant career: the machine operator Vittorio Storaro and his assistant Pasqualino de Santis.

title: The Secret of Nimh 2: Timmy to the Rescue
Cuore scatenato
actors: Francesco Sframeli, Luigi Maria Burruano, Reeno Raiss, Barbara Rizzo
description: Boe Tamburo is the most violent and ruthless gunslinger that eastern Sicily has ever known. Various arrest warrants hang on him. He is married to Donna Bella, a beautiful girl, untouchable even with just the thought. On the trail of Boe is Sheriff Frankie Cuzzata who, after countless failed attempts, manages to arrest him and send him to prison. Here, Boe's life runs smoothly until one night he gets a couple of horns. The doctor's diagnosis is merciless for a man of honor of his caliber: his wife betrayed him by turning him into a cuckold. In no time at all, the feared and revered gunslinger becomes everyone's laughing stock. All he has to do is escape and satisfy his thirst for revenge.
notes: Hot spirits lit here and there by a guessed song, a fleeting and happy moment, a foolish sheriff and nothing more.

title: The Operator
actors: Michael Laurence, Jacqueline Kim, Brion James, Stephen Tobolowsky
description: The lawyer Gary Wheelan has it all: a large bank account, a beautiful house, a loving wife ... One day, however, he loses his temper with a telephone operator, who, offended, decides to ruin his life.
notes: When you think you've hit rock bottom, you always find someone ready to dig ...

title: Maid in Manhattan
actors: Jennifer Lopez, Ralph Fiennes, Natasha Richardson, Stanley Tucci, Bob Hoskins
description: Marisa Ventura is a single mother employed as a waitress in an elegant Manhattan hotel. Here she meets a wealthy and charming gentleman, on the run for the United States Senate who initially mistakes her for a hotel guest. Having cleared up the misunderstanding, the two begin dating: the man has no intention of giving up on her even if their love story can compromise his political career.
notes: It is a film more of a script than a directing: the stationmaster on the set is the modest Wayne Wang and the writer is Kevin Wade (he has written many mediocre scripts, but he deserves credit for _Una donna in career_). It is a film with dialogues, in flashes, savory.

title: Dillo con parole mie
actors: Stefania Montorsi, Giampaolo Morelli, Martina Merlino, Alberto Cucca
description: Megghy is fourteen years old and voluntarily lost the group of scouts she was supposed to go on vacation with. Her mother has already left and the only possibility for her is to convince her aunt Stefania, who has just broken up with Andrea, to go with her to Greece. Once they leave, the girl reveals her plan: on the island of Ios, where they are going, she intends to finally lose her virginity. Here she tries to conquer a boy who does not even see her, without knowing that it is Andrea, the ex-boyfriend of her aunt.
notes: An advertising rhythm is not enough to ennoble a bored and stupid operina, equivalent in images of those tests that, in the warm months, (us) infect many weeklies.

title: The Jungle Book 2
description: Mowgli has moved into the village with his half-brother Ranjan and his best friend Shanti, but he badly misses Baloo and all the friends he grew up with. When the "man cub" decides to return to the jungle to find his old acquaintances, the terrible Shere Khan is also waiting for him, who has long been waiting for revenge.
notes: Fascinating in its musical / dancing numbers that fully collect from the 1967 original, reassuring in the drawings that follow the tradition and excellent in the backgrounds, the film also has the merit of building an exclusive and credible character.

title: The Hunted
actors: Tommy Lee Jones, Benicio Del Toro, Connie Nielsen, Jenna Boyd
description: Oregon: Aaron Hallam, former Special Forces member, has fallen into a murderous obsession. Taking refuge in the forest, he chooses hunters as his victims, killing them preferably with sidearms. To track him down, the FBI turns to the only one who could stop him: L.T. Bonham, his former trainer. Initially L.T. He refuses the assignment, but when he realizes that it could be one of his former students he feels compelled to accept and decides to face Aaron openly ...
notes: Working on the screenplay signed by the English brothers David and Peter Griffiths and by Art Monterastelli, Friedkin moves the two protagonists with his usual skill: the manhunt has always been the heart of his cinema. However, every action is truncated within a few minutes, as if the characters were in a hurry to arrive on that "Highway 61" where Abraham will sacrifice Isaac (the homonymous song by Dylan is quoted in the opening), as if today's cinema does not allow more "times" than that of the '70s. In _The Hunted_ there are _A quiet weekend of fear_, _The Hunter_ and _Rambo_. In place of paranoia, there is fear; not America that distrusts itself, but America that barricades itself at home. All mixed in a kaleidoscope of psychological and narrative degree close to zero. A "skin" film, iconographically built on myths (the photography by Caleb Deschanel is suggestive). Take it or leave it: legends rest in peace, better isolate yourself among the wolves.

title: Lanse da men
actors: Chen Bo-lin, Guey Lun-mei, Liang Shu-hui, Joanna Chou
description: Kerou is seventeen, attends high school and like many of her peers, she is extremely insecure. Shihao is the beauty of the school, all the girls go crazy for him, including Yuezhen, Kerou's best friend. The biggest concern for the boy, however, is the school swimming championship even if he feels a strong attraction for Kerou. One day the latter goes to see him at training and confides in him.
notes: The director's gaze works precisely as an investigator of banality: and it is modest, sad, very close to the torments and impulses of the characters. The mechanisms are always the same (palpitations, confessions, disappointments), yet there is an unusual depth.

title: La sirène rouge
actors: Jean-Marc Barr, Asia Argento, Frances Barber, Andrew Tiernan, Alexandra Negrao
description: Little Alice, on the run from her mother who traffics in snuff movies, reports the murder of her babysitter to police inspector Anita Staro. The policewoman decides to take up the case despite the opposition of her boss who fears the economic and political power of the woman. Meanwhile Alice, to avoid being sent home, hides in Hugo's car. The latter is nothing more than an unscrupulous killer who, however, decides to help the child by accompanying her on the journey in search of her father, who has retired to Portugal.
notes: Notable Jean-Marc Barr in the role of the soldier of fortune, and quite in part also Asia Argento, fortunately dubbed in the Italian version. The glossy staging, Luc Besson style of the fourth category, nullifies any possibility of being moved by the story. Discreet flop at home, a sign that the formula of fashionable French action cinema is losing effectiveness.

title: L'ospite segreto
actors: Corso Salani, Ludgero Fortes Dos Santos, Ben Gazzara, Romina Mondello, Spiros Focas
description: Hadì is a young man who tries to save enough money to leave his country. Failing to do so, he reached desperation and dives into the sea and after an exhausting swim he is recovered from the ship led by Emanuele Lari Alliano. Without thinking too much, the captain decides to hide the fugitive in his cabin. Thus was born a deep friendship between two men extremely different in culture, age, ethnicity.
notes: The rhetoric of the welcome is trombonesque, the holes in the story are countless, the directorial sloppiness is not excusable even in the name of productive poverty (and in any case the film had state funding). Salani seems to be looking for jokes, poor Gazzara duets with Romina Mondello. And everyone, for some reason, speaks with exotic accents.

title: La casa de las palomas
actors: Ornella Muti, Lucia Bosé, Caterina Boratto, Glen Lee, Carmen De Lirio
description: Seventeen-year-old Sandra, a student in a girls' boarding school run by the nuns, is attracted to the playboy Fabrizio. The situation becomes complicated when the Don Juan also begins to court Arianna, the girl's mother. Who will win between the two contenders?
notes: A romantic comedy that is all too obvious.

title: Prigionieri del male
actors: Bernard Blier, May Britt, Francisco Rabal, Vera Carmi
description: The Russian journalist Nadia is sent to Italy to carry out an investigation into Catholicism. The woman - atheist and communist - goes to the sanctuary of the Madonna of Pompeii and, after various vicissitudes, witnesses a miracle. Thus begins to have doubts ...
notes: Senseless mess in which only the actors are saved.

title: Il fanciullo del West
actors: Erminio Macario, Elli Parvo, Giovanni Grasso, Tino Scotti
description: In an imaginary country of Far West two families are fighting each other for dominance. The clashes are complicated by the presence of a band of outlaw that sows terror. Maccarey's good -natured doctor tries to put an end to disputes and to end rivalries.
notes: Western genus Western SCACE.

title: Matador
actors: Assumpta Serna, Nacho Martinez, Antonio Banderas, Carmen Maura, Eva Cobo, Julieta Serrano
description: Due to an accident, the bullfighter Diego Montes is forced to abandon his brilliant career. Unable to help but kill, he transfers his murderous fury to his mistresses which he eliminates at the moment of orgasm. Maria, a charming criminal lawyer, also reserves the same treatment for her lovers. Ángel, a problematic boy who was a pupil of Montes, accuses himself of the murders. Maria, secretly in love with Montes, decides to defend the boy in order to finally meet the great bullfighter. Between the two, a mad passion breaks out.

title: Kumonosu-Jo
actors: Toshiro Mifune, Isuzu Yamada, Minoru Chiaki, Akira Kubo
description: Japan, 16th century. A spirit prophesies to Taketoki Washizu, a noble warrior returning from a victorious expedition, the conquest of power and invincibility until the forest moves towards the Spider Castle. The oracle comes true: man, through a series of usurpations and heinous crimes, becomes extremely powerful. When the enemy army approaches the castle, using the cut branches of the trees to blend in, the prediction will be fulfilled.

title: Auto Focus
actors: Greg Kinnear, Willem Dafoe, Rita Wilson, Maria Bello, Bruce Solomon
description: Los Angeles, 1964: Popular radio presenter Bob Crane is at the height of success with his morning show, and his agent tells him that he has been selected to shoot the pilot episode of a new television series titled _The Heroes of Hogan_, set in a German prison camp during the Second World War. On the set, Crane meets the ambiguous and fascinating John Carpenter: it is the beginning of a friendship destined to turn the lives of both of them.
notes: Schrader focuses the lens on an egoist obsessed with the urge to look and look at himself, to have sex and to fix on tape the anonymous, grainy, mechanical and confused repetition (names, places and days are confused) of pleasure. The story of Crane is also the story of a "vicious" gaze that is transformed thanks to technology: the technical evolution and the advances in video recording refine and "perfect" the scenes of desire without real fulfillment. The pornographic magazines hidden in the garage, the striptease rooms, the photography, the sets, the camera: the era of technical reproducibility is also that of infinite reproducibility, forced, gloomy and afflicted. The cinematographic use of direct and indirect speech, the excellent actors and the fundamental parallel plot (the relationship between Crane and Carpenter) outline the degeneration and disintegration of this new "carnal knowledge", dystonic with respect to increasingly perfect and precise images in the which bodies no longer have weight or smell.

title: Dreamcatcher
actors: Morgan Freeman, Tom Sizemore, Thomas Jane, Jason Lee, Damian Lewis
description: Jonesy, Henry, Pete and Beaver have known each other since childhood. As children they saved a child named Duddits: this heroic act endowed each of them with supernatural powers and united them in a profound way. Once they become adults, the powers become more of a burden than a gift: and when an accident threatens to kill one of them, the four realize that the episode is somehow linked to the past and to the figure of Duddits ...
notes: The first half hour promises very well, on the trail of the cruel and enchanted atmospheres that Rob Reiner had been able to grasp in _Stand by Me_ and with the precipitous descent into a nightmare at _Misery must not die_ (again by Reiner). Too bad that the rest of the film - which lasts more than two hours - is literally "devoured" by the tale of the alien invasion.

title: Siu lam juk kau
actors: Stephen Chow, Vicki Zhao, Man Tat Ng, Yin Tse, Cecilia Cheung
description: Fong was once an important footballer, but his career was hopelessly compromised after he sold the national championship final. His marriage also failed, and he now lives on the street as a tramp. One day, near a pitch, he sees a Shaolin student facing a group of thugs: he notices his martial arts skills and imagines him as a future football star. Fong convinces the boy and his companions to form a team and to register, under the name of "Real Shaolin", in the national tournament. As a coach, Fong is determined to change the sport of football forever by mixing it with kung fu ...
notes: In its original integral version (and this is the one that deserves the green thumb, because to the Italian one - cut and dubbed in an insane way - we would only give the red one), Chow's film is a masterpiece of mixing the senses, in which rice and tears go hand in hand and burlesque playfulness overlooks an adult world of loneliness and abuse, which only the outcasts (whether they are "drop outs" or almost extraterrestrial meteors, such as the bald female presence in the final meeting), with their strength, even the upright one of the Shaolin monks, can shake. Hilarious, hilarious, exciting and moving, it is a work that everyone should see: to understand what and how much the Western world, in the last twenty years, has lost itself in a distant cinematography. Not only geographically.

title: Seishun no yume imaizuko
actors: Ureo Egawa, Kinuyo Tanaka, Tatsuo Saito, Chishu Ryu
description: Tetsuo, a student from a rich family, enjoys spending time with three friends and the servant Oshige. With his father dead, Tetsuo inherits the family business and hires his friends, but the situation soon becomes embarrassing ...
notes: Despite the year of production, the film (the 24th signed by the Japanese master) is still silent.

title: Marathon
actors: Sara Paul, Trevor Moore
description: The solitary and symbolic journey of Gretchen a girl who crosswords wherever she is: on the subway, on the bus, on the streets of New York. A harmless pastime that acquires epic dimensions, but perhaps this is the only way it knows to test itself and stand out in a society that instead only asks for approval.

title: Roustabout
actors: Elvis Presley, Barbara Stanwyck, Joan Freeman
description: Charlie Rogers wanders around with his motorcycle in search of clubs to perform as a singer. But due to a breakdown he is forced to stop and, to make ends meet, he decides to accept the offer of a funfair.
notes: Elvis is already on the avenue of sunset and Barbara Stanwyck, one of the few stars to have joined him, is not needed to save the film.

title: Peau d'espion
actors: Louis Jourdan, Senta Berger, Edmond O'Brien, Maurice Garrel
description: Henri Banck, a French scientist with ill-concealed communist sympathies, plans an escape to China. The counter-espionage puts Charles Beaulieu, a former soldier who became a writer, after him, who will also have to monitor Geltrude Sphax, wife of a publisher and suspected by the secret services of being a spy ...
notes: Based on a novel by Jacques Robert, a perhaps excessively complex “spy story”, with double-dealing editors and spouses of only a facade. The director Edouard Molinaro (best known for _The vice_), manages to carry out the intrigue with skill and clarity, also finding a way to deepen the characters a little.

title: A Farewell to Arms
actors: Rock Hudson, Jennifer Jones, Vittorio De Sica, Alberto Sordi
description: Frederick Henry, an American journalist, volunteers for the Italian army and meets the English Red Cross nurse Kitty. It is the great love, against the backdrop of the First World War. Frederick would like to marry Kitty after being admitted to the military hospital where she works, but is sent back to the front just a few days before Caporetto.
notes: The film is inspired by the novel of the same name by Ernst Hemingway, which in turn tells a real episode in the life of the writer, in the army during the Great War. De Sica was nominated for an Oscar as a supporting actor.

title: Senza via d'uscita
actors: Roger Hanin, Marisa Mell, Philippe Leroy, Lea Massari, Georges Rigaud
description: Glbert receives news of his son's kidnapping from his wife. Some time later, the woman suffering from nerves is seen delivering a bloody mannequin depicting her little son; upset, she kills herself. Gilbert who organized everything, is about to run away with his lover and the ransom money, but ...
notes: First and last film by Sciumé.

title: Fausto 5.0
directors: Isidro Ortiz, La Fura dels Baus
actors: Miguel Angel Sola, Raquel Gonzáles, Eduard Fernández, Najwa Nimri
description: The repetitive routine of the specialist in terminal illnesses increasingly resembles Dr. Fausto in the pre-cadaverous state in which his patients find themselves. One day, when he arrives in another city for a congress, the doctor meets a certain Santos, who claims to have been treated by him eight years ago. Disturbing and arrogant, Santos ensnares Fausto by claiming that he can turn his every desire into reality: especially the most secret and repressed, those linked to sex ...
notes: The provocateurs par excellence of the contemporary theatrical scene, the Catalans of the Fura dels Baus, rework the classic Goethian themes in a viscous, sensual and "material" nightmare.

title: High Noon
actors: Gary Cooper, Grace Kelly, Lloyd Bridges, Thomas Mitchell
description: Willy resigns from his post as sheriff on the day of his wedding to Amy, a Quaker girl with whom he has always been in love. When he learns that a dangerous outlaw is about to return to the city on the midday train, he feels compelled to take back the star and confront him. But the citizens he tries to protect, frightened, deny him the help and so Willy will have to manage alone.
notes: Fred Zinnemann, is inspired by the short story _The Tin Star_ by John Cunningham, and directs a film in which the time in which the action takes place coincides with the actual minutes. Four Oscars (lead actor, editor, music and best song) and many remakes.

title: Rosafuria
actors: Serena Rossi, Biancamaria D'Amato, Ugo Dighero, Carola Silvestrelli
description: In a Neapolitan condominium, the stories of Rosa, a beautiful young daughter of the concierge of the building, and Vita, her contemporary who just arrived in the city from the North with her father, a bank official, intertwine. Initially, Rosa's sunshine clashes with Vita's cold attitude, who doesn't want to settle in and make new friends. Over time, however, the tension eases and the two learn to understand each other until they face together the terrible test that awaits Rosa.
notes: Based on the novel _Rosa Furia_ by Patrizia Zappa Mulas, it is the second chapter of the _Generazioni_ series produced by Rai Fiction and created by Eagle Pictures.

title: Where Danger Lives
actors: Robert Mitchum, Faith Domergue, Claude Rains, Maureen O'Sullivan
description: One night, in the hospital, the young doctor Jeff Cameron meets Margo, hospitalized after a suicide attempt, and falls in love with her, severing the relationship with the nurse Giulia for her. Shortly thereafter, however, Jeff learns that the woman - whose psyche is obviously very unstable - is already married to the older Frederick. Things fall apart: during a confrontation Frederick accidentally dies and Jeff, confused and perplexed, is persuaded by Margo to follow her on a hasty and mysterious flight to Mexico ...
notes: An atmospheric "black" with all the credentials: from the script to the direction, passing through a very classy cast.

title: Texas Lady
actors: Claudette Colbert, Barry Sullivan, Gregory Walcott, Ray Collins, James Bell
description: Inherited ownership of the local newspaper, Prudence arrives in a secluded Texas town. The two individuals who dictate the law in the area, however, show that they do not like the liberal spirit of the woman, who can nevertheless count on the unexpected help of a gambler ...
notes: Whelan's latest film, active since the dawn of sound.

title: The Bullfighters
actors: Stan Laurel, Oliver Hardy, Richard Lane, Margo Woode, Carol Andrews, Diosa Costello
description: On their way to Mexico City to arrest the notorious criminal Nell, detectives Laurel and Hardy come across the famous Spanish bullfighter Don Sebastian, who happens to look like a drop of water to Laurel. Easy to imagine how it will turn out ...
notes: Laurel struggling with muleta and banderillas is a guaranteed blast.

title: A-Haunting We Will Go
actors: Stan Laurel, Oliver Hardy, Elisha Cook jr., John Shelton, Sheila Ryan
description: Laurel and Hardy are recruited by a gang of outlaws to take possession of a trunk containing the documents of an inheritance. But when the trunk is exchanged for the one that the magician Dante uses in his shows, trouble begins ...
notes: Laurel & Hardy goofy as usual, with a hint of prestidigitation.

title: Sen to Chihiro no kamikakushi
description: Chihiro is ten years old and a stubborn and capricious child. When Akio and Yugo, her parents, tell her that they have to move, the little girl gets furious and lets out all her anger. On the way to their new home, the three stop in a ghost town where a sumptuous feast awaits them. Akio and Yugo greedily throw themselves on the food and are turned into pigs under the incredulous eyes of their daughter: they have ended up in a world inhabited by ancient gods and magical creatures ruled by an evil witch, the evil Yubaba. Chihiro, to survive, will have to make himself useful by working ...
notes: Miyazaki describes in the form of a metaphor the tortuous growth path of the little protagonist: the world he stages is simply fascinating, both in the impeccable drawings and in the flow of the story. Despite the apparent looting of typically Japanese folklore and mythology, the director creates a surprising narrative "melting pot" in which he mixes Lewis Carroll and the dark side of the Brothers Grimm's fairy tales, managing in the final - with lightness and extraordinary sensitivity - to transform into imagine the memorable passage in which Jorge Luís Borges speaks of the "Coleridge flower". More than a film, a gift dedicated to those who have kept their curiosity and the ability to let themselves be carried away by the emotion of poetry. Golden Bear at the 2002 Berlin Film Festival.

title: The Core
actors: Aaron Eckhart, Hilary Swank, Stanley Tucci, Delroy Lindo, Tchéky Karyo
description: Some scientists discover that, due to a change in temperature in the core, our planet is about to stop its rotational movement, with the risk of apocalyptic consequences for humanity. The only solution seems to be to take a bomb into the depths of the Earth and detonate it, in order to give new force to the rotation. The mission is entrusted to a group of "terranauti" trained by NASA, who will have to go aboard an experimental shuttle ...
notes: Despite the duration, you do not get bored: strangely, however, the special effects - which should be a strong point of the film - are very poor.

title: Lucía y el sexo
actors: Paz Vega, Tristán Ulloa, Najwa Nimri, Daniel Freire, Elena Anaya, Javier Cámara
description: When Lucía, a young waitress in a restaurant in central Madrid, learns of the disappearance of her boyfriend, a writer with whom she had lived for six years, she takes refuge on a quiet island in the Mediterranean. Here, in a shining atmosphere, full of sun and pure air, the girl discovers the darkest aspects of her past as a couple, as if they were the forbidden passages of a novel that now the author, thanks to the distance, allows her to to read.
notes: Lucía's story turns out to be literary and didactic: the impulses are mechanical, the tourist ardor, the romanticism of papier-mâché. Too bad: Medem has almost always been able to orchestrate tones and bodies, but it's really hard not to get bored here. And a few turgid flashes, perhaps even surprising, are not enough to reinvigorate a soufflé so hot, but born already deflated.

title: Mein Bruder, der Vampir
actors: Roman Knizka, Hinnerk Schönemann, Marie-Luise Schramm, Julia Jentsch
description: 14-year-old Nic is looking for the right person to have sex with in order to feel great. His 30-year-old mentally retarded brother Josch wants to have sex with Nadine, brother Mike's new girlfriend. Josch explains to Nadine what he wants for her upcoming birthday and she is flattered. Mike is willing to make any sacrifices to indulge his brother, but respecting what he considers his territory. He then uses a variety of defensive techniques to get his brother away from Nadine and get him to have sex before it's too late.
notes: The title already reveals how the problematic young man in the middle will spend the evening of his coveted birthday. Less obvious, on the other hand, that the ending makes all three find lying down and satisfied, after a programmatically and factually incestuous night. The spirit, as mentioned, is naive. While the intentions seem sincere.

title: The Adventures of Pinocchio
country: Great Britain, United States, France, Germany, Czech Republic
actors: JonathanTaylor Thomas, Martin Landau, Geneviève Bujold, Udo Kier
description: A wooden Geppetto puppet comes to life thanks to the Blue Fairy. Disobedient, Pinocchio will face a thousand vicissitudes to fulfill his dream: to become a child.
notes: Nothing new, but the film works thanks to the direction of Steve Barron (_Cone Heads_), the excellent cast and animations of Craig Crane.

title: Ochazuke no aji
actors: Shin Saburi, Michiko Kogure, Keiko Tsushima, Chishu Ryu, Chikage Awashima, Yûko Mochizuki, Koji Tsuruta
description: The capricious Taeko, originally from Tokyo-well, is bored with the grind of her marriage to the all too quiet and trustworthy Mokichi. The outbreak of an inevitable crisis will stimulate a new awareness in the couple.
notes: A film strongly desired by Ozu, conceived during the war period but blocked by censorship.

title: Poznavaya belyj svet
actors: Nina Ruslanova, Sergej Popov, Aleksej Zharkov, Ludmila Gurchenko
description: The desolate landscapes of the deepest Siberia are the backdrop to an intense and painful love story. Protagonists: a truck driver and a cook.
notes: Fifth feature film by one of the leading authors of ex-Soviet and neo-Russian cinema, whose _Tre piccola murdas_ (1997) made a fleeting appearance also in Italian cinemas.

title: Nessuno al suo posto
actors: Vittoria Belvedere, Marco Baliani, Anna Maria Ghepardi, Giorgia Spencer Davison
description: Rocco is a fourteen-year-old boy with a broken family: his father Saverio, a cursed painter and poet, is a misunderstood genius unable to assert himself; his mother, beautiful and restless, fled to the United States when he was little; the stepmother is hostile and insensitive; the grandmother lives in a world of her own and the deaf-mute little sister already goes to the analyst at the age of four. His life on the outskirts of Turin feels tight to him, he has no one to talk to and he would like some stability and human warmth, like the characters in the many books he reads: a normal family, someone to rely on. For this Rocco decides to run away from home, on the trail of his mother who has abandoned him.

title: Les couleurs du diable
actors: Wadeck Stanczak, Ruggero Raimondi, Isabelle Pasco, Luca Zingaretti
description: Nicolas Morgan is in Rome to exhibit some of his works. Willing to do anything to be successful, however, he does not have the talent (or the luck) to break through. And so, to notice it is not a famous gallery owner but a disturbing patron ...
notes: Italian-French production with many known faces (there is also a semi-unknown Luca Zingaretti). But that's not enough.

title: Whore 2
actors: Amos Kollek, Mari Nelson, Marla Sucharetza, Gilbert Giles
description: Halfway between documentary and drama, an (explicit) journey through the streets of New after nightfall. Sex, prostitutes, nudity, but nothing is free and vulgarity is found only in the eye of the viewer.
notes: From the director of the funny _Fast Food, Fast Woman_, she has no connection to Ken Russell's film.

title: Jian gui Jian gui
actors: Angelica Lee, Lawrence Chou, Chutcha Rujinanon, Yut Lai So, Candy Lo
description: Mun is a blind girl from the age of two who undergoes a delicate operation: the corneas of a person who died a few days ago were transplanted. The operation is successful and Mun slowly regains his sight, but next to the real images he begins to see unreal presences. Ghosts of men, women and children who all died tragically haunt her with increasing frequency to the point of pushing her to the brink of madness.
notes: Watching the film, the viewer also easily enters the world of precognition, since the style of the Pang twins reveals an advertising provenance, which is enhanced in the scenes in which rhythm plays a fundamental role, such as in the white heat finish. The story lends itself like The Ring to a juicy Hollywood remake, in the meantime it is the Pangs who move to Hollywood to try their hand at Tesserect, Alex Garland's latest novel that of _The Beach_, and we had no doubts about this trip too.

title: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
actors: Kate Hudson, Matthew McConaughey, Adam Goldberg, Kathryn Hahn, Bebe Neuwirth, Liliane Montevecchi, Samantha Quan, Annie Parisse, Michael Michele, Shalom Harlow, Robert Klein, Thomas Lennon
description: Andie Anderson is a promising reporter who is assigned an unusual investigation: compiling a list of what a woman unwittingly does to turn a man away. In 10 days she is therefore forced to make someone fall in love and then to make all the classic mistakes to be left. As a victim he chooses Benjamin Barry, a handsome advertiser who has just bet with his friends that he will be able to conquer a woman - in fact - in 10 days ...
notes: The viewer and the writers (more important, in this romantic comedy with a good script, the director) know the situation better than the characters. In this "genre", the fun lies in following the development of the plot-theme and observing the solutions devised to overcome the various levels-tests. The structure of the script is effective and functional, and the actors descend with a verve from classic black and white in their respective roles.

title: National Lampoon's Van Wilder
actors: Ryan Reynolds, Tara Reid, Tim Matheson, Kal Penn, Teck Holmes
description: Van Wilder has been in college for seven years and - much to his father's anger - spends most of his time throwing parties, so much so that he has become a true professional. Meanwhile, Gwen, who writes for the university newspaper, has to do a piece on Van, but he is always too busy to receive it: the girl then reports what she has heard about him, and the article is not very flattering. Finally the two meet ...
notes: The eternal "student-pig" trend continues, with the usual characters (the Cool and the Blonde-Girl-with-his-head-in-place, the Loser and the Strafatto) and the usual four gags that are always repeated the same.

title: Beauty and the Beast
description: Bella agrees to take the place of her old father, held captive in the castle of a prince trapped in the body of a Beast due to a curse. Over time he realizes that the latter is not as bad as it seems at first glance. To make your stay in the haunted castle pleasant, many nice humanized objects: the candlestick waiter Lumière, the butler clock Tockins, the housekeeper teapot Mrs. Bric with her son Chicco ...
notes: Two Academy Awards: Best Soundtrack and Original Song. But the film is the first title in the history of animated cinema to be nominated for best picture.

title: A Shot at Glory
actors: Robert Duvall, Michael Keaton, Ally McCoist, Brian Cox, Kirsty Mitchell
description: In a small Scottish village, football is a favorite pastime of the locals. The local team, militant in Serie B and led by coach Gordon McLeod, is getting stronger and aiming high, but they lack a striker. The possibility of a match with the Glasgow Rangers is expected and the population is taxed in order to hire a champion. Meanwhile the coach faces serious problems both personally and professionally ...
notes: Dignified treatment of a football club, where an unusual Robert Duvall stands out. as a coach A curiosity: McCoist, former Glasgow Rangers star, plays here a former player of the bitter city rivals Celtic.

title: Conspiracy
actors: Kenneth Branagh, Colin Firth, Stanley Tucci, David Threlfall
description: Berlin, January 20, 1942. Nazi leaders and SS leaders meet at the Wannsee conference, led by SS general Reinhard Heydrich. There, they definitively finalize the "final solution to the Jewish question", marking the beginning of the planned extermination of an entire people.

title: Ju-on
actors: Misa Uehara, Megumi Okina, Misaki Ito, Yui Ichikawa
description: It looks like an ordinary house, anonymous like a thousand others: but some time ago, the horrible murder of the young Kayako and her son Toshio took place inside. Now the spirits of the victims, thirsting for blind revenge, continue to inhabit the building, cloaking it with a curse that falls on anyone who sets foot there. And no one, absolutely no one, can escape you ...
notes: In 2003, Shimizu shot both this film (passable, but nothing more) and the canonical sequel. And the following year, in compliance with a trend that has now grown, the director himself moved to Hollywood to direct the remake of the first episode: the mediocre _The Grudge_.

title: Dagon - La secta del mar
actors: Ezra Godden, Francisco Rabal, Raquel Merono, Macarena Gomez
description: Paul is looking for his girlfriend Barbara, who has disappeared on an island in Spain. He will have to face men who are turning into sea creatures: bizarre individuals worshiping the god Dagon, who asks them to sacrifice human beings in return ...
notes: Gordon, the director of _Re-Animator_, fishes with both hands from the genre repertoire and makes a rather naive film, but one that is appreciated for that retro flavor that goes straight back to the B-series cinema so fashionable a few years ago. The film, based on a story by Lovecraft, is dedicated to Francisco Rabal, who died shortly after the shooting.

title: The Lost Battalion
actors: Ricky Schroder, Phil McKee, Jamie Harris, Jay Rodan, Adam James
description: October 1918: As the First World War draws to a close, American troops enter German-occupied France. In the Argonne forest, a battalion of the 77th division, made up of about 800 soldiers, finds itself trapped behind enemy lines, with orders to maintain their position at any cost ...
notes: Mulcahy's film is deliberately chaotic, hectic, often claustrophobic. His characters come out of the "good or bad" schemes, coloring themselves with a humanity that is perhaps too widely ostentatious, but unquestionably the bearer of an interesting (and jagged) point of view.

title: Chain of Fools
actors: Steve Zahn, Jeff Goldblum, Salma Hayek, Orlando Jones, Michael Rapaport

title: Double Take
actors: Eddie Griffin, Orlando Jones, Edward Herrmann, Gary Grubbs
description: Daryl Chase deals with banking investments, but is framed for the murder of two policemen, which occurred after the discovery of irregularities in a client's account. To escape the police, the man exchanges his identity with that of Freddy Tiffany: but who is he really?
notes: Series B action-comedy with too many ambitions.

title: Framed
actors: Rob Lowe, Sam Neill, Chad Bruce, Alicia Coppola, Dorian Harewood
description: On vacation in the Bahamas with his family, New York cop Mike Santini accidentally runs into Eddie Meyers, a high-profile outlaw involved in money laundering, and goes after him. The law enforcement officer is surprised at the strange willingness shown by the ambiguous individual, who agrees to report what he knows as long as it is Santini - and he alone - who conducts the interrogation in a safe place, once they return home. From here on, Meyers will implement a sort of prolonged seduction strategy, using every resource (money, women, expensive gifts) to bribe his "keeper".

title: The General
actors: Brendan Gleeson, Jon Voight, Maria Doyle Kennedy, Angeline Ball
description: August 18, 1994: Irish outlaw Martin Cahill is murdered outside his home by a hitman. A long flashback reconstructs his life, from his youth to his arrival in the Dublin neighborhood of Hollyfield. With the first thefts, Cahill manages to support his wife Frances, four children and sister-in-law Tina; later, however, the aim of his criminal enterprises rises ...
notes: Shot in color but printed in black and white, Boorman's film (unreleased in Italian cinemas) expertly evokes the traits of a controversial character. His stories also inspired Thaddeus O'Sullivan's _Un Perfect Criminal_ (2000), starring Kevin Spacey.

title: Watchtower
actors: Tom Berenger, Rachel Hayward, Tygh Runyan, Elizabeth Carol Savenkoff
description: Art Stoner (Tom Berenger) is the Casanova of serial killers, a predator who ensnares his victims with kind ways and affable manners. He is a chameleon who assumes different identities, seduces people in need of affection and slaughters them mercilessly, believing he is giving them eternal bliss. When the dangerous killer arrives in a small fishing village and poses as a writer in search of peace, it seems that everything is going according to his plans. He establishes his home in the town's lighthouse and forms a loving relationship with Kate, a handsome and lonely sea woman, and her young brother. Will it be another carnage?

title: Ignition
actors: Bill Pullman, Lena Olin, Peter Kent, Colm Feore, Barbara Eve Harris
description: Under accusation for his often exaggeratedly violent systems and behavior, former military helicopter pilot Conor Gallagher is removed from the Air Force and provisionally made available to the Secret Service. He is thus destined for the safety of Federal Judge Faith Mattis whom someone tried to intimidate by delivering a package bomb to her court office. A mediocre action film that does not shine for the originality of the subject. Her protagonists, Bill Pullman, in the role of the restless soldier, and Lena Olin, a determined and strong judge, save her from the wreck.

title: The Killing Yards
actors: Morris Chestnut, Alan Alda, Rose McGowan, Arthur Holden

title: Le porte del silenzio
actors: John Savage, Sandi Schultz, Richard Castleman, Jennifer Loeb
description: Melvin Devereux is driving home when his attention is drawn to a hearse that passes him and slows down right in front of his car. Any attempt to overcome it is in vain and the only tangible result is the mockery suffered by the bizarre driver. The return home of Melvin will continue between strange encounters and omens of death until a disturbing discovery that will subvert any logical and temporal plan.
notes: It is the latest film by Lucio Fulci and was produced by Joe D'Amato. It was shot in Louisiana and is based on a short story by Fulci himself entitled Doors from nowhere. The costumes of the film are by Laura Gemser, famous for having played the black character Emanuelle.

title: Sesso nero
actors: Mark Shannon, Annj Goren, George Eastman, Chantal Kubel

title: The Breed
actors: Adrian Paul, Bokeem Woodbine, Bai Ling, Péter Halász, James Booth
description: In the distant future, vampires have left the darkness and live among the people, considered by all to be a special and peaceful race. When a series of strange murders begins to unfold, a policeman and his vampire colleague are tasked with tracking down the dark killer who kills victims by assaulting them in the throat.

title: Three Blind Mice
actors: Brian Dennehy, Mary Stuart Masterson, Debrah Farentino, John Doman, Glenn Plummer
description: Attorney Matthew Hope is defending Stephen Leeds, a former fellow soldier in Vietnam accused of killing three immigrants from the Asian country, and has to fight the tenacity of District Attorney Patricia Demming ...
notes: Discreet television adaptation of Ed McBain's (aka Evan Hunter) novel of the same name.

title: 29 Palms
actors: Rachel Leigh Cook, Michael Rapaport, Jeremy Davies, Chris O'Donnell
description: David and Katia,

title: WW3
actors: Timothy Hutton, Lane Smith, David Aaron Baker, Hrant Alianak
description: After the sudden death, due to the same symptoms, of passengers on a cruise ship and spectators of a baseball match, federal agents Sullivan and Chang open an investigation and discover that the cause of the massacre is a bacteriological weapon. that a group of terrorists wants to use to sow death ...

title: Office Killer
actors: Carol Kane, David Thornton, Barbara Sukowa, Molly Ringwald
description: The budget cuts of "Constant Consumer" magazine have also affected Dorine Douglas who, after sixteen years of service as an editor, is downgraded to a simple "home" employee. So the fact that her hated boss Gary is left dry by an electric shock doesn't upset her too much: on the contrary ...
notes: Curious "horror comedy" that stands out for being the first (and only) work behind the camera by photographer Cindy Sherman, author of self-portraits emblematic of the female condition (her fake still photos in which she reflected on the representation of women in Hollywood).

title: Surviving the Game
actors: Ice T, Charles S. Dutton, Rutger Hauer, Gary Busey, F. Murray Abraham
description: Plot in preparation

title: The Hurricane
actors: Jon Hall, Dorothy Lamour, Mary Astor, C. Aubrey Smith, Raymond Massey

title: White Zombies
actors: Bela Lugosi, Madge Bellamy, Robert Frazer, Brandon Hurst
description: Falling in love with the beautiful Madeleine, the rich Beaumont convinces the young woman and her betrothed to celebrate the wedding in his villa in Haiti. To get Madeleine, Beaumont turns to the sorcerer Legendre, who transforms the girl into a zombie with his voodoo practices. Beaumont tries to rebel against Legendre to get Madeleine back alive, but by then it will be too late.
notes: In the US, a horror classic, it is considered the first zombie film in the history of cinema. Its strengths are above all the interpretation of Bela Lugosi, and his legendary close-ups with the spirited gaze, the settings and certain atmospheres that refer directly to German expressionism.

title: Tall in the Saddle
actors: John Wayne, Ella Raines, Audrey Long, George 'Gabby' Hayes
description: Arriving in an isolated valley, a young adventurer ends up involved in the personal war of two women who compete for a piece of land. Falling in love with the weakest and most honest, he supports her in the fight.

title: Une histoire immortelle
actors: Orson Welles, Jeanne Moreau, Roger Coggio, Norman Eshley
description: Macau, 19th century: lonely and exclusively in love with money, the elderly merchant Clay sets out to demonstrate its infinite power. To this end, he plans to materialize a legend that tells of a wealthy gentleman who "hires" a sailor to spend a night with his wife, giving him an heir. Clay then instructs his accountant Levinsky to engage the protagonists of the staging, which is destined, however, to an unexpected and bitter ending.
notes: From a short story by Isak Dinesen (aka Karen Blixen), Welles draws one of his major works, short but of an almost unbearable intensity. Music by Erik Satie, performed by the pianist Aldo Ciccolini.

title: Tokyo no onna
actors: Yoshiko Okada, Ureo Egawa, Kinuyo Tanaka, Shinyo Nara, Chishu Ryu
description: In one of the capital's workers' districts, Chikako shares a modest apartment with his younger brother Ryoichi. Constraints lead her to supplement her office work with a job in a shady room; for Ryoichi, the truth will taste very bitter ...
notes: Short but essential for the stylistic development of the mature Ozu.

title: Parlez-moi d'amour
actors: Judith Godrèche, Niels Arestrup, Anne Le Ny, Laurence Fevrier, Jean-Marie Frin, Aurélien Wiik
description: Justine and Richard have three children and fifteen years of common life. The two are on the verge of separating: Richard actually already lives in another apartment and has accepted a job abroad. It is an opportunity for Justine to get back in touch with herself, with her reasons for living, her past, her childhood memories: the abandonment of her father, the first disappointment in love, the first meeting with her future husband. Time passes, it will soon be Christmas, Justine and her children always live in the same neighborhood, in the same building where Richard returns to show up one evening. A year has passed.
notes: All a little déjà vu, elegant in the packaging, well interpreted, but without real need and without digging. The song that gives the title to the film, and which we listen to during a flashback, is the famous Parlez-moi d'amour, a hit from the 1930s by Lucienne Boyer. Which, however, haunted by the success of the single, then had her lyricist write an ironic abjuration: _Parlez-moi d'autres choses_. Motto that could also apply to the film.

title: The Man Who Knew Too Much
actors: Leslie Banks, Edna Best, Peter Lorre, Nova Pilbeam, Frank Vosper, Pierre Fresnay
description: Bob and Jill Lawrence are spending a ski vacation with their daughter Betty. But after Jill collects the last words of agent Louis Bernard, murdered by a spy, Betty is kidnapped and the Lawrences find themselves embroiled in a dangerous intrigue ...
notes: Remade 22 years later by Hitch himself, with the Stewart-Day couple.

title: Life or Something Like It
actors: Angelina Jolie, Edward Burns, Tony Shalhoub, Christian Kane
description: Lanie Kerrigan is a television reporter who considers herself very lucky: she has a job she loves, a beautiful apartment, beautiful clothes and a perfect boyfriend. But her world begins to waver after a wanderer tells her that what she is leading is a meaningless existence and that she will die the following week. When some prophecies come true, Lanie reviews what had been her priorities until then and falls in love with a colleague, a cameraman with whom she was certainly not on good terms ...
notes: Herek "translates" a cheap script into images, yet another proof that in Hollywood there are neither ideas nor people capable of writing.

title: Cidade de Deus
actors: Matheus Nachtergaele, Seu Jorge, Alexandre Rodrigues, Leandro Firmino da Hora
description: The birth and development of organized crime in "Cidade de Deus", one of the most unfortunate and dangerous favelas in Rio de Janeiro, between the end of the 60s and the beginning of the 80s. Before the eyes of Buscapé, a shy eleven year old who dreams of becoming a photographer, the lives, struggles, loves and deaths of a series of characters flow by. Among them is Dadinho, a teenager who aspires to become Rio's worst criminal and begins his apprenticeship by joining Cabeleira's service. Over time, he realizes that drug dealing is more profitable than robberies and sets up a cocaine trade that will transform him into the most feared and respected drug trafficker in the city ...
notes: To tell a decade of violence, socio-cultural upheavals and drugs in the "City of God" at the foot of Rio, Meirelles filters the original novel-river (by Paulo Lins) through the gaze of a boy who never "from outside", indeed always soaked up to his neck in the chaos of the environment, he spends the years maturing. More than (as has been said) spectacularizing misery, the film has the defect of being entirely derivative; but it is also vital, sanguine, anxious, explicit, muddy, naked and raw. Stylistically, it is in a precarious balance between dirty glamor and demonstration. But it does not bother, it often proves to be able to mount tension and rhythm, to succeed in quite daring narrative choices and to orchestrate a truly remarkable polyphony of faces, voices and bodies.

title: Ghost Ship
actors: Gabriel Byrne, Julianna Margulies, Ron Eldard, Desmond Harrington, Isaiah Washington, Alex Dimitriades, Karl Urban, Emily Browning, Francesca Rettondini
description: The maritime recovery team aboard the "Arctic Warrior" tug is the best in its field. She is therefore contacted by Canadian air force pilot Jack Ferriman to investigate a mysterious ship she spotted off the coast of Alaska. This is the wreck of the legendary "Antonia Graza", the pride of the Italian cruise fleet, reported missing in the spring of 1962 when she sailed for America. Once aboard the wreck, the "Arctic Warrior" team discovers that it is not abandoned ...
notes: A correct and decent product of the genre, which wears out from the moment it clarifies the transcendent causes of the ship's curse.

title: Beethoven's 3rd
actors: Judge Reinhold, Julia Sweeney, Michaela Gallo, Joe Pichler
description: The Newton family is about to leave, aboard a large caravan, for California, where the annual meeting with all the relatives will be held. A long journey from Colorado, especially if at the last moment you have to board an unexpected (and bulky) passenger ...
notes: Third (and not least ...) sequel to _Beethoven_, released only on the home video market with a new cast.

title: Superseven chiama Cairo
actors: Roger Browne, Fabienne Dali, Mino Doro, Massimo Serato
description: A British secret agent, codenamed "Superseven", must retrieve a camera that was mistakenly sold to a tourist in Cairo. A radioactive material is hidden in the device that is tempting to the Russians.
notes: 007 was raging on the screens, so we adapted ... Despite some gimmicks, Lenzi directs listlessly and the script is a bit thrown away.

title: Il pranzo della domenica
actors: Massimo Ghini, Maurizio Mattioli, Barbara De Rossi, Elena Sofia Ricci, Galatea Ranzi, Giovanna Ralli, Rocco Papaleo
description: The life of Franca Malorni, an exponent of the Roman good bourgeoisie, suddenly changes when her husband (an established marriage lawyer) dies. Her attentions are thus poured out on her three daughters, all married, who are obliged every Sunday to go to her house for lunch with their respective families. One day, Franca falls and breaks her thigh bone. During his long and tiring hospitalization, the disagreements and disagreements that characterize three couples very different in terms of wealth, political ideas and ways of living that until now have hidden behind the facade of a perfect and happy family emerge.
notes: The firm of the Vanzina Brothers (Carlo and Enrico) writes and directs following the track of an important tradition of Italian cinema (well-balanced tributes). They are thoroughbred storytellers, good, like other critically respected directors, in describing the human comedy of these years. Theirs is a cinema of characters and jokes. Of actors (the male performers seem more vivid) and moods.

title: X-Men 2
actors: Patrick Stewart, Hugh Jackman, Ian McKellen, Halle Berry, Rebecca Romijn, Famke Janssen
description: The Mutant Academy is attacked by enemy forces, but the X-Men are engaged in the hunt for a murderous mutant who wants to attempt the President's life. The news of the assault provokes a violent protest against the mutants from the public opinion, which badly supports them. In this context, many are asking for the reintroduction of the Mutant Registration Act: among the most staunch defenders of this idea, William Stricker, a soldier suspected of having conducted experiments on mutants ...
notes: The young Singer, who once harbored auteur ambitions, does not renounce his favorite subtexts (militant anti-fascism, the metaphor of new or old racism, the "witch hunt"), but is much less radical than the first film. On the other hand, however, the most popular component of the saga is clear. Singer is a good storyteller, and the sequel maintains a difficult balance by giving each character, old and new, the right density. Sure, Wolverine has an edge because he's brutal and "unfair": his fury when Stryker's men attack Xavier's college is pure adrenaline. Against the film, some limits. A negative example: viewers who have never read the comics will not understand anything about the ending, they will lose all the winks on the fate of Jean Gray and maybe they will not even notice that the beam of light projected in the last shot on the water of the dam draws a phoenix. Is all this correct?

title: Tutti gli uomini sono uguali
actors: Massimo Wertmüller, Randi Ingerman, Enzo Decaro, Maurizio Crozza, Sabrina Salerno
description: Giacomo, Claudio and Martino lead very different existences, but something unites them: the recent separation from their respective consorts. Dried up by the payment of foods, they decide to rent an apartment together and to take a dash: thus arrives the beautiful American Eli, and the mess begins ...

title: Le sette sfide
actors: Ed Fury, Furio Meniconi, Roldano Lupi, Gabriele Antonini, Bella Cortez
description: In the presence of the Khan, a quarrel breaks out between the Circassian Ivan and the Kyrgyz Amok. The Khan decides to end this rivalry: the winner of seven challenges will have supremacy over the rival. Ivan, defeated by deception in the seventh match, contemplates revenge.
notes: Among the screenwriters is the name of Sergio Leone.

title: The Order
actors: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Charlton Heston, Sofia Milos, Brian Thompson
description: Rudy Cafmeyer is an art thief. Whether he steals treasures from the Angolan jungle or steals the jewels of the Russian mafia in Moscow, Rudy is used to living on a tightrope. He then plays on his grounds when he receives a phone call from his father, a famous archaeologist, who is in big trouble in Israel. Having rushed to Tel Aviv, Rudy finds himself involved in a manhunt. At stake there is not only the safety of the parent, but of the whole world, threatened by a dangerous sect.
notes: Exotic fantasy adventures for Van Damme whose monolithic interpretation does not acquire depth in the "esoteric" context

title: Zenon: Girl of 21st Century
actors: Kirsten Storms, Frederick Coffin, Raven-Symoné, Stuart Pankin, Holly Fulger
description: 2049. Zenon Kar, a troubled thirteen year old lives with her family on an orbital station. The girl is sent to planet Earth because she has a fight with Wyndham, the owner of the station. Will the girl be able to adapt to the new situation and go home?

title: Phantom of the Megaplex
actors: Taylor Handley, Corinne Bohrer, Caitlin Wachs, Jacob Smith
description: 17-year-old Pete works part-time in a multiplex near his home. The boy and his friends are excited, because they have learned that a major Hollywood film will be premiered in the cinema. Soon, however, Pete realizes that there is someone who intends to sabotage the evening ...

title: Pyaasa
actors: Guru Dutt, Mehmood, Mala Sinha, Waheeda Rehman, Johnny Walker
description: Vijay, a 30-year-old poet from Calcutta, is frustrated by the short-sightedness of publishers, who prefer to focus on sentimental by-products. Things are not going well even in the family and Vijay just has to wander the streets of the city, where he will meet the prostitute Gulab ...
notes: Seventh, intense film by the director of Bangalore.

title: Dodsworth
actors: Walter Huston, Ruth Chatterton, Paul Lukas, Mary Astor, David Niven
description: On a trip to Europe, mature businessman Sam Dodsworth discovers that his frivolous, age-obsessed wife Fran is having an affair. Left by Fran, Sam will find love and the will to live next to the younger Edith ...
notes: Wyler's anti-moralistic approach shields the film from platitudes and stereotypes.

title: Fanfan la Tulipe
actors: Hélène de Fougerolles, Magdalena Mielcarz, Vincent Perez, Penélope Cruz, Didier Bourdon, Magdalena Mielcarz, Hélène de Fougerolles
description: France, 18th century. Fanfan, a young and intrepid adventurer, joins the king's army under pressure from the beautiful Adelina, daughter of a sergeant in search of new fighters. On the road that leads him to the camp, he drives away a handful of brigands intent on robbing the royal carriage in which Madame de Pompadour and Henriette, the daughter of the sovereign, travel. Fanfan sees in this action a sign of destiny and therefore tries to foil a plot.
notes: As happens more and more often in films dazed by action and devoured by special effects, there is no more life in these bodies, pathos in duels, laughter in joy. There is no grace in film composition anymore.
