The jokes (often sadly "modernist", with references to current events) follow one another with television times (as if waiting for recorded laughter) and consequent banality. 95 minutes of French comic-swordsmanship grandeur that seem 197 and leave us exhausted and sulky.

title: Panj é asr
actors: Agheleh Rezaïe, Abdolgani Yousefrazi, Razi Mohebi, Herzieh Amiri
description: The teenager Noqreh decides to attend school without saying anything to the family, because her old fundamentalist father would certainly forbid her from doing so. The girl wants to study at all costs because she has a singular goal, emblematic of her desire for emancipation: when she grows up she wants to become president of Afghanistan. Then the father decides to leave for the desert with Noqreh and the sister-in-law who lives with them, because "city" life corrupts family morality.
notes: Third film, after _La mela_ and _Lavagne_ (plus the episode in the collective _11 September 2001_), by Samira Makhmalbaf. Winner of the Jury Prize in Cannes, with criticized decision.

title: Akarui mirai
actors: Jô Odagiri, Tadanobu Asano, Tatsuya Fuji, Takashi Sasano, Marumi Shiraishi
description: Two guys, Yuji and Mamoru, work in an industrial laundry and share the same apartment. When not working, the taciturn Mamarou spends his time contemplating his poisonous jellyfish in the aquarium, while Yuji continues to behave like an eternal adolescent. Their employer, a man dominated by his wife and daughter, hopes to rebuild a life by dating the two who accept him without particular enthusiasm. But the desperation of the man and the mediocrity of his family deeply affect Mamoru who decides to remedy the situation in the only way he thinks possible.

title: Carandiru
actors: Caio Blat, Rita Cadillac, Gero Camilo, Milton Gonçalves, Nelson Machado
description: The film is based on the experience of Dr. Drauzio Varella in the Carandiru penitentiary in São Paulo, Brazil, where he dealt with AIDS prevention. Here the doctor finds himself in the presence of hundreds of inmates who live in total degradation: men huddled together, without any rights. The situation is getting worse and reaches its peak in October 1992 when, to quell a revolt, 350 soldiers enter the prison and kill 111 inmates.

title: Dogville
actors: Stellan Skarsgård, Nicole Kidman, Siobhan Fallon, Chloë Sevigny, Patricia Clarkson, Jeremy Davies, Lauren Bacall, Paul Bettany, Harriet Andersson, James Caan
description: 1930: Beautiful Grace arrives in Dogville, a remote village in the Rocky Mountains. On her trail there are two ruthless killers: thanks to the intercession of Tom, spokesperson for the community, Grace obtains hospitality and protection as long as she is willing to work for the common good. When the inhabitants of Dogville discover that the woman is wanted, they make more and more demands on her. But she hides a secret that will make them regret bitterly ...
notes: The first segment of von Trier's new trilogy on America is a film of head and emotions. Head film: _Dogville_ is an abstraction drawn on the floor of a set which is a stage between Brecht and Ronconi, the characters correspond to the stereotypes of novels (and films) about any small town, the story is divided into a prologue and nine chapters, the voice of a narrator guides us. Film of emotions: as long as the camera approaches the face of Grace or one of the inhabitants of Dogville and we forget we are on a set, we enter a labyrinth of repressed passions, desires never vented, hypocrisy, hatred, humiliation. _Dogville_ is an act of faith in cinema and at the same time a demonstration of its falsity. It is also a kind of hymn to an actress, Nicole Kidman, diaphanous, strong, light and determined, who runs through the film with passionate shrewdness and penetrating participation. The immoral von Trier may well be an impostor, as his detractors say. There is not even a shadow of reality in _Dogville_, there is only one set.

title: Ce jour-là
actors: Bernard Giraudeau, Elsa Zylberstein, Jean-Luc Bideau, Michel Piccoli, Christian Vadim, Laurent Malet, Rufus, Feodor Atkine, Jacques Denis, Edith Scob, Hélène Surgere, Laurence Fevrier, Jean-Michel Portal, Jean-Baptiste Puech, Matthias Urban
description: When her mother dies, a somewhat naive girl inherits a fortune. The members of her family then hire a killer to have her murdered and thus recover the conspicuous inheritance. But the killer falls in love with his victim.

title: A raíz do coração
actors: Luis Miguel Cintra, Joana Bárcia, Melvil Poupaud, Isabel Ruth
description: There is turmoil in Lisbon: the election of the new mayor looms and the patronal feast of St. Anthony fills the air with excitement. The transvestites known as "St. Anthony's brides" parade, there are the politician Caton and the ethereal Sílvia, ambiguous characters like "the Crow" and "the Crane" circulate ...
notes: Baroque and colorful mix of farce, musical and pamphlet.

title: Il segreto delle rose
actors: Marian De Koning, Aldo Pensa, Mario Carotenuto, Dolores Palumbo
description: The Dutch Marian, in a marriage crisis, arrives in Italy where he meets Alfredo, his compatriot and his former flame. Marian soon realizes that the past cannot return. The woman, who in the meantime has experienced various vicissitudes, just has to take the road back.
notes: Cloying little comedy.

title: Ali: An American Hero
actors: Vondie Curtis Hall, David Ramsey, Clarence Williams III, Joe Morton
description: The story of Cassius Clay is told through various flashbacks. It starts from his adolescence lived on the street and reaches his first successes in the ring. From victory to victory Cassius, who became Muhammad Ali and converted to Islam, won the title of world heavyweight champion in 1964.

title: La destinazione
actors: Roberto Magnani, Elisabetta Balia, Salvatore Mele, Gisella Vacca, Antonio Moro
description: Emilio, an unemployed young man from Rimini, joins the Carabinieri. In Rome, during his training, he meets Costantino, a Sardinian boy of few words. At the end of the course Emilio indicates Sardinia as the third option for the destination and there he is sent, to Coloras, a remote village of Barbagia. As a first assignment he must investigate the murder of a shepherd killed in front of his son Efisio who, hidden behind a bush, was able to see the hitman in the face. Little by little, between difficult investigations and a conflicted love story with Giacomina, a local girl, Emilio realizes that he has ended up in a world that is profoundly different from the one he is used to.
notes: The director Piero Sanna tells things he knows: he is Sardinian and a carabiniere in actual service. Among his illuminating beacons, in addition to General Dalla Chiesa, of whom he was a collaborator, Ermanno Olmi: the profession of the weapon on the one hand and that of cinema on the other. Beautiful things intercepted by never banal glances, such as the harsh sequence of the murder smeared with blood and milk, or that of the bilingual confrontation between the marshal and the killer's mother. And then the rough faces on which the earth - that earth - has left more than one mark. Visually impetuous, the film is lost in delays. He leaves more than one interesting character on the street (Constantine above all) and in the end risks diluting his emotions too much. A more courageous editing would have helped.

title: The Truth about Charlie
actors: Mark Wahlberg, Thandie Newton, Christine Boisson, Tim Robbins, Ted Levine
description: Regina Lambert returns to Paris to get a divorce from her husband, but discovers that he has been killed and that all their money has disappeared.
notes: Demme talks to us about cinema as it was and how it was overturned and how it could be useful to him today to start over from that overturning. A remake of _Sciarada_, to re-establish cinema on the _nouvelle vague_.

title: 2 Fast 2 Furious
actors: Paul Walker, Tyrese Gibson, Eva Mendes, Cole Hauser, Ludacris, Michael Ealy, Devon Aoki, Amaury Nolasco
description: Former cop Brian O'Conner agrees to help his old partner Roman Pierce carry a batch of dirty money on behalf of criminal boss Carter Verone, who runs an import-export firm in Florida as a cover business. In reality, in this way, Brian continues his cover work alongside agent Monica Fuentes, who infiltrated the organization to try to dismantle it ...
notes: Singleton is good, but he is wasted on such productions. However, the multiracial aspect of the operation is interesting, given that the three protagonists seem to have been chosen on purpose to involve an ethnically diverse audience.

title: La petite Lili
actors: Ludivine Sagnier, Nicole Garcia, Bernard Giraudeau, Jean-Pierre Marielle, Robinson Stévenin, Julie Depardieu
description: Summer on an island in Brittany. Lili, a young actress, leaves Julien, a boy studying to become a director with whom Jeanne-Marie is in love, to throw herself into the arms of Brice, an established director. The latter then leaves Mado, an actress who remains faithful to him.
notes: There are the Chekhov of _Gabbiano_, the Truffaut of _Effetto notte_, a bit of Claude Sautet, open conflicts and hidden pitfalls, affable discussions and inevitable clashes (what is real cinema), demanding artistic declarations and unsuccessful experiments. The film has an old-fashioned air, but Ludivine Sagnier's Lili ...

title: Les égarés
actors: Emmanuelle Béart, Gaspard Ulliel, Samuel Labarthe, Clémence Meyer
description: June 1940. The Germans are at the gates of Paris. Odile, a teacher, panics and runs away with her two children, Philippe and Cathy. The little family, who lost everything following the bombings, runs into Yvan, a strange teenager with a shaved head, dressed like a clown. The four find themselves in an abandoned house without electricity where, without any contact with the outside world and forced to invent something every day to get to the next day, they will experience their own personal war.

title: Une nouvelle vie
actors: Sophie Aubry, Judith Godrèche, Bernard Giraudeau, Philippe Torreton, Nelly Borgeaud
description: After the death of her mother, Tina, a young saleswoman at the supermarket and close to marriage, sets out in search of the father she never met. Instead, he will find a stepsister, Lisa ...
notes: Great sensitivity, impeccable style, young actors taken to the limit: in a word, Olivier Assayas. The film is unreleased in Italy.

title: Sacrifice
actors: Michael Madsen, Joshua Leonard, Bokeem Woodbine, Jamie Luner
description: Bank robber Tyler Pierce got busted. During the transfer to the prison, however, he manages to escape. The reason for such a rush? The news that her daughter was killed by a serial killer. Tyler wants revenge, and to get his hands on the killer he also accepts the help of a police officer. The only clue: all the victims had recently aborted. On the trail of the fugitive, meanwhile, the manhunt has begun ...
notes: From cable TV to home video without going through the street. Unbelievable (aside from the obvious "food" reasons) that Michael Madsen still accepts these cheap parts.

title: Elephant
actors: Alex Frost, Eric Deulen, John Robinson, Elias McConnell, Jordan Taylor
description: In quiet Portland, life is monotonous. On a day like any other, in the local high school the students are dedicated to the usual activities, but the tragedy looms ...
notes: Van Sant shoots with real students, matching the shooting timeline and the time of the film, and progressively modifying the script. Daily life, banal dialogues, routine: for the first hour nothing happens, the same morning is told from different points of view and with long sequence shots. Then, the explosion of madness. But so consistent with the world shown, that at that point the massacre boys could be almost all: the bespectacled librarian, the one with the alcoholic father, the three amoral ducks, the pianist intrigued by the Nazis. Do not misunderstand: Van Sant is not a nihilist, he would love his protagonists with the transport of a Pasolini, and therefore he sees doubly the horror. His cold gaze is the most painful and passionate thing in a film that rejects any socio-psychological explanation (except for a couple of hints to habitat and repressed homosexuality, which are in fact the only little "sticks"), because he knows that what cinema must and can give is the vision of a world, is to make us feel the cold to the point of unbearable, to give us back the times, the rhythms, the signs. Show us the elephant that is under everyone's eyes and that nobody wants to see (this is the meaning of the title), without necessarily saying: here is the elephant. Rightly awarded at Cannes (best film and best direction: the latter on the edge of virtuosity, but never free), _Elephant_ has the right distance from things and gives a sense to the concept of independent American cinema. Not surprisingly, it was made outside of every major, for cable TV.

title: Les invasions barbares
actors: Rémy Girard, Stéphane Rousseau, Dorothée Berryman, Louise Portal, Dominique Michel
description: Rémy, a former university professor and great womanizer, has cancer. His son Sébastien, a successful broker in London, returns to Québec with his girlfriend to assist him. Exasperated by the bureaucracy that afflicts public health, Sébastien pays out huge sums to ensure maximum comfort for his father (with whom he has always had tense relations). Meanwhile, at Rémy's bedside, his ex-wife and old friends gather to help him bear the tragic reality and the burden of memories ...
notes: Arcand orchestrates an ideal sequel to his 1986 film: cinema of the word and of actors, which however has the merit of still conveying some doubts and uneasiness.

title: Mystic River
actors: Sean Penn, Tim Robbins, Kevin Bacon, Laurence Fishburne, Marcia Gay Harden, Laura Linney, Kevin Chapman, Tom Guiry, Emmy Rossum, Spencer Treat Clark, Andrew Mackin, Adam Nelson, Robert Wahlberg
description: Sean, Dave and Jimmy were inseparable as children, but they lost sight of each other after a tragic event that changed their lives forever: the kidnapping of Dave by two pedophiles. To bring them together, 25 years later, is another tragedy: the murder of Jimmy's eldest daughter. Sean, now a police detective, is on duty in the area and is in charge of the case. But Jimmy, a former inmate, doesn't trust the law and starts investigating on his own; day after day, Dave ends up being the main suspect, but more conflicts and other drama have yet to unfold ...
notes: Conducting with a classic calmness that now has few equals (fields, reverse shots, small zooms on close-ups and alternate editing in the most tense scenes: in particular the long and nocturnal one of the pre-final, which follows Jimmy and Dave on the one hand and Sean on the other), sparing in words and almost hostile to any possible virtuosity, Eastwood guides our instincts with the imperceptible choices of the camera: menacingly low, treacherous in the opening sequence, and then again when we approach the subsequent revelations; at times tall and relentless, ready to swoop down into the neighborhood and across the river that cuts through Boston, to reveal terrible truths. Screenplay by Brian Helgeland (former collaborator of Clint for _Blood Debt_, as well as director in his own right for _Payback - Porter's revenge_ and _The fate of a knight_), from the novel of the same name by Dennis Lehane.

title: Otets i syn
actors: Andrei Shchetinin, Aleksei Nejmyshev, Aleksandr Razbash
description: For years, a father and son have lived in St. Petersburg, in an old apartment furnished in a spartan way. The mother has been dead for a long time. Little by little, the two men have built a universe that fully reflects them, starting from memories, rituals and habits. Still, their lives are destined to separate ...

title: The Brown Bunny
actors: Chloë Sevigny, Vincent Gallo
description: Bud Clay is a professional motorcyclist (he runs in the 250 category), clinging to and almost obsessed with the desperate memory of Daisy, his one, unforgettable and lost love. Wherever he goes he tries to find a new woman to accompany him on his journey across America ready to abandon her as soon as he accepts it.

title: Swimming Pool
actors: Charlotte Rampling, Ludivine Sagnier, Charles Dance, Marc Fayolle, Jean-Marie Lamour
description: The rigid and rather conservative English writer Sarah Morton visits her publisher John Bosload in southern France in hopes of regaining her lost inspiration. Instead, she meets Julie, John's unscrupulous daughter, who deeply disturbs her ...
notes: In this psychological noir with an evident literary matrix, Ozon re-proposes the exchange of roles between the novel's protagonist and its creator (in this case the writer) that has fascinated the masters of the genre, from Agatha Christie to Stephen King. The unveiling theorem of the "real" Sarah Morton passes through the clash-confrontation with an opposite and coveted version of herself (Ludivine Sagnier, beautiful young and unscrupulous), with sapphic overtones. Eroticism flows above and under the skin, thanks above all to the disturbing presence of the French actress: but the too literary structure proceeds schematic and cerebral, as confirmed by the revealing ending of a metanarrative reversal already seen, already read and already heard.

title: The Moab Story - The Tulse Luper Suitcase - Part I
country: Great Britain, Italy, Spain, Hungary, Russia
actors: JJ Feild, Jordi Mollà, Victoria Abril, Kathy Bates, William Hurt, Vincent Gallo, Caroline Dhavernas, Steven Mackintosh, Raymond J. Barry, Scott Williams, Drew Mulligan, Jack Wouterse, Yorik van Wageningen, Naím Thomas, Valentina Cervi, Tom Bower
description: 92 mysterious suitcases scattered around the world tell the life of Tulse Luper, a repeat offender, who has been in prison several times. Suitcases containing the most disparate objects: from ingots from the Nazi treasure, to shoes, from pornographic collections from the Vatican to panties belonging to American actresses.
notes: It has been a while since Greenaway hasn't missed an opportunity to declare that cinema is dead, that stories can no longer be told as films have always done, that screens must be transformed into walls of art galleries, of a Visual Art. and Digital, the result of the composition, superimposition and decomposition of images obtained according to the most advanced video techniques. The New Director, that is he, is a collector of real-virtual images, a classifier of objects, a lover of numerology, a bundle of characters. Greenaway's Grande Impresa is divided into three parts: this first was in competition at Cannes; the third part we saw in Venice; the second, shot last, is almost ready. The protagonist of the trilogy is a certain Tulse Luper, subscriber to prisons all over the planet, owner of 92 suitcases, observer of world history from 1928, when they discovered uranium in Colorado, until 1989 when the Berlin Wall fell. We can be wrong, indeed: we are wrong for sure, but we don't know what to do with the elegance, refinement, iconic experiments and all the other trinkets of Greenaway.

title: Tiresia
actors: Stefano Cassetti, Laurent Lucas, Clara Choveaux, Thiago Telès
description: Tiresia is a beautiful clandestine transsexual who lives in the Parisian suburb with his brother. Terranova, an individual who has a cult of beauty, falls madly in love with him and kidnaps him. Deprived of the hormones he has to take on a daily basis, Tiresias transforms: his beard grows, his voice becomes hoarse. Disgusted by this mutation, Newfoundland throws Tiresias into an escarpment after having blinded him. Saved by a girl, Tiresias begins to show signs of foresight.

title: Uzak
actors: Emin Toprak, Fatma Ceylan, Zuhal Gencer Erkaya, Muzzafer Özdemir
description: The photographer Mahmut, convinced that the gap between his life and his ideals is becoming increasingly significant, is forced to welcome Yusuf, a young member of his family, who had previously left the village to find work on a boat that runs from Istanbul. route to foreign countries ...
notes: Among the Turkish directors, Ceylan is the most solid and promising: guarded style, long times, minimal dialogues, narrative ellipses, elusive meanings, claustrophobic atmosphere with touches of wild comedy, as in the unexpected mouse hunt. Grand Jury Prize in Cannes 2003. A name to keep an eye on.

title: Le temps du loup
actors: Isabelle Huppert, Patrice Chéreau, Béatrice Dalle, Olivier Gourmet, Rona Hartner, Maurice Bénichou, Brigitte Roüan, Lucas Biscombe, Hakim Taleb, Anaïs Demoustier, Serge Riaboukine
description: When Anna and her family arrive at the house where they are to spend their holidays, they find it occupied by poor, aggressive and hungry refugees. Confronting these unknown individuals is the beginning of a painful process of knowledge.
notes: Michael Haneke makes another thesis film: without social superstructures, without well-being, without conventions, we reveal our propensity for violence. The surprising things about the film are the iciness of the tones and the radical aesthetic choices. In this case, the obsessive use of natural lighting, which makes everything even more disturbing, and the absolute lack of rhetoric (visual and narrative).

title: Les triplettes de Belleville
description: The old Madame Souza is rather worried about her nephew's attitude: in fact the boy seems to show no interest in anything, except for his collection of photos of the Tour de France and of cycling champions. For this grandmother decides to give him a bicycle, in the hope that in the future he can win the prestigious race. But the "French mafia" involves the young man in a shady round of clandestine betting. With the help of three elderly ladies, called "Les Triplettes", Madame Souza sets out on the trail of her missing nephew ...
notes: Chomet's work in recovering the sense of past decades is extraordinary, through the rich soundtrack and décor that return the essence of French and New York metropolitan landscapes inhabited by slightly touched but full of sweetness characters, which transmit without the need for dialogue strong vibrations in the viewer's heart.

title: Nagaya shinshiroku
actors: Choko Iida, Hohi Aoki, Reikichi Kawamura, Hideko Mimura
description: Japan, postwar: a man finds a lost boy and plans to take him to his home. Nobody in the neighborhood offers to host him for just one night. The only one to come forward is Otane, a sour middle-aged widow who is growing fond of him ...
notes: First film shot by Ozu after the end of the world war.

title: Qui a tué Bambi?
actors: Sophie Quinton, Laurent Lucas, Catherine Jacob, Yasmine Belmadi
description: Isabelle takes a course to become a nurse. At the hospital she meets Doctor Philipp, a serious and respected surgeon, and is very impressed by his coldness. Over time, the girl begins to suspect that the surgeon is dealing with strange incidents that occurred in another hospital. When she discovers the truth, a real nightmare begins for her.

title: The Banger Sisters
actors: Goldie Hawn, Susan Sarandon, Geoffrey Rush, Erika Christensen, Robin Thomas, Eva Amurri
description: In the late 1960s, Suzette and Vinnie were two wild "groupies". But it's been a long time and they have lost sight of each other: Vinnie is now called Lavinia and is an impeccable uptown wife and mother of a family as well as a pillar of the community in which she lives. Suzette is still the same as she used to be, only with a few more tattoos and a few "tweaks": when her world falls apart, the woman searches for the only friend who can save her.
notes: The comedy doesn't scratch, goes nowhere, and is even rather sloppy in narrative coherence. Too bad for the two "girls" and for Geoffrey Rush, who are good and deserve better opportunities.

title: Les mains d'Orlac
actors: Mel Ferrer, Dany Carrel, Christopher Lee, Lucile Saint-Simon
description: Famous pianist Stephen Orlac loses his hands in a plane crash. A surgeon transplants those of a strangler sentenced to death: Orlac is no longer able to play, but begins to feel an irrepressible murderous drive. The ambiguous illusionist Nero takes advantage of the situation and starts blackmailing him ...
notes: Third of the four adaptations (after _Orlacs Hände_, 1924, by Robert Wiene and _L'amore folle_, 1935, by Karl Freund, and before _The hands of the murderer_, 1962, by Newton Arnold) of a good novel by Maurice Renard: unfortunately it is also the least accomplished, despite the disturbing presence of the "vilain" personified by Christopher Lee.

title: Annibale
directors: Carlo Ludovico Bragaglia, Edgar G. Ulmer
actors: Rik Battaglia, Gabriele Ferzetti, Rita Gam, Victor Mature, Milly Vitale, Terence Hill, Bud Spencer
description: Carthaginian general Hannibal lands in Italy and begins to win victories. Fabio Massimo's troops try to stem him, but the news of the death of his brother Asdrubale will arrest him.
notes: Hurry Italian adventures, with little money and fewer ideas. Rightly forgotten.

title: Silence
actors: Kristy Swanson, Vincent Spano, Daveigh Chase, Bruce Boxleitner
description: A little girl is an involuntary witness to a crime. The murderer is not aware of her, who thus becomes the only weapon in the hands of the police to arrest the culprit. But first the little one will have to overcome her fears ...
notes: Films with a few too many aspirations, which would surely have been more at ease among TV movies.

title: Un giorno, una vita
actors: Pierre Brice, Daniela Rocca, Sandra Dall, Corrado Croce
description: The marriage between Olga and Giuliano no longer makes sense: day after day, they lost sweetness and respect, replaced by indifference and boredom. The situation is now critical, but the only one to react is Olga, who still sees a hope of happiness in her future.
notes: A (rightly) forgotten melò from the 70s. Only Daniela Rocca is saved.

title: High Crimes
actors: Ashley Judd, Morgan Freeman, Jim Caviezel, Adam Scott, Amanda Peet
description: Claire Kubik, a brilliant lawyer, and her husband Tom, a successful businessman, lead an idyllic life in Marin County, California. A trivial accident - an attempted robbery in their splendid home - unleashes a series of events that upset the couple's existence. Tom is arrested because, as an undercover military agent, he allegedly killed civilians in El Salvador and then went into hiding. The man admits his true identity - he responds to the name of Ron Chapman - but pleads innocent, and it is Claire who assumes his defense before a secret military court. Charlie Grimes, a former army lawyer, helps her, who sees in the case an opportunity to attack the same hierarchies that years before decreed her end. Meanwhile, as the trial progresses (and as Claire's sister Jackie falls in love with Lieutenant Terence Embry, assigned to the defense board), it turns out that many of those who should have testified have either died or disappeared into thin air ...
notes: Tension, debates, violence and twists are not lacking in a film in which the director knows what instructions to give to his fellow actors. As a pupil of Corman, Franklin is able to pilot a story, and as a former teacher of analysis he knows how to juggle recipes and formulas. Screenplay by Yuri Zeltser and Cary Bickley, from a novel by Joseph Finder; photograph of the Dutch Theo van de Sande, moved to the States since the end of the 1980s.

title: Sotto gli occhi di tutti
actors: Laura Del Sol, Paolo Sassanelli, Loredana Cannata, Alfredo Pea, Regina Bianchi
description: At the news of the sudden death of their father, the four children find themselves in the position of having to find a niche within 48 hours. It sounds easy, but it isn't. Rosa, the eldest, an energetic and proud teacher, stumbles upon the business of the dearly departed. Tommaso, the brother who runs his father's shop, decides to ask for help from a disreputable acquaintance. From Rome Patrizia, the youngest daughter and from Milan Alberto, the second son, join the family and reluctantly accept the compromise proposed by Tommaso. But Rosa is firmly opposed.
notes: From the Monicellian incipit, an Italian comedy radiates (forcefully back on the crest of the wave) which has the ambition to tell the bitter taste of helplessness through characters bordering on the grotesque, a strong dose of irony that borders on the cynicism, sketches stolen from classical southernism (we are in Bari), confused feelings and widespread resentments.

title: Ora o mai più
actors: Jacopo Bonvicini, Violante Placido, Edoardo Gabbriellini, Elio Germano, Camilla Filippi
description: David is a student of the Normale di Pisa. He attends the last year of Physics, has an impeccable curriculum and a dizzying average. On the day of the last exam, while he is reaching the classroom, he meets a girl in the corridors of the Viola university who leaves him a flyer and leaves. Without thinking, he follows her and finds himself in the middle of an assembly of the student collective. From that moment, for the first time, he begins to ask himself questions and begins a journey that leads him to discover passions.
notes: Fresh and naive like a teenager pulsing with the future, the film is indignant and indignant, it flutters and runs, in and out of alternative spaces. In the group of protagonists the good Edoardo Gabbriellini and the strong-willed Camilla Filippi stand out. A Fandango production. That is: another bet won by the brave captain Domenico Procacci.

title: Il posto dell'anima
actors: Silvio Orlando, Michele Placido, Claudio Santamaria, Paola Cortellesi, Imma Piro, Flavio Pistilli, Maria Laura Rondanini
description: Campolaro: Carair, an American multinational tire manufacturer, announces the imminent closure and consequent dismissal of all workers. The factory is occupied, an Internet site is born, the case acquires national resonance. The workers attempt an extreme gesture and travel to the Carair world headquarters to reach an agreement for a restructuring plan. Meanwhile, their existence continues: Antonio dreams of returning to live in his country of origin with Nina, his partner who now works in Milan; Salvatore, a trade unionist, has a conflictual relationship with his unemployed son; Mario seeks an alternative way to the factory by starting a production of fresh pasta with the wives of some of his companions ...
notes: The story, as real as a shift on the assembly line, is re-proposed by Milani - also a screenwriter, with Domenico Starnone - in a key halfway between Mario Monicelli's _Folk novel_ and Pasquale Pozzessere's _Father and son_. In other words: a Silvio Orlando (truly inspired) on the path that once belonged to Ugo Tognazzi; and a Michele Placido who puts on the uncomfortable clothes of an old worker in perpetual conflict with his son, the symbol of another generation. Speaking of symbols, which the character played by the Lucanian actor invokes and sponsors: there are many, perhaps too many, from the bear (which Starnone and Milani could probably only "suggest") to the American Indians.

title: Cecilia
actors: Pamela Villoresi, Gianni Grima, Anna Terzano, Erika Manni, Massimiliano Rossi
description: Cecilia lives with her family in a seaside village: quarrels, misunderstandings and neuroses are the order of the day. When he realizes that it is impossible to change the insane and precarious balances on which everything rests, he goes away. The family is desperate and displaced. Relatives and friends flock to give a hand to parents who do not give each other peace.
notes: Between chaos and chance, "wars" and "insurrections", oblique glances and characters of various humanity, the play slips away without infamy and without praise, so close to medium tedium and so far from that "insanity" that, perhaps, it wanted to reach and overcome. The author and the performers try in every way not to get stuck, they choose live music and a beautiful song by Vinicio Capossela (Marajà) to entertain themselves as long as possible with the rhythm. But the cortist origin of the honest work is self-confessed.

title: Piazza delle Cinque Lune
actors: Donald Sutherland, Giancarlo Giannini, Stefania Rocca, Aisha Cerami
description: The investigating judge Renato Saracini has arrived at his last day of work. A stranger awaits him in the hallway of his house and gives him an envelope. It is a super8 reel in which an attack is confusedly filmed. The next day, the judge confides in Branco, the head of his escort, and shows him the video. Meanwhile, the stranger contacts him again and gives him an appointment in a church, claiming to know where the original of the Moro Memorial is located. Saracini is convinced that this investigation is worthwhile and involves Branco and Ferdinanda Doni, a young deputy prosecutor, in the enterprise.
notes: Su Moro remains to this day more sincere, clear-cut, concise and even "spectacular" the film that Giuseppe Ferrara shot in 1986 Here we are more in the parts of _The year of terror_, Frankenheimer's mess of 1991. As for the actors, what to say ? Giannini is bored, Sutherland perplexed and Stefania Rocca out of the way.

title: Good bye, Lenin!
actors: Daniel Brühl, Katrin Saß, Mária Simon, Chulpan Khamatova
description: East Germany, 1989: Young Alexander Kerner protests against the regime and is arrested. His mother Christiane has a heart attack and ends up in a coma. A few months later, after the collapse of the Wall, Christiane wakes up. To avoid too strong emotions, Alexander tries to keep the past alive by implementing every possible stratagem. But the world has irreversibly changed ...
notes: The film is nice, even if for the Italian viewer it will never have the same cathartic value that it had at home. Sometimes, however, the somewhat gray direction burns the possibilities of the story, proceeding without great rhythm.

title: Das Mädcheninternat - Deine Schreie wird niemand hören
actors: Katharina Wackernagel, Anne Kanis, Luise Bähr, Alexandra Finder
description: Nina enters a sanatorium located on a remote islet in the Channel. Seven other girls live in the institute (which is located in an ancient monastery of nuns), all victims of dark forces, among which a legend circulates about an evil spirit that every ten years, during a witches' sabbath, would return to the island ...

title: National Security
actors: Steve Zahn, Martin Lawrence, Colm Feore, Bill Duke, Eric Roberts
description: Earl Montgomery is a LAPD cadet who is kicked out of the academy due to his rebellious attitude and has to make do with being a modest National Security agent. After a confrontation with Hank Rafferty, an overzealous cop, Earl accuses him of abusing his power by making him lose his badge. Eventually Hank also finds himself working for National Security.
notes: Having exhausted the constitution of yet another "strange couple" of policemen in a rather lengthy presentation, the very modest film follows them vanquishing a gang of robbers led by Eric Roberts. And finding the unfortunate brother of the famous Julia here in a platinum-plated villain version is the film's greatest interest. Imagine the rest. The American comedy is dead, the action movie as well, their pairing in the "corner-from-multiplex" version is deadly. Martin Lawrence, who has been mimicking Eddie Murphy for years now, is the coup de grace.

title: Pollock
actors: Ed Harris, Marcia Gay Harden, Amy Madigan, Jennifer Connelly, Val Kilmer
description: A tormented man, torn by doubts, engaged in a solitary tug-of-war between the need to express himself and the desire to exclude the whole world from his work. So was Jackson Pollock, the great American painter who, little by little, sank into a spiral of no return that destroyed his marriage to Lee Krasner, his career and, on a summer night in 1956, his life.
notes: In this respectful and sincere declaration of love for Pollock the tone and structure are calibrated, correct and Harris exhibits a curd genius in stains, twisted lines and wonderful drippings. Oscar alla Harden for Best Supporting Actress.

title: Nueve reinas
actors: Gastón Pauls, Ricardo Darín, Leticia Bredice, Tomas Fonzi, Graciela Tenembaum
description: Juan and Marcos are two petty scammers who work in companies and are hired to make a half-million dollar heist: their job is to sell a counterfeit set of rare high-value stamps, "The Nine Queens". The shady negotiations involve Marcos' beautiful sister, their younger brother, and a slew of thieves, swindlers and muggers.
notes: The script (it has some negligible errors) is built as Chinese boxes inside which the spectators and some characters are not aware of everything and ignore what others might prepare to surprise the former and deceive the latter. Script, staging and interpretation have an insightful energy and the story exploits every resource, every reversal. The plot is tense and unpredictable. The lies and the games are those of a Latin American Mamet.

title: Perduto amor
actors: Corrado Fortuna, Donatella Finocchiaro, Anna Maria Gherardi, Lucia Sardo
description: Three stages in the formation of Ettore Corvaja, a young Sicilian, between the mid-50s and the mid-60s. In the first part, set in 1955, Ettore is a child and grows up between the joie de vivre of time and the teachings of his mentor, a cultured aristocrat from the town. In the second part - in full economic boom - Ettore is twenty years old and has already made his choices and his studies. Finally, Ettore is in Milan where he enters the world of music even if his aspiration is to write. Meet an esoteric group that opens up a new world to him.
notes: A film that irritates and excites, involves and repels, flies and plunges the head into the sand, excites but up to a certain point.

title: View from the Top
actors: Gwyneth Paltrow, Christina Applegate, Kelly Preston, Marc Blucas, Mark Ruffalo, Mike Myers
description: Donna Jensen's dream, a young woman living in a small provincial village, is to visit the world. To make it happen, try becoming a flight attendant ....
notes: Screenwriter Eric Wald (a name to write down in his notebook to avoid it) thinks he's witty, and hopes Mike Myers will come up with something funny. Myers actually participates in the Paltrow affair and her career in the skies as if she were in another movie. The icy actress-mannequin seems to delight in the swooning role of a quality "forced" with a chromatic collapsing wardrobe. Lightning-fast cameo from seasoned Rob Lowe.

title: Creature
actors: Craig T. Nelson, Kim Cattrall, Colm Feore, Cress Williams, Michael Reilly
description: After losing his brother, Simon Chase focuses his studies on sharks hoping to find a cure for the disease in their DNA. On a Caribbean island, formerly the site of a military base, a female specimen begins to follow, but when one of the inhabitants is massacred, the community blames her shark ...

title: Balto II: Wolf Quest
description: In the veins of Balto, the heroic sled dog, wolf blood flows: these origins are reflected in his offspring, in particular on little Aleu. In fact, the puppy, whose "wolfish" features are more marked than those of the brothers, is rejected by humans and, embittered, decides to run away from home ...

title: I diamanti che nessuno voleva rubare
actors: John Elliot, Aldo Giuffré, Salvo Randone, Jeanne Valerie, Mario Brega
description: Spiros, an old paralytic usurer, summons five criminals of different nationalities to his home in Rome to carry out a big blow against a jewelry store. The blow, studied by Spiros in every detail, is made with extreme ease by the five bandits, who, however, not wanting to submit to the conditions imposed by their inspirer, do not hesitate to kill him. In turn, they are exterminated with machine gun shots by a very faithful friend of Spiros, while another gang of criminals, who had managed to take possession of the stolen jewels, soon ends up in the hands of the police. Only one of the bandits, Fangio, manages to escape capture, fleeing on board a plane to Switzerland, in the company of Ursula, Spiros's beautiful secretary, with whom he fell in love during the preparatory phase of the coup.

title: Tempted
actors: Burt Reynolds, Saffron Burrows, Peter Facinelli, Mike Starr, George DiCenzo
description: New Orleans: Wealthy businessman Charlie Le Blanc finds he doesn't have much left to live. As he prepares to leave all his fortune to his beloved young wife Lilly, he begins to wonder if she really deserves it, and to test her loyalty he offers $ 40,000 to a certain Jimmy Mulate to "provoke" her. At first Jimmy refuses, then changes his mind: Lilly doesn't give in to his advances, but when the secretary reveals Charlie's plan to her she goes on a rampage ...
notes: The eroticism is sweaty, a little Zalman King. Little action, much less suspense, the characters speak in the heat it is and are very very dogs. Even the charm of the protagonist is repeatedly declaimed, but is not reflected in her appearances. The beaked husband is poor Burt Reynolds, who must have had a facelift and now looks like one of the Village People. Of note only Mike Starr, in a role of bodyguard who reserves some surprises.

title: Va e vem
actors: João César Monteiro, Rita Pereira Marques, Manuela de Freitas
description: João Vuvu, a widower with a son in prison convicted of double murder and robbery, lives in one of the oldest neighborhoods in Lisbon in the company of books and records. The man spends his days always traveling the same route aboard bus no. 100. The exit from the penitentiary of the son breaks the balance that João has created and brings out his criminal nature.

title: The Good Thief
actors: Nick Nolte, Tchéky Karyo, Said Taghmaoui, Marc Lavoine, Ralph Fiennes
description: Nice: while he is burning his last savings in a clandestine gambling den, Bob Montagnet - gambler and thief, abandoned by luck and penniless - meets Anne, a girl from the East who makes a living, and is struck by her beauty. After snatching Anne from her protector's clutches, Bob finds himself asked by an old friend to join him in carrying out a spectacular heist in Monte Carlo. For Bob it's a chance to reconstitute the old gang and get back to work, but in his own way ...
notes: In remaking _Bob the player_ (1955) by the great Jean-Pierre Melville, Jordan has the courage to change spirit and vision of things when we least expect it: it seems that desperation and loneliness prevail, but then the guts are torn, levity imposes itself and love for life takes over. No conciliation, only a precious trust in the desires of man. It is not cheap nowadays. Those quick and beautiful "freeze frames" on faces and bodies, which sometimes interrupt a gesture in the bud, are there on purpose to tell us that there is no time to waste time, and that life goes too fast to even deal with death . With prestigious collaborators (magnificent hyper-realistic photography by Chris Menges, great music by Elliot Goldenthal), a focal point - Nick Nolte - to scream and faces to frame, Jordan transforms Melville's melancholy, disenchantment and sense of defeat into pleasure to find the ransom. Living.

title: Swept Away
actors: Madonna, Adriano Giannini, Bruce Greenwood, Jeanne Tripplehorn, Elizabeth Banks
description: Rich and spoiled Amber is cruising on a yacht from Greece to Italy with her husband Anthony and four friends. The sea life does not correspond to the high standards of the woman, who pours her dissatisfaction on the mild Italian fisherman Giuseppe, guilty of having set his sights on her. It so happens that while Giuseppe, on a small boat, accompanies Amber to join the rest of the party, the engine breaks down: the two end up adrift on a desert island, where they remain for several months ...
notes: The remake of Lina Wertmüller's _ Swept away by an unusual destiny ..._ (1974) lines up an hour and a half of cloying jokes and predictable intrigues.

title: Cowboy Bebop: Tengoku no tobira
description: 2071, Halloween, Mars: A truck explodes on the Alba City crater highway, spilling a lethal chemical. The police suspect it is a terrorist attack and, in agreement with the Martian government, announce that they have placed a large price on those responsible. The crew of the spaceship Bebop, attracted by the reward, sets out on the trail of the guilty ... Taken from the Japanese TV series of the same name, the film strikes for its visual richness and structure. Paradoxically, its limit also lies in this richness: excessive duration, an involved plot and an animation that in some points shows evident drops in quality.

title: Waking Up in Reno
actors: Charlize Theron, Patrick Swayze, Natasha Richardson, Billy Bob Thornton
description: Roy and Candy have been happily married for a long time. With their close friends, Lonnie Earl and Darlene, another happy couple, decide to take a vacation. Destination of the trip is the Monster Truck show in Reno, Nevada. Their dream vacation is about to come true, but along the way Lonnie Earl realizes that Candy may not be just a friend ...
notes: An ugly hotel room is the main set of a film directed by a former comedian who quit after years of touring (looking at the soap skits of this impressed film, you can guess the reasons for his regretful abandonment). The actors are unbearable and Swayze has forgotten how to dance too.

title: Antwone Fisher
actors: Derek Luke, Malcolm David Kelley, Cory Hodges, Denzel Washington, Joy Bryant
description: The young sailor Antwone Fisher has serious character problems and for this he is sent to a psychiatrist in the navy. Initially the boy refuses his help, but over time it turns out that in childhood he suffered all kinds of possible abuse: physical, psychological, sexual. With the help of the psychiatrist, he confronts his past and sets out on a search for a family he has never really known.
notes: The story of Antwone Fisher (he was a security guard at the Sony studios in Los Angeles when the project was born) is a true and painful story. For many years he was in the Navy and in the film the protagonist is an aggressive and irascible sailor, forced to meet a psychiatrist (Washington) to learn how to control himself. The sessions, with inevitable transference and turbulent Thanksgiving lunch, are a tiring journey into the memory of a childhood marked by violence and abuse. Between self-care, the power of speech, the strength of the past, flashbacks and self-esteem recovery, Washington proves to be familiar with the yellowed grammar manual of the diligent filmmaker.

title: Apocalypse Now: Redux
actors: Marlon Brando, Martin Sheen, Robert Duvall, Frederic Forrest, Sam Bottoms, Laurence Fishburne, Albert Hall, Harrison Ford, Dennis Hopper, G.D. Spradlin, Jerry Ziesmer, Scott Glenn, Bo Byers, James Keane, Kerry Rossall, Colleen Camp, Cynthia Wood, Aurore Clément
description: Kurtz, a colonel in the US military in Southeast Asia, has fallen out of line, trespassed into Cambodia with his men and built a kind of personal empire, fighting a private war. Captain Willard is entrusted with the task of reaching Kurtz in his territory and eliminating him. It will be a terrible mission ...
notes: Twenty-one years later, Coppola reworked his masterpiece. The 53 minutes reinstated concern the sequence of the "Playboy" bunnies, that of Kurtz reading the "New York Times" and the long episode of Willard among the French settlers (which helps to understand the European presence in Indochina in the 1950s and '60).

title: 101 Dalmatians II: Patch's London Adventure
description: Confused in the sea of ??Dalmatian puppies, little Macchia would like to get noticed and become "a truly unique superhero", just like Fulmine, his favorite TV star. And finally for Macchia, accidentally separated from his family, the day of the big occasion comes: he meets his hero and is chosen to become his right hand in real life. Cruella becomes the financier of a new and eccentric artist who paints spot paintings and to inspire him she kidnaps all the other Dalmatian puppies. Macchia and Fulmine will have to invent together a way to save them and, thanks to his new friend, Macchia will discover that he is truly a supere.

title: Zerkalo
actors: Margarita Terechova, Jurij Nazarev, Ivan Danilcev
description: Aleksej is forced to stay in bed for a long time due to a mysterious illness that has struck him. From his memories emerge episodes of childhood and adolescence, some really happened, others only imagined: the summers spent in the country house, the father who had abandoned the family and the mother who hoped in vain for his return, the fire. of the barn, the work of the mother in a typography ...
notes: Between introspection and references to the history of his country, Tarkovskij unfolds his stylistic armamentarium (fixed shots, long sequence shots, symbols, metaphors, surreal openings) in a difficult but fascinating work.

title: Hidden Agenda
actors: Dolph Lundgren, Maxim Roy, Brigitte Paquette, Ted Whittall
description: Former agent Jason Price suspects something is rotten in the upper echelons of the feds, especially after a prominent witness is killed in a hearing. Investigating the perpetrators of the murder, he discovers that ...
notes: A tip: if you love suspense and twists, carefully avoid this film.

title: My Side of the Mountain
actors: Ted Eccles, Theodore Bikel, Tudi Wiggins, Paul Hébert, Cosette Lee
description: After learning that the summer vacation with his family has been canceled, 13-year-old Sam sets out for the Canadian mountains. In the fascinating natural environments he will live experiences that will mature him, accompanied by his raccoon friend and the advice of the wise wanderer Bando ...
notes: Uplifting story for kids.

title: Né terra né cielo
actors: Davide Gemmani, Antonella D'Arcangelo, Fabio Fulco
description: The worker Simone is fired, he discovers that his wife is cheating on him with his union friend and becomes pregnant. The man then matures an extreme gesture: he climbs the factory chimney and remains there, going on a hunger strike. Of course, TV and politicians rush in, and the case mounts. So much so that when Simone loses his voice, friends and enemies decide to leave him there, because it suits everyone.
notes: At first it looks like a film about workers, a bit Loach-like or _Monday in the sun_. Sure shot badly, interpreted worse, superficial and demagogic, but so be it. If in the first part it was only boring, in the end it becomes even worse.

title: Paris, Dabar
actors: Osvaldo Caracciolo, Leonardo Piccellar, Antonio Roma, Roberto Bozzetti
description: The film is an alcoholic competition: a marathon of ten competitors in the bars of via del Pratello, the "off" area (or so-called) of the old Bologna, competing to see who gets the most out of it. The protagonists are all possible and imaginable alcoholic beverages, from beer upwards, and the chatter that brings with it about such alcohol consumption.
notes: The portrait of a very particular slice of the city emerges (those who frequent Bologna know that pieces of the seventies that have disappeared, or destroyed, throughout the rest of the world, survive) and of a generation that is stubborn, proudly and so much in so much pathetic, not to align.

title: Un poker di pistole
actors: George Hilton, George Eastman, Annabella Incontrera, Dick Palmer
description: To honor a gambling debt with George, Lucas agrees to take a wagon with a precious cargo to Chamaco. On the road he is attacked by the gang of Masters who are responsible for all the illegal activities in the country. The Mexican Lazar rushes to get him out of the way.
notes: Interesting spaghetti western.

title: SpaceCamp
actors: Kate Capshaw, Tate Donovan, Kelly Preston, Lea Thompson, Joaquin Phoenix
description: Andie, a NASA instructor who has never participated in a mission in space, must train four 18-year-olds who participate in a study session sponsored by the space agency. It happens that due to an accident the space shuttle in which they are working takes off.
notes: Amiable mockery of space flights.

title: Flamingo Road
actors: Joan Crawford, Zachary Scott, Sydney Greenstreet, David Brian
description: Arriving in a small Southern town, dancer Lane Bellamy forms a relationship with Deputy Sheriff Fielding Carlisle. However, he is maneuvered by the local boss, the corrupt Titus Semple, who deems Lane harmful to his political ambitions and mounts a smear campaign against her. Released after an arrest, the woman gets a job in a club where she meets Dan Reynolds, another politician: the two get married and go to live in the uptown, but their tranquility doesn't last long ...
notes: Points of social controversy emerge in a typical melodramatic structure, supported by the excellent direction of Curtiz and by a cast of great luxury.

title: Il ronzio delle mosche
actors: Greta Scacchi, Giorgio Colangeli, Raffaele Vannoli, Renzo Alessandri, Marco Baliani
description: A team of doctors and scientists is working on an ambitious project: to bring back the madness among people to fight boredom and depression and thus be able to live better. For this purpose, the last three madmen left on earth are taken. In a secret place, the three unfortunates are thoroughly studied to understand their reactions. Only Doctor Natalia seems to feel a little tenderness for them ...
notes: Dario D'Ambrosi, who wrote and directed this unusual and intrepid first work, is a valid director, author and theatrical actor with a long experience and with a significant list of plays staged and performed. The passion for the theatrical scene has always been accompanied, for the director, by the attention and work on mental illness. These two paths materially and allegorically converge in the film, the title of which refers to one of the recurring sensations denounced by those suffering from brain disorders. In a world where insanity seems to have disappeared or been erased, a team of scientists and doctors plans to capture the last three patients and re-insert them into the daily reality that caused their insanity. The experiment needs actors and in fiction the insane recognize each other and show that pretending to be healthy or sick is not so immediate and that some continue to need the others. The cast is from a quality theatrical bill.

title: Top of the World
actors: Peter Weller, Dennis Hopper, Tia Carrere, David Alan Grier
description: A former cop, Ray Mercer, just released from prison after being convicted of stealing $ 40,000 from the coffers of his police district, is called to Las Vegas by his ex-wife. Do you want me not to get into some trouble? In fact, involved in the robbery of a casino, he realizes that the owner of the club and his assistant are in league with the bandits ... Is it time for the former policeman to redeem himself?
notes: Routine action movie, animated by an interesting cast, on which Dennis Hopper stands out as the "dirty" owner of the casino.

title: B.B. e il cormorano
actors: Edoardo Gabbriellini, Carolina Felline, Giorgio Algranti, Paolo Vivaldi, Selen, Marco Giallini
description: Mario, young and grumpy, is a plumber and works in a colony at the mouth of a river in a town on the west coast. His dream is to reach his uncle who lives in America. His employer is Nevio, a cynical and desperate schemer, who has his mistress Gabriella run the residence. The colony is populated by forgotten characters: a professor with a ferret, Guido the handyman caretaker and Gaia, the waitress, the only one who questions Mario and his overseas dreams. One day, to complicate everything, Piero, the uncle of America, arrives.
notes: Boring, very sad, with few ideas, Gabbriellini's debut has the only virtues in its brevity and in the character of Gaia, played by Carolina Felline.

title: Diggity: A Home at Last
actors: Max Dolbey, Bill Treacher, Andrew McCarthy, Louise Lombard
description: Diggity is a rather mischievous cherub who, in an attempt to make a leap up the ranks and earn wings, rescues an old church from the clutches of greedy Mister Slee, as well as helping a lonely young man find love ...
notes: The plot of producer Tom Reeve's debut feature is far too banal.

title: FearDotCom
country: Great Britain, Germany, Luxembourg, United States
actors: Stephen Dorff, Natascha McElhone, Stephen Rea, Udo Kier
description: A young and arrogant police officer from the investigative team and a beautiful and ambitious researcher from the Ministry of Health investigate the death of four people, which took place under mysterious circumstances. The four in fact all died 48 hours after connecting to the fear.com website. The investigations of the two become more complicated as they proceed, acquiring increasingly terrifying implications.
notes: The film is saved only by the scenographic care, which discards the modern objects to overshadow itself in démodé sets, large and very Thirties: beautiful the subway, the police station, the hospital, the factory cradle of the mad. For the rest, there is little.

title: L'isola
actors: Veronica Guarrasio, Ignazio Ernandes, Marcello Mazzarella, Erri De Luca, Anna Ernandes
description: Turi and Teresa are the sons of a fisherman and live on a small island. Turi is a shy and reserved teenager destined to grow up quickly: his father makes him participate in the slaughter of tuna. Teresa is 10 years old and would like to go fishing with her brother, but in the summer she finds a job as a waitress in the marina bar. The story of the two children is intertwined with the life of the island: the work, the effort, the rituals and habits of the fishermen.
notes: It is in the smile of Teresa (the talented Veronica Guarrasi) that _L'isola_ softens its defects, some temptation a little too authorial or the reluctance to let oneself go more often to skin, immediate emotions. Costanza Quatriglio knows how to direct actors and non-actors, above all she has a look with a small idea of ??the world. We hope you keep it.

title: Bruce Almighty
actors: Jim Carrey, Morgan Freeman, Jennifer Aniston, Philip Baker Hall
description: Despite being a TV reporter appreciated by the public, Bruce Nolan is not happy: he would like to take the place of the anchorman nearing retirement or be a special correspondent. He is actually unhappy with almost every aspect of his life and complains constantly despite having a delightful girlfriend, Grace, who adores him. At the end of a bad day in which all sorts of things happen to him, Bruce meets a mysterious man who offers him to take God's place for a week. By granting Bruce all his powers, God has in fact decided to challenge him to take on his duties to see if he can do better than Him.
notes: The direction is vigilant not to miss Carrey's bursts of energy and his tendency to turn the shooting field into a stage for a club comedian performance. Carrey is Bruce a frustrated TV reporter who aspires to become anchorman and growls at everything and everyone and takes it out on God for never listening to his prayers. One day the almighty, tired of his protests, decides to take a vacation and entrusts the demanding divine substitute to Bruce. A tasty starting point full of potential implemented to a limited extent.

title: An American Werewolf in London
actors: David Naughton, Jenny Agutter, Griffin Dunne, John Woodvine, Brian Glover
description: Jack and David, two American students on vacation in England, are attacked on a rainy full moon night by a monstrous creature. Jack is horribly torn apart, David is wounded and the monster is killed by the villagers. To David, hospitalized, Jack appears in a dream and warns him that he himself will become like the monster who hurt him. David does not want to believe it but at the next full moon he turns into a monstrous being half man and half wolf who begins to wreak havoc.
notes: Landis manages to mix irony and fear well. Oscar to Rick Baker for makeup.

title: Hijosen no onna
actors: Kinuyo Tanaka, Joji Oka, Sumiko Mizukubo, Hideo Mitsui
description: Tokiko, employed in an office, bonds with the gangster Joji. The man, determined to lend a hand to the girl and her younger brother, tries to score a blow, but the police are lurking ...
notes: Contrary to usual, here Ozu opts for a dynamic and varied staging, enriched by a photography rich in noir influences.

title: Playtime
actors: Jacques Tati, Barbara Dennek, Rita Maiden, Jacqueline Lecomte
description: While wandering through the most futuristic neighborhoods of Paris in a futile attempt to track down an employee, the lanky and staid Monsieur Hulot gets lost in a jungle of modern architecture and technological gadgets, getting "entangled" in a group of American tourists ...
notes: Tati emphasizes the more abstract and "lunar" features of his comedy, in open hostility towards the mounting contemporary alienation. Sounds and noises supplant the dialogues, while the human figures are lost in a geometric and anguishingly uniform urban landscape. Shot in 70mm (and therefore unsuitable for the TV screen) and widely shortened after the flop at the box office.

title: Il terrore dei barbari
actors: Chelo Alonso, Andrea Checchi, Luciano Marin, Steve Reeves
description: 568 AD: Alboin, king of the Lombards, subjugates northern Italy; the violence of its warriors causes unspeakable massacres, and the victims are countless. Among the few survivors is the Herculean Emilian, who gathers a handful of daring spirits animated by the proud intent of obtaining revenge ...
notes: "Medieval" routine for the Campogalliani craftsman.

title: Le grand chef
actors: Fernandel, Gino Cervi, Jean-Jacques Delbo, Noelle Norman
description: Antonio and Paolo are two poor people who make a living by washing cars. To raise some money and open a gas station, they decide to kidnap the son of an industrialist. Helped by two friends (the determined Paola and the shy Antonia), they successfully succeed in their intent. The child, however, turns out to be very pestiferous: the two then decide to get rid of him as soon as possible, demanding his ransom, but the parents do not wish to take him back. Desperate, the kidnappers come to a compromise ...
notes: The starting idea is good: it is a pity it does not hold up to the end, despite the two protagonists giving it their all.

title: Oh, Heavenly Dog!
actors: Chevy Chase, Jane Seymour, Omar Sharif, Robert Morley
description: Fatally wounded during an investigation, Detective Browning awakens in heaven. Here he learns that his "final destination" is linked to the outcome of another trial: he will have to return to Earth and, transformed into the furry dog ??Beniamino, solve the case of his own murder ...
notes: Nonsense for children of all ages.

title: Un difetto di famiglia
actors: Nino Manfredi, Lino Banfi, Carlo Cascone, Jane Ashbourne
description: Nicola is the happiest man in the world: his daughter is about to marry a boy from an excellent family. But on the day of the wedding, Nicola's mother died at the ripe old age of 101. During the funeral ceremony, Francesco, Nicola's elder brother, arrives, whom he hasn't seen for forty years. Francesco, the stone of the family scandal because he was homosexual, had forced Nicola and his mother to flee the country. Since then Nicola hates Francesco with all his strength. But to respect the last wishes of the mother, the two brothers are forced to undertake a long journey together to their country to accompany the body.

title: La vispa Teresa
actors: Vera Carmi, Antonio Gandusio, Carlo Ninchi, Roberto Villa, Lilia Silvi
description: A guy from a good family falls in love with a manicure. Parents opposed to the relationship send their son to Cortina. The lover brings with him the girl who, on the same day of arrival, leaves the young man to follow another man.
notes: First comedy screened in Rome after the liberation.

title: The Soul of a Man
description: The music and life of three blues artists: the story is interspersed with the performance of their songs by a host of contemporary artists. Skip James (1902-'69) studied guitar and piano, creating his own style. After studying theology, he became a Baptist pastor, performing for some time in churches. He preached until 1964, after which he returned to devote himself exclusively to music. Blind Willie Johnson (1902-'47), a Texas-born gospel singer and excellent guitarist, like other blind bluesmen makes a living singing on the street. His songs have become classics of the gospel blues. Finally, J. B. Lenoir (1929-'67) discovers music thanks to his guitarist father; it will then give life to a unique genre, in which the sax is combined with guitar and percussion with the accompaniment of a very particular voice.
notes: Wenders's is an anomalous documentary, given that half of what you see is an artificial reconstruction of the environment, with actors immersed in a grainy black and white and an over voice (in Laurence Fishburne's original) who takes the place by narrator Blind Willie Johnson. In fact, therefore, a disguised fiction, a sort of period hyperrealism that makes the discourse even more likely. Which? The usual of Wenders: images can be an ideal archive of the memory and custody of the removed. It was already theorized in science fiction _Until the end of the world_ (1991), and it is no coincidence that this film also begins with a literal "projection" into space and into the future.

title: Yossi & Jagger
actors: Ohad Knoller, Yehuda Levi, Assi Cohen, Aya Koren, Hani Furstenberg
description: Yossi, a career officer and company commander, and Jagger, one of his best conscript corporals, couldn't be more different: the first is reserved, thoughtful, traditional, the second is transgressive and casual. The two serve on the border between Israel and Lebanon and have a relationship, but their love must remain as secret as possible. Jagger is about to take his leave and is convinced that Yossi should also leave the army.
notes: Metaphorical enough, the comedy that in some ways recalls Mike Nichols's _Frenesie ... militare_, ends in blood and tragedy. Necessary seal to the daily struggle with which in the Middle East we are used to living together. It is understandable why it remained in the cinemas of Tel Aviv for over two months: you can breathe fresh air, you can smell a new desire, you can see different horizons.

title: City of Ghosts
actors: Stellan Skarsgård, Matt Dillon, James Caan, Natascha McElhone, Gérard Depardieu
description: Jimmy, under investigation for a bad insurance scam, flees the United States to join Marvin, the gang leader in Bangkok. Upon his arrival, he discovers that Marvin is in Cambodia, where he has deceived the wrong people. Jimmy sets out on a journey to track him down and recover his share of the loot: against his will, he will find himself embroiled in a bad story from which he may not get out alive ...
notes: The film that marks Matt Dillon's directorial debut is a fairly successful Oedipal thriller, in which the protagonist's bewilderment influences a staging that is distracted and attracted to the secondary implications of the plot.

title: No Looking Back
actors: Lauren Holly, Jon Bon Jovi, Edward Burns, Blythe Danner
description: Charlie returns to his hometown intent on regaining the heart of his ex-girlfriend Claudia, left three years earlier. But now the girl, who works as a waitress, is with the mechanic Michael, who has always been Charlie's best friend ...
notes: Burns writes, produces, directs and co-stars this discreet comedy with a bitter aftertaste.

title: Swimfan
actors: Jesse Bradford, Erika Christensen, Shiri Appleby, Kate Burton, Clayne Crawford
description: Ben Cronin has friends who love him, a gorgeous girl, and is the leader of the school's athletics team. Not that his life is simple: every day he spends many hours in the pool working out, works at the hospital, and tries to find time to be with Amy. But his existence is destined to be turned upside down by the arrival of Madison Bell. The newcomer sets her eyes on Ben and decides she must have him at all costs.
notes: Calm flat, in a film that begins at the fortieth minute of screening and ends at the forty-fifth. The title pool doesn't even function as a designated place for a couple of mother scenes.

title: Tosca e altre due
actors: Franca Valeri, Adriana Asti, Carlo Cecchi, Franco Interlenghi
description: Emilia, married to a jailer of Castel Sant'Angelo, works as a caretaker in the concierge of Palazzo Farnese. The woman never gets upset by the screams or unorthodox traffic that animates the building and barely notices Scarpia's comings and goings in a carriage. One night Iride arrives in his reception, wife of Scarpia's thug and former starlet.
notes: In the 1987 theatrical show written by Franca Valeri and played by the actress-author and Adriana Asti, the concierge of the Palazzo Farnese Emilia and Iride, a wandering starlet who does not resign herself to the boredom of a sedentary married life, they were alone to retrace and comment what happened on the upper floors, that is, the obstinate and threatening seduction of Baron Scarpia, the arrest of Cavaradossi, the extreme attempt by Tosca to save him. Instead, in the film Tosca and other two, directed by Giorgio Ferrara, the ghosts of the gentlemen appear in flesh and blood, dialogue and sing the most famous arias of melodrama. Perhaps it is this, this piece of "filmed work" that continues to interrupt the meddlesome, light-headed and angry chatter of the two women, the cause of the innumerable dead times and the flattening of the narrative tension of the film, which declares itself as a theatrical work since prologue interpreted by Carlo Cecchi, but does not dare to shut himself up in a single scene. Too bad, because we are not so interested in seeing what is happening upstairs, but rather hearing its "popularization" by two great actresses and glancing at their feminine frustrations and disappointments.

title: Blue Crush
actors: Kate Bosworth, Matthew Davis, Michelle Rodriguez, Sanoe Lake, Mika Boorem
description: Anne Marie is a passionate surfer who lives in a beach hut with two friends and her rebellious sister. He is preparing for an important competition: every day he wakes up before dawn and goes out with the board to train. But his balance is tested when he meets Matt, a handsome soccer player ...
notes: The portrait of the "Hawaii of the poor" that revolves around the world of tourists is very banal. The direction instead tries to flex its muscles, and drowns precisely in the sequences that were wanted more spectacular, those of the big waves: all accelerated on the computer, rigged for editing, they are an example of how not to shoot an action sequence.

title: Undercover Brother
actors: Eddie Griffin, Chris Kattan, Denise Richards, Aunjanue Ellis, David Chappelle
description: Anton Jackson, a seemingly shy and inexperienced "colored", is actually a brave agent of an underground African-American association whose aim is to protect ethnicity from the worst enemy around: The Man.
notes: Demented laughter in black, when it's good: otherwise all that remains is to look at the attractive protagonists.

title: Anger Management
actors: Jack Nicholson, Adam Sandler, Marisa Tomei, Luis Guzmán, Alleb Covert
description: Judge Daniels, because of a misunderstanding, the mild-mannered Dave a short-tempered and quarrelsome subject, requires him to undergo the anger management sessions held by Dr. Rydell. The decidedly unorthodox approach to therapy scares Dave a lot, who by a twist of fate is forced to intensify the sessions to avoid ending up in prison. The strange doctor decides to move to his house to help him but Dave is on the verge of a nervous breakdown.
notes: The best things about the film are the special invitations and the "cameos" (John Turturro in the part of the violent patient, Woody Harrelson in that of Galaxia, Rudolph Giuliani as himself) and _I Feel Pretty_ from _West Side Story_ intoned to calm the morning stress .

title: Young Adam
actors: Ewan McGregor, Tilda Swinton, Peter Mullan, Emily Mortimer
description: Glasgow, 1950s. The body of a young woman is fished out of the River Clyde by two bargemen. For three people - Joe, a tramp without roots, Leslie, the owner of the barge and his wife Ella - together with the corpse, memories of a murky and mysterious past resurface. As the police investigate and arrest a suspect, it is revealed that Joe had a stormy relationship with the girl in the past.
notes: Classic film with stars made up like bums, which nobody believes, even if the three leading actors in the end do not even exaggerate. Rhetorical and with some itchy cunning, the film is notable only for the river landscapes accompanied by the music of David Byrne.

title: Arrowhead
actors: Charlton Heston, Jack Palance, Katy Jurado, Brian Keith, Milburn Stone
description: Ed Bannon, chief of guides at Fort Clark, Texas, miraculously escapes an ambush by an Apache tribe. Later, the officer is removed because he is considered an obstacle to the "tolerant" policy of the army, which would like to move all the Apaches in the area to a reservation in Florida. When Toriano, son of the tribal chief, returns after attending a school in the east of the country, Bannon becomes increasingly suspicious ...
notes: Very tough Western, with unusual violence for that period. Difficult to see on TV, it deserves to be recovered; Heston and Palance give the best of themselves as two bitter enemies.

title: Hitori musuko
actors: Choko Iida, Shinichi Himori, Chishu Ryu, Tomio Aoki, Masao Hayama
description: Otsune goes out of his way to support his son Ryosuke. Years later, the woman goes to Tokyo to visit him, ignoring that Ryosuke is married, has a small child and leads a life that is certainly not comfortable ...
notes: Ozu's 36th feature film is also the first to be spoken, and is undoubtedly one of his major works.

title: L'inganno
actors: Nicole Grimaudo, Gianni Cavina, Alessio Di Clemente, Melanie Gerren
description: Lucia has a guaranteed future in the cinema. In fact, she is shooting the film that will consecrate her to the eyes of critics and the public. One day, however, she offers a ride to a homeless man, who steals a precious brooch from her. Lucia follows her tracks and finds herself in a homeless shelter run by some nuns. Is your life about to change?

title: Frozen Impact
actors: Ted McGinley, Linda Purl, Stacy Keach, Myles Jeffrey, Nicole Paggi
description: In Rutland, a town near Green Mountain, the Blanchards experience moments of tension. In fact, Dan and Christy are worried about the health of their son Jason who needs a liver transplant. At the hospital where he works as a doctor, Christy receives the news that a donor compatible with Jason has been found and that the explanted liver is already on board a plane flying to Rutland. Unfortunately the plane runs into a hail storm, crashing into the mountains. Knowing what happened, Dan goes to the scene and locates the container with the organ that can save his son's life. But...
notes: Discounted and predictable.

title: Andata e ritorno
actors: Alessandro Paci, Flavia Vento, Erika Bernardi, Giustino Durano, Andrea Cambi, Simona Caparrini
description: Due to a consistent and unexpected inheritance, Samuele - a thirty-year-old who works as a waiter - radically changes his habits. He lets himself go shopping, neglects his friends and girlfriend Sara and starts dating wealthy people, high finance wizards who involve him in ultra-billion dollar deals. But all that glitters is not gold and Samuel soon realizes it.
notes: The film is an obsolete object: because Flavia Vento wants topless and guépieres but she is no longer the bellona of the last resort, Neffa who sings _My Miss_ is already revival, Pieraccioni we have forgotten it and the characters who pay in lire take effect "costume drama".

title: La repubblica di San Gennaro
actors: Gianfelice Imparato, Anna Ammirati, Lucrezia Lante Della Rovere, Vincenzo Peluso
description: We are in 2013 and Italy is divided in two. In the Northern Republic, southerners are deported or locked up in special ghettos complete with high-voltage Friesian horses. In Milan, poor Strummolo tries everything to become a citizen of the North: he boasts German origins and calls himself Strumm and speaks with an unlikely Milanese accent. Neighbors treat him like a collaborator, relatives pity him, authorities persecute him.
notes: Learned, he is a well-known theatrical actor, but as an author he is superficial (the film is based on one of his plays), and his mimicry and his eyes bulging at the cinema are unbearable.

title: Welcome to Collinwood
actors: George Clooney, William H. Macy, Sam Rockwell, Jennifer Esposito, Edward Furlong, Luis Guzmán
description: To Cosimo, a thief in prison for theft, a lifer reveals the plan for the perfect heist: the one that all thieves dream of and that the penniless who roam the streets of Collinwood, a working-class neighborhood on the outskirts of Cleveland, in jargon call " Bellini". Since he's stuck in the jail, it's up to his girlfriend, Rosalind, to look for a wretch to replace him in prison, but no one is available. In a short time, Rosalind has five collaborators eager to get their hands on the swag. Led by Pero, an amateur boxer who with cunning manages to extort all the details of the plan from Cosimo and then let him rot in jail, the colorful brigade is made up of Riley, a failed photographer and painter who needs a thousand dollars to get out. the wife in prison; Leon, who wants to guarantee a better life for his sister; Basil, of Italian origins and completely broke; Toto, a no longer young rogue who has nothing more to lose. Relying on the dubious experience of Jerzy, a professional burglar, the band of desperate people are preparing to collect the "Bellini" ...
notes: Remake of _I soliti ignoti_ by Monicelli, set in a nerd suburb that the Russo brothers know well. Clooney carves out the cameo of the burglar master: here his name is Jerzy and he lectures on safes sitting in a wheelchair; there was the mythical Dante Cruciani (Totò). The comparison is absurd, but Clooney plays the impossible match with class and irony.

title: Cradle 2 the Grave
actors: Kelly Hu, Jet Li, DMX, Anthony Anderson, Tom Arnold, Mark Dacascos, Gabrielle Union
description: Ling, a dangerous criminal, kidnaps Vanessa, the daughter of Tony Fait, a notorious thief. In exchange for his release, a batch of black diamonds is demanded that Fait's gang has just stolen. The man is then forced to ally with the policeman Su to save his little daughter. The couple sets off a devastating race against time, where exploits, fights and chases are beyond imagination.
notes: The director Bartkowiak is less exhibitionist here than in the previous _Romeo must die_ and limits himself to managing everything without trying big things. Jet Li sets the pace a bit; the fight scenes are few and sparse.

title: Il leone di S. Marco
actors: Rik Battaglia, Gianna Maria Canale, Gordon Scott, Franca Bettoja
description: Venice, 17th century: the incursions of the Usocchi, ferocious pirates who infest the Adriatic, worry the government of the republic. Despite being destined by his father to a diplomatic career, the doge's son wages - under the guise of the "lion of St. Mark" - a personal war against privateers, at the head of a handful of daring men.
