His exploits will lead him to meet the beautiful Rossana, a commoner who has joined the Uskoks, and to fall in love with her ...
notes: The director of _Cuore di mamma_, _Suor Maria_ and _Sorrisi e canzoni_ (!) Tries his hand at his other favorite genre, pure adventure. But with little success.

title: Cupid's Prey
actors: Katrina Browne, Joanna Pacula, Jack Wagner, Glen Drake, Owen Black
description: Attending for a weekend the luxurious summer home of her boyfriend Matt Wetherton's parents, the beautiful and brilliant Rebecca Swain feels attracted to his father, the elegant and charming Jeremy. Informed that, several years earlier, a young man's lover had been killed on the property, Rebecca ends up learning more than she would have liked ...
notes: An absolutely routine plot and direction, with the usual slightly morbid triangle and the related thriller complications (so to speak). In the role of Iris, Matt's mother and Jeremy's wife, appears the over forty but always seductive Joanna Pacula.

title: Bell'amico
actors: Mariano Bartolomeu, Luca D'Ascanio, Rosalinda Celentano, Giorgio Tirabassi, Paola Cortellesi, Cecilia Dazzi, Cinzia Mascoli, Francesca D'Aloja
description: Damiana "piazza" at the home of Nicola the Angolan director Mariano Bartolomeu. Time passes, but Mariano does not go away: on the contrary, he penetrates deeper and deeper into the life of his guest, also shooting him with a camera. But when he decides to use the old films of Nicola starring Laura, a girl who later left him, the landlord is furious and Mariano is forced to remove the curtains ...
notes: Cinema and fiction provide the comfortable context for a successful first feature which is also an ironic digression on emigration, multiracial society and the instability of male figures.

title: Baran
actors: Hossein Abedini, Zahra Bahrami, Mohammad Amir Naji, Hossein Mahjoub Amir Naji, Hossein Mahjoub, Abbas Rahimi
description: Latif, 17, works as an assistant on a construction site: he goes shopping, prepares food for the workers. One day, one of the workers is seriously injured and has to stop working. The man is an illegal immigrant Afghan refugee and his son, Rahmat, arrives at the construction site to replace him. For the boy, heavy work is impossible and the foreman decides to give him the place of Latif, physically stronger and therefore able to tackle more demanding tasks. The kitchen soon turns out to be the ideal place for Rahmat and all the workers are won over by the goodness of the meals he prepares and his exquisite tea. No one regrets Latif who, forced to do heavy manual work, begins to spy on his rival to catch him out and get his place back. After many unsuccessful attempts, Latif discovers Rahmat's secret astonished. A secret that will upset his existence.

title: Heremakono
actors: Mohamed Mahmoud Ould Mohamed, Khatra Ould Abder Kader, Nana Diakite
description: Nouadhibou, a small fishing village. Seventeen-year-old Abdallah visits his mother before emigrating to Europe. The young man, unable to understand the language, feels a stranger but tries to decipher the universe in which he finds himself through the encounters he makes: the sensual Nana who tries to seduce him, Makan who, like him, dreams of leaving, Maata, an old man an improvised fisherman as an electrician and his apprentice Khatra, little more than a child. It will be he who will teach Abdallah the local language so that he can break the silence to which he is condemned.

title: Another Day
actors: Shannen Doherty, Julian McMahon, Max Martini, Chad Bruce
description: As soon as she is admitted to a difficult medical school, Kate discovers she is pregnant with her boyfriend Paul. The two have an argument and she leaves the house to reflect; upon returning, he learns that Paul died in a factory fire. Four years later, the woman and her daughter Megan live in the house next to David, a friend but also in love with Kate, who, however, has not yet mourned. One day, Megan falls into a river and Kate, trying to save her, loses consciousness. Recovering, she realizes she has gone back in time, two days before Paul's fatal accident ...
notes: Julian McMahon, the handsome Christian Troy of _Nip / Tuck_, is in the cast.

title: Die Salzmänner von Tibet
description: The expedition of four Himalayan nomadic shepherds in the region of the great lakes, where they will obtain the precious "white gold": salt, a substance that in those inaccessible lands has inestimable value. They will travel for three months together with more than one hundred yaks, on a journey that is also a respectful homage to the mountains and the gods.

title: Scorcher
actors: Mark Dacascos, Rutger Hauer, John Rhys-Davies, Mark Rolston, Tamara Davies, Mark Rolston, Thomas F. Duffy, Sam Lloyd
description: Despite the huge safety measures, the irreparable thing happened in a nuclear power plant, and the accident had apocalyptic consequences: uncontrolled earthquake and volcanic movements devastate Southern California. To prevent the long wave of the frightening phenomenon endanger the entire planet, a very serious decision is made: evacuate and destroy the city of Los Angeles! An authentic "mission impossible", entrusted to a panel of experts led by Ryan Beckett ...
notes: The "fighter" Dacascos (that of _Crying Freeman_) and the repeat offender Hauer in a film so full of clichés that it is even funny.

title: Tre punto sei
actors: Marco Giallini, Stefania Orsola Garello, Petra Faksova, Valerio Binasco
description: San Salvario, Turin. The multi-ethnic neighborhood is a powder keg always on the verge of exploding. This is where the story of two friends who fight on different fronts takes place. Corrupt cop Silvio and gangster Dante, close friends since they were kids, continue to do dirty business together in the neighborhood. Then one day they will be divided by love for the same woman.
notes: The setting, the use and the sense of space, the dazed rhythm of memory, are the most relevant elements of the film; Rondolino has an instinctive cinematic eye and a sure taste for the genre, with memories and references that are more Anglo-Saxon than French. But the story is a bit confusing, even more than what noir, by its nature, presupposes. Perhaps a greater concentration on the personal nightmare that surrounds the two protagonists would have benefited her.

title: 28 Days Later
actors: Cillian Murphy, Naomie Harris, Noah Huntley, Christopher Eccleston
description: Some British animal rights activists break into a scientific laboratory and - despite the contrary opinion of the researchers - free chimpanzees forced to see violent images continuously, but they are bitten. Some time later, a blood-borne epidemic spreads in England, causing permanent rage. A month later, three survivors try to save themselves from the attacks of the infected ...
notes: Playing well with the abstract and slightly hazy colors of digital video footage (chosen specifically to render a post-apocalyptic landscape), Boyle and screenwriter Alex Garland construct a modern science fiction apologue that has little to envy to the classic B movies of the past: a handful of survivors besieged by the hordes of their rabid peers, the forays into the dangers of the devastated city, the flight north in an old taxi in search of an area protected by the military. The references are explicit, strictly national and deliberate: the novels of James G. Ballard and John Wyndham, a certain air of institutionalized barbarism that comes straight from the ferocity of William Golding's _The Lord of the Flies_, that feeling of the "apocalypse under the house "well rendered by the films on Quatermass (especially _The Spaceship of Lost Beings_ by Roy Ward Baker, visually recalled in the London part), a typically British taste for anti-utopia. Excellent actors, mostly young and little known (except Eccleston and Gleeson).

title: Lettere al vento
actors: Edmond Budina, Bujar Asqeriu, Vilota Trebicka Banushi
description: Niko, an unemployed professor, lives with his wife and daughter in post-Communist Albania. Another son of his, who arrived in Italy in search of fortune, regularly sends money home, but does not respond to his letters. To find out why Niko leaves for Turin where a dramatic truth awaits him.
notes: Edmond Budina's work is perhaps naive here and there, and his imagination feeds too much on Kusturizian explosions and Tonino Guerra-like poetry. But the sincerity with which Budina, between obvious difficulties and forced cinegrammatic indecisions, proposes and re-proposes himself, his strength, his moral cleanliness, his ethics overshadow the "contradictions" of a film that should be screened in schools and , above all, on the walls of the municipal councils of many northern cities. A "liver" of _Lamerica_ by Gianni Amelio, which brings to mind and not infrequently Vittorio De Sica's neorealism.

title: Tra due mondi
actors: Stéphane Freiss, Lorenzo Crespi, Bianca Guaccero, Michele Placido
description: Captain Loyola at the head of the Bourbon army prepares to leave Sicily to reach France when he is ordered to escort a prisoner from Palermo to Messina. The captain at first refuses then changes his mind when he learns the name of the prisoner. It is about Grifone who two years earlier had kidnapped Angelica, the captain's fiancée, on the day of her wedding to Loyola.
notes: The film, written by critics Vito Zagarrio and Claver Salizzato, does not offer great news and constructs the story as a sort of historical western, with a distant echo of certain cinema of the 70s. Conversi conducts without great flights, and with a few drops of taste (redundant flashbacks, a few too many slowdowns, an awkward and rhetorical ending). Blurred the cast, even if the mercenary soldier played by Michele Placido has a lot of energy.

title: Riders
actors: Stephen Dorff, Natasha Henstridge, Steven Berkoff, Bruce Payne, Karen  Cliche
description: A gang of four young robbers - Slim, Otis, Frank and Alex - carry out daring high-risk robberies. The four always manage to escape the police thanks to their acrobatic skills. Slim, to secure his retirement, plans to score the coup of his life: five consecutive robberies in five days for a loot of twenty million dollars. Will he succeed in the undertaking?
notes: The screen is used as a billiard table for carom games that deny the laws of physics or as a precipice in which to throw oneself upside down or as a wall to climb with bare hands for a condensation of alleged thrills. Dorff remains a non-actor and even the extras overshadow him.

title: Perry Grant agente di ferro
actors: Umberto D'Orsi, Peter Holden, Jack Stuart, Marilù Tolo
description: Following the trail of a swag of fake dollars, a CIA special agent named Perry Grant arrives in Rome. Here he discovers that the organization revolves around Aaron Yosipovic, a megalomaniac scientist who intends to finance a much more ambitious criminal plan ...
notes: Very pale amatriciana spy-story.

title: Maya
actors: Peter Phelps, Mariella Valentini, William Berger
description: Strange deaths are occurring in a Mexican village. The first to fall victim is Salomon, a scholar who wants to discover the secret of the pyramid of King Xibalbay, who, centuries later, takes revenge on the profaners. An adventurer and the scientist's daughter arrive on the spot.
notes: Trash movie cost three billion.

title: Jumping Ship
actors: Joey Lawrence, Andrew Lawrence, Matthew Lawrence, Susan Walters
description: Michael and his cousin Tommy charter a luxury yacht on which they hope to have an unforgettable vacation. But their dreams of grandeur are shattered when they discover that the boat is a tub. And that's not all. Attacked by modern-day pirates, the two are forced to land on a desert island.

title: The Great Mouse Detective
directors: Ron Clements, John Musker, Burny Mattinson, David Michener
description: In London at 221 / B Baker Street, you can meet two celebrities: one is Sherlock Holmes, the other is the mouse Basil. Investigator with a formidable deductive logic. Basil must find a mysteriously missing toy manufacturer. After various adventures, Basil, aided by the faithful Dawson, brings the culprit to justice and thwarts a plot against the queen.

title: The File on Thelma Jordon
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, Wendell Corey, Joan Tetzel, Stanley Ridges
description: Turning to the prosecutor Cleve Marshall to report some thefts suffered by her old and wealthy aunt, Thelma Jordon begins a relationship with him. But the man is married and Thelma is with gangster Tony Laredo, and complications escalate when her aunt is found dead ...
notes: The excellent direction of Siodmak at the service of a great Stanwyck.

title: The Beach Girls and the Monster
actors: Jon Hall, Sue Casey, Walker Edmiston, Elaine DuPont, Arnold Lessing

title: House of Secrets
actors: Michael Craig, Anton Driffing, Gérard Oury, Brenda De Banzie
description: A sailor involved in smuggling is captured by the CIA, which forces him to infiltrate the criminals by posing as a criminal of which he is the double.

title: Teenage Monster
actors: Anne Gwynne, Gloria Castillo, Stuart Wade, Gil Perkins, Stephen Parker

title: Halloween: Resurrection
actors: Busta Rhymes, Jamie Lee Curtis, Brad Loree, Bianca Kajlich
description: A group of young people decide to participate in a competition that allows them, if they win, to take part in a TV show. Teens are called in for an audition at Michael Meyers' childhood home. Soon the kids will find themselves in a nightmare that is hard to get out of alive.
notes: Michael Myers is not dead and his sister Jamie Lee knows it well, waiting for him awake in an asylum, but now he is forced to play the scarecrow of young witch hunters who seem to have never seen a horror in their life and with writers who hope. just to be hired for the next reality TV show. Luckily for the first ten minutes there is the Big Sister, because the "brothers", big and small, are really disappointing.

title: Half Past Dead
actors: Steven Seagal, Ja Rule, Morris Chestnut, Nia Peeples, Tony Plana
description: In 2002, the infamous Alcatraz prison was reopened: a cunning criminal, former bureaucrat turned dangerous criminal, devises a plan to enter the high-tech prison. Its goal? Find out where one of the prisoners, locked up on death row, hid two hundred million dollars in gold bars. Federal agent Sasha Petrosevitch, with the help of prisoner Nick, tries to put a spoke in his wheel ...
notes: Not content with having given birth to the script, Don Michael Paul _ (Renegade, Pacific Blue) _ also decided to shoot this film, which recycles old ideas and equally old clichés.

title: A.A.A. Achille
actors: Paolo Bonacelli, Sergio Rubini, Hélène Sevaux, Loris Pazienza, Diego Verdegiglio, Paolo Bonacelli, Lucia Vasini
description: Achille is a stuttering child whom his uncle Ciro, doctor and prominent figure of the family, takes to Villa Agorà, a clinic run by Doctor Aglieri. This is a rascal who claims to have invented an effective therapy: spoken singing.
notes: Gentle praise of slowness and calm on an almost cheerful handicap.

title: Tokyo no korasu
actors: Tokihiko Okada, Emiko Yagumo, Hideo Sugawara, Hideko Takamine, Tatsuo Saito, Choko Iida
description: Employed in a company, Shinji takes a stand against the abuses committed by his boss and ends up fired. Driven by hardships (aggravated by his daughter's illness), he will have to adapt to a humiliating job ...
notes: Still belonging to the master's silent period, a film dominated by a subtle but inextinguishable bitterness.

title: La vita semplice
actors: Giulio Stival, Luciano de Ambrosis, Anna Bianchi, Maurizio D'Ancora
description: The daily routine of Marco and Bepi, two gondoliers from Giudecca, is turned upside down by a factory located nearby. It will be the love between Marco's daughter and the industrialist's son to put everything back in place ...
notes: The director of _Uomini sul fondo_, an adept from Salò, directs a conventional "lagoon" melodrama.

title: Babyraub - Kinder fremder Mächte
actors: Jeffrey Meek, Nina Franoszek, Matthias Habich, Patricia Millardet
description: Having escaped a terrible car accident in which his wife died, the American parapsychologist Philip Devlin reports a very serious amnesia: the only person who seems to emerge from the fog of his memories is a Berlin doctor, Dr. Wiemer. Plagued by inexplicable hallucinations, Devlin - accompanied by his German colleague Horst Glockner - decides to visit Wiemer. But he lies lifeless in his apartment, killed - apparently - by the French Jeanne, who tells the two a story that is incredible: Wiemer allegedly kidnapped his son, whose father is no less than an alien ...

title: Il destino ha quattro zampe
actors: Lino Banfi, Nino Frassica, Edoardo Baietti, Rosa Pianeta, Michela Noonan
description: Giuseppe is a middle-aged actor who had previously experienced some success with a children's show. Over the years, however, his career is in decline and the only parts he manages to remedy are from extras, until Tempesta, an actor dog, joins his life.

title: Six Black Horses
actors: Audie Murphy, Dan Duryea, Joan O'Brien, Bob Steele, Roy Barcroft
description: Ben and Frank are hired by the mysterious Kelly to escort her home through Indian territory. Along the way, Kelly offers Ben the entire agreed fee in exchange for the life of Frank, who had previously killed her husband ...
notes: Written by specialist Burt Kennedy, collaborator - among others - of Budd Boetticher.

title: Killer Flood: The Day the Dam Broke
actors: Joe Lando, Bruce Boxleitner, Matthew Ewald, Michele Greene
description: For the people of Rutland, life does not flow smoothly: on more than one occasion, in fact, torrential rains have jeopardized the seal of the dam overlooking the town. The doubts grew after the accidental death of an engineer who had gone to the site: one of the most skeptical is the builder of the dam ...

title: Deadly Swarm
actors: Shane Brolly, Kaarina Aufranc, Pepe Serna, Roger Nevares, Freddy Soto
description: A swarm of killer bees dramatically disrupts life in a quiet town. A journalist and a scholar try to understand what triggered the aggression of the insects ...
notes: The director's only merit was being an assistant in the production of Ron Howard's _Fire killer_.

title: Avalanche Alley
actors: Ed Marinaro, Nick Mancuso, Kirsten Robek, Wolf Larson, Tobias Mehler
description: Rick is definitely not having a good time: in fact, his small ski resort is on the verge of bankruptcy and some potential buyers are already buzzing around him, which leads him to drown his sorrows in alcohol. Then, one bad day, his wife - with whom he has had bad relations for some time - risks freezing to death under an avalanche that caught her on an excursion. The searches are triggered, but they do not give the hoped-for fruit ...
notes: Modest television movie directed by one of the directors of the _Highlander_ series. We saw Nick Mancuso in _Trap on the high seas_ and _Trap in the Rocky Mountains_.

title: Silenzio: si uccide
actors: Claudio Trionfi, Lea Lander, Gianni Santuccio, Luisa Rivelli
description: Around Europe on the trail of an arms trafficking, the secret agent Mark Robin follows a trail that leads him to Tunisia, guest of the young Diana: and when she is kidnapped by Maude (right arm of Thetokis, the chief of traffickers), Mark is forced to intervene ...
notes: Laughable "spy-story" of self-sufficient production.

title: La meglio gioventù
actors: Luigi Lo Cascio, Fabrizio Gifuni, Maya Sansa, Sonia Bergamasco, Jasmine Trinca, Alessio Boni, Adriana Asti, Fabrizio Gifuni
description: The story of an Italian family from the late 1960s to today. At the center the stories of two brothers, Nicola and Matteo who at first share dreams, hopes, readings and friendships until the meeting with Giorgia, a psychically disturbed girl, will not mark the fate of both: Nicola will decide to become a psychiatrist, Matteo di drop out of school and join the police. Next to them are their parents, Angelo and Adriana and two sisters: Giovanna, who entered the judiciary very young and Francesca, the youngest, who will marry Carlo, Nicola's best friend, destined for an important role at the Bank of Italy and for this reason in the sight of terrorists during the years of lead.
notes: Two very dense acts for a long and at times heartbreaking fresco that starts in 1966 and reaches the present day: the precedent of Marco Tullio Giordana's masterpiece is another Italian film with identical historical coordinates and ambitions - Novecento by Bernardo Bertolucci - also distributed in theaters in two parts. They also share the melodramatic undertone (Giordana confesses that she thought of Fassbinder), the great breath of the opera, the absolute lack of shame in bathing with the tears of life, with the absolute and purity (the tormented character of Matteo, for whom he cheers: and thanks to Alessio Boni), with coherence and ethics (Nicola: another extraordinary testimony of Lo Cascio), with repudiation and shortcuts (the intense, brigatista by Sonia Bergamasco), with ferocious institutional pragmatism (the calm, subtle Carlo di Gifuni, here at his most mature cinematographic test). The best and the worst of a generation, Pasolini contrasted, involved and detached, warm and distracted, like a work in black by Rainer Werner Fassbinder.

title: Fellini: je suis un grand menteur
actors: Federico Fellini, Roberto Benigni, Donald Sutherland, Italo Calvino, Terence Stamp
description: An irreverent portrait of the Rimini master, who explores the creativity and profound contradictions of an extraordinary artist. Taking its cue from the often recognized inability of the filmmaker to distinguish truth from lie and fiction from reality, the film embarks on a journey from Rimini to Rome in search of an unknown Fellini and the sources of his imagination.
notes: Pettigrew collects the latest filmed conversations (made between 1991 and 1992) with a man who has always admitted an ancient and amused familiarity with the lie, between scenes of his masterpieces, fragments of some backstage and tasty testimonies.

title: Identity
actors: John Cusack, Ray Liotta, Amanda Peet, John Hawkes, Alfred Molina
description: Due to a raging storm, ten strangers (all with their own secret) find themselves in a hotel for motorists run by a nervous night manager. The relief of finding shelter is soon replaced by terror as, one after another, the ten travelers begin to die. To survive they must uncover the mystery that caused them to meet.
notes: James Mangold's fifth film is a good thriller that uses a puzzle architecture and that modulates the tension and the uncanny, reading the stereotypes of the genre through the encrypted code of madness.

title: Cradle Will Rock
actors: Angus McFayden, Hank Azaria, Emily Watson, John Turturro, Philip Baker Hall, Bill Murray, Susan Sarandon, Joan Cusack, John Cusack
description: New York, 1930. As worker protests sweep across the country, the Big Apple is animated by an intense cultural revolution. Nelson Rockefeller hires Mexican Diego Rivera to paint the lobby of the Rockefeller Center, while Italian propagandist Margherita Sarfatti provides Leonardo Da Vinci millionaires to support Mussolini's war effort. Meanwhile, a young Orson Welles directs _The Cradle Will Rock_, the new musical by Marc Blitzstein that addresses social problems and dramatic themes. But the performance is suspended on the eve of the debut by the soldiers of the American government.
notes: Beyond the extraordinary interpretations (Susan Sarandon, John Turturro, John Cusack, Bill Murray, Philip Baker Hall ...) the film, the real one, is not entirely successful precisely because the ambitions are exaggerated. But it has a very beautiful ending, with the past and the present that blend seamlessly to underline the dramatic cyclical nature of the story.

title: Bringing Down the House
actors: Steve Martin, Queen Latifah, Eugene Levy, Joan Plowright
description: Lawyer Peter Sanderson lives in one of the most exclusive neighborhoods in Los Angeles and although he has long been divorced, he is still very attached to his ex-wife. Surfing the internet in a chat room, he meets Charlene Morton, a woman who uses the pseudonym of LawyerGirl. When they decide to meet, he who was expecting a young blonde and refined lawyer, finds himself in front of a black fresh from prison who wants him as her lawyer. Peter tries in every way to get rid of the woman, but he always finds her in front of him so much that he risks seeing his attempts at reconciliation with his ex-wife and a billionaire cause go up in smoke.
notes: Director Adam Shankman, responsible for the unbearable _Sooner or later I get married_, redeems himself thanks to the actors and the screenplay of a rookie who has reviewed and rehearsed the comedies of the last twenty years. Mindful of his past as a successful choreographer, he suggests to the protagonists to "dance" in almost all the scenes, even those in which they are seated at a table.

title: Double Frame
actors: Daniel Baldwin, James Remar, Leslie Hope, Peter Outerbridge
description: Police Detective Frank Tompkins and his colleague Tim Follett are given the thorny task of conducting a sensitive $ 3 million investigation. A sum to make your head spin, no doubt about it: exactly what happens to Tara, Frank's lover and law enforcement informant, who in fact manages to convince her man to take over the huge swag and get away with it. she...
notes: A plot similar to a thousand others, shot in the most obvious and predictable way. As if that weren't enough, the presence of one of the many Baldwins around also neutralizes an authentic tough face like Remar (_48 hours_).

title: Little House on the Prairie
actors: Michael Landon, Karen Grassle, Melissa Gilbert, Melissa Sue Anderson
description: At the end of the Civil War, the Ingalls family leaves their home in Wisconsin to move to the Minnesota prairies. Here the members of the family hope to find a new accommodation and to be able to rebuild a new life. But the difficulties they will encounter will be innumerable and unforeseen.

title: Dio vede e provvede
actors: Angela Finocchiaro, Marisa Laurito, Maria Amelia Monti, Cochi Ponzoni

title: Error in Judgement
actors: Joe Mantegna, Joanna Pacula, Sung Hi Lee, Ric Sarabia, Kate Jackson
description: For the purpose of treatment and without the knowledge of those concerned, the psychologist Liz causes her patient, the young artist Toni, to exhibit in her husband Eric's gallery. The exhibition is a success; what Liz had not foreseen is that a story could be born between the two: but is it reality or an invention of the girl?
notes: Quite predictable.

title: Kaze no naka no mendori
actors: Shuji Sano, Kinuyo Tanaka, Chishu Ryu, Takeshi Sakamoto
description: Circumstances push Tokiko to prostitute herself (even if only once) in order to pay for her sick child for medicines. But her husband Shuichi, recently discharged from the army, does not forgive her ...
notes: Ozu addresses thorny social issues such as the return of war veterans, urban depersonalization and violence within the family.

title: The Westerner
actors: Gary Cooper, Walter Brennan, Doris Davenport, Fred Stone
description: After the end of the Civil War, legions of pioneers - herders and farmers - pushed further and further west, colonizing vast territories. But the two groups have conflicting interests, and the conflict is often bitter. Self-invested in the authority of "man of the law", herdsman Roy Bean presides over summary trials against cattle thieves, who invariably end up hanged. But even Bean has a weakness (a passion for actress Lily Langtry), and adventurer Cole Hardin will be able to use it to his advantage ...
notes: Wyler for his part tells a story that John Huston will resume in _The man with the seven halters_ (1972).

title: Bord de mer
actors: Hélène Fillière, Jonathan Zaccaï, Bulle Ogier, Patrick Lizana, Ludmila Mikael
description: A holiday town in the Bay of Somme. Many characters who live here: Paul, the lifeguard who works in a supermarket during the year; his mother Rose, who likes to play slot machines; Marie, his girlfriend, who works in the factory, but would like to leave like Albert, the boss's son ...
notes: The heart of the film is the relationship of the characters with the landscape, their wandering in the bathhouses covered by clouds, in the out-of-season houses, the abstract, almost cartoon-like frames in which they are inserted. The direction of the actors is excellent, the music is delightful with echoes of refrains that do not become melody. Debut awarded with the Caméra d'Or in Cannes.

title: Tristano e Isotta
actors: Ralf Bauer, Léa Bosco, Pierre Cosso, Joachim Fuchsberger
description: Son of the king of Brittany, the young Tristan renders a precious service to his uncle, King Mark of Cornwall, by killing the hostile giant Morholt, son of the king of Ireland. Severely wounded by the envious courtiers and abandoned on a drifting boat, Tristan lands right in Ireland where he falls in love with Isolde, Morholt's sister ...

title: Kangaroo Jack
actors: Jerry O'Connell, Anthony Anderson, Christopher Walken, Estella Warren, Michael J. Shannon
description: Charlie and Jack are inseparable. They are in trouble because they have taken the police to the lair of Sal, a mala boss who, as a last resort, asks them to go to Sydney to deliver $ 50,000 to a colleague. Everything seems to be going well until they hit a big kangaroo in the jeep. Struck by the resemblance to their friend Jack, they put the jacket on him. The animal wakes up suddenly and runs away taking away the vest with the swag.

title: Tandem
actors: Jean Rochefort, Gérard Jugnot, Philippe Dormoy, Sylvie Granotier, Julie Jezeque
description: Mortez and his assistant Rivetot tour France presenting "The Cat's Tongue", an unlikely radio quiz. Mortez is revered by his audience and by Rivetot; for 25 years the two have been traveling and living side by side, because Rivetot endures anything to be with his idol: nights in the car, squalid hotels, hysterics ... Mortez is still animated by the enthusiasm for his " "program, what he invented: and when Rivetot learns that the quiz will be canceled, he is careful not to let him know ...
notes: Leconte mixes the tones and aspires to the bittersweet-surreal comedy, but does not get the dose of the cocktail right.

title: Layover
actors: David Hasselhoff, Gregg Henry, Yvonne Sciò, Sherri Alexander
description: During an airport layover, businessman Dan Morrison meets young Vickie. Passion overwhelms them: but the affair is discovered by Vickie's husband, the dangerous jewelry dealer Gillardo ...
notes: The former lifeguard of _Baywatch_ and one of the former lolitas of _Non è la Rai_: what did you expect?

title: Black Knight
actors: Martin Lawrence, Marsha Thomason, Tom Wilkinson, Vincent Regan
description: While he is cleaning the moat of the medieval playground where he works, Jamal tries to pick up an object and enters another space-time dimension. Thus he finds himself in the middle of the Middle Ages, among dissolute knights, beautiful ladies and insurrections. Jamal will have to use the tricks of the 20th century he came from to save the kingdom from a bloodthirsty plot.
notes: The reconstruction of England in the fourteenth century looks like that of Monty Python, but the packaging of the "television" director Gil Junger, imbued with low-grade gags, and the ending make the film look more like a pilot episode of a TV series. save only the crackling interpretation of Martin Lawrence in the main role.

title: Dogma
actors: Ben Affleck, Matt Damon, Linda Fiorentino, Salma Hayek, Jason Mewes, Kevin Smith, Alanis Morisette
description: Exiled from Paradise millions of years ago, the fallen angels Loki and Bartleby are now in Wisconsin. They learn that if they manage to enter a New Jersey church on the day of the "rededication" they will be able to return to Heaven. It is one of the ideas of a progressive cardinal who wanted to modernize religion with many initiatives (for example, replacing Christ on the cross with statues of smiling Jesus with the thumbs up). But God's spokesman - with the help of Bethany, the last descendant of Christ, two prophets, a muse and the thirteenth apostle - does everything to prevent Loki and Bartleby from gaining the plenary indulgence because otherwise the word of God would prove to be fallible and consequently everything would have to be called into question.
notes: Damn what a mess! If Kevin Smith, a fallen talent like his little angels, wanted to prove himself capable of making a film without a consistent narrative trace, with references and found thrown in at random, he succeeded in full.

title: Sempre più difficile
actors: Germana Paolieri, Nerio Bernardi, Clelia Matania, Adriano Rimoldi
description: Sicily, early 1900s: unleashing his brilliant rhetorical visage, the joyful and penniless prince Raimondo di Falcomarzano manages to settle with a wealthy shipowner, to involve him in random undertakings and even to ... become his relative.
notes: Actors of school and consummate skill for an old-fashioned costumed comedy.

title: Phone Booth
actors: Colin Farrell, Kiefer Sutherland, Forest Whitaker, Radha Mitchell, Katie Holmes
description: Stu Shepard, a small-town advertising New Yorker, often uses a pay phone to avoid being discovered by his wife Kelly and to call Pamela, a young woman who wants to become an actress, undisturbed. One day, after trying to give the girl yet another date, the phone rings and a stranger warns Stu that if he ends the conversation he will be killed. The mysterious interlocutor is none other than a serial killer armed with a rifle, who to prove his real intentions cuts down a passer-by. At first the police believe that the murder was committed by Stu, until Captain Ramey realizes that things are different ...
notes: Schumacher allows himself a divertissement and - using a canvas that is not exactly the first hair - gradually builds a tension that envelops and captivates. As the minutes pass, the thriller tends to fade and blend into Stu's personal drama: which, while not having the moral qualities, is transformed into a modern secular version of Job. His mysterious interlocutor is as omnipotent as a god and seems to be everywhere. Subjected to a seemingly interminable torture, Stu loses his original boldness and ends up collapsing. Interesting is the work of the discontinuous American director, who - based on the concise screenplay signed by a veteran like Larry Cohen - takes advantage of the metropolitan set to make the most of a warp that is always disturbing and full of pathos.

title: Historias mínimas Historias mínimas
actors: Javier Lombardo, Antonio Benedictis, Javiera Bravo, Francis Sandoval
description: Three stories intertwine in Patagonia: all the protagonists in search of something. The old Don Justo runs away from home to find his beloved dog who has mysteriously disappeared; Roberto, a traveling salesman, is chasing an impossible love; finally, Maria Flores is confident in participating in a prize game to solve her economic problems.
notes: Sorin, almost twenty years ago, had made himself noticed in Venice with an all too clever and pimp film, _La pelicula del rey_, and also in this film he remains faithful to an inspiration that draws nourishment from the atmospheres of the "magical realism" of lots of Argentine literature, making it less harsh, more mildly "lunar". There is little boredom, some gags are lively, the places suggestive, the dialogues are impeccable and in short, the film lets itself be watched. But the naïve, the funny and the dreamers in this film are overwhelmed literary figures, and the film (even compared to some surprising points of recent Argentine cinema) has a bit of an old age.

title: Menja d'amor
actors: Juliet Stevenson, Paul Rhys, Allan Corduner, Kevin Bishop, Geraldine McEwan
description: Paul, a piano student, casually meets his idol, world-renowned pianist Richard Kennington at a concert. Called at the last minute to do the page turner, Paul impresses the pianist and his agent with his looks and skill. Some time later Paul, on vacation in Barcelona with his mother, runs into Richard again and a relationship is born between the two. After moving to Paris to attend a prestigious music school, Paul lives in the shadow of powerful and mature patrons but gradually realizes he doesn't have enough talent.
notes: The idea of ??telling a love story where a lover who is not yet of age proves to be mature, had a certain charm. Instead the second part suffers the repercussions of a staged staging that does not allow the melodramatic elements to explode as they should.

title: Beneath Loch Ness
actors: Patrick Bergin, Lysette Anthony, Brian Wimmer, Lysa Apostle
description: Taking over from his late colleague Gus Eagen, the American paleontologist Case Howell continues his research on the presence of creatures descended from marine dinosaurs in the waters of Loch Ness, in Scotland. Howell, determined but with an intractable character, often and willingly clashes with the other members of the scientific expedition, already at loggerheads both with the coast guard and with the equally suspicious local population. And when a diver and some fishermen die inexplicably in the lake, the situation worsens ...
notes: Yet another variation - technological but completely inessential - on the eternal riddle of "Nessie".

title: Princess of Thieves
actors: Keira Knightley, Stuart Wilson, Jonathan Hyde, Stephen Moyer
description: Gwyn, daughter of Robin Hood, takes the place of her father in the defense of the weakest when her parent is captured by Giovanni. Philip, son of Riccardo, heir to the throne after his father's death and too frightened to claim his due, has fled to France. Will Gwyn be able to track him down and free his father?

title: In a Lonely Place
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Gloria Grahame, Frank Lovejoy, Carl Benton Reid
description: Dixon Steele, a Hollywood screenwriter and WWII veteran, is subject to sudden outbursts of violence. The man is suspected of killing a girl, but is cleared by a neighbor who has a crush on him. Their relationship is compromised by the doubt that the man is a real killer.

title: The Deadly Look of Love
actors: Jordan Ladd, Vincent Spano, Holland Taylor, Harant Alianak
description: Janet is an emancipated provincial girl full of dreams for her future. One day he meets Brett and falls in love with him, but soon his obsession becomes so much that he kills his wife, which she considers the only obstacle to their love story. Janet manages to get Brett to blame for the crime ...

title: Testa di sbarco per otto implacabili
actors: Peter Lee Lawrence, Guy Madison, Erika Blanc, Alfio Caltabiano
description: As D-day looms, eight Marines disguised as Germans must identify the bunker where the Wehrmacht command is based.
notes: Boring war adventure film, produced on a blatantly laughable budget. The monochord director from Brescia, a specialist in various _lacrima movies_ with Mario Merola, doesn't help.

title: Gli intoccabili
actors: Peter Falk, John Cassavetes, Britt Ekland, Gena Rowlands, Gabriele Ferzetti
description: Charlie Adamo, a middle-class mobster, breaks Hank out of prison because he intends to use his help to rob a gambling house in Las Vegas. When he discovers that he belongs to the Cosa Nostra bosses, he desperately tries to stop Hank.
notes: Rather conventional film saved by good performers.

title: Rider of Revenge
actors: Polly Kuan, Tian Peng, Chiang Ping, Miao Tian
description: The fierce Li Hua, daughter of the prefect, meets a colorful series of characters including a one-eyed brigand and another with a deadly claw ...
notes: The film has nothing to do with the more well-known _Chen's scream terrifies even the West_ with Bruce Lee, but at the time we weren't looking too subtle.

title: Cadet Kelly
actors: Hilary Duff, Christy Romano, Gary Cole, Shawn Ashmore, Aimee Garcia
description: Kelly is the daughter of divorced parents and entrusted to her mother. When she remarries with Major Joe "Sir" Maxwell, the girl finds herself in the military school where her stepfather works. Arriving at the barracks, she immediately has to deal with the sardonic Jennifer, who is part of a team of instructors. The latter does not take much sympathy for the newcomer: especially when she begins to have sweet eyes at Bret, her boyfriend. In fact, he will put her in punishment forcing her to clean and polish the uniforms of the whole school team, next to an exercise competition against other military institutes ...
notes: Typical Disney production about the triumph of good feelings.

title: The Glow
actors: Portia De Rossi, Dean Cain, Hal Linden, Dina Merrill, Joseph Campanella

title: Wrong Number
actors: Karen  Cliche, Brigitte Bako, David Lipper, Jo Marr, Eric Roberts
description: Internet tycoon Josh falls from the balcony of his building after being shot and wounded. As he is dying, he thinks back on how drastically his life has changed since he became immensely rich, examining his past to try and figure out what went wrong.

title: Hilfe, ich bin ein Junge
actors: Sarah Hannemann, Nick Seidensticker, Philipp Blank, Pinkas Braun
description: Eleven-year-old Emma's life is not easy: her mother expects her to be the best in her class, her swimming coach wants to turn her into an Olympic swimmer. Emma wants to become a boy and, thanks to a spell, her wish is granted.
notes: An obvious plot for a film that is not much fun.

title: Così sia
actors: Luc Merenda, Alf Thunder, Renato Cestié, Sydne Rome, Tano Cimarosa, Dante Maggio
description: The gunslinger So be it track down Smith, a former partner of his who, to respect the last wishes of a preacher, seems to have changed his life by becoming a priest. Together with him, a professor, a pickpocket and his nephew he plans a robbery. The gang will have to contend with a clever teacher.
notes: Mediocre western comedy.

title: Nancy Drew
actors: Maggie Lawson, Jill Ritchie, Lauren Birkell, Marieh Delfino, Charlie Finn
description: Young detective Nancy Drew, who has entered River Heights University, must solve a rather complicated case: Jesse, the school's football star, has fallen into a coma after suffering an accident. Nancy thinks there is something strange underneath and, aided by her companions Bess and George, begins the investigation.

title: When Good Ghouls Go Bad
actors: Joe Pichler, Christopher Lloyd, Tom Amandes, Brittany Byrnes
description: Twelve-year-old Danny discovers that in the small town of Minnesota where he moved with his recently separated father, local authorities have banned Halloween due to a curse. With the help of a weird but likeable ... zombie, Uncle Fred, Danny will have to fight evil spirits to ensure that the magic of Halloween can be experienced again ...

title: Guarda il cielo: Stella, Sonia, Silvia
actors: Sandra Ceccarelli, Paolo Pierobon, Antonio Latella, Denis Fasolo
description: Three women from different eras try to reconcile work and family. In the 1940s, 28-year-old Stella hopes to raise enough money to buy her own piece of land after spending her life working that of others, but continual pregnancies prevent her from fulfilling the desire. In the early seventies, the Milanese Sonia is planning her wedding with the man she loves - who would want her at home once she becomes his wife - but the victory of a scholarship in Rome forces her to postpone the wedding, generating constant tensions with boyfriend. In the nineties, the telephone operator Silvia has constant clashes with her husband, the foreman of the same company for which they both work, due to different views of employment and trade union problems.

title: Time Lapse
actors: William McNamara, Dina Meyer, Roy Scheider, William McNamara, Henry Rollins
description: Clayton Pierce, a US intelligence agent, infiltrates a gang of Russian mobsters to defeat what he believes is an international drug ring. Everything revolves around a mysterious case that will have to cross the American border: Clayton is convinced it is a large batch of heroin, but in reality there is a thermonuclear device inside. Trying to retrieve it, he loses his cover, is injured and begins to suffer from partial amnesia. With the help of his wife (from whom, however, he does not remember having divorced), he goes back on the trail of the device to find out who is hiding behind the plot ...

title: Black River
actors: Jay Mohr, Susan Bain, Paul Batten, Patricia Drake, Lisa Edelstein
description: A Hollywood screenwriter, Bo Aikens, arrives in the quaint town of Black River to rediscover lost inspiration. The carefree stay, thanks also to the relationship that Bo has woven with Laura, really seems to start under the best auspices. Too bad Black River hides a terrible secret.
notes: From a story by Dean Koontz.

title: Below
actors: Bruce Greenwood, Olivia Williams, Holt McCallany, Scott Foley, Jason Flemyng
description: The USS Tiger Shark, submarine of the Second World War, after having wandered for a long time in the waters of the Atlantic in search of German submarines, heads home. At the end of the long and tiring mission, the crew is ordered to take on board three survivors of a British hospital ship that has been sunk. Among them there is also a nurse and this worries the crew because, according to the legend, a woman aboard a submarine brings bad luck. And so it happens: the submarine is no longer able to return to the surface and the survival of men is at risk due to the lack of oxygen.
notes: After the excellent _The Arrival_ and _Pitch Black_, Twohy (which debuted with an unrecognized and ugly television fantasy, _Timescape_) is confirmed as a good guarantee for science fiction and horror. On a multi-handed script (including _¼'s Aronofsky - Il theorem delirio_ and horrible _Requiem for a Dream_), _Below_ recharges itself continuously, with an unbeatable rhythm and an intelligent suspense, able to use all the mechanisms of this kind with logic of respect that make it clear that stereotypes, if understood "from the inside" without cinephile articulations, can still make good cinema. The phantom scare will also be derivative, but it works better than in similar, more celebrated products. And the ending doesn't disappoint.

title: Kukushka
actors: Anni-Kristiina Juuso, Ville Haapasalo, Viktor Bychkov, Aleksei Kashnikov
description: September 1944: Finland fights alongside the Soviet Union, an ally of Nazi Germany. Willi, a Finnish kamikaze sniper (the Russians call "kukushka") tries to free himself from the rock he has been tied to. Meanwhile, Ivan, a captain of the Red Army arrested by the border police, manages to escape. By chance the two meet on Anne's farm, a woman of the Saami people who hosts them, not considering them two enemies but only two men.
notes: The theme is the absurdity of war as a matter of principle, the tones and the register are the tragicomic ones of Danis Tanovic's _No Man's Land_, with the difficulties of explaining and understanding each other of the protagonists who become a metaphor for a much more dramatic lack of communication. Not a masterpiece, but to keep an eye on.

title: Little Secrets
actors: Evan Rachel Wood, Michael Angarano, David Gallagher, Vivica A. Fox, Jan Gardner
description: Fourteen-year-old Emily Lindstrom has a dream: she wants to be a violinist. For this reason she spends her summer holidays practicing the violin and, to earn a few dollars, she keeps the secrets that are confided to her for the modest sum of 50 cents. Since her mother is pregnant, no one cares about the girl's problems. When a new family arrives in the neighborhood, Emily finds a friend in 12-year-old Philip. But the weight of the secrets is such that Emily risks succumbing ...

title: Charlie's Angels: Full Throttle
actors: Cameron Diaz, Drew Barrymore, Lucy Liu, Justin Theroux, Demi Moore
description: Charlie's Angels are tasked with recovering two particularly valuable titanium rings, containing encrypted information that reveals the new identity of all people included in the federal witness protection program. When some of the latter are found lifeless, Nathalie Cook, Dylan Sanders and Alex Munday set out on the trail of the culprit - a mysterious "fallen" Angel - willing to do anything to stop him ...
notes: For the irresistible Lucy Liu, the calendar is an irrelevant option, while Drew Barrymore and Cameron Diaz - not to mention the new "villain" Demi Moore (gold guns, fur coat, designer lingerie and perennial diet bikinis) - begin to feel the weight of the springs. The personal-anatomical detail would be irrelevant if we were not faced with a sequel that sets its communication mission on the image, the look of the performers, the design kitsch, the clothes, the fold of the hair and other accessories. The director claims to admire Hitchcock, the Mike Nichols of the graduate and David Lean: but the lessons of the classics are irrelevant for a film that spoils the plot as soon as the opportunity arises to insert engravings and "numbers" (the Diaz dancer waits with anxiety his musical). A colorful, phonata, enameled, alluring digression (all in all quite funny) on a fiction in which the laws of physics and "characters" correspond to those of cartoons.

title: Last Orders
actors: Michael Caine, Tom Courtenay, David Hemmings, Bob Hoskins, Helen Mirren
description: Longtime friends Ray, Vic and Lenny meet at their favorite pub to carry out Jack's last wish: they must travel to Margate and scatter his ashes overboard at his favorite seaside resort. They are accompanied on the journey by Vince, Jack's son and second-hand car salesman, who has agreed to be a driver. As soon as they set out on the street, the past resurfaces and allows them to relive the intense friendship that has united them over time.
notes: But the sympathy for the four main actors and for the method of the "non-method" typical of the best British acting is not enough to lift _L'ultimo vetro_, from the meandering boredom, from an undertone so refined and insisted that it borders on opacity.

title: Me Without You
actors: Anna Friel, Michelle Williams, Oliver Milburn, Trudie Styler, Marianne Denicourt
description: London, 1970s. In a long and hot summer, little Holly and Marina make a pact: they will be friends for life. For Marina, who has a sedative-addicted mother, Holly is the only fixed point in a life marked by divorced parents and drugs. For her part, Holly, with an overprotective mother, takes refuge in reading. She keeps only a secret from her best friend, the passion she has for her brother Nat, destined to grow with the passage of time.
notes: With regard to the narrative structure, one could cite more or less recent precedents - for example, Mike Leigh's _Gagazze_ - but the question of the film is not the originality but the excessive desire to meet the tastes of the average public.

title: Interno berlinese
actors: Gudrun Landgrebe, Kevin McNally, Mio Takaki, Massimo Girotti
description: Berlin, 1938. Louise, young and beautiful wife of a foreign ministry official, meets Mitsuko, daughter of the Japanese ambassador, in a drawing course and is seduced by him. The amorous encounters of the two women continue, unbeknownst to Heinz, the woman's husband, first in Louise's house and then in a shabby hotel. Upon learning of the situation, Heinz strangely ends up tolerating the situation so much that he too ends up in Mitsuko's seductive network.
notes: Liliana Cavani takes a novel by Tanizaki _ (The Buddhist cross) _ sets it in Nazi Germany, facing improbability.

title: Prince Charming
actors: Sean Maguire, Martin Short, Michael Boisvert, Christina Applegate, Billy Connolly, Bernadette Peters
description: An extra-marital escapade of Prince John costs dear both to him and to his usual companion in adventure: the two find themselves transformed into as many frogs, and so they will have to remain for eternity. Unless a girl agrees to first kiss and then marry the unfortunate prince-batrach ...

title: Primate
description: Caged monkeys, meticulously observed in their captive life. Immediately after (and always without any comment), we see the same animals subjected to atrocious laboratory experiments.
notes: Once more, Wiseman demonstrates how images can become a powerful weapon of sounding and reworking of reality.

title: Beskonechnost
actors: Vladislav Pilnikov, Aleksej Zelenov, Marina Khazova, Anna Kudryavtseva
description: Vladimir Ivanovic is more or less fifty years old, he is an intellectual and is in a delicate phase of transition in his life. On the trail of the one he believes to be his double, he embarks on a long journey that will lead him far away ...
notes: A fluvial, meditative work, tuned to the times of introspection and memory.

title: Anthrax
actors: Cameron Daddo, Allison Hossack, Joanna Cassidy, Kyla Anderson
description: A farmer who lives with his family near Calgary begins to lose some head of cattle, struck by a sudden and inexplicable death. When other animals also begin to die on nearby farms, the suspicion becomes a reality: death has occurred from anthrax poisoning. Who are the culprits? The terrorists? Or a careless agricultural policy of the Canadian research center? A reporter will help him find out.
notes: Film produced before the anthrax nightmare that hit the United States after September 11, but still attributable to an event that occurred in Canada in 1999.

title: Determination of Death
actors: Michele Greene, Marc Singer, Veronica Hamel, William Katt
description: Reese Williams is certainly not a man of sound principles: in the past he had a child with Ginny, then he married his sister, who now subjects him to physical and psychological violence of all kinds. At the same time, however, he has not forgotten the old flame, blackmailing her with the threat of revealing to his son who his real father is. The two unfortunates thus decide to get rid of it once and for all, involving him in a scam against the insurance company: the money to him, their freedom. But something goes wrong ...
notes: It is not a TV-Movie, but it has never even seen a movie theater. To be avoided.

title: Global Effect
actors: Daniel Bernhardt, Mädchen Amick, Joel West, Arnold Vosloo
description: Africa is devastated by an epidemic that causes thousands of victims every day. The scientific community understands little and the only clue as to a possible antidote has ended up in the hands of a group of terrorists. Who are going to have to pay very dearly for it ...
notes: Little short film with the "mummy" Arnold Vosloo.

title: Sigfrido
actors: Sebastian Fisher, Katharina Mayberg, Rolf Tasna, Ilaria Occhini
description: On the death of the king of Burgundia, Siegfried wins the tournament which has as a trophy the hand of Crimilde, sister of the deceased king. The love of the two young men is thwarted by Hagen and Brunhild who has set her sights on him. The two devise a trap ...
notes: Mediocre film based on the Wagnerian saga of the Nibelungs.

title: Bed & Breakfast
actors: Colleen Dewhurst, Talia Shire, Nina Siemaszko, Roger Moore
description: Ruth, a widow, runs a small hotel in a New England resort town and shares her apartment with Claire (a well-known former 1960s political activist who also recently lost her husband) and her daughter Cassie, who aspires to make a career in the music field. The unexpected finding - on the beach, like a castaway - of the aging and ambiguous Adam will have consequences that will make a change in their lives.
notes: Good cast for a gentle comedy with a pink background, produced in 1989 but released only three years later. Behind the camera is the Miller of _Reuben, Reuben ..._ and _Brenda Starr_.

title: Hets
actors: Stig Järrel, Alf Kjellin, Mai Zetterling, Olof Winnerstrand, Gösta Cederlund
description: A Latin professor, nicknamed Caligula, terrifies his students with his pathological severity. In particular, his cruel attentions focus on Bertha, a student who cannot stand the stress and dies of a heart attack. Jan-Erik Widgren, the girl's boyfriend, in trying to do justice, is expelled from school.
notes: Written by a young Ingmar Bergman and shot by theater director Sjöberg, a dark and obsessive psychological drama. Expressionist memories and no concession to hope, in a film that, in the relationship between victims and tormentors, is a mirror of the fears of a Europe that has not yet emerged from the Nazi nightmare. Special Jury Prize at the Cannes Film Festival.

title: Kris
actors: Wiktor Andersson, Anna-Lise Baude, Allan Bohlin, Gus Dahlström

title: Hamnstad
actors: Nine-Christine Jönsson, Bengt Eklund, Mimi Nelson, Berta Hall

title: La faille
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Michel Piccoli, Mario Adorf, Adriana Asti

title: Till glädje
actors: Maj-Britt Nilsson, Stig Olin, Birger Malmsten, John Ekman

title: L'isola alla deriva
actors: Delia Boccardo, Bernardo Olivieri Passeri, William James, Marina Moresco Cascales

title: One's Man Hero
actors: Tom Berenger, Joaquim De Almeida, Daniela Romo, Mark Moses, Patrick Bergin
description: 19th century: Former Sergeant John Riley commands the "St. Patrick's Brigade", groups of Irish immigrants who have deserted to Mexico after suffering religious and ethnic discrimination in the ranks of US troops.
notes: If nothing else, the Hool film has the merit of making known a little-known episode in American history.

title: En lektion i kärlek
actors: Eva Dahlbeck, Gunnar Björnstrand, Yvonne Lombard, Harriet Andersson
description: Left by his lover Susanne, the exuberant gynecologist David Erneman tries to reconnect with his wife Marianne during a train journey to Copenhagen: in fact, Carl-Adam lives here, Marianne's lover, an alcoholic sculptor and former best friend of David ...
notes: One of the films belonging to the "brilliant" genre of the Swedish master.

title: Sommaren med Monika
actors: Harriet Andersson, Lars Ekborg, Dagmar Ebbesen, Åke Fridell
description: Monica is sixteen and works as a shop assistant, Harry is a little older and works in a shop. They meet, fall in love, leave Stockholm and go to live on an islet: but the summer of love is short ...
notes: Melancholic and sensual, a film that dazzled the filmmakers of the Nouvelle Vague, quoted by Truffaut in _I 400 hits_.

title: The Girls of Pleasure Island
actors: Leo Genn, Dorothy Bromley, Audrey Dalton, Joan Elan, Elsa Lanchester
description: 1945: Englishman Roger Halyard lives on an atoll in the South Seas with his daughters Gloria, Hester and Violet and housekeeper Thelma. The news that 1,500 Marines are about to land on the island makes Halyard apprehensive, since - apart from him - the three girls have never seen a man in their life ...
notes: Nothing special, but enjoyable.

title: A Man Apart
actors: Vin Diesel, Larenz Tate, Timothy Olyphant, Jacqueline Obradors, Geno Silva
description: Policeman Sean Vetter and his partner work to stem drug trafficking along the US-Mexico border. They manage to arrest the head of the Baja Cartel, who is promptly replaced by a shady character called Diablo. He kidnaps Vetter's wife, who uses all the expedients at his disposal to destroy Diablo. It will stop at nothing, moving dangerously on the border between justice and lawlessness, even if this creates conflicts with the police unit to which it belongs.
notes: The film is completely obvious and no one (producer, director, screenwriters and actors) does anything more or different.

title: Le Boulet
actors: Gérard Lanvin, Benoît Poelvoorde, José Garcia, Rossy De Palma
description: Moltès, in prison, together with his friend Reggio plays Lotto every week. One day he guesses the winning combination, but his wife leaves for Africa and the ticket goes missing. Moltès thus decides to escape with Reggio and leave for Africa.

title: Tuno negro
directors: Pedro L. Barbero, Vicente J. Martín
actors: Silke Hornillos Klein, Jorge Sanz, Fele Martinez, Maribel Verdú, Eusebio Poncela
description: Salamanca: some university students found the "tuna", a musical group that dresses in the medieval way and plays serenades. Taking advantage of the darkness and the din of the revelry, a psychopath who calls himself "tuno negro" sneaks between them. Alex, an architecture student, manages to discover the common denominator that unites the victims.
notes: Unbelievable how loffia the investigation is, the actor's participation turned off, the suspense nothing. The ending is then absolutely absurd in its improbability pushed to the highest levels: congratulations to the two director-screenwriters.

title: Higanbana
actors: Shin Saburi, Kinuyo Tanaka, Ineko Arima, Keiji Sata, Chishu Ryu
description: Hirayama is often consulted by friends on matters relating to family and marriage, to which he can provide objective and balanced responses. A different matter when his daughter Setsuko is involved ...
notes: Ozu's first color film is a savory variation on the favorite motif of the conflict between modernity and tradition.

title: Dance, Girl, Dance
actors: Maureen O'Hara, Lucille Ball, Louis Hayward, Virginia Field
description: Judy, a dancer in a row, aspires to make a career, while her colleague Bubbles gives up everything and tries the path of burlesque. After the company is disbanded, Bubbles remedies a gig for Judy as well, but the friendship is broken when they both fall in love with Jimmy ...
notes: Penultimate film by Arzner, a pioneer of female directors in the US.

title: The Caretakers
actors: Robert Stack, Joan Crawford, Polly Bergen, Janis Paige, Diane McBain
description: On the American West Coast, in a mental institution, Dr. MacLeod - in total disagreement with the violent and repressive methods with which patients are treated - first tries to oppose, then tries to reform them from within. He will be forced to fight hard with the head nurse Lucretia Terry, the undisputed ruler of the hospital and a staunch supporter of violence as the only therapeutic tool.
notes: Drawing on Joan Crawford's interpretation, Bartlett harshly and firmly emphasizes a sore aspect of psychiatric hospitals. Also known as _Borderlines_.

title: Befrielsesbilleder
actors: Edward Fleming, Kirsten Olesen

title: Epidemic
actors: Allan De Waal, Ole Ernst, Michael Gelting, Colin Gilder, Svend Ali Hamann, Cæcilia Holbek Trier, Udo Kier, Claes Kastholm Hansen, Ib Hansen, Anja Hemmingsen, Kirsten Hemmingsen, Gitte Lind
description: A director and a screenwriter work on writing a film, but the script is deleted by mistake. In a few days, the two have to rewrite another one that deals with the spread of a terrible epidemic in Europe. But the virus really begins to spread, in an alternation of fiction and reality.

title: Destination Moon
actors: John Archer, Warner Anderson, Tom Powers, Dick Wesson

title: Europa
actors: Jean-Marc Barr, Barbara Sukowa, Udo Kier, Eddie Constantine, Ernst-Hugo Järegård, Erik Mørk, Jørgen Reenberg, Henning Jensen, Eddie Costantine, Max Von Sydow, Benny Poulsen, Erno Müller
description: Germany, 1945. Leopold Kessler returns from the United States at the end of the war and his uncle places him as an apprentice driver of sleeping cars in Max Hartmann's railway company. Peace is only apparent: the Americans are fighting the "werewolves" and Hartmann is caught in the middle. The train is the symbol of a continent that goes towards self-destruction.

title: Les yeux sans visage
actors: Pierre Brasseur, Alida Valli, Edith Scob, Juliette Mayniel, Beatrice Altariba, Claude Brasseur, François Guérin, Alexandre Rignault, Michel Etcheverry
description: Christine Genessier, following a car accident, for which her father, Dr. Genessier, his face was completely disfigured: only his eyes remained healthy. From that moment on, Dr. Genessier, who runs a clinic, is completely occupied with the idea of ??finding an effective remedy for the misfortune that befell his daughter. He then devotes himself to secret experiments aimed at ascertaining whether there is the possibility of transplanting the skin of a healthy person on the disfigured face of Christine. Dr. Genessier is assisted in his work by a woman who has the task of luring the girls who will have to serve in these cruel experiments. One of these girls dies and the doctor, to deflect suspicions, induces his assistant to throw the body into the river; when he is rescued, Genessier claims that it is his daughter, and orders that the remains be buried in the family tomb. Another of his victims kills himself; this too is secretly buried in the same tomb. However, the facial plastic operations do not achieve the effects that the doctor expected, and Christine, forced to stay closed at home, cannot resist the temptation to make her ex-boyfriend hear her voice over the phone. The latter, worried, turns to the police, but the investigations do not yield any results. Another girl is lured; but Christine, impressed by the victim's heartbreaking screams, intervenes, frees her and kills her father's assistant with a scalpel. Christine then frees the numerous dogs that Genessier needed for the experiments: freed, the dogs rush to the doctor and kill him.

title: Shark Attack 3: Megalodon
actors: John Borrowman, Jenny McShane, Ryan Cutrona, George Stanchev
description: While laying submarine cables off the Mexican coast, some technicians are attacked by a huge shark. Arrived on the spot together with a diver of the special unit, a researcher finds that the predator is the specimen of a prehistoric species extinct for millions of years ...
notes: A few chills, a lot of boredom.

title: Záhrada
actors: Roman Luknár, Marián Labuda, Zuzana Sulajová, Jana Svandová

title: The Italian Job
actors: Mark Wahlberg, Charlize Theron, Donald Sutherland, Jason Statham, Edward Norton, Seth Green, Mos Def, Fausto Callegarini
description: After stealing a mountain of gold bars from a Venetian palace, Charlie Croker and his gang - made up of an internal accomplice, a computer genius, a chauffeur, an explosives expert and a safe-picker - must surrender to the evidence: someone has "blown". With Stella's help, the group moves to California on the traitor's trail to recover the loot. The plan is to manipulate the Los Angeles traffic control system, creating a traffic jam of unprecedented proportions ...
notes: Did anyone feel the need for the remake of "A coup all'italiana", a modest robbery comedy directed in 1969 by Peter Collinson? But Hollywood, as we know, is now specialized in remakes, which rarely get it right and much more often crushes with the ill grace of a mechanism that must somehow keep young stars in search of personalities and mature stars in search of special appearances, colorless directors busy. and writers running out of ideas.

title: Equilibrium
actors: Christian Bale, Emily Watson, Taye Diggs, Dominic Purcell, Sean Bean, Christian Kahrmann, John Keogh, William Fichtner
description: Peace reigns in Libria. The rules governing the library system are very simple: those who are happy are arrested, those who cry are punishable by justice. Reading a book or contemplating a painting is considered a crime, and if you don't take Pozium - the medicine imposed by the state - on a daily basis, capital punishment is expected. Senior government official John Preston has always believed in these rules, but one day he skips his daily dose of Pozium, discovers a world of incredible sensations and decides it's time to fight for freedom ...
notes: Enjoyable, in spite of the predictability and the copiousness / quotations: book fires and mega-screens as in _Fahrenheit 451_, megacities and backlit interiors as in _Blade Runner_ and above all continuous winks at the Dickian vulgate and at the counter-utopias of films like _Gattaca_ or _Matrix_ (from martial arts to clothing, even to the poster).

title: The Animal
actors: Rob Schneider, Colleen Haskell, Michael Caton, John C. McGinley
description: Marvin works as an archivist in a police station but dreams of becoming a real cop, like his father. One day, left alone in the district, he answers an emergency call indicating a robbery in progress. He rushes to the spot, but the bad guys manage to escape; during the car chase he has a terrible accident and is rescued by a mysterious individual, Dr. Wilder, who transforms him into the guinea pig of an experiment: he transplants a strange mixture of animal organs into his body. Upon awakening Marvin is amazed by his powerful muscles and strong sense of smell ...
notes: The film does not want and does not know how to be compact and structured and works as a collation of gimmicks, sketches, inventions (some hilarious).

title: Robot Monster
actors: George Nader, Claudia Barrett, Selena Royle, John Mylong, Gregory Moffett

title: Medea
actors: Kirsten Olesen, Udo Kier, Henning Jensen, Solbjørg Højfeldt
description: In Corinth, in the fifth century BC, Medea lives with her husband Jason and their two children. Their existence is upset by Creon, king of the city, who wants to marry his daughter Creusa to Jason. Faced with the possibility of succeeding the throne, the man decides to abandon his family to a lonely destiny, but Medea is ready to do anything to dissuade him from making this decision.
notes: Filmed in 1988 on commission from the Danish state broadcaster, and still unreleased in Italy, _Medea_ is a free adaptation of the treatment that Danish director Carl Theodor Dreyer wrote fifteen years earlier, as the backbone of a film that never managed to shoot. due to lack of financial support.

title: Lianlian fengchen
actors: Li Tianlu, Wang Jingwen, Xin Shufen

title: Lust och fägring
actors: Johan Widerberg, Marika Lagercrantz, Tomas von Brömssen
description: In 1943, in Malmö, while the country is upset by the Second World War Stig, a fifteen -year -old boy, falls in love with his purple teacher, who has 37. The woman is exhausted by the relationship with her husband Kjell, alcoholic and unfaithful, e For this reason, a morbid and clandestine relationship begins with the boy; But, while the husband seems not to interest himself at all of what happens, the relationship ends up unleashing the jealousy of the young neighbor Lisbet, in love with Stig.

title: Sabretooth
actors: David Keith, Vanessa Angel, John Rhys-Davies, Jenna Gering
description: By manipulating the DNA extracted from some fossil finds, the unscrupulous scientists Catherine and Anthony manage to obtain a specimen of prehistoric mammal, one of the most ferocious predators ever to appear in nature: the saber-toothed tiger. More than academic recognition, the two aspire to the predictable high earnings associated with the discovery. Despite all the precautions, however, the irreparable happens: an accident during transport to a laboratory located in the mountains allows the frightening feline to escape and to mortally assault a group of hikers ...
notes: Originality below the guard level.

title: Á köldum klaka
actors: Masatoshi Nagase, Lili Taylor, Fisher Stevens, Gísli Halldórsson

title: White of the Eye
actors: David Keith, Cathy Moriarty, Art Evans, Alan Rosenberg, Fred Allison
description: Plot in preparation

actors: Colin Welland, David Bradley, Lynne Perrie, Freddie Fletcher

title: Masquerade
actors: Cliff Robertson, Jack Hawkins, Marisa Mell, Michel Piccoli
description: The British government has long negotiated the concession for the exploitation of the oil fields located in the Middle Eastern state of Ramaut, but at the last moment the agreement fails. Colonel Drexel is therefore tasked with kidnapping the young prince Jamil, the designated heir to the throne of Ramaut, on whom he will ascend as soon as he turns 21 (that is, a few weeks later). The plan is to keep Jamil under arrest until the fateful date, then persuading him to sign the contract. The coup succeeds, but the situation is destined to get complicated ...
notes: A mix of "action" and spy satire, enjoyable and well interpreted.

title: So Ends Our Night
actors: Fredrick March, Margaret Sullavan, Glenn Ford, Erich Von Stroheim
description: Joseph Steiner, a German army captain opposed to the advent of Nazism, meets Ruth and Ludwig, two young Jewish boyfriends persecuted by the police. Deciding to desert because worried about his sick wife, Joseph takes refuge in Austria, where he shares the hiding place with the two boyfriends before the invasion of the German army pushes them to try to reach France.

title: San duk bei do

title: Wu du
actors: Chiang Sheng, Philip Kwok, Feng Lu, Wei Pai, Sun Chien, Lo Meng

title: Pork Chop Hill
actors: Gregory Peck, Harry Guardino, Rip Torn, George Peppard, Carl Benton
description: The conflict in Korea is about to end. An American patrol is tasked with taking over Pork Chop, a hill where North Koreans have installed loudspeakers calling for desertion. At the cost of heavy losses, the marines occupy the post and defend it. When help arrives, very few are still alive.
notes: Twenty-nine years later _Nothing new on the Western front_, Milestone returns to talk about war without forgetting the horrors, the agony and the loss of human life. He does not repeat the greatness of his masterpiece, but nevertheless hits the mark with strong characters and ferocious irony. Memorable are the scenes in which, after the loudspeakers have gone out, an icy silence precedes the battle.

title: Duk bei do wong

actors: Makiko Esumi, Takashi Naitô, Tadanobu Asano, Gohki Kashiyama

title: L'uomo puma
actors: Walter George Alton, Donald Pleasence, Sydne Rome, Miguel Angel Fuentes
description: The Luciferian Kobras wants to conquer the world, and for this purpose he intends to use a gold mask from the Andes and endowed with mysterious hypnotic powers. Vadinho, the priest of the god Puma, is determined to avert the danger and goes to London to the paleontologist Tony Farmes: he, in fact, a direct descendant of the White god, is none other than the reincarnation of the puma man, in possession of thaumaturgical faculties. ..
notes: The top of the Z series, also punished by the public who decreed its total failure. The brave Donald Pleasence puts it all in the shoes of the evil Kobras, but not even his prowess and usual skill can save the film from catastrophe.

title: Klatretøsen
actors: Julie Zangenberg, Stefan Pagels Andersen, Mads Ravn, William Haugaard
description: Ida's father, a former climber and now manager of a go-kart track, is seriously ill. To find the money for the operation, Ida asks for help from her two friends who decide to rob the safest bank in the world.
notes: The film won the Crystal Bear in Berlin 2002 prize awarded by a jury of boys.

title: An Angel for May
actors: Matthew Beard, Charlotte Wakefield, Julie Cox, Anna Massey
description: Tom, an enterprising and ingenious little boy, discovers a way to travel back in time and magically finds himself in England during the Second World War. Here she helps May, a displaced girl with her family on a farm, cope with the traumas of war.
notes: A good story about the value of friendship.

title: The Guru
actors: Jimi Mistry, Heather Graham, Marisa Tomei, Michael McKean
description: Only a guru could have predicted the fate of Ramu Gupta, an Indian dance teacher who leaves everything to pursue his dream on Broadway. But once he arrives in the Big Apple, he ends up being a waiter in an Indian restaurant between auditions. When he is finally summoned by a producer, the excitement soon turns to set panic as soon as he discovers he has been cast as a star in a red light movie.
notes: The producers (they are the same ones from Notting Hill, Bridget Jones's Diary and About a Boy and you can see and hear) have launched, with a certain shrewdness, a plot and an installation to make fun of the Euro-American-centric culture, the uncomfortable fashions of opulent society, Bollywood and the musical. It is a fusion cinema: between Travolta and tandoori, bangra and santoni. Graham, disguised as an Indian diva, is on a pilgrimage to Bombay.

title: Elsker dig for evigt
actors: Mads Mikkelsen, Sonja Richter, Nikolaj Lie Kaas, Paprika Steen, Stine Bjerregaard
description: About to marry Cecille, Joachim is hit by a car and is paralyzed. In the hospital, Cecille falls in love with Niels, the doctor who is treating him: who is none other than the husband of the woman who hit Joachim ...
notes: An expertly written drama of affections, studded with homages (unintentional, according to the director, but not very random) to _The waves of destiny_, _Idioti_ and _The Kingdom_. In accordance with the dictates of Lars von Trier's "Dogma", the video camera and the Super8 are inserted like probes into the connective tissue of a post-neorealist everyday life, lit by the tones of an icy melodrama.

title: Barbershop
actors: Ice Cube, Anthony Anderson, Cedric the Entertainer, Sean Patrick Thomas, Troy Garity
description: Calvin inherits a modest barber shop in Chicago from his father, which he sees as a burden and a waste of time. He therefore decides to sell it to a local loan shark, but immediately afterwards he is seized with remorse when he realizes what it meant for the parent and for those who usually meet there to chat, joke, tell each other problems and misfortunes. There's Eddie, an old hairdresser with no clients; there's Jimmy, a professional colleague who can't stand Isaac, the newcomer. And again Ricky, a former prisoner who is desperately trying to get straight; Terri, who is unable to leave her boyfriend; finally Dinka, another barber madly in love with Terri who, however, does not find the time to declare himself ...
notes: The only reason for interest is the documentation of the state of relations between African Americans and Hollywood, but the film itself - while not unpleasant - is not worth much: some hint of a description of the environment, a subplot of an ATM theft , well-known faces of US sitcoms.

title: Promenons-nous dans les bois Promenons-nous dans les bois
actors: Clément Sibony, Clotilde Courau, Vincent Lecoeur, Alexia Stresi, Maud Buquet
description: A group of young actors and actresses is hired for a performance by a wealthy gentleman who wants to celebrate his son's birthday. The troupe arrives at her residence, a luxurious castle in the woods, to stage _Little Red Riding Hood_, but is received by a mysterious gamekeeper and the equally disturbing wealthy gentleman. Visibly the atmosphere is not festive and the evening has a tragic twist ...
notes: Nothing new in Lionel Delplanque's film, which indeed returns to the places of the crime of a vein, the slasher, which is desired at all costs metalinguistic and subtly played on the affinity between Eros and Thanatos. The work on the bodies, while tending to the patina, is quite ferocious and morbid, but it is no coincidence that the only truly disturbing presence is that of Denis Lavant (Stephan), an authentic and acrobatic freak, a splendid contrast to the cover faces of Clotilde Courau and company.

title: Lost in La Mancha
actors: Jeff Bridges, Johnny Depp, Jean Rochefort, Bernard Bouix, Vanessa Paradis
description: A documentary about the failure to make a film, Terry Gilliam's _Don Quijote_. The problems started in the weeks before the first take: the international and multilingual crew had enormous communication problems, the actors were often absent because they were engaged in other projects, untrained horses and soundproof sets plagued the production.
