Then, on the sixth day of shooting, the production was on its knees: a sudden storm had destroyed sets and equipment, Jean Rochefort had become seriously ill and the film was postponed to a later date ... All this from the live voice of the protagonists.
notes: Anyone who loves films will find this documentary extraordinary, which is tout-court a metaphor of how often cinema is the struggle of dreamers against the windmills of the star system and the production machine.Jeff Bridges is the narrator in the original version.

title: Santa Who?
actors: Leslie Nielsen, Max Morrow, Steven Eckholdt, Robyn Lively
description: Santa Claus stumbles on his sleigh and loses his memory. At this point Zack intervenes, a little boy who, in order to save the best party of the year, will have to help him overcome his amnesia. Meanwhile, the bearded gift-giver must help a TV reporter overcome his Christmas phobia.

title: Oliver & Company
description: The kitten Oliver, alone and hungry in the traffic of New York, helps the dog Dodger in some petty thefts. The dog, however, takes the route of escape, leaving him without stolen goods. Oliver, not at all discouraged, joins him in his dingy attic, where ...
notes: This is certainly not one of the best Disney cartoons.

title: The Black Cauldron
description: The young Taron must guard - on behalf of the wise old Dalven - the pig Evy, a very special animal since it is able to identify the magic pot, which will endow its owner with an army of immortal warriors. Cruel King Cornelius will do anything to kidnap Evy and find the pot ...
notes: Discreet Disney production.

title: El segundo nombre
actors: Erica Prior, Trae Houlihan, Craig Hill, Dennis Rafter, Craig Stevenson
description: One morning like any other, Theodore Logan parks his car at the side of a road and shoots himself. The 25-year-old daughter Daniella tries to reconstruct her last days in search of an answer, a clue, something that can make her understand the reason for the gesture: little by little, the image of the good and altruistic parent gives way to that of a heartless, cruel and dangerous individual ...
notes: Plaza must have misread Ramsey Campbell's novel, because nothing shines through of the writer's "distressing indeterminacy." The images, on the other hand, are televised, aesthetically very similar to the investigations of _Who saw it? _.

title: Fantaghirò
actors: Alessandra Martines, Kim Rossi Stuart, Angela Molina, Mario Adorf, Jean-Pierre Cassel
description: A long-standing war tears apart two neighboring kingdoms. To put an end to it, it is decided to have two knights challenge to a duel: the one who prevails will also give the victory to his sovereign. Having no male heirs, the Father King makes his daughter Fantaghirò participate in the battle, under the false name of Count Valdoca: but the girl falls in love with her rival Romualdo ...

title: Inferno
actors: Jeff Fahey, Janet Gunn, Richard Danielson, Greta Danielle Newgren
description: Due to a phenomenon due to solar combustion, a heat cap of volcanic origin has invaded the earth's atmosphere. While the last hour is about to strike for the planet, survival becomes the one and only priority: the stories of a teacher, a surgeon, a couple of lovers intertwine ...

title: Darkness Falls
actors: Chaney Kley, Emma Caulfield, Lee Cormie, Grant Piro, Sullivan Stapleton
description: For 150 years, the legend of Matilda Dixon, the "fallen tooth fairy", has hovered like a dark shadow over the town of Darkness Falls. Unjustly accused of a crime, the woman was massacred by a maddened mob and from that moment her spirit is said to hover over the city to take revenge. Kyle is the only one who escaped the encounter, but his mother was brutally murdered. Since that day, the boy has not been able to stay in the dark even for a moment, not knowing if it was a real fact or a hallucination. When his one-time girlfriend invites him back to town because his little brother is the victim of the same nightmares, Kyle has confirmation that the evil spirit is not the fruit of his imagination ...
notes: Fear of the dark, childhood nightmares, falling teeth, supernatural horror, creatures created by the master Stan Winston (_Alien_), characters who try to overcome the limits of pure narrative functions, directed by a newcomer with some (not many) more shots take care of what happens in the contemporary standard of the genre, children as natural interlocutors of the afterlife. Titles and background of the story are the best things about this nictofilm.

title: Mille millièmes
actors: Grégori Dérangère, Irène Jacob, Jean-Pierre Darroussin, Patrick Chesnais
description: In the condominium of rue des Oursins, as in the condominiums all over the world, there is a sample of various humanity and inhumanity. Old and young, widows and couples, each with their own needs. Two tenants who are engaged would like to join the apartments with an internal staircase, the elderly would like an elevator. In addition, in the courtyard there is a voluntary association that looks after the homeless, creating inconvenience to the condominiums, and the annoying person on duty tries to redeem himself by organizing a collective lunch.
notes: The path of the film remains uncertain between social allegory and bourgeois sketches, and in both cases it remains at a very superficial level.

title: Rare Birds
actors: William Hurt, Andy Jones, Molly Parker, Vicky Hynes, Greg Malone
description: It's a bad time for Dave: his restaurant "The Auk" is about to close, which has known better times, and is also about to get a divorce. But his neighbor, Alphonse, thinks he knows how to save his friend's place: he spreads the rumor that a bird of a species that was thought to be extinct has been sighted nearby: in no time at all, ornithologists from all over arrive. the world and "The Auk" is once again very popular. Plus Alphonse has a very nice sister, Alice, who doesn't leave Dave indifferent at all ...
notes: The film loses consistency minute by minute, resulting in a predictable and superficial ending.

title: The Transporter
actors: Jason Statham, Shu Qi, Matt Schulze, François Berléand, Ric Young
description: Frank Martin, a former special forces agent, lives a quiet existence on the French coast. From time to time he must perform a mission as a mercenary "transporter". On these occasions he has to transfer both human and cargo loads, but he never asks questions. One day he violates the strict rules he has imposed on himself because in the package he has to carry there is a woman.
notes: The story does not stand up, but in this type of film it could also be overlooked, the action sequences (except the one on lube oil) are choreographed and shot badly and edited worse, the protagonist (Jason Statham) is an excellent character actor , but promoted to the main role self-certifies undeniable and obvious defects. Among other limitations, he looks like Bruce Willis' ugliest brother.

title: Le sorprese del divorzio
actors: Armando Falconi, Sergio Tofano, Bice Parisi, Filippo Scelzo
description: Exasperated by his mother-in-law's impossible character, a wealthy young man gets a divorce; after which, determined not to have anything to do with the category of mother-in-law, he marries the daughter of an elderly widower. However, unbeknownst to everyone, one day he takes a wife again: who is none other than ...
notes: Actors in great shape.

title: The Darkling
actors: Aidan Gillen, Nina Siemaszko, Lisa Linde, F. Murray Abraham
description: The life of Jeff, a passionate motor chef, and his family runs smoothly until the day he, his wife and daughter meet Bruno Rubin. Everyone in town thinks that the very rich man has relations with dark forces. Jeff doesn't take these rumors seriously at first, but he'll have to change his mind.

title: Gueule d'arnaque
actors: Hughes Quester, Philippe Rouleau, Jeanne Goupil, Jacques Spiesser
description: The dark Joe and the beautiful Chris move with shrewdness in a double agent environment.
notes: Based on the hard-boiled novel _Perfect Pigeon_ of 1962 by the American writer Richard Wormser (not to be confused with the more famous journalist of the same name), published on the paperbacks of the Golden Medal, now collectible volumes.

title: Malpractice
actors: Stephanie Zimbalist, Gabrielle Carteris, Michael Arata, Ritchie Montgomery
description: Nurse Ellen Robertson's record of service is not entirely faultless, as it also includes a negligent dismissal. But when even her lawyer begins to doubt her, a series of strange incidents begins ...
notes: First film for the big screen by the former Monkees drummer, who has been active on TV for some time.

title: Una spada per Brando
actors: Paul Winston, Karin Schubert, Tano Cimarosa, Dante Maggio
description: A sect kidnaps some girls to sacrifice them to the god of darkness. The brave Brando and his gang of companions try to save them and stop the dangerous fanatics.
notes: Stracco and not very memorable cloak and sword of a solid craftsman like Caltabiano, with a series of enjoyable character actors.

title: A Mother's Testimony
actors: Kate Jackson, Chad Allen, Susan Blakely, William R. Moses
description: Kenny, after serving two years in prison, is paroled. His mother, Sharon, who has never stopped trusting him, welcomes him with open arms. The woman would do anything to protect him. Instead, he will have to deal with a terrible truth.
notes: Usual TV movie without infamy and without praise.

title: Twist of Faith
actors: Andrew McCarthy, Michael Ironside, Matthew Laurance, Suzy Joachim
description: Detective Henry Smith has been given a big deal: bringing to justice a serial killer who has recently raised the bar more and more, targeting prominent characters. Policeman and criminal, each in their own way, seems devoured by an identical obsession ...
notes: Absolute banality.

title: Tokyo boshoku
actors: Chishu Ryu, Setsuko Hara, Ineko Arima, Isuzu Yamada, Teiji Takahashi
description: Left almost twenty years earlier by his wife, Shukichi has two daughters, Takako and Akiko: the first is married, but her difficult relations with her husband lead her to often return to her father; the second, younger, is in a relationship and becomes pregnant. But one day the mother comes back ...
notes: An "extreme" mélo by Ozu.

title: El sol del membrillo
actors: Antonio López García, Marina Moreno, Enrique Gran, María López
description: The painter Antonio López García has a favorite subject for his work: a quince tree he himself planted years ago. But his attempts to make shades of light on ripe fruit will meet with inevitable failure.
notes: A bare, effective metaphor of the complex relationships between art and reality.

title: Leoni al sole
actors: Vittorio Caprioli, Franca Valeri, Philippe Leroy, Serena Vergano, Francesco Morante
description: Group of young bulls in an exterior. Three rampant Neapolitans dribble responsibility by stealing the hearts of women on vacation. There are those who are rejected and those who console themselves by working.
notes: The directorial debut of Caprioli, a brilliant actor who shows talent even behind the camera. Leroy is confronted with a new role for him.

title: Villa Ada
actors: Gabriel Garko, Eva Grimaldi, Leo Gullotta, Ray Lovelock, Maurizio Mattioli
description: A Sunday like many others in the public park of Villa Ada in Rome. A burly businessman waits at the gate for a bank manager with a jogging mania, and in order to be able to talk to him he undergoes a series of very heavy tests, including the tearing of a large dog ... Between a young mother with a child and an equally a young father with a child is born a tender friendship, destined to soon turn into love. In the meantime, in the meadow near the lake, one of the usual football matches is organized: all the repressed passions converge in the encounter-clash, from condominium quarrels to supposed marital betrayals ...

title: Beethoven's 4th
actors: Judge Reinhold, Julia Sweeney, Joe Pichler, Michaela Gallo
description: While strolling in the park following the Newtons, Beethoven is mistaken for Michelangelo, another obedient and incredibly quiet Saint Bernard. It will be very difficult for the Newtons to believe in ... his transformation.
notes: The film was produced for the home video market only.

title: Peau d'ange
actors: Morgane Moré, Guillaume Depardieu, Magalie Woch, Karine Silla
description: Angele leaves the countryside where she was born to go to work in a provincial town where she meets a man with whom she will spend the night. For her it is a night of love during which she will offer all of herself, for him only a way to console himself. The two are forced to separate, but fate and above all coincidences force them to see each other again.
notes: The premises for a discreet mello were all there but what remains is only the echo of a crash due to the failure of a screenplay full of flaws and improbable dialogues and the delightful Morgane Morè is of no use to whose comparison Guillaume Depardieu seems even more uncertain than usual.

title: Sunshine State
actors: Angela Bassett, Edie Falco, Timothy Hutton, James McDaniel
description: Ambitious Marly Temple and Desirée Perry return to their hometown of Florida after seeing their career aspirations in show business collapse. Both try to find a way to finally make them independent: Marly, returning from a failed marriage, would like to fulfill her father's dream, which is to manage a motel; for her part, Desirée wishes to introduce her new partner, the anesthetist Reggie ... to her family ...
notes: Sayles is outraged by the progressive distortion of culture and its homogenization, and is too intelligent to represent today's world as an ideal and authentic place. Therefore, in reconstructing the movements and motives of the two protagonists (the white Edie Falco and the black Angela Bassett) and their friends and relatives, he underlines how bogus there really is in what we believed were our true roots, and how many misunderstandings and compromises inevitably paved our lives. Here, perhaps, there are no longer just causes for which to take sides; fatigue marks the gestures and relationships of the characters and represents the ethical and narrative measure of the film: our dignity is the only certainty we have left, Sayles seems to say, let's assert it. Despite its length and its moralistic hints, _La costa del sole_ is a fair and rare film, focused on human beings.

title: Stolen Summer
actors: Adiel Stein, Mike Weinberg, Aidan Quinn, Kevin Pollak, Brian Dennehy
description: Chicago, 1976: little Pete, from a Catholic family, reprimanded for his pranks by the nun who teaches him, embarks on a divine mission to do good in his community and thus prove that he deserves heaven. His unlikely partner is Danny, a Jewish boy with whom Pete will learn the true meaning of the words "hope" and "friendship".
notes: There are many qualities of the script which, on an established track (the relationship between two children who are almost the same age), introduces intelligent and witty variations on religious faith, tolerance and prejudice in Chicago in the mid-1970s, when racism and anti-Semitism were not yet tempered by the etiquette of "politically correct". The very young performers are perfect, and the director is careful not to cross the thin line that separates deep emotion from molasses.

title: Paid in Full
actors: Wood Harris, Mekhi Phifer, Kevin Carroll, Esai Morales, Regina Hall
description: Harlem neighborhood, 1980s. Ace who works in a dry cleaner envies his friends Mitch and Calvin who drive around in luxurious cars and in the latest fashion. His life suddenly changes thanks to the meeting with Lulu, a drug dealer who manages to involve him in drug dealing. Ace soon becomes powerful, but has a crisis of conscience when his friends and family fall victim to his shady dealings.
notes: The story of Ace and his cronies is true only in impersonal frames and in the lines of a weak and ordinary script. Even the American critics who have less appreciation for the film (the American reactions have been average-thumb) have underlined the strength of the actors' interpretations, observed in an overheated and empty Italian room, the performances of the interpreters seem (will it depend on the dubbing?) Pitiful and devoid of charisma or that anonymity that functions as the essence of a false cinema of reality.

title: Twisted
actors: Alessandro Tiberi, Monica Comegna, J. Emiliano Coltorti, Angelo Maggi
description: The relationship that binds the brothers Matteo and Valentina became more intense following the death of their mother. At a party the two meet Stefano, a boy from a good family who hides a psychotic personality. An understanding is established between the boy and Valentina which leads Stefano to declare his love for her. Slowly Valentina discovers Stefano's true nature and upset convinces her brother to leave with her. But Stefano is on their trail ...
notes: The actors seem truly denied, but to declaim the winking banalities of the screenplay, Sir Laurence Olivier would also be in difficulty.

title: Head of State
actors: Chris Rock, Bernie Mac, Dylan Baker, Nick Searcy, Lynn Whitfield
description: Mays Gilliam, a victim of discrimination because he is a black man, loses his job as a Washington city councilor. The death of the presidential candidate in an accident throws Mays into the spotlight. His party decides to propose him as a candidate for the presidency of the United States.
notes: No one would have missed Chris Rock's directorial debut, especially since the pillory of the US political class, which is in fact the focus of the film, has in fact been largely superseded by the reality of recent years. The satire of the political world does not scratch, full of banal jokes and a populist morality, and in the end it is a difficult undertaking to make fun of a reality that is unfortunately far more farcical.

title: Deep Core
actors: Harty Van Gorkum, Craig Sheffer, Wil Wheaton, James Russo
description: Industrialist Alan finances research to develop a machine that is capable of penetrating all types of terrain. Brian, the inventor of the vehicle, realizing its danger destroys it. A few years later Alan tries again, but will be forced to agree with Brian.
notes: Silly science fiction story.

title: Abbott and Costello Go to Mars
actors: Bud Abbott, Lou Costello, Mari Blanchard, Anita Ekberg, Robert Paige
description: Gianni, an attendant in an airfield, and his friend Pinotto get on a rocket that is about to be launched into space and make it take off. First they land in New Orleans (they believe they are in the capital of the planet Mars) and then head to Venus where women reign.
notes: Debut of Anita Ekberg.

title: Peter Ibbetson
actors: Gary Cooper, Ann Harding, John Halliday, Ida Lupino, Douglass Dumbrille
description: Architect Peter Ibbetson is hired by the Earl of Towers to design a building when he discovers that Mary, the Duchess of Towers, is nothing more than his grown childhood love. With feelings rekindled, Peter ends up being sentenced to life in prison for an accidental murder. The two unfortunate loved ones will be able to find each other every night only in dreams.

title: Abbott and Costello in the Foreign Legion
actors: Bud Abbott, Lou Costello, Patricia Medina, Walter Slezak, Douglass Dumbrille
description: The two friends travel to Algeria, in search of a wrestler, who has to perform on Broadway. The rebels, with the complicity of a sergeant of the Foreign Legion, attack the workers who are building the railway. The two, mistaken for American agents, are forcibly enlisted in the Legion.
notes: The mirage scenes were hilarious.

title: Gas-s-s-s/Gas! Or It Became Necessary to Destroy the World in Order to Save It
actors: Robert Corff, Elaine Giftos, Bud Cort, Talia Shire, Bn Vereen

title: Abbott and Costello Meet Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
actors: Bud Abbott, Lou Costello, Boris Karloff, Craig Stevens, Helen Westcott
description: In London, Gianni and Pinotto must stop Dr Jekyll's murderous rampage.
notes: Abbott and Costello return to play the famous duo of American cops. Excellent Karloff in the double role of Jekyll and Hyde, also good special effects, but now the couple, after several films together, gets a few laughs.

title: Abbott and Costello Meet the Mummy
actors: Bud Abbott, Lou Costello, Edwin Parker, Marie Windsor, Michael Ansara
description: Two American cool men on vacation in Egypt discover that Dr. Zoomer, a famous archaeologist, has been murdered. Guided by an enigmatic medallion, they will enter a crypt from which a mummy will come back to life spreading terror ...
notes: Yet another episode of the endless series starring Abbott & Costello.

title: Destry Rides Again
actors: Marlene Dietrich, James Stewart, Mischa Auer, Charles Winninger
description: When the cheater Kent kills the "man of the law", the mayor - who is tangled up with him - assigns the star to the drunkard Dimsdale, thinking he can handle him: but the new sheriff hires the meek and unarmed Tom Destry jr as deputy. . Although a pacifist, Destry will be able to restore order to the town.
notes: Based on a novel by Max Brand, the film is a pleasant _western comedy_ that manages to balance the witty and funny part with the more melodramatic moments. A cast of stars enriches the film: James Stewart outstanding in the role of Tom Destry and, for the first time in a western, the shining Marlene in the role of singer Frenchy. Excellent Winninger as a drunken sheriff.

title: Cotton Mary
actors: Madhur Jaffrey, Greta Scacchi, James Wilby, Sarah Badel, Riyu Bajaj
description: Malabar, South West India, 1954: Cotton Mary, an indigenous woman with Anglophile nostalgia, is hired as a nanny by Lily, the wife of a British journalist. Following her own plan of integration and self-affirmation, she aspires to become servant-mistress ...
notes: Slow and predictable first feature from Ivory's producer.

title: They Came From Beyond Space
actors: Robert Hutton, Jennifer Jayne, Zia Mohyeddin, Bernard Kay

title: Beautiful Creatures
actors: Susan Lynch, Rachel Weisz, Iain Glen, Tom Mannion, Maurice Roëves, Alex Norton
description: Scotland: Regularly mistreated by her boyfriend Brian, Petula is rescued by her friend Dorothy, who in turn has just ended her relationship with Tony. The fact is that, in a fit of anger, Brian accidentally ends up killed: the two women therefore devise a plan to convince Ronnie, Brian's wealthy older brother, that the latter has been kidnapped. But when Inspector Hepburn eats the leaf - and Tony also reappears, demanding to get into the business - Petula and Dorothy are forced to change their strategy ...
notes: Eagles' debut is a semi-parodic noir, with some winks at first-rate Danny Boyle.

title: Submerged
actors: Sam Neill, Shea Whigham, Emily Procter, Hugh O'Conor, Matthew Wait
description: Commander "Swede" Momsen, head of a rescue team, tries to rescue the fifty-nine sailors trapped in the Squalus military submarine. It is 1938, for the first time an underwater mission manages to save human lives from the depths of the sea.
notes: From a true story.

title: The In Crowd
actors: Lori Heuring, Susan Ward, Matthew Settle, Nathan Bexton, Tess Harper
description: The beautiful Adrien manages to get admitted to an exclusive country club where she is taken in sympathy by Brittany, the charismatic leader of a group of wealthy students. But when tennis player Matt is sensitive to Adrien's charms, jealousy pushes Brittany to reveal her dark side ...
notes: Maneuvered and superfluous beyond words.

title: The Men's Club
actors: Richard Jordan, Roy Scheider, Frank Langella, Harvey Keitel
description: Seven Californian friends forty and married, decide to meet periodically at the home of one of them, a psychoanalyst, to talk and exchange confidences, spending goliardic evenings. The main topic of the discussions is obviously the other sex. Each of them communicates their experience and seeks the support of others to overcome difficulties. The situation takes a different turn when they decide to move their meeting to a brothel ...
notes: Based on a Leonard Michaels novel, who also adapted it. The irony is interesting and effective, but is a bit clouded by the constant chatter and a ridiculous ending.

title: The Crossing
actors: Jeff Daniels, Roger Rees, Sebastian Roché, Steven McCarthy

title: The Day the World Ended
actors: Randy Quaid, Bobby Edner, Nastassja Kinski, Harry Groener
description: Child psychologist Jennifer Stillman moves from New York to a small town in Nevada. His arrival is greeted with coldness and distrust by the local population. It immediately becomes clear that a dark and profound secret is jealously guarded by the inhabitants, willing to defend it by force. Stillman takes up service in the elementary school attended, among others, by young Ben, a child with paranormal powers. Everyone in town, from the local policeman to the school director, from the restaurant owner to the boy's adoptive father, seems to want to protect the child with a kind of awe. The night arrives and a strange figure with tentacles wanders in the woods and in the country leaving a trail of horribly mutilated corpses. While the police investigate and begin to suspect the new arrival, the psychologist tries to save Ben from a terrible end, finding herself, in turn, involved in a struggle between the vengeful monster, somehow related to the child, and the indefinable evil that. nestles in the heart of the country.

title: Head Over Heels
actors: Freddie Prinze jr, Monica Potter, Shalom Harlow, Ivana Milicevic, Tomiko Fraser, Sarah Murdoch, China Chow, Jay Brazeau, Stanley DeSantis, James Kirk
description: Amanda, a restorer at the Metropolitan, shares a spacious apartment on the East Side of Manhattan with four models. After the meeting with Jim, even the matters of the heart seem resolved: but the doubt that her new boyfriend could be a murderer will push her to improvise detective ...
notes: Unpretentious yellow-pink.

title: Joe Dirt
actors: David Spade, Brittany Daniel, Dennis Miller, Adam Beach, Christopher Walken, Erik Per Sullivan
description: Joe Dirt is a middle-aged man with extravagant hair and an average sad story: abandoned by his parents at the age of eight, he is obsessed with the idea of ??finding them, if only to tell them about his life. Instead, he will end up narrating to many more spectators from the recording booth of a radio program: during his journey in a desperate search for his family, Joe is in fact "discovered" by a well-known disc jockey ...
notes: The ingredients are all there: the soft-hearted loser, the beautiful (im) possible, the usual gags, the parade of unlikely characters (= human cases). The result is what you expect: it's not funny.

title: Faust: Love of the Damned
actors: Mark Frost, Andrew Divoff, Isabel Brook, Jennifer Rope, Jeffrey Combs, Monica Van Campen
description: John Jasper is an artist who lives happily with his girlfriend. When the girl is killed, John, overwhelmed by grief, attempts to commit suicide. Before he can commit the insane gesture, M shows up and proposes him to make a deal: to sell his soul in exchange for superpowers. John just has to accept because in this way he will be able to carry out his intentions of revenge.
notes: Brian Yuzna puts a famous and bloody comic by Tim Vigil and David Quinn into bad images. The result is far below expectations because Yuzna stuffs the story with gore effects that have already been seen in abundance. The finish also leaves something to be desired.

title: The Pooch and the Pauper
actors: Carolyn Dunn, Cody Jones, Fred Willard, George Wendt, Laura Press
description: Bulldog Liberty - whose thoughts we can hear - has the honor of being none other than the "First Dog", and to keep company with Washington's number one. However, he is a lazy, spoiled dog with a bad temper that fate will repay during a walk, when he is exchanged with a street dog, identical to him as a drop of water, named Moocher. Liberty will end up at the kennel where bad guys mistake him for a look-alike of the presidential dog ... Meanwhile, in the White House, Moocher is doing much better than his predecessor.
notes: Produced by Disney Channel, the film takes up the famous novel by Mark Twain _The Prince and the Poor_.

title: El sabor de la venganza
actors: Richard Harrison, Fernando Sancho, Roberto Undari, Gloria Milland
description: A ranch owner is killed in front of his wife and three small children. The widow makes her children swear to avenge the killing of their father. The children grow up cultivating the violent intentions of their mother, and when they reach the age of majority they start hunting.
notes: Riz Ortolani's soundtrack is actually very Morricone, but Richard Harrison, the fourth category star of "spaghetti", unfortunately is not Clint Eastwood. In any case, for fans, a "paella-western" (more Spanish than Italian) therefore sufficiently grim to entertain. Fernando Sancho at his best!

title: 2009 Lost Memories
actors: Ahn Kil-Kang, Jang Dong-Kun, Ken Mitsuishi, Toru Nakamura
description: August 15, 1945. After the drop of the atomic bomb on Berlin, the United States and Japan win the Second World War. The Great Empire of the Far East, the other name of the Japanese Empire, extends throughout East Asia. Japan is the second largest world power after the United States, despite the presence of a strong anti-government terrorist movement. 2009, Seoul, third city of the Great Far Eastern Empire. Sakamoto Masayuki and Saigo Shojiro are the two agents of the Japanese Bureau of Investigation in charge of investigating the theft carried out by some members of Hureisenjin, the main anti-government organization, in an archaeological exhibition. The investigations soon lead the two detectives to identify a much more complex plot behind the attack: the case is closed by the leaders of the JBI, but Sakamoto decides to continue his battle alone to discover the truth ...
notes: It is a pity that 2009 Lost Memories soon gives way to the din of special effects, to the most obvious racial revenge, to the logic of excess - where the desire to amaze turns into a numbness of the senses. As the story progresses, gaps in the script and inconsistencies of all sorts alternate with alarming constancy; agree that Korean cinema is on the rise, agree that international acclaim is starting to flood, also agree that consequently investments increase, allowing more accurate and prestigious productions. But the virtuous circle cannot be taken for granted forever, if the Korean film industry begins to level itself with the worst American popcorn cinema, churning out films of such mammoth fragility. And if no one disputes the profuse commitment, the high technical yield, the skill of the actors and even the atmosphere of expectation and curiosity created with the first sequences, yet everything is irremediably thwarted by the little courage and fugitive imagination shown.

title: Sherlock Holmes und das Halsband des Todes
actors: Hans Soehnker, Christopher Lee, Senta Berger, Hans Nielsen
description: Holmes and the faithful doctor Watson are again grappling with their eternal enemy, the evil Professor Moriarty: he is, in fact, the mastermind of the sensational theft of Cleopatra's necklace, found by some archaeologists in Egypt ...
notes: Curt Siodmak's script is very loosely inspired by Conan Doyle's novels: mediocre outcome.

title: Incompreso
actors: Luca Zingaretti, Margherita Buy, Walter Conciatore, Riccardo Manera, Irene Ferri, Fabio Sartor, Gianna Giachetti, Sabrina Colle, Luigi Diberti
description: The environment is a farm near Lucca, an important producer of fine wines. The story takes place during the second half of the 1950s. We are booming and the attention of Edoardo Quaratesi (Luca Zingaretti) is all directed towards business. Edoardo adores his wife Elisa (Margherita Buy) and the two beautiful children born of their marriage, ten-year-old Francesco (Walter Conciatore) and Mino (Riccardo Manera), who is about half as old, but work and business distract him from his affections. To suffer most of all for this paternal absence, it is Francis. Also because, when he is at home, Edoardo reserves his warmest effusions to his youngest son: he thinks in good faith that Francesco is now a little man and no longer needs "cuddles". Elisa is the only one who senses Francesco's little drama and tries to cover up her husband's distractions, even going so far as to lie to justify it. Francesco pours all his unsatisfied need for love on his mother and on Mino, towards whom he has no jealousy. On the contrary, to please every whim, she lets him get involved in risky adventures, the outcome of which often jeopardizes her little brother's health. But the responsibility for all the more or less serious pranks committed by children is always attributed by the father to Francesco; he is the "oldest" and should take care of his little brother, rather than exposing him to dangers and ailments. In reproaching him, Edoardo uses harsh and severe tones that hurt Francesco deeply and sharpen in him the oppressive sense of the distance that separates him from his father. Elisa falls ill and Edoardo asks Laura, his wife's sister, to take over the reins of the house. The relationships of the children with the aunt are not easy ...

title: Biker Boyz
actors: Laurence Fishburne, Derek Luke, Orlando Jones, Djimon Hounsou
description: Manuel Galloway, known in the biker scene with the nicknames "Smoke" and "Re di Calì", is the leader of a gang of African American motorcyclists who, abandoning their work clothes, compete on the streets of America. But his domination is threatened by Kid an emerging young man, determined to oust him.
notes: In this blaxploitation version of _Fast and Furious_, various elements (and stereotypes) of classic American cinema return: the father-son clash, the itinerant scammers and so on. The story is crudely implanted, everything smacks of fake a mile away, but the direction of the unknown Reggie Rock Bythewood has a nervous, snappy, dirty look: hand-held camera, long sequence shots, night setting.

title: The Hot Chick
actors: Rob Schneider, Rachel McAdams, Anna Faris, Matthew Lawrence
description: A very strange thing happens to Jessica, the most beautiful and popular girl in her school, head of cheerleaders and engaged to the quaterback of the high school football team. One morning he wakes up in the body of over 30 Clive. But the funny thing is that Clive finds himself in Jessica's body.
notes: The script is a sieve, a smoothie of inconsistencies. The effort is to keep up a series of sketches, to make some farce fragments work every now and then. It produces Adam Sandler's Happy Madison which appears in the cameo of a fake rasta, smoked and bongo player.

title: Les pygmées de Carlo
actors: Stéphane Rideau, Beppe Chierici, Sonia Rolland, Yves Verhoeven
description: A famous Italian director, such Carlo Ercole, forces his confidence assistant to a perilous journey to the Central African Republic by ordering him to take him to Paris, where he lives and works, twenty pygmies, for a mass scene to turn around in the Saint Denis stadium. Marc, after some hesitations, obeys and together with Oliver leaves for the black continent in search of the bizarre extras.
notes: The film is beautiful, affectionate, militant - as they said - without the need to win flags and march in the jungle. And above all it makes merit and grace to ours (in) forgettable Marco Ferreri, for which Mihaileanu (that of _train de vies_) worked for a long time. The figure of Carlo Ercole is in fact followed on the exuberant personality of the brilliant author of _la Grande Abbuffata_, he owes the idea - true - to request twenty pygmies for a crazy sequence remained in his bulimic, fervent fantasy.

title: The Arrival
actors: Charlie Sheen, Lindsay Crouse, Teri Polo, Phyllis Applegate
description: After receiving a signal from space via radio, an astronomer contacts the sender. The scientist - who has joined the Seti, a program that scours the universe in search of alien presences - is working with a meteorologist. But, one day, the two seem to pick up other traces ...

title: Nancherrow
actors: Katie Ryder Richardson, Tristan Gemmill, Phillipp Moog, Donald Sinden
description: Nancherrow is a stunning property in Cornwall. In 1947 the house passed to Loveday, the sole heir of the Lewis family. The woman is married to Walter, a simple farmer, with whom she had a son, Nat. The marriage, already in crisis, falls when Loveday goes to live in Nancherrow and Walter refuses.

title: Der Schutzengel
actors: Christiane Paul, Heino Ferch, Barbara Rudnik, Huub Stapel, Günther Bothur
description: Maria Fender, on her first day of work as a therapist, is entrusted with Marc Bittner, a violent criminal found guilty of brutally killing some women. The woman is convinced that the man, suffering from personality disorders, is innocent and deserves to return to freedom.

title: It Runs in the Family
actors: Michael Douglas, Kirk Douglas, Rory Culkin, Cameron Douglas, Diana Douglas
description: Mitchell, the patriarch of the Grombergs, is a partner in one of the most important law firms in New York, but struggles to accept a pension; Evelyn, his devoted wife, is his point of reference and the peacemaker between the old man and his son Alex. Who, in turn, tries not to make the same mistakes as his father with his two offspring: the rebellious Asher and the eleven-year-old Eli, perhaps the most mature and balanced of the family ...
notes: Direction non-existent, ridiculous screenplay, a very tanned Kirk in his underwear who gets an insulin shot in his ass: it would be a funny sculpt, if in the face of the decadence of myths we didn't feel like crying.

title: Old School
actors: Luke Wilson, Will Ferrell, Vince Vaughn, Ellen Pompeo, Juliette Lewis
description: Mitch, Frank and Beanie are three in their thirties undecided whether to find a stable job and start a family, or enjoy life without too many worries. Of the two alternatives, the second is certainly the most tempting ...
notes: Few moments of mad comedy and clichés about "thirtysomething".

title: 15 août
actors: Richard Berry, Charles Berling, Jean-Pierre Darroussin, Melanie Thierry
description: When Max, Raoul and Vincent arrive in LaBaule on August 15th, their wives are gone. After fifteen days of rain, housework, shopping and children to look after, they thought they too deserved a holiday, leaving the house and five children in the hands of their husbands.
notes: Accumulating sociological notations and funny and ridiculous situations, Patrick Alessandrin's comedy, despite some successful scenes and an impeccable Jean-Pierre Darroussin, does not escape clichés and slightly too simplistic scenes. The three protagonists are in part, but everything ends up having the air of a show.

title: Il ragazzo dal kimono d'oro 6
actors: Ron Williams, Dorian D. Field, Raffaele Exiana, Richard Goon
description: University students in Greece. Once in chaotic Athens, one of them is the victim of a scam by Yorgo: once the common fund has disappeared, without money and without tickets, the return journey becomes a problem ...
notes: The infamous series has reached its sixth episode: now there are no more barrels to scrape.

title: Sutjeska
actors: Richard Burton, Milena Dravic, Irene Papas, Ljuba Tadic, Bata Zivojinovic
description: In May 1943, the liberation struggle in Yugoslavia went through a decisive phase: in Sutjeska, the troops under the orders of Marshal Josip Broz - who later became famous as Tito - had to endure the fifth, very heavy offensive of the Nazi troops. The battle is revealed to the death as the Yugoslav soldiers do not spare themselves just to be able to break through the circle of iron and fire of the enemy.
notes: Triumphant and celebratory, as only the war films of the former Eastern countries could be, the film was made on the occasion of the 30th anniversary of the famous battle.

title: Pulse
actors: Joey Lawrence, Cliff De Young, Roxanne Hart, Matthew Lawrence
description: A wave of electricity that seems to have its own intelligence moves from house to house through the cables of the electricity grid, sowing destruction, terror and death: David an eleven-year-old boy and his father are also victims, trapped without apparent path exit ...
notes: The starting idea is discreet and the special effects are good: in the long run, however, everything falls apart miserably despite the director having collaborated with George Lucas (he co-directed the short film _Herbie_, 1966 and edited the documentary _The Emperor_, 1967 by Lucas himself).

title: The Man from Elysian Fields
actors: Andy Garcia, Mick Jagger, Julianna Margulies, Olivia Williams, James Coburn, Anjelica Huston
description: To pay off his debts, failed writer Byron Tiller agrees to work for Luther Fox, owner of the escort agency "Elysian Fields". In one of his first assignments, he begins a relationship with a wealthy lady married to an elderly successful novelist: in short, he finds himself in a situation he never imagined, torn between his wife and son - unaware of everything - and lover. ...
notes: The only curiosity lies in the composite surrounding cast, wasted but still interesting: Anjelica Huston in a secondary part and above all a wonderful Coburn, just before his death, which alone could also be worth the film.

title: Xiao Wu
actors: Wang Hong-wei, Hongjian Hao, Baitao Zuo, Jinrei Ma, Junying Liu
description: Young pickpocket Wu has always been on the road, and when one of his former colleagues doesn't invite him to his wedding, the knowledge that he's left alone is burning. He falls in love with the prostitute Mei Mei, but the future looks uncertain ...
notes: All the disquiet of contemporary China in the extraordinary and intense debut of Jia.

title: Dekigokoro
actors: Takeshi Sakamoto, Nobuko Fushimi, Den Ohikata, Choko Iida, Tomio Aoki
description: Kihachi, widower and illiterate, has to raise his son in a situation of poverty. But when the man falls in love - unrequited - with a young orphan, the boy becomes jealous and a conflict arises between the two ...
notes: First film in a series dedicated to the character of Kihachi and set in the slums of the capital.

title: Tokyo no yado
actors: Takeshi Sakamoto, Yoshiko Okada, Choko Iida, Tomio Aoki
description: Kihachi has lost his wife, has no home or work and has to look after his two children as well. The encounter with a woman in conditions similar to his and with a sick daughter to be hospitalized pushes him to become a robber ...
notes: Fourth chapter of the Kihachi series, marked by the raw realism of the staging.

title: Super Troopers
actors: Brian Cox, André Vippolis, Michael Weaver, Jay Chandrasekhar, Marisa Coughlan, Joey Kern, Geoffrey Arend, Erik Stolhanske
description: Thorny, Mac, Rabbit, Foster and Farva are the cheerful members of a cavalry unit stationed in a very quiet area in the state of Vermont, near the Canadian border. Their survival is threatened by a series of budget cuts, but the discovery of drug trafficking could be an opportunity to prove that they are worth much more than they appear to be.

title: Children of the Corn IV: The Gathering
actors: Naomi Watts, Karen Black, Brent Jennings, Jamie Reneé Smith, Mark Salling
description: Back home to assist her sick mother, Grace does not believe her eyes: in fact, after a night spent between fever and convulsions, the children of the town have fallen into a sort of trance that has made them evil and murderers. The cause of the extraordinary and disturbing phenomenon is the impending resurrection of a "possessed" child, killed a few years earlier ...
notes: Now in its fourth chapter (but in the meantime we have reached seven, the last one in 2001), the saga that began in 1984 with _Grain blood red_ has now lost not only the connection with the original idea (Stephen King's story), but also every reason for being on a cinematic level.

title: Leo & Beo
actors: Marco Columbro, Sabrina Ferilli, Erika Blanc, Arnoldo Foà, Maria Rosaria Omaggio
description: The inventor Leo inherits from his aunt Giulia the ancient villa by the sea where he used to spend his holidays as a child, but which is now threatened by speculators. The building will see the fates of four characters intertwine: Leo himself, the restorer Laura with her daughter Valentina and ... the collie Beo, a dog with uncommon talents.

title: Final Destination 2
actors: A.J. Cook, Ali Larter, Michael Landes, Jonathan Cherry, Sarah Carter
description: Clear Rivers, the sole survivor of the flight 180 accident, lives locked up, of her own free will, within the walls of a psychiatric hospital. She is terrified of Death coming to claim her, as she did with all her friends, and perhaps she is right. Meanwhile, Kimberly Corman, intent on spending a weekend out of town, helplessly witnesses a terrible accident, but it could be just a vision or a warning ...
notes: _Final Destination 2_ is far better than the previous one. More serious (which does not mean without irony), more fun, more gory. Unstoppable, it has been a long time since we witnessed a product of a major that sank its feet in the splatter with such impetuousness: the murders spray blood like fountains, the bodies of the victims are tortured, blasted, sliced ??with a taste that fans will like as a manna. But it's neither gloomy nor leaden, rather it's like a cartoon.

title: Like Mike
actors: Lil' Bow Wow, Morris Chestnut, Jonathan Lipnicki, Brenda Song, Jesse Plemons
description: Calvin Cambridge is a 14-year-old orphan who dreams of becoming a great basketball point guard. Unfortunately, his modest stature and limited ability mean that this dream is just a fantasy. However, when Calvin puts on a pair of old sneakers with the initials "M.J." demonstrates a surprising unexpected skill that will even lead him to become fundamental for a troubled NBA team.

title: Bulletproof Monk
actors: Chow Yun-fat, Seann William Scott, Jaime King, Karel Roden, Victoria Smurfit
description: For sixty years a mysterious unnamed monk has wandered the world to protect a precious manuscript, but now it's time to find a replacement who can continue his mission ...
notes: Inspired by a comic from the Flypaper Press of the late 90s, modified with an infinite number of quotes, seductions and contaminations that have made it a potentially reproducible hybrid. The attempt to create something new was only partially successful, suffocated by an excessive amount of ingredients that sometimes do not bind together; and the stupid smile exhibited by Chow Yun-fat does not help either, who likens him to the worst Jackie Chan.

title: Cebo para una adolescente
actors: Philippe Leroy, Ornella Muti, Emilio Gutiérrez Caba, Philippe Leroy, Emilio Gutiérrez Caba
description: After being seduced by Ignacio, a middle-aged businessman, the young Maribel would like to end the relationship, but he comes to blackmail her by boasting the favors bestowed on her family. Maribel is forced to accept, but love for Carlos will give her the strength to rebel ...
notes: Nineteen year old in bloom, Muti lights up a film of rare banality.

title: Diabolik
actors: John Phillip Law, Marisa Mell, Michel Piccoli, Adolfo Celi
description: The city of Clerville is experiencing days of terror. A ruthless criminal, known to all by the name of Diabolik, together with his accomplice Eva Kant, hits billionaires by mocking the authorities. The thief, thanks to ingenious disguises and perfect masks, can assume the simplicity of anyone. Inspector Ginko then tries to set him a trap.
notes: Cult film directed with visionary inspiration by Mario Bava and inspired by the famous comic strip by the Giussani sisters. The scenographies that evoke pop-art and the "iterative" structure, without a real narrative coherence, make it an almost experimental work.

title: Shanghai Knights
actors: Jackie Chan, Owen Wilson, Fann Wong, Donnie Yen, Aidan Gillen
description: London 1880. A Chinese rebel kills the father of Chon Wang, a dignitary of the imperial court and escapes to England, but Chon Wang and his friend Roy O'Bannon pursue him for revenge. Once in London they discover that there is a conspiracy to exterminate members of the royal family ...
notes: The ending is pyrotechnic and seems to announce new adventures in the Hollywood where cinema is being born ... The ingredients are many, perhaps too many, but the general impression is that of a script already seen, like the usual credits that reproduce the real or alleged errors during filming.

title: Sissi. Schicksalsjahre einer Kaiserin
actors: Romy Schneider, Karlheinz Böhm, Magda Schneider, Josef Meinrad, Gustav Knuth, Johannes Ferigo, Helga Jesch, Walther Reyer, Uta Franz
description: After the celebration of the wedding with Francesco Giuseppe, Sissi has to deal with the problems of politics. Despite her young age, she immediately showed tact and the innate charisma that distinguishes her, managing to appease the revolutionary outbreaks that broke out in Hungary and Italy. Precisely for this reason, when a long indisposition forces her to move away from the cold Viennese climate, the Habsburg Empire realizes the importance of its presence at court ...
notes: The long tale orchestrated by Marischka continues and ends with this fourth feature film, not unlike the previous ones in terms of pomp and sentimentality.

title: Swimming Pool - Der Tod feiert mit
actors: Kristen Miller, Elena Uhlig, Thorsten Grasshoff, John Hopkins, Isla Fisher, Jason Liggett
description: After school, 13 students from the Prague International Lyceum organize a party to say goodbye before the summer holidays. Gregor, the charismatic gang leader, has the idea of ??setting the party in the huge municipal swimming pool of the city. But the evening, starting off in a big way, turns into a bloodbath: among the boys a dangerous serial killer wanders and the boys soon realize they have no escape.
notes: But the worst is the "Yellow Saturday" aesthetics (complete with hypocritical ellipses on each death), the variegated obtuseness of the faces (one of the boys is the same as Silvio Muccino), the predictability of jokes and narrative twists. Prague would be a really good horror set, but you never see it here. Only watchable moment, a chase in the air duct (you know what a novelty). Worse than American home video equivalents.

title: Esther Kahn
actors: Summer Phoenix, Ian Holm, Fabrice Desplechin, Frances Barber
description: London, late nineteenth century: the young Esther Kahn lives in a Jewish quarter of the East End. The harshness of daily existence and the hostility of the family have made her silent and lonely, but the sudden encounter with the theater pushes her to search strongly its place in the world ...
notes: Fourth film by the cultured and introverted French author.

title: Nella terra di don Chisciotte
description: Nine episodes produced by Rai, in which Orson Welles, his wife Paola Mori and daughter Beatrice make a real "tour of Spain". From Andalusia to Pamplona, ??from the Roman legacy to the Arab vestiges, the camera of the great master wanders relentlessly, capturing the most authentic aspects of the Iberian spirit.

title: Our Lips Are Sealed
actors: Mary-Kate Olsen, Ashley Olsen, Jim Meskimen, Tamara Clatterbuck
description: Witnesses to a crime, lively twins Maddy and Abby undergo the witness protection program. While awaiting trial, the FBI sends them to Sydney, Australia: here the two girls often and willingly escape surveillance to enjoy the sun and the beaches, but in this way they are noticed by the "bad guys" ...

title: Buongiorno, notte
actors: Luigi Lo Cascio, Maya Sansa, Roberto Herlitzka, Giovanni Calcagno, Pier Giorgio Bellocchio, Paolo Briguglia
description: Rome, 1978: Chiara becomes Aldo Moro's "vivandaia" after her kidnapping by the Red Brigades. The girl struggles to reconcile armed struggle with everyday life, made up of work, boyfriend and relationships with family, friends and colleagues.
notes: All built on the "private" of the protagonist (the young Red Brigade who lives the schizophrenic double existence of an employee and a jailer / prisoner), on the silent relationships that are intertwined in the house in via Gradoli (bodies leaning to sleep next to her in the bed , the ghostly presence enclosed in the ravine in the wall, his voice, the cat, the canaries, the terror of the neighbors' eyes), _Buongiorno, notte_ perhaps tells us much more about today than about that particular moment in our history. With his parades of politicians, taken from the television services of the time, with his hints of junk television (which in those years began to gnaw at our brains), and above all with his private obstinacy, with his "outside "distressing and threatening (the two sequences at the Ministry, between stairs and elevators, which photograph the air and the fear we breathed), describes the germs that have crept into our reality and clearly indicates who sowed them. As in _The hour of religion_, for Bellocchio the only way of survival is traced by the dream: Moro / Herlitzka, who insists on going free in Chiara's imagination, has the same expression as Castellitto who finds his freedom in the finale of that movie. These ghosts have something to teach us.

title: Viva gringo
actors: Guy Madison, Francisco Rabal, Fernando Rey
description: Sobillated by a fanatic priest, the last descendants of the Insta dynasty rebel against the government. The Peruvian authorities commissioned an explorer Welcome by the natives to quell the riot. The man will find a valid ally in the young heir to the throne of the tribe.
notes: Adventurous film without pretensions but enjoyable.

title: Segreti di Stato
actors: David Coco, Antonio Catania, Aldo Puglisi, Sergio Graziani, Francesco Guzzo
description: During the trial of Salvatore Giuliano's gang for the Portella della Ginestra massacre (which took place in Viterbo in 1951), a lawyer not entirely convinced of the results of the investigation, decides to secretly conduct his own investigation. Starting from a small detail - the caliber of the bullets extracted from the bodies of the victims - the lawyer, after listening to new witnesses in Sicily and having examined the site of the massacre, comes to a hypothesis totally different from the official version.
notes: Paolo Benvenuti's "history lesson", broadening the framework of responsibilities, calling into question the interpretations already given, obviously including that of Rosi's beautiful film, certainly does not say that the responsibilities are not unspeakable, but that they are wider and more complex than we have not thought so far. It brings back Italian history, from 1945 to today, as a piece of the history of the empire of which Italy has been a part or colony ever since.

title: Twentynine Palms
actors: Katerina Golubëva, David Wissak
description: Photographer David leaves for Los Angeles in search of new places to make reportages. In the company of Katia he crosses the Californian desert of Joshua Tree, stopping near Twentynine Palms. Here, immersed in a wild nature, the two indulge in passion to the point of letting themselves be possessed by the most hidden primordial instincts.
notes: The Californian desert is beautiful and easy to frame and this is certainly not an epochal discovery by the director. The two actors, Katia Golubeva and David Wissak, are overwhelmed by two very poorly written fashion roles and are both left on their hysterical swing. Dumont seems to irreversibly detest his interpreters. Many shots are beautiful, but the credit is only of nature.

title: Alila
actors: Yaël Abecassis, Uri Ran Klauzner, Liron Levo, Hanna Laslo, Amos Lavie
description: Lives crossed in an apartment building between Tel Aviv and Jaffa: the lonely Aviram, with his inseparable dog; the elderly Schwartz, a survivor of the concentration camps; Hezi and his mistress Gabi; Ezra, the owner of the property, who exploits the illegal work of some Chinese illegal immigrants; Mali, Ezra's ex-wife, who lives with Ilan. Meanwhile, Eyal, son of Ezra and Mali, is wanted for desertion ...
notes: The director's voice announces the titles and wishes the viewers good viewing, trying to blend in with his characters (but this is one of the film's problems) and superimposing details of stories that we already find in progress and that are left open.

title: Imagining Argentina
actors: Antonio Banderas, Emma Thompson, Horacio Flash, Kuno Becker, Rubén Blades
description: Buenos Aires, 1976: Cecilia Rueda, a journalist famous for her harshly critical articles of the government, disappears into thin air. Her husband Carlos, director of a small theater, begins a personal and courageous search to free her and other "disappeared", based on mysterious visions and premonitions ...
notes: An unspeakable hybrid between denunciation films and "paranormal" suggestions. Banderas is tanned with hair on his forehead and two-expressions-two: a) when he is angry he looks like a 1950s shepherd from Barbagia; b) Saint Joseph the worker seems to be good. When he sings on the guitar (expression b), an unstoppable shiver of disgust arises.

title: Baramnan gajok
actors: Moon So-ri, Hwang Jungmin, Kim In-mun, Yun Yeo-Jong
description: Housewife Hojung is married to Youngjak, a rampant lawyer. A former dancer attentive to her body, when she discovers that her husband is cheating on her with a model, she begins to feel her body foreign and no longer feel pleasure. Meeting a teenager will awaken her from her slumber.
notes: If it is a choral film (there are children, mothers-in-law and neighbors), there is no progressive symphony, there are no predictable sinuosities. Chorality, for the director Im, is an institution that lives on loneliness and autarchy. And even the staging, therefore, absorbs despair and abysses, disintegrating in sequences of an incredible rarefied chill, removing all pathos and often cooling with an irony that displaces and then leaves stone.

title: Zatôichi
actors: Takeshi Kitano, Tadanobu Asano, Yûko Daike, Akira Emoto, Taka Gatarukanaru
description: Japan, 19th century: the blind Zatoichi makes a living by gambling and massaging, but under this humble facade he is extremely skilled with the katana, the samurai sword. As he wanders, he ends up in a mountain town dominated by the gang of the unscrupulous Ginzo: when he runs into two beautiful geisha sisters, whose parents have been killed, he decides to avenge them ...
notes: A "Kitano doc", which beyond appearances escapes the codified definitions. The structure of the "chanbara" (the Japanese swashbuckle) becomes for the director-protagonist the territory of a challenge, of a duel with his own poetics and his own "physicality". At the center of the scene, "Beat" Takeshi is martial choreographer according to the teachings of the Asakusa school, from which he comes and which prepares students for combat with the katana and the bokken. Offstage, on the other hand, he is a pure filmmaker, attentive as usual to the rigor of the direction, to visual dissonances (blood, rain, mud, the chromatic contrasts of clothes, things, spaces), to grotesque or comic estrangements. This is perhaps the most interesting aspect: Kitano has accustomed us to the hilarious curtains, but in _Zatoichi_ there is a theoretical programmaticity in showing sappers who go in time, fake samurai imbeciles or characters-comedians (like the actor "Guadalcanal" Taka , who gets beaten on the head), transforming the absurd into the "ontological" category of cinema. The pre-final choreography is memorable.

title: Rosenstrasse
actors: Katja Riemann, Maria Schrader, Jürgen Vogel, Martin Feifel, Isolde Barth, Jan Decleir
description: Ruth is a New York Jew. When her husband dies, she reacts harshly, venting her pain in Jewish orthodoxy. He also tries to prevent the marriage of his daughter Hannah, who decides to go to Berlin to find the reasons for her mother's behavior. Here, the young woman meets Lena who tells her the episode that in 1943 saw her involved together with Ruth: hundreds of Jewish women protested in Rosenstrasse against the deportation of their husbands. The demonstration was of such vast proportions that the Nazis were forced to arrest them.
notes: Margarethe von Trotta, advocate of a structurally European cinema, with Rosenstrasse continues her circumnavigation in the "stories" of the history of the twentieth century. Before stopping in this Berlin street of 1943, he skirted other moments, other real or fictitious figures, other tears, other collective self-analyzes of the last century with _Rosa L. _, _Anni di lead_, _Das Versprechen_ and the television _Jahrestage_. The point of view of representation favors the feminine order of the discourse and the mixture of sequences which, despite social changes, remain "secret" and different.

title: The Hostage Negotiator
actors: Gail O'Grady, Michael Bowen, Brian Bloom, Taylor Anne
description: Theresa Foley is a hostage negotiator who is highly regarded in her work. At home, however, things are not going so well: her husband, Frank, suffers from personality disorders. The situation escalates when Frank takes some people hostage and Theresa is called to negotiate for their release ...

title: Wide Awake
actors: Joseph Cross, Dana Delany, Denis Leary, Robert Loggia, Rosie O'Donnell
description: Embittered by his grandfather's recent death, Joshua tries to follow in his footsteps by playing football, but with little success. The boy's mind is occupied with "spiritual" questions, which will be answered in the most unexpected way ...
notes: Second, a curious feature film by Shyamalan, made before _The sixth sense_.

title: Dirty Dozen: The Fatal Mission
actors: Telly Savalas, Ernest Borgnine, Hunt Block, Matthew Burton, Jeff Conaway
description: Now aware of the imminent defeat, Hitler sends some high-ranking officials to Istanbul with the task of laying the foundations for a future Fourth Reich. The Nazis take their places on the Orient Express, but are unaware that they have the men of the "dirty dozen" on their heels, determined to make the last plan of the Führer fail ...

title: Il trionfo di Robin Hood
actors: Don Burnett, Germano Longo, Vincenzo Musolino
description: Robin Hood, in Sherwood Forest, fights his battle against the usurper to the throne and against the thugs of the Sheriff of Nottingham, who are tyrannizing the region. The battle continues until Richard the Lionheart returns from the Holy Land.
notes: Adventurous Italian: low budget, high professionalism in the packaging.

title: La buena vida
actors: Fernando Ramallo, Lucía Jiménez, Luis Cuenca, Isabel Otero, Joel Joan, Victoria Peña, Jordi Bosch
description: Tristán, a 15-year-old budding writer with early sexual urges, has always enjoyed the comforts his family has built for him. But the accidental death of his parents forces him to face life differently ...
notes: Interesting exploration of adolescent psychology, poised between drama and humor.

title: Il momento della verità
actors: Miguel Mateo 'Miguelín', José Gomez Sevillano, Pedro Basauri 'Pedrucho', Linda Christian
description: Arriving in Barcelona, ??where he hopes to free himself from the misery of the Andalusian countryside from which he comes, the young Miguel comes into contact with the circles of bullfights. The job of a bullfighter ensures notoriety and high earnings, and Miguel decides to take the risk: he attends a school, works his way up in the town arenas and finally manages to get noticed by an important businessman. Glory and wealth come, but the price to pay will be very high ...
notes: The Neapolitan director's approach is semi-documentary, and his intent to demystify the myth of bullfighting (and the circle of interests that governs it) is all too transparent.

title: The Viking Sagas
actors: Ralf Moeller, Ingibjörg Stefánsdóttir, Sven-Ole Thorsen, Thorir Waagfjörd, Hinrik Olafson
description: To stop the family feuds that were tearing them apart, the Vikings move from Norway to Iceland, where, however, the rivalry between Kjartan and the usurper Ketil breaks out. The first will have to face his deadly enemy, aided by the old warrior Gunnar, in defense of his land and to avenge the death of his father.
notes: Rude and brutal reinterpretation of the Nordic sagas, directed by the prestigious director of photography, former collaborator, among others, of Martin Scorsese. In the film, the contrast is posed between a fighter with morality and bloodthirsty warriors without any scruple, all seasoned therefore with inserts of gratuitous violence with a strong graphic impact.

title: La beauté du diable
actors: Gérard Philipe, Michel Simon, Nicole Besnard, Carlo Ninchi
description: Doctor Faust, now an elderly man, is nostalgic for the juice of life that only youth can make you taste. So he accepts the pact with Mephistopheles: in exchange for the soul he is transformed into Henri, a beautiful boy.
notes: Classic of French cinema, still highly admired at home, it testifies to the cultural climate of an era dominated by existentialism. For this reason it should be seen in parallel with Clouzot's _Lives sold_, from a few years later, but with the same philosophical suggestions. Clair is sometimes calligraphic in the direction, but there are scenes of great charm. And Gérard Philipe is the French James Dean.

title: 21 Grams
actors: Sean Penn, Benicio Del Toro, Naomi Watts, Charlotte Gainsbourg, Danny Huston, Clea DuVall
description: Ex-inmate Jack runs over two girls in his car causing their death. Christine, mother of one of the two young victims, retraces her entire existence in the light of this tragedy; meanwhile, Paul, suffering from heart disease, awaits the call for the transplant. The title refers to the 21 grams that the human body exhales with the last breath.
notes: Focusing stubbornly on the structure, Iñárritu - flanked by the screenwriter Guillermo Arriaga - loses sight of the characters and the pathos of their personal stories. The excellent actors on stage, with the precious and never banal photography of Rodrigo Prieto, however, balance the director's satisfaction and save the film. The 21 grams of the title are the weight that the human body would lose exhaling the last breath.

title: Il miracolo
actors: Claudio D'Agostino, Stefania Casciaro, Carlo Bruni, Anna Ferruzzo
description: Twelve-year-old Tonio is run over by the young Cinzia, who runs away without helping him. Before he faints, he sees a wonderful light: when he wakes up from a coma, he begins to perform real miracles. For example, one night, while wandering around the hospital, he enters a room where there is a dying man: the electrocardiogram on the monitor is flat, but the touch of Tonio restarts the heartbeat ...
notes: Winspeare's - we know - is a stubborn gaze, which believes in beauty and seeks it in a context whose devastation is inevitably reflected in the hearts and soul: that of Taranto which from sequence to sequence, with its also symbolic contrasts (the leaden smoke of the factories becomes cancer in the flesh of the ill of Ilva), it becomes pervasive. And he clarifies, illuminates, basically explains: he explains that the true miracle is precisely in this gaze, which rediscovers the value of absolute love and its explosive force. Less visceral than Winspeare's previous film (the beautiful _Live blood_), perhaps more ambitious and "headstrong", _The miracle_ is still sincere, finally necessary.

title: Code 46
actors: Tim Robbins, Samantha Morton, Om Puri, Jeanne Balibar, Togo Igawa
description: William, able to read the minds of others, must investigate a fraud against the Sphinx, an insurance company. In a short time he discovers that the culprit is Maria, an employee who is spreading an insurance formula she created. But William falls in love with her ...
notes: Almost the (less successful) science fiction version of _Lost in Translation_, _Code 46_ by ??Michael Winterbottom mixes fears and suggestions of the end of the millennium, globalization, invasion, loss of identity, genetic manipulation, limitation of freedoms, from _Blade Runner_ to _Gattaca_ to _Minority Report_ . Unlike its many predecessors, it is shot at a relatively low cost and in an intimate key that risks making it a bit schematic and wordy. The two protagonists, perplexed and lost, work.

title: Les sentiments
actors: Jean-Pierre Bacri, Nathalie Baye, Melvil Poupaud, Isabelle Carré, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi
description: Jacques is a doctor taken to a small village in the French countryside, he lives in a villa with his wife Carole and two teenage children; one day the young doctor François, who will have to take his place, comes to live next to them with his wife Edith. The two couples make friends, especially women. But the patatrac happens: the older doctor seduces his colleague's wife. Carole discovers everything, by chance, and the uproar begins ...
notes: Reflection on love, perhaps more serious and painful than it appears at first sight. The tone is comedy but the smile hides more than a tear. Quartet of high-level actors.

title: Um filme falado
actors: Leonor Silveira, John Malkovich, Catherine Deneuve, Stefania Sandrelli, Irene Papas
description: Rosa María, a Portuguese history teacher, embarks in Lisbon with her little daughter María Joana for a cruise that, across the Mediterranean, will take her to join her husband in Bombay. During the trip he will have the opportunity to meet three women (one French, one Italian and one Greek), and the captain of the ship, an American of Polish origin. An unpredictable fate, however, awaits everyone at the gate ...
notes: Film of disarmed simplicity, geometric theorem, mocking cultural-political apologue: de Oliveira has no illusions (anymore). Once upon a time there was the West ...

title: Bu San
actors: Yang Kuei-Mei, Lee Kang-sheng, Chen Shiang-chyi, Miao Tian, Kiyonobu Mitamura
description: To escape a violent storm, a boy walks into an old cinema while the last show is in progress. The room - where _Dragon Inn_, the Taiwanese swashbuckling blockbuster from 1966 is screened - seems deserted, but in the dark the young man comes across other presences, ghosts that have the faces of the characters in the film. Meanwhile, the projectionist and the conductor continue to chase each other without ever meeting.

title: Vozvraschenie
actors: Vladimir Garin, Ivan Dobronravov, Konstantin Lavronenko, Natalja Vdovina
description: A man returns home after many years. His two sons, 14-year-old Andrei and 12-year-old Ivan, are shocked, because the only memory they have of him is an old faded photograph. The questions are many: is it really the father? Why did he turn up suddenly? The three embark on a journey that will take them far away, towards a lacerating epilogue.
notes: Zvyagintsev's debut feature by No Longer Young (from 1964) asks a lot of questions and doesn't give a shred of an answer, which is fine. It remains to be determined whether it is a choice that enriches the film's journey or leaves it there, in the inert limbo of a suspended ambition. And the very controlled direction, always attentive to the composition of the picture and the care of the atmospheres and colors, is it a sign of a talented predisposition or a somewhat scholastic ability? It is therefore legitimate to ask what path the Siberian director will take in the future: will he lean towards a post-Soviet festival-like academism? Will it accentuate its unstable, liquid and Tarkovskian sides, or the - mysterious - anime thriller sides? Or will he devote himself to exploring the world of adolescence? We wait with curiosity.

title: Anything Else
country: United States, France, Netherlands, Great Britain
actors: Danny DeVito, Woody Allen, Jason Biggs, Stockard Channing, Christina Ricci, Jimmy Fallon
description: Jerry Falk, a New York-based Jewish comedy writer, dreams of writing the novel of his life. Jerry is irresistibly attracted to his friend's partner, aspiring actress Amanda. Soon, however, she betrays him and Jerry finds the solution to his problems in the enlightened advice of David Dobel, an elderly professor met by chance in Central Park ...
notes: The film has the swirling lightness and stylistic essentiality of certain "vintage" Allen's: the irresistible romanticism of _Hannah and her sisters_, the third age melancholy of _Broadway Danny Rose_, the frenetic succession of lines of _Manhattan_. Take _I and Annie_: there Alvy Singer, incurable New Yorker, rejected the West Coast with its kitsch and its supermarket culture; while here it is David Dobel, a philosopher-joke obsessed by the Holocaust and self-defense, who convinces the young Jerry to drop everything and leave. Curious exchange of roles, which seems to correspond to the discovery of a young comedian capable of giving a new body and new romantic possibilities to that psychic and physical unicum that is Allen. Counterpointed by the great voice of Billie Holiday and the first-person narration of Jason Biggs, built through the classic succession of fields, counterfields, middle floors and dry side carriages (very "metropolitan", like the old idols Bogart and Sinatra and the film club that projects _The exterminating angel_), one of Allen's best films of the last decade.

title: The Human Stain
actors: Anthony Hopkins, Nicole Kidman, Ed Harris, Gary Sinise
description: Professor Silk loses his chair of classical literature at Athena College, accused of racism. His private life is also in crisis, but two fundamental encounters allow him to be reborn.
notes: On several occasions, Benton's direction proves to be indecisive, dampening and blurring the destinies of beings damaged in the soul.

title: The Dreamers - I sognatori
actors: Jean Pierre Kalfon, Michael Pitt, Louis Garrel, Eva Green, Jean-Pierre Léaud
description: Paris, 1968: Left alone while their parents are on vacation, Isabelle and Theo invite Matthew, an American they have just met, to their home. The three decide not to go out and define the rules of their imprisonment. Exploring emotions and eroticism, they will come to know each other deeply and to test themselves to understand how far they can go ...
notes: Bertolucci's dreamers dream indoors, in the front rows of the cinema and in a beautiful empty house: they tell the intolerance of the enlightened French bourgeoisie and the American petty bourgeoisie, which with pacifist tolerance tries to find lost innocence. They dream and know that it will never be like this again, more mature than their bodies, older than the images of "their" cinema. Opened by the dolly that descends from the Eiffel Tower (and which is repeated in similar movements outside the elevator of the children's house), accompanied by a soundtrack of "etymological" precision and instant emotional warmth (Jimi Hendrix and Edith Piaf, the Doors and Françoise Hardy, _El paso del Ebro_ and _La mer_), _The Dreamers_ is shot with the lightness of the cinema that in the 1960s discovered the world, with the fugues of _Bande à part_ and the ingenuity of _Pierrot le fou_ and _Partner_, with the desire to dirty the screen with a happy piece of autobiography, to tell that the only way out is suicide, as for _Mouchette_, but that sometimes, a blow of air, a dream that materializes for an instant, it can stop you. And the desire not to forget and not to regret anything.

title: Intolerable Cruelty
actors: George Clooney, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Geoffrey Rush, Billy Bob Thornton, Jack Kyle
description: Tired of the usual routine, Miles Massey - a skilled divorce lawyer from Los Angeles - finds in the chance meeting with Marilyn Rexroth the opportunity to change his life. But the woman is ambitious and careerist and seeks economic independence through a convenient marriage. Initially, the lawyer tries to frame her to prevent her client from being forced to pay alimony, but Marilyn, in revenge, promises to make Miles fall at her feet ...
notes: It may be just a "divertissement", but there is enough material inside to stuff at least a dozen films by other more asphyxiated directors.

title: Monsieur Ibrahim et les fleurs du Coran
actors: Pierre Boulanger, Omar Sharif, Isabelle Adjani, Pierre Boulanger, Gilbert Melki, Isabelle Renauld
description: Paris, the 1960s: 13-year-old Moïse - nicknamed Momo, a Jew - has his only friend in Monsieur Ibrahim, the Arab grocer who lives in the neighborhood. The boy, in love with the affectionate and maternal prostitutes and the daughter of the concierge, lives - after his mother's abandonment - with his surly father, taking care of shopping, the house and the kitchen. For the boy, Ibrahim is a real teacher of life: it is he, in fact, who makes him discover women and love ...
notes: Polite, very predictable, not boring, written and directed in a flat way, the film convinces more in the description of the encounter between the boy and the old man and in the tolerant scrutiny between the two worlds.

title: Le divorce
actors: Naomi Watts, Kate Hudson, Melvil Poupaud, Leslie Caron, Thierry Lhermitte
description: Isabel comes from California to Paris to help her half-sister Roxeanne in her eighth month of pregnancy. But, shortly after her arrival, the woman is left by Charles-Henri, a painter husband who prefers a Russian dancer to her. Meanwhile, Isabel embarks on a relationship with a man much more mature than her.
notes: The film is very badly written, with characters from indefinite evolution and worse directed, without a shred of rhythm. The description of the French is the most disarming thing in the film: if Ivory had made them eat frogs, which also happens only in the American imagination, the catalog of stereotypes would have been complete.

title: Coffee and Cigarettes I, II, III
actors: Roberto Benigni, Steve Buscemi, Iggy Pop, Tom Waits, Steven Wright, Cate Blanchett, Alex Descas, Isaach De Bankolé, Bill Murray, Vinny Vella, Renee French, Meg White, Jack White
description: Around bar tables with coffee and cigarettes, Iggy Pop and Tom Waits chatter about drummers and records that are missing from the juke-box; the acclaimed rock duo _The White Stripes_ takes an interest in energy conduits; Alfred Molina and Steve Coogan exchange suspicious civilians and low blows: GZA and RZA (of the Wu-Tang Clan) meet the ghost-catcher waiter Bill Murray in disguise, the most ghost of all; and two old men, finally, toast to Paris in the 1920s and New York in the 1970s, while one says that if you can listen well, you can hear Mahler's notes during your life.
notes: The film, on balance, is beautiful: because it manages, with dialogues of unbeatable times, to tell us about the "smokiness" of the universe, but with pure irony. Which does not subtract the emotion and the deepest meditation (on man, old age, time, silence), as in the last, splendid episode. Jarmusch shows us his cool acquaintances and friendships: but he does not overflow into haughty snobbery, and he has a lot of fun.

title: The League of Extraordinary Gentlemen
country: United States, Germany, Great Britain, Czech Republic
actors: Sean Connery, Naseeruddin Shah, Peta Wilson, Tony Curran, Stuart Townsend, Shane West
