description: Adventurer Allan Quatermain leads a superhero team that includes Captain Nemo, vampire Mina Harker, the invisible man Rodney Skinner, Dorian Gray, Tom Sawyer and Dr. Henry Jekyll aka Mr. Edward Hyde. The unusual group must travel to Venice to foil the plans of the evil Phantom ...
notes: The film would like to take off the imagination in the manner of the old George Pal, even if the accumulation of quotes reveals a target certainly not adolescent. The lightness is hidden but the operation remains enjoyable, especially in the scenographies that refer to the comics origin (as yet another re-enactment / exorcism of the Twin Towers, half Venice is thrown down).

title: Once Upon a Time in Mexico
actors: Antonio Banderas, Salma Hayek, Johnny Depp, Willem Dafoe, Rubén Blades, Eva Mendes, Mickey Rourke
description: Sands, a corrupt CIA agent, forces the Mariachi, who had chosen to retire, to return to help him foil the plot of a group of villains led by Barillo, who intend to assassinate the Mexican president. The Mariachi, driven by a thirst for revenge and money, can only accept. His two trusted companions accompany him in the enterprise: Lorenzo and Fideo ...
notes: Around this amused nonsense (the director certainly is), even a minimum of films: the idea of ??the two lovers Banderas & Hayek who flee from the counter chained and notable some editing ideuzza is nice, but we know that in this autarchic Rodriguez knows how to do it.

title: Matchstick Men
actors: Sam Rockwell, Nicolas Cage, Bruce Altman, Alison Lohman, Bruce McGill
description: Roy, a con artist and his partner Frank, have a plan in mind that will allow them to appropriate a large sum of money. But the unexpected arrival of Roy's teenage daughter upsets the plans and the existence of the two ...
notes: The film has a disillusioned lightness reminiscent of the cinema of the '70s, a nice subterranean air in the description of relationships, the ability to dodge the traps of contemporary American cinema: slowness, dribbling, moralism. The endings chase each other, but not because Scott doesn't know how to conclude, but because the story slips towards its natural closure: one more look, a different living room, a new piece of life.

title: Dumb and Dumberer: When Harry Met Lloyd
actors: Eric Christian Olsen, Derek Richardson, Rachel Nichols, Cheri Oteri, Luis Guzmán, Elden Henson
description: From day one in college, Lloyd Christmas realizes that he has found an inseparable friend in Harry Dune. The boys, without realizing it, fall into the net of the corrupt principal Collins and his girlfriend, the coordinator of the canteen service: the two want to turn them into the first students of a fictional class for "special" students to defraud $ 100,000 in grants. But the beautiful reporter from the school newspaper realizes that there is something sinister underneath.
notes: The pre-production ends brilliantly. There remains the problem of a comic film that is not funny because the jokes and almost all the gags of the situation are sloppy. Between the two actors, Olsen gets along better than his colleague only because he struggles to imitate Carrey.

title: Il ritorno di Cagliostro
actors: Robert Englund, Luigi Maria Burruano, Franco Scaldati, Pietro Giordano
description: Sicily, 1950s. The La Marca brothers, founders of a film production house, encouraged by a high prelate who sees cinema as the means for a new evangelization, try to create an ambitious work that will make them known throughout the world and allow them to recover economically. They then hire a Hollywood star, Erroll Douglas, who is on the decline. To complete their project, the two do not hesitate to get involved in shady Mafia trafficking.
notes: Increasingly sharp and talented (the film appears much more expensive than it really is), Daniele Ciprì and Franco Maresco are the other side of our busy cinema, the mirror in which Paolo Benvenuti's Secrets of State are reflected, of which they tell a story virtually identical story, only more ragged, approximate, "artisanal", perhaps more equal to Italy (then and today), which is very funny in the first part and which, suddenly, freezes, with the abrupt change of final register, when a new character enters, a Lynchian dwarf master of ceremonies who, moving the shots like wings, tells us the true story. A rare Italian film, very cultured and inflamed with ironic passion, desolate and very lively.

title: Lost in Translation
actors: Bill Murray, Scarlett Johansson, Giovanni Ribisi, Anna Faris
description: Traveling to Tokyo to shoot some commercials, 50-year-old American actor Bob Harris meets a fellow countryman who is staying in the same hotel as him: young Charlotte, fresh from Yale graduation and wife of a busy photographer. Both bored and lost in a totally foreign culture, the two enter into a singular relationship made of complicity and irony, confusion and allusions, tender but without sex ...
notes: La Coppola discreetly touches its two protagonists and the consolidation of their mutual attraction. A small and precious film, in an unstable balance between gag and emotion, fun and romance.

title: Travellers and Magicians
actors: Tsewang Dandup, Lhakpa Dorji, Sonam Kinga, Deki Yangzom
description: Dondup, a government official, works (so to speak) in a village up in the mountains and waits to leave for America. When he sets out on a journey, it is immediately clear that it will be difficult for him to get to even the nearest town: he misses the bus, meets other people, goes on foot together with an old man with a basket of apples to take to the fair, to a monk. musician and narrator of old stories and above all to the beautiful Sonam.
notes: The film is shot with care, is designed for the international market and winks at the Western viewer: the point is to see if there is still, under the patina of the package, the taste of sincerity.

title: Paris nous appartient
actors: Betty Schneider, Gianni Esposito, Françoise Prevost, Jean-Claude Brialy, Claude Chabrol, Jacques Demy, Jean-Luc Godard, Jacques Rivette
description: Paris, 1957: Anne, invited by her brother Pierre to a friend's party, meets Philip, an American persecuted by McCarthy, and the theater director Gérard. Everyone seems involved in the suicide of a Spanish comrade, an anarchist activist ...
notes: From one of the fathers of the Nouvelle Vague, former editor-in-chief of the "Cahiers du cinéma".

title: Casa de los Babys
actors: Daryl Hannah, Marcia Gay Harden, Mary Steenburgen, Rita Moreno, Lili Taylor, Maggie Gyllenhaal
description: Six Americans travel to Latin America to find children to adopt. The law requires adoptive mothers to settle in the country of origin of their new children and adapt to local customs. Among the women is a worker, a member of an association of alcoholics anonymous, a moody New York Jew, a wealthy girl, a Bostonian in financial difficulty and an athlete.

title: Vacanze in val Trebbia
actors: Marco Bellocchio, Gisella Burinato, Pier Giorgio Bellocchio, Gianni Schicchi, Gionata Cella, Beppe Ciavatta
description: The future director of _The hour of religion_ returns with his family to his homeland, in the province of Piacenza. The journey is an opportunity to confront oneself with one's past, as well as with the nostalgia of an era.
notes: Between documentary and fiction, Bellocchio anticipates the style of _Addio del Past_, his docu-film on Verdi's Traviata.

title: Liberi
actors: Luigi Maria Burruano, Elio Germano, Nicole Grimaudo, Anita Zagaria, Myriam Catania, Rosa Pianeta
description: In Bussi, a small town in the Pescara mountains, lives Cenzo, who spent thirty years in the factory before his department closed. His 20-year-old son Vince aspires to study in a big city, but his girlfriend Elena disagrees: he wants to get married, have children, find a job there. And then there is Genny, who works as a waitress in Pescara and would like to see the world, but as soon as she gets on a train she suffers from panic attacks ...
notes: The over voice is often redundant, and in the end the film is predictable, mechanical like a soap. The two young protagonists are quite fresh and credible, even when the dialogues don't come to life and "smell like a script".

title: Bande à part
actors: Anna Karina, Claude Brasseur, Sami Frey, Jean-Luc Godard
description: Two bad guys, Arthur and Frantz, convince the beautiful Odile to help them rob her old uncle. Soon, the partnership turns into a love triangle ...
notes: As always happens with Godard, it is useless to tell the intertwining of his films: especially when the Franco-Swiss master tries his hand at genre conventions (in this case noir), systematically deconstructed and turned upside down like a glove. Striking mix of metalinguistic digressions, subtle irony and fake "dead time" (as in the café dance scene), the film has an illustrious fan in Quentin Tarantino, who has dubbed his production company "A Band Apart".

title: Last Life in the Universe
actors: Tadanobu Asano, Yutaka Matsushige, Riki Takeuchi, Takashi Miike, Yoji Tanaka, Sakichi Satô
description: A mysterious Japanese with obsessive-compulsive and suicidal manias lives in Bangkok. He finds himself entangled with a woman in a tragic chain of events. The two could not be more different: he is a rather tidy hippy who always does the dishes and keeps all the books in strict alphabetical order; she smokes marijuana and lives in utter disorder.

title: Rosamunde Pilcher: Blumen im Regen
actors: Karina Kraushaar, Oliver Hörner, Katja Woywood, Winnie Markus, Andrea L'Arronge, Wolf Roth, Alexander Wussow, Gaby Heinecke
description: What else could Lavinia want from life? She has a rich and charming boyfriend, John Shiplay, who is in love with her, and the future smiles at her. The only cloud concerns the health of Helen, John's grandmother, who is seriously ill. Fearing that his birthday could be their last, John and his father Gordon decide to celebrate it in an unforgettable way.

title: Une place parmi les vivants
actors: Christian Vadim, Thierry Gibaut, Valérie Kaprisky, Cécile Bois, Julie Judd, Jacques Pieiller, Denis Karvil, Don Condurache, Tomi Cristian, Vlad Ivanov, Monalisa Basarab, Lucia Muresan, Lamia Beligan, Antoine Burret
description: A serial killer spreads terror in the northern districts of Paris, killing many women. Joseph Arcimboldo, an insignificant man who accuses himself of the crimes, proposes to Ernest Ripper, a third-rate writer, to write his biography.

title: De fem benspænd
actors: Alexandra Vandernoot, Jacqueline Arenal, Patrick Bauchau, Daniel Hernandez Rodriguez, Jørgen Leth, Lars von Trier
description: A cinematic journey in the form of an investigation, a real research film in which the preconceptions and opinions of the two directors are continually questioned. The starting point is the short film _Det perfekte menneske_, made by Jørgen Leth in 1967. Lars von Trier asks his friend to make five different remakes and, each time, imposes different obstructions.
notes: We have the impression that, from this film, Lars von Trier's detractors will come out confirmed in their idea and supporters will rejoice at his brazen and human cruelty. Therefore, the battle continues.

title: Camur
actors: Yelda Reynaud, Bulent Emin Yarar, Taner Birsel
description: In a still divided Cyprus, four Turkish friends try to make peace with the past. Ali, participates in a curious peace initiative that involves the placement of a plaster statue that depicts him in the Greek part of the island and a copy in the Turkish area. Temel, tormented by feelings of guilt (during the war he committed mass murder) seeks comfort in Halil, responsible as he is for the deaths, but finds him completely indifferent to the past. Finally there is Aisha, Ali's sister and Halil's girlfriend.
notes: A slow movie. Even a bit 'malformoso. Because if some suggestions intrigue (the casts of diseased and deformed parts of the body as "offers" for an ideal healing, for example), the whole appears inert and out of focus, without a center or a foothold for a story.

title: Vodka Lemon
actors: Romen Avinian, Lala Sarkissian, Ivan Franek, Ruzan Mesropyan, Zahal Karielachvili
description: Armenia. Hamo, a 60-year-old widower and former Red Army officer, spends his days with his alcoholic son, grandson and a beautiful widow with whom he tries to rebuild a life. His assets consist of an old cupboard, a broken Russian television, his uniform and a military pension of $ 7 a month. Unexpectedly, a letter arrives from his son who lives in Paris. Hamo hopes it contains a $ 100 bill and with the help of the whole village goes to Yerevan to collect it ...
notes: The director skillfully mixes realism and comic situations, surreal inventions and naive sketches. Awarded in Venice in 2003 in the Controcorrente section.

title: Schultze Gets the Blues
actors: Horst Krause, Harald Warmbrunn, Karl-Fred Müller, Ursula Schucht
description: Recently retired, Schultze spends his days in the village where he lives in the company of friends Manfred and Juergen, while in the evening he devotes himself to his passion: the accordion. One day, he hears a Zydeco song on the radio, the music of the Louisiana Creoles. He tries to reproduce the sound that fascinated him on his instrument, after which he decides to leave for the United States in search of the roots of Zydeco music.
notes: The slightly numb gaze of director Michael Schorr moves "horizontally" from Germany to an America all of sad and funny stateless singing, suburbs, marshes, streets and different languages. More than Kaurismäki's cowboys, we think of certain "wacky" fashions of the 1980s (Percy Adlon, do you remember her?). But to keep the film on its intended ropes, the director lacks the necessary lightness. The film is enjoyable in some passages, but overall it remains a bit indigestible.

title: What a Girl Wants
actors: Amanda Bynes, Colin Firth, Kelly Preston, Eileen Atkins, Anna Chancellor, Jonathan Pryce
description: Seventeen-year-old Daphne's parents had to end their overwhelming romance due to opposition from his aristocratic family. Now a desire has arisen in Daphne to meet her father, who lives in London: to her surprise, the girl discovers that it is Henry Dashwood, an important politician. As his arrival threatens to jeopardize his father's success in the upcoming elections, Daphne strives to help him despite the hostility of Glynnis, Henry's new girlfriend, and Clarissa, Glynnis's jealous daughter ...
notes: Pale remake of _How to marry a daughter_ (1958) by Vincente Minnelli.

title: Tres hombres buenos
actors: Geoffrey Horne, Paul Piaget, Fernando Sancho, Robert Hundar, Raf Baldassarre, Charo del Río, Cristina Gaioni, Donatella Marrosu
description: A young ranchero's wife is killed by a gang of seven gunfighters. The widower who wants to punish the guilty joins two easy gun cowboys. The hunt for those responsible will be long and merciless.
notes: The direction of Marchent, who directed in 1955 _El Coyote_ one of the first European westerns, is flat.

title: Insomnia
actors: Stellan Skarsgård, Maria Mathiesen, Sverre Anker Ousdal, Gisken Armand
description: Swedish policeman Jonas Engström is called, together with colleague Vik, to the remote Norwegian town of Tromsø to investigate the murder of a young girl. Here by mistake, chasing a suspect, he ends up killing his colleague Vik, under the eyes of the real killer who will use this information to blackmail him and start a complex game of cat and mouse.
notes: Immersed in the fog and light of the midnight sun, the film wallows in the moral ambiguity of the characters, creating a noir perpetually illuminated by the sun. The idea, the cast and the setting are there; the script shows the chord a bit. Remade by Christoperh Nolan in 2002.

title: Boss of Bosses
actors: Chazz Palminteri, Angela Alvarado, Jay O. Sanders, Clancy Brown
description: Paul Castellano, ambitious and intelligent gangster, climbs the top of organized crime to become, in the 70s, the boss of the Gambino, one of the five mafia families in New York. Its power becomes immense, but the fall will be just as rapid.
notes: Tv movie inspired by the real story of Castellano.

title: Sokoote beine do fekr
actors: Maryam Moqadam, Kamalan Narouli, Moazen
description: A young woman is pardoned as a virgin (according to religious precepts she would end up in heaven). A local spiritual leader wants the execution to be carried out: for this he accompanies the woman to the executioner who must marry her and then kill her.
notes: Babak Payami, after _The vote is secret_, continues the critical investigative work on Iranian society. That film of hers was a kind of paradoxical comedy about the unlikely development of democracy and women's emancipation in a theocracy. This _The silence between two thoughts_, blocked by the censors and carried out with difficulty, returns to the theme of the condition of women almost in the form of an apologue, in a situation dominated by a gloomy religiosity.

title: Ballo a tre passi
actors: Yaël Abecassis, Caroline Ducey, Michele Carboni, Daniele Casula, Giampaolo Loddo
description: In the summer Michele leads his flock to the mountains and only occasionally goes down to the valley to bring Massimo, the manager of a bar near a beach, some of his cheese. When autumn arrives, at the home of Ziu Predu (who shares the sheepfold in the mountains with Michele) preparations are underway for the wedding of Simona, a niece. Many people arrive for the party: Francesca, the daughter Ziu Predu hasn't seen for years because she is a Carmelite nun, Giorgio, Palla ...
notes: The first three episodes are beautiful (and even the first is beautiful, with a realism that becomes effortless poetry); gradually, however, the film loses altitude and then gets bogged down in an insistent "poetic" ending, a la Fellini, which leaves a bad taste in the mouth. Sin. But Ballo a tre passi is still a strong and important attempt on today's Italian scene. He has flesh and blood, he knows how to look for things to look at and dares, even at the cost of making mistakes. The film won Critics' Week in Venice.

title: Barravento
actors: Antonio 'Pitanga' Sampaio, Aldo Teixeira, Luiza Maranhão, Lucy Carvalho, Lidio Silva
description: Returning to his country of origin, Firmino tries to make Bahian fishermen - exploited by a master come from the city - understand the reasons for their misery, but he clashes with superstition and ignorance. However, it will be Aruã, the village chief initially hostile to Firmino, who becomes aware of the situation ...
notes: Rocha's first film.

title: Out for a Kill
actors: Steven Seagal, Michelle Goh, Corey Johnson, Kata Dobó, Kevin Dunn
description: Archaeologist Robert Burns is sent to China to direct major excavations. Here he finds himself involved, in spite of himself, in a grandiose drug trade. The Chinese mafia in fact uses the finds to hide huge quantities of drugs and thus cross the border without arousing suspicion. Burns tries to report the trafficking, but his assistant is killed and he is charged with the murder. When Robert kills his wife, the situation becomes terribly complicated.
notes: Time also passes for Steven Seagal who in the action scenes has been replaced by a double. For the rest, nothing new under the sun.

title: Corps à corps
actors: Emmanuelle Seigner, Philippe Torreton, Clément Brilland, Vittoria Scognamiglio, Yolande Moreau
description: Marseille: between the stripper Laura and Marco, a loner who frequents the night club in which she performs, a total and passionate love blossoms. And even when a car accident forces Laura to a long hospital stay, Marco stays close to her constantly. Later the two moved to Lyon, in a splendid house surrounded by greenery where they live with their son Jeannot. Then, out of the blue, their relationship falls apart inexorably ...
notes: The deliberate rhetoric of domestic harmony crumbles into a spiral of horror, and the film becomes more and more enveloping. But the tension pays for some too many uncertainties.

title: They
actors: Laura Regan, Marc Blucas, Ethan Embry, Dagmara Dominczyk, Jon Abrahams
description: After witnessing a terrifying event as a child, Julia Land, a graduate in psychology, returns to be tormented by nightmares as around her the people who have lived the same experience mysteriously begin to disappear. Julia has to face the return of the monsters alone because neither her boyfriend nor her psychologist's help can help her.
notes: The film has the flaws of the target it is aimed at: sweetened, phoned, and with monsters that lack charm and mythical power, even if sometimes it jumps in the chair. The best part, however, is the last quarter of an hour, with an unexpected ending and ready-to-go sequel, and a long urban nightmare sequence: getting trapped in the subway after closing time. An example of how US cinema continues to anticipate small and large catastrophes (here, it is the New York blackout), almost on the edge of jinx.

title: Eight Crazy Nights
description: Davey is again in trouble with justice, but since it's almost Christmas and it's also the first day of the Jewish holiday of Hanukkah, the judge decides to give him a chance: if he wants to avoid ending up in prison, he'll have to be an assistant to the youth basketball referee during the holidays. Davey thinks it's child's play until he meets the eccentric referee Whitey. The two have profoundly different characters: Davey is an unrepentant daredevil, while Whitey is a good-hearted and optimistic man by nature ...
notes: Animated musical that gives ample space to Sandler's demented vein, transformed for the occasion into cartoon.

title: Miranda
actors: Christina Ricci, John Simm, Kyle MacLachlan, John Hurt, Cavan Clerkin
description: Librarian Frank begins a relationship with the mysterious Miranda. When the latter suddenly disappears, Frank leaves for London intent on finding her and discovers that the woman actually has three identities: dancer, dominatrix and scammer. But what is the real Miranda?
notes: The problem of the film arises precisely from this fascination, from this dark side that progressively loses consistency to transform itself into a harmless sentimental sweetness. Ricci is undecided whether to get carried away by her dark Burtonian side or by the somewhat heavy charm she wore in _The Opposite of Sex_, and the direction of the "television" Munden certainly does not help her.

title: The Lizzie McGuire Movie
actors: Hilary Duff, Adam Lamberg, Hallie Todd, Robert Carradine, Jake Thomas
description: After school, Lizzie and her friends Gordo, Kate and Ethan choose Italy as their summer vacation destination. In Rome, Lizzie makes the singer Paolo fall in love, who mistakes her for the irascible pop star Isabella who looks like her like a drop of water. The artist suggests that she do a duet, but in reality her goal is another.
notes: Disney product suitable for a teenage audience who does not have too many scruples about the verisimilitude of the story. Do not miss the final twenty minutes authentically trash filmed at the Colosseum. The protagonist Hilary Duff is an incredibly popular singer with a young audience.

title: Fallo!
actors: Raffaella Ponzo, Maruska Albertazzi, Virginia Barrett, Sarah Cosmi
description: Six episodes to tell the erotic imagination. In _alibi_ a young bride transforms the honeymoon to Casablanca into a curious Ménage à Trois; In _ _montracting_ the wife of a television manager repays the consort who betrays her with a "letter" seducing the girl's husband; In _2 hearts & 1 hut_ a sadomaso couple involves the waitress in his games; in _botte d'Alegria_ A wife betrays her husband excessively jealous ...
notes: The new product of the increasingly stinet Brass is of a fatal boredom, it is tasty as the messe of fakes exposed and shown, is cowardly because it does not dare to really break down the barriers and is involuntarily sincere only in the final frame, when the director himself appears in the Dark dressed as a voyeur, after yet another virtual ejaculation and after giving to understand that the object of his gaze (and therefore of his film) other not (is) ra that the foul: of the title, of the Veneto of the last chapter , of the other men called to the need. Finally (one) the truth.

title: The Road to Memphis
actors: B. B. King, Bobby Rush, Ike Turner, 'Little Milton' Campbell, Rosco Gordon
description: In the early 1950s, between the Mississippi Delta and the city of Memphis, a generation of musicians marked the transition from "rural" blues - played by workers in the cotton fields - to performances on club stages and in front of radio microphones. . Leading exponent of the "Memphis style" is the legendary B.B. King, who with his inseparable "Lucille" guitar has become an authentic icon of the American music scene.
notes: Pearce contributes to the series by alternating original performances (with interviews) by old B.B., Bobby Rush, Ike Turner and Rosco Gordon with valuable repertoire materials on Howlin 'Wolf and Rufus Thomas.

title: Godfathers and Sons
actors: Ike Turner, Pinetop Perkins, Otis Rush, Koko taylor, Magic Slim
description: A survey on the Chicago blues, on the influence of the Chess record company and on the lines that join the same blues and hip-hop: the "Blues Brothers 3000", or Marshall Chess - current owner of the historic brand - and Chuck D by Public Enemy (who explicitly cite the 1968 album _Electric Mud_ by Muddy Waters as fundamental to the development of their sound). The result will be a record capable of bringing together modernity and tradition.
notes: Interesting operation directed by Levin of _Slam_. Performances and interviews by some of today's "blues rockers" and archival materials on Bo Diddley, Howlin 'Wolf and the Paul Butterfield Blues Band.

title: From Mali to Mississippi
actors: Corey Harris, Taj Mahal, Othar Turner, Pat Thomas, Sam Carr, Dick Waterman
description: A journey from the banks of the Niger river, in Mali, to the cotton fields and the clubs with juke boxes of the Mississippi delta, on the traces of the origins of the blues through original interpretations (Ali Farka Touré, Salif Keita, Habib Koité, Taj Majal among the others) and rare archive images.
notes: Corey Harris is a blues guitarist of the third millennium: young, not "purist", also in love with rap, soul, perhaps even rock'n'roll, of all the forms that black music has acquired over time. Scorsese is a second millennium filmmaker: not because he is old or "ancient", but because he has the perception of memory and struggles to preserve it. In the world of blues, Scorsese is Dante and Harris is Virgil. Together they travel through Hell, Purgatory (rural South America, where Africans were deported as slaves and where they still live today, mostly in poverty) and Paradise: Africa, more precisely Mali, a very poor but culturally extraordinary sub-Saharan country. (Souleymane Cissé, the greatest living African director comes from there). There they find the roots of the blues, meeting musicians such as Salif Keita, Ali Farka Touré, Habib Koité. The documentary is beautiful: not "poetic" like _The soul of a man_ by Wim Wenders, but dry, objective, nobly didactic. In Scorsese's filmography it ranks alongside _Ultimo valzer_: two frescoes on music, culture, memory.

title: Piano Blues
actors: Ray Charles, Little Richard, Dr. John, Pinetop Perkins
description: The passion of a lifetime for the blues piano: it is that of Clint Eastwood also interpreter of a documentary that uses a real treasure composed of documents of historical importance and interviews with some living legends of the Blues including Ray Charles, Little Richard and Dr John.

title: Red, White and Blues
actors: Tom Jones, Jeff Beck, Van Morrison, John Porter, Chris Barber, Eric Clapton
description: In the 1960s, the UK was the site of a passionate social revolution: musicians from Belfast and Glasgow came to London to be part of the capital's club scene. This is the breeding ground for a new kind of blues, influenced by the black blues of the USA but personalized. Interviews with the protagonists of the blues scenario alternate with the interpretations of Tom Jones, Jeff Beck, Van Morrison who improvise some classics.

title: Holes
actors: Shia LaBeouf, Shia LaBeouf, Sigourney Weaver, Jon Voight, Tim Blake Nelson, Khleo Thomas
description: Stanley Yelnats IV, haunted by an ancient curse that has befallen his entire family, is unjustly accused of stealing a pair of sneakers. The unfortunate individual is doomed to make a choice: go to jail or serve his sentence at Green Lake Camp. Obviously he chooses the second option and, once he arrives on the spot with other companions in misfortune, he is forced by the Guardian and her assistants to dig holes in the desert to search for treasure.
notes: Pleasant film that combines western-style adventure with classic comedy for kids.

title: Alla fine della notte
actors: Ennio Fantastichini, Elena Sofia Ricci, Ida Di Benedetto, Ricky Tognazzi
description: A brilliant actor and film director finds himself on the verge of depression. Abandoned by the analyst, he decides to undertake a solitary journey in search of the thread that holds his life together. He goes to visit friends in Tuscany, meets with uninhibited girls, escapes the fans, writes a script about his childhood in Campania, relives it in flashbacks, goes to Sorrento to find an old gay actor with whom he had worked in the early days.
notes: Fantastichini often manages to keep up with an implausible and over-the-top role; Piscicelli's direction often has its own harshness that may make it preferable to many of his colleagues. But the nonsense of the assumption, the mold and the kitsch of the themes are unforgivable.

title: The Sleeping Dictionary
actors: Jessica Alba, Hugh Dancy, Brenda Blethyn, Bob Hoskins, Christopher Ling Lee Ian
description: 1930, Sarawak, Borneo. John, a young British officer, meets Selima who, according to local tradition, has the task of teaching the newcomer the local language and traditions. The girl becomes a kind of love dictionary to be consulted in intimacy. Through her John, in addition to a new language, discovers what he did not know he was looking for: love.
notes: The film is a good witness to the prospect of cultural hybridization and the romantic and tumultuous love story between Selima and her John, who will have to make a painful choice of field. The magic of the places and a well-calibrated cast make this film a good example of absolutely enjoyable cinema.

title: Rain
actors: Melora Walters, Kris Park, Jo Anderson, Diane Ladd, Jamey Sheridan
description: Iowa: Ellen kills her husband Paul - whom she finds in bed with Patsy, the sheriff's dissatisfied wife - and floods the house with blood. By the way, Ellen has an affair with a much younger boy than her, whose father she had been mistress a few years earlier ...
notes: The rural tragedy written and directed by Lindberg is produced by Scorsese, but the fates of the characters are immersed in a landscape that evokes in a minor the Malick of _The young anger_ or even certain Lynchian atmospheres. The actors (among which _Magnolia_'s Melora Walters stands out) are effective, even if they do not have the decisive charisma. Houses burn, rain purifies, sins are expiated.

title: Assassini dei giorni di festa
actors: Sara D'Amario, Carmen Maura, Agnese Nano, Domenico Fortunato
description: Buenos Aires, 1952. During the wake of a comedian's wake, a theater company has an idea: the actors decide to play the roles of the relatives of the deceased in real life and no longer in the theater. One day during a vigil, they discover that the dead man had no relatives or friends who could inherit his fortunes. A golden opportunity presents itself for the company ...
notes: The film based on the book by the Argentine Marco Daveni (published in Italy by Sellerio) and directed by Damiano Damiani has the rhythms of the pochade without rhythm. An operation whose meaning, frankly, escapes us.

title: Betty Fisher et autres histoires
actors: Sandrine Kiberlain, Nicole Garcia, Mathilde Seigner, Luck Mervil
description: A mother attacks her little daughter Betty with a pair of scissors and injures her. Years pass and that little girl has become a single mother, best-selling author. The detestable mother, Margot, comes to visit from Malaga ...
notes: Claude Miller's film, based on the novel by Ruth Rendell, while not freeing itself from the dramatic web, opens the text to other sensations and tensions. The staging reveals its nature as a social and psychological mosaic: it is a story with Kieslowkian reflections on ineffectiveness, on chance, on disturbed relationships between parents and children, on mental abuse, on motherhood (found or useless).

title: Confidence
actors: Edward Burns, Rachel Weisz, Morris Chestnut, Leland Orser, Louis Lombardi, Paul Giamatti, Dustin Hoffman
description: Jake Vig is a skilled scammer who one day cheats, without knowing it, the accountant of a mafia boss. To compensate him without unleashing his anger, Jake and his gang organize a sensational scam. But not everything seems to be going well ...
notes: the sympathy of the actors is a chimera, the structure is rigid, the twists are standard, the verve is opaque. The dialogues are chatter, which does not envelop or, let alone, affect. And they remain, in fact, chatter. Foley, who also did some good things (_A close range_, _The Corruptor_), continues to be a postponed promise.

title: Love & Sex
actors: Famke Janssen, Jon Favreau, Noah Emmerich, Ann Magnuson
description: Kate Welles, a frustrated journalist for a women's magazine, has twenty-four hours to write a romantic love story. The best idea is to rummage through her past but regret for the right man, let slip when she was too inexperienced to recognize him, is already around the corner.
notes: Written and directed by Valerie Breiman, an actress who moved to directing, it is a comedy presented at Sundance. Despite the skills of the actors and some more successful scenes, the feeling is that of seeing a film with few ideas, most of which have already been seen at least a hundred times.

title: Star Wars
actors: Mark Hamill, Harrison Ford, Carrie Fisher, Peter Cushing, Alec Guinness
description: The despotic Lord Darth Vader has waged war on a galactic empire. Princess Leia Organa, representative of the rebels, is his prisoner but she has managed to steal the plans of the Death Star, Lord Vader's space base that can disintegrate an entire planet. Elder General Obi-Wan Kenobi and young Luke Skywalker free Princess Leia and then lead the attack on the Death Star.
notes: An adventure that skillfully mixes the flavors of the western, myths of chivalry and horror. Great means, a lot of imagination and technological prodigies for a realization that has left a mark in American cinema, reworking myths and fantasies from the inside, and paving the way for the cinema of the following decades, Oscar for the soundtrack (very famous, by John Williams) , the scenography, the costumes, the editing, the sound and of course the special effects. Followed by _The Empire Strikes Again_ (1980) and _The Return of the Jedi_ (1983), produced by Lucas and directed by Irvin Kershner and Richard Marquand respectively. In 1999 "Star Wars - The Phantom Menace" finally arrived, the first episode of a trilogy that tells the preamble of the 1977 film. _Una new hope_ is the remastered and restored version of _Star Wars_, released twenty years later together with two successive episodes. Great success with the public but also some criticism from fans, who in the few minutes added did not like the "softening" of Lucas.

title: Superfire
actors: D.B. Sweeney, Gedeon Burkhard, Jay Bunyan, Chad Donella
description: Two devastating wildfires are gripping the town of Portland, Oregon. James Merrick is a CanadAir pilot who volunteered to help rescue and try to stop the two fronts that advance inexorably.
notes: An Emmy nomination (Visual Effects) for an ABC miniseries that comes to us like a movie for almost two and a half hours. The only protagonist, the fire, seen through the eyes of which it must sprinkle it, of those who are surrounded by it and of those who merely observe it (or set it on). In the cast, also Wes Studi.

title: The Jayhawkers!
actors: Jeff Chandler, Nicole Maurey, Henry Silva, Fess Parker, Herbert Rudley
description: Civil War. The escaped Cam driven by the desire for revenge (the Northerners killed his wife), accepts the task of hunting down an outlaw responsible for the murder. But Cam, oblivious to his intentions, joins his gang that intends to take over Kansas.
notes: Interesting western.

title: Rebeldes en Canadá
actors: George Martin, Pamela Tudor, Luis Marin, Diana Lorys, Franco Fantasia, Giulia Rubini, Rafael Hernández, Mirko Ellis, Raf Baldassarre
description: The Hudson's mestizos, exasperated by the surprised British colonizers, rebel. The insurgents capture Ann, Sullivan's daughter, a hostile industrialist towards them. When Ann realizes what a rascal her father is, she allies herself with a revolutionary she has fallen in love with.
notes: Modest co-production.

title: Dancing at the Blue Iguana
actors: Charlotte Ayanna, Daryl Hannah, Sheila Kelley, Elias Koteas, Jennifer Tilly
description: Five women with different characters and aspirations: Stormy is melancholy and haughty, Jasmine writes poetry, Angel wants a baby, Jessie, recently arrived in Los Angeles, is a vulnerable teenager, Jo is pregnant. Apparently they don't have much in common other than the fact that they all perform as dancers and strippers at the Blue Iguana.

title: Blue Car
actors: David Strathairn, Agnes Bruckner, Margaret Colin, Frances Fisher, A.J. Buckley, Regan Arnold
description: Eighteen-year-old Meg has a bad relationship with her mother and has been living badly since her father left the family by driving away in a blue car. Her poetry teacher, Professor Auster, helps her to overcome the crisis and to highlight her qualities, so much so that the girl wins a poetry competition and establishes herself among the finalists in all of Florida. While she is preparing for the final at home things are going badly: the tension, suddenly increased, forces her to take refuge from Professor Auster. A relationship is born between the two that goes beyond friendship.
notes: The feature debut by television actress Karen Moncrieff is quite convincing.

title: The Velvet Underground and Nico
actors: Lou Reed, Sterling Morrison, John Cale, Maureen Tucker, Nico
description: The Velvet Underground and Nico performed in concert in 1966 directed by Andy Warhol, who had already promoted the collaboration (Nico is the German singer Christa Paffgen, former star of _The Chelsea Girls_). The result is a work in pure Factory style, characterized by "dirty" images and long sequence shots.

title: Gimme Shelter
actors: Rolling Stones, Jefferson Airplane, Ike Turner, Tina Turner, Melvin Belli
description: According to legend, the era of the "flower children" and pacifist beat began with Woodstock and ended with Altamont. During the first rock megaraduno we listened to Jimi Hendrix and made love in the mud; during the Rolling Stones concert in the Californian racetrack, on the other hand, the Hell's Angels (order service !!) fatally wounded a spectator and beat people with billiard cues. Chronicle of a tragic event relived through the dismayed eyes of the Stones themselves. A rare and truly dramatic document, which shows the dark side of a now mythical generational shift.

title: Cold Heart
actors: Nastassja Kinski, Jeff Fahey, Josh Holloway, Hudson Leick
description: Linda cannot ask for anything else from life: she has a company that sails in excellent waters and a psychiatrist husband; Phil, with whom she is very much in love. When the latter decides to hire one of his patients, Sean, as a collaborator, Linda goes into crisis. She is attracted to that man and one night she gives in to temptation. In the morning, in the grip of guilt, he decides to end the relationship immediately, but Sean disagrees at all ...
notes: All already seen and reviewed, the question remains as to why Nastassja KInski continues to embark on similar productions Not to be confused with Noyce's Power Games.

title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
actors: Johnny Depp, Geoffrey Rush, Orlando Bloom, Keira Knightley, Jack Davenport, Jonathan Pryce, Zoë Saldana, Kevin McNally, Lee Arenberg, Mackenzie Crook, Treva Etienne, David Bailie, Martin Klebba, Trevor Goddard, Isaac C. Singleton Jr., Brye Cooper
description: 17th century. The pirate Barbossa raids and plunders the city of Port Royal and kidnaps the beautiful Elizabeth, daughter of the governor. Will Turner, a childhood friend of the girl, comes to her aid, who joins forces with the wandering pirate Jack Sparrow to save her from whom Barbossa stole the ship, the Black Pearl. On board the fastest ship in the British fleet, the HMS Interceptor, the two set out on the trail of the fearsome pirate and discover that he and his crew are victims of a curse. They are doomed to live as the undead and turn into skeletons on full moon nights ...
notes: The Curse of the First Moon is Depp's masterpiece as an actor: he is the reason for success, he is the destabilizer. He imitates Keith Richards and looks like a drag queen. His annoying and perennial drunkenness is narratively justified by his abandonment on a desert island, under the sun that made him mad, but Depp, in interviews, confessed to having thought of different reasons. For example, endless nights of sex with that mulatto piratess, washed down with liters of rum or the precursor of the other Jack, Daniel's. Debauched and amoral rockstar, anarchic and harassing privateer: Sparrow / Depp is the character you never expected in a Disney movie. This is why it is an important precedent, as well as a sublime one. And it happens to be banned.

title: Murder in the Mirror
actors: Jane Seymour, James Farentino, Robert Desiderio, Hayley DuMond
description: Paul Richaland dies in mysterious circumstances. The police, led in the investigation by detective Russo, suspect the victim's young wife, Mary, who, however, pleads innocent. Digging into the man's past in search of evidence that clears her, Mary discovers that what she considered to be a faithful and wealthy husband was actually a man with a double life. The first news was that he wasn't an orphan at all, the second that his business was falling apart. The third, and much more shocking, who had been dating for some time a young prostitute with a surprising resemblance to her. What is the key to solving the case?

title: Killer Bees!
actors: C. Thomas Howell, Fiona Loewi, Emily Tennant, Michael Eklund
description: A peasant community in the American province releases a certain number of bees every year for the purpose of pollinating crops. This time, however, the swarm is transformed suddenly (and just as mysteriously), assuming a collective will that pushes it to mercilessly kill the inhabitants of the area. An enterprising sheriff, Lyndon Hobbs, who happens to be suffering from apiphobia for some time, tries to oppose their unstoppable advance ...
notes: One of the worst television movies produced in Canada in recent years. Hilarious special effects to create the murderous swarm.

title: The Jack Bull
actors: L. Q. Jones, John Cusack, John Goodman, John Savage, Miranda Otto
description: Myril, a horse breeder tired of the harassment of the owner of a nearby ranch, asks the law to do justice by condemning the violence. It will not be successful and will therefore choose to close the account personally.
notes: Beautiful film for television produced by Hbo: screenwriter Dick Cusack (John's father) and director John Badham overturn the myth of the western, presenting us a gray world (also in photography), with a fragile and just hero, but called to accountable for all his actions. A western of this level hadn't been seen for some time, even in theaters.

title: Cruel Intentions 2
actors: Robin Dunne, Sarah Thompson, Keri Lynn Pratt, Amy Adams
description: Sebastian and Kathryn are half siblings and have always led a comfortable life. Rich, spoiled, enrolled in one of New York's most exclusive schools, they only have one problem: boredom. So they decide to use their cunning to manipulate those around them.
notes: If _Cruel Intentions_ had any cards to play (especially in the cast), this television sequel just wants to ride the wave of success, copying the original idea without adding anything new. Even Roger Kumble, former director of the first episode, does not seem to believe it very much. Maybe he was already thinking about _The sweetest thing ..._

title: Persona non grata
description: After _Commander_'s Fidel Castro, Oliver Stone tries to meet Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat at his Ramallah headquarters. Nothing to do, and so the director "falls back" on the conflict that surrounds those who should stop him uncontrolled: he interviews three former Israeli prime ministers (Shimon Peres, Benjamin Netanyahu and Ehud Barak) and, in the opposite field, a representative of the fundamentalist movement Hamas and some masked terrorists. In the end Arafat grants him an audience, but the interview lasts only a moment ...
notes: A naked look, without comments, to tell what can no longer be described in words.

title: Cabin Fever
actors: Jordan Ladd, Rider Strong, James DeBello, Cerina Vincent, Joey Kern
description: Five friends go on vacation together in a remote mountain cabin. One of them contracts a mysterious disease that literally devours him: the others soon get sick too, and little by little the true personality of each one emerges ...
notes: If the first part passes without almost anything happening, in the midst of a sea of ??often silly chatter, the second is an orgy of flowing blood and of flesh that is undone, politically incorrect, between infections, viruses and nudity. It may seem strange, but despite being an anarchy that has already had the opportunity to express itself thirty years earlier, it has not lost an ounce of its explosive capacity. And luckily, Roth also knows that a little irony never hurts. The look of the executive producer David Lynch (who has a person of "his" staff among the credits: Angelo Badalamenti to the music) is very explicit: for example in the disturbing figure on the veranda and in the character of the policeman, treated as if they were splinters from his works . Cinema that does not pretend to say anything about contemporaneity: only a "product", but of a good category.

title: Empire Strike Back
actors: Harrison Ford, Mark Hamill, Carrie Fisher, Billy Dee Williams
description: Despite the destruction of the planet of the Death Star, the imperial troops have taken over Yavin again. The rebels have taken refuge on the ice planet, but are still forced to flee. Han Solo leaves the pursuers, while Luke travels to the planet of Dogabah to find the "Force". In an attempt to free Leila and friends, she later meets Darth Vader, who turns out to be her father.
notes: Re-edition for the twentieth anniversary of the trilogy: digitally remastered audio and video but very few unreleased sequences that do not touch the narrative development but improve the special effects of the time.

title: Return of Jedi
actors: Harrison Ford, Mark Hamill, Carrie Fisher, Billy Dee Williams
description: Luke Skywalker and Ian Solo are preparing for the final battle against the Empire but Luke has learned that the terrible Darth Vader, the greatest enemy of the rioters, is in fact his father. The insurrection is unsuccessful and Luke is captured by the emperor's troops, who tries to bring the young man to his side.
notes: Third (or rather sixth) and last episode of the saga conceived by George Lucas. For the twentieth anniversary, the entire trilogy has been restored and digitally remastered with the addition of unreleased sequences. In this case, a fun ballet in the palace of Jabba the Hut, new images of the "creature" of the sand and a finale full of scenes of the celebrations for the victory over the Empire.

title: Armstrong
actors: Frank Zagarino, Kimberley Kates, Charles Napier, Joe Lara, Justin Carroll
description: On vacation in Moscow with his friend Bob and his wife Susan, the former "Navy Seal" Rod Armstrong discovers that the two work for the American secret services and that they are in the Russian capital to clear up a trafficking in stolen atomic weapons , intended for terrorist groups. And when Bob is killed ...
notes: Any comment would be superfluous.

title: Cutaway
actors: Stephen Baldwin, Tom Berenger, Dennis Rodman, Maxine Bahns
description: Victor, an elite police officer, carries out undercover missions to bring drug traffickers to justice. The precious merchandise arrives in Florida from the Bahamas thanks to a gang of "sky surfers". They parachute down on Miami carrying illegal substances. Victor infiltrates them.

title: Le giraffe
actors: Sabrina Ferilli, Veronica Pivetti, Alessandro Di Carlo, Paola Tiziana Cruciani
description: Roberta and Michela Tiberi - the first from Rome, the second from Milan - almost accidentally discover that they are sisters, daughters of the same father (recently deceased, at whose bedside they meet) and of different mothers. Michela is going through a difficult time from a financial point of view, and for her the hospitality offered by Roberta is a breath of fresh air. The relationship between the two will not be easy, and surprises - especially in the finale - will not be lacking ...
notes: Bonivento (producer by profession) sets up the most predictable and "televised" of the plots, dusting off for the umpteenth time the Lazio-Lombardy contrast, with obvious annexes and connections.

title: Il figlio della sepolta viva
actors: Fred Robsham, Eva Czemerys, Pier Maria Rossi, Gabriella Lepori
description: France, 1700. The Duchess of Cambyses usurped the title after having the true nobleman buried alive and murdering her husband. A friar, a pilgrim, a court jester and the son of the buried alive, aware of the secret, are ready to unmask her.
notes: Ignoble mess from Carolina Invernizio.

title: The Virginian
actors: Bill Pullman, Diane Lane, John Savage, Colm Feore, Harris Yulin
description: A mysterious man known by the nickname "The Virginian" meets the teacher Molly, falls in love and plans a future life with her. The man looking for a job finds him at the Shiloh ranch where bullying reigns. His sense of justice will lead him to clash with unscrupulous individuals.

title: Quando le donne si chiamavano madonne
actors: Edwige Fenech, Vittorio Caprioli, Mario Carotenuto, Stefania Careddu
description: Three young people, Tazio, Gisippo and Ruberto, go to Prato to attend the trial for adultery celebrated against Madonna Giulia, Romildo's wife, surprised by her husband in the company of bold Marcuzio. While, having heard the defense of the woman, who has invoked Romildo's insufficient amatory ability in his defense, the magistrate Cecco decides to ascertain, in a public confrontation with Marcuzio, whether this is true, the three boys, took lodging in the house of Quinto Fulvio, Ruberto's uncle, do their utmost to conquer three beautiful young women: Peronella, daughter of Quinto Francesca, nephew of Fra Mariaccio Lucia, daughter of a priest. Tazio, with the complicity of a housekeeper, managed to lie down with Peronella, Ruberto is forced, in order to possess Francesca, to evade the surveillance of his uncle's friar by disguising himself as a pregnant woman, while Gisippo, also wearing feminine clothes, to overcome the mistrust di Lucia, who is afraid of men, manages to heal the girl from her fears. Full victory for them, therefore, and for Madonna Giulia, of which Don Cecco himself, after having acquitted her, ends up enjoying her favors.

title: Jeux interdits
actors: Brigitte Fossey, Georges Poujouly, Amédée, Laurence Badie
description: France, 1940: the war rages on and Paulette, a five-year-old orphan, becomes friends with eleven-year-old Michel, the youngest of four children in a peasant family. The two keep company and bury the dead animals together, even deciding to build a cemetery for this purpose. The grownups do not approve.
notes: From a novel by François Boyer, scripted by Jean Aurenche and Pierre Bost with Boyer and Clement, he takes the protagonist as a symbol of those who are victims of events and adults. Famous musical theme on guitar, by Narciso Yepes. Golden Lion at the 1952 Venice Exhibition.

title: Muhomatsu no issho
actors: Toshiro Mifune, Hideko Takamine, Hiroshi Akutagawa, Haruo Tanaka

title: Le passage du Rhin
actors: Charles Aznavour, Georges Rivière, Nicole Courcel, Cordula Trantow
description: In the spring of 1940 the French army was overwhelmed by the Wehrmacht; long lines of French prisoners are thus sent to the prison camps in Nazi Germany. On a bridge that crosses the Rhine, two Frenchmen meet by chance, very different in terms of conditions and ideas: Jean Durrieu, a brilliant journalist, convinced interventionist, and Roger Balland, a mild-mannered pastry chef with no particular ambitions. The two are sent to a farm and while Roger adapts quickly, fraternizing with the German peasants, Jean does nothing but think about escaping. In fact, one day Jean manages to escape, taking refuge in England to resume the fight. Roger, on the other hand, as time passes, finds himself better and better in the German village, where life becomes more and more difficult but where everyone is friends. He forms an affectionate relationship with Helga, a girl left alone, who sees in Roger the only support and help. After the war, life in Paris resumed a normal rhythm. Jean is back with his partner Florence and has become editor of his newspaper. But suddenly her situation becomes difficult: it turns out, in fact, that Florence was a collaborator of the Nazis. Jean resigns from the newspaper to stay close to her, but the woman leaves spontaneously, frightened by a life of poverty. Roger has also returned to Paris, but his wife shows him no affection. He then decides to return to the German village, to go and live with his friends from across the Rhine.

title: Rok spokojnego slonca
actors: Maja Komorowska, Scott Wilson, Hanna Skarzanka, Ewa Dalkowska

title: Fantaghirò 3
actors: Alessandra Martines, Kim Rossi Stuart, Brigitte Nielsen, Ursula Andress
description: The evil wizard Tarabas, who lives with his mother in his underground kingdom, learns of a prophecy: a newborn princess will be able to defeat him thanks to her innocence. Tarabas's fury is unleashed and he orders his army to kill all royal heirs under ten. When the children of Fantaghirò's sisters also become targets of the kidnappers, she and Romualdo protect them. Accidentally, during a fight, Romualdo falls into a cursed river and turns to stone. Fantaghirò then understands that he will have to find Tarabas if he wants to get his beloved Romualdo back.

title: Piglet's Big Movie
description: The pink piglet Piglet lives in the 100 Acre forest with many friends. Not invited to the "honey hunt" because considered too small, he decides to leave. Friends search for him, find his diary and read about his heroic deeds.
notes: Spin-off of _Winnie the Pooh_ with many songs and suitable for children.

title: Don't Look Back
actors: Bob Dylan, Joan Baez, Donovan, Albert Grossman, Bob Neuwirth, Alan Price
description: In the spring of 1965, 23-year-old Bob Dylan spent three weeks in England on tour. Glued to him, the lens of one of the greatest American documentary makers (specialized in shooting rock events) followed him everywhere, on stage and in private. Participants, among others, Joan Baez and Donovan.

title: Charulata
actors: Madhabi Mukherjee, Soumitra Chatterjee, Shailen Mukherjee
description: Married to Bhupati, editor of a Calcutta newspaper, Charulata is forced into her role as a frustrating and oppressive housewife. The visit of the brothers-in-law and the young cousin Amal seems to bring a breath of harmony and serenity, but ...
notes: Scripted by Ray from a book by Rabindranath Tagore, Nobel 1913 for literature.

title: Ray
description: Ghose, born in 1950, reconstructs with great accuracy and a wealth of documents the cultural and creative universe of Satyiajit Ray (1921-1992): a director - and not only: he was also a novelist, musician and painter - whose importance goes beyond borders patrii, to rightly place itself among the reference figures of the entire Seventh Art.

title: L'acqua... il fuoco
actors: Sabrina Ferilli, Olivier Pages, Valérie Kaprisky, Eloise Eonnet, Giancarlo Giannini
description: Turin: Stefania, separated, lives in a social housing in the suburbs, she is full of vitality and to keep herself beats the television scripts on the computer, until she decides to make a clean break with the past. Paris: Elena is saved by a tramp after she attempted suicide by jumping into the Seine; the two will spend a night together and start the new day with more hope. Luxembourg: Stella, a circus performer, tries to help her comrade David, completely drunk, to enter the scene, but he is not at all well ...
notes: In the face of ostentatious optimism, there is a lack of an authentic "cognition of pain" that would make the three parables more convincing and engaging.

title: Wadi Rushmia/Wadi 1991/Wadi Grand Canyon
description: Wadi Rushmia is a valley located between the Carmel Hills and Haifa Bay, where Jewish and Arab immigrants expelled from their respective countries lived side by side. Gitai returns there three times, over a span of 23 years, to demonstrate the progressive deterioration of the geography - physical and human - of a place that is symbolic in its own way.

title: La prima volta
actors: Alessia Fugardi, Micaela Ramazzotti, Max Malatesta, Francesca Chiarantano
description: A trip to the Rome subway is an opportunity for a group of young people to remember their first sexual experience. There is Elena, who yields to her boss's insistence without reacting; Federico, an introverted boy who lets himself be seduced by his brother's girlfriend; Norma, an orphan who lives in the suburbs and falls in love with a neighborhood bully who sells drugs for a living; Davide and Giovanna, boyfriends who have decided to go to bed together only after marriage: a choice that especially his father is unable to accept ...
notes: Second film for the director who had made his debut with the interesting _Il tuffo_

title: La muerte llama a las diez
actors: Gillian Hills, Ángel del Pozo, Bruno Corazzari, Orchidea De Santis
description: Coveted by her boss Ronald, but intending to remain faithful to her fiancé Michael, the young designer Darin Faster rents an attic in London. Michael, who is in Vietnam as a war correspondent, has not shown up for over four months; Suddenly, however, strange things happen to Darin: at first he thinks he catches a glimpse of Michael in the chaotic city traffic, then he hosts two men, both named John, the first of whom a corpse will be found on the asphalt. And the mysteries don't end there ...
notes: Needlessly complicated and confusing weaving, botched production, amateur acting - only for trash fans.

title: El otro lado de la cama
actors: Ernesto Alterio, Paz Vega, Guillermo Toledo, Natalia Verbeke, Alberto San Juan
description: Javier and Sonia have been together for a long time and live a seemingly perfect life. On the contrary, their friends Pedro and Paula are facing a painful separation. To overcome the difficult moment, Pedro asks Sonia for comfort: he does not yet know that the new boyfriend of his ex is Javier ...
notes: Typical perfect Latin comedy, with its good dose of lust not too destabilizing (but Paz Vega is really a bomb), the trendy soundtrack and a couple game that - despite the twisting of the plot - in the end you expect it a bit . Pleasant, however, and perhaps that is enough. Resounding commercial success in Spain (over three million spectators).

title: Ringu 0: Bâsudei
actors: Yukie Nakama, Takeshi Wakamatsu, Yoshiko Tanaka, Ryûji Mizukami
description: Before becoming an avenging specter, what was Sadako like? A college girl, passionate about acting, yet very talented. Her classmates are jealous of her, and someone on campus begins to mysteriously die. Meanwhile, a journalist investigates the figure of Sadako's mother, and the coincidences surrounding the crimes.
notes: The _Ring_ and _Ring 2_ prequel is an unnecessary and boring horror movie. The authors did not realize that by dint of dissecting the character of Sadako, elsewhere pure cursed spirit, they irreparably defused his morbid charm.

title: Terminator 3: Rise of the Machines
actors: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Nick Stahl, Claire Danes, Kristanna Loken, David Andrews, Mark Famiglietti
description: John Connor is twenty-two and lives undercover. But Skynet does not give up and sends back in time T-X, the most sophisticated cyborg killer that exists: it is a lethal machine, as ruthless as it is beautiful in its human form, infinitely more destructive than the Terminators that preceded it. Just three hours to the day of Judgment, and Connor realizes that the only hope of survival lies with the cyborg Terminator, his former enemy who now appears obsolete ...
notes: The ending is interesting: the idea of ??linking "that" future to the Kennedy past of a "new frontier" that leads straight to a nuclear shelter has something of genius. For the rest, business as usual. Schwarzenegger "good" already annoyed in episode 2, which - despite everything - was still inferior to the first. Since the basic plot is always the same (the machines of the future are still trying to kill John Connor), the authors have seen fit to vary the addends, aware that if the result does not change it is better. So the bad guy on duty (that is the cybernetic messenger of death) has been transformed into a bad guy, and to anchor it in the genre's current affairs it was called "Terminatrix" (also called, by friends, TX), a hybrid of flesh and metal between _Matrix_ and the world of James Cameron. To her we owe the tastiest moments: for example the idea of ??attaching her to a magnet. Always pleasant the work of Stan Winston, one of the most creative "make-up artists" in Hollywood.

title: Cattive inclinazioni
actors: Eva Robin's, Mirca Viola, Elisabetta Cavallotti, Franco Nero, Florinda Bolkan
description: A ruthless serial killer kills women with an unusual weapon: a metal drawing squad. The victims all live in the same building where the magistrate in charge of the investigation also resides. Everything suggests that the same killer lives here. A television program emphasizes the case out of all proportion by generating dangerous episodes of emulation.
notes: The whole film is shot in a television style of such boredom and flatness that it can only be enjoyed in fragments. The only two true mysteries of the film are: 1) why did Italian Columbia distribute it? 2) Who is the most redone in the greedy parterre of actresses and starlets? The quote before the credits is from Paul Valéry, for those who know how to appreciate.

title: Just Married Just Married
actors: Ashton Kutcher, Brittany Murphy, Christian Kane, David Moscow, Monet Mazur
description: Tom Leezak is a radio announcer who gives traffic news, Sarah McNerney is a writer with a very rich and very snobbish family behind her. They know each other and fall in love, even if her parents and sisters do not willingly accept the relationship. When Tom and Sarah get married and leave for their honeymoon in Europe, the McNerneys send her ex-boyfriend on a mission to ruin the young couple's vacation ...
notes: Dozens of revolting films like this one by Levy come out every year. What is astonishing, grieving and worrying, however, is that such a trifle in the United States has grossed billions.

title: L'apetta Giulia e la signora Vita
description: A small worker bee would like to lead a life different from the one for which it is destined, made of monotonous and stressful work in a honey factory. To change things, she is willing to fight: she goes to the queen bee and claims the right to have a proper name that she herself has chosen, Giulia. To please her, the queen bee begins to tell her a fairy tale about human beings every evening, from birth to old age. The protagonists are called Simone and Sarah.
notes: Compared to its overseas peers, what penalizes the film is not so much the lower quality of the animation, but a certain narrative rigidity that limits the possibility of being fully enjoyed by a transversal audience, in which everyone finds personal keys. reading, which are not designed exclusively for children.

title: Per sempre
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Francesca Neri, Emilio Solfrizzi, Alberto Di Stasio, Elisabetta Pellini
description: Giovanni, a charming criminal lawyer, leads a life full of professional successes and extramarital escapades. When he meets Sara, a beautiful and unscrupulous woman who enjoys conquering men and then leaving them, Giovanni loses his head and leaves his family, but fearing a stable bond, Sara leaves him. The man is destroyed: he is hospitalized in a specialized clinic, but he no longer has any interest in life. The psychologist who is treating him decides to track down Sara.
notes: Strange film, this _For always_, which swerves and recovers, bores and amazes. A non-trivial script by Maurizio Costanzo, which starts from the scratches of his soul (he has it too), from a sentimental drift sewn on a Giancarlo Giannini also in the throes of contradictory jolts, very good (for example) in the scene with his son on the bench and clumsy in some close-ups, and in the role of the ghost of love. Direction wasteful, undecided.

title: Idi i smotri
actors: Aleksej Kravchenko, Olga Mironova, Liubomiras Lauciavicius
description: Among the remote villages of Belarus fiercely occupied by the Nazis, the young Florya casually joins the partisan ranks. Unimaginable atrocities flow before his eyes, which will forever mark his perception ...
notes: The horror of mass extermination in a film of exceptional visionary force.

title: If...
actors: Malcolm McDowell, David Wood, Richard Warwick, Ronbert Swann, Arthur Lowe
description: In an English college where reactionary and militaristic teaching methods reign, three freshmen suffer the violence and repression of a system that does not tolerate any infringement of the rules. On graduation day, during the end-of-year ceremony, Mick, Wallace and Johnny stand on the roofs of the school and open fire on professors and classmates ...
notes: Anderson makes a film imbued with the libertarian moods of the English Free Cinema, a faithful mirror of the 1968 protest: anarchic and with a considerable dose of authentic anger. It may look a little aged today, but it still remains a great movie. Palme d'Or in Cannes.

title: Ticker
actors: Steven Seagal, Dennis Hopper, Tom Sizemore, Jaime Pressly
description: San Francisco: Detective Ray Nettles and his partner Art "Fuzzy" Rice have to contend with the dangerous terror gang led by Swan. After the arrest of the beautiful scientist Claire Manning, who is part of the gang, Swan demands her release and to obtain him threatens to the bitter end bomb attacks throughout the city. Nettles therefore turns to Frank Glass, expert in explosives ...
notes: Legitimately in the running for the coveted title of worst director in the world, Hawaiian Pyun earns points in the standings thanks to this literally unwatchable film, with Seagal surpassing himself in terms of woodiness and inexpressiveness.

title: Vulcano figlio di Giove
actors: Rod Flash, Bella Cortez, Gordon Mitchell, Roger Browne, Omero Gargano
description: The god Mars quarrels with Jupiter and with Venus he goes to Earth, where he prepares to climb Olympus. Jupiter sends Vulcan to fight the god of war, who asked for help from the Thracians for his designs. Vulcano meets a wave, Etna, who follows him in the enterprise.
notes: Mythological mess shot in Iran.

title: Tutto Totò - La scommessa
actors: Totò, Mario Castellani, Luisella Boni, Mario Pisu
description: The revival of an episode of the comic series with Totò and Mario Castellani, made for Rai by Bruno Corbucci and directed by Daniele D'Anza. Beyond the sketches presented, _Tutto Totò_ is one of those ancient productions that remind us how once it was possible to make intelligent television.

title: The Philadelphia Experiment
actors: Michael Paré, Nancy Allen, Eric Christmas, Bobby Di Cicco
description: 1943: Dr. Longstreet, a brilliant scientist, is carrying out an experiment on a warship, the purpose of which is to make allied units invisible to enemy radars. However, the test fails and the entire crew loses their lives: only the marines David Herdeg and Jim Parker are saved, who find themselves projected in 1984 in the middle of the Nevada desert ...
notes: The starting point is discreet, but neither the screenplay (which too many have handled) nor Raffill's direction are able to fully exploit it. In the credits, under "executive production", appears the name of John Carpenter, who was originally supposed to direct the film. A sequel in 1993.

title: Ringu 2
actors: Miki Nakatani, Hitomi Sato, Kenjiro Ishimaru
description: Mai is trying to understand how her boyfriend died, suspicious of the fact that everyone "accuses" the spirit of Sadako evoked by the vision of the deadly videotape. Meanwhile, Reiko has decided to hide her son Yoichi, who has developed the same Esp powers Sadako had as a child. Meanwhile, the curse continues to claim victims.
notes: After the great success of _Ring_, Hideo Nakata returns to the helm of this sequel made in respect of the suspense and horror of the model. But once Sadako's mystery is uncovered, the film loses its bite. Less than the first.

title: The Philadelphia Experiment 2
actors: Brad Johnson, Gerrit Graham, Marjean Holden, John Christian Graas
description: In 1943, the US Navy had attempted a disastrous experiment to make warships invisible to enemy radars: David Herdeg, the sole survivor of the catastrophe, had been thrown forward in time to 1984. Now a certain Dr. William Mailer - alias Friedrich Mahler - has hatched a similar and opposite plan, which provides that a Stealth bomber traverses the space-time continuum backwards to change the course of history and make the Nazis win. It will be up to Herdeg to intervene ...
notes: Nine years later, a sequel quite unrelated to the previous one, but even more lacking in direction, writing and special effects.

title: The Emperor's Club
actors: Kevin Kline, Emile Hirsch, Embeth Davidtz, Rob Morrow, Edward Herrmann
description: William Hundert is a professor convinced that his role is not only to educate the pupil, but also to shape his character. When Sedgewick Bell, the son of a West Virginia senator, arrives in the classroom, conflict with Professor Hundert's authority is inevitable. Extremely charismatic Bell breaks the rules and pushes his teammates to do the same. After a furious conversation with the boy's father, the teacher realizes that he must find a way to get close to him and win his trust.
notes: The film starts from Peter Weir's _The Fugitive Moment ‹," inspired "by the mediocre and obvious story _The Palace Thief_ by Ethan Canin

title: Berlin Alexanderplatz
actors: Günter Lamprecht, Hanna Schygulla, Barbara Sukowa, Gottfried John
description: Franz gets out of prison after four years. During the Weimar Germany crisis he forced his friend Ida to fight for him. Back free, he meets Lina, with whom he would like to live honestly.
notes: Fassbinder's extraordinary saga on contemporary Germany begins. Giordana, Rulli and Petraglia were inspired by it for _The best of youth_.

title: Ballistic: Ecks vs. Sever
actors: Antonio Banderas, Lucy Liu, Gregg Henry, Ray Park, Talisa Soto, Miguel Sandoval
description: A no holds barred fight between Sever, a precise and unstoppable agent in achieving a goal, and former FBI man-hunter Jeremiah Ecks called back to service for the most demanding mission of his career. Up for grabs is an ingenious device that allows you to commit murders: microscopic and injectable, it remains in the victim until activated, killing in an instant and disappearing without a trace. Only one of the two contenders can get hold of it.
notes: Ballistic is a very ugly film of explosions, smoke bombs, fake martial arts duels (the conditions would be ripe to abolish them for two or three seasons), of volleys of firearms that never hit the target: obviously , all specialists, in uniform and plain clothes, of action films are nearsighted or farsighted.

title: La societé du spectacle
description: Derived from the book of the same name, the best-known operation among the cinematographic encroachments of one of the most lucid and acute "cultural provocateurs" of the last twentieth century: oscillating between seriousness and parody, the accumulation and "détournement" of visual materials (clips of fictional film) tends to distort and overturn its original meaning.

title: Calendar Girls
actors: Helen Mirren, Julie Walters, Penelope Wilton, John Alderton, Linda Bassett, Annette Crosbie, Celia Imrie
description: After John's death from leukemia, his wife Annie and her closest friend Chris decide to propose to the local Women's Institute that they create a calendar whose proceeds will go to the hospital. Together with a group of friends, as uninhibited and as courageous as they are, they pose naked for twelve shots. The initiative is destined to have great success and to attract attention even overseas, completely overwhelming the lives of these unusual and improvised "calendar girls".
notes: The protagonists are - like the flowers loved and cultivated by the husband of one of them who will fall ill and die of cancer - in the most radiant age (closer to sixty than fifty) of their beauty. After a few hesitations they launch themselves with amusement, embarrassment, absolute self-irony, into the beneficial nude. In theaters, these adorable and witty third age girls have the faces of Helen Mirren, Julie Walters, Penelope Wilton and other high school actresses. Velvety film like a refreshing mid-afternoon tea.

title: High School
description: Third work by Wiseman, who would later be confirmed as a figure of absolute importance in non-fiction cinema. An x-ray of the value and ideological system on which the transmission of knowledge is based, conducted through informal interviews and interviews with teachers and students of a high school (the Northeast High).

title: Diario di un maestro
actors: Bruno Cirino, Massimo Bonini, Luciano Dal Croce
description: In 1972, Albino Bernardini had collected Don Milani's civil passion by publishing _Un anno a Pietralata_, a lucid chronicle of a "counter-current" didactic experience in the degraded Roman village of Tiburtino III. This "film-truth" produced by Rai, shot in 16mm by De Seta, is its rigorous and lucid adaptation.

title: Baby Geniuses
actors: Kathleen Turner, Peter MacNicol, Christopher Lloyd, Kim Cattrall, Dom DeLuise
description: Dr. Elena Kinder and Dr. Heep work for Baby Co., the most important company of objects and accessories for children in the world. In a secret laboratory of the company, however, some frugoletti are subjected to experiments on their learning and communication speed. Used as guinea pigs, the little ones find a "boss" willing to rebel: it is Sly, the "little genius", who manages to escape.
notes: Pleasant family comedy, starring the talented Kathleen Turner and directed by a whole do of genre cinema, Bob Clark. Originally designed for the home video market.

title: No Place to Hide
actors: Anthony Page, Vickie Lancaster, Sylvester Stallone, Dennis Tate
description: A group of young protesters decides to boycott a New York Stock Exchange agency after discovering that it collaborates with some fascist dictators in South America. The FBI, however, senses their ambitions and hunts them.
notes: Naive but honest film son of those post-sixty-eight times. For Stallone, one of the first important tests.

title: Se souvenir des belles choses
actors: Isabelle Carré, Bernard Campan, Bernard Lecoq, Anne Le Ny
description: The Les Ecureils clinic hosts various patients suffering from traumatic or psychological amnesia. A nice group of funny fools, cared for by nice doctors. Claire is there because she lost her memory after a lightning bolt; Philippe, on the other hand, after the accident in which his wife and son died, removed his past. Between them, with various hesitations, a real love story is born.
notes: The film immediately has a light and conciliatory atmosphere, and never changes tone, remaining below the evocative themes evoked (memory, oblivion, personal identity). A little dull, and a little too built and blunt (all entrusted to the dialogue, full of catchy accordions on the soundtrack) to really thrill.

title: Tutto Totò - Totò ciak
actors: Totò, Gordon Mitchell, Ubaldo Lay, Mario Castellani, Gianni Morandi
description: Totò is the protagonist of a series of parodies of western and espionage films that were very popular at the time. This television special was broadcast on June 8, 1967 in prime time and achieved considerable public success: as many as 13 million viewers remained glued to the television screens.

title: Il ragazzo che sapeva amare
actors: Antonio Marsina, Vittorio Congia, Didi Perego, Nadia Scarpitta
description: Roberto, waiter at the Europa Palace Hotel in Capri, falls in love with Francesca, a girl he met by chance and who is the goddaughter of the Countess De Cristoforis. She loves him too, but she rejects him because she promised another. Will the two lovers crowd their dream of love?
notes: Comediola without too many pretensions.

title: Peut-être
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Emmanuelle Devos, Romain Duris, Julie Depardieu
description: New Year 2000. Party in a house in Paris. Music, euphoria, sex ... Lucie asks and Arthur to make love in the hope of getting pregnant right at the stroke of midnight. Not only does this happen, but through a dimensional door, Arthur falls into the future, sixty years later, in front of his now elderly son ...
notes: Unreleased in Italy, Cédric Klapisch's film is a cult movie in France and launched the now famous actor Romain Duris. The most sci-fi and visionary part is beautiful (Paris submerged by the sand is a nice glance), while the intellectual côté is more unsolved ... Anyway to see.

title: The Rats
actors: Mädchen Amick, Vincent Spano, Shawn Michael Howard, Daveigh Chase
description: New York: Some people are hospitalized with a severe infection after being attacked and bitten by rats. Susan Costello, the manager of a department store in which one of these cases has occurred, requests the intervention of the expert rodent Jack Carver: in the meantime, however, the invasion is expanding out of all proportion ...

title: The Mummy's Hand
actors: Dick Foran, Peggy Moran, Wallace Ford, Eduardo Cianelli

title: Carmen
actors: Antonio Gades, Laura Del Sol, Paco de Lucía, Marisol, Cristina Hoyos
description: "Maitre de ballet" of great fame, Antonio, accompanied by his friend and musician Paco, believes he has discovered his future Carmen, the "flamenco" dancer destined to be the " étoile "of the homonymous, great ballet that Antonio wants to stage.
