The very young woman thus becomes part of Antonio's corps de ballet. Under the guidance of the most expert and talented Cristina, Carmen turns out to be a docile, patient and tenacious pupil. But Antonio, while he is genuinely passionate about his work as a creator, falls madly in love with his new dancer, being reciprocated. Between ballet rehearsals, individual lessons and an apparently intense and perfect understanding, some time passes, until Juan, Carmen's hitherto ignored husband, is released from prison. Although she no longer loves him, she no longer loves her teacher either. Juan would also be willing, for money, to disappear forever, but, during a close and dramatic dance for two, Antonio "kills" his rival out of jealousy. It is only a game and a symbolic representation and a challenge, but when the fatuous Carmen is surprised by Antonio with a member of the ballet in the costume warehouse, the dancer, furious and lucid, kills her.

title: The Mummy's Tomb
actors: Lon Chaney jr., Dick Foran, John Hubbard, Elyse Knox, George Zucco

title: Les corps impatients
actors: Laura Smet, Nicolas Duvauchelle, Marie Denarnaud, Catherine Salviat, Maurice Antoni, Julien Bouvard
description: Charlotte and Paul are two in their twenties who love each other passionately. Charlotte suddenly has to undergo a series of medical tests after which she is diagnosed with a very serious illness. He therefore has to face a long cure that tests his relationship especially as Ninon, his cousin, who Paul feels strongly attracted to, bursts into his life.
notes: Newcomer Xavier Giannoli perfectly introjected Maurice Pialat's cinema and the analysis of his À nos amours made in the documentary L'Oeil humain, shot before this remarkable debut feature in which sick flesh, imperious sex, emotions violent and fear demand clear and transparent shots. They move the unconscious as happens in the films of the directors admired by the young author: Bergman, Cassavetes, Renoir, Truffaut and Scorsese. The film and the three talented protagonists express, with harshness, abandonment, bewilderment and awareness of the roles, a contagious physical truth, a vital energy, a threesome passion conquered and lost as night falls.

title: Levity
actors: Billy Bob Thornton, Morgan Freeman, Holly Hunter, Kirsten Dunst, Manuel Aranguiz, Geoffrey Wigdor
description: Manuel Jordan served his sentence for killing Abner Easley, a shop boy. When he gets out of prison, he feels irresistibly drawn to the city where he committed the crime. Here he meets Miles, an enigmatic man, who offers him a job in a bad neighborhood and gets him a room. Meanwhile, Manuel approaches Adele, Abner's sister who has a son, and tries to help her.
notes: The cast of highly credentialed soloists, Morgan Freeman, Holly Hunter, Kirsten Dunst, is abandoned in borderline, very conventional character acting roles: the eccentric and ambiguous preacher, the sister of the murdered and mother of a difficult boy, the young girl from the easy high and with a played mother. Studio Canal pursues, without hesitation, its pathetic production concept of a different, alternative American cinema, to be ascribed to an unidentified "independent" trend.

title: Mio cognato
actors: Sergio Rubini, Luigi Lo Cascio, Mariangela Arcieri, Alessandra Sarno, Gigi Angelillo, Carolina Felline
description: Toni and Vito, two people at the antipodes, are brothers-in-law and struggle to bear each other. Toni, a small business owner of forty, is always very busy while Vito, who married Anna, Toni's sister, is an employee with a rather ordinary life. When at a family reunion, Vito is stolen from his new car, Toni rather reluctantly offers to accompany him in the search. Thus begins a journey that lasts all night during which the two will make many discoveries.
notes: Less effective is the unfriendly relationship of the protagonists, who seem to suffer more than Piva's indecisions, his curious unwillingness to sink the knife into the wound. Perhaps an avowedly grotesque streak would have helped more. Well done Lo Cascio (more) and Rubini.

title: Berlin Alexanderplatz
actors: Günter Lamprecht, Hanna Schygulla, Barbara Sukowa, Gottfried John

title: American Wedding
actors: Jason Biggs, Seann William Scott, Alyson Hannigan, Eddie Kaye Thomas, January Jones
description: Jim and Michelle are getting married and friends are preparing for the event. Steve Stifler immediately sets his sights on Cadence, the bride's attractive little sister, who has arrived to be the bridesmaid. Jim tries to keep him quiet because he wants to impress his future in-laws, Harold and Mary. Of course you can't miss a wild bachelor party ...
notes: A very rare case of a growing series, the third is the best episode: thoughtful script, good comic times in directing and acting, mocking and rampant malice. Everything ends in glory, but it's only the glossy surface, behind which the world has crumbled into a trashy mockery.

title: La maestra... di sci
actors: Carmen Russo, Cinzia De Ponti, Andy Luotto, Sonia Otero, Daniele Vargas
description: The usual uncle of America dies, and his fabulous inheritance should in theory go to his niece Celia, a model by profession. The condition is that prof. Thompson ascertains that the girl's conduct is morally flawless, and seeing that Celia is - let's say - a little lively, her friend Carla thinks well of making her change jobs and finding her a job as a ski teacher at an alpine hotel. The idea works until the paparazzo Franco discovers Celia's real identity, and in order not to reveal the truth, he requires a sexy photo shoot as a counterpart ...
notes: Russo & Luotto: an Oscar-winning couple ...

title: The Baltimore Bullet
actors: James Coburn, Omar Sharif, Bruce Boxleitner, Ronee Blakley
description: Nick Casey, aka "Baltimore Bullet", is an aging snooker pro who has seen better days and is now touring the country with his young protege Billie Joe Robbins, to whom he has taught everything he knows. One day, when he learns that his colleague Joe Denton is out of jail, Nick asks him for a rematch for a previous defeat and Joe grants it to him, as long as he can get the same sum as the first time: a good 20,000 dollars ...
notes: Not original (shot before _Il colore dei soldi_, the Scorsesian remake of the famous _Lo braggart_) but discreet. Some real aces of the "pool billiard" appear in minor roles.

title: Purgatory
actors: Eric Roberts, Sam Shepard, Randy Quaid, Peter Stormare, Brad Rowe
description: A gang of thugs, led by Jack Britton, known as Blackjack, invades the isolated and mysterious town of Refuge, where it receives a peaceful welcome. But who are the apparently placid and peaceful inhabitants of the village, and what is their mission? Britton and his family soon discover that Refuge is the door to purgatory ...
notes: It's been a long time since Uli Edel made his big screen debut with _Christiana F. - We the boys of the Berlin zoo_. Looking at this paranormal western it seems that time has done more damage to the director than anything else. Screenplay by Gordon T. Dawson (_I want Garcia's head_).

title: A Bright Shining Lie
actors: Bill Paxton, Amy Madigan, Vivian Wu, Eric Bogosian, Donal Logue, Kurtwood Smith, Robert John Burke, Ed Lautner, Harve Presnell, James Rebhorn
description: The true story of Lieutenant Colonel John Paul Vann and his ten-year stay (1962-1972) in Vietnam, during which he repeatedly handed over to his superiors "lying" reports (i.e. modified to please the upper echelons of the army) concerning, among the other, the number of casualties and the progress of war actions. All proved and proved by the investigations undertaken by the journalist Steven Burnett. Even in his private life, Vann does not deviate from this scabrous course of action: he has an affair with a Vietnamese teacher, and it is only thanks to his wife's false testimony that he manages to avoid court martial for his sexual encounters with a minor.

title: Return of the Frontiersman
actors: Gordon MacRae, Julie London, Rory Calhoun, Jack Holt, Fred Clark
description: Logan Barrett is the son of Sam, the village sheriff. Set up by the "bad" Larrabee for a series of robberies, he escapes and is chased by a patrol assembled by his own father. It will be the young Janie to help him ...

title: SubUrbia
actors: Giovanni Ribisi, Amie Carey, Jayce Bartok, Nicky Katt, Steve Zahn, Dina Spybey

title: Warning Shot
actors: David Janssen, Ed Begley Sr., Keenan Wynn, Sam Wanamaker, Lillian Gish
description: During a stakeout, Sergeant Tom Valens, a special agent of the police, spots an individual who sneaks off, chases him and orders him to stop. However, he draws a gun and points it at him: in the inevitable firefight Valens kills the antagonist, but is framed and charged because the victim's weapon is not found; which, moreover, is identified for Dr. James Rustin, an esteemed physicist of international fame. Valens will have to work hard not to go to jail ...
notes: The protagonist of the TV series _Il fugitive_ mentions himself. Readers poll: who remembers him in the show _Harry O_?

title: Le dernier combat
actors: Pierre Jolivet, Fritz Wepper, Jean Bouise, Jean Reno, Christiane Krüger
description: In a Paris devastated by a nuclear catastrophe, a man walks around trying to build a plane to get away from it all. To take possession of the vehicle he collides with other survivors who, like him, survive in the midst of abandoned cars. The man struggles with a villain, is injured and hospitalized, meets a girl and tries to save her.

title: Sacco e Vanzetti
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, Riccardo Cucciolla, Rosanna Fratello, Cyril Cusack
description: Boston, 1920: two Italian immigrants, Nicola Sacco and Bartolomeo Vanzetti, have to answer for the infamous accusations of armed robbery and murder against two cashiers of a shoe factory. The death penalty concludes a process that immediately reveals itself to be conditioned by political reasons: in the face of the lack of real evidence, in fact, it is the declared anarchist faith of the accused that determines the verdict. For seven years, the repeated requests to reopen the case were rejected, and on 23 August 1927 Sacco and Vanzetti climbed into the electric chair.
notes: Indignant and vibrant, but marked by the usual didacticism of a lot of "political" cinema.

title: Nothing But the Night
actors: Christopher Lee, Peter Cushing, Diana Dors, Georgia Brown, Keith Barron, Michael Gambon
description: Following an accident, little Mary is admitted to Prof. Mark Ashley's clinic. Doctor Peter, who treats the little girl, notices her psychic anomalies and records her mysterious soliloquies. Furthermore, he cannot help but draw the director's attention to the fact that as many as three financiers of the Inver House, the castle-school on the island of Bala where Mery was studying, have recently died in accidents. Journalist Joanne is also interested in the case, which is entrusted to Colonel Charles Bingham when Dr. Peter is killed. When the healed child returns to the castle, her mother Anna, who is forbidden to see her, blinds herself to reach her secretly. When four other financiers also die in a boat explosion and Mrs. Anna is burned alive by the schoolchildren of the Inver House, finally Bingham can discover the truth. The founders of the institute, in order to eternalize their existence, usually transplant their personalities into that of their clients. The mediumistic bond between Mary and the founder Helen made her a murderer.

title: One Hundred Men and a Girl
actors: Deanna Durbin, Adolphe Menjou, Leopold Stokowski, Mischa Auer
description: An orchestra made up of one hundred professors was left without work overnight: luckily there is Patricia, a singing girl who knows the prestigious conductor Leopold Stokowski and persuades him to leave the Metropolitan to direct the musicians ...
notes: The film won the Oscar for music by Charles Previn.

title: Prendimi e portami via
actors: Valeria Golino, Rodolfo Laganà, Antonino Iuorio, Marco Zangardi, Claudio Botosso
description: In a squalid neighborhood on the outskirts of Rome lives Giampiero, a thirteen-year-old boy, with his parents Alfredo who is a greengrocer and Luciana, a still young, beautiful and sensitive woman. One day Giampiero finds in his class a new companion, Romana, a small Roma, lively, cheerful, very lively, who lives in the gypsy camp just below his building. The two become inseparable. Unfortunately, however, in the neighborhood the malaise linked to the presence of the Roma camp is becoming more and more common.
notes: Zangardi often fanned the camera over houses, things, churches and people, without digging deeply and without that other necessary gaze that avoids not (un) falling into demagogy. A bad script, full of stereotypes (the story of the two kids is unbearable) and characters cut with a hatchet.

title: Les Granges brûlées
actors: Alain Delon, Simone Signoret, Paul Crauchet, Renato Salvatori, Pierre Rousseau, Bernard Le Coq, Miou-Miou, Christian Barbier, Dany Jacquet
description: After the discovery of the atrociously devastated body of a young woman, the investigating judge Pierre Larchais arrives in the countryside from Paris and starts the investigation: his sights immediately enter mother Rose and her children Paul and Louis, owners of a nearby farm. ..
notes: Chabrolian atmospheres, but the model is far away.

title: Uomini & donne, amori & bugie
actors: Ornella Muti, Paolo Giommarelli, Shasa Vitale, Chiara Mastalli, Jacopo Venturiero
description: Giovanni and Anna got married very young. In twelve years they have had five children, but their vision of life as a couple with the passage of time is increasingly distant: she is completely dedicated to her family and her husband, while he, extremely determined and ambitious, only thinks about her professional fulfillment.
notes: The direction is even lower than the television average, the reconstruction of the very unkempt era (if there were no Tg abbreviations, we would never understand what era we are in). If you want, you can laugh a bit in the finale with Muti and his wife dressed up as old men, and in a scene of sexual harassment in slow motion. Produced by Massimo Ciavarro, music by the writer Andrea De Carlo: no one in this film who does his job. It finances the state, with the funds of article 8 for beginners.

title: Interstella 5555: The 5tory of the 5ecret 5tar 5ystem
description: Four musicians from another galaxy are kidnapped by an evil impresario, whose aim is to transform them into the best-known pop ensemble on Earth and thus enrich themselves behind them ...
notes: No doubt, therefore, that an electric guitar will save the world ... Screenplay and music by the French group Daft Punk, whose sound commentary is unstoppable and effectively transforms the film into an abstract cartoon, without dialogue, emotionally connected to the amplifiers . Of course, the obsessive techno of the French duo could be indigestible to some, but de gustobus ... The fans, however, don't miss it.

title: Veronica Guerin
actors: Cate Blanchett, Colin Farrell, Gerard McSorley, Ciarán Hinds, Brenda Fricker
description: Veronica Guerin is a storm reporter for the "Dublin Sunday Independent". In 1996 she found out who was behind the drug trafficking in Dublin, but a year later she was murdered by those she had accused.
notes: Looked at with skepticism by her colleagues, ready to exploit her sources in the underworld and the police, lovingly flanked by her husband, invited to have a healthy fear of her mother: in Schumacher's film, Guerin has an impetuousness, a contempt for danger, a ardor, an impudence that probably belonged to the real Veronica, but which in the cinema seem the result of a lack of mediation between scene and news. Not a "piece" of denunciation or a cinematographic investigation, but a "biopic", a noble obituary built in flashbacks, which with a few brutal traits describes the wild undergrowth of delinquency and emphasizes the determination of the protagonist. Colin Farrell makes a special attendance.

title: Freddy vs. Jason
actors: Robert Englund, Ken Kirzinger, Monica Keena, Jason Ritter, Kelly Rowland
description: Waking up in hell, Jason is enraged to discover that his precious mask has been stolen by none other than Freddy Krueger. Who, in order to return to the world of the living from which he was definitively expelled, tries to enter Jason's dreams, with the intent of exterminating the descendants of the inhabitants of Elm Street. But Jason disagrees ...
notes: Very influenced by comics (as well as full of quotes, from Hitchcock to Cronenberg to Disney), Yu's film holds up well - narratively and visually - when it moves in the dreamlike universe, where a sadistic-surreal imprint reigns like Clive Barker. The adolescent parts are more banal and now depleted.

title: Berlin Alexanderplatz
actors: Günter Lamprecht, Hanna Schygulla, Barbara Sukowa, Gottfried John

title: Scacco pazzo
actors: Alessandro Haber, Vittorio Franceschi, Monica Scattini
description: Eleven years ago, on his wedding day, Antonio lost his girlfriend in a car accident. At the guide was her brother Valerio, who was accompanying her to the church for the ceremony. From that moment Antonio has a childhood regression and is patiently cared for by Valerio. When the latter brings Marianna into the house, the woman he would like to marry, Antonio tries to oppose himself in every way, but then ends up involving the newcomer in his world.
notes: Dedicating it to Nanni Loy, Piero Natoli and his father, the Haberrante Alessandro looks for what is not there and what cannot be had. A text that floats intelligently in words and a luminous Monica Scattini help him, very concentrated.

title: Tian xia wu shuang
actors: Tony Leung Chiu Wai, Faye Wong, Vicki Zhao, Chen Chang, Roy Cheung
description: China, Ming dynasty: the young emperor and his sister Wushuang manage to escape from the palace, evading the control of the servants. In the city they meet a wanderer who goes by the name of King Bully and his sister Phoenix: it's love at first sight, but fate has ready a series of obstacles before the two couples can fulfill their dream ...
notes: If comedy is very often hilarious (an invention above all: the patterned velox), tragedy moves with a force, even stylistic, that cannot and must not be resisted (the final scene under the peach blossom is exemplary). Epic of feelings: cinema as it is not done anymore, not even in Hong Kong.

title: Bad Boys II
actors: Martin Lawrence, Will Smith, Jordi Mollà, Gabrielle Union, Peter Stormare, Joe Pantoliano
description: Miami narcotics team detectives Mike Lowrey and Marcus Burnett are on a task force to stem the spread of ecstasy in the city. Unintentionally, they discover a grandiose conspiracy involving a ruthless drug lord, willing to kill anyone who intrudes on his plans to control all drug trafficking. To complicate the situation comes Syd, Marcus's sister and undercover agent of the drug team.
notes: In other times, it would have been a harmless C-series short film, ironic and quick. With producer Bruckheimer's estrogen, it becomes a kind of bewildering blockbuster, inexplicably lasting two and a half hours and piling up chases with thirty crashed cars or slow motion scenes of a bullet piercing Martin Lawrence's buttock.

title: Leprechaun 2
actors: Warwick Davis, Charlie Heath, Shevonne Durkin, Adam Biesk
description: After a thousand years, an evil creature called Leprechaun decides to take a wife, but without success. A millennium later he tries again, kills people left and right and kidnaps young Bridget: Cody, the girl's boyfriend, intervenes, but killing a Leprechaun is a difficult task ...
notes: A film that, more than fear, inspires compassion.

title: Tutto Totò - Totò yè yè
actors: Totò, Mario Castellani, Gianni Agus, Mina, Patty Pravo, Tony Renis
description: It is a special, one of the few shot by Totò for TV shortly before his death, in which he parodies the so-called "hairy", or those young emerging singers of the Sixties who, in the wake of the Beatles, had revolutionized the world of pop music. Alongside the faithful "shoulder" Mario Castellani, with whom he proposes the double bass sketch, the prince of laughter duets with some singers including Patty Pravo, Mina (with whom he had already participated, the year before, in "Studio Uno") and the American-Lebanese Ricky Shayne, who became famous in the space of one morning with the song "One of the Mods". A vintage gem.

title: Tutto Totò - Premio Nobel
actors: Totò, Mario Castellani, Enzo Turco, Sandra Milo, Corrado, Vera Drudi
description: Totò is an intrusive curmudgeon who is in the same railway compartment with the Hon. Cosimo Trombetta, distinguished and meek gentleman who undergoes the inevitable propotencies of the other. At a certain point a woman enters between the two who, making believe she is persecuted, ends up relieving them both of the wallet ...
notes: The magazine _ Once upon a time in the world_, by Michele Galdieri, was an authentic workhorse of Totò in the theater. Among the most famous and successful sketches of this show was the very famous one of the sleeping car played by Totò in a duet with his most trusted and habitual "shoulder": Mario Castellani.

title: Tutto Totò - Il latitante
actors: Totò, Mario Castellani, Enzo Turco, Gino Cervi, Lia Zoppelli
description: The episode is taken from the screenplay that Corbucci and Grimaldi had prepared for _Le belve_, a film that Toto 'had to interpret but which was never made. Gennaro La Pezza, a professional thief, has just come out of prison and is already continuing his "business". In the end it is Gino Cervi, the commissioner, who arrests him and takes him back to jail: but also here: as soon as he arrives, he steals the watch from the director of the prison ...

title: Tutto Totò - Totò a Napoli
actors: Totò, Ugo D'Alessio, Luisella Boni, Nunzio Gallo, Miranda Martino, Gloria Christian, Renata Mauro
description: Totò reads one of his most famous poems dedicated to Naples and plays an unauthorized guide struggling with a group of unsuspecting foreign tourists who would like to visit the city. All this is accompanied by the songs of Peppino Di Capri, Nunzio Gallo and the tourist views of the Campania capital.
notes: The program was broadcast by the National Program on June 13, 1967.

title: Senseless
actors: Marlon Wayans, Brad Dourif, David Spade, Matthew Lillard
description: The penniless student Darryl Witherspoon, tired of jumping through hoops to scrape together a few pennies, agrees to be a guinea pig for a science experiment. Dr. Wheedon injects him with an experimental drug that can enhance all five senses. Darryl initially feels like a superhero, but the painful notes will come when he is given an overdose.
notes: Marlon Wayans (_Scary Movie 2_) mocks Jim Carrey, but it's not very funny. Penelope Spheeris, who had made herself noticed with the tense _The boys next door_, is no longer able to keep her demeziale streak at bay.

title: See Spot Run
actors: David Arquette, Angus T. Jones, Michael Clarke Duncan, Leslie Bibb, Joe Viterelli
description: "Agent 11" is a gritty bulldog in the FBI, trained by the instructor Murdoch to use his sensitive sense of smell to find drugs of all kinds. Another of the characteristics of the sympathetic animal consists in not showing any mercy towards his antagonists: the mafia boss Sonny knows something about it, bitten in the bottom of his back. To preserve him from the probable revenge of the criminal, "Agent 11" is entrusted to the equivalent of the witness protection program: but his adventures will not end there, involving an unsuspecting postman named Gordon ...
notes: Childish clone of the "dogs in uniform" vein.

title: Con Express
actors: Sean Patrick Flanery, Arnold Vosloo, Ursula Karven, Eyal Podell, David Lea
description: Brooks, a secret agent of counter-terrorism, receives a tip that reveals the arrival by sea of ??a shipment of chemical weapons. Investigating, he discovers that Simeonov, a well-known Russian terrorist, is behind this clandestine operation. Brooks assembles a team and travels with them to the port area to avert the danger. Following a terrible firefight, the criminal is arrested. However, during the move to Washington, he manages to escape and, together with other terrorists, organizes a new, terrible attack ...
notes: A television film devoid of ideas, based simply on a series of firefights as an end in itself. Not at all engaging.

title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
actors: Richard Roxburgh, Ian Hart, Richard E. Grant, Matt Day, John Nettles
description: Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson arrive at the Baskerville estate, where the life of Sir Henry is in grave danger: a demonic presence, in fact, roams the house in the form of a ferocious mastiff. Is it the fulfillment of a curse on the estate, or a potential murderer who wants to use the legend to disguise his crime?
notes: Perhaps the most "looted" from cinema among Conan Doyle's novels. This BBC television production is admittedly unassuming entertainment, backed by a good dose of suspense and Roxburgh's effective performance as the famous detective.

title: Dark Summer
actors: Jean-Hugues Anglade, Connie Nielsen, Mia Kirshner, Robert Culp

title: Macbeth
actors: Orson Welles, Jeannette Nolan, Dan O'Herlihy, Roddy McDowall, Edgar Barrier, Alan Napier, Erskine Sanford, John Dierkes, Keene Curtis, Peggy Webber, Lionel Braham, Archie Heugly, Jerry Farber, Christopher Welles, Morgan Farley
description: After meeting three witches who predict a bright future for them (the first will ascend the throne now occupied by Duncan, while the second will father a king), the Scottish nobles Macbeth and Banquo return to the palace very disturbed. Her husband's wrath does not escape the cruel lady Macbeth, who pushes him to assassinate Duncan. Girded with the crown, so that the other prophecy does not come true, Macbeth pays two assassins to kill Banquo and his son: but the witches have other verdicts in store ...
notes: The first of Welles' three Shakespearean films is a "low budget" shot in three weeks in the Republic studios, but it can unleash a "barbaric" force that takes your breath away.

title: Yinghung bunsik III
actors: Chow Yun-fat, Anita Mui, Tony Leung Ka Fai, Kien Shih, Saburô Tokitô
description: Mark Gor - who was to be a supporting character in the first episode and was "resurrected" as a "twin" in the second, becoming the true idol of the series - is the protagonist of this prequel set during the Vietnam War. His cousin Cheung looks for him to bring him back to Hong Kong, then he meets the "reason" that is holding him back ...
notes: Outstanding action melodrama directed by the producer of the other A Better Tomorrow, aka Tsui Hark. The quintessence of the extreme, where passion as the engine of history justifies any visionary, epic and sentimental excess. Unpublished in Italy.

title: American Nightmare
actors: David Cronenberg, John Carpenter, Wes Craven, George A. Romero, Tobe Hooper
description: From the hands-on voice of leading figures such as David Cronenberg, John Carpenter, Wes Craven, George A. Romero and Tobe Hooper, an x-ray of the ways in which horror and its surroundings have often been able to engage in anguish and restlessness. individual, but of the whole society.

title: Hellraiser
actors: Andrew Robinson, Clare Higgins, Ashley Laurence, Sean Chapman
description: A mysterious box projects the refined and depraved Frank Cotton into a demonic parallel universe, inside which his body is torn to shreds by a myriad of hooks, chains and hooks; the members of the sect of the Supplizianti collect the remains, keeping them in some way alive. Years later, Larry, Frank's brother, moves into Frank's abandoned house with his wife Julia and daughter Kristy: Frank's accidental and horrific resurrection will raise hell again ...
notes: For his directorial debut, Barker adapts one of his stories and materializes on the screen a visionary carnal and sadomasochistic nightmare.

title: Cabin by the Lake
actors: Judd Nelson, Hedy Burress, Michael Weatherly, Susan Gibney
description: To "read up" on the script he is working on, based on a maniac who kidnaps and kills girls, Stanley Caldwell replicates the crimes in reality, making the bodies of young victims disappear in the waters of a lake. Nobody suspects anything until the killer stumbles upon the pretty but tenacious Mallory ...

title: Amorfù
actors: Sonia Bergamasco, Ignazio Oliva, Barbara Mautino, Luigi Diberti
description: Elena is a girl who is specializing in psychiatry and who lives her profession with absolute enthusiasm. In the nursing home for the mentally ill where she works, she is attracted to Fausto, a restless soul that she thinks she can recover with the strength of friendship. But a much stronger bond is established between them, an 'amour fou', in which the roles are reversed ...
notes: Piovano (whose "Pasolinian" film about a women's prison, _Le rose blu_ was appreciated years ago) relies on various Italian cinema character actors who "go crazy" with results that are never credible, on script poetry, to didactic dialogues and trombones that put one tirade after another, to a staging without backbone and with really vulgar slips (the flashbacks on Fausto as a child).

title: Dinner with Friends
actors: Dennis Quaid, Andie MacDowell, Greg Kinnear, Toni Collette
description: Invited to dinner by the couple of friends Gabe and Karen, Beth tearfully confesses that her marriage after 12 years is at an end and she suspects that her husband is cheating on her. The unexpected revelation undermines Gabe and Karen's solid status quo and forces them to face reality, questioning their only seemingly perfect relationship.
notes: Faithful adaptation of the play by Donald Margulies, which the veteran Jewison transposes on the screen while maintaining the centrality of the characters and the ability to explore marriage, friendship and the complexity of human relationships with delicacy and honesty. Excellent actors, especially Andie McDowell in the role of Beth.

title: Vampires 2: los muertos
actors: Jon Bon Jovi, Cristián de la Fuente, Natasha Gregson Wagner, Arly Jover, Darius McCrary
description: Mexico: Aided by Father Rodrigo and other henchmen, including a girl infected by vampires, specialist Derek Bliss is hired to wipe out a bloodsucking coven. These, led by Princess Una, try in every way to get hold of the legendary Black Crucifix, thanks to which they could develop an immunity to sunlight ...
notes: Useless ideal sequel to John Carpenter's _Vampires_, produced by the American director with a cast led by rock star Bon Jovi. Little "gore", the irony stale and the action devoid of bite: but the failure did not stop the "saga", continued in _Vampires 3 - The return_.

title: Habit
actors: Larry Fessenden, Meredith Snaider, Aaron Beall, Patricia Coleman

title: Cantando dietro i paraventi
actors: Jun Ichikawa, Bud Spencer, Sally Ming Zeo Ni, Camillo Grassi, Makoto Kobayashi
description: In the guise of an old captain, an actor tells the story of a famous pirate woman: the widow Ching, who in order to avenge the treasonable killing of her husband convinces her crews to refuse any other offer and to engage in boarding and looting. The widow does not fear anyone and even attacks the ships under imperial protection, so much so that the government of the Generals orders the supreme admiral Kwo-lang to eliminate the outrageous pirate ...
notes: A film interwoven with respect and tenderness: respect for an unusual iconography (because, underneath, the feelings remain the same as always: love and war, oppression and rebellion, desire for revenge and the need for peace), to which Olmi approaches with curious astonishment, and for a woman's temperament to which even the old corsair and the emperor bow; tenderness for characters who seem to come from the childhood of humanity, with their Homeric and Salgarian cadences. And unexpectedly for Olmi, sensuality also finds its place: in the perfect nude of the actress who plays the piratess Mary Li, but also in the dreams, gestures and body of the widow, in the feminine elegance with which she fights, commands and yields to peace proposals of the emperor. As if Olmi went back to childhood, he discovered the female body and, with it, the possibilities of peace and rest. Something that was already running in the folds of _The craft of arms_, but which was overwhelmed by reason of state and male disillusionment.

title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Life
country: United States, Germany, Japan, Great Britain, Netherlands
actors: Angelina Jolie, Gerard Butler, Ciarán Hinds, Noah Taylor, Chris Barrie
description: Pandora's box is hidden in Africa, in an area called "the cradle of life". It's up to the famous archaeologist Lara Croft to find the vase (which is said to contain the most unspeakable evils), before it falls into the hands of the evil Doctor Reiss who would like to use it to achieve his goal: world domination.
notes: Less worse than the first episode, but still full of the same defects, starting with a protagonist, Angelina Jolie, who certainly has the physique of the role but is credible as a dinghy to act. Behind the camera the Dutch Jan De Bont, former director of photography promoted to director with Speed, someone who knows the trade but who does not escape the ready-made action sequences. Already seen and metabolized by looks, as indeed the thin story. If during the viewing you happen to imagine what happens in the next scene, nine times out of ten you are right. The cast is quite anonymous, the only reason of interest is given by the great Simon Yam (the devil, probably) who have not even been able to fully exploit. How sad ...

title: Svegliati e uccidi
actors: Robert Hoffmann, Lisa Gastoni, Gian Maria Volonté, Claudio Camaso

title: Caterina va in città
actors: Sergio Castellitto, Margherita Buy, Alice Teghil, Galatea Ranzi, Flavio Bucci
description: The Iacovoni family moved to Rome from the province. In the capital, the thirteen-year-old Caterina - daughter of the arrivalist Giancarlo and the shy and distracted Agata - soon became the subject of contention and rivalry between Margherita, daughter of two left-wing intellectuals, and Daniela, scion of an important exponent of the right-wing government. The first, leader of the alternatives of the 3 A, drags Caterina into her world of parades, hangovers and social centers, while Daniela is accompanied to high society parties ...
notes: Between "right" and "left", Rome and Lazio, intellectuals and undersecretaries, friends out of boredom and companions for training, the (bitter) comedy gallops fast, sneaks into traffic, crosses the forbidden thresholds of contemporary bedrooms, "zapping" on the cultural decay and on the faces-icons of the sad Italic tele-imaginary (from Costanzo to Melandri to Simonetta Martone). Cameo-surprise by Roberto Benigni and the author's appearance by an amused Michele Placido, provoked to remember the unforgettable Commissioner Cattani.

title: Deathline
actors: Rutger Hauer, Mark Dacascos, Yvonne Sciò, Patrick Dreikauss
description: Moscow: John Anderson Wade, engaged in shady black market activities, is murdered by his partner Merrick. However, a bionic experiment brings him back to life, and the former corpse teams up with the kickboxer Marina to exact revenge ...
notes: Yet another "food" performance for Hauer, more than ever far from the glories of _Blade Runner_ and _The Hitcher_.

title: Jason and the Argonauts
actors: Jason London, Dennis Hopper, Diana Kent, Jolene Blalock, Frank Langella, Brian Thompson, Derek Jacobi, Olivia Williams, Angus MacFadyen
description: Little Jason narrowly escapes the massacre that cost the life of his father Aeson, king of Iolco, at the hands of his cruel uncle Pelias. Having become an adult, he returns home determined to assert his rights as heir to the throne, but Pelias sets a condition: the recovery of the mythical golden fleece of Colchis, guarded by a ferocious dragon ...

title: Zong heng si hai
actors: Chow Yun-fat, Leslie Cheung, Cherie Chung
description: Jim, Joe and Cherie are the top three thieves in Hong Kong and all of Cantonese China. Their ability is almost magical, theft for them is a real art. But the object they have set their eyes on is dangerous: a cursed painting that could lead their "family" to self-destruction ...
notes: Among the last films that John Woo shot in his homeland before flying to Hollywood, he suffered the difficulties of production. Originally it was supposed to be more of a comedy than an action movie, according to the model of the Pink Panther. Excellent interpreters. Remade by the director for American television.

title: Riverworld
actors: Brad Johnson, Emily Lloyd, Cameron Daddo, Jonathan Cake
description: After his death, the American astronaut Hale undergoes a series of reincarnations and ends up on a planet called "Riverworld": here the deceased humans, reduced to the tribal state, live a sort of "second existence" under the dominion of mysterious beings who they watch their every move. It will be up to Hale to lead a riot ...

title: Holiday Affair
actors: Bruno Eyron, Ursula Karven, Mark Kuhn, Stefanie Schmid
description: Sabine is spending a difficult moment of her marriage life. To make the way of her reconciliation more complex with her husband of her, Thierry, a skipper known in Tunisia with whom she has a relationship. What seems to be only an occasional betrayal will turn into a nightmare ...

title: Domestic Violence
description: A group of elderly ladies goes on a visit to a sort of refuge / rehabilitation center, crowded with women who have suffered violence at home: their point of view reproduces that of the spectators, projected into a vast, chilling and misunderstood. A disturbing and essential document.

title: Seabiscuit
actors: Jeff Bridges, Chris Cooper, Tobey Maguire, Valerie Mahaffey, Paul Vincent O'Connor
description: Against the backdrop of 1930s America, the lives of Charles Ho-ward, an automobile magnate, Tom Smith, a horse trainer and Johnny "Red" Pollard, a young jockey, intertwine. Together they begin a legend that bears the name of a rebellious and stubborn horse, Seabiscuit. In a particularly complex and difficult historical period, Seabiscuit becomes a symbol of hope and rebirth for an entire nation ...
notes: Gary Ross builds bridges with wide arches between the sporting enterprises - between 1935 and 1937 - of Seabiscuit and the story of a nation that wants to come back to life, but continually loses a sense of measure and dryness.

title: Basic
actors: John Travolta, Connie Nielsen, Samuel L. Jackson, Timothy Daly, Giovanni Ribisi
description: Tom Hardy, a former Army soldier turned narcotics agent, is tasked with working with Fort Clayton Military Police Chief Captain Julia Osborne to shed light on the mysterious disappearance of the feared and hated Sergeant Nathan West. Initially the woman disapproves of the behavior of her colleague, involved in unclear trafficking, but then the two arrive at a temporary truce.
notes: The script, happily caring about the narrative inconsistencies, weaves a series of twists that actually conquer, and an unusually hard vision of the relationships between characters. The genre is what it is, but McTiernan brings out some of the grit of the old action fox and tightens the pace a lot. The result is almost a film with the merits of the B-movie, and a dry unity of time, place and action. Too bad that, in order to save the happy ending and the good name of the army, in the end the film, pretending to turn things upside down one last time, actually worries about reassuring the viewer, throwing it into a joke and ruining the whole. .

title: Gente di Roma
actors: Giorgio Colangeli, Antonello Fassari, Fabio Ferrari, Arnoldo Foà, Sabrina Impacciatore, Valerio Mastandrea, Stefania Sandrelli
description: Rome, today. An unemployed person does not have the courage to tell his wife and pretends to go to work. A black social researcher harasses a young man on the bus. An old woman thinks that the Germans have returned to the ghetto, and instead she is a television crew. Stefania Sandrelli plays with her grandchildren in the park. A mother loses her child during the San Giovanni demonstration while Moretti speaks, and they bring her back ...
notes: Scola returns to tell about his Rome, that of today and yesterday, mixing digital and Zavattinian invitations to take the bus. But the parade of various narrative segments recalls certain episodic films that marked the decline of the Italian comedy.

title: Daddy Day Care
actors: Eddie Murphy, Jeff Garlin, Steve Zahn, Regina King, Kevin Nealon
description: Charlie and Phil are so engrossed in their job as a publicist that they have completely lost sight of the joys of parenthood. However, following the failure of their advertising campaign on a new type of vegetable cereal, the two are fired and are forced to withdraw their children from the exclusive asylum they were enrolled in. While waiting for a new job, they are the ones who take care of the little ones and consequently have the idea of ??taking care of a dozen children. But the beginnings are not as easy as they expected.
notes: Eddie Murphy chatting to animals in _Doctor Dolittle_, reading bedtime stories and wrestling "bathroom" comedy in _Dads Kindergarten_ hints that time for the disruptive and rousing comedian of _48 hours_ and _Beverly Hills Cop_ is up .

title: La mia vita a stelle e strisce
actors: Massimo Ceccherini, Victoria Silvstedt, Novello Novelli, Manuela Magherini, Cyrus Elias
description: The quiet cottage of Lando, a farmer in the Tuscan countryside, is about to undergo a shocking invasion: Aunt Giuly arrives from America with a lot of husband, former colonel of the Marines, daughter of breathtaking beauty and pestiferous nephew. Poor Lando is thus forced to undergo all kinds of harassment (from the parabolic hoisted on the roof of the cottage to the pumpkins in the field carved for Halloween) and his protests are of little value.
notes: Wandering between a penny anti-Americanism Chiantishire version, inevitable jokes and erotic impulses always lurking, Ceccherini tries, however, to settle down. His monologues acquire a certain unusual melancholy, only that the structure of the film is burdened by an excessive length and there is a lack of a wise hand that knows how to bring out the good that undoubtedly is in that mask potentially full of wonders.

title: Sabrina, Down Under
actors: Melissa Joan Hart, Scott Michaelson, Tara Charendoff, Rachel Anderson, Lindsay Sloane
description: The witch Sabrina has landed with her friend Gwen in Australia to study marine biology and local "fauna". Committed to saving the last sirens from extinction, the girl meets a handsome newt, Barnaby, who has fallen ill due to pollution. Sabrina tries to save him and his sister the mermaid Fin.

title: Le Rat d'Amérique
actors: Charles Aznavour, Franco Fabrizi, Marie Laforêt
description: Carlo, who is experiencing an economic crisis, emigrates to Paraguay. He soon realizes that it will be difficult to overcome misery in that country too: he decides to engage in smuggling, but it goes badly to the point that in order not to end up in jail he has to reach Chile ...
notes: Second, negligible Apricot film.

title: Razzia sur la Chnouf
actors: Jean Gabin, Marcel Dalio, Lino Ventura, Albert Rémy, Magali Noël
description: Henri known as "Le Nantais", who arrived in Paris from America, is hired by a drug trafficker, Liski. He soon gets to run the drug ring hiding behind the cover of a restaurant, where he has a flirt with the cashier Lisette. When entrusted with the task of hiding two killers recognized by the authorities, Henri makes his move ...
notes: In the wake of _Grisbì_ and based on a novel by Auguste Le Breton, this polar of solid workmanship, without authorial flourishes, has its best moments in the observation of drug addiction, with passages of shocking hardness for the time and still effective today.

title: Les Tontons flingueurs
actors: Lino Ventura, Bernard Blier, Francis Blanche, Jean Lefebvre

title: Inspecteur Lavardin
actors: Jean Poiret, Jean-Claude Brialy, Bernadette Lafont, Jean-Luc Bideau

title: Easy Riders, Raging Bull
actors: John Milius, Peter Bogdanovich, Roger Corman, Peter Fonda, Dennis Hopper, Kris Kristofferson, Margot Kidder, Paul Schrader
description: Through a series of interviews with many of the characters involved in what was a veritable revolution in Hollywood, the documentary reveals how the studios and the entire American film industry were literally saved by a generation of young independent visionaries who took control. of Hollywood subverting its rules. With William C. Macy as narrator and guide, we meet the likes of Richard Dreyfuss, John Milius, Peter Bogdanovich, Roger Corman, Peter Fonda, Dennis Hopper, Kris Kristofferson, Margot Kidder and Paul Schrader. Alternating with the interviews, many clips taken from important films that contributed to the change of paradigm and as many precious behind the scenes with authors such as Francis Ford Coppola, George Lucas, Dennis Hopper, Martin Scorsese and Roman Polanski.

title: Emmanuelle 2
actors: Sylvia Kristel, Umberto Orsini, Frédéric Lagache, Catherine Rivet

title: Salmonberries
actors: K.D. Lang, Rosel Zech, Chuck Connors, Jane Lind, Oscar Kawagley

title: Windows
actors: Talia Shire, Joseph Cortese, Elizabeth Ashley, Kay Medford

title: Cover Girl
actors: Rita Hayworth, Gene Kelly, Lee Bowman, Eve Arden, Otto Krüger, Jinx Falkenburg
description: Rusty Parker is the dancer from a small Broadway club who finds herself catapulted into show business when she wins a cover girl contest. Intoxicated by success, she abandons her boyfriend and entrepreneur Danny to throw herself into the arms of a richer man, but she realizes that happiness is elsewhere.
notes: Vidor manages to transform a rather abused subject into an overwhelming musical, which shines with its own light thanks to the shining Rita Hayworth (voiced for the sung scenes) and the extraordinary dance numbers of Gene Kelly, some of them very innovative for the time ( like the one in which he duets with his shadow). Oscar to the soundtrack of Carmen Dragon and Morris Stoloff.

title: A Raising in the Sun
actors: Sidney Poitier, Ruby Dee, Claudia McNeil, Louis Gossett jr.

title: You 'll Never Get Rich
actors: Fred Astaire, Rita Hayworth, John Hubbard, Robert Benchley

title: Sirocco
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Marta Toren, Lee J. Cobb, Everett Sloane

title: The Talk of the Town
actors: Cary Grant, Jean Arthur, Ronald Colman, Lloyd Bridges, Rex Ingram

title: Jabberwocky
actors: Michael Palin, Harry H. Corbett, John Le Mesurier, Warren Mitchell

title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
actors: Graham Chapman, John Cleese, Terry Gilliam, Eric Idle, Terry Jones, Michael Palin

title: Cat Ballou
actors: Nat King Cole, Jane Fonda, Lee Marvin, Michael Callan, Stubby Kaye
description: Returning to her native village of Wolf City, Wyoming, after graduating from school, Catherine "Cat" Ballou discovers that her father Frankie is in the crosshairs of a company that wants to take over her land. And when Frankie leaves his skin at the hands of Tim Strawn, a ruthless artificial-nosed killer, Cat reunites a messed-up gang and sets out to seek revenge ...
notes: A very dated western parody kept afloat by the glamor of La Fonda and the verve of Marvin, here in an unusual double role awarded with an Oscar. Curious but no more the singing curtains by Nat "King" Cole and Stubby Kaye, who comment on the story like a Greek choir.

title: The Villain
actors: Kirk Douglas, Ann-Margret, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Paul Lynde

title: H
actors: Jung-ah Yum, Jin-hee Ji, Ji-ru Sung, Seung-woo Cho, Woong-ki Min

title: Momentum
actors: Louis Gossett jr., Teri Hatcher, Grayson McCouch, Michael Massee, Nicki Lynn Aycox
description: Raymond Addison, a Pentagon agent, engages telekinetic Professor Zach Shefford on a dangerous mission. In 1977, Addison oversaw the "Momentum Project," which brought together individuals with extrasensory abilities to harness its benefits for the benefit of humanity. But the operation had proved uncontrollable, forcing Addison to eliminate all participants. All but one, Adrian Geiger, who managed to escape and now heads a hostile group of "gifted": Shefford's job is to infiltrate Greer's ranks, neutralizing them forever ...

title: For Love or Country: The Arturo Sandoval Story
actors: Andy Garcia, Mia Maestro, Gloria Estefan, Charles S. Dutton
description: Athens 1989. In the visa office of the American embassy, ​​the Cuban jazz musician Arturo Sandoval traces his history.

title: Waltz of the Toreadors
actors: Peter Sellers, Margaret Leighton, Dany Robin, Cyril Cusack
description: Leo Fitzjohn, a retired general, is forced to suffer the harassment of his shrewish wife Emily. His only consolation: the memory of the good old days, spent - platonically - in the company of the beautiful Ghislaine. But one day, years later, here is the latter reappearing at Fitzjohn's door, expressing the desire not only to resume the relationship, but also to "make it concrete" ...
notes: The screenwriter Wolf Mankowitz adapts a play by Jean Anouilh, preserving its bittersweet tones and transporting the action from the French post-war period to the early 20th century, in the very British Sussex. Luxury cast, with the usual great Sellers.

title: Serving Sara
actors: Matthew Perry, Elizabeth Hurley, Bruce Campbell, Amy Adams, Vincent Pastore, Cedric the Entertainer
description: Bailiff Joe Tyler makes his living by sending subpoenas to unsuspected victims. Sara Moore, a Texas cattle farmer, is one of her targets. With the help of Gordon, Sara's partner who has plotted to ruin her financially to get hold of her share, Joe is trying to frame her. Sara then tries to reverse the situation and makes an offer Joe can't refuse: frame his partner and make a million dollars. The two find themselves working side by side.
notes: Interesting canvas, but mixing romantic comedy with demented comedy does not always guarantee a good result, as in this case. And the sadistic teasing that Joe and his colleague / enemy Tony endlessly exchange like Scott's duelists don't help either.

title: Bionicle: Mask of Light
description: Takua, Mata Nui's unreliable chronicler, and his friend Jaller accidentally discover the legendary Kanohi Mask which is said to be endowed with incredible powers. Moreover, it is not just any mask, but the mythical "Mask of the Light" which must be worn only by the seventh and greatest of the Toa, the one who will bring the light into the darkness. Takua and Jaller's mission then becomes to find the seventh Toa so that the island of the Matoran can be saved.

title: Prima dammi un bacio
actors: Stefania Rocca, Marco Cocci, Luca Zingaretti, Camilla Filippi, Fiorella Mannoia
description: Adele and Marcello are marked by destiny since birth: they came to light at the same moment, a few centimeters away. They have always lived in symbiosis, even coming to celebrate their marriage when they were children, with the complicity of Loris, a friend of a few years older. Then the Second World War separated them, but their dream of love continues.
notes: The debut in the cinema of the director of video clips and commercials Ambrogio Lo Giudice, more than a film for the cinema, appears as a promone of a television drama. Gracile puny, decorative and feel-good, he chases that trickle of Avati's cinema that is already hard to bear.

title: Io no
actors: Gian Marco Tognazzi, Francesco Venditti, Ines Sastre, Myriam Catania
description: Flavio and Francesco are two very different brothers. On the death of his father, Flavio, over ten years old, took over the management of the family hotel and with his wife Laura and the two children, he returned to live in his parents' house. Francis, on the other hand, continues to lead a disordered life without reference points. Laura has taken her brother-in-law's case to heart and is looking for a companion among her friends who can suit him well. Until one night changes their lives forever ...
notes: The screenplay is the sore point of _Io no_: a script that does not give credit to at least a couple of interpreters and a swashbuckling director, which takes its risks and climbs confidently both in the South African desert and in the gloomy streets of a very anomalous Milan.

title: Dolce
description: The director of _Madre e son_, _Moloch_ and _Arca russo_ retraces the biography of the Japanese writer Toshio Shimao (1917-1986): his childhood spent in the comforts of a family of wealthy merchants; enrollment among kamikaze pilots; the meeting with Miho, the love of a lifetime, whose memories innervate the entire film.

title: Akibiyori
actors: Setsuko Hara, Yoko Tsukasa, Mariko Okada, Keiji Sata, Chishu Ryu
description: After years of widowhood, Akiko thinks about remarrying, despite the strenuous opposition of her daughter Ayako. Three old schoolmates, who have always been in love with Akiko, come forward, but at the same time try to snatch a yes from Ayako too ...
notes: The master's third last film, curiously poised between drama and comedy.

title: Wakaki hi
actors: Ichirô Yuki, Tatsuo Saito, Junko Matsui, Shinichi Himori, Chishu Ryu
description: Alongside their daily efforts to pass their exams, two students make all sorts of attempts to impress the girl who made them both lose their minds.
notes: Humorous and lively, the film showcases a very varied stylistic repertoire, which Ozu will gradually "dry up" in the years to come.

title: The Matrix Revolutions
actors: Keanu Reeves, Laurence Fishburne, Carrie-Anne Moss, Hugo Weaving, Jada Pinkett Smith, Lambert Wilson
description: War has broken out and the army of the Machines advances relentlessly on Zion. Will the citizens of the last human stronghold be able to hold out until the Chosen One finds within himself the power and courage to put an end to the conflict once and for all?
notes: In this third chapter there are losses, mourning, allegorical blindness, the usual rosary from a philosophical compendium, mélo moments, figurative intuitions. In the incessant rain that bathes the fatal clash of the war of the worlds, however, the identity of the characters, the body and time of the story, the identification of the spectators, the geometry of the set and the field of vision also go under water.

title: Il magnifico avventuriero
actors: Brett Halsey, Bernard Blier, Claudia Mori, Françoise Fabian, Elio Pandolfi
description: 16th century: goldsmith, sculptor and unrepentant womanizer, Benvenuto Cellini is forced to flee from Florence. Arriving in Rome, he wins the favors of Pope Clement VII, who appoints him head of the Mint: but he takes the opportunity to mint false coins and is imprisoned ...
notes: A "swashbuckler" with a (very vaguely) historical background.

title: Barbie of Swan Lake
description: Odette, the daughter of the baker from her village, sees a unicorn enter the enchanted forest and sets out on its trail. As she enters the forest, the young woman discovers the magical creatures that inhabit it, ending up meeting the queen of the fairies. This tells her that she will be the one to save the forest, threatened by the evil wizard Rothbart. The girl, frightened, declares herself unsuitable for the undertaking, but is immediately found by the evil sorcerer, who turns her into a swan. The good fairy tries to help her, but her power is enough to break the curse only from dusk to dawn ...

title: Il trucido e lo sbirro
actors: Tomas Milian, Claudio Cassinelli, Nicoletta Machiavelli, Henry Silva, Robert Hundar
description: To arrest the dangerous criminal Brescianelli and free a kidnapped girl, who is also in urgent need of a kidney transplant, Commissioner Sarti thinks of enlisting the help of the thief Monnezza, and for this purpose he favors her escape.
notes: The film opens with inmates at the prison cinema seeing a western, and later stages a train robbery, almost a declaration of the legacy the cop would like to collect. The great success with the public made Monnezza a recurring character in our cinema, even if here his dialogues are not yet edited by Tomas Milian.

title: L'uomo del vento
actors: Alessio Boni, Tosca D'Aquino, Niccolò Branchi, Sophia Lewis, Matteo Malfetti
description: Massimo, a young air force pilot who, due to an accident, caused the wounding of some elementary school children, abandons the body. The man resumes his psychology studies that he had prematurely interrupted and becomes a support teacher in the class victim of the disaster. The parents suspect nothing of Massimo's past and entrust him with their children still in shock. The situation will get complicated when Alida, a young widowed mother of Giulio who has since been unable to speak, begins to suspect him. Then one day the truth comes out ...

title: Les amants criminels
actors: Natacha Régnier, Jérémie Rénier, Miki Manojlovic, Salim Kechiouche
description: Alice, a teenager from an unidentifiable suburb, has a particular predilection for sadism and violence. In particular, he focuses on one purpose: to rape his schoolmate, Said. Killing it. To do this, she has to ask for help from her naive boyfriend, Luc. As if this were proof of his love for her. Once the crime is completed, the two venture into the woods ...
notes: A gothic fable that looks directly at Hansel and Gretel, but which deviates towards a morbid sensuality and the extreme voyeurism of situations, cold, cerebral, calculated.

title: Il compagno americano
actors: Hugh O'Connor, Nancy Brilli, Tosca D'Aquino, Giulio Base
description: Paris 1940. In a cell of anti-fascists, the young Muffa militates, whose enthusiasm is equal to ingenuity. His comrades decide to send him to Italy as a diversion, to cover up the real envoy, who must organize an attack against Mussolini. But the attack goes awry, and the poor Yankee finds himself catapulted to Cinecittà where everyone is waiting for mr. Hogan, a technician who must reveal the secrets of Technicolor for the first Italian production in color.
notes: The absurdity of the project is evident from the first scene, when everything is already understood about how it will end. The cast is the most absurd you can imagine, with Brilli who can now do nothing but parody of the vamp, and O'Connor dazed.

title: The Incredible Hulk Returns
actors: Bill Bixby, Lou Ferrigno, Eric Allan Kramer, Jack Colvin, Tom Finnegan, John Gabriel
description: Dr. Bruce Banner / Hulk has invented a Gamma Transponder that is supposed to help him get rid of the gamma radiation responsible for his transformations. With this contraption Bruce would like to finally put an end to his continuous metamorphosis. However, it happens that his invention is stolen and his girlfriend is kidnapped. All that remains for Bruce is to return to "dress up" as the Hulk and ask Thor for help.

title: The Trial of the Incredible Hulk
actors: Bill Bixby, Lou Ferrigno, Rex Smith, John Rhys-Davies, Nancy Everhard
description: Dr. Bruce Banner / Hulk is tried by the New York courthouse for assaulting a woman. The victim in question was forced to lie by the evil Kingpin who wants to put the Hulk in jail. The doctor is defended by lawyer Matt Murdock under whose disguise the super hero Devil is hiding. The purpose of the two is to face and win the Kingpin.

title: Ma 6-T va crack-er
actors: Hamouda Bouras, Arco Descat C., Peterasta, Jean-François Richet

title: La croce dalle sette pietre
actors: Marco Antonio Adinolfi, Annie Belle, Gordon Mitchell, Paolo Fiorino

title: Mickey One
actors: Warren Beatty, Alexandra Stewart, Hurd Hatfield, Franchot Tone

title: Rocco e le sorelle
actors: Tiberio Murgia, Moira Orfei, Anna Ranalli, Memmo Carotenuto
description: A Sicilian leaves for Milan with the four sisters whom he closely guards. However, he is arrested for misunderstanding and the girls find love.

title: Le inibizioni del dottor Gaudenzi, vedovo con il complesso..
actors: Carlo Giuffrè, Françoise Prevost, Saro Urzì, Katia Christine

title: Ame agaru
actors: Akira Terao, Yoshiko Miyazaki, Shiro Mifune, Mieko Harada

title: I 7 magnifici cornuti
actors: Femi Benussi, Oreste Lionello, Tiberio Murgia, Carlo Delle Piane

title: Captured
actors: Dolph Lundgren, Meilani Paul, Alexander Kuznetsov, Natalie Radford, Randolph Mantooth, Neal Matarazzo, Tony Becker, Steve Eastin, Allan Kolman
description: After the Cold War, the Russians decide to return a terrible bio-weapon to the US, from which they had stolen it long ago. But while the delicate cargo is being transported, Officer Matt Hendricks' submarine is attacked by a gang of terrorists intent on spreading the deadly virus on both New York and Moscow ...

title: The Enemy
country: Luxembourg, United States, Germany, Great Britain
actors: Luke Perry, Olivia D'Abo, Roger Moore, Horst Buchholz, Tom Conti
description: Mike Ashton works in the field of genetics. Years earlier, his father - also a scientist - had collaborated in the creation of a biochemical weapon: and today, because of these precedents, he is kidnapped by a gang of terrorists. With the help of tough, handsome agent Penny Johnson, Mike will do anything to free his parent.

title: The Wild Beasts
actors: Lorraine De Selle, John Aldrich, Ugo Bologna, Louisa Lloyd
description: A toxic substance is accidentally released into the drinking water pipes causing a wave of aggression among the pets, mice and beasts of the zoo. A doctor and a brave zoo attendant try to deal with the situation.

title: Nipoti miei diletti
actors: Adriana Asti, Marc Porel, Romolo Valli, Luciano Salce, Mattia Sbragia
description: 1939. In the Bassa Padana, an adventor forty -year -old takes care of the grandchildren. These are youngsters in the middle of their sexual explosion and will demonstrate it by passing one by one in the aunt's bed. The war of Abyssinia is however on the horizon and the grandchildren will leave for the front, despite the attempt of the aunt to hold them back.

title: Money Movers
actors: Terence Donovan, Ed Devereaux, Tony Bonner, Lucky Grills
description: The employee of a valuable transport company tries the perfect shot, but realizes that the other employees also dream of getting rich at the owner's expense.
notes: A well done detective story, tense and vibrant to the end, which constantly shuffles the cards between good and bad and plays to confuse the viewer. Directed, written and edited by the Australian Beresford.

title: Sleeping Beauty
description: When the Maleficent witch is not invited to the baptism of the newborn Princess Aurora, she casts a curse that promises the death of the little girl by her 16th birthday. The three godmother fairies remove Aurora from her parents and make her spend a peaceful and safe childhood in the woods of the kingdom. Despite his best efforts, Maleficent manages to find the girl on the stroke of her sixteenth birthday and carries out her diabolical plan ...
notes: Officially based on the fairy tale of the same name by Charles Perrault (although more reminiscent of the Brothers Grimm version also known as _Rosaspina_), the film was shot with the help of real actors, used as models by the animators.

title: Provocateur
actors: Jane March, Stephen Mendel, Lillo Brancato, Nick Mancuso, Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa
description: The beautiful Sook Hee (aka Miya), in the pay of the North Korean regime, enters the family and professional life of Colonel Greg Finn, stationed in South Korea, to steal important military secrets. However, the mission will also have other implications, especially of a sentimental nature ...
notes: Pretentious and very mediocre "spy thriller".

title: Ti spiace se bacio mamma?
actors: Alessandro Benvenuti, Natasha Stefanenko, Marina Massironi, Arnoldo Foà, Annalisa Favetti
description: The lawyer Sandro has three sisters and a 75-year-old father who still feels a strong attraction for women. Lena, a beautiful and mysterious Ukrainian maid (actually a lawyer in her country), not only upsets the monotonous rhythms that mark Sandro's existence, but also revolutionizes the family balance ...
notes: In the tenth film, Benvenuti shifts his focus a little and, while still dealing with shady parental trafficking, tries to come out by sewing on the character of a lawyer full of manias: but the urgency to tell too much - racism , immigrants, loneliness, old age - does not allow him to balance everything properly.

title: Paprika
actors: Debora Caprioglio, Stephane Ferrara, Martine Brochard, Valentine Demy

title: Dirty Mary, Crazy Larry
actors: Peter Fonda, Susan George, Adam Roarke, Vic Morrow, Roddy McDowall

title: Kopps
actors: Fares Fares, Torkel Petersson, Göran Ragnerstam, Sissela Kyle, Eva Röse
description: In a small Swedish town, the crime rate is zero. The four local cops spend the day playing cards. When a beautiful inspector arrives from Stockholm with the news that the police station will be closed because it is inactive, the four devise a plan: they will simulate a series of crimes in order not to lose their jobs.
notes: The funny comedy has fun ridiculing clichés by throwing, at times, into surreal areas like Suleiman. And also the bet that the author ventures with the rhythm - overturned, compared to Hollywood, as much as the inaction of thefts and murders - surprisingly wins on points. Curiosity: the name of Lars von Trier appears among the producers. What if the village of Kops were the other side, the good soul, the white mirror of the tragic Dogville?

title: Gli indesiderabili
actors: Vincenzo Albanese, Marcello Mazzarella, Lynda Steadman, Vincent Gallo, Violante Placido, Antonio Catania, Vincent Schiavelli
description: Some thugs of Italian origin accused of collusion with the mafia, unable to be imprisoned for lack of evidence, are sent back home as undesirable. To welcome them there is also the journalist Giancarlo Fusco, who is passionate about their stories.
notes: Scimeca stages the story of Fusco as he investigates the fates of the undesirables. The events are fascinating and certain atmospheres of dreamed America are suggestive. But the Palermo director does not control the complex flashback choral construction, does not make the most of a wonderful cast, flatly transposes certain dialogues from the book. His naïveté would like to be touching and Brechtian, but the aim in this case is not the best.

title: Il fuggiasco
actors: Daniele Liotti, Roberto Citran, Francesca De Sapio, Claudia Coli, Alessandro Benvenuti, Joaquim De Almeida
description: Padua, 1976. The eighteen year old Massimo Carlotto is accused of a murder, on which he had only to testify, and sentenced to 18 years in prison. Massimo flees to France and here he comes into contact with exiles and political refugees who, with their solidarity and friendship, allow him to move forward, then he goes to Spain and Mexico where he tries to rebuild his life. Meanwhile in Padua, the parents, with the help of the lawyer Vignoni, try to bring out the truth ...
notes: Except for the notable start to "sketched" editing, we often slip into the usual. Who knows if the trust in a "strong" subject did not work like the classic double-edged sword. Good performance by Daniele Liotti, despite the aftermath of his diction is very little "Paduan"; and instead the presence of Alessandro Benvenuti (Massimo's lawyer) is remarkable in a dramatic role that is so unusual.

title: Amore estremo. Tough Love
actors: Jennifer Lopez, Ben Affleck, Justin Bartha, Lainie Kazan, Christopher Walken, Al Pacino
description: Larry, a middle-class thug, is given a prestigious assignment: to kidnap Brian, the unstable brother of a powerful federal prosecutor, to prevent a crime boss from going to jail. To assist him in the enterprise, the boss sends Ricki, a beautiful and unscrupulous woman. Larry falls in love with her and does everything to conquer her but the woman seems unreachable.
notes: Of course, the sensual Lopez is in plaster and Affleck has the glamor of a dead carp, the dialogues are very flat and the whole cloying: but with what courage to rage on a film that in the USA has already (apparently) scored 130 slings, an absolute record ? If anything, the only moment of perversely enjoyable nonsense are the appearances of Christopher Walken and Al Pacino, directly from another planet.

title: Tais-toi!
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Jean Reno, André Dussollier, Jean-Pierre Malo, Richard Berry, Aurélien Recoing, Leonor Varela
description: In prison, Ruby, a thug intent on taking revenge on the man who killed his beloved, meets Quentin, a giant as kind as he is stupid who immediately becomes attached to him. Ruby is forced to make her new friend participate in her escape project. Once outside, the two must escape the gendarmes and hitmen on Ruby's trail to retrieve some loot.
notes: Genre cinema, pure narrative mechanism, pleasure of the story. Fortunately, there are still some craftsmen capable of this: Francis Veber is one of them, and may the WWF protect and preserve him. The film is a variation on the theme of _Rompiballe_, a masterpiece that Veber wrote thirty years ago for Molinaro.

title: Love Actually
actors: Hugh Grant, Colin Firth, Emma Thompson, Liam Neeson, Keira Knightley, Laura Linney, Rowan Atkinson
description: London, a few weeks before Christmas. Scenes of everyday life. The Prime Minister has to contend with the service staff, a betrayed writer finds true love on the shores of a lake, a shy girl finally manages to declare herself to her colleague, a stepfather ends up establishing a very strong relationship with his son, a suspicious wife of being betrayed and goes into crisis ...
notes: Richard Curtis' screenwriter (_Four weddings and a funeral_, _Notting Hill_ and _ Bridget Jones's diary_) makes his directorial debut with a film that alternates the comic element with the sentimental one. Camei by Rowan Atkinson and Claudia Schiffer.

title: Whale Rider
actors: Keisha Castle-Hughes, Rawiri Paratene, Vicky Haughton, Cliff Curtis, Rachel House
description: Legend has it that Paikea led his people to New Zealand riding a whale: from that moment, by tradition, the first male born to one of his descendants becomes chieftain. However, everything is destined to change: Porourangi, son of the current boss, has two twins, a boy and a girl; but the male dies during childbirth and it is the daughter Pai who takes his place - not without great difficulty ...
notes: After a realistic start, the film moves towards fairytale atmospheres. The director does not exaggerate with the pathos, but she never fascinates completely and remains on the surface touching the "big themes" (ecology, multiculturalism, sexual difference).

title: Koroshi no rakuin
actors: Jô Shishido, Annu Mari, Mariko Ogawa, Isao Tamagawa, Hiroshi Minami
description: The killer Hanada was "sentenced to death" by his boss Yabuhara, who entrusts the execution first to Harada's own wife, then to the beautiful Misako. The latter, however, falls in love with her target, and the situation becomes complicated ...
notes: Abstract, stylized, innovative. At the time distributed in Italy under the title _The butterfly on the viewfinder_.

title: Pistol Opera
actors: Makiko Esumi, Sayoko Yamaguchi, Kan Hanae, Masatoshi Nagase
description: Miyuki, known as "Stray Cat", occupies the third rank in the "hit parade" of professional killers. Behind her, although confined to a wheelchair, there is the "Professor", who tries to eliminate her: Miyuki prevails, but someone has seen everything ...
notes: Sort of sequel to _The Mark of the Assassin_, equally cryptic and fascinating.

title: BASEketball
actors: Trey Parker, Matt Stone, Dian Bachar, Yasmine Bleeth, Jenny McCarthy
description: In addition to being losers and unemployed, Joe and Doug are definitely not cut out for traditional sports, so they invent one tailored for them: the "Baseketball", a hybrid (totally static) between basketball and baseball ...
notes: Zucker hires the two creators of _South Park_ and stays in the demented area: we laugh, but in moderation.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn 3: The Hangman's Daughter
actors: Marco Leonardi, Michael Parks, Temuera Morrison, Rebecca Gayheart
description: Johnny, a Mexican outlaw just as he is about to be hanged, manages to escape. On the run he takes his girlfriend, the daughter of the executioner Esmeralda with him. The bandit, who has got his gang back on his feet, must face the priestess Quixtla's vampires. A survival war begins between humans and creatures of the night.

title: Greenfingers
actors: Clive Owen, David Kelly, Helen Mirren, Warren Clarke, Danny Dyer
description: Colin Briggs and Fergus Wilks, detained in a minimum security prison, discover they have a passion for gardening. Thanks to the guidance and expertise of the expert horticulturist Georgina Woodhouse, they manage to participate in the prestigious Hampton Court Palace flower competition.
notes: The American Hershman (also screenwriter) takes his cue from an article published by the "New York Times" on the true story of some inmates of his country, but draws from it a film that is not more "British". Unfortunately, however, despite the efforts made, the inspiration from the old Ealing comedies and the good cast put in place, the results are negligible.

title: Boksuneun naui geot
actors: Kang-ho Song, Ha-kyun Shin, Du-na Bae, Ji-Eun Lim, Bo-bae Han
description: The deaf-mute worker Ryu would like to donate a kidney to his sick sister but he himself remains entangled in the ugly network of organ traffickers. To find a compatible kidney, he now has to shell out a lot of money, and together with his girlfriend he decides to kidnap the daughter of a wealthy businessman. Something will go wrong.
notes: One of the best films of recent years arrives directly on TV. Not to be missed: it is the extreme portrait, unusual in form (so little homogenized to Western tastes) but current in content (nihilism, tragedy, sensuality of desperate lives), of a idea of ??cinema and, it goes without saying, of the world.

title: Committed
actors: Goran Visnjic, Heather Graham, Casey Affleck, Luke Wilson
description: Joline is a middle-class girl who is deeply convinced of the value of a marriage that lasts a lifetime. She is quite shocked, then, when she reads her husband's farewell note, who has left to "find himself". The woman does not give up and decides to set out in pursuit of her husband, abandoning her beloved New York to join him in the wild Texas ...
notes: Under the surface of a romantic comedy, illuminated by the verve of Heather Graham, lies a deeper reflection on the concept of commitment and the search for eternal love; it's a pity that all the good ideas are concentrated in the opening part of the film and in the long run the emotional dynamics become repetitive.

title: Leprechaun 4: In Space
actors: Warwick Davis, Tim Colceri, Guy Siner, Jessica Collins, Rebekah Carlton
description: This time the evil creature called Leprechaun kidnaps Zarina, a princess from a distant planet: her aim is to seize her powers to try to conquer the universe. To counter it, a commando of human beings ready for anything is sent into space ...
notes: The worst movie in the series.

title: Leprechaun 3
actors: Warwick Davis, John Gatins, Lee Armstrong, Caroline Williams
description: Transformed into a statuette but accidentally "awakened" by the careless (and unfortunate) owner of a pawnshop in Las Vegas, the evil Leprechaun tries to recover at any cost a magical gold coin that ended up in the hands of the unsuspecting student Scott .. .
notes: The saga of the hideous and greedy creature continues, but the level remains low.

title: Christmas Carol: The Movie
description: In Boston in 1857, the renowned writer Charles Dickens begins to tell a ghost story in a reading, in which the little mouse called Gabriel acts as a Greek choir. Through the point of view of the rodent, you swoop into the streets of London where rich and poor coexist and where Mr. Scrooge will soon be visited by Christmas ghosts of the past, present and future.

title: La ley del deseo
actors: Eusebio Poncela, Carmen Maura, Antonio Banderas, Bibí Andersen, Miguel Molina
description: Pablo Quintero, the famous gay director very close to his sister Tina, falls in love - not reciprocated - with Juan, to whom he writes ardent letters. Thus begins to attend Antonio, extremely possessive and jealous, arousing the ire of Tina, who hopelessly loves the same man. When Antonio discovers the letters Pablo sent to Juan, he has a disproportionate reaction ...

title: Semi-Tough
actors: Burt Reynolds, Kris Kristofferson, Jill Clayburgh, Robert Preston
description: Billy and Clyde are professional American football players and true friends, so much so that they share not only the apartment but also the girl: Barbara Jane Bookman, daughter of the Texan billionaire who owns the team where they both play. The young woman, after joining a religious sect, is convinced that she has to marry one of the two, but then ...
notes: Half sports parody and half satire of American religious confusion, the film seasons it all with a dash of libertinism, but is only rambling and independent on the surface. Based on a novel by Dan Jenkins, it inspired a short and homonymous TV series in 1980.

title: I tartari
actors: Orson Welles, Victor Mature, Folco Lulli, Liana Orfei, Arnoldo Foà
description: The Viking leader Oleg goes with his brother Eric to the Tatar camp where the great chief Trogul awaits them. He would like to establish an alliance with the Vikings to counter the advance of the Slavs. But when Oleg refuses, Trogul attacks him, trying to hurt him, but he's the one who gets the worst of it and succumbs. He is succeeded by his brother Burundai, thirsting for revenge also because his daughter Samia is in the hands of the Vikings and it is his intention to exchange her with Helga, the wife of Oleg, his prisoner. At the moment of the exchange, however, Burundai rapes Helga and she, for the shame suffered, tries to commit suicide. The situation worsened ...
notes: Historical-adventurous mess.

title: Race to Space
actors: James Woods, Annabeth Gish, Alex D. Linz, Wesley Mann
description: 1960s: the struggle between the United States and the Soviet Union for the conquest of space reaches its peak of intensity. Very ambitious projects are illustrated to the scientist Wilhelm von Huber, who recently moved to Florida. Above all, that of NASA to send a chimpanzee to the deepest galaxy, trained for the feat by a very fascinating trainer. The situation becomes complicated when even the son of the man of science is involved in the mad challenge in spite of himself ...
notes: Based on a true story, it fails to engage or break through the viewer's imagination. Also because of a James Woods to say the least subdued.

title: Deranged
actors: Roberts Blossom, Cosette Lee, Robert Wagner, Marcia Diamond
description: A Midwestern farmer, living with his mother's embalmed corpse, captures and kills other women to "turn" them into ladies-in-waiting ...
notes: B-movie of the 70s surrounded by a cult aura, more for the sick subject than for the (rather poor) realization.
