Despite the Oedipus complex, the film has little to do with _Psyco_ and instead refers to the atrocious case of Ed Gein, the "Plainfield butcher", one of the most notorious serial killers in American history. It seems that the Italian version is heavily cut. The special effects bear the prestigious signature of Tom Savini, Romero's long-time collaborator.

title: Tang ren jie xiao zi
actors: Fu Sheng, Sun Chien, Wang Lung Wei, Philip Kwok, Lo Meng

title: Elf
actors: Will Ferrell, James Caan, Bob Newhart, Edward Asner, Mary Steenburgen
description: A little boy raised by elves decides to find his dad.
notes: This wacky and funny fairytale, directed by Jon Favreau and starring Will Ferrell, one of the protagonists of the _Saturday Night Live_ and exceptional impersonator of George W. Bush, in America has made dizzying revenues.

title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre
actors: Jessica Biel, Jonathan Tucker, Erica Leerhsen, Mike Vogel, Eric Balfour
description: In a remote Texas farmhouse, five boys - Erin, Morgan, Pepper, Andy and Kemper - find themselves fighting for their lives against Thomas Hewitt and his gang of cannibals. The killer is best known as the Skin Face because he wore the grotesque flesh masks of his victims.
notes: It is not theoretical like _Jeepers Creepers_, nor inspired and volcanic like the unfortunately still unpublished in Italy _House of 1000 Corpses_ by Rob Zombie (true remake, albeit undeclared, of Hooper's work, from which Nispel copies some parts, such as the escape in the underground tunnels), but unrolls with decorum, and builds some good sequences (murder in the middle of the spread sheets). The gore is quite consistent, but we are on average levels (which today is no longer as low as recently: just look around). A mystery the credits of the Italian version: where are they?

title: In the Cut
actors: Meg Ryan, Mark Ruffalo, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Nick Damici, Susan Gardner
description: Frannie, an unsuspecting double-life literature teacher, starts a relationship with Detective Malloy, who investigates a serial killer. The heinous murders took place in the neighborhood where the woman lives and the first body is found right in her garden ...
notes: Between the folds of the thriller (which is quite usual) there is a family history "circumvented" with painstaking patience to build a balance: a father so fascinating that he has collected five wives and an indefinite number of girlfriends, mothers conquered, seduced and "killed" "from their partners, daughters (of different mothers) who otherwise keep their past at a distance. A dream of ice skaters closes the magnificent opening sequence and punctuates the film, increasingly hallucinated. Below, a ghostly version of _Que será será_ which immediately makes us guess the "other" dimension in which Campion (based on the screenplay by Susanna Moore, also author of the original novel) intends to transport us: straight into the cuts, the metaphorical wounds and real of the body of women, in desires, in nightmares, in memories never dormant. She comes out covered in blood, without an engagement ring, with a man tied to the bed, finally able to offer himself without dying. Jane Campion is one of the few true directors around: she knows how to use the genre to tell us more, she knows how to immerse herself in the metropolis to descend into souls. Noteworthy is the photography by Dion Beebe and the music by Hilmar Õrn Hilmarsson.

title: S.W.A.T
actors: Samuel L. Jackson, Colin Farrell, Jeremy Renner, Michelle Rodriguez, LL Cool J, Josh Charles
description: Agents Jim and Brian are kicked out of the S.W.A.T., special unit to which they belong, due to a decision made during a hostage robbery. As Brian quits his job, Jim agrees to be demoted, hoping to one day redeem himself. The opportunity arises when the squad commander is tasked with training five agents for a new S.W.A.T. The group goes into action to arrest a French drug kingpin.
notes: Inspired by the well-known TV series of the 70s, the film required the actors a preparatory training similar to that of their characters.

title: Son de mar
actors: Jordi Mollà, Leonor Watling, Eduard Fernández, Sergio Caballero
description: One day in late summer, Ulises, the new literature teacher of the local school, arrives in a small town on the Spanish coast. The man has the opportunity to discover the sensuality of the Mediterranean and to meet Martina, who prepares delicious fries for him. The two fall in love, and after some time she becomes pregnant. One morning, however, Ulises goes out to go fishing for tuna and disappears. Martina, left alone with a small child, resigns herself to marrying Sierra, a wealthy local builder. But Ulises reappears ...
notes: Bigas Luna did better, but also much worse. Sensually photogenic Watling, while poor Mollà sports a Raz Degan look.

title: Gli angeli di Borsellino (Scorta QS21)
actors: Brigitta Boccoli, Pino Insegno, Tony Garrani, Alessandro Prete, Cristiano Morroni, Ernesto Mahieux
description: Emanuela Loi, Agostino Catalano, Vincenzo Li Muli, Eddie Cosina, Antonio Vullo and Claudio Traina make up the escort "Quarto Savona 21". They were assigned the task of protecting the deputy prosecutor of Palermo, Paolo Borsellino, even at the cost of his own life. An increasingly difficult task especially after the Capaci massacre when the six "moving targets" try in every way to avert what appears to be an announced catastrophe.
notes: The Borsellino outlined by Tony Garrani is ridiculous for its superficiality, the foreman Pino Insegno seems to have come out of one of the teleparodies of the _Premiata Ditta_ and the repentant of Ernesto Mahieux is a stereotype in the (im) pure state.

title: The Knack
actors: Rita Tushingham, Ray Brooks, Michael Crawford, Donald Donnelly
description: England, the 60s. The young Colin, a sexomaniac teacher, convinces his friend Tolen to teach him his personal technique of conquering women ...

title: Tuck Everlasting
actors: Alexis Bledel, William Hurt, Sissy Spacek, Ben Kingsley, Amy Irving, Jonathan Jackson
description: Winnie Foster, a teenager who dreams of a life far from her mother's control, meets Jesse Tuck, a boy different from the people she knows, by chance in the woods. He and his parents immediately welcome her together as if she were part of the family. The Tucks, however, hide a secret that cannot be revealed, on pain of the transformation of the world in which they live: after drinking the water of an enchanted stream they fell victim to a spell that made them immortal and therefore destined never to grow old.
notes: The staging, the script, the rhythm, the flat sequences and the definition of the characters are like a good Disney Channel primetime movie. The director, Jay Russell _ (My dog ??Skip) _ has a better cast than the usual ones involved in these cases and uses it at low speed.

title: Alexandra's Project
actors: Gary Sweet, Helen Buday, Bogdan Koca, Jack Christie, Samantha Knigge
description: Steve received the much-needed promotion on his birthday. He returns home looking forward to the surprise party that his wife Alexandra will surely have organized. But when he arrives the house is deserted: waiting for him there is only a videotape with the words "Look at me" in which his wife and two children wish him good wishes. When the children walk away from the screen, Alexandra starts a very seductive streptease, but then a gun is pointed at her on the video. Steve seeks help ever since, but finds he is completely isolated. He just has to watch the rest of the movie ...
notes: The layout and many passages are superficially reminiscent of certain Michael Haneke (_Benny's video_, _Funny Games_), but basically it is the umpteenth crush of an overrated (and awarded) author at the beginning.

title: Bharat Mata
actors: Nargis, Sunil Dutt, Rajendra Kumar, Raaj Kumar, Kanhaiyalal

title: Al cuore si comanda
actors: Claudia Gerini, Pierfrancesco Favino, Pierre Cosso, Sabrina Impacciatore, Giovanni Esposito
description: Thirty-year-old Lorenza has not yet found the man of her life. She then decides to hire a man who is nice to her and who acts as her companion. The choice falls on Riccardo, a whimsical trumpet player always broke who, after some time, takes her to bed. Lorenza goes into crisis the day she meets Giulio, a charming dentist with whom she begins dating. The time has therefore come to fire Riccardo, but it is not an easy task.
notes: Favino does what he can (a little), and at a certain point they even sing a song at the piano bar; Gerini agitates painfully, the supporting actors are unbearable. The debut of Morricone's son is a real disaster.

title: Crash Point Zero
actors: Treat Williams, Julie St. Claire, Susan Blakely, Sean Kanan, John Beck
description: Maurice Hunter and his daughter Nadia discover in Siberia, a legendary death ray invented by Nicola Tesla (sic). They try to return to America to deliver it to the CIA but the plane is hijacked and a struggle for survival begins.
notes: Fearsome collage of scraps of other films on the snow.

title: Air Bud: World Pup
actors: Kevin Zegers, Dale Midkiff, David Glyn-Jones, Caitlin Wachs
description: Josh and Tom, the aces of the school's football team, learn a curious news from coach Montoya: alongside them the sweet English girl Emma will also take the field! It happens that the girl owns a golden retriever named Molly: who obviously won't be long in making friends with Bud, Josh's sporty dog ??...

title: Air Bud. Golden Receiver
actors: Kevin Zegers, Cynthia Stevenson, Nora Dunn, Perry Anzilotti
description: When the veterinarian Patrick gives a football to Buddy, Josh's dog, the athletic animal discovers a new vocation, to the point of even finding a place on the school team. But Buddy's fame reaches the ears of two bad guys, who plan to kidnap him ...
notes: Sequel to _Air Bud_ (1997).

title: Eloise at the Plaza
actors: Sofia Vassilieva, Julie Andrews, Jeffrey Tambor, Christine Baranski
description: Little Eloise has a whim: to participate in the debutante ball held at the Plaza Hotel, and moreover alongside the handsome prince charming (not much older than her, actually ...) on whom she has set her eyes. Meanwhile, the lively little girl will mediate between a reluctant "deb" and her haunting mom.

title: Nói Albinói
actors: Tómas Lemarquis, Thröstur Leó Gunnarsson, Elin Hansdóttir, Anna Fridriksdóttir
description: 17-year-old Nói lives with his grandmother and alcoholic father in Bolungarvik on a fjord in northern Iceland. In winter, when the village is completely cut off from the world, Nói dreams of escaping in the company of Iris, a city girl who has ended up working in the squalid local gas station. But the boy's clumsy escape attempts are doomed to fail ...
notes: Shocking ending. Great music by the director's group, Slowblow. Very simple cinema, very clear, beautiful, blinding and warm as the ice of a land that we would like to make "ours".

title: Tears of the Sun
actors: Bruce Willis, Monica Bellucci, Cole Hauser, Eamonn Walker, Johnny Messner
description: A.K. Waters, commander of a US Navy special team, is sent on a mission to the Nigerian jungle to rescue Dr. Lena Kendricks. The woman is willing to leave the country only on condition that the seventy refugees who are with her are also taken away.
notes: We are not spared any predicted and predictable stereotype, from the sunsets to the musicone (by Hans Zimmer and to think we once esteemed him), from the key sequences (the massacre in the village) to the villains. The American actor only acts with the folds of his eyes and mouth (and that's not a compliment).

title: Italian Sud Est
actors: Antonio Aluisi, Caterina Tortosa, Matteo Fraterno, Gianni Monteduro, Alberto Signore
description: Salento 2003. Several characters travel on the trains of the South-East, the almost disused railway that crosses the province of Lecce. Caterina talks to someone every day, listens to the stories that are told to her, takes notes. The stories speak of nomadic peoples, saints, fables, injustices, decay and abandonment ...
notes: Galloping on those strange local trains, the fragile backbone of a forgotten territory, a tangle of lost roads and logistical arrhythmias, the "investigation" goes on and on, stopping and starting again, meeting involuntary poets and their voices and their stories, entering the baroque dream with its styles, costumes and languages. Twenty characters in search of love, who move and move, "delirious" and go crazy. By expanding and shortening the times, faces, bodies, stories and landscapes embrace and exchange emotions. Because the sun never sets in the South.

title: Alex and Emma
actors: Luke Wilson, Kate Hudson, Sophie Marceau, Paul Willson, David Paymer
description: The brilliant writer Alex Sheldon is in crisis for lack of inspiration. To pay off a gambling debt and finally quit this vice, he must finish a novel within thirty days. Being without a computer, in the hands of creditors, he is forced to hire a stenographer, Emma, ??an orphan girl who raised her three sisters alone. While Alex tells the story, which is about a love triangle, the two fall in love with Emma, ??but the fiction has a lot to do with reality.
notes: The fusion between the plot of the film and that of the novel "in progress", while caressing the theoretical suggestions of the meta-story (with all the similarities and footnotes that the viewer autonomously brings to the film) is a game, at times funny and in others tired. If a romantic comedy (a kind of minimal slips in a very rigid grid), it works mainly thanks to the hormonal balance between the two protagonists, Luke Wilson and Kate Hudson, together, are "cute".

title: Sciopèn
actors: Giuliana De Sio, Michele Placido, Adalberto Maria Merli, Tino Schirinzi, Lino Troisi, Fabio Traversa, Anna Bonaiuto, Luigi Uzzo, Consuelo Ferrara, Carlo De Matteis
description: In the placid town of Chieti, two musicians wage their own private war for the direction of the local band. A local politician intervenes in the dispute, famous to the inhabitants for having previously participated in a music competition by passing off a piece by Chopin as the result of his work.
notes: Satire, at times simplistic, at times with subtle wit, of the "beautiful country" caught in its most provincial and mean aspects. Great all the cast.

title: Il sospetto
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, Renato Salvatori, Annie Girardot, Gabriele Lavia, Felice Andreasi
description: In 1934, a communist worker returned from France to fascist Italy, from which he had been expelled because he was accused of deviating from the party: in reality he was recalled to his homeland to investigate his comrades and identify an infiltrated spy ...
notes: Successful attempt by Maselli (also screenwriter, with Franco Solinas) to reflect on the conduct of parties in the dark years of the dictatorship and on the dramatic choices that are imposed on those who struggle between fidelity to principles and individual freedom. The performance of Gian Maria Volonté was extraordinary. Photography by Giulio Albonico and Sebastiano Celeste, music by Giovanna Marini.

title: Coup de tête
actors: Patrick Dewaere, France Dougnac, Michel Aumont, Jean Bouise
description: A soccer player ends up in prison after being accused of rape. Released due to pressure from the powerful sports club to which he belongs, he returns to the field to play the decisive match in the French Cup and wins his team. But to take revenge on the cruel mechanisms of the sports environment, he will not play the return match.
notes: Schematic and simplistic: a naive denunciation of the rottenness that exists in the world of sport.

title: Thirteen
actors: Evan Rachel Wood, Nikki Reed, Holly Hunter, Jeremy Sisto, Deborah Unger
description: Thirteen-year-old Tracy lives with her mother Melanie, who works as a hairdresser at home. She spends her days studying until she becomes friends with Evie, an orphaned mother of the same age, who initiates Tracy into a series of hitherto unknown experiences. It will be above all the relationship with Melanie to go into crisis, when the woman discovers that her daughter's life is characterized by sex, drugs and petty criminal acts ...
notes: Newcomer Hardwicke's film, which won various awards from Sundance to Locarno, was co-written by 13-year-old Nikki Reed, who plays Evie. In reality, the story is written and staged with consummate cunning, according to the unspoken rules of recent American independent cinema, and its merits are of narrative strength rather than freshness. If the direction has an eye in following the girls, it does not give up some vulgarity and easy shortcuts (starting from the choice of a very "cool" photograph). More than teenagers, the film tells of the squalor of the families of the lower white bourgeoisie (the "white trash"), in a not very new but still impressive way. While the bad girl is brunette as per North American literary tradition, the protagonist is blonde (actress Evan Rachel Wood comes from sitcoms). As the parent, Holly Hunter plays a couple of old-school mothers scenes from Actor's Studio.

title: He ni zai yi qi
actors: Tang Yun, Liu Peiqi, Chen Hong, Wang Zhiwen, Chen Kaige
description: 13-year-old Xiao Chun expresses himself more easily with the violin than with words. The father, a cook, has invested all his hopes in his son as a musician and leaves with him for Beijing to study him. In the big city the boy finds himself in a whole new world of feelings and possibilities never even imagined, where he will live the first sentimental experiences ...
notes: The elegant style of Chen Kaige _ (Goodbye my concubine) _, almost academic, which leaves room for plot twists, works enough, even if it gradually drags on towards a bad ending. It appears as a more affordable, less poetic (and poetic) update of his _Life hanging by a thread_ made in the early 1990s.

title: Et Dieu... créa la femme
actors: Brigitte Bardot, Curd Jürgens, Christian Marquand, Jean-Louis Trintignant
description: Juliette, a young orphan, is the protagonist of a hot summer in Saint Tropez. When the girl realizes that she has a magnetic charm on men, she goes wild without knowing that disappointments are lurking for her too.
notes: The narrative material is like a seaside film, however _Piace a too many_ became a manifesto for those preparing for the costume revolution of the 60s. Brigitte Bardot, icon of an imaginary ahead of its time, dictated for a long time the fashions and ways of an all-female emancipation. Revised today, Roger Vadim's film keeps its freshness intact.

title: Benny's Video
actors: Ulrich Muehe, Arno Frisch, Angela Winkler, Ingrid Stassner
description: Benny invites a friend over, and so far so good. They watch television, and nothing bad here either. Then the little girl asks what that strange metal object is. Benny tells her it's a gun to take down pigs and kills her, while her camera captures everything. The parents, at dinner, scold him and move on to something else.
notes: The masterpiece of the Austrian Michael Haneke is a disturbing apologue on the addiction to violence. If the horror of murder remains off screen, in order to avoid any spectacle, the moral abyss of a contemporaneity that trivializes death, hence life, bursts into the film.

title: La légende de Parva légende de Parva
description: Seventeen-year-old Parva was born at the same instant that a block of the purest sapphire collided with the earth. For this Parva has special powers and is linked to the fate of Prince Shiva who lives thousands of kilometers away. One evening the girl runs into an abandoned dog and decides to take care of it. The dog is actually a messenger who will take her to the island of Kiam where the prince is a prisoner of the tyrant Malaw.

title: The Iron Petticoat
actors: Bob Hope, Katharine Hepburn, James Robertson Justice, Robert Helpmann
description: Vinka Kovelenko, a Soviet general on a trip to Berlin, is joined as bodyguard by Charles "Chuck" Lockwood, an American pilot who tries in every way to convert her to the advantages of capitalism.
notes: Dull attempt to follow up on _Ninotchka_'s magic. Little rhythm and no really original gimmicks.

title: The Thin Blue Line
description: Mixing documentary artifacts, interviews and fictional sequences, the film that revealed Morris's work to the general public reconstructs the dynamics of the murder of a Dallas policeman for which a hitchhiker is indicted and convicted. Precisely by virtue of the theatrical release of this film, the trial will be reopened and the accused cleared after spending years on death row.
notes: Perhaps not the most beautiful of Morris's documentaries, but certainly the one who dared the most in reflecting on reality / fiction and which blurred the boundary between fiction and documentary. Morris's portrayal of the mechanics and functioning of the US judicial machine and the human beings working there is chilling.

title: Sotto dieci bandiere
actors: Van Heflin, Charles Laughton, Mylène Demongeot, Folco Lulli, Eleonora Rossi Drago, Gian Maria Volonté
description: Set during the Second World War, it narrates the exploits of Captain Rogge (who will recall the incident in an autobiographical book) who, aboard a pirate ship in the pay of the German navy, fights fiercely against the allied fleet.
notes: War film, among the few of pro-German production. To be looked at more as a curious object of propaganda; as an adventure film it is a mediocre product.

title: Il garofano rosso
actors: Miguel Bosé, Denis Karvil, Elsa Martinelli, Marisa Mantovani
description: Alessio is the scion of a wealthy Sicilian family who sent him to study in Syracuse. Full of ideals and energies, the boy lets himself be carried away by the rebellions of his friend Tarquinio and by the delicate feeling towards his contemporary Giovanna.
notes: From a novel by Vittorini, a story that the almost novice Bosé portrays with sensitivity.

title: The Long Day's Dying
actors: David Hemmings, Tom Bell, Tony Beckley, Alan Dobie
description: While waiting for help, John, Cliff and Tom - three British soldiers trapped in German territory - capture the Nazi officer Helmut. To avoid being executed on the spot, Helmut offers to guide them ...
notes: A strong war drama, which at the time was awarded at the Cannes and San Sebastian festivals.

title: Mystery Submarine
actors: Macdonald Carey, Marta Toren, Robert Douglas, Ludwig Donath, Carl Esmond
description: After the Second World War, a submarine of the German fleet continues a personal war against allied ships in the Pacific. An American spy manages to infiltrate the crew and defuse their war force.
notes: An ineffective flashback structure unnecessarily complicates an unsolved film, perpetually undecided between adventure and melodrama.

title: The Shooting
actors: Will Hutchins, Millie Perkins, Jack Nicholson, Warren Oates, Charles Eastman
description: An enigmatic and mysterious woman pays two men to guide her in the desert. In reality, his aim is to kill the brother of one of his guides. To do so, he also hires a killer and the small group will move towards a hallucinated and unusual ending.
notes: A low-cost western that hides a psychological drama structure behind the coordinates of the genre, and that is tinged with unexpected tragic shades. It went unnoticed at the time of its release and was slowly rediscovered and re-evaluated. The ending is still unsettling today. A young Jack Nicholson in the role of the killer.

title: La poison
actors: Michel Simon, Germaine Reuver, Jean Debucourt, Jeanne Fusier-Gir
description: Exasperated by an alcoholic, vulgar and filthy consort, Paul Braconnier turns to lawyer Aubanel, pretending to have already eliminated the hag and asking him to find the appropriate legal quibbles. Then take action ...
notes: Redone - but the comparison is impossible - in 2001 by Jean Becker (Murder in Paradise).

title: Faisons un rêve
actors: Sacha Guitry, Raimu, Jacqueline Delubac, Arletty
description: A couple is invited to the home of a playboy lawyer, who aims to become the woman's lover.
notes: Movie theater, from the play by Guitry staged in 1916, to which, however, for its cinematic passage, the director has added a festive prologue (taking advantage of the new scene to include well-known faces of the cinema of the period) and cut the last act. There is him, her and the other, where the "other" side of the triangle is, irreverently, the husband. Who is also, even more surprisingly, an accomplice. Irresistible whirlwind of misunderstandings, amorous subterfuges, secrets and reversals that resonate like mocking and light-hearted jeers to the expectations of the public.

title: Le roman d'un tricheur
actors: Sacha Guitry, Serge Gave, Pierre Assy, Marguerite Moreno

title: A Patch of Blue
actors: Elizabeth Hartman, Sidney Poitier, Shelley Winters
description: Life was not tender with Selina: raised in a bleak family environment, she lost her sight in an accident caused by her mother. Handicapped in body and spirit, she tends to isolate herself from the world around her until the day when, during a walk in Central Park, she meets Gordon, an African American who is impressed by her despite her problems. Thanks to the man, Selina will be able to forget her past.
notes: From a novel by Elizabeth Kata, a discreet film that deals with the issue of handicap and the racial problem with sensitivity. Excellent performance by Shelley Winters, who won the Oscar for best supporting actress.

title: Kiss the Blood Off My Hands
actors: Burt Lancaster, Joan Fontaine, Robert Newton, Lewis L. Russell
description: Wanted for killing a man in a pub fight, former sailor Bill Saunders finds refuge in the apartment of Jane Wharton, a young nurse who tries to offer him human and medical help. But criminal boss Harry Carter, who witnessed the murder, is determined to exploit Bill's potential for his trafficking.
notes: In a London reconstructed at the table, Foster realizes a thriller without too much bite and with a strong melodramatic vein based on a rather confused script by Leonardo Bercovici. instead the music by Miklós Rósza is beautiful.

title: Francesco
actors: Raoul Bova, Amélie Daure, Gian Marco Tognazzi, Mariano Rigillo, Claudio Gioè, Paolo Briguglia, Erika Blanc, Sergio Romano, Gabriele Bocciarelli
description: Umbria, 12th century. Francesco, son of the rich merchant Pietro, spends his adolescence between parties and entertainment. One day, during a hunting trip in the forest, Francesco meets Chiara who is taking care of some lepers and is impressed by her strength of mind. Francis, stimulated by his example and by the reflections made in the prison in which he was locked up after the revolt in Assisi, decides to give all his father's treasures to the poor. Francesco leaves the city and reaches the church near the leper colony, where his friend Paolo found refuge. This is where the journey that will lead him towards holiness begins.

title: 101 Reykjavík
actors: Hilmir Snaer Gudnason, Victoria Abril, Hanna María Karlsdóttir
description: Hlynur is a listless, never grown up 30-year-old who lives with his mother Berglind. The guy spends all his time drinking, watching porn movies and surfing the Internet. On New Year's Eve he has a brief affair with Lola, a Spanish flamenco teacher, who becomes pregnant. But the unexpected is just around the corner: the girl is actually a lesbian and she is Berglind's own lover!
notes: Films with a slightly Pedro Almodóvar-like grotesque tone (not surprisingly the protagonist is Victoria Abril, one of the Spanish director's fetish actresses), who had some luck at the Locarno Film Festival. Kormákur's directorial debut, also an actor (he cuts himself a part in the film).

title: Pizzicata
actors: Cosimo Cinieri, Fabio Frascaro, Chiara Torelli, Paolo Massafra
description: 1943: shot down with his plane while flying over Salento, the Italian-American pilot Tony Morciano is picked up and cared for by the farmer Carmine Pantaleo and his three daughters; the second of which, Cosima, gradually brings Tony back to the cultural roots from which he comes. A feeling arises between the two, but in the meantime Cosima - unbeknownst to her - has been promised by her father to the wealthy landowner Pasquale ...
notes: On a mélo plot, the former documentarian Winspeare grafted, with interesting results, a series of socio-anthropological elements (starting from the dance mentioned in the title) that fully restore the spirit and warmth of the Salento land.

title: Beltenebros
actors: Terence Stamp, Patsy Kensit, José Luis Gomez, Geraldine James
description: 1962: The Englishman Darman goes to Madrid to eliminate an individual who had infiltrated the ranks of the underground Communist Party twenty years earlier. To get closer to the intended victim, Darman starts a romance with his mistress, the beautiful prostitute Rebeca ...
notes: An unsuccessful mess, technically licked but useless and presumptuous.

title: Sorority Girl
actors: Susan Cabot, Dick Miller, Barboura Morris, June Kenney, Barbara Crane

title: Lost Junction
actors: Neve Campbell, Billy Burke, Jake Busey, Charles Powell, Michel Perron
description: When the car leaves him near the town of Lost Junction, Mississippi, Jimmy McGee gladly accepts a ride from a nice lady in a Cadillac. The beautiful and young Missy offers him hospitality at her home and soon convinces him to leave with her for New Orleans. Only after, having set out on the road, does she reveal to him that the body of her husband Doc is in the trunk ...
notes: Masterson would like to make an ironic noir, but he makes a subdued film, with an anonymous male lead and an unlikely dark lady. The only sketchy characters, the almost total absence of verve in the dialogues and a chaotic second part do the rest.

title: The Undead
actors: Pamela Duncan, Richard Garland, Allison Hayes, Mel Welles

title: Lianna
actors: Linda Griffiths, Jane Hallaren, Jon DeVries, Jo Henderson, Jessica Wight MacDonald
description: Lianna, mother of two daughters, one of thirteen and the other of ten, is often in conflict with her husband Dick, a methodical man with a precarious and faithful job. She thinks she finds comfort in Ruth, a psychology teacher, a declared lesbian and older than her, who, having an easy game on her, seduces her. The two become lovers and, since Lianna has been thrown out by her husband, they decide to move in together. But soon Lianna will have to find a home and a job because Ruth pushes her away little by little with the excuse of avoiding chatter in the workplace.
notes: Sayles makes a film that pits the American middle class. A defect? It's a little too verbose.

title: The Saxon Charm
actors: Robert Montgomery, Susan Hayward, John Payne, Audrey Totter
description: Eric Busch and his wife arrive in New York to ask Matt Saxon to produce their play. Saxon's stubbornness, however, puts a strain on the marriage.

title: Machine-Gun Kelly
actors: Charles Bronson, Susan Cabot, Morey Amsterdam, Richard Devon

title: La salamandre
actors: Jacques Denis, Bulle Ogier, Jean-Luc Bideau, Véronique Alain

title: Roma città libera
actors: Vittorio De Sica, Andrea Checchi, Nando Bruno, Valentina Cortese
description: An intellectual, a thief, a typist live their daily life in the second post-war period. And around them the protagonists of a Rome fresh from Liberation, festive but in crisis and in search, above all, of a new rebirth.
notes: Happy, but misunderstood, attempt at contamination between neorealist aesthetics, detours into comedy moods, and French cinema poetry. The acumen of Ennio Flaiano, among the screenwriters, reigns over the rest, who actually suffers from a certain neglect in the details of shooting and staging. The work manages to elicit some laughs, but in general it is the spaces of bitter reflection that dominate the rest of the narrative.

title: The Best Man
actors: Taye Diggs, Nia Long, Morris Chestnut, Monica Calhoun, Harold Perrineau jr.
description: While awaiting the publication of his first novel, Harper agrees to be the best man at the wedding of his friends Lance and Mia. Given that the plot of the book is largely autobiographical, the neo-writer fears that family members and acquaintances may recognize themselves behind the literary fiction. This also applies to the story Harper had with Mia some time ago; and since one of the bride's bridesmaids, the television reporter Jordan, managed to get hold of a copy of the novel in advance, for poor Harper the worst is really looming ...
notes: Pleasant "all black" comedy produced by Spike Lee.

title: Teenage Cave Man
actors: Robert Vaughn, Leslie E. Bradley, Frank de Kova, Marshall Bradford

title: Ju-on 2
actors: Noriko Sakai, Chiharu Nîyama, Yui Ichikawa, Shingo Katsurayama

title: Return of the Secaucus 7
actors: Bruce McDonald, Maggie Renzi, Adam Le Fevre, Gordon Clapp, Karen Trott
description: A group of friends, all former sixty-eightes, are in New Hampshire at Mike and Katie's house to spend the weekend. The thing that unites them is the fact that they are in an existential, love or professional crisis. The two days spent together will bring out some small discussion, but, in the end, one way or another the optimism will win.
notes: Low budget debut for novelist and screenwriter John Sayles, who in the following years will become the champion of American independent cinema. Many denounced a strange similarity of _The great cold_ to this film, certainly not Sayles who, for the occasion, edited the editing. Maggie Renzi, on the other hand, organized the production.

title: Clockstoppers
actors: Jesse Bradford, Paula Garcés, Robin Thomas, French Stewart, Billy Mayo
description: Zak is a teenager like many others, who wants to buy a car and conquer Francesca, the beautiful schoolmate. His life changes when, together with the girl, he finds a clock able to stop time among the old objects of his inventor father. Initially the two have fun with the wonderful trinket, but soon find themselves having to escape from a shady figure intent on using the clock to ... dominate the world.
notes: Adventure for teenagers of the most obvious. The direction of Frakes, coming from _Star Trek: Next Generation_ (played William Ryker) and not very convincing even in that venue is not an added value.

title: Shuang tong
actors: Tony Leung Ka Fai, David Morse, Rene Liu, Dai Li Zen
description: Detective Huang Huo-tu is broken. After he denounces the internal corruption in the police force, he is given a new post in foreign affairs. But his colleagues are hostile to him and his wife wants a divorce. When a serial killer commits three heinous crimes, Taiwan is forced to seek the intervention of its best ally, the United States, and the FBI hires an expert, Detective Ritcher, to investigate. Since a foreigner is involved in the case, Huang can finally get back to handling the case ...
notes: Anyone looking for a thunder and lightning action, however, should refrain. It's nice to find an actor with all the trimmings like Tony Leung Ka-fai (the one from L'amante, not the one from In the Mood for Love, whose name is Chiu-wai). Unexpected, quite shocking, the final massacre. In many ways, a missed opportunity, even if not to be thrown away: the seeds are there, but they have not bloomed as they could and should have.

title: Chik yeung tin sai
actors: Shu Qi, Vicki Zhao, Karen Mok, Song Seung-heon, Yasuaki Kurata
description: Sisters Lynn and Shue are two very skilled murderers who, to commit crimes, use their physical ability and an ingenious system of cameras and spy satellites devised by their late father. In this way they manage to complete even the most impossible missions. But things get complicated when a female cop goes after them.
notes: In this film directed by Corey Yuen (he had signed _The Transporter_ with Louis Leterrier), there is no feeling (the intimate parentheses, with music à la Fausto Papetti, are disgusting), there is no participation, nor from either side of the screen.

title: Freaky Friday
actors: Jamie Lee Curtis, Lindsay Lohan, Mark Harmon, Harold Gould
description: Dr. Tess Coleman doesn't get along with Ann, her 15-year-old daughter. They have diametrically opposed tastes in terms of clothes, hats, music, men ... But one day, a Friday, they wake up in each other's body. Forced to literally exchange parts, they begin to understand and have respect for each other's points of view.
notes: Waking up in someone else's body can be a Kafkaesque nightmare or a great starting point for a funny comedy. Mary Rodgers' book represents the second option well and Disney in '76 drew from it _All Happened on a Friday_ of which _That crazy Friday_ is the successful remake.

title: Spartaco ­ Il gladiatore della Tracia
actors: Massimo Girotti, Gianna Maria Canale, Carlo Ninchi, Ludmilla Tchérina, Vittorio Sanipoli
description: Captured and enslaved by the Romans, Spartacus flees from his master and leads a gladiator revolt. The clash with the Roman army will cause a bloodbath.
notes: The life of the Thracian hero is interpreted by Freda and collaborators as a succession of spectacular adventures. Without infamy and without praise, in pure Cinecittà style.

title: Sea Devils
actors: Yvonne De Carlo, Rock Hudson, Maxwell Reed, Denis O'Dea
description: The war between Spain and England is raging: we are in 1800 and in the English Channel (the strait) the fishermen of the small island of Guernesey, the sparrow hawks, take advantage of the hostilities between the two countries to prosper with the smuggling of cognac. One of the smugglers saves a beautiful English spy from French captivity in charge of stealing information on the movements of the Napoleonic troops and falls in love with her.
notes: Loosely inspired by Victor Hugo's The Workers of the Sea, the film mixes adventure and melodrama with good results.

title: Spasms
actors: Peter Fonda, Oliver Reed, Kerrie Keane, Al Waxman, Miguel Fernández
description: In New Guinea, an indigenous tribe conjures up a serpent-god every seven years who sows death and destruction among the population. A billionaire obsessed with monster legend hires a hunter to uncover the truth about the giant reptile.
notes: Nice special effects by Dick Smith and a successful dramatic crescendo for a slightly overused subject.

title: Speed Cross
actors: Fabio Testi, Vittorio Mezzogiorno, Daniela Poggi, Lia Tanzi
description: Two professional motorcyclists compete for the love of the same woman, but find themselves united in the moment of opposing the criminal gang that wants to make up races and bets.
notes: Film that alternates sports performances and sentimental brackets with a certain amount of professionalism. The scenes dedicated to the reckless motocross races are not badly shot.

title: Speed Driver
actors: Fabio Testi, Orazio Orlando, Senta Berger, Francisco Rabal
description: From the same director of Speed ??Cross, and with the same lead actor, a film that is the ideal follow-up: a motorcyclist recycles himself as a Formula One driver to try to help his drug addict brother, but ends up in the drug trade.
notes: A comic without interest, which takes advantage of the success of the first episode.

title: Spooks Run Wild
actors: Bela Lugosi, Leo Gorcey, Bobby Jordan, Huntz Hall, Ernest Morrison
description: A group of young New Yorkers, on vacation at a summer camp, discover an abandoned house where they meet a strange pair of monsters: a hideous and tender creature and its dwarf friend.
notes: Funny and anomalous little horror that plays on the meeting / clash of characters and on the staging of paradoxical situations.

title: Captain Clegg
actors: Peter Cushing, Patrick Allen, Michael Ripper, Martin Benson, Oliver Reed
description: A pirate believed to be dead by everyone hides under the false guise of a country vicar and puts his experience as a smuggler at the service of the small town that hosts him, helping parishioners in the illegal alcohol trade.
notes: Remake of Dr. Syn from 1937, a pleasant comedy, with no rhythm and with a likeable protagonist.

title: Lo spettro
actors: Barbara Steele, Peter Baldwin, Leonard G. Elliot, Harriet White
description: Margaretha Hichcock, in league with her lover, kills her husband by denying him the serum that cures him from a severe form of paralysis. Forced to stay in the dead man's villa to search for the mysteriously disappeared family treasure, the two accomplices have to deal with the ghost of the corpse that reappears for revenge.
notes: Freda follows up on Dr. Hichcock (1962), immersing the material in a gothic universe, where the episodes of violence explode in colors of great visual impact. Here Freda, who signs himself under a pseudonym, does not hold back his lyrical talent, and creates one of his best horror films.

title: The Thief
actors: Ray Milland, Martin Gabel, Harry Bronson, Rita Vale, Rex O'Malley
description: An American scientist makes a fatal mistake: to sell, through an agent, some documents reserved to the secret services of a foreign power. The guilt for having betrayed his country gnaws at him, the FBI is after him: and when his intermediary dies ...
notes: Known for being perhaps the only sound film completely devoid of dialogue, scripted by the director together with Clarence Greene: an atypical "spy story" that well defines the paranoid climate of McCarthy America, plunging the protagonist into a Kafkaesque hell. At times the suspicion of a virtuoso - but somewhat an end in itself - an exercise in style creeps in.

title: The Groundstar Conspiracy
actors: George Peppard, Michael Sarrazin, Christine Belford, Cliff Potts, James Olson
description: The explosion in an American space center causes a scientist to lose his memory, who later discovers that he was a spy. The American secret services try to get his memory back, to use the information in his possession.
notes: Medium-level spy story, which does not reserve many surprises and which in some moments borders on science fiction.

title: Master & Commander. The Far Side of the World
actors: Russell Crowe, Paul Bettany, James D'Arcy, Edward Woodall, Chris Larkin, Max Pirkis, Jack Randall, Max Benitz, Lee Ingleby, Robert Pugh, Richard McCabe, Billy Boyd
description: On board his "Surprise", Captain Jack Aubrey sets out in pursuit of the much larger and more powerful Napoleonic frigate "Acheron", which threatens His British Majesty's whalers off the coast of South America. But the obstacles to overcome are many, the crew has been trained in a hurry and soon rivalries and jealousies begin ...
notes: Almost entirely set and shot on awkward and bulky ships, the film is pleasantly interwoven with the mestizo "oceanic" culture of Weir and Crowe himself. About Russell: once again his transformation is extraordinary. He is the only actor in the world who today manages to pass from the role of a Roman gladiator to those of a mathematician and a leader with impressive naturalness and absolute credibility. His performance holds up for at least fifty percent this pachydermic - and yet fascinating - marine film of the Nelsonian tradition.

title: Ah! Si j'étais riche
actors: Jean-Pierre Darroussin, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Richard Berry, François Morel
description: Aldo, a representative of hair products about to get divorced, wins € 10 million in the lottery. The same day he finds out that his wife is cheating on him with her new boss. For this he decides to keep his winnings hidden, so as not to have to divide his new fortune. From this moment he begins to live two parallel lives: on the one hand he allows himself every kind of luxury, on the other he pretends to be poor.
notes: The pace is fast, despite a not very brilliant script, which covers its gaps with a handful of guessed and scoring lines. The lead actor, as mentioned, gets in on it. Followed, a tad bit below, by a Richard Berry who wants to take a risk on land that is not his. While Valeria Bruni Tedeschi strives to get out of her own way by playing the role of a woman who acts as a sunny post scriptum to the one played in _It's easier for a camel ..._, her recent directorial debut.

title: Finding Nemo
description: The little fish Nemo gets lost and ends up in a dentist's aquarium in Sydney. His father, Marlin, sets out on his trail and faces a path full of obstacles to save his little son helped by various marine animals.
notes: Beyond the edifying plot, with the double path of growth of father and son, the film gives in to the cuteness of the protagonists and while there are amusing parentheses, such as the group of vegetarian sharks, there are others less successful, on all the turtles who can say a sentence without the word "beautiful", pronounced in a few minutes a dozen times. The best part of Finding Nemo remains the escape from the aquarium, the only one to have a real villain, namely the little girl Darla accompanied by Psyco's music, and an anti-hero, the fish Gill expert in escapes.

title: Opopomoz
description: A Neapolitan family is preparing to celebrate Christmas in a special way: on the night of the eve a baby will be born, Franceschino. Everyone is happy except Rocco, the little brother, convinced that the newcomer will deprive him of the love of his parents. Meanwhile, in Hell, His Depth, who wants to prevent the birth of the Child Jesus, orders three little devils to find someone capable of carrying out the plan. The choice falls on Rocco who, after having pronounced the magic word "opopomoz", finds himself in Bethlehem.
notes: The film is a metaphor about a society that makes excessive use of "temptation" and the difficulty of raising children.

title: Fermate il mondo... voglio scendere!
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Barbara Steele, Paola Pitagora, Claude Vegas
description: A group of nonconformists go to live in a small apartment. One of them, Richi, takes advantage of being a ventriloquist to show up for a TV audition. The success of Richi pushes the other guys to abandon their attitude and try the road to success.
notes: Troubled first work by Cobelli.

title: Spirit
actors: Elisabeth Moss, Greg Evigan, Austin O'Brien, Ralph White, James Asmus
description: When their mother dies, Kelly and father travel to New Orleans to take possession of the new home. The girl soon realizes that the house is haunted by a ghost who asks her for help. Her father doesn't believe her, but Kelly, convinced that she is struggling with a spirit, calls in her brother Cole.

title: Hogoraka ni ayume
actors: Minoru Takada, Hiroko Kawasaki
description: The young criminal Kenji likes to spend his time amidst booze and fights. One day he meets the sweet Yazue and falls in love with her; but she discovers his true character and leaves him, at least until he repents. Changing your life, however, is not easy ...
notes: One of the seven films made by Ozu in 1930, still silent and inspired by American cinema.

title: Shukujo to hije
actors: Tokihiko Okada, Hiroko Kawasaki, Satoko Date, Choko Iida
description: Far from considering the idea of ??shaving, a slightly scruffy student has a face as bristly as a porcupine. But when - at the suggestion of a friend - he finally decides to put his hand to the razor, his appearance improves to the point of making him a heartbreaker ...
notes: Curious story belonging to the pre-sonorous period of the master.

title: Dukhovnye golosa
description: Divided into four parts, the fluvial "stalking" of the grueling daily routine of the Russian soldiers stationed on the border between Tajikistan and Afghanistan. Flat and empty days alternate with moments of action, in a state of perennial suspension made palpable by Sokurov's participation and lyricism.

title: A mi madre le gustan las mujeres
actors: Leonor Watling, Silvia Abascal, María Pujalte, Rosa María Sardà, Eliska Sirová, Chisco Amado
description: Three sisters, Elvira, Sol and Gimena come together to celebrate the birthday of their mother Sofia, a famous pianist who takes the opportunity to announce her engagement ... With a woman. The daughters do not digest the news and do everything to make their mother change her mind (they introduce a brilliant Czech pianist ...), but their efforts are worthless.
notes: In short, you have understood it: we are in the Almodóvar area, in the free and wild post-Franco Spain, in Madrid open to various and possible experiences, in the plot of the Feydeau-style comedy, good for all seasons. Pretty, certainly, brilliantly interpreted (but the one who stands out is the beautiful and talented Leonor Watling, former protagonist of Pedro's masterpiece, Parla con lei), colorful and cunningly grabbing, "transgressive" but underneath crossed by a very respectable bourgeois who, at the end, he puts things back in place, houses, churches and locks. To confirm that gay cinema, now a true genre of cinema (especially on the Eurasia axis), is irremediably homologating to the stylistic features, contents, forms and ideology of the older parent, meanstream cinema.

title: Depuis qu'Otar est parti
actors: Rusudan Bolqvadze, Nino Khomasuridze, Esther Gorintin, Dinara Drukarova, Temur Kalandadze
description: Tbilisi, Georgia. 25-year-old Ada lives with her mother Marina and grandmother Eka in an old apartment. Coexistence is not the best and only the news coming from Otar, Eka's son who emigrated to Paris, brings a breath of hope. When the man dies in an accident, Marina doesn't feel like telling her elderly mother and with Ada's complicity she keeps the news from her.
notes: Perhaps the Critics' Week award and the Caméra d'Or at Cannes 2003 were a bit too much, but the sympathy of this little debut is undeniable. More than in the construction or in the intensity of the style, the director is appreciated for the direction of the actors and for the intuition with which she chooses to tell the story from the bewildered point of view of the youngest woman in the family, Ada.

title: Looney Tunes: Back in Action
actors: Brendan Fraser, Timothy Dalton, Steve Martin, John Cusack, Heather Locklear
description: Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck continue to fight as usual. Tired of being in the background, the duck terminates his contract with Warner Bros. Without trying to dissuade him, Vice President Kate Houghton accepts the resignation and instructs aspiring security officer DJ Drake to escort Daffy to the exit. Left alone, Daffy decides to team up with DJ in the search for his father, a spy kidnapped by a gang of criminals ...
notes: Films of "creatures" that act as a counterpoint to the actors in flesh and blood (the sequence at the Warner restaurant is also memorable, with the Tunes bickering and dining at tables in the background) and of actors in flesh and blood trying to live as cartoon (Brendan Fraser, who is not by chance a stuntman, Joan Cusack and above all Steve Martin, almost unrecognizable in the role of the very bad president of Acme), _Looney Tunes Back in Action_ will drive cinephiles crazy and maybe he will convince some kids to get carried away in the world naive who lives beyond the screen. A world where Las Vegas is that of _A dream long a day_ and Paris that of _An American in Paris_ (including the brilliant ride of Daffy and Bunny among the masterpieces of the Louvre, Dalì and Lautrec, Munch and Monet), which reveals his tricks between the folds of the frame, and which, although made of "cardboard", of light and shadow, is not aseptic and sterile as a video game.

title: Call Me Claus
actors: Whoopi Goldberg, Nigel Hawthorne, Brian Mitchell, Victor Garber
description: When she was a child, Lucy Cullins had asked Santa Claus to bring her father, a soldier back to Vietnam, but the tragic demise of her parent had turned the Christmas holidays into a time of sadness and bitterness. Now grown up, Lucy works as a producer on a cable TV dedicated to shopping; As it happens, during the casting for a series of commercials, the woman ends up hiring an elderly gentleman named Nick, who is none other than ... the "gift distributor" par excellence. Who, having reached the venerable age of 200, must find someone to replace him for the next two centuries. Could it be Lucy?

title: Alien
actors: Sigourney Weaver, Tom Skerritt, Harry Dean Stanton, Veronica Cartwright
description: Following the imprudent exploration of an abandoned spaceship, a monstrous being is introduced aboard the space freighter Nostromo who wreaks havoc on the crew. Of the seven people that make it up, at the end only Ripley and her cat remain: she will throw the creature back into the void of space and return safely to Earth. _Alien_ in the restored and digitally remastered version, with unpublished scenes and some scenes from the first version "filed" with imperceptible cuts, it is confirmed, a very remarkable film. Of the added images (a fight between Lambert and Ripley, a shot of the Alien hanging from chains before an attack), the most notable is Ripley's discovery of the "nest" with the remains of Brett and Dallas.

title: Daniel
actors: Timothy Hutton, Lindsay Crouse, Mandy Patinkin, Amanda Plummer
description: After the suicide attempt of his sister Susan Isaacson, Daniel, a pacifist activist and committed on the anti-nuclear front, is in search of the truth about his parents Rochelle and Paul and the validity of the trial that sentenced them to death. In full McCarthyism they had been accused of being spies paid by the Soviet Union.
notes: Sidney Lumet adapts the novel _The Book of Daniel_ (1971) by Edgar L. Doctorow which traces the true story of Julius and Ethel Rosenberg. The excessive use of the flash back makes the film rather tiring, even if the cut given to the story is rigorous and provocative.

title: The King Is Alive
actors: David Bradley, Bruce Davison, Romane Bohringer, Janet McTeer, Brion James, Jennifer Jason Leigh
description: A bus with eleven Western tourists breaks down in an abandoned village in the Namibian desert. When Henry expresses his fears about the fate of the group, the others - especially the Americans Ray, Liz, Ashley and Gina and the Parisian Catherine - are definitively paranoid. To distract themselves from the pangs of heat, hunger and dehydration, the "castaways" decide to organize a staging of the _Re Lear_: mutual rancor and poisons will soon come to the surface ...
notes: Fourth film labeled "Dogma 95", directed by one of the signatories of the manifesto: an exercise in improvisation and video-digital aesthetics.

title: L'effrontée
actors: Charlotte Gainsbourg, Clothilde Baudon, Bernadette Lafont, Julie Glenn, Jean-Claude Brialy
description: The fourteen-year-old Charlotte Castang clashes with the reality that surrounds her (including a family that is certainly not ideal) after meeting with her peer Clara Bauman, a pianist for whom she has great admiration, and with little Lulu, who instead demonstrates in towards him a similar devotion ...
notes: Around the excellent performance of the new daughter of Serge Gainsbourg and Jane Birkin, Miller (also co-writer) builds a film that is not excellent, but nevertheless interesting in its pungent exploration of the adolescent universe. The Italian subtitle comes from the song of the same name by Ricchi e Poveri, present in the soundtrack.

title: Stessa rabbia, stessa primavera
actors: Marco Bellocchio, Roberto Herlitzka, Luigi Lo Cascio, Maya Sansa

title: Next Stop Wonderland
actors: Hope Davis, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Ken Cheeseman, Pamela Hart
description: After a bad love affair, a nurse posts an ad in the marriage ads. Among the aspirants, she is attracted to an oceanographer, but chance makes sure they never meet.
notes: From the director of _The man without sleep_, an atypical and surprising _romantic comedy_, with semi-documentary appearances.

title: The Original Kings of Comedy
actors: Steve Harvey, D.L. Hughley, Cedric the Entertainer, Bernie Mac

title: La iena
actors: Cinzia Roccaforte, David D'Ingeo, Anna Maria Petrova, Jason Saucier
description: Emy is a beautiful woman who is a professional modeling. For some years she has been married to Max, a successful businessman, with whom she lives in Los Angeles. However, he always leads a life on the move and during one of his many business trips, she, who is alone in the house, is kidnapped by a criminal. Besides, the man has already taken Emy's sister prisoner ...
notes: One of the latest films by Joe D'Amato, made when the director's career was now wallowing in porn. It would like to be a soft-core thriller, but the intentions are not successful: the eroticism is very big and the suspense is hidden.

title: Sant'Antonio di Padova
actors: Daniele Liotti, Enrico Brignano, Vittoria Puccini, Glauco Onorato
description: Sicily, 1221. The Franciscan Antonio, shipwrecked on the island with his brother Giulietto, tells his story to the local bishop. Fernando, as Antonio was called before wearing the habit, was a Portuguese nobleman destined to become a knight. A serious episode forced him to abandon secular life and retire to a convent. After being in Africa and touring Europe with his trusted Giulietto, a friar minor from Italy, Antonio reaches Padua. The friar finds a city in the hands of usurers who, touched by his words, try to kill him by serving him a poisoned soup. But a miracle happens ...

title: The Servant
actors: Dirk Bogarde, James Fox, Sarah Miles, Wendy Craig, Catherine Lacey
description: Hired by the young, rich and noble Tony Mounset, the waiter Hugo Barrett senses the weak disposition of his new master and does not take long to conquer a dominant position, involving his mistress Vera in the game ...
notes: The claustrophobic staging by Losey and the script by Harold Pinter (in turn based on a novel by Robin Maugham) return in the form of a black comedy a stinging reflection on the relationships between classes. Amazing Bogarde, spearhead of a perfect cast: his perverse charm feeds a subtle but perceptible homosexual subtext, which at the time did not fail to cause scandal.

title: Mona Lisa Smile
actors: Julia Roberts, Kirsten Dunst, Julia Stiles, Maggie Gyllenhaal, Ginnifer Goodwin, Dominic West, Marcia Gay Harden
description: Katherine Watson, an idealistic and stubborn art history teacher, upsets the dull and repressive climate of Wellesley's girls' college (where America's richest and brightest girls study). Katherine encourages her students to look beyond the established in art and think for themselves.
notes: Between cintz and bon ton lessons, the female cast moves at ease: Julia Roberts is a modernized Katharine Hepburn; Kirsten Dunst, Julia Stiles, Maggie Gyllenhaal and Ginnifer Goodwin look like young women straight out of a Sirk movie, while Marcia Gay Harden is a fluffy marvel stiffened by busts and frustrations. An honest film, where the background, only at times unmasked, weaves an inextricable web.

title: Totò Sapore e la magica storia della pizza
description: Naples, 1700. Every day the young storyteller Totò Sapore tells of rich lunches and delicacies. His dream is to become a great chef and when he inherits four old pots his life is destined to change: any crap is transformed as if by magic into exquisite food. In this way, Totò becomes the cook of the king of Naples and at court he falls in love with the beautiful Confiance. But the evil witch Vesuvia, owner of the pots, is lurking.
notes: The characters are cute and especially the magic pots look good compared to other magical and animated objects from the Disney tradition of the past. The painful notes come from a dubbing that at various times is difficult to understand, perhaps for a slightly too daring use of the Neapolitan dialect and from the increasingly penalizing choice for Italian animated films to address an exclusively children's audience.

title: The Medallion
actors: Jackie Chan, Lee Evans, Claire Forlani, Julian Sands, John Rhys-Davies
description: Eddie Yang, a Honk Kong detective involved in a near-fatal accident involving a mysterious medallion, finds himself transformed into an immortal warrior who possesses extraordinary powers. With the help of colleague Nicole, Eddie tries to uncover the secret of the locket that someone wants back at all costs.
notes: Jackie is aging and this second "Westernized" artistic career is slowly but surely tarnishing the myth. Compared to before, however, we are no longer so sure that the stunts are all his work. Not to mention that film scripts are now mere pretexts for a succession of moderately funny, but overcooked actions.

title: Hollywood Homicide
actors: Harrison Ford, Josh Hartnett, Lena Olin, Bruce Greenwood, Lolita Davidovich, Martin Landau
description: Joe Gavilan and Kasey Calden, two detectives from the Los Angeles homicide squad, are investigating the murder of members of an up-and-coming rap group during a concert. In all likelihood, the instigator of the massacre is Sartain, a well-known producer of hip hop music, already suspected in the past of the murder of some artists who had tried to dissolve the contract with his record label ...
notes: Shelton, already a specialist in the sports sub-genre, directs something that looks like an "action movie", a film about a heterogeneous couple of detectives, a comedy, a tribute to the world of entertainment. In the end, however, it is just a flan.

title: O anjo nasceu
actors: Hugo Carvana, Milton Gonçalves, Maria Gladys, Norma Bengell
description: Santamaria is white and pervaded by mystical ignitions, Urtiga is black and naive: outlaws on the run and inseparable cronies, they enter a house and keep two women in prison. When will the advent of the "purifying angel" invoked by Santamaria?
notes: Milestone of the Brazilian "marginal cinema" of the 1960s.

title: Matou a família e foi ao cinema
actors: Márcia Rodrigues, Renata Sorrah, Antero de Oliveira, Vanda Lacerda
description: His parents slaughtered with stabs, a boy sees the film _Perdidos de amor_. A wealthy young wife wants to get a divorce. Passion (lesbian or otherwise) and blood on the edge of a precipice. A poor woman is killed by her husband ...
notes: Splinters of paroxysmal violence, interlaced by an elliptical and innovative style.

title: Miramar
actors: João Rebello, Giulia Gam, Diogo Vilela, Louise Cardoso, Maria Clara Abreu
description: Miramar is a filmmaker whose name reveals the obsession that devours him: the mutability, the mystery, the infinity of the sea surface. Which dominates almost every shot, between the beaches and streets of the southern area of ??Rio.
notes: Full of the most disparate quotations, a sort of "false autobiography" of Bressane.

title: São Jerônimo
actors: Everaldo Pontes, Hamilton Vaz Pereira, Helena Ignez, Bia Nunes
description: Jerome, a follower of Ciceronian philosophy, is examined by a divine court. After a dream in which the dilemma between doubt and faith is manifested, he accepts the conversion to Christianity and devotes himself to the study of the Holy Scriptures ...
notes: Filmed entirely in the desert "sertão" of northern Brazil.

title: Sermões - A história de Antônio Vieira
actors: Othon Bastos, Eduardo Tornaghi, Breno Moroni, Paschoal Villaboin
description: Father Antônio Vieira (Lisbon, 1608 - Salvador de Bahia, 1697): priest persecuted by the Inquisition for his positions against slavery and colonialism, but also a master of dialectics and Portuguese language.
notes: Bressane reinterprets the biography of Vieira, revived by de Oliveira in _Parole e utopia_ (2000).

title: Beach Red
actors: Cornel Wilde, Rip Torn, Burr DeBenning, Jean Wallace, Patrick Wolfe
description: During the Second World War, Captain MacDonald leads his troop unit on a suicide mission against the Japanese on a small Pacific island. The battle will end in a bloodbath.
notes: Shot with the Vietnam tragedy in mind, the film perhaps a little naively conveys a pacifist message and its style, unusually crude for the time, effectively renders the madness of war and the injustices of history.

title: Les espions
actors: Gérard Séty, Curd Jürgens, Véra Clouzot, Peter Ustinov, Sam Jaffe
description: A spy and a scientist who guards the secret of the atomic bomb find refuge in the Parisian asylum of Dr. Malic. But other spies converge inside the place of confinement, both Russian and American, prisoners of the obsession with mutual control.
notes: Designed at the table as a reworking of the Kafkaesque model, Clouzot's film fails to find its own balance and a precise stylistic will: poised between grotesque and psychological drama, it often slips into complacent mannerism. Based on a novel by Egon Hostovski.

title: Blithe Spirit
actors: Rex Harrison, Kay Hammond, Constance Cummings, Margaret Rutherford
description: During a séance a writer evokes the ghost of his first wife who still claims to be in love with him. In an attempt to take the ex-husband to the other world, the spirit causes the death of his second wife. United in the afterlife, the two women do not intend to give up their earthly love.
notes: Based on a comedy by Noel Coward, a delightful and extravagant work, full of humor and rhythm, which makes the most of the skill of the performers. Oscar 1946 for special effects.

title: El espíritu de la colmena
actors: Fernando Fernán Gómez, Ana Torrent, Isabel Telleria, José Villasante, Teresa Gimpera
description: Ana is a girl who lives in a remote country of Franco's Spain with her father, who is dedicated to the study of bees. One day she attends the screening of James Whale's _Frankenstein_ and is fascinated by the monster. More and more closed in her reverie, when she comes into contact with a republican looking for help because he is wounded, she confuses him with the monster of her cinematographic suggestions and welcomes him giving him help in an abandoned cottage ...
notes: Against the backdrop of the civil war, a delicate and poignant parable about the encounter between loneliness and the useless comfort that different people can give each other. First feature film by a secluded and rigorous director, who here signs his most lyrical and saddest work.

title: Antonia - Zwischen Liebe und Macht
actors: Alexandra Kamp-Groeneveld, Kai Wiesinger, Benjamin Sadler, Naike Rivelli, Vanni Corbellini
description: Student Antonia Scherer is young and beautiful, but far from wealthy. Count Leonard Ahrendorff falls in love with her and - despite the hostility of the family - marries her: shortly after, however, he dies tragically, leaving her a huge fortune. As often happens, money and power will bring dangers ...

title: Durango Kids
actors: Taylor Root, Austin Nichols, Brendon Ryan Barrett, Curtis Williams, Caitlin Lara Barrett
description: Spencer, a young boy with a passion for the West, convinces some of his friends that there is a hidden treasure in an old mine near a thriving town at the time of the gold rush. At the end of the school year, instead of leaving for the holidays, Spencer and his friends secretly organize the expedition.

title: It's a Very Merry Muppet Christmas Movie
actors: David Arquette, Joan Cusack, Matthew Lillard, William H. Macy
description: Greedy bank owner Rachel Bitterman has set her sights on the famous Muppets variety theater, intending to turn it into a nightclub. But the willing Daniel, an apprentice guardian angel, takes the field to save Kermit and his disrupted band of friends from the machinations of the woman ...

title: The Shu
actors: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Michael Bailey Smith, Marnie Alton
description: Kyle LeBlanc is an American who works in Russia, his wife is killed but the murderer is acquitted for lack of evidence. Kyle then becomes executioner and ends up in jail for his revenge. For Le Blanc it is a new hell: the warder manager organizes bets on fighting to the death between inmates.
notes: Last American effort by Ringo Lam, cult director of the Hong Kong new wave known above all for _City on Fire_ model of _Le Iene_. Here he directs Van Damme and does his best to create a harsh atmosphere and a dark "prison movie", too bad the script doesn't care about other characters besides the protagonist and you run into several clichés.

title: L'arbre de Noël
actors: William Holden, Virna Lisi, Bourvil, Madeleine Damien, Mario Feliciani
description: After school, Marcel, orphan of his mother, joins his father and leaves with him for the holidays. During a boat trip while Laurent is in the water, a military plane flying over the area explodes, dropping an atomic bomb with a parachute. Marcel remains contaminated ...
notes: The most tearful film of the 60s.

title: La vedova del trullo
actors: Rosa Fumetto, Mario Carotenuto, Carlo Giuffrè, Renzo Montagnani
description: Maddalena, a square widow of Nicola, lives in the last trullo left free of a Apulian village. The woman arranges himself making the nurse at Calogero's house, where he tries to keep his son Marco at bay. When the impersonator of the deceased arrives ...
notes: The protagonist, former stripper of the _crazy Horse_, exuberant.

title: American Outlaws
actors: Colin Farrell, Scott Caan, Ali Larter, Gabriel Macht, Gregory Smith
description: Plundered by a corrupt Missouri railroad tycoon, some rancheros join forces and begin robbing banks to get back what is rightfully theirs. Leading the group's revenge is a farmer from the Civil War, a young man destined to become a true legend of the West: Jesse James ...
notes: Yet another and tired reinterpretation of one of the myths of the Frontier, which claims to update the western by purifying it of its intrinsic violence and sprinkling it with do-gooders and claims in a "no global" style. The result is flat and televised, and the heroic bandit looks like a reassuring teen idol.

title: Trastevere
actors: Nino Manfredi, Rosanna Schiaffino, Vittorio De Sica, Leopoldo Trieste
description: An elderly opera singer loses his dog in the popular Trastevere district of Rome. The animal, wandering through alleys and squares and passing into the hands of temporary owners, is a "witness" to a series of episodes that enliven the life of the neighborhood.

title: Nico the Unicorn
actors: Kevin Zegers, Anne Archer, Larry Day, Michael Ontkean
description: Billy Hastings, a child unable to relate to the surrounding world, invents a magical dimension within which to escape. In this fantastic land, the little protagonist meets a unicorn, which gives him back the joy of living. Fairy tale taken from a children's book.

title: George Washington
actors: Donald Holden, Candace Evanofski, Damian Jewan Lee, Curtis Cotton III
description: In a sad little farming town in the southern United States, a 12-year-old boy, Buddy, is accidentally killed by his age George during an innocent game in an abandoned amusement park. George and his friends, forced to face the dramatic situation and make a series of difficult choices, will prove to be true contemporary American heroes.

title: Sinbad: Legend of the Seven Seas
description: Sinbad, the hero of the seven seas, is unjustly accused of stealing the Book of Peace. Instead of recovering the precious object and saving the life of Proteus, his best friend, Sinbad decides to take his crew to Fiji in search of sun and fun. But Marina, Proteus's fiancée, has clandestinely embarked on Sinbad's ship to ensure that Sinbad completes his mission and rescues her betrothed ...
notes: The world of Sinbad developed by the animators of DreamWorks is inspired by the magical world of Ray Harryhausen, one of the greatest creators of special effects in the history of cinema. Interesting is the 3D work conducted on the character of Eris (the goddess of chaos capable of assuming any form, who wants to hinder Sinbad's attempt to return possession of the book) and on the sirens, creatures that are born and merge in the splashes of water. But despite the best of intentions, not everything goes smoothly in the magical universe of Sinbad: paradoxically, starting from the story, which aims exclusively at a childish audience and which retains only a few glimpses of wonder from the ancient text. Even the quality of the "tradigital" (that is the mixture between the traditional 2D animation and the three-dimensional digital one) denotes, if not a step back, at least a certain impasse.

title: Salmer fra kjøkkenet
actors: Joachim Calmeyer, Tomas Norström, Bjørn Floberg, Reine Brynolfsson, Sverre Anker Ousdal
description: Immediately after the war, some experts in home furnishings discovered that to minimize the financial expenditure of families it was enough to rationalize the work in the kitchen. In the 1950s, 18 experts were sent to a Norwegian countryside village known for its large number of bachelors to monitor their cooking habits 24/7. The search for the ideal cuisine is actually an opportunity to explore the difficult world of human relationships ...
notes: A funny, humble and modest operina, which intends to do good (succeeding), while facing loneliness (which remains, for anyone, despite everything) with spirit and participation.

title: Natale in India
actors: Massimo Boldi, Christian De Sica, Enzo Salvi, Biagio Izzo, i Fichi d'India, Paolo Conticini, Clarissa Burt, Giulia Montanarini
description: Between the judge Enrico Paci, health expert and new age, and the engineer Fabio Detassis there is no good blood. Detassis has just managed to shady postpone a trial involving him. However, the two are on vacation in India in the same hotel and remember meeting for the first time in 1987, in a Roman clinic, where they both became fathers of two boys, born at the same time. The two sons, Costantino and Nelson, now sixteen, have characters opposite to those of their respective father: the judge's son is shrewd, ignorant and indifferent, while the other is healthy, cultured and honest.
notes: A global film that trotters, set with the remote control levers, vulgar even in the absence of swear words, coprofilo and sadomasochistic, wet from pissing and pervaded by a nice form of sexual perversion directed towards animals.

title: Il Paradiso all'improvviso
actors: Leonardo Pieraccioni, Angie Cepeda, Anna Maria Barbera, Alessandro Haber, Rocco Papaleo
description: Lorenzo is an unrepentant single, owner of an agency that creates special effects for cinema and TV and extremely satisfied with his life. His two best friends, Taddeo Borromini and Giandomenico Tardella (scions of two noble families who have always fought), greatly envy his freedom. But during a trip to Ischia, Lorenzo meets Amaranta, as fascinating as it is mysterious, and falls madly in love with her.
notes: Leonardo Pieraccioni continues to pamper his audience with his comedies water, neutral soap and syrup. Just that. Since he is an intelligent person, he should have noticed, for a few seasons, that his viewers have shrunk and the responsibilities are all with the actor-director. This market detail doesn't seem to bother him and he starts all over again from the quicksand he ended up in a few films ago.

title: The Dentist
actors: Corbin Bernsen, Linda Hoffman, Michael Stadvec, Ken Foree
description: Allan is a dentist with a seemingly perfect life: an established profession, a beautiful wife and no worries. But when he finds out that the woman is cheating on him, his revenge will be terrible ...
notes: Stereotypical characters and non-existent suspense where real torture is inflicted on the eyes of the spectators.

title: Ho visto le stelle!
actors: Vincenzo Salemme, Maurizio Casagrande, Alena Seredova, Claudio Amendola, Fabio Bosco
description: The forty-year-old Neapolitan Antonio works in his grandfather's newsstand from which he also inherited the dreamer character. After having participated in a competition in the Lombard capital to select competitors for a reality show, he begins to think that his life is a soap opera. So to gain the attention of others he decides to play the role of the gay. In this way, not only does he find work in the club owned by a boss, but he also has to take care of Alina, a beautiful Russian girl whose boss is in love and very jealous.
notes: Boredom and sloppiness are rampant on backgrounds that look like warehouse stocks even when they are shot from life.

title: Fire and Ice
description: As the Ice Age draws to a close, a deadly conflict pits the Kingdom of Ice, ruled by Queen Juliana and her son Nekron, to Tierra del Fuego, ruled by the ruler Jarol and daughter Teegra ...
notes: Comic book inspiration and pacifist ambitions for this "adult" cartoon directed by the author of _Fritz the cat_.

title: Road to Utopia
actors: Bob Hope, Bing Crosby, Dorothy Lamour, Hillary Brooke, Douglass Dumbrille

title: El Bruto
actors: Katy Jurado, Pedro Armendariz, Andrés Soler, Rosita Arenas

title: Street Trash
actors: Mike Lackey, Bill Chepil, Marc Sferrazza, Jane Arakawa, Nicole Potter
description: A liquor shopkeeper sells a liquor called "viper" to the homeless people in the neighborhood. It is actually a toxic liquid that dissolves the organs of the unfortunate.

title: Ohayô
actors: Keiji Sada, Yoshiko Kuga, Chishu Ryu, Kuniko Miyake, Masuo Fujiki, Eiko Miyoshi
description: Exasperated by the constant requests for a television from the two children, mom and dad force them to stay calm. And the kids take them at their word, refusing to utter a syllable: their forced silence will turn the whole neighborhood upside down ...
notes: Ozu takes up and updates his _I was born, but ..._ (1932).

title: Three Days
actors: Kristin Davis, Reed Diamond, Tim Meadows, Andrew Bush
description: Andrew, an established literary agent, has been married for ten years to Beth, with whom he has been in love since childhood. The marriage, however, did not work out as hoped, and moreover it is tragically interrupted by the death of Beth, who was killed just before Christmas. It will be an angel to give Andrew an unexpected chance ...

title: Un posto tranquillo
actors: Lino Banfi, Nino Manfredi, Nicole Grimaudo, Felice Andreasi
description: Four friars spend their days in a small convent immersed in the tranquility of the Tuscan countryside: Raniero, the gruff but nice guardian father, Gervasio, jovial but hypochondriac, the naive Bettino and Vittorio, an elderly friar who takes care of the vegetable garden. Antonio bursts into their daily routine and soon gains the trust of the three friars, but not that of Raniero, who looks at him with great distrust. Between the two begin real acts of espionage to try to find out something about the past of the other. Raniero rummaging in the cell where Antonio is staying makes a shocking discovery about an unspeakable secret ...

title: Lady and the Tramp II: Scamp's Adventure
description: Lady and the tramp live together in the house of the dog's owners. Soon their love is gladdened by the birth of four puppies, three females and one boy. The only male heir hates the rules and the quiet life and, having grown up, falls in love with a little dog fought over by other dogs.

title: The Bellboy
actors: Jerry Lewis, Bob Clayton, Alex Gerry, Sonny Sands, Eddie Shaeffer
description: Attentive but very clumsy, the laconic Stanley is the doorman at the Fountainbleau Hotel in Miami Beach. One day, star Jerry Lewis shows up at the reception: it's impossible not to notice his incredible resemblance to Stanley ...
notes: Lewis's directorial debut is also one of his best films, with a creative and essential comedy.

title: In the Light of the Moon
actors: Steve Railsback, Carrie Snodgress, Carol Mansell, Sally Champlin
